name: BRUNCH PIZZA SQUARES
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk pork sausage
1  (8 oz.) tube refrigerated crescent rolls
4  eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
1/8  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. shredded cheese
preparation: In a skillet, cook sausage over medium heat until no longer pink. Drain. Unroll crescent rolls into 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Press dough 1/2-inch up the sides and seal seams. Sprinkle with sausage.

name: GINGERED ICED TEA
ingredients:
2  tsp. fresh ginger, grated
1  qt. water (about)
juice of 1 or 2 lemons
honey to taste
preparation: Grate the ginger.  Brew it as you would regular tea in about 1 quart of water for 20 to 30 minutes.  To brewed mixture, add the lemon juice and honey to sweeten to taste.   Water may also be added if brew is too strong.

name: CHOCOLATE GLOB BARS
ingredients:
1  pkg. German chocolate cake mix
3/4  c. melted butter
1/3  c. evaporated milk
preparation: Mix together.  Place 1/2 of mixture in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 6 minutes.  Top with Caramel Mixture.  Pour on remaining cake mixture and bake 20 more minutes.

name: CHEESY BRAT STEW
ingredients:
6  fully cooked bratwurst or Polish sausage, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
4  medium potatoes (about 1 1/4 lb.), cooked, peeled and cubed
1 (16 oz.)  can green beans, drained
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese (about 4 oz.)
1  small onion, chopped
preparation: In 3-quart casserole, stir together bratwurst or Polish sausage, potatoes, green beans, cream of mushroom soup, Cheddar cheese and onion.

name: CUTOUT COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. shortening (1/2 butter and 1/2 Crisco)
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. sour cream
3  eggs
pinch of salt
4 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Mix together sugar, shortening, eggs, baking soda, salt and sour cream.  Stir in flour.   Dough will be soft.  Chill for 1 hour.  Roll out and cut. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Makes 6 dozen.

name: CHEESY HAM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. salad dressing
2  c. frozen broccoli or peas
2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
2  c. chopped ham (sliced)
2  c. corkscrew noodles, cooked and drained
1/2  c. green pepper
1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. seasoned croutons
preparation: Mix ingredients, except 1/2 cup of cheese and croutons.  Spoon into 2-quart casserole.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese and croutons.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CHILE CON CARNE
ingredients:
1-1/2 to 2  lb. chopped beef or pork
4  ripe tomatoes
Thai (small) red peppers (hot), to taste
1  clove garlic
Vegetable oil
Salt to taste
preparation: Cook meat in deep frying with enough water (4 cups) to cover meat until well cooked.  Meanwhile, blend garlic, tomatoes and peppers together.  Once meat is well cooked, drain out all the extra juices.  Add oil to pan and fry meat, stirring occasionally, until meat is browned.  Add the blended sauce and salt to taste. You could also add 2 tablespoons of El Pato sauce.  (This is a small can with a yellow label and a picture of a duck.)  Serve with red fried rice.

name: BEEF SHISH KABOBS
ingredients:
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. lemon juice
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  tsp. salt
2  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  lb. beef, cut unto 1 1/2-inch cubes
1  large green pepper, cut into 1-inch squares
fresh, medium sized mushrooms
small onions
cherry tomatoes
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients in a bowl.  Add beef cubes. Cover and refrigerate at least four hours or overnight, stirring occasionally.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  stick melted oleo
1  c. shredded coconut
1/2  c. Bisquick (I use Jiffy)
2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. coconut flavor
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Put all ingredients into blender for 30 seconds at low speed. Pour into ungreased 10-inch pie tin.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Cool, serve with Cool Whip.  Also good plain.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. shredded coconut
1  c. walnuts
preparation: Melt margarine in a 2-quart saucepan.  Remove from heat and stir in brown sugar.  Add eggs.  Beat well.  Add vanilla.  Beat well.  Stir together flour, baking powder and salt.  Add to brown sugar mixture.  Add coconut and nuts.  Mix well.  Spread in greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch baking pan.  Bake at 350° about 25 minutes.  Cut into bars while warm.  Remove from pan when cool. Makes about 36 bars.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
4  eggs, slightly beaten
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk, mixed with 2 tsp. baking soda
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
5  crushed ripe bananas
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
preparation: Mix buttermilk and baking soda in 2-cup measuring cup.  Cream butter with sugar until smooth; add eggs and vanilla.   Mix well. Add prepared buttermilk and soda mixture; stir.   Add flour mixed with salt; mix well.  Last, add bananas and nuts.  Mix thoroughly. Bake in loaf pans at 325° for about 1 hour or until done.  Yields 2 loaves.

name: HOT SHRIMP APPETIZERS
ingredients:
7  oz. Cheez Whiz
1/4  lb. butter, softened
1 1/2  tsp. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1 (6 oz.)  can shrimp or you can use cooked chopped shrimp
English muffins
preparation: Meat butter and Cheez Whiz; add all other ingredients. Let cool. Spread on 12 halves of English muffins. Cut each half into quarters. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and freeze. Pour into a freezer bag.

name: VANILLA PUDDING DESSERT
ingredients:
1  Jiffy yellow cake mix
2 small  pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
1  can crushed pineapple, well drained
1  (10 or 12 oz.) Cool Whip
1  c. crushed nuts (optional)
preparation: Bake cake mix in a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan as directed on package.  Mix pudding until thickened and fold in drained pineapple.  Pour mixture over baked cake. Cover with Cool Whip and sprinkle with nuts. Can be made a day ahead.

name: AVIATION CLUB DIP
ingredients:
2/3  c. mayonnaise
2/3  c. sour cream
1 1/2  Tbsp. dehydrated onions
2  tsp. dill weed
1/2  tsp. parsley
2  tsp. Beau Monde seasoning
preparation: Blend mayonnaise and sour cream.  Add remaining ingredients. Chill for 1 hour.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. mushroom soup, undiluted
1/2  tsp. minced fresh onion
1  beaten egg
cheese cracker crumbs
preparation: Cook broccoli about 8 minutes in boiling water.  Drain.  Mix mushroom soup, mayonnaise, onion, cheese and egg with broccoli.

name: GREEN RICE BAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. uncooked brown rice
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Cook the rice according to package directions.  Cook broccoli until tender.  Drain and set aside.

name: BARBECUE KIELBASA
ingredients:
2  pkg. smoked kielbasa, cut in 2-inch pieces
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
3  c. Open Pit barbecue sauce
1  c. water
2  Tbsp. butter
1  large onion, halved and sliced
1  large green pepper, cut in strips
preparation: Saute onions in butter.  Brown kielbasa in frypan.  Combine kielbasa, onions and green pepper in large covered pot or crock-pot.  Add brown sugar, barbecue sauce and water.  Simmer, covered, for 1 hour or until kielbasa is tender (longer, if in crock-pot).

name: CORN BREAD AND SAUSAGE STUFFING
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green bell pepper
2  tsp. poultry seasoning
1 1/2  tsp. thyme leaves
1  tsp. garlic powder
10  c. cooked and coarsely crumbled corn bread
1/2  lb. sausage, cooked and crumbled
1  can (14 ounces) chicken broth
1  pkg. turkey gravy mix, prepared (optional)
preparation: In a large skillet melt butter.  Add onion, celery and bell pepper; sauté 5 minutes.  Stir in poultry seasoning, thyme and garlic powder.  Combine corn bread, vegetable mixture and sausage. Add broth; toss gently.  Spoon into 13x9-inch baking dish.  Bake in a 350° oven 30 to 35 minutes.  Serve with turkey gravy, if desired.

name: FABULOUS FUDGE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2/3  c. undiluted evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. light or dark corn syrup
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1  tsp. vanilla
walnut halves
flaked coconut
preparation: In a quart saucepan, combine butter or margarine, milk, sugar and corn syrup, stirring constantly.  Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a full, rolling boil.  Cook 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Add chocolate pieces, marshmallows, chopped walnuts and vanilla to saucepan.  Stir vigorously for 1 minute or until chocolate and marshmallows are melted.  Pour into a buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.  Decorate with walnut halves or coconut.  Chill in refrigerator until firm, about 1 hour.  Cut into squares.  Makes 2 pounds.

name: CARROT SALAD
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots
1  green pepper, diced
1  medium onion
1/2  c. corn oil
1 1/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
1  can condensed tomato soup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Slice and boil carrots in salted water; drain and cool.  Do not overcook.  (I sometimes use 3 cans of carrots.) Slice onion and pepper and add to cold carrots.  Combine all other ingredients and heat; do not boil.  Pour over carrots.  Will keep in refrigerator for weeks.

name: SUGAR-FREE SWEET PICKLES
ingredients:
1 (46 oz.)  jar kosher dill pickle slices
30  pkg. artificial sweetener
1 (12 oz.)  bottle tarragon vinegar
preparation: Open pickles and drain.  Empty the sweetener on top of the pickle slices and pour the tarragon over the sweetener.  Do not heat anything.  Shake jar several times after you have tightened the lid firmly.  Then turn the bottle upside down to help the sweetener through the pickles.

name: RASPBERRY MINT CRUSH
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. lightly packed, fresh mint leaves
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen red raspberries
1 (6 oz.)  can lemonade concentrate
preparation: Combine sugar, mint leaves and 1 cup boiling water.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Add raspberries and concentrate; stir until thawed. Add 2 cups cold water and stir.  Serve over ice.

name: CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
1  boiled chicken
1 3/4  c. broth
1  c. cream of mushroom or celery soup
salt and pepper to taste
1  stick oleo
1  c. flour
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Layer chicken in bottom of dish.  Pour broth over chicken. Spread soup over chicken and broth; salt and pepper.  Make mixture of flour, oleo and milk.  Pour over meat mixture; it will be thin. Cook for 40 minutes at 350°.

name: BEER AND CHEDDAR CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter
1/2  c. 1/8-inch diced celery
1/2  c. flour
2 1/2  pt. chicken stock
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1/4  tsp. Accent
1/2  c. 1/8-inch diced carrots
1/2  c. 1/8-inch diced onion
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
8  oz. Cheddar cheese
1 (11 oz.)  bottle beer (flat)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Saute vegetables until done, but not browned.  Blend in flour, dry mustard and chicken stock; cook 5 minutes.  Blend in cheeses and beer.  Let simmer 20 minutes.  Season and serve with French bread and tossed salad.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: FRUIT BARS
ingredients:
4  c. cake flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. nuts, chopped up fine
1  c. coconut
1  c. vegetable shortening
1/2  c. oleo
preparation: Mix all together like pie dough.  Put half on bottom (pressed down) on cookie sheet with sides.  Add prepared apricot filling or other fruit.  Enough to cover the dough, don't over do it.  Put rest of dough on top.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: SPOON BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. white corn meal
1  tsp. salt
2  c. cold water
1  c. milk
3  eggs, well beaten
2 to 3  Tbsp. melted shortening
preparation: Mix cold water with corn meal and salt.  Boil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Then stir in milk, eggs and lastly, melted shortening.  Mix well and pour into a heated, well-greased casserole.  Bake in a 400° oven for about 50 minutes or until the top is firm and well browned.  If any is left over, it is good warmed over with a lump of butter on top.

name: CREPES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. milk
3/4 to 1  c. Wondra flour
dash of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. Wesson oil
preparation: Beat eggs and milk together.  Add salt and vanilla.  Slowly add flour and beat by hand.  Using a small frying pan put in enough oil that would cover crepe.  Make oil hot.  Pour batter in pan.  Fry lightly; turn and do other side.  You can use syrup or jelly and jam on crepe.

name: PEACHY PORK PICANTE OVER RICE
ingredients:
1  lb. pork, cut into cubes
2  tsp. oil
1/3  c. peach jelly
1  Tbsp. taco seasoning mix
1  (8 oz.) salsa
rice, cooked
preparation: Coat pork with taco seasoning mix; brown in oil.  Add salsa and peach jelly.  Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.  Serve over rice.

name: CREAMY ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
1  qt. creamed cottage cheese
2  c. Cool Whip
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. orange gelatin
2 (11 oz.)  cans mandarin oranges, drained
preparation: Fold Cool Whip into cottage cheese, blending well.  Sprinkle the dry gelatin into the mixture and stir gently to combine.  Stir in mandarin oranges.  Refrigerate until firm.

name: PHYLLIS' LIMA BEANS
ingredients:
1  (20 oz.) sack frozen fordhook limas
3  slices bacon
1  c. chopped onions
1  c. chopped celery
1 large  can tomatoes
1  tsp. sugar
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook the limas for a few minutes in the microwave.  Fry the bacon; remove bacon.  Saute onions and celery in bacon grease. Add the tomatoes.  Add beans, bacon, sugar and salt and pepper to taste.  Cook down.

name: DEATH BY CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
1  pkg. brownie mix, baked
3  pkg. Jell-O chocolate fudge mousse pudding mix, made according to directions and chilled*
1  large Cool Whip
6  Heath bars (regular size), crushed
preparation: * Four boxes of Jell-O instant chocolate or chocolate fudge pudding can be substituted for mousse.

name: CHICKEN CRANBERRY LAYER
ingredients:
1  pkg. gelatin
1/4  c. water
1 1/2  lb. can whole cranberries
1 (9 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  pkg. gelatin
1/4  c. water
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. water
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
3/4  tsp. salt
pepper
2  c. diced chicken
1/2  c. diced celery
2  Tbsp. parsley
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Dissolve 1 package gelatin in water over low heat.  Add the cranberries, pineapple and lemon juice.  Chill in a 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch pan until firm.

name: NORTH DAKOTA WHEATBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. uncooked wheatberries (seed; untreated)
8  oz. cream cheese
12  oz. Cool Whip
15  oz. crushed pineapple
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
2 small  pkg. dry vanilla pudding
preparation: Cook wheat in water until soft (1 to 2 hours).  Drain and cool.  Combine cheese and pudding.  Stir in drained pineapple. Add enough juice only to thicken pudding batter.  Fold in Cool Whip, nuts and wheatberries.   Chill.

name: CHEESY CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. light cream cheese (Neufchatel), softened
1 1/2  c. skim milk
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can reduced sodium condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, thawed
2  c. cubed cooked chicken
1  c. quick cooking rice
3/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Spray a 2-quart casserole with nonstick coating.  Place cream cheese in casserole; stir in the milk.  Stir in the soup until well blended, then add the thawed vegetables, cooked chicken, uncooked rice, half the Parmesan cheese, pepper and garlic powder. Bake covered in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.  Stir.  Sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan cheese.  Bake uncovered about 20 minutes longer, until heated throughout.  Makes 6 main dish servings.

name: NO-BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. cocoa
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
3  c. quick oats
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook margarine, cocoa, sugar and milk until bubbles form around sides.  Boil for 1 minute; remove from heat.  Add oats, peanut butter and vanilla.  Drop onto waxed paper; cool.

name: HOPPING JOHN
ingredients:
1  c. cooked rice
1  c. black-eyed peas
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. cooked ham or bacon
1  green or red strong pepper, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook the peas and saute the onion and peppers and mix.  Add all the ingredients and serve hot.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1/4  tsp. salt
2 1/2  tsp. oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. milk (not skim)
1/2  c. walnuts
preparation: Place all ingredients in pan.  Boil for 20 minutes.  Beat until thick.  Pour into well buttered pan.

name: FRESH PEACH PIE(This pie is a peach.)
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
4  c. (about 2 lb.) peaches
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/3  c. water
1/2  tsp. lemon rind
1/2  tsp. almond flavoring
preparation: In a saucepan, boil sugar, cornstarch, salt and water for 1 minute, stirring gently.  Let cool.  Place in a bowl and mix in remaining ingredients.  Pour into unbaked pie shells and bake in a 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN BARS
ingredients:
1  box Pillsbury Plus yellow cake mix
1  c. canned pumpkin
3  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
Pillsbury ready to spread frosting
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
candy pumpkins
preparation: Follow the directions on a box of Pillsbury Plus yellow cake mix, except reduce the water to 1/2 cup and add 1 cup of canned pumpkin and 3 teaspoons of pumpkin pie spice.  Spread into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake as directed.  Cool; frost with ready to spread frosting, mixed with 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon. Decorate with candy pumpkins.

name: SWEDISH MEATBALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  lb. sausage (Bob Evans)
1  c. finely diced onion
1 1/2  c. bread or cracker crumbs
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
3  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  eggs
1  c. milk
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients together; best if worked by hand.  Shape into balls and brown well in skillet with hot oil.  Do about a dozen at a time.

name: JELLY ROLL
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cold water
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat eggs and sugar until quite thick; add water and vanilla. Add the flour, salt and baking powder which has been sifted together twice.  Pour batter into a shallow baking pan which has been greased and floured.  Bake in a quick 400° or higher oven, about 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown.  Turn out on a cloth sprinkled with sugar.  Roll up and unroll it, then spread with jelly or jam and roll up quickly.

name: TUNA CREAM CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  can tuna, drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3  Tbsp. sour cream
3  Tbsp. salad dressing or mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. grated onion (or dry onion soup mix)
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Soften cream cheese at room temperature.  Put cream cheese in a bowl and mash smooth with a fork.  Add tuna, flake and mix with cheese.  Add other ingredients and mix until well blended. Refrigerate.  Serve with chips or veggies.  Also good as spread for sandwiches.

name: MUSHROOM SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. mushrooms
2/3  c. celery
2/3  c. onion
1  medium tomato
Creamy Italian dressing
1/3  c. bell pepper, chopped
preparation: Wash mushrooms, drain, dry and slice in half. Cut celery into 1/8 inch cuts and onions into 1/4 inch squares, put in serving bowl. Add bell pepper, garnish with julienne cut tomato in 1/2 inch strips. Pour dressing over top, marinate 30 minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

name: Scrumptious Sausage Balls
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  lb. shredded Cheddar cheese
3  c. Bisquick
preparation: Mix all together and form into balls.  Put on sheet pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  box 10x sugar
1  tsp. ginger
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix and serve with gingersnaps.

name: I CAN'T BELIEVE I DID IT PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1/2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. water
2 1/2  c. flour, divided
1 1/2  c. shortening
1  tsp. salt
preparation: With a work, stir together a paste of 1/2 cup plus 2 tablespoons water with 1/2 cup flour; set aside.  Cut 1 1/2 cups shortening into 2 cups flour and salt until crumbly.  Add paste mixture; mix well.  Roll out with plenty of flour.  Makes 3 1/2 shells or 2 bottoms and 1 top.  Bake at 400° until lightly browned.

name: SLAW
ingredients:
1  head cabbage
1  medium  onion
3/4  c. plus 2 tsp. sugar
1  green pepper
1  c. cider vinegar
3/4  c. oil
1  tsp. each:  salt, celery seed and dry mustard
preparation: Marinade overnight if possible.  Toss lightly and serve.

name: WILD RICE DRESSING
ingredients:
turkey giblets
4  c. water
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. long grain and wild rice
1  celery rib, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  c. butter
2 1/2  c. crushed seasoned croutons
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
preparation: Remove the liver from the giblets, if desired. Place giblets and water in a saucepan. Cover and simmer for 2 hours or until tender.

name: TUNA NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  oz. medium width noodles
5  hard-cooked eggs
1  can cream of mushroom soup
3 to 4  slices American cheese
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 (6 to 7 oz.)  can tuna
1/2  c. any WIC cereal
preparation: Cook noodles until done; drain.  Place in casserole dish along with flaked tuna.  Peel hard-boiled eggs and cut into quarters. In a pot, heat soup along with cheese and Worcestershire sauce until hot.  Pour into casserole dish and top with cereal crumbs. Heat 30 to 35 minutes in a 350° oven.  Makes 6 servings.

name: FRENCH MASHED POTATOES
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. minced onion
3/4  c. hot milk
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water 30 minutes. Drain and mash. Add milk, margarine, seasonings and baking powder.  Beat until fluffy. Add onion.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: GOLDEN POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
5  lb. potatoes
2/3  c. melted oleo
4  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. minced parsley
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
2 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Peel potatoes; put in cold water.  Saute onion in butter until tender.  Add evaporated milk.  Bring to boil.  Remove from heat. Combine eggs in large bowl.  Beat until frothy.   Shred potatoes on medium shredder.  Place immediately in egg mix; turn to coat well.  Add parsley, 1 cup cheese and milk mixture.  Mix well. Turn into well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Add 1/2 cup cheese; continue to bake 30 minutes.

name: BUNKY'S QUICK PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can peaches
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Melt butter in 9-inch pan.  Pour peaches in pan.  Mix flour, sugar and milk together.  Pour over peaches.  Bake at 350° for approximately 20 minutes.

name: VEGETABLE SALAD AND MARINADE
ingredients:
3  bunches broccoli
1  tub cherry tomatoes
1  head cauliflower
1  tub mushrooms
1  1/2 to 3 carrots
preparation: Salad:  Cut broccoli and cauliflower in bite size pieces. Slice carrots thin.  Combine all vegetables for the marinade.

name: ONE-POT SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef or bulk pork sausage
1  small onion, chopped (1/2 c.)
2 (14 1/2 oz.)  cans chicken broth
1 (6 oz.)  can Italian style tomato paste
1/2  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
1/2  tsp. bottled minced garlic or 1/8 tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
6  oz. spaghetti, broken
grated Parmesan cheese or shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a  large  skillet, cook beef and onion until meat is brown and  onion	is  tender.  Drain  off fat.  Stir in broth, tomato paste,  oregano,  garlic  powder and pepper.  Bring to boiling. Add  spaghetti,  a	little	at a time, stirring constantly. Reduce  heat.  Boil  gently, uncovered, for 15 to 17 minutes  or until  spaghetti  is tender, stirring frequently. Serve with cheese.  Serves four.

name: VET BOLLEN(Fat Balls)
ingredients:
2 3/4  c. flour
1  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. raisins
preparation: Cream sugar and eggs.  Add dry and liquid ingredients alternately.  Drop by tablespoons in hot oil.  Fry until golden and place on paper towels to drain.  Roll in granulated sugar while warm.  Use deep fryer or skillet at 400°.

name: BAKED CORN
ingredients:
1  can cream-style corn
1  egg, beaten
1/3  c. corn meal
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. corn oil
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1  or 2 chopped jalapeno peppers, seeded
preparation: Mix corn, cornmeal, oil, salt and garlic salt.  Add eggs, milk and peppers.  Grease 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until solid in middle.

name: AUNT MARY'S ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/3  c. warm water
1  c. warm milk
1/3  c. melted butter or shortening
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
3 1/2 to 4  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve dry yeast in warm water. Mix together warm milk, melted butter or shortening, sugar and salt. Add dissolved yeast and flour. Continue mixing for 5 minutes. Cover and let rise until double in bulk. Roll out into balls and let rise again for 1 1/2 hours (dough should be kept warm from mixing until baking). Bake 25 minutes in 350° oven.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BONBONS
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
2  boxes confectioners sugar
4  sticks butter, melted
3  c. Minute oats
2  c. coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix and roll into balls.

name: SPICY YOGURT DIP
ingredients:
1  c. nonfat plain yogurt
1/2  c. salsa
1  tsp. ground cumin
1/8  tsp. Tabasco sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl; mix thoroughly.  Serve with raw veggies of your choice.

name: HILLBILLY CHILI
ingredients:
3  lb. ground chuck
1  green pepper, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  stalk celery, chopped
1 large  can stewed tomatoes
1  can Spanish-style tomato sauce
1 1/2  cans special tomato sauce
1  tsp. celery salt
1  tsp. onion salt
1  can beef broth
1 to 2  cans tomatoes and green chilies
2  Tbsp. oregano
3  Tbsp. chili powder
1  Tbsp. ground cumin
1/4  c. sugar
salt and pepper to taste
3  cans water
1  can kidney beans
preparation: Brown meat with onion, pepper and celery in skillet; drain off fat.  In a 6-quart Dutch oven, combine sauces and seasonings.  Add meat and beans, if desired.  Cook until thick.

name: OIL FREE FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1  can condensed tomato soup
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
juice of 1/2 lemon
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix well and let stand several hours to improve flavor.

name: ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  can Mandarin oranges
1  small container cottage cheese
1 small  pkg. orange Jell-O (dry)
1  small tub Cool Whip
1 small  can pineapple chunks
preparation: Drain fruits and set aside.  Combine Jell-O with cottage cheese.  Add pineapple and oranges.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Pour in bowl and chill.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  c. Crisco oil
1  tsp. baking powder
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
4  Tbsp. water
1/8  tsp. salt
1  c. pecans (optional)
2  envelopes premelted chocolate
preparation: Blend oil and chocolate in bowl, then add sugar.  Blend well. Sift flour, baking powder and salt.  Add to chocolate mixture. Beat eggs in one at a time.  Mix thoroughly.  Add vanilla.  Grease a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan generously.  Pour in mixture. Preheat oven to 350°.  Bake 30 minutes.

name: CHEERWINE PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (2 liter)  bottle Cheerwine
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1  bottle ginger ale
preparation: Mix Cheerwine and pineapple juice; chill.  Freeze some of the mixture and add along with ginger ale when ready to serve.

name: HOGIE'S BACON BROIL SNACK
ingredients:
6  slices bread
1  white or Vidalia onion
6  Tbsp. sour cream (optional)
1  lb. bacon
6  slices American or any other cheese
1  Tbsp. dried chives or green onion (optional)
preparation: Half cook bacon in a microwave or pan-fry.  Lay out sliced bread on a cookie sheet.  Place one slice of cheese on each slice of bread.  Place sliced onion on cheese (to taste).  Place 2 to 4 slices of bacon on onion.  Place sheet under broiler until bacon is crisp (not burnt!).  Top with sour cream and chives to taste.

name: ALMOND FLOAT
ingredients:
4  envelopes unflavored gelatin
5  c. water
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  Tbsp. almond extract
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup of the water.  In saucepan, bring remaining 4 cups of water to a boil.  Stir in gelatin mixture. Lower heat and add milk and sugar; heat to just below boiling point.  Remove from heat.  Stir in almond extract.  Pour into two (9-inch) square pans.  Refrigerate until set.  Cut into 1/2-inch cubes.  Serve with fruit mixed with gelatin.  Use at least 3 cans of any of the following: fruit cocktail, pineapple tidbits, peach halves, mandarin oranges, lychee and/or maraschino cherries.

name: YUM YUM CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. crushed pineapple, undrained
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix with a spoon and pour into a slightly greased 9 x 12-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
1 (No. 303)  can cream-style corn
1/2  c. light cream or whole milk
2 stalks or 1/2  c. celery, diced
1  small green pepper, diced
1/4  c. cheese, diced
1  egg
salt and pepper to taste
1  small onion, diced
2  Tbsp. butter
14  to 16 soda crackers, crushed
preparation: Mix corn, egg, cream, salt and pepper in mixing bowl.  Add celery, onion and green pepper.  Pour into greased baking dish in layers with cheese, butter and cracker crumbs, ending with layer of corn mixture.  Top with 1/2 cup buttered bread crumbs, if desired. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: BERRIES AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
4  c. ripe berries
2  c. water
1  c. sugar or to taste
2  c. biscuit mix
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Wash berries and combine with water and sugar, using a kettle with lid.  Boil until berries are soft and there is lots of juice. Mix biscuit mix with milk.  Drop by teaspoonful in boiling berries.  Cover and cook 15 minutes.  Sugar and cinnamon may be added to dumpling mix for sweeter dough.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3/4  lb. mild sausage
1  c. Rice Krispies
1/4  c. Minute rice
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  can water
1  egg
shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Lightly brown sausage and chopped onion.  Beat egg with water; add soup and mix together.  Add the Rice Krispies and rice, sausage and onion and half of the cheese.  Stir together.  Cover with shredded cheese and bake for 1/2 hour at 375°.

name: MOM'S BROWNIES
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  stick butter
1  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2/3  c. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Pour into a 9 x  13-inch pan.  Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean.  Do not overbake.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar (gradually)
2  eggs
2 3/4  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix thoroughly the first 3 ingredients.  Sift together remaining ingredients.  Stir flour mixture gradually into creamed mixture one-third at a time.  Roll dough into balls the size of small walnuts.  In a custard cup, mix 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon.  Roll balls in the mixture.  Place about 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake until lightly brown, but still soft.  (These cookies puff up at first, then flatten out with crinkled tops.)  Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Yield: 5 dozen 2-inch cookies.

name: HOT MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cornmeal
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
3  eggs
1 small  can cream-style corn
2/3  c. oil
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
1  c. grated American cheese
3  large jalapeno peppers, chopped
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Add milk and eggs.  Mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients.  Bake in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. German chocolate
1  c. shortening
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  tsp. soda
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. butter flavoring
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening.  Add eggs, flavoring and buttermilk.  Sift flour, soda and salt together and add to shortening.  Mix well.  Stir in melted chocolate until blended. Pour into greased and floured 9-inch tube pan.  Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: FRIED DILL PICKLES
ingredients:
3  large dill pickles, sliced round 1/4-inch thick
1  c. flour
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. milk
dash of sugar
preparation: Heat cooking  oil  to  about  400°.  Dip dill slices in milk, then flour,  then  egg,  then  flour again and drop into cooking oil.  Fry  quickly,  watching  carefully  to  prevent burning.

name: STRAWBERRY BUTTER
ingredients:
1  lb. unsalted butter, softened
16  oz. frozen strawberries, thawed
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Drain strawberries, reserving the juice. Bring all to room temperature. Whip all in a bowl, adding strawberry juice 1 teaspoon at a time. Chill. Serve on bagels or muffins.

name: NUTMEG FEATHER CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  beaten eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. shortening
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk
2  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Cream 1/4 cup margarine and 1/4 cup shortening with sugar.  Add vanilla.  Add eggs one at a time.  Add alternately with 1 cup buttermilk, 2 cups flour, nutmeg, soda, baking powder and salt. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or 2 (9-inch) cake pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: HOT LETTUCE DRESSING
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1 1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. water
crumbled bacon
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add sugar.  Stir in vinegar, cornstarch and water. Cook until thick.  Add crumbled bacon to dressing.  Pour dressing over lettuce right before serving.

name: CHOCOLATE PRETZEL DESSERT
ingredients:
1  lb. milk chocolate flavored disks
1  lb. white chocolate flavored disks
2  Tbsp. peanut butter
2  c. crushed pretzels
preparation: Melt milk chocolate flavored disks, the white chocolate flavored disks and the peanut butter in the microwave.  Melt on Defrost for 1 minute, then check every 10 seconds until melted. Stir in 2 cups of crushed pretzels (I used pretzel sticks, which I put in a sealed plastic bag and crushed with a rolling pin.  I left some chunks for crunch.)  Spread on cookie sheet really thin; refrigerate.  When set, break up in small pieces to serve.

name: BANANA ICE CREAM
ingredients:
9  eggs (extra large)
2  c. sugar
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  pt. heavy xxx cream
1  gal. milk
2  Tbsp. vanilla
3  large bananas, mashed
preparation: This is for a 5-quart maker.

name: ORANGE SLICE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. orange slices
1  pkg. coconut
1  c. pecans
1  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Chop oranges up fine.  Mix all ingredients together.  Grease 9 x 12-inch pan and spread into it.  Bake 25 minutes at 350°.  When just cool enough to work, take a spatula and lift up from pan. Start rolling into balls the size of walnuts.  (A little water will help your hands not to stick to the cookies while rolling.) Then roll in powdered sugar.

name: CHILI VERDE
ingredients:
1  lb. lean pork, cubed
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. fat
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  clove garlic
14 1/2  oz. can tomatoes
7  oz Ortega chilies, diced
1/4  tsp. oregano
2 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. water
preparation: Flour meat and brown in fat.  Add onion and garlic and cook. Add rest of ingredients and simmer 1 to 2 hours.  Great in burritos, over rice, etc.  Very mild.

name: LIGHTNING SALAD
ingredients:
6  oz. lime gelatin
2  c. 7-Up
1  jar or can grapefruit
preparation: Refrigerate grapefruit (undrained). Dissolve gelatin in boiling 7-Up. Stir in cold, undrained grapefruit. Pour into a serving bowl. Refrigerate.

name: CREAMY GREEK POTATOES
ingredients:
6  potatoes
salt and pepper
1 1/2  c. cheese
1  stick margarine
2  tsp. Cavender's Greek seasoning
preparation: Peel and slice the potatoes and place them in a baking dish. Salt and pepper to your desire.  Sprinkle Cavender's seasoning across top.  Place 1/2 margarine in patties across potatoes. Sprinkle cheese and then remaining margarine on top of the cheese. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes depending on the thickness of the potatoes.  Makes approximately 6 (1 cup) servings.

name: BLUEBERRY CRUNCH
ingredients:
1/2 to 1  c. chopped pecans
1 1/2  c. all-purpose plain flour
1 1/2  c. margarine, melted
8  oz. cream cheese, room temperature
12  oz. Cool Whip
1 large  can blueberry pie filling
1  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Mix melted margarine, flour and nuts.  Press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish.  Bake at 350° until brown. Cool completely.  Mix cream cheese and confectioners sugar, then stir in Cool Whip. Spread on crust, then pour pie filling on top; place in fridge until firm.

name: GERMAN FUDGE
ingredients:
2  boxes powdered sugar
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  stick margarine, melted
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
2  c. nuts, chopped
1  bottle cherries, chopped fine
1 1/2 large (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  block paraffin
preparation: Mix sugar, coconut, nuts, cherries alternating with milk, margarine and vanilla.  Mix well and drop from a teaspoon on wax paper.  Place toothpick in center of each piece and freeze.

name: DINNER IN FOIL
ingredients:
hamburger patties
1  slice onion
2  potato slices
1  tomato slice
preparation: Starting with a patty, place 4 ingredients on a large sheet of foil.  Season to taste.  Wrap and seal.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: SHRIMP FETTUCCINE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. unpeeled, medium size fresh shrimp
1  c. sliced green onions
1  clove garlic, minced
vegetable cooking spray
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
Alfredo Sauce (see recipe)
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. fettuccine, cooked without salt or fat
preparation: Peel and devein shrimp. Set aside. Cook green onions and garlic in a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium heat, stirring constantly, 1 minute. Add shrimp.  Cook, stirring constantly, until shrimp turns pink. Stir in parsley and Alfredo Sauce; add fettuccine and toss gently. Serve immediately. Yields 6 servings.

name: WILL'S HUEVOS RANCHEROS
ingredients:
1  helping Will's Chili Verde
2  flour tortillas
2  eggs
preparation: Heat chili.  Cook eggs sunny side up.  Place eggs over chili and serve with warmed tortillas.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans mandarin oranges, drained
1 large  can pineapple chunks, drained
1 extra large  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  pt. fresh strawberries, sliced
1 large  can peach pie filling
3  bananas, sliced
preparation: Drain fruit in colander, add sliced strawberries and pour all into a large bowl.  Add peach pie filling (you may want to cut peaches in pie filling into smaller pieces).  Mix well and refrigerate overnight.  Add bananas just before serving.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
2  c. confectioners sugar
1  (9-inch) baked pie shell
1  pt. strawberries
strawberry glaze
preparation: Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and sugar together and spread in pie shell.  Cover top with strawberries and then strawberry glaze. Refrigerate.

name: STREAMLINED CHIMICHANGA
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. ground cumin
1/4  tsp. oregano
3/4  c. picante sauce
8  flour tortillas (7 to 8-inches)
2  Tbsp. melted margarine or none
guacamole
picante sauce
preparation: Brown meat with onion and drain.  Stir in garlic powder, cumin, oregano and picante sauce.  Simmer 5 minutes or until most of liquid has evaporated.  If using margarine, brush one side of tortillas with melted margarine.  Spoon heaping 1/3 cup meat mixture onto center of unbuttered sides.  Fold 2 sides over filling; fold ends down.  Place seam side down in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Bake at 475° for about 13 minutes until golden brown.  Top with guacamole and additional picante sauce to serve.

name: SWEET PICKLE RELISH
ingredients:
4  c. chopped cucumbers (about 4 medium)
2  c. chopped onions
1  chopped green pepper
1  chopped sweet red pepper (if desired)
1/2  c. canning salt
3 1/2  c. sugar
2  c. cider vinegar
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1  Tbsp. mustard seed
preparation: Combine cucumbers, onions and peppers in large bowl; sprinkle with salt and cover with cold water.  Let stand 2 hours.  Prepare home canning jars and lids according to manufacturer's instructions.  Drain vegetables thoroughly; press out liquid. Combine sugar, vinegar, celery seed and mustard seed in a large saucepot; bring to boil.  Add drained vegetables; simmer for 10 minutes.  Carefully pack hot relish into hot jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace.  Adjust caps.  Process 10 minutes in boiling water bath canner.  Yields approximately 8 half pint jars.

name: CREAMY BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  can Eagle Brand milk
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
1  box vanilla wafers
6  bananas
preparation: Beat first 3 ingredients until thick.  Stir in Eagle Brand milk and 1/2 of Cool Whip.  Line 9 x 13-inch dish with vanilla wafers.  Layer pudding with bananas.  Spread remaining Cool Whip on top and sprinkle with crushed vanilla wafers.

name: THUMBPRINT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. plain flour
1  egg, beaten
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients; form in small balls.  Make indentations with thumb.  Bake at 375° until the bottom of the cookie is brown but the top is still white.

name: CHICKEN TORTELLINI SOUP
ingredients:
chicken breast
8  c. water
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  stalk celery
1  onion
3 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans condensed chicken broth
9  oz. frozen broccoli
1  (10 3/4 oz.) cream of chicken soup
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. sliced carrots
1/2  c. dry vermouth
2  garlic cloves, minced
1/2  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. oregano
1  (7 oz.) cheese tortellini
preparation: Simmer chicken in water, salt, pepper, celery and onion for 1 hour.  Remove chicken, cool and strain broth.  In large pan, combine broth, condensed chicken broth, cream of chicken soup, chopped onion, carrots, vermouth or water, garlic, basil and oregano.  Bring to boil.  Add cubed chicken and tortellini. Simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes.   Add broccoli.  Simmer an additional 20 minutes.  Serve with grated Parmesan cheese.

name: BURGER BEAN BAKE
ingredients:
2  strips bacon, cut in pieces
1  medium onion, chopped
1  lb. ground chuck
2 (1 lb.)  cans pork and beans
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  c. sorghum
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Fry bacon and remove bits from grease.  Saute onions in bacon grease.  Brown ground beef.  Drain any grease from beef.  Combine all ingredients and pour into baking dish and bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. white Karo syrup
pinch of salt
1 1/2  c. pecans
preparation: Beat eggs slightly.  Add sugar, beat again, then add Karo syrup, salt, vanilla and nuts.  Place in uncooked crust and dot generously with butter.  Cook about 10 minutes in hot oven at 425°, reduce heat to 325°.  Continue cooking until done, about 45 minutes.

name: FERN'S GAZPACHO
ingredients:
6  c. canned plum tomatoes
1  onion, chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. cucumber, chopped
2  c. tomato juice
1/2  tsp. cumin
1  garlic clove, minced
1  Tbsp. salt
freshly ground pepper
1/4  c. olive ol
1/4  c. wine vinegar
1  c. finely chopped tomato-garlic croutons
preparation: In a blender, puree tomatoes, onion, green pepper and cucumber.  Add tomato juice, cumin, garlic, salt and pepper.  Put in a bowl; cover and chill.  Before serving, add oil and vinegar. Serve accompanied by side dishes of chopped vegetables.  Garnish with croutons.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. Dream Whip
1 large and 1 small  pkg. cream cheese
2  pt. strawberries, washed and hulled
1  c. milk
3/4  box confectioners sugar
preparation: Prepare Dream Whip according to package directions with milk. Add softened cream cheese and confectioners sugar.  Whip well. Add sliced strawberries and pour in baked pie shell.  Makes 2 pies.

name: BACON ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
7  strips bacon
pineapple tidbits (1 small can)
water chestnuts (1 small can)
preparation: Cut raw bacon in half; wrap around pineapple and water chestnuts.  Pierce with a toothpick.  Microwave on High for 7 minutes.

name: PEAS AND RICE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. peas
2  qt. water
1  pt. fresh coconut milk
salt to taste
thyme to taste
1 1/2 to 2  lb. rice, uncooked
preparation: Wash peas, drain and place in pot with 2-quarts of water. Prepare coconut milk.  Put 1/2 pint coconut milk in boil for about 1 1/2 hours or until peas start breaking.  Add remainder of milk, thyme and salt to taste.  Wash rice, drain and add to peas.  Cook under slow fire until done.

name: CHOCOLATE SHAKES
ingredients:
3  c. vanilla ice cream
1  c. whole milk
5  splash chocolate syrup or strawberry
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together in blender and serve.

name: COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs, well beaten
1/2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
1/2  stick margarine
2  tsp. vanilla
1  (7 oz.) canned or frozen coconut (best)
preparation: Mix all well and pour into two 9-inch pie plates.  Bake at 325° until brown and firm.

name: PINEAPPLE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter flavor Crisco
1/2  lb. butter or margarine
2 3/4  c. sugar
3/4  can crushed pineapple, undrained
6  large eggs
3  c. plain flour, sifted
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream shortening, butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating thoroughly after each addition.  Add pineapple. Add flour that has been sifted with baking powder. Add small amounts at a time alternately with milk.  Pour into 10-inch tube pan. Place in cold oven. Turn oven to 325° and bake for 1 1/2 hours or until top springs back when touched lightly.  Let stand for 10 minutes in pan.

name: ENCHILADAS DE COLORES
ingredients:
1  c. green chiles, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. tomatoes, chopped
1  Tbsp. fat
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1  c. grated Longhorn cheese
6  corn tortillas
preparation: Chop chiles. In a frying pan, heat fat; saute onions. Add tomatoes and chiles; simmer 5 minutes. Fry and soften tortillas; roll small amount of cheese (2 teaspoons) in each tortilla. Place rolled tortillas in baking pan, 6 x 8-inches. Pour chili sauce over the tortillas; sprinkle cheese over top. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serves 2.

name: WHITE FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. whole candied cherries
1  lb. candied pineapple chunks
1 large  pkg. whole dates
4  c. whole pecans
2  c. plain flour
4  eggs
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar (heaping)
3  tsp. cooking sherry or 2 tsp. vanilla
preparation: Dredge fruit and nuts in small amount of flour.  Cream the sugar and margarine.  Alternately add flour and eggs.  Add flavoring and dredged fruit and nuts.  Pour in greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

name: ZUCHINIA SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. zuchinia
1/2  c. olive oil
1  bunch parsley
2  c. yogurt (plain)
1  tsp. salt
4  cloves garlic
preparation: Wash zuchinia; cut into small pieces.  Place the pan onto stove.  Put the zuchinia into the pan.  Add salt and two cups of water.  Leave on stove until water boils and the zuchinia gets soft.  Then beat the garlic.  Mix garlic and yogurt together and the zuchinia, place into plate, then add parsley on top.

name: DROP SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. soda, dissolved in milk
1  tsp. salt
2  c. Crisco
2  c. buttermilk
2  tsp. vanilla
9  c. sifted flour
preparation: Mix all together.  Drop by tablespoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.  Sprinkle with sugar when still hot or cool and spread with icing.  (Children love this cookie when you use several colors for icing.)

name: HAWAIIAN HOLIDAY PUNCH
ingredients:
6  c. pineapple-orange-guava juice
1  liter ginger ale, chilled
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
2  oranges, sliced
1  lime, sliced
preparation: Combine all ingredients in punch bowl. Serves 14.

name: PEACH PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. canned peaches, cut up
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. soda, dissolved in peaches
1  egg, well beaten
preparation: Cream sugar, peaches and soda.  Add salt, nuts and eggs; then beat.  Add flour and beat again.  Pour in a 9 x 9-inch pan (greased or sprayed with Pam).  Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve with Cool Whip.

name: CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
3/8  tsp. salt
3  egg yolks
1  unbaked pie shell
1  egg
4 1/2  Tbsp. water
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1  stick margarine
preparation: Melt margarine slowly.  Mix flour, sugar and salt together. Beat the egg yolks and whole egg together, adding water, lemon juice and margarine.  Mix together well, then add to the sugar-flour mixture.  Pour into the unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 350° until knife in the center comes out clean, about 35 minutes.

name: CHERRY SUPREME
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. flour
1  c. chopped pecans
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1 small  carton Cool Whip
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Mix butter, flour and chopped pecans.  Press in a casserole dish.  Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.  Mix the cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip.  Spread on crust.  Add pie filling.  Eat!

name: PASTIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Crisco shortening
1 1/2  c. boiling water
4 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Pour boiling water over Crisco shortening; add flour and salt. Mix well.  Will be consistency of cookie dough.  Chill in refrigerator at least 1 hour before using.

name: PATCHWORK COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. (2 sticks) butter
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. all-purpose flour
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
preparation: Cream butter; gradually add sugar until blended.  Beat in egg and vanilla.  Blend in flour.  Spread evenly in well-buttered 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan.  Bake in preheated 350° oven for 15 to 18 minutes until lightly browned.  Remove from oven; quickly spread chocolate pieces over baked cookie base.  Return to oven 2 to 3 minutes to soften chocolate.  Remove from oven; immediately spread chocolate evenly over base.  Make off in squares and top with the following:  rainbow sprinkles, chopped nuts, coconut, crushed peppermint candy, etc.  Chill just until frosting is set.  Cut into squares.  Arranged patchwork style on serving tray.

name: LASAGNA - SAUCELESS
ingredients:
3/4  lb. ground beef
1/4  lb. bulk Italian sausage
1  small onion, minced
1/2  clove garlic or 1 1/2 tsp. garlic powder
1 small  can mushrooms
1  bay leaf
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. mixed Italian spices
2 small  cans tomato paste
1  pkg. lasagna (about 6)
1  carton Ricotta cheese
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef, sausage and onion in skillet.  Pour off excess fat.  Add garlic, mushroom pieces, bay leaf, salt, pepper, spices and tomato paste.  Rinse each tomato paste can with 3 tablespoons water; stir into meat mixture.  Simmer 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Cook lasagna according to package directions.  Alternate layers of lasagna, meat sauce, Ricotta, Mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses in greased oblong baking dish. Repeat layers.  Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
12  (6-inch) corn tortillas
2  c. cooked chicken or canned chicken
2 (4 oz.)  cans green chillies
1/2  c. chopped red or green onion
1  c. salsa
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
2  c. shredded Mozzarella or Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Heat the cooking oil in medium skillet.  Hold tortillas with tongs. Dip each in hot oil 5 to 10 seconds or until limp. Drain on paper towels. Add oil as needed.  Combine chillies, onion, chicken and salsa.  Spoon on tortillas.  Roll up.  Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake, covered, at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Uncover and spread on sour cream. Top with cheese.  Bake 5 minutes longer or until cheese melts.  Makes 6 servings.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, cook and cool (drain)
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. celery
1  c. Miracle Whip
1/2  c. shredded cheese
1 1/2  c. Ritz cracker crumbs
preparation: Cook mixed vegetables and cool.  Drain.  Add onion, celery, Miracle Whip and shredded cheese.  Mix well and pour into dish. Cover with Ritz cracker crumbs.  Drizzle 1/2 cup melted butter over this.  Bake 30 minutes in 325° oven.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BANANA PUDDING(Serves 8 to 10)
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/8  tsp. salt
2  large eggs, lightly beaten
3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  c. creamy peanut butter
1 (12 oz.)  box vanilla wafers
6  medium bananas, sliced
1  (8 oz.) whipped topping, thawed
1/2  c. unsalted roasted peanuts
preparation: Combine sugar, flour and salt in a heavy saucepan.  Add eggs and milk, mixing well.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, 25 minutes or until thickened.  Remove from heat and stir in vanilla.  Spread about 1/2 teaspoon peanut butter between 2 vanilla wafers forming a sandwich; repeat procedure with remaining peanut butter and vanilla wafers.  Layer 1/3 of peanut butter and vanilla wafer sandwiches in bottom of 3-quart bowl; top with 1/3 of bananas.  Pour 1/3 of custard over bananas.  Repeat layers twice.  Cover and chill.  Spread with whipped topping and sprinkle with peanuts.  Yields 8 to 10 servings.

name: SCALLOPED CLAMS
ingredients:
1  can minced clams, drained
1  c. drained clam juice and milk
1  c. coarse cracker crumbs
1  egg, beaten
1  can mushroom soup
dash of pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients in baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until set.

name: CHICKEN BASKET BAKE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked, chopped chicken
1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. sliced green onions
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1 1/2  c. milk
3  eggs
3/4  c. Bisquick
1/2  tsp. dehydrated cilantro
1/4  tsp. powdered onion
1/4  tsp. powdered garlic
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Lightly grease a 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle chicken, mushrooms, onions, salt and cheese in pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth.  Pour into pie plate over first ingredients.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown and knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Let stand five minutes before cutting.  Can substitute 2 cups fully cooked turkey or smoked ham for chicken.

name: EASY TO MAKE DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour, sifted
1/2  tsp. sugar
1  c. sweet milk
1/4  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all ingredients together; drop into greased muffin pan. Cook at 450° for 12 minutes.

name: BLUE CHEESE DRESSING
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. Wesson oil
1  tsp. garlic salt
1 small  jar salad dressing (1/2 pt.)
1  tsp. white vinegar
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  pkg. Blue cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

name: LONDON CHICKEN
ingredients:
24  pieces of chicken (breasts, legs, and second joints)
butter (enough to brown chicken)
3/4  lb. sliced mushrooms (can use canned, drained)
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  can mushroom soup
sherry or white wine to taste, (about 1/4 c.)
preparation: Brown the chicken in butter. Then brown mushrooms if using fresh ones. Place chicken in a large casserole. Mix the soups (undiluted) and pour over chicken. Place mushrooms on top. Refrigerate. When ready to bake, add wine, cover the casserole, and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 12 servings.

name: EUNICE RATLIFF'S CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. hamburger meat
1/2  lb. bacon
1/2  c. ketchup
1  large onion, chopped
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. mustard
4  tsp. cider vinegar
3/4  c. brown sugar
1 large  can baked beans
1  can chickpeas (garbanzos), drained
1  can red kidney beans, drained
1  can green limas, drained
preparation: Fry  bacon  until  crisp.  Remove  bacon.  Crumble  and reserve.  Brown hamburger  in  bacon fat.  Add onion, ketchup, salt, mustard, vinegar, brown sugar and bacon; simmer for five minutes.  Mix beans together and add to sauce.  Bake in baking dish or bean pot for 40 minutes at 350°.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: FRIED GREEN TOMATOES
ingredients:
green tomatoes
1/2  c. milk
salt
pepper
flour
oil
preparation: Slice green tomatoes.  Heat oil in a frying pan.  Pour milk in a bowl.  Mix salt and pepper with flour.  Dip slices of tomatoes in milk, then dredge in flour.  Fry in hot oil until brown on both sides.

name: ELNORA'S SPANISH CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  stewed chicken
1  large bag plain Doritos
1  to 2 sliced onions
jalapeno peppers, diced
grated Cheddar cheese
cream of mushroom soup
chicken broth
preparation: Layer the Doritos, chicken, onions, peppers and cheese. Repeat until meat is used up.  Cover with mushroom soup and chicken broth (mixed together).  Bake for 45 to 60 minutes at 350°.

name: BACON AND GARLIC SAUTE
ingredients:
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. butter
3/4  lb. bacon, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch strips
3 medium  cloves garlic, finely chopped
2  Tbsp. fresh parsley, chopped
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Melt 1 tablespoon butter over moderate heat.  Add the bacon; saute until crisp, about 3 to 5 minutes.  Drain.  Add the remaining butter, garlic and parsley.  When the butter is melted, saute garlic and parsley for about 1 minute more.  This is great over cooked pasta or boiled, diced potatoes.

name: CARAMEL PIE
ingredients:
2 to 3  c. condensed milk (depending on size of crust)
1  graham cracker crust
1  large container Cool Whip
chopped or minced pecans
mini toffee bits (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Empty condensed milk into a casserole dish. Place dish on a baking pan. Fill baking pan halfway with water (this is important because it will keep the milk from scalding). Cover the casserole dish with aluminum foil. Bake 2 hours or until milk is caramel colored. Break up any large lumps in the filling before pouring into the crust. Let cool for an hour before spreading Cool Whip on top. The pie must be refrigerated overnight to set properly. Before serving, garnish with pecans, chocolate and toffee bits.

name: MISSISSIPPI MUD PIE
ingredients:
2  pkg. chocolate sugar-free pudding
1  large container lite Cool Whip
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/2  c. diet margarine
1  tsp. sugar or sugar substitute
4  c. skim or low-fat milk
preparation: Mix graham cracker crumbs with butter and sugar.  Mix will look wet and crumbly.  Spread diet margarine on bottom of glass dish; put graham cracker crumbs in pan and press.  Mix pudding and milk together.  When milk and pudding thickens, pour a thin layer on bottom and a thin layer of Cool Whip.  Add some plain graham cracker crumbs for extra yum!  Alternate layers until you reach the top.  End up with Cool Whip.  Sprinkle some crumbs on top for decoration.

name: FUNNEL CAKES
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. milk
4  c. flour
1/2 to 1  c. sugar (brown or white)
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
4 to 6  c. lard (melted) or vegetable oil
preparation: Beat eggs until fluffy with fork or hand beater.  Then add sugar, salt and milk; mixing thoroughly in a large bowl.  Next, stir in flour and baking powder, making sure that there are no flour or sugar clumps left in the batter.  (Hint: Sift sugar, flour and baking powder before adding to mixture.)

name: PECAN FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. sugar
2  beaten eggs
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. pecans
1/2  c. chopped dates
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Melt butter  and  sugar  together  and  set aside.  Mix beaten eggs,  coconut,  pecans,  dates,  vanilla  and vinegar together. Add  to  butter and sugar mixture.  Bake in unbaked pie shell for 50 minutes at 300°.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. butter, softened
3/4  c. granulated sugar
3/4  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
2  c. chocolate morsels
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Combine flour, baking soda and salt in small bowl.  Beat butter, sugar and brown sugar in large mixing bowl.  Add eggs. Gradually beat flour mixture.  Add morsels and nuts.   Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls to ungreased baking sheets.   Bake in preheated 375° oven for 9 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand for 2 minutes and remove to wire racks to cool.  Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

name: ITALIAN VEGGIE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. cut-up vegetables such as zucchini, yellow squash, onion, peppers, eggplant and mushrooms
1  c. spaghetti sauce
1  c. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
preparation: In a sprayed baking dish, combine your choice of veggies and enough spaghetti sauce to lightly coat them. Cover and bake at 400°for 20 minutes or until veggies are almost done.

name: BEEF BARBECUE
ingredients:
6  lb. chuck roast
1  stalk celery
3  onions
1  green pepper
1  bottle ketchup
3  Tbsp. barbecue sauce
3  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. hot sauce
1 1/2  c. water
preparation: Brown chuck roast.  Add all other ingredients.  Pour over roast.  Bake at 350° for 2 hours.

name: SALISBURY STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. dry bread crumbs or cracker crumbs
1  beaten egg
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1/4  c. finely chopped celery
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. water
preparation: Combine everything except soup and water and shape into an oval patty about 1-inch thick.  Using a small amount of butter, brown on both sides in a skillet.  Combine soup and water and pour around meat.  Cook slowly in covered skillet for 25 minutes.  If desired, put boiled potatoes around meat.  Soup and meat juices will make the gravy without further thickening.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
4  beaten eggs
6  oz. chocolate bits
1  pkg. small instant vanilla pudding mix
1/4  c. oil
8  oz. sour cream
preparation: Hand beat eggs; mix rest of ingredients with eggs.  Bake in Bundt pan for 40 minutes at 350°.  Cool in pan for 15 to 20 minutes.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
1  lb. shrimp (tails off, no shells), deveined and rinsed
2  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
1  c. chopped onions
1  c. chopped green pepper (optional)
1/2  c. chopped clove garlic or 1/4 tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. paprika
1  pt. stewed tomatoes
salt and pepper
preparation: In skillet, melt butter and mix in onions, peppers, salt, pepper, paprika and garlic.  Let simmer 5 minutes and add rest of ingredients and bring to boil, about 5 minutes.  Add shrimp and simmer 10 minutes longer.  Serve plain or on rice.

name: LOBSTER MOUSSE "CAPE COD"
ingredients:
1  c. diced lobster meat
1/2  c. low-fat or skim milk
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. diced celery
1  small red onion, diced
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  tsp. Dijon mustard
1  green pepper, diced
1  can cream of tomato soup
2  envelopes unflavored gelatin
salt and pepper to taste
fresh cilantro for garnish
preparation: Heat soup and cream cheese until cream cheese is melted.  Stir in milk, lobster meat, celery, onion, garlic, green pepper, salt and pepper.  Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water.  Add to mixture.  Pour into greased mold or shaped glass or plastic dish. Refrigerate at least 4 hours.  Unmold, if desired.  Serve on a bed of shredded romaine and arrange radishes, carrots, broccoli and cauliflower around mousse.  Garnish with cilantro.  Serves 6.

name: TEX-MEX DIP
ingredients:
3  ripe avocados
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. mayo
1  envelope taco seasoning
2 (10 1/2 oz.)  cans plain or jalapeno flavored bean dip
1  c. chopped green onion
3  tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
1/4  c. olives, chopped
8  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
tortilla chips
preparation: Peel, pit and mash avocado in medium bowl with lemon, salt and pepper.  Combine sour cream, mayo and taco seasoning mix.

name: RICE SALAD
ingredients:
2  bags Success rice
2  carrots, chopped
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. instant onion
1 1/2  c. diced celery
1 1/4  c. mayonnaise
1  envelope vintage herb or original Hidden Valley dressing mix
preparation: Cook rice as directed on package.  Drain and cool.  Mix all other  ingredients	with rice.  Refrigerate.  (Can be made up day before.)

name: OAT BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. oat bran
1/4  c. chopped nuts
1/4  c. raisins
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. skim milk
1/3  c. honey
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
preparation: Mix all together. Put in 12 muffin cups.  Bake at 425° for 15 to 17 minutes.

name: CANDY CANE BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  recipe Powdered Sugar Icing
red and green decorator icing
crushed peppermint candies and/or cinnamon candies
1/4  c. chopped peanuts
1  beaten egg
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Stir together flour, brown sugar, baking powder and salt.  Cut in the butter or margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add nuts. Mix egg and milk.  Stir into dry mixture just until moistened.  On a lightly floured surface pat dough into a 10 x 7-inch rectangle, 1/2-inch thick.  Cut crosswise into 1-inch strips.  Twist each strip by holding both ends.  Bend 1 end to form a candy cane.  Place several inches apart on greased baking sheet.  Bake at 425° for 10 minutes or until light brown. Carefully transfer to rack.  Cool.  Coat each cane with Powdered Sugar Icing.  Decorate, using decorator icing, cinnamon candies or peppermint candies as desired.  Makes 10.

name: HAM AND BROCCOLI QUICHE
ingredients:
1  c. diced ham
1  c. shredded Cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese
1/2  c. chopped broccoli
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. Bisquick
1 1/2  c. milk
3  eggs, lightly beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. paprika
preparation: Sprinkle ham, cheese, broccoli, onion and green pepper over bottom of greased 10-inch quiche dish; set aside.  Place Bisquick in large mixing bowl.  Whisk in milk, eggs, salt and pepper. Pour Bisquick mixture over ingredients in quiche dish.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake in preheated 375° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center of quiche comes out clean.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. grated cheese
1 small  pkg. Italian dressing mix
2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix well; chill.  Serve over green tossed salad.

name: SAUSAGE AND EGG STRATA
ingredients:
8  slices white bread, crusted and cubed
1 1/4  lb. link sausage, cooked and sliced
3/4  lb. shredded Cheddar cheese
4  eggs
1  c. milk
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can sliced mushrooms, drained
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Layer bread, sausage and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Mix eggs and 1 cup milk.  Pour over bread mixture.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Mix soup, mushrooms and 3/4 cup milk.  Pour mixture over refrigerated bread mixture.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHILI BURGERS
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  ripe tomato, seeded and cut into 1/4-inch dices
1/2  c. pitted black olives, chopped
1  tsp. finely minced garlic
1/2  tsp. Dijon-style mustard
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. dried basil
1/4  tsp. dried oregano
finely grated zest of lemon
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh dill or parsley
salt and pepper to taste
4  toasted hamburger buns
1/3  c. sour cream (optional)
1/2  c. Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Prepare grill for grilling.  Place meat in bowl and mix well with tomato, olives, garlic, mustard, chili powder, basil, oregano, lemon zest and dill.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Gently form into 4 patties.

name: SAUSAGE BREAD
ingredients:
1  loaf frozen bread dough
1  lb. sausage, cooked and drained
2  eggs
8  oz. Swiss cheese, grated
4  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
dash of garlic powder
preparation: Mix the eggs and cheese together with meat.  Roll the dough out the size of a jelly pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: RICE DRESSING
ingredients:
6  each chicken livers, gizzards and necks
water enough to cover giblets
1  stick margarine
1  c. brown rice
1  onion, chopped
3  green onions, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
2  cloves garlic, chopped
1 1/2  tsp. sage
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. red pepper
1  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Gently boil giblets for approximately 2  hours or until done. Cool  and chop giblets and meat  from  necks.  Discard bones and skin, reserve liquid and add enough  to  equal 2 1/2 cups.	Brown rice in margarine, add vegetables and saute until onion is clear. Add giblets, turn into  a  covered casserole, add  salt, pepper and red pepper, mixing well.  Bake	at  350° approximately	1 1/2 hours or until rice is  done.  Stir  once during the baking process.  Serves 6.

name: ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple
2  pkg. orange Jell-O
1  (8 oz.) cottage cheese
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Drain crushed pineapple, then mix all ingredients together in a large bowl and stir together.

name: BEER BATTER FOR FISH OR VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. paprika
1  beaten egg
1  c. beer
preparation: Combine all dry ingredients. Stir beaten egg into beer.  Add to dry ingredients. Batter will thicken as it sets.  Add more beer if it is needed. Batter can be stored in refrigerator for 2 to 3 days. Recipe can be doubled.

name: ZUCCHINI APPETIZERS
ingredients:
3  c. grated zucchini
1  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. minced onion
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
4  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
1  clove garlic, minced or 1/4 tsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. salad oil
dash of pepper
preparation: Mix ingredients in descending order.  Put in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Cut into squares and serve warm.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: CHICKEN PRIMAVERA
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/3  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. paprika
1  lb. boneless chicken breasts
2  c. thinly sliced vegetables (combination of celery, green pepper, sweet red pepper and/or green onion)
hot cooked rice
preparation: In skillet, blend first 3 ingredients; stir in chicken and vegetables.  Over medium heat, heat to boiling.  Reduce heat to low.  Cover; simmer 20 minutes or until chicken is tender, stirring occasionally.

name: ANISE CRISPS
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. anise extract
1  c. coarsely chopped walnuts
preparation: Beat eggs, sugar,  mayonnaise  and extract with a mixer on medium speed.  Add flour and powder to sugar mixture 1/3 at a time, beating  well  after	each  addition.  Stir  in  nuts. Cover and chill overnight.

name: PICKLED CARROTS AND ZUCCHINI
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
2 inches  stick cinnamon
3  medium carrots, cut strips
1/2  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. mustard seed
3  whole cloves
1  medium zucchini, cut strips
preparation: In saucepan mix sugar, vinegar, water, mustard seed, cinnamon and cloves.  Add carrots, cover and simmer until carrots are crisp-tender.  Add zucchini strips, return to boiling.  Transfer mixture to bowl.  Cover and chill at least 8 hours.  Makes 3 cups.

name: EASY BARBECUE CHICKEN SANDWICHES
ingredients:
3  to 4 boneless/skinless chicken breasts
1  bottle your favorite barbecue sauce
preparation: Spray your crock-pot with nonstick spray.  Place frozen chicken breasts in crock-pot and cover with bottle of barbecue sauce.  Cook on high all day.  Use a whisk and break apart the chicken until shredded.  Serve on buns.  Delicious and easy!

name: SWISS TUNA QUICHE
ingredients:
1  frozen 9-inch pie shell, thawed
1 (7 oz.)  can tuna, drained and flaked
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese (4 oz.)
1/2  c. sliced onions
1/2  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Pierce pastry with fork.  Bake in 375° oven 10 minutes.  In large bowl, toss tuna, cheese and onions; spoon into shell.  In small bowl, beat eggs, mayonnaise and milk.  Pour over cheese mixture.  Bake 35 or 40 minutes until golden brown.

name: EASY CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  fryer
1  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
3  stalks celery, chopped
1  can mushroom soup
1  jar chopped pimentos
1/2  lb. cheese, cubed
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti
preparation: Cook chicken until tender.  Remove bones and chop.  Cook onion, green pepper and celery in chicken broth until tender.  Add spaghetti.  Cook until tender.  Add soup and pimentos.

name: FISH STICKS
ingredients:
1  box Bi Lo fish sticks
newspaper
preparation: Go to Bi Lo and buy a package of fish sticks.  Put it in the freezer.  Every morning, take 4 out and put in a real small frying pan and put plate on top.  Cook for 20 minutes and turn over. Leave plate off a bit, then take out, put ketchup on them, eat them, then read the paper.

name: RED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  head red cabbage
1  onion
2  apples, chopped
1/2  c. vinegar
sugar or honey to taste
preparation: Saute onion chopped in margarine.  Add chopped cabbage and stir and saute for 5 minutes.  Add chopped apples and vinegar. Add sugar or honey to taste.  Cover and cook slowly, stirring once in a while for 45 minutes or 1 hour.  Salt, if desired.

name: DEEP DISH PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
2 (29 oz.)  cans sliced peaches
1  box yellow cake mix
1  c. brown sugar
cinnamon
1 1/2  c. butter, melted
preparation: Dump entire contents of peaches in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Layer evenly with cake mix.  Sprinkle with cinnamon.  Poke cake mix with wooden spoon handle throughout.  Do not mix together!

name: WILTED LETTUCE SALAD
ingredients:
garden lettuce or head lettuce
green onion
vinegar
bacon grease
preparation: Cut lettuce very small.  Add onion.  Add vinegar and salt to taste.  Heat bacon grease until smoking.  Pour over lettuce (amount to taste), then toss.

name: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. jello mixed fruit gelatin (strawberry-lemon, or orange-pineapple)
dash of salt
1  c. boiling water
1 (8 3/4 oz.)  can pineapple tidbits
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1  c. Cool Whip
1  banana, diced
1/2  c. seeded halved grapes
1/4  c. diced maraschino cherries
1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Dissolve jello and salt in boiling water.  Drain pineapple, measuring syrup.  Add water to make 1/2 cup if necessary.  Stir into gelatin with lemon juice.  Blend in mayonnaise.  Chill until very thick.  Fold fruits, nuts and Cool Whip into jello.  Pour into 2 freezing trays or a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Freeze until firm or at least 3 to 4 hours.  To serve, cut in squares or slices.  Makes about 8 servings.

name: HOT FUDGE FOR SUNDAES
ingredients:
2 to 4  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/4  tsp. salt
3  c. sugar
1  can evaporated milk
preparation: Melt chocolate squares and 1/2 cup butter or margarine in top of double boiler.  Add salt.  Then add sugar, 1/2 cup at a time. Stir well after each addition.  Then add evaporated milk, small amount at a time.  Continue cooking until thickened.  Serve hot over ice cream.

name: SALAD DRESSING CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. salad dressing
1  c. lukewarm water
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix together just enough to be creamy, flour and soda sifted together.  Mix the sugar, cocoa, salad dressing and water. Combine both mixtures and beat until light and fluffy.  Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: TACO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  onion
1  can taco sauce
1 small  can chopped green chilies
1  large bag plain tortilla chips
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. salt and pepper
preparation: Brown ground beef, onion, salt and pepper in medium saucepan. Stir in rest of ingredients, except Doritos.  Heat oven to 350°. Layer bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan with tortilla chips.  Then spoon 1/2 meat mixture and 1/2 cheese.  Repeat. Bake 1/2 hour.

name: HOT WATER CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. corn meal
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
boiling water
hot oil
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients.  Pour boiling water into mixture and stir until all ingredients are wet and you have a heavy batter you can handle with your hands.

name: EASY CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
3  c. cooked, cubed chicken
1 (12 oz.)  jar salsa
4  (8-inch) tortillas
2  c. grated cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine salsa and cheese.  Cook over medium heat until cheese melts.  Set aside 1 1/4 cups of mixture.  Stir chicken in remaining sauce.  Spoon chicken mixture onto tortillas.  Roll up and place in greased 8-inch square pan; cover with foil. Bake at 375° for 15-20 minutes.  Pour remaining sauce mixture over enchiladas.  Serves 4.

name: CHOCOLATE  DREAM
ingredients:
1  Duncan Hines chocolate cake
1  package Heath Bar pieces (found near chocolate chips at grocery)
1  large cool whip
2  small or 1 large instant chocolate pudding mix
large trifle compote
preparation: Bake cake in 9 x 13 inch dish according to recipe on the box. Cool. Cut into 1 inch pieces. Prepare chocolate pudding according to package directions. Layer twice in trifle compote: Cake pieces, Heath bar crumbs, chocolate pudding and cool whip. On top of the last Cool Whip, sprinkle some Heath Bars crumbs.

name: ORANGE BREAD
ingredients:
rinds of 3 large oranges, clipped fine
2  c. water
2  c .sugar
1  c. milk
1  egg, beaten slightly
2  Tbsp. melted fat
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
4  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Cook cut peel in water until peel is tender, about 20 minutes. Add the sugar and cook 30 minutes longer with a very low heat. Let cool.  Add milk, egg, fat and sifted dry ingredients.  Mix well and turn into two well-greased bread pans.  Let stand 25 minutes, then bake 1 hour at 375°.  Brush top with soft butter when removed from oven.

name: PATIENCE CAKE
ingredients:
white cake mix
2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  pkg. frozen coconut
Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake mix as directed on box in 9 x 13-inch pan. Punch holes. Bring to boil, sugar, milk and coconut. Pour over cake. Let cool. Put container Cool Whip over cake. Add another package frozen coconut on top of Cool Whip. Better if refrigerated before serving.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/4  lb. butter or margarine, cut into 6 or 8 pieces
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
4  very ripe bananas, peeled and cut into 3 pieces
preparation: Place butter, sugar and eggs in processor.  Blend until all ingredients are combined.  Add bananas and process again.  Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt and add gradually. Blend until mixed well.  Bake in greased loaf pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: PEPPER JELLY
ingredients:
1/3  c. ground hot peppers
5  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. ground bell peppers
1 1/2  c. vinegar
2  (6 oz.) liquid pectin
green or red food coloring (optional)
preparation: Grind peppers and combine with pectin, sugar, vinegar and lemon juice.  Boil for 10 minutes, stirring constantly.  Strain into another pan and boil for one minute.  Add food coloring if you desire.  Remove from heat and put in jars; seal.  Delicious with cream cheese and crackers.

name: DUMPLINGS FOR CHICKEN 'N DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. hot rich chicken soup
