preparation: Sift together dry ingredients.  Stir in hot soup until dough comes clean from bowl.  Roll out and cut into strips.   Add to hot soup and bring to a boil.  Turn fire out, let stand 5 minutes and serve.

name: NOODLE CANDY
ingredients:
6  oz. pkg. butterscotch morsels
6  oz. Planter's cocktail peanuts, separated
3  oz. chow mein noodles
preparation: Melt morsels in double boiler.  Stir in noodles and nuts with rubber spatula.  Spoon onto waxed paper.  Let cool.  Place in tightly covered container.

name: SOFT BUNS
ingredients:
5 3/4 to 6 3/4  c. flour
1/4  c. instant dry milk
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  pkg. dry yeast
1/3  c. soft margarine
2  c. warm water
preparation: Mix with mixer.  In large bowl, thoroughly mix 2 cups flour, sugar, salt, dry yeast and margarine.  Gradually add water and beat 2 minutes, scraping bowl.  Add 3/4 cup flour and beat on high speed 2 minutes.  Stir in enough flour to make a soft dough, not too stiff.  With a spoon take out and put on a floured board and knead until smooth.  Put in a greased bowl and grease top; let rise in warm place until doubled in size, about 45 minutes.  Punch down; let rise again.  Make buns, let rise and bake at 375° until brown and done, 25 to 30 minutes.

name: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
2  cans cream-style corn
2  eggs
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. cracker crumbs
1  Tbsp. oleo
1  small onion, chopped
preparation: Beat eggs and oleo together.  Mix with other ingredients and pour into a greased 2-quart casserole dish.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes, then at 350° for 1 hour.

name: HARVEST STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. beef cubes (1 1/2-inch cubes)
2  Tbsp. shortening
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
6  medium carrots, cut in 2-inch chunks
8  small, whole white onions, peeled
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen whole green beans
noodles, cooked according to pkg. directions
preparation: In a large, heavy pan, brown beef in shortening.  Pour off excess fat.  Add soup, water and Worcestershire sauce.  Cover; cook over low heat about 1 1/2 hours.  Add carrots and onions. Cook 45 minutes more.  Add beans; bring to boiling, stirring to separate beans.  Cook 10 minutes more or until meat and vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally. Thicken sauce, if desired. Serve over hot noodles.  Serves 6.  Freezes well.

name: APPLE BROWNIES
ingredients:
4  medium apples, peeled and chopped fine
1  c. nuts, cut medium
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  sticks butter or margarine
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar.  Beat eggs until light and add to mixture.  Add apples and nuts.  Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture.  Pour into an approximate 10 x 13-inch size pan and bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.  Cool in pan and cut into squares.  Serve with Cool Whip or whipped cream.

name: STRAWBERRY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. self-rising flour
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. mashed strawberries and juice
preparation: Mix together,  batter will be heavy.  Bake in greased tube pan at 325° for one hour.  Let stand 15-20 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI QUICHE
ingredients:
4  c. zucchini, thin sliced
1  c. onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. dried parsley
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. sweet basil
2  c. Mozzarella cheese
1  can Pillsbury refrigerator crescent rolls
2  eggs, well beaten
1  stick butter
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. oregano
2  tsp. Dijon mustard
preparation: Cook zucchini and onion in butter over medium heat, no more than 10 minutes.  Stir in salt, pepper and other spices.

name: GOLDEN CHICKEN NUGGETS
ingredients:
4  whole broiler-fryer chicken breasts
1/2  c. unseasoned fine dry bread crumbs
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  tsp. Accent
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. thyme
1  tsp. sweet basil
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Bone chicken breasts, remove skin and cut each breast half into 6 to 8 nuggets, about 1 1/2-inches square.  Combine bread crumbs, cheese, Accent, salt and herbs.  Dip chicken nuggets in melted butter, then crumb mixture.  Place in single layer on foil-lined baking sheets.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.  Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

name: CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. buttermilk
2  c. chicken broth
1  stick oleo
1  c. self-rising flour
4  chicken breasts
preparation: Cook chicken and debone.  Mix cream of chicken soup and chicken broth.  Bring to a boil.  Pour over chicken.  Mix flour, buttermilk and oleo and spoon on top.  Bake at 425° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: PASA DE SHUTO
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk sausage
1  lb. ground beef
6  c. chopped vegetables (carrots, onions, green peppers, fresh mushrooms, and celery)
1  can condensed tomato soup, undiluted
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  pkg. (12 oz.) thin spaghetti, broken into 1-inch lengths
preparation: In a skillet, brown sausage and beef; drain fat.  Add vegetables and saute just until crisp-tender.  Stir in soups, tomato sauce, and spices.  Meanwhile, cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain.  Add to skillet and stir gently to mix. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

name: NANCY'S CRAB PATE
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can mushroom soup
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
3  Tbsp. cold water
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2 (6 1/2 oz.)  cans crabmeat, drained
1  small onion, grated
1  c. finely chopped celery
preparation: Heat soup, dissolve gelatin in cold water, add gelatin to soup, stirring well.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Spoon into oiled 4-cup mold (preferably a fish mold).  Chill until firm.  Unmold and garnish with parsley.   Serve with assorted crackers.

name: BERRY VINAIGRETTE
ingredients:
5  Tbsp. berry vinegar
1/2  c. oil
2  Tbsp. minced shallots
1  tsp. Dijon mustard
2  tsp. honey
pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients; shake to mix.  Chill before using on spinach or mixed lettuces.

name: PRALINE-TOPPED SWEET POTATO
ingredients:
3  c. mashed sweet potatoes
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. melted butter
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. rum
1/4  c. raisins
1/2  tsp. ginger
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/3  c. milk
1/4  tsp. allspice
preparation: Mash potatoes and remove all lumps.  Add all other ingredients.  Pour into buttered casserole.  Make topping. Sprinkle over potatoes.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. butter or margarine
1  egg
1/4  c. molasses
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. ginger
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Beat in egg, add the molasses and sifted dry ingredients.  Roll into 1-inch balls, dip into sugar. Place on baking sheet 2 inches apart.  Bake at 375° about 15 minutes.  Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

name: MARBLED CREAM CHEESE BROWNIES
ingredients:
6  oz. semi-sweet chocolate, coarsely chopped
3  oz. unsweetened chocolate, coarsely chopped
16  oz. cream cheese, softened
2  c. granulated sugar, divided
4  large eggs (room temperature)
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract, divided
1  c. (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 350°.  Line a 13 x 9-inch baking pan with aluminum foil so foil extends 2 inches beyond sides.  Lightly butter bottom and sides.  Melt chocolates. Cool 10 to 15 minutes until tepid.  In a large bowl, using a hand held mixer set at medium beat together cream cheese and 1/3 cup of the sugar until smooth.  Beat in one of the eggs and 1 teaspoon vanilla until combined.

name: SEAFOOD PRIMAVERA
ingredients:
1/4  c. concentrated lemon juice
2  tsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. each: scallops and large raw shrimp, peeled and deveined
1/4  c. margarine
8  oz. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1  c. thinly sliced carrots
3  cloves garlic, chopped
1/2  tsp. thyme leaves
4  oz. fresh pea pods
1/4  c. sliced green onions
2  Tbsp. dry sherry (optional)
preparation: Combine lemon juice, cornstarch and salt; mix well.  Add scallops and shrimp.  Cover; marinate in refrigerator 30 minutes. In large skillet over high heat, cook and stir mushrooms, carrots, garlic and thyme in margarine until tender-crisp, about 8 minutes. Add seafood mixture; cook and stir 5 to 8 minutes until seafood is opaque.  Add pea pods, onions and sherry if desired; heat through.  Serve over hot cooked pasta.  Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 4 servings.

name: MOM'S TOMATO PUDDING
ingredients:
8  tomatoes
4  slices bread
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4 to 1  stick margarine
1/2  tsp. lemon flavoring
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Pour hot  water over tomatoes, then drop in cold water. Peel tomatoes  and  stew.  Add bread crumbs.  Add sugar, salt, pepper, margarine and lemon flavoring.

name: HONEY NUT GRANOLA
ingredients:
3  c. quick cooking oats
1  c. chopped walnuts
2/3  c. oleo or butter
1/2  c. honey
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: In large bowl, thoroughly stir together the oats, walnuts, oleo, honey and salt.  Spread evenly in an ungreased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan.  Bake in a preheated 350° oven, stirring occasionally until light golden brown, about 25 minutes.  At once, spread mixture onto an ungreased cookie sheet or foil to keep granola from browning further.  Cool completely.

name: ANGIE'S CHOCOLATE ECLAIR PIE
ingredients:
2  pkg. French vanilla instant pudding
1  large Cool Whip
1  container milk chocolate instant icing
3  c. milk
1  box graham crackers
preparation: Mix milk with pudding.  Beat for about 3 minutes.  Stir in Cool Whip and beat for about 2 more minutes.  Layer graham crackers and pudding (usually put pudding first).  Last layer needs to be the graham crackers.  Spread chocolate icing over top. Refrigerate.  The longer it can refrigerate, the better.

name: MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. oatmeal
1  c. shredded wheat
1  c. All-Bran
1/2  c. boiling water
1/2  lb. brown sugar or 3/4 c.
1/2  pt. buttermilk
2 1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. oil
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. whole wheat flour
1 1/2  c. white flour
preparation: Mix  first  3  ingredients;  add remaining ingredients. Mix and fill muffin tins 1/2 full.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIFFON CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. water
4  sq. (4 oz.) unsweetened chocolate, broken up
1/4  c. sugar
2 1/4  c. sifted cake flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cooking oil
7  egg yolks
3/4  c. cold water
1  tsp. vanilla
7  egg whites
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
Chocolate Icing
Confectioners Icing
preparation: In saucepan, combine 1/2 cup water, chocolate and 1/4 cup sugar.  Cook, stirring constantly, until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth; cool.  In bowl sift together flour, 1 1/2 cups sugar, baking powder and salt; make a well in center.  Add cooking oil, egg yolks, 3/4 cup water and vanilla.  Beat egg yolk mixture at high speed of electric mixer for 5 minutes or until satin smooth.  Stir in chocolate mixture.

name: FRENCH FRIED ZUCCHINI SQUASH
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  lb. zucchini squash
1  c. corn flake crumbs, fine
preparation: Beat eggs slightly with fork.  Slice squash in 1/4-inch thick slices.  Dip in egg and then in crumbs.  Fry in deep fat, 350°, until golden brown, about 3 to 5 minutes.

name: MILLION DOLLAR PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker pie shell
1  (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  can condensed milk
1/2  c. pecan or walnuts, chopped
1/2  c. cherries (optional)
preparation: Drain pineapple  and  cherries	and  mix with remaining ingredients.  Pour into pie shell and freeze.  Serves 8.

name: TORTELLINI SPINACH SOUP
ingredients:
1  small onion, chopped
2  carrots, thinly sliced
5  c. chicken broth
8  oz. pkg. cheese filled tortellini pasta
1/2  pkg. fresh spinach
preparation: In a large saucepan, combine onion, carrots and broth.  Bring to a boil.  Add tortellini, reduce heat and simmer 4 minutes. Meanwhile, clean, trim and coarsely chop spinach.  Add spinach and simmer 4 to 5 minutes longer until carrots are tender-crisp.  Add pepper to taste.

name: OLD-FASHIONED BUTTER ROLL
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/3  c. shortening
3  Tbsp. ice water
1/4  c. butter
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon
2  c. milk
preparation: Mix flour, shortening, water and 1 cup of milk.  Roll out like pie crust.  Mix butter, 1 cup of sugar, vanilla and lemon.  Put butter mixture on crust; roll up like a jelly roll.  Cook remainder of milk and sugar over low heat for 10 minutes.  Pour over rolls.  Cook at 400° until brown.

name: SKILLET CHICKEN PARMESAN
ingredients:
1  tsp. olive or vegetable oil
4  fully cooked breaded chicken breast cutlets
1 (1 lb. 10 oz.)  jar Ragu pasta sauce
1  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese (about 4 oz.)
preparation: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat and brown chicken, turning once.  Add Ragu pasta sauce and bring to a boil. Sprinkle with cheese.  Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, 2 minutes or until cheese is melted.  Serve with hot cooked spaghetti or in Italian rolls.

name: CRANBERRY SAUCE
ingredients:
1 16  oz. can crushed pineapple
1 16  oz. can cranberry sauce, Whole Cran
1/2  c. sugar
1  pack of miniature marshmallows
1  c. nuts
2  pints whipping cream
preparation: Pour pineapple and marshmallows in large bowl. Let stand overnight stirring often. Add cranberry sauce in blender for 2 to 3 seconds. Add to pineapple mixture. Add nuts. Mix well. Add whip cream. Add sugar gradually until stiff. Fold in fruit mixture. Best when served immediately the juice acid will dissolve cream.

name: SURPRISE MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1/2  c. tomato juice
1/2  c. bread crumbs
2  tsp. dried onions
2  strips bacon
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  lb. ground beef
2  hard-boiled eggs
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Put the first six things that are listed into a large bowl and stir.  Add the ground beef.  Blend everything together very well. Pour one half of this meat mixture into a large baking pan.  Shape the meat into an oblong patty.  Then make two hollows in the mixture and fit the hard-boiled eggs into them.  Use the rest of the meat mixture to cover the eggs. Shape gently into a loaf.  Lay the bacon strips on top.  Bake at 350° for about an hour.  When you serve this meat loaf, each slice will have a ring of egg in the middle.

name: BROCCOLI WITH STUFFING
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  large eggs
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1  c. herb seasoned stuffing mix
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
preparation: Cook broccoli according to package directions.  Arrange broccoli in lightly greased 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese.  Combine eggs and next three ingredients; spread over cheese.  Combine stuffing mix and margarine; sprinkle over top.  Bake at 350° for thirty minutes or until thoroughly heated.  Yield:  8 servings.

name: NO COOK CUCUMBER PICKLES
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
4  c. apple vinegar
1/2  c. plain salt
2 1/2  tsp. turmeric
1 1/4  tsp. celery seed
1 1/4  tsp. mustard seed
3  onions, sliced thin
cucumbers, sliced
preparation: Mix together; do not heat.  Fill one gallon jar with cucumbers and onions.  Mix other ingredients and pour over cucumbers. Refrigerate for 5 days before eating.  Will keep in refrigerator for 9 months.

name: SPINACH SOUFFLE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
3  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. milk and 1/2 c. cream
3  beaten egg yolks
salt and pepper
dash of nutmeg
1/2  c. grated American cheese
1  c. chopped spinach (1 box frozen), drained well
3  egg whites, beaten to peaks
preparation: Even non-spinach eaters like this one!

name: SPARERIBS
ingredients:
about 3 lb. spareribs
a few slices bacon, cut in pieces
1  onion, chopped fine
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. brown sugar
Worcestershire sauce to taste
Tabasco sauce to taste
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown bacon and onion.  Add catsup, water, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, Tabasco sauce and salt and pepper.  Cook ribs 1 1/2 to 2 hours in water.  Drain.  Broil about 10 minutes with sauce on.

name: BLUE CHEESE SPREAD WITH WALNUTS
ingredients:
12  walnut halves
1  lb. soft white cheese (such as cream cheese or Ricotta)
5  oz. Blue cheese (Roquefort or Gorgonzola)
1  Tbsp. cognac
salt and freshly ground pepper
1  bunch fresh chives, finely chopped
preparation: Grate walnuts using food processor with shredding disk or rotary grater and set aside. Combine the white and Blue cheese in a dish and mash together with a fork, incorporating the cognac and a little salt and pepper. When the mixture is smooth, add the walnuts and chives. Mix again until well blended. Spoon into a serving bowl. Serve with breadsticks, fresh veggies or toast points. Serves 8.

name: HOT SLAW
ingredients:
1  head cabbage
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  c. Duke mayonnaise
preparation: Cook cabbage, then add vinegar and mayonnaise.  Salt and pepper.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. raw sausage
2  c. Bisquick mix
10  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Preheat  oven  to  375°.  Combine  ingredients,  mixing well. Roll  into  small  balls.  Place  onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1/2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 large  can peaches
preparation: Melt butter.  Add sugar and milk.  Mix together flour, salt and baking powder.  Add to butter mixture.  Add vanilla.  Spread batter on bottom of casserole dish.  Spoon fruit on top of batter. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over fruit, then pour juice over.  Bake in slow oven until done.

name: CRISPY BACON SHRIMP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. peeled and deveined raw or thawed frozen medium shrimp
3 minced  cloves garlic
1/4  c. chopped parsley
1  tsp. crumbled basil
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. olive oil
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
20 to 25  slices bacon, halved
preparation: In shrimp are frozen, thaw on paper toweling to absorb moisture.  Combine all remaining ingredients except bacon.  When shrimp are completely defrosted, pour marinade over them.  Let shrimp marinate in refrigerate several hours.  Drain.  Wrap each shrimp in bacon and secure with toothpick.  Broil until shrimp are pink and bacon crisp.  When serving, replace burnt toothpicks with fresh ones.  Yields 6 appetizer servings.

name: VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  container sour cream
1  pkg. Good Seasons dry Italian dressing or Zesty dry Italian
preparation: Mix and serve with cut vegetables, carrots, celery and broccoli.

name: MAMMIES ICE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1 small  box instant vanilla pudding
1 small  box instant chocolate pudding
2  c. cold milk
2  c. vanilla ice cream
1  pkg. Dream Whip
preparation: Mix vanilla pudding, chocolate pudding and milk; mix well. Add vanilla ice cream.  Pour into baked pie shell and frost with Dream Whip (made according to directions).  Chill.  Makes 1 pie.

name: APRICOT NECTAR CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1 small  pkg. lemon Jell-O
3/4  c. apricot nectar
3/4  c. Wesson oil
4  whole eggs
preparation: Blend cake  mix,  jello.  Add  apricot  nectar, oil and eggs one at a  time,  beating each time as egg is added.  Beat mixture 4 minutes.  Pour  into  tube  pan.  Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325° to 350°.

name: PEANUT BUTTER STICKS
ingredients:
10  slices bread
1 (12 oz.)  jar creamy peanut butter
1/2  c. cooking oil
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Trim crust from bread and cut each slice into 5 strips.  Place in oven, 200°, for 2 hours to make crisp.  Combine peanut butter and cooking oil in saucepan, stirring constantly, until smooth. Dip bread slices in this mixture.  Combine graham cracker crumbs and powdered sugar; dip bread sticks into this mix after dipping in peanut butter and oil mix.

name: PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1  c. sifted self-rising flour
1/4  c. shortening
2 1/3  Tbsp. cold milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Cut shortening into flour with pastry blender or rub with fingertips until the shortening particles are the size of peas.  Add milk slowly, tossing mixture lightly.

name: ZUCCHINI RELISH
ingredients:
10  c. zucchini, grated or chopped
2  c. onions, chopped
5  Tbsp. salt
2 1/2  c. white vinegar
4  c. sugar
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. turmeric
1  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. cornstarch
2  tsp. celery seed
2  chopped peppers (1 red, 1 green)
preparation: Mix and let first 3 ingredients stand overnight.  Next day, drain mixture but do not rinse.  Place in large kettle.  Add next 8 ingredients.  Mix well and add peppers.  Cook for 30 minutes at a full rolling boil.  Mix frequently to prevent burning.  Put in sterilized jars and seal.  You may use wax to seal.  Makes enough for 10 half-pint containers.

name: CRAB ALMOND DIP
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  can crabmeat
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. blanched almonds browned in 2 Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
8  drops Tabasco sauce
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. seasoned salt
butter
preparation: Mix together all ingredients, reserving about 1/3 of almonds for top.  Bake at 450° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Serve hot.

name: BAKED HAM
ingredients:
12 to 14  lb. sugar-cured ham
1  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
4  Tbsp. prepared yellow mustard
preparation: Heat oven to 325°.  Place ham, fat side up, uncovered, no water.  Bake 4 to 5 hours.  Mix together brown sugar, flour and mustard for glaze.  Increase heat to 400°.  Spread glaze over ham and bake for 20 minutes.

name: BERRY OR FRUIT MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
2  c. flour
1  c. milk
1  c. chopped berries or chopped fruit
1/4  c. oil
1  Tbsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix all together and fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full.  Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Makes 12 muffins.

name: CRANBERRY MOLDED SALAD
ingredients:
2  boxes red jello
1  C. hot water
1/2  C. sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  C. pineapple juice
1  C. fresh cranberries (ground)
Juice of one orange
1  C. crushed pineapple
1/2  C. celery (ground)
1  C. English Walnuts (chopped)
preparation: Dissolve jello with hot water, add sugar, stir until dissolved.  Add lemon juice and pineapple juice.  15 to 20 minutes later add remaining ingredients.

name: LAYERED LETTUCE AND VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  head lettuce, coarsely shredded
1  c. grated carrots
1  c. chopped purple onion or Vidalia
1 small  can Oscar Mayer bacon bits
3  tsp. sugar
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped green pepper
1 large  can peas, drained
1/2  c. mayonnaise
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Layer vegetables in 2 or 2 1/2-quart casserole, starting with 1/2 of the lettuce and the other vegetables as they are listed. End with the other 1/2 of the lettuce.  Mix sugar and mayonnaise; spread over salad at least 1/2-inch thick.  Be sure to touch sides of salad.  Top with Parmesan cheese.  Cover tightly and chill overnight.  Delicious! Serves 8.

name: OH SO GOOD PIE(No Cooking Required)
ingredients:
1  can condensed milk
1/2  c. lemon juice
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. frozen coconut
1  c. chopped nuts
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  deep dish graham cracker pie crust
preparation: Mix condensed milk and lemon juice until smooth.  Add pineapple, coconut and nuts.  Mix.  Blend in Cool Whip.  Pour into pie crust.  Refrigerate several hours prior to serving.

name: BRENDA'S DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can tomato soup
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon jello
1 1/2  c. celery
1  green pepper
1  purple onion
1/2  c. chopped almonds
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix together along with ingredients from double boiler.  Pour in wet mold.  Chill.  Pour out of mold.  Serve with crackers.

name: ORIENTAL CABBAGE
ingredients:
1/2  c. melted margarine
1  medium head cabbage, chopped
1  green pepper, cut into strips
2  stalks celery, chopped
2  carrots, thinly sliced
1  large onion, sliced into rings
3/4  c. evaporated milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine margarine and vegetables in a large skillet or electric skillet.  Cover and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes. Stir in milk.  Heat thoroughly.  Add salt and pepper to taste. Yield:  6 to 8 servings.

name: PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
1 (11 1/8 oz.)  can Italian tomato soup
2  Tbsp. water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4-1/2  tsp. hot pepper sauce
preparation: Combine soup, water, vinegar, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, and pepper sauce.  Spoon mixture over chops. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until chops are done.

name: MARINATED NOODLES AND CABBAGE
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. Oriental noodles with chicken flavor
1/4  c. cooking oil
3  Tbsp. rice vinegar or wine vinegar
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. finely shredded cabbage
1 (6 3/4 oz.)  can chunk-style chicken, drained
1/4  c. sliced green onion
3  Tbsp. sesame seed
3  Tbsp. sliced almonds, toasted
green pepper rings
preparation: Break up noodles in noodle mix.  In a mixing bowl combine oil, vinegar, sugar, 1/4 teaspoon salt, dash of pepper and seasoning packet from noodle mix; stir to dissolve seasonings.  Stir in broken noodles, cabbage, chicken, onion and sesame seed.  Cover; chill several hours.  Before serving, stir in almonds.  Garnish with green pepper rings.   Serves 6 to 8.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
3  c. flour
3  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
3  tsp. vanilla
2  c. grated zucchini, unpeeled
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together eggs, sugar and oil.  Mix together flour, cinnamon, salt, soda and baking powder.  Then add vanilla, zucchini and nuts.  Divide into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 325° approximately 60 minutes.

name: SPOON ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
2  c. lukewarm water
4  c. sifted self-rising flour
3/4  c. melted shortening
1/4  c. sugar
1  egg
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water.  Mix together in a large bowl with all other ingredients.  Store, covered, in refrigerator overnight. Spoon batter into well-greased muffin tins. Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.

name: NO CRUST COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1/2  stick butter or margarine, melted
1  (7 oz.) bag Angel Flake coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, flour and eggs together. Blend well. Add milk, butter, coconut and vanilla. Mix well and pour into 2 well-greased pie pans. Bake at 350° until golden brown.

name: PENNSYLVANIA DUTCH CHICKEN CORN SOUP
ingredients:
1  stewing hen (about 4 lb.)
4  qt. water
1  chopped onion
10  ears corn
1/2  c. chopped celery with the leaves
2  hard-boiled eggs
salt and pepper
rivels
preparation: Put cut-up chicken and onion into water and cook slowly until tender.  Add salt.  Remove chicken.  Cut the meat into small pieces and return to broth together with the corn (which has been cut from the cob), celery and seasoning.  Continue to simmer.

name: SWEET POTATOES AND APPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  large sweet potatoes
1  large apple
3 1/2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
lemon juice
1/2  c. maple syrup
preparation: Boil potatoes 20 to 25 minutes until tender.  Peel.  Peel and core apple, slice in 1/4-inch rings.  Melt 1 teaspoon butter and brown apple slices.  Butter shallow casserole dish large enough to hold potatoes flat after slicing them 1/2 to 3/4-inches thick. Sprinkle with salt and top with apple slices.  Squeeze lemon juice over all.  Pour maple syrup over all.  Dot with remaining butter. Bake at 375°, uncovered, for 30 minutes until sweet potatoes absorb syrup.

name: A TART SAUCE FOR BROCCOLI, ASPARAGUS, CAULIFLOWER, ETC.
ingredients:
1/2  c. vinegar
1/3  c. sugar
salt and pepper
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. or 1 Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. cream or half and half, well beaten
1  egg
preparation: Cook the first 5 ingredients together, then add the cream or half and half and the egg.  Cook a little longer.  Add mixture to cream and egg, then add to original pan.

name: TOMATO SOUP
ingredients:
5  Tbsp. oleo or butter
1  Tbsp. oil
1  c. onion, chopped
3  c. chopped tomatoes
1/4  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. parsley
3  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. baking soda
2  c. chicken broth
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  c. heavy cream
pinch of salt
preparation: Saute onion in butter and oil until soft.  Add chopped tomatoes, thyme, basil, parsley and black pepper.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Mix flour with 1/2 cup of the chicken broth until smooth.  Add the 1 1/2 cups of chicken broth and chicken-flour mixture to the tomatoes.  Add baking soda, sugar, cream and pinch of salt to the tomatoes.  Simmer on low for 25 minutes.

name: SWEET PICKLES
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. canning salt
1 1/2  tsp. pickling spices
2  tsp. alum
4  c. white vinegar
3  c. vinegar
3  c. water
6  Tbsp. salt
2  c. vinegar
1  c. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
a pinch of celery seed
1 level  Tbsp. mixed pickling spice (2 Tbsp. if tied in a bag)
preparation: Cut cucumbers in 1-inch slices and soak in salt water overnight.  For 1 quart of cukes, use 1 pint of vinegar (diluted if strong), 1/2 cup sugar, 2 level teaspoons mixed pickling spice and a little salt.  Put vinegar, sugar, salt and spices on stove.  When it boils, add cukes and stir until they turn color.  Put in jar with lid lightly screwed on.  Drain and reheat vinegar for 2 days. Then seal.  Just reheat the vinegar, not the cukes.  Makes a very crisp sweet pickle.

name: NO CARB DESSERT
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  (4 oz.) diet instant Jell-O or pudding (any flavor; lemon is very good)
1 serving size  pkg. walnuts
1/2  stick butter
preparation: Crush nuts. Mix with the butter (melted). Spread on bottom of pie plate; refrigerate. Mix all the other ingredients. Spread over nuts and chill.

name: SPICY BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/4  lb. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
4  mashed bananas
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. flour
1  tsp. to 1 Tbsp. cinnamon
small amount lemon juice
1  tsp. lemon or orange peel
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add remaining ingredients as listed. Bake in a 325° to 350° oven for 40 to 60 minutes.

name: CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1  stick oleo, melted
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
3  eggs
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Melt oleo.  Mix in sugar, vanilla and vinegar.  Beat eggs, one at a time.  Bake in moderate oven.

name: EASY CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Stove Top chicken flavor stuffing mix
1/4  c. margarine, cut up
1 1/2  c. hot water
1  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1  c. milk
3  c. cooked chicken or turkey, chopped
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen vegetables
dash of thyme
preparation: Place  contents   of   vegetable/seasoning  packet  and margarine in bowl.  Add  water; stir to partially melt butter. Add stuffing crumbs; stir gently to mix.

name: ZUCCHINI CRABCAKES
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. grated zucchini
1  c. Italian bread crumbs
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  tsp. Old Bay
1  tsp. melted butter
1  tsp. minced onion
1  tsp. parsley
1  tsp. mustard
preparation: Mix  zucchini,	egg  and butter;  add bread crumbs, Old Bay, mustard and onion.	Roll in bread crumbs.  Don't make the cakes too large.	Chill.	Fry in oil until brown.

name: HAWAIIAN HOLIDAY PUNCH
ingredients:
6  c. Dole orange/pineapple/guava juice
1  liter ginger ale
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
2  slices orange
1  slice lime
preparation: In punch bowl, mix juice and ginger ale.  Mix in strawberries. Float orange and lime slices on top.  Serves 14.

name: JOHNNY SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon instant pudding
1 large  carton whipped topping
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Mix pineapple and pudding together; add whipped topping.  Stir well.  Stir in marshmallows.  Chill for 2 hours before serving.

name: AUNT BEE'S APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
4  oz. cream cheese
2  c. flour
2 1/2  c. sliced apples
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. orange juice
2  Tbsp. honey
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. butter or oleo
preparation: In large bowl, combine 1/2 cup of butter or oil and the cream cheese and let come to room temperature.  Add 2 cups flour and blend well.  Chill.  Roll out half of the dough and place in a 9-inch pie plate.  Reserve the remaining dough for the top crust.

name: STRAWBERRY/BANANA JELLO
ingredients:
1  large strawberry Jell-O
1  banana
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1 large  pkg. frozen strawberries
1  c. nuts
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  small instant vanilla pudding
1  c. milk
preparation: Dissolve  Jell-O  in  boiling  water; add frozen strawberries, banana  and  nuts.	Put  in  refrigerator to congeal. Mix vanilla pudding  with  milk.  Add  Cool Whip.  Cover congealed Jell-O.

name: SALSA DIP
ingredients:
4  medium tomatoes, chopped
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
2 or 3  Tbsp. chopped green chiles
1/4  c. green peppers
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1  Tbsp. salt
dash of pepper
1/4  c. oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Chill.

name: ORANGE BLOSSOM COOLER
ingredients:
2 - 6  oz. cans lemonade concentrate
1 - 6 oz  can orange juice concentrate
9  c. cold water
5  pts. pineapple sherbet
1  qt. vanilla ice cream
preparation: Combine concentrate and water.  Put sherbet and ice cream in bottom of punch bowl.  Pour juice over mixture, stir until partially melted.  Makes 40 - 1/2 oz. cups.  5 quarts.

name: CHOCOLATE-PECAN BROWNIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. butter
2  Tbsp. water
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1  tsp. vanilla
2  large eggs
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Set oven to 325°. In small bowl, mix flour and baking soda. In a small saucepan, combine sugar, butter and water; bring to the boil over medium heat. Remove from heat. Stir in 1 cup of morsels and the vanilla until smooth. Transfer mixture to a medium bowl and cool completely. Stir in eggs one at a time, beating well. Gradually stir in flour mixture until smooth. Stir in remaining morsels and nuts. Pour batter into a greased 9-inch square baking pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until a pick inserted in middle comes out clean. Cool and cut into squares. Makes 16 brownies.

name: SOUTH AFRICAN GOURMET SALAD
ingredients:
8  (3 oz.) South African rock lobster tails
2  lb. potatoes
1/2  c. diced onions
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. white pepper
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. heavy cream
preparation: Drop frozen rock lobster tails into boiling salted water.  When water re-boils, cook for 3 minutes.  Drain immediately; drench with cold water and cut away underside membrane.  Remove meat from shells.  Chill.  Boil potatoes; drain and peel.  While still warm, cut into cubes in bottom of large bowl.  Add onion, salt and pepper immediately.  Mix mayonnaise with cream until smooth.  Pour over potatoes and onions and leave in a thick top layer.  Cool, then chill.  At serving time, cut chilled rock lobster meat into bite size pieces.  Add to potatoes in bowl and toss together until all ingredients are well blended.  Yield:  8 servings.

name: STUFFED ZUCCHINI
ingredients:
3  medium zucchini (about 8 oz. each)
3/4  lb. lean ground beef
1/4  c. sliced scallion
1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. chopped tomatoes
2  Tbsp. tomato paste
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In a large saucepan, cook zucchini in boiling salted water for 10 minutes or until fork-tender.  Drain and cool slightly.

name: WALNUT SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1  c. granulated sugar
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
3/4  tsp. ground cloves
3/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/4  c. buttermilk
3  eggs
preparation: Beat together all ingredients, except walnuts.  Scrape bowl. Mix on high speed for 3 minutes.  Stir in nuts.  Pour into greased and floured 9 x 1 1/2-inch pans.   Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.  Let cool.  Fill and frost with Caramel Frosting.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. corn meal
1  c. Cheddar cheese
3  eggs
1  green bell pepper, chopped
1  pod hot pepper, chopped
1  c. onion, chopped
2/3  c. Wesson oil
1  c. corn
1  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

name: NEL'S PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
3  c. sugar
2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
4  eggs
2/3  c. water
1  c. oil
2  c. canned pumpkin (No. 303 can)
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Sift all the dry ingredients together and mix well.  Add remaining ingredients and blend until smooth.  Divide into 4 greased and floured 1-pound coffee cans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Turn out of cans onto a rack.  Wrap in foil.  Make at least 1 day ahead.  Can also be baked in loaf pan for 1 hour.

name: EASIER-THAN-LASAGNA
ingredients:
8  oz. spiral pasta
1  onion
4  cloves garlic, chopped
2  Tbsp. olive oil
2  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. basil
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes, crushed
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. water
2  c. cottage cheese
9  oz. Brick or Jack cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Saute onion and garlic in the olive oil.  Add tomatoes, herbs, salt and water.  Simmer 30 minutes.  Cook pasta until tender. Stir all ingredients together except for Brick or Jack cheese to sprinkle on top.  Bake for 20 minutes at 375°.

name: NACHOS GRANDE
ingredients:
1  bag Doritos
1/2  lb. ground beef, cooked and drained
2  bell peppers, chopped
2  tomatoes, chopped
1  onion, chopped
20  dashes hot sauce
Mozzarella cheese, shredded
preparation: Spread Doritos in single layer	in  pan.  Top  with the next 6 ingredients.  Bake in  350°  oven.	Cook  until  cheese melts and mixture is bubbly.

name: CHILI CON CARNE
ingredients:
2  lb. lean ground beef
4  Tbsp. chili powder
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1  large onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
2 (15 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1  c. water
1  bay leaf
2  Tbsp. pure vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. flour
2 (1 lb.)  cans red kidney beans (undrained)
preparation: In a Dutch oven or large wide saucepan over moderately low heat, brown the beef, crumbling it with a fork; push beef to one side and spoon off any fat.  Sprinkle meat with chili powder, salt and sugar; mix well.  Add onion, green pepper, tomato sauce, water and bay leaf.  Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 1 hour.  Remove bay leaf.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked, mashed sweet potatoes
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2/3  c. sweet milk
1  stick butter
preparation: Mix all ingredients and put into a buttered casserole dish. Mix 1 cup light brown sugar, 1/3 cup plain flour, 1 cup finely chopped pecans and 1/3 cup melted butter.  Sprinkle over top of potatoes.  Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350°.

name: PARTY HAM 'N CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (4 to 6)  can ham
8  oz. cream cheese
1/4  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. minced onion
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. Tabasco sauce
preparation: Drain ham; blend in cheese and mayonnaise.   Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate 8 to 12 hours. Shape into a ball or mold as  desired.  Roll in finely chopped pecans.  Let stand a little longer.  Serve with crackers or use as a filling for appetizers.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage (hot or regular)
2  c. milk
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  c. grated sharp cheese
6  eggs
1  tsp. salt
2  slices white bread, cubed
preparation: Saute sausage; drain.  Beat eggs and add milk, salt and mustard and mix well.  Layer bread cubes  in  a  greased, 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Add crumbled  sausage	and  cheese.  Pour egg mixture over top.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.  This dish can be made the day before or can be frozen.

name: CRANBERRY-ORANGE BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. quick Quaker oats
3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
3/4  c. orange juice
2  eggs
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. grated orange rind
3/4  c. chopped cranberries
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour bottoms of 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  Combine first 6 ingredients.  Mix well and set aside. Beat orange juice and orange peel and eggs until well mixed.  Add to dry ingredients. Mix just until moistened.  Fold in cranberries and nuts and pour into prepared pan.  Bake 60 to 70 minutes or until a wooden pick comes out of center clean.  Cool 10 minutes, then remove from pan.  Cool thoroughly before cutting.  Makes 12 servings.

name: FUDGE BROWNIE PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) unbaked pastry shell
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/4  c. margarine
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1/2  c. Bisquick baking mix
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Bake shell 10 minutes.  Reduce oven temperature to 325°.  In saucepan, over low heat, melt chips with margarine.  In large mixer bowl, beat chocolate mixture with remaining ingredients except nuts, until smooth.  Add nuts.  Pour into pastry shell.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until center is set. Cool slightly.  Serve with ice cream, if desired.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: CORN BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising meal
1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  egg
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  May add more buttermilk if too thick.  Bake in greased pan until brown.

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sifted regular flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves
1  stick butter or margarine
1 3/4  c. sugar
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. applesauce
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: On a piece of waxed paper sift together the flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves.  In a large mixing bowl cream butter and sugar.  Beat in eggs one at a time.  Stir in sifted flour mixture in 4 additions alternately with applesauce, beginning and ending with dry ingredients.  Mix the raisins and walnuts with the last addition of flour, and stir in.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 small  cans tuna
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. egg noodles
cheese, grated
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook noodles.  Pour in bowl.  Mix in soup and tuna.  Add cheese on top.  Cook in oven until cheese is melted and warmed up.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. cranberries
3  lb. grapes
1  pt. cream (whipping)
1  c. sugar
pecans
marshmallows
preparation: Wash and grind cranberries, adding 1 cup of sugar and allowing it to drain overnight.  Remove seeds from grapes.  Add whipping cream.  Mix all together.  Pecans improve flavor.  Marshmallows may be added for bulk.

name: LEMON SQUARES
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. all-purpose flour
2  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. finely shredded lemon peel
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. baking powder
powdered sugar (optional)
preparation: In a smal mixer bowl beat butter or margarine until softened. Add 1/4 cup sugar and beat until fluffy.  Stir in 1 cup flour. Press dough onto the bottom of a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake in a 350° oven for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, in the mixer bowl beat eggs.  Add 3/4 cup sugar, 2 tablespoons flour, lemon peel, lemon juice and baking powder.  Beat about 3 minutes or until slightly thickened.  Pour the lemon mixture over the baked layer. Return to the 350° oven and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until edges are light golden brown and center is set.  Cool.  If desired, sift powdered sugar over cookies.  Cut into squares.  Makes 16.

name: PERFECT DIVINITY
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. water
2  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped candied cherries
preparation: In a heavy 2-quart saucepan, combine sugar, corn syrup and water.  Cook to soft ball stage (236°), stirring only until sugar dissolves.  Meanwhile, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. When syrup reaches 236°, gradually add half the syrup to egg whites, beating at high speed on electric mixer.  Cook remaining syrup to hard ball stage (250°) slowly add to the egg white mixture, beating constantly.  Add vanilla and beat until candy holds its shape (about 5 minutes).  If desired, add chopped candied cherries.  Drop pillows of candy from a teaspoonful onto waxed paper, swirling tops.  Makes about 3 dozen pieces of candy.

name: FROZEN LEMON TORTE
ingredients:
3/4  C (18 cookies) vanilla wafer crumbs, OR graham cracker crumbs (12 sqs)
3  eggs, separated
1  Tbsp grated lemon peel
1/4  C lemon juice
1/4  C sugar
1/8  tsp salt
Another 1/4 C sugar
1  C whipped cream or 2 C frozen whipped topping, thawed
preparation: Line ice cube tray, 9x5 inch loaf pan or 8 inch sq pan with half the crumbs.  In medium saucepan, combine the egg yolks (reserve whites in small mixer bowl), lemon peel, lemon juice, 1/4 C sugar and the salt.  Mix thoroughly.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, till mixture just bubbles.  Cool.

name: EASY PUNCH
ingredients:
1  (32 oz.) ginger ale
1 (48 oz.)  can pineapple juice
3  lb. sugar
2  oz. citric acid
preparation: Mix all ingredients and serve over ice.

name: BARBECUED CHICKEN LEGS AND THIGHS
ingredients:
4  chicken legs, skinned
4  chicken thighs, skinned
3/4  c. catsup
1/3  c. firmly packed brown sugar
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. orange juice
1  Tbsp. onion flakes
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Place chicken in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; set aside. Combine catsup and remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake at 350° for 1 hour, turning chicken once.

name: CREAMED ASPARAGUS AND MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
3  lb. fresh or frozen asparagus
1  lb. mushrooms
3  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1/2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. heavy cream
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
dash of nutmeg
paprika
preparation: Remove stems from mushrooms.  Wipe caps and slice.  Saute mushrooms in butter with onion until golden.  Prepare asparagus (cooked) as usual; cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces.  Heat 1 tablespoon butter and blend in flour.  When lightly browned, add cream.  Heat slowly, stirring occasionally, until thickened.  Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.  Add sauteed mushrooms and onion; keep warm. Drain asparagus; place in dish.  Top with mushroom sauce.  Add a sprinkle of paprika, if desired.  Serves 8.

name: HERSHEY'S LITE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. flour
1/3  c. cocoa Hershey
1  tsp. soda
6  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. white vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together flour, cocoa and soda.  Melt butter.  Stir in sugar, then add milk, vinegar and vanilla.  Add dry ingredients. Put in flat glass dish or pan.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

name: VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onions
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. French green beans
1  c. peas
1  c. Shoe Peg corn
1  c. green limas
1  jar pimentos
3/4  c. vinegar
1/2  c. cooking oil
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. water
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Drain all canned vegetables.

name: CHERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
3  egg whites
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. sugar
1  c. saltines, crushed
1/2  c. nuts
1  can cherry pie filling
Cool Whip
preparation: Beat eggs until frothy.  Add cream of tartar and beat until stiff.  Add sugar and fold in saltines and nuts.  Put in greased 7-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until light brown; cool.  Then put on cherry pie filling and refrigerate overnight.  Serve with Cool Whip.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. mild sausage
1  onion, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can mixed veggies
1  pkg. Uncle Ben's chicken flavored rice (6 oz.)
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1 1/2  cans water
1 small  can mushrooms (4 oz.)
preparation: Brown  sausage	and onion in skillet.  Drain well.  Add remaining  ingredients.  Simmer  in  skillet  until  liquid is absorbed and rice is cooked (about 25 to 30 minutes).  Time of preparation: 45 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: CHARCOAL STEAK MARINADE
ingredients:
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. olive oil
1  Tbsp. lemon pepper seasoning
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
preparation: Combine the mixture and pour over your steaks 2 to 3 hours before cooking.

name: COOTER PIE(The Hunter's Delight)
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped bacon
2  medium onions, chopped
2  toes garlic, crushed
1  stewed tomato, chopped
1  tsp. thyme
1/4  c. flour
preparation: First you take a live cooter and wait for him to stick his head out from under his shell.  When he does, you grab it and whack it off.  Take a hatchet to the underside so you can get to the meat and remove it along with the liver, tripe and eggs (if he has any?).  Set aside.

name: 3 STEP CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia brand cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1  (9-inch) ready graham cracker crust
preparation: Mix cheese, sugar and vanilla at medium speed.  Pour into crust.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Cool.  Refrigerate for 3 hours.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  cooked pie crust
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. water
1  c. mashed strawberries, 1 qt. strawberries (2 little baskets)
whipped cream
preparation: Mix cornstarch and sugar.  Add strawberries to water and sugar.  Cook until thick and clear.  Stir in 2 to 3 drops food coloring.  Stir in rest of strawberries (don't add water) into pie crust.  Chill 3 hours and top with whipped cream.

name: ROAST-N-RED GRAVY
ingredients:
1  roast (beef)
6  medium potatoes
1 (32 oz.)  bottle ketchup
1  medium onion, chopped
4  c. water
preparation: Brown roast on both sides.  Season to taste, then add ketchup and water.  Add potatoes and onion.  Cook on medium until roast is tender.  Add extra water during cooking as needed to thin gravy.

name: CROCK-POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  (3 lb.) pot roast
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  envelope onion soup mix
1 soup  can water
preparation: Combine mushroom soup and celery soup in crock-pot.  Heat on low.  Sprinkle roast with salt and pepper.  Brown on all sides in shortening in saucepan.  Remove roast to plate.  Stir onion soup mix into drippings in saucepan.  Cook until brown.  Add 1 soup can water; mix well.  Add to soups in crock-pot; mix well.  Add roast.  Cook on low for 8 hours.  Yield: 6 servings.

name: MILLION DOLLAR FUDGE
ingredients:
13  (1/2 oz.) plain Hershey bars
12  oz. pkg. semi-sweet chips
1  pt. marshmallow cream
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
4 1/2  c. granulated sugar
1 large  can evaporated milk
1  lb. chopped pecans
preparation: Break Hershey bars, then place them plus the chocolate chips, vanilla, marshmallow cream and butter in a 6 to 8-quart container. Place sugar and milk in a 4 to 6-quart saucepan; bring to a boil and cook 6 minutes. Pour mixture of sugar and milk over remaining ingredients; blend until smooth and creamy. After blended, add nuts. Mix, then drop balls of mixture on waxed paper with tablespoon.  Refrigerate about 6 hours. Makes about 6 pounds.

name: GRAHAM TOFFEE BARS
ingredients:
24  graham cracker squares
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Arrange crackers in single layer in ungreased pan.  Heat sugar and butter to boiling.  Boil and stir 1 minute; remove from heat. Stir in vanilla.  Pour over crackers. Spread evenly. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake until bubbly, 8 to 10 minutes. Cool slightly. Cut into bars.  Makes 48 bars.

name: THREE BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1  can peas
1  can green lima beans
1  can white lima beans
1  can Great Northern beans
ham bone
1  c. potatoes, peeled and diced
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. diced onions, tossed lightly in 1 Tbsp. flour
preparation: Cook ham bone with potatoes until potatoes are done.  Add peas and all beans, juice and all to the ham and potato pot.  Saute floured onions in butter; add to soup mixture.   Cook about 10 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. butter
2 3/4  c. sugar
6  eggs
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla extract
3/4  c. crushed pineapple, undrained
preparation: Combine shortening, butter and sugar.  Cream until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each one. Combine flour and baking powder.  Add to creamed mixture, alternating with milk and vanilla and beating well after each addition.  Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: WATERMELON DRINK
ingredients:
5  c. watermelon chunks with seed
6  Tbsp. plain yogurt
7  Tbsp. sugar
1  ice cube
preparation: Place all the ingredients in the blender and blend for 2 minutes.  Refrigerate for an hour and serve.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. green onion, chopped fine
1  Tbsp. seasoned salt
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix pineapple, cream cheese, green pepper, onion and salt. Roll into a ball.  Chill.  Roll in nuts.  Chill again.  Can be spread on toasted buns or muffins as well as crackers.

name: SLICED BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  medium, even potatoes
1  tsp. salt
2 to 3  Tbsp. melted butter
2 to 3  Tbsp. chopped, fresh herbs (parsley, chives, thyme or sage) or 2 to 3 tsp. dried herbs
4  Tbsp. grated Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Scrub potatoes and rinse.  Cut potatoes into thin slices, but not all the way through.  Place potatoes in baking dish.  Fan slices slightly.  Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with herbs.  Bake potatoes at 425° for about 50 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheeses.  Bake potatoes for another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned.  Check with fork. Cheeses should be melted and potatoes soft inside.

name: PINEAPPLE CREAM CHEESE
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. pineapple juice
1/4  c. drained, crushed pineapple
preparation: Blend all ingredients together.  Spread on bread.

name: PICNIC PORK FRY(Laci Pecsenye)
ingredients:
2  lb. lean pork, sliced thin
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. paprika
2  garlic segments (crushed)
preparation: Sprinkle pork butts with salt and pepper.  Add paprika and garlic. Let stand for about 10 minutes.  Fry in deep fat.  Serve on slices of rye bread with sauerkraut.

name: GWEN'S APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. unbleached flour
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
3 1/2  c. diced apples, peeled (cooking apples)
1 1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1  c. salad oil
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. currants
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Grease well and flour one 13 x 9-inch pan.  In a large bowl, measure the flours and the sugar, oil, eggs, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and vanilla extract. Beat until well mixed.  (This is hard work, but worth it.)  Keep beating until well mixed.  Sometimes I get my hands right in the bowl and mix.  It's good for me and it doesn't hurt the cake. Anyway, next, you stir in the apples, nuts and currants.  (You can use raisins, but chop them first.)  Spread batter evenly into pan. Bake 1 hour or until cake is golden brown. Cool cake in pan on wire rack about 10 minutes. Remove from pan and cool completely on rack. Wrap and refrigerate.  Or eat it while it is hot with fresh butter. Enjoy.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
4  small fresh jalapenos, chopped
6  medium tomatoes, chopped or diced
1  medium onion, chopped
1/4  batch fresh cilantro, chopped
2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  fresh lime
preparation: Thoroughly mix all ingredients and squeeze with lime juice. Serve with chips or fajitas.

name: BAKED FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. light corn syrup
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. margarine
12  slices French bread
5  eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Microwave first three ingredients until melted.  Blend well. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan and lay 6 slices of bread on syrup mixture.  Top with 6 more slices.  Combine rest of ingredients and pour on bread.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: RICE AND PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  to 6 pork chops
1 1/2  c. Uncle Ben's rice
1  pkg. Lipton onion mix
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
3  c. water
preparation: I use large iron frying pan greased with butter or margarine. Wash and drain rice.  Spread in pan.  Sprinkle soup mix over rice. Place pork chops on top of this mixture.  Spread cream of mushroom soup over pork chops and add water.  Bake on 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: ZUCCHINI STUFFING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  medium zucchini, sliced
3/4  c. shredded carrots
1/2  c. chopped onion
6  Tbsp. butter
2  1/4 herb stuffing (Pepperidge Farm)
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Cook zucchini (steam or boil).  Cook carrots and onion in 4 tablespoons of butter until tender.  Place vegetables in 1 1/2-quart casserole with soup, sour cream and 1 1/2 cups of the stuffing.  Mix well.  Then melt the remaining butter and toss with the remaining stuffing.  Sprinkle that mixture on top of the prepared vegetables.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CARAMEL SQUARES
ingredients:
1  box light brown sugar
1 1/2  sticks margarine
3  eggs
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Beat together first 2 ingredients.  Add remaining ingredients and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Cut into squares when cool.

name: CHICKEN LASAGNA
ingredients:
8  oz. lasagna noodles, cooked and drained
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  lb. sliced mushrooms
1  bunch green onions, chopped
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese, grated (save 1/2 for topping)
salt
pepper
paprika
4  chicken breasts, cooked and diced (1/2 per person)
2 soup  cans half and half
1  large green pepper, chopped
8  oz. Ricotta cheese, mixed with 1 raw egg
8  oz. Jack cheese
3 to 4  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Saute mushrooms, onions and green pepper in butter.  Add soup and cream.  Stir until smooth.  Set aside.  Butter a 13-inch oblong pan.  Layer with half the noodles.  Place half the chicken in the pan, top with half the cheeses and pour half the sauce over the cheeses.  Repeat layers with other half of ingredients, ending with sauce.  Sprinkle with saved Mozzarella and paprika.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1 1/2  c. cold water
1  (4 serving) instant banana pudding
2  c. (1 pt.) whipping cream, whipped
36  vanilla wafers
3  medium bananas, sliced
preparation: In a large bowl, combine water and condensed milk and mix. Add pudding mix; beat well.  Chill 5 minutes.  Fold in whipped whipping cream.  Put vanilla wafers and bananas in bottom of bowl. Put 1/2 pudding mixture over.  Put another layer of wafers and bananas.  Put remaining pudding on top.   Crumble a few wafers and sprinkle over top of pudding and refrigerate.

name: CHERRY TOPPED ICEBOX CAKE
ingredients:
20  whole graham crackers
2  c. cold milk
1  pkg. (6 serving size) Jell-O vanilla or chocolate flavor instant pudding and pie filling
1 3/4  c. thawed Cool Whip
2  cans cherry pie filling
preparation: Line 13 x 9-inch pan with some of the graham crackers, breaking crackers, if necessary.  Pour cold milk into bowl.   Add pudding mix.  With electric mixer at low speed, beat until well blended, 1 to 2 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes; then blend in whipped topping.  Spread half of pudding mixture over crackers. Add another layer of crackers.  Top with remaining pudding mixture and remaining crackers.  Spread cherry pie filling over crackers. Chill about 3 hours.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. margarine
6  eggs, separated
3  c. flour, sifted 3 times
1  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. almond extract
2  tsp. butter flavoring
1  tsp. lemon extract
preparation: Cream sugar and margarine until very smooth.   Add egg yolks one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add soda to sour cream; stir well.   Add flour and cream alternately to the sugar-margarine mixture.   Blend well.  Add vanilla, almond, butter flavoring and lemon extract.  Beat egg whites until stiff, then fold into mixture.  Pour into well-greased and lightly floured stem pan (loaf pan).   Bake in preheated oven at 350° for about 1 1/2 hours or until toothpick inserted into center comes out clean.

name: CHEESE CHIPS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick margarine
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  pkg. onion soup mix
preparation: Blend ingredients;  form into log and chill.  Slice and bake at 375° for about 8 minutes.

name: BLUEBERRY CRUNCH
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple
4  c. blueberries
1/2  c. sugar
1  box yellow cake mix
2  sticks melted butter
preparation: Spread pineapple on bottom of lightly greased baking dish. Cover with blueberries.  Add 1/2 cup sugar sprinkled over berries. Sprinkle dry cake mix over sugar.  Melt butter and pour evenly over cake mix.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: TROUT ALMONDINE
ingredients:
4  trout fillets
1/2  c. slivered almonds
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. milk
1/4 to 1/2  c. oil
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Put fillets in shallow pan and add milk to cover.  Let stand for 1 hour.  Put almonds with peel in small bowl; cover with water.  Place in microwave on High for 1 minute.   This will make peeling come off easily.  Sliver the almonds with paring knife and set aside.  Remove fillets from milk and put in flour mixture (flour, salt and pepper).  Toss lightly and shake off excess. Brown fillets in oil until lightly brown on both sides.  Discard oil.  Put butter in skillet and add nuts.  Saute until golden brown.  Place fillets on platter and covered with toasted almonds. Serve.

name: APPLE DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese (room temperature)
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
7  oz. canned crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  c. chopped dates
preparation: Beat  together	cream  cheese  and mayonnaise.	Stir in pineapple, dates and pecans.  Cover  and  refrigerate up to 48 hours.  Serve with tart red and green apples, unpeeled and cut into wedges for dipping.

name: SLICED CUCUMBER PICKLES
ingredients:
30  small cukes
1  c. salt
1  qt. small onions
1  qt. vinegar
2  tsp. celery seed
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
preparation: Combine ingredients in order given.  Cook to boiling point. Add peeled cucumbers and onions.  Simmer 20 minutes.  Remove from fire and place in jars.

name: NEIMAN MARCUS COOKIES(Recipe May Be Halved)
ingredients:
2  cups butter
4  cups flour
2  tsp. soda
2  cups sugar
5  cups blended oatmeal
24  oz. chocolate chips
2  cups brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  (8 oz.) Hershey bar grated
4  eggs
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. vanilla
3  cups chopped nuts of your choice
preparation: Measure oatmeal and blend in a blender to a fine powder. Cream the butter and both sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix together with flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder and soda. Add chocolate chips, Hershey bar and nuts. Roll into balls and place 2 inches apart on a cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes at 375 degrees. Makes 112 cookies.

name: BAKED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  (1-inch thick) loin pork chops
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
3/4  c. ketchup or chili sauce
6  slices onion
6  slices lemon
preparation: Place chops in baking  pan  in  single  layer; salt and pepper to  taste.  Spread 2 teaspoons brown sugar and 2 tablespoons ketchup  on  each  chop.  Top  with  slice of onion and slice of lemon.  Add  enough water to reach a level halfway up on chops. Bake,  covered,  at  350°  for  2  1/2  to 3 hours. Uncover last half hour of cooking.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies
2  onions, chopped
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes (undrained), chopped
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1/2  c. water
1 1/2  lb. cooked, skinless and boneless chicken breast, chopped
2  c. nonfat plain yogurt
4  (12-inch) flour tortillas, torn into 1-inch strips
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. part skim Mozzarella cheese, shredded
preparation: Coat a skillet with nonstick cooking spray; saute the green chilies and onions until tender.  Stir in tomatoes, garlic powder, oregano and water.  Simmer, uncovered, for about 30 minutes, or until thick.  Combine chicken and yogurt; place in a shallow 3-quart baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray.  Add tortilla strips on top of chicken mixture; cover with tomato sauce.  Top casserole with shredded Mozzarella cheese.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes, or until thoroughly heated.  Yields 10 servings.

name: CORNED BEEF HASH WITH EGGS
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can corned beef hash, cut into 1-inch thick slices
1 egg for  slice hash
preparation: Arrange hash slices in a buttered baking pan.  Press a hollow in the center of each and break an egg into it.  Cover and bake 25 minutes at 325° or until the egg white is firm.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  1/2 yellow squash (small), sliced
1  stick margarine
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  large onion, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing
preparation: Cook squash until tender, 20 to 25 minutes.  Drain in colander.  Put in bowl.  Add margarine while hot.  Add other ingredients; mix well.  Place in Pyrex dish; sprinkle top with stuffing mix.  Dot with margarine.  Bake at 350° for about 25 minutes until bubbly and brown.

name: SWEET AND SOUR SLAW(Teacher Favorite)
ingredients:
1  large head cabbage, shredded or thinly sliced
1  green pepper, finely chopped
1  red onion, thinly sliced
1  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
3/4  c. olive oil
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. celery salt
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. mustard seed
preparation: Combine shredded cabbage, green pepper and onion in large bowl.  Sprinkle with sugar.  Combine remaining ingredients in a small saucepan.  Bring to a boil and pour over cabbage mixture. Cover tightly and refrigerate at least 4 hours.  Toss just before serving.  Can keep up to two weeks.

name: MEDITERRANEAN SHRIMP WITH LINGUINE
ingredients:
12  oz. linguine
3  Tbsp. olive oil
1 1/2  lb. large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1  large onion, chopped (about 1 1/4 c.)
2  cloves garlic, crushed
2 (28 oz.)  cans whole tomatoes, drained
3/4  c. large pitted black olives, sliced and drained
2  tsp. dried oregano
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground pepper
1/2  c. crumbled Feta (2 oz.)
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Prepare linguine and keep warm.  In 12-inch skillet over medium-high, heat 2 tablespoons oil.  Add shrimp and cook 4 minutes, stirring frequently until shrimp is just pink.  Using slotted spoon, transfer shrimp to plate.

name: YUM YUM GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. molasses filled to 3/4 with white sugar
1/4  c. shortening
1 1/4  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
1  egg
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ginger
1/2  c. boiling water
preparation: Blend molasses, sugar, shortening and egg in electric mixer, about 2 minutes.  Sift dry ingredients and add gradually.  Add boiling water last.  It makes a thin batter.  Pour into 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  It makes very light gingerbread that doesn't get dry.

name: APPLE  CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  large eggs
3  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1   tsp. baking soda
3  c. peeled and cubed Winesap or Rome apples
1  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease and flour a tube or Bundt pan.  Combine the oil, sugar and eggs in a large bowl.  Mix well. Combine the flour, cinnamon, salt, and baking soda. Add the flour mixture to the creamed mixture alternately with the apples. Stir in the pecans and vanilla. Pour into the prepared pan. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until a toothpick inserted into center of cake comes out clean. Cool for about 10 minutes before removing from the pan. Frost with your favorite caramel icing, if desired.

name: BROCCOLI-CAULIFLOWER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  bunch broccoli, cut into bite size pieces
1  head cauliflower, cut into bite size pieces
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can French fried onion rings
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
preparation: Steam vegetables until crisp-tender.  Melt soup and cheese together and pour over vegetables.  Fold in casserole dish.   Top with onion rings and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN PIES
ingredients:
1  can Libby's pumpkin
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. rum
1/4  lb. butter
1  qt. egg nog
1/2  c. whiskey
preparation: Follow recipe on Libby's can, then add melted butter, flour, spiked egg nog and 2 extra eggs.  Mix well.  Bake in 350° oven 45 to 60 minutes or until butter knife inserted comes out clean.

name: YELLOW RICE AND CORN
ingredients:
1  pkg. Mahatma yellow rice
1  stick butter or margarine
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 or 2  cans Mexicorn
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook rice according to directions.  Put butter in while hot, then add soup and Mexicorn.  Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with cheese for the last 5 minutes.

name: QUICK SAVORY POPCORN
ingredients:
4  qt. freshly-popped corn
1 (1 oz.)  envelope original party dip mix
1/3  c. butter or margarine
preparation: Pour popped corn into a large bowl; set aside.  Microwave on High the butter in uncovered 1-cup glass measure for 1 to 1 1/4 minutes or until melted.  Stir in dip mix.  Drizzle butter mixture over popped corn.   Toss lightly to coat evenly.  Makes about 16 cups.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1 2/3  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. shortening
2  unbeaten eggs
1/2  c. nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. mashed bananas (2 large or 3 small)
preparation: Mix together dry ingredients.   Add remaining ingredients and put in greased loaf pan and bake in 300° oven for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: HONEY BARBECUE CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  c. flour
paprika (enough to make nice red color)
1/4 to 1/2  c. celery salt
salt
2  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. honey
your favorite barbecue sauce (about 2 Tbsp.)
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients together well. Dip chicken pieces into flour mixture. Bake for 45 to 60 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: SWEDISH CABBAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
1  egg
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
2/3  c. milk
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. ground pork
3/4  c. rice, cooked
6  large cabbage leaves
1  can tomato soup
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
fresh sage (optional)
marjoram (optional)
preparation: In bowl, combine egg, 1 teaspoon salt, dash of pepper, Worcestershire sauce, onion and milk; mix well. Add beef, pork and rice. Beat together with fork. Immerse cabbage leaves in boiling water for 3 minutes or just until limp; drain. Heavy center vein may be slit about 2 1/2 inches.  Place 1/2 cup meat mixture on each leaf. Fold in sides and roll ends over meat. Place rolls in baking dish. Blend soup, sugar and lemon juice. Pour over cabbage rolls. Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours. Baste once or twice with sauce.  Serves 6.

name: TOURTIERE(French Pork Pie)
ingredients:
3  lb. lean ground pork
2  lb. ground beef
4  medium onions, chopped
4  potatoes, cooked and mashed
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. allspice
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In large kettle, cook pork, beef and onions until beef and pork are grey color.  Simmer meat over medium-low heat until fat starts coming to top, about 1 hour.  Stir occasionally.  If meat appears dry, add some water.  Skim fat while meat is simmering. Add spices, salt and pepper; continue simmering while the potatoes are cooking in another pot.  Drain potatoes and mash.  Add potatoes to meat mixture and cook for 20 to 30 minutes.  (If more spices are desired, add at this time.)

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  can tropical fruit, drained
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
1  c. red and white grapes, seeded and cut in halves
1  c. diced apples
1  can Eagle Brand milk (condensed)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
preparation: Mix all fruit together in a large bowl.  Blend milk and cream cheese together.  Pour over fruit and refrigerate.

name: SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box (18.25 ozs) Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
1  ox (3.4 oz.) Jello instant Lemon pudding
5  eggs
3/4  c. oil
2/3  c. milk
1/2  stick oleo
cinnamon sugar mixture to taste
preparation: In bowl, blend together first 5 ingredients on low speed; then beat on high for 5 minutes.  Pour into a greased 9 x 13 x 2 inch baking dish and bake at 350° for 20 minutes, or until brown.  Melt margarine and drizzle over hot cake.  Sprinkle cinnamon sugar mixture on top.

name: MY MOM'S RAISIN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. raisins
1  c. water
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. margarine
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
4  c. flour
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Boil raisins and water for 5 minutes.  When cool, add baking soda.  Cream sugar and margarine and add eggs.  Add flour with the rest of the dry ingredients, raisins and nuts.  Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.  Bake for 12 minutes in a 375° oven.

name: ZUCCHINI-GARBANZO BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
2  c. chopped zucchini
1  medium onion, chopped
2  tomatoes, chopped
1  c. tomato juice or V-8 juice
1  tsp. parsley
1  tsp. finely chopped hot pepper
preparation: Simmer.

name: GREEK VINAIGRETTE
ingredients:
1/3  c. olive oil
3  Tbsp. wine vinegar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  tsp. fresh oregano
1  tsp. sugar
1 small  clove garlic, minced
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Combine ingredients in a jar with a screw-top lid.  Shake well to mix.  Store in refrigerator, covered, for up to two weeks.

name: BANANA ORANGE SHAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. skim milk
1/2  large, ripe banana
2  Tbsp. frozen orange juice concentrate
2  ice cubes
preparation: Combine all ingredients in blender.  Blend on high for 30 to 45 seconds or until smooth.  Serve immediately.   Serves 1.

name: MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
12  oz. sour cream
1  pkg. taco seasoning powder
1 small  jar taco sauce
chopped peppers
onions
black olives
shredded Cheddar cheese
shredded Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Mix first 3 items.  Put on bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish.  Pour taco sauce on top of this.  Then add layer of chopped peppers, onions, black olives, shredded Cheddar cheese and shredded Monterey Jack cheese.  Top with chopped tomatoes.  Serve with nachos.

name: WILD RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box Uncle Ben's wild rice mix
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2 beef bouillon cubes, dissolved in 1 1/2  c. hot water
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1/4  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  crumbled bay leaf
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  lb. ground beef
2  cans mushrooms
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/4  tsp. onion salt
preparation: Cook wild rice mix as directed.  Brown ground beef and onion. Mix all ingredients together.  Let stand overnight or several hours.  Bake in 3-quart casserole at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: WHITE BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
3 (1/4-inch)  slices ham
2  Tbsp. butter
1  medium onion, diced
3  (8 oz.) containers light cream
2  c. water
2  large chicken bouillon cubes
2 (16 oz.)  cans Great Northern white beans
1  dash black pepper
preparation: Cube slices of ham and onion and sauté in melted butter. Add cream, water, beans, chicken bouillon and pepper; bring to a boil. Lower heat to simmer and cook 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Mash the beans in the soup. Cook another 20 minutes and serve.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  box yellow or butter recipe cake mix
1/8  tsp. soda
1  c. mashed bananas
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Follow cake directions except use only 1/3 cup water.  Add other ingredients.  Pour into a large loaf pan.  Bake at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: PEPPER BISCUITS
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1 1/2  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. fennel seed (or less)
3/4  c. oil
1  pkg. dry yeast
1  c. lukewarm water
preparation: Melt yeast in lukewarm water and mix well.  Let rise (cover) for at least 2 hours.  Bake in 400° or 500° oven.

name: Squash Casserole(Serves 8)
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. squash
3/4  tsp. sugar
1  onion, diced
1/2  c. sharp cheese, grated
buttered bread crumbs or Pepperidge Farm cornbread stuffing
dash of salt and pepper
preparation: Cook squash and onion in saucepan with water until tender. Drain and place in casserole.  Sprinkle cheese, salt, pepper and sugar over squash.  Add Cheese Sauce.  Top with bread crumbs. Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: COUNTRY STYLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans (10-3/4 oz.) condensed cream of chicken soup undiluted
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. honey
2  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
1  pkg. (26 oz.) frozen shredded hash brown potatoes
4  c. cubed cooked chicken or fully cooked ham
3  c. sliced frozen carrots, optional
preparation: In a large bowl, combine the first 5 ingredients.  Stir in hash browns, chicken, and carrots, if desired.  Transfer to a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish.  Cover and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.  Bake uncovered 15 to 20 minutes longer or until bubbly.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  (20 oz.) roll refrigerator sugar cookie dough
1  c. sugar
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1 (16 oz.)  can sliced peaches
1 (20 oz.)  can sliced pineapple
1 (4 oz.)  jar maraschino cherries
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  or 4 large bananas, sliced
preparation: Press cookie dough into 12-inch pizza pan.   Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown.   Spread cream cheese over cooled cookie and add drained fruit.

name: CREAM PUFF PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. boiling water
1/4  c. shortening
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  c. flour
2  eggs
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  In a saucepan, combine the water, shortening and salt until melted. Add flour and stir constantly until mixture leaves side of pan and forms a ball.	Remove from heat and cool a few minutes. Beat in eggs, one at a time, until smooth and velvety. Spread in a greased 9-inch glass pie pan. Be sure to grease the sides of the pan but do not spread batter on sides. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400°, then reduce to 350°.	Bake until done, about 35 to 40 minutes.  Cool away from any draft.

name: OLD FASHION RAISIN CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. raisins
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. cloves and nutmeg
1/2  tsp. allspice
1  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Boil raisins with water to cover until plump and let stand until cool. Drain and save the juice. Cream together the butter, sugar and eggs until light and fluffy. Sift together all the dry ingredients. Beat all the dry ingredients along with the juice from the raisins and add enough water to make 1 cup. Beat with cream mixture until smooth. Fold in raisins and nuts. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done. Frost with peanut butter frosting or frosting of your choice.

name: MARINATED FRUIT CUP
ingredients: various fruits (such as apples, oranges, watermelon, strawberries, grapes, pineapple, peaches, pears and cherries)
preparation: Chop the fruit.  Marinate in fruit punch or grape juice.  Serve cold.

name: SNICKERS CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
14  oz. caramels
1/3  c. milk
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Prepare cake mix and pour half the batter into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. While baking, melt together the caramels, milk and margarine.
