When cake has cooked first 20 minutes, cool 10 minutes, then pour caramel mixture on top. Reduce oven to 250°. Sprinkle chocolate chips and nuts on top of caramel mixture. Cover with remaining cake batter.  Bake at 250° for 20 minutes.  Replace oven to 350° and bake 10 minutes or until done.

name: EASY BLACKBERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. sugar
1 (16 oz.)  can blackberries (undrained)
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  pkg. Martha White blackberry muffin mix
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Melt butter in 8 to 9-inch baking dish. Add sugar to blackberries and lemon juice.  Let come to boil. Add muffin mix and milk.  Stir until well blended.  Spoon into baking pan with butter (don't stir).  Spoon hot blackberries and juice evenly over batter (do not stir).  Bake 35 to 45 minutes or until golden brown.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: LAYERED MUSHROOMS AND EGGS
ingredients:
1  can (about 10 3/4 oz.) condensed cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
3  Tbsp. dry sherry or milk
1 1/2  c. (6 oz.) each shredded sharp Cheddar cheese and Jack cheese
18  eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1/8  tsp. pepper
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  lb. mushrooms, sliced
1/4  c. chopped green onion
paprika
preparation: In a pan over medium heat, stir soup and sherry until hot and smooth.  Remove from heat; set aside.  In a small bowl, toss cheeses lightly to mix; set aside.  Beat together eggs, milk, parsley, dill weed and pepper; set aside.

name: STUFFED CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
6  whole chicken breasts, skinned and boned
1/2  c. grated Swiss cheese
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
3  green onions with tops, chopped
1/4  c. butter (room temperature)
salt and pepper
3  Tbsp. olive oil
3  Tbsp. melted butter
1/4  tsp. paprika
preparation: Place chicken breasts between 2 sheets of waxed paper and pound out.  Blend cheese, crumbs, parsley, onions and 1/4 cup butter. Shape into 6 balls.  Season inside of each chicken breast with salt and pepper.  Place stuffing ball at one end of each breast.  Turn long sides of breast toward center just enough to make a neat fold. Roll up each breast as for a jellyroll.  Secure ends with skewers or toothpicks.  Brush rolls with oil and butter and sprinkle with paprika.  Arrange on medium-hot grill.  Cover and cook 15 minutes. Brush with oil and butter; turn and brush again.  Cover and continue cooking about 10 minutes more or until done.  Brush with oil and butter again just before serving.  Top with packaged mushroom sauce, if desired.

name: BLUEBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  pkg. Dream Whip
1  c. self-rising flour
3/4  c. chopped nuts
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  stick margarine
8  oz. cream cheese
preparation: Melt butter.  Add flour, nuts and sugar.  Stir; grease oblong pan or Pyrex dish.  Pat out mixture as a layer, cook 15 minutes at 350°.

name: CABBAGE PATCH SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat (beef or turkey)
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
3  c. cabbage, cut up
2  cans tomatoes
1  can pinto beans with jalapeno peppers
1 1/2  c. water
3  slices bacon, cut up
1  tsp. sugar
salt and pepper
basil leaf to taste
preparation: Combine and cook slow for 2 hours.  Thin with chicken broth if too thick.

name: PEANUT BUTTER SQUARES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/3  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. packed brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. milk
1/3  c. chopped peanuts (topping)
preparation: Grease a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.  Stir together flour, baking powder and salt.  In mixer bowl, beat peanut butter and shortening on medium speed for 30 seconds.  Add brown sugar and beat until fluffy.  Add eggs and vanilla; beat well.  Add dry ingredients and milk alternately to beaten mixture and beat until well blended.  Spread batter in prepared pan.  Bake in 350° oven for 20 minutes or until done.  Cool and frost with Peanut Butter Frosting.  Sprinkle with chopped peanuts.

name: JELLO POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
5  qt. popcorn, popped
1  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  c. sugar
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Jell-O
preparation: Bring syrup and sugar to a boil.  Remove from heat and add Jell-O.  Mix until Jell-O is dissolved.  Let cool.  Pour over popcorn.  Mix well and form into balls.

name: RUSSIAN TEA MIX
ingredients:
2  c. orange Tang mix
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. instant tea
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1/2  Tbsp. cloves
preparation: Combine  all  ingredients  together.  Use 2 to 3 tablespoons per coffee mug with very hot water.

name: APPLE CRUNCH CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. peeled thin sliced apples
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. oil
2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  egg
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
2 1/4  c. flour
preparation: Mix together sliced apples and sugar.  Set aside 20 minutes or in refrigerator overnight.  Add oil, vanilla, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, egg, nuts and flour.  Pour into floured pan; bake at 350° for 60 minutes.

name: DATE NUT CHEWS(Golf Balls)
ingredients:
2  eggs
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. almond extract or brandy
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. Karo syrup (red label)
1/2  c. chopped dates
1/2  c. nutmeats, chopped
3/4  c. flour
powdered sugar (to roll chews in)
preparation: Beat eggs, salt and almond extract or brandy until light. Gradually add sugar and syrup.  Add flour, dates and nuts.  Pour into 2 greased 8-inch pans.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from oven.  While still hot, shape into small balls with 2 teaspoons and roll in hands, then in powdered sugar.

name: YUMMY CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cooking oil
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
4  c. diced apples
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix by hand sugar, eggs and oil.  Add flour, soda, salt and cinnamon.   Add apples and nuts.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan for 45 minutes in a 350° oven.  Top with cream cheese icing.

name: PEPPY VEGGY
ingredients:
2  c. beef bouillon
2  c. vegetable juice
1/2  tsp. Tabasco
lime slices
preparation: In medium saucepan, combine beef bouillon and vegetable juice; bring to boil.  Stir in Tabasco.  Remove from heat.  Serve in mug with lime slices.  Contains 36 calories per serving.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES SUPREME
ingredients:
8  medium potatoes, sliced
1/4  c. green pepper
1/4  c. minced onions
2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Alternate layer of potatoes, green pepper and onions in baking dish. Season each layer with salt and pepper. Mix soup and milk. Pour over potatoes. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 8 servings.

name: Clam Dip
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
1  can minced clams
1/3  juice from clams
dash of Tabasco sauce
1/4  grated lemon
1 small  clove garlic, grated
preparation: Mix together.  Add enough mayonnaise to thin mixture for dipping.  Serve with crackers or chips.

name: O.K. BARS
ingredients:
3/4  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. peanut butter
1  c. raisins (optional)
6  c. cereal (Triples, Special K, Cheerios, etc.)
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. butterscotch chips
preparation: Heat corn syrup and sugar to boiling in heavy saucepan, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter. Pour over cereal and raisins (optional) and stir until well coated.  Press into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and cool.  Melt chips together and spread over top.  Cool, then cut into bars.

name: HAM ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. (10 slices) ham lunch meat
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
10  slices American cheese
1  Tbsp. chopped chives
1  Tbsp. onion flakes
preparation: Mix cream cheese, chives and onion flakes.  Take one piece of ham, 1 piece of cheese and spread with cream cheese mixture.  Roll up pinwheel style and secure with 5 toothpicks.  Repeat procedure with rest of the ingredients.  Chill for one hour.  Slice each roll into 5 pieces.  Yields 50 rolls.

name: TANGY FRUIT DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
1/4  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl until thoroughly blended.  Serve with your favorite fruit or combination of fruits for a salad or dessert.  Makes 1 cup.

name: LAYER CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
2  c. white sugar
3  c. self-rising flour
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
6  eggs
preparation: Use electric mixer on low speed.  Cream butter and sugar together.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Save 2 of the above egg whites for icing.  Add flour and milk, about 1/2 at a time.  Beat a few minutes on high speed.  Bake at 350° until brown and  cake leaves sides of pan.  This makes 3 layers of cake.

name: CRUNCHY BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  bunches raw broccoli or 12 large stalks
10  slices bacon, fried and cut into small pieces
2/3  c. raisins
1  c. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. chopped red onion
preparation: Wash and drain broccoli.  Cut into bite-size pieces.  Combine broccoli, bacon and raisins in a large bowl with lid.  In blender combine mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar and onion.  Blend until smooth. Pour over broccoli mixture and toss to coat.  Cover bowl with lid and refrigerate overnight to blend flavors.  Toss salad again before serving to coat broccoli with dressing.

name: PEANUT PORK
ingredients:
pork loin
unsalted peanuts
flour
salt and pepper
oil for frying
egg and water wash
preparation: Slice pork lengthways into about three fillets, then slice into bite-sized pieces.  Place unsalted peanuts in food processor with knife blade; process until they are the consistency of flour.  Be careful not to make peanut butter.  Mix peanut flour with all-purpose flour (half and half).  Add salt and pepper to taste, set aside.  Beat one egg and add as much water.  Dip meat in egg wash, then into peanut flour.  Drop into hot grease and fry until golden brown and crispy.

name: PINEAPPLE COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
1  pie shell, unbaked
3  eggs, well beaten
1  c. sugar
3/4  stick softened oleo
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. crushed pineapple, undrained
1  c. coconut
preparation: Add sugar, oleo and flour to beaten eggs.  Beat well and stir in pineapple and coconut.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: SAUERKRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onions
1  c. chopped celery
1 large  can sauerkraut (shredded)
1/2  c. oil
1  c. chopped bell pepper
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Heat sauerkraut, sugar and oil until hot through and through. Add onion, celery and bell pepper.  Heat all together.  Keep in refrigerator.

name: BAKED BEANS(Servings: 12)
ingredients:
2  cans B&M baked beans
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
8  bacon strips
1  chopped onion
3/4  c. ketchup
1  can beef consomme
1  lb. ground beef
1  chopped bell pepper
preparation: Fry bacon, crumble and reserve.  Brown ground beef, onion and bell pepper in skillet.   Drain.  Pour into large bowl and add remaining ingredients, adding bacon into mixture last.  Bake 1 hour at 300°.

name: PUMPKIN CRISP
ingredients:
1 (29 oz.)  can pumpkin
1  c. sugar
1  c. evaporated milk
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
spice cake mix
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Combine and mix first 6 ingredients. Spread in 9 x 13 baking pan. Sprinkle 2/3 of spice cake mix on top. Sprinkle on top of cake mix the chopped walnuts. Drizzle butter over top. Bake for 50 minutes at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. chopped frozen broccoli
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
2  c. sharp cheese
1/2  stick margarine
1  small onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Saute the chopped onion in the margarine.  Add all other ingredients and mix well.  Place in baking dish.  Place in preheated oven at 350° until bubbly.

name: FLUFFY LEMON CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  stick margarine, melted
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs (1 pkg. crackers)
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix lemon jello and boiling water together; cool.  Cream the cream cheese, sugar and vanilla together until smooth.  Add jello mixture and mix well.  Chill until thickened.

name: *AUTUMN SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onion
4  c. water
1  c. chopped carrots
1  c. diced celery
1  c. cubed potatoes
6  tomatoes
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. bottled brown bouquet sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. basil
1  bay leaf
preparation: In a large saucepan, cook and stir meat until brown; drain off fat.  Cook and stir onion with meat until onion is tender.  Stir in remaining ingredients except tomatoes.  Heat to boiling, reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes.  Add tomatoes; cover and simmer 10 minutes longer or until vegetables are tender.

name: FLAG DESSERT
ingredients:
2  pt. strawberries
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. Entenmann's all butter pound loaf, cut into 8 slices
1 1/3  c. blueberries, divided
1  (12 oz.) tub Cool Whip non-dairy whipped topping, thawed
preparation: Slice 1 cup of the strawberries. Set aside.  Halve remaining strawberries and set aside.  Line bottom of 12 x 18-inch baking dish with cake slices. Top with 1 cup sliced  strawberries, 1 cup of the blueberries and all of the whipped topping.  Place strawberry halves and remaining 1/3 cup blueberries on whipped topping to make flag design.

name: Waffles
ingredients:
2  well beaten eggs
2  tsp. sugar
1 1/2  cup milk
2  cups flour
3  teaspoons baking powder
preparation: Beat mixture thoroughly with 1/2 cup melted butter added in at the end.  Pour small amounts onto waffle iron, cooking until golden brown.

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. applesauce
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. margarine or butter
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg
1  c. raisins
preparation: Combine ingredients and pour into loaf pan.  Bake in 350° oven for about 1 hour.

name: CREPES(French Pancakes)
ingredients:
1 2/3  c. flour
2  eggs
2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil (butter is best)
1  pinch of salt
preparation: Place flour in a bowl.  Make a hole.  Put in it the whole eggs, oil, salt and a little milk.  Mix well with a spoon. Progressively, add the milk until mixture makes a ribbon when you pour it from the spoon.  Add the flavoring of your choice (vanilla or lemon juice).  Let the mixture sit for 1 hour.  It will become thicker.  Add a little milk to make it thinner.  Put just a little oil (Pam is better) on a very hot pancake griddle or skillet.  A round Teflon skillet with the bottom the desired size of the pancake is best.  Make the mixture spread out by moving and turning skillet vigorously.  Turn the crepe as soon as it's brown and it is done enough to be turned.  This takes less than a minute.  Cook it on the other side.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar.  Serve hot.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  can whole corn, drained
5  large potatoes, chopped
1/2  c. cheese, grated
salt and pepper to taste
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  c. water
1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Place ground beef, bell pepper and onion in skillet over medium heat until ground beef is done; drain.  Add corn, tomato paste and water and mix.  Boil potatoes and cream with milk and butter.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 serving size)  pkg. cherry gelatin
3  c. boiling water
1 small  can cranberry sauce
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped apples
1  c. chopped nuts
bananas (optional)
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water in a large saucepan.  Add cranberry sauce and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and cool. Add remaining ingredients.  Pour into mold (lightly greased with mayonnaise) and refrigerate.

name: YUM YUM SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. vanilla tapioca pudding
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. orange Jell-O
3  c. water
1  can mandarin oranges
1 flat  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 large  pkg. Dream Whip
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix tapioca pudding, orange Jell-O and water together in pan; place on heat, stirring constantly, until it boils.  Boil for 1 minute; semi cool and fold in Dream Whip which has been whipped with milk.  Add mandarin oranges and crushed pineapple.  Put in loaf pan and refrigerate.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. apple pie spice or 2 tsp. cinnamon
2  c. apples, cubed
1  c. nuts
1/2  c. raisins
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. Crisco oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 55 to 60 minutes at 350°.

name: FRIED SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Kraft tangy Italian style spaghetti dinner
2  tsp. salt
3  qt. boiling water
3  Tbsp. margarine, divided
2  eggs
2  tsp. minced parsley
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. olive or vegetable oil
8  oz. sausage
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. chopped onion
8  oz. ketchup or tomato sauce
1/4  c. water
preparation: Prepare spaghetti according to package instructions, using 2 teaspoons salt, boiling water and 1 tablespoon of margarine.  Do not add herb and spice mix.  Cool spaghetti to room temperature and stir in package of grated Parmesan cheese, eggs, parsley and 1/4 teaspoon of salt and pepper.

name: LADYE'S WEDDING MOCHA PUNCH
ingredients:
1  gal. strong coffee
2  c. sugar
3  cans Hershey's syrup (3 or 4-inches tall)
1 to 2  tsp. vanilla
Amaretto or kahlua (to spice up)
2  gal. milk
French vanilla ice cream (10 to 15 scoops)
cinnamon/nutmeg/chocolate shavings
chocolate syrup
maraschino cherries
preparation: Mix together first 4 (or 5) ingredients.  Put in refrigerator. Gradually add 2 gallons of milk to mixture.  Garnish with whipped ice cream.  Add cinnamon, nutmeg, chocolate shavings, cherries and chocolate syrup on top.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD:  COUNTRY CLUB STYLE
ingredients:
4  c. chopped cooked chicken
2  c. chopped celery
4  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
1 (2 oz.)  jar diced pimiento, drained
1  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
2/3  c. sliced almonds, toasted*
preparation: *You may substitute 1 1/2 cups crushed potato chips for almonds.

name: MEXICAN ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1  pkg. extra large tortillas
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
8  oz. sour cream
1  bunch green onions, chopped
1  can chopped green chilies
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Spread on tortillas and roll up.  Refrigerate for 2 days.  Slice in bite-size pieces.  Serve with picante sauce.

name: CHICKEN SALAD SUPREME
ingredients:
4  c. chopped cooked chicken
1/2  c. slivered almonds, toasted
1/4  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. salt
lettuce leaves
2  c. seedless grapes (about 3/4 lb.)
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. chutney
1/8  tsp. pepper
hard-cooked eggs, quartered (optional)
preparation: Combine chicken,  grapes  and  almonds.  Combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, sour cream, chutney, salt and pepper.	Add to chicken mixture and toss  well.  Cover and chill.  Serve on lettuce leaves.  Garnish  with hard-cooked eggs.  Yields about 6 servings.

name: MUESLI(Swiss Oatmeal)
ingredients:
2  c. oats (quick or regular)
1 1/2  c. skim milk
1/3 to 1/2  c. raisins, chopped prunes or dates (depending on how sweet you like it)
1/2  c. orange juice
1/3  c. wheat germ or unprocessed bran
1/4  tsp. salt (optional)
1/3  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients; mix well.  Cover and refrigerate overnight or at least 8 hours.  Mix well.  Serve with milk and honey, if desired.  May be warmed in microwave, if desired.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. powdered sugar
2  c. butter or margarine
2  c. oil
4  eggs
9  c. flour
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream sugar, powdered sugar, margarine, oil and eggs until smooth.  Add the flour (a little at a time), cream of tartar, baking soda and vanilla; mix well.  Refrigerate dough for 2 hours. Roll out on a flour covered board.  Then you may use your desired cookie cutter to cut cookies.  Place on a cookie sheet and bake 7 to 9 minutes at 375°.  Serves 36.

name: JOANN'S BUTTERMILK BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. shortening
3/4  c. buttermilk
preparation: In a bowl, combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in buttermilk; knead dough gently. Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake on lightly greased pan at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes.    Yield: 10 biscuits.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE OR ASPARAGUS
ingredients:
1  loaf bread, stale and broken into cubes
1  c. Longhorn cheese
1/2  c. melted butter
1  c. cubed chicken (as much as you like)
1  can cream of chicken soup, mixed with 1/2 c. milk
broccoli or asparagus (as much as you like)
preparation: Mix together the bread, Longhorn cheese and melted butter. Pour half of the mixture in a casserole dish.  Layer broccoli or asparagus and cubed chicken.  Pour soup mixture over chicken and top with remaining bread crumb mixture.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

name: PAT'S FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can peach pie filling
1  can mandarin oranges
1  can pineapple, crushed
1  can pineapple chunks
1  can peaches
2  bananas
grapes, maraschino cherries, blueberries, pecans and whatever may be added
preparation: Drain the oranges, pineapple and pineapple chunks.  Mix pie filling with all the other fruits and chill. Serve over lettuce or with cottage cheese and lettuce.  Makes about 10 good servings.

name: PUMPKIN BARS
ingredients:
4  eggs
1 2/3  c. sugar
1  c. oil
1  can pumpkin
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix eggs, sugar, oil and pumpkin together in large bowl. Combine rest of ingredients in a separate bowl, then add to pumpkin mixture.  Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool and frost.

name: CHICKEN PINEAPPLE STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1  chicken breast, skinned, boned and cut into chunks
20  oz. can pineapple chunks (in juice not syrup)
2  cloves garlic, pressed
1  green bell pepper, slivered
1  tsp. ground ginger
1/3  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  medium carrots, sliced
rice
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/3 cup juice.  In large skillet, stir-fry chicken with garlic and ginger in oil for 2 minutes.  Add pineapple, carrots and bell pepper.  Cover; steam 2 to 3 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.  Combine pineapple juice, soy sauce and cornstarch.  Pour into skillet; add green onions and toss until heated through.  Serve over rice.

name: LIVER DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground liver
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1  egg
1  stack crushed crackers (1 regular pkg.)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix well; form into balls the size of walnuts.  Drop into a good beef broth.   Boil for 30 minutes.

name: CABBAGE A LA CREME
ingredients:
1/2  medium cabbage
1/3  c. reconsitituted nonfat instant milk
1  tsp. margarine
preparation: Cut cabbage into thin slices; boil for 8 minutes in small amount of boiling salted water.  Drain; stir in milk and margarine.  Serve immediately.  Makes 4 large servings.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. cubed apples (5 medium)
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. oil
preparation: Beat eggs; add sugar and oil.  Add dry ingredients.  Fold in raisins and nuts.  Beat 2 minutes.  Add 3 or more tablespoons water if batter is dry.  Add vanilla and apples.  Bake, cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: FROZEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  (3 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. mayonnaise
juice of one lemon
1/2  c. chopped pecans
2  medium size bananas, mashed
1/2  c. maraschino cherries
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1/2  c. crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix all together and freeze.  Cut into squares.

name: DIET BUSTERS
ingredients:
1  pkg. German chocolate cake mix
3/4  c. melted butter
1  c. chocolate chips
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. light caramels
1 small  can evaporated milk
preparation: Combine caramels and 1/3 cup evaporated milk; melt on low heat and stir.  In separate bowl, combine cake mix, 1/3 cup evaporated milk and butter.  Spread only 1/2 the mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan; bake at 350° for 6 minutes.  Remove from oven; sprinkle with chocolate chips.  Drizzle caramel over that; dot with reserved cake mixture.  Bake 20 more minutes at 350°.  Let cool before cutting.

name: MARINATED ROAST(Sirloin)
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. salad oil
3/4  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. dry mustard
2 1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. black pepper
1/2  c. wine vinegar
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/3  c. lemon juice
4  lb. roast
preparation: Combine all ingredients except roast.  Makes enough to marinate about 4 pounds of meat.  Marinate 2 to 3 hours at room temperature.  If you run out of sauce to cover while cooking, use Wish-Bone garlic dressing. Cook roast on grill 20 minutes per pound.  Keep basting with marinade sauce while cooking.

name: TOOEY'S COFFEECAKE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped walnuts
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: In bowl, sift flour, salt, soda and powder.  In large bowl, mix butter, sugar and eggs on medium speed.  Alternate sour cream and sifted mixture, mixing in bowl.  Add vanilla.  Place half the mixture in a lightly greased and floured tube pan.  Sprinkle half the walnut/cinnamon mixture evenly on top of the cake.  Add remaining batter and sprinkle with remaining walnut/cinnamon mixture.

name: BUFFALO WINGS
ingredients:
4  lb. chicken wings, cut apart at joints
1/2  c. distilled white vinegar
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. tomato paste
4  tsp. sugar
1 to 3  Tbsp. liquid hot pepper seasoning or to taste
1 to 3  tsp. red pepper (cayenne)
preparation: Discard chicken wingtips.  Rinse remaining wing pieces and pat dry, then arrange in a single layer in 2 lightly greased shallow 10 x 15-inch baking pans.  Bake, uncovered, in 400° oven until golden brown, about 30 minutes.

name: CRISPY CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken
1  c. bread crumbs
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
1  tsp. salt
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. ground red pepper
1/2  tsp. lemon pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/8  tsp. celery seed
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. milk
hot shortening or hot deep fryer
preparation: Mix eggs and milk in small bowl.  In medium bowl with lid add all dry ingredients.  Clean chicken and remove skin if desired (I leave skin on to make crispier).  Dip one piece at a time in egg, then flour mixture.  Shake bowl with lid on and let set for 15 seconds to assure breading will hold to chicken.  Place in deep fryer or hot oil.  Repeat until each piece has been coated and cooked.

name: HAMBURGER SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
1 large  can V-8 juice
2  grated carrots
3  to 4 finely chopped onions
2  cans cream of celery soup
Sweet 'N Low to taste
preparation: Brown meat and onions; drain.  Add remaining ingredients; cook 45 minutes.

name: P-NUT CRUNCH
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. cold water
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white Karo
1 heaping  c. peanuts
1/2  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  Tbsp. oleo
1/2  Tbsp. baking soda
preparation: Boil cold water, sugar and Karo syrup to 250° and then add peanuts.  Stir until golden brown (3 to 5 minutes or to 290°). Now remove from heat and immediately add remaining ingredients, stirring in each individually.  The soda will cause the mixture to foam (takes about 30 seconds).  Then pour onto a greased baking sheet, spreading it around evenly.  Cool.  Break up and enjoy.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/4  c. graham cracker crumbs
bit of honey
raisins (optional)
nuts (optional)
coconut (optional)
sunflower seeds (optional)
preparation: Mix together and chill for about an hour and roll into balls. Leave on a plate or cookie sheet in refrigerator for easy snacking.

name: SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  C. sugar
1/2  C. Vinegar
1  C. ketchup
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1  C. Crisco Oil
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. grated onion
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in blender.  Store in refrigerator.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburg
1  large onion
8  oz. can tomato sauce
16  oz. can tomatoes
2  cans kidney beans
cumin (optional)
chili powder to taste
preparation: Fry hamburg and onions and drain.  Add sauce ingredients.  Add tomatoes, kidney beans, chili powder and cumin.  Stir well; cook on low heat until seasoned and hot.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
1  box pistachio instant pudding
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple with juice
1/2  c. pecans (optional)
1/2  c. coconut (optional)
1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Mix pineapple and pudding together.  Add pecans (optional), coconut (optional) and marshmallows; mix well.  Fold in Cool Whip. Chill before serving.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/3  c. margarine, softened
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/3  c. shortening
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Mix sugar, margarine, shortening, egg and vanilla. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet, 2-inches apart.  Bake until lightly brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE STARS
ingredients:
2  c. cooked sausage, crumbled
1 1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. grated Monterey Jack cheese
1  can sliced olives
1/2  c. chopped red pepper
1  pkg. wonton wrappers
1  c. prepared salad dressing (i.e., Hidden Valley Ranch, Seven Seas)
1/4  c. cooking oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine sausage, cheeses, salad dressing, olives and pepper.  Grease mini muffin tin and line with wonton wrapper.  Brush with oil.  Bake 5 minutes until brownish. Remove from tins, place on cookie sheet and fill with mixture. Bake until bubbly.

name: SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chopped spinach
3  eggs
1  lb. cottage cheese
2  c. grated sharp cheese
6  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook chopped spinach.  Beat eggs until fluffy.  Add spinach, cottage cheese, grated sharp cheese, flour and salt.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour in a 9 1/2 x 6-inch casserole.  Sprinkle bread crumbs and paprika on top.

name: CHICKEN IMPERIAL CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sliced celery
3  c. cooked rice
3  hard-boiled eggs, chopped (optional)
1/2  c. chicken broth
1/2  c. mayo
mushroom or celery soup
1  tsp. onion powder
1 1/2  c. chow mein noodles (optional)
2  c. boned chicken pieces
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. toasted slivered almonds (optional)
1/2  c. milk
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Combine celery, chicken, rice, cheese, eggs and almonds. Blend broth, milk, mayo, soups and seasonings; pour over chicken mixture.  Pour over chicken mixture.  Pour into a greased shallow 2 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  I also add a little more grated cheese and paprika over all.  This dish can be frozen.

name: SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
3/4  lb. hamburger
2  c. spaghetti sauce
3  c. water
8  oz. spaghetti
1  lb. cottage cheese
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
4 to 6  oz. grated Mozzarella cheese
grated cheese
preparation: Brown beef in large pot.  Drain fat; stir in spaghetti sauce and water.  Bring to boil.  Add spaghetti.  Cook 7 minutes.  Stir occasionally.  In bowl mix cottage cheese, eggs, parsley, salt, oregano and garlic powder.  Scoop 1/2 spaghetti mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Top with cottage cheese mixture and sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.  Pour rest of spaghetti mixture on top. Sprinkle top with grated cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  After baking, let stand for 15 minutes.

name: LEMON LUSH
ingredients:
1  pkg. graham cracker crumbs
3/4  stick margarine, melted
1/2 to 1  c. nuts
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
2  pkg. instant lemon pudding
3  c. milk
1  tsp. lemon extract
preparation: Melt margarine and mix with crumbs.  Add nuts.  Mix cream cheese, sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip and spread on crust.  Mix pudding milk and lemon extract; spread on last layer.  Top with remainder of Cool Whip.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage
3/4  c. diced onion
3/4  c. diced green pepper
1 (1 lb. 13 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
8  oz. macaroni, cooked
1  c. dairy sour cream
preparation: In a 10-inch microwave cooker, cook sausage, onion and green pepper for 6 minutes, stirring once.  Drain off fat.  Stir tomatoes, sugar, chili powder, salt and cooked macaroni into sausage mixture.  Cook 6 minutes.  Stir in sour cream.  Heat 1 to 2 minutes.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked macaroni
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed mushroom or celery soup
1  c. milk
1/4  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  Tbsp. chopped onion, pimientos, green pepper
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1 small  can tuna
preparation: Combine soup, milk, pimientos, green pepper and black pepper. Place over low heat.  Add cheese and heat until melted.  Mix macaroni and tuna in 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Add cheese sauce and bake at 325° for about 15 minutes.

name: MOCK ECLAIR
ingredients:
1  box graham crackers
2  pkg. (3 oz. each) French vanilla instant pudding
3 1/4  c. milk
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix pudding with milk.  Beat 2 minutes.  Blend in Cool Whip. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan with butter.  Line with graham crackers. Pour half of pudding mixture over crackers.  Then add another layer of crackers.  Pour remaining pudding over crackers.  Add another layer of crackers.  Refrigerate for 2 hours.

name: BRIAN'S SAUSAGE BREAD
ingredients:
1  loaf frozen bread dough
1/2  lb. white cheese
1/2  lb. yellow cheese
1  small onion, chopped
1  lb. mild sausage
1/2  tsp. sage
1/2  tsp. parsley flakes
1  egg, separated
seasonings of your choice
preparation: Follow baking directions for oven temperature. Let dough rise according to package. Brown the sausage with the onion; crumble in pan. Drain and let cool. In a large mixing bowl, combine both shredded cheeses, sausage, spices and the yolk of the egg. Mix well. Roll out bread dough flat. Pour mixture evenly on the dough. Roll, making sure that sides are tucked in. Before you are finished rolling, coat with egg white to help seal the bread. Put on a pan and coat the rest of the bread with the remaining egg white. Bake until outer crust is brown.

name: HOMEMADE CHICKEN SOUP(With A Little Help From Campbell's)
ingredients:
2  boneless chicken breasts, split
1/4  c. rice
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. celery, chopped
pepper to taste
parsley
milk (optional)
preparation: Boil chicken breasts for approximately 15 minutes.  Remove chicken from pan and boil rice in broth.  When rice is done, add cans of soup, celery, pepper and parsley.  Pick chicken apart and toss in pan.  Use milk to thin out if necessary.  Stir a lot while cooking.  Serve with a loaf of bread.  You can make this in 30 minutes and there'll be enough to serve at least 2 people.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
9  chicken breasts
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. broccoli
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
juice of 1 lemon
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1 1/2 to 2  c. Pepperidge Farm dressing
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Cook chicken.   Bone, skin and cut in chunks.  Cook large package of broccoli until crunchy and place drained broccoli into buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.  Place chicken over broccoli.  Combine 1 can of cream of chicken soup, 1 can cream of mushroom soup, 1/2 cup mayonnaise, lemon juice and 1/2 teaspoon curry powder (optional).  Pour sauce over chicken.  Take 1 1/2 to 2 cups Pepperidge Farm dressing tossed with 2 tablespoons melted butter. Press topping down well over casserole.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CRUNCH CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
3/4  c. peanut butter
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
3  eggs
1  c. water
1/3  c. chopped nuts
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Heat oven to 350°. Grease and flour oblong pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inches. In large mixer bowl, blend sugar, peanut butter and cake mix on low speed until crumbly. Reserve 2/3 cup crumb mixture; set aside. Blend remaining crumb mixture, the eggs and water on low speed until moistened, scraping bowl constantly. Beat on medium speed 4 minutes, scraping bowl occasionally. Spread batter in pan. Sprinkle reserved mixture over batter. Sprinkle chocolate chips and nuts over top. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick in center comes out clean.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked sweet potatoes
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. grated lemon rind
3  eggs, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. butter or oleo
preparation: Cook sweet potatoes until tender.  Mash and mix with milk and sugar; run through a coarse strainer.  Add remaining ingredients and pour into unbaked pie crust.  Bake 10 minutes in 425° oven. Reduce heat to 350° and bake 30 minutes or until set.

name: HAMBURGER BARLEY SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. ground chuck
6  c. water
2 (16 oz.)  cans tomatoes, undrained
3  to 4 medium onions
2  Tbsp. beef bouillon granules
3  tsp. seasoned salt
2  tsp. dried basil
2  bay leaves
2  c. carrots
2  c. celery
2/3  c. barley
1/2  c. ketchup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown beef and drain off fat.  Add water and all other ingredients.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer (covered) for about 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Remove leaves.  Freezes well.  Yield:  10 servings.

name: PLANT FOOD
ingredients:
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. saltpeter
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. household ammonia
preparation: Stir into 1 gallon of tepid water.  Use once every 4 to 6 weeks.

name: FROZEN VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen cauliflower, thawed (12 oz. box)
1  pkg. frozen broccoli, thawed (12 oz. box)
1  pkg. frozen green beans, thawed (12 oz. box)
1  c. pearl onions
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz (8 oz.)
1  pkg. croutons
preparation: Mix ingredients, all but croutons, in a large casserole. Bake, covered, at 350° for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Uncover last 15 minutes, after putting croutons on top.  Serve warm.

name: MEDITERRANEAN CHICKEN AND PENNE
ingredients:
Nonstick cooking spray
2  tsp. olive oil
1/2  onion (peeled and finely diced)
2  cloves garlic (minced)
1  lb. boneless skinless chicken breast
8  oz. penne pasta
8  pitted black olives (sliced)
1/4  c. chopped fresh basil
1  tsp. oregano
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Liberally spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Add oil and heat over medium heat.  Add garlic and onions.  Heat until soft (approximately 3-4 minutes).  Fill large saucepan with 2 inches of water.  Place chicken breast in steaming basket or stainless steal saucepan with lid.  Bring water to boil and steam chicken for 7 minutes.  Remove from heat and let set in steam until fully cooked.  Remove chicken from basket and let cool. When cool, cut into 1 inch chunks.  Meanwhile, cook penne according to packaging.  Drain and keep warm.  Add chicken chunks, olives, basil, and oregano to skillet with onions.  Turn to medium heat for 5 minutes.  In large bowl, toss chicken with hot penne pasta.  Sprinkle top with cheese and serve.

name: STRAWBERRY SLUSH
ingredients:
1  tub Crystal Light soft drink mix (raspberry ice flavor)
1 1/4  c. water
1  (20 oz.) bag frozen unsweetened strawberries
preparation: Put soft drink mix into blender; add water and strawberries. Cover and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve immediately. Try it, you'll like it.

name: BEEF AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of onion soup (Campbell's)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can mushroom pieces
1  onion
1  bell pepper
1  rib celery
dash of soy sauce
dash of Worcestershire sauce
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. rice
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix all together and put in baking dish.  Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  to 6 crookneck yellow squash
8  oz. sour cream
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  carrot, shredded
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  stack saltine crackers
1/4  c. (1/2 stick) butter or margarine
preparation: Steam squash until tender.  Mash squash with a potato masher. In a large bowl combine sour cream, soup, shredded carrot and chopped onion.  Stir in squash.  Pour mixture into a casserole dish.  Top with crushed crackers and then butter or margarine. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

name: QUICK MARINATED CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  chicken breasts
1  bottle dark Wish-Bone Russian dressing
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
10  oz. jar peach or orange marmalade preserves
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.  Combine the dressing, soup mix and preserves.  Mix until well blended.  Layer half the sauce on the bottom of a shallow baking dish.  Place the chicken side-by-side on top.  Pour remaining sauce over chicken. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator overnight.  Bake uncovered at 325° for 1 hour or until chicken is tender.

name: GRANDMOTHER ESTHER'S MATZOH BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. matzoh meal
1/2  c. water
4  eggs, beaten
1/3  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
dash of nutmeg
preparation: Add water, oil, salt and pepper to beaten eggs.  Mix well. Add meal and stir thoroughly.  Refrigerate one hour.  Form into balls and drop into soup or 1 1/2 quarts of boiling water to which salt has been added.  Cook 20 minutes with lid on.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE BAKE
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. rice
1  small Cheez Whiz
1/2  c. celery
1/2  c. onion
1  box frozen chopped broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  stick butter
preparation: Cook rice separate.  Saute celery and onion in butter.  Add broccoli, cream of mushroom soup, Cheez Whiz, celery and onion to cooked rice.  Pour into casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: KRAUT AND CARROT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can kraut - drained
1  cup shredded carrots
1  cup celery
1/2  chopped onion
3  tablespoon sugar
preparation: Mix well to blend flavors.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1/4  c. bacon fat
2  c. tomato juice
1/2  c. mushroom pieces
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1/4  tsp. chili powder
1  c. cooked shrimp
2  Tbsp. flour
rice
preparation: Brown onion and green pepper in melted fat.  Add tomato juice, mushrooms and seasonings.  Cover and simmer for one hour.  Add shrimp and cook for 30 minutes longer.  Thicken with paste made from flour and 1/2 cup water.  Serve over rice.

name: BUTTERMILK BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. water
1/4  c. cocoa
1/2  c. oil
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine butter, water, cocoa and oil in saucepan.  Bring to a boil and pour over mixture of sifted flour, sugar, salt and soda. Mix. Add buttermilk, eggs and vanilla.  Blend well.  Pour into greased and floured pan, 11 x 16 x 1-inch.	Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 400°.  Remove from oven and ice immediately with icing.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. chopped tomatoes
1/4  c. thinly sliced onions
1/4  c. chopped cilantro leaves (I use celery)
1  Tbsp. lime juice
1  tsp. minced jalapeno pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients in small bowl.  Cover and refrigerate. Bring to room temperature before serving.  Makes 1 1/2 cups.

name: PHEASANT SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. cooked pheasant meat, diced*
1  c. cooked rice (cool or warm)
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. cream of chicken or mushroom soup
1  c. diced celery
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: To serve warm, heat the pheasant, rice and soup.  Can be served cold, also.  Mix all ingredients and enjoy!

name: SUMMER SALAD
ingredients:
1 small (3 oz.)  pkg. orange Jell-O
1  (16 oz.) cottage cheese
1  (4 oz.) Cool Whip
1 (15 oz.)  can mandarin orange slices
1  (20 oz.) chunk pineapple, drained
preparation: Mix dry Jell-O with cottage cheese.  Add orange slices and pineapple.  Mix in the Cool Whip.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: MISSISSIPPI MARINATED CARROTS(Copper Pennies)
ingredients:
2  lb. cooked carrots
1  raw onion
1  raw pepper
1  can tomato soup (undiluted)
1/3  c. salad oil
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. mustard
3/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Heat together soup, salad oil, sugar, mustard, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.  Add vegetables and heat; marinate at least overnight.

name: COKE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
2  sticks margarine
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. Coke
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. small marshmallows
1  c. pecans (optional)
preparation: Sift together sugar and flour.  Boil margarine, cocoa and Coke together 1/2 minute and add to dry mixture.  Mix buttermilk, soda, eggs, vanilla and marshmallows; add to other mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Pour mixture into sheet pan.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked diced chicken (can use ham or turkey)
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 soup  can chicken broth
1  pkg. bow tie noodles, cooked
2  Tbsp. oleo
preparation: In saucepan, brown chicken and onion in oleo.  Add soup, broth and cheese.  Heat until cheese is melted.  Add to cooked noodles. Mix and serve.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
3  c. cranberry juice cocktail
1  c. orange juice
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Add 2 cups club soda to the ingredients in punch bowl.

name: CARAMEL/BANANA PIE
ingredients:
3  cans Eagle Brand milk
4  or 5 bananas
3  c. pecans
12  oz. Cool Whip
2  (9-inch) pie crusts, baked
preparation: Boil Eagle Brand milk (unopened) in cans for 3 hours.  Keep cans covered with water at all times. Let milk cool and then open and put in a bowl.  Put in refrigerator for about 4 or 5 hours. Layer into baked pie shell:  caramel, bananas, nuts and caramel in that order.  Top with Cool Whip and sprinkle nuts on Cool Whip.

name: SHRIMP MOLD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. and 1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  envelopes unflavored gelatin, dissolved in 2 Tbsp. cold water
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  lb. shrimp, cooked and finely chopped, or 3 small cans shrimp, well drained
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1  onion, finely chopped
1  green pepper, finely chopped
2  boiled eggs, chopped
2  Tbsp. hot sauce
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix cream cheese, mayonnaise, dissolved gelatin and lemon juice.  Add shrimp, celery, eggs, salt, pepper, onion and hot sauce.  Put in lightly oiled fish mold and chill.  Unmold and serve with crackers and Melba toast.

name: LAZY WIFE'S PIE
ingredients:
fresh or frozen fruit such as blackberries, blueberries, peaches, cherries, apples or strawberries
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  stick margarine
preparation: Mix together the flour, sugar and milk.  Melt the margarine in pan in oven.  Place fruit in pan with margarine.  Pour the mixture over the fruit.  Bake in 375° oven until brown.

name: GREEN TOMATO AND VIDALIA ONION TART
ingredients:
2  large Vidalia onions
4  to 6 large green tomatoes, thinly sliced
2  Tbsp. snipped fresh chives
1  tsp. dried basil, crushed
1  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/3  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Bake pastry shell 6 to 8 minutes or until golden. Cook onions, covered in small amount of boiling water, 5 minutes or until tender. Drain and arrange cooked onions on bottom of pastry. Arrange tomato slices atop onions. Sprinkle with chives, basil, sugar, salt and pepper.  In medium bowl, combine mayonnaise, lemon juice and cheese.  Spread on top of pie and bake at 375°, uncovered, until golden and bubbly.

name: EASY AS PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker pie crust or chocolate cracker
1  gal. Blue Bell ice cream, softened
preparation: Dump the ice cream in the shell; smooth it out very nicely. Back in the freezer for 3 to 4 hours.  Cut like pie and serve. They will never figure it out.

name: ONION RINGS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  can beer
6  onions
preparation: Mix flour and beer with a fork.  Let stand for 3 hours or longer at room temperature.  Make rings out of onions.  Dip rings in batter and fry in 2 to 3 inches of oil.  Turn when brown. Drain.  Salt to taste.

name: POCKET STEW
ingredients:
3  carrots
2  or 3 potatoes
2  onions
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
salt to taste
preparation: Make 4 beef patties.  Peel carrots, potatoes and onions.  Add salt to beef mixture.  Slice onions and potatoes and cut carrots 2 to 3-inches in length.  Place each beef patty on aluminum foil, approximately 12 to 15-inches long.  Put several slices of potatoes and onions on patty; also the carrots.  Cook at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PRINCESS CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  lb. boneless, skinless chicken
1  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. dry sherry or white wine
3/4  c. water
8  tsp. cornstarch
1 1/2  Tbsp. peanut oil
1  tsp. red pepper flakes
4  tsp. sugar
4  tsp. sesame oil
4  tsp. rice wine vinegar
4  tsp. water
4  tsp. cornstarch
2  c. vegetables in bite-size pieces (broccoli, carrots, celery, bell pepper, pea pods)
preparation: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces.  Mix 1/4 cup soy sauce, 1/4 cup sherry, 3/4 cup water and 8 teaspoons cornstarch together. Toss over chicken and let marinate 20 minutes.  Mix remaining soy sauce, sherry, sugar, sesame oil, rice vinegar, 1 tablespoon water and cornstarch.  Heat peanut oil in a wok or skillet.  Stir-fry red pepper flakes for 1 or 2 minutes (depending on desired hotness). Add chicken and marinade and stir-fry until chicken changes color. Add remaining mixture, water chestnuts and vegetables and stir-fry until sauce thickens and vegetables are desired tenderness and chicken is cooked.  Serve over rice.

name: HEAVENLY HOT CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
1/2  c. skim milk
1/2  c. evaporated skim milk
1 1/4  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. Dutch process cocoa powder
1  tsp. water
preparation: In a small heavy saucepan, combine the skim milk, evaporated skim milk and sugar.  Heat, uncovered, over low heat until the milk bubbles gently, about 5 minutes.

name: BARBECUED MEATBALLS
ingredients:
3  eggs
3/4  c. milk
3  c. soft bread crumbs
1/2  c. finely chopped onions
2  tsp. salt
3  lb. ground beef
1  c. catsup
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. molasses
1/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix eggs, milk, bread crumbs, onions and salt.  Add meat; mix well.  Shape into 72 one-inch balls.  Bake in two 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch baking pans at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.   Cool meatballs and freeze, putting 24 meatballs in a package.

name: WASSAIL
ingredients:
1  qt. apple cider or apple juice
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. allspice
6  cinnamon sticks
1  qt. ginger ale
fresh orange slices
preparation: Bring apple cider, nutmeg, allspice and cinnamon sticks to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes.  Add ginger ale and serve warm with orange slices.

name: BREAD AND BUTTER PUDDING
ingredients:
1/3  c. raisins
5  slices day old bread
1/4  c. margarine or butter
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2/3  c. sugar
2  c. homogenized milk
preparation: Line bottom of greased ovenproof casserole with raisins.  Cut bread in 1-inch strips; dip each in melted butter and arrange a layer over raisins.  Beat remaining ingredients together and pour over bread.  Set dish in pan of hot water.  Bake in 375° oven until bread is browned and a knife blade inserted in center of pudding comes out clean.  Serve plain or with whipped cream. Serves 6.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
2  c. sliced peaches
1  stick butter
2  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. flour
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Mix peaches with 1 cup sugar.  Set oven at 350°.  Put butter in casserole dish and put in oven to melt.  Make batter of 1 cup sugar, baking powder, flour and milk.  Pour over melted butter; do not stir.  Put sugared peaches on top; do not stir.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1  can creamed corn
1  can whole corn
2  eggs
1  stick butter
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  Jiffy corn muffin mix (box)
preparation: Combine ingredients in a large mixing bowl.  Pour into a Pam-sprayed 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden brown on top.

name: HOT MULLED CIDER
ingredients:
1/2  gal. apple  cider
1/2  c. light brown sugar
1 1/2  tsp. cider vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  cinnamon stick
6  whole cloves
preparation: Combine all in crock-pot.  Cook on low 5 to 6 hours.  Discard cinnamon sticks and cloves.  Serve.

name: ARTICHOKE PIE
ingredients:
1  frozen unbaked deep dish pie crust
1  pkg. frozen artichoke hearts (9 oz.)
4  eggs, beaten well
1/2  c. pepperoni, diced
1  tsp. salt
1  c. Mozzarella, diced
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/4  c. grated cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Defrost artichoke hearts, pat dry and cut in half.  Blend all ingredients together and pour in pie crust.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: COUNTRY CABBAGE SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. shredded cabbage
1/2  c. green pepper, diced
1  small onion, diced
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. salad dressing or oil
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine cabbage, pepper and onion.  Set aside.  Mix together vinegar, water, salad dressing or oil, sugar and salt.  Pour over cabbage mixture.

name: HEALTHY HEROS
ingredients:
3/4  c. thinly sliced fresh mushrooms
1/2  c. seeded and chopped cucumber
1  Tbsp. sliced green onion
1  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. balsamic vinegar
1/8  tsp. ground pepper
1  hoagie bun
2  lettuce leaves
2  oz. thin sliced ham
2  oz. thin sliced turkey
4  slices tomato
1  oz. shredded part-skim Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients; let stand 30 minutes. Slice bun in half lengthwise; pull out soft inside of top and bottom, leaving a shell. Spoon mushroom mixture into each half of bun; cover with a lettuce leaf. Top with ham, turkey and tomato slices. Sprinkle with shredded cheese and serve.

name: LEMON CHESS PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  eggs, lightly beaten
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. cornmeal
1/3  c. butter, melted
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2 (9 oz.)  cartons Cool Whip, thawed
1  can Eagle Brand
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  c. finely chopped nuts
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients.  Pour into 2 baked 9-inch pie shells. Top with nuts.  Refrigerate.

name: SUMMER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
10  wieners
1  green pepper, chopped
1  onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. soft bread crumbs
2 large  cans pork and beans
1/2  lb. process cheese, grated
preparation: Cut wieners into thin slices.  Saute green pepper and onion in butter.  Stir in bread crumbs, beans, wieners and cheese.  Place in a 4-quart casserole dish.  Cover.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. soda
2  c. all-purpose flour
3  c. carrots, grated
preparation: Beat sugar, oil and eggs; add salt, cinnamon and soda.  Mix well.  Add flour gradually, then carrots and mix.  Bake 3 layers at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: BREADED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  pork chops
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. boiling water
3/4  c. fine bread crumbs
1  can onion soup
1  can tomato soup
1  c. bread crumbs
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. celery soup
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Add salt and pepper to bread crumbs.  Beat egg and milk.  Dip chops in liquid and roll in bread crumbs.  Put 3 tablespoons fat into skillet and brown chops.  Place chops in baking pan or dish. Add boiling water.  Cover and bake at 400° for about 50 minutes. Take the cover off last 10 minutes baking time.   These are very tender and delicious.

name: SALMON AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. milk
1/4  lb. pimento cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  c. cooked rice
1  c. flaked salmon (7 1/2 oz. can)
1/4  c. chopped or sliced olives
preparation: Combine cheese, milk, salt and pepper in double boiler.  Heat until well blended and smooth.  Put a layer of cooked rice in well greased casserole.  On top arrange layers of salmon, olives and the cheese sauce.  Repeat ending with the cheese sauce.  Arrange slices of stuffed olives around edge for garnish.  Bake 60 minutes in 350°oven.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  whole chicken
1  pkg. spaghetti noodles
1 (12 oz.)  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Velveeta
preparation: Boil chicken until it falls off the bones.  Pick chicken off the bones.  Cook the spaghetti noodles; drain.  In large pan, mix spaghetti, chicken, Ro-Tel tomatoes and Velveeta.  Cook over low heat until cheese has melted.

name: FAVORITE SHAKE(Low-Fat)
ingredients:
1  c. skim milk or 1% milk
4  ice cubes
1  tsp. extract (vanilla, almond, etc.) or 1 tsp. instant coffee
sugar substitute to taste
preparation: Place all ingredients in blender container; blend until all ice is crushed and malted is thick.  Makes 1 serving.

name: MUSHROOM-GARLIC CHICKEN WITH ARTICHOKES
ingredients:
6  skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, pounded to 1/4-inch thickness
salt and freshly ground pepper
3  Tbsp. butter
8  garlic cloves, crushed through a press
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1/4  lb. mushrooms, sliced
1 (14 oz.)  can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. dry Marsala
preparation: Season chicken with salt and pepper.  In a large frying pan, melt butter over medium heat.  Add half the garlic and cook 1 minute.  Add chicken and cook until lightly browned, 3 minutes a side.  Remove to a warm serving platter.

name: PERFECTLY SIMPLE ROASTED CHICKEN
ingredients:
5 to 7  lb. roasting chicken
1  Tbsp. flour
1  medium onion, sliced
2  stalks celery, sliced
salt
pepper to taste
paprika to taste
preparation: You will need one large oven cooking bag.

name: CURRY DIP
ingredients:
1  pt. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. chili sauce (Heinz bottled)
3  tsp. curry powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. grated onion with juice
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well.  Chill.  Keeps indefinitely in covered container in refrigerator.  Great served with raw veggies (broccoli and cauliflower florets, carrot and zucchini sticks, sliced mushrooms, radishes, cherry tomatoes, etc.).

name: BROWN RICE PILAF
ingredients:
1/2  c diced carrots
1/2  c red bell pepper
3  c water
1  c uncooked brown rice
1/2  tsp salt
1/2  tsp dried oregano
1/2  tsp dried thyme
2  large garlic cloves, minced
preparation: Steam carrot and bell pepper, covered, 2 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain well; set aside.

name: SKILLET MEAL
ingredients:
2  slices bacon, diced
1  onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
2  c. egg noodles
1/2  c. chili sauce
1/2  lb. ground beef
1  green pepper, chopped
dash of pepper
1/2  c. water
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can tomatoes
preparation: Heat diced bacon, ground beef and onion in skillet over high heat.  Reduce heat until meat is slightly browned.  Add remaining ingredients; when steaming, cool over heat for 35 minutes.  Yields 6 servings.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
8  C cooked and drained rotini or twist trio pasta
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  celery, chopped (optional)
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
1  C ham, luncheon meat, or chicken, chopped
1/2  C mild cheese, grated
1/2  C mozzarella cheese, grated, (optional)
1  small cucumber, chopped
1  small tomato, chopped
1/2  bottle Italian salad dressing (16 oz)
Salt & pepper to taste
Parmesan cheese to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Cover and chill for at least 4 hours. If dry, add more dressing before serving.

name: POPPY SEED CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines golden butter cake
4  eggs
2  sticks oleo
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  bottle poppy seed
preparation: Add cake mix to creamed oleo and sugar.  Add eggs, then vanilla.  Mix and beat.  Stir in sour cream.  Mix thoroughly.  Add poppy seed.  Batter will be thick.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes in a greased and floured Bundt cake pan.  Place right side up and glaze if desired.

name: COUNTRY HOT ROLLS
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. warm milk
5  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
2  yeast cakes
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Let rise for 2 hours.  Roll out and let rise 1 hour.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until done.

name: CHEESE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
2  c. grated sharp cheese
2  c. flour
2  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Mix margarine and cheese.  Add flour, a little at a time. Stir in Rice Krispies and form into small balls.  Place on cookie sheet and press with fork that has been dipped in flour.  Bake at 325° to 350° for 20 minutes.

name: CHOW CHOW
ingredients:
1  qt. cabbage, chopped
1  qt. green tomatoes, chopped
1  qt. onions, chopped
hot peppers, chopped (hot as you want)
1  qt. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1  Tbsp. mustard seed
preparation: Mix vegetables and 1/2 cup salt.  Let stand overnight.  Next day drain.  Heat vinegar, sugar and spices and simmer 10 minutes. Add to vegetables.  Cook approximately 10 to 15 minutes.  Chow will change to a dull green color.  Pack and seal.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. peanut butter
1 level  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
2 1/2  c. flour
2 scant  tsp. soda, sifted with flour
vanilla
preparation: Cream butter with sugar and add peanut butter.  Combine all ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: EASY CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1 1/3  c. margarine
2  eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts (optional)
12  oz. bag chocolate chips
preparation: Mix both sugars, margarine and eggs in a large bowl.  Stir in flour, baking soda and salt.  Stir in nuts and chips.  Drop by tablespoon on ungreased sheet.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: BARBECUE SANDWICHES
ingredients:
5  lb. ground chuck beef
2  medium sized onions
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. tomato juice
2  c. catsup
preparation: Brown ground chuck in pan.  Add onions, celery, green pepper, sugar, vinegar and Worcestershire sauce, then add tomato juice and catsup.

name: ICE CREAM JELL-O
ingredients:
1  pkg. (3 oz.) JELL-O Gelatin, any flavor
1  c. boiling water
1  c. ice cream, any flavor*
4  ice cubes
preparation: Sherbet, ice milk, or frozen yogurt can be substituted for ice cream.

name: TACO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. ground beef
1  bell pepper
1  onion
1  can whole tomatoes
1 large  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. mild Cheddar cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Monterey Jack cheese
1  pkg. tortilla chips
preparation: Cook your ground beef, onion and bell pepper together.  Grate both cheeses together in bowl.  Drain excess grease and mix in tomatoes and seasoning mix.  Grease casserole dish with butter. Layer the bottom of the dish with chips, layer of meat sauce, then cheese until you have used all ingredients.  Put in oven at 325° until cheese melts.  Top with sour cream and picante sauce.  Very Good.

name: MEXICAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  tomato or more, chopped
1  can Ranch Style beans, drained
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  (8 oz.) Catalina salad dressing
1 regular  pkg. Fritos
preparation: Toss first 6 ingredients. Add crumbled Fritos just before serving.

name: YUMMY BARS
ingredients:
1  (18 1/2 oz.) German chocolate cake mix
3/4  ??? melted butter
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nuts
1  bag Kraft caramels
1/3  c. evaporated milk
preparation: Mix the German chocolate cake mix with melted butter and 1/3 cup evaporated milk.  Spread (pat) half of the mixture in a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: TOMATO SAUCE FOR CANNING
ingredients:
24  large tomatoes
1  large green pepper
2  large onions
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
1/4  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. parsley flakes
2  Tbsp. sugar
4  Tbsp. salt
1/4  c. A.1.
1  Tbsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Peel tomatoes; grind and chop onions and peppers.  Add tomatoes with all other ingredients.  Cook slowly for 2 hours, stirring frequently.  Place in jars and hot pack to seal.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
20  oz. frozen broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. sharp cheese, grated
2  eggs, well beaten
4  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/3  c. butter, melted
2/3  c. hot water
2  c. Earth Grain Herb stuffing mix
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook and drain broccoli as package directs.  Mix soup, mayonnaise, cheese, eggs and onion with broccoli. Pour in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch dish.  Mix butter, water and stuffing mix, spread over broccoli.  Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, uncovered.

name: PORK BARBECUE
ingredients:
4  lb. pork
3  peppers
3  onions
1  bottle ketchup
1  bottle chili sauce
preparation: Add all together and simmer for 3 hours.  Take meat out of pot and shred the meat.  Put the meat back into the pot.  It's done.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
16  oz. creamed corn
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. oil
3  eggs
1  medium onion
6  or 8 jalapeno peppers
2 1/4  c. corn meal
preparation: Mix together creamed corn and cream cheese.  Add oil and mix well.  Add eggs and mix well.  Stir in remaining ingredients. Grease loaf pan or iron skillet.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

name: SUGAR CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1 (2 layer)  box yellow cake mix
1  stick margarine, softened
1  egg
preparation: Mix cake mix, margarine and egg together.  Spread in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Press down.

name: SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. green peas, or cooked carrots, or corn, or combination of these
potatoes
sharp cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion; salt and pepper to taste.  Drain well.  Place in bottom of square casserole dish.  Place vegetables on top.  Cream potatoes and spread on top of vegetables.  Top this with shredded sharp cheese.  Bake, uncovered, approximately 30 minutes or until bubbly and cheese is melted.

name: SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. Cool Whip
1  pt. cottage cheese
1  box orange Jell-O (dry)
1  can Mandarin orange sections
2  c. small marshmallows
preparation: Combine and chill.

name: CAJUN TORTILLA CHIPS
ingredients:
1 1/2  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. dried thyme
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. onion powder
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. ground red pepper
10  (7-inch) tortillas, cut into 8 wedges
cooking spray
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°. To prepare Cajun seasoning, combine first 8 ingredients in a small bowl. To prepare chips, arrange the tortilla wedges on 2 baking sheets coated with cooking spray. Coat wedges in cooking spray. Sprinkle 2 teaspoons Cajun seasoning over wedges. Bake chips at 375° for 6 minutes or until crisp. Yield: 80 chips (serving size: 4 chips).

name: MICROWAVE VEGETABLE-CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
1/2  c. water
1 1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. instant chicken bouillon granules
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2  c. shredded American cheese
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
preparation: In a 1 3/4-quart casserole, combine vegetables and water.  Cook according to package microwave directions.  Stir in the milk, bouillon granules, dry mustard, oregano and Worcestershire sauce. Cook, uncovered, on High for 3 to 5 minutes or just until bubbly around the edges.

name: HALF HOUR APPLE BUTTER
ingredients:
2  c. unsweetened applesauce
1/4 to 1/2  c. sugar or 4 to 6 packets Sweet 'N Low
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. allspice
1/8  tsp. ginger
1/8  tsp. cloves
preparation: Combine ingredients in heavy 1 1/2-quart saucepan.  Bring to a boil; cook 30 minutes.  Makes 1 1/4 cups.

name: DEEP-SOUTH OVENLY CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine (1/2 stick)
1  c. buttermilk baking mix
1/2  c. pecans, finely chopped
1 (5 oz.)  can evaporated milk (2/3 c.)
parsley sprigs (for garnish)
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
1  (3 lb.) fryer-broiler, cut up
preparation: About 1 1/4 hours before serving:  In large open roasting pan in 400° oven, melt butter or margarine.  Meanwhile, on waxed paper, combine baking mix, chopped pecans, paprika, salt and poultry seasoning.  Into pie plate, pour evaporated milk.  Dip chicken pieces in milk, then coat well with baking mix mixture. Place chicken pieces, skin side down, in roasting pan.  Bake chicken 30 minutes.  With pancake turner, carefully turn chicken pieces.  Bake 20 minutes longer or until juices run clear when chicken is pierced with a fork, covering with foil after 10 minutes if chicken begins to brown too quickly.  Arrange chicken on platter.  Garnish with parsley sprigs.  Makes 4 servings.

name: SWEET-N-SOUR MEATBALLS WITH SAUCE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
1/4  c. milk
1  small onion, finely chopped (about 1/4 c.)
1  egg
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
Sweet-And-Sour Sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients except Sweet-And-Sour Sauce.  Shape mixture by tablespoons into 1 1/4-inch balls.  (For ease in shaping meatballs, wet hands occasionally with cold water.) Arrange meatballs in rectangular dish, 11 x 7 x 1 1/2 inches. Cover loosely and microwave on High 8 to 10 minutes, rearranging meatballs after 5 minutes, until no longer pink inside.  Let stand, covered, 3 minutes; drain.  Prepare Sweet-And-Sour Sauce. Stir meatballs gently into sauce until coated.  Cover tightly and microwave 4 to 6 minutes or until hot.

name: BLUEBERRY TORTE
ingredients:
16  graham crackers
1/3  c. butter, melted
1/2  c. sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  can blueberry pie filling
Cool Whip
preparation: Crush crackers into fine crumbs.  Mix in 1/2 cup sugar and melted butter.  Press into bottom of pie pan.  Cream together cream cheese, 1/2 cup sugar and eggs.  Pour mixture over crust and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Let cool.  Pour blueberry filling over top and chill.  Serve with Cool Whip.

name: CARROT AND POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1  small onion, chopped
4  c. cubed potatoes
3  c. sliced carrots
6  c. chicken broth
salt to taste
1/8  tsp. white pepper
2  c. half and half or milk
preparation: Serve hot or cold.  Melt butter in large saucepan, cook onion several minutes.  Add potatoes, carrots, salt and pepper and broth. Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat; simmer for 30 minutes until vegetables are done.  Puree in blender.  Return to pan.  Add milk and heat to serving temperature if desired.  Garnish with shredded carrots.  Makes 8 servings.

name: BAKED CRISPY CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's condensed cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. milk
4  skinless, boneless chicken breast halves (about 1 lb.)
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  c. Pepperidge Farm herb seasoned stuffing, finely crushed
2  Tbsp. margarine
fresh rosemary sprigs for garnish
preparation: In a shallow dish, combine 1/3 soup and 1/4 cup milk; set aside.  On waxed paper, lightly coat chicken with flour.  Dip into soup mixture.  On another piece of waxed paper, coat chicken with stuffing.  On baking sheet, arrange chicken.  Drizzle with margarine.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.

name: ROSEMARY CHEESE FINGERS
ingredients:
2  oz. butter
2  c. oat flakes (oatmeal)
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. finely chopped rosemary
pinch of cayenne
pinch of salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Melt butter in saucepan.  Place remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix in the melted butter. Press mixture in a greased 8-inch square pan.  Bake 30 to 40 minutes.  Cut into finger size pieces.

name: TACO RICE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey or beef
1  chopped onion
1 1/2  c. salsa
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
preparation: Brown meat and onion in skillet.  Add salsa and tomato sauce; bring to a boil.  Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

name: HOT PINEAPPLE SIDE DISH
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. melted margarine
1 1/2  c. (6 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese, divided
2/3  c. coarsely crushed saltines (14 crackers)
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/4 cup of the juice.  Set aside. In a medium bowl, combine sugar and flour.  Add the butter and 1 cup cheese; mix well.  Gently stir in the pineapple.  Pour into a greased 1 1/2 quart baking dish.  Sprinkle crushed cracker crumbs on top; drizzle with reserved pineapple juice.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until bubbly around edges.  Remove from the oven and sprinkle with the remaining cheese.  Yield:  6 servings.

name: SCALLOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. small scallops
1 1/4  sticks real butter (no substitutes!)
1  pt. all-purpose cream or light cream, warmed
10  to 12 Ritz crackers or any other buttery tasting cracker
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
dash of hot pepper sauce (optional)
4 heaping  Tbsp. white flour
preparation: Melt 1 stick of butter in a skillet.  Add scallops and spices; cook over low heat 8 to 10 minutes.  Blend in the flour; add warmed cream.  Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until it comes to a boil.  Remove and pour into a 2-quart casserole dish.  Melt remaining butter in small saucepan; add crumbled crackers and stir.  Sprinkle cracker mixture over the top of casserole.  Bake, covered, at 425° for 10 minutes.  Uncover; bake an additional 5 minutes.  Let cool for a few minutes before serving.

name: SUGARPLUM PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. prunes, cooked and chopped
3/4  c. butter or oleo
1  c. buttermilk
1 1/4  tsp. soda
2  eggs
preparation: Sift together dry ingredients.  Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs.  Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk.  Fold in prunes.  Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.  Pour glaze over hot cake.

name: ZIPPY MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  egg
1/4  c. soft bread crumbs
1/4  c. chili sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. instant minced onion
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. minced celery
2  Tbsp. butter flavor Crisco
1  bottle barbecue sauce
preparation: Beat egg in medium bowl.  Mix in bread crumbs, chili sauce, salt, onion, garlic powder, ground beef and celery.  Shape into 30 small balls about 1-inch in diameter.  Melt butter flavor Crisco in large skillet on medium heat.  Add meatballs and brown on all sides.  Continue cooking until done, about 12 minutes including browning.  Warm barbecue sauce while meatballs cook.  Serve meatballs on wooden picks.  Dip in warm sauce.

name: DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  egg yolks
2  whole eggs
4  c. milk
pinch of salt
flour
preparation: Beat eggs and egg yolks; mix in milk and add salt.  Add flour a little at a time to thicken.  Mix in enough flour to make it the consistency of very thick pudding.  Let rest for 15 minutes, covered.  Boil a big pot of salted water.  Drop teaspoonfuls into boiling water.  When they come to the top, let boil 1 to 2 minutes longer.  Do not overcrowd.   Do this in separate batches.  Strain dumplings; toss with butter.  This recipe yields a lot.  Can be reduced by half.

name: SWISS APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  egg
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
1  c. chopped apples
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Mix egg, sugar, flour, baking powder, vanilla and salt.  Add chopped apples and walnuts.  Place in an 8-inch square baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: MACARONI SAUTE
ingredients:
2  c. elbow macaroni, uncooked
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. Wesson oil
2 1/2  c. water
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: All is cooked together in 1 skillet!

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  box cornbread mix
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
1  large onion, chopped fine
6  oz. cottage cheese
1  tsp. salt
4  eggs, well beaten
preparation: Mix all, except cornbread mix, in bowl.  Add cornbread mix (or make your own cornbread) to mixture.  Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan and heat in oven.  Bake (using metal pan) 30 minutes at 400°.  Or bake (using glass pan) 25 minutes at 400°.  Great as brunch muffins.

name: CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
18  chicken wings
2  Tbsp. salad oil
3  green onions, cut up
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/3  c. sherry
1/4  c. ketchup
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
preparation: Cut wing tips off at the joint.  Cut each wing in half at joint.  In Dutch oven, in hot oil and high heat, cook chicken wings and green onions, stirring constantly, for 7 minutes. Reduce heat to medium.  Add soy sauce and remaining ingredients. Stir well.  Cover and cook for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally. Uncover and cook for 10 minutes longer, stirring frequently, until almost all liquid is absorbed (18 drumettes can be substituted for chicken wings).

name: THREE-HERB POPCORN
ingredients:
6  qt. popped popcorn (24 c.)
salt to taste
1/2  c. butter
1  tsp. dried basil
1  tsp. dried chervil
1/2  tsp. dried thyme
1 (12 oz.)  can mixed nuts (optional)
preparation: Place popcorn in a large container or oven roasting pan.  Salt to taste and set aside.  Melt butter in small saucepan; remove from heat.  Stir in basil, chervil and thyme.  Drizzle butter mixture over popcorn and toss lightly to coat evenly.  Stir in the nuts, if desired.  Makes about 20 cups.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1 small  can coconut
1  c. pecans, chopped
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  stick margarine
1  box confectioners sugar
preparation: Grease bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.  Place coconut and nuts in pan.  Mix cake mix as directed on box.  Pour over nuts and coconut.  Mix softened margarine, cream cheese and powdered sugar. Pour over top of cake batter.  Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.

name: HOT FUDGE SAUCE
ingredients:
1 tall  can evaporated milk
3  (1 oz.) squares unsweetened chocolate
2  cups sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook over medium heat.  Bring to boil.  Cook 5 minutes.  Stir until chocolate melts.  Remove from heat.  Add 1 tsp. vanilla. Beat with beater until thick.  Use sauce hot or cold.

name: YUKI'S FRIED RICE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oil
8  oz. meat (uncooked chicken breast, pork or beef, sliced or chopped), about 1 c.
1  medium size carrot (about 1/2 c.)
1  tsp. sugar
1  medium size onion (about 3/4 c.)
1/2  c. celery
1/4  c. green pepper
2  cubes (2 tsp. powdered) chicken or beef bouillon
3  c. cooked rice
1/2  tsp. soy sauce
preparation: Trim all fat from meat.  Heat skillet to 350° and add oil (this is a medium hot frying pan).  Add chicken, quickly fry for 5 minutes.  Add sugar and carrots and fry medium-high 3 minutes. Add onions and celery; stir and cook 2 minutes.  Add green pepper and bouillon cubes (crush them in pan).  Add soy sauce.  Add cooked rice.  Serves 4.

name: SALMON CROQUETTES
ingredients:
2  c. flaked cooked or canned salmon
bread crumbs
2  c. mashed potatoes
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. minced parsley
1  tsp. lemon juice or Worcestershire sauce
