preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Chill and shape.  Bread and fry croquettes in deep pot.  Drain on towels before serving.  Makes 12 croquettes.

name: MOUNDS CANDY
ingredients:
2  boxes powdered sugar
1  can condensed milk
1  c. chopped nuts
1  lb. coconut
1  stick melted margarine
1  cake paraffin
2 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix powdered sugar, condensed milk, chopped nuts, coconut and melted margarine; shape into desired shapes.  Dip into melted mixture of paraffin and chocolate chips.  Place on waxed paper until set.  This candy stores well in airtight container.

name: LEMON-BROCCOLI CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  lemon
1  Tbsp. oil
2  whole chicken breasts, split, skinned and boned
1  can Campbell's condensed cream of broccoli or cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cut 4 thin slices of lemon; set aside.  Squeeze 2 teaspoons juice from remaining lemon; set aside.

name: BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
15  oz. pkg. Raisin Bran
1  c. oil or melted margarine
3  c. sugar
4  eggs
5  c. flour
1  qt. buttermilk
5  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. salt
preparation: In large bowl, mix Raisin Bran, oil and sugar.  Mix the following and add to the Raisin Bran mix:  eggs, flour, buttermilk, baking soda and salt.  Do not stir.  Put in covered container; will keep for 6 weeks.  Do not stir after it's been refrigerated, just spoon out into muffin tins.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
8  oz. spaghetti
4  oz. sliced mushrooms
1  pt. sour cream
2  c. mushrooms, drained
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pt. French onion dip
3 to 4  c. cooked chicken
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Cook spaghetti according to package directions and drain. Toss spaghetti with butter.  Add remaining ingredients.  Pour into a 12 x 9-inch baking dish.  Spread 4 ounces sliced mushrooms over top.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: PIZZA SAUCE
ingredients:
2  gal. tomatoes
6  c. green peppers
2  c. hot peppers (banana)
6  c. onions
4  tsp. garlic powder
1  oz. oregano
5 (12 oz.)  cans tomato paste
1/2  c. salt
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. oil
preparation: Cook tomatoes, green peppers, hot peppers, onions, garlic powder and oregano until tender.  Blend in blender.  Add remaining ingredients and cook until it begins to thicken.  Put in jars. Process 15 minutes in boiling water bath (start timing after it comes to a full boil).

name: PECAN BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. butter
4  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. pecans
powdered sugar
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add vanilla, then flour and pecans. Mix well.  Roll into small balls.  Bake 30 to 40 minutes on cookie sheet in 300° oven.  Roll in powdered sugar.

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
1/2  c. mayonnaise
3  hard-boiled eggs
1  large green bell pepper, diced
1  medium yellow onion, diced
1/2  c. diced celery
mustard to desired taste (optional)
preparation: Peel potatoes.  Boil potatoes until slightly firm; do not overcook.  Drain water off potatoes and dice potatoes while still hot.  Add all remaining ingredients and mix together.  Serve while hot.  You may serve cold, if you prefer.

name: DRY BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. dry white butter beans
dry bread crumbs
cheese
1  can pimientos
preparation: Cook beans until tender.  Add desired amount of cheese and bread crumbs.  Mix in pimientos (chopped) and seasoning to taste. Bake until cheese is melted.  Add small amount of milk if more liquid is needed.

name: DIABETIC PRUNE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. cooking oil
1 1/2  c. cooked prunes, mashed
1 1/2  c. chopped Golden Delicious apples
3  eggs
8  pkg. sugar substitute
grated rind or 1 orange
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. coconut (not sugared)
1  c. raisins, cut
4  c. flour
preparation: Mix together oil, cooked prunes, chopped apples, eggs and sugar.  Add orange rind and mix well.  Add salt, soda, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg, mix well then add flour and mix.  Add nuts, coconut and raisins.  Mix well, take a teaspoon of mixture and drop on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes, more or less depending on thickness.  Makes 9 to 10 dozen. These cookies freeze well.

name: SEAFOOD JACQUES
ingredients:
1  c. white wine
1/4  c. snipped parsley
1  lb. scallops + 1 lb. shrimp or 1/2 lb. haddock
4  oz. sliced mushrooms
2  green onions, chopped
3  Tbsp. margarine or butter
3  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. half and half
1/2  c. Swiss cheese, grated
preparation: Put scallops, wine and parsley in 3-quart saucepan.  Heat to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer 8 minutes; drain, reserving 1 cup liquid.  Saute mushrooms and onions in 2 tablespoons butter. Remove and add 3 more tablespoons butter.  Stir in flour. Put in 1 cup liquid and half and half, stirring until smooth.  Add cheese; stir until melted, then add fish, mushrooms, onions and shrimp. Serve in patty shells or on rice.

name: PEGGY'S POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
4  c. potatoes, peeled and cut into cubes
1/2  c. diced onions
5 to 6  c. broth
1  small container heavy cream
1 1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook potatoes and onions in water until half done; drain. Pour broth over potatoes and onion; cook until done.  Add milk, butter, salt and pepper.  Add cream to soup until desired taste is achieved.

name: ORANGE JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. water
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. miniature marshmallows
2 regular  pkg. orange Jell-O
1  can crushed pineapple
1  c. Angel Flake coconut
pecans (if desired)
preparation: Heat 4 cups water.  Dissolve cheese and marshmallows in water with electric mixer.  Add dry Jell-O.  After it has cooled some, add pineapple, coconut and pecans.  Stir and put in refrigerator until firmly set.

name: CROCK-POT MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
8  oz. cooked elbow macaroni
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  small onion, chopped
1  can evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. milk
1 to 1 1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
preparation: Grease  crock-pot   with  oil  or  shortening.  Put  in cooked, drained  macaroni.  Over  low  heat,  melt  butter  in saucepan.   Add   onion;   cook  until  tender.  Mix  macaroni noodles with 1  tablespoon  vegetable  oil.  Add  onion-butter mixture, evaporated milk and  milk;  mix  well.  Cut  Velveeta cheese into chunks.  Add  to macaroni mixture.  Turn crock-pot to low.  Cook, covered, on low for 2 to 3 hours.  Serve hot.

name: 2 X 4 SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  cans minestrone soup
2  cans navy beans
2  cans Ro-Tel
onion and salt to taste
preparation: Brown beef and drain.   Place in crock-pot with remaining ingredients and simmer for 3 to 4 hours.

name: CREME DE MENTHE BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. vanilla wafer crumbs
2/3  c. pecans, finely chopped
2  c. confectioners XXXX sugar, divided
2  Tbsp. corn syrup
1/2  c. creme de menthe
preparation: Combine crumbs, nuts, 1 cup sugar, syrup and creme de menthe with a fork to make a stiff dough. Form into balls. Roll in the rest of sugar. Chill overnight and store in an airtight container.

name: MACARONI 'N CHEESE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. macaroni, cooked and drained (6 c. cooked)
2  Tbsp. oil
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. shredded sharp processed cheese
1/4  c. melted butter
2  Tbsp. minced onion
preparation: Toss cooked macaroni in 2 tablespoons oil.  Add all remaining ingredients.  Pour into lightly greased crock-pot.  Cover and cook on low for 3 to 4 hours; stir occasionally.

name: PINEAPPLE YAM BAKE(No Fat)
ingredients:
3  yams, cooked
3/4  c. crushed pineapple, drained
1/4  Tbsp. pure maple syrup
2  egg whites
preparation: Mash yams until smooth.  Preheat oven to 400°. Mix drained pineapple and 3 tablespoons of syrup into yams.  Spoon into a 9-inch round or 8-inch square, nonstick baking pan.  Beat egg whites to soft peaks.  Add remaining 1 tablespoon of syrup and beat until stiff.  Spread with spatula using a swirling motion on top of yam mixture.  Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes or until top is golden brown.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1  can artichoke hearts
1  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  good dash garlic powder
preparation: Drain and chop	artichoke  hearts.  Mix all ingredients together.  Bake at 300° about 30 minutes.  Let cool.  Serve as a dip  with  crackers.  Delicious!  (This  was  the late Mrs. Betty Jackson's favorite.)

name: WILMA'S SPONGE CAKE
ingredients:
6  egg yolks
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. cold water
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon extract
1  tsp. grated lemon peel (if desired)
6  egg whites
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Heat oven to 325°.  In small bowl, beat eggs yolks until very thick.  Pour yolks into large mixer bowl.  Gradually beat in sugar. On low speed, mix in flour, baking powder and salt alternately with water, flavorings and lemon peel.  In another bowl, beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff.  Gradually fold egg yolk mixture into egg whites.  Pour into greased tube pan.  Bake 60 to 65 minutes.  Invert pan on funnel.  Let hang until cake is completely cool.

name: CHEESE NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. butter
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed Cheddar cheese soup
1/2  c. milk
3  c. cooked macaroni
2  Tbsp. buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Cook onion in butter until tender. Blend in soup.  Gradually stir in milk.  In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, combine sauce and cooked macaroni. Sprinkle crumbs on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown and bubbly.

name: PEANUT BLOSSOMS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. plain flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. oil
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1  lb. Hershey's chocolate Kisses
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except candy Kisses, in a large bowl until a large ball is formed.  Shape into small balls.  Roll ball in sugar.  Place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Press Kisses on cookies while warm.  Makes 6 dozen.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sour cream
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. parsley, chopped
salt and pepper
preparation: Combine ingredients and mix well.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Chill at least 2 hours before serving.  Swirl in blender for smoother dip, if desired.  Serve with raw vegetables or wheat crackers.

name: BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
potatoes (1 per person)
garlic powder
onion salt
paprika
1/2  stick butter or margarine
salt and pepper
preparation: Peel and slice potatoes. Put into baking dish that has been buttered on sides and bottom.  Sprinkle with garlic powder, onion salt, salt and pepper and dot the top of potatoes with remainder of butter.  Cover with foil, if using conventional oven, and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: SPICY NUT TRIANGLES COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. soft margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg, separated
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Cream together margarine, sugar and egg yolk.  Add flour mixture gradually, stirring well.  Spread dough evenly in 15 x 10-inch cookie sheet.  Beat egg white and brush over top.  Smooth surface with fingertips.  Sprinkle nuts over dough and press in. Bake at 275° for 45 minutes.  While warm, cut into 4 length strips than 6 crosswise strips.  Cut each piece in half diagonally.  Makes 48.

name: ONION CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. Vidalia onions
1  egg, well beaten
1  c. nonfat condensed milk
3/4  tsp. seasoned salt
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/2  tsp. white pepper
1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar
paprika
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease an 8 x 8-inch Pyrex pan.  Peel and slice onions and separate into rings. Put into a medium sized saucepan and cover with hot water.  Boil 1 minute.  Drain well. Spread onions evenly in the 8 x 8-inch pan.   Sprinkle with the parsley.

name: CHICKEN NUGGETS
ingredients:
6  to 8 chicken breasts, boned and skinned
1  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. water
2  eggs
4  Tbsp. sesame seed
hot oil
preparation: Cut chicken breasts into bite size pieces.   Mix flour, salt, water, eggs and sesame seed.   Beat together until smooth.   Dip chicken in batter and drop in hot oil.   Oil should cover chicken. Cook each piece about 5 to 7 minutes or until golden brown. Drain.   Serve with sweet and sour sauce, if desired.

name: DANISH CABBAGE SOUP(Hvidkaalsuppe)
ingredients:
2  lb. meat (lamb, salt pork or ham bone)
2  onions or 4 leeks
1  head cabbage
4  carrots, diced
4  potatoes, diced
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cover meat with cold water and boil until tender, 3 to 4 hours.  Cut up cabbage and onions and cook separately until tender.  Cook carrots and potatoes together.  Add all the cooked vegetables to the broth just before serving.  Serve meat on a side dish dipped in prepared mustard and a slice of bread.

name: BARBARA'S STEW
ingredients:
4  lb. hamburger
3  c. carrots, sliced
6  c. potatoes, sliced
3  cans peas (frozen)
4  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  onions, chopped
2  cans whole corn
mild Cheddar cheese, shredded
salt and pepper
preparation: Good for a crowd.  Use a large roaster, it's best.

name: ANGEL DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  angel food cake, baked and let stand overnight
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
1  box coconut
3  envelopes Dream Whip
juice of 1 lemon
1  c. white sugar
2  envelopes Knox gelatine
4  Tbsp. cold water
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Dissolve gelatine in cold water; add boiling water, sugar, crushed pineapple and lemon juice.  Chill until partly gelled. Whip 2 envelopes of Dream Whip (make sure your bowl, beaters and milk are very cold).  Add to gelatine mixture.  Flake angel food cake into very small pieces.  Put 1/2 of flaked cake into a 9 x 13-inch pan; place 1/2 of gelatine mixture over cake.  Add last 1/2 of cake pieces and remaining gelatine mixture.  Prepare last envelope of Dream Whip.  Spread on top.  Cover with coconut; chill overnight.  "Nuts and cherries can be added on top if desired."

name: CORNBREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  pan cornbread
4  slices white bread
1/3  c. finely chopped celery
1/3  c. finely chopped bell pepper
1  c. finely chopped onion
3  tsp. poultry seasoning
2  eggs
6  c. chicken or turkey broth
preparation: Put crumbs of cornbread and white bread in big pot.  Add celery, bell pepper, onions and poultry seasoning mix.  Add broth and eggs; mix.  You want it like pancake mix.  Put in pan and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until browned.

name: PEAR SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. lime Jell-O
1  pkg. Dream Whip
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
1 large  can pears
preparation: Mix Jell-O according to directions on box using 1/2 cup pear juice with cold water.  Let jell.  Soften cream cheese with a little of the Jell-O mixture while warm (using a fork).  Drain pears well and cut up.  Whip Dream Whip.  Whip Jell-O and add softened cheese and whip some more.  Fold in Dream Whip and pears; return to the refrigerator.  Makes a large salad.

name: FANCY CHICKEN LOG
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. bottled steak sauce
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1 1/2  c. minced cooked chicken
1/3  c. minced celery
1/4  c. chopped parsley
1/4  c. chopped toasted almonds
Ritz crackers
preparation: Beat together first 3 ingredients. Blend in next 2 ingredients and 2 teaspoons parsley; refrigerate remaining parsley. Shape mixture into a 9-inch log. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill 4 hours or overnight. Toss together remaining parsley and almonds; use to coat log. Serve with crackers. Makes about 3 cups spread.

name: BANANA SPICE CAKE(This cake will spice up your life.)
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cloves
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
3/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and spices together. Add brown sugar, shortening and 1/2 cup milk; beat for 2 minutes. Add remaining milk, eggs and vanilla; mix well.  Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake in a 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: SALMON CROQUETTES
ingredients:
1  can salmon
1  small potato, cooked and mashed
1  egg
1  onion, chopped
salt
pepper
cracker crumbs
dash of garlic salt
preparation: Parboil chopped onion in salt water until clear. Drain and debone salmon.  Mix all ingredients well. Season to taste.  Roll in cracker crumbs mixed with salt, pepper and garlic salt. Fry until golden brown.

name: BUTTERMILK PIES(Makes 2 Pies)
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  stick margarine
4  eggs
2/3  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla flavor
preparation: Pour into pie crust.  Bake in oven on 325° for 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  whole chicken, boiled and cut up
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. chicken broth
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  medium chopped onion
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  chopped green bell pepper
1  Tbsp. dry parsley
1 1/2  c. partly cooked rice
preparation: Combine all ingredients and place in greased casserole. Sprinkle top with crushed potato chips.  Bake 30 minutes at 400°.

name: COUNTRY POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
8  Slices lean bacon, coarsely chopped
1/4  c. Chopped celery
1/2  c. Chopped onion
2  Medium potatoes, peeled and cut in 1-inch cubes
2 1/2  c. Water
1  Bay leaf
1/2  tsp. Salt
1/4  tsp. Grated nutmeg
1/4  tsp. Dried marjoram
1/4  tsp. Celery salt
1/4  tsp. Black pepper
1  c. Milk
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. Finely minced parsley
preparation: In a deep pan, over a medium heat, saute the bacon, celery and onion until the onion is golden brown, about 5 minutes.  Add the potatoes, water and seasonings, raise the heat to high and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cover, simmer for 15 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. Mash the potatoes slightly, about 1/4 of the cubes should be left whole. Remove the bay leaf, add the milk, Worcestershire sauce and parsley and bring back to a boil. Serves 4-6.

name: BACON WRAPPED PORK LOIN
ingredients:
1  pork loin
1/2  lb. bacon
1/2  c. orange juice
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper as you like
preparation: Wrap bacon around pork loin. Use toothpicks to hold bacon to loin. Salt and pepper loin. Put loin in bowl or marinade dish. Pour 1/2 cup orange juice over pork loin. Add Worcestershire sauce. Marinate for 8 to 24 hours. Wrap loin in tinfoil and grill at 350°.

name: YABBA-DABBA-DOO SQUARES
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  pkg. miniature marshmallows
6  c. Post fruity Pebbles cereal or cocoa Pebbles
preparation: Microwave:  Melt margarine in large microwave bowl at High 45 seconds.  Add marshmallows; toss to coat.  Cook 1 minute or until marshmallows are smooth when stirred.  Add cereal; toss to coat well.  Press firmly into greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Chill 1 hour. Cut into squares.  Store in cool place.  Makes 24 squares.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  can crushed pineapple
1  can cherry pie filling
1  c. chopped pecans
1  stick butter, cut in thin slices
preparation: Dump undrained pineapple into pan; spread evenly.  Dump in pie filling and spread into even layer.  Dump dry cake mix onto cherry layer; spread evenly.  Sprinkle nuts over cake mix.  Put butter over top.  Bake at 350° in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan for 48 to 53 minutes.

name: TOMATO ASPIC
ingredients:
2  c. V-8 juice
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
seasonings to taste (salt, Tabasco sauce and lemon and onion juices)
1/2  c. chopped celery
enough cold water to soften gelatin
preparation: Sprinkle gelatin on cold water to soften.  Add to boiling  V-8 juice; cool.  When cool, add celery.  Pour into mold or individual molds and refrigerate until stiff.

name: SUGARLESS FRUIT/NUT MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. chopped dates
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped prunes
1  c. water
1/2  c. margarine, cut into pats
1/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In pan, combine chopped dates, raisins, prunes and water. Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes.  Stir in margarine and salt; set aside to cool.  Add remaining ingredients to fruit. Stir just until dry ingredients are moistened.  Spoon into greased mini-muffin pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  You can use an 11 x 7 x 2-inch pan and bake for 30 minutes.  Yields 32 muffins.

name: RED BEANS AND RICE
ingredients:
1  lb. dry pinto beans
2  chopped onions
2  stalks chopped celery
1  green pepper, chopped
1  clove garlic, crushed
1  lb. smoked sausage or turkey sausage, cut in pieces
2  c. cooked rice
preparation: Sort, wash and soak beans overnight in water.  Next day, drain, rinse and add the onion, chopped celery, green pepper and garlic.  Put in pan and cover with water.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour.  Add the sausage and continue cooking for 1 1/2 hours or until beans are tender.  If necessary, add water (hot) to prevent beans from sticking.  Stir in salt, pepper and Tabasco as mixture simmers.  Add rice in the last 30 minutes. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

name: SWEET POTATO PIES
ingredients:
1  can yams
3  large eggs
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  stick butter, melted
1  Tbsp. vanilla
nutmeg to taste
2  pie shells
preparation: Mix well.  Pour into pie shells. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.

name: CHERRY CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker crust
1  c. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
1  (10 to 15 oz.) container Cool Whip
1  can sour cherries (water packed), drained and rinsed
preparation: Cream together cream cheese and sugar until sugar is dissolved.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Gently mix in cherries.  Pour into pie shell.  Refrigerate for 4 hours at least before serving.

name: BISQUICK CARAMEL ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. cold water
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. brown sugar
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Mix Bisquick and water.  Roll out and spread with 2 tablespoons margarine.  Sprinkle with 1/4 cup brown sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.  Roll up and cut into slices.  Melt 1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons margarine and add brown sugar.  Place spoonfuls of mixture in bottom of muffin cups.  Place a slice of dough in each cup.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

name: HARVARD BEETS
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. cornstarch
1/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. water
4  c. cooked beets
3  Tbsp. butter
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Combine sugar and cornstarch.  Add vinegar and water.  Boil 5 minutes.  Add beets and simmer 1/2 hour.  Add butter and season with salt and pepper.

name: FAT FREE APPLE DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. nonfat cream cheese, room temperature
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together.  Makes a great dip.  It's a wonderful substitute for caramel dip.

name: SPOON CORN BREAD
ingredients:
2  slightly beaten eggs
1 (9 1/2 oz.)  pkg. corn muffin mix
1 (8 oz.)  can creamed corn
1 (8 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. butter
1  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Combine all ingredients and pour into greased baking dish (11 x 7 x 1 3/4-inch).  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Add cheese on top and bake 10 minutes longer.

name: OREO DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 (16 to 19 oz.)  pkg. Oreo cookies
1  stick margarine
2  pkg. French vanilla instant pudding
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
3 1/2  c. milk
1  container Cool Whip
preparation: Crush Oreo cookies (reserve about half the amount).  Use other crumbs, mixed with melted margarine to make crust.  Mix milk, cream cheese and pudding mix together.  Fold in Coool Whip.  Put mixture on top of crust, then sprinkle remaining amount of crumbs on the top of this.  Freeze or refrigerate for several minutes, if you wish.

name: BRIDE'S DINNER(Pork Chops)
ingredients:
5  slices day old bread, cubed
1  egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. grated onion
1/8  tsp. poultry seasoning
4  pork chops (1 inch thick)
4  apples (medium)
1/4  c. seedless raisins
4  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
4  medium sweet potatoes, pared
3  Tbsp. melted butter
salt and pepper
preparation: Combine bread cubes, egg, butter, seasonings and onion.  Shape into four balls.  Place chops in shallow baking pan.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Place one ball of stuffing on each chop. Core apples.  Set in pan with chops.  Combine raisins, sugar and cinnamon.  Fill centers of apples.  Roll sweet potatoes in melted butter.  Place in pan with chops and apples.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Bake 1 1/2 hours in 350° oven.  Serves 4.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oil
1  medium onion, chopped
3  c. cooked, shredded chicken
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can whole tomatoes, diced
1 medium  jar chunky salsa *
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. parsley
1  doz. flat corn tortillas
4  c. grated Monterey Jack cheese
1  c. black olives, chopped
preparation: Saute onion in hot oil in large skillet until soft.  Add chicken, tomato sauce, tomatoes, salsa, garlic powder and parsley; stir well and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes.  Spray 13 x 9-inch pan with Pam and place 4 tortillas in bottom.  Spread 1/3 of the chicken on top.  Layer 1/3 of the cheese, then 1/3 olives.  Repeat twice.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes until cheese is light brown and bubbly.  Serves 8.

name: GRANNY'S SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1  large egg
2 to 2 1/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together butter and sugar.  Blend in egg.  Sift together flour, baking powder and salt and add to mixture.  Add vanilla.

name: FRUIT SLUSH
ingredients:
6  c. water
4  c. sugar
2 (12 oz.)  cans frozen orange juice
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
6  c. premixed juice (apple or pineapple)
2  bananas, mashed very fine
ginger ale or 7-Up
preparation: Boil 6 cups water with 4 cups sugar.  Let cool, then add remaining ingredients.  Freeze.  Put couple scoops in a glass and cover with 7-Up or ginger ale.

name: HARVEST POTATOES
ingredients:
32  oz. cubed (frozen) hash browns, thawed
1  can mushroom soup (undiluted)
1  c. sour cream
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. melted butter
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  tsp. onion powder
2  c. shredded Cheddar
preparation: Melt butter in large bowl. Add spices and mix. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: ROTEL TOMATO-CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1 large  can Ro-Tel tomatoes (undrained)
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, chunked
preparation: Melt cheese in saucepan, being careful not to scorch.  Cut tomatoes into small pieces.  Add to cheese.  Heat, stirring constantly.  Good as chip dip or poured over tortilla chips.

name: PUMPKIN CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. sugar
1  c. Wesson oil
1 small  can (2 c.) pumpkin
4  eggs, one at a time
preparation: Preheat oven at 350°.  Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Sift together first 5 ingredients.  Mix together remaining ingredients.  Add dry mixture to the wet mixture slowly to blend. Beat 2 minutes.  Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean when inserted into middle of cake.

name: LEMON DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
2  boxes lemon instant pudding
2  c. milk
preparation: Mix flour, oleo and nuts.  Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Cool.

name: CORN PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  can drained shoe peg corn
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour in buttered casserole.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 45 minutes.  Test with toothpick.  If toothpick dry, it is cooked.  In microwave on High, 17 minutes or less.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1 (16 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
1  stick butter
1  c. nuts
preparation: Pour pineapple (undrained) and pie filling in 9 x 13-inch pan; mix together.  Sprinkle dry cake mix over mixture.  Dot with 1 stick butter.  Sprinkle with nuts.  Bake at 350° about 45 minutes to 1 hour, until golden brown.

name: SQUASH AND STUFFING
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow squash
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix
1 small  jar chopped pimentos, drained
1  onion, chopped
1  c. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
3  carrots, grated
1/2  c. butter or margarine
dash of salt
preparation: Cook squash; mash and drain.  Mix with half of stuffing mix, pimentos, onion, sour  cream and carrots.  Place in large casserole.  Melt butter and  mix  with remaining stuffing mix. Place on top of squash mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: Black & White Cookies(Yield: 8 Large Cookies)
ingredients:
1  1/2 cups All Purpose Flour
1/2  tsp. Baking Soda
1/2  tsp. Salt
1/2  cup Granulated Sugar
1/3  cup Unsalted Butter (at room temperature)
1  Egg
1/3  cup Buttermilk
preparation: 1. Heat Oven to 350°.  Coat 2 baking sheets with cooking spray.  In medium-size bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt. In large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed, beat together sugar and butter until smooth and creamy, about 1 minute.  Beat in egg until well combined.  On low speed, alternately beat in flour mixture and the buttermilk, ending with flour mixture; beat until smooth.

name: LIFE'S RECIPE
ingredients:
1  c. good thoughts
1  c. kind deeds
1  c. consideration for others
3  c. forgiveness
3  c. sacrifice for others
2  c. well beaten faults
preparation: Mix these thoroughly and add tears of joy and sorrow and sympathy for others.  Flavor with little gifts of love.  Fold in 4 cups of prayer and faith to lighten other ingredients and raise the texture to great heights of Christian living.  After pouring all this into your daily life, bake well with the heart of human kindness.  Serve with a smile.

name: LITTLE PIG SOUFFLE
ingredients:
4  eggs
6  slices bread, cubed
2  c. milk
2  c. grated cheese
1  tsp. salt
1  lb. link sausage, cooked and sliced
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: In 9x13-inch casserole dish, layer bread cubes, sausage and cheese.  Beat eggs well, add milk, salt and mustard.  Pour over casserole and let stand overnight in refrigerator.  Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.  Serve immediately.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: RECIPE FOR HAPPINESS
ingredients:
4 heaping  c. of patience
1  heart full of love
2  handfuls of generosity
a dash of laughter
1  headful of understanding
preparation: Serves:  Everybody you meet.

name: CANDIED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
6  sweet potatoes
1  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Select sweet potatoes of approximately the same size for uniform cooking.  Scrub potatoes and remove any spots with a sharp knife.  Prick surface with a fork.  Place 1-inch apart on paper plate in microwave oven.  Cook about 12 minutes on High power or until tender.  Peel and slice when cool enough to handle.  Arrange in a 2-quart casserole dish.

name: JOAN'S PINEAPPLE DIP
ingredients:
1  whole pineapple
1  egg
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1  (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
preparation: Core and peel pineapple.  Crush 1/2 of pineapple with a potato masher.  Put the crushed pineapple into a saucepan.  Add beaten egg, flour and sugar.  Mix well.   Heat on low heat until thickened.  Allow to cool thoroughly, then add Cool Whip.  Mix well.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.  Cut remaining pineapple into chunks to serve with dip.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
2 (10 oz.)  cans mushroom soup
2 (4 oz.)  cans mushrooms, drained
1  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Cheddar cheese
1  stick butter
salt and pepper
1 to 1 1/2  c. cracker crumbs
preparation: Layer this twice (beginning with broccoli) in a 9 x 9-inch pan, sprayed with Pam.  Dot each layer of the cracker crumbs with 1/2 stick butter.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
3  medium potatoes
4  carrots
1  large onion
1  green bell pepper
2  c. chopped okra (fresh or frozen)
1  can tomato soup
1  can celery soup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In large pot, cook chicken with salt and pepper, covered with water, until tender.  Take chicken out of pot and put in large mixing bowl.  Chop all vegetables in small pieces.   Add to pot in which chicken was cooked.  Cook slowly until tender.  Remove bones from chicken.  Chop chicken in small pieces.  Add soup to cover vegetables.  Simmer until well heated.

name: LEMON CHIFFON PIE
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1/3  c. lemon juice
few drops of yellow food coloring
3  egg whites
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1  graham cracker pie crust
preparation: Combine sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice and food coloring; mix well.  Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff, but not dry.  Gently fold into sweetened condensed milk mixture.  Pour into crust and chill 3 hours or until set.

name: CHERRY COKE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can Bing cherries
1 (1 lb. 4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. cherry Jell-O
2 (6 1/2 oz.)  bottles Coke
preparation: Drain juice from fruit; add water to make 2 cups.  Heat juice to boiling, add gelatin, stir until dissolved.  Cool.   Add cola and fruit.  Pour into 1/2 quart mold.  Chill until set.  Serve with salad dressing or cream cheese dressing.

name: SOFT SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar (white)
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. dairy sour cream
cinnamon-sugar mixture
preparation: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add vanilla.  Add flour, salt, soda and baking powder alternately with sour cream. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased baking sheet, two-inches apart.  Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar mixture.  Bake until brown around the edges at 400° for approximately 10 minutes. Cool and store in airtight tin.

name: CREAMY CHICKEN SALAD(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  boneless chicken breast (1/2 lb.)
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. seedless grapes
1  c. thinly sliced celery
1  Tbsp. thinly sliced green onions
2  Tbsp. low-fat plain yogurt
lettuce
preparation: Place 1 boneless chicken breast on a microwave-proof plate. Sprinkle with lemon juice.  Cover with wax paper and cook on High for 3 to 5 minutes, turning over once.  Cool in freezer for 10 minutes.

name: ALPINE SPINACH AND NOODLES
ingredients:
8  oz. lasagna noodles
2  slices whole wheat bread, crumbled
3  egg whites
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
4  oz. shredded Swiss cheese
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. spinach, thawed and drained
3  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
2  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (32 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cook lasagna noodles.  Drain.  Spread noodles in pan.  Cover with 1/2 jar of spaghetti sauce.

name: TEA CAKES
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
1  c. shortening
3  eggs
1 1/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. baking soda
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Bake at 350° until lightly brown.

name: BANANA SPLIT DESSERT
ingredients:
3  eggs
3  c. 10x sugar
1 1/2  sticks softened margarine
2  cans crushed pineapple, drained
5  to 6 bananas
16  oz. Cool Whip
1  jar cherries
peanuts, crushed
2  c. graham crackers
preparation: Mix the graham cracker crumbs and a stick of margarine (melted) and pat down in the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan.

name: LEMON BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. toasted almonds
1/2  c. golden raisins
grated rind of 1 lemon
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1/4  c. lemon juice
preparation: Cream butter.  Add sugar, beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer.   Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each.

name: APRICOT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (17 oz.)  can apricots, drained and chopped
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  pkg. orange jello
2  c. hot water
1  c. apricot juice
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. pineapple juice
1  c. whipping cream
3/4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Keep apricot and pineapple juices separate.  Chill fruit. Dissolve jello in hot water.  Add apricot juice.  Fold in apricots, pineapple and marshmallows.  Chill.  Combine sugar and flour.  Add egg and butter.  Add pineapple juice; cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thick.  Cool.  Fold in whipped cream; spread over jello mixture.  Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.  Chill.

name: STUFFED GREEN PEPPERS
ingredients:
5  to 6 large green peppers
1  c. boiling water
1  c. tomato sauce
1/2  lb. ground beef
1  egg
salt and pepper to taste
1  small chopped onion
2  c. cooked rice
preparation: Cut a thin slice from top of peppers; remove seeds and wash. Cook peppers in boiling salt water, about 5 minutes; drain.  Brown hamburger and onion; drain off grease.  Mix together hamburger, egg, salt, pepper, rice and tomato sauce; stuff into peppers.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
4  cans biscuits, cut into quarters
2 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  sticks margarine
3 1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix 1 2/3 cups sugar and 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon and roll biscuits in this mixture; drop into Bundt pan.  In a pan, mix 1 1/2 cups sugar, butter and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.  Bring this to a boil; pour over biscuits.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Combine all ingredients in order and mix well.  Pour in 2 pie shells and bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: LEMONADE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box lemon cake mix
1  lb. box powdered sugar
6  oz. can frozen lemonade (thawed)
preparation: Mix and bake cake mix according to directions on box; bake cake in an oblong cake pan.  After cake is done and while hot, cut into tiny squares.  Mix sugar and lemonade and pour over cake and down into cuts.  Put cake back into oven for 5 minutes.  Remove and allow to cool.

name: MACARONI AND VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. elbow macaroni
2  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
1/2  pt. sour cream
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. white vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1  large onion, chopped
preparation: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until tender.  Drain. Cook frozen vegetables according to directions on package.  Drain; chill.  Combine sour cream, mayonnaise, vinegar, salt, celery seed and Tabasco sauce in large bowl.  Add macaroni, vegetables and onion.  Toss to mix thoroughly.  Serve on lettuce leaf.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/4  c. shortening
1/4  c. butter
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1 1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix shortening, margarine, peanut butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar and egg thoroughly.  Blend all dry ingredients and add. Roll dough into 1 1/4-inch balls.  Place 3-inches apart on lightly greased baking sheets.  Flatten crisscross style with a fork dipped in flour.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes in a preheated 375° oven.  Makes 3 dozen, 2 1/2-inch cookies.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
4 (1 oz.)  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Melt chocolate with shortening.  Cool.  Sift together flour with powder and salt.  Beat eggs until light; add sugar, then chocolate mixture.  Blend.  Add flour, vanilla and nuts.  Mix well.  Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

name: HOT CHILI(For Cold Days)
ingredients:
1  lb. venison or beef
1  tsp. crushed red pepper
1  tsp. oil
1  jar Ragu sauce of your choice
1  pt. kidney beans, cooked
1  pt. cooked pinto beans
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown meat in oil; drain.  Combine all ingredients.  Serve with crackers and cheese.  Grate cheese on chili.

name: BOHEMIAN COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
2 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. oil
1  c. coconut
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. nuts
1  c. sugar
1  c. buttermilk
2  eggs
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, oil and eggs.  Then add other ingredients and mix well until creamy.  Bake in greased Bundt pan at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE RECIPE 1
ingredients:
2  c. white sugar
2/3  c. evaporated milk
1  c. Marshmallow Creme or 16 marshmallows
1  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook sugar and evaporated milk to soft ball stage (235°F). Stir while cooking. Remove from heat and add Marshmallow Creme or marshmallows, peanut butter and vanilla. Cool.

name: POTATO DELUXE
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick butter or margarine, melted
1  onion, chopped finely
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cheddar cheese, shredded
1  (2 lb.) bag hash browns
preparation: Mix all together well and spread in a rectangular baking dish. Bake, uncovered. at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

name: ASOPADO PUERTORRIGUENO(Soup)
ingredients:
2  large chicken thighs or more
1  medium onion
2  cloves garlic
1/2  green pepper
1  tsp. oregano
1/8  tsp. paprika
1/4  lb. ham
2  cans chicken broth
1/2  c. pearl rice
1/2  c. fresh cilantro
1/2  envelope achiote-cilantro *
4  oz. tomato sauce
preparation: Put everything together in a pot except the rice.  After it has boiled abut 45 minutes, add rice.  Boil until it gets thick. Add some water, if needed.  Also taste for salt.  Serves 2 or 3 people.

name: CHINESE LEMON CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  box lemon flavored gelatin
2  tsp. garlic salt
3  Tbsp. prepared mustard
3  Tbsp. melted margarine
2  whole chicken breasts, halved, skinned and boned
1/2  c. thinly sliced almonds
preparation: Combine dry lemon gelatin, garlic salt and mustard.  Add melted margarine; mix well.  Place gelatin mixture in oblong dish; arrange chicken in single layers, turning to coat both sides. Sprinkle with almond slices.  Cover; bake at 350° for 30 minutes, basting once.  Remove cover; baste again and bake 15 minutes more or until done.  Makes 4 servings.

name: OVEN MASHED POTATOES
ingredients:
8  to 12 Idaho potatoes
2  Tbsp. onion flakes
dash of pepper
1  pt. sour cream
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook potatoes until tender. Mash with milk.  Mix remaining ingredients, reserving 1/4 of cheese for garnish.  Grease 2-quart casserole.  Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes (last 20 minutes, uncover until golden brown).

name: FORGOTTEN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  egg whites
3/4  c. sugar
pinch of salt
1  c. pecans
1  c. chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat egg whites until foamy.  Gradually add sugar and salt. Beat until stiff.  Stir in pecans, chips and vanilla.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto foil covered cookie sheet.  Put in oven and turn off oven.  Leave cookies in closed oven overnight. Do not peek!

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  bag frozen broccoli, cooked
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. mayonnaise or Miracle Whip
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  box Stove Top stuffing
cooked cubed chicken
preparation: Use 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onions
2  lb. hash browns
1/2  stick oleo
8  oz. Cheez Whiz
8  oz. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. crushed cornflakes
preparation: Butter a casserole dish heavily.  Layer spuds and onions and salt and pepper to taste.  Mix Cheez Whiz, sour cream and soup. Pour over spuds and onions.  Cover with cornflakes.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BUTTERY FRENCH BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. celery seed
1  loaf French bread (about 20 inches), sliced
preparation: In a small bowl, combine butter, paprika and celery seed. Spread between bread slices and over top.  Wrap bread tightly in foil.  Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.  Open foil and bake 5 minutes longer.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: ORANGE SALAD SUPREME
ingredients:
1 large  box orange Jell-O
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  (16 oz.) Cool Whip
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. pineapple juice
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. plain flour
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Step 1:  Mix Jell-O by box directions (less 1 cup water). Pour into 9 x 12-inch dish.  Chill until it begins to thicken. Add pineapple and let mixture congeal.

name: CHIPPED BEEF BALL
ingredients:
1  pkg. cream cheese, softened
3  to 4 green onions, chopped
1 small  can black olives, chopped
1 small  jar dried beef, chopped
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2 to 1  tsp. Accent
preparation: Mix all ingredients together; shape into ball.  Leave a little of the beef for sprinkling on top.

name: CHEESEY SPINACH
ingredients:
2  cans cheddar cheese soup
8  oz. sharp cheddar cheese, cubed or shredded
2  pkgs. fresh spinach
1  box croutons
preparation: Pre-cook fresh spinach for about 5 minutes. Drain. Mix together the soup, cheese and spinach in mixing bowl. Put mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan and cover top with croutons. Bake at 350° for 30-40 minutes. Serves 12.

name: TACO SALAD PASTA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef (brown and drain)
1  pkg. dry taco season
1  pkg. spiral garden noodles (boil, drain, and rinse)
1  pkg. salad mix
2  c. (8 oz) shredded cheese
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped bell pepper
1 sm.  bottle catalina dressing
corn chips (1 large bag)
preparation: Mix all ingredients and serve.

name: FAST FUDGE FROSTING
ingredients:
1  pkg. confectioners sugar, sifted (4 1/2 c.)
1/4  c. cocoa
1/4  tsp. salt
1/3  c. boiling water
1/3  c. butter or margarine (soft)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, cocoa and salt, mixing well.  Add boiling water and butter; blend.  Add vanilla.  Beat until of spreading consistency.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. shredded cheese
1/2  c. crumbled cheese
2  Tbsp. grated onion
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix cheese and onions. Chill. Shape into balls. Roll into nuts.

name: THREE BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can green beans
1  can wax beans
1  can kidney beans
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. salad oil
1/2  c. cider vinegar
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Drain the beans and mix with the pepper and onion. Set aside and mix the rest of the ingredients very well.  Mix everything together in one bowl and refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

name: BROWNIE CANDY CUPS
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines Chocolate Lovers extra double fudge brownie mix
2  eggs
1/3  c. water
1/4  c. vegetable oil
30  miniature peanut butter candies, unwrapped
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place 30 (2-inch) foil cupcake liners in small muffin pan or on cookie sheet.

name: LIZ'S BAKED FISH CREOLE
ingredients:
2  lb. fish (cod, haddock, flounder, perch or sole)
1  onion, minced
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  c. canned tomatoes, chopped
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Saute onion in butter until limp but not browned.  Add rest of the ingredients except fish.  Simmer for 5 minutes to combine flavors.  Place fish fillets in a baking dish and bake in a preheated 400° oven for 25 minutes.

name: HOTTERNL VEGETARIAN CHILI
ingredients:
1 (32 oz.)  can chili hot beans
1 (16 oz.)  can black beans
1  can corn
1  can crushed tomatoes
1  can Cajun flavor stewed tomatoes, cut in bite sized pieces
3  tsp. chili powder
1  small habanero pepper (optional, but recommended)
preparation: Cut habanero pepper into strips, but not through the stem. Wrap in a coffee filter and tie with dental floss.  This is a pepper too hot to eat alone, but has a great flavor when allowed to cook with the chili.  Be sure to wash hands, knife and cutting board.   Put all ingredients in a crock-pot.  Add habanero.   Cook on high for at least 4 to 6 hours.  Overnight is fine.  The longer it cooks, the hotter it gets.  Fish out and remove the habanero before serving.   Serves 4 to 6.

name: TAILGATING MIX
ingredients:
16  c. Crispix cereal
24  oz. chocolate chips
1 1/2  c. smooth peanut butter
2  boxes 10x sugar
preparation: Pour cereal into a large bowl.  Melt peanut butter and chocolate chips.  Dribble over cereal.  With a spoon, toss and coat the mixture.  Add 10x sugar.  Place seal on bowl to shake (or place entire mixture into a large plastic bag to seal and shake).

name: FRUIT BREAD PUDDINGS
ingredients:
2  qt. 1/2-inch square soft bread cubes
2  qt. milk
1 1/3  c. sugar
16  eggs, beaten
2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  Tbsp. vanilla
1  qt. pitted dates, chopped
2  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. melted butter
whipped cream
preparation: Combine bread cubes, milk, sugar, eggs, salt, vanilla, dates, walnuts and melted butter.  Pour into a greased 9 x 14 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serve with whipped cream.  Yield: 23 servings.

name: HOMEMADE PIZZA
ingredients:
Ragu Pizza Quick crust (mix for 2 crusts)
1  pkg. pepperoni
1  can pizza sauce
1  lb. hamburger
1/2  lb. sausage
1  onion, chopped
1  pkg. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
ham
bacon bits
1  jar mushrooms
preparation: Mix crust for 2 pizzas. Butter cookie sheet and spread crust onto pan. Pour pizza sauce on crust and spread out.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP BARS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. margarine
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. brown sugar
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In medium bowl, combine flour and sugar; cut in margarine until crumbly.  Stir in 1/2 cup chips; press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, in same bowl, combine Eagle Brand milk, egg and vanilla, stir in remaining 1 1/2 cups chips and nuts.  Spread evenly over prepared crust.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until light golden brown.  Cool completely.  Cut into bars.  Store, covered, at room temperature.

name: PINEAPPLE COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
dash of salt
1 large  pkg. (6 oz.) lime Jell-O
1/3  c. cold water
1 (14 oz.)  can condensed milk
1  lb. cottage cheese (small curd)
preparation: Drain pineapple and add enough water to juice to make 1 cup. Add salt.  Bring to a boil.  Pour over gelatin.  Add 1/3 cup cold water.  Stir and set aside.

name: GREEN CHILI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1  can green chili
Monterey Jack cheese
1  can mushroom soup
flour tortillas
preparation: Cook and drain ground beef; add chopped onion and chopped chilies.  Cook until onions are sauteed.  Line casserole with tortillas, bottom and sides.  Pour ground beef mixture over tortillas.  Layer this with strips of tortillas and grated Monterey Jack.  Continue layering until used up.  Mix mushroom soup and 1/2 can water and pour over casserole.  Top with grated cheese.  Cover and bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until cheese has melted and casserole has heated through.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
6  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. water
3  eggs, well beaten
1/2  c. cracker crumbs
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
20  oz. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
preparation: Saute onion in 4 tablespoons butter until soft.  Stir in flour.  Add water.  Stir and cook until thick.  Blend in cheese. Add to broccoli.  Beat eggs and add gently into 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Cover with crumbs.  Dot with 2 tablespoons butter. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.  Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan.

name: BAILEY'S LIQUOR
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. whiskey
14  oz. Borden condensed milk
8  oz. light cream
4  eggs
2  Tbsp. chocolate syrup
2  tsp. instant coffee
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Place all ingredients in the blender.  Mix for 2 minutes. Chill and serve.

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA
ingredients:
2  tubes Pillsbury crescent rolls
2  (8 oz.) Philadelphia cream cheese
1  c. Miracle Whip
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing (dry)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spread out rolls on a cookie sheet and bake 8 to 10 minutes.  Cool.  Mix remaining ingredients together and spread over crust.  Top with your choice of fresh vegetables: broccoli, cauliflower, green peppers, tomatoes, onions, olives, mushrooms, radishes, celery, cheese, etc.  Cover with plastic wrap and push vegetables into cheese mixture.  Let set overnight in refrigerator and cut into squares.

name: LEMON SAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. soft oleo
1/4  c. flour
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
3  eggs, separated
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Cream oleo and sugar.  Add egg yolks.  Stir in lemon juice, milk and salt.  Beat egg whites (stiff).  Add 1/2 cup sugar.  Fold in first mixture.  Bake 1 hour at 325°.  This cake makes its own sauce.

name: MARINATED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms
1  c. Italian dressing
1/4  c. red wine vinegar
1  onion, sliced
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. oregano
1 finely chopped  clove garlic
preparation: Wash mushrooms.  Cut into thin slices and steam for 1 minute. Combine remaining ingredients in a glass jar.  Add mushroom slices and marinate, at least overnight.  Keep refrigerated.

name: A SHEEPHERDER'S DIP
ingredients:
4 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (5 oz.)  jar dried beef (can use clams, crab, etc.)
14  dashes garlic salt
14  dashes pepper
6  or more green onions, chopped
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  loaf sheepherder's bread
preparation: Cut 5 or 6 inches off top of bread.  Pull out soft insides (save for making bread dressing).  Soften cream cheese.  Combine with remaining ingredients.  Fill shell with mixture.  Replace top of bread; cover with foil.  Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.  Use fresh vegetables as well as top of bread for dippers.

name: SANDPAPER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. lemon extract
2 1/3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. yellow cornmeal
preparation: Cream shortening until soft; add sugar and beat until fluffy. Beat in eggs and extract.  Add dry ingredients; mix thoroughly. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 5 dozen 2-inch cookies.

name: TURKEY-BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
2  ribs celery, chopped
3  Tbsp. butter
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1 1/2  c. cooked turkey, cubed
1  c. cooked rice
1  can mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.)  can sliced water chestnuts
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. shredded hot pepper cheese
preparation: Saute onions, peppers and celery in butter until tender.  Cook broccoli and drain.  Arrange broccoli in bottom of a 2-quart casserole dish.  Combine sauteed vegetables and other ingredients. Spoon over broccoli.  Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: FROZEN COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
12  oz. frozen coconut
8  oz. sour cream
2  c. sugar
1  box yellow cake mix with butter
preparation: Mix cake mix according to directions in two round pans.  Mix first 3 ingredients and set aside.  When cake is cool, slice layers in half and frost between each.  Put cut side down on each. Frost over all cake with rest of icing.

name: ONION PIE
ingredients:
8  c. sliced Vidalia onions
1/4  c. olive oil
1  tsp. chopped garlic
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
partially baked 10-inch pie shell
1/2  c. grated Swiss cheese
1  can flat anchovy fillets
9  pitted black olives
preparation: Combine onions, oil and garlic in a large heavy pot.  Cover and braise slowly for 40 to 45 minutes.  After 30 minutes, remove the cover.  Season with salt and pepper and cook, uncovered, until tender and golden.  Stir from time to time; do not brown.   Lift onions into pie shell with a slotted spoon to remove excess moisture.  Sprinkle with grated cheese and decorate with anchovy fillets and black olives.  Bake in preheated 400° oven for 20 minutes.

name: WALNUT PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. light brown sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1 1/4  c. light corn syrup
3  Tbsp. butter
3  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. walnuts, cut up coarse
1  unbaked 9-inch pie crust shell
preparation: Mix in saucepan the sugar and flour.  Add corn syrup and butter.  Warm over low heat until butter is melted.  In large bowl, beat eggs with vanilla.  Stir in sugar mixture and nuts. Pour into unbaked pie crust shell.  Bake at 350° for 60 minutes, then turn oven off for 10 more minutes.  Serve with whipped cream.

name: GERMAN SWEET CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. German sweet chocolate
1/2  c. boiling water
1  c. margarine
2  c. sugar
4  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
4  egg whites, stiffly beaten
preparation: Melt chocolate in boiling water.  Cool.  Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.  Add egg yolks, 1 at a time, beating well after each.  Blend in vanilla and chocolate.  Sift flour with soda and salt; add alternately with buttermilk to chocolate mixture, beating after each addition until smooth.  Fold in beaten whites. Pour into three 9-inch layer pans, lined on bottom with paper. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Cool.  Frost tops only.

name: GRANDMA BILLIE'S MARSHMALLOWS
ingredients:
2  tsp. plain gelatin
1  c. cold water
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. cornstarch
1/4  c. powdered sugar
pinch of salt
preparation: Place gelatin and 1/2 cup cold water in bowl; let stand while you put sugar, salt and 1/2 cup cold water in deep stew kettle. Boil to soft ball (235°). Pour gelatin mixture into the hot syrup. Beat it and beat it and beat it. Grease flat pan well on bottom and sides. Powder with powdered sugar and cornstarch. Pour mixture into pan and dust top; cool. Cut into squares and dust bowl on all sides.

name: MARINATED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh mushrooms
1  large onion, cut into chunks
1/3  c. sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
1/4  c. oil
1/2  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Clean and boil mushrooms for 15 to 20 minutes; drain.  Cut onion into chunks.  Mix sugar, vinegar, oil, oregano and salt. Combine with mushrooms and onion.  Marinate 24 hours.  Drain before serving.

name: CRACKER CRUMB CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  pkg. boneless, skinless chicken
1/2  stick butter, melted
1  pkg. Town House crackers
preparation: Cut chicken in small 2 x 2-inch pieces.  Dip in butter; roll in cracker crumbs.  Place on cookie sheet lined with foil.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes, turning once.

name: SOUR CREAM APPLE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. apples, sliced
2  Tbsp. flour
1/8  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
topping
preparation: Sift together flour, salt and sugar.  Add egg, sour cream, vanilla and nutmeg.  Beat into a smooth thin batter.  Fold in apples.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.  Turn down oven to 350° for 30 minutes. Sprinkle topping over pie and return to oven and bake for 10 minutes at 400°.

name: CREAMED CORN
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen or 2 cans whole corn, drained
8  oz. Philly cream cheese
1/2  stick butter
preparation: Cook on stove or in slow cooker on low until melted together.

name: JALAPENO BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1  c. yellow cornmeal
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. chili powder
3/4  c. buttermilk
1  large egg
1  medium onion, chopped
7  oz. whole kernel corn
4  oz. chopped pimentos
3 1/2  oz. jalapenos, seeded and chopped
3  Tbsp. melted margarine
3  oz. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. bottled salsa (optional)
preparation: In a large bowl, combine first 6 ingredients.  Make a well in the center. In a medium bowl, combine next 6 ingredients.  Pour into well of dry mixture. Add margarine and blend in.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and bake 5 minutes more to melt cheese.   Serve with salsa or soup, if desired.

name: TEX-MEX DIP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  can jalapeno bean dip
2  ripe avocados
2  Tbsp. lime juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. mayo
1  envelope taco seasoning
1  bunch scallions, chopped
1  jar black olives, chopped
8  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  ripe tomatoes
1  jar pimento olives, sliced
preparation: Spread bean dip.  Puree avocado with lime juice, salt and pepper in blender.  Spread on bean dip.  In separate bowl, mix sour cream and taco seasoning.  Spread on dip.  Layer with chopped scallions, then layer with black olives, then layer with cheese. Last garnish with tomatoes and black olives.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: CHOCOLATE PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. chocolate pudding (not instant)
1  chocolate cake mix
nuts and chocolate chips
preparation: Make chocolate pudding according to directions.  Add to dry cake mix and mix thoroughly.  Pour into oblong greased pan.  Top with nuts and chocolate chips.  Bake at 350°.  Check after 35 minutes if toothpick comes out clean.

name: CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  large cauliflower, cut bite size
1/2  lb. bacon, cooked crisp, drained and crumbled
2  large firm tomatoes, chopped
1 small  bunch green onions, chopped bite size
1  c. Cheddar cheese, diced
1/2  c. mayonnaise (more if desired)
preparation: Mix all together.  Serve.  Be ready for everyone to say, "This is good!!"

name: HAM ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1  lb. sliced sandwich ham
8  oz. cream cheese
4  oz. sour cream
1/4  c. onion, minced
2  Tbsp. chives
1  tsp. garlic powder
toothpicks
preparation: Blend all ingredients, except ham.  Spread mix on ham slices, roll up and secure with toothpicks.  Cut into thirds.  Chill for 1/2 hour.

name: CARAMEL COCONUT AND PECAN PIE
ingredients:
2  pie crusts (cooked and cool)
12  oz. Cool Whip
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans, chopped
1/4  c. butter, melted
1  can condensed milk
preparation: Cook coconut and pecans in butter until lightly browned; cool. Mix Cool Whip, cream cheese and condensed milk.  Put layer in pie crust; put caramel topping.  Sprinkle with coconut and pecans.  Put another layer of Cool Whip.  Put caramel icing on top.  Freeze.

name: CARROT-PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
2  (3 oz.) orange jello
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. grated carrots
preparation: Prepare jello.  Refrigerate until soft set.  Add pineapple and carrots.  Return to refrigerator until set.  Enjoy.

name: CHILI AND CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  can hot dog chili sauce
4  oz. cream cheese
1  bag tortilla chips
preparation: Heat hot dog sauce in saucepan until hot.  Add cream cheese and stir until melted.  Pour into bowl and use as a dip with tortilla chips.

name: NO KNEAD DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. hot water
1  c. warm water
6  c. plain flour
1  c. shortening
3  pkg. dry yeast
3  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Blend together sugar and shortening; add hot water.  Dissolve yeast in warm water; add eggs, flour and salt.  Cover and let rise until double in bulk.  Stir down, cover up to 4 to 5 days.  Roll out to 1/4-inch thickness, cut with biscuit cutter and fold over and place on cookie sheet.  Brush with melted butter.  Let rise until double and bake at 350° until brown, 12 to 15 minutes.

name: PASTA SEAFOOD SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. small, cooked shrimp
1  bunch green onions, chopped
1 1/2  c. celery chopped
salt and lemon pepper to taste
1/2  c. bottled Italian dressing
8  oz. capellini noodles
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Marinate shrimp, onions, celery, salt and lemon pepper in Italian dressing.

name: AMALGAMATION CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
2  c. butter
1  c. buttermilk
4  c. cake flour
3/4  c. white raisins
10  eggs, beaten and separated
3/4  c. milk
3  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1 1/4  pt. strawberry jam
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar. Add yolks, jam and other ingredients with flour, spice and soda that have been sifted together.  Fold in beaten whites. Bake at 300°.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. cornmeal
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped onions with tops
3/4  c. buttermilk
1  egg (beaten)
preparation: Combine cornmeal, flour, soda, baking powder and salt; stir in buttermilk.  Add onion and egg.  Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil, cook until light brown, drain on paper towels.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  pastry pie shell, unbaked
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. melted butter
3  eggs
1/2  c. corn syrup (dark Karo)
1  c. pecans
preparation: Set oven to 375°.  Beat eggs slightly in 2-quart bowl.  Stir in sugar, corn syrup, melted butter and pecans.  Pour into unbaked shell.  Bake near center of oven 35 to 40 minutes or until filling is slightly firm. Center of pie may look soft when pie is gently shaken, but will become firm when cool.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  can tomato soup
1/2  can water
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
cabbage, cut in bite size pieces
2  Tbsp. rice (uncooked)
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients together in a nonstick pan and brown.  Combine soup, water and Worcestershire sauce.  In a 9 x 12-inch loaf pan, place cut cabbage pieces.  Cover with turkey mixture.  Sprinkle rice over mixture and add the tomato soup mixture.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

name: CHESTNUT DRESSING(Turkey)
ingredients:
2  lb. chestnuts
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
6  c. soft bread crumbs
1/2  c. melted butter
1  Tbsp. minced onion
2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. chopped celery
dash of pepper
preparation: Make two 1/2-inch slits with a sharp knife in the shell of each chestnut.  Place them in a deep saucepan with the oil and cook slowly for 5 minutes, shaking the pan frequently.  Then bake in a very hot oven (400°) for 5 minutes.  Remove and cool.  Peel nuts and mash the nuts and add to the bread crumbs which have been blended with all the ingredients.  Stuff turkey lightly.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. diced, cooked chicken
1 1/2  c. celery, diced
1  c. mayonnaise or 1/2 c. cream of chicken soup and 1/2 c.  mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. Accent
1/2  c. slivered almonds
2  tsp. grated onion (optional)
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. shredded cheese
potato chips
preparation: Mix together all but cheese and potato chips.  Put in 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Cover top with 1/2 cup shredded cheese and crushed potato chips.  Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 6.

name: ZUCCHINI RELISH
ingredients:
10  medium size zucchini squash
4  medium size onions
2  green sweet peppers
2  red sweet peppers
1/2  c. canning salt
2 1/2  c. white vinegar
4  c. sugar
1  tsp. turmeric
1  tsp. celery salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Remove seeds from squash and slice.  Chop onions and peppers. Sprinkle salt over squash, onions and peppers.  Mix together; let set overnight.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
bananas
vanilla wafers
3  oz. sour cream
2 small  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
3  c. milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix pudding and milk with mixer.  Let set for a few minutes to set up, then fold in Cool Whip and sour cream by hand.  Layer bananas and vanilla wafers, then pudding mixture.  Keep layering until pudding is used up.

name: COCKTAIL MEATBALLS
ingredients:
2  parts Heinz chili sauce
1  part grape jelly
big bag of meatballs
preparation: Combine chili sauce and grape jelly.  Dump bag of meatballs in crockpot.  Pour mixture over meatballs.  Let simmer. Serve.

name: STRAWBERRY-NUT SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. strawberry flavored gelatin
1  c. boiling water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1 (1 lb. 4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
3  medium size bananas, mashed
1  c. coarsely chopped nuts
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Combine gelatin with boiling water in large bowl, stirring until gelatin is dissolved.  Fold in strawberries with juice.  Add drained pineapple, mashed bananas and nuts (chopped).  Turn 1/2 of mixture into a 12 x 8-inch dish; refrigerate until firm.  Spread top with sour cream; add rest of strawberry mixture.  Refrigerate; cut into squares to serve.

name: GREEK CHICKEN(Serves 12)
ingredients:
12  chicken breasts
1  can pitted black olives
1  can artichoke hearts
8 to 10  oz. Feta cheese
4 to 8  Tbsp. olive oil
1  c. white wine
1  c. lemon juice
1  c. chicken stock
4 to 5  cloves crushed garlic
salt and pepper
preparation: Pound breasts thin.  Mash olives, artichokes, Feta, 2 to 4 tablespoons oil, salt and pepper in bowl with pastry blender. Spread about 4 tablespoons of mixture on each breast.  Roll breast and secure with toothpick.  Heat remaining oil in heavy skillet. Place chicken breast in oil and brown on all sides.  Remove breasts from pan, add remaining 5 ingredients.  Stir and cook 10 minutes. Pour this sauce over chicken breasts.  Cook in 350° oven for about 20 to 30 minutes.  Serve with linguine, lots of good Chardonnay and a great big salad and crusty French bread.

name: COCOONS
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. brown sugar
1  lb. dates, cut fine
3  c. nuts, chopped
4  c. Rice Krispies
7  oz. coconut
powdered sugar
preparation: Combine butter and brown sugar in sauce pan, cooking over medium heat until butter melt.  Add nuts, coconut and dates cooking over medium heat for 6 minutes stirring steady to keep from scorching.  Add Rice Krispies and mix well.  Shape into balls and roll in powdered sugar.

name: WALDORF SALAD DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
2 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar (light)
3/4  c. real mayonnaise
2  large eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. coarsely chopped red unpeeled apples
1  c. coarsely chopped walnuts
1/4  c. finely chopped celery
preparation: In a medium-size bowl, stir together the flour, soda, salt and cinnamon.  In large bowl of electric mixer at medium speed beat together sugar, mayonnaise, eggs and vanilla until smooth.  Add flour mixture and at low speed beat until smooth.  Stir in the apples, walnuts and celery.  Drop by level tablespoons, 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake in preheated 350°  oven until lightly brown, 10 to 12 minutes.  Remove to wire rack to cool.  Makes about 4 dozen.

name: MARY ANN'S TOMATO, ONION, CUCUMBER SALAD
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. minced parsley
2  medium tomatoes, sliced
1  large onion, sliced and separated into rings
1  medium cucumber, peeled and thinly sliced
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients in a jar; shake well.  Into a large bowl, put a layer of tomatoes, a layer of cucumber and a layer of onion.  Pour first 6 ingredients over this.  Refrigerate 2 hours before serving.  Hers was delicious!

name: SCALLOPED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. celery, chopped fine
2  Tbsp. melted butter
2  c. cooked chicken
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1 1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dried onion
1  tsp. poultry seasoning
1  bouillon cube
1/4  c. buttered crumbs
preparation: Cook celery in butter until soft.  Mix chicken and bread crumbs in bowl.  Add cooked celery and mix lightly.  Stir milk into flour, onion and seasonings.  Place in a 1-quart glass casserole.  Add crushed bouillon cube.  Cook with microwave and let come to a boil, stirring every 30 seconds.  Place chicken and crumb mixture in 1 1/2-quart glass utility dish.  Pour hot milk mixture over chicken and top with buttered crumbs.  Cover and cook 6 to 7 minutes.  If desired, use glass ceramic dish to cook and place under the broiler or conventional range to brown the top.

name: APPLESAUCE NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. whole-wheat flour
3/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. chopped walnuts
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg, beaten
1 1/4  c. unsweetened applesauce
1/4  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Combine all dry ingredients, including nuts, in a large bowl; stir well to blend.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1 (16 oz.)  box powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
1  stick margarine
preparation: Mix coconut and pecans together and put into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix 1 box German chocolate cake mix according to directions.  Pour on top of pecan mixture.  In saucepan, put one stick of margarine and 8 ounces of cream cheese, softened.  Heat until mixture is warm enough to stir in one box confectioners sugar (1 pound).  Spoon over top of cake mix.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Do not cut until cooled.

name: BEEF AND POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
onion, thinly sliced
bell pepper, sliced
Irish potatoes, thinly sliced
1  can celery soup
1/2  pt. sour cream
Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown meat and drain.  Place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer onion, bell pepper and potatoes over meat.  Mix celery soup and sour cream and pour over top.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Top with Cheddar cheese and bake another 10 minutes.

name: TACO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. taco mix
1/2  c. water
3  tomatoes, diced (may use canned)
1  onion, diced
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, sliced
8  oz. noodles
1 1/2  c. crushed Doritos (nacho cheese flavored)
taco sauce, salsa or green chilies as desired
preparation: Brown beef and onion in skillet.  Add tomatoes, water and taco seasoning.  Stir well and simmer for 10 minutes.  Cook noodles until tender and drain.  In greased 2 1/2-quart casserole dish, layer beef mixture, noodles, cheese, nacho chips and salsa 3 times.  Sprinkle nacho chips on top.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1 (22 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
1 (8 1/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1  box cake mix
1  c. margarine, melted
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can flaked coconut
1  c. nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spoon pie filling evenly into bottom of 9 x 13 pan.  Spread pineapple over cherry pie filling.  Sprinkle dry cake mix over pineapple.  Pour margarine evenly over all. Sprinkle with coconut and nuts.  Bake for 1 hour or until cake is done.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs
3  c. grated, fresh carrots
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine the first 6 ingredients.  Add grated carrots and mix well.  Add nuts and pour into a baking pan.  Bake for 35 minutes. Remove from oven and spread with icing.

name: GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. molasses
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  unbeaten egg
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. shortening, filled to 1 c. with boiling water
preparation: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix thoroughly.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in a greased 9 x 9-inch pan.

name: GRANDMA'S CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (30 oz.)  can chili beans
1  Tbsp. chili powder or less
preparation: Brown meat and onion.  Drain.  Add sauce, beans and chili powder.  Cook slowly for 1 hour.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  boxes strawberry Jell-O or 1 (6 oz.) box
1  c. hot water
1  can whole berry cranberry sauce
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
2  medium sized bananas
1/2  c. ground nuts
1  bag strawberries
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O with  hot  water.  Add	cranberry sauce and pineapple with  juice.  Then  add  remaining  ingredients. Mix well and refrigerate overnight.

name: CHERRY CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
16  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  lb. cottage cheese
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs, slightly beaten
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. butter, melted
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Heat   oven  to  325°.	Grease	spring-form  pan.  With electric mixer,  beat cream cheese and cottage cheese.  Gradually beat in  sugar,  then  eggs.  At low speed, beat in cornstarch, flour, lemon juice and vanilla.  Beat in melted butter and sour cream.

name: SQUASH DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. cooked squash
1  stick margarine
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  can water
2  eggs
1  small skillet cornbread
1  small onion
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix eggs and onions into cornbread before cooking.  Crumble up bread.  Add margarine (melted), soup, water, and cooked squash (drained) to crumbled cornbread.  Add salt and pepper to taste. Bake for 30 minutes at 400°.

name: QUICK CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP
ingredients:
3  c. cooked chicken, diced
3  c. uncooked fine egg noodles
2  Tbsp. instant minced onion
2 1/2  Tbsp. chicken flavored bouillon granules
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. dried whole thyme
1/8  tsp. celery seed
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1  bay leaf
preparation: Combine above ingredients (except chicken) with 8 cups water. Add 1 carrot diced in a Dutch oven or soup pot.  Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes.  Discard bay leaf. Stir in 3 cups cooked chicken; simmer an additional 5 minutes.  Makes 8 servings.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. macaroni, cooked until soft (measure uncooked)
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
6  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
parsley (not necessary, but adds color)
grated carrot (not necessary, but adds color)
preparation: Combine.

name: GRANDMA DELLAR'S PICKLED BEETS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
1  c. cider vinegar
pinch of salt
washed beets
preparation: You will need canning jars, lids and rings for this recipe.

name: OVEN BAKED APPLE PANCAKES WITH SAUSAGE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Brown 'N Serve sausage links
2  Tbsp. melted butter
2/3  c. milk
1  egg, well beaten
1  c. sifted flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. finely chopped apple (more apples makes it more moist, if you like)
preparation: Stir melted butter into blended milk and egg.  Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon.  Add dry ingredients and apple to liquid mixture; beat just enough to mix ingredients.  Pour into an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish (or large cast-iron skillet is good), which has been lightly rubbed or sprayed with oil.  Arrange sausage on top of the batter.  Bake in a very hot oven (450°) for 15 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: Summer Pudding
ingredients:
1  pt. strawberries, hulled and quartered
1  pt. blueberries
1 1/2  pt. raspberries
1/2  pt. blackberries
3/4  c. sugar or to taste
stale white bread, firm textured, thin sliced with crusts trimmed
preparation: You will also need 6 to 8 cup pudding mold or bowl with steep sides.

name: TOLL HOUSE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. butter, melted and cooled
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  (6 oz.) bag chocolate chips
1/2  c. chopped nuts
pie crust
preparation: Melt and cool butter; beat eggs until foamy.  Add sugar, brown sugar and flour.  Mix well.  Blend in cooled butter; fold in chips and nuts.  Pour into crust.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: WASSAIL
ingredients:
3  c. pineapple juice
6  c. apple juice
1  cinnamon stick
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  c. honey
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  oranges
cloves (whole)
