preparation: Stud 3 oranges with whole cloves.  Place in pan with enough water to cover bottom.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.  Meanwhile mix all other ingredients and bring to boil.  Float oranges in Wassail.

name: OLD KENTUCKY NUT CAKE
ingredients:
1/3  c. shortening
1/3  c. butter
2/3  c. sugar
3  eggs
2 2/3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/3  c. walnuts
preparation: Cream  together shortening, butter and sugar.  Add eggs and beat well.  Then add flour, baking powder and salt.  Stir in milk, vanilla and walnuts.  Bake at 350°.

name: CHEESY CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
4  whole chicken breasts
6  to 8 medium potatoes
1  large onion, chopped
5  carrots
1  stick oleo
1 large  can tomatoes
1  large bag frozen whole kernel corn
2  lb. Velveeta cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Boil chicken in 3 quarts water until tender.  Remove chicken from broth.  Debone and skin chicken, cut chicken in bite-size pieces and set aside.  Add all remaining ingredients, except Velveeta, to broth; simmer 2 to 3 hours.  Add chicken and Velveeta.  Let Velveeta melt.  (You can add more water to vegetables to get desired consistency.)

name: BETTER THAN ANYTHING
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick butter or margarine
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix together and put in 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass dish.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.  Let cool!

name: FRESH BLUEBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  pt. fresh blueberries
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Cream the butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, and beat until fluffy.  Add vanilla.  Sift dry ingredients together.  Reserve one cup flour mixture.  Add remaining flour to batter; beat well.  Dredge berries in reserved flour.  Fold gently into batter.  Spoon into greased and floured tube pan.  Bake 1 1/4 hours.

name: HOLIDAY POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
5 to 6  c. leftover mashed potatoes
3 to 4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
3  eggs
1/2  paprika
1/2  c. each red and green pepper
preparation: If potatoes are not seasoned, salt and pepper to taste.  In a bowl, lightly beat egg yolks.  Add melted butter and paprika, beating well. Combine mixture with potatoes, cheese and chopped peppers.  Stir until well blended. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Spoon into buttered 6-cup ring or 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes or until lightly browned.

name: CHOCOLATE BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. bread (white), broken up
1/3  c. cold water
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  egg
2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Break bread up.  Add water, salt, sugar and cocoa to broken bread.  Beat egg.  Add beaten egg and milk to bread mixture, then add melted butter and vanilla extract.  Bake in moderate oven about 30 minutes or until center is set, not milky.  It seems to take longer, perhaps 45 minutes.  Spread with Hard Sauce.

name: LIGHT BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
2  egg whites
1  c. sugar
1  c. mashed ripe banana
1/4  c. cooking oil
preparation: Stir together flour, baking soda, cinnamon, baking powder and nutmeg.  In a mixing bowl beat together egg whites, sugar and banana.  Add oil and mix well.  Stir flour mixture into banana mixture.  Spray an 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan with nonstick coating. Transfer batter to prepared pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 55 to 60 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted near center comes out clean.  Cool in pan to 10 minutes.  Remove from pan; cool thoroughly on a wire rack.  Makes one loaf.

name: ICEBOX COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
2 1/2  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add egg and beat well.  Add flour gradually while beating the mixture.  Add chopped nuts, then vanilla.  Shape into a loaf.  Let stand in icebox until it can be sliced (couple of hours).  Slice and bake in moderate oven at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange Jell-O
1  large (1 lb. 8 oz.) container cottage cheese
1  can crushed pineapple, drained (2 c.)
1 (9 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: With electric mixer, mix Jell-O and cottage cheese until well mixed.  Add the crushed pineapple and Cool Whip.  Can be eaten right away.  Use as salad or dessert.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. plain flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. Wesson oil
4  eggs, beaten
3  c. finely grated carrots
preparation: Sift together and mix by hand the first 5 ingredients.  Then add remaining ingredients and mix well.

name: BURGUNDY EYE ROUND WITH HORSERADISH SPREAD
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  oven bag
1  (3 to 5 lb.) eye round roast
1/4  tsp. seasoned salt
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. Burgundy wine
preparation: Place tablespoon of flour in oven bag and shake to coat sides. Season meat with seasoned salt, garlic and pepper (season to your liking).  Place roast into oven bag and pour wine over roast.  Tie off bag.  Place bag into baking pan and refrigerate to marinate overnight.  When ready to bake, place slits into bag, about 6, then insert meat thermometer.  Bake at 325° until thermometer reads 140°, about 50 to 60 minutes.  Cool and slice thin.

name: EGGPLANT SANDWICHES WITH GOAT CHEESE AND WALNUTS
ingredients:
4  rounds eggplant (each about 1-inch thick, a total weight of about 3/4 lb.)
salt to taste (if desired)
freshly ground pepper to taste
4  small rounds goat cheese (about 2 oz.)
4  tsp. chopped walnuts (preferably black walnuts)
1/2  c. flour
1  egg, lightly beaten
2  Tbsp. water
1  c. fine fresh bread crumbs
oil (for shallow frying)
Tomato Sauce (see recipe in Sauces section; optional)
Garlic, Oil and Anchovy Sauce (see recipe in Sauces section; optional)
preparation: If desired, trim off and discard the skin of each eggplant round.  Place each round on a flat surface and hold a knife parallel to the surface.  Cut each round in half, splitting each sandwichlike almost but not through to the end.  Leave a small hinge at one end of each round.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

name: HAM AND BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/8  c. butter or margarine
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of celery soup
1  can milk
1  c. American cheese, shredded
3  c. cubed ham
2  c. quick-cooking rice
1/2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Cook frozen broccoli; drain well.  In saucepan, cook onion in butter until tender.  In large bowl, stir together mushroom soup, celery soup, milk and cheese.  Add drained broccoli, onion, ham, uncooked rice and Worcestershire sauce.  Mix well.  Place mixture in 1-quart casserole dish.   Bake covered at 350° until rice is done, 45 to 50 minutes.   Garnish with shredded cheese.

name: BACON-ONION GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. fresh green beans, trimmed
6  bacon strips, diced
1  medium onion, chopped
2  T. cider vinegar
1/4  t. salt
1/8  t. pepper
1  T. sesame seeds, toasted
preparation: Place beans in saucepan, cover with water.  Cook uncovered 8 to 10 minutes until tender.  Cook bacon until crisp.  Drain drippings, reserve 1 T. Sauté onion in drippings until tender. Stir in vinegar and salt and pepper.  Stir in onion mixture and bacon.  Sprinkle with sesame seeds.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: SAUSAGE CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  can Rotel tomatoes
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  lb. cooked Jimmy Dean sausage
preparation: Heat Rotel and soup.  Melt in Velveeta cheese; then add cooked sausage.

name: GUMDROP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
2  c. quick oatmeal
1  c. gumdrops, cut up
preparation: Mix all together.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

name: COOKIE DESSERT
ingredients:
1  large vanilla instant pudding
2  c. buttermilk
1  large pineapple tidbits, drained
1  can Mandarin oranges, drained
1  - 8 oz Cool Whip
1  pkg. Keebler Fudge Shoppe Cookies
preparation: Mix ingredients as listed above.  Stir in crumbled cookies right before serving.

name: ALMOND CHICKEN WITH RICE
ingredients:
3  whole chicken breasts, cut in half
1 (3 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms
salt and pepper
paprika
1/2  c. slivered almonds
1/2  c. margarine or butter
1/2  c. chopped onions
juice of 1 lemon
1/4  c. cooking sherry
1  c. raw rice, cooked
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Place chicken in baking dish and sprinkle with salt, pepper and paprika. Brown almonds in butter. Remove almonds and in the same skillet, sauté onion and drained mushrooms. Add lemon juice, sherry and almonds, stirring well. Spoon over chicken pieces. Cover with foil and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes. Spoon over rice on serving platter and place chicken on top.

name: POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. white syrup
1/3  c. water
3  qt. popped corn
1/4  c. butter or oleo
3/4  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil sugar, syrup, water, butter and salt until it spins a long thread.  Add vanilla.  Pour all over popcorn.  Shape into balls.

name: SWEET DILLS
ingredients:
1  jar sliced dills
sugar
preparation: Drain liquid from dill slices.  Layer pickles.  Then cover with sugar, layer of pickles, then sugar alternately until all pickles are used.   Alternately turn jar over each day until all sugar is dissolved.

name: PINEAPPLE-ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
2  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained
2  c. grated zucchini
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. nuts (walnuts)
preparation: Beat until fluffy the eggs, vanilla, oil and sugar.   Add in order: zucchini, flour, salt, soda, baking powder, pineapple and nuts.  Mix well and bake in two loaf pans that are greased and floured.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: YABBA-DABBA-DOO SQUARES
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter or margarine
3  c. miniature marshmallows
3  c. Post Fruity Pebbles or Cocoa Pebbles cereal
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan, stirring frequently.  Add marshmallows and cereal.  Stir until marshmallows start to melt and stick to cereal.  Remove from heat.  Press mixture firmly into buttered 8-inch square pan.  Chill about 1 hour.   Cut into squares.  Store in cool place.  Makes 16 squares.

name: CHOCOLATE CREAM FUDGE CAKE
ingredients: 1  box Duncan Hines Swiss chocolate cake mix
preparation: Cook 2 layers and let them cool.  Then split them.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2 (11 oz.)  cans mandarin oranges, drained
preparation: Mix all together until well blended (3 minutes).  Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes.  Add topping while still warm.

name: MOCK OYSTER DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  large onion, minced
8  Tbsp. butter
16  oz. roll garlic cheese
1  can mushroom stems and pieces
dash of Tabasco
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Cook broccoli in water.  Saute onion in butter.  Add cream of mushroom soup to onion when it is golden brown.  Add mushrooms and juice.  Break up garlic cheese and add to mixture.  Add broccoli (drained) and Tabasco and mix well.  Serve hot with crackers, chips, French bread or whatever.

name: CONFETTI RICE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. sliced bacon, diced
1  c. long grain rice, cooked
1  c. diced carrots, parboiled
1  c. diced celery, parboiled
1/2  c. fresh or frozen peas
soy sauce (optional)
preparation: In large skillet, cook bacon until crisp.  Remove to paper towels; drain all but 3 tablespoons of the drippings.  Cook rice, carrots, celery and peas in drippings until heated through, about 5 to 7 minutes.  Stir in bacon.  Serve with soy sauce if desired. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: RICE AND BLACK BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6.9 oz.)  pkg. Rice-A-Roni chicken flavor, cooked as directed and cooled
1 (16 oz.)  can black beans, drained and rinsed
1  medium red bell pepper, chopped finely
1  medium green pepper, chopped finely
4  green onions, chopped
1/4  c. minced fresh cilantro
1/3  c. peanut oil
1/4  c. fresh lime juice
salt and pepper
preparation: Combine the first 6 ingredients in large bowl.  Whisk together oil and lime juice in small bowl.  Pour over rice mixture; toss to coat.  Season with salt and pepper.  Line large bowl with lettuce; mound salad in bowl.  Garnish with sliced avocado and papaya and serve.  (Should be made several hours ahead or refrigerated overnight for best flavor.)

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
4  oz. mild taco sauce (can use hot taco sauce)
1  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
diced tomato
sliced black olives
chopped lettuce
Cheddar cheese, shredded
tortilla chips
preparation: Cream together the cream cheese and taco sauce.  Spread in middle of a plate.  On top layer, put other ingredients.  Put tortilla chips on the plate around the salad.  Dip chips into salad.  Enjoy.

name: PORCUPINE MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  egg, beaten
1 (10 oz.)  can tomato soup
1/4  c. long grain rice
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1  Tbsp. parsley
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine egg and 1/4 cup soup.  Stir in uncooked rice, onion, parsley, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.  Add beef and mix well.  Shape into 20 small balls.  Place in a 10-inch skillet.

name: DIVIINTY
ingredients:
5  c. sugar
1  c. light corn syrup
1  c. water
3  egg whites, stiffly beaten
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
1/2  c. chopped black walnuts
preparation: Cook sugar, syrup and water to soft ball stage.  Add half of hot mixture to egg whites and beat until cool.  Let remaining syrup cool until it forms hard ball in cold water.  Add to egg white mixture, and beat until smooth.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Pour into buttered pan; spread 1 inch thick.  Cut into squares.

name: SALMON SPREAD
ingredients:
12  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
1/2  tsp. dried dill
3  oz. smoked salmon, coarsely chopped
4  green onions, thinly sliced or chopped
preparation: In food processor (or by hand), blend cream cheese, mayonnaise, lemon juice and dill until smooth.   Add salmon and green onions and process very briefly just to mix.  The salmon and onion chunks should be visible and the cream cheese mixture still white.  Chill.  Serve with hearty crackers.  Makes approximately 2 cups.

name: EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8 to 10  slices bread
sliced American cheese
1  lb. Bob Evans sausage
6  eggs
3 1/2  c. milk
salt and pepper
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Cover bottom of dish with bread slices.  Lay slice of cheese over each bread slice.  Fry and drain grease from sausage.  Put fried sausage over cheese layer. Mix in bowl the eggs, milk, salt, pepper and dry mustard.  Pour over cheese. Cover with foil and put in refrigerator overnight. Bake the next morning at 350° for 45 minutes, uncovered.  Better served immediately.

name: CHEESY MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. milk
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1 1/2  c. finely cooked, chopped chicken
1/2  tsp. cumin
1/4  tsp. salt
4  oz. can chopped green chiles, drained, reserving 2 Tbsp.  liquid
3  drops hot pepper sauce
tortilla chips
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In medium bowl, combine sour cream, milk and cream cheese.  Beat until smooth.  Stir in chicken, cumin, salt, green chiles and hot sauce.  Spread mixture in 9-inch pie pan.  Bake at 350° for 13 to 15 minutes, or until thoroughly heated.  Arrange chopped tomato around outer edge of chicken mixture, place reserved chiles in center.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD(Makes Two Loaves)
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
2  c. zucchini squash, grated
1  c. nuts
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
3  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Combine ingredients and mix well.  Pour into 2 greased loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for approximately one hour.

name: * HAMBURGER SOUP *
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. vegetable soup
4  medium potatoes
1  can whole tomatoes
1  to 2 whole allspice
salt and pepper to taste
4  c. water
preparation: Bring the 4 cups of water to a boil.  Add all ingredients, except allspice.  Cook until nearly tender, then add allspice. Simmer until vegetables are tender.  Add more water if needed. Serves 4.

name: SHRIMP OVER NOODLES
ingredients:
1  lb. unpeeled medium-size fresh shrimp
vegetable cooking spray
1  c. sliced green onions
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
4  cloves garlic, minced
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1/4  tsp. Creole seasoning
1 (8 oz.)  carton plain yogurt
hot cooked noodles
preparation: Peel and devine shrimp; set aside.  Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray.  Place over medium heat until hot. Add green onions and next 3 ingredients.  Saute until vegetables are tender.  Add shrimp.  Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Stir in soup and seasoning; bring to a boil.  Remove from heat; stir in yogurt (at room temperature) and serve immediately over hot noodles.  Yield:  4 servings.

name: CHICKEN AND DRESSING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts (or any other chicken parts)
1  can mushroom slices
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
1  c. water (from boiled chicken)
1  stick butter, melted
1  pkg. Stove Top (cornbread type)
preparation: Cook chicken in salted water for 45 minutes, then tear in pieces.  Mix soup, sour cream, chicken and mushrooms in casserole dish.  In separate bowl, add butter and water to moisten the dressing.  Sprinkle dressing over casserole ingredients.  Bake one hour at 350° (20 minutes in microwave).

name: FRUIT WALDORF
ingredients:
1  c. diced apples
1  c. crushed pineapple
2  Tbsp. strained honey
1/4  c. nuts
1/3  c. coconut
preparation: Mix ingredients and chill before serving.  Serve on lettuce.

name: MISSISSIPPI MUD COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
1  stick margarine
1  Tbsp. vanilla
3/4  c. peanut butter
3  c. quick oatmeal
preparation: Add sugar and cocoa to saucepan; stir well.  Add milk and mix thoroughly.  Put on stove and boil 1 to 2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Take off stove and add butter, vanilla and peanut butter, then add oatmeal and stir.  Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.  Allow to cool and harden.

name: CHILI CON CARNE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  cans tomato soup
4  cans kidney beans (15 oz.)
2  stalks celery, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
2  carrots, chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
chili powder to taste
garlic (optional)
preparation: In saucepan, fry beef, garlic and onion until brown.  Add all other ingredients and cook at low temperature about 1 hour, stirring occasionally.  Serve with Italian bread or rolls.

name: APRICOTS-STUFFED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
1  c. diced dried apricots
1/2  c. boiling water
1  Tbsp. sugar
4  rib pork chops (cut 1-inch thick)
1/4  c. flour
salt and pepper
2  Tbsp. shortening
3  c. toasted 1/4-inch white bread cubes
1  c. peeled, cored and diced tart apples
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. leaf thyme
1/4  tsp. leaf marjoram
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Combine apricots, water and sugar.  Set aside. Trim chops and coat with flour, seasoned with salt and pepper to taste.  Heat the shortening in a skillet and brown the chops on both sides.  Combine apricot mixture, bread cubes, apples, celery, thyme and marjoram.  Mix lightly and season with salt and pepper.   Place fruit stuffing in bottom of casserole and arrange the browned pork chops on top. Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours or until chops are well done. Yields 4 servings.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
4  small boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (about  1 1/4 lb.)
1  c. Taco Bell Home Originals thick 'n chunky salsa
1 (2.5 oz.)  pkg. Taco Bell Home Originals taco seasoning mix
2  c. each water and Minute white rice (uncooked)
1 (8 oz.)  can Albertson's whole kernel corn, drained
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
olives, chopped (optional)
preparation: Bring chicken, salsa, taco seasoning mix and water to boil in a large skillet; cover. Simmer 10 minutes. Return to boil. Stir in Minute rice. Sprinkle with cheese (and olives, if desired); cover. Cook on low heat 5 minutes. Serves 4.

name: PRIZE WINNING BURRITO BAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Bisquick baking mix
1/4  c. water
1  can (16 oz.) refried beans
1  lb. ground chuck, cooked and drained
1  avocado, sliced, if desired
1  c. thick taco salsa
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Grease  10	x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Mix Bisquick, water  and  beans.  Spread  in pie plate.  Layer remaining  ingredients  on	bean  mixture.	Bake  30  minutes. Serve with sour cream  if  desired.  Takes	10 minutes to prepare!

name: LEFTOVER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked pasta or rice
1  c. leftover meat or fowl
1  can undiluted cream of mushroom soup
1  c. leftover gravy or 1 pkg. instant gravy (follow instructions)
any leftover vegetables (optional)
preparation: Combine all together and heat either on top of stove or pour in baking pan.  Top with bread crumbs or crushed potato chips. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: FRESH VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. dry chives
1  Tbsp. dry parsley
1  tsp. dill weed
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. Accent
2  drops Tabasco
preparation: Serve with carrots, celery, cauliflower, broccoli and radishes.  Best if made one day ahead.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. water
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  can baby green lima beans
1  medium stalk green celery, sliced
2  c. frozen crinkle cut carrots
sprigs of parsley
1  small onion, sliced
1 small  can peas (no salt or sugar), available at Grand Union
1/4  c. raisins
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
grated orange rind
1  Tbsp. oil (cottonseed, corn or soybean)
preparation: In a Corning casserole dish, dilute soup with water and mix. Blend in onion, celery, lima beans and juice, carrots, peas and juice, raisins, parsley, orange rind, paprika, garlic salt and oil.  Cover and simmer on stove top (large burner) for about 15 minutes or until all veggies are cooked.  This recipe serves 4.

name: SUE'S TURKISH GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground meat
2  small chopped tomatoes
1  small onion
salt to taste
pepper to taste
garlic to taste
pinch of sugar
1 large  can green beans or fresh beans
preparation: In large pot, saute meat in butter until it changes color to gray or light brown.  Add onion and leave until they get limp. Add tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes or so.  Add beans and seasonings.  Cook on top of stove until beans are done.  Sprinkle pinch of sugar over top and several pats of butter while beans are cooking.

name: CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. hot sausage
1 large  box Velveeta cheese, cut into chunks
1  (12 oz.) chunky salsa
preparation: Brown sausage in skillet until done.  Put sausage into crock-pot.  Add cheese and salsa.  Stir occasionally until cheese is melted.  Takes approximately 1 hour to prepare.  Serve over tortilla chips.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  medium onion, chopped
1  medium pepper, chopped
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
2  cans mushroom soup
2  cans French onion rings
1  bag wide noodles
preparation: Brown hamburger.  Add onion and green pepper.  Cook 10 minutes.  Add cheese and melt.  Add mushroom soup with 1/2 can milk.  Cook noodles according to package directions and mix together.  Pour into casserole and top with French fried onions. Bake in medium oven for 45 minutes.

name: ORANGE CRUSH POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. vegetable shortening
2  sticks butter
2 3/4  c. sugar
5  eggs
1  c. orange Crush
3  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. orange flavoring
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together shortening, butter and sugar.  Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add orange crush alternately with flour.  Stir in flavorings.  Pour mixture into a greased and floured tube pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until cake tests done.  Let cake cool.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
8  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese
1  medium onion, grated
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Soften cream cheese; mix with Cheddar cheese, then all other ingredients.  When all is well mixed, form into a ball and roll ball in sesame seed.  Ball will be soft.  Put in refrigerator for at least 1 hour.

name: FRESH COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1  can cream of coconut
1  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
1  (8 oz.) bag fresh coconut
preparation: Bake cake as directed on box.  As soon as cake is out of the oven, poke holes all over the cake with handle of a small wooden spoon.  Immediately pour cream of coconut over the cake evenly, then pour Eagle Brand milk over the cake evenly.  Refrigerate until cold.  Spread Cool Whip evenly and sprinkle with fresh coconut.  Keep in refrigerator.  Makes a 9 x 13-inch cake.

name: CRABMEAT MOUSSE
ingredients:
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
3  Tbsp. cold water
1/4  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
2  Tbsp. lime juice
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh or frozen chives
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. fresh lump crabmeat, drained
3/4  c. whipping cream, whipped
2  to 3 limes, thinly sliced
2  avocados, peeled and mashed
2  Tbsp. lime juice
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh or frozen chives
12  wonton wrappers (are available in the supermarket produce section and in Asian markets)
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
salt
24  medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
1/3  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. soy sauce
3/4  tsp. grated fresh ginger
1/2  tsp. Oriental sesame oil
1/4  tsp. red pepper sauce
pinch of sugar
watercress
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Arrange wonton wrappers on cookie sheet. Brush both sides with butter.  Cut each wrapper diagonally into 4 triangles.  Bake 3 minutes.  Turn wrappers over and bake 3 to 4 minutes more until golden.  Cool on wire rack.  (Can be made ahead.  Store in airtight container up to 2 days.)

name: WILTED BACON SALAD
ingredients:
1/3  c. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. cider vinegar
4  slices turkey bacon, cooked and crumbled
7  c. mixed salad greens
preparation: Combine first four ingredients in a small suacepan and bring to a boil.  Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes, stirring until sugar is dissolved.  Place salad greens in a large bowl and pour vinegar mixture over greens, tossing gently.  Serve warm.

name: DIRT DESSERT
ingredients:
2 small  boxes vanilla pudding
1 (12 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
3/4  stick butter
1  pkg. Oreo cookies
4  c. milk
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/3  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Separate Oreo cookies and take middles out.  Crush cookies very fine.  Set aside.  Mix vanilla pudding and milk together; set aside.  Cream butter and cream cheese together; then add powdered sugar.  Take Cool Whip and add to pudding.  Then mix pudding with cream cheese mixture.  Now get a clean flowerpot and start with Oreo cookies, then pudding; continue to layer, ending with Oreo cookies.  You may place a silk flower in pot and wrap stem with aluminum foil.

name: STUFFED MUSHROOMS ITALIANO(Microwave)
ingredients:
12  large fresh mushrooms (5 oz.)
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. diced pepperoni (1 oz.)
2  Tbsp. finely chopped green pepper
1/2 small  clove garlic, minced
1/4  c finely crushed rich round crackers (6 crackers)
4  tsp. grated Parmesan cheese
2  tsp. snipped parsley
1/4  tsp. seasoned salt
1/8  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
dash of pepper
preparation: Wash mushrooms; gently remove stems and finely chop.  Drain caps on paper toweling.  In 1-quart bowl combine butter, chopped stems, 1 onion, pepperoni, green pepper and garlic.  Cook at High for 2 minutes, until tender.  Stir in crumbs, cheese, parsley, salt, oregano and pepper; mix well.  Mound mixture in the mushroom caps.  Place caps in 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish.  Cover and cook at Medium or cook power 5 (50%) for 4 minutes, until hot.  Makes 12 appetizers.

name: BAKED PINEAPPLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
3  eggs, slightly beaten
6  slices bread, cubed
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. melted butter
1 average  can crushed pineapple (do not drain)
preparation: Place mixture in greased baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: BAKED FRENCH FRIES
ingredients:
4  to 6 medium potatoes
1  c. grated American cheese
1  c. cream or half and half
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cut potatoes into French fry strips.  Put potatoes in a shallow pan lined with aluminum foil.  Sprinkle cheese over top. Add cream.  Fold foil over top and seal by pinching together. Bake at 350° for approximately 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

name: MAWMAW'S BOILED CUSTARD(Club Member: Ben Steadman)
ingredients:
1/2  gal. milk
8  eggs
4  Tbsp. flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Heat milk in large double boiler.  While milk is heating, beat 8 eggs.  Add 2 cups sugar and 4 tablespoons flour, already mixed together, to 1 cup of hot milk.  Pour mixture in double boiler with rest of milk.  Cook until thick, constantly stirring.  Add 2 teaspoons vanilla.  Do not let custard boil.  Strain or blend in blender if desired.  Let cool.  Delicious served for dessert or used in recipes calling for custard base.

name: THUMB PRINT PECAN COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/4  c. sugar
1  egg yolk, slightly beaten
1  c. flour
1  egg white, unbeaten
3/4  c. nut meats, cut fine
preparation: Cream butter.  Add sugar gradually and cream until light.  Add egg yolk.  Mix thoroughly and blend in flour.  Form into small balls (about 1-inch in diameter).  Dip into egg white, then into nuts.  Place on greased cookie sheet and press firmly flat with bottom of glass.  Bake in slow oven (300°) for 5 minutes.  Remove from oven and press centers down and bake about 15 minutes.  Cool and fill with a tart jelly or jam.  Makes 15 to 18 cookies.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow squash, sliced
1  large onion, sliced
1  stick margarine
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. grated cheese
salt and pepper to taste
1  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1  c. herb dressing mix
preparation: Cook squash and onion until tender. Drain and mash.  Combine all ingredients except dressing.  Put in buttered casserole. Sprinkle dressing on top.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: COLD CORN SALSA
ingredients:
1  large bag frozen corn, thawed
1  red onion, chopped
1  red or green pepper, chopped
1/2+  c. mint or cilantro
10  Roma tomatoes, chopped
6+  Tbsp. oil
4+  Tbsp. lemon/lime juice
2+  ??? cumin
preparation: Mix together corn, onion, pepper, mint and tomatoes.  Blend in oil, lemon/lime juice and cumin.  Chill overnight.   Stir occasionally.  Add chopped jalapenos for a real Mexican flavor. Fantastic with grilled marinated chicken.

name: HOLIDAY CHOCOLATE TURTLES
ingredients:
1  c. pecan halves
1/2  lb. soft caramels (26 caramels)
2  Tbsp. heavy cream
4  sq. semi-sweet chocolate
preparation: Melt caramels in cream over low heat; cool abut 5 to 10 minutes.  Place nuts on wax paper in groups of three.  Spoon caramel mixture over nuts, leaving tips showing.  Let stand until set (about 1/2 hour).  Meanwhile, melt chocolate over low heat; cool to lukewarm.  Spread cooked chocolate over caramel.  (Can be placed in refrigerator to harden.)  Yield:  Approximately 24.

name: SAUTEED AQUA
ingredients:
1  heating device such as kitchen stove or for modern homes, a microwave oven
1  wooden spoon
1  qt. saucepan or Pyrex bowl for use in microwave
1  qt. tap water
preparation: Place saucepan filled with tap water on heating element of kitchen stove or Pyrex bowl in microwave oven.  Turn heating device on high temperature setting.  As water begins to have turbulence, stir occasionally with wooden spoon.  Be sure to watch carefully as water level will gradually become lower.  Soon after water completely disappears, the saucepan will begin to turn brown.  At this point, you have sauteed aqua, more commonly known as burned water.  This recipe highly recommended for new brides.

name: IMPOSSIBLE FRENCH APPLE PIE
ingredients:
6  c. peeled sliced apples (tart, Granny Smith)
1 1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. Bisquick, divided
2  eggs
5  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. brown sugar (packed)
1/3  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Mix apples, cinnamon and nutmeg in bowl.  Arrange in 10-inch greased Pyrex plate.  Combine sugar, milk, 1/2 cup Bisquick, eggs and 2 tablespoons of butter in blender on high speed for 15 seconds.  Pour over apples.

name: YUCKY BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bacon, sliced or 1/2 lb. cooked ham, sliced
1  large onion, chopped
1 large  can baked beans
1  can kidney beans
1 small  can baby lima beans
1/2  c. ketchup
2/3  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  lb. or more, if desired, cubed sharp cheese
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Fry bacon and onion together or combine ham and onion and heat.  Drain beans.  Then combine all ingredients and place in large baking dish.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: QUICK TEA MIX
ingredients:
1  c. instant tea
1 (26 oz.)  jar instant powdered orange drink
5  oz. presweetened lemonade
1/2  tsp. allspice
3/4  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. red hot candies
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Use 1 teaspoon spiced mix per cup. Add boiling water.

name: BAKING POWDER BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. vegetable shortening or butter
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Grease two 8-inch cake pans.  Put the flour, salt, baking powder and sugar in a bowl.  Cut the shortening into the flour with two knives or a pastry blender until the mixture resembles coarse meal.  Add the milk, all at once, and stir just until the dough forms a ball around the fork.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
4 1/2  oz. can fine shrimp
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  small onion, finely chopped
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. milk
pinch of garlic salt
pinch of pepper
preparation: Using a wire whisk, mix all ingredients until shrimp are shredded.  Chill.  Serve with choice of crackers and potato chips.

name: ORANGE OR LEMON SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. orange or lemon jello
2  c. boiling water
1  c. juice from pineapple or apricots
1 (No. 2)  can apricots, cut and drained
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple, drained
3/4  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. pecans
1  small container Cool Whip
preparation: Mix orange or lemon jello, boiling water, juice from pineapple or apricots, apricots and pineapple.  Let set until syrupy, uncovered.  Whip cottage cheese and Cool Whip.  Add to previous mixture.  Fold in pecans; cover and refrigerate.

name: ICE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  chocolate flavored Ready-Crust pie crust
1  qt. vanilla ice cream, softened (any flavor)
chocolate fudge topping to taste
caramel topping to taste
1  large Heath candy bar, broken up small
1  container Cool Whip
preparation: Allow ice cream to soften.  Stir in pie crust.  Add fudge and caramel topping.  Swirl it around, then add candy bar pieces, then Cool Whip.  You can decorate with pecan pieces and cherries. Freeze.

name: HAM DELIGHTS(Yield:  36 Rolls)
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. Cure 81 ham or similar cooked ham
3/4  lb. Swiss cheese
1  medium onion, quartered
2  sticks margarine, softened
3  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2  Tbsp. poppy seed
3  pkg. party rolls (Pepperidge Farm party or finger rolls)
preparation: Using steel blade  of  food processor, chop ham finely. Remove to bowl,  chop  cheese  finely  and set aside.  Combine finely chopped  onion,  margarine,  mustard and Worcestershire sauce. Process.  Add poppy seed and process.  Split the whole package of rolls as  one large roll.  Spread both insides with onion mixture. Sprinkle ham  and cheese on one side of rolls. Put rolls together in original container and cut out individual rolls.  May  return to	original  plastic  bag,  cover and freeze.  When ready to serve,  preheat  oven to 375° and heat rolls for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve hot.

name: CHICKEN ROTEL
ingredients:
8  oz. cooked chicken
1/2  c. bell pepper, chopped
1/2  can Ro-Tel tomatoes, mashed
4  oz. Velveeta cheese, chopped
1  c. English peas
1  c. mushrooms
1  small onion, chopped
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. cooked vermicelli
preparation: Saute onion and pepper in Pam.  Add tomatoes and Worcestershire sauce.  Simmer for 4 minutes.  Add cheese; stir until melted.  Add chicken, mushrooms and peas.  Mix.  Add vermicelli, salt and pepper to taste.  Put in Pam sprayed casserole and heat at 350° until bubbly.

name: Mandarin Orange Cake
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
4  eggs
1/2  c. salad oil
1 small  can mandarin oranges
preparation: Place all ingredients in a mixing bowl and beat with electric mixer for two minutes.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan or two 8-inch round pans, according to package directions.

name: CHERRY OR BLUEBERRY CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 medium sized  can blueberry or cherry pie filling
1  can sweetened condensed milk
3  or 4 fresh lemons or bottled lemon juice
1  box graham cracker crumbs
1 to 2  sticks butter
preparation: Put your cream cheese and condensed milk into a medium sized bowl and mix together well.  Squeeze lemons and add juice or about 1/2 cup of bottled lemon juice.  Beat well.  Melt the butter and pour into a pie plate. Then put your graham cracker crumbs in after the butter.  Mix that together to form your crust.  Pour cream cheese mixture in next.  Let that chill for about 15 to 20 minutes until firm.   Then put your blueberry or cherry pie filling on top and chill until time to serve.

name: CHEESY BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  c. water
3  c. medium egg noodles (uncooked)
3/4  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Brown meat in skillet. Drain. Stir in water. Bring to a boil. Stir in noodles. Reduce heat to medium-low. Cover. Simmer 8 minutes or until noodles are tender. Add Velveeta, soup and pepper. Stir until Velveeta is melted. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: HEAVENLY HASH
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can mandarin oranges
1 (20 oz.)  can chunk pineapple
1 1/2  c. coconut flakes
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Drain pineapple and oranges well.  Mix the sour cream, marshmallows and coconut together.  Add the fruit and mix gently. Chill 12 to 24 hours before serving.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE (LOW-FAT)
ingredients:
1  baked pie crust
1  pt. washed and sliced blueberries
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. sugar
1 small  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1  c. hot water
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.  Add cornstarch and sugar and boil until thick.  Let gel for a few minutes in the refrigerator. Add strawberries and pour into crust.  Chill in the refrigerator. Serve with whipped topping, vanilla ice cream or yogurt.

name: THE "NOW FAMOUS" CHEESE RING
ingredients:
1  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1  c. chopped pecans
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  medium onion, grated
1  clove garlic, pressed
1/2  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1  c. strawberry preserves
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except preserves, and mix well. Chill.   Mold into ring.  Fill with strawberry preserves.  Serve with crackers.

name: CORN SUPREME
ingredients:
1  can cream-style corn
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1 (2 oz.)  jar pimento
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix all together.  Pour into a buttered casserole dish.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.  Double for a crowd.

name: JEZEBEL SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (18 oz.)  jar apple jelly
1 (18 oz.)  jar pineapple jelly or peach-pineapple or apricot-pineapple
2  tsp. prepared horseradish
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. ground white pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and keep covered in refrigerator.  Serve with ham or for an appetizer, spoon over cube of cream cheese and serve with crackers.

name: COCOA ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. cocoa
3  c. powdered sugar
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix cocoa and powdered sugar well.  Add sweetened milk and vanilla; mix well.  Add pecans and mix together by hand.  Dust your hands in 2 tablespoons cocoa and 2 tablespoons powdered sugar to keep mixture from sticking to hands.  Roll the mixture into balls and roll balls in bowl of 2 tablespoons cocoa and 2 tablespoons powdered sugar.

name: BAKED EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. sugar
1 3/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Scald milk and cool slightly. Combine beaten eggs and sugar. Stir in vanilla.  Pour in baking dish and bake at 350° for about 1 hour or until knife inserted comes out clean.

name: OPOSSUM PIE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick margarine
1  c. pecans, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2 to 2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
1  pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
1  pkg. chocolate instant pudding mix
3  c. milk
preparation: Melt margarine and mix with flour and pecans.  Press on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes and let cool.  For filling, mix next 3 ingredients until creamy and spread over cooled crust.  Mix vanilla pudding with 1 1/2 cups of milk and spread over cheese filling.  Mix chocolate pudding with remaining milk and spread over the vanilla pudding.  Spread top with remaining Cool Whip.  Shave Hershey bar on top, if desired.

name: BROCCOLI-CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  container cherry tomatoes
1  head broccoli, cut up
1  head cauliflower, cut up
3  to 4 carrots, peeled and sliced
1 to 2  bunches green onions
1  c. fat-free sour cream
1  c. fat-free mayonnaise or Miracle Whip
1  pkg. lite Italian dressing
preparation: Combine sour cream, mayonnaise and dressing.  Pour over vegetables and mix.  Best to set 3 to 4 hours in refrigerator. Very low in fat grams.

name: RUSSIAN TEA CAKES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
2 1/4  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. finely chopped nuts
preparation: Mix in order given.  Form 1-inch balls.  Bake 14 to 17 minutes in 400° oven.  While hot, roll in confectioners sugar.  Cool. Roll in sugar again.

name: FRANCES' SWEET POTATO DELIGHT
ingredients:
2  c. mashed sweet potatoes, cooked
1/2  c. canned milk
1/3  stick melted oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Mix together and pour into greased baking dish.

name: BLUEBERRY JELLO(Great For July 4th)
ingredients:
3  oz. pkg. black raspberry Jell-O
1  can blueberries and juice
1  c. hot water
1  pkg. Knox gelatine
1/2  c. cold water
1  c. half and half
1  c. sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
6  oz. pkg. red raspberry Jell-O
2  c. hot water
2  c. cold water
preparation: First Layer:  Dissolve black raspberry Jell-O in 1 cup hot water.  Add blueberries and juice.  Gel.

name: HOMEMADE ORANGE SHERBET
ingredients:
1 medium  can crushed pineapple
1  can Eagle Brand milk
6  bottles Orange Crush
preparation: Mix together and freeze.

name: "HOT" WINGS SAUCE
ingredients:
24  oz. Durkee hot sauce
2  sticks butter (1 stick for hotter wings, more for mild wings)
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  Tbsp. oregano
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. Tabasco sauce
1  Tbsp. cayenne pepper
1  Tbsp. red pepper flakes
2  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: Combine hot sauce and butter until butter is melted.  Add other ingredients.  Bring all to simmer.  Dip fried chicken wings.

name: LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, shredded
1  head cauliflower, broken in flowerets
1  pkg. frozen green peas, thawed
4  green onions, chopped
5  slices bacon, fried crisp and broken into pieces, or bacon bits
5  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
2  c. grated cheese
preparation: In a bowl, layer lettuce, cauliflower, green peas, green onions, bacon, eggs and cheese.  Spread with topping as though icing a cake.  Let set overnight; toss before serving.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 whole  pkg. frozen tortillas
2  cans enchilada sauce
1  can green chilies
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  lb. ground beef
preparation: Break tortillas into small pieces in the bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Brown the ground beef; mix all the ingredients together except the cheese and pour it over the tortillas.  Sprinkle cheese on top of meat mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BARBECUED TROUT
ingredients:
trout
Ranch dressing
preparation: Fill inside of trout with Ranch dressing.  Marinate for 10 to 15 minutes.  Place on barbecue about 5 minutes on each side.

name: SWEDISH NUT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
2  c. sugar
2  eggs, slightly beaten
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
20  oz. can crushed pineapple (juice and all)
preparation: Put all  into  a  large  bowl.	Mix  well with a spoon. Pour into  a  greased  and  floured 10 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: PENNY PUFFS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. butter
pinch of salt
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese (8 oz. pkg.)
preparation: Mix all together.  Make into small round balls.  Can punch down with fork.  Bake at 425° until they begin to brown.  Watch carefully.  If desired, a touch of paprika or Tabasco can be added.

name: CREAMED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  chicken
flour
butter
salt
pinch of nutmeg
1/4  c. cream
1  beaten egg yolk
preparation: This recipe was served over noodles with applesauce on the side.

name: HOT HAM AND CHEESE SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. mustard
1/2  c. dried onions
2  Tbsp. poppy seed
8  large buns or rolls
8  slices Swiss cheese
8  slices ham
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients; spread on buns. Add ham and cheese on each bun. Wrap in foil. Heat at 350° for 5 minutes. Can be frozen. Place directly from freezer into oven at 400° for about 30 minutes.

name: CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. sugar
1  large cauliflower, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1  lb. bacon, fried and chopped
1  c. Colby cheese, grated
preparation: Combine mayonnaise and sugar.  Mix together cauliflower, onion, green pepper, bacon and cheese.  Add mayonnaise mixture and refrigerate.

name: PASTA PESTO WITH VEGETABLES
ingredients:
4  cloves garlic
1/2  onion, diced
1/2  bunch broccoli flowerets
1  c. spinach
1  lb. thin spaghetti
olive oil
1  can whole tomatoes
3  carrots, sliced
3  Tbsp. chopped fresh basil
1/4  c. walnuts
preparation: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Saute broccoli and carrots in olive oil 2 minutes; add onions and garlic.  Saute for 1 minute.  Add remaining ingredients; saute is al dente.  Toss with cooked pasta and Parmesan cheese.

name: GRANDMA'S FRUIT CRUNCH
ingredients:
1 medium  can crushed pineapple
1  can cherry pie filling
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1 small  pkg. coconut
1  pkg. slivered almonds
1/4  lb. butter, melted
preparation: Into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan, put can of crushed pineapple.  Add can of cherry pie filling.  Spread over pineapple. Pour package of dry cake mix over fruit, breaking up lumps with a fork.  Sprinkle with coconut, then sprinkle almonds over all. Dribble melted butter over top.   Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serve hot or cold.

name: POTATOES AND SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
potatoes
1  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese
1 to 2  lb. sausage (mild)
1/2  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.    Peel the potatoes (enough to fill a 13 x 9-inch casserole bowl) and slice as thin as possible.   Grate the cheese.   Brown the sausage.  Alternate the layers of each, beginning with a layer of potato slices, then sausage and then cheese.    Add the milk, salt and pepper.   Bake in preheated 350° oven.   You may have to cover with foil.   For softer potatoes you may want to boil them for a few minutes before putting them in the casserole bowl.

name: BANANA SPLIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  c. water
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon gelatin
8  large marshmallows
2  bananas, sliced
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. sugar
5  tsp. all-purpose flour
dash of salt
1  egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  c. heavy cream, whipped
1/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/2 cup of juice; set aside.  In a saucepan, bring water to a boil; remove from heat.  Add gelatin and marshmallows.  Stir until dissolved.  Chill until partially set.  Toss bananas with lemon juice; fold bananas and pineapple into gelatin.  Pour into 8-inch square dish.  Chill until firm.

name: KNIGHTS IN SHINING ARMOUR(Method:  Foil Packet)
ingredients:
1  large onion
1  pkg. dry gravy mix
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
1  lb. hamburger
1 (16 oz.)  can sliced white potatoes
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Slice large onion.  Drain liquid from potatoes; set aside. Shape hamburger into four 1/4-pound patties.  With shiny side of foil face up, place a hamburger patty, 1 to 2 slices of onion, 1 teaspoon of dry gravy mix, 1/3 cup sliced potatoes, 1/3 cup mixed vegetables and 1 to 2 tablespoons of the potato liquid.  Wrap, using the drugstore wrap method.  Place on coals for 10 to 15 minutes per side.

name: BARBECUE BURGER
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  tsp. onion salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/4  c. onion soup mix
1  Tbsp. barbecue sauce
preparation: In a large bowl, mix ground beef, onion, salt, pepper and onion soup until thoroughly mixed.  Add sauce and mix well. Shape ingredients in several large patties.  Place patties into a cold large skillet.  Cook at low temperature.  Cover with lid when patties begin to sizzle and are lightly brown on underside.  Cook until done.

name: Easy Carrot Cake
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1 1/4  c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
4  eggs
1/4  c. cold water
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. finely shredded carrots
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
Cream Cheese Frosting
preparation: Combine cake mix, salad dressing, eggs, water and cinnamon, mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended.  Stir in carrots and walnuts.  Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until when pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool.  Spread with frosting.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2  c. sifted flour
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
2  c. coarsely grated zucchini, loosely packed
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In a bowl, beat eggs until fluffy.  Beat in sugar, oil and vanilla until it is thick and lemon colored.  Add rest of ingredients and pour into 2 loaf pans and bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.  Invert on rack and let cool completely.

name: BARBARA'S SUGARLESS APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. unsweetened apple juice
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
8  c. sliced, peeled apples
1/2  c. raisins
1  recipe 2-crust pie pastry
butter
preparation: Combine lemon juice, apple juice, flour and cinnamon in a bowl. Mix with apples and raisins in a large bowl.  Line 10-inch pie plate with half the pastry.  Fill with apple mixture; dot with butter.  Cover with top crust; cut vents.  Bake at 425° for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown.

name: RYE BOAT DIP
ingredients:
1  (6 oz.) sour cream
1/3  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
2  Tbsp. dill weed
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  jar Hormel dried beef, chop in food processor
preparation: Mix and  chill.  Make a boat out of a loaf of rye bread and fill with dip.  Use rye bread to dip with.

name: MEAT LOAF (BLENDER)
ingredients:
3/4  c. milk
onion
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  eggs
2  slices bread
1  tsp. oregano
2  lb. ground beef
preparation: Tear bread in pieces.  Place milk, eggs, bread, onion, salt, oregano and pepper in blender.  Blend until combined.   In large mixing bowl, place ground beef and mixture and mix well.  Pat meat into loaf; place in pan and cover with catsup.  Add little water at sides of pan.  Bak eat 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: QUICK RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1  box cake mix (white or yellow)
1/3  c. oil or margarine
1  tsp. vinegar
2  eggs
2 (1 oz.)  bottles red coloring
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Bake in Bundt pan that has been greased well.  Cook at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.  Then cool and frost.

name: CANDIED YAMS
ingredients:
pinch of ginger
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. Karo syrup
1/4  stick butter
pinch of cinnamon
1 large  can sweet potatoes
2  tsp. honey
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Pour over potatoes in shallow pan.  Cook in 350° oven until candied.

name: NACHOS PLUS
ingredients:
16  to 20 plain tortilla chips
1 1/4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
chopped olives
cooked bacon pieces
sliced green onion
sour cream or taco sauce
preparation: Put tortilla chips on a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.  Make sure they don't overlap.  Sprinkle cheese over chips.  Sprinkle the olives, bacon pieces and green onion.  Bake in a 400° oven for 2 to 3 minutes, or until cheese is melted.  Transfer to a serving platter.  Serve with sour cream or taco sauce.  Makes 2 servings.

name: SPICED TEA
ingredients:
1  jar Tang (1 lb. 2 oz.)
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. instant tea
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Mix together.  Use 2 teaspoons tea per cup hot water.

name: CHOCOLATE MAYONNAISE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. cold water
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sifted flour
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. unsweetened cocoa
1 1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Beat together first 3 ingredients.  Add dry ingredients and mix well.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Makes 2 layers or loaf cake.  Grease and flour pans.

name: OLD-FASHION TRIPLE FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box devil's food cake mix
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. chocolate chips
1  c. fudge ice cream topping
preparation: Mix cake mix as directed on box.  Stir in nuts.  Spread batter in greased and floured rectangular pan.  Sprinkle chocolate chips evenly over batter and bake as directed on cake mix box. Immediately after baking, poke deep holes through top of cake (still in pan) with meat fork.  Space holes about 1-inch apart. Spread fudge topping evenly over cake.  Serve when completely cool, topped with ice cream or whipped topping.

name: BUTTERMILK COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs
1/4  stick margarine
1  can coconut
1/4  c. buttermilk
preparation: Cream sugar and butter together. Add eggs, buttermilk and coconut. Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour or until golden brown.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
30  tomatoes
2  large onions
1  green pepper and 1 red pepper
2  cloves garlic, minced
3  Tbsp. salt
1/2  c. vinegar
1/4  c. sugar
2 (12 oz.)  cans tomato paste
5  jalapeno peppers (take seeds out)
8  to 10 roasted Anaheim chilies (take seeds out and peel skin off)
preparation: Cut tomatoes, onions and peppers into what size you want for chunkiness. Mix all together and boil for 15 minutes. You then need to do a tomato bath (like canning tomatoes) and boil with lids for another 30 minutes. This makes 12 pints.

name: CHEESE RING
ingredients:
1  lb. medium cheese, grated
1  onion, grated
1  c. pecans, chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
dash of black or cayenne pepper
strawberry preserves
preparation: Mix all ingredients except strawberry preserves.  Spray ring mold with Pam. Place in mold and refrigerate until firm.  Fill center with preserves and serve with crackers.

name: CURRIED CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts, shredded
1  c. white rice
6  green onions, chopped
curry powder to taste
salt to taste
1  green pepper, chopped
preparation: Cook chicken breasts until done.  Reserve broth.  Shred chicken breasts and put back in broth.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 2 to 3 hours.  (The longer it cooks, the better it is.)  Serves 4 or more.  Start temperature at high and then lower to low heat.  Cooking time is 3 hours (slow).

name: FRIED VEGGIES
ingredients:
1  large yellow squash
4  medium potatoes
1  large bell pepper
1  medium onion
2  c. cut up okra
preparation: Cut up all your vegetables in bite size pieces.  Flour the squash and okra.  Put all the veggies in a skillet of hot oil and fry until tender.  Salt and pepper to taste.

name: HAM BALLS
ingredients:
1  ham loaf
2  eggs
dash of pepper
1  c. cracker crumbs
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix together and form into balls.

name: APRICOT ORANGE MOLD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1 1/2  c. apricot juice
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. whipping cream
1  can mandarin oranges
preparation: Measure juice and add water to make 2 cups.  Boil juice and pour over Jell-O.  Cool in refrigerator until thickened.  Beat the cream cheese into gelatin.  Whip the cream and fold into gelatin. Arrange oranges in mold and pour gelatin mixture over them or just mix oranges in.  Refrigerate until thickened.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: RAISIN POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  c. applesauce
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. vegetable oil
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/4  tsp. ground allspice
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: In a mixing bowl, combine dry cake mix, applesauce, water, oil, eggs, cinnamon, nutmeg and allspice. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes. Stir in raisins. Pour into two greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool 5 to 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire rack.

name: SUGARED DATE SQUARES
ingredients:
3/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
3/4  c. margarine or butter
8  oz. chopped dates
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. Rice Krispies
1  c. chopped dates
1  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Grease an 8 or 9-inch square pan.  In a large saucepan, combine brown sugar, margarine and dates.  Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently until mixture is smooth, about 5 minutes. Stir in vanilla, cereal and nuts.  Spread in prepared pan.  Cool completely.  Cut cooled bars into 1-inch squares.  Coat all sides with powdered sugar.  Makes 5 to 6 dozen.

name: COMPANY POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  c. cooked cubed peeled potatoes
1 1/2  c. (12 oz.) sour cream
1 1/4  c. shredded Swiss cheese, divided
1/2  c. shredded carrot
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
1  tsp. salt (optional)
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. paprika
preparation: In a large bowl, combine the potatoes, sour cream, 1 c. cheese, carrot, onion, parsley, salt, dill, and pepper. Transfer to a greased 8 inch square baking dish. Sprinkle with the paprika and remaining cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25-35 minutes or until bubbly.

name: BLUEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  boxes grape Jell-O
2  c. boiling water
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  can blueberry pie filling
preparation: Mix all of the ingredients and let jell.

name: BAKED NOODLES AND HAM
ingredients:
4  c. boiled noodles
1  c. ham
2/3  c. grated cheese
2  c. thin white sauce
preparation: Put a layer of noodles in a greased baking dish.  Sprinkle with ham and cheese, then cover with a layer of white sauce. Repeat until all ingredients are used.  Sprinkle top with cheese. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

name: CHICKEN WITH MUSHROOMS AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. seasoned dried bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. minced parsley
1/2  c. shredded part-skim milk Mozzarella cheese
1 1/2  tsp. cornstarch
4  boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
1/2  tsp. paprika
1 1/2  tsp. chicken flavor instant bouillon
1/2  lb. mushrooms, sliced
preparation: In 12 x 8-inch baking dish, melt butter in microwave on High for 45 seconds or until melted.  Dip chicken breast halves in butter; coat with mixture of bread crumbs, parsley and paprika.  In same dish, cook chicken, covered, on high 7 to 9 minutes until tender, rotating dish once.  Top each chicken breast with some cheese.  Cover tightly; set aside.

name: CINNAMON FLOUR TORTILLAS
ingredients:
5  lb. flour (self-rising)
2  c. cinnamon powder
2  c. sugar
2  c. cooking oil
preparation: When making tortillas, follow instructions on the package of flour.  Roll tortilla dough thin (round). Using a large deep frying pan, pour the cooking oil into pan and heat cooking oil to a boil on low fire.  Put flat rolled out tortilla into the hot cooking oil slowly until it has a nice brown color and with tongs, flip the tortilla.

name: CHICKEN JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
1/3  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
2/3  c. long grain rice
1  tsp. dried basil or thyme
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. bottled hot pepper sauce
1  bay leaf
2  c. cubed, cooked chicken or turkey
preparation: In a large skillet, cook onion, celery and green pepper in margarine or butter until tender.  Stir in undrained tomatoes, chicken broth, rice, basil or thyme, garlic salt or pepper, hot pepper sauce and bay leaf.  Bring to a boil.   Reduce heat; cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until rice is tender.  Stir in chicken or turkey.  Cook until heated through.  Discard bay leaf.

name: INDIAN SUMMER SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange Jell-O
2  c. boiling water
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in water; add orange juice, pineapple and oranges.  Pour into a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Chill until firm.

name: CREAM PUFF CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. water
1  stick oleo
1  c. flour
4  eggs
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
3  c. milk
3 (3 oz.)  boxes instant pudding
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
preparation: Bring the water and oleo to a boil and melt oleo. Add the flour. Stir until mixture leaves side of pan and forms a soft ball. Cool slightly. Add the eggs, one at a time, and mix well. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan (greased), over bottom and sides. Bake 35 minutes at 400°. Cool. This crust will raise up different places; don't disturb it.  Mix together the cream cheese, milk and pudding.  Spread on cake.  Spread the Cool Whip over the pudding.

name: FARINA DUMPLINGS(For Soup)
ingredients:
2  qt. broth
1/3  c. plus 1 Tbsp. farina
1  c. milk
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. parsley (dried)
1  tsp. chives (optional)
preparation: Bring milk and salt to a rolling boil.  Briskly stir in the farina. Continue to stir until batter comes loose from sides of pot.  Remove from heat.  Beat in the eggs, one at a time.  Add parsley. Bring broth to rolling boil. With tablespoon, cut the mixture and immerse into the boiling broth. Reduce heat.  Slowly cook the dumplings for about 15 minutes, partly covered.

name: CRANBERRY BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can jellied cranberry sauce
2/3  c. chili sauce
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: In saucepan, break cranberry sauce up with fork.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Cook over low heat until smooth and blended.  Good on grill.  Makes 2 cups.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. rice
1  c. mayonnaise
2  c. chopped celery
4  green onions, chopped
1  small head cauliflower
1 large  can Swanson Premium white chicken
salt
pepper
preparation: Cook rice (Minute rice will do).  Stir in mayonnaise, celery, green onions and cauliflower (flowerets broken into small pieces), then stir in chicken and salt and pepper to taste.  Chill before serving.  May need to add a little more mayonnaise if it appears too dry.

name: EARTHQUAKE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 1/2  c. shredded coconut
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan or Bundt pan, combine pecans and coconut in bottom of pan.  Prepare cake mix according to box directions and pour over pecans and coconut.  Melt butter and cream cheese together, stir in powdered sugar and pour over batter.  Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour or until done.  Let cool and remove from pan.

name: BARBECUE POTATOES
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. magarine, melted
1  Tbsp. honey
2  tsp. chili powder
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. black pepper
3  medium baking potatoes
preparation: Slice potatoes into 1/2-inch slices.  Don't peel potatoes. Combine the first 5 ingredients; mix well.  Add to sliced potatoes and toss to coat real good.  Spread lightly on a greased 10 x 15-inch baking dish and bake at 425°  for 20 minutes.

name: HOLIDAY AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1  can chunk pineapple
1  can mandarin oranges
1 1/2  c. seedless grapes, sliced
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. flaked coconut
1/2  c. chopped pecans
3/4  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Drain pineapple and oranges. Combine pineapple, oranges, grapes, marshmallows, coconut and pecans. Mix sour cream and sugar. Stir into fruit mixture. Chill.

name: BLUEBARB PIE(Or variation of peach, apple, strawberry.)
ingredients:
1  double pie crust
3  c. 1/2-inch rhubarb pieces
2  c. blueberries
1/4  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. butter
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Roll out the bottom crust and fit into a 10-inch pie pan.  Mix together the fruit, sugar and flour.  Pour this mixture into the crust and dot with butter.  Roll out the top crust and place it over the fruit. Crimp edges. Cut a few steam vents with a knife or fork.  Brush the crust with beaten egg and bake pie for 20 to 25 minutes at 400°.  Turn oven down to 350° and continue baking for 20 minutes or more.  Remove pie from oven and allow to cool.

name: FRUIT DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  angel food cake mix
2  c. Cool Whip, thawed
1  c. milk
2  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
2  cans pie mix any kind or fresh fruit
preparation: Prepare angel cake as directed.  Cool and slice in 1/4-inch slices.  Put layer in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan.

name: BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen cut broccoli
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
4  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
1 (2.8 oz.)  can French fried onions
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook broccoli; drain and set aside.  In skillet, saute onion in butter until tender.  Stir in soup, mustard and salt.  Heat until bubbly.  In a 1 1/2-quart casserole, arrange half of broccoli.  Top with 1/2 of the eggs, 1/2 of cheese and 1/2 of the mushroom sauce.  Repeat layers.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°. Sprinkle onions on top and bake 5 minutes more.  Put a few egg slices on top.  Makes 6 servings.

name: BASIC CREAM CHEESE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. half and half
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  rennet tablet
2 1/2  c. cream
2  Tbsp. buttermilk
preparation: Combine creams and sugar and scald.   Cool to lukewarm. Dissolve rennet in 1 tablespoon water and stir into cream mixture. Add the buttermilk.   Pour into a large, glass bowl; set in cool (not the fridge) place for 4 to 5 hours until set.   Line colander with cheesecloth or muslin.  Spoon in the cream mixture, tie the ends together and hang over the sink or bowl to drain at least 2 days.   Turn out into a bowl, place in containers and refrigerate.

name: PIZZA SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
2  cans chopped olives
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. Italian seasoning
2  pkg. hoagie rolls
8 to 10  slices Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Mix the first 5 ingredients together.  Spread on rolls.  Bake at 400° on cookie sheet for about 15 minutes, or until meat is cooked.  Remove from oven.  Place Mozzarella cheese on top.  Put back in oven until cheese is melted.

name: PISTACHIO AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) Cool Whip non-dairy topping
1 (16 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans or walnuts
1 small  box pistachio pudding
preparation: Combine both cans of pineapple in a large bowl, including undiluted liquid.  Sprinkle pudding on top and do not mix.  Let sit for 3 minutes.  Fold in Cool Whip, coconut and nuts.  Pour into graham cracker pie crust and refrigerate for 3 hours.

name: AMARETTO CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sliced almonds or pecans
1  yellow cake mix
1 small  box vanilla pudding mix
3  eggs
1/3  c. oil
1/4  c. Amaretto
3/4  c. orange juice
1 1/2  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Spread almonds on baking sheet and bake 8 to 10 minutes at 325°.  Remove and set aside.  Grease and flour a Bundt pan. Sprinkle 1/2 cup almonds in bottom of pan.  In mixing bowl combine cake mix, pudding mix, eggs, oil, Amaretto, orange juice and almond extract.  Beat until fluffy.  Fold in remaining ingredients.  Pour into pan and bake 1 hour at 325° or until tested done.

name: ZEBRA BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cream
1  c. Crisco
pinch of salt
4  eggs
1/2  c. evaporated milk
2  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  egg
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts (optional)
1  bag chocolate chips (optional)
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together first 4 ingredients and then add eggs, 1/2 milk, flour, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla, nuts and chips.  Pour 1/2 of brownie mix into greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Pour mixture of cream cheese, 1 egg, 1/4 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla, then spoon on remaining brownie batter.  Marble by pulling knife through butter in wide curves; turn pan and repeat.  Bake in preheated oven at 350°.  Do not overbake!

name: DEEP-DISH PIZZA
ingredients:
1  lb. loaf frozen bread dough
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1/3  c. grated cheese (Parmesan)
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese slices
preparation: On lightly floured surface, allow dough to stand at room temperature for 1 hour.  Brown meat and drain.  Add onion, cook until tender.  Stir in tomatoes, paste, Parmesan cheese and your seasonings.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Roll out dough to 15 x 11-inch and press onto bottom and sides of greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Layer cheese, meat sauce and your choice of pizza toppings, alternately. Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

name: CROCK POT CANDY
ingredients:
2  pkg. white bark
1  pkg. (12 oz.) chocolate chips
1  bar German chocolate
1  (16 oz.) salted nuts (peanuts are good)
1  (16 oz.) unsalted nuts
preparation: Put nuts in bottom of crock pot.  Layer other ingredients. Cook on low 1 hour without stirring.  After 1 hour stir well. Cook on low another hour.  Add 2 tsp. vanilla.  Drop on wax paper.

name: CAULIFLOWER SOUP
ingredients:
2  c. water
1  head cauliflower
1  onion, sliced
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. chicken bouillon (instant, not cubed)
1/2  tsp. celery salt
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. half and half
preparation: Bring two cups of water to a boil and place cauliflower, broken into flowerets, and onion in water and cook until tender. Place (including water) into blender and blend until smooth.  Set aside.  Mix butter and flour and mix in 1 cup water gradually. Heat until it starts to boil.  Stir in blender mix and rest of ingredients, except cream.  Heat until it just boils and add cream.  Heat to serving temperature.

name: FAT-FREE BROWNIE OAT COOKIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. flour
2/3  c. sugar
1  c. quick oats
1/3  c. unsweetened cocoa
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  egg whites
1/3  c. light Karo syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Spray cookie sheets with cooking spray.  In a large bowl, combine dry ingredients.  Add egg whites, corn syrup and vanilla. Stir just until dry mixture is moistened.  Batter will be thick. Bake in a 350° oven for 10 minutes or until set.  Cool 5 minutes on cookie sheet.  Remove.  Cool on wire rack.  Makes about 2 dozen cookies.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage meat
1  small onion, chopped
1  small bell pepper, chopped
1  stalk celery, chopped
2  envelopes chicken noodle soup mix
1/2  c. rice (uncooked)
4 1/2  c. water
preparation: Saute sausage, onion, pepper and celery in skillet until meat is brown and vegetables are tender.  Drain well.  Bring water to boil.  Add soup mix and rice.  Boil for 10 minutes.  Combine sausage mixture and soup mixture in casserole dish.  Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: CABBAGE MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. lean ground beef
1  egg
1/2 to 3/4  c. grated cabbage
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. catsup
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Bake at 350° as you would for any meat loaf.  Time depends on thickness of loaf.  Drain juice off as it bakes.  Cabbage will produce extra liquid.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, melted
32  oz. pkg. thawed hash brown potatoes
1 (16 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, cubed
1  can cream of chicken soup
3  Tbsp. diced onions
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Bake, uncovered, 1 1/2 hours at 350°, in 9 x 13-inch greased casserole dish.

name: KAY'S JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  boxes jello (1 cherry and 1 orange)
1 (6 oz.)  can orange juice
2  c. boiling water
1  (20 oz.) crushed pineapple and juice
2  apples, cut up
1  c. pecan pieces
1  can jelled cranberries
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add orange juice (don't dilute).  Add in crushed pineapple along with the juice.  Add cut up apples, pecans and cranberries.

name: APPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1 large  can crushed pineapple
approximately 4 apples
1 (12 oz.)  carton whipped topping
preparation: Melt margarine in oblong dish.  Mix together the sugar and flour.  Stir into margarine until slightly thickened.  Spread crushed pineapple on top of mixture.  Peel and dice apples; spread on top of pineapple.  Top with whipped topping and cover.  Chill until ready to serve.

name: SEAFOOD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. crab meat
1  lb. shrimp, cooked, shelled and deveined
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1  c. finely chopped celery
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  c. crushed potato chips
paprika
preparation: Combine crab meat, shrimp, mayonnaise, onion, celery, salt, pepper and Worcestershire.  Pour into buttered 2 1/2-quart casserole.  Top with potato chips.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake for 25 minutes in a 400° oven until thoroughly heated.  Serves 6.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
3  c. sugar
4  eggs
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin (2 c.)
1  c. Wesson oil
1/2  c. water
2  tsp. each: cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and baking soda
1  c. nuts (if desired)
preparation: Cook at 300°.  I like to use coffee cans to bake this in.  Just grease and flour 3 cans to bake in.

name: EGGPLANT AND RICE FRITTERS
ingredients:
2  c. mashed, cooked eggplant
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
2  tsp. grated onion
2  eggs, beaten slightly
1  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
dash of hot sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients; mix well.  Drop by spoonfuls into 1/2-inch hot oil in skillet.  Fry until brown.  (Fry amount needed to serve and refrigerate the rest.)   Will keep 3 or 4 days.

name: OLD FASHIONED SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter or oleo
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. milk
2  eggs, beaten
2 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add vanilla, milk and eggs.  Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.  Add to creamed mixture and mix well.  Chill dough until stiff enough to roll into balls 3/4 inches in diameter.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. chicken, cut in small pieces
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. melted butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. herb seasoned stuffing
preparation: Cook chicken; reserve 2 cups of broth.  Place cut up chicken in 3-quart baking dish.  Combine soups plus 1 cup broth.  Pour over chicken.  Mix butter and 1 cup broth; stir in stuffing mix. Spoon over chicken.  Bake in 400° oven for 30 minutes until brown.

name: LUCY'S CREAMY FRUIT DIP #1
ingredients:
8  oz. Cool Whip topping
8  oz. sour cream
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/3  c. shredded coconut
preparation: Soften topping at room temperature. Using an electric mixer, whip together Cool Whip, sour cream, sugar, vanilla and coconut. Chill.  Serve as a dip for fresh fruit or spoon over fresh fruit as a dressing.

name: BAKED POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. hot water
2  chicken bouillon cubes
2  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1  tsp. instant minced garlic
1/4  c. olive or salad oil
2  Tbsp. white vinegar
2  tsp. tarragon leaves, crushed
1/4  tsp. black pepper
2  lb. small red potatoes, cut in quarters and unpeeled
preparation: Combine water, bouillon cubes, onion and garlic and let stand 10 minutes.  Add to mixture, oil, vinegar, tarragon and pepper. Place potatoes in shallow 3-quart casserole dish.  Pour dressing over all, tossing to coat.  Bake at 350°, uncovered, until potatoes are fork-tender, about 35 to 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Serve at room temperature on lettuce leaves or as a hot vegetable dish.  Makes 6 servings.

name: PINEAPPLE NUT REFRIGERATOR PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (2 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
4  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  large bowl Cool Whip (3 1/4 c.)
preparation: Mix well and pour in graham cracker crust; chill.  Makes 2 pies.

name: FANCY CHOCOLATE CANDY
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo, melted
2  boxes powdered sugar
1  can condensed milk
1  can coconut, flaked
3  c. chopped pecans
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  pkg. paraffin wax
preparation: Cream butter and sugar; mix in all ingredients, except chocolate and wax.  Make balls.  Cool.  In double boiler, mix chocolate chips and paraffin wax.  Use toothpick and dip the balls into chocolate mixture.  Store in airtight container.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
2  bunches broccoli, chopped
6  strips bacon, cooked and crumbled
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  red onion, chopped
preparation: In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar. Chill the dressing at least 1 hour before serving.  In a salad bowl, layer the broccoli, bacon and onion.  Pour the dressing over all and toss before serving.   Serves 6.

name: PERFECT SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. sifted cake flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/16  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. butter
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Sift dry ingredients.  Cream butter and sugars until light and fluffy.  Add vanilla and add eggs, one at a time, beating after each egg.  Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk.  Put into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until center is done.

name: GARDEN PUREE SOUP
ingredients:
1  can split pea with ham soup
1  can tomato soup
1  can milk
1  can water
preparation: In large saucepan, combine all ingredients and cook on medium heat for 9 to 11 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Let stand, covered, for 3 minutes.  Before serving, garnish with seasoned croutons or small pretzel rings, if desired.

name: VEAL SANDWICH SPREAD(Kalve-Sus)
