ingredients:
4 to 5  lb. veal
1  gal. water
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. caraway seed
2  pkg. unflavored gelatin
preparation: Boil meat in salted water until done.  Grind meat and put it back in broth; let it come to a boil.  Add gelatin.  Season to taste.  When cold, slice and serve.  Tastes good with lefse or flatbread.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. Crisco oil
3  c. grated carrots
preparation: Combine dry ingredients in large bowl.  Add eggs and oil.  Mix until blended.  Add carrots.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes. Cool and frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

name: 6-CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. shredded coconut
1  c. pineapple chunks
1  c. fruit cocktail
1  c. sour cream
1  c. cottage cheese
preparation: Combine and let stand 12 hours.

name: BREAKFAST PIZZA
ingredients:
1  Pillsbury crescent rolls (dough)
1  lb. sausage, browned
hash browns, chopped (Ore-Ida)
5  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese
bacon (optional)
onion (optional)
green peppers (optional)
preparation: Grease pan.  Spread out dough to form crust.  Put on sausage, hash browns and eggs.  Put on optional items if desired.  Put cheese on top.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until done.  Bake at 375°.

name: YELLOW RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. saffron rice
1  can pork and breans
1  lb. hamburger
1  onion
chili powder (to taste)
2  cans nacho cheese soup
preparation: Prepare rice to package directions and layer bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Brown hamburger and drain; add chili powder, pork and beans and onion.  Heat until hot, then layer on top of rice.  Spread nacho cheese soup on top.  Swirl soup into mixture. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until cheese melts into mixture. Serve with nacho chips.

name: YAZOO SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Campbell's tomato soup
1  pkg. plain gelatin
1/4  c. water
1  can English peas, drained
1 1/2  c. celery, chopped
1  small minced onion
1  c. salad dressing
salt and pepper to season
preparation: Heat soup to warm.  Dissolve gelatin in water.  Pour into warmed soup.  Mix together with other ingredients and refrigerate. Serves 8.

name: SWISS CHICKEN CUTLETS
ingredients:
2 thin  slices Swiss cheese
4  chicken cutlets (40oz. ea. and 1/4 inch thick)
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. chicken broth
1/4  c. dry white wine
1/4  tsp. dried oregano
Chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Cut each cheese slice in half;  place one half on top of each cutlet.  Starting with a short end, tightly roll up cutlets, jelly-roll style.  Tie securely with string.

name: REESE'S CUPS
ingredients:
2  c. peanut butter
2 1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Melt over low heat 1/2 stick butter and add 6 ounces chocolate chips. Pour over top of peanut butter mixture.  Cool and cut into squares.

name: ROLL YOUR OWN SOFT TACOS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef with 1 pkg. taco or burrito seasoning or 1 lb. grilled boneless chicken breasts
refried beans
shredded Cheddar cheese
marinated bell pepper and onions
hot flour tortillas
guacamole
sour cream
salsa
tortilla chips
preparation: Cook or prepare each ingredient separately and place in serving dish.  Everyone makes their own soft tacos to their liking with all or part of the ingredients.  Ole!  If company's coming, I make a pot of pinto beans and Spanish rice.

name: CARROTS
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can sliced carrots, slightly salted or home cooked (same amount)
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. allspice
dash of pepper
preparation: Combine margarine, sugar, allspice, pepper and lemon juice in pan over low heat until blended.  Drain carrots and add to pan. Simmer about 3 minutes until flavors are blended.  Serve immediately.

name: MICROWAVE PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. white syrup
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. raw peanuts
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, stir together syrup, sugar, peanuts and salt.  Microwave at High for 4 minutes.  Stir and cook 4 minutes longer.  Add butter and vanilla to the syrup mixture. Blend well.  Microwave on High for 1 minute longer.  Add the soda and lightly stir until light and foamy.  Pour onto a sheet of aluminum foil.  Let cool for 1 hour.  When cool, break into small pieces.

name: GOLFER'S BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. stew meat
1  can mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
1  c. Burgundy wine
3  Tbsp. Kitchen Bouquet
3  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Stir the meat, soups and wine together in crock-pot. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours. During last hour, add Kitchen Bouquet and flour.  Serve with rice or noodles.

name: PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. crushed pretzels
3/4  c. melted margarine
3  Tbsp. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
1  c. sugar
2  c. frozen whipped topping, thawed
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin
2  c. boiling water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
preparation: Mix crushed pretzels, margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar together; press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 8 minutes. Cool thoroughly.

name: TRADITIONAL PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) unbaked pastry shell
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin (2 c.)
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
2  eggs
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into pastry shell and bake 15 minutes.  Reduce oven temperature to 350° and bake 35 to 40 minutes longer or until knife inserted 1 inch comes out clean.  Cool; garnish.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
3  c. white sugar
1/2  c. water
3  tsp. butter
2  tsp. soda
1  c. Karo white syrup
3  c. raw peanuts
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Boil sugar, Karo and water until thread spins, then add raw peanuts and stir continuously after peanuts are added.  Cook until it turns a brownish gold.  Take from burner; add butter, salt and soda.  Mixture will boil up in pan quickly.  Pour onto buttered board to cool.  When cool, break into pieces.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER DELIGHT CAKE
ingredients:
1  cup butter or margarine
2  cups sugar
4  eggs
1  lb. box graham crackers made into crumbs
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1  cup milk
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  cup chopped pecans or walnuts
1  cup coconut
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each egg. Set aside. Mix graham cracker crumbs, baking powder and soda. Add to the sugar mixture.  Add milk and mix well. Add vanilla, stir in nuts and coconut.  Pour into 2 greased 10 inch round cake pans.  Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

name: HAMBURGER TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  can mixed vegetables, drained
1  can mushroom soup
1  pkg. frozen Tater Tots
preparation: Brown hamburger.  In small bowl, mix soup with 1/2 cup water to thin.  In 9 x 9-inch pan, layer half hamburger, half mixed vegetables and top with Tater Tots.  Pour over half soup mixture. Layer remaining ingredients again, topping with soup.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. chicken, chopped
1/4  c. celery
1  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. honey
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1  c. grapes
pecan halves
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate for several hours.

name: GLAZED BAKED HAM
ingredients:
1  smoked shank roast (your family size)*
1  c. brown sugar
2 heaping  Tbsp. flour
1  can pineapple (4 slices)
mustard of your choice
whole cloves
1/3  c. white vinegar
1  tsp. cinnamon
maraschino cherries (optional)
preparation: *Have butcher cut shank end off for split pea soup or whatever.

name: HOLIDAY PUNCH
ingredients:
1  qt. 7-Up
1  qt. orange juice
1  qt. pineapple juice
1  qt. cranberry juice
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. sugar granulated
preparation: Make ice cubes by filling tray approximately 1/2 full of 7-Up. Add a maraschino cherry in each cube.  Freeze.  Add 7-Up to fill tray almost to the top.  Refreeze.

name: MACARONI FISH SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cooked macaroni
12  oz. tuna
1  chopped onion
1/2  green pepper
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
2  Tbsp. water
2  Tbsp. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. diet mayonnaise
lettuce leaves
preparation: In bowl, combine macaroni, fish, onion, salt, pepper and green pepper.  Toss lightly.  Add water and dry mustard; mix well.  Add mayonnaise and toss.  Refrigerate overnight.  Yields 2 servings.

name: CHEESE STUFFED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  medium baking potatoes
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. milk or sour cream
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  tsp. chopped chives or parsley (optional)
preparation: Bake potatoes as normal.  Let potatoes stand for 5 to 10 minutes after removing from oven.  Halve potatoes lengthwise and carefully scoop out inside. Set shells aside.

name: FANCY BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. vanilla wafers
5  large ripe bananas
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix pudding mix and milk in a large bowl. Mix on low speed with mixer until thick. Add the sour cream and mix well for 2 minutes. Fold in Cool Whip until well blended. Place a layer of wafers in the bottom of a large deep bowl, then a layer of sliced bananas, a layer of pudding mixture and continue to layer in this order. Top with vanilla wafer crumbs. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: PIE CRUST
ingredients:
4  c. flour
2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 1/2  c. Crisco
preparation: Crumb all ingredients together.  Add 1 cup warm water.  Slowly mix with fork until well mixed.  Divide into 5 parts.  Knead each part lightly on a floured board and roll.  Makes five 9-inch pie shells that can be placed in the freezer and used at a later time.

name: DATE-NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. chopped pitted dates
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/4  c. boiling water
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. honey
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. coarsely chopped walnuts or mixed nuts
preparation: Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine first 5 ingredients.  Add boiling water; let it cool.  Add egg to date mixture.  Sift together flour, baking powder and salt; mix into date mixture.  Stir in nuts and vanilla.  Spoon into pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours.

name: CHEESE BACON PUFFS
ingredients:
1  lb. bacon
1  c. shredded Cheddar
1  Tbsp. sherry
Tabasco sauce
1  c. mayonnaise
4  green onions, chopped
Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp, drain and crumble.  Combine with rest of ingredients.  Season to taste.  Chill overnight.  Spread on Melba rounds.  Broil until bubbly.  Makes 50 puffs.

name: RAVE REVIEWS COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  pkg. Jell-O brand vanilla instant pudding and pie filling (4 serving size)
1 1/3  c. water
4  eggs
1/4  c. oil
2  c. Baker's coconut
1  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
preparation: Blend cake and pudding mix, water, eggs and oil in large bowl. Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes.  Stir in coconut and nuts. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Cool in pans for 15 minutes.  Remove and cool on rack. Fill and top with Coconut Cream Cheese Frosting;

name: NUTTY OATMEAL-CHOCOLATE CHUNK COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. uncooked regular oats
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
1  c. sugar
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
2  large eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3  (1.55 oz.) milk chocolate candy bars, chopped
1  1/2 cups chopped pecans
preparation: Process oats in a blender or food processor until ground.  Beat butter and sugars at medium speed with an electric mixer until fluffy.  Add eggs and vanilla; beat until blended.	Combine ground oats, flour and next 3 ingredients.  Add to butter mixture, beating until blended.  Stir in chocolate and pecans.  Drop dough by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheets.  Bake at 375° for 7-8 minutes or until golden brown; remove to wire racks to cool. Yield:  6 dozen.

name: MEAT RUB SEASONING
ingredients:
1/3  c. salt
1/3  c. chili powder
1 1/2  Tbsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. hot pepper (add if you want rub to be hot and spicy)
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Makes enough seasoning for 10 pounds meat.  Rub on meat.  Place in refrigerator overnight before barbecuing.

name: PINEAPPLE ICEBOX PIE
ingredients:
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
juice of 2 lemons
1  c. sugar
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  pt. whipping cream, whipped
1  c. pecans
preparation: Mix together and put in 2 graham cracker crusts and chill.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
1  jar Kraft Marshmallow Creme
1  tsp. grated lemon peel
preparation: Soften cream cheese.  Cream together with Marshmallow Creme and lemon peel.  Allow to set 10 minutes so lemon peel can soften in mixture.  Stir until smooth.  Dip fresh strawberries, bananas or grapes.  Can be used with any fresh fruit.

name: FAVORITE POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  Tbsp. light corn syrup
10 large marshmallows or 1  c. mini marshmallows
6  qt. popped popcorn
preparation: Over low heat, melt all ingredients together (except popcorn) until smooth and no sugar crystals remain. Remove from heat and pour over popped popcorn. With hands, form popcorn balls. Put on waxed paper and store in airtight container.

name: BARBECUED VENISON TENDERLOIN
ingredients:
1  deer tenderloin (1 1/4 lb.)
2  Tbsp. butter or shortening
barbecue sauce
1  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. grated onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. water
2  tsp. vinegar
1/2  c. water
2  tsp. vinegar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire (as desired)
preparation: Cut tenderloin into slices 1 3/4-inch thick (about 6).  Trim off any strong fat or tough membrane.  Heat butter in a skillet and brown slices of deer quickly.  Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients and pour over hot meat.  Place, uncovered, in a moderate oven at 350° for 1 hour.  Baste meat occasionally with the barbecue sauce and turn once during the baking.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SOUR CREAM COOKIES
ingredients:
4  1/2  C  flour
1  2/3  C sugar
2  eggs (beaten well)
1  C shortening (butter flavor crisco)
1  C sour cream
1  tsp baking soda (must  be dissolved in 1 tsp of water)
1  tsp baking powder
1  tsp vanilla
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar, then add eggs, vanilla, then baking soda and baking powder, then sour cream alternately with flour.

name: ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (15 oz.)  cans asparagus spears
4  hard-boiled eggs
1  c. grated sharp cheese
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1/3  c. asparagus broth
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
3  Tbsp. oleo
1 1/2  c. Ritz cracker crumbs
preparation: Drain asparagus.  Arrange in a 2-quart glass dish.  Put 1/2 of the asparagus in bottom of dish, a layer of sliced eggs, another layer of asparagus and sliced eggs.  Top with cheese.  Pour the can of mushroom soup over asparagus and eggs; sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Use a knife to cut through mixture 2 or 3 times.  Add asparagus broth.  Add crumbled up Ritz crackers which have been tossed in oleo.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: LITTLE CHEDDAR LOAVES
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. oats
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  egg
3/4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. brown sugar, firmly packed
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/3  c. catsup
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except last 3.  Shape into 6 small loaves.  Place in a shallow baking pan.  Combine remaining ingredients and spread over top of loaves.  Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes.  Yield: 6 loaves.

name: QUICK AND EASY CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. lemon instant pudding
2  c. cold milk
preparation: Blend in blender until smooth.  Pour in graham cracker pie crust.  Chill 20 minutes.

name: TOMATO RUFF
ingredients:
3  ripe tomatoes (chopped)
1  cucumber (seeded and chopped)
1  small green pepper (chopped)
1  small red onion (chopped)
preparation: Chop all vegetables in small cubes.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. water
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
juice of lemon
red cake coloring
preparation: Bring to boil until clear and thick and bubbling.  Cook for about 5 minutes, then add 2 to 3 cartons of clean, fresh, cold strawberries.  Put in prepared pie crust.  Just before serving, top with whipped cream.

name: MIMI'S CHRISTMAS WREATHS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
5  c. corn flakes
35  large marshmallows
1 1/2  tsp. green food coloring
preparation: Melt margarine with marshmallows. Add vanilla and food coloring. Pour over corn flakes and mix. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper. Put "red hots" or cherry halves in middle to form wreath. Chill about 40 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

name: COCONUT POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1/2  c. Crisco
6  eggs
1  tsp. almond extract
1  tsp. coconut extract
3  c. flour
3  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  can coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
1 small  can maraschino cherries, drained and chopped
preparation: Cream sugar and shortenings;  beat until fluffy.  Add 1 egg at a time and beat.  Add flavors; alternate milk and flour.  Beat after each addition.  Fold in coconut,  pecans  and  cherries. Bake  in  prepared Bundt pan at 325° to 350° about 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. grated sharp cheese
1  stick margarine
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. paprika
olives
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Drain olives well and make a ball of the mix around an olive.  Brush with paprika and bake at 400° about 15 minutes.

name: CELERY SHRIMP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. peeled shrimp
1/3  c. chopped celery
1/3  c. chopped green pepper
1/3  c. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. margarine
1  can condensed cream of celery soup
1/3  c. sliced water chestnuts
1  hard-boiled egg, chopped
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2/3  c. cracker crumbs
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a 2-quart saucepan, saut celery, green pepper and onions in margarine for 10 minutes.  Stir in all the remaining ingredients, except for cheese, and spoon the mixture in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top and put back in oven until melted.  Serves 4.

name: STRAWBERRY CHANTILLY
ingredients:
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. Jell-O pudding and pie filling (vanilla flavor)
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. Jell-O gelatin (strawberry flavor)
2 1/2  c. water
1  (4 1/2 oz.) container Cool Whip, thawed
1  c. sliced strawberries, sweetened
preparation: Combine pudding mix, gelatin and water in a saucepan.  Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil and is clear.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Thoroughly blend in Cool Whip.  Chill until firm (about 3 hours).  Spoon into individual dessert dishes.  Top with strawberries.  Makes 4 cups or 6 to 8 servings.

name: POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  (2 lb.) beef chuck pot roast
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
salt and pepper
1 (7 to 8 oz.)  pkg. mixed dried fruit
1  large onion, cut into thin wedges
1/4  tsp. allspice
1 (5 1/2 oz.)  can apple juice
preparation: Trim fat from meat. In Dutch oven, brown meat on all sides in hot oil. Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper. Cut up any large pieces of dried fruit.

name: SOUTHWEST BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. stew meat
1/2  c. flour
vegetable oil
3  medium onions, chopped
3  large carrots, cut in 2-inch pieces
3  medium red potatoes
2  stalks celery, sliced
1 (17 oz.)  can corn, drained
1 (28 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies
1  garlic clove, minced
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Dredge meat in flour and brown in oil in Dutch oven.  Add remaining ingredients, cover and simmer for 2 1/2 hours.

name: BANANA CRUSH PUNCH
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
1 (14 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1  can frozen lemonade
7 (28 oz.)  bottles ginger ale
6  c. water
2 (12 oz.)  cans frozen orange juice
6  bananas, crushed
preparation: Dissolve sugar in water.  Add juices and bananas.  Mix well and freeze in milk carton.  Place frozen block into punch bowl and pour in the ginger ale.  Punch will be slushy.  Serves 60.

name: ULTRA-LIGHT CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
3  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/4  c. Crisco oil or light margarine
1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate bits
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Oil cookie sheets well and combine flour, baking soda and salt.  Set aside.    Combine egg, water and vanilla.  Set aside.  Combine and blend brown sugar and Crisco at low speed on mixer.  Add egg mixture.  Beat until well mixed.  Add flour mixture slowly while mixing.  Stir in chocolate bits.

name: GRANNY'S LAZY DAISY CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. flour
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Beat first 4 ingredients together.  Boil last 2 ingredients, add to egg mixture and mix well.  Bake in a 350° oven until done.

name: SNACKS
ingredients:
hot dogs, cut in bite size pieces
chunk size pineapple
stuffed olives
preparation: Wrap each of the first 3 ingredients with 1/2 slice of bacon. Broil until bacon is cooked and serve warm.  Put toothpick in to hold bacon in place.  They can be used to hold while eating.

name: SEMINARY PUDDING
ingredients:
1  stick oleo, melted
1  c. flour
1/4  c. brown sugar
1 small  pkg. slivered almonds
1  c. coconut
2 2/3  c. milk
1 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 small  pkg. instant coconut cream pudding
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Mix oleo, flour, brown sugar, almonds and coconut.  Spread on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350°, stirring often, to brown evenly (about 15 to 20 minutes).  Combine milk, vanilla pudding, coconut cream pudding and Cool Whip.  Layer in deep bowl starting with first mixture.  Save some of the first mixture to sprinkle on top.

name: LEMON BREAD
ingredients:
3/4  lb. butter
2 1/2  c. sugar
6  eggs
4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  lb. candied cherries, chopped
1/2  lb. candied pineapple, chopped
4  c. pecans, chopped
2  oz. bottle pure lemon extract
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar. Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Sift dry ingredients together (save 1/2 cup for dusting).  Add flour gradually. Add lemon extract, fruits and nuts by hand.  Grease and flour 4 loaf pans. Bake at 300° for 45 minutes.  Test after 40 minutes. Can be frozen and better if made 2 or 3 days in advance.

name: HELEN MORLEY'S POTATO DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
7  tsp. baking powder
6  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. nutmeg
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. mashed potatoes (unsalted and unseasoned)
6  Tbsp. melted lard
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Beat eggs and sugar together. Add potatoes and lard; beat well.  Alternate additions of milk and flour.  Place into covered bowl.  Chill 2 hours.  Roll out, cut out and deep fry in hot shortening or oil at 365° until golden brown.  Turn over with fork in order to brown both sides.  Fry 2 to 4 at a time.  Drain excess oil by placing doughnuts onto paper towels.

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. cubed, cold, boiled potatoes
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1 to 2  Tbsp. chopped pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped celery
1  tsp. celery seed
2  tsp. mustard
1/2 to 1  tsp. parsley
1  Tbsp. chopped pickles or relish
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. Mrs. Dash
2  hard-cooked egg whites, chopped (no yolks)
1  c. no fat, no cholesterol salad dressing
preparation: Mix, chill and serve cold.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Yields 8 servings.  Seasonings may vary according to individual tastes.

name: SOUTHWEST CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, skinned and split*
1  can tomato soup
1  can cream-style corn
1  pkg. mild taco mix
1/3  c. cornmeal
1/2  c. chunky salsa
preparation: Place prepared chicken in 9 x 13-inch baking dish which has been greased lightly.  Mix remaining ingredients together well and pour over the chicken.  Bake at 350°  for 1 hour.

name: BROCCOLI DISH
ingredients:
2  pkg. (10 oz.) chopped frozen broccoli, cook and drain
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  c. mushroom soup, undiluted
1  chopped onion
1  beaten egg
1  c. mayonnaise
4  slices diced bread
2  Tbsp. melted butter
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Put in pie plate or shallow casserole.  Mix 2 tablespoons melted butter with 2 tablespoons mayonnaise and 4 slices diced bread.  Sprinkle on top.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: RANGER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs
2  c. corn flakes
2  c. oatmeal
2  c. flour (plain)
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Cream Crisco; add sugars and eggs, then dry ingredients.  Bake for 12 to 15 minutes in 350° oven.  They brown quickly on bottom. Bake, cool, then freeze, if desired, in tightly covered containers.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/8  tsp. salt
1 to 1 1/2  c. shelled raw peanuts
1  tsp. butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Combine sugar, syrup and salt in 2-quart casserole.  Mix well. Microwave at High for 5 minutes.  Stir in peanuts.  Microwave at High for 4 to 11 minutes or until syrup and peanuts are lightly browned, stirring every 2 minutes.  Stir in butter, vanilla and soda until light and foamy.  Spread to 1/4 inch thickness on large, well buttered baking sheet.  Cool until set.  Makes about 1 pound.

name: BUTTERMILK BISCUITS
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
3  tsp. baking powder
2/3  c. shortening
1  c. buttermilk (approximately)
4  Tbsp. butter (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Sift flour, salt, soda and baking powder into mixing bowl.  Cut in shortening, using 2 knives, a pastry cutter or your hands dusted with flour.  Add sufficient buttermilk to make a soft dough.

name: BARBECUE BEAN BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. bacon, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1/2  c. ketchup
1/2  c. barbecue sauce
1  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. prepared mustard
4  Tbsp. molasses
1  tsp. chili powder
3/4  tsp. pepper
2 (16 oz.)  cans red kidney beans
2 (16 oz.)  cans pork and beans
2 (16 oz.)  cans butter beans
preparation: Brown ground beef, bacon and onion.  Drain excess fat.  Combine and add all other ingredients, except the beans; stir well.  Add beans; combine thoroughly.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.  Makes 20 to 24 servings.

name: SWEET PEPPER RELISH
ingredients:
12  bell peppers
12  hot Portugal peppers
12  onions (egg size)
2  c. cider vinegar
2  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Note:  For hotter relish, increase number of hot Portugal peppers.

name: CHARLIE BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
1/2  c. cooking oil
1/2  c. cream-style corn
2  eggs
1 small  carton sour cream
preparation: Coat sides of pan.  Pour into 8 or 9-inch square pan.  Bake 18 to 20 minutes at 450°.

name: EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  eggs, beaten
3  tsp. flour
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. melted butter or margarine
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients in a bowl; mix well.  Pour into greased and floured 9-inch pie plate.  Bake for 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

name: GROUND BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. beef, ground
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can mushrooms (undrained)
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1  c. sour cream
cooked noodles
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Brown meat and onion.  Pour off any grease.  Add flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms.  Cook 5 minutes over medium heat, uncovered. Add soup and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes.  Stir in sour cream and noodles (adjust quantity to personal taste).  Sprinkle with parsley.  Makes 4 servings.  If desired, serve noodles separately and let each guest spoon on the stroganoff.

name: CORN COB JELLY(Sometimes Called Poor Man's Jelly)
ingredients:
1  doz. medium size red corn cobs
2  qt. water
1 1/4  oz. pkg. powdered pectin
3  c. corn cob juice
3  c. sugar
preparation: Wash corn cobs and cut into 4-inch lengths.  Place in container and add 2 quarts of water.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and boil slowly for 30 minutes.  Strain the juice.  Measure 3 cups of juice into a large saucepan.  Add pectin and bring to a boil.  Add sugar and bring to boiling point again.  Boil 5 minutes.  Skim, then pour into sterilized jars and seal.

name: GRANDPA'S CHILI SOUP
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans whole tomatoes
1 (16 oz.)  can red kidney beans
1 (16 oz.)  can pork and beans
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  large onion
3  to 4 stalks celery with leaves
1/4  lb. spaghetti or elbow macaroni
chili powder, salt and pepper to taste
1  qt. water
preparation: Chop onions and saute in large skillet.  When translucent, add hamburger and cook while chopping until well done and crumbled.

name: BUTTERFINGER PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker crust
6  Butterfinger candy bars
1-8 oz. cream cheese
small Cool Whip
preparation: Beat candy bars in a ziploc bag.  Mix cream cheese and small Cool Whip together.  Add crushed candy bars, reserving enough to sprinkle on top.  Pour into crust.  Sprinkle reserved candy on top.  Let set in refrigerator for at least 2 hours.

name: COCONUT DREAM PIE
ingredients:
2  envelopes Dream Whip topping mix
2 3/4  c. cold milk
2  pkg. (4 serving size) instant vanilla pudding
1  c. coconut
1  pkg. graham cracker or chocolate flavor crust
preparation: Prepare whipped topping mix with 1 cup milk as directed on package using large mixer bowl.  Add remaining milk and the pie filling mix.  Blend, then beat at high speed for 2 minutes scraping bowl occasionally.  Fold in coconut.  Spoon into crust. Chill at least 4 hours or overnight.

name: CLASSIC RICE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. cooked rice, cooled
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped pickle
1/4  c. chopped pimento
4  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
preparation: Season to taste.  Mix well. Put in salad bowl.  Put strips of red and green pepper on top.  Chill.

name: POTATO CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine (or 1/2 c. of each)
1/2  c. white granulated sugar
1 1/2  c. flour, sifted
3/4  c. crushed waffle potato chips
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix  in order given:  margarine,  sugar,  flour,  potato chips, nuts and vanilla.  Drop  by slightly rounded teaspoonful on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at  350° for 12 to 15 minutes. Watch them!  Sprinkle with confectioners sugar if desired, when cool.

name: NEVER FAIL DIVINITY ICING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. white Karo
1/4  c. water
2  egg whites
3 heaping  Tbsp. powdered sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook sugar, Karo and water together until it spins a thread. Beat the egg whites stiff.  Pour cooked mixture over eggs slowly, beating constantly.  When stiff, add powdered sugar and vanilla. The powdered sugar is the secret to success in this icing.

name: CRABBIES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, softened
1 (5 oz.)  jar Old English cheese
1 1/2  tsp. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
8  oz. crabmeat
6  English muffins
preparation: Mix well all the ingredients.  Spread on English muffins. Bake in 350° oven about 10 to 15 minutes. Cut into quarters. Makes 24.

name: GRANNIE'S COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1  egg
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. molasses
2  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Chill before baking approximately 1 hour.  Roll into small balls, then roll in sugar. Bake for 10 minutes at 375°.

name: KIBBLES AND BITS(For People)
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. peanut butter
preparation: Melt together.  Add 1 large box Crispix cereal.  Stir to coat. Place in a large grocery bag.  Add 1 pound powdered sugar and shake well.

name: SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. macaroni
1  can deviled shrimp
4  hard-boiled eggs, diced
1  small onion, chopped
1  tsp. chopped green pepper
salt and pepper
salad dressing to moisten
preparation: Cook, rinse and drain macaroni.  Add shrimp, eggs, onion, green pepper, salt, pepper and salad dressing.  Chill and serve on lettuce.

name: VANILLA ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  cans fat-free sweetened condensed milk
Egg Beaters equivalent to 4 eggs
1  c. whipping cream
2  Tbsp. vanilla
about 1 1/2 qt. milk
preparation: Mix in a 1-gallon freezer. Use ice cubes and 1 pound table salt. It freezes in about 1 hour in an electric freezer.

name: MEXICAN FIESTA BISCUIT BAKE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. melted margarine
1 (17.3 oz.)  can buttermilk biscuits
1 (10.8 oz.)  can buttermilk biscuits
1 (16 oz.)  jar chunky salsa
3  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. sliced green onion
1 (2 1/4 oz.)  jar sliced black olives
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Spread melted margarine in 9 x 13-inch dish.  Separate dough into 13 biscuits.  Snip each biscuit into eighths, using kitchen cutters.  Place biscuit pieces in large bowl.  Toss with salsa.  Spoon evenly into dish.  Sprinkle with remaining ingredients.  Bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes.  Let stand 15 minutes before cutting.  Makes 12 to 15 servings.

name: FRUITY YOGURT MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. chopped fresh rhubarb
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (8 oz.)  carton strawberry-banana low-fat yogurt
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  egg, lightly beaten
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. all-purpose flour, divided
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. unsweetened orange juice
1  tsp. vanilla extract
vegetable cooking spray
preparation: Combine rhubarb and 2 tablespoons of flour in a small bowl. Toss well and set aside.

name: TODD'S CHICKEN DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  chopped onion
1  chopped red pepper
1  chopped green pepper
oil as needed
1  lb. (every 2 people) chopped chicken breast
3 heaping  Tbsp. Grey Poupon mustard
3  dashes oregano
decorative dashes parsley
hot sauce (optional)
1/2  lb. chopped mushrooms
5  Tbsp. margarine
1  lb. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  large diced tomato
1  lb. (every 4 people) noodles
1  c. white wine (Zinfandel)
1  dash basil
3  dashes pepper
preparation: Heat large skillet or wok on high.  Melt margarine.  Add onions, pepper, then mushrooms.  Saute to your liking.  Move veggies to the side and fry up the chicken.  Once cooked, mix with veggies.  Add Grey Poupon.  Mix. Add wine.  Mix. Add spices.  Mix. Let simmer for 3 to 5 minutes.  Heat oven on broil 350°.  Cover skillet with Mozzarella then top with tomatoes and parsley.  Put under broiler if using skillet, if using electric wok, just let the cheese melt in.  Let broil for 2 to 4 minutes.  Serve over noodles and a side of salad and applesauce.

name: WHITE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  lb. white chocolate
1/2  c. boiling water
2  c. sugar
1  c. margarine
4  eggs, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk
2 1/2  c. cake flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1/2  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Melt chocolate in boiling water; cool.  Cream sugar and margarine until fluffy.  Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating after each addition.  Combine with chocolate mixture.  Add vanilla, buttermilk, flour and baking powder alternately to chocolate mixture.  Do not overbeat.  Beat egg whites and fold gently into batter.  Add pecans and coconut.  Pour into three greased and floured cake pans.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: EASY CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb ground meat
1/2  c green pepper, chopped
1/2  c onion, chopped
1/2  c celery, chopped
1  can crushed tomatoes
1  can tomato soup
chili powder to taste
salt and pepper
1  can kidney beans (optional)
preparation: Brown ground meat and drain. Add onion, green pepper, and celery. Heat thoroughly. Add tomatoes, soup, spices and beans. Cook on medium heat for 1 hour.

name: CHEESE STRAWS
ingredients:
1  lb. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1  stick oleo
red pepper to taste
1  tsp. salt
2  c. flour (all-purpose)
1 heaping  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cold water
preparation: Cream butter; add flour, salt and baking powder.  Cream well. Add water, cheese and red pepper.  Roll out thin on waxed paper and cut in strips or circles.  Bake at 350° for approximately 10 minutes.

name: RAINBOW PASTA-LOBSTER SALAD
ingredients:
rainbow pasta
2  large tomatoes
1  bell pepper
1  yellow pepper
1  cucumber
2  green onions
2  pkg. imitation lobster or crab meat
Italian salad dressing to your taste
preparation: In large pot, bring 4 cups of water to a boil; add pasta.  Cook until tender.  Rinse under cold water; set aside.  Cut up tomatoes (to desired size), cucumbers, green pepper, onion, yellow pepper and lobster or crab meat.  Place in large mixing bowl.  Add Italian salad dressing to your taste.  Chill, covered, in refrigerator until ready for use.  Sprinkle with parsley on top.

name: IRISH SHERRY TRIFLE
ingredients:
1  c. sweet sherry
1  pt. each:  strawberry and lime gelatin, prepared and partially set
2  c. prepared custard
1/2  c. strawberry or raspberry jam
2  c. whipped dairy cream
sponge cake or pound cake
1  pkg. (about 12) ladyfingers
a few cherries or strawberries
preparation: Put a layer of sponge cake, about 3/4 inch thick, at bottom of dish.  A clear glass dish (about 3-quart) is preferable.  Coat lightly with jam and saturate with half of sherry.  Arrange ladyfingers in standing position around dish.  Cover sponge cake with 1/2-inch layer of both gelatins.  Cover with layer of cool custard.  Repeat procedure 2 more times.  Place whipped cream on top and garnish with cherries or strawberries.  Chill and serve. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

name: HEALTHY WALNUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. packed light brown sugar
1  egg
1  c. skim milk
3/4  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spray an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan with oil. Sift together the flour, baking powder, soda, salt and sugar; set aside.  In second bowl, beat egg until thick.  Add milk; continue beating until blended.  Add dry ingredients and nuts; stir until mixture is moist.  Turn mixture into pan.  Bake for 40 minutes, or until tester comes out clean.  Loosen loaf from sides of pan.  Turn out, right side up, on wire rack to cool.

name: GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. molasses
1/2  c. shortening
1  egg
2 1/2  c. flour
dash of salt
1  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cassia or cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until done.

name: FAVORITE BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can small white beans
1  (12 oz.) solid packed tomatoes
1  green pepper, chopped
2  small onions, chopped
3  Tbsp. parsley, chopped
1  bay leaf
1  clove garlic, chopped
1/2  tsp. oregano
salt and pepper
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3  to 4 carrots, sliced
preparation: Rinse and soak beans overnight.  Add bay leaf, garlic, salt and pepper.  Simmer for several hours or until beans are tender.  Saute onions and green pepper and add tomatoes.  Allow to cook several minutes.

name: CREAMY BROCCOLI CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
1  envelope Ranch salad dressing mix
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Beat all ingredients in medium bowl.  Serve with vegetable dippers and assorted crackers, if desired.  Makes 3 1/2 cups.

name: CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
6  slices bacon
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. ketchup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
2  tsp. vinegar
1 (28 oz.)  can pork and beans
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans
1 (10 oz.)  can lima beans or butter beans
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Cook beef; add onion and saut until tender. Combine beef, onion, ketchup, salt, brown sugar, mustard and vinegar in Dutch oven or electric casserole. Add partially drained beans and stir gently to mix. Sprinkle with bacon. Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked chicken
1 to 1 1/2  c. cooked rice
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. Miracle Whip
1  c. cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. almonds
2  hard-boiled eggs, chopped or sliced
ripe olives (as many as you like)
potato chips or Chinese noodles
preparation: Mix all ingredients together, except the chips or noodles. Place in casserole; put the chips or noodles on top.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: PORK CHOPS AND RICE
ingredients:
6  pork chops
rice
1  can tomato soup
1  pt. tomatoes
1 small  can tomato paste
preparation: Brown 6 pork chops.  Spray Pam in large cake pan and place chops in single layer.  Cook 1 cup rice.  Put thick slice of onion on each chop.  Put mound of cooked rice over each onion.  Mix 1 can tomato soup, 1 pint tomatoes and 1 small (6 ounce) can tomato paste.  Pour over chops and rice.  Cover (I use foil).  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Baste with sauce every half hour.

name: EASY CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1 2/3  c. frozen mixed vegetables, thawed
1  c. cut-up, cooked chicken
1  c. cream of chicken soup
1  c. bisquick baking mix
1/2  c. milk
1  egg
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Mix chicken, vegetables and soup in ungreased 9 inch pie plate. Stir remaining ingredients with fork until blended. Pour into pie plate. Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown. 6 servings.

name: HUEROS RANCHEROS
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can enchilada sauce
8  flour tortillas
1/2  c. thinly sliced green onions
1 1/2  c. Monterey Jack cheese with jalapeno peppers, shredded
2  tsp. butter
10 large eggs, beaten with 1/4  tsp. salt and 1/4 tsp.  pepper
1/2  c. chunky salsa
preparation: Heat oven to 300°.   Warm 4 ovenproof dinner plates.  Pour enchilada sauce into pie plate.  Dip tortillas in sauce.  Place 2 on each plate, overlapping slightly.  Sprinkle with onions and cheese.  Place in oven to melt.  Scramble eggs in melted butter. Remove plates from oven.  Top with eggs and salsa.  Serve with chopped, fresh tomatoes, sour cream and/or guacamole.  Serves 4.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CRACKER CANDY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  sleeve soda crackers, crushed
preparation: Combine sugar and milk.  Bring mixture to a boil.  Combine other ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Let stand 5 minutes.   Beat it.  Pour into buttered pan.  Cool in refrigerator.  Cut into desired pieces.

name: CANTONESE LOBSTER SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. oil
1  clove garlic
1/2  lb. ground pork
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1/2  tsp. monosodium glutamate (Accent)
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. cold water
1  egg
2  green scallions
preparation: Heat  oil  in large skillet.  Stir in crushed or minced garlic and  cook until golden.  Add ground pork and fry until browned, forking  meat apart as it cooks.  Stir in soy sauce, sugar,  salt, pepper,  chicken broth and monosodium glutamate and  cook  to boiling  point.  Add  cleaned  and deveined raw shrimp (or lobster  pieces).  Cover  tightly  and  cook eight minutes.

name: YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. warm water
1  pkg. yeast, dissolved in water
2  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. oil
flour
preparation: Add enough flour to other ingredients to make a stiff dough (approximately 1 1/2 to 2 cups).  Knead and roll into biscuits or crescents.  Let rise until doubled in size.  Bake at 375° to 400° until lightly browned.  Butter tops.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 - 16  oz. can veg-all
1  small onion, chopped
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. shredded cheddar cheese
1  roll crushed Ritz crackers
preparation: Drain vegetables.  Add onion, mayonnaise and cheese.  Place in casserole dish.  Sprinkle with crushed crackers.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.  Season to taste.

name: HANKY-PANKY
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. hot pork sausage
3/4 to 1  lb. Velveeta cheese, grated
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. oregano
1  Tbsp. worcestershire sauce
2  loaves party rye bread
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes, optional
preparation: Brown ground beef and sausage in skillet.  Add cheese, garlic salt, oregano and worcestershire sauce.  Heat and stir until cheese melts.  Spread mixture on bread (about 1 tsp. per slice). Garnish with tomatoes for color and added flavor, if desired. Bake at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Makes about 70.

name: VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato sauce (Italian style)
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1  bag butter beans, frozen
1  bag Green Giant Niblets corn
2  large potatoes, diced
1  can green beans
1  can English peas
pepper and salt
ground beef, cooked and drained
1  chicken bouillon cube
water
preparation: Put all ingredients in large pot.  Simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: CHUCK WAGON BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bacon slices
3  lb. ground beef
3  c. finely chopped onion
1  c. finely chopped celery
2  beef bouillon cubes
2/3  c. boiling water
1 1/2  cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2  c. catsup
3  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2 (29 oz. each)  cans molasses-style baked beans
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  In a Dutch oven or large roasting pan, fry bacon until crisp; set aside.  Drain fat from pan.

name: PREACHER'S ROLLS(An Appropriate Recipe For This Book)
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. water
2  pkg. yeast (preacher says if 2's good, 3's better)
5  c. self-rising flour
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
preparation: My grandfather was nicknamed "Preacher" because his father was a United Methodist minister.  At any family gathering, Preacher would always make the rolls.  Just before he died, he asked me to come watch him so that I could carry on the family tradition.  I guess he knew his time with us was short.  Here is a beloved family recipe with Preacher's hints.

name: SKILLET ROAST
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. chuck roast
2  tsp. cooking oil in skillet
1  medium onion
4  potatoes, quartered
4  carrots
1/2  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Rub roast in flour and salt until coated. Heat skillet on medium heat; brown 10 minutes until brown on both sides.  Add water; cook until almost done. Add potatoes, carrots and onions (in slices) on roast. Add black pepper. Cook until done.

name: MAMA'S CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
1/2  c. Crisco shortening
3  c. sugar
3  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. Hershey's cocoa
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. milk (room temperature)
5  eggs (room temperature)
preparation: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar. Sift all dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk and vanilla. Add eggs, 1 at a time, blending with all other ingredients. Coat tube pan with shortening. Use a small amount of flour and cocoa to flour pan. Pour mixture into prepared tube pan and place in COLD oven. Turn oven on and let it heat to 325°. Cook for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until done. Cool in pan for 10 minutes.

name: APPLE PIE
ingredients:
pastry for 2 crust pie for 9-inch pie pan
6  to 8 tart cooking apples (Empire or McIntosh)
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. sugar
3 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Wash, core, peel and thinly slice apples.  Brush slices with lemon juice.  Toss apple slices with a mixture of the sugar, flour, cinnamon and salt.  Fill pastry shell with apple mixture and dot with butter.  Cover apples with second pastry.  Prick top crust with fork.  Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to 350° and bake about 40 minutes longer.

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
1  can mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. chicken broth
1  large chicken, cooked (4 c. sliced)
2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
12  oz. pkg. spaghetti, cooked and broken in half)
4  oz. can sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
paprika
preparation: Grease 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Mix soups, chicken broth, Cheddar cheese, chicken, mushrooms and spaghetti together.  Pour into baking dish.  Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Serves 8 to 10. Turkey can be used instead of chicken.

name: BREAD STICKS
ingredients:
6  c. flour
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
2  pkg. active dry yeast
2  c. very warm water
1/4  c. oil or shortening
melted butter or oleo
egg white
sesame or poppy seed
preparation: In large bowl, combine 2 cups flour, sugar, salt and yeast; blend well.  In small saucepan or in a microwave, heat water and oil until very warm (120° to 130°).  Add warm liquid to flour mixture.  Blend at low speed until moistened; beat 3 minutes at medium speed.  By hand, stir in an additional 2 1/2 to 3 cups flour until dough pulls cleanly away from sides of bowl.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS CORDON BLEU
ingredients:
6  boneless chicken breasts
salt & pepper
3 thin  slices Swiss cheese
3 thin  slices ham
1/2  c. flour
3  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. bread crumbs
3/4  c. margarine
preparation: Flatten breast with cleaver, salt and pepper.  Place 1/2 slice cheese and 1/2 slice of ham on 1/2 chicken piece.  Fold other half over and seal with toothpick.  Dip each in flour, then egg and crumbs.  Sauté in melted margarine over medium flame until golden brown.  Continue to cook on low flame until done.  6 servings.

name: NEVER FAIL BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2/3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Measure sifted flour, then sift again with dry ingredients into bowl.  Measure shortening.  With pastry blender, cut it into dry ingredients quickly and lightly until mixture looks like coarse crumbs.  Scoop a deep well in flour mixture and add milk all at once.  Stir gently with fork until flour is dampened.  Stir vigorously, just until dough follows fork around bowl.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen broccoli, thawed
1  pt. cottage cheese
3  eggs, well beaten
1/4  lb. sharp grated cheese
salt and pepper to taste
3  Tbsp. plain flour
1/2  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Combine all ingredients and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: REESE PEANUT BUTTER BARS
ingredients:
1  lb. margarine
18  oz. peanut butter
2  lb. confectioners sugar
2  (1/2 lb.) Hershey bars
preparation: Melt margarine with peanut butter; add confectioners sugar. Mix well and pour into a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Melt Hershey bars and spread on top.  Cool in refrigerator until set. Cut into bars.

name: IRIS' CHICKEN
ingredients:
12  chicken thighs, skin removed (thighs are tastier than breasts)
1  can Campbell's golden mushroom soup
1/4  c. water
6  oz. box Stove Top stuffing for chicken
cheese
preparation: Place chicken thighs in shallow casserole.  Mix soup with 1/4 cup of water and pour over chicken.  Cover with thin cheese slices, then place Stove Top stuffing on top.  Bake at 325° to 350° for  1 hour.  Freezes beautifully.  Nice served with asparagus or Chinese pea pods.  Serves 8 to 12.

name: DANISH PUFF
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. flour
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Cut margarine into flour until it is very fine.  Add water; beat it until it forms a ball and leaves the sides of the bowl. Take this ball and divide it in two parts.  Use ungreased cookie sheet.  Press this mixture onto cookie sheet, making two sections, 3 x 12-inch.  Make these two sections 3 inches apart on the sheet.

name: THE BISCUIT
ingredients:
1  c. tonic water
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. sour cream
1  egg
6  c. biscuit mix
preparation: In a 2-quart mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except biscuit mix.  Use a wire whisk and mix until there is a smooth consistency.  Add biscuit mix, changing to a large spoon to work biscuit mix into tonic water mixture.  Dip kneading hand into just enough additional biscuit mix that dough can be kneaded in the bowl until smooth and elastic.  Knead about 12 times in bowl. Divide the dough into 14 equal pieces and shape into biscuits, about 1 1/2-inches thick.

name: EARTHQUAKE CAKE
ingredients:
nuts (pecans or walnuts)
1  German chocolate cake mix, prepared according to directions
coconut
1  pkg. cream cheese
1  stick margarine
1  lb. powdered sugar
preparation: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.  Layer nuts on bottom of pan, then layer coconut.  Pour prepared cake batter over nuts and coconut. Mix cream cheese, margarine and powdered sugar together until smooth.  Dab on top of cake all over.  Bake at 350° until done.

name: OATMEAL RAISIN COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. (1/2 lb.) butter or margarine, softened
2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
2  eggs
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
3  c. quick-cooking rolled oats
1 1/2  c. raisins
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: In large bowl of an electric mixer, beat butter and sugar until creamy, then beat in eggs and lemon juice.  In another bowl, stir together flour, salt and baking soda; gradually add to butter mixture, blending thoroughly.  Add oats, raisins and walnuts and stir until well combined.

name: CHICKEN LASAGNA
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. diced basil
3  c. chicken broth
2  c. (1 lb.) cottage cheese
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/2  lb. lasagna noodles, cooked
1/4  lb. sliced Mozzarella cheese
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2 1/2  c. diced cooked chicken
preparation: Melt butter in large saucepan.  Blend in flour, salt and basil.  Stir in chicken broth and cook until mixture thickens and comes to a boil.  Add chicken.  Mix cottage cheese with beaten egg.

name: CARROT SALAD
ingredients:
2  lb. bag carrots, peeled and sliced
1  small green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. white (clear) vinegar
1/2  c. oil
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  or 3 stalks celery, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can Campbell's tomato soup
1/4 to 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine everything except carrots.  Cook carrots and while still hot, add to sauce.  Refrigerate 12 to 24 hours.

name: CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philly cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1  graham cracker crust
preparation: Mix Philly cream cheese, sugar and vanilla together at medium speed until blended.  Add eggs and mix well.  Pour batter into ready to use graham cracker crust.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until center is almost set.  Cool.   For best results, refrigerate 3 hours.  Garnish as desired.  I like blueberry pie filling on top.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. mixed vegetables, cooked as directed and drained
1  large onion, chopped fine
1  c. celery, chopped fine
1  c. mayo
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  stick butter or margarine
1  tube Ritz crackers, crushed
preparation: Mix 1/2 of the cracker crumbs with melted butter or margarine. Spread in bottom of casserole dish.  Mix vegetables, cheese, onion, celery and mayo in a bowl.  Pour over cracker crumbs.  Put remainder of crumbs on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: ANGEL FLAKE ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
2  c. buttermilk
1  c. Crisco
2  tsp. baking powder
5  c. sifted plain flour
preparation: Put sugar, salt and yeast in bowl with 1 cup warm water.  Let dissolve.  Melt Crisco and cool.  Add buttermilk and yeast water to flour and knead until smooth.  More flour will be needed. Store in flour covered containers in the refrigerator to be used as desired.  Bake at 350° until golden brown.

name: CHOCOLATE MERINGUE PIE
ingredients:
1  3/4 c sugar, divided
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. cocoa
2  c. milk
4  large eggs, separated
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted and cooled
1  baked 9-inch pastry shell
1/2  Tbsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Combine 1 1/4 cups sugar, flour and cocoa in a heavy saucepan. Combine milk, egg yolks and melted butter and beat using a wire whisk, until mixture is well blended.  Gradually add milk mixture to sugar mixture, stirring until smooth.  Cook mixture over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly (about 10 minutes).  Spoon into pastry shell; set aside.  Beat egg whites and cream of tartar at high speed with an electric mixer until foamy. Gradually add remaining 1/2 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating until stiff peaks form and sugar dissolves (2 to 4 minutes).  Spread meringue over chocolate filling, sealing to edge of pastry.  Bake at 325° for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Yield:  1 (9-inch) pie.

name: PINEY WOOD HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cornmeal
1  tsp. baking soda
dash of salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  egg, beaten
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients; beat milk and egg together and combine with dry ingredients; batter should hold its shape when picked up with a spoon. If dough is too soft, add more cornmeal. Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil. Cook about 1 1/2 minutes on one side; turn and cook on other side for 1 minute. Makes about 45 hush puppies.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  boxes apricot jello
2  c. sugar
4  c. hot water
6  oz. can frozen lemonade
1 large  can pineapple juice
2  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Dissolve the jello and sugar in the hot water.  Cool. Add the frozen lemonade and pineapple juice. Freeze. When ready to serve, pour the ginger ale over it.

name: CHICKEN, SAUSAGE AND WILD RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage
1  lb. sliced mushrooms
2  medium onions, sliced
1  chicken, cooked, boned and cut in bite-size pieces
2  c. wild rice
1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. heavy cream
2 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  tsp. monosodium glutamate
1/2  tsp. each oregano, thyme and marjoram
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Saute sausage and set aside.  In drippings, saute mushrooms and onions; add sausage and cooked chicken.  Cook wild rice according to package directions.  In separate pan, mix flour with cream until smooth.  Add broth and cook until thickened.  Add seasonings along with the rice, sausage, chicken, mushrooms and onions.  Put in 10 x 12-inch baking dish and bake at 350°  for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1 (18 oz.) refrigerated  slice and bake cookies
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  (18 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. confectioners sugar
1/2  c. orange marmalade
2  Tbsp. water or fruit juice
1  tsp. vanilla
assorted fruit or canned sliced fruit, drained
preparation: Slice dough into 1/8-inch slices and place on 12-inch pizza pan, overlapping edges. Bake at 375° for 8 minutes or until lightly brown.  Cool.

name: OYSTER CRACKER SNACKS
ingredients:
1  box oyster crackers
1/2  c oil
1  pkg dry ranch salad dressing mix
1/2  tsp dill weed
1/2  tsp garlic powder
1/2  tsp lemon pepper seasoning
preparation: Place oyster crackers in large deep pan. Warm the oil and sprinkle over crackers. Toss well. Mix dry ingredients well and sprinkle over crackers, stir to coat. Bake 250° for one hour, stirring once or twice. Store in an airtight container.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. Wheat Chex cereal, crushed to 1/2 c.
1/3  c. chopped nuts
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/4  c. oil
2  Tbsp. water
1 1/2  c. mashed banana
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2-inch loaf pan.  Stir together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, cereal and nuts.  Combine egg, oil, water, bananas and vanilla. Add all at once to dry ingredients.  Stir just to moisten.  Spread evenly into pan.  Bake 50 to 55 minutes.  Let cool 15 minutes before removing from pan.  Makes 1 loaf.

name: TOLL HOUSE PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
3/4  c. margarine, softened (1 1/2 sticks)
1  c. nuts, chopped (walnuts or pecans)
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Nestle Toll House semi-sweet chocolate (1 c.)
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
whipped cream or ice cream (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  In large mixer bowl, beat eggs at high speed until foamy, about 3 minutes.  Beat in flour, sugar and brown sugar until well blended.  Beat in softened margarine.  Stir in nuts and Nestle Toll House semi-sweet morsels.

name: ITALIAN POTATOES
ingredients:
potatoes (as many as you need)
1/4 to 1/2  bottle Italian dressing (I use Kraft fat-free)
salt and pepper as desired
preparation: Quarter and boil potatoes (as many as you need) for approximately 20 minutes.  After cooked, put in a bowl.  Pour approximately 1/4 to 1/2 bottle Italian dressing (I use Kraft fat-free dressing) over potatoes. Salt and pepper as desired. Serve warm.

name: TEATIME TASSIES
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. flour
1/2  c. butter or margarine
preparation: Let cheese and butter soften; stir in flour and blend well. Chill dough 1 hour.  Shape into small balls and place each in miniature muffin tins.  Press into shape bottom and sides.

name: SPAGHETTI PIE(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  clove minced garlic
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. fennel
2  eggs, beaten
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. butter
3  c. hot cooked spaghetti
1  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: In 1 1/2-quart casserole crumble beef.  Add onion, green pepper and garlic.  Cook covered on 100% power for 4 to 6 minutes, stirring once.  Drain fat.  Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, flour, basil and fennel.  Cook uncovered on High 6 to 8 minutes, stirring every 3 minutes.  Cover and set aside.

name: GRANDMA NEGUS' GROUND BEEF PATTIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  onion, chopped
8  to 10 soda crackers, crushed
2  eggs
dash of salt and pepper
1  Tbsp. milk
preparation: In a medium sized dish break in eggs; whip with fork.  Add milk, crushed crackers, onion, salt and pepper. Let stand five minutes to soften crackers.  Knead in ground beef and make into patties.  Fry in skillet until brown.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box (23 herb) Uncle Ben's wild rice
1  can French-style green beans (undrained)
1  can celery soup (undiluted)
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
1  can water chestnuts, sliced and drained
1  chicken, cut up
preparation: Cook rice.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix all ingredients together.  Top with grated cheese.  Bake at 350°  for 45 minutes, or until bubbles and cheese melts.

name: MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1/2  c. bread crumbs
3/4  c. milk (soak bread crumbs in milk)
3  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. butter
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 (20 oz.)  jar apple jelly
1 1/2  bottle chili sauce
1 (14 oz.)  bottle ketchup
preparation: Saute onion in two tablespoons of butter until soft.  Add to bread crumbs.  Add beef, seasoniong and egg.  Form into one inch balls, and bake in oven on broiler rack at 400° until brown.  Drain on paper towel.

name: PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. seasoned flour
1 1/2  lb. round steak, cut into strips
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  can onion soup
1/2  c. ketchup
1  medium green pepper, cut in strips
preparation: Flour meat, then brown in shortening; drain fat.  Add soup and ketchup.  Cover and simmer for 45 minutes.  Stir.  Add green pepper; continue to cook 15 to 20 minutes.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  egg
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/3  c. sugar
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Line a muffin pan with paper baking cups. Beat milk, oil and egg.  Stir in flour, sugar, baking powder and salt all at once until flour is moistened.  (Batter will be lumpy.)  Fold in blueberries; fill baking cups.  Sprinkle with sugar, if desired.  Bake until golden brown, 18 to 20 minutes. Immediately remove from pan.

name: PORCUPINE MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  egg, beaten
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans condensed tomato soup
1/4  c. rice
1  onion, finely chopped
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: In a bowl, combine egg and 1/4 cup soup.  Stir in uncooked rice, onion, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.  Add beef and mix well.  Shape meat mixture into small balls.  Place in a 10-inch skillet or Dutch oven.

name: STIR-FRY VEGGIES
ingredients:
1/4  cabbage, cut up
2  medium Irish potatoes, sliced thin
1  large carrot, sliced thin
1/2  green bell pepper, cut up
1/2  red bell pepper, cut up
medium onion, sliced
preparation: Put in large frypan with 2 tablespoons oil.  Cook on low to medium heat 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Salt to taste.

name: RANCH-STYLE BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1 (23 oz.)  can regular Ranch Style beans
1 (23 oz.)  can jalapeno Ranch Style beans
1  chopped onion
1/2  lb. smoked or mesquite sausage
2  Tbsp. mustard
1/2  c. maple syrup or molasses
1/4 to 1/2  c. medium hot picante sauce
preparation: Saut onion with sausage and then combine with remaining ingredients. Bake for 1 hour in a 350° oven.

name: YOGURT TOPPED VEGETABLE PIE
ingredients:
9-inch pie crust
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. thinly sliced broccoli
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. basil
2  Tbsp. flour
2  eggs
3/4  c. plain yogurt
1/4  lb. fresh mushrooms
3  Tbsp. butter
1  c. shredded green cabbage
1  c. thinly sliced carrots
1/2  tsp. ground caraway seed
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. dry white wine
1/3  c. cottage cheese
1/4  c. sour cream
paprika
preparation: Melt butter in frying pan.  Saute vegetables just until tender. Stir in spices.  Remove from heat and toss with flour and wine. Puree eggs and cottage cheese in blender.  Add to sauteed vegetables.  Mix well.  Spread into pastry lined pie pan.  Stir yogurt and sour cream until creamy.  Spread on top of vegetable filling.  Wash, trim and slice mushrooms.  Saute lightly in butter and arrange gently on top of yogurt layer.  Dust with paprika. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 40 minutes.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: AFRICAN CHOP
ingredients:
1  (3 lb.) chicken, cut up
3  onions (medium)
3 large tomatoes (fresh) or 1  can tomatoes
salt and pepper to taste
ground red hot chilies to taste, (optional)
1 1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. crunchy peanut butter or curry (optional)
1 1/2  c. shredded coconut
2  c. cheese
3  tomatoes, chopped
4  to 6 green onions, chopped
2  c. bananas, chopped
2  c. pineapple, chopped
1  c. chopped green pepper
preparation: Cut up chicken and fry in oil with salt and pepper.  Put onion and tomatoes in blender 1 minute.  Add to chicken and cook 5 minutes.  Mix flour and water and add to chicken stew.  Cook until tender.  Serve over hot rice.  Then add (as desired) last 7 ingredients set out for people to add to rice and stew.  Makes 4 to 5 servings.

name: FRUIT BOWL
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  can pineapple tidbits
1  can mandarin oranges
1  box frozen strawberries
2  bananas
preparation: In a bowl, dump everything together, then slice bananas.  Let sit for 30 minutes. Serve as a salad or dessert.

name: BAKED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  to 8 pork chops (all fat trimmed)
1  lb. carrots, peeled and sliced
2  large green peppers, cleaned and diced
2  onions, peeled and sliced
1 family size  can or 2 regular cans tomato soup
1/2  can family size or 1 can regular size water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Place all ingredients over pork chops in baking pan.  Bake 2 hours at 375°.  Stir vegetables after 1 hour.  Last 1/2 hour bring pork chops to top for browning.  Serve with mashed potatoes or rice, crusty Italian bread or rolls.  Enjoy!

name: DESSERT
ingredients:
2  c. flour
3/4  c. chopped nuts
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
2  pkg. chocolate instant pudding (mix with half and half)
1  pkg. vanilla instant pudding (mix with half and half)
2  sticks oleo
1 1/2  c. Cool Whip
8  oz. Philadelphia cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix the flour, chopped nuts and oleo for the crust.  Pat in the bottom of Pyrex dish; bake for 15 minutes, until brown.

name: CRACKER SNACKS
ingredients:
2  pkg. oyster crackers
1  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. lemon pepper
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1  pkg. original Hidden Valley dressing
1  cup oil
preparation: Put first 5 ingredients into a large brown sack and shake well.  Add oil and shake until well mixed and coated.  Put in airtight container for at least 1 hour

name: CHESTNUT STUFFING
ingredients:
3  c. soft bread cubes
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. hot milk
2  c. boiled chestnuts
preparation: Mix bread crumbs, salt and pepper.  Moisten with butter, melted in the hot milk.  Chop the chestnuts fine and add to the bread crumbs mixture.  Mix thoroughly.

name: STRIPPED DELIGHT CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. melted butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. milk
1 1/2  c. thawed Cool Whip
2 (4 serving size)  pkg. Jell-O instant pudding and pie filling
3 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. Cool Whip
preparation: Combine graham cracker crumbs 1/4 cup sugar and melted margarine.  Press firmly into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.  Chill 15 minutes.

name: SQUASH DRESSING
ingredients:
3  c. corn bread crumbs
3  c. cooked squash
3  boiled eggs, chopped
salt, pepper and sage to taste
1  large onion, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Mix well.  Place in a casserole dish and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: CREAMY COLESLAW
ingredients:
1  small green cabbage, cut into 1-inch slices
1/2  green pepper, cut up
1/2  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1/4  c. dairy sour cream
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
dash of pepper
preparation: Mix mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon juice, salt, mustard and pepper.  Pour over chopped cabbage and green pepper; mix thoroughly.  Chill.

name: YEAST RISE DUMPLINGS(From the Kitchen of Lola Zahn)
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. warm water
2  Tbsp. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. shortening
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onions
1  beaten egg
1 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve 1 package yeast in water.  Stir in sugar, salt, shortening, parsley, onions and egg.  Add flour.  Stir.  Let rise until double in size.  Drop by spoonfuls onto gently boiling stew. Allow batter to rest on meat and vegetables.  Cover tightly and steam 20 minutes.  Do not lift lid.

name: MRS. JOHNSON'S ORIENTAL SALAD
ingredients:
1  can French-style green beans
1  can wax beans
1  can red kidney beans
1 (4 oz.)  can cut up mushrooms
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts, cut up
1  medium size onion, cut up
1  stalk celery, cut
1  tsp. minced garlic
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. white vinegar
preparation: In a large bowl, put the first 8 ingredients all drained. Heat the sugar and vinegar.  Pour the heated mixture over the vegetables. Toss several times until coated.  Chill before serving.  Will keep a week in refrigerator.

name: DADDY'S BIG POT OF CHILI
ingredients:
3  lb. hamburger
Carol Shelby's chili seasoning
2  cans chili beans
2  cans kidney beans
1  can pinto beans
1  can diced tomatoes
1  can Ro-Tel
1 to 2  qt. tomato juice (depending how you like your chili)
preparation: Brown hamburger. Drain grease. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer for at least 2 hours before serving.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
3  ripe bananas, mashed
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. shortening
3/4  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake at 350 degrees.

name: LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, broken in bite size pieces
1  bunch celery, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
4  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1  bell pepper, sliced
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen sweet peas
1  pt. jar mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. sugar
grated cheese (Cheddar)
1  jar Hormel real bacon bits
preparation: Mix together the mayonnaise and sugar in a small bowl and set aside.  Layer the first 6 items in order listed, then spread mayonnaise mixture over top, sealing edges.  Sprinkle cheese and bacon bits over the top.  Refrigerate and let sit overnight.

name: SICILIAN STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. collard greens (use mustard greens, collard greens, kale, Swiss chard or a combination of all), wash and rinse well, pat dry, cut out stems and cut into small pieces
1/4  c. pine nuts
1/4  c. Sonoma sun dried tomatoes, cut into small pieces after soaking
1/4  c. olive oil or Pam spray, if you prefer
preparation: Heat olive oil in large skillet or electric frypan over medium heat.  Soak dried tomatoes in hot water (save liquid).  Add nuts to oil in pan and stir-fry until lightly browned.  Add tomatoes and stir-fry.  Add prepared greens and stir-fry.  You can add liquid from tomatoes, if needed.   Prepare 20 minutes before serving.  Good with beef, fish or poultry.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: SUGAR AND SPICE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. rolled oats
1/2  c. raisins
1/4  c. chopped nuts
1/4  c. melted shortening
1  egg
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Mix  ingredients together until moist.	Pour into muffin tins and sprinkle with topping:	combine 2 tablespoons sugar, 2 tablespoons flour and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.	Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.

name: STEAK BURGUNDY
ingredients:
4  c. hot cooked rice
1  lb. round steak, cut into 1-inch strips
3  Tbsp. corn oil
2  c. sliced onions
2  c. carrots
1/3  c. Burgundy or red cooking wine
1 3/4  c. beef broth
1 (4 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms and liquid
2 1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  c. celery, diagonally sliced
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Saute steak in oil until brown.  Add onions and cook 2 minutes.  Stir in carrots, wine, broth, mushrooms with the liquid and seasonings.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer ten minutes longer.  Dissolve cornstarch in 1/4 cup water.  Stir into meat mixture.  Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Serve over rice.  Makes six servings.

name: ENGLISH MUFFIN PIZZA
ingredients:
English muffin, split in half
canned or bottled pizza sauce
sliced salami or pepperoni
grated Mozzarella cheese (Cheddar, if desired)
preparation: On split muffin, spread with canned pizza sauce. Add salami or pepperoni. Top with grated cheese and place under broiler until cheese is melted and begins to bubble.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  medium bell peppers
2  small onions
2  c. rice (uncooked)
3/4  tsp. salt
2  ripe tomatoes
1/2  c. cooking sherry
6  center-cut pork chops
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Layer pepper, tomatoes, onions, rice and pork chops in large baking dish.  Add salt and pepper.  Pour sherry over layers and bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour.  Serves 3 to 5.

name: CRESCENT ROLL SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1  tube refrigerated crescent rolls
sliced ham or turkey
cheese slices
preparation: Divide crescent roll triangles.  Place four on a cookie sheet and flatten the triangles a bit.  Place sliced meat on triangle, then cheese.  Cover tops of sandwiches with remaining triangles. Flatten and pinch top and bottom rolls together.  Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. paprika
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. catsup
1  c. brown sugar
1  medium onion, chopped
1  lemon, sliced or juice
preparation: Combine ingredients and cook for 5 minutes.

name: SKY-HIGH BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. whole-wheat flour
4 1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. cream of tartar
3/4  c. butter or margarine
1  egg, beaten
1  c. milk
preparation: Preparation Time:  20 minutes.  Rising Time:  1 1/4 hours. Baking Time:  30 minutes. Oven Temperature:  375°.

name: RHUBARB DESSERT
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. butter
4  Tbsp sugar
preparation: Put in bottom of 9 x 13 pan and bake for 15 minutes at 325°. Meanwhile, cook in heavy saucepan: 6 slightly beaten egg yolks, 3/4 c. cream, 3 c. sugar, 4 Tbsp flour and 4 c. rhubarb, cut. Watch closely while cooking until rhubarb in tender. Pour into crust and top with meringue. Brown slightly.

name: BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
cut up chicken parts
seasoned salt
preparation: Arrange  chicken in one layer in baking dish.  Sprinkle generously  with seasoned salt.  Bake at 350° until chicken is tender.

name: CHOCOLATE MAYONNAISE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. cold water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all together and pour into a greased and floured 9-inch square pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Frost with your favorite icing.

name: SHRIMP AND WILD RICE
ingredients:
1/2  c. grated onion
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  c. cooked, wild rice
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  lb. cooked shrimp
1/2  c. mushrooms
1/4  c. butter
1 soup  can water
dash of Tabasco
preparation: Saute onion and celery in butter.  Add seasonings, rice, soup and water.  Fold in shrimp.  Bake in baking dish 30 minutes at 350°.  Serve hot.

name: CHOCOLATE GRAVY
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  Tbsp. flour
3/4-1  c. water
preparation: Cook over medium heat until thick.  Remove from heat and add 3 tablespoons butter and 1 teaspoon of vanilla.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
5  c. potatoes, sliced thin
1 1/2  c. milk
4  Tbsp. butter
6  slices cheese
4  Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Make alternate layers of potatoes, butter, cheese, flour and salt in buttered baking dish. Add milk and bake, uncovered, in hot 400° oven for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: TANG SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans pineapple tidbits (don't drain)
2 small  cans mandarin oranges, drained
1/2  c. Tang
1  jar maraschino cherries, drained and halved
4  sliced bananas
1 large  box vanilla instant pudding
preparation: Mix together and chill.

name: MOCK SOUR CREAM
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. low-fat milk
1  c. creamed cottage cheese
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Put ingredients in blender container; cover and run on high until completely smooth.  Makes 1 cup.

name: K'S HAM DELIGHTS
ingredients:
1  lb. boiled ham
1  lb. Swiss cheese
1  medium onion (optional)
1  tsp. poppy seed
1  stick softened butter
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. each: Dijon, German and French mustard
3  pkg. small Pepperidge Farm rolls (20 count each)
preparation: Process ham, cheese and onion in blender separately.  Add remaining ingredients.  Split rolls.  Fill with mixture.  Wrap in tinfoil.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.  Do not let burn.

name: CARAMEL FROSTING
ingredients:
1  stick oleo, melted
1/4  c. milk
1 3/4 to 2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. brown sugar, packed
preparation: Boil  oleo  and  brown	sugar  2 minutes over low heat, stirring  constantly.  Add	milk  and  continue stirring until mixture  boils  again.  Remove  from heat; cool.  Add powdered sugar,  beating  well  until of spreading consistency.  If too thick, add a few more drops of milk or cream.

name: BAKED CHICKEN IN ORANGE-ALMOND SAUCE
ingredients:
4  skinless chicken breasts
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
dash of ginger
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. orange juice
1/2  c. sliced almonds
1/2  c. seedless raisins
preparation: Season chicken with 1/2 teaspoon salt.  Brown lightly in butter.  Arrange in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Mix flour, cinnamon, ginger and 1/4 teaspoon salt.  Add to drippings in skillet.  Make a smooth paste.  Stir in orange juice, almonds and raisins.  Stir until thickened and boiling.  Pour over chicken and bake, covered, for 45 minutes at 450°.  Then bake, uncovered, 10 minutes more. Makes 4 servings.
