name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can French-style green beans, drained
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. grated cheese
1  roll Ritz crackers
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Put drained green beans and corn in casserole dish.  Mix soup, onion, sour cream and cheese and pour on top of vegetables.  Crush crackers and mix with melted margarine.  Put atop casserole and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: APPLE COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
6  c. sliced apples
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Cook over medium heat until almost tender, stirring often.  Place in baking dish.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
1/3  c. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1 (8 3/4 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1/3  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper (I use jalapenos)
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In mixing bowl, combine first 6 ingredients.  Combine remaining ingredients; add to dry ingredients and stir only until moistened.  Pour into a greased 9-inch square baking pan or a 10-inch heavy skillet.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: SUMMER STEW
ingredients:
2  or 3 nice large green tomatoes
2  nice ripe tomatoes
2  green peppers
1  red pepper
4  or 5 medium potatoes, diced fine
2  medium onions, diced
1  stick oleo
cooking oil
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Chop vegetables into bite size pieces. Place all ingredients in heavy skillet and cook slow. You may want to boil potatoes a little before adding to the stew.

name: RITZ SLICES
ingredients:
6  c. water
3  c. sugar
6 heaping  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Bring this to a boil for 2 minutes.  Then add 72 Ritz crackers. Boil 2 minutes more.  Set aside for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

name: COOLED CARROTS
ingredients:
2  bunches carrots
1  can cream of tomato soup
1  c. vinegar
1 heaping  tsp. dry mustard
1 large  jar boiled onions, chopped (do not boil your own onions)
3/4  c. green peppers, chopped fine
1/2  c. cooking oil
1  c. sugar
preparation: Peel carrots; slice and boil in salted water for 10 minutes or until tender.  Drain and let cool.  Boil other ingredients for 5 minutes and pour over carrots while hot.  When cold, refrigerate. These will keep for several weeks in refrigerator.

name: BAGELS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. water
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  pkg. yeast
1  tsp. salt
5  c. flour
raisins or chopped onions (if desired)
preparation: Combine water, sugar, yeast and salt.  Add about 5 cups flour to the ingredients until stiff, then beat vigorously.   It is important to knead dough for a long time.  Let it rise once.  Then shape and roll out twelve ropes.  At this time, add raisins, broiled onions, etc.  Wet ends to join together.  Let rise until doubled.

name: CHEESE BALL-DRIED BEEF
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. cream cheese, softened
chopped green onion
1 small  pkg. dried beef, chopped small
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. Accent
preparation: Mix together cream cheese, onion, salt and Accent.  Add 2/3 chopped beef.  Shape into ball.  Press remaining beef on outside of ball.

name: CHEESY MEXICAN RICE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked rice
1  can creamed corn
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  c. butter
1 small  jar Mexican Cheez Whiz
salt to taste
preparation: Saute onion and pepper in butter until onion is clear.  Mix all ingredients together and bake in deep casserole dish for 30 minutes in 350° oven.

name: CHUNKY CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. butter or margarine
3/4  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1/4  c. dairy sour cream
1  c. coarsely chopped nuts
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate, coarsely chopped
preparation: Stir together flour, baking soda and salt. Cream butter or margarine. Gradually beat in sugars and continue beating until light and fluffy, about 5 minutes. Beat in vanilla, egg and sour cream. Gradually add flour mixture, beating until smooth after each addition. Stir in nuts and chocolate. Drop by scant quarter cupfuls onto a cookie sheet, leaving 2 inches between; flatten slightly. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool 1 minute. Remove from sheet. Cool on wire rack. Makes 2 dozen.

name: CAMPER STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
4  to 5 medium potatoes, sliced
4  to 5 carrots, sliced
1  onion
15  oz. can tomato sauce
salt and pepper (as desired)
preparation: Brown ground beef in frypan.  Drain off fat.  Place layers of potatoes, carrots and onions on top of ground beef.  Salt and pepper each layer as desired.  Pour tomato sauce over ingredients. Cook approximately 45 minutes on medium heat.  This recipe can also be prepared in crock-pot or in individual packets of aluminum foil and cooked over a campfire.  Delicious!

name: UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
1 (No. 2)  can crushed or sliced pineapple (apricots or peaches may be used)
1  white cake mix
preparation: Melt butter and brown sugar in 13 x 9 x 2-inch or 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan.  Drain pineapple.  Arrange fruit on mixture in pan. Mix cake mix into batter following directions on box.  Pour over fruit.  Bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes.  Invert on plate.  Let syrup drain onto cake before removing pan.

name: ZUCCHINI SALAD
ingredients:
3  medium zucchini, thinly sliced
2/3  c. cider vinegar
1/2  c. celery, cut fine
1/2  c. green pepper, diced
1/2  c. onions, cut fine
1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. oil
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours before serving.  Will keep up to 2 weeks.

name: TAMALE PIE(8 to 10 Servings)
ingredients:
10  oz. bean dip/refried beans
Tabasco sauce
2  large ripe avocados
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. sour cream
1  pkg. taco mix
10  oz. grated Monterey Jack and shredded Cheddar cheese
1  bunch scallions (green onions)
2  tomatoes, chopped
1  can black olives (optional)
preparation: First before chopping tomatoes with sharp knife, start a top of tomato and peel around top layer of skin. Will curl like a rose for center of dish. In 10-inch square baking dish, layer as follows. Mix first 2 ingredients for bottom layer. Mash avocados; blend lemon juice, mayonnaise, sour cream and taco mix. Spread over bean dip. Add cheese. Sprinkle chopped scallions. Put tomato rose in middle. Put olives around edge of dish. Fill in with chopped tomatoes. Refrigerate to combine flavors. Serve with favorite tortilla chips or crackers. Dip to reach all layers. Enjoy.

name: CRUSTLESS ZUCCHINI QUICHE
ingredients:
3  c. grated zucchini
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. biscuit mix
4  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. Parmesan or Mozzarella cheese, grated
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1/4  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients until zucchini is evenly coated.  Pour into buttered 10 x 6-inch or 13 x 4-inch pie plate.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.  Yields 6 portions.

name: FROSTY GREEN GRAPES
ingredients:
3  c. seedless green grapes, chilled
1/2  c. dairy sour cream
4  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Mix all together. Cover grapes well.

name: HELLO DOLLIES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine or butter
1  c. crumbled graham crackers
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Melt margarine in 9 1/2 x 11-inch pan.  Sprinkle crumbled graham crackers on top of butter. Sprinkle chocolate chips and butterscotch chips on top of cracker crumbs.  Dribble sweetened condensed milk on top.  Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. allspice
1 1/2  c. canned applesauce
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream butter, gradually add sugar; add eggs and beat well. Stir dry ingredients together.  Add alternately with applesauce. Stir in raisins and nuts.  Put in greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.  Cool in pan.  Serve with Cool Whip or lemon sauce.

name: MOCHA CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. sifted powdered sugar
1  large egg
1 1/2  tsp. instant coffee granules
1 1/2  tsp. water
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. milk chocolate morsels
2/3  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
sugar
preparation: Beat shortening and butter in a large mixing bowl at medium speed of an electric mixer until fluffy.  Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar and powdered sugar, beating well.  Add egg, beating well. Dissolve coffee granules in water; add to creamed mixture, beating well.  Combine flour and next 4 ingredients; gradually add to creamed mixture, beating well.  Stir in chocolate morsels and pecans.  Cover and chill 1 hour.  Shape into 1/2-inch balls; roll in additional sugar.  Place on lightly greased cookie sheets. Press with a fork to flatten.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.  Cool on wire racks.  Yield:  6 1/2 dozen.

name: LIVER AND ONIONS
ingredients:
3  tsp. butter or margarine
1  large onion, sliced
1  lb. chicken, pork or calf liver
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of black pepper
2  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Melt 2 teaspoons of butter in nonstick skillet.  Add onion and saute over medium heat about 10 minutes.  Remove onion from skillet.  Melt remaining butter and add liver.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Brown over medium heat about 3 minutes each side. Distribute onion evenly over browned liver in skillet.

name: CREAMY CUCUMBER SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  small to medium cucumber
3  tsp. Miracle Whip
preparation: Cream Miracle Whip and cream cheese until blended well.  Peel cucumber and slice lengthwise into quarters.  Cut out seeds. Finely dice.  Add to cream cheese mixture.  Chill.  Serve on cocktail rye bread.

name: RANCH POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
8  medium potatoes
1  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. red onion, chopped
1 (1 oz.)  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing mix
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. water
preparation: Peel, boil and cube potatoes; drain.  Combine with celery and onion.  Combine salad dressing mix, mayonnaise and water.  Add to potato mixture.  Toss to coat.  Chill and serve.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: BROWN BREAD(Yields 3 Cans Or 2 Loaves)
ingredients:
1  pkg. seedless raisins
1 3/4  c. water
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. shortening
1  egg, beaten
2 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Cook raisins in water for 5 minutes; cool.  Cream shortening and sugar; beat in egg.  Add raisin mixture.  Sift flour, soda and salt together.  Add to raisin mixture.   Bake at 350° for 1 hour in cans or loaf pans.

name: SAUSAGE GRITS
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk pork sausage
3  c. hot cooked grits (not instant grits)
2 1/2  c. (10 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. milk
pimento strips (optional)
parsley (optional)
preparation: Cook sausage  until  browned  in a heavy skillet; drain well. Spoon sausage  into  a  lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Combine  hot  grits,  cheese  and  butter.  Stir until cheese  and  butter  melt.  Combine eggs and milk;  stir into grits.  Pour  over  sausage.  Bake  at  350°  for 1 hour. Garnish with  pimento  strips and parsley, if desired.  Yield: about 15 servings.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Karo syrup
1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
1  c. pecans
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Pour into pie crust and bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until knife comes out clean.  Mmm-good!

name: CRESCENT ROLL LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. sausage
3/4  c. onion
1/2  tsp. garlic
1  tsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
6  oz. tomato paste
1/2  can Ro-Tel
1  small cottage cheese
1  egg
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
2  cans crescent rolls
2  c. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown meat; drain.  Add seasonings, tomato paste and Ro-Tel.

name: APPLE STRUDEL
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen puff pastry
1  can apple pie filling
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
1  c. powdered sugar
2 or 3  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Unthaw the pastry as directed on box. You can cut each sheet into 4's or you can leave whole. Mix sugar and cinnamon. Spread over dough not getting on the edges if making squares. Mix pie filling, raisins and nuts together and put a small amount on each square. Take water and dampen edges of dough; bring up opposite corners and press together real well. If making roll, spread on dough and roll up. Place on a lightly sprayed baking sheet and bake for 35 minutes at 375°.

name: PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  white or yellow cake mix
1  large instant vanilla pudding
2 1/2  c. milk
1  large plus 1 small softened cream cheese
1  lb. can crushed pineapple, well drained
12  oz. Cool Whip
crushed walnuts
preparation: Bake cake mix on edged cookie sheet at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden brown.  Let cool before topping.

name: FLAKY PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  c. Crisco
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
3  Tbsp. cold water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Blend flour, shortening and salt.  Cut in shortening until pieces are the size of small peas.  Beat egg; mix with water and vinegar.  Add to flour mixture and toss lightly with fork.  Roll out onto floured board or wax paper.  Makes 3 single crusts.

name: SEVEN-LAYER DIP
ingredients:
1  pt. sour cream
1  can refried beans
1  medium bag Muenster cheese
1  medium bag Cheddar cheese
1  jar medium salsa
1  jar guacamole
1  can black olives
tortilla chips
jalapeno peppers
preparation: Layer on platter in order:  Refried beans, 1/2 jar salsa, guacamole, sour cream, Muenster cheese, remaining 1/2 jar salsa, jalapeno peppers and Cheddar cheese.  Garnish with black olives. Use chips to dip.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3 1/2  c. flour (plain)
3  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. salad oil
4  eggs
2/3  c. water
2  c. canned pumpkin
preparation: Mix together sugar, flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg. Make a well in dry ingredients.  Add remaining ingredients and mix until smooth.  Pour into greased and floured loaf pans.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.  Makes 3 loaves.

name: CHICKEN ALMOND CREAM SOUP(Makes 1 1/2 quarts)
ingredients:
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. margarine, melted
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  qt. milk
2  tsp. chicken flavored bouillon granules
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. chopped cooked chicken
1/2  c. sliced almonds, toasted
preparation: Cook celery and onion in butter in a Dutch oven over low heat until tender.  Stir in flour and pepper; cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.  Gradually stir in milk.  Add bouillon granules and Worcestershire sauce.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly.  Stir in chicken and almonds; cook until thoroughly heated, stirring often.

name: APPLE LOAF
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
1  egg
4  medium-size apples, cored and chopped
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  c. raisins (optional)
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Combine shortening and sugar in large bowl; mix well.  Add egg; blend.  Add remaining ingredients; stir until dry ingredients are moistened.  Turn into greased, floured bread pan.  Sprinkle topping over mixture.

name: STRAWBERRY SHORTCUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. mini marshmallows
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. milk
3  eggs
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1 1/2  c. sugar
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Generously grease only bottom of pan.  Sprinkle marshmallows evenly over bottom.  Thoroughly combine thawed strawberries and syrup with Jell-O; set aside.  In large mixer bowl, combine remaining ingredients.  Blend at low speed until moist; beat on medium 3 minutes.  Pour batter evenly over marshmallows in pan. Spoon strawberry mixture over batter.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown.  Seve warm or cool with ice cream or whipped cream.

name: POPPY SEED CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, cubed
2  cans cream of chicken soup
8  oz. sour cream
1  stick margarine
2  Tbsp. poppy seed
1  roll Ritz crackers
preparation: Wash,  drain and cube chicken breasts.	Place in baking dish. Mix  together  soup  and sour cream; pour over chicken. Melt margarine and pour over soup mixture.  Crush Ritz crackers	and mix  with  poppy seed.  Sprinkle over dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: ENCHILADA SQUARES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1/4  c. chopped onions
3  eggs
5 1/2  oz. canned milk
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  envelope enchilada mix
1/3  c. ripe olives
2  c. corn chips
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook ground beef and onions until beef is cooked and onions are soft.  Drain excess fat.  Spread on bottom of 10 x 6-inch baking dish.  Beat 2 eggs, milk, tomato sauce and enchilada sauce mix.  Pour over meat.  Sprinkle with olives and top with corn chips.  Bake in a 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until firm in center.  Sprinkle with cheese and return to oven for 3 to 5 minutes.

name: SPAM PICNIC CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Creamettes (or any kind desired)
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of celery soup
1/4  lb. process cheese, cut into cubes, or can use grated
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. each chopped onion and green peppers
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  can Spam, cut into 12 (1/2-inch) slices
preparation: Cook Creamettes according to directions on package.  Combine soup, milk, onion and green peppers.  Place over low heat; add black pepper.  Also, add cheese, stirring occasionally, until melted.  Drain Creamettes and mix with the cheese sauce.  Pour half mixture in 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Cover with 6 slices of Spam.  Add balance of mixture with 6 more slices of Spam on top. When ready to serve, put in oven at 325° and bake 30 minutes or until it bubbles.

name: STUFFED BELL PEPPERS
ingredients:
8  bell peppers
1  lb. ground beef
1  can tomato sauce
2  eggs
2  c. rice
shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain. Stir in tomato sauce. Boil rice. Drain water. Add to ground beef.  Mix in 2 eggs.  Stuff peppers with mix. Sprinkle cheese over top.  Cook at 350° for about 30 to 45 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND WILD RICE
ingredients:
3  lb. broiler
1  large onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. curry
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. sherry
6  oz. pkg. wild long grain rice
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Place the first 6 ingredients in a Dutch oven and add enough water to cover chicken.  Heat to boil and cover and reduce heat. Simmer until tender.  Remove chicken from the bones and dice. Reserve 2 1/3 cups broth; use instead of water in cooking rice. Prepare rice and set aside.  Melt butter in skillet and add sliced mushrooms.  Cook until tender.  Place mushrooms and chicken in large bowl.  Stir rice with soup and cream.  Mix well.  Combine with other ingredients.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake for 50 minutes, covered, at 350°.

name: GRATED APPLE PIE
ingredients:
3  c. apples, grated, or more (if firm apples)
1  c. sugar or less
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  stick margarine, melted
1  Tbsp. flour
1  egg
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
2  qt. sliced potatoes
1  c. chopped onions
2  cans mushroom soup or cream of chicken soup
salt and pepper
1  stick butter
preparation: Slice potatoes and place in a 3 to 4-quart baking dish.  Add onions, salt and pepper.  Pour mushroom soup over vegetables.  Cut butter up over top.  Bake in a 350° oven until bubbly.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. vinegar
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. celery seed
1  bunch broccoli
1  bunch green onions
1  carton mushrooms
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients in saucepan.  Heat until sugar dissolves.  Let cool.  Chop broccoli, green onions (entire onion) and mushrooms.  Just before serving, toss veggies with dressing.

name: POPPY SEED CHICKEN
ingredients:
5  boneless chicken breasts
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
1  to 1 1/4 tubes Ritz crackers, crushed
1/2  stick margarine
3 to 4  tsp. poppy seeds
preparation: Combine chicken (cut into pieces), 2 soups, sour cream and water chestnuts.  Place in 9 x 13 cooking dish.  In a small bowl, place cracker crumbs.  Melt 1/2 stick margarine.  Pour over crackers.  Add poppy seeds.  Mix together.  Sprinkle cracker mixture over chicken.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: TEXAS SALSA
ingredients:
1  large tomato, chopped
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies
2  tsp. fresh cilantro or parsley
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients and allow to marinate 1 hour before serving.

name: FESTIVE APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1  pkg. Pillsbury crescent rolls
small cream cheese with chives
1/4  c. each: green pepper, red pepper, yellow pepper
preparation: Open crescent rolls and roll dough out flat onto very lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake until light brown in color.  Let cool. Chop peppers very fine.  Spread layer of cream cheese onto cooked rolls, then sprinkle on the peppers; cut into appetizer pieces. Very festive and pretty for the holidays.

name: FANTASY FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. margarine
2/3  c. evaporated milk
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
7  oz. jar Marshmallow Creme
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine sugar, margarine and milk.  Stir for 5 minutes over medium heat.  Remove from heat.  Add chocolate chips, Marshmallow Creme, nuts and vanilla.  Beat well.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch buttered pan.  Cool and cut into squares.

name: YUMMY DOUGH(Kids Recipe)
ingredients:
1/4  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. granola
preparation: Measure brown sugar and peanut butter into bowl.  Squeeze with hands.  Add granola (optional).  Explore dough freely.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  c. sliced squash
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. herb seasoning stuffing mix
1/2  c. margarine
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
1  c. carrots, shredded
preparation: Cook squash, onions and carrots in salted water for 5 minutes. Drain.  Combine soup and sour cream and add to first mixture. Combine dry stuffing mix with margarine.  Spread half in large baking dish.  Spoon vegetable mixture over this, then spread remaining stuffing on top.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: OVEN CRISP ZUCCHINI SPEARS
ingredients:
3  medium zucchini
1/3  c. corn meal
1/3  c. flour
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. onion powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1  egg, beaten
2  Tbsp. milk
3  Tbsp. margarine, melted
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Grease 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish.  Cut off and discard ends from zucchini.  Slice each zucchini in half lengthwise, then in half again, forming 12 spears.  Combine dry ingredients.  In shallow bowl, combine egg and milk.  Roll zucchini in corn meal mixture.  Dip into egg mixture, then again in corn meal to coat thoroughly.  Place in prepared dish.  Drizzle with margarine.  Bake 15 minutes.

name: HAMBURGER STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3  slices bacon, diced
1/4  c. chopped onion
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
dash of pepper
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. sherry
hot buttered noodles
preparation: Brown ground beef with bacon.  Add bacon; cook until tender. Drain off excess fat.  Add seasonings to meat mixture.  Stir in soup.  Cook slowly, uncovered, 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Stir in sour cream and sherry and heat through.  Do not boil. Serve on noodles.  Serves 4.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1  can artichoke hearts, drained and mashed
preparation: Stir all ingredients together, saving a sprinkling of Parmesan cheese for top.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Very good served with Triscuits crackers.

name: ZUCCHINI CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sour milk
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. firmly chopped zucchini
2 1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. chocolate chips
1/4  c. nut meats
preparation: Sprinkle top with more chocolate chips and nut meats. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: OVEN FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
Whole chicken, cut up
flour
salt and pepper
butter
preparation: Wash chicken pieces. Batter in flour, salt and pepper. Place on a 9 x 13 baking pan. Brush melted butter on top. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve.

name: PLAIN PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2 heaping  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  egg
water
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, salt and baking powder.  Make depression in center and add milk, then egg.  Stir.  Add water to thin.  Any leftover can be kept in Tupperware for several days.

name: DANDELION WINE
ingredients:
1  qt. blossoms (no stems)
9  lb. sugar
1/2  c. lemon juice
3  gal. water
3  lb. raisins
1  dry yeast
preparation: Bring water to a boil, add sugar and bring to a boil.  Remove from heat.  Put in blossoms, let stand until lukewarm.  Add yeast, dissolved in 1/2 cup lukewarm water.  Let stand 7 days, stirring in the morning and night.  After 7 days, strain through cheesecloth. Add raisins and lemon juice, let stand 2 weeks.  Do not stir! Strain after 2 weeks and put in bottles.  Do not cap too tightly. Let stand for 3 weeks before drinking.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. mashed potatoes
8  oz. cream cheese
1  small chopped onion
2  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
dry onion rings
preparation: Mix all together and pour into greased casserole dish.  Top with dry onions.  Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.

name: HOT TAMALES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  c. meal
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. red pepper
1  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. chili powder
3  Tbsp. cumin
1  tsp. table salt
1 1/4  c. water
preparation: Crumble raw ground beef well; mix together the next 7 ingredients well.  Then mix into the ground beef.  Add the water and mix well.  Form into cylinder shapes approximately 5 to 6 inches long and about as big around as your thumb.

name: PUMPKIN PECAN PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs, slightly beaten
2  c. pumpkin, cooked
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. dark corn syrup
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. pecans, chopped (save half for topping)
1/4  tsp. salt
1  pie shell
preparation: Mix all ingredients until mixture is smooth.  Pour into pie shell and top with pecans.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until set.

name: GRANNY'S FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  (2 to 3 lb.) fryers
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. milk
2/3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. paprika
vegetable oil
preparation: Cut up fryers.  Wash and drain well.  Mix milk and 1 teaspoon salt in a large container and place the chicken in the mixture. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.  Place flour and seasoning into a large plastic bag.  Shake to blend.  When ready to cook, shake several pieces of chicken in the bag at a time.  Heat oil until hot and place 4 to 5 pieces of chicken in the pan at a time.  Cook on high for a short time to brown, then turn heat to medium.  Cover pan and cook 5 to 7 minutes.  Turn chicken over and cook 5 to 7 minutes on the other side, covered.  Then turn heat up to complete browning other side.  Remove and drain well on paper towels. Serves 6.

name: COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
2  c. brown sugar
4  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped nuts
3  cans biscuits (10 per can)
preparation: Heat first 4 ingredients slowly until liquid form.  Stir frequently.

name: BAKED TOMATOES
ingredients:
1  tomato (per guest)
1/2  pkg. dry bread crumbs
minced onions
garlic salt
chopped parsley
salt and pepper
preparation: Cut slice off top of tomato. Mix seasonings and place small amount on top of tomatoes in shallow baking pot. Dot each tomato with butter. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 375°.

name: CALICO VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1 regular size  can french style green beans
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can green peas
1  can garbanzo beans
1  can red kidney beans
1  chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1  jar diced pimentos
1  chopped green pepper
1-1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. vegetable oil
1-1/4  c. vinegar
1-1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Pour this dressing over all the vegetables and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for several hours.

name: SPAGHETTI CABONARI
ingredients:
2  lb. bacon
1  c. red onions, chopped
1  c. green pepper, chopped
1  lb. spaghetti
3  to 4 eggs
fresh Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook spaghetti. In large skillet, cook bacon.  Pour off fat. Remove bacon.  Saute onions and pepper in butter.  Stir in cooked spaghetti.  Add crumbled bacon. Add eggs and stir until eggs are done.  Mix well. Put on plates and add Parmesan cheese. Serve immediately.  Serves 4 hungry people.

name: BROCCOLI POTATOES
ingredients:
4  or 5 medium potatoes, sliced
1/2  stick butter
1  can cream of broccoli soup
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Place sliced potatoes in baking dish.  Place butter slices on potatoes.  Put cream of broccoli soup over potatoes.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.  Remove from oven.  Put cheese on top; put back in oven until cheese melts.

name: DUTCH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sifted plain flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
3  Tbsp. butter Crisco
1  egg, beaten
2/3  c. milk
4  to 6 apples, peeled, cored and cut into eighths
1/2  c. sugar, mixed with 1 tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together. Work in Crisco. Mix to a light dough with egg and milk. Press into greased shallow baking pan. Top with the apples by pressing down into the dough. Sprinkle with the sugar and cinnamon mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cut into squares and serve hot with sweetened whipped cream.

name: FUDGE BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
2/3  c. cocoa
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
preparation: Melt butter; add cocoa and sugar.  Beat eggs; add them slowly. Add vanilla and flour.  Mix until smooth. Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

name: QUICK VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onions
2  c. coarsely cut cabbage
3  c. water
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can mixed vegetables
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can tomatoes
2 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. shell macaroni
preparation: Brown beef over medium heat.  Add remaining ingredients except macaroni.  Cover; bring to a boil.  Add macaroni.  Simmer for 15 minutes.  Yields 5 to 8 servings.

name: BLUEBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. Cool Whip
3/4  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. sugar
1  can blueberry pie filling
white cake mix
preparation: Bake cake as directed.  Bake 2 layers; cut in 1/2 to make 4 layers.  Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and powdered sugar together to use as the first layer mix.  Mix sugar and blueberry filling together to use as the second layer.  Spread layer mixes on top of cake layers.  Mix the 2 leftover mixes together; spread on cake to cover.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1  can artichoke hearts, well drained and chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
1 (3 oz.)  can Parmesan cheese
dash of garlic salt
dash of lemon juice
dash of Worcestershire
dash of hot sauce (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients well. Place in a 1 qt. casserole dish and bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Serve warm with wheat crackers or Melba toast rounds.

name: CHERRY-BANANA PIE
ingredients:
1  can cherries, drain
1 small  can crushed pineapple
7  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. red food coloring
2  c. sugar
6  bananas
3/4  c. pecans, chopped
whipped cream
preparation: Drain cherries and pineapple in separate cups.  Add enough water to make 2 cups.  Add cornstarch, salt, vanilla, food coloring and sugar in saucepan.  Add cherries and pineapple.  Cook until thick.  Let cool completely.  Add bananas and pecans.  Put into your favorite crust; top with whipped cream.  Chill.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  boxes frozen chopped broccoli
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Cook and drain broccoli.  Mix broccoli with other ingredients, spread in greased casserole dish.  Cover with bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: APLETS
ingredients:
2  envelopes Knox gelatine
1/2  c. cold applesauce
3/4  c. hot unsweetened applesauce
2  c. sugar
1  c. finely chopped walnuts
1  tsp. vanilla
powdered sugar
preparation: Soak gelatine in 1/2 cup cold applesauce for about 10 minutes. Add to hot applesauce and sugar.  Cook over low heat, stirring until quite thick, about 20 minutes.  Add walnuts and vanilla. Spread in a greased 8 x 8-inch pan and let stand overnight.  Cut in squares and roll in powdered sugar.

name: TERIYAKI SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. grated ginger
1  clove garlic
1  tsp. pepper
1  dash Tabasco sauce (optional)
preparation: Basic marinade for meat, poultry and seafood.  Marinating times depend on thickness.  Example:  chicken thighs equal 3 to 4 hours.  Thinly sliced (1/8 to 1/4-inch thickness) beef, 2 hours. Can be used as basting sauce.

name: PUPPY CHOW
ingredients:
9  c. Rice Chex cereal
12  oz. chocolate chips
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Melt chocolate pieces and peanut butter.  Pour over cereal and toss to coat well.  Put powdered sugar in plastic bag and shake until all pieces are coated. Place on cookie sheet to dry.

name: LEMON GLAZE
ingredients:
1  c. unsifted confectioners sugar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: In small bowl, blend together until smooth.

name: PORK CHOP POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
6  pork chops
vegetable oil
seasoned salt
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  (24 oz.) bag O'Brien hash browns
1 1/4  c. Cheddar cheese
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
preparation: Brown pork chops in lightly greased skillet.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper, set aside.  Combine soup, milk, sour cream, salt and pepper.  Stir in potatoes, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can Durkee onions.  Spoon mixture into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Arrange pork chops over potatoes and bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions and bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.

name: 7 LAYER DINNER
ingredients:
4  potatoes, peeled and sliced
4  carrots, cleaned and sliced
1  bell pepper, diced
1  onion, chopped
2  stalks celery, cleaned and cut into chunks
1  lb. ground beef
1 large  can stewed tomatoes
salt and pepper to taste
1  tsp. sugar (optional)
garlic powder (optional)
preparation: Layer each item as listed in casserole dish.  Cover with foil; bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. green pepper
3  cloves garlic, minced
2 1/2  c. diced tomatoes
3  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
3  bay leaves
3  c. water
3  lb. raw shrimp, cleaned
2  Tbsp. flour, mixed in cold water
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan.  Saute onion, celery and green pepper until soft, about 5 minutes.  Stir in garlic.  Fry about 5 more minutes.  Remove pan from direct heat and slowly stir in flour. Add parsley, bay leaves, salt, cayenne and tomatoes.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Add shrimp; cover and simmer 30 minutes.  Serve over cooked, fluffy rice.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: ONE DISH HAM BAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. (16 oz.) frozen broccoli cuts, rinsed and drained
1  can (10 3/4 oz.) condensed cream of mushroom soup
1  can (10 3/4 oz.) condensed cream of corn soup
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. onion powder
2  c. Bisquick original or reduced fat baking mix
1 1/2  c. milk
3  c. cut up low-salt cooked ham (chicken can be substituted)
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Mix broccoli, soups, 1 cup milk, the ham and onion powder in ungreased rectangular baking dish (13 x 9 x 2-inch).  Mix baking mix and milk.  Pour evenly over soup mixture. Sprinkle with parsley if desired.  Bake 27 to 30 minutes or until light golden brown.  Let stand at least 5 minutes.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: CHICKEN CHOW LEIN
ingredients:
2  c. diced chicken
1  c. diced onion
1  c. diced celery
1  can water chestnuts
1  c. bamboo sprouts
1/2  can chow mein noodles
2  cans mushroom or celery soup
2  cans water
1/2  can chow mein noodles
preparation: Mix first (8) eight ingredients together in large casserole baking dish.  Sprinkle top with 1/2 can chow mein noodles.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Serves 4 to 5.

name: SUPER CRABMEAT DIP
ingredients:
2 (6 1/2 oz.)  cans crabmeat, drained
1/2  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
2  tsp. horseradish
4  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. chopped green onions
salt and pepper to taste
1/4  c. catsup
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
paprika
preparation: Drain and remove cartilage pieces from crabmeat.  Combine other ingredients. Cover and chill.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
4  c. chicken broth
1  c. boiled chicken, diced
1  c. potatoes, cooked and diced
1/3  c. corn
1/3  c. carrots, cooked and diced
biscuits
preparation: Combine all ingredients in large saucepan.  Heat to boiling. Pour into a 9 x 14-inch casserole.  Top with biscuits.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until biscuits are lightly browned.

name: EASY CRABMEAT DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. block Philadelphia cream cheese
12  oz. jar Heinz cocktail sauce
6  oz. can crabmeat
preparation: Mix  crabmeat with  cocktail  sauce.  Pour  over  cream cheese.  Serve with Ritz crackers.

name: SAUTEED TOMATO SLICES
ingredients:
4  medium (firm) ripe tomatoes
1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
3  Tbsp. salad oil
preparation: Wash  tomatoes;  cut  stem  ends  off.	Mix  flour  and seasonings.  Cut tomatoes in 1/2-inch slices; dredge in flour. Saute in salad oil until brown on both sides, turning once.

name: Creamy Vegetable Casserole
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh mushrooms
3  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
6  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. milk
10  oz. frozen peas
8 1/2  oz. can pearl onions
1  can onion rings
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Saute mushrooms in the butter.  Blend in the flour, salt and pepper.  Add milk.  Cook and stir until thick and bubbly.  Add cream cheese; stir until melted.  Stir in peas and onions.  Turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake at 425° for 25 minutes. Sprinkle onion rings over casserole.  Bake an additional 5 minutes.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. elbow macaroni
1  can tuna
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. milk
1/3  c. onion, chopped
preparation: Cook and drain macaroni.  Add soup, milk, tuna and onion.  Mix together and pour in baking dish.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Tuna may be substituted with corned beef and garden peas may be added.

name: SEAFOOD MARINADE
ingredients:
2  c. orange juice
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. onion salt
1  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Marinate seafood 2 hours.  Bake, broil or grill.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. can drained sweet potatoes
1 large  can drained chunk pineapple
1  can apple pie filling
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. pecans, chopped
1/2  stick butter, melted
preparation: In casserole dish, put sweet potatoes, pineapple and pie filling; mix well.  In large bowl, mix sugar, pecans and butter. Pour over top of fruit and potatoes.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: SAUSAGE EGG BRUNCH(Servings:  8)
ingredients:
6  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
3  slices dry bread
1  lb. sausage, cooked, drained and cooled
1  c. cheese, grated
preparation: Add ingredients to sausage and top with grated cheese. Refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes, uncovered.

name: QUICK CHOCOLATE-CARAMEL CAKE
ingredients:
1  Duncan Hines moist deluxe devil's food cake mix
1 regular size  jar hot fudge
1 regular size  jar caramel topping
1  bag toffee bits or Skor candy bar, crushed (other crushed candy can be used)
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake according to instructions on box.  When cake is done, poke holes all over the top (about the size of a ball point pen). Heat hot fudge and spread over the top of the cake while it is still hot. Heat caramel and spread over the top. Let cool completely on counter or put in fridge. Top with whipped cream when ready to serve. Sprinkle candy bits on top. Store any leftovers in the refrigerator.

name: STUFFED BELL PEPPERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1/2  c. minced onion
1/4  c. minced bell pepper
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
4  large bell peppers
preparation: Saute the minced bell pepper and onion in butter.  Add ground meat and other ingredients.  Simmer for 30 minutes.  Core bell peppers; boil until tender.  Stuff with meat mixture.  Top with grated cheese, if desired.  Bake in 300° oven for 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
5  c. chopped, cooked chicken breast
3  c. cooked rice
1 1/2  c. salad dressing or mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. roasted, slivered almonds
1 small  can chunk pineapple, drained
1 small  can mandarin oranges
1 1/2  c. white grapes
preparation: Let chicken and rice cool; add all in large mixing bowl and chill.   Makes 12 servings.

name: FOUR LAYER DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1  stick oleo (butter)
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. Cool Wip
2  small or 1 large instant chocolate pudding
3  c. milk
1  (9 oz.)  Cool Whip
preparation: Mix flour and 1 cup pecans and melt oleo and mix for first layer.  Press into bottom of large dish or pan.  Bake at 350° until brown.  After it has cooled, blend cream cheese, confectioners sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip for second layer.  Mix instant chocolate pudding and 3 cups milk for third layer.  Spread Cool Whip for top layer.

name: CHESS CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  egg
1  stick softened margarine
1  c. chopped nuts
2  eggs
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  box powdered sugar
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Press the first 4 ingredients into a 13 x 9-inch pan that has been greased and floured.

name: DEVIL BURGERS
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
2  eggs
salt and pepper
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire
catsup
cracker crumbs
bacon strips
preparation: Make patties from mixture.  Wrap a bacon strip around each patty.  Broil 15 minutes each side.

name: TEA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  lb. chopped dates
1/2  lb. coarsely chopped nuts
2  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. sifted plain flour
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat  eggs.  Add sugar.  Beat until smooth.  Add flour, salt and baking powder.  Stir in dates, nuts and vanilla.  Mix well. Put  in greased small loaf pan.  Bake at 275° for about 1 1/2 hours.  Cool completely before turning out.

name: STICKY BUN TOPPING
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. light corn syrup or half and half corn syrup and honey
1/2  c. pecans or walnuts, chopped
1/4  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: In an 8-inch square or 9-inch round pan, melt butter.  Add sugar and corn syrup and heat until the sugar dissolves.  Sprinkle with pecans (walnuts) and raisins.

name: CHICKEN NEWBURG
ingredients:
3  c. chopped chicken
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can peas
1 small  jar chopped pimentos
Pepperidge Farm pastry shells
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except pastry shells, and heat thoroughly until simmering.  Serve over Pepperidge Farm pastry shells with tops removed.

name: CRANBERRY VODKA PUNCH
ingredients:
1/2  gal. cranberry juice cocktail
1  bottle (fifth or 750 milliliter) Wolfschmidt vodka
1  qt. ginger ale
1  qt. club soda
pineapple chunks
preparation: Combine cranberry juice cocktail and vodka in a large punch bowl.  Set a block of ice or mold in the center.  Add ginger ale and club soda; stir in gently to blend. Garnish with pineapple chunks.  Makes about 5 quarts or 40 (4 ounce) servings.

name: HERB DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. fresh tarragon or 1/4 c. dried
1  clove garlic, crushed
1/8  tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
1/2  c. olive oil
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Blend well and serve over mixed greens.  Yields 1 pint.

name: BEEF AND BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can lima beans
1  can red beans
1  can pork and beans
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  diced onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. tomato catsup
1/2  tsp. mustard
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
preparation: Brown beef in skillet and drain.  Mix rest of ingredients in large casserole dish.  Add beef.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN-CHIPPED BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. dried chipped beef
6  whole chicken breasts, boned
3  strips bacon, split lengthwise
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 large  carton sour cream
pepper to taste
preparation: Line 8 or 9-inch square casserole with dried beef.  Wrap each chicken breast with lengthwise strip of bacon and arrange in casserole.  Mix soup and sour cream together and pour over chicken.  Bake, uncovered, at 250° for four hours.

name: MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter flavored Crisco
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/3  c. molasses (Grandma's Molasses)
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
preparation: Preheat  oven  to 375°.  Combine Crisco and sugar, beat at medium speed until blended.  Beat in egg.  Blend in molasses. Combine  flour,  soda,  ginger  and  cinnamon.  Add  to mixture. Drop  round teaspoonful of dough in a dish of sugar. Roll.  Place on a baking sheet.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

name: CHEESEBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. Bisquick mix
3  eggs
2  tomatoes, sliced
1  c. Cheddar or American cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 400°; grease pie plate.  Brown beef and onions; drain and stir in salt and pepper.  Spread in pie plate.  Beat milk, Bisquick and eggs until smooth.  Pour in plate.  Bake 25 minutes.  Top with tomatoes and sprinkle with cheese.  Bake 5 more minutes until knife comes out clean.

name: TOM'S PERFECT EGGNOG
ingredients:
6  eggs
3/4  c. sugar, divided
1  pt. fresh cream
1  qt. milk
1  pt. good bourbon whiskey
grated nutmeg
preparation: Beat separately the yolks and whites of 6 fresh eggs.  Add 1/2 cup of sugar to the yolks while beating and 1/4 cup of sugar to the whites after they have been beaten very stiff.  Mix the egg whites with the yolks.  Stir in 1 pint of rich cream and 1 quart of milk. Then add 1 pint of good bourbon whiskey.  Stir thoroughly and serve very cold with grated nutmeg on each glass.  Yield:  6 pints of eggnog.

name: ICE CREAM JELLO MOLD
ingredients:
3  oz. box cherry Jell-O or your favorite flavor
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
8  oz. c. boiling water
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
8  to 10 maraschino cherries, cut in small pieces
1/4  c. walnuts, chopped fine
preparation: Melt ice cream completely  before  you are ready to use it. Add 1 cup  boiling  water  to  Jell-O;  dissolve  Jell-O. Then, add pint of ice cream.  After all ice cream is dissolved in Jell-O, add the rest of the ingredients and mix them with a spoon. Then pour Jell-O into  a mold and let it set overnight in refrigerator.  Do not use metal mold.

name: ZESTY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  c. green olive pieces, drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. Cheddar cheese, cubed
1  (8 oz.) container smoke flavored Cheddar or cheese spread
chopped parsley or nuts
preparation: Grate cheese.   Add olives and remaining ingredients.  Mix well. Cover bowl and chill thoroughly.  Shape chilled mixture into ball. Roll in parsley or nuts.

name: MICROWAVE TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 small  cans tuna
noodles, cooked (as many as you need for a 2-quart casserole)
1  onion, chopped
1/2 to 1  c. chopped celery
1  stick oleo
1  can cream of mushroom soup
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Saute onions and  celery  in stick of oleo in microwave for 5 minutes.  Combine  noodles,  tuna, soup, milk and onion-celery mixture.  Set  microwave  on Roast for 8 minutes.  Also good with yellow cheese added (Velveeta or Cheddar).

name: MAGIC COOKIE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter, melted
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. chocolate chips
1 1/2  c. coconut
1  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan, pour melted butter.  Grease sides also.  Now add rest of ingredients, one by one, on top of the other.  Pour condensed milk over all.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Cool for 15 minutes before cutting.

name: BUNSTEADS
ingredients:
1  c. tuna
2  hard-boiled eggs
2  Tbsp. sweet pickle
2  Tbsp. stuffed olives
1/4  lb. sharp cheese, cubed
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Chop hard-boiled eggs, sweet pickle and stuffed olives, then measure.  Mix together all ingredients.  Fill hot dog rolls with mix.  Wrap in foil.  Heat at 350° for approximately 25 minutes. Try chicken or ham instead of tuna.

name: AMBROSIA PARFAIT
ingredients:
1  c. cold milk
1  pkg. (4 serving size) jello vanilla flavor instant pudding mix
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  small banana (chopped)
1  can (8 oz) crushed pineapple, undrained
1  can (11 oz.) mandarin orange sections, drained
1/2  c. toasted almonds (sliced)
1/2  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Beat pudding mix and milk with wire whisk 1 to 2 minutes.  Mix in 1/2 c. marshmallows, the banana and pineapple with juice.  Spoon some of mixture into parfait glasses.  Add a layer of the remaining ingredients, alternate with layers of pudding.  Chill.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
4  diced ripe tomatoes
2  chopped green onions
1/2  clove garlic, pureed or 1 tsp. granulated
1 1/2 to 2  oz. lime juice
1/2  bunch cilantro leaves, chopped
1  oz. salad oil
diced jalapeno to desired hotness
1  small diced onion
3  oz. tomato juice
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix together all ingredients.

name: LIME PICKLES
ingredients:
8  lb. medium cucumbers
2  c. hydrated lime
2  gal. cold water
2  qt. vinegar
8  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. whole cloves
1  Tbsp. mixed pickling spices
preparation: Slice cukes in 1/4-inch slices.  Cover with lime and water. Soak 24 hours.  Rinse well.  Cover with ice water for 3 hours. Drain and cover with other ingredients.  Let stand overnight. Boil gently about 35 minutes.  Pack in jars.  This makes a crisp pickle.  Add a little green coloring if desired.  Makes a pretty garnish around meats etc., also.

name: MOM'S CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. cocoa, mixed with 1/2 c. hot water
1  c. sour milk (add vinegar to make milk sour)
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Bake in 2 (8-inch) pans or oblong pan at 350° until cake tests done.  This cake is for anyone who still likes to dunk their cake.

name: CORNISH HENS MANDARIN
ingredients:
4  Cornish hens
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. orange marmalade
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Combine the ingredients and marinate hens overnight.  Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Bring marinade to boil, then baste hens while baking.

name: SALADE NICOISE
ingredients:
3  c. sliced, cooked new potatoes
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
2  tomatoes, cut into wedges
2  c. cooked cut green beans
1/3  c. wine vinaigrette
4  c. salad greens
small, pitted, ripe olives
preparation: Sprinkle potatoes with vinegar; let stand 1 hour.  In another bowl, toss tomatoes and green beans with vinaigrette; let stand 1 hour.

name: LONDON BROIL
ingredients:
1  (1 to 1 1/2 lb.) beef flank steak or top round steak
1/4  c. cooking oil
2  Tbsp. vinegar or lemon juice
1  clove garlic, minced
preparation: Score meat by making shallow cuts at 1-inch intervals diagonally across steak in a diamond pattern.  Repeat on 2nd side. Place meat in a plastic bag set into a shallow dish.

name: HOT CINNAMON TWISTERS
ingredients:
1/3  c. sugar
1 1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. butter
1 (5 oz.)  pkg. refrigerated biscuits
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Grease cookie sheet.  In small bowl, combine sugar and cinnamon. In a small saucepan, melt butter over low heat.  With hands, flatten each biscuit to a 4-inch circle. Dip in butter, then cinnamon-sugar mixture.  Twist 2 or 3 times. Place on cookie sheet.  Bake 12-15 minutes.

name: MEAT-POTATO DINNER
ingredients:
1  lb. round steak
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  small onions, sliced very thin
3  Tbsp. Crisco
2  c. water
3  thinly sliced potatoes
salt and pepper
paprika
garlic salt
preparation: Melt Crisco in skillet.  Cut steak into small cubes and flour; now add to Crisco in skillet and brown.  Add onion and cook until tender.  Put into a casserole and sprinkle with the 3 tablespoons flour, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/8 teaspoon pepper and some garlic salt. Pour the 2 cups water over this.  Cover and bake in a 350° oven for about 50 minutes.  Remove from oven and place potatoes on top. Sprinkle with salt and paprika.  Turn oven to 450°.  Bake 30 minutes.

name: THREE BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  medium onion, chopped
2  c. rice, uncooked
1 (15 oz.)  can garbanzo beans or chick peas, drained
1 (15 oz.)  can kidney beans, drained
1 (15 oz.)  can black beans, drained
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, drained
1 (4 oz.)  can green hot chilies, drained
3 1/2  c. water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, thawed
salsa or Tabasco sauce (optional)
preparation: This casserole requires only 15 minutes preparation time.  A great dish for those busy Moms and Dads.

name: CAJUN PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (1 oz.)  pkg. dry onion soup mix
3  c. water
2  c. instant uncooked rice
1 (4.5 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
6  (approximately 3/4-inch) pork chops
1  Tbsp. Tabasco
salt to taste
Tony Chachere Creole seasoning
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Clean and season pork chops with Tony's seasoning and place in bottom of casserole dish. Mix soup mix, water, rice and mushrooms together and pour on top of chops. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour. When cooked, remove pork chops and sprinkle with salt. Set aside. Add Tabasco to rice mixture and mix.

name: CLAM SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  cans minced clams
1/2  can chicken broth
1/3  c. olive oil
1  tsp. minced garlic
1/3  c. chopped fresh parsley
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  lb. spaghetti
preparation: Drain clam liquid into measuring cup and add chicken broth to make 1 cup.  Set aside.  Heat oil in pan and saute garlic and parsley for 1 minute.  Add clam liquid, clams, salt, pepper and simmer for 2 minutes.  Take off heat and stir in butter.  Pour over spaghetti.

name: BAKED PORK TENDERLOIN
ingredients:
1  pork tenderloin
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2 1/2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. ginger
1 (1 lb.)  can applesauce
1/2  c. wine
1/2  c. soy sauce
preparation: Season flour with salt and pepper.  Rub both sides of roast with flour mixture, then brown in butter.  Place in oven serving dish.  Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of fat.  Brown onion and garlic, then stir in ginger.  Mix together applesauce, wine and soy sauce; stir into onion mixture.  Simmer 1 minute, then pour over pork.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Makes 6 servings.

name: EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  slices white bread, cubed
1  stick butter or oleo
1 1/2  c. shredded Velveeta cheese
5  to 6 eggs, beaten well
2  c. milk
1  lb. sausage, browned and crumbled
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
2  eggs
1  piece thick Italian bread, toasted
fresh Parmesan or Romano cheese, grated
1 thick  slice Canadian bacon, lightly fried
Hollandaise sauce of your choice
preparation: Separate eggs.  Whip whites in copper bowl, if available.  If whites won't stiffen to peaks, beat in pinch of cream of tartar. Spoon whipped whites to perimeter of toast.  Layer on Canadian bacon.  Arrange egg yolks on top of bacon.  Bake at 350° to 370° until desired doneness is reached.  Ladle Hollandaise over dish. Top off with grated cheese.

name: CHOCOLATE BREAD
ingredients:
1  stick butter
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour, sifted
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1  c. hot water
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Cream sugar and butter; add eggs.  Add flour and buttermilk. Melt chocolate and add 1/2 cup hot water.  Add to batter.  Bring to boil the other 1/2 cup of hot water.  Add soda and immediately add to batter.  Add vanilla last.  Bake in a greased loaf pan filled 3/4 full.  (There will be extra batter for cupcakes.)  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.  Keep in refrigerator.

name: ASPARAGUS ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
3  oz. Roquefort or Bleu cheese
1  egg, whipped
1 or 2  cans asparagus spears
thinly sliced bread, crust removed
preparation: Mix softened cheeses and egg together until smooth.  Roll bread thin with rolling pin.  Spread cheese mixture on bread.  Roll up asparagus spears in bread and coat with butter (melted). Refrigerate or freeze.  To serve:  Slice in 1/3-inch rounds.  Bake 15 minutes at 400°.

name: PESTO OVEN FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  C pesto
4  pieces chicken
1/2  C dry seasoned bread crumbs
preparation: Heat oven to 400°F.  Line pan with aluminum foil.

name: DORIS' DESSERT BARS
ingredients:
1  pkg. cake mix (any flavor; I like lemon supreme cake mix)
1  stick melted oleo
2  beaten eggs
1  (8 oz.) softened cream cheese
2  eggs
1  lb. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients and spread in greased pan. Top with the mixture of cream cheese, eggs and powdered sugar.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: QUICK AND EASY CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  cup chopped onion
1/2  cup chopped celery
4 (14.5 oz.)  cans chicken broth
1/2  lb. chopped cooked chicken
1 1/2  cup egg noodles
1  cup sliced carrots
1/2  tsp. dried basil
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In a large pot over medium heat, melt butter. Cook onion and celery in butter until just tender, about 5 minutes. Pour in chicken broth. Stir in chicken, noodles, carrots, basil, oregano, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink and soup is hot.

name: ARIZONA SKILLET DINNER(Heart Healthy)
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. corn oil
1  medium onion, chopped
1  medium green pepper, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. ground cumin
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (28 oz.)  can whole tomatoes, undrained and coarsely chopped
1 (15 oz.)  can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen corn, thawed
8  oz. elbow macaroni (1 3/4 c.), cooked and drained
1/2  c. (2 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: In a large skillet, heat corn oil.  Add vegetables and seasonings.  Saute until vegetables are tender.  Add tomatoes, beans and corn.  Bring to a boil.  Simmer, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes.  Toss with macaroni.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Yield:  8 servings.

name: ITALIAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1/2  onion, diced
1  tsp. dried rosemary
1/2  c. dry wine
2  cloves garlic, minced
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Saute onions in olive oil.  Add chicken and fry until done. Drain off oil.  Prepare wine, garlic, tomato sauce and rosemary and pour over chicken.  Cook 10 minutes.

name: GRANDMA'S SYRUP PIE
ingredients:
1  c. dark Karo syrup
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. oleo, melted
3  whole eggs
1  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Beat eggs.  Mix sugar and flour together.  Add to eggs.  Add butter and syrup.  Add pecans last.  Bake in an uncooked pie shell in a 350° oven for 1 hour.  This is for an 8-inch pie plate.

name: OMELET(For 6 to 8 People)
ingredients:
shredded hash brown potatoes, browned
6  to 8 eggs, beaten
green diced peppers
diced onions
diced mushrooms
a few strips bacon, fried, or cut ham
shredded cheese
preparation: Brown hash brown potatoes on both sides.  Place in bottom of baking dish.  Beat eggs; pour over hash browns, then layer green peppers over the eggs, then also onions and mushrooms.  Fry a few strips of bacon or cut ham and layer over that and add shredded cheese.  Bake until cheese melts and browns and eggs are cooked.

name: FROSTY TREASURES
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. creamy peanut butter
6  c. Kellogg's Crispix cereal
2  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: In a small bowl, combine chocolate morsels and oil.  Microwave on High 1 1/2 minutes or until chocolate melts.  Stir in peanut butter.  Pour mixture over Crispix cereal.  Place confectioners sugar in a gallon size storage bag.  Add coated cereal and close bag tightly.  Shake bag gently until all cereal is thoroughly coated with sugar.  Refrigerate in airtight container.  Yields 8 cups.

name: RAISIN BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. regular flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
3  c. Raisin Bran
1 1/4  c. milk
1  egg
1/2  c. soft shortening
preparation: Stir together flour, baking powder, salt and sugar; set aside. In another large bowl, stir Raisin Bran and milk to combine.  Let stand 2 minutes.  Add egg and shortening.  Beat well.  Add dry ingredients to cereal mixture and stir until mixed only.  Pour batter evenly into 12 greased muffin cups.

name: WALDORF STYLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. tart red apple, diced
2  tsp. lemon juice
dash of low calorie sweetener
1  tsp. rice vinegar
tiny pinch of dry mustard and paprika
1  c. celery, diced
preparation: Combine apple with the lemon juice, sweetener, vinegar, dry mustard and paprika.  Make sure that apple is coated with lemon juice which will prevent browning.  Toss in celery.  Good accompaniment to cottage cheese.

name: JOHNNY MAZETTE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  c. chopped green peppers
2  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  can tomato soup
1/2 (15 1/2 oz. size)  jar Ragu spaghetti sauce
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. pepper
1 large  can mushrooms (do not drain)
1  lb. noodles
2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Brown meat.  Add rest of ingredients.  Cook 5 minutes.  Cook noodles, then add to the sauce.  Spread cheese on top.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan for 30 to 35 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1 large  c. margarine
5  tsp. soda
5  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  c. Nabisco Shredded Wheat and 2 c. boiling water
4  c. Kellogg's All-Bran
4  eggs, beaten
preparation: Cream sugar and margarine. Sift soda, flour and salt. Pour boiling water over crushed wheat and let cool. Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs, buttermilk and cooled wheat. Sift dry ingredients and add all at once with bran. Mix until moist. Fill tins 2/3 full. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes. Will keep in refrigerator 5 weeks or more. One pint makes 1 dozen. Makes several dozen. Can do ahead.

name: TWINKIE SALAD
ingredients:
1  box Hostess Twinkies (slice)
4  bananas (slice)
1 medium  can crushed pineapple
2  boxes instant French vanilla pudding
1  small container Cool Whip
preparation: Slice Twinkies	in  half; put in oblong dish with cream up. Then  slice bananas, then crushed pineapple.  Fix pudding like the box says  to  do.  After  it is thick, add Cool Whip, then put on top.  You can put nuts on top if you like.

name: ONION SOUP
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
5  onions, chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. water
6  c. beef stock or canned beef broth
salt and pepper
chopped parsley
preparation: Save onions in butter until golden brown.  Add the salt and water and cook over medium heat until the water is reduced to 1/2 cup.  Add the beef stock and season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve garnished with chopped parsley.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: BUTCH'S GOULASH
ingredients:
1  whole Chicken
5  large Potatoes
2  large Onions
1/2  bag (16 oz.) baby Carrots
8  slices bread
preparation: In a large pot, add salt and chicken.  Cover in water and cook until done.  Remove chicken (do not drain off water) and cut up and debone.  Add potatoes, carrots and onions.  Cook until potatoes are tender. Do not stir. Add bread to thicken.  Add salt and pepper to taste.

name: WHOLE WHEAT BREAD
ingredients:
3 3/4  c. warm water
3  pkg. dry yeast
6  Tbsp brown sugar
4  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. margarine
2  eggs
10 to 11  c. whole wheat flour, divided
preparation: Stir yeast in water until dissolved; add brown sugar, salt, margarine, eggs and 2 cups whole wheat flour.  Stir until mixed. Add 8 to 9 more cups flour; knead until mixed.  Put in big Tupperware bowl and seal with lid.  Wait 30 minutes.  Divide into 4 parts.  Put in loaf pans, cover with towel and wait about 30 minutes until it has risen.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: DELICIOUS BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. (2 c.) navy beans, dried
2 1/2  qt. water
1  meaty ham bone (1 1/2 lb.)
1  clove garlic, minced
1  small bay leaf
1  c. cubed potatoes
1  c. celery, thinly sliced
1  c. onion, finely chopped
1  c. carrots, cubed
salt and pepper
preparation: Boil the beans in the water for 2 minutes before removing them from the heat to let stand for 1 hour.  Then add the ham bone, garlic and bay leaf to the beans.  Cover and simmer them for 2 hours or until the ingredients are almost tender.  Add the vegetables and salt and pepper to taste; simmer them for 1 hour longer.  Remove the ham bone; cut off the meat and dice it to add to the beans.  Reheat the soup almost to boiling; then remove the bay leaf.

name: FRITO PIE
ingredients:
1 large  can chili without beans
1  large bag Fritos
1  large onion, chopped
preparation: Heat can of chili without beans.  Add large bag of Fritos and onion.  Pour into baking dish.  Top with cheese and bake until cheese is melted.  Serve with garlic bread.

name: RASPBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
1  pkg. raspberry Kool-Aid
1  c. sugar
1 large (48 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 large (48 oz.)  can water
1  qt. 7-Up
preparation: Dissolve Kool-Aid and sugar in water.  Add pineapple juice. Add 7-Up last.  Yields 1 gallon.

name: HOT FRUIT
ingredients:
2  cans peach slices
2  cans pears, sliced
2  cans chunk pineapple
1  bottle red maraschino cherries
3  bananas, sliced
1  stick butter
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1  c. peach juice
preparation: Cook in a large kettle for 25 minutes on top of stove, stirring occasionally.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. cranberries
2  oranges, unpeeled
2  pkg. raspberry Jell-O
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. celery
1  c. walnuts
preparation: Grind together cranberries, oranges and celery.  Add sugar; let stand 1 hour.  Dissolve Jell-O in 1 3/4 cups hot water.  Add with other ingredients in oblong baking dish.  Refrigerate until set.

name: CRANBERRY SAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can cranberry sauce
3  c. flour
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. orange juice
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. mayonnaise
grated rind of 1 orange
preparation: Grease tube pan; line bottom with wax paper.  Reserve 1/4 cup cranberry sauce for frosting.  Stir dry ingredients into large bowl.  Add remaining sauce, nuts, mayonnaise and orange rind.  Mix well.  Stir in orange juice and pour into prepared pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.  Remove from pan and frost with Cranberry Frosting.

name: SHRIMP & CRAB CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  green pepper
1  celery stalk
1  medium onion
2   cans - 6 oz. shrimp
2   cans - 6 oz. crab
1   c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1   tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1   c. buttered crumbs
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Finely chop green pepper, celery and onion.  Drain shrimp and crab.  Mix all ingredients.  Top with bread crumbs.  Reduce heat to 350° and cook 30 minutes.

name: YUMMY-MANDARIN DESSERT
ingredients:
2  small or 1 large orange pineapple Jell-O
1 1/2  c. hot water
2  cans mandarin oranges
No. 2 size crushed pineapple
preparation: Use juice  from  these;  in  all you should have 3 cups liquid.  Mix together and let stand until firm.

name: SPAGHETTI PIZZA
ingredients:
10 to 12  oz. spaghetti
1/2  stick melted butter
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese
1  pkg. Hormel pepperoni, sliced
1 regular size  jar Ragu or Prego spaghetti sauce
preparation: Boil, rinse and drain spaghetti, then put into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Toss with Parmesan cheese and butter.  Top with Mozzarella cheese.  Cover with pepperoni slices.  Top with spaghetti sauce.  Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.  Bake at 350° until cheese is melted, approximately 20 to 25 minutes.

name: SICILIAN STEAK SANDWICH
ingredients:
6  cube steaks
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  large green pepper, sliced
1/4  c. Italian salad dressing
1  large onion, sliced
1  large tomato, sliced
6  French bread loaves, split
6  slices Provolone or Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cook meat in margarine.  Cook green pepper in dressing 5 minutes.  Add onion and tomato; continue cooking for 5 additional minutes.  For each sandwich, place meat on the bottom half of the French bread loaf; cover with vegetables.  Top with a cheese slice and place under the broiler until the cheese melts just slightly.

name: CHICKEN WITH MUSHROOM GRAVY(Low Calorie - 230 Calories)
ingredients:
6  chicken breast halves
1  c. tomato juice
1 (4 oz.)  can mushroom pieces, drained (reserve liquid)
1/3  c. finely chopped onion
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. basil leaves
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
2  tsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Place skinned chicken in a heated skillet treated with vegetable spray-on.  Brown chicken.  Pour tomato juice and mushroom liquid over chicken; stir in onion, parsley, salt, basil leaves and garlic powder.  Cover and simmer about 60 minutes or until chicken is done.  Stir in mushrooms.  Mix cornstarch and water and stir into liquid in skillet.  Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and boils.  Boil and stir 1 minute.  Serves 6.

name: OLIVE SPREAD
ingredients:
6  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. olives
2  Tbsp. olive juice
dash of pepper
preparation: Let cream cheese stand at room temperature until it's soft. Mash with a fork and add mayonnaise.  Chop up pecans until you have 1/2 cup.  Chop up one cup of olives.  Put them in your bowl and add olive juice with a dash of pepper.  No salt!  Stir well. This will be mushy, but it's supposed to be that way.  Put this in a pint jar and refrigerate for at least 24 to 48 hours.  It will thicken.

name: COCONUT SHRIMP
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. white wine or beer
1  lb. medium shrimp (24 to 1 lb.), shelled and deveined
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. coconut (shredded)
1 1/2  c. oil (for frying)
preparation: Whisk together the flour and wine or beer until batter is smooth.  Dip shrimp in batter, then dip into the shredded coconut, turning to coat all sides.  Pour oil into large, deep frying pan; heat over high heat to 375°.  To be sure oil is hot enough, drop shred of coconut into oil; it should begin sizzling immediately.  Fry shrimp in 2 to 3 batches without crowding, turning occasionally, until cooked through and curled and coconut is golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove shrimp with a slotted spoon; drain on paper towels.  Serve hot.  Makes 8 servings (3 shrimp each).

name: HAMBURGER DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion
1  green pepper
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
1  jar salsa
Fritos corn chips
preparation: Brown ground beef, green pepper and onion in skillet.  Drain grease. Add Philadelphia cream cheese and salsa.  Heat until cheese is melted and place in crock-pot. Serve with "dip size" Fritos corn chips.

name: CARROT AND ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. carrots, peeled and cut diagonally (1/2-inch slices)
3  to 4 small zucchini
1/2  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. grated onion
3/4  tsp. horseradish
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
Italian bread crumbs to taste
1/4  c. butter, melted
preparation: Cook carrots and zucchini in small amount of boiling, salted water for 5 minutes or until tender.  Drain well, reserving 1/4 cup cooking liquid.  Combine liquid with mayonnaise, onion, salt, pepper and horseradish.  Add to veggies, stirring well.  Spoon mixture into lightly greased pan.  Combine bread crumbs and melted butter; sprinkle over casserole.  Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes or until bubbly.

name: VEGGIE BARS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  cans refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1 (1 oz.)  envelope Ranch-style salad dressing mix
1  medium size sweet red pepper, chopped
1  medium size green pepper, chopped
3/4  c. (3 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. coarsely chopped broccoli flowerets
1/2  c. coarsely chopped fresh mushrooms
preparation: Unroll crescent roll dough.  Place in a lightly greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan, pressing edges and perforations together to line bottom of pan.  Bake at 350° for 7 to 8 minutes or until browned.  Cool.

name: APPLESAUCE RAISIN MUFFINS(Sugar-Free)
ingredients:
1  large egg
2  Tbsp. oil
1 1/2  c. unsweetened applesauce
2  c. unbleached white flour
3/4  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. raisins
preparation: Beat together egg, oil and applesauce.  Add flour, baking soda, baking powder and spices; beat well.  Stir in raisins. Spoon batter into oiled and floured muffin tin.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes or until firm to the touch and browned.  Cool on wire racks.  Delicious topped with cream cheese.

name: LEMON CHESS PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. cornmeal
4  eggs
1/4  c. butter, melted
1/4  c. milk
4  Tbsp. lemon rind, grated
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
preparation: Toss together lightly the sugar, flour and cornmeal. Add remaining ingredients and beat until smooth and thoroughly blended. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes or until top is golden brown.

name: CHILI DE SAN MIGUEL
ingredients:
8  - 10 lbs. ground beef
2  -3  lbs. ground Italian sausage
5  large onions, chopped
6  long green chiles, roasted, skinned
5- 29  oz. cans peeled tomatoes, mashed
5- 29  oz. cans crushed tomatoes
3- 12  oz. cans Rotel original tomatoes, chopped
5- 29  oz. cans chili beans
10- 16  oz. cans pinto beans, jalapenos optional
10- 16  oz. kidney beans
2  oz. ground cumin
3  oz. chili powder
1 1/2  Tbsp. green tabasco
1/4  c. salt
preparation: Sauté onions.  Brown meats.  Add all ingredients to a 40 quart pot.  Heat slowly, stirring often.  Simmer for at least 3 hours. Do not let it scorch.  Serve with favorite toppings (onions, cheese, crackers or Fritos).

name: OATMEAL DATE COOKIES
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
2  c. light brown sugar
1  c. butter and lard, mixed
1  tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 Tbsp. sour milk
3  c. oatmeal
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix, roll out and cut into squares.  Put together like a sandwich with date filling in between.

name: SENATOR RUSSELL'S SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
3  c. mashed sweet potatoes (boil in skin)
1  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Remove skins from potatoes.  Thoroughly mix together potatoes, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, and butter.  Pour into buttered casserole.

name: WILD RICE AND SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. long grain and wild rice (about 4.5 oz. size)
1 (10 oz.)  can beef stock
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
3  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Butter 2-quart casserole.  Cook rice as directed, but use beef stock instead of water.  Thaw and warm spinach in microwave, then squeeze out water.   Mix with cream cheese until well mixed.   Saute mushrooms in butter and keep the juice.

name: QUICK CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. Crisco
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Place sugar and flour in large bowl.  Bring margarine, Crisco, cocoa and water to a rapid boil.  Pour this slowly over the flour and sugar mixture, beating well.  Add buttermilk; mix.  Add eggs; mix, then add cinnamon and vanilla.  Pour into a well-greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 400° for 20 to 22 minutes (bake at 375° if glass pan is used).  Icing is spread over cake in pan immediately  after removing from oven.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
4  cans buttermilk biscuits (10 oz. can)
2/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Quarter each biscuit and put into a bag with the cinnamon and sugar.  Shake well.  Place biscuits in  a Bundt pan.

name: BUTTERNUT CRUNCH CANDY
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. water
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. walnuts
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate pieces, melted
preparation: Combine sugar, salt, water and butter.  Heat to boiling.  Cook to light crack stage (285°).  Add 1/2 cup nuts.  Pour into well-greased cookie sheet.  Cool.  Spread half of chocolate mixture over top and sprinkle with 1/2 cup walnuts.  Cool.  Turn over and spread remaining chocolates and sprinkle with remaining nuts. Break into pieces to serve.  Makes 2 dozen pieces.

name: ESCALLOPED CARROTS
ingredients:
4  c. sliced, peeled carrots
1  medium onion, chopped
3  tsp. butter
1  can condensed cream of celery soup, undiluted
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  c. herbed bread stuffing
1/2  c. melted butter
preparation: Cook carrots and drain.  Cook onion in 3 teaspoons butter until soft.  Stir in soup, salt, pepper, cheese and carrots. Place in greased 2-quart casserole.  Toss stuffing in 1/2 cup melted butter, sprinkle over top.  Place in 350° oven for 20 minutes.

name: TACO SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground round
1  onion, chopped
1  tsp. garlic salt
1 (15 oz.)  can Ranch Style beans
1 (16 oz.)  can dark red kidney beans
1 (16 oz.)  can garbanzo beans, drained
1 (11 oz.)  can Shoepeg corn, drained
1 (10 oz.)  can mild Ro-Tel diced tomatoes
1  pkg. mild taco seasoning (dry)
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch Style dip mix
3  cans water (use can corn came in)
1/4  c. Minute rice
preparation: Brown ground round and onion in a Dutch oven or similar pan. Add the remaining ingredients, EXCEPT rice. Bring mixture to a boil; reduce heat. Add rice. Simmer for about 5 minutes. Makes approximately 12 cups.

name: LIME JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
4  large marshmallows
1  c. pineapple juice
1  pkg. lime Jell-O
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  pkg. (3 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  c. whipping cream
preparation: Melt marshmallows in pineapple  juice.  Add  the Jell-O and stir until dissolved.  While  the  mixture  is still warm, stir in cream cheese, crushed  pineapple and pecans.  Place in refrigerator  to cool.  When  cold,  fold  in  whipped  cream. Chill until firm.  Serve on lettuce  leaf  as a salad or plain as a dessert.

name: BEEF BARBECUE
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. chuck roast (boneless)
1  large onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. catsup
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
