2  Tbsp. mustard
2  tsp. chili powder
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. diced celery
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients  and pour over meat.  Cook in covered pan at 350° for six hours.  Shred meat with fork.

name: CINNAMON CUCUMBERS
ingredients:
2  gal. large cucumbers
2  c. lime
8 1/2  c. water
1  c. vinegar
1  bottle red food coloring
1  tsp. alum
3  sticks cinnamon
2  c. vinegar
2  c. water
1 small  pkg. red hots
5  lb. sugar
preparation: Peel, slice and seed 2 gallons cucumbers.  Soak in lime and 8 1/2 cups water for 24 hours.  Drain and wash.  Soak in clear water for 3 hours.

name: RAGGEDY ROBINS(Cookies)
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. margarine (1/2 stick)
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. peanut butter
1 1/2  c. oats (oatmeal)
preparation: Measure into a saucepan the sugar, cocoa, butter and cold milk.  Stir over medium heat and bring to a rolling boil.  Boil exactly 1 1/2 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Quickly stir in vanilla, peanut butter and oats.  Working quickly, drop onto wax paper with teaspoon.  Cool 10 minutes.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1  c. (1/2 lb.) butter or margarine, softened
1 1/3  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. each baking soda and cream of tartar
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
3  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Large bowl, use electric mixer.  Beat butter, 1 1/3 cups sugar until creamy.  Beat in eggs and vanilla.  In other bowl, stir together flour, baking soda, cream of tartar and salt.  Gradually add to butter mix, blend thoroughly.  Small bowl combine cinnamon and 3 tablespoons sugar.  Roll dough into balls, then roll in cinnamon-sugar mix to coat.  Place at least 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheets.  Bake at 375° for 12 minutes or until lightly brown.  Makes 4 1/2 dozen.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
2/3  c. Miracle Whip
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. Accent
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. Lawry's seasoning
1  tsp. dill weed
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire
2  drops Tabasco sauce
preparation: Mix ingredients thoroughly and chill.  Serve with fresh vegetables.

name: PINA COLADA FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. crushed pineapple in its own juice (undrained)
3 1/2  oz. instant coconut pudding mix
3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: In food processor, with metal blade or blender, combine all ingredients.  Cover; process 30 seconds (15 seconds in blender). Refrigerate overnight.  Serve with fresh fruit.  Makes 2 1/2 cups.

name: MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1 1/2  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. molasses
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. hot water
preparation: Mix ingredients in order, adding hot water last.  Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: LUCKY IF THERE'S A BITE LEFT
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. chopped pecans
2 (9 oz.)  cartons Cool Whip
2  c. powdered sugar
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
3 small  boxes chocolate instant pudding
4 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together margarine, flour and pecans; press in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

name: BURT REYNOLDS' PARMESAN GARLIC TOAST(Makes 8 Slices)
ingredients:
8  Tbsp. soft butter
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  clove garlic, crushed
8  slices French sourdough bread or Italian bread
preparation: Combine butter, cheese and garlic.  Pile mixture high on 8 thick slices of bread (or hard sliced rolls, or in a pinch, use English muffins).  Place the slices on a double thickness of aluminum foil.  Bake in hot oven at 400°  for 10 minutes.  Garnish with a dash of paprika.

name: ANGEL HAIR PRIMAVERA
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. angel hair pasta
3  carrots, sliced
1  zucchini, sliced
1  yellow squash, sliced
1  sweet red pepper, sliced
1/2  small onion, chopped
1/2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. half and half
1/4  c. tomato sauce (optional)
salt, pepper, parsley and garlic to taste
preparation: Cook pasta according to directions.  In large skillet, over medium heat, saute carrots, squash, zucchini, red pepper, onion and peas in butter for about 5 minutes, until carrots are tender. Add half and half, tomato sauce and herbs.  Cook 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until sauce thickens.  Drain pasta.  Pour veggie mix over pasta.  Serve immediately.  Takes 10 minutes to prepare.

name: CHERRY PIE JELLO
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. cherry jello
1  c. boiling water
1  can cherry pie filling
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
preparation: Dissolve jello in water; add cherry pie filling.  Mix well and chill until firm.  Drain pineapple and mix well with cream cheese. Spread over jello mixture and chill.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hash browns (frozen)
1/2  c. onion, sauteed
8  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup or cream of mushroom soup
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  pt. sour cream
1 1/2  sticks margarine, melted
2  c. crushed corn flakes
preparation: Mix corn flakes and half of the melted margarine.  Set aside. Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle corn flake mixture over top.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix (18.25 oz. with pudding)
1 (3.9 oz.)  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. vegetable oil (I use a little less)
3/4  c. water
4  large eggs
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
sifted confectioners sugar
preparation: Combine dry cake mix, dry instant pudding and 1/2 cup sugar, stirring with a wire whisk to remove large lumps.  Add oil and next 3 ingredients, stirring until smooth.  Stir in chocolate morsels.  Pour batter into greased and floured 12-cup Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tester is clean.  Cool on rack 10 minutes.  Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

name: DIET SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
1 large  can tomato juice
1 large  can water
1  large onion, diced
2  stalks celery, diced
3  carrots
1/2  head cauliflower
1/2  head broccoli
1/2  head cabbage
1  can French-style green beans
1  can kidney beans
1  can chickpeas
3 small  cans seasoned stewed tomatoes
1  can mushrooms
dash of garlic powder
8  beef bouillon cubes
preparation: Brown beef, drain and rinse.  Empty tomato juice into pot. Fill can with water and add to juice. Simmer bouillon cubes until dissolved. Add remaining ingredients including beef.  Cook until vegetables are tender.

name: CANDY NUT ROLL
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. dates
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
2  tsp. butter
powdered sugar
preparation: Cook together sugar, dates and milk until mixture forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water (236°).  Remove from heat; set pan in bowl of cold water and cool to lukewarm.  Add chopped nuts and butter.  Beat until thick and entirely cold.  Turn onto board dusted thickly with powdered sugar and knead until it will mold well.  Roll into a long cylinder, about 1-inch in diameter and let stand 24 hours.  When wanted, cut into slices.

name: VEAL MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. veal ground
grated rind and juice of 1 lemon
salt and pepper
1  small onion, chopped fine
1  c. breadcrumbs
1  egg, beaten
1  can mushrooms
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  When done, add 1 can heated mushrooms with liquid on top.

name: M&M PARTY COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
1  c. light brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. M&M's
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Blend sugars together; add eggs, butter and vanilla.  Gradually add in flour, salt and soda.   Roll out to 1/4 inch thickness on lightly floured surface.  Cut out cookies using round cookie cutter or if you don't have a round cutter a kitchen glass will work fine (dip in flour first).  Press M&M's lightly on top of each cookie, careful not to disturb round shape. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until sides are lightly brown.

name: BEEF AND BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
10  oz. pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1 1/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. dehydrated onions
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
3  oz. pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
1  egg, beaten
4  oz. Monterey Jack cheese
1  pkg. refrigerated crescent rolls
preparation: Mix flour, milk and cream cheese. Add egg and seasonings.  Mix with meat and broccoli.  Place in a 9 or 10-inch pie pan or long baking dish.  Cut Monterey Jack cheese and put on top of mixture. Flatten crescent rolls and place on top.  Bake 40 minutes at 350°. Let stand a few minutes before serving.

name: SPAGHETTI PIZZA
ingredients:
7  oz. pkg. spaghetti, cooked
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1  lb. ground beef
onion seasoning or onions
1 medium  jar Ragu Extra Thick 'N Zesty
mushrooms, chopped
olives, chopped
Mozzarella cheese
pepperoni
preparation: Beat egg and milk and pour over noodles in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Brown ground beef and onion.  Pour on top of spaghetti.  Add Ragu, mushrooms and olives.  Cover with cheese and pepperoni.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  (May mix sauce with hamburger mixture.)

name: FLUFFY SEVEN MINUTE FROSTING
ingredients:
2  egg whites
1 1/2  c. sugar
dash of salt
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. corn syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Place first 5 ingredients in top part of double boiler.  Beat at low speed to mix thoroughly.  Place over boiling water and beat at high speed for 7 minutes.  Add vanilla.  Beat for 1 more minute to thicken spread.

name: BACON CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. bacon
2  lb. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp and crumble.  In a mixer with paddle attachment, beat cream cheese until softened.  Slowly add buttermilk to cream cheese.  Continue to beat until smooth; add salt, garlic powder, Tabasco, Worcestershire sauce and bacon.  Mix well.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  chicken cutlets
1  jar salsa (hot, medium or mild)
2  c. grated cheese (Cheddar)
butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Use glass or aluminum pan.  Place pats of butter on bottom of pan.  Place chicken on top of butter.  Pour salsa on top of chicken cutlets.  Sprinkle cheese on top of salsa. Bake for about 30 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: SALMON MOLD
ingredients:
1  can pink salmon (7 3/4 oz.)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  envelopes unflavored gelatin
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. green onions
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1  c. boiling water
preparation: In double boiler, melt cream cheese and soup.  Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup boiling water.  Mix all ingredients together. Put in mold.  Serve with Escort crackers.

name: CHURCH WINDOW COOKIES
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  stick margarine
1  c. chopped nuts
1  (10 oz.) bag colored miniature marshmallows
1  (14 oz.) bag coconut
preparation: In a saucepan over low heat, melt chocolate chips and margarine.  Then add nuts.  Cool slightly, then add marshmallows until well coated.

name: PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. beef chuck or round
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  c. green peppers
1  c. water
1  c. onion
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. mushrooms
preparation: Cut meat into strips.  Add soy sauce, toss and set aside, while preparing vegetables.  Heat oil in a large frying pan or wok.  Add beef and toss until browned.  Cover and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes over low heat.  Turn heat up and add vegetables.  Toss until vegetables are crisp.  Mix cornstarch with water and add to pan, cooking until thickened.  Serve over rice.  Makes 2 servings.

name: PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE #2
ingredients:
2 (No. 2)  cans chunk pineapple, drained
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1  c. grated sharp cheese
preparation: Drain pineapple and put in large casserole dish.  Mix next 3 ingredients and pour over pineapple.  Melt 1 stick of margarine. Crush plain Ritz crackers (or Cheese Nips) to make 1 cup of crumbs.  Mix crumbs with margarine and pour on top of mixture. Bake at 300° for 25 minutes.

name: LOMI SALMON
ingredients:
1/4  lb. smoke salmon
1/2  onion, thinly sliced
2  green onions, chopped (include green part 2 inches above white)
2  tomatoes, cubed
6  ice cubes
preparation: Shred salmon with finger; place in bowl.  Add onions and tomatoes.  Press (lomi) or mash slightly with fingers.  Put ice cubes on top.  Refrigerate.  Serve in small side dishes with some of the liquid.  Serves 6.

name: SPICY PEACH NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
2  tsp. softened margarine or butter
1 (16 oz.)  can (2 c.) sliced peaches or apricot halves, drained (reserve syrup)
1/2  c. reserved syrup
2  eggs
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. raisins
preparation: In a large bowl, blend all, except nuts and raisins, until moistened.  Beat 2 minutes at medium speed, scraping bowl occasionally.  Stir in nuts and raisins.  Pour into generously greased loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch). Bake at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes or until tests clean.  Immediately remove from pan.  Cool completely.  If desired, drizzle with powdered sugar glaze.  Store tightly wrapped in refrigerator.

name: CHEESEBURGER 'N' FRIES CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  can golden mushroom soup
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. frozen crinkle cut fries
preparation: In skillet, brown the beef; drain.  Stir in soups.  Pour into 13 x 9 baking pan.  Arrange French fries on top.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until the fries are golden brown.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. plain flour
1  stick margarine
1  c. chopped pecans
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1  c. powdered sugar
cherries, if desired
3  c. milk
1 large  pkg. vanilla pudding
1 large  pkg. chocolate pudding
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
preparation: Melt margarine.  Mix flour, margarine and pecans.  Press into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes; cool. Mix 1 cup Cool Whip, powdered sugar and cream cheese.  Spread over crust.  Mix both puddings with milk.  Spread over cream cheese layer.  Top with rest of Cool Whip.  Top with cherries.  Chill 2 to 3 hours.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) bag frozen broccoli, cauliflower and carrots combination, thawed and drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1/3  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (4 oz.)  jar pimento (optional)
1 (2.8 oz.)  can French fried onions
preparation: Combine veggies, soup, 1/2 cup cheese, sour cream, pepper, pimento and 1/2 can onions.  Pour into 1-quart casserole.  Bake covered in 350° oven for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onions.  Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer.

name: CAJUN SHRIMP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. shrimp, peeled and deveined
3  Tbsp. butter
3/4  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped bell pepper
1/4  tsp. mace
1/4  tsp. curry powder
1/4  tsp. Louisiana hot sauce
1/4  tsp. paprika
4  green onions, sliced
3  Tbsp. flour
salt to taste
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 (3 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In heavy skillet, melt butter; saute celery, pepper and onions for 7 minutes stirring constantly.  Add flour, salt, mace, curry powder, hot sauce and Worcestershire sauce, stirring until well blended.  Stir in milk.  Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce is smooth and thickened.  Add shrimp; cook about 3 minutes.  Pour into a buttered 6 x 10-inch casserole.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and paprika.  Bake 20 minutes at 425°.

name: CHERRY YUM-YUM
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
preparation: Mix all together and put in bottom and sides of pan.

name: INSTANT SPICED TEA
ingredients:
1 large  jar Tang
1  pkg. lemonade mix
2  tsp. cinnamon
2 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. instant tea
1  tsp. cloves
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Use 3 teaspoons in boiling water for a cup of tea.  Store in airtight container.

name: CORNBREAD SALAD
ingredients:
1  green pepper, diced
2  tomatoes, diced
1  sweet onion, chopped
1  lb. bacon, crisp and crumbled
6  boiled eggs, diced
1  large pone cornbread
mayonnaise
preparation: In a large bowl, mix together eggs, pepper, tomatoes, onion, bacon and crumbled cornbread.  Add enough mayonnaise to make the mixture moist.  It should stick together also.  Allow to set in refrigerator in a covered bowl overnight.

name: TOMATO GRAVY
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. bacon drippings
3  Tbsp. flour
1  can 14 1/2 oz. diced tomatoes, undrained
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt bacon drippings in an iron skillet over medium heat; stir in flour until smooth and medium brown; stir in tomatoes, salt and pepper; simmer 20 minutes; and serve with biscuits.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  roll sugar cookie dough
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, at room temperature
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 small  can Mandarin oranges, drained
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
10  oz. strawberries, drained
2  bananas, sliced
1/2  c. pecans
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Slice cookie dough 3/8 inch thick and place 1/2 inch apart on a 12-inch pizza pan.  Bake 12 minutes at 350°.  Let cool.

name: BAKED ONION RINGS
ingredients:
2  lb. white onions, sliced
8  slices buttered toast
1/4  lb. American cheese, shredded
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. butter
paprika (optional)
preparation: Cook onions in boiling salted water until tender; drain well. Place half of the toast in a baking dish.  Layer half of the onions and half of the cheese over toast.  Repeat layers.  Beat eggs with milk, salt and pepper.  Pour over cheese.  Dot with butter.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until set.  Yields 8 servings.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
1 small  pkg. banana instant pudding mix
1  c. chopped pecans
2  or 3 bananas, mashed (use real ripe bananas)
preparation: Mix all together for 4 minutes.  Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. rice
1/2  c. margarine
32  oz. frozen broccoli
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 (16 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
1  chopped onion
preparation: Cook rice.  Mix ingredients together.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: CRANBERRY-ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. any red gelatin
2  c. boiling water
1 (16 oz.)  can whole berry cranberry sauce
2  Tbsp. grated orange rind (optional)
1  c. diced orange sections
1  c. chopped apple
preparation: Add boiling water to gelatin.  Mix in salt, cinnamon and cloves.  Stir until gelatin is dissolved.  Add cranberry sauce and orange rind.  Chill until mixture starts to thicken.  Fold in orange and apple.  Chill until firm.

name: OATMEAL BREAD(Yeast Bread)
ingredients:
2  c. boiling water
1 1/2  c. oatmeal
1  c. water
6  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. brown sugar
salt
2  c. flour
2  pkg. yeast
2  eggs
2  c. whole wheat
preparation: Pour the boiling water over the oatmeal and let it cool.  Heat 1 cup water, butter, brown sugar and salt to 120°.  Add this to the 2 cups flour, yeast, eggs and whole wheat.  Knead for 3 minutes.  Add 2 more cups regular flour.  Knead for 4 minutes. Cover and let rise 1 1/4 hours.  Divide into 3 loaves and let rest 10 minutes.  Shape and put into greased pans.  Let rise 45 minutes.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: NINE DAY - COLE SLAW
ingredients:
3  lb. cabbage
1  bell pepper
1  medium onion
2  c. sugar
1  c. salad oil
1  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. celery seed
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Shred cabbage, bell pepper and onion. Stir in 2 cups of sugar. Combine salad oil, vinegar, celery seed and 2 tablespoons sugar and bring to boil. Add 2 mixtures together; cover and put in refrigerator. Can do ahead.

name: HAMBURGER-MACARONI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. sirloin hamburger
1  tsp. or less finely chopped onion
1  pkg. elbow macaroni
1  Tbsp. butter
1 large (28 oz.)  can tomatoes (juice too)
1 small (14.5 oz.)  can tomatoes (juice too)
1  pkg. sharp Cheddar cheese, cubed
1  dash garlic salt plus salt and pepper to taste
1  pinch oregano
preparation: Brown hamburger with onion and drain off all fat.  Cook macaroni in water with the 1 tablespoon of butter until tender. Drain.

name: SPICY PEACH HALVES
ingredients:
1 (1 lb. 13 oz.)  can peach halves
2/3  c. peach syrup
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. grated orange peel
1  tsp. whole cloves
1/2  tsp. whole allspice
minced parsley
preparation: Drain peaches.	Combine peach syrup, brown sugar, vinegar, orange peel, cloves and allspice.  Boil gently; add peach halves and simmer for 5 minutes.  Chill in syrup.	Drain; serve with parsley (optional) or on a lettuce leaf or meats.

name: OLD FASHIONED CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
2  c. stone ground cornmeal
1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. shortening
2  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. flour
preparation: Put sugar, salt, soda and baking powder in a bowl and add buttermilk.  Stir well, then add cornmeal and flour alternately. Melt shortening in iron skillet and add to mixture.  Sprinkle a little cornmeal in iron skillet.  Heat pan and pour mixture into hot pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

name: CHEDDAR ROSEMARY SCONES
ingredients:
2  c. Flour
1  tsp. Salt
2  Tbsp. Sugar
1  Tbsp. Baking Powder
1  Tbsp. Fresh Rosemary (Minced)
1/2 - 1  tsp. Red Chili
Pepper Flakes to Taste
5  oz. Sharp Cheddar Cheese (Grated)
1 1/3  c. Heavy Whipping Cream
3  Tbsp. Butter (Melted)
preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.  Use an ungreased baking sheet. 2. Combine flour, salt, sugar, baking powder, rosemary, chili pepper flakes, and cheese in a bowl stirring with a fork to mix well until the dough holds together. 3. Lightly flour a board and transfer dough to it.  Form the dough into a ball but don't over handle. Flatten dough to 3/4 inch thick disc. 4. Cut into 8 wedges. Transfer to baking sheet.  Brush with butter. 5. Bake for 15-17 minutes or until lightly golden brown.  Serve warm.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  qt. squash
1  small onion, chopped
1/4  c. oleo
1  tube Ritz crackers
1/4  c. milk
8  oz. Cheddar or Velveeta cheese
preparation: Boil squash in small amount of water until tender. Sauté onion in oleo. Mix 1/2 Ritz crumbs, cheese, milk, smashed squash and sautéed onions. Stir to blend. Place in casserole dish (greased). Crumble 1/2 tube Ritz and place on top. Bake at 350° uncovered until slightly browned.

name: SOUTHERN FRIED BAKED STEAK
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak, trimmed
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. milk
1  egg, lightly beaten
cooking oil
1  onion, chopped
1  c. beef broth
preparation: Pound steak to tenderize; cut into serving size pieces. Season with salt and pepper.  Dust with flour.  Combine milk and egg; dip meat in egg mixture and back into flour.

name: ARTICHOKE DELIGHT
ingredients:
2  cans artichokes (drained)
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. parmesan cheese
preparation: Tear leaves away from hearts.  Mix leaves, mayonnaise and cheese together.  Place in greased casserole dish and bake for 15 minutes at 350°.  Serve with Ritz crackers.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti
1  lb. Velveeta, cubed
1  stick (1/4 lb.) oleo
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  onion, chopped
1  c. chicken broth
salt and pepper
preparation: Boil, debone and cut up chicken.  Boil spaghetti in broth from chicken, then drain.  Mix all other ingredients and melt in double boiler or microwave.  Stir in chicken, spaghetti, salt and pepper to taste.  Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

name: SUPER DUPER CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
4  sq. unsweetened chocolate or 1 c. cocoa
1/2  c. oil (plus 8 tsp. if using cocoa)
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
4  unbeaten eggs
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt chocolate down and mix with oil.  Add sugar and vanilla. Add eggs singly.  Sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Add chocolate mixture and nuts to dry ingredients.  Chill overnight.  Form into balls and roll in powdered sugar.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.  Yields 6 dozen.

name: LEMON DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. butter
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. powdered sugar
1/4  c. nuts, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
2  pkg. instant lemon pudding or any flavor
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix flour, butter, 2 tablespoons powdered sugar and nuts together.  Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° until lightly browned.  Cool 15 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  pt. milk
4  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. cocoa
2  egg yolks
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Scald the milk.  Mix flour, sugar, salt and cocoa in separate bowl.  Add a little hot milk to flour mixture to make consistency like gravy. Mix. Then add to rest of hot milk. Add egg yolks, butter and vanilla. Cook over low heat until thick.  Pour into pie crust and refrigerate.

name: WATERGATE
ingredients:
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1 big  box instant pistachio pudding
1 (13 1/2 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Stir all ingredients together and serve.  Nuts can be sprinkled on top.

name: PORK CHOPS-N-POTATOES
ingredients:
6  pork chops
vegetable oil
seasoned salt
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. sour cream
black pepper
1  pkg. frozen O'Brien potatoes, thawed
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  can (2.8 oz.) Durkee French fried onions
preparation: Brown pork chops in lightly greased skillet.  Sprinkle with seasoned salt and set aside.  Combine soup, milk, sour cream, pepper and 1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt.  Stir in potatoes, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can French fried onions.  Spoon mixture into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Arrange pork chops over potatoes.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 40 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onions; bake uncovered 5 minutes longer.

name: PAW-PRINT COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. margarine
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. flour
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
cocoa
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Blend sugars, peanut butter, magarine, egg and vanilla until creamy.  Sift flour, baking soda and baking powder into creamed mixture.  Stir until flour is blended.  Shape dough into 1-inch balls and roll into cocoa.  Place balls 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are lightly browned.  Remove from oven and immediately use your little finger to make the paw print.  Cool on rack.

name: COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box of yellow cake mix
1 1/4  C. water
1/2  C. vegetable oil
3  eggs
1  pack of flaked coconut
1  C. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cake mix, eggs, oil and water until creamy.  Bake at 350 for 30-35 minutes. Make 2 layers and cool.  Mix 1/2 of coconut and Cool Whip.  Frost cake with Cool Whip and coconut mixture. Sprinkle top with Coconut.

name: BUTTERMILK PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
2  Tbsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Beat all ingredients together with a spoon.  Cook quickly on a hot griddle.  Yields 12 to 15 pancakes.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen vegetables
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. shredded mild Cheddar cheese
1  c. Ritz cracker crumbs or corn flake crumbs
1  stick butter
preparation: Cook vegetables until tender, adding onion when vegetables are done.  Drain.  Add next 3 ingredients.  Put in casserole and top with cracker crumbs mixed with margarine.  Put in oven and bake at 325° until crumbs are brown.

name: CORN FLAKE KISSES
ingredients:
2  egg whites
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. shredded coconut
2  c. corn flakes
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chocolate chips (for variety, optional)
preparation: Beat egg whites until stiff. Gradually add sugar.  Continue beating.  Gently fold in remaining ingredients.  Barely mix together.   Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 325° for 12 minutes.  Makes 30 small kisses.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pt. sliced yellow squash
1  small chopped onion
1 small  can evaporated milk
1/2  c. whole milk
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm stuffing
salt
pepper
preparation: Boil squash and onion in salted water until tender.  Drain. Cook until thickened evaporated milk, whole milk, butter and flour.  Stir in Cheddar cheese.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Place squash and onion in a casserole and cover with sauce.  Pour enough dressing on top of casserole to cover and dot with butter.  Bake 15 minutes at 350°, until browned.

name: FIRST-TIME FRIED RABBIT
ingredients:
3  or 4 whole rabbits
flour
salt and pepper
oil to cook rabbit in
no knowledge of cooking or cutting up wild game
healthy sense of humor
preparation: To do this you must not know how to cut up a rabbit.

name: CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. salad oil
2/3  c. wine vinegar
2  Tbsp. honey
2  Tbsp. pickle relish
pepper
garlic salt
1  can green beans
1  can yellow beans
1  green pepper, chopped
1  stalk celery, chopped
1  head cauliflower, broken up
1  bunch green onions and tops, sliced
1  can black olives, drained
1  jar stuffed green olives, drained
preparation: Mix the day before the salad oil, wine vinegar, honey, pickle relish, pepper and garlic salt.

name: EASY ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
8 1/2  oz. carton small curd cottage cheese
9  oz. Cool Whip
1 small  pkg. orange jello
1  can drained mandarin oranges
preparation: Mix together the cottage cheese and Cool Whip.  Add the jello and the mandarin oranges; refrigerate until ready to eat.

name: SPINACH AND ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1/2  pouch Stouffer's cream spinach, fully thawed and cold
8  oz. artichoke hearts, drained (1/2 inch rough chop)
8  oz. Stouffer's alfredo sauce, fully thawed
8  oz. Parmesan cheese, shredded cold
1  tsp. salt (granulated)
1  tsp. white pepper
1  tsp. garlic (granulated)
preparation: Gather all ingredients, then pour the needed amount of artichoke hearts into a colander and allow to drain thoroughly. Then rough chop into 1/2 inch pieces.  Place all ingredients into large mixing bowl and using rubber spatula mix all ingredients together.  Place 6 ounces of mixture evenly into a bowl; cover and refrigerate.  Microwave until hot.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix
1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
chocolate icing of your choice
preparation: Use recipe on cake package.  Just before turning batter into pan, fold semi-sweet chocolate pieces into batter.  After baking, according to cake directions, frost.

name: SWEET AND SOUR PORK
ingredients:
1  lb. pork shoulder, cubed
1  beaten egg
1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. water
1  c. pineapple chunks
3/4  c. pineapple juice
1  green pepper, cut in 1-inch strips diagonally
1/2  c. carrot, raw, thinly sliced
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/4  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. water
preparation: Make batter with egg, flour, salt and water.  Salt and pepper the pork and coat with the batter.  Fry until brown.  Simmer with little water, covered, about 1 hour while making sauce.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. pumpkin
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1  Tbsp. flour
2  eggs, well beaten
1 1/4  c. evaporated milk
1  (9-inch) pie shell
preparation: Mix pumpkin and dry ingredients together.  Add eggs and milk; mix well.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: COMPANY STRATA
ingredients:
12  slices white bread
12  oz. sharp processed cheese, sliced
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. broccoli, cooked and drained
2  c. diced ham
6  slightly beaten eggs
3 1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cut doughnut shapes out of bread.  Fit scraps (crust removed) in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Layer cheese, broccoli and diced ham over bread.    Arrange doughnuts and holes on top.   Combine eggs, milk, onion, salt and mustard.  Pour over bread.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Bake uncovered at 325° for 55 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

name: LEMON BAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. butter
preparation: Mix all together and pat in pan 10 x 13-inch.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  slices white bread, brown trimmed off
1  lb. sausage (mild and hot, mixed)
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
6  eggs, beaten well
2  c. half and half
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Spread bread with butter.  Put buttered side on bottom of greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Put aside.

name: MEXICAN PIZZA
ingredients:
1  (12-inch) tortilla
oil for frying
1/3  c. refried beans
8  cherry tomatoes, cut in half
2  green onions, chopped
3  to 4 black olives, pitted and sliced
1/4  c. sliced sweet peppers
1  c. grated Monterey Jack cheese
1/4  c. taco salsa
2  Tbsp. olive oil
preparation: Heat 1-inch of oil in a skillet.  Soften the tortilla in the hot oil for a few seconds.  Drain it on a paper towel and lay it flat on a plate or baking sheet.  Cover the tortilla with refried beans.  Decorate it with tomatoes, onions, olives and peppers. Top with cheese and salsa.  Sprinkle with the olive oil.  Bake for 15 minutes in a 375°  oven.  Serves 4.

name: SHRIMP BAKE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked brown rice
2  c. cooked shrimp, cut up
3  oz. can mushrooms
1/2  tsp. garlic Season-All
2  c. shredded Cheddar or Jack cheese
3  eggs
6  oz. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: In oiled baking dish, spread rice evenly.  Top with shrimp, mushrooms and cheese.  Beat eggs, milk and seasonings and pour over shrimp-rice mixture.  Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: SALMON PARTY LOAF
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. grated onion
1  tsp. horseradish
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. pecans
preparation: Drain salmon.  Mix in ingredients, except pecans.  Roll in pecans and chill 2 hours.

name: SWANS MADE EASY
ingredients:
1  c. water
6  Tbsp. butter
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. flour
4  eggs
preparation: In a medium sized saucepan, bring water, butter and salt to a boil.  Reduce heat.  Add the flour all at once.  Stir constantly with a wooden spoon until the mixture leaves the sides of the pan and forms a ball.  Remove from heat.  Beat in eggs one at a time. Dough is ready to shape.  Fun for children to do.

name: ALABAMA LEMON CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. softened margarine, divided
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
2  Tbsp. grated lemon rind, divided
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  In a mixing bowl, beat sugar, shortening and 1/2 cup margarine together until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Sift flour, baking soda and salt together and alternately stir in with buttermilk.  Stir in 1 tablespoon of lemon rind and the lemon juice.  Pour into a greased 9-inch pan.  Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until toothpick (when stuck in center of cake) comes out clean.  Cool for 10 minutes, then remove from pan.

name: TURKEY
ingredients:
10  lb. turkey, sliced about 1/2-inch thick
2  c. 7-Up
1  c. oil
1  tsp. horseradish
1  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Marinate 6 to 24 hours in refrigerator.  Cook on grill, basting with marinade.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. oil or margarine
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  c. plain flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. raw diced apples
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine  oil,  sugar,  eggs, flour and flavorings.  Add apples and nuts; mix well.  Pour into greased and floured tube pan.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour and 25 minutes.  Delicious warm or cold.

name: CRAB QUICHE
ingredients:
7 1/2  oz. drained crab
8  oz. Swiss cheese, grated
1/3  c. sliced green onion
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  beaten eggs
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Combine mayonnaise, flour, eggs and milk.  Mix until blended. Stir in crab meat, cheese and onions.  Pour in a 9-inch pie plate (no crust).  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: SOFT MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
3 to 4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. ginger (optional)
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. white sugar
1  egg
1  c. Brer Rabbit molasses (do not use turkey syrup)
1  Tbsp. vinegar
2  tsp. baking soda, dissolved in 1/2 c. boiling water
preparation: Sift 3 cups of the flour with the salt and spices; set aside. Cream shortening and sugar; add egg.  Beat together until light. Next, add the molasses and vinegar, then the dry ingredients.  Add soda dissolved in boiling water last.   If necessary, add more flour to make a soft dough.  Drop by soup spoon or tablespoon onto a cookie sheet.  Sprinkle lightly with granulated sugar.  Bake at 350° for about 12 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli, chopped
1/2  c. melted oleo
1  bunch green onions, chopped
1 (4 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms, drained
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1/2  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. cracker crumbs
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In medium saucepan, cook broccoli by directions on package, then drain.  In a large skillet, saute 1/2 cup oleo, onions and mushrooms.  Cook until tender.  Add soup, flour and cheese.  Stir well.  Combine mixture with broccoli and mix well.  Pour mixture into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. In a small saucepan, melt remaining 1/2 cup margarine.  Add cracker crumbs and mix well.  Top casserole with crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: RAINBOW SNOWBALL CAKE
ingredients:
1  qt. strawberry ice cream
1  qt. orange sherbet
1  qt. lime sherbet
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pt. whip cream
3  qt. vanilla ice cream
preparation: Chill 10-inch tube pan.  With small scoop shape balls (strawberry cream and sherbets).  Place balls on cookie sheet; put in freezer until firm.  Soften vanilla ice cream.  Whip like fluffy whipped cream.  Arrange 1 layer of balls, adding vanilla ice cream to fill spaces.  Repeat to fill tube pan.  Freeze overnight.  Remove from pan.  Frost with whipped cream flavored with vanilla.

name: NEIMAN-MARCUS CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  stick oleo, melted
2  eggs
2  c. pecans, chopped
1  c. coconut
1  box powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
preparation: Mix together cake mix, oleo, eggs, pecans and coconut.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan.  Mix powdered sugar, vanilla and cream cheese.  Put on top of first layer.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serve cold.  Keep refrigerated.

name: STRAWBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1  stick margarine
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
2 small  pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix floured pecans.  Melt butter and pour over flour and pecans mixture.  Mix well and press into bottom of large dish. Bake at 350° until brown.  Cool.  Blend cream cheese, confectioners sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip.  Spread over cooled crust.  Mix pudding and milk.  Spread over cream cheese layer. Put Cool Whip on top of strawberry.  Decorate with strawberries, if desired.

name: PINTO BEANS -N- HAM
ingredients:
2  lb. dried pinto beans
3 to 4  lb. ham (bite size)
2  medium onions, minced
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. salt (optional)
3  qt. water
1/2  tsp. oregano
3  to 4 bay leaves
preparation: Soak beans overnight with plenty of water; add to beans, onion and trimmed ham (bite size).   Add remaining ingredients.  Cover and bring to a boil.   Boil slowly for 2 to 3 hours, stirring frequently.   An 8-quart pot is best.   Remove bay leaves before serving.

name: ALMOND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh broccoli
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1/3  c. slivered almonds, toasted
2  egg whites
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Trim off leaves of broccoli and remove tough ends of lower stalks.  Wash broccoli thoroughly and cut into spears.  Cook in a small amount of boiling water for 8 minutes.  Drain.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  oz. pkg. cooked wild rice
1  chicken or chicken breasts, cooked, boned and cut up
1  can sliced green beans
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  can cream of celery or mushroom soup
1/2  c. chicken broth
1  can sliced water chestnuts (optional)
preparation: Mix all together and bake 30 minutes at 350° topped with buttered bread crumbs.

name: DIVINITY FUDGE
ingredients:
2  egg whites
3  c. white sugar
3/4  c. light corn syrup
3/4  c. water
1  c. chopped nuts
1 small  box strawberry jello
preparation: Beat egg whites and jello until they hold a definite peak.  In saucepan, mix sugar, corn syrup and water.  Cook to a boil and cook to 250° on candy thermometer.  Pour this over egg white mixture in a slow steady stream, beating constantly with your electric beater. Continue to beat until candy holds shape and loses its' gloss. Stir in nuts.  Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper or place in well buttered dish and cut in squares.

name: HALF PENNY SNACKS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine, at room temperature
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, coarsely grated
1/2 (1 3/4 oz.)  pkg. dried soup mix
preparation: Beat butter and cheese in a medium size bowl.  When creamy, stir in flour, salt and onion soup mix.  Mix well and then turn out and roll into a cylinder about 9 inches long and 2 inches in diameter.  Wrap in waxed paper and chill 1 hour or longer.  (Dough also may be frozen, then thaw enough to slice.)

name: STRAWBERRY "PIZZA"
ingredients:
1  refrigerated sugar cookie slice-n-bake loaf
2 (8 oz.)  boxes cream cheese
1  (8 oz.) tub Cool Whip
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  qt. strawberries
1  bag strawberry glaze
preparation: Spread cookie batter out on large round pizza pan.  Bake according to directions.  Cool.  Mix together cream cheese, Cool Whip and confectioners sugar with hand mixer until smooth.  Smooth this mixture onto cookie crust.  Prepare strawberries (or other fresh fruit).  Mix glaze into strawberries.  Top off the "pizza" with a layer of this strawberry-and-glaze mixture.  Keep refrigerated.

name: BLACKBERRY CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. blackberries
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. margarine
1/2  c. milk
3  tsp. flour
1  pie shell
1 1/2  c. Cool Whip
preparation: Cook blackberries; add sugar and stir.  Add margarine and stir.  Mix 1/2 cup milk and flour, stirring until the mixture is not lumpy.  Combine blackberries and flour mixture and cook until done.  Pour mixture into pie shell.  Let cool, then top with 1 1/2 cups Cool Whip.

name: 9 MINUTE MICROWAVE PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. raw peanuts
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. butter or margarine
2  tsp. baking soda (rounded)
preparation: In a glass pan with handles, stir together the peanuts, sugar, syrup and salt.  Cook 8 minutes on High, stirring after 4 minutes. Add butter and vanilla.  Cook one minute longer on High.  Add baking soda and quickly stir until light and fluffy (foamy). Immediately pour on lightly buttered baking sheet.  Spread out thin.  When cool, break into pieces.  Store in airtight container.

name: TWICE COOKED DIVINITY
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. finely chopped nuts
1/4  tsp. salt
2  egg whites, room temperature
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, syrup, water and salt in small saucepan; cover and boil  for  3  minutes.	Uncover  and  cook  to 248°. Meanwhile, beat the  egg  whites  in a large bowl until stiff, but not dry.  Pour  1/2  of syrup over egg whites, beating all the time.  Put	remaining  syrup on to cook to 272° and slowly pour over  the  candy,  still  beating constantly.  Beat until mixture begins to lose its gloss and stands in peaks (approximately 7 minutes).  Mix  in	vanilla  and  nuts;  drop by teaspoons on waxed  paper.  Store in airtight containers.  Makes about 4 dozen pieces.

name: BARBECUE(Spicy-Sweet)
ingredients:
large roast
1 1/2  c. ketchup
1  Tbsp. mustard
1/4  tsp. garlic
1  tsp. Tabasco
1  Tbsp. chili powder
3/4  c. jelly
salt and pepper
2  Tbsp. Heinz 57 sauce
1  tsp. honey
1/2  tsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. A.1.
preparation: Cook roast until it falls apart.  Cool and tear apart.  Place in a large pot.  Mix all other ingredients and add to meat. Simmer at least 40 minutes.

name: CHICKEN FETTUCCINI
ingredients:
5  c. cooked diced chicken (use another cup of it's there)
1 (4 oz.)  jar chopped pimento
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
2  cans mushroom soup
1  can chicken broth
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1  good-sized onion, grated
1 (8 oz.)  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
8  oz. pkg. spinach or regular fettuccini, broken into 2-inch pieces
1  lb. grated Cheddar or hot Velveeta cheese
salt and pepper to taste plus a few dashes of Tabasco
2  cloves garlic
preparation: Cook fettuccini according to package directions; drain and combine all ingredients in an ovenproof baking dish big enough to hold it all without bubbling over. Save about a fourth of the cheese and sprinkle it on top of the mixture. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes, until it is hot and bubbly.

name: CHERRY PINK SPONGE
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  box cherry Jell-O
3  c. boiling water
2  c. cooked rice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. almond extract
2  c. Cool Whip
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.  Add cooked rice, salt, sugar and flavorings.  Chill until partially thickened.  Then add Cool Whip.  Let chill at least 2 hours.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can chopped green chiles
3 (28 oz.)  cans tomatoes
6  cloves garlic, pressed
2  yellow onions
1  1/2 stalks celery
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
2  bay leaves
preparation: Drain chiles.  Add to chopped onions, celery and garlic (pressed);  stir.  Puree  tomatoes  separately and combine all ingredients.

name: CHOCKLIT CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
chockit chips
1  c. shugar
flour
dough
preparation: Put chocklit chips into the dough.  Add 1 cup shugar and 2 scoopes of flour.  Stir and put them in the oven for 100 degrees for 3 minutes.  Take it out and eat.

name: ROLLED CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
12  chicken breasts
1  can golden mushroom soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pt. sour cream
1  pkg. pressed beef
12  slices bacon
preparation: Lay 1 slice of  beef  on top of 1 chicken breast.  Roll and wrap 1 slice  of  bacon  around  chicken.  Secure with two toothpicks.  Mix remaining ingredients and spoon over chicken. Cover and cook 3  hours  at  300°.  Sauce  is good served over white rice.

name: CORN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. yellow cornmeal
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1/4  c. butter, melted
1  egg
1  can corn, drained
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Grease 12 muffin cups.  In large bowl, mix flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder and salt.  Mix milk, butter and egg in 2nd bowl.  Add slowly to dry ingredients just until combined.  Stir in corn gently.  Spoon into muffin tins. Bake approximately 20 minutes.  Serve warm.

name: JALAPENO CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. creamed corn
1  c. yellow corn meal
1  c. butter, melted
3/4  c. buttermilk
2  onions, chopped
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar
3  jalapeno peppers, diced
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease a 9-inch square baking pan. Combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl and mix well.  Pour half of this batter into pan. Cover evenly with half the cheese, then peppers, then remaining cheese. Top with remaining batter. Bake 1 hour.  Let cool 15 minutes.  Cut into squares.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pint squash
1  c. sharp cheese, grated
3/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
6  crushed saltine crackers
1  egg, well beaten
3  Tbsp. melted butter
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Combine ingredients in greased casserole dish. Set in a pan of water and bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: GRANDMA'S STRING BEANS
ingredients:
2  slices bacon
1  pkg. frozen green beans or fresh
garlic salt
preparation: Finely chop bacon and fry in saucepan.  Add green beans with bacon and grease.  Cook on low, stirring often.  Add a dash of garlic salt.

name: PINEAPPLE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
2  cans sliced pineapple
12  maraschino cherries
1  stick butter
1  box brown sugar
preparation: Take oblong pan, melt butter in it.  Sprinkle brown sugar on melted butter.  Place 12 pineapple rings on bottom of buttered pan and put cherries inside rings of pineapple.  Mix cake mix and pour over pineapple and cherries.  Bake 35 minutes or until brown.  Turn upside-down on cake box.

name: COCONUT BUCKEYES
ingredients:
2  lb. powdered sugar
2  sticks margarine
21  oz. coconut
1  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1  tsp. vanilla
chocolate wafers for dipping (milk or dark)
preparation: Blend sugar and margarine.  Add coconut, milk and vanilla; mix thoroughly.  Roll into balls a little smaller than 1 inch. Refrigerate to make solid.

name: CAULIFLOWER AU GRATIN
ingredients:
1  large cauliflower (about 6 c.)
1/4  c. margarine, divided
1/2  c. diced onion
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
8  oz. sour cream
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Break cauliflower into sections.  Cook 10 minutes in boiling salted water.  Drain well.  Combine cauliflower with 2 tablespoons butter and onion, cheese, sour cream and salt.  Spoon into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Melt remaining butter; toss with bread crumbs.  Sprinkle over cauliflower.   Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until heated through.  Yields 6 to 10 servings.

name: CARAMELS
ingredients:
2  c. light brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. sweetened condensed milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts
preparation: Cook to a firm ball stage the light brown sugar, butter, Karo syrup, salt and sweetened condensed milk.  Add the vanilla and nuts.  Pour into buttered pan.  Cool.  Cut into squares.  Wrap each in wax paper.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
3  sticks margarine
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
2  c. confectioners sugar
2  eggs
5  to 7 bananas
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. chopped nuts
1 large  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Blend one stick margarine with graham cracker crumbs.  Line bottom of 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan with this crust.  Beat 2 sticks margarine, sugar and eggs for 15 minutes.  Spread over cracker crumbs and slice bananas over that; then spread pineapple over bananas.  Top with Cool Whip and nuts.  Chill in refrigerator at least 2 hours before serving.  Also, you can add a layer of fresh strawberries after the layer of pineapple.

name: GREAT MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
2  boxes Jiffy corn bread mix
milk
2  eggs
1  medium onion, chopped/diced
1  can creamed corn
picante sauce or Ro-Tel tomatoes, diced
3/4  lb. cheese (grated Cheddar or sliced Velveeta)
preparation: Prepare corn bread according to instructions on Jiffy mix box. Fry/saute onion (chopped); combine cooked onion pieces, 1 can of creamed corn and diced Ro-Tel tomatoes.  (If using canned Ro-Tel, drain before emptying contents.)  Mix 3/4 of cheese in with corn bread mix, onions, Ro-Tel and creamed corn.  Grease pan, 9 x 13-inch; cook 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.  Watch to see when edges turn lightly brown and it looks done.  Sprinkle remaining cheese on top of corn bread while hot.

name: DAD'S SHRIMP AND CRAB SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. shell roni, cooked and drained
2  stalks celery
4  large dill pickles, diced
1  bunch green onions, sliced
1  pkg. crab or imitation crab, flaked
1  can shrimp
6  eggs, hard-boiled
preparation: Mix together with salad dressing and 1/2 cup dill pickle juice.  The more salad dressing, the more moist it is.  Use your judgment on this one.

name: PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburg
2  c. cooked egg noodles
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
1  can tomato soup
1  medium onion
1  tsp. garlic salt
1/3  c. water
1/2  lb. Mozzarella cheese or more
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion.  Add rest of ingredients except cheese.  Mix thoroughly.  Layer with cheese in casserole dish. Cook 30 to 45 minutes at 350°.  Freezes good.

name: BARBECUED POSSUM
ingredients:
1  possum, dressed, but not cut up
1  stick margarine
2  c. white vinegar
1/2  c. Dale's steak seasoning
barbecue sauce of choice
preparation: Turn possum on its back and spread body cavity open.  Use a hatchet to split backbone down the middle so possum will spread flat on the grill.  Cook possum over medium coals, brushing often with mixture of melted margarine, vinegar and Dale's.  Just before possum is done throughout, brush inside and out with barbecue sauce and cook until barbecue sauce cooks into the meat.  Do not burn.

name: REFRIGERATOR YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. warm water
1  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. honey or sugar
2  tsp. salt
6 1/2  c. flour (can substitute 2 c. wheat, soya, graham, wheat germ or bran)
2  eggs
1/4  c. soft butter
preparation: Mix yeast into sugar or honey and warm water (100°); set 10 minutes.  Add salt and half the flour.  Beat 75 strokes.   Add eggs and butter.  Add remaining flour 1/2 cup at a time.  Make dough into nice ball.  Butter bowl and place dough face down to coat top, then turn face up and cover tightly.  Place in refrigerator for 2 hours, then make into rolls (or roll dough into a 6-inch snake and knot)      .  Bake in a 400° oven for 10 minutes.  Keeps in refrigerator for 4 to 5 days.

name: SOURDOUGH BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. sourdough
2 3/4  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. butter, melted
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Make   dough,  knead  30  seconds.  Roll  out  and  cut 1/2-inch thick biscuits.  Brush with more melted butter.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.  Makes a large batch.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
2  c. corn meal
1  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. finely chopped onions
1  egg, well beaten
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix and sift dry ingredients.  Add onion, well beaten egg and buttermilk.  Drop by the spoonful into hot fat.  Fry until golden brown.  Drain on absorbent paper.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: DELICIOUS SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  lb. round steak (1-inch thick)
1  c. onion, sliced
3  carrots, sliced
1 1/2  c. canned tomatoes
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
salt to taste
preparation: Mix together mustard, flour and salt.  Pound dry mixture into steak; cover both sides.  Brown both sides.  Cover meat with onions, carrots and tomatoes.  Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce, salt and brown sugar over all in long pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  oz. pkg. noodles
1 (12 1/2 oz.)  can tuna
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
1 1/2  c. sour cream
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. dry bread crumbs
1/4  c. grated cheese
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Cook noodles as on package; drain.  Mix noodles, tuna, mushrooms, sour cream and milk in ungreased casserole dish.  Mix bread crumbs, cheese and butter in separate dish.  Spread over tuna and noodle mixture.  Bake uncovered about 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly.  Makes 6 servings.

name: POPPY SEED CHICKEN
ingredients:
5  to 6 chicken breasts
8  oz. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 1/2  c. Ritz cracker crumbs
1  stick melted butter
2  tsp. poppy seed
preparation: Boil and debone chicken.  Place in bottom of baking dish. Cover with sour cream and soup mixed together.  Top with cracker crumbs and melted butter, then poppy seed.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: "DAD'S" PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
6  c. fresh peaches, sliced
2  c. Bisquick
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  c. sugar
1/2  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Place peaches in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and sprinkle with lemon juice.  Mix Bisquick, sugar and eggs until lumpy.  Spread mixture over peaches.  Pour melted margarine over top.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: FRIED CABBAGE AND NOODLES
ingredients:
noodles
bacon
cabbage
salt
pepper
preparation: Cook noodles; drain well.  Cut bacon in half.  Fry bacon until crisp.  Remove with slotted spoon.  Cut cabbage in half and cut in 1/2-inch slices.  Fry cabbage in bacon fat until tender.  Add salt and pepper; stir in noodles and add bacon.

name: RHUBARB PECAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. chopped pecans (walnuts may be substituted)
1  egg
1/4  c. vegetable oil
2  tsp. grated orange peel
3/4  c. orange juice
1 1/4  c. finely chopped rhubarb
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt and nuts.  In another bowl, combine egg, oil, orange peel and orange juice.  Add to dry ingredients all at once; stir just until moistened.  Stir in rhubarb.  Fill 12 lightly greased muffin cups almost to the top.  Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Yields 1 dozen.

name: HIDDEN TREASURE STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin
1  c. boiling water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. strawberries
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
3  medium bananas, mashed
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  pkg. unbaked cheese cake mix
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in fruit and nuts. Pour half of gelatin mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Chill until firm.  Store remaining gelatin mixture at room temperature.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
2  c. mashed sweet potatoes
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
1 (13 oz.)  can milk
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Blend well.  Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until knife inserted in middle comes out clean.

name: GREEN CHILI CHEESE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
12  eggs
1  can chopped green chilies
preparation: Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Put half of the grated cheese in bottom of pan. Sprinkle green chilies on cheese.  Cover with remaining cheese. Beat eggs and pour over cheese and chilies. Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.  Cut in 1-inch squares.  These freeze very well and are good for breakfast or hors d'oeuvres.

name: MOLASSES CRINKLES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar, packed
3/4  c. shortening
1/4  c. molasses
1  egg
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
1/4  tsp. salt
granulated sugar
preparation: Mix brown sugar, molasses, shortening and egg.  Mix in flour, soda, spices and salt.  Cover and refrigerate 1 hour.  Heat oven to 375°.  Shape dough by rounded teaspoonfuls into balls.  Dip tops in granulated sugar.  Place balls, sugared side up, 3 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake just until set, 10 to 12 minutes.  Immediately remove from cookie sheet.  Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

name: QUICK SUPPER DISH
ingredients:
1  lb. ground round
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1 (29 oz.)  can tomatoes
1/2  head cabbage, cut in 1/2-inch strips
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown beef and onion.  Chop whole tomatoes and add with juice. Put cabbage on top.  Season with salt and pepper.  Cover and cook until cabbage is tender.  Serve with rice.

name: CARROTS
ingredients:
pkg. of carrots, sliced
1  can tomato soup
salt
2  to 3 stalks celery
1  onion
chopped green peppers
black pepper
preparation: Cook carrots.  Add to cooked carrots the onion, green peppers, salt, black pepper, celery and tomato soup.  Cook just until tomato soup is hot.  Enjoy.

name: CUSTARD FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
1  single pie crust
fruit (of your choice, enough to fill pie shell)
3  eggs, separated
1  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
preparation: Sprinkle crust with flour and fill with fruit and dust fruit with sugar.  Beat egg yolks.  Add sugar and milk.  Beat egg whites and add to yolk mixture.  Pour custard over fruit.  Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.  Reduce heat to 300° and continue baking until crust is golden brown.

name: DRIED BEEF CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  boneless chicken breasts
1  pkg. dried beef
1/2  carton sour cream
1  can mushroom soup
6  slices bacon
preparation: Cover bottom of large shallow casserole with dried beef.  Place chicken breast on the beef; place a piece of semi-fried (limp) bacon on each piece of chicken.  Mix sour cream and mushroom soup and spread over the casserole.  Bake 2 hours at 350°.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. White Tenda Bake cornmeal mix
3  eggs
1  can yellow cream-style corn
1  lb. hot Neese's sausage
1  lb. sharp cheese, grated
1/3  c. Wesson oil
1  large onion, chopped
2  or 3 hot peppers, chopped
2  Tbsp. sugar
2 1/2 to 3  c. buttermilk
preparation: Cook sausage and drain off all fat.  Combine all ingredients. Pour into well-greased pan.  Bake at 400° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI AND CHEESE WITH RICE
ingredients:
3/4  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  sticks margarine
20  oz. pkg. frozen cut broccoli
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
1 1/2  c. Minute rice
2  cans cream of celery soup
preparation: Saute onions and celery in margarine.  Add cheese until melted.  Add saute mix to broccoli and soup.  Stir well.  Add uncooked rice and mix.  After all mixed together, pour into an 11 x 13-inch ungreased pan.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Uncover and bake an additional 20 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE THUMBPRINT COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2/3  c. sugar
1  egg, separated
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1/3  c. cocoa
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
vanilla filling
26  chocolate kisses
preparation: In a small bowl, cream butter, sugar, egg yolk, milk and vanilla.  Combine flour, cocoa and salt; blend into creamed mixture.  Chill dough at least 1 hour or until firm enough to handle.  Heat oven to 350°.  Shape dough into 1 inch balls.  Beat egg white slightly.  Dip each ball into egg white; roll in nuts. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Press thumb gently in center of each cookie.  Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until set.  As soon as cookies are removed from oven, spoon about 1/4 teaspoon filling in thumbprint.  Gently press kiss in center of each cookie. Carefully remove from cookie sheet.  Cool on wire rack.  Makes about 2 dozen cookies.

name: COPPER PENNIES
ingredients:
2  cans carrots, sliced and drained
2  medium onions, thinly sliced and separated into rings
1  medium green pepper, cut in thin strips
1 (10 oz.)  can condensed tomato soup
3/4  c. vinegar
1/2  c. cooking oil
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine carrots, onions and green pepper in large bowl.  Stir together remaining ingredients.  Pour over vegetables in bowl. Cover and marinate in refrigerator several hours or overnight. Drain, reserving marinade.  Serve in lettuce-lined bowl, if desired.  Return any leftover vegetables to marinade; keep refrigerated.  Yields 5 cups.  Will keep several weeks.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
2 to 3  c. diced, cooked chicken
2  cans cream of celery soup
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  cans Veg-All
salt and pepper to taste
chicken broth (add a little if you like it soupy)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour into baking dish. Bake for 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN SUPREME
ingredients:
4  whole chicken breasts, split, skinned and boned
4  slices Swiss cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  c. Pepperidge Farm stuffing
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Place chicken breasts in shallow pan.  Top each piece with a slice of Swiss cheese.  Thin soup with 1/2 can water and pour over chicken.  Combine stuffing and melted margarine.  Sprinkle over soup.  Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: CHEESEBURGER PIE(Weight Watchers Recipe)
ingredients:
16  oz. ground turkey
1/2  c. diced onion
1/2  c. diced green pepper
1  c. tomato sauce
1  envelope beef or chicken broth and seasoning mix
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
2  c. cooked macaroni
4  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Brown turkey, onion and green pepper in skillet.  Add tomato sauce, chili powder and garlic powder. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes.  Add cooked macaroni and 3 ounces of cheese.  Stir until cheese melts.  Pour into an 8 x 8-inch casserole dish that has been sprayed with a nonstick spray. Sprinkle remaining 1 ounce of cheese on top.  Bake 30 minutes. Remove and let set 10 to 15 minutes before cutting.

name: BEER BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. self-rising flour
1/3  c. sugar
12  oz. bottle beer
dash of salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients.   Bake in a greased pan at 350° for 55 minutes.  Cut with electric knife.

name: CEREAL CANDY
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. light corn syrup
1  c. peanut butter
6  c. wheat or corn flake cereal
preparation: Power:  High.

name: DADDY'S POTATO SALAD DOSS' STEAK HOUSE(This Is Unusual And Especially Good)
ingredients:
8  to 10 medium potatoes, diced
1  doz. hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1  large onion, chopped fine
3/4  c. sweet pickle relish
1 small  jar pimento, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/2  c. mustard
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Boil potatoes until well done and drain.  Peel eggs and chop fine.  Mix all ingredients.  Mix mustard and mayonnaise together and then add to other ingredients.  (More mustard and mayonnaise can be added if needed for right consistency.)

name: STIR-FRIED SHRIMP AND RICE
ingredients:
1  lb. uncooked shrimp, shelled and cleaned
2 to 4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. chopped sweet red pepper
2  tsp. chicken bouillon granules
2  eggs, slightly beaten
3  c. cooked rice
1 to 2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/8  tsp. fresh cracked pepper
1 to 2  tsp. minced onion (for garnish)
preparation: Melt butter or margarine in a 10-inch skillet; add shrimp and stir-fry over medium-high heat only until shrimp turn pink. Remove shrimp from pan and set aside.  Place onion and peppers in pan and stir-fry for 2 minutes.  Add chicken bouillon and stir 1 minute.  Stir in beaten eggs and stir-fry for 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat; season with soy sauce and peppers.  Place shrimp and rice on serving dish.  Top with green onions.  Serves 4.

name: CHOCOLATE-NUT BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  sq. unsweetened chocolate or 1 oz. no-melt unsweetened chocolate
1/2  c. shortening
2  Tbsp. sweetener
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt the unsweetened chocolate and shortening in a saucepan over low heat.  Remove from heat.  Add sweetener, vanilla and beaten eggs.  Stir until well blended.  Add flour, salt and baking soda.  Mix until well blended.  Stir in nuts.  Pour into greased 8-inch pan.  Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.  Cool; cut into squares.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE CAKE(Diet Dessert)
ingredients:
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1  packet diet gelatin
3  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1 (15 oz.)  can unsweetened pineapple, crushed
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. graham crackers
preparation: Pour evaporated milk in a large mixing bowl and freeze until crystals form when whipped.  Soften cream cheese at room temperature.  Then mash with fork until creamy.  Pour pineapple juice into a cup, adding water to equal 1 cup of juice and water. Dissolve gelatin in boiling juice; cool.  Add cream cheese and vanilla; beat well.  Fold in pineapple and whipped milk.  Line bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan with graham cracker crumbs.  Fill with mixture and refrigerate.  Cut into 12 servings.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
8  oz. Cool Whip
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sugar
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
strawberries (as many as you want)
1  pkg. sugar cookie dough
4  sliced bananas (put in pineapple juice, then put the bananas only in a layer, not the juice)
preparation: Slice 1 package sugar cookie dough and put in 9 x 13-inch pan, closely.  Bake 8 to 11 minutes at 350°.  Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip, vanilla and sugar.  Beat until smooth; spread on top of cooled cookie dough.  On top, add in layers:  crushed pineapple, bananas (in single layer), sliced strawberries (as many as you like), sprinkle coconut and handful of pecans.  Chill and serve.

name: CRAWFISH BISQUE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. crawfish tails
5  medium onions, minced
3  stalks celery, minced
4  medium bell peppers, minced
4  cloves garlic, minced
6  slices stale bread
cooking oil
black pepper
red pepper
salt
preparation: Combine minced vegetables and brown well in enough cooking oil to barely cover.  Pour off excess oil when vegetables are browned. Grind crawfish tails.  Soak bread in water and wring out water.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/4  c. red food coloring
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. butter flavoring
2  Tbsp. cocoa
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar and eggs.  Make a paste with coloring and cocoa; add to cream mixture.  Add salt and flour with buttermilk and vanilla.  Alternately add soda and vinegar.  Add butter flavoring.  Blend.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: C2C AND PSCC CHILI MAC
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chicken
2  c. elbow macaroni
2 (16 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1/2  small onion, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
2  celery stalks, sliced
1  tsp. chili seasoning
salt and pepper
1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Brown ground meat.  Cook macaroni according to directions; drain.  To meat brown onion, green pepper and celery.  Add small amount of oil, if needed.  After sauteeing veggies, add tomato sauce.  Pour all into pan with drained macaroni.  Warm.  Serve with grated cheese and enjoy.  (This dish can be personalized with various ground meat, different pasta and more or less chili seasoning.)

name: CREAMED SPINACH
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
1  large onion, chopped
2  lb. fresh spinach
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large saucepan.  Saute onion in butter until brown.  Add washed, drained spinach to onion and cook, covered, for 3 to 5 minutes.  Drain and chop.  Return spinach to a saucepan.  While spinach is cooking, work remaining butter and flour together with a fork.  When spinach is cooked, lower heat and add butter-flour mixture a little at a time until all is smoothly incorporated.  Add milk and seasonings.  Reheat.  Use as a garnish with other vegetables.  Serves 6.

name: CHRISTMAS SALAD
ingredients:
1  can French-style green beans
1  can baby peas
1  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  green pepper, diced
1 (4 oz.)  jar pimento, diced
1/2  c. salad oil
1/2  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
preparation: Mix together first 6 ingredients.  Then mix oil, vinegar and sugar.  Pour over vegetables.  Refrigerate overnight to marinate.

name: 7 LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
lettuce, torn in bite size pieces
1  medium onion, chopped or sliced (purple or green)
1  pkg. frozen green peas, uncooked
4  hard-boiled eggs, sliced
1/2  lb. bacon, cooked and crumbled
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2 to 1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Layer lettuce, onion, peas and eggs. Sprinkle with bacon.  Ice top with mayonnaise.  Sprinkle top with shredded cheese.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. paprika
1 3/4  c. milk
4  medium potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced (about 4 c.)
1  large onion, thinly sliced
preparation: Microwave: Grease 2-quart microwave-safe ring mold.  Place butter in 4-cup glass measure.  Microcook at 100% power for 1 minute.   Stir in flour, salt, pepper and paprika until smooth. Blend in milk.  Cover tightly with Saran Wrap, turning back edge to vent.  Microwave at 100% power for 5 minutes, until thickened, sirring twice.  Layer potatoes and onion slices alternately in prepared mold, starting and ending with potatoes.  Pour sauce over potatoes and sprinkle with paprika.  Cover dish tightly with Saran Wrap, turning back edge to vent.  Microwave at 50% power about 25 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender, rotating dish twice. Let stand on heatproof surface for 5 minutes before serving.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. grated orange peel
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. grated zucchini
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.

name: BAKED NOODLES
ingredients:
1  lb. fine noodles
4  c. creamy cottage cheese
4  c. sour cream
1  c. minced onion
3  cloves garlic, minced
4  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
4  dashes Tabasco sauce
4  Tbsp. poppy seed
2  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
paprika
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook noodles until tender; drain.  Combine noodles with the remaining ingredients, except paprika and cheese.  Bake in buttered casserole dish at 350° until hot (about 30 minutes). Sprinkle with paprika and Parmesan cheese.

name: COCONUT ICING
ingredients:
1  c. sweet milk
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. oil
1  c. pecans
1  c. coconut
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: In a saucepan combine flour, salt, and milk.  Heat stirring constantly, until thick.  Cool completely.  Cream sugar, oil, and vanilla until fluffy.  Beat in flour mixture.  Add nuts and coconut.

name: SOUR CREAM CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
3  cans cream of chicken soup
3  or 4 chicken breasts, cooked
1  pt. sour cream
1/2  c. vegetable oil
4  c. cheese, grated
15  corn tortillas
1 (7 oz.)  can green chilies, diced
preparation: Combine soup, chicken and sour cream.  Dip tortillas into hot oil.  Spoon 3 teaspoons of chicken cream mixture into tortillas. Sprinkle 3 tablespoons of cheese on top of chicken cream mixture. Roll up.  Place into oblong dish, seam side down.  Tortillas should fit snugly.  Pour rest of chicken cream mixture over top.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: SWEET AND SOUR SAUCE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. catsup
1/4  c. vinegar
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Combine in saucepan and bring to boil, mixing thoroughly. Pour over chicken and bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

name: GRANDMA'S TEA CAKES(Old Family Recipe)
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
4  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. buttermilk
1 to 1 1/4  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add one egg at a time, beating after each.  Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a separate bowl.  Add flour mixture to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk.  Mix well.  Stir in almond extract, cover and chill one hour.  Roll dough to 1/4-inch thickness on a floured surface.  Cut with 2 3/4-inch round cookie cutter.  Place on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until edges begin to brown.  Sprinkle with sugar.

name: ORANGE CANDIED YAMS
ingredients:
1  tsp. salt
1  c. orange juice
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. orange rind
3  to 4 medium yams, cut in halves
preparation: Place yams in pressure cooker with orange juice, rind, brown sugar, butter and salt.  Cook 6 to 8 minutes.  Cool cooker at once.  Boil liquid until thickened and pour over yams.

name: SLICKER DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  egg, beaten
1 1/4  sticks butter
1/2  c. milk
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
pinch of baking powder
chicken broth (hot)
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Combine egg, milk and melted butter; add to dry ingredients.  Roll thin; cut into 1-inch squares or 2-inch long strips.  Drop into hot chicken broth; cook until done.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. diced onion
3  cloves garlic, diced
salt to taste
chili powder to taste
cumin to taste
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  c. tomatoes with chilies
1  head lettuce, coarsely chopped
2  large firm ripe tomatoes, diced
1 large  pkg. corn chips
preparation: Brown beef in small amount of oil.  Saute onion and garlic until soft, but not brown; add to beef.  Simmer for several minutes.  Season with salt, chili powder and cumin.

name: PECAN BARS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  box brown sugar
2  c. pecans
2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs
2  sticks butter
preparation: Melt butter. Add brown sugar and mix.  Add eggs and vanilla; mix.  Mix dry ingredients and add to butter mix.  Mix entire ingredients.  Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° until done.

name: DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  c. enriched flour, sifted
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. fat or oil
preparation: Mix ingredients in order.  Makes soft dough.  Drop dumplings from spoon into hot broth.  Cover and steam for 12 to 15 minutes without lifting cover.

name: BRAUNSCHWEIGER CHIP DIP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. braunschweiger
3  oz. cream cheese
1  tsp. onion juice
1/2  pt. sour cream
preparation: Combine all ingredients except sour cream in a bowl; mix with electric mixer.  When smooth and well mixed, stir in sour cream. Chill for 2 hours.  Serve with chips or snack crackers.  Yields 23 to 35 servings.

name: CHICKEN DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1 small  can white meat (chicken)
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can sweet milk
1 big  Tbsp. margarine
1  pkg. White Lily biscuit mix
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Open cream of chicken soup; add 1 can sweet milk and margarine.  Cook on low heat.  When starts cooking good, add meat (separate with a fork) and add a teaspoon of salt to chicken. When this is cooking good, add your dumplings.

name: VEGETABLE BEEF SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. stew beef
1 (15 oz.)  can tomatoes
2  carrots, sliced
2  medium onions, diced*
2  medium potatoes, peeled and diced
3  c. water
1  tsp. salt
2  celery stalks, sliced (optional)
3  beef bouillon cubes
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables*
preparation: Put all ingredients in crock-pot. Cover and cook on low for 12 to 24 hours. (High 4 to 6 hours.)

name: LEMON BREAD
ingredients:
1  Pillsbury lemon cake mix
1/3  cup sugar
1/4  cup oil (1 use canola)
1  cup apricot nectar
1  tsp. lemon extract
4  eggs (room temperature...very important)
3/4 - 1  cup of powdered sugar
1  large lemon squeezed
preparation: Stir until creamy and then glaze bread while still in the pan.

name: RICH ROLL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2/3  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cream first 2 ingredients.  Beat in egg and vanilla.  Add flour, salt and cinnamon.  Blend well.  Chill dough 3 to 4 hours. Preheat oven to 350°.  Roll and cut out.  Bake on cookie sheet for 8 to 10 minutes or until slightly browned.   Makes about 60 (2-inch) cookies.

name: MOCK APPLE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  tsp. cream of tartar
dash of salt
20  Ritz crackers, broken
lump of butter
cinnamon
whipped topping
preparation: Bring water, sugar, salt and cream of tartar to a boil.  Add crackers and set off heat.  Add a lump of butter and some cinnamon.  Pour in unbaked pie shell.  Add whipped topping.

name: NO-BAKE BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
2  (3-4 oz.) instant vanilla pudding
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
3 1/2  c. milk
Vanilla Wafers
3  lg. bananas, sliced
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
