preparation: Combine instant pudding, sour cream and milk.  Beat at low speed 2 minutes.  Allow to set.  Line bottom and sides of a 3 quart bowl with vanilla wafers.  Spoon one third of pudding mixture over sliced bananas.  Repeat layer of vanilla wafers, bananas and Cool Whip.  Spread remaining Cool Whip on top.  Chill and serve.

name: MARINATED GREEN BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. cooking oil
3/4  c. vinegar
1  can French green beans, drained
1  can garden peas, drained
1 small  jar pimento, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
preparation: Heat sugar, oil and vinegar until sugar is dissolved, stirring frequently.  Cool.  Pour beans, peas, pimento, celery, onion and pepper into sugar mixture; mix well.  Refrigerate overnight.  Drain before serving.

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
5  potatoes
1/2  onion
Tbsp. mustard
1/2  c. mayo
sprinkle of salt
preparation: Boil potatoes until done. Drain water. Combine all ingredients. Put in the refrigerator until cool.

name: STOVE TOP SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
4  lb. sweet potatoes
1/2  stick margarine
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. water
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. marshmallows (enough to cover large skillet)
1 1/4  c. pecans (Optional)
preparation: Peel and slice potatoes into 1/2-inch slices.  Melt margarine in large covered skillet over medium heat. Brown potato slices in margarine on both sides until all slices have been browned.  Add brown sugar, water and cinnamon to potatoes.  Turn heat to low and cook until potatoes are fork-tender (10 or 15 minutes).

name: BAKED SPINACH DIP(Serves 8 to 10)
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. chopped jalapenos
3/4  c. chopped onions
2  tomatoes, chopped (about 2 c.)
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
2  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1/3  c. half and half
preparation: In medium bowl, mix all ingredients together and pour into ovenproof dish.  Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Serve with pita chips, bagel chips or crackers.

name: BUTTERMILK BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1/4  tsp. soda
1/4  c. shortening
3/4  c. buttermilk
preparation: Bake at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: BLACK FOREST CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
1 2/3  c. sugar
2/3  c. cocoa
1 1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1 1/4  c. water
3/4  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
Cherry Filling
1  (4 oz.) bar milk chocolate
2  c. whipping cream, chilled
1/4  c. sugar
maraschino cherries
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Generously grease and flour two 9-inch round layer pans.  Beat flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda, salt, baking powder, water, shortening, eggs and vanilla in a large bowl on low speed, scraping bowl constantly, 30 seconds.  Beat on high speed for 3 minutes.  Pour into pans and bake 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 5 minutes; remove from pans.  Cool on wire racks.  Prepare cherry filling.  With a vegetable parer, make chocolate curls using the candy bar.  Refrigerate until ready to use.  Beat whipping cream and 1/4 cup sugar in chilled bowl until peaks form. Spread bottom layer with 2/3 of cherry filling and 1 cup of the whipped cream.  Top with the second layer.  Spread with remaining cherry filling.  Frost top and sides with remaining whipped cream. If desired, coarsely shred sweet chocolate and press onto side of the cake.  Garnish with chocolate curls and maraschino cherries.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. white syrup
1  c. sugar
2  c. raw peanuts
1  tsp. baking soda
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook the 3 ingredients together until peanuts are done or until real brittle stage.  Syrup gets brown and the peanuts pop. Take off heat and add all at once the soda, melted butter and vanilla.  Stir real hard (it will bubble up).  Pour immediately while still bubbling onto a buttered cookie sheet to cool and harden.

name: LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, torn
1  c. celery
4  eggs, hard-boiled and sliced
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas (uncooked)
1  c. grated raw carrots
1  medium onion, diced
8  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix together and spread on top.  Sprinkle 4 ounces of grated Cheddar cheese on top.  Cover and refrigerate for 8 to 12 hours.

name: DANNY'S DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
20  oz. pkg. Oreo cookies
2 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
16  oz. carton Cool Whip
8  oz. cream cheese
gummy worms
preparation: Will also need 1 artificial stem flower and 1 flowerpot.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. boneless chicken breasts
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  lb. Swiss cheese, shredded
1  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1/4  c. dry white wine
8  oz. pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb seasoned stuffing mix
1  stick melted butter
preparation: Cut uncooked chicken into small pieces, mix chicken, mushrooms and soup together (do not dilute the soup).  Place mixture into a 13 x 9-inch glass dish.  Cover with the shredded cheese and pour the wine over cheese.  Sprinkle dry stuffing mix on top and pour on melted butter.   Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, uncovered, until chicken is done.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
2  sticks margarine, melted
1/2  c. peanut peanut
1  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  c. finely chopped nuts
1  box powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1/2  block paraffin wax
preparation: Mix cracker crumbs and powdered sugar.  Add melted butter. Add peanut butter.  Add nuts.  Mix well.  Shape into small balls. Let chill.  Using a double boiler, melt wax.  Add chocolate chips. Dip balls into chocolate mixture using a toothpick.  Coat each ball.  Place on wax paper.

name: THUMBPRINT COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
4  c. flour
1  Tbsp. salt
pecans
preparation: Mix together thoroughly, shortening, brown sugar, egg yolks and vanilla.  Sift together and stir in flour and salt.  Cool in refrigerator until firm.  Roll into small balls.  Dip in slightly beaten egg whites.  Roll in ground pecans.  Place about 1 inch apart on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake at 350°.  Bake five minutes and remove and press thumb in each cookie.  Return to oven and bake 8 minutes.  Cool.  Ice with confectioners sugar icing.

name: CHEESE STRATA
ingredients:
5  slices bread
3/4  lb. shredded sharp cheddar cheese
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Grease 3 quart casserole.  Butter and cut bread into squares. Make two layers of bread and cheese in casserole.  Mix together eggs, milk and mustard.  Pour milk/egg mixture over bread and cheese layers.  Cover and let stand overnight in fridge.  Bake at 350° for one hour.

name: MEXICAN CAVIAR
ingredients:
2 (4 1/4 oz. each)  cans chopped olives
2 (4 oz. each)  cans chopped green chilies
2  tomatoes, peeled and chopped
3  green onions, chopped
2  garlic cloves, mashed
3  tsp. olive oil
2  tsp. red wine vinegar
1  tsp. pepper
dash of seasoning salt
preparation: Combine ingredients and chill overnight.  Serve with Fritos.

name: CREAMY CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
4  c. cubed potatoes
1/4  c. chopped shallots
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can chicken broth
3  slices cooked and crumbled bacon
1  clove of garlic
3  c. milk
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  (6 1/2 oz.) minced clams
2  Tbsp. chopped chives
preparation: Heat potatoes, shallots, broth and garlic to boiling in Dutch oven; reduce heat to low.  Cover and simmer about 12 minutes or until potatoes are tender.  Cool slightly.  Place 1/2 of potato mixture in blender, cover and blend about 15 seconds or until smooth.  Stir back into potato mixture in Dutch oven.  Stir in milk, pepper, the clams and bacon.  Heat over medium heat, stirring frequently, until hot.  Sprinkle with chives.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1 large  can pork and beans (29 oz.)
1  c. catsup
1/2  lb. bacon
1 small  can pineapple tidbits
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  small onion, chopped
1  chopped bell pepper
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Fry bacon and drain.  Break up in pieces.  Mix everything together and bake 2 hours at 325°.  Stir occasionally.  (Can slice bacon after freezing, then fry and drain.)  Serves 6 to 8.

name: SURPRISE COBBLER
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. sweet milk
1  qt. sweetened juicy fruit
preparation: Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.  Add sweet milk and beat together.  Pour batter into a greased pan.  Pour juicy fruit over batter and bake slowly about 35 minutes.

name: SWEDISH APPLE NUT PIE
ingredients:
1  large egg, beaten
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. thinly sliced apples
1  c. chopped nuts
cinnamon and nutmeg
preparation: Mix egg and sugar.  Add remaining ingredients one at a time. Pour into a greased pie tin. Sprinkle top with the cinnamon and nutmeg.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serve warm with ice cream or whipped cream.

name: GREEN BEAN BAKE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. soy sauce
dash of pepper
4  c. French-cut green beans
1 (2.8 oz.)  can French fried onions
preparation: In 1 1/2-quart casserole, combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper.  Stir in beans and 1/2 can onions.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Top with remaining onions.  Bake 5 additional minutes. Serves 6.

name: PUDDING DESSERT
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jiffy yellow cake mix
2  c. cold milk
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  large container Cool Whip
nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix the cake as directed on package.  Spread in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan and bake.  Mix milk and cream cheese. Add vanilla pudding. Beat for 2 minutes. Spread on cooled cake.   Drain the pineapple well. Spread over the pudding mix.  Spread Cool Whip over the pineapple. Sprinkle with nuts, if desired.

name: BUSTER BAR DESSERT
ingredients:
26  Oreo cookies, crushed
1/2  gal. softened vanilla ice cream
11 1/2  oz. can beer nuts
1  can Hershey chocolate syrup
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Layer crushed Oreos in a 9 x 13-inch dish.  Reserve 1/2 cup for topping.  Layer each ingredient in order as given on top of Oreos. Top with remaining Oreos.  Keep in freezer.

name: IMPOSSIBLY EASY CHICKEN 'N BROCCOLI PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. (10 oz.) frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
1-1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese (6 oz.)
1  c. cut-up cooked chicken
1  medium onion, chopped (1/2 c.)
1/2  c. Original Bisquick
1  cup milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  eggs
preparation: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  Grease 9-inch pie plate.  Sprinkle broccoli, 1 cup of the cheese, the chicken and onion in pie plate. Stir Bisquick, milk, salt, pepper and eggs until blended.  Pour into pie plate.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. Pillsbury's Best sugar cookies
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
banana slices
peeled kiwi slices
strawberry halves
blueberries
preparation: Freeze cookie dough 1 hour.  Slice into 1/8 inch slices.  Line foil-lined 14-inch pizza pan with slices, overlapping edges slightly.  Bake at 375° for 12 minutes or until golden brown. Cool.  Invert onto serving plate; carefully remove foil.  Invert to right side.

name: ITALIAN BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
2  c. small red beans (1 lb.)
8  c. water
1  clove garlic
1  large onion, chopped
1 1/2  c. shredded carrots
1  c. celery, finely chopped
1  can tomatoes (14 oz.)
3  lb. fully cooked bone in ham
2  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. parsley, minced
preparation: Put beans in water; boil 2 minutes.  Remove; cover and let stand 1 hour.  Add garlic, onion, carrots, celery, tomatoes and ham.  Bring mix to boil; reduce to simmer and cover.  Cook 2 to 2 1/2 hours until beans mash easily.  Remove ham bone.  Coarsely chop ham and blend 1/2 of soup mix until smooth.  Add to rest of soup and ham.  Cook 5 to 6 minutes over medium heat.  Top with Parmesan cheese and parsley.

name: ALEX'S BREAKFAST BEANS
ingredients:
1  c. refried beans (see Susan's recipe)
1/4  c. shredded Mozzarella
preparation: Spread beans in  shallow ramekin and sprinkle cheese on top. Cover with	waxed  paper  and  microwave  on  High for 1 minute.

name: ITALIAN POT ROAST
ingredients:
3  lb. lean chuck or rump roast
2  cloves garlic, crushed or 1/4 tsp. garlic powder
1 1/2  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. thyme
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. sugar
3  c. water
grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  medium onions, chopped
1/2  tsp. basil leaves
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. black pepper
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
1  lb. thin noodles
chopped chives
preparation: Brown meat on all sides in oil.  Remove meat and lower heat. Add garlic and next 8 seasonings.  Simmer about 5 minutes.  Do not burn.  Return meat.  Mix tomato paste with water and pour over meat.  Bring to full boil.  Lower heat and cover loosely.  Simmer slowly about 2 to 3 hours, turning meat occasionally.  When meat is tender, cook noodles and drain.  Slice roast and arrange with noodles and cover with sauce.  Sprinkle with cheese and chives.

name: TEX-MEX FONDUE
ingredients:
1/4  c. tequila
1  garlic clove, minced
1  lb. Velveeta Mexican cheese spread with jalapeno peppers, cubed
2  Tbsp. lime juice
2  Tbsp. cilantro, chopped
preparation: Heat tequila and garlic in medium saucepan or fondue pot. Bring to boil.  Reduce heat; simmer 1 minute.  Add cheese spread and lime juice; stir until cheese spread is melted.  Stir in cilantro.  Keep hot while serving.  Dip cooked chicken chunks, jicama chunks, red, green or yellow pepper chunks and tortilla chips into the mixture.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  boxes cream cheese
2 small  pkg. chipped beef, chopped
12  green onions, chopped
1  Tbsp. Accent
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix well and form into ball. Roll in chopped pecans.

name: SEAFOOD SALAD(Baked)
ingredients:
1  large green pepper
1  small onion
1  c. diced celery
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can crabmeat
1 (5 3/4 oz.)  can shrimp
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
seafood seasoning
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. salt
pepper
soft bread crumbs
butter
paprika
lemon wedges
preparation: Chop pepper, onion and celery.  Combine with seafood, Worcestershire sauce, seasoning, mayonnaise, salt and pepper.  Top with bread crumbs.  Dot with butter (in a full size shallow baking dish).  Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Serve with lemon.  Serves 4. Serve chilled over lettuce and lemon.

name: FRUIT 'N CRUMB COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. and 1 1/3 c. all-purpose flour*
1/3  c. and 2/3 c. sugar
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  c. vegetable shortening
1  egg
2/3  c. milk
1 1/2  c. Wheat and Raisin Chex cereal, crushed to 1/2 c.
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/2  c. preserves (apricot, peach or strawberry)
preparation: *Stir flour, then spoon into measuring cups.

name: ANISE COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. milk
3 1/4  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. anise or 1/2 bottle
preparation: Mix all the ingredients and place onto a greased cookie sheet by heaping teaspoonful. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  pack taco seasoning
1  jar salsa
1  head chopped lettuce
chopped tomatoes
black olives
onions
green peppers
1  pack shredded Cheddar
sour cream
1  bottle Catalina dressing
1  bag crushed tortilla chips
preparation: Brown and drain hamburger.  Add taco seasoning.  Mix together with remaining ingredients.  Before serving, add tortilla chips.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. Oreo cookies
1/2  stick oleo
8  oz. soft cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
3 1/2  c. milk
2 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
12  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: You will also need 1 new flowerpot with 8-inch diameter at top and 1 new garden hand spade.

name: QUICHE LORRAINE
ingredients:
pastry
1/4  c. onion
1 1/2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. diced ham or bacon
5  eggs
1  egg yolk
2 1/2  c. light cream
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
2  dashes cayenne pepper
dash of white pepper
1  c. grated Swiss cheese
preparation: Line 10-inch pan with pastry.  Bake 8 to 9 minutes at 400°. Cook onion in butter until transparent.  Mix with ham.  Beat eggs and egg yolk, light cream and seasonings.  Add to ham mixture. Pour into pastry shell.  Top with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until set.

name: DIABETIC POUND CAKE(1/4-Inch Slice, 45 Calories)
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. mace
1  c. butter
6  tsp. sugar substitute or 24 single serve packets
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. milk
3  eggs, beaten
2  mixing bowls
preparation: In first mixing bowl, mix flour and mace.  In second bowl, cream sweetener and butter and vanilla until fluffy.  Add eggs and beat.  Add dry ingredients and milk alternately.  Pour into 10-inch pan and bake 60 minutes at 350°.

name: TROPICAL ISLAND PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen concentrated limeade
2 (6 oz.)  cans frozen concentrated pineapple juice
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen concentrated orange juice
13 (6 oz.)  cans water (9 3/4 c.)
2  c. sugar
3 (12 oz.)  bottles ginger ale, chilled
maraschino cherries
preparation: (I freeze a mold of some of this mixture for the punch bowl.) Thaw concentrated juices.  Combine in a large container.  Add water and sugar.  Stir until sugar dissolves.  Chill well.  Add ginger ale.  Pour all into punch bowl with crushed ice and the frozen mold.

name: ZUCCHINI CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  c. zucchini, grated with skin
3  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
3  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together all liquid ingredients; set aside.  Mix all dry ingredients; combine with liquid mixture.  Mix in nuts.   Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch dish.  Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: APPLE COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. apples, peeled and sliced
1/2  c. oil
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
2  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except apples, together until well blended.  Fold in apples.  Pour into greased pan.  Bake for 35 to 40 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350°.

name: THE W I V K WHILHITE AND WALL BURGER
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  packet Lipton onion soup mix
1/4  c. beer or water
salt and pepper
sliced American cheese
lettuce
pickles
tomato
sliced onion
mustard
catsup
buns
preparation: Mix together in a bowl the ground beef, chopped onions, Lipton onion soup mix and water or beer.  Form three or four patties, depending on how big your buns are (the hamburger buns, not your personal buns).  Salt and pepper the patties.  At this point, you should be thinking if you washed your hands before you started. It's too late, but remember next time.  You don't know where your hands have been.  Grill the burgers on the barbecue; melt the cheese on the patties as they finish cooking.  Garnish with lettuce, pickles, tomato, sliced onion, mustard and catsup.

name: PUFF PHYLLO SPINACH SQUARES
ingredients:
12  sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed
1/2  c. margarine, melted
2 (12 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach souffle, thawed
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts, finely chopped
preparation: Arrange 6 sheets of the phyllo dough in bottom of a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan, brushing margarine between each sheet.  (Allow edges to overlap sides of pan.)  Spread souffle evenly over dough. Sprinkle with water chestnuts.  Top with remaining 6 sheets of dough, brushing margarine between.

name: POPCORN CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine or butter
1/2  c. oil
1  lb. marshmallows
4  qt. popped popcorn
1/2  lb. peanuts (salted or roasted)
1  lb. plain M&M's
preparation: In a saucepan, combine margarine, oil and marshmallows.  Stir until mixed well.  Cool slightly and pour over popcorn and peanuts.  Add M&M's last.  Press into greased pan and refrigerate 1 hour.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  egg, slightly beaten
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can creamed corn
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
3  Tbsp. butter
1  c. Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix
preparation: In mixing bowl, place egg, broccoli, corn, onion, salt and pepper.  In saucepan, melt butter and add stuffing mix; toss to coat.  Stir in half stuffing.  Mix into vegetables.   Put in 1-quart casserole.  Sprinkle with remaining stuffing mix.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.   Serves 4.

name: TAMALE PIE
ingredients:
3  large tamales, diced
2 small  cans tomato sauce
2  cans chili con carne with no beans
1  can Niblets corn
1  can pitted ripe olives
1  lb. shredded cheese
Fritos
preparation: Mix all together.  Save 1/2 of cheese for top.  Crush Fritos and put on top of cheese.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: CORN DOGS(Makes 8)
ingredients:
1/2  c. corn meal
2  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  egg, beaten
8  hot dogs
preparation: Mix corn meal, flour, milk, egg and oil.  Beat with fork. Roll hot dogs in flour, then roll in batter.  Deep fry in oil until brown.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. cooked, diced chicken
1  doz. corn tortillas
8  oz. Cheddar cheese
1  small container sour cream
1 large  can diced green chiles
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 small  bunch chopped green onions
preparation: Mix the chiles, sour cream, cream of chicken soup and green onions.  Coat tortillas in soup mixture.  Place one layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Place chicken layer and cheese, then repeat layers. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND SAUSAGE GUMBO
ingredients:
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
vegetable cooking spray
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. sliced celery
7  c. hot water
2  tsp. reduced sodium Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. hot sauce
1/2  tsp. dried thyme
4  c. cooked rice
1/2  lb. 80% fat-free smoked sausage
6  (6 oz.) skinned chicken breast halves
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
2  bay leaves
2  cloves minced garlic
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sliced green onions (optional)
preparation: Place flour in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until caramel colored, stirring flour every 5 minutes. Brown sausage in a Dutch oven or large skillet coated with cooking spray over medium heat.  Drain and pat dry with paper towels.  Wipe drippings from Dutch oven.  Brown chicken; drain and pat dry.  Wipe drippings from Dutch oven.  Cook onion, green pepper and celery in Dutch oven (coated with cooking spray) until tender; sprinkle with browned flour.  Gradually stir in water; bring to a boil.  Add sausage (cut into 1/4-inch slices); add chicken, garlic, bay leaves, Worcestershire sauce, hot sauce, thyme, salt and green onions (optional).  Reduce heat and simmer mixture (uncovered) for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Serve over rice.

name: COLD-CHASER CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
1  pkg. 4 to 5 chicken thighs
1  pkg. 4 to 5 chicken breasts
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. frozen spinach
1  c. frozen broccoli
1  c. frozen peas
1  c. frozen corn
1/2  c. sliced okra
1 (12 oz.)  can chopped tomatoes
1 1/2  tsp. chopped garlic
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. rosemary
2  large bay leaves
preparation: Place chicken in large Dutch oven, crock-pot or stew pot; fill pot 3/4 full with water.  Add all other ingredients, except okra. Simmer for 3 hours.  Add okra; cook 1/2 hour longer.  Remove bones from chicken; replace meat in soup.  Serves 6.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD MOLD
ingredients:
1  c. walnuts
1 small  pkg. lime jello
1 small  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
1  pt. large curd cottage cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
8  oz. crushed pineapple (juice included)
1 large  can evaporated milk
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in water; stir well.  Mix in the rest of ingredients.  Chill at least 4 hours until firm in individual or large mold.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: FAKE RUMAKI
ingredients:
1  lb. box pitted dates
1  can sliced water chestnuts, halved
bacon strips, cut in half
1 small  jar orange marmalade
preparation: You will also need round toothpicks.

name: QUICK MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. uncooked elbow macaroni
3  Tbsp. melted margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. shredded sharp cheese
1  qt. skim milk
preparation: Place uncooked macaroni in casserole dish.  Add margarine, salt and cheese.  Mix; pour milk over ingredients and stir.  Bake in oven 1 hour at 350°.  Do not stir.  Bake uncovered.  Makes 4 servings.

name: HOT MULLED CIDER
ingredients:
1  qt. fresh apple cider
1  c. sugar or honey
4  cinnamon sticks
1  doz. whole cloves
preparation: Combine cider and sugar in a large enameled pan or crock-pot. Tie cinnamon and cloves with cheesecloth bag; add to cider mixture.  Bring to simmering over medium heat.   Simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes.  Discard spice bag.

name: TEENAGERS SPECIAL SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. thawed, well drained, chopped spinach
1 small  can water chestnuts, sliced (optional)
1  small onion, chopped
1 1/2  c. light sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
preparation: Mix all ingredients and chill.  Serve in a hollowed out loaf of pumpernickel bread.  Add various kinds of cut breads as options for dip.

name: PERFECT PIE CRUST
ingredients:
4  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
1 3/4  c. shortening
1  egg
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  c. cold water
preparation: Blend dry ingredients, then cut in shortening with pastry blender until mixture is crumbly.  Add liquid ingredients and toss with fork.  Chill before rolling.  Divide in 6 equal parts.  Can be frozen and used as needed.  Makes 3 double crust pies.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
2  cloves garlic
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  lb. ground beef
1  can tomato sauce (15 oz.)
1  can stewed tomatoes (14.5 oz.)
3/4  c. A.1. steak sauce
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. cumin
1  can kidney beans
shredded cheese
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add beef and cook until brown. Drain and stir in tomato sauce, stewed tomatoes, steak sauce, chili powder and cumin. Heat to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in beans and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Ladle into bowls and top with shredded cheese.

name: REESE CUP CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
1/4  c. cocoa
1  c. water
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  eggs, well beaten
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. peanut butter
1 1/2  Tbsp. warm oil
preparation: In a saucepan on medium heat, combine and bring to a boil, first 5 ingredients.  In a bowl, combine next 3 ingredients; add to the other ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Let cool. Prepare peanut butter and oil.  Mix together and spread over cooled cake.

name: MANHATTAN DELI SALAD
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. spiral pasta
1 1/4  c. pitted ripe olives, sliced
1  c. chopped red or green pepper
1/4  lb. hard salami, cut in strips
1  small red onion, cut in rings
1/4 to 1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. chopped parsley
1  Tbsp. capers (optional)
3/4  c. Italian salad dressing
preparation: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Combine remaining ingredients in large bowl.  Add pasta; mix well.  Serve at room temperature or chilled.  Makes about 6 servings.

name: RHUBARB CAKE WITH OATMEAL CRUST
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
2  c. flour
1/2  c. oatmeal
3/4  c. shortening
preparation: Work all ingredients together like pie crust.  Line a 13 x 9-inch baking dish with the mixture and reserve 1 cup for topping. Slice rhubarb or apples (1/2-inch pieces) into pan.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2 small  cans pork and beans
3/4  c. ketchup
1 1/2  c. dark brown sugar
1  onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. mustard
salt and pepper
bacon strips (on top)
preparation: Cook 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: BIBLICAL CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Judges 5:25 (butter)
2  c. Jeremiah 6:20 (sugar)
3 1/2  c. 1 Kings 4:22 (flour)
2  c. 1 Samuel 30:12 (raisins)
2  c. 1 Samuel 30:12 (figs)
1  c. Genesis 43:11 (almonds)
6  Isaiah 10:14 (eggs)
1  c. Genesis 9:11 (water)
pinch of Leviticus 2:13 (salt)
1  Tbsp. Exodus 16:31 (honey)
1  tsp. Matthew 13:33 (sweet spice to taste)
2  tsp. Matthew 13:33 (baking powder)
preparation: Follow Solomon's advice for making good boys and you will have a good cake.  (Proverbs 23:14, first clause).  Bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes at 350°.

name: PIZZA
ingredients:
dough (store bought)
1  can mushrooms
1/4  lb. pepperoni
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. basil
1  qt. sauce
1/2  lb. Mozzarella cheese
1  clove garlic
preparation: Grease a cookie sheet.  Spread the dough and let rise.  After it has risen, spread the sauce on it.  Sprinkle oregano, basil and garlic on the dough.  Then put pepperoni and mushrooms on it. Bake in a preheated 425° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.  After it's done cooking, sprinkle the cheese on top.

name: STRAWBERRIES AND CREAM DESSERT
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1 1/2  c. cold water
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding and pie filling mix
2  c. (1 pt.) whipping cream, whipped
1 (12 oz.) prepared loaf  pound cake, cut into cubes (about 6 c.)
4  c. sliced fresh strawberries
1/2  c. strawberry preserves
additional fresh strawberries
toasted slivered almonds
preparation: In large mixing bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk and water; mix well.  Add pudding mix; beat until well blended. Chill 5 minutes.  Fold in whipped cream.  Spoon 2 cups pudding mixture into a 4-quart round glass serving bowl.  Top with half the cake cubes, half the strawberries, half the preserves and half the remaining pudding mixture.  Repeat layering, ending with pudding mixture.  Garnish with additional strawberries and almonds.  Chill for 4 hours or until set.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: CREAM CHEESE TREATS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla extract
vanilla wafers
fruit pie filling
preparation: Beat cream cheese on medium speed until light and fluffy. Gradually add sugar, mixing well.  Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well.  Add vanilla.  Place a vanilla wafer in miniature baking cups.  Spoon in mixture to approximately 3/4 full.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Chill overnight.  Add fruit topping.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP CAKE
ingredients:
1 (18 1/2 oz.)  pkg. yellow butter cake mix
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1  c. milk
1  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1  (8 oz.) bar German chocolate
confectioners sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a large mixing bowl, combine cake mix, pudding mix, milk, oil and eggs and mix well.  Stir in chocolate morsels.  Grate 5 squares of chocolate and add to batter.  Pour batter into greased and floured, fluted tube pan. Bake 1 hour.  Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes; invert on wire rack and completely cool.  Sprinkle top with confectioners sugar. Grate 3 squares of chocolate and sprinkle on cake.  Cake may be frozen.  Serves 12.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large chicken, boiled and deboned
1  c. chicken broth
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick margarine, melted
1  pkg. stuffing mix
preparation: Mix chicken, broth, soup and batter.  Add stuffing mix.  Place in casserole dish and bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes.

name: SOFT ROLL OUT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
3/4  c. milk
3  c. flour (1/4 to 1/2 c. more as needed)
1  c. sugar
1  c. butter or shortening
1  tsp. salt*
3  Tbsp. baking powder
1/4  c. water in 2 Tbsp. Jell-O (optional; only use if want colored and flavored cookies)
preparation: Beat egg into milk.  Mix all together.  Roll out and cut in shape desired.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes in a 375° oven.  Makes about 30 cutouts.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
2 1/2  c. milk
1  large Cool Whip
bananas
vanilla wafers
preparation: Combine pudding and cold milk.  Stir until thickened.  Add Cool Whip.  Stir until mixed.  Line bowl with vanilla wafers and bananas, sliced.  Pour some of pudding over this layer.  Continue until all ingredients are used.

name: PICKLED EGGS
ingredients:
24  fresh eggs
6  c. cider vinegar
2  Tbsp. peppercorns
1  Tbsp. allspice
1/2  Tbsp. mace
1/2  Tbsp. coriander seed
1/2  Tbsp. cardamon seed
1/2  Tbsp. cloves
10  small hot red peppers
3  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Cook the eggs in hot water for 15 minutes.  Place in cold water.  Remove the shells and pack the eggs in preheated jars.  In a kettle, combine vinegar, spices and sugar.  Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes.  Pour over the eggs and seal.  Set container in refrigerator until ready to use.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
4  chicken breasts, cooked and chopped
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken or mushroom soup
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  tsp. curry powder
1  c. buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Cook broccoli according to package and drain.  Place in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Place chicken on top of broccoli. Combine remaining ingredients except bread crumbs.  Stir well and spoon mixture over chicken; top with bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1/2  onion, minced
1  c. celery, chopped
mushrooms (optional)
1/2  green pepper, cut up
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  cans kidney beans
1 large  can tomatoes
1 large  can tomato sauce
1  pkg. chili flavoring
preparation: Brown (in large pan) ground beef.  Add onions, celery and garlic and cook until soft.  Add tomatoes and tomato sauce.   Cook about 1 hour; add green pepper.  Cook 2 to 3 minutes.  Add kidney beans and heat.  Serve over mashed or baked potatoes.   Top with shredded Cheddar cheese.

name: TURKEY QUICHE
ingredients:
6  oz. pkg. Stove Top stuffing
1  c. chopped turkey
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
4  eggs, beaten
15 1/2  oz. can evaporated milk
preparation: Make stuffing according to box and press in baking dish forming a crust.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.  Combine meat and cheese.  Beat eggs, milk and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper.  Sprinkle meat and cheese over hot crust.  Pour egg and milk mixture on top. Drop temperature down to 350°.  Bake about 20 to 25 minutes.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

name: HOMINY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  onion
1/4  c. margarine
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  cans yellow hominy, drained
jalapeno peppers
salt and pepper
8  oz. grated cheese
preparation: Saute medium onion with margarine.  Mix all ingredients and add onion.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.  Add grated cheese and bake until cheese is melted.

name: BREAKFAST PECAN ROLLS
ingredients:
1  loaf frozen bread dough
1/2 small  box butterscotch pudding
cinnamon
pecans or walnuts
1  stick butter
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Thaw bread dough just enough to cut.  Cut lengthwise and halves into 6 pieces or 12 pieces in all.  Grease 1-piece tube or Bundt pan.  Place pieces in circle.  Sprinkle pudding mix over sections. Sprinkle cinnamon and nuts in desired amounts.  In saucepan, mix butter and sugars; cook until dissolved slightly.  Pour over rolls and cover.  Let rise in refrigerator overnight.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.  Immediately invert on plate.

name: CORN FLAKE CANDY
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. white Karo
1 (12 oz.)  jar creamy peanut butter
6  c. corn flakes
preparation: Boil together sugar and Karo syrup and remove from heat.  Stir in the peanut butter until smooth.  Next, stir in corn flakes. Roll into balls and place on wax paper or serving dish.

name: CLARA DEARISO'S SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. shredded raw squash
4  or 5 strips bacon or bacon drippings
1  large chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. milk
1  c. fine bread crumbs
1  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Preheat  oven  to  350°.  Fry  bacon  and drain.  Saute onion in  small  amount of bacon drippings.  Crumble bacon and mix  with onion,  squash,  bread crumbs, milk and seasonings. Add cheese, saving  a  bit  to sprinkle on top.  Put in a buttered, 2-quart casserole and bake about 1 hour.  Serves 8.

name: BUTTERFINGER DESSERT
ingredients:
6  Butterfinger candy bars, crushed
8  oz. Cool Whip
6  ice cream sandwiches
preparation: Put half of crushed Butterfinger candy bars on bottom of 8 x 8-inch Pyrex dish, then layer half of Cool Whip, layer of 6 ice cream sandwiches on top of Cool Whip and add remaining Cool Whip on sandwiches. Sprinkle rest of Butterfinger candy bars on top. Freeze.

name: TURTLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. veal bones, cracked
1  onion, sliced
1  carrot, sliced
1  Tbsp. butter
4  c. beef stock (cold)
5  c. tomatoes
2  Tbsp. flour
3  whole cloves
salt and pepper
1/4  c. sherry
1  c. cooked turtle meat
1/2  lemon, sliced
1  hard-boiled egg, chopped
preparation: Brown bones, onion and carrot very slowly in butter in heavy pan.  Add flour and stir until blended.  Add cold beef stock, tomatoes, cloves and salt and pepper.  Heat slowly to boiling. Skim and cover.  Let simmer 2 hours.  Strain stock through a fine sieve and cool quickly.  When cold, remove fat and if necessary, clarify soup.  Add turtle meat and sherry.  Bring to a boil. Serve with a slice of lemon and chopped egg.  Serves 6.

name: CHICKEN AND POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
4  c. diced potatoes
1  medium onion, chopped
4  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1 1/2  c. chopped cooked chicken
1  c. chicken broth
2  tsp. parsley flakes
2  tsp. salt
1 tall  can Pet milk
preparation: Cook potatoes and onion with oil in hot saucepan.  Add chicken, chicken broth, parsley and salt.  Heat to boiling. Lower heat; cover and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 30 minutes.  Stir in Pet milk and simmer.  Makes 6 servings.

name: EGG SALAD
ingredients:
3  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. salt
6  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1  c. sliced ripe olives
1/2  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. chopped onions
preparation: Blend cream cheese, mayonnaise and seasoning.  Stir in remaining ingredients.

name: RAVE COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
4  eggs
1/4  c. oil
1  c. nuts
1 (3 3/4 oz.)  pkg. vanilla pudding mix (instant)
2  c. coconut
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  pkg. cream cheese (8 oz.)
1  box confectioners sugar
4  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. milk
2  c. coconut
preparation: Combine the first 6 ingredients and bake in three 9-inch cake pans at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage
4  slices bread
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
6  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. dry mustard
2  c. milk
preparation: Crumble sausage, fry and drain.  Set aside.  In 9 x 12-inch baking dish, layer half the sausage, 2 slices bread (broken in pieces) and 1/2 cup cheese.  Repeat the layers.  In bowl, beat the eggs, salt, pepper, dry mustard and milk. Pour over layers in baking dish and refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes and serve.

name: IDAHO POTATO CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. cold mashed potatoes
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. baking cocoa
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. milk
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar until fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Blend in potatoes and vanilla.  Combine flour, cocoa and baking soda; add alternately with milk, blending well after each addition.  Stir in nuts.  Pour into a greased pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool on a wire rack.

name: VANILLA PUDDING
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
3  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
vanilla wafers
pineapple or banana
preparation: Mix sugar, flour, salt, milk, egg yolks and vanilla until thick.  Add vanilla wafers and pineapple or banana.

name: BANANA LOAF
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. vegetable shortening
2  eggs
3  Tbsp. buttermilk
1  c. mashed bananas
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped or broken nut meats (walnuts or pecans)
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar together.   Beat in eggs, then buttermilk and mashed bananas.   Sift flour together with baking powder, soda and salt.   Stir into the other mixture.   Add nuts last and stir in.   Pour batter into well-greased loaf pan.   Let stand for 20 minutes before baking.  During this time, preheat the oven to 350°.   Bake for 50 to 60 minutes until done.   Remove to wire rack.  Serve warm or cold.

name: WHITE BEAN CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. Great Northern Beans
1 1/2  lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast
2  med. onions, chopped
4  cloves garlic
2  4-oz.  cans chopped green chiles
2  tsp. ground Cumin
1 1/2  tsp. Oregano
1/8  tsp. Cloves
1/4  tsp. Cayenne pepper
4  15-oz.  cans low sodium chicken broth (remove circle of fat from top of broth)
6  oz. Chederella Cheese (or 4 oz. Jack + 2 oz. Mozzarella)
preparation: Cover beans in 3 inches of cold water and soak overnight.

name: YUM YUM LAYER CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
4  eggs, separated
2  c. sugar
3  c. flour (plain)
1  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. water
1  c. buttermilk
2  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Whip egg whites. Set aside.  Cream butter and sugar.  Add egg yolks.  Mix soda and water with buttermilk.  Add alternately with flour to the creamed mixture.  Blend in beaten egg whites and flavoring. Cook at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.  Makes 3 layers or a 9 x 13-inch sheet cake.

name: SPAGHETTI RYAN
ingredients:
1/4  lb. bacon
1  stick butter
1/2  c. grated Parmesan (fresh if possible)
1/2  c. grated Romano
2  eggs, beaten
salt and pepper
8  oz. spaghetti, cooked and drained
preparation: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble.  Add all ingredients to hot spaghetti; stir vigorously over low heat until egg is cooked and butter is melted.  For garnish, may add chopped parsley, sliced pimentos and sliced ripe olives.

name: SEVEN MINUTE FROSTING
ingredients:
2  egg whites (unbeaten)
1 1/2  c. sugar
5  Tbsp. water
1 1/2  tsp. light corn syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine egg whites, sugar, water and corn syrup in top of a double boiler, beating with rotary eggbeater until thoroughly mixed.  Place over rapidly boiling water; beat constantly with rotary eggbeater and cook 7 minutes, or until frosting will stand in peaks.  Remove from boiling water.  Add vanilla; beat until thick enough to spread.  Makes enough frosting to cover tops and sides of two 9-inch layers or 2 dozen cupcakes.

name: GRAMP MORSE'S GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
1  egg
1  c. molasses
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. ginger
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. hot water
preparation: Mix all ingredients together, adding hot water last.  Bake at 350° until done.

name: CHERRY COKE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Bing cherries
2 small  pkg. cherry jello
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. chopped pecans
8  oz. cream cheese
Coke
preparation: Take drained juice from cherries and pineapple.  Bring to boil. Stir in jello until dissolved.  Add 2 cups Coca-Cola.   Let chill and add remainder.

name: VEGETABLE BEEF SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  (16 oz.) bag mixed vegetables
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Brown ground beef in 2-quart saucepan on medium heat.  Chop up tomatoes and add to ground beef.  Stir in tomato paste.  Add bag of mixed vegetables.  Add remaining seasonings.  Bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and let simmer 30 minutes.

name: STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  lb. large mushrooms
1/2  c. chopped frozen spinach, thawed
1/4  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. Italian style bread crumbs
preparation: Wash and de-stem mushrooms.  Chop mushrooms stems and add the remaining ingredients.  Fill mushroom caps with spinach mixture. Drizzle with melted butter or margarine.  Broil, stuffed side up, for 5 to 8 minutes, until heated.

name: PIZZA DIPPERS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. Italian sausage
2  c. Pillsbury Best flour
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. salt
2/3  c. shortening
1/3  c. plus 1 Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Brown sausage in skillet.  Crumble.  Drain.  Set aside. Combine flour, cheese and salt in mixing bowl.  Cut in shortening until mixture is the size of small peas.  Stir in sausage.  Add water, a little at a time, tossing and stirring with fork until dough is just moist enough to hold together.  Shape into balls about 1-inch in diameter.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes until lightly browned.  Serve hot dipped in sauce.  Makes about 40.

name: BING CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cherry Jell-O
1 large  can Bing cherries, pitted
1  can crushed pineapple
1  can Coca-Cola
1/2  c. chopped English walnuts
1  c. chopped celery
preparation: Drain fruit; heat juice from fruit and add boiling water to make 2 cups.  Pour over Jell-O and let cool.  Add Coca-Cola. Chill until partially set.  Fold in fruits, nuts and celery.  Pour in mold and chill in refrigerator until firm.

name: CHERRY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. plain flour
3  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. Crisco
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. milk and 3 tsp. juice (from cherries)
6  eggs
4  or 5 maraschino cherries, chopped
4  drops red cake coloring
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake in tube pan for 1 hour.

name: SMOTHERED STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. chuck or round steak, cut in 1-inch strips
1/3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  large onion, diced
1  to 2 green peppers, diced
1  lb. can stewed tomatoes
2 (4 oz.)  cans mushrooms
2  Tbsp. molasses
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen French-style beans
rice
preparation: Put steak, flour, salt and pepper in crock-pot.  Stir well. Layer the remaining ingredients in order.  Do not stir while simmering in crock-pot.  Cover and cook on high for 1 hour.  Then low for 8 hours or on high for 5 hours.  Stir together when ready to serve it over rice.

name: LEMON-SUGAR CREPES
ingredients:
3  lemons
3  large eggs
1 1/2  c. whole milk
2/3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. butter, melted
3/4  c. sugar
candied lemon peel (optional)
preparation: From lemons grate 1/2 teaspoon peel and squeeze 3/4 cup juice.  Cover and refrigerate.  In blender at medium speed, mix eggs, milk, flour, salt, lemon peel and 2 tablespoons melted butter until smooth.  Transfer to medium bowl; cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight.  Whisk batter before using.

name: TRASH BAG MIX
ingredients:
1 (2 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. margarine
1  c. smooth peanut butter
1  box raisins
2  c. peanuts
1  box Rice Chex
1  box 4x sugar
preparation: Melt on low heat in large pan the margarine, peanut butter and chocolate chips.  Remove from heat.  Add raisins, peanuts and Rice Chex.  Mix well with wooden spoon.  Put 4x sugar in 8-gallon trash bag.  Pour in mix and shake until all covered.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  bunches broccoli, chopped
1  red or white onion, chopped
1/2 (15 oz.)  box golden raisins
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
1/2  c. Kraft mayo
1/3  c. sugar
1/4  c. white vinegar
1/3  c. oil
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. bacon, cooked and crumbled
preparation: Combine broccoli, onion, raisins and water chestnuts in a serving bowl.  In a small bowl, combine mayo, sugar, vinegar and oil, blending well.  Pour over salad mixture.  Toss to blend. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight.  Sprinkle bacon over top before serving.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: TASTY CHEDDAR-WURST AND BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. Hillshire Farm Cheddar-Wurst links, cut into slices
1  small onion, chopped
1  green pepper, seeded and chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can baked beans
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. mustard
preparation: In a large skillet over low heat, cook Cheddar-Wurst pieces with onion and pepper for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
7  oz. marshmallow cream
2  Tbsp. orange juice
preparation: Mix orange juice and cream cheese.  Fold in marshmallow cream. Chill.

name: CHERRY OR BLUEBERRY YUM YUMS
ingredients:
1  pkg. Dream Whip
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  cans cherry or blueberry pie filling
1  stick butter
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
preparation: Cream sugar, cream cheese and vanilla. Mix in Dream Whip. Melt butter and mix with cracker crumbs. Pat crumbs in bottom of dish. Add pie filling and top with cream cheese mixture. Chill 1 hour.

name: PEPPER RELISH
ingredients:
6  red peppers
6  green peppers
4  medium onions
1  c. vinegar
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. celery seed
3/4  c. sugar or white syrup
hot water
preparation: Grind peppers and onions medium fine.  Place in saucepan with hot water to cover.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Drain.  Add vinegar and sugar with salt and celery seed.  Cook 15 minutes over slow fire. Cool and serve.

name: CREPES
ingredients:
2  eggs
milk
1/4  c. oil
2  Tbsp. sugar
about 3/4 c. flour
salt
preparation: You will need small Teflon pan.

name: SOUR CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can red sour pitted pie cherries, undrained
1  c. sugar
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cherry jello (no water)
1  pkg. Knox gelatine, dissolved in 1/4 cup cold water
1 (8 1/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, undrained
1 small  can mandarin oranges, drained
1/4  c. chopped nuts
2  Tbsp. orange juice concentrate
preparation: Combine cherries, juice and sugar.  Bring to a boil.  Add cherry jello and dissolved Knox gelatine.  Let cool.  Add mandarin oranges and orange juice concentrate, pineapple and nuts.  Put in a 9 x 13-inch dish.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Yields 12 servings.

name: SWEDISH HEIRLOOM COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1  c. sifted powdered sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
1 1/4  c. ground almonds
additional powdered sugar
preparation: Beat shortening and butter at medium speed of an electric mixer until fluffy. Add 1 cup powdered sugar and salt. Mix well. Stir in flour. Add water, vanilla and almonds, stirring well. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheets and flatten. Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes or until firm and lightly browned. Dredge warm cookies in additional powdered sugar. Yield: 4 dozen.

name: IRISH CREAM
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. favorite liqueur
1  can Eagle Brand milk
4  eggs
2  tsp. chocolate syrup
2  tsp. instant coffee
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. almond extract
2  pt. Cool Whip
preparation: Blend all together until smooth.  Store tightly covered. Keeps in refrigerator for a month.  Shake before using.

name: MICROWAVE SQUASH
ingredients:
5  to 6 small squash, thinly sliced
1  large onion, thinly sliced
1/2  stick margarine
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Slice squash and onions and place in casserole dish.  Slice margarine over top and add salt and pepper.  Cover with wax paper and cook on High until desired doneness, stirring several times during cooking process.

name: DIFFERENT CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
3  egg whites
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. crushed graham crackers
2  c. dessert topping
1/4  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Beat egg whites and add sugar gradually.  Fold in vanilla, nuts and graham crackers.  Spread in an ungreased 9-inch round pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Sprinkle with chocolate chips immediately.  Cool and add whipped topping.

name: TUNA UNIQUE
ingredients:
2  boxes macaroni and cheese
1/2  c. butter
2  cans tuna fish (in spring water)
1  c. milk
preparation: Boil macaroni, drain.  Add butter, cheese and milk.  Drain tuna and add to mixture.  Serve.  Makes 6 servings.

name: LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
juice of 1 lemon
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. hot or boiling water
5  Tbsp. flour or cornstarch
1  baked pie shell
preparation: Mix egg yolks and lemon juice together.  Cook sugar and hot water together until it becomes clear and add to the other ingredients.

name: TEA CAKES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. self-rising flour
1 1/8  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening and 2 Tbsp. margarine (room temperature)
2  whole eggs, beaten with a fork
1  Tbsp. sweet milk
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1/2  tsp. butter flavoring
preparation: Cream shortening, butter and sugar together.  Add eggs and beat.  Add all other ingredients.  When you roll out dough, do not get too thin.  Cookie will be softer if not too thin.  I bake mine 7 minutes in a 325° oven.  Sprinkle with sugar when removed from oven.

name: GRANDMOTHER'S CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Butter, softened
1  c. Sugar
1  c. Brown Sugar, packed
2  Eggs
1/2  c. Milk
1  tsp. Vanilla
2  c. All-Purpose Flour
1/3  c. Baking Cocoa
1  tsp. Salt
1  tsp. Baking Powder
1  tsp. Baking Soda
1  c. Boiling Water
Confectioner's Sugar (optional)
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, cream the butter and sugars.  Add the eggs, milk and vanilla, beat well.  Combine the flour, cocoa, salt, baking soda and baking powder.  Add to the creamed mixture and mix well.  Stir in the water and mix until smooth.  The batter will be thin.  Pour into a greased and floured 13x9x2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 35-40 minutes, or until cake tests done.  Cool on a wire rack.  Dust with confectioner's sugar if desired.  Serves 12-16.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
2 (21 oz.)  cans strawberry pie filling
2 (20 oz.)  cans crushed pineapple, drained
2 (3.4 oz.)  boxes vanilla instant pudding
2  (8 oz.) containers Cool Whip
6  or 7 bananas
preparation: Fix cake according to directions.  Let cool.  Cut into 4 equal parts.  Fix pudding according to directions.

name: CHICKEN AND FRUIT SALAD(Must prepare ahead.)
ingredients:
2  c. cooked chicken, diced
1  c. unpeeled red apples, cubed
1  c. seedless red grapes
1/2  c. celery, diced
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1/2  c. sour cream
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. honey
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine chicken, apples, grapes, celery and pecans; toss gently with a few drops of lemon juice to keep fruit looking fresh.  Combine the remaining ingredients and stir until smooth. Pour over chicken mixture and toss gently.  Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

name: RANCH SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
2  cans whole kernel corn
2  cans red kidney beans
1  onion, diced
1  pkg. Ranch-style dressing mix
2  cans pinto beans
preparation: Brown hamburger, onion and taco mixture.  Add other ingredients and simmer. Freezes well.

name: PARMESAN TWISTS
ingredients:
1  (1 lb.) loaf white bread dough
1  Tbsp. butter, melted
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
paprika
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease baking sheet.  Roll bread dough into rectangle.  Trim edges.  Brush with butter.  Sprinkle cheese and paprika.  Cut into long strips.  Place on baking sheet.  Twist each strip several times.  Bake 12 minutes.  Contains 97 calories and 2 grams fat.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
6  medium apples, sliced
1/4  c. sugar
cinnamon
1/4  c. butter
1/2  c. flour
3/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: Place apples in buttered baking dish; sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.  Combine butter, flour and brown sugar; spread over apples.  Bake 30 minutes or until apples are soft and tops are golden brown.

name: BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can kidney beans
1  can French-style green beans
1 small  can baby lima beans
1  c. celery, chopped
1  c. onions, chopped
1/2  c. bell pepper, chopped
2/3  c. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. salad oil
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Drain beans.  Mix well.  Leave overnight.  Drain before serving.

name: SUNDAY SCHOOL PUNCH
ingredients:
3  oranges (juice and grated rind)
4  lb. sugar (5 lb. bag less 2 c.)
2 1/2  pt. boiling water
2  oz. citric acid
preparation: Mix oranges (juice and rind), sugar and water.  Stir well until sugar dissolves.  Pour equally into 3 (1 gallon) milk jugs. Fill each with water.  Color as desired.  Makes 3 gallons.  Serve in punch bowl with added ginger ale.

name: VEGGIE DIP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. (12 oz.) sour cream
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. dried minced onion
1  tsp. dried dill weed
1  tsp. dried parsley flakes
1  tsp. garlic salt
dash of Worcestershire sauce
fresh veggies
preparation: In a small bowl, combine sour cream, mayonnaise, onion, dill, parsley, garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce.  Chill for at least 1 hour.  Serve with fresh vegetables.  Yield:  2 cups.

name: OLD FASHIONED COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
1  uncooked pie shell
preparation: Blend sugar and butter.  Add eggs and mix well.  Add vanilla, vinegar and coconut.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: EASY KOSHER DILL PICKLES
ingredients:
1  peck med size cucumbers
1  cuppa coarse Kosher salt
1  cuppa vinegar
1  gallon watah
1/2  cuppa mixed spices
preparation: Wash cucumbers...dry well...pack in clean sterile jars.  Boil watah, vinegar, salt 'n spices 'n pore over cucumbers in jar...let set a few minutes 'n pore back in pan 'n boil again...pore rite back over cucumbers...add 3 buds garlic 1 head dill 'n 1 bay leaf to each jar...put lids on 'n seal.  The reason fur porin' liquid over cucumbers twice iz to get the jar 'n contents hot...the second heatin' will assure thet the jar will seal.

name: DAY AHEAD CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  egg
1  c. sugar
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip
1  pt. strawberries (if frozen, thaw and drain)
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix margarine, egg and sugar well.  Add strawberries and fold in nuts and Cool Whip.  Place layers of vanilla wafers in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Spread half of mixture over wafers.  Put another layer of wafers; pour rest of mixture over wafers. Refrigerate.

name: HERMITS
ingredients:
1/3  c. margarine or butter
2/3  c. sugar
1  egg
1 3/4  c. flour
2  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. mace
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
2  Tbsp. milk
1/3  c. raisins
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar; add egg.  Beat, then add dry sifted ingredients.  Add milk and fold in raisins.  Drop by spoonfuls on greased pan.  Bake at 400° for about 8 minutes.

name: REFRIGERATOR COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. light brown sugar
1  unbeaten egg
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix sugars and shortening; add vanilla and egg.  Mix dry ingredients.  Add to sugar mixture.  Fold in nuts.  Roll in wax paper and refrigerate at least 1 hour before baking.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

name: LEMON CHESS PIE
ingredients:
5  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  stick melted oleo
1  Tbsp. corn meal
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all in order.  Add to pie crust.  Bake at 350° until it sets firm (toothpick comes out clean).

name: YANKEE GRAVY
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. flour
2  tsp. chicken fat (pan drippings)
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt fat and remove from heat.  Add flour; stir until smooth. Return to heat.  Add cold liquid all at once and cook, stirring constantly, until thick.  Cook over direct heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add salt.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sifted all-purpose flour
2/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. Snowdrift shortening
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. milk
1  c. mashed bananas
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Into a large bowl, sift dry ingredients.  Cut in Snowdrift shortening.  Add eggs, milk and bananas; mix well.  Stir in nuts and vanilla.  Pour into 9 x 5 x 3-inch greased loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.  Makes 1 (9-inch) loaf.

name: CHICKEN AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  or 5 chicken breasts, cooked and boned (set aside)
4  cans cream of chicken soup
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  tsp. curry powder
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients except chicken.  Cook 2 boxes frozen chopped broccoli according to directions on box.  Add soup mixture to cooked broccoli.  Add boned chicken.  Put in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Sprinkle 2 (8-ounce) packages Cheddar cheese on top.  Bake at 350° until cheese is melted (about 1 hour).  Serve over rice.

name: POTLUCK POTATOES
ingredients:
8  to 10 medium red potatoes (about 2 lb.)
1 (2 oz.)  jar chopped pimentos, drained
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/8  tsp. garlic salt
1/8  tsp. onion salt
1  lb. processed American cheese, cut in 1/2 inch cubes
2  slices bread, cut in cubes
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Place unpeeled potatoes in large saucepan and cover with water; cook until tender but firm.  Drain.  Cut potatoes in 1 inch cubes. Place in an ungreased 2 1/2-quart baking dish.  Add pimentos, onion, garlic salt and onion salt; toss gently.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Place bread cubes on top and pour butter over all.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes or until bread is toasted.  Yields 10 to 12 servings.

name: GRANOLA
ingredients:
6  c. old fashioned oats
1  c. wheat germ
1  c. bran
1  c. coconut
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. honey
1/2  c. olive oil
2  c. chopped dried fruit (Craisins, raisins, papaya, dates, etc.)
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  In a large mixing bowl, stir together oats, wheat germ, bran, coconut, and nuts.  In a glass measuring cup, combine honey and oil.  Microwave until it boils (approximately 2 minutes).  Watch carefully.  Pour oil and honey over oat mixture, and stir to coat all.  Using 2 large cookie sheets or baking pans, divide oat mixture evenly, and spread as thin as possible.  Bake at 325° for 10 minutes.  Stir and spread. Bake 10 minutes.  Stir and spread.  Bake 10 minutes.  Remove from oven, combine both halves, and add dried fruit.  Store airtight.

name: OUT-OF-THIS-WORLD CHEESY PRETZELS(Children's)
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. baking mix
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  egg, beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine baking mix, milk and cheese in a bowl and mix well. Roll into 8 x 12-inch rectangle on floured surface.  Cut into strips.  Twist each strip into a pretzel shape and place on greased baking sheet.  Brush with beaten egg.  Sprinkle with salt. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

name: CHARLESTON CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayo
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. onion, finely chopped
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
8  slices of bacon, cooked and crumbled
preparation: Mix and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Top "baked" dip with bacon crumbs.  Serve with Wheat Thins.

name: TATER TOPPED CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/3  c. thin sliced celery
1  lb. ground beef
salt and pepper
1  can celery soup
chopped pimentos
Ore-Ida frozen Tater Tots
preparation: Preheat  oven  to  400°.  Grease a 2 quart baking dish. Brown onions,  celery  and beef in a skillet over medium-high heat. Spoon  fat  off,  then  add  salt  and  pepper.  Spread mixture in  dish;  pour soup over mixture.  Stir in pimentos, top with  a layer of Tater Tots.  Bake for 45 minutes.  Serves 5.

name: FAVORITE MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. medium cracker crumbs
2  beaten eggs
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
dash of dried thyme, crushed
dash of dried marjoram, crushed
1/4  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. corn syrup
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except catsup and corn syrup.  Shape mixture into a loaf in baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BEST CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs
3 heaping  Tbsp. cocoa
2  eggs
1/2  c. sour milk
2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 c. boiling water
vanilla
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix all together well. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI BONANZA
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1  can mushroom soup
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1  c. yogurt
2  beaten eggs
1  c. grated cheese
cracker crumbs
preparation: Combine ingredients and top with crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: MEXICAN POTATO WEDGES
ingredients:
2  large potatoes
2  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. taco mix
1 1/2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Scrub potatoes, cut in half.  Cut each half into 4 wedges. Microwave butter in 8 x 12-inch pan 45 seconds.  Mix in cheese and seasonings.  Coat wedges and place wedge side up in dish; cover and microwave 12 to 14 minutes or until tender.  Rotate dish halfway through cooking.

name: HEAVENLY CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate cake mix
1/2  c. unsweetened cocoa
3  eggs
1 1/3  c. water
1  c. mayonnaise or light mayonnaise
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Stir cake mix and cocoa.  Add other ingredients.  Beat at medium speed with mixer until blended.  Pour into greased and floured pans (13 x 9-inch or two 9-inch pans). Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center is clean.  Cool and frost as desired.

name: TAMALE PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  onion
1/2  lb. sausage (optional)
1  can stewed tomatoes (3 1/2 c.)
2  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  can whole corn
1  can black olives
1  c. cornmeal
3/4  c. milk
2  eggs
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion (and sausage if used).  Cook until done.   Add tomatoes, salt, chili powder, corn and olives.   Cook until heated.   Place into an 11 x 7-inch oblong pan.   Mix cornmeal, milk and eggs; spread on top.  Cover with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until cheese browns.

name: PIZZA LOAF
ingredients:
2  loaves frozen bread dough, unbaked
3/4  c. diced onion
1  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. celery salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. chopped mushrooms
1 1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
1  lb. hamburger
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/3  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  c. chopped ripe olives
1  Tbsp. dried sweet pepper flakes
preparation: Let dough rise according to directions.  Combine in skillet the meat, onion, tomato sauce, mushrooms and pepper flakes.  Add paprika, oregano, celery salt, garlic salt and pepper.  Cover and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Stir in olives. Cool to lukewarm. Press dough out onto 2 greased 10 x 15-inch cookie sheets (one loaf on each sheet). Place half of meat mixture on each loaf. Spread to within 2-inches of outside.  Sprinkle with cheese. Fold ends over filling. Brush with milk.  Let rise in warm place for 15 minutes.  Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

name: LEMON CHESS PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. yellow corn meal
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. milk
1  stick butter
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix together and put in crust.  Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 375°.

name: RIPE OLIVE RESOTTI
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. finely chopped celery
1  c. uncooked rice
1  c. sliced ripe olives
1 2/3  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can consomme or beef bouillon
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Melt oleo; add onion and celery and saute gently several minutes.  Add rice and stir until well coated with oleo and deep golden color (but not brown).  Add consomme, water, salt and pepper.  Turn into 2-quart casserole.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.  Fold in sliced ripe olives and cheese and return to oven for 5 minutes.  Serves 8.  Delicious served with steak.

name: STRAWBERRY COMPOTE WITH KIRSCH
ingredients:
1  qt. strawberries
2  Tbsp. Kirsch
juice of 1/4 lemon
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, water, vanilla and juice; boil.  Hull and wash strawberries.  When sugar mixture is thick, add strawberries and remove from heat.  Add Kirsch and cover 10 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: THELMA'S JELLO AND FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1 (No. 2)  can pineapple chunks, drained well
2  yellow apples, cut to bite size
2  bananas
preparation: Follow directions on Jell-O package.  Cool to thick, firm. Mix in fruit.  Pour into 1 large dish or 2 smaller dishes.   Can be made a day ahead.

name: BEST BAKED CUSTARD
ingredients:
3  eggs, slightly beaten
dash of salt
2 1/2  c. milk, scalded
1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
nutmeg
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Blend eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla. Gradually stir in milk.  Pour into six 6 ounce custard cups. Sprinkle with nutmeg.  Place cups in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan; pour very hot water into pan to within 1/2 inch of tops of cups. Bake for 45 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.  Remove cups from water.  Serve custard warm or chilled.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  sticks margarine
1  c. pecans, chopped
1  c. powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  boxes instant butterscotch pudding
3  c. milk
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Cut together flour and margarine; add 3/4 cup of pecans (save 1/4 cup for topping).  Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Allow to cool.  Mix together powdered sugar and cream cheese; spread over cool cake.  Combine instant pudding and milk; spread over 2nd layer.  Top with Cool Whip and sprinkle with pecan chips you have kept.  Refrigerate.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1 (4 oz.)  box strawberry jello
1  c. oil
1/2  c. mashed strawberries (sweet)
1/2  c. milk
4  eggs
preparation: Mix together cake mix and jello.  Add oil, strawberries, milk and eggs.  Bake at 350° about 25 minutes.

name: DIRTY RICE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. uncooked rice
1 1/2  c. uncooked ground beef
1  can clear onion soup
1  large onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can water (use empty soup can)
preparation: Mix all ingredients and put in a greased baking dish.  Cover with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

name: TACO PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. crescent rolls
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. onions, chopped
1  pkg. taco seasoning
2/3  c. water
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1 1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
crushed corn chips
preparation: Spread crescent rolls in a glass pie dish to form crust. Brown meat and onion; drain.  Add taco seasoning and water. Spread meat mixture over dough.  Spread sour cream over meat. Sprinkle with cheese; then add chips.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Makes 4 to 5 servings.  You can serve with lettuce wedge.

name: CHOCOLATE GOOP DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
1 1/2  sticks margarine
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake in 9 x 13 pan for 20 minutes at 350° then let cool.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
12  oz. pkg. fine noodles, cooked and cooled
1  chopped green pepper
1  medium chopped onion
1/2  c. sliced black olives
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  to 2 chopped carrots
2  tomatoes, chopped
1 large  bottle Italian dressing
1  pkg. McCormick Salad Supreme seasoning
preparation: Mix and chill.

name: FRUITY MACAROONS
ingredients:
2/3  c. margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. orange or lemon rind
3/4  tsp. almond extract
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. coconut
1/2  c. maraschino cherries or fruit cake mix
preparation: Beat  together the margarine, salt, sugar and egg.  Add the remaining ingredients.  Bake 10 to 11 minutes at 350°.

name: CHOCOLATE ICING
ingredients:
2  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. margarine
2 to 3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Soften butter; combine with sugar and cocoa, then vanilla and milk.  Sprinkle pecans or coconut on top.

name: MOIST CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. cooked carrots
3/4  c. oil
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. walnuts
preparation: Bake at 350° until done (30 to 40 minutes).  Frost with cream cheese frosting.

name: BROCCOLI AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen broccoli, chopped
4  eggs, beaten
2  c. milk
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook broccoli according to package directions (omit salt from water).  Put in buttered dish.  Mix together remaining ingredients.  Pour over broccoli.  Bake in 325° oven with pan of water underneath.  Bake 1 hour or until browned.

name: POTATOES ROMANOFF
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes
1  c. sour cream
4  sliced green onions
1 1/4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
paprika
preparation: Cook potatoes in jackets until tender.  Peel and shred. Combine potatoes, sour cream, onions, 3/4 cup cheese, salt and pepper.  Put in buttered 2-quart casserole.  Top with remaining cheese and paprika.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Serves 8.  May be assembled early and refrigerated (add 10 minutes to baking time).

name: EASY CHICKEN AND SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  pkg. Kraft Italian Spaghetti Mix Dinner
Cook and debone one fryer, save broth
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of tomato soup
Package of seasoning from box of Italian Spaghetti mix
preparation: Heat on low for 20 minutes.  Add deboned chicken.  Cook spaghetti in chicken broth, add water if needed.  Drain spaghetti and place on platter.  Pour chicken sauce over it and serve.  Top with Parmesan Cheese.

name: WHITE TEXAS SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
2  c. white sugar
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  sticks margarine
3  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk or sour milk
1  c. water
preparation: Combine flour, sugar, soda and salt.  Place margarine in saucepan with 1 cup water and bring to a boil.  Combine eggs and buttermilk; add to margarine, then pour into flour mixture.  Mix until blended.  Pour into large cookie sheet with rim.  (Note: batter will be thin.)  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

name: SOUR CREAM DUCK
ingredients:
1  duck
1/4  c. flour
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. sliced onion
1/2  c. tomato juice
1  can drained mushrooms
1  c. sour cream
salt and pepper
preparation: Coat duck with flour; fry in melted butter.  Add onion, tomato juice and mushrooms.  Cook until onion is tender.  Cook duck until tender.  Remove duck; stir sour cream in juice.  Pour over duck before serving.

name: VEGGIE PIZZA
ingredients:
2 large  pkg. refrigerator crescent rolls
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
2/3  c. oleo
1  Tbsp. dill weed
1  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
preparation: Flatten crescent rolls on jelly roll pan.  Cream the cream cheese, oleo, dill weed and onion.  Spread cream cheese mixture on crust.  Sprinkle with any combination of fresh vegetables (cut small).  Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400° then cool.  Cut in squares. Serve.  Cover with Saran Wrap.  Refrigerate.

name: MILLER POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. water
1/3  c. corn syrup
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bring all ingredients to boil, except vanilla.	Boil to soft ball  stage.  Add  vanilla.  Pour  over  1 gallon popped corn. Let set a minute.  Using wet hands, form into balls.

name: VIRGINA'S EASY BAKE LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. water
3  c. Mozzarella
2  eggs
1/4  tsp. pepper
32  oz. spaghetti sauce
2  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Brown meat and drain. Add sauce and water and simmer 10 minutes. Combine rest of ingredients in separate bowl and mix well. In large pan, layer as follows: 1 cup meat sauce on bottom, layer of lasagna pasta, 1 1/2 cups of meat  sauce, 1/2 cup cheese mix, lasagna pasta, 1 1/2 cups meat sauce, 1/2 cheese, lasagna pasta and rest of meat sauce. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes, covered, then 10 minutes uncovered.

name: OATMEAL CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. quick oats
1 1/3  c. boiling water
1  stick butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1 1/3  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.  Serves 8.

name: APPLE CRISP WITH PEANUT BUTTER
ingredients:
6  to 7 apples, sliced
1/2  c. white sugar
1/3  c. brown sugar
4  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. rolled oats (quick cooking)
1/3  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. margarine
3  Tbsp. peanut butter
preparation: Peel and slice apples in a greased shallow pan.  Add white sugar and mix.  Mix together the brown sugar, flour, oats, salt and cinnamon.  Cut in margarine and peanut butter until crumbly. Sprinkle evenly over apples.  Bake at 350° until apples are tender, about 40 to 50 minutes.  Top with ice cream!

name: SPANISH OMELETTE
ingredients:
3  to 4 medium-size potatoes
1  onion
4  eggs
oil
salt
preparation: Cut potatoes and onion in small pieces and sauté.  Beat eggs. Pour potatoes and onions into bowl with eggs.  After it is well mixed, return mixture to frying pan and cook slowly.  Get a plate, cover the frying pan and turn the omelette upside down.  Slide back into frying pan and cook the other side.  It's done when the fork comes out clean.  Easy, fast and good!

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter or margarine, melted
1  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. flour
6  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix all together and pour in an unbaked pie shell.  Bake in a slow oven at 300° to 325° for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until set.

name: SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
6  oz. spaghetti
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  well beaten eggs
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  c. (8 oz.) cottage cheese
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese (2 oz.)
preparation: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions; drain (should have about 3 1/4 cups spaghetti).  Stir butter or margarine into hot spaghetti.  Stir in Parmesan cheese and eggs. Form spaghetti mixture into a "crust" in a buttered 10-inch pie plate.

name: APPLESAUCE SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. applesauce
1  (3 oz.) strawberry Jell-O
drop of red food coloring
1/2  c. red hots
1  c. water
preparation: Heat water to boiling.  Add red hots and Jell-O.  Stir until dissolved.  Add applesauce and food coloring.  Chill.

name: RED RICE
ingredients:
1  c. rice
2  c. tomato juice
2  onions, diced
1  bell pepper, diced
3  Tbsp. bacon grease
3  Tbsp. margarine
salt, pepper, celery salt and sugar to taste
preparation: Saut onions and peppers in bacon grease. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into casserole dish. Cover tightly and bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI WITH SAUCE
ingredients:
6  to 10 stalks broccoli
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. mustard
1  tsp. lemon juice (concentrate)
1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Boil  broccoli; put in casserole dish.	Mix mayonnaise, mustard  and  lemon juice.	Pour over broccoli.  Spread cheese over the  top.  Bake  at  350°  for  about 15 minutes or until bubbling.

name: PUFFY GERMAN PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine
4  eggs
2/3  c. flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. milk
choice of toppings
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Spoon 2 tablespoons margarine into a 10-inch pie pan.  In a medium bowl, combine remaining ingredients; beat until smooth.  Place pie pan in oven to melt margarine and heat the pan.  Pour batter into prepared pie pan.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes, until edges are deep brown and puffy.  Loosen pancake with a knife or spatula; cut into wedges.  (Top with butter, syrup, powdered sugar, jam, fruit, sauteed apples, shredded cheese, crumbled bacon or cubed ham.)  Serves 4 to 6.

name: FUDGE FROSTING
ingredients:
2  sq. chocolate (unsweetened)
1  can Eagle Brand milk (condensed)
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Melt chocolate in double boiler.  Add milk.  Cook; stir until thick enough to spread, 20 minutes.  Then add butter.  Done in order written.

name: CHERRY CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) pie shell (either pastry or graham cracker crumb crust)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk
1/3  c. ReaLemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling, chilled
