preparation: In large mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.  Gradually beat in Eagle Brand milk until smooth.  Stir in ReaLemon and vanilla. Pour into prepared pastry shell.  Chill 3 hours or until set.  Top with cherry pie filing before serving.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. crescent rolls
2  pkg. frozen spinach
2  eggs, beaten
1  lb. Monterey Jack cheese, cubed
1  lb. bulk Italian sausage, browned and drained
preparation: For a thick crust, spread rolls in casserole dish (I prefer a thin crust).   Blend spinach, eggs and 1/2 of cheese and sausage. Spread over crust; add the other half of cheese to top.   Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: SMOOCHIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar
pecans (optional)
preparation: Mix ingredients and roll in balls (about a teaspoonful). Place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.  Makes 36.

name: CHOCOLATE VELVET CREAM
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. finely crushed chocolate wafers
1/3  c. melted butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar (1/4 with cream cheese, 1/4 with egg whites)
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs, separated
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate bits, melted in double boiler
1  c. heavy cream, whipped
3/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Crust:  Combine crumbs and butter.  Press into bottom of 9 or 9 1/2-inch spring-form pan.  Bake 10 minutes at 350°.  Cool.

name: VINEGAR PIE
ingredients:
1  stick butter, melted and cooled
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
3  eggs
preparation: Blend all together and put into unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 350° until well done, about 35 to 40 minutes, when middle does not shake.

name: PARTY POTATO SKINS
ingredients:
8  small baking potatoes
vegetable oil
garlic salt
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
12  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh chives, divided
2  Tbsp. chopped green chilies
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1/8  tsp. ground red pepper
preparation: Scrub potatoes.  Rub skins with oil.  Prick each potato several times with a fork.  Bake at 400° for 30 to 45 minutes or until potatoes are done.  Allow potatoes to cool to touch.  Cut top third off each potato.  Discard tops.  Carefully scoop out pulp, leaving about 1/8-inch thick shells.  (Reserve potato pulp for other uses.)  Fry potato skins in hot oil at 375° for 3 to 4 minutes or until browned.  Invert and drain on paper towels. Place potato skins, cut side up, on an ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle with garlic salt and Cheddar cheese.  Broil 6-inches from heat for 30 seconds or until cheese melts.  Top potato skins with bacon and 1 tablespoon of chives.  Press green chilies between paper towels to remove excess moisture.  Combine chilies, sour cream and red pepper in a small bowl.  Stir well.  Top with remaining 1 tablespoon of chives.  Serve with potato skins.

name: BAKED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  pork chops
3/4  c. bread crumbs
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. boiling water
preparation: Add salt and pepper to bread crumbs.  Beat egg and add milk. Dip chops in liquid; roll in crumbs.  Put 3 tablespoons fat in skillet and brown chops.  Place chops in a baking pan; add boiling water.  Cover and bake at 400° for about 50 minutes.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
2  boxes frozen spinach
3  green onions, chopped
1  can water chestnuts
8  oz. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
preparation: Do not cook spinach.  Drain spinach and press between 2 paper towels.  Mix all other ingredients.  Serve with pita bread or crackers.

name: MEAT BALL STEW
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. softened bread crumbs
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. margarine
1/4  tsp. thyme
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1 large  can tomato soup
1 large  can condensed beef broth
6  medium potatoes
6  carrots, scraped and sliced into 1-inch pieces
8  small white onions
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Combine the first 7 ingredients.  Shape into 24 meat balls. Brown meat in cooking oil in a 4-quart Dutch oven.  Add meat and vegetables.  Bring to a boil or until vegetables are tender. Add parsley.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: RED TATERS AND SAUCE
ingredients:
1  can diced Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chili
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
7  boiled red potatoes with skin
onion
bell pepper
preparation: Saute onion and bell pepper.  Add cheese.  Add diced Ro-Tel tomatoes.  Melt and blend.

name: COCA-COLA CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
2  c. flour, sifted
1 3/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1/4  c. buttermilk
1  c. Coca-Cola
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Combine soda and buttermilk.  Put all ingredients in large bowl except Coca-Cola and marshmallows; blend well.  Blend in Coke at low speed.  Stir in marshmallows at low speed by hand.  Pour in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: PORK CHOP AND APPLE SKILLET
ingredients:
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. cooking wine (white)
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  garlic clove
1  pkg. (4 to 5) pork chops
3  apples, peeled and sliced
1  small onion, sliced
preparation: Brown pork chops in frying pan in a little oil.  Take pork chops out of pan and set aside.  Add apples and onions to pan; brown.  Add pork chops.  Add all sauce mixture.  Simmer 1 hour on stove.  May serve with wide noodles or rice.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage, cut up
1/2  c. cheese
preparation: Cook cabbage in salted water until tender.  Drain cabbage well.  Place cabbage in casserole dish and place cheese on top. Bake until cheese is melted.  Bake at 350°.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
4  c. sifted self-rising flour
1  c. Crisco
1  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. sugar
2  c. buttermilk
3  Tbsp. warm water
preparation: Sift flour into bowl. Add sugar and Crisco. Mix well with fork. Dissolve yeast in water and then add to the buttermilk. Stir slowly and add to the flour mixture, mixing well. Roll out. Bake at 450° until done. Dough will keep in the refrigerator for 1 week.

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
1/2  lb. bacon, crumbled
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1  Tbsp. hot water with pepper (optional)
1  onion, diced
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Boil potatoes in skins.  When cool enough to hold, dice potatoes.  Fry bacon crisp.  Crumble.  Add potatoes with salt and pepper.  Heat vinegar and water.  Pour over mixture of potatoes. Heat oil.  Pour over ingredients.  Toss and set aside.  Do not refrigerate.  Serve at room temperature.  This salad must be put together while hot.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
8  medium potatoes, sliced thin
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1  c. milk
8  oz. mild shredded Cheddar cheese
salt and pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
preparation: Combine soup, milk, salt and pepper.  Alternate potatoes, onion and cheese in an 8 x 10-inch greased baking dish.  After one layer of potatoes, onion and cheese, pour on 1/2 of soup mixture.  Add the rest of the potatoes, onion and cheese.  Top with remaining soup mixture.  Bake at 300° for about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
3  boxes instant vanilla pudding
4  c. milk
8  oz. sour cream
8  oz. Cool Whip
1  box vanilla wafers
bananas
preparation: Mix pudding with milk in one bowl.  Mix sour cream and Cool Whip together with pudding.  Put vanilla wafers in bottom of loaf pan, then mixture of pudding, sour cream and Cool Whip, then bananas.  Probably will make 2 to 3 layers, depending on size of pan.

name: BEEF AND MACARONI SKILLET MEAL
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1  c. elbow macaroni (uncooked)
2 1/2  cans tomatoes
preparation: On high, brown onion and meat mixture together.  Add macaroni, tomatoes and seasoning.  Place cover over skillet.  When steam comes from vent, turn to low.  Allow to cook 30 minutes.  Do not remove the lid during the cooking period.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
4  oz. mild taco sauce
1  pkg. taco seasoning
preparation: Mix together and spread on a large serving plate.  Top with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, black olives, etc.  Chill.  Serve with chips.

name: PASTA E FAGIOLI
ingredients:
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. water
1 (16 oz.)  can cannellini beans
1/2  lb. ditalini
preparation: In a saucepan, fry garlic in oil until it is golden brown. Add the tomato sauce and water; cook for about 10 minutes.   Add beans; stir gently and continue to simmer.  Cook ditalini al dente; drain and add to bean mixture.  Stir.  Serve immediately. Serves 4.

name: THROW-TOGETHER-IN-THE-MORNING WHEN THE RELATIVES SPEND THE DAY -(Note:  Nothing needs to be exact.)
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. boneless chicken breasts (can be frozen)
1 (8 oz.)  bottle no salt salsa (hot, medium or mild)
1 large  bottle low sodium V-8
1 to 2  cans chickpeas, rinsed
sliced stalks of 1 bunch broccoli
2  sliced green peppers (add later if crispness is desired)
preparation: Optional:  Chicken broth, kidney beans, tomatoes (fresh or canned), snap peas, sliced mushrooms, celery, onions, garlic, zucchini, parsley, almost any vegetable, even potatoes.

name: BOSTON BROWN BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. All-Bran
2  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. Crisco
1  egg
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. molasses
2  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. hot water
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. nutmeats
preparation: Soak All-Bran in sour cream for 30 minutes.  Cream together Crisco, egg, sugar and molasses.  Dissolve soda in hot water.  Add flour and salt.  Stir into bran mixture.  Add raisins and nutmeats.  Bake in cans, 1/2 to 2/3 full, for 45 minutes.

name: BEEF - BEAN POT STYLE
ingredients:
1  lb. stew beef
1 small  pkg. baby carrots
1  pkg. pearl onions
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can peas
1  lb. 12 oz. can stewed tomatoes
1  Tbsp. bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. tapioca
salt and pepper to taste
6  whole cloves
preparation: Put everything raw into bean pot and cook covered in 325° oven for 3 to 3 1/2 hours.

name: SAUSAGE AND POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  potatoes, diced
1  medium onion, chopped
1  lb. sausage links, sliced
1 1/2  c. Cheddar cheese
salt and pepper to taste
1  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Boil potatoes until almost tender.  Sauté sausage and onion in margarine.  Drain potatoes and combine with sausage and onion. Place in a 9 x 13 baking dish.  Top with cheese.  Bake 15 minutes in 350° oven.

name: BREEZY BROWNIES AND ICING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  can Hershey's chocolate syrup
1  c. plus 1 Tbsp. flour
preparation: Cream together margarine and sugar.  Add salt and eggs.  Blend in chocolate syrup and flour.  Pour in greased 10 x 13-inch cake pan.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

name: KENT'S FAVORITE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar (firmly packed)
2  unbeaten eggs
2  c. quick cooking oats
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Cream butter gradually.  Add the sugars. Next blend in the eggs.  Beat well.  Add dry ingredients.  Mix thoroughly.  Stir in oats and chips.  Use heaping teaspoon to measure for each cookie. Bake at 375° for 9 to 12 minutes until lightly brown.

name: LIME JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime jello
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. boiling water
1/4  c. celery, chopped
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1/4  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. cold water
preparation: Put the first 3 ingredients in blender; mix until well blended. Pour into a 3-cup jello mold which has been sprayed lightly with Pam.  Add the rest of the ingredients.  Chill until firm.

name: CAROLINA DELIGHTS
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter
2 1/2  c. quick oats
1/4  c. cocoa
preparation: Combine sugar, butter, cocoa and milk in saucepan.  Bring to a boil; boil for 1 1/2 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Add oats and peanut butter; stir until well mixed.  Drop immediately onto waxed paper and allow to set.

name: SHRIMP BALL OR LOG
ingredients:
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  c. shrimp (can)
2  Tbsp. chili sauce
2  Tbsp. chopped olives
2  Tbsp. chopped green onion
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  From ball or log.  Place in container and refrigerate overnight.  Serve with crackers.

name: POTATO AND ONION BAKE
ingredients:
baking potatoes
onions
garlic
salt and pepper
preparation: Take baking potatoes and slice them 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick; do not peel. Peel and slice onions 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick.  Place on heavy foil a slice of potato and a slice of onions alternately until together, then sprinkle with garlic, salt and pepper.  Wrap in foil.  Bake at 350° about 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
1  whole chicken, cut up
2  pkg. frozen broccoli spears
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. curry powder
1/2  c. grated cheese and/or Pepperidge Farm stuffing crumbs
preparation: Boil chicken until tender, 25 to 30 minutes.  Skin and pull meat into chunky pieces.  Cook broccoli according to package directions and drain.  Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Place broccoli spears in bottom of pan in one layer.   Scatter the chicken over the broccoli.  Make a paste of the mayonnaise and soup (add some water), lemon juice and curry powder.  Spread over chicken evenly.  Sprinkle cheese (or preferred topping) on top of casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: ORANGE SLICE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
1  c. sugar
2  c. shortening
2  eggs
3  c. self-rising flour
10  oz. nuts, chopped
20  candy orange slices, diced
1 small  can coconut
3  c. quick oats
preparation: Cream sugars and shortening.  Add eggs and mix well.  Sift flour.  Add to sugar mixture.   Add remaining ingredients.  Form mixture into 4 long rolls and wrap with waxed paper.   Chill or freeze.  Slice and put on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes before removing from cookie sheet.

name: COLD CUCUMBER SOUP *
ingredients:
1  pt. plain yogurt
1  clove garlic
fresh dill (2 to 3 Tbsp.)
2  cucumbers (unpeeled), diced
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Place garlic, dill and half of yogurt in blender; puree for 10 seconds.  Add cucumbers and blend until cucumbers are still visible.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.  Fold in rest of yogurt and serve.  Serves 4.

name: HOT POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1  pkg. frozen potatoes
1 1/2  pkg. franks, sliced
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas or beans
1/2  c. salad dressing
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cider vinegar
dash of salt and pepper
green peppers and onions
preparation: Put salad oil in skillet over medium heat.  Prepare potatoes as label directs; cook until franks are heated through.  If desired to keep warm, put in crock-pot on low setting.  Makes about 8 servings.

name: OATMEAL DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine (1 stick)
3  Tbsp. cocoa
3  c. oats
2  Tbsp. peanut butter
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In saucepan, combine butter, sugar, cocoa and milk; heat to boiling and boil for 4 minutes.  Remove from heat; add oats, vanilla and peanut butter.  Stir briskly, then drop by teaspoonful onto waxed paper.  Let cool.

name: CHEESE MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  c. corn flakes, crushed
1  egg
1/2  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. milk
3/4  tsp. salt
juice of 1 lemon
1/4  c. chopped olives
3  slices bacon
preparation: Mix all ingredients except bacon.  Place in 1-quart baking dish. Cool and freeze. To serve, thaw slightly and top with the bacon. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.  Very good.

name: AUNT SUSAN'S WAFFLES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs, separated
1 3/4  c. milk
6  Tbsp. butter, melted
preparation: Mix dry ingredients and sift. Beat egg yolks until lemon colored and add with milk to dry ingredients.  Add melted butter. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter.  Bake in preheated waffle iron.

name: MAM-MA'S APPLE BUTTER(Mountain Style)
ingredients:
8  qt. or 16 cans (16 oz. size) for fresh apples, prepare and grind into applesauce
16  c. sugar (more for tart fresh apples)
6  boxes Sure-Jell
16  tsp. cinnamon (16 to a small box)
preparation: You will need a large 16-quart metal dish pan, 18 pint cans and lids (washed and heated), large stirring spoon, ladle, funnel and medium spoon.  Move oven rack on bottom (second notch).  Heat oven to 500°.

name: MICROWAVE APPLE-WALNUT COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. buttermilk
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1  egg
1 1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/4  tsp. salt
1  red, medium, unpared, all-purpose apple, chopped
1  red, medium, unpared, all-purpose apple, thinly sliced
Walnut Topping (recipe follows)
preparation: Lightly grease bottom only of round microwavable 8 x 1 1/2-inch dish.  Beat sugar, buttermilk, oil and egg in medium bowl with fork.  Stir in remaining ingredients, except sliced apple and Walnut Topping, just until moistened.  Spread batter evenly in dish.  Microwave, uncovered, on Medium for 9 to 10 minutes, rotating dish 1/2 turn after 5 minutes, until top of cake is set but still moist.  Arrange apple slices in spoke fashion on coffee cake.  Sprinkle evenly with topping.  Microwave, uncovered, on High for 3 to 4 minutes, rotating dish 1/2 turn after 2 minutes, until apple slices are slightly tender and toothpick inserted in center of cake comes out clean.  Let stand uncovered for 5 minutes.  Serve warm.

name: BANANA RAISIN BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. unsifted all-purpose flour
1  c. unprocessed bran
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. pitted prunes
1  Tbsp. water
1/2  c. mashed banana
18  oz. plain yogurt
2  large egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. golden raisins
1/2  banana
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Grease six 3-inch crown muffin pan cups.

name: CHILI (WITH BEANS)
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  qt. home canned tomato juice
1  can tomato soup
3  tsp. chili powder
2  medium onions
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  pkg. chili seasoning
pepper (if desired) or 1 pkg. chili mix
1 (30 oz.)  can chili beans
1  c. celery, cut up (optional)
preparation: Brown beef and onions.  Add to other ingredients and cook slowly for 1 hour.

name: BEEF AND CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
3  pkg. chipped beef
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
6  to 8 chopped green onions
2  Tbsp. Accent
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix ingredients and form into a ball.  Serve with crackers or chips.  Keeps in the refrigerator for several weeks.

name: CHR-SON PUNCH(Recipe Originated for Wedding of Chris and Sonja Broome)
ingredients:
1  pkg. unsweetened Kool-Aid pink lemonade
1/2  c. sugar
1  qt. water
46  oz. orange-peach Twister
1/4  c. grenadine syrup
1  (2 liter) Sprite
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients beforehand and chill.  You can make an ice ring of these ingredients if you like, adding colorful pieces of fruit (i.e. cherries, strawberries, peach slices).  Add Sprite at time of serving.

name: GINGERBREAD COOKIES
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1/2  c. brown sugar
2/3  c. molasses
2  eggs
1/2  c. margarine, softened
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°. In a large mixing bowl, mix 1 1/2 cups flour and remaining ingredients at low speed until blended. Scrape bowl often. Increase speed to medium and beat 2 minutes or until smooth. Reduce speed to low; add remaining flour 1 cup at a time until dough is very stiff. If using a small mixer, the last flour may be stirred or kneaded in by hand. Roll into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Brush cookie press lightly with oil. Press dough with desired cookie press or use a fork to press. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned at edges. Cool 5 minutes on sheet. Cool completely on rack. Makes 3 to 4 dozen cookies.

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. flour
3/4  tsp. salt
generous dash of pepper
1  lb. lean beef, cut into 4 slices (bottom round)
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/3  c. diced celery
1  clove garlic, crushed
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 1/2  c. sliced onions
1/2  tsp. sugar
preparation: Combine flour, salt and pepper; pound into meat.  In Dutch oven or large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.  Add meat and brown on both sides, about 5 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients. Reduce heat, cover and simmer, stirring occasionally until beef is tender, about 1 hour.

name: PACE-SETTING ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  sm. onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1 1/2  c. Picante sauce
1  8  oz. tomato sauce
2  med. tomatoes, seeded & chopped (can use canned, drained tomatoes)
1  lg. red or green pepper, diced
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cumin
2  tsp. chili powder
1  c. sour cream (can use nonfat)
3/4  c. each Monterrey Jack and Cheddar cheese, shredded
12  corn tortillas
preparation: Brown meat with onion, garlic & peppers; Pour off fat and add picante sauce, tomato sauce, tomatoes, salt & pepper, cumin and chili powder.  Simmer uncovered 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

name: PUMPKIN CAKE ROLL
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. pumpkin
1  tsp. lemon juice or 1/2 tsp. vinegar
3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. finely chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Beat eggs at high speed for 5 minutes.  Gradually add sugar. Stir in flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt.  Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice.  Spoon into greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.  Top with nuts.  Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.  Turn out on towel; sprinkle with powdered sugar.  Starting at narrow end, roll towel and cake together.  Cool.  Unroll for filling.

name: BROCCOLI AND VELVEETA CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  cube melted butter or margarine
1  tube Ritz crackers, crushed
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli (may use fresh)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Velveeta, cut in 1/2-inch cubes
preparation: Cook broccoli as directed; drain.  Pour 1/2 of melted butter over broccoli.  Add cheese.  Mix remaining butter with crushed crackers.  Pour over broccoli/cheese mixture.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: SOUTHERN PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  unbaked pie crust
3  beaten eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. dark brown corn syrup
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. margarine
1  c. pecan halves
preparation: Mix all ingredients (except pecans) together.  Line unbaked pie crust with whole pecans.  Pour mixture over pecans.  Bake at 350° until brown.

name: GLENNIE NELL'S ROAST CHRISTMAS POSSUM
ingredients:
1  live possum
1/2  c. vinegar
Kitchen Bouquet
persimmon jam
5 or 6  slices bacon
salt and pepper
8  to 10 medium sweet potatoes
preparation: Combine one food from each of the groups below:

name: CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP
ingredients:
3 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans condensed chicken broth
4 soup  cans water
2  medium carrots, diagonally sliced
2  celery stalks, diagonally sliced
1  medium onion, chopped
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1/4  tsp. crushed dried thyme
1/8  tsp. pepper
3  c. cooked cut up chicken
1 1/2  c. uncooked noodles
2  green onions, diagonally sliced
preparation: Heat broth, water, carrots, celery, onion and seasonings to boiling in Dutch oven; reduce heat.  Cover; simmer until carrots are tender, about 15 minutes.  Stir in chicken and noodles.  Heat to boiling; reduce.  Simmer uncovered 7 to 10 minutes.  Stir in onions.  Yields 6 servings.

name: MOM'S APPLE COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  c. (1 stick) margarine
2  c. sugar
2  c. hot water
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour, sift before measuring
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. finely chopped tart apples (any apple that cooks quickly will do fine)
1  c. (additional) apples, chop and reserve
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Melt margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Add sugar and water.  Stir to melt margarine and sugar. Add 1 cup chopped apples and stir.  Let stand while preparing pastry.

name: CHEESE FISH BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. fish fillets, fresh or thawed frozen
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. shredded cheese
dash of black pepper
dash of paprika
preparation: Arrange fish fillets in a single layer in a greased 10 x 6 x 2 inch shallow baking dish.  Stir cream of mushroom soup and pour over fish.  Season with pepper, and then sprinkle with shredded cheese and paprika for extra color and flavor.  Bake at 375° for about 45 minutes or until lightly brown.  Makes 4 servings.

name: HERB BREAD
ingredients:
1  loaf long French bread
1/2  c. soft margarine or butter
1/2  tsp. paprika
1 1/2  tsp. snipped fresh rosemary or 1/2 tsp. dry rosemary leaves
3/4  tsp. snipped fresh thyme or 1/4 tsp. dry thyme leaves
3/4  tsp. snipped fresh marjoram or 1/4 tsp. dry marjoram
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  At 1-inch intervals, make diagonal cuts in bread; do not cut through bottom.  In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients until well blended.  Spread mixture between slices and over top.  Wrap bread completely in foil.  Bake 20 minutes until spread is melted and bread is hot and crusty.  Makes about 8 servings.

name: FOOD PROCESSOR PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. cake flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. shortening
1/4 to 1/3  c. cold milk
preparation: Makes crust for one (9-inch) pie.

name: CHICKEN N' STUFFING
ingredients:
1  pkg. (8oz.) Seasoned Stuffing
3  c. Cubed Chicken
1  c. Butter
1/2  c. Flour
1/4  tsp. Salt
Dash Pepper
6  Eggs, slightly beaten
4  c. Chicken Broth
Pimiento Mushroom Sauce
preparation: Prepare stuffing per directions.

name: GOLDEN POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  lb. butter
8  eggs, at room temperature
4  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  c. milk
1  tsp. almond extract
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Combine sugar and butter.  Cream until light and fluffy.  Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add flour to creamed mixture alternating with milk, beating after each addition.  Stir in flavorings.  Pour batter into a well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 40 minutes or until cake tests done.  Yield:  1 (10-inch) cake.

name: COUNTRY HAM BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. finely ground ham
1  c. fine, fresh bread crumbs
1  egg, beaten
3  Tbsp. milk
1/3  c. light corn syrup
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Combine ham, crumbs, egg and milk.  Form mixture into 1 inch balls.  Place close together in small baking dish.  Combine remaining ingredients and pour over ham balls.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.  Makes about 18.  May be refrigerated or frozen, then heated at serving time.

name: HAM AND CHEESE ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1/4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. margarine, softened
Ritz crackers
3  oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened
4  slices boiled ham
preparation: In a small bowl, combine cheese and margarine until well blended.  Spread 1/4 of mixture on 1 ham slice.  Repeat with remaining cheese mixture and ham slice.  Roll up from short sides; chill for several hours or wrap and freeze, if desired.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
3  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
1 heaping  c. raisins
1/2  c. milk
3  c. quick-cooking oatmeal
4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Cream sugar, shortening and eggs.  Add remaining ingredients. Drop by spoonful on greased cookie sheets.  Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: SIMPLE BAKED CRAB
ingredients:
1  medium green pepper, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
1  lb. crabmeat or half crab and half shrimp
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. fresh bread crumbs
4  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients in a casserole.  Mix bread crumbs and butter and sprinkle over top of casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until browned.  Serves 4.

name: SWEET POTATO BISCUITS
ingredients:
2 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1 1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
3/4  c. chopped nuts
2  c. mashed sweet potatoes
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. oleo, melted
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and nuts. In another bowl, combine sweet potatoes, sugar, oleo and vanilla. Add flour mixture and mix well.  Roll dough 1/2-inch thick.  Cut with biscuit cutter and  place on greased baking sheet.  Bake at 450° for 12 minutes or until golden brown.

name: OLIVE CRAVER'S LIGHT REFRIGERATOR ROLLS
ingredients:
1/2  c. hot water
1/2  c. warm water
3  c. plain flour
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/2  c. lard
1/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Soften lard in hot water.  Add sugar and salt.  Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Add egg; mix altogether well.  Add flour and beat well.  Place in refrigerator to chill.  Dough will be soft until it chills.  Make out into rolls 1 hour before baking to double the dough.  Bake at 425° for 10 to 15 minutes.  May be kept in refrigerator for 2 or 3 weeks.

name: TAPIOCA PUDDING
ingredients:
5  Tbsp. tapioca
9  Tbsp. sugar
4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  eggs, separated
preparation: Put tapioca, cornstarch and 5 tablespoons sugar in saucepan and mix.  Add yolks to milk and then to the dry ingredients.  Beat egg whites and 4 tablespoons sugar; set aside.  Cook 8 minutes until boiling; add 1 teaspoon vanilla.  Pour into whipped egg whites. Fold in until mixed.

name: MOIST PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. cooking oil
1  c. dark brown sugar
2  c. white sugar
4  eggs (add one at a time)
3 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. each: cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and cloves
2/3  c. water
2  c. pumpkin
preparation: Cream together the first 4 ingredients, adding eggs one at a time.  Sift together next 5 ingredients; set aside.  Measure water and pumpkin.  To the creamed mixture, add a small amount of dry ingredients.  (For variety, add 1/2 cup chopped walnuts, 1 cup chopped dates, 1 cup raisins or 1 cup coconut.)  Bake in 2 greased, not floured, loaf pans at 325°.  Serve, while warm, topped with Cool Whip or ice lightly.  Can be served at breakfast, by toasting, and topped with jelly.

name: CRANBERRY-ORANGE NUT CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. white flour
1 1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. melted margarine
3/4  c. orange juice
1  Tbsp. orange rind
1  egg, beaten
2  c. cranberries, chopped
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix together flours, baking powder, soda and sugar.  Beat margarine, orange juice and rind into egg. Stir into flour mixture.  Add cranberries and nuts.  Pour into an 8-cup loaf or ring pan, greased and floured.  Bake 1 hour.  Cool and remove from pan.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. chopped bell pepper
8  oz. can crushed pineapple, drained
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. chopped pecans for rolling
preparation: Mix all of the	ingredients  into  a  ball.  Roll in an extra cup of chopped pecans until covered.  Refrigerate before serving.

name: GLAZED CARROTS
ingredients:
1  large purple onion, cut in rings
1  green pepper, cut in strips
1  can tomato soup
1/2  c. cooking oil
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar (white)
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. dill weed
carrots, cooked
preparation: Simmer until hot. Add cooked carrots and heat.

name: HAMBURGER CORN PONE PIE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. salad oil
1  medium green pepper, diced
1  large onion, chopped
2  lb. ground beef
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes
1 (1 lb.)  can pinto beans
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. corn muffin mix
preparation: Heat oil in 3-quart heatproof casserole on top of stove.  Add green pepper and onion; cook until tender.  Salt and pepper beef; brown in casserole, breaking up with fork.  Add tomatoes, beans and chili powder; let simmer.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
1  c. cocoa
1  c. milk
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In saucepan, combine sugar, cocoa and milk.  Boil hard for 4 minutes if using whole milk, 6 minutes if using skim milk.  Remove from heat.  Add margarine and vanilla.  Beat with electric mixer until it begins to thicken.  Pour into 11 x 14-inch buttered container. Serves 36.

name: BONELESS CHICKEN BREAST CREOLE
ingredients:
4  oz. boneless chicken breast
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. oil
1/8  tsp. ground thyme
1  Tbsp. onion, diced
1  Tbsp. green pepper, diced
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1  small tomato, chopped
preparation: Place flour in bag big enough to hold chicken.  Add ground thyme, pepper and garlic powder.  Shake to blend flour and spices. Put chicken in bag and shake until coated.  Heat oil in pan and saute chicken breast 10 minutes per side.  Remove from pan and saute onion and green pepper for 5 minutes.  Add tomato and its juice.  Cook 5 minutes.  Return chicken to pan.  Cover and let simmer 5 minutes.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE(Makes 6 Servings)
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. diced celery
1  clove garlic, minced
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes, mashed
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. chili powder
dash of hot pepper sauce
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  lb. cooked shrimp
preparation: Combine butter, onion, green pepper, celery and garlic in a 2- or 3-quart casserole.  Cook, uncovered, on High for 3 minutes. Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, Worcestershire sauce, salt, sugar, chili powder and hot pepper sauce.  Cook, uncovered, on High for 7 minutes, stirring once.  Combine cornstarch with 2 teaspoons cold water.  Stir into casserole.  Cook, uncovered, on High for 3 minutes, stirring once.  Add shrimp.  Cook, uncovered, on High for 2 minutes or until shrimp is piping hot.  Serve with wild rice or plain boiled rice.

name: YUMMY MOUND BARS(Microwave)
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  c. graham crackers, crushed
1/4  c. sugar
2 2/3  c. coconut (8 oz.)
1  can sweetened condensed milk
2  c. (12 oz.) chocolate pieces
preparation: Microwave butter in 12 x 8-inch glass baking dish, about 1 minute or until melted.  Stir in crumbs and sugar until combined. Press mixture firmly into bottom of dish.  Stir together coconut and condensed milk.  Spoon over crust.  Spread evenly.  Microwave Medium (1/2 power) uncovered 9 to 11 minutes or until heated through, rotating dish once.  Microwave chocolate pieces in uncovered glass bowl on High for 2 minutes or until softened. Stir until smooth.  Spoon onto coconut mixture.  Spread to cover. Refrigerate to set chocolate, about 1 hour.  Cut into bars.

name: BANANA SPLIT SALAD
ingredients:
4  large ripe mashed bananas
1 large  can crushed pineapple
12  oz. carton Cool Whip
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. chopped cherries
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  pt. sour cream
4  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix bananas and pineapple. Add lemon juice and sugar, then add rest of ingredients. Pour into a buttered Pyrex dish.  Freeze and when ready to serve, cut into squares.

name: HARVEST CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. fresh apples, dried or chopped
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. Wesson oil
2  c. flour, sifted
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped walnuts
2  eggs
preparation: Beat eggs, adding oil.  Add this to sugar and apples mixture. Sift flour and baking soda, cinnamon and salt.  Beat 2 minutes. Add walnuts.  Fill 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: TURKEY CHILE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey
1  can tomatoes (28 oz.)
1  can red beans
1  can pinto beans
1  medium onion, minced
1 1/2  tsp. garlic, chopped
3/4  tsp. ground coriander
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. or to taste chili powder
1/2  c. wine (optional)
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Saute turkey, onion and garlic in olive oil.  Add tomatoes, chili powder, cinnamon, ground coriander, salt, wine, beans (undrained) and tomato sauce.  Simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

name: HAMBURGER ONION PIE
ingredients:
2  large onions
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
2  cans buttermilk biscuits
1  tsp. salt
2  cans vegetable beef soup
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. garlic
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
preparation: Brown onion, beef, garlic, salt and pepper in skillet.  Drain off excess fat.  Pour into a baking dish and add tomato paste and vegetable soup.  Mix together.  Arrange biscuits over top of this and bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: NELLIE'S STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1-1/2  c. Water
3/4  c. Sugar
2  Tbsp. Cornstarch
8  oz. package of Strawberry Gelatin
Fresh Strawberries (as many as you like)
Cool Whip or Whipped Cream
preparation: Combine Water, Sugar and Cornstarch into a saucepan.  Cook until thick and clear.  Remove from heat then add Strawberry Gelatin to saucepan.

name: TUNNEL OF FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  1/2 cups of butter
6  eggs
1  1/2 cups sugar
2  cups flour
1  pkg. Pillsbury two layer size Double Dutch Fudge Buttercream Frosting mix
2  cups chopped walnuts
preparation: Cream butter in mixer at high speed; add eggs one at a time, beating well after each.  Gradually add sugar and continue creaming at high speed until light and fluffy.  By hand stir in flour, frosting mix, and walnuts until well blended.  Pour batter into bundt pan and bake at 350 degrees for 60-65 minutes.  Cool 2 hours; remove from pan.  Cool completely before serving.

name: STUFFED GREEN PEPPERS
ingredients:
4  large green peppers
1  lb. hamburger
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1/3  c. ketchup
1/2  tsp. salt
little pepper
1  c. potato chips, crushed
1  tsp. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
preparation: Cut tops off pepper, remove seeds and cook for 5 minutes; drain.  Meanwhile in a skillet, brown the onion and meat.  Add the ketchup, salt and pepper; blend well.  Stir in the chips.  Place peppers on shallow baking dish and spoon the meat mixture into them.  Combine the tomato sauce and sugar and spoon half of it over the peppers.  Bake in a 350` oven for 25 minutes.  Spoon the rest of the sauce over the peppers and bake another 10 or 15 minutes.

name: RANCH POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
8  medium Russet potatoes
1  c. celery, sliced
1/2  c. chopped red onion
1  packet Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. water
preparation: Combine 8 medium Russet potatoes (boiled, peeled and cubed) with 1 cup of sliced celery and chopped red onion.  Combine the salad dressing mix with mayonnaise and water.  Add to potatoes and toss to coat.  Chill.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: PUNCH BOWL DESSERT
ingredients:
2  angel food cake bars
2  boxes instant sugar-free vanilla pudding
2  cans cherry pie filling
1 large  can crushed pineapple
16  oz. lite Cool Whip
maraschino cherries
preparation: Cut angel food cake into 1-inch cubes.  Make instant pudding as directed with skim milk.  Layer half of the cake in punch bowl. Spread half the pudding over the cake.  Follow with half of the pineapple and then one can of pie filling, followed by half of the Cool Whip.  Repeat second layer of ingredients, topping with Cool Whip.  Decorate with maraschino cherries.

name: ONE POT MEAL
ingredients:
3  lb. frozen pork roast
3  lb. frozen beef roast
1  lb. carrots
1  large onion
6  potatoes, quartered
1/2  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Place frozen pork and beef roasts into covered baking pan; add onion and carrots and 1/2 cup water.  Put in oven at 350°.  Bake for 2 hours, then add potatoes and bake another 45 minutes. Remove meats and vegetables to make gravy.  Be sure to get all the brown around pan into your gravy.  Serve hot.

name: EVERGREEN PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. lime Kool-Aid (or other color)
2  c. sugar
2  qt. water
1 (45 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except ginger ale.  Add ginger ale when ready to serve.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  whole chicken breasts
1  pkg. frozen broccoli, chopped
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
1  can chicken soup
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese
2  tsp. margarine
1/4  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Boil chicken breasts in salted water for about 45 minutes. Cut into 1/2 to 1-inch pieces.  Cook broccoli; drain.  In baking dish, spread broccoli, then layer chicken on top.  Mix the Miracle Whip, soup, curry powder and lemon juice; pour over chicken. Sprinkle 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese over chicken.  Melt 2 teaspoons margarine; mix with 1/4 cup bread crumbs.  Sprinkle over cheese. (May use Ritz crackers.)  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: NO BAKE CHOCOLATE OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter or margarine (4 Tbsp.)
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/4  c. peanut butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1 1/4  c. oatmeal
preparation: Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.  Let cool until firm.

name: VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) Philly cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. milk
3  Tbsp. French dressing
1/3  c. ketchup
2  Tbsp. grated onion
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix well together and refrigerate overnight for best results.

name: SPICY APPLE GROG
ingredients:
3  c. apple cider
2  c. white grape juice
1 (16 oz.)  jar spiced cranapples
1 (750 ml)  bottle pop apple wine
1  c. brandy
preparation: Total cooking time:15 minutes.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADA BAKE
ingredients:
2  c. diced cooked chicken
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese spread, cubed
1  can pinto beans
1  c. sliced olives, drained
1/2  c. salsa
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. cornmeal
3/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Combine first 7 ingredients in large mixing bowl and put in greased, 2-quart baking dish.  Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken mixture.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

name: NO MIX CAKE
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can cherry pie filling
2  c. crushed pineapple with juice
1 1/2  c. grated coconut
1  c. pecans
1  box yellow or white cake mix
2  sticks butter or margarine, sliced in 1/4-inch pats
preparation: Spread cherry pie filling into greased 14 x 10-inch pan.  Pour crushed pineapple and juice over the pie filling.  Cover with coconut and pecans.  Spread cake mix (dry) over mixture.  Place pats of butter over entire top of cake.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until browned.  Serve with ice cream or whipped cream. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

name: MICROWAVE ENCHILADA TORTE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  Jar (16 oz.) chunky salsa
2  tbsp. Chili powder
8  (6 to 8 inch) flour tortillas
1  Can Cheddar cheese soup
1  Cup Shredded cheddar cheese
Sour cream, optional
preparation: Cook beef in skillet until browned. Pour off fat. Add salsa and chili powder. Layer 4 tortillas in 2 qt. Microwave safe dish. Top with half of the meat mixture and half of the soup. Repeat layers. Top with cheese. Cover. Microwave at 70 percent power for 8 min. or until hot. Serve with sour cream if desired.

name: CHEESE AND GREEN CHILI SANDWICH
ingredients:
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  (4 oz.) chopped green chilies
preparation: Mix with enough salad dressing or mayonnaise to spread on bread.

name: STRAWBERRY GLAZE PIE
ingredients:
1  baked (9-inch) pie shell
1 1/2  qt. strawberries
2/3  c. honey
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Crush enough strawberries for 1 cup.  Combine crushed berries, honey, cornstarch and water in saucepan.  Stir to boil and cook 2 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Stir in butter and let mixture cool. Place remaining whole berries in pie shell, reserving a few for garnish.  Pour cooked mixture over berries; chill 2 hours.  Serves 8.

name: CREAM CHEESE FOR BAGELS
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) tub soft fat-free cream cheese
1/4  c. dried fruit bits (optional)
3/4  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. honey
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Serve on hot toasted bagels.  Yields 8 servings (2 tablespoons each).  Keep this on hand for a filling bite on your way out the door in the mornings.  Has 50 calories. Fat free.

name: SQUASH CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  c. grated raw squash
4  eggs (I use only 2)
12  oz. cottage cheese
1  stick margarine, melted
1  box Jiffy corn muffin mix
preparation: Stir all ingredients together.  Pour into greased casserole dish.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.  This freezes well.

name: BROCCOLI AND CHICKEN PASTA
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine
4  c. broccoli florets
1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  red pepper, cut into thin strips
4  skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cooked and cubed
3/4  c. chicken broth
8  oz. plain yogurt
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
3  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. dry white wine
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. seasoned pepper
8  oz. no-egg yolk noodles
preparation: Melt margarine in large skillet.  Stir in broccoli, mushrooms, onion and red pepper.  Cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Add chicken and broth.  Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.

name: BEEF 'N TATER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. frozen, cut green beans, cooked and drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed tomato soup
1/4  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
few dashes of garlic
2  c. prepared mashed potatoes
1 (2.8 oz.)  can French fried onions
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown beef; drain.  Combine beef, green beans, soup, water, salt, garlic and pepper.  Pour into a casserole.  Combine mashed potatoes and 1/2 can onion.  Spoon potato mixture in a mounded ring around top outer edge of casserole.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25 minutes.  Top potatoes with cheese and remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer.  Serves 6.

name: MONKEY BREAD BY MARIAN
ingredients:
4  cans biscuits
1 1/2  sticks butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cut biscuits in half and make balls.  Place sugar and cinnamon in a Baggie.  Mix well.  Drag balls in mix to coat.  Place in fluted pan; fill pan.  Pour melted butter over biscuits, then sprinkle the remainder of sugar and cinnamon over top.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Allow to cool.  Turn over on plate and walk past and pull off a piece.  Enjoy!

name: SHRIMP NEWBURG
ingredients:
2  c. cooked shrimp
1/2  c. butter
2  c. cream
2  Tbsp. flour
juice of 1 lemon
4  eggs
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sherry
pinch of clove
1/2  tsp. paprika
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan.  Stir in shrimp.  Saute for 1 minute. Add lemon juice and stir in flour.  Add cream, stirring until smooth.  Add salt, cloves and paprika and simmer gently for 5 minutes.  Beat eggs until light and stir in.  Add sherry just before serving.  Serve at once on toast or pastry shells.

name: TRIBBY'S COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. shortening (half butter)
3  c. brown sugar
6  c. flour
4  c. rolled oats
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bake at 375° until golden brown.  When cookies are cold, spread with filling.

name: EASY PEACH UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow or white cake mix
1/8  c. margarine
1/2  c. brown sugar
1 (16 oz.)  can peaches, drained (sliced)
whipped cream (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Generously grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with margarine.  Arrange peach slices in bottom of pan until evenly covered.  Sprinkle with brown sugar.  In a medium bowl, prepare cake batter according to package directions.  Spoon over peaches, covering peaches well.  Bake for 55 to 65 minutes. The top should spring up when lightly touched in the middle.  Remove from oven and serve warm with whipped cream.

name: IMPOSSIBLE CHERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine, softened
1/4  tsp. almond extract
2  eggs
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. Bisquick baking mix
1 (21 oz.)  can Thank You cherry pie filling
Streusel
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate.  Beat all ingredients (except pie filling and Streusel) 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute by hand beater.  Pour into pie plate. Spoon pie filling over top.  Bake 25 minutes; top with Streusel. Bake until Streusel is brown, about 10 minutes longer. Cool. Refrigerate any remaining pie.

name: CHEESEBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
1  large onion
1/2  bell pepper
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. noodles, cooked until tender
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of tomato soup
preparation: Brown meat and onions, then drain; put in baking dish.  Add soups and cooked noodles; mix well.  Put two or three slices of cheese on top.  Bake until cheese is melted.

name: CHEW BREAD
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  lb. box brown sugar
3  eggs
2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt margarine.  Add sugar; stir well.  Add eggs one at a time.  Add other ingredients, stirring with spoon.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

name: GLAZED FRUIT MELBA DESSERT
ingredients:
1  box tapioca pudding (not instant)
1  box vanilla pudding (not instant)
2 small  cans mandarin oranges, well drained
20  oz. can pineapple chunks, well drained
1  large banana, sliced
3  c. liquid juice from pineapple chunks and mandarin oranges
preparation: Cook puddings and fruit juice until thick; cool.  In a large bowl, combine mandarin oranges, pineapple chunks and sliced banana.  Pour the sauce over the fruit.  Mix all together.  After 1/2 hour, mix again.  Refrigerate.

name: MARINATED SIRLOIN
ingredients:
1  lb. sirloin steak
1  tsp. grated ginger root (fresh)
salt and pepper
6  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce (Lea & Perrins)
1  Tbsp. olive oil
preparation: Cut steak in cubes.  Mix all ingredients together.  Marinate overnight.  Next day heat skillet thoroughly.  Grease it sparingly.  Cook the meat cubes in the skillet to desired doneness.  Baste with marinade juice, if necessary.

name: PECAN CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  stick oleo
3  eggs
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  unbaked pie shell
5  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. cornmeal
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt oleo and add sugar.  Beat in eggs, milk, cornmeal, vinegar and vanilla.  Stir in pecans.  Pour into shell and bake at 375° about 20 to 30 minutes.  Pie is done when knife inserted in middle comes out clean.  Turn oven off and let pie completely cool in oven (overnight is best).

name: JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
1  lb. boned chicken breast, cut in pieces
2  Tbsp. butter
12  oz. Polish sausage, sliced
1  small green pepper
1  small onion, diced
1  stalk celery, diced
1  can stewed tomatoes
1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. Minute rice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. hot pepper sauce
preparation: Brown chicken in butter in large skillet.  Add sausage, green pepper, onion and celery; cook until vegetables are just tender, about 5 minutes.  Mix in tomatoes and water; bring to a full boil. Stir in rice, salt and hot pepper sauce.  Cover and remove from heat.  Let stand for 5 minutes.  Makes about 4 servings.

name: FIESTA BEET SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. dried canned beets
1  pkg. lemon gelatin
1  c. hot water
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. minced onion
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. beet liquid
preparation: Add 1 cup hot water to gelatin in a mixing bowl and stir until dissolved, then add remaining ingredients and stir together.  Pour into square pan or mold and chill until firm.

name: MICROWAVE MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  box macaroni shells
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1/2  c. margarine
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese, divided
preparation: Prepare macaroni according to package directions and drain. Pour into a 2-quart baking dish and set aside.

name: SHORTBREAD COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. confectioners sugar
1/2  lb. butter
2 1/4  c. flour
preparation: Cream sugar and butter and mix in flour.  Press into cookie sheet.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Sift flour and salt.  Cream together butter, sugar, vanilla and egg.  Stir in flour and salt.  Add chocolate chips.  Drop onto cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: SUPPER A LA KING
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
1/2  c. diced green pepper
1/3  c. chopped onion
1  c. (10 3/4 oz. can) condensed cream of chicken soup
3/4  c. milk
2  c. cubed cooked chicken
3/4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. diced pimento
steamed rice
preparation: In 10-inch skillet over medium heat, in hot margarine, cook green pepper and onion until tender, stirring occasionally.  Stir in soup and milk; blend well.  Stir in meat, cheese and pimento. Cook 5 minutes more or until heated thoroughly.  Serve over rice. Makes about 3 1/2 cups sauce.  Makes 6 servings.

name: BANANA MILKSHAKE
ingredients:
1  banana, sliced
1  c. ice cream
1 1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. sugar
dash of lemon juice
preparation: Put all ingredients in a blender.  Blend for 5 minutes or until finely blended.  For best use, chill first.  Serves 1.

name: ZUCCHINI PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
8  oz. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Pillsbury crescent rolls
4  c. zucchini
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. butter
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. basil
1 1/2  tsp. parsley
preparation: Piece  together  crescent  rolls  in a pie pan.  Thinly slice zucchini,  leaving	skins  on;  saute it with onion and butter for 15 minutes.  Add remaining garlic powder, oregano, basil and parsley.  Beat  3  eggs  in  a bowl and add cheese. Combine all in the pie pan and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: LEMON BROILED RAINBOW TROUT
ingredients:
3  tsp. Old Bay Dash O'Lemon seasoning blend
1 1/2  lb. rainbow trout fillets
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  lemon, sliced
preparation: Place fish fillets on lightly greased broiler pan, skin side down.  Brush fillets with melted margarine.  Sprinkle approximately 1/2 tablespoon Old Bay Dash O'Lemon seasoning blend over each fillet.  Broil 5 to 6 minutes or until fish flakes easily. Garnish with lemon slices.

name: ROUND STEAK
ingredients:
round steak, cut in pieces
1  pkg. dry onion soup
1 small  can mushrooms
preparation: Bake at 350°.  Put layer of foil on baking sheet.  Sprinkle dry onion soup mix on foil.  Lay round steak on foil.  Sprinkle rest of onion soup on top.  Add mushrooms (drained) on top.  Cover with another piece of foil.  Seal tightly.  Bake 2 to 3 hours.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans pork and beans
1/2  lb. hamburger meat
1/2  c. barbecue sauce
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  small onion, chopped
preparation: Brown meat and onion in a skillet.  Drain and then add beans, barbecue sauce and brown sugar.  Put in a baking dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: RHUBARB CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
1  egg
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. chopped rhubarb
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. nuts
1/2  tsp. plus cinnamon
preparation: Make your favorite pie crust.  Butter or use Pam on inverted muffin tins.  Cover tins with pie crust and flute.  Prick well. Bake in hot oven at 450° until brown.  Cool.  Remove from tins and fill with any type of filling.

name: PINEAPPLE COOL WHIP PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
juice from 1 lemon
large carton Cool Whip
1 large  can crushed pineapple (in syrup), drained
1/2  c. chopped nuts
2  Keebler graham cracker pie crusts
preparation: Mix milk and lemon juice.  Add large carton Cool Whip, pineapple and nuts.  Mix all together and place in the pie crusts. Make ahead and freeze.  Take out 30 to 40 minutes before serving (serves 12 to 14).

name: PUMPKIN NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. cooked pumpkin
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  c. chopped pecans
1/4  c. softened butter
preparation: Sift  together flour, baking powder, soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Combine  pumpkin,  sugar,  milk  and eggs in mixing bowl. Add  dry ingredients and butter.  Mix until well blended.  Stir in nuts.  Spread in well greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake in  350°  oven  for 45 to 55 minutes or until toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

name: BUTTERMILK BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1  c. water
1/4  c. cocoa
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  beaten eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil oleo, water,  cocoa  and shortening.  Pour mixture over combined remaining ingredients and mix well.  Pour into a greased and  floured 13  x	18-inch  cookie  sheet.  Bake  20 minutes at 350°.

name: FOUR LAYER DESSERT
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  stick melted butter
1  c. pecans
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
2  pkg. instant pudding
preparation: Mix together flour, butter and pecans.  Spread out and bake for 15 minutes at 350°.  Let cool.

name: IDIOT'S DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 large  can chow mein noodles
12  oz. butterscotch bits
1  can cocktail peanuts
preparation: Melt butterscotch bits in a double boiler.  Mix noodles and peanuts in melted butterscotch.  Drop on wax paper.

name: MARINATED LONDON BROIL OR FLANK STEAK
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. flank steak
Italian dressing
1  pkg. Au Jus
1 (6 oz.)  can mushrooms
1 (6 oz.)  can water
dash of pepper
dash of garlic salt
dash of Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Prick meat with  fork  and marinate in Italian dressing overnight or 5  to  6 hours.  Charbroil steak on grill.  Slice very thin on bias.

name: HOPPIN' JOHN
ingredients:
1/2  c. dry black-eyed peas
3/4  c. dry rice
1  1/2 green peppers, chopped
2  carrots, thinly sliced
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
4  cloves garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. butter
1  c. tomatoes, chopped
1  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. red pepper flakes
preparation: Cook peas and rice.  Reserve.  Cook vegetables in butter 6 to 8 minutes.  Add peas, rice and tomatoes.  Heat through.  Add seasonings.

name: SMALL CHEESE CAKE(Servings:  36)
ingredients:
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix the ingredients and pour into small cupcake papers, after placing vanilla cookie wafer in the bottom.  May top with red cherry pie filling if desired.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: CRESCENT ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. active dry yeast
1 1/2  c. warm water
2/3  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  c. lukewarm mashed potatoes
7 to 7 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Stir in sugar, shortening, eggs, potatoes and 4 cups flour.  Beat until smooth.  Mix in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle.

name: RECIPE FOR A MARTIN FAMILY REUNION(Dedicated to all of the Tom & Liza Martin Descendants)
ingredients:
1  Thomas Jefferson Martin
1  Liza Jane Smith
preparation: Start with 2 good people.  Strain off 10 children.  Mix these 10 children with the opposite sex.  After this mixture, you end up with approximately 49 of the grandest grandchildren.  After these 49 grandchildren, you need a desire for them to care for each other and be proud of who they are.  This is like a starter cake...you need something to keep the seedlings interested year after year.  Throw in a 3 day weekend filled with fun, games and visiting.  Mix with lots and lots of love.  You end up with a Martin Family Reunion.  (May not be fat free, but it is good for your heart and soul!!!)  This is considered an appetizer...it curbs your appetite a little, but it makes you hungrier for more!

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground cranberries
1  ground orange peel
3  or 4 diced, peeled apples
1/2  c. chopped nuts
2  c. sugar
1  pt. crushed pineapple
1  c. hot water
1  pkg. red jello
preparation: When grinding cranberries, use coarse chopper blade.  Use fine blade for orange peel.  Dice apples very fine.  Mix together with nuts, sugar and pineapple.  Dissolve jello in hot water.  Add to mixture.  Mix well.  Refrigerate and let set.

name: SINFUL BAKED FUDGE
ingredients:
1  lb. Baker's chocolate or other high quality chocolate
3/4  lb. butter
15  eggs, separated, at room temperature
1 1/4  lb. sugar
preparation: Melt chocolate and butter in a bowl over hot water.  Work half of the sugar into the egg yolks, stirring with a whisk until mixture lightens in color.  Combine yolk mixture with chocolate mixture.  Whip egg whites to soft peaks.  Gradually add the remaining sugar to make a stiff meringue.  Fold into chocolate batter carefully, preserving as much volume as possible.  Chill to set, approximately 3 hours.  Smooth one-half batter into a greased 9 x 12 baking dish.  Bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees.  Cool (it will fall).  When cool, smooth remaining batter into the same pan and freeze solid, 3 hours or overnight.  Bake 20-30 minutes at 400 degrees until center is hot, but still liquid and fudge is cakey on top and bottom.  Serve warm with a dollop of whipped cream.

name: HORSERADISH DIP
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. milk
2  c. creamed cottage cheese
2  Tbsp. horseradish
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire
2  sprigs parsley, minced
dash of salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients and blend until smooth.

name: CHICKEN 'N MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
4  boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/4  tsp. ground sage
3  Tbsp. olive oil
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (7 oz.)  can mushroom bits and pieces
preparation: Sprinkle chicken with salt, poultry seasoning and sage. Slightly brown chicken in oil on both sides.  Mix together soup and mushrooms with any liquid.  Pour over chicken in skillet. Cover and simmer over low heat 15 to 30 minutes.  Serve over rice.

name: CRANBERRY FLUFF
ingredients:
1  bag raw cranberries
3  c. miniature marshmallows
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. seedless green grapes, halved
1  c. peeled apple, cut into small pieces
1/2  c. broken walnuts
1/4  tsp. salt
whipped cream (approximately 1 c.)
preparation: Wash and drain cranberries; mince (or grind) in blender or food processor.  Combine with marshmallows and sugar. Cover and chill overnight. Add grapes, apple, walnuts and salt.  Fold in whipped cream, just enough to moisten all ingredients. Transfer salad into serving bowl and garnish with holly, etc.  Freeze at least overnight (the salad will be served in the same bowl you freeze it in).  Let thaw 1 hour before serving.  It should be semi-frozen when served.   Freeze unused portion; refrigeration will not do!

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo
1  stick butter
3  c. sugar
dash of salt
6  large eggs
3  c. cake flour
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1 1/2  tsp. almond
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together oleo, cream  cheese  and sugar.  Add and beat well the salt, almond  and  vanilla.  Add  eggs, one at a time! Stir in cake flour and  mix  well.  Bake in tube pan at 325°  for 1 1/2 hours.  Makes  a  large  and  delicious  cake. Enjoy!

name: CARROT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots, pared and sliced
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  lb. Velveeta cheese
12  Ritz crackers, crushed
1  stick margarine
preparation: Boil carrots 10 minutes.  Drain and put in baking dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar.  Melt cheese and margarine together and pour over carrots.  Top with cracker crumbs and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BAKED CORN
ingredients:
2  c. canned corn
2  eggs, well beaten
1  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. flour
2  Tbsp. milk
2  Tbsp. cream
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Mix thoroughly.  Pour into well-oiled pan.  Set in another pan of warm water.  Bake in moderate oven (400°) until an inserted knife comes out clean.  If desired, additional milk may be added to provide moisture.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  bag fresh cranberries, chopped in food processor
2  c. sugar
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  bag small marshmallows
2/3  c. nuts, chopped fine (walnuts or pecans)
preparation: Combine cranberries, sugar and pineapple. Refrigerate overnight (covered).  Drain this the next day and add whipped cream, marshmallows and nuts.  Refrigerate until serving.

name: SWEET 'N SOUR MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  egg
1  onion
1  c. bread crumbs
salt and pepper to taste
1 (12 oz.)  jar or bottle chili sauce
1 (10 oz.)  jar grape jelly
juice of 1 lemon
preparation: Mix ground beef, egg, onion, bread crumbs, salt and pepper together.  Shape into 3/4-inch                       meat balls. Place chili sauce, jelly and lemon juice in a saucepan and bring to a boil.  Place meat balls in the boiling mixture.  Be careful when turning meat balls so they will remain whole.

name: MINIATURE CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
24  vanilla wafers
2  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  can blueberry, cherry or peach pie filling
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Line cupcake pans with liners.  Place a vanilla wafer in bottom of each liner.  In small bowl beat cream cheese, sugar, eggs, lemon juice and vanilla until light and fluffy.  Fill liners 3/4 full with mixture.  Bake in preheated 375° oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Top with filling.

name: HELOISE'S MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef (lean)
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. bread crumbs
3/4  c. ketchup
1/2  c. warm water
1  pkg. onion soup mix
preparation: Beat thoroughly for 1 minute.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.  Serves 6.

name: SCRIPTURE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter (Judges 5:25)
2  c. sugar (Jeremiah 6:20)
1  Tbsp. honey (Exodus 16:31)
6  eggs (Isaiah 10:14)
3 1/2  c. all-purpose flour (1 Kings 4:22)
2  tsp. baking powder (1 Corinthians 5:6)
1/2  tsp. salt (Leviticus 2:13)
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon (1 Kings 10:10)
1/4  tsp. ground cloves (Exodus 17:6)
1/8  tsp. ground ginger (1 Samuel 30:12)
1  c. water (Genesis 43:11)
2  c. figs, chopped
1  c. chopped almonds
preparation: Cream butter in large bowl.  Add sugar and beat.  Add honey and beat.  Add eggs and beat.

name: STRAWBERRY JAM
ingredients:
2  qt. strawberries
7  c. sugar, divided
1/2  bottle liquid fruit pectin
preparation: Wash the strawberries; slice in half lengthwise or cut large berries in quarters.  Measure 4 cups berries into large saucepan; add 1 cup sugar.  Mix carefully; let stand 15 minutes.  Add 6 cups sugar; mix well.  Heat to a full, rolling boil.  Boil hard for 1 minute; stir constantly.  Remove from heat; stir in the fruit pectin.  Stir and skim alternately for 5 minutes to cool slightly and prevent floating fruit.  Ladle into hot, sterilized jars; seal at once.  Makes about seven half pints.

name: DOG PEANUT BUTTER BISCUITS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1/2  c. soy flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  c. peanut butter (any kind)
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Grease two baking sheets.  In mixing bowl combine flours, baking powder and salt.  In blender combine peanut butter and milk.   Blend until smooth.  Pour into dry mixture and blend well.  The dough will be soft.  Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead lightly.  Roll out 1/4-inch thick and cut into 2-inch squares.  Place on baking sheet, about 1-inch apart.

name: PARTY CHICKENS
ingredients:
4  large whole chicken breasts, split, skinned and boned
8  slices bacon
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. chipped beef
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Wrap each chicken breast with a strip of bacon.  Cover the bottom of a flat greased baking dish (about 8 x 12 x 2-inch) with chipped beef.  Arrange breasts on chipped beef.  Mix undiluted soup and sour cream; pour over chicken.  Cover and store in refrigerator overnight, if possible.  Bake chicken in very slow oven at 275°, uncovered, for 3 hours.

name: MARINATED FRIED TURKEY
ingredients:
1  (12 lb.) turkey
1  pt. water
4  Tbsp. salt (to taste)
2  Tbsp. Cajun seasoning
2  Tbsp. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1  Tbsp. Tabasco
1  Tbsp. celery salt
2  Tbsp. cayenne pepper
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. onion salt
1  tsp. lemon pepper
preparation: Inject turkey all over and set overnight.

name: SCALLOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. scallops
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. chopped onions
1 1/2  c. diced celery
1  c. fresh or a can of mushrooms
1/4  c. melted butter
1/4  c. flour
2  c. milk
1  c. bread crumbs
1/4  c. grated cheese
3  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Spread the scallops in a baking dish.  Sprinkle with salt. Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in pan; add the onions, celery, and mushrooms.  Let stand a few minutes at low heat.  Make white sauce with 1/4 cup melted butter, 1/4 cup flour, and 2 cups milk.  Add this to the ingredients fried in butter.  Spread this mixture onto the scallops.   Cover with the bread crumbs, grated cheese and melted butter.  Cook at 375° for 20 minutes or until it is a golden color.

name: GELATIN SALAD WITH HORSERADISH
ingredients:
1  pkg. lime Jell-O
1  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. evaporated milk
1  c. cottage cheese
1  c. crushed pineapple
2  Tbsp. horseradish
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups of boiling water.  Allow to jell to egg white consistency.  Salt to taste.  Beat with electric beater until well blended.  Pour into mold and chill for 2 hours, until set.

name: FRESH PEACH MUFFINS(From Leadville Country Inn)
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
3/4  c. milk
1  large egg, beaten
1/2  c. fresh peaches, chopped
2  c. flour
2/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Mix wet ingredients.  Mix wet and dry ingredients until lumpy.  Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.

name: AMISH DRESSING
ingredients:
18  slices toasted bread, cubed
2  c. diced, cooked potatoes
1  c. chopped carrots
3  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped parsley
6  eggs
1  qt. liquid (meat stock, milk, cream or condensed milk)
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, put bread cubes, potatoes, carrots, onion and parsley.  Add 6 eggs, well beaten.  Then add the liquid. Then add 1 pint or more cooked diced chicken and salt, pepper and sage to taste.  Toss lightly.  The dressing may be cooked in a well buttered skillet or baked in a roaster in the oven.

name: ORANGE GLAZED CARROTS
ingredients:
3  c. carrots, sliced into 1 inch pieces
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  c. orange juice
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook carrots just until tender, drain.

name: SWEET AND SOUR CARROTS
ingredients:
3  c. sliced carrots
1/4  c. unsweetened pineapple juice
2  Tbsp. honey
1  tsp. cornstarch
4  green onions, cut up
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. soy sauce
preparation: In a medium saucepan, cook fresh or frozen carrots covered. Cook until tender.  Drain.  Remove from pan.  Mix all together onions, juice, honey, butter, cornstarch and soy sauce.  Cook until tender.

name: COCONUT CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine, softened
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon extract
1/2  tsp. butter flavoring
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. sugar
Coconut Frosting
1 1/4  lb. fresh coconut or 3 c. canned coconut
preparation: Beat butter at medium speed.  Gradually add sugar, beating well.  Add eggs one at a time, beating after each.  Combine flour and baking powder; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk, beginning with flour.  Stir in flavorings.  Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Cool 10 minutes.  Remove from pan.

name: SOUTHERN BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1/3  c. shortening
2/3  c. buttermilk
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Measure flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and soda in a bowl.  Cut in shortening until mixture is the consistency of cornmeal.  Stir in the buttermilk.  Dough needs to be pliable and easy to roll.  If dough is too sticky, add a little flour at a time.  Roll out dough on a floured surface and knead lightly.  Cut biscuits and place on a buttered pan.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.

name: IMITATION CRABMEAT SPREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. imitation crabmeat, chopped fine
1  small minced onion
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. Ranch dressing
1/4  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients. Mix well.  Chill 1 hour.  Serve in bowl surrounded with assorted crackers or breads.

name: PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
chopped onion
12  oz. pkg. noodles
14  oz. can tomato paste
2  c. whole tomatoes
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. oregano or Italian seasoning
2  c. Mozzarella or Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion.  Cook noodles.  Mix together and spread cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: CHICKEN IN WINE SAUCE
ingredients:
2  whole chicken breasts
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. white cooking wine
1 small  can mushrooms
1  c. sour cream
paprika
preparation: Parboil chicken; skin and bone.  Place chicken pieces in 9 x 13-inch glass dish.  Mix soup, wine, mushrooms and sour cream. Pour over chicken.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 hour.

name: APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  stick butter, melted
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. thinly sliced apples
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Mix the  cinnamon  with sugar.  Beat the eggs slightly, add to the  sugar.  Peel  and  core apples, then slice thinly. Add the apple and  butter  to  the  mixture  and  pour  in the unbaked pie shell.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: EASY BROWNED RICE
ingredients:
1  stick butter or margarine
1  c. converted white rice (not Minute rice)
1  can cream of celery or cream of chicken soup
1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in 1 1/2  c. boiling water
preparation: Melt butter or margarine in skillet.  Saute rice in skillet until lightly browned (approximately 10 minutes).  Put rice into casserole dish.  Add can of soup to rice and mix.  Add bouillon cube/water and mix.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

name: CORNED BEEF AND POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can corned beef
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. caraway seed, crushed slightly
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 (about 5 oz.)  pkg. hash brown potatoes with onions
1 3/4  c. boiling water
2  medium size tomatoes, sliced (optional)
preparation: Chop corned beef coarsely; place in a 6-cup casserole.  Add mustard, caraway seed, salt and pepper; toss to mix well.  Dot top with butter.  Stir in potato and onion mix; pour water over.  Stir with a fork; cover.  Bake in a 375° oven for 20 minutes, stirring once after 10 minutes.  Uncover; stir with a fork.  Place tomato slices, overlapping, in a ring around edge of casserole.  Continue baking 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender.  Makes 4 servings.

name: YEAST DOUGH FOR SWEET BUNS AND CHERRY BREAD
ingredients:
2  yeast cakes or pkg.
2  c. scalded milk
2  c. sifted flour
3  whole eggs or 1 whole egg and 4 yolks
1  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar (3/4 c. for less sweet dough)
cinnamon
maraschino cherries
5  c. flour
preparation: Mix together yeast, milk and flour.  Let stand until spongy (20 to 30 minutes).  In a large bowl, put eggs, salt and sugar. Mix well, then add 4 cups flour.  You'll have a very soft dough. Next, add your first mixture. Beat with a spoon. Add 1/2 cup melted butter. Work butter into the dough mixture until smooth. Knead on floured surface, adding 1 more cup flour until smooth and elastic. Dough is kneaded enough when it becomes shiny and has little air pockets or bubbles in the surface.  Put dough in greased bowl and turn, leaving greased side up. Cover and let rise in warm place until double in size (approximately 1 1/2 hours). Punch down and make cinnamon buns or Cherry Bread.

name: SWEDISH APPLE PIE(A Crustless Pie)
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
dash of salt
1  c. apples, chopped
3/4  c. nuts, chopped
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Mix together dry ingredients. Add apples, nuts and egg.  Stir together.  Spread into 8-inch pie plate.  Bake at 350°  for 25 to 30 minutes. Test apples for tenderness with toothpick.  Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.  Serves 5 or 6.

name: CHOCOLATE HEATH BAR CAKE
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake mix, pudding in the mix
6  frozen heath bars
1  large container cool whip
1  jar chocolate fudge sundae sauce
1  can eagle brand condensed milk
preparation: Crack two heath bars in small pieces and place in cake batter. Follow instructions on cake mix. Warm the chocolate fudge sauce and mix with eagle brand milk. Set aside. Poke holes in cake and pour mixture over it. Crack 3 heath bars and mix with cool whip. Spread on cooled cake. Sprinkle remaining heath bars on top. Refrigerate over night before serving.

name: MILLION DOLLAR PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  can (medium) crushed pineapple or strawberries
1  large Cool Whip
juice from 1 lemon
2  graham cracker crusts
1/2  c. chopped pecans (optional)
preparation: Mix  well.   Put  in  graham  cracker  crusts.	Freeze. Makes 2 pies.

name: MEXICAN SALSA
ingredients:
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
1 small  can chili peppers, diced
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/8  tsp. oregano
1 to 2  Tbsp. chili powder
salt and pepper to taste
garlic as desired
preparation: Stir and serve with tortilla or corn chips.

name: FRUIT FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. Mazola oil
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. orange juice
1/4  c. vinegar
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
6  tsp. powdered sugar
preparation: Combine all these together (beat with egg beater).

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA
ingredients:
2  pkg. crescent rolls
1  egg, beaten
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  oz. Ranch Style dressing
1/2  c. each of vegetables of your choice, raw and broken in small pieces
preparation: Place crescent rolls in pizza pan to make crust.  Brush beaten egg on crust.  Bake at 375° for 11 to 13 minutes.  Mix cheese, mayonnaise and Ranch dressing and put over crust.  Place vegetables over cheese mixture.

name: LAZY DAISY OATMEAL CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. boiling water
1  c. oats
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Add margarine to boiling water, then add oats.  Let this mixture sit while you cream eggs and sugars.  Add these mixtures to all other ingredients.  Pour batter into well-greased and floured 11 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes. (Good with or without Lazy Daisy Frosting.)

name: TAHITIAN HAM LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground ham
1  lb. ground fresh pork
2/3  cup cracker crumbs
1/2  cup chopped onion
1/2  cup milk
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  tsp. parsley
dash pepper
8  slices pineapple
1  cup brown sugar
1/4  cup pineapple syrup
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Combine ham, pork, crackers, onion, milk, egg, parsley and pepper.  Shape into patties.  Line in rows alternating with pineapple slices.  Bake in a slow oven at 325 degrees for 30 minutes.  Prepare brown sugar, syrup, vinegar and mustard.  Pour over rows and continue to bake for 1 hour.

name: OVEN POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. bag frozen hash browns (don't defrost)
2  c. Velveeta cheese, grated
2  c. sour cream
1  bunch green onions, sliced
1  c. Kellogg's corn flake crumbs
1  stick butter or margarine
2  c. half and half
1  can cream of chicken soup
lemon pepper and garlic salt to taste
preparation: Mix half and half with soup; blend well.  Add sour cream; blend well.  Add 1/2 cup crumbs, green onions, cheese, salt and pepper to hash browns.  Melt 1 stick butter or margarine in a 13 x 9-inch glass dish.  Pour mixture into dish and sprinkle other 1/2 cup crumbs on top.  Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, until bubbly and brown.

name: BANANA NUT LOAF
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. cake flour
