1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  medium, well ripened bananas
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Mix flour, soda and salt.  Set aside.  Mash bananas. Add lemon juice and buttermilk. Cream the shortening.  Add sugar gradually. Add eggs, one at a time.  Stir in vanilla.  Add dry ingredients alternately with banana mixture.  Fold in nuts.  Bake 28 to 30 minutes in a 350° oven.  Makes 2 large loaves.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  c. Bisquick
2  c. milk
1  c. shredded coconut
1/2  stick margarine
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients; pour into greased 9-inch pie plate.  Pie makes its own pie crust.  Bake for 50 minutes at 350°.

name: CANDIED APPLES
ingredients:
6  apples
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. dark corn syrup
1  c. light cream
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Combine sugar, corn syrup, light cream and butter.  Cook until dissolved (on low heat).  Cook to hard boil stage (don't stir). Remove from heat and add vanilla.  Dip apples and roll in nuts.

name: SAUSAGE BAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. sausage
1  c. chopped red pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  tsp. ground sage
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
8  large eggs
1  c. milk
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook sausage, red pepper, onion, sage, garlic powder, salt and pepper until done.  Spoon mixture into greased 9-inch round baking dish.

name: CHOCOLATE TRIFLE
ingredients:
1  (13 x 9-inch) baked chocolate cake
2  pkg. chocolate instant pudding, prepared as directed on pkg.
12  oz. Cool Whip
1/2  c. Kahlua
4  large Heath bars, frozen and crushed
preparation: Split cake in half.  Crumble in bowl.  Top with 1/2 Kahlua, 1/2 pudding, 1/2 Cool Whip and 1/2 Heath bar candy.   Repeat the process on top of first.  Chill until ready to serve.  Scoop out into dessert dishes.

name: DIP FOR FRITOS OR TORTILLA CHIPS
ingredients:
1  can refried beans
1  can picante sauce
8  oz. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Mix together refried beans and picante sauce.  Melt cheese and add to other mixture.  Keep warm.

name: BREAD STICKS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. yeast
1 1/2  c. warm water
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. flour
1  cube butter
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Mix the first 5 ingredients.  Knead for 10 minutes; let rest 10 minutes.  Melt cube of butter on cookie sheet.  Roll dough on floured board; cut into strips.  Roll in butter and line on cookie sheet.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Raise 10 minutes.

name: FRESH GARDEN PIZZA
ingredients:
1  pkg. crescent rolls
1/2  c. Miracle Whip or mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. dry minced onions
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
fresh vegetables of choice
diced, shredded cheese (desired amount)
preparation: Roll crescent rolls out flat and place in pizza pan.  Bake until brown and let cool.  Combine mayonnaise, cream cheese and minced onions.  Spread on top of crust.  Top with vegetables and cheese.  Makes 1 large or 2 small pizzas.

name: PUMPKIN CREAM PIE
ingredients:
3  c. pumpkin
1  c. white sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. nutmeg
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. milk (half whole and half evaporated)
preparation: Mix  ingredients  and bake in 2 large pie shells for 40 minutes at 350°.

name: OVEN SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. boneless beef round steak (3/4-inch thick)
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. Crisco
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped carrot
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire
1/4  c. shredded process cheese (1 oz.)
preparation: Cut meat in 4 portions; combine flour and salt.  Pound into meat, reserving remaining flour for sauce.  Brown meat in hot Crisco.  Transfer meat to shallow baking dish.  Blend reserved flour mixture into pan drippings in skillet.   Add tomatoes, celery, carrots, onion and Worcestershire to drippings and cook. Stir constantly until mixture boils.  Pour over meat; cover and bake at 350° for 2 hours or until meat and vegetables are tender. Sprinkle cheese over meat; return to oven for a few minutes to melt cheese.

name: GERRY'S POTATOES
ingredients:
8  to 10 potatoes
8  oz. cream cheese
1  tsp. onion salt
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. garlic salt
butter and paprika
preparation: Boil and drain potatoes; add cheese and sour cream which are at room temperature; beat into potatoes while hot until fluffy.  Add salts and put in a 2-quart casserole.  Dot with butter.  Sprinkle paprika over.  Refrigerate overnight before baking.  Can be frozen for later use.  Bake for 45 minutes in a 350° oven.  (If frozen, bake 1 1/2 hours.)

name: CHARMING CHERRY BARS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. flour
1/4  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. butter
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  beaten eggs
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. finely chopped candied cherries
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Sift 1 cup flour and powdered sugar.  Dot in butter.  Press into 11 x 17-inch pan.  Bake 10 minutes at 350°.

name: HAMBURGER TOMATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  medium sized tomatoes
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1/2  c. minced onion
1 1/2  lb. ground beef or turkey
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. oregano leaves, crumbled
2  c. cooked rice
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Use tomatoes held at room temperature until fully ripe.  Slice four of the tomatoes; chop remaining 2 tomatoes; set aside.  In a large skillet, heat oil.  Add onion. Saute until tender, about 2 minutes.   Add beef.  Saute until browned, about 3 minutes.  Stir in reserved chopped tomatoes, Worcestershire sauce, salt and oregano.  Grease casserole dish and spoon half the meat mixture into bottom of the casserole.  Top with half the rice and half the reserved sliced tomatoes.  Repeat, ending with tomatoes.  Brush with butter.  Bake until hot, about 40 minutes.  Sprinkle with cheese.  This kitchen tested recipe makes 6 servings.

name: FUDGE ICING
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2/3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  sq. chocolate
1  Tbsp. butter
few grains of salt
preparation: Melt chocolate over hot water. Add milk, sugar, butter and salt.  Boil to soft ball stage (236°). Cool to room temperature. Add vanilla and beat until thick and creamy.  Spread on cake.

name: MARIAN'S CREAM PUFFS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. boiling water
1  c. enriched flour
1/4  tsp. salt
4  eggs
preparation: Melt butter in boiling water.  Add flour and salt; cook, stirring constantly, until mixture forms a ball that doesn't separate.  Remove from heat; cool slightly.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating vigorously after each egg is added.  Drop from 2 teaspoons, 2 inches apart, onto greased baking sheet.  Cook at 450° for 15 minutes, then at 325° for 25 minutes.  When cool, cut in half.

name: STRAWBERRY JAM WITH GREEN TOMATOES
ingredients:
4  c. green tomatoes
1 2/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
6  oz. pkg. strawberry jello, mixed with water
preparation: Put green tomatoes through blender twice.   Mix all ingredients well.   Bring mixture to a rolling boil and boil for 20 minutes.   Pour into jars and refrigerate.  Can use any flavor jello.

name: WEEKEND PUNCH
ingredients:
1  qt. cranberry juice
18  oz. pineapple juice
1  c. orange juice
1/2  c. lemon juice
750  ml. bourbon
preparation: Combine in punch bowl.  Draw off enough to fill ice cube tray and freeze.  Refrigerate bowl until well chilled.  Before serving, add 25 ounces chilled ginger ale or Sprite.   Float ice cubes in punch bowl.

name: CRUNCHY PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. Zesty Italian dressing
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, thawed and drained
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. peanuts
6  slices crisply cooked bacon, crumbled
1/4  c. chopped red onions
preparation: Combine mayonnaise  and  Italian  dressing.  Mix  well. Add remaining ingredients.  Mix  lightly;  chill.  Add	additional salad dressing just  before serving if desired.  Can be served as a stuffing	in  tomatoes or cut tomatoes into wedges if desired. Makes 8 servings.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. zucchini
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  egg
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  pkg. Pepperidge farm dressing mix
preparation: Shred zucchini; add onion, one beaten egg and cream of chicken soup.  Top with Pepperidge farm dressing mix and put in buttered casserole dish.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: RAISIN SAUCE
ingredients:
2  c. apple cider
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. raisins
preparation: Put cornstarch in apple cider.  Cook over medium heat.  Add butter and raisins.  When mixture thickens, remove from heat. Ideal over ham.

name: BEEF STRIPS ORIENTAL
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak, cut into strips
3  Tbsp. oil
1  large onion, sliced
1  can beef consomme
2  c. water
2  cloves crushed garlic
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1/4  tsp. black pepper
flour
salt
pepper
preparation: Dip meat strips in flour, salt and pepper.  Heat oil in heavy pot  or  wok  and brown meat strips rapidly.  Add onion. Cook until  transparent.  Add beef consomme, water and rest of ingredients.  Cover and cook until meat is tender.	Serve over rice.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: NO COOK MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1  can mushroom soup
1 1/2  c. milk
1  c. diced Velveeta
1 heaping  c. uncooked macaroni
preparation: Put in 8 x 8-inch greased casserole.  Cover and store in refrigerator overnight.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.  May add corned beef or other meat if desired.

name: LEMON DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. Cool Whip
1  c. confectioners sugar
2  boxes lemon instant pudding
3  c. milk
chopped nuts
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish and bake at 350° for 10 minutes or just until turning a little golden.  Remove from oven and cool completely.

name: SOUTHERN INDIAN STYLE GREEN BEAN CURRY
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. French-cut green beans (frozen)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. chili powder (red)
1  tsp. coriander powder
1  pinch turmeric powder
1  tsp. mustard seed
1  Tbsp. oil
2  Tbsp. fresh grated coconut
preparation: Heat oil.  When hot, add mustard seed.  When seed makes crackling sound, lower heat and add salt, spices and the frozen green beans.  Saute on medium heat until beans are cooked.  May add a tablespoon of water, if needed, to help cook.  When done, remove from heat and mix with fresh coconut.

name: HARRIET'S POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3  c. flour (cake)
1/2  c. yellow Crisco
2  sticks butter
5  eggs
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. butter flavoring
preparation: Mix Crisco and butter; cream in sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Alternate milk and flour; mix well. Add vanilla and butter flavorings. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

name: RED FRUIT COMPOTE
ingredients:
currants
strawberries
raspberries
rhubarb
gooseberries
sour cherries
sugar to taste
cornstarch mixed with water
sweet cream
preparation: Use equal quantities of first 6 ingredients.  Frozen fruit may be used.  Mix fruit together and bring to a boil.  Simmer just until all the fruit is tender.  Add sugar to taste and thicken with cornstarch mixed with water.  Serve cool with sweet cream.

name: Old Fashioned Pound Cake
ingredients:
1  lb. butter (2 c.)
2  c. sugar
10  eggs, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  lb. seedless raisins
4  c. sifted flour
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Work flour until mealy.  Beat egg yolks, sugar and vanilla until thick and fluffy.  Add baking powder, salt and raisins.  (Cook raisins in water until soft. Drain before adding to mixture.)  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.  Bake in baking pan lined with wax paper.  Always grease the pan before putting wax paper.

name: CORN AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. yellow rice (cooked as directed)
1  can mushroom soup (undiluted)
1  stick oleo
1  can Mexicorn
Velveeta slices
preparation: Cook rice; add butter to hot rice to melt, then add mushrooms, soup and corn.  Pour into buttered dish and top with cheese slices.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE(Diabetic)
ingredients:
2  c. red tart cherries or other fruit
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1 1/4  c. flour, sifted
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. almond extract
1  tsp. Sucaryl solution
preparation: Drain cherries (or fruit) and save juice for Cherry Sauce. Spread cherries over bottom of greased shallow loaf pan.  Cream margarine with sugar.  Add egg and beat well.  Mix and sift flour, baking powder and salt; add alternately with milk to first mixture. Add flavoring and Sucaryl solution.  Pour over cherries and bake. Serve warm with Cherry Sauce.

name: FRESH PEACH ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs, beaten
1  qt. whole milk
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  Tbsp. vanilla
6  c. chopped peaches
1  c. sugar
preparation: Combine sugar, flour and salt; add eggs and blend well.  Add milk and cook slowly until slightly thickened.  Allow to cool. Add whipping cream (unwhipped), vanilla and peaches sweetened with 1 cup sugar.  Pour into freezer only 2/3 full and freeze.  Makes 1 gallon.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  c. pecans
1/2  c. corn syrup
1/4  c. butter
unbaked pie shell
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Beat eggs slightly.  Stir in sugar, syrup and butter.  Stir in pecans.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until filling is slightly firm.  Center of pie may look soft when shaken but will become firm when cooled.

name: PINEAPPLE ICE
ingredients:
juice of 3 oranges
juice of 2 lemons
1 large  can crushed pineapple
2  c. sugar (more if necessary)
preparation: Combine and be sure all sugar is dissolved.  (Easy to do in crushed pineapple while squeezing juices).  Freeze in ice cube trays.  Serve topped with red cherry or 1 tablespoon ginger ale.

name: PIMENTO CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
2  lb. Velveeta cheese
4  oz. jar pimentos
1  pt. mayonnaise
preparation: Let cheese get warm and cut into pieces.  Place in large mixing bowl; add pimento, including juice.  Mix until smooth.  Add mayonnaise and thoroughly mix.

name: MILLION DOLLAR PIE
ingredients:
3  small graham cracker crusts
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained well
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecan pieces
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  can mandarin oranges
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Pour into pie shells and garnish with mandarin oranges.  Refrigerate.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  whole chicken
1  stick butter
1  small bag Pepperidge Farm stuffing
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. chicken broth
1  c. chopped celery
4  oz. can mushrooms (optional)
preparation: Cook the chicken and save the broth.  Melt the butter and mix with the stuffing.  Put half of the stuffing in bottom of greased casserole dish.  Layer rest of ingredients.  Add rest of stuffing crust and sprinkle with stuffing.  Cook 45 minutes at 350°.

name: MAPLE SYRUP MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. maple syrup
1/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Mix together the flour, baking powder and salt.  Make a well in the center.  In a separate bowl, mix egg, milk, syrup and butter.  Pour liquid mixture into dry mixture; combine thoroughly. Spoon mixture into greased muffin pan for 12 muffins.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: DEVILED EGGS
ingredients:
1  doz. eggs, boiled
2/3  c. sweet relish
1/2  c. celery, chopped fine
1  c. mayonnaise
salt and pepper to taste
paprika
preparation: Cut eggs in halves; take out yolks.  Place egg whites on tray. Combine egg yolks with remaining ingredients; mix well.  Place filling back into egg whites.  Garnish with paprika.

name: PATIO BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can green beans, drained
1  can wax beans
1  can red beans
1  small onion, chopped
1/4  tsp. garlic oil
1  small green pepper, chopped
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. salad oil
preparation: Mix sugar, salt, pepper, vinegar, oil or garlic and salad oil. Pour mixture over beans, onion and pepper.  Let stand 2 hours.

name: EGGS FOR A CROWD
ingredients:
14 to 16  slices buttered bread (I "decrust" them)
4  c. milk
8  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
6  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Blend milk, eggs and spices.  Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer 7  to  8 slices bread.  Cover with 3 cups of cheese and half  the egg  mixture.  Repeat using balance of ingredients. Refrigerate overnight  or  all day.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Let  set  for  a few minutes.  Cut into squares.  Perfect for brunch  or after-dance  breakfast.  Serve  with ham, sausage, melon balls, etc. or sweet rolls, if desired. Serves 12 to 15.

name: BEER CHEESE
ingredients:
1  lb. sharp Cheddar, finely ground
1  lb. mild Cheddar
1  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. salt
1 (12 oz.)  can beer
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
4 to 5  drops hot pepper sauce to taste
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except beer, and beat with electric mixer.  Pour in beer slowly and beat until cheese is very smooth. Store in covered jar.  Remove from refrigerator at least 30 minutes before serving.  Beat once more.

name: APPLESAUCE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
1 1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1 1/2  c. sugar
5  large eggs
1 1/2  c. applesauce
2  tsp. baking soda
3  c. all-purpose flour, divided
1  tsp. grounded cinnamon
1  tsp. grounded nutmeg
1/2  tsp. grounded cloves
1/2  tsp grounded allspice
1 1/2  c. raisins
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Beat butter in a large mixing bowl at medium speed of an electric mixer about 2 minutes or until soft and creamy. Gradually add sugars, beating at medium speed 5 to 7 minutes.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating just until yellow disappears. Combine applesauce and soda and set aside.  Combine 2 3/4 cups flour and spices.  Add to butter mixture alternately with applesauce mixture, beginning and ending with flour mixture.  Mix at low speed just until blended after each addition.  Combine remaining 1/4 cup flour, raisins, and pecans.  Fold into batter. Pour batter into a greased and floured 12 cup Bundt pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 to 20 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool in pan on a wire rack 10 to 15 minutes; remove from pan, and cool completely on wire rack.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, melted
1/2  c. chopped onions
2  lb. bag hash browns, thawed
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  pt. sour cream
1  tsp. salt
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients and put in a large casserole dish.  Spread 2 cups crushed corn flakes and 1 stick melted margarine over top of mixture.  Bake in 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: HAM BALL
ingredients:
1  (5 oz.) Hormel chunk ham
8  oz. cream cheese
1/4  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. Tabasco sauce
chopped pecans
preparation: Blend cream cheese with mayonnaise.  Add ham and all other ingredients.  Mix until well blended.  Refrigerate until firm (overnight).  Roll into ball or place in small dish.  Cover with chopped pecans.  Serve with fancy crackers.

name: BON BON COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. soft butter
3/4  c. sifted confectioners sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat oven to 350° (medium). Mix butter, sugar and vanilla thoroughly. Measure flour. Blend in flour and salt. If dough is dry, add 1 to 2 tablespoons cream. Wrap level tablespoon of dough around filling (a candied or well-drained maraschino cherry, pitted date, nut or chocolate piece). Place 1 inch apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Cool. Dip tops of cookies in Icing. Decorate. Makes 20 to 25 cookies.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
10  slices white bread
1  lb. ground sausage
5  eggs
3  c. milk
3/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. whole pepper
2  c. shredded cheese
2  c. shredded milk cheese
preparation: Remove crust from bread. Cut into squares. Brown sausage and drain. Arrange half of bread in bottom of lightly greased 13 x 8 1/2 casserole dish. Top with cheese, sausage and remaining bread. Dissolve mustard in a little of milk. Beat eggs. Add milk, mustard, salt and pepper and pour mixture over layers. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Take out of refrigerator. Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 1 hour or until firm. Serve with fresh fruit and sweet muffins.

name: CHERRY CHEESECAKE PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker crust
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. sugar
1  (1/2 pt.) sour cream
2  tsp. vanilla
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
1  c. cherry pie filling
preparation: Beat cheese until smooth.  Gradually beat in sugar.  Blend in sour cream and vanilla.  Fold in Cool Whip topping.  Blend well. Spoon into pie crust.  Chill until set at least 4 hours.  Spoon cherry pie filling over top of pie.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP PIE
ingredients:
1  stick oleo or butter
2  eggs
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  (9 5/8-inch) pie crust
preparation: Melt oleo and let cool to room temperature.  Beat eggs and add flour and sugars, mixing well.  Add cooled oleo and vanilla and beat well.  Add chocolate chips and walnuts and pour into pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
salt
1/3  c. milk
5  medium potatoes
3/4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
butter
preparation: Boil the potatoes, cream, butter and salt to taste.  Brown ground beef and drain.  Add soup and milk.  Simmer 3 to 5 minutes. Pour mixture in bottom of casserole dish.  Make a layer of corn and layer of cheese.  Top with cream potatoes.  Bake at 400° until bubbly hot, for approximately 25 to 30 minutes.

name: BARBECUE BEANS
ingredients:
2  cans butter beans, drained (these are limas)
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  bottle ketchup
1  small onion, cut fine
preparation: Mix in casserole and bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1 large  can Italian tomatoes
1  large onion, chopped
3 or 4  cloves garlic, crushed
1  tsp. basil
2  Tbsp. oil
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. parsley
preparation: Cook onion and garlic in oil until tender.  Add tomatoes and seasoning; simmer until very thick (1 hour or more).  Makes enough sauce for 4 servings of pasta.

name: HOMEMADE DEODORANT
ingredients:
3/4  oz. (2 Tbsp.) aluminum chloride crystals
8  oz. (1 c.) soft water
preparation: Dissolve aluminum chloride in water.  Bottle and use when necessary.  Apply with a small swab of cotton.  Bathe the underarm before applying a small amount of the deodorant and let dry.  (May be left on overnight.)  Before dressing, bathe underarm and dust with powder.

name: FIVE FLAVORED POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1/4  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
5  eggs, well beaten
3  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
1  tsp. rum flavoring
1  tsp. almond flavoring
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  tsp. coconut flavoring
preparation: Cream margarine, shortening and sugar until fluffy.  Add eggs (well beaten).  Combine flour and baking powder.  Add flavorings to milk.  Alternate flour mixture with milk and beat.  Bake in well-greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: HOT TURKEY HUSTLE-UP(Tasty Casserole For Leftover Turkey)
ingredients:
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
3  c. cubed turkey
1  c. finely chopped celery
1/2  c. slivered almonds
1/2  c. mayonnaise (Hellmann's)
1  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
2  tsp. dried onion flakes
3  hard-cooked eggs
3  Tbsp. pimento
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine ingredients in a 9 to 10-inch greased casserole dish.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cornmeal
2  Tbsp. chopped bell pepper
1  c. (small can) cream-style corn
1  c. buttermilk
2/3  c. salad oil
2  eggs
2  c. grated sharp cheese
few shakes garlic powder
preparation: Mix together everything, but the cheese.  Pour half of the mixture in a well-greased, hot skillet (iron pan is best). Sprinkle 1/2 cheese on top of this mixture.  Pour rest of combined mix on top of this and then sprinkle rest of cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
7  qt. popped corn
2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white Karo syrup
1  tsp. salt
1  c. margarine
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except baking soda and popped corn, in saucepan; heat until boils, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat and add baking soda.  Stir well.  It will be light and foamy.  Add popcorn.  Toss and coat well.  Pour on cookie sheet.  Bake 1 hour at 175° to 200°, stirring occasionally.  Remove and break apart. Store in airtight containers.

name: CHEESY RICE AND BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1  pkg. (10 oz.) frozen chopped broccoli
3/4  c. water
1/2  lb. Velveeta pasteurized process cheese spread, cubed
1 1/2  c. Minute original rice, uncooked
preparation: Bring broccoli and water to boil in medium saucepan, separating broccoli with fork.  Stir in Velveeta.  Reduce heat to low.  Cover and simmer 3 minutes.  Stir in Minute rice; cover. Remove from heat.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Stir before serving.

name: BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lean beef stew meat
1  can cream of mushroom or golden mushroom soup
1  can French onion soup
water
salt and pepper
4  medium potatoes
4  to 5 medium carrots
preparation: Cover the beef stew meat in water in a large pot.  Cook the meat in the water for 15 to 20 minutes. Add soups, salt and pepper.  Add potatoes that have been cubed and sliced carrots. Cook on low simmer until all are tender.

name: REUBEN MELT
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can sauerkraut, drained
1 (12 oz.)  can corned beef
8  oz. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  c. mayo
preparation: Mix all ingredients. Put in casserole dish.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.  Serve hot with crackers.

name: MRS. FIELD'S COOKIE RECIPE
ingredients:
2  c. butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
2  c. brown sugar, packed
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1  (24 oz.) bag chocolate chips
8  oz. Hershey bar
4  c. flour
5  c. rolled oats*
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: *Option:  Put small amounts in blender until it turns to powder.

name: EASY POTATO ROLLS
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
2/3  c. shortening (Crisco)
1  c. mashed potatoes
2 1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
2  pkg. active dry yeast
1 1/3  c. warm water (110~ to 115~)
6 to 6 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, cream sugar and shortening.  Add potatoes, salt and eggs.  In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in 2/3 cup of warm water; add to creamed mixture.  Beat in two cups of flour and remaining water.  Add enough remaining flour to form a soft dough .  Shape into a ball.  Do not knead.  Place in greased bowl, turning once to grease.  Cover and let rise in a warm place until double in size.  Divide into thirds.  Shape each portion into 15 balls and arrange in 3 seasoned 9-inch pans.  Cover and let rise.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: APPLE DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
10  Butter-Me-Not biscuits
4  Granny Smith apples
2  sticks margarine
2  c. water
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Peel and core apples.  Cut into fourths.  Roll out biscuits and cut, forming 20 halves.  Roll biscuit half around apple wedge.  Place apples in a 9 x 13-inch glass pan.  Mix water and sugar and heat until sugar melts.  Pour over apples.  Melt 2 sticks margarine and pour over apples. Sprinkle cinnamon and bake 1 hour.

name: BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  bunch fresh broccoli, chopped or 20 oz. frozen chopped broccoli
1/4  stick butter
1  medium onion, diced
1/4  c. flour
1  clove garlic, chopped fine
1  tsp. basil
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
12  oz. can evaporated milk
2  c. milk
preparation: Boil broccoli until very tender.  Cool; pure in food processor.  Saut onion in butter along with flour, garlic, basil, salt and pepper until onion is transparent, but not browned.  Add broccoli, evaporated milk and milk.  Heat to boiling point.  Serve hot with French bread and grated Cheddar cheese.

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. strawberry jello
1/2  c. hot water
1  c. frozen strawberries
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  c. sour cream
1  c. pecans
preparation: Let water come to a boil; add jello.  Choose bowl you want to serve dessert in.  Put in frozen strawberries; pour jello over strawberries.  Add crushed pineapple.  Halve mixture.  Put both mixtures in refrigerator to chill.  Spread sour cream over top; add the remaining mixture.  Top with pecans.

name: BREAKFAST BRUNCH HAM SOUFFLE
ingredients:
16  slices bread, crusts removed
2/3  lb. ham, chopped
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
6  eggs, slightly beaten
3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. green pepper, chopped
1/4  c. green onion, chopped
1  tsp. dry mustard
corn flakes
butter, melted
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cube bread and ham.  Place in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Sprinkle cheese over top.  Mix eggs, milk, dry mustard, onion, green pepper, salt and pepper.  Pour over bread, ham and cheese. You may top with buttered corn flakes, if you wish.  Refrigerate overnight or at least 3 hours.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: WACKY CAKE
ingredients:
3  C. flour
10  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
2  C. sugar
2  tsp. soda
3  Tbsp. milk
10  Tbsp. Crisco
2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. vinegar
2  C. cold water
preparation: Sift first 5 ingredients together.  Add remaining ingredients mixing well.

name: CARAMEL PECAN BAKED APPLES
ingredients:
2  large apples
2  tsp. butter
2  Tbsp. caramel topping
2  Tbsp. chopped pecans
preparation: Core apples and peel strips from top of each.  Place 1 in custard cup.  Fill core with 1 teaspoon butter.  Microwave 2 minutes.  Top each with 1 tablespoon caramel topping and 1 tablespoon nuts.  Cook 30 seconds; let stand.

name: ITALIAN MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. ground, lean pork
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. grated cheese
3  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. minced onions
1  Tbsp. celery flakes
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. each:  pepper and garlic salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and shape into a loaf in a shallow pan.  Place 1/2 cup of water in the pan and top with loaf with 2 strips of bacon.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped green onion
2  Tbsp. chopped celery
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix together and roll into balls.  When chilled, roll into finely chopped nuts.  Decorate with 1/2 cherry on top.  Serve with crackers.

name: VEGETARIAN BURRITOS
ingredients:
1  soft wrap tortilla
2 to 3  Tbsp. cooked broccoli or drained cooked chipped spinach
1 to 2  Tbsp. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  Tbsp. salsa
preparation: Microwave tortilla for one minute.  Lift and wipe excess moisture off plate.  Return tortilla to plate, adding to center broccoli (or spinach).  Top with cheese, then salsa.  Warm entire tortilla for one minute.  Remove from microwave.  Wrap by rolling (to eat with fork and knife) or fold one side up and then roll (to pick up).  Let cool one minute before eating.

name: EVERY DAY BROCCOLI, CHEESE AND CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. margarine
4  skinless, boneless chicken halves (about 1 lb.)
1  can Campbell's new broccoli cheese soup
1/3  c. water or milk
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  box frozen broccoli
preparation: In a skillet over medium heat in hot margarine, cook the chicken about 10 minutes or until browned on both sides.  Next spoon off the fat.  Stir in soup, water and pepper.  Heat to boiling, and add broccoli.  Reduce heat to low.  Cover; simmer 10 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender and broccoli is done, stirring occasionally.  Makes 4 servings.   Prep time:  15 minutes.  Cook time:  25 minutes.

name: PIZZA JOES
ingredients:
1  lb. Italian sausage, casings removed
1  medium green pepper, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  c. fresh mushrooms, chopped
2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1  clove garlic, minced
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
6  English muffins, split and toasted
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown sausage in skillet; drain any excess fat.  Add green pepper, onion, mushrooms, seasonings and garlic; cook 2 minutes. Stir in tomato sauce and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes.  Top each muffin half with 2 tablespoons of meat sauce.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Broil until cheese melts and filling is hot.  Serve immediately.  Yields 12.

name: BLACK-EYED PEAS
ingredients:
4  c. peas
2  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. bacon or ham
preparation: Pick peas.  Shell and wash.  Put in pot.  Add salt and meat. Cover with water.  Cook until peas are tender.

name: SAVORY GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh green beans, trimmed
1 1/2  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
2  Tbsp. chopped green onion
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  Tbsp. minced fresh savory or 2 tsp. dried savory
2  Tbsp. minced fresh parsley
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
4  bacon strips, cooked and crumbled
preparation: Place beans in a steamer basket. Place in a saucepan over 1-inch of water. Bring to a boil; cover and steam for 7 to 9 minutes or until crisp-tender.

name: CHRISTMAS CANDY
ingredients:
2  boxes powdered sugar
1  can condensed milk
1  stick margarine
3  c. nuts
1  box semi-sweet chocolate
1/3  cake paraffin
preparation: Combine the first 4 ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Roll into balls and let stand until they get firm.  Melt the chocolate and paraffin.  Dip balls in chocolate and lay on waxed paper.

name: CHILI CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  brick chili
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. water
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  can Ro-Tel (but not all the juice)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Heat until melted in quart size pan.

name: BANANA SMOOTHY
ingredients:
3  ripe (brown spots), peeled and frozen bananas
2  c. cold water
1  pkg. non-sugar sweetener
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Put frozen bananas, cold water, sweetener and vanilla in blender.  Blend on low speed until large pieces are chopped and then blend on high speed for 1 minute or until smooth.  Yields generous 32 ounce serving.

name: CREOLE CHICKEN GUMBO
ingredients:
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. flour
1  lb. sliced okra
1  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green onions
2  cloves garlic, pressed
1/4  c. chopped fresh parsley
3/4  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. marjoram
1/2  tsp. basil
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1/2  lb. ham, cubed
1  lb. Andouille sausage*
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper to taste
cayenne pepper to taste
Tabasco to taste
4  lb. stewed chicken with 3 qt. chicken stock
1  lb. raw, peeled shrimp (optional)
4  c. steamed rice
preparation: In a large, heavy pot, heat oil.  Gradually add flour, stirring constantly over low heat until roux is medium brown.  Add okra, onion and celery.  Cook until okra is no longer stringy. Add green onions, garlic, parsley, thyme, marjoram, basil, tomatoes with juice, ham and chicken.  Slowly stir chicken stock into gumbo.  Cook sausage; drain and add to gumbo.  Simmer for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.  Add remaining seasonings.  Add shrimp during last 5 to 10 minutes.  Serve over rice.  Serves 8.

name: STUFFED APPLE TREATS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise or softened cream cheese
2  Tbsp. chopped nuts
2  Tbsp. raisins, dried cranberries or dates
2  apples
preparation: Combine mayonnaise or cream cheese, nuts and raisins, cranberries or dates; set aside.  Core each apple.  Stuff cavity with mixture.  Yields 2 servings.

name: SPICY TEXAS CORN CAKE
ingredients:
1  chile poblano or other large fresh hot green chile
1  lb. chorizos (Spanish sausages), chopped coarse
1  large onion, chopped fine
3  Tbsp. unsalted butter, softened
3  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1 (7 oz.)  can Mexican green hot sauce
1 1/4  c. corn meal
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
8  oz. (about 2 1/2 c.) Monterey Jack cheese, grated
1 1/4  c. fresh or canned corn kernels
preparation: Roast the chile on broiler pan about 4-inches from heat. Place in a paper bag until cool enough to handle.  Peel chile by rubbing in paper toweling.  Scrap out seeds and remove veins. Finely mince.

name: CHICKEN RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  chickens, cut up
1  box long grain wild rice/Minute rice
2  c. boiling water
1  can cream of celery soup (undiluted)
1  can cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
1  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
preparation: Place chicken on top of mixture, skin side up (salt and peppered).  Sprinkle over chicken one envelope of dry onion soup mix.  Cover with foil and cook 3 hours at 325°.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. shell macaroni
1 small  bunch green onions
1  can crabmeat
1  can shrimp
1  bunch parsley
2  stalks celery, chopped
3  medium carrots, shredded
1 3/4  c. mayonnaise
3/4  c. chili sauce
preparation: Chop onion and parsley.  Mix with other ingredients while macaroni is cooking.  When macaroni is cool, mix with rest of ingredients.  Best if made day before.  Serves 10 adults.  Great with a barbecue or for lunch with warm bread.

name: PORK ROAST WITH SAUERKRAUT
ingredients:
1  boneless pork loin (2 1/2 to 3 lb.)
32  oz. good sauerkraut (canned or in a bag)
preparation: Place roast in covered roasting dish or pan*.  Top with sauerkraut, including juice.  Roast at 200° for 8 to 9 hours.  Do not open oven or uncover.  Tastes good with mashed or boiled potatoes.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
1  can milk
1  large (12 oz.) bag chocolate chips
1 large  jar hipolite
1  c. English walnuts (optional)
preparation: Cook first 3 ingredients until it forms a firm ball in cold water.  Remove from  heat and add next 3 ingredients.  Stir until chocolate chips and hipolite dissolve.  Beat fudge about 10 minutes.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch lof pan.  Cool and score.

name: LAYERED BEAN DIP
ingredients:
2  cans refried beans
1  (8 oz.) container guacamole dip
1  (8 oz.) container sour cream
8 to 10  oz. picante sauce (hot or mild)
16  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Layer ingredients in a shallow dish or 9 x 9-inch square Pyrex.  Serve cold with corn chips or Doritos.

name: ROYAL HOLIDAY SPICED PUNCH
ingredients:
4  c. water
2/3  c. sugar
20  whole cloves
2  sticks cinnamon
1 (32 oz.)  bottle apple cider, chilled
1 (24 oz.)  bottle white or purple grape juice, chilled
juice of 6 fresh lemons (1 cup)
ice
preparation: In a saucepan, combine water, sugar and spices.  Bring to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves.  Reduce heat; simmer 5 minutes.  Chill; remove spices.  To serve in punch bowl, combine all ingredients.  For garnish, float lemon cartwheel slice in punch, if desired.  Makes about 12 cups (Sixteen 6 ounce servings).

name: BARA BRITH
ingredients:
4  c. self-rising flour
2  c. tea
2  c. mixed fruit
1  tsp. mixed spices
1  egg
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Soak the fruit in milkless tea overnight.  Mix all dry ingredients together.  Stir in the beaten egg.  Combine together well and spoon into a lined tin.  Bake in a moderate (325°) oven for 1 1/2 hours.  Serve sliced and spread with butter.

name: POPPIN FRESH BARBECUPS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. barbecue sauce
1/4  c. chopped onion
1 to 2  Tbsp. brown sugar
10  oz. can flakey biscuits
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar or American cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Grease 10 muffin cups.  In skillet, brown beef; drain.  Stir in next 3 ingredients.  Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.  Separate dough into 10 biscuits.  Place 1 biscuit in each greased cup; firmly press in bottom and up sides, forming 1/4 inch rim.  Spoon 1/4 cup meat mixture into each cup. Sprinkle with cheese and bake for 10 to 12 minutes.  Cool 1 minute and remove from pan.

name: SHIRLEY'S PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  qt. can peaches
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
1  egg
1/2  c. butter
cinnamon
nutmeg
preparation: Drain most of juice off peaches. Place in a large saucepan with 3/4 cup sugar. Bring to a boil. Beat together flour, baking powder, salt, 1 cup sugar, milk and egg. Pour boiling fruit into an 8 or 9-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Don't put more than 1/2-inch of juice in baking dish. Pour the batter over the hot peaches. Melt 1/2 cup butter. Pour butter over the batter into drizzle. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve plain or with ice cream.

name: CHICKEN SPECTACULAR
ingredients:
3  c. cubed cooked chicken
1  box Uncle Ben's seasoned wild rice
1/2  onion, chopped fine
1 medium  jar pimento, chopped (optional)
1 (1 lb.)  can French-style green beans, drained
1/2  ____ mayonnaise
1  can cream of celery soup
preparation: Cook rice.  Combine chicken and cooked rice.  Add onion, pimento and beans.  Combine mayonnaise and soup.  Add to other ingredients and mix well.  Bake 30 minutes in 2-quart casserole until bubbly and brown.

name: PINWHEELS
ingredients:
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. Jell-O
1/2  c. warm water
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows or 12 large
preparation: Spray 8 or 9-inch pan with no stick cooking spray (2 or 3 sprays).  Spread on bottom and sides of pan with paper towel. Put gelatin and water in 1 1/2-quart microwavable bowl. Microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes.    Stir to dissolve completely.

name: HONEY BUTTER
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/3  c. honey
1/4  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix until creamy.  Refrigerate in covered jar.

name: SUMMER DESSERT
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1 small  pkg. strawberry Jello
1 small  pkg. frozen strawberries
1  small Cool Whip
1  cup boiling water
preparation: Dissolve Jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add strawberries. Stir and refrigerate stirring occasionally. When it begins to thicken, fold in Cool Whip.  Leave in refrigerator until jelled. Cut angel food cake in half, crosswise, making two layers. Spread bottom layer with Jello mixture. Add top layer and frost top and sides with Cool Whip.  Refrigerate until ready to slice and serve.

name: DIVINITY CANDY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  egg whites
1/2  c. water
1/2  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  c. corn syrup
1  c. chopped nuts
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  Tbsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Combine sugar, syrup, water, salt and cream of tartar.  Let boil for 5 minutes, stirring to form firm ball. Remove from fire and pour over stiffly beaten egg whites (slowly).  Continue boiling until mixture holds its shape. Drop on wax paper.

name: JENN'S CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. yellow corn meal
1/4  c. sugar
4  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1/4  c. cooking oil or melted shortening
preparation: Stir together the first 5 ingredients.  Add milk, eggs and oil.  Beat just until smooth.  Turn into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: PECAN CRISPIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. Crisco
2 1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
2  eggs, well beaten
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Cream butter, Crisco and brown sugar until fluffy; add beaten eggs and sifted dry ingredients.  Bake at 375° for about 10 minutes.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. macaroni
3  carrots, grated
1  bell pepper
1  onion
1  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
1  c. mayonnaise
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix together well and chill.

name: CANDY YAMS
ingredients:
sugar
cinnamon
pats of butter
uncooked sweet potatoes
1/2  Tbsp. lemon peel
sliced oranges
preparation: Cover bottom of pan with sugar, cinnamon and pats of butter. Add large slices of uncooked sweet potatoes until area is covered. Sprinkle sweet potatoes with 1/2 tablespoon of lemon peel.  Add sliced oranges with peeling on top.

name: OATMEAL CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. quick cooking oats
1/2  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream together shortening and sugars until light and fluffy. Add egg. Beat well. Add vanilla. Stir in. Sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Gradually add dry ingredients to creamed mixture and mix well. Stir oats into mixture and mix well. Add chocolate chips. Shape into small balls and place on a greased cookie sheet about 2-inches apart. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from cookie sheet. Cool on racks. Yield: about 2 dozen.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can green beans
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
1/3  c. milk
pepper to taste
preparation: Mix together beans, soup, milk, pepper and 1/2 can of onions. Put in a casserole dish.  Cook on 350° for 25 minutes.  Pour the rest of the onions on top.  Cook 5 more minutes.

name: HIDDEN VALLEY SAUSAGE STARS
ingredients:
2  c. (1 lb.) cooked and crumbled sausage
1 1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. grated Monterey Jack cheese
1  c. prepared Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing
1  c. (2.25 oz.) sliced ripe olives
1/2  c. chopped red pepper
1  pkg. fresh wonton wrappers (usually found in produce section)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Blot sausage dry with paper towels and combine with cheeses, salad dressing, olives and peppers.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime jello
1  c. hot water
1/4  c. maraschino cherries
1/4  c. chopped walnuts
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 small (8 oz.)  pkg. small curd cottage cheese
1 small  pkg. Dream Whip (leave out vanilla)
preparation: Dissolve jello in water.  Chill slightly.  Add all other ingredients.  Mix together well.  Can be put into jello mold. Chill overnight.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs, well beaten
2  c. sugar
1 1/4  tsp. oil
3  c. plain flour
2  c. grated carrots
1  c. chopped nuts
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix oil and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Sift flour, cinnamon, salt, soda and baking powder. Add carrots, nuts, vanilla and pineapple. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
3 (16 oz.)  cans Mexican stewed tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato paste
2  tsp. minced garlic
1  c. chopped green onions
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. Louisiana hot sauce
4  Tbsp. cilantro
2  Tbsp. jalapeno juice (if desired)
preparation: Chop cilantro and place in blender.  Add 2 cans of stewed tomatoes, garlic, 1/2 cup green onions and tomato paste.  Blend to count of 5 and dump into a bowl.

name: CORNED BEEF AND CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  large cabbage
2  cans corned beef
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/4  c. water
preparation: Cut cabbage in quarters (wedges).  Place in strainer; rinse. Place in Dutch oven.  Sprinkle cabbage with salt and pepper.  Slice corned beef.  Place two slices on top of each wedge (quarter) of cabbage.  Steam on medium heat about 20 minutes.  Add 1/4 cup water if needed; test for doneness.  Do not overcook cabbage.

name: SPAGHETTI SQUASH WITH GARLIC SAGE CREAM SAUCE
ingredients:
1  spaghetti squash
3  fresh sage leaves
3/4  heavy cream
salt and pepper
1  clove minced garlic
1/4  grated parmesan cheese
preparation: Cut squash in half, lengthwise; remove seeds.  Place face down in baking dish with about 1 inch of water.  Cook squash in oven until it can be easily pierced with a fork.  Scrape inside of squash into a serving bowl.

name: ZALABIA
ingredients:
7 1/2  lb. flour (to start with)
1  doz. eggs
1  lb. oleo, melted
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  gal. milk, warmed
1/3  c. salt
2  oz. cake yeast
preparation: Combine cake yeast in the warmed milk  Beat eggs slightly, add melted oleo, sugar and warmed milk and yeast.  Mix well.  Add flour and mix.  You will need more flour, could use as much as 10 lb. of flour depending on size of eggs.  Knead until dough is smooth.  Let rest.  After 2 hours, cut into balls and let rest again.  Roll out like a pizza and cut into squares.  Fry in hot oil and sprinkle sugar, powdered sugar or cinnamon and sugar.  Of course, you can eat plain also.

name: PINEAPPLE NO-BAKE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
5 1/2 to 6  oz. size vanilla instant pudding
8  oz. can crushed pineapple
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix on low speed of mixer for 1 minute.  Pour into a baked pie shell (plain or graham cracker).  Top with Cool Whip.

name: MAPLE CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
2  c. self-rising flour (do not use all-purpose)
2  Tbsp. maple flavoring
1 1/2  c. Crisco oil
2  c. chopped pecans
1  c. coconut (if desired)
preparation: Mix with spoon.  Bake in 15 x 7 x 2-inch pan for 45 minutes at 325°.  Mix eggs, sugar and oil thoroughly.  Add flour, flavoring and mix well.  Add pecans.  Lightly grease pan.  Do not leave in oven any longer than 45 minutes.

name: ASPARAGUS ALMONDINE
ingredients:
2  cans asparagus spears, drained (reserve liquid)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  can reserved water from asparagus
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. grated cheese
1  c. bread crumbs
4  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. slivered blanched almonds
preparation: Lay asparagus in oblong baking dish.  Dilute soup with asparagus juice, salt and pepper and pour over asparagus. Sprinkle bread crumbs over soup, then sprinkle with grated cheese. Saute almonds in butter and sprinkle over cheese.  Bake 35 minutes in 300° oven.

name: CREOLE COUNTRY SOUP
ingredients:
1  large sweet red pepper (optional)
1  large green pepper
4  carrots, pared
1 (1 lb. 12 oz.)  can tomatoes (undrained)
1  white onion, peeled
4  whole cloves
3  bunches scallions
3  c. water
2  cans condensed chicken broth (undiluted)
4  celery stalks, chopped
1/2  tsp. dried basil leaves
1/8  tsp. dried thyme leaves
1/4  tsp. turmeric
1  whole bay leaf
1/4  tsp. hot red pepper flakes
1  tsp. salt (optional)
1 to 2  pkg. frozen cocktail shrimp
1 to 2  pkg. ready to eat crabmeat
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Wash, core and cut peppers into small pieces.  In small bowl, using a fork, crush and break tomatoes into edible pieces.  Stud onion with cloves; cut scallions into pieces.   Put water and chicken broth into large pot.  Bring to boil over high heat.  When liquid is at full rolling boil, add peppers, carrots, tomatoes, onion, scallions, celery, basil, thyme, turmeric, bay leaf and pepper flakes.  Return to boil; reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes.   Shrimp should thaw before using and add to liquid after 30 minutes cooking time. Add lemon juice; simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes.  Add crabmeat (it might unroll, not to worry) and cook for 5 minutes.  Add parsley at end of cooking time.

name: PINEAPPLE FREEZE
ingredients:
1  (3 oz.) lemon gelatin
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
preparation: Freeze and serve with cookies.

name: FLUFFY CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. orange juice
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant French vanilla pudding
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Beat  until  soft  2  (8  ounce) packages cream cheese. Beat in	orange juice, crushed pineapple, pudding and nutmeg. Chill. Serve with gingersnaps.

name: CHICKEN STEW
ingredients:
1  hen
1  bell pepper
1  stick celery
1 large  can evaporated milk
1  gal. milk
1  whole onion
6  medium Irish potatoes
preparation: Cook chicken, pepper, celery and onion in 1 gallon water until meat comes off bone. (Save water.)  Take meat off bone (do not use skin). Dice potatoes and cook (separate). Mash up 1/2 of onion, celery and bell pepper with fork. Add chicken, potatoes, mashed onion, bell pepper and celery, milk and can of milk to the water you cooked the chicken in. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook until hot enough to eat.

name: CHRIS' FAVORITE PIZZA
ingredients:
1 double  box cheese pizza
2 small  cans mushrooms
1  lb. hamburger
1  medium green pepper
6  c. cheese
2  pkg. pepperoni
1 large  jar olives
1  medium onion
2  large banana peppers
1  lb. sausage
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Follow directions on back of double box of pizza.  Add sliced olives, mushrooms and pepperoni.  Cook the hamburger and sausage.  Add green pepper and onion.  Add banana pepper, finely cut.  Add cheese.  Bake until cheese is brown.  Let cool.

name: PINWHEELS
ingredients:
2  pkg. wafer sliced meat (turkey, beef or ham)
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. dry Ranch dressing
1  bunch green onions
dill pickle spears
preparation: Combine softened cream cheese and dressing mix in a bowl. Using 2 slices of meat, spread on mixture.  Place either green stalk of onion or pickle spear at edge of covered meat.  Roll. Chill until firm and slice.  Serve with snack crackers.  Store in covered dish in refrigerator.

name: ITALIAN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onions
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 or 2  cloves garlic, minced
12  oz. tomato paste
16  oz. tomato sauce
1/4  c. chopped parsley
4  c. tomato juice
1 1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. sage
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. thyme
3  bay leaves
2  c. water
sliced mushrooms (if desired)
preparation: In a large skillet, cook onions until almost tender. Add the ground beef and garlic and brown lightly. Add sliced mushrooms. Stir in remaining ingredients.  Simmer, uncovered, for 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until thick.  Remove bay leaves.  Serve over spaghetti.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. raw rice
1  pkg. onion soup
1  c. water
4  pork chops
1  can cream of mushroom or celery soup
preparation: In a 2-quart casserole dish, spread raw rice on bottom of dish.  Stir 1 cup of water into the soup mix.  Pour soup mix over rice.  Brown the pork chops; place on top of soup and rice.  Pour the soup on top of pork chops.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: EASY APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
3  eggs
1  can apple pie filling
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Place half batter in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.   Put rest of batter in and top with remaining sugar and cinnamon mixture.  Bake at 350° until a wooden pick inserted comes out clean, approximately 30 minutes.

name: CHRISTMAS GINGERBREAD MEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. molasses
1  egg yolk (unbeaten)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. ground cloves
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
2  c. plain flour, sifted
preparation: Cream the shortening and sugar together.  Add molasses and egg yolk.  Blend well.  Add salt, soda, baking powder and spices. Slowly add sifted flour.  Roll out dough and cut with gingerbread man cookie cutter.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Decorate. Yields 2 to 3 dozen, depending on size of cutter.

name: LEMON BREAD
ingredients:
1  lemon
1 1/4  c. granulated sugar, divided
3/4  c. (1 1/2) sticks margarine
2  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Grate rind from lemon.  Set aside.  Squeeze juice from lemon. Mix juice with 1/4 cup sugar.  Set aside.

name: CHEESE LOGS FOR CHRISTMASTIME
ingredients:
2  lb. Owens hot sausage
2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  lb. sharp cheese
1  lb. mild cheese
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
preparation: Fry the sausage until done; drain, then add all the cheese and the drained Ro-Tel tomatoes.  Heat all together.  (May add more chilies or jalapenos.)  Pour into a large pan to chill and then cut into logs.  Delicious.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2/3  c. Crisco
1  egg
1/2  c. sour milk (add 1/2 Tbsp. vinegar to milk to sour)
2/3  c. banana, mashed
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix ingredients and pour into greased loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

name: ENCHILADAS(Low-Fat)
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  lb. light Velveeta Cheese, diced
1  doz. tortillas (corn)
4  c. tomato juice
3  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. onion powder
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. seasoned salt
preparation: Cook meat in skillet with spices until brown (done); get tomato juice hot.  Dip tortillas in hot tomato juice.  Put hot tortilla in pan you are going to cook them in; place 1 tablespoon meat and 1/2 diced cheese on tortilla and roll up.  Continue until you have all 12 tortillas rolled up side by side.  Pour remaining tomato juice on top and bake until cheese is melted.  Cook in 9 x 13-inch pan. Serve with chopped onion.

name: PUMPKIN ROLL
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. pumpkin
1  tsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. finely chopped nuts (optional)
1  c. confectioners sugar
8  oz. softened cream cheese
1/4  c. softened margarine
1/2  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Beat eggs in mixer bowl for 5 minutes.  Gradually add sugar, beating constantly.  Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice.  Sift in next 6 ingredients, mix well.  Spread in a greased 10 x 15 inch baking pan lined with wax paper.  Sprinkle with nuts (optional).  Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.

name: JALAPENO PEPPER CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1  c. buttermilk
2  eggs
1/2  c. bacon drippings
3/4  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  medium onion, chopped
3  peppers (jalapeno)
1/2  can cream-style corn
3/4  c. cheese, cut up
1/2  lb. ground beef, cooked (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients except cheese.  Pour half of the batter in greased iron skillet that has been heated.  Sprinkle ground meat over, then cheese.  Add rest of the batter. Don't let the cheese touch side of pan or the cornbread will stick.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  pkg. graham crackers
1 1/2  sticks soft margarine
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
4  bananas
1  can drained crushed pineapple
1  tub medium size Cool Whip
chopped nuts (if desired)
preparation: In a bowl mix crushed graham crackers with 1 stick of melted butter or margarine.  Put graham crackers in 9 x 12-inch cake pan for the crust.  Chill for a while.  Take another bowl and mix crushed pineapple, cream cheese and 1/2 stick butter together. Spread evenly on graham cracker crust.

name: MISSISSIPPI MUD BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. (1 stick) margarine or butter
3/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  pkg. (8 sq.) Baker's semi-sweet chocolate, chopped and divided
1  pkg. (6 sq.) Baker's Premium white chocolate, chopped and divided
1  c. chopped Diamond walnuts, divided
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Beat margarine, sugar, egg and vanilla until light and fluffy.  Mix in flour, baking soda and salt.  Stir in 1/2 of the semi-sweet and white chocolates and 1/2 cup of the walnuts.  Spread in greased foil-lined 9-inch square baking pan. Bake 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out almost clean.  Sprinkle with remaining semi-sweet and white chocolates.  Cover with foil.  Let stand 5 minutes or until chocolates are melted.  Swirl chocolates with small knife to marbleize.  Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup walnuts.  Cool in pan until chocolate is firm.  Cut into bars.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: CREAM CHEESE AND PECAN POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 1/2  c. butter, softened
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
3  c. cake flour
1/8  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Sprinkle 1/2 cup pecans in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Cream butter and cream cheese in mixer bowl until light. Add sugar; beat until fluffy.  Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add flour and salt; mix well.  Stir in vanilla and remaining 1 cup pecans.  Pour into prepared pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or until cake tests done.  Cool in pan for 10 minutes.  Invert onto serving plate.  Yield:  16 servings.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. mashed bananas (3 large)
3/4  c. vegetable oil
2  eggs
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat oven to 325°.  Grease  loaf  pan  9  x 5 x 3-inch. Mix sugar, bananas, oil and eggs in a large bowl with a wooden spoon. Stir in remaining ingredients and pour into pan.  Bake until wooden pick inserted in center of bread comes out clean. Bake for 60 to 70 minutes.  Let cool 10 minutes.  Loosen sides of loaf from pan and  remove  from  pan.  Let  cool completely before slicing. Makes 1 loaf.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1 2/3  c. sugar
1 1/4  tsp. baking powder
2/3  c. shortening
2/3  c. buttermilk or sour milk
3  very ripe bananas
1 1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
3  eggs
cinnamon to taste (optional)
preparation: Beat all ingredients except for 1/3 cup buttermilk and eggs for 2 minutes.  Add eggs and buttermilk.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour in 2 prepared loaf pans.

name: BEER BREAD
ingredients:
4  c. Bisquick
3  Tbsp. sugar
1 (12 oz.)  can beer (at room temperature)
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Pour into 2 small loaf pans.  All bread to rise 10 minutes before baking.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

name: SPICY PEACH SALAD
ingredients:
1  can sliced peaches
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange jello
1  Tbsp. broken stick cinnamon
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. whole cloves
water
preparation: Drain peaches, save juice and add it to vinegar and enough water to make 2 cups.  Boil 5 minutes with the spices.  Strain over jello and stir to dissolve.  Chill until thickened.  Add peaches and chill until set.

name: BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can English peas
1 large  can French green beans
1 small  jar chopped pimento
1  chopped onion
1  chopped bell pepper
4  stalks chopped celery
1 small  can mushrooms
1  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. Wesson oil
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. paprika
preparation: Mix all vegetables in a bowl.  Mix the vinegar, sugar, oil, salt and paprika  and pour into vegetable mixture.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Keeps well.

name: PARMESAN FISH FILLETS
ingredients:
1  lb. skinless fish fillets (1/2 inch thick)
1  beaten egg white
2  Tbsp. water
1/3  c. coarse bread crumbs
3  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. fresh parsley
preparation: Wash fish.  Pat dry.  In a small bowl stir together egg white and  water.  Mix  together  crumbs, Parmesan cheese and parsley. Dip  fish  into  egg  white mixture, then into crumb mixture. Lightly  grease  large  skillet and cook fish in hot skillet for 6 to 8 minutes until fish flakes easily with fork. Turn once.  Makes 4 servings.

name: PADDLE WHEEL PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour (plain)
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1  stick margarine
1  lb. 13 oz. can sliced peaches (including syrup)
preparation: Melt margarine in 9-inch baking dish in 350° oven.  Mix sugar, flour, baking powder and salt; gradually add milk.  Mix well. Slowly pour flour mixture over melted margarine in baking dish. Do not stir.  Spoon fruit, including syrup, over flour mixture. Do not stir.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. salt
1/4  c. Crisco
1  c. water
1  c. milk
1  c. mashed potatoes
2  eggs
3  pkg. yeast, dissolved in 3/4 c. water
7 to 8  c. flour
preparation: Heat sugar, salt, Crisco, milk and water until sugar dissolves, then cool.  Mix potatoes, eggs and dissolved yeast and add to cooled mixture.  Beat with mixer, knead in flour and raise until doubled (2 hours).

name: COUNTRY FAIR BROWNIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. cocoa
3/4  c. walnuts
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Add dry ingredients, then walnuts.  Spread into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° until firm in center.  Be careful not to overbake.

name: MILLION DOLLAR POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. butter
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
4  c. flour
3/4  c. milk
1  tsp. almond extract
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Cream butter; gradually add sugar, beating well at medium speed.  Add eggs, beating after each addition.  Add flour alternately with milk, beginning and ending with flour.  Mix until just blended after each addition.  Stir in flavorings.  Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 40 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center of cake comes out clean.  Cool in pan 15 minutes.  Remove from pan and let cool completely on a wire rack.

name: OLD FASHIONED SOUR CREAM COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
3  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  c. thick sour cream
2  tsp. vanilla
5 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Sift together the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Cream shortening with sugar.  Add eggs; beat well.  Add cream alternately with flour mixture.  Add vanilla.  Chill at least 1 hour.  Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 400°.  Makes 6 dozen.

name: RICE AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  boxes frozen, chopped broccoli, thawed
1  c. rice
1 small  jar mild Cheez Whiz
1 small  jar jalapeno Cheez Whiz
preparation: Cook rice in usual manner; set aside.  Soften both jars of Cheez Whiz by placing in the microwave.  In a mixing bowl, combine thawed broccoli, rice and softened Cheez Whiz; mix well.  Pour into a casserole dish and bake in a 375° oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: CUSTARD
ingredients:
1  qt. milk
4  eggs
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
crushed pineapple (optional)
preparation: Scald milk. Beat egg yolks. Add sugar and salt. Stir constantly when adding to the hot milk. Return to double boiler. Stir until thick. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into custard. Serve cold.

name: "CHEESE THINGS"
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Snappy cheese
1/2  lb. butter or oleo
1 3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  dash Tabasco or hot pepper sauce
1  Tbsp. poppy seed
preparation: Blend cheese and butter with seasonings until smooth and slowly work in the flour until it's all smooth.  Form into a roll 1 1/2-inches in diameter.  Wrap in wax paper and chill overnight or longer.  At serving time, slice rolls 1/2-inch thick and set on an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 6 minutes at 400° and serve direct from the oven.

name: ZUCCHINI AND MUSHROOM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. zucchini, washed and cut in 1-inch slices
1/2  lb. sliced mushrooms
2  Tbsp. flour
fresh or dried dill
2 large  cloves garlic
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Simmer until tender, zucchini, dill and garlic; drain and save 3 tablespoons liquid.  Saute mushrooms and butter.  Add 2 tablespoons flour and 1 cup sour cream; heat slowly.  Put both mixtures in casserole; top with buttered breadcrumbs.  Boil until brown.

name: FETTUCINI ALFREDO
ingredients:
1/2  lb. fettucini noodles
3/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  stick butter
1/2  pt. heavy cream
chopped parsley
preparation: Cook noodles until slightly crunchy.  Rinse cold water.  Melt butter and put 1/2 aside.  Heat 1/2 cream and 1/2 butter until bubbly.  Add noodles and parsley.  Toss until cream starts to cook off.  Add rest of butter and cream, then as you toss add as much cheese as desired.  Add salt and pepper if desired.

name: KAHULA
ingredients:
1  fifth vodka
1  whole vanilla bean
4  c. white sugar
4  c. water
1 (2 oz.)  jar Sanka
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients  in  gallon glass jug.  Shake and blend well.  Shake jar once a day.  Store in dark place 3 to 4 weeks. Strain Kahlua and place back in jug.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. thin cooked spaghetti
1  diced cucumber
1/2  sweet red onion, chopped
1  tomato, diced
1 large  bottle Italian dressing
1  jar Durkee Salad Supreme
1/2  green pepper, chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients and marinate for at least 24 hours.

name: SCAMPI STYLE SHRIMP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. sliced green onions
4  garlic cloves, chopped fine
2  Tbsp. each: margarine or butter and olive oil or vegetable oil
1  lb. medium (raw) shrimp, peeled and deveined
1/4  c. ReaLemon juice (from concentrate)
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: In large skillet, stir the green onions and garlic with margarine and oil for 1 minute.  Add shrimp; cook and stir until shrimp are pink.  Add ReaLemon and salt and heat thoroughly. Garnish as desired.

name: POLYNESIAN CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. oil
2  c. flour
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
2  jars baby junior carrots
1 small  can crushed pineapple and juice
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. coconut
preparation: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Mix ingredients by hand. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in cake comes out clean.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  hen, boiled and deboned
salt and pepper to taste
1  tsp. baking powder
2  c. flour
1  egg
water
preparation: Mix flour, salt, pepper, egg, baking powder and enough water to form a stiff dough.  Divide dough into 3 parts and roll, one at a time, very thin on floured surface.  Cut into 1 1/2-inch strips and drop into broth.  Add chicken.  Serve hot.

name: OATMEAL PECAN COOKIE
ingredients:
2  c. butter- stick Land of Lakes
2  c. sugar
2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
4  c. flour
5  c. blended oatmeal in food processor
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
2  - 4 oz chocolate chips- semi sweet
1- 8  oz. grated Hershey Bar
3  c. pecans
preparation: Blended oatmeal measure and blend in a blender to a fine powder.  Cream butter and both sugars.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Mix together with flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder and baking soda. Add chocolate chips, Hershey Bar and nuts.	Roll into balls and place 2 in. apart on cookie sheet.	Bake 375 degrees for 6 minutes.  Makes 112 cookies, recipe can be halved.	Roll to size of walnuts do not press.

name: FRUIT SALAD WITH FRUIT DRESSING
ingredients:
2  quarts,  8 c., fruit salad mix
1  c. milk
1 6  oz. can pineapple juice
1 3  oz. package vanilla instant pudding mix
1/2  c. non-dairy whipped topping, thawed
preparation: Divide fruit among serving dishes.

name: OATMEAL YEAST BREAD FOR BREAD MAKER
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast (1 Tbsp.) in bottom of pan
2  c. bread flour
1  c. whole wheat flour
1  c. rolled oats
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. butter
1  1/2 water
preparation: Add bread flour to yeast and follow with remaining ingredients.  Bake according to bread maker's instructions.

name: BLUEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. grape gelatin
2  c. boiling water
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (21 oz.)  can blueberry pie filling
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Dissolve the gelatin in the boiling water in a bowl.  Stir in the undrained pineapple and pie filling.  Spoon into a 9 x 13-inch dish.  Chill for 1 hour or until set.  Beat the cream cheese and sugar in a mixer bowl until fluffy.  Add the sour cream, pecans and vanilla.  Spread over the congealed layer.  Chill until serving time.  Yields 8 servings.

name: CHICKEN KIEV
ingredients:
2/3  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. fine dry bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. basil
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. salt
4  chicken breasts, skinned and boned
1/4  c. apple juice
1/4  c. green onions, chopped
1/4  c. fresh parsley, chopped
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Melt margarine.  Combine bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, basil, oregano, garlic salt and salt.  Dip chicken pieces in melted butter or margarine, then coat with crumb mixture.  Reserve remaining butter.  Place chicken in baking pan. Bake 50 to 55 minutes.

name: RASPBERRY JAM
ingredients:
2  qts. red raspberries, free of leaves and rinsed
6 1/2  c. sugar
1  pouch "Certo" pectin
1/2  tsp. butter
Jelly jars
preparation: Prepare fruit:  crush 2 quarts of raspberries (should equal 4 cups of crushed berries).  Measure 4 cups into a large pot, stir sugar into the fruit,  mix thoroughly.  Add butter (reduces foaming).  Bring mixture full rolling boil, stirring constantly. Open Certo pectin pouch and quickly stir contents into fruit mixture.  Bring to full rolling boil again and continue boiling for one minute, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Skim off any foam with a large metal spoon.  Make sure you have jars ready and fill to 1/3 of inch from the top.  Wipe jar rims and threads and cover quickly with lids.  Screw bands on tightly.  Invert jars for 5 minutes then turn upright. Check lids to see if there is a slight bulging on top.  If there is, they are sealed.

name: HAMBURGER/POTATO/CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1  c. cooked cut up potatoes
1 regular sized  can corn, drained
1 regular sized  can tomato soup
1 small  can mushrooms, chopped
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef. Sauté onions and mushrooms with meat. Cook potatoes and dice. Layer all ingredients in a casserole. Bake at 300° for 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

name: FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. water
1/8  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. cocoa
3  Tbsp. Karo syrup
3  Tbsp. margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1/2  pkg. small marshmallows
nuts
preparation: Cook first 5 ingredients until it forms a soft ball in cold water.  Do not stir after first mixing.  When ready, remove from stove and add margarine and vanilla, then add chips and marshmallows.  Beat until they are melted and mixture thickens. Add 1 cup nuts and spread on buttered pan.  Cut in squares.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. Oreo or Hydrox chocolate sandwich cookies
1/2  c. butter, softened (1 stick)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. powdered sugar
2 (4 oz.)  pkg. instant chocolate pudding and pie filling
3  c. milk
1  (8 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
preparation: Crush cookies in food processor or blender.  Set aside.  In medium bowl, cream together butter, cream cheese and powdered sugar, beating with electric mixer until smooth, about 2 minutes.

name: LIME PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. lime jello, dissolved
2 (48 oz.)  cans pineapple juice
1 large  can frozen lemonade
2  c. sugar
green food coloring (desired color)
1 (48 oz.)  can water
1  qt. chilled ginger ale
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
preparation: Follow	directions  on	package to dissolve jello, then add sugar.  Stir  well.  Add  can of frozen lemonade, then add pineapple juice, water and food coloring.  Refrigerate.

name: ITALIAN SCALIDI(Honey Covered Cookies)
ingredients:
2  dozen egg yolks, beaten well
3  tsp. baking powder
3  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. anise oil
flour
oil for deep frying
honey
preparation: Beat egg yolks well.  Add baking powder, butter and anise oil; mix until creamy.  Add as much flour as beater will take and then turn dough on floured board and add enough flour to make a soft dough.  Roll out dough; cut into thin strips and form into pretzel shape.  Deep fry until golden brown.  When cool, coat with honey.

name: CARAMEL ICING
ingredients:
2  c. light brown sugar
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook light brown sugar with milk.  Boil until it's thin in cold water.  Add butter and vanilla.  Remove from fire and leave until cold.  Then beat until creamy.  If sugar curdles the milk, add a pinch of baking soda.

name: BARBECUED MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. bread crumbs
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  lb. ground beef
preparation: Combine hamburger, bread, milk, onion and green pepper.  Shape into meatballs and place in casserole dish.

name: CORN FLAKE PEANUT BUTTER DELIGHT
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. white Karo
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. peanut butter
5  c. corn flakes
preparation: Boil the first 2 ingredients.  Add rest of ingredients.  Roll into balls in an 8 x 8-inch pan.

name: POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  (3 to 5 lb.)  beef roast
5  to 6 med. potatoes, divided into quarters
1  med. onion, sliced
3  to 4 lg. carrots, sliced (or several baby carrots)
salt and pepper to taste
1  Tbsp. Teriyaki sauce
preparation: Place meat, vegetables, salt and pepper in crock pot with 1/4 to 1/2 cup of water, and cook on high for at least 4 to 6 hrs. or until tender. (Add 1 Tbsp. of Teriyaki sauce while cooking.)

name: DAVID'S FAVORITE CHRISTMAS ITALIAN FUDGE
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
1/4  lb. real butter
1  can evaporated milk
1  c. white syrup
preparation: Put all ingredients together and put over low to medium heat. Cook mixture until it forms a ball in cold water.  Stir the entire time it cooks.  Once it forms a ball, remove from heat and beat until cool enough to pour into a pan.  Will only harden if it has been cooked long enough, otherwise get a spoon and eat caramels!

name: LAYERED TACO DIP
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  c. taco sauce
2  tomatoes
1  green pepper
1  onion
12  oz. cream cheese
16  oz sour cream
8  oz. shredded cheese
sliced pitted black olives
tostada chips
1  can refried beans
preparation: Layer 1:  Cook and drain hamburger.  Add taco seasoning and taco sauce.  Spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Spread refried beans over hamburger.

name: CORN BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. corn meal
1/2  tsp. soda (1/4 tsp. if self-rising)
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1  c. water
preparation: Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes.  A very moist corn bread.

name: QUICK CARAMEL COFFEE RING
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. brown sugar
2 (10 oz.)  cans Hungry Jack refrigerated flaky biscuits
1/2  c. chopped nuts
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  In a small saucepan, melt the margarine. Coat the bottom and sides of a 12 cup fluted tube pan with 2 tablespoons of the margarine.  Sprinkle 3 tablespoons of the nuts over bottom of the greased pan.  Add remaining nuts, brown sugar and water to remaining margarine; heat to boiling, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Separate dough into 20 biscuits; cut each biscuit in half and shape into a ball.  Place 20 balls in bottom of pan; drizzle with half of the caramel over the balls. Repeat layers.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.  Invert immediately on waxed paper and remove from pan. Makes 10 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/3  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. margarine or butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1 1/4  c. self-rising flour
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Mix sugar, margarine and vanilla.  Beat in egg.  Stir in flour. Mix in nuts and chocolate chips.  Spread dough in pan.  Bake until light brown, 12 to 14 minutes.  Cool; cut into bars about 2 x 1 1/2-inches.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: CRUNCHY CHICKEN CHEESE BAKE
ingredients:
8  skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
4  slices Swiss or American cheese, each cut in half
1  can (10 3/4 oz.) cream of chicken soup
8 thin tomato  slices (optional)
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1/2  c. Pepperidge Farm herb seasoned stuffing, crushed
preparation: In 3-quart oblong baking dish place chicken, top with cheese. Stir soup and spread over cheese; top with tomato.  Combine butter and stuffing, sprinkle over tomatoes.  Bake at 400° for 25 to 35 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.  Garnish with fresh oregano if so desired.  Can be served over rice.

name: CRAN-SCRUMPTIOUS PUNCH
ingredients:
1  pkg. strawberry jello
1  c. hot water
3  c. cold water
1  qt. cranberry juice
1  qt. ginger ale
