1  qt. vanilla ice cream
6  oz. frozen lemonade
preparation: Mix in punch bowl in order listed.

name: FAMOUS WESSON FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Wesson oil
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
3  c. flour
1  c. orange juice
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1  c. seedless raisins
4 1/2  c. mixed fruits
3  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. allspice
preparation: Heat oven to 275°.  Line 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) pans with lightly greased wax paper.  Combine Wesson oil, sugar and eggs.  Beat 2 minutes.  In large bowl, combine 1 cup flour with fruits and nuts. Sift remaining ingredients: flour, baking powder, salt and spices.  Beat eggs, sugar and oil.  Add flour to Wesson mixture; alternate with orange juice.  Pour batter over fruit mixture. Blend well.  Turn into pans.  Place pan of water on lower rack of oven.  Bake cakes 2 1/2 to 3 hours, until done.  Cool on wire racks.  Remove from pans.  Peel off paper.  Wrap in cloth dampened with brandy, fruit juice or wine and wrap in foil.

name: STUFFED STEAK
ingredients:
take any kind of steak for how ever many people are in your family
1  can mushroom soup
1 small  box Stove Top stuffing
preparation: Put your steaks in the oven at about 325° until they are done. Take them out and drain the steaks.  On the bottom of your pan, put the Stove Top stuffing on the bottom.  Put steaks on top.  And then put the mushroom soup on top of the steaks.  Then put back in the oven for about 10 or 15 minutes.

name: SPICY CHAFING DISH FRANKS AND APPLES
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken franks
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2/3  c. apple jelly
1  c. hot chili sauce
2  tsp. cider vinegar
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  green skinned apples, unpeeled and cut into 1-inch chunks
preparation: You will need toothpicks.

name: SPIDER COOKIES
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch morsels
1/4  c. creamy peanut butter
1 (3 oz.)  can chow mein noodles
preparation: Combine butterscotch morsels and peanut butter in a 2-quart glass bowl.  Microwave on High for 2 minutes (after 1 minute, stir).  Add noodles.  Stir to coat noodles.  Drop by rounded teaspoon on waxed paper.  Top with two raisins or cherries.  Let harden on waxed paper.

name: OOOOH-LA-LA POTATOES
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
6  Tbsp. butter (reserve 2 for topping)
3/4  c. sour cream
3  green onions, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook  potatoes in skins.  Cool, peel and dice.  Combine cheese and  4 tablespoons butter in large saucepan.  Heat and stir until  cheese in almost melted.  Remove from heat; blend in  sour cream, onions, salt and pepper.  Fold in potatoes and spoon into a greased 2-quart casserole dish.  Dot with remaining  2 tablespoons butter.  Cover and bake for 25 minutes in a 300° oven.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: GIAN-MIKEL'S GRILLED CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
chicken breasts
thyme
basil
garlic powder
salt
pepper
olive oil
vinegar
preparation: Trim fat from chicken breasts and slice in half.  Add some fresh herbs to taste such as thyme, basil, oregano, garlic powder, salt, pepper, olive oil and vinegar.  Mix everything, making sure breasts are well coated.  Marinate for at least 1 hour.  Grill and serve hot.

name: MY BOURSIN CHEESE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. butter
2  crushed garlic cloves
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. basil
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
2  Tbsp. fresh parsley
preparation: Combine all ingredients (may be done in a food processor with steel blade) and blend thoroughly.  Shape into a ball and roll in crushed pepper.  Refrigerate overnight before serving.  Boursin cheese may be frozen.

name: HOMEMADE SOAP
ingredients:
5  lb. grease (must be animal fat)
water
1/3  c. Purex
1/2  c. powdered Borax
1  can lye
preparation: Melt grease and strain through cloth, then add equal amount of water and let stand for a day or two until the grease hardens on top of the water, that takes out the salt, etc.  When the grease has hardened, skim off of the water and put it into an enamel pail. In a bowl, take 1 quart of cold water plus 2/3 cup cold water, Purex and Borax.  Take outside and add lye to the mixture in the bowl, being careful not to inhale the fumes.  The lye will cause the water to almost boil.  Stir occasionally until lukewarm, then add slowly to the grease which should be the same temperature. Stir about 15 minutes or until about the consistency of honey. Pour into milk cartons or glass dishes.  Allow to stand for 2 days or until it can be cut.  Let harden a few weeks before using. 1.2 ounces of cotronella gives it a scent which is nice.  Good luck.

name: TEX MEX DIP
ingredients:
3  medium avocados
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
2 (10 1/2 oz.)  cans bean dip
1 large  bunch green onions
3  medium tomatoes, chopped
2 (3 1/2 oz.)  cans pitted and chopped olives
18  oz. shredded cheese
1  bag tortilla chips
preparation: Mash avocados with lemon juice, salt and pepper.  Combine sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning mix.  Spread bean dip on platter.  Top with avocados.  Layer with sour cream and taco mixture.  Next, spread onion, tomatoes and olives.   Cover with shredded cheese.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: CHICKEN AND DRESSING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  to 8 pieces split boned chicken breasts, cut up
3 to 4  slices Swiss cheese or Cheddar
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans cream of chicken soup
1  bag cubed type poultry dressing
1/2  c. milk or a little more
preparation: Put chicken breast pieces in a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Top with cheese.  Mix soup and milk and pour over the chicken and cheese. Prepare dressing according to package directions.  Place over chicken.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: MISS SMITH'S HOMEMADE PRETZELS
ingredients:
2  pkg. dry yeast
1 1/2  c. warm water
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
4  c. flour
1  egg, beaten
coarse salt
preparation: Mix dry yeast and water.  Add sugar and salt.  Add flour. Knead dough until smooth.  Cut off pieces.  Roll pieces of dough with your hands and shape.  Place on cookie sheet and brush shapes with egg.  Sprinkle with coarse salt.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 425°.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CRINKLES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. sugar
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. unsifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
sugar, nuts, chocolate kisses or jam or jelly
preparation: In bowl with mixer at medium speed, beat first 6 ingredients until fluffy.  At low speed, beat in next 4 ingredients.  Shape into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar.  Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets.  Bake in 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until browned.  Immediately press nuts or candies into cookies or press with thumb and fill with jam.  Cool.  Store in airtight container.  Makes 6 dozen.  (Very good just as they come out of the oven without candies or nuts.)

name: CHICKEN AND STUFFING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  chicken, boiled, boned and diced
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  box stuffing mix
preparation: Prepare stuffing mix according to box directions; set aside. Cover bottom of baking pan with chicken soup.  Spread chicken over soup and put stuffing on top.  Butter lightly and bake at 350° until stuffing is lightly browned.

name: PUMPKIN WAFFLES AND CINNAMON SYRUP
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
2  c. milk
3/4  c. canned pumpkin
1/2  c. oil
3  eggs
1/2  c. chopped pecans (optional)
preparation: Heat waffle iron.  Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off.  In large bowl combine dry ingredients for waffles; blend well.  Add milk, pumpkin, oil and eggs; beat 1 minute at medium speed.  Stir in nuts.  Bake in hot waffle iron until golden brown and steaming stops.  Makes 12 waffles.  Freeze any leftovers and warm up in toaster.

name: EASY YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1/2  c. Crisco
1/3  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
1  c. warm water
4 to 5  c. plain flour
preparation: Mix yeast with 1/4 cup of warm water.  Set aside.  Cream sugar and Crisco.  Add egg.  Stir in the 1 cup of water.  Add yeast. Stir in flour.  Put in a large bowl.  Let rise in warm place until double.  Punch down and shape into rolls.  Let rise until double in bulk.  Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: HARVARD BEETS
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can small or sliced beets
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. beet juice
dash of salt
1/4  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Mix  sugar  and  cornstarch;  add  vinegar, beet juice, butter and  salt.  Boil  five minutes or until slightly thickened.  Add beets and let cook over low heat 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 6.

name: CINNAMONY APPLE STREUSEL BARS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 1/4  c. all purpose flour
3/4  c. packed brown sugar, divided
1/4  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
3/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
2  c. chopped apples (2 medium apples), cored and peeled)
Glaze
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 13 x 9 inch baking pan. Combine graham cracker crumbs, flour, 1/2 c. brown sugar, granulated sugar, cinnamon and melted butter in large bowl until well blended; reserve 1 c. Press remaining crumb mixture into bottom of prepared pan. Bake 8 minutes. remove from oven; set aside. Toss apples with remaining 1/4 c. brown sugar in medium bowl until brown sugar is dissolved; arrange apples over baked crust. Sprinkle reserved 1 c. crumb mixture over filling. Bake 30 to 35 minutes more or until apples are tender. Remove pan to wire rack; cool completely. Drizzle with glaze. Cut into bars. Makes 3 dozen bars.

name: EXTRA EASY LASAGNA
ingredients:
3/4  lb. ground beef
3  c. Prego traditional spaghetti sauce
1  container (15 oz.) Ricotta cheese
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese (8 oz.)
6  uncooked lasagna noodles
1/4  c. water
preparation: Bake at 375°  for 45 minutes. In 10-inch skillet over medium heat, cook beef until brown, stirring to separate meat.  Spoon off fat.  Add spaghetti sauce; heat through, stirring occasionally.

name: MEXICAN LASAGNA
ingredients:
4  flour tortillas
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  envelope taco seasoning mix
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  can diced tomato
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  can chili with beans
1  lb. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
12  oz. Ricotta cheese
2  eggs
preparation: Mix eggs and Ricotta cheese. Set aside. Brown meat. Drain. Add taco seasoning and tomatoes. Cook 10 minutes. Add onions and chili. Layer in 9 x 12 baking pan.

name: CAESAR DRESSING
ingredients:
2  egg yolks
2  oz. Dijon mustard
2  c. oil (1 olive and 1 salad)
2 to 4  oz. vinegar
1 1/2  tsp. anchovy paste
2  tsp. garlic, mashed
1/2  tsp. onion powder
1/2  tsp. coarse black pepper
dash of lemon juice
1  tsp. parsley flakes
few capers, crushed
Parmesan cheese, shredded
preparation: In mixing bowl, using a wire whisk, whip eggs and mustard for 5 minutes.  Slowly add oil; whip until absorbed before adding more.  Thin with vinegar.  Add anchovy paste and remaining ingredients with Parmesan cheese last.  Cover and refrigerate. Don't keep longer than three weeks.

name: FRIED ONION RINGS
ingredients:
4  to 5 large onions
1  egg
1  c. milk
1  c. flour
pinch of sugar
1  tsp. garlic salt, if desired
1  c. cooking oil
preparation: Slice onions and separate into rings.  Make batter of the beaten eggs and milk.  Stir together flour and seasoning.  Dip onions into flour and then in batter.  Drop onion rings into oil and cook until golden.   Serve hot.

name: MRS. REESE'S DIVINITY CANDY
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
preparation: Boil until it threads.

name: HOT APPLE TODDY
ingredients:
1  qt. apple cider or juice
1/4  c. maple syrup
1  tsp. whole cloves
3  whole nutmeg
1  cinnamon stick
grated peel of 1 orange
preparation: Combine all ingredients in large saucepan.  Simmer 15 minutes. Serves 6.

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak (cut 3/4 inch thick)
2  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper to taste
1  medium onion
1  carrot, chopped
1  small stalk celery, chopped
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
preparation: Cut round steak in serving pieces.  Season flour with salt and pepper.  Dredge meat in seasoned flour.  Place onions in bottom of crock-pot; add meat.  Top with carrots and celery and cover with tomato sauce.  Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours - on high 3 to 5 hours.  Serve with noodles or mashed potatoes.

name: TURKEY TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. cayenne
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
2  1/2 cooked turkey
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
2  Tbsp. dry sherry
8  oz. spaghetti, cooked
1  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. grated Parmesan
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Melt margarine; stir in cornstarch, salt and pepper.  Stir in broth.  Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute.  Stir in Miracle Whip and sherry.  Remove from heat.  In buttered 2-quart casserole, layer spaghetti, turkey and mushrooms.  Cover with remaining sauce.  Repeat layers and cover with remaining sauce.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake for 30 minutes or heat thoroughly in a microwave.

name: SMORES
ingredients:
5  Hershey bars
1  bag big marshmallows
1  box graham crackers
preparation: Take the Hershey bars and break them into twos.  Get 4 marshmallows and stick in between two graham crackers.  Bake in oven for 5 to 10 minutes.  Eat!

name: SWEET N SOUR CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  envelope instant onion soup
1  bottle Russian salad dressing
1 small  jar apricot preserves
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour over chicken.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Great served over white rice.

name: CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
1  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking powder
1  beaten egg
1  c. milk
1/4  c. shortening
preparation: Mix dry ingredients in a mixing bowl.  Add egg, milk and shortening.  Beat until smooth.  Bake in a greased 8-inch square pan at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: SQUASH RING MOLD
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen mashed squash
2  Tbsp. water
2  Tbsp. butter
4  eggs, beaten
8  oz. tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
dash of Tabasco
preparation: Cook squash as directed on package using only 2 tablespoons water and 2 tablespoons butter.  Beat eggs.  Mix eggs, tomato sauce, onion, salt, pepper and Tabasco and add to squash.  Pour into greased ring mold and place mold in pan of hot water.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3 or 4 (16 oz.)  cans pork and beans
2/3  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  large or 2 small chopped onions
2  Tbsp. chili powder
2  lb. ground beef
2 beef bouillon cubes, dissolved in 1  c. hot water
preparation: Saute ground beef and onions in skillet.  Drain off fat.  Mix well other ingredients, except bouillon.  Put in casserole dish. Pour bouillon over all and bake 1 hour at 300°.

name: PLUM CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  oz. red food coloring
2 small  jars Gerber plums with tapioca
3  eggs
2  c. flour, sifted
preparation: Place all the ingredients into mixing bowl and beat approximately 5 minutes. Fold in 1 cup nuts.  Bake in Bundt or tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: WINE AND WILD RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. long grain and wild rice mix
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. dairy sour cream
1/3  c. dry white wine
1/2  tsp. curry powder
2  c. cubed cooked chicken or turkey
1/4  c. snipped parsley
preparation: Prepare rice mix according to package directions on top of range.  Meanwhile, place onion, celery and butter in a 2-quart glass casserole.  Cook, covered in a countertop microwave oven until tender, 2 to 2 1/2 minutes.  Blend in soup, sour cream, wine and curry.  Stir in chicken and cooked rice.  Microcook, covered, until heated through, 8 to 10 minutes, giving casserole a half turn after 5 minutes.  Garnish with parsley.

name: SUMMER SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. spaghetti, cooked
1 large  bottle Italian salad dressing
1/2  c. fresh Parmesan
1  onion, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1  tomato, chopped
1/2  bottle Durkee salad seasoning
preparation: Mix and refrigerate overnight.  Serve cold.

name: FRIED RICE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked long grain white rice
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1/4  c. onion, chopped *
2  Tbsp. green pepper, chopped *
1  can sliced mushrooms
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
3  eggs, beaten
1  can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
preparation: Cook onion and green pepper in oil in large skillet.  Stir in rice, water chestnuts, mushrooms and soy sauce.  Cook over low heat for 10 minutes.  Stir in beaten eggs; cook and stir 2 to 3 minutes.  Makes 4 to 5 servings.

name: ANGEL FLAKE BISCUITS
ingredients:
5 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1/4  c. warm water
1  pkg. dry yeast
3/4  c. shortening
2  c. buttermilk
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water; mix with buttermilk. Sift flour and sugar together. Mix all ingredients as you would regular biscuits. (Can keep in refrigerator for days.) Roll and let stand 10 to 15  minutes. Bake on ungreased baking sheet in very hot oven (450°) for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
3  c. flour
1  tsp. each:  salt, cinnamon, baking powder and baking soda
1  c. vegetable oil
3  c. grated raw zucchini
1 1/2  c. coconut (optional)
1  c. nuts
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Pour into 2 greased bread pans. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.  Yum, yum.

name: CRANBERRY PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. (6 oz.) raspberry flavored gelatin
3/4  c. boiling water
1  can (16 oz.) jellied cranberry sauce
1  can (8 oz.) crushed pineapple, undrained
3/4  c. orange juice
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
lettuce leaves
choice of mayonnaise or Dream Whip for topping
preparation: In a bowl dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Break up and stir in cranberry sauce.  Add pineapple, orange juice and lemon juice. Chill until partially set.  Stir in nuts.  Pour into an 11 x 7 x 2-inch dish.  Chill until firm.  Cut into squares.  Serve each on a lettuce leaf.  Serves 12.

name: QUICHE
ingredients:
1 big  can evaporated milk
4  eggs
1  c. Bisquick
4  green onion tops (optional)
1  can mushrooms (optional)
salt and pepper
meat (sausage, bacon, hamburger or ham)
6 to 12  oz. Cheddar or Swiss cheese
preparation: Brown and drain meat.  Mix all ingredients except meat and cheese.  Pour in deep pie pan.  Drop in meat and sprinkle cheese on top; do not stir.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: ICEBOX OATMEAL CRISP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. plain flour
2  well beaten eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
3  c. quick cook oatmeal
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients. Add oatmeal and nuts. Mix well. Roll in wax paper in two slender round rolls and chill overnight. Then cut into thin round pieces and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI SUPREME
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli
3  Tbsp. oil
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. Minute rice
1  c. water
1/2  c. onions, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2 soup  can milk
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
preparation: Saute onions in pan with oil.  Add celery and broccoli with water.  Steam for 10 to 20 minutes.  Add soup, milk, rice and Cheez Whiz.  Bake at 350°  for 1/2 hour.

name: EGG MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1 (7 1/4 oz.)  pkg. Kraft macaroni and cheese dinner
1  (10 oz.) frozen peas
1  medium tomato, chopped
3/4  c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
1/2  c. celery slices
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
6  hard-boiled eggs
preparation: Prepare Kraft dinner as directed on package.  Add peas, tomato, salad dressing, celery, onion and seasoning.  Chop fine the eggs; add to dinner mixture.  Mix lightly.  Chill.  Stir in additional salad dressing before serving.  If desired, garnish with remaining egg slices.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: EASY SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  box chopped frozen spinach, thawed and drained
1  can water chestnuts, chopped
1  pt. sour cream
1  pt. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1  box Knorr dry vegetable soup mix
preparation: Mix all the above ingredients.  Let chill.  Carve out the center of a loaf of rye bread and fill with spinach dip.  Serve with rye bread chunks removed from center and crackers.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. chopped walnuts
4  Tbsp. sour milk or 4 Tbsp. milk and 1 tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. soda
1/2  c. butter
1  c. banana
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and eggs.  Add banana, milk, vanilla and nuts.  Stir in soda and flour.  Bake in loaf pan at 350° for about 1 hour.

name: ZUCCHINI PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/4  tsp. oregano
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1/4  c. flour
1 1/2 to 2  c. unpeeled zucchini, grated and squeezed as dry as possible
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Melt 1 tablespoon margarine in heated skillet.  Spoon batter (1 to 2 tablespoons) in pan to brown on one side, then flip and brown other side.  The pancake will be soft and moist.  Serve as a potato replacement, plain or topped with grated Parmesan cheese, sour cream, chives or tomato sauce.  Serves 2 to 3 people.

name: AMARETTO CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham crumbs
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. butter, melted
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
1  c. sugar
4  eggs
1/3  c. Amaretto
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. Amaretto
1/4  c. toasted sliced almonds
1  (1.2 oz.) Hershey bar, grated
preparation: Combine the first 4 ingredients; mix well.  Press firmly into bottom and 1/2-inch up sides of 9-inch spring-form pan.  Beat cream cheese with electric mixer until light and fluffy. Gradually add sugar, mixing well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each.  Stir in Amaretto.  Pour over crumbs.  Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes.  Combine the sour cream, sugar and Amaretto, stirring well.  Spoon over cheesecake.  Bake at 500° for 5 minutes.  Let cool to room temperature, then refrigerate 24 to 48 hours.  Garish with grated chocolate and almonds.

name: PARTY PIZZA(Makes 90)
ingredients:
1  lb. hot sausage, cooked, drained and crumbled
1  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. sharp cheese, grated
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese (from wedge)
1 1/2  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. garlic salt
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
3  cans flaky biscuits (Hungry Jack brand)
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except biscuits.  Separate each biscuit into 3 pizza rounds.  Spread with mixture.  Put pizzas on cookie sheet and freeze.  Remove from cookie sheet and store in plastic bags.   Bake frozen pizzas at 425° for 10 minutes.  Great for a cocktail party.

name: MOSTACCIOLI PRIMAVERA SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. (8 oz.) mostaccioli, uncooked
2  c. fresh asparagus tips, uncooked
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. Italian dressing
2  Tbsp. balsamic or red wine vinegar
1/2  c. sweet red pepper strips
1/2  c. sliced zucchini
1/2  c. diced red onion
1/4  c. fresh basil leaves, chopped
preparation: Cook pasta according to package directions.  During last 2 minutes of cooking, add asparagus to cooking water.  Drain pasta and asparagus.  Rinse with cold water to cool quickly.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1  qt. water
1 1/2  c. dry macaroni
1  can evaporated milk
2  eggs
American cheese to taste
preparation: Bring water to boil and add salt.  Add macaroni and cook about 10 to 12 minutes. Drain, saving 1 cup of the water.  In bowl, beat eggs and milk.  Add macaroni and mix well.  (May need to add saved water so dish won't be too dry.)

name: POTATO HOT DISH
ingredients:
8  to 10 potatoes, peeled and sliced
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can vegetable soup
1 1/2  lb. hamburger, fried and drained
preparation: Put one layer of potatoes, 1 layer cream of mushroom soup, 1 layer of vegetable soup, 1 layer hamburger.  Keep putting in layers until all is used.  Add 3/4 to 1 can of milk over the top. Bake 2 to 3 hours at 350°.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1  box confectioners sugar (3 1/2 c.)
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  sticks butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  stick paraffin
9  oz. pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Mix confectioners sugar, peanut butter, butter and vanilla together.  Shape into balls; dip into melted paraffin and semi-sweet chocolate chips.

name: MICROWAVE PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white syrup
1 to 1 1/2  c. raw peanuts
1/8  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. baking soda
preparation: Combine sugar, syrup and water.  Microwave on High for 5 minutes.  Stir in peanuts and salt.  Microwave 5 1/2 to 6 minutes. Add butter, vanilla and baking soda.  Stir just to mix and melt butter (mixture will be foamy, do not stir down).  Pour onto a well buttered cookie sheet.  Tilt pan to spread mixture.  When cool, break into small pieces.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICOTTA PIZZA
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. olive oil
3/4  lb. broccoli, chopped
1/4  c. water
2/3  c. Ricotta cheese
1  large egg
2  large garlic cloves
1/4  tsp. salt
2/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
cornmeal for sprinkling on pan
1  pizza dough
preparation: In large heavy skillet, heat 2 tablespoons oil over moderately high heat until it is hot but not smoking and saute the broccoli, stirring for 1 minute or until bright green and coated well with hot oil.  Add water, cook the broccoli, covered, for 3 minutes, or until crisp-tender and let stand, uncovered, off the heat.

name: CHRISTMAS COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. Spry
1/4  c. butter
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. powdered sugar
2  Tbsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1  c. pecans
powdered sugar
preparation: Blend Spry, butter, salt, sugar and vanilla.  Add flour and pecans.  Bake in slow oven (325°) for 25 minutes.  Cool and roll in powdered sugar.

name: HUMMINGBIRD CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. oil
3  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. pineapple (crushed and undrained)
1 1/2  c. bananas
1  c. nuts
preparation: With large spoon, mix dry ingredients.  Mix eggs and oil; stir into dry ingredients.  Add vanilla, pineapple, bananas and nuts. Bake in 9-inch pans at 350° for 30 minutes.  Makes a 3-layer cake. Bake and cool.  Frost with cream cheese icing.

name: HONEY WHEAT BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. water
1  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. honey
1/4  c. margarine
4 1/2 to 5  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. wheat flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
3  tsp. salt
2  pkg. dry yeast
1  egg
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients together and heat until very warm. Combine this warm liquid gradually with 2 cups flour and remaining ingredients.  Beat 2 minutes.  Stir in remaining flour to make enough dough.  Knead until smooth and elastic.  Put in greased bowl and let rise until doubled.  Punch down and divide into 2 loaves or 24 rolls.  Let rise again until doubled.  Bake at 350° until golden brown and sounds hollow to tap.  Brush the warm loaves with honey and butter mixture.

name: SAUSAGE BREAD
ingredients:
1  lb. Jimmy Dean sausage
2  loaves frozen bread
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese
3  c. Mozzarella cheese
1  beaten egg
2  c. mushrooms
2  medium onions
2  medium bell peppers
preparation: Let bread rise as directed on package. Brown meat and vegetables together. After bread rises, roll out flat and place on a cookie sheet, one for each roll. Spread 1/2 the mixture in center of each loaf and top with 1/2 of each cheese. Fold bread over and tuck in ends. Brush with egg and bake at 375° until golden brown.

name: BANANA DRESSING
ingredients:
1  egg or 2 egg yolks
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. white sugar
1  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. water
1  pkg. peanuts
bananas
preparation: Cook the first 5 ingredients until almost candy. Grind the peanuts.  Roll the bananas in the dressing, then in the chopped peanuts.

name: GINGER CREAM COOKIES
ingredients:
2  1/4 cups sifted all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. mace
10 2/3  tbsp. (2/3 cup) unsalted butter, melted
1  1/3 cups sugar
Enough fresh gingerroot when peeled, cut and pressed thorough a garlic press to measure 1 1/2 tsp.
1  tsp. freshly grated orange rind
1  large egg
3  tbsp. unsulfured light molasses
preparation: Into a bowl sift the flour twice with the baking soda, the ground ginger, the cinnamon and the mace.  In a food processor blend the butter, 1 cup of the sugar, the gingerroot, and the rind for 5 seconds, add the egg, and pulse the motor until the mixture is just combined.  Add the molasses and pulse the motor until the mixture is just combined.  Add the flour mixture, blend the mixture for 8 to 10 minutes.  Pinch off chunks of the dough, each about the size of a cherry, roll them into balls, and roll the balls in the remaining 1/3 cup sugar, coating them well.  Arrange the cookies 3 inches apart on lightly buttered baking sheets and bake them in batches in the middle of a pre-heated 375 degree oven for 10 - 12 minutes or until they are browned lightly.

name: PAELLA(Spain)
ingredients:
4  oz. Italian sausage links
2 (19 oz.)  cans ready-to-serve minestrone soup
8  oz. tomato sauce
2  tsp. dried crushed thyme leaves
8  oz. small to medium peeled and deveined shrimp
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
8  oz. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1/2-inch strips
1 1/4  c. uncooked quick cooking rice
preparation: In a large saucepan, brown sausage links and cut in 1/4-inch slices.  Add minestrone soup, tomato sauce, thyme and garlic powder; bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 3 minutes.  Add shrimp and chicken.  Simmer, covered, until shrimp are pink and chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes.  Stir in uncooked rice.  Remove from heat.  Cover; let stand until almost all the liquid is absorbed.  Serve in bowls.  Makes 6 cups.

name: RICE AND CHICKEN RISOTTO(Risotto, my dear, is a way with rice; a delectable way.)
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
1  chopped green bell pepper
2 to 3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  c. raw rice
1  chopped, boiled, deboned chicken (in large pieces, 1-inch cube)
3  c. chicken stock
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. cooking sherry
1 small  can pimento, chopped
preparation: Saute onion and bell pepper in butter or margarine.  Add remaining ingredients and mix.  Place in a large baking dish. Cover and cook in the oven at 400° until liquid is absorbed. (More liquid may be added for tender rice.)  Remove cover the last 15 minutes to lightly brown.

name: CHOCOLATE DATE COOKIES(Rich's Cookies)
ingredients:
8  oz. pitted dates, chopped
1/2  c. butter
3/4  c. light brown sugar, packed
6  oz. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
2  eggs
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. orange juice
1  c. chopped pecans
Orange Glaze
drained kumquats
preparation: Grease well a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.  Mix dates, sugar and butter with 1/2 cup water in a saucepan.  Cook over low heat for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Add chocolate; stir until melted.  Beat in eggs.

name: BANANA CAKE WITH PEANUT BUTTER ICING
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. mashed, very ripe bananas
1  c. buttermilk
2/3  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  In a medium bowl combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt.  Set aside.  In a small bowl combine bananas and buttermilk; set aside.

name: COLE SLAW DRESSING
ingredients:
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. vinegar
2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Stir until dissolved and mix into chopped cabbage.

name: CARAMEL WALNUT BARS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
3/4  c. light brown sugar
3/4  c. butter, divided
1 (14 oz.)  can condensed milk
1  egg, beaten
3/4  c. nuts
24  caramels
preparation: Combine flour, sugar and egg.  Cut in butter until crumbly. Stir in nuts.  Reserve 2 cups crumbs.  Press remainder of mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 15 minutes.

name: SNOWBALLS
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
3  Tbsp. 10x powdered sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. finely grated walnuts
10x powdered sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix ingredients together.  Roll into 1 to 1 1/2-inch balls.  Bake 20 to 30 minutes, turning over once at 10 to 15 minutes.  Roll in 10x sugar when hot.   Roll a few more times in 10x sugar to taste (more times rolled, sweeter taste).

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. bacon drippings or oil
1 1/2  c. uncooked long grain rice
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2 to 3  c. water
1/4  tsp. garlic salt or 1 clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. onion salt or 1 small onion, minced
preparation: Heat bacon drippings or oil over medium heat in large skillet. Add rice, stirring constantly, until rice is browned.  Be careful not to burn rice.  Turn burner off.  Add tomato sauce, water and salts or garlic and onion.  Cover immediately.  Simmer over low heat until all liquid is evaporated and rice, onion and garlic are tender, 25 to 30 minutes.  Add more water if necessary to prevent drying.   Serve immediately.  Makes 4 to 6 (1/2 cup) servings.

name: MEAT AND POTATO QUICHE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
3  c. raw potatoes, shredded
3/4  c. meat (may be cooked chicken, diced ham or ground beef)
1  c. cheese, grated
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1  c. rich milk
5  eggs (Egg Beaters may be substituted)
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix  the  potatoes and oil together in a large pie pan. Press evenly  into  pie  crust shape.  Bake for 15 minutes at 425°  or until beginning to brown.  Layer the meat, cheese and onion  onto the crust.  Beat together the milk, eggs, salt and pepper  in a bowl.  Pour over the other ingredients in the pie pan.  Sprinkle with  parsley  flakes.  Bake for 30 minutes at 425°.

name: PASSOVER SPINACH SOUFFLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1-2 clove garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
1  pkg. (8 oz.) Philadelphia cream cheese, softened
8  oz. Farmer cheese (feta? ?)
1/8  tsp. each salt and pepper
dash of Tabasco
3  eggs
2  pkgs. (10 oz. each) frozen chopped spinach, thawed, well drained.
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/8  tsp. ground nutmeg
preparation: Cook and stir onion and garlic in butter until tender.

name: PEACH CHEESE TARTS
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  can condensed milk
1/3  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
3  to 4 fresh sliced peaches
1/2  c. apricot preserves
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  pt. whipped cream
pre-baked tart shells
preparation: Whip cheese and condensed milk.  Whip again.  Stir in lemon juice and continue beating until thickened.  Pour into tart shells and chill.  Place sliced peaches in shells.  Melt preserves with sugar.  When sugar is dissolved, pour glaze over peaches.  Top with whipped cream.

name: CHOCOLATE NUT PIE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1 large  can evaporated milk
6  eggs
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. cocoa
3  Tbsp. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
3  pie shells
preparation: Combine sugar, milk, eggs and margarine.  Add cocoa and flour; mix well.  Add nuts.  Pour into half baked pie shells.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: APPLE BETTY
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/4  c. melted butter
4  c. sliced apples
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
2  tsp. grated lemon rind
preparation: Combine bread crumbs and butter.  Place 1/3 of mixture in 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Combine apples, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and lemon rind.  Toss together until apples are well coated with sugar mixture.  Spoon 1/2 of apples over bread crumbs in casserole. Layer with more bread crumbs and apples, reserving 1/3 of crumbs for top.  Pour 1/4 cup of water over.  Cover and bake at 375° for 35 minutes.  Uncover and brown for 5 minutes.  Serve warm with cream.

name: SPICY HOT BLACK-EYED PEAS
ingredients:
3  slices bacon
1 (17 oz.)  can black-eyed peas
1 (16 oz.)  can whole tomatoes, undrained and chopped
1  c. chopped onion
1  large green pepper, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. ground cumin
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Cook bacon slices in large skillet over medium flame until crisp.  Remove bacon; crumble and set aside.  Stir all remaining ingredients except parsley into bacon drippings in skillet; bring to a boil over medium-high flame.  Reduce flame to low and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Spoon mixture into serving dish; sprinkle bacon and parsley over top.  Yield:  6 servings.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  small onions
1  green pepper
1  tsp. salt
1 small  can tomatoes
1 small  can kidney beans
1/2  c. rice
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Chop onions and pepper, then saute onions and pepper in 2 tablespoons butter.  When done, add meat and brown.  Add the tomatoes, beans and seasoning.  Cook the rice and put all ingredients together in a greased casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: GARLIC RUMP ROAST
ingredients:
rump roast
garlic salt
preparation: Preheat oven at 500°.  Wash rump roast and dry with a paper towel.  Line iron skillet with aluminum foil.  Gather sides of foil to prevent splattering.  Sprinkle garlic salt in bottom of pan. Lay fat side of roast on bottom of pan.  Sprinkle generous amount of garlic salt all over roast.  Cook 10 minutes per pound plus 10 minutes.  Let set in oven one hour after turning oven off.  Do not open oven door until hour is up.

name: ELEPHANT STEW
ingredients:
1  elephant (medium size)
2  rabbits (optional)
salt and pepper to taste
brown gravy
preparation: Cut the elephant into small bite size pieces.  Add enough brown gravy to cover.   Cook for 4 weeks at 425°.  Will feed up to 2,500 people.  If more are expected, 2 rabbits may be added.  Do this only in an emergency, most people do not like hare in their stew.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  c. sugar
1  c. shortening or oil
6  ripe bananas, mashed
4  eggs, beaten
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening.  Mix mashed bananas and beaten eggs together.  Stir flour, salt and baking soda into mixtures. Do not overmix.

name: APPLE TEA COOLER
ingredients:
1/3  c. apple juice (unsweetened)
1/3  c. tea
ice cubes
lemon wedge (optional)
preparation: Exchange List Approximation:  Fruit 1/2.

name: CHEESE STICKS
ingredients:
1  loaf sliced white bread
8  oz. whipped cream cheese
1 small  can mushrooms, drained and chopped
1  large onion, chopped
preparation: Cut off crusts and roll out slices of bread until very thin. Saute chopped onion and mushrooms in butter.  Mix with cream cheese.  Spread bread slices.  Roll up like jelly roll and cut each slice into 3 pieces.  Brush top with melted butter and sprinkle with paprika.  Bake on cookie sheet for 15 minutes at 350°.

name: HOMEMADE SAUERKRAUT
ingredients:
1  gal. cold water
1/2  c. canning salt
1  c. vinegar
cabbage
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and let stand for 24 hours.  Chop cabbage, clean jars and lids real hot.  Pack cabbage in jars. Pour warm solution over cabbage and seal.

name: QUICK DISH DINNER
ingredients:
3  strips bacon
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, minced
1  green pepper, minced
1/2  c. elbow macaroni
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Dice the bacon; cook in a large skillet until crisp.  Crumble in ground beef and brown well; drain off excess fat.  Add remaining ingredients, slightly breaking up tomatoes and dampening macaroni.  Cover and simmer gently for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: BEEF MACARONI DINNER
ingredients:
2  tsp. butter
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
2  c. chopped onions
1  garlic clove, minced
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1 (6 oz.)  can mushrooms (undrained)
1/2  lb. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
1 1/2  Tbsp. chili powder
2  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. sugar
4  drops Tabasco sauce
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown meat and onions in butter.  Mix all other ingredients except cheese.  Cook and drain elbow macaroni.  Save macaroni until last.  Cook all ingredients including meat and onions in frying pan for about 1 hour.  Mix elbow macaroni, meat mixture and cheese in a large serving dish.  Arrange triangles of cheese on top.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans tuna
2  c. elbow macaroni
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  can milk
bread crumbs
Italian dressing
preparation: Cook elbows in saucepan.  Cook mushroom soup and milk.  When elbows are done, empty into casserole dish.  Moisten with Italian dressing, then add tuna and mushroom soup mix.  Then sprinkle bread crumbs on top.  Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes.

name: BARBECUED GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
2  slices bacon
1  medium onion, sliced
1 (16 oz.)  can cut green beans, drained
1/4  c. catsup
1/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble.  Saute onion in bacon drippings until transparent. Combine beans and onion; put in casserole dish.  Stir catsup and brown sugar together; pour over beans.  Sprinkle bacon over top. Cover and bake 1 hour.  Makes 3 to 4 servings.

name: APPLE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. shortening
2  egg yolks
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. water
preparation: Combine salt and flour.  Cut in shortening until mixture is crumbly.  Blend yolks, lemon juice and cold water; blend into flour mixture.  Divide mixture into two equal parts; set aside one part.  Roll other part to fit bottom and halfway up sides of a 9 x 12-inch pan.

name: SPINACH
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, thaw and drain off excess water
6  eggs
6  Tbsp. plain flour
12  oz. cottage cheese
8  oz. mild sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1  stick margarine, melted
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: LOW FAT ITALIAN SAUCE(15 Minute Pasta Sauce)
ingredients:
1  oz. dried Porcini mushrooms
8  oz. fettucini noodles
1  tsp. olive oil
1  clove fresh garlic, minced
1  lb. Roma tomatoes, chopped
1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms, halved
3 sprigs fresh oregano or 1/2  tsp. dried oregano
Basil Chiffonade
Parmesan cheese to sprinkle
preparation: Wash porcini mushrooms in water; strain and save the water. Heat olive oil in pot and add porcini mushrooms.  Add herbs and chopped tomatoes.  Add liquid from Porcini mushrooms and fresh mushrooms.  Saute 15 minutes with lid off.

name: CORN FRITTERS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. milk
4  Tbsp. melted butter
1  c. white kernel corn, drained
oil for frying
powdered sugar
preparation: Heat oil to 350°, 3-inches deep.  Mix dry ingredients. Combine eggs, milk and butter; mix together with dry ingredients. Add corn and stir to combine.  Drop by tablespoonfuls into hot oil.  Deep fry about 5 minutes or until brown.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve warm.

name: HOMEMADE CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  cans chili beans
1/2  c. barbecue sauce or 1 c. tomatoes
1  Tbsp. onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. celery, chopped
1  Tbsp. carrots, chopped
1  Tbsp. green pepper, chopped
preparation: In skillet, cook meat until nearly done, stirring frequently to separate.  Add remaining ingredients; cook slowly until vegetables are tender and flavors are well blended.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  box spaghetti
1  large tomato
1  small bell pepper
1  small onion
1/2  lb. American cheese
2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Cook  spaghetti.   Set   aside  and  cool.  Add  finely chopped tomato, bell pepper, onion and cheese.  Add mayonnaise and mix together.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: BEET RELISH
ingredients:
1  qt. cooked beets
1  qt. raw cabbage
1  c. grated horseradish
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cayenne
1/4  black pepper
vinegar
preparation: Chop beets and cabbage fine. Add the rest of the ingredients and cover with vinegar. It is then ready to serve.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1 1/4  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. chopped nuts
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. raw apples, diced
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Add oil and vanilla.  Beat until smooth.  Beat eggs until foamy.  Add sugar and blend together.  Fold into batter.  Add nuts and apples.  Pour into greased tube pan.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: 5 CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. flaked coconut
1  c. fruit cocktail, drained
1  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Refrigerate for several hours before serving.  Garnish with maraschino cherries on top for color.

name: MOLASSES SURPRISE COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
3/4  c. unsulphured molasses
3 1/2  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
3/4  tsp. ginger
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/3  c. sour milk
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar and molasses.  Add eggs; mix well. Sift together flour, salt, soda, ginger, nutmeg and cinnamon.  Add small amount of dry ingredients and mix until blended.  Stir in sour milk, nuts and chocolate chips.  Mix in remaining dry ingredients.  Drop from tablespoon on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: ALMOND JOY COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c butter
1  1/2 c white sugar
1  1/2 c brown sugar
4  eggs
4  tsp vanilla extract
4  1/2 c all purpose flour
2  tsp baking soda
1  tsp salt
5  c semisweet chocolate chips
2  c flaked coconut
2  c chopped almonds
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°. Grease cookie sheets. In a large bowl, cream together the butter, white sugar and brown sugar until smooth. Beat in the eggs, one at a time, then stir in the vanilla. Combine the flour, baking soda, and salt, stir into the creamed mixture until well blended. Finally, stir in the chocolate chips, coconut and almonds.  Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto the prepared cookie sheets.  Bake for 8-10 minutes in the preheated oven. Allow cookies to cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: GERMAN SLAW(A Handy Salad To Have Around)
ingredients:
2  qt. cabbage, chopped or grated
2  green or red peppers
2  medium onions
1 1/3  c. vinegar
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. turmeric
1  tsp. celery seed
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. mustard
preparation: Boil vinegar, sugar, turmeric and spices.  Pour over cabbage mixture.  Put in sterile jars.  Store in refrigerator.  Keeps 6 months.

name: SIMPLE APPLE PIE
ingredients:
5  Granny Smith apples, peeled and sliced
3/4  c. raisins
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. oleo
1  (9-inch) 2-crust pie shell (deep-dish)
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Combine sugar, flour, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Blend well.  Stir in apples and raisins.  Pour in crust with oleo.  Cut other in strips.  Crisscross strips over apples.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or more.

name: CRISPIX MIX
ingredients:
8  c. Crispix cereal
1  c. peanut butter
1  (12 oz.) bag butterscotch morsels
1/2  (6 oz.) bag chocolate chips
preparation: Melt peanut butter and butterscotch morsels on low heat until liquid forms.  Mix in Crispix until coated.  Remove from heat and stir in chocolate chips until Crispix is completely covered with chocolate.  Spread mixture on wax paper until "dry" (sheen disappears).

name: COCKTAIL FRANKS
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/3  c. fresh lemon or lime juice
1  c. catsup
1/3  c. Heinz 57 sauce
1/3  c. chopped celery
1  tsp. dry mustard
salt to taste
pepper to taste
cooked hot dog pieces
1/3  c. white wine (optional)
preparation: In a medium saucepan, mix all ingredients.  Bring to a slow boil.  Add sliced, cooked hot dog pieces and reduce heat to low. Simmer about 5 minutes.

name: MICROWAVE CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
4  qt. popped corn
1  stick oleo
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white corn syrup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Put popped corn in paper sack.  Bring oleo, brown sugar, corn syrup and salt to boil; boil for 2 minutes.  Then add soda and stir.  Pour mixture over popcorn in sack and shake.  Put in microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes, remove and shake.  Repeat 3 times total, pour on counter to cool.

name: CHOCOLATE CHERRY DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines Deluxe II Cherry Supreme cake mix (or whatever brand is available)
1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. cooking oil
1/4  c. water
1  egg
1  c. (6 oz. pkg.) chocolate chips (I have used a 12 oz.  pkg. chocolate chips)
1  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Blend cake mix, flour, oil, water, egg and almond extract. Stir in chocolate chips.  Drop from a teaspoon onto an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes, until edges of cookies just begin to brown.  Cool on cookie sheet for about 1 minute and then remove to rack to finish cooling.  Makes 3 1/2 dozen, 2 1/2-inch cookies.

name: PINK SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  c. coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
1  can cherry pie filling
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Mix and chill.  Will serve a crowd and will also keep well in refrigerator.

name: HAWAIIAN MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  egg
1 1/2  c. crushed crackers
1  onion, minced
1/2  c. syrup from pineapple
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  evaporated milk
1/2  c. crushed pineapple, well drained
preparation: Make meat loaf; top with an 8 ounce can of tomato sauce.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BEANLESS CHILI-CHEESE DIP(Microwave)
ingredients:
16  oz. Velveeta cheese
1 small  can diced chilies
1 (12 oz.)  can beanless chili
preparation: Dice cheese.  Place cheese, chili and chilies into microwave-safe bowl.  Microwave for 3 minutes.  Stir.  Microwave for 3 minutes more.  Serve hot with tortilla chips.

name: OVEN-EASY BEEF AND POTATO DINNER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
3  Tbsp. oil
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. water
1  pkg. (about 3/4 oz.) brown gravy mix
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, thawed and drained
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  In 8 x 12-inch baking dish, combine potatoes, oil and pepper.  Firmly press potato mixture evenly across bottom and up sides of dish to form a shell.  Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 15 minutes.

name: BUTTERMILK BISCUITS
ingredients:
3 1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. shortening
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Blend all dry ingredients; cut in shortening until crumbly-coarse.  Add milk and stir to form soft dough.  Place onto lightly floured surface; knead gently for 30 seconds.  Roll out. Cut into desired size and bake on ungreased baking sheet for 15 minutes in 450° oven (varies as to altitude).

name: CRISP SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. oleo
1  unbeaten egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
2  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Cream sugar and oleo.  Add egg and vanilla.  Mix well.  Sift flour, salt and soda and mix with first mixture.  Stir in milk well.  Dip hands in flour and form dough into small balls and place on greased baking sheet 2 inches apart.  Flatten with a flat bottom glass dipped into sugar as each cookie is pressed.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

name: PINK LEMONADE PIE
ingredients:
1  large container Cool Whip
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 small  can pink lemonade
graham cracker pie crust
preparation: Blend milk and lemonade together, then add Cool Whip.  Add enough red food coloring to make pink.  Pour into graham cracker pie crust.  Garnish with cracker crumbs.  Chill.

name: BARBECUE BEEF
ingredients:
2 to 4  lb. chuck roast
2  onions, chopped
1  c. water
1  c. ketchup
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. paprika
2  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. pepper
dash of garlic salt
preparation: Put roast in pan. Place onion on top. Mix all other ingredients together and pour over top of roast. Cover and bake at 300° for 4 to 5 hours.

name: PHILLY CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. margarine, melted
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar and margarine; press into a 9-inch pie pan.  Combine cream cheese and sugar, mixing at medium speed.  Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each. Add vanilla; pour into pie crust.  Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 250° for 35 minutes or until done all the way through.  Let cool and chill.

name: LEMON PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
dash of salt
3  Tbsp. butter or oleo, melted
1  tsp. finely shredded lemon peel
1/4  c. lemon juice
3  eggs, divided
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: In a mixing bowl, combine sugar, flour and salt.  Stir in the melted butter, lemon peel and lemon juice.  In another bowl, beat egg yolks until well beaten.  Add milk to beaten yolks and stir together.  Pour yolk mixture into lemon mixture, mixing well. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form.  Fold whites into the lemon mixture.  Pour batter into an ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan.  Place a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan on oven rack; place the batter-filled pan in the 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Carefully pour hot water into the larger pan to a depth of 1 inch.  Bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes.  Serve warm or chilled in dessert dishes.  Serves 9.

name: PRESIDENTIAL CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  whole chicken breasts, boned, halved and skinned
8  slices bacon
1/4  lb. chipped beef
10 1/2  oz. can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Wrap 1 slice of bacon around each piece of chicken.  Place chipped beef on bottom of baking dish.  Put chicken on top of beef.  Mix sour cream and soup; spread on top of chicken. Sprinkle with a little paprika.  Don't salt! Bake at 350° for about 50 minutes.  Serves 8.

name: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
1  can cream-style corn
1  can whole kernel corn (do not drain)
3  eggs
1/2 large  carton sour cream
1  stick melted margarine
1  box Jiffy corn meal muffin mix
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour in casserole dish.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: CHICKPEAS AND PASTA
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  garlic clove, crushed
1 (19 oz.)  can chickpeas, rinsed and drained
1  tsp. fresh oregano or 1/4 tsp. dried
1/4  tsp. ground black pepper
1/4  tsp. crushed red pepper
1  bay leaf
1 (28 oz.)  can no salt added Italian style plum tomatoes with the juice
2  c. elbow macaroni or small tubular pasta
1  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Heat oil in large skillet.  Add onion and cook over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until tender, 3 to 5 minutes.  Add garlic and cook 1 minute longer.  Add chickpeas, oregano, black pepper, hot red pepper and bay leaf.  Cook, stirring and crushing half the chickpeas, with back of spoon until heated through, 5 minutes.  Add tomatoes with juice.  Bring to boil over medium-high heat, stirring and breaking up tomatoes with the side of a spoon. Reduce heat to medium-low; cover and simmer 10 minutes.

name: CHEESE STRAWS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
4  c. extra sharp cheese, grated
2  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. baking powder
scant 1/4 tsp. salt
water
preparation: Blend all ingredients well.  Add water, a little at a time as pie crust.  Roll very thin.  Salt and cut into strips, then place on slightly greased cookie sheet and bake until light brown at 350° for 12 minutes.

name: OUR FAVORITE PICKLES
ingredients:
1  jar dill pickles (1 qt. 14 oz.)
3  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. mustard seed
20  whole cloves
preparation: Drain pickles; add to cut-up pickles all of the remaining ingredients and let stand outside of refrigerator for 24 hour before refrigerating.

name: MOCK PRIME RIB
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. rolled rump roast
1  can Swanson's beef broth
1  pkg. Good Seasons Italian dry mix
1  pkg. Schilling au jus mix
preparation: Place roast in crock-pot.  Mix broth, Italian dressing mix and au jus mix together.   Cook on low setting for 8 to 10 hours. Potato and carrots may be added last 2 to 3 hours, if desired.

name: CREAM CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
4  oz. crushed pineapple, drained
1/4  c. finely chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  Tbsp. finely chopped green onion
1/2  tsp. Lawry's seasoned salt
preparation: You can either leave this spread in a bowl or you can chill it.  Form into balls and roll in nuts.

name: JAMBALAYA PEPPERS
ingredients:
3/4  c. uncooked instant rice
1 (8 oz.)  can Italian style tomato sauce
1/3  c. water
1  tsp. chili powder
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  can tiny shrimp, drained
1  c. chopped, fully cooked, smoked ham (4 oz.)
2  large bell peppers
preparation: Mix rice, tomato sauce, water and chili powder in 1-quart microwavable casserole.  Cover tightly and microwave on High for 5 minutes.  Stir in shrimp and ham.  Cut bell peppers in half lengthwise.  Remove seeds and membranes; rinse.  Arrange peppers, cut sides up, in circle on 9 or 10-inch pie plate.  Fill each pepper with about 1 cup mixture.  Cover and microwave on High 7 to 9 minutes or until filling is hot in center.

name: KRINGLA(This is a Norwegian cookie.)
ingredients:
1  c. whipping cream
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. butter, melted
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
4 1/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Whip the whipping cream.  Add (fold) in sour cream.  Let stand.  Beat together the butter, sugar, egg and vanilla.  Add whipping cream and sour cream mixture.  Slowly add remaining ingredients.  The dough will be very soft!  Chill dough overnight before forming cookies.

name: SHRIMP COCKTAIL DIP
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. chili sauce
grated onion to taste
3  dashes Tabasco sauce
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper to taste
1  can drained small or broken shrimp
preparation: Mix all ingredients; chill.  Serve with potato chips or crackers.

name: LAZY MAN'S CHILI BEANS
ingredients:
4  cloves garlic
2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. sugar
10  oz. can Spanish chili
4  slices bacon, diced
2  large onions, sliced 1/8 inch thick
2 (No. 2)  cans red kidney beans
1  c. water
preparation: Mash garlic, salt and sugar to a paste.  Blend into chili. Fry bacon until golden; add onion and cook until soft and transparent.  Stir in kidney beans, water and chili mixture; simmer 20 to 30 minutes.  May be made day or so before and reheated.  Makes 8 servings.

name: SMALL TARTS
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
2-inch tart shells
1  can cherry pie filling
Keebler vanilla wafers
preparation: Mix cream cheese, sugar, lemon and vanilla.  Add eggs.  In each tart shell, place vanilla wafers and top with 1 tablespoon of cream cheese mixture.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Cool, then top with cherry filling.

name: CHERRY TORTE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. butter
1  c. walnuts, chopped
1/2  c. white sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
1  c. powdered sugar
2  cans cherry pie filling
preparation: Mix flour, butter, nuts and white sugar.  Press in 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Cool, crumble and pat in pan.

name: SNAPPY BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. baby lima beans (frozen)
1 (8 oz.)  can red kidney beans
1 (16 oz.)  can yellow wax beans
1/2  small onion, sliced in thin rings
1/4  c. finely chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. olive oil
3  Tbsp. white wine vinegar
3  pkg. Equal sweetener
freshly ground black pepper
preparation: Cook lima beans in small amount of water or steam them; cool. Drain  and	rinse  kidney  and  yellow  beans.  Mix all beans, onions and green pepper in bowl.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  bunch broccoli, cut up
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. olives (green or ripe)
4  eggs, hard-boiled
salt and pepper
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. mayonnaise, mixed with Italian creamy dressing
preparation: Mix mayo mixture with lemon juice.  Pour over broccoli; toss lightly and serve.

name: LEMON DELITE
ingredients:
2  c. flour, sifted
2  blocks butter or margarine
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Mix ingredients together and press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Cool.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1 small  can creamed corn
1/2  c. grated onion
3  eggs
1  c. grated cheese
1/4  c. salad oil
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. red pepper or 1 grated jalapeno pepper
1  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Beat together all ingredients.  Pour into greased pan large enough for batter to be thin.  Cook at 350° until brown.

name: FEEDING HERMAN
ingredients:
1  c. or more of starter you have saved
3/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. potato flakes
1  c. warm water
preparation: Mix starter and sugar, potato flakes and water.  Let stand at room temperature 8 to 12 hours or all day . At this point, you use 1 cup to make bread or share it with a friend.  Refrigerate the rest of the mixture 3 to 5 days and make bread anytime by allowing 1 cup to reach room temperature.  You must always keep at least 1 cup of starter and it must be fed at least every 3 to 5 days.

name: PEAR HONEY
ingredients:
6  pears
2  apples
1  orange
3  c. sugar
preparation: Grate the rind of orange.  Peel and core all fruit.  Run all fruit (pears, apples and orange) through a blender until it is of applesauce consistency.  The add grated orange rind.  Cook to near soft ball stage, then can.  Yields approximately 2 pints.

name: BAKED POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
2/3  c. butter
6-7 c. milk
1/2  t. pepper
4  green onions, chopped divided
1 - 8  oz. sour cream
2/3  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  t. salt
12  slices bacon, cooked, crumbled, and divided
1 1/4  c. shredded cheddar cheese, divided
4  baking potatoes
preparation: Wash potatoes and prick several times with a fork; bake at 400 degrees for 1 hour or until done.  Let cool.  Cut potatoes in half length wise; scoop out pulp.  Melt butter in a saucepan over low heat; add flour, stirring until smooth.  Cook 1 min., stirring constantly.  Gradually add 6 c. milk; cook over med. heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened and bubbly.  Add potato pulp, salt, pepper, 2 T. green onions, 1/2 c. bacon, and 1 c. cheese.  Cook until thoroughly heated; stir in sour cream.  Add extra milk, if necessary, for desired thickness.  Serve with remaining onion, bacon, and cheese.

name: PUMPKIN CAKE (IN A JAR)
ingredients:
2/3  c. shortening
2 2/3  c. granulated sugar
4  eggs
2  c. canned pumpkin
2/3  c. water
3 1/3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground cloves
1/2  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Bake in wide-mouth canning jars that have been greased.  Fill jars only half full.

name: PINK PUNCH
ingredients:
6  oz. strawberry Jell-O
2  c. boiling water
2  pkg. strawberry Kool-Aid
5  c. sugar
4  qt. water
2 (46 oz.)  cans pineapple juice
20  oz. Sprite or 7-Up
1  qt. pineapple sherbet (may omit)
preparation: Dissolve  Jell-O  in  boiling water.  Dissolve Kool-Aid and sugar  in water.  Stir until dissolved.  Add to Jell-O and pineapple juice.  Add sherbet and Sprite just before serving.

name: MR. D.'S MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  slightly beaten egg
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. Heinz 57 sauce
1 1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Shape into a loaf.  Brush the top with sauce.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: HAM AU GRATIN
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. Tabasco
1 1/2  c. diced ham
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
3  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
1 1/2  c. peeled, seeded tomatoes
1  c. Cheddar cheese, cubed
preparation: Mix ham, tomatoes, peppers and cheese.  Put in casserole dish. Make white sauce.  In small saucepan melt butter, stir in flour; slowly add milk and stir.  Add salt, Tabasco and dry mustard.  Pour sauce over ham mixture.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: EASY PIZZA
ingredients:
1  English muffin, split and toasted
4  tsp. pizza sauce
3  Tbsp. cooked lean ground beef
3  Tbsp. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Spread muffin with 2 teaspoons pizza sauce, 1 1/2 tablespoons cooked ground beef and 1  1/2 tablespoons cheese.  Broil until cheese melts.  Serve immediately.

name: PECAN PIE BARS
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1/4  c. margarine or butter, softened
1  egg, beaten
3  eggs
1  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Set aside 2/3 cup yellow cake mix.  Combine remaining cake mix, butter and the beaten egg.  Stir by hand until the mixture is crumbly.  Press the mixture evenly over bottom and one inch up sides of an ungreased pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch).  Bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE AND CHEESE BAKE
ingredients:
1  can pineapple tidbits
1  can mandarin oranges
1 1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
1  c. sugar
5  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. crushed Ritz crackers
1  stick melted margarine
preparation: Drain pineapple and oranges; save juice.  Put pineapple, oranges and cheese in mixing dish.  Mix cornstarch and sugar and liquids from fruit in a saucepan.  Cook until thickened and pour over pineapple mixture.  Sprinkle crushed crackers over top.  Pour melted butter over all.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  to 8 pork chops
5  medium potatoes
1  can cream of mushroom soup
salt and pepper
preparation: Grease a large baking dish.  Layer pork chops, sliced potatoes and mushroom soup.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

name: BASIC RICE
ingredients:
2  c. rice
2 1/2  c. chicken stock
1 1/2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1 1/2  Tbsp. finely chopped celery
green bell peppers (optional)
1 1/2  Tbsp. butter
salt to taste
preparation: Use loaf pan.  Combine all the stuff; cover with foil.  Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350°.

name: MISSISSIPPI MUD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. flour
1  c. chopped pecans
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  c. 10x sugar
2  c. whipped topping, whipped
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. instant chocolate or butterscotch pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: Whip pudding and milk until blended.  Pour over cream cheese mixture.  Chill 20 minutes.  Spread on remainder of whipped topping (2 cups whipped).  Chill overnight.

name: TRIPLE FILL CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
6  c. flour
4  Tbsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
2  c. shortening (1/2 butter/1/2 Crisco)
5  egg yolks
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. milk
preparation: ortening as for pie dough.  Beat together last three ingredients, then mix with first mixture.  Divide into 3 parts. Roll out dough layers to fit 11 x 16-inch greased pan.  Arrange as follows:  layer dough, layer nut filling, layer dough, layer apricot filling, layer dough, meringue, sprinkle with nuts.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.  Cool and cut into squares.

name: BUD'S FAVORITE CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1 large  box Velveeta cheese
1 small  box Velveeta cheese
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes with chilies, undrained
1  can Hormel chili without beans
1  lb. Jimmy Dean sausage
preparation: Brown sausage.  While sausage is browning, cube cheese and pour in a large pot or crock-pot on low.  As cheese is melting, add all other ingredients.  After sausage is cooked, drain and add.  Serves an army.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: CRANBERRY MOLD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. red Jell-O
2  c. boiling water
1  c. pineapple juice
1  can whole cranberry sauce
2  c. diced celery or apple or both
2/3  c. coarsely chopped nuts
preparation: Dissolve  Jell-O in boiling water.  Add pineapple juice and cranberries;  stir.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Pour into mold.

name: SCOTTISH SHORTBREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. soft butter
1/4  c. sugar
2  c. Gold Medal flour
preparation: Mix butter and sugar thoroughly.  Work in flour by hand and chill.  Heat oven to 350°.   Roll 1/3 to 1/2-inch thick. Cut into squares or oblongs.  (I prefer to make into a pie shape and cut it into pie slices.)  Place on ungreased baking sheet.*  Bake 20 to 25 minutes.  (The tops do not brown during baking.)  Makes 2 dozen (1 1/2 x 1-inch) cookies.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. melted oleo
1  lb. squash, sliced
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. green pepper, chopped
1/3  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  c. shredded American cheese
preparation: Put squash in buttered casserole.  Mix other ingredients and pour over mixture.  Cover.  Cook at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: SEAFOOD QUICHE
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  beaten eggs
7 1/2  oz. crabmeat, flaked and drained
1  (8 oz.) Swiss cheese
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. white wine
1/3  c. sliced green onion with tops
1/3  c. finely chopped celery
preparation: Mix ingredients well.  Add 3/4 teaspoon curry powder.  Pour into unbaked pastry shell.  Use "Can't Fail Crust" but omit the sugar and add 1 teaspoon oregano leaves.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: MARTILLE'S POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes, peeled and chopped
1/2  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. chopped celery
4  c. milk
1/4  c. butter or margarine, softened
salt and pepper to taste
chopped parsley
preparation: Barely cover potatoes, onion and celery with water.  Cook until tender.  Mash with potato masher.  Add milk, butter, salt and pepper.   Cook until thoroughly heated.  Serve topped with parsley.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 large  can sweet potatoes
3/4  stick oleo
2  eggs
1  c. canned milk
1 1/2  c. sugar
dash of cinnamon
preparation: Warm potatoes; drain juice.  Cream margarine, eggs and sugar. Add milk and cinnamon.  After potatoes warm, add ingredients. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE FONDUE* * * * *
ingredients:
1/4  c. cornstarch
2  c. water
1/2  c. unsweetened cocoa
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mock cream made with 1/2 pound low salt, low-fat cottage cheese and 1 1/2 tablespoons low-fat or skimmed milk.  Blend in blender until the consistency of sour cream.  For thicker cream, use less milk and for recipes calling for light cream, use more milk.

name: VENISON ROAST
ingredients:
venison roast
bacon
1  can golden mushroom soup
1  can onion soup, strained
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Wrap roast with bacon and secure with toothpicks. Put in crock-pot and add all other ingredients. Cook slow in crock-pot until tender.

name: SWISS SCRIPTURE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine (Judges 5:25)
2  c. plain flour (1 Kings 4:22)
1/2  tsp. salt (Leviticus 2:13)
1  c. figs (1 Samuel 30:12)
1 1/2  c. sugar (Jeremiah 6:20)
2  tsp. baking powder (Luke 13:21)
1/2  c. water (Genesis 24:11)
1  c. raisins (1 Samuel 30:12)
3  eggs (Isaiah 10:14)
1  Tbsp. honey (Proverbs 24:13)
1/2  c. almonds (Genesis 43:11)
1/4  tsp. each: cinnamon, mace and cloves (1 Kings 10:10)
preparation: Blend margarine, sugar, salt and spices.  Add beaten egg yolks.  Sift flour and baking powder; beat in.  Mix in water and honey.  Put fruit and nuts through food chopper; coat with flour and beat in.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.  Bake in greased and floured loaf pan at 375° for 1 hour.

name: BEEFARONI SKILLET DINNER
ingredients:
1  lb. ground Beef, browned and drained
1  med. Onion, chopped
1 15  oz. can Pork & Beans
2  c. elbow Macaroni uncooked
1/2  c. Barbeque Sauce
1/4  c. brown Sugar
1  c. Water
preparation: Brown ground beef, drain.  Add chopped onion. Stir well.  Add remaining ingredients.  Stir well.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer until macaroni is tender. Add more water if needed.

name: SIMPLE MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion
1 1/2  c. tomato sauce
1  egg
3  slices loaf bread, crumbled
green pepper (optional)
dash of salt
dash of pepper
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients listed.  Mix thoroughly.  Shape into a loaf in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. (Optional:  Top with ketchup and green pepper for garnish.)  Bake at 350° for approximately 45 minutes.  Do not cover.

name: RAVIOLI PRIMAVERA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (17 oz.)  pkg. fresh or frozen cheese ravioli
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
2 1/2  c. milk
2  c. frozen broccoli cuts, partially thawed
2  green onions, sliced thin
1  small bell pepper, cut into short thin strips
1  tsp. dried basil leaves
1/2  tsp. dried oregano leaves
1/4  tsp. each:  salt and pepper
preparation: Grease a 2-quart baking dish.  Cook ravioli according to package directions.

name: SUMMER DIP
ingredients:
6  oz. cottage cheese
1  c. peeled and diced cucumber
1/4  c. chives
1/4  c. parsley
1  Tbsp. salad burnet
preparation: Chop herbs fine.  Blend all ingredients together and chill. Garnish with nasturtium flowers.  If too thick, add milk.

name: FAMOUS AMOS COOKIES
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. vanilla
1  tsp. water
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2 1/2  c. flour
12  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream margarine, sugars, vanilla, water and eggs.  In small bowl, mix flour, soda and salt.  Add to egg mixture.  Add chocolate chips.  Drop by teaspoons onto lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 8 minutes.

name: APPLE SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box spice cake mix
3  eggs
1  can apple pie filling
cream cheese icing
preparation: Mix dry mix, eggs and apple pie filling until well blended. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 cake pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Add 1/2 teaspoon apple pie spice to your favorite cream cheese icing and frost cooled cake.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
Prepare a 9-inch unbaked pie crust
1  C. sugar
1 1/2  C. milk
2  eggs
1 1/2   tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. each - cloves, ginger and nutmeg
1 sm.  can pumpkin
preparation: Stir sugar, milk, eggs, spices and pumpkin together; mix well.  Pour into pie shell.

name: CORN DOGS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. biscuit mix
1/2  c. corn meal
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  egg, beaten
3/4  c. milk
10  wieners
preparation: In medium bowl, combine biscuit mix, corn meal and sugar. Beat in egg and milk until smooth.  Allow batter to stand at least 30 minutes.  Dip wieners in batter.  Fry in hot oil until brown.

name: SOUTHERN GREEN BEANS(Serves 4)
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans green beans, drained
1  small onion, sliced thin
5  strips bacon, fried crisp
5  Tbsp. brown sugar
5  Tbsp. vinegar
5  Tbsp. bacon drippings
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix brown sugar, vinegar, bacon drippings and salt and pepper to taste.  Arrange green beans and onion in casserole.  Pour mixture over them.  Crumble bacon and sprinkle on top.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Cook 45 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: OLD FASHIONED CHOCOLATE COBBLER
ingredients:
1  cup flour
3/4  cup sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. baking powder*
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  cup milk
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  cup chopped pecans
1  cup brown sugar, packed
1/4  cup cocoa
1  3/4 cups very hot water (hot tap water is ok)
preparation: Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Mix flour, sugar, 2 Tbsp. cocoa, baking powder and salt in ungreased 2 quart pan (9 x 9 inch pan). In a small bowl mix milk, butter and vanilla; add to flour mixture and stir with fork until mixed and smooth.  Stir in nuts and spread the dough evenly in the pan.  Sprinkle with brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa.  Pour hot water over batter;  DO NOT STIR.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. dark corn syrup
2  eggs
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  c. pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix ingredients together, beating in the eggs one at a time. Pour into crust.  Bake 50 minutes at 375° or until firm.  Cool before serving.

name: SHAKER BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. boiling water
6  c. whole bran cereal
3  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
3  c. ground raisins
1  qt. buttermilk
4  eggs
5  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. salt
5  tsp. soda
preparation: Pour boiling  water  over  2  cups  cereal;  set aside. Cream sugar,   shortening,   raisins,  buttermilk  and  eggs together. Fold  flour,  salt,  soda and remaining cereal into creamed mixture.  Add soaked cereal to batter;  mix only until dry ingredients are moistened.  Store in refrigerator.  Do not stir when  ready  to  use.  Spoon  into  greased muffin tins, filling cups  2/3  full.  Bake  at 400° for 20 minutes.  Will keep  in refrigerator  for  4  to  6 weeks.  Yields 1 gallon. Handed down for generations.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. boiled chicken, deboned
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  can chicken soup
36  Ritz crackers
1  stick margarine
preparation: Place chicken into baking dish.  Mix soup and sour cream together and pour over chicken.  Crumble Ritz crackers over mixture.  Melt margarine and pour over chicken and crackers.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until slightly brown.

name: CHICKEN-N-BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. flour
1  pkg. chicken gravy mix
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
4  sliced carrots
2  sliced celery stalks
1 1/2  c. water
6  to 8 chicken pieces, seasoned with salt and pepper
1  can buttermilk biscuits
preparation: You will need 1 large size Reynolds oven cooking bag.

name: HEARTS-A-FIRE CHILI(Kids In The Kitchen)
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1 (28 oz.)  can crushed tomatoes
1  medium size onion, chopped
1  pkg. chili seasoning mix (such as French's Chili-O)
2 (19 oz.)  cans red kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1/2  c. water
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded (optional)
1  c. green pepper, chopped (optional)
2  c. white rice, cooked (optional)
preparation: Brown beef in skillet over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes. Drain excess fat. Add chopped onion. Cook 5 minutes more. Stir in chili mix, tomatoes, water and beans.  Bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for at least 30 minutes. Serve in soup bowls over rice, if desired.  Shredded cheese and chopped pepper can be sprinkled on top.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: JIFFY HAMBURGER SOUP
ingredients:
1  qt. water
5  beef bouillon cubes
1  large onion, diced
3/4  c. celery, diced
1  clove garlic, pressed
1  bay leaf
1/2 to 1  lb. ground round, browned, drained and crumbled
1 large  can tomatoes
vegetables:  carrots, potatoes, etc., cubed
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water.  Add next four ingredients and simmer covered 1/2 hour.  Add remaining ingredients.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Skim off fat.  Serves 8.  Add any leftover vegetables.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage, cooked and drained
1  can mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
4  oz. pimentos
1  bell pepper
1  small onion
1  c. cooked long grain wild rice
1/2  c. celery
1  c. Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix together.  Place in casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PASTA, PEPPER AND BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  lb. linguine, cooked to directions
2  large red peppers
2 medium-sized  bunches broccoli
olive oil
salt
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. sesame oil
3  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1/2  tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
2  Tbsp. sesame seed, toasted
