preparation: Cook linguine.  Cut red peppers into 1/4-inch strips.  Cut broccoli into 2 x 1/2-inch pieces.  In 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat, in 1 tablespoon hot olive oil, cook peppers and 1/4 teaspoon salt until tender-crisp.  Remove peppers to bowl.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  can shrimp, drained and chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  bunch scallions, chopped
1  c. finely chopped celery
lemon juice to taste
dash of salt
dash of cayenne pepper
chopped parsley
preparation: Combine all ingredients  (will be very thick).  Refrigerate until ready to  use.  Serve  with crackers.  Makes 2 1/2 cups.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening (may be part butter)
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1  egg
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. white sugar
1 1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.   Grease cookie sheet.  Mix first 5 ingredients well. Sift dry ingredients and add to first mixture. Roll into 1 1/4-inch balls.  Flatten with fork dipped in flour. Bake on cookie sheet at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Yields 3 dozen.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  qt. cooked squash, drained
1  tube Ritz crackers, crushed
1  large onion, chopped
1  egg
2  c. mild Cheddar cheese, grated
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. Tabasco sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake in a large casserole dish for 1 hour at 375°.

name: 6 MINUTE BROCCOLI SOUFFLE
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. condensed cream of chicken soup
1/3  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1/4  c. broccoli, cooked and finely chopped
2  egg yolks
2  egg whites, stiffly beaten
preparation: Heat the soup and cheese until it melts.  Stir in broccoli and egg yolks.  Cool slightly.  Fold in egg whites.  Put mix in 2-cup oven dish.  Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Serve at once.

name: Bully Pudding
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  beaten eggs
1  c. milk
1 heaping  Tbsp. flour
1  c. nut meats
1  c. dates
preparation: Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

name: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
1  very small green pepper
1/2  onion, finely chopped
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  c. milk
2  c. corn
1  egg yolk
1/2  c. dried bread cubes
2/3  c. buttered cracker crumbs
preparation: Cook pepper, onion and butter until soft.  Stir often.  Add flour, mixed with seasonings and stir until well blended.  Add milk gradually, stirring constantly; bring to boil and add corn, egg yolk and bread cubes.  Turn into buttered casserole; cover with cracker crumbs and bake at 400° for 1/2 hour or until crumbs are browned.

name: MOCK SPICED APPLE RINGS(Relish)
ingredients:
large cucumbers or zucchini
1  c. lime
4 1/2  qt. water
1/2  c. vinegar
1 1/2  tsp. alum
1  tsp. red food coloring
2  c. vinegar
2  c. water
7  c. sugar (I use 5 c.)
1  c. red hots
4  cinnamon sticks
preparation: Use large cucumbers or zucchini that will fit through neck of canning jars after sliced.  (I use wide mouth jars.) Peel, slice 3/8-inch thick and remove seed centers to make rings.  Mix lime to 4 1/2 quarts water.  Pour over veggie rings; soak for 24 hours. Rinse well and soak in clear water for 3 hours.  Then drain.  Mix 1/2 cup vinegar, alum and red food coloring.  Add this with enough water to cover.  Simmer 2 hours.  Drain well.

name: BEEF IN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  tsp. salt
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  cloves garlic
2  c. cooked rice
1  c. sour cream
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
6  green onions, chopped
1  c. grated American cheese
preparation: Cook first 5 ingredients together in skillet over low heat until done.  Combine rice, sour cream, cream cheese and onions.

name: "EAT ALL YOU WANT" LO-CAL SOUP
ingredients:
4 to 6  c. water
1  c. onions
2  c. yellow squash
1  c. green beans
1  c. tomatoes
2  c. tomato sauce
1  pkg. dry Lipton onion soup
2 to 3  oz. spaghetti or macaroni
preparation: Boil squash and onions in water for 15 minutes.  Add green beans, tomatoes, tomato sauce, soup mix and spaghetti.  Simmer about 20 to 30 minutes.  Deliciously low calorie and low-fat.  (You may add other lo-cal vegetables as desired:  carrots, celery, cabbage, okra, etc.)

name: NAVY BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1  pkg. navy beans
2  to 3 chopped onions
2  to 3 sliced celery stalks
salt, sage, oregano, celery seed, soy sauce (season with)
preparation: Cook 1 cup presoaked navy beans with the onions until tender. Saute the celery for 5 minutes, then add.  Season with spices, being careful to let the bean and onion flavor predominate. Garnish with parsley or green onions.

name: MAGIC COOKIE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine or butter, melted
1 1/2  c. crushed graham crackers
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1 (5 oz.)  pkg. coconut
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Pour each ingredient in layers in a 13 x 9-inch pan.   Pat down gently by hand.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cool thoroughly.  Cut into squares.  Eat and enjoy.

name: FAT FREE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. unsweetened cocoa
1/4  c. cornstarch
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  c. water
3  egg whites
1/2  c. Karo corn syrup (light or dark)
preparation: Spray 9-inch square baking pan with cooking spray.  In large bowl combine flour, cocoa, cornstarch, powder, soda and salt.  In medium bowl using a wire whisk or fork thoroughly mix sugar and water.  Whisk in egg whites and corn syrup.  Gradually stir into dry ingredients until smooth.  Pour into pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until toothpick in center comes out clean.  Cool in pan on wire rack.

name: PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. alum (found in spice section of grocery store)
1 1/2  c. water
1/2  c. salt
1  Tbsp. oil
food coloring
preparation: Mix flour and alum together.  In saucepan heat water, oil and food coloring to boil.  Stir liquids into dry ingredients.  Knead until smooth.  Store in airtight container.

name: APPLES IN IRISH MIST
ingredients:
8  eating apples such as Golden Delicious
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
3  Tbsp. Irish Mist liqueur
12  slices good quality white bread, crusts removed
2  oz. (55 g/1/2 stick) butter (preferably unsalted)
1/2  tsp. freshly grated nutmeg or cinnamon or mixed spice
7  oz. (200 g/1 1/4 c.) plump raisins or sultanas
4  large eggs (preferably free-range), beaten lightly
8 fluid  oz. (225 ml/1 c.) milk
16 fluid  oz. (475 ml/2 c.) cream
1  tsp. pure vanilla essence
6  oz. (170 g/3/4 c.) castor sugar
pinch of salt
1  Tbsp. (1 American Tbsp. + 1 tsp.) granulated sugar for sprinkling on top
softly whipped cream (garnish)
preparation: You will need pottery or China dish, 8-inches (20.5 cm) square.

name: TURKEY BURGERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey
1/4  c. oat bran
1  large minced garlic clove
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1/8  c. finely chopped green pepper
1  tsp. salt or sodium alternative
preparation: Mix together and form into patties.  Broil or grill them.

name: STRAWBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. cinnamon
2 (10 oz.)  boxes frozen strawberries
4  eggs
1/3  c. applesauce
preparation: Grease and flour 2 loaf pans.  Mix dry ingredients and make a well in the center.  Aside, combine strawberries, 4 eggs well beaten and applesauce.  Pour liquid mixture into well and mix slowly until well blended.  Bake for 1 hour at 325°.  Makes 2 loaves.

name: LEE'S FAMOUS PINA COLADA MUFFINS(30 Muffins)
ingredients:
1 (1 lb. 2 oz.)  box yellow cake mix
1  tsp. coconut extract
1  tsp. rum extract
1  c. flaked or shredded coconut
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1  c. crushed pineapple
preparation: Prepare cake mix in a mixer bowl, following package directions. Add other ingredients; mix 1 minute. Do not overmix. Grease tins or line with paper cups. Fill 3/4 full. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. cooked rice
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. margarine
2  tsp. vanilla
3  beaten eggs
5  c. milk
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  c. raisins
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
preparation: Mix together.  Bake at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes.  Sprinkle a little nutmeg and cinnamon on top.

name: ORANGE FROST
ingredients:
1/2  c. orange sherbet
1/2  c. orange soda
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
3  Tbsp. nondairy whipped cream
preparation: Pour the first 4 ingredients into a blender and blend.  Pour into a glass and top with the whipped cream.

name: SPANISH RICE WITH BEEF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  c. chopped onion
10  oz. frozen corn
12  oz. thick style spaghetti sauce
1  c. water
chopped black olives
1 1/2  c. quick cook rice
preparation: Brown meat with spices and onion.   Add everything else but rice and bring to a boil.   Stir in rice; cover and remove from heat.   Let stand for 10 minutes.    Serves 6 to 8.

name: TERMITE LODGE VENISON MARINADE
ingredients:
1/4  c. olive oil
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. freshly ground black pepper
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/3  c. steak sauce
1  Tbsp. gravy coloring
1  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1/2  can beer
1  shot whiskey
preparation: Combine ingredients in a mixing bowl and stir well.  Pour over venison steaks or chops in a large bowl and marinate for a few hours in a refrigerator.  Marinade also can be brushed on while grilling.

name: HARD CANDY
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. light Karo syrup
1  c. water
preparation: Boil to hard ball stage.  Add coloring and flavor.  Sprinkle powdered sugar on buttered pan.

name: FLOUNDER WITH CRABMEAT STUFFING
ingredients:
flounder
1  lb. crabmeat
1  tube crackers
1  egg
salt and pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  sticks celery
1  chopped bell pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  stick oleo
preparation: Saute onion, celery, bell pepper and garlic salt in oleo.  Add crabmeat, crackers and egg.  Make lengthwise split in one side of flounder.  Stuff with crabmeat mixture.  Bake in 375° oven for 20 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE BREAD
ingredients:
1  loaf Bridgeford bread
2  eggs
1  lb. sausage
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Note:  Bridgeford bread is frozen dough.  Thaw loaf in fridge the night before you plan to make Sausage Bread.

name: SHRIMP MOLD
ingredients:
1 1/2  pkg. unflavored gelatin
3  c. deveined shrimp, boiled
1  can tomato soup
3 small  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
3/4  c. finely chopped celery
1/4  c. finely chopped green onion
salt, pepper and Tabasco sauce to taste
preparation: Heat soup; add cream cheese.  Continue heating until melted. Remove from heat.  Dissolve gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water and combine the gelatin mixture with tomato soup  mixture.  Add remaining ingredients.  Pour into lightly greased ring mold. Chill overnight.  Unmold and serve with Ritz crackers.

name: CHEESE BALL OR CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  stick margarine
1  pkg. chopped dried beef
20  olives, cut up
preparation: Shape into a ball or put into a small bowl.  Will keep for a long period of time in refrigerator.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  bushel tomatoes
3  lb. onions
2  sweet peppers
2  hot peppers
1/2  c. salt
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. oregano
2  tsp. basil
6  bay leaves
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
2  Tbsp. garlic powder
4 (12 oz.) or 8 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
preparation: Cook tomatoes; run through a colander.  Chop peppers and onions; crush spices.  Cook for 1 hour; pour into jars.  Pressure for 10 minutes at 10 pounds pressure.  May also be frozen.

name: CAL'S CHILI
ingredients:
4  lb. chili meat
1/2  c. chili powder
1  button garlic
6  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. black pepper
1  tsp. oregano
dash of sugar
1  tsp. comino
2  qt. water
dash of red pepper
preparation: Brown meat lightly.  Pour off excess fat; add rest of ingredients, then add water.  Mix well.  Simmer for 2 hours.

name: RASPBERRY POPPY SEED DRESSING
ingredients:
1/4  c. raspberry vinegar
1/4  c. fresh raspberries
1  shallot, finely diced
1/2  c. low-fat yogurt
3/4  c. vegetable or canola oil
3  Tbsp. poppy seed
preparation: Whip first four ingredients well.  Add oil in a slow, steady stream while whipping.  Add poppy seed.  Taste to check vinegar to oil ratio.  Add one or the other to desired taste.  Makes about 2 cups.

name: ITALIAN VEGETABLE CROUTON BAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sliced yellow squash
1/2  tsp. Watkins garlic salt
2  c. chopped tomatoes
1/2  tsp. Watkins Italian Blend
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. Watkins Italian pepper
2  c. croutons
2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1/2  c. margarine, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In each of three small mixing bowls, toss sliced squash with garlic salt; stir Italian Blend into tomatoes and toss onion with Italian pepper.  Set these bowls aside.  Spray 3 or 4-quart casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Layer 1 cup croutons, 1 cup squash mixture, 1 cup tomato mixture, 1/2 cup onion mixture and 1 cup Cheddar cheese.  Repeat this process.  Pour melted margarine evenly over top.  Cover and bake for 45 minutes.  Remove cover and bake an additional 10 minutes.  Makes 12 servings.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
2  cans (1 lb. 13 oz.) crushed tomatoes (Italian)
1 (1 lb. 13 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (12 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
mushrooms (if you like)
1  medium onion, finely chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
2  cloves garlic, crushed
dash of salt and pepper
2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/2  tsp. onion powder, garlic powder
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
6  Italian sausage links
preparation: Fry ground beef and cut up Italian sausage into pieces and fry until cooked.  Add to sauce.  Cover and simmer for at least 1 1/2 hours.  Add seasonings.  I season to taste.

name: PINK FLUFF PIE(Yield: 9-Inch Pie)
ingredients:
1  roll refrigerated sliced bake cookies
1  c. heavy cream
2  Tbsp. confectioners sugar
1/2  c. fruit cocktail, drained
1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  tsp. almond flavoring
few drops red food coloring
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°. Lightly grease and sugar bottom of sides of pan with cookie slices overlapping slightly to form a scalloped edge (use about 1/2 roll). Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown; cool.

name: DRIED BEEF DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
4  Tbsp. milk
4  Tbsp. onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
2 (4 oz.)  pkg. dried beef
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into baking dish.  Bake, uncovered, for 1/2 hour.  Serve with crackers.

name: PECAN PIES
ingredients:
5  eggs
1  c. Karo syrup (green label)
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. pecans, chopped finely
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Adding pecans last, pour into pastry shell.  Bake in hot oven at 400° for 15 minutes and reduce heat to 350° and bake 30 minutes longer or until a knife inserted in center of filling comes out clean.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
dash of salt
1  c. milk
1 large  can peaches
preparation: Put butter in long glass pan.  Put in oven and melt.  Mix together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.  Add milk and mix. Put peaches in pan and bring to a boil.  Pour peaches into the glass pan of melted butter.  Pour mixture over peaches.  Bake at 300° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until brown on top.

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  c. hot applesauce
1  c. raisins and nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat together first 6 ingredients.  Mix and beat all remaining ingredients.  Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.

name: HUMMINGBIRD CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. plain flour, sifted
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
3  slightly beaten eggs
1 1/2  c. oil
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  c. finely chopped bananas
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine plain flour, sugar, soda, cinnamon and salt.  Then add but do not beat, slightly beaten eggs, oil and vanilla.  Stir in pineapple, bananas and nuts.  Stir well.  Do not use mixer.  Bake in 3 x 9-inch greased cake pans at 350° for 25 minutes.  Cool thoroughly and ice with caramel icing.

name: APPLESAUCE SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. orange
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry Jell-O
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon Jell-O
29  oz. applesauce
preparation: Bring applesauce to a boil.  Add both packs of Jell-O.  Stir until dissolved.  Add orange juice.  Stir.  Refrigerate to gel.

name: FRIENDSHIP TEA
ingredients:
1  c. lemonade mix
2  c. Tang
1  c. instant tea
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix well. To serve, mix 2 teaspoons into a cup of boiling water.

name: AVOCADO AND CRAB SALAD
ingredients:
1  envelope Knox gelatine
3/4  c. water
1  c. mashed avocado
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. Tabasco
preparation: Sprinkle gelatine with water and place over low heat until clear.  Chill to unbeaten egg white consistency.  Mash avocado and blend in other ingredients. Stir in gelatin and chill.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1 1/4  c. powdered sugar
1  c. white Karo syrup
1 1/4  c. powdered milk
preparation: Mix thoroughly.  Knead and spread on greased platter.  Cut into pieces.

name: MICKEY'S CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. diced, cooked chicken
1  c. chicken gravy (leftover or canned)
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. cooked macaroni
1  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix chicken, gravy, green pepper, salt and pepper in a large bowl. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Arrange the macaroni on top of the chicken mixture.  Dot with little pieces of the butter and sprinkle with the cheese. Cover and bake for 20 minutes.  Uncover and bake for an additional 10 minutes.

name: BROWNIE CHEESECAKE BARS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
2/3  c. butter or margarine, melted
2/3  c. Hershey's cocoa
3  eggs, divided
1/2  c. milk
3  tsp. vanilla extract, divided
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  In mixer bowl, beat flour, sugar, melted butter, cocoa, 2 eggs, milk, 2 teaspoons vanilla and baking powder until well blended.  Stir in nuts.  Spread into pan.

name: OLD FASHIONED COCONUT POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  sticks margarine or butter (1 c. plus 4 Tbsp.)
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
3  c. plain flour
8  oz. sour cream
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pkg. frozen coconut
preparation: Defrost coconut.  Eggs and butter should be at room temperature.  Preheat oven to 300°.  Spray pan with oil spray. Cream the butter and sugar together well. Add eggs, one at a time, and mix well. Add flour, salt, soda, sour cream and vanilla. Blend.  Stir in coconut.  Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done.

name: FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
3  c. tea
juice of 6 lemons
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  c. water
juice of 4 oranges
2  c. grape juice
6  c. ice water
1  c. pineapple juice
1  c. blackberry juice
1  c. raspberry juice
preparation: Make a syrup by combining water and sugar.  Boil 5 minutes; cool.  Combine thick syrup, fruit juices and ice water.  Pour over ice.  Garnish with mint leaves and slices of oranges and lemons. Yields 30 servings.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. Americana tapioca pudding mix (not instant)
2  cans chunk pineapple (in own juice)
2  cans mandarin oranges
1  jar maraschino cherries
3  to 4 bananas
preparation: Cook both tapioca pudding mixes using juice drained off pineapple and oranges, adding enough orange juice to equal 4 cups. Let cool.  Add fruit to pudding and refrigerate.

name: Spanish Rice
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (1 1/4 oz.)  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1 1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. thinly sliced zucchini
1  c. frozen corn
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1 1/2  c. instant rice
preparation: In a large skillet, saute the onion.  Stir in the remaining ingredients except the rice; bring to a boil.  Stir in the rice. Reduce the heat to low; cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes or until liquid is absorbed; stir occasionally.  Remove from heat.  Fluff mixture with a fork.  Garnish with cilantro and cherry tomatoes, if desired.  Makes 6 (1 cup) servings.

name: MEXICAN RICE
ingredients:
1/4  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. rice, rinsed
1/4  c. tomato sauce
diced onion
salt to taste
3  c. chicken broth
preparation: Melt shortening in skillet; add onion and rice until rice turns a pink color (about 5 minutes).  Add chicken broth and tomato sauce.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 25 minutes with a lid on skillet.

name: YUM YUM CABBAGE
ingredients:
2  lb. cabbage, partly cooked and drained
1  c. cooked rice
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  medium green pepper
1  large onion
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1 small  can tomato paste
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. mustard
1/4  c. vinegar
preparation: Saute ground beef, chopped pepper and chopped onion.  Add rice.  In baking dish, add 1/2 of meat and rice mixture.  Next, layer 1/2 of cabbage, then layer 1 can of soup undiluted.  Repeat with balance of meat/rice mixture, cabbage and soup.  Blend last 4 ingredients, making a sweet and sour sauce.  Spread over top. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

name: PEACH FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  Tbsp. water
1 (29 oz.)  can sliced peaches, drained
12  slices French bread
5  eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: In a saucepan, bring brown sugar, butter and water to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring frequently.  Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Top with peaches.  Whisk eggs, milk and vanilla.  Slowly pour over bread slices placed over peaches.  Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.  Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before baking.  Sprinkle with cinnamon. Cover and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Uncover and bake 25 to 30 minutes longer or until bread is golden brown.

name: CHOCOLATE SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. water
1/2  c. oil
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  stick butter
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift together sugar, flour and cinnamon.  In saucepan, put oil, water, butter and cocoa and bring to a boil.  Pour over dry ingredients and mix well.  Mix together eggs, vanilla and buttermilk and add to batter.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased sheet pan and bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

name: GELATIN COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. Shortening
1/2  c. Sugar
1  pkg. (3 oz.) Strawberry or lime Jello
2  Eggs
1  tsp. Vanilla
2 1/2  c. Flour
1  tsp. Baking Powder
1  tsp. Salt
preparation: Combine shortening, sugar, gelatin, eggs and vanilla.  Mix thoroughly.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Roll in balls; place 2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet.  Dip the bottom of a glass jar in sugar and flatten each cookie.  Bake at 400° for 5 to 6 minutes.

name: Pasta Salad For A Crowd
ingredients:
5  lb. spiral noodles *
1/2  lb. carrots, thin sliced
1  bunch broccoli, bite-size pieces
3  cucumbers, sliced
2  onions, chopped
4  c. oil
1  c. sugar
1  cauliflower (bite-size)
1  qt. plus 1 c. mayonnaise
4  c. water
4  c. vinegar
Italian seasoning to taste
garlic salt to taste
salt to taste
pepper to taste
preparation: *Colored noodles are good in this.

name: COOL WHIP JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1 small  pkg. Jell-O
1  container creamed cottage cheese
1  large tub Cool Whip
preparation: Heat pineapple; add Jell-O and dissolve.  Add creamed cottage cheese.  When it jells, add the Cool Whip.  Refrigerate.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIPPERS
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. quick oatmeal
2  c. flour
1/2  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. walnuts, chopped
1  c. corn flakes
preparation: Cream sugars, shortening and eggs.  Add vanilla and mix in. Sift together and add flour, baking powder and salt.  Mix well and add chips, nuts, corn flakes and oatmeal.  Drop by tablespoonfuls on cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Makes 7 dozen crunchy chocolate chip cookies.

name: CRANBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. chopped nuts
rind of 2 oranges
1  tsp. soda
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
3/4  c. cooking oil
1  c. diced dates
1  c. cranberries, cut in half
1  c. sugar
juice of 2 oranges
water
preparation: Cook over medium heat, sugar and juice of 2 oranges, adding water to make 1 cup.  Bring to a boil.  Brush over cake and let soak in.  Refrigerate 3 days.  Is also good to eat hot.

name: PLANTATION SUPPER
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. milk
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. whole kernel corn
1/4  c. chopped pimento
8  oz. cooked noodles
1 1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Brown meat; add onion and cook until tender.  Stir in milk, soup and cheese until well blended.  Add remaining ingredients and heat.  Corn should be drained.

name: CHRISTMAS COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. light brown sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. buttermilk
2  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1  c. nuts, chopped
1  c. dates, chopped
1  c. candied cherries, chopped
preparation: Cream together shortening and sugar.  Add egg.  Blend together.  Sift together dry ingredients and add alternately to creamed mixture with buttermilk.  Stir in by hands nuts, dates and cherries.  Chill dough 2 to 3 hours or may be chilled overnight. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: SOUR CREAM COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  stick butter
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Preheat the oven at 350°.  Mix all ingredients together. Grease the pan.  Let cake bake for 45 minutes, then let it cool off.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
3/4  c. ketchup
3/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  tsp. chili powder
pepper
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. paprika
preparation: Mix together.  Great with country style ribs.

name: MOLASSES SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1/4  c. molasses
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. sugar
1  egg
2  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt shortening in 3 or 4-quart saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat; let cool.  Add sugar, molasses and egg; beat well.  Sift together flour, soda, cloves, ginger, salt and cinnamon.  Add to first mixture.  Mix well and chill.  Form in inch balls.  Roll in granulated sugar and place on greased cookie sheets 2 inches apart.  Bake in moderately hot oven, 375° 8 to 10 minutes.

name: CORN BREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  pan yellow corn bread, cooked
5 to 6  slices dried bread
2  cans chicken broth
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  onion, chopped
2  to 3 boiled eggs, chopped
1 to 2  tsp. sage
1  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Crumble corn bread and dried bread in a large mixing bowl. Add chicken broth and cream of chicken soup. Stir thoroughly. Add in chopped onions and boiled eggs. Mix again, then add sage and black pepper. Taste; you might need to add more sage. If dressing is too dry, add more broth. Bake in 350° oven until golden brown.

name: BEET RELISH
ingredients:
2  c. beets, cooked and coarsely shredded
2  small onions, finely grated
2  Tbsp. wine vinegar
2  tsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. horseradish mustard
2  Tbsp. fine olive oil or canola
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Stir well and cover.  Place in fridge overnight before serving to fully blend flavors.  Keeps in fridge up to a week.  Makes 2 cups.

name: CHICKEN BANANA CURRY FROM SOUTH AFRICA
ingredients:
2  oz. butter or margarine
2  to 4 bananas, mashed
1/4  pt. cream
1  large onion, grated
approximately 2 Tbsp. curry powder
sugar and salt to taste
2  to 4 tomatoes, peeled and seeded
1  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
1  c. chicken stock
juice of 1 lemon
2  Tbsp. tomato juice (optional)
2  c. cut up cooked chicken
preparation: Grate onion; saute in butter.  Add curry and fry 1 minute. Add mashed bananas, tomatoes, sugar and salt and cook.  Stir in flour and slowly add chicken stock, milk and cream, stirring constantly until thick.  Add lemon and tomato juice.  Fold in 2 cups cooked chicken chunks and heat thoroughly.  Serve with white rice and buttered thin bread slices.  Unusual and delicious dish.

name: TERIYAKI CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/4  c. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. water
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
4  skinless chicken breasts
preparation: Marinate chicken for at least 3 hours.  Remove chicken; reserve marinade.  Grill chicken or bake at 350°.  Baste often with marinade.  Makes 4 servings.  Each serving contains 151 calories and 3 g fat.

name: KIT KAT BARS
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. margarine
1/3  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. milk
25  Club crackers (Waverly)
1/2  c. chocolate chips
1/2  c. butterscotch chips
2/3  c. peanut butter
preparation: Mix crumbs, margarine, sugars and milk together in pan.  Bring to boil; boil 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Put 1 layer of crackers in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pour 1/2 of the boiled mixture on top.  Put a second layer of crackers and top with remaining boiled mixture.  Top with 1 more layer of crackers.  Melt together the chips and peanut butter.  Spread over top of crackers. Cool and cut.

name: HOLIDAY MASHED POTATOES
ingredients:
8  lb. baking potatoes, peeled and cut in eighths
1  can (14 1/2 oz.) chicken broth
1/2  c. softened butter or margarine
1  c. light sour cream
1  tsp. poultry seasoning
paprika
salt
preparation: Butter a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, set aside.  Combine potatoes, 1 teaspoon salt and water to cover in large Dutch oven. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 17 minutes.  Drain.  Return potatoes to pot with broth, butter, sour cream, poultry seasoning and two teaspoons of salt.  Beat with hand held mixer or potato masher until smooth.  Spread potatoes in baking dish and sprinkle with paprika.  Cover and refrigerate up to two hours.  Bake in preheated 350° oven until puffed and heated through.  Makes 16 cups.  A 3/4 cup serving is 165 calories.

name: STUFFED CHILE PEPPERS
ingredients:
long peppers as desired
2  lb. Monterey Jack cheese (thick slices)
5  egg whites
5  egg yolks
2  large onions
3  large tomatoes
preparation: Roast peppers on a skillet until well toasted.  Let them cool. Peel the crust off peppers; cut a slice off top of each pepper and scoop out insides.  Fill with slices of cheese, tomatoes and onions.  Whip up egg whites well, then add egg yolks and whip until foams up.  Dip stuffed chile peppers in the eggs and fry in a large frying pan in heated oil until slightly brown.

name: JELLO POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. hot water
1 small  pkg. lemon jello
1  yellow cake mix
3/4  c. Wesson oil
4  eggs, beaten (add eggs one at a time)
1  Tbsp. lemon flavoring
preparation: Mix together hot water, jello and cake mix and let cool. Then add oil, eggs and lemon flavoring.  Bake in cake pan or loaf pans at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: HERSHEY BAR PIE
ingredients:
6  small Hershey bars with almonds (or plain)
16  marshmallows
1/2  c. milk
1  c. whipping cream
graham cracker crust
preparation: Heat chocolate bars, marshmallows and milk in a double boiler until chocolate and marshmallows are melted.  Cool thoroughly.

name: SWEET MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  egg
1/2  c milk
1/4  c vegetable oil
1  1/2 c all purpose flour
1/2  c sugar
2  tsp baking powder
1/2  tsp salt
preparation: Heat oven to 400°. Grease bottom of muffin cups or use paper muffin cups. Beat egg with fork. Stir in milk and oil. Blend dry ingredients; stir in egg mixture just until flour is moistened. Batter should be lumpy. Do not over mix. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown. Muffins will have gently rounded and pebbled tops. Makes 12 medium muffins.

name: CARAMEL HEATH BAR CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
55  vanilla wafers, crushed
2  Tablespoons of sugar
1/3  cup of melted butter
preparation: Mix all,  press into 9 inch spring form pan, covering bottom and one inch up sides.  Refrigerate 30 minutes.

name: VEAL PARMIGIANA
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter, melted
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. onion salt
8  slices Mozzarella cheese
2  lb. veal cutlet or tenderized steak, cut in 8 pieces
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1  tsp. sugar
1  c. crushed cornflakes or crackers
2  eggs, slightly beaten
preparation: Melt butter in 13 x 9-inch pan. Blend salt, pepper, crumbs and Parmesan cheese.  Dip meat in eggs and then in crumbs twice. Place meat in buttered pan.  Cook 20 minutes in 400° oven; turn and bake 20 minutes on the other side.

name: EASY CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
3  boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1/2-inch cubes *
1 (19 oz.)  can enchilada sauce
1  can (4.5 oz.) chopped green chilies
8  corn tortillas
3  c. (12 oz.) Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
preparation: Combine chicken and 1/2 cup enchilada sauce; cook until chicken is done.  Stir in green chiles.  In a separate skillet bring remaining enchilada sauce to a boil and remove from heat, dip each tortilla into heated sauce to soften.  Spoon 2 tablespoons chicken and 1/4 cup cheese down center of tortilla. Roll, place tortillas, seam-side down in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish.  Pour remaining enchilada sauce over top and sprinkle with remaining cup of cheese.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.  Makes 4 servings.

name: MIMERE'S BANANA TOAST
ingredients:
4  slices bread
2  bananas, sliced
4  tsp. brown sugar
preparation: Place banana slice on bread.   Sprinkle with brown sugar. Place in toaster oven and toast to desired brownness.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  can (large size) crushed pineapple
yellow cake mix
2  sticks butter
1  c. nuts
Cool Whip
preparation: Spread pie filling over bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Spread undrained pineapple over pie filling.  Crumble cake mix over pineapple.  Pour melted butter over cake mix.  Place chopped nuts on butter.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.   Top with Cool Whip when serving.

name: GREEK CHEESE AND SPINACH SQUARES
ingredients:
2  to 3 eggs
6  Tbsp. whole wheat flour
1  lb. (2 c.) cottage cheese
1/2  lb. (2 c.) grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. salt
1  lb. fresh spinach (simply tear up)
3  Tbsp. wheat germ
preparation: Beat eggs, whole wheat flour, cottage cheese, Cheddar cheese and salt in large bowl until smooth.  Add fresh spinach.

name: FRUIT CAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. pecans
1  lb. chopped dates
1  lb. candied cherries
1  lb. mixed fruit
1/2  c. flour
1  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda, salt and cinnamon (each)
preparation: Mix first 4  ingredients together.  Sprinkle flour over fruit and mix.  Set aside.  Cream  butter and sugar.  Add 1 at a time the eggs.  Add flour, soda, salt and cinnamon.  Combine batter with fruit and pecans.  Mix well.

name: RAISIN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. milk
3  Tbsp. margarine
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  yeast cakes
4 1/2  c. flour
1  c. raisins
1  c. walnut pieces
preparation: Heat milk to warm.  Add shortening, sugar and salt.  Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup lukewarm water and add to mixture when it is cooled to 125°.  Add 2 cups flour and beat until smooth.  Cover and let rise for 1 hour.  Add raisins and nuts and enough flour to make firm dough.  Knead thoroughly and shape into loaf.  Place in greased loaf pan and let rise until doubled.  Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CORDON BLEU
ingredients:
6  medium whole chicken breasts, skinned and boned
1  (8 oz.)  Swiss cheese slices
1  (8 oz.) sliced cooked ham
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. paprika
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. dry white wine
1  tsp. chicken stock base
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. heavy cream
preparation: Spread chicken breasts flat; fold cheese and ham slices to fit on top; fold breasts over filling and fasten edges with toothpicks.  On waxed paper, mix flour and paprika; use mixture to coat chicken pieces.  In a 12-inch skillet over medium heat, in hot butter or margarine, cook chicken until browned on all sides. Add wine and bouillon.  Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 30 minutes or until fork-tender.  Remove the toothpicks.

name: PINEAPPLE-RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice
1 small  can crushed pineapple (8 oz.)
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. milk
1/4  lb. butter
preparation: Boil rice in about 1-quart salted water until soft (about 20 to 25 minutes).  Strain in colander and cool off with cold water. Place rice in mixing bowl and add sugar, egg yolks, salt, butter, vanilla, milk and crushed pineapple.  Fold in egg whites which have been beaten stiffly.  Pour into greased baking dish and bake at 350° for about 45 to 50 minutes, until golden brown.

name: DIRTY BIRD CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. bananas, cut up
1 1/4  c. salad oil
1/2  c. nuts, chopped (optional)
3  slightly beaten eggs
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple and juice
preparation: Blend well; do not beat.  Pour into Bundt pan that has been sprayed with Pam.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: POTATO PANCAKES
ingredients:
3  medium raw potatoes
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. cream
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Grate potatoes.  Add other ingredients.  Stir well.  Cook by spoonfuls in heavy skillet (iron) until brown.  Use olive oil or vegetable oil.

name: WELSH COOKIES
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. nutmeg
3  tsp. baking powder
1  c. Crisco
3/4 to 1  c. currants
2  eggs, beaten
not quite 1/2 c. milk
preparation: Combine dry ingredients.  Cut shortening into mixture as for pie dough.  Add currants and mix.  Add beaten eggs and milk and mix thoroughly.  Roll out on floured cloth until 1/4 inch thickness and cut with rounded glass or cookie cutter dipped in flour.  Fry in Teflon or ungreased griddle until golden brown on both sides.  When cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar.  Store in tight container.

name: BAKED ONIONS
ingredients:
2  large Vidalia onions
Parmesan cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Peel onions and cut in half.  Pour mushroom soup over onions and sprinkle liberally with Parmesan cheese.  Cover and bake at 325° to 350° until tender.

name: TANG SALAD
ingredients:
1  can chunk pineapple, drained (reserve juice)
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
1  can chunky mixed fruit, drained
1  can pear halves, drained and cut up
2  apples, chopped
2  bananas, chopped
3  Tbsp. Tang (regular, not sugar-free)
1 small  box vanilla instant pudding
preparation: Make dressing for salad using reserved pineapple juice; dissolve Tang in juice.  Add instant pudding to juice.  Stir until smooth.  Mix fruits in bowl; add dressing and stir well. Refrigerate.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1  large onion
1  bell pepper
2  to 3 green onions (optional)
2  to 3 jalapeno peppers (optional)
2 to 3  cloves garlic, diced
1 (16 oz.)  can pinto beans (optional)
1 (16 oz.)  can light red kidney beans (optional)
1  (16 oz.) diced tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  lb. kielbasa or Italian sausage
1 1/2 to 2  lb. marinated, browned beef tips (reference other recipe)
hot sauce (optional)
chili seasoning
salt and pepper
preparation: Sweat chopped onions, peppers and garlic. Combine beans (optional), diced tomatoes and tomato sauce. Cook over medium-high heat until it begins to boil, then reduce to lowest heat and simmer. Add sweated vegetables and chili seasoning. Brown kielbasa or Italian sausage, cut into 1-inch cubes, then add to chili. Deglaze sauté pan and add to chili. Add marinated, browned beef tips with sauce (reference other recipe). Simmer over low heat for 1 hour. Add salt and pepper to taste. If necessary, thicken with cornstarch.

name: SCALLOPED ASPARAGUS
ingredients:
1  bunch (2 1/2 lb.) asparagus
salt
6  Tbsp. butter
3/4  c. soft bread crumbs
1/4  c. flour
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. paprika
2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. steak sauce
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. sliced stuffed olives
preparation: Cook asparagus in boiling salted water by any preferred method.  Put in shallow 2-quart baking dish. Melt butter in saucepan and mix 2 tablespoons of crumbs.  Set aside.

name: CORN BREAD MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1  c. bread flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. melted butter or fat
2  well beaten eggs
preparation: Sift dry ingredients.  Beat in separate bowl the milk, shortening and egg; add to dry ingredients.  Beat lightly until thoroughly mixed.  Partly fill hot muffin tins.  Bake in quick oven (450°) for 15 to 20 minutes.  Yields 2 1/2 dozen small muffins.

name: TACO PUFFS
ingredients:
1/4  lb. mild pork sausage
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
3  Tbsp. mild taco sauce
3/4  c. Bisquick mix
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  In skillet, brown and crumble sausage. Remove from heat; allow to cool a few minutes.  Remove excess fat. In mixing bowl, combine sausage and remaining ingredients.  Form into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.  Place on ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until puffs are lightly browned.  Makes 24 puffs.

name: EASY LINGUINI AND CLAM SAUCE
ingredients:
1  pkg. linguini
1/2  onion
2  cloves garlic
basil to taste
1  can mushroom soup
1  can diced clams
1  Tbsp. olive oil
preparation: Begin cooking pasta according to directions on package.  Saute onion and garlic in olive oil.  Add mushroom soup and undrained can of clams as well as basil, salt and pepper to taste.  Serve over cooked pasta.

name: MINI PIZZAS
ingredients:
can biscuits, pie crust or English muffins
pizza
cheese
preparation: Flatten out a biscuit. Spread with pizza sauce.  Sprinkle with cheese on top.  You can also top with your other favorite toppings.  Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes (until biscuit is done).

name: YEAST ROLLS(Makes 36 Rolls)
ingredients:
1  c. milk, scalded
1/2  c. shortening
3  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  pkg. yeast to 1/4 c. warm water
4  c. flour
preparation: Scald 1 cup milk.  Add shortening.  Cool.  Beat eggs and 1/2 cup sugar. Add salt, cool milk and shortening.  Add yeast dissolved in water.  Stir in flour.  Let rise for 4 hours. Refrigerate, then divide into 3 balls.  Spread soft butter on it. Cut into 12 wedges.  Roll each roll out side edge into point. Place on a cookie sheet.  Let rise for 4 hours.  Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: HAMBURG LOAF
ingredients:
4  potatoes, sliced thin
3  onions, sliced
1  lb. hamburg
1  tsp. sugar
1  can tomatoes (large can)
salt and pepper
preparation: Put layer of potatoes in buttered 3-quart casserole, then layer on onions, seasoning, then hamburg and seasoning.  Repeat layering until all hamburg is used.  Finish with hamburg on top. Pour sugar and tomatoes over mixture.  Cover and cook one hour in 350° oven.  Remove cover and cook 1/2 hour longer.

name: POOR MAN'S STEAK
ingredients:
3  lb. hamburger
1 1/2  c. cracker crumbs
1 1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  minced onion
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: Mix together the ingredients except the soup.  Pat to 1 1/2-inch thickness in pan.  Let  stand a couple of hours or overnight.  Cut out; fry until light  brown  on  both  sides. Place  in  baking dish.  Pour mushroom soup over meat and bake for 1 hour.

name: PORK CHOPS IN CROCK-POT
ingredients:
pork chops
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: Brown pork chops slightly on each side.  Put in crock-pot. Put in a can of mushroom soup.  Cook on slow until done.  Serve with rice.

name: HONEY MUSTARD SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. mustard seed (optional)
1/2  c. honey
1/4  c. white wine vinegar
1/4  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. cold water
1  tsp. thyme
preparation: Process mustard, mustard seed, honey, vinegar and salt.  Cover and let stand overnight for the flavor to develop.

name: CHRISTMAS BEETS
ingredients:
1  jar crinkle sliced pickled beets
1/3 to 1/2  c. French dressing
sour cream
chopped green onions (include green tops on top for garnish)
preparation: Drain and chop beets.  Heat in microwave or on top of stove until warm.  Stir in French dressing.  Place in bowl.  Top with sour cream.  Sprinkle chopped green onions (include green tops) on top for garnish.

name: OREO DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  pkg. Oreo cookies
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  gal. vanilla ice cream
1  tsp. instant coffee (optional)
preparation: In large mixing bowl, let ice cream soften slightly.  Fold in Cool Whip and coarsely crumbled Oreo cookies.  (Add instant coffee for a slight mocha taste.)  Pour into pan and return to freezer until ready to serve.

name: MIMI'S EASY CHOCOLATE MOUSSE
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate morsels (semi-sweet or sweet, your preference)
1  egg
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vanilla
3/4  c. milk
whipped cream
preparation: Put milk into a saucepan and warm until very, very hot but not scalded.  Place rest of ingredients into blender and add hot milk. Blend for 2 minutes at high speed.  (Make sure it's 2 full minutes.)  Pour into wine glasses or parfaits.  Refrigerate for at least 2 hours.  Store in refrigerator.  Top with whipped cream.

name: NAPPA CABBAGE SALAD
ingredients:
1  head nappa cabbage
1  bunch green onions
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. sesame seed
1/2  c. slivered almonds
2  pkg. Ramen noodles, crushed
1  c. salad oil
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/2  c. vinegar
preparation: Finely chop cabbage and onions.  Saute butter, sesame seed, almonds and Ramen noodles until brown.  Drain on paper towel. Shake oil, sugar, soy sauce and vinegar in covered jar.  Toss cabbage, onions, sauteed ingredients and dressing just before serving.

name: DROP SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda (in milk)
1  tsp. salt
4  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar, add eggs and vanilla.  Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture alternating with buttermilk.  Bake at 350 degrees for 8 - 12 minutes.  Sprinkle with sugar.

name: ALABAMA PIE
ingredients:
1  cherry pie filling
1 medium  can crushed pineapple
1  can coconut
1  yellow cake mix
1  c. nuts, chopped
2  sticks margarine
preparation: In oblong cake pan, spread pie filling, next pineapple and sprinkle coconut over this.  Sprinkle dry cake mix over this. Cut up margarine in small slices over top and add nuts to top.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries minus 4 Tbsp.
1  box strawberry Jell-O
4  eggs
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. Wesson oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes in 3 (8-inch or 9-inch) pans.

name: CHOCOLATE MARSHMALLOW HAYSTACKS
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
4  Tbsp. milk
2  c. confectioners sugar
3  c. mini marshmallows
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  oz. unsweetened chocolate
preparation: Combine softened cream cheese and  milk,  mixing  until well blended.  Gradually add sugar.  Stir in melted chocolate, salt and  vanilla; fold in marshmallows.  Drop  rounded	teaspoonful of mixture into shredded coconut  or chopped walnuts. Toss until well covered.  Place on waxed  paper  lined  cookie sheet;  chill until set.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: NACHO DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  jar salsa sauce
1  c. shredded Co-Jack cheese
preparation: Spread softened cream cheese on bottom of 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan.  Top with salsa.  Sprinkle cheese on top.   Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 15 minutes.

name: MARMALADE DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
3/4  c. orange marmalade
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Beat cream cheese until smooth.  Stir in marmalade, sour cream, pecans and cinnamon.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

name: ZUCCHINI PICKLES
ingredients:
12  c. finely chopped zucchini
4  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. salt
2 1/2  c. vinegar
3  c. sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
3/4  tsp. turmeric
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  tsp. celery seed
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Mix zucchini, onion and salt.  Let stand overnight.  Mix vinegar, sugar, mustard, turmeric, nutmeg, celery seed and cornstarch. Mix all together.   Cook 10 to 15 minutes.  Pour in sterilized jars.   Seal at once.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese, softened
1/2  jar El Rio Salsa Inferno
black olives, sliced
lettuce, shredded
8  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  bag tortilla chips
preparation: Mix cream cheese and salsa together. Sprinkle black olives, lettuce and cheese on top. Dip chips and enjoy.

name: SQUASH DRESSING
ingredients:
3  c. cooked squash
1  pkg. Mexican cornbread mix
1  stick margarine, melted
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° until done, about 45 minutes.

name: EGG SOUFFLE
ingredients:
6  eggs
1/3  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  lb. American cheese (processed), cubed
preparation: Beat with beater  until  frothy  first	4  ingredients. Stir in cubed cheese.  Pour  into  greased deep 1-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 30  minutes  or until golden brown and fluffy. Serve with bacon,  sausage	or  ham  and hash browns. May be served as a breakfast or brunch.  Serves 4.

name: GINGERSNAPS
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. molasses
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. ground cloves
1  tsp. ground ginger
additional sugar
preparation: Cream butter and sugar in mixing bowl.  Add egg and molasses; beat well. Sift together dry ingredients; gradually add to creamed mixture.  Mix well. Chill dough 1 to 2 hours.  Roll into 1 1/4-inch balls and dip in sugar.  Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for about 10 minutes or until set and surface cracks.  (Cookies will be chewy.)   Cool on wire rack. Yields approximately 4 dozen.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
3/4  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chunky peanut butter
2  eggs, beaten
1 1/4  c. flour
1  c. bran
3/4  c. rolled oats
2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Melt butter. Beat together with the sugars, vanilla, peanut butter and eggs. In a bowl, combine flour, bran, oats and baking soda. Stir into butter mixture. Drop by teaspoonful onto ungreased coolie sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes.

name: COLONEL HARRIS' CHICKEN STIR-FRY
ingredients:
2/3  c. chicken (white meat), cut up to bite size
1  tsp. curry powder
6  Tbsp. oil or butter, divided
1/2  c. walnuts
1/4  c. diced celery
1/4  c. chopped green onion
1  c. flour (approximately)
1  c. milk or water (approximately)
preparation: Rub curry powder on chicken and cook in 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.  Remove chicken and set aside.  Add balance of oil and cook celery and onion over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes. Add flour and milk/water to make white sauce.  (You may also wish to add chicken broth).  Add cooked chicken and walnuts.  Mix well. Season with lemon pepper.  Serve over rice.  Makes 2 servings.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  chicken breasts, cooked and cut into bite-size pieces
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli spears, cooked according to directions on pkg.
1 small  can sliced mushrooms or fresh, sautéed in butter
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. curry powder
1  c. sharp grated cheese
bread crumbs (2 slices bread)
preparation: Grease casserole; line bottom with cut up broccoli. Cover with cut up chicken, then mushrooms. In a separate bowl, combine mushroom soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder. Pour over the chicken. Sprinkle cheese over top of casserole. Sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. beef
4  tsp. margarine
1  large onion, sliced thinly
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. dry mustard
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. beef broth
1/3  c. plain yogurt or sour cream
preparation: Cut beef into 2 x 1/2-inch strips.  Lightly brown in margarine and remove from pan.  Saute onion.  Stir in flour and seasonings. Stir in broth and cook until thickened.  Stir in beef, yogurt or sour cream.  Do not boil.  Serve with noodles.

name: KAREN'S FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. orange-pineapple jello
2  c. sugar
1 large  can pineapple juice
6  lemons
3  bottles ginger ale
preparation: Combine jello with 1 cup hot water and 1 cup cold water to dissolve.  Add sugar, pineapple juice and the juice of 6 lemons. Pour into a 1 gallon jug and fill remainder of jug with water. Add ginger ale after mixing in punch bowl.  Serves 50.

name: BROCCOLI BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jiffy corn muffin mix
8  oz. chopped broccoli, thawed
1  stick melted margarine
4  eggs
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. cottage cheese or Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix together all ingredients.  Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan or an iron skillet.  I prefer using the Cheddar cheese and I also prefer some other cornbread mix that is not as sweet as Jiffy!

name: NATIVE SUCCOTASH SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. (1 1/3 c.) dried hominy or 3 (14 1/2 oz.) cans hominy, drained
1  lb. dry white beans
10  c. chicken broth
2  Tbsp. minced garlic
1  c. fine chopped onions
1/2  c. chopped artichokes
1  c. chopped carrots
1 meaty ham bone or 1  c. chopped ham steak
8  oz. smoked sausage
1/4  c. snipped parsley
2  Tbsp. fresh sage or 1 tsp. ground sage
2  Tbsp. fresh rosemary or 1 tsp. dried rosemary, crushed
salt and pepper
preparation: Cover beans and hominy 8 hours or overnight.  Drain.  Discard liquid.  In 6 to 8-quart Dutch oven, combine beans, hominy (if using canned hominy, add last 30 minutes of cooking), chicken broth, garlic, carrots, onion, artichokes, ham, sausage, parsley, sage and rosemary.  Heat to boiling.  Reduce heat.  Cover; simmer 2 hours until beans are tender.  Add canned hominy, if using.  Remove ham and sausage.  Cut into bite-size pieces.  Return to soup. Season to taste.

name: STRAWBERRY CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
1 (8 3/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  banana, mashed
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped or pecans
preparation: Combine gelatin and  water,  stirring  until dissolved. Add berries,  pineapple and  mashed  banana.  Spoon  half  of mixture in an 8-inch pan  or  mold.  Combine  cream cheese and nuts.  Mix well in the second half of gelatin left out at room temperature. Carefully spread  over set gelatin.  Refrigerate until firm.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FINGERS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter, softened
1/3  c. creamy peanut butter
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. quick oats
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Combine all ingredients except the chocolate chips; mix until blended.  The mixture will be crumbly.  Spread into 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Remove from oven; spread chocolate chips over hot cake.  Let chips soften, then spread evenly over bars.  Cut into bars.

name: SPAGHETTI WITH ZUCCHINI SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. oil
1  medium onion, chopped
2  medium zucchini, sliced (about 6 c.)
3  c. diced fresh tomatoes (or canned)
1/2  tsp. salt
1  bay leaf
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. oregano
8  oz. spaghetti noodles
preparation: Saute in a large skillet oil and onion.  Add zucchini and rest of ingredients (except noodles).  Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Uncover and simmer for 10 more minutes.  Discard bay leaf.  Cook spaghetti noodles according to package.  Serve noodles with sauce and grated Parmesan cheese.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: "DIP"
ingredients:
1  c. ketchup
8  oz. Philadelphia cream cheese
1 small  pkg. sour cream
1 large  can deviled ham
1  onion, grated
preparation: Mix all ingredients and chill before serving.

name: MARMALADE
ingredients:
3 or 4  c. rhubarb, diced
water
1 1/3  c. sugar
1 (3 oz.)  box Jell-O (your choice flavor)
1 small  can pineapple
preparation: Dice rhubarb; add a little water.  Cook until done.  While still hot, add Jell-O.  Stir in 1 small can crushed pineapple.

name: MARINATED VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower
1  bunch fresh broccoli
1  green pepper, chopped
3  ribs celery, chopped
8  large fresh mushrooms, sliced
1  small onion, grated
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. vinegar
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. poppy seed
preparation: Break cauliflower and broccoli into bite sized flowerets. Combine vegetables.  Toss lightly.  Combine remaining ingredients to make marinade.  Mix the marinade well and pour it over the vegetables.  Chill at least 3 hours.

name: 5 MINUTE CARNATION FUDGE
ingredients:
2/3  c. undiluted evaporated milk
1  Tbsp. butter
1 2/3  c. sugar
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1 1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine and boil for 5 minutes the evaporated milk, butter and sugar.  Remove from heat and add the marshmallows, nuts, chips and vanilla.  Stir until marshmallows and chips are melted.  Pour into 8 or 9-inch buttered, square pan.  When cooled, cut into squares and serve.

name: VEGGIE PIZZA
ingredients:
1  1/2 tubes crescent dinner rolls
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. dill weed
1  Tbsp. horseradish
2  Tbsp. chopped scallions
chopped vegetables (carrots, peppers, broccoli, etc.)
preparation: Separate rolls in a baking pan, making sure dough sticks together and there are no holes.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes and cool.  Mix cream cheese, mayonnaise, dill weed, horseradish and chopped scallions.  Spread mixture over crust.  Chop finely any fresh vegetables.  Sprinkle on top cream cheese.  Pat lightly. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours.   Cut to serve.

name: VINEYARD CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. crushed pineapple
1/4  c. chopped fine green pepper
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped fine
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients as listed.  Put in plastic bag and shape. Chill.  Serve with crackers.  This can be made ahead and frozen. Yield:  1 cheese ball.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  onion, chopped
1 large  pkg. flat noodles, cooked and drained except 1 c.
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Mix all together and cook until bubbling.

name: PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs
1 (16 to 20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple and juice
1  stick margarine
1 small  can evaporated milk
2/3  c. sugar
3/4  c. coconut
preparation: Sift flour, sugar and soda.  Add eggs and pineapple with juice.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CHRISTMAS COOKIES
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/4  sticks oleo
1 1/2  c. sifted flour (self-rising)
2/3  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. allspice
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. dry white cooking wine
1/2  lb. candied cherries, quartered
1/2  lb. candied pineapple, chopped
4 or 5  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Soak fruits in wine overnight.  Sift flour and spices together next morning.  Add to fruit.  Cream oleo and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Fold into fruit mix.  Add pecans.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: CHOCOLATE YOGURT CREME PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. Hershey's cocoa
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
1 1/3  c. 2% low-fat milk
2  c. vanilla low-fat yogurt
1  tsp. vanilla extract
raspberries or sliced fresh strawberries
preparation: In medium saucepan, stir together sugar, cocoa and gelatin. Gradually stir in milk; let stand 5 minutes.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil and gelatin is dissolved.  Cool slightly.  Add yogurt and vanilla; blend gently just until well combined.  Pour into dessert dishes. Refrigerate 6 hours or until set.  Top with fruit.  Makes 8 servings.

name: LAYERED BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
2/3  c. packed brown sugar
2  c. milk
2  egg yolks, beaten
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. heavy cream, whipped
4  to 6 bananas, sliced
chopped walnuts
vanilla wafers
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In medium saucepan, combine flour and brown sugar.  Stir in milk.  Cook and stir over medium heat until thick and bubbly. Stir 1 minute more and remove from heat.  Gradually stir 1 cup of hot mixture into egg yolks.  Return to saucepan.  Bring to gentle boil and cook and stir for 2 minutes.  Remove and stir in margarine and vanilla.  Cool to room temperature, stirring occasionally.  Fold in whipped cream.

name: 7-UP CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. margarine or butter
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
3  c. flour
2  Tbsp. lemon extract
3/4  c. 7-Up
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening together.  Beat until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time and beat well.  Add flour.   Beat in lemon extract and 7-Up.  Pour batter into well-greased and floured jumbo fluted mold.  Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

name: CINNAMON TOAST
ingredients:
4  slices home-style bread
3  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
grating of nutmeg
preparation: Toast bread slices; trim crust.  Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a small skillet over low heat.  Add cinnamon, confectioners sugar and if desired, a grating of nutmeg.  Cook for about a minute after it bubbles, stirring constantly.  Spread on one side of the toast and run under the broiler for about 30 seconds, until a glossy crust forms.  Watch that toast doesn't burn.

name: ALMOND BUFFET CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. water
2  envelopes dry chicken noodle soup
1  c. rice
1  lb. bulk sausage
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
2/3  c. blanched almonds
preparation: In a large saucepan, bring water and soup to a boil.  Add rice.  Cover, reduce heat and very gently boil 25 minutes or until all water is absorbed.  Remove from heat.

name: PINEAPPLE RAISIN DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
3/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
1  unbeaten egg
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. raisins
chopped nuts
preparation: Sift together the flour, soda, baking powder and salt in a mixing bowl.  Add the shortening, egg, brown sugar and pineapple. Beat all together until smooth.  Stir in the raisins and chopped nuts.  Drop by spoon.  Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.

name: CREAMY SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
5  lb. sweet potatoes, peeled and cooked
4  eggs, lightly beaten
1/2  c. orange juice
1/2  c. margarine, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
dash of salt
miniature marshmallows
preparation: In a large bowl, mash sweet potatoes.  Add eggs, orange juice, margarine, sugar, vanilla, nutmeg and salt; mix well.  Transfer to a greased 3 quart baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until set.  Top with marshmallows; return to oven until they just begin to puff and melt, about 5 to 10 minutes.  Yield:  10 to 12 servings.

name: CHEWY-O'S BAR
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  pkg. dry cake mix (devil's food or yellow)
3  c. mini marshmallows
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate or butterscotch pieces
3  c. Cheerios cereal
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In oven, melt butter in jelly roll pan (15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch).  Rotate pan until butter covers bottom. Sprinkle dry cake mix over butter; sprinkle with marshmallows, chocolate pieces and cereal.  Pour milk evenly over top.  Bake about 25 minutes or until golden brown.  While warm, run knife around edges to loosen sides.   Cut into bars, about 3 x 1 1/2-inches.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
3 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  eggs
3/4  c. milk
1  c. ripe bananas, mashed
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Measure all ingredients into a large bowl.  Blend 1/2 minute on low speed, scraping side and bottom of bowl constantly.  Beat 3 minutes at medium speed, scraping bowl occasionally.  Pour into pan.  Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Remove from pan; cool thoroughly before slicing.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
3  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. Crisco (solid)
6  eggs
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
3  c. cake flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream the butter, sugar and Crisco.  Add flour with soda, eggs and sour cream (alternately), beginning and ending with flour. Grease and flour pan.  Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours or 325° for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. sugar
1  c. oil
3  large eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
3  c. dried apples
1  c. walnuts
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
preparation: Beat eggs well. Add to oil, sugar and vanilla. Mix dry ingredients. Add to egg mixture. Add apples, walnuts and cinnamon. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with butterscotch chips. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: HOLIDAY PEAS AND RICE
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice
3  Tbsp. butter
2 1/4  c. chicken broth
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  onion, diced
1/2  can English peas
preparation: Saute onion and rice in butter until tender; add garlic powder and broth.  Simmer until done, then add English peas.

name: CRANBERRY CHEESE BARS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  c. oats
3/4  c. plus 1 Tbsp. firmly packed brown sugar
1  c. margarine, softened
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)
1/4  c. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 (16 oz.)  can whole cranberry sauce
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large mixing bowl, combine flour, oats, 3/4 cup brown sugar and margarine.  Mix until crumbly. Reserve 1 1/2 cups crumb mixture.  Press the rest into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.

name: APRICOT KALACHES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. flour
1  (10 oz.) apricot preserves
powdered sugar
preparation: Combine butter, cream cheese and sugar.  Add flour.  Shape dough into ball; chill overnight.  Roll out 1/8-inch thick.   Cut into 2 x 2-inch squares; place 1/2 teaspoon apricot preserves in center.  Bring 2 sides together and pinch tightly.  Place on foil-lined cookie sheet.  Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes. Place on cookie rack on waxed paper; sprinkle with powdered sugar while hot and again when cooled.

name: MINIATURE CREAM CHEESE CAKES
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1 (1 lb. 5 oz.)  can cherry or blueberry pie filling
1  box vanilla wafers
preparation: Combine the first 4 ingredients.  Beat with electric mixer until blended.  Place 1 wafer in each cupcake liner or muffin tin. Fill with about 1 tablespoon of mixture.  Bake.  Cool. Top with pie filling.  Refrigerate.

name: LEMON SQUARES(Bar Cookie)
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. butter
1/4  c. confectioners sugar
2  eggs
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Heat oven to 350°. Measure flour, butter and confectioners sugar thoroughly. Press evenly in a square pan, 8 x 8 x 2. Bake 20 minutes. Beat rest of ingredients together. Pour over crust and bake 20 to 25 minutes more. Do not overbake. (The filling puffs during baking but flattens when cooled.) Makes 16 bars.

name: HEARTY HOT PECAN SPREAD
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 (2 1/2 oz.)  jar dried beef, chopped
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  c. chopped green peppers
1/4  c. minced onion
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients together except the pecans.  Spread into an 8-inch flat casserole dish.  Top with pecans.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Serve warm with corn chips, crackers or celery sticks.

name: CHEESE ROLL
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese
8  oz. pimento
1  tsp. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/8  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. hot pepper
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together.  Roll in wax paper.  Sprinkle with paprika. Chill.

name: CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
1/2  c. warm water
2  pkg. dry yeast
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  c. oleo
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
5  c. flour
preparation: Stir yeast and 2 tablespoons sugar in warm water.  Let set 15 minutes.  Heat milk and 1/2 cup oleo in saucepan.  Measure sugar and salt in large mixing bowl.  Pour in milk mixture.  Stir until dissolved.  When lukewarm, add eggs and yeast mixture.  Add 2 1/2 cups flour; stir.  Add remaining flour and mix well.  Turn out on floured board.  Knead until smooth and elastic for 5 minutes. Place in greased bowl; let rise until double in bulk, about 2 hours.   Punch down and let dough rest for 30 minutes.  Roll dough out on floured board.  Spread other 1/2 cup oleo over the dough. Mix cinnamon and sugar (1/4 cup and 3/4 cup).  Sprinkle over the oleo; roll and slice.  You may leave some for doughnuts.  Let rolls rise until double, about 2 hours.

name: DATE BALLS
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. Rice Krispies
1  c. chopped dates
1  egg, well beaten
coconut or confectioners sugar
preparation: Cook oleo, sugar, nuts, dates and egg in heavy saucepan on low to low-medium setting for 10 minutes.  Add vanilla; stir.  Add cereal and stir well.  Allow to cool slightly, then roll into small balls and roll in sugar or coconut.

name: BAKED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
2  sweet potatoes
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Wash sweet potatoes and dry well. Grease the outside of potatoes with oil.  Price the skins with a fork.  Place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.  Split open each potato and add butter.

name: MARTHA WASHINGTON JETS
ingredients:
1  egg white
1/4  lb. butter
1  box xxx sugar
preparation: Cream butter and 1/2 sugar.  Add egg white (beaten until fluffy, but not stiff).  Gradually add remaining sugar.  Use flavoring, if desired.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
3  tsp. vanilla
1  c. oil
2  c. zucchini
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add vanilla, sugar and oil.  Stir in zucchini. In a small bowl, sift flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Add nuts and stir into dry ingredients.  Pour into 2 greased loaf pans and bake for 60 minutes at 325°.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked and shredded chicken
4  c. rice
1  large size bag chopped broccoli
2  cans Cheddar cheese soup
1  can milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl.  Pour into a casserole dish.  Bake for 1 hour at 375°.  When 5 minutes are left, sprinkle with cheese.

name: SWEET POTATO PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. grated raw sweet potatoes
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
4  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix ingredients in order given.  Put in a shallow baking dish. Bake in a slow oven at about 350° until firm and brown.

name: HEAVENLY HASH
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
1  (16 oz.) fruit cocktail
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Drain fruit cocktail; mix rest of ingredients.  Let set in refrigerator several hours or overnight before serving.

name: LAZY DAY PIE
ingredients:
1  qt. fruit
1  stick butter
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. flour
1/2  c. water
preparation: Heat the fruit.  Melt butter in baking dish.  Mix sugar, flour and water together.  Pour the sugar, flour and water mixture into the baking dish on top of the butter.  Pour fruit on top of this and bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
2  c. dry milk
3/4  c. honey
1/4  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Combine the peanut butter, dry milk and the honey in a medium bowl.  Knead the mixture by hand.  Roll dough into 1-inch balls. Roll the balls in powdered sugar.  Yield: 2 dozen.

name: APPLE NUT DIP
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. light cream cheese
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  apple, shredded
1/2  c. chopped nuts
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Beat sour cream, cream cheese and cinnamon in medium bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients.  Chill; serve with fruit dippers, pound cake or angel food cake cubes.

name: CHOCOLATE CAKE DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
3 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2/3  c. milk
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
1  sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
shortening or cooking oil for frying
preparation: Stir together first 3 ingredients.  In a large bowl, beat eggs, sugar and vanilla until thick.  Combine milk, melted butter and melted chocolate.  Add flour mixture and milk mixture alternately to egg mixture.  Beat until just blended after each addition. Cover and chill 2 hours.  On lightly floured surface, roll dough to 1/2-inch thickness.  Cut with doughnut cutter.  Fry in deep fat at 375° for about 1 minute per side, turning once.

name: TROPICAL CREAM PUNCH
ingredients:
1  can condensed sweetened milk
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice, thawed
1  (6 oz.) frozen pineapple juice, thawed
2 (32 oz.)  bottles club soda
preparation: Mix all ingredients except club soda; mix well.  Slowly add club soda.  Serve over ice.

name: PECAN CRISPIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
2 1/2  c. brown sugar
2 1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter
2  beaten eggs
1/2  tsp. soda (baking)
1  c. pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients in bowl until well blended.  Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet.  Bake at 320°.

name: EGG PIE
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
2 2/3  c. milk
3  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
1  baked pie shell
preparation: Mix together.  Cook until thick.  Pour into prepared pie shell.

name: TWIST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. spiral macaroni dinner
1  c. regular or hot barbecue sauce
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
preparation: Prepare dinner as directed on box.  Brown meat.  Drain.  Mix in barbecue sauce and onion.  Heat. Layer half of the dinner in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish.  Spoon on beef mixture.   Top with rest of the dinner.  Cover and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: CHEESE FILLED JUMBO SHELLS
ingredients:
1  box jumbo shells
4  c. (2 lb.) Ricotta cheese
2  c. (2 lb.) shredded Mozzarella cheese
3/4  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
3  eggs
1  Tbsp. parsley, chopped
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
3/4  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3 1/2  c. (32 oz. jar) spaghetti sauce
preparation: Cook jumbo shells according to package directions.  Drain and rinse with cold water.  Combine cheeses, eggs, broccoli, parsley, oregano, salt and pepper.  Fill each shell with about 2 tablespoons cheese mixture. Spread a thin layer of sauce on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Place shells, open side down, in single layer in pan.  Cover with remaining sauce.  Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese if desired.  Cover with foil; bake at 350° about 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly.  Fills about 36 shells.  Yields ten to twelve servings.

name: BROCCOLI RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  onion
1/2  stick butter
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked
1  c. uncooked rice
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. water
1/2  c. Cheez Whiz
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Saute onion in butter until transparent.  Add all ingredients and mix well.  Pour into greased baking dish and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: HUNGRY JACK BISCUIT BARBECUPS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. prepared barbecue sauce
1  Tbsp. minced onion or 1/2 c. chopped onion
1 to 2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 (10 oz.)  can Hungry Jack refrigerated flaky biscuits
2  oz. shredded Cheddar or American cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Grease 10 muffin cups.  Brown ground beef; drain.  Stir in barbecue sauce, onion and brown sugar.  Cook 1 minute to blend flavor, stirring constantly.   Separate dough into 10 biscuits.  Place 1 biscuit in each greased muffin cup.  Firmly press in bottom and up sides, forming 1/4-inch rim of meat mixture into each biscuit-lined cup.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges of biscuits are golden brown. Cool 1 minute; remove from pan.  Serves 10.

name: MASHED SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (17 oz.)  cans sweet potatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can fruit cocktail, drained
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. melted butter plus 1 1/2 tsp. Morton Nature's Seasons seasoning blend
12  to 16 marshmallows
preparation: Drain sweet potatoes and mash.  Add remainder of ingredients, except marshmallows.  Place in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Top with marshmallows.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  pkg. herb Pepperidge Farm dressing
1  stick butter
2  c. cooked yellow squash
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook squash until done, then drain.  Mix stuffing and melted butter together.  Add squash, sour cream, soup, salt and cheese together.  Mix well.  In a 9 x 12-inch pan, layer bottom of pan with stuffing mix.  Pour squash mixture over stuffing, then put rest of stuffing mix on top of this.  Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: PERSIMMON COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. persimmon puree
1  tsp. soda
1  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. brandy or orange juice
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. nuts
3/4  c. currants
preparation: Mix together persimmons and soda.  Let stand while creaming together butter and sugar until light and fluffy.  Beat in egg, vanilla, lemon juice and brandy.  Add persimmons and mix until blended.  Sift flour, measure and sift again.  Add baking powder, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Gradually blend into creamed mixture. Add currants and nuts.  Mix until just well blended.  Drop a level tablespoon of dough 2 inches apart onto lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 12 to 14 minutes or until brown.  Makes about 5 dozen.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
2  lb. beef tenderloin, cut into 1/4-inch strips
1/4  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. butter
1  clove garlic
1  c. chopped onion
1  lb. fresh sliced mushrooms
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1  can beef broth
1  can tomato paste
1  c. sour cream
noodles
preparation: Combine 1/4 cup flour, salt and pepper; coat meat.  Melt 1/4 cup butter in frying pan; brown meat.  Add garlic, onion and mushrooms; fry until golden.  Move meat and onion to one side of pan.  To other side of pan add 2 tablespoons butter and 2 tablespoons flour; blend.  Add tomato paste and beef broth.  Mix well.  Cook until thickened.  Add sour cream and heat through; do not boil.  Sprinkle with parsley.  Serve over noodles (or rice).

name: PINEAPPLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. Crisco oil
