1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. drained crushed pineapple
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Put dry ingredients together; then add wet ingredients.  Spoon teaspoon of cookie dough on a cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.  You will probably want to double this recipe.

name: PICADILLO DIP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground meat (extra lean)
1  medium onion, chopped
1 (4 oz.)  jar chopped pimientos
2 1/2  oz. pkg. slivered almonds
4  oz. can mushroom pieces
1  (4 oz.)can chopped ripe olives
1 (10 oz.)  can Ro-Tel tomatoes, diced
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. green pepper
2 to 3  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  c. water
1  lb. box Velveeta cheese
1  c. golden raisins
preparation: Brown beef; drain any grease.  Add remaining ingredients. simmer 2 hours, stirring frequently.  Serve in chafing dish with tortilla chips.

name: GARLIC BUTTER
ingredients:
3  lb. softened butter
1/2  c. garlic, peeled and minced
2  t. lemon juice
1  T. salt
1/3  c. fresh parsley, chopped
1/4  c. white wine
1/2  c. salad oil
preparation: In a medium bowl, combine butter with garlic, lemon juice, salt, parsley, wine and salad oil. Mix well. Makes 1 1/2 quarts.

name: BEAN POT
ingredients:
1  lb. hot sausage (Jimmy Dean)
1  lb. bacon
1  onion, chopped
1/2  c. vinegar
1  c. brown sugar
1  lb. lima beans, drained (canned)
1  lb. butter beans, drained (canned)
1  lb. pork and beans (canned)
1  lb. can kidney beans, drained
preparation: Brown sausage and bacon in different pans.  Mix onion with sausage.  Drain fat.  Mix with rest of ingredients.  Cover and cook in slow cooker or oven until heated through.  Bake in a 325° oven for at least 1 hour.

name: THREE LAYER CARAMEL CAKE
ingredients:
3  sticks butter, softened
2  c. sugar
5  eggs
4  c. Swans Down cake flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
dash of salt
3/4  c. cold milk
1  tsp. vanilla flavor
1/2  tsp. banana flavor
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, cream together butter, sugar and eggs. Beat until smooth.  Add flour, baking powder and salt.  Mix until well blended.  Add milk and flavors.  Mix until smooth and fluffy.

name: ITALIAN BEEF
ingredients:
1  (5 to 7 lb.) rump roast
2  c. boiling water
2  beef bouillon cubes
1  tsp. marjoram
1  tsp. thyme
1  tsp. oregano
Tabasco sauce (few drops)
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
preparation: Cook roast; cool and slice thinly.  To drippings in pan, add water and bouillon cubes.  Add seasonings, garlic and green pepper. Simmer 15 minutes.  Add sliced beef and marinate in refrigerator overnight.  Heat and serve.

name: OVEN BAKED BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2  c. potatoes, sliced
1 1/2  lb. beef cubes
1  medium onion, sliced
1  tsp. vegetable oil
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can mushroom gravy
1  pkg. (envelope) onion soup mix
1/2  c. water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas
preparation: Place 1/2 sliced potatoes in bottom of large baking dish. Brown meat, a few pieces at a time, with onion in oil in a large skillet.  Place meat and onion over potatoes in baking dish.  Top with remaining sliced potatoes. Combine gravy, onion soup mix and water in a small bowl.  Pour over meat and potatoes. Cover. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.  Stir in frozen peas. Continue baking for 15 minutes longer or until meat is tender.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  (2 lb.) bag frozen hash brown potatoes
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  pt. sour cream
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
2  c. crushed corn flakes
preparation: Melt half the butter in a 9 x 13-inch dish.  Mix in potatoes. In a medium bowl, combine soup, sour cream, onion and cheese. Pour over potatoes. Combine corn flakes and remaining butter. Sprinkle over potatoes.  Bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour.

name: DIP FOR VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
juice of 1 lemon
1/2  grated onion
2  tsp. Spice Islands seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sour cream
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. horseradish
preparation: Blend in blender in the preceeding order and serve with fresh cauliflower, bell peppers, celery, carrot sticks and broccoli.

name: OREO FUDGE PIE
ingredients:
1  qt. vanilla ice cream or frozen yogurt
1  Oreo pie crust
1/2  c. chocolate fudge sauce
prepared light whipped topping
mini Oreo bite size chocolate sandwich cookies
preparation: Spread ice cream or yogurt in crust.  Top with fudge sauce. Freeze until firm, about 6 hours.  To serve, garnish pie with whipped topping and cookies.

name: 7 LAYER BARS
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. coconut
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  c. chopped nuts (not salty)
preparation: Take  a  9 x 13-inch pan.  Put margarine in the pan and melt it  in a slow oven.  Now sprinkle graham cracker crumbs. Then coconut.  Then chocolate chips.  Then butterscotch chips. Then sweetened  condensed milk.  Top with chopped nuts.  Bake at 350° for  25  to 30 minutes.  Will be the best seven layer bars you ever ate.  Be sure to cool well before cutting.

name: ZUCCHINI APPLE PIE
ingredients:
4  c. sliced and peeled zucchini
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
dash of salt
1 1/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
dash of nutmeg
3  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Toss together zucchini, lemon juice and salt.  Cook until tender.  Mix sugar, cinnamon, cream of tartar, nutmeg and flour in a bowl.  Add the zucchini and mix well.  It will be runny.  Dump the filling into a 9-inch crust; dot with butter.  Add top crust and bake at 400° for 40 minutes, until golden brown.

name: ITALIAN BASS STEW
ingredients:
3  lb. bass fillets
2  Tbsp. oil
1  onion, chopped
1  garlic clove, minced
1 (6 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1  c. red wine or grape juice
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  carrots, sliced
1/2  lb. mushrooms, sliced
1  green pepper, chopped
2  celery stalks, chopped
2  potatoes, quartered
preparation: Cut  fillets  into  2-inch squares.  Rinse and pat dry. Heat oil in 12-inch Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion and garlic and cook until soft.  Add  fish, stewed tomatoes, wine, salt, pepper, carrots, mushrooms,  green	pepper,  celery  and potatoes. Cover and cook for 25 minutes.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. oil
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  medium Granny Smith apples, diced
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° about 40 minutes in a lightly greased 9 x 13 pan.

name: SUSIE'S GRAPE BLUEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. grape Jell-O
2  c. boiling water
1  large crushed pineapple
1  blueberry pie filling
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
3/4  c. powdered sugar
1  large Cool Whip
nuts
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients and let congeal.  Mix next 3 ingredients together and place on top of salad; sprinkle nuts on top.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. cooking oil
2  eggs
4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. white sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Cream together butter, cooking oil, powdered and white sugar. Add eggs and vanilla and mix well.  Sift together the dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet.  Bake 12 minutes at 375°.

name: BREAD AND BUTTER PICKLES
ingredients:
4  c. thinly sliced cucumbers
cracked ice
coarse salt
1  small head cauliflower, broken into flowerets (4 c.)
8  onions, thinly sliced (4 c.)
2  green peppers, cut in strips
2  red peppers, cut in strips
2 1/2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. white vinegar
3/4  tsp. ground turmeric
3/4  tsp. celery seed
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Arrange cucumbers in bowl; top with cracked ice and sprinkle with salt.  Repeat layers with remaining vegetables.  Let stand 4 hours.

name: CHICKEN SAUCE PICANTE
ingredients:
1  large fryer or hen
1/2  c. onions, chopped
1  bunch green onions
3  buds garlic, chopped
1  pkg. mushrooms (fresh)
1/2  c. bell pepper, chopped
1  bunch parsley, chopped
2  cans tomato sauce
1  can tomato paste
1  qt. water
1  c. oil
salt
red pepper
1  lemon
cornstarch
preparation: Cut up chicken.  Cook all vegetables in oil until tender.  Put all in a heavy pot.  Add water and chicken.  When chicken is done, add 1/2 of lemon.  Mix cornstarch in a cup with water.  Pour in pot; cook until thick.  May have to add water along when needed. Serve over rice.  You may want to debone chicken.  This is usually hot with pepper.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. jello, strawberry
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. water
1  pt. strawberries
1  graham cracker crust, 8-inch (Keebler)
8  oz. (1 tub) Cool Whip
preparation: In a saucepan, mix together jello, cornstarch and sugar.  Add water and mix thoroughly.  Cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture comes to a boil and is transparent. Remove from heat.  Cool and set aside.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans Campbell's cream of broccoli soup
1  c. milk
1/4  tsp. dried thyme leaves, crushed
1/4  tsp. pepper
4  c. cooked cut-up vegies (carrots, potatoes, broccoli)
2  c. cubed cooked chicken or turkey
1 (10 oz.)  can Hungry Jack refrigerated biscuits
preparation: In a 3-quart oblong baking dish, combine soup, milk, thyme and pepper.  Stir in vegies and chicken.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, or until mixture begins to bubble.  Meanwhile, cut each biscuit into quarters.  Remove dish from oven; stir.  Arrange biscuit pieces over hot chicken mixture.  Bake for 15 minutes, or until biscuits are golden brown.  Makes 5 servings.

name: FRESH PEAR CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. butter or margarine
1  tsp. baking soda
3  to 4 pears (medium-size but ripe and very firm)
2  large eggs
1  tsp. instant coffee, dissolved in 3/4 c. hot water and cooled
preparation: On wax paper, stir together flour, baking soda and salt.  Core pears but do not peel; chop fairly fine (there should be approximately 3 cups).  In a medium mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar; beat in the eggs until blended.  Stir in flour mixture, in several additions, alternately with the coffee just until smooth; fold in the pears.  Turn into a buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan; sprinkle batter with Streusel Topping (recipe to follow). Bake in preheated 350° oven until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean; 45 to 50 minutes.  Place on wire rack to cool.

name: SELF-RISING BEER BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. self-rising flour
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  can beer, at room temperature
preparation: Grease 1 loaf pan.  Set aside.  Mix together flour, sugar and beer.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Great bread to serve with chili or stews.

name: SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken wings
1  c. water
1  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. catsup
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/2  c. reserved broth
garlic salt to taste
1  c. cornstarch
3  eggs, beaten
oil (for frying wings)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cut wings into 3 parts.  Cook tips of wings in saucepan with 1 cup water.  Cook until soft.  Discard tips and reserve broth.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
3/4  lb. lasagna noodles
3 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
1  medium onion
2 1/2  c. water
4  sprigs parsley (optional)
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  lb. Mozzarella cheese, grated
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1  lb. Ricotta cheese
2  lb. ground beef
2  bay leaves
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Sauce:  Brown meat in oil.  Add diced onion, tomato paste, water, parsley, salt, pepper and bay leaves.  Simmer for 1 1/2 hours.  Arrange in large baking dish in layers as follows:  sauce, noodles, Ricotta and Mozzarella cheese.  Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 375° for about 20 minutes, or until cheese on top is melted.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. lean stew meat
1  Tbsp. olive oil
2  c. water
1  pkg. dry onion soup
8  bouillon cubes
1  c. wine (red or white)
1  c. fresh or canned, sliced mushrooms
2  tsp. garlic
2  tsp. basil
2  to 3 bay leaves
2  Tbsp. paprika
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 large  carton sour cream (fat-free)
noodles, cooked
preparation: In a large pot, brown meat in olive oil.  Add all ingredients, except sour cream.  Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours.  Check occasionally and add water, if necessary.  Remove from heat.  Stir in sour cream.  Serve over cooked noodles.

name: EASY BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  c. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. fresh or unthawed frozen blueberries
3/4  c. milk
1  egg
1/3  c. melted margarine
preparation: In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Add milk, egg and butter to dry mix.  Stir until moist.  Add blueberries.  Spoon batter into 12 to 15 paper-lined or greased muffin cups.  Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Serve warm.

name: SUN DILL PICKLES
ingredients:
small cucumbers
1  or 2 buttons garlic
sprigs of dill
1/4  tsp. powdered alum
1  tsp. salt
1  c. vinegar
1  c. water
preparation: Pack cukes in jars with all other items, except vinegar and water.  Bring vinegar and water to a boil.  Pour over cukes within 1/2 inch of top.  Seal and set in the sun for 7 to 10 days.  Don't open until 5 weeks later.

name: MAYONNAISE BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sweet milk
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  dash salt
preparation: Beat well and bake in muffin tins at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: SUSAN'S SALAD
ingredients:
1  can mandarin oranges
1  can crushed pineapple
1  c. coconut
1  pkg. orange gelatin
1  large container Cool Whip
1  carton cottage cheese
preparation: Drain oranges and pineapple.  Mix all ingredients except gelatin.  Sprinkle dry gelatin over salad and toss lightly.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
2  c. strawberries
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  pt. heavy whipped cream
3/4  c. sugar
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1  (9-inch) baked pie shell
preparation: Thoroughly  wash  and  dry strawberries; cut in halves. Place strawberries  in  baked pie shell.	Mix water with sugar and cornstarch.  Cook  2  to 5 minutes; add strawberry Jell-O. Stir until dissolved.  Pour over strawberries in crust and top with whipped cream.  Serves 8.

name: ANGINETTI
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  medium container Cool Whip (8 oz.)
1  tsp. sugar
2  pkg. anginetti cookies
preparation: Cream the cream cheese and add the pineapple, Cool Whip and sugar.  Cut the cookies in half.  Fill and let stand in refrigerator 8 hours.  (If desired, pineapple may be substituted with a small package of frozen/thawed strawberries.)

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
2  to 4 chicken breasts
1  bay leaf
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  chopped onion
1/2  stick butter
2 (4 oz.)  cans chopped green chilies
2  c. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
flour tortillas
2  cartons whipping cream (2 small)
preparation: Boil chicken breasts with bay leaf. Combine onion and green chiles with butter. Sauté until onion is cooked (I microwave 10 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes). Mix cream cheese with onion mixture. Combine well. Mix finely chopped chicken. Put about 3 tablespoons of this mixture in a flour tortilla. Roll and place seam side down in pan (9 x 13). Cover with Monterey Jack cheese. Pour whipping cream over all. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. This should make 12 tortillas.

name: DOLLY BECK'S FUDGE DAINTIES
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. sugar
1  stick butter (1/4 lb.)
2  sq. baking chocolate
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. or less salt
1  c. broken or chopped nuts (Dolly uses walnuts)
preparation: Beat together the eggs and sugar.  Melt together over low heat, or use double boiler, the butter and baking chocolate.  Add to egg mixture.  Add the remaining ingredients.  Mix ingredients in order given.  Bake in a greased 9 x 9-inch glass baking pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or slightly longer if needed.  These brownies are moist and chewy.

name: VANILLA WAFER CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks Butter
2  c. Sugar
6  Eggs
1 lg.  box Vanilla Wafers, crushed (3 c.)
1/2  c. Milk
1 1/2  c. Pecans, chopped
1  can Coconut flakes
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs and beat well.  Add vanilla wafer crumbs and milk.  Fold in pecans and coconut.  Pour into greased and floured tube pan or bundt pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 275 degrees.

name: MARINATED BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1  c. vegetable oil
1  c. cider vinegar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. garlic salt
1  Tbsp. Accent
1  Tbsp. dill weed
3  lb. raw broccoli
1  lb. cherry tomatoes
preparation: Wash broccoli and cherry tomatoes and put aside and drain. Combine oil, vinegar and spices; mix well.  Pour mixture over broccoli.  Garnish with cherry tomatoes.  Place in refrigerator. Baste intermittently with sauce.  Marinate for at least 2 hours. Now enjoy.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  large onion, sliced thin
1  Tbsp. butter
2  large potatoes, sliced thin
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. salt
nonstick vegetable cooking spray
1  Tbsp. whole wheat flour
1  c. skim milk
2  Tbsp. bread crumbs
preparation: Saute the onion in the butter until translucent.  Add the potatoes and combine.  Add the lemon juice, thyme and salt.   Mix well.

name: PINEAPPLE APRICOT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. sugar
3  oz. apricot gelatin
1/2  c. cold water
3  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  regular size Cool Whip
preparation: Mix together pineapple, sugar and cream cheese.  Bring to a boil; stir well.  Add gelatin and water.  Refrigerate until partly set.  Add Cool Whip.  Let stand in refrigerator until set.

name: APPLE STRUDEL
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg, lightly beaten
1/2  c. lukewarm water or milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
bread crumbs
butter
apples
raisins
sugar
cinnamon
1/2  lemon
preparation: Combine the first 5 ingredients; let stand in oven 1/2 hour. Add the butter; knead in dough.  Slap on table several times until it forms blisters.  Roll dough on cloth from center out; stretch if necessary.  Brown bread crumbs in a pan with butter until light brown.  Spread on dough; fill with apples, raisins, sugar and cinnamon.  Squeeze 1/2 lemon on top.  Roll into a Strudel.  Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes, or until light brown.

name: PRUNE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. self-rising flour
1  Tbsp. cake spice
3  eggs
1  c. salad oil
1 (4 oz.)  can black walnuts
1  jar junior prunes
preparation: Mix sugar and flour.  Blend eggs, salad oil, walnuts and prunes.  Add to flour and beat until smooth.  Pour into greased and floured tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SOUTHERN COFFEE PUNCH
ingredients:
2  qt. strong cold coffee
1  pt. cold milk or half and half
2  tsp. kahlua
1/2  c. sugar
1  qt. coffee ice cream, softened
1/2  pt. whipping cream, whipped
preparation: Combine cold coffee, milk, kahlua and sugar in a large bowl. Stir until sugar is dissolved.  Chill thoroughly.

name: MOTHER'S OLD-FASHIONED TEA CAKES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
3  eggs
2  tsp. baking powder
3  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. sugar
2  c. flour
preparation: Sift flour with baking powder and sugar.  Mix butter, eggs, milk and vanilla.  Combine with dry ingredients.  Add enough flour to make a stiff dough.  Divide dough into 2 parts.  Roll on floured board thin and cut with cookie cutter.  Place on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350°.  (You may sprinkle tops of cookies with sugar before baking.)

name: CHICKEN OR TUNA BALLS
ingredients:
4  oz. can chicken or tuna
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1 or 2  slices crumbled up bread
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Form into balls.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  whole chicken breast, cooked, finely chopped
1/2  head lettuce, finely chopped
4  strips cooked bacon, crumbled
2  hard-boiled eggs, finely chopped
1/2  red beet, cooked, finely chopped
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Mix all of the ingredients in a medium-size bowl and toss with your favorite salad dressing. Serves 4 to 6.

name: ALMOND TRIANGLES
ingredients:
1  lb. room temperature butter
3/4  c. granulated sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. almond extract
1  egg
2 3/4  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. honey
1/4  c. heavy cream
1  lb. sliced almonds (about 5 1/4 c.)
preparation: Line a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan with foil.  Beat 1/2 pound butter, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, salt and almond extract.  Beat in egg and then flour.  Press dough into pan and push up sides. Refrigerate.  Heat oven to 375°.  Prick dough with fork and bake 10 minutes.

name: CRACKLING CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  c. cornmeal
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. sugar
2  c. pork cracklings
2  c. buttermilk
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. bacon drippings
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl.  Add buttermilk, egg and bacon drippings.  Stir until dry ingredients are moistened.  Spoon batter into a preheated, greased iron skillet and bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/4  lb. margarine
1  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  lb. can Hershey's syrup
1  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Add syrup, flour and vanilla.  Mix well.  Stir in nuts.  Pour in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BEEFY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1 (2 1/2 oz.)  jar Armour dried beef, shredded (reserving 1/4 c.)
1  tsp. grated onion
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Put dried beef in blender or food processor and shred it (reserve 1/4 cup).  Mix shredded beef with the cream cheese, onion and Worcestershire sauce.  Roll into a ball and coat with remaining 1/4 cup beef.  Chill and serve with crackers.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can chili beans
1/2  c. ketchup
1  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. ground oregano
1  head of lettuce
2-3 chopped tomatoes
2  c. shredded cheddar cheese
salt
pepper
preparation: Brown the ground beef and drain.  Add beans, ketchup, chili powder, oregano, salt and pepper.  Set aside.

name: HOT SAUSAGE AND PEPPERS
ingredients:
1  pkg. rolled hot sausage
3  to 4 green and red peppers, cut in strips
2  onions, sliced
salt and pepper to taste
1  tsp. basil (dry) or basil leaves
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  jar or can tomato sauce
preparation: Put all ingredients in a casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

name: SAUSAGE CHEESE BISCUITS
ingredients:
4  c. Bisquick
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  lb. bulk sausage (mild or hot to taste)
preparation: Gently fry the sausage, breaking it up as you fry it.  Mix the shredded cheese and Bisquick in a large mixing bowl.  Add sausage, drippings and all.  Blend well.  Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet.  Bake 7 to 8 minutes in a 400° oven.  Makes 50.

name: GLAZED CARROTS
ingredients:
4  carrots, peeled and sliced
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
salt to taste
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan. Add carrots, brown sugar, dry mustard and salt. Cover and cook about 20 minutes or until done.

name: RUGELACH
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter (room temperature)
1/2  lb. cream cheese (room temperature)
2 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Combine all.  Separate into 4 balls.  Refrigerate until you want to make them.  Dough can be frozen.  Roll out into round (doesn't have to be perfect).  Cut into 4 triangles, then cut each into 3 (total of 12 triangles).

name: BROCCOLI DIP
ingredients:
1  roll Kraft jalapeno cheese
1  roll Kraft garlic cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli
preparation: Melt 2 cheeses in top of double boiler.  Add soup and frozen broccoli.  Stir until all is melted. Serve warm with chips or veggies.  Sauteed onions are good to add to this dip.

name: MACARONI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. deluxe macaroni
1  pkg. shredded dried beef
2  cans mushroom soup
3  hard-boiled eggs, diced
2  c. buttered bread crumbs
1  c. milk
preparation: Cook macaroni; then add cheese, undiluted soup, beef and eggs. Pour milk all over.  Top with crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until crumbs are brown.

name: MACARONI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. grated cheese
1  (7 oz.) macaroni (best if precooked)
1  green pepper, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  onion, chopped
preparation: Thin this mixture with  milk  and  pour  into a 2 quart greased casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: MUSCADINE DIP
ingredients:
3  oz. muscadine hot sauce
8  oz. cream cheese
preparation: Allow cream cheese to come to room temperature.   Mix with muscadine hot sauce.   Serve with round (small) tortillas chips.

name: SUGAR-FREE STRAWBERRY JAM
ingredients:
3/4  c. diet lemon-lime soda
1  pkg. sugar-free strawberry flavored gelatin
1  c. mashed fresh or frozen unsweetened strawberries
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: In a saucepan, bring soda to a boil.  Remove from heat; stir in gelatin until dissolved.  Stir in strawberries and lemon juice. Pour into jars or plastic containers; cover and refrigerate up to 3 weeks.  Do not freeze.  Yields 1 3/4 cups.

name: PIGS IN A BLANKET
ingredients:
3  hot dogs
3  ready to bake crescent rolls in a tube
catsup
mustard
preparation: Cut 3 hot dogs in half.  Remove 3 crescent rolls from tube and cut each in half.  Wrap half a crescent roll around each hot dog half.  Place on a cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Serve with catsup and mustard for dipping.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BARS
ingredients:
1 (18.5 oz.)  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  c. crunchy peanut butter
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
2  eggs
1/3  c. water
1/4  c. shortening
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
2/3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour jelly roll pan, 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch.  Blend cake mix (dry), peanut butter and brown sugar in large mixer bowl on low speed until crumbly.   Reserve 2/3 cup of the crumb mixture.

name: OATMEAL CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. quick-cooking oats
1 1/3  c. boiling water
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/2  c. firmly packed light brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1 1/3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
Topping (recipe follows)
preparation: Combine oats and boiling water, stirring well.  Let stand 20 minutes.  Cream butter.  Add sugars and beat well at medium speed of an electric mixer.  Add eggs, vanilla and oatmeal mixture, beating until blended.

name: CHICKEN AND BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
2  c. chopped, cooked broccoli
2  c. cubed cooked chicken
2  c. soft bread crumbs
2  c. shredded process sharp American cheese
1 (12 oz.)  jar Heinz homestyle chicken gravy
1/2  c. undiluted evaporated milk
dash of pepper
preparation: In buttered 9-inch square baking dish, layer broccoli, chicken, bread crumbs and cheese.  In medium bowl, combine gravy, milk and pepper; pour over chicken-broccoli mixture.   Bake in 357° oven for 40 minutes.  Let stand for 5 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  pork chops
1 (1 lb. 4 oz.)  can baked beans
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. chili sauce
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
green pepper rings
preparation: Trim excessive fat from chops, render in frying pan.  Turn heat to medium-high and brown chops on both sides.  Season with salt and pepper and place in baking dish.  (Use a deep baking dish.)  To the baked beans, add chili sauce, brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce. Pour over chops and place green pepper rings over top.  Bake 1 hour, uncovered, at 350°.  Use a 3-quart casserole dish.

name: EGGLESS CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter or oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. sour milk
preparation: Beat all ingredients together well.  Bake in an 8 or 9-inch greased and floured pan at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: MINT SYRUP
ingredients:
3  c. water
2 1/4  c. sugar
3  c. fresh washed mint leaves
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a sauce pan and stir well.  Bring to a boil and cook 10 minutes or until mixture is reduced to 2 1/4 cups.  Remove from heat, stir and strain.  Refrigerate.  May be served over fresh fruit or in tea.

name: EASY DELICIOUS CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  c. sugar
1 small  can coconut
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  large container Cool Whip
1 large  box vanilla pudding (not instant)
preparation: Cook cake according to directions on the box in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Punch holes in the cake with a fork.  Cook pineapple with sugar until sugar dissolves.  Pour over cake.  Cook vanilla pudding according to directions and pour over pineapple.  Let cool.  Spread with Cool Whip, then sprinkle coconut on top.

name: GRANDMA'S FEATHER DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  egg, well beaten
2  Tbsp. melted butter
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Add egg, melted butter and enough milk to moisten stiff batter.  Boil chicken pieces and then take out of broth.  Drop dumplings by teaspoon into boiling liquid.  Cook covered and without peeking for 18 minutes or until dumplings are done.  Take bones out of chicken and then add chicken back in broth with dumplings.

name: STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  can (1 lb.) vegetable steaks
3  Tbsp. oil
1  can (4 oz.) sliced mushrooms
1  envelope dry onion soup mix
1  can sour cream
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Drain steaks and cut into 1/4-inch wide strips.  Brown strips in oil.  Add mushrooms and onion soup mix.  Heat to boiling.  Put the flour into the sour cream and blend.  Combine with first mixture.  Cook and stir until mixture thickens.  Serve over noodles or rice.  Yields 6 servings.

name: PINEAPPLE PIE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1 large  can crushed pineapple
4  oz. coconut
1  stick margarine
preparation: Melt margarine.  Mix together.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: RAINBOW SHERBET PIE
ingredients:
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. lemon sherbet
1 1/2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. orange sherbet
2 1/2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. raspberry sherbet
3  c. plus 2 Tbsp. lime sherbet
1  (6 oz.) ready-to-fill butter flavored crumb crust
1  (8 oz.) tub frozen nondairy whipped topping, thawed
3  c. mixed fruits *
mint sprigs (for garnish)
confectioners sugar (for garnish)
preparation: *Sliced strawberries, kiwi fruit, oranges, blueberries, blackberries and raspberries.

name: HAWAIIAN WEDDING CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
2  tsp. soda
1  c. coconut
1  c. chopped walnuts
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple with juice
preparation: Mix everything by hand in order.  Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Ice with icing recipe below when cake is cool.

name: COCONUT PECAN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. brown sugar, packed
2  c. soft butter
2  c. oil
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
8  c. plain flour
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. cream of tartar
2  c. Rice Krispies
2  c. coconut
2  c. oats
2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine sugars, butter, oil, vanilla and eggs; mix well.  Add salt, soda and cream of tartar to flour; add to creamed mixture. Mix the other 4 ingredients.  Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes, until brown.

name: REFRIGERATOR NUT WAFERS
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines Deluxe Yellow Cake Mix
1/2  c. Crisco oil or Puritan oil
2  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  egg
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Blend dry cake mix, water, vanilla extract and egg. Work in nuts with your hands. Shape into 2 inch rolls. Wrap in wax paper and chill thoroughly in refrigerator or freezer.

name: CHICKEN-SPANISH RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large hen
3  c. water
1  tsp. salt
1/4  lb. sausage
1 1/4  c. raw rice
3  Tbsp. shortening
1/2  c. sliced onions
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  c. tomato sauce
1  tsp. salt
2  c. hot chicken broth
2  cans green peas
pimento
preparation: Simmer chicken in water, salt and seasonings.  Remove meat from bones in large pieces.  Place in large greased casserole.  Quarter sausage and fry in skillet; scatter over chicken.  In shortening, fry raw rice until golden brown, stirring constantly.  Drain rice and sprinkle over chicken and sausage.  Add onions, garlic, tomato sauce and salt to hot broth.  Pour over chicken and rice.  Cover; bake for 1 1/4 hours in 325° oven.  Heap hot drained peas around edge.  Garnish with pimento.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: CHICKEN FAJITAS
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken breasts (4 breasts)
2  green bell peppers, chopped
2  onions, quartered and sliced
salt and pepper to taste
1  pkg. soft white flour fajitas
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Cut chicken in strips 1-inch long.  Place in oiled skillet along with green peppers, onions, salt and pepper.  Saute until chicken is cooked and onions are golden brown.  Put fajitas in a 200° oven for 1 minute.  Remove and place some of the chicken mixture on each.  Sprinkle shredded cheese on each.  Roll fajitas and place, seam side down, in pan in one layer.  Place pan in oven for 2 minutes, then eat.

name: BRAUNSCHWEIGER SPREAD
ingredients:
1/2  lb. braunschweiger
1  c. sour cream
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
Tabasco sauce
preparation: Chill and serve with crackers.

name: JULIE'S CHILI(Chili Cook Off Entry - 1994)
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
1/2  white onion
1 big  can chili hot beans
2  cans tomato sauce
chili powder
ground red pepper
pepper
salt
preparation: Cook ground chuck with onion; drain.  Add remaining ingredients.  (For the chili powder, red pepper, black pepper and salt, add as much as your heart desires.)  Simmer.

name: BARBECUED RIBS
ingredients:
1 3/4 to 2  lb. baby beef ribs
3  Tbsp. oil
3  Tbsp. chili sauce
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
dash of pepper
dash of dry mustard
preparation: Wipe ribs with damp paper towels.  Place ribs in a single layer in a roasting pan.  Roast ribs at 450° for 20 minutes, turning once.   Prepare basting sauce:  Mix all ingredients together.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE SUPREME
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. long grain and wild rice mix
1 (16 oz.)  can French-style green beans, drained
3  c. chopped cooked chicken
1 (4 oz.)  jar chopped pimentos, drained
1 (7 oz.)  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
1  can cream of celery soup
1  c. mayonnaise
salt and pepper to taste
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook rice using package directions.  Combine with green beans, chicken, pimentos, water chestnuts, soup, mayonnaise, salt and pepper in bowl; mix well.  Spoon into baking dish.  Top with cheese.  Bake at 300° to 350° until cheese melts and casserole is heated through.  Yield:  15 servings.

name: PEG'S CORN MUFFINS
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  c. corn meal
1  tsp. salt
8  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
2  c. milk
2  eggs
1/2  c. melted margarine
preparation: Mix eggs, sugar and margarine.  Add all dry ingredients alternately with milk.  Add corn meal.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: TROPICAL FRUIT BRUNCH PARFAIT
ingredients:
1  can Dole tropical fruit salad
1  c. nonfat cottage cheese
1 (8 oz.)  carton nonfat sugar-free peach yogurt
1/4  c. raisins
1/2  c. granola
preparation: Drain fruit salad.  Combine cottage cheese, yogurt and raisins.  Layer in four glasses the cottage cheese mixture, fruit salad and granola.

name: HOMEMADE YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. plain flour
1  pkg. active dry yeast
1 1/4  c. milk
1/2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1  egg, beaten
preparation: In large bowl, combine yeast and 2 cups of flour.  Heat milk, sugar, salt and butter/margarine.  Add to flour mixture. Add egg and  beat  at  low speed for 30 seconds.  Beat at high speed for 3  minutes.  Gradually add the remaining 1 1/2 cups flour and continuing  mixing  by  hand  to form a soft dough. Turn dough into  a  greased  bowl  in a warm place, 80 to 85°. Dough should double in volume in 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  Turn dough on floured board and shape.  Place on greased baking sheet or muffin tin. Cover  for 30 to 45 minutes.  Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: PECAN PRALINE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. light brown sugar
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
2  c. plain flour
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: The temperature of the buttermilk is what makes the cake, about 110°.  Warm buttermilk and butter.  Put in mixing bowl.  Add brown sugar and eggs.  Beat.  Add dry ingredients, sifted together.  Beat well. Add vanilla. Bake in greased and floured rectangular 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: MARSHMALLOW FUDGE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. white sugar
1/4  c. butter
3/4  c. evaporated milk
5  oz. marshmallows
1  pkg. chocolate chips
chopped nuts (if desired)
preparation: Mix sugar, butter, evaporated milk and marshmallows.  Put in heavy 2-quart saucepan.  Cook quickly to a boil and boil 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Add chocolate chips and stir until dissolved.  Pour into buttered pan and cool in refrigerator.  Makes 2 pounds of fudge.  May add chopped nuts, if desired.

name: CORN AND BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (11 oz.)  cans white corn, drained
1 (16 oz.)  can French-style green beans, drained
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/3  c. chopped onion
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of celery soup, undiluted
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. (2 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. sliced almonds, toasted
preparation: Combine all ingredients except almonds.  Spoon into a lightly greased 2-quart baking dish.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 45 minutes.  Sprinkle with almonds.  Yield:  8 servings.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
20  oz. broccoli, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. onion, chopped
2  hard-boiled eggs, diced
1 (2 oz.)  jar pimentos, chopped
1  Tbsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix ingredients and chill for at least 2 hours.

name: FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. milk
1 (2 lb.)  can peaches
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Drain canned peaches.  Put in cake pan.  Pour batter over fruit.  Sprinkle 1 cup sugar over batter.  Pour 1/2 cup of water over sugar.   Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: MINCEMEAT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. condensed mincemeat, crumbled
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat  oven  to  375°.  In  a  large mixer bowl, beat shortening	and  sugar  until  fluffy.  Add  eggs;	beat well. Combine  dry ingredients; gradually add to first mixture.  Mix well.  Stir  in  mincemeat.  Drop  by  rounded  teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto greased baking sheets.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.  Cool.  Frost, if desired.  Makes 6 dozen.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  crushed bananas (add 1 tsp. soda)
2  c. flour
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Cream sugar and butter; add eggs and beat well.  Add banana mixture alternately with flour.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Bake in loaf pan at 350° for one hour or until done.

name: SWEET POTATO BISCUIT
ingredients:
2  c. flour (self-rising)
1/3  c. shortening
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. cooked, mashed sweet potatoes
3/4  c. (about) buttermilk
preparation: Sift flour.  Cut in shortening.  Add sweet potatoes and stir in milk, more if necessary, to make a stiff dough.  Toss dough on floured board or cloth and knead lightly.  Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness.  Cut with floured cutter or roll out with hands.  Bake in a 450° oven until golden brown.

name: HOT HAM BUNS
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter or oleo, softened
2  Tbsp. prepared horseradish
mustard
2  tsp. poppy seed
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
4  hamburger buns, split
4 thin  slices boiled ham
4  slices Swiss cheese
preparation: Mix butter, mustard, poppy seed and onion and spread on the surface of buns.  Tuck a slice of ham and cheese in each bun. Arrange on a baking sheet and bake in 350° oven for 20 minutes until hot.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. honey
1  c. dry milk
1  c. oatmeal
preparation: Mix all together with clean hands.  Store in airtight container.  Eat some now and save the rest for later.  Yum!

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. creamy or chunky peanut butter
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cream butter with peanut butter and sugar.  Add egg and vanilla.  Beat until light and fluffy.  Sift flour, salt and soda over creamed mixture; blend thoroughly.  Form into 1-inch balls.  Place on a greased baking sheet.  Press flat with a fork.  Bake in a moderate oven for 12 to 15 minutes.  Makes 3 dozen cookies.

name: CREAM CHEESE COOKIES
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. butter, softened
1  pkg. Betty Crocker lemon cake mix
1  egg
1/4  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Beat cream cheese and butter.  Mix in 1/2 cake mix, egg and vanilla until smooth.  Stir in rest of cake mix and coconut.  Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: 5 HOUR MEAL
ingredients:
2  lb. stew beef
pinch of salt and pepper
6  potatoes
3  carrots
1  onion
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. water
1/2  pkg. onion soup
preparation: Place meat, potatoes, carrots and onions in heavy pot.  Mix soups and water and pour over top of meat and vegetables.  Cover. Bake at 250° to 300° for 5 hours.

name: SNOWBALL SURPRISES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. finely chopped pecans
10  chocolate-coated peppermint patties, quartered
sifted powdered sugar
preparation: Beat butter at medium speed with mixer until creamy. Gradually add sugar, beating well.  Stir in vanilla.  Gradually stir in flour and pecans, mixing well.  Cover and chill 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN A LA KING
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
2  c. cooked chicken, cut up
1  c. drained cooked peas
2/3  c. sliced mushrooms, sauteed lightly
2  carrots, sliced and cooked
1/4  c. chopped onion, sauteed
2  Tbsp. pimento
1  tsp. salt
1  pkg. refrigerated biscuits
preparation: Saute mushrooms and onion in a small amount of butter.  Cook the peas; set aside.  Cook the carrots; set aside.  Melt 3 tablespoons butter; blend in flour.  Gradually add chicken broth. Cook and stir until thick.  Add the chicken, the vegetables and salt.  Heat to boiling.

name: ON THE DOUBLE DINNER ROLLS(Yields 24 Rolls)
ingredients:
2  pkg. yeast
2  c. warm water
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. lite salt
2  Egg Beaters (1/2 c.)
1/4  c. liquid Butter Buds
5  c. bread flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl.  Add sugar, salt, Egg Beaters, Butter Buds and 1 cup of the flour; beat until smooth.  Stir in the rest of the flour; continue stirring until smooth.  Cover; let rise in a warm place until it doubles in size (about 30 to 40 minutes).  Spoon batter into 24 muffin cups sprayed with a nonfat cooking spray. Fill each cup about half full.  Let rise until dough reaches the top of muffin tins (about 20 to 30 minutes).  Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  box butter-flavored yellow cake mix
3 small  pkg. vanilla pudding
2  large bananas, sliced
2  (16 oz.) drained crushed pineapple
2  qt. fresh strawberries
2  large containers Cool Whip
2  pkg. fresh blueberries
preparation: Bake cake as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cook pudding as directed and cool.  After cake is cool, cut into small pieces. Layer all the ingredients in a punch bowl in the following order: pieces of cake, pudding, pineapple, strawberries, blueberries and Cool Whip.  Repeat layers and garnish with strawberries.

name: SQUASH SUPREME
ingredients:
2  c. squash, cooked
1  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1  c. sour cream
1  carrot, grated
2  Tbsp. onions, chopped
1/2  stick butter
1 small  pkg. Pepperidge Farm Herb Season Mix
preparation: Mash cooked squash then add soup, onion, carrots, sour cream, salt and pepper. Butter bottom of a baking dish. Sprinkle crumbs on bottom of bowl. Add squash mixture. Cover squash with crumbs and butter on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: WALTER'S CRAWFISH PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. chopped crawfish *
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. water
1  can cream of celery soup
double crust pie shells or tart shells
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped bell pepper
1  stick oleo or butter
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: *May use shrimp.

name: GOLDEN EGGPLANT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. peeled, cubed eggplant
18  saltine crackers, crushed
1/2  c. shredded sharp cheese
1/4  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. cream or evaporated milk
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook eggplant in boiling salted water for 10 minutes.  Drain. Combine with remaining ingredients.  Turn into 1-quart casserole. Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 45 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: CHEESEBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. original Bisquick
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Grease 9-inch pie plate.  Cook beef and onion until beef is browned; drain.  Spread in pie plate. Sprinkle with salt and cheese.  Stir eggs, milk and Bisquick until well blended.  Pour on top of meat and cheese.  Bake 25 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  lb. flour
1/2  lb. ground chocolate
1 1/2  lb. sugar
3/4  lb. lard
1/2  lb. butter
2  tsp. baking ammonia, powdered
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients together into a cookie dough.  Let set overnight in refrigerator.  Make into small balls and bake at 325° for 12 minutes.

name: STEWED TOMATOES
ingredients:
1 large  can tomatoes
1/2  stick butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
2  slices toast, cut into small cubes
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients except toast.   Cook slowly for 30 minutes.  Add toast cubes.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

name: WASHBOARDS
ingredients:
2  c. shortening
2  c. brown sugar
2  c. white sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. soda, dissolved in 1/2 c. hot water
8  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Stir soda mixture in first 4 ingredients.  Sift together and add the flour, baking powder and salt.  Mix in chocolate chips, nuts and coconut.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400°.  Makes about 10 dozen cookies.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1  can creamed corn
1  egg
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  stick margarine
preparation: Melt butter in baking dish.  Mix corn, egg, sugar and butter. Bake at 425° for about 35 or 40 minutes, until set and brown.

name: GREEN PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. beef chuck or round, fat trimmed
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  clove garlic
1 1/2  tsp. grated fresh ginger or 1/2 tsp. ground
1/4  c. salad oil
1  c. green onions, sliced thin
1  c. red or green peppers, cut into 1-inch squares
2  stalks celery, sliced thin
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. water
2  tomatoes, cut into wedges
preparation: With  a  very  sharp  knife, cut beef across grain into thin strips  1/8-inch  thick.  Combine  soy sauce, garlic and ginger. Add beef.  Toss and set aside while preparing vegetables.  Heat oil  in large frying pan or wok.  Add beef.  Toss over high  heat until  browned.  Taste  meat.  If  it  is not tender, cover  and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes over low heat. Turn  heat  up  and add vegetables.  Toss until vegetables are tender-crisp,  about  10 minutes.  Mix cornstarch with water. Add  to  pan.  Stir  and cook until thickened.  Add tomatoes. Heat through.

name: PRIN'S PIE CRUST
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2/3  c. lard
6 to 7  Tbsp. ice cold water
dash of salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients together with a fork. Crumble with fingers to desired consistency (little pieces). Roll into 2 balls. Flour a cloth and roll, spreading from middle. Makes 2 flaky pie crusts.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1 large  can sliced peaches
1  stick oleo
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
preparation: Heat fruit.   Melt oleo in a large casserole dish.  Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.  Add milk and beat until mixed. Pour into butter dish and stir until blended with oleo.  Pour hot fruit evenly over batter. Bake at 350° until dough rises to top and browns about 1 hour.  Blackberries may be used instead of peaches.

name: PIZZA CUPS
ingredients:
3/4  lb. ground beef
1  c. (6 oz.) tomato paste
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. (10 oz.) refrigerator biscuits
1/2 to 3/4  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown and drain beef. Stir in tomato paste, onion and seasoning (mixture will be thick). Cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Place biscuits in a greased muffin tin. Spoon about 1/4 cup of meat mixture into biscuit-lined cups and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400° for 12 minutes.

name: BAKED CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. chopped chicken, cooked
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1  bag slivered almonds
1  small bag potato chips, crushed
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Toss  together all ingredients except cheese and potato chips. Mix  grated  cheese  and  potato chips and put on top. Bake at 400°  about  10  minutes  or  until cheese melts.  If desired, add 1 or 2 cups cooked rice for volume.

name: HARVEST STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak, cut in small pieces
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2 1/2  c. water
1  c. barbecue sauce
8  carrots, halved
3  medium onions, quartered
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. flour
3  medium potatoes, cubed
1  c. biscuit mix
preparation: Brown meat in oil.  Add 2 cups water, barbecue sauce, carrots, potatoes, onions and salt.  Cover and simmer 1 hour.  Gradually add remaining water to flour, stirring until well blended.  Add flour mixture to hot meat and vegetables, stirring constantly until it boils and thickens.  Prepare biscuit mix like dumplings. Drop by tablespoons onto hot stew mixture.  Simmer 10 minutes. Cover; simmer another 15 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. butter
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking soda
6  c. sifted flour
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix butter, eggs and sugar.  Add the rest.  Roll in sugar and flatten with fork.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Real butter is the secret!

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1  box strawberry Jell-O
1  c. Wesson oil
1/2  c. water
4  eggs, beaten
juice from pkg. of strawberries (frozen)
preparation: Mix ingredients together; cook at 325° in 3 layers.

name: RUSSELL'S LINGUINE AND SHRIMP
ingredients:
1 1/2  sticks oleo
2  Tbsp. chopped green onion
2  cloves garlic, chopped
2  Tbsp. white wine
1  lb. peeled shrimp
1  lb. cooked linguine
2  c. (about 8 oz.) steamed spinach or other greens
1  tomato, sliced
8  oz. sliced fresh mushrooms
1 to 2  tsp. dried basil or 1/4 c. fresh basil
grated Romano cheese
preparation: Saute onion, garlic and shrimp in oleo until shrimp are done. Add wine.  Add cooked linguine and toss until hot.  Add steamed spinach, tomato, mushrooms and basil.  Toss to heat through.  Top with grated cheese.  Serve immediately.  Serves 6.

name: BLUE RIBBON BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
2 small  boxes instant vanilla pudding
3  c. milk
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand
bananas
vanilla wafers
preparation: In large bowl, mix pudding and milk; beat until pudding sets. Add sour cream; blend well.  Add Cool Whip; blend well.  Add Eagle Brand; blend well.  Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with vanilla wafers. Slice bananas over wafers.  Pour pudding over bananas and wafers. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FROSTING
ingredients:
1  box 10x powdered sugar
1/4  c. Crisco
1  tsp. vanilla
5  Tbsp. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter (add more if needed)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Add peanut butter.  Mix on high.  Add more milk if needed.

name: PORK BARBECUE
ingredients:
1  c. Worcestershire sauce
2  c. water
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. cayenne pepper
salt and pepper
5 to 8  lb. Boston butt pork roast
preparation: Mix all ingredients and cook on low temperature on top of stove for 6 to 8 hours. Serve on buns with barbecue sauce.

name: BANANA NUT ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2  cans Eagle Brand milk
6  bananas, mashed
1  C. pecans, chopped
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix above ingredients and pour in ice cream can of freezer. Fill remaining space with milk, allowing room for ice cream expansion. Follow freezer directions.

name: CREAM CHEESE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1 small  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. nut meats or cherries
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter and cheese.  Add flour, nuts and flavoring.  Make into 2 rolls.  Chill overnight.  Cut into 1/4-inch slices or make into small balls and press down on cookie sheet with fork.  Bake at 350° until slightly brown.

name: STUFFED PIZZA
ingredients:
2  (13 oz.) frozen cheese pizzas
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. brown and serve sausage links
1/4  c. sliced olives (green or black)
4  oz. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Place one pizza on greased baking sheet.  Cut sausage into thin slices.  Arrange sausage and olives on top.  Sprinkle with half the cheese.  Top with second pizza, upside-down.  Cover with foil.

name: HAYNES' OKRA GUMBO
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. frozen or fresh cut okra (supermarket size)
2  large onions, cut into small pieces
4  celery sticks, cut into normal size pieces
1  green pepper, cut into pieces
1/2  box fresh mushrooms
1/2  tsp. powder garlic
1/2  tsp. dill weed
salt to taste
1/2  jar canned tomatoes
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Put first 5 ingredients in large nonstick frying pan and stir frequently so the juice from the okra will dry up, leaving the ingredients non slimy.  This takes about 20 minutes, then add powder garlic, dill weed and salt.

name: QUICHE
ingredients:
1  can condensed milk, heated to almost scalding
4  eggs
8  oz. Swiss cheese
shaved ham or cooked, crumbled bacon
1/2  tsp. salt and pepper or dash of cayenne
preparation: Melt cheese in hot milk.  Crumble cooked bacon or shaved ham into unbaked pie shell.  Add eggs, salt and pepper to milk and cheese mixture.  Pour over bacon into pie shell.  Bake at 450° for 12 minutes, then bake at 300° about 35 minutes.  Best served hot.

name: PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans pineapple tidbits
3/4  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. flour
8  oz. cheese, grated
1  stack Ritz crackers
1  stick butter
1/2  c. walnuts (optional)
preparation: Spread pineapple in casserole dish. Mix sugar, flour and cheese: pour over pineapple. Cover with crushed crackers. Pour melted butter on top. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until crackers are brown. If adding nuts, roast them before mixing them with crushed crackers.

name: STRAWBERRY FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
2  c. boiling water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, sliced
1 (1 lb. 4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
3  medium mashed bananas
1  c. broken nut meats
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: In a large kettle, combine gelatin with boiling water.  Stir until dissolved.  Fold in all ingredients, except sour cream. Turn half of mixture into a 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan.  Refrigerate until firm.  Evenly spread sour cream over top.   Gently spoon remainder of mixture (which has been kept at room temperature) over cream.  Refrigerate.

name: AUNT LILL'S SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
10  peeled and thinly sliced potatoes
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  stick butter or margarine
1  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
flour
preparation: Peel and slice potatoes.  Place a layer of potatoes in baking dish and top with some onion.  Sift a little flour over this layer.  Add 2 more layers.  Don't put flour on top layer.  Dot with butter or margarine.  Add a bit of salt and pepper.  Add water until you can see it on the side of the dish.  Cover and bake about an hour at 350°.  Uncover and bake it a little longer.

name: ALMOND TORTE
ingredients:
2  Jiffy yellow cake mixes
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
toasted almonds
2 (4 serving size)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
3  c. milk
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Let cool.  Mix the pudding with milk.  Blend in cream cheese (slightly softened in microwave). Spread mixture over cooled cake.  Drain pineapple and spread over pudding mixture.  Spread layer of Cool Whip.  Top with almonds.

name: PUNCH FOR 25
ingredients:
1  pkg. flavored gelatin (any flavor)
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 (46 oz.)  can grapefruit juice
1/2 small  bottle almond extract
2  c. sugar
3  c. water
1  bottle ginger ale
preparation: Make gelatin as directed.  Add the remaining ingredients except the ginger ale and mix thoroughly.  Add ginger ale just before serving.  Sherbet may also be added when ready to serve.

name: FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. salad oil
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1  c. tomato soup
1/2  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. celery seed
dash of garlic salt (if desired)
preparation: Mix together until well blended.  Refrigerate.  Keeps for weeks.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. water
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. diced celery
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. vinegar
4  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  c. catsup
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. dried mustard
1  c. tomato juice
preparation: Cook onion, celery, butter and water until tender.  Add other ingredients and simmer  30 minutes.  Delicious added to browned hamburger to make Sloppy Joes or use it as you would any barbecue sauce.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE
ingredients:
1  pkg. thawed and chopped broccoli
1/2  lb. (1 c.) jalapeno cheese
2/3  c. rice, cooked
1/3  c. canned milk
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Mix all together and bake for 1 hour at 350° until set.

name: BROCCOLI RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped
1/3  stick margarine
2  pkg. chopped broccoli
2  c. rice, cooked
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2/3  lb. grated Velveeta cheese
preparation: Brown onion  in  margarine; add broccoli and stir until thawed.  Add  rice,  soup  and  cheese.  Mix  well	and put in greased casserole  dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Yield: about 8 servings.

name: DELICIOUS FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
1 (No. 2)  can fruit cocktail
1 (10 oz.)  box whipped topping
1 small  box instant lemon pudding
1  can mandarin oranges
preparation: Mix undrained pineapple and lemon pudding; let set.  Drain fruit cocktail and oranges and mix with pineapple/pudding.  Fold whipped topping into fruit.  Chill.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  (3 lb.) chicken, cooked and deboned (save broth)
1  can mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 small  can green chilies (peppers)
1 small  pkg. corn tortillas
1  can Carnation milk
1  small onion, chopped
broth from chicken (about 2 c.)
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Heat the soups, chilies, broth and milk. Set aside. Layer 9 x 13 casserole as follows: tortillas, mixture, onion, cheese (save enough for top layer) and chicken. Bake at 400° (until it bubbles) for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: OVEN POTATOES
ingredients:
8  to 10 potatoes, cut up 1-inch size
1/2  stick oleo
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1/3  c. flour
preparation: Melt oleo in a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Mix Parmesan cheese, flour and seasoned salt in bag.  Shake potatoes (a few at a time).  Put in pan with melted oleo.  Bake in 375° oven for 1 hour.

name: LITTLE CHEESECAKES
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
vanilla wafers
pie filling (your choice)
preparation: Beat cream cheese and sugar until creamy.  Add eggs; beat again.  Put cupcake papers into cupcake pan.  Place one vanilla wafer in bottom of each paper.  Top with large tablespoon of filling.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.  Cool.  Top each cheesecake with the pie filling of your choice.  Chill completely.

name: MARY'S EGG PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. Carnation milk
3  egg yolks (save whites to beat and fold in)
1/2  stick melted oleo
1  tsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of nutmeg
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Beat egg whites and fold in last.  Bake in uncooked pie crust for 10 minutes in a 400° oven, then reduce heat to 350° and bake 35 to 40 minutes longer.   Do not overcook.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
2  c. Bisquick
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. sharp grated cheese
1/4  c. water
preparation: Cook sausage.  Crumble and drain grease.   Mix sausage with other ingredients.  Shape into bite-size balls. Bake on cookie sheet at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: LEMON CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. lemon juice
8  egg yolks
1/2  c. butter
1  box almond butter cookies, crushed
sifted powdered sugar
preparation: Prepare cake using box directions.  Let cool.  Combine sugar and lemon juice in saucepan.  Add yolks.  Cook and stir over medium heat until bubbly.  Reduce heat and stir for 2 minutes.  Add butter a few pieces at a time.  Stir until melted.  Transfer to a bowl and cover with plastic wrap.  Chill.

name: QUICK LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  small lasagna noodles (do not cook)
1  lb. ground beef
1  (32 oz.) spaghetti sauce
1/2 to 3/4  c. water
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. Italian seasoning
2  c. cottage cheese, mixed with 2 beaten eggs
3  c. Mozzarella cheese and Cheddar cheese, shredded
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Brown meat.  Add sauce and water, salt and seasoning.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Mix in small bowl cottage cheese and eggs until blended.  Put 1/3 cup of meat in bottom, then noodles, then 1 cup cottage cheese, then Mozzarella and Cheddar cheese.  Repeat.  End with meat.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours, then put more cheese on top.  Bake until cheese is melted.

name: THREE BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can French-cut green beans
1  can cut wax beans
1  can kidney beans
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1  c. vinegar
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. oil
preparation: Drain the beans.  Add the chopped onion, celery and green pepper.  Heat the vinegar, sugar, pepper and salt.  Cool and add oil.  Pour over bean mixture.  Let stand 1 hour and serve.

name: CUCUMBER-DILL PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. cooked spiral pasta
1/2  c. thinly sliced carrot
1/2  c. thinly sliced celery
1  c. parboiled broccoli florets
1  green onion, thinly sliced
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2 to 3/4  bottle cucumber salad dressing
1  tsp. dill weed
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a large salad bowl.  Chill until serving time.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  box frozen chopped broccoli
1  box Kraft egg noodle dinner
8  oz. shredded mild Cheddar cheese
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Cook noodles to specifications on box.  Drain while preparing broccoli.  Cook broccoli and butter for 10 minutes on High in microwave.  Add 2/3 cup water to gravy mixture and cook on medium on stove top until it thickens.  Mix broccoli, noodles, gravy and Cheddar cheese all together.  Cook 7 more minutes in the microwave.

name: SOUR CREAM BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  boxes instant vanilla pudding
2  c. milk
6  bananas
1  c. sour cream
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1  box vanilla wafers
preparation: Mix together instant pudding and milk, then add sour cream and Cool Whip.  Layer wafers, banana and pudding mixture.  Top with vanilla wafer crumbs and refrigerate.

name: THICK CUT O RINGS AND SPICY DIPPING SAUCE
ingredients:
Vegetable or canola oil for frying
2  large sweet Vidalia onions
2  cans evaporated milk, 5 oz
1  c all purpose flour
1/2  tsp dried mustard
1/2  tsp cayenne pepper
1  tsp sweet paprika, 1/3 palm full
coarse salt
preparation: Heat 1 inch oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cut onions across into 1 inch rings and separate. Discard the outer layer of skin on your rings. Pour evaporated milk into a small bowl. Mix flour with seasonings in a shallow dish. Dip individual rings in milk, then coat in flour. And repeat for a double dip. Fry in a single layer in hot oil until golden brown. Remove to paper bag or towel lined surface to drain. Salt while hot, to your taste.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CRISSCROSSES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs, beaten
3  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1/8  tsp. salt
2  c. peanut butter
preparation: Cream shortening, vanilla and sugars.  Add eggs and beat thoroughly.  Stir in peanut butter and then sifted dry ingredients.  Form into tiny balls.  Place on greased cookie sheet.  Press with back of fork dipped in water.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.  Yields 4 to 5 dozen.

name: RICE PILAF
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  tsp. dried or fresh parsley flakes
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. uncooked rice
preparation: Combine broth, parsley and butter in a saucepan; bring to a boil.  Stir in rice; cover.  Reduce heat; simmer 20 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
1  jar Old English Cheddar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Mix well and roll in nuts.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cornmeal
3  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  egg
1  c. buttermilk
water
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except water.  Add enough water to achieve a smooth consistency.  By teaspoon or tablespoon, drop into deep fat.  Fry until golden brown.  Serve with fish or greens.

name: MOM'S ROAST BEEF
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  eye round beef roast (about 2 1/2 lb.)
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. brewed coffee
1  c. water, divided
1  beef bouillon cube
2  tsp. dried basil
1  tsp. dried rosemary
1  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Heat oil in Dutch oven; brown roast on all sides.  Add onion and cook until transparent.  Add coffee, 3/4 cup water, bouillon, basil, rosemary, garlic, salt and pepper.  Cover and simmer for 2 1/2 hours or until meat is tender.  Combine flour and remaining water until smooth; stir into pan juices.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.  Remove roast and slice.  Pass the gravy. Yield:  8 servings.

name: CHICKEN FETTUCCINE
ingredients:
1  chicken, cut into serving pieces
12  oz. spaghetti or spinach fettuccine
10  oz. Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  jar pimento
salt and pepper to taste
Parmesan cheese to taste
preparation: Cook and debone chicken.  Cook spaghetti or fettuccine. Combine chicken, pasta, cheese, pimentos, salt, pepper and soups; mix well.  Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
3  lb. hamburger
1  clove garlic
1  Tbsp. parsley
1  Tbsp. basil
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  lb. tomatoes
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
9  lasagna noodles
36  oz. cottage cheese
2  beaten eggs
2  Tbsp. parsley
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown meat and drain.  Add first 6 ingredients to meat and simmer 45 to 60 minutes.  Combine cottage cheese with eggs, parsley, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper.  Layer in lasagna pan, noodles, meat mixture, cottage cheese mixture and Mozzarella cheese.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: SWEET AND SOUR SPARERIBS
ingredients:
2  lb. spareribs
1/2  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2 to 3  drops red pepper sauce
preparation: Place ribs, meaty side up, in rack in foil-lined shallow pan. Mix remaining ingredients; pour about 1/3 cup sauce on ribs. Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven until done, 1 1/2 to 2 hours, basting 3 or 4 times with remaining sauce.

name: HAM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. frozen hash browns
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1  can mushroom soup
3/4  c. milk
1/2c.  mayonnaise
2  c. cut-up ham
preparation: Put thawed hash browns in bottom of baking dish; cover with broccoli.  Mix mushroom soup with milk and mayonnaise; mix well. Add ham to that and pour on top of broccoli.  Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

name: LUCKY IF YOU GET A PIECE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
2  c. flour
1  c. nuts (pecans)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  box powdered sugar
1  pt. strawberries
2  bananas, sliced
1  pkg. strawberry glaze
preparation: Melt butter; add flour and nuts.  Mix well in a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.  Spread evenly in bottom of pan.  Bake at 250° about 15 to 20 minutes.  Cool completely.  Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and powdered sugar.  Spread on cooled crust.  Add strawberries and bananas together and spread on top of cream cheese mixture.  Then spread strawberry glaze on top of that.  Sprinkle with crushed pecans and chill.

name: CHERRY SALAD SUPREME
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry-flavored gelatin
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon-flavored gelatin
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/3  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1 (8 3/4 oz.)  can (1 c.) crushed pineapple
preparation: Dissolve raspberry gelatin in 1 cup boiling water; stir in pie filling.  Turn into a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; chill until partially set.  Dissolve lemon gelatin in 1 cup boiling water. Beat together cream cheese and mayonnaise.  Gradually add lemon gelatin; stir in undrained pineapple.  Whip 1/2 cup whipping cream; fold into lemon mixture with 1 cup tiny marshmallows.  Spread atop cherry layer; top with 2 tablespoons chopped nuts.  Chill until set.  Makes 12 servings.

name: CABBAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
1  head cabbage
1  lb. hamburger
1  egg
1/2  c. rice
1  small onion
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1 large  can tomato soup
preparation: Cut core from head of cabbage; peel off 12 leaves.  Cover with water; bring to boil, remove and drain.  Mix hamburger, egg, rice, onion and Parmesan cheese.  Fill each leaf and roll.  Put in baking pan and top with tomato soup.   Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  stick butter, melted
preparation: Mix and press into dish (the crust), dish size approximately 12 x 7 1/2-inch.

name: FUDGE PIE
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
2  eggs
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt margarine, add sugar and cocoa; stir well.  Add eggs and stir well, do not beat.  Add milk and vanilla; stir well.  Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and continue baking 20 to 25 minutes.  Cool before slicing.

name: HORSERADISH SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. prepared horseradish
1/4  c. sur cream
1/4  c. mayonnaise
preparation: In a bowl, combine all the ingredients.  Serve with beef.

name: OYSTER STEW
ingredients:
2 small  cans oysters
2  cans evaporated milk
4  c. whole milk
1/2  stick butter or margarine
salt to taste
pepper to taste
preparation: Put all ingredients, including oyster stock, in large pot. Heat on medium-low until hot and margarine has melted.  Stir frequently.  Do not allow stew to boil.  Serve with oyster crackers.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can green beans drained
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. fried bacon crumbled
1/2  c. almonds slivered
1  stick butter
preparation: In a greased baking dish (butter flavored Crisco); layer green beans, brown sugar, garlic powder and bacon to the top. Melt butter and mix with crackers; then spread cracker mixture and almonds over top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: COOL WHIP DESSERT
ingredients:
1 small  box jello
1  c. sour cream
1  container Cool Whip
marshmallows
3  cans mandarin oranges, drained
preparation: Mix all together and serve.

name: SUMMER SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow or zucchini squash, sliced 3/8-inch thick (approximately 7 c.)
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1  c. dairy sour cream
1  c. shredded carrot
1/4  c. butter or margarine
2  c. herb-seasoned stuffing mix (about 1/2 of an 8 oz.  bag)
preparation: Cook squash with onion in boiling water (salted) about 5 minutes.  Drain well.  Combine soup and sour cream.  Stir in carrot.  Fold in drained squash and onion.  Melt butter or margarine; toss with stuffing mix.

name: CAROLINA COOLER
ingredients:
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 (32 oz.)  bottle ginger ale
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen limeade, thawed
2  c. vanilla ice cream, softened
few ice cubes
preparation: Combine pineapple juice and limeade in a punch bowl.  Pour chilled juices and ginger ale over ice cream.  Add ice cubes. Garnish with orange slices, strawberries or mint sprigs.

name: SESAME SEED STICKS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2/3  c. butter
1  egg
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sesame seed
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together into bowl.  With blender, cut in shortening until mixture has look of large crumbs.  Add egg, milk and vanilla; mix with fork just until dough holds together.  Knead several times until smooth.  Shape tablespoon of dough into ovals. Roll in seed.  Bake at 375° (190°C) for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
8  c. lettuce
1/2  onion, chopped fine
2  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1 (10 oz.)  box frozen peas
1  c. grated sharp cheese
2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. plain yogurt
preparation: In large bowl, layer half of all ingredients.  Sprinkle teaspoon sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper on top. Mix mayonnaise and yogurt well.  Spread 1/2 of dressing on top. Repeat with all other ingredients, ending with dressing.  Spread other cheese pressing on top.  Cover and chill.

name: SKIPPER'S SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. oil
1  bunch green onions and tops
3  ribs chopped celery
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can beef broth
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. thyme
1  tsp. crushed bay leaves
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  good dash hot pepper sauce (like Tabasco)
1  c. long grain rice
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
12  oz. shrimp
preparation: Cook onions and celery in oil until tender.  Add celery, tomatoes, tomato sauce, broth, chili powder, salt, sugar, thyme, bay leaves, Worcestershire sauce and hot pepper sauce.  Cook 45 minutes, then add chopped green pepper and shrimp.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  can mushroom soup
1  pkg. Tater Tots
preparation: Brown hamburger and drain off fat.  Mix soup and hamburger together.  Pour into pan (9 or 10-inch).  Put Tater Tots on top. Bake at 350° until brown.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
2  c. (16 oz.) sour cream
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
1/4  c. finely chopped sweet red pepper
1/4  c. chopped green onions
1  garlic clove, minced
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. hot pepper sauce
preparation: In a bowl, combine the sour cream, spinach, red pepper, onions, garlic, salt and hot pepper sauce. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Serve with tortilla chips or crackers.

name: BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli cuts
1  can cream of broccoli soup or mushroom
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. soy sauce
pepper
1 (2.8 oz.)  can French fried onions
preparation: Cook broccoli cuts according to directions.  Drain.  In a small bowl combine soup, milk and soy sauce.  In 1 1/2-quart casserole layer half of the broccoli, half soup and 1/2 French fried onions.  Top with rest of broccoli and soup mix.  Bake 25 minutes at 350°.  Add remaining onions and bake 5 minutes more.

name: ORANGE PORK TENDERLOIN
ingredients:
1  whole pork tenderloin
1  Tbsp. butter, softened
1/4  tsp. dried thyme, crushed
dash of cayenne pepper
3/4 to 1  c. orange juice
1  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. aromatic bitters
preparation: Mix butter, thyme and cayenne pepper. Spread evenly over tenderloin.  Place tenderloin in shallow roasting pan and pour 3/4 cup orange juice over meat.  Roast in a 375° oven for 25 to 30 minutes to 155° to 160° on meat thermometer, basting occasionally. Remove meat to serving platter.  Keep warm.  Measure basting liquid into small saucepan, adding additional orange juice, if necessary, to make 3/4 cup.  Quickly whisk in flour, sugar and butter. Cook and stir until mixture boils and thickens. Cut tenderloin in 1-inch slices and serve with sauce.  Makes 4 servings.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. plain flour, sifted
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. cloves
1  c. Wesson oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. raisins
3 1/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
4  eggs
1 (1 lb.)  can pumpkin
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Sift flour, salt, sugar, cinnamon, soda, nutmeg and cloves together; make a hole in center.  Add eggs, Wesson oil, pumpkin, vanilla, nuts and raisins; mix together.  Bake in a greased and floured tube pan.  Bake at 325° for about 1 1/2 hours.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  boxes Jiffy cornbread mix
4  eggs
1  (12 oz.) cottage cheese
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1 1/2  sticks margarine
preparation: Melt margarine in pan.  Combine all ingredients.  The frozen broccoli should be thawed and drained.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: BLACK FOREST CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. devil's food cake mix
1 (2 lb.)  can cherry pie filling
oil
eggs
Cool Whip
maraschino cherries
chocolate scrapings or drizzle
preparation: Make cake according to directions on box, stirring in cherry pie filling.  Divide into 2 or 3 well-greased round layer cake pans.  Bake as directed.  Check for doneness.  Let cake cool.

name: SANGRIA
ingredients:
1  bottle red Burgundy wine
32  oz. bottle apple juice
12  oz. frozen lemonade concentrate
32  oz. ginger ale or 7-Up
1  lemon, thinly sliced
1  orange, thinly sliced
preparation: Combine liquid ingredients and float lemon and orange slices on top.   Add plenty of ice to punch bowl.

name: RITCH'S SOUR CREAM BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
3  c. milk
8  oz. sour cream
1  box vanilla wafers
2 small  boxes instant vanilla pudding
16  oz. Cool Whip
4  to 6 bananas
preparation: Mix milk and vanilla pudding together.  Add sour cream and 8 ounces of Cool Whip.  Set aside.  Line the bottom of a bowl with a layer of wafers.  Slice 2 to 3 bananas and place on top of wafers. Cover with pudding mixture.  Put a second layer of wafers on pudding mixture.  Top with a second layer of bananas.  Cover with remaining Cool Whip.

name: FRENCH BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  pkg. dry yeast
2  c. warm water
2  Tbsp. honey
6 to 7  c. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. corn meal
preparation: Sprinkle yeast over water and honey.  Stir.  Slowly add flour and salt; beat with wooden spoon. Turn dough out on floured board and knead 8 to 10 minutes.  Place dough in lightly greased bowl. Cover and let rise 2 hours.  Sprinkle corn meal in well-greased loaf pans.  Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: MAYONNAISE(Old Fashion)
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. water
1  egg
