preparation: Beat the egg, add the flour, salt and sugar.  Stir until well mixed.  Add the vinegar and water.  Cook until almost transparent. Perfect for potato salad.  Add a little extra sugar for apple salad.

name: STRAWBERRY FRUIT FROST
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. strawberries
2  small ripe bananas, broken into pieces
1  c. peach slices
1  c. apple juice
1  Tbsp. honey
1  c. ice cubes
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except ice cubes into blender and blend.  Gradually add ice cubes and keep cutting blender on and off until all cubes are crushed.  Serve.

name: VEAL STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. veal cubes
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. Crisco
small garlic, minced
1  can chicken broth or 3 bouillon cubes in 1 c. water
1  oz. can tomato sauce
1/2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. butter
1  large onion, sliced thin
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 small  can mushrooms
preparation: Shake veal cubes in salt and flour mixture. Brown in butter and Crisco. Add onion, garlic, pepper and broth.  Simmer 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Let stand for 10 minutes.  Then add tomato sauce and mushrooms. Serve over hot rice or noodles.

name: SHRIMP BATTER
ingredients:
2  beaten eggs
3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. cold water
1/4  c. cornstarch
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Dip shrimp and fry.

name: PRUNE BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped prunes
2  c. boiling water
1/2  c. oleo
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
4  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. chopped nuts
2  tsp. soda
preparation: Combine raisins, prunes and boiling water.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Cream oleo, sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Add flour, cinnamon and chopped nuts.  Add soda to raisin mixture and dump into cake batter.  Stir until mixed.  Grease and flour loaf pans or cans.  Soup cans make nice little round loaves.  If you use cans, place them on a cookie sheet.  Fill about 1/3 full.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SAUERKRAUT CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  to 6 chicken breasts, skinned
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
Thousand Island dressing
16  oz. can sauerkraut, drained and rinsed
Mozzarella cheese slices
preparation: Place chicken in Pyrex dish. Top each breast with half of slice of Mozzarella cheese. Rinse and drain sauerkraut, then mix with brown sugar.  Put sauerkraut over chicken and cheese. Cover sauerkraut with bottled Thousand Island dressing.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

name: LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. pork sausage (ground)
1 big  jar Ragu (green pepper)
1  can tomato sauce (add oregano and parsley to sauce)
1  box lasagne noodles
2  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1  large container Ricotta cheese
1 large  pkg. Provolone cheese
preparation: Layer sauce, noodles, Ricotta, Mozzarella, sauce, etc. Bake until brown and bubbly.

name: EASY MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
2  slices loaf bread
1/2  c. sweet milk
1  small onion, chopped fine
2  Tbsp. chopped sweet pepper (fine)
1  egg
3/4  c. tomato ketchup
salt and black pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well.  Place in oblong baking dish and cover top with ketchup.  Bake at 400° for approximately 1 hour.  I put foil over the top for the first 1/2 hour, then uncover to let brown.

name: COLE SLAW DRESSING
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. vinegar
3 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
4 or 5  Tbsp. half and half
preparation: Mix the ingredients together and pour over cabbage.

name: FUDGY PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter or margarine
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. Hershey's cocoa
3  eggs
1  c. light corn syrup
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped pecans
1  unbaked 9-inch pie crust
sweetened whipped cream
pecan halves (optional)
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  In saucepan, melt butter or margarine. Add sugar and cocoa; stir until well blended.  Remove from heat; cool.  In medium bowl, beat eggs slightly.  Stir in corn syrup and salt.  Add cocoa mixture; blend well.  Stir in chopped pecans.

name: CRUNCHY PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1/4  lb. cracked graham crackers
1  lb. box powdered sugar
1  c. finely chopped walnuts
1  c. crunchy peanut butter
12  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
1/2  stick paraffin wax
1  c. flaked coconut
2  sticks (1 c.) soft margarine
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients together and then form into balls the size of walnuts (3/4-inch).  Chill overnight.  After chilling, place chocolate chips and paraffin wax in double boiler and melt together.  Remove peanut butter balls from fridge and dip each one in chocolate.  Place coated balls on waxed paper to harden.  When finished, it's best to store them in sealed container in refrigerator with wax paper between layers.  Makes about 90 delicious balls that melt in your mouth.

name: SHRIMP SCAMPI
ingredients:
1  lb. raw shrimp
1  beaten egg
1/4  c. white wine
3  cloves crushed garlic
3  Tbsp. butter
salt and pepper
preparation: In skillet, beat butter and garlic until sizzling.  Dip shrimp in egg and quickly drop in skillet.  Saute quickly over high heat 2 to 4 minutes.  Add white wine, salt and pepper.  Serve over a bed of rice.   Makes 5 servings.

name: COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1  lb. cabbage
1 1/4  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. sugar
6  Tbsp. mayonnaise
4  Tbsp. vinegar
4  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Shred cabbage.  Sprinkle 1 1/4 teaspoons salt over top of cabbage.  While cabbage wilts, mix in jar or shaker: sugar, mayonnaise, vinegar and milk.  Stir cabbage and add dressing.

name: COOKED MAYONNAISE FOR CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. sugar
1 heaping  Tbsp. flour, sifted in
2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. water
salt and cayenne pepper to taste
preparation: Cook in top of double boiler and stir constantly.  When thickened, take off and add salt and red pepper.

name: CRANBERRY FRUIT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. shortening
1  Tbsp. grated orange peel
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. orange juice
1  egg, well beaten
1 to 2  c. fresh chopped cranberries
preparation: Sift all dry ingredients.  Blend in shortening well.  Combine orange juice and rind in beaten egg.  Pour all at once over dry ingredients, mixing just enough to dampen.  Carefully fold in nuts and cranberries.  Spoon into greased loaf pan.  Spread to corners higher than center.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: GOULASH
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. box macaroni
1  medium onion, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: In large skillet, brown your hamburger and onion.  Add 1 teaspoon salt.  Cook macaroni in water with 1/2 teaspoon salt added.  Drain hamburger and onion, then drain macaroni.

name: PORK LOIN
ingredients:
1/4 to 1/2  c. Kikkoman soy sauce
1/2 to 1  c. water
1/4 to 1/2  c. Mitsukan rice vinegar *
small amount sugar (optional)
1  c. water
1  c. soy sauce
3/4  c. sugar
dash of sake
preparation: Dip pork loin in soy sauce and rub in with your hands.  Brown meat lightly in a roasting pan.  Boil sauce ingredients in a separate pan that is large enough to hold pork for further cooking after the browning process.  After sauce comes to a boil, add meat and stir often to prevent scorching.  Cook until transparent juices run from meat when testing fork is inserted.  Remove meat and allow to cool before slicing.  Allow remaining liquid to reduce in volume and thicken to be served as a sauce/gravy for pork loin.

name: PUMPKIN CUPCAKES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. butter, softened
1 1/3  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. pumpkin
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Combine  dry ingredients.  Beat butter with sugar;  add eggs and  pumpkin.  Then add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.  Makes 2 dozen cupcakes or one cake.

name: GUACAMOLE DIP
ingredients:
2  ripe avocados, mashed
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tomato, chopped finely
1  tsp. onion powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  green pepper, chopped finely
preparation: Mix together all ingredients.  Fold in soy mayonnaise.  Stir and chill.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  can crushed pineapple, do not drain
1  yellow cake mix
2  sticks oleo
preparation: Pour cherry pie filling and crushed pineapple into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Mix the undrained pineapple and pie filling together. Dump the dry cake mix over top of fruit, spreading it out evenly. Slice oleo thinly and place on top of cake mix. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour until golden brown.  It will become crisp on top. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

name: CREAMY CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. crushed chocolate wafers
1/4  c. butter, melted
12  oz. pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
3  Tbsp. strong coffee
1 1/2  c. heavy cream (just to boiling point)
5  egg yolks
preparation: Place chocolate wafers and butter in a 9-inch pie plate; press into crust.  In blender, place chocolate chips, egg yolks, coffee and cream; blend until smooth.  The hot cream will cook the eggs. Pour into pie crust and refrigerate until firm.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. oil
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. milk
2  c. flour
3  ripe bananas
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix together; pour into greased bread pans and bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: OLD SETTLERS BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
8  strips bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces
1  small onion, chopped
1  can B&M beans, drained of liquid
1  can kidney beans, drained
1  can butter or yellow lima beans, drained
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/4  c. ketchup
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. molasses
preparation: Brown  in  pan	ground beef, bacon and onion.  Pour off fat and put in crock-pot.  Add beans.  To mixture, add remaining ingredients.  Mix  well  in crock-pot.  Cook on low 3 to 4 hours. Or,  if  you  prefer, put mixture in 9 x 12-inch Pyrex dish and bake at 325° for 1/2 hour.	Serves 8.

name: SARA'S EASY TORTILLA SOUP
ingredients:
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can tomatoes (undrained)
1  medium onion, diced
1  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. cilantro or parsley
1/4  tsp. sugar, salt and pepper
5  c. chicken broth
2  c. Monterey cheese, cubed
2  medium avocados, diced
8  oz. fried corn tortilla chips
preparation: In blender, combine undrained tomatoes, onion, garlic, cilantro and sugar. Blend until chunky. In a large pot, add vegetable mixture and chicken broth. Simmer 20 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  c. oil
3  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. nuts
2  c. grated zucchini
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Peel and grate zucchini.  Mix sugar, eggs, oil and vanilla. Sift flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt and cinnamon.  Mix all together.  Add zucchini and nuts.  Bake in 2 greased bread pans at 350° about 1 hour (can be glazed).

name: DELICIOUS MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
8  c. cooked macaroni shells
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped onion
1  can sliced olives
1  green pepper, diced
1  can shrimp, drained
3  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1/2  c. Ranch dressing
1  c. salad dressing
preparation: Mix all together.  Salt and pepper to taste.

name: OLD FASHIONED VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
2  soup bones
1  Tbsp. salt
2  carrots, diced
1  onion, diced
1  c. peas
1  c. tomatoes
2  stalks celery, diced
1  c. sliced okra
preparation: Bring soup bones and 3 quarts of water to a boil.  Reduce heat.  Simmer, covered, for 1 hour and 30 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients.  Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

name: SOUTHERN APPLE PIE
ingredients:
6  apples, sliced
6  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
1 scant  c. flour
preparation: Place apples in pie shell.  Mix flour, sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples.  Make crumb mixture of other ingredients. Sprinkle over apples.   Bake 20 minutes at 450°.   Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.  Serve with ice cream.

name: SARAH'S POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  tsp. salt
2  sticks butter
1/2  c. Crisco
5  eggs
3  tsp. lemon extract
3  c. sugar
3 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
preparation: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar thoroughly.  Sift flour once. Add dry ingredients, then sift 4 more times.

name: SWEET POTATO SOUFFLE
ingredients:
3  c. potatoes, mashed
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put in casserole.  Top with topping.

name: CHICKEN PUFFS
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. (3 oz. each) cream cheese, softened
5  Tbsp. butter, melted
2  c. diced, cooked chicken
1/4  c. milk
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. diced pimientos
2  cans (8 oz. each) crescent rolls
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a large bowl mix together the cream cheese and 3 tablespoons melted butter.  Add the chicken, milk, pepper, minced onion and pimientos; mix well.  Separate each package of crescent rolls into 4 rectangles.  Divide the chicken filling evenly and spoon into center of each rectangle.  Bring ends up together and pinch closed.  Brush with remaining 2 tablespoons of melted butter.  Place puffs on a greased cookie sheet and bake 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIRS
ingredients:
1  c. water
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. flour
4  eggs
1 large  box instant pudding
Cool Whip
1  oz. cocoa
1  tsp. butter
2  Tbsp. hot water
1  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Add butter to water; bring to rolling boil. Stir in flour vigorously over low heat.  Beat 1 minute until mixture forms a ball.  Beat in eggs, one at a time, until smooth. Drop 1/4 cup of the mixture onto ungreased cookie sheet, spacing 3 inches apart.  Bake for 35 to 40 minutes.  Remove from oven; keep away from drafts.  Allow to cool.

name: TURKEY BREAST SCALLOPINI
ingredients:
4  turkey breast cutlets (or boneless chicken breast)
1/4  c. grated Parmesan
1/4  c. bread crumbs
3  Tbsp. butter
juice of 1 lemon
preparation: Pat the cutlets dry.  Mix the Parmesan and bread crumbs. Press the mixture into both sides of cutlets.  Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in skillet.  Add the breast, brown on both sides.  Cook about 5 minutes on each side.  Transfer to a warm platter.  Add lemon juice to pan, scrape the browned bits into sauce.  Add the remaining spoon of butter.  Pour over cutlets, serve immediately.

name: CHICKEN FLAUTAS
ingredients:
2  whole chicken breasts
1  c. water
1  c. Monterey cheese
1  (4 oz.) diced green chilies, drained
1/2  tsp. ground cumin
16  flour tortillas
shredded lettuce
guacamole dip
sour cream
salsa sauce
preparation: Boil chicken until tender.  Drain well.  Let stand cool. Shred chicken and add cheese, chili peppers and cumin.  Heat tortillas to soften.  Overlap 2 tortillas by about half.  Spoon about 1/3 cup of chicken mixture down center and roll up tightly. Fry in skillet of oil until crisp and golden brown.  Drain.  Serve on lettuce bed with guacamole, sour cream and salsa.

name: SUTTLE CHILI
ingredients:
2  # ground raw turkey
1  1/2 chopped onion
1  clove minced garlic
2  1/2 c water
1  to 2 Tbsp chili powder
1  Tbsp dried parsley flakes
1  tsp paprika
1  tsp dry mustard
1/2  tsp salt
2 16 oz  cans red kidney beans, drained
2 4 oz  cans mushrooms stems and pieces
1 14 1/2 oz  can diced tomatoes with green chiles
1  bay leaf
preparation: Brown turkey, onion, garlic and drain drippings.  Add water and remaining ingredients.  Bring to boil and cover.  Reduce heat and simmer 1 hour.  Uncover, simmer 1 hour.  Stir from time to time.  Discard bay leaf.  Yield 10 1/2 cups.

name: MICROWAVE FUDGE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  lb. powdered sugar
1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
nuts (optional)
preparation: Put butter, sugar, cocoa and milk in microwave.  Cook for 2 minutes on High.  Remove.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Stir and pour in buttered pan.

name: AUNT GEORGIE'S SCALLOPED CABBAGE
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. cabbage
3  Tbsp. margarine
3  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. water from cabbage
3/4  c. evaporated milk
8  oz. grated American cheese
preparation: Cook cabbage in boiling, salted water for 7 minutes; save 3/4 cup water.  Make white sauce with margarine, flour, water and milk.  In buttered casserole, put layer of cabbage, layer white sauce, 1/2 of cheese; repeat.  Melt 2 tablespoons margarine with 1/2 cup bread crumbs; top casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large onion
1  c. milk
1/2  c. water
2  c. uncooked Minute rice
1 (16 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  box frozen broccoli
2  cans French fried onions (Durkee)
preparation: Saute onions in 1 tablespoon of butter.  Cook broccoli as directed on package and drain.  Mix all ingredients together, except Durkee onions, and place in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Bake at 325° for 1/2 hour.  Add onions on top last 5 minutes.  Bake longer if not quite set.

name: CHOCOLATE CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter, melted
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
2  eggs, beaten
1 small  can evaporated milk
1  tsp. vanilla extract
pinch of salt
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Combine first 7 ingredients in bowl, mix well.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 30 or 40 minutes or until set.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen broccoli
1/4  c. salad dressing
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. minced onion
1  egg, beaten
4  oz. grated sharp cheese
preparation: Cook broccoli as directed on package; drain.  Then mix all ingredients together, leaving cheese to sprinkle on top of casserole.  Bake with lid on dish at 400° for 30 to 34 minutes.

name: Peanut Butter Candy
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1  pt. marshmallow cream
1  c. Rice Krispies
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix and place in freezer for 20 minutes.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Dip in almond bark or butterscotch chips.

name: MICROWAVE LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground meat
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1/2  c. water
8  uncooked lasagna noodles
2  c. cottage cheese
3  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Crumble beef into a microwave-safe colander.  Place colander in a 9-inch pie plate.  Cover with wax paper; microwave at High for 5 to 6 minutes or until the meat is no longer pink, stirring after 3 minutes.

name: BOSTON BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. dry navy beans
1/4  lb. salt pork or bacon
1/4  c. molasses
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1  small onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Soak beans overnight in water.  Drain.  Cook beans in 1-quart water until tender, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Add more hot water, if necessary.  Drain and rinse with cold water.  Put pork in bottom of a deep casserole.  Add beans and remaining ingredients. Cover and bake at 325° for 4 hours.  Add water if beans become too dry while cooking.

name: CHOCOLATE KRISPIES(A Delicious Chewy Blend of Chocolate And Peanut Butter)
ingredients:
1  c. white Karo
1  c. sugar
18  oz. jar peanut butter (smooth or crunchy)
5 1/2  c. Rice Krispies
1  large bag semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  large bag butterscotch chips
preparation: Heat sugar and Karo until sugar dissolves.  Add peanut butter. Stir until melted.  Add Rice Krispies and cool slightly.  Spread this mixture in a buttered cookie sheet pan (12 x 8-inch).

name: PEPPER STEAK WITH RICE
ingredients:
3  c. hot cooked rice
1  lb. lean beef round steak, cut 1/2-inch thick
1  Tbsp. paprika
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1 1/2  c. beef broth
1  c. sliced green onions (tops also)
2  green peppers, cut in strips
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  large tomatoes, cut in 1/8's
preparation: While  rice  is cooking, pound steak to 1/4-inch thickness; cut  into  1/4-inch strips.  Sprinkle meat with paprika and  allow to stand while preparing other ingredients.  Using large skillet,  brown  meat in butter.  Add garlic and broth. Cover  and simmer  30 minutes.  Stir in onions and green peppers;  cover and cook 5 minutes.  Blend cornstarch, soy sauce and  water.  Stir into  meat  mixture.  Cook, stirring, until clear  and thickened (about 2 minutes).  Add tomatoes and stir gently.  Serve over beds of fluffy rice.

name: CREAMY BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1 1/2  c. cold water
1  pkg. vanilla or French vanilla instant pudding (4 serving size box)
2  c. (1 pt.) whipping cream, whipped
1  box Nabisco vanilla wafers
3  bananas, sliced and dipped in lemon juice
preparation: In large bowl, combine condensed milk and water.  Add pudding mix; beat well with mixer.  Chill for 5 minutes in freezer. Meanwhile, whip cream until soft peaks form.  Remove from freezer; fold in whipped cream.  Spoon 1 cup of pudding mixture into bottom of a punch bowl (or 2 1/2-quart glass bowl).  Add vanilla wafers on top of pudding, then layer with sliced bananas.  Continue layering, ending with vanilla wafers.  Keep chilled until serving time.  This makes a large, rich pudding!

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. raspberry or strawberry Jell-O
1  orange and rind, grated
2  c. sugar
1  pkg. cranberries
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. nuts
preparation: Chop cranberries and orange in blender.  Mix with pineapple and sugar.  Let this set.  In another bowl mix Jell-O as directed on package.  Add cranberry mixture to Jell-O.  Add nuts.  Put in refrigerator to chill.

name: CRUSTY CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  cooked chicken
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
preparation: Bone chicken and cut meat into bite-sized pieces. Arrange in a well-greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Sift flour, baking powder, salt and poultry seasoning. Is a separate bowl, beat eggs until light and fluffy. Add milk and butter; mix well. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the egg mixture. Mix until well blended; pour over chicken. Bake at 350° for about 50 minutes, until golden brown and puffy.

name: DIABETIC SUGARLESS DATE COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. water
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/3  c. shortening
2  c. dates or raisins
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. soda
1 1/4  tsp. liquid sweetener
1  tsp. soda
2  Tbsp. water
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix together eggs, 2 tablespoons soda, liquid sweetener, 1 teaspoon soda and water.  Add first mixture.  Add flour and baking powder.  Drop by teaspoon on baking sheet.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: HOT CRAB DIP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  drops Tabasco sauce
1/4  c. light cream
1  tsp. onion, finely chopped
1  tsp. garlic flakes
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/8  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
6 1/2  oz. crab meat
preparation: Drain crab meat.  Pour lemon juice over crab meat.  Combine remaining ingredients; add to crab meat and juice.  Put in saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally until creamy.  Serve with any type of cracker.

name: KASHA AND MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  c. medium buckwheat grouts (whole, coarse or fine may be used also)
1  egg (or egg substitute)
2  c. boiling chicken stock
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. canola oil
1  large onion, chopped
10  to 12 large mushrooms, sliced
salt to taste
preparation: In a small bowl, mix grouts with egg until each grout is well coated with egg.  Place in medium size saucepan over moderately high heat, and stir constantly with a wooden spoon until grouts separate and the egg begins to dry.  Remove from heat and pour boiling chicken stock or water over kasha.  Add salt and stir. Cover tightly and cook over low heat at a bare simmer for 10 to 15 minutes, or until all the liquid is absorbed.  Remove from heat and reserve.

name: EASY MICROWAVE FUDGE
ingredients:
1  (12 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
3/4  c. miniature marshmallows
3/4  c. coarsely cut walnuts
preparation: Microwave chips 2 1/2 minutes and stir.  May need to microwave 1 1/2 to 2 more minutes. Stir until smooth.  Stir in marshmallows until melted and smooth.  Stir in nuts.  Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/3  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. tomato juice
2  c. water
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. onion salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
hot sauce to taste
preparation: Mix and simmer about 1 hour.  Will refrigerate good for several days.

name: ZUCCHINI BEEF SKILLET
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. chopped green peppers
1  clove garlic, minced
1 1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. chili powder (more to taste)
5  c. sliced zucchini or yellow summer squash
2  large tomatoes, peeled and chopped
1 1/4  c. fresh whole kernel corn (may be frozen or canned)
1/4  c. chopped fresh parsley
2  Tbsp. chopped pimientos
preparation: Saute beef, onion, green pepper and garlic until well browned. Add remaining ingredients.  Cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender.  Makes 6 servings.  I double or triple this and freeze for later use.

name: THE ALL AMERICAN DESSERT
ingredients:
4  c. boiling water
8  oz. Jell-O (red)
8  oz. Jell-O (blue)
2  c. cold water
8  oz. tub Cool Whip, thawed
4  c. pound cake cubes
2  c. sliced strawberries
1  c. fresh blueberries
preparation: Stir 2 cups boiling water into 2 bowls until Jell-O is completely dissolved.  Stir 1 cup cold water into each bowl.  Pour into separate 13 x 9-inch pans.  Refrigerate 3 hours.  Cut into 1/2-inch cubes.  Layer red and blue Jell-O, Cool Whip, blueberries, cake cubes and strawberries in 3-quart clear bowl. Chill 1 hour and serve.

name: FINGER JUICES GELATIN
ingredients:
3 (4.2 oz.)  bottles infant juice (apple, apple-cherry or apple-grape)
2  envelopes unflavored gelatin
preparation: In a 1-quart square casserole dish, sprinkle gelatin over juice.  Let stand 3 minutes.  Microwave on High for 1 minute; stir.  Microwave on High for 2 minutes.  Remove; stir until completely dissolved.  Chill until firm (approximately 3 hours). Cut into blocks.

name: STRAWBERRY PRETZEL DESSERT
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin
2  c. boiling water
1/2  c. cold water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, partially defrosted
3  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  sticks margarine
2  c. coarse, crushed pretzels
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. powdered sugar
1  small container whipped topping
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add cold water.  Add berries and set aside to cool.  Do not refrigerate.  Cream 3 tablespoons sugar with margarine; add pretzels.  Press in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 10 minutes at 350°; cool.  Blend cream cheese with powdered sugar.  Add whipped topping.  Spread cream cheese mixture over cooled crust and let firm up in refrigerator.  When cream cheese mixture firms, top with strawberry mix and refrigerate overnight.

name: CREAM FLUFF
ingredients:
1/2  angel food cake, crumbled
2  boxes strawberry jello
1 1/4  c. boiling water
2  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1 1/2  pt. whipping cream
preparation: Arrange cake pieces in buttered 9-inch cake pan or large bowl.  Dissolve jello in boiling water; stir in strawberries. Whip cream and fold into jello mixture.  Pour over cake pieces and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours or until set.  Yield:  6 servings.

name: GROUND BEEF GRAND STYLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. milk
salt to taste
1/4  c. ketchup
1  can biscuits
preparation: Brown beef and onion.  Add softened cream cheese and other ingredients.  Bake for 10 minutes at 375°.

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. unsweetened applesauce
4  tsp. soda
1  c. shortening
2  c. sugar (1 white and 1 brown)
2  eggs
4  c. cake flour
1  tsp. each: cinnamon, cloves and salt
1  c. candied cherries
1  box raisins
1  c. nuts
1  can coconut (leave out if desired)
preparation: Mix soda and applesauce; beat.  Mix sugar, shortening and eggs.  Add to applesauce mix.  Mix spices and flour; add to mixture.  Add nuts, coconut, cherries and raisins to mixture.  Put a little flour on fruits.  Add 1 cup orange juice for moisture. Bake about 2 1/2 hours at 250° or 275°.

name: NO BAKE INSTANT PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
2 (3 3/4 oz.)  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1 1/3  c. milk
1  c. pumpkin
1 1/2  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip (4 c.), thawed
1  baked pie shell or graham cracker crust
pecan halves (optional)
preparation: Add vanilla pudding to milk in bowl. Beat at lowest speed just until blended, about 30 seconds. Blend in pumpkin, spice and 2 cups Cool Whip. Pour into pie shell. Chill until set, at least 4 hours. Garnish with remaining Cool Whip and pecan halves. Enjoy.

name: PINTO BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
1  bell pepper, finely diced
1  large onion, finely diced
1  can tomato soup
1  c. cooked macaroni
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  can cooked pinto beans, drained of liquid
preparation: Cook first 3 ingredients in frying pan until done.  Drain off liquid and put in a baking dish or pan.  Then add remaining ingredients.  Stir and top with grated cheese.  Bake at 350° until the cheese melts, usually about 15 minutes.  If you want to you can make ahead of time and while the cheese is melting it will get warm.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  large hen or 6 chicken breasts
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. pepper and salt
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. mayonnaise
3  hard-boiled eggs
1/2  c. almonds
2  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Chop up chicken.  Mix all together except almonds and chips. Put in baking dish. Sprinkle almonds on top, then potato chips. Bake at 450° for 14 minutes.  May be frozen.  Serves 6 to 7.

name: SWEDISH MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  c. breadcrumbs
1 (10 oz.)  bottle chili sauce
1 (6 oz.)  bottle grape jelly
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  egg
1/4  c. dried minced onions
preparation: Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper, egg and minced onions together.  Roll into small balls about the size of a walnut or smaller; brown thoroughly.  While you are browning the meatballs, place the grape jelly and chili sauce in a fairly large cooker and heat until bubbling.  When meatballs are browned, place in cooker with chili sauce and jelly and simmer for several hours (the longer the better).

name: P. B. AND FUDGE ICE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  (6 oz.) graham cracker pie crust
1/2  c. creamy peanut butter
1/4  c. honey
1  qt. vanilla ice cream, softened
1/2  c. cashews, chopped
6  oz. chocolate fudge topping
preparation: Mix peanut butter and honey.  Stir mixture into softened ice cream.  Spoon half of ice cream mixture into pie crust.   Sprinkle with half of chopped cashews.  Drizzle 4 ounces fudge sauce over cashews.  Spoon remaining ice cream mixture in pie shell. Sprinkle with remaining cashews.  Drizzle 2 ounces fudge sauce over cashews.  Freeze overnight.  Garnish with Cool Whip.

name: SOMBRERO SPREAD
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. chopped onion, divided
1/4  c. extra hot ketchup
1 1/2  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (8 oz.)  can kidney beans (undrained)
1/2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. chopped green olives
corn chips
preparation: Brown meat and 1/4 cup chopped onion in skillet.  Stir in ketchup, chili powder and salt.  Add beans, including liquid; mash to mix thoroughly with other ingredients.  Heat.  Garnish with shredded cheese, remaining 1/2 cup chopped onion and olives. Serve with corn chips.  Makes about 3 cups.

name: POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
10  qt. popped corn (40 c.)
1  c. molasses
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Combine molasses, sugar, salt and butter.  Cook slowly while popcorn is popping.  Pour molasses mixture over corn and shape into balls.

name: JELLIED OLD-FASHIONED COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1  c. hot water
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. grated onion
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  c. fine shredded cabbage
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cold water
1/2  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Dissolve gelatin and salt in hot water.  Add cold water and chill until syrupy.  Fold in remaining ingredients except cabbage. Chill until slightly thickened.  Fold in cabbage.  Chill until firm.

name: COLD YELLOW SQUASH SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow squash
1  onion, chopped
5  bouillon cubes
3  c. water
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  tsp. curry powder
pinch of seasoned salt
pinch of garlic salt
pinch of red pepper
preparation: Boil squash and onion in bouillon until tender.  Puree in blender.  Add cream cheese, curry powder, seasoned salt, garlic salt and red pepper to taste.  Continue blending until frothy and well mixed.  Serve cold with garnish of parsley and sour cream, if desired.

name: BUBBLE BREAD
ingredients:
1  box vanilla pudding (not instant)
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  sticks (3/4 c.) oleo
3  Tbsp. milk
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  loaves frozen bread dough, thawed, but do not let raise
preparation: Bring pudding mix, sugar, oleo and milk to a slow boil.  Remove from heat.  Pull 1 loaf of bread dough apart in small balls and layer on bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pour half of syrup over balls and sprinkle with half of the cinnamon.  Repeat with the second loaf, syrup and cinnamon.  Cover and let raise to the top edge of pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Turn out onto foil or serving plate.

name: COCONUT COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. Oatmeal Mix
1  c. coconut
1  egg
1/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Combine ingredients.

name: GLAZED MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
3/4  c. packaged seasoned bread crumbs
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/4  c. catsup
1  tsp. red beet horseradish (optional) *
1  Tbsp. water
Glaze (recipe follows)
preparation: Combine beef, bread crumbs, eggs, catsup, horseradish (if using) and water in large bowl.  Mix well.  Shape into a loaf on a well-greased jelly roll pan.  Bake in a moderate oven (350°) for 30 minutes.  Baste with half the Glaze.  Continue baking for 30 minutes longer.  Dilute remaining Glaze with 1/4 cup water.  Pour over loaf for a nice gravy.   Bake 10 minutes longer.  Makes 6 servings.

name: 5 CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  c. small marshmallows
1  c. coconut
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. Mandarin oranges
1  c. chopped pecans (if desired)
preparation: Mix sour cream, oranges and pineapple well.  Add marshmallows, coconut and pecans.  Stir well, then refrigerate. This salad is better if made the day before you serve it.

name: IOWA CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. boiling water
2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put shortening and sugar in mixing bowl; cover with boiling water.  Sift dry ingredients and add to hot mixture.  Then add eggs and vanilla.  Stir.  Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: Stuffed Zucchini
ingredients:
3  medium zucchini
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. cooked rice
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. garlic salt
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Half the zucchini lengthwise.  Scoop out zucchini halves leaving 1/4-inch shell.  Rinse and drain.  Cook and stir ground beef and onion in a 10-inch skillet until beef is light brown. Drain.  Stir in rice, salt, garlic salt, chili powder and 1 cup of tomato sauce.  Heat through.  Stuff each zucchini half with beef mixture.  Place in an ungreased baking pan.  Pour remaining tomato sauce over the zucchini.  Cover and bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.  Uncover.  Bake 15 minutes longer.  Makes 6 servings.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
2  bags carrots
1  can tomato soup
1/2  c. vinegar
1  medium onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
1/2  c. cooking oil
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1  c. sugar
preparation: Peel, slice and cook carrots until tender.  Drain.  Mix all other ingredients and pour over carrots.  Chill overnight.  (This can be made 1 or 2 days in advance.)

name: FULLABULL'S PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. dark Karo syrup
1/2  c. butter (1 stick)
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans
unbaked deep dish pie shell
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Pour in pie shell.  Top with pecans and bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: MOTHER'S CHICKEN CASSEROLE WITH WILD RICE
ingredients:
2  whole fryers
1  c. water
1  c. sherry
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  lb. fresh mushrooms
1/4  c. butter (1/2 stick)
2  pkg. (6 oz.) Uncle Ben's seasoned long grain and wild rice mix
1  c. sour cream
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can mushroom soup
preparation: Place chicken in a deep kettle.  Add water, sherry, salt, curry powder, onion and celery.  Bring to boil.  Cover and reduce heat to simmer 1 hour.  Remove from heat.  Refrigerate chicken and broth separately.  When chicken is cool, remove meat from bones, discard skin.  Cut meat into bite size pieces.  Wash mushrooms and saute in butter until golden brown.

name: HOT MUSTARD
ingredients:
4  oz. dry mustard
1  c. malt vinegar
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. sugar
preparation: Combine dry mustard and vinegar; mix well.  Let stand overnight.  Add eggs and sugar.  Cook until thick.  Let cool and store in refrigerator.

name: CHILI CON CARNE
ingredients:
3 1/2  lb. round steak
1  Tbsp. oil
4  cloves minced garlic
2  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  tsp. oregano
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1 1/2  tsp. cumin
1/2  tsp. crushed red pepper (optional)
1  c. beef broth
1 (13 oz.)  can tomatoes
6  oz. can tomato paste
1  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt or less
preparation: Heat 3 tablespoons oil in large pan.  Sear round steak (cut into 1/2-inch cubes) until lightly browned.  Add 1 tablespoon oil, garlic and onion.  Cook until wilted.  Add oregano, chili powder, cumin and red pepper.  Mix well.  Add broth, tomatoes, paste, sugar and salt.  Mix.  Simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours until meat is very tender.  Serve over egg noodles.

name: STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. white wine
1 large  clove garlic
3  Tbsp. shredded jack cheese
1/2  tsp. soy sauce
1/3  c. bread crumbs
12  mushrooms (1 1/2 to 2-inch diameter)
2  Tbsp. chopped mushroom stems
paprika
preparation: Wash mushrooms and remove stems; set aside.  In a small bowl, combine first 6 ingredients.  Add mushroom stems and fill mushroom caps with mixture.  Place a paper towel on plate and arrange mushrooms in a circle on plate.  Microwave on High for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes, rotating plate after 1 1/2 minutes.

name: TURTLE SHELLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. Azteca salad shells
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. caramels
1/2  c. canned sweetened condensed milk
1  c. (6 oz.) pecan pieces
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cut shell into 8 pie-shaped wedges. Bake on ungreased baking sheets for 7 to 9 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove shells; place on waxed paper.  Place caramels and milk in microwave-safe bowl.  Microwave on Medium for 3 minutes; stir and repeat for 3 minutes (stirring often).  Spread caramel onto cooled shells; top with pecans.  Microwave chocolate on Medium for 3 minutes; stir and repeat for 2 minutes (stirring often). Drizzle chocolate over caramel and pecan.  Makes 32 candies.

name: GRANDMA'S OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. quick oatmeal
1  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Cream together margarine, brown sugar and eggs.  Add flour, soda, baking powder, salt and vanilla.  Mix all these ingredients well.  Add oatmeal and mix well.  These ingredients can all be mixed in an electric mixer or by hand.  Drop teaspoonful of batter into a tray of confectioners sugar.  Roll batter until covered with sugar and put onto an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 325° for 8 to 10 minutes.  For an added taste, add 1/2 cup coconut to batter. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

name: FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. oil
3  lb. sliced yellow onions
2  Tbsp. flour
3  cans beef broth
3  cans beef consomme
1/2  tsp. fresh ground pepper
1  pt. water
1/4  c. Port wine
1/4  c. Burgundy
toasted French bread slices
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook the first 4 ingredients in heavy kettle until onions are slightly brown.  Stir in the flour; cook 1 minute.  Add the beef broth, beef consomme, pepper and water.  Reduce heat; simmer for 30 minutes.  Add the Port wine and Burgundy, then ladle over slices of toasted French bread and pass the Parmesan cheese. Makes 3 quarts.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/3  c. sugar
2/3  c. shortening
1 1/4  c. milk
3 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
5  egg whites
1/2  c. fresh, mashed strawberries
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch or two 8-inch pans.  Beat all ingredients except egg whites on low speed until blended (about 30 seconds).  Beat on high speed 2 minutes. Add egg whites and beat on high 2 minutes more.  Add fresh strawberries; mix well.  Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until cake springs back when touched lightly in center.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  tsp. olive oil
1  can pizza sauce
1  jar spaghetti sauce
1  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. pepper
lasagna noodles
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. basil
1  chopped onion
3/4  lb. Ricotta cheese
3/4  c. grated Parmesan
3/4  lb. Mozzarella
preparation: Brown the ground beef in the olive oil.  Add spices while browning.  Mix the spaghetti and pizza sauces together.  Add the ground beef and 1 cup of water; simmer for 1/2 hour.  Layer the sauce, noodles and cheeses in a lasagna pan and bake for 1 hour at 300°.

name: SESAME GINGER STRING BEANS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. fresh trimmed string beans
vegetable oil (for deep frying)
4  Tbsp. light sesame oil
1 1/2  tsp. minced fresh ginger
1 1/2  tsp. minced green onion
2  tsp. minced garlic
2  Tbsp. minced ham
2  tsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
2 1/2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/4  c. chicken stock
preparation: Garnish with sesame seed.

name: PINK LEMONADE PIE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen pink lemonade concentrate
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Mix ingredients in blender until thoroughly mixed.  Pour contents into a graham cracker pie crust.  Chill and serve.

name: PICKLED RED BEETS
ingredients: 1/2  bushel beets
preparation: Scrub beets and boil until tender; peel and drop into brine.

name: APPETIZER ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
peeled, chopped cucumber
garlic salt
large soft flour tortillas
1/2  c. sour cream
chopped onion
chopped black olives
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Add more or less of the sour cream to have a good spreading consistency.  Add chopped onions, cucumber and black olives and garlic salt to taste.  Spread on tortillas. Spread to all but one of the edges.  Roll up, starting on the side opposite this edge.  Place rolls in covered container several hours or overnight.  Slice chilled rolls in 1/2 to 1-inch slices. Can use chopped ham or corned beef and leave out cucumbers. Experiment with combinations.

name: HILLSHIRE FARM SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Hillshire Farm sausage, cut in 2-inch sections
1  large onion, cut in strips
1  large green pepper, cut in strips
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Combine all ingredients together and put in a casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: RHUBARB COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. pancake mix or Bisquick
1  tsp. grated lemon peel
4  c. fresh rhubarb, cut in 1/2 inch pieces
3/4  c. pancake mix or Bisquick
2/3  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. melted margarine
preparation: Mix 1 cup sugar, 1/3 cup pancake mix, lemon peel and rhubarb. Toss together.  Place in 9-inch greased pan.  Mix remaining dry ingredients; stir in eggs until coarse.  Sprinkle over rhubarb. Drizzle with melted butter.  Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: PETIT SUCRE
ingredients:
1  c. powdered sugar
1  egg white
1  drop food coloring
preparation: Beat powdered sugar and egg white       for 15 minutes (no less) on medium-high speed (again no less than 15 minutes).  Do not double!

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. shortening
1  egg
3  bananas, mashed
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda, dissolved in juice
1  Tbsp. orange juice
1/2  c. walnuts
preparation: Mix sugar and shortening.  Add egg, bananas and soda.  Add flour; mix well.  Add walnuts.  Grease and flour bottom of loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.  This recipe freezes well. Double recipe makes 3 loaves.

name: BISCOTTI(Italian Cookies)
ingredients:
3  eggs
6  Tbsp. sugar
6  Tbsp. oil
1/4  c. milk
3  tsp. baking powder
1 small  bottle anise flavoring
3 to 4  c. flour
preparation: In large bowl, combine first 6 ingredients.  Gradually add flour (mixture will become sticky).  Make small balls or other shapes from mixture.  Place on a slightly greased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: WACKY CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. vinegar
3/4  c. salad oil
preparation: Mix well.  Add 2 cups tap water.  Mix well again.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Cake is very moist.

name: SHIRLEY'S GREEK BREAD
ingredients:
2  loaves French bread
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  stick margarine, melted
2  c. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
1 (4 oz.)  jar sliced mushrooms
1 small  can chopped ripe olives
green onion tops, chopped
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
jalapeno peppers, chopped or green peppers, chopped
preparation: Combine mayonnaise, margarine, cheese, mushrooms, olives, onion, garlic powder and peppers.  Spread on French bread.  Bake until cheese is melted and bread is hot at 350°.

name: PINEAPPLE CREAM MERINGUE PIE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. flour
2  egg yolks
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  egg whites
1  (9-inch) baked pie shell
preparation: Drain crushed pineapple.  Mix together in bowl the sugar, salt, flour and egg yolks.  Put milk in pan; mix in sugar flour mixture and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil.  Be careful not to scorch.  Remove from stove and cool.  Add pineapple and vanilla.  Put into pie shell.  Cover with meringue made from egg whites.

name: SEVEN-IN-ONE LAYER DISH
ingredients:
1  layer white potatoes, sliced
1  layer sliced carrots
1  layer sliced onions
4  celery stalks, cut up
1 (No. 2)  can peas, drained
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  can tomato soup
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. oregano
preparation: Layer into buttered casserole in order given, the first 5 ingredients.  Season each with salt and pepper.  Brown hamburger in a little oil or margarine.  Place on top of vegetables in casserole.  Cover with tomato soup which sugar and oregano have been mixed in.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until vegetables are tender.

name: PHYL'S PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans pineapple chunks and juice
1  c. shredded sharp cheese
1  c. white sugar
6  Tbsp. flour
1  stick melted butter
1  tube Ritz crackers, crushed
preparation: Mix pineapple chunks and juice, cheese, sugar and flour and put into Pyrex baking dish.  Mix butter and Ritz crackers and sprinkle on the pineapple mixture and bake at 350° until done and crackers are toasted.  This is good served with ham or barbecue chicken.

name: BEEF BALL
ingredients:
12  oz. dried beef
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. minced onions
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. Accent
preparation: Chop dried beef in food processor until fine.  Reserve 1/2 cup of chopped beef.  Combine all ingredients except the 1/2 cup chopped beef into a large mixer bowl; mix well.  Sprinkle the reserved 1/2 cup of beef onto waxed paper.  Spoon cream cheese mixture onto the dried beef and form into ball.  Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 hours.  Serve with crackers and enjoy.

name: POT ROAST
ingredients:
4  lb. chuck roast
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Place roast on a large piece of aluminum foil.  Pour soup mix and mushroom soup (undiluted) on the roast.  Bring the ends of foil together tightly so juice cannot escape. Cook in a 325° oven for 2 hours.   Serves 6.

name: RED HOT CIDER
ingredients:
1  gal. apple juice or cider
8  oz. red hots candy
preparation: Combine ingredients in large coffee pot.  Heat to serve. Stir often until red hots dissolve.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar, divided
1  Tbsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
1  c. milk
4 or 5  c. fresh peaches (I cook them if raw)
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. ground cinnamon or nutmeg
preparation: Use 13 x 9 baking dish. Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and milk; stir. Pour over butter in pan. Combine sugar, peaches, lemon juice and cinnamon. Bring to a boil. Pour over batter. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

name: PEARL'S REFRIGERATED PICKLES
ingredients:
7  c. sliced cucumbers
1  c. sliced onions
1  c. sliced green peppers
1  tsp. salt
1  c. vinegar
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. celery salt
preparation: Mix the salt, vinegar, sugar and celery salt; pour over the cucumbers,  onions and green peppers.  Stir and let sit an hour or so.  Put in jars and refrigerate.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. water
2/3  c. rice
1  Tbsp. butter
4  eggs
1  qt. milk
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
raisins (if desired)
nuts (if desired)
preparation: Cook rice and water in butter for 20 minutes, covered.  Stir occasionally.   Beat 4 eggs.  Add milk, sugar and vanilla.  Add raisins and nuts.  Place in a buttered dish.  Bake at 350° for one hour or until knife comes out clean.

name: GRANDMA'S SPECIAL SQUASH PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
pinch of salt
2 heaping  c. cooked squash
1  egg, beaten
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
unbaked pie shells
preparation: Combine sugar,  flour and salt.  Add to squash; stir in egg, milk  and vanilla.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.  Serve with whipped topping, if desired.

name: JELLO SALAD SUPREME
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon jello
1  pt. boiling water (less 2 Tbsp.)
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
shake of cayenne pepper
2  c. cabbage, cut fine
1  c. tart apples, cut fine
8  stuffed olives, cut fine
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add vinegar, salt and cayenne pepper.  Chill.  When slightly thickened, stir in cabbage, apples and olives.  Chill until firm.  Serve on lettuce with mayonnaise.  Serves 8.

name: SUGAR COOKIES NO. 2
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/4  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. almond flavoring
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients until well blended.  Add remaining ingredients.  Cover and chill at least 1 hour.  Roll out on floured surface and cut with seasonal cookie cutters.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes on ungreased baking sheet at 400°.  Ice when cooled, if desired.

name: PINEAPPLE CREAM CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can condensed milk
1/4  c. freshly squeezed lemon juice
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  (9-inch) graham cracker pie shell
preparation: Combine condensed milk and lemon juice; add cream cheese and beat mixture until smooth.  Fold in pineapple.  Pour mixture into prepared crumb crust.  Chill 4 to 5 hours before serving.  Yields 1 (9-inch) pie.

name: JANE'S SKIER'S FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. corn syrup
1/2  c. butter
1  c. packed brown sugar
1  loaf bread
5  eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: In  a  small  saucepan,  combine corn syrup, butter and brown sugar;  simmer  until  syrupy.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.  Slice  bread  into 12 to 16 slices and place over sugar/butter  mixture  in dish.  Beat together the eggs, milk, vanilla and salt; pour over bread.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Bake for 45 minutes in a preheated 350° oven. Serve hot before bottom hardens!

name: DOUBLE-BAKED POTATOES WITH HAM, CHEESE AND MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
6  to 7 potatoes, scrubbed
3  Tbsp. butter
4  c. sliced mushrooms
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  c. red wine
1  Tbsp. chicken bouillon powder
1 1/2  c. grated Colby cheese
1 1/2  c. chopped ham
1 1/4  c. sour cream
1/4 to 1/2  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
1/4  stick butter, melted
preparation: Microwave potatoes for 20 to 25 minutes on High power.

name: LEFSE
ingredients:
8  c. mashed potatoes
1  Tbsp. salt
4  c. flour (very scant)
8 heaping  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. whipping cream (not whipped)
preparation: Peel the potatoes; cook and mash with butter, cream and salt. Let them get cold.  Mix in the flour and roll out rounds of dough paper thin on lightly floured board.  Bake the rounds on a grill, turning to lightly brown on both sides.

name: HANKY PANKY
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. hot sausage
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. oregano
1  lb. Cheddar cheese
2  loaves party rye bread
preparation: Cook ground beef and sausage.  Drain.  Add cheese and spices. Stir until cheese melts.  Spread on bread slices.  Freezes well. When ready to serve, bake at 350° until hot.

name: FUDGSICLES
ingredients:
1  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
1/4  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix well and freeze.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
3  sticks oleo
1/4  c. sugar
2  c. confectioners sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
4  bananas
13 1/2  oz. Cool Whip
2  c. pineapple, well drained
cherries and nuts
preparation: Mix graham cracker crumbs, 1 stick oleo and sugar.  Put in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Heat 20 minutes.  Mix confectioners sugar, 2 sticks oleo, eggs and vanilla.  Spread over crumbs.  Spread pineapple over mixture.  Add sliced bananas over top.  Cover with Cool Whip.  Top with cherries and nuts.  Chill.

name: SAUSAGE STUFFING
ingredients:
1  lb. sweet Italian sausage (loose)
4  extra large onions, diced
4  stalks celery, diced
2  eggs, beaten
Romano cheese
1/2  bag Pepperidge Farm stuffing
1 to 2  c. bouillon
preparation: Saute sausage until light brown.  Set aside in a bowl for final mixing.  Saute onions in oil until translucent.  Add celery and saute until soft.  Mix sausage, onions and celery together, then add eggs.  Sprinkle Romano cheese on mixture, then add Pepperidge Farm stuffing to mixture.  Add bouillon if mixture is too dry.  You don't want it runny, but you do want it wet.  Cook in turkey.  If you prefer to cook it outside of the turkey, bake it in a baking dish for about 1/2 hour.

name: VEGGIE PIZZA (LOW-FAT)
ingredients:
8  oz. lite cream cheese
1  c. lite mayo
1  pkg. Good Season's Italian dressing (add to taste)
1  pkg. pita bread
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. low-fat Mozzarella cheese
broccoli
cauliflower
any veggie you like
preparation: Mix cream cheese, mayo and dressing with mixer until smooth. Cut bread into fourths and spread mix on it.  Top with veggies and cheese.

name: EASY COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen roll dough (12 balls)
1  pkg. instant butterscotch pudding
cinnamon
1/4  c. chopped pecans
1/2  stick butter or margarine
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: The  night  before  baking,  grease  a	Bundt pan.  Put frozen rolls  in	pan.  Sprinkle	box  of pudding over rolls. Sprinkle liberally  with  cinnamon and the 1/4 cup of pecans. Melt  butter and combine with sugar and water.  Pour this over other ingredients  in  pan.   Cover   with   foil  and  leave unrefrigerated overnight.  Uncover and  bake  in 325° oven for 25 minutes.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. Wesson oil
2  c. plain flour
1  c. buttermilk
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  bottle red food coloring
3  eggs
preparation: Cream sugar, oil and eggs.  Beat.  Add vinegar, food coloring and vanilla.  Add dry ingredients; alternate with buttermilk. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. cranberries
3  pkg. jello (small size, strawberry, orange and orange-pineapple)
3  c. boiling water
2  to 3 tangelos (rind and all)
2  c. sugar
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Dissolve the jello in the boiling water.  Grind the cranberries in blender.  Grind the tangelos.  Mix the sugar, celery and nuts with the other ingredients.

name: PEPPERONI PINWHEELS
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) Pillsbury refrigerated quick crescent dinner rolls
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. Hormel sliced pepperoni (32 slices)
2 (1/2 c.)  oz. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  c. prepared pizza or spaghetti sauce
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Separate dough into 4 rectangles; firmly press perforations to seal.  Place 8 pepperoni slices on each rectangle.  Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cheese.  Starting at shortest side, tightly roll up each rectangle; pinch to seal. Slice each roll into 4 equal slices.  Pinch dough together on 1 side of each slice to seal.  Place sealed side down on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve pinwheels with warm pizza sauce, if desired.  Makes 16 pinwheels.

name: ICE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  c. evaporated milk
dash of salt
16  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  qt. vanilla ice cream
graham cracker pie crust
preparation: In pan, melt evaporated milk, salt and chocolate chips.  Add marshmallows and let them melt.  Soften ice cream and spread in pie crust.  Pour sauce over ice cream and freeze 2 hours.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
4 or 5  Tbsp. rice
1/2  c. sugar
1  qt. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Wash rice in sieve.  Put in pan and cook until done (about 15 minutes).  Stir in milk, cinnamon, vanilla and butter.  Put in baking dish and bake 2 hours.  Stir 4 times the first hour.  Do not stir 2nd hour.  Bake at 350°.

name: FUDGE WAFFLES
ingredients:
2  large eggs
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/4  c. semi-sweet chocolate mini morsels
vanilla ice cream
Chocolate Peppermint Sauce (see recipe)
crushed pineapple candy (garnish)
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients in a mixing bowl.  Beat at medium speed with an electric mixer until foamy (2 minutes).  Add buttermilk, mixing well.  Set aside.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
2  (10 1/2 oz.) mushroom soup
1  small bag Tater Tots
preparation: Brown hamburger in skillet. Drain well. Add mushroom soup to hamburger. Pour mixture into a 9 x 12 baking dish. Layer Tater Tots on top. Cook in oven at 400° or until Tater Tots are brown.

name: ZESTY SALT SUBSTITUTE
ingredients:
5  tsp onion powder
1  tbsp paprika
1  tsp thyme
1/2  tsp celery seed
1  tbsp garlic powder
1  tbsp dry mustard
1/2  white pepper
preparation: Combine ingredients. After mixing well, store in a spice shaker with tight fitting lid. As with spices, keep in a cool dry place.

name: CHIPPED HAM BARBECUE
ingredients:
1  lb. chipped ham
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. water
4  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
8  Tbsp. ketchup
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Heat the ham in a skillet with the butter.  Mix the remaining ingredients in a bowl.  Pour the mixture over the ham and mix. Simmer for 5 minutes.  Serve on buns.

name: FROZEN FRUIT WHIP
ingredients:
16  oz. container Cool Whip
2  c. buttermilk
1 large  box jello (any flavor)
3  c. fruit (any)
preparation: Crush fruit in pan.  Mix in dry jello.  Simmer.  Cool.  Mix Cool Whip and buttermilk, then add fruit.  Refrigerate.   Stir occasionally, then freeze.  (Peach jello and peaches are great!)

name: GARLIC BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  large chicken or chicken breasts
butter
garlic salt
Season-All salt
preparation: Remove skin from chicken.  Lay flat (1 layer) in baking dish. Put 1 slice of  butter  on  each  piece.  Sprinkle with garlic salt and Season-All salt.  Cover  with foil and bake at 375° for about 45 minutes to  1  hour.  Remove  foil  and bake about 15 minutes, until golden brown.

name: CHEESE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  jars Old English spread
1  stick oleo
2  eggs
preparation: Beat ingredients until smooth.  Trim crusts off day-old bread; cut into 4 pieces.  Ice top and sides with mixture, not bottom. Bake until heated through in a 350° oven.

name: SOUR CREAM BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. butter
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix together flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.  Cut in butter until mixture is consistency of coarse crumbs.  Mix in sour cream, stirring to form soft dough.  Turn dough onto lightly floured surface.  Roll or pat dough to 1/2-inch thickness.  Cut with floured 2-inch biscuit cutter.  Place on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake at 425° for 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes 2 dozen.

name: TURKEY-NOODLE PARMESAN
ingredients:
3  c. dry medium egg noodles
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's condensed cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. milk
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/8  tsp. black pepper
2  c. cubed, cooked turkey or chicken
chopped fresh parsley
grated Parmesan cheese
red onion strips for garnish
preparation: In 3-quart saucepan, prepare noodles according to package directions; drain.  In same saucepan, combine soup, milk, 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese and black pepper.  Add noodles and turkey.  Over low heat, heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally.  Sprinkle with parsley and Parmesan cheese.  Garnish with onion strips, if desired.  Prep time:  20 minutes.  Cook time:  10 minutes.

name: CHICKEN QUICHE AMANDINE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) pie shell, unbaked
3/4  c. chicken, cooked and chopped
3  Tbsp. sliced almonds
1 1/2  c. shredded Swiss cheese
3  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. mace
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese, grated
preparation: Place chicken and almonds in pie shell, then Swiss cheese. Beat eggs slightly in a medium bowl.  Blend in milk, salt, mace and pepper.  Pour over cheese.  Bake in a preheated oven at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean. Allow to stand 10 minutes before serving.   Serves 6.

name: BROCCOLI AND MUSHROOMS IN SOUR CREAM SAUCE
ingredients:
1 large  bunch fresh broccoli
1  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. Dijon mustard
4  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. paprika
preparation: Cook broccoli until bright green.  Saute mushrooms in butter. Combine all ingredients and heat over low.  (Do not boil.)

name: FRESH LEMON MERINGUE PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cold water
1/2  c. freshly squeezed lemon juice
3  egg yolks, well beaten
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  tsp. grated peel
food coloring (if desired)
1  (9-inch) baked pie shell
preparation: Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt.  Use wire whisk.  Blend in cold water, then lemon juice until smooth.  Add beaten egg yolks. Blend thoroughly.  Add butter and boiling water, stirring constantly.  Bring to a boil until thickened.  Pour into pie crust.  Add meringue.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

name: NO BAKE DATE BALLS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. cut-up dates
pinch of salt
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/4  c. butter
3  c. Rice Krispies
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  tsp. vanilla
powdered sugar (optional)
preparation: Combine dates, salt, sugar, egg and butter in saucepan.  Mix well.  Cook 10 minutes, stirring frequently.  Stir in cereal, walnuts and vanilla.  Roll into balls (butter hands first).  Roll in powdered sugar, if desired.

name: DANISH APPLE BARS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. shortening
8  c. apples, sliced
1  c. cornflakes cereal, crushed
3/4 to 1  c. sugar
1  egg yolk
1  egg white
milk
preparation: Combine flour and salt; cut in shortening.  Beat egg yolk and add enough milk to make 2/3 cup liquid.  Mix well.  Stir in flour.

name: CORK AND CLEAVER MUD PIE
ingredients:
5  c. chocolate wafers
1  c. (8 oz.) margarine
3  lb. coffee ice cream
1/2  c. hot fudge chocolate topping
whipped cream
sliced, toasted almonds
preparation: Crush wafers into fine crumbs and mix thoroughly with melted margarine.  Press into a 9-inch pie tin about halfway up the sides.  Crust should be about 1/8-inch thick.  Firm in freezer for 15 minutes.  Whip softened ice cream until smooth.  Fill pie shell so that top is mounded to 3-inches in the center and less than 1-inch on the edges.  Place in freezer to harden.  When ice cream is firm, spread topping to 1/8-inch thickness all over top and return to freezer to harden.  Serve on a chilled plate.   (Suggest you also chill server.)  Top each slice with whipped cream and sliced, toasted almonds.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE II
ingredients:
2  c. cooked rice
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  stick oleo, melted
1  small onion, chopped
preparation: Cook broccoli about half of regular time; drain off water. Mix all together and put in greased casserole.  Can put buttered bread crumbs on top if you like.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: YELLOW BUNS
ingredients:
2  c. milk
1/2  c. cornmeal
1/2  c. butter
1  tsp. salt
2  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. warm water
3  eggs, beaten
3  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Cook milk and corn meal (can be white or yellow) until thick. Add butter, sugar and salt.  Dissolve yeast in warm water and let stand for 20 minutes.  Then add eggs and flour.  Combine with cornmeal mixture and add enough additional flour (3 to 3 1/2 cups) until a soft bun mix.

name: SOUR CREAM CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 small  can cream-style corn (8 oz.)
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. self-rising meal
1  c. sour cream
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. salad oil (Wesson)
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake at 400° for about 30 minutes or until done.  Cook in 10-inch iron skillet.

name: MY OWN JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
4 to 6  lb. meat (you may use hen, sausage, pork or wild game), cut in pieces
3 or 4  c. rice
about 4 large onions, chopped
1  tsp. garlic, minced
1  small bell pepper, chopped
1  c. cooking oil
5  c. water
3  Tbsp. salt
1/2  tsp. red and 1/2 tsp. black pepper
preparation: Brown meat in cooking oil in a heavy gauge pot, stirring often. Drain some of the excess oil out.  Add onions, salt and pepper. Brown and stir until onions are clear.  Add a little water at a time, cooking and stirring until meat is tender and golden brown. (When cooking a hen or wild game, it takes longer to tenderize meat.)  Add washed rice, green pepper and garlic.  Add 5 cups water or enough to cover rice and meat mixture by about 1 1/2-inches. Cover and bring to a hard boil.  Stir and reduce to a simmer. Cover about 45 minutes.  Stir once.  Let steam awhile and serve.

name: GUACAMOLE SALAD
ingredients:
3  soft avocados
1/2  onion, chopped very fine
1  tomato, chopped very fine
dash of garlic powder
salt and pepper to taste
chopped jalapeno pepper (or hot salsa sauce)
lemon juice
preparation: Mash  avocados	with potato masher.  Add onion, tomato, garlic powder, peppers, salt and pepper.  Add your lemon juice to suit your taste.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: STRAWBERRY PATCH CAKE
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. strawberry jello
1  angel food cake
2  c. boiling water
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. sliced frozen strawberries
1 large  carton Cool Whip (part for topping)
1 small  pkg. whole strawberries (for garnish)
preparation: Break up cake into bite size pieces; reserve.  Dissolve jello in boiling water; add sliced strawberries and stir until they are separated.  Chill until thick and syrupy.  (Be sure this doesn't get too thick.)  Remove from refrigerator and fold in Cool Whip (save part for topping).   Grease a 9 x 10-inch tube pan or rind mold (use butter).  Put 2 cups cake pieces in pan, then add jello mixture.  Continue this until pan is full or all mixture is used. Chill several hours or overnight.  Sit pan in hot water for a second and turn out on plate.

name: LIGHT AS A FEATHER COCONUT CAKE(If you like coconut, you will like this recipe.)
ingredients:
1/4  c. shortening
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. lemon extract
7/8  c. sugar
1  egg (unbeaten)
1 1/2  c. and 2 Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. grated raw coconut
preparation: Cream in a large bowl the shortening, salt, sugar and egg. Sift dry ingredients, then add to mixture, alternating with milk. Add extract, and stir.  Add coconut, stir lightly, then place in two round, lightly greased cake pans.  Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.

name: WHIPPING CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter (room temperature)
3  c. sugar
6  eggs (room temperature)
3  c. flour
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put all ingredients into mixing bowl at once and beat.  Grease and flour tube pan; pour batter into it and put into cold oven. Set oven at 325° and bake for 1 1/2 hours.

name: MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  egg
1  c. milk
1/4  c. salad oil
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Grease bottom of muffin cups.  Beat egg; stir in milk and oil.  Mix in remaining ingredients just until flour is moistened.  Batter should be lumpy.  Fill muffin cups 2/3 full.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Immediately remove from pan.  Yields 12 muffins.

name: ZUCCHINI FRITTERS
ingredients:
1/3  c. biscuit mix
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. grated zucchini
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Use nonstick skillet, well coated with spray.  Heat skillet.  Drop zucchini mixture by tablespoons into hot skillet.  Brown on both sides.

name: BAKED CORN
ingredients:
1  can creamed corn
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
1 1/2  c. whole milk
4  Tbsp. oleo
preparation: Add all ingredients together in baking dish. Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.  Stir once when you see it starting to thicken around edges.

name: DELICIOUS DAIRY DIP(Great For Fresh Fruit!)
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1 to 2  Tbsp. maple syrup
preparation: In a small mixing bowl, combine cream cheese, sour cream, sugars and syrup; beat until smooth.  Chill.  Serve with fresh fruit.

name: JUST LIKE FRIED ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2  c. ice cream (any flavor)
2  tsp. margarine or butter, melted
4  tsp. honey
1 1/4  c. almond cluster multi-grain cereal, crushed
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Using a large ice cream scoop, make four 1/2 cup scoops of ice cream.  Place in a shallow pan.  Cover and store in the freezer until firm.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1  can cream-style corn
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sweet milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Cover with bread crumbs.  Put in a greased casserole and bake until thickened, about 20 to 30 minutes, at 350°.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES, TOMATOES AND HAM
ingredients:
6  c. thinly sliced, peeled potatoes
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. chopped, cooked ham
1 (14 1/2 or 16 oz.)  can whole tomatoes, undrained and chopped
2  Tbsp. oleo
preparation: Lightly grease slow cooker.  Layer half of each ingredient in the order listed.  Repeat layers.  Cover and cook on high setting for 1 hour.  Reduce to low setting. Cook 5 to 6 hours or until potatoes are tender. Stir before serving.

name: TURKEY CROQUETTES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  Tbsp. Mrs. Dash, salt free
1  c. crushed wheat or corn flakes
preparation: Mix well the turkey, onion and Mrs. Dash.  Shape into 3 ounce patties.  Roll in cereal and place on baking sheet.  Bake in 400° oven for 45 minutes or until fork will remove clean.

name: KIELBASA BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
3  ribs celery, diced
4  medium potatoes, diced
3  carrots, sliced
1  medium onion, chopped
2  cans bean and bacon soup
1  lb. Polish kielbasa, cut up
salt and pepper
preparation: In large kettle combine celery, potatoes, carrots and onion with 4 cups water.  Bring to a boil and cook until vegetables are tender.  Add soup and kielbasa.  Add extra water if needed.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer.

name: LEMON CHICKEN CUTLETS
ingredients:
6  boneless chicken breast halves (1 1/2 lb.), skinned
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
vegetable cooking spray
1  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  c. dry sherry
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. grated lemon rind
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. water
1  tsp. chicken flavored bouillon granules
1/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  tsp. paprika
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Trim excess fat from chicken.  Place chicken between 2 sheets of waxed paper; flatten to 1/4-inch thickness, using a meat mallet or rolling pin.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper; set aside.

name: DATE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. dates
1  c. boiling water
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
1  egg
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Put chopped dates in boiler with 1 cup boiling water and add 1 teaspoon baking soda.  Cream sugar and butter.  Add egg and beat well.  Add flour and salt alternately in thirds with water, soda and dates.  Add vanilla and 1/2 cup nuts.  Bake at 350°  in a 9-inch square pan until done.

name: CRANBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. whole wheat flour
1  c. all-purpose flour
2/3  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground allspice
3/4  c. orange juice
1  Tbsp. grated orange rind
1  egg
1/2  c. vegetable oil (canola or safflower)
2  Tbsp. vanilla
2  c. fresh cranberries, chopped
preparation: You will also need vegetable oil spray.  Do not use vegetable oil spray near an open flame or a heat source.  Read and follow directions on can before using.

name: CHEESE BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. plain flour
2  sticks margarine
1  tsp. salt
dash of red pepper
1/2 to 1  lb. extra sharp cheese
preparation: Grate cheese.  Cream butter, flour and cheese.  Add salt and pepper.  Separate into 4 parts.  Roll in small (1 1/2-inch) rolls. Wrap in wax paper and place in refrigerator overnight.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until done.

name: MEAT LOAF WITH STUFFING(Buddy's Favorite Meat Loaf Recipe)
ingredients:
3  lb. ground beef
3  c. fresh bread crumbs
1  c. minced onions
4  eggs, slightly beaten
3  Tbsp. horseradish
1  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/4  c. evaporated milk
1/4  c. catsup
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. sharp cheese, grated
snipped parsley
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Mix ground beef, crumbs and onions lightly into eggs.  Add remaining ingredients except cheese and parsley; mix lightly.  Divide into 3 parts; put 1 part into a 10 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Cover with 6 ounces cheese.  Spread with second part of ground beef mixture.  Cover with 6 ounces cheese. Spread with remaining ground beef mixture.  Invert loaf onto jelly roll pan or foil-covered cookie sheet, turning up edges of foil to form rim.  Bake for 45 minutes.  Sprinkle top with rest of cheese. Bake for 5 minutes.  Cool for 15 minutes before serving.  Garnish with parsley.   Slice.  Yield:  10 to 12 servings.

name: CHINESE CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  chicken breasts or thighs
3  Tbsp. shortening or 1/2 c. cooking oil
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  Tbsp. hot sauce
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cut meat in cubes.  Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper.  Add flour and stir with fork to cover each piece.  Shake each piece off to remove excess flour.  Put each piece in shortening and let it cook for 15 or 20 minutes or until brown on medium heat.  Add 1 tablespoon of flour to brown for gravy.  Add 1/2 cup of water, then the other seasons and let it simmer for 10 minutes in the covered pot.  Serve over rice.  A serving for 4 or more.

name: ORANGE JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  (12 oz.) tub Cool Whip
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange Jell-O
1 small  can mandarin oranges
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. chopped pecans or walnuts (optional)
1/2  c. coconut (optional)
preparation: Mix together the Cool Whip and sour cream thoroughly.  Add orange Jell-O; mix until blended.  Add remaining ingredients; mix well.  Chill in refrigerator about 1 hour before serving.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
4  eggs
2/3  c. water
2  c. pumpkin (canned or fresh)
1  c. oil
3  c. sugar
1  c. walnuts (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease two loaf pans.  Set aside.  Mix dry ingredients.  Add remaining ingredients as listed.  Pour into pans about 3/4 full.  Bake 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

name: CROCK-POT PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
5  or 6 boneless pork chops
1  Tbsp. Crisco
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  medium onion, sliced
preparation: Using Crisco, brown pork chops in skillet.  Then layer in the crock-pot and pour soup and onion over.  Do not add water to the soup.  Cover and cook on low for 7 to 9 hours.

name: IRISH STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. boneless stew meat
1/2  lb. potatoes
1  onion, chopped
1  can whole kernel corn
preparation: Cook (boil) meat and onions until tender.  Add potatoes and corn.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Cover and simmer on low 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  medium sized yellow squash
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. milk
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. green pepper (optional)
1  c. grated cheese
crushed saltines
preparation: Combine all ingredients except saltines and 1/2 cup cheese. Pour into buttered casserole dish.  Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and reserved cheese.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.  Freezes well.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1 (5 1/2 oz.)  pkg. Bisquick mix
2  c. or more grated cheese
1  lb. Jimmy Dean hot sausage, or your choice
preparation: Mix ingredients and roll into balls the size of walnuts.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 15 or 20 minutes.

name: RANCHERO CORN
ingredients:
6  slices bacon, diced
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
3/4  c. grated Velveeta cheese
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  jar sliced mushrooms
2 (12 oz.)  cans Mexican corn
preparation: Fry bacon until cooked, but not brown. Drain excess fat. Stir in drained mushrooms and onions. Sauté until onion is tender. Blend in corn (drained) and heat through. Sprinkle with cheese. Heat until cheese is melted.

name: CHUNKY GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
15  medium Russet potatoes
1  lb. bacon
4  or 5 eggs, boiled
1  bunch green onions
1  pt. size Hellmann's mayonnaise
preparation: Boil whole potatoes, drain and cool.  Fry bacon to crisp.  Cut in small pieces.  Dice onions and eggs.  Peel cooled potatoes and cube.  Add bacon, onions, eggs and mayonnaise.  Chill and serve.

name: PEACH MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. melted shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  c. flour
1  c. diced peaches
1  c. milk
2/3  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
3  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Beat eggs and milk together.  Add shortening, sugar, salt, vanilla and lemon juice.  Sift cinnamon, flour and baking powder. Fold in egg mixture until smooth.  Fold in peaches.  Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full.  Bake in 450° oven for 15 minutes.

name: MOCK LOBSTER NEWBURG
ingredients:
2  lb. fish fillet
2  cans cream of shrimp soup
1/4  c. melted butter
1/2  Tbsp. minced onion
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
30  Ritz crackers, crushed
