preparation: Place fish in casserole dish.  Sprinkle with salt and lemon juice.  Heat undiluted soup and pour over fish. Bake uncovered at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Blend remaining ingredients together and sprinkle over fish.  Bake 10 to 15 minutes more.

name: PINEAPPLE-ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
1 (18 1/4 oz.)  box yellow cake mix
3  eggs
1 1/4  c. water
1/3  c. oil
1 sm.  can mandarin oranges, drained
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and lightly flour a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. In a mixing bowl, blend the cake mix, eggs, water and oil. With an electric mixer, beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Add the oranges and continue beating for 1 minute. Pour into pan and bake 30-35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hot pork sausage
1  c. grated sharp cheese
2  c. milk
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
6  eggs
5  slices bread, cubed (remove the brown edge)
preparation: Cook sausage; drain and set aside.  Beat eggs; add milk, salt and mustard.  Into a greased baking dish (8 1/2 x 11-inch), layer the bread, sausage and cheese.  Pour egg mixture over these ingredients.  Refrigerate overnight.  Put in oven and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can chunked pineapple (2 1/2 c. size)
1  can sliced peaches, cut up in chunks
1  can mandarin oranges
1  can pears, cut up in chunks
1 small  box instant vanilla pudding
4  bananas
maraschino cherries
preparation: Drain fruit, but save 1 1/2 cups of juice (except for peach or pear juice).  If not enough juice, add water to make 1 1/2 cups. Mix juice with pudding.  Beat 2 minutes.  Add fruit except for bananas and cherries.  Do not add bananas or cherries until ready to serve.  Store in refrigerator.

name: A PIGGY APPLE(For The Kids)
ingredients:
1  small red apple
1 1/2  Tbsp. peanut butter
2  raisins
1  miniature marshmallow
1  carrot stick
2  small turnip or apple triangles
preparation: You will need 5 wooden picks.

name: BROCCOLI RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. Minute rice (uncooked)
2  c. water
3/4  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. chopped celery
1  stick melted butter
2  cans mushroom soup
1 (16 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
2  boxes frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
preparation: Mix all the ingredients together.  Pour into a baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serves 16.

name: BLUEBERRY COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  white cake mix
1/2  c. oil
4  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
2  tsp. vanilla
1  can blueberry pie filling
4  Tbsp. oleo
1/2  c. nuts (if desired)
preparation: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix well the cake mix, pudding, sour cream, oil, eggs and vanilla.  Place part of mixture in pan and cover with pie filling.  Cover with rest of cake mixture.  Top with combined flour, sugar, oleo, cinnamon and nuts. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage, browned and drained
6  slices bread, cubed and cut off crust
4  eggs, beaten
2  c. milk
1/2  lb. cheese, grated
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. mustard
preparation: Brown sausage and drain.  Put in buttered casserole dish. Place bread on top of sausage and cheese.  Mix all the other stuff and pour over.  Let set overnight in refrigerator.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large head broccoli
3/4  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  stack Ritz crackers
1  c. Minute rice
1/4  c. milk
1  stick butter
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Blanch broccoli and layer in casserole dish.  Melt cheese in milk.  Cook rice and melt butter.  Spoon rice between broccoli stems.  Pour melted cheese over rice.  Mix melted butter and crackers; sprinkle over top.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: MAGIC BARS
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  can sweetened condensed milk
6  oz. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. flaked coconut
1 1/2  c. graham crackers
preparation: Melt stick of margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pat margarine in  1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs.  Pour evenly the condensed milk.  Sprinkle chocolate chips; sprinkle chopped nuts.  Top with flaked coconut.  Press down lightly.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  This is delicious and also very easy.

name: SCOTCH-A-RUE
ingredients:
3/4  c. light brown sugar
3/4  c. light syrup (white)
1  c. crunchy peanut butter
5  c. Kellogg's Special K cereal
preparation: Boil brown sugar and syrup.  Off stove, add peanut butter; mix good.  Add cereal.  Pack into loaf pan (tight).  Melt 6 ounces chocolate chips with 6 ounces butterscotch chips and spread on top.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1 small  box strawberry jello
4  eggs
1  box white or yellow cake mix
3/4  c. oil
1  c. strawberries, drained (10 oz. pkg. frozen strawberries)
3  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. water
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well and bake in 3 greased and floured cake pans at 350° until done.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
8  c. sliced pared Jonathan apples
1 1/3  c. flour
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
2/3  c. butter
preparation: Pare and slice apples and put in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan that has been buttered.  Mix together the flour and brown sugar. Cut in the butter and spread over apples.  Bake in 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP CAKE
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake mix
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. oil
1  pkg. chocolate instant pudding
4  eggs
1/2  pt. sour cream
1 large  pkg. chocolate chips
chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into a greased Bundt or tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.  Let the cake cool completely before turning it out of the pan.

name: FIVE MINUTE FUDGE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
2/3  c. undiluted Carnation evaporated milk
1 2/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1 1/2  c. (1 1/2 six oz. pkg.) semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Combine butter, Carnation, sugar and salt in saucepan over medium heat.  Bring to a boil.  Cook for 4 to 5 minutes; stir constantly.  (Start timing when mixture starts to "bubble" around edges of pan.)  Remove from heat.  Stir in marshmallows, chocolate, vanilla and nuts.  Stir vigorously for 1 minute (until marshmallows melt and blend).  Pour into an 8 or 9-inch square buttered pan.  Cool.  Cut in squares.  Makes 2 pounds.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. melted oleo
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
3  bananas, mashed
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream butter  and sugar; beat in eggs, salt and vanilla. Add flour and  soda.  Then add bananas and nuts.  Pour into two greased loaf pans.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour or until done.

name: ORIENTAL PORK ROAST
ingredients:
1  (4 to 4 1/2 lb.) pork roast
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. sesame seed
3/4  c. water
2  tsp. chicken bouillon granules
1/3  c. cold water
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
1 1/2  tsp. five spice powder
1/4  c. sliced green onions
2  clove garlic, minced
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Rub roast with 5-spice powder.  In a 4-quart Dutch oven or large heavy skillet, over medium-high, brown meat on all sides in oil.  Transfer meat to slow cooker.  In remaining oil in Dutch oven, saute onions, sesame seed and garlic for 1 minute.  Remove from heat.  Add 3/4 cups water, soy sauce and bouillon granules. Stir to loosen browned bits from bottom.  Pour mixture over roast in slow cooker.  Cover and cook on high for 4 1/2 to 5 hours or on low for 9 to 10 hours or until tender.  Move meat to platter. Skim fat from broth.  Pour broth in saucepan.  Bring to boil. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir 1/3 cup cold water and cornstarch until smooth.  Stir in broth.  Bring to boil.  Stir until thickened.  Spoon over carved roast.

name: PUMPKIN BARS
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  cup oil
2  cups sugar
1 (15 oz.)  can pumpkin
2  cups flour
2  tsp baking powder
1  tsp baking soda
1/2  tsp salt
2  tsp cinnamon
1/2  tsp ginger
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix eggs, oil, sugar and pumpkin.  Sift remaining ingredients.  Add to pumpkin mixture.  Stir well.  Pour into greased and floured 12 x 8 x 1 inch pan.  Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes.

name: CHERRY CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
2  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
vanilla wafers
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Blend ingredients well (except wafers and pie filling). Place 1 vanilla wafer in a cupcake cup.  Spoon in mixture.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Top with cherry pie filling.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3/4  c. rice
1  whole chicken, cut up
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can water
seasoned salt
preparation: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan very well.  Put chicken on top of rice. Mix together the soups and water and pour over chicken.  Sprinkle with seasoned salt.  Bake at 350° for 2 hours, uncovered.

name: TWIX COOKIE
ingredients:
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
1/3  c. milk
2/3  c. peanut butter
1  c. chocolate chips
2  pkg. Club crackers
preparation: Boil the brown sugar, white sugar, milk and graham cracker crumbs together for 1 to 2 minutes.  Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan and put a layer of whole Club crackers in pan, then pour sugar mixture over crackers, then add another layer of crackers.  Melt peanut butter and chocolate chips and pour over the second layer of crackers.  Refrigerate.  Cut into bars.

name: GLAZED RUM CARROTS
ingredients:
1  lb. small carrots
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. rum
preparation: Put carrots (cut into 2-inch lengths) into a saucepan with water, brown sugar, butter and rum.  Cook, boiling gently, until carrots are glazed and water has evaporated.  Be careful not to burn!  I usually parboil carrots first.

name: PUNCH(Fifty Servings; Make 1/2.)
ingredients:
3  qt. ice cream
4  qt. sherbet
4  qt. 7-Up
food coloring
preparation: Chill 7-Up until very cold but not frozen.  Put sherbet and ice cream in large container and soften slightly.  Add 7-Up and color; mix.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER CRUST
ingredients:
2  c. crushed graham crackers
2  tsp. white sugar
1/2  c. melted oleo
preparation: Combine ingredients and press into pie shell.  Let sit 1/2 hour before filling.

name: FROZEN PICKLED CUCUMBERS
ingredients:
7  c. sliced cucumbers
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped bell pepper (red if you have it)
1  c. vinegar
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. mustard seed
salt to taste
preparation: Wash and slice cucumbers and mix onion, pepper, vinegar, sugar, celery and mustard seed and salt.   Mix well.   Let set for 2 or 3 hours.   Mix it good about every 30 minutes.   Put in boxes and freeze.

name: ENGLISH PEAS AND ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can English peas
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can asparagus spears
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Drain English peas and reserve liquid.  Mix soup with 1/8 to 1/4 cup of liquid from English peas.  Add English peas and drained asparagus.  Cook at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Top with slices of Kraft American cheese.  Let cheese melt.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. cooked chicken, cut into small pieces with scissors
2  stalks celery, chopped
1  c. seedless green grapes, sliced
1  pkg. Planters slivered almonds, toasted (1/3 c.)
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1/4  c. lite sour cream
lettuce
preparation: Combine all ingredients except lettuce.  Mix thoroughly. Serve over lettuce, if desired.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. Crisco, melted
1 1/2  lb. meat loaf mix
1/2  onion, chopped
1  small garlic clove
12  oz. can Contadina tomato paste (save can to measure water)
14 1/2  oz. can Contadina whole, peeled tomatoes, chopped up
salt and pepper
1 1/2  cans water
preparation: Brown meat loaf mix in hot, melted Crisco in a large pot.  Add onion.  Add garlic clove.  Add tomato paste, 2 teaspoons of salt and 1 teaspoon of pepper.  Add water.  Add whole tomatoes with juices, chopped into small pieces.  Add 1 tablespoon of salt and 1 teaspoon of pepper and bring mixture to a hard boil.  Reduce heat to simmer, cover and let cook 2 to 3 hours.  Stir occasionally. Remove garlic clove when done.  Sauce can be frozen for later use.

name: HOMEMADE GRANOLA BARS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. rolled oats
1  c. shredded coconut
1/2  c. raw sunflower seeds
1/4  c. sesame seed
1/2  c. wheat germ
1/2  c. slivered almonds
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  c. dark brown sugar
1/2  c. honey
1  c. raisins
2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Heat oven to 300°.  Spread oats, coconut, sunflower seeds, sesame seed, wheat germ and almonds on a 9 x 12-inch baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  c. grated zucchini
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Beat eggs until foamy.  Add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla; mix lightly.  Add remaining ingredients; mix until blended.  Pour into 2 loaf pans.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: HOT FUDGE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. melted lard
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
1 3/4  c. hot water
preparation: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, milk, lard and nuts. Spread in a 9-inch square pan.  Mix the brown sugar and cocoa; spread on top.  Pour hot water evenly over top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. cooked chicken, chopped
2  c. celery, diced
1  c. mayonnaise
lettuce
1/4  c. onion, chopped
salt and pepper
1/4  c. pickle relish
preparation: Combine all ingredients except lettuce.  Chill for 1 hour. Serve on lettuce.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  lb. bulk sausage
5  eggs
3/4  tsp. mustard
2 1/2  c. milk
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
2 1/2  c. unseasoned croutons
preparation: Brown and drain meat. Grease a 13 x 9 pan. Then layer most of the croutons, cheese and sausage in the pan. Beat eggs, 2 1/2 cups of milk and mustard. Pour mixture over ingredients in pan. Cover pan and refrigerate overnight.

name: HAMBURGER AND MACARONI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box macaroni
8  oz. sour cream
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  lb. hamburger
3/4  c. chopped onions
3/4  c. bread crumbs, mixed with butter
preparation: Cook macaroni in salted water.  Cook hamburger and onions together until done.  Drain macaroni and put in casserole dish.

name: STUFFED GREEN PEPPERS
ingredients:
3  large green peppers
2  tsp. salt
boiling water
1  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
2  Tbsp. finely chopped celery
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. chili sauce
1  egg
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Halve peppers lengthwise.  Remove stems, seeds and membranes. Add salt to enough boiling water to cover peppers.  Boil 5 minutes; drain.

name: CUPCAKE CONES
ingredients:
1  pkg. any flavor cake mix
24  - 36 flat bottomed ice cream cones
frosting of your choice
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

name: SANTA FE SUPER CHIEF'S FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
2  beaten eggs
1/2  c. half and half cream
pinch of salt
dry bread slices, cut 3/4 inch thick
fat (for frying)
preparation: Beat eggs with cream and salt, blending well.  Place in a shallow dish and coat the bread slices thoroughly, turning to soak both sides through.  Fry until nicely browned in hot fat.

name: SWEET AND SOUR KIELBASA
ingredients:
2 (12 oz.)  pkg. kielbasa, cut in 1/4-inch slices
1 (12 oz.)  bottle chili sauce
3/4  c. red currant jelly
2  tsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. lemon juice
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, drained
preparation: Cook sausage over low heat in a large skillet 8 to 10 minutes. Drain; set aside.  Combine chili sauce and next 3 ingredients in large skillet; stir well.  Add kielbasa and pineapple chunks. Simmer 15 minutes.  Stir occasionally.  Serve in chafing dish. Yields 24 appetizer servings.

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
7  to 10 potatoes, diced and cooked
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/4  c. celery, chopped
3  Tbsp. pickle relish
1  Tbsp. mustard
1/4  c. mayonnaise
3  eggs, boiled and chopped
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook potatoes.  Mix all ingredients in well drained potatoes. Must refrigerate.  Yields 15 to 20 servings.

name: BAKED CHICKEN LEGS
ingredients:
12  chicken legs
2  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. cracker crumbs
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. butter or margarine
preparation: Dip chicken pieces in egg, then in cracker crumbs.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Place chicken in casserole; dot with butter.  Cover. Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes or until tender.  Yields 8 servings.

name: CORNED BEEF AND CABBAGE
ingredients:
4  large potatoes
2  large onions
1  small head shredded cabbage
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can corned beef
preparation: In large baking dish, slice potatoes.  Add onions.  Put shredded cabbage on top of onions.  Crumble corned beef on top of cabbage.  Add a little water to mushroom soup and pour over top. Bake for 1 hour at 350°, uncovered, until potatoes are cooked.

name: DRY ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
12  oz. carton cottage cheese
3  oz. pkg. orange Jell-O
11  oz. can mandarin oranges, drained
15  oz. can pineapple tidbits, drained
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Mix all ingredients (do not dissolve Jell-O in water, use it dry).  Let set overnight in refrigerator.  Ready to serve.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1  (14 oz.) bag caramels
3/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix the cake as directed on box.  Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pour 1/2 of the cake batter into the pan.  Bake until done, about 15 minutes, at 350°.

name: COOKED FRUIT
ingredients:
30  oz. can fruit cocktail, drained
14  oz. can pineapple tidbits, drained
1 small  jar cherries, drained and sliced
1 small  can mandarin oranges, drained
1  can peach pie filling
2  large bananas, sliced
1/2  stick melted margarine
1  c. brown sugar
pinch of curry
cinnamon
preparation: Mix cocktail, pineapple, cherries, oranges, peach pie filling and bananas. Melt margarine and add brown sugar and curry. Mix with the fruit. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 300° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: MOCK OYSTER STEW
ingredients:
1  small eggplant
1  onion
2  qt. whole milk
1  stick butter
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cube  eggplant   into  small  pieces.  Sauté  eggplant, onion, salt and pepper  in  butter.  Add  milk.  Heat;  do not boil.

name: BROWN SUGAR POUND CAKE
ingredients:
5  eggs
1  c. Crisco
1  stick margarine
1  box brown sugar (light)
1  c. white sugar
4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. maple flavoring
preparation: Bake 1 hour at 350° in tube pan.

name: STRAWBERRIES IN THE SNOW
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
8  oz. cream cheese
1  box powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  pkg. strawberry glaze
1  qt. fresh strawberries
preparation: Crumble cake in bowl.  Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and sugar together; make thin and pour on cake.  Mix strawberries and glaze together and pour on top of other mixture.

name: CABBAGE, CARROT AND RAISIN SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. grated, pared carrot
1  c. shredded green cabbage
1/4  c. seedless raisins
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. cooked salad dressing or dressing of your choice
preparation: Lightly toss carrot, cabbage, raisins, salt, lemon juice and sugar until well combined.  Refrigerate until well chilled.  Just before serving, toss with dressing.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE(Makes 8 Servings)
ingredients:
6  medium sweet potatoes (approximately 6 c.)
1/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. milk
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/3  c. brown sugar, packed
1/3  c. chopped pecans
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Cook sweet potatoes in boiling water with skins on for 45 minutes or until tender.  When cool to touch, peel and mash. Combine sweet potatoes, sugar, eggs, vanilla, milk and butter. Beat with electric mixer on medium speed until smooth.  Spoon mixture into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.  Combine 1/3 cup brown sugar, pecans, flour and 2 tablespoons butter; sprinkle mixture over casserole.  Bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: SWEET-SOUR BEETS
ingredients:
3  c. cooked or canned beets
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
grated rind of 1/2 lemon
2  Tbsp. orange juice
grated rind of 1/4 orange
preparation: If you are using fresh beets, scrub well and cut off tops, leaving about an inch of stem on the beets.  Cook in boiling water until tender, 45 to 60 minutes, depending upon size and age. Drain, saving 1/3 cup cooking liquid.  Peel and dice.

name: 5 CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. pineapple, diced
1  c. oranges
1  c. grapes
1  c. coconut or small marshmallows
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Drain fruit well.  Mix all ingredients together.  Chill.

name: QUICK AND EASY SALMON CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 large  can red salmon, drain off half of juice
1  c. milk
1  c. cracker crumbs
1  egg, beaten
1/4  medium onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Spread the mixed ingredients into a buttered casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until the top is slightly golden brown.   Serves 4.

name: BUTTER CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. corn syrup
3/4  c. chopped nuts
4  oz. milk chocolate
preparation: Melt butter over low heat.  Remove from heat.  Add sugar. Return to heat and wait for sugar and butter to bubble.  Add water and syrup.  Mix well.  Cook over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes (hard crack stage).  Remove from heat.  Add nuts.  Pour on lightly greased baking sheet.  Spread to 1/4-inch thick.  Spread melted chocolate over the top of the crunch as it begins to harden. Sprinkle nuts over chocolate, if desired.

name: PARTY PIZZA APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1  lb. Hot Sausage (cooked, drained and crumbled)
1  c. Onion (Chopped)
1/2  c. Sharp Cheese (grated)
1/2  c. Grated Parmesan Cheese (from wedge)
1 1/2  tsp. Oregano
1  tsp. Garlic Salt
1 (8 oz.)  can Tomato Sauce
1 (6 oz.)  can Tomato Paste
3  cans Flaky Biscuits (Hungry Jack brand)
preparation: Combine first 8 ingredients.  Separate each biscuit into 3 pizza rounds.   Spread with mixture.  Put pizzas on cookie sheet and freeze.  Remove from cookie sheet and store in plastic bags. Bake frozen pizzas at 425 degrees for 10 minutes.  Great for a party.

name: CRISPY BACON COLESLAW
ingredients:
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. sugar
4  c. shredded green cabbage
1  c. shredded red cabbage
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
6  slices bacon, cooked crispy and crumbled
preparation: Mix mayonnaise and sugar in large bowl.  Add remaining ingredients; mix and refrigerate.  Makes about 10 servings.

name: POACHED FISH BERG-STYLE
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. fish fillets
1  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
butter
1  medium onion, minced
3/4  c. well-drained canned tomatoes
parsley, minced
1/4  c. water with 1/2 tsp. lemon juice or 1/4 c. white wine
1/4  c. light cream
1  tsp. flour
preparation: Cut a circle of waxed paper to fit a 10-inch skillet.  Tear a small hole in the center.  Set aside.  Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper.  Saute onion with some butter in the skillet until golden brown.  Top with the fish, tomatoes and parsley.  Add the lemon water or white wine.  Lay the paper circle on top.  Bring to a boil.  Cover and cook over high heat 5 to 10 minutes.  Remove cover and paper.  Pour cream around the fish.  Mix 1 tablespoon softened butter with the flour and stir into the cooking liquid, moving skillet in a circular motion to blend until sauce thickens. Spoon sauce over fish and sprinkle with parsley.  Serve from skillet or arrange on a platter with the sauce.  Serves 6.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  unbeaten eggs
3  to 4 mashed ripe bananas
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and soda.  Set aside. Add sugar gradually to shortening.  Blend in eggs, beating well after each.  Stir in bananas.  Blend in the sifted dry ingredients.  Stir in chopped nuts.  Turn into 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan, well-greased on bottom.  Bake at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes.  Cool before slicing.

name: QUICK CHILI SUPPER
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
16  oz. corn, drained
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  c. instant rice
1/2  c. water
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a 2-quart microwavable dish, cook hamburger and onion, covered, for 6 minutes on High.  Break up hamburger; cover and cook 4 more minutes.  Drain grease.  Add remaining ingredients, except cheese.  Stir, cover and cook 5 minutes.  Cook 1 to 1 1/2 minutes on High or until melted.

name: BROCCOLI-CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of broccoli soup
1 soup  can milk
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. ground red pepper
2  c. shredded cheese
4  large eggs, separated (whites brought to room temperature)
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and squeezed dry
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Lightly grease an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish.  Mix the soup, milk, flour, mustard and pepper in a 3-quart saucepan until blended.  Stir over medium-high heat until almost boiling.  Remove from heat.  Add cheese; stir until melted. Stir in egg yolks and broccoli until blended.  Cool slightly. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form; fold into broccoli mixture.  Pour into prepared dish.   Bake for 50 minutes, until top is golden and puffy and a knife inserted comes out clean. Makes 8 servings.

name: PINEAPPLE-BANANA DELIGHT
ingredients:
2  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1  c. miniature marshmallows
3 1/4  c. boiling water
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple (save juice)
4  large bananas, sliced
preparation: Mix Jell-O, boiling water and marshmallows and set aside to thicken.  Add pineapple and bananas.  Pour into large Pyrex dish.

name: CRISPY ITALIAN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. olive oil or 1 c. (2 sticks) butter or margarine, melted
1  c. Italian-style bread crumbs
1  loaf (16 oz.) Italian bread
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Cut bread in half lengthwise.  Place on a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, combine olive oil or butter or margarine and bread crumbs.  Spread cut surfaces of bread with crumb mixture.  Switch oven to broil.  Broil bread 3 inches from heat source for one minute or until surface is bubbly and lightly browned.  Slice and serve immediately.  Makes 16 (2-inch) slices.

name: ICEBOX FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. evaporated milk
1 large  pkg. marshmallows
1  box graham crackers, crushed fine
1  qt. chopped pecans
1 large  jar maraschino cherries, drained and chopped (reserve 1/4 c. juice)
preparation: (May line graham cracker box with waxed paper; cake should fit in it after preparation!)

name: ITALIAN CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  whole chicken breast (1 lb.)
4  c. bite size pieces salad greens
1  c. cherry tomato halves
1  small red onion, cut into single rings
1/2  c. small pitted ripe olives
6  radicchio or lettuce cups (optional)
1/4  lb. Mozzarella or Monterey Jack cheese, cut into strips
1 (2 oz.)  can anchovies, drained (optional)
preparation: Place chicken breast skin side up in ungreased square 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan; cover tightly.  Bake in a 350° oven until done, about 1 hour.  Prepare with Italian dressing.  Toss with greens, tomatoes, onion and olives; arrange in radicchio cups.  Arrange chicken, salami and cheese on greens mixture.  Garnish with anchovies.  Serve with breadsticks, if desired.

name: ORANGE FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can orange juice concentrate, thawed
1 (3 3/4 oz.)  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1/4  c. sour cream
1 1/4  c. cold milk
assorted fruit
preparation: Mix orange juice and milk.  Beat in pudding mix on low speed and beat for 2 minutes. Stir in sour cream.  Chill.  Serve with fruit to dip.  Strawberries, bananas and pineapple chunks are especially good.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can mandarin oranges
1  can pineapple chunks
1/2 small  pkg. miniature marshmallows
1 small  pkg. flaked coconut
sour cream
preparation: Drain fruit.  Mix first four ingredients together.  Add enough sour cream to hold together.  Let sit overnight, then serve.

name: HE-MAN BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
1  c. Crisco
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1  pkg. dry yeast, dissolved in 3 Tbsp. warm water
2 1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients.  Cut in Crisco; add buttermilk and yeast mixture.  You don't need to let them rise.  Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full.  Store remainder of dough in airtight container.  You can take dough out of refrigerator and cook.  Will keep up to 2 weeks.  Cook at 400°  until done.

name: PASTA PRIMA
ingredients:
1/2  c. real mayonnaise
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs, beaten
10  oz. pkg. fettucini noodles, cooked and drained
12  crisply cooked bacon slices, crumbled
1/2  c. (2 oz.) grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. chopped parsley
preparation: Gradually add milk to mayonnaise; cook over low heat until warm.  Remove from heat.  Stir in eggs.  Toss with pasta until well coated.  Add bacon, cheese and parsley.  Toss lightly.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
3  sticks margarine
4 1/2  c. granulated sugar
5  eggs
5  c. flour (all-purpose)
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon extract
1/2  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Combine flour, cream of tartar, salt, baking soda and nutmeg; set aside.  Cream butter and sugar in large mixing bowl.  Stir in eggs one at a time.  Add lemon, vanilla and almond extracts; beat well.  Gradually add flour mixture and blend thoroughly.  Place in greased bowl and chill overnight.  Roll out on floured pastry cloth and cut with cookie cutters.  Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 325° until golden brown, about 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 7 dozen.

name: CHRISTMAS KRAUT
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can shredded sauerkraut, drained
1  c. chopped onions
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. chopped celery
1 small  jar pimiento, chopped and drained
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. white vinegar
preparation: Mix together all ingredients and cover.  Put in refrigerator and let set overnight.

name: QUICK AND EASY CANDY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2/3  c. milk
24  saltine crackers, crumbled
6  Tbsp. peanut butter
preparation: Combine sugar and milk in sauce pan. Boil 4 minutes. Stir in cracker crumbs and peanut butter. Drop by spoonful onto waxed paper. Cool until firm.

name: SUGAR WAFFLES
ingredients:
1  egg
1  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. flour
1/8  tsp. baking powder
2 1/4  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat egg and sugar together.  Mix in baking powder and vanilla.  Gradually add flour and water, alternating as you add. Beat together.

name: "MOM'S" BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. soft butter (not margarine)
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  egg (unbeaten)
3  tsp. vanilla
3  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix butter, sugar and egg thoroughly.  Stir in vanilla.  Sift together and stir in flour and baking powder.  Chill dough.  Roll lightly on floured board.  Cut into shapes (use cookie cutters). Place on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake until delicately browned in hot oven (425°).  Bake 5 to 7 minutes; watch, the cookies will burn easily.  Yields 6 dozen.

name: END OF THE GARDEN RELISH
ingredients:
1  c. sliced cucumber
1  c. chopped bell pepper
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped cabbage
1  c. cut green beans (green)
1  c. cut green beans (yellow)
1  c. lima beans
1  c. carrots, scraped and finely cut
1  c. whole kernel corn
1  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  qt. vinegar
1  Tbsp. celery seed
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
2  Tbsp. turmeric
2  c. sugar
preparation: Soak cucumber, pepper, onion and cabbage in salt water (1/2 cup salt to 2 quarts water) for 30 minutes.  Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.  Turn heat on low and simmer for 15 minutes.  Add raw, soaked vegetables.   Boil again for 15 minutes.  Put in hot, sterilized jars and seal.  Makes 6 to 7 pints.

name: CREAMY TOMATO SOUP
ingredients:
1 (13 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed tomato soup
1 soup  can water
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. celery salt
preparation: Blend cream cheese with soup to make a smooth mixture.  Stir in water, Worcestershire sauce and celery and salt.  Heat on simmer until hot, stirring often.

name: ITALIAN CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
5  eggs, separated
1 (7 oz.)  can coconut
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. shortening
1  tsp. soda
1  c. chopped pecans
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
preparation: Cream the margarine, shortening and sugar.  Add egg yolks; beat well.  Combine flour and soda; add to cream mixture alternately with buttermilk.  Stir in vanilla.  Add coconut and nuts.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.  Pour into 3 well-greased 8-inch round pans.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lean hamburger
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
1  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
2  cans mushroom soup
1 large  pkg. Tater Tots
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Line the bottom of a baking dish (10 x 14-inches) with hamburger meat.  Sprinkle Lipton onion soup on top.  Put mixed vegetables on top of this.  Cover with mushroom soup and place Tater Tots on top. Bake in oven set at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: PICKLE ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1  jar baby dill pickles
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  pkg. Buddig dried beef
preparation: Leave all ingredients out for 2 hours to soften.  Lay the pickles out on a paper towel; pat to dry.  Lay dried beef out flat and spread softened cream cheese on meat.  Place pickle on edge of meat and roll the meat around pickle (jelly roll style).  Repeat steps and re-roll the pickle with a 2nd piece of meat. Refrigerate the rolls for approximately 1 hour before slicing.

name: CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
2 1/4  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
9-inch unbaked pastry shell
nutmeg
preparation: Beat eggs slightly; add sugar, salt, milk and vanilla extract. Pour into pastry shell;  Sprinkle with nutmeg.  Bake in hot oven (425°) for 40 minutes or until inserted knife comes out clean.

name: Mother's Caramel Sauce
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. boiling water
preparation: Put all ingredients in a pot altogether under low heat.  Stir until it is dark brown.  (Be careful not to burn).  When dark brown, pour 2 cups boiling water and stir until it becomes a smooth mixture.

name: APRICOT BARS
ingredients:
1  c. dried apricots
3/4  c. water
1  c. all-purpose flour
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. grated orange peel
2  Tbsp. orange juice
2  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Cut apricots  in  small  pieces;  combine  with  water; cover and simmer for 20 minutes.	Meanwhile, mix flour, butter and  1/2 cup  sugar.  Press crumbly mixture into greased 11 x 7-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Mix 1 cup  sugar, cornstarch, and salt; stir into undrained apricots and  cook until  thickened, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat;  stir in	remaining  ingredients,  reserving  a  little coconut.	Spread apricot  mixture  over baked crust; sprinkle top with remaining coconut.  Bake at 350°for 25 minutes.  Cool in pan; cut into bars. Makes 27 to 30 bars.

name: BREAD DIP
ingredients:
4  pkg. Carl Buddig thin sliced beef
2  (8 oz.) lite cream cheese
1  tomato, peeled
1/2  bell pepper
1  bunch green onions
1  c. Cheddar cheese
preparation: Chop and mix all ingredients together in food processor.  Put in hollowed out loaf of French bread.  Sprinkle more Cheddar cheese on top and bake at 350° until bubbly.

name: MEAT BALL SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  jar grape jelly
1  jar chili sauce
meat balls
preparation: Mix together jelly and chili sauce.  Cook meat balls in separate pan.  When done, put in pan with sauce and simmer 1 to 2 hours.  Stir occasionally.

name: SHRIMP PUFFS
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh shrimp, cleaned and chopped fine
1  can water chestnuts, chopped fine
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. sherry
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg, slightly beaten
preparation: Mix and shape into dollar size balls. Fry in deep oil until golden brown. Drain and serve.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. zucchini, diced
1  small onion, diced
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 (4 oz.)  can diced green chilies
1  lb. Monterey Jack cheese, grated
1  c. cottage cheese
1  Tbsp. salsa (more if desired)
3  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
2  tsp. minced parsley
1  egg
1 1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Combine zucchini, onion and butter in a skillet.  Saute until barely  tender.  Mix  in  chilies, flour, salt, pepper, Italian seasoning and parsley.  Turn into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with grated Jack cheese.

name: COUNTRY STYLE STEAK
ingredients:
1  pkg. cube steak
flour
salt and pepper
preparation: Flour steak; salt and pepper.  Fry good and brown.  Remove from pan.  Pour off some grease, leaving about 2 tablespoons grease.  Add about 3 to 4 tablespoons flour; mix and brown.  Add hot water; stir and bring to a boil.  Turn down heat.  Add steak; simmer for about 5 hours.  Keep checking to see if you need to add water.

name: MICROWAVE PEANUT BRITTLE(Never Fails!)
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. roasted, salted peanuts
1  tsp. butter
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Note:  If raw peanuts are used, add before microwaving to the sugar-syrup mixture along with 1/8 teaspoon salt.

name: AUNT BETTY'S MISSISSIPPI MUD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  sticks butter, softened
1/2  c. finely chopped walnuts
preparation: Mix together.  Press on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.  Let cool.

name: BAKED PINEAPPLE
ingredients:
4  C. soft bread crumbs
3  eggs, beaten
1  C. sugar
1 1/2  C. milk
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1/2  C. butter or margarine, melted
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients and place in a baking dish.  Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 1 hour.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. taco mix
1  head lettuce
1  pkg. sharp Cheddar cheese
2  to 3 tomatoes, diced
1  pkg. nacho cheese chips (Doritos)
preparation: Cook and drain hamburger.  Prepare taco mix according to directions.  Cut up lettuce and tomatoes and mix together.  Add hamburger, chips and cheese just before you serve.

name: CROCK-POT CABBAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
12  large cabbage leaves
1  beaten egg
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. cooked rice
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Immerse cabbage leaves in large kettle of boiling water for 3 minutes until limp; drain.  Combine egg, milk, onion, salt, pepper, beef and cooked rice.  Place about 1/4 cup of meat mixture in center of each leaf.  Fold in sides and roll ends over meat. Place in crock-pot.  Combine sauce, brown sugar, lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce.  Pour over cabbage rolls.  Cover and cook on low for 7 to 9 hours.

name: EASY PINA COLADA CAKE
ingredients:
1  cake mix with pudding
1 (15 oz.)  can Coco Lopez cream of coconut
1/2  c. rum
1/3  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, well drained
2  Tbsp. rum
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine cake mix, 1/2 cup cream of coconut, 1/2 cup rum, oil and eggs.  Beat for 2 minutes.  Stir in pineapple.  Pour into greased 10-inch tube cake pan.  Bake for 50 to 60 minutes.  Cool; remove from pan.  Poke holes 1-inch apart almost to bottom.  Combine cream of coconut and rum.  Pour over cake and chill thoroughly.  Garnish with Cool Whip, pineapple chunks, cherries and coconut.  Store in fridge.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
taco mix
1  can refried beans
guacamole
sour cream
green onions
tomatoes
chilies in can
black olives
grated cheese, mixed
taco chips for garnish
preparation: Combine taco mix with refried beans.  Spread out in a circle on a glass plate.  Layer remaining ingredients in order given. Garnish with taco chips (make a circle).

name: BLUEBERRY ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1  small instant French vanilla pudding
2 1/2  c. sugar
vanilla to taste
1  can blueberry pie filling
1  small bowl Cool Whip
milk
preparation: Mix instant  pudding  with  1  cup  milk.  Add	rest of ingredients and  mix  well.  Pour  in  freezer  can and finish filling with milk.	Freeze and eat.

name: BUTTER NUT CHEWIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter, melted
2  eggs
2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. finely chopped nuts
preparation: Mix together and put in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour (all-purpose)
3/4  tsp. soda powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Thoroughly cream butter, peanut butter, sugar, brown sugar, egg and vanilla. Sift in dry ingredients and blend into creamed mixture and shape into balls. Put on cookie sheet and bake 10 to 15 minutes at 375°.

name: SIX LAYER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. sweet butter
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1 1/2  c. sweetened flaked coconut
1 (14 oz.)  can condensed (not evaporated) milk
preparation: Heat oven to 325°.  Put butter in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan and place in oven 2 to 3 minutes to melt.  Remove pan and add remaining ingredients in order listed, using back of spoon to flatten each layer.  Bake at 325° for 25 minutes or until lightly browned.  Remove from oven and refrigerate until cold before cutting.  Yields 36 bars with 142 calories per bar.

name: BRANDIED FRUIT
ingredients:
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
1 (16 oz.)  can sliced peaches
1 (17 oz.)  can apricot halves
1 (10 oz.)  jar maraschino cherries
1 1/4  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. brandy
preparation: Drain all fruit.  Mix all ingredients and store in a glass jar with a lid.  Let stand at room temperature for 3 weeks.   Stir 2 times a week.  Serve over ice cream or cake.

name: BARBECUED BOURBON PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  medium onion, sliced thinly
1  tsp. dried thyme
3  Tbsp. good quality sipping bourbon
2  (1-inch) thick center cut pork chops
1/2  c. barbecue sauce (any variety)
preparation: Heat oil in heavy medium saucepan over medium heat.  Add onion and saute until begin to soften.  Add thyme and saute about 1 minute.  Add bourbon and simmer until liquid is reduced to a glaze; add barbecue sauce.  Season chops with salt and pepper; grill 5 minutes per side.  Brush with sauce.  Continue grilling until done. Grilling time is about 20 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE MERINGUE PIE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. milk
4  Tbsp. flour
1  baked pie shell
6  Tbsp. sugar, folded in egg whites
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. sugar
3  egg yolks
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
3  egg whites, stiffly beaten
preparation: Heat milk.  Add beaten egg yolks.  Mix sugar, cocoa and flour. Add to milk mixture, stirring vigorously.  Return to heat and cook until thick, stirring constantly.  Add butter and vanilla. Cool and pour into pie shell.  Cover with meringue.  Bake in slow oven, 300°, until brown.

name: BUTTER CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs
2/3  c. water
1/2  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  tsp. lemon extract
1  box Duncan Hines Butter cake mix
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Preheat oven to 375°.  Pour in Bundt pan and bake 45 minutes.

name: CRANBERRY ORANGE RELISH
ingredients:
2  lb. cranberries
juice from 2 oranges
preparation: Clean and dry thoroughly 2 pounds of fresh cranberries.  Freeze overnight.  Grind cranberries without thawing.  Squeeze the juice from 2 oranges and then grind the rind.  Mix altogether with sugar substitute to taste.  Yield:  4 cups.  Carbohydrate 2 g, protein 0 g, fat 0 g, calories 8. One tablespoon = free food exchange.

name: CORN VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can creamed corn or use frozen corn
1  can whole kernel corn
1  stick oleo or butter
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. sour cream or yogurt
1 small  box Jiffy corn muffin mix
salt to taste
preparation: Butter a casserole dish.  Heat corn.  Add butter, eggs and sour cream.  Mix in the Jiffy mix.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  slices bread (crusts removed)
3  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
pinch of salt
1  can crushed pineapple (No. 2 1/2 size)
1  stick butter or margarine
preparation: Grease casserole lightly.  Cube bread.  Beat eggs; gradually add sugar, flour, salt and crushed pineapple, juice and all.  Mix all together and put into casserole, then put bread cubes on top. Then slice 1 stick of butter over all.  Bake approximately 45 minutes at 400° uncovered.  Serves 6 to 8 (in an 8 x 8-inch pan). Excellent with ham or as a side dish.

name: GOOEY BUTTER CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
2  beaten eggs
1  box yellow cake mix
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
3  c. powdered sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix butter, beaten eggs and cake mix together.  Spread in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan, greased and floured.  Beat eggs, cream cheese and powdered sugar until creamy.  Pour over batter.  Sprinkle with chopped pecans.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Sprinkle with a little powdered sugar when done.

name: ITALIAN SPICE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. basil, ground
2  tsp. marjoram, ground
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. each: minced garlic and onion
preparation: Place in a sealable freezer bag and freeze.  It preserves flavor better than drying.

name: TERIYAKI CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
3  lb. chicken wings or drumettes (can use more or less)
1  c. soy sauce
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. pineapple juice
1/4  c. sherry wine
1 1/2  tsp. powdered ginger
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Disjoint chicken wings, cut off tips.  Set wings aside.  Mix all other ingredients in pan.  Heat and stir until sugar is dissolved.  Pour over chicken wings and marinate for 12 hours. Refrigerate while marinating.  Stir occasionally to coat.  Bake in oven uncovered for 1 hour at 350°.  Stir once or twice while baking.

name: PIG PICKEN CAKE(Mandarin Orange)
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1/2  c. oil
3  eggs
2 small  cans mandarin oranges (undrained)
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients together.  Stir in mandarin oranges. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350°.

name: JOHNNYCAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. cornmeal
1  c. sour milk
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  c. molasses
1/4  c. oil
1  egg
preparation: To make sour milk, place 1 tablespoon vinegar in bottom of cup and add milk.

name: DILLY CHEESE BATTER BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1  c. small curd cottage cheese, heated to lukewarm
2  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. dill seed
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. soda
1  unbeaten egg
2 1/2  c. flour
garlic butter
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water.  Combine cottage cheese, sugar, onion, butter, dill seed, salt, soda and egg; add yeast mixture and beat until it forms a stiff dough.  Cover and let rise until double in bulk, 50 to 60 minutes.  Pat down and turn into a well-greased tube pan.  Let rise 30 to 40 minutes.  Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes.  Remove from oven and brush with garlic butter.

name: ORANGE JULIUS
ingredients:
1  (6 oz.) orange juice concentrate
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
16  ice cubes
Cool Whip or whipped cream
preparation: Blend in blender. Top with drop of Cool Whip or whipped cream. Serve immediately.

name: SOUTH OF THE BORDER MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. (1.25 oz.) taco seasoning
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. unseasoned dry bread crumbs
1/4  c. finely chopped green bell pepper
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  c. chunky salsa
preparation: In large bowl, combine all ingredients except salsa; blend well. Form into 1-inch balls.  In large skillet, brown meatballs on all sides; drain fat.  Add salsa to skillet.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CORNBREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
4  c. crumbled cornbread
2  c. crumbled toast crumbs
4 1/2  c. chicken, pork or turkey stock
3  boiled eggs
1  c. grated celery
1/2  c. grated onion
1/2  c. grated bell pepper
preparation: Mix cornbread with bread crumbs and add boiling stock.  Cover and set for 5 to 10 minutes.  Add chopped boiled eggs, celery, onion and bell pepper.  Bake in a well-greased pan at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Since stock and bread are already seasoned, add salt and pepper only if desired.  Makes 8 cups.

name: PIZZA
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. hamburger
1/4  c. chopped onion
6  oz. tomato paste
2  lb. Parmesan cheese
1 to 1 1/2  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. sweet basil
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  cans buttermilk biscuits
preparation: Cook hamburger and onion together.  Drain.  Mix all ingredients into hamburger.  Warm up.  Flatten and pinch together biscuits. Spray pan with Pam.  Spread meat with ingredients over the biscuit dough.  Then spread ingredients (mushrooms, etc.) to your liking. Top with Mozzarella cheese.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: BREAKFAST PIZZA
ingredients:
1  pkg. Pillsbury crescent rolls
4  eggs
2  Tbsp. water
1  c. chopped ham, sausage or bacon
1/2  c. diced onion
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese or Monterey Jack cheese mix
preparation: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pat crescent rolls into bottom of pan for crust.  Beat eggs, water and onion.  Pour over crust (will barely cover).  Top with meat, then cheese.  Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: CRAB DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
6 to 7  oz. crab meat
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped fine
1  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. horseradish
paprika
preparation: Drain crabmeat of liquid.  Combine other ingredients in a shallow pie plate that has been greased with butter.  Carefully fold in crab meat.  Sprinkle top with paprika.  Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes or until top is bubbly and brown.

name: FIESTA CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. canned cream-style corn
2  c. canned whole kernel corn
1/4  c. chopped ripe olives
1/4  c. pimento, chopped
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. cracker crumbs
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
little Tabasco sauce
preparation: I add some milk if necessary as the corn has little juice. Combine corn, olives, pimento, onion, pepper with eggs and cracker crumbs.  Mix thoroughly.  Pour into casserole.  Season with butter.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until set like custard.

name: HOT DOG RELISH
ingredients:
1  gal. shredded cabbage
3  onions
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. hot pepper (dried)
3  shredded carrots
1  c. white vinegar
2  c. mustard
preparation: Put together and cook slow 40 minutes. Put in jars. Hot water bath 10 minutes. Makes 6 pints.

name: CHEESEBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cheese slices
1  can biscuits
1/4  c. catsup
3/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Combine beef and onion in skillet.  Cook until meat is slightly browned; drain fat and add salt and pepper.  Stir in catsup and tomato sauce.  Heat thoroughly.	Put into 8-inch square or 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Put meat in dish and cover with cheese; put biscuits on top.  Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

name: EASY BAKE PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  lean pork chops
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Place pork chops in long baking dish.  Sprinkle all ingredients over them.  Spread on sauce.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until done.

name: PATTY'S CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1 (17 oz.)  can butterscotch pudding
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs
6  oz. butterscotch chips
preparation: Combine cake mix, pudding and eggs; mix well. Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle with sugar.  Top with butterscotch chips.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: BASQUE VEGETABLE STEW(Serves 8)
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
1  large onion, sliced thin
2  large garlic cloves, minced
8  to 10 red new potatoes, unpeeled and sliced in 1/4-inch slices
3  large firm tomatoes, chopped
4  large carrots, sliced in 1/8-inch slices
1 1/2  c. sliced celery
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. parsley
1/3 to 1/2  c. chicken broth
preparation: Melt butter in a Dutch oven and saute onions and garlic until onions  are  translucent  and soft.  Add potato slices; cover  and simmer,  stirring	often until potatoes are almost tender, about 20 minutes.  If necessary, add more butter.  Add tomatoes, carrots, celery, salt and pepper; cover and continue cooking  on low  heat until carrots are tender, about 20 minutes.

name: VEAL GOULASH
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  lb. veal in 3/4-inch cubes (chicken or pork may be substituted)
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce with mushrooms
1  envelope (approximately 16 oz.)  Sloppy Joes mix
1/2  c. sour cream
1  tsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Brown meat.  Bring tomato sauce and Sloppy Joes mix to a boil; add meat and simmer 30 minutes, stirring often (prevent sticking). Just before serving, remove from heat and stir in sour cream. Garnish with parsley.  Serve on noodles.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. mashed sweet potatoes (use canned)
1  c. sugar
1  c. evaporated milk
1  egg
1/2  c. coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Put in greased casserole and bake 45 minutes in 350° oven.

name: HOT PEPPERS
ingredients:
banana peppers
2  qt cold water
1  qt white vinegar
1  c salt
cloves of garlic
Pure olive oil
preparation: USE RUBBER GLOVES!  Wash and dry banana peppers, remove seeds and cut into strips or rings.  Pack firmly into jar.  Mix the solution together.  Place 1 or 2 cloves of garlic in each jar then pour solution over peppers.  Remove bubbles with a knife.  Put 1 Tbsp of pure olive oil on top of each jar and seal.  Ready to eat in 3 to 4 weeks.

name: PARTY CRACKERS
ingredients:
2  pkg. oyster crackers
1  pkg. Hidden Ranch dressing mix
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. dill weed
1  c. oil
preparation: In paper sack (double), pour oyster crackers and all spices. Pour 1 cup of oil in bag.  Shake well.  Let set for 2 or 24 hours.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. spaghetti
1 large  bottle Italian dressing (16 oz.)
1/2 to 1  bottle McCormick Salad Supreme
1  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1  tomato
black olives (optional)
green olives (optional)
preparation: Cook spaghetti according to package directions.  Cool.  Add all ingredients.  Mix and refrigerate.

name: FRENCH MARKET SQUASH
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow squash or 3 pkg. frozen
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 small  carton sour cream
1  grated carrot
1  firmly chopped onion
1 small  jar pimento, chopped
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm cornbread stuffing mix
1  stick melted butter
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. white pepper
preparation: Boil squash in salted water for 7 to 10 minutes, until soft; drain and add soup, sour cream, carrot, onion, pimento and 1/2 package stuffing mix.  Mix in with butter, salt and pepper.  Put in large casserole dish and top with remaining stuffing mix.

name: CONSUME RICE
ingredients:
1/2  stick oleo
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. dry rice
2  c. water
3  chicken bouillon cubes
salt and pepper
preparation: Saute dry rice and onion in butter until rice turns dark brown. Dissolve bouillon cubes into 2 cups hot water and add salt and pepper to taste for 1 cup rice.  Mix all in a covered dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: SEVEN LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  qt. shredded lettuce
2  c. chopped tomatoes
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, thawed and drained
4  oz. Kraft mild Cheddar, cubed
1  c. red onion rings
2  c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
2  c. mushrooms
preparation: In a 2-quart serving bowl, layer lettuce, tomatoes, mushrooms, peas, cheese and onions.  Spread salad dressing over onions. Cover and chill several hours or overnight.  Garnish with bacon and shredded cheese, if desired.  Makes 8 servings.

name: PEGGY'S SWEDISH MEATBALLS
ingredients:
3/4  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  lb. ground veal
1/4  lb. ground pork
1 1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
1  c. light cream
1/2  c. chopped onion, cooked until tender
1  Tbsp. butter
1  egg
1/4  c. snipped parsley
1 1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper, ginger and nutmeg
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Grind together the beef, veal and pork twice.  Soak the bread crumbs in cream for 5 minutes.  Mix meats, crumb mixture, onion, egg, parsley, salt, pepper, ginger and nutmeg.  Beat 5 minutes at medium speed.  Shape into small balls.  Brown in 2 tablespoons of butter.  Prepare Swedish Meatball Gravy.

name: ONE-HALF GALLON BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  gal. vinegar
3/4  c. vegetable oil
1  stick butter
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. A.1. Sauce
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. salt
1/4  c. pepper
1/4  c. ketchup
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and boil for 5 minutes before using.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2 (8 1/2 oz.)  boxes cornbread muffin mix
1 (16 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
1 (10 oz.)  box frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
1  small onion, chopped
4  eggs
dash of garlic powder
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
preparation: In large bowl combine cornbread muffin mix, beaten eggs, cottage cheese, thawed broccoli, chopped onion and garlic powder. Mix well.  Add melted margarine and mix.  Pour into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

name: PEANUT BUTTER AND CRACKERS(Men Only)
ingredients:
8  crackers (salted or unsalted)
honey, jam or jelly
2  Tbsp. peanut butter
preparation: Place 4 crackers on a tablecloth.  Smooth peanut butter over them; add jam, jelly or honey.  Top with remaining crackers.  Lay a knife on tablecloth.  Leave top off honey, jam or jelly, whichever you use.  Stay out of house until wife "cools-off"!

name: PEANUT CLUSTERS
ingredients:
24  oz. almond bark
16  oz. chocolate chips
16  oz. Spanish peanuts
preparation: Melt almond bark and chocolate chips in a double boiler over medium heat, stirring constantly until smooth.  Add your nuts and drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.

name: DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
1/4  c. shortening
1  yeast cake
1  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
3 1/2  c. flour
shortening (for deep frying)
preparation: Heat milk slightly and dissolve yeast.  Add 1 1/2 cups flour and beat until smooth.  Let rise in a warm place until double in bulk, about 2 hours.  Cream shortening, salt and sugar.  Add eggs and beat.  Blend this mixture into yeast sponge.  Add remaining flour and knead well, about 5 minutes.  Rub with shortening and let rise again until double in bulk.  Roll about 1/2-inch thick and cut with doughnut cutter.  Let rise about 45 minutes.  Fry in deep shortening.  Dip in caramel syrup.  Let cool.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1/4  c. plus 1 Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1  c. blueberries, drained
1/3  c. shortening, melted
preparation: Sift together flour, baking soda, cream of tartar, sugar and salt.  Make a well in the middle of the dry ingredients and add the beaten egg, milk and melted shortening.  Mix to combine. Lightly fold in blueberries.  Bake in muffin tin at 400°  for 18 to 20 minutes.  Makes 12.

name: CUCUMBER SALAD
ingredients:
2  cucumbers
1  small onion (red or white)
1/2  c. sour cream
1/3  c. vinegar
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Serves about 6.  Excellent for summer.

name: BAKED BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen broccoli spears, thawed
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can drained mushrooms
1 small  can fried onion rings
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  c. buttered, cubed bread pieces
preparation: Layer broccoli, soup, mushrooms and onion rings twice.  Top with cheese and bread cubes.  Bake for 30 minutes at 400°.

name: PASTA FASOOLA
ingredients:
1  can white or Great Northern beans
2  cans water
1/2  onion, chopped
3  stalks celery, chopped
1  to 2 garlic, minced
2  large tomatoes
parsley, chopped
basil to taste
salt to taste
1/2  c. oil
1/2  lb. salad macaroni
grated cheese
preparation: Saute celery and onion in oil until soft.  Mash tomatoes. Cook macaroni.  Add all ingredients to onion mixture.  Simmer 20 minutes or so.  Serve with a little grated cheese.

name: CHEESE AND HAMBURGER
ingredients:
1  can Hormel chili without beans
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  medium onion
1 large  pkg. Mexican Velveeta cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion.  Cut bars of cheese into slices for easier melting.  Combine all ingredients in a crock-pot, or until cheese is melted.  Stir occasionally.  Serve with chips.

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
2  c. boiling water
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
2  bananas, mashed
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
1  carton sour cream
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water and add partially thawed strawberries.  Add pineapple and bananas.  Put 1/2 mixture into 9 x 12-inch dish and place into refrigerator to set.  When set, spread sour cream over top and add remaining mixture.  Place into refrigerator to set.  Cut into squares.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. pasta, cooked, drained and rinsed (can use linguini, shells, rotini, spaghetti, etc.)
1 large  bottle Italian dressing
Salad Supreme seasoning (1/2 bottle or more)
chopped onion
chopped cucumber
chopped tomatoes
chopped green peppers
chickpeas (garbanzo beans)
any chopped raw vegetables
preparation: Can also add shredded cheese.

name: JIM'S EASY BRUNSWICK STEW
ingredients:
1 large  can white chicken, undrained
1  1/2 cups pork, cooked & diced
1/2  lb. ground beef, browned & drained
1  onion, chopped
1 large  can tomatoes
1  can whole kernel corn, undrained
1  can chicken broth
1/4  cup vinegar
14  oz. ketchup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt & pepper, to taste
cayenne pepper, to taste
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion, drain. Add cooked pork and chicken. Add all other ingredients. Stir frequently. Simmer for approximately 1 - 1 1/2 hours. Serve over cooked rice. Great with crackers or cornbread muffins.

name: SWEDISH APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. flour
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
a few chopped walnuts
5  apples, peeled and sliced
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in bowl; put in 9-inch pie tin (greased) and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CHIPMUNKS (MOM'S)
ingredients:
1  c. boiling water
1  c. chopped dates
1/4  c. cocoa
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chocolate chips
1/2  c. chopped nuts (use more, if desired)
preparation: Combine boiling water and dates; let cool.  Cream shortening and sugar; add beaten eggs.  Sift cocoa, flour and salt.  Add dry ingredients and date mixture into the creamed ingredients.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Spread flat in pan.  Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cut into squares when cooled.

name: CRANBERRY/ORANGE NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. sugar
juice and rind of 1 orange
2  Tbsp. shortening
boiling water
1  beaten egg
1  c. nuts
1  c. raw, chopped cranberries
2  c. coarsely cut up, pitted dates
2  tsp. baking soda
1  Tbsp. melted margarine
2 3/4  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. boiling water
1  c. sugar
2  egg whites, lightly beaten
1  c. coarsely chopped walnuts
preparation: Mix dates, boiling water and soda; cool, cover and let it stand overnight.  Next day, preheat oven to 325°.  Add sugar, margarine and egg whites to date mixture and stir until sugar dissolves.  Add flour, a few spoonfuls at a time, mixing after each addition until smooth.  Stir in nuts and vanilla.

name: PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef or Italian sausage
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. pepper
2 (15 oz.)  cans or jars pizza sauce
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. milk
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1  box mini lasagna noodles or egg noodles
preparation: Brown meat with onions.  Add rest of ingredients, except cheese; simmer.  Cook noodles according to package directions; drain.  Mix sauce with noodles.  Layer in baking pan with cheese. Bake at 350°, covered, for 45 minutes and then 15 minutes, uncovered.

name: PEACHES AND CREAM CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1 small  pkg. dry vanilla pudding (not instant)
3  Tbsp. margarine, softened
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1 (16 oz.)  can sliced peaches, drained (reserve 3 Tbsp.  peach juice)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. reserved peach juice
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Grease bottom and sides of a 9-inch deep dish or 10-inch pie pan.  Beat together at medium speed for 2 minutes the flour, baking powder, pudding, margarine, egg and milk.  Pour into pan. Arrange drained sliced peaches over the batter.  (Reserve 3 tablespoons of peach juice.)

name: ROSETTES
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  tsp. sugar
pinch of salt
1  c. milk
1/2  c. cornstarch
1/2  c. flour
vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, eggs, vanilla and salt together, then sift flour and cornstarch and pour alternately with milk.  Fry in hot grease.

name: POOR BOY FILLETS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped mushrooms, drained
2  Tbsp. finely chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. lemon pepper seasoning
6  slices bacon
preparation: Shape ground beef into 12 x 7 1/2-inch rectangle on sheet of waxed paper.  Sprinkle remaining ingredients, except bacon, evenly over beef.  Beginning at short end, roll up, jelly roll fashion, lifting wax paper to support ground beef.  Slide roll onto baking sheet, seam side down.  Smooth and shape roll.  Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.

name: PIPING HOT BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
4  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. sugar
2/3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  c. shortening
preparation: Roll dough half as thick as you like your biscuits.  Sift together flour, baking powder, sugar, salt and cream of tartar. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Add milk all at once.  Stir with a fork just until moistened, knead gently 10 times on lightly floured surface.  Roll or pat dough 1/2-inch thick.  Cut with floured biscuit cutter.  Place on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes 16.

name: MARINATED TOMATOES
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vinegar
3  Tbsp. oil
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. minced onion
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix together ingredients and pour over tomatoes that have been cut in small wedges.

name: "HOUSE" SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. salad oil
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. grated onion
2  c. catsup
preparation: Beat all on low speed in blender until well blended.

name: SPINACH PIE PARMA
ingredients:
2  c. seasoned croutons, coarsely crushed
1/4  c. margarine, melted
grated Parmesan cheese
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1  c. small curd cottage cheese
4  oz. Monterey Jack cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
3  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. dairy sour cream
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine croutons and margarine; mix well and press into bottom of 9-inch pie plate.  Combine 1/4 cup Parmesan and remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Spoon over crust.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until set.  Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese. Let stand five minutes before serving.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2  medium chopped onions
1  chopped bell pepper
Progresso bread crumbs
1  can cream of mushroom soup
salt and pepper to taste
3  stalks chopped celery
2  minced pods garlic
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
3  pkg. grated Cheddar
chopped parsley
cabbage
preparation: Preboil cabbage; drain and chop.  Saute onions, celery and bell pepper in margarine.  Add cabbage and smother.  Add cheese and cook 5 minutes.  Add soup and enough bread crumbs to give consistency desired.  Place in greased casserole dish and cover with more bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SEAFOOD SALAD
ingredients:
2  envelopes Knox gelatine
1  c. hot tomato soup
1  c. mayonnaise
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. chopped celery
2  chopped green onions
2  c. tuna, shrimp or crab or any combination
preparation: Blend Knox gelatine with 1 cup hot tomato soup (mixed according to directions on can).  Blend mayonnaise with cream cheese.  Stir into tomato mixture.  Add scant 1/2 teaspoon salt, sugar, chopped green pepper, celery and green onions.  After all the mixture is well mixed, gently fold in tuna, shrimp or crab or any combination.  Pour into mold and chill until set.

name: MICROWAVE CUSTARD
ingredients:
2  c. milk
3  beaten eggs
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
ground nutmeg
preparation: Measure milk.  Cook uncovered at High for 4 minutes.  Combine with beaten eggs, sugar and vanilla in bowl, adding gradually. Pour into 4 (1/2 cup) custard bowls. and sprinkle with nutmeg. Place cups into glass baking dish with 1 inch hot water in dish. Microwave uncovered 10 minutes and cool.

name: PECAN CHEWS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. soft caramels
2  Tbsp. heavy cream
1 1/4  c. pecan halves
dipping chocolate (optional)
preparation: In a double boiler melt the caramels and heavy cream over hot, not boiling water.  Scatter nuts thickly in the bottom of the pan. Let caramel mixture cook a few minutes, then drop spoonfuls of the caramel partially over the nuts, letting the nuts stick out around the caramel.  Let stand until firm, then cover or dip each piece with chocolate.

name: PASTA PRIMAVERA
ingredients:
4  tsp. olive oil
1  clove garlic, crushed
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. sliced zucchini
3/4  c. sliced mushrooms
1  c. broccoli florets
1/4  c. chicken broth
3/4  c. halved cherry tomatoes
1/4  c. chopped parsley
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. dried basil
1/2  tsp. oregano
2  c. cooked spaghetti
2  oz. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
6  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
coarsely ground pepper
preparation: In a large skillet, heat olive oil. Add garlic, onion, zucchini and mushrooms.  Saute until onion is translucent.  Add broccoli and broth. Cover and steam 5 to 7 minutes or until broccoli is just tender-crisp.  Add tomatoes, parsley, lemon juice and seasonings.  Toss thoroughly.  Serve over spaghetti. Sprinkle with Mozzarella and Parmesan.  Makes 4 servings.

name: STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. rice
6  bell peppers
1  lb. ground meat
1/2  stick butter
2  onions, chopped
2  green onions, chopped
1/2  tsp. beef bouillon (granules)
2  pinches basil
2  shakes Tabasco
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/3  c. grated Parmesan
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
preparation: First, put rice onto boil.  Cut tops off the tops of bell peppers and clean out the insides.  Boil peppers in plain water 8 to 10 minutes until soft.  Brown ground meat in butter.  Drain all but 2 tablespoons of the liquid.  Add onions and green onions and saute.  Sprinkle beef bouillon, basil, Tabasco, garlic salt and chili powder.  Add tomatoes, rice, cayenne pepper and grated cheese to meat sauce and mix well.  Stuff peppers with mixture and place in a pan.  Add enough water to cover bottom of pan.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  slightly beaten egg
1  c. fresh or frozen blueberries, thawed and drained
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Grease bottoms only of 12 medium muffin cups, 2 1/2 x 1 1/4-inch, or line with paper baking cups.  Mix flour, 1/2 cup sugar, the baking powder, salt and cinnamon in a large bowl.  Stir in milk, butter, vanilla and egg just until blended.  Fold in blueberries (batter will be lumpy).  Divide batter evenly among muffin cups.  Sprinkle each muffin with 1/4 teaspoon sugar.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Cool 5 minutes; remove from pan.  Makes 1 dozen muffins.

name: FRESH CARROT SOUP
ingredients:
2  slices bacon, diced
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, crushed
2 (13 3/4 oz.)  cans condensed chicken broth
2  c. chopped carrots
1  c. diced potatoes
1  medium tomato, chopped
1  tsp. salt
dash of white pepper
preparation: Cook and stir bacon, onion and garlic in large saucepan until bacon is crisp.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Heat to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer uncovered until vegetables are tender; 15 to 20 minutes.  Pour mixture into blender and cover.  Blend on high until smooth.  If thinner consistency is desired, stir in water or chicken broth.  Garnish with sour cream, snipped parsley or shredded carrot, if desired.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1/2  c. butter
1  c. buttermilk
3  Tbsp. flour (self-rising)
1  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring
dash of nutmeg
2  frozen pie shells
preparation: Cream butter and sugar; add flour and then add beaten eggs. Add buttermilk and vanilla flavoring.  Mix well and pour into 2 frozen pie shells.  Bake at 350° for 45 or 50 minutes.  Sprinkle nutmeg on top before baking.

name: QUICK GLAZED PINEAPPLE
ingredients:
1 canned pineapple  slices or spears
Brown sugar
Bacon drippings, pan drippings or butter
Grated cheese
Red pepper grains
preparation: Drain canned pineapple.  Dip them in brown sugar.  Brown them by simmering for about 3 to 5 minutes on each side in hot drippings or butter.  You may also dust them with grated cheese and/or a few grains of red pepper and broil or bake them in a moderate oven to melt cheese.

name: M&M COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda (baking)
1 1/2  c. or 3/4 lb. plain M&M's
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Mix first five ingredients.  Add flour and soda, then candy.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
1  lb. 10x sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  pt. marshmallow
1  pt. peanut butter
preparation: Boil 10x sugar and milk for 5 minutes.  Add marshmallow and peanut butter; beat until smooth.  Pour into buttered dish and cut when cooled.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. devil's food cake mix (cook according to directions)
2 large  pkg. chocolate pudding, prepared one at a time
2  containers Cool Whip
Heath bars (as desired)
preparation: Crumble 1/2 of cake into bottom of punch bowl.  Mix 1 package of pudding and pour over hot cake.  Layer Cool Whip over pudding. Take Heath bars and crush with a rolling pin.  Sprinkle over Cool Whip.  Repeat the above process to make a second layer.  Serve.

name: ARTICHOKE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
4  chicken breasts
1  c. mushrooms, drained
1  jar marinated artichoke hearts
1  c. chicken broth
1/4  c. onion
preparation: Mix flour and seasonings; dredge chicken and brown in butter and onion.  Add broth.  Simmer 20 minutes.  Add other ingredients. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes.

name: CHRISTMAS BREAKFAST SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans crescent rolls
2  lb. Jimmy Dean sausage
1 1/2  c. mild Cheddar cheese, cubed or shredded
1 1/2  c. Monterey Jack cheese, cubed or shredded
4  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
4  eggs, beaten
preparation: Line 9 x 13-inch dish with crescent rolls, pushing dough up sides of pan.  Blend sauteed sausage, cheese and 3 eggs together. Pour in sausage mixture; cover with second can of crescent rolls. Brush top of rolls with 1 egg.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Make a day ahead and refrigerate.  I prepare this on Christmas Eve and bake it Christmas morning.  This is one of my family favorites.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
4  slices cooked and drained bacon
1  lb. ground beef
2  small onions
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. mustard
1  can tomato paste
1  Tbsp. barbecue sauce
2  cans pork and beans
preparation: Cook bacon crisp; drain and set aside.  Brown ground beef and onions; drain.  In a small bowl, combine brown sugar, mustard, tomato paste and barbecue sauce.  Add this to beef mixture; crumble bacon into all.  Add pork and beans; simmer for 10 minutes on top of stove.  Pour into casserole dish; cook at 325° for 30 or 35 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
3  c. Bisquick
1  lb. sausage
1/2  c. milk
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
preparation: Mix ingredients in order. Roll in balls. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.

name: FLUFFY MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3 medium  slices bread, torn in pieces
1  c. milk
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. sage
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients; shape into loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

name: CARAMEL POPCORN
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  box brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
3  qt. popped popcorn
1  c. peanuts
preparation: In a 4-quart dish, place brown sugar, butter, corn syrup, water and salt.  Microwave at High 12 minutes, stirring after 5 minutes.  Add soda.  Pour over popped corn and peanuts.  Toss. Spread on foil to cool or form into balls.

name: GINGERSNAPS
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1/4  c. molasses
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground cloves
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ground ginger
1  egg, beaten
2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar; add molasses and egg.  Beat well. Add dry ingredients.  Form into balls (approximately 1/2 teaspoon and roll in hands) and dip in sugar.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: DIVINITY CANDY
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3/4  c. water
3/4  c. white corn syrup
3  egg whites
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans (optional)
preparation: Cook sugar, water and syrup until it spins a thread. Gradually add this to the beaten egg whites.  Beat continuously. Beat until stiff enough to drop on buttered cookie sheet.  A cup of chopped pecans can be added to the mixture before placing on the cookie sheet.

name: BROCCOLI-CHEESE-RICE CASSEROLE(Microwave)
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli, cut
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  c. cooked rice
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/3  c. milk
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Defrost broccoli, drain.  Combine broccoli, butter, rice and cheese.  Combine egg, milk, spices and onion.  Stir into broccoli. Pour mixture into a 1 1/2-quart souffle dish.
