Cover with plastic wrap.  Microwave on 70% power 10 to 12 minutes.  Allow to stand 5 minutes before serving.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: FRENCHMAN'S STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. beef stew meat
1  large onion
2  cloves garlic
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  bell pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. rosemary
1/4  tsp. thyme
1  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Saute meat in olive oil to a golden brown; sprinkle flour over top of meat.  Chop onion, garlic and bell pepper very fine.  Add other seasonings with 1/2 cup of water.  Place lid on stew pan and simmer 2 hours.  Serves 4.  Add package of mixed vegetables, if desired.

name: GOOSEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  box lemon jello
1 3/4  c. boiling water
10  large marshmallows, cut in small pieces
1  c. sweetened gooseberries
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. mandarin oranges
preparation: Add jello to boiling water.  Stir in marshmallow pieces. Chill until partially set.  Add gooseberries, nuts, celery and oranges.  Chill and cut in squares and serve.

name: 4 LAYER PIE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick butter, softened
1  c. pecans, finely chopped
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  c. powdered sugar
12  oz. Cool Whip
1 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 small  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
3  c. cold milk
Cool Whip
grated Hershey bar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix flour, butter and pecans. Press in dish. Bake 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool.

name: NEVER FAIL CARAMEL ICING
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
6  Tbsp. white sugar
9  marshmallows
1 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
6  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. cream
preparation: Mix butter, brown and white sugar and cream.  Bring to a boil and cook rapidly for 2 minutes.  Remove from heat; add marshmallows.  When they have melted, add vanilla and sifted confectioners sugar.  Stir until thick enough to spread over layers of cake.

name: PARTY PINK PINEAPPLE PUNCH
ingredients:
5 3/4  c. pineapple juice
1  c. lemon juice
1  c. sugar
1  pt. bottle cranberry juice
2  qt. bottles ginger ale
preparation: Combine the pineapple juice, lemon juice, sugar and cranberry juice.  Stir.  Add ginger ale at last minute.  Makes 4 quarts.

name: TEXAS SPOON BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. milk
1  c. cornmeal (preferably stone-ground)
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. bacon fat or butter
1  tsp. sugar
1/3  c. green chiles, chopped
1/2  c. Monterey Jack cheese, grated
3  eggs, separated
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Scald milk in a large saucepan.  When bubbles begin to form around the edge, whisk in the cornmeal, bit by bit.  Stir until mixture thickens, then continue cooking over very low heat for 5 minutes, stirring now and again to make sure it does not stick on the bottom.   Add salt, fat and sugar, and cook several minutes longer.  Remove from the heat and stir in chiles, cheese and egg yolks. Grease a souffle dish with bacon fat or butter and heat in the oven.  Whip whites stiff, but not dry, and fold into the cornmeal mixture.  Place in the hot dish and bake 45 minutes, or until puffed up and beginning to brown on top. Serve with butter.  Serves 6.

name: GOLDEN NUGGET COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
3 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
walnut or pecan halves
preparation: Cream together butter and 1 1/4 cups sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Sift together flour, salt, soda and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Add to creamed mixture. Mix 1/4 cup sugar, 1 teaspoon cinnamon and walnut or pecan halves. Shape dough into small balls and roll in sugar mixture. Place on greased baking sheet. Press nut halves in each. Bake in 375° oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

name: BUSY DAY POT ROAST
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. chuck roast
Lipton onion soup packet
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Mix all ingredients at once.  Bake, uncovered, 1 to 2 hours or until brown and tender.

name: LAS PALMAS TURKEY ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
2  c. cooked and shredded turkey
3  c. (12 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese, divided usage
1 (4.5 oz.)  can chopped green chiles
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (19 oz.)  can Las Palmas green chile enchilada sauce
8  corn tortillas
3/4  c. dairy sour cream
preparation: In small bowl, combine turkey, 2 cups of cheese, green chiles and onion.  In small skillet, bring enchilada sauce to a boil; remove from heat.  Dip each tortilla into heated sauce to soften. Spoon 1/3 cup of turkey mixture and 2 tablespoons of sour cream down center of each tortilla.  Roll.  Place tortillas seam side down in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish.  Pour remaining heated enchilada sauce over top.  Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup of cheese.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CREAMY RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. rice
1/4  c. raisins
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  pinch salt
1  large egg
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine milk, rice, raisins, sugar and salt in saucepan. Bring to boil.  Reduce heat.  Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally until rice is tender, about 30 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Whisk egg, 2 tablespoons milk, nutmeg and cinnamon in small bowl.  Stir 1/2 cup rice into yolk mixture until blended, then stir into rest of rice.  Return to low heat and cook stirring, until most of liquid is absorbed.  Remove from heat.  Stir in vanilla.  Serve warm.

name: OVEN-BAKED CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
1  c. (2 sticks) margarine
2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. light or dark corn syrup
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
6  qt. popped corn
preparation: Melt butter; stir in brown sugar, corn syrup and salt.  Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Boil, without stirring, 5 minutes.  Remove from heat; stir in soda and vanilla.  Gradually pour over popped corn, mixing well.  Turn into 2 large, shallow pans.  Bake at 250° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.  Remove from oven and cool.  Break into smaller pieces.

name: ICEBOX COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. white sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. cinnamon
4  c. flour
preparation: Cream shortening; add sugar and mix well.  Add eggs one at a time and beat.   Sift dry ingredients and add nuts or chopped dates may be added.  Shape into rolls.  Refrigerate.  Slice thin and bake.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. cocoa
4  egg yolks
1  stick margarine
preparation: Mix sugar, cocoa, flour and egg yolks, adding milk, margarine and vanilla.  Cook well and pour into baked pie shell.  Put meringue on top and brown.  Great!

name: IRENE'S TOMATOES
ingredients:
3  or 4 large tomatoes
1  Tbsp. chopped dill
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing
preparation: Mix Italian dressing according to package directions.  Slice tomatoes and arrange them flat in a shallow dish.  Sprinkle dill and parsley over the top, then the dressing and refrigerate.

name: TORTIERRE(Canadian Pork Pie)
ingredients:
3  lb. ground pork or 1 1/2 lb. ground pork and 1 1/2 lb.  hamburger
2 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2 1/2  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. sage
1  large onion, chopped
3  to 4 medium potatoes, mashed
recipe for 2 (2-crust) pie shells
preparation: In a large, heavy pot, combine all ingredients, except crusts. Simmer for 2 to 3 hours, draining fat off with spoon as mixture cooks.  Boil and mash the potatoes.  Add to pork mixture.  Stir until thoroughly combined.

name: CHICKEN QUESADILLAS
ingredients:
1  pkg. flour tortillas (small-sized)
2  large, skinless, boneless chicken breasts
1  tsp. salt
1-1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1-1/2  tsp. onion powder
1-1/2  tsp. cajun seasoning
1  tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil, divided
1  large onion, thickly sliced
1  each, green, yellow and red peppers, cut into strips
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. shredded, Mexican style 4 cheese blend
preparation: Washed and pat dry the chicken breasts.  Marinate with garlic powder, onion powder, cajun seasoning, and crushed red pepper flakes.   Add a bit of water and boil until chicken is tender. Let cool then cut into thin strips.  Set aside.

name: SHRIMP SCAMPI
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. olive oil
1  Tbsp. chopped garlic
1  lb. medium shrimp, deshelled
1/2  tsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. white vinegar
1 1/2  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. white wine
1  lb. spaghetti
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Heat oil and vinegar in skillet.  Add garlic until heated. Add vinegar, wine, salt and pepper to taste.  Then add shrimp. Cook shrimp 5 to 7 minutes (don't overcook).  Boil water.  Cook spaghetti until done.  Drain.  Serve shrimp and sauce over pasta.

name: AFRICAN CHOW MEIN
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1 1/2  c. uncooked rice
2  c. celery, diced
1  can mushroom soup
1  can water
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
oregano
salt and pepper
preparation: Blend together in baking dish.  Cook 1 hour in 350° oven. Cover with foil.  Add more water, if necessary.

name: PARTY MIX
ingredients:
6  c. each Wheat Chex, Corn Chex, Rice Chex, pretzels and Cheerios
1  c. nuts
6  Tbsp. butter
4  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3/4  Tbsp. garlic powder
3/4  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Select a dozen young tender radishes. Wash and cut off leaves. Place on a cutting board, making several slices down, without cutting all the way through.  Soak in salted ice water for 1 hour before serving.  This causes the radishes to open and resemble miniature roses.

name: OLD FASHION GOULASH
ingredients:
40  beef cuts (stew meat cut in small pieces)
pinch of red pepper
1  large onion
1/2  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  bay leaf
1/2  pt. catsup
8  gingersnaps
preparation: Flour beef cuts and  brown  in	oil.  Salt  and pepper. Cover with water.  Add  pinch  of red pepper, onion, allspice, cloves and  bay  leaf.  Simmer for several hours until meat is tender. Add catsup and gingersnaps.  Cook for 1/2 hour longer and serve.

name: BLUEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. grape gelatin
2  c. boiling water
1 (15 oz.)  can blueberries, drained
1 (15 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. liquid from blueberries and pineapple
preparation: Mix gelatin, water and fruit.  Place in refrigerator until set.

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1  c. onion (scant)
2  c. celery
2 1/2  c. cooked chicken, diced
1/2  lb. noodles, cooked, or spaghetti
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. Velveeta cheese
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Saute onion and  celery  in  butter.  Mix  and bake until cheese melts (about 1 hour).

name: CHILI BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1 to 2  lb. pinto beans
1  pkg. French's chili  mix
1/2  c. chopped onions
garlic salt to taste
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
preparation: Cook pinto beans in pot on the stove or in a crock-pot (add onion and garlic salt to beans) until done.  Fry hamburger in a skillet (you may add more onion).  Drain hamburger; then add chili mix and mix well.  Add the can of tomato sauce.  It will be sticky. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes.  Then add hamburger mix to the beans and mix well.  You may add salt or garlic salt, if needed.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1  roll Ritz crackers
3/4  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. sour cream
1  can drained white corn
1  can French-style green beans
1/2  can diced water chestnuts
preparation: Mix melted oleo and crackers together; set aside until later. Mix the next four ingredients together and set aside until later. Mix the next three items together and layer on bottom of the casserole dish.  Top with soup mixture.  Cover with cracker mix. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.  (Can be made ahead and frozen.)

name: SWEET/SOUR DOGS(Easy Appetizer)
ingredients:
1  lb. hot dogs, cut in 1-inch pieces
1  c. apple jelly
1/2  c. prepared mustard
preparation: Melt jelly and mustard over low heat in pan on the stove, stirring occasionally.  Stir in hot dog pieces when lumps are gone in mixture.  Keep in a chafing dish so it will be warm.  Serve with toothpicks.  Sauce can be re-used; just store in refrigerator.

name: MELISSA'S TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  (1 1/4 oz.) taco seasoning mix
1  can refried beans
1 (16 oz.)  jar taco sauce, divided
2  heads lettuce, torn in bite-size pieces
1/2  c. sliced black olives
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  large tomato, diced
1  c. shredded New York sharp Cheddar
1  c. Southwestern style blue color chips
1  carton sour cream
preparation: Prepare beef according to seasoning mix directions.  Add beans and 3/4 cup taco sauce.  On large platter, arrange 1/2 the lettuce. Add beef and bean mixture.  Top with remaining lettuce, olives, onion, tomatoes, cheese and chips.  Serve with remaining taco sauce and sour cream.  Serves 6. Nice with Green Giant Mexican.

name: LUSCIOUS LUMPS(3 Dozen)
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. cornstarch
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  c. mini chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add cornstarch and beat until blended.  Add vanilla.   Add flour and combine until mixed.   Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.  Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake in a 350° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown around edges.

name: POTATO AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. baking potatoes, peeled and diced into 2-inch pieces
1  clove garlic, minced or pressed
1/2  c. thinly sliced green onion
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
4  oz. cream cheese, softened and cut into cubes
1/2  c. half and half
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
8  oz. cold Brie or Camembert cheese with rind removed, diced into 1/2-inch pieces
thyme or parsley (for garnish)
preparation: Cook potatoes in boiling, salted water for 15 minutes or until tender.  Drain well.  Meanwhile, saute garlic and green onion in butter for 2 minutes or until softened.  Mash potatoes.  Beat in garlic butter mixture, cream cheese, half and half, salt and pepper.  Fold in Brie or Camembert cheese.  Place in 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake at 450° for 15 minutes or until top begins to lightly brown.  Garnish with thyme or parsley.  Serve at once.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH PIE
ingredients:
2 scanty  c. brown sugar
4 1/2 heaping  Tbsp. flour
3  eggs, separated
2 1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Put brown sugar, flour and two cups milk on in a double boiler and  bring	to  scalding point.  Beat egg yolks and add other 1/2 cup milk;  stir  into  hot	mixture.  When done, add butter and vanilla.  Pour  into crust.  Top with meringue made from egg whites and brown.

name: MAKE AHEAD MEXICAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, chopped
3  medium tomatoes, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
2  avocados, chopped
1 (14 to 16 oz.)  can hot beans, drained and rinsed
1 (8 oz.)  bottle creamy Italian dressing
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
crushed corn chips
preparation: Make the salad the day	before.  Layer	in  a deep dish the lettuce, tomatoes,	onion,	avocados,  beans, dressing and cheese. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.

name: MADONNA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. apricot Jell-O
3/4  c. sugar
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1 (7 oz.)  jar apricot baby food
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Cook together apricot Jell-O, sugar and pineapple until it boils.  Let  cool.	Mix cream cheese and baby food together with mixer.  Stir  into	Jell-O	mixture.  Stir	in Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

name: BAKED MACARONI AND CHEESE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. macaroni
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. milk
1  c. cheese
preparation: Cook macaroni; drain.  Melt butter; add flour and seasonings. Stir until smooth and well blended.  Gradually add milk; cook until thick.  Add cheese; cook until melted.   Combine with macaroni.  Place in greased casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: TANGERINE BLOSSOM COMPOTE(6 Servings)
ingredients:
6  large Sunkist tangerines
1  c. slivered tangerine peel
1  c. boiling water
1/2  stick (1-inch) cinnamon, broken into pieces
1/2  tsp. whole cloves
1  bay leaf, crushed
1 1/4  c. granulated sugar
3/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. freshly squeezed tangerine juice
flaked coconut (optional)
preparation: Wash fruit; score peel into quarters.  Remove sections of peel with fingers, leaving fruit whole.  Sliver peel as directed to yield 1 cup; reserve.  Rinse peeled fruit in cold water and gently scrape off excess white membrane with a small knife.  Carefully remove center white core and slightly separate sections at one end to resemble "petals"; set aside in deep medium bowl.  Pour boiling water over spices and bay leaf; steep 5 minutes and strain liquid into saucepan.  Add slivered peel, sugars and tangerine juice; bring to a boil, stirring, until sugar is dissolved.  Boil briskly for 10 minutes until syrupy; immediately pour syrup over tangerines and baste for several minutes.  Refrigerate several hours, preferably overnight, until thoroughly chilled, basting several times.  Serve on individual dessert plates with some of the syrup and peel; sprinkle tops with coconut.

name: VENISON MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. chopped venison
3  small, finely chopped tomatoes
2  medium chopped onions
2  large celery sticks, grated
1  c. cooked carrots, mashed
1  firm raw grated zucchini
1  c. seasoned bread crumbs
1  egg, lightly beaten
1  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Lightly grease a loaf pan.  Bake for approximately 50 minutes, until done.  After 45 minutes, watch venison meat loaf so it doesn't burn the top of meat loaf.  Spoon part of the fat off; save.  Pour over slices of venison meat loaf. Any leftovers go great with scrambled eggs.  Serves 4 to 6 people.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, browned
2  tsp. chili powder
1  can refried beans (with sausage)
2  c. shredded cheese (Cheddar)
1  jar salsa sauce
preparation: Layer refried beans, ground beef, sauce and cheese.  Microwave on High for 8 minutes.  Serve on Tostitos chips with tomatoes and lettuce.

name: BREAST OF CHICKEN SHIRLEY
ingredients:
8  to 10 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
salt and freshly ground pepper
paprika
1/4 to 1/3  c. butter
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  tsp. curry powder
2  c. sour cream
1  c. sliced mushrooms, sauteed
3 1/2  oz. (1 c.) slivered almonds
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Season chicken generously with salt, pepper and paprika.  Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.  Add chicken and brown quickly on both sides. Transfer to shallow baking dish large enough to accommodate pieces in 1 layer.

name: CRANBERRY CHICKEN
ingredients:
3 or 4  lb. chicken pieces
1 (1 lb.)  can whole cranberry sauce
1  envelope onion soup mix
1 (8 oz.)  bottle French dressing
preparation: Place chicken pieces in a 3-quart casserole.  Mix cranberry sauce, soup mix and French dressing.  Pour over chicken and marinate 1 to 2 hours (or longer).  Turn chicken pieces occasionally.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours, uncovered, turning chicken once to brown on all sides.  Serve on rice.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: ASPARAGUS STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh asparagus
4  green onions, sliced
2  c. mushrooms, sliced
1  Tbsp. each:  soy sauce and vegetable oil
rice, cooked
1  tsp. cornstarch
preparation: Snap off base of asparagus and snap into 2-inch lengths.  In a small bowl, blend small amount of water and cornstarch.  Stir in soy sauce and set aside.  Stir-fry asparagus and green onions in oil for about 4 minutes, stirring constantly.  Add mushrooms and cook another minute.  Add your liquid and simmer.  Serve over cooked rice.  Makes about 4 servings.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. elbow macaroni
1/4  c. onion, finely chopped
1/4  c. bell pepper, finely chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  jar pimento with juice
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Cook macaroni as directed on package.  Saute onion and pepper in a minimal amount of butter.  Heat soup; add onion, pepper and pimento.  Continue to heat this mixture thoroughly, then add mayonnaise.  If this mixture does not seem "pourable" add a small amount of milk to make so.

name: CALDERETTA
ingredients:
2  lb. beef, cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks
4  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
2  garlic cloves, crushed
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  medium potatoes, peeled and quartered
1  tsp. m.s.g.
1/2  c. stuffed olives
1  medium green pepper, seeds removed, cut into 1-inch squares
3  Tbsp. sherry or vinegar
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  medium onion, sliced
1/2  lb. pepperoni, sliced 1/4-inch thick diagonally
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Season meat with soy sauce, sherry or vinegar and salt.  Set aside.  In hot oil, brown garlic, add onions and cook until transparent.  Add tomato sauce and beef.  Stir 2 minutes, reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.  Add about 2 cups water; simmer, covered, for 45 minutes or until meat is tender. Add pepperoni, potatoes, m.s.g. and pepper.  Simmer 7 minutes or until potatoes are soft.  Taste.  Add olives and green pepper. Cook for 3 minutes or more.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: FRESH ASPARAGUS WITH LEMON SAUCE
ingredients:
1  bunch (2-3 lbs) fresh asparagus
1/4  c fresh orange juice
1/2  t grated orange rind
1/4  lb butter
4  t fresh lemon juice
1/2  t grated lemon rind
preparation: Break off asparagus stalks as far down as they snap easily. Cook covered in small amount boiling water till crisp and tender, 3-4 minutes, and drain.  Transfer asparagus to a warmed serving platter.  Melt butter and stir in remaining ingredients.  Heat to simmer, stirring occasionally.  Pour heated sauce over asparagus. Garnish with lemon slices.

name: MACARONI SALAD SUPREME
ingredients:
1  pkg. macaroni and cheese
1  c. salad dressing
1  c. grated carrots
1  c. chopped onion (red for color)
1/2  lb. crisp bacon, crumbled
3  chopped hard-boiled eggs
3  c. fresh broccoli, chopped
1 1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Cook macaroni and cheese as directed on package.  Mix all ingredients.  Cover and store in refrigerator at least 4 hours.

name: KIDNEY BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can kidney beans
1  hard-boiled egg
1  medium onion
2 to 3  Tbsp. pickle relish
1  rib celery (optional)
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
lettuce leaves
preparation: Drain beans and relish.  Dice onion and celery.  One hour before serving time, toss all ingredients together with mayonnaise.  Serve on bed of lettuce.

name: EASY MICROWAVE LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 (32 oz.)  jar Ragu Homestyle
3/4  c. water
1  lb. ground beef, cooked and drained
lasagna noodles (uncooked)
1  c. cottage cheese
1  egg
pepper (optional)
2 to 3  c. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Mix sauce, water and ground beef.  In a separate bowl, mix cottage cheese, egg and pepper (if you wish).  Make sure your pan fits into your microwave.  Layer sauce, noodles, cottage cheese mixture and Mozzarella cheese.  Repeat layers and then end with sauce on top.  Microwave on High for 8 minutes and then 50% power for 30 to 32 minutes.  Let stand for 10 minutes and serve.

name: LILLIE'S BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans
1 (16 oz.)  can pintos
1 (16 oz.)  can Great Northern beans
1 (16 oz.)  can white limas
1 (16 oz.)  can navy beans
1/2  c. barbecue sauce
1/2  c. mustard
1/2  c. ketchup
1/2  c. molasses
1  c. brown sugar
1  big onion, chopped fine
1  sweet red pepper and 1 sweet green pepper or 2 green peppers
4 or 5  slices bacon
preparation: Mix together first 12 ingredients and pour into 5-quart Dutch oven.  Place bacon on top.  Bake at 450° until bacon is done.  Will serve 25.

name: CHEESE QUICHE (GRAPE-NUT)
ingredients:
2  bacon slices
1  c. thinly sliced onion
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1 3/4  c. milk
3/4  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1  tsp. salt
1  dash pepper
1/3  c. Post Grape-Nuts cereal
1  lightly baked 9-inch pie shell
preparation: Fry bacon until crisp.  Drain and crumble.  Reserve 1 tablespoon drippings.  Saute onion in reserved bacon drippings until tender and lightly browned.  Combine eggs, milk, cheese, salt, pepper and cereal.  Stir in onion and bacon.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.   Reduce temperature to 350° and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer.   Serves 4.

name: COCKTAIL SAUCE
ingredients:
Chutney
Mayonnaise
preparation: Combine 2 parts Chutney with 1 part mayonnaise.

name: CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo
3  c. sugar
3  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. shortening
5  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream oleo and shortening with sugar.  Add eggs one at a time and blend well after each.  Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk.  Add vanilla.  Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
4  whole chicken breasts
1  (16%) Chinese noodles
1  small onion
1  lemon (juice)
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. celery
1  pkg. slivered almonds
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Boil chicken breasts until done.  Chop chicken meat into small pieces.  Simmer celery until tender then drain (save).  Mix all ingredients together, save half of noodles for top of casserole. If too dry add some liquid from celery or chicken broth.  Cook at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BARBECUED CHICKEN
ingredients:
whole chicken or parts
1  c. water
1/2  c. catsup
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Arrange chicken in single layer.  Combine all other ingredients and pour over chicken.  Bake, uncovered, about 1 hour at 400°.  Good over rice.

name: CHOCOLATE SPOON CAKE
ingredients:
2  pkg. chocolate instant pudding
1  chocolate cake, baked in 9 x 13-inch pan
1/2  c. Kahlua, Amaretto or other liqueur
1  large container Cool Whip
4  Skor bars, crumbled into small pieces*
preparation: *Freeze and roll with rolling pin or "whack" with back of ice cream scoop.

name: WATERMELON COOLER
ingredients:
2  peeled kiwi, cut up
2  c. seeded watermelon pieces
1  ripe banana, peeled and frozen
4  ice cubes
3/4  c. chilled apple juice
preparation: Blend all ingredients in blender until smooth.  Makes 4 cups.

name: FROZEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  pt. whipping cream or Pet milk
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. salad dressing
1  (3 oz.) cream cheese
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  lb. tiny marshmallows
1/2  c. cherries, chopped
preparation: Soak marshmallows and pineapple overnight.  Mix salad dressing and soft cream cheese.  Next mix everything together.  Freeze. Serve as desired.

name: WAURINE'S FROZEN PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
1/4  c. granulated sugar
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
2  c. pineapple flavored yogurt
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, well drained
2  Tbsp. pecan pieces
2  Tbsp. chopped red and green cherries
preparation: In a small mixing bowl, beat together cream cheese and sugars. Stir in yogurt and drained pineapple.  Spoon into 10 paper muffin cups and place in muffin pan.  Combine pecans and cherries and place atop each cup.  Cover.  Freeze firm.  Let stand for about 10 minutes before serving.

name: OATMEAL "CANDY" COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/3  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. canned milk
1  c. oatmeal
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, milk and cocoa.  Bring to a boil for 1 minute; remove from heat.  Add rest of ingredients, ending with oatmeal. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIR CAKE
ingredients:
2  boxes instant vanilla pudding
3  c. sweet milk
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  box graham crackers
1  can milk chocolate icing
preparation: Prepare pudding mix with milk.  Stir until thick.  Fold Cool Whip with pudding.  Pour 1/2 mixture over crackers.  Put another layer of crackers.  Cover with remaining mixture.  Put another layer of crackers and cover with the chocolate icing.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium onion
1  medium green pepper
3  Tbsp. butter
6  Tbsp. flour
2 (7 oz.)  cans tuna, drained
3  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Chop onion and green pepper coarsely.  Cook in butter until limp.  Stir in flour as smoothly as possible.  Add milk. Gradually season with salt and pepper.  Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture bubbles.  Stir in tuna.  Pour into a shallow baking dish.

name: SENIOR BREAKFAST HOT DISH(Impossible Ham and Cheese Pie)
ingredients:
2  c. chopped ham
1 1/2 to 2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/3  c. chopped green onion
3  c. milk
6  eggs
1 1/2  c. Bisquick baking mix
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Grease 9 x 12-inch baking pan or dish. Spread ham, cheese and onions in bottom of pan.  Beat remaining ingredients until smooth (15 seconds with blender or 1 minute with hand beater).  Pour into pan.

name: LEMON LIFT PUNCH
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. lemon Kool-Aid (unsweetened)
2  c. sugar
2  qt. water
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1  qt. Sprite
preparation: Freeze all but Sprite; set out to thaw approximately 3 hours before serving.  Thaw to slush stage.  Add Sprite.  Yield:  40 servings.

name: BLUEBERRY MELBA(Serves 8 To 10)
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
3/4  c. Port wine
1/4 to 1/3  c. fruit juice from berries
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  c. fresh blueberries (frozen or canned okay)
6  fresh or canned peach halves
6  scoops vanilla ice cream
preparation: In small saucepan, combine sugar and cornstarch.  Stir in Port and lemon juice.  Cook and stir over low heat until thickened and translucent.  Stir in blueberries; simmer about 5 minutes.  Cool to room temperature.  To serve, arrange peach halves cut side up in 6 sherbet glasses.  Top each with 1 scoop ice cream.  Spoon cooled blueberry sauce evenly over each.  Colors are very pretty and cool looking for a summer dessert.

name: NOODLE MIX(Healthy Mixes U-Make)
ingredients:
1  c. instant nonfat dry milk
2  Tbsp. Romano cheese, grated
1/4  c. dried minced onion
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. white pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients and store in a sealable container or zip-lock plastic bag. This will keep for 2 months in the pantry; however, I personally store in the refrigerator because of the cheese; plus it will last longer. Mark the date on the container or bag with a sharpie pen. This recipe doubles and triples well.

name: (GEORGIA) PEACH SEAFOAM SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can peaches, drained and mashed (save 1 c. juice)
1 large  box peach gelatin
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 large  carton whipped topping
preparation: Heat peach juice to boiling; add gelatin and stir to dissolve. Place gelatin and softened cream cheese in blender container. Blend until smooth; add mashed peaches.   Refrigerate until cool and thick.  Fold in whipped topping.  Refrigerate in 8 x 12-inch dish until set.  Serves 6.

name: MAPLE SYRUP FOR PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  box brown sugar
1  c. water
1/2  tsp. Mapleine flavoring
preparation: Bring to a boil.  Pour into a jar.  Ready to eat over pancakes or waffles.

name: PORK CHOP AND POTATO SCALLOP
ingredients:
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
1/2  c. commercial sour cream
1/4  c. water
3  Tbsp. chopped parsley
4  c. thinly sliced potatoes
2  medium onions, thinly sliced
3/4  c. coarsely ground green pepper
6  (3/4-inch thick) pork chops
1/4  c. flour
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Combine soup, sour cream, water and parsley.  In a 2-quart shallow casserole dish, alternate layers of sliced potatoes, onions, green pepper and cheese soup mixture.  Sprinkle each layer of potatoes lightly with salt and pepper.  Place uncovered in a preheated oven (about 375°).  Bake 30 minutes.  Trim excess fat from pork chops.  Roll in flour to coat thoroughly.  Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat (about 375°).  Brown pork chops in oil evenly on both sides.  Sprinkle pork chops with salt and pepper.  Place on top of potatoes.  Cover and return to oven for one hour and 20 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. spicy sausage
6  eggs
2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
3  slices bread, cubed (no crusts)
1  c. sharp grated cheese
preparation: Brown sausage and drain.   Layer sausage in casserole and top with bread.   Beat eggs, milk, salt and mustard.   Pour over sausage and bread.   Top with cheese.   Put in refrigerator overnight.   Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: GEORGIA'S SOUTHWEST SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can artichoke hearts, chopped
1/2  c. chopped green chilies
1 1/2  c. shredded Parmesan cheese
1/2  medium red bell pepper, chopped
2  Tbsp. (at least!) garlic, minced
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. red pepper flakes
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Put in a shallow baking dish. Cook 25 to 30 minutes at 350°, until golden brown on top.  Serve with a loaf of sliced baguette bread (toasted or plain).

name: MARIA'S SALSA
ingredients:
1  bunch cilantro
1/2  small onion
2  jalapeno peppers
2  large tomatoes or tomato sauce
1 small  clove garlic
garlic salt
preparation: Wash and pick cilantro leaves.  Dice cilantro, onion, peppers, tomatoes and garlic into small bowl and add tomato sauce and garlic salt to taste.  (If using fresh tomatoes, omit tomato sauce.)

name: SAVORY SOUTHERN CHICKEN PIES
ingredients:
8  oz. pork sausage (bulk type)
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
1 3/4  c. chicken broth
2/3  c. milk
1  recipe Savory Pastry
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  c. chicken, cooked and cubed
10  oz. frozen peas, thawed
preparation: In saucepan, brown sausage; drain on paper towels.  Pour off fat and in same pan, melt butter.  Blend in flour, salt and pepper.  Stir in chicken broth and milk.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly; cook 1 minute more.  Add chicken, sausage and peas; heat through.  Pour into large casserole.

name: MEXICAN LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1 large  can pureed tomatoes
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  can French fried onions
1  pt. cottage cheese
2  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
12  (6-inch) flour tortillas
1  tomato, chopped
sliced green onions
preparation: Brown hamburger; drain fat.  Add pureed tomatoes and seasoning. Simmer 5 minutes.  In bowl, combine cottage cheese, eggs and 1 cup Cheddar cheese.  In greased 9 x 13-inch pan, layer tortillas (I tear into pieces).  Spoon meat mixture evenly next.  Sprinkle with 1 can of onions.  Top with another layer of tortillas.  Spoon cheese mixture over tortillas.  Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 35 minutes.  Sprinkle remaining shredded cheese and bake 15 minutes longer.  Garnish with chopped tomatoes and green onions.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: CROCK-POT APPLESAUCE
ingredients:
11  apples
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Wash and cut apples in chunks.  Put in crock-pot.  Cook on low all day.  Add more sugar if needed.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
2  ripe medium bananas, mashed
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. milk or buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In a large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, soda and salt. In another bowl combine eggs, bananas, oil, milk and vanilla.  Add to the flour mixture until combines.  Fold in nuts.  Pour into greased bread pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: CARAMEL POPCORN
ingredients:
2  c. light brown sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  lb. margarine
6  qt. popped popcorn
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: In saucepan, combine brown sugar, syrup, margarine, cream of tartar and salt.  Bring to a boil, stirring over medium heat. Stirring constantly, boil rapidly about 5 minutes, until mixture reaches 260° on candy thermometer.  Remove from heat.  Stir in baking soda quickly but thoroughly.  Pour at once over popcorn. Stir gently until kernels are coated.  Bake at 200° for 1 hour, stirring 2 or 3 times.  Turn out on wax paper and cool completely. Break into small clusters and store in airtight container.

name: CRUMB CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
2  c. flour
2  sticks margarine
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. cinnamon
confectioners sugar
preparation: Bake cake mix as directed on box in 9 x 13-inch greased pan at 350° for only 20 minutes.  Top with crumb mixture and continue baking 10 to 15 minutes longer or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool and top with confectioners sugar.

name: OATMEAL LOAF
ingredients:
2  c. quick oatmeal
2  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  c. Recip-ease or 2 c. Jiffy mix
1/2  stick soft oleo
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk (which has been added 1 Tbsp. vinegar)
preparation: Measure oatmeal into bowl along with the melted butter, eggs and milk.  Add flavorings.  Stir well.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Add sugar and all ingredients.  Stir well.  Oil a loaf pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Reduce heat to 325° to complete 1 hour in all or until bread tests done and light brown.  Cool completely before slicing.

name: CHICKEN AND DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chicken broth
1  c. cream of chicken soup
4  c. cornbread crumbs
salt and pepper to taste
1  whole chicken, boned and in serving size pieces
preparation: Saute onion and celery in margarine; set aside.  Heat soups (undiluted) and pour over cornbread crumbs.  Add onion and celery; mix well.  Season to taste (be careful with salt as soups are already salted).  Pour 1/2 of dressing into a greased 3-quart casserole dish.  Add chicken; top with remaining dressing.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SLUSH PUNCH
ingredients:
3  pkg. raspberry jello
9  c. water, boil and let cool
4  c. sugar
4  c. water, boil and let cool
2 (46 oz.)  cans pineapple juice
1 (16 oz.)  can lemonade concentrate
preparation: Freeze in gallon bags. Add 3 bottles (1 liter) ginger ale to frozen gallons at least one hour before serving.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. spaghetti, cooked and cooled
2  green peppers, chopped
2  tomatoes
1  large onion
celery
ripe olives, sliced
green olives, sliced
1/2  jar Salad Supreme seasoning
8  oz. jar Viva Italian dressing
preparation: Mix together.  Marinate overnight.

name: TACO SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
4  c. tomato juice
1 (15 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (15 oz.)  can kidney beans
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
preparation: In large pot, brown beef with onions and drain off excess grease. Add the tomato juice, corn, beans, tomato sauce and seasoning mix. Stir together well and heat throughout, but do not boil! Serve with tortilla chips, shredded Cheddar cheese and sour cream on top.  Yield: 8 servings.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. Bisquick
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
2  eggs
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
2 1/2  tsp. vanilla pie spice
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease pie plate, 9 x 1 1/4-inch or 10 x 1 1/2-inch.  Beat all ingredients until smooth, 1 minute in blender on high or 2 minutes with hand mixer.  Pour into place. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean, 50 to 55 minutes.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. sliced jalapeno pepper or green pepper
1  can whole kernel corn
1  box corn bread mix
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix corn bread mix.  Drain corn and add to mixture.  Set aside. Brown ground beef and add salt and pepper to taste.  Pour 1/2 of corn bread mixture in casserole dish on top of mixture; add hamburger meat, cheese and peppers.  Pour remaining corn bread mixture on top.  Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: GOLDEN GARDEN DIP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. Velveeta
1/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. finely chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
2  Tbsp. finely chopped pimento (optional)
preparation: Heat Velveeta and milk over low heat until smooth.  Add remaining ingredients; mix well.  Chill.  Serve with assorted veggie dippers.

name: TRADITIONAL CHRISTMAS EGGNOG
ingredients:
6  eggs, separated
1/2  c. sugar
2  c. light or whipping cream
2  c. milk
1/8  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. vanilla
grated nutmeg
preparation: Beat egg yolks and sugar until thick and light.  Beat in cream, milk, salt and vanilla.  Beat egg whites until they hold stiff peaks; fold into egg yolk mixture.  Serve in chilled punch bowl; sprinkle with nutmeg. Makes 2 1/2 quarts.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  strips bacon
2  eggs
2  cans corn (whole kernel or your choice), drained, except for 1/4 c.
Ritz crackers (one sleeve from box)
1  stick butter or margarine
preparation: Fry bacon crisp; chop in small bits.  Drain oil from pan.  Add eggs and corn and mix.  Roll crackers in foil with rolling pin until crushed.  Press on top of other ingredients.  Melt margarine and sprinkle over crackers.  Bake at 425° for approximately 30 minutes.

name: ZESTY CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
salt and pepper
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. celery salt
1 (4 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 large  can Pet milk
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
2  c. chopped cooked chicken
1/2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
2  c. cooked rice
preparation: Drain mushrooms (save juice).  Saut onions in butter. Add salt, pepper, celery, salt and mushroom liquid. Blend in soup; add milk slowly until thickened.

name: EGG DISH
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. bulk sausage
9  eggs, slightly beaten
3  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
3  slices white bread, cut into 1/4-inch cubes
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown sausage and drain.  Mix eggs, milk, mustard and salt. Stir in bread and moisten, then stir in sausage and cheese.  Put in 13 x 9-inch pan.  Refrigerate, covered, overnight.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for one hour.

name: BROCCOLI CREAMED CORN BAKE
ingredients:
2  boxes frozen broccoli
2  cans creamed corn
2  eggs
4  Tbsp. margarine
1  small diced onion
preparation: Thaw broccoli and drain well.  Beat eggs, melt butter and add corn, onion and broccoli.  For topping, use crouton crumbs or bacon.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: RANCH ARTICHOKE SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can artichoke hearts, rinsed and drained
3/4  c. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
1/4  c. sour cream
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
crackers or sliced French bread
preparation: Coarsely chop artichoke hearts and combine with dressing, sour cream and Parmesan cheese. Chill 30 minutes. Spread on crackers or sliced bread to serve.

name: APPLE PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. raisins
1  c. chopped nuts
2  c. chopped apples
1/2  c. soft shortening
1  egg, well beaten
preparation: Sift dry ingredients in a mixing bowl.  Add other ingredients and mix well.  Pour in a baking pan and bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten until frothy
2  c. granulated sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2  c. coarsely grated zucchini (do not peel)
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Add sugar, vegetable oil and vanilla to beaten eggs.  Beat mixture until thick and lemon colored.  Stir in zucchini.  Add rest of ingredients to nuts.  Pour into 2 greased bread pans and bake at 350°  for 1 hour.

name: CHEESY GARLIC BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. shredded mild Cheddar cheese or any flavor cheese you and your family like
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
2  Tbsp. Crisco shortening
1/2 to 1  c. fat-free milk
preparation: In a large bowl, combine flour, baking powder, cheese and garlic; mix well, coating all the cheese.  Add Crisco shortening in small lumps, blending with fork until crumbly.  Add milk, a spoonful at a time, while mixing with fork.  You may not need all the milk.  Press dough out on floured surface.  Make biscuits as thick or thin as you like, also as big or little as you like, depending on your biscuit cutter.  Bake in preheated 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

name: ANGEL YEAST BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
2  Tbsp. warm water (110~)
5  c. self-rising flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. shortening
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Dissolve  yeast in warm water;	set aside.  Stir flour, sugar and  baking soda together.	Cut in shortening until the size  of peas.  Mix buttermilk with yeast water; add to flour mixture. Stir  with	a  fork until moistened.  May be covered and refrigerated overnight to be shaped and baked later.  Turn out onto  floured  surface.  Knead  until smooth and elastic. Roll out dough to 1/2-inch thickness.  Cut biscuits out with a 2-inch cutter.  Place close together on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake  in  preheated  400°  oven  for 15 to 20 minutes. Brush  with melted  butter or margarine.  Makes 24 to 30 biscuits.

name: ZUCCHINI PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  lb. zucchini
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
2 small  cloves garlic, minced
3  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. chopped chives
1  tsp. oregano or sweet basil
oil or vegetable shortening for frying
preparation: Wash zucchini.  Do not peel.  Grate with coarse grater.  Place grated zucchini in sieve and press out moisture.  Combine eggs, flour, cheese, salt, chives, garlic and oregano.  Mix with drained shredded zucchini.  Heat shortening in skillet.  Shortening should be about 1/4-inch deep.  Pour large tablespoonful of batter onto griddle for each pancake.  Fry first side until light brown, 1 or 2 minutes.  Turn and fry on other side.  Serve with sour cream or tomato sauce and grated Parmesan.  Yields about 10 to 12 pancakes.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
4  pieces chicken breasts
1 1/4  c. chicken broth
1  can cream of onion soup
2  eggs, boiled
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  can Veg-All
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. milk
1/2  stick margarine, melted
1/4  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Mix flour, milk, margarine and black pepper.  Spoon over chicken mixture (this makes the crust).  Cook 30 minutes at 425°.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. diced cooked chicken
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  c. celery, diced
1  c. slivered toasted almonds
1  c. mayonnaise
3  hard-cooked eggs, diced
crushed potato chips
preparation: Mix all ingredients except crushed potato chips.  Pour into casserole.  Top with crushed potato chips.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: HONEY GLAZED CARROTS
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. sliced carrots (2 lb.)
1  Tbsp. reduced calorie margarine
1 1/2  Tbsp. honey
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Arrange carrots in a vegetable steamer over boiling water. Cover and steam for 4 to 8 minutes or until desired tenderness. Remove from steamer, keep warm.

name: CINNAMON BREAKFAST BITES
ingredients:
1-1/3  cups flour
1  cup crisp rice cereal, coarsely crushed
2  Tbsp sugar
3  tsp baking powder
1/2  tsp salt
1/4  cup butter-flavored shortening
1/2  cup milk
1  tsp cinnamon
1/2  cup sugar
1/4  cup butter or margarine, melted
preparation: In bowl, combine and cut in flour, cereal, sugar, baking powder, salt and shortening.  Stir in milk.  Shape into 1-inch balls.

name: ORANGE JELLO
ingredients:
6  oz. orange Jell-O
8  oz. Cool Whip
1 large (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Heat pineapple juice in saucepan.  Then dissolve Jell-O in heated pineapple juice.  Dissolve Cool Whip in pineapple juice and Jell-O.  Mix in buttermilk.  Mix in pineapple.  Refrigerate several hours.  Enjoy!  Yummy!  Good!  Kids love it.  Very easy recipe.

name: PINK CLOUD
ingredients:
1  c. Eagle Brand milk, beat 3 to 4 minutes
1  c. drained crushed pineapple
1  can cherry pie filling
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
3/4  c. pecans
preparation: Mix ingredients and refrigerate overnight before serving.

name: CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bacon, diced
1  onion
1  lb. hamburger
1/2  c. ketchup
1  tsp. salt
1  can butter beans, drained
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1 (No. 2)  can pork and beans
preparation: Brown bacon, onion and hamburger.  Pour off excess fat and add remaining ingredients.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: EASY PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1 big  can sliced peaches
1  c. milk
1  c. flour (must be self-rising)
1  c. sugar
1  stick butter
cinnamon
preparation: Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Mix flour and sugar. Then add milk.  Mix until all lumps are gone.  Pour in pan with butter.  Add peaches.  Spread around.  Add cinnamon (sprinkled) on top.  Bake at 350° for an hour or until crust has risen and is brown.

name: BROWN SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
1  c. Karo (light or dark)
1  c. shortening
3  eggs
1  tsp. soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. sour milk
5 to 6  c. flour (enough for soft dough for drop cookies)
preparation: Cream brown sugar, Karo, shortening and eggs and blend well. Add soda, baking powder, salt, vanilla, nutmeg and cinnamon.  Add milk and flour until well blended.

name: BROILED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  lb. large mushrooms
4  c. cold water
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. butter, melted
salt and pepper
preparation: Wash mushrooms.  Trim stems to 1/2-inch length.  Soak in cold water and lemon juice 5 minutes.  Drain and dry well.  Brush with butter.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Broil 6 inches from heat, until lightly browned, about 10 minutes.  Serve with remaining melted butter.

name: MEXICAN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. corn meal (self-rising)
1/2  c. cooking oil
2  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1  can cream-style corn
2  tsp. onions
2  tsp. chopped bell pepper
1  hot pepper, chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

name: WALDORF GRAPE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. California seedless grapes
1  c. diced apple
1  c. sliced celery
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  c. diced Swiss cheese
1/2  c. heavy cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. sugar
lettuce cups
preparation: Toss first 5 ingredients.  Whip cream.  Add remaining ingredients except lettuce and blend well.  Fold dressing into salad; serve cold on lettuce cups.

name: TUPPERWARE BREAD
ingredients:
3 3/4  c. warm water
3  pkg. dry yeast
5  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. oil
6  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
10  c. flour
preparation: Mix together and use part of flour to knead but use all 10 cups.  Put in Tupperware bowl (the large one!), burp and let rise until it pops off.  Make into loaves, let rise and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: GRITS WITH SHRIMP & ROASTED RED BELL PEPPERS
ingredients:
2  large red peppers
2  Tbsp. butter
3 garlic  cloves chopped
2  green onions chopped
1 1/2  tsp. fresh thyme chopped
1  c. quick cooking grits
3 1/2  c. low salt chicken broth
3  Tbsp. whipping cream
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. hot pepper sauce
1/4  tsp. black pepper
30  large shrimp uncooked, peeled, deveined
1  c. feta cheese crumbled
Fresh thyme sprigs
preparation: Butter 11 by 7 inch glass baking dish.	Char peppers over gas flame or in broiler until blackened on all sides.  Enclose in paper bag; let stand 10 minutes.  Peel, seed and coarsely chop peppers.  Melt butter in heavy large saucepan over medium heat. Add garlic, green onions, and chopped thyme.  Sauté until onions wilt.  About 2 minutes.  Add grits and stir one minute.  Whisk in broth and cream.  Simmer until liquid is absorbed and grits are thick and tender, stirring occasionally, about 8 minutes.  Whisk in salt, hot pepper sauce and black pepper.  Fold in roasted bell peppers.  Spread grits in prepared dish.  (Can be made 2 hours ahead, let stand at room temperature.  Can be made the night before, placed in refrigerator.)  Preheat oven to 400°.  Press shrimp, on their sides, onto top of grits in single layer. Sprinkle with cheese,  Bake until grits are heated through. Shrimp are just opaque in center and cheese begins to brown, about 20 minutes.  Garnish with thyme sprigs.

name: TROPICAL FRUIT BREAD
ingredients:
2  large ripe bananas
8  oz. can pineapple chunks
1 1/2  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1/4  lb. butter
1/2  c. and 1 Tbsp. flaked coconut
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Butter an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan. Mash bananas.  Drain pineapple.  On low speed, beat flour, sugar, baking powder, soda, salt, eggs, bananas and butter (softened) until blended.  Increase speed to medium and beat for 2 minutes. Stir in pineapple and 1/2 cup of coconut.  Pour into pan and sprinkle with remaining coconut.  Bake about 1 hour.  Cool ten minutes.  Take out of pan and cool completely.

name: CORNMEAL MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. cornmeal
1/4  c. sugar
4  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1/4  c. margarine
preparation: Mix above ingredients together. Bake in muffin pan at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: EGG HORS D'OEUVRES
ingredients:
1  lb. Monterey Jack cheese
1  lb. small curd cottage cheese
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. parsley
1  lb. sausage, bacon or ham cubes (I use sausage)
12  eggs
preparation: Beat eggs and add other ingredients.  Melt 1 stick of margarine; put half in a 13 x 9-inch pan and half in the egg mixture.  Stir together well.  Pour egg mixture into pan and bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1/4  c. water
1 1/2  c. raw peanuts
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Cook sugar, syrup and water until it spins a thread when poured from a spoon.  Add peanuts, stirring continuously on medium heat until mixture turns light brown (peanuts will look cooked).  Remove from heat, add soda and stir well.  Pour on buttered cookie sheet. Cool.  Break into small pieces.

name: NOODLE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  lb. wide noodles
1  c. sugar
1/2  pt. sour cream
1 1/2  Tbsp. farina
6  to 8 eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. butter, melted
1  lb. small-curd cottage cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
1  jar Musselman's cherry pie filling
cinnamon and sugar
preparation: Cook noodles according to package directions, almost tender (6 to 7 minutes).  Drain.  Combine all remaining ingredients except cherries and cinnamon-sugar.  Blend well.  Stir into hot noodles. Pour half the noodle mixture into large 4-quart baking or roasting pan.  Spread cherries over surface.  Add remaining noodle mixture. Sprinkle lightly with cinnamon-sugar.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Serve hot or cold with sour cream if desired. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

name: HAWAIIAN BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. vegetable oil
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
3  eggs, beaten
2  c. mashed ripe bananas
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine dry ingredients.   Stir in nuts; set aside.  Combine remaining ingredients.   Add to dry mixture, stirring just until batter is moistened.   Spoon into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.   Bake at 350° for 1 hour.   Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan.

name: KENNY'S SURPRISE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
1  c. light brown sugar
1  egg
1  c. oil
1  c. crushed corn flakes
3 1/2  c. plain flour
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream the margarine and sugars.  Add egg; mix well.  Add remaining ingredients one at a time; mix.  Stir in pecans.  Chill well.  Roll into walnut size balls.  Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.

name: PEACH COOLER
ingredients:
1  c milk
1  c peaches
salt
2 - 3  drops almond extract
1  c vanilla ice cream
preparation: Put all ingredients except ice cream, into blender.  Cover and process at liquify (Ice crush)  until smooth.  Add ice cream, cover and blend for 1 cycle.  Makes 2 servings.

name: PICKLED BEETS
ingredients:
2 or 3  cans small beets or more
2  c. vinegar
1  c. water
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Boil vinegar, etc., together and pour over warmed beets.  Put in prepared jars and seal airtight.

name: SAUSAGE STRATA
ingredients:
2  lb. bulk pork sausage
1/4  c. each: finely chopped red and green pepper
6  large eggs
4  c. milk
1  tsp. Worcestershire
1/8  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. yellow mustard
12  slices white bread, crusts removed
1  lb. shredded Swiss cheese
1/8  tsp. ground black pepper
1/8  tsp. ground nutmeg
preparation: Day before serving, grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Saute sausage and green and red peppers until well browned.  Drain off all fat. Add mustard to mixture.  Arrange bread in bottom of pan.  Top with sausage mixture and cheese.  In large bowl, lightly beat eggs. Beat in milk, Worcestershire sauce, pepper, nutmeg and salt.  Pour over layers in pan.  Cover tightly.  Refrigerate overnight.  Next day, heat oven to 350°.  Bake, uncovered, 40 to 50 minutes.  Serve immediately.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1/2  box elbow macaroni
4  eggs, beaten
3  c. sweet milk
1/2  lb. butter or margarine
1/2  lb. aged cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook and drain macaroni according to directions on package. Mix milk and butter to beaten eggs and add salt.  Place alternating layers of sliced cheese and macaroni in buttered baking dish.  Pour milk and egg mixture over these.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until milk and egg mixture is set.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE PIE
ingredients:
1  can mandarin oranges
1 medium  can pineapple
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  (16 oz.) Cool Whip
1/2  c. lemon juice
2  or 3 graham cracker pie crusts
preparation: Combine oranges, pineapple and milk in a bowl; blend with mixer.  Add Cool Whip; blend.  Add lemon juice; blend.  Pour into pie crust.  Keep cool.

name: SPICY LEMON CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  roasted chicken drumsticks
2  roasted chicken breast halves
2  c. sliced yellow onion
1  tsp. salt
1  jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
1/3  c. fresh lemon juice
1/2  tsp. black pepper
2  c. thinly sliced carrots
1/2  c. pimento stuffed olives
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Place a large saucepot over high heat and add oil.  Add onion and jalapeno pepper and  sauté until well browned.  Add salt, pepper and carrots, cook for 3 to 4 minutes.  Add chicken broth, Dijon mustard and lemon juice and simmer for 5 more minutes  Add chicken into the sauce, let simmer on medium-low heat for 20 to 25 minutes.  Add olives when ready to serve.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. onion flakes
1/2  bag (10 oz.) taco chips
taco dressing
liquid hot pepper sauce (optional)
4  tomatoes, sliced
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  head lettuce
sour cream
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef with onion flakes.  Drain.  Add chili powder.

name: DEER (OR BEEF) CHILI
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. ground meat
1  large onion, chopped
salt
1  can (small) tomato paste
1 large  can chopped tomatoes
1/4  c. (yes c.) chili powder
dash of vinegar
dash of sugar
preparation: Brown meat.  Dump in everything else; adjust with water. Simmer to desired thickness.  Top with cubed Monterey Jack cheese, olives (black) and a big blob of sour cream.  Take Rolaids.

name: PUPPY CHOW
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  box Rice Chex
2/3  c. creamy peanut butter
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  stick margarine
1 (1 lb.)  box powdered sugar
preparation: Microwave or in a double boiler, melt chocolate chips, peanut butter and margarine.  Stir until smooth.  Pour over Rice Chex and stir until all is covered.  Put the powdered sugar in a clean grocery bag and pour in the chocolate Rice Chex.  Close bag and shake until all is covered.

name: FIVE BEAN SWEET AND SOUR SALAD
ingredients:
1  can cut green beans
1  can red kidney beans
1  can green limas
1/3  c. salad oil
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  small green pepper, chopped
1  small red onion, chopped
1  can wax beans
1  can garbanzo beans
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2/3   c. vinegar
preparation: Mix ingredients  together and refrigerate.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
2  c. raw zucchini, medium grated
chopped nuts may be added
3  c. flour, self-rising
3  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Blend oil and sugar; beat in eggs.  Beat well; add zucchini. Mix together flour and cinnamon.  Add egg mixture to flour mixture.  Beat thoroughly; pour into 2 greased loaf pans.  Bake 1 hour at 325°.

name: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling or 12 to 16 oz. frozen strawberries
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1 large  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Combine all ingredients together and mix well.  Freeze.

name: DEBBIE'S ORIENTAL DIP WITH SNOW PEAS
ingredients:
1/4  lb. fresh snow peas
1/2  c. plain low-fat yogurt
1/4  c. reduced calorie mayo
1 1/2  tsp. low sodium soy sauce
1  tsp. grated fresh ginger root
dash of garlic powder
2  Tbsp. chopped water chestnuts
1  Tbsp. chopped, fresh parsley
preparation: Trim ends of snow peas.  Place snow peas in vegetable steamer over boiling water.  Cover and steam about 1 minute.  Do not overcook.  Should still be crisp.  Remove snow peas; rinse with cold water and chill for about 2 hours.

name: SOUR CREAM FROSTING
ingredients:
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
1  egg white, well beaten
preparation: Combine nuts,  sugar and sour cream and bring to a boil. Reduce heat  and  cook  slowly  for  15 minutes or until thick. When thick,  add  the well beaten egg white and mix thoroughly. Allow mixture  to  cool.  Spread  between  layers and to top of cake.  (Not sufficient amount to cover sides of cake, but since it is so rich, it really doesn't need to.)

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  egg
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
3  large bananas, mashed
1  c. walnuts, cut in small pieces
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add beaten egg.  Add mashed bananas. Sift baking soda, salt and flour together, then add to mixture and mix well.  Add nuts.  Mix again.  Bake in greased loaf pan at 375° for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350°.  Bake for 45 minutes.  Do toothpick test.

name: BREAD STUFFING
ingredients:
1  c. melted butter or margarine
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1  Tbsp. poultry seasoning
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. parsley
4  qt. stale bread crumbs
preparation: Cook onion and celery in butter for 4 minutes.  Add seasonings and add to bread crumbs.  Makes enough to stuff 16 to 20 pound turkey.

name: ONION RINGS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
4  tsp. sugar
2  large eggs, beaten
1/2  c. cornstarch
1  c. water
1/4  tsp. salt
onions, sliced 1/4-inch thick
preparation: Slice onions; coat with flour.  Dip into batter.  Heat oil to 375°.  Fry onion rings until golden brown.  May also use other vegetables.

name: WESTERN MAC
ingredients:
1  pkg. macaroni and cheese
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  c. whole kernel corn
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Prepare macaroni and cheese. Brown meat and onions. Cook until tender. Stir in corn, tomato paste, water, salt and pepper. Add macaroni and mix well. Pour into 2-quart casserole; bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: PEACHY LEMONADE PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. peach gelatin
1  c. sugar
2  c. boiling water
2 (12 oz.)  cans frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
10  cans water
preparation: Dissolve gelatin and sugar in boiling water in a large container.  Add lemonade concentrate and remaining water; mix well.  Chill thoroughly.  Pour over crushed ice in punch bowl.

name: PINEAPPLE BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
1  stick butter
4  eggs
1  can drained crushed pineapple
6  bread slices
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Blend softened butter, eggs and sugar.  Add pineapple.  Cut bread slices into small sections.  Add to mixture until all bread is soaked.  Bake at 400° until brown.  Good with ham.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
1  can pineapple chunks
1  can mandarin oranges
1  can peach pie filling
3  to 4 sliced bananas
preparation: Drain strawberries, pineapple and oranges.  Mix together in a large bowl.  Chill before serving.  If salad is to be chilled overnight, it is best to add the bananas just before serving. Serves 6 to 8.  Good to serve with breakfast casserole.

name: CHERRIES IN THE SNOW
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  large container Cool Whip
2  cans cherry pie filling
preparation: Crumble cake and set aside.  Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar, then add Cool Whip to this mixture.  In a large bowl, put a layer of crumbled cake, Cool Whip mixture and then 1 can of cherry pie filling.  Repeat layers.  Top with cherry pie filling.

name: BARBECUED BRISKET
ingredients:
5 to 6  lb. beef brisket
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. onion salt
1  tsp. garlic salt
1 (3 oz.)  bottle liquid smoke
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire
preparation: Sprinkle brisket with salts and seed.  Place in marinade pan or cooking bag if no pan.  Pour smoke over meat to coat all surfaces. Flip pan from time to time.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: BLUEBERRY BUTTERMILK MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. butter, melted
2  eggs, beaten
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. fresh or dry packed frozen blueberries
preparation: In small bowl, combine buttermilk, butter and eggs until blended.  In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.  Make well in center.  Add buttermilk mixture.  Stir until just moistened.  Fold in blueberries.  Spoon batter into greased muffin cups, filling 2/3 full.  Bake in prepared 400° oven for 20 minutes or until tops are golden and toothpick in center comes out clean.  Remove from pan.  Serve warm or cool on wire rack.  Makes 18 muffins.

name: PINK COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage
1  small fresh beet, peeled and finely shredded
1  small onion, finely grated
2  to 3 carrots, coarsely shredded
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. mayonnaise
3/4  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Quarter and core cabbage.  Slice into thin slivers.  Place in large bowl.  Cover with ice water.  Refrigerate one hour.  Drain well.  Add beet, onion, carrots, sugar and salt to drained cabbage.  Toss.  Combine mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon juice and pepper in small bowl.  Stir well.  Pour over cabbage mixture. Toss to coat vegetables.  Cover.  Refrigerate several hours. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

name: VERMICELLI WITH ASPARAGUS
ingredients:
1  lb. asparagus, sliced thin on the diagonal
boiling water
1/4  c. butter or margarine
2 large  cloves garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. fresh ground black pepper
1  lb. thin spaghetti or vermicelli, cooked and drained
preparation: Cook asparagus in boiling water for 2 minutes; drain, then refresh under running cold water.  Melt butter in large skillet. Add asparagus, garlic, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce and pepper; saute while stirring for a minute or two.  Toss with hot, cooked spaghetti.  Serve with grated Parmesan.

name: GRILLED SHORT RIBS
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. beef short ribs
1/4  c. prepared yellow mustard
1/4  c. tomato juice
2  Tbsp. molasses
preparation: Arrange short ribs in shallow baking pan.  Cover with foil. Bake at 400° for 1 hour.  Stir together mustard, tomato juice and molasses.  Brush over baked short ribs.  Grill over hot coals for 20 to 30 minutes until tender, turning frequently and brushing with mustard mixture.  Makes four to six servings.

name: RICE
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine, melted
1  can beef consomme soup
1  can French onion soup
1  c. uncooked rice
preparation: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350° for 30-35 minutes, or until all liquid is absorbed.

name: PEPPER CHICKEN(International:  Africa)
ingredients:
18  chicken legs
2  medium onions, thinly sliced
1  tsp. ground red pepper
1/4  c. cooking oil
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. thyme
2 (16 oz.)  cans whole tomatoes, drained
preparation: In a large skillet brown chicken pieces on both sides in hot oil about 15 minutes.  Remove from skillet and set aside, reserving the drippings.  Add tomatoes and onion slices to pan drippings.  Stir in red pepper, thyme and salt.  Bring to a boil. Return chicken legs to skillet.  Spoon tomato mixture over chicken.  Return mixture to boiling, reduce heat.   Cover and simmer for 35 to 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.  Skim off fat.   Serves 12.

name: ZUCCHINI PINEAPPLE BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. salad oil
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. coarsely shredded zucchini
1 (8 oz.)  can well drained crushed pineapple
3  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. raisins
preparation: Beat eggs with mixer.  Add next three ingredients; beat until thick and foamy.  Stir the next two ingredients with a spoon. Combine the rest of the ingredients and then mix all ingredients together and stir.  Bake in loaf pans for 1 hour at 350°.  Cool in pans for 10 minutes.  Turn out on racks.

name: BEST BIG-BATCH TOMATO SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. salad oil
3  medium onions, thinly sliced
3  large carrots, thinly sliced
2  medium green peppers, diced
2  medium garlic cloves, minced
12  lb. tomatoes, peeled and diced
1 (12 oz.)  can tomato paste
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
2  Tbsp. salt
2  tsp. oregano leaves
1 1/2  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: In an 8-quart Dutch oven over medium heat in hot salad oil, cook onions, carrots, green peppers and garlic until tender, stirring occasionally.  Add tomatoes and remaining ingredients. Over high heat, heat to boiling.  Reduce heat to medium-low. Partially cover Dutch oven and cook 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Makes about 9 pints.  (Each pint is enough to serve over one 8 ounce package of spaghetti, cooked.  Or use sauce in Swiss steak, pizza, lasagna or Eggplant Parmigiana.  Freezes well.

name: GRAPE MUFFINS
ingredients:
3  c. biscuit mix
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  egg
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
1/2  c. light brown sugar, firmly packed
2/3  c. milk
1  c. fresh seedless grapes
preparation: Combine biscuit mix, brown sugar and nutmeg in a mixing bowl. Mix well.  Beat egg until frothy; mix in milk and butter.  Pour egg mixture into dry ingredients and mix well.  Stir in grapes. Turn batter into 12 well-greased 2 1/2-inch muffin cups.  Bake in preheated 400° oven for 20 minutes.  Remove from pan while hot.

name: CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/2  lb. sausage
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  (8 oz.) salsa
preparation: Cook beef, sausage and onion. Brown and drain off excess fat. Add soup, cheese and salsa; mix well.  Put in crock-pot to keep warm.

name: SHRIMP AND CREAM CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) block cream cheese
1 small  can tiny shrimp
1  bunch green onions
1  dash Worcestershire sauce
"Club" crackers
preparation: Soften cream cheese; drain can of shrimp.  Chop green onions; mix together well with a fork.  Add a dash of Worcestershire sauce; mix again.  Even better if made several hours ahead.  Serve on "Club" crackers.  So yummy it's hard to stop eating!

name: SUPER HOT CHOCOLATE MIX
ingredients:
8  qt. pkg. powdered milk
2  lb. can Nestle Quik
12  oz. Coffee-mate
1 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Mix ingredients, store in airtight container.

name: TEX-MEX DIP
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans refried beans
1/2 to 1  c. salsa
8  oz. container sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. taco seasoning
2  medium size avocados
lemon juice, salt and pepper
2  to 3 whole scallions, chopped
1  large tomato, diced
1/2 to 1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
sliced jalapeno peppers
1 small  can black olives, sliced (optional)
preparation: Combine refried beans with enough salsa to be spreadable, but not runny. Spread mixture on a large serving plate with a rim to contain the mix.  Combine the sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning. Spread on top of the beans.  Peel, pit and puree avocados.  Season to taste with lemon juice, salt and pepper (or use prepared guacamole). Spread mixture on top of sour cream layer.  Sprinkle scallions, tomatoes, cheese, jalapenos and olives (if you like them!) on top of the guacamole.  Serve with lots of white corn tortilla chips!

name: LEMON CHESS PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. cornmeal
4  unbeaten eggs
1/4  c. melted butter
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. lemon juice
4  Tbsp. grated lemon rind
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Toss lightly with a fork the sugar, flour and cornmeal.  Add eggs, butter, milk, lemon juice and rind.  Beat lightly.  Pour in unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/3  c. cocoa
1/4  c. dry buttermilk
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. water
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. liquid egg substitute (at room temperature)
liquid sugar substitute to equal 1/3 c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Place flour, cocoa, dry buttermilk, sugar, cinnamon, baking soda and baking powder in bowl and mix at low speed to blend well. Mix water, oil, egg, sweetener and vanilla with a fork to blend. Add to flour mixture and mix at medium speed only until flour is moistened.  Add nuts to dough and spread evenly in a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan which has been greased with margarine.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean from the center and the bread pulls away from the sides of the pan.  Let cool in pan for 10 minutes.  Turn out on wire rack to cool to room temperature.

name: HONEY DRESSING
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. honey
1/2  c. plus 2 tsp. yellow mustard
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
3/4  c. chopped onion
9  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  c. chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Place all ingredients in blender container.  Process for 30 seconds or until creamy.  May be stored in refrigerator indefinitely.  Makes 4 cups.

name: MEXICALI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix (1 1/2 oz.)
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can whole tomatoes, chopped and undrained
1 (15 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1  egg
2/3  c. buttermilk
1  pkg. Mexican cornbread mix (with jalapeno)
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°. Brown ground beef in a large iron skillet. Drain.  Return beef to skillet and add taco seasoning mix, tomatoes  and	corn.  Bring mixture to a boil over medium heat, stirring  occasionally.  Beat  egg in small mixing bowl. Add milk  and  cornbread mix.  Stir until smooth.  Spoon cornbread batter  over ground beef mixture. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

name: MAGIC COOKIE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. nuts, chopped
1  c. chocolate chips
1 1/3  c. coconut, flaked
1 1/3  c. sweetened condensed milk (1 can)
preparation: Layer in pan in order given above, then pour canned milk over top of layers.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Cool 15 minutes. Makes a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Use 1/2 for a 9 x 9-inch pan.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE MOLD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. pineapple juice
1/4  c. cut up maraschino cherries
1  c. boiling water
1  can crushed pineapple
1  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  Tbsp. cherry juice
preparation: Dissolve jello in hot water and add pineapple juice.  Chill until slightly thickened.

name: MOM'S ROAST BEEF
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  eye of round beef roast (about 2 to 2 1/2 lb.)
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. brewed coffee
1  c. water, divided
1  beef bouillon cube
2  tsp. dried basil
1  tsp. dried rosemary
1  garlic clove
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Heat oil in a Dutch oven; brown roast on all sides.  Add onion and cook until transparent.  Add coffee, 3/4 cup of water, bouillon, basil, rosemary, garlic, salt and pepper.  Cover and simmer for 2 1/2 hours or until meat is tender.

name: MANHATTAN CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
4  slices bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  c. chopped clams (about 12 medium clams)
4  diced potatoes
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes
1  c. water
2  tsp. parsley
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. thyme leaves
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: In a large saucepan, cook and stir bacon and onion until bacon is crisp and onion is tender.  Mix in remaining ingredients.  Cook until potatoes are tender.  Yields 5 servings, 1 cup each.

name: EMPANADAS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck beef
1  medium size onion, chopped
1  c. celery, diced
1  green pepper, chopped
1  hot pepper, chopped
1  clove garlic, chopped
2  Tbsp. tomato paste
1/4  tsp. salt
pastry*
preparation: Brown meat and other ingredients, except pastry.  Cook until done.  If too thin, add flour to thicken.  Cut pastry in circles; put meat in half the circle.  Fold over; press edges together. Brush with milk.  Bake at 350° to 375° for 10 minutes.

name: CHEESEBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburg
1  chopped onion
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. milk
1/4  c. Bisquick
3  eggs
preparation: Brown hamburg and onion together; spread in bottom of greased casserole.  Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over top.  In blender, mix milk, Bisquick and eggs for 1 minute.  Pour over mixture in casserole.  Bake at 400° for 1/2 hour or until a knife comes out clean.

name: POUND CAKE LOAF
ingredients:
1  c. butter
4  eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. nutmeg (optional)
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bring butter and eggs to room temperature.  Grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Stir together flour, baking powder and nutmeg if used.  Beat butter on medium speed about 30 seconds, until softened.  Gradually add sugar, 2 tablespoons at a time. Beat 6 minutes.  Add vanilla.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Gradually add flour.  Beat on low speed until blended.  Bake at 325° for 55 to 65 minutes.  Cool 10 minutes in pan; finish cooling on wire rack.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. cooked, sliced carrots
2  small onions, diced
1  green pepper, diced
1  can tomato soup
3/4  c. vinegar
1/4  c. salad oil
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight.  Serves 10.

name: ALMOND JOY
ingredients:
2  (14 oz.) coconut
1  stick butter
1  lb. powdered sugar
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  pkg. milk chocolate chips
paraffin
whole almonds
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients well and press into a pan.  Put almonds in center (optional).  Freeze 1 hour.  Melt 1/2 block paraffin and package of milk chocolate chips.  Dip and refreeze.

name: SAWDUST SALAD
ingredients:
1  box lemon jello
1  box orange jello
2  c. hot water
1 1/2  c. cold water
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained (reserve liquid)
5  or 6 bananas, sliced
small marshmallows
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
preparation: Dissolve both jellos in hot water, then add cold water.  Put in refrigerator and let set until it starts to jell good.  Add pineapple and bananas.  Return to refrigerator and let chill good. Cover with small marshmallows.

name: COOKIE MONSTER'S SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Put butter and sugar in a bowl; blend well.  Crack eggs over mixture; add vanilla and mix.  Put flour, baking powder and salt in a bowl and mix.  Put everything together and mix well.  Put dough in icebox to chill for 1 hour.  Bake at 400° for 6 to 8 minutes.

name: CINNAMON HONEY SCONES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. quick cooking oats
2  tsp. baking powder
