1/8  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/3  c. butter or margarine
1  beaten egg
2  Tbsp. milk
2  Tbsp. honey
preparation: Stir together flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon and 1/4 teaspoon salt.  Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Stir in eggs, milk and honey until mixture is moistened. (Dough will be sticky.)  On an ungreased baking sheet, pat dough with lightly floured fingers to a 6-inch circle.  Cut into 12 wedges.  Bake in a 400° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.  Makes 12.

name: TACO APPETIZER
ingredients:
2  cans refried beans
3  large avocados, mashed
4  Tbsp. lemon juice
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix, Lawry's is the best
1  c. green onion, chopped
1 (7 oz.)  can black olives, chopped
8  oz. cheddar cheese, grated
3  large tomatoes, diced
1  large bag taco chips
preparation: Open cans of refried beans. In bowl mix avocado, lemon juice, 4 tablespoons mayonnaise, salt and pepper, set aside, In another bowl mix 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1 cup sour cream and taco seasoning mix and set aside. Layer on a very large plate as follows:

name: DEER JERKY
ingredients:
3  lb. venison, cut in stirps 3/8 inch thick
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. seasoned salt
2  tsp. Accent
2/3  tsp. garlic powder
2  tsp. onion powder
2/3  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Stir this mixture well with a spoon to dissolve all of the soluble ingredients.  Place the strips of meat in the marinade. Be sure they are completely submerged.  Marinate overnight, turning if necessary.  Lay marinated meat strips on oven rack. Cook for 6 to 8 hours at 150°.  They get crisper the longer they bake.  Store finished jerky in Ziploc bags or other airtight containers to seal in freshness.

name: HASH BROWN POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (2 lb.) bag hash browns, thawed
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1  onion, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  carton commercial sour cream
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. melted butter, divided
1  tsp. salt and pepper
2  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl and mix together.  Add 1/4 cup butter, salt and pepper and mix together.  Pour into a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan, spreading smoothly over casserole.  Mix 1/4 cup of butter (melted) with potato chips. Spread on top of casserole.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: BASIC CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. diced, cooked, cold chicken
1 1/2  c. diced celery
3  hard-cooked eggs, diced
about 2 to 3 Tbsp. sweet pickles or pickle relish
salt to taste
mayonnaise
preparation: Combine chicken, celery, eggs, pickles and salt.  Do not add mayonnaise until ready to serve.  Then mix with enough mayonnaise to lightly blend everything.

name: SCHOOL BACK PACK SNACK
ingredients:
3  c. granola cereal
1/2  c. honey roasted nuts
1/2  c. M&M's
1/2  c. Cheddar goldfish or cheese-flavored crackers
1/2  c. Post Toasties
1/3  c. raisins
preparation: In large bowl combine all ingredients.  Store covered in airtight container until ready to pack for school.

name: CARAMEL APPLES
ingredients:
6  medium sized red apples
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. dark corn syrup
1  c. light cream
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Stick wooden skewers into stem end of apples.  Combine corn syrup, cream and butter.  Cook over low heat; add vanilla.  Dip apples into syrup (work fast).  Roll in coarsely chopped nuts, if desired.  Place upright on well-greased cookie sheet to cool.

name: SAUSAGE BITES(Catherine Hamilton's Kitchen)
ingredients:
3  c. Bisquick
8  oz. grated sharp cheese
1  lb. very hot sausage
preparation: Mix  ingredients  together well.  Roll into balls, size of quarter  (approximately).  Put  onto cookie sheet.	Bake at 350° for  10 minutes, approximately or until lightly browned. Serve hot.  Great for guests.

name: GERMAN SWEET CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. German sweet chocolate
1/4  c. butter
1 2/3  c. evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/8  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  unbaked 8 or 9-inch pie shell
1 1/3  c. coconut
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Melt chocolate and butter over low heat, stirring until blended.  Remove from heat and gradually blend in milk.  Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt and blend in eggs with vanilla. Gradually blend into chocolate mixture; pour into pie shell. Combine coconut and nuts and sprinkle over filling.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.  Filling will be soft, but will set as it cools. Cool at least 4 hours before cutting.

name: VEGETABLE RELISH
ingredients:
12  medium onions, ground (4 c.)
1  medium cabbage, ground (4 c.)
12  green tomatoes, ground (4 c.)
12  sweet peppers
2  sweet red peppers
1/2  c. salt
6  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1 1/2  Tbsp. turmeric
4  c. cider vinegar
2  c. water
preparation: Grind vegetables using coarse blade.  Sprinkle with salt; let stand overnight.  Rinse and drain.  Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over vegetables.  Heat to boiling.  Simmer 3 minutes.  Seal in hot sterilized jars.  Makes 8 pints.

name: CRISP BREAD AND BUTTER PICKLES
ingredients:
4  qt. sliced upward cucumbers
6  medium white onions, sliced (6 c.)
2  green peppers, sliced (1 2/3 c.)
3  cloves garlic
1/3  c. granulated pickling salt
5  c. sugar
3  c. cider vinegar
1 1/2  Tbsp. celery seed
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
preparation: Combine cucumbers, onions, peppers and whole garlic cloves. Add salt.  Cover with cracked ice.  Mix thoroughly.  Let stand 3 hours.  Drain well.  Remove garlic and combine remaining ingredients.  Pour over cucumber mixture.  Bring to a boil.  Fill hot jars to 1/2-inch from top.  Adjust lids.  Process in boiling water bath for 5 minutes.  (Start timing when water returns to boiling.)  Makes 8 pints.

name: PAN SUGAR BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  can any biscuits enough to cover bottom of skillet
1  c. sugar
preparation: Pull biscuits in halves or fourths.  Get grease or Crisco or oil hot, place in skillet.  Turn when golden brown on every side. Remove carefully.  Place on paper towel, then roll in sugar or powdered sugar until coated.  A great sweet and chewy snack.

name: LISTY
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. sour cream
2  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix flour and margarine until crumbly, then mix sour cream, egg yolks and vanilla together.  Add to flour and margarine.  Mix well.  Chill overnight in refrigerator.  Divide into 4's and roll out thin on floured board.  Cut in 4-inch squares.  Make a  slit in middle.  Put on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: REFRIGERATOR ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. boiling water
2  pkg. dry yeast
1  c. warm water
6  c. sifted flour (plain flour)
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Pour boiling water over shortening, sugar and salt.  Blend and cool.  Add beaten eggs.  Sprinkle yeast in warm water; dissolve and add flour to it.  Mix well.  Cover and place in refrigerator for 4 hours.  About 3 hours before using, roll out and cut with biscuit cutter.  Pat melted butter on top and fold like a pocketbook.  Place in greased pan and allow to rise until double. Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: HAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
2  qt. water
1  medium onion, diced
2  c. ham, diced (can also use a ham bone)
6  to 8 potatoes
4  to 6 carrots
10 to 12  oz. frozen corn
1  c. half and half
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Put 2 quarts water in large soup kettle.  Add onion and ham to water and boil 1/2 hour.  Add remaining ingredients.   Cook until potatoes are tender, then mash with back of spoon about half of the potatoes to help thicken broth.  Add half and half and serve hot.  Good with fresh bread.

name: MRS. PATTERSON'S BUTTERNUT PIE
ingredients:
3  medium butternut squash
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. milk
vanilla-butternut flavoring
1  pie shell
preparation: Cut outer skin away from squash.  Cut  in pieces.  Cook inside meat by boiling on stove until soft.  Remove and drain. Add eggs and beat.  Add flour, sugar, flavorings and milk. Mix until lumps are gone.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake  at  350° to 375° until firm.

name: UPSIDE-DOWN PIZZA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  can spaghetti sauce
2  c. Mozzarella cheese
1  pkg. dry yeast
1  c. very warm water
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. salad oil
2 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain.  Add sauce and cook 15 minutes. Place in a 9 x 13-inch dish.  Cover with cheese.

name: HOT ROLLS
ingredients:
2 3/4  c. warm water
2  yeast cakes
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
6  c. flour
1/2  c. shortening
preparation: Mix  dry  ingredients  and  shortening.  Dissolve yeast cake in water.  Combine and bake.

name: CHILI-BEAN BAKE
ingredients:
2  cans Armour chili beans
1  can hominy
1  pkg. shredded cheese
1  pkg. Fritos (optional)
preparation: Pour hominy into large casserole dish.  Spread chili beans on top of hominy.  Sprinkle shredded cheese as topping.  (Crushed Fritos may be sprinkled over cheese.)  Bake in oven or microwave oven until thoroughly hot and cheese is melted.

name: SKILLET EGGPLANT
ingredients:
2  tsp. each oil and butter
1  c. chopped onion
1  large bell pepper, cut into strips
1/4  c. water
1/4  tsp. allspice
2  c. diced eggplant
1  large tomato, diced
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Place all ingredients in pan and simmer for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

name: OLD-FASHIONED SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  lb. medium potatoes
2  Tbsp. minced onions
3  c. milk
preparation: Peel potatoes with sharp knife; thinly slice potatoes.  In greased 2-quart casserole, arrange half the potatoes.  Sprinkle with half the onion; pour half the sauce on top.  Repeat with remaining potatoes.

name: HAMBURGER-CORN BAKE
ingredients:
3  c. egg noodles
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can corn
8  oz. sour cream
1/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. chopped pimiento
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  c. bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook noodles and drain.  In a frypan melt butter and add bread crumbs.  Brown bread crumbs and set aside.  In a skillet, cook beef and onion until meat is browned and onion is tender.  Drain off fat.  Stir in soup, corn, sour cream, milk, pimiento, salt and pepper; mix well.  Stir in the noodles.  Turn mixture in casserole dish.  Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.  Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven about 50 minutes.

name: PORK CHOP AND CORN STUFFING BAKE
ingredients:
1  can Campbell's new golden corn soup
1/4  c. each:  finely chopped celery and onion
1/2  tsp. paprika
1 1/2  c. Pepperidge Farm corn bread stuffing
4  boneless pork chops (3/4-inch thick)
1  Tbsp. brown sugar, packed
1  tsp. spicy brown mustard
preparation: Combine soup, celery, onion, paprika and stuffing.  In 9-inch greased pie pan, spoon stuffing mixture.  Arrange chops over stuffing mixture, pressing lightly into stuffing.  Combine sugar and mustard.  Spread evenly over chops.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until chops are fork-tender.

name: PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. salt
2  c. flour
1  c. water
4  tsp. salad oil
food coloring
preparation: Mix salt and flour, set aside.  Mix water, salad oil and food coloring.  Add to salt and flour.  If too sticky, add flour or if too dry, add water.  Keep in jars (capped) between uses. Consistency of clay.

name: BAKED MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
2  c. uncooked macaroni
1 1/2  tsp. salt (or less)
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  c. shredded cheese
4  c. milk
preparation: Mix above together. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. oleo
2 1/2  c. flour
1 1/3  c. sugar
1 1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. mashed bananas
2/3  c. buttermilk
2  large eggs
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix together  oleo and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, then add  all the other ingredients except the nuts.  Add nuts last. Makes  2  loaves.  Bake  in 350° oven until done.  Test with toothpick.

name: PIZZA CRUST(Using a pizza stone makes a nice brown bottom crust)
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. all-purpose flour or half bread flour
1  pkg. RapidRise yeast
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1  c. warm water (120~)
1  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Place flour, yeast, salt and sugar in food processor and pulse a few times to combine.  Add oil to warm water.  With machine running, add water slowly through feed tube until dough forms a ball.  Process a few more seconds to knead.  Place in greased bowl, turning to grease top and cover.  Let rise while you chop the vegetables.  Our favorites are onions, green peppers, pineapple tidbits (drained) and pepperoni (sliced thin).  Punch dough down and form or roll into circle.  Place on pizza pan that has been oiled and sprinkled with cornmeal.  Add pizza sauce, toppings and cheese of your choice.  Bake and serve.  Makes 8 pieces.

name: NEIMAN MARCUS CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  cup unsalted butter soften
1  cup brown sugar
3  tablespoons sugar
1  egg
2  teaspoons vanilla extract
1/2  teaspoon baking powder
1/2  teaspoon baking soda
1/2  teaspoon salt
1  3/4 cups flour
1  1/2 teaspoons instant coffee slightly crushed
8  oz. semisweet chocolate chips
preparation: Cream butter with sugar until fluffy. Beat in the egg and the vanilla. Combine the dry ingredients and beat into the butter mixture. Stir in the chocolate chips. Bake at 375° for 9 minutes.

name: GUACAMOLE
ingredients:
3  avocados
1/2  c. onion, diced small
1  large tomato, diced small
1  tsp. seasoning salt
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. oil
1  jalapeno, diced small (optional)
preparation: Mash avocados.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Chill or enjoy ASAP, as we do.  Serve with tacos or chips or by the spoonful.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple
1  can cherry pie mix
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1/2  lb. butter
1  can coconut
1  c. pecans
preparation: Spread large can crushed pineapple in bottom of pan.  Put cherry filling on top of pineapple.  Pour yellow cake mix over pineapple and cherry.  Slice 1/2 pound butter thin and place over cake mix.  Spread coconut over butter and top with broken pecans. Bake at 325° for 55 to 60 minutes.

name: MUDDY BUDDIES(Great For Kids To Make)
ingredients:
9  c. Chex brand cereal (Corn, Rice, Wheat, Double and/or Graham)
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/4  c. margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Pour cereal into large bowl; set aside.  In small saucepan over low heat, melt chocolate chips, peanut butter and magarine until smooth, stirring often.  Remove from heat.  Stir in vanilla. Pour mixture over cereal, stirring until pieces are evenly covered.  Pour cereal mixture into resealable plastic bag with powdered sugar.  Seal securely and shake until all pieces are well coated.  Spread on wax paper to cool.

name: GAVIN'S YUMMY IN THE TUMMY JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
5  slices bacon
1  c. sliced celery
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
6  c. canned tomatoes with liquid
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
1 1/2  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. thyme
3  lb. shrimp, shelled and deveined
1/3  c. finely chopped parsley
salt to taste
6  c. hot cooked rice
preparation: Fry bacon until crisp.  Drain, but save grease.  Cook onion, celery and green pepper in the bacon fat until onion is tender. Add the tomatoes, garlic powder, cayenne pepper, chili powder and thyme.  Simmer for 15 minutes.  Add the shrimp, parsley and salt. Cook until shrimp are done.  Serve over the cooked rice.  Garnish with crumbled bacon.

name: SOUTHERN COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour (self-rising)
1  can cream
1  can fruit (sweetened, 16 oz.), drained
preparation: If using fresh fruit, coat with sugar first.  Any fruit will do.

name: BAKED CHICKEN-MUSHROOM GRAVY
ingredients:
1  whole chicken (or breast), cut up
1/4  c. bell pepper
1/4  c. onion
3  Tbsp. oleo
3  Tbsp. flour
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Skin  chicken  pieces;	coat  with  flour that has been seasoned.  Put  in	a 13 x 9-inch dish.  In a saucepan combine oleo  and  flour;  brown slightly.	Add soup and water to make gravy consistency.	Add bell pepper, onion, salt and pepper to taste.  Pour over chicken.	Cover with foil.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serve gravy over rice.

name: HOLIDAY PUNCH
ingredients:
3  c. sugar syrup*
1 small  pkg. cherry Kool-Aid
4  c. water
2  c. lemon juice (bottled or fresh, fresh is better)
2  c. orange juice (bottled or fresh, fresh is better)
2  c. pineapple juice (unsweetened)
2  qt. ginger ale or Sprite
preparation: Mix sugar syrup, Kool-Aid and juices.  Pour over ice in a punch bowl.  Add ginger ale or Sprite.  Serves 50.  A ring of frozen sweetened cherry Kool-Aid is nice to put in punch bowl.

name: DILL PICKLES
ingredients:
3  qt. water
1  qt. vinegar
1  c. salt (scant)
pickles
turmeric
dill
garlic
preparation: Heat  water, vinegar and salt to boiling.  Pack pickles in jar.  Add  1  large head dill, 1/4 teaspoon turmeric and 2 sections  garlic  per  jar.  Cold pack to boiling point.  Turn heat off and let stand 5 minutes.

name: SUGAR-FREE APPLE PIE
ingredients:
7  to 8 tart apples
2  Tbsp. flour
dash of salt
8  or 9 packets Sweet 'N Low
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
2  Tbsp. butter
pastry for 2-crust pie, unbaked
preparation: Pare apples and slice.  Mix flour, salt, sweetener and spices. Add to apples.  Fill 9-inch pastry-lined pie pan.  Dot with butter. Adjust top crust.  Bake in hot 400° oven for about 50 minutes or until brown and apples are soft.

name: CRISPY RICE TREATS
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. margarine
1  jar (7 oz.) marshmallow creme or puff
6  cups rice cereal or chocolate rice cereal
Vegetable cooking spray
preparation: Melt margarine in large saucepan over low heat.  Add marshmallow creme and stir until well combined.  Remove from heat. Add rice cereal.  Stir until well coated.  Using buttered spatula or waxed paper, press mixture evenly into 13x9x2-inch pan coated with cooking spray.  Cut into 2x2- inch squares when cool.

name: CRAB IMPERIAL
ingredients:
1  lb. crabmeat
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. green pepper
3  Tbsp. butter, melted
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  hard-cooked eggs, diced
preparation: Remove shells from crabmeat.  Cook onion and green pepper in butter until tender.    Blend in flour.   Add milk to make white sauce.   Add seasoning, eggs and crabmeat.  Put in well-greased pan.   Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: NOODLE BURGER BAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onions
3  c. cooked drained noodles
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. chopped pimento
1/4  tsp. pepper
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. soft bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. melted oleo
preparation: Combine and brown meat and onions until tender.  Add all ingredients except bread crumbs and melted oleo and pour into oblong baking dish or casserole.  Top with bread crumbs and oleo. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

name: APPLE DESSERT
ingredients:
2  c. apples
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. oatmeal (quick cooking)
3/4  c. self-rising flour
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter, melted
preparation: Mix apples, sugar and cinnamon.  Place in greased casserole dish.  Combine oats, flour, brown sugar and butter.  Crumble over apples.  Bake at 350° for approximately 30 to 45 minutes.

name: SALSA ROJA
ingredients:
5  large ripe tomatoes, diced
1  c. chopped onion
3  large garlic cloves, crushed
1  tsp. salt
2 to 4  Tbsp. dry sherry (optional)
1/2  c. chopped green chilies, canned
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. cayenne
1/2 to 1  tsp. ground cumin
minced parsley, basil and chives to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients except parsley, basil and chives in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil, lower the heat and cover.  Simmer for 40 to 50 minutes.  Add minced herbs to taste.

name: HUMMINGBIRD CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. vegetable oil
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1  c. chopped pecans
2  c. mashed bananas
preparation: Combine flour, sugar, baking soda, salt and cinnamon in a large mixing bowl.  Add eggs and oil.  Stir until dry ingredients are moistened.  Do not beat.  Add vanilla, crushed pineapple, pecans and bananas.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
dash of allspice
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix and chill a few hours before serving.  Use with sliced fruits, use as you would with veggies and ranch dip.

name: EASY CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans chicken or 4 chicken breasts, cooked and cut up
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can chicken broth
Pepperidge Farm stuffing
butter
preparation: Put chicken in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine soups and broth and mix well. Pour on top of chicken. Spread Pepperidge Farm stuffing on top of chicken and soup and put butter on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
8  oz. water
1  onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. sugar
2  cans tomatoes
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain.  Add tomatoes, water and onion; bring to a boil.  Add butter, salt and pepper.  Cook until onion is soft.

name: PECAN CRUNCH COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. crushed potato chips
2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add other ingredients.  Mix well. Make into small balls and place on a cookie sheet.  Press flat with a glass dipped in sugar.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: STUFFED PASTA SHELLS
ingredients:
1  c. Ricotta cheese
1  c. Mozzarella cheese
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
1  medium onion, chopped
1/4  c. fresh grated Parmesan cheese
garlic salt and pepper to taste
large jar your favorite spaghetti sauce
1  pkg. large pasta shells
preparation: Mix Ricotta cheese, Mozzarella cheese, broccoli (thawed), about 1/4 cup onion, Parmesan cheese and garlic salt and pepper to taste. Cook shells (about 24) as directed on the box.  Put a layer of spaghetti sauce on the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Drain shells and rinse in cold water.  Stuff shells with cheese mixture and place on top of the spaghetti sauce (seam side upright).  Then spread more sauce on top of shells.  Bake at about 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  This makes an excellent appetizer, too!  Makes about 20 to 25 shells.

name: SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. shortening
1 1/4  c. water
2  c. carrot sticks
1/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  c. ketchup
3  chicken broth packets
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
diced, cooked chicken
1  c. green pepper, cut in strips
2  boil in bags rice
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving juice.  Add enough water to juice to make 2 1/4 cups or according to rice directions.  Bring to boil.  Cook rice according to box directions.  Saute onion in shortening in large skillet until tender.  Add 1 1/4 cups water, carrots and broth.  Cover and simmer 5 minutes.  Combine sugar, cornstarch, ginger, ketchup, vinegar and soy sauce.  Stir into vegetable mixture.  Cook until thickened.  Add chicken, green pepper and pineapple.  Cover and simmer 5 minutes.  Serve over rice.

name: CORN FLAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. Karo syrup
3/4  c. creamy peanut butter
6  c. corn flakes
preparation: Melt sugar and  Karo  syrup  over  low  heat,  stirring occasionally.  Rotate  mixing  corn flakes and  peanut  butter (it's easier if you  rotate).  Let  cool  for 20 minutes, then shape into balls on waxed paper.  Enjoy!

name: STRAWBERRY DIP
ingredients:
2  qt. fresh strawberries (uncapped)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  large tub Cool Whip
2  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and lemon juice with mixer until smooth and creamy.  Add milk.  Stir in Cool Whip; mix well. Wash strawberries, but do not cap.  Arrange on a serving platter, dip berries in mixture and enjoy.

name: OKRA AND TOMATOES
ingredients:
1 large  can tomatoes
1 medium  can okra
1  onion (small), chopped
3  slices bacon
1/2  tsp. salt
black pepper to taste
preparation: Fry bacon in medium pan. Mix ingredients with bacon in pan. Serve over Uncle Ben's rice.

name: MRS. ALFRED J. ORLIDGE'S FRUIT COCKTAIL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. fruit cocktail
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Drain fruit cocktail; cream butter, brown sugar, white sugar and vanilla until fluffy.  Add eggs.   Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with 1/3 cup of cocktail syrup.  Add cocktail and nuts.  Drop by spoonful on greasy cookie sheet.  Bake in 375° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/4  c. granulated sugar
3/4  c. light brown sugar, firmly packed
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pkg. vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
2  eggs
1  pkg. (12 oz.) chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix flour with baking soda.  Combine butter, sugar, vanilla and pudding mix in large mixer bowl; beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs, gradually add flour mixture; then stir in chips and nuts (batter will be stiff).  Drop by rounded measuring teaspoonfuls, about 2 inches apart, onto ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Makes about 7 dozen.

name: ITALIAN BAKED CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
6  split skinned boneless chicken breasts
3 (10 oz.)  boxes frozen broccoli spears
6 thick  slices Mozzarella cheese
1  c. Frying Magic
2  Tbsp. oil
2  cloves garlic
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Coat chicken breasts in Frying Magic.  In large skillet, heat oil and cook chicken about 7 minutes on each side or until browned. Remove from skillet and onto plate.  Steam broccoli spears and when done, add broccoli and garlic to same skillet.  Saute for 5 minutes.  In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, lay out broccoli spears. Place chicken breasts on top of spears and cheese slices on chicken.  Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350°.  Delicious.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: SHRIMP ETOUFFEE(A-Too-Fay)
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh or frozen raw shrimp, peeled
1/4  c. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. chopped green peppers
1/2  c. sliced celery
1  clove garlic, chopped fine
1  c. water
2  Tbsp. fresh parsley, chopped
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. hot sauce (more to taste)
hot cooked rice
preparation: Make a shallow cut down shrimp; wash out vein.  Heat butter in medium saucepan over low heat.  Stir in flour; cook, stirring constantly, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.  Stir in onions, green peppers, celery and garlic.   Cook until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes.  Stir in remaining ingredients, except rice.  Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until shrimp are pink.  Serve over hot rice.  Makes 4 servings.

name: MCVAY'S PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. hot water
1  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. baking soda
3  c. flour
preparation: Cream shortening and peanut butter.  Add well beaten eggs. Stir soda in hot water; add to batter.  Add flour and mix.   Drop by spoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Dip fork into sugar and make crisscross pattern.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Makes about 60 medium size cookies.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. Niblets corn
4  egg yolks, beaten lightly
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. butter
dash of pepper
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Beat the yolks and corn lightly and set aside.  Combine the flour, sugar, salt, butter and pepper.  Add milk slowly, beating until smooth.  Combine the 2 mixtures and pour into a well-greased casserole dish.  Bake in a pan of water at 350° for 1 hour or until custard is firm.

name: NEVER-FAIL MERINGUE
ingredients:
3  egg whites
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
6  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat the egg whites and cream of tartar in a bowl until fluffy.  Add the sugar gradually and beat until stiff peaks form. Add the vanilla and beat well.  Spread on pie so that meringue touches edge of crust.  Bake in a 400° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until brown.

name: CHOCOLATE CRAZY CAKE(Do not grease or flour pan!)
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. cocoa
3/4  c. salad oil
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. water
preparation: Mix in 11 x 13-inch pan the first 5 ingredients.  Pour over the oil, vinegar and vanilla.  Add water and stir with a fork. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Do not remove from pan.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage, browned and well-drained
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can mushroom or cream of celery soup
1 1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. uncooked rice
1/4  Tbsp. salt
1  can chopped mushrooms (optional)
preparation: Add celery and onion to browned sausage.  Cook until tender, not brown.  Stir in soup, milk, rice, salt and mushrooms.

name: KENTUCKY SLAW
ingredients:
1  head cabbage
1  carrot
1 1/2  Tbsp. vinegar
2 1/2  Tbsp. lemon
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. buttermilk
1/4  c. milk
preparation: Shred cabbage and carrot and set aside.  Combine rest of ingredients and mix well.  Add cabbage and carrots and mix well. Chill before serving.

name: PECAN CRISPIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. softened margarine
6  Tbsp. brown sugar
6  Tbsp. granulated sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream butter and sugar until light; beat in egg and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients. Stir in nuts. Drop from teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake about 10 minutes at 375°.  Cool slightly before removing from pan. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

name: CHOCOLATE-PECAN CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. cornmeal
pinch of salt
3/4  c. chopped pecans
4  large eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  unbaked (9-inch) deep dish pie shell
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients in medium bowl.  Combine eggs, milk and vanilla; stir into sugar mixture.  Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes until set.  Cool on wire rack.

name: BEER BATTER ONION RINGS
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs, separated
2/3  c. beer, at room temperature
3  Tbsp. margarine
2  large sweet onions, sliced into rings
preparation: Sift flour and salt.  Beat egg yolks slightly; add beer.  Mix with flour mixture.  Blend well.  Let batter stand at room temperature 20 to 25 minutes.  Fry in oil at 375°.  Brown on both sides, about 2 to 3 minutes.

name: NO COOK MARSHMALLOW FROSTING
ingredients:
1/8  tsp. salt
2  egg whites
1/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. Karo syrup
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Add salt to egg whites and beat with electric mixer until soft peaks form.  Gradually add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time.  Beat until smooth and glossy.  Slowly add Karo syrup, beating until firmly peaked.  Fold in vanilla.  This is good topped with coconut.

name: CUSTARD'S KIDS SOUP
ingredients:
100  books
21  bug eyed students
400  sheets of paper
21  pencils
1  green chalkboard
10  numbers
180  problems of the day
1  principal
40  teachers
preparation: Mix the books and the students in a large classroom.   Add the paper and the pencils.  Mix well.  Mix together the chalkboard, numbers and problems.  Add this to the student mixture.  Stir in the principal and the students.  Boil for 180 days at full steam. Serve with 2 cups of love and laughter.

name: LEMON PUDDING
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. margarine
3  Tbsp. flour
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. grated lemon rind
preparation: Cream margarine;  add  the  flour and 3/4 of the sugar; blend well.  Add	the  beaten egg yolks and mix well.  Add the milk, lemon juice and rind.  Beat the remaining sugar into the stiffly beaten  egg  whites  and fold them into the first mixture.	Pour into  greased  custard cups and place in a pan of hot water.  Bake in  a  moderate oven at 350° for 40 minutes. Cool; unmold and serve with your favorite lemon sauce.

name: SOUR CREAM COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. sour milk
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
1 3/4  c. shortening
1  c. sour cream
6  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together shortening and sugar.  Add eggs and mix well. Add rest of ingredients; mix well.  Roll out.   Cut and sprinkle tops with sugar.  Also good frosted.  Bake in 350° oven until done.  The more sour the cream, the better the cookie.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, boiled in salted water and diced
2  cans cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1  c. diced celery
1/4  c. chopped onions
1  can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. crushed cornflakes
1  c. soda cracker crumbs
margarine
preparation: Mix chicken, soup, celery, onion, water chestnuts and mayonnaise.  Add 1 cup cornflakes.  Mix well and pour into buttered casserole dish.  Sprinkle cracker crumbs on top and dot with margarine.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
2  cans cream of potato soup
1 (16 oz.)  can Veg-all, drained
2  c. cooked chicken
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. black pepper
2  (9-inch) pie crusts (Pillsbury Ready-Crust)
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients.  Spoon into pie crust.  Cover with second crust and crimp edges to seal.  Slit top crust and brush with slightly beaten egg.  Bake for 40 minutes at 375°.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  chicken, stewed and boned
1  can cream of chicken or cream of celery soup
1  box Stove Top stuffing
preparation: Place chicken pieces on bottom of pan.  Cover with soup. Prepare box of Stove Top stuffing according to package directions. Layer over the soup.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CUP TO CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. coconut
1  can crushed pineapple
1  c. small marshmallows
1  can white grapes
1  large tub Cool Whip
16  oz. sour cream
2  cans oranges (mag)
preparation: Drain all juices off fruits.  Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.  Serve.

name: BROCCOLI CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  bunch broccoli
1  bunch green onions
1/2  lb. bacon
2  c. Mozzarella cheese
1  c. Miracle Whip
1/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
preparation: Chop the broccoli in small pieces.  Chop green onions.  Cook bacon until crisp. Cool. Crumble bacon.  Mix all ingredients together.  Let set 1 hour in refrigerator before serving.

name: BIBLE (POUND) CAKE
ingredients:
6  Jeremiah 17:11
4  c. Jeremiah 6:20
1/2  lb. Judges 5:25
4 1/2  c. I Kings 4:22
2  T. Amos 4:5
few pinches Leviticus 2:13
2  pinches II Chronicles 9:9
2  c. Judges 4:19
2  T. I Samuel 14:25
2  C. Nahum 3:12
2  C. Numbers 17:8
preparation: Beat Jeremiah 17:11 until light.  Blend in Jeremiah 6:20. Beat in Judges 5:25.  Into another bowl, sift I King 4:22, add Amos 4:5, Leviticus 2:13, and II Chronicles 9:9.  Combine dry ingredients with liquid mixture, alternately with Judges 4:19. Fold in I Samuel 14:25, chop Nahum 3:12 and Numbers 17:8.  Add to the mixture, fold gently.  Administer Proverbs 23:14 and pour into 2 large 9 x 12 baking pans.  Bake 45 minutes at 350 degrees.

name: RICOTTA CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  box lemon cake mix
1  box instant lemon pudding
32  oz. Ricotta cheese
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
preparation: Mix cake mix by package directions.  Add lemon pudding; mix well.  Pour in 9 x 12-inch pan.  Mix Ricotta cheese, sugar and eggs; pour over cake mix.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: CHINESE COLESLAW
ingredients:
16  oz. coleslaw mix (shredded cabbage and carrots)
1  bunch green onions, chopped
1  package beef Ramen Oodles of Noodles
1/2  c. slivered almonds
1/2  c. sunflower seeds
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Sauté broken noodles and almonds in margarine until almost brown.  Mix together dressing ingredients.  Pour dressing over cabbage mix and onions.  Mix in noodles, almonds and sunflower seeds.  Serve immediately.  (Noodles tend to get stiff if they sit too long.)

name: CHICKEN BREASTS ROMANA
ingredients:
3  chicken breasts
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  c. (3/4 lb.) diced ham
1  medium onion, chopped
3/4  c. sliced celery
1/2  tsp. basil
1 1/2  c. chicken bouillon or stock or water
2 (6 oz.)  cans Hunt's tomato paste
1  Tbsp. minced parsley
1/2  lb. spaghetti, cooked
preparation: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper.  Lightly brown in oil. Remove chicken and set aside.  Add ham, onion, celery and basil to oil; simmer and stir for 5 minutes.  Return chicken to pan.  Add stock or water to tomato paste.  Pour over chicken.  Cover; simmer 40 to 60 minutes, turning occasionally.  Add parsley.  Serve with boiled spaghetti, swirled with a long-tined kitchen fork into individual portions.

name: SPINACH SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
2  beaten eggs
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped spinach, thawed and drained
preparation: Mix flour and salt.  Add eggs, milk, butter or margarine, cheese and onion.  Drain the thawed spinach well.  Add to mixture. Grease a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.  Pour mixture into pan and bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly golden. Let stand about 5 minutes before cutting into squares.

name: ROUND ABOUT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  box Jell-O (any flavor)
1 small  box cottage cheese
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Blend together Jell-O and cottage cheese, then add remaining ingredients.

name: APRICOT PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
1  can (8 oz.) unpeeled apricot halves
6  pork chops
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/3  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. chopped green onions
preparation: Drain apricots reserving 1/4 cup syrup; cut apricots in half.

name: MACARONI AND GROUND BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (7 1/4 oz.) Kraft macaroni and cheese dinner
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1  can (10 3/4 oz.) cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Prepare dinner as directed on package.  Brown meat and drain. Add onion and green pepper and cook until tender.  Combine ingredients; spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.   Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: STUFFED GREEN PEPPERS
ingredients:
3  medium green peppers, cut in half
1/4  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. ground beef
1  c. cooked rice
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/4  c. water
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Remove seed section from cut green peppers.  Place pepper halves on a paper towel and cook 6 minutes with microwave energy. Cook onions and beef in an 8-inch round glass cake dish about 4 minutes or until all pink has left the meat.  Stir several times during cooking.  Cook rice according to the directions.  Mix the tomato sauce with water.  Combine onion, beef mixture with cooked rice, half of tomato mixture, egg, salt and pepper.  Stuff pepper halves and place in a 2-quart glass utility dish.  Pour remaining tomato sauce over top and place wax paper over the dish.  Cook with microwave 10 minutes.  Recipe yields 6.

name: OVEN-BARBECUED COUNTRY PORK RIBS
ingredients:
4 to 5  lb. pork ribs
barbecue sauce
preparation: Place ribs in a single layer in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.  Drain off pan drippings; discard. Pour barbecue sauce over ribs.  Bake at 325° for additional 40 minutes or until tender.  Serves 8.

name: APPLE PIZZA COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  pkg. yeast
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. oleo
1  beaten egg
4  oz. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
2  Tbsp. oleo
2  large apples
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Into a large bowl combine 1 1/2 cups flour, yeast, 3 tablespoons sugar and salt; mix.  Heat water, milk, oleo and egg; blend into flour.  Knead to soft dough.  Let rise 15 minutes. Shape into ball.  Pat into a 12-inch pizza.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
1  can (2 c.) pumpkin
1  c. packed brown sugar
1  Tbsp. pie spice
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (13 oz.)  can Pet milk
1  large or 2 small pie crusts
preparation: Mix ingredients well.  Pour into unbaked crust.  Bake 15 minutes at 425°.  Then turn down to 350° and bake another 30 to 40 minutes.

name: PRALINE CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. dark brown sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
3  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. finely chopped pecans
maple syrup
pecan halves
preparation: Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine; press onto bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Combine cream cheese, brown sugar and flour, mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended.  Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition.  Blend in vanilla; stir in chopped pecans.  Pour over crust.   Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 250°.  Continue baking 30 minutes. Loosen cake from rim of pan; cool before removing rim of pan. Chill.  Brush with syrup; top with pecan halves.

name: SPAGHETTI WITH MEAT SAUCE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
2 (15 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
2 (15 oz.)  cans tomato paste
1 (1 1/2 oz.)  can pitted ripe olives, sliced
2  envelopes Italian spaghetti sauce mix
mushrooms
3  c. water
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. oregano leaves
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1  bay leaf, crumbled
preparation: Brown meat, onion and pepper.  Stir in remaining ingredients except spaghetti and cheese.  Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours.  Stir sauce occasionally.  Serve over spaghetti noodles and sprinkle with cheese.  Makes 8 servings.

name: YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. hot water
1  egg
1  pkg. dry yeast
3 1/2  c. flour or 2 c. white flour and 1 1/2 c. whole wheat flour
preparation: Melt shortening with sugar and hot water.  Cool.  Combine well beaten egg with yeast and add 1/2 cup lukewarm water.  Add shortening mixture to egg mixture and stir in flour.  Beat well and let rise in refrigerator overnight.  Roll out dough and grease pan.  Let rise in warm place about 3 hours.  Cook at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN SOUP WITH DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  whole chicken
3  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. pepper
3  medium onions
3  c. flour
preparation: Rinse chicken and place in a large cooking pot 3/4 full of water.  Cut onions to desired size.  Place in water with chicken. Add salt and pepper.  Bring to a boil, then simmer on medium for 1 1/2 hours.  Remove chicken and let cool to touch.  Strip meat and place back in soup.  Let simmer on low.

name: BUNNY BISCUITS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. refrigerated biscuits
10  raisins
5  red candied cherries
20  slivered almonds
1  tube pink decorator icing
preparation: Separate biscuits; place 5 of them on a greased baking sheet, about 2 inches apart.  Cut remaining biscuits in half.  Shape biscuit halves to form ears and firmly attached to whole biscuit. On each biscuit, press on 2 raisin eyes, 1 candy nose and 4 slivered almond whiskers.  Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes, or until biscuits are browned.  Cool slighlty; frost ears with icing. Yields 5 biscuits.

name: PINEAPPLE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cartons sour cream
2  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  ready made graham cracker crusts
preparation: Combine sour cream, pudding and pineapple in a large bowl. Reserve some pineapple for garnish.  Mix well.  Pour into crusts. Refrigerate until chilled.

name: 2 BAKED PIE SHELLS(Fruit Pie)
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  c. water
1  box Jell-O (strawberry)
4  c. uncooked strawberries
preparation: Boil the first 3 ingredients 5  minutes or until thick.  Stir in the Jell-O and boil 1 minute.  For strawberry pie, use the 4 cups uncooked strawberries and stir into the mixture.  Pour into shells and chill.  Use Cool Whip for topping.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large egg
2/3  c. mayonnaise
10 3/4  oz. cream of mushroom soup
2  (10 oz.) frozen chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1  medium finely chopped onion
1  c. loosely grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. bread crumbs mixed with 2 Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Beat egg, mayonnaise and soup.  Stir in broccoli, onions and cheese.  Turn into greased 9 x 13-inch dish.  Sprinkle with bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: ADOBO
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. pork shoulder or butt, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
1/3  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. salt
3  cloves garlic, minced
1  small bay leaf
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
preparation: Combine all ingredients except cooking oil in a pot and let stand for at least 30 minutes.  Simmer, covered, for 1 hour or until meat is tender.  Drain and reserve sauce.  Heat  cooking oil in skillet.  Brown on all sides.  Transfer to a serving dish. Pour off all remaining oil from skillet.  Add reserved sauce and cook for a minute or two, scraping all browned bits sticking to pan.  Pour sauce over meat and serve.

name: A HAPPY HOME RECIPE
ingredients:
4  cups love
3  cups forgiveness
5  spoons of hope
4  quarts of faith
2  cups of loyalty
1  cup of friendship
2  spoons of tenderness
1  barrel of laughter
preparation: Bake love and loyalty; mix it thoroughly with faith.  Blend it with tenderness, kindness and understanding.  Add friendship and hope.  Sprinkle abundantly with laughter.  Bake it with sunshine. Serve daily with generous helpings.

name: CRUMB CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. packed brown sugar
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter, softened
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. baking powder
preparation: Combine flour, sugar and salt.  Cut in butter until mixture resembles a coarse meal.  Remove 1 cup of mixture and combine with cinnamon and nuts.  Set aside for topping.   To remaining mixture, add milk and baking powder.  Spread into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle crumb topping over batter.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower
carrots
1/2  jar bacon bits
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
lettuce (optional)
3/4  c. Ranch dressing
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
salt and pepper
preparation: Cut cauliflower and carrots into small pieces.  Mix all other ingredients.  Add cauliflower, carrots and lettuce.

name: SHRIMP-WILD RICE SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. uncooked long grain white rice
1/2  c. uncooked wild rice
1/2  c. carrot strips, parboiled
1/2  c. frozen peas
2  hard-boiled eggs, diced
1/2  c. celery, diced
2  to 3 green onions (tops and all), sliced
1/4  c. fresh parsley, chopped
3/4  c. mayonnaise or to taste
1  can baby shrimp
1/2  tsp. curry
1/4  c. Italian dressing
preparation: The night before, cook rice.  Add curry and Italian dressing. Chill overnight.  Toss marinated rice with other ingredients just before serving.  Line bowl with lettuce leaves.  Add salad and garnish with cherry tomatoes.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: SWEET CHUNK PICKLES
ingredients:
7  lb. cukes
1  c. salt
1  gal. water
2  c. vinegar
alum
6  c. brown sugar
2  c. white sugar
4  c. vinegar
3  Tbsp. allspice (whole)
2  Tbsp. celery seed
8  sticks cinnamon
2  qt. water
preparation: Clean cukes and chunk into 1-inch pieces.  Soak overnight in 1 cup salt and 1 gallon vinegar.  In the morning, drain and boil in 2 quarts water and 2 cups vinegar until they lose their bright green color.  Drain.  Put alum size of pea in each pint.  Make syrup of 6 cups brown sugar and 2 cups white sugar, 4 cups vinegar, 3 tablespoons allspice berries, 2 tablespoons celery seed and 8 sticks of cinnamon.  Heat slowly to boiling point and pour over pickles.  Seal.

name: APPLE PIE ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGE
ingredients:
1  gal. pure unfiltered apple juice
2  c. Everclear (153 proof)
1/3  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Serve ice cold!!!

name: ITALIAN CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Crisco
1  stick margarine
2  c. sugar
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. flour
5  eggs, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. coconut
preparation: Beat egg whites and set aside.  Mix dry ingredients.  Using mixer, beat Crisco and margarine together.  Add sugar and mix well.  Add egg yokes and vanilla and mix. Add flour and buttermilk alternately, beginning and ending with dry ingredients.  Mix well. Add pecans and coconut and fold into batter.  Fold in beaten egg whites until white is gone.  Bake in 3 greased and floured 9 inch pans at 350° until done.

name: CREAMY CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
2  medium breasts
2  celery stems
1/4  onion
3  tsp. butter
1  Pet Ritz deep dish pie crust
1  can mixed vegetables
1  can chicken mushroom soup
1  tsp. mushrooms, diced
1  boiled egg
preparation: In a 2-quart saucepan over high heat, heat first 3 ingredients in 4 cups of water and a teaspoon of butter.  Season to desired taste.  Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 35 minutes or until nearly done.  When chicken is done, reserve 1/4 cup broth.  Cool chicken slightly, remove skin; cut into 1-inch pieces.

name: DATE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. dates, chopped
1  tsp. soda
1  c. boiling water
1  egg, beaten
3  Tbsp. melted butter
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
cooked vanilla pudding*
bananas
crumb cake
topping**
preparation: *Put two boxes of cooked vanilla pudding if you use one cake and four if you use two in layers.

name: WHITE PARTY MIX
ingredients:
1  lb. corn chex cereal
8  oz. pretzel sticks and small twists
12  oz. mixed nuts
4  oz. Nestle Baby Ruth mini bars (cut in 1/8ths)
4  oz. Nestle 1000 Grand Mini Bars (cut in 1/8ths)
2  lbs. Nestle White Icecap morsels (melted)
preparation: Combine cereal, pretzels and nuts.  Mix well.  Add chopped candy bars.  Toss.  Pour melted morsels over mixture.  Toss until well coated.  Spread mixture onto well sprayed sheet pan to cool. Break into pieces.  Store in airtight container.  Yield 5.25 lbs. Servings:  42 - 2 oz. servings.

name: STARLIGHT MINT SURPRISE COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. butter or oleo
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pkg. chocolate mint wafers (9 oz.)
walnut meats
preparation: Cream butter and sugars.  Blend in eggs, water and vanilla. Beat well.  Add dry ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours.  Enclose a mint wafer in about 1 tablespoon of chilled dough.  Place on baking sheet about 2 inches apart.  Top each with a walnut half.  Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 10 to 12 minutes.  Makes about 4 1/2 dozen cookies.

name: PIZZA CUPS
ingredients:
1  lb. pork ground sausage
1 (14 oz.)  jar pizza sauce
2  Tbsp. ketchup
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
2 (10 oz. each)  cans refrigerated biscuits
shredded Mozzarella cheese
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In a skillet, cook sausage over medium heat and drain.  Stir in pizza sauce, ketchup and garlic powder. Set aside.  Press biscuits into 20 well-greased muffin cups. Spoon 1 or 2 tablespoons of the meat mixture into each biscuit. Top with Mozzarella cheese and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15minutes or until golden brown.  Refrigerate or freeze any remaining meat sauce.  Yields 20 pizzas.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. cooked rice
1  c. chicken broth
4  hard-cooked eggs
2  c. cooked chicken, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
grated cheese
preparation: Place rice in casserole and add broth.  Cover with layers of egg slices and then add chicken.  Pour soup over this and top with cheese.  Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes or until bubbly.

name: STIR-FRIED CHICKEN, GREEN BEANS AND PEANUTS
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. cold water
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. cider vinegar
1  tsp. sesame seed oil
1  Tbsp. oil
1  c. frozen chopped bell peppers and onions
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. frozen petite green beans
2  c. cooked chicken
1/3  c. salted peanuts
preparation: Mix water, soy sauce, cornstarch, sugar, vinegar and sesame seed oil in a measuring cup, until blended.  Heat oil.  Add peppers, onions and green beans.  Stir-fry 4 to 5 minutes.  Stir in chicken, peanuts and soy sauce.  Bring to boil.

name: FIVE BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can garbanzo beans
1 (16 oz.)  can green beans
1 (16 oz.)  can lima beans
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans
1 (16 oz.)  can golden wax beans
2  medium carrots, shredded
1  medium onion, finely chopped
3/4  c. vinegar
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Drain liquid from 5 cans of beans. Drain and rinse kidney beans. Combine first 7 ingredients in large bowl. Combine remaining ingredients, mixing well. Pour over vegetables, tossing gently. Cover and refrigerate 8 to 10 hours before serving.

name: FRESH PLUM BUBBLE
ingredients:
3  c. quartered fresh plums
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  can pineapple tidbits
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. butter/oleo
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. flaky buttermilk biscuits
melted oleo/butter
2  Tbsp. cinnamon
sugar mixture
preparation: Combine plums and pineapple tidbits in a 10-inch ovenproof baking dish.  Mix sugar and cornstarch together and stir into fruit mixture.  Dot with butter/oleo and bake in a 400° preheated oven and top with biscuits.  Brush biscuits with melted butter/oleo and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.  Continue baking at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes longer.  Serve warm.  This is a great dish for brunch or can be topped with whipped cream or ice cream for dessert.

name: CHEWY SPICE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  eggs
1  tsp. brandy extract
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. allspice
2  (1 1/2 oz.) packets instant oatmeal with raisins and spice (uncooked)
1 1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
2  c. sifted flour
dash of salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
2  (1 1/2 oz.) packets instant Quaker oatmeal
preparation: Combine and spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Cool.

name: CHOCOLATE CREAM CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. butter or oleo, softened
1  tsp. vanilla
6 1/2  c. sifted powdered sugar
1/3  c. milk (room temperature)
4  sq. (4 oz.) unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
4  Tbsp. butter or oleo, softened
3  eggs
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. milk
preparation: Cream together cheese, 1/2 oleo and vanilla. Alternately beat in sugar and 1/3 cup milk. Blend in chocolate. Remove 2 cups for frosting; cover and refrigerate.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CUPS
ingredients:
8  oz. Hershey milk chocolate bar
1 1/2  c. peanut butter
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine (optional)
preparation: In the top of double boiler over hot, not boiling water, melt the chocolate with half of the peanut butter.  Stir until smooth. For extra creaminess, add the 4 tablespoons butter or margarine. Put remaining peanut butter in the top of another double boiler over simmering water.  Melt the peanut butter until it has a pouring consistency.  Place 24 miniature muffin paper liners inside cupcake or muffin tins.  Pour 1/2 of the chocolate mixture equally over the peanut butter.  You now have a bottom layer of chocolate, then peanut butter and finally top layer of chocolate. Let stand at room temperature about 2 hours to set.  Store them refrigerated in a covered container up to a week or frozen for months.

name: BOJANGLES BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. powdered sugar
1/3  c. Crisco
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Blend in Crisco and buttermilk. Knead about 5 minutes. Roll 1 1/2-inches thick on floured surface. Cut with biscuit cutter. Place on greased baking pan. Brush with melted butter. Bake at 425° until brown. Remove from oven and brush with melted butter.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
6  large potatoes, diced
4  large onions, diced
3  c. powdered milk
4  tsp. chicken bouillon
2  c. water
1/2  tsp. celery powder
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Cover potatoes and onions with water.  Cook until tender. Mash.  Add powdered milk, bouillon, 2 cups water, celery powder and onion powder.  Add salt to taste.  Bring up to temperature and serve.

name: MICROWAVE TOASTEY O'S
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. honey or white Karo syrup
1 1/2  c. peanut butter
5  c. Cheerios
1  c. chocolate chips
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Place sugar and syrup in microwave for 2 minutes on High.  Stir mixture.  Put back in on High for 1 minute.  Add the peanut butter to mixture.  Stir in Cheerios and put in jelly roll pan; let cool. Microwave chocolate chips and butter in measuring cup.  Spread mixture on cooled Cheerios mixture.

name: CRABMEAT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. backfin crabmeat
3  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1  c. mayonnaise
dash of salt, Tabasco and Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix everything well; put in a casserole dish.  Top with cracker crumbs; dot with butter and bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until hot.  Serves 5.

name: KATHY'S VEGGIE DIP
ingredients:
1/2  pt. sour cream
1/3  c. mayo
1  Tbsp. parsley
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  tsp. dill weed
1  tsp. Beau Monde
preparation: Combine all ingredients and chill.  Serve with fresh, raw vegetables.

name: APPLESAUCE PECAN BREAD
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  cup canned applesauce
1  cup sugar
1/3  cup vegetable oil
3  Tbsp. milk
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  cup flour
1  cup finely chopped pecans
1/2  cup mixed candied fruit, if desired
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  cup light brown sugar
1/4  cup chopped pecans
preparation: Beat eggs until foamy, stir in applesauce, sugar, oil and milk.  Gradually add  dry ingredients, stir in nuts and candied fruit.  Spread in greased 9 x 5 x 3 inch pan.  Sprinkle on top cinnamon, brown sugar and chopped pecans, press lightly with hand. Bake 350° for 1 hour.  Can sprinkle confectionary sugar to cover top last 1/2 hour if too brown.

name: ORANGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. vanilla wafers
1  stick butter, melted
1  box confectioners sugar
1 (6 oz.)  can orange juice concentrate
preparation: Crush wafers.  Add powdered sugar and mix well.  Pour melted butter and undiluted orange juice in wafers and sugar.  Mix again. Shape into balls (I allow the mixture to cool in the refrigerator first).  Roll in nuts or coconut if desired.

name: STUFFED FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
12  slices white bread, crusts removed
8  oz. cream cheese
2  c. milk
12  eggs
1/2  c. maple syrup
preparation: Coat 13 x 9-inch casserole dish with cooking spray.  Make 1 layer with 6 slices bread, cubed.  Make second layer with cubed cream cheese.  Top with layer of 6 slices of bread, cubed. Combine milk, eggs and syrup and pour over bread.  Refrigerate overnight.  Bake in morning at 350°  for 40 to 45 minutes.  Great for brunch!

name: SPINACH LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. small curd cottage cheese
3  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
2  eggs
4 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach, thawed and drained
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  jars spaghetti sauce
1  box lasagna noodles (uncooked)
1  c. water
preparation: Mix cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese (reserve 1 cup for topping), eggs, spinach, oregano, salt and pepper in a large bowl. In greased 13 x 9-inch pan, layer 1/2 cup sauce, 1/3 noodles and 1/2 of cheese mixture.  Repeat, then top with remaining noodles. Add remaining sauce.  Top with reserved Mozzarella cheese.  Pour water around edge of pan.   Cover with foil tightly.  Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until bubbly.  Let stand before serving.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE FOR RIBS
ingredients:
1  c. vinegar
2  lemons
1  c. catsup
1/3  c. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. mustard
2  Tbsp. flour, mixed to paste
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix together all ingredients. Bring to a boil and simmer for about 5 minutes. Baste ribs every 15 to 20 minutes. Serve rest with ribs.

name: CLASSIC PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  c. Karo light or dark syrup
1  (9-inch) pie crust
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. pecan halves
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. In medium bowl, beat eggs slightly. Add sugar, corn syrup, butter and vanilla. Stir until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie crust. Bake 50 to 55 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
2  eggs
1  c. sour milk
3  c. flour
1/2  c. cocoa
1  tsp. salt
4  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. soda
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Cream sugar, eggs and oil.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1  gal. chili beans
2  lb. extra lean ground beef
2  chili lengths
1/2  c. diced onion
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  qt. tomato juice
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain.  Place chili beans, tomato juice, chili lengths, onion and chili powder in a large pan. Add browned beef and cook until all is cooked well.

name: DUTCH GREEN SPLIT PEA SOUP
ingredients:
2  oz. Canadian-style bacon
2  c. water, divided
1 1/2  oz. uncooked green split peas, sorted and rinsed
6  oz. potatoes, pared and diced
1/2  c. leeks, chopped
1/2  c. celery root, pared and diced
2  Tbsp. celery leaves
4  oz. precooked kielbasa, sliced into 1/4-inch thick rounds
1/8  tsp. summer savory leaves
dash of pepper
preparation: Cut bacon into small pieces and set aside.  In a 2-quart saucepan, bring 1 cup of water to a boil.  Add peas and boil for 3 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Cover and let stand for 1 hour.  Add remaining cup of water and the bacon to saucepan and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, partially cover and let simmer for 1 hour. Add potatoes, leeks, celery root and celery leaves and cook until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes.  Add kielbasa, savory, and pepper and cook until sausage is heated through.  Serves 2.

name: Lemon Dropper
ingredients:
Fresh or prepared lemonade
Wicked cold lemon flavored vodka
Chilled martini glass
Slice of lemon and/or kiwi
preparation: Fill cocktail shaker with ice.  Pour fresh or prepared lemonade almost to top.   Add 2 - 3 shots of wicked cold lemon flavored vodka and shake.  Serve in chilled martini glass with slice of lemon and/or kiwi.

name: CAJUN ORANGE ROUGHY
ingredients:
orange roughy fillets or your favorite fish
Cajun style barbecue sauce
preparation: Bake orange roughy at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Depends on how thick your fillets are.  Pour off any juices in pan.   Coat the fish with Cajun style barbecue sauce.  Return to oven for 5 minutes.  Turn fish over, coat the other side with barbecue sauce and return to oven for 5 minutes.  Keep repeating, until fish is easily flaked with a fork.

name: EASY MARINATED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  bottle (8 oz.) Italian salad dressing
2  lb. medium mushrooms
grated peel of 1/2 lemon
juice of 1 lemon
2  Tbsp. parsley
preparation: In  large  saucepan,  combine  the Italian dressing and mushrooms.	Bring  to  a  boil.  Cook,  uncovered,	for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly.  Add lemon peel and lemon juice. Cover  and chill for 4 hours or more.  Drain.  Stir parsley in the mushrooms.	Serve as an appetizer with toothpicks.

name: MAMA'S CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2  cans yellow creamed corn
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. pimento
3  eggs
1/3  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. canned milk
1/2  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients.  Beat together remaining ingredients and add to corn mixture.  Pour into greased (buttered) shallow casserole.  Bake at 400° for 25 minutes, and 350° for 20 minutes or until custard is set.  Sprinkle with 1/3 cup bread crumbs.

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. vinegar
3  Tbsp. mustard
dash of salt
1  onion, chopped
8  eggs, boiled, peeled and chopped
3  c. mashed potatoes
preparation: Mix all together.  Garnish with a cup of ripe tomatoes.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter or margarine
pastry for single crust pie
1  c. pecan halves
3  slightly beaten eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
preparation: In saucepan, combine corn syrup, sugar and butter or margarine.  Bring to boiling.  Boil gently, uncovered, 5 minutes. Stir occasionally.  Cool slightly.  Prepare and roll cut pastry. Line a 9-inch pie plate with pastry.  Flute edge; do not prick pastry.  Place pecans in pastry shell.  Combine eggs, vanilla and salt.  Pour cooled syrup mixture into eggs and beat well.  Pour over nuts (pecans will rise to top).  Bake in 375° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Cool before serving.  Cover; chill to store.

name: CHIPPED BEEF DIP
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
1  pkg. Buddig beef
1  green onion and stem
few shakes garlic salt
few shakes onion salt
about 1 Tbsp. milk
few shakes parsley flakes (on top)
preparation: Dice beef, onion and onion stem.  Combine all ingredients. Stir and chill.

name: SIMPLE SALISBURY STEAK
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. hamburger
1/3  c. dry bread crumbs
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. minced onion
1 1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
preparation: In bowl, mix thoroughly 1/4 cup soup, hamburger, bread crumbs, egg and onion.  Shape firmly into 6 oval patties.  In skillet over high heat in 1 tablespoon hot fat, cook the patties until brown. Spoon off fat.  Stir in remaining soup and mushrooms.  Return patties to skillet.  Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until done, turning occasionally.  Serves 6.

name: CHICKEN BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
2  c. cider vinegar
4  Tbsp. salt
1/2  lb. oleo or butter or 1 c. corn oil
1/2  bottle Tabasco
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix together and keep warm (not boiling) to baste chicken. Serves 12.

name: SHEILA'S SALSA
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  Tbsp. sour cream
1 (24 oz.)  jar salsa
1 (16 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain.  Add sour cream, salsa and Cheez Whiz.  Mix well and cook on medium heat until thick.  Great with tortilla chips.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. raspberry jello or 2 small
1 3/4  c. boiling water
2  c. cold water
1  can whole cranberry sauce
1  c. crushed pineapple
2 oranges, cut up or 1 small  can mandarin oranges
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together.  Makes a medium size casserole bowl.

name: MEAT CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground meat
1  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  c. finely shredded carrots
2  c. finely shredded cabbage
1  tsp. salt
dash of black pepper
1  jar herb-style spaghetti sauce
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. chopped chives
1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: In medium skillet, saute onion in butter until soft, but not brown.  Add ground meat.  Cook, breaking up meat until meat loses its pink color.

name: APRICOT CHEWS
ingredients:
1  c. dried apricots, chopped
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. flour
2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix together; stir well.  Drop on well greased cookie sheet. Bake 20 minutes at 300°.  Freezes well.  Serve as candy or cookie.

name: HOT ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1  can artichoke hearts, drained and broken in pieces
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
1/2  clove garlic (optional)
1  Tbsp. lemon juice (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Put in 1 or 2 small oven dishes. Heat at 350° for 20 minutes or more until browned.   Serve hot with Fritos, crackers and veggies.

name: DUSTY MILLER COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. molasses
2  c. sifted flour
2 1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix in order as listed.  Chill dough.  Form dough into balls. Roll in powdered sugar.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

name: CARAMEL CANDY
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  lb. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. white Karo syrup
1  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Boil sugar, syrup and butter over low heat for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and add milk.  Return to low heat and stir constantly until reaches 237° to 238° on candy thermometer or soft ball stage (takes about 15 minutes).  Remove from heat.  Stir in vanilla.  Beat 10 minutes or until quite stiff.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan.  Put into refrigerator until cool.  When cool, cut into squares or roll pecans to make pecan rolls.  Cut into strips and eat.

name: BEEF AND POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef (extra lean)
1  medium onion, sliced
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen Tater Tots
1  can golden mushroom soup (undiluted)
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Place uncooked ground beef in bottom of 9-inch square baking dish.  Cover with a layer of onion slices.  Add a layer of frozen Tater Tots, covering beef and onion.  Spread soup evenly over top. Top with grated cheese.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PANCIT(Panseat)
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped fine
4  cloves garlic, chopped
1  c. shrimp, boiled, cleaned and sliced
1  c. pork, boiled or leftover roast, chopped
1  c. cabbage, chopped into small strips
2  carrots, slivered
4  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
14  oz. pancit noodles
lemon wedges
preparation: Using a large skillet or frying pan, lightly saute in a small amount of oil the onion and garlic.  Add the pork and shrimp.  Add cabbage, carrots, soy sauce and 1 cup of water.  Turn heat to medium and simmer for about 5 minutes.   Stir and simmer until carrots are cooked.  Place noodles on top of mixture and spoon vegetables and broth over noodles.  You might have to add a little more water if the noodles have not wilted.  Cover and allow to steam for about 2 minutes.  Turn out on a platter and garnish with lemon wedges.

name: BLUEBERRY/BLACKBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  large blackberry Jell-O
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  c. pecans
1  can blueberries in heavy syrup, drained
2  c. hot water
1  c. cold water
preparation: Mix Jell-O and 2 cups hot water; dissolve.  Add 1 cup cold water and the rest of the ingredients.

name: CHERRY NUT BARS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. quick oats
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. melted butter
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. baking soda
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
1  c. mini marshmallows
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Combine first 6 ingredients in large bowl.  Beat on low until mixture is coarse crumbs.  Save 1 1/2 cups crumbs for topping.  Use remaining crumbs for crust and press into 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes.  Spoon pie filling evenly over crust and sprinkle with marshmallows, then remaining crumbs.  Bake for 25 to 35 minutes or until light brown; do not overbake.  Cool. Cut into bars.  (We like to top with ice cream for a great tasting treat.)

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, well beaten
3  or 4 bananas, crushed
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Grease loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: CALIFORNIA MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. boiling water
2 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  egg yolk
2  c. buttermilk
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. all-bran cereal
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. chopped dates or raisins
preparation: Dissolve soda in boiling water; cool.  Cream together shortening and sugar.  Add water and 1 egg, beating well.  Stir in remaining ingredients in order given, beating well after each addition.  Store in refrigerator overnight or up to 6 weeks.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.  Makes 3 dozen muffins.

name: FRITO BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. small Fritos
2 (15 oz.)  cans Ranch Style beans
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Catalina dressing
2  medium tomatoes, diced
1  medium onion, chopped
3/4  c. cheese (optional)
1/4  c. jalapenos (optional)
1/2  c. diced black olives (optional)
preparation: Drain and rinse beans.  Mix beans, dressing, tomatoes and onion; do not mix Fritos in until ready to serve.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  boiled, deboned chicken breasts
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm cornbread dressing
1  can undiluted cream of celery or mushroom soup*
1  can undiluted cream of chicken soup
preparation: Layer chicken, 1/2 of dressing and cream of celery/mushroom soup in a medium sized, greased casserole dish.  Repeat layers using cream of chicken soup.  Pour 1 soup can of water over tops and sides of casserole.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes or until bubbly.  This can be prepared ahead of time and baked just before serving.

name: CORNBREAD
ingredients:
3  c. Bisquick
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  c. butter or margarine, melted
1 1/2  c. milk
3/4  Tbsp. baking powder
6  Tbsp. yellow cornmeal
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour in 9 x 13 pan.  Place in oven and bake at 350 for 35-45 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1/2  c. Carnation milk
2  Tbsp. oleo
1  c. marshmallows
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. peanut butter
preparation: Cook sugar, milk and butter to soft boil stage.  Stir in marshmallows until melted.  Add peanut butter and vanilla; beat 1 minute.  Pour into a buttered pan; cool.  Cut into squares.

name: SWEDISH MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. ground pork
1/2  c. minced onion
3/4  c. Italian bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. minced parsley
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. salt
pinch of black pepper
3/4  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix first 10 ingredients together.  Make balls.  Brown in 1/2 cup vegetable oil.  Remove meatballs and keep oil.  Mix flour, paprika, salt and black pepper.  Add sour cream.  Add this mix to oil.  Return balls to gravy and cook in oven 15 to 20 minutes.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. sweet potatoes, mashed
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sweet milk
preparation: Beat together with mixer and spread in pan.

name: BUTTERNUT SPREAD(Traditional)
ingredients: butternuts
preparation: Gather a quantity of butternuts.  Crack nuts and separate meats from shells.   Grind nuts to paste.  Traditionally, this was done on the grinding stone in much the way as corn was ground. Spread is eaten with bread or corn cakes.

name: Layered Salad
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
2  stalks celery, chopped fine
1/3  purple onion, sliced thin and quartered
1/2  pkg. bacon, fried crisp
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Break lettuce in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Layer celery and layer onion.  Mix the sour cream, sugar, mayonnaise and vinegar.  Pour over the layers, then crumble bacon over.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Cover tightly and refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.

name: BAKED APPLES
ingredients:
3  good cooking apples
1/2  c. sugar
1 heaping  Tbsp. flour
1  c. water
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cut apples in half and core.  Place in baking dish.  Mix sugar, flour and cinnamon and mix with water and pour over apples. Bake 1/2 hour at 350° or until soft.  Turn once to glaze if desired.  Serves 6.

name: MEAL ON KABOBS
ingredients:
2  c. tomato juice
1/2  c. vinegar
1/4  c. prepared mustard
2  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  lb. beef sirloin steak, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
1/2  lb. mushroom caps
1  large green pepper, cut in 1-inch pieces
1  pt. cherry tomatoes
1/2  pineapple, cut into 1-inch pieces
preparation: Mix tomato juice, vinegar and seasonings.  Place meat in shallow glass dish; pour tomato juice mixture over meat.  Cover; refrigerate 2 hours.  Remove meat from marinade; reserve marinade. On 6 skewers, alternate meat, vegetables and pineapple.  Place on grill 4 inches from hot coals.  Cook for 12 to 15 minutes, turning and basting frequently with reserved marinade.  Serves 6.

name: CHINESE CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  c. rice
1/2  lb. chicken (breasts, thighs, legs)
1  pkg. chicken gravy
1  can chow mein noodles
16  oz. vegetables
1  c. reserved chicken broth
preparation: Remove skin from chicken.  Boil in water until done.  Cool. Tear into bite size pieces.  Prepare chicken gravy with reserved broth.  Place chicken pieces in gravy.  Prepare rice as per directions.  Heat vegetables.  Place rice on large serving plate. Top with vegetables and chicken gravy.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
12  bananas
8  eggs
8  c. flour
8  c. sugar
4  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mash 12 bananas with a fork.  Beat 8 eggs with a fork.  Put in first bowl and mix.  In second bowl put flour, sugar, salt and baking soda.  Add banana mixture to second bowl and stir well.  Put in a greased pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. corn meal
1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  can cream-style corn
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  to 4 chopped jalapeno peppers
2  eggs
2  c. Cheddar cheese (better with Velveeta)
1  c. drained corn
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix meal, flour, both corns, oil, peppers, eggs and milk. Blend very good until very smooth.  Pour 1/2 of batter in greased pan (preferably cast-iron skillet).  Sprinkle 1 1/2 cups cheese over batter.  Pour rest of batter over top.  Sprinkle rest of cheese (1/2 cup) on top of last batter.  Bake in 400° oven for 45 minutes.  Serve warm.

name: PORK CHOPS ITALIANO
ingredients:
4  shoulder pork chops (about 1-inch thick)
seasoned salt
1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms (optional)
1/2  clove garlic, sliced (optional)
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
pepper
1  Tbsp. salad oil
1  medium onion, chopped
2  large green peppers, cut in 3/4-inch strips
1/2  bay leaf
1/8  tsp. dried sage
preparation: About 1 3/4 hours before serving, trim pork chops of all excess fat; sprinkle with seasoned salt and pepper.  In large skillet, saute chops until well browned, draining fat as it collects; place chops in a large roasting pan or 2 1/2-quart casserole.  Arrange mushrooms around chops.  Start heating oven to 375°.  In a clean large skillet in salad oil, saute onion, garlic and green peppers until golden; add tomato sauce, 1 teaspoon seasoned salt, 1/8 teaspoon pepper, bay leaf, lemon juice and sage; simmer, covered, until vegetables are almost fork-tender. Pour sauce over chops and bake covered until pork chops are done, about 1 hour.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
6  large eggs
3  c. cake flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. soda
1  c. sour cream
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream Crisco and sugar thoroughly; add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add sifted dry ingredients gradually, beating well.  Add sour cream and flavoring; beat well. Grease and flour tube pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Do not open oven for the first hour.

name: HOAGIE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef, seasoned with salt and pepper to taste
6  medium potatoes
1  medium or large onion
1  can English peas
