1  pkg. onion gravy mix
preparation: Brown  ground  beef  until well done; drain excess fat. Peel potatoes  and slice into 1/4-inch thick slices; do onion the  same way.  After meat has cooked, pour into baking dish, layer potatoes on top, then onion rings;  pour English peas on top of this.  Take the package of onion gravy and mix with 3/4 cup  of hot water;  pour over entire casserole.  Cover; place in  350° oven for 30 minutes.  Can be cooked on top of stove. Place in saucepan and bring to a boil.  Turn down and let slow simmer until potatoes are done, do not stir.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage meat
8 to 10  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
3 1/2  c. biscuit mix
pinch of garlic powder
preparation: Mix  together;  roll  in  small balls.  Place on cookie sheet and bake in preheated oven at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, or until light brown.

name: PICKLED OKRA
ingredients:
2  lb. tender okra
5  cloves peeled garlic
1  qt. white vinegar
6  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. mustard seed
2  Tbsp. liquid crab boil
preparation: Wash okra and pack in 5 hot sterilized pint jars.  Put one clove of garlic in each jar.  Bring remaining ingredients to a boil.  Pour over okra and seal.  Keep several weeks before serving.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. sifted powdered sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  Tbsp. milk
1  envelope Dream Whip
1  (8 or 9-inch) graham cracker crust
preparation: Mix together ingredients and pour into pie crust.  Chill for 5 or 6 hours.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
4  eggs
2/3  c. water
2  c. pumpkin or 1 (16 oz.) can
1  c. oil
3 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  c. nuts or raisins
preparation: Put sugar and oil in mixer.  Mix at medium speed.  Add 4 eggs and mix well.  Add water and pumpkin and mix well.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Pour in 3 greased loaf pans and bake 1 hour at 350°.  Let cool before removing from pan.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  small bag coconut
1  c. pecans
1  yellow cake mix
2  cans Thank You Brand cherries
1  stick butter
1 small  can crushed pineapple (8 to 10 oz.)
preparation: In cake pan, layer cherries, pineapple, cake mix, butter, pecans and coconut.  Cook at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: COOKED SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1/3  c. vinegar
2/3  c. water
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Beat eggs; add sugar and flour.  Add vinegar, water and butter.  Bring to boil; cook until thick.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  baked cake mix sheet cake (yellow, white or use angel food cake)
4 (10 oz.)  pkg. strawberries
2 large  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
2 1/2  c. milk
1  c. sour cream
1 large  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix pudding, milk and sour cream.  In a punch bowl, layer cake, pudding and strawberries.  Top with Cool Whip.  (Make several layers for a pretty dessert.)

name: PANCAKE SYRUP
ingredients:
1  c. water
2 1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Put water and sugar in saucepan.  Stir until dissolved.  Cook about 5 minutes or until it coats the spoon.

name: PEACH CRISP
ingredients:
4  c. sliced peaches
3/4  c. sugar, divided
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. flour
1/2  c. butter or margarine
preparation: Toss peaches, 1/3 cup sugar and cinnamon in a large bowl. Spoon into a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish or a 9-inch deep dish pie plate. Set aside.

name: FROSTED ORANGE
ingredients:
1 small  can (6 oz.) frozen orange juice
1  c. water
1  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
1/2 to 1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put all ingredients into blender.  Fill remainder of blender with ice cubes.  Blend until ice is crushed and drink is frothy. Enjoy!

name: TACO STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
garlic powder
onion
2  cans tomato sauce
1  can hominy
2  cans chili beans
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch
1  can Ro-Tel
corn chips
Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger, onion and garlic powder together and drain. Mix the rest of ingredients together except chips and cheese in slow cooker and add hamburger.  Simmer for 30 minutes.  Serve in bowl with chips and cheese on top.

name: HOME-MADE BUTTERFINGERS
ingredients:
1  box Cheese Nips
peanut butter
chocolate bark
preparation: Spread peanut butter between Cheese Nips. Dip in melted chocolate and let cool on wax paper.

name: SAUSAGE AND EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter (1 stick)
1  lb. pork sausage
6  slices white bread, cubed
2  tsp. dried basil
1  tsp. dried dill
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
6  eggs
2  c. milk
preparation: Melt the butter in small pan and pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Brown the sausage; drain well and set aside.  Layer half the cubed bread in the buttered pan and sprinkle with half the basil, dill and cheese.  Then layer the rest of the bread cubes, herbs and cheese.  Sprinkle the sausage over all.  Beat eggs well.  Add milk. Pour over the contents of baking pan.  Bake in 350° oven for 1/2 hour or until set.  Cut into squares and serve.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  box rotini noodles, cooked and drained
1  c. chopped green onions
1  c. green peppers
1/2  lb. any kind of cheese, chopped in chunks
1  c. uncooked broccoli
1  bottle Zesty Italian dressing
4  tsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Combine ingredients and chill for an hour; then serve.

name: GINGERBREAD CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter, softened
1/3  c. light molasses
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. water
1  egg
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. cloves
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Combine all ingredients.  Beat at medium speed for 1 to 2 minutes.  Pour into greased 9-inch square baking pan.  Bake for 25 to 35 minutes or until toothpick placed in center remains clean.  Serve with whipped cream.

name: MEATLESS VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. celery
1  c. onion
1  c. carrots
1/2  c. green pepper
1  c. cabbage
1 1/2  c. tomato juice
4  c. water
salt and pepper
1/4  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. basil
1  Tbsp. parsley
1/2  c. cooked rice
preparation: Dice all vegetables very small.  Saute celery, onion, carrots and green pepper in butter for 15 minutes.  Add cabbage and cook 15 minutes longer.  Add remaining ingredients and cook 3 hours.

name: BEAN DIP
ingredients:
1 large  can refried beans
2 small  cans chili with beans
2 small  cans plain chili
4  cloves garlic, crushed
1  onion, chopped
2  cans Ortega green chili peppers, chopped
1 1/2  Tbsp. cumin seed, crushed
1  Tbsp. oregano
1  small block mild Cheddar cheese, grated (1/2 mixed into dip and 1/2 on top)
preparation: Mix all ingredients; put in baking dish.  Bake 35 minutes in a 350° oven.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: BETSY'S POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
1  gal. water
1  Tbsp. chicken base seasoning or 4 chicken bouillon
2  cans Cheddar cheese soup
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
1  lb. margarine
2  c. half and half cream
2 1/2  lb. potatoes, cubed
preparation: Bring water to boil; put potatoes in and chicken seasoning, pepper and salt.  Cook until 1/2 tender.  Add soup, simmer for 10 minutes.  While simmering, melt margarine; add flour to butter to make paste.  Add to potatoes.  Add milk; heat to serving temperature.  Do not boil.

name: ORANGE SLICE CANDY COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
2  Tbsp. orange juice
1  lb. orange slices, cut up
1  c. nuts
2  c. sifted powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add sugar and juice.  Sift flour with other dry ingredients, then add to egg mixture.  Then add remaining ingredients.  Mix well and pour into 8 x 16-inch pan.  Bake at 250° for 1 1/2 hours.  Cool and cut in squares, then roll in confectioners sugar.

name: HONEY DRESSING
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. each: dry mustard, paprika and celery seed
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. honey
5  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients except oil.  While processing, slowly add oil.

name: SEAFOOD QUICHE
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. white wine
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Monterey Jack cheese
7 1/2  oz. crabmeat (white)
1  c. cooked shrimp
1/2  c. chopped celery
preparation: Mix together with mixture and pour into unbaked frozen pastry shell.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Let cool a little before slicing.  Excellent to prepare ahead and freeze.

name: GLORIFIED ONIONS
ingredients:
5  large Vidalia or Spanish onions
1 1/2  c. white vinegar
1  c. sugar
2  c. water
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. celery salt
preparation: Slice onions extremely thin, then marinate overnight in large bowl with vinegar, sugar and water.  Drain and toss with mayonnaise and celery salt.  Serve with crackers or bagel chips as an appetizer.

name: TEXAS CRACKERS
ingredients:
1 (11 oz.)  box or bag oyster crackers
3/4  c. salad oil
dill weed
lemon pepper
garlic powder
Hidden Valley salad dressing mix (original)
preparation: Put crackers in a sealed container. Mix all ingredients and pour over crackers. Marinate overnight. Shake container or stir with spoon several times.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1  stick margarine
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
3  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix cake mix according to directions substituting milk for water.  Sprinkle coconut and pecans in pan.  Pour cake mix over coconut and pecans.  Melt cream cheese and margarine together.  Add sugar and vanilla.  Mix well (until easy to pour).  Pour over cake mix.  Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI AND CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
a bunch of broccoli
head of cauliflower
1  c. Mozzarella cheese, chopped in cubes
1  c. Cheddar cheese, small cubes
1 small  can sliced ripe olives
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Zesty Italian dressing
1  tomato
preparation: Mix all ingredients except tomato ahead of time.  When ready to serve, chop tomato into small pieces and add to salad.

name: CRAB SMASH
ingredients:
1  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
1 small  can fancy crabmeat
1  bottle cocktail sauce
1  pkg. Wheat Thins
preparation: Spread cream cheese 1/4-inch thick on platter.  Pour and spread cocktail sauce over top.  Drain crabmeat and separate with a fork.  Sprinkle crabmeat over top of cocktail sauce.  Surround with crackers.

name: DAIRY QUEEN ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2  envelopes Knox gelatine
1/2  c. cold water
4  c. whole milk
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
3  c. cream
preparation: Soak the gelatine in the cold water.  Heat the whole milk hot, but not boiling.  Remove from heat.  Add gelatine, sugar, vanilla and salt.  Cool, then add the cream.  Makes 1 gallon.

name: MICROWAVE TUNA STROGANOFF
ingredients:
2 (6 1/2 to 7 oz.)  cans tuna, drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms with liquid
cooked noodles
1/2  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Combine tuna, soup and mushrooms in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Heat on full power, 6 to 8 minutes, or until bubbling. Stir twice during heating.  Stir in sour cream.  Garnish with parsley if desired and serve over noodles.

name: SYBIL'S OLD FASHION RAISIN CAKE
ingredients:
1  box seedless raisins
5  c. plain flour
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
1/2  lb. margarine
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Add flour, soda and milk and mix, then add raisins by stirring. (Raisins should be soaked in hot water overnight, then drained well.)  Start to bake in cold oven.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 45 minutes.

name: CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
1  can chicken broth
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can Veg-All or peas and carrots
1  pkg. Bisquick
1  c. milk
preparation: Cook chicken; debone and put in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix all the soups and chicken broth together.   Drain the Veg-All and mix with the soup.  Pour this mixture over the chicken.  Mix the milk with 1 package of Bisquick and pour over the other ingredients.  Bake in oven at 350° for approximately 40 minutes or until brown.

name: SWEET CUCUMBER PICKLES
ingredients:
4  qt. sliced cucumbers
4  Tbsp. salt
4  Tbsp. alum
2 1/2  Tbsp. pickling spice
4  Tbsp. dry mustard
8  c. sugar
preparation: Put  sliced  cucumbers  in gallon jar.  Put salt, alum, mustard and  spices  (tied  in  bag)  in  jar.  Fill  jar with vinegar.  Put lid  on  jar and put in a paper bag and put in a dark place.  After  6  weeks, drain vinegar off.  Layer cucumbers with  8  cups  sugar.  Close  jar  and  put back in dark. Ready to eat  in  2  days.  No  need to seal.  May put some in small jar and chill in refrigerator.

name: CREAMED CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. Butter
3  Tbsp. Flour
1/3  c. Milk
1/2  tsp. Salt
1/8  tsp. Pepper
2  c. Cooked chicken, diced
2  oz. Mushrooms, sliced
1  Chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in
1  c. Boiling water
Hot cooked noodles
preparation: Melt the butter, blend in the flour until smooth. Gradually stir in bouillon, cook and stir until thickened and smooth.  Stir in milk, chicken, mushrooms, salt and pepper. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occassionally. Serve over noodles.

name: SWEET POTATO CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
3  oz. slab bacon
1  small onion
1/2  c. chopped sweet red pepper
1/2  c. chopped leek
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. marjoram
2  tsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  medium size sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch chunks
1  c. whole kernel corn
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can chicken broth
3  c. water
1/2  c. heavy cream
preparation: In saucepan, saute bacon over medium heat until crisp and brown.  Remove bacon and set aside.  Add onion, red pepper, leek, thyme, marjoram, salt and pepper to bacon drippings.  Saute 10 minutes.  Add sweet potato, corn, chicken broth and 2 1/2 cups water.  Cook until sweet potatoes are tender (20 minutes).  Mix cornstarch into remaining 1/2 cup water and stir into soup mixture. Heat soup to boiling, stirring constantly and cook until thickened. Reduce heat to low, stir in cream and reserved bacon; heat until bubbles appear.

name: SPICY MEAT LOAF AMERICANA
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. salad oil
1  large onion, diced
1  large green pepper, diced
1  large celery stalk, diced
1  garlic clove, minced
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
salt
2  slices white bread
2  lb. ground beef
1  egg
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
Worcestershire
hot pepper sauce (optional)
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
celery leaves (for garnish)
preparation: About 2 hours before serving, in 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat, in hot salad oil, cook onion, pepper, celery and garlic until vegetables are tender and lightly browned, stirring occasionally.  Remove 2 tablespoons vegetable mixture; reserve for garnish.  Into vegetables remaining in skillet, stir nutmeg and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt.   Cook 1 minute.  Remove skillet from heat.

name: POSSUM AND SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
1  possum
salt and pepper
6  large sweet potatoes
preparation: Fatten possum for 2 weeks on cornbread and buttermilk.  Kill and clean possum.  Boil possum 30 minutes in salt water.  Boil sweet potatoes; cut in halves.  Place possum in baking dish; put sweet potatoes around possum.  Season with salt and pepper.  Bake uncovered at 400° for 1 hour or until golden brown.  Baste with natural juices.   Best served with turnip greens and biscuits.

name: POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
1 (32 oz.)  pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
1  (16 oz.) container sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  onion, chopped
cracker crumbs
preparation: Mix the first 5 ingredients together.  Spoon into a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle crumbs on top.  Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1  c. soft margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
3  c. flour
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. milk
cinnamon sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients except cinnamon sugar.  Place by teaspoons onto lightly greased cookie sheet.  Sprinkle before baking with cinnamon sugar.  Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Store in an airtight container.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: OLD-TIME BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
1/2  c. butter
2  c. sugar
3 rounded  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
3  large eggs, beaten
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of nutmeg (optional)
preparation: Have butter soft; add sugar.  Cream together well.  Add flour and  eggs;  beat well.  Stir in buttermilk, vanilla and nutmeg. Pour in unbaked pie shell.  Bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 350°. Place  on  wire rack to cool completely before serving.

name: MEATBALLS AND GRAVY
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
3  Tbsp. instant minced onion
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
2  eggs
flour
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  c. beef bouillon
1  bay leaf
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients lightly but thoroughly.  Shape in 2-inch balls and roll in flour.  Brown on all sides in margarine. Add 1 1/2 cups bouillon and bay leaf.  Bring to a boil, cover and simmer 1/2 hour.  Mix 1/4 cup flour with remaining bouillon until smooth.  Stir into mixture and cook, stirring gently until thickened.  Serves 6.

name: CHERRY JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  box cherry Jell-O
1  c. hot water
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Mix 1 cup hot water with Jell-O.  Add the pie filling.  Mix. Before Jell-O sets up completely, add 1 small carton Cool Whip.

name: CINNAMON BARS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. butter
2  egg yolks
2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  egg whites
chopped nuts
1/2  c. (1 stick) butter or margarine
3  Tbsp. 10x confectioners powdered sugar
1  c. sifted flour
1  c. finely chopped pecans
10x confectioners powdered sugar
preparation: Cream butter or margarine and 3 tablespoons 10x sugar until fluffy in medium-size bowl; stir in flour gradually, then pecans until well blended.  Chill several hours or until firm enough to handle.  Roll dough, a teaspoonful at a time, into marble-size balls between palms of hands; place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets.  Bake in slow oven at 325° for 20 minutes or until lightly golden.  Cool on cookie sheets 5 minutes; remove carefully.  Roll in 10x sugar in pie plate while still warm to make a generous white coating; cool completely on wire racks. Store with waxed paper or transparent wrap between layers in container with tight-fitting cover.  Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

name: TEXAS BARBECUE
ingredients:
4  lb. chuck roast
1  large onion
2  cloves garlic
4  Tbsp. butter
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 small  can tomato sauce
4  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
6  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. paprika
1  tsp. black pepper
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook roast in water.  Saute onion, garlic and butter.  Add and cook together all other ingredients.  Add roast that has been cooked and cut fine.  Mix thoroughly.

name: SALMON PATTIES
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can salmon with juice, boned and flaked
2  Tbsp. self-rising flour
1  egg, beaten
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Fry in frying pan until golden brown.

name: SPINACH-ARTICHOKE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1 large  can artichokes
1  pt. sour cream
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
salt
pepper
preparation: Cook spinach as directed.  Drain.  Saute onion in butter.  Mix all ingredients together in casserole dish.  Stir Parmesan cheese into casserole and also sprinkle on top.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: ICEBOX FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
2 (12 oz.)  boxes Nilla Wafers
2 (8 oz.)  bottles maraschino cherries
2  c. pecans
1  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Grind	or  grate  wafers,  cherries  and  pecans.  Add sweetened  condensed  milk	and  enough  cherry  juice to make mixture moist  enough  to  mix and pack into waxed paper lined bowl.  Mix	well.  Press  in  bowl.  Place in refrigerator for about 24  hours.  Turn  out  on  plate  and serve.	Return any leftover to refrigerator.

name: ENDIVE SALAD(Serves 2)
ingredients:
2  (3-inch) Belgian endive
2 to 3  Tbsp. crumbled Bleu cheese
2 to 3  Tbsp. chopped walnuts
1/4  c. wine vinegar
3/4  c. oil
1  tsp. Dijon mustard
salt and pepper
preparation: On individual salad plates, place chopped endive (leave some rounds).  Sprinkle with Bleu cheese and chopped walnuts.

name: ROAST OR BEEF DINNER
ingredients:
2  lb. stew beef or cut up roast
2  medium size onions
2  c. potatoes
2  c. carrots
2  c. celery
3  c. V-8 juice
5  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bake in covered Dutch oven at 250° for 5 hours.

name: FRIED PIES
ingredients:
1  lb. dried apples
3/4  c. sugar
4  c. water
cinnamon and nutmeg to taste
plain biscuit dough
preparation: Cook  apples  and  water  over  low heat until done and thick. Add  sugar  and spices.  Roll biscuit dough thin.  Cut into  5 inch  rounds.  Place  a dab of dried fruit filling on each  round and  fold over and crimp to seal.  Fry in hot oil until crisp and brown.  Drain on paper towels.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/4  c. margarine, softened
1/4  c. shortening
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. quick cooking oatmeal
1  c. raisins or chopped nuts
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Mix the first 6 ingredients, then stir in the flour, baking soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon, oats and nuts or raisins.  Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake for about 10 minutes, until light brown. Remove from cookie sheet immediately.  Cool on waxed paper.

name: SAUSAGE PINWHEELS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. cornmeal
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  lb. bulk pork sausage, softened
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine flour, baking powder, salt and cornmeal; stir in milk and oil.  Divide dough into 3 equal portions.  Roll each into 12 x 9-inch rectangle.  Spread 1/3 of sausage over dough and top with 1/3 cup cheese.  Roll up jellyroll fashion, beginning with long side; pinch seam and ends to seal.  Wrap in wax paper and chill until firm.  Repeat with remaining ingredients.  Cut rolls into 1/4-inch slices; place on ungreased mesh wire racks or baking sheets.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Yield: 5 dozen.

name: HAM SPREAD
ingredients:
12  oz. ham, finely chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix (dry)
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Mold  on  plate  and  chill. Serve with crackers.

name: OLD KENTUCKY APPLE PECAN CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. Wesson oil
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
3  c. thinly chopped or sliced apples
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together oil, sugar and eggs.  Sift together flour, salt and soda.  Add to wet mixture.  Fold in pecans and chopped apples. Add vanilla.  Start in cold oven.  Set oven at 325° and bake 1 hour.  Pour frosting over hot cake.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP SHEET CAKE WITH ICING
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
4  eggs (1 at a time)
1  c. plain flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (16 oz.)  can chocolate syrup
preparation: Mix all together, and then add eggs.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350°.  Cool cake slightly, and pour icing over cake in pan.

name: APPLE CINNAMON MUFFINS
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. oat bran cereal
1 1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. skim milk
2  egg whites
2  Tbsp. oil
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/4  c. raisins
3/4  c. frozen apple juice concentrate
1  medium apple, cored and chopped
preparation: Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl.  Mix the milk, apple juice concentrate, egg whites and oil in bowl or blender.  Add to dry ingredients and mix.  Add chopped apples, nuts and raisins.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. shredded zucchini
1  tsp. salt
4  eggs, beaten
1  c. Bisquick
1  c. grated cheese
2  tsp. chopped onion
parsley (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients except cheese together.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE-NUT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. (1 layer size) devil's food cake mix
1 (8 oz.)  carton dairy sour cream
1/2  c. coarsely chopped walnuts
1/2  c. peanut butter flavored pieces or semi-sweet chocolate pieces
preparation: In  a mixing bowl, beat cake mix and sour cream with an electric  mixer  on  medium  to  high speed about 2 minutes or until  smooth and creamy, scraping sides of bowl occasionally. Stir  in  peanut  butter  pieces or chocolate pieces and nuts. Drop dough from a rounded teaspoon 2 inches apart on a greased cookie  sheet.  Bake  in  a  350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until  tops  look  dry.  Cool  on  cookie  sheet for 1 minute. Remove cookie and cool on wire rack.  Makes about 36.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. Oreos, crushed and set aside
1  stick margarine, softened
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. powdered sugar
3 1/2  c. cold milk
2 regular size  pkg. instant French vanilla pudding
1  (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
preparation: You will need an 8-inch diameter flowerpot, a small hand shovel and artificial flowers.  Plug holes of flowerpot.  Grease inside of flowerpot with margarine.

name: ADAM'S BACHELOR SPECIAL
ingredients:
6  oz. macaroni and cheese box mix
1 small  can tuna, drained
1  can whole corn, drained
1 medium chopped onion or 2  Tbsp. minced onion
preparation: Prepare macaroni and cheese according to directions on box. Add other ingredients and stir well.  May be baked in 350° oven or eaten as is.

name: CHOCOLATE SNOWBALLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. (9 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, cut into small pieces
1 1/2  c. finely ground chocolate wafer cookies (about 64) or 1 Oreo cookie crumb crust (ready made)
1  c. finely ground pecans
powdered sugar to roll cookies in
preparation: In a large saucepan, melt chocolate chips over low heat, stirring constantly.  Add cream cheese and vanilla.  Stir until smooth.  Stir in pecans and cookie crumbs.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Roll in powdered sugar.  Cover and refrigerate until firm (about 2 hours).  Roll in powdered sugar again.  Store in airtight container in the refrigerator or freezer.  Yields about 6 dozen snowballs.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  pkg. (8 oz. each) cream cheese, softened
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
1 (8 1/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  Tbsp. chopped green onion
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
3/4  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Thoroughly blend cream cheese.  Fold in pineapple, onion and Worcestershire sauce.  Chill several hours.  Divide in half. Shape into balls; roll in nuts.  Chill overnight.  Serve with crackers.  Make ahead and freeze, if desired, 2 cheese balls (1 pound each).

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. oil
1  c. shortening
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1  c. quick oatmeal
1  c. coconut
1  c. Rice Krispies
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
3 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Cream shortening, oil and sugar.  Add egg and beat well.  Add oatmeal, vanilla, coconut and Rice Krispies.  Add flour, soda, cream of tartar and salt.  Put in refrigerator until the dough is firm.  Roll in balls the size of a walnut.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned, in 350° oven.  Makes 90 cookies.

name: PAN DE ELOTE
ingredients:
1  lb. can cream corn
1 1/2  c. Bisquick
2  Tbsp. sugar
2/3  c. milk
4-oz. can green chiles, chopped
1  egg
2  Tbsp. melted butter
8-oz. sliced Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Mix corn, bisquick, sugar, milk and butter.  Stir to remove lumps.  Pour 1/2 batter into a greased 8 x 8 pan.  Top with green chiles and lay cheese slices on top.  Pour rest of batter over all.  Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until top is brown.

name: FRESH FRUIT PIE(Strawberry, Peach, Berry)
ingredients:
1  qt. sliced fruit
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
1/4  c. water
1  (9-inch) pie shell
preparation: Mix fruit, sugar and lemon juice.  Set until all sugar is dissolved.  Measure out 1/4 cup of mixture and 1/4 cup water.  Add 1 envelope of unflavored gelatin.  Boil.  Pour over fruit and set in refrigerator until lightly jelled.  Pour into a 9-inch pie shell and cool completely until completely jelled.  Serve with whipped cream.

name: FRUIT SALAD (FIVE CUP SALAD)
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  c. pineapple chunks
1  c. mandarin oranges
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. shredded coconut
1  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients  together.  Chill  3  to 4 hours. Makes 6 servings.

name: CHICKEN AND WILD RICE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  box original long grain wild rice
1  stick oleo
1  can milk
6  boneless, skinless chicken breasts
mozzarella and parmesan cheese mixture
preparation: Mix soups together with rice, oleo, and can of milk.  Heat until warm.  Pour half into 9 x 13 baking dish.  On top put chicken breast, then rest of mixture.  Sprinkle with small amount of cheese.  Bake at 275° for 2 1/2 hours.   Serves 8.

name: APPLE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1 3/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. shortening
1  beaten egg
1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. grated apple
preparation: Cut shortening in dry ingredients.  Mix egg, milk and apple; add all at once to dry ingredients.  Mix well.  Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes* or until golden brown.  Remove immediately, roll in 1/2 cup melted butter, then in mixture of 1/2 cup of sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.  Serve warm.

name: BREAKFAST PASTRY
ingredients:
2  puff pastry sheets
8  eggs
3  handfuls fresh baby leaf spinach
8  oz. thin sliced deli ham
salt and pepper
8  oz. Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Preheat your oven to 400°. Roll out puff pastry sheets. Softly scramble 7 eggs and place in center of pastry. Wilt spinach and layer on top of eggs. Continue with ham and then shredded Monterey Jack cheese. Top with second sheet of puff pastry. Seal edges with an egg wash and brush top with egg wash. Cook until golden brown on sheet pan.

name: JUICY CHICKEN
ingredients:
3  c. Cheerios cereal, finely crushed
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2 1/2 to 3  lb. fryer/broiler chicken, cut up
1/2  c. evaporated milk
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter, melted
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Line 13 x 9 x 2-inch rectangular pan with aluminum foil.  Mix cereal, salt and pepper.  Dip chicken into milk, then roll in cereal mixture until well coated.  Place chicken, skin side up in pan.  Drizzle with melted margarine.  Bake until chicken is done, about 1 hour.  Do not turn chicken.  Makes 4 servings.

name: LEMON CARROTS
ingredients:
1  lb. medium carrots
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. salt*
preparation: *Salt is to individual tastes; can omit completely.

name: SALMON PATTIES
ingredients:
1  c. bread crumbs, cracker crumbs or crushed cornflakes
salt to taste
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. paprika
few grains garlic salt
small onion, diced
preparation: Combine all ingredients; fry in hot skillet, dropping by spoonfuls in hot grease, turning when brown.

name: VEGETABLE CHEESE CAZUELA(Serves 8)
ingredients:
1  can tomato sauce
1 (8 oz.)  bottle mild taco sauce
1 (1 1/4 oz.)  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1  c. water
1/2  c. sour cream
1 (16 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
8  oz. medium egg noodles, cooked and drained
2  c. shredded Jack cheese
preparation: In saucepan, combine tomato sauce, taco sauce, taco seasoning and water.  Bring to boil, stirring constantly.  In small bowl, combine sour cream and cottage cheese.

name: PINEAPPLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. white sugar
1  c. crushed pineapple with juice
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream the shortening and sugar.  Add eggs.  Add pineapple and vanilla.  Sift flour, baking powder, soda and salt; add to creamed mixture.  Add nuts.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake 10 minutes or until done at 375°.

name: WILD RICE SIDE DISH
ingredients:
1  c. wild rice (6 oz.)
4  c. water
3  to 4 chicken bouillon cubes
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. sliced celery (across grain)
1  c. fresh sliced mushrooms (domestic, exotic or wild)
preparation: Rinse rice thoroughly in a strainer.  Combine wild rice, water and chicken bouillon cubes in a heavy 3-quart saucepan.  Bring to boil.  Reduce heat to low boil; cover loosely and cook 45 to 60 minutes, or until rice has puffed and most of liquid has absorbed. Remove from heat.  Fluff rice with fork; cover tightly and let stand for 5 minutes.  Drain off excess water.  In separate pan, melt butter and saute onion, celery and mushrooms.  Combine cooked rice with saute mix.  Salt or spice to taste.

name: TEX MEX CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  large chicken breasts
2  c. cream of mushroom soup
16  oz. low-fat sour cream
3  cans green Old El Paso chopped chilies
tortilla chips
Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Butter bottom of casserole dish.  Layer with tortilla chips. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.  Pour in mixture.  Top with chips and cheese.  Bake until it bubbles around sides.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Serve over rice.

name: LEMON CHESS PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  stick melted butter
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
pie crust
preparation: Mix ingredients and pour in unbaked pie crust.  Bake until done (approximately 30 minutes) at 350°.

name: UNCOOKED OZARK RELISH
ingredients:
4  green peppers
4  large onions
4  sweet red peppers
4  c. cabbage
2  Tbsp. salt
4  c. sugar
4  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. mixed pickling spices
4  Tbsp. mustard seed
1  c. water
1  c. cider vinegar
2  c. sugar
3 inches  stick cinnamon
8 whole  cloves (without heads)
preparation: Tie the spices in a bag and place in the pan with the other ingredients.  Boil for 5 minutes and then add the rind.  Boil for 30 minutes or longer, if you want the melon more like preserves. Remove the spice bag.  Put the melon pieces in sterilized jars and cover with the boiling vinegar mixture.  Seal.

name: HOT FUDGE PUDDING(Old Family Favorite)
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. water
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix Bisquick and sugar (white) together.  Add milk and mix. Spread in 2-quart baking dish (rectangular).  Spread brown sugar over batter.  Melt chocolate chips and pour over batter.  Bake 40 minutes at 350°.  Good plain, but great with vanilla ice cream. Cut into squares to serve, making sure you get the bottom sauce with each piece.

name: ORANGE SHERBET SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. orange jello
1  c. boiling water
1  pt. orange sherbet
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  can mandarin oranges, drained and cut in bite-sized pieces
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Prepare orange pieces and drain pineapple.  Set aside. Dissolve the jello in boiling water.  Add sherbet and stir until dissolved.  Fold in the Cool Whip and mix well.  Add the pineapple and orange pieces.  Mix well and pour into a glass dish or mold and chill until firm.

name: WEDDING BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. plain flour
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped pecans
1  c. butter or margarine
preparation: Combine all ingredients together; mix well.  Shape into small balls;  dough  will  be  slightly  crumbly.  Place  on ungreased cookie  sheet.  Bake  at 325° for 18 minutes.  Cool for 5 minutes; roll in powdered sugar.  Yields about 3 dozen.

name: CHEESE FONDUE
ingredients:
1  c. cream of shrimp soup
1/2  c. milk
2  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1  Tbsp. cooking sherry
2  Tbsp. garlic
2  tsp. minced onion
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. chives
1  loaf Italian bread, cut into 1-inch cubes
4-6 apples, cut into cubes or wedges
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except bread cubes.  Cook slow over low heat until cheese is melted.

name: COMPANY SALAD
ingredients:
2  boxes lemon jello
3  c. boiling water
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple, drained
3  bananas, cubed
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Cool.  Add bananas, marshmallows and pineapple.  Chill until firm.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  German chocolate cake mix (mix as directed)
3/4  c. butter
1  c. chocolate chips
1  (14 oz.) bag caramel cubes
1/2  c. Pet milk
1  c. pecans
preparation: Grease and flour a large pan, 11 x 19-inch.  Mix and cook 1/2 of the cake batter for about 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, melt the caramel, butter and milk in a double boiler or microwave.  When smooth, pour over finished cake.  Cover with a layer of pecans (I chop them, but you don't have to), then chocolate chips.  Cover with remaining cake mix and cook for 20 minutes or maybe a little longer.  It is done when an inserted toothpick comes out with only caramel on it.

name: APPLE COFFEECAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1 2/3  c. applesauce
3  eggs
preparation: Blend the sugar and cinnamon.  Grease a 10-inch Bundt pan and dust with 1 tablespoon of cinnamon-sugar mixture.  Blend cake mix with applesauce and eggs.  Beat well.  Reserve 1 1/2 cups batter and pour remaining in pan.  Sprinkle sugar mixture over batter in pan, then pour in remaining batter.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.  Cool in pan for 15 minutes.

name: POTATO-CLAM SOUP
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes
2  large onions
1/2  Tbsp. salt
1/2  lb. bacon
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/2  Tbsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/2  Tbsp. pepper
2  c. milk
8  oz. cream cheese
2  cans minced clams
preparation: Dice the potatoes and onions.  Volume-wise, make 1/2 volume of onions versus the potatoes.  Cook onions in oil until there are no crunchies, then add the remainder of the spices.  Simmer for 3 1/2 minutes.  Cover the potatoes with water; boil until semi-soft. Cook the bacon until it is thoroughly done, but not crisp.  Add the onion mixture to the potato pot.  This will seem like too much for the water.  It is, so now cut the temperature down so the water is not boiling.  Add the 2 cups of milk and clams; fold in the cream cheese.  The consistency should be about right.  If it is too loose, mix some flour and water in the mixer and add to suit your personal needs.

name: GLAZED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  pork chops
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Marinate pork chops 2 hours, turning once.  Grill.

name: CATALINA DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. vinegar
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. pepper
4  Tbsp. grated onion
1  tsp. celery seed
2  tsp. paprika
2  tsp. dry mustard
3  c. Crisco oil
1  can tomato soup
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients together with mixer not blender.  Let stand 24 hours before using to blend flavors.  Will keep for up to a week in refrigerator.

name: CHEESE COOKIES(Appetizer)
ingredients:
2  c. soft butter/margarine
2  c. grated cheese
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Knead together.  Roll into hands into round balls.  Put on ungreased cookie sheet.  Press down with fork dipped in flour to make flat cookies.  Bake 15 minutes at 350°.

name: HOT DOG RELISH
ingredients:
4  c. onions
4  c. cabbage
4  c. green tomatoes
12  green peppers
6  red peppers (for color)
1/2  c. salt
6  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. celery seed
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
1 1/2  tsp. turmeric
4  c. vinegar
2  c. water
preparation: Grind vegetables coarsely.  Add salt and let set overnight. Rinse and drain.  Combine remaining ingredients and pour over vegetable mixture.  Heat to boiling and simmer for 3 minutes. Seal in hot, sterilized jars.  May substitute cucumbers for cabbage or tomatoes.  Makes 8 pints.

name: GROUND BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
2  c. noodles, cooked
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
1  can cream of celery soup
1  egg
1  c. cheese, cut up
preparation: Brown onion and beef.  Cook noodles until tender.  Put all ingredients together in casserole dish.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: CHEESE BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. biscuit mix
2/3  c. finely shredded cheese
1/2  c. water
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl, stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened.  Turn dough out onto a well floured surface and knead 15 to 20 times.  Pat dough to 1/2-inch thickness.  Cut with a 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter.  Place biscuits on a lightly greased baking sheet.  Bake at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.  Yield: 1/2 dozen.

name: FLUFFY FROSTING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1/4  c. water
1  beaten egg white
6  big marshmallows
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil for 1 minute the sugar, cream of tartar and water.  Beat egg white.  Add cooked mixture and marshmallows.  Beat until it forms peaks.  Add vanilla.  Frosts 1 (9 x 13-inch) cake or 30 cupcakes.

name: MAPLE BLENDED BUTTER
ingredients:
1  c. softened butter
1/8  tsp. salt
2  c. maple blended syrup, warmed
preparation: Cream butter and salt with electric mixer.  Add syrup 1 tablespoon at a time, beating after each addition until thoroughly blended.  Serve on waffles, toast, biscuits, muffins or gingerbread.  Makes about 3 cups butter.

name: WASSAIL
ingredients:
2  qt. apple cranberry juice
1  gal. apple cider
1 (6 oz.)  can orange juice concentrate
1/2  bottle ReaLemon
brown sugar to taste
2  Tbsp. whole cloves
cinnamon
peel of 2 small apples
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Let simmer on low for several hours in advance of serving time.  Continue simmering and serve hot on demand.

name: SCHUBERT'S CRANBERRY SHERBET
ingredients:
4  c. cranberries
3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  c. milk
1  c. cream
1/2  c. finely chopped black walnuts
preparation: Cook cranberries in 2 cups water for 10 minutes, or until berries pop.  Press through sieve.  Combine cranberry juice, sugar and lemon juice; stir in milk.  Add walnuts.  Place in freezer. Freeze until firm, stirring occasionally.

name: SCALLOPED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. coleslaw blend (chopped cabbage)
2  Tbsp. water
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. crushed cheese flavored crackers
preparation: Cook cabbage in oil in skillet until it starts to wilt.  Add water; cover and simmer on low 5 to 8 minutes.  Stir in soup. Warm through.  Top with cracker crumbs.  Can be put under broiler to toast crumbs.

name: POPPY SEED CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs
2 1/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/8  c. oleo or oil
1 1/2  tsp. almond extract
1 1/2  tsp. (or 1 Tbsp.) poppy seed
1 1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. concentrated orange juice (before mixing)
preparation: Mix ingredients and pour into 3 greased loaf pans or one greased tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 55 minutes (longer for tube pan).

name: SANDRA'S SAUCY APPETIZER FRANKS(Microwave)
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  bottle chili sauce
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. bourbon (if you like)
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1  lb. franks, cut in 3/4-inch slices or cocktail wieners
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on High for 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until hot.  Stir in franks.  Cover and cook 4 to 5 minutes on High, stirring once.

name: PINA COLADA FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1  box instant coconut pudding
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Put in food processor or blender for 30 seconds. Let set overnight in refrigerator to let flavors blend. Dip your favorite fruits.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
2 (15 1/2 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/2  tsp. salt
1  lb. pkg. wide lasagna noodles
1  lb. Mozzarella or Monterey Jack cheese
1  c. cottage cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion. Drain. Add tomato sauce, water and seasonings.  In oblong pan, layer sauce, noodles and cheeses. Repeat layers, ending with sauce.  Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

name: CHOCOLATE MINT COOKIES(Jets)
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. water
2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
10  oz. Andes creme de menthe candies
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
1 1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Baking Temperature: 350°.  Baking Time: 8 to 10 minutes.

name: PEANUT CLUSTERS
ingredients:
6  sq. almond bark
12  oz. chocolate chips
Spanish salted peanuts (2 or more c.)
preparation: Melt bark and chocolate chips in double boiler or in microwave.  When completely melted, add nuts and stir.  Spoon onto wax paper.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese
1 1/2  c. milk (can be skim)
1 small  pkg. instant pineapple cream pudding
preparation: Stir cream cheese until very soft.  Blend in 1/2 cup milk until smooth.  Add 1 cup more of milk and pudding mix.  Beat slowly with rotary beater 1 minute.  Pour at once into 9-inch crumb crust.  Chill at least 2 hours before serving.

name: CHICKEN AND DRESSING
ingredients:
Pepperidge Farm cornbread dressing mix
3  c. cooked chicken, cut up
1/2  c. oleo
1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
pepper
4  c. broth
6  eggs
celery and onion to taste
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Heat.

name: ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1  pkg. flour tortillas
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. dry Hidden Valley Ranch dip
preparation: Cream softened cream cheese and Ranch dip; spread on flour tortillas.  Starting at one corner, roll up and refrigerate enough to slice easy.  Serve with picante sauce.

name: KONNIE'S MILLION DOLLAR BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. butter (2 1/2 sticks)
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3  pkg. Nestle Choco-Bake
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  can coconut and nuts
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs and dry ingredients.  Stir in vanilla and Choco-Bake.  Add coconut and nuts.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Frost with Kim's Boiled Frosting.

name: 5 CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. mandarin oranges
1  c. coconut
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Mix well.  Put in refrigerator and let set 4 to 6 hours before serving.

name: DOUBLE CHOCOLATE BUNDT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  pkg. instant chocolate pudding (3 oz.)
6  oz. chocolate chips
1  oz. melted chocolate semi-sweet square
1  c. oil
1  c. sour cream
4  eggs or Egg Beaters
preparation: Mix all ingredients except chocolate chips.  Blend for 4 minutes, then let stand for 15 minutes.  Oil and flour Bundt pan. Pour half of the batter into the Bundt pan.  Sprinkle half the chocolate chips onto batter.  Pour on the remaining batter. Sprinkle with remaining chips.  Slightly press chips down into batter.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.  Let cool 15 minutes, then remove from pan.

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  egg
1 1/2  c. applesauce
1  c. raisins
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. allspice
preparation: Cream sugar and butter and add unbeaten egg.  Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with applesauce and raisins.  Bake in greased tube pan (or 2 loaf pans) at 350° for about one hour, (less if in loaf pans).

name: PEPPER CHICKEN FETTUCINI TOSS
ingredients:
1  pkg. fettucini
1/4  c. olive oil or vegetable oil
3  whole boneless chicken breasts
2  large red peppers
2  large yellow peppers
1  medium onion, cut in chunks
1  medium green pepper
2  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1  garlic
preparation: Heat oil.  Add chicken, peppers, onion, mushrooms and garlic. Cook and stir over medium heat until chicken is cooked, 8 to 12 minutes, or until vegetables are done.  Serve over fettucini.

name: CHEESY TATER TOPPER
ingredients:
1  c. skim milk
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. shredded American cheese
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, cooked and drained
4  medium baking potatoes (6 to 8 oz. each), baked*
preparation: In a small saucepan, stir together milk, cornstarch, mustard and pepper.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.  Add cheese, stirring until melted.  Stir in mixed vegetables and heat through.  Serve warm over baked potatoes.  Serves 4.

name: ANGEL PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  egg whites
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans, chopped
1  c. saltine cracker crumbs
preparation: Beat egg whites until frothy.  Add sugar gradually with vanilla.  Beat until mixture forms soft peaks.  Add cracker crumbs and pecans together.  Fold into egg white mixture.  Bake in 9-inch pan for 30 minutes at 325°.  Cool thoroughly.  Top with 1 1/2 boxes Cool Whip mixed according to directions on box.  Sprinkle with nuts and coconut, if desired.

name: HOG DOGS IN CROCK-POT
ingredients:
1  c. granulated sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
dash of garlic sauce
1  c. brown sugar
2  c. water
dash of Kitchen Bouquet
preparation: Combine 1 cup water with the Kitchen Bouquet sauce.  Bring all ingredients to boil and thicken.  Put in crock-pot with previously warmed hot dogs.  Add 1 to 2 cans drained pineapple chunks.  Warm all through entirely and keep hot dogs and pineapple under sauce to keep moist.

name: BROWNIES FOR THE CROWD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
8  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. vegetable oil or shortening
1/4  c. milk
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla flavoring
4  eggs
2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients. Stir in pecans. Bake in 9 x 13-inch dish at 350° until done.

name: MACARONI-SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. Creamettes noodles
1  lb. pork sausage, browned and drained
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
Velveeta cheese (the more, the creamier)
1/4 to 1/2  c. milk (as needed)
preparation: Boil noodles according to package directions.  Mix all ingredients together and pour into casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: EASY CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
1  lb. confectioners sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1  Tbsp. vanilla
4  Tbsp. milk
6  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. nutmeats
preparation: Mix the half cup nutmeats with the first 3 ingredients.  Heat to boiling the milk and margarine and pour over the sugar and cocoa mixture.  Mix well and put into a greased pan.  Cool.

name: COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1  large head cabbage, chopped
1  large onion, chopped
1  large bell pepper, chopped
1  carrot, grated
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. olive oil
1/2  c. white vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. celery seed
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Chop cabbage, onion, bell pepper and carrot. Add sugar and set aside. Boil 1/2 cup olive oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, celery seed and mustard until salt dissolves.  Cool and pour over cabbage mixture.

name: MOTHER'S RAISIN COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. white raisins
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. shortening
1  egg, well beaten
1/4  c. water (left from cooking raisins)
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cook white raisins in 1 1/2 cups water.  Cook until 1/2 cup water is left.  Sift flour.  Add soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt. Cream together sugar and shortening.  Add egg.  Add 1/4 cup water (left from cooking raisins) and nuts.  Add dry ingredients and mix well.  Spread on greased cookie sheet.  Bake 10 to 15 minutes in 350° oven.  Spread powdered sugar icing on cookies while still warm.  Cut into squares when cool.

name: NUTTY FINGERS
ingredients:
2/3  c. butter
1  c. ground pecans
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. cake flour
4  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Blend butter, nuts and vanilla until smooth; add flour and sugar gradually.  When thoroughly blended, shape dough into small finger-shaped cookies, place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 325° until lightly browned.  Roll in confectioners sugar while still hot.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk sausage
10  slices bread
6  eggs
2  c. milk
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown and drain sausage.  Remove crusts from bread and cut into cubes.

name: SHRIMP JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
2  c. rice, uncooked
1  bunch green onions, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
1/2  c. parsley, chopped
1/2  lb. sausage
1  can beef bouillon soup
1  can fresh onion soup
1  can tomato sauce
1  stick margarine
1  lb. raw shrimp
black pepper
1/2  capful liquid crab boil
preparation: Combine all ingredients and put into large casserole dish. Cover and bake 1 1/2 hour, stirring occasionally (every 15-20 minutes) in 350° oven.

name: LIME JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  box lime jello
2  c. marshmallows
1 small  can crushed pineapple (not drained)
1 1/2  c. boiling water
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. cottage cheese
1  c. whipped topping
preparation: Mix jello with water and add 1 cup marshmallows while hot. Set aside to cool.  Mix remaining ingredients and add to jello mixture.  Place in refrigerator to set.

name: POTATOES ROMANOFF
ingredients:
6  medium baking potatoes
2  c. sour cream
1  bunch green onions, chopped (approximately 1 c.)
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
paprika
preparation: Cook (boil) unpeeled potatoes until tender (20 to 25 minutes). Cool.  Peel.  Grate into a large bowl.  Add everything except paprika.  Place in casserole dish.  Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours or overnight.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
1-lb. frozen hash brown potatoes
1  c. chopped green onions
3  c. water
1 (10-oz.)  can cream of celery soup
1 (10-oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1 (14-oz.)  can chicken broth
2  c. milk
preparation: Combine potatoes, onions, chicken broth and water in a Dutch oven.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes.  Stir in soups and milk.  Heat thoroughly.

name: SELF-FILLED CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate cake mix
8  oz. softened cream cheese
1/3  c. sugar
1  egg
dash of salt
6  oz. semi-sweet chocolate pieces (1 c.)
preparation: Mix cake according to directions.  Fill paper muffin cups 2/3 full.  Cream sugar and cheese; beat in egg and salt.  Stir in chocolate pieces.  Drop one rounded teaspoonful of cheese mixture into each cupcake.  Bake as cake box directs for cupcakes.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
1  bar butter
1/4  c. Karo
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  bags micro popcorn
preparation: Cook to soft boil and pour over corn.

name: EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
bread slices, cubed
1  lb. sausage
grated cheese
6  eggs
2  c. milk
dry mustard
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Cube slices of bread to half fill a 12-inch Dutch oven. Brown a pound of sausage and crumble over bread.	Grate enough cheese to cover bread and sausage.  Mix 6 eggs and 2 cups milk with dry mustard to taste.  Pour over sausage and bread.  Mix 1 can of cream  of  mushroom  soup  with  1/2 cup of milk and spread over casserole.	Chill overnight.  Bake for 1 1/2 hours with 8 coals on top and 8 coals on bottom.

name: BOILED COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. cocoa (use less, if desired)
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring
2 1/2  c. oats
1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Place the first 4 ingredients in boiler and boil hard for 3 minutes.  Stir in peanut butter and vanilla flavoring.  Have ready the oats and nuts; pour into boiling mixture after it has boiled for 3 minutes and stir.  Remove from heat immediately and drop onto wax paper by teaspoonful.  Let cool.  These may seem sticky, but they will dry out.  Do not refrigerate.

name: ONE MEAL CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jiffy corn muffin mix
2  eggs
1/3  c. milk
1  lb. hamburger, browned
1  onion, chopped
1/2  c. finely chopped celery
1  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix Jiffy corn muffin mix, eggs and milk together.  Shred hamburger with fork into mix.  Add celery, onion and cheese and mix.  Pat batter into greased dish.  Bake in 400° oven for approximately 30 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE SQUARES
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
2  eggs, beaten
1 1/4  c. evaporated milk
3/4  c. water
1  c. salted cracker crumbs
preparation: Break up sausage while browning in skillet; pour off most of the fat.  Add beaten eggs to cooled sausage; add milk, water and crumbs.  Pour into greased baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until firm.  Cut in squares.

name: CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
diced onion
1  can minced clam
2  cans New England clam chowder
2  cans cream of potato soup
1  can evaporated milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In microwave-safe dish with lid, melt butter and onion.  Saut onion 2 to 3 minutes (time differs per microwave).  Add the remaining ingredients and return to microwave and cook 20 minutes, stirring twice.  Serve.

name: CHOCOLATE TRIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  stick butter or margarine
1/2  c. cocoa
dash of salt
1/2  c. milk
3  c. quick oats
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, butter, cocoa, salt and milk in large saucepan over medium heat to a boil.  Stir constantly.  Let boil one minute. Remove from heat and stir in quick oats, peanut butter and vanilla.  Mix well.

name: OYSTER DRESSING
ingredients:
7  slices bread, buttered and cubed
6  slices American cheese
2  cans oysters, drained (keep oyster liqueur)
2  eggs
milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Place half the bread in 9 x 13 Pyrex dish. Cover with cheese, then oysters. Top with remaining bread. Mix eggs and the oyster liqueur, then add enough milk to total 2 1/2 cups. Add salt and pepper. Pour liquid over the bread, cheese and oysters. Cover with foil and refrigerate 24 hours. Bake, covered, at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: ORANGE SUPREME CAKE
ingredients:
1  box orange supreme cake mix
1  box vanilla instant pudding
1  c. water
1/3  c. oil
4  eggs
preparation: Mix cake mix, pudding mix, water, oil and eggs together; blend until smooth.  Pour into a greased Bundt pan.  Bake at 350° until toothpick comes out clean.

name: CHEESE DANISH
ingredients:
2 (8 oz. each)  pkg. cream cheese
3  eggs, separated
1 1/2  c. sugar, divided
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2  (8 oz. each) tubes crescent roll dough
ground cinnamon
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Combine cheese, egg yolks, 3/4 cup sugar and vanilla in bowl. Mix with electric mixer on high until creamy, about 3 minutes. Set aside.  Unroll 1 package dough, evening in 13 x 9-inch pan, pressing down to close perforations.  Spread cheese mixture evenly on dough.  Unroll other package dough evenly over filling.  Whip egg whites with fork in small bowl until frothy; spread evenly atop dough.  Sprinkle with remaining 3/4 cup sugar, cinnamon for color and nuts.  Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Allow to cool and set; then slice into bars.  Makes 16 to 24 bars.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. oil
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. fine chopped red Delicious apples
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Beat together sugar, oil and eggs until fluffy.  On slow speed, add dry ingredients, then vanilla, apples and pecans.  Pour into greased and floured tube pan and bake at 275° for 30 minutes and at 300° for 1 hour.

name: EASY ENGLISH TRIFLE
ingredients:
1  pound cake, torn into chunks
1 small  carton whipping cream, whipped
1  pkg. frozen blueberries
1  pkg. frozen red raspberries
1  pkg. frozen sliced peaches
preparation: Drain fruits, reserving liquid.  (If too dry you can add a little of the reserved liquid.)  In a glass dish, arrange layers of the cake, large spoonfuls each of blueberries, raspberries, peaches and large dollops of whipped cream.  (Any frozen fruits may be substituted.)

name: DIVINITY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. water
1/8  tsp. salt
2  egg whites
1  tsp. powdered sugar
preparation: In saucepan, mix the sugar, syrup, water and salt.  Slowly bring to a boil, stirring, until sugar dissolves.  Cook to 50 on candy scale (in between soft and hard stage).  Beat egg whites until stiff.  Gradually pour hot syrup into whites, beating constantly.  Beat until candy begins to hold its shape.  Beat in vanilla and powdered sugar.  (This amount of powdered sugar makes a real improvement in texture.)  Drop from teaspoon onto waxed paper, or pour into buttered pan.  Let stand several minutes until firm.  Store in airtight container.  Makes 50 pieces.

name: VEAL GUISEPPE
ingredients:
1/4  c. olive oil
4  oz. cleaned nature veal
flour (for dredging)
1/2  can peeled plum tomatoes
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. garlic
1  pinch oregano
1  pinch basil
chicken broth
preparation: Heat oil in saucepan.  Dip veal in flour; place in oil when hot.  Saute until veal is white.  Drain oil and add remaining ingredients.  Bring to a boil and let simmer until sauce is thickened and serve.  Yield:  1 serving.

name: NEW ORLEANS' BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
3  c. milk
4  beaten eggs
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  lb. melted butter
24-inch day-old French bread, cut into 1/2-inch slices
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Note:  Optional 1 cup raisins added to custard mixture.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
1 large  can diced tomatoes
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
3  cloves garlic, minced
1  small purple onion, chopped
1  medium bell pepper, chopped
1/2  c. red wine vinegar
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1  can Mexican corn, rinsed
1  can black beans, rinsed
fresh cilantro to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients. Serve with chips. Refrigerate leftovers.

name: OATMEAL CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  c. oatmeal (quick Quaker)
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Pour water over oatmeal and set aside.  Cream shortening and add sugar, then add eggs, one at a time.  Add vanilla.  Whip up oatmeal mixture and add to cream mixture.  Add dry ingredients. Pour in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  When done, spread with topping.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
6  to 8 apples, peeled, cored and sliced
1/4 to 1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Put the apples in a shallow 2-quart baking dish.  Add water and lemon juice.  Mix flour, brown sugar and cinnamon in bowl. Cut butter into dry ingredients with pastry blender or two knives until crumbly.  Sprinkle over apples.   Bake at 375° for 30 minutes, or until apples are tender.

name: VIDALIA ONION PIE
ingredients:
9-inch pie crust
2  lb. Vidalia onions, thinly sliced
1  stick butter
3  large eggs, beaten
1  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
dash of hot sauce
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Roll out crust and place into pie pan.  Refrigerate.  Heat oven to 450°.  Saute onions in butter until crisp-tender.  Remove from heat.  Mix eggs and sour cream.  Stir in onions and seasonings.  Pour into crust and top with Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 450°  for 20 minutes.  Reduce heat to 325°  and continue baking for 20 more minutes until top and crust are golden.  Cool on wire rack and serve warm.  Good with roasted or grilled pork or poultry.

name: MOUNDS CAKE
ingredients:
1  box chocolate cake mix
1  c. milk
1  c. sugar
24  large marshmallows
14  oz. bag coconut
1  c. milk
14  oz. bag coconut
1  c. sugar
24  marshmallows
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
5  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Boil 1 minute.  Remove from heat, stir in 16 ounce bag semi-sweet chocolate chips until melted.  Spread over coconut mixture on cake.  Delicious.

name: LUSCIOUS CRAB DIP
ingredients:
12  oz. cream cheese
1  c. sour cream
1  c. Colby/Jack cheese
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon pepper
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  lb. imitation crab meat, shredded
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except crab, in a bowl.  Fold in crab. Put in small casserole dish.  Sprinkle on cheese.  Bake at 375° until bubbling, about 20 minutes.  Serve with crackers or French bread pieces.

name: DAD'S BROCCOLI AND BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. chopped broccoli
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  c. instant rice
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. onion powder
2  c. nonfat cottage cheese
1  c. reduced-fat or nonfat shredded Cheddar
1  can low-fat cream of mushroom soup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook broccoli just until tender; drain.  Fry beef until well done.  Rinse with hot water and drain again.  Add rice and seasonings.  Stir until mixed.  Put half of broccoli in the bottom of a 2-quart casserole dish.  Layer 1/2 of beef and rice, cottage cheese, rest of beef and rice and rest of broccoli.  Spread soup over top and sprinkle with the cheese.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CURRIED CHICKEN AND BROCCOLI
ingredients:
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. salad dressing or mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1  tsp. lemon juice
salt and pepper to taste
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli spears, cooked and chopped in large pieces
4  c. cooked chicken, cut in bite size pieces (4 chicken breasts)
1  can Durkee French fried onions
preparation: Combine chicken soup, salad dressing, curry powder, lemon juice, salt and pepper well.  Layer half the broccoli, chicken and soup mixture in a 2-quart casserole.  Repeat layers.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with onion rings and return to oven for 3 to 4 minutes until onions are hot.

name: CRANBERRY RELISH
ingredients:
1  lb. cranberries
1  orange
1  c. sugar
1  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. hot water
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. marshmallows, cut
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Grind the cranberries and orange.  Add the sugar and let stand overnight.  Dissolve the jello in the hot water.  Mix with cranberries, orange and sugar.  When starting to gel, add nuts, marshmallows, celery and salt together.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. salad oil
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
1 medium  can fruit cocktail
preparation: Beat together sugar, eggs and oil.  Add flour, salt, baking soda and fruit cocktail.  Beat cocktail in blender with juice. Then put cocktail in with other ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: JELLO PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
2  whole eggs
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  box vanilla wafers
1 large  can evaporated milk
preparation: Pour milk in bowl, place in freezer until ice crystals form. Mix sugar, Jell-O, eggs and pineapple.  Bring to a boil and set aside.  Beat milk until fluffy and fold in hot mixture.  Pour in 2 wafer crusts.

name: 7 LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
cut or torn lettuce
cut spinach
green onions, sliced or chopped red onion
sliced radishes
bite size pieces cauliflower, green peppers or broccoli
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen green peas, thawed but uncooked
Hellmann's mayonnaise
grated Parmesan cheese
cherry tomato halves (to decorate)
preparation: In a 9 x 12-inch casserole (round or flat), layer lettuce (1-inch deep) and remaining vegetables in order listed.  Spread mayonnaise over top.  Sprinkle freely with Parmesan cheese. Decorate as desired with cherry tomatoes.  Serves 8.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
3  mashed bananas
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
dash of salt
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well.   Mix in bananas, flour, soda and salt.   Grease pan; cook at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PASTA WITH CHICKEN AND TOMATOES
ingredients:
1  pkg. fettucine
2  lb. chicken, cubed
1  onion, chopped
1/4  c. sun-dried tomatoes
2  Tbsp. oil
1  tsp. fennel
2  carrots, cut in toothpick strips
preparation: Saute onion, tomatoes, carrots and fennel in oil.  Brown chicken.  Fold into each other.  Mix into prepared fettuccine. Enjoy.

name: SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, drained into pan
2  green bell peppers, cut up
1/4  c. cornstarch
1 3/4  c. water
3/4  c. white sugar
1/2  c. distilled white vinegar
10  drops red food coloring
8  skinless, boneless chicken, cut into 1-inch cubes
2 1/4  c. self-rising flour
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. white pepper
1  egg
2  c. water
preparation: In saucepan, combine 1 1/2 cups water, sugar, vinegar, reserved pineapple syrup and red food coloring.  Heat to a boil. Turn off heat.  Combine 1/4 cup cornstarch and 1/4 cup cold water; stir into saucepan until mixture thickens.	Combine flour, 2 tablespoons oil, 2 tablespoons cornstarch, salt, white pepper and egg.  Add chicken pieces and stir until chicken is well coated. Heat oil in skillet or wok to 360°F.  Fry chicken pieces in hot oil until golden brown.  Remove and drain on paper towels.	When ready to serve, layer green peppers, pineapple and chicken on a platter and pour sauce over the top.

name: TORTILLA SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  stick (4 Tbsp.) butter
1/2  c. oil
1  lg. onion
1  fresh jalapeno, seeded and chopped
4  garlic cloves, minced
2  lg. carrots, diced
6  ribs celery, diced
1  lb. boned, diced raw chicken
1  tsp each: ground cumin, chili powder, salt, and lemon pepper
3  tsp. bottled liquid hot red pepper sauce
1/2  c. flour
1 14-oz.  can tomatoes
4 (10 1/2-oz)  cans chicken broth or equivalent in homemade stock
3  corn tortillas, cut in strips
Garnishes: sour cream, avocado, grated cheese
preparation: Heat butter and oil in large kettle and sauté chopped onion, jalapeno, garlic, carrots, celery, and chicken.  Simmer 5 minutes. Combine with cumin, chili powder, salt, lemon pepper, pepper sauce, and flour.  Add tomatoes and chicken stock and simmer one hour.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box frozen broccoli
1  c. chopped onions
1  c. chopped celery
1  can cream of chicken or mushroom soup
1  can milk (from soup can)
salt and pepper to taste
1 (8 oz.)  can Cheez Whiz
3  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1  bag cooked Success rice
preparation: Saute onions and celery in margarine.  Salt broccoli; boil for 10 minutes in 1 cup water.  Remove broccoli; add it to onions and celery.  Add soup and milk.  Add cheese to this mixture; simmer for 1 minute.  Add rice.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: OREO CAKE
ingredients:
10  Oreos
1  white cake mix
1  large Cool Whip
1/4  c. oil
3  eggs
1/4  c. water
preparation: Mix the cake mix with the oil, eggs and water.  Crush 6 Oreos and put them into the cake mix.  Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.  Top with Cool Whip and add remaining crushed Oreos.

name: CRACKLING-SAUSAGE BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
5  c. flour
1  lb. cracklings
1  lb. sausage
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water.  Add 2 cups warm water, salt and pepper.  Stir in large bowl.  Add flour; turn out onto floured board.  Knead dough until it becomes semi-firm and will not stick to hands.  Put dough in bowl and rub 1 tablespoon oil over and around the dough so as not to form a crust.  Let rise 1 hour.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
2  sticks butter
5  eggs
2  c. sugar
2  c. self-rising flour, sifted
1  tsp. lemon flavor
preparation: Mix ingredients all together.  Grease and flour a tube pan. Pour mixture into pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: GRANDMA'S RICE PILAF
ingredients:
1  lb. regular long-grain rice
3  cans beef consomme soup
1  can mushroom stems and pieces
1  tsp. curry powder
1  tsp. salt
2  bunches green onion, sliced
preparation: Brown 1 pound rice in 1/4 pound margarine.  Add 3 cans beef consomme, 1 can mushroom stems and pieces, salt, curry powder and green onions.  Bake, uncovered, for 1/2 hour at 350°, then use as stuffing for turkey or bake, uncovered, for an additional 30 minutes or until done.

name: ORIENTAL COLE SLAW
ingredients:
2  c. shredded cabbage
6  green onions, chopped
1/4  c. slivered almonds
1/4  c. sunflower seeds
1  pkg. Ramen noodles (chicken flavor)
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. oil
pepper to taste
preparation: Mix oil, sugar, pepper and Ramen seasoning; let stand. Combine cabbage, onions, nuts and noodles.  Pour dressing over mixture and serve.

name: ROAST ALA "GRECQUE"
ingredients:
1  lb. onions
3 to 4  lb. beef pot roast (blade, round, rump or chuck)
2  Tbsp. paprika
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. fat
preparation: Cut off root ends and a thin slice from stem ends of onions. Peel and rinse; slice thinly and set aside.  Wipe meat with a damp cloth.  Coat evenly with a mixture of the paprika, salt and pepper.  Heat fat in saucepan or Dutch oven with a tight fitting cover.  Brown meat on all sides slowly over medium heat.  Lift meat.  Layer the onions into the pot and place meat over onions. Cover tightly.  Cook over low heat for about 3 hours or until meat is tender.  Makes a delicious gravy that is served over rice or mashed potatoes.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: CARTER EGGS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
2  eggs
dash of salt
2  Tbsp. milk
1/4  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Place 1 tablespoon of cooking oil in skillet.  Place skillet on stove eye on medium heat.  Beat two eggs well.  Add dash of salt and 2 tablespoons milk.  Add 1/4 cup shredded sharp Cheddar cheese.  Pour in hot skillet.  Do not stir until eggs puff up and appear to be done on bottom side.  Less stirring makes better eggs.  Serve with homemade biscuits only.

name: SQUASH PATTIES
ingredients:
4  c. cooked squash
1  medium onion
1  egg
enough flour to thicken
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Fry in frying pan, using cooking oil.  Brown on both sides.

name: MEXICAN PICKLES
ingredients:
1  c. vinegar
1  c. water
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. mustard seed
2  bay leaves
2  cloves garlic
2  drops olive oil
4  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Any vegetable that will pickle and stay firm such as carrots, cauliflower, cucumber, celery, green tomatoes, small onion, peppers (sweet or hot) or green beans.

name: ITALIAN CREAM CAKE AND FROSTING
ingredients:
1  stick butter
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. buttermilk
1 small  can coconut
5  egg whites, stiffly beaten
1/2  c. Crisco shortening
5  egg yolks
1  Tbsp. soda
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream the butter, Crisco and sugar. Beat until smooth. Add egg yolks; beat well.  Mix flour and soda.  Add to mixture.   Add buttermilk; stir in vanilla. Add coconut and pecans.  Fold in egg whites.  Pour in tube pan that has been greased and floured.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BAKED CHICKEN AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked Minute rice
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
3  lb. chicken breasts, boned
pepper to taste
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can chicken gumbo soup
3  c. water
margarine
preparation: Spread rice evenly in buttered casserole pan.  Sprinkle 1/4 of the dry onion soup on rice.  Place chicken on rice.  Sprinkle with remaining onion soup and pepper to taste.  Blend well the mushroom soup, chicken gumbo soup and water.   Pour over chicken and rice. Dot with margarine and cover with foil.  Bake 2 hours at 325°.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. Minute rice
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  tsp. powdered onion
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. butter
8  oz. jar Cheez Whiz
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Cook broccoli and drain.  Add all other ingredients and mix well.  Place in a greased casserole dish and bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.

name: SPICED SHRIMP
ingredients:
3  lb. shrimp
4  c. water
1  Tbsp. salt
1  pkg. shrimp spices or 1 1/2 Tbsp. mixed pickling spices
preparation: Put all ingredients in crock-pot.  Cover and cook on low 3 to 5 hours.

name: ITALIAN-STYLE POTATOES
ingredients:
1  pkg. Betty Crocker au gratin potatoes
2 1/4  c. boiling water
2/3  c. milk
1/3  c. pizza sauce
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese (2 oz.)
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  pkg. (3 1/2 oz. size) sliced pepperoni
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Mix potatoes, sauce mix and water in ungreased 2-quart round casserole; stir in milk.  Bake, uncovered, 30 to 35 minutes or until top is golden brown and potatoes are tender.

name: NUTS AND BOLTS
ingredients:
1 regular  box Rice Chex
1 regular  box Corn Chex
1 regular  box Cheerios
1 regular  box thin pretzels
6 to 8  c. pecans
4  sticks butter
3  tsp. garlic salt
3  tsp. onion salt
3  tsp. celery salt
3  tsp. Accent
3  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Melt butter and add spices.  Pour over cereal and pecans.  Mix well.  Bake for 2 hours at 200°.  Stir about every 20 minutes.

name: LEMON CRUNCH POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  c. Crisco
5  large eggs
2  tsp. lemon flavoring
2  c. cake flour, sifted 4 times
preparation: Cream sugar and Crisco together. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add flavoring, then flour, 1/2 cup at a time, beating after each addition. Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour at 350°.

name: FRIED CORN
ingredients:
5 to 6  ears fresh corn
1/2  c. water or milk
2  Tbsp. butter
salt to taste
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Cut corn from cob, scraping cobs to get the "milk." Place in skillet; add water, butter and sugar.  Simmer 30 minutes or until tender. Salt to taste.

name: MINT PUFFS
ingredients:
2  egg whites
3/4  c. sugar
2 to 3  drops green food coloring
10  oz. pkg. Nestle mint morsels
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Line cookie sheet with foil and spray with Pam.  Beat egg whites until stiff.  Gradually beat in sugar. Add food coloring; blend in.  Add mint morsels; fold in.  Drop small spoonfuls onto cookie sheets.   Turn off oven and put cookie sheets in oven overnight.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
2  Tbsp. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. lemon extract
preparation: Sift first 4 ingredients.  Cream butter and sugar.  Blend in egg, milk and flavoring.  Add dry ingredients.  Chill 2 hours or more.  Roll 1/8-inch thick.  Cut into shapes.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: KNEFLA SOUP
ingredients:
2  carrots
1  med. onion
4  stalks celery
1/2  stick butter
2  qt. chicken broth
1  c. a/p flour
1/2  t. salt
1/2  c. water
preparation: Sauté carrots, onion, and celery in butter.  In large stock pot bring broth to a boil.  Pour in sautéed vegetables.  Mix flour, salt and water together to form dough, (you may not need all the flour).  Add to broth one tsp. at a time.  Let cook until dough is cooked throughout.

name: SCALLOPED PEACHES
ingredients:
1  c. sliced peaches
4  c. sliced apples
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Arrange a layer of peaches on bottom of greased baking dish. Place half of apples over peaches.  Sprinkle with salt.  Add remainder of peaches and apples and sprinkle again with salt. Spread brown sugar over top, then crumbs.   Add water last.  Cover baking dish first 30 minutes so crumbs don't brown too quickly. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: ENGLISH PEA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans English peas, drained
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
4  ribs celery
1  stick margarine
1  can pimento, chopped
1  can mushrooms (stems and pieces)
1  can mushroom soup
