preparation: Saute onions, peppers and celery in margarine.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Bake in a greased casserole at 350° for 30 minutes.  May be prepared the day before serving.  Allow more time for heating.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: ITALIAN CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
5  egg yolks
5  egg whites, beaten stiff
1  tsp. salt
2  c. flour (plain)
1  tsp. soda
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. nuts
1  c. coconut
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter, shortening and sugar well. Add slightly beaten egg yolks. Dissolve soda in buttermilk and add alternately with flour to which the salt has been added. Fold in egg whites. Add coconut, nuts and vanilla. Bake in 3 (8-inch) pans at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: HOLIDAY CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can sweetened condensed milk (14 oz)
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  can (20 oz.) crushed pineapple, drained
1  can (16 oz.) whole berry cranberry sauce
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. chopped pecans
8  oz. frozen whipped topping, thawed
preparation: Combine milk and lemon juice and mix well.  Stir in pineapple, cranberry sauce, marshmallows and pecans.  Fold in cool whip.  Spoon into a 13 x 9 baking dish and freeze until firm. Yield 12 - 16 servings.

name: DATE-NUT COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. margarine
1/2  lb. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. flour
1  lb. dates, cooked with 1 c. water
1  c. nuts
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Mix margarine, cream cheese and flour to make dough.  Cook dates with 1 cup water, stirring until thick, to make filling.  Add nuts and sugar to date mixture.  Roll out dough and cut with biscuit cutter.  Place filling on circle.  Fold in half and seal with fork.  Dip in sugar.  Bake on middle shelf for 20 minutes.

name: CRAWFISH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. finely chopped onions
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. butter
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
bread crumbs
2 to 3  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1  lb. crawfish tails
2  c. cooked rice
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook onions, bell pepper and celery in butter until tender. Add mushroom soup and Worcestershire sauce, stirring gently.  Stir in crawfish, rice, salt and pepper.  Pour into buttered casserole. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.  Bake, uncovered, in preheated 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: PECAN TARTS
ingredients:
1  (3 oz.) cream cheese
1  stick oleo
1  c. flour
1  Tbsp. oleo
1  egg
1  c. brown sugar
preparation: Dough:  Mix the cream cheese, 1 stick oleo and flour together and let stand 1 hour; refrigerate.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  stick oleo
1  lb. can sliced peaches, undrained
preparation: Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch in pan.  Mix flour, sugar and milk together and pour over oleo. Pour peaches over mixture in pan.  Mix 4 tablespoons cinnamon and 3/4 cup sugar and sprinkle over top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: MAMA'S RAISIN-SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. nutmeg
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  c. butter
2  c. sugar
2  c. milk
2  eggs
1  pkg. raisins
1  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Grease and flour a large tube pan.  Cream the butter and sugar; add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.  Sift the dry ingredients together and add to the creamed mixture alternately with the milk.  Save a little of the flour mixture to flour the raisins.  Add these last of all.  Bake at 325° for approximately an hour or until a straw inserted comes out clean.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  Can of Coke
1  Cup of Ketchup
1/4  Cup of Brown Sugar
preparation: Mix all and heat.  Cook down.  Make with Ham, Chops, Chicken, or Short Ribs.  Double if doing a lot.

name: CAVITINI
ingredients:
3  c. trio mix noodles
1  lb. ground sausage
1/2  tsp. garlic
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  small onion, chopped
1  (8 oz.) drained mushrooms
1  (3 1/2 oz.) pepperonis
32  oz. jar Prego sauce
2 to 3  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cook noodles as directed. Drain. Brown sausage, peppers and onions. Drain. Mix noodles and meat mixture with all other ingredients except cheese. Place in a greased 9 x 13 pan. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: DONALD'S FAVORITE BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pt. blueberries
1/2  c. walnuts
preparation: Cream together shortening, sugar and salt for 4 minutes.  Add baking powder and eggs.   Mix.  Add flour, milk and vanilla and mix again.  Add blueberries and walnuts.

name: OREO BLIZZARD
ingredients:
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. Oreo cookies
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Soften ice cream; crunch up Oreo cookies and add the ice cream.  Stir well, then fold in Cool Whip.  Put in pan and freeze. Best if made the night before serving.

name: GRANDMA PARKES CHOW CHOW
ingredients:
2  qt. finely shredded cabbage
3  c. cucumbers
1  Tbsp. green peppers (add red for color, may add more according to taste)
3  Tbsp. salt
3  c. green tomatoes
1  onion
2 1/2  c. vinegar
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. pickling spice, tied in cheesecloth
preparation: Combine vegetables. Sprinkle with salt. Let stand for 4 to 6 hours. Drain and rinse well. Combine vinegar, sugar and pickling spice. Simmer 30 minutes to flavor vinegar. Add vegetables. Simmer 10 minutes. Bring to boil. Pack boiling hot into Ball jars. Great with peas in the winter months.

name: BREAST OF CHICKEN RUSTICA
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oleo
4  skinned chicken breasts (also good with thighs)
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1 1/2  c. milk
1  (2.7 oz.) dried Swiss tomato with basil soup
3  c. medium egg noodles
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
1  (10 oz.) French-style green beans
preparation: Melt oleo in 12-ounce skillet; add chicken breasts.  Cook 4 minutes on each side.  Add water, milk and soup; mix and stir. Add noodles and stir to cover with liquid.  Add remaining ingredients.  Cover and bring to a boil.  Simmer 10 minutes, stirring twice, until chicken is done and noodles tender.

name: CHICKEN - PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1 -8  oz. box macaroni
1/2  cup Italian dressing
2  cups thinly sliced cucumbers
1/2  cup diced green peppers
1  tsp. salt
2  cups cooked chicken diced
1  cup mayonnaise
1  tbsp prepared mustard
1 1/2  cup diced tomatoes
1/4  cup green onions
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook macaroni as directed.  Drain and rinse with cold water. In large bowl combine mayonnaise, dressing and mustard.  Mix well. Add cucumbers, tomatoes, green pepper, onions, salt and pepper. Also add chicken and macaroni  Toss to mix well.  Put in covered salad bowl and refrigerate.  Until well chilled.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
3  chicken breasts, cooked and cut into quarters
2  pkg. broccoli, booked until tender
1  can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. grated cheese
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. curry powder
1/2  c. fine bread crumbs or Pepperidge Farms dressing mix
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Put cooked broccoli in baking dish, place chicken on top. Mix soup, milk, mayonnaise, cheese, lemon juice and curry together.  Pour over the broccoli and chicken.  Sprinkle with bread crumbs and butter.  Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: MUSTARD-GRILLED SHRIMP
ingredients:
1/2  c. prepared mustard
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  tsp. prepared horseradish
2  lb. fresh shelled jumbo shrimp
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except shrimp, together.  Add shrimp to mixture.  Chill several hours, stirring often.  Drain, reserving marinade.  Grill over medium coals for 6 to 8 minutes. Turn and baste twice with marinade.

name: EASY SALMON CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1 (1 lb.)  can flaked salmon, drained (liquid reserved)
preparation: Melt butter.  Add salt, pepper and  mustard.   Mix well.  Add bread crumbs and stir until butter mixture is absorbed.   Add milk, eggs and liquid from salmon.  Add salmon and mix well.  Pour into a well-greased 2-quart baking dish.   Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until firm and brown.  Yields 6 servings.

name: PRESSURE CANNED GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
green beans
1/2  tsp. salt to each pt. or 1 tsp. salt to a qt.
hot water
preparation: Wash,  string  and break or cut green beans into 1-inch pieces.  Pack  tightly  into  jars, leaving within 1/2-inch of top of	jar.  Add 1/2 teaspoon salt to each pint or 1 teaspoon salt to a	quart.	After  packing	beans in jar, add salt and fill within  1/2-inch  of  top of jar with hot water.  Put on lid, that has been setting in hot water.  Screw on cap tightly and  place into  pressure  canner.  Most  canners will hold 7 quarts  or  8 pints.  After putting jars into canner, add 3/4 full  of  hot water.  Place on lid;  tighten down securely and place  on	gauze. Time after it rises with steam and jiggles, 20  minutes  for pints and 25 minutes for quarts.  Let canner cool  down  before removing lid.  Remove from canner and place cloth over jars; let stand to seal for 24 hours, then place on shelves  or in cabinet. Date lid with magic marker; will keep for years.

name: REFRIGERATED SLAW
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage, shredded
1  green pepper, chopped
1 red pepper, chopped or 1 large  jar diced pimento, drained
1  c. celery, chopped
1  Tbsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. mustard seed
1  tsp. celery seed
1  c. vinegar
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
preparation: Boil together for 5 minutes.  Cool and pour over slaw.  Let set several hours or overnight.  Refrigerate.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD JELLO MOLD
ingredients:
1  pkg. raspberry gelatin
1/2  c. cold water
1/2  c. crushed drained pineapple
1/4  c. chopped nuts
1  c. hot water
1  orange, peeled and diced
1  lb. can cranberry sauce
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in hot water.  Add cold water.  Chill until partially set.  Fold in remaining ingredients.  Chill until firm.

name: ZUCCHINI AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. sliced zucchini
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. Minute rice
2  c. cottage cheese
1  can mushroom soup
1 small  can chopped mushrooms
1  c. grated sharp cheese
salt and pepper
oregano
garlic salt
preparation: In a 13 x 9-inch casserole, layer rice, zucchini, mushrooms, onions and cottage cheese.   Season with salt and pepper, oregano and garlic salt.  Pour can of mushroom soup over entire casserole. Top with grated cheese.  Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

name: BUTTER SQUASH
ingredients:
butter squash
1/2  tsp. salt
1  can chunk pineapple
1/2  stick butter
2/3  c. brown sugar
preparation: Cut butter squash into bite-size chunks.  Steam squash with salt.  Drain and pour squash in baking dish.  Drain pineapple and add to squash.  Slice butter over top.  Sprinkle the brown sugar on top.  Bake at 350° for about 25 to 30 minutes.

name: CATFISH SUPREME
ingredients:
4  filets of catfish
4  radishes
1  bunch scallions or 2 large leeks, chopped
4  carrots, sliced in julienne style
1  Tbsp. sesame seed
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Place catfish, skin side up, in a glass oven dish, side by side.  Sprinkle lightly with coarse pepper and drizzle 1 tablespoon of oil over filets.  Meanwhile, saute all vegetables in 1 tablespoon oil, using a large skillet until almost done.  Then sprinkle sesame seed over vegetables and cook until lightly brown.  After 15 minutes of cooking, remove catfish from oven and spread vegetables equally over each filet.  Serve with salad and white or red wine.

name: ROTEL
ingredients:
6  c. chopped tomatoes
2  c. tomato juice
3/4  c. hot pepper
2  Tbsp. garlic salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Simmer 2 minutes.  Put in jars and seal.  Pressure for 8 minutes.

name: PEACH CRUNCH
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. plain flour
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  stick margarine
1 8  oz. cream cheese
1 3/4  c. powdered sugar
1 8  oz. cool whip
4  to 5 fresh peaches
1  box peach Jell-O
1  c. boiling water
3/4  c. cold water
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, pecans and margarine well.  Pat into bottom of a 9 x 13 inch glass baking dish.  Bake about 10 minutes in a 350° oven.  Cool completely.

name: CHEESY BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. grated Jack cheese
1/2  c. soft margarine
1/4  tsp. Italian seasoning
1  loaf French bread
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Mix cheese, margarine and seasoning. Spread on bread.  Place on cookie sheet.  Bake for 5 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned.

name: RUTH MARTIN'S M-F-A PICKLES
ingredients:
1  gal. whole cucumbers
4  c. vinegar
4  Tbsp. canning salt
4  Tbsp. alum
6  Tbsp. pickling spice
enough cold water to finish filling jar
6  c. sugar
2  c. cold water
preparation: Cover pickles and seal cold.

name: BROWNIE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  c. water
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. Wesson oil
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift sugar, flour and soda and set aside.  Put water, oil, butter and cocoa in pot and bring to boil.  Pour this over dry ingredients.  Mix with spoon.  Add eggs and buttermilk.   Bake in greased pan at 400° for 25 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CRISSCROSS
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. peanut butter
3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Thoroughly cream shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla.  Stir in peanut butter.  Sift flour, soda and salt together.   Stir flour stuff into creamy stuff.  Roll cookie dough into balls and crisscross lightly with fork.  Bake 8 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.

name: NEW YEAR'S CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. finely chopped green pepper
1/4  c. finely chopped celery
1 small  jar dried beef, shredded
1  Tbsp. Accent
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Allow cream cheese to come to room temperature.  Mix in all ingredients.  Mix well.  Roll into a ball.  A brick shape is a good idea, as it is easily sliced.  Refrigerate until serving time.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1  baked pie shell
1  c. powdered sugar
1/4  c. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
3  egg yolks, beaten
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. creamy peanut butter
2/3  c. sugar
2  c. scalded milk
2  Tbsp. butter
3  egg whites
preparation: Combine powdered sugar and peanut butter.  Mix with fork until mixture resembles coarse corn meal.  Spread half of mixture in baked pie shell.  Set remaining mixture aside.  Combine remaining ingredients, except egg whites, in a saucepan.  Cook over medium heat until thick, stirring constantly.  Spoon over peanut butter mixture in pastry shell.  Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Spread over cooked filling.  Sprinkle remaining peanut butter mixture over meringue.  Bake at 325° for 20 minutes or until firm and brown.

name: APPLE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine, melted
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. flour
4  lg. or 6 med. apples
1  c. chopped walnuts, optional
preparation: Mix first six ingredients.  Add sliced apples and nuts. Spread mixture into 9 x 11-inch cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 40-45 minutes.

name: GARLIC BEANS
ingredients:
2  cans French green beans
5  garlic bulbs
1  c. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. Wesson oil
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Soak overnight; drain and serve.

name: HERBED STUFFING MIX
ingredients:
30  slices bread, cut in small cubes*
1/3  c. cooking oil
3  Tbsp. dry onions
3/4  tsp. sage
3  Tbsp. parsley flakes
2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. seasoned pepper
preparation: Dry bread in slow oven for about 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Remove from oven and let cool.  Stir in seasonings and oil.  Lightly toss the cubes.  Store in airtight container. Label and store in cool, dry place.  Use within 4 months.  Makes 12 cups.

name: ORANGE SALAD(Sugar-Free)
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. sugar-free orange jello
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen juice (no sugar added)
1 large  can crushed pineapple (no sugar)
2  cans Mandarin oranges
2  c. boiling water
preparation: Mix jello in boiling water.  Add frozen juice.  Add pineapple and juice.  Add Mandarin oranges and about 1/2 cup cold water. Chill; serve with sour cream on top, if you like.

name: PEAR JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can pears
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. jello (any flavor)
1  (3 oz.) cream cheese, softened
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Drain pears.  Use juice and water to make 1 cup.  Boil and add to jello.  Set aside until thickened.  In blender, blend cream cheese and pears.  Add the jello and blend.  Fold in Cool Whip. Sets in about 2 hours.

name: NORSK LAPPE(Straight from the recipes of Tante Magnhild, Flekkefjord,
ingredients:
1  egg
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
buttermilk
flour
preparation: Beat the egg.  Add the sugar.  Dissolve baking soda in the buttermilk.  Add alternately to egg.  Mix with 1 cup flour.   At this point, recipe can be halved.  Beat well.  Beat in another cup of flour and another cup of buttermilk.  Drop by generous spoonfuls onto hot griddle or frypan.  Turn to cook both sides evenly.  Serve warm with butter and syrup or jam.  Or, serve cold with homemade preserves.

name: CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1 small  pkg. orange Jell-O
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  can cherry pie filling
1 large  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix pineapple and Jell-O together.  Add milk, pie filling and Cool Whip.  Mix together.  Salad tastes better if left to set overnight.

name: FROZEN CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  large container Cool Whip, thawed
1/2  c. sugar
1  medium size crushed pineapple, drained
1  can whole cranberry sauce
2  bananas, sliced
preparation: Mix sugar and Cool Whip.   Stir in canned fruit.  Fold in bananas.  Keep frozen.   Cut into squares to serve.

name: SPINACH BALLS
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
3  c. herb seasoned stuffing mix
1  large onion, chopped fine
6  eggs, well beaten
3/4  c. melted butter or margarine (1 1/2 sticks)
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. pepper
1 1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. thyme
preparation: Cook spinach according to package directions; drain well in strainer.  Squeeze to remove excess moisture.  Combine rest of the ingredients with spinach.  Shape into balls.  Can be baked now or frozen.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Makes 6 dozen.

name: DESSERT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) roll sugar cookie dough
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  c. sugar
1 (21 oz.)  can strawberry pie filling
1  c. crushed pineapple
2  bananas, sliced
preparation: Slice cookie dough 1/4 inch thick.  Arrange slices close together in pizza pan.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown.  Cool completely.  Beat cream cheese, vanilla and sugar in mixer bowl until smooth.  Spread over cookie layer.  Layer pie filling, pineapple and bananas over creamed layer.  Chill until serving time.  Yield:  12 servings.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. Oreo cookies, crushed
2 small  boxes French vanilla instant pudding
3 1/2  c. milk
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  stick butter/margarine
1  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix together pudding, milk and Cool Whip.  Cream together cream cheese, butter and powdered sugar.  Combine the pudding mixture with cream cheese; mix well.  In layers, alternate cookies and filling.  Refrigerate.

name: PIG PICKING CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1 small  can mandarin oranges
1/2  c. oil
4  eggs
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and blend well.  Bake at 350° until done.  Makes 3 layers.

name: HASH BROWN POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. frozen hash brown potatoes
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. milk
8  oz. sour cream
6 to 8  oz. Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick margarine, melted
8  oz. cheese crackers
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except for butter and cheese crackers. Pour into buttered 2-quart casserole dish.  Mix melted butter and crumbled crackers together.   Add to top of other mixture.   Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. chopped broccoli
1  c. Minute rice, cooked
1/2  c. chopped celery
3/4  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz (room temperature)
preparation: Mix together and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  You may add chopped almonds or water chestnuts for variations.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
4  pkg. (10-count) biscuits
2/3  c. sugar
1 heaping  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  sticks butter
1  c. sugar
1 heaping  tsp. cinnamon
nuts, chopped
preparation: Cut biscuits into quarters and roll in the first cinnamon and sugar mixture.  Put half the biscuits in a Bundt pan.  Cook butter and second cinnamon  mixture with 2 teaspoons water.  Bring to a boil and boil for 2 minutes.  Pour half over the biscuits. Layering with nuts as you go, put the remaining biscuits in pan and pour the rest of the syrup over this.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.  Cool 5 minutes.   Then turn out on a plate.  Pull apart and enjoy.

name: BUBBLE AND SQUEAK(Microwave)
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes, peeled and cubed
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. milk
6  Tbsp. butter
1  onion, chopped
4  c. shredded cabbage
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a 2-quart casserole, combine the potatoes and water.  Cover tightly and cook on High (100%) for 7 to 13 minutes or until fork-tender, stirring once halfway through cooking.  Let stand covered 3 minutes.  Meanwhile, in a 1-quart glass measure, combine milk and 4 tablespoons butter.  Cook on High for 1 minute.  Set aside.

name: HOMEMADE NOODLES
ingredients:
2  c. flour or more
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix eggs, milk and salt together. Add baking powder to flour and mix into first ingredients. If not stiff enough to make a stiff dough, add more flour gradually. Roll very thin. It may creep. Cover rolled pieces with flour and roll up. Cut into thin strips. May be cooked immediately or dried and stored. Noodles will be done when edges are not sharp.

name: SLOPPY JOES
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. mustard
1/4  c. ketchup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can Veg-All, undrained
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion.  Drain.  Stir in mustard and ketchup; mix well.  Blend in cream of celery soup.  Stir in Veg-All.  Simmer for about 15 minutes.  Serve over toasted hamburger buns, open faced.

name: PICANTE SAUCE
ingredients:
22  medium unpeeled tomatoes
5  large onions
9  to 11 jalapeno peppers
2  sweet bell peppers
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
1/4  c. salt
1  c. tomato paste
preparation: Put vegetables in blender; chop.  Add remaining ingredients. Cook 30 to 40 minutes after it starts to boil.  Fill jars and seal.  Makes 11 to 12 pints.

name: OVER AND UNDER CAKE NEW ORLEANS RECIPE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped nuts (pecans)
1  c. coconut
1  German chocolate cake mix
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  stick margarine
1  box 4x sugar
preparation: Spread pecans in greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish (or aluminum pan), then spread coconut.  Make German chocolate cake mix as directed on package.  Pour over coconut.  Melt margarine and cream cheese in a saucepan slowly, then add 4x sugar.  Mix well, then pour over cake mix.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.  Be sure when you check it, it should spring back.  This has to be served from dish.  You will enjoy!

name: BANANA SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. flour
1  egg, beaten
2 1/2  c. Milnot milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  large bananas, sliced
1/2  c. peanuts, crushed
preparation: Cook together sugar, flour, egg and Milnot.  Add vanilla.  Let cool.  In a bowl, make a layer of 1/2 bananas, 1/2 pudding mixture and 1/2 peanuts.  Repeat layer, using remaining ingredients.  Keep refrigerated.

name: SUGARED NUTS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. water
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. nuts
preparation: Cook sugar, water and cinnamon together for about 5 minutes. Pour over nuts in buttered pan. Cool and break apart.

name: BUTTERHORNS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1  Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. lukewarm water
1/2  c. sugar (scant)
1/2  c. melted butter (scant) (1/4 lb.)
3  eggs
4  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve  yeast  and  1  tablespoon  sugar  in lukewarm water. Combine  remaining  ingredients.  Keep in refrigerator overnight. Divide  dough into 3 sections; roll 1/4-inch thick and cut into 16 pie wedges each.  Roll each section from large end and cover with plenty of butter.  Let raise 2 hours.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 375°.

name: CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. grated onion or onion flakes
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  lb. grated sharp Cheddar
1/4  lb. grated Blue cheese
garlic and Tabasco to season
preparation: Allow cheeses to come to room temperature.  Mix all together in large bowl.  Separate into 2 equal size balls and roll around in your hand until round.  Roll in parsley flakes or chopped nuts. Wrap in cellophane and refrigerate.

name: FRUIT TEA MIX
ingredients:
2  oz. dried pineapple or papaya, chopped (1/3 c.)
2  tsp. dried lemon peel
1  c. Earl Gray or orange pekoe tea leaves
preparation: Combine in small bowl and store in jar with tight fitting lid.

name: SLOW-COOKED RIBS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  small onion, finely chopped
1  large garlic clove, pressed
3/4  c. water
1/4  c. cider vinegar
2  Tbsp. pancake syrup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground pepper
1/4  tsp. ginger
1  can tomato paste
1  (2 1/2 to 4 lb.) rack pork spareribs
preparation: Heat oven to 200°. In a saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Add onion and cook 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in garlic and cook 1 minute. Stir in water, vinegar, syrup, Worcestershire, mustard, chili powder, salt, pepper, ginger and tomato paste. Cook over low heat, stirring until mixture begins to thicken. Place ribs in a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Pour sauce over ribs. Cover dish tightly with heavy foil and bake until tender, about 4 hours.

name: HEATH BAR CAKE
ingredients:
1  German chocolate cake mix
1  medium Cool Whip
1  can Eagle Brand milk
2  to 3 Heath bars
1  jar caramel ice cream topping
preparation: Prepare cake mix and bake as directed.  As soon as you remove cake from the oven, take a wooden spoon and poke holes in the top of the cake.  Next, pour Eagle Brand milk on top of the cake, then pour caramel topping on the cake.  Let cake cool.  Spread on Cool Whip.  Crush the Heath bars and sprinkle on top of the cake. Refrigerate.  Cake is supposed to be served cold.

name: CHEESE PUFFS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. refrigerated biscuits
1/4  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, cubed to 30 pieces
oil for deep frying
preparation: Separate biscuits; cut into thirds.  Wrap dough around cheese cubes; seal well. Fry in hot oil for 2 to 3 minutes until golden brown. Yield: 30 puffs.

name: WELCH FRIED CAKES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or oleo
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. currants
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Add milk to eggs.  Add sifted dry ingredients.  Add currants.  Mix and chill.

name: WILD TURKEY
ingredients:
cleaned and dressed turkey, with skin on
lemon butter
salt
coarse black pepper
12  oz. cranberry juice, apple cider or beer
preparation: Brush bird with lemon butter and season with dry spices inside and out.  Place bird in roasting bag.  Pour juice into cavities and tie bag loosely.  Insert thermometer into meatiest part of thigh.  Bake at 225° until temperature reaches 180°.  The sweetness of the juices will affect the sweetness of gravy.

name: GARLIC NIBBLES
ingredients:
1  box oyster crackers
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix oil, herbs, garlic and dressing mix.  Place crackers on cookie sheet.  Pour sauce over.  Toss to mix 3 or 4 times over an hour or so.  Store in tin or Baggie.

name: BLUEBERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1 1/2  sticks oleo
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. nuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  can blueberry pie filling
1 large  carton Cool Whip or 2 pkg. Dream Whip
preparation: Mix flour, crumbs, oleo and nuts together; spoon into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Cool.  Mix cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip together; pour into prepared crust. Spread pie filling on top and chill.

name: QUICK LUNCHBOX CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. packed brown sugar
2  eggs
1/4  c. soft butter
1  lb. can fruit cocktail (undrained)
1/2  c. chocolate bits
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Grease and flour bottom of 13 x 9 pan.  Combine all ingredients except chocolate bits and nuts in large mixer bowl. Blend well at lowest speed.  Beat 2 minutes at medium speed.  Pour batter into pan.  Sprinkle with chocolate bits and nuts.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: HEAVENLY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  (10 oz.) angel food cake
1  can Eagle Brand milk
2 1/2  c. strawberries, sliced
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  (16 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Break cake in bite-sized pieces in one bowl.  Mix milk and lemon juice in another bowl.  Pour over cake.  Add strawberries and Cool Whip; toss lightly.  Refrigerate 6 hours.

name: SOCK IT TO ME CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
3/4  c. oil
2  tsp. vanilla
1  yellow cake mix (Duncan Hines butter flavor)
1  c. nuts
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Beat eggs well.  Add sugar, sour cream, oil and vanilla.  Beat 1 minute.  Add cake mix and beat 2 minutes.  Fold in nuts.  Pour half of batter into Bundt pan (well-greased and floured). Sprinkle brown sugar mixed with cinnamon over top and add rest of butter.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BROWNIE CAMP-OUT COFFEE CAN ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1  qt. half and half
1  can sweetened condensed milk (14 oz.)
1  tsp. vanilla
2  (1 lb.) coffee cans
2  (3 lb.) coffee cans
1  bag ice (small cubes are best)
rock salt
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients together and pour in 1-pound coffee can.  (You will probably have enough liquid for two (1-pound) cans.)  Place lid on can and secure with duct tape.  Put this can inside of a 3-pound coffee can.  Place ice all the way around the smaller can.  Sprinkle a little rock salt on top of ice.  Close can.  Roll the can back and forth between several friends for about 10 minutes.  Open the can and drain the water.  Add more ice and salt.  (Pour melted salt water outside on gravel.)  Roll until the ice cream is frozen (30 to 40 minutes).

name: CRISP SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
5  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  c. milk`
preparation: Mix all.  Cover and refrigerate 1/2 hour.  Take out chunks. Roll on floured board 1/8-inch thick.  Cut out shapes.  Bake until brown around edges.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Makes 8 dozen.

name: TEA CAKES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. self-rising flour *
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. Crisco
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. milk
preparation: *If made with plain flour, add 1 teaspoon baking powder, 1/2 teaspoon soda and 1/2 teaspoon salt.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
4  large cubed tomatoes
1  chopped green pepper
1  large onion, chopped
4  oz. can green chilies
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. ground cumin
preparation: Mix all together.  If too hot, add more tomatoes.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: "COMPANY IS COMING"(Coconut Cake)
ingredients:
6  egg whites
2  c. sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. cream of tartar
36  soda crackers, crushed
2  tsp. vanilla
1  regular size extra creamy Cool Whip
1 (12 oz.)  jar pineapple preserves
1  can Angel Flake coconut
preparation: Beat egg whites until foamy. Add the cream of tartar and beat until stiff. Add sugar and beat. Add crackers, nuts and vanilla. Bake in buttered oblong 13-inch pan at 325° for 30 minutes. (Allow cake to cool well.)  Whip the preserves into the Cool Whip and spread over cooled cake.  Sprinkle on coconut.  Chill several hours.  Cut into 2-inch squares. Keeps well in refrigerator several days.  Also may be frozen several weeks.

name: FRIED PIE CRUST
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. Crisco
preparation: Blend together; then add 1 small can Pet milk and 1 beaten egg. Blend as well as possible, then roll out into desired size.  Makes about 18 small pies.  I used 2 cups of self-rising flour and 1/2 cup plain.  No salt and no baking powder.

name: COCKTAIL MEAT BALLS(Makes 5 Dozen)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
1/3  c. minced onion
1/4  c. milk
1  egg
1  Tbsp. snipped parsley
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire
1/4  c. shortening or oil
1 (12 oz.)  bottle chili sauce
1 (10 oz.)  jar grape jelly
preparation: Mix the ground beef, bread crumbs, milk, egg and the next 4 ingredients.  Gently shape into 1-inch balls.  Melt shortening in a large skillet; brown meat balls.  Remove meat from skillet; pour off fat.  Heat chili sauce and jelly in skillet, stirring constantly, until jelly is melted.  Add meat balls; stir until thoroughly coated.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
cooked elbow macaroni
mayonnaise
1  can tuna fish
2  Tbsp. sweet relish
parsley flakes
1  carrot, shredded
sugar
salt and pepper
preparation: Add mayonnaise to macaroni.  Add flaked tuna, sweet relish, parsley flakes, carrot, sugar, salt and pepper to taste.

name: CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
2  chicken breasts
2  cans chicken broth
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can creamed corn
1  can English peas
1  bay leaf
chili powder to taste
salt to taste
preparation: Remove skin from chicken; boil chicken until tender and debone.  In a large pot, combine chicken and remaining ingredients; cover and simmer for 45 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE MOUSSE WITH COFFEE LIQUEUR
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen puff pastry shells
1  pkg. regular chocolate pudding mix
2  c. milk
1  c. heavy cream, whipped
2  Tbsp. coffee flavored liqueur
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
preparation: Prepare pastry shells according to package directions. Meanwhile in a 2-quart saucepan, combine pudding and milk.  Cook according to package directions.  Chill.  Fold whipped cream, liqueur and chocolate pieces into cooled pudding.  Evenly divide among pastry shells.

name: PLAY CLAY
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. water
1/2  c. salt
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
2  tsp. cream of tartar
food coloring
preparation: In a medium saucepan combine all ingredients except food coloring.  Mix together by stirring with a spoon.  (Cream of tartar makes it less sticky.)  Cook mixture slowly over medium heat. While cooking add a few drops food coloring.  Clay is ready when it forms a ball.  Let cool.  Knead the clay.  When it is soft and smooth it's ready to play with.

name: SLOPPY JOES
ingredients:
1  onion, chopped
1  lb. hamburger
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. water
1  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt
pepper
preparation: Brown onion and meat; drain.  Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

name: EASY SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. sliced potatoes
2  c. milk
1/4  c. butter or oleo
parsley
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  pkg. onion soup mix
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix chicken soup and milk, onion soup, salt and pepper.  Add potatoes.  Top with parsley and butter.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

name: ONION CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. bacon, diced (remove some fat)
raw onion rings from 2 very large sweet onions (grapefruit size)
1/2  c. butter
2  c. soda cracker crumbs
1  lb. Cheddar cheese (mild)
4  eggs, slightly beaten
1 1/2  c. milk
salt and pepper
preparation: Partially cook bacon pieces.  Remove.  Add onion rings to bacon fat.  Saute until soft.  Add onions to bacon.  Melt butter in a large casserole dish.  Add crumbs to butter; mix.  Pat mixture up sides of casserole dish and cover bottom.  Line with grated cheese.  Add bacon and onion mixture.  Combine eggs and milk.  Pour over all.  Season with salt and pepper.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER LOVERS DIP
ingredients:
2/3  c. creamy peanut butter
2/3  c. honey
1/4  c. lemon juice
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl; beat at low speed with an electric mixer until smooth.  Serve with fresh fruit (apple slices, banana chunks and grapes).

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. sweet potatoes from meat counter at grocery store
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. raisins
1 large  can pineapple
preparation: Mix pineapple, sugar and margarine and pour over potatoes in Pyrex dish; sprinkle raisins and bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. corn oil
3  eggs
3  c. chopped apples
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
3  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Beat together the sugar and corn oil.  Mix dry ingredients and add to first mixture.  Add eggs and vanilla; fold in nuts and apples.  Pour in greased tube pans. Bake about 1 hour at 350°.

name: TABBOULEH
ingredients:
1  c. cracked wheat
1  bunch parsley
3  tomatoes
1  bunch scallions
1  tsp. dried mint or 4 tsp. chopped fresh
1  tsp. cumin
1  tsp. coriander
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. lemon juice
1/4  c. olive oil
preparation: Soak cracked wheat in water for 30 minutes.  Dice parsley, scallions and tomatoes.  Squeeze out cracked wheat and mix with spices, lemon juice and oil.  Add diced vegetables and mix thoroughly.  (Diced vegetables are parsley, scallions and tomatoes.)

name: GRANDMA HOLLEY'S JELLY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box cake mix
1  pt. bronze grape jelly
preparation: Bake 4 layers, following cake mix directions.  Cool layers until just slightly warm.  Spread each layer generously with jelly.

name: GOOF BALLS
ingredients:
32  Kraft light caramels
1  can sweetened condensed milk
large marshmallows
crushed Rice Krispies
preparation: Melt in double boiler over hot water the caramels and milk. Put a large marshmallow on fork and whirl in the goo.  Then roll in crushed Rice Krispies.  Makes about 50 balls.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen broccoli, thawed
3  chicken breasts, cooked and shredded
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. curry powder
bread crumbs
preparation: Place broccoli on bottom of pan.  Put chicken on top; mix soup, mayonnaise and curry powder and pour over chicken.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: SWISS VEGETABLE MEDLEY
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) bag California Blend broccoli, cauliflower and carrots, thawed and drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1/3  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  can French fried onions
preparation: Combine vegetables, soup, 1/2 cup cheese, sour cream, pepper and 1/2 can onions.  Pour into a casserole.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onions.  Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.

name: CHRISTMAS BREAKFAST
ingredients:
8  slices raisin bread, crust removed
1/2  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
6  eggs
3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  lb. bacon, partially cooked
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Crumble bread and mix with grated cheese.  Spread this mixture on the bottom of a 9 x 9-inch Pam sprayed pan. Beat eggs and milk together.  Add salt and pepper and mustard to this mixture.  Pour this mixture over the bread mixture.  Place bacon strips on top of this.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Christmas morning, bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: LAYERED CAULIFLOWER
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
2  c. mayonnaise
1  lb. bacon
1  head cauliflower
1  chopped onion
preparation: Mix garlic powder and prepared mustard to one small carton sour cream.

name: MACAROON KISS COOKIES
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter
3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. almond extract
1 1/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. milk chocolate kisses
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  egg yolk
2  tsp. orange juice
2  tsp. baking powder
5  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Cream butter, softened cream cheese and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add egg yolk, almond extract and orange juice.  Beat well. Combine flour, baking powder and salt.  Stir in 3 cups flaked coconut.  Cover dough and chill about 1 hour.  Shape dough into 1-inch balls.  Roll balls in remaining coconut.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned on bottom.  Remove from oven and press a chocolate kiss into center of each cookie.  Allow to cool 1 minute.  Carefully remove cookies from sheet and cool until chocolate kisses are firm. Makes 4 1/2 dozen.

name: OATMEAL CRISPIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
3  c. oatmeal
1  c. nuts
preparation: Cream  until smooth, shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Add all other ingredients and mix well.  Using wax paper, shape into rolls about 2  x 10-inches.  This will make 2 rolls of cookie dough.  Wrap and  freeze.  When ready to bake, slice about 1/4 inch thick. Bake at  350°  about 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown.

name: SOUR CREAM CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising meal
3/4  c. oil
2  eggs
1 small  can creamed corn
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  small chopped onion
preparation: Mix and pour into greased skillet.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: GINGERSNAPS
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. molasses
1  egg
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
granulated sugar
preparation: Cream  together  shortening,  brown sugar, molasses and egg until  fluffy.  Sift  together  all remaining ingredients except granulated  sugar.  Stir  into molasses mixture;  form into  small balls.  Roll in granulated sugar.  Place 2 inches apart  on greased  cookie  sheet.  Bake  in  375° oven for 12 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3/4  stick oleo, melted
2  c. cooked, mashed squash
2  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. grated cheese
1  c. evaporated milk
2  c. cracker crumbs
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well.  Pour into a greased casserole dish and bake at 375° for 45 minutes. or until well set.

name: COCONUT POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. corn oil
5  whole eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. coconut
2 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. coconut flavoring
preparation: Mix together all ingredients.  Beat for 5 minutes with electric mixer.  Pour in tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

name: JAPANESE FRUIT CAKE PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans
1  c. yellow raisins
1  c. sugar
2  sticks butter, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bake 50 minutes at 300°.  Makes 2 pies.

name: PINK JELLO SALAD(Sugar-Free)
ingredients:
2  cans crushed pineapple in own juice
2 (4 oz.)  boxes strawberry jello (sugar-free)
2  c. buttermilk
1  (12 oz.) light Cool Whip
preparation: Bring pineapple and juice to boil.  Remove from heat.  Stir in strawberry jello.  Cool slightly.  Add buttermilk.  Refrigerate until jello begins to gel.  Stir in Cool Whip.  Place in refrigerator until sets.

name: QUICK COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  can pie filling
1  stick margarine
preparation: Melt butter in 9 x 12 Pyrex dish while oven preheats to 350°. Mix milk, flour and sugar. Then add pie filling (apple, cherry, blueberry) and pour into greased dish. Cook until firm and lightly browned on top (about 30 minutes). Serves 6 to 8.

name: POTATO TOPPINGS(Lo-fat)
ingredients:
1  c. low-fat cottage cheese
1  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. celery powder
preparation: Combine ingredients and chill 1 hour before serving to allow flavors to blend.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. ketchup
1  Tbsp. salt
dash of red and black pepper
1  tsp. chili powder
1  lemon, sliced thin
preparation: Mix all ingredients and simmer on low heat at least 30 minutes.

name: OATMEAL RAISIN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked oatmeal
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. raisins
1  beaten egg
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix everything together.  Drop teaspoonfuls of batter onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

name: KENTUCKY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. Crisco oil
1  c. crushed pineapple
4  egg yolks
4  egg whites
1 1/2  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. hot water
preparation: Mix all ingredients except egg whites.  Beat egg whites until stiff, then fold in mixture.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

name: DATE FILLED COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. Spry or Crisco
2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. water
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix all ingredients.

name: DILLY BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1  c. cottage cheese, heated to lukewarm
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. instant minced onion or 3 Tbsp. chopped fresh
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  tsp. dill seed
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. soda
1  unbeaten egg
2  c. flour
preparation: Soften yeast in warm water.  Combine remaining ingredients  in a large bowl. Add yeast mixture;  stir  until  moist dough is formed. Allow to rise (about 1 hour  in  warm  place) until doubled. Put 1/2 cup flour on clean  surface  and  knead dough. Put  into  a large oiled casserole.  Let  rise  until doubled, approximately 1/2 hour. Bake at 350° for  40  to  50 minutes. While hot, brush with melted  butter  and  sprinkle with salt. Serve warm.

name: CRAB TREAT
ingredients:
1  stick butter or margarine (1/2 c.)
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  jar Old English cheese spread
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt (optional)
1 1/2  tsp. mayonnaise
1 (7 oz.)  can crabmeat
6  English muffins, split
preparation: Soften butter with cheese spread, garlic salt, mayonnaise and seasoned salt.  Pick any shells out of crabmeat; drain and add crabmeat to cheese.  Spread on muffins.  Freeze 10 minutes; cut into eighths or quarters.  Broil on cookie sheet or in toaster oven until bubbly.  May be kept frozen until ready to broil. Makes 96 (1/8 size) wedges or 48 (1/4 size) wedges.

name: FRUIT ICE
ingredients:
1  frozen banana
1  c. apple juice
1/2  c. strawberries
preparation: Mix above ingredients in blender.  Serve in glasses and enjoy; it tastes like ice cream without the fat!

name: PIE DOUGH
ingredients:
2  c. flour
3/4  tsp. salt
10  Tbsp. lard or shortening
6 to 8  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Mix  ingredients  well	and  roll  out.  Bake  at 325°. Makes 2 shells.

name: CLINTON'S CHIPS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. solid vegetable shortening
1  c. firmly packed light brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2  c. old fashioned, rolled oats
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease baking sheet.  Combine flour, baking soda and salt on wax paper or in a bowl.  In a large bowl, mix shortening, sugars and vanilla until creamy.  Add eggs and beat until light and fluffy.  Gradually beat in flour mixture and rolled oats.  Stir in chocolate chips.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. rice
1 large  pkg. frozen broccoli
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  cans cream of celery soup
1  pkg. onion soup mix
2  c. sharp grated cheese
preparation: Cook rice.  Mix hot rice with frozen broccoli, soups and onion soup mix.  Pour half of mixture into casserole dish.  Sprinkle with 1 cup grated cheese.  Add remaining mixture and top with remaining cheese.  Bake 30 minutes at 325°.

name: COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
white cake mix- pudding in the mix
1  can Eagle brand, sweetened condensed milk
2/3  can cream of coconut
flake coconut
large Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake in 9 x13 as directed on box.

name: EASY DINNER CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box frozen peas and carrots
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can small whole onions
1  can mushroom pieces
2  c. cut up cooked chicken
1  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Mix together.  Sprinkle chips on top.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: GRANNY'S KENTUCKY POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. malt vinegar
1  Tbsp. pickle relish
1 1/2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. white pepper
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
4  c. cooked, cubed, peeled potatoes
1  c. diced celery
1/2  c. diced red onion
2  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
2  Tbsp. yellow mustard
1  Tbsp. malt vinegar
preparation: Combine first eight ingredients.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Cover.  Chill.

name: MINESTRONE SOUP
ingredients:
3  lb. beef
4  leaves parsley
1  large onion, chopped
1  can crushed or whole tomatoes
1/4  lb. spaghetti noodles, broken
1  pkg. cut frozen string beans
4  qt. water
4  large carrots, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
1  bay leaf
2  c. chopped cabbage
1  can chickpeas
1  pkg. frozen peas
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In water, put beef, carrots, parsley, celery, onion and bay leaf and simmer, uncovered, for 3 hours. Remove beef and carrots and strain. Combine remaining ingredients. Cook, covered, for 45 minutes. Cut up beef in small pieces. Makes 3 1/2 quarts of soup.

name: MIRACLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Make small cookies.  Bake at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. steak
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  small garlic
1/2  green pepper
3  Tbsp. shortening
1  diced onion
1  diced celery
2  c. cooked tomatoes
parsley
preparation: Cut meat in small cubes.  Combine the flour, salt and pepper. Roll meat in flour mix.  Add few pieces to remaining ingredients, except parsley.  Bring liquid to boil, then simmer meat and mix together for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  Remove from heat and sprinkle with parsley.

name: SNOWBALL CAKE
ingredients:
1  large angel food cake, cubed
2  pkg. plain gelatin
4  Tbsp. cold water
1  c. boiling water
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. pineapple juice
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
juice of 1 lemon
3  pkg. Dream Whip
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in cold water and then add boiling water; cool.  Mix pineapple with juice, sugar, salt and lemon juice into gelatin; wait for it to begin to jell.  Add cubes of cake and a portion of gelatin mixture until all is used.  Place in mold and refrigerate overnight.  Ice with package of Dream Whip and spread with coconut.

name: CRANBERRY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
12  oz. cranberries, washed and stemmed
2  pears or apples, unpeeled and sliced thin
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. chopped pecans
1/2  stick butter
3/4  c. Quaker oats
preparation: Mix fruit, sugar and cinnamon and put in lightly greased casserole.  Mix brown sugar, flour, pecans, butter and Quaker oats and sprinkle over fruit mixture.  Bake at 375° for about 40 minutes.

name: TOMATO ROSE
ingredients:
4  large tomatoes
1/4  c. green onions
1/4  c. celery
1/2  c. green pepper
1/2  pkg. Italian salad dressing mix
3  Tbsp. wine vinegar
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1/2  c. cooking wine
garlic salt
preparation: Chop onions and green peppers fine.  Slice tomatoes.  Arrange in a shallow serving bowl.  Combine all remaining ingredients. Add salt.  Pour over tomatoes and chill at least 1 hour.  Serve from bowl or on lettuce leaves.  Yields 6 servings.

name: PASTA PRIMAVERA
ingredients:
8  oz. bow tie pasta
2  c. fresh vegetables, chopped
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. whipping cream
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
3  oz. shredded Parmesan cheese
preparation: Prepare pasta according to package directions; drain.  In 10-inch skillet, cook vegetables in 2 tablespoons of margarine for 4 to 5 minutes.  Melt remaining margarine in 3-quart pan over low heat.  Stir in whipping cream, salt and pepper.  Heat thoroughly. Add pasta, vegetables and Parmesan cheese.  Stir until thoroughly heated.

name: FRIED BAKED APPLES
ingredients:
apples
1  Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
preparation: First, cut apples, then put tablespoon of water, then tablespoon of sugar and tablespoon of cinnamon.  Put in microwave for 5 minutes.

name: BARBECUE SLAW
ingredients:
1  head cabbage
1  onion
1  green pepper
1/2  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. ketchup
preparation: Chop, mix and drain first 3 ingredients.  Add the rest of the ingredients.  Will keep 6 months in refrigerator.

name: CHOCOLATE SYRUP
ingredients:
3/4  c. cocoa
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. hot water
2  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients except vanilla in saucepan.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture boils; cook and stir 3 minutes.  Remove from heat; add vanilla.  Cool.  Pour into container. Cover and refrigerate.  Makes 2 cups of syrup.

name: LEMON MERINGUE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines deluxe lemon cake mix
2  c. prepared lemon pudding
8  oz. Cool Whip, thawed
preparation: Bake cake as directed on package in a 10-inch tube pan.  Cool. Split into 3 layers.  Stir pudding until smooth.  Spread 1/3 of filling between each and layer on top.  Frost sides and center with Cool Whip.  Refrigerate.  Light and delicious.

name: PISTACHIO NUT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  box Jell-O pudding and pie filling (pistachio)
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can chopped pineapple
1/2  c. nuts (any kind), chopped
1  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Let Cool Whip soften to mixable.  Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate before serving.  Will be a slight lime color.

name: POTATO CANDY
ingredients:
1/4  c. hot mashed potatoes
1  tsp. melted butter
1 3/4  c. powdered sugar
1 1/2  c. flaked coconut
dash of salt
1/4  tsp. grated lemon or orange rind
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Combine potatoes  and  butter in medium bowl.  Gradually add sugar;   beat  until  thoroughly  blended.  Add  remaining ingredients, mixing  well.  Drop  by  teaspoonfuls  onto  waxed paper.  Let stand until firm.  Yields approximately 2 dozen.

name: VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  qt. Miracle Whip
1 small  carton cottage cheese
1 small  carton sour cream
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing mix
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. parsley flakes
preparation: Mix well.  Can serve with chips or vegetables.

name: CHRISTMAS CUTOUT COOKIES
ingredients:
5  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. sugar
1  stick butter
1  stick oleo
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Mix flour, baking soda, sugar, butter and oleo into crumbs like pie dough and wet it with sour cream.  Put in refrigerator overnight.

name: BLACK BEANS WITH RICE(Low-fat)
ingredients:
16 to 20  oz. dry black beans
6  c. water
2  c. chicken broth
2  large onions, chopped
1  large green pepper, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  bay leaves
2  tsp. oregano, crushed
1  tsp. salt
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. crushed red pepper
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed tomatoes
1/4  tsp. cumin
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Rinse beans.  In a 4-quart Dutch oven, combine black beans and water.  Bring to boiling.  Reduce heat.  Simmer for 2 minutes. Remove from heat, cover and let stand 1 hour.  Drain and rinse beans.  In the same pot, combine the beans, broth, chopped onions, green pepper, celery, garlic, bay leaves, oregano, salt, red pepper and cumin.  Bring to boiling.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until black beans are tender, stirring in undrained tomatoes the last 15 minutes of cooking.  Discard bay leaves.  Mash beans slightly.  Stir in lemon juice.  Serve atop rice.  Raw chopped onion is good; also a spoonful of nonfat sour cream.

name: ASPARAGUS WITH BACON
ingredients:
1  1/2 Asparagus, cut diagonally into 1 inch pieces
2  Tbsp. Parsley, chopped
2  tsp. Lemon Juice
1/4  tsp. Salt
2  Slices Bacon, crispy cooked and crumbled
preparation: Steam asparagus about 7 minutes. Mix asparagus, parsley, lemon juice and salt. Sprinkle with bacon.

name: LAST MINUTE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. water
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. diced cheese
2  c. uncooked macaroni
1 (16 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown meat; salt and pepper.  Drain fat off meat and add onions.  Mix and add all other ingredients.  Toss.  Pour into a large 2 1/2 or 3-quart baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. beef steak, cut into strips
1  large bag noodles
1 large  can cream of mushroom soup
1  onion, chopped
1  tsp. garlic powder
8  oz. sour cream
preparation: Brown steak strips, onion and garlic powder together.  Add soup and let simmer.  Cook noodles separately, drain and add to beef mixture.  Before serving, add the sour cream.

name: MAYONNAISE DRESSING
ingredients:
2  eggs (raw)
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
juice of 1/2 lemon
2  c. oil
preparation: Process the eggs, mustard, salt and lemon until lemon yellow. Slowly add the oil.

name: SNOW ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. whipping cream
1 1/3  c. sugar
5  qt. fresh snow, don't pack
1/2  c. half and half
preparation: Whip cream to soft peaks; add sugar.  Fold in half and half and vanilla.  Add snow and beat.  Cover and place in freezer.

name: CANDIED YAMS
ingredients:
1/2  bag small marshmallows
6  fresh sweet potatoes
1  lb. sugar
cinnamon
nutmeg
1  stick butter
cherries
preparation: Scrub sweet potatoes.  Boil until tender.  Cool and peel and cut in half.  Make simple syrup by putting sugar in pot and cover with water.  Cook until the consistency of syrup.   Place potatoes in casserole and pour syrup over potatoes.  Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg, then dot with butter.  Bake on low heat for 1/2 hour. Add marshmallows and cherries; place back in oven and bake until marshmallows are browned.  Keep warm until ready to eat.

name: ANIMAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. margarine (room temperature)
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
3  eggs
7 1/2  c. flour
7 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Refrigerate for 4 hours.  Divide dough into 4 parts.  Roll out 1/4 inch thick.

name: INCREDI-BREAD!
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. yeast
1/4  c. water
dash of sugar
2 1/2  c. hot water
1  c. dry milk
1/3  c. shortening
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
7  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast, water and sugar; set aside.  Mix together hot water and milk.  Combine milk, water, shortening, salt and sugar. Add 4 cups flour.  Beat until smooth.  Add yeast.  Mix well and let rise for 45 minutes.  Add 2 more cups of flour; mix well.  Put remaining 1 cup of flour on breadboard and knead until all gone. Grease a large bowl.  Put the dough into the bowl and turn to grease dough.  Let rise 20 minutes.  Punch down.  Repeat 2 more times.

name: "COOL AS A CUCUMBER" SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. cooked rice
1/2  c. chopped cucumbers
1/2  c. chopped tomatoes
2  Tbsp. chopped green onions with tops
1/2  c. reduced calorie cucumber dressing
6  hard-cooked eggs, quartered
lettuce leaves (optional)
preparation: In large bowl, combine rice, cucumbers, tomatoes and green onions.  Add dressing and eggs; toss gently until ingredients are evenly coated with dressing.  Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours.  Serve on lettuce, if desired.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
8  oz. cream cheese (room temp.)
1  can sweetened condensed milk
2  tsp. lemon juice
8  oz cool whip
preparation: Cream together peanut butter and cream cheese. Add milk, lemon juice and cool whip. Pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
3  tsp. vanilla
1  c. oil
2  c. grated zucchini
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. cinnamon
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Beat eggs lightly; add sugar, vanilla, oil and zucchini.  Sift dry ingredients; add to mix.  Add nuts.  Divide into 2 loaf pans, well-greased.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: OATMEAL PANCAKES
ingredients:
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. quick cooking oats
3/4  c. buttermilk (powdered formula will work)
1/4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
preparation: Beat all ingredients in a medium bowl with a hand beater until smooth (for thinner pancakes, stir in 2 to 4 tablespoons additional milk).  Grease a heated griddle if necessary.  (To see if griddle is hot enough, sprinkle with a few drops of water; if bubbles skitter around, heat is just right.)  For each pancake, pour about 1/4 cup of batter onto the hot griddle.  Cook until pancakes are puffed and dry around edges.  Turn and cook other side until golden brown.  Makes 10 to 12 pancakes.

name: RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. onion soup mix
2  c. water
1  c. rice (may use Minute rice)
1  can mushrooms (optional)
1  stick margarine
preparation: Melt butter in pan and pour in rice; brown.  Pour in water, onion soup mix and mushrooms.  Bake 40 minutes at 350°.  Bake, uncovered.

name: CRACKER CANDY
ingredients:
Saltine crackers
2  sticks butter
1  c. brown sugar
chocolate chips
preparation: Line cookie sheet with foil and cover with saltine crackers. Boil butter and brown sugar for 3 minutes until frothy. Pour over crackers. Bake at 400° for 5 minutes. It will bubble. Remove from oven and sprinkle with chocolate chips. Let set 5 minutes. Spread chocolate with spatula. Refrigerate at least 1 hour; break into pieces.

name: LEMON BISQUE
ingredients:
1  pkg. (20 sq.) graham crackers, crushed
1/2  stick margarine, melted
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream, softened
6  oz. frozen lemonade, thawed
preparation: Mix graham crackers and sugar.  Melt margarine and mix with cracker mixture.  Press in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.  Let cool.  Stir lemonade into ice cream. Pour over crust.  Freeze.

name: BACON DRESSING
ingredients:
4  slices bacon, diced fine
1/2  small onion, chopped
1/4  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Fry bacon until crisp; add onion and cook over low heat until onion is tender but not brown.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bring to steaming point and pour over leaf lettuce or spinach.  Serves 4.

name: GREEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger meat
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  can green chili peppers
1  c. milk
1  c. grated cheese
2  pkg. tortillas (10 count)
preparation: Brown hamburger; season to taste.  Dip tortillas in boiling water.  Roll hamburger in tortilla.  Place in an 8 x 11-inch pan. Spread chopped green peppers and cheese on top.  Combine soup and milk; heat until smooth.  Pour over enchiladas and bake until cheese is melted.

name: BROCCOLI/CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen broccoli
1  can creamed corn
1  egg
1  c. herb stuffing
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onions
3  Tbsp. margarine
salt and pepper to taste
lemon pepper to taste
preparation: Melt margarine and toss stuffing in it.  Mix other ingredients and add 1/2 stuffing mixture.  Put in a pan; sprinkle remaining stuffing over top.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  pkg. chocolate instant pudding mix
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. oil
3  eggs
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix dry ingredients, except chocolate chips.  Combine all other ingredients; mix well, then add chocolate chips last.   Pour into greased and floured tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.

name: CHICKEN-ITALIAN DRESSING BAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Italian seasoned bread crumbs
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/8  tsp. salt
4  chicken breast halves, skinned and boned
1/4  c. commercial Italian salad dressing
vegetable cooking spray
preparation: Combine bread crumbs, cheese and salt in a plastic bag.  Shake to mix.  Dip chicken in salad dressing.  Place 1 piece of chicken in bag; shake to coat.  Repeat procedure with remaining chicken. Place in a lightly greased pan.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Spray chicken with cooking spray; bake an additional 5 to 10 minutes, or until done.  Yields 4 servings.

name: AUNT KATIE'S CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. lard
1/2  c. cocoa
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
2  tsp. soda
salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Cream the sugar, lard, cocoa and eggs together, then add the rest of the ingredients.  Put batter into greased and floured pans and bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

name: CHEESECAKE TARTLETS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
18  vanilla wafers
strawberry pie filling
preparation: Mix all together, except wafers, in mixer.  Put on wafer in bottom of each paper muffin cup.  Put mixture on top of wafer. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Top with filling.  You can use different pie filling.

name: BAKED POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
6  baked potatoes
2  cans Campbell's chicken broth
2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. half and half
1  tsp. parsley
1  tsp. chives
2  Tbsp. oleo
preparation: Bring soup, broth, flour, half and half, parsley, chives and oleo to a boil.  Turn heat down to a simmer and add potatoes (cut into large chunks).  Simmer for 20 minutes.  Serve with chopped green onions, grated cheese and bacon pieces.

name: DANG GOOD PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  stick oleo, melted
3  eggs
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. shredded coconut
2  Tbsp. flour
1  (9-inch) pie shell
preparation: Mix flour and sugar.  Add melted butter and well beaten eggs. Add  pineapple,  coconut and vanilla.  Put in raw crust and bake until  knife stuck in center of pie comes out clean. Start at 400° for 10 minutes.  Then turn to 325° for remainder of baking time.

name: PECAN PUFFS
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
2  egg whites
1  Tbsp. vanilla
3 to 4  c. pecan halves
preparation: Beat egg whites until stiff.  Add brown sugar and vanilla. Stir in pecan halves with a spoon.  Drop one by one on a greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 250° for 30 minutes.

name: EASY FETTUCINI
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
3  c. hot cooked noodles
4  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Heat soup, milk and cheese.  Toss noodles with butter. Combine.  Serve with extra Parmesan cheese.

name: HOT CHEESE SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. real mayonnaise
1  onion, grated
preparation: Mix.  Spread about 1/4 cup of mix on a slice of bread and top with second slice.  Trim crust and slice in fourths after desired number of sandwiches have been prepared.  (Mix will keep 2 weeks in refrigerator.)  Bake at 425° until light brown.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage
3/4  stick butter
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese, chopped
1 (10 oz.)  can mushroom soup
1  c. buttered bread crumbs (5 to 6 pieces bread)
salt and red pepper to taste (cayenne)
preparation: Coarsely chop cabbage, remove core and boil until tender in salted water; set aside.  Wilt onion in melted butter.  Add cheese.  When melted, add soup.  When blended add boiled cabbage and mix well.  Add spices.  Put into 1 1/2-quart greased casserole.  Sprinkle bread crumbs on top and bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350° in oven.

name: AUNT SHARON'S PUMPKIN NUT LOAF
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
2 3/4  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. pumpkin pie spice
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (1 lb.)  can pumpkin
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat shortening until light and fluffy.  Add sugar gradually. Beat in eggs.  Blend together flour, pumpkin pie spice, baking powder, baking soda and salt.  Stir into sugar mixture.  Add pumpkin and vanilla; mix well until blended.  Fold in nuts.  Pour into 2 greased 9 x 5 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: DANG GOOD PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. undrained crushed pineapple
1  c. coconut
3  eggs, lightly beaten
3  Tbsp. flour
3/4  stick oleo
1  unbaked pie shell (9-inch)
preparation: Melt oleo and add all ingredients.  Stir well.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes or until center is set.

name: ZUCCHINI APPETIZERS
ingredients:
3  c. thinly sliced unpared zucchini (4 to 6 small zucchini)
1  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. oregano leaves, crushed
dash of pepper
1  clove garlic, pressed
1/2  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs, slightly beaten
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease oblong pan.  Mix all ingredients. Spread in pan.  Bake until golden brown, about 25 minutes.  Cut into small squares.  May be frozen before reheating.  Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese before reheating.

name: CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. cocoa
1  c. hot water
2  c. flour
2 1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
2  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix cocoa in hot water; add remaining ingredients; beat well. Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.  Remove from oven, cool slightly and frost.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH SPECTACULAR
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
1  stick margarine, softened
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  (13 oz.) Cool Whip, thawed
2 (3 3/4 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch instant pudding mix
3  c. cold milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix flour, margarine and pecans together for crust; pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Let cool.  Cream together powdered sugar and cream cheese; fold in half of the Cool Whip whipped topping.  Spread over cooled crust.  Beat together pudding mix and milk for 2 to 3 minutes, stir in vanilla.  Spread over cream cheese layer, then spread the remaining half of the whipped topping over the butterscotch layer.  Top with a few additional chopped pecans.  Refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours or overnight before serving.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  box twists or shells, cooked and drained
2  cans mushroom soup
1  lb. County Line cheese, cut up
preparation: Mix all together; put in crock-pot.  Cook for 2 or 3 hours. Great to take for carry-ins.

name: SHREDDED BEEF
ingredients:
17 1/2  oz. cooked beef, shredded
2  slices tomatoes
1/2  onion, sliced
1  head lettuce, sliced or shredded
1  avocado, peeled and sliced
5 1/2  oz. Chambourcy cheese, cubed
2  Tbsp. cilantro
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix all of the ingredients in a bowl. Add any dressing that you like. You may serve it on large pieces of Mexican tortilla chips.

name: BUTTERED FISH FILLETS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/4  lb. white fish fillets
salt and pepper
paprika
preparation: Melt butter in a glass custard cup or glass measuring cup in microwave about 15 seconds on High.  Put fish into a 2-quart glass baking dish, brush with melted butter and sprinkle with salt, pepper and paprika.  Cover with waxed paper.  Cook for 3 minutes on High or until fish flakes when tested with a fork.  Makes 4 to 5 servings.

name: BUCKEYES
ingredients:
2  sticks real butter
2/3  c. extra crunchy peanut butter
2/3  lb. powdered sugar
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. chopped peanuts
1 large  pkg. chocolate chips
1  tsp. paraffin (not necessary, just helps make the chocolate shiny)
preparation: Mix all the ingredients, except the chips together in a large bowl.  Roll into balls and place on tray.  Freeze the balls for 20 minutes.  Next, melt the chips and add the paraffin if available. Use toothpicks to dip the balls into the heated chocolate.  Be sure to leave a peanut butter top.  (Hence the Buckeye.)

name: BEEF PARMIGIANA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak (3/8 inch thick)
1  egg, beaten
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/3  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1  medium onion, minced
2  c. water (hot)
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. powdered marjoram
1/2  lb. Mozzarella cheese
1/3  c. oil
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Place meat between pieces of waxed paper larger than the meat and lay on a board.  Pound meat thin (1/4 inch) with a heavy mallet.  Trim off gristle and fat; cut into 6 to 8 pieces.  Dip meat in egg, roll in mixture of Parmesan cheese and crumbs.  Heat oil in skillet, brown steaks on both sides over medium heat until golden brown.  Lay in shallow, wide baking dish.  In same skillet, cook onion over low heat until soft.  Stir in salt, pepper, sugar, marjoram and tomato paste, plus hot water, stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes, scraping browned bits from pan.  Pour most of sauce over meat, top with slices of Mozzarella cheese and remaining sauce.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour or until meat is tender.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  (10 oz.) frozen chopped spinach
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. dry vegetable soup mix (Knorr)
8  oz. can water chestnuts, chopped
3  chopped green onions
preparation: Thaw and  squeeze  spinach  until  dry.  Stir  together spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise, soup mix, water chestnuts and green onions.  Blend  well.  Cover; refrigerate 2 hours.  Stir before serving.

name: TASTY ITALIAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
2 or 3  lb. chicken wings or chicken drummettes
salt and pepper to taste
1  bottle Italian dressing
preparation: Wash and clean chicken.  Place in bowl.  Pour Italian dressing over and let set overnight.  Place in pan or baking dish. Cover with foil.  Cook in oven until chicken is tender. During the cooking, turn and check the chicken for tenderness.

name: ONION ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton onion soup mix
2  lb. red potatoes, peeled and cut in large chunks
1/3  c. olive or vegetable oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  In a large plastic bag or bowl, add all ingredients.  Close bag and shake or toss in the bowl until coated evenly.  Empty potatoes into a shallow baking dish or roasting pan. Bake, stirring occasionally, about 40 minutes until tender and golden brown.  Garnish with chopped parsley.  Makes 8 servings.

name: CITRUS AND PAPAYA SALAD
ingredients:
1  tsp. finely shredded Florida orange peel
1/4  c. Florida orange juice
1/4  c. salad oil
1 1/2  tsp. poppy seed
1  papaya
2  Florida red grapefruit
1  head Belgian endive or Boston or bibb
1/3  c. sliced almonds
preparation: For dressing, in a screw top jar combine orange peel, orange juice, salad oil and poppy seed.  Cover and shake well.  Chill for at least 1 hour.

name: CHOW CHOW
ingredients:
4  c. onions, chopped
1  medium cabbage
12  green tomatoes
6  green peppers
6  red peppers
1/2  c. salt
6  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. celery seed
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
1-1/2  tsp. turmeric
3  c. cider vinegar
2  c. water
preparation: Chop vegetables (coarse).  Sprinkle with salt.  Let stand over night.  Drain and rinse.  Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over vegetable mixture.  Heat to boil.  Simmer 3 minutes. Fill hot sterilized jars and seal.  Yield:  about 8 pints.

name: APPLE BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. butter
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. grated apples
1/2  c. walnuts
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour in greased and floured pan or muffin tin.

name: BOILED CRAWFISH AND CRABS
ingredients:
3 1/2  boxes salt
8  oz. cayenne pepper
4  bags crab boil
1 small  bottle liquid crab boil
6  lemons, cut like twister fries
10  lb. new potatoes
8  ears corn, cut in half
4  large onions, quartered
6  cloves garlic
2  bunches celery
7  gal. water (large pot)
bag of ice
30 to 40  lb. sack crabs or crawfish
preparation: Bring water to a boil. Add salt; mix and taste. (If it almost takes your breath, it's enough).  Has to be too salty. Add lemons, onions, celery, garlic, pepper and crab boil (both kinds).  Let come to a hard boil.  Put in crawfish and let come to a boil again.  Time 5 minutes. Add potatoes and corn. After 2 1/2 minutes, turn off flame. Add bag of ice to cool.  Let stand for 20 to 30 minutes.  Boil crabs  10 minutes to boil.  The rest is same as crawfish.  Turn crabs stomach up when taking out of pot; it holds in seasoning.

name: WHITE BEAN CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. dried Great Northern white beans
2  lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1  medium onion, diced
12  oz. can chopped mild green chilies
1/2  Tbsp. minced garlic
1/8  c. vegetable oil
1/2  gal. chicken stock
3/8  Tbsp. ground cumin
1/2  Tbsp. ground oregano
1/2  Tbsp. onion salt
3/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
3/4  tsp. seasoned salt
8  oz. beer
preparation: Soak beans overnight in cold water.  Wash chicken and cover with 1/2 of spice mixture.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Heat oil in skillet.  Saute onions, chilies and garlic for 1 minute.  Drain beans and add beans and stock to pot.  Add sauteed vegetables, spice mixture and beer.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for about 2 hours or until beans are tender.  Dice chicken into quarter size pieces.  Add to stock and simmer a little longer.

name: ELEPHANT STEW
ingredients:
1  elephant
2  rabbits
lots of gravy
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cut elephant into bite size pieces.  This will take about 2 months.  Add enough brown gravy to cover.  Cook over a wood fire for about 2 weeks.  Season.  This will serve about 3,801 people. If more are expected, add the 2 rabbits, but do so only if necessary, as most people don't like to find hare in their stew.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can artichoke hearts
1  c. mayonnaise, not salad dressing
1  c. Parmesan cheese
garlic, to taste
preparation: Mix together and bake in Pyrex dish at 325° for 25 minutes. Serve with Melba toast or Chicken-in-Biscuit crackers.

name: VEAL PARMESAN
ingredients:
1/4  c. Italian bread crumbs
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. paprika
dash of fresh pepper
5  (3/4-inch) veal loin chops, boned and tenderized until thin
1  beaten egg
2  Tbsp. olive oil
5  slices Mozzarella cheese
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 to 3  cloves garlic, crushed
1  tsp. oregano
1/4  c. Sauterne
dash of Sweet 'N Low
preparation: Mix crumbs, Parmesan cheese, salt, paprika and pepper.  Dip chops in egg, then in crumbs.  Brown in oil.  Place slice of Mozzarella cheese in each.  Mix tomato sauce, garlic, wine, oregano and Sweet 'N Low.  Pour over chops.  Simmer 50 minutes.  Serve with linguini.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. diced chicken
1 1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. dark ripe olives
1/4  c. cashews or almonds
1 1/2  c. green grapes
1  c. salad dressing
1/4  c. cream
3  c. shell macaroni
salt
preparation: Mix together and serve on lettuce leaf or in a bowl.

name: BARBECUE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1 1/2  c. chopped onion
2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. pepper
salt to taste
2  tsp. celery salt
2  tsp. paprika
1/4  c. vinegar
1/2  c. water
1  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Brown hamburger.  Add rest of ingredients and simmer at least one hour.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. mashed bananas
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. nuts
preparation: Cream the shortening, sugar and bananas.  Add eggs.  Sift flour, salt and soda. Add.  Add vanilla and nuts, if desired. Bake.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
3  cans biscuits, cut into fourths
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
chopped pecans
1  stick oleo
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix 1/2 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon together.  Roll biscuits in cinnamon-sugar mixture.

name: WILD RICE CHICKEN SUPREME
ingredients:
1  (6 oz.)  pkg. long grain and wild rice
