1/4  c. margarine
1/3  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  c. milk
1  c. chicken broth
2  c. or more cubed cooked chicken
1/3  c. diced pimento (optional)
1/3  c. chopped fresh parsley (optional)
1/4  c. chopped slivered almonds (optional)
preparation: Cook rice according to package directions.  Meanwhile, cook onion in margarine until tender.  Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Gradually stir in milk and broth.  Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.  Stir in chicken, rice and any remaining ingredients.  Pour into greased 2-quart casserole dish.  Bake, uncovered,  at 400° for 30 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: HOT CRAB DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. crab meat
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  c. mayo
2  tsp. dry mustard
2  tsp. powdered sugar
2  tsp. grated onion
pepper to taste
garlic salt to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° until bubbly.  Delicious. Serve with an assortment of crackers.

name: "COPPER PENNIES" OR MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
5  c. carrots, cooked until tender only
1  medium onion, chopped up
1  small green sweet pepper, chopped
3/4  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
10  oz. can tomato soup
1/2  c. Wesson or Crisco oil
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: After cooking carrots, drain water off.  Add all ingredients (already combined) to them while hot.  Will keep for days.

name: FATTIGMAN(Crisp Pastry Cookie)
ingredients:
6  egg yolks
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
2 1/4  c. sifted milk
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  Tbsp. grated lemon peel
cooking oil
confectioners sugar
preparation: Beat together egg yolks and salt until thick and light.  Beat in light cream, sugar and butter.  Sift together flour and nutmeg. Add to egg yolk mixture with lemon peel, mixing well.  Chill for 1 hour.  Roll out 1/4 of dough at a time.  Keep remaining dough chilled.  Roll to 1/16-inch thick and cut in strips about 1 1/2-inch wide with sharp knife.  Cut diagonally at 4-inch intervals.  Make 1-inch slits lengthwise in center of each piece. Slip one end through slit.  Fry a few at a time in deep, hot oil at 350° for 1 to 2 minutes or until golden.  Remove from oil with slotted spoon.  Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with sifted confectioners sugar.  Store in airtight container.  Makes 6 dozen.

name: NELLOU'S FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
15  to 20 maraschino cherries
1 large  can chunk pineapple
1  can mandarin oranges
1  large banana, sliced
1 (4 oz.)  box vanilla pudding (cook type)
preparation: Drain 1 cup pineapple juice.  Mix the juice with the dry pudding.  Microwave on High for 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 minutes.  Let cool. Mix pineapple chunks, drained oranges, banana and halved cherries.  Fold the cooled pudding mix into the fruit. Refrigerate.

name: LOW-FAT STRAWBERRY TEA BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
4  Egg Beaters (1 carton)
1 1/2  c. liquid Butter Buds
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1  c. Grape-Nuts cereal
preparation: Cream together Egg Beaters, liquid Butter Buds, sugar and strawberries.  Sift together the dry ingredients and blend with strawberries.  Stir in Grape-Nuts.  Pour into 2 loaf pans that have been sprayed with a nonfat cooking spray.  Bake at 325° for 55 to 60 minutes.  Cook on wire rack.  Only .09 g fat per slice.

name: SCALLOPED PINEAPPLE
ingredients:
3  c. bread, broken (but not fine pieces)
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple (including syrup)
1  c. sugar (1/2 brown and 1/2 white)
1  stick margarine, softened
preparation: Mix all.  Pour into 10 x 10 x 2-inch casserole.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour or until brown.  Cut into squares.  Good warm or cold.  Good with ham.  Quite rich.

name: PORK CHOPS AND RICE
ingredients:
2  cans Campbell's onion soup
1  stick butter
4  or 5 pork chops
2  c. Minute rice (raw)
preparation: Heat soup and butter until all melted. Do not dilute.  Heat this in a 10-inch skillet.  Then pour in 2 cups of rice. Mix well. Place 4 or 5 pork chops on top of rice mixture.  Cut off extra fat from the pork chops.  Spoon a little of the juice over chops. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour, uncovered, or until pork chops are nice and brown on top.

name: TEX-MEX SPECIAL
ingredients:
3  avocados
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
12  oz. sour cream
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1 (16 oz.)  can refried beans
2  chopped fresh tomatoes
1/2  c. chopped green onion
8  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
coarse ground pepper
preparation: Mash avocados and lemon juice in medium mixing bowl.  Set aside. Combine sour cream with seasoned salt in small mixing bowl. Set aside.  In base of 9-inch pie plate, spread refried beans. Layer the avocado mixture, sour cream and tomatoes, making smaller circles with each layer.   Sprinkle with green onions and cheese. Top with ground pepper.  Serve with chips.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. macaroni
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped pimiento
1  lb. grated hoop cheese
1  can mushroom soup
3/4  c. milk or cream
salt and pepper
1/2  c. cracker crumbs
preparation: Cook macaroni according to package.  Mix macaroni, onion, pimiento, grated cheese (reserve 1/4 cup), milk and mushroom soup together.  Season with salt and pepper.  Pour into a greased casserole.  Sprinkle with reserved cheese and cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: COCONUT MACAROONS
ingredients:
3  egg whites (room temperature)
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
12  oz. flaked coconut
1/2  c. shortening
preparation: Mix and spoon onto cookie sheet with foil.  Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.

name: Pretty Pumpkin 4-Layer Torte
ingredients:
1  pkg. spice cake mix
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
2  tsp. soda
2  eggs
1/3  c. water
1 (4 1/2 to 5 oz.)  pkg. vanilla pudding
2 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
2  c. whipping cream
1  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. milk
1 3/8  oz. box Milk Duds
preparation: Mix cake mix, pumpkin, soda, eggs and water together.  Bake in 2 circular cake pans at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cool and split each half to make 4 layers.

name: STRAWBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  pt. strawberries
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  small container small curd cottage cheese
1  large Cool Whip
1  large strawberry Jell-O
preparation: Drain pineapple well.  Mix Cool Whip, strawberry Jell-O, cottage cheese and drained pineapple in a large bowl.  Cut strawberries in small chunks and fold into mixture carefully. Chill for about 1 hour.  Serve cold.

name: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. Borden salad dressing
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can Stokely's fruit cocktail
1  can Stokely's pineapple chunks, drained
12  to 15 maraschino cherries, drained
1/2  lb. marshmallows, cut fine
1/2  pt. Oakfarms whipping cream, whipped
2  Tbsp. sugar
cherry juice for color
preparation: Mash and stir cheese until softened.  Blend in salad dressing until smooth.  Add fruits and cream which has been whipped stiff with the sugar.  Add enough cherry juice to give color, then spoon into molds and freeze firm.  Cover tops with wax paper before freezing.

name: CURRIED FRUIT
ingredients:
28  oz. can each: pineapple chunks, peaches, pears, cherries, apricots, mandarin oranges
2  Tbsp. melted butter
2 to 4  Tbsp. curry
1/2  c. brown sugar
dash of salt
preparation: Drain all fruit. Combine all ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BAKED VIDALIA ONIONS
ingredients:
4  Vidalia onions
4  beef bouillon cubes
salt and pepper
butter or margarine
preparation: Peel onions; cut out root end in wedge.  Insert beef bouillon cube, salt, pepper and seal top of hole with butter or margarine. Wrap in foil and bake at 350° for about an hour.

name: EXCELLENT LONDON BROIL
ingredients:
London broil (whatever size needed)
2/3  c. red wine
1/3  c. olive oil
2  large diced garlic cloves
1/2  tsp. thyme and black pepper
1/4  tsp. basil and marjoram
preparation: Marinate the London broil in the wine, oil, garlic, thyme, black pepper, basil and marjoram for 2 hours or overnight.  You may broil the steak on the grill, but I remove it from the marinade, wrap it tightly in foil and cook at 450° for 45 minutes to 1 hour until desired doneness.  Do not overcook or it will be tough.  Slice in very thin strips.

name: BREAD PUDDING FOR A CROWD(Abington Grange Supper)
ingredients:
1  gal. milk
8  c. stale bread cubes *
10  eggs
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. nutmeg
2  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  c. melted butter
1  c. raisins
preparation: Heat the milk in double boiler (I use 2 mixing bowls set in large kettles) until bubbly around the edges.  The butter can be melted in the milk.  Beat eggs lightly, add sugar and flavorings. Put bread cubes in baking pan (10 x 18 x 2 1/2-inches).  Mix hot milk, eggs and flavorings.  Pour over bread.  Sprinkle raisins on top and try to submerge them somewhat with a rubber spatula.  This will prevent them from sinking to the bottom or clumping together. Put your large broiler pan filled with water on lower oven rack and set pudding pan on a rack above.  Bake about 1 hour or until a dinner knife inserted in the middle comes out clean.  Serves 36.

name: FRESH FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2  oranges
2  apples
2  bananas
1/4  c. chopped walnuts
1/3  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Peel oranges, apples and bananas and dice.  Add nuts, sugar and lemon juice and mix well.  This salad is best served as a dessert.  Serves 4.

name: HASH BROWN POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 large bag  square chunk hash browns
1  stick melted butter
16  oz. sour cream
1  can creamy chicken or mushroom soup
2 1/2  c. crushed corn flakes
1  stick melted butter
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients together.  Spread into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Mix crushed corn flakes and melted butter together; spread on top of potato mix.  Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: BARBECUE PORK RIBS
ingredients:
4  lb. spareribs (country)
1 1/2  c. water
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  can tomato sauce
2  medium onions, chopped
1 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Mix all ingredients; bring to a boil.  Pour over meat.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1  can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
3/4  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. garlic
1  pkg. dry Italian salad dressing mix (I use Good Seasons)
1 small  can deveined shrimp (small) or crabmeat (I use shrimp)
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and refrigerate overnight.  Serve with crackers.

name: CHICKEN PARMESAN PIZZA(Makes 4 to 6 Servings)
ingredients:
10  oz. chicken breasts, skinned, boned and cut into 1-inch slices
1/4  c. flour
vegetable oil
2  c. tomato sauce, divided
1  (12-inch) Boboli brand Italian bread shell
3/4  c. Kraft natural shredded low-moisture part-skim Mozzarella cheese, divided
8  black olives, pitted and halved
1  Tbsp. Kraft 100% grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. dried oregano leaves, crushed
preparation: Dredge chicken in flour.  Pour oil into large skillet 1-inch deep.  Heat oil over medium-high heat until hot.  Add chicken; fry until chicken is tender and golden brown.  Remove to a paper towel with slotted spoon to absorb excess oil.  Spread 1 cup tomato sauce over Boboli Italian bread shell, leaving 1-inch border. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese.  Top with chicken, remaining 1 cup tomato sauce and olives.  Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup Mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese and oregano.  Bake on ungreased baking sheet in lower 1/3 of oven at 450° for about 8 to 10 minutes or until puffed and lightly browned.

name: INDIANA'S BEST PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. white corn syrup
1  c. brown sugar
1/3  tsp. salt
1/3  c. melted oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. pecan pieces (or whole)
preparation: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Pour into 9-inch pie pan.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. Minute rice
1  c. cold water
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
2/3  stick margarine, melted
1  pkg. chopped broccoli (frozen)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake for 1 hour at 300°.

name: NEVER FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1 3/4  c. shortening
1  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vinegar
1  egg
1/2  c. water
preparation: Mix flour, shortening, sugar and salt.  Mix water, egg and vinegar with a fork and add to flour.  Chill for 15 minutes.  Dough can be stored in refrigerator for 3 days or frozen until ready to use.  Makes 2 double crusts for 9-inch shell.

name: CLAY(Kids Stuff)
ingredients:
1  c. salt
1/2  c. flour
1  c. water
preparation: Cook over medium heat until it is thick and rubbery.  Let cool.

name: CORNBREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  pan Old-Fashioned Egg Cornbread
4  eggs
4  to 6 stalks celery, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. sage
6  slices white bread, crumbled
1  large onion, chopped
stock from turkey or chicken
2  Tbsp. poultry seasoning
preparation: Saute onion and celery.  Crumble cornbread and add white bread, onion, celery, eggs, salt, pepper, sage, poultry seasoning and stock (may use canned stock and some water).  Mix well; the mixture should be the consistency of thick cornbread batter.  Pour into a large, oblong pan, greased or sprayed with Pam.  Cook at 350° for 1 hour or until firm and browned on top.

name: APPLE PIE
ingredients:
2  cans apple pie filling
loaf of bread
1  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
1  egg
3 heaping  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Put pie filling in dish.  Place enough thick loaf bread with crust cut to cover top of pie.  Melt margarine.  Add sugar, flour and egg.  Stir.  Pour this over bread.  Let stand 10 or 15 minutes.  Bake in a 350° oven until golden brown.

name: TASTY APPLE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine
6  c. chopped apples
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix sugar, margarine, eggs and add apples.  Mix well.  Mix dry ingredients and add to apple mixture.  Mix this recipe by hand.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. quick cook rolled oats
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/4  c. flour
2  egg whites, stiffly beaten
preparation: In mixing bowl, stir together oats, sugar, butter and flour. Fold in egg white until well blended.  Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets.  Bake in 350° oven until golden, about 12 minutes.  Remove to wire rack to cool.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: CHICKEN KRAUT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  strips bacon
1/3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. onion, chopped
1  clove garlic
1/2  tsp. thyme
2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  Tbsp. Lawry's Choice seasoning
4  to 6 chicken breasts, halved
1  qt. jar or 2 (15 oz.) cans sauerkraut
approximately 1 1/2 c. chicken broth
preparation: Fry bacon crisp, drain, then crumble.  Roll chicken in 1/3 cup of flour; brown in small amount of oil.  Using the same pan, saute onions, garlic and thyme.  Blend 2 tablespoons flour with onion mixture.  Gradually add chicken broth; cook until thickened.  Stir in bacon, kraut, sugar and seasonings; bring to a boil.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Lay chicken on top; cover.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.  Uncover the last 15 minutes to brown.  May be frozen before baking.

name: CHICKEN LUNCHEON CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  boneless chicken breasts, cooked (Market Day chicken steaks work great!)
16  slices sandwich bread (crust cut off)
8  slices American cheese
6  eggs, beaten
3  c. milk
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. onion salt
margarine
preparation: Grease a large baking dish with margarine.  Lay 8 slices of bread, flat.  Slice a chicken breast on each piece of bread.  Top with a slice of cheese and another slice of bread.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE 2
ingredients:
1  box white cake or strawberry supreme cake mix
1  box small strawberry jello (3 oz.)
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
1  c. Wesson oil
3  Tbsp. self-rising flour
3  eggs
1  c. pecans
1  pkg. frozen coconut
1/2  stick margarine, melted
1  box powdered sugar
preparation: Let strawberries thaw to room temperature.  Mix into bowl the cake mix, jello mix, Wesson oil, 1/2 cup of strawberry juice from frozen strawberries, self-rising flour and eggs.   Blend well.  In a separate bowl, mix together 1 cup strawberries, pecans and coconut.  Mix well, then add 1/2 of mixture into cake batter and reserve other 1/2 for frosting.  Bake cake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
1/4  tsp. soda
3  c. cake flour
1 8  oz. (1 c.) sour cream
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. lemon extract
6  eggs
preparation: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs one at a time. Sift flour and soda together. Add one third of flour, then one half sour cream, another one third of flour, sour cream, etc. Add vanilla and lemon extract. Bake in tube pan one hour and 15 minutes or until done at 325°.

name: PEANUT BUTTER TEMPTATIONS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
48  miniature peanut butter cups
preparation: Cream butter and peanut butter; gradually add sugar, beating until light and fluffy.  Add egg and vanilla, beating well. Combine flour, soda and salt.  Add to cream mixture, mixing well. Chill dough for 1 hour.  Shape dough into 1-inch balls.  Place in lightly greased mini muffin pan.  Shape balls into a shell by pressing thumb in center.   Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.  Remove from oven and immediately place peanut butter cup in center of hot crust.   Cool before removing from pan.  Yield:  4 dozen cookies.

name: SAVORY CRESCENT CHICKEN SQUARES
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
6  Tbsp. melted butter
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  c. cooked, cubed chicken
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. pepper
8  Tbsp. milk
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. crescent rolls
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Blend cream cheese and 2 tablespoons of butter until smooth.   Add chopped onion, chicken, salt, pepper and milk.   Separate crescent rolls into 4 rectangles.  Pat out seams.  Spoon 1/2 cup chicken mixture onto crescent rolls.  Seal edges completely.  Place sealed side on baking sheet.  Brush with butter.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI PIZZA
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. zucchini, coarsely grated (4 medium size)
2  eggs, beaten
1/3  c. flour
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1 1/2  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
salt and pepper to taste
olive oil
8  oz. pizza sauce
preparation: Lightly salt the zucchini and let stand for 15 minutes; squeeze out excess moisture.

name: CEVICHE
ingredients:
2  lb. scallops or halibut
2  c. lemon juice
2  c. chopped onion
1 3/4  c. fresh peeled, seeded and chopped tomatoes
1/2  c. tomato juice
2  green chiles, chopped
12  green olives, chopped
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. Tabasco sauce
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Cut fish into bite size pieces and marinate in lemon juice at least 6 hours.  Mix together remaining ingredients except parsley. Drain off 1 cup lemon juice. Stir in remaining ingredients and marinate overnight in the refrigerator.  Before serving, stir in the chopped parsley.  Serve in stemmed glasses on a lettuce cup. Glass shows off the pretty colors.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  (6 oz.) strawberry jello
1  c. boiling water
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
3  bananas, mashed
1  large frozen strawberries, half thawed
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Combine all except sour cream.  In clear glass dish, congeal half.  After congealed, spread sour cream over it.  Pour other half of salad over sour cream.   Congeal overnight.

name: BEEF AND POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. boiling water
1  onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
4  to 6 potatoes, thinly sliced
preparation: Brown beef; drain.  To the boiling water, add onion and simmer 5 minutes.  Add soup, salt and pepper to cooked onion.  Cover bottom of 1 1/2-quart casserole with layer of potatoes.  Cover with thin layer of ground beef.  Top with onion-soup mixture. Continue alternating layers.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes to 1 hour or until potatoes are tender.   If needed, add extra water. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: PENNE WITH GRILLED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  lb. boneless chicken breast, cut in strips
8  oz. (1 pkg.) pignolias (pine nut)
1  yellow pepper, cut in strips
1  pkg. sun dried tomatoes
1/4  onion
2  cloves garlic
6  oz. light cream
4  oz. heavy whipping cream
8  oz. white wine
salt and black pepper
4  oz. Gorgonzola cheese or Blue cheese
16  oz. penne pasta
hot red peppers (optional)
preparation: Saute chicken with onion, garlic  and  wine for 5 to 10 minutes.  Meanwhile broil pine  nuts  and yellow pepper strips until brown.  Add yellow  peppers, creams (both), salt, pepper and sun dried tomatoes.  Cook until thickened.	Meanwhile cook pasta and drain.	Pour  chicken  and  cream  sauce over pasta. Sprinkle with  the cheese  and  peppers.  Serve  with  garlic bread.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese (room temperature)
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  small bell pepper, chopped fine
1/2  small sweet onion, chopped fine
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix cheese, pineapple, pepper, onion, salt and half of the nuts and shape into a ball.  Roll ball in remaining nuts.  Wrap in foil and refrigerate for 24 hours before serving.  Serve with crackers

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
2/3  c. mayo
2/3  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. dry onion
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. dry parsley
1  Tbsp. Lawry's salt
1/2  tsp. Accent
1  tsp. dill weed
2  drops Tabasco sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and refrigerate overnight.

name: CHERRY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. shortening
3  c. sugar
6  large eggs
3/4  c. milk and cherry juice (to make 1 c.)
3 3/4  c. plain flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  (10 oz.) maraschino cherries
preparation: Cream margarine, shortening and sugar until light.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Mix together milk and cherry juice.  Measure sifted flour and add to first mixture alternately with cherry-milk mixture.  Add 1 teaspoon vanilla.  Stir in half of the cherries. Reserve the rest of cherries for icing.  Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: CREAM CHEESE FLAN
ingredients:
6  large eggs
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1  can water
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. sugar
preparation: Beat eggs and add milk.  Mix cream cheese with one can water until smooth.  Add to egg mixture.  Then add vanilla and mix well. Set aside.  Put sugar in saucepan and cook on high until sugar caramelizes to brown color.  Pour into center of 9 x 5-inch glass baking dish and shift dish from side to side until sugar covers it completely.  Let sugar cool and harden.  Pour flan mixture into dish.  Put dish into a 13 x 9-inch pan and fill with water until it reaches about halfway up flan dish.  Bake at 250° for 2 hours. Cool and refrigerate.  When ready to serve, invert dish onto larger platter and cut into pieces.

name: CHICKEN MUSHROOM SOUP
ingredients:
6  c. chicken broth
1/4  c. celery, diced
1/2  onion, diced
12  mushrooms, sliced
1/2  c. cooked chicken white meat
salt to taste
dash of pepper
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  eggs, well beaten
preparation: Combine broth, celery and onion.  Cook until tender, then add mushrooms and chicken. Boil about 10 minutes.  Add salt, pepper and sauce.  Add eggs gradually and cook until firm.  Serve at once.  Serve hot.

name: CARAMEL DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. white sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine all ingredients and beat until smooth.	Makes a delicious dip for apples.  Keep stored in refrigerator.

name: HEALTHY BLUE CHEESE DIP(Low Fat Dip Recipe)
ingredients:
1/2  cup crumbled Roquefort or blue cheese
2  cups fat-free cottage cheese
1  teaspoon dried onion flakes
1/4  cup skim milk
garlic salt to taste
preparation: Combine and blend above ingredients.  Chill until ready to serve.  Serve with veggies or on salads as a dressing.

name: STUFFED GREEN PEPPERS
ingredients:
6  green peppers
1  lb. hamburger
1/2  onion, chopped
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. salt
1  c. cooked rice
preparation: Slice tops of pepper; take out seeds and wash.  Place peppers in enough hot water to cover them; cook for 5 minutes.  Cook hamburger and onion together until meat is done; drain off grease. Add remaining ingredients; heat.  Fill peppers with stuffing. Cover and cook in a 350° oven for 20 minutes.  Uncover; cook for about 10 minutes.

name: HAM AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
2  c. ham, cut up
1 1/2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar
1  c. Bisquick
4  eggs
3  c. milk
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Cook broccoli according to directions; drain well.  Spread broccoli into ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Layer ham and cheese over broccoli.  Beat milk and eggs; add Bisquick and beat until smooth.  Pour slowly over cheese. Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: LEMON COCONUT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  (2-layer) yellow cake mix
1 large  pkg. instant lemon pudding
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. water
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix everything together.  Spoon a teaspoon of dough onto cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° just until edges of cookie turn brown. Don't overbake.

name: PEANUT BUTTER AND CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. light brown sugar, packed
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. chunky peanut butter
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. large chocolate chips or chunks
1/2  c. peanut butter chips
preparation: In bowl, beat butter until light and creamy.  Beat in brown and granulated sugars.  Beat in eggs, one at a time, until blended.  Beat in peanut butter.  Stir together the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt.  Stir into peanut butter mixture. Stir in chocolate and peanut butter chips.  Spoon about 1/4 cup dough for each cookie onto lightly greased baking sheet, about 2 inches apart.  Bake at 350° for 14 to 16 minutes, or until golden brown.  Remove from oven.  Let stand on baking sheet a few minutes, then remove to wire rack to cool.  Makes about 1 1/2 dozen.

name: HAWAIIAN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  pineapple
1  cantaloupe
1  honeydew melon
1  papaya
1  mango
2  kiwi
1  c. grapes
1  c. halved strawberries
2  ripe bananas, sliced
1  c. sour cream
4  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix together the first 8 ingredients; set aside.  Place the bananas and remaining 3 ingredients in blender on mix setting for just a few seconds, then pour over fruit mixture.  Stir and chill about 1 hour before serving.

name: MAMA'S HOMEMADE ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. milk, scalded
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. Crisco
1  cake yeast
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
2  c. sifted flour
3/4  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: To scalded milk, add sugar and Crisco. Let cool until lukewarm and dissolve yeast cake in it. Beat in the flour. Let rise for 30 minutes. Sift together and add to the mixture baking powder, sifted flour, soda and salt. Put in the refrigerator and let stay until next day. Take out of refrigerator; roll and fold then place in baking pan and let rise for 2 hours before baking at 400°.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker crust
3  oz. cream cheese
1  (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/3  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Cream the powdered sugar and cream cheese.  Add peanut butter, then 1 cup Cool Whip.  Put mixture into crust.  Top with more Cool Whip.

name: WEST OF THE PECOS ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. salt
salt to taste
1/2  lb. Longhorn cheese, grated
1  can chopped ripe olives
1  c. chopped onions
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can tomato soup
1  can mushroom stems and pieces
1  tsp. picante sauce to each enchilada
garlic
2  c. water
1/2  c. cooking oil
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  doz. tortillas
preparation: Brown the beef.  Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and garlic salt. Reserve 1 cup cheese.  Add meat to remaining cheese, olives and onions.  Combine tomato sauce, tomato paste, soup, water, oil, chili powder, garlic powder and 1/2 teaspoon salt.  Simmer.  Dip tortilla in sauce; place a heaping tablespoon of meat in center. Roll.  Lay filled tortillas in baking dish.  Pour 1 cup sauce over tortillas.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Sprinkle with reserved cheese.  Heat until cheese is melted.  Serve with remaining sauce.

name: GARLIC CHEESE GRITS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. grits
4  c. water
1  egg
1  (5 oz.) tube Kraft garlic cheese spread
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Cook grits in water until thick (quick grits cook in 5 minutes, regular grits take about 20 minutes).  Mix egg, margarine and cheese with grits and pour into casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until crusty on top.  Serves 6.

name: FROZEN BUTTERMILK SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar (use to suit your taste)
1  c. buttermilk
2  chopped bananas
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 small  can crushed pineapple and juice
1  large Cool Whip (12 oz.)
preparation: Mix all this together and freeze.

name: PASTA CON PRESTO
ingredients:
2 large  cloves garlic
2  c. tightly packed stemmed Italian parsley
1/2  oz. fresh basil
3  oz. grated Parmesan, preferably imported
1  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. pine nuts
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Chop  2  cloves  of  garlic  in  food processor.  While processor  is still running add fresh Parmesan cheese, Italian parsley, pine nuts, fresh basil, salt and vegetable oil.  When mixture is soft and pasty, spoon sauce over freshly cooked hot spaghetti and mix thoroughly.  Add grated Parmesan as topping.

name: CREAMY LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. cold milk
2  pkg. vanilla flavor instant pudding and pie filling
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
1  (8 oz.) tub Cool Whip
1  pie crust, baked or graham cracker crust
preparation: Pour milk in large bowl. Add pudding mixes. Beat with whisk 30 seconds. Add lemonade. Beat 30 seconds more (mixture will be thick). Stir in whipped topping. Spoon into baked crust. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set. Garnish with lemon slices, if desired. Store leftover pie in refrigerator.

name: COCONUT BALLS
ingredients:
3/4  c. white syrup
2 1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Heat until runny; add coconut.  Set in refrigerator for 1 hour or overnight.  Roll into balls.  Put in freezer.  Dip in chocolate, either bittersweet (like chocolate chips) or milk chocolate, whichever you prefer.

name: CORNCOB JELLY
ingredients:
12  bright red cobs
3  pt. water
1  pkg. Sure-Jell
3  c. sugar
preparation: Boil broken cobs in the water for 30 minutes.  Remove from heat and strain the liquid.  If not 3 cups, add enough water to make 3 cups.  Add Sure-Jell and bring to a rolling boil.  Add sugar and boil 2 to 3 minutes or until jelly stage.  The finished product tastes a lot like apple jelly, has an attractive reddish color.

name: CHOCOLATE PUDDING DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  sticks oleo
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  c. finely chopped nuts
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  large Cool Whip
1 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 small  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: Blend flour, oleo, sugar and nuts and press into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake for 22 minutes at 350° and let cool.  Soften cream cheese and mix powdered sugar and 1/2 of the Cool Whip and spread over crust.  Mix puddings 1 at a time with 1 1/2 cups milk each and spread over cream cheese layer.  Spread with remaining Cool Whip.  Garnish with grated Hershey bar or finely chopped nuts.

name: SAKANA NO MISO YAKI(Broiled Fish With Soybean Paste)
ingredients:
3/4  c. miso (soybean paste)
1/4  c. sake (Japanese rice wine)
1  tsp. grated ginger
1/4  c. sugar
1  lb. white-fleshed fish
preparation: Combine miso, sake, ginger and sugar.  Mix well.  Soak fish in miso sauce overnight.  Broil until cooked.

name: PECAN TARTS
ingredients:
1 large (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. margarine, softened
2  c. flour
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. soft margarine
2  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
1 1/3  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Blend together cream cheese and 1 cup of margarine.  Add flour, then chill for 1 hour.  Shape into 4 dozen (1-inch) balls.  In small muffin tins, place ball in each and work around tin.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  whole eggs
1  c. syrup
2  tsp. melted butter or oleo
1  c. pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

name: CAN-CAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed cream of celery soup
1 soup  can water
1 1/3  c. Minute rice
1 (12 oz.)  can boned chicken or 1 1/2 c. diced, cooked chicken
1 (3 oz.)  can chow mein noodles
preparation: Combine all ingredients except noodles in a large skillet. Stir to mix.  Bring quickly to a boil.  Cover; reduce heat and simmer 4 minutes or until chicken is done.  Remove from heat; stir.  Serve with the noodles.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: APPLE FRITTERS
ingredients:
2  eggs, separated
1  c. milk
2  c. all-purpose flour
3  cooking apples, peeled, cored and thinly sliced
butter or margarine, melted
sifted powdered sugar
preparation: Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored. Add milk and beat well. Beat egg whites (at room temperature) until stiff peaks form; gently fold into flour. Dip apple slices in batter. Fry in hot butter until golden brown and tender, turning once. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: ZUCCHINI-BEEF SKILLET
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion
1  pt. tomatoes, undrained
1/2  c. chopped dill pickles
1  clove garlic, chopped
3/4  tsp. salt
black pepper to taste
3/4  lb. zucchini or other squash
preparation: In large skillet, brown beef with onion, stirring frequently. Add tomatoes, dill pickes, garlic, salt and pepper.  Simmer uncovered 5 minutes.  Add zucchini/other squash, cover and cook 15 minutes or until squash is tender.  Serve over egg noodles.

name: QUICK FUDGE SUNDAES
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. (1 c.) semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1 (16 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1/2 (1 pt.)  jar marshmallow cream
vanilla ice cream
preparation: Mix chocolate and milk in saucepan.  Heat slowly; stir to blend.  Beat in marshmallow cream until blended.  Serve warm or cool over ice cream.  Makes 2 cups.

name: GOOBER CRISPS
ingredients:
1  c. soft shortening (part butter)
1 1/2  c. light brown sugar, packed
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. roasted peanuts
preparation: Heat oven to  375°.  Mix  shortening, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla well.  Blend  flour,  soda and salt; stir in.  Mix in peanuts.  Drop by  rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto lightly greased baking  sheet.  Flatten with greased bottom of glass dipped in sugar.  Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.  Makes about 6 dozen.

name: MOCK PECAN PIE
ingredients:
2  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1  unbaked pie shell (10-inch)
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
4  eggs, beaten
1  c. cooked pinto beans, mashed
whipped cream or vanilla ice cream
preparation: Beat together sugar, butter, vanilla and eggs.  Stir in beans. Pour into pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.  Serve warm or chilled with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.

name: GRANDMOTHER'S CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. milk
1  c. cream-style corn
1/2  c. sugar
5  slices day old bread, crusts removed
1  Tbsp. butter, softened
preparation: In a bowl, beat eggs and milk. Add corn and sugar. Mix well. Cut bread into 1/2-inch cubes and place in a greased 9-inch square baking dish. Pour egg mixture over bread. Dot with butter. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes. Yield: 9 servings.

name: PEANUT BUTTER 'N CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Beat butter, sugars and peanut butter in a large bowl with mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy. Blend in eggs and vanilla.  Mix in flour, baking powder and salt. Stir in chips.  Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes.  Cool 2 minutes.  Remove. Yields 4 dozen.

name: SPICED CRANBERRY CIDER
ingredients:
2  qt. apple cider
1 1/2  qt. cranberry cocktail juice or cranapple juice
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
4  cinnamon sticks
1 1/2  tsp. whole cloves
1  lemon, thinly sliced, or hot cinnamon candies
preparation: Combine all ingredients in large saucepan.  Heat to boiling, reduce heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.  Remove spices and lemon with slotted spoon.  (Can be made in a large coffeepot.)

name: BANANA MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  egg
2  c. Bisquick
1 1/2  c. mashed bananas
1/3  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Spoon into greased muffin pans.  Bake 15 minutes at 400°.

name: SPINACH AND ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
2  pkg. Stouffer's creamed spinach, thawed
1/2  jar marinated artichoke hearts, cut in pieces (you may use more if you want and pour some of the marinade in)
4  oz. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Blend all the ingredients together in a glass baking dish. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, covered.  Serve hot with tortilla chips, salsa and sour cream.

name: OLD FASHIONED SUGAR COOKIES(Great For Christmas Cookies)
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2 3/4  c. cake flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream sugar and butter together slowly, adding sugar gradually.  Cream until very light.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.  Add vanilla.  Stir in sifted cake flour, baking powder and salt.

name: OATMEAL CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. boiling water
1  c. quick oats
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  unbeaten eggs
1 1/3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Pour water over oats.  Let stand 20 minutes.  Mix in brown sugar, white sugar, shortening and eggs.  Add to oatmeal.  Mix in flour, soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon.  Put in greased and floured cake pan, 13 x 9-inch.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: HERB CHEESE WEDGES
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. dried minced onion
1/2  tsp. each dried dill, basil and oregano
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. melted butter
1/4  c. Sauterne wine
1/3  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Combine Bisquick, onion, sugar and herbs.  Mix the egg and milk together.  Beat softly. Add this, the butter and wine to the dry ingredients. Beat until blended.  Turn out onto a well-greased round 8-inch cake pan.  Sprinkle the cheese on top. Bake at 400° until brown and crusty, about 25 minutes. Allow to sit for 10 minutes. Cut in wedges and serve with butter. Serves 6 to 8.

name: BUTTERMILK PAN ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. active dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1 1/2  c. warm buttermilk
1/2  c. vegetable oil
3  Tbsp. sugar
4 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: In large mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water. Add buttermilk, oil and sugar. Combine flour, soda and salt. Add to yeast mixture and beat until smooth. Do not knead. Let stand for 10 minutes. Turn dough on a lightly floured surface. Punch down. Shape into 24 balls and place in 2 greased 9-inch square baking pans. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 30 minutes. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 2 dozen.

name: OYSTER CRACKER SNACKS
ingredients:
1  lb. oyster crackers
2/3  c. Orville Redenbacher's popcorn oil
1/2  tsp. lemon pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
preparation: Mix or toss ingredients.  Makes great snack crackers or use as croutons.

name: CHILI CON CARNE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 (1 lb.)  can (2 c.) tomatoes, broken up
1 (1 lb.)  can (2 c.) dark red kidney beans, drained
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. salt
1 to 2  tsp. chili powder
1  bay leaf
preparation: In heavy skillet, cook meat, onion and green pepper until meat is lightly browned and vegetables are tender.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Cover and simmer for 1 hour.  Remove bay leaf. Makes 4 servings.

name: TWO LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
1 (1 lb.)  can whole cranberry sauce
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon jello
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (9 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cranberry  Layer:  Dissolve  strawberry  jello in 1 1/4 cups boiling water.  Add cranberry sauce, mixing well.  Chill until partially  set.  Pour  into  Pyrex  dish.  Chill  until almost firm.  Top with cheese layer.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Crisco
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  c. nuts
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. chopped apples
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream Crisco and sugar.  Add eggs and beat.  Add flour mixture and mix well; then add apples, nuts and vanilla.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour in tube or sheet pan.

name: ORANGE CREAM SHERBET
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. orange juice
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  egg white
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  Tbsp. grated orange
1/2  c. Dream Whip
preparation: Put milk and  sugar in mixing bowl.  Mix.  Add strained orange juice, lemon  juice  and  quartered  orange rind, stir, until sugar is dissolved  pour  in  ice  cube  tray and put in freezer. Chill until  frozen,  beat  egg  whites until stiff, fold egg whites and whip.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
12  oz. Cool Whip
1/8  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
cinnamon to taste
preparation: Mix together and serve with fresh fruit.

name: POT OF POTATOES
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes, sliced and parboiled
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
8  oz. American cheese or Velveeta
1/2  c. milk
1  medium onion, diced
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In lightly greased casserole dish, layer potatoes, ground beef, onion, mushroom soup and cheese.  Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour milk over all.  Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) bag frozen broccoli, carrots and cauliflower
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
3  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
3  oz. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1 (2/8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
preparation: Combine thawed vegetables, soup, sour cream, 1/2 cup each of the cheeses, pepper and 1/2 can French fried onions.  Pour into a 1-quart casserole. Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer. Ready to serve.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can water
1  can mushrooms, drained
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  (4 oz.) container sour cream
1  pkg. wide noodles
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain.  Add cream of mushroom soup, water, garlic powder and mushrooms.  Simmer for 20 minutes.   Take off heat immediately and add sour cream.  Cook wide noodles and pour sauce over them.

name: PRUNE BREAD
ingredients:
1  lb. prunes
2 1/2  c. water
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
3/4  c. shortening
2  eggs
4  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Soak prunes overnight; remove seeds and chop fine.  Mix with sugar, shortening, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Cook over low heat for 15 minutes and cool.  Beat in eggs, flour, soda and salt.  Bake for 1 hour at 350° in loaf pan.

name: ORANGE CRANBERRY TRIFLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. pure orange extract
2  c. Cool Whip
1  c. whole cranberry sauce
1 small loaf (10 - 12 oz.)  pound cake, thinly sliced
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
Sliced almonds
Cinnamon
preparation: Mix cream cheese, sugar, cinnamon and 1/2 tsp. orange extract.  Mix till smooth.  Gently stir in Cool Whip and cranberry sauce.  Set aside.  Using an 8 inch square pan, arrange 1/3 of cake slices on bottom of pan.  Mix together milk, vanilla and 1/2 tsp. orange extract. Drizzle approximately 2 Tbsp. of milk mixture over cake slices.   Spread 1/3 of cream cheese over cake slices. Repeat for second and third layers.  You will end up with cream mix on top.  Top with slices of almonds and cinnamon.

name: CHICKEN GAI-TAO(Also Known As Chicken With Peaches)
ingredients:
4  chicken breast pieces, with skin and fat removed
2  beef bouillon cubes
2  c. Minute rice
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter
2  c. water
1  can peaches, drained
1/4  c. coconut
preparation: In a saucepot, place the bouillon cubes, soy sauce and water. Bring to a boil.  Add rice, cover and set aside.  Brown chicken in margarine until lightly brown on both sides.  Place the rice in a baking dish.  Place chicken and pan drippings on top of rice. Bake (covered tightly) at 350° for 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.  Arrange peaches on top.  Sprinkle with coconut.  Put back in oven (covered) for 10 to 15 minutes (until peaches are warm).

name: SHOE PEG CORN SALAD
ingredients:
3  cans white Shoe Peg corn
6  green onions, chopped fine
3/4  c. chopped green peppers
1 1/3  c. chopped celery
3  tomatoes, chopped
1/2  c. chopped cauliflower
1/2  c. chopped broccoli
dash of salt and pepper
10  oz. Wish-Bone salad dressing
preparation: Combine all ingredients and toss.  Amount of Wish-Bone dressing can be reduced.  Serve chilled.

name: OYSTER STEW
ingredients:
1  pt. shelled oysters
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. cold water
1  qt. scalded milk
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1/2 to 1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Clean oysters, reserving liquid.  Heat butter.  Add oysters and liquid and water.  Simmer gently until edges of oysters begin to curl.  Add scalded milk, seasoning and Worcestershire sauce. Garnish each serving with dash of paprika.  If richer stew is desired, substitute 1/2 cup cream for 1/2 cup milk.

name: Easy Chocolate Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients:
1  Can Chocolate Fudge Creamy Frosting
1  Cup Creamy Peanut Butter
1  Egg
1 1/2  Cup Flour
Granulated sugar for final step
preparation: Preheat oven to 375F.  In Large Bowl mix 2/3 of frosting, Peanut Butter, egg and blend well.

name: SWEET POTATO FRIES
ingredients:
2  large yams
1  c. peanut oil
salt to taste
preparation: Cut yams into long strips, leaving skin on.  Heat oil until sizzling.  (It is ready when a square of bread cooks quickly.) Fry yams in a large frying pan until brown on each side.  Drain on paper towels and blot off the extra fat.  Sprinkle with salt before serving.  Makes 4 servings.

name: RAISIN CLUSTERS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/4  c. light corn syrup
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. confectioners sugar
2  c. raisins
preparation: Combine  chocolate chips and corn syrup in the top of a double boiler.  Place  over  very hot (not boiling) water and stir until  chocolate  is  melted.  Mix	in  the  vanilla and confectioners  sugar.  Stir in the raisins.  Drop by teaspoons onto  greased  cookie sheet.  Chill until firm.  Makes about 3 dozen.

name: SHORTBREAD(A Taste of Scotland)
ingredients:
12  oz. flour
4  oz. sugar
8  oz. butter or margarine
preparation: Sieve  the  flour and add the sugar.  Rub in the butter and then work the mixture into a ball with a knife.  Butter a baking tray  and  then  spread in the mixture or press into a floured mold.  Bake  in preheated 375° oven for 25 minutes or until browned.  Remove  from oven.  Cut into squares from the tray and sprinkle with sugar.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
large bag spaghetti
1  chicken
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
1  large chopped bell pepper
2  cans mushroom soup
1  can diced tomatoes
1 small  jar pimentos
1  pkg. Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook chicken and remove from bone; in 1/2 cup butter, cook onions, celery and bell peppers. Cook spaghetti; rinse and mix in soup, tomatoes, pimentos and 1 cup chicken broth. Stir in chicken and 1/2 package of grated cheese. Mix well and pour into 2 big casseroles. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.

name: TWINKY CAKE
ingredients:
1  cake mix, prepared according to directions
1  c. milk
5  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. Crisco
1/2  c. oleo
preparation: Prepare the cake according to directions and cook in a 9 x 13-inch wax paper lined pan.  Turn the cake onto a cookie sheet after cooled.  Cook the milk with the flour, stirring constantly, until boiled and thick (like paste).  Cool.  Beat the vanilla, sugar, salt, Crisco and oleo until very light and fluffy.  Add paste to this; beat until very smooth.  Split cake and put this between the layers.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  can cherry pie filling
1  can crushed pineapple
1  stick butter or margarine
crushed nuts and/or coconut
preparation: Spread pie filling into 8 x 13-inch pan.  Next, distribute pineapple over filling (juice and all).  Sprinkle dry cake mix over all, creating next layer. Cut butter into patties and lay on top.  Sprinkle with coconut and/or nuts.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SALMON BALL
ingredients:
1 large  can salmon
1  tsp. mayonnaise
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  onion, finely chopped
preparation: Mix all of the ingredients together and form into a ball. Roll in crushed nuts.

name: COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1/2  head cabbage, finely chopped
1  green pepper, finely chopped
2  or 3 stalks celery, finely chopped
1  tsp. mustard seed
1  tsp. celery seed
1/2  c. white distilled vinegar
1 1/2  c. sugar (can use 1 c.)
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients.

name: MEXICAN DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  can refried beans
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
8  oz. sour cream
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  large tomato, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1  can black olives, drained and chopped
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
tortilla cheese
preparation: Spread beans in 10 x 13-inch glass dish.  Sprinkle with 1/2 of taco seasoning mix.   Mix sour cream and mayonnaise and spread over beans.  Sprinkle with other half of taco seasoning mix. Sprinkle with chopped tomatoes, then onions and olives, ending with grated cheese.  Serve with tortilla chips.  Refrigerate.

name: SPAETZLE
ingredients:
1  egg
3/4  c. flour
1/3  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
preparation: Beat egg well.  Add flour, water and salt, stirring to a stiff, smooth batter.  Drop batter from tip of spoon, 1/2 teaspoon at a time, into boiling water.  Cook until spaetzle comes to surface.  Remove with slotted spoon.  Transfer to goulash.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen green string beans or 2 (1 lb.) cans, drained
3/4  c. milk
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/8  tsp. ground black pepper
2  Tbsp. diced pimentos
1 (3 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
preparation: Cook green beans according to directions.  Combine milk, soup and pepper; pour over beans.  Add 1/2 can onions.  Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Garnish with 1/2 can of onions and pimentos.  Bake 5 more minutes.  Serves 6.

name: BUNGALOSA (NOODLES)
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  eggs
3/4  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. butter
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix flour, eggs, water and salt into a ball.  (May need to mix with hands.)  Cut with a knife into small pieces and put into boiling water.  Boil for 3 minutes and drain.

name: VEGETARIAN CHILI
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant (1/2-inch dice)
2  medium onions
1  large yellow squash, diced
1  large zucchini
2  bell peppers, diced
6  plum tomatoes
29  oz. crushed tomatoes
4 large  cloves garlic, chopped
3/4  c. olive oil
1  c. chicken broth
1 (9 oz.)  can red kidney beans
10 1/2  oz. can chickpeas
11  oz. can corn
1/2  c. chopped fresh parsley
2  tsp. basil
2  tsp. cumin
4 to 6  tsp. high quality chili powder to taste
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
1  tsp. ground black pepper
preparation: Saute onion, zucchini, yellow squash and peppers in 1 1/2 cups oil until soft (can use oil sparingly).  In skillet, saute eggplant in 1/2 cup oil (can decrease oil).  Add tomatoes, broth, parsley and spices.  Cook for 30 to 40 minutes.  Add beans, chickpeas and corn; adjust seasonings.   Serve with grated Mozzarella cheese, sour cream and bread on the side.  Serves 12.

name: EASY BURRITOS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck, browned and drained
1  medium size onion, chopped
1  pkg. burrito spice
1 (15 3/4 oz.)  can kidney beans
1 (16 oz.)  can salsa sauce
12  corn burrito shells
2  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Fry shells in a tablespoon of grease lightly in frypan.  Mix onion and spice with hamburger.  Place 4 tablespoons of meat on each shell and sprinkle with cheese.  Roll shells and place on a cookie sheet.  Pour the can of kidney beans over the shells and then the can of salsa over the kidney beans.  Sprinkle any remaining hamburg over the salsa.  Heat in a 350° oven for 10 minutes and sprinkle with shredded cheese.  Serve.

name: SCALLOPED EGGPLANT
ingredients:
1  large eggplant
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
2  c. canned or chopped raw tomatoes
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. oleo
1  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Peel eggplant and dice in small cubes.  Saute pepper and onion until tender.  Add tomatoes, eggplant, salt and pepper; cook 15 minutes.   Place in a casserole dish.  Melt oleo in a skillet. Add bread crumbs and stir.  Sprinkle bread crumbs over eggplant. Bake in a 350° oven for 15 minutes, or until eggplant is tender and crumbs are brown.

name: TUNA LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. shredded lettuce
1 1/2  c. (4 oz.) medium shell macaroni, cooked and drained
2  c. chopped cucumber
2  c. chopped tomatoes
2  cans (6 1/2 oz. each) tuna, drained
1  pkg. (10 oz.) green peas, thawed
1  c. (4 oz.)  Kraft shredded mild Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
preparation: Layer lettuce, shells, cucumber, tomatoes, tuna, peas and cheese in 3-quart serving bowl.  Spread Miracle Whip salad dressing over salad sealing to edge of bowl; cover.  Refrigerate several hours or overnight.  Toss to serve.

name: PINEAPPLE ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
1  (15.5 oz.) crushed pineapple (undrained)
1  (6 oz.) orange flavored gelatin
2  c. buttermilk
1  c. flaked coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
1  (12 oz.) whipped topping
preparation: Place pineapple in a saucepan.  Bring to boil, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Add gelatin, stirring until completely dissolved.  Stir in buttermilk, coconut and pecans. Cool.  Fold in whipped topping.  Pour in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Chill until firm.  Yields 15 servings.

name: PEACH PARFAIT PIE
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. peaches (sweetened)
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon flavored gelatin
1/2  c. cold water
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
1  baked 9-inch pastry shell
1/2  c. whipping cream, whipped
preparation: Drain peaches, reserving syrup.  Add water to syrup to make 1 cup.  Heat to boiling.  Add gelatin.  Stir until dissolved.  Add cold water.  Cut ice cream into 6 pieces; add hot liquid.  Stir until melted.  Chill until partially set.  Fold in peaches.  Pour into pastry shell.  Chill to set.  Top with whip cream.

name: PEAR CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. oil
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
3  c. raw pears, chopped
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix eggs and sugar.  Add oil.  Stir in dry ingredients.  Add pears.  Bake in tube pan at 350° for 1 hour.

name: COUNTRY STYLE STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. cubed steak
1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. shortening
gravy
preparation: Mix flour, salt and pepper.  Flour meat.  Melt shortening in skillet until hot, then add floured meat.  Brown on each side 5 to 8 minutes.  Remove meat and put in baking dish.  Pour gravy over meat and bake uncovered at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: SODA-CITRUS FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
2  liter club soda, chilled
2  liter lemon-lime, chilled
1  (12 oz.) lemonade concentrate (frozen)
1  (12 oz.) frozen orange juice
1  (6 oz.) limeade (frozen)
preparation: Partially  thaw juices, put in bowl, add chilled sodas, stir in	ice  and  garnish  with lime slices.  If punch is too tart may add  1  quart ice cream just before serving.  Serves 12.

name: GREAT FROSTING
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. oleo
1  c. granulated sugar
dash of salt
1 rounded  Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. warm milk
preparation: Heat milk to warm.  Put all ingredients in deep bowl and beat 6 to 8 minutes.

name: EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
6  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Pour into deep dish unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg.  Bake at 350° until almost firm.  Do not overbake.

name: BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1 large  bunch fresh broccoli
2  c. chicken broth
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. half and half
preparation: Steam broccoli until crisp-tender.  Chop.  Combine broccoli, broth and onion and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes.  Puree mixture in blender until smooth.

name: APPLE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  large or 3 small eggs
1  c. liquid shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. plain flour
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
4  apples, sliced and grated
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix well eggs, shortening, brown sugar and white sugar.  Add vanilla, plain flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and apples.  Batter will be very thick.  Pour into oblong pan.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: JELLIED WALDORF SALAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. apples (tart), diced
1/4  c. nut meats, chopped
1  box lime jello
1/2  c. celery, diced
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
lettuce
preparation: Combine diced apples, celery, nut meats and mayonnaise. Prepare lime jello according to directions on package.  When slightly thickened, fold in mixture and turn into 1-quart mold or individual molds.  Serve on lettuce leaves.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
sugar to taste
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. evaporated milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bake in oven at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: LEMON CRACKERS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  pt. lard
1  pt. milk
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. baking ammonia
1  bottle lemon oil
little salt
8  c. flour
preparation: Combine ammonia and milk.  Let stand until ammonia has dissolved.  Cream sugar and lard.  Add salt and eggs and mix well. Add ammonia, milk and lemon oil.  Add flour and mix well.  Knead the dough.  Roll to 1/8-inch thickness; cut with square cutter. Prick with fork.  Bake at 400° until light brown.

name: SALISBURY STEAK
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  can onion soup
1  c. bread crumbs
2  eggs, beaten
1  can tomato soup
1  can celery soup
flour
1  can water
preparation: Mix hamburger, bread crumbs, onion, soup and eggs as for meat loaf.  Make into patties; dip in flour and brown on each side. Arrange in a greased baking dish.  Mix celery soup, tomato soup and water.  Pour over the patties and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. melted margarine
1/3  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. cottage cheese
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli, chopped and drained
4  eggs, slightly beaten
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  pkg. corn muffin mix
preparation: Mix all together and pour into 13 x 9 x 1 1/2-inch pan.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400°.

name: FOOD PROCESSOR SECRETS
ingredients:
2  c. plain flour
1  c. butter, cut up
1  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. almond
2  c. sifted confectioners sugar
preparation: In food processor, combine flour, butter, pecans, 1/2 cup sugar, salt, vanilla and almond.  Process well.  Refrigerate, covered, for 1 hour.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Shape dough into balls, using 1 tablespoon each.  Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until set but not brown. Let stand 1 minute.  Place hot cookies in the 2 cups sugar; roll to coat each cookie.  Cool completely; roll again.  Keep in airtight container.

name: AMBROSIA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can chunk pineapple
1 small  can mandarin orange slices
1  c. shredded coconut
1 (10 oz.)  jar maraschino cherries
1  c. miniature marshmallows
8  oz. sour cream
preparation: If desired, slice pineapple and orange pieces in half.  Mix all ingredients together.  Add a little pineapple juice if dry. chill for 2 hours.  Yields 10 servings.

name: RED BEANS AND RICE
ingredients:
1  small bag red beans, soaked overnight or 2 to 3 hours
2  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
1  lb. Polish sausage, cut into small pieces or 1 lb.  little smokies
rice
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Cook in a slow cooker on low all day (about 6 to 8 hours).  Take a few of the beans out and mash them; add to the other beans to thicken gravy.  Serve over cooked rice.

name: PICKLED PORK HOCKS
ingredients:
pork hocks (desired amount)
1  tsp. salt
whole allspice cloves (as desired)
vinegar
broth
preparation: Boil as many clean hocks as you want, with skin on, in kettle. Cover with water; add salt and allspice.  When meat comes off bones, cool until you can handle; take meat from bones.  Cut into bits; put in bowl or pan.  Cover generously with juice, made from broth left from boiling hocks and vinegar (3/4 cup broth to 1/4 cup vinegar).

name: CREOLE SEASONING
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. cayenne pepper
4 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. chili powder
1 1/2  tsp. paprika
1 1/2  tsp. ground coriander
1 1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. ground cloves
3/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and store in an airtight container in a cool place.  Yields 1/3 cup.

name: LAYERED MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. sour cream
1  envelope taco seasoning mix
lettuce, shredded
tomatoes, chopped
black olives
cheese
preparation: Combine ingredients and spread on plate or platter, then layer lettuce, tomatoes, black olives and cheese.

name: PAIGE'S CHILI
ingredients:
2  cans Hormel chili
1  can corn, drained
1  c. cooked macaroni
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1  garlic clove, chopped
1  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Saute onion, green pepper and garlic in oil.  Add chili, corn and cooked macaroni.  Heat thoroughly.  Add cheese and allow it to melt before removing from the heat.

name: GREENS WITH BACON
ingredients:
6  slices bacon
2  c. chopped onions
2  c. chicken broth
4  lb. collard greens or turnip greens, rinse and remove stems
crushed red pepper
hot sauce
preparation: Clean greens and cut up 2 days ahead. Make sure you clean greens really well.  Cook bacon in 4 to 5-quart pot until crisp. Drain bacon on paper towel.  Remove all but 2 tablespoons bacon fat.  Cut onions in bacon fat over medium heat and cook 5 to 6 minutes, stirring, until translucent.  Add chicken broth.  Bring to boil; add bacon and bring to boil.  Add greens, a batch at a time, adding more as they cook down.  Cover and simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until leaves are tender and liquid is reduced by half.  Add crushed red peppers over greens.

name: VEGGIE WEDGIE
ingredients:
2  pkg. crescent rolls
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch (buttermilk)
3/4  c. fresh broccoli
onion
black olives
green olives
tomato
celery
grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Roll crescent rolls out flat and bake at 325° for 7 minutes. Cool.  Top with cream cheese mixed with mayonnaise and Hidden Valley Ranch.  Top with broccoli, onion, black olives, green olives, tomato and celery.  Top with grated Cheddar cheese.  Cut into wedges.

name: IRISH SODA BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  c. raisins
2  beaten eggs
1/3  c. sugar
1 3/4  c. buttermilk
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix 6 dry ingredients.  Melt butter and add to eggs and buttermilk.  Mix all ingredients together.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. pumpkin
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Sift together the dry ingredients.  Mix eggs (beaten) with buttermilk, sugar and pumpkin.  Last, beat in all of the sifted dry ingredients.  Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (12 oz.)  cans Mexicorn
16  oz. Velveeta cheese, grated
1 (8 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Combine all ingredients in large bowl.  Pour into baking dish. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: BARBECUE BEEF
ingredients:
5  lb. boneless chuck roast, cut into chunks
1 (16 oz.)  can whole peeled tomatoes
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. chopped celery
1  Tbsp. mild taco sauce
1 small  can chopped green chilies
3/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/2 to 1  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients in roasting pan and marinate in refrigerator for 12 hours.  Cook, covered, in oven at 275° for 12 hours.  Remove from oven and shred with fork.  Add 1 cup catsup and 3/4 cup brown sugar to barbecue and cook for 15 minutes longer. Serve on hot onion rolls.  This makes approximately 30 sandwiches. The meat can be frozen in small portions, thawed, heated and served in minutes.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  large onion
1 large (19 oz.)  can red kidney beans
2 (15 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1  can sliced mushrooms
3  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2 to 1  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
1  large pepper, sliced
preparation: Saute onion and meat in oil until brown.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer about 1 hour.

name: YULETIDE TOFFEE SQUARES
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. quick oats (uncooked)
1  c. packed brown sugar
3/4  c. margarine, melted
1/2  c. Karo corn syrup
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
12  oz. pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
2  Tbsp. shortening
2/3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Heat oven to 450°. Grease 15 x 10 baking pan. Combine oats, sugar, margarine, corn syrup, vanilla and salt. Mix well. Firmly press mixture into pan. Bake 12 minutes or until brown and bubbly. Cool completely.

name: BLITZ TORTE OR KISS ME CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening or oleo
1/2  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
4  egg yolks, beaten well
3  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
4  egg whites
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. sliced almonds or nuts
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Cream shortening; beat in sugar and salt, then egg yolks, vanilla, milk and flour, mixed with baking powder.  Spread mixture in 2 round greased cake pans.  Beat egg whites until very light, adding 3/4 cup sugar slowly and spread on unbaked mixture in both pans.  Sprinkle nuts, sugar and cinnamon and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.  Let cool and put together with whipped cream, berries or pudding.

name: PISTACHIO PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
2/3  c. powdered sugar
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. chopped nuts
8  oz. Philadelphia cream cheese
1 large  carton Cool Whip
2  pkg. instant pistachio pudding mix
2 1/2  c. milk
maraschino cherries
preparation: 1st Layer:  Mix flour, 2 tablespoons sugar, oleo and nuts.  Put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 15 minutes at 350°.  Set aside to cool.

name: POTATO CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
5  medium potatoes, peeled
1  stick butter or margarine (1/2 c.)
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 1/2 to 2  c. milk
2  sticks celery, chopped
2  carrots, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1 to 2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
bacon bits (optional)
preparation: Add potatoes, celery, carrots and onion to pot of water.  Boil until vegetables are soft.  Drain water; mash potatoes.  Add butter, chicken soup, milk and salt and pepper to taste.  Heat. While heating, add cheese.  Stir frequently.

name: TURKEY WALDORF SALAD
ingredients:
1  medium unpared red apple, cored and diced (1 1/4 c.)
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  c. coarsely diced, cooked turkey
1  c. halved and seeded red grapes
1  c. sliced celery
1/4  c. broken walnuts
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
2/3  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
lettuce
1  hard-cooked egg
preparation: Chill ingredients.  Sprinkle diced apple with lemon juice.  Add turkey, grapes, celery, walnuts, onion, salad dressing, salt and pepper and toss lightly.  Serve in lettuce-lined bowl.  Cut white of egg into wedges and arrange in shape of a flower.  Top with grated yolk.  Makes 5 to 6 servings.

name: FRIED PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. flaked coconut
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Combine butter, coconut, flour and brown sugar in a saucepan. Cook on medium heat until a rich brown color, stirring frequently. Pour into pie plate and press out to edges evenly with a fork. Allow to cool before filling.  Makes 1 (9-inch) crust (8 servings).

name: FREE VEGETABLES SOUP
ingredients:
1  qt. tomatoes (canned or fresh)
1  pt. green beans
1  lb. carrots
1  large onion
1 1/2  c. celery
1/2  medium head cabbage
1  Tbsp. beef bouillon
preparation: Mix all ingredients in large stock pot.  Start with 1/2 gallon of water.  Add herb to season (your choice).  Cook until it is almost tender.  It's better if veggies are crisp, not soft.

name: CARROT CAKE WITH CREAM CHEESE FROSTING
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
2/3  c. whole wheat flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
3/4  tsp. ground allspice
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/8  tsp. salt
2  egg white
3/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
3  c. coarsely shredded carrots
1/2  c. raisins
2/3  c. buttermilk
1  can (8 oz.) crushed pineapple, drained
2  tsp. black walnut extract
2  tsp. vanilla
Cream Cheese Frosting
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spray 13 x 9-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray; set aside.  In medium bowl mix first 7 ingredients; set aside.  In large bowl with whisk beat egg whites, sugar and oil.  Stir in next 6 ingredients until well combined. Stir in flour mixture until well combined.  Spoon into prepared pan.  Bake 35 minutes until pick comes out clean.  Cool in pan on wire rack.

name: POOR BOY
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  can tuna, drained and flaked
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. chopped parsley
1/4  c. dairy sour cream
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  long loaf French bread
3  Tbsp. margarine
1  pkg. Swiss cheese, thinly sliced
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients.  Slice bread; spread with margarine.  Place cheese and tuna mix on bread.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Can be served open-face, presliced.  Top with American cheese.

name: POPSICLES
ingredients:
2  pkg. Kool-Aid
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. jello
1 3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Mix dry ingredients together. Store in closed container.  To make one batch, mix 6 tablespoons of dry mix to 3/4 cup boiling water.  Add 3/4 cup cold water.  Put in popsicle molds.  Way cool!

name: BAKED MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
pinch of salt
pinch of pepper
3  eggs
2  c. milk
10  squares butter
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
2  lb. sharp cheese
1  lb. macaroni
preparation: In a small mixing bowl add milk, eggs, salt and pepper.  Mix until well blended.

name: CHERRY CRISP
ingredients:
2  cans cherry pie filling, sprinkle with 1 tsp. almond extract
1  box white cake mix
1 1/2  sticks butter, melted
ground or finely chopped nuts
Cool Whip
preparation: Grease and flour 9 x 12-inch pan.  Pour in contents of pie filling and spread.  Sprinkle cake mix on top of filling.  Top with melted butter.  Sprinkle on nuts.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Cool and serve with whipped topping.

name: LUSCIOUS APRICOT BARS
ingredients:
2/3  c. dried apricots
1/2  c. soft butter
1/4  c. sugar
1 1/3  c. flour, divided
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. almonds, divided
preparation: Rinse apricots and cover with water.  Simmer 10 minutes. Drain, cool and chop.  Combine butter, 1/4 cup sugar and 1 cup flour.  Mix until crumbly.  Press into greased 9-inch square pan, bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

name: GREEN GOOP
ingredients:
approximately 40 large marshmallows
2 large  pkg. lime Jell-O
1  large and 1 small size Philadelphia cream cheese
1 large and 1 small size  can crushed pineapple, drained, reserving juice
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Please make exactly as instructed.  Do not substitute.

name: VANILLA POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  sticks margarine
1  box confectioners sugar
6  eggs
3  c. flour
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add eggs, two at a time.  Add flour and vanilla; beat until well mixed.  Pour into a greased and floured angel food cake pan or 3 loaf pans.  Bake in 325° oven for 1 1/2 hours.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. diced apples
2  c. sugar
1  c. nuts
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. cooking oil
2  eggs, well beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together apples, sugar and nuts and let stand 1 hour or overnight.  Sift together flour, salt, soda and cinnamon.  Add to apple mixture.  Add cooking oil, eggs and vanilla and blend well. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.  Make toothpick test to see if done.  Let cool before removing from pan.

name: TONI'S ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
2  c. shredded zucchini, packed
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. chopped pecans (optional)
preparation: Beat eggs and sugar.  Beat in oil, then zucchini.  Mix dry ingredients together.  Mix all together.  Pour into oiled or Pam-sprayed loaf pans (2).  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: DEEP CHOCOLATE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines deep chocolate deluxe cake mix
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/4  c. water
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
1 1/3  c. (3 1/2 oz.) can flaked coconut
whipped cream, if desired
preparation: Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Add water.  Sprinkle brown sugar evenly in pan.  Arrange nuts and coconut in sugar mixture.  Mix cake as directed on package.   Pour batter over mixture in pan.  Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes until cake springs back when touched lightly.  Let stand 5 minutes for topping to begin to set.  Then turn upside-down onto a large platter or a cookie sheet.  Serve pieces of cake topped with whipped cream.

name: MOST REQUESTED LIVER
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. calf liver, cut into serving-size pieces
flour (as needed)
1  large sliced bell pepper
oil (as needed)
1  envelope onion soup mix
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
seasoned salt and pepper
preparation: Coat wide heavy skillet with oil.  Dust liver with flour. Cook over medium heat until lightly browned on both sides.  Add oil as needed.  Remove from pan.  Add onion and pepper to pan. Cook until onion is soft.  Remove.  Put liver back in pan.  Put vegetables on top.  Sprinkle with soup; pour tomatoes over all. Season to taste.  Cook over low heat approximately 25 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: BAKED CHERRY-PINEAPPLE DESSERT
ingredients:
1  can cherries
1  can crushed pineapple
1  white cake mix
1  c. broken pecans
3/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Drain cherries and pineapple well.  Place fruit in buttered 12 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish.  Spread dry cake mix evenly over fruit.  Sprinkle with pecans and drizzle with melted butter.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes or until top is golden brown.  Serve warm with ice cream or whipped cream.

name: SHRIMP SKEWERS
ingredients:
2/3  c. rice
6  oz. large shrimp
3  cherry tomatoes
3  pearl onions
3  (1-inch) pieces bell pepper
6 1/2-inch  slices zucchini squash
3  whole mushrooms
3/4  c. unsweetened pineapple chunks
1/2  c. sugar-free gelatin cubes with 2 Tbsp. whipped topping
2  Tbsp. Italian salad dressing
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Alternate shrimp, vegetables and pineapple on 3 skewers. Broil or grill approximately 5 minutes on each side or until done. Baste with Italian dressing while cooking.  Serve over rice.

name: CHICKEN AND NOODLES
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3  lb. fryer chicken, cut up
1  Tbsp. butter, melted
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can clear chicken broth
3  c. medium egg noodles, uncooked
1  tsp. diced Italian seasoning
1  pkg. frozen peas and carrots, thawed
preparation: In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, arrange chicken, skin side down. Pour melted butter over chicken.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Remove chicken from dish.

name: POLLO CON POSOLE SOUP(We Call it Just "Posole")
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
3 to 5  cloves garlic
1 1/2  tsp. chili powder
1 to 2  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. salt
5  c. chicken broth or stock or bouillon
3 (14 1/2 oz.)  cans golden hominy, drained
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  lb. chicken parts or chopped
1  tsp. cumin
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1/2  c. masa harina flour
3  c. chilled chicken broth or stock or bouillon
preparation: *Fresh cilantro,  dairy  sour cream, lettuce, tomatoes, onion (chopped).

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
1 (13 oz.)  can fruit cocktail
preparation: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Mix ingredients together and pour into pan.  Sprinkle 1 1/2 cups brown sugar and 1/2 cup chopped walnuts on top of cake batter.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: DANISH BARS
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1  c. sugar
1  large egg
1/2  c. milk
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. coconut
1  c. crushed graham crackers
whole graham crackers
1  stick margarine
1  box powdered sugar
little milk
vanilla
preparation: Boil 2 sticks margarine, sugar, egg and 1/2 cup milk for 1 minute. Take off heat and add pecans, coconut and crushed graham crackers.

name: LOW CHOLESTEROL CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. canola oil
2  tsp. vanilla
6  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. soda
2  c. water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  c. maraschino cherries, chopped (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Sift dry ingredients together in a large bowl.  Add liquid ingredients and mix well.  Pour into greased and floured sheet cake pan and bake 20 to 30 minutes.  Add your favorite chocolate icing or eat without icing.

name: COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
1  deep dish pie shell
small pkg. coconut
2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1 tall  can Pet milk
1  stick butter, melted
3  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar and flour.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Stir in milk, water coconut and melted butter.  Pour in unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until set.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked squash
1  onion, grated
1  carrot, grated
1 small  jar pimiento
1  c. sour cream
2  cans undiluted cream of chicken soup
3/4  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix
1  stick butter, melted
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix well.  Top with remaining Pepperidge Farm.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: APPLE NUT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3  c. self-rising flour
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
3  eggs
1  c. chopped nuts
3  c. chopped apples
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix sugar, flour, oil, and  egg together in large bowl.  Do not use mixer.  Use wire whisk or large spoon.  Add nuts, apples, cinnamon and vanilla.  Mix well.  Spoon into lightly greased tube pan or 9 x 13 inch pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1  can kidney beans, drained
1  medium onion
1  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  tomato
