preparation: Brown hamburger and drain.  Tear lettuce.  Mix all together. Let set for several hours.  Mix with Western dressing and Doritos when ready to eat.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
1  c. rice
6  slices bacon
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  onion, chopped
1  tsp. paprika
1  qt. tomatoes
salt
pepper
preparation: Cook until tender the rice in 2 cups salted water while frying bacon (chopped) until crisp.  Add hamburger (salt and pepper to taste) and onion (chopped).  Cook until done and drain grease. Combine with rice and paprika.  Stir in tomatoes.  Use a large bowl that can be used in oven.  Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: CREAMED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  head cabbage
1  pt. half and half cream
2  c. boiled ham, cubed
salt to taste
black pepper to taste
1/4  tsp. onion powder
2  Tbsp. instant flour
preparation: Cube or shred cabbage; add cubed ham, cream, flour and seasonings.  Cook just until tender.  You may add a little milk if more liquid is needed.  Slow heat is the secret.

name: TOSTADA DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1  can refried beans
1 small  carton guacamole dip
4  chopped green onions
1  small chopped black olives
1 small  can chopped green chiles (hot or mild)
1/2  c. Cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Add or take away portions according to taste.

name: SOUR CREAM CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
1  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1 (8 1/4 oz.)  can creamed corn
1  c. sour cream
2  eggs
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Pour into greased 8 x 8 baking pan.  Bake 30 minutes at 425°.

name: THREE CHEESE CHICKEN BAKE
ingredients:
8  oz. lasagna noodles
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green peppers
10 3/4  oz. cream of chicken soup
4  oz. sliced mushrooms, drained
1/2  c. chopped pimiento
1/3  c. skim milk
1/2  tsp. basil
1 1/2  c. low-fat cottage cheese
2  c. chopped, cooked chicken or turkey
1 1/2  c. shredded American cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook noodles.  Drain well.  In saucepan, cook onions and pepper in small amount of water until tender.  Drain.  Add soup and mushrooms, pimiento, milk and basil to vegetables.   Layer 1/2 of noodles, 1/2 mix, chicken and cheeses.  Repeat.  Bake in covered casserole in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

name: HOT FUDGE PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
1 3/4  c. hot water
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients in large bowl.  Stir in milk, peanut butter, oil and vanilla until smooth.  Spread mixture into square 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Stir together in small bowl brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa.  Sprinkle this mixture over batter in pan.  Pour hot water over the top of brown sugar, cocoa mixture but do not stir. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  To serve, spoon each serving upside down into dessert dishes.  Spoon sauce over top.  Best served warm.

name: JEZEBEL DIP
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  jar pineapple preserves
1 (16 oz.)  jar apple jelly
1 (1 1/2 oz.)  can dry mustard to taste
1/2 to 3/4  jar horseradish, semi-drained (5 oz. size)
preparation: Mix in blender.  Keep in covered jar in refrigerator.  Dip will keep for weeks.  To serve, place three 8 ounce blocks of cream cheese on platter at room temperature.  Pour Jezebel dip over top of cream cheese and serve with crackers.

name: PUMPKIN MUSHROOM SOUP
ingredients:
1/4  lb. sliced fresh mushrooms
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. oil or butter
1  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. curry powder
3  c. homemade chicken stock or canned
1  lb. canned pumpkin (2 c.)
1  Tbsp. honey
dash of nutmeg
salt and pepper
1  c. heavy cream
preparation: Saute mushrooms and onions in oil or butter.  Add the flour and curry; stir.  Gradually add the broth, then the pumpkin, honey and other seasonings to taste.  Cook for 15 minutes, stirring constantly.  Add cream and heat through without boiling.  Top with a dollop of sour cream, if desired.  Serves 6.

name: BIBLE CAKE("Behold there was a cake baken." 1 Kings 19:6)
ingredients:
1/2  c. almonds (Genesis 43:11)
1  c. raisins (1 Samuel 30:12)
1  c. figs (1 Samuel 30:12)
2  c. sifted flour, reserve some for fruit
3  egg whites, stiffly beaten (Isaiah 10:14)
1 1/2  c. sugar (Jeremiah 6:20)
1/2  c. butter (Judges 5:25)
1/2  tsp. cinnamon (1 Kings 10:10)
1/2  tsp. mace (1 Kings 10:10)
1/2  tsp. cloves (1 Kings 10:10)
1/2  tsp. salt (Leviticus 2:13)
3  egg yolks (Isaiah 10:14)
2  tsp. baking powder (Luke 13:21)
1/2  c. water (Genesis 24:11)
1  Tbsp. honey (Proverbs 24:13)
preparation: Grease and flour a 9 1/2-inch tube pan.  Chop nuts and fruit fine; flour well with flour from the 2 cups.  Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry; set aside.  In mixing bowl, blend butter, sugar, spices and salt.  Beat egg yolks and add.  Sift in baking powder and flour; add water and honey.  Stir in floured nuts and fruits; beat.  Fold into well beaten mixture the egg whites.  Pour batter into pan.  Bake 30 to 60 minutes at 375°.

name: SWEET CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
4  c. fresh corn kernels
4  large eggs
1  c. whipping cream
1/2  c. whole milk
6  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. butter, softened
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Butter an 8 x 8 x 2-inch glass pan. Blend all ingredients in a food processor until nearly smooth. Pour into prepared dish. Bake until brown and the center is set, about 45 minutes. Cool 10 minutes and serve.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. chicken thighs
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  medium onion
4  medium potatoes
4  large carrots
8 to 16  oz. mixed vegetables
2  c. Bisquick baking mix
3/4  c. milk
preparation: In large pressure cooker, combine chicken, onions, potatoes, carrots and mixed vegetables and cook on high until top starts to rock and turn back to medium and cook 15 minutes.  Let steam off and drain all except 1 1/2 cups of liquid. Remove chicken, skin and bones.  Add soups and mix in large 3-quart casserole dish. Mix Bisquick and milk and pat to shape on top of casserole dish, about 1/2-inch thick.  Layer on top of mixture and bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: NUT ROLL
ingredients:
2  boxes graham crackers (crumbs)
2  cans maraschino cherries
1  can Pet milk
1/2  large bag marshmallows, cut into pieces
2  c. black walnuts
preparation: Mix all in large bowl except 3 cups of graham cracker crumbs to roll each in.  Makes 4 rolls.  Wrap and store in refrigerator until ready to use.

name: MOUNDS CAKE
ingredients:
1 devil's food cake mix, mixed as directed plus 1  stick butter
24  large marshmallows
2/3  c. sugar
1  c. milk
14  oz. coconut
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. milk
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Pour cake mix into greased and floured jelly roll pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. While cake is baking, melt marshmallows, sugar and 1 cup milk. Add coconut to mixture. Spread over warm cake.

name: CHOPSTICK TUNA
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. water
2  c. chow mein noodles
1 large  can tuna
1  c. diced celery
1/2  c. cashews
preparation: Combine soup and water.  Add 1 cup chow mein noodles, tuna, celery and cashews.  Toss lightly.  Place in a baking dish. Sprinkle 1 cup chow mein noodles over top.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. chopped broccoli
1  can mushroom soup
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. minced onion
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
butter flavored cracker crumbs
preparation: Cook broccoli and drain.  Mix all ingredients and top with crackers.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

name: CORN "PUDDING"
ingredients:
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
2  cans cream-style corn
5  slightly beaten eggs
1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1  tsp. dried minced onion
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. melted margarine
preparation: Mix the corns and eggs together, then add sugar, cornstarch, seasoned salt and dried onion to mixture.  Then stir in milk and melted margarine.  Pour into a 3-quart casserole dish.  Bake 1 hour at 400°, stirring once.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. all-purpose flour (unsifted)
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. shredded zucchini
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. finely chopped walnuts
1 (8 1/4 oz.)  can drained crushed pineapple
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Beat eggs to blend.  Add oil, sugar and vanilla.  Continue beating with spoon.  Stir in zucchini and pineapple.  Combine flour, soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, walnuts and raisins.  Stir in gently into zucchini mixture just until blended. Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.  Use 2 loaf pans, greased and floured.

name: COOKIES AND CREAM CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
2  c. cream filled cookies*
1/2  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. margarine, softened
3/4  c. milk
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
1  c. whipping cream, whipped
1/4  c. cold water
1 1/4  c. cream filled cookies**
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
preparation: *These cookies (24) should be chocolate cream filled cookies and be chopped as fine as can be done.

name: ORANGE-PEACH REFRESHER
ingredients:
2  medium peaches
1  c. orange juice
1/4  c. dry milk powder
8  ice cubes
preparation: Peel and pit peaches.  In blender container, combine orange juice, milk powder, ice cubes and fruit.  Cover and blend until the mixture is smooth.  Pour into 2 glasses.  Garnish with additional peach slices and mint sprigs, if desired.  Makes 2 servings.

name: CHICKEN ALOHA
ingredients:
3  large chicken breasts
1 1/2  c. sliced celery
1  green pepper, cut into strips
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3  c. cubed cooked chicken
1 (22 oz.)  can pineapple pie filling or 1 (20 oz.) can pineapple chunks
1/3  c. water
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  tsp. granulated instant chicken bouillon
chow mein noodles
sliced almonds
rice
shredded coconut (optional)
preparation: In a frying pan, cook celery and pepper in butter or margarine just until tender-crisp. Add remaining ingredients except noodles. Serve over chow mein noodles and top with toasted almonds. You may add coconut if you wish.

name: CLASSIC SOUR CREAM CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. shortbread crumbs
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk
4  eggs
1  (8 oz.) container sour cream
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  (21 oz.) cherry pie filling
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine crumbs and margarine.  Press firmly on bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan.  In large bowl, combine cheese until fluffy.  Gradually beat in milk until smooth. Beat in eggs, then sour cream and vanilla.  Pour into pan.  Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until edges are light brown.  Cool.  Chill. Top with filling.

name: CHOCOLATE "PHILLY" FUDGE
ingredients:
4  c. sifted powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
4 (1 oz.)  sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Gradually add sugar to cream cheese, mixing well after each addition.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Spread into greased 8-inch square pan.  Chill several hours.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. shortening
2  cans (15 oz. each) tomato sauce
1/3  c. tomato ketchup
1  tsp. oregano leaves
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Brown ground beef, onions, garlic and shortening.  Drain off excess fat and stir in the tomato sauce, tomato ketchup, oregano leaves, salt and pepper.  Simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour.  Stir occasionally.

name: FUDGE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter or oleo
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
5  Tbsp. cocoa
3  c. quick oatmeal
preparation: Let come to a boil the sugar, butter and milk, then add vanilla.  Mix together coconut, cocoa and oatmeal.  Stir into hot mixture.  Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper lined cookie sheet. Cool.

name: FRIED ZUCCHINI PATTIES
ingredients:
1  med. shredded zucchini
1  egg
1  onion, chopped fine
Mint
3  tbsp. oil
Salt, pepper to taste
Flour
preparation: Shred zucchini and squeeze out excess water.  In bowl, add zucchini, egg, onion, mint, salt, pepper and enough flour to make a thick batter.  Heat oil in fry pan and drop batter into hot oil using a big tablespoon. Make little pancakes.  Fry until golden brown and then turn over.  Drain on paper towel.  Finish using batter.  Great on sandwiches or as a side dish.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
2  cans artichoke hearts, drain and chop fine
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
garlic powder to taste
preparation: To artichoke hearts add Parmesan cheese and mayonnaise. Sprinkle on garlic powder to taste.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes until top browns.  Serve with Ritz crackers.

name: SWISS CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen coconut or 1 can
Swiss chocolate cake mix
8  oz. cream cheese
1  stick margarine
1  box powdered sugar
preparation: Grease	pan  (9  x  13-inch).  Put coconut on bottom of pan. Mix Swiss chocolate cake mix by directions and pour over coconut. Mix cream cheese, margarine and powdered sugar.  Put this  mixture in globs on cake and swirl.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
2/3  cup sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
2  cups milk
3  Tbsp. flour or cornstarch
1  tsp. vanilla
3  egg yolks, beaten
1  Tbsp. butter
Baked pie shell
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Add milk, cook, stirring until thickened.  Add small portion into eggs; blend well.  Pour egg mixture into hot mixture.  Cook, stirring until thickened.  Remove from heat; add vanilla and butter.  Pour into baked pie shell. Top with meringue or whipped topping.

name: IMPOSSIBLE HAM AND SWISS PIE
ingredients:
2  Cups cut-up fully cooked, smoked ham
1  Cup shredded natural swiss cheese
1/3  Cup chopped onions
4  eggs
2  Cups milk
1  Cup Bisquick baking mix
1/4  tsp. salt, if desired
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 400.  Grease pie plate, 10 X 1 1/2.  Sprinkle ham, cheese and onions in plate.  Beat remaining ingredients until smooth 15 second in blender on high.  Pour into pie plate.  Bake until golden brown and knife inserted in center comes our clean. 35-40 minutes.  Cool 5 minutes and serve.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
sliced zucchini
sliced tomatoes
sliced onion
sliced bell pepper
8  oz. or more Mozzarella shredded cheese
saltine crackers
3  Tbsp. flour or cornstarch
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Butter a 9 x 13-inch dish.  Layer vegetables repeating zucchini and tomato layers, sprinkling the flour or cornstarch over lower layers to thicken and to absorb some of the liquid the vegetables make as they cook.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Cook vegetables, covered with aluminum foil, for 30 minutes.  Remove cover after 30 minutes.  Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese over top to cover.  On top of this, place crushed saltine crackers to cover.  Return to oven for 30 minutes more, uncovered. Delicious when flavors meld.  Bake at 350°.

name: SHRIMP SQUIGGLE
ingredients:
2  lb. raw shrimp, peeled and rinsed
1  stick oleo
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2 onions or 2  bunches green onions
paprika
spaghetti
preparation: Saute onions in butter.  Add shrimp and soup last.  Heat thoroughly (saute until pink).  Serve over spaghetti.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2 3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. Crisco
1/2  c. butter
6  eggs (medium)
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. plain flour
1  c. Carnation milk
preparation: Cream together sugar, Crisco and butter; add eggs, one at a time.  Add salt, baking powder and vanilla alternately with flour and milk.  Bake at 325° for about 1 hour.

name: GRANDMA'S SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. (4 sticks) butter
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
4  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Lightly grease cookie sheet.  Cream butter and sugar together.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Add 2 cups flour, then soda, salt and cream of tartar.  Add remaining flour.  Drop tablespoonfuls of dough onto cookie sheet.  Butter bottom of flat bottomed glass.  Dip in sugar and flatten cookies.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes until light brown.  Makes approximately 50 cookies.

name: POMMES DAUPHINOISE(Thinly Sliced Potatoes in Creamy Sauce)
ingredients:
2  lb. potatoes, peeled and very thinly sliced
3  oz. Gruyere cheese, grated
10 fluid  oz. whipping cream
1  garlic clove
1  tsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. water
salt and pepper
preparation: Layer potatoes in buttered ovenproof dish.  Sprinkle a little salt between layers.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
2  lb. sweet potatoes, boiled
1  egg
1  stick margarine
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Beat together the sweet potatoes (making 1 1/2 cups mashed sweet potatoes) and mix together with rest of the ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
1  Duncan Hines spice cake mix
1  c. pumpkin
1/2  c. oil
3  eggs
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. water
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup chopped nuts.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

name: EASY CHERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) graham cracker crust
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/3  c. sugar
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Beat cream cheese and sugar until creamy; add Cool Whip.  Put into crust and place pie filling on top.  Chill and serve.

name: CARAMEL HEATH CAKE
ingredients:
5  or more Heath candy bars
chocolate cake mix
1  jar caramel
Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake according to directions on box.  Cut slits randomly throughout cake.  Pour caramel in slits and all over the cake. Let cool.  Spread Cool Whip on top of cake.  Break up Heath bars and sprinkle on top of Cool Whip.  Refrigerate before serving.

name: HOLIDAY OYSTER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  qt. select oysters
4  c. cracker crumbs
1/2  c. melted butter
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. cream
1/2  c. whole sweet milk
preparation: Mix cracker crumbs, butter, salt and pepper together.  Cover bottom of casserole dish with 1/3 of the cracker crumbs. Add 1/2 of the oysters. Add another 1/3 of the cracker crumbs. Add the rest of the oysters.  Pour milk and Worcestershire sauce mixture over the above. Sprinkle remaining cracker crumbs over the top. Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CHICKEN T
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli
3  c. cooked chicken or turkey
2  cans chicken soup
1  can celery or mushroom soup
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1  beaten egg
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  stick oleo
1  pkg. Stove Top dressing
preparation: Cook broccoli, drain and cover bottom of greased large casserole.  Add chicken.  Mix soups, mayonnaise, egg and lemon juice; spread over chicken.  Cover with cheese.  Melt butter and add to dressing.  (I also add some chicken broth.)  Spoon over soup mixture.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: REFRIGERATOR COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1  large head cabbage
1  large Vidalia or purple onion
1  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Slice  cabbage into thin strips.  Cut onion into thinly sliced rings.  Layer  cabbage,  onion  and  cup of sugar.  In small saucepan,  add vinegar, oil, sugar, celery seed and dry mustard. Bring  to  boil.  Pour  over cabbage layers.  Do not stir. Refrigerate.  Stir before serving.

name: STUFFED EGGPLANT
ingredients:
2  medium eggplants
1  medium onion, chopped
1/4  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
4  Tbsp. margarine
salt and pepper
2  c. Italian cooking sauce
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. Stove Top stuffing
preparation: This recipe has no garlic.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CELERY STUFFER
ingredients:
peanut butter
celery
preparation: Cut celery into small chunks.  Stuff with peanut butter.

name: OATMEAL REFRIGERATOR SHORTBREAD COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. softened margarine
1  c. sifted confectioners sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. quick cooking rolled oats
preparation: Mix together first 3 ingredients, then add flour, salt and oats.   Divide dough in half and shape each half into a roll about 1 1/2-inches in diameter.   Wrap each roll in plastic wrap and chill 1 hour or longer.     Slice 1/4-inch thick and place on an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake for 12 to 13 minutes at 350°. Makes 4 dozen.

name: 100-YEAR-OLD CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. all-purpose flour
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat sugar and shortening; add dry ingredients alternately with milk.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: IRON SKILLET CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cornmeal
1  tsp. baking soda
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  Tbsp. butter, melted
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix cornmeal, baking soda and sugar together.  Add liquids to dry mix.  Pour in a preheated 9-inch iron skillet in which 1 tablespoon oleo is melted.  Bake 30 minutes in 450° oven.  Mixture is very thin before baking.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising meal
1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. creamed corn
1  (8 oz.) onion dip
1 small  jar mild picante sauce
2  eggs
2  tsp. baking powder
2/3  c. oil
a little water if needed
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well and bake at 350°.  Makes 24 muffins.

name: BLACKBERRY WINE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box plain white cake mix
1/2  c. cooking oil
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. blackberry gelatin
3/4  c. blackberry wine
3  eggs
preparation: Mix dry cake mix and gelatin.  Add eggs, oil and wine.  Blend to moisten, then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes.  Pour into well-greased Bundt pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.   Remove from pan and pour the glaze over the cake.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE(No Dairy, Low-fat)
ingredients:
1  medium potato, peeled and coarsely diced
1/2  medium carrot, scraped and thickly sliced
1/2  medium onion, peeled and coarsely diced
1  c. water
1  tsp. salt
16  oz. frozen, chopped broccoli
4  oz. firm tofu, crumbled
1/2  c. nutritional yeast flakes
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
pinch of garlic granules
1  c. uncooked instant brown rice
10  oz. can sliced mushrooms, drained
3/4  c. water
1 small  jar chopped pimentos
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a small saucepan, bring potato, carrot, onion, 1 cup of water and salt to a boil over medium-high heat.  Lower heat to medium, cover and simmer until potato and carrot are tender, about 10 minutes.

name: CHINESE CABBAGE SALAD
ingredients:
3  oz. slivered almonds
3  Tbsp. sesame seed
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. shredded cabbage with carrots
1  pkg. Ramen beef flavored Oriental soup mix noodles, broken up
preparation: Bake together almonds and sesame seed at 350° until brown. Cool.  Add cabbage and noodles.  Just before serving, add the dressing.

name: TRISHA'S BEST SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  whole eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
pinch of salt
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. cream of tartar
5  c. flour
preparation: Cream butter and all wet ingredients.  Add dry ingredients. Blend.  Chill 1 hour.  Bake at 350° for 7 to 8 minutes.  Make little balls of dough and place on ungreased baking sheet.  Press dough balls with bottom of glass (dip glass in flour so it won't stick).  Sprinkle with colored sugar.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  lb. butter or margarine
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
2 1/2  c. cake flour, measured before sifting, then sifted twice
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  oz. red food coloring
2  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Cream butter or margarine, sugar and eggs.  Make a paste of cocoa and food coloring; add to first mixture.  Mix salt and vanilla to buttermilk.  Add alternately with flour to first mixture.  When well mixed next with a spoon (not mixer), add baking soda and vinegar.  Mix in well.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: FRUIT CAKE(Low-Cholesterol)
ingredients:
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. egg substitute
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  tsp. grated orange rind
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  c. maraschino cherries
1  c. unsweetened pineapple tidbits
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. pitted dates, diced
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. dried apricots
vegetable cooking spray
preparation: Line a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan with foil. Coat with cooking spray and set loaf pan aside.

name: NO FOOLS PIE
ingredients:
3/4  stick butter
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. self-rising flour
3/4  c. milk
1  tsp. cinnamon
2 1/2  c. fruit (your choice)
preparation: Melt butter in 9 x 9-inch baking pan.  Mix other ingredients together.  Pour over butter.  Add fruit on top.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: BAKED EGGPLANT WITH FETA CHEESE
ingredients:
1  large or 2 medium eggplants
olive oil
1/3  c. feta cheese
1/4  c. finely chopped & packed fresh basil
preparation: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees.

name: EASY BEEF
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. powdered brown gravy mix
1 1/2  lb. stew beef cubes
1 soup  can water
1 small  can mushrooms
preparation: Pour soup and brown gravy mix into slow cooker; mix well. Add soup can of water and mix.  Add beef cubes and cook on medium for as much as 8 hours.  Before serving, add mushrooms.

name: HAWAIIAN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  envelope Durkee beef gravy
1  envelope Durkee chicken gravy
1 1/2  lb. hamburg
1/2  lb. spaghetti
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  small onion, diced
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
preparation: Cook spaghetti according to directions on package; drain after cooked.  Fry hamburg and onion in skillet; drain fat.   Combine mushrooms, soy sauce, salt and pepper to hamburg mixture; add to spaghetti.  Cook gravy according to package instructions; add to spaghetti mixture.  Mix well.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. milk
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. corn (cream-style)
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1  lump butter
preparation: Mix flour and sugar together. Stir into beaten eggs and milk. Add corn and butter.  Pour into greased casserole and bake 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/3  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. softened margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Mix sugars, margarine and vanilla.  Beat in egg.  Stir in flour, baking soda and salt.  Mix in chocolate chips.  Spread dough in pan.  Bake until light brown, 12 to 14 minutes.  Cool; cut into bars.

name: CREAMY PEACH PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. flour
1 small  pkg. vanilla pudding and pie filling
1/4  c. oil
1  egg
3/4  Tbsp. butter, softened
1 (16 oz.)  can sliced peaches, drained
3 to 4  Tbsp. peach juice
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1 large  pkg. cream cheese, softened
sugar
preparation: Combine the first 5 ingredients in bowl; mix well.  Spread in 9-inch pie plate.  Arrange peaches in pie plate, reserving and chopping several for topping.  Combine cream cheese, 1/2 cup sugar and peach juice in bowl; mix well.  Spread over peaches.  Combine 1 tablespoon sugar and cinnamon; mix well.  Arrange reserved chopped peaches over cream cheese layer.  Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. biscuit mix
1  lb. hot sausage
1  lb. Cheddar cheese
1  lb. Colby cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients until dough sticks together.  Roll into balls the size of walnut.  Bake  for 25 minutes; drain on paper towels.  Serve warm on toothpicks. Makes about 75 pieces.  Great for the holidays or small parties.

name: CHOCOLATE ANGEL PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. instant chocolate pudding mix
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. milk
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. frozen nondairy whipped topping, thawed
preparation: Combine pudding mix and cocoa in a medium bowl.  Blend well. Add milk.  Beat with rotary beater or at lowest speed of electric mixer for 1 minute.  Fold in thawed topping.  Spoon into baked and cooled crust.  Freeze at least 4 hours.

name: CHILI-CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
2  cans Hormel chili (no beans)
8  oz. Velveeta cheese
Doritos chips or Tostitos
preparation: Put cheese in a microwaveable bowl.  Add chili.  Microwave on High for 9 minutes (stir halfway through cooking time).  Stir again before serving.  Serve with a big bowl of Doritos.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box chopped frozen broccoli, cooked and drained
2  eggs, beaten
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2 to 3/4  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Have the chopped frozen broccoli cooked, drained and placed as base in a casserole dish and add the rest of the ingredients.  Bake at 350° until heated through.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1  (3 oz.) pistachio pudding mix
1  can crushed pineapple with juice
9  oz. Cool Whip
1/2  c. nuts
1  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Mix pudding and nuts together.  Add pineapple and marshmallows; mix together.  Add Cool Whip very carefully.  Chill. This is better when left in the fridge for a couple of days!

name: BURGER BUNDLES
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2/3  c. milk
2  c. moist bread stuffing
2  cans cream of chicken soup
4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. catsup
preparation: Mix beef with milk.  Divide into 10 patties.  On waxed paper, flatten each patty to form a 6-inch circle.  Put equal amounts of stuffing on each of 5 patties.  Place another pattie on top and seal.

name: VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. water
2  beef or chicken bouillon cubes
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1  small onion, chopped
3  stalks celery, chopped
2  carrots, thinly sliced
1/8  head cabbage, shredded
1  c. canned tomatoes
1  small bell pepper
preparation: Bring water to a boil.  Add cubes, garlic powder and pepper. Next, add onion, celery, carrots and cabbage.  Boil gently until vegetables are tender.  Add tomatoes; boil gently until all is heated and serve.

name: BACON AND CUCUMBER DIP
ingredients:
1  large cucumber
8  slices bacon
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1 1/2  tsp. salt
4  hard-boiled eggs
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. green pepper, finely chopped
preparation: Peel and chop cucumber very fine.  Drain well.  Cut the bacon in small pieces and fry until crisp.  Drain off fat.  Add all ingredients and mix good.  Serve with crackers or chips.

name: CINNAMON-LEMON COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. grated lemon peel
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: In a mixing bowl, cream together sugar and butter.  Beat in egg and vanilla.  Combine flour, cinnamon, baking powder, lemon peel and salt.  Cover and refrigerate 2 hours until firm.  Shape dough into small balls about 3/4-inch in diameter.  Roll in cinnamon-sugar to coat.  Place cookies 1-inch apart on lightly greased cookie sheets.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until edges are light brown.  Cool slightly before your remove from baking sheets.

name: GRANDMOTHER'S BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  stick butter or margarine
4  eggs
2  squares unsweetened chocolate
1  c. pecans, chopped
1  c. flour, sifted
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Melt chocolate and butter over low heat.  Cream eggs and sugar.  Add chocolate mixture.  Stir well.  Add dry ingredients and nuts.  Bake in greased, glass baking dish at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Cool and cut into squares.

name: SAUSAGE BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
soft margarine
5  eggs
1  tsp. salt
2  c. half and half milk
6  slices bread
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Cook sausage.  Stir to crumble. Drain.  Spread each slice of bread with margarine and cut into cubes.  Put cubes in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with sausage. Top with cheese.  Combine remaining ingredients. Beat.  Pour over mixture.  Chill 8 hours or overnight.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Good for Derby Day!

name: CHICKEN NOODLE CASSEROLE(Makes 10 Servings)
ingredients:
1  (3 lb.) chicken
3  to 4 stalks celery, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
6  to 8 peppercorns
1  lb. medium noodles
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of tomato soup
8  oz. grated Longhorn cheese or medium sharp Cheddar
1 small  can mushrooms (optional)
preparation: Cook chicken, celery, onion and peppercorns in Dutch oven with only enough water to come to tips of wings for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Remove chicken from pot; cool and remove meat from bones.  Cook noodles in chicken water in Dutch oven, stirring at first.  (There will not be much water, but don't add any, because noodles are to absorb all of broth.)  Add chicken and soups to noodles (and mushrooms if desired).  Transfer to 9 x 13-inch pan; grate cheese on top.  Bake at 350° in oven until cheese melts and casserole is bubbly, about 25 minutes.  Casserole can be frozen before baking or divided.  Freeze half for another meal.  Can be cooked frozen for 65 minutes at 350°.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 medium  can pork and beans
1/2  c. ketchup
1  tsp. seasoning salt
preparation: Cook ground beef and onion in heavy skillet until brown. Drain off fat.  Add other ingredients.  Pour in casserole dish and bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

name: SALSA #2
ingredients:
14  lb. tomatoes, peeled and quartered
3  lb. onions, coarsely chopped
10  green peppers, coarsely chopped
10  Hungarian wax hot peppers with seeds, chopped
1  c. vinegar
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. salt
2  tsp. oregano
1 1/2  tsp. cumin
3  cloves garlic, finely chopped
2  Tbsp. hot Mexican chili powder
6  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Cook vegetables, vinegar, sugar, salt and seasonings for 40 minutes.  Thicken with cornstarch.  Ladle into pint jars.  Process 20 minutes at 10 pounds pressure.  Yields approximately 18 pints.

name: DEVILED EGGS
ingredients:
6  large eggs
2  Tbsp mayonnaise
1  1/2 Tbsp sweet pickles relish
1  tsp prepared mustard
1/8  tsp salt
dash of pepper
paprika, (for garnish)
preparation: *Also try adding honey mustard instead of the mayo and regular mustard this is great.

name: PRETTY GOOD CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
5  or more chicken breasts
1/2  c. onion, finely chopped
2  cloves garlic, chopped or pureed
2-4 Tbsp. Kikkoman Teriyaki marinade
Approximately 1 3/4 c. Dukes mayonnaise
1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 small  can water chestnuts, drained and rinsed
Dash of liquid smoke
preparation: Grill chicken breasts.	Chop coarsely across grain.  Combine with all other ingredients in a large bowl and mix.  Hands work well for this.  Add more or less mayonnaise for desired consistency.  Chill for a while before serving.  May garnish with chives or fresh parsley.

name: ORANGE SHERBET JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  box orange jello
1  c. hot water
1/2  pt. orange sherbet
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1 small  carton Cool Whip
1/4 to 1/2  c. chopped nuts (if desired)
preparation: Dissolve jello in hot water.  Add orange sherbet and crushed pineapple.  Chill until partially set.  Add Cool Whip and nut meats (if desired).  Refrigerate until set.  You can use sugar less jello, no sugar pineapple and low calorie Cool Whip for low calorie dessert.

name: OREO COOKIE CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  bag Oreo cookies
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
1  large tub Cool Whip
2  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Crumble cookies.  Melt butter and pour over half of Oreos.

name: TONI'S CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
3/4  c. granulated sugar
1  c. butter, melted
1  Tbsp. Harvey's Bristol cream sherry
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  tsp. baking soda
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped walnuts
12  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Beat sugars and butter in a large bowl until fluffy.  Beat in Bristol Cream and eggs.  Stir in flour, baking soda and salt.  Add nuts and chocolate chips.  Drop dough about 2 inches apart onto a greased cookie sheet.  Bake 11 to 14 minutes or until edges are lightly browned.

name: EGG AND BACON SPREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. bacon
6  eggs
mayonnaise
tomato
pickles (optional)
preparation: Fry bacon.  Hard boil eggs.  Let grease drain from bacon while peeling shells from eggs.  Crush eggs up in medium mixing bowl. Crumble bacon in with eggs.  Add 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise.  Mix together well.  Spread on wheat bread topped with sliced tomato and enjoy.

name: BAKED SWEET POTATOES WITH MARSHMALLOWS
ingredients:
8  medium-size sweet potatoes
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  stick butter
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
few dashes of nutmeg
1  Tbsp. orange juice
marshmallows
preparation: Bake sweet potatoes in 350° oven until done.  Peel hot potatoes and put through ricer until mashed.  Scald milk and add vanilla, sugar and butter.  To potatoes, add cinnamon, nutmeg and orange juice; stir.  Add milk mixture to potatoes.  Layer potatoes and marshmallows in casserole dish.  Bake at 350° until very hot. Add a top layer of marshmallows and brown.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. water
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. cold water
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
red food coloring
1  qt. sliced fresh strawberries
preparation: Put the water and sugar in saucepan and bring to a boil.  Mix the water, cornstarch and lemon juice.  Pour into boiled mixture and boil until thick and clear.  Add the food coloring. Cool and pour in the strawberries.

name: HOMEMADE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
6  eggs
1  qt. half and half
2  c. Cool Whip
2 1/2  c. fruit
preparation: Mix together and freeze in ice cream freezer.

name: COOKED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  large cabbage
red pepper to taste
oil
chunk of ham
preparation: Boil ham.  Wash and cut up cabbage.  Put in a big pot with enough water to cover cabbage a little bit.  Add red pepper to taste.  Add boiled ham and cook covered for 30 minutes.  When Mama made it, it was mmm...good!

name: COLLARDS(Better After Frost)
ingredients:
2  heads collards
1/2  lb. fatback meat
1  tsp. sugar
salt and pepper
preparation: Wash and strip heavy stems from collards.  Slice fatback meat; soak in cold water for 1 hour.  Pat meat dry.  Fry in heavy pot or frying pan until all grease is fried out.  Place grease and fatback in large pot.  Add small amount of water.  Add sugar.  Cut collards up.  Drop drippings wet in hot grease.  Stir; cover and cook for about 45 minutes, or until tender.  Add salt when almost done.

name: SPAGHETTI CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. thin spaghetti
1  small chopped onion
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
4  c. chopped chicken
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
preparation: Cook spaghetti; drain and set aside.  Cook pepper and onion in chicken broth until tender.  Add cheese, soups and seasonings; stir.  Add chicken and spaghetti.  Mix well and pour into large baking dish.  Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes at 325°.  Remove foil and bake 15 minutes longer.

name: TEX-MEXICAN CHOPS
ingredients:
pork chops
1  Tbsp. oil
1 large  jar salsa (chunky)
1 (4 oz.)  can green chillies
preparation: Brown chops in oil.  Add salsa and chillies.  Cook over low heat.  Cover and simmer for 1 hour.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) Keebler chocolate crust
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, at room temperature
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip, thawed
1  c. extra crunchy peanut butter
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Pour into pie crust. Chill at least 4 hours.

name: LINGUICA AND PORK CHOPS AND VEGETABLES
ingredients:
5  to 6 pork chops
2  large green peppers, sliced
2  large onions, sliced
linguica, washed and cut up
1/2 to 3/4  c. ketchup
1/4  c. water
paprika
salt and pepper
potatoes, washed and sliced
carrots, washed and sliced into small pieces
preparation: Wash pork chops and pat dry.  Place in bottom of large roasting pan.  Add peppers, onions, carrots and potatoes (rub with paprika).  Add salt, pepper, ketchup and small amount of water. Cut up linguica and place around.  Bake at 350°, covered, for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, until vegetables and pork chops are done.

name: CHICKEN ADOBO
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken thighs, legs or wings
4  cloves garlic, chopped
1  onion, diced
1/4  c. vinegar (apple cider recommended)
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. oyster sauce
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
preparation: Saute garlic until brown in medium saucepan.    Add onion, chicken, vinegar, soy sauce and oyster sauce.    Cover; cook until tender.    Sauce will thicken.    Halfway between cooking, taste mixture.   Add additional vinegar, soy sauce or oyster sauce as needed to own liking.

name: 7-LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
lettuce, torn into bite size pieces (about 1 head)
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  c. chopped red onion
1 1/2  c. chopped green pepper
2  pkg. frozen peas, cooked, drained and cooled
1  pt. Kraft salad dressing
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. Parmesan cheese
8  strips bacon, crumbled
preparation: Place the torn lettuce in a large mixing bowl.  Then, in order in layers, add the chopped celery, chopped red onion, chopped green pepper and the peas.  Spread evenly with the salad dressing. Sprinkle the sugar over salad dressing.  Sprinkle the Parmesan cheese over sugar.  Top with crumbled bacon.  Cover with Saran Wrap; chill overnight.  Serves 12.   (Recipe can be cut in half for smaller group.)

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  box Dream Whip (2 envelopes)
1  box confectioners sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  can strawberry pie filling
2  deep dish pie crusts
preparation: Whip Dream Whip as directed on package.  Combine confectioners sugar and softened cream cheese; then add to Dream Whip.  Spread evenly in two baked deep dish pie crusts.  Pour half of pie filling on each.  (Looks good if you use back of spoon and press pie filling down into cream cheese mixture.)  Yield:  2 pies.

name: AUNT BETSY'S BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
2  c brown sugar
2  c ketchup
2  T mustard
2  T cider vinegar
dash Worcestershire sauce (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate until ready to use.

name: LIGHT 'N LEMONY FISH
ingredients:
2  lb. fresh or frozen sole, halibut or other firm fish
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
1/2  c. lemon juice
4  green onions, sliced thin
1/2  tsp. white pepper
4  Tbsp. sherry
1/2  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. seasoned salt
preparation: Arrange fish fillets in single layer in a baking dish.  Combine remaining ingredients, except onions, and pour over fish.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, basting occasionally.  Remove fish and garnish with green onions.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: SPINACH BALLS
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach, chopped
3  eggs, beaten
2  c. packaged stuffing
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1  onion, chopped fine
3/4  c. butter
2  tsp. garlic salt
1 1/2  tsp. ground pepper
preparation: Melt butter and saute onions.  Add all other ingredients.  Mix well.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or freeze until ready to cook.

name: CRANBERRY SWIRL COFFEECAKE
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. margarine or butter
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. almond extract
1 (8 oz.)  carton dairy sour cream
3/4  c. canned whole berry or jellied cranberry sauce
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Stir together flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and nutmeg in a mixing bowl; set aside.  Beat margarine or butter in a large mixing bowl until softened.  Add eggs and almond extract. Beat until well combined.  Add flour mixture alternately with sour cream, beating just until combined.  Spoon half of the batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Spoon half of the cranberry sauce and half of the walnuts over the batter.  Repeat layers with remaining batter, cranberry sauce and walnuts.  Gently cut through the mixture with a knife to swirl.  Bake in a 350° oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until the cake tests done.  Cool on a wire rack for 20 minutes.  Remove from pan.  Serve warm.  Makes 12 to 16 servings.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. squash, cooked
3  Tbsp. onions, chopped
1  c. grated cheese
1  c. saltine crackers, crushed
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. butter
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mash squash up.  Add eggs, 1/2 cup crackers, 1/4 cup butter, milk, onions, cheese, salt and pepper.  Mix well.  Pour into casserole and top with 1/4 cup melted butter.  Sprinkle 1/2 cup crackers on top.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until brown around edges.  You may garnish with cheese, if desired.

name: Spring Pie
ingredients:
1  c. boiling water
1  pkg. lemon gelatin
1  c. orange sherbet
2  c. Cool Whip, thawed
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  graham cracker crust
preparation: In medium bowl, stir boiling water into gelatin until completely dissolved.  Add sherbet; mix until melted.  Refrigerate about 25 minutes, or until mixture is slightly thickened.  Fold in whipped topping, marshmallows and pineapple.  Pour into crust. Freeze until firm.  Remove from freezer 20 to 30 minutes before serving.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: CINNAMON CRESCENTS
ingredients:
1  can Pillsbury crescent rolls
3  egg whites (room temperature)
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1 egg, beaten with 2  tsp. water
powdered sugar
preparation: For filling, beat 3 egg whites until stiff peaks form; gradually beat in 2/3 cup of sugar.

name: ANGEL FOOD-SHERBET CAKE
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1  container softened sherbet
1  container nondairy Cool Whip
preparation: Slice angel food cake horizontally in middle; separate.  Slice 1-inch pieces of sherbet and place on bottom layer of cake.  Cover all of bottom layer with sherbet.  Place top layer of cake. Refreeze.  Cut wedges and serve.  Top with Cool Whip.

name: NUTMEG POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. ground nutmeg
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  lb. unsalted butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. powdered sugar
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Butter and flour a 12-cup Bundt pan. Combine flour, soda, nutmeg, salt and baking powder.  With an electric mixer at medium speed, beat butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat in eggs, one at a time, beating well.  Add vanilla.  On low speed, gradually beat in flour mixture, alternating with buttermilk.  Spread in pan.  Bake until toothpick comes out clean, about 45 minutes.  Put powdered sugar in a sieve and sprinkle over cooled cake.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. grated zucchini
1  tsp. baking powder
3  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Beat eggs, oil and sugar until light.  Add sifted dry ingredients.  Stir in grated zucchini.  Add vanilla and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Makes 2 loaves.

name: CAJUN GUMBO
ingredients:
1  large hen, cut in pieces
1  wild duck, cut in pieces
1  lb. pork sausage
1  link smoked sausage
1  large onion, diced
1  envelope onion soup mix
parsley
Louisiana hot sauce
roux
salt and pepper
preparation: Place hen in large baking pan and brown well.  Brown duck and sausage in Dutch oven.  Meanwhile, fill a large gumbo pot half full of water.  Boil on high.  Add onion soup mix, onion and roux (about 1/2 pint, depending on how dark you like your gumbo). Drain meat well and add to gumbo.  Add salt, pepper and hot sauce to taste.  When meat is almost cooked; add parsley.  Serve over hot rice.  Feeds a gang!

name: PINK ANGEL CAKE(Easter Dessert)
ingredients:
1  (10-inch) angel food cake
1  pkg. frozen strawberries (10 oz.)
1  envelope plain gelatin
2  c. heavy cream
preparation: Thaw strawberries and drain off juice.  Sprinkle gelatin over juice in a small dish.  Allow to stand until gelatin is softened. Set dish in hot water until gelatin dissolves.  Combine gelatin mixture with berries.  Chill until thickened but not congealed.

name: SAUTE VEGETABLES OVER RICE
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) low-fat Italian salad dressing
1  (8 oz.) water
1 to 2  lb. California Blend frozen vegetables
1  small zucchini, sliced
1  small summer squash, sliced
1  small onion, chopped
1  large or 2 medium tomatoes, chopped
preparation: Put water, Italian dressing and California Blend in a large saucepan.  Cook until vegetables are almost done.  Add the squash, zucchini, onions and tomatoes to vegetables.  Cook for 5 minutes more.  Serve over a bed of rice.

name: FLUFFY DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
1  c. milk
1 1/2  c. flour
2  eggs
preparation: Bring butter and milk to a boil.  Then add flour; separate eggs and add egg yolks one at a time.  Beat egg whites and add to the above.  Drop by spoonfuls onto stew, soups, etc.   Cook, uncovered, for about 20 minutes.

name: FAT-FREE OATMEAL RAISIN COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. plain flour
1  c. quick oats
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  egg whites
1/3  c. Karo syrup
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Spray cookie sheet with Pam.  In bowl, combine dry ingredients.  Stir in egg whites, syrup and vanilla until well mixed.  Add raisins.  Batter will be stiff.  Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet.  Bake 10 minutes or until firm.  Do not overbake.  Remove and cool on wire rack.  Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

name: BACONY CHESTNUTS
ingredients:
water chestnuts
bacon
preparation: You will need toothpicks.

name: PEAS WITH BACON
ingredients:
3  slices bacon
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  tsp. flour
1  c. light cream
2  c. shelled fresh peas or 1 (10 oz.) frozen peas, thawed
preparation: Fry bacon until crisp; drain.  Cook onion in bacon drippings until tender.  Blend in flour, stir in light cream.  Add peas, cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until peas are tender, 15 minutes for fresh peas.  Add bacon, season to taste.  Makes 4 servings.

name: MOM'S BLUEBERRY CAKE(This is a very old recipe.)
ingredients:
1  c. blueberries
1 3/4  c. flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  egg
1/4  c. oleo
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Cream egg, sugar, oleo and milk.  Add flour, salt and baking powder.  Fold in blueberries.  Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Sprinkle with sugar.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: FROZEN GROUND BEEF SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. frozen ground beef
1 large  pkg. mixed soup vegetables
3  cans tomato sauce
3  cans water (tomato sauce can)
1/2  onion, chopped fine
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/8  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/4  tsp. marjoram
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients in heavy container with top.  Cook until ground beef is done, about 30 minutes.  Then chop meat into large pieces.  Put top back on and cook about 20 minutes longer.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
3/4  c. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. Bisquick mix
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Grease a pie plate.  Mix all together in blender for one minute.  Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.  May use Sweet 'N Low package for sugar.

name: PEACH CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
4  large peaches
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs, well beaten
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. butter or oleo
preparation: Fill pastry shell with peaches.  Combine other ingredients and pour over peaches.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. sour cream
1  pkg. dry taco mix
preparation: Mix soft cream cheese (room temperature) and sour cream until real smooth.  Add the taco mix. Mix thoroughly and let set several hours or overnight.

name: BUTTERMILK SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Jell-O (any flavor)
8  oz. Cool Whip
2  c. buttermilk
nuts to taste
marshmallows to taste
1  can mandarin oranges or fruit of your choice, drained
preparation: Bring to  a boil the pineapple and Jell-O.  Chill until cool but  not  set.  Mix  Cool Whip and buttermilk together in blender. When  Jell-O mixture is chilled, fold in the buttermilk  mixture and  add  the  nuts,  marshmallows  and  fruit. Colored  miniature marshmallows  work  nice and so does fruit cocktail.

name: REDUCED SODIUM HERB BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  c. thinly sliced carrots
1  c. thinly sliced onions
3 1/2  lb. broiler chicken, cut in pieces
1  c. chicken stock
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. rosemary
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. marjoram
1/4  tsp. ground pepper
1/3  c. chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Heat oven to 325°.  Arrange carrots and onions in a shallow baking dish.  Place chicken, skin side up, over vegetables.  Pour 1/2 cup of the stock over chicken; cover tightly and bake 45 minutes.  Meanwhile in a small pan, bring to a boil remaining stock, lemon juice, rosemary, thyme, marjoram and pepper.  Remove from heat; increase oven temperature to 400°.  Uncover chicken and bake, basting with herb mix for 20 minutes or until chicken is tender and skin is browned.  Spoon vegetables over chicken and serve.  Makes 4 servings, 107 mg. sodium per serving.

name: TORTELLINI CHICKEN AND ARTICHOKE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. green beans
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. uncooked cheese tortellini
3  c. cubed, cooked chicken
1/2  cucumber, sliced
1/4  c. red onion
1  medium tomato, chopped
1 (14 oz.)  can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Caesar salad dressing
preparation: Cook green beans according to package; drain.  Meanwhile, cook tortellini to desired doneness as directed on package; rinse with cold water.

name: COCONUT MERINGUE COOKIES
ingredients:
3  egg whites
2/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla (white)
2  cans (4 oz. each) flaked coconut
preparation: Beat egg whites until foamy, white and double in volume in a medium bowl.  Beat in sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating all the time until meringue stands in firm peaks.  Fold in vanilla and coconut.  Drop by teaspoon, 2 inches apart, on greased and floured large sheets.  Bake in very slow oven (250°) for 35 minutes or until lightly golden.  Remove from sheet to wire racks.  Let stand to cool completely.

name: HEAVENLY HASH
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
2  egg yolks
4  Tbsp. flour
juice of large can of pineapple
preparation: Mix together and cook until thick.  Beat 1 pint whipping cream. Beat egg whites.  Add pineapple and marshmallows.

name: SWEET POTATO SOUFFLE
ingredients:
3  c. sweet potatoes, mashed
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. milk
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  stick butter, melted
1/3  c. flour
1  tsp. orange peel, grated
2  Tbsp. orange juice
preparation: Combine all ingredients; mix well and pour into a greased 2-quart baking dish.

name: FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
3  med. onions, chopped
1/4  c. margarine
2  cans beef broth
1/2  c. water
2  tsp. worcestershire sauce
4  pieces of french bread torn into bite-sized pieces
shredded mozzarella cheese
preparation: In saucepan cook onions in margarine until tender.  Add broth, water, worcestershire sauce.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat, simmer covered for 25 minutes.  Put bread into 4 oven proof bowls. Pour mixture over bread and sprinkle top of broth with mozzarella cheese.  Broil until cheese melts and is slightly brown. Serves 4.

name: MEDITERRANEAN STROGANOFF
ingredients:
3  c. broccoli, bite size
4  medium carrots, thinly sliced
1/4  c. butter
1  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1  medium leek (3-4 green onions), sliced
1  clove garlic, minced
3  Tbsp. flour
2  c. lite cream or milk
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. bouillon or 1 cube
1/2  c. dry white wine
1/2  c. sliced ripe olives
1  c. sour cream
1  c. ricotta
1/2  c. grated Parmesan
preparation: Cook broccoli and carrots in boiling, salted water 5 minutes or until crisp and tender.  Drain.  Saute mushrooms, leek and garlic in butter until mushrooms are tender.  Blend in flour. Stir in cream, soy and bouillon.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.  Add drained veggies, wine and olives.  In small bowl, combine sour cream, ricotta and Parmesan.  Gradually stir 1 cup hot mixture into cheese and then return to pan.  Cook 3 to 4 minutes until heated.  Do not boil!

name: TWICE BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  small baking potato per person
1  Tbsp. each, per potato, butter and sour cream
milk
seasoned salt
pepper
grated cheddar cheese
preparation: Bake or microwave potatoes. When done, cut in half lengthwise. Scoop potatoes into a bowl. Add butter and sour cream. Mash with a fork. Add enough milk for mashed potato consistency. Salt and pepper to taste. Put potato mixture back into shells and top with cheese. Microwave until cheese melts or put in 325° oven for 10 minutes.

name: ANYTIME CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. Sloppy Joe seasoning mix
1 1/2  c. water
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (12 oz.)  can Mexican-style corn
8  oz. spiral macaroni
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger; drain fat.  Add Sloppy Joe mix, water, paste and corn.  Stir.  Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes.

name: APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. melted margarine
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla extract
3  c. coarsely chopped raw apples, grated
1  (10-inch) unbaked pie shell
preparation: Mix sugar and flour together.  Add beaten eggs, melted margarine, nutmeg, cinnamon and vanilla extract.  Stir in grated apples.  Let filling mixture stand.

name: CAULIFLOWER SALAD BOWL
ingredients:
4  cups cauliflower, broken into pieces
1  cup pitted coarsely chopped black olives
2/3  cup chopped green pepper
1/2  cup chopped onion
1/2  cup vegetable oil
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. rice vinegar
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. sugar
preparation: Place all ingredients in bowl and mixture thoroughly.  Chill prior to serving.

name: ICEBOX FRUITCAKE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. vanilla wafers
16  graham crackers
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1 (8 oz.)  jar maraschino cherries, cut up and drained
1  qt. chopped pecans
1 (15 oz.)  pkg. raisins
5  tsp. cherry juice
preparation: Blend vanilla wafers and graham crackers in blender.  In a large bowl, mix ingredients in order.  Put in a greased (with butter) tube pan.  Set in icebox (covered with foil) for one day and then turn out and keep covered in icebox until all is gone. Won't last long!  Very good!

name: CINNAMON APPLESAUCE JELLO
ingredients:
1/3  c. red cinnamon candied
6  oz. lemon jello
2  c. applesauce
6  oz. cream cheese
1/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
preparation: Dissolve candy and jello in 2 cups boiling water.  Stir in applesauce.  Chill until partially set.  Mix cream cheese, mayonnaise and milk.  Fold into jello and chill.

name: ZERO SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. lemon juice or vinegar
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid.  Shake well before using.  Add parsley, green pepper, horseradish or mustard if necessary.  May be used in any amount. Almost no calories.

name: TEX-MEX MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground turkey or chicken breast
3  slices fat-free bread,  torn in small pieces
1  egg or 2 egg whites
1  can Ro-Tel diced tomatoes and green chilies
1  small onion, chopped
1  tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/3  c. chili sauce
1/4  c. fat-free Cheddar cheese, shredded or lay slices of Borden fat-free American cheese on top (it melts)
preparation: Combine all but chili sauce and cheese.  Spread in ungreased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.  Bake one hour, covered.  Spoon chili sauce over cooked loaf and cover with cheese.  Bake an additional 15 minutes in 350° oven.

name: STRAWBERRY NUT SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. strawberry gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
3  medium size bananas, crushed
1  c. chopped pecans
2  c. sour cream
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Fold in thawed strawberries with juice, drained pineapple, bananas and nuts. Pour 1/2 mixture into a 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan and chill until firm. Spread top with sour cream and gently spoon on rest of mixture. Chill until firm.

name: GARDEN PASTA BAKE
ingredients:
6  oz. penne pasta
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. butter
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can diced tomatoes (not drained)
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can Del Monte sweet whole kernel corn, drained
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can fresh cut green beans, drained
1 (10 1/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
2  c. diced cooked ham or chicken (optional)
preparation: Cook pasta as directed on package; drain. Cook onions in butter in 10-inch skillet until tender. Add tomatoes, corn, green beans and 1/2 of cheese. Stir in soup; mix well. Combine pasta with vegetable mixture. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Pour into 11 x 8-inch baking dish or casserole dish. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until hot.

name: JELLO CAKE
ingredients:
1  angel food cake or sponge cake
2  boxes Jell-O (any flavor)
preparation: Prepare Jell-O as directed on box.  Let Jell-O cool a little. Punch holes in cake with a wooden spoon.  Pour Jell-O over cake and put in refrigerator until Jell-O gels.   May be served with Cool Whip.  This is a good summer dish!

name: CORNY CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. oil
2  eggs
1 small  can creamed corn
1  c. self-rising corn meal
1  carton sour cream
preparation: Mix and cook at 350° for 40  minutes.

name: CREAMY MINTED MOCHA
ingredients:
2  hard peppermint candies
1/2  c. Cremora nondairy creamer
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. instant coffee
2  Tbsp. unsweetened cocoa
preparation: In food processor or blender container, crush peppermint candy. Add remaining ingredients; mix well.  Store in airtight container.

name: DIXIELAND STIR-FRY
ingredients:
2  c. cubed purple-top turnips
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. minced garlic
1  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  apple, cubed
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. sugar
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. pork sausage (optional)
preparation: In a 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat, place turnips, oil, garlic and celery. Cook 10 minutes. Stir frequently. Reduce heat to medium add lemon juice, apple, Worcestershire sauce, sugar, salt and pepper. Stir to blend. Crumble sausage into vegetables. Stir and cook until all the pink is gone from sausage. Add 1/2 cup water; stir, cover and remove from heat. Let sit 4 or 5 minutes to steam. Serve with rice or noodles. Serves 4.

name: HARVARD BEETS(5 Servings)
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. tarragon vinegar (optional)
3  c. sliced, cooked beets
preparation: Melt butter or margarine in top of double boiler over low heat. Remove top of double boiler from heat.  Add cornstarch, sugar and salt; stir until smooth.  Add vinegar and tarragon vinegar slowly; stir to make a smooth paste.  Return to heat and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture boils.  Add sliced, cooked beets.  Cover and place over simmering water in bottom of double boiler and heat for about 15 minutes.

name: CHRISTMAS EVE BARBECUE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  jar Heinz chili sauce
ketchup
1  onion
1  green pepper
preparation: Cut onion and pepper into small pieces.  Combine with ground beef in skillet.  Brown hamburger.  Drain off grease.  Put back in skillet and add jar of chili sauce and a little ketchup.  Mix together and cook on low heat for about 30 minutes.  If it gets dry, add more ketchup.

name: GROUND BEEF DINNER
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. oil
1  lb. ground beef
1 1/4  c. minced onion
1  green pepper, diced
1  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
1 large  can tomatoes
1 large or 2 small  cans kidney beans
3/4  c. uncooked rice
1/2  c. grated cheese
1/4  c. chopped black olives
preparation: Brown meat lightly in oil; add onion, green pepper, chili powder and salt.  Cook about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat; add tomatoes, beans and rice.  Mix well.  Pour into greased casserole and bake, covered, for 1 hour at 350°. Sprinkle with cheese and olives; return to oven, uncovered, for 15 minutes.

name: ROASTED NEW POTATOES
ingredients:
24  small new potatoes (2 1/2 lb.)
olive oil cooking spray
1/4  c. Italian seasoned breadcrumbs
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
3/4  tsp. paprika
preparation: Cook unpeeled potatoes in boiling water about 15 minutes; drain and cool slightly.  Quarter potatoes; spray cut sides with spray.  Combine remaining ingredients; dredge cut sides in mixture.  Place in a single layer on a baking sheet, coated with the cooking spray.  Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.

name: EASY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
4 1/2  oz. grated cheese
1  envelope Hidden Valley salad dressing mix
chopped pecans
preparation: Let cream cheese and Cheddar cheese come to room temperature. Mix cheeses, gradually adding dressing mix, a little at a time until entire package is used.  If too sticky, refrigerate or place in freezer 30 to 45 minutes.  Shape into ball and roll in pecans. Makes a large ball so recipe can be cut in half.

name: CREAM CHEESE MUFFIN PUFFS
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. almond extract
1/4  c. melted margarine
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  can Pillsbury buttermilk biscuits
3  oz. Philadelphia cream cheese, cut into 8 cubes
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  In a small bowl, combine sugar, cinnamon and almond extract.  In another small bowl, combine margarine and vanilla.

name: FROSTY CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
9-inch graham cracker crumb crust pie shell
4  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  c. Hershey's syrup
1/2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. frozen nondairy topping, thawed
preparation: In large bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth.  Gradually add 1 cup syrup and milk, beating until blended.  Fold in whipped topping.  Pour mixture into crust.  Freeze several hours or overnight.  (Wrap pie after partially frozen.) Serve topped with chilled syrup.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: VANILLA SUGAR COOKIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking powder
2 3/4  c. flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Cream butter and sugar.  Beat in eggs and vanilla.  Add baking powder and flour, 1 cup at a time, mixing after each addition.  Dough will be stiff.  Do not chill.  Roll out dough on floured surface to 1/8-inch thick.  Dip cookie cutters in flour and cut dough into shapes.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 6 to 7 minutes until light brown.  Remove immediately from sheet.  Decorate with frosting.

name: APPLE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. flour
2  eggs
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. chopped apples
preparation: Mix all together.  Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: ALL IN ONE QUICHE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. biscuit mix
6  Tbsp. butter (room temperature)
3  eggs
pinch of salt
1  c. diced ham, turkey, shrimp, chicken, bacon or vegetables
4  oz. can sliced mushrooms, drained
1  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine first  5 ingredients in blender and mix well.  Turn into ungreased deep dish 9-inch or regular 10-inch pan.  Add meat, shellfish or vegetables, poking into batter.  Top with onions, mushrooms and cheese.  Bake until top is golden brown, about 45 minutes at 350°.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

name: EASY BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix all together and bake in a greased 8 x 8-inch pan for 25 minutes in 350° oven.

name: PLAIN AND SIMPLE CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. yellow cornmeal
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  egg
2 1/2  Tbsp. corn oil
preparation: Heat oiled 10-inch iron skillet.  Sift together the first 4 ingredients.  Add milk, then unbeaten egg and mix well.  Heat oil and add.  Turn into hot skillet.  Bake at 450° for 30 minutes.

name: CRANBERRY CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken breast (boneless)
2 (8 oz.)  bottles French dressing
2  pkg. Lipton onion soup
2 (12 oz.)  cans berried cranberry sauce
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place chicken (single layer) in baking dish.  Spread French dressing over chicken with pastry brush. Sprinkle 2 packages of Lipton onion soup over French dressing. Spread berried cranberry over Lipton onion soup.  Place in oven (not covered) for 1 hour.  Tastes great served over rice.

name: PINK SQUIRREL
ingredients:
5  quarts vanilla ice cream
12  oz. cool whip
1  1/2 cups Cream de Almond
1  1/2 cups white Cream de Coco
preparation: Mix all together and enjoy.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. unsalted peanuts
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/8  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In glass mixing bowl combine peanuts, sugar, corn syrup and salt.  Cook  on  High  (100%  power)  7 to 8 minutes until mixture is  bubbling  and  peanuts are brown.  Quickly stir in butter and vanilla.  Cook  on  High 2 to 3 minutes longer; add soda.   Stir quickly  just  until  mixture  is  foamy.  Pour immediately onto greased baking  sheet.  Let  cool  about  15 minutes until firm. Break into pieces.

name: GOOEY BUTTER CAKE
ingredients:
1  egg
1  box yellow cake mix
1  stick butter or oleo
1  c. chopped nuts
1  box powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  eggs
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients together with hands until crumbly.  Put in 9 x 12-inch pan.  Mix remaining ingredients together.  Pour over mixture.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.  Let cool and cut in squares.  Real good, but rich.

name: CHICKEN TORTELLINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. tortellini
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Monterey Jack cheese
4  chicken breasts, cut up
3/4  c. chopped onion
2  chicken bouillon cubes
8  oz. chicken broth
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  pkg. fresh sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Cook tortellini; drain.  Roll chicken in flour and brown; set aside.  Cook onion in butter.  Add bouillon cubes, broth, sugar and mushrooms.  Bring to slow boil and cook 5 minutes.  In large bowl, combine tortellini, chicken, mushroom mixture and sour cream.  Toss gently.  Place in lightly greased baking dish.  Cover with foil and bake at 275° for 1 hour.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour (self-rising)
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ground cloves
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. allspice
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped black walnuts
3  c. raw apples, peeled and chopped
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, add oil and sugar, blending well.  Add eggs.  Blend well.  Sift dry ingredients together.  Add to creamy mixture.  Mix well.  Add apples, vanilla and nuts.  Mix well.  Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan or tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or, if using tube pan, bake for 1 hour.  May also bake in 2 or 3 layers.  Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped frozen broccoli
1/2  c. cooked rice
1  c. cream of celery or mushroom soup
8  oz. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix together all ingredients except cheese. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cheese over top of mixture. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

name: CHICKEN (OR TURKEY) CURRY IN A HURRY
ingredients:
leftover chicken or turkey, cut off the bone into fairly small pieces (about 1 1/2 cups worth)*
1 normal size  can cream of chicken soup (or cream of mushroom)
at least 1 tsp. curry powder (but then some like it hot)
1/4  c. any old white wine
a little salt and pepper (if you think it helps)
preparation: *If you make more than you can eat, this leftover becomes a pretty good leftover.

name: PICKLES
ingredients:
7  lb. cucumbers
3  c. lime
2  gal. water
3  pt. vinegar
5  lb. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. mace
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Wash and slice cucumbers.  Dissolve lime in water.  Put cucumbers in this and soak 24 hours.  Pour water off and soak in clear water 4 hours, changing water each hour.

name: RHUBARB BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
2/3  c. salad oil
1  egg, beaten
1  c. buttermilk
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. nuts
1 1/2  c. chopped rhubarb
preparation: Mix in given order.  Put into two greased bread pans.  Crumble 1 tablespoon melted butter and 1/2 cup brown sugar mixture on tops.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: TERIYAKI BEEF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak, cut into 1/4-inch thick strips
1/2  c. soy sauce
5  Tbsp. sugar
8  Tbsp. dry sherry
2  cloves fresh garlic, minced
1/2  lemon, thinly sliced
2  tsp. fresh ginger root, finely chopped, or about 1/2 tsp. powdered ginger
preparation: Blend all the liquid ingredients and the seasonings. Marinate the steak strips in this sauce for 2 hours (or more). Drain and cook quickly over charcoal or in a small amount of cooking oil in a very hot frying pan. Quickly is the key word; the steak slices should be pink inside and are much better underdone than overdone.

name: GRITS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. boiling water
1  lb. sausage, cooked and drained
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded (Monterey Jack can be substituted)
1/4  c. melted butter
2  large eggs
1/2  tsp. garlic
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1  c. instant grits
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies, diced
1 (4 oz.)  can jalapenos, diced
dash of Tabasco
preparation: Combine grits and water.  Mix with remaining ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: PESTO
ingredients:
2  bunches fresh basil (approximately 3 to 4 c.)
1 1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese (Romano, if you prefer)
1 1/2  c. finely chopped pine nuts or walnuts
1 1/4  c. olive oil
2 to 3  cloves fresh garlic
preparation: Place basil leaves (no stems; unwashed), garlic cloves and small amount of oil in food processor.  Continue to add oil until thick and pasty and leaves are all blended.  Add grated cheese. Blend slowly.  Remove from food processor and mix in pine nuts or walnuts.  Serve over hot linguine.  Makes 3 to 4 cups.  Pesto can be frozen or refrigerated.

name: HERBAL VINEGAR
ingredients:
1  c. white vinegar
1/4  c. chives or 1/4 c. dill weed or 1/2 tsp. tarragon or 1/3 c. mint or 1/2 tsp. basil or 10 oz. raspberries, strained to 3/4 cup juice plus 1 c. sugar
preparation: Shake the vinegar plus one of the other ingredients; refrigerate 4 days.  Strain.  You may add a sprig of fresh dill or mint if appropriate.   Bottle and refrigerate.  Use to make salad dressing and marinades.

name: DELICIOUS BROCCOLI BREAD
ingredients:
1  box Jiffy mix
4  eggs, whipped
1  large onion, chopped
1  stick butter or margarine
6  oz. cottage cheese
1  box chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
preparation: Sauté onions in butter or margarine. Mix Jiffy mix with eggs, cottage cheese and broccoli. Add onion and butter. Put into oblong casserole dish. Bake at 400° for 25-30 minutes; until a nice brown on top and doesn't jiggle.

name: CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
2  lb. Velveeta cheese
2  cans Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  lb. sausage, fried
preparation: Fry sausage; drain.  Add to tomatoes and cheese, put all in a slow cooker and cook until cheese is melted.

name: HOT TURKEY SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. cooked, cubed turkey or chicken
2  c. sliced celery
1/2  c. toasted almonds, chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. grated onion
2  Tbsp. lemon juice or less
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. grated American cheese
1  c. potato chips, crushed
preparation: Combine ingredients, except cheese and potato chips; toss lightly.  Pile lightly into individual bakers, or custard cups.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. broccoli spears
1  egg
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  tsp. grated onion
preparation: Cook broccoli just enough to separate well.  Chop and mix with other ingredients.  Top with 1/2 cup Pepperidge Farm crumbs that have been tossed in 2 tablespoons butter.  Bake 30 minutes at 325°.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  small onion, diced
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
2  c. quick cooking rice
2  c. water
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  tsp. salt
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, partially thawed
1 (10 oz.)  can Cheddar cheese soup
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Bake for 1 hour at 375°.

name: TRIPLE-RICH POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. chopped pecans
1/3  c. unsalted butter, room temperature
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1/3  c. whipping cream
1/4  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1/4  tsp. lemon flavoring
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Butter and flour a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Sprinkle the pecans over the bottom and sides of the pan.  With an electric mixer, cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add the flour, cream, vanilla and lemon flavorings; mix until batter is smooth.

name: BAKED SQUASH
ingredients:
yellow squash (amount according to servings needed)
cornmeal
cooking oil (peanut, vegetable or any other kind)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Lightly grease baking pan with cooking oil.  Wash squash, cut off ends and cut longways (not in circles),* thickness is according to desired taste.  Coat squash with cornmeal and place in baking dish.   Bake for approximately 20 minutes or until brown.

name: COLONIAL PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cooked pumpkin
1  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1/8  tsp. allspice
2  Tbsp. molasses
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1  can evaporated milk
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Combine pumpkin, brown sugar, salt, spices and molasses; mix well.  Add eggs and milk; mix thoroughly.  Pour into pie shells. Bake at 425° for 40 to 45 minutes, or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

name: BEEF TIPS ON NOODLES
ingredients:
2 to 2 1/2  lb. stew beef
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
1 soup  can water
1 small  can mushrooms (undrained)
pepper to taste
8  oz. egg noodles
preparation: Brown meat in about 2 tablespoons of oil; drain.  Mix with other ingredients and put in 3-quart casserole.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serve over egg noodles.

name: ITALIAN BISCUITS
ingredients:
4  c. oil
6  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. anise seed
1  tsp. baking powder
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together until smooth and spread in greased cookie sheet. Bake in 400° oven for 15 or 20 minutes.  When done, slice and toast until done.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  pkg. cream cheese
1/4 to 1/2  c. sharp cheese (Old English or Cracker Barrel)
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing mix
2 to 3  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  c. chipped beef or ham
preparation: Mix well.  Form into ball.  Refrigerate.

name: JAN'S PARTY MIX
ingredients:
1  large bag peanut M&M's (1 lb.)
1  large bag plain M&M's (1 lb.)
1  can mixed nuts
1  can peanuts
1  bag Indian corn candy
1 big  box raisins
