preparation: Toss in a large bowl; exact amounts specified are not necessary.  Mix it as you like it.

name: ZUCCHINI QUICHE
ingredients:
2  c. zucchini, chopped
1  c. chopped fresh tomatoes
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1 1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. Bisquick
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients and sprinkle them into a pie pan sprayed with Pam.  Ingredients should be in bottom of pan.  Mix the next 4 ingredients and pour over ingredients in the pan.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.  Prick for doneness.  Cool 5 minutes before serving.

name: CARROT BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
3/4  c. oil
1 3/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. sugar
2 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2 to 2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. shredded carrots
preparation: Cream eggs, sugar and oil together.  Mix in remaining ingredients.  Bake for 80 minutes at 325° in a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch bread pan.

name: SKYLINE APPLE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
2/3  c. vegetable oil
1  egg, beaten
1  c. buttermilk
1 1/2  c. apples, diced
2 1/2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: In a bowl, combine sugar, oil and egg.  In another bowl, combine flour, salt and soda, mixing well.  Add the flour mixture to the sugar mixture alternately with the buttermilk.  Mix well after each addition.  Fold in the apples and nuts.  Pour into muffin pans that have been sprayed with Pam.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  c. milk
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
6  slices bread, cubed (trim off crust)
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Brown sausage and cook; crumble and set aside.  Beat eggs, milk and remaining ingredients.  Pour all into greased casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: KANSAS DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. Oreo cookies, crushed
1  stick butter or margarine
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
2 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. milk
preparation: Spread half of the crushed cookies in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Whip together butter and cream cheese. Add sugar and Cool Whip; fold together and set aside. Prepare pudding using vanilla and milk. Add pudding mixture to cream cheese mixture and mix thoroughly. Pour over cookie crumbs. Sprinkle top with remaining crumbs. Chill 1 to 2 hours or overnight before serving. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

name: PORK CHOP POTATO SCALLOP
ingredients:
4  pork chops
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
4  c. thinly sliced potatoes
salt to taste
preparation: In skillet, brown chops, blend soup, sour cream, water and parsley in 2-quart casserole.  Alternate layers of potatoes. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and sauce.  Top with chops.  Cover. Bake at 375° for 1 1/4 hours.  Makes 4 servings.

name: SALMON CROQUETTES
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. margarine
7  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. milk
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flaked salmon
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. fine, dry bread crumbs
preparation: Melt margarine in saucepan; blend in flour.  Add milk gradually and cook about 3 minutes, stirring until a thick sauce is formed.  Add the salmon, 1 egg and 1 cup bread crumbs.  Mix and add salt.  Mix thoroughly.  Pour onto a platter and let cool. Chill in refrigerator for 1 hour or longer.  Shape into desired shapes.  Heat to medium-high heat a skillet half full of oil. Beat other egg in bowl.  Spread remaining bread crumbs on platter. Dip each first in egg, then in bread crumbs.  Fry until brown. Drain and serve.

name: MRS. JOHNSON'S COCOA RECIPE
ingredients:
2  lb. cocoa (Hershey's quick sweetened)
1  c. sugar (scant)
11 1/2  c. powdered milk or 10 qt. pkg.
1 (11 oz.)  jar Coffee-mate
preparation: Mix together.  To use, fill cup 1/2 full of mix and fill with hot water.

name: SWEET TEA
ingredients:
2  family size tea bags
1 1/4  c. sugar
water
preparation: Fill 1 quart microwave safe container with water. Put in tea bags. Microwave for 10 minutes and 24 seconds. Pour sugar in gallon container. Pour in tea. Stir. Taste. Add more sugar if needed. Add water to make one gallon of tea. Stir. Taste again.

name: FUDGE
ingredients:
1 tall  can cream
2  sticks margarine
5  c. sugar
2  pkg. chocolate chips
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix cream, margarine and sugar on low heat and bring to a boil.  Stir all the time.  Boil for seven minutes.  Add chocolate chips and vanilla.  Stir until chips are melted.  Pour onto a wax paper-lined pan and cool.  Cut to desired size.

name: STRAWBERRY PIZZA
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. flour
1/4  c. powdered sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
1  can condensed milk
1/3  c. lemon juice
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  pt. strawberries
preparation: Crust:	Melt  margarine;  pour	into flour and powdered sugar. Spread on	buttered  pizza pan and bake for 10 minutes at 350° or until golden brown.

name: MOM'S PEACH PIE
ingredients:
1  egg white
1  unbaked pastry shell (9-inch)
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/3  c. sugar
1/4  c. chilled butter or margarine, cut into 6 pieces
6  c. sliced peeled fresh peaches
preparation: Beat egg white until foamy; brush over the bottom and sides of the pastry.  In a small bowl, combine flour and sugars; cut in butter until mixture resembles fine crumbs.  Sprinkle two-thirds into the bottom of the pastry; top with peaches.  Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture.  Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until filling is bubbly and peaches are tender.  Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

name: JACK LONDON'S ONION ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton onion soup mix
1/3  c. olive or vegetable oil
2  lb. all-purpose potatoes, cut into large chunks
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  In large plastic bag or bowl combine all ingredients.  Close bag and shake or toss in bowl until potatoes are evenly coated.  Remove potatoes and place on shallow baking or roasting pan; discard remaining mixture.  Bake, stirring occasionally, for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown.  Garnish, if desired, with chopped fresh parsley. Makes 8 servings.

name: PARTY NIBBLES(Microwave)
ingredients:
2  c. pretzels
1 1/2  c. peanuts
2  c. rice squares
2  c. wheat squares
2  c. oat circles
7  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. onion powder
1/2  tsp. celery powder
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix cereal and nuts in a large bowl.  Melt butter on High for 1 1/2 minutes.  Stir in seasoning.  Drizzle over cereal.  Mix thoroughly.  Cook on High for 5 to 6 minutes or until evenly toasted.  Cool and store in airtight container.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PIE(Makes Its Own Crust)
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/4  c. oleo
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1  c. coconut (flaked)
2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix in a blender.  Pour into buttered 9-inch Pyrex pie plate. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.

name: SALMON BALL
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can salmon
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  tsp. grated onion
2  tsp. horseradish
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of Worcestershire
1/4  tsp. liquid smoke
3  Tbsp. fresh parsley, chopped
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Parsley and nuts are optional.

name: SPICY BEEF AND VEGETABLE STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1/2  c. low sodium beef broth
1  Tbsp. reduced sodium soy sauce
2  tsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. Dijon mustard
6  broccoli spears, cut up
2  tsp. peanut oil
1  c. cauliflower florets
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, chopped
8  oz. lean roast beef, cooked and cut into strips
1  oz. unsalted peanuts, chopped
1/4  tsp. red pepper flakes
1/4  tsp. ground black pepper
preparation: In a small bowl, combine the beef broth, soy sauce, cornstarch and mustard.  Stir until the cornstarch dissolves.  Set aside.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (2 lb.) bag hash browns (O'Brien), thawed
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
2  c. cheese, grated
preparation: Mix thawed hash browns with other ingredients. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: RASPBERRY LIME CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  whole chicken breasts
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  cloves garlic, crushed or minced
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1 1/2  Tbsp. raspberry vinegar
juice of 2 limes (3 to 4 Tbsp.)
preparation: Halve the breasts; bone and skin.  Flatten with hand.  Melt butter in heavy pan over low heat.  Add chicken; cover tightly. Cook slowly until it is no longer pink inside (approximately 5 to 7 minutes), turning once.  Do not brown.  Remove chicken and reserve.

name: BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c Bisquick
1  c cheddar cheese, grated
1  tsp garlic salt
3/4  c milk
preparation: Mix together and drop by tablespoonful on greased pan.  Bake at 450° until brown.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
3  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. dates or raisins, cut up
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. oatmeal (rolled or quick)
preparation: Cream shortening with sugar.  Add eggs, milk and vanilla; mix well.  Sift dry ingredients and stir into creamed mixture.  Blend last items in and chill if desired.  Drop or form into balls size of walnut.  Place on greased baking sheets.  Flatten to 1/4 inch thick.  Bake about 10 to 12 minutes in 375° oven.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: WILTED LETTUCE WITH CHICKEN
ingredients:
3  c. torn romaine
3  c. torn red leaf lettuce
1  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
1/4  c. green onion, sliced
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1  whole large chicken breast, skinned, boned and cut into bite size julienne strips
1  tsp. mustard seed
3  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. white wine vinegar
2  small apples, cut into very thin wedges
3  hard-cooked eggs, cut into wedges
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, combine romaine, red leaf lettuce, mushrooms and onion.  Toss lightly to mix.  Set aside.  In a 12-inch skillet, heat one tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat. Add chicken and mustard seed.  Cook and stir for 2 to 3 minutes or until chicken is tender.  Reduce heat to medium.  Stir in 3 tablespoons of olive oil and the vinegar.  Add apples and cook for 30 seconds.  Remove skillet from heat and immediately add lettuce mixture.  Carefully toss for about one minute or until lettuce begins to wilt.  Spoon lettuce mixture into 4 salad plates. Garnish with egg wedges.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BLUEBERRY BUTTERMILK BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. shortening
1  egg, beaten
3/4  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. fresh or frozen blueberries
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a medium bowl; cut in shortening with a pastry blender until mixture resembles cornmeal. Combine egg and buttermilk, add to flour mixture, stirring just until dry ingredients ar moistened.  Stir in blueberries.  Turn dough out onto heavily floured surface and knead 4 or 5 times. Roll dough to 1/2-inch thickness; cut with a 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter.  Place on lightly greased baking sheet.  Bake at 400° for 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Brush warm biscuits with glaze. Yields 15 biscuits.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
6  medium-sized potatoes, diced
2  small carrots, diced small
1  stick margarine
1  can undiluted Pet milk
1  small onion, diced
2  stalks celery, diced small
3  or 4 chicken bouillon cubes
preparation: Cook potatoes, onion, carrots and celery with water.  Add chicken bouillon cubes.  Cook slowly until potatoes are tender, but not mushy.  Add margarine, salt and pepper.  Heat Pet milk before adding to other ingredients.  Cool 5 to 10 minutes more.

name: GLORIFIED CABBAGE
ingredients:
whole cabbage
1  can mushroom soup
3/4  stick margarine
1/2  lb. shredded Cheddar cheese
4  slices bread, cubed
1  small chopped onion
preparation: Shred cabbage head.  Cook in water until tender; drain.  Melt butter and add onion.  Cook until soft.  Add cheese, soup and bread cubes and mix well.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Bake at 350°, uncovered.

name: HAM PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. ham, chopped
1  can cream of potato soup
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, thawed
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. milk
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1  can biscuits (not Grands), cut into quarters
preparation: Mix ingredients (except biscuits) and bake for 15 minutes at 350°. Add biscuits on top and bake until biscuits are brown (about 12 minutes).

name: BEAUTY QUEEN SHORTCUT SHORTCAKE
ingredients:
1-  premade Angel Food cake (available at any supermarket)
1- 8  oz. container Cool whip, thawed
2  c. strawberries, cut up and sugared to taste
1  c. blueberries, washed and drained
preparation: Open the angel food cake and place on cake plate. Cover cake with Cool Whip. Fill the hole in the center of the cake with berries. Add any decorative touches on top of cake with the berries you choose. Any left over berries should be placed next to the finished cake for those who might like extra berries with their serving.

name: CHEESE CAKE - NO BAKE
ingredients:
3  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 1/4  sticks oleo, melted
2  Tbsp. powdered sugar
3  oz. lemon Jell-O
1  c. hot water
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  c. granulated sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  can Carnation evaporated milk
preparation: Mix cracker crumbs, oleo and powdered sugar.  Press in 9 x 13-inch pan (up sides).  Save some for top.  Dissolve and cool over cold water, Jell-O and hot water.  Cream the cheese, sugar and vanilla; cream together with fork.  Chill evaporated milk, beaters and bowl.  Whip until stiff (approximately 5 to 7 minutes).  Add Jell-O , then cream cheese; blend.  Pour into crust.  Top with reserved crumb mixture.  Store in refrigerator 12 hours or more.

name: RIBBON TURKEY LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. pkg. ground turkey
1/2  c. uncooked Minute rice
1  small onion, chopped
1  egg
1  Tbsp. beef bouillon
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
3 (1 oz. each)  slices Swiss cheese (4 x 7 1/2 inches)
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach or broccoli, thawed and well drained
preparation: Mix turkey, rice, onion, egg, bouillon and garlic powder. Spoon 1/2 the mixture into a lightly greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Top with 1 slice of cheese, vegetable, another slice of cheese and remaining turkey mixture.

name: ORANGE JULIUS DRINK
ingredients:
6  oz. can frozen orange juice
1  c. water
1  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
10  to 12 ice cubes
preparation: Blend all ingredients in blender until drink is frosty.

name: APPLE OR BERRY PIE FILLING
ingredients:
5 large apples, sliced thin or 4 to 5  c. berries
2/3  can frozen apple juice concentrate, thawed
3 rounded  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white sugar
1/2  tsp. cardamon
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
1  Tbsp. butter
1  pie crust
preparation: Cook cornstarch and apple juice over medium heat, stirring with wire whip until thickened.  Add sugars and butter; stir.  Add spices.  Add sliced apples.  Pour into pie crust.  Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 375° the first 15 minutes, then at 350° for the rest of the baking time.

name: PISTACHIO SALAD
ingredients:
1  box instant pistachio pudding
1  can crushed pineapple
1  carton Cool Whip
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  carton cottage cheese
pecan pieces to taste
preparation: Mix all together.  Let stand overnight.

name: GERMAN POTATO PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  c. potatoes, grated in food processor
1  egg plus 1 egg white, beaten
2  Tbsp. whole wheat pastry flour
1/8  tsp. baking powder
salt and pepper, if desired
onion juice, chopped onion or onion flakes (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls and saute until browned.  Often served with warm applesauce.

name: HEAVENLY SALAD
ingredients:
3  oz. orange jello
3  oz. lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
8  oz. Cool Whip
1  c. mayonnaise
pecans
20  oz. can crushed pineapple
3  cans mandarin oranges (save 2 c. liquid)
1  pkg. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Mix jellos and boiling water; let jell in refrigerator.  Mix jello, fruit and 1 package miniature marshmallows with juice.  Pour in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix 8 ounces Cool Whip and 1 cup mayonnaise. Spread over jello.  Garnish with pecan pieces or grated sharp cheese.  Chill several hours.

name: SPINACH DIP(Serves 10)
ingredients:
1  pt. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. Knorr dry leek soup mix (about 1/2 c.)
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, well drained
1/4  c. chopped parsley
1/2  c. chopped green onions
1  tsp. dry dill
1  tsp. dry Italian salad dressing mix
preparation: Combine all ingredients in food processor until well blended. Serve with assorted raw vegetables.

name: FRIED OKRA
ingredients:
1  lb. small to medium pods okra
salt and pepper
bacon fat or shortening
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. cornmeal
preparation: Wash okra.  Remove ends of pods.  Cut okra into 1/4-inch slices.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Mix meal and flour.   Roll okra in mixture and fry in hot fat until golden brown.

name: SWISS BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
2  tsp. instant chicken bouillon
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
2  c. milk
10  oz. frozen, cut broccoli
1/8  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: In saucepan, heat chicken bouillon in 1 1/2 cups of water until dissolved.  Add broccoli (1 head chopped, fresh broccoli can be used); cover and cook 8 to 10 minutes or until tender.  Add milk, cheese, nutmeg and a dash of pepper.  Cook and stir until cheese melts.  Combine flour and 1/2 cup of cold water; stir into broccoli mixture.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: HOT ROLLS
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. lard
1  Tbsp. salt
1  egg
2  lb. flour
1  c. hot water
1  c. lukewarm water
1  pkg. yeast or 1 Tbsp. loose yeast
preparation: Cream lard, sugar, salt and beat egg slightly.  Add to flour and hot water.  Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water.  Use enough flour to make a soft dough, about 2 pounds or 1 1/2 quarts.  Makes 2 dozen rolls.

name: CHICKEN RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  c. uncooked rice
1  c. white wine or water
chicken breasts or thighs
preparation: Mix soups and wine in casserole.  Add rice and chicken parts. Cover and bake 1 hour or until rice is cooked.  Remove lid and bake a little longer at 350°.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
5  eggs, beaten slightly
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  Tbsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. butter
5  c. scalded milk
4  c. cubed bread
1  c. raisins
preparation: Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Set pan in larger pan that has a little water in it.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until set.

name: CHAMPAGNE PUNCH
ingredients:
2  bottles ginger ale
1 (46 oz.)  can Hawaiian Punch
1  bottle pink champagne
1  qt. raspberry sherbet
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a large punch bowl (6 to 8-quart). Spoon in sherbet balls.  Stir and enjoy!  Should be made a half to 1 hour before company arrives.  Improves upon standing.  This punch was served at the Art Auction.

name: PEA AND CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can peas, drained
1/4  lb. American cheese
3  Tbsp. chopped sweet pickles
1/4  c. chopped celery
3  boiled eggs
1  small onion, chopped
2/3  c. salad dressing
preparation: Chill peas in their liquid and then drain.  Dice cheese small and combine with other ingredients.   Toss gently.  Let stand in refrigerator overnight.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1 1/2  c. water
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding and pie filling mix
2  c. Cool Whip
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
vanilla wafers
bananas
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk and water.  Add pudding mix, Cool Whip, sugar and vanilla.  Beat until well blended.  Layer bananas and vanilla wafers in a bowl.  Top with about 1/3 of the pudding mix.  Repeat layers twice and end with pudding mix on top.

name: SHRIMP FRA DIAVOLO
ingredients:
20  to 30 shrimp, sautéed until tender
1/3  c. butter
1/3  c. olive oil
1/4  c. chopped parsley
2  garlic cloves, crusted
4  c. marinara sauce
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Simmer all ingredients for 15 minutes.  Serve over hot pasta.

name: QUICK AND EASY CHILI
ingredients:
2  cans pinto beans
2  cans tomatoes or 1 can tomatoes with 1 can tomato sauce
1  lb. hamburger
1  onion
1  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Brown hamburger and medium onion in bottom of large pan.  Add 1 teaspoon chili powder, salt and pepper to taste.  Add beans and tomatoes; stew on low boil for 30 minutes.  Add more chili flavor or dash of garlic salt if desired.

name: DILLON'S RAISIN BREAD
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. bread flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. dry milk
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. raisins
1/2  Tbsp. cinnamon
7/8  c. water
1  tsp. dry yeast
preparation: Mix and knead well, then bake until done.

name: CALIFORNIA BAKE
ingredients:
broccoli or cauliflower
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. oleo
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. paprika
1  c. Swiss cheese, shredded
preparation: Cook broccoli or cauliflower.  Stir together constantly and bring to a boil, for 1 minute, milk, oleo, salt, pepper and cornstarch.  Add paprika and Swiss cheese.

name: JUNE BUGS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/8  tsp. red pepper
dash of paprika
25  pitted dates (6 oz.)
preparation: Combine butter and cheese; beat until smooth.  Combine next 3 ingredients.  Add to cheese mixture; mix well.  Cut dates in half crosswise; wrap each half with dough.  Place on ungreased baking sheets; bake at 400° for 15 to 18 minutes.  Cool on wire racks. Yield: 50 appetizers.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  pkg. frozen broccoli, chopped
2  pkg. Kraft garlic cheese roll
2  cans mushroom soup
1  can mushrooms
1  large onion, chopped
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. chopped almonds
preparation: Thaw  and  drain  vegetables.  Cook  onions  in butter. Combine  remaining	ingredients.  Cook until cheese is melted. Garnish  with  almonds  and  bake  approximately 30 minutes at 325°.  Serves 10 to 12.  Time of preparation: 30 minutes.

name: MIRACLE BISCUITS
ingredients:
6  c. flour
1  c. Miracle Whip
3 to 4  Tbsp. baking powder
enough water or milk to make a pliable dough
preparation: Blend baking powder into flour.  Make a well in middle of dry ingredients and dump in Miracle Whip.  Stir in liquid until soft dough stage is reached.  Knead on floured surface for 5 minutes. Flatten dough to 1-inch thickness.  Cut into rounds and let stand 10 minutes before baking in 350° oven until golden brown.

name: CARAMEL ICING
ingredients:
1/3  c. sweet milk
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
2 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Melt butter.  Add brown sugar; cook 2 minutes.  Add milk. Bring to a full boil.   Remove from heat.  Cool.  Beat in confectioners sugar.  Spread on cooled cake.

name: STEAK AND POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
4  or 5 cube steaks
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1  can mushrooms
4  c. sliced potatoes
1  c. sliced onions
1/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. buttermilk
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: In large skillet, melt butter; saute onions until tender. Remove from skillet.  Brown meat and remove.  To pan drippings, add flour, salt, pepper and dry mustard.  Remove from heat. Gradually stir in milk; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thick.  Cook an additional 2 minutes.  Stir in mushrooms and parsley.  In 2-quart shallow casserole, layer potatoes, onions and steak.  Pour sauce over all.  Cover with foil; bake in a 350° preheated oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.  Serves 4 to 5.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
2  (9-inch) baked pie shells
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
4  Tbsp. strawberry jello (dry)
2 1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  pt. cleaned strawberries
preparation: Arrange strawberries with points up in pie shells.  Cook remaining ingredients, stirring constantly until clear and bubbly. Pour evenly over berries.  Chill and serve with fresh whipped cream.  You can use other fresh berries and use complimentary flavor of dry jello.  Works very well with blueberries.

name: CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. buttermilk
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/8  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  pkg. fast rising dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
3  c. flour
1  large egg
softened butter
2/3  c. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. raisins
preparation: Heat  buttermilk  to  lukewarm.  Stir  in  cooking oil, sugar, soda and  salt.  Dissolve  yeast in warm water.  Add to buttermilk mixture, with unbeaten egg, stirring to blend.  Mix in flour all at	once.  Turn  out  on floured board and knead lightly  for several minutes to form a smooth ball.  Cover and let stand 5 or 10 minutes to tighten dough.

name: WHEAT GERM CORN BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. yellow corn meal
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/4  c. toasted wheat germ
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. oil
2  eggs, slightly beaten
preparation: About 2 hours before serving or early in the day:  Preheat oven to 375°.  Grease well a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  In a large bowl, with a fork, beat buttermilk, oil and eggs.  In another bowl, combine dry ingredients.  Stir egg mixture into flour mixture, just until flour is moistened.  (Batter will be lumpy, not smooth.)  Quickly pour into loaf pan, spreading evenly.  Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool bread in pan on wire rack 10 minutes.  Remove from pan.  Serve warm or cool bread completely on wire rack to serve later.  Makes 1 loaf.

name: ICEBOX COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. brown sugar
1  c. nuts
3 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
preparation: Sift soda and salt with flour.  Mix firm butter and flour together until it looks like crumbs.  Add brown sugar, then nuts. Beat eggs together until light; mix into the dough which will be rather firm.  Knead until smooth, then make into the size roll desired.  Wrap in waxed paper; place in refrigerator overnight or until thoroughly chilled.  Slice cookies very thin; place on greased baking sheet and bake at 350° until light brown, approximately 12 minutes.  This dough will keep for several days. Makes 5 to 6 dozen cookies.  Keep in tightly covered container.

name: 6 WEEK MUFFINS
ingredients:
15  oz. Raisin Bran flakes
1  c. melted shortening
3  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  qt. buttermilk
5  c. flour
5  tsp. soda
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Mix eggs, shortening and buttermilk. Mix all together.  Fill muffin pan 2/3 full.   Bake 15 minutes at 375°.  Store remaining batter in refrigerator.  Will keep several weeks.

name: PIZZA DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. sour cream
8  oz. cream cheese
2  tsp. oregano
1/2  c. pizza sauce
1/2  c. pepperoni
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Mix together sour cream, cream cheese and oregano.  Spread mixture in bottom of 9-inch pie pan.  Layer pizza sauce, pepperoni, onion and green pepper on top of cheese mixture.   Bake 10 minutes at 350°.  Then top with Mozzarella cheese.   Bake until bubbly.  Serve with crackers of your choice.

name: PERSIMMON AND DATE PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. whole milk
1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
1  c. persimmon, skinned and mashed to a pulp
1  c. walnuts, coarsely chopped
1  c. dates, chopped fine
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  tsp. melted butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Sift together flour, sugar, baking soda, baking powder and salt.  Add the remaining ingredients.  Mix well.

name: BACON 'N EGGS PANCAKE ROLL-UP
ingredients:
2  (8 or 9-inch) pancakes
16  slices bacon
6  eggs, scrambled
1/2  c. cooked, chopped onion
1/2  c. cooked, chopped green pepper
preparation: Prepare pancakes using pancake mix.  Cut 8 slices bacon into pieces 1  inch  long.  Pan-fry  until  lightly  browned. Drain. Cook 8 additional bacon slices; drain and keep warm.

name: BACON AND SHELL-RONI
ingredients:
1  lb. bacon, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
3 (15 oz.)  cans Hunt's tomato sauce
1 (1 lb.)  box large pasta shells
garlic salt
preparation: Fry bacon until crisp; pour off part of fat.  Add onion and tomato sauce.  Simmer until thickened, adding garlic salt to taste.  Sauce should taste a little salty.  Cook shells as per instructions on box; add sauce to shells.  Serve with garlic bread and a salad.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH SPECTACULARS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. soft margarine
8  oz. softened cream cheese
2  small instant butterscotch pudding
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. pecans, chopped
9  oz. Cool Whip
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix flour,  pecans  and  soft margarine.  Pat into 12 x 8-inch pan.  Bake 15 minutes at 375°.

name: Toffee Butter Crunch
ingredients:
1/2  c. coarsely chopped pecans
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. light corn syrup
1/2  c. finely chopped pecans or almonds
1  c. butter
3  Tbsp. water
3/4  c. semi-sweet or milk chocolate pieces
preparation: Sprinkle the 1/2 cup coarsely chopped nuts on the bottom of a buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Butter the sides of a heavy 2-quart saucepan.  In it, melt the 1 cup butter; add sugar, water and corn syrup.  Cook over medium heat to 290° (soft crack stage), stirring frequently.  Watch carefully after 280°, remove from heat.

name: LEMON SEASONED CHICKEN BREAST
ingredients:
1  tbsp. water
1/2  tsp. bouquet sauce
1  tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. lemon pepper
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
2  whole bone-in-chicken breast, halved, skin removed
1 to 2  tsp. parsley flakes (optional)
preparation: In a small dish; combine all ingredients except chicken and parsley. Arrange chicken breast bone-side up on a microwave roasting rack, meatiest portions to outside of dish. Brush with half of seasoned mixture. Microwave  on high 5 minutes. Turn pieces over and brush with remaining mixture. Microwave 10 -15 minutes, or until meat near bone is no longer pink, rotating once during cooking. If desired, sprinkle with parsley before serving.

name: 7-UP CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Lemon Supreme Cake mix
1  box pineapple instant Jell-O pudding mix
4  eggs
3/4  c. Wesson oil
10  oz. bottle of 7-Up
preparation: Empty cake mix and pudding mix in a bowl, add wesson oil and eggs. Beat together, add 7-Up. Pour into a large pan and bake as a sheet cake at 325° for 45 minutes. Leave in pan.

name: ITALIAN TRASH
ingredients:
6  cups bite size rice cereal squares
4  cups Cheerios
6  cups freshly popped popcorn
1  can peanuts
4  cups corn chips
2  cans Chinese noodles
1  bottle Italian dressing
preparation: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Combine all dry ingredients in a very large bowl. Drizzle Italian dressing over top and toss to mix well. Spread in 2 shallow pans. Bake, stirring once, for 30 minutes. Cool completely and then store in airtight containers.

name: COCA-COLA CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  sticks margarine
1  c. Coca-Cola
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
3  Tbsp. cocoa (optional)
preparation: Combine flour and sugar in bowl.  Heat butter, cocoa (optional) and Coca-Cola to boiling and pour over flour and sugar mixture, mixing well.  Add buttermilk, eggs, soda, vanilla and marshmallows.  Mix well.  This will be a thin batter with marshmallows floating.  Bake in pan 1-inch deep at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Ice while hot.

name: STRAWBERRY FLUFF
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin
1  lb. cottage cheese (small curd)
chopped walnuts
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, well drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. frozen whipped topping, thawed
preparation: Mix dry gelatin, cottage cheese, pineapple and thawed frozen whipped topping.  Refrigerate.

name: KRISPIE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  cut up fryer
1  can evaporated milk
Rice Krispie crumbs
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
salt and pepper
paprika
preparation: Beat milk and mayonnaise.  Season chicken with seasonings. Dip fryer in milk mixture, then in crumbs.  Place in pan.  Bake at 350° for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until done.

name: CRAB OR SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
16  oz. light cream cheese
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  can crab or shrimp
3  Tbsp. onion soup mix
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and spread in middle of plate. Cover with cocktail sauce.   Serve with onion crackers.

name: PEANUT BUTTERED PORK LOIN
ingredients:
2  boneless pork loins (5 to 6 lb. total)
Salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. orange juice
1/4  c. creamy peanut butter
preparation: Place pork loins in shallow roasting pan; season with salt and pepper.  Insert meat thermometer.  Bake at 350° for about 1 1/2 hours or until thermometer reads 170°.  Meanwhile, combine orange juice and peanut butter.  When thermometer reads 170° brush sauce on roast and continue baking and basting 15 to 20 minutes more.  Serves 15.

name: EASY FRUITCAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped dates
1/2  c. chopped candied cherries
1/2  c. chopped candied pineapple
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 (11 oz.)  box pie crust mix
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/8  tsp. ground cloves
1/8  tsp. ground nutmeg
2  eggs
preparation: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In medium bowl, combine dates, cherries, pineapple, raisins, and pecans.  Mix well. In large bowl, combine the pie crust mix, baking soda, sugar and spices. Stir to mix. Add the eggs and beat well. Stir in the fruit mixture. Mix well. Drop from a teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet, spacing the cookies about 2 inches apart. Bake for about 10 minutes, until light brown. Remove from the cookie sheet and place on a rack to cool completely before storing. Be careful as you remove the cookies from the cookie sheet because they are fragile while hot. They become more crispy as they cool. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

name: SMOKY SALMON SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  can salmon
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
crackers or Melba rounds
3  drops liquid smoke flavoring
3  Tbsp. finely diced green onion
preparation: Drain salmon, reserving 2 teaspoons salmon liquid; flake. Combine cream cheese, liquid smoke flavoring and salmon liquid; blend thoroughly.  Stir in green onion, then fold in salmon. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight to blend flavors.  Serve as a spread for crackers or Melba toast rounds.  Makes 1 1/2 cups spread.

name: RITZ CRACKER PIE
ingredients:
20  Ritz crackers, rolled fine
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3  egg whites
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Beat egg whites until frothy.  Start adding sugar gradually and beat until mixture stands in a soft peak.  Fold in vanilla, crackers, baking powder and nuts.  Spread evenly in well-greased pie plate and bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: EASY MINI PIZZAS
ingredients:
1 (10 count)  can refrigerator biscuits
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
3  oz. sliced pepperoni
1 to 2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Flatten biscuits, one at a time, between palms of hands.  Place on baking sheet. Spread tomato sauce over biscuits.  Arrange pepperoni slices on top. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.  Yields 10 servings.

name: CINNAMON ORNAMENTS
ingredients:
5  oz. ground cinnamon
10  Tbsp. applesauce, warmed
acrylic paint (optional)
ribbon
preparation: Mix cinnamon and warmed applesauce until mixture forms a ball, adding more cinnamon, if necessary.  Knead dough on wooden cutting board dusted with cinnamon.  Roll out dough to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with cookie cutters.  Using a drinking straw or coffee stirrer, cut hole in top of each ornament for hanging.  Place on wire screen or cooling racks to air dry (approximately 6 days). To speed drying, place in 200° oven for 3 hours.  Put ribbon in hole.

name: WILD RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box wild rice
salt and pepper to taste
1 (5 oz.)  jar sliced mushrooms
1  (2 oz.) chopped pimentos
1/2  c. chopped parsley
2  Tbsp. butter
3/4  c. diced celery
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook rice, salt and pepper.  Add mushrooms, pimentos and parsley.  Mix. Melt butter.  Add celery and saute gently.  Add mushroom soup and onion salt.  Pour over rice mixture.  Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

name: VEGETABLE CHOWDER(Reduced Fat/Calorie)
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. polyunsaturated margarine
4  c. low sodium chicken broth
2  medium carrots, peeled and sliced
1  c. green beans
2  medium potatoes, peeled and diced
1  Tbsp. fresh parsley
1  tsp. diced tarragon leaves
1/4  tsp. black pepper
40  fat free saltine crackers
preparation: In large pan over medium heat, cook onion in margarine until tender.  Add chicken broth, carrots, potatoes, green beans, parsley, tarragon and pepper.  Heat to a boil, reduce heat.  Simmer 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.  Makes 8 servings (1 cup with 5 crackers).  Calories per serving 158; sodium per serving 226 mg; fat per serving 3 gm.

name: SOUPER MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's cream of mushroom soup
1  pouch Campbell's onion soup and recipe mix
2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Mix thoroughly 1/2 cup mushroom soup, onion soup mix, beef, bread crumbs and egg.  Bake in a 2-quart baking dish.  Shape into loaf.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: EASY PRUNE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
3  eggs
2  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1  jar baby food prunes
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix sugar and oil. Add eggs. Sift flour and spices together. Add to sugar mixture.   Add prunes.  Mix well.  Drop in nuts. Mix.  Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

name: PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  head lettuce
1  can peas, drained or 1/2 (1 lb.) pkg. frozen peas
3  or 4 boiled eggs, chopped
1  c. diced cheese
2  or 3 dill pickles, diced or sliced green olives
mayonnaise
preparation: Chop lettuce and add peas, eggs, cheese and pickles or stuffed green olives.  Add enough mayonnaise to hold together.  Mix and serve at once.

name: MOROCCAN SNAPPER IN PARCHMENT(Serves 2)
ingredients:
1  medium red pepper
1  medium yellow pepper
1  to 2 pieces green onion
1  tsp. extra virgin olive oil
1  medium garlic clove, minced
2  tsp. fresh parsley, minced
1/8  tsp. cumin seed, ground
1/8  tsp. coriander, ground
1/8  tsp. red pepper
1  tsp. lemon peel, grated
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  red snapper fillets (4 oz. each)
1  medium lemon
preparation: Stem and seed peppers; cut into very thin strips.  Slice green onion in diagonal slices.  Slice lemon into 6 slices.

name: AU GRATIN POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash browns (small cubes), thaw 30 minutes
1  chopped onion
1  can celery or chicken soup
16  oz. sour cream
1  stick oleo
8  oz. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix together.  Pam casserole (10 x 14-inch pan).  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: FRUIT DELIGHT PIE
ingredients:
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1/4  c. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  large container frozen whipped topping, thawed
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
16  oz. can sliced peaches, drained
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix milk, sugar and lemon juice together until thickened.  Add pineapple, peaches and pecans.  Fold in whipped topping.  Mix well and pour into 2 deep graham cracker crusts.  Refrigerate.

name: MICROWAVE PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white Karo
1  c. raw peanuts
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. butter
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Cook sugar and Karo 4 minutes on High; stir.  Add peanuts, cook 4 minutes on High.  Add vanilla and butter, cook 1 1/2 minutes on High.  Stir in soda.  Pour at once on buttered pan and spread.  Cool and break in pieces.

name: CHESS CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. cake mix (any flavor)
3  eggs
1  stick margarine
8  oz. cream cheese
1  box 10x sugar
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
preparation: Mix cake mix, butter and 1 egg together.  Press into a 9 x 12-inch pan that has been sprayed with Pam.

name: FANTASTIC BUTTER TOFFEE
ingredients:
2  c. whole unblanched almonds, divided
11  oz. milk chocolate, divided
2  sticks sweet butter
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Spread almonds in pan; toast in a 350° oven for about 10 minutes.  Shake occasionally.  Cool nuts.  Grind milk chocolate fine in a food processor; do not over process.  Set aside.  Chop nuts coarse in food processor.  Sprinkle 1 cup nuts over bottom of greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch cookie sheet.  Sprinkle 1 cup ground chocolate over nuts.  Set aside.

name: CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can pork and beans
1 (16 oz.)  can lima beans
1 (16 oz.)  can pinto beans
3/4  c. catsup
1/2  c. molasses
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  lb. bacon
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans
1 (16 oz.)  can butter beans
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  medium onion, diced
1  lb. hamburg
preparation: Brown meat and onion; drain.  Combine all ingredients.  Pour into a casserole. Bake at 350°, or put in crock-pot.  Otherwise, bake for 2 hours.

name: QUICK FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
1  qt. sweetened and cooked fruit (blackberries)
1  stick oleo
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix together flour, sugar, baking powder, milk and melted oleo.  Spread in bottom of pan, then pour fruit over the top (the fruit needs to be cooked long enough to melt sugar and make syrup).  I use blackberries or rhubarb or peaches; use sugar to sweeten as needed.  Bake at 350° until brown on top.

name: LATTICE TOP CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of potato soup
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
2  c. cubed, cooked chicken
1  (16 oz.) bag frozen broccoli, carrots and cauliflower combination, thawed and drained
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (2.8 oz.)  can French fried onions
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. refrigerator crescent rolls
preparation: Combine soup, salt, milk, chicken, vegetables, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can French fried onions.  Place in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish.  Bake, covered, at 375° for 20 minutes.  Unwrap crescent rolls; separate into two rectangles.  Press together perforated cuts and cut into 3 strips.  Place strips on casserole to form lattice top.  Bake, uncovered, 15 minutes longer.  Top with remaining cheese and onions; bake, uncovered, 3 to 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: WITCHES BREW
ingredients:
2  qt. apple juice
1  Tbsp. whole cloves
2  cinnamon sticks
1  c. orange juice
1/2  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Soften cream cheese:  Remove from foil wrapper and place on plate.  Heat 8 ounces for 15 seconds on full power.  Add 10 seconds at a time until softened as desired.

name: CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
2 regular-size  cans tomatoes
1  Tbsp. cumin
1 1/2  tsp. black pepper
2  lb. American cheese, grated or cubed
2  jalapeno peppers, seeded
1  Tbsp. Accent
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  c. hot water
preparation: Heat all ingredients except cheese to boiling.  Lower heat and add cheese.  Stir until smooth.  Add 1 cup hot water.  Cool and use blender to make smooth.  Keep refrigerated.  Instead of heating everything up, I sometimes half everything and use the blender.   You still need to add the cup of water at the end or it will be too thick.  This is as close to Pancho's old cheese dip as you will ever taste.

name: BEET MOLD
ingredients:
1 small  can beets with liquid, julienned
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1  c. 7-Up
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. horseradish
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Drain beets, reserving beets.  Mix juice with 7-Up to produce 1 1/2 cups liquid.  Bring vinegar, liquid, Jell-O, salt and sugar to a near boil.  When cool, add horseradish and beets.  Pour into 8 x 8-inch pan or approximate size pan.  Refrigerate until firm.

name: WALNUT OR PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  c. Karo light or dark corn syrup
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
1  (9-inch) unbaked pastry pie shell
1 1/2  c. large walnut pieces
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Combine eggs, flour, corn syrup, butter and vanilla; blend well.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Arrange walnuts on top.  Bake in oven at 400° for 15 minutes.  Reduce oven temperature to 350°.  Bake an additional 35 to 45 minutes or until center appears set.  Cool completely.

name: BLUEBERRY OATMEAL MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. rolled oats
1/2  c. lightly packed brown sugar
1  egg
1  c. milk
1/4  c. melted margarine
3/4  c. fresh or frozen blueberries
preparation: Stir dry ingredients together.  Add sugar and rolled oats. Beat together in a large bowl egg, milk and melted margarine.  Add the dry ingredients and stir just until moistened.  Fold in blueberries.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until brown.

name: APPLE COFFEECAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. stick margarine, softened
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. baking powder
2 1/2  c. unbleached flour
1  c. plain yogurt
3  apples, peeled and sliced
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. sugar
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: In a large bowl, cream together the stick of margarine and the cup of sugar until light and fluffy.  Add the eggs, one at a time, and beat well after each.  Add the vanilla.

name: MERRY CRANBERRY MARGARITAS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. cranberry juice cocktail
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. fresh or frozen cranberries, rinsed
3/4  c. lime juice
3/4  c. tequila
1/2  c. orange flavored liqueur
3  c. coarsely crushed ice
preparation: Pour 1/4 cup cranberry juice into a shallow bowl.  Pour 3 tablespoons sugar onto a flat plate.  Dip the rims of 4 to 6 widemouthed glasses (6 to 8 ounce size, suitable for Margaritas) into juice, then into sugar.  Set the glasses aside.

name: EGG NOG PUNCH
ingredients:
8  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. rum
1  tsp. brandy extract
2  tsp. vanilla
2  qt. milk
1  c. whipping cream
nutmeg
preparation: Beat eggs until frothy.  Add sugar gradually.  Add rum, brandy and vanilla extract.  Add milk.  Fold whipped cream in last. Sprinkle with nutmeg for dressing.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
12  oz. herb seasons
3  c. sliced or diced squash
1  can cream soup
1  c. sour cream
1  large onion
3  large carrots
black pepper
preparation: Melt butter; toss with dressing.  Mix 1/2 dressing with squash, cream soup and sour cream.

name: CORDON BLEU
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
4  thin ham slices
2  oz. Swiss cheese
flour
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
2  c. bread or cracker crumbs
preparation: Skin and bone chicken breasts.  Flatten with heel of hand. Wrap a slice of ham around a piece of cheese about 2 x 1/4-inch. Then wrap chicken around ham and cheese.  This may be secured with a toothpick.  Dip chicken in flour, then in egg wash (egg in milk) and then in crumbs.  Brown in hot oil for 4 minutes per side.  To finish in microwave, place meat on a platter set in oven on roast or medium setting for 1 1/2 minutes.

name: GEORGIA PEACH PIE
ingredients:
Pastry for 9-inch double-crust pie
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
Pinch of salt
6  to 8 large peaches, peeled and sliced thin (about 5 cups)
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. butter, cut into small pieces
preparation: Prepare your favorite pastry recipe.  Preheat oven to 425°. Shape pastry into balls, one slightly larger than the other; flatten into disks.  On lightly floured surface, roll larger disk into 11-inch circle.  Fit loosely into 9-inch pie plate.

name: SAMOVAR INSTANT TEA
ingredients:
1 medium  jar Tang
2 1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1 1/4  tsp. ground cloves
1  pkg. lemonade mix
3  c. sugar
1/2  ??? plain instant tea
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well.  To serve, mix 1 heaping teaspoonful to 1 cup hot water to taste.

name: MISSISSIPPI MUD CAKE
ingredients:
2  cups sugar
1  cup shortening
4  eggs
1  1/2 cups flour
1/3  cup cocoa
1/4  teaspoon vanilla
1  cup chopped pecans or walnuts
1 large  package marshmallows
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening.  Beat in eggs by hand.  Sift flour, cocoa and salt together.  Add to creamed mixture.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Pour into a greased and floured oblong cake pan.  Bake for 25 minutes in a 300° oven.  Sprinkle cake with rows of marshmallows.  Increase oven to 350° and bake for 10 minutes longer, cool cake completely.

name: PORK ROAST HAWAIIAN STYLE
ingredients:
1  (3 to 4 lb.) pork roast
1  c. catsup
1  can tomatoes
3/4  c. water
hot sauce
Worcestershire sauce
brown sugar
salt and pepper
preparation: Rub roast with brown sugar, salt and pepper.  Mix catsup, tomatoes and water with a dash of hot sauce and dash of Worcestershire sauce.  Pour mixture over roast and bake at 350° until tender.  Serve sauce over rice or noodles.

name: SPOON ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. very warm water
1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. shortening
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. scalded milk
1/3  c. cold water
1  egg
3 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in very warm water.  Combine sugar, shortening, salt and scalded milk.  Cool to lukewarm by adding cold water. Blend in yeast mixture, egg and flour.  Mix well.  Grease top of dough and sides of bowl.  Cover.  Rise for 1 hour until double. Stir down.  Spoon into well-greased muffin pans, 1/2 full.  Cover. Let rise 45 minutes.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.  Makes 18.

name: BROCCOLI TUNA ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. milk
1 (10 oz.)  can tuna, drained
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli spears or 2 1/2 c. fresh broccoli
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
1  tomato, chopped (optional)
6  small (7-inch) flour tortillas
preparation: Combine soup and milk; set aside.  Combine tuna, broccoli, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can French fried onions.  Stir in 3/4 cup soup mixture.  Divide tuna mixture evenly between the tortillas and roll up; place seam side down in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Stir tomato into remaining soup and pour over top of tortillas.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 35 minutes.  Top center of tortillas with remaining cheese and onions and bake uncovered 5 minutes longer.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. cooked elbow macaroni
1/2  c. diced celery
2  Tbsp. chopped dill pickles
2  Tbsp. chopped pimiento
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. grated onion
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
3/4  c. cold water
preparation: Combine macaroni, celery, pickles, pimiento, mayonnaise, salt, onion and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl.  Mix well and chill. Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add cold water and chill until slightly thickened.  Fold in macaroni mixture.  Spoon into individual molds.  Chill until firm, about 3 hours.  Unmold.

name: MAMA ANN'S SUNDAY CHICKEN
ingredients:
flour
salt
pepper
1  pkg. each:  chicken breasts and thighs
1  can cream of chicken soup
4  oz. mushrooms
1/2  tsp. curry powder
preparation: Flour and season chicken.  Brown in shortening.  Place chicken in casserole dish.  Add soup to skillet in which chicken was browned.  Add curry powder and mushrooms; mix well.  Pour over chicken.  Cover; bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serve with rice.

name: HOMEMADE CRACKERS
ingredients:
2  c. whole wheat flour (we grind our own flour and for crackers, leave it fairly coarse for texture)
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. butter
1/2  c. milk
1  large egg
preparation: Sift flour, salt and baking powder into a bowl.  Cut in the butter until very fine.  Add milk and egg to make a stiff dough and knead thoroughly, about 5 minutes.  On a lightly floured surface, roll out dough until very thin and cut into squares or rounds (whatever shape and size you like) and place on a lightly buttered cookie sheet.  Prick with a fork and bake at 400° for 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly brown.  You will need to keep an eye on them until you determine the time in your particular oven.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. butter, melted
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. coconut
preparation: Beat all ingredients together in a bowl.  Pour into a greased 9 or 10-inch glass pie plate.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  When baked, crust will be on bottom, custard in middle and coconut on top.

name: LEMON PEPPER MARINADE
ingredients:
1  c. cooking oil
1/3  c. water
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. lemon-pepper
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
few drops hot pepper sauce (Tabasco)
preparation: Combined all ingredients mixing well. Good for marinating shish kabobs!

name: TACO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground round
taco seasoning (optional)
1  (6 1/2 oz.) bag corn chips
1  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  medium head lettuce, shredded
2  tomatoes, chopped
1  large onion, chopped
preparation: Microwave meat with seasoning 6 to 7 minutes on High.  Stir once during cooking.  Spread chips in bottom of baking dish. Spread meat over chips; top with cheese.  Micro-cook 6 to 8 minutes on Medium or until heated through and cheese melts.  Top with lettuce, tomatoes and onion.

name: BAKED APPLES
ingredients:
apples
raisins
brown sugar
cinnamon
preparation: Core apples and place on a square of aluminum foil.  Fill apple hole with raisins, brown sugar and dash of cinnamon.   Wrap foil around apple and bake on hot coals.

name: CHERRY FLIP
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
8  oz. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  stick margarine
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  pkg. Dream Whip
preparation: Melt margarine and add graham cracker crumbs.  Take half of crumb mixture and press in bottom of dish.  Beat together Dream Whip and milk, add in sugar and vanilla, beat again.  Add cream cheese and beat until smooth.

name: SWISS STEAK FOR SIX
ingredients:
6  top round steaks
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. thyme
1  bay leaf
2  c. beef stock
1/2  c. julienned carrots
1/2  c. sliced onions
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Mix flour, salt and thyme. Dredge steaks in mixture to coat. Sear steaks in 2 tablespoons hot oil to brown on both sides. Place in saute pan. Add thyme and bay leaf.  Pour in beef stock. Cover and simmer 1 hour. Turn steaks.  Add vegetables. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Arrange on platter, vegetables on top. Sprinkle with fresh parsley.

name: MILKY WAY ICING
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. evaporated milk
1  stick butter
6  oz. chocolate chips
1  c. Marshmallow Creme
preparation: Add sugar and milk.   Cook over low heat until it reaches soft ball stage.   Add and stir butter, chocolate chips and Marshmallow Creme.   Stir until chocolate chips are melted.    Remove from heat; stir until cool.   Spread on cake.

name: PINEAPPLE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. oleo
1/2  c. brown sugar
pineapple and cherries
1/3  c. oleo
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. pineapple juice
preparation: Melt 3 tablespoons oleo in baking dish.  Sprinkle 1/2 cup brown sugar, pineapple and cherries.  Mix the rest of the ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Let cool.

name: QUICK CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP
ingredients:
2  cans (10 1/2 oz. each) Campbell's condensed chicken broth
2  c. uncooked egg noodles (about 4 oz.)
2  cans chicken chunks
1  c. cooked vegetables
preparation: Prepare broth as directed on can, using a 3-quart saucepan. Heat to boiling.  Stir in noodles, chicken and vegetables.  Heat to boiling.  Reduce heat.  Simmer, uncovered, for 8 to 10 minutes or until noodles are tender.   You can also add a can of cream of chicken soup.  Serve with crackers.

name: TACO SALAD DIP(Appetizer)
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  jar taco sauce or salsa
1/2  head shredded iceberg lettuce
1 small  can chopped black olives
1/4  c. sliced green olives
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese (or as little or much as you want)
1/2  c. chopped tomatoes
1/2  c. chopped red onion
1  large bag tortilla chips
preparation: Whip mayonnaise and cream cheese together until smooth.  Spread evenly on a flat tray or serving dish.  Spread taco sauce on top of mayo mix.  Add shredded lettuce next.  Then spread chopped tomatoes, red onion and green olives.  Top with cheese and black olives.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour minimum before serving with your favorite tortilla chips.  Dip chips into taco mixture. Mmm good.

name: COCONUT TARTS
ingredients:
1  c. coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
12  tart shells
1/2  c. sugar
pat of butter
1  Tbsp. corn syrup
jam
preparation: Combine ingredients, except jam.  Place 1 teaspoon of jam in each tart shell.  Cover with 1 teaspoon of coconut mixture.  Bake in moderate oven for 20 minutes.  Makes 1 dozen tarts.

name: MEAL IN A CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
salt and pepper to taste
1  medium onion, sliced
1  can mushroom soup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
5  Irish potatoes
1  bell pepper, sliced
1  can green beans (optional)
preparation: Mix meat, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.  Press in a deep baking dish.  Place Irish potatoes  on  top of meat, then the sliced onions and bell pepper.  Mix;  pour	over all. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE 2
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  can evaporated milk
3  eggs, beaten
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. onion
1/2  c. fresh mushrooms
1  c. crushed cheese crackers
preparation: Cut and cook broccoli until tender.  Combine soup, milk and eggs.  Add broccoli, cheese, onion and mushrooms.  Pour into buttered casserole dish.  Add crackers on top.  Bake (uncovered) at 350° until bubbly (about 45 minutes).

name: FUDGY BANANA BROWNIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. quick cooking oats
2/3  c. brown sugar, packed
3/4  c. Dole chopped almonds
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1  extra ripe medium banana
1  firm medium banana
1 (21.5 oz.)  pkg. fudge brownie mix
preparation: In a bowl, mix	together  oats,  brown	sugar, almonds, flour and soda.  Stir  in  melted  margarine  to	form  crumb mixture. Press evenly into 13  x  9-inch baking pan.  Bake in 350° oven for 10 minutes.

name: ORANGE GLAZED BEETS
ingredients:
3/4  c. unsweetened orange juice
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. grated orange rind
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1/8  tsp. salt
1 (16 oz.)  can sliced beets, drained
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a medium skillet; stir until blended. Add beets to skillet. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Cook 1 minute or until sauce thickens, stirring constantly. Yield: 4 servings.

name: INSTANT SPICED TEA
ingredients:
1  c. lemon flavored presweetened tea
1  c. Tang
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
preparation: Mix well.  Use 1 to 2 teaspoons per cup of hot water.

name: RASPBERRY MINT CRUSH
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. lightly packed mint leaves
1  (10 oz.) frozen red raspberries
1  (6 oz.) frozen lemonade concentrate
preparation: Combine sugar, mint leaves and 1 cup boiling water. Let stand 5 minutes. Add 2 cups cold water and stir. Serve over ice. Makes 8 servings.

name: FRED'S FAVORITE MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
12  to 15 Ritz crackers, crushed
1  egg
1  onion, chopped
dash of garlic salt
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can tomato soup
4  or 5 potatoes, cut in chunks
3  or 4 carrots, cut in chunks
preparation: Combine beef, crackers, egg, onion and seasonings.  Mix well. Make a hole in the mixture and fill with about 1/4 cup undiluted tomato soup.  Mix again, working in the tomato soup.  Form mixture into loaf and place in a 9 x 13-inch dish coated with vegetable oil.  Dilute remaining soup with 3/4 cup water and pour over the meat loaf.  Surround with potatoes and carrots.  Salt and pepper vegetables to taste.  Cover with foil and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.  Remove foil and bake until meat loaf is brown on top.

name: STRAWBERRY SLUSH
ingredients:
2  qt. plus 1/2 c. water
3/4  c. sugar
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
1 (No. 303)  can crushed pineapple
1  qt. strawberry soda pop
1  qt. lemon-lime pop
1/4  c. lemon juice
preparation: Heat 1/2 cup water and add sugar.  Stir until sugar dissolves; cool.  Add remaining ingredients and stir.  Serve with crushed ice.  Yields 24 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine (room temperature)
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
5  eggs
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
5 heaping  Tbsp. cocoa powder
1  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Grease, and instead of flour, coat pan with cocoa powder, a 10-inch tube pan.  Cream butter and shortening.  Gradually beat in sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating thoroughly after each.  Combine flour and dry ingredients. Add alternately with milk.  Add vanilla and beat until smooth. Bake for 1 hour and 25 minutes.  Next day serving is best.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. diced raw apples
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
2  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat together oil, sugar and eggs on low speed.  Then mix flour, cinnamon and nutmeg to mixture by hand.  Add apples, nuts and vanilla to mixture.  Grease and flour tube cake pan.  Pour mixture in and bake at 325° for 70 to 75 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
3/4  c. finely chopped pecans
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
2  tsp. vanilla extract
2  c. coarsely shredded zucchini
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Combine flour, soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon and nuts. Set aside.  Beat eggs lightly; add sugar, oil and vanilla.  Beat until creamy.  Stir in zucchini and pineapple.  Add dry ingredients; stir only until moist.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour in 2 well-greased loaf pans.  Cool 10 minutes.  Remove from pans.

name: PAULETTE'S SOUTHERN SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
1 large (42 oz.)  can sweet potatoes or yams
2  eggs
1/3  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. evaporated milk
3/4  stick margarine
preparation: Heat potatoes in pan.  Drain off the juice.  Combine all ingredients and mix with a mixer.  Pour into a buttered dish.

name: SUPPER BAKE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can roast beef
1/3  c. cold water
1/4  c. flour
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can beef gravy
1  lb. can cut green beans, drained
1  tsp. instant onion
package instant potatoes
preparation: Place pieces of meat in 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Blend water and flour.  Stir in gravy and cook and stir until thick and bubbly.  Stir in beans and onion.  Pour over meat.  Top with mounds of mashed potatoes.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: MACARONI AND BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  sm green pepper, diced
1  med onion, diced
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. elbow macaroni
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed tomato soup
1  c. water
1/2  tsp. sugar
preparation: About 45 minutes before serving: Preheat oven to 300°.  In a 10 inch skillet over high heat, cook first 5 ingredients until meat is browned, about 10 minutes.  Remove skillet from heat.  Spoon mixture into a 2 qt. casserole dish. Add uncooked macaroni, tomatoes with their liquid and remaining ingredients to casserole, stirring to break up tomatoes. Cover casserole, bake 35 minutes or until mixture is hot and macaroni is tender; stirring occasionally.

name: CHOCOLATE MESS
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake mix
3/4  c. cooking oil
1  pt. sour cream
4  eggs
1  box instant chocolate pudding
1small bag of chocolate chip
1  c. water
preparation: Combine chocolate cake mix, oil, sour cream and eggs.  Mix well. Add pudding mix and mix well.  Stir in chocolate chips. Pour in crock pot and cook on low for 6 hours.  When done serve over vanilla ice cream.

name: MOM'S QUICK MEAT
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can cream of mushroom soup
milk
1/4  to 1/2 onion (to taste)
noodles or rice
preparation: Brown beef and onion in a skillet.  Drain off the grease.  Add the mushroom soup.  "Rinse" the can with about 1/4 can of milk and add to beef.  Simmer over low heat.  Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve over noodles or rice.

name: SALAD(Christmas or Valentine's Day)
ingredients:
2  pkg. red raspberry or strawberry jello
2  c. hot water
2  pkg. frozen red raspberries or strawberries
2  c. applesauce
preparation: Bring water to a boil; add jello.  Stir until dissolved.  Add frozen berries; continue to stir until berries are thawed apart. Add applesauce.  Stir until well mixed.  Set in refrigerator until set.

name: APRICOT NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can (2 c.) apricot halves
1/3  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 3/4  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Drain apricots, reserving syrup.  Sieve apricots; add reserved syrup, if necessary, to make 1 cup.  Cream together shortening and sugar; add eggs, one at a time.  Beat until light and fluffy.  Sift together dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture alternately with apricot mixture.  Stir in walnuts; turn into well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake in moderate oven (350°) for about 50 minutes.  Remove from pan; cool on rack.

name: HAMBURGER-PASTA CHEESE BAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. hamburger
1/2  c. onion
1/4  c. green pepper
2/3  c. tomato sauce
1  c. shredded cheese
salt and pepper
1  tsp. sugar
8  to 9 manicotti shells
2  c. cottage cheese
preparation: Saute meat, onion and green pepper.  Add tomato sauce, sugar and seasoning.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Boil shells 4 minutes.  Drain on towels.  Fill shells with cottage cheese and grated cheese. Place in baking dish.  Cover with sauce.  Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.

name: QUICHE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage, browned and drained well
1  pkg. pepperoni, chopped
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. Swiss cheese, grated
1  c. Mozzarella, grated
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
5  eggs
1 3/4  c. Carnation milk
2  frozen pie crusts (9-inch)
preparation: Mix ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shells.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until knife inserted in the middle comes out clean.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. self-rising flour
preparation: Beat shortening and peanut butter and sugar together, then add eggs, one at a time.  Add flour and vanilla.  Roll into walnut size balls and flatten in crisscross pattern with floured fork. Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° until light brown, 10 to 12 minutes.  Immediately remove from cookie sheet; cool.  Yields about 2 dozen cookies.

name: HOT DOG SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. ketchup
1/2  c. soy sauce
garlic salt to taste
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. honey
preparation: Bring to boil.  Simmer for 1 hour.  Put cut hot dogs in for last 15 minutes.

name: YOGI POPSICLES
ingredients:
1  carton plain yogurt
6  oz. concentrated fruit juice
preparation: Mix well and freeze in molds.  Three ounce paper cups work well as molds.  Insert wooden sticks or spoons for handles.

name: PARTY MIX
ingredients:
1 small  box Cheerios
1  small bag pretzels
1  box Chex mix
1  pkg. nuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.

name: CREAMY BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
6  bananas sliced
8  oz. cool whip
1 large  box vanilla instant pudding (mixed by directions on box)
1  can condensed milk
1  box vanilla wafers
preparation: Mix cool whip with instant pudding.  Stir in bananas last. Then add  condensed milk.  Layer your large casserole dish with vanilla wafers.  Then a layer of the mixture. Then a layer of vanilla wafers.  Then another layer of mixture, until it is used up.  Line the edged of the bowl with vanilla wafers as you do the layers.  Then top off with cool whip if you have extra cool whip or vanilla wafers.

name: TRIPLE TREAT JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime Jell-O
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry Jell-O
1 (9 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/3  c. mayonnaise
2  c. sliced bananas
preparation: Dissolve lemon and lime Jell-O in 1 cup hot water for each. Dissolve raspberry Jell-O in 2 cups hot water.

name: COCONUT POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3  sticks butter
6  eggs
3  c. plain flour
1/4  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
8  oz. sour cream
1  lb. frozen coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream sugar and butter.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Add dry ingredients.  Fold in coconut.  Pour into a greased and floured tube pan.  Bake at 300° for approximately 1 hour.

name: MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1  can refried beans
1 (8 oz.)  c. sour cream
1  pkg. dry Hidden Valley Ranch
1  pkg. shredded cheese
1  onion
preparation: Place refried beans in bowls.  In separate bowl, mix sour cream and Ranch mix.  Place on beans.  Add cheese and onions. (Purple onions will make a pretty dish.)

name: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can creamed corn
2  Tbsp. sugar
1   c. crushed cracker crumbs (Town House or Ritz, reserve a few crumbs to sprinkle on top)
1  egg
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well. Pour into a 1 3/4-quart casserole dish that has been sprayed with Pam and buttered. Dot with butter and sprinkle on remaining cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: DEEP DARK CHOCOLATE CAKE WITH BUTTERCREAM FROSTING
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 3/4  c. flour
3/4  c. cocoa
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour two 9 x 1 1/2-inch round pans or rectangular 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  In large mixer bowl, combine dry ingredients.  Add eggs, milk, oil and vanilla.  Beat on medium speed 2 minutes.  Remove from mixer, stir in boiling water (batter will be thin).  Pour into prepared pans and bake 30 to 35 minutes for round pans, 35 to 40 minutes for rectangular pan or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. raw apples (Winesap)
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
2 1/2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Peel apples and chop. Set aside.  Pour oil in large mixing bowl. Add sugar and eggs. Beat well. Gradually add sifted dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Gently add apples.  Flour nuts lightly and add to cake mixture. Bake in cake pan or 10-inch tube pan at 325° for 1 hour.  Glaze while warm with glaze.

name: CHICKEN CHAUSSEUR
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. chicken cutlets, sliced in thin strips
1/2  stick margarine or butter
1  c. white cooking wine
6  carrots, cut in sticks
1  head broccoli flowerets
2  small zucchini squash, sliced 1/2 inch thick
2  small summer squash, sliced 1/2 inch thick
1  large green pepper, sliced
pea pods (optional)
cauliflower (optional)
1  large tomato, cut in wedges
salt
pepper
garlic powder
2  Tbsp. flour or cornstarch
1  c. water
1 to 2  pkg. fettucini
preparation: Have all ingredients cut up before starting.  Get water boiling for the fettucini.  Heat large electric frypan and melt margarine. Add wine and chicken strips.  Cook until white.  Start adding vegetables.  Start with carrots and let cook a few minutes before adding the rest.  Start cooking the pasta.  When carrots soften a bit, add all the rest of vegetables except the tomato.  Do not overcook.  You want the vegetables to be tender-crisp.  Mix the flour and water until smooth and add to vegetables and stir.  Add spices to taste.  Meanwhile cook the pasta.  Last, add the tomato just to heat.  Serve the chicken and vegetables over the fettucini.

name: KAHLUA CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate cake mix
1  pkg. chocolate pudding (instant)
4  eggs
1/2  c. oil
walnuts
1  c. water or 3/4 c. water and 1/4 c. Kahlua
preparation: Bake at 325° for 45 minutes in a tube pan.  Glaze on top while hot with powdered sugar and Kahlua.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  whole chicken
1 to 2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  can crescent rolls
salt and pepper
rice or noodles
preparation: Boil 1 whole chicken.  Take off bone.  Add 1 to 2 cans of chicken soup to juice.  Take crescent rolls and slice each roll in half.  Boil in broth for 1 to 2 minutes on each side.  Take them up as you cook them and set aside.

name: RITZ PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  egg whites
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. Ritz cracker crumbs
1  c. finely chopped pecans
preparation: Beat egg whites with baking powder until medium stiff.  Add sugar and vanilla; beat until stiff.  Fold in cracker crumbs and pecans.  Spread in a greased pie pan.  Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.  Cool.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
8  ears cut fresh corn
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
2  beaten eggs
3  c. milk
salt to taste
preparation: Pour in casserole dish and add 1/2 stick margarine on top. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: GLAZED CARROTS
ingredients:
9  to 12 medium carrots
4  Tbsp. margarine
1 to 2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Cut carrots lengthwise; cook until tender.  Drain well.  Melt margarine in skillet; add lemon juice and brown sugar.   Stir until mixture thickens.  Add carrots and stir until well glazed and heated through.

name: BABY FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  c. vegetable oil
2 small  jars baby food (apricots)
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix all ingredients in large bowl.  Be sure to mix well.  Pour in tube cake pan and bake 1 hour at 325°.

name: GARLIC PRETZELS
ingredients:
2  bags pretzels
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1/2  tsp. lemon pepper seasoning
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  pkg. dry Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
1  c. oil
preparation: Mix all together and add 2 bags hand-broken pretzels.  Bake 1 hour at 200°.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  stick butter
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients while broccoli cooks according to directions on package.  Drain broccoli.  Place in buttered 2-quart casserole dish.  Pour mixture over top.  Crumble buttered Ritz crackers or stuffing over top.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: COOKED CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  stick butter
1/2  c. Crisco
1  c. water
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
preparation: Mix together the flour and sugar and set aside.  Mix together the cocoa, Crisco, butter and water.  Bring to a boil, then pour over flour and sugar.  Mix together the buttermilk, soda, vanilla and eggs.  Add to the mixture.  Pour in 11 x 16-inch greased pan. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until done.  Start making frosting 5 minutes before cake is done.

name: STUFFED ONIONS
ingredients:
8  to 10 medium onions
1  Tbsp. butter
some chopped mushrooms
1  c. bread crumbs
3  Tbsp. white sauce
salt and pepper
1  grate of Bee Brand nutmeg
bread crumbs
preparation: Peel the onions; parboil in boiling, salted water with the butter.  Drain and cool.  Carefully scoop out the center part of each onion and chop very fine with half its quantity of chopped mushrooms.  Put in a saucepan with the cup of bread crumbs, salt, pepper and nutmeg, then add the white sauce.  Mix well and stuff the center of the onions with this mixture.  Place onions on buttered tin.  Sprinkle the tops with bread crumbs.  Put a small piece of butter on each one and bake in a moderate oven for 1/2 hour.

name: OATMEAL DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  lb. butter
3  Tbsp. vanilla
1  c. peanut butter
5  c. quick oats
preparation: In saucepan, combine sugar, milk, cocoa and butter.  Bring to a boil.  Boil 2 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Add remaining ingredients.  Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.  Yields 50 cookies.

name: MONTEREY SPINACH MELT
ingredients:
4  oz. Monterey Jack cheese
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. salt
1  garlic clove, pressed
1  pkg. (9 oz.) frozen chopped spinach, thawed, drained and patted dry
1/3  c. chopped carrot
1/4  c. chopped onion
20  French bread slices, 1/4-inch thick
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Cut cheese into 20 thin slices; cover and set aside.  In a large bowl, combine mayonnaise, sour cream, salt and garlic; mix until well blended.  Stir in spinach, carrot onion.  Spread rounded tablespoonful spinach mixture into each bread slice.  Place on baking sheet; top with cheese.  Bake 10-12 minutes or until cheese is melted and bread is crisp.  Serve warm.

name: FRESH PEACH PIE WITH PECANS
ingredients:
4  c. sliced peaches
3/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1/3  c. brown sugar, packed
1/4  c. flour
3  Tbsp. margarine
1/3  c. chopped pecans
1  (9-inch) pie shell
preparation: Combine peaches, sugar, 3 tablespoons flour and lemon juice in a bowl and mix well.  Combine brown sugar and 1/4 cup flour in another bowl.  Cut in margarine using pastry blender; add pecans and toss to mix.  Sprinkle 1/2 pecan mixture in unbaked pie shell and arrange peach mixture.  Top with remaining pecan mixture. Bake at 400° for about 40 minutes or until peaches are tender. Cool on rack.  Serves 8; 383 calories per serving.

name: FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  stick oleo, melted
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
preparation: Melt  butter.  Mix  all  ingredients together well with mixer. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: FAT FREE CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. Karo syrup
3  egg whites
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, cocoa, soda and salt.  Then, add Karo syrup and egg whites, mixing by hand.  Drop rounded spoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet.  While cooling, sprinkle with 10x sugar. Bake at 350° for 7 to 8 minutes.  Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

name: SALMON STEAKS
ingredients:
salmon steaks (as fresh as possible; one 1-inch steak per person)
lemon juice
1  small onion
butter or margarine
seafood seasoning (optional)
preparation: Wash salmon and place on foil lined pan.  Place small pieces of shaved butter or margarine, approximately one piece per square inch, on one side of salmon.  Cut very thin slices of onion and place on top of the butter or margarine.  Pour enough lemon juice on steaks to coat all surfaces (a small amount may be used by tilting pan and spooning over steaks).  Leave juice in pan. Seasoning may be added, if desired.  Cook under preheated oven broiler for 7 to 10 minutes per side, depending on broiler temperature.  Do not overcook.

name: APPLE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. nonfat dry milk
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. soft margarine
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. egg substitute
1  c. finely chopped apple
1/3  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. finely chopped pecans or walnuts
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients in a bowl.  Add shortening, egg and 1/2 cup water.  Blend with mixer just until blended.  Add apples; stir in by hand.  Spoon batter into 12 greased muffin cups.  Mix cinnamon, brown sugar and nuts.  Sprinkle on top of each muffin. Bake at 375° about 20 minutes.

name: KEY LIME PIE
ingredients:
1  (8 or 9-inch) baked pastry shell or graham cracker crumb crust
3  egg yolks
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1/2  c. ReaLime lime juice from concentrate
