yellow food coloring
whipped cream or whipped topping
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  In large mixer bowl, beat egg yolks with condensed milk, ReaLime and food coloring.  Pour into prepared pastry shell; bake for 30 minutes.  Cool; chill.  Top with whipped cream.  Garnish as desired.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: BAKED BANANAS
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
6  medium bananas cut in fourths
Vanilla ice cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  In a 12 x 8 inch dish, melt butter in dish.  Add brown sugar, cinnamon and ginger.  Mix well.  Add bananas to butter mixture, mix gently to coat bananas.  Bake 10 minutes or until bananas are heated, basting with butter mixture. Serve over ice cream.

name: RAINBOW COOKIE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine or butter
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 (14 oz.)  can condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can coconut
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. M&M's plain chocolate candies
preparation: Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass pan).  In 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt margarine in oven.  Sprinkle crumbs over margarine.  Pour condensed milk evenly over crumbs.  Top with remaining ingredients.  Press down firmly.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.  Cool.  Cut into bars.   Store loosely covered at room temperature.

name: WHIPPED CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
6  eggs
3  c. sugar
3  c. cake flour
1 small  carton whipping cream
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream sugar and butter.   Add eggs, one at a time.    Add flour and cream alternately.   Add vanilla.  Place in greased tube pan in cold oven and bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: SHORTCUT BARBECUED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's condensed tomato soup
2  Tbsp. honey
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. onion powder
4  chicken breast halves (about 2 lb.), skinned
fresh Italian parsley (for garnish)
preparation: In a medium bowl, combine soup, honey, mustard and onion powder.  Arrange chicken, bone side up, on rack in broiler pan. Brush chicken with soup mixture.  Broil 6-inches from heat for 30 minutes or until no longer pink and juices run clear, turning once and brushing often with soup mixture during cooking.  Garnish with parsley, if desired.  Prep time:  10 minutes.  Cook time:  30 minutes.  Yields 4 servings.

name: NEW ENGLAND YAM BAKE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple slices
2 (17 oz.)  cans Princella or Royal Prince yams, drained
1/4  c. flour
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. Parkay margarine
1/4  c. chopped nuts
1  c. Kraft miniature marshmallows or 10 Jets marshmallows
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/4 cup syrup.  Line sides of 10 x 6-inch baking dish with pineapple slightly overlapping.  Arrange yams in center.  Pour pineapple syrup over yams.  Combine flour, brown sugar, cinnamon and salt.  Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs; stir in nuts.  Sprinkle over yams.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Top with marshmallows.  Broil until lightly browned.

name: CHEDDAR SQUASH BAKE
ingredients:
2  lb. squash
1  c. sour cream
2  beaten egg yolks
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
2  stiffly beaten egg whites
1 1/2  c. shredded cheese
4  slices bacon, crisp
1/3  c. dry bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. butter, melted
preparation: Scrub squash, cut of ends and slice to make 6 cups.  Cook, covered, in boiling salted water 15 to 20 minutes.  Sprinkle with salt.  Mix sour cream, egg yolks and flour.  Fold in egg whites. In a 10 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish, layer half the squash, half the egg mixture and half the cheese; sprinkle bacon on top. Repeat layers of squash, egg and cheese.  Combine crumbs and butter; sprinkle atop.  Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.  Top with bacon and parsley.

name: DOUBLE CHOCOLATE MINT CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. (1 1/2 c.) Nestl
Toll House
mint flavored semi-sweet chocolate morsels, divided
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter, softened
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  egg
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation:
Preheat oven to 375°. Melt over hot (not boiling) water 3/4 cup Nestl
Toll House
mint flavored semi-sweet chocolate morsels; stir until smooth.* Cool to room temperature. In bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt; set aside. In bowl, beat butter, brown sugar, sugar and vanilla extract until creamy. Add melted morsels and egg; beat well. Gradually blend in flour mixture. Stir in remaining morsels and nuts. Drop by rounded measuring tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375° for 8 to 9 minutes. Allow to stand 2 to 3 minutes before removing from cookie sheets; cool completely. Makes about 1 1/2 dozen cookies.

name: STRAWBERRY SHAKES
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1  c. milk
1  pt. strawberry ice cream or frozen yogurt
preparation: Put strawberries and their juice into blender container with adult help.  Cover and blend until smooth.  Scoop some of the ice cream or yogurt into 3 tall glasses.  Put the rest of the ice cream of yogurt into the blender container.   With adult help, cover and blend until smooth.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
3/4  c. Karo syrup
1/2  c. ketchup
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. mustard
2  tsp. ground ginger
preparation: In bowl, stir together all ingredients.  Brush on meats, turning frequently during last 20 minutes of grilling.  Makes about 1 1/2 c. sauce.

name: DECORATOR FROSTING
ingredients:
8  c. sifted powdered sugar
2  c. shortening
3/4  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl; beat at high speed for 5 minutes or until light and fluffy.  If too stiff, add a few drops of milk until it reaches the right consistency.

name: STIR-FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  chicken breasts
1  large yellow pepper
1  large green pepper
2  small tomatoes
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can pineapple tidbits, reserve juice
1  (16 oz.) bag frozen mixed vegetables
4  cloves garlic
1/4  tsp. ginger
salt to taste
1/4  tsp. onion powder
2  tsp. cooking oil
preparation: Debone, skin and cut chicken breasts in chunks.  Seed and chunk peppers and quarter tomatoes.

name: CRISPIES
ingredients:
12  oz. Guittards vanilla milk chips
12  oz. butterscotch chips
2  c. chopped pecans
5  oz. can La Choy Chow Mein noodles
preparation: Melt chips in double boiler. We use our old Presto cooker, it's larger, heavier and we can add all the other ingredients in that pan.

name: YANKEE SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans sweet potatoes in light syrup, drained
1  c. thinly sliced apples
1/2  c. fresh cranberries
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
3/4  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
1/2  c. walnut halves, toasted
preparation: Cut sweet potatoes crosswise into 1/2-inch slices.  Evenly arrange half of sweet potatoes in shallow, 1 1/2-quart, microwave-safe pan.  Top with all apple slices.  Layer remaining sweet potatoes over apples; reserve.

name: SWEET POTATO PUFFS
ingredients:
2  cups cooked mashed sweet potatoes
1  cup sugar
1  cup raisins
1/4  tsp. almond flavoring
maraschino cherries
corn flakes
preparation: Mash potatoes.  Add sugar and raisins (coconut if desired). Add flavoring.  Roll in crushed corn flakes and roll into balls. Press down and place on cookie sheet.  Put cherry on top.  Bake at 350° about 20 to 25 minutes.

name: DONNIE DUKE CLARK'S CORN BREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. white cornmeal
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda (use 1/4 tsp. more if old buttermilk)
1 heaping  Tbsp. flour
1  egg
1  Tbsp. bacon drippings
preparation: Mix dry ingredients together and add buttermilk until you have the consistency of pancake batter.  Add bacon drippings and 1 egg. Mix together and pour into a hot skillet with enough oil to barely cover bottom of skillet.  Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes, until cornbread is lightly browned and firm.  Makes enough dressing for 4 people.

name: EASY HEARTY CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
1  can creamed corn
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  raw potato, chopped in small pieces
3/4  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. cooked and chopped bacon, ham or sausage
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Blend all ingredients and cook over low heat until potatoes and celery are done.  Add water for desired thickness.

name: KOREAN KIM CHEE
ingredients:
1  medium bok choy (or Chinese cabbage)
2 1/2  tsp. salt
1  large onion, thinly sliced (or scallions, chopped)
1  tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
1 1/4  tsp. cayenne for color
4  cloves garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. sugar (optional)
1/4  tsp. powdered ginger or crushed ginger roots
preparation: Thinly slice bok choy into vertical pieces.  Then sprinkle bok choy with salt.  Let stand overnight in a cool place or in refrigerator.

name: QUICK COBBLER
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
pinch of salt
1  can favorite fruit
preparation: Melt butter in 8 x 8-inch pan. Mix all other ingredients. Take can of fruit and pour off half of the juice, then pour fruit over batter and bake.  Bake at 325° until golden.

name: ANGEL STRAWBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1 large  pkg. jello instant pudding mix (vanilla)
1  pt. fresh strawberries
Cool Whip
preparation: In large casserole dish, crumble angel food cake.  Prepare instant pudding as indicated on box.  Pour layer on top of cake; add layer of strawberries; then layer of Cool Whip.  Strawberries can be put on top, if desired.

name: CHILI RELLENOS
ingredients:
6  eggs
1  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. white pepper
dash of seasoned salt
5 1/2  oz. can evaporated milk
1  lb. shredded cheese
1/2  lb. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/2  lb. shredded hot pepper cheese
preparation: Mix cheeses and flour.  Place in a 9 x 12-inch pan.  Mix remaining ingredients and pour over cheeses.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Cool 30 minutes.  Cut into squares.

name: LEMON CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1/2  c milk
4  eggs
1  1/2 c sugar
3  T lemon juice
1  (9 inch) unbaked pie shell
preparation: Melt butter until caramel color.  Add milk until almost scalded.  Cool.  Beat eggs, add sugar and lemon juice.  Pour into pie shell, bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: CHICKEN PARMESANA
ingredients:
6  pieces boneless chicken
6  slices ham
6  slices Mozzarella cheese
1 1/2  tsp. oregano
1  jar spaghetti sauce
7 or 8  oz. pasta (any kind)
preparation: Put chicken in pan (for oven).  Cover with cheese, ham  and spaghetti sauce and sprinkle with oregano.  Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 325°.  Serve over pasta.  Serve with salad and bread.

name: RYE BOAT
ingredients:
2  c. mayonnaise
2  c. sour cream
2  tsp. dill
2  tsp. Beau Monde seasoning
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. parsley
2  pkg. dried corned beef
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Serve with rye bread.

name: MOM STEPHEN'S WILD RICE AND CRAB SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. wild rice, rinsed well and drained
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sherry vinegar
1/4  c. peanut oil
6  oz. (1 c.) lump crab
2  scallions, sliced thin or diagonal
1/4  c. water chestnuts, blanched 5 minutes, sliced thin and dried
2  oz. snow peas, blanched 10 seconds and cooled
preparation: In saucepan, combine wild rice, salt and 1 1/2 cups water. Simmer, covered, 35 to 45 minutes, until rice is tender.  Drain, if necessary.  Let rice cool 15 minutes.

name: BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  box Raisin Bran cereal
1  c. melted margarine (2 sticks)
3  c. sugar
5  c. flour
5  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. salt
1  qt. buttermilk
4  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Can use as much of batter as wanted and bake in an oven at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes in paper-lined muffin tins.  Can refrigerate leftover batter until next time.

name: BREAKFAST PIZZA
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  c. hash brown potatoes, thawed
5  eggs
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1  pkg. (8) crescent rolls
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown sausage, drain.  Separate crescent rolls into 8 triangles and place on an ungreased 12-inch pizza pan or 12-inch round cake pan with points toward center.  Press over bottom and up sides to form a crust.  Spoon sausage over crust.  Sprinkle with potatoes and top with Cheddar cheese.  In a bowl, beat together eggs, milk, salt and pepper.  Pour over crust.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground round or chuck
1  jar Ragu chunky
1 small  pkg. shredded sharp cheese
lettuce, shredded
tomato, diced
1  bag Frito-Lay Scoops
preparation: Brown hamburger and drain. Add Ragu. While this is simmering, put a layer of Frito-Lay corn chips in a pan and heat in oven until warm (this gives chips a totally different flavor). Individuals may put mixture in a dish; top with cheese, tomato and lettuce. Use Scoops to eat.

name: HOT WASSAIL
ingredients:
1/2  gal. apple juice
1/2  gal. cranberry juice
1  c. brown sugar
2  sticks cinnamon
6  to 8 whole cloves
preparation: Mix and simmer on low for 2 to 3 hours.

name: CUCUMBER SALAD(Weight Watchers)
ingredients:
1  medium unpeeled cucumber, diced
1  bunch green onions, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon sugar-free gelatin
1/2  c. boiling water
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  c. reduced calorie Miracle Whip
1 1/3  c. low-fat cottage cheese
1  c. crushed unsweetened pineapple and juice
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in hot water.  Add vinegar.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Pour into 1-quart dish and refrigerate until set.  Serves 8.

name: BUTTERMILK SALAD
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can pineapple
1 small  pkg. Jell-O (any flavor)
1  bowl Cool Whip (8 oz.)
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. nuts
preparation: Boil pineapple and Jell-O together for about 5 minutes. Chill.  Mix in other ingredients.  Refrigerate.

name: CARROT DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. low-fat milk
1 1/2  c. diced carrots
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Whirl in blender for 2 minutes.  Serve over equal parts shredded red and green cabbage.  Top with chopped scallions. Makes 2 cups.

name: PISTACHIO BREAD
ingredients:
1  (18  oz.) yellow cake mix
2  (3 oz.) pistachio pudding - instant
6  eggs
1/4  c. oil
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. sour cream
preparation: Beat all ingredients together.  Pour into 2 floured bread pans, 1/2 amount of batter in each pan.  In small bowl, mix 5 Tbsp. sugar, 4 tsp. cinnamon, and 1/3 cup ground nuts.  Sprinkle over batter in pans.  Pour remaining batter in each pan and bake at 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes.

name: JAPANESE PIE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. pecans
1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Mix together margarine, sugar, vinegar and vanilla.  Add eggs, raisins, pecans and coconut.  Pour into a pie crust and bake for 45 minutes at 325°.

name: TINA'S RICE
ingredients:
2  c. precooked white rice
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  can drained water chestnuts
1  c. frozen chopped broccoli
1/2  c. crushed potato chips (optional)
preparation: Dice water chestnuts.  Then, combine rice, cheese, chestnuts and broccoli in a large oven-proof casserole dish.  Top with potato chips (optional).  Bake at 425° in a conventional oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: BUTTERMILK BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. soda
1/4  c. shortening
3/4  c. buttermilk (more if needed)
preparation: Mix dry ingredients, cut in shortening and milk.  Stir with fork to mix.  Turn out on floured board and knead a few times. Roll out and cut.  Place on greased baking sheet or shallow metal baking pan.  Bake at 425° to 450° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

name: CHUNKY CHILI DIP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground hamburger
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
1  c. chopped tomatoes
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  bag tortilla chips
preparation: Brown hamburger; drain off fat.  Add onion and green pepper. Cook until tender.  Stir in cheese, tomatoes and chili powder. Heat until cheese is melted.  Serve with chips.

name: CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. strawberry jello
2  c. hot water
1  tsp. Knox gelatine
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. pecans
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix jello with water.  Add berries, pineapple and nuts.  Pour 1/2 mixture in Pyrex dish and congeal.  Add sour cream over this. Then pour rest of mixture over this and congeal.

name: BEAVER (OR ANY SMALL GAME) HASH
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. leftover cooked wild game meat
2  onions, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
vegetable oil
1  can tomatoes
1  c. Minute rice
Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. garlic powder
salt and pepper
preparation: Grind or finely chop up the meat.  Saute onions and celery in oil.  Add the meat and cook until all is browned.  Mix in canned tomatoes and rice.  Simmer over low heat for 5 minutes or until rice is done.  Season with Worcestershire sauce, garlic, salt and pepper.

name: LAYERED CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey breast or chicken breast
3/4  c. onion, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1  c. 1% cottage cheese
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
3  Tbsp. lite sour cream
6  Tbsp. lite cream cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. fat-free cheese
3  c. cooked pasta, drained
black pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Brown meat and onion in large skillet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.  Add tomato sauce and seasonings.  Simmer 7 to 8 minutes.  In large bowl, combine green pepper, cottage cheese, cream cheese and sour cream.  Mix thoroughly.  Spray a large casserole dish (9 x 13-inch) with nonstick cooking spray.  Cover bottom with pasta.  Add a layer of meat mixture.  Pour cottage cheese mixture for next layer and top with shredded fat-free cheese.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: PENNE A LA VODKA SAUCE
ingredients:
1 to 2  Tbsp. olive oil
4  Tbsp. crushed garlic
2 (16 oz.)  cans Contadina tomato sauce
salt and pepper
1/4  tsp. dried basil
1/2  pt. light cream
2  oz. vodka
preparation: Put olive oil in pan over low heat.  Saute garlic to a golden brown color.  Add cans of Contadina tomato sauce, salt and pepper to taste.  Also add 1/4 teaspoon dried basil.  Stir to a boil on high heat.  Then lower to medium heat.  Cook for 15 minutes.  Add 1/2 pint light cream.  Stir occasionally for 5 minutes.  Last add 2 ounces of vodka.  Bring to a boil.  Serve over cooked macaroni.

name: GRILLED ONIONS
ingredients:
4  large onions
1  stick margarine
lemon pepper
paprika
preparation: Peel and cut ends off onions.  Cook on grill until black and spewing or well done.  Peel off black and cut an x halfway through.  Put in 1/4 of margarine and sprinkle with lemon pepper and paprika.  Serve warm.  Great with meat cooked on grill!

name: APPLE-RAISIN SHORTCAKES
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. raisins or dried cranberries
1  Fuji apple, peeled, cored and thinly sliced
2  Tbsp. water
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  can refrigerated buttermilk-flavored biscuits
6  Tbsp. vanilla low-fat yogurt
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  In a small bowl, mix sugar and cinnamon and set aside.

name: TEXAS BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. tomato juice
1/4  c. vinegar
1/4  c. catsup
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. molasses
several dashes hot pepper sauce
1/4  c. white Karo syrup
2  Tbsp. paprika or chili powder
2  tsp. dry mustard
1 1/2  tsp. onion salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients in 1 quart saucepan.  Cover and simmer 5 minutes.	Makes 2 cups.

name: PIMENTO CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (2 lb.)  box Velveeta cheese, grated
1  jar diced pimento
1  tsp. sweet relish
1/2  c. salad dressing
preparation: Mix all together and use on bread or serve on crackers.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
2  lb. ground round
onion to taste
32  oz. spaghetti sauce
small can mushrooms
oregano to taste
1  lb. Mozzarella cheese
1  carton Ricotta cheese
1  pkg. lasagna noodles
preparation: Brown beef with onion.  Simmer with spaghetti sauce.  Cook noodles.  Layer noodles, then sauce, then Ricotta, then Mozzarella.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: SAUCY MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  c. soft bread
1  c. milk
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  egg
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. minced onions
preparation: Add bread to milk and let stand for a couple of minutes.  Mix beef, egg, pepper, Worcestershire and onion.  Shape into loaf and place into baking pan.

name: AUTUMN VEGETABLE BEEF SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. very lean ground beef
3/4  c. chopped onions
2 1/2  c. hot water
3/4  c. chopped celery
3/4  c. diced potatoes
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. Lawry's seasoned salt (optional)
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  bay leaf
1/8  tsp. dried sweet basil
1/4  tsp. chives
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. dried thyme
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes (undrained)
2  carrots, thinly sliced
preparation: Brown ground beef and onions in large saucepan.  Drain off fat.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bring to a boil and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender.  Remove bay leaf before serving.

name: CEREAL
ingredients:
6  c. oats
1 1/2  c. sunflower nuts
1 1/2  c. coconut
1  c. wheat germ
3/4  c. honey
1/4  c. water
1/2  c. oil
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients.  Mix honey and water.  Stir oil, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt into honey mixture.  Mix both mixtures together.  Bake at 250° for 1 hour, stirring every 20 minutes.

name: AUNT JAN'S CHILI SAUCE
ingredients:
7 to 8  qt. tomatoes
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. salt
2  green peppers, chopped
2  hot red peppers, chopped
2  stalks celery, diced
3  medium onions, diced
1  c. cider vinegar
2  Tbsp. paprika
1 1/2  tsp. powdered cloves
1 1/2  tsp. powdered nutmeg
1 1/2  tsp. powdered cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. powdered allspice
1 1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/8  tsp. thyme
1/8  tsp. caraway seed
1/8  tsp. powdered ginger
preparation: Remove skin from ham.  Add glaze 45 minutes before it is finished cooking.

name: BALSAMIC B~B~Q CHICKEN
ingredients:
2/3  c. Balsamic Vinaigrette Salad Dressing
1/4  c. Ketchup
1  tsp. Dried Oregano
1/4  tsp. Pepper
4  Chicken Leg and Thigh quarters, 3-4 lb.
preparation: In large resealable plastic food storage bag, combine dressing, ketchup, oregano and pepper; add chicken.  Turn bag to coat chicken with marinade; seal bag and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.  Heat oven to 425°.  Transfer chicken to roasting pan. Skin side up.  Discard marinade.  Roast until meat is not longer pink near bone, 40 minutes, covering loosely with foil if skin is browning to quickly.  Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

name: BANANA CAKE-PIE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick margarine, melted
about 1/2 box vanilla wafers, crushed
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. frozen whipped topping
2  or 3 bananas, sliced
1 large  pkg. instant vanilla pudding (prepare as directed on box)
additional whipped topping
preparation: Combine flour and melted margarine.  Press into 9 x 13-inch dish or pan and bake at 375° for 15 minutes.  Cool completely. Blend cream cheese, powdered sugar and 1 cup whipped topping. Spread over pastry in pan.  Add a layer of 2 or 3 bananas, sliced. Top with prepared instant pudding.  Sprinkle on the 1/2 box of crushed vanilla wafers.  Top with whipped topping.  Chill.

name: SWEET & SOUR TUNA
ingredients:
1 (8 3/4 oz.)  can pineapple tidbits
1  c. green pepper strips
1  chicken bouillon cube
1/2  c. water
1  T. cornstarch
3  T. sugar
1  T. vinegar
1  t. soy sauce
1 (7 oz.)  can tuna
1  T. butter
1 (3 oz.)  can chow mein noodles
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving juice. In sauce, combine 1/3 cup of the pineapple juice, pineapple tidbits, green pepper strips, chicken bouillon cube and water. Heat to boiling and simmer for 5 minutes.

name: SOY MARINADE
ingredients:
3/4  c. oil
1/4  c. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. honey
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1  green onion (if desired)
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Makes enough marinade for 2 pounds of meat.  Marinate  meat in a nonmetallic container.  Marinate in refrigerator  for  8  hours  or 2 hours at room temperature before cooking.

name: GRAPE SALAD
ingredients:
bunch of red grapes
bunch of fresh broccoli, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. young onions
2/3  c. slivered almonds
3/4  c. raisins
6  or 7 strips cooked crisp bacon, crumbled
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Combine mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar for dressing; refrigerate.  Combine rest of ingredients and refrigerate until serving.  Just before serving, add dressing to salad mixture and mix well.

name: VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. non-butter fat sour dressing
3/4  c. reduced calorie mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. seasoning salt
3 or 4  drops Tabasco sauce
1  Tbsp. dried onion flakes
1  tsp. dill weed
1/2  tsp. Accent
preparation: Combine sour dressing and mayonnaise.  Add other ingredients and mix well. Great dip for green peppers, cucumbers and cauliflower. Only 50 calories per serving.

name: LADY DI'S CHEESE RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. Monterey Jack cheese, cut in strips
1 3/4  c. sour cream
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies, chopped
1/2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
2  c. rice, cooked
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, combine sour cream, chilies, salt and pepper; mix well.  In buttered casserole dish, layer rice, sour cream mixture and cheese strips.  Top with rice.  Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.  Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese during the last 5 minutes; cook until cheese is melted.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BONBONS
ingredients:
1  jar (18 oz.) crunchy peanut butter
1/4  lb. oleomargarine
1  lb. confectioners sugar
3  c. Rice Krispies
1/2  bar paraffin wax
1  (8 oz.) Hershey bar
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Dip balls in this and place on wax paper to set.

name: DILL PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. sour cream
1  can small green peas
salt
1/3  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. onions, chopped
2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. dried dill weed
preparation: In large mixing bowl, combine mayonnaise, sugar, salt, dill weed, sour cream and Worcestershire sauce.  Mix well.  Add celery, onions and peas.  Stir to coat.  Chill about 2 hours.  Serve on lettuce bed.

name: SALAD FOR DINNER
ingredients:
1  medium head lettuce
1  pkg. sunflower seeds
1  lb. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  lb. raisins
1  jar Italian dressing or your own oil and vinegar
2  boiled chicken breasts
3  thinly sliced carrots
preparation: After boiling chicken breasts, cool and chop into squares. Be sure to remove skin.  Chop lettuce and place in a large bowl. Add sunflower seeds, cheese and raisins to lettuce.  Add carrots and chicken, then stir and serve.

name: CHRISTMAS SPECIAL FRUITCAKE
ingredients:
3  c. coarsely chopped Brazil nuts
1  lb. pitted dates, chopped
1  c. halved maraschino cherries
3/4  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: In mixing bowl, combine nuts, dates and cherries.  In another bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.  Add to nut mixture, stirring until nuts and fruit are well coated.  Beat eggs until foamy.  Stir in vanilla.  Fold into nut mixture.  Mix well.  Pour into a greased and waxed paper lined 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 45 minutes.  Cool 10 minutes in pan before removing to wire rack.  Yields 24 servings.

name: VERY BASIC QUICHE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1/3  c. chopped onion
4  eggs
1 1/4  c. light cream
1 1/2  c. coarsely grated Swiss cheese
6  Tbsp. grated Romano or Parmesan or mixed
preparation: Saute onion in butter.  Combine with rest of ingredients. Pour into slightly baked pie crust.  Bake for 30 minutes, or until middle is set, at 350°.

name: MOCK CHAMPAGNE
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
4  c. water
4  c. grape juice or pineapple juice
2  c. orange juice
8  pt. chilled ginger ale
preparation: Boil  sugar and water for 3 minutes and cool.  Add rest of the  juices  and  chill.  Just before serving, add chilled ginger ale.  Makes 50 servings.

name: EGG - CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. sausage
9  eggs
12  slices of bread
3  C. milk
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry or prepared mustard
1 1/2  C. cheese
preparation: Crumble and brown sausage.  Beat eggs in a large mixing bowl. Tear bread into eggs.  Add milk, mustard, cheese and salt.  Add sausage.  Place in a 9 x 13 inch pan sprayed with Pam.  Refrigerate over-night.  Let stand 15 minutes before baking.  Bake in a 350 degree oven 45 minutes or until brown.

name: RUSSIAN TEA CAKES
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
1/2  c. sifted powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. finely chopped pecans
preparation: Mix together the butter, powdered sugar and vanilla.  Mix the flour and salt; stir into the butter mixture.  Add the chopped nuts.  Chill dough.  Roll into 1-inch balls.  Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake until set but not brown.  While still warm, roll in powdered sugar.  Cool and roll in powdered sugar again.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: VENISON ROAST
ingredients:
3  medium onions, sliced
3  stalks celery, chopped
2  carrots, chopped
1  bunch parsley, chopped
3  cloves garlic, slivered
1  c. red wine vinegar with garlic
1  c. red wine, reduced (optional)
1  Tbsp. peppercorns, cracked
1  c. water
1  venison roast
preparation: Mix all ingredients together to form marinade and pour over roast.  Cover and refrigerate for 4 to 5 days, turning twice a day.  Remove meat and pat dry with a paper towel.  Strain marinade and reserve both marinade and vegetables.  Make deep slits and insert pieces of bacon or rinsed salt pork.  Melt 3 to 4 tablespoons fat in heavy roasting pan and brown meat evenly. Cover loosely with foil and roast in oven at 350° for 20 minutes per pound for medium and 30 minutes per pound for well done. Remove roast to a large platter and set on top burner.  Saute vegetables from marinade.  Remove vegetables with slotted spoon and put around roast.  Stir in a little flour to make a brown roux, then stir in reserved marinade.  Cook until thickened. Correct seasoning and pour into a sauce boat.

name: PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
round steak
1 3/4  c. water
juice from large can tomatoes
1/2  c. chopped onion
beef gravy base
canned tomatoes
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Cut round steak in strips (trim of fat or gristle).  Season with flour, garlic salt, salt and pepper, then fry in large skillet in small amount of oil.  Add 1 3/4 cups water, juice from tomatoes, chopped onion and gravy base.  Let simmer about 1 hour or until tender.  Add canned tomatoes and Worcestershire sauce. Cook 5 minutes and serve over rice.

name: LIFE SAVER FROSTING
ingredients:
4 level  tsp. flour
3/4  c. milk
3/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. shortening
1/3  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
preparation: Cook flour and milk until thick and cool (do this while cake is baking).  Cream sugar, shortening and butter well and add to cooled flour mixture; add vanilla and salt.  Beat until fluffy and about the consistency of whipped cream.  This is a life saver when you need icing but are out of confectioners sugar.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. crushed parsley
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  Tbsp. dill weed
1  Tbsp. Accent flavor enhancer
preparation: Make this the day before. Excellent with fresh vegetables such as cauliflower, broccoli, carrots, celery, slices of cucumber, green peppers and cherry tomatoes.  (I make a tray of all these vegetables, fresh, with Dill Dip in the middle.)

name: ANGEL SALAD
ingredients:
2  (3 oz.) cream cheese
2  pkg. lime jello
2  c. hot water
1 small  can crushed pineapple
3  c. diced celery
1  c. chopped pecans
1 (2 oz.)  jar pimiento
1/2  c. whipped cream
preparation: Mix jello and hot water; let cool.  Mash cheese; add pineapple, celery, pimiento and nuts.  Mix this into jello and put in refrigerator until begins to gel.  Whip cream and fold into jello.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  skinless chicken breast fillets
dash of oregano
dash of garlic
dash of paprika
1  bag nacho Doritos
1  onion, diced
1  can green chilies
1  can cream of chicken soup
shredded cheese
preparation: Cut chicken breasts up into pieces.  Sprinkle with spices and cook in 1 tablespoon oil until done.  Layer in order the remaining ingredients.  Bake at 375° until cheese is bubbly and casserole is warm through.

name: SQUIRREL MULLIGAN
ingredients:
3  squirrels
5  medium sized onions
3  cans tomatoes
1  can corn
1  piece salt pork
8  medium sized potatoes
1  can green peas
celery and carrots, diced
preparation: Cook meat  until tender and well done.	Add the vegetables and simmer  1  hour.  Season  to taste with black pepper, salt and Tabasco  sauce.  Sift  corn meal into mixture.  Stir and cook the meal.  Let	set  for a few minutes but keep warm and then serve.

name: TURKEY LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. ground turkey
3/4  c. bread crumbs
1/2  c. chopped onions
3/4  c. milk
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. horseradish
1  tsp. poultry seasoning
1  tsp. dry mustard
salt and pepper as desired
preparation: Mix together all ingredients until homogeneous.  Place in an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SOUR CREAM RAISIN PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. raisins
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
12  oz. sour cream
3  egg yolks
1/4  c. cornstarch
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cook raisins before adding to filling.  Mix next six ingredients together and cook in microwave until thick.  Add raisins and put in cooked pie shell.  Put meringue on pie and bake until brown.

name: FUDGE TOPPED CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
chocolate chip cookies
hot fudge sauce
preparation: Go to grocery store.  Buy a package of Chips Ahoy chocolate chip cookies and a jar of Hershey's hot fudge sauce.  Use a spoon to put some fudge on top of each cookie as you eat it.

name: PEACHES N' CREAM PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. self-rising flour
3  Tbsp. margarine, softened
1  egg
3 1/4  oz. pkg. vanilla pudding mix (not instant)
1/2  c. milk
1 (15 oz.)  can sliced peaches
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
3  Tbsp. reserved juice (from peaches)
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in mixing bowl.  Beat 2 minutes. Pour into greased 9-inch pie plate. Drain peaches and reserve juice.  Place peaches over the batter in the plate.  Mix the cream cheese, sugar and 3 tablespoons reserved juice until smooth. Spoon to within 1-inch of edge of batter. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: AUNT ANNIE'S RELISH PICKLES
ingredients:
12  large cucumbers
4  green peppers
4  red peppers
4  large onions
1  qt. vinegar
5  c. sugar
1 heaping  tsp. salt
3  tsp. turmeric
4  tsp. celery seed
4  tsp. mustard seed
preparation: Grind cukes, peppers and onions.  Add 1 quart water; boil for 15 minutes.  Drain.  Add vinegar, sugar, salt, seed and turmeric. Cook for 30 minutes.  Put in jars and seal while hot.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
3  real ripe bananas, mashed
1 1/2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. soda
1  c. sugar
1  stick butter
2  eggs
1  c. nuts, ground
preparation: Melt butter; cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs.  Mix soda and flour.  Add bananas. Add nuts.  Save some of nuts to sprinkle on top.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

name: PEACH CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
2  eggs
16  oz. canned peaches, fresh peaches, sliced apples or 1 pt. blueberries
1/2  c. butter
1  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add flour, baking powder, eggs and salt.  Beat until smooth.  Pour into 9-inch spring-form pan. Cover entire surface with fruit.  Sprinkle with sugar.  Squirt with lemon juice.  Sprinkle with flour and cinnamon.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Let cool 15 minutes before removing.  Serve with ice cream.

name: APRICOT NECTAR SALAD
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  boxes apricot or orange jello
1  c. boiling water
2  c. apricot nectar
2  bananas, sliced
1  c. mandarin oranges, drained well
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. real whipped cream or Cool Whip
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Then add apricot nectar, mix together and chill until it begins to thicken.  Add bananas, mandarin oranges and marshmallows.  Fold in whipped cream or Cool Whip.  Pour into square or small rectangle Pyrex pan and chill until firm.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
1  egg
2  to 3 crushed bananas
5  Tbsp. sour milk (4 milk and 1 vinegar)
1  tsp. soda
pinch of salt
2  c. flour
1/2  c. nuts, chopped (optional)
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients.  Sift flour, salt and soda.  Add to mixture with nuts.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean.  Recipe makes 1 loaf; can be doubled or tripled if more is desired.

name: APRICOT SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. apricot or 1 peach and 1 apricot jello
2/3  c. sugar
2/3  c. boiling water
2 small  jars apricot baby food
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Bring to a boil the jello, sugar and water.  Remove from heat. Add baby food and pineapple; set aside to cool, being sure that all is dissolved.  Combine softened cream cheese and milk.  Beat again.  Add nuts.  Refrigerate until set.

name: BROCCOLI-CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. broccoli flowerets
6  slices bacon
1  c. cauliflower florets
1  c. mayonnaise
6  hard-cooked eggs, diced
1/2  c. white sugar
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. white wine vinegar
preparation: Fry bacon until evenly brown. Crumble and set aside.

name: HEARTY BEEF AND CHEESE CRESCENT PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can (1 c.) tomato sauce
1/4  tsp. cumin seed (if desired)
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg, slightly beaten
paprika
1/3  c. chopped onion or 4 tsp. instant minced onion
1 (8 oz.)  can cut green beans, drained
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1 (8 oz.)  can crescent rolls
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  In a large frypan, brown ground beef, onion and green pepper; drain fat.  Stir in tomato sauce, beans, cumin seed, garlic salt and salt; simmer while preparing crust.

name: GINGER APRICOT MUFFINS(This Is A Low-Cholesterol Recipe)
ingredients:
2  c. white four
2  c. whole wheat flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  Tbsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. poppy seed
1  Tbsp. ground, fresh ginger root
4  egg whites
1 1/2  c. canola oil
2  c. buttermilk
1/2  Tbsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
2  c. dried apricots, diced
preparation: Sift together the flours, salt, baking soda and baking powder. Combine the ginger, egg whites, canola oil, buttermilk, vanilla, brown sugar, poppy seed and cinnamon.  Stir in the flour mix and the diced apricots until well blended. Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes in muffin tins.  Batter may be made in advance and refrigerated.  Makes 2 dozen muffins.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  can tomatoes, crushed
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. oregano
3  garlic cloves, chopped
1  bay leaf
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato sauce
4  cans water (use sauce cans)
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a 3-quart saucepan.  Cook over medium heat 10 minutes.  Add tomato sauce and water.  Cook 1 hour or until thickened.  Serve with spaghetti and meat balls.

name: TACO SHELLS(Soft)
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. water
1  c. flour
1/2  c. yellow cornmeal
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
preparation: Mix well.  Cook on medium or medium-hot heat on stove burner. Use an iron skillet.  Use no oil or grease on pan.  Ladle mix onto pan and smooth down into thin, flat pancake shape, 8 or 9-inches in diameter.  Flip once.  Throw first shell away, as it will be the one to clean out the surface of the pan.

name: SMOTHERED CHICKEN
ingredients:
boneless breast of chicken
onion
butter
potatoes
salt
pepper
preparation: Cut aluminum foil into 12-inch squares for each piece of boneless chicken.  Spray aluminum foil with Pam.  Place a piece of chicken on each piece of aluminum foil.  Slice potatoes and onion over each piece of chicken.  Put 1 tablespoon butter on each and sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Fold aluminum foil over the chicken.  Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL PIE
ingredients:
1  can fruit cocktail
1  (8 oz.) container whipped cream
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/4  c. chopped nuts
2  graham cracker crusts
preparation: Drain fruit cocktail.  Mix whipped cream, Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice and add fruit cocktail and pecans.  Mix well.  Pour into 2 graham cracker crusts.  Chill until set, about 1 hour.

name: SPECIAL K DELIGHTS
ingredients:
4  c. Special K cereal (may substitute Rice Krispies)
2/3  c. peanut butter (plain or crunchy)
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch morsels
preparation: Melt butterscotch morsels over low heat.  Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and Special K.  Stir until cereal is completely covered.  Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper and let cool.

name: HOT POTATO FRY BALLS
ingredients:
1  small onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  lb. ground beef
3  small fresh hot red chiles such as Serranos or jalapenos, stems removed and minced
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
6  shallots or green onions, chopped
3  c. cooked, mashed potatoes
2  eggs, separated
vegetable oil for frying
preparation: Saute onion and garlic in the butter until golden brown.  Add the beef, chili and nutmeg and toss over a heat until the meat browns well.  Stir in shallots and cook three more minutes. Combine with the potatoes and add the egg yolks.  Beat until well combined.  Cool and refrigerate for 30 minutes.  Roll into balls the size of an egg.  Beat egg whites until just frothy.  Dip balls into egg whites.  Deep fry in 350° to 375° oil until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper.  Yield:  6 to 8.

name: CHICKEN STIR FRY
ingredients:
1  lb. skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into strips
1  c. broccoli flowerette
1  c. carrots, cut into matchstick thin strips
1/2  c. onion, cut into wedges
1  can cream of broccoli soup
2/3  c. water
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
4  c. hot cooked rice with parsley
preparation: In a skillet spayed with cooking spray, stir fry chicken, half at a time.  Remove.  Repeat with remaining chicken.  Remove skillet from heat, spray with cooking spray.  Stir fry vegetables until crisp-tender.  Add soup, water, soy, ginger and stir-fried chicken.  Heat thoroughly.  Serve over rice.

name: OLIVE CHEESE BALLS(Serves 36)
ingredients:
2  c. shredded sharp natural Cheddar cheese (8 oz.)
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. margarine, melted
36  small olives
preparation: Mix cheese and flour; mix in melted margarine; mold 1 teaspoon of this dough around each olive and shape into a ball.  Place 2-inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet; cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.  Bake in 400° preheated oven until set (approximately 15 to 20 minutes).

name: VANILLA WAFER CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
2  c. sugar (granulated)
6  eggs
1/2  c. sweet milk
1  can coconut
1  c. pecans
1 (12 oz.)  box vanilla wafers, crushed
preparation: Cream the sugar and butter until smooth.  Add eggs one at a time.  Beat well after each.  Add crumbs and mix.  Add milk and beat until smooth.  Add coconut and nuts and blend together. Grease and flour a tube or loaf pan.  Bake at 275° for 1 or 1 1/2 hours.

name: TEMPTATIONS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. flour
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
Reese's peanut butter cups
preparation: Cream margarine, white sugar, brown sugar, peanut butter, egg and vanilla.  Add flour, baking soda and salt.  Make into ball that is small enough to fit into tea cupcake tin.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.  They should be golden brown and will not look done, but they are.

name: TORTILLA ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
about 1/2 c. mayonnaise
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Cheddarella (or 4 oz. each shredded Cheddar and Mozzarella cheeses)
1  envelope Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing mix
3  or 4 green onions, chopped fine
1/2  green pepper, chopped fine
1  pkg. (8-inch) flour tortillas
preparation: Mix softened cream cheese with remaining ingredients, except tortillas.  Spread cheese mixture on tortillas (thin layer).  Roll up like jelly rolls.  Chill for 1 hour for easier slicing. Slice into 1 inch pieces.  Secure with toothpicks.  Can be eaten plain or dipped in salsa sauce.

name: CABBAGE SALAD
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage
1  small onion
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Cut up cabbage with knife.  Grate small onion on top of cabbage.  Sprinkle sugar over cabbage and onions.  Pour sauce over cabbage mixture.  Refrigerate at least 4 hours.  Toss lightly just before serving.

name: SOUR CREAM COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  butter recipe cake mix
2  small containers sour cream
2  c. sugar
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. frozen coconut
preparation: Mix coconut, sugar and sour cream.  Store in refrigerator 24 hours or more.  Stir once or twice.  Bake cake.  Make 3 thin layers.  Spread coconut mixture on cake layers.  Finish by spreading coconut mixture on top and sides of cake.  Store cake in refrigerator.

name: BANANA BREAD OR PEACH BREAD
ingredients:
3  medium very ripe bananas (can substitute 1 c. smashed peaches; fresh very ripe and peeled)
1  c. sugar
dash of salt
1  egg
1/4  c. oil or margarine
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Put together in order listed. Bake in slow oven at 300° for 45 minutes in a greased and papered loaf pan.

name: 24 HOUR VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1  head cauliflower
1  medium onion
1  lb. bacon, fried crisp
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Break up lettuce.  Slice onion.  Break up bacon and cauliflower.  Put all ingredients in layers in large, covered bowl. Mix together mayonnaise, sugar and Parmesan cheese.  Put this mixture over top of vegetables.  Set overnight in refrigerator. Mix well before serving.

name: MIRACULOUS MICROWAVE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. cocoa
3/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  egg
2/3  c. water
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. plus  2 Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cut out a circle of wax paper to fit bottom of 8-inch round plastic or glass pan, 1 1/2-inch deep. (I use square pan.) Cut another to make a collar to line sides to come up 1-inch higher.

name: MEDITERRANEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. green pepper
1  lb. ground beef
1  can tomato soup
1/2  c. catsup
1  tsp. salt
3  oz. pkg. cream cheese (room temperature)
1/3  c. milk
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
6  oz. noodles, cooked, rinsed, and well drained
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown beef in butter; add onion and green pepper and cook lightly.  Blend in tomato soup, catsup, salt and pepper.  Cook, uncovered, about 8 minutes.  Stir several times.  Blend cream cheese, milk, lemon juice, garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce; mix with noodles.  Spread in a buttered glass baking dish.  Pour meat sauce over top; sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SEVEN MINUTE FROSTING
ingredients:
2  egg whites
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine egg whites, syrup, sugar and salt in upper part of double boiler.  Beat with rotary beater until partially mixed. Set pan over rapidly boiling water.  Cook 7 minutes, beating constantly, with a rotary beater until frosting stand in peaks. Remove pan from hot water.  Add flavoring.  Beat into mix well. Makes enough to cover top and sides of 2 round 8 or 9-inch layers.

name: OLIE BOLLEN(Dutch Doughnuts)
ingredients:
1  pkg. active dry yeast
1/2  tsp. sugar
3/4  c. warm milk
2  c. sifted flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. diced apples, pared
3  Tbsp. chopped candied fruit (optional)
1  tsp. grated lemon peel
cooking oil
confectioners sugar
preparation: Sprinkle yeast and 1/2 teaspoons sugar on milk; stir to dissolve.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Sift together flour, 2 tablespoons sugar and salt into bowl.  Make a well in the center. Add yeast and eggs; mix just until blended.  Stir in raisins, apple, candied fruit and lemon peel.  Cover and let rise in warm place until double, about 1 hour.  Drop batter by heaping tablespoonfuls into deep hot oil (350°), frying until golden brown, about 3 minutes.  Drain on paper.  Roll in confectioners sugar.  Yield: approximately 15.

name: MICROWAVE PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. raw shelled peanuts (leave skins on)
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole, stir together peanuts, sugar, syrup and salt.  Cook 8 minutes on High in microwave oven, stirring well after 4 minutes.  Stir in butter and vanilla. Microwave 2 minutes longer on High; add baking soda and stir quickly until light and foamy.  Immediately pour onto lightly greased baking sheet; spread out very thin.  When cool, break into small pieces.  Store in airtight container.  Makes 1 pound.

name: SUE'S GUACAMOLE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mashed avocados (2 avocados)
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. chili powder
1/3  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Combine all ingredients and serve with tortilla chips. Optional:  crumbled bacon and/or tomato bits.

name: BLACK BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3  c. cooked black beans (or two 15 1/2 oz. cans)
1  red bell pepper, cored, seeded and cut in 1/4-inch dice
3  green onions (white bulbs and 3 inches green), cut in 1/4-inch rounds
2  ripe plum tomatoes, seeded and cut into 1/4-inch dice
6  Tbsp. extra virgin oil
3  Tbsp. chopped cilantro or coriander
1  tsp. coarse black pepper
3/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and toss gently.  Let salad rest, loosely covered, at room temperature for at least 1 hour before serving.  You may want to double this recipe.  It goes in a hurry.  Makes 6 servings.

name: RUM CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1 (3 3/4 oz.)  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
4  eggs
1/2  c. rum (light)
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients  2  minutes.  Grease a Bundt pan. Spread 10  nuts  on  bottom of pan.  Decorate with maraschino cherries on top of nuts.  Pour batter in pan and bake at 350° for 55 minutes.

name: SNOW-TOP CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
4  sq. unsweetened chocolate
3  beaten eggs
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. flour
2/3  c. sifted powdered sugar
preparation: Melt chocolate and shortening in a small saucepan over low heat.  Stir until melted.  Cool 15 minutes.  Combine eggs, sugar, baking powder, vanilla and salt in large bowl.  Stir in chocolate mixture.  Gradually add flour, stirring until completely mixed. Cover; chill 2 hours or until easy to handle.  Shape dough into 1-inch balls.  Roll in powdered sugar to coat generously.  Place 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake approximately 10 minutes or until edges are just set.  Transfer to rack to cool. Makes 60.

name: PIE CRUST
ingredients:
5  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. shortening
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3  tsp. sugar
2  egg yolks
2  tsp. vinegar (optional)
preparation: Mix until consistency of corn meal.  Slightly beat 2 egg yolks and almost finish filling a 1 cup measure with ice water.  Add 2 teaspoons vinegar, if desired.  This dough handles well and freezes well.  Makes 5 pie crusts.

name: MOTHER'S JELLY PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  eggs, separated
2  Tbsp. good jelly
1/4  c. milk
8-inch unbaked pie shell
preparation: Combine sugar, margarine, egg yolks, jelly and milk.  Beat egg whites and fold into mixture.  Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake in 325° oven until firm.

name: TUNA QUICHE
ingredients:
1  deep dish pie crust
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can tuna fish, drained
1 1/2  c. Swiss cheese, chopped or grated
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. evaporated milk
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. chives
3/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Bake pie crust at preheated 450° oven for 5 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Distribute tuna over the bottom of pastry shell. Sprinkle cheese and onion over tuna.  Beat eggs; add milk, lemon juice and seasonings.  Pour over tuna mixture.  Bake on cookie sheet 15 minutes.  Reduce heat to 350° and bake 12 to 15 minutes or until top is golden.  Remove from oven and let set a few minutes before cutting.

name: ECLAIR DESSERT
ingredients:
1 large  box instant vanilla pudding
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  c. water
1  c. flour
1  cube margarine
4  whole eggs
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1 small  can chocolate syrup
preparation: Prepare pudding as directed; set aside to set.  Soften cream cheese.  Mix with pudding.  (Mixture will be lumpy.) Set aside. Boil water; add butter and bring to boil (simmer).  Add flour; mix well.  Take off heat.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Beat each well. Pour mixture into greased 10 x 15 1/2-inch jelly roll pan (don't flour).  Bake for 20 minutes at 425° or until golden brown. Mixture will puff up.  Let cool; mash with hand.  Spread pudding mixture on top.  Spread Cool Whip on top.  Drizzle chocolate syrup; chill until set.

name: CRISPY FRIED OKRA
ingredients:
1 3/4  lb. fresh okra
1 1/2  c. yellow cornmeal
salt and pepper
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  egg, lightly beaten
cooking spray
preparation: Combine cornmeal, salt and pepper.  Dredge okra in cornmeal mix.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Mix with egg and buttermilk.  Bake on cookie sheet at 450° for 40 minutes or until crisp.

name: BROCCOLI MOUSSE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
2  hard-boiled eggs
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. Tabasco sauce
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
2  pkg. clear gelatin
1/2  c. cold water
1  can beef consomme
preparation: Mix the gelatin in cold water; add then to hot consomme soup. Dissolve gelatin in hot soup and set aside.

name: HOMINY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  onion, chopped
1  medium bell pepper, chopped
1/2  lb. mushrooms, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
1 small  can ripe olives, chopped
1  stick butter
1 small  jar pimentos
1 large  can and 1 small can hominy (3 c.)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz with jalapenos
preparation: Saute  onions,	bell  pepper,  mushrooms  and celery in butter.  Add  olives,  pimentos, mushroom soup, Cheez Whiz and hominy.  Put  in a 2 quart casserole dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

name: VICKI'S BREAKFAST
ingredients:
8  slices white bread, cubed
3/4  c. grated cheese (1/2 Cheddar, 1/2 Swiss)
1  lb. sausage or ham
1  c. fresh mushrooms
2  c. milk
5  eggs
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
3/4  Tbsp. mustard
2  green onions, chopped
preparation: Brown sausage; drain. Grease 9 x 12-inch pan. Put bread cubes on bottom. Add meat. Pour other ingredients on top.  Top with onions. Refrigerate overnight (very important).  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Do not overbake.

name: CHICKEN - N - DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
4  chicken breast
2  c biscuits
salt and pepper to taste
3  Tbsp chives
preparation: Boil chicken until tender. Add seasonings. Tear off pieces of the biscuits and drop them into the pot. Cook until dumplings are done.

name: BLUEBERRY TEA CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. Sugar
1/4  c. Shortening
1  Egg
2  c. Blueberries
1/2  c. Milk
2  c. Gold Medal Flour (sifted)
2  tsp. Baking Powder
1/2  tsp. Salt
preparation: Mix ingredients as usual for a cake, but blend 2 c. Flour mixed with Blueberries in last.

name: CROCK POT CHICKEN AND DRESSING
ingredients:
5  chicken breasts or 1 chicken (cooked, chopped, deboned)
4  eggs slightly beaten
1  medium onion, chopped
1  tsp. salt and pepper
1  can cream of celery soup
8  inch pan of cooked and crumbled cornbread
8  slices of white bread, torn into pieces
1  tsp. poultry seasoning
1  tsp. ground sage
1  can cream of chicken soup
2 14 1/2  oz. cans of chicken broth or 28 oz. of chicken broth from cooking your chicken
preparation: May need to add 1/2 to 3/4 c. more broth as needed.

name: WHEAT AND LAMB MEAT
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lamb meat and bones
3  large onions, sliced
2  Tbsp. Crisco
1  can chickpeas or garbanzo beans (hoomos)
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. coarse cracked wheat (burghul)
preparation: Cover meat and bones with water 4 to 5 inches above.  Add a little salt; bring to a boil.  Remove foam and cook until meat is tender.  Fry the onions in Crisco until transparent.  Add onions, spices, salt and chickpeas to meat and cook on low for 15 minutes. Remove 2 cups of broth with some onions and chickpeas to a small pan and save for sauce topping.  Wash cracked wheat, drain and add to meat and broth.  Broth should be about 1 inch above wheat. Cover and bring to a boil; boil briskly until water is level with wheat.  Lower heat and simmer until liquid is absorbed and wheat is done.  More broth can be added if needed.  Before completely dry, check for salt.  When done and dry, stir wheat to mix with meat and bones.  Serve on a deep platter.  Add some of the hot reserved broth with onions and chickpeas on top.  Serve with yoghurt.

name: CARROT KUGEL *
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. flour
3/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves
3/4  c. oil (canola)
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  egg whites
1  Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  c. grated carrots (about 4 medium size carrots)
preparation: Stir together all dry ingredients except sugar.  Beat the oil, brown sugar and egg whites.  Stir in the flour mixture.  Stir in the water, lemon juice and grated carrots.  Bake at 350° in greased 8-inch baking dish or in ring mold for 45 minutes.  Can be frozen after baked and cooled.

name: POLISH HAMBURGERS
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburg
1  c. flavored bread crumbs
1  small onion
2  eggs
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix together ingredients well in large bowl.  Shape into hamburgers; fry in large skillet on medium flame, for 8 to 10 minutes.  Makes 6 to 8 burgers.

name: MEXICAN MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef or beef and pork mixture
1  egg, beaten
1/3  c. dry bread crumbs
1 1/2  c. mild taco salsa
preparation: Combine meat, egg, bread crumbs and 1 cup salsa.  Pat into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake in preheated 400° oven for 45 minutes.  Spoon remaining salsa over loaf.  Continue baking for 15 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: 5 CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 small  can cubed pineapple, drained
1  c. sour cream
1  c. coconut
1  c. marshmallows
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and let set overnight.  It keeps well.

name: SALMON CROQUETTES
ingredients:
1  can pink salmon, drained
1  large onion, chopped
2  eggs
1/2  Tbsp. Season-All
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. Accent
3  Tbsp. Crisco
preparation: Combine salmon, onion, eggs, seasoning, flour and Accent in large mixing bowl; blend well.  Shape into patties.  Place Crisco into large skillet on medium heat.  Place patties in hot oil and fry 3 minutes on each side.  Remove from heat; drain and cool. Yields 8 croquettes.

name: FROZEN CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1  (16 oz.) crushed pineapple plus juice
1  can whole cranberry sauce
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except Cool Whip.  Fold in Cool Whip. Freeze in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cut in squares.

name: MEATBALLS AND GRAVY
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
2  Tbsp. dried onions
1  can cream of mushroom soup
3/4  can milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Blend together meat, onions, salt and pepper.  Shape into balls and cook in skillet until meat is cooked thoroughly. Combine soup and milk and pour over meatballs and bring to boil. Serve.

name: SCRAMBLED EGGS(Huevos Revueltos)
ingredients:
5  beaten eggs
2  Tbsp. shortening
1/2  c. tomato sauce
1  small onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
green chiles, chopped (to taste)
salt and pepper
preparation: Saute onion, garlic and chiles in tomato sauce.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Simmer for 4 minutes.  Add eggs.  Stir.  Serve immediately.

name: DELUXE GINGERBREAD(Serves 9)
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  egg
3/4  c. molasses
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar together.  Blend in egg and molasses.  Stir in dry ingredients sifted together alternately with buttermilk.  Pour in a greased and floured 9 x 3-inch square pan.  Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.  Serve warm.

name: BROCCOLI-RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can either soup
1/4  c. melted butter
1/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. instant rice
dash of salt and pepper
3  Tbsp. diced onion
2  stalks celery, diced
2  pkg. chopped frozen broccoli or 1 each broccoli and cauliflower
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Grease casserole pan or dish.  Mix together and stir first 10 ingredients, add Velveeta cheese and put in pan.  Top with 1/2 pound Velveeta cheese.  Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour; uncover and bake 1/2 to 1 hour.

name: SWEET AND SOUR MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  jar grape jam
1 (12 oz.)  jar chili sauce
2  lb. ground chuck
preparation: Mix grape jam and chili sauce in large heavy pan.  Roll meat into  very  small  meatballs.  Cook  in sauce for 1 hour. Serve hot over rice or serve with toothpicks for party.

name: FRIED GREEN TOMATOES
ingredients:
1  large egg lightly beaten
1/2  c buttermilk
1/2  c all purpose flour-divided
1/2  c cornmeal
1  tsp salt
1/2  tsp black pepper
3  medium sized green tomatoes-cut into 1/3 inch slices
vegetable oil
salt & pepper to taste
preparation: Combine egg and buttermilk, set aside.  Combine 1/4 c flour, cornmeal, 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper in a shallow bowl or pan.  Dredge tomato slices in remaining 1/4 c flour, dip in egg mixture, then dredge in corn meal mixture.

name: COCKTAIL MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
1/3  c. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  egg
1/4  c. shortening
1 (12 oz.)  bottle chili sauce
1 (10 oz.)  jar grape jelly
preparation: Mix ground beef, bread crumbs, onion, milk, salt Worcestershire sauce, pepper and egg.  Shape into 1-inch balls. Cook meatballs in shortening in 12-inch skillet until brown. Remove meatballs from skillet; drain fat.  Heat chili sauce and jelly in skillet, stirring constantly, until jelly is melted.  Add meatballs; stir until coated.  Simmer uncovered 30 minutes.  Serve hot.  Makes 5 dozen.

name: LIMA BEAN AND BEEF BALL CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 or 2  boxes frozen Fordhook limas
1/4  c. milk
1  slice bread
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  egg
1  clove garlic, grated
1  lb. ground lean beef
4  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. water
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Soak bread in milk.  In another bowl mix 1 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon pepper, egg and garlic.  Squeeze excess milk out of bread.  Add egg mixture and beef.  Stir lightly with a fork. Pinch off balls (size of walnut).  Handle lightly.   Brown on all sides in 1 tablespoon of margarine.

name: JOANNE'S JAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. clove
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
1  jar blackberry jam
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar together.  Add eggs, flour, soda, baking powder, cinnamon, clove, nutmeg and salt, then add alternately 1 cup buttermilk and 1 jar blackberry jam.

name: PORK 'N CRESCENT PASTIES(Easy, Fast And Great)
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. margarine
2  c. diced, cooked pork
3/4  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. salt
8  oz. can (1 c.) applesauce
2  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
2 (8 oz.)  cans Pillsbury refrigerated crescent rolls
1  egg, slightly beaten
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  In large skillet, cook green pepper and onion in margarine until tender.  Stir in pork, ginger, salt, applesauce and mustard; set aside.  Separate dough into 8 rectangles.  Firmly press perforations to seal.  Spoon about 1/3 cup meat mixture on one end of each rectangle.  Fold dough in half over filling.  Press edges to seal.  Brush each with egg.

name: TEXAS POTATOES
ingredients:
1 16  oz. bag frozen hash browns
1/4  c. diced onion
8  oz. sour cream
1/2  c. butter, melted
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  c. shredded cheddar cheese
1/2  c. butter
2  c. crushed cornflakes
preparation: Put potatoes and onions into a greased 9x13 pan.  Mix sour cream, butter, and soup and spread over potatoes.  Sprinkle with cheese on top.  Melt 1 stick butter and mix with crushed cornflakes.  Put on top of casserole and bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter or margarine
4  c. thinly sliced onions
4 (10 1/2 oz.)  cans condensed beef broth, undiluted
4 to 6  slices French bread (1-inch thick)
1/4  c. grated Gruyere cheese
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: You may use any cheese of your taste.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. diced zucchini
2  c. peeled tomatoes or 1 can tomatoes, cut up
2  ribs celery, chopped
1  large onion
1  egg
small amount cracker crumbs
butter
garlic salt
sage
nutmeg
salt
pepper to taste
preparation: Cook the vegetables for 15 minutes.  Strain, then add the remaining ingredients.  Pour into casserole and place pieces of cheese throughout.  Add paprika to top and bake for 20 minutes. Delicious.

name: QUICK PASTA DISH
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  c. half and half
3/4  c. brown gravy
1  tsp. oregano
salt and pepper
1  c. Cheddar cheese
1  lb. hamburger
3/4  c. spaghetti sauce
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. rosemary
3/4  lb. pasta
preparation: Cook noodles.  Brown meat.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix. Top with cheese.  Bake at 350°  for 25 minutes.

name: PIZZA PIE
ingredients:
1/2  pkg. dry yeast
1  c. scalded milk
1  Tbsp. shortening
2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. hamburger
1  medium onion
1  c. ketchup
1/2  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
Worcestershire sauce to taste
Kitchen Bouquet to taste
preparation: Soften yeast in 2 teaspoons warm water.  Mix the first 6 ingredients.  Place in greased bowl and let rise until doubled in bulk (1/2 hour).  Simmer remaining ingredients until dough is ready.  Add 2 cups fairly thick tomato gravy.  Roll out dough 1/4-inch thick.  Let rise 15 minutes.  Pour on the sauce and sprinkle with grated cheese.  Bake at 400°.

name: SUGAR FREE PUNCH
ingredients:
1- 16  oz. can frozen orange juice
20  oz. unsweetened grapefruit juice
32  oz. unsweetened pineapple juice
2- 2 litre  bottles diet lemon-lime soda or ginger ale
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Chill before using or may serve over ice.  Makes 30 -35 servings.

name: ASPARAGUS GRAVY
ingredients:
8-10 spears fresh asparagus
Bacon drippings
1  recipe Cream Gravy listed above this recipe
preparation: Wash, drain, and cut asparagus on bias.  Simmer asparagus in small amount of water until fork tender and then sauté in bacon drippings.  Proceed with directions for cream gravy.  As far as I know this family favorite was created in Paris, Texas by someones Great-Uncle Billy over 70 years ago.  Serve for breakfast on biscuits.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  slices bread, buttered and cubed
2  c. cooked ham
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
5  eggs, beaten
2  c. canned evaporated milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
1 small  can mushrooms
preparation: Grease a 9 x 13-inch casserole.  Layer bread cubes, meat and cheese.  Mix beaten egg, milk, salt and dry mustard.  Pour over ingredients in casserole.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  In morning, add mushrooms,  cover and bake at 350°  for 45 minutes. Uncover for last 10 minutes to let top brown.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
salt to taste
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  can tomato sauce
1  can diced tomatoes
1  can chili beans
preparation: Brown hamburger; add ingredients.  Simmer.

name: OVEN OMELET
ingredients:
12  slices bacon
6  slices cheese
8  eggs, beaten
1  c. milk
preparation: Fry bacon and drain well. Chop half of bacon and leave half in strips. Butter bottom of 8-inch cake or pie pan. Arrange cheese in bottom of pan. Beat eggs and milk. Add chopped bacon. Pour over cheese. Top with remaining bacon strips. Bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven.

name: GROUPER CHOWDER
ingredients:
1  lb. frozen grouper bits, thaw almost completely
2  cans cream of potato soup
3  c. milk
1/2  c. potato flakes
4  Tbsp. butter
1/3  c. celery, chopped fine
1/2  tsp. minced onion flakes
seasonings:  parsley flakes and dried chives
1 (8 oz.)  can cream-style corn (optional)
preparation: Gently heat milk with cans of soup.  Add grouper bits and cook 10 minutes.  Add potato flakes and other ingredients.  Continue cooking gently another 8 minutes.  Chill.  At serving time, heat portions in individual bowls in the microwave oven.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. cooked squash, chopped
1  stick butter
1  grated onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  jar pimentos
1/2 (4 oz.)  pkg. seasoned croutons
2  grated carrots
1/2  pt. sour cream
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Add cooked squash with remaining ingredients and place in casserole dish.  Sprinkle croutons on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

name: HAM QUICHE
ingredients:
2  c. biscuit mix
1/2  c. cold water
1  c. finely chopped cooked ham
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies, drained
1/2  c. sliced black olives
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. sour cream
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1/2  c. sliced green onions
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Grease a 12-inch pizza pan.  Combine biscuit mix and water; mix until soft dough forms.  Knead on floured board until it can be handled.  Press into pan.  Spread ham, green chilies and olives over crust.  Mix eggs, sour cream, cheese, onions, salt and pepper.  Pour over ham.  Bake for 25 minutes or until set.  Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: HARDEE'S BISCUITS
ingredients:
1/4  c. warm water
2  tsp. sugar
1  pkg. yeast
5  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. soda
2  c. buttermilk
1  c. Crisco
preparation: Mix water, sugar and yeast and let stand while mixing other ingredients.  Mix together flour, soda, buttermilk and Crisco. When mixed well, add yeast mixture.  Roll out biscuits and bake at 400°.  Put in covered container and take out as needed.

name: SPINACH MANICOTTI
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. butter
1  lb. Ricotta or cottage cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. salt
12  large manicotti noodles, cooked and drained
1  garlic clove, minced
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, cooked and drained well
4  oz. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
3  beaten eggs
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
dash of pepper
2  c. spaghetti sauce
preparation: Saute onion and garlic until tender.  Combine all ingredients except noodles and sauce.  Fill noodles with spinach mixture. Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Cover.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Heat sauce.  Pour over noodles.  Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese, if desired.

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
1  qt. orange juice
1  qt. orange sherbet
1  qt. vanilla ice cream
1  qt. cold ginger ale
preparation: Beat orange juice, sherbet and ice cream with rotary beater until well mixed.  Add ginger ale.  Stir well.  Serves 30.

name: VENISON PATTIES WITH GRAVY
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. venison or ground beef
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. black pepper
1  medium onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Mix together all ingredients, except soup.   Make into thick patties.   Arrange in skillet and cook until done.  In mixing bowl, add soup and 1 can water and whip together.     Pour over patties in skillet and simmer for about 20 minutes.   Gravy will turn light brown in color.

name: FUDGE PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
3  Tbsp. baking cocoa
3/4  c. hot water
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (5 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1  c. pecan halves
1  unbaked 9-inch pie shell
1  c. whipped topping
preparation: Melt butter with cocoa in saucepan.  Add hot water and mix well.  Add sugar, flour, salt, vanilla and milk.  Mix until smooth.  Stir in pecans.  Pour into pie shell.  Place on preheated baking sheet and bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until set.  Top with whipped topping.  Serves 6.

name: WIENER SCHNITZEL
ingredients:
6  boneless pork cutlets
1  Tbsp. Chef's salt*
1  c. flour
2 large eggs, beaten with 4  Tbsp. cold water
2  c. Italian style bread crumbs
2  c. lard (for frying)
preparation: *Make this from 1 tablespoon salt, 1 teaspoon black pepper, 1/4 teaspoon paprika and 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt (not garlic powder).

name: NEW ENGLAND LOBSTER NEWBURG
ingredients:
1/4  c. New York sherry wine
1/3  c. flour
1  Tbsp. salt
4  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. dry mustard
pinch of cayenne (red pepper)
1 1/2  c. light cream
4  oz. canned mushrooms
1  box Ritz crackers
3 (1 lb.) lobsters or 1 1/2  lb. medium shrimp
1 1/2  lb. medium scallops
preparation: Cook seafood.  Pour sherry over seafood and let sit.  Melt butter in pan.  Stir in flour (low heat), slowly.  Add salt, mustard, cayenne and mushrooms.  Add cream slowly.  Cook until thick.  Add to seafood and sherry. Cover with butter and crumbs. Cook at 375° in casserole pan 10 minutes. Serve over egg noodles or cook in puff pastry.

name: CHOCOLATE TURTLE CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
7  oz. pkg. caramels
1/4  c. evaporated milk
3/4  c. chopped pecans
1  (9-inch) chocolate crumb pie crust
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sour cream
1 1/4  c. milk
1  (3.9 oz.) chocolate instant pudding mix
1/2  c. fudge topping
preparation: Place caramels and evaporated milk in a heavy saucepan. Heat over medium-low heat, stirring continually, until smooth, about 5 minutes.  Stir in 1/2 cup pecans. Pour into pie crust.

name: SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
8  oz. spaghetti
2  Tbsp. melted butter
2  eggs, beaten
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
16  oz. jar spaghetti sauce with meat
1  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
preparation: Cook spaghetti.  Stir butter, eggs and Parmesan into hot spaghetti.  Use this mixture to shape a "crust" in 10-inch pie plate.  Spread cottage cheese over crust and cover with sauce. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and bake until cheese melts.  Slice and serve.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
2/3  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  Tbsp. milk
12  oz. whipped cream (Cool Whip)
graham cracker crust
preparation: Beat the cream cheese and powdered sugar together until smooth.  In separate bowl, mix the peanut butter and milk.   Mix the peanut butter with the cream cheese.  Add the whipped cream. Whip all together. Put in the graham cracker crust.  Chill 4 to 5 hours.  (You may use crunchy peanut butter.)

name: LEMON POPPY SEED BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix (no pudding mix kind)
1  pkg. instant lemon pudding
1/4  c. poppy seed
4  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1  c. hot water
preparation: Blend all ingredients.  Pour into two greased loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: HOT TACO DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
3  cans tomato soup
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine ingredients; add to a casserole dish.  Bake in oven at 325° for 45 minutes.  Serve with nacho chips.

name: CAKE MIX COOKIES
ingredients:
1  box of your favorite cake mix
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  eggs
Optional:  small amount of chopped nuts, raisins or chocolate chips
preparation: Mix all ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: HOT CRAB DIP
ingredients:
1/4  lb. butter
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
2  c. heavy cream
1  Tbsp. whole sweet basil
1  tsp. ground thyme
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. white pepper
1/2  lb. cream cheese
1  lb. lump crabmeat, cleaned of shell
preparation: In a 2 quart skillet, melt butter and add flour.  Whisk flour until completely blended.  Add heavy cream a little at a time, whisking constantly until blended.  Keep heat on high and continue to whisk until mixture thickens.  Add basil, thyme, salt and white pepper; whisk until blended.  Bring mixture to a medium boil and slowly add cream cheese a little at a time, whisking or stirring until blended.  If mixture is too thick, add a little milk until mixture is perfect for dipping.  Remove from heat; add crabmeat. Stir gently until completely blended.  Cover and allow to sit, off the stove, for 10 minutes.  Serve hot with crackers or with pastry shells.

name: BAKED BEANS(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  can regular pork and beans
1  can Trapies jalapeno pork and beans
5  slices bacon, cut up
2  Tbsp. mustard
1/4  c. ketchup
1  small chopped onion
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Place in baking dish.  Cook, uncovered, for 20 minutes.

name: SUPREME CHOCOLATE CREAM PIE FILLING
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. flour
5  Tbsp. cocoa
dash of salt
1  baked 9-inch pie shell
meringue (see recipe for Perfect Everytime Meringue)
4  egg yolks
2  c. evaporated milk
1/4  c. melted butter
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Combine all ingredients except vanilla and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture thickens.  Remove from heat and stir in vanilla.  Immediately spoon into pie shell and spread the meringue on hot pie filling.  Spread meringue to edge of pastry.  Bake at 325° for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.  To prevent meringue shrinkage, move to draft free place. Do not refrigerate.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIR CAKE
ingredients:
graham crackers
2 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. French vanilla pudding
3  c. milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
2  tsp. butter
2  c. confectioners sugar
4  Tbsp. boiling water
preparation: Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with graham crackers.  Then mix pudding and milk together.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Then pour over first layer of graham crackers.  Then layer with graham crackers. Melt chocolate and butter over boiling water, add sugar and water. Mix. Pour this over second layer of graham crackers.  Chill.

name: PORK CHOP AND POTATO DINNER
ingredients:
4  c. thinly sliced potatoes, peeled
1 small  can sliced mushrooms
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2/3  c. milk
1/2  small onion, finely chopped
4  pork chops
preparation: Mix soup, mushrooms, milk and onion in bowl; set aside.  Place sliced potatoes in nonstick casserole dish (or spray with Pam). Pour soup mixture over potatoes.  Trim fat and season pork chops. Brown only slightly in skillet and then place pork chops on top of potatoes and soup mixture.  Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: LEMON PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs, separated
1/3  cup lemon juice
1  teaspoon grated lemon rind
1  tablespoon melted butter
1  1/2 cups sugar
1/2  cup flour
1/2  teaspoon salt
1  1/2 cups milk
