preparation: Beat together egg yolk, lemon juice, lemon rind and butter until thick and lemon colored. Combine sugar, flour and salt. Add to the egg mixture alternately with milk, beat after each addition.

name: PUMPKIN GOBS
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
2  c. pumpkin
1  c. oil
2  eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Cream sugar, oil, eggs and pumpkin.  Add vanilla and dry ingredients.  Mix thoroughly and drop by tablespoons on a greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake mix
1 small  pkg. chocolate instant pudding mix
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. oil
2  c. shredded zucchini
preparation: Mix all together and bake at 350° until done.  Cream cheese frosting is good on this cake.

name: STUFFED POTATOES CACCIATORE
ingredients:
4  medium baking potatoes
1  medium zucchini, diced
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. water
2  c. cooked, chopped chicken
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (8 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
3/4  tsp. dried Italian seasonings
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Scrub potatoes.  Prick with fork.  Cook uncovered in microwave on 100% power, 13 to 16 minutes.  Let potatoes sit while making sauce.  Combine zucchini, onion, garlic and water in covered container.  Cook on High, 3 to 5 minutes or until tender.  Drain. Stir in chicken and both cans of tomatoes and Italian seasonings. Cook covered 5 to 7 minutes until heated through.  Split potatoes. Mash centers.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Spoon sauce on top, then sprinkle with cheese.  Return to microwave to melt cheese.

name: SEAFOOD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  slices white bread
3/4  c. water
1/2  c. bell pepper, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. onion
1  stick margarine
2  cans crabmeat (1 lb.)
1  lb. fresh or frozen shrimp (salad size)
1  can water chestnuts
1  egg
1/2  lb. sharp cheese
dash of Tabasco
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. potato chips, crushed
preparation: Break up the bread and soak in the water. Sauté celery, pepper and onion. Mix all remaining ingredients (except potato chips) with the celery, pepper and onion. Place in buttered casserole. Cover with crushed chips and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: NACHO POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
1 (5 1/4 oz.)  pkg. au gratin potatoes
1 (11 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (10 oz.)  can diced tomatoes and green chilies (undrained)
2  c. water
2  c. milk
2  c. cubed processed American cheese
dash of hot pepper sauce (optional)
minced fresh parsley (optional)
preparation: In a 3-quart saucepan combine the contents of the potato package, corn, tomatoes and water; mix well.  Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender.  Add milk, cheese and hot pepper sauce (if desired).  Cook and stir until the cheese is melted.  Garnish with parsley if desired.  Yield:  6 to 8 servings (2 quarts).

name: FILET DE BOUEF
ingredients:
4  (7 oz.) filet mignon, cut in half against the grain
1  c. red wine
1  shallot, chopped
1  c. liquid beef stock
1  c. shitake mushrooms, sliced (no stems)
10  Tbsp. unsalted butter
preparation: Heat heavy skillet over medium-high heat.  Add 2 tablespoons of butter to pan and then the filets.  Cook until medium rare; set aside in a warm place.  Add mushrooms and saute until limp.  Set aside and keep warm.

name: LITTLE SAUSAGES
ingredients:
1/3  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. mustard
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. vinegar
1 (8 oz.)  jar jellied cranberry sauce
3 to 4  pkg. fully cooked Smok-Y-Links
preparation: Mix all ingredients (except Smok-Y-Links) over medium heat in saucepan until well mixed.  Cut Smok-Y-Links into fourths.  Pour sauce and Smok-Y-Links into bowl.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Put in crock-pot on low until hot.  (Can use fondue pot on low.)

name: NAN'S DIVINITY
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
1  c. white corn syrup
3/4  c. water
3  egg whites, stiffly beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cook sugar, corn syrup and water over low heat until sugar is dissolved; then cook without stirring to 255° (hard-ball stage). Remove from heat and pour, beating constantly, in a fine stream into egg whites.  Continue beating until mixture holds its shape and loses its gloss. Add  vanilla and pecans.  Drop quickly from tip of teaspoon onto waxed paper.

name: STUFFED BELL PEPPERS
ingredients:
6  medium bell peppers
1  lb. ground beef
1/3  c. chopped onion
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  c. Minute rice (uncooked)
1/2  c. water
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. chili powder
4  oz. shredded Velveeta cheese
preparation: Cut off top of bell peppers; remove seeds.  Precook peppers in boiling, salted water for 5 minutes; drain.  (Omit precooking for crisper peppers.)  Sprinkle inside of peppers with salt.  Brown the ground beef and onion; drain well.  Add tomato sauce, rice, water, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, garlic and chili powder.  Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in cheese.  Stuff the peppers with this mixture.  Place in baking dish and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: HAPPY DAY CAKE(Great for Shortcake)
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
2 1/2  c. flour
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix butter and eggs together.   Add sugar, vanilla, salt and baking powder.  Blend.  Add the milk and flour alternately.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can Shoe Peg white corn
1 (16 oz.)  can French-style string beans
1 (16 oz.)  can tiny peas
3/4  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. red wine vinegar
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat 1/2 cup red wine vinegar along with 3/4 cup sugar.  Bring to a boil.  Add 1/2 cup oil, 1 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper.  Pour over well drained vegetables and refrigerate.  Keeps for days in the refrigerator.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. self-rising flour
preparation: Cream first 6 ingredients.  Work in flour.  Dough will be very stiff.  Shape into 24 small balls.  Place on cookie sheets (12 per sheet).  Press lightly with fork dipped in sugar.  Bake 10 to 13 minutes at 350°.  Cool before removing from pan.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Crisco
2  eggs
1  oz. red food coloring
1  oz. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. buttermilk
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Cream together shortening and sugar.  Add eggs, food coloring and water.  Mix cocoa with flour and salt.  Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk.  Mix well.  Add vanilla.  Pour vinegar over soda.  Stir into batter.  Bake at 325° in 2 (9-inch) cake pans for 30 minutes.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
3  cans refrigerated biscuits
1 1/2  sticks oleo
1  c. chopped pecans
3  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
preparation: Cut biscuits into quarters. Mix sugars and cinnamon together in a gallon Ziploc bag. Shake biscuit pieces in sugar mixture. Layer coated biscuits and chopped nuts in a Bundt pan. Melt butter and mix with remaining sugar mixture. Pour over biscuits. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: OLD TIMEY PICKLES
ingredients:
2  c. vinegar
1  c. water
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
spices, if desired
preparation: Wash small cucumbers.  Bring vinegar, water, sugar, salt and spices to rolling boil.  Drop cucumbers in boiling mixture until they change color.  Pack in jars and cover with boiling mixture. Seal.

name: CHILI RELLENO
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can green chiles
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese
1/2  lb. Monterey Jack cheese
2  to 3 eggs, separated
6 1/2  oz. evaporated milk
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper
8  oz. tomato sauce
preparation: Put 1/2 the chiles on the bottom of a greased casserole dish. Top with Cheddar cheese.  Add the rest of the chilies.  Top with Jack cheese.  Beat egg whites until stiff.  Combine egg yolks, evaporated milk, flour, salt and pepper.  Fold together with egg whites and pour over chiles and cheese.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.  Pour tomato sauce on top and bake another 30 minutes.

name: PINK CHAMPAGNE SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 (8 oz. or 10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
2  bananas, quartered and sliced
1  (9 oz.)  Cool Whip
1/3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream together cream cheese and sugar.  Add pineapple, strawberries, bananas, Cool Whip and nuts.  Add other ingredients to the cream cheese mixture.  Freeze.  Thaw 1/2 hour before serving.  Keeps weeks in freezer.  Serves 8 to 10.  Use loaf pan. Return to freezer after slicing off what is needed.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CANDY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1/2  stick butter or margarine
1 heaping  Tbsp. peanut butter
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients.  Place over medium heat and bring to a boil.  Cook until soft ball stage.  Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and 1 cup nuts, if desired.  Stir until it thickens. Pour into greased platter. Cool before cutting.

name: PORK CHOPS, ONION AND RICE
ingredients:
6  chops
2  tsp. oil
1  c. raw rice
1  envelope onion soup
4  oz. sliced mushrooms
2  tsp. pimento
preparation: Brown chops in oil.  Spread rice in bottom of dish (13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole).  Reserve 1 teaspoon onion soup.  Sprinkle remaining soup over rice.  Drain mushrooms; reserving liquid. Spread mushrooms and pimento over rice.  Add hot water to reserve mushroom liquid to equal 3 cups liquid and pour over rice.  Top with chops and reserved seasoning.  Cover lightly with foil and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Remove foil and cook 10 minutes longer.

name: HOT SPINACH DIP(Microwave)
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. minced green onion
2  Tbsp. milk
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can chunked ham, drained
1  c. sour cream
3/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Microwave cream cheese in casserole on High 30 seconds.  Add seasonings and milk and stir well.

name: BRAZILIAN RICE
ingredients:
1  c. raw rice
1  Tbsp. salad oil
garlic
1 (4 oz.)  can mushroom pieces and liquid
2  c. hot water
1 (1 1/4 oz.)  envelope onion soup mix
1 1/2  c. peeled and chopped tomatoes
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. oregano
preparation: Saute rice, garlic and mushrooms in oil until rice begins to brown.  Stir in hot water and onion soup.  Add tomatoes, salt and oregano.  Pour into casserole. Cover and bake for 35 minutes at 350°.

name: APPLE DESSERT PANCAKES
ingredients:
4  c. pared, thinly sliced apples (4 medium)
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  beaten eggs
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. Burnett's pure vanilla
3  Tbsp. Land O Lakes butter, melted
1/2  c. Pillsbury's Best all-purpose flour *
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  tsp. grated orange rind
1/3  c. orange juice
preparation: Combine apples with sugar and cinnamon in saucepan.  Cover; cook until apples are tender.  Combine in small mixing bowl, eggs, milk, vanilla and butter.  Stir in flour and salt.  Heat lightly greased skillet over medium-high heat.  Pour batter, 2 tablespoons at a time, into skillet.  Tilt pan to make a 6-inch round, thin pancake.  Brown about one minute; turn and brown on other side. Place about one tablespoonful apple mixture on each; roll up and place in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish.  Combine brown sugar, orange rind and orange juice.  Sprinkle over pancakes.  Broil 5 inches from heat, watching carefully, 2 to 5 minutes until golden brown and pancakes are hot.  Serve immediately with sour cream.  Makes 12 to 15 crepes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: CHERRY BARS
ingredients:
3/4  c. margarine
1  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. oatmeal
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add flour, oatmeal, baking soda and salt.  Mix well.  Press 1/2 of this crumb mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Spread pie filling on top. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture.   Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: PRUNE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. cooking oil
3  whole eggs
1  c. buttermilk
2  c. flour
pinch of salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. prunes
1/2  c. to 1 c. nuts
preparation: Beat sugar, cooking oil, eggs and buttermilk together.  Then add flour, salt, baking soda, allspice, nutmeg, cinnamon, vanilla, prunes and nuts.  Bake in loaf pan at 325° for about 40 minutes. As you take out of oven, pour glaze mixture over cake. (Pierce top of cake first, gently).

name: PEANUT BRITTLE(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1  c. raw peanuts
2  tsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Cook first 3 ingredients on High 4 minutes. Stir. Microwave 4 more minutes on High. Stir. Add butter and vanilla. Stir and microwave 1 1/2 minutes. Add soda and stir and pour on greased baking sheet.

name: CANDIED FRUIT SLICES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. powdered sugar
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  c. pecan halves
1/2  c. candied pineapple
1/2  c. green candied cherries
1  c. red candied cherries
preparation: Cream butter. Gradually add sugar and cream well. Blend in egg and vanilla. Add flour and blend well. Add pecans and fruit. Divide into 3 rolls. Chill. Slice and bake at 325° for 10 to 13 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. broccoli spears
1  small onion
1  stick margarine
1  can cream of celery soup or your choice
1  small Cheez Whiz
1/2 soup  can milk
Ritz crackers
1  c. rice
preparation: Cook rice with 1/2 stick margarine.  Saute onion with 1/2 stick margarine until clear.  Add can of soup and 1/2 can milk. Add small Cheez Whiz.  Keep on low heat.  Cook broccoli spears in salted water and drain.  Chop.  Spread layer of rice in casserole dish.  Spread some of cheese sauce, then broccoli alternately layering until all used.  Top with Ritz crackers.

name: QUAIL BREASTS WITH RICE
ingredients:
1/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. basil
1/8  tsp. pepper
8  quail breasts, skinned
1  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
1/3  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. instant chicken bouillon
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. butter
1 (10 oz.)  box frozen mixed vegetables, cooked and drained
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
1  c. water
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Shake flour, salt, basil and pepper in regular size oven cooking bag.  Shake breasts one at a time in flour mixture to coat evenly.  Remove and set aside.  Place bag with remaining flour mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Add mushrooms, onion, water, bouillon and Worcestershire sauce to bag.  Turn to mix and set aside.  Saute breasts in butter until brown.  Place on top of vegetables in bag.  Close bag with tie.  Make 6 one-half inch slits in top of bag.  Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until meat is done.  Combine hot rice and vegetables.  Press into small bowl. Unmold on serving platter and place breasts around rice.  Serve with sauce left in cooking bag.

name: OLD FASHIONED BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
3  c. soft bread crumbs
2  c. milk, scalded with 1/4 c. butter
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon and nutmeg
1/2  c. seedless raisins
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place crumbs in baking pan (1 1/2-quart).  Blend in remaining ingredients.  Bake 40 to 45 minutes.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1  can refried beans
1 small  carton cottage cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. taco seasoning
2  Tbsp. taco sauce
1/2  c. green onions, chopped
2  c. Monterey Jack, grated
2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Mix all ingredients well, but only use half of the shredded cheese.  Put in 12 x 8-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle the rest of the shredded cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Serve with tortilla chips or crackers.

name: NO EGG CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1/3  c. cocoa
1  c. water
1/2  c. cooking oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix first 7 ingredients together.  Add vanilla and vinegar last.  Bake in greased and floured 9 x 9-inch square pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: OLD FASHIONED CHERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
1  Tbsp. oleo
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  can tart cherries
pastry for 2-crust pie
preparation: Combine sugar and flour; mix thoroughly.  Add juice from cherries and cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thick and clear.  Add cherries, oleo and lemon juice. Let stand and make pastry.   Fill shell and top with remaining pastry.  Pierce the top and flute edges.  Bake at 450° for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° for 45 minutes or until done (top will be golden brown).

name: SPICY MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  egg
1  c. corn flake crumbs
2  Tbsp. tomato catsup
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. finely chopped onions
2/3  c. instant nonfat dry milk
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  lb. ground beef
preparation: Mix together and roll into small balls.  This will fill 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pour 1-quart prepared sauce (I prefer Ragu with mushrooms) and bake, covered, for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1/2  to 1 small head cabbage, grated
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. ReaLemon
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt (less, if desired)
1/2  tsp. whole celery seed (optional)
3 to 4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix dressing.  Pour over grated cabbage.  Mix well and refrigerate 1 hour.

name: ITALIAN CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2  c. sugar
2  c. cake flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts
5  egg whites, beaten stiffly
1/2  c. vegetable shortening
5  egg yolks
1  tsp. baking soda
1  can coconut
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Cream margarine and shortening.  Add sugar and beat mixture until smooth.  Add egg yolks; beat well.  Combine flour and soda. Add to mixture alternately with buttermilk.  Stir in vanilla.  Add coconut and nuts.  Fold in egg whites.  Pour into three 8-inch greased and floured cake pans.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until done.  Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

name: PECAN SANDIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo
5  Tbsp. powdered sugar
1  c. flour
1  c. broken pecans
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together the oleo and powdered sugar with hands. Add remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet. Bake in 350° oven. Don't let bottom brown. Roll in powdered sugar while hot and cool on wax paper.

name: POPCORN CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. vegetable oil
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. caramels (approximately 20)
10  c. popped popcorn
1/2  lb. peanuts
1/2  lb. M&M's candies
preparation: Melt together butter,  vegetable  oil,  marshmallows and caramels.   Mix  together  with  popcorn,  peanuts  and  M&M's. Grease Bundt pan well.  Pour mixture into Bundt pan and let sit for 1/2 hour.  Then remove from pan.

name: LEMON CLOVER ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. plain flour
3/4  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. shortening
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Combine dry ingredients; add shortening and mix well.  Combine milk and lemon juice and add to mixture.  Place on floured surface; knead slightly.  Form dough into balls.  Place on baking sheet.  Sprinkle with sugar.  Bake at 450° for 20 minutes.  Makes 12 rolls.

name: SPICY GROUND BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box Kraft Velveeta shells and cheese
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
2  cans green beans, drained
1  can diced tomatoes, drained
2  cans corn, drained
1  can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. chili powder
3  Tbsp. oregano
1  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Cook shells and cheese; set aside.  Brown ground beef and onion; drain.  In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer ground beef, corn, green beans and tomatoes.

name: CREAM CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese (soft)
2 (2.5 oz.)  pkg. dried beef
1  small onion, chopped
preparation: Cut beef into small squares, saving 3 slices.  Mix ingredients.  Once fully mixed, form into a ball and cover with 3 slices of the uncut beef.  Serve with crackers.

name: NO FRIED FRENCH FRIES
ingredients:
5 potatoes, sliced into  stick shapes or oval chip shapes (1/4-inch thick)
light oil spray
2  large egg whites
2 to 4  tsp. favorite spice (garlic, cajun, basil or oregano)
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Spray baking sheet.  Mix egg whites with spice.  Coat potatoes; place in baking sheet.  Bake 40 to 45 minutes until fries are crispy, turning every 8 to 10 minutes to brown them evenly.

name: GREEN PEPPER SANDWICHES
ingredients:
2  to 3 green peppers, chopped
1  onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
garlic salt to taste
mayonnaise
1  container cream cheese, softened
Pepperidge Farm bread
preparation: Mix peppers, onion, cream cheese and seasonings with enough mayonnaise to make spreadable.  Let mixture set for 30 minutes before making sandwiches.

name: WORLD'S BEST COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1  egg
1  c. salad oil
1  c. crushed cornflakes
1  c. regular oatmeal
1/2  c. flaked coconut
1/2  c. chopped nuts
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream margarine, sugars and egg.  Add oil and mix well.  Add oatmeal, cornflakes, coconut and nuts.  Sift flour, soda and salt together; add to mixture.  Add vanilla and mix well.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. chicken broth
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2 to 3  pkg. broccoli, cooked
7  to 8 chicken breasts, cooked and boned
paprika
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Arrange broccoli in the bottom of greased dish, adding pieces of chicken breasts on top.  Mix other ingredients together and pour over broccoli and chicken.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and paprika.  Bake at 375` for 1 hour or until lightly browned.

name: SWEDISH MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. paprika
3/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. butter, divided
1/4  c. flour
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can beef broth
1/2  c. water
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Combine first 8 ingredients; mix well.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Melt 1/4 cup of butter in a skillet.  Brown meatballs. Remove meatballs from skillet and drain well.  Melt remaining 1/4 cup of butter, add flour and stir.  Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.  Gradually stir in beef broth and water.  Cook, stirring constantly until thickened.  Add sour cream; reduce heat, stir well.  Add meatballs, heat thoroughly.  Serve over rice or noodles.

name: BUTTER-PECAN BREAD
ingredients:
1  egg
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. light brown sugar
2  Tbsp. melted butter
2 1/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. pecans
preparation: Beat egg and add sugar, butter and buttermilk.  Add to this mixture the sifted dry ingredients and the pecans.  Bake 1 big or 3 small (baked in medium size fruit cocktail cans).  Grease containers and dust with flour.  Fill 2/3 full.  Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes for small loaves, longer for large.

name: CALICO PICKLES
ingredients:
4  c. sliced cucumbers
2 1/4  c. sliced carrots
2  c. sliced celery
2  c. cubed onion
2  c. cubed red pepper
1  c. cubed green pepper
1  medium head cauliflower
1  c. salt
4  qt. cold water
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. mustard seed
2  Tbsp. celery seed
2  Tbsp. dried whole peppercorns
1  Tbsp. dried cilantro
6 1/2  c. vinegar
preparation: Combine vegetables in a large bowl.  Dissolve salt in water and pour over vegetables.  Soak for 15 to 18 hours in cool place. Drain.  In a large kettle, mix sugar, spices and vinegar.  Bring to a boil and boil for 3 to 4 minutes.  Add vegetables and simmer 5 to 7 minutes.  Pack hot into 8 hot pint jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace.  Remove air bubbles.  Adjust caps; process 15 minutes in boiling water bath.  Yield:  8 pints.  Very good and pretty to give as gifts.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE SALAD W/POPPY SEED DRESSING
ingredients:
romaine lettuce
spring mix
purple onion (in rings)
mandarin orange slices
large pecan pieces
goat cheese (opt)
preparation: Mix together torn lettuce and spring mix.  Garnish with thin slices of onion, mandarin orange slices, and pecan pieces.  You could add goat cheese if desired.  Toss with Poppy Seed Dressing.

name: BAKED PIGS TROTTERS(Porco al Forno)
ingredients:
6  whole pigs feet, halved
2  qt. salted water
1 1/2  c. chopped tomatoes
3  cloves garlic
1/4  c. chopped fresh parsley
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. olive oil
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Boil pigs feet  in  water for 25 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease a large baking pan and place cooked pigs feet onto pan, bone  side  down.  Sprinkle tomatoes and the rest of the ingredients on  top of pigs feet in the above order.  Bake for 40 to  50  minutes,  until skin looks browned and a little crispy. Serve immediately.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: STUFFED CABBAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
12  cabbage leaves
1  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. uncooked instant rice
1  medium onion, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. garlic salt
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. water
preparation: Cover cabbage leaves with boiling water.  Let stand until limp, about 10 minutes.  Remove and drain.  Mix ground beef, rice, onion, salt, pepper, garlic salt and 1/2 of the tomato sauce. Place about 1/3 cup of meat mixture at stem end of each leaf. Roll leaf around mixture, tucking in sides.  Place rolls, seam side down, in 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.  Mix remaining ingredients, pour over cabbage.   Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until ground beef is done.

name: BURRITOS
ingredients:
flour tortillas (heat briefly in microwave)
ground beef
French's Chili-O mix
1  can kidney beans
preparation: Brown ground beef.  Drain grease.  Add Chili-O mix and beans and mix.  Serve in tortillas, rolling them.  You can add onions, cheese, sour cream or anything you like before rolling.

name: BLACK BOTTOM WITCHES' PIE
ingredients:
18  chocolate wafers
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. melted butter or margarine
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate bits
1/2  c. heavy cream
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  pt. chocolate ice cream
1  qt. orange sherbet
preparation: Crush wafers; place in bowl.  Add sugar and butter.  Mix. Press into 9-inch pie plate.  Chill.

name: SIMPLE CRUMB CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. packed brown sugar
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter, softened
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. baking powder
Cool Whip
pecan halves for topping
preparation: Combine sugar, flour and salt.  Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal.  Remove 1 cup of mixture and combine with cinnamon and nuts.  Set aside.

name: SPARKLING SEA BREEZE PUNCH
ingredients:
2  c. chilled cranberry juice cocktail
1  c. chilled grapefruit juice
1  c. chilled vodka
juice of 1 lime
2  Tbsp. sugar (superfine)
1 (750 ml.)  bottle sparkling wine, chilled
preparation: In 2-quart pitcher, combine cranberry juice, grapefruit juice, vodka, lime juice and sugar. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Add wine. Stir briefly. Garnish with lime slices. Makes 16 (1/2 cup) servings.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. margarine
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
4  c. apples, pared and sliced
1  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Cream margarine, sugar and eggs.  Add flour, soda, salt and cinnamon.  Add apples and nuts.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour in 13 x 9-inch pan, two 8-inch rounds or Bundt pan.

name: FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  can tomato soup
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. oil
salt to taste
3  Tbsp. ground onion
1  c. white vinegar
1/2  c. horseradish mustard
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Mix well.  Makes 4 cups.

name: OLD-TIME BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. beef or venison, cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  clove garlic
1  medium onion, sliced
1  or 2 bay leaves
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. pepper
dash of ground allspice or cloves
6  carrots, pared and quartered
4  potatoes, pared and quartered
1  lb. small white onions
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
preparation: In Dutch oven, thoroughly brown meat in shortening, turning often (I roll meat cubes in flour first).  Add 2 cups of water and next 9 ingredients.  Cover, simmer for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally to keep from sticking.  Remove bay leaves and garlic. Add vegetables.  Cover and cook 30 to 45 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.  Slowly blend 1/3 cup cold water into the 3 tablespoons flour.  Stir slowly into hot stew mixture.  Cook and stir until bubbly.  Cook and stir 3 minutes longer.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: PESTO SHORTBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
8  oz. Parmesan cheese, shredded
3  garlic cloves, minced
1/2  c. pine nuts, finely chopped and toasted
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh basil
1/4  tsp. ground red pepper
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. whole pine nuts
preparation: Beat butter and Parmesan cheese at medium speed with an electric mixer until blended.  Add garlic and next 3 ingredients, beating just till blended.  Gradually stir in flour with a spoon (mixture will become crumbly); stir until mixture is blended and smooth, about 2 to 3 minutes.  Or instead of stirring the dough with a spoon after adding flour, you can gently press mixture with hands and work until blended and smooth.

name: STRING BEAN CREOLE
ingredients:
1  qt. canned string beans, drained
6  slices lean bacon
1/3  c. onion, chopped
3  Tbsp. butter
2  c. canned tomatoes
1/3  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. American cheese, shredded
1  c. bread crumbs (not spicy)
preparation: Drain beans; save 1/4 cup of liquid.  Cut bacon into small pieces; fry until almost crisp.  Add beans and reserved liquid to bacon; cook for 10 minutes.  Cook onion and green pepper in butter until tender.  Add tomatoes; cook until sauce is thick.  Season. Combine mixtures and pour into greased baking dish.  Sprinkle with cheese and crumbs.  Bake at 375° until cheese is melted and crumbs are brown.

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (46 oz.)  can unsweetened pineapple juice, chilled
2 (33.8 oz.)  bottles ginger ale, chilled
3  qt. sherbet (your choice), softened
preparation: Combine all ingredients in punch bowl.  Makes 5 1/2 quarts.

name: BRAZOS RIVER STEAMBOAT PIE
ingredients:
1  c. packed brown sugar
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. white corn syrup
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. pecan halves
preparation: Mix brown sugar, eggs, corn syrup, vanilla, margarine and salt.  Add pecans.  Pour into 9-inch unbaked pastry shell.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Serve with whipping cream or Cool Whip.

name: SQUASH PIE
ingredients:
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
3  c. squash, peeled and diced
4  large eggs
1  c. Bisquick
1/2   c. grated cheese
1/2  c. oil (Mazola)
1/2  onion, diced
1/2  tsp. parsley
preparation: Combine all ingredients in bowl.  Pour ingredients into Pyrex. Preheat oven to 350°.  Place Pyrex into oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

name: FROSTING AND FILLING FOR ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/3  c. lemon juice
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: A bought angel food cake is fine.  Slice cake into 3 layers. Put filling between layers and on top and sides.  Frozen strawberries can be used instead of pineapple.

name: TUNA PATTIES
ingredients:
1/3  c. milk
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
2  eggs, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. milk
2  c. Stove Top stuffing (in canister)
1 (6 oz.)  can tuna, drained
paprika
preparation: Combine 1/3 cup of milk, 1/3 cup soup and eggs.  Mix well. Add stuffing mix and tuna.  Mix lightly.  Shape into 4 to 8 patties. Heat margarine in large skillet.  Brown patties.

name: PUMPKIN CREAM PIE
ingredients:
2  c. cold milk
2  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1  c. canned pumpkin
1  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
1  c. thawed Cool Whip
1  baked 9-inch pie crust
preparation: Combine milk, pie filling mix, pumpkin, spice and whipped topping in a deep narrow bottom bowl.  Beat at lowest speed of electric mixer for 1 minute.  Pour into cooled pie shell.  Chill until set, at least 3 hours.  Garnish with additional whipped topping and pecans, if desired.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. milk
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. mashed ripe bananas
1/4  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
preparation: In mixing bowl, cream sugar and shortening until light, scraping sides of bowl often.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Add milk, beating until smooth and fluffy after each addition.  In medium bowl, stir together flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda. Add flour mixture and mashed banana alternately to creamed mixture, beating until smooth after each addition.  Gently fold in chopped nuts.  Turn into lightly greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan. Bake in a 350° oven for 60 to 65 minutes.  Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan; cool on wire rack.

name: GREEN TOMATO PRESERVES
ingredients:
4  c. blended tomatoes
4  c. sugar
1 (7 to 7.5 oz.)  box jello (berry flavor)
preparation: Blend tomatoes (any ripeness).  Add sugar and boil 10 minutes on medium heat.  Remove from heat and add jello.  May be canned, froze or kept in refrigerator.  Use strawberry or blackberry jello for taste.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
2 to 3  c. peaches
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. self-rising flour
3/4  c. milk
1  stick butter
preparation: Melt butter in baking pan (8 x 8-inch).  Mix 1 cup sugar with peaches.

name: Applesauce Cake
ingredients:
1/4  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  c. applesauce
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. raisins
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening; add sifted dry ingredients alternately with applesauce.  Add raisins.  Bake in large bread pan at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Ice with butter frosting. Quick, easy and requires no eggs.

name: ORANGE PRESERVES
ingredients:
5  oranges
2  lemons
1  can pineapple
water
sugar
preparation: Squeeze juice out.  Slice oranges and lemons into thin slices. Place the sliced fruit in a pot with 1 1/2 cups water.  For each cup of pulp, boil 30 minutes, then add the juice and 1 can of No. 2 pineapple.  Then add equal parts of sugar to juice and pulp.  Boil until jelly test or as thick as you desire it.  Cook slowly.  Pour into jars.

name: BAKED TURKEY LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground turkey
1/2  medium onion, finely chopped
1  stalk celery, finely chopped
1/4  c. fresh parsley, minced
1/2  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
1  Tbsp. bell pepper, finely chopped
1/2  c. whole wheat bread crumbs, toasted
1/4  c. skim milk or chicken stock
1  egg white, slightly beaten
1  clove garlic, crushed
preparation: Mix all ingredients until just blended.  Do not overmix. Press the mixture into 4 x 9-inch nonstick loaf pan.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Serve hot or cold.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
2 (10 oz. each)  pkg. frozen broccoli spears, cooked and well drained
4  chicken breasts (double), cooked
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. mayonnaise (not Miracle Whip)
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. cornflake crumbs
1  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Arrange broccoli spears on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, cutting large spears in half lengthwise.  Place large slices of cooked chicken in single layer over the broccoli.  Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and pour over the first 2 layers. Sprinkle cheese on top of this.  Combine melted butter and cornflake crumbs and sprinkle over layers.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: OH! SO GOOD CHICKEN
ingredients:
12  oz. cooked and chopped chicken or turkey breast
2  c. cooked brown rice
4  oz. reduced calorie Cheddar cheese
paprika (if desired)
6  Tbsp. light sour cream
4  tsp. oil
2  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
1/2  c. chopped onions
1 1/2  c. salsa
4  oz. chopped green chilies
preparation: Saute mushrooms and onions.  Add salsa and chilies. Cook until thick, about 5 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup of this mixture.  In a 10-inch square pan, which has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray, layer the chicken or turkey.  Pour salsa mixture on top. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.  Mix reserved salsa, rice and sour cream.  Place on top of meat.  Top with cheese.  Bake 5 more minutes.

name: INSTANT HOT COCOA
ingredients:
10  c. dry milk
1  lb. Nestle Quik
1  lb. powdered sugar
8  oz. Cremora
preparation: Mix together.  Store in an airtight canister.

name: BROCCOLI RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  small onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1/2  c. milk
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. process American cheese spread, cubed
3  c. cooked rice
preparation: Cook broccoli according to package direction; drain well and set aside.  Saute onions in butter until tender.  Add soup, milk and cheese.  Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until cheese is melted.  Stir in rice and broccoli.  Pour into a greased 2-quart shallow casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. broken nuts
1/3  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt together over hot water chocolate and shortening.  Beat in sugar and eggs.  Sift together and stir in flour, baking powder and salt.  Mix in nuts.  Spread in well-greased 8-inch square pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch).  Bake until top has dull crust.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  A slight imprint will be left when touched lightly with finger.  Cool slightly, then cut into squares.

name: CREAM CHEESE AND CHIVES CHICKEN BREAST
ingredients:
4  chicken breast halves
4  slices bacon
2  pkg. cream cheese and chives
1  tsp. margarine
preparation: Pound chicken breasts, not too thin.  Place margarine and generous portion of cream cheese and chives.  Roll chicken breasts.  Wrap with 1 slice bacon.  Cook at 400° for 40 minutes.

name: ITALIANO CALZONO
ingredients:
1  pkg. Pillsbury frozen dough
margarine
ham or cappicola
pepperoni
Provolone cheese
Mozzarella
Mortadella
seasoning
preparation: Roll out dough into portions; dab a little margarine on dough. Let cook for 3 minutes.  Apply one layer of ham or cappicola, layer of pepperoni and layer of Provolone cheese.  Add a seasoning, then add Mortadella with Mozzarella on top.  Close dough, adding a dab of oil on top.  Put in oven at 350°.  Let cook 30 to 40 minutes or desired cooking time (ovens vary).

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked squash
1  onion
1  c. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick margarine
1  bag herb stuffing
preparation: Melt margarine.  Add squash, onion, soup and sour cream, along with stuffing.  Leave some stuffing to put on top.  Bake at 325°. Just before it gets done, put the remaining stuffing on top.

name: CARIBBEAN ISLAND SAUSAGE AND RICE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. regular rice
1 small or large  can pineapple chunks in unsweetened juice, drained (I use large can as we like lots of pineapple)
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  tsp. salt
1  lb. smoked sausage, cut in 3/4-inch pieces
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1  Tbsp. vinegar (I use cider vinegar)
1/2  c. apricot preserves
1/2  c. water
1  green pepper, cut up in cubes or strips
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving juice.    Add enough water or juice to make 2 1/2 cups liquid.   Bring to a boil in large saucepan and stir in rice, 1 tablespoon of the butter and salt.   Cover tightly and simmer 20 minutes.   Remove from heat and let stand, covered, until all liquid is absorbed, about 5 to 10 minutes.

name: GARLIC DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. wine vinegar
1/4  c. olive oil
2  Tbsp. water
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. onion powder
preparation: In a covered container, combine all ingredients.  Cover and shake well to mix.

name: Vidalia Onion Casserole
ingredients:
3  large Vidalia onions, sliced thin
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  c. grated cheese (American)
1  can mushrooms
1  can water chestnuts
1 small  jar pimento
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. paprika
3  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. sour cream
1/4  c. butter
2  c. Ritz cracker crumbs
preparation: Spread onions in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pyrex dish.  Mix all other ingredients except butter and crumbs.  Spread on top of onions. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Toss crumbs in melted butter. Spread over top.  Bake 10 minutes more.

name: TOMATOES VINAIGRETTE
ingredients:
4  large ripe tomatoes
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. salt and pepper
1/4  c. oil
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Slice tomatoes in wedges.  In small bowl, whisk vinegar, salt, pepper and mustard until blended.  Whisk in oil and parsley.  Pour over tomatoes.  May add 1 cucumber, sliced.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream-style corn
1  can regular corn, drained
1  box Jiffy corn muffin mix
1  stick margarine, melted
8  oz. sour cream
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Pour into greased casserole.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: MOM'S CONGO BARS
ingredients:
2 3/4  c. flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. margarine
1  box light brown sugar
3  eggs
1  c. broken nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
6  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Melt margarine.  Add brown sugar; stir until well mixed. Allow to cool.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Add vanilla, then dry ingredients and nuts.  Bake in a 10 x 15-inch pan at 350° for about 25 to 30 minutes.

name: JELLO AND PUDDING DESSERT
ingredients:
1 large  box Jell-O (cherry flavor)
1 small  box instant vanilla pudding
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
3  to 4 bananas
1  jar cherries
preparation: Cook Jell-O as directed on box.  Pour Jell-O into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass dish.  Place in refrigerator until firm.  Mix instant pudding.  Place pudding on top of firm Jell-O.  Slice bananas and place on top of pudding.  Spread Cool Whip over bananas.  Drain cherries and arrange decoratively on top of Cool Whip.  Chill in refrigerator (1 to 2 hours).

name: CHICKEN DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  chicken
chicken broth (3 c.)
3  eggs, beaten
garlic and onion salt to taste
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  Tbsp. sage
1  c. cheese, grated
1  c. celery, chopped
4  c. smashed Ritz crackers
preparation: Boil and debone chicken.  Grate cheese.  Chop celery.  Smash Ritz crackers.  Beat eggs.  Mix together and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN BREAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  boneless chicken breasts
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1 small  jar chipped beef
3  slices bacon
preparation: Cover bottom of oblong baking dish with dried beef.  Arrange unsalted chicken on top of beef.  Mix sour cream and soup together.  Pour over chicken.  Place 1/2 slice bacon on each piece of chicken.  Bake at 225° for 4 hours.  Cover dish with foil.  You can use all chicken parts in place of breast.

name: VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  head cauliflower, cut small
1/2  c. green pepper, diced
1/2  c. thinly sliced carrots
1/2  c. zucchini, chopped
1/2  c. celery, diced
1/2  c. red onion, diced
1/2  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
1/2  c. black olives, cut up
8  oz. creamy Italian dressing
preparation: Mix together.  Marinate overnight.

name: 7-UP CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1 small  box vanilla instant Jell-O pudding
2  eggs
3/4  c. oil
10  oz. 7-Up drink (room temperature)
preparation: Mix and bake at 350° in layers.

name: DEVILED EGGS
ingredients:
5  hard-boiled eggs, peeled and sliced in half
1/8  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. regular mustard
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
paprika
preparation: Take out yolks of all eggs.  Place in a bowl.  Take all ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Amounts may be varied according to taste.  Once it's all whipped up, replace back into the white halves of the eggs.  Sprinkle a little paprika for color.  If more eggs are desired, then just increase other ingredients.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage, browned and drained (can also use ham and bacon)
1  stick oleo
12  eggs
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  c. milk
1  lb. (16 oz.) pkg. hash brown potatoes
preparation: Melt oleo in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Layer 3/4 of potatoes.  Mix rest of ingredients in large bowl and pour into pan on top of the hash browns.  Sprinkle rest of potatoes on top of egg mixture. Bake 1 hour at 350°.  Serve with coffee, orange juice and toast for a complete breakfast.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. pkg. frozen broccoli, carrots and cauliflower
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1  c. Ritz crackers, crumbled
preparation: Unthaw vegetables.  Mix mayonnaise and soup together.  Mix vegetables, cheese and onion.  Pour soup mixture over vegetable mixture.  Mix thoroughly.  Place in baking dish and top with cracker crumbs.  Pour margarine on top of cracker crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SPAGHETTI-N-MEAT
ingredients:
2  lb. ground chuck
1  lb. spaghetti
1  jar Ragu sauce
1  pkg. spaghetti mix
1  can Hunt's tomato sauce
1  small bell pepper, chopped
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1  c. shredded cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1  small onion, chopped
preparation: Melt butter in skillet.  Add bell pepper, onion, celery and ground chuck.  Cook slow until done.  Mix in spaghetti mix, Ragu sauce and tomato sauce.  Simmer 20 minutes.  Boil spaghetti. Rinse with cold water.  Add to the meat sauce.  Cook for 10 more minutes.  Cover with cheese.  Put lid on pot.  Turn off heat. Serve with salad or cold slaw and garlic bread.

name: GOLDEN GLAZED CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  chicken legs, cut up
1  Tbsp. melted butter
1  can Campbell's golden mushroom soup
1/4  c. sweet vermouth
1/8  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/4  c. pimento strips
preparation: In 13 x 9-inch baking pan arrange chicken skin side up and brush with butter.  Bake at 400° for 45 minutes; baste with pan drippings.  Combine rest of the ingredients and spoon over the chicken.  Bake for 15 minutes or more until chicken is done.

name: DEBBIE'S PORK CHOPS FLORENTINE
ingredients:
6  pork chops
4  Tbsp. butter
4  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. paprika
2  eggs
1  jar asparagus
1  large Mozzarella cheese
preparation: (You may substitute turkey tenderloins or chicken breasts for pork chops.)

name: DREAM BARS
ingredients:
1  c. margarine or butter, softened
1  c. flour
1  c. nuts
2  eggs
1  c. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. walnuts
3/4  c. shredded coconut
6  oz. semi-sweet chocolate
preparation: Place margarine and flour in blender (food processor) with steel blade.  Place crust ingredients in the bowl and process on high speed until combined.  Pat mix into bottom 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until golden.  Set aside to cool. Meanwhile, add nuts to coarsely chop; set aside.  Then add eggs to empty bowl process on high speed, adding brown sugar gradually. Then add flour, baking powder, salt and vanilla just until combined.  Then fold in walnuts, coconut and semi-sweet chocolate. Pour over crust.  Bake 350° for 25 minutes longer.  Makes 30 bars.

name: FORGOTTEN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1 1/2  c. water
1  large fryer, cut up
1/2  pkg. dry onion soup
salt and pepper
preparation: Grease bottom of baking pan.  Pour rice in.  Combine chicken soup and water and pour over rice.  Let stand a few minutes.  Salt and pepper chicken pieces and place on top of rice.  Pour remaining chicken soup over chicken.  Top with dry onion soup. Cover with lid or foil.  Place in oven at 350° and forget for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

name: BABY BIRD SEED
ingredients:
2  c. multi-grain Cheerios
2  c. Kix cereal
1  c. pretzel sticks, broken into smaller pieces
1  c. raisins
1  c. banana chips
preparation: Combine ingredients in a large bowl.  Serve as a dry snack in a bowl or take along in a sandwich bag.

name: CORN RELISH
ingredients:
12  ears of corn
4  c. chopped cabbage
6  sweet peppers (red and green)
2  tsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. celery seed (optional)
1/4  tsp. turmeric
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  qt. vinegar
preparation: Mix all together. Cook 10 minutes.  Pack in jars and seal.

name: DATE-NUT PINWHEELS
ingredients:
1/4  lb. pitted dates, chopped
1/3  c. granulated sugar
1/3  c. water
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: In saucepan, cook dates, granulated sugar and water, stirring constantly until slightly thickened.  Remove from heat; stir in nuts.  Cool.  Mix shortening, brown sugar, egg and vanilla until smooth.  Stir in flour and salt.  Divide dough in half.  Roll each half on waxed paper into rectangle (about 11 x 7-inch).  Spread half of the date-nut filling on each rectangle.  Roll up tightly, beginning at long side.  Pinch edge of dough to seal securely. Wrap and chill at least 4 hours.  May bake immediately or store for up to 6 weeks.  Fifteen minutes before serving, heat oven to 400°. Cut rolls into 1/4-inch slices.  Place 1 inch apart on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake until light brown, about 10 minutes.  Remove immediately from baking sheet.  Makes 5 dozen.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  head broccoli
1/2  small red onion
1/3  c. sunflower seeds
1/3  c. raisins
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/3  c. sugar
5  bacon strips, cooked and crumbled
preparation: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble on paper towel. Finely chop broccoli and onion; toss with raisins and sunflower seeds.  Mix mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar and add.  Mix in crumbled bacon last.  This salad will keep for days in the refrigerator.

name: MICROWAVE CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
1  lb. brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1  stick margarine
1/4  c. white corn syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
3 to 4  qt. popped corn
preparation: Combine all ingredients except soda and popcorn in a 2-quart microwave dish.  Bring to a boil (3 minutes on High).  Stir and then cook 2 minutes more on High.  Remove from microwave and stir in soda.  Stir until foamy.  Put popped corn in brown paper bag. Pour syrup over corn, close bag by folding top.  Shake and place bag back in microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes.  Remove and shake; then cook another 1 1/2 minutes on High.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and let cool.

name: KAPANKY - DOUGH DROPS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
3  eggs
preparation: Beat  eggs.  Add  flour;  mix  until smooth.  Spoon out droplets into boiling chicken broth.  Dough drops surface when done.

name: FRUIT COOLER
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple chunks and juice
2  bananas, sliced
1/2  c. shredded coconut
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 (16 oz.)  can lite fruit cocktail and juice
1 (3 3/4 oz.)  pkg. instant lemon pudding mix
preparation: Mix pineapple chunks and juice with bananas.  Add oranges, fruit cocktail and coconut, stirring slowly.  Add the instant lemon mix into fruit and juice.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Pudding will set in fruit juice.  Refrigerate.

name: PEPPY POTATOES
ingredients:
1  pkg. scalloped potato mix
1  can tomatoes
1 1/4  c. water
1/4  tsp. oregano
1  pkg. sliced pepperoni
1  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Mix tomatoes, water and oregano in a 2-quart ovenware casserole dish.  Heat to boiling, about 8 to 10 minutes.  Stir in seasoning mix and potatoes.  Cook for 5 minutes at medium heat. Stir.  Place cheese and pepperoni on top.  Turn oven to 350° and cook for an additional 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender and cheese is melted.

name: WAKE UP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  frozen hash brown patties
4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  lb. bacon, cooked, drained and crumbled
7  eggs
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. mustard powder
preparation: Place hash brown patties in a single layer in a greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish.  Sprinkle with cheese and bacon.  In a bowl, beat eggs, milk, salt and mustard.  Pour over casserole.  Cover and bake at 350° for one hour.  Uncover; bake 15 minutes longer, or until edges are golden brown and a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.

name: 1 BOWL BROWNIES
ingredients:
4  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1 1/2  sticks margarine
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1 1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Heat oven to 350° (325° if glass dish).  Melt chocolate and margarine in a large microwaveable bowl on High for 2 minutes or until margarine melts.  Stir until chocolate melts.  Stir sugar into chocolate; blend well.  Mix in eggs and vanilla.  Stir in flour and walnuts.  Spread into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° (or 325°) for 30 to 35 minutes.  Do not overbake.  Cool in pan.  Makes 24 squares.

name: DAD MURIN'S FAMOUS SPICY PIZZA SAUCE
ingredients:
3  medium size onions
3  large bell peppers
4  stalks celery
2  Tbsp. shortening or oil
1 (29 oz.)  can tomato sauce
15  oz. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. oregano leaves
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. sugar
preparation: Cut onions, peppers and celery fine.  Cook onions, peppers and celery in shortening (or oil) for 30 minutes.  Add tomato sauce, water and all other ingredients and simmer (slow flame) for one hour.  Use with white crust pizza dough; not as good on whole wheat.  Spread sauce on pizza and sprinkle oregano lightly. Favorite toppings with sauce:  Colby, Cheddar cheese and ham. Usually bake pizza at about 400° for 15 minutes.

name: FRIED OYSTERS
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. freshly ground black pepper
pinch cayenne pepper
3  whole eggs
1  Tbsp. milk
3  c. fresh bread crumbs or very fine matzoh cracker crumbs, ground in a food processor
2 to 3  doz. oysters, shucked, drained and dried on paper towels
8  Tbsp. butter (1 stick)
1/4  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Season flour with salt, black pepper and cayenne and put in shallow pan.  Whisk eggs with milk in a small bowl and put 1 cup of crumbs in a second shallow pan.  Dust each oyster with flour, dip in the beaten egg and then in crumbs, coating completely.  (Add fresh crumbs, as needed.  If you put them in the pan all at once, they will get damp and won't coat the oysters.)  Refrigerate 1 hour to set.  Place a skillet over medium-high heat.  Add half the butter and oil and heat until melted and hot, but not smoking.  Add oysters a few at a time and sauté until golden brown on both sides. Place on paper towels to drain and sprinkle with more salt.  Repeat until done, adding butter and oil as needed.

name: PIONEER APPLE PIE(Diabetic)
ingredients:
2  (9-inch) pie crusts
2  cans apple slices (packed in water; do not drain)
1 1/2  c. apple juice
1/4  tsp. rum extract
1/4  c. cornstarch
1 1/2  tsp. apple pie spice
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. Equal sweetener
preparation: Bake 1 pie crust at 350° until golden brown.  Heat apples with water (undrained), 1 cup apple juice and rum extract to a gentle simmer until apples are soft.  In small bowl combine 1/2 cup apple juice, cornstarch, apple pie spices and salt.  Mix well.  Add slowly to simmering apples.  Stir gently but completely.  Cook for 1 minute after mixture starts to boil.  Remove from heat.  Stir 1 cup Equal into mixture.  Cool and pour into cooled pie shell. Place uncooked pie shell on top of filled shell. Seal and crimp around edges.  Brush with water.  Bake at 325° until golden brown.

name: MINIATURE CREAM PUFFS
ingredients:
1  c. water
1  c. flour
1/2  c. butter
4  eggs
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Heat water and butter to rolling boil in saucepan.  Stir in flour.  Stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball, about 1 minute.  Remove from heat.  Beat eggs in thoroughly, one at a time.  Beat until smooth.  Drop dough by slightly rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake about 25 minutes or until puffed, golden brown and dry. Remove from baking sheet and allow to cool.  Bakes about 70 puffs.

name: WALK TO SCHOOL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. oleo
1  c. sugar
4  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Shape into balls about the size of small walnuts.  Flatten balls with tumbler dipped in sugar.  Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 325°.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. celery, sauteed in 3/4 c. butter or oleo
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  pkg. chopped, cooked broccoli, drained
preparation: Place over 1 cup cooked rice in casserole.  Cook until hot throughout.

name: DATES BARS
ingredients:
3/4  lb. pitted dates
1  c. hot water
1  Tbsp. butter
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
2 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
3/4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Pour hot water over dates.  Add butter.  Add sugar and egg. Mix together and add flour, soda, baking powder, vanilla and nuts. Mix well and pour into greased and floured oblong pan.  Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.  When cool, cut in bars and roll in powdered sugar.

name: SEVEN LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head shredded lettuce
1  c. celery, chopped fine
1  white onion, chopped (small)
1  green pepper, chopped
1  can LeSueur English peas, drained
1  pt. Hellmann's mayonnaise
2  tsp. sugar
1  c. Parmesan cheese
few strips bacon
preparation: Start with lettuce and layer in a large casserole dish or bowl.  After the lettuce, layer the celery, onion, green pepper, peas and mayonnaise.  Sprinkle the sugar over that and cover with the cheese.  Fry the bacon and crumble it over the top.  Cover the bowl tightly and let it set in the refrigerator for a few hours before serving for the best flavor.

name: SHOO-FLY PIE
ingredients:
8  Tbsp. butter
12  Tbsp. flour
3  c. maple sugar
1  c. hot water
whipped cream
1  pie shell
preparation: Melt butter on low heat and add flour.  Remove from heat; add syrup and water.  Put back on stove and boil until thick.  Cook 5 minutes; mix often.  Remove from heat.  Cool before putting into pie shell.  Put on whipped cream.

name: MINESTRONE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk mild Italian sausage
1  medium stalk celery, coarsely chopped (about 1/2 c.)
1  pkg. Hamburger Helper mix for spaghetti
1 (16 oz.)  can whole tomatoes, undrained
1 (16 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, undrained
1 (15 to 16 oz.)  can kidney beans, undrained
1/2  c. hot water
1 1/2  tsp. chopped fresh or 1/2 tsp. dried thyme leaves
preparation: Heat  oven to 375°.  Cook sausage and celery in 10-inch skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until sausage is done.  Drain.  Mix sausage mixture, spaghetti, sauce mix and remaining ingredients in ungreased 3-quart casserole or rectangular baking dish (11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch).   Break up tomatoes.  Cover and bake about 50 minutes or until hot and bubbly.   Stir.   Let stand uncovered about 5 minutes before serving.  Yields 6 servings.

name: CARAMEL PIE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  c. milk
4  Tbsp. flour
3  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil 10 minutes the brown sugar, white sugar and 1 cup milk. Mix together flour, 1 cup milk, egg yolks and vanilla.  Mix all ingredients and boil until thick.  Pour into prepared pie crust. Top with meringue.  Rich and delicious.

name: MUSTARD PICKLES
ingredients:
1/2  gal. vinegar (1 qt. vinegar to 1 pt. water)
1/2  c. salt
1/4  c. dry mustard
1/2  dram saccharin
preparation: Put in 1-gallon crock.  Let pickles stand 3 days before using.

name: NO FAT LEMON BLINTZ PIE
ingredients:
1 (24 oz.)  carton no fat cottage cheese
1/3  c. liquid egg substitute (must have 0 grams fat)
2  egg whites
3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. grated lemon peel
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. no fat sour cream
3  Tbsp. flour
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  In blender or food processor, place egg whites, liquid egg substitute, sugar and vanilla.  Blend 1 to 2 minutes.  Add salt, lemon juice, lemon peel, sour cream and flour. Blend thoroughly for a few seconds.  Gradually add and blend in cottage cheese.  Spray a 9-inch pie plate with nonstick cooking spray.  Pour in mixture.  (Be sure it is a big pie plate, the stuff expands.)  Bake for 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted in the center of the pie comes out clean.  The center of the pie will fall as it cools.  This is normal.  Use sugar substitute if diabetic.

name: OLD-FASHIONED CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. water
2  sticks butter or margarine
4  Tbsp. or more cocoa
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bring the first 3 ingredients to a boil; set aside.  Mix flour and sugar together.  Pour hot mixture over dry ingredients, then add eggs, buttermilk and vanilla.   Put in prepared sheet cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh cranberries
1  whole orange
1  c. sugar
1  pkg. raspberry Jell-O
1  pkg. orange Jell-O
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  c. pecans
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple with juice
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.  Grind cranberries and orange with peeling, very fine.  Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate until firm.

name: CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bacon, cut in 1-inch lengths
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/4  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
any mix of four 1 lb. cans beans (lima beans, butter beans, navy beans, kidney beans, green beans, pork and beans, black beans, white kidney beans, etc.; try to make a colorful mix)
preparation: Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove bacon, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings in skillet.  Saute onion in drippings until crisp-tender.  Drain all beans (except pork and beans).  Add beans and all other ingredients, mixing well.  Spoon into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 minutes or until heated through.  Sprinkle with cooked bacon. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

name: KEY LIME PIE
ingredients:
1  baked pie shell (9-inch)
6  oz. can thawed limeade
2  c. Cool Whip
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
few drops green food coloring
preparation: Mix limeade and Cool Whip.  Fold in condensed milk; mix well. Tint light green.  Pour into baked pie shell.  Refrigerate. Serves 6 to 8.

name: AMY'S PIZZA
ingredients:
6  English muffins
1  jar spaghetti sauce
1 to 2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Place muffins faced up on a cookie sheet.  Spread sauce on each muffin and then sprinkle cheese on top.  Broil at 500° for 2 to 3 minutes.

name: BISQUICK COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  (3 oz.) cream cheese
4  Tbsp. margarine
2  c. Bisquick
1/3  c. milk
preparation: Roll out dough in two 8 x 12-inch rectangles 1/4-inch thick. Place on cookie sheet about 2 inches apart.  Spread any kind of your favorite preserves down the middle of the dough.  Cut dough down each side in strips of 1-inch and brush across the preserves. Can be frosted with powdered sugar frosting.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. salt
1  can cream-style corn
2/3  c. Wesson oil
1 1/2  c. corn meal
2  Tbsp. chopped bell pepper
2  chopped jalapeno peppers
3  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients and then add the remaining ingredients.  Grease a 9 x 13-inch dish and pour mixture in.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: LITTLE RICH COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/4  lb. butter
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans, finely chopped
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Form small balls of dough on cookie sheet, flatten out.  Bake  in  325°  oven  for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: ROBERT REDFORD TREAT
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate cake mix
3 or 4 (8 oz.)  pkg. Cool Whip
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
6  or 7 Heath candy bars, crushed
4  c. milk
preparation: Bake cake according to package instructions.  When completely cool, crumble it up.  Make pudding with 2 cups milk instead of 3 per package of pudding (4 cups milk total).  In a large punch bowl (or any clear, large container), crumble a layer of cake, layer of pudding, layer of Cool Whip and sprinkle Heath bars.  Repeat all layering 2 more times.  Cover and chill at least one hour.

name: CHEESY BROCCOLI 'N MUSHROOM BAKED
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli, thawed
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. salad dressing
1/2  c. milk
1  c. (4 oz.) 100% natural Kraft shredded cheese
1/2  c. coarsely crushed croutons
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Arrange broccoli in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish.  Whip together soup, salad dressing and milk.  Pour over broccoli.  Sprinkle with cheese and croutons.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes until heated through.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
6  boiled eggs
1  lb macaroni cooked
green onions chopped up
real mayonnaise
preparation: Cook macaroni in salted water: don't overcook.  Rinse in cold water after draining off the cooked water first.  Cut up the 6 boiled eggs.  Chop up the green onions and green peppers and add to the macaroni.  Now smooth in the real mayonnaise or Miracle Whip.

name: ZUCCHINI WITH EGGS(Zucchini con Uova)
ingredients:
1/4  c. olive oil
1  onion, sliced thin
6  medium zucchini, washed, scrubbed and sliced
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
5  parsley sprigs, chopped
1/2  c. water
6  eggs
preparation: Heat  oil  in medium saucepan.  Add the onion and saute until transparent.  Add  cut  zucchini  and  saute  for a few minutes. Add salt, pepper, parsley and water.  Cover and cook on medium-low  heat  until  zucchini is tender to fork.  Make indentions  in  zucchini and place raw egg (out of shell) onto squash.  Cover  pan  and  cook 5 minutes.  Close heat and keep covered until ready to serve.  Makes 6 servings.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. white sugar
2/3  c. evaporated milk
1 1/2  sticks oleo
1  c. peanut butter (chunky or smooth)
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. Marshmallow Fluff
preparation: Boil the first 3 ingredients for about 5 minutes until soft-ball stage. Add the peanut butter, vanilla and Marshmallow Fluff. Pour into a buttered 9 x 13 or smaller pan.

name: FORGOTTEN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  egg whites (at room temperature)
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pinch of salt
1  c. chopped pecans
6  oz. chocolate chips
1  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cover 2 cookie sheets with aluminum foil (ungreased).  Beat eggs until foamy; add sugar, beat until stiff.  Add vanilla and salt.  By hand, add pecans, chocolate chips and Rice Krispies.  Stir real good!  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheets.  Put in oven, shut the door, turn oven off. Leave overnight or 8 hours.  Do not peak!  Remove cookies from cookie sheet with spatula.

name: HEAVENLY CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. creamed corn
1  c. whole kernel corn, drained
1  stick oleo, melted
2  eggs, beaten
1  box Jiffy corn muffin mix
6  oz. sour cream
preparation: Mix all together.  Put in a 9 x 13-inch casserole or pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: SAUTEED APPLES
ingredients:
1 1/2  Tbsp. margarine
5  apples, peeled, cored and sliced
2  Tbsp. sugar
cinnamon to taste
preparation: Melt margarine in heavy skillet over low heat.  Add apples, stirring until coated with margarine.  Cover and saute, shaking skillet occasionally to prevent sticking, 5 to 10 minutes or until apples are tender.  Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.  Serves 4.

name: FESTIVE PORK ROAST
ingredients:
2  lb. boneless pork loin roast
2 large  cloves garlic, pressed
3/4  c. golden raisins
1  sprig fresh rosemary (4-inch long)
1 3/4  c. canned pineapple juice
3  Tbsp. currant jelly
1  Tbsp. minced, crystallized ginger
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
sliced pineapple for garnish
preparation: Cut a slit lengthwise through center of pork, not all the way through.  Lay flat.  Rub with garlic, salt and pepper to taste; sprinkle with raisins.  Close roast and tie with string.  Place rosemary on top.  Wrap roast with heavy duty foil.  Poke several small holes through foil into pork on all sides.  Place in roasting pan.  Roast in 350° oven 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

name: DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
1  cup boiling water
1  cup sugar
3  packages yeast
2  eggs
1  cup butter or margarine
1  cup warm water
6  cups all-purpose flour
preparation: Pour boiling water over butter, sugar and salt.  Stir to mix well.  Cool.  Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Beat in eggs and add to cooled mixture.   Add flour. Mix well.  Let rest in refrigerator over night.  Roll dough out to thickness of 1/4 inch. Cut rolls with biscuit cutter 2 hours before baking. Preheated oven at 450 degrees.  Bake rolls for 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Rolls can be frozen before they are cooked.

name: PIZZA BURGERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
Mozzarella cheese
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. oregano
hamburger buns
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Spread evenly on bottom half of buns.  Broil until meat is cooked and edges of buns are toasting. Watch very closely.  During last 2 minutes put 2 strips of cheese crisscrossed on top of each bun.  Brown tops of buns.

name: PARTY MIX
ingredients:
4  c. light salad oil
3  oz. Mexene chili powder
6  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3  jars Durkee Barbecue seasoning
1  box Tid-Bits
2  lb. peanuts
1  box Cheerios
1  box Wheat Chex
1  box Rice Chex or Crispix
1  box thin pretzel sticks
preparation: Mix first four ingredients together in a blender.  Pour mixture over remaining ingredients.   Use a large roaster pan (an electric roaster is ideal).   Bake at 250° for 2 hours.  Stir from bottom every 15 minutes.  When cool, store in airtight cans.  It keeps for months.

name: SWEETBREAD
ingredients:
8  eggs
1 1/4 to 1 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  lb. butter
3  c. milk
1  large cake yeast
about 5 lb. flour
preparation: Beat eggs until light.  Add sugar, salt and vanilla.  Melt butter in milk.  Cool to lukewarm.  Add to first mixture.  Add yeast and mix well.  Add flour and knead well about 1/2 hour.  Let raise until double in bulk, punch down and let raise again.  Brush top with milk after shaping into two loaves.  Bake at 325° for one hour or more.

name: LINGUINE WITH SHRIMP SCAMPI AND BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. large shrimp
3  cloves fresh garlic, crushed
1/4  c. extra virgin olive oil
3  Tbsp. fresh parsley
1/2  bunch broccoli florets
1/2  stick sweet, unsalted butter
fresh ground pepper
linguine
1/4  c. white wine
preparation: Melt 1/2 butter in oil and saute shrimp for 2 minutes.  Put aside.  Put 1/2 butter, 2 cloves garlic and olive oil in.  Add broccoli, wine, parsley and pepper.  Mix together, then add shrimp.  Serve over cooked linguine.

name: MOTHER'S BUTTERSCOTCH SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
2  egg, separated
1/2  c. cream
dash of salt
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Beat yolks until thick; add cream. Beat into butter and sugar.  Cook in double boiler until thick. Pour slowly over egg whites.  Serve hot.

name: PEPPER RELISH
ingredients:
12  sweet red peppers, chopped
12  green peppers, chopped
12  onions, chopped
2  c. vinegar
2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. mustard seed
preparation: Cover peppers and onions with boiling water; let stand for 5 minutes.  Drain.  Add vinegar, sugar and salt.  Boil mixture for 5 minutes.  Pour into clean hot jars and seal.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CANDY
ingredients:
1/2  lb. margarine
1  lb. powdered sugar
2  c. creamy peanut butter
2  (1/2 lb.) Hershey candy bars
preparation: Melt margarine; stir in peanut butter, then add powdered sugar.  Pat in a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan.  Melt chocolate in a double boiler and pour over the mixture.  Refrigerate at least 2 hours; cut at room temperature.  These taste like Reese's peanut butter cups.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. Oreo cookies
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  stick margarine
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
2 small  pkg. French vanilla pudding (instant)
3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Crush Oreo cookies and put half of crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix cream cheese and margarine until smooth.  Mix in confectioners sugar.  Fold in Cool Whip.

name: APPLE COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
1  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
4  c. diced apples
1  c. All Bran or Raisin Bran
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar together.  Add eggs.  Mix well. Add apples and Bran.  Blend well.  Add all dry ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Bake in greased angel food or Bundt pan.  Bake for 50 minutes at 350°.

name: LAYERED PISTACHIO DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. Bisquick
1  Tbsp. brown sugar, packed
3  Tbsp. margarine (firm)
1/2  c. nuts, finely chopped
1  c. powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, soft
1  c. whipping cream, chilled
1 (3 3/4 oz.)  pkg. pistachio instant pudding and pie mix
2 1/2  c. cold milk
1  Tbsp. powdered sugar
1 small  pkg. instant chocolate pudding mix
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Mix baking mix, brown sugar and margarine until crumbly.  Stir in nuts.  Press in ungreased rectangular pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inches.  Bake until light brown, about 10 minutes. Cool.

name: NEW ORLEANS RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice
3  c. milk
1  c. whipping cream
1  stick butter
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  c. raisins
3  whole eggs, beaten
6  egg yolks, beaten
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Bring rice, milk and cream to a boil; cover and  cook until most of milk is absorbed and rice is tender.  Add all other ingredients, except egg yolks and whole eggs.  Stir some of the rice mixture into eggs and pour egg mixture into rice mixture and stir.  Pour into 2-quart buttered casserole and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: FRUIT SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1/4  c. honey
1/4  c. mayonnaise/salad dressing
1  tsp. lemon juice/concentrate juice
1/4  tsp. celery seed (optional)
preparation: Whip together (blend) or beat together.  Should liquify. Serve with fruit.

name: HODGEPODGE SALAD
ingredients:
8  new potatoes
3  c. frozen mixed vegetables (broccoli, cauliflower and carrots
1  c. diced fully cooked ham
2  c. coarsely shredded cabbage
1/2  c. creamy buttermilk salad dressing
preparation: Halve or quarter large potatoes.  In a 3-quart saucepan cook potatoes in 3 cups boiling salted water for 12 minutes.  Add frozen vegetables and ham; return to boiling.   Add cabbage. Cover and simmer for 3 minutes more or until cabbage is crisp-tender.  Drain.  Stir in dressing.  Cool slightly.

name: ZUCCHINI LASAGNA
ingredients:
3/4  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. onion, finely chopped
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  tsp. crushed dried oregano
1/2  tsp. crushed dried basil
salt and pepper to taste
4  medium zucchini squash (approximately 8-inches long)
1  c. Ricotta or large curd cottage cheese
1  egg
1/2  lb. grated Mozzarella cheese
ground Parmesan cheese
preparation: In a large skillet, cook beef and onion until browned.  Drain fat.  Add tomato sauce, herbs, salt and pepper.  Simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Slice zucchini lengthwise into 1/4-inch slices.  Arrange half of the zucchini slices in an 11 x 7-inch baking dish.  Salt lightly.  Beat Ricotta or cottage cheese with egg; spread on zucchini.  Top with half the cheese mixture and half of the sauce.  Layer with remaining zucchini, cheese and sauce.  Sprinkle generously with Parmesan cheese. Pre-heat oven 350°.  Bake uncovered 40 minutes or until hot and bubbly and zucchini is tender.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

name: ORIENTAL SALAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. salad oil
1/3  c. ketchup
1/4  c. cider vinegar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  medium onion, grated or equivalent dried onion
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Makes a double recipe.  Keeps 2 weeks in refrigerator.

name: BROCCOLI LASAGNA
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  cans condensed cream of broccoli soup
10  oz. pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
salad oil
3  carrots, thinly sliced
1  large onion, diced
3/4  lb. mushrooms, sliced
12  lasagna noodles
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. shredded Mozzarella cheese
15  oz. container Ricotta cheese
2  large eggs
preparation: In 2-quart saucepan, heat soup and broccoli until broccoli is thawed, then in skillet, in 1 tablespoon oil, cook carrots and onion until lightly browned.  Reduce heat; stir in 1/4 cup water. Simmer for 15 minutes, covered, until vegetables are very tender; remove to a bowl.

name: ELEPHANT STEW
ingredients:
1  elephant
12,000  whole bay leaves
500  lb. white potatoes, diced
100  stalks celery, diced
100  onions, diced
1,000  tomatoes, diced
500  bunches carrots, diced
2  rabbits (optional)
500 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
200 (5 oz.)  pkg. paprika
200  (9 oz.) adobo seasoning
50  garlic pods, sliced
150  (15 oz.) whole oregano
brown gravy (as desired)
preparation: Cut elephant into bite size pieces. This should take about 2 months. Cover and cook over fire (kerosene) for about 4 weeks at 465°. This will serve 3,800 people. Add the rest of the ingredients.  If more are expected, two rabbits may be added, but do this only if necessary as most people do not like to find hare in their stew.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Uncle Ben's long grain wild rice with herbs
1  can string beans, drained
1  can celery soup
1  can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
2 to 2 1/2  oz. slivered almonds
2  c. diced, cooked chicken (I use chicken breast)
salt and pepper to taste
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
preparation: Cook rice as directed on package.  Mix all ingredients with rice.  Put in casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SUE'S BLUEBERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
3/4  stick butter
1  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. freshly grated nutmeg
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. milk
2  c. blueberries (11 oz.)
Whipped cream or vanilla ice cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°. In an 8-inch square baking dish, melt butter. Into a bowl, sift together flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg and stir in sugar until well combined. Add milk and whisk batter until it is just combined. Pour batter into melted butter, but do not stir. Pour berries into center of batter, but do not stir. Bake cobbler in middle of oven 40 minutes, or until cake portion is golden and berries exude juice.

name: CRAB DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese (room temperature)
1/2  lb. crab meat
3  Tbsp. finely chopped onions
2  Tbsp. milk
1/2  tsp. horseradish
salt and pepper
1  pkg. slivered almonds
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Blend cream cheese, onions, milk, horseradish, salt and pepper together, then add crab meat.  Spoon mixture into plate or casserole.  Toast almonds separately at 375° until light brown.  Place almonds on top of crab meat mixture and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.   Serve on crackers or toast.

name: SALAD DRESSING(Mine)
ingredients:
4 heaping  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  c. V-8 juice
2  tsp. lemon juice
