1  Tbsp. mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. buttermilk
dash of salt
pepper
garlic salt
preparation: Combine ingredients.

name: SALISBURY STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. cornflakes, crushed
dash of pepper
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
flour
fat
1  can golden mushroom soup, mixed with 1 can milk
preparation: Combine meat, egg, onion, milk, cornflakes, salt and pepper. Form into 6 patties, roll in flour and brown in fat.  Place in baking pan.  Cover with mushroom soup.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
pastry for 2-crust pie
1  Tbsp. dried onion
6  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
2  c. boiling water
1  Tbsp. instant chicken bouillon granules
3  c. cubed, cooked chicken
1/2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas and carrots, thawed and drained
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Prepare crust.  Fit bottom crust into pie pan.  Prepare bouillon broth by dissolving granules in 2 cups boiling water.  Melt butter; blend in flour and salt.  Allow to bubble slowly about 30 seconds.  Add broth and milk gradually. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly.  Add remaining ingredients. Heat until bubbly.  Pour into pastry crust.  Put on the top crust. Seal and flute the edge.  Cover edge with aluminum foil, dull side down.  Bake uncovered in 425° oven until golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes.

name: BAKED PERCH FILLETS
ingredients:
1  lb. perch fillets (1/4 lb. per serving)
1  small onion, sliced thin
1/8  lb. mushrooms, sliced thin
2/3  c. fresh whole wheat bread crumbs
2  tsp. parsley
3  Tbsp. chicken broth
preparation: Cover bottom of baking dish with onion slices.  Add layer of mushrooms.  Place fish fillets on top.  Cover with bread crumbs. Sprinkle with parsley.  Pour broth over all.  Bake at 450° for 10 minutes per inch of thickness at thickest part.

name: OVEN BARBECUED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  small chicken fryer, split and cleaned
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/4  c. vinegar
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix butter, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, vinegar, salt, pepper  and  sugar  for sauce.  Heat until well blended. Place chicken  in  covered  casserole  or wrap in foil.  Brush sauce over chicken and brown under broiler.  Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: HOLIDAY TURKEY AND BISCUITS
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter, cut in pieces
2  c. cut up turkey
1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. dried basil leaves
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
biscuits
2/3  c. milk
1  c. julienne strips red bell pepper
1 (4 oz.)  can mushroom stems and pieces, drained
1  c. julienne strips spinach
1  c. chicken broth
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Heat butter in 2-quart casserole in oven until melted.  Stir in remaining ingredients except spinach and biscuits.  Bake 20 minutes, stirring once, or until sauce is slightly thickened.  Stir in spinach, prepare biscuits, place around edge of casserole, overlapping biscuits slightly to fit. Increase oven heat temperature to 425°.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes longer or until biscuits are golden brown.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SMOKY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  c. shredded smoky Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
2  Tbsp. milk
2  tsp. steak sauce
1  c. finely chopped nuts
assorted crackers
preparation: In a mixer bowl, combine cream cheese, shredded Cheddar cheese, softened butter, milk and steak sauce.  Beat mixture with electric mixer until fluffy.  Chill slightly; shape into a ball. Place chopped nuts on waxed paper; gently roll cheese ball over nuts to coat.  Serve with crackers.  Makes about 3 1/2 cups.

name: BASIC BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. instant uncooked rice
1  box frozen chopped broccoli
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1/4  c. chopped onion or 1 Tbsp. dehydrated onion
preparation: Cook broccoli and onion; drain.  Mix other ingredients together in 2-quart casserole dish.  Bake, uncovered, for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.  This is a holiday standard dish in our home!

name: ARKANSAS STEW(Sausage/Bean Soup)
ingredients:
2  lb. smoked sausage, cut into 1/4-inch slices
5  lb. potatoes, peeled and diced
2  lb. carrots, peeled and diced
1 small  jar pimientos, drained
1  lb. Great Northern beans (dry)
2 (16 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
8  c. water
garlic salt and pepper
preparation: Soak beans in water overnight.  Cook for 1 hour.  Add potatoes, carrots and sausage slices.  Simmer 30 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients.  Simmer for 1 hour.  Serve with corn bread.

name: JALAPENO PIE
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  can jalapeno peppers
4  eggs
1/2  lb. sharp cheese, coarsely grated
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Drain and seed peppers.  Cut into lengthwise slices and line bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie plate.  Press grated cheese in plate over peppers.  Beat eggs, adding salt and red pepper.  Pour over cheese.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  After removing from oven, slice into small wedges.  Leave in pie plate and serve as finger food.

name: SOUTHERN PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. heavy cream
1/2  c. dark corn syrup
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
1 1/2  c. pecans
1  (9-inch) frozen or prepared pie shell
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Beat eggs and gradually mix in sugar, butter and salt.  Whip cream gently for 1 minute and stir into egg mixture with corn syrup.  Add vanilla and 1 1/4 cups pecans. Spoon into pie shell and bake 40 to 50 minutes.  Decorate top with remaining pecans.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. hot sausage (uncooked)
7  Tbsp. milk
4 1/2  c. Bisquick
10  oz. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Pinch off bite-sized pieces and form into balls.  Bake on a cookie sheet at 350° for 15 minutes.  Freezes well before cooking.

name: BREAKFAST BURRITOS
ingredients:
6  slices bacon
a little onion
a little bell pepper
3  eggs
some cheese
flour tortillas
preparation: Cook bacon and put aside.  Drain grease from pan; saute onion and bell or hot peppers.  Add eggs, scrambled, to pan.  Crumble bacon in also.  When almost done, add cheese on top.  Spoon into tortillas; add hot sauce, if desired.

name: CRANBERRY RELISH
ingredients:
2  peeled oranges
2  c. sugar
1/2  grapefruit, peeled
1  bag cranberries
1  c. crushed pineapple
preparation: Grind and mix altogether.

name: GERMAN MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
1  pkg. Mrs. Grass dry onion soup mix
1  c. bread crumbs
1  egg
1  can jellied cranberry sauce
1/4  c. dark brown sugar
1  can Bavarian sauerkraut
preparation: Mix the first 4 ingredients together and form into small meatballs.  Place on a cookie sheet and bake in a 375° preheated oven until brown, turning meatballs to keep them cooking through thoroughly.

name: FRIED PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  large eggs, well beaten
1  c. Crisco
1/2  c. Carnation
4  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix in order given by hand or mixer.  Put on floured board and knead until not sticky.  Pinch off in pieces the size of plums. Roll and cut by a saucer.  Place cold filling on half of circle and fold over.  Press edges together with fork.  Drop in hot oil and brown.  Makes 15 pies.  This recipe will serve 15 people.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1 large  can pumpkin (4 c.)
4  c. sugar
1  c. Wesson oil
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. salt
4  tsp. soda
2  c. chopped nuts
5  c. flour
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Bake in 3 or 4 loaf pans 1 hour at 350°.

name: SALMON LOAF
ingredients:
1  can salmon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. hot milk
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  egg yolks
1/2  c. crackers or bread crumbs
3  egg whites
preparation: Mix everything together except the egg whites which are beaten stiff and added last.  Bake in greased loaf pan at 350° to 370° for 1 hour.

name: VEGETABLE BEEF AND CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  can Campbell's condensed golden corn soup
1  can Campbell's tomato soup
3/4  c. water
1 (15 oz.)  can Veg-All mixed vegetables, drained
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  pkg. can biscuits
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In skillet, brown beef; spoon off fat.  Stir in soups, water, mixed vegetables and Worcestershire sauce.  Spoon into 3-quart baking dish.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes or until hot. Meanwhile, cut each biscuit into quarters.  Remove dish from oven; stir.  Arrange biscuits on hot mixture.  Top with cheese.  Bake 10 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.  Serves 6.

name: RAISED DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. warm water
3/4  c. milk, warmed
4  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. shortening
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Let yeast and water set until dissolved.  Mix all ingredients. Let rise until doubled in bulk.  Roll out, cut and rise until doubled again.  Fry at 365°.  Add sugar or leave plain.

name: 10 MINUTE GERMAN SWEET CHOCOLATE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. Baker's German's sweet chocolate
1/3  c. milk
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
8-inch graham cracker crumb pie crust
preparation: Heat chocolate and 2 tablespoons of the milk in saucepan over low heat, stirring until chocolate is melted.  Beat sugar into cream cheese.  Add remaining milk and chocolate mixture and beat until smooth.  Fold in Cool Whip, blending until smooth.  Spoon into crust.  Freeze until firm, about 4 hours.  Garnish with chocolate curls, if desired.  Store any leftover pie in freezer.

name: TUNA BURGERS
ingredients:
1 small  can tuna
1  can cream of mushroom soup
sliced bread
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix tuna and soup together.  Season with salt and pepper. Spread on bread to make a sandwich.  Toast sandwich on both sides in the oven.

name: SPICY RICE DISH
ingredients:
2  c. cooked rice
2  c. sour cream
6  oz. chopped chili peppers
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese, chopped or shredded
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Mix rice and sour cream.  Put 1/2 of rice mixture in buttered casserole dish.  Sprinkle on Cheddar cheese and chili peppers.  Dot with butter.  Layer rest of rice mixture on top.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Dot with butter.  Cook at 350° for 1 hour.  Don't let it dry out.

name: FAST FIXIN' CHOCOLATE CHIP CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. devil's food cake mix
1/4  c. oil
2  eggs
1 1/4  c. water
1  pkg. chocolate instant pudding (4 serving size)
1  c. chocolate chips (6 oz.)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Mix ingredients 2 minutes until blended.  Spread batter evenly in pan. Bake 35 to 45 minutes until toothpick near center comes out clean. Cooled cake may be sprinkled with powdered sugar.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  cup red food coloring
3  tsp. Nestle's Nesquik Chocolate
1/2  cup Crisco
3  eggs
2  1/2 cups cake flour
1  tsp. soda
1  1/2 cups sugar
1  cup buttermilk
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix food coloring and chocolate to make a paste.  Cream Crisco and sugar.  Add eggs.  Mix.  Add paste mixture.  Sift dry ingredients together.  Add  buttermilk and vanilla.  Mix real good.  Bake 350 degrees 25 - 30 minutes or until done.  Use three 8 inch pans.

name: ARROZ BLANCO(White Rice)
ingredients:
1  c. rice
2  c. water
3  Tbsp. olive oil or any oil
2  tsp. salt
preparation: In a heavy kettle or pot, heat 2 cups water with 2 teaspoons salt.  When water is at a rolling boil, add rice.   Stir and bring to a second boil.  Let it cook, uncovered, at high heat until water is absorbed (about 5 to 8 minutes).  Add 3 tablespoons olive oil.  Stir and simmer, covered, on low heat for 10 minutes more or until tender.

name: MINIATURE HAM PUFFS
ingredients:
1  c. water
3  cans deviled ham
1/4  c. margarine
1/3  c. sour cream
1  c. flour
3/4  tsp. onion salt
4  eggs
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Heat water and margarine to rolling boil in 3-quart saucepan. Stir in flour. Stir vigorously until mixture forms a ball, about 1 minute.  Remove from heat. Beat in eggs, all at once, until smooth and glossy.  Drop dough by rounded spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake until golden brown, puffed and dry, about 25 minutes. Cool on wire racks. Blend ham, sour cream and salt.  Just before serving, cut off puffs with sharp knife. Fill each puff with a teaspoon of ham mixture.  Makes 5 to 6 dozen appetizers.

name: ANN'S LINGUINI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. linguini, broken in half
1  medium cucumber, chopped
1  medium red onion, chopped
2  tomatoes, chopped
2  green peppers, chopped
1  packet salad seasonings
1  bottle Viva Italian dressing
preparation: After cooking linguini, rinse with cold water.  Mix all ingredients in large bowl.  Use all of the salad seasoning and all of the Italian dressing.  Mix well.  Refrigerate for 6 hours.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  qt. milk
1  c. rice
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook in slow cooker on high until rice is done.  Stir a few times.  After rice is done, beat eggs and vanilla.

name: HAM AND CHEESE LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. boiled ham, sliced
1  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
24  oz. chili sauce, mixed with 2 tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Place slice of ham in baking dish.  Spread on top of slice 1 tablespoon chili sauce and sprinkle with cheese.  Continue for size of loaf desired.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Cool and place in refrigerator.

name: NO-FOOL PIE
ingredients:
3/4  stick (6 Tbsp.) margarine
1  c. self-rising flour
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
1 to 1 1/2  c. drained fruit
preparation: Melt margarine in 8 or 9-inch baking dish while preheating 350° oven.  Set aside.  Combine flour, sugar and milk, stirring until dry ingredients are moistened thoroughly.  Pour batter over melted margarine.  Do not mix.  Place drained fruit over top of this mixture.  Do not stir to combine.  Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until lightly browned and center springs back when touched.

name: NUTTY CHEESE BARS
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
3/4  c. butter, melted
1 1/2  c. chopped walnuts or pecans (divided 3/4 c. and 3/4 c.)
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. packed brown sugar
preparation: Base:  Stir together in a medium bowl until well mixed the butter, cake mix (dry) and 3/4 cup chopped pecans or walnuts. Press mixture evenly into the 9 x 13-inch baking pan.

name: BEEF STICK
ingredients:
5  lb. ground beef
4  Tbsp. Morton Quick salt
2 1/2  tsp. garlic salt
2 1/2  tsp. mustard seed
2  tsp. medium ground pepper
1  tsp. liquid smoke
preparation: Mix and refrigerate, kneading once a day, for 3 days.  Shape into rolls and bake for 10 hours at 150°.

name: FRUIT-NUT SNACK MIX
ingredients:
4  c. bite size twist pretzels
1  c. dried tart cherries
1  c. salted mixed nuts
1  c. banana chips
preparation: Combine  all  ingredients.  Store  in covered container about 1 week.  Makes 7 cups.

name: PINWHEEL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
2/3  c. sweet milk
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. shortening
1  lb. pork sausage
preparation: Make dough; roll thin.  Spread on sausage (which is at room temperature).  Roll up like a jelly roll and chill.  Slice thin and bake in moderate oven at 350° until cookies are light brown.

name: BAKED SPINACH BALLS
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach
6  eggs
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
3/4  c. butter, softened
1  Tbsp. chopped, fresh parsley
salt and pepper to taste
2  c. stuffing mix, crushed
preparation: Cook spinach following directions; drain well.  Set aside. Heat oven to 350°.  In medium bowl, combine eggs, cheese, butter, parsley, salt and pepper.  Mix well.  Stir in spinach and stuffing mix.  Shape into small balls.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake about 10 minutes.  Serve warm.  Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

name: MY FAVORITE CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  large cream cheese, softened to room temperature
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drain on a paper towel
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
3/4  c. chopped pecans
1  Tbsp. seasoned salt
3/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine onions, 3/4 cup pecans and salt.  Using a mixer, mix cream cheese with onion, nuts and salt.  Chill in same bowl.  When chilled, about 1 hour, shape mixture into a ball and roll in 1/2 to 3/4 cup chopped pecans.  Refrigerate.  Serve with whole wheat crackers.

name: TEX MEX DIP
ingredients:
2  cans Fritos bean dip
2  cans guacamole dip
1  c. sour cream, mixed with 1/2 c. mayo and 1 pkg. Lawry's taco seasoning
2  to 3 tomatoes, seeded and chopped, mixed with 2 bunches chopped green onions with tops
1  c. shredded Cheddar and 1 c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1 small  can chopped black olives
preparation: Layer in order given on platter or shallow dish.

name: PINA COLADA DRESSING
ingredients:
1 (8.5 oz.)  can cream of coconut
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. coconut
1  tsp. apple cider vinegar
1/2  tsp. rum extract
preparation: Combine all ingredients in small mixing bowl and beat until well blended.  Store in airtight container in refrigerator. Yields about 1 1/2 cups of dressing.

name: MOUSSAKA(Greek Dish)
ingredients:
1  c. oil in skillet (more if needed)
eggplant, sliced and fried
squash, sliced and fried
onion, sliced and fried
ground meat, fried
tomato paste
1/4  lb. margarine
1/4  c. flour
1  c. milk
1  egg
preparation: Make alternate layers of vegetables and meat.  Cover with the tomato paste mixed with a bit of water in a large baking pan. Cover with cream sauce made of margarine, flour and milk.  Add egg to cream sauce after sauce is thick.  Bake about 1 hour at 350°.

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
3  slices bacon, crumbled
1/3  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. green peppers, chopped
1/2  lb. Velveeta
1/4  c. chopped pimento
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  c. cooked, cubed chicken
1/4  c. milk
1/2  lb. spaghetti, cooked and drained
preparation: Lightly brown the onion and green peppers in bacon drippings. Combine all ingredients.  Pour into casserole dish and bake at 375° until bubbly and browned on top.

name: CHICKEN HOT DISH
ingredients:
10  oz. pkg. frozen chopped broccoli (cook and drain)
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. real mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice (optional)
1  chicken, cooked, boned and skinned
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. toasted bread cubes
preparation: Heat soup; drain broccoli.  Combine all and top with bread cubes.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serves 12.

name: GREEN BEAN CATALINA
ingredients:
2 large  cans whole green beans
1  lb. bacon
1  bottle Catalina dressing
preparation: Bundle 5 green beans and secure with bacon.  Place all bundles in a baking dish.  Cover with Catalina dressing and bake at 340° for 30 minutes.

name: SOLE IN PARSLEY SAUCE
ingredients:
16  oz. sole fillets
1  pkg. vegetable bouillon
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. carrots, chopped
1/4  c. celery, chopped
3  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. skim milk
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1/8  tsp. marjoram
salt and pepper
preparation: In medium saucepan, over medium heat, dissolve bouillon in 1/2 cup water.  Add carrots and celery.  Simmer 10 minutes.   Drain vegetables, reserving liquid for sauce.  Sprinkle fillets with salt and pepper.  Place 2 tablespoons vegetable mixture in center of each fillet.  Roll up and secure with toothpick.

name: PEEK-A-BOOS
ingredients:
1/2  stick (1/4 c.) butter
12  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1  bag Kisses, "Hugs" or chocolate stars
preparation: Heat the butter and chocolate chips over medium heat in a heavy saucepan until mixture is smooth and creamy.  Add the milk and stir until well blended and smooth.  Add the vanilla and flour and mix very well.  The bottom of the mixture will pull away from the sides of the pan and will look like one large "glob."  Take a small tablespoon of dough and roll into a ball in the palm of your hand. Push a Kiss, Hug or chocolate star into the center of the ball of dough.  Pull the dough up around until candy is covered.  Place on an ungreased baking sheet.  Bake in a 350° oven for 6 minutes.  Do not overbake!

name: PINEAPPLE PASSION
ingredients:
2 (8 1/2 oz.)  cans pineapple tidbits
1/4  c. lime juice
1  tsp. rum flavoring
preparation: Combine all ingredients in blender container.  Cover and blend at high speed until pineapple is finely crushed.  While blender is running, add 6 ice cubes one at a time.  Trim glasses with lime wedges.  Serves 4.

name: MISSISSIPPI MUD CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. margarine
1  c. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. unsweetened cocoa
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  can Eagle Brand milk
miniature marshmallows
1  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In small saucepan, melt 1 cup margarine, stir in 1/4 cup cocoa, then water.  In large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, soda and salt.  Add cocoa mixture; beat well.  Stir in 1/3 cup Eagle Brand milk, eggs and vanilla.  Pour into 15 x 10-inch pan.  Bake 15 minutes.  Top with marshmallows and bake until melted.  In small saucepan, melt remaining 1/4 cup margarine; stir in 1/4 cup cocoa and remaining Eagle Brand.  Sti in powdered sugar and nuts.  Spread on warm cake.

name: CHOCOLATE-COVERED CHERRY COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. unsweetened cocoa powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 (10 oz.)  jar maraschino cherries
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1/2  c. Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
preparation: In a large bowl, stir together flour, cocoa powder, salt, baking powder and baking soda.  In mixer bowl, beat together butter or margarine and sugar on low speed of electric mixer until fluffy.  Add egg and vanilla; beat well.  Gradually add dry ingredients to creamed mixture; beat until well blended.

name: CHRISTINA'S KIELBASA DINNER
ingredients:
1  pkg. kielbasa
1/2  lb. fettuccine
1/4  c. onions, chopped
3/4  c. corn
3/4  c. peas
1  c. heavy cream
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
garlic to taste
seasoning salt to taste
preparation: Prepare fettuccine, drain; melt butter in skillet.  Add onion, then vegetables; cook until tender, set aside.  Brown kielbasa and drain.  Combine kielbasa, vegetables and cream; simmer.  Add cheese, parsley, garlic and seasoning salt.  Combine with fettuccine.  Serves 5 to 6.

name: DIRT PIE
ingredients:
3  c. cold milk
2 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1  c. confectioners sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
1  stick butter
1 large  pkg. Oreo cookies
preparation: Crush Oreo cookies and set aside.  Soften cream cheese and butter.  Mix milk with instant pudding.  Add confectioners sugar, cream cheese and butter to pudding.  Mix well.  Alternate layers of pudding and cookies in a 9 x 13-inch dish with cookie layer on bottom and top.  Chill several hours or overnight.

name: GOLDEN BROWN CHIVE ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
6  large baking potatoes
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shredded or grated cheese
3  Tbsp. bread crumbs
1/4  c. butter, melted
4  Tbsp. freshly chopped chives
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Peel potatoes and place in a bowl of cold water until ready to use.  Dry thoroughly and cut a thin slice off the long side of each potato so it  can sit flat.  Cut vertical slits from the top almost to the bottom of each potato, being careful not to cut through it.  Dip the cut potatoes in melted butter and sprinkle with salt.

name: D.T.'S FAVORITE STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
4  Tbsp. sour cream
8  oz. Pepperidge Farm mix
1  carton whole mushrooms (large)
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Take mushroom and remove stems to have center to fill.  Mix together sour cream, cream of mushroom soup, and Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix.  Put in center of mushrooms.  Place mushrooms in melted margarine.  Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.  Add parsley on top before cooking.

name: CHICKEN AND SHRIMP
ingredients:
2  lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1/2  onion, chopped
1  c. Port wine
16  oz. tomato sauce
3  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. dried basil
1 to 1 1/2  lb. raw shrimp, cleaned and deveined
olive oil
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In large frying pan, brown chicken and onion in olive oil. When browned, add rest of ingredients except shrimp.  Cover and simmer about 45 minutes until chicken is tender.  Add shrimp and simmer about ten minutes longer.  Serve over rice.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: Chess Pie
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
3  eggs
1  Tbsp. corn meal
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
juice of 1 lemon
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Cream together sugar and butter.  Add eggs and beat well.  Add corn meal and mix well.  Add lemon juice and mix well.  Add flour and mix well.  Add milk and mix well.  Spread mixture in an 8-inch pie crust.  Bake at 325° for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. orange jello
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  c. water
1 small  carton cottage cheese
1  pkg. Dream Whip
preparation: Combine jello, pineapple and water.  Bring to a boil and cool. Add cottage cheese and Dream Whip.  Refrigerate.

name: CRANBERRY PIE
ingredients:
2  c. fresh cranberries
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1/2  c. margarine or butter, melted
1/4  c. shortening, melted
preparation: Grease 10-inch pie plate.  Spread cranberries on bottom. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar and nuts over cranberries.  Mix the rest of the ingredients together; pour over top of cranberry mixture. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: CRISPY POTATO WEDGES
ingredients:
4  medium Russet potatoes, cut in large wedges
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/4  tsp. freshly ground black pepper
1/8  tsp. salt
2  cloves garlic, minced (optional)
ketchup (optional)
preparation: Place potatoes in large bowl; add cold water to cover.  Let stand 15 minutes.  Preheat oven to 425°.  Spray nonstick baking sheet with vegetable cooking spray; set aside.  Drain potatoes in colander and spread on double layer of paper towels.  Cover with second layer of paper towels.  Press down on towels to dry potatoes.  Transfer potatoes to clean large bowl.  Sprinkle with oil, pepper and salt; toss gently to combine.  Arrange seasoned potatoes in single layer on prepared baking sheet and bake 20 minutes.  Using spatula, turn potatoes; sprinkle with garlic. Bake until golden, about 20 minutes, turning baking sheet after 10 minutes for even browning.

name: BLT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  pizza crust (12-inches)
1/3  c. mayonnaise
4  plum tomatoes, sliced
1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
8  slices bacon, cooked, drained and cut into quarters
1  c. shredded lettuce
salt and pepper
preparation: Spread pizza crust with mayo, then layer tomatoes, cheese and bacon.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 450° for 5 to 7 minutes or until cheese melts.  Top with lettuce and serve.

name: BEEF NOODLE BAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  Tbsp. chopped onions (I put more)
1  Tbsp. salt
3  oz. cream cheese
1  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. sugar
2 (8 oz. size)  cans tomato sauce
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/4 sauce  can water
1  bag egg noodles
preparation: Brown meat and onions; drain.  Add salt, sugar, tomato sauce and water.  Cook at low heat for 20 minutes.  Cook and drain noodles.  Add cream cheese as soon as noodles are drained and cheese will melt.  Add sour cream.  Put layer of noodles and layer of meat, etc.  (I put noodles on bottom because there is not enough to layer.)   Sprinkle grated cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: MOO GOO GAI PAN
ingredients:
2  whole chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch squares
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. oil
1  c. sliced celery
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
1  sliced green pepper
1  can water chestnuts
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Shake pieces of chicken with salt and cornstarch.  Stir-fry in hot oil until chicken turns white.  Add mushrooms with liquid, green peppers, water chestnuts and soy sauce.  Cook for 4 minutes. Serve with rice.

name: THE BEST DRESSING
ingredients:
1  large pan prebaked cornbread
1  large bag stuffing mix (Pepperidge Farm, herb)
1  large onion, chopped fine
3  stalks celery, chopped
1  stick butter
sage to taste
2  cans chicken or turkey broth (2 c.)
preparation: Bake cornbread.  Saute onions and celery until transparent in butter.  Mix all ingredients in a large bowl until mixed thoroughly.  Press into 2 (15 x 9-inch) pans.  If you want, you can boil fresh chicken for chicken broth and save meat for giblet gravy.

name: VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onions
1 to 2  Tbsp. chopped garlic
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can beef broth
2  c. water
2  tsp. sugar
1/2  Tbsp. salt
dash of pepper
15  oz. tomato sauce
16  oz. pkg. frozen mixed veggies
2  or 3 potatoes
1  c. elbow noodles
30  oz. jar spaghetti sauce (chunky, garden style with mushrooms, peppers)
preparation: Cook first 3 ingredients in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.  Brown and drain.  Add spaghetti sauce and next 6 ingredients.  Bring to a boil.  Cook, then dice the potatoes. Cook macaroni.  Add potatoes and macaroni to pot.  Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Stir in frozen veggies.  Return to a boil.  Cover and simmer 10 to 12 minutes or until veggies are tender.  Yield:  12 cups.

name: PINK LADY CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. shortening or 1/2 lb. butter
4  eggs
1  box white cake mix
1  box strawberry jello
10  oz. frozen strawberries
1  Tbsp. strawberry juice, add water to make 1/2 c.
preparation: Add all the ingredients and beat well.  Put in three layer pans.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  boxes Jiffy cornbread mix
2  sticks margarine, melted
4  eggs
1 (8 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
1  medium onion, chopped
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli
preparation: Mix all together; bake at 400° about 30 minutes until tests done.  Use a 13 x 9-inch pan.

name: BLACK-EYED PEA SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans black-eyed peas with jalapenos, drained
1  red onion, chopped
1  can sliced black olives, drained
1  bell pepper, chopped
2  avocados, chopped
2  tomatoes, chopped
1  bottle (medium) Italian salad dressing
preparation: Put all vegetables in a bowl.  Pour Italian dressing over vegetables.  Cover and marinate in refrigerator overnight.  This keeps well for several days.

name: BANANA TEA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1 1/3  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/4  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. light rum or milk
1  tsp. almond extract
2  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. mashed ripe bananas
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
powdered sugar (to sprinkle on top)
preparation: Combine butter and sugar in a large mixing bowl; cream until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, sour cream, rum and almond extract, mixing well.  Combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with mashed bananas, mixing well after each addition.  Stir in pecans.  Pour batter into 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done. If loaf gets too brown, cover with foil.  Remove from pan; cool. Sprinkle sugar.

name: EASY LOBSTER NEWBURGH GREEN LAKE
ingredients:
2  cans Atlantic brand Newburgh sauce
1  lb. lobster meat
1  pt. medium cream
2  pkg. Pepperidge Farm patty shells
preparation: Combine Newburgh sauce with cream to desired consistency over medium heat.  Add chunked lobster meat and spoon over cooked patty shells.  Serves approximately 6.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked rice
1 large  pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked
1  can cream of celery or cream of onion soup
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
preparation: Mix everything together in casserole.  Microwave on High for about 20 minutes.

name: ORANGE-COCONUT BALLS
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. vanilla wafers
1  lb. box powdered sugar
1/2  c. margarine, softened
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice, thawed and undiluted
1  c. finely chopped nuts
1 (7 oz.)  can flaked coconut
preparation: Crush vanilla wafers to fine crumbs.  Add next 4 ingredients, mixing well. Form into balls and roll each in flaked coconut. Freeze. Serve frozen.  Yields 6 dozen.

name: APRICOT-OATMEAL BARS
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  beaten egg
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. plain yogurt
1/3  c. water
1/4  c. molasses
1/4  c. oil
1  c. quick cooking oats
3/4  c. snipped dried apricots
1/2  c. raisins
3/4  c. powdered sugar
1 to 2  Tbsp. orange juice
preparation: Combine the flours, salt, soda and cinnamon.  Mix egg, brown sugar, yogurt, water, molasses and oil. Stir into flour mixture. Mix well.  Stir in oats, apricots and raisins.  Spread in a Pam sprayed 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.  Cool.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped spinach
1 (1.4 oz.)  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup and recipe mix
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
3  green onions, chopped
preparation: Stir  all  ingredients  until  well  mixed.  Cover  and chill. Hollow  out  a  loaf  of  pumpernickel bread leaving a shell like a boat.  Cut bread taken from inside into bite size pieces.  Fill the  hollowed  loaf  with spinach dip and place bread  pieces around  the  outside.  May  also be served with crackers or vegetables.  Makes 3 cups dip.

name: LUAU RIBS
ingredients:
4  lb. meaty spareribs
2 (4 1/2 oz.)  jars strained peaches (baby food)
1/3  c. catsup
1/3  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  tsp. salt
pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Place spareribs in 450° oven for 15 minutes.  Spoon off fat.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours continually basting with sauce.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker crust (reduced fat)
1 small  box sugar-free Jell-O (can be any kind to coordinate with one container reduced-fat yogurt)
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Melt Jell-O in 1/4 cup of warm water. Then blend the yogurt into the Jell-O. Then you blend in the Cool Whip. Put into the crust and let chill. That's it!  ENJOY.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1  box pistachio instant dry pudding
15  oz. crushed pineapple and juice
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  small Cool Whip
1  c. nuts
cherries
preparation: Mix and chill.

name: APRICOT GLAZED PORK ROAST(Crock Pot)
ingredients:
1  can Campbell's Condensed Chicken Broth
1 - 18  oz. jar apricot preserves
1  large onion, sliced
2  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
4  lbs. boneless pork loin roast
preparation: Mix broth, preserves, onion and mustard in slow cooker.  Add pork and turn to coat.  Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours. If you wish to have shredded pork, just cook longer.

name: OLD FASHIONED GOULASH
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
1  lb. cheese (American)
1  medium onion
1  c. Ragu spaghetti sauce
2  lb. hamburger
1 1/2  boxes elbow macaroni
preparation: Brown hamburg and onion in skillet, then add canned tomatoes and Ragu sauce.  Bring to low boil, then add cheese.  Simmer until cheese is completely melted.  Boil elbows until done, then mix together.

name: SOUR CREAM CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising corn meal
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
2  eggs
1 small  can cream-style corn
1/4  c. oil
preparation: Mix all together in bowl.  Mix well but do not stir more than 2 minutes.  Pour into hot, well-greased iron skillet.  Bake at 425° for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: SHRIMP OR CRAWFISH MOLD
ingredients:
2  lb. shrimp or crawfish
1  (8 oz.) Philadelphia cream cheese
3/4  c. onion, chopped
3/4  c. celery, chopped
1  can Campbell's tomato soup
1 1/2  Tbsp. Knox gelatine (unflavored)
1  c. mayo
preparation: Boil shrimp in crab boil bag; peel and chop, or chop fresh or frozen crawfish (thawed).  Dilute gelatine in 1/4 cup water (mix and stir).  In Magnalite, bring soup to a boil.  Remove from fire. Add cream cheese and gelatine mix.  Let cool.  Add celery, onion, mayo and meat.  (Add red pepper and salt if not boiling in seasoning bag.)  Spray mold with Pam.  Pour in mold.  Refrigerate overnight.  Serve on tray with decorated lettuce.  Serve with Ritz crackers.

name: SWEET POTATO BALLS
ingredients:
6  baked sweet potatoes, peeled and mashed with 3 Tbsp.  butter
pinch of nutmeg and allspice
1  bag large marshmallows
corn flake crumbs
preparation: This should be sticky to form a ball.  Place a large marshmallow in the center.  Don't let it show.  Roll in corn flake crumbs and fry until brown.  This compliments any dish and it is so easy to fix.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans cream-style corn
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Put in casserole and cover with 20 crushed crackers which have been mixed with 1 stick of melted oleo.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: SUGAR-FREE GLAZED FRUIT
ingredients:
3  bananas
1  can pineapple tidbits in own juice
1  can tropical fruit in own juice
1/2  tub sugar-free Tang
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. sugar-free vanilla pudding
preparation: Sprinkle Tang over sliced bananas.  Drain pineapple and fruit (reserve 1/3 cup juice).  Sprinkle dry pudding over all fruit. Mix lightly and refrigerate.

name: KAVARMA(Bulgarian)
ingredients:
2  lb. pork
1  lb. veal liver
5  peppers
4-5 onions
2  tomatoes
1  cup mushrooms
1/3  cup white wine
1/2  cup sunflower oil
Savory, paprika, pepper, parsley to taste
preparation: Cut meat into small pieces and fry in oil and water.  Add the onions.  When tender, add sliced mushrooms, peppers, tomatoes, wine, savory, salt and parsley with a little water and mix.  Pour into earthenware dish or bowl.  Bake at 375F for 30-40 minutes.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
16  oz. noodles (curly vegetable noodles), cooked and drained
1  can black olives
1  can mushrooms or fresh ones
10  oz. pkg. chopped broccoli or fresh
8  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1 +  c. creamy Italian dressing
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and chill.  If making ahead of time, add cheeses at serving time.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1 large  can pumpkin
4  eggs
3  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. allspice
3  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. ginger
2  prepared pie shells
preparation: Mix all ingredients as listed and turn into 2 prepared pie shells.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then turn oven down to 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
1  c. onion
1  c. carrots
1  c. celery
1  c. potatoes
2  c. broccoli
1/2  c. green pepper
1 (49 1/2 oz.)  can chicken broth
1/2  c. flour
2  c. milk
16  oz. Velveeta cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Dice all vegetables.  I put through my food processor.  Add all vegetables to the can of chicken broth. Simmer until vegetables are tender.  Mix milk with flour slowly.  Combine with broth and vegetables.  Boil and let thicken for 5 to 10 minutes. Add cheese.  Simmer for 10 minutes.

name: SPICY CAJUN POPCORN TOPPING
ingredients:
1  c. pecan halves
1/2  c. butter (1 stick)
1/2  tsp. each dry mustard and garlic powder
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
preparation: Place in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave for 30 to 45 seconds on High until butter is melted.  Keep warm. Add to popcorn as desired.

name: JIFFY SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
1  can creamed corn (don't drain)
1  c. sour cream
1  c. shredded cheese
1  Jiffy corn muffin mix
1  can whole corn (don't drain)
2  eggs
1/2  c. melted butter
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add sour cream, butter and corn.  Fold in Jiffy mix and cheese.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: RASPBERRY KISSES
ingredients:
3  egg whites
1/8  tsp. salt
3 1/2  Tbsp. raspberry fruit-flavored gelatin
3/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. chocolate bits (mini chips)
preparation: Beat egg whites with salt until foamy.  Combine gelatin with sugar.  Add gradually to the egg whites, beating to stiff peaks. Make sure sugar is well dissolved by rubbing a bit of the mixture between your fingers.  It should not feel grainy.  Blend in vinegar, then fold in chocolate.  Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased brown paper-lined or nonstick pans.  Bake 25 minutes in a preheated 250° oven.  Then turn off oven, but do not remove cookies for another 20 minutes.  The kisses are light and fragile, remove carefully with spatula.  Ideal for those on low-cholesterol diet.

name: ANCHOVY GARLIC BREAD(Pane con Acciughe)
ingredients:
1  loaf Italian or French bread
4  oz. butter
2  cloves garlic, crushed
2  Tbsp. olive oil
6  to 8 anchovy fillets, finely chopped
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. fresh parsley, chopped
preparation: Cut loaf of bread  in  halves lengthwise.  Place halves on baking sheet.  Cream butter,  garlic  and oil in bowl until fluffy.  Mix in remaining  ingredients  and  spread  on bread. Place bread under broiler  until  it  starts  to  bubble.  Cut diagonally to serve.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: PORK WITH CHINESE FLAVOR
ingredients:
8  oz. medium egg noodles (4 c.)
6  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  lb. pork, cut into 8 strips
1  c. thinly sliced celery strips
1  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. ginger
1  Tbsp. soy sauce (or as desired)
preparation: Cook noodles, drain and rinse.  Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large skillet.  Tilt to coat evenly.  Add egg and tilt again.  When egg is set, remove.  Cut into strips.  Set aside.  In same skillet, cook pork in 2 more tablespoons oil until browned.  Add celery and onion; cook 2 minutes.  Add chicken broth.  Combine cornstarch, salt, pepper, ginger and soy sauce.  Stir into pork mixture.  Cook and stir until thickened and boil 1 minute.  Remove.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
chicken (whole or favorite parts)
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  c. chicken broth
1  pkg. stuffing mix
preparation: Pull chicken apart and place on bottom of pan.  Spread both cans of soup over chicken.  Cover top with stuffing mix.  Pour chicken broth over top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BAKED BREAKFAST
ingredients:
6  eggs
1  tsp. dry mustard
8  slices bread
1  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1/2  lb. ham in chunks or pieces
preparation: Beat eggs, salt, mustard and milk as for scrambled eggs.  Cut bread into pieces.  Mix cheese, bread and ham.  Add eggs mixture. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350°  for 1 hour.

name: PINA COLADA CAKE II
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  can crushed pineapple in juice
1  Tbsp. rum flavoring
1  c. shredded coconut
1  can vanilla frosting
preparation: Mix cake mix as directed.  Instead of water use pineapple juice from the pineapple.  Add other ingredients and bake at 350°.

name: STUFFED JALAPENO PEPPERS
ingredients:
1  doz. green pickled jalapeno peppers
1 small  can potted meat
2  Tbsp. sweet relish
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  doz. salted crackers, crumbled
preparation: Mix potted meat, pickle relish, mayonnaise and enough cracker crumbs to make a thick meat paste.  Cut the tips off peppers; remove seeds and membrane.  Fill peppers with mixture.  Serve as hors d'oeuvres.

name: HOLIDAY FRUIT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. soft shortening
2  c. brown sugar, packed
2  eggs
1/2  c. sour milk or buttermilk
3 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. pecans
2  c. candied cherries, chopped
2  c. chopped dates
preparation: Combine shortening, sugar and eggs.  Mix and stir in sour milk.  Sift dry ingredients together and stir in pecans, cherries and dates.	Chill at least 1 hour.	Preheat oven to 400°.  Drop by teaspoonfuls about 2-inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.  Makes about 8 dozen.

name: TURKEY MEDALLIONS WITH ORANGE TERIYAKI SAUCE(Light and Easy)
ingredients:
light corn oil spread
1/2  small onion, minced
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
2  tsp. white horseradish
6  small carrots, cut in 1-inch slices
1/4  lb. Chinese pea pods
1  Tbsp. light teriyaki sauce
1  tsp. flour
1  celery stalk, minced
1/2  tsp. salt
1  lb. ground turkey
chopped parsley
1/3  c. orange juice
parsley sprig for garnish
preparation: In a 1-quart saucepan over medium heat in 2 teaspoons corn oil, cook celery, onion, salt and ginger until tender.  In medium bowl, mix turkey, vegetable mix, horseradish and 1 tablespoon chopped parsley until blended.  With slightly dampened hands, shape turkey mixture into 8 medallions.

name: EGGNOG PUDDING AND PIE FILLING
ingredients:
2  c. eggnog
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. heavy cream, whipped
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. almond extract
1 large  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  baked 9-inch pie shell
preparation: Mix gelatin, sugar and salt.  Gradually stir in eggnog.  Warm over direct low heat until gelatin is dissolved.  Chill until mixture mounds when dropped from spoon.  Fold in whipped cream, flavorings and 1 1/2 cups fruit cocktail.   Chill again for 5 to 10 minutes.  Heap into pie shell; decorate with remaining fruit cocktail.  Chill 2 to 3 hours.

name: LAYERED STRAWBERRY CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
2  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. reduced-calorie margarine, melted
1/2  c. water
4  eggs
1 (16 oz.)  carton low-fat cottage cheese
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. instant dry milk powder
1/4  c. flour
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. vanilla extract
1/8  tsp. salt
4  c. fresh strawberries, washed and hulled
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. unsweetened orange juice
preparation: Combine cracker crumbs, 2 tablespoons sugar and margarine. Press evenly into bottom of a 9-inch pan.  Combine water, eggs, cottage cheese, 1/2 cup sugar, dry milk, flour, lemon juice, vanilla and salt in an electric blender.  Process 1 minute or until smooth.  Pour into crust.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Turn off heat and leave in oven 1 hour.  Set aside to cool.

name: CELERY DELIGHT
ingredients:
3  c. fresh celery
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 (5 oz.)  can water chestnuts, sliced
1 (2 oz.)  can sliced pimento
1/4  c. butter
1/2  c. slivered almonds
1/2  c. bread crumbs (can use Pepperidge Farm dressing)
preparation: Cook celery in salted water (boiling) for 8 minutes; drain. Combine celery, undiluted soup, pimentos and water chestnuts. Turn into 6-cup casserole.  Heat butter until hot; add almonds and stir until pale brown.   Scatter over casserole; scatter crumbs over top (can be mixed with almonds, if desired, first).  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. sweet potatoes, mashed
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
3  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  c. sour cream
pinch of salt
pinch of baking soda
marshmallow, pecans or raisins (for topping, optional)
preparation: Boil 4 large, unpeeled sweet potatoes or enough to make 3 cups when mashed.  Peel and place in mixing bowl.  Mash well with a fork.  With a wooden spoon, stir in the sugar, butter, eggs, vanilla, nutmeg and sour cream.  Mix well.  Add salt and baking soda and stir.  Spread the mixture in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish and bake uncovered at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.  When done, place marshmallows on top and put casserole back into the oven until marshmallows melt and are lightly browned.  This dish can also be topped with pecans or raisins.  Serves 6.

name: STUFFED BELL PEPPERS
ingredients:
4  extra large or 8 small bell peppers
2  lb. ground beef
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. onion flakes or chopped onion
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
5  Tbsp. catsup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. cooked rice
preparation: Cut large pepper in half and remove seeds.  Place in roasting pan.  Mix 3 tablespoons catsup and 3 tablespoons mushroom soup in a small bowl.  Mix all other ingredients in a large bowl.  Mix with hands until well blended.  Fill peppers until all mixture is used (heaping, if necessary).  Use mixture in small bowl to spread over top.  Fill pan 1/4 full with water.  Cook in 325° oven for 1 1/2 hours.  Freeze leftover cooked peppers in foil for later use.

name: DAKOTA BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. active dry yeast
1/2  c. warm water (105~ to 110~)
2  Tbsp. sunflower oil
1  egg
1/2  c. cottage cheese
1/4  c. honey
1  tsp. salt
2 to 2 1/2  c. bread flour
1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1/4  c. wheat germ
1/4  c. rye flour
1/4  c. rolled oats
cornmeal
preparation: Sprinkle yeast in warm water; stir to dissolve.  In a large bowl, mix sunflower oil, egg, cottage cheese, honey and salt.  Add dissolved yeast and 2 cups bread flour, beating until flour is moistened.  Gradually stir in whole wheat flour, wheat germ, rye flour and oats, plus enough bread flour to make a soft dough.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2/3  c. ripe olives, chopped
1  Tbsp.chopped chives
1/3  c. walnuts, chopped
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
4  oz. Bleu cheese
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Blend all ingredients.  Shape into a ball.  Chill.  Roll in chopped nuts.  (Can be frozen.)

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
15  oz. can crushed pineapple
1  can cherry pie filling
1  box butter cake mix
1  c. butter, melted
1  c. pecans
preparation: Grease 9 x 13 pan. Pour in cherry pie filling. Pour pineapple on top. Sprinkle with cake mix. Drizzle melted butter over top. Top with pecans. Bake at 350° until top is slightly brown, about 30 minutes.

name: POT ROAST IN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4 to 5  lb. rump roast
1  can tomato soup
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  tsp. ginger
1  onion
preparation: Pour mixture over top of roast then slice onion rings on top. Cover and bake at 325° for 3 1/2 to 4 hours.

name: BARBECUE CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
1  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. honey
1/4  c. sherry
2  tsp. brown sugar
1 (6 oz.)  can concentrated orange juice
2  tsp. ground ginger
1  tsp. onion powder
juice of 1 lemon
preparation: Mix ingredients and heat slowly.  Remove wing tips; dejoint middle and upper pieces.  Marinate wings for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  (I usually let them stand overnight in a tightly closed baggie, turning occasionally.)  Put in shallow pan and bake in oven for 1 hour at 275°, turn and baste wings and bake 40 minutes at 300°.  Wings will be dark and glazed.

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
4  lb. potatoes, cooked and shredded
8  hard-boiled eggs
2  mild onions
2  c. celery
3  c. salad dressing
3  tsp. mustard
1/4  c. vinegar
4  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/2  lb. bacon (optional)
1/2  lb. shredded cheese (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients and it is ready to serve.

name: MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
16  oz. cream cheese
1 (8 oz.)  jar salsa
1  chopped onion
1  chopped green pepper
1  chopped tomato
1  c. shredded Cheddar
sliced black olives
preparation: Cream together cream cheese and salsa.  Put in 9-inch pie plate and layer with vegetables.  Top with Cheddar cheese and black olives.  To make it low-fat, use fat-free cream cheese and low-fat Cheddar.  Enjoy with tortilla chips.  Yummy!

name: HEARTY MEAT SAUCE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, diced
1  small garlic clove, minced
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. oregano leaves
1/2  tsp. cracked pepper
preparation: About  45  minutes  before serving:  In 4 quart skillet over medium-high  heat,	cook  ground  beef, onion and garlic until pan juices evaporate and meat is well browned, stirring often. Add  tomatoes with their liquid and remaining ingredients, stirring to mix well  and  break  up  tomatoes over high heat, heat to boiling.  Reduce  heat  to low; cover and simmer 30 minutes to blend flavors, stirring occasionally.

name: SEVEN LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, torn in small pieces
1  box frozen peas
1  head cauliflower, torn up
8  to 10 strips bacon, crisped and broken
1  pkg. dry Hidden Valley ranch dressing
1  pt. mayonnaise
shredded cheese
preparation: Layer first six ingredients in large salad bowl.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Add cheese and toss before serving.

name: EASY PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter or margarine
1 (16 oz.)  box powdered sugar
1  c. peanut butter
6  Hershey bars
preparation: Place butter or margarine in 2-quart saucepan on low heat until butter is melted.  Add peanut butter; stir until creamy. Add the box of powdered sugar; stir until smooth consistency. Spread in a 9 x 9-inch square pan.  Lay Hershey bars on top. Place in oven on warm until Hershey bars are melted.  Remove from oven; spread evenly.  Chill 1 hour before serving.

name: PEANUT BUTTER POPCORN
ingredients:
1/2  c. popcorn
1/3  c. white corn syrup
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
preparation: Pop popcorn.  Combine corn syrup and brown sugar and cook until hot and bubbly.  Stir in peanut butter and cook until blended.  Pour over corn and stir in.

name: DATE BALLS
ingredients:
1  egg, well beaten
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine or butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. chopped dates
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. Rice Krispies
1/2  c. finely chopped nuts
1  pkg. flaked coconut
preparation: Mix egg, sugar, margarine, salt and dates in saucepan.  Cook, stirring constantly, until dates are soft and mixture is thick. Place saucepan in ice water until mixture is cool enough to handle.  Add Rice Krispies and nuts; mix quickly.  Shape into small balls with buttered hands and roll each ball in coconut.

name: MICROWAVE RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. milk
1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. cooked rice
1/3  c. raisins
preparation: Lightly beat eggs.  Add other ingredients.  Pour into a 2-quart casserole.  Sprinkle with cinnamon.  Microwave 8 to 10 minutes, until thickened.  Stir every 2 minutes.

name: MILD JALAPENO CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. cornmeal
2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. salt
7  oz. can mild jalapeno peppers, chopped
1 1/2  c. minced onions
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
3  Tbsp. bacon drippings
preparation: Combine dry ingredients except salt in a large bowl.  Heat milk with salt until hot.  Add jalapenos and onions.  Cover and cook 30 minutes over low heat.  Cool.  Combine eggs and Cheddar cheese.  Blend dry ingredients, liquids, cheese mixture and bacon drippings until smooth.  Pour into a well-greased 9-inch square baking pan.  Bake in preheated 425° oven for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: TUNA BISCUIT POCKETS
ingredients:
1  pkg. Pillsbury layer buttermilk biscuits
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can tuna, drained and flaked
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. chopped green onion
2  Tbsp. chopped green or red bell peppers
1/4  c. water chestnuts
1/4  c. dry roasted peanuts
1/3  c. halved seedless grapes
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Combine all ingredients.  Separate biscuit dough into 10 biscuits on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Place 2 biscuits together, one on top of the other and press evenly to form a 4 1/2-inch circle.  Press edges with fork to seal.  Bake at 400° for 4 to 6 minutes until light brown.  Remove from cookie sheet; cool 5 minutes.  With knife, cut along edge 1/3 of way around to form pocket.  Open pocket and fill with about 1/2 cup tuna mixture. Garnish as desired.

name: CRANBERRY-ORANGE BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour *
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  c. margarine or butter, softened
1  Tbsp. grated orange peel
3/4  c. orange juice
1  egg
1  c. fresh or frozen cranberries, chopped
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: *If using self-rising flour, omit baking powder and salt. Decrease baking soda to 1/4 teaspoon.

name: HOT MEXICAN-STYLE SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  medium onion, chopped
2  tomatoes (about 12 oz.), peeled, seeded and chopped
2  Tbsp. jalapeno chilies (canned), chopped
1  (10 oz.) frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
2  c. Monterey Jack cheese, grated (about 7 oz.)
8  oz. cream cheese, cut into 1/2-inch pieces (room temperature)
1  c. half and half
2 (2.2 oz.)  cans sliced black olives, drained
1  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
salt and pepper
tortilla chips
preparation: Heat oil in heavy medium skillet over medium heat.  Add onion and saute until softened, stirring occasionally, about 4 minutes. Add tomatoes and chilies and cook 2 minutes.  Transfer mixture to large bowl and stir in spinach, Monterey Jack cheese, cream cheese, half and half, olives and vinegar.  Season with salt and pepper.  Spoon mixture into shallow ovenproof baking dish.  (Can be prepared 2 days ahead.)  Cover and refrigerate.  Preheat oven to 400°.  Bake until dip is bubbly and top is light brown, about 35 minutes.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
6  to 8 medium potatoes
1  stick oleo
1/2  lb. grated cheese
1/2  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Peel  and slice potatoes, (thin and oval shape).  Place one layer of potato slices in a deep casserole dish.  Dot with parts of	oleo  and  sprinkle  with salt and pepper.  Add one layer  of cheese.  Repeat  the  above  until all potatoes are used.  Pour milk  over	all.  Bake  at	350°  for 35 minutes. Serves 6.

name: SALSA DIP
ingredients:
c. salsa
c. cream cheese
preparation: Mix the salsa and cream cheese; dip with chips.

name: CHEESE POTATOES IN FOIL
ingredients:
3  Large Baking Potatoes (pared)
Cracked or coarsely Ground Pepper to taste
Salt to taste
4 or 5  Slices Bacon (cooked)
1  Large Onion (sliced)
1/2  lb. Sharp Cheese (cubed)
1  stick Butter or Margarine
preparation: Slice potatoes onto a large piece of foil.  Sprinkle with pepper and salt.  Crumble bacon over potatoes.  Add onion and cheese.  Dot with butter.  Wrap loosely and seal well with double fold.  Cook in 350 degree oven for about 1 hour or until done, turning occasionally.  Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. dark corn syrup
3  eggs
4  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. broken pecan nuts
preparation: Cook sugar and syrup until mixture thickens.  Beat eggs. Slowly add hot mixture to eggs, beating constantly.  Add butter, vanilla and nuts.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake in hot oven 10 minutes at 400°.  Reduce heat to 300° and bake 30 minutes. Cool and serve with or without whipped cream.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  lb. hamburger
5  large potatoes
2  large onions
1  jar Cheez Whiz
preparation: Layer hamburger, then layer potatoes and onions.  Cover those first layers with 1/2 of Cheez Whiz.  Layer again as before. Add the rest of the Cheez Whiz. Salt and pepper to taste.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN-AND-SHRIMP FLORENTINE
ingredients:
1  lb. unpeeled medium fresh shrimp
4  chicken breast halves, skinned and boned
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. dry white wine
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, cubed
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
2  Tbsp. fine dry bread crumbs
lemon slices, halved (optional)
parsley sprigs (optional)
additional cooked shrimp (optional)
preparation: Peel and  devein  shrimp;  set aside.  Sprinkle chicken with pepper and garlic powder; place in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking  pan.  Dot  with 2 tablespoons butter and pour wine over top. Broil 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned, turning once. Add  shrimp; broil 5 to 8 minutes more or until shrimp turns pink,  stirring  once.  Remove  from  oven, cool slightly.	 Drain drippings  and  reserve.	Cut  chicken  in bite-size pieces, set chicken and shrimp aside.

name: CHOCOLATE-MINT SHAMROCKS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
few drops green food color
3  c. Gold Medal all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. mint flavored semi-sweet chocolate chips, chopped
green sugar
preparation: Mix sugar, margarine, shortening, vanilla, eggs and food color in a large bowl.  Stir in flour, baking soda and salt.  Stir in chopped chocolate chips.  Divide dough into 4 parts.  Shape each part of dough into a roll, 1-inch in diameter and about 10 inches long.

name: "BEST IN THE WEST" BEAN BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion
1/2  c. ketchup
1/2  c. barbecue sauce
1  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. mustard
4  Tbsp. molasses
1  tsp. chili powder
3/4  tsp. pepper
2  (16 oz.) pork and beans
2  (16 oz.) butter beans
2  (16 oz.) red kidney beans
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion.  Drain off fat.  Combine all except beans.  Mix well.  Then add beans to mix.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: PATRICK'S PUNCH
ingredients:
1/2  pt. (1 c.) lime sherbet
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen limeade concentrate
2 (7 oz.)  bottles ginger ale, chilled
2  c. water
preparation: Stir in bowl to soften the sherbet.  Stir in the limeade concentrate, the ginger ale and water.  Pour into glasses to serve.

name: DIABETIC CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo or oil
1  Tbsp. liquid sweetener (10)
2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. chopped pecans
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. diabetic applesauce or mashed banana
1  c. dried dates
preparation: Cream margarine, eggs and sweetener.  Add soda, spices, flour and applesauce (or mashed bananas).  Mix well.  Fold in fruit and nuts.

name: PUMPKIN SEEDS
ingredients:
pumpkin seeds
water
cooking oil
salt
preparation: Wash seeds.  Steam seeds (colander inside a pot).  Put water into the bottom of the colander or strainer.  Cook covered at a fairly high heat about 30 minutes; add more water if needed.  Dump seeds on paper towel and pat dry.  Spread on cookie sheet.  Pour a little oil (just enough to make seeds shiny when you stir them around).  Sprinkle with salt.  Bake at 300° for about 1/2 hour. Eat for snack.

name: MICROWAVE PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1  c. salted peanuts
1  tsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix sugar and corn syrup together and cook 4 minutes at 100% power.  Add peanuts, stir and cook 4 minutes at 100% power.  Add butter and vanilla.  Blend and cook at 100% power; add baking soda, stir and pour onto greased cookie sheet.

name: SCALLOPED MUSHROOM POTATOES
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  qt. greased casserole
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2/3  c. milk
3/4  c. grated cheese
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
4  c. thinly sliced potatoes
preparation: Combine soup and milk until well blended.  Add cheese, pimento, mushrooms and salt.  Blend well.  Add potatoes and mix well.  Pour into greased casserole dish.  Bake at 375° for 1 1/2 hours until potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork.

name: LEMON ICE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  c. milk
2  c. whipping cream
2/3  c. lemon juice
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. lemon peel
preparation: Combine all ingredients in large bowl.  Beat at low speed 1 to 2 minutes.  Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan.  Cover.  Freeze until firm (about 4 hours).  Spoon into larger mixer bowl.  Beat at medium speed until light and fluffy but not thawed (2 to 3 minutes). Return to pan and refreeze at least 4 hours or until firm.

name: BREAKFAST-IN-A-DISH
ingredients:
8  slices bacon, crumbled*
6  frozen hash brown patties
2  c. water
1  Tbsp. chicken bouillon cubes
1/4  c. margarine
1  carton egg substitute
6  slices American cheese
1/2  c. celery, diced
1/2  c. onion, diced
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Prepare bacon in skillet over medium heat; drain.  In large saucepan or stockpot, combine hash brown patties, bouillon cubes and water.  Cover and place over medium-low heat until patties are thawed and crumbled.  Remove from heat.  Add bacon, margarine, cheese, celery, onion, salt and pepper.  Mix ingredients together until margarine and cheese have melted.  Gradually add egg substitute to mixture, stirring constantly.  Pour mixture into a 2 quart casserole dish.  Bake 1 hour or until mixture is firmly set in center.

name: NO BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. instant nonfat dry milk
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. peanut butter
1 1/2  c. rolled oats
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix the first 5 ingredients in a pan and boil.  Add peanut butter and stir until melted.  Add oats and vanilla.  Mix well. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper.  Let cool at room temperature. Makes about 24 cookies.

name: BABY FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
1  c. nuts
2  jars apricot baby food
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
1/4  c. oleo
1/2  c. nuts
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.

name: FROSTED ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. orange flavored gelatin
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1  pt. orange sherbet, softened
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1/2  c. orange juice
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1 (1.25 oz.)  envelope whipped topping mix
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water in a large bowl.  Gently stir in sherbet, pineapple and oranges.  Pour into a 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan.  Set aside.   Combine orange juice, egg, sugar and flour in a small saucepan; cook over medium heat until thickened, stirring constantly.  Allow to cool.  Prepare topping mix according to package directions.  Fold into cooked orange mixture; spread evenly over salad.  Cover and chill overnight.  Yields 12 servings.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans tuna
1  can peas
1/2  bag plain potato chips
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Combine cream of mushroom soup and milk.  Layer peas.  Crumble potato chips and tuna.  Repeat layers.  Cover.  Cook in microwave for 10 minutes.

name: TEXAS SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. granulated sugar
2  c. flour
pinch of salt
1  stick oleo
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. hot water
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. buttermilk or 1/2 c. milk with 1 Tbsp. vinegar
2  beaten eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix in saucepan oleo, cocoa, hot water and shortening.  Stir until rolling boil.  Pour over first three dry ingredients.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Bake on greased 11 x 16-inch pan at 350° for 20 minutes.  Ice immediately from oven.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  qt. fresh strawberries
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. boiling water
red cake coloring
1  (9-inch) baked pastry shell
preparation: Wash, hull and sort berries, saving perfect berries for placing in crust.  Crush enough berries to make 1 cup (about half of berries).  Mix sugar, salt, cornstarch, crushed berries and water.  Cook over direct flame until thickened.  Add few drops of red food coloring and cool thoroughly.  Just before serving, place whole berries in cooled crust.  Pour cooked sauce over berries. Garnish with whipped cream.

name: CHICKEN BAKE
ingredients:
4  to 6 boned, skinless chicken breasts
4 to 6  slices Jack cheese
1  can cream of mushroom or chicken soup
3/4  can white wine
1  box chicken Stove Top stuffing
1/4  lb. melted butter
preparation: Place chicken in flat casserole and top with cheese.  Over this, pour soup and wine that have been mixed together.  Take seasoning packet from stuffing mix and sprinkle over soup mixture. Cover this with dry stuffing mix.  Pour melted butter over this. Bake at 350° for one hour.

name: BUTTER PECAN TORTE
ingredients:
1  c. soda crackers, crumbled
1  c. graham crackers, crumbled
1/3  c. melted butter or margarine
2  pkg. butterscotch instant pudding
1  c. milk
1  qt. softened butter pecan ice cream
Dream Whip topping
1  shredded Hershey milk chocolate bar
preparation: Combine the soda crackers, graham crackers and melted butter or margarine.  Put in a cake drip pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Cool in refrigerator.  Combine the 2 packages of butterscotch pudding; mix it with the milk.  Mix in the butterscotch ice cream.  Put this mixture in the crust.  Top with Dream Whip.  Sprinkle with the shredded chocolate.  Will keep in the freezer for 1 month.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked squash
1  chopped onion
2  oz. pimiento, chopped
1  stick margarine, melted
1  c. (1 can) cream of chicken soup
1 small  carton sour cream
1  pkg. herb dressing (cube style)
1  carrot, grated
preparation: Mix half of dressing with margarine.  Line casserole dish with mixture.  Combine rest of ingredients and add the rest of dressing.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until bubbly and a little brown.  Freezes well.

name: VANILLA FROSTING
ingredients:
1/2  cube butter
powdered sugar (1/2 box or so)
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. or so cream
preparation: Cream the sugar and butter well. Add liquid slowly and turn beater to high. Add vanilla or other flavoring.  It turns out real fluffy like whipped cream. Don't over add the liquid.  Beat as you add the liquid.

name: COLLARDS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. collards, rinsed well and chopped
4  c. water
1/3  c. oil
1  tsp. salt (or to taste)
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a large pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until tender and most of water has cooked away.

name: Nutter Butter Cake
ingredients:
1  pkg. Nutter Butter crackers
2  boxes vanilla pudding mix
Cool Whip
preparation: Put half crackers (crushed) in long dish.  Mix pudding with 3 cups milk.  Pour on top of crackers.  Top with Cool Whip.  Put remainder of crackers on top of Cool Whip.

name: KRINKLE'S HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. chopped, cooked chicken
2  c. sliced celery
1  can thin-sliced water chestnuts
1/2  c. sliced almonds
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. mayonnaise
few drops soy sauce
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Combine first 9 ingredients and fold into a greased casserole pan.  Top with grated cheese and crushed potato chips.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 375° or until heated through.  This can also be made with leftover Thanksgiving turkey!

name: TACO PIE
ingredients:
1  deep dish pie crust
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1 (16 oz.)  can refried beans
1 (8 oz.)  jar taco sauce
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
12  tortilla chips, crushed
lettuce
chopped tomato
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Thaw pie crust 10 minutes.  Prick bottom and sides of pie crust thoroughly with fork. Bake pie shell on cookie sheet for 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and reduce temperature to 350°.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. bacon (cut small)
1  small onion
1 (16 oz.)  can lima beans (drained)
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans (drained)
1 (16 oz.)  can pork and beans
1  c. ketchup
1  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. mustard
preparation: Brown beef, bacon and onion; strain fat.  Mix with all remaining ingredients and be careful not to mash beans.  Warm in 300° oven for 15 minutes or until bubbly.

name: LEMON-ROSEMARY CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  tsp. dried rosemary, crushed
2  cloves garlic, minced
6  boned chicken breast halves
salt and pepper to taste
2  lemons
4  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix rosemary and garlic.  Flatten chicken breast with palm of hand or back of a knife.  Arrange them on large sheet of foil.  Season with salt and pepper.  Sprinkle rosemary-garlic mixture over chicken.  Slice lemons.  Put 2 to 3 slices on each breast.  Dot with butter.  Seal foil into packet. Place on baking sheet.  Bake 30 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: CHEF'S SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup
1 1/2  c. oil
3/4  c. sugar
1  T. salt
1/2  T. black pepper
1  T. prepared mustard
1  T. worcestershire sauce
1  T. garlic powder
1/2  med. onion or 2 T. minced onion
3/4  c. vinegar
preparation: Put all ingredients in large bowl and beat with mixer for 20 minutes or combine in the blender for 5 minutes.

name: CHICKEN WALDORF SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. cubed, cooked chicken
1/2  c. coarsely chopped apple
1/2  c. celery slices
2  Tbsp. raisins
1/4  c. walnuts
1/2  c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
preparation: Mix all ingredients until blended.  Garnish with shredded carrots, if desired.  Yields 4 servings.

name: FROZEN CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1/2  c. lemon juice
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 (16 oz.)  can whole cranberry sauce
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into rectangular glass dish.  Cover and freeze.  Cut into squares to serve.

name: SWISS CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  chicken breast halves
4  slices Swiss cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. white wine
1  c. Pepperidge Farm herbed stuffing mix
1/2  c. melted butter
preparation: Place chicken in greased baking dish.  Cover with cheese. Combine soup with wine; pour over cheese.  Sprinkle with stuffing; drizzle with butter.  Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 1 hour.

name: POPPY SEED DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. honey or sugar
1 1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. vinegar
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. onion, grated
1 1/4  tsp. dry mustard
2  tsp. poppy seed
preparation: Combine sugar, salt and vinegar in saucepan.  Heat over low heat until sugar dissolves.

name: CHEDDAR CHEESE MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground, round or turkey meat
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
1  can Pillsbury crescent dinner rolls
preparation: Brown meat and drain.  May add onion or vegetable of your choice to add variety or color.  Add Cheddar cheese soup and let cool down.  Remove crescent rolls from can and gently pull away, leaving dough in 2 sections.  Gently finger dough to spread out into a square shape.  Place meat and cheese mixture on top of one of the dough squares.  Gently place the second dough square on top of meat mixture and press together the edges of the dough.  Follow the baking instructions on the crescent dinner roll can and bake until done.  Delicious!

name: BAKED PEARS
ingredients:
6  fresh pears
1/3  c. water
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. maple syrup
dash of salt
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1  lemon rind, grated
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Cut slice off bottom of pear so it will stand upright.  Place, with stem up, in baking dish.  Mix remaining ingredients and pour over pears.  Bake, uncovered, about 1 1/2 hours, basting 3 or 4 times.  Serve cool with syrup.

name: FANCY STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cherry gelatin
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
3  bananas, mashed
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. hot water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries (juice, also)
1  c. sour cream (1/2 pt.)
preparation: Dissolve cherry gelatin  in  hot  water.  Add remaining ingredients, except sour  cream, and stir together well.  Pour half of mixture into 1 1/2  quart  mold  or  8 x 10-inch dish. Chill for 1/2 hour.

name: CARAMEL POPCORN
ingredients:
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. light corn syrup
3  c. brown sugar
3  sticks butter
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
9  qt. popcorn
preparation: Put popcorn in greased bowl.

name: PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (20 oz.)  cans pineapple chunks, drained
1  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. flour
6  Tbsp. pineapple juice
1  c. grated Cheddar
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour into dish.

name: OATMEAL CARAMELITOS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. quick oatmeal
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. melted margarine
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  jar Mrs. Richardson's caramel fudge syrup
6  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Combine flour, oatmeal, brown sugar, soda, salt and margarine. Press 1/2 of crumbs into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 300° for 10 minutes.  Take from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips (can add nuts also) over baked crust.  Combine caramel syrup and 6 tablespoons flour, mixing well, and drizzle over chocolate chips.  Sprinkle remaining crumbs over topping.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.  Chill bars.

name: POTATO MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. potatoes
1  egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  lb. lean ground beef
preparation: Peel and grate potatoes; rinse and drain. In a large mixing bowl, combine potatoes, egg, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, salt, pepper and garlic powder. Add ground beef and mix well. Pat meat mixture into an 8 1/2 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until no pink remains; drain. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: WHITE ICING
ingredients:
1/3  c. water
1  Tbsp. light corn syrup
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  egg white
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Place water, syrup, sugar, cream of tartar and salt in a saucepan.  Stir over heat until the sugar is completely dissolved. Put egg white in bowl.  Turn speed control to highest number and beat until frothy, about 1/2 minute.  Pour the hot syrup gradually into the bowl in a fine stream, 1 1/2 to 2 minutes.  Add vanilla and continue whipping 5 1/2 or 6 minutes or until icing loses its shiny appearance and will stand in stiff peaks, approximately 8 to 9 minutes mixing time.  Makes frosting for tops and sides of two 8-inch layers.  This makes a soft icing.

name: EVERYDAY MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  beaten eggs
3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. bread crumbs or oatmeal
1/2  c. finely chopped onions
1/2  c. finely chopped green pepper
1  tsp. ground sage
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. ketchup
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan or dish. Put a thin layer of brown sugar and ketchup on top.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PEAR PECAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  (3 oz.) lemon jello
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1 (29 oz.)  can pears
1  c. pecans
preparation: Drain pears, reserving 1  cup of juice.  Heat juice and dissolve jello in it.  Cool  until	thick, but not set.  Blend together pears and cream  cheese.  Add  to	jello  with  nuts. Pour into small square  dish  and  refrigerate.  Makes 8 servings.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  chicken, cut up
celery
green onions, cut up
regular onions, chopped
2  to 3 bouillon cubes
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook chicken with celery, green onions, regular onions and bouillon cubes.  Add salt and pepper to taste.

name: CHERRY-MIX-DESSERT
ingredients:
2  c. graham crackers
1  stick butter
1/2  c. sugar
8  oz. Philadelphia cream cheese
2  whole eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1  can cherry pie mix
preparation: I:  Put  together  first  three  ingredients.  Place in large pie pan or dish.

name: CRANBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
4  c. sifted flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1 small  can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
4  Tbsp. oil
2  c. raw cranberries
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together the first five dry ingredients.  Add eggs and orange juice concentrate.  Add vegetable oil with enough boiling water to measure 1 1/2 cups.  Add cranberries and nuts.  Pour into 2 greased and floured bread pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: AVOCADO SALSA
ingredients:
1  can (4.5-oz.) diced mild green chiles
2  large ripe tomatoes (about 1 lb. total)
1  fresh jalapeno chile, seeded and finely chopped
2  Tbsp. fresh lime juice
2  garlic cloves, peeled and minced
1  tsp. salt
2  ripe California avocados, pitted, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch chunks
1/3  c. finely diced red onion
1/3  c. finely chopped cilantro
preparation: Halve the tomatoes crosswise and gently squeeze out and discard the liquid and seeds.  Coarsely chop the tomatoes.  In a blender or food processor, combine the tomatoes, jalapenos, lime juice, garlic, and salt and pulse several times.  Transfer the puree to a bowl and stir in the green chiles, avocado chunks, onions, and cilantro.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.  Best if eaten within an hour or so of preparation.

name: SCOTCH OATMEAL PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. quick or old fashioned oats, uncooked
1 1/2  c. water
