1/4  c. honey or brown sugar (light or dark)
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. iodized salt
2  c. peeled apple slices or 3 medium apples, cored, peeled and sliced
1/2  c. raisins
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine (optional)
preparation: Making it in a crockery-lined slow cooker is a real winner, followed by the almost-as-good microwave version.  The slow cooker version is ready for eating when you come to the kitchen in the morning.  It's ideal for staggered eating hours.

name: SCRAMBLE EGG MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  pound Pork sausage
12  eggs
1/2  cup chopped onion
1/4  cup chopped green pepper
1/2  teaspoon salt
1/4  teaspoon pepper
1/4  teaspoon garlic powder
1/2  cup shredded cheddar cheese
preparation: In a skillet, brown sausage:  drain.  In a bowl, beat the eggs. Add onion, green pepper, salt pepper and garlic powder.  Stir in sausage and cheese.  Spoon by 1/3 cupfuls into greased muffin cups. Bake at 350° for 20 - 30 minutes or until a knife is inserted near the center comes out clean.  Yield:  12.

name: YELLOW SQUASH PUFF
ingredients:
1  c. cooked squash, mashed
1  egg
1/3  c. flour
1/3  c. meal
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  small onion, grated
preparation: Mix all together and drop in hot oil with a teaspoon.  When brown, drain on paper towel.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
2  cans artichoke hearts, drained
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1 small  jar mayonnaise
seasoning salt
garlic powder
preparation: Chop artichoke hearts in small pieces and mix with Parmesan cheese and mayonnaise.  Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes or until bubbly.

name: EASY REFRIGERATOR ROLLS
ingredients:
2  C. warm water
2  pkg. active dry yeast
1/2  C. sugar
1/4  C. soft shortening
2  tsp. salt
1  egg
6 1/2 to 7  C. sifted all-purpose flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water, stir in sugar, salt, shortening and egg. Mix flour in until dough is easy to handle. No kneading necessary. Grease top of dough and put in refrigerator before using. Shape about 2 hours before serving. Bake at 400 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large  can unsweetened pineapple juice
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen orange concentrate
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade concentrate
preparation: Thaw frozen concentrates, then add to pineapple juice.  Pour into empty milk carton and freeze.  Take from freezer 3 hours or less before using; add 1/2 gallon ginger ale just before serving.

name: GLORI-FRIED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
4  pork chops (about 1 lb.)
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2/3  c. water
preparation: In skillet, brown chops in 2 tablespoons shortening.  Pour off fat. Stir in soup and water. Cover and cook over low heat (210° to 220°, electric frying pan) for 45 minutes or until tender. Stir now and then. Make gravy with leftover soup and water. Serve on boiled potatoes.

name: PIZZA SALAD
ingredients:
tomatoes
cauliflower
green onions
broccoli
Cheddar cheese, shredded
Mozzarella cheese, shredded
1 (8 oz.)  jar mayonnaise
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch mix (dry)
1 large  can crescent rolls
preparation: Spread crescent rolls out on baking sheet.  Press sides out to fill baking dish.  Bake in 300° oven until golden brown.  Let cool; while cooling, mix mayonnaise with the dry Ranch mix.  After rolls have cooled, spread this mixture on rolls.  Chop all remaining ingredients and sprinkle on top of rolls.  Press firmly down with fingers to get vegetables and cheeses down into Ranch mixture.  Cover and put into refrigerator overnight.  Cut into squares before serving.

name: SUGAR-FREE FINGER JELLO
ingredients:
4  envelopes Knox unflavored gelatine
3  pkg. (3 oz. each) flavored sugar-free gelatin
4  c. boiling water
preparation: In large bowl, combine Knox gelatine and Jell-O.  Add boiling water until dissolved.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and chill until firm.  Cut into squares and serve.

name: KRAUT
ingredients:
4  to 5 cabbage heads, chopped
3/4  c. salt
1  c. vinegar
1  gal. water
preparation: Put vinegar and salt in saucepan and boil until dissolved. You can add some water from the gallon to the vinegar and salt to help get dissolved.  When salt is dissolved, add this to the remaining gallon of water.  Pack sterilized jars with chopped cabbage and cover with solution, leaving 1/2-inch of space at the top of the jars.  Put caps on jars and store in cool, dry place.

name: GREEN PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. ginger
1  c. water
green peppers
2  beef bouillon cubes
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  round steak
onions
preparation: Combine all the ingredients, except green peppers and onions and place in a skillet and simmer for 1 hour.  Next add green peppers and onions.  Cook for 5 more minutes.

name: BUTTER BEAN BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  box butter beans
1  (10 oz.) broccoli flowerets
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can water chestnuts
8  oz. sour cream
preparation: Cook and drain broccoli and butter beans.  Do not add salt. Drain water chestnuts and mix with onion soup mix.  Put butter beans and broccoli in casserole dish.  Put mixture of cream of mushroom soup, onion soup and water chestnuts on top.  Bake for 30 minutes at 375°.

name: PULL-APART CINNAMON BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. white sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
3 (10 oz.)  cans biscuits
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. oleo, melted
preparation: Combine cinnamon and white sugar.  Cut biscuits into quarters. Roll each piece in sugar and cinnamon mixture.  Layer pieces into a well-greased Bundt pan.  Combine brown sugar and butter.  Pour over dough.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Cool for a few minutes before turning out.  Eat warm.

name: JUDY'S MASHED POTATOES
ingredients:
12  potatoes (3 lb.), cooked and mashed
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened and cubed
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Add cream cheese and butter to potatoes.  Add sour cream.  Add milk, eggs and salt.  Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI PARMESAN
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli spears
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. butter
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
2/3  c. milk
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook frozen broccoli spears in unsalted water until tender. Drain.  Cook onion in butter until tender.  Blend in cream of chicken soup, milk and cheese.  Heat and serve atop broccoli. Serves 6.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, boiled and deboned
2  pkg. frozen broccoli, cook 10 minutes in stock
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  carton sour cream
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Butter 3-quart casserole dish and put broccoli on bottom of dish.  Put chopped chicken on top.  Blend soup and sour cream and spread over the entire dish.  Top with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: GEORGETOWN BROCCOLI PECAN(4 Servings)
ingredients:
3  lb. fresh broccoli, untrimmed
3  Tbsp. olive oil
1  clove garlic, minced or pressed
1/3  c. chopped pecans
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Trim broccoli flowerets into 1/2-inch buds.  Trim off tough ends and discard.  In a wide skillet or wok, heat oil.  Add the garlic and pecans.  Saute until pecans are lightly browned 2 to 3 minutes.  Lift pecans from oil with slotted spoon.  Drain and set aside.

name: CRACKER DESSERTS
ingredients:
45  Town House or Ritz crackers
1/2  c. melted oleo
2 small  boxes instant vanilla pudding
1 3/4  c. milk
1  qt. butter pecan ice cream, softened
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Crush crackers; moisten with oleo.  Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with cracker mixture.  Save 1/2 cup.  Mix pudding, milk and ice cream.  Pour over cracker crust.  Spread Cool Whip on top. Sprinkle remaining cracker crumbs on top.  Refrigerate.

name: SHRIMP FRANCESE
ingredients:
20  medium shrimp (about 1/4 lb.)
1  c. flour
3  eggs, beaten
6  Tbsp. butter
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. lemon juice or juice of 1 lemon
1/2  c. dry white wine (Chablis preferred)
preparation: Peel, devein and butterfly shrimp, leaving tail attached. Dredge shrimp in flour.  Shake off excess and dip in beaten eggs. Heat butter in large skillet.  (Iron skillet may darken shrimp.) Saute shrimp until golden on both sides.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.

name: MATTIE PADGETT'S BREAD
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. boiling water
1/2  c. honey
1  Tbsp. salt
1/3  c. Crisco
3  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1  Tbsp. sugar
8  c. plain flour
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients.  Mix yeast with warm water and sugar and let rise.  Blend with mixer the yeast mixture and egg mixture. To this add about half the flour.  Mix with mixer and add remaining  flour, mixing again.  Cover with foil and let stand overnight in refrigerator.	Dump bowl of dough onto floured counter and make into 6 loaves.  Roll and cut.  Preheat oven to 200°.  Turn off and let loaves set for 1 1/2 hours.  Leaving loaves still in oven, turn oven to 300° for 30 minutes.  Cover with butter immediately when taken out.

name: APPLE SPONGE CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. melted butter
5  c. apples, peeled, cored and diced
1/4  c. fresh lemon juice
3  Tbsp. light corn syrup
1/2  c. sugar
3  egg yolks
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
3  egg whites, stiffly beaten
preparation: Butter a 1 1/2-quart baking dish and pour in melted butter. Combine apples, sugar, lemon juice and corn syrup, mixing well. Transfer to buttered casserole.  Beat egg yolks until thick.  Add brown sugar and flour, beating well.  Add vanilla, then fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.   Cover apples with batter and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.   Good with heavy cream or soft vanilla ice cream.  Serves 6.

name: GREEK EASTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
1/3  c. granulated sugar
2  egg yolks
1/2  tsp. brandy flavoring (if desired)
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. Gold Medal flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cloves
confectioners sugar
preparation: Heat oven to 350° (moderate).  Mix the first 5 ingredients together thoroughly.  Measure flour by dipping method (or by sifting).  Blend flour, baking powder and cloves; stir into butter mixture and mix well.  Shape dough in small balls, about 3/4-inch in diameter, or in cylindrical shapes, formed in 2-inch long half moons.  Place cookies on lightly greased baking sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes, or until cookies are set, but not browned.  Let stand 2 minutes before removing from baking sheet.  When cool, dust with confectioners sugar.  (For a more authentic Greek cookie, omit ground cloves and place a whole clove in center of  each cookie before baking.)  Makes 8 dozen cookies.

name: COFFEE LOPEZ
ingredients:
4  c. hot coffee
1/2  c. cream of coconut
1/2  c. Irish whiskey
1  tsp. vanilla
whipped cream
preparation: In a heat-proof pitcher, combine all ingredients except the whipped cream.  Mix well.  Pour into mugs; top with whipped cream. Serve immediately.  Makes 5 cups.

name: MIXED VEGETABLE BAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sliced carrots
1  c. green beans cut into 2 inch lengths
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/4  c. onion thinly sliced
1/2  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 4  oz. can mushrooms sliced
2  medium tomatoes peeled and cut into wedges
1 4  oz. pkg. Mozzarella, cheddar and or Muenster cheese shredded
preparation: In large sauce pan, cook carrots and green beans in boiling water until crisp tender (or steam them).  Drain.  Place in 2 quart casserole.	In medium sauce pan, melt butter; add onion, herbs and mushrooms.	Saute until tender.  Spoon mixture over carrots and beans; top with tomato wedges and sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes, or until thoroughly heated.  Yield:  12 (1/2 c.) servings.

name: RHUBARB CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk or sour milk
1  tsp. soda
2  c. raw chopped rhubarb
1/2  c. white sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 to 2  Tbsp. melted margarine
preparation: Cream the margarine and brown sugar together; add the egg and beat until fluffy. Stir in the dry ingredients, buttermilk and vanilla. Add diced rhubarb and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix the white sugar and cinnamon together and sprinkle over the batter. Drizzle the melted margarine over the top. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  to 3 heads fresh broccoli tops
1/2  lb. bacon, fried
1  c. raisins
1  to 2 small red onions
1  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. wine vinegar
2  Tbsp. white sugar
preparation: Prepare broccoli by cutting and using only the tops.  Fry, drain and crumble the bacon.  Sliver the onion; add raisins.

name: HOT GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
6  potatoes
1/4  lb. bacon
1/4  c. bacon fat
1/4  c. chopped green onion
1/4  c. chopped celery
1/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. water or bouillon
2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. paprika
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley or chives
preparation: Cook potatoes in jackets in covered saucepan with water until they are done, but not mushy.  Peel and slice them while hot. Keep warm.

name: SURPRISINGLY GOOD BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
20  oz. pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  can cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb dressing mix
1/3  stick butter
preparation: Cook and drain onion and broccoli (adding 1/2 teaspoon of salt to cooking water). Place broccoli mixture in large mixing bowl and add cheese, soup and mayonnaise. Spread into 9 x 13 baking dish that has been greased. Sprinkle dressing mix on top of broccoli and dot all over with butter. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: HOPI INDIAN POTATO BREAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  qt. warm water
1/2  handful salt
1/2  handful sugar
1  c. evaporated milk (warm)
3/4  c. dry potatoes (instant)
2  pkg. dry yeast
1  handful shortening or little more if you wish (Crisco)
preparation: Flour  enough until you barely can  handle  and  grease dough. Let stand 10 minutes. Knead and grease.  Let rise until double size; knead and grease.  Let rise again until double in size, then roll to desired size.  (I usually make biscuits and freeze some.) Let dough rise double again and bake at 375° for about 35 to 45 minutes. You can grease or butter to soften the crust.

name: SPAGHETTI PIZZA
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti (uncooked)
1/2  c. milk
1  egg, beaten
1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  medium green pepper, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. Italian seasoning
1  tsp. herb seasoning
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. sliced, fresh mushrooms
2  c. shredded part-skim Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Prepare spaghetti; drain.  In medium bowl, blend milk and egg. Add spaghetti and toss to coat.  Spray a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan with vegetable cooking spray.  Spread spaghetti mixture evenly in prepared pan.

name: VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. vinegar
1/2  c. oil
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. water
1 (14 oz.)  can French-style green beans
11  oz. can Shoepeg corn
15  oz. can LeSueur green peas
1  c. celery, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1  bunch green onions, sliced
preparation: Bring first 6 ingredients to a boil and let cool.  Put the remaining ingredients in a colander and drain.  Pour liquid over vegetables and refrigerate overnight or 1 day ahead of time.

name: MOUNDS
ingredients:
2  large (14 oz.) bags coconut
1  lb. box powdered sugar
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
1  can condensed milk
preparation: Mix together  well.  Press  in	9 x 13-inch pan.  Chill overnight.	Cut  in 1-inch squares.  Melt 1 1/2 bags chocolate chips and  1  block paraffin wax in double boiler.	Use toothpicks and  dip  coconut  squares in chocolate.  Place on waxed paper.

name: SECRETS OVEN ROASTED VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets savory herb with garlic
1  pkg. Recipe Secrets onion soup mix
1 1/2  lb. assorted fresh vegetables*
2  Tbsp. olive or vegetable oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  In plastic bag or bowl, toss all ingredients until vegetables are coated.  Empty in 9 x 13-inch baking or roasting pan.  Discard bag.  Bake, stirring once, for 20 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.  Serves 4.

name: SIMPLE, EASY FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. chopped chocolate or chocolate morsels (sweet, semi-sweet or a combination)
1  c. sugar
1  can sweetened condensed milk
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt chocolate in the top of a double boiler over hot, not boiling, water.  Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients.  Spread in a generously buttered 8-inch square pan. Chill 2 hours or until firm.  Turn fudge out onto a cutting board; cut into squares.  Store in tightly covered containers.  Makes 49 pieces.

name: KEY LIME CAKE
ingredients:
1  box lemon cake mix
1  box lime Jell-O
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
5  eggs
1/2  c. orange juice
4  Tbsp. confectioners sugar
1/2  c. Key lime juice
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients; beat 2 to 3 minutes at medium speed. Pour into 3 round, greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 350° approximately 25 minutes.

name: SPICE CAKE OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  box spice cake mix
1/4  c. brown sugar
2  c. uncooked oats
1  c. raisins
1  c. chopped nuts
2  eggs
3/4  c. oil
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix together in large bowl the cake mix, brown sugar, oats, nuts and raisins.  Stir to coat nuts and raisins.  Add eggs, oil and milk.  Mix well. Drop teaspoonful of dough onto greased baking sheet.  Bake in 350° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.  Makes 60.

name: CORNED BEEF SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
1/2  c. cold water
12  oz. corned beef, crumbled
3  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. diced celery
1  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1  Tbsp. minced onion
2  hard boiled eggs, chopped
preparation: Mix jello with boiling water, then add cold water and set aside until cool.  Add corned beef, celery and remaining ingredients.  Mix all together; pour into 8 x 11-inch pan or serving dish.  Spread sour cream on top 1 hour before serving and sprinkle with finely chopped parsley.

name: 5TH SUNDAY SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. yellow squash, sliced
1  lb. zucchini squash, sliced
1  chopped onion
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1/2  stick butter
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  onion, chopped
salt and pepper
3  eggs
bread crumbs
preparation: Boil squash with onion, salt, pepper and 1 tablespoon water until tender. Drain. Add milk, cheese, onion, eggs, salt and pepper.  Put in casserole and top with bread crumbs and dot with butter.

name: CHOCOLATE CAKE - GOOD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. plain Mosoca flour
1/2  c. sour milk
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  sq. Baker's chocolate, melted
2  eggs
preparation: Mix together and bake 45 minutes at 375°.

name: ORANGE MARMALADE LAMB SHOULDER ROAST
ingredients:
2  cloves garlic, chopped
4 to 6  lb. lamb shoulder
1/2  c. orange marmalade
1/2  tsp. coarsely ground pepper
1/4  c. soy sauce
preparation: Insert garlic into roast.  Combine marmalade, soy sauce and pepper.  Pour over lamb and let stand 4 hours in refrigerator, turning frequently.  Reserve marmalade mixture.  Place roast on rack in a 325° oven and bake 30 to 40 minutes per pound.  During last 30 minutes of baking, baste roast with marmalade mixture until done.

name: RAISIN PUMPKIN OR SQUASH BREAD
ingredients:
1 2/3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/3  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  c. cooked or canned pumpkin or squash
1/3  c. pineapple or orange juice
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Cream together margarine, sugar and egg.  Add pumpkin or squash.  Add remaining dry ingredients.  Add juice and raisins.

name: CABBAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground meat
2  cloves garlic, chopped
1  large onion
1/2  c. uncooked rice
1  head cabbage
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1/2  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix meat, salt, pepper, garlic, onion and rice.  Roll meat mixture in cabbage leaves; place in pot.  Cover with tomatoes and water.  Bring to boil, turn down heat and cover.  Cook on low heat for 1 hour.

name: SUNSET SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
1  c. pineapple juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. grated carrot
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add pineapple juice and salt.  Chill.  When slightly thickened, add pineapple and carrots. Chill in refrigerator until firm.  Cut into individual servings and place on lettuce.  May be served with a teaspoon of salad dressing on the side.

name: POTATO PANCAKES
ingredients:
3  c. grated raw potatoes (4 to 5 potatoes)
1  medium onion, grated
2  eggs
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. flour
1/8  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Peel potatoes and onions and grate into bowl.  Beat eggs; add to potato-onion mixture.  Add salt, flour and baking powder.  Mix well.  Spoon mixture onto hot greased skillet.  Fry on both sides until browned.  Can be served plain, with sour cream or applesauce.

name: CAESAR SALAD
ingredients:
1  clove garlic
1/2  head lettuce
1  c. croutons
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 (2 oz.)  can anchovy fillets
ripe olives
1/2  c. salad oil
1/2  bunch curly endive
1  beaten egg
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
3  or 4 tomatoes, diced
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Mash garlic; add to salad oil.  Break lettuce in salad bowl; tear endive.  Add croutons, anchovy and tomatoes.  Strain oil to remove garlic; pour over vegetables.  Combine remaining ingredients; beat well.  Pour over salad; toss lightly.  Garnish with ripe olives.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: WIENER DAFFLE
ingredients:
1  pound wieners, cut in 1 inch slices
1  package brown gravy mix
1/2  cup cold water
1/2  cup apple jelly
preparation: Combine gravy mix and water in sauce pan.  Add remaining ingredients.  Heat slowly, stirring frequently until sauce thickens.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising corn meal
1/2  c. oil
2  eggs
1  can cream-style corn
1  can garden peas
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. buttermilk
1  or 2 banana peppers
a dash of garlic
2  c. sharp cheese, grated
preparation: Mix all ingredients except cheese.  Pour a layer of mixture in oblong pan.  Then add a layer of cheese, then a second layer of mixture and top with the rest of cheese.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until brown.

name: ROTEL GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
2  cans green beans
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  onion
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
3  strips bacon
preparation: Drain green beans.  Pour 1 can into a 2-quart casserole dish. Slice onion into rings.  Mix cream of mushroom soup and Ro-Tel tomatoes together.  Pour 1/2 of soup mixture over the beans. Place 1/2 of the onion on top and sprinkle with half the grated cheese.  Add the second can of green beans and repeat layers of soup mixture, onion and grated cheese.  Top with bacon slices. Bake at 325° to 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: CARROT-PINEAPPLE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. quick oats
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. lite salt (optional)
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. crushed pineapple (in juice)
1/3  c. plain nonfat yogurt
2  Egg Beaters
1/4  c. liquid Butter Buds
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. shredded carrots
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  In a large bowl, stir together the flour, oats, baking powder, baking soda, salt and spices.  In another bowl, stir together the pineapple, yogurt, Egg Beaters, liquid Butter Buds and vanilla.    Stir in the brown and white sugars until blended.  Make a well in the center of the flour mixture and stir in liquid just to moisten.  Stir in the carrots and raisins.  Spoon the batter into muffin cups that have been lined with muffin papers and sprayed with a nonfat cooking spray. Bake 15 to 17 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Remove muffins to a wire rack to cool.  Yields 20 to 24 muffins.

name: PARMESAN CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
6  boneless chicken breasts
2  Tbsp. melted margarine
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. dry bread crumbs
1  tsp. dried oregano
1  tsp. parsley flakes
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Spray 15 x 10-inch baking pan with Pam spray.  Dip chicken in margarine; coat with combined remaining ingredients.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes until tender.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  medium yellow squash
1  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. oleo
1  c. grated cheese
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. milk
1  c. cracker crumbs
preparation: Cook squash in water until tender.  Remove from water and drain.  Add salt and oleo and cream together.  Add cheese, egg, onion, milk and 1/2 cup of crumbs.  Put in a buttered baking dish and sprinkle remaining crumbs over top.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
4  qt. popped corn
2  c. nuts
1 1/4  c. sugar
2/3  c. oleo
2/3  c. dark corn syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Mix sugar, oleo and syrup.  Stir over heat until it boils. When it boils, cook 5 minutes without stirring.  Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and soda.  Pour over corn.  Bake in oven for 1 hour at 250°, stirring every 15 minutes.   Cool.  Store in tight container.

name: PUMPKIN OR ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
2  c. grated, peeled raw pumpkin or zucchini
3  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
3  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Beat eggs until light and foamy.  Add the sugar, oil, pumpkin or zucchini and vanilla and mix lightly, but well.  Combine flour, salt, soda, baking powder and cinnamon and add to the egg-pumpkin or zucchini mixture.  Stir until well blended; add nuts and pour into two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans that have been greased and floured.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Cool on rack.  Freezes very well.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
2  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
1  chopped onion
1  can chopped water chestnuts
1  box frozen, chopped spinach, cooked and drained
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and chill for several hours before serving.  This can be served in a hollowed out loaf of bread.  The pieces of bread can be used to dip.  Also great with vegetable sticks or crackers.

name: VEGETABLE PASTA WITH CHEESE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. uncooked mostaccioli
2  c. broccoli florets
2  c. cauliflower florets
1  c. sliced carrots
1  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1  c. Fontina cheese, shredded
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese, divided
3  Tbsp. margarine, melted
preparation: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Add vegetables during the last 2 minutes of cooking.  Drain.   Gently toss in a large bowl with shredded cheeses, 2 1/2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese and margarine.

name: SWEET DOUGH
ingredients:
1/2  c. warm water
2  pkg. dry yeast
1 1/2  c. lukewarm milk
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1/2  c. soft shortening
7 to 7 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Mix together and raise for about 1 1/2 hours, doubles in size.

name: NOEL BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. quick cooking oats (uncooked)
1 3/4  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. grated orange peel
1/4  c. orange juice
1/4  c. dark syrup
preparation: In medium sized mixing bowl, combine oats, 3/4 cup confectioners sugar, nuts, cocoa and orange peel.  Add orange juice and syrup, mixing until dry ingredients are thoroughly moistened. Chill 1 hour.  Shape to form 1-inch balls.  Roll balls in 1/2 cup confectioners sugar; place in wax paper-lined container.  Store tightly covered at least 8 hours or overnight at room temperature. Roll each ball in remaining 1/2 cup confectioners sugar.  Store tightly covered.  Makes about 3 1/2 dozen balls.

name: LASAGNA ROMANO
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. cottage cheese (small curd or Ricotta), drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. lasagna
3/4  lb. ground beef
salt and pepper to taste
2  cans tomato sauce or 1 can tomatoes
1  can water
1 foil  pkg. sauce mix
1/4  tsp. salt
a little black pepper
preparation: Set out cottage cheese; drain and let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes.  Cook lasagna according to package directions.  Drain well and set aside.  Brown ground beef in a skillet.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Add tomato sauce or tomatoes, water, sauce mix, salt and pepper.  Put a layer of sauce over meat; spoon in thin layer cottage cheese cheese, layer of lasagna and remaining layers of each.  Sprinkle with grated Romano or Mozzarella cheese.  Bake in a 325° oven for 20 minutes or until bubbles if it has been refrigerated.  Serves 6.

name: EASY CHEESE POTATOES
ingredients:
1 (2 lb.)  pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes, partially thawed
1  (16 oz.) container sour cream
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Colby cheese (yellow)
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green bell pepper
1 (2 oz.)  jar sliced pimientos, drained
1  Tbsp. Wyler's chicken flavor instant bouillon
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large bowl, combine all ingredients except 1/2 cup Colby cheese; mix well.  Turn into buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Bake 55 to 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender.  Top with remaining cheese; bake 3 to 5 minutes or until cheese melts.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: SALMAGUNDIES CHEESE SOUP(Serves 6)
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
4  Tbsp. flour
3 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  c. white wine
8  oz. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  onion
2  stalks broccoli
8  carrots
1  head cauliflower
3  Russet potatoes
preparation: Steam the onion, broccoli, carrots, cauliflower and potatoes until fork can go through!

name: FROZEN BANANA SMOOTHIE
ingredients:
1  c. cold milk or half and half
1/2  c. (1) mashed ripe banana
1/2  c. cream de banana liqueur
1/3  c. Hershey's syrup
2 1/2  c. ice cubes
preparation: In blender container, place all ingredients.  Cover; blend on high speed 2 minutes.  Decrease speed; blend 1 minute longer or until frothy.  Garnish with mint leaves.

name: SEVEN LAYER DIP
ingredients:
2  cans (16 oz.) refried beans with green chillies (Rosarita brand)
3  ripe avocados, mashed
1/3  c. sour cream
1/3  c. mayonnaise (not salad dressing)
1/2  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  c. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
1 to 2  cans (4 1/4 oz.) chopped ripe olives with jalapeno added (Early California brand)
3  small fresh tomatoes, chopped
3  to 4 green onions, chopped
1  bag tortilla chips (large round)
preparation: Spread the refried beans over the bottom of a 10-inch diameter plate. Spread the mashed avocados over the beans. In a small mixing bowl, combine the sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning and mix well to blend. Spread a layer of this mix over the avocados. Follow this by a layer of the cheeses, combined. Layer the olives, tomatoes and green onion. Serve with the tortilla chips.

name: DRESSING FOR FRUIT
ingredients:
1  small instant vanilla pudding
1 1/4  c. milk
3  oz. frozen orange juice
3/4  c. sour cream
preparation: Beat first 3 ingredients together.  Fold in sour cream.  Will keep about 2 weeks.  Use on any fruit (fresh, frozen or canned).

name: RIBBON SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3-oz.)  pkg. lime Jello
5  c. hot water
4  c. cold water
1 (3-oz.)  pkg. lemon Jello
1/2  c. small marshmallows, cut in pieces
1  c. pineapple juice
1 8-oz.  pkg. cream cheese
1  (1 lb.-4 oz.) canned crushed pineapple
1  c. heavy whipping cream
1  c. mayonnaise
2 (3-oz.)  pkg. cherry Jello
preparation: Dissolve lime Jello (2 cups hot water and 2 cups cold water). Pour into 10x14-inch Pyrex pan.  Chill till partly set.  Dissolve lemon Jello in 1 c. hot water in top of double boiler, add marshmallows and stir to melt.  Remove from heat.  Add 1 c. pineapple juice and cream cheese.  Beat till well blended and stir in pineapple.  Cool slightly.  Fold in chilled cream and mayonnaise.  Chill until thick.  Pour in layer over lime.  Chill until almost set.  Dissolve cherry Jello in 2 cups hot water, add 2 C. cold water.  Chill until syrupy.  Pour over pineapple layer. Chill until firm.  Serves 24.  Very Pretty!!!

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
2 to 3  c. sliced peaches
2  c. sugar
1  stick butter
3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Mix peaches with 1 cup sugar.  Put butter in deep square cake pan and set in oven to melt.  Stir up batter of 1 cup sugar, flour, baking powder, salt and milk.  Pour over melted butter.  Do not stir.  Put peaches on top.  Bake 1 hour in 350° oven or until golden brown.  Batter rises to top during baking.

name: VEGGIE PIZZA
ingredients:
2  tubes refrigerated crescent rolls
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  c. Miracle Whip
assorted vegetables, chopped small
preparation: Unroll crescent rolls to form rectangle.  Pinch together perforations.  Bake according to crescent roll directions.  Cool.

name: CASHEW NUT LOAF
ingredients:
2  c. raw cashews
1  large onion
3  Tbsp. margarine
1  tsp. Vegex or Savorex
3/4  c. evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. vegeburger
1/2  c. bread crumbs
4  eggs
1  Tbsp. parsley
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. Bakon yeast
1  tsp. sage
preparation: Grind cashews, dice onion and saute in margarine; melt Vegex into onion and margarine.  Add remaining ingredients.   Mix well and bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

name: DIRT PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. Oreo cookies
1/2  c. butter, melted
preparation: Smash cookies and add butter.  Save 1 cup of Oreos for top.

name: EASY LASAGNA
ingredients:
9  uncooked lasagna noodles
1  lb. ground beef
1 (32 oz.)  jar chunky mushroom and onion spaghetti sauce
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
12  oz. cottage cheese
3  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cook noodles, using package directions; drain.  Brown ground beef in skillet, stirring until crumbly; drain.  Mix ground beef with spaghetti sauce.  Spread 3 spoonfuls in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Layer noodles, remaining meat sauce, Parmesan cheese, cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese, 1/3 at a time, in prepared dish.   Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Yield: 8 servings.

name: OLD-FASHIONED BUTTERSCOTCH PIE
ingredients:
1  c. light brown sugar
2  c. boiling water
5  Tbsp. flour
3  egg yolks, beaten
4  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix sugar, flour and salt real good.  Add boiling water.  Cook over medium heat until thickened.  Add butter and cook until melted.  Add small amount of cooked mixture to beaten eggs and mix.  Put back into mixture.  Cook 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove; add vanilla.  Let cool.  Pour into baked pie shell. Cover with meringue.  Bake at 350° until brown.

name: TEXAS SWEET POTATO BREAD
ingredients:
3  1/2 cups plain flour
3  cups sugar
1  cup Wesson oil
2  tsp. soda
4  eggs
2  cups sweet potatoes, cooked and mashed
2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  cup water
1  cup nuts
preparation: Mix the liquids, except the water together.  Then mix the flour, sugar, soda, cinnamon, and nutmeg together.  Combine with liquid mixture.  Add potatoes, nuts, and water.  Place in a bundt pan or 3 small loaf pans.  Bake at 350° until done.

name: STRAWBERRY BALLS
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
3  pkg. strawberry jello
1  c. nuts, chopped
3  c. coconut
preparation: Mix milk, 2 packages jello, nuts and coconut.  Shape and refrigerate overnight.  Roll in jello and trim.

name: CHICKEN CHEESE MACARONI
ingredients:
1 small  box macaroni, cooked
1 3/4  c. milk
1  can potato soup
8  oz. jar Cheez Whiz
2 (5 oz.)  cans boned chicken
1  pkg. sour cream mix
4  Tbsp. dried onion
preparation: Pour into greased casserole. Bake at 420° for 25 to 35 minutes.

name: OOEY-GOOEY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  stick margarine
3  eggs
8  oz. cream cheese
1  lb. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix cake mix, margarine and 1 egg together.  Pat in bottom of an 8-inch square pan.  Mix remaining ingredients together and spread over crust.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: PEAR HONEY(Jam or Marmalade)
ingredients:
10  c. Bartlett pears, ground
2  c. pineapple, ground
4  navel oranges, ground (rind and all)
6  c. sugar
6  c. Karo white syrup
preparation: Boil pears until soft.  Add remaining ingredients and cook until thick.  Makes 6 pints.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CANDY
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
1  box powdered sugar
8  oz. crunchy peanut butter
7  oz. marshmallow cream
1/4  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil milk and powdered sugar for 5 minutes and add peanut butter, marshmallow cream and vanilla.  Stir constantly.  Pour into 9 x 9-inch pan.

name: SAUTEED ROUND STEAK
ingredients:
steak
seasoned flour
hot butter or drippings
preparation: Cut steak 1/3-inch thick into 2 x 4-inch pieces.  Dip meat pieces in flour and saute until brown.  Reduce heat.  Cover and cook until meat is tender.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) macaroni
1/4  c. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. flour
1 3/4  c. milk
8  oz. mild Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix butter, salt, pepper and flour.  Cook until smooth and bubbly.  Remove from heat.  Stir in milk.  Heat until boiling. Boil and stir 1 minute.  Stir in cheese until melted.  Mix with cooked macaroni.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: CREAM OF CAULIFLOWER AND CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. cauliflower (fresh)
8  oz. Cheddar cheese, shredded
8  oz. butter
1  c. flour, sifted
1  qt. chicken stock
1  qt. half and half
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. white pepper
preparation: Clean and cut cauliflower into 1/2-inch pieces.  Steam in 1/2 cup of water until tender.  Do not drain; set aside.  Melt butter in saucepan over medium heat.  Add flour to make a roux.  Cook for 2 to 4 minutes.  Add chicken stock, stirring with a wire whip, and bring to a boil.  Turn heat to low.  Add cauliflower, cheese, half and half, salt and pepper.  Heat, but do not boil.

name: SAUSAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
1  lb. mild Italian sausage meat
1/2  onion diced
1  cup stuffing mix or bread crumbs
1  sheet puff pastry
1  egg
pinch of sage & thyme if you choose bread crumbs
preparation: Mix sausage, onions, stuffing mix and herbs.  Roll out pastry to 18x12 inches.  Cut in half long-ways. Place a line of mixture along the middle of each piece of pastry long-ways. Brush pastry with beaten egg and fold pastry over sausage and seal.  Turn sealed side down.  Brush top with beaten egg. Slice each roll into one inch pieces and put on cookie sheet sealed side down about one inch apart. Bake at 400 for 15-20 minutes until golden brown. Serve warm or at room temperature.  Makes 3 dozen rolls.

name: LEMONADE PIE
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1 (6 fluid oz.)  can frozen concentrated lemonade or limeade
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip nondairy whipped topping
9-inch graham cracker crumb crust
preparation: Beat concentrate in large bowl about 30 seconds.  Blend in condensed milk.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Spoon into crust.  Freeze until firm, 4 hours or overnight (optional).  Garnish with lemon or lime.  Return leftover pie to freezer.

name: COCONUT PUDDING
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  c. coconut milk, divided
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine sugar and cornstarch in small bowl.  Blend in 1/2 cup coconut milk and salt.  Heat remaining 1/2 cup coconut milk in medium saucepan.  Do not let it boil.  Add cornstarch mixture. Cook and stir until thickened.  Pour into 8-inch square dish. Refrigerate until firm.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BLUE CHEESE DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  lb. crumbled Blue cheese
1  c. oil
1/3  c. vinegar or lemon juice
1  clove garlic, chopped
preparation: Mix all in dressing jar.  Serve over green salad.

name: GRANOLA
ingredients:
1/2  c. crunchy peanut butter
1/2  c. raw honey
2  handfuls each:  oats, seeds, fruits and nuts
preparation: Mix the peanut butter and honey in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 5 minutes.  Add the remaining ingredients.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour, stirring well every 15 minutes.  Store in covered container.

name: BROCCOLI AND CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
fresh cauliflower, chopped
fresh broccoli, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. sugar
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Chop cauliflower, broccoli and onion.  Mix vinegar, sugar, mayonnaise and salt.  Pour over the vegetables.  Toss well and refrigerate for at least  1 hour before serving.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE 4
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. squash, cooked and mashed
1  onion, chopped
1  c. sour cream
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm dressing
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Mix all ingredients together, saving enough dry dressing to put on top of casserole.  Place in a greased casserole.  Dot margarine over squash mixture.  Cover with reserved dry dressing.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: ST.  MARK'S CHILI RECIPE
ingredients:
25  lb. meat
1 1/4  lb. chili powder
8  cans tomato paste
1/8  lb. comino powder
1/4  lb. garlic
5  lb. onions
1 1/2  lb. lard from suet
4  c. flour
6 to 8  qt. boiling water
preparation: Sear meat, a little at a time.  Chip or grind onions.  Peel and chip garlic.  Mix onions and garlic with meat.  Add tomato paste.  Add seasoning and water.  Stir occasionally.  Cook slowly, about 3 hours.  Parch flour and add to chili just before serving. If too greasy, skim off fat.

name: PIZZA DIP
ingredients:
1 to 2  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. picante sauce
2  pkg. popcorn shrimp
1  can black olives
1  c. Cheddar cheese
1  c. Mozzarella
dash of garlic salt
preparation: (The amount of ingredients depends on the size of your pizza pan.)

name: FREE BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans French-style beans
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  large cucumber
3  stalks celery
1  green pepper
1/4  c. tarragon vinegar
1/2  c. vinegar
1/3  c. water (drained off beans)
4  packs Sweet 'N Low
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix together and chill before serving.

name: GERMAN HOT POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
3  lb. potatoes
1/4  c. finely diced bacon
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. salt
1 1/4  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. pepper
2/3  c. cider vinegar
1/3  c. water
1/2  tsp. celery seed
3  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Cook potatoes in skin until tender.  Cool, peel and thinly slice.  Fry bacon until crisp.  Add onion and cook one minute. Blend in flour, salt, sugar and pepper.  Add vinegar and water. Cook 10 minutes, stirring well.  Pour over sliced potatoes.  Add celery seed and parsley.  Toss gently.  Serve  warm.  Yields 6 portions.  Great served with roast beef or baked ham.

name: MUSHROOM CROISSANT APPETIZER
ingredients:
2  pkg. Croissants
1-8 oz. pkg.  Cream Cheese
12  oz. Chopped Fresh Mushrooms
1  tsp. Garlic Salt
1  tsp. Onion Powder
preparation: Sauté mushrooms in a small amount of butter and cool.  Mix mushrooms with cream cheese and seasonings.  Unroll croissants and cut each croissant in half long ways.  Spoon a small amount of mixture onto large end of croissant.  Roll up.  Place in ungreased cookie sheet and bake 10-12 minutes at 350.

name: WORLD'S EASIEST ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. strawberry jam
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Stir buttermilk into jam.  Pour into refrigerator tray. Freeze until firm.  Cut up frozen mixture and place in chilled mixer bowl.  Whip with electric mixer until fluffy.   Return to tray.  Cover and freeze until firm.  Spoon into sherbet dishes. Garnish with fresh strawberries and mint leaves.

name: LAYERED LEMON JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. lemon jello
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  pkg. Dream Whip
1 large  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  can crushed pineapple, drained (save juice)
preparation: You will need an 8 x 12-inch or 9 x 13-inch dish for this recipe.

name: BREAKFAST POCKETS
ingredients:
1  pkg. refrigerated biscuits
diced ham/sausage, cooked
scrambled eggs
shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Roll out 1 biscuit and add egg, meat and cheese.  Fold the biscuit around the filling and bake according to biscuit directions.  You can substitute any kind of filling to make pizza, taco, chicken, etc., pockets.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
2  rolls chocolate chip cookie dough
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.  Press 1 roll of cookie dough in bottom of pan.  Mix cream cheese, eggs, sugar and vanilla.  Put on top of cookie dough.  Press other roll of dough and put on top. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: FIESTA CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. pecans
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped bananas
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix and sift flour, sugar, soda, salt and cinnamon.  Stir in pecans.  Beat eggs slightly.  Combine with oil, vanilla, bananas and pineapple.  Add to dry ingredients and mix thoroughly, but do not beat.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 25 minutes.  Remove from oven and let stand 10 to 15 minutes.  Remove from pan and cool.

name: BEEF AND NOODLE MEDLEY
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oil
1  lb. ground meat or leftover roast, cut into small pieces
1 1/2  c. celery
1/2  c. onion
1/2  c. green pepper
2  c. uncooked medium width noodles
2  cans (1 lb. each) tomatoes, cut into pieces
1  can red beans
4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. salt
preparation: In large skillet, brown meat in oil, about 5 minutes.  Add celery, onion and green pepper; saute 5 minutes longer.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until noodles are tender, about 20 minutes.  Can add cooked leftover vegetables, such as peas, green beans, carrots, cabbage, etc.

name: CRUSTY CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
8  boneless chicken breasts
1/2  c. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. mustard
1  stick melted butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. herbed stuffing mix, crushed
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Use 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Thoroughly mix mayonnaise, mustard and butter.  Dip the chicken breasts into the mixture and roll in the stuffing.  Place chicken breasts in baking dish.  If there is remaining stuffing left, stir it with the remaining butter mixture and sprinkle around the breasts.  Bake covered for 1 hour.  Then remove cover and bake an additional 30 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: JETTE'S MOTHER'S COFFEECAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
3  eggs, separated
1/2  c. milk
3 1/4  c. flour, divided
1 1/4  c. sugar, divided
1  tsp. salt
1  c. cold margarine or butter
1 1/2  tsp. grated lemon rind (optional)
1  c. lightly toasted ground filberts
confectioners sugar
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water.  Beat egg yolks thoroughly, then beat in milk and yeast mixture.  In a large bowl or food processor, combine 3 cups flour, 1/4 cup sugar and salt.  Cut in butter until particles are fine.  Stir in yeast mixture and lemon peel.  Cover and let stand 30 minutes.  Stir in about 1/4 cup flour or enough to make a soft dough.  Turn out on a floured board and knead (adding flour only if necessary to prevent sticking) until smooth and satiny.  Place in greased bowl, cover tightly and refrigerate 12 hours or overnight.  After removing from refrigerator, let stand at room temperature to warm (or press with hands to warm and soften). Roll into a 20 x 16-inch rectangle.  Stir together egg whites, nuts and remaining cup of sugar.  Spread on dough.  Starting at lengthwise edge nearest you, roll as for jelly roll.  Grease Bundt pan, then carefully lift roll and place, seam side up, in prepared pan, adjusting to fit and overlapping ends to join.  Cover and let stand 2 to 2 1/2 hours.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until a rich golden brown.  (Start to check after 30 minutes and when top begins to turn golden, cover loosely with foil for remainder of baking time.)  Cool in pan 10 minutes, then gently loosen at edges and around center tube.  Turn out on wire rack. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar, sifted.  Makes 18 slices.  This sounds time-consuming to prepare, but it is very easy and very delicious.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  pkg. creamed cheese
1  c. chopped pecans (divided, 1/2 c. in ball and 1/2 c.  to roll)
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1/4  c. chopped green peppers
1  tsp. seasoned salt
2  tsp. finely chopped onion
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except 1/2 cup pecans.  Form in a ball.  Chill and roll in pecans.

name: LAZY DAISY CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped dates
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1 1/2  sticks margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
1 3/4  c. unsifted flour
preparation: Combine and let stand the dates, baking soda and boiling water. Cream margarine and 1 cup sugar and beat in the vanilla, eggs, salt and flour.  Add dates to mixture.

name: TRACY AND GREG'S BEST BLONDE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  sticks butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs, well beaten
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts, chopped
1  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate drops
preparation: Combine sugars and butter in medium boiler.  Stir on low heat until butter is melted.  Cool.  Add eggs, flour, salt, vanilla and nuts.  Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle chocolate drops over top.  Bake about 35 minutes at 325°.  Cool. Cut in squares.  Do not overbake.  Yield: 2 dozen.

name: PIMENTO CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
1/4  cup mayonnaise
dash of worcestershire
salt to taste
milk as needed
2  cups cheddar cheese, grated
4-  oz. jar diced pimentos, drained
preparation: Combine all ingredients except milk and slowly add milk to achieve desired consistency.  Cover and refrigerate. Yield:  2-1/2 cups.

name: EASY APPLE RAISIN CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. diced apples
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Combine apples and sugar in a mixing bowl and let stand 10 minutes.  Blend oil, vanilla and egg with the apples, then combine the dry ingredients.  Bake in preheated 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until done.

name: STRAWBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
3  pkg. unsweetened strawberry Kool-Aid
3  c. sugar
1  qt. pineapple juice
2 1/2  qt. water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen sliced strawberries (do not thaw)
preparation: Mix and freeze until slushy.  Stir several times while freezing to mix the strawberries.  Serve slushy.  If made ahead, may be frozen then defrosted to slushy.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. crushed graham crackers
1/2  c. melted butter
1  Tbsp. sugar
16 to 18  oz. softened cream cheese
3  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
juice of 1 lemon
1  pt. sour cream
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Set oven at 350°.  Mix together the graham crackers, melted butter and 1 tablespoon sugar.  Mix well and pat into a 9-inch round or spring-form pan.

name: MINI PIZZAS
ingredients:
bread (however many pieces you want)
pizza sauce
Mozzarella cheese
pepperoni
preparation: Toast bread.  Spread sauce over the toasted bread.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Add 3 pieces of pepperoni on each piece (if desired).  Put into the microwave for 45 seconds (for 2 pieces).

name: ORANGE FLUFF SALAD
ingredients:
1  box orange jello
1  box instant vanilla pudding
1  box tapioca pudding
preparation: Mix all three in 3 cups of boiling water.  Stir continuosly until boiling.  Remove from heat and put in the refrigerator until set.  Add a small pkg. of Cool Whip and 2 small cans of drained mandarin oranges.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
3  c. sugar
1/2  c. melted butter
1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. soda
2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix all ingredients well with electric mixer.  Bake in 2 (9-inch) pie shells at 450° for 10 minutes, then turn oven down to 300° and bake 30 to 35 minutes longer.

name: DELICIOUS BEEF AND NOODLES
ingredients:
1  pound beef stew meat
Salt
Pepper
Garlic powder
Flour
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2 (15 ounce)  cans beef broth
1 (10 ounce)  can cream of mushroom soup
8  ounces noodles
1 (5 ounce)  can Milnot
preparation: meat with salt, pepper, garlic powder and flour. Heat cooking oil in heavy skillet or Dutch oven. Add meat and brown; drain. To the meat in the skillet, add broth, and simmer for 5 or 6 hours until meat is tender. Stir in soup. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. Add to meat with Milnot. Taste and add salt and pepper as needed. Stir well until blended.

name: POTATO AU GRATIN
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes, peeled
1  tsp. dried rosemary
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. milk
1 (15 to 16 oz.)  pkg. chicken gravy mix
3  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Place potatoes in lightly greased 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle with rosemary and pepper.  Combine with milk and gravy mix; pour over potatoes.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until tender.  Yields 6 servings.

name: SUGAR-FREE COPPER PENNIES
ingredients:
2  bags carrots, clean scraped and cut round
1  small green pepper
1  can tomato soup
sweetener to equal 1 c. sugar
3/4  c. apple vinegar
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
dash of salt and pepper
preparation: Cook carrots in steamer or boil until tender but not overdone; drain water if boiled.  Mix with remaining ingredients. Refrigerate overnight, at least.  The longer it sits the more the flavor goes through the carrots.  Keep in refrigerator several weeks.  Serve cold.  If you like onions add a small chopped onion to the mixture.

name: HOLIDAY GRAVY
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. canned chicken broth
1/2  c. flour
2  chicken bouillon cubes
1  tsp. Kitchen Bouquet
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Blend in a bowl 1 cup cold broth with flour until smooth. Heat remaining broth with bouillon cubes in saucepan.  Stir flour mixture into hot broth.  Cook and stir over moderate heat until mixture thickens.  Reduce heat.  Add Kitchen Bouquet and pepper. Makes about 4 cups.  Contains 1% fat, less than 1 gram per serving.

name: HOT CURRIED FRUIT
ingredients:
1 (30 oz.)  can peach slices
1 (29 oz.)  can pear halves, cut in chunks
1 (16 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
1 (16 oz.)  can pitted Bing cherries
1 (29 oz.)  can apricots
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1  tsp. curry powder
1/4  lb. margarine
preparation: Drain  fruit  well  and mix.  Put into 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt brown sugar, curry powder and margarine; pour over mixed fruit. Heat  in  a  300°  oven for 30 minutes, being sure the fruit neither  burns  nor cooks too long.  Serve hot.  Serves 20.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
6  apples, sliced and sprinkled with lemon juice
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  egg
1/4  lb. margarine
preparation: Mix with pastry blender flour, sugar, baking powder and egg. Sprinkle over apples.  Sprinkle top with cinnamon.  Melt margarine and pour over top.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes in 9 x 9-inch pan.

name: HUTZLER'S CHEESE BREAD
ingredients:
9 1/2  c. bread flour
2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. sugar
2  c. milk
13 1/2  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1 cake or  pkg. yeast
1  c. water (lukewarm)
2 1/4  Tbsp. margarine or butter
preparation: Dissolve the yeast in the lukewarm water.  Add the rest of the ingredients.  Knead dough and let rise until double in bulk, about 2 hours.  Divide into four parts and put in greased 4 x 8-inch bread pans.  Let rise again and bake in a 300° oven for one hour.

name: FRUIT GLOW PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1  qt. chilled apple juice
1  pt. orange or lemon sherbet
2  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Mix all ingredients, adding sherbet last.  Serves 20.

name: QUICK-ENERGY PICKUPS
ingredients:
3 or 4  sq. graham crackers
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. crunchy peanut butter
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  c. instant nonfat dry milk or 3 Tbsp. milk
preparation: Crush graham crackers.  Mix remaining ingredients in a bowl. Shape teaspoonfuls of mixture into 1-inch balls.  Roll the balls in the graham cracker crumbs until coated.  Refrigerate until firm.

name: NONFAT SEASONED FRENCH FRIES
ingredients:
unpeeled potatoes, washed
butter flavored cooking spray
seasoned salt
preparation: Spray a baking sheet with butter flavored cooking spray. Slice potatoes lengthwise to desired thickness.  Spray potatoes with cooking spray and season to taste with seasoned salt.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until brown and crispy.  The crispness will depend on how much spray you use.

name: MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
12  single saltine crackers
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped bell pepper
1  can tomato soup
1  lb. ground beef
preparation: Combine crackers, milk, eggs, salt, pepper, onion and bell pepper.  Mix well; add ground beef.  Form into balls; brown in skillet and add tomato soup.  Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE COFFEE DESSERT
ingredients:
20  Oreos, crushed in blender (filling and all)
1/3  c. butter, softened
1/2  gal. coffee ice cream
3  sq. chocolate (unsweetened)
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. butter
1 large  can evaporated milk
1  large container Cool Whip
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix Oreos and 1/3 cup butter together and press into an 11 x 13-inch pan.  Freeze until firm.  Slightly soften ice cream. Press on top of crust.  Freeze until firm.  Mix chocolate, 1 cup sugar, 2 teaspoons butter and evaporated milk together and cook in heavy pan until thick.  Then cool.  After sauce cools, spread over frozen ice cream layer and refreeze.  Soften Cool Whip and spread on top of chocolate layer.  Sprinkle nuts on top.  Refreeze.  Let sit out of freezer a little while before cutting.

name: CHRISTMAS ROCKS
ingredients:
3/4  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. lemon flavoring
2 1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. candied pineapple
1/2  c. white raisins, steamed (so they don't draw moisture)
1  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. butter
1/4  tsp. sherry flavoring
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. candied cherries
preparation: Combine sugar, butter and eggs; beat until fluffy.  Add flavorings and mix well.  Add flour and baking powder and mix well.  Then dredge the fruit and nuts lightly with 2 tablespoons flour.  Drop by spoonful on a greased cookie sheet and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned in 350° oven.

name: DIRT CAKE(Made in a Flowerpot)
ingredients:
1  large bag Oreo cookies
1/2  c. melted margarine
1 (12 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  c. powdered sugar
2  pkg. French vanilla instant pudding
3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Blend cookies in blender (makes crumbs).  Put small amount in bottom of flowerpot.  Mix the margarine, Cool Whip, cream cheese and powdered sugar.  Mix the pudding, milk and vanilla together. Mix the two mixtures together.  Spread in alternate layers with cookie crumbs until pot is full, ending with crumbs.  Chill.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
8  apples, sliced thin
1/2  c. apple juice
1/4  tsp. salt
1/3  c. sugar
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. flour
preparation: Put apple juice in bottom of shallow baking dish.  Put in half of the apples.  Sift together flour, salt, sugar and cinnamon.  Mix with brown sugar and cut in margarine until mixture is crumbly. Spread half of the mixture over apples.  Add the rest of the apples on top.  Cover with the remaining crumb mixture.  Bake in 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes.  Serve warm.  Can be topped with whipping cream or ice cream.

name: QUICKIE DILLIE BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. water
1  c. cottage cheese
1  Tbsp. minced onion, lightly browned in butter
2  tsp. dill seed
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  egg (unbeaten)
2 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Soften yeast in water; add all other ingredients except flour and mix well.  Gradually add flour and beat until smooth and elastic.  Cover with damp cloth and let rise until double in size, about 1 hour.  Place in greased casserole 2-quart size and let rise uncovered until light to touch, about 45 minutes.  Remove from oven; brush with butter.  Sprinkle lightly with salt and cover with damp cloth for 10 minutes.  Bake at 350°  about 45 minutes.

name: BREAD (EASY EGG BRAID)
ingredients:
4 to 4 1/2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. shortening
2  pkg. yeast
2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
3 eggs, slightly beaten (reserve 1  Tbsp. egg for glaze)
preparation: In bowl, combine 2 cups flour, yeast, sugar and salt.  Mix well.  Heat water, milk and shortening until warm (shortening does not need to melt), then add to flour mixture.  Add eggs.  Beat 3 minutes at medium speed.  By hand, gradually stir  remaining flour to make a firm dough.   Knead until smooth and elastic at least 5 minutes.  Place in greased bowl, turning to grease top.

name: RAW APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
2  eggs
2  c. flour (plain)
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. finely chopped apples
preparation: Cream sugar and margarine.  Add eggs.  Sift together flour, soda, cinnamon and salt; add to creamed mixture.  Add apples and mix.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI WITH CHEESE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. fresh broccoli
6  oz. American cheese, sliced
1/3  c. milk
1/4  tsp. onion salt
1  drop red pepper sauce
preparation: Heat 1-inch salted water (1/2 teaspoon salt to 1 cup water). To boil, add broccoli.  Cover and heat to boiling.   Reduce heat and boil until stems are tender, 12 to 15 minutes.  Drain.

name: DIET LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. 90% ground beef or turkey
1/4  c. minced onion
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. basil
1  tsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. oregano
dash of salt and pepper
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms or fresh mushrooms
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach
6  oz. cottage cheese
4  oz. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Saute onion and ground meat.  Add seasonings, tomato sauce and mushrooms.  Squeeze liquid from thawed spinach and mix with cottage cheese.  Cut Mozzarella cheese in strips.  In a 7 x 11-inch baking dish, arrange in layers the spinach mix, meat mix and Mozzarella; repeat.  Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes until hot and bubbly.  Serves 4.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. milk
dash of salt
vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar and cocoa together, then stir in milk and butter. Place on stove.  Bring to rolling boil and boil two minutes for fudge or one minute for icing.  Place in pan of cold water and beat until cool.  Add flavoring.

name: CHICKEN PARMESAN
ingredients:
4  to 6 chicken breasts
dash of salt
dash of paprika
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. dry white wine or cooking sherry
1 small  can sliced mushrooms
1  small sour cream
preparation: Place chicken in Dutch oven.  Salt and paprika to taste.  In large bowl, mix soup, wine and mushrooms and pour over chicken. Cook uncovered in oven at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Remove chicken and add sour cream to sauce.  Place sauce over medium to low heat and simmer until well heated.  Serve rice with chicken and use sauce as a gravy.

name: ALEXANDER CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. whole almonds
3/4  c. sugar
5  egg yolks
3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. rum
1  c. toasted sliced almonds
5  egg whites
1 1/4  c. heavy cream
1  tsp. cornstarch
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease cookie sheet.  Grind the almonds.  Whip the egg whites in a large mixing bowl until stiff. Fold in the almonds and sugar.  Spread the batter into 2 equal size heart shaped layers on cookie sheet.  Bake for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, make the custard cream; combine the egg yolks, cream, sugar and cornstarch in the top of a double boiler.  Let the custard cream cook slowly over boiling water for 10 to 15 minutes or until it thickens, stir constantly.  Stir in the rum, then cool.  Frost top of one layer with half the custard cream.  Place the second layer on top and spread with remaining cream.  Garnish with almonds.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. strawberry cake mix
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
1  c. Crisco oil
2  Tbsp. self-rising flour
4  eggs
1  c. sliced strawberries and juice
preparation: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl.  Beat well at medium speed.  Divide into 4 layers.  Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
6  potatoes
1  medium onion
1/2  lb. sausage
small box Velveeta cheese
small can of Pet milk
preparation: Cook potatoes and onions together. Add pepper and salt to taste. Fry sausage, crumble and drain. Mix in Velveeta cheese, sausage and a small can of Pet milk. Cook until thickens.

name: CRACKER ICE BOX COOKIES
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. nuts, chopped
1  c. shredded coconut
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  tsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
additional graham crackers
preparation: Melt margarine and add sugar, milk and egg. Cook until thick, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add graham cracker crumbs, nuts and coconut. Line a 9x13 inch pan with whole graham crackers. Spread the cooked mixture over the crackers. Add another layer of graham crackers. Make frosting; mix confectioners sugar, milk and vanilla. Spread this over final layer of graham crackers. Chill in refrigerator about 3 hours before cutting. (A ready to spread frosting may be used.)

name: MINCEMEAT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. mincemeat
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Beat together shortening, sugar and eggs.  Add dry ingredients gradually to mixture.  Stir in mincemeat.  Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on greased baking sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool.  Makes 6 1/2 dozen.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. celery, chopped
2  c. onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. butter
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  c. Minute rice
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz (plain)
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz (jalapeno)
2 small  boxes chopped broccoli (frozen)
preparation: Sauté celery and onion in butter. Mix all ingredients together; let sit overnight in refrigerator. Bake 45 minutes in 350° oven. Enjoy.

name: GREEN RICE
ingredients:
2  c. rice
1  can Cream of Mushroom Soup
1  box frozen broccoli
8  oz. Velveeta Cheese
1  stick butter
preparation: Cook 2 cups rice.   Cook broccoli by directions on pkg.  Mix cooked rice with mushroom soup, broccoli, cheese, and melted butter.  Cook in oven for 30 minutes at 350 degrees.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans Veg-All
3/4  c. celery, chopped
1  c. cheese (mild Cheddar)
3/4  c. onion, chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. mushroom soup
Ritz crackers
butter
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except Ritz crackers and butter.  Cover with Ritz crackers; dot with butter.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CACCIATORE
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. cut up chicken
2  small green peppers, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1  bay leaf
1/4  tsp. thyme
2  Tbsp. dried parsley
1 to 1 1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
2  c. stewed tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients in saucepan.  Simmer 30 minutes, covered.  Uncover and continue cooking to desired consistency. Serve with noodles, pasta or rice.

name: APRICOT BARS
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter  or margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1 1/3  c. shredded coconut
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
12  oz. jar apricot preserves
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, cream the butter and sugar. Add egg and mix well.  In a separate bowl, combine flour and baking powder. Gradually add to butter mixture. Add coconut, walnuts and vanilla.  Mix thoroughly.  Press 2/3 of the dough into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Spread with preserves.  Crumble remaining dough over preserves. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Cool in pan on wire rack. Cut into squares. Makes 36 bars.

name: AMBROSIA ORIENTAL SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. cooked fresh shrimp
1  c. mandarin oranges
1  c. pineapple chunks
1 small  can sliced water chestnuts
4  c. lettuce (bite size)
1  c. diced celery
1/2  c. sliced onions (in rings)
1/4  green pepper, diced
1/4  c. flaked coconut
1  c. cashew nuts
preparation: Place lettuce in bowl and other ingredients. Drain fruit real good.

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
2  c. chicken (white meat)
1/2  c. chopped celery (optional)
1/2  c. chopped onion (optional)
1/2  c. chopped green pepper (optional)
1 (4 oz.)  jar mushrooms
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. soy sauce
1  c. mushroom soup
1  c. milk
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
8  oz. vermicelli, cooked and drained
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Saute onion, celery and green pepper in butter until tender; add mushrooms and juice, soy sauce, salt and pepper.

name: TARRAGON POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
10  medium red potatoes (3 lb.)
1/2  tsp. instant beef bouillon powder
1/4  c. warm water
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. vinegar
1/4  c. thinly sliced green onion
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
2  tsp. fresh snipped tarragon or 1/2 tsp. dried crushed tarragon
1/2 to 1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Scrub potatoes well.  Leave skins on.  In a 4 1/2-quart Dutch oven or kettle, cook potatoes covered in boiling, salted water 20 to 25 minutes, until just tender.  Drain.  Cool slightly (or do the day before) and cut into 1/4-inch slices.  Dissolve bouillon in water.  Combine with mayonnaise, vinegar, parsley, tarragon and pepper.  Toss gently and chill several hours or overnight.  Serve on leaf lettuce.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  pork chops
1  Tbsp. thyme (spice)
1  Tbsp. marjoram (spice)
1  can beef consomme soup
1  can water
1  c. uncooked long grain rice
1  green pepper, sliced into 6 pieces (rings)
1  tomato, sliced into 6 pieces (rings)
1  medium onion, sliced into 6 pieces (rings)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Brown chops and put into casserole dish. Sprinkle thyme and marjoram over each chop.  Place 1 ring of onion, pepper and tomato over each chop.  Pour uncooked rice around chops. Pour 1 can consomme soup and 1 can water over rice.  Cover casserole dish and place into 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours.

name: ICEBOX MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
2 1/4  c. flour
1  c. sour cream (1 carton)
3  whole eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  c. nuts
1  c. raisins (optional)
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Bake in greased and floured muffin tins for 10 to 12 minutes.  Mixture may be kept in refrigerator for many days and use small amounts for breakfast each day.

name: COCA-COLA SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Bing cherries
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  c. chopped pecans
1  envelope plain gelatin
1 small  box black cherry Jell-O
3  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  c. Coke
preparation: Drain pineapple and cherries.  Heat juices.  Pour over Jell-O and gelatin; dissolve.  Add cream cheese and dissolve.  Add Coke. Chill.  When almost set, add cherries, pineapple and pecans.  Chill until set.

name: CHEDDAR CHOWDER
ingredients:
2  c. boiling water
1/2  c. sliced carrots
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. flour
8  oz. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  c. chopped ham
2  c. diced potatoes
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. butter
2  c. skimmed milk
preparation: Add  water  to  carrots, potatoes, onions, celery, salt and pepper.  Simmer  10  minutes.  Do  not  drain.  Mix flour, butter, milk and Cheddar cheese; add last.  Stir until melted. Add ham last to mixture.  Heat.  Do not boil.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1 or 2 big  cans tomato sauce
1 or 2 big  cans diced tomatoes
1 or 2 big  cans chili beans
1  or 2 onions
1  lb. hamburger
chili powder
preparation: Brown and drain hamburger. Put your chili beans, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce and onion in a crock-pot. Add hamburger. Season with chili powder until you like the way it tastes, the way you want it to. Let it simmer all day, stirring occasionally. Eat and you are done.

name: MOLDED SPINACH SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon jello
1 1/2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  c. mayonnaise
salt and pepper
1  c. chopped spinach
3/4  c. cottage cheese
1/3  c. diced celery
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
preparation: Dissolve jello in 1 cup hot water.  Add 1/2 cup cold water, vinegar, mayonnaise, 1/4 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper.  Blend well with rotary beater.  Pour into tray for refrigerator freezing. Quick chill in freezing unit without changing control for 15 to 20 minutes or until firm, about 1-inch from edge but soft in center.  Turn mixture into bowl and whip with rotary beater until fluffy.  Fold in spinach (thin small pieces), cottage cheese, celery and onion.  Pour into individual molds.  Chill until firm in refrigerator (not freezing unit) 30 to 60 minutes.  Unmold and garnish with salad greens and optional tomato wedges.  Serve with additional mayonnaise.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix shortening, margarine, sugar and eggs.  Add dry ingredients and mix well. Shape into balls. Roll in cinnamon-sugar mixture.  Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: FRUIT AND YOGURT PARFAITS
ingredients:
1/4  c. slivered almonds
1/4  c. sweet flaked coconut
1/4  c. raisins
2  medium peaches
2  medium plums
2  c. strawberries
1/2  c. plain yogurt
1/2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. honey
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: In a small greased skillet, toast almonds and coconut over medium heat until golden.  Set aside and stir in raisins.  Thinly slice peaches and plums.  Halve strawberries and combine fruits in medium bowl.  In another bowl, stir in yogurt, sour cream, honey and vanilla.  Layer fruit and yogurt mixture in 4 parfait glasses, adding 1 tablespoon coconut mix to each glass when 1/2 filled. Top with remaining coconut mix.

name: FUDGE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
4  Tbsp. flour
1  stick melted butter or margarine
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients and beat until smooth.  Pour in an unbaked pie shell.  Bake for 30 minutes.

name: WEST INDIAN PORK
ingredients:
1  lb. pork tenderloin
1  Tbsp. Crisco shortening or Crisco oil, divided
2  medium bananas, peeled and sliced
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. brandy or rum
preparation: Slice tenderloin into 1-inch pieces.  Flatten slightly with heel of hand.  Heat one teaspoon Crisco shortening or Crisco oil in large skillet on medium heat.  Add meat.  Brown quickly on both sides, about 4 to 5 minutes.  Remove meat from skillet.  Keep warm.  Heat remaining 2 teaspoons Crisco shortening or Crisco oil in skillet.  Add bananas.  Saute 2 to 3 minutes.  Add brown sugar and brandy.  Cook and stir until sauce is thick and bubbly. Return meat to skillet.  Heat through.  Makes 4 servings. Contains 355 calories, fat 9 g (83 cal or 23% of total calories), sat fat 2 g (6% of total calories), carb 32 g, protein 33 g, chol 105 mg and sodium 85 mg.

name: MEXICAN EGGS
ingredients:
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1  large tomato
6  eggs
minced garlic
2  Tbsp. margarine
6  medium size mushrooms
preparation: Saute onion, green pepper and garlic in margarine.  Add sliced mushrooms and tomato (crushed).  Cook until tomato and mushrooms are heated through.  Mix eggs together in separate dish and add to onion and tomato mixture.  Cook together, mixing all ingredients together until eggs are cooked through.

name: RAINA'S FAVORITE BROWN COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. softened margarine
2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. vanilla
1  large bag (12 oz.) chocolate chips or colored chips
1  c. chopped nuts (if desired)
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Put margarine, sugar and eggs in mixing bowl.  Beat with electric mixer on medium until smooth.  Add flour, baking soda and vanilla; mix well.  Stir in chocolate chips and nuts (if desired).  Dough will be very stiff.  Spoon dough onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake for 8 to 10 minutes for soft cookies; for 10 to 12 minutes for crisp cookies.

name: STRAWBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. sifted all-purpose flour
3  Tbsp. baking powder
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  c. sliced strawberries
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Stir together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.  Beat eggs.  Blend in oil, vanilla and milk.  Add liquid to dry mixture. Stir quickly just until moistened.  Fold in strawberries.  Spoon into well-greased 2 1/2-inch muffin tins or paper muffin cups. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until golden brown.

name: HIDDEN VALLEY RANCH TURKEY-VEGETABLE PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. corkscrew pasta, cooked and drained
1  c. turkey, cut into strips
4 to 5  c. assorted cooked or raw vegetables (such as broccoli, bell peppers, cauliflower)
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
2  c. prepared Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing
preparation: Toss all ingredients in a bowl.  Chill until ready to serve.

name: OVEN BAKED SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
8  oz. whole wheat spaghetti, cooked
2 (14 oz.)  cans tomatoes, roughly chopped
1  large onion, grated
1  tsp. oregano
seasoning
1  c. Gruyere cheese, sliced
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese, grated
preparation: Grease four individual ovenproof dishes and place a quarter of the spaghetti in each one.  Pour tomatoes over the top.  Add the onion; sprinkle with oregano and season well.  Arrange the sliced cheese over the top of the spaghetti mixture.  Sprinkle with Parmesan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  pkg. Doritos
1  fryer, chicken stewed and boned
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can chicken broth
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes (with hot pepper)
1 1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  large onion, chopped
preparation: Heat  in  saucepan  broth,  mushroom  soup  and  Ro-Tel tomatoes.  Meanwhile, layer  in casserole dish Doritos, chicken, onion and cheese.  Pour  soup  mixture over this.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: ICEBOX PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  large Cool Whip
1  can drained crushed pineapple
1  c. chopped nuts
8  oz. jar red cherries
1/3  c. lemon juice
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour into graham cracker crust.

name: REAL FUDGE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
3/4  c. flour
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together in order.  For fudge like brownies, bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: MY FAVORITE CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. melted margarine
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk
3  eggs
1/4  c. lemon juice
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
preparation: Mix crackers, sugar and margarine together and press in the bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan.  Preheat oven to 300°.

name: RICH AND CHARLIE SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  head lettuce
1/2  head romaine lettuce
1  can artichokes, drained
1  red onion
1 small  jar pimento, drained
1/2  c. grated cheese
1/3  c. red vinegar
1/2  c. oil or olive oil
preparation: Mix ingredients and let sit 1/2 hour before serving.  Serves 6.

name: JAPANESE FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Cream margarine, sugar and eggs.  Add all other ingredients. Bake in uncooked pie shell for 40 minutes at 300°.

name: SUNSHINE BARBECUE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  c. barbecue sauce
8  skinless chicken pieces
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. orange juice
