preparation: You will need 1 Reynolds oven bag (large).

name: HOT BEEF DIP
ingredients:
1/2  cup chopped onion
1  Tbsp margarine
2  Tbsp dry white wine
1-8 oz package of cream cheese, softened
1/2  cup sour cream
1/2  cup mayonnaise
1- 2 1/2 oz  jar dried beef, finely chopped
1/2  cup chopped pecans
preparation: Sauté onion in margarine until tender.  Add wine; simmer a couple minutes.  Add remaining ingredients except pecans.  Spoon mixture into a 8 inch square baking dish and sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 350°.  Serve hot with your favorite crackers.

name: APRICOT DELIGHT
ingredients:
7 1/2  oz. box vanilla wafers, crushed
4  eggs
1 1/2  sticks oleo
2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
3  pkg. Dream Whip or 1 carton of Cool Whip
4  jars baby food (apricot with tapioca)
preparation: Place vanilla wafers in a well-buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cook in double boiler eggs, oleo and powdered sugar until it is the consistency of mayonnaise.  Spread mixture over crumbs.  Let cool. Put nuts over the filling.  Put Cool Whip over filling.  Pour baby food over top of Cool Whip.  Let set 24 to 48 hours before serving.

name: SWEDISH MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. finely ground beef
1/2  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1  egg
2/3  c. milk
2  Tbsp. grated onion
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix together lightly ground beef, bread crumbs, egg, milk, onion, salt, pepper and nutmeg.  Gently form into small balls (1 1/2-inches).  Brown in hot fat.  Add about 1/4 cup hot water. Cover.  Simmer 20 minutes.  Serve hot with slightly thickened pan gravy.  Makes 6 servings.

name: COLD SLAW - CUCUMBER AND ONIONS
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. cream
2  Tbsp. Miracle Whip
cabbage
preparation: Combine ingredients and pour over slaw.

name: CARAMEL FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate cake mix
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. caramels, unwrapped
1/4  c. margarine or butter
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Prepare cake mix as directed on package.  Pour 2 cups of batter into greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan; bake 15 minutes.

name: APPLE BRAID(Brunch)
ingredients:
1  pkg. (8 oz.) refrigerated crescent rolls
2  Tbsp. all purpose flour
1/3  c. granulated sugar
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/8  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/8  tsp. ground cloves
2  medium apples, peeled, cored and thinly sliced into rings
2  tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Unroll crescent dough into 2 rectangles.  Place in greased 13 x 9 inch baking pan with long sides overlapping 1/2 inch; press perforation together to seal. Lightly sprinkle surface of dough with flour.  Pat dough out with fingers to form 13 x 7 inch rectangle.  In medium bowl, combine sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves.  Cut apple slices into quarters;  Add to sugar mixture and toss lightly.  Place apple mixture in 2 inch wide strip lengthwise down center of dough to within 1/4 inch of each end.  Make cuts, 3/4 inch apart, on longest sides of rectangle just to edge of filling.  Braid dough by folding strips at an angle across apple mixture, alternating dough strips from one side to the other.  Fold top and bottom ends over; press to seal.  Brush with butter,  Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown.  Cool slightly.

name: AMBRA'S HOT ROLLS
ingredients:
6 to 6 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  pkg. dry yeast
2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. water
1/2  c. milk
5  Tbsp. sugar
5  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Heat water, margarine and milk until margarine melts (in microwave approximately 1 minute and 45 seconds).  Add liquid mixture to 4 cups of the flour, yeast, salt and sugar.  Mix with electric mixer until well blended.  Add 1 more cup of flour and mix with mixer.  Add remaining 1 1/2 cups of flour, a little at a time, and knead with hands.  Knead about 5 minutes either on flat surface or if using a large bowl, you can knead it in the bowl. Let rise in warm place until double (approximately 1 hour).

name: CHEESE BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. plain flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. shortening
1  tsp. salt
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Sift the dry ingredients; cut in shortening.   Add grated cheese.  Add milk, enough to make a soft dough.  Put on a floured board and knead 1/2 minute.  Roll 1/2-inch thick and cut with biscuit cutter.  Bake in hot oven (450°) for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: SPICED NUTS
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo
4  c. pecan halves
1 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. ground cloves
1  Tbsp. nutmeg
preparation: In a deep heavy skillet, melt oleo and stir in unbroken pecan halves.  Cook nuts	over  low heat, stirring frequently, for about 20 minutes	until lightly brown.  Sift confectioners sugar and spices.  Remove nuts from skillet with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.  Add	nuts to spiced sugar and toss until generously coated.  Turn  nuts  into  colander and shake gently to remove excess sugar.  Spread  nuts on paper towel to cool.  Store in lightly covered container.

name: CRAB DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. frozen crab, thawed
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  small onion, chopped fine
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Put in a baking dish and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Yield: 16 servings, approximately 2 tablespoons per serving.  Contains 75 calories per serving.   Diabetic exchanges: 1/2 meat, 1 fat.

name: SPICY LASAGNE ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1  large yellow onion, chopped fine
1  tsp. dried basil, crumbled
1/2  tsp. dried marjoram, crumbled
1  bay leaf, crumbled
2  cloves garlic, minced
3/4  tsp. black pepper
1/2  skinned, boned chicken breast, chopped fine (4 oz.)
1 (1 lb.)  can low sodium tomatoes, chopped with their juice
2  Tbsp. low sodium tomato paste
8  ruffle edged lasagne noodles
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  c. part skim Ricotta cheese
1/2  lb. fresh spinach, trimmed and chopped or 1/2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1/4  tsp. ground mace or nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Heat olive oil in a heavy 10-inch skillet over moderate heat for 1 minute.  Add the onion, basil, marjoram, bay leaf, half of the garlic and 1/4 teaspoon of the pepper.  Cook, uncovered, until the onion is soft (about 5 minutes).   Remove 2 tablespoons of the mixture and set aside.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
4  eggs
3  c. sugar
1  c. oil
2/3  c. water
1 large  can pumpkin
3 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. allspice
1  c. nuts
1  c. raisins
preparation: Mix first five ingredients first.  Add remaining ingredients and mix by hand.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Makes 4 small or 2 large loaves.

name: SUGARLESS APPLE PIE
ingredients:
4  c. apples, sliced
2  Tbsp. margarine
cinnamon to taste
8 or 9  oz. can frozen apple juice concentrate
1 1/4  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Heat juice in a saucepan.  Add the apple slices.  Stir in cornstarch which has been blended with a little water.  Pour into a 9-inch pastry-lined pie pan.  Dot with margarine and put on the top crust.  Bake as usual (400° for 10 minutes, then 350° until browned).  Do not use tart apples.

name: CANDIED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  stick margarine
boiled sweet potatoes (red and white mixed)
preparation: Peel the boiled sweet potatoes.  Slice them the long way and lay in Pyrex dish.  Mix the sugars and cinnamon together in a bowl. Sprinkle this mixture over the top of the sliced sweet potatoes. Cut the margarine in chunks and lay on top of the sugar.  Bake in a 350° oven until most of the sugar melts.  You might need to sprinkle a little water on top of sugar before baking.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. corn oil
2  eggs (unbeaten)
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
3  c. chopped apples
preparation: Sift together the flour, soda and salt.  Mix the corn oil, eggs, sugar and vanilla.  Add dry ingredients, then add the pecans and apples.  Bake in a tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 300°.

name: CHICKEN FRIED STEAK
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. round steak
1  egg
1  Tbsp. milk
1  c. cracker crumbs
1/4  c. salad oil
preparation: Pound steak to 1/4-inch thickness.  Cut into serving size pieces.  Beat together egg and milk.  Dip meat in egg mixture and then in cracker crumbs.  In heavy skillet, heat oil.  Add coated meat.  Brown well on both sides, turning once.  Reduce heat and cook, covered, for 45 to 60 minutes or until tender.  Add salt and pepper.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
3  lb. ground beef
3  eggs
2  Tbsp. dried parsley
2  Tbsp. garlic puree
1  Tbsp. Italian seasoning mix
1  c. Italian bread crumbs
1  envelope Lipton onion soup mix
1/4  c. warm water
1/4  c. ketchup
preparation: In very large bowl, combine all ingredients.  Mix well.  Form into three small loaves.  Place all three loaves into a foil lined baking pan.  Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.  One loaf serves 3 to 4.  (Freezer other 2 loaves for later use.)

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. milk
1  medium onion, chopped
1 medium size  can green chili salsa
1  c. sour cream
1 (2 lb.)  pkg. grated cheese (Cheddar)
1  pkg. chicken breasts
1  pkg. corn tortillas
preparation: Bake the chicken ahead of time so skin and bones can be removed.  Cut chicken into cubes.  Cut about 7 tortillas into strips.  Make gravy of the first 6 ingredients.

name: SALMON SUPREME
ingredients:
4  salmon steaks
salt and pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped onions
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  pt. sour cream
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
paprika
preparation: Place salmon in greased shallow baking dish.  Sprinkle with salt, pepper and onions.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Spoon sour cream over salmon.  Sprinkle with parsley and paprika.   Bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven or until salmon flakes easily.

name: BANANA SPLIT DESSERT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
3  large bananas, sliced
1/2  c. melted margarine
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
2  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. margarine, softened
2  eggs
16  oz. whipped topping
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. chopped maraschino cherries
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving juice.  Pour pineapple juice over banana slices in small bowl; set aside.  Spread mixture of melted margarine and graham cracker crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cream confectioners sugar, softened margarine and eggs in mixer bowl for 15 minutes or until light and fluffy.  Spread into prepared dish.  Layer banana slices, pineapple and whipped topping over creamed mixture.  Sprinkle with pecans and cherries.  Chill until serving time.  Yield:  15 servings.

name: OVEN CARAMEL POPCORN
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/4  c. corn syrup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
3  qt. popped corn
preparation: Preheat oven to 200°.  Boil sugar, butter, syrup and salt for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and add soda.  Stir well; pour over popcorn in 9 x 13-inch glass pan.  Place in oven for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.  Spread on wax paper to cool.

name: BACON-BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  lb. (1 bunch) fresh broccoli
1/2  lb. bacon
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. water
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
dash of pepper
preparation: Cut broccoli into bite-sized pieces, discard stems.  Place in large bowl.  Cut bacon into 1-inch pieces.  Cook in skillet until crisp; remove and drain, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings.  Add bacon to broccoli and toss lightly.  Cook onion in reserved drippings until tender.  Stir in sugar, vinegar, water, salt and pepper.  Heat to boiling, reduce heat and cook slowly one minute. Pour over bacon and broccoli and toss well.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
12  oz. sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. dehydrated vegetable soup mix
2  oz. jar pimento
1  can water chestnuts
1  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, squeeze out all the water
preparation: Chop pimento and water chestnuts. Mix all ingredients together. Serve with bread cubes or crackers.

name: ROQUEFORT DRESSING
ingredients:
2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. buttermilk
1 (4 x 4-inch)  pkg. Roquefort (Blue cheese)
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. onion powder
preparation: Mix all ingredients together with a wire whisk.  Keep refrigerated.  Will keep for weeks if it lasts that long.

name: SUSAN'S MICROWAVE FUDGE
ingredients:
1/2  c. cocoa
1  lb. confectioners sugar (3 1/2 c.)
1/4  c. milk
1  stick butter
1  tsp. vanilla
2/3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Grease an 8 x 8 or 9 x 9-inch pan.  Mix cocoa and confectioners sugar.  Place butter on top of cocoa/sugar mixture. Also add milk; do not mix.  Cook in microwave dish 2 minutes on High.  Remove.  Add vanilla.  Beat with mixer until smooth.  Add nuts.  Pour in a greased pan.  Refrigerate until firm.

name: TORTELLINI AND SPINACH TOMATO SOUP
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  qt. chicken broth (4 c.)
9  oz. cheese tortellini
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
salt and pepper to taste
14 1/2  oz. can stewed tomatoes, chopped
1/2  (10 oz.) bag spinach, stemmed and chopped
1  tsp. dried basil leaves
2  cans tomato soup
1 1/2  cans milk
4  c. canned tomato soup
1  c. consomme
1/4  tsp. soy sauce
1  egg, slightly beaten
preparation: On top of stove, combine soup and consomme; bring to a boil. Add soy sauce.  Pour in egg and stir constantly for 2 minutes, until egg separates into shreds.  Pour and serve.

name: MICROWAVE RITZ PIZZA SNACK
ingredients:
Ritz crackers
pizza sauce
cheese
pepperoni
preparation: Put sauce on cracker.  Put on pepperoni.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Place in microwave until cheese melts (about 10 seconds).

name: ICED COFFEE
ingredients:
8  c. strong vanilla nut coffee
1  c. confectioners sugar
2  Tbsp. vanilla
8  oz. whipping cream, whipped
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Make coffee in pot (very strong).  Then add sugar and vanilla; mix well and chill.  When serving, whip cream.  Add ice cubes in a large wine glass; pour in coffee to 2/3 full.  Spoon whipping cream on top of coffee.  Sprinkle with nutmeg.

name: 5-MINUTE PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
2  c. white flour
1  c. plain salt
4  tsp. cream of tartar (optional)
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
2  c. warm water
1  pkg. Kool-Aid (any flavor optional for coloring)
preparation: In a medium saucepan put all ingredients.  Stir and cook over medium heat until mixture resembles mashed potatoes and comes away from sides of saucepan.  (If it is still sticky, it is cooked enough.)  Dump dough onto kneading surface and knead until all lumps are gone.

name: CHUNKY CHIPPERS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening or margarine
1/2  c. chunky peanut butter
2  eggs
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. water
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Lightly grease cookie sheets.  Mix flour, baking soda and salt together in bowl.  Beat sugar, shortening, peanut butter, eggs, vanilla and water in bowl until creamy.  Add flour mixture.  Blend well.  Stir in chocolate pieces.  Drop dough by teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto prepared cookie sheets.  Bake about 12 to 14 minutes or until firm to touch.  Let cool and enjoy!

name: SHAKE AND BAKE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  frying chicken, cut up
1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
garlic salt
pepper
preparation: Dip chicken pieces in milk; drain.  Place margarine in 13 x 9-inch pan.  Melt in 400° oven until melted.  Combine flour, salt, paprika and poultry seasoning in paper bag.  Shake well.  Place chicken in flour mixture.  Shake until well coated.  Place in melted butter.  Turn once to coat.  Sprinkle with garlic salt and pepper, if desired.  Bake uncovered in 400° oven for 30 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake 30 minutes or until tender.

name: QUICK MEAT STEW
ingredients:
2  c. diced meat
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
1 (16 oz.)  can vegetable soup
preparation: Brown meat in margarine and flour.  Add soup. Cook until thickened.

name: BLUE SOUP
ingredients:
3  slices salt pork
1  qt. speckled butter beans
1  qt. field peas
1  pt. whole kernel corn
5  qt. water
1/2  c. corn meal
salt to taste
preparation: Parboil and fry salt pork in heavy skillet.  Put in large pot with beans, peas, corn and water.  Bring to boil; lower heat to medium and boil 3 hours, adding more water as needed.  Mix corn meal and salt with enough water to make it soupy.  Add to pot and bring to boil.  Lower heat and simmer 20 minutes longer.  Yield: 8 servings.

name: THREE BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can French green beans
1  can red kidney beans
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. vinegar
1  can wax beans
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. Wesson oil
1/2  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Drain and wash beans.  Add green pepper and onion.  Marinate overnight in oil, salt, pepper, vinegar and sugar.

name: CHEESE CRACKER NIBBLES
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
dash of red pepper
2/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Combine flour and red pepper in bowl.  Add cheese, mixing well. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal.  Mix with hands until dough is smooth.  Shape into a ball.  Roll out dough on a lightly floured surface to 1/3-inch thickness.  Cut into desired shapes with cookie cutters.

name: CHILI RELLENOS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
nonstick spray coating
2 (4 oz.)  cans diced green chili peppers, drained
8  oz. Cheddar cheese, shredded (2 c.)
4 eggs or 8  oz. carton frozen egg substitute, thawed
2  c. skim milk
1  c. pkg. biscuit mix
1  c. cottage cheese
preparation: Spray a 3-quart rectangular baking dish with nonstick spray coating.  Sprinkle with chili peppers and Cheddar cheese; set aside.

name: CORN DOGS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. corn meal
2  tsp. baking powder
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. shortening, melted
1  lb. wieners
preparation: Stir milk into dry ingredients.  Add melted shortening.  For deep frying, dip wieners in batter, holding with a fork or skewer. Drain excess batter back into bowl.  Fry in wire basket until golden brown at 375°.  Drain on paper towel.  Serve hot.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. meal
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1 (17 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1/4  c. bacon grease
2  c. shredded sharp cheese
1  Tbsp. chopped jalapeno pepper
1  medium onion
1/4  lb. sausage
1/2  lb. ground beef
preparation: Combine 1 cup meal, salt and soda; mix in bowl.  Add eggs, milk, corn and bacon grease.  Stir until smooth; set aside. Saute beef and sausage; drain.  Sprinkle 1 tablespoon cornmeal in greased skillet and heat.  Pour half of batter in the skillet; sprinkle with cheese, ground beef, sausage and onion, then pepper. Pour remaining batter over mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Let stand in skillet about 10 minutes.

name: BUTTERY LEMON SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. powdered sugar
2  1/3 all-purpose flour, sifted
4  eggs
1/2  qt. sugar
1  tsp. lemon peel, grated
6  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. baking powder
3  Tbsp. powdered sugar
preparation: In a large bowl, cream together butter and the 1/2 cup powdered sugar until fluffy.  Add 2 cups of flour, beating until blended.  Spread evenly over the bottom of a well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes.

name: BALLETJES SOUP(Small Meatballs Soup)
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. cracker crumbs or rusk
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
2  bouillon cubes
1  grated potato
8  c. water
3 to 4 fresh or frozen or 16  oz. can stewed tomatoes, chopped in blender
1  can cream of celery soup
1  pkg. dry soup mix (Knorr vegetable mix or Honig soup)
3 to 4  oz. thin noodles, broken up
preparation: Roll ground beef, cracker crumbs, pepper, salt and egg into small meatballs.  Boil water. Add meatballs and cook, covered, 1/2 hour. Skim off foam.  Add tomatoes, canned soup, dry soup mix, noodles and bouillon cubes. Simmer 1/2 hour. Add potato. Simmer 1/2 hour. Salt and pepper to taste.

name: FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
8  eggs
4  c. flour (I use self-rising; leave 2 cups out for fruit)
2  boxes raisins
1  lb. pineapple (candied or canned)
1  lb. candied cherries
1  qt. fig preserves
1  qt. pecans
mixed fruit (if desired)
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. ginger
preparation: Mix shortening, sugar, eggs and 2 cups of flour in pan.  Set aside.  Then mix all fruit together; put in other 2 cups of flour and all the spices.  Mix well together.  Then mix all together in one big pan.  You can use tube pans or loaf pans.  It will take 2 tube pans or 4 loaf pans.  Cook at 350° for 90 minutes to 2 hours.

name: SINFULLY DELICIOUS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick softened margarine
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix the flour, margarine and nuts.  Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350°.  Cool completely.

name: CHUTNEY-CURRY SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese (soft)
1/4  c. Major Grey's chutney
few drops Tabasco sauce
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. curry powder
1/4  c. almonds, chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients.

name: White Sugar Cake Cookies
ingredients:
1  c. light brown sugar
1  box white raisins
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. crystallized pineapple
2  c. candied cherries
7  c. pecans
3  eggs, well beaten
3  c. plain flour
1  c. butter
2  c. chopped dates
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix butter and sugar.  Add eggs and other ingredients.  Drop from spoon onto greased pan.  Bake at 275° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: BACHELOR BAIT/CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs, separated
3  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1/3  c. strong coffee
2 1/4  c. cake flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream the butter, sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Add beaten egg yolks.  Mix melted chocolate and coffee to a smooth paste. Cool and add to creamed mixture. Sift flour, measure and sift again with the baking powder and salt. Add to first mixture alternately with the milk. Add nuts.  Pour into 2 greased and floured deep 8-inch layer pans. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes. Frost with chocolate nut frosting.

name: JUDY'S LEMON-PEPPER CHICKEN
ingredients:
lemon pepper spice
butter
boneless skinless chicken breast
preparation: Roll chicken breast in butter.  Put lemon pepper spice on chicken breast.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Do not overcook.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 (17 oz.)  can creamed corn
1 1/4  c. self-rising cornmeal
1/3  c. cooking oil
2  eggs, well beaten
1  medium onion, diced
3/4  c. milk
8  oz. Cheddar cheese, grated
hot peppers to taste
1  lb. sausage or ground beef
preparation: Brown meat, drain and set aside.  Mix corn, cornmeal, oil, eggs, onion, milk and 3/4 of the cheese.  Add meat and peppers. Mix well.  Pour into a greased baking dish and use leftover cheese to put on top.  Bake at 375° to 400° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Can be wrapped in foil and put in freezer.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  c. butter or oleo, softened
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1 small  pkg. Jell-O brand vanilla instant pudding
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chip cookies
preparation: Cream sugars, eggs and butter together.  Add dry pudding mix, then add remaining ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. salt
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. water
1  Tbsp. salad oil
preparation: In a saucepan, combine dry ingredients.   Mix in wet ingredients and cook at medium heat for about 3 minutes or until edges look dry.   Stir into ball and dump on wax paper. Immediately put water in the pan; it will be easier to wash. Knead the dough while still hot and until salt crystals are gone. Store in airtight container.

name: M & M COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2 1/4  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
3/4  lb. plain M&M's candy
preparation: Blend  shortening, brown sugar and granulated sugar in a large bowl.  Beat  eggs,  then  add  eggs  and  vanilla.  Sift remaining   dry  ingredients  together;  blend  into  sugar-egg mixture.  Stir  in 1/2 cup candies (reserve remaining candy for decorating).  May  add  chopped  pecans  if desired.  Drop from teaspoon  on  ungreased  cookie sheet.  Decorate top of cookies with remaining candy.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Makes 6 dozen.

name: FRITO SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  head lettuce, broken in pieces
3  tomatoes, cut up
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  grated onion
1  can pinto beans
1  pkg. crushed Fritos
1  bottle Catalina dressing
preparation: Combine all ingredients except last two ingredients.  Mix those in immediately before serving.

name: CRANRASPBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry jello
1  c. boiling water
1  lb. can whole raspberry sauce
2  bananas, diced
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Stir in whole cranberry sauce and finally bananas and nuts.  Chill in 3 1/2 cup mold.  Can be served with sour cream.

name: BLUEBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
angel food cake
1  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese (8 oz.)
1/2  bag confectioners sugar
1  can blueberry pie filling
1/2  c. milk
2  pkg. Dream Whip
preparation: Cut angel food cake into slightly thin pieces and place in bottom of container.  Mix Dream Whip and milk (provided on package) together.  After this is mixed, add cream cheese, confectioners sugar and 1/2 cup milk in with Dream Whip.  Combine all together.  Spread part of this over the layer of cake.  Place some of the filling over this. Do another layer of cake and do the same with the mixture and then the berries on top.  Cool before serving.

name: TAMALA PIE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. chives
2  Tbsp. minced garlic
1/2  tsp. oregano
1  Tbsp. bacon grease
1/2  tsp. Cajun spice
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  tsp. sage
1/2  tsp. parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. turmeric
1/2  tsp. basil
pinch of red pepper
1/2  tsp. marjoram
1 1/2  c. cooked grits
1  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Saut onions and garlic in bacon drippings; add meat and brown. Add the seasonings and simmer. Cook grits and then stir into meat mixture. Grease baking dish, then pour into baking dish. Top with shredded cheese. Bake in 350° preheated oven until cheese is melted and bubbly.  Allow cooling about 10 minutes before serving.

name: FROZEN STRAWBERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
2  egg whites
1  c. granulated sugar*
2  c. sliced strawberries*
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. whipping cream
preparation: *Or 10 ounce package berries, thawed and reduce sugar to 2/3 cup.

name: STRAWBERRY FUDGE REVEL CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. Gold Medal all-purpose flour
1/3  c. cocoa
1/4  c. margarine or butter, softened
1  pkg. Betty Crocker SuperMoist Strawberry Cake Mix
1  c. water
1/3  c. vegetable oil
3  eggs
Chocolate Glaze (below)
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Generously grease and flour 12-c. Bundt cake pan or tube pan, 10x4 inches.  Mix brown sugar, flour, cocoa and margarine until crumbly; reserve.  Beat cake mix (dry), water, oil and eggs in large bowl on low speed, scraping bowl frequently, 2 minutes.  Pour about 1 2/3 c. batter into pan; sprinkle with about 1 1/3 c. of the crumbly mixture.  Pour about 1 2/3 c. batter into pan; sprinkle with remaining crumbly mixture.  Pour remaining batter into pan.  Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, 45 to 55 minutes.  Cool 10 minutes; invert on wire rack or heatproof serving plate.  Remove pan; cool cake completely. Spread top of cake with Chocolate Glaze, allowing some to drizzle down side.

name: FRESH COCONUT ICING
ingredients:
3  fresh coconuts, peeled and grated (reserve juice to add to filling) *
2 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. half and half
1/2  pt. whipping cream
2  tsp. cornstarch
preparation: Bring all ingredients except 1/2 cup of half and half with cornstarch dissolved in it to a bubbly boil.  Stir in cornstarch mixture and continue cooking and stirring for 8 to 10 minutes. Put frosting on your favorite yellow or white cake layers while frosting is hot.  This will frost three 9 x 13-inch layers or four 8-inch square layers.  It's very juicy.

name: JUST PEACHY
ingredients:
1  can peach pie filling
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  small container whipped topping
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix all and chill.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. raw apples, chopped
lemon juice
1 1/2  c. salad oil
2  c. sugar
2  large eggs
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Prepare apples.  Put a little lemon juice over them; set aside and cover.  Add sugar and  eggs  to  oil; mix well at low speed until creamy and  smooth.  Sift  flour and measure.  Sift again with salt, soda and  baking powder.  Add flour mixture to creamed mixture a little at  a  time.  Fold  in well after each addition; add vanilla.  When  batter  is stiff, remove beaters and finish mixing by hand.  Fold in apples and nuts.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 55 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

name: BAKED LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. basil
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  lb. can tomatoes (2 c.)
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
10  oz. pkg. lasagna noodles
3  c. cottage cheese
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
1  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Mix together and cook 30 minutes the beef, onion, garlic, basil, salt, tomatoes and tomato paste.  Cook noodles and set aside.  Mix cottage cheese, eggs, salt, pepper, parsley flakes and Parmesan cheese together.  In 9 x 13 pan, put 1/2 of the noodles in the bottom. Next, put in 1/2 beef mixture, then 1/2 cheese mixture, then 1/2 Mozzarella cheese.  Repeat process for second layer.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.  Let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving.  Serves 12.

name: PUMPKIN NUT BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. corn oil
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. pumpkin
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Sift together flour, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, baking powder, baking soda and salt, then add the pumpkin and chopped nuts.  In a separate bowl, mix corn oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Pour into pumpkin mixture.  Grease and flour two loaf pans.  Pour half the batter into each pan.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: ORANGE SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
6  medium sweet potatoes
2  tsp. grated orange rind
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
pinch of salt
1  c. orange juice
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Cook sweet potatoes in jackets in 1/2 inch of boiling, salted water until tender, about 30 minutes.  Remove skins.

name: DATE BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. dates
1  c. hot water
1  c. brown sugar
1  unbeaten egg
1  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. shortening
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. walnuts
1 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Spoon soda over dates (cut up); add hot water.  Cool.  Mix shortening, brown sugar, egg, flour, salt and nuts.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: CHICKEN AND NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  lb. chicken
1  c. each:  chopped celery, onion and green pepper
salt and pepper to taste
1  can tomato soup
1  can mushroom soup
1/2 small  jar chopped pimentos
1/2  c. sliced olives
1 (10 oz.) and 1 (5 oz.)  pkg. noodles
1 1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
preparation: Stew chicken until tender.  Remove from broth and let cool. Cut from bones in bite sized pieces.  Have ready the celery, onion and green pepper.  Saute in some of the chicken fat until tender, but not brown.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Then add tomato soup, mushroom soup, pimentos, olives, the chopped chicken and a little of the broth.  Let cook slowly while noodles are cooking. Cook noodles in the remaining chicken broth.  Add water if necessary.  When noodles are tender, add to the chicken mixture. Mix well and fold in cheese.  Put in casserole and bake 40 minutes at 350°.  Freezes well.

name: OUTSTANDING OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg, well beaten
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. quick rolled oats
1/2  c. finely crushed walnuts or pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together the shortening and the 2 sugars; blend well. Add egg and stir.  Sift together the flour, soda and cinnamon; add to the first mixture.  Stir in oatmeal, nuts and vanilla.  Chill dough for 1 hour.  Make walnut size pieces of dough; place on cookie sheet.  Butter the bottom of a small glass and dip into white sugar.  Use glass to flatten each piece of dough.  Continue with each piece of dough.  There is no need to re-butter the glass.  Do re-dip in sugar before each pressing.  Bake for 10 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: FRENCH COUNTRY-STYLE BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. beef stew meat, cut in 1-inch cubes
1/4  c. flour
2  Tbsp. oil
2 (14 1/2 oz.)  cans Del Monte tomatoes
1 (13 oz.)  can beef broth
4  to 6 carrots (1-inch chunks)
2  to 4 potatoes (1-inch chunks)
3/4  tsp. thyme
2  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
preparation: Combine meat and flour in a plastic bag.  Toss to coat evenly. In a 6 quart pot, brown meat in oil.  Add salt and pepper to taste, if desired.  Add remaining ingredients except mustard. Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat.  Cover and simmer about 1 hour or until beef is tender.  Stir occasionally.  Blend in mustard.  If too thin, add a little Wondra flour to thicken.  Serve over rice.

name: HEARTS OF ROMAINE SALAD
ingredients:
1  large head romaine lettuce
1  c. loosely packed basil leaves
1  tsp. minced shallots
1  tsp. white vinegar
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
1/2  c. olive oil
1/4  c. freshly ground Parmesan cheese
salt and fresh ground pepper
preparation: Remove dark green outer leaves and discard.  Tear remaining leaves into quarter pieces; rinse and dry.  Add into food processor the basil, shallots, vinegar and mustard and process briefly (three or four short bursts).  Add oil and cheese and process in two short bursts, just to combine.  Divide romaine hearts among four chilled plates and drizzle dressing over. Garnish with basil sprigs and toasted pine nuts.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
29  oz. can sliced peaches
16  oz. can fruit cocktail
20  oz. can pineapple chunks
5  bananas, sliced
6  oz. jar cherries
3 1/2  oz. box instant lemon jello
3 1/2  oz. box instant vanilla jello
preparation: In a large bowl, mix fruit. Add boxes of jello. Mix well. Chill and serve.

name: SNAPPY CRAB DIP
ingredients:
6 1/2  oz. can crab meat
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. Tabasco
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. horseradish
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine all the ingredients.  Refrigerate until time to serve. Quick and good!

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
1/2 (14 oz.)  bottle catsup
dash of Worcestershire sauce
1/4  stick margarine
2  Tbsp. mustard
1  green pepper, chopped
2/3  c. brown sugar
1  large onion, chopped
3 medium  cans pork and beans
preparation: Melt margarine in skillet; brown onion, green pepper and meat. Mix in other ingredients and pour into casserole dish.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: ONION AND BACON QUICHE
ingredients:
5  medium onions, thinly sliced
1/4  c. butter or oleo
3 thick  slices bacon
3  eggs
1/2  c. whipping cream
1  tsp. flaky pastry
1/2  tsp. caraway seed (optional)
chopped parsley for garnish
1  already pie crust
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  In a large frying pan, cook onions in butter over medium heat.  Stir occasionally until onions are soft and begin to brown, 15 to 20 minutes.

name: CARROT NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
3/4  c. liquid shortening
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour (plain)
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. carrots, grated
1/2  c. nutmeats
preparation: Mix together sugar and shortening.  Add eggs.  Sift together flour, cinnamon, soda and salt.  Add to first mixture, then stir in carrots and nutmeats.  Bake in a loaf pan for 1 hour at 370°.

name: SEAFOOD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. shrimp, cooked
8  oz. oysters in juice, cooked
1  lb. scallops, cooked
1  lb. crabmeat
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. flour
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dill weed
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. dry mustard
pinch of thyme
2  c. cheese, grated
2  egg yolks
juice of 1 lemon
1  lb. mushrooms
preparation: Make sauce with butter, flour and milk. Add spices, cheese and salt. Be sure that the cheese melts. Add slightly beaten egg yolks. Cook for 5 minutes over low heat. Mix seafood with sauce. Sauté mushrooms and add to seafood and sauce. Add lemon juice. Pour into a large casserole dish. Garnish with additional cheese. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes. Serves 12.

name: SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
chicken wings
1  c. orange juice
1/2  c. honey
2  pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing
preparation: Mix orange juice, honey and dressing; pour over wings.  Bake in a 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours, until chicken is golden brown.

name: SCRUMPTIOUS CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. thin noodles
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
4  c. cooked, cubed chicken
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. stuffing
1  c. chicken broth
preparation: Cook noodles; drain.  Add in soups, sour cream, chicken and 1/3 stuffing.  Turn into a 2-quart casserole.  Combine remaining stuffing, butter and broth.  Place over top of casserole.  Cover with foil; bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: Zucchini Bread
ingredients:
3  beaten eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. grated zucchini
3  c. flour
3 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. oil
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
3 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped walnuts
dash of nutmeg
preparation: Mix sugar, beaten eggs, oil, vanilla and zucchini.  Combine dry ingredients separately, then mix together with wet ingredients.  Pour into 2 ungreased loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CREAM CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (17 oz.)  can of cream style corn
1  cup dry minute rice
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Combine all ingredients in large bowl, mix well.  Pour into greased 9-inch baking dish.  Bake at 375° for 25 Minutes or until liquid is absorbed.  Cover with cheese and crushed crackers.

name: MOM'S DATE BARS
ingredients:
8  oz. dates
1/2  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. water
1 1/4  c. sifted flour
1 1/4  c. oatmeal
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. margarine or butter
preparation: Combine and cook first 3 ingredients over moderate heat until slightly thick.  Combine and blend remaining ingredients.  Press half of mixture into 8 x 8-inch pan.  Spread with date mixture; and cover with remaining mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool and sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

name: BEST EVER OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. oatmeal
2  eggs
1  c. butter or margarine
3  Tbsp. sweet milk
2  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. raisins
1 scant  tsp. soda
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly; add eggs and milk, then oatmeal, flour, soda, spices and vanilla which have been mixed together.  Mix thoroughly before adding raisins and nuts.  Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet and bake in preheated 375° oven until lightly browned.  Remove with spatula to wire rack to cool.  Makes 6 to 7 dozen medium size cookies.

name: QUICK DESSERT
ingredients:
1  Jiffy yellow or white cake mix
1  can favorite pie filling
1  stick margarine, melted
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In 9 x 9-inch pan, pour pie filling.  Sprinkle dry cake mix over top.  Do not mix.  Cover with nuts.  Swizzle melted margarine over top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with Cool Whip.

name: HAMBURGER STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. lean hamburger
1  small onion, chopped
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
1  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 1/2  c. nonfat sour cream
cooked noodles or rice
preparation: In a large nonstick skillet, brown onion until tender.  Remove from skillet and brown hamburger until done.  Stir in cooked onion, flour, salt, garlic, pepper and mushrooms.   Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Stir in soup.  Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.  Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes.  Stir in sour cream and heat through.  Serve over rice or noodles.  Serves 6.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH CHEWIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan; add brown sugar over low heat.  Stir constantly and bring to a boil.  Cool slightly and add eggs, one at a time.  Add vanilla.  Sift dry ingredients and add.  Drop on ungreased cookie sheet by teaspoonful.  Bake at 350° in preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: TURNIP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked mashed turnips
3  Tbsp. butter
4  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs, well beaten
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Combine turnips, butter, sugar, salt, eggs, pepper and 3/4 cup of the bread crumbs; mix well.  Pour into buttered casserole dish. Top with rest of bread crumbs mixed with 1 tablespoon of melted butter.  Bake until brown, about 30 minutes, at 350°.

name: "OUTSIDE IN" BURGERS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
4  thinly sliced onion rings
4  thin tomato slices
4 thin  slices Cheddar cheese
4  tsp. Dijon-style mustard
4  tsp. pickle relish
4  tsp. mayonnaise
4  crisp lettuce leaves
4  hamburger buns
preparation: Mix meat with the salt, pepper and parsley.  Divide into 8 portions.  Flatten each portion to make rounds 4 to 5 inches in diameter.  Top 4 patties with onion, tomato and cheese.  Top 4 patties with mustard, relish and mayonnaise.   Place relish patties over other patties, carefully enclosing all the relishes on the inside.  Press out any air bubbles and seal well.  Broil or grill about 4 minutes on each side.  Top with lettuce and place into prepared buns.  Serve immediately.

name: SIMPLE FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  qt. fruit with sugar added to taste and heated
preparation: Melt butter in casserole dish and set aside.  Mix flour, sugar and milk; beat well.  Pour over butter.  Do not stir.   Pour heated fruit over flour mixture.  Bake at 375° until brown, approximately 30 minutes.

name: SWEET AND SOUR MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
2  eggs
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  onion, minced
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1 1/4  c. pineapple juice
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. wine vinegar
1/3  c. water
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  c. pineapple and papaya chunks
2  green peppers, cut to bite size
preparation: Blend together beef, eggs, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, onion, pepper, nutmeg, salt and garlic.  Form into 1-inch balls.  Heat oil in skillet and brown meatballs on all sides.

name: CINNAMON CARROT MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. oat bran
1 1/2  c. skim milk
1 1/2  c. shredded carrot
1/2  c. raisins
1/3  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. oil
1  egg, slightly beaten
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Mix baking powder, cinnamon, salt and oat bran in large bowl.  Mix with milk, a little at a time, then stir in carrots, raisins, sugar, oil, egg and flour.  Spoon batter into muffin pan which has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray, filling each cup 2/3 full.  Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes 12.

name: YUM-YUM SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. water
3/4  c. sugar
1 small  pkg. orange Jell-O
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. grated cheese
1 small  carton Cool Whip
1/2  c. or more chopped nuts
miniature marshmallows (optional)
preparation: Boil sugar in water. Add Jell-O and pineapple. Let stand to cool. Fold in cheese, Cool Whip, nuts and marshmallows. Let set to congeal. Stir occasionally as it begins to set. May be served as a salad on top of lettuce or as a dessert.

name: CHICKEN FLORENTINE WITH RICE
ingredients:
3/4  lb. boned chicken breasts
1  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  can chicken broth
1  pkg. (10 oz.) Birds Eye chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
1/2  c. small carrot sticks
1/2  tsp. oregano
dash of nutmeg
1 1/2  c. Minute instant brown rice
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook and stir chicken and onion in hot margarine in large skillet until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.  Stir cornstarch into broth.  Add to chicken with spinach, carrots, oregano and nutmeg.  Bring to a full boil.  Stir in rice and simmer 5 minutes. Cover; remove from heat.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Stir in cheese.

name: BEAN SOUP(6 Quarts)
ingredients:
5 to 6  c. navy beans
salt to taste (may take 2 to 3 tsp.)
milk
1  c. diced or chopped onions (more or less to your liking)
1  c. diced celery or cooked spinach
1  c. tomato soup (homemade is best), plain tomato juice or even catsup
Accent
garlic powder
softened butter
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Soak the beans in water for 3 to 4 hours or overnight.  Wash them into a 6-quart stockpot; just cover with water.  Add salt to taste (may take 2 to 3 teaspoons).  Cover with lid; cook until tender.  Add more water during cooking, if necessary.  Add enough milk to make it soupy.  Add the onions.  A cup of diced celery or cooked spinach enhances it, too.  Add a cup of tomato soup, plain tomato juice or even catsup, but use less of this.  Sprinkle in some Accent and garlic powder seasoning (a teaspoon or more of each according to your preference).  Let simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. If the milk doesn't get a little thickish, rub some softened butter in with 2 tablespoons flour to make a paste.  Add a bit of bean liquid and stir, then pour back into the pot.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can undrained crushed pineapple
1  can cherry pie filling
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. coconut (optional)
1  box yellow cake mix
2  sticks oleo
1  c. nuts (pecans or walnuts)
preparation: Layer ingredients as follows:  pineapple, cherry pie filling, coconut, nuts.  Sprinkle dry cake mix on top.  Pour melted oleo over top.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: FAVORITE PORK CHOP DINNER
ingredients:
5  pork chops
salt
pepper
23  oz. can sweet potatoes, drained
3/4  c. maple syrup
1  can biscuits
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  In large skillet, brown pork chops.  Place pork chops in ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking pan; drain liquid. Arrange sweet potatoes around pork chops.  Pour syrup over pork chops and sweet potatoes and in bottom of pan.  Arrange biscuits next to chops and potatoes.  Return to oven.  Bake, uncovered, 17 to 25 minutes or until biscuits are brown and pork chops are tender.

name: EGG AND SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8 to 10  slices white bread, crusts removed and cubed
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
4  eggs
2  c. milk
3/4  tsp. dry mustard
1  lb. bulk pork sausage
preparation: Brown sausage; stir until crumbly.  Drain well.  Put bread cubes in bottom of ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Lay cheese on top of bread.  Put sausage on top of cheese.  Beat eggs; add 2 cups of milk and seasoning as desired.  Pour liquid mixture over layered ingredients.  Cover; refrigerate overnight.

name: GREEN BEANS SUPREME
ingredients:
2 (9 oz.)  pkg. frozen French-cut green beans
2  Tbsp. butter
1/3  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook beans according to package directions; drain.  In a small saucepan, melt butter.  Saute onion until tender.  Add flour, salt and pepper mixing well.  Carefully blend in sour cream and heat thoroughly.  (Do not boil.)  Stir into beans and put into casserole.  Top with cheese and bake for 15 minutes at 350°. Serves 6 to 8.  Use 1-quart size casserole.

name: MAYUMI'S CHICKEN YAKITORI
ingredients:
3/4  lb. chicken thighs, cut in 1/2-inch cubes
3  Tbsp. Kikkoman soy sauce
3  Tbsp. Mirin (sweet sake) or white wine
onions
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. cornstarch
preparation: For marinade, combine soy sauce, Mirin, sugar and cornstarch and boil.  When it cools, marinate the meat for 20 minutes. Thread meat and onions alternately on bamboo skewers.  Broil 15 minutes at 375°, turning once and brushing with marinade 2 or 3 times.  Serve hot.

name: CHICKEN-CORNBREAD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. crumbled cornbread
1/2  c. chopped green or white onions
1/2  c. chopped celery
2  c. chicken, cooked and coarsely chopped
2  c. chicken broth
1  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: OATMEAL CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. boiling water
1  c. rolled oats
preparation: Stir boiling water into oats and let stand 20 minutes before making batter.

name: SEAFOAM
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
2/3  c. water
2  egg whites
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Beat egg whites and salt at speed 8 for 3 minutes in large bowl.  Boil sugar, corn syrup and water together until it forms a hard ball.  Pour syrup slowly into beaten whites while beating at speed 8.  Continue beating until mix passes glossy stage.  Add nuts and vanilla and continue beating until mix forms a peak. Pour on buttered platter or drop on waxed paper.

name: FRIT-O-QUE(Free-tokie)
ingredients:
1  lb. can chili con carne (plain or with beans)
1  c. grated cheese
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. crushed Fritos (measure after crushing)
preparation: Pour 1 cup chili con carne in casserole dish.  Add layer of grated cheese and chopped onion and layer of corn chips.   Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SOBA
ingredients:
10  oz. boiled fettucini noodles
2  large zucchini, cut into pinkie size strips
2  large carrots, julienned
1  large onion, sliced
1  (12 oz.) bag string beans
1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1/2  head fresh cabbage, sliced
1/4  c. oyster sauce
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: In a nonstick large pan (Dutch oven), spray with Pam.  Throw in all the veggies.  Put heat on medium.  Steam fry veggies, tossing now and then.  Sprinkle in garlic salt and pepper.  When veggies are crisp cooked, throw in noodles and stir to unstick noodles. Add sauces and heat through.

name: CHEESE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  pt. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
4  eggs
8  oz. Cheddar cheese, grated
2  c. bread crumbs
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
dash of Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Heat milk and butter until butter melts.  Beat eggs and mix together.  Add all ingredients together in a bowl.  Let mixture sit for about 30 minutes.  This gives the pudding a better taste. Pour into a buttered dish and bake for 45 minutes at 375°.  When done, it will be all puffed up and brown.

name: PECAN PIE *
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. corn syrup (dark)
1/4  c. melted butter
1  c. pecan meats (whole or chopped)
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add sugar, salt and vanilla and beat lightly.  Add syrup and butter.  Place pecans in bottom of unbaked crust; add filling.  Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: PIG STOMACH
ingredients:
1  pig stomach
1  lb. sausage, cut in small pieces
6  to 8 diced potatoes
1  medium onion, diced
2  Tbsp. parsley
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all together and stuff into cleaned pig stomach.  Sew hole closed.  Put into roast pan and bake at 350° for 3 1/4 to 4 hours. Remove lid the last 1/2 hour to brown skin.

name: NEW ENGLAND CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  medium onions, diced
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. diced pared potatoes
2  c. scalded whole milk
1 (11 oz.)  can chopped clams, drain and reserve juice
preparation: In a large pot, melt margarine.  Add onions and cook until tender.  Add flour, celery salt and pepper; blend.  Add salt, clam liquid with enough water added to make 2 cups and potatoes.  Cover and cook 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally.  Add milk and clams and warm through.  Makes 6 servings.  Best if made a day ahead.

name: CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick margarine
1  c. milk
1 1/4  c. self-rising flour
preparation: Cook chicken (boil); pull off bones.  Line pan with chicken. Mix soup with 3/4 cup chicken broth and pour over chicken.  Melt margarine; add to milk and flour and pour on chicken mixture. Bake at 325° until nicely browned.

name: ABBY'S CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1/3  c. powdered sugar
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  lb. butter
1  c. granulated sugar
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
4  eggs
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Melt butter and add to graham cracker crumbs and sugar. Line the bottom of spring-form pan; pack firmly.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE(Sophia Wood)
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. flour
1 1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
1  egg, well beaten
2  sq. chocolate
baked pastry shell
Cool Whip whipped cream
preparation: Bake pastry shell according to package directions. Cream butter until soft. Gradually blend in sugar, then add flour.

name: APPLE NUT RING
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  can apple pie filling
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Beat together first three ingredients.  Mix together in separate bowl all dry ingredients.  Add oil mixture to dry mixture.  Puree apple pie filling and add to mixture along with chopped pecans.  Bake at 350° in greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Freezes well.

name: SWEDISH MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  egg
2  crumbled bread slices
1  tsp. salt and pepper
1/3  c. milk
1/2  c. onion, diced
1  Tbsp. Greek seasoning
preparation: Combine all above ingredients in a mixing bowl, press into hamburger patties and place in a baking pan.  Cook at 350° for 45 minutes.  Drain grease, then smother them with gravy of your choice.  Bake again for 15 minutes.

name: PARTY SAUSAGES
ingredients:
1  jar mustard
1  jar orange marmalade
small sausages, such as Little Smokies or Sizzlers
preparation: Use small jars of the mustard and marmalade for small groups and large jars for medium to large groups.  Mix the mustard and marmalade together over low heat.  Use a saucepan big enough to allow room for the sausages.  When the mixture is hot, add sausages.  Use as many as you need, just make sure the mixture covers them all.  Heat thru, stirring occasionally.

name: SWEETHEART COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
tart jelly or jam
1  egg yolk
1/2  c. flour
1/3  c. nuts (if desired)
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar and egg yolk.  Add flour and knead. Form dough into tiny balls and place on baking sheet.  Make a depression in center of each and fill with jam or any desired tidbit.  Bake in 350° oven until lightly browned.  Makes 60 cookies.

name: SALMON SPREAD
ingredients:
2 (15 oz.)  cans salmon, drained, boned and flaked
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  Tbsp. prepared horseradish
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2 to 3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1 1/2  tsp. dried dill weed
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. (8 oz.) sour cream
fresh dill or parsley (optional)
toasted bread rounds or crackers
preparation: In mixing bowl, combine first 8 ingredients; mix well.  Spread on a serving platter and shape into a loaf or ball.  Top with sour cream.  Garnish with dill or parsley, if desired.  Serve with bread rounds or crackers.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
4  small apples, pared, cored and sliced
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. grated lemon rind
1/3  c. nonfat dry milk
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. brown Sugar Twin
1/2  c. Sugar Twin
preparation: Mix apples with lemon juice, making sure all sides are covered.  Arrange apples in rows in 7 x 10-inch baking dish sprayed with Pam.  Mix dry milk, lemon rind, cinnamon, Sugar Twin and brown Sugar Twin.  Sprinkle on apples.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. flour, unsifted
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1/4  c. cocoa
1 3/4  c. hot water
preparation: Stir together the first 5 ingredients. Add the milk, 2 tablespoons cocoa and vanilla.  Mix all together with dry stuff. Add the nuts (optional).  Pour in an 8 x 8-inch ungreased pan. Spread.  Sprinkle the brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa.  Pour the hot water over the batter.  Bake 40 minutes at 350°.  For a 9 x 13-inch pan, take all times 2.  Put Cool Whip on top.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. German chocolate
1/2  c. boiling water
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. butter (not margarine)
4  eggs, separated
1  tsp. baking soda
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
4  egg whites
preparation: Melt chocolate in boiling water; allow to cool.  Cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add egg yolks, one at a time; beat well.  Add chocolate and vanilla.  Sift all dry ingredients together.  Alternately add dry ingredients with buttermilk to butter-sugar mixture.  Beat egg whites; fold into mixture.  Turn oven on to 350°.  Prepare four 9-inch round pans by spraying with a nonstick baking spray.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 20 minutes, or until cake tests done.  After done, allow layers to cool completely before frosting.

name: SLOW COOKER SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef or turkey
1  large onion, chopped
1  garlic clove, minced
2 (16 oz.)  cans tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
12  oz. tomato paste
1  c. beef bouillon
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. dried oregano leaves
1  tsp. dried basil
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Combine meat in large skillet with onion and garlic.  Break up meat with a fork and cook until it loses red color.  Drain excess grease.  Transfer to slow cooker; add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.  Serve hot with spaghetti/macaroni.  Serves 6.  Freezes well.

name: APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sliced apples (or peaches or dewberries)
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. flour
1/2  c. milk
8  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  deep pie crust
preparation: Into unbaked pie crust, pour in apples.  Mix sugar and flour. Add milk and eggs; mix.  Pour filling over apples.  Mix softened butter, flour and sugar.  Sprinkle over top of pie.  Bake in a slow 300° oven for 1 hour or until crust is brown and filling is firm.  For apples or peaches you may wish to add 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon to the filling.

name: LO-CAL FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can mandarin oranges
1  can pineapple chunks
1  can chunky fruit cocktail
1  pkg. vanilla sugar-free instant pudding
3  Tbsp. sugar-free Tang (optional)
preparation: Choose fruits in own juice (no sugar added).  Drain fruit and reserve pineapple juice.  Mix together pudding, Tang and reserved pineapple juice.  Mix all ingredients together.  Chill.

name: MEALIE AND JOHNNIE
ingredients:
1  eggplant, peeled, sliced and fried in batter
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  onion
2  pods garlic
1  can stewed tomatoes
chili powder
1/2  can water
preparation: Simmer	meat, onion and garlic until done.  Add remaining ingredients; simmer for about 20 minutes.  Dip eggplant in batter or	beaten	egg,  then  flour and fry.  Drain on paper towel.  Put eggplant slices and meat in layers and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.  May put cheese on top.

name: EASY CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  cans Campbell's chicken and rice soup
1/4  c. margarine
1/2  c. milk
2  pkg. egg noodles
preparation: Cook egg noodles according to package.  Mix soups, margarine and milk together until heated.   Pour in noodles and heat.   Salt and pepper to taste.  For more chicken, add 2 cans chunky chicken.

name: RABBIT SUPREME
ingredients:
4 to 5  lb. ready to cook rabbit, cut up
flour
1/4  c. cooking oil
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. chopped onions
1  clove garlic, minced
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. milk
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Coat rabbit pieces with flour.  In ovenproof 10-inch skillet over medium heat, in hot oil and butter, cook rabbit, a few pieces at a time, until browned on all sides. Remove to platter as they are browned.

name: CHEESE CRISPS(Appetizer)
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
2  c. sharp cheese, shredded
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. hot sauce (to taste)
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Combine butter, cheese, flour, hot sauce and salt.   Mix well. Gently fold in Rice Krispies.  Shape into walnut size balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Makes 6 dozen.

name: TOMATO AND RICE SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onion
1  clove minced garlic
1 (15 oz.)  can red kidney beans
1  c. sliced carrots
1  c. sliced celery
1/4  c. uncooked rice
32  oz. can stewed tomatoes
3 1/2  c. water
5  bouillon cubes
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dried basil
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. frozen or fresh cooked green beans
preparation: Cook beef, onion and garlic in Dutch oven until brown (about 5 minutes).  Drain fat and add remaining ingredients, except green beans.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes.  Add green beans.  Adjust seasonings.  Better if made a day ahead.

name: PORK SAUSAGE
ingredients:
12  lb. pork meat, cut in pieces, ready for grinding
5  Tbsp. salt
3  Tbsp. black pepper
2  Tbsp. pulverized sage leaves
preparation: Sprinkle meat well with the remaining ingredients.  Grind all together and it will need no further mixing.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger, fried until no longer pink
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
3  onions
3  carrots
3  large potatoes
preparation: Slice vegetables thick.  Layer in casserole, beginning and ending with hamburger.  Mix soup; heat and stir well.  Pour over casserole.  Bake at 275° or 300° for 1 1/2 hours, or until well done.

name: MISSISSIPPI MUD PIE
ingredients:
1  stick butter, melted
1  c. diced pecans
1  c. flour
1  c. powdered sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1 large  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
Cool Whip
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix butter, pecans and flour and press in long (9 x 2 x 13-inch) dish.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until lightly browned; let cool.  Mix powdered sugar, cream cheese, vanilla and 1 cup Cool Whip.  Spread on crust, let cool and firm.  Mix instant pudding and spread on first layer; let firm.  Top with Cool Whip; decorate, if desired.  Keep in freezer; take out 15 to 20 minutes before serving.

name: OLD STATE HAM AND NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter
4  oz. medium noodles
1/4  c. chopped onion
3  c. boiling water
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 1/4  c. diced ham
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. chopped pimiento
dash of pepper
1/2  c. grated American cheese
preparation: Add salt and noodles to boiling water; boil rapidly, stirring constantly for 2 minutes.  Cover; remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes.  Melt butter in a saucepan and add onion and green pepper.  Cook for 5 minutes.  Add ham and cook a few minutes longer.  Rinse noodles.  Heat soup and milk together until smooth. Combine ham mixture, soup, pimiento and pepper with noodles.  Pour into a greased 1-quart casserole.  Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake in a moderate oven (375°) for 20 minutes.

name: BLUEBERRY CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
2 small  boxes grape jello
1  can blueberry pie filling
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  large cream cheese
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Dissolve the jello in 2 cups boiling water in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.  Add the pie filling and pineapple with juice. Congeal.  To make topping, add cream cheese, sour cream, sugar and vanilla; mix and spread evenly over jello mixture.  Refrigerate. May be made a day ahead.

name: SMOOTH 'N CREAMY FROSTING
ingredients:
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. instant pudding (any flavor)
1/4  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. cold milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Combine pudding mix, sugar and milk in small bowl.  Beat slowly with mixer until well blended, about 1 minute.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Spread on cake at once.  Makes 4 cups.

name: DONNA'S PORK BARBECUE
ingredients:
6  lb. boneless pork shoulder
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  c. water
6  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
4  Tbsp. vinegar
6  Tbsp. lemon juice
4  c. ketchup
4  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. chili powder
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Place pork in baking dish and add all ingredients, mixed well. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 250° for 3 1/2 to 4 hours. Shred meat with 2 forks and return to oven (covered) and continue baking 1 to 2 more hours until really tender.  Stir occasionally. If sauce cooks down, make additional and add to meat.  Serve with rolls.

name: PIZZA MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's tomato soup
1 small  clove garlic, minced
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. water
1/2  tsp. oregano, crushed
1  c. small bread cubes
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  slices process or Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Blend soup, water, oregano and garlic. In bowl, combine 1/4 cup soup mixture, bread, onion, parsley, egg, salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly with beef. Shape firmly into a loaf; place in shallow baking pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove from oven; spoon off fat. Pour remaining soup over loaf. Top with cheese. Bake until melted. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  boxes frozen green beans
5  to 6 pieces bacon
1  can (15 oz.) stewed or whole tomatoes
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook beans according to directions on box.  Cook bacon separately.  Combine beans, bacon and tomatoes; add salt and pepper to taste.  Serve warm.

name: CRANBERRY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans cherries (30 oz.)
3 1/2  c. chopped peeled apples
1  c. chopped nuts (pecans)
2  cans whole cranberries
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Put in casserole dish.

name: FUDGESICLES
ingredients:
1  pkg. instant chocolate pudding mix
2  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. evaporated milk
preparation: Mix together with mixer for about 2 minutes.  Pour in freezer cups and freeze.  Serves 8.  Any flavor of pudding can be used.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bacon, fried
onions
1  c. ketchup
1  c. brown sugar
2 (31 oz.)  cans Van Camp's pork and beans
preparation: Bake at 400° for 1 hour.  Makes 2 quarts.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/3  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. soda
1  c. mashed ripe bananas
1/2  c. broken walnuts
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar, add eggs and beat well.  Put dry ingredients together, add to creamed mixture alternatively with bananas.  Stir in walnuts.  Pour into well greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2 loaf pan.  Bake at 350° oven about 1 hour.  Remove from pan, cool on rack.  Better a day old.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. elbow macaroni, uncooked
1/4  c. French dressing
1  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1/3  c. green pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
2  medium tomatoes
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. shredded cabbage (optional)
preparation: Cook macaroni, then chill in water and drain.  Combine French dressing with macaroni.  Toss lightly.  Chill.  Add remaining ingredients, mix and chill.

name: MEATBALL CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  box dried onion soup (2 envelopes)
2  cans Campbell's cream of mushroom soup
2  cans Campbell's cream of celery soup
preparation: Prepare small meatballs of hamburger.  Fry meatballs until done.  Drain well.  Place in crock-pot.  Pour all 4 cans of soup into a large bowl.  Add 2 envelopes of dried onion soup.  Mix well, then add this mixture to meatballs.  With a large spoon, turn this mixture into meatballs until it is mixed well and meatballs are coated with mixture.  Cook on high for 1 1/2 hours.  Then cook for 1 1/2 hours on low.

name: HUNTINGTON CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  cooked chicken (remove from bone)
1  pkg. cooked noodles
1/4  c. chopped bell pepper
1/4  c. celery
1 small  can pimentos
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: Cook celery and pepper in chicken broth.  Put noodles and all other ingredients in pan.  Add some grated cheese on top.  Cook in oven at 350° for 30 minutes or until cheese is golden brown.

name: SAUTEED APPLES AND RAISINS
ingredients:
4  large tart apples, peeled and cored
1/4  c. margarine
2  tsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  c. golden raisins
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Cut apples in half and then into 1/4-inch thick slices.  Melt margarine in a large skillet; add apples.  Cook and stir over medium heat for 6 to 7 minutes or until almost tender.  Dissolve cornstarch in water; add to skillet.  Add brown sugar and raisins; bring to a boil.  Boil for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from the heat; stir in lemon juice.  Serve warm.  Yield: 4 cups.

name: TAFFY APPLE SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. cubed apples
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
8  oz. salted peanuts
1  egg
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Heat pineapple and juice, sugar, flour, egg and vinegar in saucepan until thick.  Put in fridge to cool several hours.   Add apples, peanuts (crushed in blender) and Cool Whip.

name: RICH BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1 large  box vanilla instant pudding
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Cool Whip
1 large  pkg. vanilla wafers
8  medium bananas
preparation: Mix vanilla pudding as directed.  Add condensed milk and Cool Whip.  Alternate with layers of cookies and bananas in large container.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. white sugar
3/4  c. Wesson oil
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. chopped apples
nuts and raisins (optional)
preparation: Beat together sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla.  Sift together dry ingredients and add to sugar mixture.  Fold in apples, nuts and raisins.  Mix well.  Bake in tube pan at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes.

name: ICEBOX ROLLS
ingredients:
1/3  c. shortening
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  c. boiling water
1  pkg. dry yeast, dissolved in 1/4 c. water (warm)
1  tsp. sugar
4  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Add 1 teaspoon sugar. Add to mixture. Blend in the flour. Knead well. Refrigerate at least 4 hours. Remove at least 2 hours before shaping into rolls. Let rolls rise 1 hour. Bake 15 minutes at 400°.

name: KAREN'S CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans cream of chicken soup
salt and pepper
5  skinless and boneless chicken breasts
butter
2  (8 oz.) sour cream
Ritz crackers
preparation: Cook chicken on High in microwave for 10 minutes.  Shred chicken.  Mix all ingredients together.  Put in casserole dish. Sprinkle with thick crust of crushed Ritz crackers.  Pour melted butter on top.  Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.

name: ZESTY CHEDDAR CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
4  Tbsp. garlic spread
1/8  tsp. salt
3/4  c. unsifted flour
1 1/2  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: In medium bowl, work all ingredients together with a fork until mixture is well blended.  Knead mixture with hands until smooth.  Roll into one-inch balls.  Place on ungreased baking sheet and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400°.

name: EASY BAKED MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
5  Tbsp. butter/margarine
3  Tbsp. flour
3 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
pepper
2 1/2  c. uncooked macaroni
Velveeta cheese
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan over medium heat.  Stir in flour.  Add milk, salt and pepper.  Cook until boils, stirring occasionally. Add 1-inch of Velveeta cheese.  Stir until dissolved.  In the meantime, cook the macaroni as directed on package.  Combine cooked macaroni and cheese mixture in a casserole dish.  Add more sliced Velveeta cheese to your liking.  Bake 15 minutes or until brown at 350°.

name: SPAGHETTI WITH PESTO
ingredients:
1  c. firmly packed fresh basil leaves
1/2  c. torn fresh spinach leaves
1/4  c. grated cheese
1/4  c. pine nuts
2  cloves garlic, quartered
2  Tbsp. olive oil
preparation: In blender or food processor, combine basil, spinach, cheese, nuts, garlic and 1/4 teaspoon salt.  Blend with several on-off turns until a paste forms, stopping the machine several times and scraping sides.  With the machine running slowly, gradually add the oil and 2 tablespoons of water and blend to the consistency of soft butter.  Toss with hot cooked pasta.  Serve with grated cheese.

name: BARB'S POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
8  medium red potatoes
1  large onion
1  c. peas
1  large cuke
3  hard-boiled eggs
1  green pepper (optional)
3/4  c. salad dressing or mayonnaise
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Wash and halve red potatoes.  Cook in salted water until fork starts to pierce potatoes.  Add 3 eggs and boil with potatoes.  In 4 minutes, remove from heat and drain.  When cool, peel potatoes and eggs.  Chop onion up finely.  Dice cucumber and pepper, if wanted. Drain can of peas and put all together in a large bowl. Spread 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper, then mix thoroughly.  Cover with Saran Wrap.  Put in refrigerator until ready to serve.   Then add salad dressing and mix again.  This allows flavors to blend.

name: CUSTARD POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  sticks whipped oleo
2  c. sugar
5  large eggs
2  c. plain cake flour
flavoring (lemon, vanilla or almond)
preparation: Cream the oleo and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Blend in flour. Add flavoring. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
2  cans enchilada sauce
1  qt. can tomatoes
1 large  can kidney beans
tortilla chips
8  oz. Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown meat; drain.  Add onions and cook until tender.  Add sauce and tomatoes; mix.  Place chips in bottom of large casserole dish.  Pour meat sauce over chips.  Top with beans and cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cheese melts.

name: CABBAGE AND NOODLES
ingredients:
1  head cabbage, chopped
1  med. onion, sliced
1/2 -3/4  c. cooked noodles or bow ties
Salt, pepper to taste
1/2  stick butter or oleo
preparation: Steam cabbage and onions until tender.  Drain.  Season with salt and pepper.  Add butter and cooked noodles and stir.

name: LAYERED SPINACH SUPREME
ingredients:
1  c. Bisquick
1/4  c. milk
2  eggs
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
4  oz. Monterey Jack cheese, grated
10  oz. chopped spinach (frozen)
1/2  tsp. salt
2  cloves garlic
12  oz. creamed cottage cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
2  eggs
preparation: Mix Bisquick, milk, eggs and onion.  Spread in greased 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking pan.  Mix remaining ingredients.  Spoon evenly over batter.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: SEAFOOD PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
1/4  c. Italian dressing
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
2  c. corkscrew noodles, cooked and drained
1 1/2  c. chopped imitation crabmeat
1  c. broccoli flowerets, partially cooked
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped tomato
1/4  c. green onion slices
preparation: Combine and chill.

name: FRESH FRUIT ICE CREAM
ingredients:
3  c. (1 1/2 pt.) half and half
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk (not evaporated milk)
1  c. pureed or mashed fresh fruit (strawberries, bananas, etc.)
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
food coloring (optional)
preparation: In ice cream container, combine all ingredients and mix well. Freeze according to manufacturer's instructions.  Freeze leftovers.

name: APPLE CRUNCH
ingredients:
8  to 12 apples
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. flour
1/2  lb. butter, softened
1  c. pecans
preparation: Peel and slice apples.  Place in 11 x 17-inch glass baking dish.  Sprinkle on 1/2 cup sugar.  Mix brown sugar, flour and butter to a paste; drop over apples and smooth out gently.  It will not be an even topping.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes; take out and top with pecans.  Bake another 15 to 20 minutes.

name: FUDGIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate instant pudding
1/4  c. sugar
3 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix ingredients and beat until smooth.  Freeze in ice cube trays or special popsicle containers.

name: YAM FRIES
ingredients:
3  or 4 medium sweet potatoes
1/4  c. margarine, melted
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Clean and peel potatoes; cut them into wedges.  Place about an inch apart on a lightly greased cookie sheet.  Brush with mixture of margarine and brown sugar.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes, turning and brushing occasionally.

name: DELICIOUS CHOCOLATE BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
5  Tbsp. cocoa
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
4  egg whites
1/2  c. applesauce
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nonfat yogurt
1  mashed banana
preparation: Sift together dry ingredients.  Beat egg whites, applesauce, water and vanilla until blended.  Beat in 1/3 of yogurt.  Beat in 1/2 of flour mixture, blending well.  Beat in half of remaining yogurt.  Beat in rest of flour.  Beat in rest of yogurt.  Beat in banana until smooth.  Pour into sprayed 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: ORIGINAL GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (16 oz. each)  cans cut green beans, drained
3/4  c. milk
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1  can French fried onions
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. In medium bowl, combine beans, milk, soup, pepper and 1/2 can French fried onions.  Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.  Top with remaining onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CHICKEN CASHEW CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. chicken, cooked
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. cashews
1  can chow mein noodles
1  can water chestnuts
1  c. chopped celery
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix everything together except noodles (may need to add a little water).  Put a layer of noodles in bottom of casserole, layer of mixture, layer of noodles,  layer of mixture, etc., ending with noodles.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serves 4 to 6.

name: OLIVE CHEESE PUFFS
ingredients:
1  c. sharp grated cheese
2  Tbsp. soft butter
1/2  c. sifted plain flour
dash of red pepper
olives, drained well
preparation: Cream the butter and cheese. Add flour and pepper to form dough.  Using 1 teaspoon of dough, wrap around olive.  Bake in a 400° oven for 15 minutes.  (Can be made ahead and reheated.)

name: NELLIE'S FAVORITE DOGGIE BISCUITS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1/2  c. dry milk powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
6  Tbsp. margarine
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. brown sugar
1/2  c. ice water
