preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine flour, dry milk, garlic powder, salt and sugar.  Cut in margarine until mixture resembles cornmeal. Mix in egg and enough water to form a ball.  Pat out dough 1/2-inch thick.  Cut with doggie biscuit cutter and place on lightly oiled cookie sheet.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cool on cake rack.

name: PEA SOUP
ingredients:
2  pkg. dried peas (yellow or green)
ham hocks or smoked pieces
1  medium or small carrot, diced
1  small onion, peeled and finely chopped
1  garlic clove, peeled, mashed and minced
2 chicken bouillon cubes, dissolved in 1  c. boiling water
preparation: Rinse peas; remove off color or impurities.  Cover with cold water; soak at least 12 hours.  Drain the soaked peas; cover with fresh water and bring to a boil.  Lower heat; simmer for several hours.  Remove any scum or froth from the top.  Add ham hocks, chicken bouillon, minced onion and diced carrots.  Continue to cook until peas begin to soften to a mush.  Stir frequently.

name: HOMEMADE MUSTARD
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  egg
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1/2  c. vinegar
1  c. cream
1  tsp. turmeric
preparation: Combine all ingredients and cook in double boiler until thick.

name: CELERY SEED DRESSING
ingredients:
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  small onion
3/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. red vinegar
a little water
1  c. oil
1  drop yellow food coloring (if desired)
1  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Blend first 6 ingredients in blender.  Add oil, food coloring and celery seed slowly until  it thickens.   Refrigerate up to 2 weeks.

name: ALL-BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. All-Bran
1/2  c. hot water
1/4  c. oil
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. molasses
1  egg
1  c. milk or buttermilk (powdered)
1/2  c. more All-Bran
1 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
salt
1/3  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Combine ingredients and bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

name: TEFF SKILLET FLAT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. teff flour (available at Newark Co-op)
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1  c. water or as needed
2  tsp. safflower or canola oil
preparation: In a mixing bowl, combine flour with baking soda.  Stir in buttermilk, then add enough water to give the mixture a fairly thick yet fluid consistency.  Stir in oil.  Heat a 6-inch nonstick crepe pan until sizzling hot.  Pour in a scant 1/4 cup of batter and quickly tilt pan to form a round.  Cook until golden brown on each side; repeat with remaining batter.  Makes 12 to 14 pancakes. Delicious with stews and chili.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  package elbow macaroni
3  Tbsp. margarine
3  Tbsp. flour
1  egg
2  cups milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  cups mild cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Cook macaroni in salt water; drain and rinse.  In a sauce pan melt butter and stir in flour.  Beat egg and milk together and stir into the flour mixture.  Add salt and pepper. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thick.  Stir in cheese and add to macaroni. (If too thick add a little milk.)  Put in 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes.

name: SWEET 'N SOUR KIELBASI
ingredients:
kielbasi
1  can cranberry sauce
1  c. catsup
preparation: Mix cranberry sauce and catsup in blender.  Cut kielbasi into 1/2-inch slices and put in crock-pot.  Pour catsup mixture over and stir.  Simmer several hours.

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA (APPETIZER)
ingredients:
2  cans crescent rolls
16  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. mayo or plain yogurt
1  pkg. Ranch dressing mix
assorted chopped fresh vegetables (your choice)
preparation: Press crescent rolls on cookie sheet and bake as directed on the package.  Let cool.  Blend cream cheese, mayo or yogurt and dressing mix and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Spread cream cheese mixture over crust.  Top with chopped veggies, olives and grated cheese.  Use your imagination!  Cut into 2-inch squares.

name: CREAM PUFFS
ingredients:
1  c. water
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. all-purpose flour
4  eggs
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Heat water and butter to a rolling boil. Stir in flour.  Stir vigorously over low heat for one minute. Remove form heat and beat in all 4 eggs at once.  Continue beating until smooth.  Mixture wil become very thick.  Drop dough by scant 1/4 cupfuls or heaping tablespoonfuls 3 inches apart onto greased baking sheet.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until puffs are golden. Cool away from draft.  Makes 12 puffs.  Fill with your favorite pudding.

name: HAWAIIAN BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  c. sugar
3  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. coconut
1  c. oil
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  mashed bananas
preparation: Mix flour, nuts, salt, soda and sugar by hand.  Then add remaining ingredients.  Pour into 2 (9 x 5-inch) loaf pans which are greased and floured.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Cool 10 minutes and turn out on wire rack.

name: MOCK CHICKEN CORDON BLEU
ingredients:
1  pkg. (about 3 lb.) whole cut up chicken
1  egg white, lightly beaten
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
1  Tbsp. water
1/4  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. dry bread crumbs
1/3  c. finely chopped ham or bacon
1/2  c. grated Swiss cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Rinse chicken; pat dry.  Spray a rectangular pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inches, with nonstick cooking spray. In a medium bowl, mix egg white, mustard, water and pepper.  Place bread crumbs in a heavy plastic bag or large bowl.  One piece at a time, dip chicken in egg white mixture, then coat with bread crumbs.  Shake excess.  Arrange chicken in pan.  Bake, uncovered, 45 to 50 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink when cut into. Sprinkle with ham and cheese.  Heat 5 minutes longer or until cheese melts.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  or 3 green onions
1  can shrimp
pepper
salt
preparation: Mix ingredients in blender.  Add spices to taste.  Serve with chips or crackers.

name: QUICHE LAREDO
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  can jalapeno peppers, drained and sliced
5  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
5  oz. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
6  eggs (room temperature), slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. picante sauce
preparation: Coat a 9-inch glass pie pan with nonstick spray; sprinkle peppers evenly over bottom of pan, followed by cheese.  Combine eggs and picante sauce and add to cheese mixture.  Let sit for 10 to 12 minutes.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. shortening (1/2 c. butter and 1/2 c. Crisco)
2 3/4  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  c. all-purpose flour, sifted
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (No. 303)  can pumpkin (2 c.)
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nutmeats, chopped (optional)
preparation: Cream shortening; add sugar gradually.  Add eggs and mix well until blended.  Sift together the flour, baking powder, nutmeg, soda, salt, allspice and cinnamon.  Add to the creamed mixture. Add pumpkin and vanilla; mix until well blended.  Fold in nutmeats and pour into four greased loaf pans.  Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour at 350°.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. instant pistachio pudding
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1 1/2  c. small marshmallows
1  c. chopped pecans
1 large  can crushed pineapple with  juice
12  maraschino cherries, cut up
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

name: PASTA WITH PINK VODKA SAUCE
ingredients:
1  lb. penne pasta
2/3  c. vodka
3/4  c. heavy cream
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
5  Tbsp. unsalted butter
1/4  tsp. red pepper flakes
1 (16 oz.)  can plum tomatoes, chopped and drained
preparation: Cook pasta until al dente; drain.  Melt butter over medium heat in saucepan.  Add vodka and pepper flakes.  Simmer for 2 minutes.  Add heavy cream and tomatoes.  Simmer 5 minutes longer. Sprinkle with salt.  Combine pasta and sauce; toss gently.  Stir in cheese.  Serve immediately.

name: PINWHEEL CAKE AND CREAM(A quick and easy dessert to make with any fruit!)
ingredients:
1  pkg. jello instant pudding French vanilla
2  c. cold milk
1  c. thawed Cool Whip
1  tsp. grated orange rind
1  small peach/nectarine, cut into small pieces
1  pound cake, cut in slices
2  c. summer fruit
preparation: Prepare pudding mix with milk as directed on package.  Let stand 5 minutes or until slightly thickened.  Fold in whipped topping, orange rind and peaches.  Arrange pound cake slices on serving plate.  Spoon pudding mixture evenly over center of cake slices.  Arrange fruit in pudding mixture.  Chill until ready to serve.

name: QUICK SAUERKRAUT
ingredients:
2  lb. bag sauerkraut, rinsed and drained
1  stick margarine
1 small  can mushrooms, undrained
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. caraway seed (optional)
1  medium bay leaf (optional)
2  tsp. beef base powder (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.  Cover partially and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, for about 45 minutes. Add small amount of water, if necessary, to prevent scorching.

name: TOMATO SANDWICH SPREAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. oil
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can tomato soup
3  well beaten eggs
corn flakes
preparation: Cook oil, onion and soup together.  Gradually beat in eggs. Thicken with corn flakes.  Add more seasoning, if desired.  Chill before serving.

name: CLAM DIGGERS(Serves 8)
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped green bell pepper
1/2  c. melted butter
1  tsp. chopped parsley
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. oregano
onion salt to taste
2 (7 oz.)  cans minced clams
12  slices bread, crumbled
paprika to taste
preparation: Saute green pepper in butter in saucepan until tender.  Add next 6 ingredients; mix well.  Simmer over medium heat for 5 to 8 minutes.  Stir in bread crumbs.  Spoon into clam shells.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Arrange in baking pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  box macaroni noodles
1  green pepper
1  medium onion
1  c. mayonnaise
salt to taste
pepper to taste
preparation: Cook and drain macaroni noodles.  Chop green pepper and onion. Mix all ingredients.  (May have to add more mayonnaise.)

name: TUNA NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  package noodles
1/2  cup mayonnaise
1/2  cup chopped onion
1/4  cup chopped green bell pepper
1  can cream of celery soup
1  cup sharp Cheddar cheese
1  can tuna, drained
1  cup chopped celery
1/4  cup chopped pimento
1  tsp. salt
1  cup milk
preparation: Cook noodles. Drain. Combine noodles and tuna, add mayonnaise, all chopped vegetables and salt. Heat on top of stove. Add cheese and stir until cheese melts. Put in casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs tossed with olive oil or with bread stuffing. Bake at 425° for 20 minutes or until bubbly.

name: APPLE SPICE CUSTARD CAKE
ingredients:
1 (18 1/4 oz.)  pkg. spice cake mix
2  medium all-purpose apples, pared, cored and finely chopped (about 2 c.)
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1  (8 oz.) container Borden sour cream
1/4  c. ReaLemon lemon juice from concentrate
ground cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Prepare cake mix as package directs; stir in apples.  Pour into well greased and floured 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Bake 30 minutes or until wooden pick inserted near center comes out clean.

name: PIZZA DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. warm water
1  pkg. yeast
1  Tbsp. salad oil
1  tsp. honey
1  tsp. salt
2 1/4  c. flour
preparation: Mix.  Let rise.  Make shell and bake lightly before adding sauce.

name: SWEET-N-SMOKY BRISKET
ingredients:
1  bottle Claudes brisket sauce
2  lb. light brown sugar
Lawry's seasoned salt
black pepper
1  (10 lb.) brisket
preparation: Trim excess fat from brisket.  Poke holes in brisket with tip of knife or large fork.  Combine brown sugar and bottle of Claudes.  Mix until mixture is syrupy.  Spoon over brisket and rub into meat.  Sprinkle seasoned salt and pepper liberally onto top of brisket.  Wrap in foil.  Leave overnight in a cool place.  Cook at 350° for 3 to 4 hours or until doone.  Cook brisket with fat side up.  Do not turn over while cooking.  Slice meat with the grain while warm.

name: MARSALA BRAISED VEAL CHOPS
ingredients:
4 shoulder veal chops, about 12  oz. each
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  carrot, peeled and diced
1  rib celery, peeled and diced
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1  c. Marsala wine
1  tsp. tomato paste
1  c. chicken stock
preparation: Season the veal chops with salt and pepper on both sides.  In a large, nonstick skillet gently brown the chops on both sides in 2 tablespoons of olive oil.  Place the browned chops in a wide shallow baking pan.  Add the carrot, celery and 1/2 cup onion to the skillet and saute until lightly browned.  Deglaze the pan with the Marsala.  Stir in the tomato paste and boil for 3 minutes. Add the chicken stock, boil for another 3 minutes.  Pour this liquid over the chops, cover the baking pan and bake in a preheated 350° oven for 2 hours.

name: HASH BROWN CHEESE BAKE
ingredients:
1 (32 oz.)  pkg. shredded hash brown potatoes, thawed
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans potato soup (undiluted)
2 (8 oz.)  cartons commercial sour cream
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
preparation: Combine all ingredients, stirring well.  Spoon into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Yields 12 to 15 servings.

name: DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
3  c. celery, chopped
3  c. onions, chopped
1  doz. hard-boiled eggs
1  pan cornbread (pie pan size)
12  slices toasted bread
1  can mushroom soup
1  can chicken soup
1  tsp. sage
2  c. liquid (chicken broth or 2 cubes chicken flavored bouillon)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Saute chopped  celery and onion in oleo in iron skillet until tender.  Chop  boiled eggs and set aside.  Mix all other ingredients, adding  chopped  eggs	last.  Bake  in  375° oven until brown on top.

name: MAKE-AHEAD SPAGHETTI SUPREME
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. ground sausage
1 (16 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. cottage cheese
1/3  c. chopped green onion
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain.  Brown meat, then stir in spaghetti sauce, salt and pepper to taste. Remove from heat. Combine cottage cheese, cream cheese, sour cream and green onion.  In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer half of the spaghetti and cover with all the cheese mixture.  Add remaining spaghetti and pour butter over top.  Spread meat sauce over top. Add Cheddar cheese over entire top. Chill up to 24 hours or bake for 45 minutes at 350°.  If refrigerated, remove 5 to 10 minutes before baking.

name: SURNEYE PAESKE(Russian Easter Cheese Mold)
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. cream cheese
1/2  lb. unsalted butter
1/2  lb. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla bean, finely chopped
juice of 1 lemon
rind of 1 lemon, finely chopped
rind of 1 orange, finely chopped
6 to 8  Tbsp. sugar
4  Tbsp. water
1/2  c. almonds, finely chopped (optional)
1/3  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Cook orange rind in 3 to 4 tablespoons sugar and 2 tablespoons water.  Simmer on low for 45 minutes.  Do the same with the lemon rind.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  stick butter, melted
1  pkg. Jiffy cornbread
3/4  c. small curd cottage cheese
3/4  c. chopped frozen broccoli
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SOUTHWESTERN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
12  oz. uncooked spaghetti
1 to 1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
1  envelope taco seasoning
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  jar sliced mushrooms, drained
1 (2 1/4 oz.)  can sliced ripe olives, drained
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook spaghetti according to package directions.  Meanwhile, in a large skillet, cook beef and onion over medium heat until meat is no longer pink; drain.  Stir in the taco seasoning, spaghetti sauce, mushrooms and olives.  Drain spaghetti;  stir into the beef mixture.

name: BOILED CABBAGE
ingredients: 1  firm head cabbage
preparation: Remove bruised outer leaves; discard and wash under running water.  Cut in fourths; remove the stalk part and cut in small wedges or chunks.  Place in large pot or saucepan.  Fill about 1/3 up on cabbage with water.  Cook on medium-high until tender.  It cooks in a short time (I test it with meat fork).  Add salt and black pepper to taste.  Also, add 1 tablespoon of sugar.  If more liquid than  you prefer, remove some before seasoning with two or three tablespoons of bacon drippings or margarine.

name: LAZY ROAST
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. chuck rib of beef
1  can peas
1  large carrot
1  onion, chopped fine
1  tsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. tapioca
salt
cloves
preparation: Set roast out in room temperature for 1 hour before cooking. Preheat oven to 375°.  Rub meat well with salt and sprinkle with pepper.  Place meat, fat side up, in shallow roasting pan. Do not cover; do not add water.  Put roast in oven.  Cook just 1 hour. Turn off heat, but do not open door at any time until ready to serve.  Regardless of the length of time meat has been in the oven, reset temperature to 375° and cook 30 to 40 minutes before serving.  Open oven door and remove roast to serving platter. Meat will be brown on out side, medium-rare inside.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium onion
3  to 4 yellow and/or zucchini squash
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can water chestnuts, drained
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  (8 oz.) canister Stove Top stuffing
preparation: Slice onion and squash; steam together for 5 to 8 minutes. Mix rest of ingredients, except stuffing.  Spread half of stuffing on bottom of a casserole dish.  Add squash mixture on top.  Spread remaining stuffing on top of squash.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: SWEET POTATO AND APPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  sweet potatoes or canned yams
4  large juicy apples, peeled, cored and sliced
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. butter
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. apple juice
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. water
1/2  c. honey
preparation: Boil unpeeled sweet potatoes in water until almost tender (about 15 to 20 minutes). Peel and slice about 1/4-inch thick when cooled (if using canned yams, just drain off the juice and slice them). Using a 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole dish, alternate layers of sliced sweet potatoes and apples, beginning with sweet potatoes and ending with apples (about 3 double layers). Cover each double layer with some of the brown sugar, salt, bits of butter and cinnamon (I usually mix these 4 ingredients together). Heat apple juice to boiling point. Combine cornstarch and water and add to juice, cooking until sauce is clear and thickened. Add honey. Spoon sauce over apples. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes to an hour or until apples are tender. Delicious with ham or turkey. Serves 8.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  Tbsp. flour
1  c. canned milk (undiluted)
3  egg yolks
dash of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix cocoa, sugar, flour and salt.  Heat milk and add to mixture.  Beat egg yolks and add to above.  Cook until thick, stirring constantly.  Pour over crumb crust and top with a meringue or Cool Whip.  (I top with a meringue.  I use 2 tablespoons sugar to one egg white.)

name: AMBROSIA
ingredients:
8  large oranges, peeled and sectioned
1  c. flaked coconut
1 (16 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, drained
6  red maraschino cherries, cut in halves
1/4  c. sugar (more or less to suit taste)
preparation: Combine oranges, coconut, pineapple, cherries and sugar in medium bowl.  Chill.  Serve on lettuce leaves, if desired.

name: FABULOUS FUDGE
ingredients:
1  pkg. vanilla pudding mix
1  pkg. chocolate pudding mix
2  c. sugar
1  c. canned milk
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
2  c. marshmallow cream or miniature marshmallows
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Boil pudding mixes, sugar and canned milk 1 minute.  Remove from heat and add chocolate chips, marshmallows and vanilla.  Whip until creamy.  Add chopped nuts, if desired.   Eat!

name: BROCCOLI CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  box frozen broccoli
2  sticks margarine
1  medium onion, chopped
4  eggs, beaten
1  small cottage cheese
2  pkg. Jiffy corn bread
preparation: Allow broccoli to thaw.  Melt margarine.  In a large bowl, combine cornbread mix, onion and salt to taste.  Add cottage cheese, butter and eggs.  Add thawed broccoli.  Pour into 8-inch square baking dish.  Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until well done.

name: CHILI CON QUESO DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. (tube) garlic cheese
1 small  bottle taco sauce
1  lb. Velveeta cheese (hot or mild)
1  pkg. (tube) jalapeno cheese
1 small  can chopped chili pepper
preparation: Heat in double boiler or crock-pot all ingredients.  You can use sharp cheese and add a few drops Tabasco hot sauce if you can't find jalapeno cheese.

name: CHEESY CHICKEN
ingredients:
3  boneless chicken breasts
1/2  c. melted butter
1  clove garlic
1  c. bread crumbs
1/2  c. grated Swiss cheese
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Crush garlic clove and mix into butter.  Let stand at least one hour.  Remove garlic.  Mix bread crumbs, cheeses, salt and pepper. Dip chicken in butter, then in cheese mixture.  Place in baking pan, tucking sides of breasts under to form neat rolls.  Pour remaining butter over chicken.  Bake 1 hour in 350° oven.  Baste occasionally.  Serves 4.

name: FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
4  c. or 2 medium onion, chopped
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. flour
6  c. water
1/4 to 1/2  c. Wyler's instant beef bouillon
Croutons
Gruyere cheese
preparation: Sauté onions in butter until tender and lightly brown. Sprinkle flour over onions an cook 2 to 3 minutes.  Add water and instant beef bouillon; heat to boiling.  Cover and simmer 20 minutes.

name: CHILIQUES
ingredients:
2  pkg. corn chips
1 large  can tomatoes
8  oz. can diced green chilies
1  c. ripe olives
1  carton sour cream
1  pkg. Spanish rice seasoning
1  lb. Monterey Jack and Cheddar cheese, grated
1  lb. hamburger meat
preparation: Brown meat and drain.  Add rest of ingredients.  Last, layer with chips, meat mix, sour cream and cheese.  Heat thoroughly.

name: GRANDMOTHER'S CHERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  c. cherries (canned cherries), drained and save juice
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder and salt.  Cream butter and 1/2 cup sugar until fluffy.  Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and beating until smooth.  Pour batter into greased baking dish and put fruit on top.  Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar on top.  Pour on juice over all.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

name: ORIENTAL CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, minced
1  medium green pepper, minced
1  small head cabbage, shredded
2  c. tomato soup
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain.  Mix onion, green peppers and cabbage.  Place in casserole dish in layers.  Pour tomato soup over top.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: FRUIT CAKE BALLS
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, softened
1  egg
2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. chopped cherries, drained
1  c. chopped dates
1  c. chopped nuts (I use pecans)
graham cracker crumbs
preparation: Blend together the margarine, egg and powdered sugar.  Add drained, chopped cherries, dates and nuts.  Drop by teaspoon into graham cracker crumbs and roll.

name: CHOCOLATE CREAM CHEESE CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  egg
1/3  c. sugar
pinch of salt
1 1/2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1  c. water
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. oil
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In little cupcake tins, put mixture of last 9 ingredients in bottom.  Mix the first 5 ingredients and add 1 teaspoon of cream cheese mixture in each tin.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: LEMON CAKE PIE
ingredients:
pastry for 1-crust pie
1 1/2  c. sugar
5  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. melted butter
3  eggs, separated
1/3  c. flour
1 1/4  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. grated lemon peel
preparation: Line a 9-inch pie pan with pastry and flute edges.  Mix together sugar, butter, flour, salt, lemon peel and juice.  Beat egg yolks.  Combine with milk.  Stir in lemon mix.  Beat egg whites until stiff.  Fold into lemon mixture.  Place in crust. Bake on lowest shelf at 375° for 45 to 55 minutes, until top is richly brown and set when lightly touched.  Serve at room temperature or chill as long as 6 hours.  Serves 6.

name: PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box rotini noodles
1  jar pizza sauce
2  pkg. Mozzarella cheese, sliced
2  lb. hamburger
1 large  jar spaghetti sauce
2  pkg. pepperoni, sliced
preparation: Boil noodles as package directs.  Brown hamburger, then drain. In very large bowl, combine hamburger, noodles and both jars of sauce.  Pour into 2 casserole dishes and cover each with a package of cheese and pepperoni.  One may be frozen for later.  (Can add cheese and pepperoni later.) Bake at 425° for 20 to 30 minutes. Should be bubbling when done.

name: GUMDROP POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. popcorn
12  oz. pkg. marshmallows
1/2  lb. butter
1  c. ground peppermint candy
1  c. peanuts
1  c. gumdrops
preparation: Melt marshmallows and butter; stir well.  Pour over popcorn, peanuts and gumdrops.  Grease hands with dab of butter and form the popcorn mixture into balls.

name: CHOCOLATE MERINGUE COOKIES
ingredients:
5  large egg whites
1/4  c. unsweetened cocoa
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cocoa
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 225°.  Cover 2 cookie sheets with parchment; set aside.  Combine 1 egg white, 1/4 cup cocoa and 2 tablespoons sugar and vanilla in bowl.  Beat remaining egg whites and salt until soft peaks form.  Add remaining 1/2 cup sugar, a little at a time, while beating until white are stiff and glossy.  Fold egg whites into chocolate mixture by thirds.  Fill pastry bag with mixture and pipe out cookies onto cookie sheets.  Each cookie should be about 1-inch wide.  Bake 1 hour 15 minutes until dry texture.  Mix remaining 1 teaspoon cocoa and cinnamon; sprinkle over hot cookies.  (To make a pastry bag, use gallon plastic bag and cut off corner.)

name: JULEKAKE(Christmas Bread)
ingredients:
3  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. warm (100~) water
1  c. scalded milk
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1  beaten egg
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. cardamon
1/2  c. candied cherries
1/2  c. diced citron
1/2  c. seedless raisins
5  c. flour
powdered sugar
preparation: Dissolve  yeast in water.  Mix milk and butter in bowl. When lukewarm,  add  egg,  yeast,  sugar,  salt, cardamon and fruit. Add 2  cups flour and mix well.  Gradually add remaining flour, saving  some  for kneading.  Knead on floured board until smooth. Place  in greased bowl.  Cover;  let rise until double in bulk. Punch  down  and divide in half.  Form into 2 round loaves and place  on greased pan. Cover; let rise until double.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Ice with powdered sugar while warm.

name: BLOODY MARY
ingredients:
2  jiggers tomato juice
1/3  jigger fresh lemon juice
dash of Worcestershire sauce
1  jigger (1 1/2 oz.) vodka
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Shake with cracked ice.  Strain into 6 ounce glass.

name: SAUERKRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can sauerkraut, drained
1  c. green pepper, chopped fine
1  c. onion, chopped fine
1  c. celery, chopped
1 (3 oz.)  jar pimento, chopped (optional)
1 1/2  c. sugar
2/3  c. vinegar
preparation: Combine sugar and vinegar in saucepan and bring to a full boil over medium heat until sugar is dissolved.  Mix remaining ingredients in a large, glass dish.  Pour vinegar mixture over sauerkraut mixture.  Let stand 24 hours in refrigerator.  This will keep for 3 to 4 weeks in refrigerator.  Very good with pork dishes or as a relish on hot dogs or hamburgers.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FINGERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. peanut butter
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. flour
1  c. oatmeal
6  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
1/2  c. sifted powdered sugar
1/4  c. peanut butter
2 to 4  Tbsp. evaporated milk
preparation: Cream butter and sugars.  Blend in egg, soda, vanilla, 1/3 cup peanut butter and salt.  Stir in flour and oatmeal.  Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle with chocolate chips.  Let stand 5 minutes, spread. Combine powdered sugar, 1/4 cup peanut butter and evaporated milk. Mix well.  Drizzle this mixture over melted chocolate.  Cool and cut into bars.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. melted oleo
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  c. white sugar
1 1/2  c. dark corn syrup
1 1/2  c. pecans
preparation: Mix flour, sugar and salt.  Combine with eggs and oleo. Add syrup and vanilla.  Beat  with  a  rotary egg beater until well mixed.  Add pecans.  Pour into pastry lined pan.  Bake at 425° for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat  to 325° and bake 40 minutes or until pie is firm.

name: OLD FASHIONED CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. yellow cornmeal
1  c. milk
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. honey or maple syrup
1/4  c. butter, melted or bacon drippings
preparation: Preheat oven oven to 425°.  Sift together the flour, baking powder and salt.  Add the cornmeal and stir until well mixed.

name: LIME CHIFFON SALAD
ingredients:
1 (9 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime jello
1  c. boiling water
1  c. creamed cottage cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. diced red cherries
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving juice.  Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Add reserved juice; cool until slightly thickened.  Beat until frothy.  Fold in pineapple, cottage cheese, mayonnaise and nuts.  Place in a 13 x 9-inch pan or mold.  Refrigerate until firm.  Serve on lettuce or other crisp salad greens.  Makes 7 servings.

name: SWEET AND CRUNCHY SAUERKRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans (16 oz. each) sauerkraut, drained and rinsed
1  c. celery, finely chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, finely chopped
1/4  c. onion, finely chopped
3/4 to 1  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. olive oil
preparation: In bowl, combine sauerkraut, celery, green pepper and onion.  Mix sugar, vinegar and oil, stir until sugar dissolves.  Pour over kraut mixture, toss, cover and chill 3 to 24 hours.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: AMBROSIA CAKE
ingredients:
1  box butter cake mix
4  eggs
1  can mandarin oranges with juice
1/2  c. Wesson oil
preparation: Mix all in mixer. Cook in 4 layers for 15 minutes at 350°.

name: BLACK WALNUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. shortening
3  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. flour
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. black walnuts
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs and beat.  Add vanilla. Mix flour, salt, baking powder and cinnamon.  Add flour mixture and milk alternately to batter and beat.  Add walnuts.  Pour into greased and floured square baking pan.  Bake at 350° until done.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sugar
2/3  c. shortening
3  eggs
2/3  c. milk
1  tsp. lemon extract
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening.  Beat in eggs; add milk and extract.   Blend in flour, baking powder and salt.  Pour into greased and floured large loaf pan.  Bake at 300°  for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

name: MEXICAN CROCK-POT(Makes 12 Servings.  Prep Time:  1 Hour.)
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. sausage
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. taco sauce or salsa
2  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and sausage together and drain.  Place meat in crock-pot and mix in Ro-Tel tomatoes, mushroom soup and taco sauce or salsa. Cut cheese into small pieces and add to mixture. Heat on low until cheese melts.  Serve over tortilla chips.

name: OREO COOKIE ICE CREAM CAKE(Grandchildren's Special)
ingredients:
1 1/2  pkg. Oreo cookies
1/2  gal. ice cream (vanilla, fudge ripple, chocolate chip, etc.)
assorted toppings (optional)
preparation: Put Oreos in a plastic bag and crush into crumbs with a rolling pin.  Spread half the Oreo crumbs in a 13 x 9-inch cake pan.  Spread softened ice cream over Oreo crumbs.  Top with remaining Oreo crumbs.  Chill until set.  Before freezing, you can drizzle with chocolate syrup.  When serving, you can offer choices of hot fudge, whipped cream, cherries, nuts - the gooier the better!

name: DREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  pre-formed graham cracker pie shell
1  pkg. Jell-O instant pudding
1  small container Cool Whip
preparation: Prepare pudding as directed, then fold in Cool Whip topping. Pour into pie shell and chill.  Serves 8.

name: MILK GRAVY
ingredients:
1/4  c. bacon, sausage or vegetable oil
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1 3/4  c. milk (whole milk best)
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground black pepper
preparation: Heat oil on medium heat in iron skillet.  Sprinkle flour over oil and *cook until well mixed.  Slowly stir milk into hot mixture; cook until blended.   Add salt and pepper.  Stir constantly until thickened, about 15 minutes.

name: PASTITSIO
ingredients:
8  oz. ziti, cooked
2  Tbsp. butter
6  oz. pkg. shredded Parmesan cheese, divided
1 1/2  lb. ground round
1  medium onion, diced
2  garlic cloves, minced
16  oz. can tomato sauce
1 1/2  tsp. salt, divided
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. butter
2/3  c. all-purpose flour
4  c. milk
2  large eggs
preparation: Toss pasta with butter and 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese.

name: OKRA GUMBO
ingredients:
2  slices bacon, chopped
1/2  onion, chopped
1 - 10  oz. package frozen sliced okra
1 - 14 1/2  oz. can stewed tomatoes
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Saut bacon and onion until brown. Add frozen okra and tomatoes. Cook over low heat until okra is tender. Season with salt and pepper.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  small Jiffy cornbread mixes
2  sticks melted butter or Butter Buds
1  box frozen chopped broccoli
diced onion
1  c. cottage cheese
a little milk (to make thinner consistency)
preparation: Mix all together.  Spray baking dish or pan.  Bake at 300° to 325° for 1 hour or until done.

name: PEPPERMINT DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. vanilla wafers, crushed (45 cookies)
2/3  c. oleo, melted
2  sq. chocolate, melted
2  eggs, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1/2  gal. peppermint ice cream, softened
preparation: Crush wafers and put in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Reserve small amount for top.  Melt oleo and chocolate.  Beat egg whites until stiff.  Mix egg yolks, vanilla, sugar, chocolate and oleo.  Fold in egg whites and pecans.  Spread over crumbs.  Put soft peppermint ice cream over top with reserved small amount of crushed wafers on top.  Freeze.

name: CASHEW BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. chopped beef (hamburger)
1  medium onion, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. fine noodles
1/2  c. celery, chopped
4  oz. mushrooms, sliced
1 medium  bottle ripe olives, sliced
1  can chow mein noodles
1/4  lb. salted cashews (dry roasted)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  can milk
preparation: Cook noodles; drain.  Brown meat and onion with salt and pepper.  Add meat to noodles; discard any grease in pan.  Saute mushrooms in 1 tablespoon butter until lightly browned; add mixture.  Also add celery and olives, milk and soup.  Mix and put in casserole.  Bake, covered, in 350° oven for 30 minutes.  Then put chow mein noodles and nuts over top.  Bake uncovered for another 30 minutes.

name: SPEEDY CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
15  oz. can condensed sweetened milk (1 1/3 c.)
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1/2  c. walnuts (optional)
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  sq. unsweetened chocolate
preparation: Cook condensed milk, chocolate and salt over rapidly boiling water until thick, about 10 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Turn into buttered glass dish (9 x 13-inch).  Chill for a few hours before cutting.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  cabbage (medium)
1  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
pepper to taste
1  c. crushed saltine crackers
2  Tbsp. flour (self-rising)
1  pkg. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Shred cabbage with knife.  Cook cabbage in pot with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1 tablespoon margarine until tender.  Make a white sauce by combining 2 cups milk, 2 tablespoons margarine, 2 tablespoons self-rising flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Stir constantly as sauce begins to thicken.  Drain cabbage and mix with sauce.  In a casserole dish alternately layer cabbage mixture and cheese ending with cheese on top.  Sprinkle saltines on top.  Place in 350° oven until cheese melts.

name: RIVER BOTTOM PIE
ingredients:
2  graham cracker crusts
1  stick butter
1/2  c. sugar
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. lemon juice
1 large  can pineapple
1  c. pecans
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients with mixer.  Mix other in by hand. Add lemon juice last.  Pour into crust.  Refrigerate until firm. This recipe will serve 4 people.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
3  ripe bananas
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Mix together, then add bananas. Bake at 350°.

name: PUMPKIN RAISIN CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
4  eggs
1  can (16 oz.) pumpkin
3/4  c. vegetable oil
2  c. bran cereal (not flakes)
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. raisins
confectioners sugar (optional)
preparation: Combine flour, sugar, pumpkin pie spice, baking powder, baking soda and salt; set aside.  In a large bowl, beat eggs.  Add pumpkin and oil stir in cereal just until moistened.  Add dry ingredients and stir just until combined.  Fold in pecans and raisins.  Pour into a greased 10-inch tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 60 to 65 minutes or until cake tests done.  Cool in pan for 10 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.  Dust with confectioners sugar before serving if desired.  Yields 12 to 16 servings.

name: KIELBASA-CHEESE POTATO TOPPING
ingredients:
1  egg
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
1  cup vegetable oil
1  jar (16 oz. pasteurized cheese spread
1  link (about 1/2 lb.) Kielbasa sausage, cut into 1/4 inch cubes
4  jalapeno peppers (seeds removed) chopped
preparation: In blender, combine egg, lemon juice, mustard, and salt. Blend well and with motor running, gradually add oil until mixture is consistency of mayonnaise.  In large heavy saucepan, melt cheese spread.  Add the egg mixture, sausage, ad jalapenos, stirring to blend.  Remove from heat and store in refrigerator in an airtight container. To serve, heat mixture and spoon over baked potatoes.

name: MAMA'S CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
5  eggs (room temperature)
3  c. cake flour
3  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  lb. soft margarine
1/2  c. Crisco
1 1/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Cream margarine and Crisco together.  Add one egg at a time, blending well after each egg before adding another one.  Add sugar a little at a time, allowing mixture to smooth each time.  Add milk and vanilla slowly while mixing slowly.  Add flour, cocoa, salt and baking powder while mixing slowly.  Place in cold oven and set oven temperature at 335° and bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

name: DRY BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. macaroni (uncooked)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. onion, cut fine
1/4  lb. dry beef, chipped
1  c. medium sharp cheese
2  hard-boiled eggs
preparation: Mix all together  and let stand 4 hours or overnight in refrigerator (covered).  Chop  up  hard-boiled  eggs  and  mix thoroughly with mixture  before  you put in oven.  Bake 1 hour at 350° (uncovered).

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1  clove garlic, crushed
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. basil or marjoram
2 (14 oz.)  cans diced or stewed tomatoes
1/2 to 3/4  lb. uncooked shrimp
preparation: Clean and devein shrimp.  Set aside.  In frypan, cook onion and green pepper in butter until limp.  Stir in remaining ingredients, mixing well.  Bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer over low heat 12 to 15 minutes or until shrimp are firm and pink, stirring occasionally.  Serves 4 to 5.

name: NOODLE PUDDING
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1/4  lb. margarine, melted
4  eggs
2  c. milk (whole)
8  oz. wide egg noodle
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. corn flake crumbs
cinnamon and sugar, mixed enough to sprinkle on top of the crumbled cornflakes
preparation: Boil noodles 4 minutes.  Leave cream cheese and margarine out of the refrigerator for 2 hours.  After they are softened, put the cream cheese and margarine in the microwave to further soften. Whisk them together.  Beat the 4 eggs with milk.  Mix all the ingredients together including the noodles.  Put all into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: POTATO CHIP CHICKEN
ingredients:
4 (6 to 8 oz.) chicken cutlets (you  can use chicken thighs with bones, if desired)
6  oz. potato chips
1  clove garlic, minced
4  Tbsp. butter
1/4  tsp. ground black pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Melt butter in a small pot.  Add garlic to it and let it cool slightly.  Crumble potato chips in food processor by pulsing for 30 seconds, or place paper towel over chips and roll back and forth with a rolling pin until chips resemble crumbs.  Mix in black pepper.  You will have 1/2 cup. Place crumbs on a large plate.  Cover a large baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Dip one chicken cutlet into butter garlic mixture. Place cutlet on potato chip crumbs and press down slightly to insure crumbs stick.  Turn cutlet over and repeat on other side.

name: BLUE RIBBON BARS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  egg
1  stick margarine, melted
8  oz. cream cheese
2  eggs
1 (1 lb.)  box confectioners sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix cake mix, egg and margarine together; pat into greased and floured (or sprayed with Pam) 13 x 9-inch dish.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. buttercup squash (approximately)
1  medium onion, coarsely chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  small container sour cream
1 small  pkg. (16 oz.) herb stuffing mix
1  stick (1/2 c.) butter
preparation: Boil, drain and mash squash and onion.  Season with butter, pepper and salt.  Add can of cream of chicken soup and container of sour cream.  In separate bowl, mix together stuffing mix and stick of melted butter.  In large casserole (3-quart) layer dressing, squash and dressing.  Bake 30 minutes at 375°.

name: STRAWBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1  large Cool Whip
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  qt. strawberries
2  pkg. strawberry gel
preparation: Tear angel food cake and add 1/3 Cool Whip. Press in pan.  Mix cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and rest of Cool Whip.  Pour over cake. Place strawberries on top. Squeeze 2 packages gel over strawberries. Refrigerate for 1 hour.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen hash brown patties
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese
3  Tbsp. milk
1  lb. sausage
4  eggs
salt and pepper
preparation: Defrost hash brown patties and crumble them in 9 x 13-inch pan, about 3/4 to 1-inch deep.  Brown the sausage and spread over the hash browns.  Grate or shred the cheese and spread over sausage.  Beat eggs with milk and pour over cheese layer.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Bake at 400° until bubbly, about 15 minutes.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
1  lb. Fresh Shrimp
1 1/2  Tbsp. Butter or Salad Oil
1/2  c. Chopped Onions
1  Clove Garlic, minced
1/2  c. Green Pepper, chopped
6  Med. Ripe Tomatoes
2  tsp. Salt
Pepper
2  Bay Leaves
preparation: Cook onions, garlic, green pepper in butter until soft.  Add tomatoes, salt, pepper and bay leaves.  Cook 10 minutes.  Add shrimp and cook until pink.  Serve with rice.

name: GRILLED SWEET-N-SOUR PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  (1-inch thick) pork chops
1  c. sweet-n-sour sauce
dash of pepper
garlic salt to taste
preparation: Combine ingredients and marinate in glass bowl for 1 hour. Grill 30 minutes.

name: PORK CHOPS AND RICE
ingredients:
1  can beef consomme
1  can French onion soup
5  pork chops
1 soup  can white rice
1  c. mushrooms
preparation: Combine soups, rice and mushrooms.  Season pork as usual. Pour mixture into casserole dish.  Lay pork chops on top.  Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour.  Serve.

name: INDOOR SMORES
ingredients:
8  c. Golden Grahams cereal
5  c. mini marshmallows
1/3  c. light corn syrup
1 1/2  c. chocolate chips
1  c. mini marshmallows
1  tsp. vanilla
6  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Measure cereal in large bowl.  Butter a 9 x 13 x 2-inch rectangular pan.  Melt mini marshmallows, corn syrup, butter and chocolate chips in a 3-quart saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly; remove from heat.  Stir in vanilla.  Pour over cereal in a large bowl.  Mix ingredients with cereal quickly until completely covered with chocolate.  Stir in 1 cup mini marshmallows.  Make squares by pressing mix in buttered pan with buttered back of spoon.  Let stand at least one hour or refrigerate if a firmer bar is desired.  Cut in 2-inch squares.

name: CREME PUFF CAKE
ingredients:
graham crackers
2  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
3 1/2  c. milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
milk for desired consistency
preparation: Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with whole graham crackers. Mix pudding with milk, then fold in Cool Whip.  Pour half of mixture over crackers, then cover with another layer of crackers. Use remaining pudding mixture and a third layer of crackers.  Let set in refrigerator at least an hour, then cover with a thin drizzle of powdered sugar using remaining ingredients.  It is best if left in refrigerator 24 hours or at least overnight.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans whole tomatoes
2  bunches green onions, finely chopped
2 (4 oz.)  cans Ortego diced green chiles
chopped jalapenos to taste
dash of Tabasco sauce (5 to 10 drops)
garlic salt to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients in food processor and process for 5 to 10 seconds. Serve with corn chips.

name: CHOCOLATE BUNDT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
1/2  c. shortening
3  c. white sugar
5  eggs
3  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. unsweetened cocoa
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°. Grease and flour a 10-inch 12-cup Bundt pan. Sift flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa; set aside. In a large bowl, cream butter, shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each. Add flour mixture alternately with milk; mix well. Pour into Bundt pan. Bake for 70 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into cake comes out clean. Let cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then turn onto a wire rack and cool completely.

name: SLICED BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  medium even potatoes
1  tsp. salt
2 to 3  Tbsp. melted butter
2 to 3  Tbsp. chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley, chives, thyme, sage or herbs of your choice
4  Tbsp. grated Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Peel potatoes if skin is tough; otherwise, just scrub and rinse them.  Cut potatoes into thin slices, but not all the way through. Put potatoes into baking dish; fan them out slightly.  Sprinkle with salt; drizzle with butter.  Sprinkle with herbs.  Bake at 425° for 50 minutes.  Remove from oven; sprinkle with cheeses.  Bake another 10 to 12 minutes, until cheeses are melted and potatoes are soft.  Serves 4.

name: SHRIMP PATTIES
ingredients:
1/4  c. olive oil
2  lb. shrimp, cooked
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Grind shrimp up coarsely in grinder or processor; add onion and remaining dry ingredients.  Add olive oil to shrimp, combine mixture and form patties.  May be baked, fried or frozen for later use.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped pecans
4  c. chopped apples
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Mix in eggs and vanilla.  Sift dry ingredients (optional) or mix together.  Add to first mixture. Fold in pecans and apples.  Bake in a 13 x 8-inch greased pan at 350° for 1 hour.

name: "APPLE PIE IN A JAR"
ingredients: 28  c. apples, peeled and sliced
preparation: Fill 7 quart jars tightly.  Cover with syrup.  Place lids and rings on jars and process 20 minutes in water bath.

name: SNICKER SALAD
ingredients:
3  granny smith apples, peeled and sliced
1 20  oz. can crushed pineapple
1  c. nuts, chipped
3  large Snicker bars, chopped
1  8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix ingredients. Add pineapple juice, if too dry. Refrigerate.

name: CHICKEN AND CHEESE ROLL
ingredients:
4  boneless chicken breasts
Cheddar cheese
parsley flakes
garlic powder
preparation: Flatten chicken breasts.  Roll cheese up in chicken, place in small casserole dish.  Sprinkle parsley flakes and garlic powder. Cook for about 45 minutes.  Remove from oven, sprinkle a little cheese on top.

name: MICHAEL'S MARVELOUS CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  c. water
1/4  lb. unpeeled fresh shrimp
1 (8 oz.)  carton unsalted whipped butter
6  fresh mushrooms, finely chopped
3  large green onions, finely chopped
1/2  lb. fresh lump crabmeat, drained and flaked
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dried whole basil
1/4  tsp. poultry seasoning
1  clove garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
8  chicken breast halves, skinned and boned
1/2  c. Chablis or other dry white wine
butter
paprika
4  fresh mushrooms, sliced
1  green onion, finely chopped
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Bring 2 cups water to a boil.  Add shrimp and cook 3 to 5 minutes.  Drain well; rinse with cold water.  Peel and devein shrimp.  Combine whipped butter and next 3 ingredients; add shrimp.  Add salt, basil, poultry seasoning, garlic and lemon juice; mix well.

name: WEIHNACHTKUCHEN(Fruit Cake)
ingredients:
1  lb. shelled pecans (halves)
1  lb. dates (whole)
1/2  lb. candied cherries
1/2  lb. candied pineapple
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
4  eggs, beaten until fluffy
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix and sift dry ingredients over fruit and nuts; mix until well coated.  Pour into loaf pan (bottom lined with waxed paper); bake in slow oven (275°) for 1 1/2 hours.  Let stand 2 to 3 days before cutting (after taking out of pan).

name: MEXICAN LASAGNE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  chopped onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can enchilada sauce (mild)
1  large jalapeno Cheez Whiz
1  can evaporated milk
1  pkg. (12) corn tortillas
preparation: Brown ground beef with onion; drain.  Mix remaining ingredients, except tortillas, in large bowl.  Add ground beef to soup mixture.  Layer mixture with tortillas in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Bake 35 minutes, until bubbly, at 350°.  May serve with tortilla chips.  Good with Spanish rice.

name: HAM DELIGHTS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. softened butter
2  Tbsp. poppy seed
3   Tbsp. mustard
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. fine chopped onion
1  lb. ham
Swiss cheese
preparation: Slice 3 packages dinner rolls and put spread on both sides. Place ham and Swiss cheese between bread and put together.  Bake in 350° oven for 10 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. wide egg noodles
6  cooked and boned chicken thighs
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1 (4 oz.)  can diced green chilies
cheese (optional)
preparation: Cook noodles according to package directions; drain.  Add chicken, soup and green chilies.  Place in casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes, or until cheese is melted.

name: COLD VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can LeSueur early peas
1  can Shoe Peg corn
1 (4 oz.)  can diced pimento
1  c. celery, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1/4  c. Wesson oil
preparation: Drain peas, corn and pimento and mix together.  Add celery, bell pepper and onion.

name: EVA'S SANDWICH SPREAD
ingredients:
2  boiled eggs
1  can Spam
2  carrots
1  small onion
1/2  c. salad dressing
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Grind together the eggs, Spam, carrots and onion, then add salad dressing, vinegar and sugar.

name: BLUE CHEESE DRESSING
ingredients:
1  can cream of celery soup
1  pkg. soft cream cheese
1/2  c. crumbled Blue cheese
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
preparation: Gradually blend soup into cream cheese, using an electric mixer.  Beat just until smooth.  Do not overbeat.  Add remaining ingredients and chill.  Makes 2 servings.

name: SPINACH BALLS
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
3/4  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1/4  c. bread crumbs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  beaten egg
preparation: Defrost and drain spinach, pressing to remove excess liquid. Mix with remaining ingredients and shape into 1-inch balls.  Place on baking dish.  Microwave 2 minutes on High or bake at 325° for about 20 minutes.  These may be frozen before baking but no longer than 2 weeks.

name: TUNA NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (6 1/2 oz.)  cans chunk light tuna, drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Kluski egg noodles, cooked lightly and drained
1 (10 1/4 oz.)  can mushroom soup
1 (10 1/4 oz.)  can golden mushroom soup
2 soup  cans milk
preparation: Combine all ingredients in greased baking pan or dish.  Frozen peas may be added if desired.  Bake at 375° for about 1 hour.

name: LEMONADE CAKE
ingredients:
1 small  box lemon jello
3/4  c. boiling water
4  eggs
1  yellow cake mix
preparation: Dissolve the jello in boiling water.  Mix the eggs and cake mix and add to jello mix.  Grease 1 large or 2 small loaf pans. Line with wax paper.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.  Turn onto cake plate.

name: ONION MUSHROOM ROAST
ingredients:
1  (5 lb.) chuck beef roast
1  can condensed mushroom soup
1  pkg. onion soup mix
preparation: Set oven to 275°.  Put in large pan the roast on a large piece of foil.  Mix onion mix with soup; spread over roast, then fold foil loosely, leaving room around meat, but seal top.  Roast 3 to 4 hours.  Serves 8.

name: IRENE ENRIGHT'S BAILEY'S PIE
ingredients:
1  chocolate crumb crust
1  pt. heavy cream
3/4  c. Irish cream liquor
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
1  envelope Knox gelatine
preparation: Following directions on Knox package, thoroughly dissolve gelatine.  When slighlty cooled, combine with Irish cream and slowly add to heavy cream which has been whipped with sugar and extract until it is almost stiff.  Don't add the liquor too soon, or it might not stiffen.  When combined, pour into crumb crust. Garnish with sprinkles or nuts and extra whipped cream (so dietetic).  For quick setting, place in freezer for a few hours. Can be frozen a few weeks ahead of time and put into refrigerator a few hours before serving.

name: BAKED CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (17 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1 (17 oz.)  can whole kernel corn
1  large onion, chopped
1  medium green pepper, chopped
1 small  can pimento, chopped
2/3  c. milk
1  egg
1  c. cracker crumbs
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. melted butter or margarine
salt and black pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour into greased casserole.  Bake at 350° for an hour.  Serves 8 generously.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES IN CHEESE SAUCE
ingredients:
6  potatoes, sliced
1  onion, chopped
2  tsp. salt
pepper
3  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. hot milk
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Melt butter.  Add flour and seasonings.  Stir until smooth. Slowly add hot milk, stirring.  When thickened, melt cheese in sauce.

name: LIME JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. lime jello
1  large cottage cheese
1  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Dissolve jello as per directions on box.  When jello is almost completely  thickened,  beat  with electric mixer.  On slow speed, beat in cottage cheese and pineapple.  Let set to thicken and ready for use.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. sliced zucchini
1  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  green pepper
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
dash of pepper
1  clove garlic
1/2  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs, beaten
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Bake until golden brown.

name: FROZEN BANANA SALAD
ingredients:
5  or 6 bananas, mashed
1/2  c. sugar
2 to 3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 to 2  Tbsp. pineapple juice
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  pt. sour cream
1 (9 oz.)  carton whipped topping
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a bowl in order given.  Mix well after each addition.  Pour into a 9 x 12-inch dish.  Freeze until firm.  Yields 12 servings.

name: BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  large chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  can each:  wax beans, French green beans and kidney beans
preparation: Drain beans.  Mix all ingredients in large covered container. Refrigerate at least 12 hours.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
32  oz. jar spaghetti sauce
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1 1/2  c. water
1  onion, finely chopped
16  oz. Ricotta or small curd cottage cheese
8  oz. lasagna noodles, uncooked
preparation: Brown beef; drain fat and add sauce and water.  Simmer about 10 minutes.  Combine remaining ingredients, excpt noodles.  Pour 1 cup sauce on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Layer 3 lasagna noodles over sauce.  Cover with 1 1/2 cups sauce and 1/2 of the cheese filling. Repeat layers.  Top with lasagna noodles and remaining sauce. Cover with foil.  Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.  Remove foil, bake 10 minutes longer.  Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

name: GOLDEN OYSTER STEW
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. sliced celery
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  c. sliced mushrooms
2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese (4 oz.)
1  can cream of potato soup
1 (2 oz.)  jar diced pimento (undrained)
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. hot sauce
1  (12 oz.) standard oysters (undrained)
preparation: Saute onion and celery in margarine until tender.  Add mushrooms and cook 2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat, stirring frequently until mixture is thickened and bubbly.  Stir in cheese, pimento and seasonings. Continue to cook and stir often until cheese melts and mixture is thoroughly heated.  Add oysters and liquid.  Reduce heat and simmer 5 to 8 minutes or until edge of oysters curl.  Yields 6 1/2 cups.

name: SEASONED POTATOES
ingredients:
3  large potatoes (approximately 2 1/2 lb.), peeled and cubed
1 (8 oz.)  carton commercial green onion dip
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. margarine or butter, melted
2 to 4  Tbsp. milk
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
paprika (optional)
preparation: Cook potatoes in boiling water to cover for 15 minutes or until tender. Drain and mash. Add green onion dip, cream cheese, butter, milk and garlic salt, beating at medium speed of electric mixer until smooth. Spoon potato mixture into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika, if desired. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Yields 6 servings.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. squeeze sharp Cheddar cheese
1  pkg. squeeze onion cheese
preparation: Soften cream cheese.  Mix  ingredients together.  Shape into ball and roll in chopped pecans.

name: EASY PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  stick margarine
1 large  can sliced peaches
sprinkle cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Melt the margarine in casserole dish in the oven. Combine flour, sugar and milk in medium bowl.  Pour the peaches into hot casserole dish, then add flour mixture. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Return to oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until top is golden brown.

name: RUM CHOCOLATE MOUSSE
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate bits
1/2  tsp. instant coffee
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/4  c. dark rum
3/4  c. scalded milk
grated chocolate (for garnish)
preparation: In the container of a blender, combine first two items with hot scalded milk at high speed.  Add 3 eggs one at a time, 1 teaspoon vanilla extract and dark rum.  Pour into six sherbet glasses.  Cover with plastic wrap and chill in refrigerator until ready to serve.

name: STRAWBERRY PRETZEL SQUARES
ingredients:
2  c. finely crushed pretzels
1/3  c. sugar
2/3  c. margarine, melted
12  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. milk
1  c. thawed Cool Whip
2  c. boiling water
1 (8 oz. size)  pkg. Jell-O strawberry flavor
1 1/2  c. cold water
2  pt. strawberries, sliced
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix crushed pretzels, 1/3 cup sugar and margarine.  Press firmly into bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake 10 minutes.  Cool.  Beat cream cheese, 1/4 cup sugar and milk until smooth.  Stir in Cool Whip.  Spread over crust. Refrigerate.  Stir boiling water into gelatin in large bowl 2 minutes or until completely dissolved.  Stir in cold water. Refrigerate 1 1/2 hours.  Stir in berries.  Spoon over cream cheese layer.  Refrigerate 3 hours.  Cut into squares.  Makes 15 to 18 servings.

name: MADE FROM SCRATCH DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
3  large eggs, separated
1  c. sugar
4 1/2  c. regular all-purpose flour
5  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. melted shortening
powdered sugar (optional)
preparation: Beat egg whites until stiff and dry, then beat egg yolks one at a time.  Beat in sugar gradually.  Sift the flour and baking powder again.  Add alternately with milk, beating well after each addition.  Add flavoring and the melted shortening.  Turn dough onto lightly floured surface.  Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut in doughnuts and fry in 380° oil.

name: CHEESE ALMOND BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (8 oz.)  jar sharp cold pack cheese food
2  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1  c. toasted sliced almonds
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Beat cheese, milk, onion and 3/4 cup almonds until well blended.  Chill at least 1 hour.  Shape into a ball; wrap in waxed paper and chill several hours or overnight.  Chop remaining almonds; add parsley.  Roll ball in almond/parsley mixture.  Serve with assorted crackers.

name: CHEDDAR CHEESE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Melt butter. Stir in flour and simmer. Briskly stir in warm milk. Blend well.  Heat until boiling.  Stir in cheese. Blend well.

name: HONEYED CRANBERRY PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
4  thick pork chops
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. cooking wine
1  c. honey
1  c. whole raw cranberries
preparation: Brown pork chops in skillet and season. Add wine and honey. Cover and cook 1 hour.  Add cranberries the last 15 minutes.

name: SPANISH COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. white sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. white sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. buttermilk or add 2 tsp. vinegar to sweet milk
1  egg
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients thoroughly and remove 1 cup of mixture to use as the topping.  Set aside.  Add 4 remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan, sprinkling on topping mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until lightly browned.

name: FRESH FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1 (8 oz.)  jar Marshmallow Creme
fresh fruit
preparation: Blend cream cheese and Marshmallow Creme thoroughly.  Serve with strawberries, pear slices, or other fruit.

name: GRANDMA STRAUB'S CHILI SAUCE
ingredients:
20  medium tomatoes, peeled
4  large green peppers
3  to 4 hot peppers (Italian style)
1  lb. dark brown sugar
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1/4  c. cider vinegar
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
5  medium onions
salt to taste
preparation: Grind peppers and onions.  Mash tomatoes to chunky.  Add all other ingredients to mix.  Cook slowly until thickens, stirring occasionally to prevent burning, about 3 to 4 hours.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
2  chicken breasts
1  c. broth
1 small  can LeSueur peas
1 small  can Veg-All mix
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick melted margarine
1  c. flour or Bisquick
1  c. milk
preparation: Cook chicken breasts for 30 to 40 minutes until tender.  After cool, chop in small pieces.  Combine chicken, 1 cup broth you cooked it in, peas (not drained), Veg-All and cream of chicken soup.  In a separate mixing bowl, combine 1 stick of melted margarine, 1 cup flour or Bisquick and 1 cup milk and blend.  Pour batter mixture over chicken mixture in large baking dish.  Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 400° until crust is golden brown.  Serves 4 to 6 people (may double for larger family).

name: 5 CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. pineapple tidbits
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. coconut
1  c. mandarin orange segments
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

name: ICING FOR CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  box 10x sugar
1  stick butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Spread on cake.

name: SOUTHWESTERN SHOEPEG CORN
ingredients:
2  cans white shoepeg corn, drained
1  pkg. (8-oz.) cream cheese
Dash garlic powder
1/4  c. milk
Canned jalapeno peppers to taste
1  stick butter or margarine
preparation: Melt the butter and cream cheese in a glass casserole dish in the microwave.  Mix well.  Add to the cheese mixture the corn, garlic powder, milk, and peppers.  Mix well.  Place in a preheated 350° oven and bake for 30 minutes.  Serve immediately.  Makes about 8 servings.

name: ALMOND ROCA
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. water
1  c. butter
1  c. almonds, chopped or sliced
1/2  bag chocolate chips
3/4  c. ground almonds
preparation: Put first 5 ingredients in heavy pan and keep on low heat. Cook until temperature reaches 300°.  Pour into large buttered pan.  Let set 10 minutes.  Add 1/2 bag of milk chocolate chips on top.  When melted, spread evenly.  Spread ground almonds all over the top.  Let set until cool.  Hit bottom of pan on countertop to break into pieces.

name: EASY TORTILLA SOUP
ingredients:
14 1/2  oz. can tomatoes
1  clove garlic, chopped
1/4  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. cilantro
1/4  tsp. salt
5  c. chicken broth
preparation: In a large saucepan, combine ingredients.  Simmer all together (the longer the better).  To serve, place in bowls over broken tortilla chips, cubed Monterey Jack cheese, cubed avocados or any spicy ingredients will be good served in the bowl with soup. (Sliced olives are good.)

name: SOUTHERN CORNBREAD THANKSGIVING STUFFING
ingredients:
Cornbread (recipe follows)
7  slices oven-dried white bread
1  sleeve saltine crackers
2  c. celery, chopped
1  large onion, chopped
8  Tbsp. butter
7  c. chicken stock
1  tsp. salt
freshly ground black pepper
1  tsp. sage (optional)
1  Tbsp. poultry seasoning (optional)
5  eggs, beaten
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a large bowl, combine crumbled cornbread, dried white bread slices and saltines; mix together and set aside.  In a large skillet, saut the chopped celery and onion in butter until transparent, approximately 5 to 10 minutes.  Pour sautéd mixture over cornbread mixture.  Add the stock.  Mix well; taste and add salt, pepper to taste, sage and poultry seasoning. Mix well.  Add beaten eggs and mix well.  Reserve 2 heaping tablespoons of this mixture for the giblet gravy.  Pour mixture into a greased pan and bake until dressing is done, about 45 minutes.  Serve with turkey as a side dish.

name: ORA'S LEMON FLUFF
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1  pkg. lemon jello
1/3  c. sugar
1 3/4  c. hot water
1/4  c. lemon juice
2 1/2  c. crushed filled cookies
preparation: Chill can of milk 3 or 4 hours.  Dissolve jello in hot water. Chill until "sets up".  Whip until light and fluffy.  Add lemon juice and sugar.  Whip chilled can milk and fold into jello mixture.  Top with remaining crumbs.  Chill until firm.  Cut into squares and top with maraschino cherries, if desired.

name: CORN FRITTERS
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can corn, not drained
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. flour (add more, if needed)
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
salt to taste
preparation: Carefully watch  the  amount of flour added, that it is not too  stiff.  Add  1/4-inch oil in frypan.  Add more oil as needed. Combine ingredients; drop by tablespoon into hot oil.

name: DATE LOAF
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  pkg. dates, finely chopped
2  c. nuts
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Boil sugar, milk and dates until they form a soft-ball. Remove from heat.  Add nuts and butter.  Beat as long as possible. Pour into a thin cloth wet with cold water.  Roll and place in refrigerator.  When cold, slice.

name: CRISPY PEPPER SKIN DUCKLING
ingredients:
1  duckling (about 3 1/3 lb.)
3  green onions
4  slices ginger root
2  Tbsp. cooking wine or sherry
1 1/2  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. peppercorns
1  star anise
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
oil (for frying)
dash of Szechuan Peppercorn Salt
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients and rub the mixture on the surface and in the cavity of the duckling.  Marinate for 30 minutes. Steam the duckling over high heat for 2 hours or until soft.  Remove. While the duckling is still hot, rub it with 1 tablespoon soy sauce.

name: STUFFED PASTA
ingredients:
1  box large stuffable pasta
1  container nonfat Ricotta
2  boxes frozen chopped spinach
1  c. shredded carrot
2  c. chopped mushrooms
1  jalapeno pepper, diced
3  cloves garlic, chopped
2  medium to large onions, chopped
vegetable broth or cooking wine
Romano Italian cheese
your favorite tomato gravy
preparation: Defrost chopped spinach.  Cook pasta according to directions on the box.  Heat broth (or wine).  Add carrots, pepper, garlic and onion.  Saute until wilted slightly, then add mushrooms. Continue to saute until mushrooms are wilted.  Add defrosted spinach and simmer.  Add the Ricotta and mix well.  Remove from heat.  Fill each pasta and place into baking dish.  Once dish is filled, cover pasta with tomato gravy and sprinkle with cheese. Cover dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: PINK CLOUD
ingredients:
20  oz. can crushed pineapple
1 large  pkg. strawberry gelatin
9  oz. container whipped topping
1 (16 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
preparation: Drain pineapple juice into saucepan; add gelatin.  Stir over low heat until gelatin dissolves.  Cool to room temperature, then add other ingredients.  Chill.  Serve on lettuce.

name: CHURCH WINDOWS
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
6  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
1  pkg. colored mini marshmallows
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
7  oz. pkg. coconut
preparation: Melt oleo & chocolate chips, cool.  Add marshmallows, nuts & coconut, stir lightly.  Form into a loaf and store in the refrigerator overnight.  I use tinfoil to roll it in a loaf and more nuts to coat it with.	Slice and serve cold.

name: BANANA SPLIT PIE
ingredients:
9-inch pie shell, baked
2  sliced bananas
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 3/4  c. milk
1  c. sliced strawberries
1  small Cool Whip
chocolate sauce or ice cream topping
maraschino cherries
preparation: Spread bananas in bottom of pie shell.  Sprinkle pineapple over bananas.  Mix pudding and milk until thick and spread over pineapple.  Chill 30 minutes.

name: HEAVENLY FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. cold water
2  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cook sugar, syrup and water over medium flame until forms hard ball (252°).  Beat egg whites while cooking and pour syrup over egg whites (stiff).  Continue beating until thick enough to drop from spoon onto waxed paper.  Add vanilla and nuts or coconut just before ready to drop (mixture will lose its shine when it is ready).  Food coloring may be added if desired.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES YOU WON'T BELIEVE
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together all ingredients.  Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Flatten with a fork which has been dipped in sugar. Bake at 325° for 15 to 18 minutes.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: MARILYN'S OVERNIGHT HOT DISH
ingredients:
3  c. noodles
2  c. chicken or turkey
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  can water chestnuts
1 small  jar pimentos
2  c. chicken broth
1  c. cubed Velveeta
preparation: Mix and leave in refrigerator overnight.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: HOT MILK CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1/2  lb. butter
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs and sugar, add sifted flour and baking powder.  Melt butter in warm milk, add lemon juice and vanilla in pan on stove. Then mix all ingredients and bake in tube pan or rectangular pan at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: DOLE GOLDEN LAYER CAKE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple in juice
1  (8 oz.) tub Cool Whip
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen pound cake, thawed
preparation: Combine undrained pineapple, Cool Whip and pudding mix.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Cut cake lengthwise in thirds.  Spread 1/3 pudding mixture over bottom layer of cake.  Top with second layer; repeat layering, ending with pudding.  Chill 30 minutes.  Sprinkle with toasted, sliced almonds and pineapple slices, if desired.

name: MOLDED TAPIOCA CREAM
ingredients:
2  egg whites
1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. Minute tapioca
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  qt. milk
2  egg yolks, slightly beaten
2  tsp. unflavored gelatin
3/4  tsp. vanilla (sweetened)
sliced peaches
preparation: Beat egg whites until foamy.  Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar and continue beating until mixture will form soft peaks.  Mix tapioca, 1/4 cup sugar, salt, milk, egg yolks and gelatin in a saucepan. Let stand 5 minutes.

name: COCOA PIE
ingredients:
1  c. milk
2  eggs
1/3  c. cocoa
1  tsp. butter
4  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. pure vanilla
2  egg whites for meringue
1  c. sugar
preparation: Mix sugar and cocoa; use enough hot water to mix, then add 2 egg yolks.  Mix well.  Add milk and butter.  Pour in unbaked pie crust and bake in a preheated oven for 30 to 45 minutes.  Add meringue and bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

name: TAGLARINI
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
1 large  can tomato juice
1  green pepper, chopped fine
8  oz. very fine noodles
salt and pepper to taste
2 small  cans tomato puree
1  clove garlic
1 small  can mushrooms (whole or cut)
1  can cream-style corn
1/2  lb. grated cheese (sharp, Cheddar or Mozzarella)
preparation: Brown meat in large pan; add onion, garlic and green pepper. Cook 5 to 10 minutes. Add mushrooms, juice, puree and corn. Bring to a boil and add noodles. Cook at a simmer about 10 minutes. (Stir frequently to keep from scorching.) Pour into greased baking dish not more than 2-inches deep. Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and slightly browned. Serves 15. Cut recipe in half for less. Will freeze well.

name: IRISH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
4  c. apples, sliced very thin
1  c. nuts
1/2  bag butterscotch drops
preparation: Cream sugar, eggs, vanilla and oil.  Mix separately all dry ingredients.  Add to creamed mixture.  Add nuts  and apples.  Mix thoroughly with wooden spoon.  Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan, well-greased and floured.  Sprinkle butterscotch drops on top. Bake at 350° for 50 or 60 minutes.  Cool before cutting.

name: CHERRY BROWNIES
ingredients:
4  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1  stick butter
2  eggs at room temperature
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2/3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Melt 3 squares of chocolate and butter over low heat.  Let cool completely.  Beat eggs, sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy.  Add flour, cinnamon and chocolate mixture.  Stir until just mixed.  Pour into greased square pan. Bake for 20 minutes.  Spread cherry pie filling on top, then bake for 10 minutes longer.  Melt 1 square of chocolate and drizzle over top of brownies.

name: CHOCOLATE COVERED CHERRY COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. cocoa
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
6  oz. chocolate chips
1/2  c. sweetened condensed milk
4  tsp. cherry juice
maraschino cherries
preparation: Mix margarine, egg, vanilla and sugar.  Add flour, cocoa, soda and powder.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Place on ungreased cookie sheets.  Press center with thumb.  Place cherry in center.  Melt chocolate chips, sweetened condensed milk and cherry juice (from maraschino cherries).  Spoon 1 teaspoon frosting over each cherry. Spread to cover.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Remove to wire rack.  Makes about 4 dozen.

name: CROCK-POT ROAST BEEF
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. chuck roast
potatoes
carrots
onions
2/3  c. beef broth
3/4  tsp. celery salt
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Brown roast.  In crock-pot, put potatoes, carrots and onions. Place browned roast on top of vegetables.  Combine beef broth and seasonings.  Pour over roast and vegetables.   Cook 10 to 12 hours in crock-pot on low or 4 to 5 hours on high.

name: ROSEBUD BEETS AND PINEAPPLE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. water
4  c. cooked, whole small beets
1  c. pineapple chunks
salt and pepper to taste
3  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Combine sugar and cornstarch.  Stir in vinegar and water. Cook over low heat until thick and clear, stirring often.  Do not boil hard.  Add beets and simmer for 5 minutes.  Add pineapple and heat through.  Add salt, pepper and butter.  Cook 1 minute and serve.  Makes 4 servings.

name: VEGETABLE STRATA
ingredients:
2  slices white or whole wheat bread, cubed
1/2  c. julienne carrot strips
1/2  c. sliced small zucchini
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
2  tsp. Fleischmann's margarine
1/2  c. chopped tomato
1 (8 oz.)  carton Egg Beaters 99% real egg product
3/4  c. skim milk
1/2  tsp. dried basil leaves
1/4  c. shredded part skim Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Place bread cubes in bottom of greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan; set aside.

name: CRANBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. margarine, melted
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. orange peel, grated
3/4  c. cranberry juice
1 1/2  c. raisins
1 1/2  c. fresh pulped cranberries
preparation: Blend all ingredients.  Mixture will be lumpy.  Pour into a greased loaf pan.  Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until lightly browned on top.

name: CUCUMBER-ONION PICKLES
ingredients:
12  large cucumbers
6  medium onions
1/4  c. salt
1  qt. vinegar
2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. turmeric
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Wash, peel and slice cucumbers and onions.  Cover them with salt and let stand overnight.  Bring vinegar and salt to a boil. Sift together mustard, turmeric and cornstarch.   Mix with a little cold vinegar and add to vinegar and sugar.  Drain cucumbers and onions from salt water.  Put in vinegar solution and bring to a boil.
