Pack in sterilized Kerr jars and seal at once.

name: OLD FASHIONED HOT COCOA(Microwaved)
ingredients:
4  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. cocoa
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix sugar and cocoa together into fine even mixture in microsafe cup.  Add 3 tablespoons of the milk.  Mix well.  Heat in microwave for 30 seconds.  Remove and stir well.  Add remaining milk and stir well.  Heat in microwave for 1 1/2 minutes.  Remove and stir again.  If not hot enough, return to microwave for a few more seconds.  Add marshmallow if desired.

name: SEVEN LAYER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. coconut
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Pour melted margarine in baking dish.  Layer ingredients in order listed.  Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.  Cool.  Cut into squares.

name: APPLESAUCE SUGAR-FREE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. raisins
2  c. water
1  c. applesauce (unsweetened)
2  eggs
3/4  c. oil
2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  Tbsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. sweetener
preparation: Cook raisins and water until water is gone.  Beat applesauce, eggs and oil.  Add flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, soda, vanilla and sweetener.  Mix with raisins. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
1  large orange juice
1  large pineapple juice
1  diet Sprite
pineapple sherbet
1  small orange Kool-Aid
preparation: One day ahead make Kool-Aid and put in small round cups; freeze.  Day to be used, mix all together in large bowl and serve.

name: APPLE BUTTER
ingredients:
apples
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Cook apples in small amount of water until done.  Put in blender until smooth.  For each cup of apple pulp, add the sugar, cinnamon and cloves in heavy pan.  Cook until thick and glossy. Put in jars and seal.

name: GOOEY BUTTER BROWNIE BARS
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake mix (may use yellow cake mix)
1  stick butter or oleo
3  eggs (large) or 6 small
1  c. chopped nuts of choice (optional)
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese (room temperature)
1  box powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: You will need a 10 x 14-inch pan greased with Pam.

name: HERMAN COFFEECAKE
ingredients:
2  c. starter
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
2/3  c. oil
1  c. raisins (if desired)
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix well, and place Herman in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle topping over Herman.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
3  bananas, mashed
pinch of salt
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 3/4  c. flour
preparation: Mix in order given.  Grease pan and bake for one hour at 300°.

name: VANILLA WAFER CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
2  c. sugar
6  eggs
1 (12 oz.)  box vanilla wafers
1/2  c. sweet milk
2  c. coconut
2  c. nuts
preparation: Cream the margarine.  Add sugar and cream well.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Beat 1 minute.  Add vanilla wafers, crushed with rolling pin and add milk.  Add coconut and nuts.  Bake in a 300° oven for 1 1/2 hours.  Use a greased and floured tube pan.

name: VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  c. green beans
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped bell pepper
1  small onion
1 small  can English peas
preparation: Boil vinegar, sugar, oil, salt and pepper.  Pour over green beans, celery, bell pepper, onion and peas.

name: LOW-FAT MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
2  c. Dannon plain yogurt
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh cilantro
1 (16 oz.)  can refried beans
1  c. chunky salsa (mild or spicy)
1  c. sliced black olives
1  c. low fat grated cheese
1  c. jalapeno peppers (optional)
preparation: Combine Dannon plain yogurt and cilantro; mix well. Set aside. In a separate bowl combine refried beans with 1/3 c. salsa. Spread half of this mixture into a flat 2 quart serving bowl. Spread half the yogurt mixture over the beans followed by half the black olives, half the remaining salsa, half cheese and half peppers, if desired. Repeat the layering again. Cover and chill completely. Serve with your favorite chips, or crackers.

name: BROKEN GLASS TORTE
ingredients:
1 small  box green jello
1 smal  box red jello
1 small  box yellow jello
2 (8 oz.)  cartons whipping cream
1  pack gelatin (unflavored)
1  c. pineapple juice (hot)
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. sugar
10  full graham crackers
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix each jello with 3/4 cup hot and 3/4 cup cold water.  Put in separate containers the night before.  Soften unflavored gelatin into 1/4 cup cold water.  Add 1/2 cup sugar to each carton of whipping cream as beating; add vanilla to whipping cream as beating (beat until stiff).  After gelatin is softened, dissolve in 1 cup hot pineapple juice, slowly put into whipping cream.  Then cut jello in cubes.  Fold into whipping cream.

name: BREAKFAST PIZZA
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk pork sausage
1  pkg. (8) refrigerated crescent rolls
1  c. frozen loose pack hash brown potatoes, thawed
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
5  beaten eggs
1/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In a skillet cook sausage until well done, drain.  Separate crescent rolls into 8-inch triangles.  Place dough in 12-inch pizza pan, with points toward center.  Press over bottom and sides to form crust.  Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes.  Top with Cheddar cheese.  In a bowl, stir eggs, milk and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.  Carefully pour over mixture in crust. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.  Bake at 375° for about 25 minutes or until set.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: NOEL CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  large chicken breasts
1  small onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. sherry
1  can mushrooms
preparation: Place chicken breasts in baking dish skin side down.  Mix onion, cream of mushroom soup, mushrooms, sour cream and sherry and pour over chicken.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Sprinkle with paprika.

name: BAKED CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. corn syrup
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
6  qt. popped corn
preparation: Melt butter.  Stir in brown sugar, corn syrup and salt.  Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Boil without stirring 5 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in soda and vanilla.  Pour over popped corn gradually.  Mix well.  Turn into 2 large shallow baking pans. Bake at 250° for 1 hour.   Stir every 15 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Cool completely.  Break apart.  Makes 5 quarts.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1  can tiny shrimp, drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. salad dressing
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. ketchup
preparation: Beat together cheese, dressing, lemon juice and ketchup until smooth.  Fold in onion and shrimp.

name: BETTER THAN SEX CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix with butter or pudding
3  or 4 bananas, sliced
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1  c. sugar
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1 large  box instant vanilla pudding
1  c. chopped nuts
cherries (optional)
preparation: Mix  and bake cake  according  to  directions  in  9  x 13-inch pan.  Combine pineapple  and  sugar  in a saucepan and bring to a boil;  boil  for  5  minutes.  Make  up	pudding by directions.  Pour cooled  pineapple  mixture  over baked cake; arrange slices of  bananas	over pineapple.  Pour pudding over bananas, spreading evenly.	Top  with  Cool  Whip  and garnish with nuts and cherries.

name: OLD-FASHIONED CANDIED YAMS
ingredients:
3  medium yams (sweet potatoes)
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. nutmeg
1/4  stick butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla flavor
pinch of salt
1 1/2  c. water
preparation: Peel and cut yams in quarters.  Sprinkle with sugar and nutmeg; add butter.  Add vanilla, salt and water.  Cover and simmer over medium heat until liquid forms a syrup.  Remove from heat and serve.

name: FAST AND EASY FRUIT CRISPSocorro, New Mexico
ingredients:
2 21  oz. cans apple or cherry pie filling
1  2 layer size yellow cake mix
1/2  cut butter or margarine, melted
1/2  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
preparation: To bake:  Spread pie filling in low rasting pan.  Sprinkle dry cake mix over fruit filling.  Drizzle with melted butter, sprinkle with nuts.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/4 to 1 1/2  c. salad oil
3  eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. chopped dates
3  c. chopped fresh cooking apples
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Mix sugar and oil with electric mixer, beating at high speed for 1 minute.  Mix dry ingredients and add dates (optional).  Add to sugar mixture.  Fold in apples, vanilla and nuts and pour into greased and flour-dusted angel food cake pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes or until cake tests done.  Cool on rack for 15 minutes before removing from pan.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
2  chicken breasts, cooked and cut up
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pt. sour cream (I use light, 40% less fat)
3  chopped green onions
1 small  can Ortega chilies
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
8  to 10 flour tortillas (medium)
1 small  can sliced olives
preparation: Mix  chicken,  soup,  sour  cream,  onions and chilies. Spoon small amount of mixture into tortillas.  Sprinkle cheese over this.  Roll  tortillas  up  and  place  in  shallow  pan. Spread remaining  mixture  over this and sprinkle cheese over all.  Bake at 350° to 375° for 15 to 30 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. Cheddar cheese
1  lb. cream cheese
1/4  lb. Blue cheese
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
pecans
parsley
preparation: Set all cheeses out until softened and grate all together. Mix 15 minutes with hands.  Roll into 2 balls, then roll in crushed pecans and chopped parsley.  Refrigerate.  Make a few days in advance and thaw 1 hour before eating.  Eat on Town House or Ritz crackers.

name: ELBOW MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. macaroni, cooked
3  hard-boiled eggs, diced
3  stalks celery, diced
1  small onion, minced
1/2  c. olives, sliced
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/8  c. cream
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/8  c. lemon juice
salt to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients while macaroni and eggs are still warm. We like a dash of garlic salt.  Refrigerate until time to serve.

name: ROASTED EGGPLANT AND FETA CHEESE
ingredients:
3  medium, cubed eggplant
1 1/2  c. extra virgin olive oil
1/4  c. fresh squeezed lemon juice
1/4  c. minced red onion
3  cloves minced garlic
2  Tbsp. minced, fresh oregano
salt and pepper
1  lb. crumbled Feta
1/2  c. pitted ripe olives
2  bunches rinsed, dried, chilled spinach
6  sprigs fresh oregano
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Place eggplant cubes in a shallow baking pan; toss with 3/4 cup olive oil. Salt to taste.  Bake until cubes are soft, but not mushy, about 30 minutes.   Set aside to cool.  Whisk together the remaining 3/4 cup olive oil, lemon juice, onion, garlic and oregano in a small bowl.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Toss about half of the dressing with eggplant.  Arrange on a bed of spinach on a large platter. Sprinkle with cheese and olives.  Drizzle with remaining dressing and garnish with fresh oregano sprigs.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  c. milk
1  can creamed corn
2  eggs, well beaten
1  lb. hamburger, browned
2  large onions, chopped
2  hot peppers, chopped
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Caution:  Skillet must be greased and hot before adding cornmeal mixture.  Brown hamburger; drain off fat.  Grate cheese; set aside.  Combine onions, hot peppers; set aside.  Place a 9-inch iron skillet, greased well, in a hot oven.  Mix all dry ingredients, add eggs, oil, milk and corn.  Remove hot skillet from oven.  Put 1/2 of corn meal mixture in skillet.  Spread cheese over mixture.  Then sprinkle hamburger over cheese.  Sprinkle onions and pepper over hamburger.  Cover with rest of corn meal mixture.  Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour 15 minutes.

name: SPINACH AND BACON QUICHE
ingredients:
unbaked 9-inch pie shell
8  oz. shredded Swiss cheese
5  oz. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1/2  c. crumbled, cooked bacon
3  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. heavy cream
2  eggs
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. onion powder
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Place drained spinach in unbaked pie shell.  Cover with shredded Swiss, then crumbled bacon.  In medium bowl, mix together remaining ingredients and pour over spinach, cheese and bacon. Bake at 400° for 40 minutes or until lightly browned.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. grated sharp cheese
2  tsp. minced or 1 heaping tsp. dry onions
1  c. mayonnaise
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook broccoli by package directions, boiling 5 minutes. (Don't overcook.)  Drain.  Mix with soup, onions, mayonnaise, salt and pepper.  Put into casserole dish.  Top with cheese.  Bake at 350° until bubbly.

name: PAN-FRIED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
4  (8 oz.) pork loin chops
1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. cornmeal
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/8  tsp. paprika
vegetable oil
preparation: Completely coat the pork chops by dredging them in a mixture of flour, cornmeal, salt, pepper and paprika.  Heat a heavy skillet (which has a lid) over medium-high heat.  Brush the pan with a thin coat of oil.  When the oil just smokes, add the coated pork chops and reduce the heat to medium.  Cook for four minutes, then turn the chops.  Cover the pan and cook for 4 to 5 minutes. The pork chops should be juicy, but not pink at the bone.  Yield: 4 servings.

name: CHICKEN AND SPINACH TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
8  oz. uncooked spaghetti
3  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1/4  c. chopped onion
1 garlic  clove minced
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dried basil leaves
dash pepper
2  c. skim milk
1/2  c. grated parmesan cheese
1 1/2  c. cubed cooked chicken
1  c. frozen cut leaf spinach, thawed
1  large carrot, cut into 1/4-inch slices, cooked
1  Tbsp. grated parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook spaghetti to desired doneness as directed on package. Meanwhile, in large saucepan, melt margarine over medium heat. Add onion and garlic.  Cook 2-3 minutes or until tender.  Stir in flour, salt, oregano, basil and pepper.  Cook until mixture is smooth and bubbly.  Gradually add milk.  Cook until mixture boils and thickens, stirring constantly.  Add 1/2 c. cheese, chicken, spinach and carrot.  Cook 2-3 minutes or until spinach is tender, stirring constantly.  Drain spaghetti.  Serve chicken mixture over spaghetti.  Sprinkle with 1 Tbsp. cheese.  Makes 4 servings.

name: OYSTER CRACKER MUNCHIES
ingredients:
2  bags oyster crackers
1 1/2  c. oil
3/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  c. lemon pepper
1  pkg. Hidden Valley original mix
1 1/4  tsp. dill weed
preparation: Warm oil.  Add seasonings to oil.  Pour over crackers and toss until oil has been absorbed.

name: SALMON STEAKS
ingredients:
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. celery salt
dash of cayenne pepper
2  Tbsp. grated onion
1  Tbsp. white vinegar
3  to 4 salmon steaks
preparation: Put salmon on broiler pan.  Mix all other ingredients in a bowl and spread over steaks.  Bake in oven 35 minutes at 350°.

name: FRENCH BREAKFAST ROLLS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
2  large eggs, separated
4 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. sugar
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
preparation: Cream butter; add sugar.  Blend in egg yolk.  Add other ingredients to creamed mixture.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.  Bake in small greased muffin tins, 20 to 25 minutes. Roll hot rolls in melted butter, then in cinnamon and sugar mixture.

name: PORTUGUESE SOUP
ingredients:
1  can kidney beans or 1/2 lb. dry kidney beans
2  large potatoes
2  carrots
1/4  head cabbage
1/2  bundle kale
1/2  c. elbow macaroni
1  Tbsp. oil
salt to taste
preparation: Soak dry beans and cook or just add canned beans to pot and mash the beans.  Add enough water to cover and bring to a boil. Add potatoes, peeled and diced and carrots, sliced.  Shred cabbage and kale.  Add all ingredients to beans.  Cook well and serve hot.

name: EASY BAKING POWDER BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  c. wheat flour
1  c. white flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. vegetable oil
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Stir dry ingredients together in bowl.  Add oil and milk, mixing with fork until combined.  Put dough on ungreased baking sheet and press flat (or roll) into a rectangle.  Cut into 12 squares.  Spread out and bake for 10 minutes in a 450° oven.

name: TUNA MUSHROOM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. chicken bouillon granules
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen green beans
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
1/4  c. chopped celery
1  garlic clove, minced
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
4  tsp. cornstarch
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1/4  c. mayonnaise
2 1/2  c. medium noodles, cooked and drained
1 (12 1/4 oz.)  can tuna, drained and flaked
1/3  c. dry bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: In a large saucepan, bring water and bouillon to a boil, stirring to dissolve.  Add the next eight ingredients; bring to a boil.  Reduce heat.  Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

name: VEGGIE DIP
ingredients:
2/3  c. sour cream
2/3  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. dried onions
1  Tbsp. parsley
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1  tsp. dillweed
1/2  tsp. Accent
1  Tbsp. Beau Monde
preparation: Mix and chill.

name: GARDEN SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. oil
2/3  c. vinegar
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  can LeSueur peas
1  can Shoepeg corn
1  can French cut green beans
1 small  jar chopped pimento
preparation: Drain vegetables well.  Mix sugar, vinegar, oil and pepper together, heat to a boil (make sure sugar is dissolved).  Cool. Pour over remaining ingredients.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: BASIC STUFFING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. chopped cooked turkey
2  c. broth
1 1/4  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. melted butter
1  egg
baked cornbread
preparation: Chop celery and onion together until fine.  Add poultry seasoning, salt and pepper.  Chop until mixed well.  Add melted butter, beaten egg, chopped turkey and broth; mix well.  Add one pan of crumbled cornbread.  Mix until consistency for making patties by hand.  May need more cornbread.  Fry in small patties in oil or can be baked.  Will keep several days in refrigerator.

name: SEVEN LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1  medium onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  pkg. ham (chopped in small pieces)
1  can sweet peas (drained)
1  c. salad dressing
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Layer  lettuce	(torn or shredded), onion, bell pepper, ham and  sweet peas.  Spread salad dressing on top.  Sprinkle cheese.

name: SPICED HOLIDAY PECANS
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
1/4  tsp. cayenne
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
4  c. pecans
2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
dash of Tabasco sauce
preparation: Melt butter and add seasonings.  Mix thoroughly. Add pecans and toss gently until all nuts are coated.  Place in shallow baking pan. Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.  Turn at least once. Yields 4 cups pecans.

name: PISTACHIO DESSERT
ingredients:
1 large (16 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
1 large (30 oz.)  can fruit cocktail, drained
2 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. pistachio instant pudding
1  (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
1  pt. sour cream
2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Mix instant pudding  and  pineapple juice until pudding is dissolved.  Add fruit  cocktail  and  then  fold  in  other ingredients.  Cool and serve.

name: CHOCOLATE PIXIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
4  sq. chocolate
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. baking powder
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. pecans or walnuts
preparation: Melt butter over low heat.  Beat eggs and sugar.  Gradually drizzle in chocolate.  Add dry ingredients and nuts.  Chill 30 minutes.  Shape in 1-inch balls.  Roll in powdered sugar.  Bake at 300° for 15 to 18 minutes.

name: QUICK CHERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. granulated sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. almond extract
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
powdered sugar to dust over top
preparation: In a large bowl, cream together the butter and sugar.  Add eggs.  Beat until light and fluffy. Add almond extract.   Stir in flour and baking powder.  Mix until smooth. Butter a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Turn mixture into pan.  Spoon pie filling onto cake in 16 spots, spacing 4 spoonfuls evenly in each direction. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes and cake tests done.  Filling will sink into the cake while baking.  Place bottom side up on plate.  Dust with powdered sugar.  Spoon slightly sweetened whipped cream over each serving. Great served warm.

name: CAMPFIRE STEW
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can sliced potatoes, drained
1 (14.5 oz.)  can cut green beans, drained
1 (11 oz.)  can Mexicorn whole kernel corn, red and green peppers
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed tomato soup
1  tsp. dried parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: In large kettle or saucepan, cook ground beef and onion over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes or until meat is browned and onion is tender.  Drain if necessary.  Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Cover; simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated, stirring occasionally.  Yields 7 (1 cup) servings.

name: FUDGE MELTAWAYS
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo
1  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg, beaten
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. coconut
1/2  c. nuts
1/4  c. oleo
1  Tbsp. milk
2  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
preparation: Melt 1/2 cup oleo and 1 square unsweetened chocolate in pan. Blend in sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla, egg, cracker crumbs, coconut and nuts into oleo-chocolate mixture.  Mix well and press into ungreased pan (9 x 9-inches).  Refrigerate.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
12 to 16  oz. sharp cheese, grated
1  small wedge Blue cheese
onion salt
garlic salt
parsley flakes (optional)
chopped nuts
preparation: Cream together first 3 ingredients.  Add onion salt and garlic salt to taste.  Add parsley flakes (optional).  Roll in chopped nuts.

name: PEANUT BUTTER REFRIGERATOR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine (room temperature)
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. smooth peanut butter
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. plain flour
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine margarine, sugar, peanut butter and eggs;  blend well. Sift flour once before measuring and then sift with soda and salt.  Shape  dough  into  long  rolls  about  3-inches in diameter.  Cover  with  waxed  paper.  Chill  thoroughly.  When chilled,  slice  and  bake  in  400°  oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 5 to 6 dozen cookies.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour or cornstarch
2  Tbsp. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
3  egg yolks
1 1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Cook until thickening.  Pour into cooked, cool pie crust.

name: MEAT LOAF SUPREME
ingredients:
1  1/2-lbs. lean ground beef or ground chuck
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
1/2  c. milk
1  egg
3/4  c. seasoned bread crumbs
1  tsp. dried basil
1  Tbsp. dried parsley
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a 9X5-inch loaf pan with foil. Spray foil with cooking spray. Combine milk and egg in a large bowl; add bread crumbs, basil, parsley and pepper. Stir until blended. Add onion and bell pepper, mix well. Add beef and mix to combine ingredients. Pour into prepared loaf pan. Do not pack. Spread topping over meat loaf. Bake until cooked through, about 1 hour. Remove from oven to wire rack. Let stand for 5 minutes. Lift meat loaf out of pan and place on serving platter, remove foil. Can prepare ahead as recipe directs, cover and keep refrigerated for 2 days. Serve cold or reheat in warm oven.

name: CAPPUCCINO ICE
ingredients:
1 1/2  Cup Strong brewed Coffee
1/2  Cup sweetened condensed milk
1/2  Cup heavy cream
1/2  tsp. Vanilla
preparation: Combine coffee and sweetened condensed milk in large mixing bowl beat with a whisk. Add remaining ingredients and whisk until combined. Divide the mixture evenly between 2 freezer safe containers. Freeze until firm, remove from tubs and shave. Serve with a spoon.

name: CREAMY POTATOES AND PEAS
ingredients:
1  pound small red potatoes, cut into wedges
1  package frozen peas (10 ounces)
2  Tablespoons chopped onions
2  Tablespoons margarine
2  Tablespoons all purpose flour
3/4  teaspoon salt
1/4  teaspoon pepper
1  1/2 cups milk
1/2  teaspoon dill weed
preparation: Place unpeeled potato wedges in sauce pan with water, cook until tender. Cook peas. Meanwhile sauté onion in butter until tender. Stir in flour, salt, and pepper. Add milk and bring to a boil, cooking until thickened. Add dill. Drain potatoes and peas. Place in serving bowl. Pour the sauce over potatoes and peas and stir to coat. Serve hot. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: CRAB CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  lb. crab meat, drained
8  oz. soft cream cheese
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2  tsp. Old Bay seasoning
1/4  c. dried parsley flakes or 1/2 c. fresh chopped parsley
preparation: Mash cream cheese in mixing bowl.  Gently blend in crab meat, Worcestershire sauce and Old Bay seasoning by hand.  Spread parsley flakes on wax paper.  Form cheese mixture into a ball and roll evenly in parsley flakes.  Refrigerate at least 3 hours (preferably overnight) before serving.

name: PENUCE FUDGE
ingredients:
1  box brown sugar
3/4  c. white sugar
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. butter
1  c. chopped pecans or 1 c. shredded coconut or both
preparation: Cook the first 3 ingredients until ball forms when dropped in cold water.  Add the butter.  Add either pecans or coconut or both.  Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan.

name: VEAL CHOPS WITH VINEGAR GLAZE
ingredients:
4 loin veal chops, 1/2  lb. each
salt and freshly ground pepper
2  Tbsp. olive oil or butter
2  cloves garlic, peeled
2  bay leaves
4 sprigs thyme or 1/2  tsp. dried thyme
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1/2  c. chicken or veal broth
preparation: Sprinkle chops with salt and pepper to taste on both sides. Brown in skillet in oil or butter, turning once about 5 minutes per side.  Add garlic, bay leaves and thyme; cook about 3 minutes. Pour the vinegar around the chops and turn heat to high.  Add the broth.  Reduce heat; cover closely and simmer about 20 minutes. Serves 4.

name: GRANNY'S FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
1  c. strong tea
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. orange juice
1  c. grape juice
2  c. ice water
preparation: Mix all ingredients. When ready to serve, add 1 quart ginger ale. Garnish with lemon slices and clove sticks.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FROSTING
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  c. peanut butter
preparation: Allow cream cheese to soften at room temperature.  In a small bowl, beat the cheese until fluffy.  Add the syrup and continue to beat.  Add the peanut butter and mix well.	Excellent on banana cake.

name: MOCK APPLE PIE
ingredients:
36  Ritz crackers
2  c. water
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cream of tartar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
grated rind of 1 lemon
butter or margarine
cinnamon
preparation: Roll out pie crust for a 9-inch pie.  Break Ritz crackers coarsely into pie shell. Combine water, sugar and cream of tartar in saucepan. Boil gently for 15 minutes. Add lemon juice and rind. Cool.  Pour syrup over crackers. Dot generously with butter and sprinkle with cinnamon. Cover with top crust. Trim and flute edges. Cut in slits to let steam escape. Bake at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes until crust is golden. Serve warm.

name: PAUL'S PECANS
ingredients:
1  egg white
1  tsp. water
1  lb. pecans or walnuts
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Whip egg and water.  Stir in nuts.  Mix sugar, cinnamon and salt.  Sprinkle over nuts.  Bake at 225° for 1 hour.  Stir every 15 minutes.

name: BLACKBERRY PECAN CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix
1  pkg. blackberry gelatin
1  c. frozen blackberries (thawed) or fresh blackberries
1  c. cooking oil
1/2  c. cold milk
4  eggs, added one at a time
1  c. pecans
1  c. coconut
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Beat for 5 minutes at low speed.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cake comes away from sides of pan. Cool.  Ice with Blackberry Frosting.

name: DOLE AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, in juice
1 (11 oz.)  can Mandarin orange segments
1  banana, peeled and sliced
1 1/2  c. seedless grapes
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. flaked coconut
1/4  c. chopped almonds
1 (8 oz.)  carton vanilla yogurt
preparation: Drain pineapple and oranges.  Use juice as a beverage. Combine pineapple, oranges, banana, grapes, marshmallows, coconut and almonds.  Fold in yogurt.  Chill.  Serves 4 to 6 people.

name: CHOCOLATE REESE'S CUPS
ingredients:
1  lb. confectioners sugar
1  c. butter
1  c. peanut butter
12  oz. chocolate chips
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  block paraffin
preparation: Mix sugar, butter and peanut butter with a mixer until well blended.  Shape into balls and chill.  Melt chocolate chips, butter and paraffin.  Dip the chilled balls with toothpicks into chocolate mixture.  Yields 50.

name: MINI CHEESECAKES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
3  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1 (21 oz.)  can Thank You brand fruit filling or topping (any flavor), chilled
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine. Press equal portions onto bottom of 24 lightly greased or paper cup lined muffin cups.  In large mixing bowl, beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.  Add eggs and vanilla; mix well.  Spoon equal amounts of mixture (about 3 tablespoons) into prepared cups.  Bake 20 minutes or until set. Cool.  Chill and top with filling.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: IMPERIAL CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  cut up fryer
2  c. bread crumbs
3/4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. chopped parsley
1  c. crushed garlic or 1/2 tsp. garlic powder
2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  stick melted butter or margarine
preparation: Mix bread crumbs with cheese, parsley, garlic, salt and pepper.  Dip each piece of chicken into melted butter, then into the crumb mixture.  Be sure each piece is well covered.  Arrange in shallow pan.  Pour remaining butter over all the chicken and bake for 1 hour or until tender.  Bake in a 350° oven.

name: CHERYL'S MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen meatballs (Italian style)
2/3  c. ketchup
1/3  c. vinegar
1  can pineapple chunks, drained
1/3  c. brown sugar
preparation: Mix brown sugar with vinegar until dissolved. Add ketchup and pineapple chunks. Pour over meatballs that have been placed in a crock-pot and cook on low for 4 hours or until hot.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines buttery cake mix
3/4  c. butter flavored Wesson oil*
1 small  carton sour cream
4  eggs
1  c. chopped nuts
1  Tbsp. or more sugar
coconut (optional)
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients well. Add eggs, one at a time; mix well. Add chopped nuts. Grease Bundt pan. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon or more of sugar in bottom of pan. Sprinkle a few nuts on the sugar. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.  Can add coconut to this cake.

name: MEXICALI LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans red kidney beans, drained, washed and drained again
1  c. sliced radishes
1  c. finely chopped celery
2  medium or 1 large cucumber, sliced thin or cubed
2  c. tomatoes, cubed fairly small
2  avocados, sliced thin or cubed
2  c. chopped green onions
enough shredded lettuce to cover salad (about 1-inch covering)
1 to 2  c. shredded cheese (low-fat Cheddar)
chopped black olives and sliced jalapeno peppers (optional)
1  bottle fat-free Ranch dressing
Doritos chips
preparation: Layer ingredients as listed in large bowl (or container). After lettuce is added, drizzle dressing over top.  Completely cover (this will drain through veggies).  After chilling for an hour, add cheese to top and garnish with olives, peppers and paprika and crushed chips around to edge of salad.  Serves a bunch.  Serve with remaining chips.

name: CRAB SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. crab meat, chopped
1 small  can shrimp, rinsed, drained and chopped
1  Tbsp. chopped green onions
1  Tbsp. chopped celery
1 to 2  Tbsp. mayonnaise (according to taste)
preparation: I use imitation crab meat for economy; also tiny frozen, cooked shrimp may be used.

name: SWEET POTATO FAMILY PIE
ingredients:
3  medium size yellow sweet potatoes, thinly sliced
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  stick margarine
2  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
pastry dough
2  c. lukewarm water
preparation: Spread 1 cup sugar in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Cut margarine and spread over sugar.  Add dash of salt and vanilla. Add 1/2 of the sweet potatoes and place strips of dough lengthwise over them.  Add remaining potatoes; cover with remaining sugar. Cover with strips of dough.  Pour water over pie and bake at 375° until crust browns.  Reduce heat to 350° and cook until potatoes are done.  Remove from oven; spoon syrup over crust.

name: LIGHT CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  c. cornmeal
1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. buttermilk
1  egg, beaten
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into a greased skillet. Let rise a little.  Bake at 425° for about 45 minutes or until lightly brown.

name: BUCKEYE PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) pie shell, baked and cooled
4  large egg yolks
2 1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. cornstarch
1  c. light brown sugar, firmly packed
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. creamy peanut butter
2  Tbsp. unsalted butter
2  Tbsp. corn syrup
1  Tbsp. water
2  oz. semi-sweet chocolate
1  oz. milk chocolate
whipped cream (optional)
preparation: In a bowl, combine yolks and milk.  In a heavy saucepan, combine cornstarch and brown sugar.  Stir milk mixture into sugar mixture.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils.  Remove from heat and add vanilla.  Strain to remove any lumps.  Stir in peanut butter.  Cover pudding with plastic wrap to prevent a "skin" from forming.  Cool to room temperature; spread in pie shell and cover with topping.

name: GREEN DREAM
ingredients:
1  (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
1 (6 oz.)  box pistachio pudding
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. pecans or walnuts, chopped
5  oz. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Gently mix contents of pudding package.  Drain pineapple. Fold in pineapple, nuts and marshmallows.  Chill and serve.

name: TIRAMISU
ingredients:
6  oz. light cream cheese
6  oz. nonfat cream cheese
1/3  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. skim milk
10  ladyfingers
1/2  c. strong coffee or Espresso, chilled
2  Tbsp. dark rum
1  Tbsp. unsweetened cocoa powder
grated semi-sweet chocolate (optional)
preparation: In medium mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and sugar with electric mixer until well combined. Add milk and beat 2 to 3 minutes until light and fluffy.

name: DREAMY ICING
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1/4  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook milk and flour until thick.  Cool completely in fridge. Beat sugar, shortening and butter until fluffy on high speed.  Add cooled flour mixture and vanilla; beat until fluffy.

name: SALMON ROLL
ingredients:
1  can salmon, drained and bones removed
1  small onion, grated
8  oz. sour cream
1  c. finely chopped pecans
preparation: Mix salmon, onion and sour cream and form into ball. Roll in the pecans. Chill and serve with crackers.

name: CAROL'S BAKED TWICE POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
16  medium potatoes
1  stick butter or margarine
shredded Cheddar cheese
salt and pepper to taste
paprika to taste
8  oz. cream cheese
1  pt. sour cream
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Peel, boil and mash potatoes.  Mix in cream cheese, butter or margarine and sour cream.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with nonstick spray.  Put potatoes in pan.  Sprinkle top with both cheeses and paprika.  Bake at 350° for about one hour or until heated through.

name: FRESH COCONUT CAKE(3 Layers)
ingredients:
1  pt. whipping cream
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
3  c. self-rising flour
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix eggs, sugar and cream. Add flour, salt and vanilla. Mix well. Pour in 3 greased pans. Bake at 350°. Cool and spoon next mixture over cake before frosting: Make 1 cup sugar and 1 1/2 cups fresh coconut soupy with coconut milk. Add water if necessary. Frost with "Never Fail Frosting, " then sprinkle with remaining coconut.

name: KNOX BLOCKS
ingredients:
3  envelopes Knox unflavored gelatine
1 1/2  c. cold fruit juice
1 1/2  c. fruit juice heated to boiling
preparation: In bowl, sprinkle gelatine over cold juice; let stand 1 minute.  Add  hot  juice and stir until gelatine is completely dissolved.	Pour  into 8 or 9-inch baking dish and chill until firm  in  refrigerator.  To  serve,  cut  into 1-inch squares. Makes about 6 dozen blocks.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
chicken
12  oz. spaghetti
3/4  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. chopped celery
1/2  stick oleo
1  can mushrooms
1  can mushroom soup
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes, mashed
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, mashed
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Mix all together; then mix in cooked spaghetti.  Grate 8 ounces Cheddar cheese on top.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes (with a foil tent over); do not touch cheese.  Uncover last 5 minutes.  Can freeze before adding cheese and before baking (or freeze half). Chicken can be cooked the day before.

name: HOT MULLED CIDER
ingredients:
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. whole allspice
1  tsp. whole cloves
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of ground nutmeg
3 inches  stick cinnamon
2  qt. apple cider
orange slices
preparation: Combine sugar, allspice, cloves, salt, nutmeg, cinnamon and cider in a large saucepan.  Slowly bring to boil.  Cover; simmer for 20 minutes.  Remove spices.  Serve warm, garnished with orange slices.

name: CHERRY GOOD AND RICH DESSERT
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling (1 lb. 5 oz.)
1  can crushed pineapple (1 lb. 4 oz.), drained
1/3  c. chopped nuts
1  Cool Whip (12 oz.)
1  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Drain pineapple.  Mix pineapple and all other ingredients together until completely blended.  Put into a serving bowl; cover and refrigerate 24 hours.

name: MAYONNAISE ROLLS
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
1  c. self-rising flour
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
preparation: Grease muffin tins.  Spoon in mixture.  Bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Makes 6 rolls.

name: LEMON CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. lemon jello
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 large  can evaporated milk
1/2  c. melted margarine
1  c. boiling water
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  pkg. graham crackers, crushed
preparation: Pour milk into large mixing bowl and chill in freezer until crystals form around the edge.   Dissolve jello in boiling water. Pour over cream cheese and beat with mixer until smooth.  Add sugar, lemon juice and vanilla. Chill.

name: NO SUGAR BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. each:  dates, raisins and prunes
1  c. water
1  stick butter or oleo
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. white flour
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  tsp. cinnamon or 1/4 tsp. nutmeg or 1/4 tsp. cloves (optional)
preparation: Boil dates, raisins and prunes in together in water for 5 minutes.  Add butter or oleo; set aside.  In a bowl, mix eggs, soda, vanilla, salt, flour and chopped nuts.  Add fruit mixture to batter.  Add cinnamon, nutmeg or cloves, if desired.  Bake in a 7 x 11-inch pan at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cool and cut.

name: MACARONI AND BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
2  sliced carrots
2  stalks sliced celery
1  large chopped onion
16  oz. can tomatoes
1  can chicken broth
2  c. cooked macaroni
1  can white kidney beans
1  can red kidney beans
1  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
preparation: Cook together carrots, celery, onion, tomatoes and chicken broth.  Add the remaining ingredients.  Serve with Parmesan cheese.

name: TATER TOT HOT DISH
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onion
1 frozen  pkg. Tater Tots
1  can cream of mushroom soup
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Brown ground beef in pan.  Drain fat. In 13 x 9-inch pan, spread ground beef and onion on bottom.  Put layer of Tater Tots on top.  Mix in a bowl the soup and milk and pour on top of Tater Tots.  Bake 1 hour.  Serves 6.

name: DIABETIC APPLESAUCE CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  egg
2  tsp. Sweet 'N Low
1 3/4  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. ginger
1  c. unsweetened applesauce
2  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. raisins (optional)
13  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Cream margarine  until	fluffy.  Beat egg and sweetener until thick and  lemon  colored.	Add  margarine and mix well. Sift together  all  dry ingredients.  Add to margarine mixture alternately with  applesauce, starting and ending with the dry ingredients.  Blend well after each addition.  Add vanilla and blend in raisins and nuts.

name: SIX WEEK BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  box Raisin Bran cereal or substitute Fruit & Fibre cereal (12 oz.)
1  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
3  eggs, beaten
1  qt. buttermilk
5  c. flour
5  tsp. soda
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix bran, sugar, flour, soda and salt.  Add eggs, Crisco and buttermilk.   Mix well by hand.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Batter will keep in refrigerator up to 6 weeks.  Small amounts can be baked fresh as you need them and store batter. Extra dry fruits can be added to taste.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1/2  c. oil
2  eggs
1 6  oz. pkg. semisweet chocolate chips
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Drop by teaspoonful on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake for 10 minutes at 375 degrees.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
2  to 3 boiled, cubed, boneless chicken breasts
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can Veg-All
2  pie crusts
preparation: Mix cooked chicken breast cubes, soups and vegetables together. Refrigerate overnight.  Prepare crust as directed.  Place chicken, soups and vegetable mixture in the bottom pie crust.  Top with other crust and bake until crust is browned.

name: SURPRISE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  pkg. Ramen noodles (beef or chicken)
1 (16 oz.)  can Veg-All, drained
2  cans Butter-me-not biscuits
preparation: Brown  ground  beef.  Cook  both  packages  of noodles; drain water and add seasoning packet (use only one).  Combine ground beef, Veg-All and Ramen noodles in a large bowl and mix thoroughly.  Divide  contents  into  two  9 x 9-inch casserole dishes.  Spread  biscuits  on  top,  one  can  per dish.  Cook according  to  directions  on biscuit can.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: HAM-CHEESE-POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  c. light cream
2  c. diced, cooked potatoes
2  c. cubed, cooked ham
preparation: In a saucepan, heat cheese and cream, stirring constantly until cheese is melted and sauce is creamy.  Put rest of ingredients into a 1 1/2-quart ungreased casserole.  Pour cheese mixture into casserole and stir until well coated.  Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BRUNCH BUBBLE RING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. granola
3/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. refrigerated biscuit dough
1/2  c. butter, melted
preparation: Grease 12-cup Bundt pan.  Combine first three ingredients in small bowl and mix well.  Separate biscuit dough; cut each biscuit in half.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. box spiral noodles or shells
3  cucumbers, deseeded
3  tomatoes, deseeded
1  jar McCormick vegetable supreme seasoning
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
8  oz. Zesty Italian dressing
preparation: Cook noodles. Dice vegetables.  Mix everything together and chill.

name: SWEDISH MEATBALLS
ingredients:
2  (10 1/2 oz.) cream of mushroom soup
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
Parmesan cheese
3  lb. Swedish meatballs
preparation: Combine mushroom soup and sour cream soup.  Place meatballs in slow cooker.  Cover meatballs with soup mixture.  Add Parmesan cheese to taste.  Cook in slow cooker for 2 to 4 hours before serving.

name: PINA COLADA MOCKTAIL
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. pineapple juice, chilled
1/3  c. canned cream of coconut
1 1/2  tsp. rum extract
crushed ice
preparation: Combine all ingredients in blender; process until smooth.

name: CHICKEN IN WINE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. white wine
1/2  c. sour cream
chicken breasts, skinned and split
1  can cream of mushroom soup
salt and pepper
flour
milk and egg mixture
preparation: Dredge chicken in milk and egg.  Mix and dip in flour. Pan-fry until slightly brown.  Arrange in casserole dish covered with half soup, sour cream and wine mixture.  Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.  Use rest of sauce at table.

name: ZUCCHINI APPETIZERS
ingredients:
3  c. thinly sliced zucchini
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt (chicken seasoning is good)
1/2  t. oregano
1  clove garlic
1/2  c. oil
4  eggs, beaten
preparation: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix all ingredients and spread in pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD OR CAKE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  c. oil
2  eggs
3  c. zucchini
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. (or less) nuts
1  pkg. instant coconut cream (or vanilla) pudding
1/2  c. flake coconut
3 or 3 1/4  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cocoa
preparation: Shred or grate zucchini (if done in the blender add 1/2 cup of the oil with it).  Sift together dry ingredients except pudding. Beat sugar and eggs, add oil and blend well. Alternately add dry ingredients and zucchini.  Stir in nuts and coconut, add vanilla and instant pudding.  Pour into 4 miniature pans (3 x 5 x 3-inch) that have been greased well and floured.  Bake in 350° oven for 50 minutes or until done.

name: BUCKEYES CANDY
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, softened
1  lb. box powdered sugar
2  c. chunky or plain peanut butter
2/3  c. Rice Krispies cereal
12  oz. chocolate chips
1/2  bar paraffin wax
preparation: Mix all together, except chocolate chips and wax.   Melt chips and wax in double boiler.  Dip each ball shape into chocolate with a fork.  Lay out on wax paper until dry.  Store in airtight container.

name: CHOCOLATE QUICKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking powder
powdered sugar
4  sq. chocolate
4  eggs
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat the oven to 350°.   Place oil and chocolate in saucepan over low heat. Stir until chocolate is melted.  Add sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Mix well. Sift flour, baking powder and salt together. Add flour mixture to chocolate mixture gradually, mixing well after each addition. Drop dough by teaspoon into powdered sugar. Coat well.  Shape into balls.  Place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake for about 10 minutes or until done.

name: COOPER PENNIES(Makes 5 Cups)
ingredients:
2  lb. fresh carrots, sliced in 1/4-inch rounds
2  medium onions, sliced thin and separated
1  medium green pepper, cut into thin strips
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed tomato soup (undiluted)
3/4  c. vinegar
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cooking oil
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Cook carrots in a small amount of salted water until tender (not soft), 8 to 10 minutes.  Drain and combine with onions and green pepper.  Stir together remaining ingredients, pour over vegetables and marinate in refrigerator for several hours or overnight.  Before serving, drain, but reserve marinade for leftovers.  Keeps very well refrigerated.

name: CORN SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans Shoepeg corn, drained
1/2  c. diced green pepper
1/2  c. diced olives (with pimentos)
1/2  c. sliced green onions
1 medium size  bottle Italian salad dressing
preparation: Mix all ingredients. Store in refrigerator.  Keeps well for several days.

name: BAKED CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
3  c. cubed chicken
1 1/2  c. rice
3  c. chicken stock
2  sticks margarine
1  onion, chopped
2  c. carrots, sliced thick
lemon pepper to taste
preparation: Saute chicken in margarine seasoned with lemon pepper.  Take out chicken and mix 1/2 cup of rice and onion in margarine.  Mix one cup of rice and chicken stock together.   Mix with the rice, onion and margarine mixture.  Add chicken and place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Lay carrots on top.  Cover and bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350°.

name: RAISIN PIE
ingredients:
2  c. raisins
2  c. water
unbaked pie crust
1  stick margarine (1 c.)
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  egg
preparation: Cook the raisins in the water.  Cool and pour into unbaked pie crust.  Combine the remaining ingredients; spread this mixture over top of pie.  Bake at 350° until brown.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. instant pistachio pudding mix
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip, thawed
1  c. small marshmallows
preparation: Combine all ingredients well. Chill thoroughly before serving.

name: MACARONI AND SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. elbow macaroni
1/2  lb. fresh or frozen shrimp
1  to 2 fresh tomatoes (according to size)
mayonnaise and milk (equal parts)
salt and pepper
fresh green pepper, cut into small pieces
preparation: Cook macaroni.  Clean and cook shrimp.  Cut up tomatoes and green pepper.  When macaroni is cooled, add shrimp and fresh vegetables.

name: HAM BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground ham
1  lb. pork sausage
2  eggs
1  c. oats
1  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
2/3  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. pineapple juice
1/3  c. white Karo
preparation: Mix first 6 items together well.  Form into balls.  Bake in shallow pan 1 hour at 300°.  Drain off grease, then cover with last 6 items cooked until slightly thickened.  Pour sauce over balls.  Cover pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  This can be frozen before baking last 15 minutes.   Serves 18.

name: CHOCOLATE-ORANGE SODAS
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) frozen orange juice, thawed
1 1/2  c. quick chocolate-flavored milk mix
1 juice  can water
2  pt. vanilla ice cream
1 (28 oz.)  bottle club soda, chilled
preparation: In medium bowl, stir orange juice with chocolate milk.  Mix until smooth; stir in water.  Pour 1/4 cup chocolate orange mixture into each of eight ounce glasses.  Add 1 large scoop ice cream to each.  Add soda to fill almost to the top.

name: TURKEY LASAGNE(Serves 8)
ingredients:
8  oz. lasagne noodles, cooked and drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2/3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
6  oz. cream cheese
1  c. creamed cottage cheese
1/3  c. green olives
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/3  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. minced parsley
3  c. cooked diced turkey
bread crumbs
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Mix noodles, soup, milk and poultry seasoning.  Mix cream cheese and cottage cheese.  Heat; add olives, onion, green pepper and parsley.  In a 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch baking pan layer noodles, cheese, turkey and sauce.  Sprinkle top with bread crumbs.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: SIGNATURE CRABCAKES
ingredients:
1  lb. lump backfin crabmeat (picked)
Juice of 1/2 lemon
2  dashes Worcestershire sauce
2  dashes tobasco
2  tsp. Old Bay seasoning
1  slice fresh bread crumbs
2  tsp. Dijon mustard
1  egg
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh chives
preparation: Mix all ingredients together gently so as not to break up lumps. Scoop out onto greased baking pan with ice cream scoop. Bake at 400° until golden brown.

name: NO BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  stick butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter
3  c. quick oats
preparation: Combine sugar, cocoa, butter and milk, stirring constantly over medium heat.  Bring to boil; have at a rolling boil for 1 minute.  Add peanut butter, oats and vanilla; stir well.  Drop onto wax paper by teaspoon.

name: CARAMEL-CHOCOLATE SQUARES
ingredients:
1  pkg. (14 oz.) caramels
1  can (5 oz.) evaporated milk
1  pkg. Betty Crocker Supermoist German chocolate cake mix
2/3  c. melted margarine or butter
3/4  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
1  pkg. (6 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Melt caramels and 1/4 cup of the milk in saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly until caramels are melted and mixture is smooth.  Keep mixture warm over low heat, stirring now and then.  Mix cake (dry), margarine, remaining milk and the pecans.  Spread half of the dough (1 1/2 cups) in ungreased (13 x 9 x 12-inch) pan.

name: CHINESE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
2  c. chicken, baked and diced
3  scallions, chopped
1  celery stalk, diced
1  carrot, shredded thin
2 1/2  c. cabbage, shredded
1/2  c. chicken broth
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
5  water chestnuts
preparation: In a large skillet, heat oil until hot.  Place water chestnuts, celery, carrots and cabbage in skillet.  Cover; cook over medium-high heat for about 2 minutes.  Add baked chicken. Pour chicken broth in center of mixture.  Cover and steam 1 minute.  Dissolve cornstarch in water.  Add soy sauce; toss with chicken-vegetable mixture to thicken sauce to cover all ingredients.  Serve immediately over rice, noodles or chow mein noodles.

name: FRENCH CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
3/4  c. sugar
2  sq. Baker's unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
2  eggs
2  c. Cool Whip, thawed
1  (9-inch) pie shell, baked
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Stir in chocolate.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating at high speed for 5 minutes after each egg.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Pour into cooled pie shell and chill until firm (about 2 hours) or freeze.

name: CHEESE BALL DIP
ingredients:
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. Accent spice
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  bunch green onions
2  jars Armour dried beef
preparation: Wash salt off beef and drain.  Soften cream cheese.  Chop meat and onions real fine.  Add other ingredients and mix well.  Great with Ritz crackers.

name: COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  c. coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add sugar.  Bring milk and butter to boiling stage.  Add to eggs and sugar.  Stir well.  Add vanilla and coconut.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to 350°.  Cook until firm.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  box sugar cookie mix
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  can pie filling
various fruits
preparation: Make sugar cookie dough and bake in shape of pizza crust and let cool.  Combine cream cheese and powdered sugar.  Spread on pizza crust.  Refrigerate spread canned pie filling, add fruits as desired.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
3  to 5 bananas
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
3  sticks oleo
2  eggs
3  c. powdered sugar
1 medium  can crushed pineapple
9  oz. Cool Whip
1  bottle maraschino cherries
preparation: Mix 1 stick oleo and crumbs.  Press in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Combine 2 sticks oleo and powdered sugar; beat for 15 minutes. Spread over crumbs.  Cover with sliced bananas.  Spread crushed pineapple over that.  Spread Cool Whip over top.  Sprinkle with nuts and garnish with cherries.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: BROWNIE MOUNTAIN ICE CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  brownie mix, baked as directed, making sure not to overbake
Cool Whip
1/2  c. Oreos, crumbled up very fine
any flavor ice cream (I prefer cookies and cream)
preparation: After your brownies have cooled slightly, you take about 2/3 of the brownies and press them around the sides and bottom of a mixing bowl that has been sprayed with Pam.  Sprinkle and press part of the Oreo crumbs into the brownies.  Scoop ice cream and press into the brownie until filled 1/4 from top of brownie.  Take remaining 1/3 brownie and press onto top of ice cream.  Sprinkle and press more Oreo crumbs onto top.  Freeze at least 4 hours or overnight. Before serving, dump bowl upside down onto a plate.  You may need to loosen sides with a knife.  Top with Cool Whip and garnish with Oreo crumbs.

name: UPSIDE-DOWN CHOCOLATE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
2/3  c. white sugar
2  Tbsp. melted shortening
1/2  c. pecans (optional)
1  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and 2 tablespoons cocoa. Add milk, shortening and vanilla. Mix only until smooth. Add pecans. Put in greased shallow 1-quart baking dish.  Pour 1 1/2 cups boiling water over top. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped pecans
1 1/2  c. butter, softened
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
3  c. sifted cake flour
dash of salt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
preparation: Cream butter and cream cheese together.  Add sugar, 1 cup at a time; mix well.  Add flour, salt, vanilla and nuts.  Pour into Bundt or tube pan (greased and floured).  Bake in a 325° oven for 1 1/2 hours, or until done.

name: PEACH CRISP
ingredients:
1  can peaches
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  egg
brown sugar
butter
preparation: Place peaches in baking dish.  Sprinkle with brown sugar and dot with butter.  Mix flour, sugar and egg until crumbly. Sprinkle over peaches and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. chopped broccoli
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/2  stick margarine
1/3  lb. Ritz crackers
preparation: Cook and drain broccoli well.  Mix  cheese,  diced, and margarine with broccoli.  Place in 9 x  9-inch buttered baking dish.  Top with crushed crackers.  Top with dabs of margarine. Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

name: LIBBIE'S FUNERAL BARS
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo
1  c. light brown sugar
graham crackers
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Line cookie sheet with whole graham crackers.  Bring oleo and sugar to a boil; cook for 2 minutes.  Pour over graham crackers. Sprinkle with nuts.  Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.  Do not overbake.  Cut.  Let cool.

name: PUMPKIN CRUNCH CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  eggs, beaten
1 large  can pumpkin
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. salt
1 large  can evaporated milk
preparation: Mix all of the ingredients together in a bowl.  Pour into a waxed paper lined 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle 1 box yellow cake mix on top; then sprinkle 1 cup chopped nuts.  Pour 1 cup melted butter over mixture.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.  When cool, flip over onto a platter and peel off waxed paper.

name: YUM YUM CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising cornmeal
1/2  c. oil
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
4  oz. cream-style corn
preparation: Combine cornmeal and oil.  Add eggs and stir.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: KING RANCH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  fryer, boiled
1 (8 oz.)  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 soup  can chicken broth
1  lb. grated cheese
1  medium onion, chopped
12  corn tortillas
preparation: Cut chicken off bones; set aside.  Combine soups, broth, Ro-Tel and salt and pepper to taste.  In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, layer tortillas, cheese, onion, chicken and soup.  Makes 3 layers.  Cover with grated cheese.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, or until hot throughout.

name: COKE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour (all-purpose)
2  c. sugar
2  sticks margarine (soft)
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. Coca-Cola
preparation: Heat Coca-Cola, butter and cocoa to boiling; mix rest of ingredients and add to mixture; batter will be thin with marshmallows floating. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in 350° oven for 35 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool.

name: SPINACH SUPREME
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
onion, mushrooms, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper
2  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1/2  c. instant rice
1  can cream of celery soup
1  c. sour cream
1  c. sharp cheese, shredded
preparation: Brown meat; add onions, mushrooms and spices.  Place frozen spinach on top.  Cover and let steam until mixable.  Add rice, soup and sour cream.  Mix and then pour into casserole.  Spread cheese over top and sprinkle with paprika.  Bake uncovered in a 350° oven for 20 minutes.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH KRISPIE TREATS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butterscotch chips
2  Tbsp. butter
2 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
2 1/2  c. crisp rice cereal
preparation: Combine butterscotch chips and butter in a 2-quart glass dish. Cook, uncovered, 2 to 3 minutes, at power control 7, until melted.  Stir in marshmallows.  Cook, uncovered, 2 to 3 minutes, at power control 7, until marshmallows are softened; stir until smooth.  Stir in cereal.  Press into a buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch square glass baking dish.  Let stand until cool and set; cut into squares.

name: ANSON'S FAVORITE FRENCH FRIED OKRA
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen cut okra (don't thaw completely)
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. flour
1  c. cornmeal mix
preparation: Turn deep fryer on first so oil will be hot when needed.  Mix cornmeal mix and flour together in a Ziploc bag.  Place partly thawed okra, egg, milk, salt and pepper into a bowl and toss until thoroughly coated.  When oil is real hot, spoon 1/2 of the coated okra into the Ziploc bag of cornmeal and flour and shake.  Put the breaded okra in deep fryer and cook until golden brown.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
3  mashed bananas
2  eggs
1/2  c. nuts
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and beat well.  Sift flour; measure and sift with soda and salt.  Add bananas to creamed mixture.  Last, add flour mixture.  Pour into a loaf pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Makes 1 loaf.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, shredded
3  diced tomatoes
1  small onion, chopped
1  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. crushed taco chips
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch original dressing
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Brown hamburger.  Drain and cool.  Mix all ingredients together except taco chips.  Add dressing to salad mix just before serving, then add taco chips.  Mix well.  Serve.

name: CRUNCHY BAKED BANANAS
ingredients:
2  large bananas
1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  c. cornflakes cereal
1  Tbsp. butter, melted
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Peel bananas; cut each lengthwise in half. Place, cut sides up, in buttered baking dish.  Sprinkle bananas with marshmallows and sugar.  Mix cornflakes and butter; sprinkle over top.  Bake for about 12 minutes, or until bananas are tender. Makes 4 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1  chocolate graham cracker pie crust
1  box of chocolate instant jello
1  container cool whip
preparation: Follow jello box directions for pudding instead of pie. (Makes the pie fuller.)  Pour into crust.  Icing with cool whip.  I like to put chocolate slices or some kind of candy on top of cool whip.  Refrigerate.

name: LINZER SQUARE(Austrian)
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. lemon peel, grated
2  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. almonds, ground
raspberry jam
preparation: Mix all ingredients as for pastry.  Roll between sheets of wax paper (or press).  Line bottom of jelly roll pan with dough.  Save some for lattice.  Spread dough with jam and nuts and then make lattice over top with reserved dough.  Brush with egg and then bake in 350° oven until lightly browned.

name: MANDARIN CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. plus 1 Tbsp. cold skim milk
1 large  box chocolate sugar-free instant pudding
1  reduced-fat graham cracker crust
4  oz. fat-free cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. concentrated orange juice
1  packet Equal
4  oz. Cool Whip Lite, completely thawed
cocoa powder with 1 packet Equal
Mandarin oranges, drained (for garnish)
preparation: Pour 1 1/2 cups milk into medium bowl. Add pudding mix and whisk until blended. While still thin, pour into pie crust. Spread evenly. This will thicken quickly.

name: EASY FUDGE
ingredients:
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  pkg. chocolate chips
1  sq. chocolate (unsweetened)
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Butter a square pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch).  Heat milk, chocolate chips and unsweetened chocolate over low heat, stirring constantly until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth.  Remove from heat. Stir in nuts and vanilla.  Spread in pan.  Refrigerate until firm. Cut into 1-inch squares.  Makes 64 candies, 50 calories per candy.

name: Cracker Candy
ingredients:
saltine crackers
2  sticks butter (no substitute)
1  c. brown sugar
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Line a 9 x 13-inch cookie sheet with foil.  Arrange saltine crackers, 1 layer thick, in rows on cookie sheet.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  pkg. ground turkey or ground turkey sausage
1  c. honey wheat germ
1  c. spaghetti sauce
chopped mushrooms to taste
chopped onions to taste
chopped garlic to taste
chopped peppers to taste
1/2  c. chopped green olives
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl and bake in a 375° oven for 1 hour.

name: OLD-TIME GINGERBREAD WITH WARM LEMON SAUCE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. salad oil
1/2  c. molasses
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  large egg
Warm Lemon Sauce (recipe follows)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Into large bowl, measure 1/2 cup boiling water and all ingredients except Warm Lemon Sauce.  With mixer at low speed, beat until well blended, constantly scraping bowl with rubber spatula.  Increase speed to high; beat 2 minutes, occasionally scraping bowl.  Pour batter into pan.   Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool gingerbread in pan on wire rack 10 minutes to serve warm or cool completely on rack to serve later.

name: IMPOSSIBLE CHEESEBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. shredded Cheddar or processed American cheese
3  eggs
3/4  c. Bisquick
2  tomatoes, sliced
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Grease pie plate (10 x 1 1/2-inch).  Cook and stir ground beef and onion in 10-inch skillet over medium heat until beef is brown; drain.  Stir in salt and pepper.  Spread in plate.  Beat milk, eggs and baking mix until smooth, 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater.  Pour into plate. Bake for 25 minutes.  Top with tomatoes; sprinkle with cheese. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean, 5 to 8 minutes.  Cool 5 minutes.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  box yellow cake mix
1  c. chopped nuts
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Layer ingredients  in  order given in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at  325°  for  35  to  40  minutes  or 1 hour.  Can substitute any pie filling you choose.

name: PEA & CORN SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  green pepper, chopped
2-3 ribs celery, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1 large  can green peas, drained
1 large  can green beans, drained
1 large  can shoe peg corn, drained
1 large  can yellow corn, drained
1 small  jar chopped pimento, drained
Salt, pepper and paprika to taste
1/2  c. Italian dressing, fat free
1/2  c. cider vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. water
preparation: Mix all the vegetables together in a very large bowl.  You'll need stirring room.  Mix dressing, vinegar, sugar and water together.  Pour over vegetables and stir well.  Refrigerate and serve the next day.  Best made a day ahead so all the flavors mingle.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked, chunked chicken or turkey
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. curry
1  bag frozen broccoli
grated cheese
bread crumbs
preparation: Place chicken and broccoli on bottom of casserole dish.  Mix soup, mayo, lemon juice and curry together.  Pour over meat, vegetable layer.  Top with grated cheese and bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour (cover for last 10 minutes).

name: CHICKEN CREPES
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
1/4  tsp. tarragon
2  c. chicken, diced
3/4  c. chicken broth
1/3  c. flour
2  egg yolks, beaten
2  Tbsp. shallots
1 1/4  c. light cream
1/4  c. dry white wine
12  crepes or French pancakes
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan; add shallots or scallions and cook, stirring for 2 minutes.  Add flour, stir to blend, and slowly add 1 c. cream, stirring constantly.  Add broth, wine and tarragon and stir over medium heat until it thickens.  Cook 5 minutes.  Beat 3 Tbsp. sauce into yolks and return yolk sauce mixture to saucepan, stirring briskly.  Cook 1 minute more and remove from heat.  Mix half of sauce with chicken and add salt to taste.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Fill each crepe with 3 Tbsp. of filling.  Roll and place, seam-side down, in 9 X 13 baking dish.  Thin remaining sauce with the last 1/4 c. cream and spread over crepes.  Bake 25 minutes or until sauce begins to bubble.

name: VEGETABLE MEDLEY
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen vegetables (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots; California blend)
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms stems and pieces, drained
1 (5 oz.)  can water chestnuts, drained
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Cook frozen vegetables in boiling water just to separate. Combine with mushrooms, water chestnuts, soup, cheese, salt and pepper. Place in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole, top with potato chips.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Yields 8 servings.

name: PUDDING IN A POT
ingredients:
1  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
3  c. milk
6  oz. Cool Whip
1/2  c. Oreos, crushed
2  gummy worms
preparation: You will also need 1 six-inch clean clay pot, 1 silk flower with long stem, wax paper and ribbon.

name: CREAM CHEESE SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar, divided
1/3  c. butter
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1 (21 oz.)  can blueberry filling
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  To prepare crust, in a medium saucepan place 1/4 cup sugar and butter; heat until butter is melted, stirring occasionally.  Stir in graham cracker crumbs, press mixture evenly over the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan.

name: BLUEBERRY CHEESECAKE(Serves 9 To 12)
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. graham cracker crumbs (about 16)
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter, softened
2  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  tsp. vanilla
cinnamon
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 (15 oz.)  can blueberries, drained (reserve liquid)
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
sweetened whipped cream
preparation: Heat oven to 300°.  Mix crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and the butter; press firmly and evenly in bottom of ungreased baking pan, 9 x 9 x 2-inches.  Beat eggs until thick and lemon colored; beat in 1/2 cup sugar, the cream cheese and vanilla until smooth.  Pour over crumb mixture.  Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.  Sprinkle cinnamon on top; cool.  In saucepan, mix 1/2 cup sugar and the cornstarch. Stir in reserved blueberry liquid and lemon juice.  Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and boils.  Boil and stir 1 minute.  Remove from heat; stir in blueberries.  Cool.  Pour over cream cheese mixture.  Chill at least 8 hours.  Serve with sweetened whipped cream.

name: MYSTERY BARLEY SOUP
ingredients:
1  beef oxtail (about 2 lb.), disjointed
1/2  c. chopped onions
8  c. water
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. chopped parsley
1/2  c. chopped carrots
1  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. barley
1 (12 oz.)  can tomato juice
2  Tbsp. chopped black licorice
1/2  tsp. marjoram
1/2  tsp. basil
preparation: In a 5-quart Dutch oven, cook oxtail pieces over medium heat until lightly browned.  Add onions and cook until tender. Add water, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, about 4 hours to blend flavors and reduce volume by half. Add all remaining ingredients.  Simmer until barley is cooked, about 45 minutes.  Skim off excess fat before serving.

name: TATER SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. dill pickle relish
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  salt
1  tsp. hot sauce
1  small cucumber (finely chopped)
black pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients together; blend well and refrigerate.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
12  oz. vermicelli, cooked, rinsed and cooled
6  oz. Viva or other tangy Italian salad dressing
1 1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  Tbsp. Accent (optional)
1  Tbsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  green pepper, diced
1/2  can black olives, sliced or 3 oz. can chopped black olives
1  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1 to 2  c. chopped shrimp, salami, ham or Spam
preparation: Marinate cooked vermicelli in mixture of Italian dressing, lemon juice, Accent, garlic salt and black pepper overnight.  Next day, add celery, green pepper, black olives and mayonnaise or salad dressing.  Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve.  Add the meat to salad when ready to serve.

name: SUGAR-FREE BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1 large (1.4 oz.)  pkg. sugar-free Jell-O instant vanilla pudding
3  c. 2% milk
2  or 3 bananas, sliced
Estee brand sugar-free vanilla cookies
preparation: Make up the pudding using the milk.  Line the bottom of a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish with vanilla cookies.  Put a layer of sliced bananas on top.  Add 1/2 of the pudding and another layer of bananas.  Arrange more cookies around the edge of the bowl. Add the rest of the pudding and spread to cover to the edges. Chill for several hours and serve.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
6  to 8 chicken breasts, boiled
4  to 5 stalks chopped celery
1/2 to 1  jar Cates sweet salad cubes
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 small  bunch white grapes, halved
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Cube chicken and add enough Hellmann's mayonnaise to mix.

name: CREAM CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. lemon juice
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Mix together with mixer.  Pour into graham cracker crumb crust.  Pour cherries on top after mixture has been chilled. Refrigerate.

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. diced hot potatoes
1  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. vinegar
3/4  c. mayonnaise
2  hard-cooked eggs
3  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  dash pepper
1/3  c. chopped sweet pickle
preparation: Mix all ingredients and chill.

name: EASY BAKE POTATOES
ingredients:
self-rising flour
Parmesan cheese
salt and pepper
potatoes, quartered
preparation: Melt enough margarine to completely cover a 2-quart baking dish.  Place potatoes in dish.  Cover with flour and cheese (mixed together).  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Bake at 375° until potatoes are done.

name: ROCKY ROAD DESSERT PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Betty Crocker SuperMoist chocolate fudge cake mix
2/3  c. water
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  eggs
1 3/4  c. chilled whipped cream
2/3  c. miniature marshmallows
2/3  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  Tbsp. whipping cream
1  tsp. margarine or butter
1  oz. semi-sweet chocolate chips, coarsely chopped
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and dust a 9 x 1 1/4-inch pie plate.  Can also use a 12 x 12-inch cake tin or small rectangular cake tin.  Reserve 1 2/3 cups lightly packed cake mix (dry).  Beat remaining cake mix, water, oil and eggs in medium bowl on low speed, scraping bowl often, for 30 seconds.  Beat on medium, scraping bowl frequently 2 minutes.  Spread in pie plate.  Bake until cake springs back when touched lightly in center, 30 to 35 minutes.  Cool completely.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  egg
1/2  c. shortening, melted
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Break egg into large mixing bowl.  Add shortening, sugar, cinnamon, milk and lemon juice; beat until creamy.  Sift flour and baking powder into another bowl; add to mixture.  Mix well with spoon.  Drop dough by teaspoonfuls onto 2 cookie sheets.  Do not grease them.  Leave one inch of space between cookies.  Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove from sheets; place on wire racks to cool.  Makes 36.

name: SOUR CREAM - BLUEBERRY PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1  egg
1/4  c. sour cream
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1/2  c. fresh blueberries
blueberry syrup (optional)
preparation: Combine milk, egg and sour cream. Beat well. Stir together flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Add to milk mixture. Beat just until large lumps disappear. Stir in the butter. Fold in the blueberries. For each pancake, pour about 1/4 cup batter into a hot, lightly greased griddle or skillet. Turn pancakes when tops are covered with bubbles and edges are slightly dry. Serve with blueberry syrup, if desired. Yield: 12 (4-inch) pancakes.

name: SWEET AND SOUR SPICY SLAW
ingredients:
4  c. chopped cabbage
2  medium carrots, grated
1/3  c. chopped sweet pepper
1/3  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. mustard seed
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Combine cabbage, carrots, sweet peppers and onions.  Sprinkle with sugar.  Combine remaining ingredients for dressing.  Pour over slaw mixture and toss lightly.  Cover and refrigerate 8 to 12 hours, tossing occasionally.  Yields 10 (1/2-cup) servings.

name: MY MOM'S CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter
1 1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1  Tbsp. flour
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. vanilla
1  unbaked pie crust
preparation: Cream butter, flour and sugar thoroughly.  Beat eggs and 1 tablespoon water slightly.  Add to mixture.  Add other tablespoon water and vanilla.  Mix and let stand 20-30 minutes. Stir and pour in unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Makes 1 pie or 12 tarts.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
7  oz. macaroni
1  small onion, chopped
1/4  c. celery, chopped
1  medium tomato, chopped
1  hard-boiled egg
1/4  c. grated cheese
1  small sweet pickle, chopped
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. French dressing
preparation: Cook macaroni in rapidly boiling salted water and cook until tender.  Chill.  Mix remaining ingredients with French dressing and mayonnaise.  Chill thoroughly.

name: STREUSEL RASPBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1  egg, beaten
1  c. plus fresh or frozen whole unsugared raspberries
preparation: Combine flour, sugar and baking powder.  In small bowl, combine milk, butter and egg until blended.  Stir into flour mixture until moistened.  Spoon 1/2 batter into muffin cups, divide raspberries in cups, then top with remaining batter.  Sprinkle Pecan Streusel Topping over tops.  Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes in greased or paper-lined cups.  Makes 12 muffins.

name: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
