ingredients:
4 (1 lb. 4 oz.)  cans crushed pineapple
2 (1 lb.)  cans sliced peaches
2  c. fresh white seedless grapes, halved or 2 (1 lb. 4 oz.) cans
1 1/2  c. maraschino cherries, cut in 1/8 pieces
1/2  lb. or 30 marshmallows, quartered
2  tsp. crystallized ginger, finely chopped
1  envelope unflavored gelatin (1 Tbsp.)
1/4  c. cold water
1  c. orange juice
1/4  c. lemon juice
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. coarsely chopped pecans
2  qt. heavy cream, whipped
3  c. mayonnaise (for salad)
preparation: Drain fruit (save 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice).  Cut peaches in 1/2-inch cubes.  Combine fruit, maraschino cherries, marshmallows and ginger.  Soften gelatin in cold water.  Heat pineapple juice to boiling.  Add gelatin; stir to dissolve.  Add orange and lemon juice, sugar and salt; stir to dissolve.  Chill mixture.

name: CALICO BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  can kidney beans (drained)
1  can butter beans (drained)
1  can pork and beans (do not drain)
1/2  lb. bacon
1/2  lb. hamburger
1  small onion
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. Worchestershire sauce
1/2  cup catsup
1/2  cup granulated sugar
1/2  cup brown sugar
preparation: Place slices of bacon (cut into thirds) on the bottom of an electric skillet.  Put small hamburger patties on the top of the bacon.  Add a thinly sliced onion, sliced carrots, a little celery cut small, sliced potatoes, and top with a green pepper sliced in small pieces. (Any raw vegetables may be added.)

name: SWEET AND SOUR SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. water
1  c. vinegar
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
dash of ginger powder
preparation: Bring to boil.  Turn off.  Ready to serve.

name: PECAN WONDER COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1  c. soft margarine
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  c. buttermilk*
preparation: *Sour cream or sour milk may be used instead.

name: PAUL BUNYAN SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. milk
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
4  c. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream together the shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy. Stir in milk and raisins.  Stir together flour, baking powder and 1/2 teaspoon salt.  Stir into creamed mixture, blending well.  Chill 1 hour.  Roll chilled dough to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut with 2 pound coffee can or lid of canister (about 5-inches round).  Sprinkle cookies with sugar on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.  Remove from pan with spatula. Set temperature at 375°.

name: CHEESY BARBECUE BEEF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1 (12 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  c. barbecue sauce
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onion rings
1 (8 oz.)  jar pasteurized processed cheese spread
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a large skillet, brown ground beef; drain.  Add green pepper and cook until tender-crisp.   Stir in corn, barbecue sauce, chili powder and 1/2 can French fried onions.  Pour half of the meat mixture into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover with half of the cheese spread.   Repeat layers.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through. Top with remaining onions; bake, uncovered, until onions are golden brown.  Serve over buns, cornbread or rice, if desired.

name: SPINACH SQUARES
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. fresh spinach
4  Tbsp. softened butter or margarine
1  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
12 to 16  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
3  eggs
1  c. milk
chopped onions (optional)
preparation: Wash, cook and drain spinach well.  Beat eggs well; add butter, flour, milk, salt and baking powder.  Stir in grated cheese and cooked spinach.  Place mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan; level off.  Bake in 350° oven for 35 minutes.  Remove from oven and cool for 45 minutes.  Cut into squares and enjoy.

name: PORTUGUESE SOUP
ingredients:
1  pkg. beef short ribs (3 or 4 pieces)
1  lb. chourico
3/4  pkg. yellow split peas
salt and pepper to taste
1  chopped onion
2  lb. kale, washed and chopped
1  small cabbage, cored and thinly sliced
4  potatoes, peeled and cut into pieces
1  can red kidney beans, drained
preparation: Place  first  5  ingredients  in  a large soup pot with about 4 quarts of water.  After it comes to a boil, cook over medium heat  until  meat  is tender.  Keep replacing water to keep  it at  the  same level.  Remove meat and chourico.  Add vegetables, except  beans,  and  cook  for  about  15  to  20 minutes.  Add drained  beans  to  soup  and  cook  for 5 more minutes.  Serve in bowls with portions of meat and chourico.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine, softened
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
2 3/4  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Mix 1 1/2 cups sugar, margarine, shortening and eggs.  Stir in flour.  Shape into 1 1/4-inch balls. Mix 1/4 cup sugar and the cinnamon.  Roll balls in mixture. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes until set.  Cool.  Yields about 4 dozen cookies.

name: EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bacon (12 slices), fried and crumbled
3  or 4 eggs, slightly beaten
3/4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1 (8 oz.)  can crescent rolls
3  slices (7 x 4-inch) Swiss cheese
1 to 2  tsp. parsley
preparation: In small bowl, combine bacon, eggs, milk and onion.  Set aside.  Separate dough into 4 rectangles and place in bottom of ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Press over bottom and 1-inch up sides to form a crust.  Place cheese slices over dough.  Pour egg mixture over cheese.  Bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes until lightly brown and knife inserted near center comes out clean. Cool 5 to 10 minutes before cutting.  To reheat, wrap loosely in foil and bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: CAFE CALYPSO
ingredients:
4  c. milk
1/3  c. instant coffee
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. heavy cream, whipped
ground nutmeg
preparation: Take a handful of bits of root for every half gallon of tea. Boil as you would coffee.  If you like strong flavor, boil until water turns darkish red.  Sweeten as you like.  Don't throw the roots away.  They'll last for several makings.  (Choose roots that are red and clean and soak overnight.)

name: CHERRY BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk, scalded
1/4  c. butter
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. cherry juice
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
8  c. flour
1  c. (16 oz.) maraschino cherries, drained and cut up
remaining cherry juice
preparation: Combine milk, butter, sugar and salt; let cool to lukewarm. Add yeast, 1/2 c. cherry juice, eggs, vanilla, flour, cherries and remaining juice.  Mix until it forms a smooth, soft dough.  Let rise 10 minutes.  Mix down and let rise again until double in bulk.  Shape into 4 or 5 loaves.   Let rise until double.  Bake for 50 minutes at 350°.  Good toasted or with cream cheese.

name: FUDGE SAUCE ALA BARBARA
ingredients:
1  sq. chocolate
1/3  c. vegetable oil or butter
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. milk
vanilla (optional)
nuts (optional)
preparation: Melt and stir together the chocolate and oil or butter.  Cook the sugar and milk to a full boil for 1 minute.  Combine.  Add vanilla and nuts after cooked.  Refrigerate.  Reheat as needed.

name: BOILED 7 MINUTE FROSTING
ingredients:
2  egg whites
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
1/3  c. water
2  tsp. light corn syrup
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Combine ingredients in double boiler with water boiling.  Beat 7 minutes with mixer until stiff peaks.  Add vanilla and blend.

name: TUSCAN BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. white beans (small), soaked overnight
2  Tbsp. olive oil
4 to 5  cloves garlic, minced
2  medium onions, chopped
3  carrots, sliced
fresh basil
crushed red pepper
8  oz. whole plum tomatoes
1  lb. escarole
8  c. water or chicken stock (add more water, if necessary)
salt and pepper
preparation: In a large pot, saute garlic and onions in olive oil, then add soaked and drained white beans. Add carrots.  Squeeze and add plum tomatoes plus juice. Add fresh basil and a few pinches of red pepper. Cover with water or stock, salt and pepper to taste and cook for 1 hour. Adjust seasonings and cook until tender. Clean and cut escarole. Saute escarole in oil until it shrinks and add to soup.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1 1/8  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs, separated
2 1/4  c. sweet milk
2 or 3  Tbsp. oleo
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together sugar, cocoa, flour, cornstarch and salt in saucepan.  Add milk; mix well.  Cook, stirring constantly until mixture boils.  Boil one minute.  Add part of cooked mixture to beaten egg yolks, stirring to keep from lumping.  Put all back into saucepan and cook one minute. Cool. Put in cooked pie crust.  Top with meringue.

name: MISSISSIPPI CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. oil
1 small  can creamed corn
1  c. corn meal
2  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Pour into ungreased 9 x 9-inch pan. Cook 25 minutes at 375°.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. oleo or Crisco
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
3  c. quick oatmeal
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Drop  by teaspoon into a mixture of cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 350° for 7 to 9 minutes.

name: OAT BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. oat bran
1/2  c. raisins and nuts
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  Tbsp. baking soda
whites of 2 large eggs
1/2  c. applesauce
1/2  c. crushed pineapple
1/3  c. brown sugar (packed)
1/2  c. low-fat yogurt or buttermilk
preparation: Mix first five ingredients until well blended in large bowl. Whisk remaining ingredients until well blended.  Add oat bran mixture and stir to mix well.   Spoon 1/3 batter in cupcake paper cups or well greased pan.

name: BASIC YELLOW CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks whipped margarine
1/2  c. Crisco
2 3/4  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. vanilla
3  c. sifted flour
1  c. milk
5  eggs
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Cream margarine and Crisco.  Add sugar, salt and vanilla. Cream well.  Add 1/2 flour and 1/2 milk.  Beat at low speed until well blended.   Add eggs, one at a time.  Beat at high speed after each addition.  Add other 1/2 flour with baking powder and other 1/2 milk.  Beat at low speed until well blended.   Bake in three layers at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: NEW POTATOES GRUYERE
ingredients:
2  lb. new potatoes (24 to 32)
1/3  c. water
1  small onion, sliced and separated in rings
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. white pepper
preparation: Cook potatoes in water until tender, along with onion and salt (set aside).  Mix last 4 ingredients in saucepan and heat slowly until thick.  Pour over hot potatoes and serve.   Yields 8 servings.

name: CHEESY BEEF-STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
3  large green peppers, cut in half lengthwise
1  lb. ground beef
1   c. creamed cottage cheese
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  small onion, finely chopped
1  egg
1/3  c. bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. salt
1  c. shredded process American cheese
preparation: Place peppers in 2-quart (12 x 7-inch) glass baking dish; set aside.  Combine remaining ingredients, except shredded cheese, in medium bowl; mix well.  Spoon meat mixture into green pepper halves.  Cover with wax paper.  Microwave for 24 to 26 minutes on Roast, or until meat is well done (about 140°).  Top with shredded cheese and continue cooking on Roast until cheese is melted. Makes about 6 servings.

name: GERMAN PURTZELS
ingredients:
6 1/2  c. flour
2  c. lukewarm water
1/2  c. sugar
2  pkg. dry yeast
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1/3  c. melted shortening
1  c. raisins
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix lukewarm water, sugar and yeast in a bowl.  Add salt and 2 cups of the flour; beat with mixer.  Add eggs and melted shortening; mix.  Add 4 1/2 cups flour, raisins and vanilla. Allow to rest about 20 minutes.  Spoon into real hot grease and brown; drain and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: BUSY DAY CHICKEN AND DRESSING
ingredients:
8  oz. herb seasoned stuffing
1  stick margarine
1  c. hot water
2  lb. chicken breasts, cooked and cut
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  small onion, chopped
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Melt margarine; stir in water.  Grease a 12 x 8-inch baking dish with margarine and put 1/2 stuffing mix in it.  Add to the chicken pieces celery, onion, salt and mayonnaise, mixing well. Make a layer of chicken on top of stuffing, then another layer of stuffing.  Beat eggs and milk; pour over dish.  Bake at 350° until brown and bubbly.

name: EASY CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. chocolate morsels
1 1/4  c. sweetened condensed milk
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Combine morsels and sweetened milk in heavy saucepan.  Warm over lowest possible heat, stirring until smooth.  Remove from heat.  Stir in nuts and vanilla.  Spread evenly into foiled 8 or 9-inch square pan.  Chill for 2 hours or until firm.  Lift from pan and remove foil.

name: SPICY PORK TENDERLOIN
ingredients:
1 to 3  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. thyme
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  pork tenderloins (about 1 lb. each)
preparation: Combine the first 5 ingredients; rub over tenderloins.  Cover and refrigerate 2 to 4 hours.  Grill over hot coals 15 minutes per side or until juices run clear.  Makes 8 servings.

name: YOGURT CUPS
ingredients:
3/4  c. flour
1/4  c. oleo
3  Tbsp. powdered sugar
2 to 3  tsp. cold water
1 1/3  c. yogurt (any flavor)
preparation: Mix flour, oleo and sugar until crumbly.  Sprinkle in water, 1 teaspoon at a time, stirring until dough forms.  Press about 3 tablespoons of dough in bottom and up the sides of each of 4 ungreased 6 ounce custard cups to within 1/2-inch of top.  Bake until golden brown at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Let cool 10 minutes.  Remove from cups with a small metal spatula; let cool completely.  Fill each cup with 1/3 cup of yogurt.  Garnish with fresh fruit if you like.

name: DEVILED EGGS
ingredients:
8  hard-cooked eggs
1/2  c. salad dressing
2  Tbsp. sweet pickle relish
2  tsp. prepared mustard
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Cut eggs in half lengthwise.  Remove yolks; mash in small bowl.  Stir in dressing, relish, mustard and seasonings until smooth.  Spoon or pipe into centers of egg whites.  Cover; refrigerate until ready to serve.  Makes 16.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
3  slices soft bread, torn in small pieces
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. ketchup
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix beef, tomato sauce, onion, bread, egg and seasoning.  Spread in a 10-inch heavy skillet.  Cover with 1/2 cup ketchup.  Bake 1 hour.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  large onion, chopped
1 small  box chopped broccoli, thawed
1/2  c. oleo
1  box Jiffy cornbread mix
1  carton cottage cheese
preparation: Braise onion.  Beat eggs.  Add cottage cheese.  Mix all together and bake 20 to 35 minutes at 400° in hot skillet.

name: PATSY'S SPICY PICKLES(Yields 3 Quarts)
ingredients:
3 3/4  c. vinegar
4 1/2  tsp. celery seed
4 1/2  tsp. turmeric powder
3/4  tsp. white mustard seed
3  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. salt
cucumbers to fill 3 qt.
preparation: Pour boiling water over fresh whole cucumbers and let stand 12 hours.  Drain and wash cucumbers and slice as you desire.  Pack slices into hot jars.  Bring vinegar solution mixture to a boil and pour over pickles in jar and seal.  Put jars in hot water bath for 5 minutes.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
2  pie shells
1  16  oz. can mixed vegetables
1  box stuffing mix
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Thaw pie shells while mixing ingredients.  Prepare stuffing. Add drained vegetables, cream of chicken soup and stuffing into pie shells.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: SALMON IN MINERAL WATER SAUCE
ingredients:
6  salmon steaks (each weighing 1/2 lb.)
6  shallots, peeled and finely chopped
15  medium sized mushrooms (wild preferred, morel, shiitake or portabella)
1/4  c. Bertolli light olive oil
1  bottle Perrier or other mineral water
3/4  c. skim milk
sea salt
ground white pepper
preparation: Grease dish liberally with Bertolli light olive oil.  Cover the bottom with shallots and rinsed, dried and chopped mushrooms. Place the salmon steaks on top in a single layer.  Surround the salmon steaks with rinsed dried mushrooms.  Season with salt and freshly ground white pepper.  Add the mineral water.  Cook in an oven preheated to 375° for 15 minutes or until the fish is just cooked.  Carefully remove the skin from the salmon steaks and transfer to a serving plate.  Surround with the mushrooms.  Cover and keep warm.  Strain the cooking liquid into a saucepan.  Boil, uncovered, until reduced by two-thirds.  Reduce the heat to very low.  Beat in the remaining olive oil; add the skim milk and continue stirring one to two minutes.  The sauce should have a thickened consistency and look very smooth.  Pour the sauce over the salmon and mushrooms and serve.

name: COLD EGGPLANT APPETIZER(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  eggplant (1 lb.)
1  small onion, minced
1/2  medium green pepper, minced
1  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. plain yogurt
preparation: Rinse eggplant and place on microwaveproof roasting rack. Pierce skin in several places.  Cook on High for 6 to 7 minutes, or until soft.  Set aside to cool.

name: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
16  oz. can whole kernel corn, drained
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  small chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. paprika
2  Tbsp. dry mustard
pepper
3/4  c. milk
1  egg, beaten
1/3  c. cracker crumbs
1  Tbsp. butter, melted
preparation: Saute onions and peppers in 2 tablespoons butter until tender. Remove from heat.  Stir in flour and seasonings.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until bubbly.  Remove from heat; gradually stir in milk.  Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute.  Stir in corn and egg.  Pour into an ungreased 1-quart casserole dish.  Stir cracker crumbs and 1 tablespoon melted butter together; sprinkle over corn.  Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: NO BAKE PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. canned milk
1  stick margarine
2 1/2  c. rolled oats
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. peanut butter
preparation: Bring to boil for 1 minute the sugar, canned milk and margarine.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Pour into a 9 x 9-inch pan.  Cut into squares when cool.

name: CORNED BEEF LOAF
ingredients:
1  can corned beef
1 3/4  c. consomme
1  Tbsp. plain gelatin, dissolved in 1/4 c. consomme
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  Tbsp. green pepper
3  hard-boiled eggs
1  c. salad dressing
preparation: Separate corned beef and mix with other ingredients.  Put in a greased pan and bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.  Serves 9 to 10.

name: SWEET-N-SASSY CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
5  lb. bag chicken wings
4  c. chicken broth
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. soy sauce
preparation: Combine broth, sugars and soy sauce.  Marinate chicken with mixture in refrigerator for at least 3 hours (overnight is best). Bake wings and mixture in covered dish for 40 to 50 minutes in a 400° oven.

name: CORN MUFFINS, CORN STICKS OR FRIED CORNMEAL CAKES
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising white meal mix
3  Tbsp. self-rising flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
3/4 to 1  c. cold sweet milk
1  egg (unbeaten)
2  Tbsp. melted shortening
preparation: Mix meal, flour and sugar.  Add egg and add milk gradually until you get the right consistency (not too thick, not too thin). Add melted shortening last, stirring only enough to mix completely. Fill preheated and greased corn stick tins or muffin tins and bake at 450° for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown and done.  If frying, melt about 3 tablespoons shortening in skillet and fry with medium-low heat until brown and done.  About 2 tablespoons of mixture to each corn cake.

name: LIME CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Dream Whip or Cool Whip
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  pkg. lime jello
2  c. nuts
1 large  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix jello and let set until it begins to jell.  Beat jello and cream cheese; stir in Cool Whip, nuts and well drained pineapple. Pour into mold and let set up.

name: SPICED HOLIDAY TEA
ingredients:
7  c. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
5  tea bags
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice concentrate, plus 1 can water
4  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
4  c. water
5  cinnamon sticks
1  Tbsp. whole cloves
lemon slices or cinnamon sticks (optional garnish)
preparation: Bring the 7 cups of water and the sugar to boil in a large saucepan; cook until the sugar dissolves.  Add the tea bags. Remove from the heat and steep for 5 minutes; remove the tea bags. Add the orange juice concentrate and 1 can of water and the lemon juice.  In a separate pan, combine the 4 cups of water, the cinnamon sticks and the cloves.  Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes. Strain and add to the tea mixture.  Serve hot, garnished with lemon slices or cinnamon sticks.  Yields 3 1/4 quarts.

name: ONION ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets onion or onion mushroom recipe soup mix
2  lb. all-purpose potatoes, cut into large chunks
1/3  c. olive or vegetable oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  In large plastic bag or bowl, add all ingredients.  Close bag and shake or toss in bowl until potatoes are evenly coated.  Empty potatoes into shallow baking or roasting pan.  Bake, stirring occasionally, 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown.  Garnish, if desired, with chopped fresh parsley.  Makes 8 servings.

name: VENISON STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. boneless venison, cubed
1  onion, sliced
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed beef broth (undiluted)
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. catsup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
4 1/2  tsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. horseradish (optional)
hot cooked noodles
preparation: Place venison and onion in slow cooker.  Combine the next 7 ingredients; pour over venison.  Cover and cook on high for 3 to 3 1/2 hours or until meat is tender.  In small bowl, combine cornstarch, sour cream and horseradish; mix well.  Gradually stir into venison mixture.  Cover and cook 15 minutes longer or until sauce is thickened.  Serve over noodles.

name: CATFISH STEW
ingredients:
6  slices bacon
3  medium potatoes, sliced thin
2  medium onions, sliced thin
1  c. tomatoes, chopped
1  lb. catfish fillets
salt and pepper to taste
1/4  tsp. crushed red peppers (optional)
preparation: Cut bacon in 1-inch square.  Place in pan and fry crisp. Remove from fire and layer potatoes, onions and fish.  Salt and pepper each layer.  Use enough water just to cover ingredients. Sprinkle red peppers over top and add cup of chopped tomatoes. Simmer until potatoes are done.

name: CHICKEN AND STUFFING
ingredients:
1  whole chicken, cooked and deboned
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. chicken broth
1/2  stick butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. onion powder
1/2  pt. sour cream
1  box Stove Top stuffing mix
preparation: Cook and debone chicken.  Mix stuffing direction from box with melted butter or margarine (reserve 1/3 dressing for the top).  Mix all ingredients together and put in greased casserole dish.  Cover with reserved dressing.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
3 1/2  sticks margarine
18  graham crackers, crushed
2  eggs
2  c. powdered sugar
8  bananas
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
8  oz. Cool Whip
chocolate syrup
pecans
maraschino cherries
preparation: Melt 2 sticks margarine and beat with eggs and sugar.  Beat for 20 minutes.  Melt 1 1/2 sticks margarine and stir with crushed graham crackers.  Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan for crust.  Drain pineapple and save juice.  Spread margarine, sugar and egg mixture on crust.  Spread pineapple on for next layer.  Split bananas lengthwise and dredge in pineapple juice for the next layer. Spread Cool Whip on top of bananas.  Drizzle chocolate syrup over Cool Whip.  Sprinkle with nuts and finish with maraschino cherries.  Freeze for at least 1 hour or cool for 2 to 4 hours.

name: MISSIONARIES' BERRY PIE
ingredients:
pastry for 2-crust pie
4  c. blackberries, washed and drained
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
3/4  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Line a 9-inch pie plate with a little more than half the pastry.  Lightly toss together the berries, cornstarch, sugar, salt and lemon juice.  Fill the lined pie plate. Roll out the remaining pastry and cut a few slits in the top. Cover the fruit, sealing the edges well.  For a glossy crust, brush with cream or beaten egg yolks.  Bake for 45 minutes or until brown.

name: YELLOW CAKE
ingredients:
5  eggs, separated
1/2  lb. margarine or butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  whole egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking powder
2  c. flour
sprinkles
preparation: Cream egg yolks, butter and sugar together.  Add one whole egg and vanilla; mix well.  Mix baking powder with flour and add slowly.  Beat egg whites in separate bowl until stiff.  Fold egg whites into batter with spoon.

name: BOOTLEGGERS BEANS
ingredients:
1 large  can baked beans
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
3  Tbsp. catsup
1  large onion, chopped
8  to 10 bacon strips
preparation: Put all ingredients in a large casserole.  Lay strips of raw bacon or cut into pieces on top.  Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to an hour.

name: FUDGE PIE
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
4  Tbsp. cocoa
3  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt oleo; add mixed dry ingredients.  Combine eggs and vanilla and add to dry ingredients.  Bake in a greased pie pan for 30 minutes at 350°.  Serve with ice cream.

name: CRAB SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. crab meat
1  chicken bouillon cube
1  c. boiling water
1/4  c. onion
1/4  c. butter, melted
1  qt. milk
3  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
chopped parsley, chives and paprika (optional)
preparation: Dissolve bouillon cube in water.  Saute onion in butter.  Blend in flour and seasonings.  Add milk and bouillon cube, gradually stirring constantly with whisk to keep from becoming lumpy.  Cook until thick, stirring constantly.  Add crab just to heat through.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
3  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  stick oleo (1/2 c.)
2 eggs, mixed with 1  c. milk
1  c. frozen berries
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients; cut in oleo.  Add eggs and milk mixture.  Fold in berries.  Bake at 350°, about 20 minutes.

name: GRITS-SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. grits (uncooked)
4  c. extra sharp cheese
2  lb. sausage, cooked and crumbled
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/8  tsp. garlic salt
4  eggs, beaten
preparation: Bring salted water to a boil.  Stir in grits.  Reduce heat and cook for 4 minutes.  Add cheese to grits, stirring until cheese is melted.  Combine eggs, milk, thyme and garlic.  Add some of the hot grits to egg mixture, stirring to blend.  Stir egg mixture into remaining grits.  Add cooked sausage.  Pour into a buttered 8 x 12-inch dish.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Remove 20 minutes before baking.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.  Serves 8.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1  c. Minute rice
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. water
chicken breasts
salt and pepper
preparation: Sprinkle rice into baking dish. Pour cream of chicken soup over rice. Add 1 cup water. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place chicken over 1/2 cream of chicken soup. Add rest of soup on top of chicken. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

name: DEBBIE'S SOUR CREAM BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. mashed very ripe bananas
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Cream margarine, sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Add dry ingredients, bananas, sour cream and nuts.  Mix well.  Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for about 60 minutes. Cake test with a toothpick.  The more ripe the bananas, the better the bread!

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  boneless chicken breasts, boiled and cut up
1  can enchilada sauce
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  pkg. tortilla chips, crushed
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  c. chicken broth
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients. Line 9 x 13 dish with 2/3 of crushed chips. Pour chicken mixture over chips. Sprinkle with cheese. Top with remaining chips. Pour chicken broth over entire casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: MUSHROOM SAUCE
ingredients:
2/3  stick butter
2 1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
1/4  c. Wondra flour
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. cream
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt butter over low heat in a frying pan.  Add mushrooms. Cover and saute 3 to 4 minutes.  Sprinkle flour over butter-mushroom mixture, stirring thoroughly to blend.  Add milk slowly.  Continue to stir.  Then add cream and salt and raise heat slighlty.  Cook until thickened, stirring to keep smooth.  Good to serve over meats, chicken or fish.

name: CREAMY FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 3/4 oz.)  can fruit cocktail, drained
2  bananas, peeled and sliced crosswise
1  small unpared apple, diced
1/2  c. seedless green grapes, halved
5  maraschino cherries, halved
1/4  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. whipping cream, whipped
strawberries
preparation: In large bowl, combine fruit cocktail, bananas, apples, grapes, cherries and marshmallows.  Fold in whipped cream; refrigerate.  Just before serving, garnish with strawberries. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: PEANUT BUTTER APPLE CRUMBLE
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. peanut butter
1/4  c. margarine
10  cooking apples
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. grated orange rind
4  Tbsp. orange juice
4  Tbsp. water
preparation: Measure flour and 1 cup of sugar into mixing bowl.  Cut in margarine and peanut butter until crumbs resemble coarse meal. Pare and slice apples.  Arrange in 2-quart casserole or shallow baking dish.  Sprinkle with the remaining sugar, orange rind, orange juice and water.  Cover with crumb mixture.  Bake at 350° until apples are tender, about 45 minutes.  Serve warm, topped with ice cream.  Makes 10 servings.

name: SAUSAGE QUICHE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) pie shell
1/2  lb. sausage
1  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1  small grated onion
1  Tbsp. flour
1 large  can Pet milk
2  eggs
parsley
preparation: Brown meat; drain.  Place in pie shell.  Sprinkle grated cheese, flour and onion on top.  Beat eggs and milk; pour over mixture in pie shell.  Sprinkle parsley on top; bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until set.

name: PEANUT BUTTER ICE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. chocolate cookie crumbs
1/4  melted butter
preparation: Mix above; pat into a 9-inch pie pan.  Place in refrigerator while making the filling.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3 1/2  lb. fryer, stewed until tender
broth from chicken
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix
preparation: Skin and bone chicken.  Cut into 1-inch strips.  Place in bottom of casserole dish.  Pour soup over chicken.  Mix one quart broth with stuffing mix and pour over chicken and soup.  Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: HEARTY BEEF AND POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. or 1/2 (30 oz.) bag frozen cottage fries
1  lb. ground beef
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
1  can Durkee French fried onions
1  medium tomato, chopped
1  can condensed cream of celery soup
1/2  c. milk
1  c. (4 oz) shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Place potatoes on bottom and up sides of 9 x 12-inch casserole.  Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 10 minutes.  Brown beef in large chunks; drain.  Place beef, broccoli, 1/2 can French fried onions and tomatoes in potato shell.  Combine soup, milk, 1/2 cup cheese and seasoning.  Pour over beef mixture.  Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onion.  Bake, uncovered, for 2 to 3 minutes longer.  Serves 6.

name: RAISIN SAUCE FOR BAKED HAM
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  c. apple cider
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  c. raisins
preparation: Measure cornstarch into saucepan.  Gradually stir in apple cider.  Add butter and raisins.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens.  Boil and stir one minute. Serve warm.  Makes 2 1/2 cups.

name: EGGPLANT FRITTERS
ingredients:
1  eggplant
1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  large egg
2  Tbsp. sugar
salt
preparation: Peel and cube eggplant.  Cook in boiling, salted water until tender; drain and mash.  Beat eggs; blend in flour, sugar, baking powder, eggplant and salt.  Drop by teaspoons in hot fat, turning to brown.

name: FUDGE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2 level  Tbsp. flour
3 level  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
1/2  stick butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all together.  Place in unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 350°.

name: MINT PUFFS
ingredients:
3  egg whites
1  c. sugar
1  c. mint chocolate chips
green food coloring
preparation: Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form.  Gradually add sugar, beating after each addition.  Add mint chocolate chips.  Add several drops of green food coloring.  Drop by spoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet.  Heat oven to 375° and turn off heat.  Put puffs into oven and leave overnight.

name: FRIED RICE
ingredients:
3  Slices of Bacon, cut into 1/4 inch pieces
2  Eggs
3  Green Onion, thinly sliced, including tops
2  Tbsp. Soy Sauce
2  Cups Instant Rice
preparation: Prepare 2 cups of instant rice.  In a bowl, beat eggs.  In a wok or wide frying pan, fry bacon until done.  Add onions and stir fry about one minute.  Add eggs; cook and stir until set.  Add rice and soy sauce; stir through.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  box strawberry jello
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1  can Milnot cream
2  pkg. graham crackers, rolled fine
1  stick butter, melted
pecans (optional)
1  c. boiling water
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drain and reserve juice and add water to equal 1 c.
preparation: Mix graham crackers and butter.  Press into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish (sides and bottom).  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Set aside to cool.  Mix jello with 1 cup boiling water; stir until dissolved, then add reserved juice and water mixture.  Set aside.

name: BRAIDED BREAD
ingredients:
3  pkg. dry yeast
3  c. water
1/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. oil
5 to 6  tsp. salt
5 to 6  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Combine water, yeast and 1 cup flour.  Set aside.  Combine sugar, oil and 2 cups flour along with salt.  Now add to original mixture.  Add remaining flour, 2 to 3 cups, enough to make dough elastic.  Knead.  Place in a greased bowl and turn so all sides are coated with oil.  Cover.  Let rise until double in size. Punch down.  Divide dough in thirds.

name: PORK CHOPS AND BROWNED RICE
ingredients:
6  pork chops
1  c. uncooked rice
1  medium onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  green bell pepper, chopped
2 bouillon cubes, dissolved in 2 1/2  c. hot water
preparation: Brown chops and set aside.  Pour rice into pan that chops were cooked in.  Cook, stirring constantly, until golden brown, about 10 minutes.  Add onion and pepper; cook until tender.  Add bouillon water; simmer over low heat until liquid is gone, about 20 to 25 minutes.  Lay chops on top for last 10 minutes.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, melted
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. dark Karo syrup
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. pecans
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs slightly.  Mix all ingredients.  Pour in two unbaked pie shells.  Cook for 35 to 40 minutes at 300°.

name: SPOON BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  c. cornmeal
1  Tbsp. butter
3  eggs, separated
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. soda
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Stir boiling water into cornmeal.  Stir in rest of ingredients except egg whites.  Beat egg whites to soft peak.  Then fold into mixture.  Pour in greased 2-quart casserole. Bake 45 to 50 minutes.  Makes 8 servings, 155 calories.

name: SPICY PRETZELS
ingredients:
2 15  oz. packages of pretzels
1  package powdered ranch
2  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  cup veg oil
preparation: Mix oil and spices and microwave for 1 minute.

name: FRENCH TOAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  loaf French bread
8  large eggs
3  c. milk
4  tsp. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. butter
cinnamon sugar
preparation: Butter bottom and sides of a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.  Cut bread into 1-inch thick slices; place in a single layer in baking dish.  Beat eggs, milk, salt, sugar and vanilla together; pour over bread.  Use most of egg mixture, but not all.  Cover with foil; leave in refrigerator overnight (4 to 36 hours).  Before baking, place small slice of butter on each slice of bread; sprinkle cinnamon sugar over top.  Pour left over egg mixture around sides.  Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. diced yellow squash
2  Tbsp. grated onion
2/3  c. grated carrots
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
2  c. prepared packaged stuffing
3  Tbsp. butter
slivered almonds (optional)
preparation: Cook squash in 1 1/2 cups water to which 3/4 teaspoon salt has been added, for about 10 minutes.  Drain and add next 4 ingredients and pepper to taste.  Butter a baking dish and put 1 cup stuffing in the bottom.  Add squash mixture.  Top with remaining stuffing and dot with butter.  Sprinkle with almonds, if desired.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BAMA CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  chicken, cleaned and cut into pieces
1  medium onion, chopped
1  clove garlic or 1/4 tsp. garlic powder
1/2  chopped bell pepper
salt and pepper to taste
2  c. water
1  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. Kitchen Bouquet browning and seasoning sauce
1/4  c. water
preparation: If gravy is desired, when almost tender, add about 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.  Mix flour, Kitchen Bouquet and 1/4 cup of water.  Slowly pour this mixture into boiling liquid, stirring constantly.  (If liquid is not boiling and mixture is not stirred in well, gravy will have lumps.)  When well mixed, lower fire and continue to simmer until chicken is tender.

name: SKINNY CHILI
ingredients:
1/2  lb. red bell pepper, stemmed, seeded and deribbed
1/2  lb. yellow onions, peeled and cut into 2-inch chunks
2  cloves garlic, smashed and peeled
2  c. canned Italian tomatoes with liquid
1  lb. lean ground beef
2  tsp. ground cumin
2  tsp. oregano
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. hot red pepper sauce
1/2  tsp. kosher salt (optional)
2  tsp. cider vinegar
fresh ground black pepper to taste
preparation: Finely chop pepper, onion and garlic in the food processor. Scrape into a 13 x 10 x 2-inch oval dish and stir in tomatoes, breaking up any whole tomatoes.  Cover tightly with microwave plastic wrap.  Cook at 100% for 9 minutes in a 650 to 700-watt oven. Prick plastic to release steam.

name: OLD-FASHIONED PANCAKES/WAFFLES
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. milk
1 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Spray waffle or pancake pan.  Makes 3 large waffles and more pancakes, about 6.  No need for box mix. Pancakes ready to turn when bubbles all over.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. cottage cheese
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange-pineapple jello
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained well
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Mix all together.  Refrigerate.  Ready in about 1 hour.

name: ZUCCHINI-SUMMER SQUASH APPETIZER OR VEGETABLE DISH
ingredients:
zucchini and summer squash, sliced
garlic salt
sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Slice the zucchini and summer squash.  Boil until just tender; drain.  Sprinkle with garlic salt.  Let stand 1/2 hour.  Top with sharp Cheddar cheese.  Wrap in aluminum foil and place on outdoor grill until cheese melts.

name: CUCUMBERS IN SOUR CREAM
ingredients:
3  large cucumbers
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
3  Tbsp. minced fresh chives
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Peel cucumbers, if desired, and slice thinly.  Set aside. Combine remaining ingredients and stir well.  Stir cucumbers into sour cream mixture.  Cover and chill.  Serves 6.

name: MARINATED PINEAPPLE
ingredients:
2  lb. cans unsweetened pineapple chunks
4  Tbsp. white vinegar
4  Tbsp. sugar
3  to 4 cinnamon sticks
18  cloves
preparation: Drain pineapple and reserve liquid.  Simmer in a large saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes 1 cup of pineapple juice, vinegar, sugar, cinnamon sticks and cloves.   Add drained pineapple chunks and continue heating 5 minutes.  Refrigerate for 3 to 4 days.  Serve in a clear glass bowl, with frilly toothpicks.

name: DOUBLE PIE CRUST
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. shortening
5  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: 1.  To keep pie bottom from getting mushy, brush the unbaked bottom crust of your pie with well beaten egg whites.

name: UPSIDE-DOWN PIZZA
ingredients:
1/2 to 3/4  lb. Italian sausage
8  oz. tomato sauce
1/2  lb. cheese (Mozzarella or Monterey Jack)
1  c. Bisquick
1  c. milk
1  or 2 eggs
1  onion
preparation: Brown sausage with onion.  Layer in baking dish: browned meat, tomato sauce and cheese.  Mix Bisquick, milk and eggs.  Pour over top of layered mixture.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Top will brown.

name: ROTISSERI KUMBAK SAUCE
ingredients:
2  garlic cloves, chopped fine
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. chili sauce
1/4  c. ketchup
1/2  c. oil
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. black pepper
dash of paprika and red pepper
juice of grated onion
2  Tbsp. grated onion
preparation: Put all ingredients in a quart jar and shake. Keep in the refrigerator. Delicious salad dressing. Very good for boiled shrimp.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  can crushed pineapple
1 medium  pkg. coconut
2  sticks butter
1  c. pecans
1  box Duncan Hines butter recipe golden cake mix
preparation: Pour cherries in bottom of pan, then drain pineapple.  Pour on top of the cherries and pineapple.  Melt 2 sticks butter; pour on, then add coconut and pecans.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: CALICO DIP
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
4  Tbsp. green onions
4  Tbsp. diced cucumber
4  Tbsp. diced radishes
4  Tbsp. diced green pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.

name: BLUEBERRY LUSH
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. grape gelatin
1 small  pkg. strawberry gelatin
2  c. hot water
1  can blueberries with syrup
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
8  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. sour cream
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients and let cool about 15 minutes. Add blueberries with syrup and pineapple.  Let gel completely.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2 1/2  c. chicken stock
1  can mushroom soup
2  c. cooked chicken, diced
1  box Stove Top stuffing
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. egg noodles
preparation: Melt butter.  Blend in flour and seasonings.  Add chicken stock.  Cook, stirring until thickened.  Stir in mushroom soup, chicken and stuffing.  Cook egg noodles according to directions on package.  Drain.  Combine noodles with chicken mixture.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: ALBERTA (B) KETCHUP
ingredients:
1  peck tomatoes
3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. allspice
1  pt. white vinegar
3  Tbsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Cook and drain tomatoes overnight.  Cook tomatoes and rest of ingredients together for 1 hour.  Put into jars and seal.  Good for baked beans and Sloppy Joes.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup
1  c. Hellmann's Real mayonnaise
1  can water chestnuts, chopped
2  c. sour cream
1  pkg. frozen spinach, chopped, thawed and squeezed dry
preparation: Mix Knorr vegetable soup, sour cream and mayonnaise.  Add the frozen spinach but make sure it is drained well.  Mix.  Then add water chestnuts and mix.  Let set for 2 hours.  Serve with Hawaiian bread or pumpernickel bread.

name: ROCKY ROAD FUDGE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. brownie mix (plus ingredients to make them)
1  c. chopped peanuts
3  c. mini marshmallows
1  bag semi sweet chocolate morsels
preparation: Prepare brownie mix according to package directions.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

name: CABBAGE SLAW
ingredients:
1  head finely chopped cabbage
1  c. finely chopped celery
1/2  c. sweet onion, chopped
1  chopped mango
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. white vinegar
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. mustard seed
preparation: Mix sugar, vinegar, and spices together. Pour over vegetables. Let stand 12-24 hours before serving. Will keep in refrigerator for 5-7 days. A good "prepare ahead" when expecting company.

name: RUSSIAN TEA (NON-ALCOHOLIC DRINK)
ingredients:
1  c. dry unsweetened instant tea
1 (10 cent)  pkg. lemonade mix
1  tsp. cloves
1 large  jar Tang (2 c.)
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix thoroughly and store in airtight container.  (Will keep indefinitely.)  Use 2 teaspoons Russian tea to 1 cup boiling water.  May be served hot or chilled.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
4  or 5 large fresh peaches
1/2  c. water
preparation: Melt butter in baking dish.  Mix flour, baking powder, 1 cup sugar and milk; pour into the baking dish.  Peel and slice peaches; arrange over batter.  Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup sugar over peaches.  Pour water over peaches.  Bake in preheated 350° oven for 50 minutes.

name: PINE NUT, RICE AND FETA SALAD
ingredients:
1  (7 oz.) long grain and wild rice mix, cooked
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. crumbled Feta cheese
1  large red pepper, chopped
1/2  c. red onion, chopped
2/3  c. pine nuts, toasted
1/3  c. olive oil
2  Tbsp. tarragon wine vinegar
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Stir together 5 ingredients in a bowl.  Stir together oil, vinegar and pepper.  Add to rice mixture, tossing to coat.  Chill 4 to 24 hours.  Serve on lettuce leaves.

name: BEAU MONDE VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise (Hellmann's)
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
2  Tbsp. onion flakes
2  Tbsp. dill weed
2  Tbsp. Beau Monde seasoning
preparation: Mix together ingredients.   Chill at least 2 to 3 hours.

name: BACON TOMATO CUPS
ingredients:
8  slices bacon, crisply cooked
1  medium tomato, seeded
1  small onion, chopped
3/4  c. swiss cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. basil
1  can (10 oz.) refrigerated biscuits
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Chop bacon, tomato, onion and grated cheese.  Mix all ingredients except biscuits.  Separate each biscuit into 3 thinner biscuits.  Lay each biscuit over a mini muffin pan cup.  Press biscuit into cup. Fill cups with bacon mixture and bake 10 - 12 minutes until golden brown.  Yields 30.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
2  c. oven baked sweet potatoes, mashed
1  c. half and half
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. light brown sugar
2  Tbsp. melted corn oil margarine
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1  unbaked pie shell (9-inch)
preparation: Beat together all filling ingredients, adding eggs last, until smooth.  Pour in pastry shell.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake for approximately 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

name: BLACK MAGIC
ingredients:
16  oz. Hydrox or Oreo cookies, crushed fine
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream, softened
1 small  can evaporated milk
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
2  semi-sweet chocolate sq.
whipped cream (optional)
preparation: Mix crushed cookies with melted margarine.  Spread on bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze.  Soften ice cream and spread on top of frozen cookies.  Refreeze.  Mix together evaporated milk, margarine, sugar and chocolate.  Boil for 10 minutes, stirring constantly.  Cool.  Put on top of ice cream. Return to freeze.  May be served with whipped cream.

name: TOMATO JAM
ingredients:
4 1/2  lb. ripe tomatoes
4 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. broken cinnamon
1 1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cloves
preparation: Scald and peel tomatoes, then quarter them.  Place in pan and add sugar, vinegar and spices. Cook slowly until thickened and put in jars.

name: HOMEMADE SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs, beaten
4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Combine flour, salt and baking powder in bowl and set aside. In a separate bowl, blend margarine, 1 cup sugar and vanilla.  Add remaining sugar and eggs and mix well, while slowly pouring in flour mixture.  Chill thoroughly.  Roll dough to 1/8 to 1/4-inch thickness on a well floured surface and cut out with cookie cutters.  Place cookies on greased cookie sheets and bake 8 to 10 minutes in preheated 400° oven.  Let cookies cool before decorating.

name: SUMMER VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Good Seasons Italian salad dressing
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
raw vegetables (tomatoes, onions, peppers, carrots, cauliflower, etc.)
preparation: Mix oil, vinegar, sugar and dressing.  Shake in a jar.  Pour over vegetables; let marinate at least 1 hour before serving.

name: Molded Vegetable Salad
ingredients:
1  (3 oz.) lemon or lime Jell-O
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. boiling water
3/4  c. cold water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  tsp. grated onion
1/2  c. finely chopped cabbage
1/2  c. grated carrot
1/4  c. chopped celery
3  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
preparation: Dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water.  Add cold water, vinegar and onion.  Chill until firm.  Fold in vegetables.  Chill.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
1 (8 qt. size)  box nonfat dry milk
1  box plus 1 c. powdered sugar
1  c. cocoa
2  c. nonfat creamer or Coffee-mate
preparation: Sift  all  together.  Store  in closed jar.  Add 2 to 3 teaspoons  to  hot  cup  of  water.  Add  water last.  Put big marshmallow on top of mixture.  Store in refrigerator.

name: CHILI ELEGANTE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. red chili beans or 1 can kidney beans
1  large onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1  lb. ground beef
3  Tbsp. fat
2  cans tomatoes
1 to 2  Tbsp. chili powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3  whole cloves
1  bay leaf
dash of paprika
dash of cayenne pepper
1/4  c. dry sherry
preparation: Soak dry chili beans overnight. Cook in boiling, salted water until tender. Drain.  Brown onion, green pepper and meat in hot fat. Add tomatoes, seasonings and dry sherry.  Simmer 2 hours. Add water, if necessary. Add beans and heat thoroughly. Freezes well. Serves 6.

name: CHESS PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/4  c. sugar
just over 1/2 stick melted butter
1  tsp. plain flour
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
4 or 5  drops almond flavoring
preparation: Beat eggs and add sugar. Stir well.  Add melted butter, flour, milk, vanilla and almond flavoring.  Mix well.  Pour into unbaked pie crust.  Cook 25 minutes at 325° or until golden brown.

name: BEST EVER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. margarine
1  c. salad oil
2  beaten eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
5  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream together the sugars and margarine.  Combine with remaining ingredients and mix well.  Roll in balls the size of a small walnut.  Place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Press with the bottom of a glass, dipped in sugar.  Sprinkle sugar generously on top of each cookie.  Bake at 350° about 10 minutes. Makes 100 cookies.

name: COFFEE BREEZE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. cold coffee
2  c. whipping cream
preparation: In heavy saucepan, combine sugar and milk.  Bring to a boil, stirring, until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat.   Let stand until cool. Combine milk mixture, coffee, vanilla and 1 cup whipping cream. Pour mixture into loaf pan. Freeze until slush, about 1 to 2 hours.  Beat cream until stiff. Stir slush mixture. Spoon into dessert dishes. Top with whipped cream.  Makes 12 (1/2 cup) servings.

name: JAM CAKE
ingredients:
2  c.sugar
1  c. butter
1  c. buttermilk
4  eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda, dissolved in milk
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. raisins
1  c. pecans
1  c. jam (blackberry)
1  c. preserves
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix well and bake at 325° for 45 minutes.  Makes 3 layers.

name: NO-RISE ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
2  c. warm water
1/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
4  c. self-rising flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Add sugar and salt.  Mix oil and slightly beaten egg into the yeast mixture.  Add flour last. Mix together, using low speed on mixer.  Place in tightly covered container and store in refrigerator.

name: HAMBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  small onion
1  pkg. crescent rolls
1 small  pkg. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Take crescent rolls and pat them in a round cake pan, up around sides to resemble pie crust, then brown hamburger and onion; drain.  Return to stove and put half of the Velveeta cheese with hamburger until blended completely.  Put in the crescent roll pie crust and slice the remainder of the cheese on top.  Put in a 350° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until crust is brown.

name: LEMON SUPREME CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines lemon cake mix
1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. apricot nectar
1/2  c. Crisco oil
preparation: Blend  all ingredients in a large bowl.  Beat at medium speed for  2 minutes.  Spread batter in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Bake for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: HONEY STEAK
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. crystallized honey or honey
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. prepared mustard
2  steaks (beef, your choice of cut)
preparation: Mix together first three ingredients.  Adjust amounts to taste.  Brush on steaks as they are grilled.

name: SWEETHEART FUDGE PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
3/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
3  eggs
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels, melted
2  tsp. instant coffee granules
1  tsp. rum extract
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. coarsely chopped walnuts
1  unbaked 9-inch pastry shell
whipped cream (optional)
walnuts (optional)
preparation: Cream the butter. Gradually add brown sugar, beating at medium speed until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add melted chocolate, coffee granules and rum extract; mix well.  Stir in flour and 1 cup chopped walnuts.  Pour mixture into pastry shell. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes; cool completely.  Chill. Garnish with whipped cream and walnuts, if desired.

name: NO-CRUST CHEESE AND SPINACH PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. Ricotta cheese
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. fresh spinach, cooked and drained (squeeze out excess water) or 2 pkg. frozen spinach
1  c. grated cheese (Mozzarella or Cheddar)
3  eggs, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. oil
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. onion salt or dill or garlic salt
1/2  c. zucchini (optional)
1/2  green pepper (optional)
1/2  lb. mushrooms, sautéed (optional)
preparation: Combine Ricotta cheese, drained spinach, grated cheese, eggs, oil, seasonings and vegetables.  Pour mixture into deep pie plate or a 9 x 9 x 2-inch lightly oiled casserole dish.  Bake in preheated 350° oven about 40 minutes.  Butter may be dotted on top of casserole.  Pie can be eaten hot or cold, served as a brunch, luncheon entree or an appetizer.

name: BAKED CRISPY CHICKEN
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3  lb. fryer chicken
1/3  c. Pet milk
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. corn flake crumbs
1  tsp. Accent
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Cut chicken in pieces.  Dip in 1/2 cup Pet milk.  Roll in mixture of corn flakes, Accent, salt and pepper.  Place chicken in shallow baking pan lined with Reynolds Wrap.  Bake in 350° oven about 1 hour or until drumsticks are tender when pierced with fork.

name: KENTUCKY FRIED CORN
ingredients:
5  ears fresh corn, cut off cob
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. water
3  Tbsp. bacon grease
preparation: Combine all ingredients except bacon grease.  Stir to blend. Melt grease in large frying pan.  Add corn mixture and simmer on low heat for 40 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Crisco
2  sticks margarine (not whipped type or light)
1  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring (more if use imitation)
5  eggs
3  c. sugar
3  c. plain flour, sifted (White Lily or Pillsbury)
1/3  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/3  c. milk
preparation: Let margarine soften and eggs get to near room temperature. Sift dry ingredients together.  Cream Crisco, margarine and flavoring together.  Add sugar and eggs alternately.  Add dry ingredients alternately with milk.  Start in a cold oven.  Bake in 9 or 10-inch tube pan at 325° for 80 minutes (1 hour and 20 minutes).  Turn out and upright on a cooling rack or towel to cool. Do not cut until completely cool; flavor seems to evaporate otherwise.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE II
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white Karo
2  Tbsp. water
1  c. raw peanuts
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Cook first 4 ingredients on medium high heat until the color changes to caramel.  Remove from heat and add soda; the candy will foam.  Quickly pour onto a butter sheet of foil.  Let cool then break into pieces.

name: DILLY BACON CORN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. unbleached flour
1  c. cornmeal
1/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
8  slices bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
2  tsp. dried dill
1  c. milk
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  egg
preparation: In a large bowl, combine flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, salt, bacon and dill.  In another bowl, combine milk, oil and egg.  Stir the liquid ingredients into dry.  Mix just until moistened.  Spoon batter into greased pans and bake at 425° until tester comes out clean.  Cool in pans for 10 minutes.  Serve hot.

name: STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  lb. medium mushrooms
8  slices cooked bacon, crumbled
1  small onion, chopped fine
1/4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Stem mushrooms; arrange on baking dish.  Combine all other ingredients and fill mushrooms.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, then set oven to broil for 2 minutes.  Serve them hot with mustard.

name: SWEET AND SOUR MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  egg
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped
pepper to taste
1  Tbsp. oil
1  c. pineapple juice
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. vinegar
6  Tbsp. water
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients; form into 18 meat balls.  Brown in oil and drain.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground round steak
1 1/2  c. bread crumbs
3/4  c. ketchup
1/2  c. warm water
1  tsp. Accent
1  pkg. onion soup mix
preparation: Combine all ingredients and put in loaf pan.  Cover with 2 strips bacon.  Pour over all one 8 ounce can tomato sauce.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: MERINGUE TARTS
ingredients:
4  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
1  c. Gold Medal flour
1  tsp. baking powder
4  Tbsp. heavy cream
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. sugar
preparation: Beat egg whites, cream of tartar and 1 cup sugar until very stiff.  Cream butter and 3/4 cup sugar until fluffy.  Add egg yolks.  Add flour and baking powder alternately with the cream. (Use 2 round pans.)  Divide the butter mixture and spread out in pans.  Top, divided egg mixture so cake is completely covered. Bake in slow oven so meringue does not get too brown, 40 minutes. (Try sides to test doneness.)  Put fresh strawberries and whipped cream between layers.

name: STEVE'S APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. hot applesauce, with 1 tsp. soda in it
1  stick butter
1  c. sugar
1  egg
2  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Combine applesauce, butter, sugar and egg.  Add sifted mixture of flour, salt, cinnamon, allspice, ginger, cloves and nutmeg. Add raisins and nuts.  Mix and bake in tube or loaf pan at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CREAM CHEESE BRIDGE SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1/4  tsp. onion salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix cream cheese with enough mayonnaise to soften.  Combine all ingredients and spread on small squares or bridge cut-outs of pumpernickel bread.

name: KATHRYN STURTZ'S FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup (not cream soup)
1 1/4  oz. catsup
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped fine
1  Tbsp. celery seed
3  c. sugar (approximately)
3/8  c. salad oil
3/4  c. vinegar
preparation: Mix well in mixer.  Makes 1 quart.  Keeps well in refrigerator.

name: EASY-DOES-IT PICKLES
ingredients:
7  c. thin cucumber slices
1  c. green pepper, sliced thin
1  c. onion, sliced thin
1  c. vinegar
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. celery seed
preparation: Mix vinegar, sugar and salt and stir until sugar is dissolved. Add cucumbers, peppers, onion and celery seed and put into containers.  Refrigerate for at least 1 day.

name: JUANITA'S DROP BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
4  Tbsp. shortening
1  c. buttermilk
1  stick butter or margarine
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together twice.  Using two knives, cut shortening into flour mixture until well mixed.  Add buttermilk; stir well.  Drop level tablespoonfuls of dough onto greased cookie sheet.  Place a pat of butter on each biscuit.  Bake 10 minutes at 425°.  Yields 26 biscuits.

name: CHICKEN PIZZA MEXICANA
ingredients:
2  c. shredded taco-seasoned cheese (8 oz.)
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. Italian bread shell or ready-to-serve pizza crust (12 to 14-inches in diameter)
1 1/2  c. chopped cooked chicken
2  Roma (plum) tomatoes, thinly sliced
1  small jalapeno chili, seeded and finely chopped
preparation: Gas grill. Sprinkle  cheese evenly over bread shell. Top with remaining ingredients. Cover and grill pizza 4 to 6-inches from medium heat 8 to 10 minutes or until crust is crisp and cheese is melted (if crust browns too quickly, place a piece of aluminum foil between crust and grill). Makes 4 servings.

name: TUNA, EGG AND MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
2 small  cans tuna
6  eggs
8  oz. macaroni
2 1/2 or 3  Tbsp. mustard
1/2  jar mayonnaise or salad dressing
salt
pepper
preparation: Cook macaroni; drain.  Drain tuna.  Hard boil the eggs.  Can add more mustard and mayonnaise.  Mix everything together.  Could be eaten warm but it is better if it sets overnight.  You could add other ingredients like onions, etc.

name: MARILYN'S HEAVENLY SALAD
ingredients:
2  big bags miniature marshmallows
2 big  cans crushed pineapple, drained
1  jar maraschino cherries, cut in small pieces
1  container Cool Whip
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Add a little cherry juice.

name: HAMBURGER-RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. bell pepper
1/2  c. onion
1  tsp. chili powder
16  oz. tomatoes
1/2  c. rice
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain.  Add bell pepper, onion, chili powder, tomatoes and rice.  Put in casserole dish.  Cook at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Spread cheese over top; put back in oven until cheese melts.  Serve.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1/3  c. dark brown sugar, firmly packed
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. strong brewed coffee
2 (16 oz.)  cans oven baked beans
1  large onion, thinly sliced
6  slices raw cut up bacon
preparation: In saucepan, mix brown sugar, vinegar, dry mustard, salt and coffee; simmer 5 minutes. In a 2-quart casserole, put layer of beans, sliced onion and half the mixture. Repeat. Top with bacon pieces. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bacon is cooked. Serves 8.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. crushed nacho chips
1  Tbsp. oil
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onions
1  can diced tomatoes
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1 small  can green chilies
1/4  c. chopped black olives
1  c. sour cream
1 1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar
preparation: Saute onions in oil until done.  Cook ground beef and add to it.  Stir in taco seasoning, tomatoes, olives and chilies.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread 1 cup nacho chips on bottom of dish.  Spoon meat mix, sprinkle cheese over, spread sour cream over and sprinkle remaining chips. Bake 25 minutes. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese atop. Bake 5 minutes more. Take it out of the oven and pig out.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  baked (9-inch) pie shell
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 1/2  c. water
3  Tbsp. ReaLemon (lemon juice from concentrate)
1  (4 serving size) strawberry gelatin
1  qt. fresh strawberries, cleaned, hulled and sliced (can leave some whole)
preparation: In medium saucepan, combine sugar and cornstarch.  Add the water and lemon juice.  Over high heat, bring to a boil.  Reduce heat.  Cook and stir until slightly thickened and clear (4 to 5 minutes).  Add gelatin.  Stir until dissolved.  Cool to room temperature.  Stir in strawberries.  Pour into baked shell. Chill 4 to 6  hours.  Serve with whipped cream.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  sweet potatoes, cooked
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2 to 1  c. sugar
1  c. butter
4  eggs
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. pecans (optional)
preparation: Beat potatoes until fluffy.  Add other ingredients.  Beat again.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with brown sugar and pecans.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. skim milk
2 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. dill weed
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. thyme
2  c. cooked green beans
2  c. cooked and sliced carrots
1  medium sliced zucchini
1/2  medium onion, thinly sliced
1 1/4  c. whole grain cereal flakes, crushed
preparation: Pour 1/2 milk in saucepan.  Add flour and seasonings and stir constantly to avoid lumps.  Slowly stir in rest of milk, 1/4 cup at a time.  Cook over medium heat until thickened, stirring constantly.  Layer vegetables in casserole dish with green beans on the bottom, then carrots, zucchini and onions on top.  Pour sauce over vegetables.  Sprinkle with crushed cereal.  Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI-CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
broccoli flowers (1 bunch)
1  head cauliflower
1  lb. bacon
1  red onion
8  oz. Mozzarella or Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  c. Miracle Whip (light)
1  tsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. vinegar
salt and pepper
preparation: Chop and tear broccoli and cauliflower into small pieces and put in big bowl.  Cook, drain and break bacon into small pieces; chop red onion.  Add bacon, onion and cheese to veggies and mix together.

name: CHOCOLATE MUNCHIN CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
2/3  c. coffee or water
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. chocolate flavored syrup
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan, stir together first 3 ingredients.  Add next 6 ingredients.  Stir with fork, scraping corners and sides of pan, until mixture is uniform.  Bake in 350° oven 30 to 35 minutes or until top springs back when touched lightly.

name: ISRAELI VEGETABLE STEW
ingredients:
1/2  c. olive oil
2  medium unpeeled eggplant, cut into 3/4-inch cubes
3  medium onions, chopped
3  cloves garlic
1  large green pepper, cut into thin strips
1 (28 oz.)  can crushed tomatoes
2  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. dry basil
1/2  c. fresh parsley
20  chopped green olives (stuffed with pimento)
salt
pepper
wide noodles or rice
preparation: Put olive oil in large, covered saucepan.  Cook eggplant and onions for about 25 minutes, until slightly browned.  Add garlic and green pepper; cook for 2 minutes.  Stir in tomatoes, sugar and basil; simmer gently for 15 minutes.  Add parsley, olives and pimento; simmer gently for a further 20 minutes.  Add salt and pepper to taste (take account of the salty olives and adjust seasonings accordingly).  Can be made a day in advance and reheated.  Serve over rice or noodles.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: BLACK AND WHITE BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  sticks butter, softened
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
pinch of salt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sifted flour
2  c. nuts (optional)
2  oz. unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
preparation: Cream butter.  Add sugar and vanilla and mix well.  Add eggs, one at a time, blending well after each addition.  Add salt and flour and mix well.  Divide batter in halves.  Add chocolate to one half and mix well.  Drop by teaspoonfuls, alternating batters, into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Swirl with a knife to marbleize.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Frost and top with nuts, if desired.  (Nuts may also be added to batter.)

name: MARGIE'S LEMON SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. butter, softened
1/4  c. powdered sugar
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix flour, butter and powdered sugar together; press this mixture into a small baking pan.  Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.  Mix remaining ingredients and pour into hot crust; bake again at 350° for about 25 minutes.  Sprinkle on top with powdered sugar and serve.

name: TURKEY MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. catsup
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. salt (optional)
1  Tbsp. onion, chopped
1/2  c. cracker crumbs or several pieces bread, torn
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Combine turkey with next 6 ingredients.  Form into meatballs; roll in flour.  Brown in a skillet with a small amount of vegetable oil or margarine.  Press the meatballs flat as they brown.  Place into small casserole (1 1/2 or 2 quart).  Cover with undiluted soup.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.  Serve with rice and a vegetable.

name: JAPANESE CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken wings
1  beaten egg
flour
oil
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. water
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cut off pointed end of wings. Dip in egg and flour and brown in oil. In saucepan, simmer next 5 ingredients for 2 minutes. Put browned wings in glass baking dish and pour sauce over wings. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Spooning sauce over wings while they bake. Best when baked long enough where sauce turns thick.

name: FUDGE NUT BARS
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  c. butter
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2 1/2  c. flour
3  c. oatmeal
1 large  pkg. chocolate chips
1  can condensed milk
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In double boiler, mix chocolate chips, milk, butter and salt. Stir until mixture is smooth.  Add nuts and vanilla.   Spread about 2/3 of oatmeal mixture in pan.  Cover with chocolate.  Dot with remaining oatmeal and swirl into chocolate mixture.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: GRANDMA CHASTEEN'S DATE PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  lb. dates
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
3  c. water
3/4  c. tapioca
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Cook all except nuts for 20 minutes.  Add nuts.  Pour into serving dish.  Cool.  Serve with whipped topping.

name: CHICKEN PIZZA
ingredients:
1  (14 inch) prepared pizza crust
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  tsp. dried sage
2  Tbsp. chopped pimiento
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
2  c. cooked, chopped chicken
1/3  c. chopped celery
1  c. grated American cheese
preparation: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Brush the pizza crust with oil.  Combine the sage, pimiento, soup, chicken and celery.  Mix well.  Spread over the crust. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake about 20 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.

name: QUICHE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped almonds
1/2  lb. Swiss cheese, grated
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  lb. bacon, crisp and chopped
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. cream
salt and pepper
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
preparation: Put onion, almonds, Swiss cheese, butter, flour and bacon in pie shell.  Mix eggs and cream together and pour in pie shell. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes and then at 325° for 25 minutes more.

name: BEEF PARMIGIANA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak, 3/8 inches thick
1  egg, beaten
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/3  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1/3  c. wesson oil
1  med onion, minced
1 - 6  oz. can tomato paste
2  c. hot water
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. powdered marjoram
1/2  lb. mozzarella cheese (or process cheese slices)
preparation: Place meat between pieces of wax paper larger than the meat and lay on a board; pound meat thin (about 1/4 inch) with a heavy skillet or rolling pin trim off gristle and excess fat.  Cut into 5 or 8 pieces.  Dip meat in egg; roll in mixture of Parmesan cheese and crumbs.  Heat oil in large skillet; brown steak on both sides over medium heat until golden brown.  Lay in shallow, wide baking dish.  In same skillet cook onion over low heat until soft; stir in salt, pepper, sugar, marjoram and tomato paste, gradually add hot water, stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes scraping browned bits from pan; pour most of the sauce over meat.  Top with slices of mozzarella cheese and remaining sauce.  Bake in moderate oven 350° for about 1 hour or until meat is tender.  Makes 4 - 6 servings.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. plain cornbread mix
1  pkg. Mexican cornbread mix
1  lb. ground meat
1/2  onion, chopped
1  can whole corn, drained
1  pkg. cheese
preparation: Brown meat and onion; drain excess fat and set aside.  Combine cornbread mixes together according to directions on box. Additionally, add 1/3 cup milk and can of corn to the cornbread mixes.  Using a nonstick spray, prepare a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour a small amount of cornbread batter in pan to form a layer. Sprinkle meat mixture on top and then sprinkle grated cheese on top of the meat.  Pour remaining cornbread mix on top of all and bake according to box directions.

name: BEEF POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  lean chuck roast, fat removed
potatoes, peeled (as many as desired)
carrots, peeled (as many as desired)
at least 4 onions, peeled
1  can beef consomme
1  can French onion soup
1  can mushroom soup
1  can water
steak salt and pepper to taste
a couple squirts Worcestershire sauce
cornstarch and water (to thicken gravy)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Peel and wash vegetables.  Trim fat from roast.  Wash roast and place in roasting pan.  Arrange vegetables around roast, placing an onion in each corner. Sprinkle roast with seasoning and Worcestershire sauce.  Pour soups over roast and rinse cans with one can of water, also pouring water over roast.  Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake for approximately 3 1/2 hours or until a knife can be easily inserted in roast and vegetables.  Using a slotted spoon, remove roast and cover it with foil as it will dry out quickly.  Spoon vegetables into a serving bowl.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE WITH ONIONS
ingredients:
8  medium potatoes
salt and pepper to taste
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. parsley
1  medium sweet Vidalia onion
1 small  can Durkee French fried onion rings
preparation: Cook potatoes and mash.  Add salt and pepper and cream cheese; beat.  Add eggs, flour, parsley and onions; mix well.  Put in 2-quart buttered dish.  Sprinkle onion rings and bake, uncovered, at 325° about 30 minutes.

name: GREEK POTATO "FRIES"
ingredients:
2  medium-sized baking potatoes
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1  tsp. dried oregano
1/2  tsp. pepper
cooking spray
2  Tbsp. malt vinegar
preparation: Clean potatoes. Cut lengthwise into 8 wedges. Place into a bowl of ice water for 30 minutes. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Toss potatoes with oil. Place on oiled baking sheet, skin side down. Sprinkle oregano and pepper over potatoes.

name: SOUTH OF THE BORDER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken breasts, boiled and shredded from bone
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 small  can diced green peppers or equivalent
1  can taco sauce or salsa (6 oz.)
1  medium onion (she doesn't use)
1  pkg. Monterey Jack cheese
1  pkg. corn tortillas
preparation: Combine all of above except cheese and tortillas.  Butter casserole dish.  Tear tortillas in 8ths and layer with chicken mixture and cheese.  Repeat 3 times.  Bake at 350°, uncovered, 1 hour.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans pineapple chunks
1 large  can mandarin oranges
3  bananas
1 large  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
preparation: Drain pineapple and mandarin oranges to make 2 cups of juice. Can use a little orange juice, if not enough juices.  Make pudding according to package, but use juices in place of milk.  Stir.  Add pineapple and oranges.  Stir again.  Refrigerate for 1 hour or more.  Add bananas in and stir before serving.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. unsifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/4  c. granulated sugar
3/4  c. firmly packed light brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pkg. Jell-O vanilla flavor instant pudding and pie filling (or Royal pudding)
2  eggs
1/2  pkg. (1 c.) mini chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix flour with baking soda.  Combine butter, the sugars, vanilla and pudding mix in large mixer bowl, beat until smooth and creamy.  Beat in eggs.  Gradually add flour mixture; then stir in chips and nuts (batter will be stiff).  Drop by rounded measuring teaspoonfuls, about 2 inches apart, onto ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Makes about 7 dozen cookies.

name: POTATO TRASH
ingredients:
Red Potatoes
Sour Cream
Crisp Fried Bacon
1  Stick of Butter, sliced
Shredded American or Cheddar Cheese
preparation: Boil desired number of unpeeled potatoes in water to cover, until tender.  Drain and cut into quarters.  Arrange in 9x13 baking dish.  Add butter, dollops of sour cream, shredded cheese and bacon.

name: CHICKEN AND BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. chopped, cooked chicken
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. milk
shredded Cheddar cheese
1 or 2  cans biscuits
preparation: Combine chicken, soup, sour cream and milk in a bowl; mix well.  Spoon into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Top with cheese and biscuits.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Yields 5 to 6 servings.

name: SWEET AND SOUR MEATBALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  eggs
2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  Tbsp. instant minced onion
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2/3  c. pineapple tidbits
4  Tbsp. oil
1  c. pineapple juice
2  c. water
2  pkg. sweet and sour mix
1  c. green peppers, cut in strips
preparation: Mix together beef, egg, salt, pepper, onion and cornstarch. Shape into marble size balls.  Drain pineapple, reserving juice. Heat oil in skillet; brown meatballs.  Remove balls from skillet; wipe skillet clean of all drippings.  Combine pineapple juice, water and sauce mix in skillet, stirring constantly until thickened.  Add tidbits, green pepper and meatballs.  Cook for 5 minutes.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: FRIED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients: 5  medium sweet potatoes
preparation: Boil potatoes with skins on until done.  Let cool, peel and slice about 1/2-inch thick.  Fry in butter until brown.   Remove from skillet and sprinkle with sugar and serve while hot.

name: BRITT'S LAMMIN' GOOD CHILI(Pressure Cooker Chili)
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. ground round steak
2  large onions, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (8 oz.)  can water
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. oregano
