2  cloves garlic, finely chopped
1  tsp. salt
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
preparation: Heat pressure  cooker  and brown meat, onions and green pepper.   Add  remaining  ingredients,  except  kidney  beans. Close cover  securely.  Place pressure regulator on vent pipe. Cook 5 minutes.  Turn  off burner and let pressure drop of its own accord.  Remove  lid, add beans and heat through.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. chopped raw apples
1 1/3  c. Mazola oil
1/8  c. milk
2  c. sugar
3  eggs, well beaten
2 1/2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Peel apples and chop; set aside.  Pour Mazola oil into large mixing bowl; add sugar.  Mix.  Add milk, eggs and vanilla; beat well.  Sift flour with salt, soda and baking powder.  Save back enough flour mixture to coat apples and pecans.  Gradually add flour to creamed mixture.  Gently fold in chopped apples and pecans.

name: RECIPE FOR LIFE
ingredients:
1  c. Good Thoughts
3  c. Forgiveness
2  c. Well Beaten Faults
4  c. Prayer and Thoughts
2  c. Kind Deeds
1  c. Consideration for Others
preparation: Mix thoroughly.  Add Tears of Joy, Sorrow and Sympathy for Others.  Fold in cups of Prayer and Faith to lighten other ingredients and raise the texture to great heights of living. After pouring all this into your family, bake well with the heat of Human Kindness.  Serve everyone with a smile.

name: BUTTER PECAN CREAM CHEESE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  c. butter (soft)
2/3  c. brown sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Blend flour, brown sugar and butter until crumbly.  Stir in pecans.  Press mixture into a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: GRANDMOTHER'S CHRISTMAS CHOW MEIN CANDY
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. chocolate morsels
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch morsels
1 to 2  cans chow mein noodles
1  c. chopped coconut *
1  c. chopped pecans *
preparation: *These quantities may vary according to taste.

name: SUNDAY CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. meal
2  eggs
8  oz. sour cream
1  onion, chopped
8  oz. corn, drained
1/2  c. Crisco
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until good and brown.

name: STUFFED POTATOES
ingredients:
seasoning salt
potatoes
sour cream
salt and pepper
grated cheese
preparation: Bake potatoes and let sit and cool.  Cut lengthwise and hollow out with a spoon.   Set shells aside.

name: SPANISH ROLLS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. vinegar
6  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1  c. onion, chopped
1  can tomato sauce
1  lb. Tillamook cheese, grated
1/4  c. olive oil
1  c. olives, chopped
1  clove minced garlic
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped Ortega chilies
salt to taste
2  doz. small French rolls
preparation: Mix all ingredients. Hollow out French rolls and fill with mixture. Individually wrap rolls in wax paper.  Heat in 250° oven for 45 to 60 minutes.

name: MAGLOUBEH
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken or lamb
1  lb. rice
2  large eggplant
1  head cauliflower
a few potatoes, sliced thin (optional)
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  tsp. bahar (Middle Eastern spice)
preparation: Soak the rice for 1 hour in warm water.  Cook the meat in water.  Remove the meat and add a little butter or margarine in the water.  Put this water left over with the rice.  Fry the eggplant and cauliflower with cooking oil.  In a large pot, put the meat in the bottom, then the eggplant and cauliflower, then the rice and water from meat on top.  Cover pot and cook to a boil until the water begins to dry (about 15 to 20 minutes).  Turn heat down to low until it is all dry.  Turn heat off and let set for 20 to 30 minutes.  Turn upside down on a platter.  Serves a lot.  Serve with yogurt or salad.

name: SPICED TEA
ingredients:
1 1/2  qt. boiling water
1  c. sugar
2  c. apple juice
3  c. pineapple juice
juice of 2 lemons (approximately 4 Tbsp.)
juice of 3 oranges (approximately 1 c.)
1  tsp. whole cloves
3 to 4  sticks cinnamon
3  tea bags
preparation: Combine all ingredients in saucepan.  Simmer 15 minutes. Remove tea bags, strain and serve hot.  Makes 3 quarts.

name: GRAPE-NUT PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. Grape-Nuts
1  qt. milk
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
small piece of butter
preparation: Cook Grape-Nuts and milk in a double boiler for 15 minutes. In a baking dish, combine the sugar, eggs and butter.  Beat together.  Pour in hot Grape-Nut and milk mixture.  Stir until blended.  Add vanilla.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: WACKY CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. vinegar
3/4  c. cooking oil
2  c. cold water
preparation: Into an ungreased pan, sift the flour, sugar, soda and cocoa. Make 3 holes in the dry ingredients.  Mix together the vanilla, vinegar and oil.  Pour this into the holes in equal amounts.  Over the whole thing, pour cold water.  Stir until well mixed.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  When cool, cut into squares and serve.

name: EGG NOODLES
ingredients:
3  eggs
4  tsp. baking powder
2  c. flour
dab of salt
preparation: Beat together the eggs, salt and baking powder.  Then add flour slowly until done.  If too thick, add one more egg.

name: "ZERO" HERB DRESSING
ingredients:
3/4  c. tomato or V-8 (6 oz. can)
1/4  c. red wine or sherry vinegar
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  Tbsp. chopped chives or scallions
1  clove garlic, crushed
1/2  tsp. salt
pinch of dried savory or oregano
pinch of sugar
pinch of cayenne
fresh ground pepper
preparation: In a bowl, whisk all ingredients until well blended. Alternately combine all ingredients in a jar; secure lid and shake until well blended. Remove garlic before serving. Makes 1 cup fat-free dressing. Great for all tossed salads/veggies!

name: POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  (3 to 5 lb) English Roast
2  can Golden Mushroom Soup
4  or 5 potatoes, medium size
8  carrots
1  large onion
salt and pepper
Aluminum Foil
preparation: Wash roast and place in center of foil. Salt and pepper, and slice onion on top of roast. Wrap foil loosely around roast and place in a roaster pan, large enough to hold everything. Cook until will done in oven, at 450 degrees. When well done, remove foil. Spread 2 cans of Golden Mushroom Soup over the roast, rinse the cans with water, pouring this around the roast. Peel potatoes and cut in half, place then around the roast. Peel carrots and place around roast. Return to oven and cook until potatoes and carrots are done.

name: DO NOT STIR PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. white sugar
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
2/3  c. milk
2  c. fresh peaches
preparation: Melt butter in 9 x  13-inch  Pyrex dish.  Make a batter with sugar, flour, baking  powder  and  salt.  Mix  with milk. Pour batter into dish with  melted butter.  Do not stir.  Pour fruit over this again; do not stir.  Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar on top.  Do not stir.  Bake in  350°  oven  for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve warm with Cool Whip.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
16  oz. cooked dried red beans
8  oz. onion
1  medium green pepper
12  oz. cooked ground beef
5  medium tomatoes
1 1/3  c. tomato juice
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: Cook ground beef; drain.  Add all ingredients.  Simmer 2 hours or cook all day in crock-pot.

name: STRAWBERRY SURPRISE SALAD
ingredients:
6  oz. strawberry gelatin
2  c. boiling water
4  oz. chopped pecans
1/2  pt. sour cream
10  oz. pkg. frozen strawberry halves
2  large or 3 medium bananas
preparation: Pour gelatin into boiling water.  When granules are dissolved, set mixture aside to cool.  Add crushed bananas, thawed berries and chopped pecans to cooled mixture.  Pour one half of this into baking dish and place in refrigerator to set.  Spread sour cream over the top of congealed gelatin and pour remaining mixture of gelatin on top of sour cream.  Return to refrigerator until top part is congealed.  Serves 6 to 8 persons.

name: COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  c. canned milk
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
3  beaten egg yolks
1  c. coconut
1  baked pie shell
preparation: Mix all ingredients except coconut in a saucepan well. Cook over medium heat until thick. Add coconut and mix well. Pour into baked pie shell.

name: VENISON CHABLIS
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. cut up venison
1/4  c. cognac
2  cloves garlic, minced
4  carrots, diced
1  tsp. salt
2  onions, diced
1  tsp. pepper
6  Tbsp. flour
2  c. white wine
1  lb. sliced fresh mushrooms
preparation: Brown meat; drain off liquid.  Add all other ingredients. Cover and bake in the oven at 325° for 3 hours.  Stir well every 1/2 hour.  Serve over rice.

name: STEAK BITES APPETIZER
ingredients:
1  (2 lb.) beef top round steak, cut 1-inch thick
seasoned meat tenderizer
1/2  c. dry red wine
1  garlic clove, crushed
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. hot pepper sauce
parsley sprigs (for garnish)
preparation: Prepare steak with meat tenderizer as label directs.  In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, mix wine and garlic.  Add steak; cover. Refrigerate 1 1/2 hours.  Turn once.  Preheat broiler.  Place steak on rack in broiling pan.  Reserve marinade.  About 5 inches from source of heat, broil steak 10 minutes.  Turn; broil 8 minutes more.

name: CROCK-POT MACARONI
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. macaroni
1 large  can evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. milk
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. melted margarine
1  tsp. salt
3  c. sharp cheese
pepper to taste
preparation: Cook and drain macaroni.  Grate cheese.  Grease crock-pot. Mix all ingredients in crock-pot.  Reserve some of the cheese to put on top.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Cook on low for 3 1/4 hours.

name: BROCCOLI BOW TIES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bow tie noodles
2  bunches broccoli, stems removed and coarsely chopped
1 to 2  Tbsp. olive oil
preparation: Prepare noodles.  Steam broccoli for 5 minutes.  Combine hot noodles, broccoli and olive oil.  Toss well.

name: FRESH RHUBARB PIE
ingredients:
4 to 5  c. fresh rhubarb *
1/2  c. flour
1 1/3 to 2  c. sugar **
pastry for two-crust pie
preparation: Mix rhubarb with flour and sugar.  Dot with 1 1/2 tablespoons butter.  Pour in pastry-lined pan and top with crust which has slits cut in it.  Bake until brown at 400°, 40 to 50 minutes.

name: CORN BREAD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. corn muffin mix
1/3  c. oil
4  eggs
2  cans cream-style corn
a little sugar
garlic salt
preparation: Mix well and put into a greased casserole.  Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: TOFU MUSHROOM STUFFED BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  medium to large potatoes
1 1/3  c. chopped onions
1 1/3  c. chopped mushrooms
1/2  tsp. sage
dash of white pepper (optional)
8  oz. firm tofu, drained and mashed
3  Tbsp. finely chopped parsley
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard (spicy or Dijon)
1/2  tsp. honey
paprika
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Bake potatoes for 40 to 60 minutes. Combine onions, mushrooms and sage in skillet.  Cover and stew 5 minutes over medium heat, until mushrooms become tender and release their juices.  Season with white pepper.

name: GRACIE BURGESS' POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
1  stick butter or margarine
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
3  c. all-purpose flour (sift at least 2 times)
1  c. sweet milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  tsp. butter flavoring
dash of salt (1/8 tsp.)
preparation: Have butter and eggs at room temperature.  Cream butter, shortening and sugar.  Sift dry ingredients together.  Add dry ingredients and milk alternately, about 1/2 at a time, beating constantly.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Add flavoring.  Bake in tube pan at 325° about 1 1/2 hours or until done.

name: BAKED BEAN-HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  strips bacon
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 to 1 1/2  lb. lean hamburger
2 (1 lb.)  cans (pea) baked beans
1/2  c. molasses
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
dash of Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Saute in skillet the bacon (cut in pieces) and the onion until lightly done (not crisp).  Brown the hamburger with the bacon and onion.  Put canned beans in casserole or bean pot with remaining ingredients stirred together.  Add meat-onion-bacon mixture.  Bake for 1/2 hour at 375°.

name: SCRAMBLED EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
9  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1/2  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can mushrooms, drained
3/4  c. grated cheese (American or Cheddar)
1/2  lb. bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
preparation: Beat eggs and milk together.  Scramble in butter.  Put eggs in shallow casserole; spread soup, mushrooms and cheese.  Sprinkle bacon all over top evenly.  Bake at 250° for 45 minutes.

name: LEMON CAKE
ingredients:
1  box lemon supreme cake mix
1  box lemon instant pie filling
1/2  c. oil
2/3  c. water
4  eggs
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Bake for 40 minutes.  Do not open oven until time is up.

name: EASY TACO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. taco seasoning
8  oz. pkg. spaghetti
8  oz. sour cream
8  oz. grated cheese
lettuce, broken in bite-size pieces
tomato, diced
onions, diced
1 small  pkg. bite-size Fritos corn chips
preparation: Cook beef and drain.  Mix taco seasoning with beef according to directions.  In meantime, cook spaghetti (broken in 2 to 3-inch pieces) and drain.  Mix beef mixture with spaghetti.  Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with spaghetti beef mixture.  Top with sour cream, cheese, lettuce, tomato and onion (or any other of your taco favorite additions).  Top with Fritos.

name: EASY BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  head broccoli
2  to 3 tomatoes
1  large onion
1  head cauliflower
Italian dressing
preparation: Break broccoli and cauliflower into flowerets and chop into bite size pieces.  Chop tomatoes and onion.   Pour any dressing over mixture.   Italian is best.   Let marinate several hours or overnight.   Keeps well for several days in refrigerator.

name: CRACKER FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. canned milk
1  stick butter
2/3  c. peanut butter
1  can coconut
24  crumbled saltines
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine in saucepan sugar, canned milk and butter.  Over moderate heat, bring to a boil.  Stir for 4 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Add peanut butter, coconut, saltines and vanilla.  Stir until blended.  Pour into buttered pan, 9 x 13-inch.  Refrigerate.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  small head cabbage
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion
1/3  c. uncooked rice
1  can condensed tomato soup
1  can water
preparation: Chop cabbage and place in greased baking dish.  Brown meat and onions.  Stir in rice and pour on top of cabbage.  Mix soup and water; pour over entire casserole mixture.  Bake, covered, for 1 hour at 325°.  Add a little water, if necessary.

name: CHERRY CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines white cake mix
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
1 (1 lb. 5 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spread pie filling in the bottom of a 9-inch square pan.  Sprinkle with lemon juice.  Combine dry cake mix, nuts and melted butter.  Mixture will be crumbly.  Sprinkle over pie filling.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes until golden brown.  Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

name: SOUR CREAM BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. sour cream
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  c. mashed bananas
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Grease a loaf pan.  Cream margarine, sugar, eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients, then bananas, nuts and sour cream.  Mix well. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PEAR PIE
ingredients:
3  to 4 fresh pears, peeled and sliced
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. lemon
1/2  tsp. almond
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. flour
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  (9-inch) pie shell, cooked
4  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. flour (plain)
preparation: Mix together sour cream and vanilla, almond and lemon extracts.  Coat pears with 2/3 cup sugar and 1/3 cup flour and stir into sour cream mixture.  Place in 9-inch pie shell which has been cooked at 325° for 10 minutes.          Mix together 1/4 cup brown sugar, flour and butter until crumbly.  Top pie with this crumbly mixture and bake 35 to 40 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. finely chopped onions
1  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix Cheddar and cream cheese well, then add other ingredients except for pecans.  Shape into a ball.  Chill, then pat in pecans. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: CARAMEL CREAM CHEESE BONBONS
ingredients:
29  Kraft caramels
1/4  c. evaporated milk
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. chopped pecans
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  lb. (or more) powdered sugar
12  oz. almond bark or chocolate chips (to melt for dipping)
preparation: Combine caramels and milk in large bowl in microwave.  Heat until melted.  Stir in 1 cup powdered sugar, margarine and pecans. Cool to room temperature, then stir in cream cheese.  Add 1 pound or more powdered sugar until mixture can be made into balls after being chilled.  Chill for 2 hours.  Roll into balls and place on wax paper and freeze for 1/2 hour until firm.  Melt almond bark or chocolate and quickly dip bonbons in with toothpicks and place back on wax paper.  Return to refrigerator until coating is hard. Store in refrigerator.

name: RAISIN PIE
ingredients:
2  c. water
2  c. raisins
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. lemon juice or vinegar
preparation: Cook raisins and water for 5 minutes, then add sugar, flour and vinegar.  Stir all the time.  Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

name: CORN DOG MIX
ingredients:
1/2  qt. corn meal (plain)
1 1/2  c. flour (plain)
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  c. powdered milk
1  egg
preparation: Mix dry ingredients in bowl.   Add egg and enough water to make medium batter.    Mix well; let stand 15 minutes.  Put stick in wieners; roll in mix.  Deep fry until golden brown.

name: COMMERCE UNION TEA
ingredients:
1 large  can frozen orange juice
juice of 3 lemons (equals 8 Tbsp.)
1 1/2  c. sugar
4 tea bags, steeped in 4  c. water
preparation: Mix all ingredients in gallon container and fill with water. Add fresh mint for extra flavor.  Serve chilled.

name: CUCUMBER CREAM SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon gelatin
1  tsp. salt
1  c. boiling water
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. grated onion
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  c. cucumber, finely chopped and drained
preparation: Dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water.  Add vinegar and onion.  Refrigerate until syrupy.  Beat in remaining ingredients. Pour into 6 individual molds and refrigerate until firm.  Unmold on greens and top with a dollop of mayonnaise.  Serves 6.

name: CHOCOLATE COVERED CHERRY COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. cocoa
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. oleo
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 (10 oz.)  jar maraschino cherries
6  oz. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1/2  c. Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Sift the first 5 ingredients together and set aside.  Cream the oleo, sugar, egg and vanilla together.  Add dry ingredients. Shape into 1-inch balls.  Place on ungreased baking sheet.  Press down center of dough with thumb.  Drain cherries (reserving liquid).  Place a cherry in each cookie.  In small saucepan, melt chocolate pieces and condensed milk.  Stir in 4 teaspoons cherry juice.  Spoon about 1 teaspoon of chocolate mixture over each cherry, spreading to cover cherry.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Remove to wire rack to cool.  Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. sweet potatoes
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. flour
1  c. nuts
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. margarine
preparation: Mix potatoes, sugar, milk, eggs, 1/2 cup margarine and coconut.  Add nuts, brown sugar, 1/2 cup margarine and flour together.  Pour over the top of the other ingredients. Bake at 350° for approximately 30 to 40 minutes.

name: JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
1  large onion
1  large bell pepper
3 to 4  cloves garlic
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
4  Tbsp. olive oil
1  lb. Hillshire Farm smoked sausage, cut bite-sized
1  envelope Lipton onion-mushroom soup mix
2  c. raw rice
3  c. beef consomme
preparation: Saute vegetables in olive oil.  Add sausage and stir-fry for approximately 20 minutes or until brown.  Add raw rice, consomme and onion soup mix.  Stir well.  Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce to low heat.  Cover and cook for 30 minutes.

name: NO BAKE FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1 small  box vanilla wafers
1  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
8  oz. mixed candied fruit
1/2  c. coconut
1/4  c. nuts
preparation: Crush vanilla wafers.  Mix all ingredients together.  Mold in a loaf shape pan.  Refrigerate.

name: CHICKEN EDEN ISLE
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts, boned and cut in half
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans cream of chicken soup
1 (2 1/2 oz.)  pkg. dried beef
1 1/2  c. sour cream
12  slices bacon
8  oz. cream cheese
preparation: Pepper chicken.  Wrap bacon around each piece of chicken. Layer dried beef in bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Arrange chicken on top of beef.  Mix soup, sour cream and cream cheese together.  Pour sauce over chicken; cover tightly with foil.  Bake at 325° for 2 hours.  Remove foil to brown chicken last 15 minutes. Serves 10 to 12 people.

name: DEBBIE'S TASTY CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES(Extra Large Recipe)
ingredients:
9  c. flour
4  tsp. soda
4  tsp. salt
4  c. butter
3  c. granulated sugar
3  c. brown sugar
6  tsp. vanilla
8  eggs
4  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Beat ingredients until creamy.  Drop on a cookie sheet and bake for 10 minutes at 375°.

name: WATERMELON RIND PICKLES
ingredients:
5  lb. watermelon rind
8  tsp. alum
1  qt. cider vinegar
1  Tbsp. whole cloves
2  cinnamon sticks
4  lb. (8 c.) sugar
preparation: Select firm watermelon rind.  Cut off green skin and all pink from rind.  Cut rind into triangular pieces. Weigh 5 pounds (about 3 1/2 quarts).  Place in a large kettle.  Cover with water; boil until rind is easily pierced with a fork.  Add measured alum to rind.  Remove from heat.  Let stand overnight.

name: CHIPPY DIPPY SQUARES
ingredients:
1  stick butter (melted at 350~)
1  c. graham cracker crumbs, sprinkled in melted butter
1  c. coconut
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
1  c. pecans
1  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Put in Pyrex dish in layers.  Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/3  c. oil
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking soda
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  oz. red food coloring
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Cream sugar and oil.  Add eggs; beat well  Add vinegar and food coloring; beat well.  Sift dry ingredients and add, alternating with milk.  Add vanilla.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Best if made in 4 layers.

name: SAUSAGE APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1  lb. sweet or hot sausage
1  c. Bisquick
8  oz. shredded cheese
preparation: Roll all ingredients together into balls.  Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.  Can be frozen.  Makes 30 appetizers.

name: EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/2  stick butter
preparation: Mix all together and put in pie dish.  Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes.  Makes its own crust.

name: SOUR CREAM CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jiffy cornbread mix (yellow)
3  eggs
1  c. (8 oz.) sour cream
3/4  can creamed corn
3/4  stick margarine, melted
honey (to top with)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together, except honey, in a bowl.  Pour into greased round skillet or Pyrex baking dish.  Bake at 325° for approximately 35 minutes.  Serve with honey.

name: TANGLE BRITCHES(Cinnamon Pastry)
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
1  c. sugar
about 5 c. flour
6  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cream  together  the  butter  and sugar.  Add the eggs, beating well.  Sift in the cinnamon and enough flour to make a stiff dough.  Roll	out the dough very thin on a floured board to about  1/8-inch  thick.  Cut  into rectangular pieces 3 x 5 inches.  Make  5  cuts  lengthwise in the dough 1/2 inch apart and 4  1/2  inches  long, so that the rectangle remains in one piece. Fry in hot deep fat (360°) for 2 minutes or until they bob up  to the top of the hot grease.	When dropping them into the fryer, pick  up the 1st, 3rd and 5th strips and pull them upward.	Let the  2nd,  4th  and  6th sag downward so that in frying they  get all fahuudelt (tangled) or as the Dutch say, all through  each other.  Dust with powdered sugar or dribble molasses over them and eat hot.

name: BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
3/4  c. powdered sugar
2  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1/2  lb. ground nuts (pecans)
preparation: Cream butter.  Add powdered sugar, then egg yolks; beat to cream consistency.  Add vanilla; mix well.  Add flour, a little at a time.  When well mixed, add nuts.  Drop by half teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° until brown.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. coconut
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1  stick margarine
1  box confectioners sugar
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Spray oblong pan with Pam.  Sprinkle pecans and coconut in bottom.  Mix cake mix by box directions.  Pour on top of nuts. Melt margarine and blend with confectioners sugar and cream cheese. Beat vigorously until creamy.  Spoon onto top of cake mix.  Bake in a 300° to 325° oven for 1 hour or longer.  Do not overbake.

name: RATATOUILLE
ingredients:
2  or 3 eggplant, peeled and thinly sliced
2  zucchini, sliced
3  to 5 peppers (green or red), cut into thin rings
1  large onion, sliced
2  or 3 tomatoes, peeled and cut into wedges
1  clove garlic, crushed
salt and pepper
1/2  tsp. chopped basil
1  tsp. chopped parsley
olive oil
preparation: Heat 1/4 cup olive oil in large cast-iron skillet.  Slowly add the vegetables, stirring to mix.  Cook on low heat until tender. Add basil, parsley and pepper to taste.  Add oil as needed.  May be served hot or cold.

name: GRANDMA'S DISHPAN CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  box chocolate cake mix
2  c. raisins
2  c. chopped nuts
1/8  tsp. cloves
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Prepare cake mix as directed on box.  Mix cake mixes together in a large bowl.  Add spices.  Stir in raisins, nuts and chocolate chips; blend in well.  Fully line a dishpan with wax paper.  Pour cake mix into prepared dishpan.  Cover top of cake mix with wax paper (to prevent cake from burning).  Bake in a 350° oven 4 hours or until toothpick comes out clean.  Cool completely in pan before pouring it out.

name: CHOCOLATE CAKE PUDDING
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. melted butter, cooled
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift sugar, flour, salt, baking powder and cocoa together into a 9-inch square baking pan.  Stir in milk, butter and vanilla. Spread batter in pan.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (No. 303)  can cream-style corn
1 (No. 303)  can whole kernel corn
1  large onion, chopped fine
1  medium size bell pepper, chopped
2  oz. can pimento
salt and pepper
2/3  c. milk
1  egg, beaten
1  pkg. crackers, crumbled
1  c. grated cheese
1  stick oleo, melted
2  tsp. sugar
preparation: Mix corns, onion, bell pepper and pimento together.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Pour into greased casserole dish (2-quart).

name: TIM'S 5 MINUTE SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. cottage cheese
2  c. Cool Whip
1- 3  oz. pkg. cherry jello
3  c. fruit cocktail (2 cans), drained
preparation: Mix cottage cheese and cool whip together.  Stir in jello. Add fruit.  Mix well and chill.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. mashed potatoes
1  c. sugar
2  egg yolks
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. melted butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. lemon
1/2  can evaporated milk
1  pt. whole milk
2  egg whites, beaten stiff
preparation: Add egg whites after straining the mixture.  Bake in two 9-inch pie shells at 400° approximately 30 to 40 minutes.

name: TWICE BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
12  large baking potatoes
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  sticks oleo
2  eggs
1 large  can Carnation milk
grated Colby cheese
preparation: Bake the potatoes.  Scoop out, mash and add the cream cheese, oleo, eggs and enough milk to be of the right consistency.  Put potato mixture back into shells and top with grated cheese.  Put back in oven at 350° and heat for about 20 to 30 minutes.  These can be frozen and reheated.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese (room temperature)
1/2  c. butter, softened
garlic salt to taste
chopped green olives
preparation: Combine cream cheese, butter and garlic salt until smooth. Add olives.  Form into ball, or leave in dish.  Serve with crackers.

name: CRUSTLESS SPINACH QUICHE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. sliced fresh  mushrooms
1  Tbsp. oil
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach, chopped, thawed and drained
2/3  c. cooked finely chopped ham
5  eggs
3  c. Muenster or Monterey Jack cheese
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Sauté the onion and mushrooms in the oil until tender. Add the spinach and ham. Mix the eggs, cheese and pepper. Spread into 9-inch pie plate or quiche pan. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes until knife comes clean.

name: STUFFED SQUASH
ingredients:
1  lb. hot sausage
1/2  c. seasoned stuffing mix
1  medium onion, finely chopped
1  c. shredded cheese (Cheddar, Swiss or Mozzarella)
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
8  medium to large yellow squash
preparation: Gently boil squash (whole) until tender.  Let cool slightly, then slice lengthwise and scoop out pulp into bowl.  Cook sausage and chopped onion; drain off excess oils.  Add to pulp of squash, then add stuffing mix.

name: CREAMY CHEF'S DRESSING(Low-Calorie)
ingredients:
3/4  c. low-fat buttermilk
1/4  c. low-fat cottage cheese
1/4  tsp. prepared mustard
dash of hot pepper sauce
1/2  small white onion, minced
1  Tbsp. minced fresh parsley
1/2  Tbsp. minced chives
preparation: Process all ingredients until smooth in a blender or the work bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade.  Process until smooth.  Keep covered and refrigerated.  Makes 1 cup.  Serves 16; 1 tablespoon per serving.

name: SOUTHERN PECAN BARS
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. double-acting baking powder
1/3  c. soft butter or margarine
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/4  c. finely chopped pecans
2  eggs
1/4  c. white corn syrup
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
3  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. coarsely chopped pecans
preparation: Sift 1 1/3 cups flour with baking powder.  Cream butter until light and fluffy.  Gradually add 1/2 cup brown sugar.   Blend in flour mixture; stir in 1/2 cup pecans.  Press mixture firmly into greased 12 x 8-inch pan.  Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.

name: NEVER FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. unsifted flour
1  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. Crisco
1  egg, beaten
5  Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix flour, salt and Crisco.  Add egg, water and vinegar. Makes 2 (2-crust) pies.

name: TAMALE PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. whole kernel corn
2  c. canned tomatoes, blended
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
1  tsp. salt
pepper (dash)
1  tsp. chili powder
1 or 2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. self-rising cornmeal
1/2  c. self-rising flour
3/4  c. buttermilk
1  egg
1/2  c. shredded American cheese
preparation: Mix well.  Then add enough water to make mixture thin.  After putting topping on meat mixture, bake at 450° until cornbread is brown.

name: POPPY SEED CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, split, cooked and deboned
1  stick margarine
poppy seed
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
Ritz crackers
preparation: Mix soup and sour cream; pour over chicken.  Melt butter and pour over casserole.  Crush crackers and cover casserole. Sprinkle with poppy seed.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: PINK FLUFF
ingredients:
8  oz. cottage cheese
large can crushed pineapple
large sugar free strawberry jello
8  oz. cool whip
pecans to taste
coconut to taste
preparation: Mix together. Set in refrigerator over night.

name: SWEET POTATO PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. pared, grated sweet potatoes
2  eggs
1  c. white or brown sugar
1  c. rich milk
1/4  c. melted butter
1/2  tsp. lemon rind
1  Tbsp. lemon juice or 1/2 tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat  the  eggs until light.  Add to grated sweet potatoes. Gradually add sugar.  Stir in milk and rest of ingredients.  Place the pudding in a greased baking dish.  Bake in a moderate	oven at	350°  for  about 1/2 hour.  Stir it with a spoon.  Bake  it 15	minutes  longer.  Serve  it with whipped cream, if desired. Makes 6 servings.

name: SHRIMP AND FRIED RICE
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter
3  c. cooked rice
1  c. chopped, cooked shrimp
1  pkg. frozen peas and carrots, cooked
1 small  can button mushrooms
salt to taste
1  tsp. garlic powder
soy sauce to taste
preparation: Melt butter in large frying pan; add rice, stirring until rice is slightly browned.  Add shrimp, peas and carrots, mushrooms, salt, garlic powder and soy sauce.  Mix well.  Serve hot with additional soy sauce.  All ingredients may be cooked the day before and stored separately in the refrigerator until time to use.  Makes 6 servings.

name: PEACH PORCUPINE CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
4  good-sized peaches, peeled and sliced
preparation: Beat margarine, sugar, egg and vanilla together by mixer or by hand until creamy.  Add flour.  Form ball and place in 8-inch greased pie plate.  Leaving it in the ball shape, push peach slices into it, as many as you can, all over it (it will look like a porcupine).

name: BLUEBERRY GELATIN SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. blueberry gelatin
2  c. boiling water
2  c. fruit juice (from drained fruits), with water added to make 2 c.
1  envelope Knox gelatine
1 (15 oz.)  can blueberries, drained
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Add 2 cups juice; chill until partially set.  Add well drained fruits; mix and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cover with plastic wrap; refrigerate at least overnight.  On the day this is to be served, prepare topping. (Mix cream cheese, sour cream, sugar and vanilla.)  Spread on top of gelatin; sprinkle with chopped nuts.

name: JEWEL'S FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  lb. candied cherries and pineapple
1  c. nuts
1  c. raisins
8  chopped orange sliced candy
2 1/2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. oleo
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. syrup
4  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. orange juice
preparation: Chop and mix fruit, etc.  Sift flour and put 1/2 on fruit and stir until coated.  Mix dry ingredients.  Mix with liquid ingredients.  Add fruit and stir in well.  You may cook it in 1 tube pan or 2 loaf pans.  Bake at 250° for 4 to 5 hours or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.  Let cool in pan 15 minutes before turning out on cloth.

name: HOT WATER GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. molasses
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. allspice
1  c. boiling water
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix all together; dissolve soda in boiling water and pour in baking pan.  It will be a little thin.  Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1  can mandarin oranges
Cool Whip
1 small  box orange jello
preparation: Bake cake as usual; cool.  Poke holes in cake with a fork. Make jello as usual; pour over cake.  Refrigerate.  Top with Cool Whip.  Decorate with oranges.  Refrigerate.

name: HOLIDAY BREAKFAST
ingredients:
8  eggs
6  slices bread, crumbled
1  lb. Owens regular sausage
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
2  c. milk
preparation: Cook sausage and crumble.  Mix milk, salt, mustard and eggs. Pour over all other ingredients, tossing lightly.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Refrigerate 12 hours.  Bake 35 minutes at 350° for a souffle breakfast.

name: CREAMY BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
1  1/2 ??? fresh or frozen broccoli
1  can (10 3/4 oz.) condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. Bisquick baking mix
1/4  c. firm butter or margarine
preparation: Heat 1 inch salted water (1/2 teaspoon salt to 1 cup water) to boiling.  Add broccoli.  Cover and heat to boiling.  Cook until stems are almost tender; 10 to 12 minutes.  Drain.  Place broccoli in ungreased 1 1/2-quart round casserole. Heat oven to 400°.  Beat soup and milk until smooth; pour over broccoli.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Mix baking mix and margarine until crumbly; sprinkle over cheese.  Bake until crumbs are light brown, about 20 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: CHICKEN WITH MUSHROOMS AND ONIONS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  Tbsp. oil
2  medium onions, sliced
2  tsp. garlic powder
2  chicken cutlets, cubed
4  oz. jar sliced mushrooms, drained
3/4  c. white cooking wine
preparation: Melt butter in medium skillet over medium high heat, add oil. Add onions, saute 5 minutes.  Add garlic powder, stir in well, add chicken.  Saute until chicken is opaque, 5 to 10 minutes.  Add mushrooms and white cooking wine, mix well.  Simmer over low heat 10 minutes.  If it looks too dry add more white cooking wine. Serve over white rice.  Serves 2 to 3. To serve 4 people, add two more cutlets.

name: FRENCH COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1  Tbsp. flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. Carnation milk
3  eggs
1  c. coconut
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat egg.  Add melted margarine, flour and sugar; beat again. Add milk, lemon juice and vanilla. Add coconut and stir together. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake 45 minutes at 350° or until lightly brown and firm on top.

name: MICROWAVE POTATOES
ingredients:
potatoes (allow about 1 per person)
onions
butter or oleo
salt
pepper
garlic salt (optional)
preparation: Slice potatoes medium thin and onions in rings.  In microwave dish put single layer of potatoes, then layer of onions.  Sprinkle with salt, pepper and garlic salt and dot with butter.  Continue to layer potatoes and onions topped with seasonings and butter to fill dish.  Cover.  Cook on High about 5 minutes.  Test for doneness. Cook about 5 minutes more; test again.

name: FIG PRESERVES
ingredients:
4  qt. fresh figs with stems
1  Tbsp. soda
3  qt. boiling water
8  c. sugar
1  qt. water
1  lemon, thinly sliced
preparation: Place figs in a large bowl; sprinkle with soda.  Add boiling (3 quarts) water and soak for 1 hour.  Drain figs, rinse in cold water.  Combine sugar and 1 quart water in large Dutch oven. Bring to a boil and cook 10 minutes.  Add figs and lemon to syrup. Cook until figs are clear and tender (about 1 hour), stirring occasionally.  Spoon figs into hot sterilized jars.  If necessary, keep cooking until thick.  Pour syrup over figs, leaving 1/4-inch headspace.  Run knife around edge of jars to remove air bubble. Cover at once with metal lids and screw bands tight.  Process in boiling water for 10 minutes.  Yields 4 or 5 pints.

name: RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can onion soup
1  can beef broth
1  c. rice, cooked
1  jar mushrooms, drained
1  stick margarine
preparation: Mix soups together to blend.  Add rice and drained mushrooms. Dot with margarine through rice.  Bake for 45 minutes at 300°.

name: FROSTY LIME PUNCH
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  cans frozen limeade concentrate, thawed
3  c. cold water
2 (12 oz.)  bottles lemon-lime carbonated beverage, chilled
1  c. lime sherbet
preparation: Mix limeade concentrate, cold water and carbonated beverage in large punch bowl.  Spoon scoops of sherbet into bowl.  Serve immediately.  Makes 15 servings (1/2 cup each).

name: CHRISTMAS FILLED COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  c. shortening
2  eggs
6  c. oatmeal
2  c. flour
8  Tbsp. hot water
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream shortening and sugars; add eggs.  Beat well.  Put 3 cups oatmeal through grinder.  Combine this with other 3 cups.  Sift flour, soda and salt together; add this to the creamed mixture. Add all oatmeal and hot water to this.  Mix well.  Chill dough 30 minutes.

name: ORANGE SHERBET MOLD
ingredients:
4  serving size orange jello (can use sugar-free)
1  pt. orange sherbet
1 (8 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 to 1 1/2  c. miniature colored marshmallows (10 oz.)
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Mix jello with 1 cup boiling water; stir in sherbet until dissolved.  Mix in marshmallows and oranges.  Let set up about 3 hours in small square casserole dish.  Makes 8 servings.

name: BEEF BROWN RICE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
2  cans beef consomme
1  large onion
1  c. water
1  c. rice (uncooked)
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Grease 9 x 13-inch baking dish with butter or Pam.  Sprinkle rice in bottom of dish, slowly add consomme and water.  Sprinkle onion over ingredients.  Add ground beef.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Remove from oven and sprinkle grated cheese on top.  Serve while hot.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. chopped cooked chicken
2  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped ripe olives
1/2  c. sliced almonds
1  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. chopped onion
1  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.  Bake for 10 minutes at 450°.  Top with 1 cup grated Cheddar cheese.  Heat until cheese melts.

name: WACKY CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
5  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  c. water
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients in an ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Make three holes in mixture and add the vinegar to one hole, the vanilla to one hole, and the oil to the third hole.  Pour one cup of water over the entire thing and mix well.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  This is a great cake for kids to make!

name: CRISPIE CANDY
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. syrup
1  c. peanut butter
2  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Combine sugar and syrup; bring to rolling boil.  Add peanut butter and mix well.  Add cereal.  Spread in pan.  Cool and cut into squares.

name: "ORANGE COW" SHAKES
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1/2  c. orange juice concentrate
1  c. ice cream and/or 1 sliced banana
preparation: Mix all in blender and serve.  Makes 2 to 4 servings.

name: DIXIE DOGS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2 1/2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  egg
milk
wieners
preparation: Mix first 5 (batter) ingredients with enough milk to make a cake-like batter.  Roll wieners in batter and drop into hot oil. Cook until golden brown.

name: KODIAK CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
4  c. diced onions
2  garlic cloves, minced
3  medium green peppers, diced
4  c. diced celery
1 (5 3/4 oz.)  jar stuffed green olives, undrained
1 (4 oz.)  can mushroom stems and pieces, undrained
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed tomato soup, undiluted
1 (8 oz.)  jar picante sauce
1 (18 oz.)  bottle barbecue sauce
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3 to 4  c. medium egg noodles, cooked and drained
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a Dutch oven, brown ground beef with onions and garlic; drain.  Add remaining ingredients except cheese and mix well. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until hot and bubbly. Sprinkle with cheese just before serving.

name: ZIPPY COCKTAIL SAUCE
ingredients:
2/3  c. chili sauce
1/4  c. lemon juice
2 to 3  Tbsp. prepared horseradish
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. hot sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients, stirring until smooth.  Cover and chill at least 2 hours.  Yields 1 cup.

name: HAWAIIAN WEDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1  box cake mix (of your choice)
1  lb. 4 oz. can crushed pineapple, drained
1 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  small container Cool Whip
preparation: Make cake according to package directions. When cool, spread crushed pineapple on top of cake.

name: TORTILLA SWIRLS
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  Tbsp. sour cream
1  tsp. grated onion
1  Tbsp. hot sauce
1  can green chiles
chopped pecans and pimentos (optional, for color)
preparation: Mix and spread onto tortilla.  Roll tortilla and chill. Cut into bite size pieces.

name: SPICED TOMATO ASPIC
ingredients:
3  c. tomato juice
2  envelopes unflavored gelatin
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. horseradish
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. Worcestershire
1/2  tsp. onion powder
dash of cayenne pepper
lettuce leaves
parsley sprigs (optional)
preparation: Pour 1 cup of tomato juice into medium saucepan; sprinkle with gelatin.  Heat slowly until gelatin dissolves.  Remove from heat; add seasonings and remaining tomato juice.  Pour into 6 individual salad molds or 1 large salad mold.  Chill until set.  Unmold on lettuce; garnish with parsley.  Can add chopped cucumber and onion (if desired) and omit onion powder.

name: MUSTARD BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  lb. oleomargarine
4  oz. prepared mustard
1/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
10  shots hot sauce
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Bring to boil all ingredients except Worcestershire sauce, which is added as the boiled ingredients are removed from heat. Mix!  Excellent with chicken.  Brush sauce onto individual pieces or 1/2 chicken and cook slowly over open charcoal already glowing hot.  Turn frequently and re-apply sauce and after each turn.  Cook until charcoal turns to ash.

name: CORN DOG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. thinly slice celery
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. sliced green onions
1 1/2  lb. hot dogs
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
2  tsp. rubbed sage
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  pkg. (8 1/2 oz.) cornbread mix
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded sharp cheddar cheese, divided
preparation: In a skillet, sauté celery in butter for 5 minutes. Add onions sauté for 5 minutes. Place in a large bowl; set aside. Cut hotdogs lengthwise into quarter, the cut into thirds. In the same skillet sauté the hot dogs for 5 minutes or until lightly browned: add to vegetables. Set aside 1 cup. In a large bowl, combine eggs, milk, sage and pepper. Add the remaining hot dog mixture. Stir in cornbread mixes. Add 1 1/2 c. oil cheese. Spread into shallow 3 qt. baking dish. Top with reserved got dog mixture and remaining cheese. Bake uncovered at 400° for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Yield: 12 servings.

name: LEAF LETTUCE GREEK SALAD
ingredients:
2  heads leaf lettuce
8  green onions, chopped
juice of 2 lemons or 4 Tbsp. ReaLemon
8  shakes Accent
1  Tbsp. Cavender's Greek seasoning
1/2  c. oil
1  avocado, chopped
preparation: Use a large bowl (not wooden).  Wash and dry lettuce.  Tear into small pieces and refrigerate.  In small bowl, mix remaining ingredients; cover and refrigerate.  Toss greens with dressing just before serving.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE WITH ALMONDS
ingredients:
1  bunch broccoli
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. grated cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. slivered almonds
4  slices crisp bacon
1/2  c. buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Cook broccoli until just tender.  Drain and place in buttered casserole.  Make a sauce of the butter, flour, salt, pepper and milk; then add cheese.  Sprinkle top with crumbs and bacon.  Bake in 350° oven for about 20 minutes, or until bubbling and brown on top.

name: APPLE TORTILLAS
ingredients:
8  to 10 flour tortillas (regular size)
1  can apple pie filling
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
1  stick margarine
preparation: Divide pie filling between the tortillas and roll up.  Spray baking dish with Pam and place filled tortillas in dish.

name: GRANOLA BITES
ingredients:
2  c. cornflakes cereal
2/3  c. quick cooking oats
1/4  c. 100% bran cereal
1/2  c. chopped pitted dates or raisins
1/2  c. reduced-fat crunch peanut butter
4 egg whites or 1/2  c. real liquid egg product
5  tsp. Equal Measure or 16 packets Equal sweetener or 2/3 c. Equal Spoonful*
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine cornflakes, oats, bran cereal and dates in large bowl.  Mix peanut butter, egg whites, Equal and vanilla in small bowl until smooth; pour over cereal mixture and stir until all ingredients are coated.  Shape mixture into 1-inch mounds; place on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake in preheated 350° oven until cookies are set and browned, 8 to 10 minutes.  Cool on wire racks.  Makes about 2 dozen.

name: MOM'S EASY FUDGE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1  large spoon peanut butter (more or less to taste)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In a double boiler, melt chocolate chips and peanut butter with sweetened condensed milk, stirring constantly.  When melted, add vanilla and stir.  Immediately pour into a buttered 8 x 8-inch pan. Refrigerate until firm.

name: CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. shortening
1/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. warm water
preparation: Mix flour, dry yeast  and  sugar.  Cut  in  shortening. Add water; mix.  Roll dough in 12 x 14-inch rectangle.  Melt 2 tablespoons margarine and brush  on.  Mix  3 tablespoons brown sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.  Sprinkle  over  top.  Roll up. Cut in 15 slices 3/4-inch thick.  Put  in  buttered  pan.  Let rise  2 hours.  Bake at 425°.  Glaze  while  hot  with  1  cup unsifted confectioners sugar and 4 teaspoons water.

name: HOMEMADE CLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. salt
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. oil
few drops of food coloring
preparation: Mix in large bowl by hand until pliable.

name: MEXICAN LAYER DIP
ingredients:
1  can refried beans
1 small  pkg. sour cream
1  jar salsa
1  pkg. shredded cheese (Cheddar or Velveeta)
2  medium tomatoes, diced
1  bunch green onions, diced
1 small  can black olives, sliced
jalapeno peppers (optional)
preparation: Layer ingredients in order in shallow dish.  Serve cold with nacho chips.

name: CHINESE FRIED WALNUTS
ingredients:
6  c. water
4  c. walnuts
1/2  c. sugar
cooking oil
preparation: Bring water to a boil and add walnuts.  Heat to boiling and cook for 1 minute.  Rinse walnuts under running hot water and drain.  Pour walnuts into large bowl and gently stir in sugar until dissolved.  (If necessary, let stand for 5 minutes to dissolve sugar.)

name: JAN'S EASY POT ROAST
ingredients:
3  lb. boneless rump roast, frozen
A.1. steak sauce
salt and pepper
onions
preparation: Rub frozen roast with salt and pepper.  Pour A.1. sauce over covering well.  Place on large sheet of heavy-duty foil and pull up ends to make tight folds.  Place in open roasting pan, and pour in a little water to keep foil from sticking.  Roast in a 325° oven for 5 hours.  Open foil carefully and remove roast to plate.  Pour out drippings, thicken with flour and water paste and boil a few minutes to make gravy.  Quartered onions may be cooked with roast for extra flavor.

name: CHOCOLATE OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. milk
1/3  c. cocoa
1/2  c. peanut butter
3  c. oats
preparation: Boil first five items together for 2 minutes.  Add oats to mixture and spread on ungreased cookie sheet.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  medium zucchini
4  medium onions
4  to 6 tomatoes
1/4  c. oregano
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
8  oz. grated Mozzarella or Cheddar cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.   Brown hamburger.  Cut onions, tomatoes and zucchini in 1/4 to 3/4-inch slices. In 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole, layer hamburger, onion, zucchini and tomatoes.  Sprinkle layer of oregano.  Repeat.  Top with grated cheese and bake for 1 1/4 hours at 350°.  Serves 8.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
12  slices bread
6  eggs
1  c. sugar
5  shakes of cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
4  c. milk
nutmeg
preparation: Mix all ingredients. Sprinkle top with nutmeg and set dish in pan of water in oven and bake at 400° for 1 hour or until knife comes out clean.

name: GRANNY'S BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia Brand cream cheese, softened
2 1/4  c. milk
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant pudding and pie filling mix
24  vanilla wafers
2  c. banana slices
preparation: Combine cream cheese and 1/2 cup milk, mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended.  Add remaining milk and pudding mix; beat at low speed 1 minute.  Layer 1/3 of pudding mixture, half of wafers and half of bananas in 1 1/2-quart serving bowl; repeat layers.  Top with remaining pudding.  Cover surface with plastic wrap; chill.   Garnish top with crushed wafers. Serve with whipped cream.

name: EASY TAMALE PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. onion, chopped
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. shortening
1  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. oregano
8  oz. can tomato sauce
16  oz. can kidney beans
1/2  c. corn chips, crushed
3/4  c. sharp cheese, grated
1  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: Combine ground beef, 1/2 cup chopped onion, salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.  Brown in oil.   Spoon mixture into a medium-size casserole.  Saute 1/4 cup chopped onion and garlic in remaining oil until onion is golden.  Add salt, chili powder, paprika, oregano, 1/4 teaspoon pepper, tomato sauce and drained kidney beans.  Mix thoroughly and spoon over meat mixture.  Combine crushed corn chips and grated cheese; sprinkle on top.  Bake at 350°  for 30 minutes.

name: SPICED PERKED PUNCH
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. pineapple juice
2  c. cranberry juice
1 1/3  c. water
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
3  sticks whole stick cinnamon, broken in pieces
1  tsp. whole cloves
1  1/2 whole allspice
salt to taste
preparation: Mix all liquid ingredients and place in percolator.  In percolator basket place brown sugar and spices and perk.

name: PEANUT BUTTER ROUND-UP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine (soft)
1  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs
1  c. creamy peanut butter
2  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. Quaker oats
preparation: Beat margarine and sugars together until creamy; add eggs and peanut butter.  Beat well.  Sift together flour, baking soda and salt; add to creamed mixture, mixing well.  Stir in Quaker oats. Shape dough into 1-inch balls.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet; with the back of a fork, press to make crisscrosses on each (if dough sticks to fork, occasionally dip fork in flour).  Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Makes 6 dozen.

name: IRENE'S GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans French green beans
1  can cream of mushroom or chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
2  cans Shoe Peg corn
1  c. grated cheese
Ritz crackers
preparation: In a long casserole dish layer the ingredients starting with green beans and ending with Ritz crackers.  Bake at 350°  for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: BRUSSEL SPROUT AND TOMATO SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkgs frozen Brussel Sprouts (10 oz. each)
1  large tomato or 1 pkg grape tomatoes or 1 pkg cherry tomatoes
1/4  vinegar
1/4  salad oil
1-1/2  tsp. chervil (or parsley can be substituted)
1/2  tsp salt
1/4  tsp pepper
Snipped parsley
preparation: Cook brussel sprouts according to directions on pkg.  Mix vinegar, oil, chervil, salt,  and pepper in tightly covered jar. Pour over hot brussel sprouts.  Refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Before serving, add sliced tomato or cherry tomatoes or grape tomatoes.  Sprinkle with snipped parsley.

name: JUST LIKE FRIED ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2  c. any flavor ice cream
1 1/4  c. almond cluster multigrain cereal, coarsely crushed
2  tsp. margarine or butter, melted
4  tsp. honey
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Using a large ice cream scoop, make four 1/2 cup scoops of ice cream. Place in a shallow pan. Cover and store in the freezer until firm.

name: ZIPPY DEVILED EGGS
ingredients:
8  hard-cooked eggs
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2 or 3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Cut eggs in half.  Remove yellow and put in bowl.  Mix the ingredients with the yellow well and put into egg white halves.

name: CREAMY MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  jar picante sauce
jalapenos, sliced
lettuce, chopped
tomato, diced
Cheddar cheese, shredded
tortilla chips
preparation: Blend softened cream cheese and picante sauce until smooth. Pour onto flat serving dish.  (Should be about 1/2 inch thick.) Top with jalapenos, lettuce, diced tomato and cheese.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. active dry yeast
1/2  c. warm water
1/2  c. lukewarm milk
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1/2  c. softened shortening, butter or oleo
5  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Stir in milk, sugar, salt, eggs, shortening and 2 1/2 cups of the flour.  Beat until smooth. Mix in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle.  Turn dough onto lightly floured board; knead until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes.  Place in greased bowl; turn greased side up. (At this point, dough can be refrigerated 3 to 4 days.)  Cover and let rise in warm place until double, about 1 1/2 hours.  (Dough is ready if impression remains when touched.)

name: INDIAN PUDDING
ingredients:
3  c. milk
3  tsp. butter
1/2  c. cornmeal
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. molasses
4  eggs, well beaten
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. mace
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Scald the milk.  Add butter.  Gradually beat in the corn meal. Stir until slightly thickened.  Remove from stove.  Add other ingredients, beating well.  Pour into a well buttered casserole. Bake in a 275° to 300° oven for 2 hours.  Serve warm or cold with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.

name: DIVINITY FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. cold water
2  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Place sugar, syrup and water in pan over medium heat.  Stir only until sugar is dissolved, then cook until a little tried in cold water forms soft ball or 236°.  Beat egg whites 2 minutes at high speed until stiff; continue beating and pour 1/2 of syrup over beaten egg whites.  Continue beating while cooking rest of syrup until it forms hard ball or 264°.  Add this syrup gradually to syrup and egg mixture you have been beating.  Add vanilla and continue beating until candy is thick enough to drop from spoon. Place on buttered platter.  Chopped nuts may be added just before candy is ready to spoon.

name: ORANGE SLICE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
3  c. plain flour
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1 small  pkg. chopped dates
2  c. orange slices, chopped
2  c. nuts, chopped
1  c. coconut
preparation: Cream oleo and sugar.  Add eggs.  Sift flour and add alternately with buttermilk plus soda.

name: EXCELLENT PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1/2  c. Wesson oil
1/4  c. milk
1 to 1 1/2  c. flour (add until you get the right mixture)
salt to taste
preparation: Mix Wesson oil, milk and flour.  Add salt.  Roll out between two pieces of wax paper.  Lay in pie pan for baking.

name: KRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
No. 2 size can kraut
2/3  c. chopped green pepper
2/3  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 small  jar diced pimentos
preparation: Fluff kraut.  Mix peppers, celery, onion and pimentos. Sprinkle sugar over all ingredients.  Do not stir.  Cover tight and leave out overnight.  One hour before serving, stir well.

name: MILK CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1 (18.25 oz.)  pkg. Swiss chocolate cake mix
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
10  (1.5 oz.) milk chocolate candy bars with almonds, divided
1  (12 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
preparation: Prepare cake batter according to package directions. Pour into 3 greased and floured 8-inch round cake pans. Bake at 325° approximately 25 minutes. Cool in pans on wire racks 10 minutes. Remove from pans and cool completely on wire racks.

name: CHEESE STRAWS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1/2  lb. margarine, at room temperature
1 1/2  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Blend cheese and butter.  Gradually add flour, then add other ingredients.  Shape into whatever and place on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Place on wire rack to cool. Makes 3 1/2 dozen, depending on size and shape.

name: COMPANY BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  onion, chopped
1  pepper, chopped
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
8  oz. wide noodles
1  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
8  oz. cream cheese
preparation: Brown onion and pepper in butter or margarine.  Add meat and brown.  Add tomato sauce.  Cook noodles and drain.  In another bowl, combine cheeses and sour cream.  Put half of noodles in a buttered 2-quart casserole.  Spread cheese mixture over this, top with remaining noodles and cover this with meat mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  You can cook this ahead and then warm up before serving.  Can also be frozen.

name: SHRIMP CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (5 oz.)  can shrimp, mashed, or use fresh
1 1/2  tsp. mayonnaise
1  tsp. onion, chopped
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix together with mixer; form into a ball.  Roll in chopped nuts; chill.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  pork chops
6  to 8 potatoes
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2/3  can milk
1  c. shredded cheese (American, Jack, Colby, your choice)
salt and pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Spray 9 x 13 casserole dish with Pam. Brown pork chops on both sides; set aside. Peel and slice potatoes; put in dish. Mix soup, milk and cheese; pour  over potatoes. Salt and pepper. Put pork chops on top. Cover with foil. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours, until potatoes are tender. Serve with salad and bread.

name: CHEESE, BACON, POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Cheddar cheese
1  lb. bacon
1  onion, sliced in circles and divided in rings
10  medium peeled potatoes
1  stick butter
preparation: Place stick of butter in bottom of baking pan; arrange potatoes and onions in alternate layers.  Top with bacon strips. Cover with aluminum foil.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Remove foil. Spread cheese on top.  Put back in oven.  Let cheese melt.

name: POTATO SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. sugar (optional)
2  tsp. celery seed
2  tsp. vinegar
2  tsp. prepared mustard
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix well. Pour over potatoes and mix well.

name: GREEN TOMATO PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) double pie crust
1 1/2  lb. green tomatoes (3 1/2 c., sliced)
1 1/2  tsp. grated lemon rind
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/3 to 1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. raisins
3  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1  Tbsp. bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Wash tomatoes; cut into quarters and slice very thin.  Stir in raisins, lemon juice, rind, vinegar and salt.  Blend flour with sugar and spices.  Sprinkle crumbs evenly over bottom of pastry lined pan.  Add 2 tablespoons of sugar mixture.  Fold rest of sugar mixture into tomatoes and flour in pan.  Dot with butter. Cover with top crust.  Bake for 15 minutes at 425°.  Reduce heat to 325° and bake 50 minutes longer.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/4  c. flour, presifted
3  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. salt
4  eggs
3/4  c. oil
3/4  c. water
2  c. pumpkin
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine all ingredients except nuts.  Beat 3 minutes at medium speed.  Mix in nuts.  Pour into 2 well-greased loaf pans.  Bake at 350° about 1 hour.

name: ZESTY CHILI PASTA
ingredients:
2  onions, coarsely chopped
3  chili peppers
1 (28 oz.)  can Italian plump tomatoes
1 (15 oz.)  can turkey chili (no beans)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. vermicelli
1/3  c. toasted pumpkin seeds
1/4  c. chopped cilantro
preparation: In roasting pan, place onions and Serrano chili peppers. Cover; cook for 8 to 10 minutes over high heat, or until skin chars on chilies.  Stir in tomatoes and chili.  Cook for 15 to 20 minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally.  Prepare vermicelli according to package directions.  Serve sauce over vermicelli.  Sprinkle with pumpkin seeds and cilantro.

name: AUNT SARAH'S  COCONUT DELIGHT
ingredients:
8  oz cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
12  oz cool whip
3  oz vanilla instant pudding
3  oz lemon instant pudding
3  c. cold milk
graham cracker crust
coconut and pecans
preparation: First Layer:  Beat cream cheese, one cup of cool whip, and one cup of powdered sugar until smoothed.  Spread on to crust. Sprinkle with coconut.

name: WHITE BREAD
ingredients:
12  c. flour in bread pan
4  c. water
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. lard
1  Tbsp. salt
3  pkg. dry yeast
preparation: Heat 4 cups water (2 cups in each pan).  In one pan, put 3 tablespoons sugar, 2 tablespoons lard and 1 tablespoon salt.  In the other, put 1/2 cake of yeast or 2 packages of dry yeast.  Put both pans of mixtures in the flour and knead.  Let it raise for 3 hours.  Put in greased pans and let raise for an hour.  Put in oven for 45 minutes at 375°.   After taking out of oven, grease the bread with shortening.

name: OVEN BARBECUE COUNTRY SPARERIBS
ingredients:
8  large country ribs
1  small green pepper
1  onion
2  ribs celery
1  can tomato paste
1  can tomato sauce
2  cans water
preparation: Brown ribs in oil for 20 minutes.  Add cut up green pepper, sliced onion rings and cut up celery to pan drippings (remove ribs before to baking dish).  Mix tomato sauce, paste and water; add to sauteed vegetables.  When hot, pour over ribs.  Cover with foil. Bake for 2 hours at 350°.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
3/4  c. flour
3/4  c. milk
1  c. sugar
1  pt. fresh peaches
preparation: Melt butter in baking dish.  Mix flour and sugar.  Add milk. Pour mixture over melted butter.  Add peaches.  Cook at 350° until crust comes to the top and browns.

name: BLUEBERRY PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. light corn syrup
1  Tbsp. corn oil
1  egg, lightly beaten
1  c. pancake mix
3/4  c. blueberries
1/3  c. cottage cheese
preparation: Combine milk, corn syrup, corn oil and egg in mixing bowl. Add pancake mix; stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Batter will be lumpy.  Stir in blueberries and cottage cheese carefully.  Pour 1/4 cup batter onto griddle; cook until brown, turning once.  Repeat cooking until all batter is used.  Yields 8 pancakes.

name: SOFT RAISIN FILLED COOKIES
ingredients:
5  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. Crisco
2  c. white sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sour cream
Raisin Filling*
preparation: Sift together dry ingredients.  Cream sugar and shortening until fluffy.  Add eggs and mix well.  Add vanilla and sour cream. Blend thoroughly.   Add dry ingredients a little at a time until blended.  Chill overnight or at least 2 hours.   Roll out and cut with a 2-inch cookie cutter.   Put a teaspoon of filling, then top with another 2-inch circle of dough.  Seal around cookie.  Prick top of cookie.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
2/3  c. mayonnaise
2/3  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  Tbsp. parsley
1  tsp. Lawry's seasoned salt
1  tsp. dill weed
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. Accent
dash of Tabasco sauce
preparation: Mix  ingredients and chill.  Serve with any raw vegetables.

name: BUTTERY CRUNCH TOPPED TOMATOES(Serves 4)
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
1/3  c. coarsely crushed buttery crackers
1/2  c. (2 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. caraway seed
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  large ripe tomatoes (each cut into 10 wedges)
preparation: In small bowl, stir together 2 tablespoons melted butter, crushed crackers, cheese and parsley.  In skillet, melt 2 tablespoons butter; stir in caraway seed, salt, pepper and onion. Add tomatoes.  Cover.  Cook on medium heat, stirring occasionally (until tomatoes are heated, 2 to 3 minutes).  Sprinkle with cheese mixture.  Cover; let stand for 1 minute.

name: SWEDISH PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  cups flour
2  eggs
20  oz. crushed pineapple plus all juice
2  tsp. baking soda
2  cups sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  cup nuts, optional
preparation: Mix cake ingredients together and bake in greased pan for 40 - 45 minutes in 350 degree oven.

name: CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
1/2  c. minced onion
5  c. diced raw potatoes
water (to cover)
1  can creamed corn
pepper
preparation: In a saucepan, saute onions slowly over low heat until transparent.  Add potatoes; cook until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes.  Add corn and liquid to potatoes.  Add a few shakes of pepper and heat thoroughly.

name: EASY LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
3 1/2  c. thick spaghetti sauce
1 1/2  c. water
2  c. cottage cheese
3  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
2  eggs
1/4  c. parsley
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
8  oz. lasagne noodles (uncooked)
preparation: Brown meat; drain.  Add sauce and water together and simmer for 10 minutes.  Combine other ingredients.  In a 9 x 13-inch pan, spray pan with nonstick spray.  Spread evenly 1 cup sauce on bottom of pan.  Layer noodles, sauce, cheese filling, noodles, etc.  Cover and bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.  Remove cover and bake 10 minutes longer.  Set 10 minutes before cutting.

name: PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Betty Crocker Super Moist cake mix
1 tall  can crushed pineapple (unsweetened)
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. sugar
1/2  stick butter
preparation: Bake cake according to package directions.  Cook pineapple, sugar and cornstarch until thick.  Remove from heat and add butter.  Cool completely before putting on cake.  I double this recipe because I like the cake to be gooey.

name: TACO PIE(Makes 10)
ingredients:
1  tube crescent rolls
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
8  oz. sour cream
1  lb. ground beef
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. grated Cheddar cheese
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1/2  c. crushed Fritos
preparation: Flatten biscuit dough into pie shell shape in pie pan.  Press crushed Fritos into dough.  Brown hamburger in skillet; drain fat. Mix taco seasoning and tomato sauce into meat.  Top meat with sour cream.  Sprinkle grated cheese on top.  Bake at 350° approximately 1/2 hour or until crust is brown.

name: MAYO PARMESAN BREAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. mayo
1  Tbsp. chives
4 to 5  slices French bread
preparation: Stir together cheese and mayo.  If desired, stir in chives. Broil 1 side of 4 to 5 slices French bread 1 minute or until toasted.  Spread some of mixture on toasted side and broil 2 to 3 minutes.

name: WILD RICE - GROUND BEEF(Serves 12)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  lb. ground turkey
3  pkg. Uncle Ben's wild rice with long grain
6  Tbsp. diced onion
2  small bay leaves
1  can consomme
2  cans water
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  cans sliced mushrooms, drained or equivalent amount of fresh mushrooms, sliced
1/2  c. chopped toasted almonds
2  c. diced celery
1/4  tsp. each: celery salt, onion and garlic powders, paprika, poultry seasoning, white pepper and Accent
pinch of thyme
1/2  c. minced parsley
preparation: Cook rice according to direction on box.  Set aside.  Grease well 1 very large or 2 medium casseroles.  In Dutch oven brown meat, breaking it up as it cooks and browns.  Next add onion and bay leaves.  Add all the rest of the ingredients and the rice.  Mix thoroughly.  Pour into the baking dish or dishes.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.  (This step is important to develop the flavors.)  Place in a 350° oven and bake for 2 hours.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
6  slices Texas size bread
1  lb. pork sausage
1  doz. eggs
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. sliced jalapenos
preparation: Saute  sausage	and  onion  together.  Set aside.  Melt butter in  9  x  13-inch	baking dish.  Place bread on top of butter. Mix  eggs  as  if  for  scrambling.  Pour over bread. Sprinkle sausage on top.  Top with cheese.  Place jalapenos on top  of casserole.	Set  in refrigerator overnight.  Bake the next morning at 350° for approximately 45 minutes.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1/2  c. powdered sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. nonfat yogurt
1  tube Pillsbury sugar cookie dough
favorite fruit
preparation: Combine powdered sugar, cream cheese and yogurt.  Spread dough out on cookie sheet and bake.  After cool, top with cream cheese mixture.  Top with favorite fruit.

name: GREEN TOMATO RELISH
ingredients:
4  qt. green tomatoes
4  green peppers
4  hot peppers
4  Tbsp. salt (on green tomatoes)
4  large onions
4  c. sugar
4  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1 1/2  tsp. turmeric
preparation: After grinding vegetables, drain in large cloth bag for 2 or more hours.  Add sugar, vinegar and spices; cook 30 minutes.  Put in clean hot jars and seal.  This is good on dried beans.  (For red relish, use half ripe tomatoes.)

name: FRIED ZUCCHINI(Serves 4)
ingredients:
2  zucchini, scrubbed and cut into 1/4-inch thick slices
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten slightly
1/4  tsp. Dijon mustard
3/4  c. flour
1 1/2  c. Italian bread crumbs
1/2  c. vegetable oil
preparation: In a colander, toss zucchini with salt.  Let drain for 15 minutes.  Pat dry.  In a bowl, whisk together eggs and mustard. Dip zucchini slices in flour, then egg mixture, then bread crumbs. Fry in vegetable oil until golden brown.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.  Drain on paper towels.

name: BANANA TREAT(Preschool Snack)
ingredients:
banana
raspberry yogurt or any other flavor
graham cracker crumbs
preparation: Cut banana into pieces easy for a child to get a fork into and also into their mouths!  Put some yogurt in a small bowl.  Put graham cracker crumbs in another bowl.  (Used T.V. dinner trays work great.)  Let child fork banana pieces, then dip into yogurt, crumbs and pop into mouth.  Be imaginative, coconut flakes, etc. may be substituted.

name: **ASPARAGUS SUPREME
ingredients:
2  cans asparagus
3  hard-boiled eggs, sliced
16  crackers, broken
1  c. sharp cheese, grated
1  c. mushroom soup, diluted with 1/3 c. asparagus juice
preparation: Mix crackers and cheese.  Place layer (1/2 of mixture) on bottom of greased baking dish.  Place a layer of asparagus over this, top with sliced egg.  Pour diluted soup over mixture.  Cover with remaining crackers and cheese.  Dot with butter or margarine. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. pecans
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. white Karo syrup
1/4  c. butter, melted
3  eggs, well beaten
1  unbaked 9-inch pie shell
preparation: Mix sugar, syrup and butter.  Add eggs and pecans.  Fill unbaked pie shell with mixture and bake in a moderately hot 400° oven for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to moderate (350°) and continue baking for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: HOLIDAY DIP
ingredients:
1 (5 oz.)  jar pimiento cheese spread
1 (2 1/4 oz.)  can deviled ham
1/2  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
1  Tbsp. minced onion
2 to 4  drops Tabasco sauce
dash of monosodium glutamate (m.s.g.) (optional)
preparation: Combine all with mixer.  Chill overnight.  Serve with crackers, toast points and chips.  Makes 1 1/3 cups.

name: SUMMER SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  (8 oz.) soft cream cheese
1 (4 oz.)  box instant vanilla pudding
1 (20 oz.)  can chunk pineapple, drained
1  small dairy whipped cream
preparation: Mix together as in order given.

name: POLISH CABBAGE SOUP
ingredients:
1  small head cabbage, cored and shredded
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes, undrained
2  c. tomato puree
1  qt. water
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. plus 3 Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  Tbsp. salt
2  egg yolks
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Combine cabbage, tomatoes, puree, water, butter, juice, sugar and salt  in  a  large  kettle.  Cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Beat  egg  yolks  and  sour  cream	in a small bowl. Gradually add 1	cup  of  hot  soup  into  egg mixture.	Stir contents of bowl gradually into soup kettle.  Remove from heat and stir  constantly to prevent eggs from curdling.  Makes 10 to 12 servings.

name: BROCCOLI RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked rice
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. grated cheese
10  oz. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
preparation: Mix well, pour into buttered casserole dish.  Bake at 350° until bubbly, 25 to 30 minutes.  Add cubed ham or chicken.

name: PEAR HONEY
ingredients:
1  qt. pears
3  unpeeled lemons
1  qt. sugar
preparation: Keep your heart free from hate, your mind free from worry. Live simply, expect little, and give much.  Sing often, pray always.  Fill your life with love; scatter sunshine.  Forget self, think of others.  Do as you would be done by.  These are the tried links of contentments golden chain.

name: SUNDAY FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2 or 3  Tbsp. poultry seasoning
2  tsp. paprika
2 or 3  tsp. onion powder
1 to 2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. milk
2  broiler-fryer chickens, cut up or 16 pieces (your favorite)
cooking oil
preparation: Combine dry ingredients in a plastic bag.  In a bowl, lightly beat eggs and milk.  Dip chicken pieces in egg mixture.  Shake a few pieces in bag and coat well.  In a skillet, heat 1/4-inch of oil to 350°.  Brown chicken on all sides.  Reduce heat and cook until done.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla extract
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
2  tsp. soda
4  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
3  large bananas, mashed
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening in bowl of electric mixer.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Beat well.  Add vanilla.  Combine soda and buttermilk.  Add flour and buttermilk alternately to creamed mixture.  Fold in bananas and nuts.

name: DEVILED EGGS
ingredients:
6  hard-boiled eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. sweet pickle relish
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
paprika
preparation: Shell eggs and cut in half.  Remove the yolk carefully and mash yolks with fork.  Add the next 4 ingredients and mix until smooth and fluffy.  Spoon the yolk mixture into egg whites.  Top each half with sprinkle of paprika.

name: SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
8  medium sweet potatoes
1 1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. apple juice
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. raisins
1  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Cook and peel potatoes; allow to cool. Slice and place in a 2 1/2-quart baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray. In a small saucepan, combine remaining ingredients; bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Pour over the potatoes. Bake uncovered at 350° for 45 minutes, basting occasionally. Yield: 10 servings.

name: OLD FASHIONED RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
6  eggs
3  c. milk
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
1  c. raisins
1  c. brown sugar
preparation: Beat eggs with fork. Add milk, sugar, vanilla and salt. Blend. Stir in rice and raisins. Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven 1 hour and 15 minutes, stirring once. Sprinkle brown sugar on top just before serving and broil 2 to 3 minutes about 5-inches until sugar melts.

name: PEPPER TURKEY SKILLET
ingredients:
1  lb. turkey or chicken cutlets
2  Tbsp. sesame oil, divided
1  c. low sodium chicken broth
3  Tbsp. low sodium soy sauce
