2  pkg. lo-cal sweetener (I recommend Sweet One)
2  green peppers, coarsely chopped
2  red peppers, coarsely chopped
1  medium onion, sliced thin
1  clove garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Slice turkey into 1/8-inch thick pieces.  In a small bowl combine broth, soy sauce and sweetener.  In a large skillet, heat to medium and add one tablespoon oil.  Add half turkey and stir-fry 2 or 3 minutes.  Remove turkey; add rest of oil and turkey. Stir-fry until lightly browned.  Remove turkey.  Add vegetables to same skillet, stirring occasionally for 3 to 4 minutes.  Stir sauce mixture into the vegetables, stirring until combined.  Add turkey and cook until tender.  In a glass measuring cup, combine water and cornstarch.  Stir into turkey mixture and bring to a boil. Contains approximately 275 calories.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. grated sharp cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. grated onion
2  eggs, well beaten
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. cheese cracker crumbs
preparation: Cook broccoli according to directions on package.  Drain well and combine with rest of ingredients.  Pour into buttered casserole and top with cheese cracker crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: ITALIAN COLESLAW
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage, shredded
1  medium sized onion, sliced thin
7/8  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
3/4  c. salad oil
2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Place cabbage in bowl in layers, alternating with onion.  Top with sugar.  Boil the remaining ingredients.  Pour over cabbage while hot.  Cover; let stand 4 to 6 hours in refrigerator.  Then mix and serve.  Even better after 2 or 3 days and will keep 2 or 3 weeks.

name: CRANBERRY JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. raspberry Jell-O
1  c. boiling water
1  pt. raspberry sherbet
1  can whole cranberry sauce
chopped walnuts
preparation: Mix raspberry Jell-O and boiling water.  Let set in refrigerator until very lightly set.  Then add sherbet (mix in well); add 1 can whole cranberry sauce (mashed).  Put in ring mold.  Cover with chopped walnuts.  Serve on bed of lettuce.

name: SWITCHEL OR GINGER WATER
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. syrup, brown sugar and molasses, any combination
1  c. cider vinegar
1  Tbsp. ground ginger
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all of the ingredients, then add enough cold water to make one gallon.  This makes a good thirst quencher on hot summer days.

name: CHICKEN PICCATA
ingredients:
1  lb. chicken cutlets
1/4  c. flour
4  Tbsp. butter, divided
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  c. dry white wine
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  chicken bouillon cube
1  Tbsp. capers (Crosse & Blackwell)
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Coat chicken cutlets with flour.  In large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons butter.  Add chicken and cook about 5 minutes or until lightly browned and tender.  Remove to platter; keep warm.

name: OLD FASHION POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
1/2  c. Crisco oil
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
3  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking powder
8  oz. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla or lemon
dash of salt
preparation: Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. finely crushed Oreos (about 18 cookies), including centers
1/4  c. melted butter
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
14  oz. can sweetened condensed milk
3  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. mini chocolate chips
1  tsp. flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°. Combine crumbs and butter.  Pat firmly on bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan.  In a large mixer bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy. Add milk; beat until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix well.  In a small bowl, toss together 1/2 cup chips with flour to coat.  Stir into cheese mixture.  Pour into prepared pan.  Sprinkle remaining chips over top.  Bake 1 hour or until cake springs back when lightly touched.  Cool to room temperature; chill. Remove side of pan.

name: SPINACH BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. bag Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix
3 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, drained
1  c. grated cheese (Parmesan or Romano)
6  eggs
2  sticks margarine, melted
salt, pepper and garlic powder to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Shape into small balls and freeze on cookie sheet.  Store in Ziploc bags in freezer overnight.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE SYRUP BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  can chocolate syrup
1  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Cream together butter and sugar. Add eggs and chocolate syrup. Mix together thoroughly. Mix dry ingredients and add to chocolate mixture. Stir in chopped nuts. Bake in greased jellyroll pan at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: E Z RAISIN CAKE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. raisins
2  c. water
1/2  c. butter or margarine
preparation: Boil the raisins in the 2 cups water for 10 minutes.  Add the butter or margarine; let this mixture cool.  Blend the flour, soda, salt, sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg together in a saucepan. Fold in the cooled raisin mixture with the blended spices and flour.  Grease a 10 x 10 x 2-inch baking pan.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Bake for 36 minutes.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. mashed sweet potatoes
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. and 1/3 c. melted butter
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/3  c. milk
1  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. flour
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine potatoes, sugar, 1/2 cup melted butter, eggs, vanilla and milk.  Mix well.  Spread in buttered 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Combine 1/3 cup melted butter with brown sugar, flour and pecans. Sprinkle over potatoes.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: ASIAN BURRITOS
ingredients:
1  pkg. circle-shaped rice wrappers
1  pkg. Oriental rice noodles
favorite toppings
preparation: In a pot, bring enough water to cover noodles to boil. Soak noodles in hot water until tender. Rinse with cold water. Soak rice wrappers in water one at a time on a plate until soft, about 1 minute. Drain off water. Place on the wrapper small amount of rice noodles. Top with your favorite ingredients such as cooked shrimp, cooked and minced pork, sliced cucumbers, carrots, avocados or Mung beans or small romaine lettuce leaves. Take wrapper and roll up like a burrito. Repeat. Make about 2 to 4 per person.

name: ITALIAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. flour
3/4  tsp. garlic powder
1 1/4  lb. boneless, skinless chicken, pounded to 1/4 inch thickness
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. oregano
3/4  tsp. basil
1/2  cup shredded mozzarella cheese
preparation: Combine flour and garlic powder and toss with chicken to coat.  In large pan, heat oil over medium high heat.  Add chicken and cook 3-4 minutes each side until brown and cooked.  Combine next 3 ingredients and add to pan.	Simmer 5 minutes.  Top with cheese.  Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until cheese melts.	Serve over noodles.

name: SOURDOUGH PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. starter
1/2  c. milk
1  egg, beaten
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. oil
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Mix all  ingredients.  Beat  until  smooth.  Bake  on a lightly greased  griddle,  using  1 tablespoon batter for each pancake.  Turn once.

name: CRABMEAT DREAMS
ingredients:
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can flaked crabmeat
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. lemon juice
pinch of salt and paprika
red pepper (optional)
bread rounds
1/2  c. grated American cheese
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients and refrigerate.  Toast bread rounds on one side.  When ready to serve, pile crabmeat on toast rounds.  Sprinkle with grated American cheese.  Broil until cheese melts.  Serve hot.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. rice, uncooked
2 to 6 chicken breasts (other chicken parts  can be used also)
1  can chicken and rice soup
1 soup  can water (use more is you want your rice moister)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place rice on bottom of shallow casserole or baking dish (greased).  Pour soup and water on top. You may season with your favorite seasonings if you wish (I usually use pepper and a little salt).  Cover with lid or aluminum foil tightly.  Bake 1 hour.

name: HEAVENLY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. butter, softened
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. confectioners sugar
5  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  tsp. lemon extract
2  c. sifted cake flour
preparation: Cream butter and confectioners sugar in large mixer bowl until light and fluffy.  Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add flavorings alternately with flour, beating well after each addition.  Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Cool in pan for 10 minutes.  Invert onto serving plate.  May spread with cream cheese icing if desired. Yield:  16 servings.

name: ZUCCHINI APPETIZERS
ingredients:
3  c. thinly sliced, unpeeled zucchini
1  c. baking mix
1/2  c. onion, finely chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. oregano
1  clove garlic, chopped
4  eggs, slightly beaten
preparation: Make your selection carefully.  Do not choose too young or green but mature and ripe, coming from good stock.  Do not keep in a stew or hot water or pickle.  This tends to make them sour, hard or bitter.

name: EMMA'S COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick oleo, melted
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. milk
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
3  c. oatmeal (quick cooking)
preparation: Relatively no cooking or baking.

name: MINESTRONE
ingredients:
1/4  lb. salt pork or bacon, diced
1  onion, peeled and coarsely chopped
2  cloves garlic, finely chopped
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  jar extra-thick prepared spaghetti sauce
6  c. water
2  envelopes dehydrated beef broth
1/2  c. sliced carrots
1/2  c. sliced celery
1  large zucchini, sliced
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. lemon-pepper seasoning
1 (1 lb.)  can kidney beans
1/2  c. vermicelli or small shell macaroni
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In a Dutch oven or large, heavy saucepan, saute pork until lightly browned.  Stir in onions and garlic.  Cook until onion is tender, but not browned.  Add spaghetti sauce and next seven ingredients, mixing well.  Bring to boil.  Reduce heat to medium. Cover and cook one hour.  Stir once or twice.  Add kidney beans and vermicelli.  Simmer 15 minutes longer.  Garnish with parsley and grated cheese.  Makes 8 servings (219 calories per serving).

name: NOODLE CHARLOTTE(A good Rosh Hashanah dessert.  Serves 10.)
ingredients:
1  box wide noodles, cooked and cooled
cinnamon to taste
2  lb. sliced and peeled apples
1/4  lb. butter
1  lb. brown sugar
1/2 to 3/4  c. chopped almonds (raisins may be added)
preparation: Add filling ingredients to lined pan in layers.  Cover with additional dough.  Do not pierce.  Bake two hours at 350°.  Turn out onto platter.  Serve warm.

name: SWEET N TANGY FREEZER PICKLES
ingredients:
10  to 12 medium pickling cucumbers, thinly sliced (about 2 lb.)
3  medium onions, thinly sliced
1  large green pepper, chopped
3  Tbsp. salt, divided
2  c. sugar
1  c. white vinegar
1  Tbsp. celery seed
preparation: In a large container, combine cucumbers, onions, green pepper and 2 tablespoons salt. Cover with crushed ice; mix well. Refrigerate for 8 hours. Drain; rinse and drain again. In a saucepan, combine the sugar, vinegar, celery seed and remaining salt. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 1 minute. Spoon over cucumber mixture. Pour into jars or freezer containers. Cool. Top with lids. Cover and freeze for up to 6 weeks. Thaw at room temperature for 4 hours before serving. Makes 4 pints.

name: CARROT BARS
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
3  jars strained carrots (baby food)
2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat eggs, sugar, oil and carrots all together. Add flour, soda, cinnamon and salt. Bake in a large cookie sheet (greased) in a 325° oven.

name: CHICKEN CORDON BLEU
ingredients:
8  boneless chicken breast halves, skinned
salt and pepper to taste
4 thin  slices boiled ham, cut in half
4  slices Swiss cheese, cut in half
2 to 3  Tbsp. water
1/2  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  egg
melted butter
preparation: Place each chicken breast half between two pieces of wax paper. Use a meat mallet to flatten each piece to 1/4-inch thickness. Salt and pepper chicken.

name: TORTILLA ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
8  oz. softened cream cheese
1 small  can chopped black olives
1 small  can chopped green chiles
8  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
8  oz. sour cream
1/4  c. chopped onions or 3 chopped green onions
preparation: Mix well all ingredients.  Spread on flour tortillas.  Roll tightly and refrigerate before cutting (overnight is best.)  Makes about 15 to 20.

name: CHICKEN CONFETTI
ingredients:
4 to 5  lb. cut up chicken
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. salad oil
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove minced garlic
2 (16 oz.)  cans tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. pepper
8  oz. spaghetti, cooked and drained
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Season chicken with 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/8 teaspoon of pepper.  In a large skillet or Dutch oven, brown chicken in oil. Remove chicken.  Pour off all but 3 tablespoons of oil.  Add onion and garlic.  Cook and stir until onion is tender.  Stir in chicken and remaining ingredients, except spaghetti and cheese.  Cover tightly.  Cook chicken slowly for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until tender, adding water if necessary.  Skim off excess fat.  Serve on spaghetti.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1 (16 oz.)  can Thank You butterscotch pudding
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Mix together and put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Put half of 12 ounces chocolate chips and nuts in mix.  Top with other half of chips and nuts.  Bake at 325° for 30 to 40 minutes, until done.

name: STRAWBERRY JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 regular size  pkg. strawberry jello*
1  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed*
3/4  c. boiling water*
1  pt. sour cream
2  bananas, sliced or diced*
1  c. crushed pineapple*
preparation: *Make this mixture up twice.

name: ORIENTAL CABBAGE SALAD
ingredients:
1  small head cabbage
1  grated carrot
2  bunches green onions
1  c. sunflower seeds
1  c. slivered almonds
2  pkg. chicken-flavored Ramen noodles
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients.  Add remaining ingredients just before serving.

name: NORWEGIAN MEATBALLS
ingredients:
3  lb. regular ground beef
1  grated onion
3  Tbsp. flour
1  egg
2  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1 or 2  cans beef or mushroom gravy
preparation: Mix with enough water to make soft meat balls.  Fry or bake them and then simmer a half hour in gravy.

name: COFFEE CREAM PUNCH
ingredients:
1  gal. strong coffee
2  c. sugar
1  qt. whipped cream
2  qt. vanilla ice cream, cut in pieces
preparation: Stir sugar in coffee.  Chill.  Before serving, mix with whipped cream and vanilla ice cream, cut in pieces, about 2 to 3-inches.  Serves 60 if 1 quart of ice cream is added later.

name: BLUEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. grape jello
2  c. boiling water
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  can blueberry pie filling
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1/2  pt. sour cream
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
chopped pecans
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water and add pineapple and pie filling.  Pour into oblong dish.  Chill until congealed.  Top with cream cheese, sour cream, sugar and vanilla.  Cream together and spread on congealed salad.  Sprinkle with chopped pecans.  Chill.

name: BEST RHUBARB PIE
ingredients:
5  c. rhubarb (3/4-inch pieces)
1 1/4  c. sugar
4 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1/8  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. or less margarine or butter
your favorite double crust pie recipe*
preparation: * Let set overnight in refrigerator.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. boiled chicken, cubed
1  pkg. Uncle Ben's combined wild and long grain rice, cooked
1 medium size  jar diced pimento
1  can French-style green beans
1  can cream of celery soup
1  medium size onion, sauteed
3/4  c. each:  Swiss cheese and yellow cheese, grated
1  can water chestnuts
1  can bamboo shoots
preparation: Combine all of the ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, uncovered.

name: TOASTED TUNA BUNS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can tuna
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped sweet pickle
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
6  hamburger buns
12  slices cheese
preparation: Combine tuna fish, onion, chopped pickle and mayonnaise. Split 6 round buns and spread with tuna fish mixture.  Top with 2 slices of cheese.  Broil until cheese melts.

name: POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  pot roast
1  can mushroom soup (undiluted)
preparation: Place pot roast in slow cooker. Pour soup over roast and cook until done.  This will make your gravy when done.

name: WASHINGTON D. C. BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1  c. diced ham
1  small chopped onion
3  to 4 stalks celery, diced
2  cans bean with bacon soup
1  can cream of potato soup
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. parsley
3  cans water
preparation: Brown ham lightly in 2 tablespoons butter.  Push to one side and cook the onion and celery until tender.  Mix in crock-pot: ham, onion, celery and all other ingredients.  Simmer several hours, stirring occasionally.

name: MAGIC COOKIE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs, or plain cookie/biscuit
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
6  oz. semi-sweet chocolate chips
6  oz. butterscotch chips
1  c. grated sweetened coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.   Place melted butter in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle crumbs over butter.  Evenly spread the chips, coconut and pecans over crumbs.  Drizzle the condensed milk over all of this and bake at 350°  for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cool completely before cutting into bite-size squares.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  egg, well beaten
1  stick butter, melted
1 (17 oz.)  can whole kernel corn
1/4  c. chopped pepper (hot)
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. sour cream
1 (17 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1  box corn muffin mix
1/4  c. chopped onion
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch casserole pan for 45 minutes.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
12  oz. thin spaghetti
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Italian salad dressing
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. diced pepperoni
1/2  c. diced fully cooked ham
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. diced tomato
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped cucumber
1/4  c. sliced ripe olives
1  avocado, peeled and diced (optional)
preparation: In a saucepan, cook spaghetti in boiling water until done. Rinse with cold water; drain well.  Place in a large salad bowl and add remaining ingredients.  Toss lightly to mix.  Chill until serving.  Yields 15 to 20 servings.

name: HUDDIE'S CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1 1/2  c. sugar, mixed with 3 Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
2  c. boiling water
preparation: Melt butter in sheet pan.  Mix 1 1/2 cups sugar with 3 tablespoons of                        cocoa and mix with self-rising flour; add milk and vanilla.  Pour in melted butter and pour in buttered pan.  In separate pan mix 2 cups sugar, 1/2 cup cocoa and boiling water.  Pour over cake in pan. Do not stir!  Cook about 30 minutes at 325°.

name: CRANBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  c. chopped nuts
2  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. salad oil
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. diced dates
grated rind of 2 oranges
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. whole cranberries
preparation: Sift together dry ingredients.  Stir in nuts, dates, cranberries and orange rind.  Combine eggs, buttermilk and oil. Add to flour mixture.  Stir until blended.  Pour into well greased tube pan and bake 1 hour at 350°.  Remove to plate; place on wide pan and spoon marinade over warm cake until it is absorbed into cake.

name: NOODLE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  lb. wide noodles, cooked
1  lb. small curd cottage cheese
6  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. sugar
1  qt. milk
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine cooked noodles with cottage cheese, eggs, sugar, milk and salt.  Pour into well-greased 10 x 14-inch pan.  Bake in preheated oven at 350° for about 1 hour, or until knife comes out clean.  Cool and refrigerate in pan 8 hours or overnight.  Cut into 3-inch squares without removing from pan.  Reheat at 350° for 25 minutes.  Serve hot.

name: RHUBARB COBBLER
ingredients:
5  cups chopped rhubarb or cherries or blackberries
1  cup sugar
3  cups miniature marshmallows
1  (3 oz) pkg raspberry jello (dry) or cherry, etc.
preparation: Grease a 9x13 pan.

name: Japanese Fruit Cake
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
3  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. chopped raisins
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Sift dry ingredients; add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture.  Flour raisins and nuts.  Add to mixture.  Bake in 4 layers at 375° for 25 minutes.

name: ANGEL FLAKE BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. unsifted flour
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1  c. shortening
2  c. buttermilk
2  pkg. dry yeast
3 to 4  Tbsp. warm water
preparation: Dissolve yeast and warm water together.  Sift dry ingredients together.  Cut in shortening.  Mix buttermilk and yeast with shortening mixture.  Put in oiled bowl and refrigerate.  When ready to use, roll out on floured board and cut with biscuit cutter.  Place on greased pan and let stand for 30 minutes or longer.  Bake at 400°.  May be kept in refrigerator in covered container for a week.  Makes 40 (2-inch) biscuits.

name: PORK BARBECUE
ingredients:
2  lb. pork
2  large onions
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can tomatoes
1/3  bottle Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. red pepper
1  Tbsp. mustard
1 small  clove garlic
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. water
preparation: Have pork cut into small pieces.  Mix all ingredients and cook slowly for 7 to 8 hours or until meat falls into pieces.  Serve on 18 to 20 buns.

name: MEAT LOAF AND ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed tomato soup
2  lb. ground round beef or turkey
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
8  medium potatoes, cut into quarters
preparation: Mix 1/2 cup soup, beef or turkey, 1/2 can onions, egg and Worcestershire sauce thoroughly.  In baking pan, shape firmly into 8 x 4-inch loaf.  Place potatoes around meat loaf.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Stir potatoes.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
2  c. cubed, cooked chicken
2  Tbsp. parsley
4  c. cooked spaghetti
preparation: Combine soup and cheese over medium heat.  Bring to a boil, stirring often.  Add the cooked, cubed chicken and parsley.  Heat thoroughly, stirring often.  Serve over the spaghetti.

name: RAW POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground chuck
1/2  lb. lean ground pork
1  can condensed tomato soup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. butter
1 (8 oz.)  can mushroom stems and pieces
1  large onion, diced
3  c. raw potatoes, diced in 1/2-inch pieces
preparation: Mix ground meat with tomato soup, salt, pepper and flour.  Mix well.  Form into balls the size of golf balls.  Melt butter in skillet and brown balls on all sides.

name: TANGY GLAZED HAM
ingredients:
1  Golden Star canned or fully cooked boneless ham
whole cloves
1 (20 oz.)  can sliced pineapple
1/3  c. Heinz 57 sauce
1/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  tsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. grated orange peel
preparation: Score  ham.  Stud  with  cloves.  Heat ham according to label directions.  Drain  pineapple  (reserve 1/2 cup juice). Combine the reserved juice with remaining ingredients in small saucepan. Heat,  stirring  constantly  to  boiling.  Boil  1 minute.  During last  30  minutes  of  baking, brush ham with pineapple glaze several times.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes
1  Tbsp. margarine
pepper and salt to taste
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. water
preparation: Dice potatoes small.  Cook in enough water to cover potatoes. When tender, add margarine, salt, pepper, chicken soup and water. Bring to a boil.

name: BABY FOOD BARS
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/4  c. salad oil
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1 1/4  tsp. vanilla
4  oz. jar baby food carrots
4  oz. jar baby food applesauce
4  oz. jar baby food apricots with tapioca
2  c. flour
preparation: Mix eggs, salad oil, sugar, cinnamon, soda, salt and vanilla. Add baby food and flour.  Bake in large jelly roll pan for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.  Cool, then frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. chopped broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  c. grated cheese
1  c. milk
1  stick butter
1  pkg. cornbread stuffing mix
preparation: Cook and drain broccoli.  In large bowl mix broccoli, soup, milk and cheese.  Pour in casserole dish.  Melt butter in saucepan. Pour cornbread mix over into butter.  Mix and spread over broccoli mixture.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: ENGLISH PEA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans English peas
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.)  can sliced water chestnuts
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  stick margarine
12  saltine crackers, crumbled
preparation: Drain	English  peas  and  water  chestnuts.  Mix  all ingredients and  pour  into a casserole dish.  Melt margarine; add crumbled crackers and saute.  Spread over casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: QUESO DIP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  can Ro-Tel
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/4  c. milk
1  lb. American cheese or Velveeta cheese
preparation: Mix well and cook in double broiler, microwave or slow cook until cheese is melted.  Stir, let cool and serve with chips.

name: SPICY GLACED MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  can cream of celery soup
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. ground sage
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. shredded American cheese
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1/2  lb. ground pork
1  egg
1  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. chili sauce
preparation: Combine meats, egg, soup, bread crumbs, onion and seasoning in large bowl.  Mix lightly.  Shape into a loaf in middle of greased shallow baking pan.  Mix chili sauce, cheese and mustard in a cup. Spread on top of meat loaf.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: BAKED JOHNNY BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. corn meal
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
2  eggs
1 1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. oil
4  tsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Pour into greased 10 x 6 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch pan.  Bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Brush margarine on top.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. minced onion
1/2  medium green pepper, chopped
1 large  can shrimp, cleaned
steamed rice
1  c. chopped celery
2  cans tomato soup
preparation: Melt butter in frypan or Dutch oven.  Add onion, green pepper and celery.  Cook until tender.  Add tomato soup.  Cook 15 minutes.  Add shrimp and cook 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated.  Serve over rice.

name: SAVORY ITALIAN VEGETABLES
ingredients:
2  medium zucchini, cut in 1/4-inch slices
1  small eggplant, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1  large green pepper, cut in strips
1  medium onion, thinly sliced
1  pt. cherry tomatoes
3  oz. jar pimento stuffed olives, drained and cut in half
1/2  tsp. basil
dash of Italian seasoning
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: In large skillet, electric or not, cook veggies until tender, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  May need to add a little water.

name: NORMA'S POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. potatoes, peeled and diced
1/2  c. salad oil
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
salt to taste
pepper to taste
1/4  c. diced onion
1/2  c. chopped pickles
2  hard-boiled eggs
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. mustard
2  Tbsp. pickle juice
preparation: Boil peeled and diced potatoes in water with a little salt. While the potatoes are still hot, mix salad oil and red wine vinegar and pour over.  Add salt and pepper and mix together.  Put mixture in refrigerator overnight.  The next morning, add diced onion, pickles, celery and chopped boiled eggs.  Then mix together some mayonnaise, mustard and pickle juice according to your own tastes and mix that in with the potatoes until they are as moist as desired.

name: FOOLPROOF DARK CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. (18 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
dash of salt
1  c. shelled California walnuts, chopped
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In heavy saucepan, over low heat, melt chips with sweetened condensed milk and salt.  Remove from heat; stir in walnuts and vanilla.  Spread evenly into wax paper lined 8 or 9-inch square pan.  Chill 2 hours or until firm.  Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel off paper and cut into squares.  Store loosely covered at room temperature.  Makes about 2 pounds.

name: WHITE CHRISTMAS PIE
ingredients:
1  envelope plus 1 tsp. unflavored gelatin
1/4  c. cold water
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/4  tsp. almond extract
1  Tbsp. powdered sugar
1/2 to 3/4  c. mixed candied fruit, finely chopped
1 1/2  c. whipping cream
1/4  c. sugar
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can flaked coconut, divided
1  pastry shell
preparation: Sprinkle gelatin over cold water in a saucepan.  Let stand 1 minute. Add 1/4 cup sugar, flour, salt and milk. Cook over low heat, stirring until the gelatin dissolves and mixture is hot. Remove from heat and chill until the consistency of unbeaten egg white. Add vanilla and almond extracts.  Beat at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth. Combine fruit and powdered sugar, tossing to coat.  Set aside. Beat whipping cream until foamy. Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar, beating until soft peaks form.  Fold fruit mixture, whipping cream and 1 cup coconut into gelatin mixture. Spoon into pastry shell. Sprinkle with remaining coconut. Chill 8 hours.

name: OVEN FRIED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  to 5 medium potatoes, peeled and quartered lengthwise
3  Tbsp. Wesson oil
salt and pepper
paprika
preparation: Dip potatoes in oil.  Place in shallow pan.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.  Sprinkle with paprika last 10 minutes of baking.

name: THANKSGIVING APPLE SALAD(Serves 8)
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. heavy cream
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/4  c. (1/2 stick) butter
3  to 4 large red apples, diced
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. halved maraschino cherries
preparation: Stir together the sugar and flour. Whisk in the cream. Pour the cream mixture into a heavy non-aluminum saucepan. Continue mixing. Add the pineapple and cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until the mixture thickens. Add the butter; remove the pan from the heat and let the mixture cool. When cooled, add the apples, nuts and cherries and mix well. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: PUMPKIN CHIFFON PIE
ingredients:
2 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/3  c. milk
2  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
2  c. Cool Whip
2  c. cooked and mashed pumpkin
preparation: Mix instant pudding with the milk.  Mix all other ingredients together with pudding.  Pour into 2 baked pie shells. Top with Cool Whip and refrigerate.

name: CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
1  medium fryer chicken
1  stick margarine or butter
1  can chicken broth (Swanson)
1  can chicken soup
preparation: Boil fryer. Take meat off bones and cut or tear into small pieces.  Melt the margarine or butter and add 1 cup chicken broth and soup.  Mix well and pour over chicken.

name: LARRY'S MUFFIN PAN OATMEAL CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened (2 sticks)
1 1/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
2 1/2  c. oatmeal (Quick or old fashioned, uncooked)
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add egg, milk and vanilla.  Beat well.  Add flour, baking soda and salt.  Mix well.  Dry by rounded tablespoonfuls into greased muffin pans.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes for delicious, chewy cookies.

name: PIZZA BY THE YARD
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. chopped green onion
1/4  c. chopped black olives
1/2  tsp. dry crushed oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. rolled bread or dough
2  sliced tomatoes
1  green pepper, cut in rings
1/4  c. finely shredded cheese
preparation: Brown beef.  Drain.  Add next 6 ingredients.  Simmer 8 to 10 minutes.  Prepare dough as directed.  Lightly oil a large baking sheet and roll dough into a 14 x 16-inch rectangle.  Place the meat filling lengthwise down the center.  Cover only the center third of the dough.  With a knife, cut into the dough every 2-inches on each side.  Cross the strips diagonally over the filling, creating a braided look.  Tuck in the ends.  Let rise 5 to 10 minutes.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with tomato, green pepper slices and sprinkle with grated cheese.  Bake 5 minutes.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
2  onions, chopped
1 large  can tomatoes
1 large  can tomato puree
1  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  Tbsp. oregano
1  tsp. salt
1  whole bay leaf
dash of garlic powder
dash of pepper
1  lb. lasagna pasta
16  oz. Mozzarella cheese
15  oz. Ricotta cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger and onions; drain.  Add sugar, baking soda, oregano, salt, bay leaf, garlic powder and pepper.  Simmer for 1 hour, 1/2 of the hour uncovered.

name: MINI CHICKEN POT PIES
ingredients:
1  can frozen peas
1  c. chopped carrots
2 (5 oz.)  cans chunk white chicken, drained
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
4  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1  oz. can refrigerated buttermilk biscuits
preparation: Cook peas according to the package directions; drain well. Steam the carrots in a vegetable steamer for 2 to 3 minutes.

name: POTATO EGG SALAD
ingredients:
10  medium potatoes
5  hard-boiled eggs
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  small cucumber, chopped
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
sliced olives
3/4  c. salad dressing
preparation: Boil potatoes for about 25 minutes so they are still firm; peel and cube.  Better if cooked the night before.  Chop up the eggs. Put all the ingredients in a large bowl and mix.  One-fourth cup half and half can be added to salad dressing if needed.

name: COMPANY HAM AND NOODLES
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. margarine
10  oz. fully cooked ham, julienned (about 2 c.)
2  tsp. all-purpose flour
1  c. (8 oz.) sour cream
1  c. (8 oz.) sliced mushrooms, drained
hot cooked noodles
chopped fresh parsley (optional)
preparation: In a skillet over medium heat, saute onion in margarine until tender.  Add ham, cook and stir until heated through.   Sprinkle with flour.  Stir 1 minute.  Reduce heat to low and gradually stir in sour cream.  Add mushrooms, cook and stir until thickened, about 2 to 3 minutes.  Serve over noodles.  Garnish with parsley, if desired.  Yield: 6 servings.

name: BACON-WRAPPED CORN
ingredients:
12  fresh corn-on-the-cob
12  bacon strips
butter or oleo
seasoned salt
pepper
preparation: Pull husks away from corn.  Wrap corn with a bacon strip.  Pat with butter or oleo.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Re-wrap corn in husks.  Place in foil wraps.  Sprinkle on 2 tablespoons water. Wrap and seal.  Cook on grill 30 to 40 minutes, turning once.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
3  c. grated carrots
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. corn oil
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix  all  dry  ingredients  together.  Add  oil,  eggs, vanilla and blend well.  Bake in three 9-inch pans at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: RAVE REVIEW COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  box (4 serving) Jell-O vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
4  eggs
2  c. Angel Flake coconut
1 1/3  c. water
1/4  c. oil
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Blend cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil in large bowl.  Beat at medium speed with electric mixer for 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and nuts.  Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Cool in pans 15 minutes; remove and cool on rack.  Fill and top with Coconut Cream Cheese Frosting.

name: VEG-ALL CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans Veg-All, drained
1/2  c. onions, chopped fine
1/2  c. grated cheese
1  c. celery, chopped fine
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix together and top with 1 package Waverly wafers or soda crackers mixed with 1 stick of margarine.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: EASY ENCHILADAS!
ingredients:
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1 large  jar salsa (mild or hot per taste)
2  lb. ground beef
2  c. shredded sharp cheese
1  pkg. flour tortillas
lettuce, chopped
tomatoes, chopped
sour cream
preparation: In skillet, brown ground beef in 1 cup water.  Add taco seasoning and 1/2 jar of salsa.  Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Heat tortillas per package directions.  Spoon mixture into wraps and roll.  Put into baking pan, seam side down.  Pour leftover filling and other half of salsa over top.  Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until cheese is slightly browned. Enjoy with lettuce, tomatoes and sour cream!

name: WHOLE GREEN BEANS WITH BACON
ingredients:
2  lb. fresh green beans
4  slices bacon, cut in pieces
1 1/2  c. water
salt and pepper
preparation: Wash beans and remove ends.  Leave beans whole.  Cook and stir beans, bacon, water, salt and pepper for 5 minutes.  Reduce heat. Cover.  Cook 25 minutes or until beans are tender.

name: TOFFEE SQUARES
ingredients:
1  cup butter or margarine, softened
1  cup packed brown sugar
1  egg yolk
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2  cups all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  pkgs. (4 oz. each) German sweet chocolate
1/2  cup chopped nuts
preparation: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.  Add egg yolk, vanilla, flour and salt; mix well.  Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan.  Bake at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.  Melt chocolate in a heavy saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly.  Spread over hot bars.  Sprinkle immediately with nuts.  Cool; cut into 1-1/4 inch squares.

name: CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
2  strips bacon
1/2  c. red pepper
sliced scallions
1  can chicken broth
1 (15 oz.)  can creamed corn
2  Tbsp. cream
preparation: Dice and saute bacon until crisp.  Pour off fat.  Add red pepper and sliced scallions.  Cook 4 minutes.  Add chicken broth and creamed corn.  Add cream.  Simmer 5 minutes.  Serves approximately 4.

name: DEER STEW
ingredients:
2 or 3  lb. deer meat
2  large onions
3  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. vinegar
3  Tbsp. catsup
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Brown meat; cut into pieces in bacon fat.  Add 2 large onions, sliced.  Continue browning.  When nicely browned, stir in 3 tablespoons flour.  Place in baking dish and add vinegar, catsup, sugar and salt and pepper to taste.  Cover meat with water and bake at 375° for 2 to 3 hours or until tender, adding water as needed to keep meat covered.  When done, thicken gravy and serve.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. seasoned pork sausage
1  large onion, chopped
1  large green pepper
2  stalks celery
1  medium zucchini, sliced
1 large  can mushrooms, drained
1  Tbsp. oleo
2 1/2  c. Minute rice
2  Tbsp. Italian seasoning
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
3  eggs
3 to 4  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. salt and pepper
1  chopped tomato
nacho chips
1/2  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown sausage.  Drain fat and set aside.  Saute vegetables in oleo; set aside.  Prepare Minute rice according to package directions.  Add Italian seasoning and garlic powder to rice. Mix eggs together with Parmesan, salt and pepper. Combine sausage, zucchini, rice and egg mixture with tomato.  Crush nacho chips and place in bottom of two 9-inch pie dishes.  Divide mixture between dishes over chips.  Sprinkle 1/2 cup grated Mozzarella cheese over each dish.  Bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.

name: PEPPERS
ingredients:
32  oz. ketchup
1  pt. vinegar
3  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  c. cooking oil
3  gal. hot peppers
preparation: Mix all ingredients in pot.  Cook 15 minutes.  Pack in jars and process 15 minutes.

name: BAKED SPAGHETTI I
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes (with liquid), cut up
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
1 (2 1/4 oz.)  can sliced ripe olives, drained
2  tsp. dried oregano
1  lb. ground beef, browned and drained (optional)
12  oz. spaghetti, cooked and drained
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In a large skillet saute onion and green pepper in butter until tender.  Add tomatoes, mushrooms, olives and oregano.   Add ground beef if desired.  Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes.  Place half of the spaghetti in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with half of the vegetable mixture.  Sprinkle with 1 cup of Cheddar cheese.  Repeat layers.  Mix the soup and water until smooth; pour over casserole.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until heated through. Makes 12 servings.

name: WATERMELON DESSERT
ingredients:
1  pt. raspberry sherbet
1  pt. pineapple sherbet
1  pt. lime sherbet
1  pkg. mini chocolate chips
preparation: Chill deep Tupperware bowl.  Pack lime sherbet around edge of bowl, center hollow.  Set in freezer until solid; pack in pineapple sherbet; set until frozen, put in 1/2 of raspberry sherbet. Sprinkle in chips; finish filling with raspberry sherbet.  Freeze until solid.  Unmold and slice like watermelon.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. Eagle Brand milk (condensed)
1  c. Cool Whip
1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix together and sprinkle top with nutmeg.  Very good dip for strawberries, cherries, white grapes, pineapple, cantaloupe, etc.

name: GRANDMA PESL'S RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
3  c. cooked rice
2  eggs
3/4  c. milk
3/4  c. sugar or sugar to taste
1/2  stick margarine
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/3  c. chopped maraschino cherries
1/2  tsp. vanilla
miniature marshmallows
preparation: Cook  rice  as directed on  box.  Beat  eggs  and  milk together.  Remove rice from heat and add milk and egg mixture. Stir  quickly  and thoroughly so  eggs  won't  cook!  Stir  in margarine,  sugar and vanilla.  Add  pineapple  and  cherries. Return mixture to stove for about  10  minutes, cooking on low heat, stirring so it won't stick.  Pour  into a casserole dish and sprinkle marshmallows on top.  Bake  at 300° until some of the liquid is absorbed (20 to 25 minutes).

name: APPETIZER
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. chopped walnuts
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. chopped pimiento
1  Tbsp. catsup
3  eggs, hard-boiled and chopped
3/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Use as a filling between lightly buttered slices of sandwich bread.  Trim crust if desired.  Cut each sandwich diagonally in 4 triangles.  Makes 2/3 cup filling.

name: GULYAS SOUP WITH MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. stewing steak
1  Tbsp. fat
1  onion
1  tsp. paprika pepper
1 level  tsp. caraway seed
1  lb. potatoes
1  egg
1  cupful breadcrumbs
black ground pepper
preparation: Mince the meat and in the heated fat, brown the chopped onion. Add the paprika pepper and the caraway seed to the browned onion. Stir and pour in one and a half pints to cold water.   Now mix the minced meat with moist bread crumbs and the egg.  Season well with salt and pepper and shape into small balls.

name: FETA CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  pkg. cream cheese
4  oz. Feta cheese
2  sticks margarine
1  tsp. oregano
1  clove garlic
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Serve with tomatoes, green peppers, black olives, onions and French bread.  (If double the recipe, only use the 2 sticks of margarine.)

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans
1  stick margarine
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  box powdered sugar
preparation: Mix coconut and pecans together and place in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan or dish. Fix cake mix according to package directions and pour over coconut and pecans and mix together. Melt margarine and mix with cream cheese and sugar. Stir this batter with knife through the top of the cake mix and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY SURPRISE
ingredients:
2  c. finely crushed pretzels
1/3  c. sugar
2/3  c. margarine or butter, melted
12  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. milk
1  c. thawed Cool Whip
2  c. boiling water
1 (8 serving size)  pkg. or 2 (4 serving size) pkg. strawberry flavored gelatin
1 1/2  c. cold water
2  pt. sliced strawberries or 20 oz. pkg. frozen strawberries, sliced
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix crushed pretzels, 1/3 cup sugar and margarine.  Press firmly into bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake 10 minutes.  Cool.

name: QUICK SALAD/DESSERT
ingredients:
1  large (24 oz.) container cottage cheese
1  small container Cool Whip
1 small  box jello
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
nuts (as many as you like)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  pork chops (better if deboned)
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can beef consomme
1/2  tsp. salt
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  stick margarine or butter
1  c. uncooked rice
preparation: Note:  If you like, you can use onion soup instead of mushroom and you can add 1 (6 ounce) can water chestnuts, drained and sliced and 1/2 cup of chopped parsley.

name: CHOCOLATE SURPRISE
ingredients:
1  c flour
1  c pecans (pieces)
1/2  or 2/3 c soft margarine
preparation: Mix ingredients together and then press in pan, bake for 15 minutes at 350 F.

name: EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. self-rising flour
4  eggs, well beaten
1/2  stick butter, melted
2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla or lemon flavor
preparation: Mix well.  Pour into 2 greased pie plates.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: ORANGE BRUNCH PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. biscuit mix
1  c. quick cooking oats
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. orange juice
1 1/2  tsp. finely shredded orange peel
1  c. milk
2  eggs
orange honey syrup
preparation: Stir together biscuit mix, oats, sugars and peel.  Beat together eggs, milk, juice and vanilla with rotary beater; add to flour mixture.  Stir until blended; let stand 5 minutes.  For each pancake, pour about 1/4 cup batter onto hot, lightly greased griddle.  Cook over medium-low heat for about 3 minutes until golden brown, turning once.

name: KRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. 11 oz. kraut
2  c. onions, finely chopped
2  c. celery, finely chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, finely chopped
1  red pepper, finely chopped
1/2  c. pimentos
2  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
preparation: Combine the kraut, onion, celery, peppers and pimentos. Combine the sugar and vinegar.  Bring to a boil.  Pour over kraut mixture.  Refrigerate.

name: "CHESS BARS"
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  stick oleo, softened
1  egg
preparation: Mix together and press into 9 x 13 pan. (I use my food processor.)

name: HELLO DOLLIE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine or butter
1  pkg. shredded coconut (1 1/2 c.)
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. crushed graham crackers
1  pkg. small chocolate morsels
1  can condensed milk
preparation: Melt margarine in pan. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over to form crust. Sprinkle coconut over graham cracker crust. Sprinkle chocolate morsels over coconut. Sprinkle chopped nuts over chocolate. Pour can of milk over mixture and let set. Bake in oven at 350° until brown. Let cool before cutting into squares.

name: PARTY CRACKERS
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  boxes oyster crackers
1  c. oil
1  Tbsp. dill weed
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix (original)
preparation: Mix together well.  Let set 3 hours.

name: FRUIT CAKE SQUARES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter (2 sticks)
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs (one at a time)
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
Pie filling
preparation: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs one at at time, and mix well.  Add vanilla.  Mix in flour.  Set aside 1 cup of dough and spread remaining dough into a greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan. Spread pie filling on top.  Drop remaining dough on top of pie filling.  After dropping remaining dough on top of filling take a knife and spread the dough so the globs of dough connect slightly with one another.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage (hot or mild)
3  c. Bisquick
1  pkg. Cracker Barrel Black Label cheese
preparation: Melt cheese in medium saucepan.  Mix Bisquick and sausage thoroughly, then add melted cheese and mix.  Form into small balls; bake until lightly browned in a 350° oven for approximately 20 to 30 minutes.  Can be frozen before or after baking.  (Good party recipe.)

name: COCONUT CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/3  tsp. salt
1  tsp. flour
3  eggs, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. shredded coconut
2  tsp. cornstarch
2 1/4  c. milk
3/4  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix together the sugar, salt, cornstarch and flour.  Stir in milk and beaten egg yolks.  Cook in saucepan on medium heat, stirring continually.  Add butter and vanilla.  Fold in coconut. Pour in baked pie shell.

name: HOLIDAY SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. Mandarin oranges
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. small marshmallows
1  c. pineapple chunks, drained
9  oz. Cool Whip
1  c. coconut
preparation: Mix well and chill before serving.

name: FRIED LUMPIA(Egg Rolls)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef or pork (or both), cooked & drained
1  cup cabbage, shredded
1/4  lb. shrimp (optional), cooked & chopped
1/4  cup mushrooms, chopped
1/2  cup carrots, shredded
salt & pepper, to taste
1  pkg. Lumpia Wrappers
preparation: Cook and drain beef/pork; add shrimp. Combine all other ingredients and mix thoroughly. Place mixture in egg roll wrapper and roll. Fry in deep fat until brown. Serve with sweet and sour sauce or hot mustard.

name: BARBECUE CUPS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. barbecue sauce
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 (10 oz.)  can biscuits
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion in a large skillet. Drain and stir in barbecue sauce and brown sugar.  Heat until very hot. Set aside.  Separate biscuits and place each in an ungreased muffin cup.  Press dough to cover bottom and sides of cup. Spoon mixture into cups. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. rotini noodles
1  large Italian dressing
4  small tomatoes
2  cucumbers
1  green pepper
1  medium purple onion
1  bottle Salad Supreme
preparation: Cook noodles until firm and set aside.  Chop all vegetables; add dressing and Salad Supreme.  Marinate overnight.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
10  slices bread, broken in small pieces
4  c. scalded milk
1  c. cream
4  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  c. melted butter
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Start combining the pieces of bread with the scalded milk and cream.  Beat the eggs and sugar; mix well.  Stir in the bread mixture.  Add the vanilla, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Stir in the melted butter and raisins.  Pour the mixture into a 2-quart buttered baking dish.  Set in a pan of warm water, about 1-inch deep.  Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour, or until knife cut in center comes out clean dry.

name: SWEET FRUIT DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. celery salt
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. onion juice
1  c. salad oil
1/4  c. vinegar
preparation: Mix dry ingredients; add onion juice.  Add oil, a small amount at a time, alternately with vinegar, the last addition being vinegar.  Use mixer until blended.  Makes 1 1/2 cups.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. butter, melted
1  pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked and drained
2  c. chicken, cooked and sliced
1  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and melted butter until smooth.  Place broccoli in casserole dish.  Add chicken and pour sauce on top.  Sprinkle with bread crumbs.   Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: HOPPING JOHN
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
4 to 6  slices bacon
1 small  box cooked rice
green chilies
2  cans black-eyed peas
preparation: Brown the ground beef; drain grease and set beef aside.  Fry the bacon; set aside.  Pour bacon grease into ground beef.  Cook rice.  Mix cooked rice and ground beef together.  Cut up bacon; add it to mixture.  Add a little green chilies, along with its juice, to desired hotness.  Add the black-eyed peas.  Simmer 10 to 15 minutes.

name: TAFFY APPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  can (8 oz.) crushed pineapple, drained
1  carton (8 oz.) whipped topping
2  c. apples, chopped
1  c. dry roasted peanuts
preparation: Combine flour, sugar, egg, vinegar and pineapple in saucepan.  Cook over medium heat, stirring until thickened.  Cool.  Fold in whipped topping, apples and peanuts.  Chill overnight.

name: MERINGUE FOR PIE THAT WON'T WEEP OR SHRINK
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. water
3  egg whites
salt
6  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Cook cornstarch, sugar and water until clear. Set aside.

name: PINEAPPLE CRUSH CAKE
ingredients:
1  box pineapple cake mix
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  pkg. (4 serving size) vanilla instant pudding and pie filling mix
2  c. cold milk
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  c. whipped topping
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour 2 (13 x 9 x 2-inch) pans.  Prepare cake as directed on package.  Divide evenly in pans.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes; follow package directions for doneness test and cooling.

name: PEACHES AND CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
20  oz. can crushed pineapple
2  pkg. frozen peaches
1  box white cake mix, dry
1/4 - 1/2  c. brown sugar
1  stick melted butter
1  handful or more raisins
preparation: Layer the pineapple in cake pan. Put 1 bag of peaches next, then the dry cake mix, then the other bag of peaches, then brown sugar, melted butter and raisins. Bake at 350 degrees for about 1 hour. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

name: SWEET PICKLES
ingredients:
whole cucumbers
brine salt
preparation: Use 2 cups salt for 3 gallons of cucumbers.  Let stay 9 days. Wash and slice. Cover with alum water (a 10 cent can).  Let stay 24 hours. Wash and cover with vinegar.  Let stay 24 hours. Drain and put a layer of cucumbers and a layer of sugar.  Use gallon jug to pack pickles in.

name: CHICKEN MARENGO
ingredients:
2  ready to cook broiler fryers (2 lb. size), quartered
3  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. olive or salad oil
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  clove garlic, crushed
1/2  tsp. dried thyme leaves
1/2  tsp. dried basil leaves
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
4 ripe tomatoes (2 lb.) or 1 (1  lb. 10 oz.) can Italian plum tomatoes (undrained)
3  Tbsp. tomato paste
1/2  tsp. sugar
2  drops Tabasco
1  c. dry white wine
1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms
preparation: Wash chicken under cold water; remove skin if desired.  Dry well on paper towels.  On sheet of waxed paper, combine flour, salt and pepper; mix well.  Roll chicken pieces in flour mixture, coating evenly.  In 5-quart Dutch oven, slowly heat the olive oil and 2 tablespoons butter.  Saute all chicken pieces on both sides in hot fat until browned.  Remove and set aside.  Add the garlic, thyme, basil and parsley to Dutch oven.  Saute over medium heat 5 minutes.  If using fresh tomatoes, scald in boiling water; peel skins.  Cut tomatoes in quarters; add to Dutch oven.  (If using canned tomatoes, add with liquid.)  Add tomato paste, sugar, Tabasco and 3/4 cup of the wine.  Stir to mix well.  Place chicken in sauce.  Bring to boiling; reduce heat and simmer, covered, 40 minutes.

name: SKILLET SUPPER
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  small onion
1  small chopped bell pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
8  oz. egg noodles
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Cook noodles according to package directions. Set aside. Heat skillet to 350°. Add ground beef, onion and pepper. Cook until meat is brown and vegetables are tender. Drain well. Spread meat and vegetables mixture evenly in skillet. Place cooked noodles in center. Spoon tomato sauce and grated cheese on top of mixture. Serves 4 to 6.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
7  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1 rounded  Tbsp. cocoa
1  pt. milk
2  eggs, separated
1  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. vanilla
1  (9-inch) cooked pastry shell
preparation: Mix sugar, flour, cocoa and salt in top of a double boiler. Add milk slowly and stir and cook over heat until boiling point is reached.  Place over hot water and cook approximately 20 minutes. Add well beaten egg yolks and butter; cook for 2 minutes.  Remove from heat and add vanilla.  Cool and turn into cooked pastry shell.  Spread with meringue made from egg whites and bake until meringue is brown.

name: PHIL'S FAVORITE
ingredients:
1 very full  c. flour
1  stick soft margarine
1/3  c. chopped walnuts or pecans (optional)
1  (8 oz.) softened cream cheese
12  oz. Cool Whip
1  c. confectioners sugar
2  (3 oz.) packs instant lemon, chocolate or butterscotch pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: First layer:  Whip together flour and margarine with mixer. Add nuts.  Pat in 9 x 13-inch pan or baking dish.  Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.  Let cool.

name: GRANDMA'S FRITO PIE
ingredients:
1 medium  pkg. Fritos
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 large  can Pet milk
1  large green pepper, chopped
hot jalapeno pepper, chopped (to taste)
1  lb. hamburger, cooked and drained
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  lb. cheese
preparation: Combine and bake 20 minutes at 350°.

name: MARINATED SALAD
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower
1  head broccoli
fresh mushrooms
1  green pepper
1  small onion (purple)
cherry tomatoes
preparation: Cut ingredients into small pieces; mix together except for mushrooms and tomatoes.  You will add them before serving.

name: CROCK-POT CHEESE SOUFFLE
ingredients:
12  slices white bread, crust trimmed and cubed
10  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
10  oz. medium Cheddar cheese, shredded
4  eggs, beaten
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Grease crock-pot well with margarine.  Layer bread cubes and shredded cheeses in crock-pot.  Mix together eggs, evaporated milk, milk and salt.  Pour over bread and cheese in crock-pot. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.  Serve hot.

name: ROMAINE SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  qt. safflower oil
3  cloves garlic, crushed
5  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
1/2  lb. Blue or Roquefort cheese
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. coarse ground pepper
salt to taste
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Blend in food processor.  Store in refrigerator for 2 or 3 days before using.  Serve over romaine, croutons and avocados and sprinkle with Parmesan.

name: VANILLA WAFER CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  sticks butter
6  eggs
1/2  c. milk
12  oz. box vanilla wafers, crumbled
7  oz. can coconut
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Cream sugar and butter; add eggs, one at a time. Mix well. Add milk, cracker crumbs, coconut and nuts. Bake in 3 (9-inch) pans at 325° until done.

name: TUNA PATTIES
ingredients:
2  cans tuna
2  handfuls corn flakes, crushed
1  egg
3/4  onion
3/4  c. celery
preparation: Fry in a skillet until brown and stays together.  Tastes like fried chicken.

name: CUSTARD PIE NO CRUST
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  c. milk
1/2  c. Bisquick
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
1/2  stick butter, cut in pieces
preparation: Put all ingredients in blender for 3 minutes.  Pour into a greased 10-inch pie plate.  Sprinkle top generously with nutmeg or coconut before baking at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BRUNCH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
16  slices white bread
1  lb. ham, shredded
1  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1 1/2  c. Swiss cheese, grated
6  eggs, beaten
3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
pinch of nutmeg
dash of Worcestershire sauce
2 1/2  c. crushed corn flakes
1/4  stick melted butter
preparation: Remove crusts from bread; cut each slice in half.  Put half the bread slices in greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.  Cover with shredded ham and cheeses.  Top with remaining bread slices.

name: CHOW CHOW RELISH
ingredients:
3  qt. ripe tomatoes
2  c. green peppers (bell or hot)
2  c. red peppers (bell or hot)
3  c. onions
2  c. celery
4  c. cabbage
1/4  c. salt
3  c. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. pickling spices
1  qt. vinegar
preparation: Chop vegetables fine.  Mix with salt and sugar.  Put spices in cheesecloth bag.  Simmer in vinegar for 30 minutes.  Cool and pour over vegetables.  Let stand overnight.   In the morning, remove bag of spices and heat to boiling point.  Pack in hot, sterilized jars and seal at once.

name: RAISIN SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  box raisins
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cocoa
1/4  tsp. cloves
2  c. water
1/3  c. shortening
1  Tbsp. baking soda
4  c. flour (approximately)
2  c. sugar
1  c. water
preparation: Cook raisins, cinnamon, salt, cocoa, cloves and water over medium hot stove for 15 minutes.  It will be rather thick and raisins will get soft.  Let cool.

name: CHERRY SURPRISE
ingredients:
2  cans cherry pie filling
1 1/2  sticks margarine, melted
1  c. chopped nuts
1  box white or yellow cake mix
preparation: Pour cherry pie filling into an oblong baking dish.  Sprinkle a box of cake mix on top of the pie filling.  Pour the melted margarine on and top with the nuts.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI RICE/CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3/4  stick margarine
1  small onion
1  c. raw rice, cooked
1  can cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. jar Cheez Whiz
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1 small  can evaporated milk (use 1/2 can to start)
preparation: Mix all.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: CONGO BARS
ingredients:
1  box brown sugar (light, 1 lb.)
1 1/2  sticks margarine
3  eggs
2 2/3  c. flour (all-purpose)
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
1 small  pkg. chocolate chips
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt sugar and margarine together.  Add 3 beaten eggs.  Stir. Add flour, baking powder and vanilla.  Stir.  Add nuts and chips. Stir.  Batter will be thick.  Spread in a greased and floured 11 x 15-inch pan.  Bake 30 minutes in 350° oven.  Remove promptly and cool 2 hours before cutting in bars.

name: MERINGUE KISSES
ingredients:
3  eggs whites
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Blend together egg whites and salt until very stiff.  Stir in gradually the sugar, beating after each addition of sugar until very stiff again.  Add vanilla and beat again.  Cover a cookie sheet with a brown paper bag.  Drop large spoonfuls on paper bag. Bake 50 minutes in 300° oven until light brown.

name: FIRST PLACE CHILI
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
1/2  green bell pepper, finely chopped
1 medium  clove garlic, finely chopped
20  oz. tomato sauce
3  oz. tomato paste
2  Tbsp. salsa
1  medium onion, finely chopped
1  stalk celery, finely chopped
2  lb. ground meat (beef, turkey, vegieburger)
2  c. water
1  fresh jalapeno
2  Tbsp. ground hot red pepper
1  Tbsp. ground mild red pepper
1  tsp. ground cumin
1  tsp. dried oregano
1 1/2  tsp. salt
freshly ground pepper to taste
preparation: Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat.  Add the onions, bell pepper, celery and garlic.  Cook, stirring until the onions are translucent.  Add the meat to the pot a little at a time, stirring occasionally, until the meat is evenly browned.  Stir the remaining ingredients.  Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer, uncovered, for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.  Stir often.  Taste and adjust seasonings.

name: GREEN BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can cut green beans
1  can cut wax beans
1  can red kidney beans
1  medium onion, cut
1  green pepper, cut
1  c. white vinegar
2  c. white sugar
1  Tbsp. oil
1  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Heat until boils the vinegar, sugar, oil and celery seed.  Let cool some, then pour over beans and let stand at least 12 hours.

name: ELEPHANT STEW
ingredients:
1  young elephant
300  lb. potatoes
50  lb. onions
150  lb. carrots
season to taste
1  rabbit, skinned
preparation: Cut elephant in bite-size pieces.  Boil for 4 weeks, add vegetables and seasonings.  Simmer for 1 week.  Will serve 1,000 people.  If you have unexpected company, add the rabbit. Everybody likes a little hare in their stew.

name: EASY CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
2  blocks unsweetened chocolate
1  stick butter
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
preparation: Melt the chocolate and butter until blended.  Beat the eggs and sugar together.  Combine all ingredients.  Pour into an unbaked pie shell and bake for 25 minutes in a 375° preheated oven.  Top with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream, if desired.

name: 3 BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans each drained beans: green beans, yellow beans and red kidney beans
1/2  c. salad oil
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  medium onion, quartered
1/2  green pepper
preparation: Combine salad oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper, onion and green pepper in blender and pour over beans.  Chill before serving.  Flavor improves overnight or longer.

name: BAKED POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
4  large potatoes
2/3  c. butter or margarine
2/3  c. all-purpose flour
6  c. milk
3/4  tsp. pepper
4  green onions
12  slices bacon, crumbled
1 1/4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
8  oz. sour cream
preparation: Wash potatoes and prick several times with a fork.  Bake at 400° for 1 hour or until done.  Let cool.  Cut potatoes in half lengthwise, then scoop out pulp.  Melt butter in heavy saucepan over low heat.  Add flour and stir until smooth.  Cook 1 minute. Gradually add milk.  Cook until mixture thickens.  Add potato pulp, salt, pepper, 2 tablespoons green onions, 1/2 cup bacon and 1 cup cheese.  Cook until thoroughly heated.  Then stir in sour cream. Add extra milk if necessary.  Serve with remaining onions, cheese and bacon.  Yield:  10 cups.

name: STRAWBERRY PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. pretzels, crushed
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
3/4  c. margarine
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1  medium Cool Whip
1  large strawberry jello
2  c. boiling water
2  c. strawberries (fresh or frozen)
preparation: Mix pretzels, brown sugar and margarine.  Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes; cool.  Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and sugar.  Pour onto cooled pretzel crust, spreading evenly. Mix jello, water and strawberries.  Chill until slightly thickened, then pour over cream cheese layer.  Spread evenly. Chill in refrigerator until jello is set.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH PIE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  stick butter
2  c. milk
2  egg yolks
5  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put brown sugar and butter in iron skillet or nonstick pan. Cook until dark brown.  Mix milk, egg yolks, flour and vanilla. Mix in a bowl and then add to brown sugar and cook until thick.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
3  c. milk
1/3  c. raisins
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/3  c. uncooked rice
preparation: In a saucepan, bring milk to a boil.  Stir in rice and raisins.  Cover; cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 30 minutes, or until most of the milk is absorbed.  Stir in sugar and vanilla.  Spoon into dishes; sprinkle with nutmeg.  Makes 5 to 6 servings.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1- 8 oz  package of cream cheese
1/3  cup Catalina dressing
1  Tbsp ketchup
1  Tbsp minced onion
preparation: Blend in blender. Add 1 can salad shrimp-spooning them into above mixture.

name: MUD PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate wafers
1/2  c. melted butter
2  pt. mocha ice cream
1/3  c. cocoa
2/3  c. sugar
1 1/3  c. whipping cream
3  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. vanilla extract
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Crush wafers and add melted butter. Mix well with a fork and press into a 9-inch pie plate.  Bake for 10 minutes.  Cool.  Spread ice cream carefully onto crust.  Freeze 1 1/2 hours or until solid.  In a saucepan, cook cocoa, sugar, 1/3 cup cream and butter until it is smooth and boils.  Stir in 1 teaspoon vanilla.  Cool but do not let mixture get too hard to pour.  Pour sauce over frozen ice cream base.  Freeze at least 1 1/2 hours.  Before serving, whip remaining cream with 2 tablespoons sugar until soft peaks form.  Add remaining vanilla and spread over pie.  Garnish with chocolate shavings.

name: BANANA SLUSH
ingredients:
3  bananas
12  oz. frozen orange juice
6  oz. frozen lemonade
1  c. sugar
2  liter Sprite
3  c. water
preparation: Combine bananas, orange juice, lemonade and sugar in blender. Blend until smooth.  Mix with remaining ingredients in a large container. Freeze overnight, stirring once.  Let thaw to slushy stage and serve.  Serves 23 (6 ounce) cups.

name: TOSTADO
ingredients:
12  oz. lean ground beef
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 (16 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
8  tostado shells, broken into quarters
1  c. shredded cheese (4 oz.)
1  c. chopped onions
1/2  tsp. ground cumin
1/2  tsp. leaf oregano, crumbled
2  Tbsp. flour (all-purpose)
1 (4 oz.)  can diced green chilies, undrained
1 (16 oz.)  can pinto beans, rinsed and drained
preparation: Position oven rack in upper third of oven and preheat to very hot (450°).  Crumble beef into large heavy skillet and place over moderately high heat.  Add onion and garlic; cook 5 to 8 minutes or until meat is no longer pink.  Drain off fat.  Add cumin, oregano, salt, pepper and flour.  Stir over medium heat for 1 minute.  Add tomatoes and chilies; cook for 3 minutes or until thickened.

name: CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cornmeal
1  Tbsp. self-rising flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1/2  stick butter
preparation: Mix ingredients together well. Pour into greased baking pan and bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
2 3/4  c. milk
3  large egg yolks
3  sq. (3 oz.) unsweetened chocolate
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1  baked pie shell
sweetened whipped cream
preparation: Combine sugar, cornstarch and salt in large saucepan. Gradually stir in milk.  Bring to a boil over medium-high heat; stirring gently.  Boil 1 minute.  Remove from heat.  Beat egg yolks lightly in small bowl; gradually whisk in 1 cup of hot mixture and return to saucepan.  Return to boil and cook 1 minute. Remove from heat.  Coarsely chop chocolate.  Whisk in chocolate, butter and vanilla until smooth.  Pour into baked pie crust.  Cook 15 minutes on wire rack.  Cover with wax paper.  Refrigerate 3 hours.  Top with sweetened whipped cream.

name: TACO RING
ingredients:
3/4  lb. lean ground beef
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. water
2  pkg. crescent rolls
3  c. lettuce, shredded
1  medium tomato
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. pitted ripe olives
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°. In skillet, cook ground beef and drain fat. In separate bowl, mix beef, taco seasoning mix, cheese and water. Unroll crescent rolls. Separate into triangles. Arrange triangles in a circle on a pizza pan with wide ends overlapping in center and points toward the outside. There should be a 5-inch diameter opening in the center. Scoop meat mixture evenly onto the widest end of each triangle. Bring points of triangles up over filling and tuck under wide ends of dough at center of ring. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. After the ring is cooked, place the chopped lettuce, tomato, black olives, onions and cheese in the middle of the ring. To serve, cut in slices.

name: PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. shortening
1  egg, beaten
5  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix flour, salt and shortening until shortening is well crumbled.  Mix beaten egg, water and vinegar together.  Add to flour mixture.  This can be rolled out and used now or kept in the freezer and used as needed.

name: PESTO SAUCE
ingredients:
2  cloves garlic, peeled
1  tsp. salt
2  c. tightly packed fresh basil leaves
2  Tbsp. finely chopped pine nuts
1/2  c. olive oil
1/2  c. freshly grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. freshly grated Romano cheese
4  Tbsp. butter, softened
preparation: In  the mixing bowl of a food processor or blender, put the garlic,  salt, basil, pine nuts and olive oil and process until smooth,  scraping down sides one or two times.  Add the cheeses and butter and process very briefly, just to incorporate the cheeses and butter.  Add 2 tablespoons of the boiling water in which pasta cooked.  If sauce is still too thick, add a little more boiling water.  Process for 1 to 2 seconds.  The sauce is now ready for the cooked pasta.  Serves 4 to 6 for 1 pound thin pasta.

name: SWEET POTATO CAKE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. hot water
1 1/2  c. cooking oil
2  c. sugar
4  eggs, separated
2 1/2  c. sifted plain flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. nuts
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1 1/2  c. grated raw sweet potatoes
preparation: Combine cooking oil and sugar and beat well.  Add hot water. Add dry ingredients which have been sifted together.  Stir in potatoes, nuts and vanilla and beat well.  Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture.  Bake in 3 greased 8-inch layer pans at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Use light icing if you want, but it is good as is.

name: JAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
3  c. flour
2  tsp. allspice or nutmeg
3  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. jam
1  c. raisins
1  c. nuts
4  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Cream together shortening and sugar.  Sift together flour, allspice or nutmeg, cinnamon and cocoa.  Add jam, raisins and nuts to cream mixture.  Beat eggs and add to cream mixture.  Dissolve soda in buttermilk.  Add flour and milk alternately to sugar mixture. Bake in 350° oven for 60 to 75 minutes.

name: LEMON CAKE PUDDING
ingredients:
1/4  c. sifted flour
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. grated lemon rind
1/4  c. lemon juice
2  egg yolks, beaten
2  egg whites, stiffly beaten
preparation: Sift first 3 ingredients together into mixing bowl.  Stir in lemon rind, lemon juice and egg yolks.  Fold in egg whites.  Pour into 1-quart baking dish.  Set in pan of hot water 1-inch deep. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.  Serve warm or cold, with or without whipped cream.  Serves 6.

name: CAULIFLOWER AND BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower
1  bunch fresh broccoli
red or green onion
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  lb. bacon, fried and crumbled
preparation: Cut vegetables in small pieces. Mix rest of ingredients together.

name: BAKED WATER CHESTNUTS
ingredients:
chestnuts (whole)
bacon
1  c. ketchup
1/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Wrap whole chestnuts in half slices of bacon.   Put in ungreased baking dish.  Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes, uncovered, at 325°.   Remove from oven and drain grease, then mix ketchup, sugar and lemon juice and pour over chestnuts.  Then bake for 20 minutes.

name: PORCUPINE MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburg
1  c. rice (raw)
1  egg
1  can tomato soup
2  c. beef gravy
preparation: Mix hamburg, rice and egg together, then roll into meat balls. Put tomato soup, gravy and meatballs in kettle.  Cover and cook slowly about 45 minutes or until meatballs are done.

name: CHERRY-APRICOT FREEZER JAM
ingredients:
1  lb. fully ripe apricots, halved and pitted (2 c.)
1/2  lb. dark sweet cherries, pitted (1 1/4 c.)
4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. almond extract
3/4  c. water
1 (1 3/4 oz.)  pkg. regular powdered fruit pectin
preparation: Wash apricot halves and cherries; drain thoroughly in a colander.  Finely chop the fruit.  (You should have a total of about 2 1/2 cups chopped fruit.)  In a medium mixing bowl, stir together the chopped fruit, sugar, lemon juice and almond extract. Cover loosely; let the mixture stand for 10 minutes.

name: NUTTY PEANUT BUTTER  CHRISTMAS FUDGE
ingredients:
3/4  c. evaporated milk
1/4  c. butter
2 1/4  c. sugar
1 3/4  c. (7 oz. jar) Marshmallow Creme
2  c. (12 oz. pkg.) peanut butter chips
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. broken walnuts
preparation: Combine evaporated milk, butter, sugar and Marshmallow Creme in a heavy 2 3/4-quart saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture begins to boil. Continue cooking and stirring 5 minutes; remove from heat. Immediately add peanut butter chips and vanilla, stirring until chips are melted. Add nuts. Pour into a buttered 8 or 9-inch square pan. Cool. Makes about 3 pounds.

name: BLACK-EYED PEA SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. cooked black-eyed peas
2  large sweet red peppers, diced
1  medium cucumber, peeled and diced
1/2  c. thinly sliced scallions (white and green parts)
1/2  c. loosely packed chopped fresh cilantro
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
4  Tbsp. lite vegetable oil
kosher salt to taste
1  tsp. minced garlic
1  Tbsp. finely chopped fresh ginger
2  tsp. ground roasted cumin seed
2  or more fresh hot green chilies, stemmed, seeded and thinly sliced
1  Tbsp. minced fresh mint
5  or 6 lettuce leaves
preparation: Combine peas, peppers, cucumber and scallions in medium bowl. Combine remaining ingredients (except lettuce) in a 2 cup glass measure; whisk until thoroughly blended.  Pour over peas; toss well.  Arrange lettuce on platter; serve salad on top.  Keeps well for several hours at room temperature.  Refrigeration is not advised as it hardens the peas.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: SPECIAL K BARS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. corn syrup
1  c. peanut butter
2  tsp. vanilla
8  c. Special K (cereal)
6  oz. chocolate chips
6  oz. butterscotch chips
preparation: Heat sugar and syrup until they boil.  Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and vanilla; mix well.  Pour in cereal and stir.  Press into 9 x 12-inch pan.  Melt chocolate and butterscotch chips.  Spread on top.

name: COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow or white cake mix
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  tub Cool Whip
1  pkg. flaked coconut
preparation: Bake cake according to directions.  While cake is still hot, poke holes in cake with large fork.  Pour (warmed) can of Eagle Brand milk over cake.  After cake has completely cooled, spread with Cool Whip and top with flaked coconut.

name: HOT DAGOS
ingredients:
2 (15 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato puree
8  oz. mushrooms (canned)
2  c. water
1  small onion, chopped
1  tsp. crushed red pepper
1  tsp. garlic salt or powder
salt and pepper to taste
2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1  tsp. basil
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1 1/2  c. dry red wine (Burgundy)
preparation: Mix in large kettle.
