name: POPPY SEED CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 to 1 1/2  tsp. poppy seed
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  pt. sour cream
1  sleeve Ritz crackers
1/2  stick oleo
preparation: Cook, debone and tear chicken into small pieces. Combine soup, chicken, sour cream and poppy seed. Place in 8 x 10 baking dish. Crush crackers on top of mixture. Add oleo (cut up) on top of crackers. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  large chicken breasts
1  (8 oz.) Cheez Whiz
1/2  can Ro-Tel
1  bag Doritos
1  can cream of chicken
1/2  can chicken broth
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook chicken and shred. Mix Cheez Whiz, cream of chicken soup, chicken broth, Ro-Tel, salt and pepper together. Place chicken in 9 x 13 pan. Pour mixture over chicken. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Crush Doritos. Pour over casserole. Bake another 5 minutes.

name: CODY'S QUICHE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. whipping cream
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
4 to 6  oz. Swiss cheese
8  oz. cooked and crumbled bacon
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
preparation: Mix eggs, cream and spices with a whisk.  Prick pie crust. Layer cheese and bacon in shell.  Pour cream over all.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.  Let stand a few minutes to set. Serve.

name: BAKED BEANS WITH PINEAPPLE CHUNKS
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. chopped bell pepper
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  c. pork and beans (1 large can)
1/2  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. molasses
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 1/2  c. pineapple chunks, drained
preparation: Saute onion and pepper in margarine.  Add all other ingredients.  Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes, or heat on top of stove.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.  Chopped ham or crispy bacon (crushed) may be added.

name: PARTY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  tsp. garlic powder
2 (8 oz.)  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
dash of cayenne pepper
1  tsp. Accent
dash of salt
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
pecans or walnuts, finely chopped
preparation: Combine softened cream cheese and Cheddar cheese, mixing until well blended.  Add pimento, green pepper, onion, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice and seasonings; mix well.   Chill until stiff. Shape into ball.  Roll in nuts.  Serve with crackers.  (Leftover cheese ball can be re-shaped and refrigerated.  Will keep up to one week.)

name: RICE HAMBURGER HOT DISH
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
3  stalks celery, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. uncooked rice
2  c. water
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion; drain.  Add the rest of the ingredients.  Mix and put into a baking dish.  Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.  Stir occasionally.  During the last 15 minutes, sprinkle the top with Chinese noodles.

name: PECAN COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine, softened
2/3  c. sugar
1  egg yolk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. flour
1/3  c. finely chopped pecans
preparation: In medium bowl, cream margarine and sugar.  Add egg yolk and vanilla; beat until mix is light and fluffy.  Beat in cream of tartar, then stir in flour and pecans.  Drop by heaping 1/2 teaspoonfuls 1-inch apart on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake in preheated 300° oven until rich golden, about 20 minutes.  These are small cookies and make approximately 5 dozen.

name: FRESH FRIED OKRA
ingredients:
4  c. sliced okra
salt to taste
1  c. flour or more if needed
1/4  c. oil
preparation: Wash and slice okra.  Leave damp.  Salt to taste.  Sprinkle with flour, shaking all loose flour off.  Put in heated skillet with 1/4 cup oil.  Cook on low.  Turn often to keep from burning. Done when golden brown.  Add more oil to skillet if needed.

name: PAULA'S COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1 1/2  c. milk
1  c. coconut
1/2  c. sugar
1 large  can pineapple tidbits
2  c. coconut
16  oz. sour cream
2  c. sugar
8  oz. container Cool Whip
coconut to taste
preparation: Follow instructions on cake mix box. Cool cake for 15 minutes.

name: MY GRANDMOTHER'S STEWED SHRIMP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. flour
2  onions, finely chopped
2  lb. peeled shrimp
6 tomatoes or 1 3/4  c. canned tomatoes
1  c. water
1  green pepper, diced
1  tsp. fresh thyme or 1/2 tsp. dried thyme
2  tsp. chopped parsley
1 bay leaf or 1/2  tsp. powdered bay leaves
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Melt butter.  Add flour gradually; cook to a light brown.  Add onions; saute until golden.  Add shrimp; mix well.  Let cool slightly.  Add tomatoes, water, green pepper and seasoning.  Cook, stirring frequently, for 20 minutes.  Serve over rice.  Serves 8.

name: Rolls
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. scalded milk, cooled
1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. shortening
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
about 7 c. flour
2 yeast cakes in 1/2  c. warm water
preparation: Beat eggs; add sugar and melted shortening.  Add salt and milk.  Add yeast which has been dissolved in water.  Lastly, add the flour.  Cover; let rise and make into rolls.  Let rise; bake in 350° oven for about 20 to 25 minutes.

name: TROPICAL FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can mandarin oranges
1/2  c. orange juice
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  honeydew melon, cubed
1  large banana, sliced
4  kiwi, peeled and sliced
1  mango, peeled and cubed
1  papaya, peeled, seeded and cubed
2  Tbsp. honey
preparation: Drain oranges.  Mix the syrup from the oranges with the orange juice, lemon juice and honey.  In a glass bowl, toss together the fruit.  Pour the dressing over the fruit and chill at least 2 hours.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. oil
4  eggs
2  c. pumpkin
2/3  c. water
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. raisins
1  c. nuts
preparation: Spray 4 small pans.  Cream sugar, oil and eggs.  Add remaining ingredients.  Pour into pans and bake at 350° for approx. 1 hour.

name: BAR-B-QUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  can of cranberry sauce
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
12  oz. bottle cocktail sauce
preparation: Combine all of the ingredients and heat.  Good with hot dogs and meatballs.

name: JUDITH'S PECAN POUND CAKE
ingredients:
5  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1  c. milk
2  sticks margarine
2  tsp. vanilla flavor
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
2 1/2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. flour (plain)
1  c. chopped pecans, rolled in flour
preparation: Mix oil, milk, margarine, vanilla, baking powder, sugar and flour. Add eggs 1 at a time. Beat well. Add chopped pecans, rolled in flour. Stir in with a spoon. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
2  c. pumpkin pulp
1  c. oil
4  eggs
2/3  c. water
3  c. sugar (try using less)
preparation: Sift dry ingredients in large bowl.  Make a well.  Add all other ingredients and mix until smooth.  Place in two 9 1/2 x 5-inch bread pans (well greased).  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PEANUT BUTTER AND JELLY COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. shortening
1  c. peanut butter
1/4  c. applesauce
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1  c. rolled oats
3  Tbsp. grape jelly
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off.  In large bowl, combine all ingredients except 1 cup flour, oats and jelly; mix well.  Stir in reserved 1 cup flour and oats.  Shape into 1-inch balls; place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets.  Flatten in crisscross pattern with fork dipped in sugar.  Place 1/8 teaspoon jelly on center of each cookie.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes or until light golden brown.  Makes 60 cookies.

name: CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Wesson oil
3  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
5  eggs
3  c. flour
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. orange flavoring
preparation: Mix well and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN TORTILLA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  to 6 chicken breasts, cooked and cubed
1  c. sour cream
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
8  to 12 tortilla shells
1  can black olives, sliced or chopped
1 small  can green chilies, chopped
1 to 2  c. shredded cheese (Colby Jack)
preparation: Spray an ovenproof casserole dish with Pam.  Mix the chicken, chilies, olives, soup and sour cream together.

name: SPINACH-ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed
1  c. Parmesan cheese
2  c. mayonnaise
2 (6 oz.)  cans artichoke hearts (unmarinated)
2 small  cans diced green chiles
preparation: Defrost and drain spinach well (can thaw in micro).  Drain artichoke hearts and cut in quarters.  Mix Parmesan cheese, mayonnaise, chiles, spinach and artichoke heart pieces.  Pour mixture into quiche pan.  Cook at 350° for 30 minutes or until lightly brown.  Serve with tortilla chips.  Enjoy.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. pistachio pudding (instant)
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/4 to 1/2  c. nuts (pecan or walnut)
1-8 oz. container Cool Whip
preparation: Mix pudding and pineapple together, till pudding is blended well, add marshmallows and  nuts. Fold in Cool Whip.

name: PEPPERONI BREAD
ingredients:
1  box Pillsbury hot roll mix
2  eggs
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. ground oregano
2  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
2  pkg. sliced pepperoni
preparation: Mix roll mix according to package directions; let rest 5 minutes.  Mix together 1 egg with cheese and oregano.  Grease jelly roll pan and spread roll mix out (use flour on fingers so dough won't stick).  Spread egg mixture over dough; top with cheese and pepperoni slices, overlapping each slice.  Roll up jelly roll style.  Pinch seams.  Let rest 20 minutes.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until almost golden brown.  Brush with margarine and return to oven for 5 minutes.  Serve with salad.

name: VEGETABLE SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
3/4  c. grated carrots
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1/2  c. finely chopped celery
1/4  c. grated cucumber, drain and squeeze
1/4  c. finely chopped bell pepper (red and green)
mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all together.  Spread mayonnaise on 1 slice of bread; add vegetable mix on this.  Slice sandwich into thirds.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter (2 sticks)
1 2/3  c. sugar
5  eggs
2  c. cake flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter thoroughly.  Gradually add sugar and continue to cream.  Add eggs (one at a time).  Beat after each egg.  Add flour gradually; add vanilla.  Bake in greased tube pan at 350° for 1 hour or until cake leaves sides of pan.

name: CATFISH CAKES
ingredients:
1  1/2 catfish
2 -3  drops tabasco sauce
2  eggs
1  large potato, cooked and mashed
1  large onion, finely chopped
1  garlic clove, minced
salt and pepper to taste
2  cups finely crushed cracker crumbs
preparation: Poach and flake fish.  Add remaining ingredients, except cracker crumbs and shape into patties.  Coat with cracker crumbs and fry.

name: PUMPKIN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
4  oz. white enriched bread
4  med. eggs
1-1/3  c. nonfat dry milk
1-1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1-1/3  tsp. baking soda
artificial sweetener to equal 2 Tbsp. sugar
2-1/2  Tbsp. brown sugar replacement
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix eggs, baking soda, pumpkin and vanilla together.  Put rest of ingredients in separate bowl.  Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients a little at a time and beat on low speed with mixer. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Makes 12 cupcakes.  Serves 4.

name: EASY BREAKFAST
ingredients:
1  lb. roll sausage
8  eggs
10  c. cubed bread (Italian)
3  c. milk
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  c. sliced mushrooms
1  can or 10 oz. frozen asparagus, drained and thawed
2  Tbsp. oleo or butter, melted
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
2  tsp. basil
1  tsp. salt
preparation: In large skillet, brown sausage; drain.  In large bowl, beat eggs.  Add remaining ingredients; mix well.  Spoon into greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Cover; refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 350°.  Bake for 60 to 70 minutes.

name: COUSIN BARB'S CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  raw cauliflower, cut up
1  head lettuce, cut up
1  green pepper, minced
1  onion, minced
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, uncooked
1  pkg. Good Seasons dry Italian dressing
2  c. mayonnaise
1  lb. bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Mix together cauliflower, lettuce, pepper, onion and peas. Place 1/2 of salad in bowl. Sprinkle 1/2 package dry seasoning mix over.  Spread 1 cup of mayonnaise over this (do not use salad dressing).  Repeat with second half of salad, seasoning mix and 1 cup mayonnaise.  Top with crumbled bacon.  Sprinkle with as much Parmesan cheese as you like.   Cover and refrigerate overnight. Toss before serving.   Can be made ahead and keeps for days.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1/2  lb. pork sausage (hot)
1  small bell pepper, chopped
2/3  c. celery, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1 1/2  c. raw oats
1/2  tsp. black pepper
2/3  c. tomato sauce (keep aside small amount for top)
2/3  c. Pet milk
1  egg
salt to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients and cook in 2 1/2-quart covered casserole for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.  Drain excess grease and let cool for 5 or 10 minutes.

name: RECIPE FOR A HAPPY LIFE
ingredients:
1  c. good thoughts
1  c. good deeds
1  c. consideration for others
3/4  c. forgiveness
2  c. well beaten faults
preparation: Mix thoroughly and add tears of joy and sorrow with sympathy for others.  Fold in 4 cups of prayers and faith to lighten other ingredients and raise texture to a great height of Christian living.  After pouring all this into your daily life, bake with the heat of human kindness and serve with a smile that reflects wonders from above.  Serves all.

name: PUMPKIN ROLL
ingredients:
5  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. canned pumpkin
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1 1/8  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
3  tsp. ground cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. ginger
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts
preparation: Beat eggs on high speed for 5 minutes.  Gradually beat in sugar.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Spread in a well sprayed sheet pan (12 x 17 x 1-inch).  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, or until toothpick comes out clean.  Loosen edges carefully from pan and dump cake on towel, well sprinkled with powdered sugar. While cake is still hot, roll cake in towel from narrow side. Cool on wire rack.  Unroll cooled cake to put filling and nuts on.

name: HAM, BROCCOLI AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box frozen broccoli
3  c. cooked rice
1  c. cream of celery soup
1/3  c. milk
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
1 small  can mushrooms
1  small grated onion
1/2 to 1  c. cooked and chopped ham (can use chicken or turkey in place of ham)
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake at 350° for about 25 minutes.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
garlic powder to taste
3/4  c. mayo
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  dashes Worcestershire sauce
2  dashes Tabasco sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients and bake, uncovered, 30 minutes at 350°.

name: MOM'S SOFT RAISIN COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. water
2  c. raisins
1  c. shortening
1 3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs, lightly beaten
1  tsp. vanilla extract
3 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Combine raisins and water in a small saucepan; bring to a boil.  Cook for 3 minutes.  Remove from heat and let cool (do not drain).  In a mixing bowl, cream shortening, gradually add sugar. Add eggs and vanilla.  Combine dry ingredients, gradually add to creamed mixture and blend thoroughly.  Stir in nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes.  Yields about 6 dozen.

name: SAND TARTS
ingredients:
3  sticks butter
1  c. powdered sugar
2  tsp. vanilla flavoring
4  c. plain flour
2  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Cream together sugar and butter; add remaining ingredients. Roll in shape of a pecan. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes. When cooled, roll in powdered sugar.

name: APRICOT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. snipped dried apricots
2  c. warm water
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine (softened)
1  egg
3/4  c. orange juice
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Soak apricots in warm water for 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, in mixing bowl, cream sugar, butter and egg.  Stir in orange juice. Combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Stir into creamed mixture until just combined.  Drain apricots well; add to batter along with nuts.  Pour into a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until bread is done.  Cool in pan for 10 minutes before removing to a wire rack.

name: CHICKEN NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  oz. egg noodles
1  onion, chopped
1/4  c. bell pepper, chopped
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. milk
1  lb. pkg. Velveeta cheese
1  fryer, boiled and deboned
preparation: Cook noodles and drain.  Saute onion and bell pepper in margarine.  Add soup, sour cream and milk to this.  Add cheese that has been cut up in squares.  Place in a 2-quart dish and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  You may also substitute with ham.

name: SPINACH SALAD
ingredients:
1  bunch fresh spinach
1  egg, hard-boiled and grated
1/4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
5  slices cooked bacon, crumbled
6  to 8 mushrooms, sliced
1/4  c. bottled Caesar or Italian salad dressing
croutons (optional)
preparation: Wash spinach, discarding stems.  Pat dry.  Tear into pieces and put in salad bowl.  Add egg, cheese, bacon and mushrooms. Gently toss to mix well.  Coat with salad dressing; top with croutons.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: ARE YOU MARRIED? CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. moist chocolate cake mix
1  pkg. chocolate instant pudding mix (small)
4  eggs
3/4  c. water
3/4  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  pt. sour cream
12  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. nuts (pecans or walnuts) - optional
preparation: Beat together the cake mix, pudding mix, eggs, water, oil, and vanilla until smooth.  Fold in the sour cream, chocolate chips and nuts.  Pour into a greased bundt pan or angel food pan.  Bake at 350° for approximately 45 minutes.  Cool at least one hour and top with powdered sugar (use a strainer to shake it on).

name: MESSETTI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. lean sausage
1  green bell pepper
1  large onion
1  stem celery
1  can tomato soup
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. water
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. noodles
2  Tbsp. bacon drippings
1  tsp. salt and pepper
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. chili powder
dash of garlic powder
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. grated cheese
preparation: Brown meat; drain.  Cook pepper, onion and celery until tender.  Cook  noodles  by	package  directions.  Combine  all ingredients  together except cheese.  Pour into a large baking dish.  Bake  at 350° for 1	hour and 5 minutes before ready to sprinkle with cheese.

name: ONE-PAN GRANOLA
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine or 1 c. oil (canola)
1  c. honey
1/2  c. water
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. bran
2  Tbsp. brewer's yeast (optional)
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. nonfat milk powder
6  c. old fashioned oats
1/2  c. peanuts (raw)
1  c. rye flakes
1/2  c. sesame seed
1  c. sunflower seeds
1  c. wheat flakes
1/2  c. wheat flour
1  c. wheat germ
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat first 4 ingredients.  Add remaining.  Toast granola on cookie sheets at 350°, stirring often.  Takes approximately 1/2 hour.  When cooled, add 1/2 cup or more of raisins and/or dates. Store in covered container.  Makes one gallon.

name: GUMBO
ingredients:
2  whole chicken breasts, cut into bite size pieces
1  large onion, cut in pieces
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  can chicken broth
1  smoked sausage, cut in slices, then cut 1/4 pieces
1  c. Pace picante sauce
1  green, 1 yellow and 1 red pepper, cut into small pieces
preparation: Mix in order. Cook chicken, onion and garlic until done.  Add chicken broth and Pace picante. Add peppers and sausage.  Thicken with cornstarch or flour  and put on cooked rice.

name: SUNDAY BREAKFAST
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage, cooked and drained
4  slices bread, trimmed and torn
1  c. grated cheese (Cheddar)
1  c. grated cheese (Swiss)
6  eggs, beaten
2  c. milk
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Place half the broken bread in bottom of a buttered casserole dish. Top with half of the sausage and half of the cheeses. Repeat combination.  Mix remaining ingredients and pour over mixture. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: LEMON DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. fine pecan pieces
1  stick soft butter
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
2 small  pkg. lemon instant pudding mix
3  c. milk
1 (12 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Step 1:  Mix together flour, pecans and butter like a pie crust.  Press in bottom of a 7 x 11-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Cool.

name: COPPER PENNIES
ingredients:
1  lb. carrots, sliced
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. mustard seed
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. water
1/3  c. oil
1/2  green bell pepper, chopped
1  c. chopped celery
1  medium onion, chopped
preparation: Cook carrots for 10 minutes.  Pour over this the celery seed, mustard seed, sugar, vinegar, water and oil.  Cook the carrots, onion, celery and bell pepper until a little tender.

name: TURKEY SAUSAGE SUCCOTASH
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  lb. turkey sausage, sliced 1-inch thick
1  large yellow onion, coarsely chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
1 (1 lb.)  can crushed tomatoes
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen baby lima beans (unthawed)
1  tsp. dried marjoram, crumbled
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen corn kernels (unthawed)
preparation: Heat the oil in 12-inch skillet over moderately high heat for 1 minute. Add the sausage and saut, stirring occasionally for 5 minutes. Drain on paper toweling. Reduce the heat to moderate; add the onion in the skillet. Saut, stirring occasionally, for 3 minutes or until softened. Add the garlic and saut, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes. Stir in the tomatoes, lima beans, marjoram and pepper. Bring to a boil, then cover and cook for 10 minutes. Stir in the corn and sausage, then return the mixture to a boil. Cover and cook for 5 minutes or until the lima beans are tender and sausage is cooked through. Serves 4.

name: THREE CHEESE CHICKEN BAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
3  Tbsp. margarine
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1 (8 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms, drained
1 (2 oz.)  jar chopped pimentos, drained
1/2  tsp. dried basil
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. noodles, cooked and drained
3  c. cooked diced chicken
2  c. cottage cheese
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. bread crumbs
preparation: In a skillet, saute onion and green pepper in margarine until tender.  Remove from heat.  Stir in soup, mushrooms, pimientos and basil; set aside.  In large bowl combine noodles, chicken and cheese.  Add mushroom sauce and mix well.  Transfer to a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until bubbly.  Sprinkle with crumbs.  Bake 15 minutes longer. Yield:  12 to 15 servings.

name: MARBLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon cake mix
1  pkg. instant lemon pudding
1  c. water
1/3  c. cooking oil
4  eggs
1/2  c. chocolate syrup
preparation: In large bowl, combine cake mix, pudding mix, water and oil. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.  Pour 2/3 of batter in Bundt pan (well-greased).  Mix remaining 1/3 batter with chocolate syrup and pour evenly over lemon mixture.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  You could use any mixes, yellow, etc.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. peanut butter
1  cube margarine
1  lb. powdered sugar
3  c. Rice Krispies
1  (8 oz.) Hershey bar
1  (6 oz.) bag chocolate chips
1/4  bar paraffin
preparation: Combine peanut butter, margarine, sugar and Rice Krispies. Mix well and form into 1 to 1 1/2-inch balls.  Place in refrigerator until ready to dip.  Melt chocolates and paraffin in double boiler over medium heat.  Dip peanut butter balls into chocolate and refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: SOUTHERN PEANUT PIE
ingredients:
1  c. coarsely chopped salted peanuts
1 1/2  c. white corn syrup
4  eggs, slightly beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of nutmeg
1  unbaked pie shell
cream topping (optional)
preparation: Spread peanuts in the bottom of the unbaked pie shell.  Mix thoroughly the corn syrup, slightly beaten eggs and vanilla.  Pour over the peanuts in the pie shell.  Add a dash of nutmeg, if desired.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: ICING
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo
4  tsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1  box powdered sugar
6  tsp. milk
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Boil oleo, cocoa and milk.  Add powdered sugar, vanilla and walnuts.  Keep on low heat while frosting cake.

name: MARTIN'S STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, uncooked
1  pack Lipton onion soup mix
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  bell pepper (diced small)
2  potatoes (medium size, diced, small cubes)
1  medium size sheet of tin foil
1  baking pan or covered roaster
salt and pepper to taste
your favorite gravy, soup, cheese, or topping
preparation: Mix ground beef, onion soup mix, garlic powder, and bell pepper; pat mixture flat. (Oblong pancake size.) Put diced potatoes in the middle of flattened ground beef. Take ends of meat and pinch together to seal in potatoes. Completely seal the meat roll in the tin foil. Place in baking pan; cook 1 to 1 1/2  hours at 350°. Remove meat roll from foil and top with your choice of topping. (Hot brown gravy, cream of mushroom, cream of chicken soup or grated cheese.)

name: MANDARIN ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow butter cake mix
1  can mandarin oranges with juice
1/2  c. oil
4  eggs
preparation: Mix.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Refrigerate.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
1  bag frozen broccoli pieces
2  c. cooked chicken breasts
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1  c. shredded cheddar cheese
1/2  c. cornflake crumbs
2  Tbsp. melted margarine
preparation: Cook broccoli, drain.  Arrange in 9 x 13 inch pan.  Cut cooked chicken into pieces and place over broccoli.  Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice, and curry powder. Spoon over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese.  Combine cornflake crumbs and margarine. Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: GRITS SOUFFLE
ingredients:
2  c. quick grits
salt to taste
8  c. boiling water
1  stick garlic cheese
2  Tbsp. Tabasco
2  eggs, well beaten
2  sticks butter
2  tsp. parsley
preparation: Cook grits in salted water 2 to 3 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients, reserving a small amount of the butter.  Put in long baking dish and brush top with remaining butter.  Cook at 300 degrees for 1 hour.

name: APPLE COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. self-rising flour
1 1/2  c. milk
1  c. sugar
2  c. applesauce
1  large cooking apple, peeled, cored and sliced
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place butter in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Place the pan in oven to melt butter.  Stir together flour, milk and sugar in a mixing bowl.  Pour the batter into warm pan.  Spoon applesauce evenly over the batter and cover with apple slices.

name: QUICK CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  can cooked chicken
2  cans biscuits
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: In Dutch oven, heat to boiling cream of chicken soup, 2 cans of water and salt and pepper to taste.  Tear biscuits into small pieces and place in soup mixture.  Add chicken.  Reduce heat and simmer for approximately 15 to 20 minutes.

name: DREAM WHIP FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can fruit cocktail, drained
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  pkg. Dream Whip
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. coconut
preparation: Whip Dream Whip according to directions on box; beat in 1/3 cup mayonnaise.  Fold in drained fruits and coconut.  Chill thoroughly or until firm.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. light syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. pecans, chopped by hand
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add and mix sugar, syrup, vanilla, salt and pecans.  Pour into unbaked deep dish pie shell.  Bake 50 minutes at 325°.

name: PICKLE STICKS
ingredients:
ripe yellow cucumbers
2  gal. water
2  c. lime
3  oz. powdered alum
2  qt. white vinegar
2  qt. water
12  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. pickling spices
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. celery seed
preparation: First Day:  In the morning, peel cucumbers and cut out seed. Cut into lengthwise strips.  Cucumbers should weigh 7 pounds after seeded and peeled.  Soak 24 hours in water and lime.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. butter, at room temperature
3  c. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, at room temperature
6  eggs
3  c. plain flour (all-purpose)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together butter, sugar and cream cheese.  Add eggs one at a time, beating after each one.  Sift flour and add to creamed mixture.  Add vanilla and mix.  Place in a 13-inch tube pan.  Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can English peas, drained
1  can French-style green beans, drained
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
1 small  jar pimentos
1  c. diced celery
1  c. diced red onion
1  c. green bell pepper
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. white vinegar
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: In a  saucepan, mix the sugar, white vinegar, oil, salt and pepper together.  Bring to a boil, stirring for 2 minutes. Remove from  heat. Cool completely and pour over vegetables in a large bowl.  Refrigerate	2 to 3 hours or overnight for best flavor. Will keep several weeks, covered, in refrigerator.

name: BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. scalded milk, heated almost to boiling point
1  c. sugar
2  pkg. dry yeast
2  eggs, well beaten
5 heaping  Tbsp. Crisco (2/3 c. melted)
7 to 8  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. salt (scant)
preparation: To the scalded milk add the sugar in a large bowl.  Cool to lukewarm.  Add the yeast and stir well to dissolve.  Add eggs and melted shortening.  Slowly stir in the flour and salt.  Let rise at room temperature for 2 hours.

name: CARROTS WITH BUTTER
ingredients:
2  c. water
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  bunches baby carrots
salt and pepper to taste
3  Tbsp. sweet butter
2  Tbsp. fresh parsley, chopped
preparation: Bring the water, sugar and salt to a boil in a saucepan and add the carrots.  Cover.  Boil slowly until carrots start to get tender.  Uncover the pan and cook longer, until the liquid has evaporated.  Season with additional salt and pepper.  Add butter and parsley.  Stir and serve.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  pkg. cornbread mix
3  eggs, beaten
1  onion, chopped
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. butter, melted
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. ground red pepper
preparation: Press broccoli between paper towels to remove excess moisture. Combine cornbread mix, eggs, onion, cheese, butter and seasonings; stir well.  Stir in broccoli (batter will be thick). Pour mixture into a greased 8-inch square pan.  Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden.  Cool slightly and cut into squares.  Yields 9 servings.

name: DIET SOUP
ingredients:
6  large onions
2  green peppers
1  can tomatoes
1  head cabbage
1  bunch celery
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
preparation: Cut all vegetables into small pieces.  Mix all ingredients. Cover with water in larger pot.  Boil 10 minutes.  Cover and simmer until vegetables are soft.

name: TAGLIATELLE(For An Army)
ingredients:
2  boxes rigatoni, cooked al dente
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
3/4  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
2 large  cans chopped tomatoes
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  large onion
1  green pepper, chopped
3  cloves garlic, minced
2  small zucchini, cut in half lengthwise and then sliced
1/2  c. red wine
2  Tbsp. fresh basil
1/2  c. black olives, sliced
preparation: This recipe feeds an army.   I like to use a large turkey pan that has been greased.

name: SPARERIB SAUCE
ingredients:
4  oz. ketchup
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. A.1. sauce
1  Tbsp. brown sugar or honey
1  tsp. dry mustard (Coleman's)
pinch of oregano
pinch of garlic powder
2  drops Tabasco
3  dashes vinegar
parsley
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Blend all together with a whisk.  Recipe can be doubled or tripled.   Will keep indefinitely in refrigerator.

name: HEARTY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. pkg. medium wide noodles
2  medium onions, chopped
20  stuffed olives, sliced
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1/2  lb. sharp cheese, grated
2  lb. lean ground beef
2  green peppers, chopped
2 small  cans mushroom pieces
preparation: Boil noodles in salted water until tender; drain and set aside. Brown ground beef, onion and peppers in skillet; drain fat. Combine with soup.  Stir in noodles, olives and mushrooms.  Mix well.  Place in greased casserole dish and top with grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: HOT CLAM DIP
ingredients:
2  cans minced clams, drained, save juice
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  onion, chopped finely
clam juice to thin if necessary
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
cayenne pepper and salt
preparation: Mix ingredients (except juice).  Heat and serve in chafing dish to keep warm.  Dip crisp cracker or melba toast rounds or like. Serves about 20.

name: CHOCOLATE KAHLUA CAKE
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake mix
1  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
2  eggs
1/2  c. Kahlua
1/4  c. vegetable oil
2  c. sour cream
1  tsp. instant coffee (optional)
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix together all above ingredients except chocolate chips on medium for a couple minutes.  Fold in chocolate chips.  Bake in greased and floured Bundt or angel food pan for 45 to 55 minutes. Let cool 20 minutes, then remove from pan.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar.  Yum!

name: SHORTBREAD
ingredients:
2  sticks butter (not margarine)
5/8  c. sugar
3  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. rice flour or cornstarch
sugar
preparation: Cream butter and sugar together.  Add flours.  Mixture will be crumbly.  Press into a greased 12 x 8-inch pan.  Bake at 350° until brown (20 to 30 minutes).  Cool for 10 minutes.  Cut into fingers.  Dredge with sugar.  Store in airtight container.

name: YELLOW POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  cake mix
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
1  c. water
1/3  c. oil
4  eggs
preparation: Mix all together.  Pour batter into greased and floured Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten well
1  c. mashed bananas
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream butter until soft.  Add sugar, creaming until fluffy. Add eggs and bananas; mix well.  Sift flour, soda and salt; stir into creamed mixture.  Stir in nuts.  Turn into well oiled and lightly floured loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Place pan on rack.  Cool 10 minutes, then remove from pan.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE MIX
ingredients:
1 (8 qt.)  box powdered milk or 10 2/3 c.
1 (1 lb.)  can Nestle Quik or 3 c.
2  c. Coffee-mate
1/2  c. cocoa
1  lb. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix all together.  Put in about 1/3 to 1 cup hot water.

name: QUICK RAISIN RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
3/4  c. precooked rice
1/2  c. seedless raisins
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of cinnamon
dash of nutmeg
2  c. milk
2  slightly beaten eggs
preparation: In saucepan, combine rice, raisins, sugar, salt and spices. Add milk.  Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil.  Remove from heat.  Stir well a small amount of mixture into eggs.  Return to remaining mixture.  Cover tightly.  Let stand 45 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: BEEF STEW BAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. beef stew meat, cut in 1-inch cubes
2  Tbsp. oil
10 1/2  oz. can mushroom gravy
1  c. tomato juice
1/2  c. water
1/2  envelope dry onion soup mix (1/4 c.)
1  tsp. prepared horseradish
4  potatoes, peeled and quartered
preparation: Brown meat in oil. Drain off fat. Combine gravy, tomato juice, water, soup mix and horseradish. Stir into the meat and simmer 5 minutes. Place potatoes in a 2-quart casserole dish. Top with meat mixture and cover. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 hours. Stir once or twice.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  can creamed corn
preparation: Mix in casserole dish; beat eggs well.  Stir in flour, sugar and salt.  Stir until blended.  Stir in corn.  Top with 1/2 cup crushed Ritz crackers and several pats of butter.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
3  lb. ground beef
3  lb. chopped onions
1 large  can tomato sauce
1  can chopped tomatoes
1  tsp. cumin
2  tsp. oregano
3  tsp. garlic powder
2  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1/2  bottle chili powder
5 to 6  cans pinto or chili beans
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Brown onions, garlic powder and meat in oil.  When brown, add everything else except tomato paste and beans.  When chili is almost done, which will be about 2 to 3 hours, add tomato paste and beans.  Let cook until done.

name: TOMATO BASIL PLATTER
ingredients:
3  to 4 large ripe tomatoes
4  Tbsp. extra virgin olive oil
1  Tbsp. freshly ground pepper
12  to 14 large basil leaves
1  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
salt to taste
preparation: Place slices of tomato alternately with basil leaves on a large platter.  Whisk together the olive oil and red wine vinegar and pour over the tomatoes.  Top with freshly ground pepper and salt to taste. Cover lightly with plastic wrap and allow to stand at room temperature about 30 minutes before serving.  Makes 12 servings.

name: ITALIAN CREME CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. Crisco
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
5  eggs
1  tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 c. buttermilk
2  c. flour
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream together the margarine, Crisco, salt and sugar.  Add the eggs, one at a time.  Dissolve the soda in the buttermilk; add alternately with the flour.  Add the coconut and chopped nuts. Bake for 25 minutes at 350° in 3 (8-inch) pans.

name: CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts with skin
1  qt. water
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. salt
3  Tbsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1 medium  pkg. thin spaghetti
preparation: In Dutch oven, mix water and chicken; bring to a boil and cook 30 minutes.  Debone chicken and throw skin away.  Shred chicken with fork and place back into boiling water.  Add onion, salt, pepper, garlic and spaghetti.  Cook another 15 minutes, then add cream of chicken soup.  Stir with fork until dissolved.  Cook on low to medium for 15 minutes.  Serve hot with buttered toast or French bread.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
6  or 7 large eggs
3  c. Swans Down cake flour
3  c. sugar
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  c. Crisco
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Can add 1 teaspoon coconut or lemon flavoring.

name: CROCK-POT DRESSING
ingredients:
1  (8-inch) pan cornbread
8  slices toast
4  raw eggs
1  medium chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  Tbsp. sage
2  cans chicken broth
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Break up cornbread.  Mix everything together, except margarine.  Pour into crock-pot and dot with margarine.  Cover and cook on low for 4 hours, 2 hours on high.  Makes 16 servings.

name: CREAM OF COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix with pudding in mix
1  can condensed milk
1 small  can cream of coconut (as used for drink mixers)
1 medium  carton whipped topping
3/4  c. coconut
preparation: Prepare cake mix according to package directions.  Bake in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Let cake cool slightly.  Using a wooden spoon handle, punch holes at 1-inch intervals over top of cake.

name: UTTERLY DEADLY SOUTHERN PECAN PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1 1/4  c. cane syrup
1 1/2  c. broken pecan meats
1  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil sugar and syrup together 2 to 3 minutes.  Beat eggs, not too stiff.   Pour in slowly the hot syrup.  Add butter, vanilla and pecan meats.   Bake in raw pie shell at 350° or until set.

name: LIGHT CREPES
ingredients:
2  eggs or 4 egg whites or egg substitutes equivalent to 2 eggs
1  c. skim milk
1  Tbsp. corn oil or safflower or canola oil
1  c. flour
preparation: Beat eggs; blend all other ingredients until batter is smooth and just thick enough to coat a spoon.  If batter is too thick, add a little more milk.  Cover and let stand 1/2 hour.

name: JELLO FINGER JIGGLERS
ingredients:
4  envelopes unflavored gelatine (Knox)
3 (3 oz.)  pkg. flavored gelatin
4  c. boiling water
preparation: Boil 4 cups water.  Immediately stir in Knox and gelatin. Chill about 3 hours until completely set.  Cut into squares or use a cookie cutter to cut into shapes.

name: 24 HOUR FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. cubed pineapple
1  c. mandarin oranges
1  c. small pillow marshmallows
1  c. flaked coconut
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Gently toss all ingredients together.  Arrange in shallow pan or dish.  Let stand in refrigerator overnight.  Cut into squares and serve on "lettuced" plates.

name: PRUNE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. allspice
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
3  whole eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1  cup chopped nuts
1  c. cooked, cut up prunes
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift together the flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and allspice. Cream together the sugar, oil, eggs and buttermilk. Add dry ingredients. Add the nuts, prunes and vanilla. Mix together and pour in greased and floured pan. Bake in 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
12  oz. fresh or frozen peeled and deveined shrimp
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/8 to 1/4  tsp. ground red pepper
1  bay leaf
2  Tbsp. cold water
4  tsp. cornstarch
2  c. hot cooked rice
preparation: Thaw shrimp, if frozen.  In a large skillet, cook onion, celery, green pepper and garlic in margarine or butter until tender, but not brown.  Stir in undrained tomatoes, parsley, salt, paprika, red pepper and bay leaf.  Bring to boiling.  Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 15 minutes.

name: CHILI CHEESE APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
10  eggs
1/2  c. flour
1/8  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. baking powder
8  oz. can green chilies, chopped
1  pt. cottage cheese
1  lb. Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Beat eggs slightly.  Add flour, salt and baking powder. Blend.  Add melted butter, chilies and cheeses.  Mix only until blended.  Return to baking pan.  Bake 15 minutes at 400°. Reduce heat to 350° and bake 35 minutes longer.  Cool and slice into bite size squares.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked sweet potatoes
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
2 1/2  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix sweet potatoes, sugar and milk together and put into 2-quart casserole. Then combine, brown sugar, all-purpose flour, melted butter and chopped nuts. Sprinkle ingredients over top of casserole and bake at 350° for 30 or 40 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
2  c. crushed pretzels
1 1/2  sticks margarine
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  c. sugar
1  small tub Cool Whip
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
2  c. pineapple juice
3 small  boxes frozen strawberries
preparation: Mix together the crushed pretzels and margarine.  Press in a 9 x 12-inch pan.  Bake 10 minutes at 400°.  Cool completely.

name: MEXICAN RICE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked rice
1  tsp. chili powder
chopped onion
8  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  lb. browned hamburger
chopped green pepper
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
preparation: Cook rice.  Set aside.  Brown hamburger.  Add chili powder, onion, green pepper and 1 can tomato sauce.  Mix rice and hamburger together.  Sprinkle on cheese and 1 can of tomato sauce on top.  Warm in oven until cheese is melted.

name: CLOWN CAKES
ingredients:
any favorite cupcake recipe
24  marshmallows
24  bugles (chips)
1  can white icing
red and yellow food coloring
192  Good-N-Plenty
toothpicks
preparation: Bake cupcakes; cool and ice with yellow icing (white icing with 3 to 4 drops of yellow food coloring; stir).  Place one marshmallow on center top.  Dip bugle in red icing and place on top of marshmallow.  Make a ball of red icing and mold on the pointed end of the bugle.  Arrange 8 Good-N-Plenty around the marshmallow on top of the cake (alternate colors).  Dip toothpick in food coloring and draw a face on the marshmallow (like +'s).

name: HOT DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage (hot)
1  lb. hamburger (lean)
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  lb. hot Velveeta
1  c. chopped tomatoes
1  can chilies and green peppers
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  onion, chopped fine
preparation: Brown sausage and hamburger until crumbly; drain excess grease.  In crock-pot melt cheeses.  Add meat, soup, tomatoes, green chilies and onion.  Mix well.  Makes a large amount and can be frozen.  Serve with chips.

name: LIGHT PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. Miracle Whip light salad dressing
1/2  c. Kraft Zesty Italian reduced calorie dressing
2  c. cooked corkscrew noodles, drained
1  c. broccoli flowerets, partially cooked
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped tomato
1/4  c. green onion
preparation: Combine dressings; mix well.  Add remaining ingredients. Chill.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. colored spiral macaroni
black olives, sliced
2  chicken breasts, diced
pepperoni
red onion, sliced
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
fresh mushrooms, sliced
cauliflower
Bernsteins Italian dressing (onion and garlic flavor)
preparation: Mix all together.  Serve chilled.  Can use any Italian dressing you like and add as much or as little of each of the ingredients.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
4  boiled chicken breasts
8  oz. pkg. spaghetti
1  can mushrooms
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. grated Cheddar
Ritz crackers
2  c. chicken broth
preparation: Drain spaghetti; chop chicken and combine all ingredients, except crackers.  Pour into buttered casserole dish; top with crumbled Ritz crackers and dot with butter.  Bake on 350° for 20 minutes or until browned.

name: CHARCOAL QUAIL
ingredients:
quail (2 per serving)
olive oil or salad oil
Charcoal Bird Sauce
preparation: Marinate quail in oil for at least 2 hours or overnight.  Cook over hot charcoal for 20 to 30 minutes, basting with Charcoal Bird Sauce.  To serve, pour remaining sauce over quail.

name: TORTILLA PINWHEELS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (4 oz.)  can green chiles, well drained and diced
1 (4 oz.)  can black olives, well drained and chopped
1  c. cheddar cheese, grated
1/2  c. green onions, chopped
garlic powder to taste
seasoned salt to taste
5  (10-inch) flour tortillas
fresh parsley, for garnish
salsa
preparation: Mix all of the filling ingredients together thoroughly. Divide the filling and spread evenly over the tortillas; roll up tortillas.  Cover tightly with plastic wrap, twisting ends; refrigerate for several hours.  Unwrap; cut into 1/2 inch to 3/4 inch slices.  Serve with salsa.

name: PAWPAW PIE
ingredients:
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. pawpaws
1  egg
1  c. milk
1  c. sugar
preparation: Peel and remove seeds.  Cook in open kettle with other ingredients until thick. Put in an unbaked crust and bake until crust is baked.  Cover with a meringue and brown.

name: FROZEN SLAW
ingredients:
1  c. white vinegar
1/2  c. water
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. mustard seed
cabbage
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. chopped carrot
1/2  c. chopped red mango
preparation: Boil vinegar, water, sugar, celery seed and mustard seed for 1 minute.  Cool.  Chop cabbage.  Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt.  Let stand 1 hour.  Squeeze out all excess liquid.  Add celery, green pepper, carrot and red mango to cabbage.  Pour dressing over cabbage mixture.  Pack in containers and freeze or refrigerate.

name: SNACK CRACKER
ingredients:
2  graham crackers
peanut butter
1  big marshmallow
preparation: Cook until brown.

name: CHICKEN AND TORTILLAS
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped onions
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 small  can green chilies, chopped
1 small  can boned chicken or 1 c. cooked, cut up chicken
6  to 8 corn tortillas
grated cheese to taste
preparation: Fry onions in small amount of fat until brown.  Add soup, green chilies, chicken and 1 soup can of water.  Cook, stirring often, until mixture bubbles.  Remove from heat; set aside.  Line a casserole with corn tortillas.  Spoon chicken mixture over tortillas until covered.  Add a layer of cheese, tortillas and chicken mixture, ending with cheese on top.  Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes.  Yields 6 servings.

name: CINNAMON TWISTS
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
6  Tbsp. shortening
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/8  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  cake yeast
3/4  c. lukewarm water
3  c. flour
butter, melted
preparation: Bring cream to boil; add shortening, sugar, soda and salt. Mix well; cool.  Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Mix yeast with cream mixture.  Add flour; knead until smooth.  Cover with damp cloth 5 minutes.  Roll into rectangle 1/4-inch thick.  Spread with butter.

name: CHOW MEIN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. shortening
2  medium chopped onions
1  c. diced celery
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 1/2  c. water
1  lb. ground chuck or ground round, browned
1/2  c. uncooked rice
1/4  c. soy sauce
preparation: Cook in oven  30  minutes, covered.  Take off cover and cook 30 minutes	longer.  Take out of oven.  Put 1 can Chinese noodles on top of casserole and bake 15 minutes longer.

name: MICROWAVE CHESTNUT BITES
ingredients:
1  can water chestnuts
1/2  lb. bacon
barbecue sauce
preparation: Drain chestnuts.  Cut bacon strips in half.  Wrap around chestnut and use toothpick to hold in place.  Dip in barbecue sauce.  Arrange on plate and place in microwave for about 4 minutes.

name: APPLE BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. oil
2  eggs
2  c. sugar
1/3  c. buttermilk
1  Tbsp. apple pie spice *
3  c. self-rising flour
3  c. grated apples
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix oil, eggs, sugar and buttermilk together.  Add spices. Add flour and apples.  Mix well; fold in nuts.  Use two loaf pans sprayed with Pam or greased.  Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

name: NO-BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. milk
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
2  c. rolled oats
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. pecans or other nuts
3/4  c. peanut butter
1  c. shredded coconut
preparation: Mix cocoa and sugar well.  Add oleo and milk; boil for 2 minutes only.  Stir in remaining ingredients immediately.  Stir just enough to mix well and drop by tablespoons onto wax paper.

name: CHEESY POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
1  c. shredded mild Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. pepper
butter or margarine
paprika
preparation: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water about 30 minutes or until tender; chill.  Peel and grate potatoes.  Combine cheese, milk and 2 tablespoons butter in a small saucepan; cook over low heat until butter and cheese melt, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat; stir in sour cream, onion salt and pepper.  Fold cheese mixture into potatoes.  Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole; dot with butter and sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Yields 6 servings.

name: CARROLL'S CONCOCTION
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  pkg. of instant rice
1  can peas
1  can corn
preparation: Fix the rice according to directions, add cream of chicken soup.  Heat and stir for 2 minutes.  Add peas and corn.

name: EGG DROP SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. chicken broth (for each person)
1  egg for each 2 people served
chives
preparation: Bring chicken broth to a boil.  Add slightly beaten egg(s) to broth, running fork back and forth through broth (shredding egg). Cook until strips of egg are done.  Add chives.  Remove from heat and serve immediately.

name: PAINLESS PUDDING
ingredients:
15  fig bars
1/2  c. Muscatel wine
1  Tbsp. chopped nuts
vanilla ice cream
preparation: Crumble fig bars.  Add chopped nuts and moisten with Muscatel wine.  Chill.  Top with vanilla ice cream.

name: CUCUMBER SALAD
ingredients:
1  cucumber, cubed
1  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. green onions, chopped
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  bunch parsley, chopped
salt and pepper to your taste
preparation: Mix together and refrigerate for one hour.

name: PEANUT BLOSSOM
ingredients:
1 3\4  C. Flour
1  tsp. Baking Soda
1\2 tsp. Salt
1\2 C. Shortening
1\2 C. Peanut Butter
1\2 C. Sugar
1\2 C. Brown Sugar
1  Egg
2  tbsp. Milk
1  tsp. Vanilla
Sugar
Hershey Kisses, unwrapped
preparation: Sift together flour, baking soda, and salt, set aside.  Cream together shortening, peanut butter. Add sugar and brown sugar. Mix well. Add egg, milk and vanilla, mix.  Blend in dry ingredients. Shape teaspoon of dough into ball. Roll in sugar and put on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 min. Take out, press Hershey's Kiss in middle. Put back in oven for 2 more min.

name: EASY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. plain flour
2  c. sugar
1  c. Crisco
6  eggs (room temperature)
1  tsp. vanilla or lemon extract
preparation: Whip sugar and Crisco until mixed.  Add one egg at a time, mixing well after each.  Add extract, then add flour.  Mix well. Bake at 350°.  Start with cold oven.  Bake for 1 hour.

name: ONION RINGS
ingredients:
3  large onions
1  c. flour
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. milk
2  c. corn meal
Crisco oil
preparation: Slice onions and separate.  Dip in flour, then egg mixed with milk, then in corn meal.  Fry in Crisco at 375° until brown.

name: RECIPE FOR A HAPPY HOME
ingredients:
1  c. God
1  c. Jesus
1/2  c. friendship
1  c. thoughtfulness
1  pinch powdered tenderness
1  c. faith
1  c. hope
1  c. love
1  c. charity
1  spoonful gaiety
1  spoonful laughter
1  sprinkle tears
1  good-natured pan
1  large serving spoon
preparation: Blend together one cup of God and a cup of Jesus, mixed in half a cup friendship and a cup of thoughtfulness.  Creamed together with a pinch of powdered tenderness.  Very lightly beaten in a bowl of loyalty with a cup of faith and hope, love and charity.  Be sure to add a spoonful each of gaiety that sings and also the ability to laugh at little things.  Moisten with the sudden tears of heartfelt sympathy.  Bake in a good-natured pan and served repeatedly. Servings should last a lifetime.

name: CRISPY CINNAMON BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 1/2  oz. corn flake crumbs
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
4  tsp. brown sugar
2  tsp. grated orange peel
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. vegetable oil
3  lb. chicken
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a blender.  Preheat oven to 400°.  Dip chicken in buttermilk, then crumbs.  Place in greased pan.  Bake 30 minutes.  Makes 4 servings.

name: PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. round steak (cut in strips)
2  green peppers
1  lg. onion
1  c. celery, diced
2  Tbsp. Wesson oil
1  beef bouillon cube (dilute in 1 cup of water)
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Brown steak strips in hot Wesson oil, add bouillon, peppers, onion, celery and cornstarch, soy sauce, salt and pepper to taste. Cook over low heat in covered fry pan for 45 minutes.

name: CHEESE CORN BAKE
ingredients:
3  c. corn
1  c. evaporated milk
1  beaten egg
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  c. shredded cheese, divided
1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook corn in salted water for 2 to 3 minutes (1/2 cream-style, 1/2 whole corn is a good combination).  Drain.

name: OVERNIGHT MACAROONS (NO COCONUT)
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked oatmeal
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. cooking oil
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Combine oatmeal, sugar and oil.  Let stand until oil absorbs oatmeal and sugar (overnight).  Mix beaten egg, salt and vanilla in mixture.  Put in greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Bake 20 minutes in a 350° oven.  Sprinkle chips on top; allow to stand several minutes.  Spread melted chips to frost.  Cut in squares while warm.

name: SINGAPORE NOODLE SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. firm tofu
soy sauce
3  cloves garlic, pressed
black pepper
preparation: Cut into 1/2-inch thick slices and dip in soy sauce.  Place on a lightly oiled cookie sheet. Sprinkle with garlic and black pepper.  Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.  Cut into strips when cool.

name: ZUCCHINI CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. grated zucchini
3  c. sugar
3  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
1 1/2  c. oil
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. baking powder
4  eggs
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 to 55 minutes at 350°.  Ice with cream cheese icing.  Try not to eat the whole thing in 1 night.  It is even better eating the next day.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large zucchini, cut into 1/4-inch slices
3  shredded carrots
1  chopped onion
1/4  stick oleo
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
1 3/4  c. seasoned croutons
preparation: Boil zucchini until tender; cook together carrots, onion, and oleo.  Mix this with soup and sour cream.  Add 3/4 cup seasoned croutons and stir in zucchini gently.  Cover with 1 cup croutons, bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN BARS
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. oil
1  can pumpkin
preparation: Mix all ingredients well. Bake in preheated oven at 350° in well-greased sheet pan for 25 minutes.

name: CHOCO-NUT DELITES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. margarine, softened
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
2  c. chopped walnuts
Chocolate Coating
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Sift flour and salt on waxed paper. Beat together margarine, sugar, egg and vanilla in large bowl until well mixed.  Blend in flour mixture.  Stir in chocolate pieces.  Shape dough on lightly floured surface into logs (2 x 1/2-inch).  Place on ungreased cookie sheet.   Bake in 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes.  Cool on wire racks.  Dip ends of cookies into Chocolate Coating; roll ends in chopped nuts.  Place on waxed paper until set.

name: FRENCH BREAD GARLIC-CHEESE LOAF
ingredients:
1  loaf French bread
1/2  c. small curd cottage cheese
1/4  c. parsley, chopped
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. onion, grated
1  garlic clove, chopped
1/4  tsp. ground pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  With sharp knife, make 13 evenly spaced deep vertical slits in loaf of bread, being careful not to slice all the way through.  Set aside.  In blender, process cottage cheese until smooth.  Add parsley, Parmesan cheese, onion, garlic and pepper.  Process until parsley and garlic are minced.  Press bread open between slices.  With small spatula, spread cheese mixture on surface.  Bake 8 minutes, or until hot and crispy. Serve hot.

name: ROACH BAIT
ingredients:
1/2 small  box borax acid powder
1/2  c. corn meal
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Add lemon juice to milk to make buttermilk.

name: GEORGETTE'S SWISS FUDGE
ingredients:
1  lb. White Chocolate
1  lb. Milk Chocolate
2/3  c. Coconut Oil
3/4  c. chopped Nuts (optional)
preparation: Melt Chocolates and Oil in double boiler.  Stir in Nuts.  Pour in 9 x 9 inch waxpaper lined pan.  Don't refrigerate.  Cut when cool.

name: VEGETABLE BATTER
ingredients:
2  tsp. oil
1  egg
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine oil, egg, water, sugar, flour, baking powder and salt in mixer bowl.  Mix until smooth.  Use to coat vegetables for frying.

name: BREAD STICKS
ingredients:
bread au jour original or sourdough bread sticks
3  Tbsp. melted butter
1  Tbsp. taco seasoning mix or 2 Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1/8  tsp. garlic powder or 1 tsp. Dijon mustard
1/8  tsp. basil
preparation: For hot sticks, mix butter with taco mix.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP MARSHMALLOW
ingredients:
2  chocolate chip cookies
1  marshmallow
preparation: Put marshmallow between 2 cookies. May be heated in microwave for 10 seconds or until warm.  Enjoy.

name: CHICKEN WINGS MARINADE
ingredients:
20  to 25 wings (drummies)
1  c. water
1  c. soy sauce
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. unsweetened pineapple juice
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  clove garlic
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Let set overnight.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PARALEE SARGENT'S POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. plain flour
1  c. Crisco
1  stick margarine
7  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
preparation: Cream butter, adding sugar gradually.  Beat mixture until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Combine flour with mixture, stirring well.  Stir in vanilla and lemon flavoring.  Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Start in a cool oven and cook at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.  Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes; remove from pan.  Cool on a rack.

name: BROCCOLI AND CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head broccoli
1  head cauliflower
1  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1  jar bacon bits
2  c. real mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. white vinegar
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Break broccoli and cauliflower into bits.  Shred Mozzarella cheese.  Mix all ingredients together.  Refrigerate until time to serve.  Serve on fresh lettuce bed or without.

name: SHRIMP AND BACON BROCHETTES
ingredients:
12  large shrimp
bacon slices
2  Tbsp. oil
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
salt
rosemary leaves
preparation: Cover 12 large shrimp with partially cooked bacon slices. Thread on skewers.  Brush with mixture of oil, lemon juice and salt to spice and rosemary leaves.  Broil, turning frequently.

name: SALT RISING BREAD
ingredients:
1  medium potato, sliced
1  Tbsp. corn meal
1/4  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. boiling water
3  c. flour
preparation: Night before, place potato, corn meal, soda, salt and sugar in a Pyrex dish. Pour boiling water over first 5 ingredients. Stir. Cover and put in oven with light on for 10 to 12 hours, until light and foamy.

name: CRAB STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
24  whole large fresh mushrooms
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. frozen crab meat, thawed and drained
1  tsp. parsley
1  tsp. onion
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  c. mayo
preparation: Wash and dry mushrooms.  With a sharp knife, remove stems from mushrooms.  Combine crab meat, parsley and onion.  Stir dry mustard into mayo; toss with crab mixture.  Fill each mushroom crown with a tablespoon of crab mixture.  Place on lightly greased baking sheet.  Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes or until heated through.

name: TACO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped (1/2 c.)
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. chili powder
1 (16 oz.)  can refried beans
1/4  c. taco sauce
1  (6 oz.) container frozen avocado dip
1 1/2  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese (6 oz.)
5  taco shells, crushed
1  c. lettuce, chopped
1  small tomato, chopped
1/4  c. sliced green onion
1/4  c. sliced olives
preparation: Crumble the beef into a 1 1/2-quart casserole, then stir in onion.  Micro-cook, covered, on 100% power (High) 4 1/2 to 5 1/2 minutes or until done.  Drain, then stir in tomato sauce, water and chili powder.  Micro-cook, covered, on High about 6 minutes or until bubbly.

name: GOOEY BUTTER BARS
ingredients:
1  stick margarine or butter
1  box yellow cake mix
2  eggs
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
2  eggs
1  lb. confectioners sugar
preparation: Melt butter and pour over cake mix; add eggs and mix well. Pour into greased 15-inch pan and spread evenly with spoon.

name: CHOCOLATE DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine, softened
1  egg
2  oz. melted unsweetened chocolate, cooled
1/3  c. buttermilk or water
1  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Mix sugar, margarine, egg, chocolate, buttermilk and vanilla.  Stir in flour, baking soda and salt. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake until almost no indentation remains when touched, 8 to 10 minutes.  Immediately remove from cookie sheet.  Cool; frost with Chocolate Frosting.

name: BAKERY FROSTING
ingredients:
8  c. powdered sugar
2  c. shortening
3/4  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. almond extract
food coloring (if desired)
preparation: Mix all ingredients for 5 minutes until light and fluffy. Makes enough to frost one 2-layer cake.

name: ONION-TOMATO SOUP
ingredients:
2  large sweet onions
1/2  c. butter
2  cans stewed tomatoes
3 (10 1/2 oz.)  cans broth
1/2  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Peel and slice onion thinly.  Saute in butter in large saucepan.  Add tomatoes, broth and spices.  Cook over low heat for 45 minutes. Serve with French bread.

name: CAPE COD SCALLOPS
ingredients:
1  lb. scallops
1  tsp. parsley
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. tarragon flakes
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  stick margarine or butter, melted
5 medium  slices French bread
preparation: Wash scallops, then drain on paper towel.  Prepare crumbs from French bread by cutting up into small pieces or blend lightly in blender.  Put crumbs into a pan with melted butter or margarine. Add parsley, tarragon, salt and lemon juice to the buttered crumbs. Stir this mixture thoroughly.  Add scallops and coat with mixture. Put scallop mixture into a shallow dish; bake in preheated oven at 350° for 15 minutes.  Run under broiler to brown.  Serves 2.

name: BUTTER PECAN BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  box Betty Crocker butter pecan cake mix
1  stick margarine
1  egg
1  (8 oz.) soft cream cheese
1  stick soft margarine
2  eggs
1  box confectioners sugar
1/2  c. pecan pieces
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spray pan with cooking spray.  Mix first 3 ingredients together and spread mixture into pan.  Press down.  Mix remaining ingredients and pour over layer in pan.  Cook for 45 minutes to 1 hour until top is golden brown.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter, margarine or butter flavored Crisco
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  ripe bananas, mashed
1/4  c. chopped nuts
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Add bananas and nuts.  Mix flour and soda.  Add to other ingredients.  Pour in slightly greased bread pan.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: PANCAKE SYRUP
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. corn syrup
1  c. water
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bring to a boil.  Cook gently 2 to 3 minutes.  Serve on pancakes, fried cornmeal mush, scrapple, as a topping for pudding, ice cream and French toast.  Store in refrigerator.

name: MEAT ROLL
ingredients:
2  beaten eggs
3/4  c. soft bread crumbs
1/2  c. tomato juice
1/2  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  clove minced garlic
2  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. dehydrated onion
8 thin  slices boiled ham
6  oz. grated Mozzarella cheese
3 diagonal  slices Mozzarella cheese (Swiss may be substituted)
preparation: Combine and mix first eight ingredients.  Add beef and mix well.  On waxed paper or foil, pat meat mixture to a 12 x 10-inch rectangle.  Arrange ham atop meat, leaving a small margin around edges.  Sprinkle shredded cheese over ham.  Starting from short end, carefully roll up meat, using paper to lift; seal edges and ends.  Place roll, seam side down, in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° until done, about 1 1/4 hours.  Center will be pink due to ham.  Place cheese strips over top of roll; return to oven until cheese melts, about 5 minutes.  Makes 8 good servings.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. ketchup
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. Tabasco
1/8  tsp. chili powder
1  c. water
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Mix ingredients and pour over 2-pound brisket.  Place flat in pan.  Bake, covered, for 2 hours at 350°.  Baste occasionally while baking.

name: ONE POT STEW
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. water
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  bay leaf
1/4  c. white wine
1  lb. beef, cubed 1-inch
1  large potato, cubed
1  onion, diced
3  carrots, sliced
preparation: In large Dutch oven or ovenproof dish, combine first 8 ingredients; blend well.  Add remaining ingredients and stir to coat.  Bake, covered, at 350°  for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.  Serves 6.

name: CURRIED ARTICHOKE SALAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. raw rice
1  tsp. salt
1 1/3  c. chicken broth
4  green onions, thinly sliced
12  pimento stuffed green olives, sliced
2 (6 oz.)  jars marinated artichokes
3/4  tsp. curry powder
1/3  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Combine rice, broth, and salt in saucepan; bring to a boil and cook covered until done.  Empty rice into large bowl and cool. Add onions and olives.  Drain artichokes and combine marinade with curry powder and mayonnaise.  Add artichokes and toss with dressing.  Let stand refrigerated for a couple of hours.

name: SPICED TEA
ingredients:
3/4  c. Nestea (instant with lemon)
1 1/4  c. Tang
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. allspice
preparation: Mix thoroughly.  Keep in tightly closed container.  Use three heaping teaspoonfuls per cup of hot water.

name: TACO PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey or ground round
1  Tbsp. instant bouillon
2  Tbsp. chopped onions
2  Tbsp. chopped bell peppers
3/4  c. tomato paste
3/4  c. water
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese
8 to 10  oz. canned biscuits or crescent rolls
preparation: Press biscuits into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Brown turkey.  Add onions, bell peppers and the remaining ingredients, except cheese; mix well.  Pour 1/2 of the turkey mixture on semi-baked crust. Sprinkle with 1/2 the cheese.  Add remaining turkey; top with remaining cheese.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER
ingredients:
4  c. roasted nuts
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Shell 4 cups of peanuts and roast.  Remove skins, grind the peanuts through a food chopper or meat grinder, add 1 teaspoon salt.  Remove 1/2 cup of the crushed peanuts, grind the remainder the second or third time using a smaller knife or take up the tension of the plate until the grinder is hard to turn.  Mix coarse butter with the fine.  Fill into clean, sterile jars.  Pack the peanut butter so that all air is expelled to prevent rancidity.  Seal the container air tight.  If the peanut butter is to be stored for several months, process for 10 minutes in a water bath to remove air from top of the jar.  Store in cool, dry, dark place.

name: PAT WATKINS SWEEPSTAKE DIVINITY
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. light Karo syrup
1/2  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
2  egg whites, beaten stiff
walnuts, finely chopped (can use walnut gems)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In a medium size heavy pan, combine the first four ingredients.  Cook this mixture over a medium-high heat until reaching 232°.  Remove from the heat and pour 1/3 of the mixture into the beaten egg whites and mix well.  Return the remaining sugar syrup to the heat and bring to 244°.  Pour the mixture into the egg mixture; beat in the vanilla and continue to beat until the mixture loses the gloss.  Spoon the mixture onto waxed paper and shape into rolls.  Roll each roll into the chopped nuts, then chill.  Slice into rounds and serve.

name: SALMON BISCUIT RING
ingredients:
1 (14 3/4 oz.)  can salmon
1  egg, beaten
1  c. shredded cheese (any kind)
1/2  c. chopped green onions
1/2  c. chopped parsley
2  cans crescent rolls
preparation: Lay the crescent rolls on a cookie sheet and press into 1 piece.  Drain and flaked the salmon.  Combine with egg, cheese, onions and parsley; mix well.  Spread salmon mixture to about 1-inch from longest side.  Roll into a roll and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serve hot or cold.

name: FORGOTTEN CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  to 5 boneless chicken breasts
1  c. instant rice
1  c. milk
1  can cream of celery or chicken soup
1  envelope onion soup mix
pepper
paprika
preparation: Pepper and paprika chicken to taste.  Mix rice, milk and soup together.  Pour rice mixture in glass baking dish.  Place chicken in dish.  Sprinkle onion soup mix over chicken and bake 2 hours at 320°.

name: CHUTNEY
ingredients:
12  oz. jar orange marmalade
3  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
dash of salt
1/4  tsp. curry powder
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Boil all ingredients together until thickened to jam consistency.  Cool and serve over cream cheese on crackers.

name: DR. HART'S CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1 (3 lb.)  box Velveeta cheese
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  lb. hamburger
1  lb. pan sausage
preparation: Brown hamburger and sausage; drain.  Melt butter and cheese. Add Ro-Tel; mix.  Add meat.  Add 1 cup milk if too thick.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  eggs
1  c. mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
crushed potato chips
preparation: Cook broccoli as  directions on package; drain.  Combine soup, eggs,  mayonnaise and  cheese.  Mix  well.  Add  chopped broccoli.  Pour into buttered casserole  dish  and bake at 350° until set about 25 minutes.  Remove  from  oven  and cover with potato chips.  Bake until light brown.

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
1-1/2  c. applesauce
2  eggs
2-1/2  c. Tube Rose flour
2  tsp. soda
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix first four ingredients. Sift flour, soda and spices. Combine flour mixture with applesauce mixture; stir in raisins and nuts. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350° for 45 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean. May be baked in two layer pans and frost with caramel icing.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1 1/2  c. pecans
1  c. coconut (Angel Flake)
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  box powdered sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Spread toasted nuts in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Prepare cake mix according to directions and pour over nuts.  Sprinkle coconut on top of cake batter and set aside.  Cream together cream cheese and margarine.  Add sugar and mix until creamy; spoon cheese mixture over batter and bake 1 hour.

name: EASY DILL PICKLES
ingredients:
2 scant  Tbsp. salt
1/3  c. vinegar
fresh dill
garlic cloves
pickling cucumbers
preparation: Mix together salt and vinegar.  Pour into quart jar.  Place dill and garlic clove in bottom of jar, then layer cucumbers and dill.  Place dill and 1 tablespoon whole pickling spice on top. Fill jars with cold water and seal.

name: MOUNTAIN DEW CAKE
ingredients:
1  orange supreme cake mix (Duncan Hines)
1  c. Wesson oil
4  whole eggs
1  coconut cream pudding pie filling (not instant)
1  can chilled Mountain Dew
preparation: Mix cake, pie filling, oil, eggs and Mountain Dew.  Makes 3 layers.  Cook for 30 minutes at temperature on cake mix box.  Can also be made in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: SWISS VEGETABLE MEDLEY
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) bag frozen broccoli, carrots and cauliflower combination, thawed and drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese
1/3  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. ground black pepper
1 (4 oz.)  jar chopped pimiento, drained (optional)
1  can French fried onions
preparation: Combine vegetables, soup, 1/2 cup cheese, sour cream, pepper, pimiento and 1/2 can French fried onions.  Pour into a 1-quart casserole.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onions.  Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts
1  pkg. Stove Top stuffing
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of celery soup (undiluted)
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Simmer chicken in 6 cups of water until thoroughly cooked (about 30 minutes).  Reserve broth.  Shred cooled chicken into bite size pieces.  Prepare stuffing according to package directions, using chicken broth instead of water.  Add butter. Combine soups and add to stuffing.  Add chicken and spread mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° until hot and bubbly (about 45 minutes).  Yields 6 servings.

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
6  large mashed bananas
juice of 6 oranges (2 1/4 c.)
juice of 6 lemons (1 c.)
large can pineapple juice
4  c. crushed pineapple
4  c. sugar
7  c. water
3  bottles 7-Up
preparation: Mix all ingredients except 7-Up.  Freeze; take out approximately 2 hours before serving.  Add 7-Up and serve.  Makes 75 servings.

name: CREAMY CARROT SOUP
ingredients:
10  medium/small carrots, chopped
4  medium/small potatoes, peeled or unpeeled and chopped
1  medium onion, chopped fine
3  Tbsp. margarine
chicken broth to cover vegetables (2 to 4 c.)
1 1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. non-fat dry milk
salt and pepper to taste
carrot curls
sprigs of fresh parsley
preparation: Melt margarine; add chopped carrots and onions.  Saute for 10 minutes over low heat, stirring often.  Add potatoes and broth to cover everything.  Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.  Put through a blender or sieve.  Dissolve powdered milk in liquid milk; heat and add to carrot mixture to thin consistency of thick cream.  Taste; add salt and pepper to season.  Soup may be served hot or cold. Garnish with carrot curls and fresh parsley.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1 small  c. lard
1  c. peanut butter
2  eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Add well beaten eggs last.  Dough will be stiff.  Mix flour in with hands.  Pat down on cookie sheet with a fork.   Bake slowly, as they burn easily, at 300°.

name: BANANA NUT MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour (self-rising)
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
2/3  c. milk
1/3  c. butter, melted and cooled
1/2  c. mashed banana
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Grease muffin cups.  Stir together flour and sugar in mixing bowl.  Beat egg in separate bowl; stir in milk, butter and banana.  Add liquid mixture to dry ingredients, stirring just until blended.  Batter will be slightly lumpy.  Fold in pecans.  Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups, filling each 2/3 full.  Bake for 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes about 12 muffins.

name: STOVE TOP BARBECUE BEANS
ingredients:
1  piece bacon
2  c. pork and beans, drained
2/3  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. bacon bits
1/4  c. onion flakes
1  tsp. mustard
1  c. hickory smoked barbecue sauce
preparation: Place strip of bacon in medium saucepan.  Heat until bacon begins to cook.  Add drained beans and other ingredients in order given; stir.  Beans are done when bacon and onion flakes are tender.

name: STRAWBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. ground cinnamon
2  c. sugar
