3  eggs, well beaten
1 1/4  c. salad oil
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen sliced strawberries, thawed and drained
1 1/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine flour, salt, soda and sugar.  Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients.  Stir in oil and eggs.  Mix until ingredients are moistened.  Stir in strawberries and pecans.  Pour into two lightly greased loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until bread tests done in center.  Perforate cake with toothpick and pour reserved strawberry juice over cake.  Let stand overnight before slicing.  Store in refrigerator.

name: THE VERY BEST PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped walnuts
2/3  c. water
2  c. canned pumpkin
1  c. salad oil
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
4  eggs
1  c. golden raisins
preparation: In large bowl, dissolve sugar in liquids.  Add all dry ingredients.  Mix well.  Add nuts and raisins.  Pour into greased and floured loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour. Check at 45 minutes.  Yields 4 small loaves or 2 large.

name: OLD FASHION LEMON PIE
ingredients:
2  lemons
6  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. butter
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  c. milk
2  tsp. lemon flavoring
preparation: Cook in double boiler.  Mix real well. Cook until thick.  Put grated rind in mix, then lemon juice.  Cook crust before putting pie filling in.  Let cool, then put on Cool Whip or egg whites over after beaten real stiff.

name: BLACK-EYED PEAS
ingredients:
1  lb. pkg. dry black-eyed peas
1  c. onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. celery, diced
meat for seasoning
preparation: Soak peas for 3 hours.  Drain.  In 4-quart pot, add all ingredients and cover with water.  Boil until peas are done. Serves 6 to 8.

name: HARVEY WALLBANGER'S CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1/2  c. liquid shortening
1/4  c. vodka
3/4  c. orange juice
1  pkg. vanilla instant pudding (3 3/4 oz.)
4  eggs
1/4  c. Galliano
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and beat for 4 minutes.  Pour batter into well-greased and lightly floured Bundt pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.  Dust with confectioners sugar.

name: JENNIFER'S BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1 large  jar beans (precooked)
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. ketchup
1/4  c. water
1  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine the ingredients.  Drizzle with dark molasses.  Bake for about 2 hours at 350°.  Stir.  Will thicken after it cools for about 1 hour.

name: EASY BAKE ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. milk
4  Tbsp. sugar
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Bake at 425° until done.

name: MRS. FIELD'S COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. butter
2  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
5  c. oatmeal
2  tsp. baking powder
24  oz. chocolate chips
3  c. chopped nuts (any kind)
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
1  (8 oz.) Hershey bar, grated
preparation: Cream together the butter, sugar and brown sugar.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Mix together flour, oatmeal (a small amount at a time in blender until it turns to powder), salt, baking powder and baking soda.  Mix all ingredients together.  Add chocolate chips, Hershey bar and nuts.  Make golf ball sized cookies, 2-inches apart.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 6 minutes.  Makes about 112 cookies.

name: WEIGHT WATCHER'S MILK SHAKE
ingredients:
1  c. skim milk
1/4  c. unsweetened fruit
3  ice cubes
1/4  tsp. sugar substitute
preparation: Put all ingredients in a blender; blend for 30 seconds.  Pour into a tall glass.  Delicious!

name: SAVORY BROCCOLI AND BRUSSELS SPROUTS
ingredients:
1  bunch broccoli (1 lb.)
1  lb. Brussels sprouts
3  carrots, peeled and shredded
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. each dried marjoram and basil or oregano leaves
salt and black pepper
preparation: Trim and cut broccoli into florets.  Trim Brussels sprouts, removing yellow leaves.  Either steam vegetables or drop into boiling salted water.  Cover and simmer about 10 minutes or until tender.  Drain well.  Repeat with carrots, cooking only 3 to 5 minutes.  Drain well.  Meanwhile, melt butter.  Stir in lemon juice, marjoram, basil, salt and black pepper.  Pour over hot vegetables and serve.  Makes 4 servings.

name: PECAN CRESCENT COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter substitute*
1/4  c. butter*
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. powdered sugar
2  c. flour, sifted
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: *Or can use all real butter.

name: EGG NOG
ingredients:
4  egg yolks
4  c. milk
4  Tbsp. sugar
cinnamon
preparation: Mix eggs, milk and sugar in blender.  Pour into glass. Sprinkle with cinnamon.  Serve.

name: SUGAR-FREE BANANA OR PEACH PUDDING
ingredients:
1  box Estee sugar-free vanilla wafers
1  pkg. Sweet Pretenders whipped topping
2  pkg. sugar-free instant vanilla pudding
bananas or peaches
preparation: In glass dish, place wafers on bottom.  Then layer with fruit and pudding.  Add second layer of wafers and fruit and pudding if desired.  Top with prepared whipped topping.

name: CONFECTIONS
ingredients:
2 1/4  lb. white chocolate (1 pkg. + 6 sq. = 2 1/4 lb.)
2  c. smooth peanut butter
2  c. Rice Krispies cereal
2  c. miniature marshmallows
2  c. dry roasted peanuts
preparation: Melt white chocolate and peanut butter in a 200° oven for about 20 to 30 minutes. Stir when melted until smooth and well blended. Pour into large mixing bowl and add Rice Krispies, marshmallows and peanuts. Stir until well blended and drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Place cookie sheet in freezer for a few minutes to harden. (They will pop off the cookie sheet, like ice cubes in a tray!) Store in an airtight container.

name: SKILLET CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  sticks butter
3  Tbsp. cocoa
5  egg yolks
1 1/2  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put in iron skillet with small amount of milk to mix.  Cook, adding rest of milk.  Heat until thick.  Remove from heat; add vanilla.  Pour in baked pie shell.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  whole chicken, cooked
1/2  stick margarine
salt and pepper to taste
flour
preparation: Cook the chicken; take chicken out of stock and pick off bones.  Put 1/2 stick margarine in stock.  Salt and pepper to taste.

name: PEANUT BARS
ingredients:
4  eggs, separated
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. boiling water
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Beat egg yolks until thick.  Beat in sugar.  Add dry ingredients and mix lightly.  Add water.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.  Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Cool.

name: CHICKEN WITH ORANGE
ingredients:
1  (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) fryer, cut into serving pieces
1/2  tsp. paprika
1  medium onion, sliced
1/2  c. frozen orange juice concentrate
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  tsp. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/3  c. water
1  tsp. sherry
preparation: Brown chicken pieces under broiler.  Place in casserole; sprinkle with paprika.  Arrange onion slices over chicken. Combine juice concentrate, brown sugar, parsley, soy sauce, ginger, water and sherry.  Pour over chicken and onion.  Cover and simmer until chicken is tender, about 35 to 40 minutes.  Yield:  4 servings.  Approximate calories/serving:  195.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1 large  can beans
chopped onion
chopped bell pepper
chopped Polish sausage
1  tsp. honey or syrup
1  Tbsp. ketchup
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  tsp. brown sugar
preparation: Mix onion, bell pepper and sausage together.  Saute these with butter; drain.  Add baked beans, syrup or honey, ketchup, mustard and sugar; mix well.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: SHORTCUT CHICKEN CORDON BLEU
ingredients:
6  to 8 chicken breasts, skinned
1  can chicken soup
1/4  c. water
1  c. Swiss cheese
1/2  c. chopped ham
preparation: Cook chicken breasts in skillet until browned.	Remove from skillet.  To skillet add all other ingredients.  Bring to boil and cook until cheese is melted and all mixed.	Place chicken in baking dish.  Pour sauce over and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve over noodles or rice.

name: CASSEROLE CHEESE BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. scalded milk
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. warm water
2  pkg. yeast
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
4 1/2  c. sifted flour
preparation: Scald milk; add sugar, salt and margarine.  Let cool. Dissolve yeast in water.  Add milk and cheese and flour.  Stir about 2 minutes until well blended.  Cover; let rise until more than double.  Stir down and beat vigorously for 1/2 minute.  Turn in greased 1 1/2 quart casserole or two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 375° for 1 hour (no second rising).

name: BLUEBERRY AMBROSIA SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. drained pineapple (crushed or chunks)
1  c. small green grapes or Emperor grapes, halved and seeded
1  c. fresh blueberries
2  c. small marshmallows
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix all together in a bowl.  Let stand in refrigerator at least 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  c. biscuit mix
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. chopped onions
1  c. grated cheese
3  jalapeno peppers, chopped
1  c. cream-style corn
1/2  c. oil
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients and cook in an iron skillet on top of stove or in oven.  Bake at 350° until center is done.

name: TOSSED SALAD
ingredients:
1  head romaine, green or red lettuce
6  medium tomatoes or 10 small
4  cucumbers
3  heads radish
vinegar
oil
preparation: Clean vegetables and cut up.  Use very large bowls.  Mix in huge bowl by hand, cut to bite size tomatoes, cucumbers and lettuce.  Store in gallon Ziploc bags to keep leftover.  Use twice a day one bowl.  Can dilute evenly oil and vinegar for dressing, use none or favorite kind.

name: WET-N-WILD BERRY SLUSH
ingredients:
3  c. fresh strawberries
6  oz. frozen cherry or orange concentrate
1  Tbsp. sugar or to taste
preparation: In blender, combine ingredients.  While blending, add ice cubes through hole in lid until slushy.  Grab a straw and start sippin'!!!  Serves 4.

name: MARINATED SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can French-style green beans, drained
1 large  can peas, drained
1  cucumber, sliced
1  green pepper, chopped
1/2  onion, chopped
1  jar chopped pimentos
2  or 3 large stalks celery, cut up
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
1/2  c. salad oil
preparation: Mix together all ingredients, stir well and marinate in refrigerator overnight.  Drain well before serving, or serve with slotted spoon.  Save juice to put leftovers in.  Keeps in refrigerator for a week.

name: THE BEST PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  egg, beaten
1  c. buttermilk or sour milk *
2  Tbsp. oil
1  c. flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients in blender.  Can put in refrigerator overnight.  Batter will be thicker and smoother.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can onion soup (in beef stock soup)
preparation: Put above in oblong baking dish.  Stir in 1 cup water and 1-1/2 cups Minute rice.  Lay 4 or 5 chicken breasts on top of mixture.  Cover with foil and bake at 325° for 1-1/2 hours then 1/2 hour uncovered until brown.

name: PEACH AND BERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. water
2  c. sweetened, sliced fresh peaches
1  c. blueberries
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. soft margarine
nutmeg
preparation: Mix   cornstarch,  brown  sugar  and  cold  water.  Add peaches  and  blueberries;	cook  over  medium  heat, stirring until  mixture thickens.  Add margarine and lemon juice.  Pour into 8 1/4 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish (round).

name: CHICKEN TORTILLA SOUP
ingredients:
2  cans chicken and rice soup
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  cans chicken broth
1  can mild Ro-Tel
1 small  can chicken
1  tsp. cumin
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and simmer.  Serve with grated cheese and tortilla chips.  Can be done in crock-pot also.  Canned mixed vegetables can be added.

name: YELLOW SQUASH AND ONIONS
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
3  small onions, chopped
1/2  tsp. fresh ground black pepper
1/2  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
2  lb. yellow squash, cut in 1/4-inch slices
preparation: Heat butter in  a  skillet over medium heat.  Add onion and saute until  tender,  but not browned.  Add squash, water, salt and pepper.  Reduce  heat and simmer, covered, 20 minutes or until tender.

name: ORANGE ONION SALAD
ingredients:
2 (11 oz.)  cans mandarin orange segments, drained
3  Tbsp. finely chopped mild onion
buttermilk dressing
4  lettuce cups
preparation: Toss mandarin oranges and mild onion. Spoon into lettuce cups. Top with 1 to 2 tablespoons buttermilk dressing.  Makes 4 servings.

name: PASTRY SHELLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. cream cheese (3 oz.)
1/4  tsp. salt
1  stick margarine
1  c. flour
preparation: Blend ingredients.  Refrigerate for at least 12 hours.  When ready to use, roll to 1/8-inch thickness.  Cut circles and form over muffin tins or place in tart pans.  Prick thoroughly with fork to prevent puffing.  Bake at 450° until golden, about 8 minutes.  Makes approximately 15 shells.  Delicious when filled with chicken salad.

name: WACKY COCOA CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. plain flour
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. water
3/4  c. vegetable oil
2  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: In large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients.  Beat 3 minutes.  Pour batter into greased and floured cake pan.  Bake at 350° until done.  Let cool.

name: BLUEBERRY ORANGE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. orange yogurt
2 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/8  tsp. salt
2  tsp. grated orange rind
1 1/4  c. blueberries
preparation: Beat butter, sugar, eggs and yogurt until blended.  Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and rind.  Add to creamed mixture.  Fold in blueberries.  Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until golden.  Makes 18 muffins.

name: ROGALACH(Crescent Cookies From Grams)
ingredients:
1  c. sweet butter
1/2  lb. cottage cheese
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  beaten egg white
preparation: Mix the butter, cheese and salt in mixer until creamy.  Mix in flour and blend thoroughly.  Make 14 balls from this mix.  Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate overnight.  Make the filling of the nuts, sugar and cinnamon and add the beaten white of an egg.  The next day, roll each ball into a 6-inch circle.  Cut each circle into 6 pie shaped wedges.  Place 1/2 teaspoon of filling on each section and roll, beginning at the wide end.  Form into crescents and place on ungreased cookie sheets.  Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.  Bake at 375° until lightly browned, about 7 or 8 minutes.

name: DELICIOUS VEAL AND PEPPERS
ingredients:
1  lb. veal stew meat
2  onions, sliced
2  large bell peppers
1 to 2  lb. mushrooms
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Gently saute onions.  Add veal and stir until veal is light pink in color.  Add mushrooms and peppers.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Simmer gently for 1 to 2 hours in covered pan.

name: HERMITS
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. Crisco
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1/2  c. molasses
1 3/4  c. flour
2  Tbsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. soda
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. milk
1  c. raisins
nuts if you wish
preparation: Cream shortening; add sugar, egg and molasses; mix well.  Sift dry ingredients; add alternately with milk.  Add raisins and nuts and mix well.  "Flop" from spoon on greased baking sheet; bake in moderate oven at 350° about 10 minutes.

name: BEAN DIP OLE
ingredients:
16  oz. can refried beans
4  oz. can chopped green chilies
1/4  c. milk
1  lb. Velveeta
preparation: Cube Velveeta and stir over low heat.  Beat with all the ingredients until cheese melts.  Serve hot with corn or tortilla chips.  Makes 4 cups.

name: WONDERFUL FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  jar marshmallow cream
preparation: Mix ingredients well.  Pour into a serving dish and serve with fresh fruit.

name: LEMON MOUSSE
ingredients:
1 large  can Pet or Carnation milk, chilled
1  c. sugar
3  lemons
graham cracker crumbs
preparation: Whip canned milk until stiff. Slowly add sugar and then add the juice of 3 lemons.  Pour into pan lined with graham cracker crumbs.  Sprinkle crumbs on top. Cover and put in freezer.  Serve like ice cream.

name: MOM'S POTATO WEDGES
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
water
dash of salt
3  Tbsp. oil
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of black pepper
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1/2  tsp. dried thyme
dash of cayenne pepper
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Scrub unpeeled potatoes well.  Cut each potato in half lengthwise.  Then cut into even wedges.  Boil potato wedges for 5 minutes in salted water; drain and pat dry.  Spread wedges in a single layer on a lightly greased baking sheet.  Brush with oil; sprinkle on spices and herbs.  Bake at 425° for about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with cheeses.  Bake for another 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown and cheeses are melted.  Serve as snack or with any meat dish.

name: CARROT SLAW
ingredients:
3  c. shredded carrots
1 1/2  c. raisins
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. dairy sour cream
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/8  tsp. ground clove
preparation: Combine carrots, raisins and celery.  Mix sour cream with other ingredients and blend into salad.  Chill.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: RICE KRISPIES TREATS
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. for 40 regular marshmallows or 4 c. miniature marshmallows
6  c. Kellogg's Rice Krispies
1/4  c. butter (margarine)
vegetable cooking spray
preparation: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat.  Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted.  Remove from heat. Stir in Rice Krispies cereal until well coated.

name: PEACHES AND CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. water
1  large container whipped topping
1  pkg. yellow butter flavored cake mix
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
4  c. chopped fresh peaches
1  c. sour cream
3  oz. cream cheese
preparation: Prepare cake according to package directions, using a 13 x 9-inch cake pan.  Cool cake and split horizontally.

name: PECAN SQUARES
ingredients:
1  cup + 2 Tbsp. butter
3/4  cup brown sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
3  cups flour
1/2  cup melted butter
1/2  cup brown sugar
2  Tbsp. honey
2  Tbsp. cream
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
8  oz. pecan halves
Pinch of salt
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients together.  Press into 9 x 13 buttered pan.  Chill 20 minutes. Bake at 375° for 18 to 20 minutes.  Mix next 5 ingredients together for filling.  Heat until melted and boil for 1 minute.  Add remaining ingredients to filling mixture. Pour over first layer. Bake at 325° until bubbly, 15 to 20 minutes.

name: POTLUCK BEANS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  c. chopped onions
1  c. chopped celery
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of tomato soup, undiluted
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1/2  c. ketchup
1 (16 oz.)  can green beans, drained
1 (15 to 16 oz.)  can undrained chili beans
1 (16 oz.)  can undrained pork and beans
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
preparation: In a large skillet, brown beef and drain.  Add onion and celery; cook until tender.  Stir in soup, tomato paste and ketchup; simmer 15 to 20 minutes.  Spoon into a large roasting pan and add all remaining ingredients.  Stir well.   Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BEEF BURGUNDY
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. stew beef
1  envelope onion soup
1  c. Burgundy wine
1 small  can whole mushrooms
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Mix together.  Cook covered for 4 hours at 300°.  Serve over rice or noodles.

name: WALDORF SALAD
ingredients:
3  large red Delicious apples
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  stalks celery, diced
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/3 to 1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/3 to 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Cut unpeeled apples into 1/4 to 1/2-inch chunks and drop into a large bowl.  Sprinkle lemon juice over apples and mix thoroughly (this keeps apples from discoloring).  Add the celery, raisins and walnuts; stir.  In another bowl, combine mayonnaise and milk to suit your taste.  Mix until smooth, then stir into salad mixture, tossing well.  Chill several hours before serving.

name: BAKED FRENCH FRIES
ingredients:
2  large baking potatoes (approximately 2 lb.)
1/8  tsp. paprika
1/8  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. oil
1/8  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Scrub potatoes and cut lengthwise into 3/8-inch slices.  Toss potatoes with ingredients in bowl.  Place potatoes single layer on greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch baking dish.  Bake at 475° for 15 minutes.  Turn over and bake 10 minutes longer or until crisp and tender.  Serves 4.

name: OATMEAL BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. oatmeal
3  Tbsp. peanut butter
preparation: Mix butter, sugar, cocoa and milk; bring to boil.  Boil for 1 minute.  Remove from heat; add vanilla, oatmeal and peanut butter. Mix well.  Spoon brownies like cookies on a piece of wax paper.

name: BLUEBERRY JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
2  boxes blackberry or raspberry jello
2  c. boiling water
15  oz. can blueberries
8  oz. can crushed pineapple
preparation: Reserve juice from blueberries and pineapple.  Use the juice for 1/3 cup of the liquid.  Add drained berries and pineapple to jello.  Chill until firm.  Spread with topping.

name: YOGURT POPSICLES
ingredients:
1  c. fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced
2  c. plain yogurt
1/4  c. honey
6  (6 oz.) waxed paper cups
6  wooden sticks
preparation: Combine strawberries, yogurt and honey in medium size bowl. Put into 6-ounce cup and freeze for 20 minutes.  Add sticks and freeze until firm.  Peel off paper cup before eating.

name: FOIL WRAPPED DINNERS
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. beef boneless round steak (1/2-inch thick)
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen green peas or corn
4  medium carrots
4  medium potatoes
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  envelope onion soup mix
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Cut beef into 1-inch cubes.  Rinse frozen peas to separate.  Drain.  Tear off 4 pieces heavy-duty aluminum foil, each 18 x 15-inches.  On center of each piece, place 1 carrot (thinly sliced), 1 potato (cut into fourths) and 1/4 of the beef. Mix mushroom soup and onion soup mix.  Spoon mixture over beef and top with peas or corn.  Wrap securely in foil.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake until beef is tender, about 50 minutes.  Makes 4 servings.

name: HUMMINGBIRD CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  c. chopped pecans
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. soda
3  eggs, well beaten
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped bananas
preparation: Combine dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and vegetable oil.  Stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Stir in vanilla, pineapple, 1 cup nuts and 2 cups bananas.  Spoon batter into pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes in greased and floured pan.

name: TATER SWISS OMELET
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
6  medium potatoes
12  slices bacon, cooked and cubed
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms, sliced and drained
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
6  eggs, separated
preparation: Melt butter in large frying pan.  Add potatoes and fry until brown.  Place in 9-inch square baking dish.  Sprinkle with cooked and crumbled bacon.  Stir together egg yolks, mushrooms and cheese.  Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry.  Fold cheese mixture into whites.  Pour over bacon.  Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until set.  Serves 6.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
6  c. cooked macaroni
1  c. chopped bell pepper
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped tomato
1  c. shredded carrots
1/4  c. bacon bits
1  c. Cheddar cheese
1  c. frozen peas
salt and pepper
onions, if desired
salad dressing
preparation: Mix all ingredients  together.  Chill in refrigerator.

name: PECAN PIE II
ingredients:
1  c. ground or chopped pecans
1  c. corn syrup (red)
1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. oleo
preparation: Beat eggs, syrup, sugar, oleo, vanilla, salt and pecans.  Pour into unbaked pastry shell.  Bake for 45 minutes in 425° oven.

name: COCONUT RASPBERRY JAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  white cake mix
3  c. flaked coconut
3/4  c. raspberry jam
1  tub frozen whipped topping, thawed
preparation: Prepare and bake the cake mix for 2 (9-inch) round cake layers, adding 2/3 cup of the flaked coconut to batter.  Cool and remove from pans.  Reserve 1 tablespoon of raspberry jam.

name: CHILI BURRITOS
ingredients:
15  oz. can chili with beans
1  c. shredded lettuce
1  small, diced tomato
3/4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. sour cream
1/4  c. chopped green onion
4  flour tortillas
preparation: Warm flour tortillas.  Heat chili.  Place 1/4 cup plus 1 tablespoon of chili in center of each tortilla.  Top with shredded lettuce and diced tomato.  Sprinkle with grated cheese and roll tortilla to enclose filling.  Top tortilla with 1 tablespoon of sour cream, 1 teaspoon chopped green onion and 1 teaspoon of grated cheese.

name: HONEY GLAZE
ingredients:
1/2  c. honey
1/2  c. soy sauce
2  cloves garlic, minced
3  Tbsp. catsup
preparation: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients.  Blend well.

name: EASY DELICIOUS LEMON CAKE
ingredients:
1  lemon cake mix
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1 (6 oz.)  can lemonade concentrate, thawed
preparation: Mix the cake mix according to package directions. Cook in two 8 or 9-inch cake pans.  Cool.

name: FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. ketchup
1/4  c. vinegar
1  c. Wesson oil
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. paprika
1  onion, chopped (optional)
garlic salt to taste (optional)
preparation: Put ingredients into blender and mix well.

name: TURKEY STEAKS WITH MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  pkg. turkey breast tenderloin steaks
1/4  c. butter
4  oz. small fresh mushrooms
2  small onions, quartered
1/2  tsp. instant beef bouillon
preparation: Melt butter in skillet on medium-high.  When butter begins to brown, add turkey.  Cook 3 minutes; turn.  Reduce heat to medium. Add mushrooms and onions.  Cover.  Cook 5 minutes.  Remove turkey to platter.  Combine bouillon and 1/4 cup water; add to skillet. Stir and heat 1 minute.  Pour over turkey.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BAKED EGGPLANT
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. minced onion
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
2  c. cooked rice
5  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Peel eggplant and cut into cubes.  Cook in boiling, salted water until tender (15 to 20 minutes).  Drain; mash with fork. Brown meat in 3 tablespoons margarine.  Add onion and pepper and cook until tender.  Stir in eggplant, rice, salt and pepper. Spoon into a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish.   Saute bread crumbs in remaining 2 tablespoons margarine.  Sprinkle over eggplant mixture.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: COLD TACO PIZZA
ingredients:
2  pkg. crescent rolls
16  oz. cream cheese
2/3  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. taco sauce
1  Tbsp. dill weed
dash of salt and pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. diced green pepper
1/2  c. sliced black olives
1/2  c. diced tomatoes
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
16  oz. uncooked spaghetti noodles
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  eggplant (about 1 lb.)
1  medium onion, finely chopped
1  clove garlic, crushed
2  tsp. parsley flakes
1 (28 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
1 (12 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
2  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Cook spaghetti noodles as directed on package.  Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat.  Cook and stir eggplant, onion, garlic and parsley in oil until onion is tender.  Stir in tomatoes (with liquid), tomato paste, mushrooms, oregano, salt and sugar and break up tomatoes.  Heat to boiling.  Reduce heat. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes.  Serve sauce over cooked spaghetti.  Great with buttered garlic bread.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: LETTIE'S FRENCH BREAD
ingredients:
8  c. flour (bread flour is best)
2  pkg. dry yeast
3  Tbsp. Crisco
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  tsp. salt
3  c. warm water
preparation: Mix all  the  ingredients together in large pan.  Knead until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes.  Let rise for 1 1/2 hours in warm  place, covered;  then punch and work down every 15 minutes, six times.	Divide dough into 3 portions and shape into loaves. Put  in greased pans or cookie sheet.  Cover and let rise again. Bake  at  350°  for 35 to 45 minutes or until done.

name: MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, finely chopped
1 (10 oz.)  can taco sauce
1 (16 oz.)  can refried beans
1  pkg. taco seasoning
preparation: Saute meat and onion.  Drain.  Mix in remaining ingredients. If too thick, add a little water.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: COMPANY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. egg noodles
1  c. chopped onion
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. sour cream
2  c. tomato sauce
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1  c. cottage cheese
2 (4 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
butter
preparation: Cook noodles according to directions.  Brown together the meat, onion, green pepper, salt and pepper.  Add the cottage cheese, sour cream, cream cheese and tomato sauce.  Simmer this mixture 1/2 hour.  Alternate layer of noodles and meat mixture in baking dish and dot with butter.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.  Serves 10.

name: FRIED OKRA
ingredients:
1  lb. small fresh okra pods
3/4  c. corn meal
salt and pepper
bacon fat
preparation: Wash okra and cut off the ends of the pods.  Cut into 1/2-inch slices.  Moisten slightly and shake in paper bag, containing corn meal and salt and pepper.  Fry in hot bacon fat until golden brown.

name: GREEN SAUCE FOR BURRITOS, ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1  chicken bouillon cube, crushed
3/4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. dry onion flakes
dash of garlic salt
dash of cumin
1/2  c. grated cheese
4  oz. can green chilies
preparation: Melt margarine over medium heat.  Add flour and stir until smooth.  Add bouillon cube (crushed), milk, 1 tablespoon of onion flakes, garlic salt and cumin.  Simmer to thicken sauce, stirring often.  Add grated cheese and stir to melt.  Stir in green chilies and heat until hot throughout.  Pour over enchiladas, burritos or whatever you like.

name: RANCH-STYLE BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
1  envelope onion soup mix
2 (1 lb.)  cans pork and beans
1 (1 lb.)  can kidney beans, drained
1  c. catsup
2  tsp. cider
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Brown meat; stir in soup mix, beans, catsup, water, etc.  Pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 400°.

name: CHOCOLATE BALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. confectioners sugar
2  c. coconut
pinch of salt
4  c. chopped pecans
1  can sweetened condensed milk
2  sticks margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together and form into small balls.  Refrigerate until cold.  Melt 24 ounces of semi-sweet chocolate chips and 1/2 bar of paraffin.  Dip balls in chocolate.  Put on wax paper.

name: EASY NACHOS
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
16  oz. chili hot or mild beans (whichever you prefer)
8  oz. salsa (your favorite)
1  block jalapeno Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
preparation: Spread cream cheese on bottom of 8 x 8-inch glass baking dish. Pour beans over cream cheese.  Pour salsa over beans.  Top with shredded cheese.  Heat in microwave until hot and cheese is melted, approximately 10 minutes.   Serve with your favorite tortilla chips.

name: TURKEY POT PIE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1  medium onion, chopped
2  tsp. poultry seasoning
2  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. water
1  can green beans
2  c. cooked turkey, cut in chunks
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a skillet; bring to a boil, then add green beans and turkey.  Stir all together and pour in a pie pan.  Put one layer of cranberry sauce over the top of pie; add shredded cheese.  Put a pie crust over the top and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: PORK CHOPS WITH SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
salt and pepper
4  extra thick loin pork chops
3  medium-size sweet potatoes, boiled and sliced
pinch of nutmeg
1  can apricots (No. 2 1/2) with juice
preparation: Salt and pepper chops.  Brown on both sides in their own fat in a skillet.  Transfer to a casserole dish;  add sliced sweet potatoes and sprinkle with nutmeg.  Pour apricots and juice over all and bake 50 minutes in a 350° oven.  Serves four.

name: CINNAMON FRIED APPLES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. firmly packed light brown sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
8  medium cooking apples, peeled, cored and sliced
1/2  red hot cinnamon candies
1/4  c. water
preparation: In large skillet, over medium heat, melt butter.  Add apples, brown sugar and lemon juice; toss gently.

name: UNCLE JIM'S POLENTA AND CHEESE
ingredients:
2  qt. water
2  c. cornmeal
1  Tbsp. salt
2  c. diced cheese (such as Muenster, Swiss or Cheddar)
ground pepper
1/2  c. butter, melted
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Bring water and salt to boiling point in a deep pan.  Slowly add cornmeal to boiling water, stirring with a wooden spoon to prevent lumping.  Cook over low heat for about 10 minutes.  Stir in cheese.  Cook 20 more minutes, stirring frequently.  The mixture should be on the soft side.  Add a little pepper.  Stir in the butter.  Turn out onto serving platter; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve with your favorite sauce.  Good with sausage.

name: OLD-FASHIONED PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1/4  cup granulated sugar
2  egg whites, lightly beaten
1/2  cup low fat milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  cup firmly packed light brown sugar
1/2  tsp. Ground cinnamon
1  tsp. Grated lemon rind
1  Tbsp. Lemon juice
4  cups sliced peeled, peaches
3/4  cup all-purpose flour
1/2  cup whole wheat flour
1  Tbsp. Baking powder
1/2  stick reduced calorie margarine, softened
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Lightly grease

name: GRILLED SALMON STEAKS
ingredients:
1/3  c. margarine
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
1/2  tsp. dried tarragon
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. paprika
2  to 4 fresh salmon steaks
preparation: In a saucepan melt 1/3 cup margarine.  Stir in lemon juice, chopped parsley, dried tarragon, garlic powder and paprika.  Brush mixture over salmon steaks.  Place over medium coals (or gas grill) for 5 to 8 minutes on each side.  Baste frequently.

name: FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
3 (6 oz.)  cans frozen orange juice
3 (6 oz.)  cans water
3 (6 oz.)  cans frozen lemonade
3 (6 oz.)  cans water
1 (46 oz.)  can grapefruit juice
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 (12 oz.)  can apricot nectar
2  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients thoroughly and chill before serving. Makes 60 cups.

name: SWEET-SOUR CABBAGE
ingredients:
4  slices bacon, diced
1  lb. red cabbage, shredded
1  onion, sliced
1/4  c. white raisins
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
1/4  c. water
preparation: Heat pressure cooker.  Brown bacon.  Pour off excess drippings.  Add remaining ingredients.  Close cover securely. Place pressure regulator on vent pipe.  Cook 3 minutes.  Cool pressure cooker at once.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  stick butter, melted
1  Tbsp. flour
2  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Add sugar and flour to butter.  Blend well; add eggs, vanilla and buttermilk.  Pour in pie shell and cook for 40 minutes at 350°.

name: ORANGE DELIGHT
ingredients:
24  oz. cottage cheese
1  large orange jello
1  jumbo and 1 large Cool Whip
2  c. mandarin oranges, drained
1 large  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix cottage cheese and jello, then add pineapple and oranges. Add Cool Whip last.

name: JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple
1  box apricot jello
small tub cool whip
1  cup small curd cottage cheese
preparation: Heat pineapple in saucepan till boiling.  Add jello and stir until dissolved.  Put mixture in serving bowl.  Mix in cottage cheese.  Cook and add cool whip.  Chill in refrigerator until set.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
4  boned chicken breasts, uncooked
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can water
2  c. instant rice, uncooked
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. mixed vegetables
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix rice, soups, water and vegetables together in a roasting pan.  Place chicken breasts on top.  Sprinkle with salt.  Cover and bake for 2 hours at 300°.

name: MARINATED FLANK STEAK
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. mixed shallot
1 1/2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
several drops hot sauce
juice of 1 lemon
2 to 3  lb. flank steak
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in a flat container large enough for steak; mix well.  Place steak in marinade and marinate for several hours in the refrigerator.  Broil or grill.  Slice thinly across the grain.  You can put the slices in heavy-duty foil; cover with reserved marinade and place back on the grill to keep it hot.

name: HOMEMADE PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
1  Tbsp. oil
1  egg
milk (to moisten)
preparation: Spoon into skillet of hot oil.  Cook approximately 3 minutes on each side.

name: WILD MUSHROOM STRUDEL
ingredients:
12  oz. shiitake mushrooms
12  oz. oyster mushrooms
12  oz. Portebello mushrooms
1/4  quarter medium onion
1/4  bunch parsley
1/4  bunch cilantro
4  oz. butter
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. rosemary
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. pepper or less to taste
8  oz. phyllo dough
1 1/2  c. heavy cream
1  oz. brandy
Sauce for Wild Mushroom Strudel
preparation: Saute onion and mushrooms.  Add herbs.  Add brandy and heavy cream; reduce by half.  Layer 3 sheets of phyllo.  Brush with melted butter.  Place mushrooms onto dough; roll into tube shape. Bake at 350° until golden brown.  Slice into 1 1/2 ounce slices. Top with sauce.  Serves 8.

name: VIDALIA ONION RELISH
ingredients:
1  gal. chopped Vidalia onions
5  c. sugar
5  c. vinegar
2  tsp. celery seed
2  tsp. turmeric
1  tsp. mustard
preparation: Let onions come to a boil.  Put into sterilized jars and seal.

name: GRAPE HULL PIE
ingredients:
2  c. grape hulls, processed
1  c. sugar
3  eggs, separated
1  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Combine egg yolk, sugar, flour and grape hulls.  Cook to a boil.  Bake a 9 inch pie shell and fill with mixture.  Top with egg white meringue.  Bake until brown.

name: SWEET CUCUMBER AND DILL SALAD
ingredients:
3  medium cucumbers, thinly sliced
salt
2  Tbsp. white wine vinegar
1  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh dill
preparation: Place cucumber slices in colander; sprinkle with salt.  Toss. Let drain for 15 minutes.  Combine vinegar, sugar and cayenne pepper.  Pat cucumber slices dry and toss with dressing and dill. Serve chilled or at room temperature.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: PEACHY NUT CAKE
ingredients:
1 (28 oz.)  can peaches
3/4  c. butter
1  box butter pecan cake mix
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Place peaches in a greased 9 x 13 pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly on peaches. Pour melted butter over mix. Add nuts. Bake at 325° for 55 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream, if desired.

name: PEACHES FOR FRIED PIES
ingredients:
15  lb. peaches (fresh, peeling and all, seed out)
5  lb. sugar
1  pt. white vinegar
preparation: Mix and cook slowly until thick and dark.  Seal in hot sterilized jars and water bath to insure seal.  Tastes like dried peaches with a lot less work.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
2  pkg. boneless, skinless chicken breasts
2/3  c. bottled Italian salad dressing
1 1/3  c. uncooked Minute rice
2  bags (16 oz. each) frozen broccoli, carrots and onions
1  can bamboo shoots, chopped
1  red or orange pepper, chopped
2  cans French fried onions
3 1/2  c. or 2 (14 1/2 oz.) cans chicken broth
1  tsp. Italian seasoning
preparation: Place chicken breast in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Pour salad dressing over chicken.  Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 minutes. Place rice, vegetables and 1 can of fried onions around and under chicken.  When 20 minutes is up, mix chicken broth and Italian seasoning; pour over chicken and vegetables.  Bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes.  Top with remaining onions and bake 2 to 3 minutes longer.  Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

name: VELVEETA FUDGE
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
4  sticks oleo
4  lb. powdered sugar
1  c. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt together Velveeta cheese and oleo.  Add cocoa, powdered sugar, cheese, oleo, vanilla and chopped nuts.  Work together and spread on cookie sheet.  Place in refrigerator to set up.  Keep in cool place.

name: BEAN AND HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. butter
1  can tomato soup
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. molasses
1/4  c. brown sugar
2 (1 lb.)  cans B & M baked beans
preparation: Brown beef and onion in butter; do not drain.  Add salt, pepper, flour, soup, molasses and sugar; mix well.  Add beans; mix lightly.  Place in a covered casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour (remove cover for the last 15 minutes).

name: PECAN CRISP
ingredients:
2  c. pecan halves
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
3/4  c. packed light brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Finely chop 1/2 cup pecans; reserve rest of pecan halves for garnish.  In large bowl, measure pecans and remaining ingredients. Knead until mixture holds together.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. beef tenderloin
3  Tbsp. cooking oil
1 1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. dry sherry
1/4  c. beef broth
1  c. dairy sour cream
hot cooked noodles
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cut beef tenderloin into strips.  In oil in heated skillet, brown meat 2 to 4 minutes.  Remove meat from skillet.  Add sliced mushrooms; cook 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove mushrooms.  Add sherry and beef broth; bring to boil.  Cook, uncovered, until liquid is reduced to 1/3.  Stir in sour cream and salt.  Stir in meat and mushrooms.  Cook slowly until heated through; do not boil.  Serve over noodles.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  small onion, chopped
1 small  jar pimento
1  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
1  can French-style green beans
1  c. sliced ripe olives
1  c. mayonnaise
1  box Uncle Ben's wild rice (cooked as directions on box)
3  c. cooked chicken (cut into bite size, add later)
preparation: Pour into casserole, heat until bubbly in a 350° oven, about 25 to 30 minutes.  Take out to sprinkle cheese on top.  Return to oven until cheese is melted.  Use a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.

name: POLISH REUBEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 1/3  c. milk
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
2  cans (16 oz.) sauerkraut, rinsed and drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. uncooked medium width noodles
1 1/2  lb. Polish sausage, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese
3/4  c. bread crumbs or cracker crumbs
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Combine soup, milk, onion and mustard in medium bowl; blend well.  Spread sauerkraut in greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Top with uncooked noodles.  Spoon soup mixture evenly over top.  Top with sausage, then cheese.  Combine crumbs and butter in small bowl. Sprinkle over top.  Cover pan tightly with foil.  Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour or until noodles are tender.

name: ZUCCHINI WITH CHEESE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. zucchini
1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. olive or salad oil
2  medium tomatoes, sliced
1  c. dairy sour cream
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Lightly grease 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.  Wash zucchini well; cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices. Combine flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon oregano and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.  Toss zucchini in mixture.  Slowly heat oil in large skillet.  Saute zucchini until golden brown, about 4 minutes on each side.  Drain.

name: LOW-FAT SOUTHWESTERN DIP
ingredients:
1  can no fat chili
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  lb. no fat cream cheese
1  can green chilies
1/2  can black olives, sliced
preparation: Mix together and heat thoroughly.  Lightly broil top.  Garnish with green onion slices.  Dip with baked tortilla chips or place in flour tortilla shells.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BARS
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking powder
16  oz. Hershey bar
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
12  oz. peanut butter
2  c. flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix eggs, sugar, vanilla, baking powder and flour.  Warm the milk and add the butter.  Add this to the batter (the batter will be thin).  Place in greased cookie sheet and bake 20 to 25 minutes.  After removing from oven, while hot, spread on peanut butter.  Refrigerate until cool and peanut butter firm.  Melt chocolate and spread on top of peanut butter.  Chill.

name: COOKIE SHEET SLICE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  can fruit pie filling (any kind)
1  c. icing sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
few Tbsp. warm water
preparation: Cream margarine, sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Stir together in a bowl:  flour, baking powder and salt.  Add to creamed mixture. Spread 2/3 of batter on greased 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet.  Spread one can fruit pie filling (any kind).  Drop remaining dough on top. (Add a bit of milk to dough to make spreading easier.)  Bake in a preheated oven.

name: BAKED FISH FILLETS
ingredients:
15  lb. fish fillets
1  lb. fat, melted
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper (white)
1/2  c. lemon juice
14  oz. flour
2  oz. butter or margarine, melted
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Cut fish into 50 portions. Mix fat, salt, pepper and lemon juice. Dip each portion into seasoned fat. Dredge fish with flour. Place close together in a single layer in a greased baking pan. Mix butter or margarine and milk and pour over fillets. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

name: BAKED EGGPLANT
ingredients:
1  eggplant
1/4  stick butter or bacon drippings
1  c. cracker crumbs
2/3  c. milk
pinch of salt (1/8)
1  c. sharp cheese
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. tomatoes
2  eggs, separated
preparation: Peel and dice eggplant.  Cook in a little water until tender over low heat.  Make a cream sauce with butter or drippings, flour and milk.  Add cheese and melt over low heat.  Drain eggplant and mash it.  Add cracker crumbs, tomatoes, beaten egg yolks and salt. Mix together with the cream sauce and fold in egg whites and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: Creamy Artichoke-Parmesan Dip
ingredients:
2  cans (14 oz each) quartered artichokes, drained and chopped
2  cups shredded mozzarella cheese
1  1/2 cups grated Parmesan cheese
1  1/2 cups mayonnaise
1/2  cup finely chopped onion
1/2  tsp dried oregano leaves
1/2  tsp garlic powder
Pita wedges
preparation: Place all ingredients except pita wedges into slow cooker, stir to blend well.  Cover, cook on low 2 hours.  Serve with pita wedges.

name: POPSICLES
ingredients:
2  c. boiling water
1  c. sugar
1 small  pkg. jello (any flavor)
1 small  pkg. Kool-Aid (same flavor as jello)
preparation: Mix well and add 1 cup cold water.  Pour into popsicle molds and freeze for several hours before serving.  Run water over molds to loosen popsicles.

name: IMPOSSIBLE COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. flaked coconut
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour mixture into two greased pie pans and bake in 350° oven for 40 to 50 minutes, until done. Pies freeze well.

name: POTATO DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. potatoes
1 1/2 to 2  c. sifted flour
1  whole egg
1  egg yolk
salt
bread crumbs browned
preparation: Pare potatoes and cook until soft.  Mash until creamy.  Work out on board with flour, salt and eggs.  Drop by spoonfuls into salt water; bring to a boil and drain.  Place on large platter and pour bread crumbs over potatoes.

name: TANGY FLANK STEAK
ingredients:
2  lb. flank or sirloin steak
2  minced onions
1  c. oil
2/3  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. marjoram
6  drops hot sauce
2  sliced onions
2  c. red wine vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. rosemary
2  tsp. plus 2 tsp. pepper
preparation: Trim excess  fat  from steak and place steak in a large shallow   container.  Combine  remaining  ingredients,  except pepper,  and  pour	over  steak.  Cover  and refrigerate for 3 hours,  turning  occasionally.  Remove  steak  from  marinade. Press 2  teaspoons pepper into each side of steak.	Grill over hot fire until desired degree of doneness is achieved.

name: CUCUMBER SANDWICHES
ingredients:
2  or 3 large cucumbers, peeled and sliced
1  large Italian salad dressing
1  lb. cream cheese
1  loaf bread
preparation: Put  cucumber  slices  in  bowl  and  cover  with salad dressing  to  refrigerate overnight.  Cut bread with small lid and spread  each  slice  with  cream  cheese.  Place 1 drained cucumber slice on each piece of bread.

name: ROTEL MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1 (2 lb.)  box Velveeta
1  can diced Ro-Tel
1  lb. sausage, browned
1  lb. ground beef, browned
1  medium onion, chopped
dash of salt
dash of pepper
1  c. mushroom soup
preparation: In small pan, saute chopped onion in Ro-Tel juice.  In larger pan, slowly melt Velveeta.  Add soup and stir until smooth.  Add Ro-Tel, sausage, beef and onion.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Serve in crock-pot with tortilla chips.

name: CRUSTY INDIVIDUAL MEAT LOAVES
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
18  saltines, crushed
2/3  c. milk
1 1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  chopped onion
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  beaten egg
corn flakes
preparation: Mix everything together except corn flakes.  Form mixture into 8 or 9 balls.  Crush corn flakes in a plastic bag and coat meat with flakes, shaping into loaves.   Place in shallow pan and bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

name: CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can chicken broth
1  c. chopped onion
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  oz. can evaporated skim milk
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1 (12 oz.)   can whole kernel corn with sweet pepper
1  Tbsp. parsley (optional)
preparation: In a medium saucepan, combine broth, onions and pepper.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat.  Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.  In a small bowl, stir together milk and flour.  Stir into broth mixture.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.  Stir in corn. Heat through.  If desired, sprinkle with parsley.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. yellow squash, chopped
3  Tbsp. minced onion
3  Tbsp. melted oleo
3  eggs, well beaten
1  c. milk
1 1/2  c. bread crumbs
salt to taste
pepper to taste
preparation: Pour milk over 1 cup bread crumbs.  Combine squash, onion, 1 tablespoon butter, eggs, salt and pepper; blend well.  Add to bread mix; stir and blend.  Spoon into lightly greased 1-quart casserole dish.  Combine remaining bread crumbs and butter; sprinkle over squash mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: FRENCH POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
8  to 10 medium all-purpose potatoes (do not use Idaho or Russets as they crumble when sliced)
4 to 5  Tbsp. dry white wine
2  Tbsp. wine vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
7  Tbsp. olive oil
6  scallions, minced
1/2  c. fresh parsley, minced
preparation: Scrub the potatoes and boil them in their jackets in salted water until just tender when pierced with a very sharp kitchen fork.  Drain and shake over low heat to dry thoroughly.  Peel them as hot as you can handle them.  The potatoes should still be warm when the dressing is added.  Slice them in 1/8-inch rounds and place in a large mixing bowl.  As you put in each layer of potatoes, sprinkle with some of the wine.  Next, beat the vinegar, salt and mustard powder together in a small bowl with a wire whisk or electric mixer.

name: HEAVENLY CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1 (2 layer size)  pkg. chocolate cake mix
1/2  c. cocoa
3  eggs
1 1/3  c. water
1  c. Miracle Whip dressing
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Add the rest and beat until well blended with mixer.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Test with toothpick.

name: LACY FRENCH FRIED ONION RINGS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  egg, well beaten
1  c. (canned) milk
1  Tbsp. salad oil
fat for deep frying (375~)
preparation: First, blend the first 3 ingredients and set aside.  Next, combine the egg, oil and milk in a bowl and beat until thoroughly blended.  Beat in the dry ingredients until batter is smooth. Cover and set aside while preparing onions.  Can use to fry shrimp, also.

name: PASTA AND CREAM SAUCE
ingredients:
8  oz. cooked pasta
1  c. fresh broccoli
1  c. sliced carrots
1  c. mushrooms (fresh or canned)
1/4  c. chopped onion
garlic to taste
salt
pepper
1 1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch (original)
1 to 1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Cook fresh vegetables to desired tenderness.  Cook onion. Mix all ingredients together, except milk.  Stir, adding a little milk at a time, until you reach the desired consistency.  For a complete dish, you can add cooked salmon or cooked chicken.

name: BANANA TORTE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
1  stick soft butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1 large  carton Cool Whip
4  bananas
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix flour, butter and nuts.  Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Let cool.  Cream the cream cheese and powdered sugar.  Fold in 1/2 of the Cool Whip.  Spread over the crust.  Slice four bananas over this.  Mix the instant pudding and the milk.  Pour this over the bananas.  Frost with the remaining Cool Whip.  Put in refrigerator.

name: COWBOY BEANS
ingredients:
2  lb. pinto beans
1 1/4  lb. ground beef
1  clove garlic
3  tsp. dried oregano
8  chopped jalapeno peppers, chopped
4  green bell peppers
preparation: In skillet, cook beef, onion and garlic.   Add peppers.  Pick and wash beans.    Cook in large pot all together for about 6 hours.

name: STIR-N-DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
2  eggs
2/3  c. Wesson oil
2  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. sugar
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat oven to  400°.  Beat  eggs  with a fork until well blended.  Stir in Wesson oil and vanilla; blend in sugar until mixture thickens.  Add  flour, which has been sifted with salt and baking  powder.  Drop  by  teaspoonfuls,  about  2  inches apart, on  ungreased  cookie sheet.  Press flat with bottom of glass dipped in  sugar (lightly oil glass, then dip in sugar). Decorate with  pecans,  chocolate bits or colored sugar.  Bake for 8 to 10 minutes;  remove immediately from cookie sheet.

name: CUCUMBER SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. (8 oz.) sour cream
1/4  c. chopped onion (white or red, optional)
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. cider vinegar
salt and pepper to taste
4  to 5 large cucumbers, peeled and thinly sliced
preparation: In large bowl, combine sour cream, onion, lemon juice, vinegar, salt and pepper.  Add cucumbers and mix them into the sauce.  Chill for at least 2 hours.  Then can stay about a week in the refrigerator.  Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE STUFFED CELERY
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. sour cream
1/4  lb. cottage cheese
7  radishes, chopped
2  Tbsp. chopped chives or scallions
salt to taste
pepper to taste
paprika to taste
celery stalks
preparation: Mix sour cream with cottage cheese; stir in radishes and chives.  Sprinkle with salt, pepper and paprika; mix well.  Fill celery with cheese mixture.

name: HOT DOG SAUCE
ingredients:
1  can tomato sauce
1  can tomato paste
1/3  bottle chili sauce
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/4  lb. ground meat
1  onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. LA red hot sauce
1  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Fry ground meat and onions. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer until ready to serve.

name: FANCY SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
1  can pineapple rings (10 rings in can)
1  can sweet potatoes
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
4  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
maraschino cherries and miniature marshmallows (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Mash potatoes, sugar, spices and butter together.  Use ice cream scoop.  Scoop one ball of mixture into center of each pineapple ring.  Place maraschino cherry in center of each scoop and place 3 or 4 marshmallows on potato.  Bake in 400° oven for 10 minutes on cookie sheet.  These can be made ahead and baked and served later.

name: VANILLA WAFER CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
2  c. sugar
6  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
12  oz. vanilla wafers
1/2  c. milk
7  oz. coconut
1  c. nuts
preparation: Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: TUNA SHOESTRING SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can tuna, chilled
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. grated carrot
1  c. Miracle Whip or mayonnaise
1 small  can potato sticks
preparation: Drain and flake tuna in bowl. Stir in celery, carrot and Miracle Whip. Just before serving, add potato sticks. Serve on lettuce leaf or shredded lettuce, if desired.

name: FRUITED OAT SCONES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/4  c. uncooked oatmeal
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt (optional)
1/3  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. dried mixed fruit, diced
1/2  c. milk
1  egg, beaten lightly
1  tsp. sugar
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Combine flour, oats, sugar, baking powder and salt.  Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs; stir in fruit.  Add combined milk and egg, mixing just until moistened.  Shape dough to form a ball.  Turn out onto lightly floured surface; knead gently 6 times.  On lightly greased cookie sheet, pat out dough to form 8-inch circle.  With sharp knife, score round into 12 wedges; sprinkle with combined sugar and cinnamon.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.  Break apart; serve warm.  Makes 1 dozen.

name: DEVIL'S FLOAT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. shortening
3/4 to 1  c. nuts (optional)
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
preparation: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and cocoa.  Mix milk, vanilla and shortening.  Add dry ingredients and nuts; mix well. Put in deep greased 9 x 9-inch pan.

name: PIZZA-A-LA-RICE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked rice
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. Mozzarella cheese
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
3/4  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. salt
onion, chopped
favorite pizza toppings
favorite cheese topping
preparation: Combine rice, eggs, and cheese in a bowl.  Press firmly into bottom of 12-inch greased pizza pan.  Bake at 450° for 20 minutes. Top pizza-rice crust with onion and favorite pizza toppings.  Mix in a small bowl the tomato sauce, oregano, basil and salt; place on top of pizza.  Top with cheese topping.  Bake for 10 minutes at 450°.

name: SAUSAGE QUICHE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. Italian sweet sausage, skinned, browned and well drained
1  c. Bisquick
8  oz. chopped Mozzarella cheese
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
4  eggs
1/4  c. hot oil
preparation: Mix together and add salt, pepper and parsley to taste.  Turn into buttered 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: PAT'S FRUIT TART
ingredients:
1 (18 oz.)  pkg. Pillsbury refrigerated sugar Slice and Bake cookies
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
assorted fruit (strawberries, bananas, cherries, grapes, kiwi, pineapple)
1/2  c. orange marmalade
1  Tbsp. water
preparation: Slice cookie dough.  Line in ungreased 14-inch pizza pan or 2 small quiche pans, overlapping slightly.  Bake at 275° for 12 minutes.  Cool.

name: DOUBLE LAYER PUMPKIN
ingredients:
4  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. sugar
pie crust (can use graham cracker crust)
1  Tbsp. milk
1 1/2  c. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cream cheese, milk and sugar in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth.  Gently stir in Cool Whip.  Spread on crust.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
32  oz. frozen hash browns
10  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese
3  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350°, covered, for 45 minutes.  Uncover and bake for 15 more minutes.

name: 7 LAYER VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  head lettuce, shredded
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. chopped red onion
1  c. small English peas
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
1 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Layer vegetables in order listed in 2-quart bowl.  Spread mayonnaise and sugar and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

name: TOMATO AND BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
4  oz. cavatelli or medium shell macaroni
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  medium onion, thinly sliced
1  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter
5  medium tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
1/4  c. snipped parsley
1/4  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
1/4  tsp. dried basil, crushed
2  c. fresh or frozen chopped broccoli
preparation: Cook pasta in boiling salt water 8 to 10 minutes or until tender.  Combine 1/2 cup cheese and flour, set aside.  In a large saucepan cook onion and garlic in butter or margarine until tender but not brown.  Stir in tomatoes, parsley, oregano, basil and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Bring to boiling.  Add broccoli.  Simmer, covered. Transfer to an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.  Bake, covered, in a 375° oven for 15 minutes.   Sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes more.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: CAPTAIN'S PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can undiluted frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 (6 oz.)  can undiluted frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. orange bitters
3  c. rum
1 1/2  qt. carbonated water
lemon slices and orange slices
preparation: Combine lemonade and orange juice concentrates, sugar, bitters and rum.  Mix well.  Place a large block of ice in large punch bowl.  Pour punch mixture over ice.  Add carbonated water.  Stir well.  Garnish with lemon and orange slices.  Makes about 24 (4 ounce) servings.

name: GROUND BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  oz. egg noodles, drained
1 medium  pkg. Cheddar cheese (reserve half of cheese for top)
1 1/2  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
1  c. mushroom soup
1  can water
1  can Mexican corn
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. sour cream
preparation: Mix together after noodles and meat have been cooked and drained.  Put in casserole bowl.  Top with cheese.  Bake at 350° until it bubbles.

name: SPICY PEAR COBBLER
ingredients:
10  packs sugar substitute
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 1/3  c. lo-cal cranberry juice cocktail
few drops red food coloring (optional)
2 1/2  lb. pears, sliced (10 medium)
1  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  c. biscuit mix
1/3  c. milk
preparation: Combine sugar and nutmeg (save about 1/4 of mixture).  Blend in saucepan, 3/4 of mixture and cornstarch.  Stir in juice and coloring.  Cook and stir over medium heat until thick and bubbly. Add pears and butter.  Return to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  c. sugar
3  c. apples, chopped fine
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all together.  Pour into a greased and floured tube pan and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Test to see when it is done.

name: JAPANESE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. saifun
1  can chopped clams or 1 can shrimp
1/2  head lettuce
1  cucumber
2  stalks celery
1  carrot
preparation: Cook saifun in boiling water for 4 to 5 minutes or longer. Drain and set aside.  Add clams, shredded lettuce and sliced cucumber, celery and carrots.

name: RED RASPBERRY TOPPING
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  jar red raspberry preserves
1/4  c. water (adjustable)
1  tsp. almond flavoring
1  pkg. whole, frozen red raspberries
preparation: Place the first 3 ingredients in a blender and whip until smooth.  Fold in the frozen raspberries very carefully.  Store in refrigerator and it lasts a long time.  Serve over pound cake, angel food cake or ice cream.

name: BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. salt
16  oz. can pork and beans
3/4  c. barbecue sauce
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1 (9.5 oz.)  can biscuits
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Brown ground beef; drain.  Stir in next 5 ingredients and heat until bubbly.  Pour into 2-quart casserole. Cut biscuits in half circles.  Place cut side down around edge of casserole.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes until biscuits brown.

name: MUSTARD BRIE
ingredients:
8  oz. or 16 oz. round Brie or Camembert cheese
sweet mustard or sweet and hot mustard
chopped hot pepper or sweet red pepper
chopped green onion
preparation: Place cheese on ovenproof dish.  Cover with mustard.  Top with remaining ingredients.  Microwave carefully until just warm, not hot, about 4 to 5 minutes.  Spread on crackers or toast.

name: OLD-FASHIONED BOILED CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. plain flour
1  stick butter
1/2  c. Crisco
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. water
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In  mixing  bowl,  sift  together  sugar and flour.  In saucepan,  put  butter, Crisco, cocoa and water.  Mix together and bring  to a rapid boil and pour over flour-sugar mixture. Add remaining  ingredients;  beat well and bake 25 minutes at 400° in an oblong pan.  Frost with Chocolate Frosting.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. chili powder
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. celery seed
2  c. water
1  c. ketchup
1  tsp. Sweet 'N Low (brown)
few drops of Tabasco sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Simmer half an hour.

name: MAYONNAISE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. Miracle Whip
4  Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Bake at 325° in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for approximately 35 minutes.  Use toothpick to test for doneness.

name: BAKED POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. potatoes
1/4  c. celery, chopped fine
1  c. mayo
1  c. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Dice potatoes and boil until almost done.  Dice Velveeta cheese.  Mix all ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: ONE CRUST BLUEBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) pie shell, baked
1  qt. fresh blueberries, cleaned
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. water
3  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. water
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Keep 3 cups blueberries aside.  Cook remaining berries with 3/4 cup of water and 1 cup sugar until soft.  Make a paste of 1/4 cup water, salt and 3 tablespoons of flour.  Add to cooked berries and cook slowly over medium-low heat until thickened.  Add hot mixture to uncooked berries and turn into pie shell.  Chill 3 hours.  Top with whipped cream.

name: BETTER THAN SEX CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix with pudding
1 large  carton whipped topping
1 large  can crushed pineapple
chopped nuts
3  to 4 bananas, sliced
1  c. sugar
1 large  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
preparation: Mix and bake cake according to box directions in a 9 x 13 pan. Combine pineapple and sugar in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Boil 5 minutes. Make pudding according to box directions. Cool. Arrange slices of bananas over pineapple. Add pudding over bananas. Spread evenly. Top with whipped topping and sprinkle with nuts. Serves 8.

name: UGLY DUCKLING CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1 (16 oz.)  can fruit cocktail (use juice)
2  eggs
1  c. coconut
preparation: Blend ingredients and beat by hand for 2 minutes.  Spread in 9 x 13-inch greased cake pan.  Sprinkle on top 1/2 cup brown sugar. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.  Cool and frost.

name: PUMPKIN NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. pumpkin
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
1/4  c. butter
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients until well blended.  Put in bread pan. Bake at 350° until knife comes out clean, 45 to 55 minutes.

name: AUNT JUDY'S SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. hot water
2  boxes lime Jell-O (4 serving size)
1 (No. 2)  can pineapple, crushed
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1 small  can evaporated milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  carton cottage cheese
1  c. pecans (optional)
preparation: Combine Jell-O and hot water.  Stir until dissolved.  Add all other ingredients.  Stir well.  Refrigerate until set.  Better if prepared 24 hours before serving.

name: CALUMET BAKING POWDER CORN BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. yellow corn meal
1/2  c. boiling water
2  c. all-purpose flour
4 level  tsp. salt
3  eggs
2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Pour boiling water over corn meal and let stand until cool. Sift flour together with baking powder and salt.  Beat eggs until light and add them to corn meal, then add milk, flour and melted butter.  Beat until the batter is smooth.  Pour into a shallow, well-greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake in a 450° oven for 25 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 generous servings.

name: WHOLE WHEAT BREAD
ingredients:
3  pkg. quick rising yeast or 7 1/2 tsp. bulk yeast
3  Tbsp. granulated sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. wheat germ
1/4  c. wheat bran
1  Tbsp. molasses
3  Tbsp. soft shortening
4  c. whole wheat flour
4 1/2 to 5  c. white flour
3 1/2  c. warm water
preparation: In a large bowl, combine and mix 4 cups whole wheat flour, 2 cups white flour, wheat bran, wheat germ, brown sugar, salt, granulated sugar and quick rising yeast.  Add molasses, shortening and water.  Mix and beat well.  Add additional flour as needed. Continue to mix well.  Turn out onto lightly floured surface and knead until smooth.

name: CHICKEN SUPREME
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts
2  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  lb. sliced mushrooms
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. white wine
1  c. heavy cream
1/4  c. parsley
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Sprinkle chicken with paprika and pepper.  In large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.  Add chicken and cook, turning for 5 to 7 minutes until brown.  Place in 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Add mushrooms to skillet.  Cook, stirring often, for 2 to 3 minutes.

name: COCONUT-SOUR CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix (not pudding)
2  (8 oz.) frozen coconut, thawed
2  (8 oz.) sour cream
2  c. sugar
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake by directions in two layers.  Let cool. Mix together sour cream, coconut and sugar and set aside.  Slice each cake layer into two layers, making a total of 4 thin layers.  Put about 1/2 to 3/4 cup of mixture between your cake layers, stacking one on top of another.  Mix Cool Whip with remaining mixture which should be about 1 1/2 cups or so and frost the cake.  Cover cake with Saran Wrap carefully and refrigerate 3 days before serving.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash browns
2  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. melted butter
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  c. Cheddar cheese
1  can creamy chicken soup
1/2  c. chopped onions
preparation: Thaw potatoes.  Mix other ingredients together.  Pour over potatoes in casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: HAMBURGER POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. hamburger
1/2  medium onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  c. shredded Velveeta cheese
1/2  bag Tater Tots
preparation: Cook hamburger; drain.  Put into casserole dish.  Cover with onion and mushroom soup.  Spread with shredded cheese over top. Place Tater Tots close together on top of cheese layer.  Cook at 350° for approximately 45 minutes.

name: STROGANOFF SKILLET
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can Campbell's cream of mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
1  can Campbell's beef broth *
1/2  c. water
3  c. uncooked medium noodles
1 small  can mushrooms, drained
preparation: In skillet, brown beef and cook onion until tender.  (Use shortening if necessary.)  Stir to separate meat.  Drain grease and blot with paper towels.  Gradually blend in remaining ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce heat.  Cover; simmer 10 minutes or until noodles are done.  Stir often.  Makes 5 cups.

name: SPINACH BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. Pepperidge Farm herb cubes
2  pkg. chopped, frozen spinach, thawed and drained
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. margarine
4  eggs, beaten
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. garlic salt
dash of thyme
preparation: Saute onion in margarine.  Combine  all ingredients and allow to set a few minutes.  Shape  into	walnut	size  balls. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake  at  400°  for about 20 minutes.

name: DIVINITY CAKE ICING
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. white Karo
1/2  c. water
2  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Boil sugar, water and Karo until it will spin a thread.  Beat egg whites stiff while syrup is boiling (not too dry).   Pour 1/2 of syrup over egg whites slowly, beating at 10 to 12 on mixer. Let other half of syrup cook until it bubbles real thick.  Pour this over first part and cream until stiff and cool.  Do not spread on cake until it has cooled or it will be sticky.  If it gets too hard, add little hot water to it or sit pot in hot water. If weather is pretty, add cream of tartar; if not, do not add, then add vanilla.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/3  c. chopped pickles
1/3  c. chopped carrots
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
2  Tbsp. mustard (mix in the mayonnaise)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Chill and serve.

name: STORYBOOK FUDGE
ingredients:
4  oz. liquid chocolate
6  oz. cream cheese
1  lb. box confectioners sugar
2/3  c. nuts
preparation: Soften cream  cheese.  Add  sugar  to cream cheese.  Add chocolate and stir well.  Add nuts.  Chill for 30 minutes.  Cut into squares.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  to 6 potatoes, peeled and sliced
1  medium onion, sliced
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can green beans, drained
4  butterfly pork chops
preparation: In casserole dish sprayed with Pam, layer potatoes, onions, 1/3 can soup (spread over top), green beans, 1/3 can soup, pork chops, remainder of soup, salt and pepper as desired.  Cover and bake at 325° for 1 3/4 hours.  Remove cover and brown for 15 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: WEST INDIES SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. crab meat
1  medium onion, chopped fine
4  oz. Wesson oil (don't substitute)
3  oz. cider vinegar
4  oz. ice water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Divide onion in half.  Spread half over bottom of a large bowl.  Separate and spread crab meat over onion.  Spread rest of onion over crab meat.  Salt and pepper.  Pour the remaining ingredients (Wesson oil, vinegar and ice water) over top of onion layer.  Cover and place in refrigerator to marinate 12 to 24 hours.  Toss lightly before serving.  Do not stir.  Follow recipe precisely for best results.

name: MEXICAN WEDDING COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter, softened
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1 1/4  tsp. almond extract
1  c. chopped pecans
2/3  c. powdered sugar (optional)
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/4  tsp. vanilla extract
1 3/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream butter, shortening and 1/2 cup powdered sugar in a large bowl.  Stir in vanilla and almond extract.  Mix in flour, pecans and salt.  Stir until smooth.  Chill until firm, 1 hour.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE AND POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
3 to 4  c. cooked cubed potatoes
1/2  c. sliced celery
1  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. chopped pimiento
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. chopped sweet pickle
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. dried mustard
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. small curd cottage cheese
preparation: Combine potatoes, celery, green pepper, pimiento, onion and pickle.  Toss ingredients lightly and chill.

name: SWEET POTATO PUDDING
ingredients:
1  pt. raw ground sweet potatoes
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
3  eggs
1/2  c. flour
1  qt. milk
preparation: Beat together and pour into buttered pan.  Add 1 tablespoon butter on top before baking about 2 hours at 375°.  Serve with cream, either warm or cold.

name: TURKEY MARINADE
ingredients:
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. oil
2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. dry mustard
2  cloves garlic
preparation: Mix and pour over turkey pieces for grilling. Marinate 4 hours or overnight. Grill and baste.

name: PECAN TARTS
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sifted flour
preparation: Soften cream cheese and butter; mix well.  Stir in flour. Mix; cover and refrigerate.  Chill about 1 hour.  Shape into small balls, about 1-inch.  Press into the mini muffin tins.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2  c. coarsely grated zucchini (unpeeled)
2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  c. chopped pecans or walnuts (optional)
8  oz. cream cheese (to spread on top, put on before eating; optional)
preparation: Beat eggs until frothy. Beat in sugar.  Add oil and vanilla and beat until thick and lemon colored.  Add loosely packed, grated zucchini.  Sift dry ingredients and add to egg mixture. Fold in pecans.  Pour into 2 (8 x 4-inch) greased and floured loaf pans or 4 small loaf pans.

name: BUTTER CREAM ICING
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
5  c. (10x) sugar
1/4  c. plus 1 Tbsp. milk
preparation: In  large  mixing  bowl,  cream butter or margarine and shortening	together.  Add	vanilla.  Gradually add 10x sugar, one cup  at a time, beating very well.  Beat on medium speed. Scrape sides and  bottom  of bowl often.  Add milk and beat at high speed until  light  and	fluffy.  Will  keep  very well, covered tightly, in refrigerator for several weeks.  Great for decorating fancy  cakes.  Set	out  at room temperature before using.

name: LONG LASTING PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. water
1/2  c. salt
2  tsp. cream of tartar
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
preparation: Mix, cook on medium heat and stir until thickened and forms a ball.  Cool.  Knead.  Use and enjoy!

name: BASQUE BEANS
ingredients:
3  lb. dried pinto beans
3  slices bacon, chopped
1  large onion, chopped
3  c. fresh green beans, snapped
1  can garbanzo beans, drained
2 (10 oz.)  cans tomatoes
1 1/2  lb. lean ham or small ham hock
1  tsp. salt (if desired)
6  Basque chorizos, cooked (available at Ponderosa Meats in Reno or Butcher Boy Meat Market in Sparks)
preparation: Discard discolored pinto beans; rinse remainder under cold running water.  Drain well.  Transfer to large bowl.  Add enough cold water to cover.  Let soak at least 8 hours or overnight.

name: CHILI CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
2  cans chili no beans
2  (16 oz.) blocks of cream cheese, softened
1  pkg. shredded Cheddar or Velveeta cheese
salsa *
green onions *
jalapenos *
olives *
preparation: *Optional additions.

name: SWEET 'N SOUR BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
8  bacon slices, panfry until crisp, drain and crumble
4  large onions, cut into rings
1/2 to 1  c. brown sugar (1 c. if you like your beans sweet)
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cider vinegar
2 (15 oz.)  cans drained dry limas
1 (No. 1)  can drained green limas
1 (No. 1)  can drained dark red kidney beans
1 (No. 1)  can baked beans (not drained)
