preparation: Place onion rings in skillet bacon was fried in.  Add sugar, seasonings and vinegar.  Cover and cook 20 minutes.  Add this to the beans.  Add bacon bits and place in 3 quart baking dish and bake until browned.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES(Stay Soft)
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. butter, softened (not melted)
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1/2  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except flour and chips.  Stir flour in last and follow with chips.  Roll in balls and bake until done at 325°.

name: DOUBLE FUDGE BROWNIE BARS
ingredients:
1 (19.8 oz. or 21.5 oz.)  pkg. fudge brownie mix
1/4  c. chopped nuts
2  c. (12 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/4  c. margarine or butter
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk!!)
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Prepare brownie mix as package directs; stir in nuts.  Spread into greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until center is set.

name: REFRIGERATOR PICKLES
ingredients:
4  pounds cucumbers, peeled and sliced
4  tablespoons pickling salt
1  - 1/2 teaspoons mustard seed
3/4  teaspoon celery seed
1/2  teaspoon alum
1  large onion, sliced
3  cups sugar
2  - 1/2 cups white vinegar
preparation: In large bowl combine salt, mustard seed, celery seed, onion, sugar, and white vinegar. Put pickles in jars, cover with vinegar mixture. Put in refrigerator. Keeps for 2 weeks.

name: CHOCOLATE OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. milk
1 1/2  Tbsp. cocoa
1 1/2  Tbsp. peanut butter
1 1/2  c. oats
preparation: Combine margarine, sugar, milk and cocoa in saucepan.  Boil for 1 minute while stirring.  Remove from heat.  Add peanut butter; stir.  Add oats; stir.  Drop by spoonfuls quickly onto waxed paper.  Cool.  Yield:  3 dozen.

name: "DUTCH BUNNY"(A Big Pancake)
ingredients:
3  eggs
3/4  cup milk
3/4  cup all purpose flour
1/2  tsp salt
1/2  cup butter, melted
juice of 1/2 lemon
confectioners sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Beat eggs and milk until they are well blended.  Add the flour and salt, stirring the batter until it is slightly lumpy.  Set 10-inch pie pan or skillet in oven to melt butter.  When the butter is very hot, pour in the batter and bake for about 20 minutes or longer or until the pancake is brown and puffed.  Sprinkle with lemon juice and confectioners sugar and cut into wedges.  Serve immediately as it will deflate quickly.  Serves 4.

name: OVEN STEW
ingredients:
6  potatoes
6  carrots
1  c. celery
3  onions
2  lb. stew meat
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. tapioca
1 (17 oz.)  can tomatoes
preparation: Chop vegetables; mix everything raw and put in roaster (you can brown meat first or put in raw).  Cover and bake at 250° for 3 to 4 hours.

name: STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
2  lb. mushrooms (large)
1  c. bread crumbs
1  c. Mozzarella cheese
1  lb. bacon
preparation: Fry bacon; drain grease.  Crumble bacon.  Remove stems from mushrooms.  Chop stems and fry in skillet.  Drain.  Add bread crumbs and cheese.  Add crumbled bacon; stuff mushroom caps with filling.  Bake caps at 450° for 12 to 15 minutes.  Serve hot. Optional:  Add 1/2 pound browned sausage.

name: CUCUMBER PARTY SANDWICHES
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing mix
dill weed
2  to 3 cucumbers
Pepperidge Farm party bread
preparation: Mix cream cheese and dressing mix. Spread on bread. Top with cucumber slices. Sprinkle with dill weed.

name: CHICKEN MARENGO(Serves 8)
ingredients:
2  fryer chickens (2 1/2 lb.), cut up
2  tsp. shortening
1  can sliced mushrooms
2 medium  cloves garlic, minced
1  lb. onions
1/3  c. flour
1  can tomatoes
1/4  c. parsley
2  bay leaves
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. white wine
preparation: Brown chicken in shortening.  Remove.  Add next 3 ingredients and saute until golden.  Stir in flour.  Add chicken and wine. Simmer 40 to 45 minutes until tender or use crock-pot.

name: WACKY CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  pinch salt
1  c. cold water
6  Tbsp. oil
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift dry ingredients into an 8 x 8-inch pan.  Make 3 holes. Put vinegar in one hole, oil in the next and vanilla in the last hole.  Pour water over all; stir with a fork until moistened. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  My favorite!

name: SMITH'S 3 BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. wax or yellow beans, drained
2  c. green beans, drained
2  c. kidney beans, drained
1/2  c. diced green peppers
1/2  c. diced onions
1/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. vinegar
1/4  c. salad oil
1  tsp. salt
pinch of garlic powder
preparation: Mix vegetables listed together.  Pour mixture of the sugar, vinegar, oil, salt and garlic over them and chill before serving.

name: MUSLIKKAPHRAKAT(Finnish Blueberry Bars)
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. butter, softened
2  c. fresh blueberries
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. grated lemon rind
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine flour, 1/2 cup sugar, egg and baking powder in bowl; mix well.  Cut in butter until crumbly.  Reserve 1/2 cup mixture. Press remaining dough in ball.  Roll on floured surface.  Press over bottom and sides of pan.  Dough will be crumbly.  Press pieces together in pan.

name: CARAMEL PIE
ingredients:
1  container Marzetti caramel apple dip
1  ready made crust (chocolate crumb or graham cracker)
1  container Cool Whip
miniature chocolate chips
chopped nuts
preparation: Pour Marzetti caramel apple dip into chocolate or graham cracker crust.  Cover with Cool Whip.  Sprinkle with chopped nuts and miniature chocolate chips per taste or eye appeal.  Freeze. Thaw about 5 minutes before serving.

name: 2 QUICK PASTAS
ingredients:
linguini or spaghetti
sauteed red peppers
sauteed mushrooms
olive oil
garlic powder to taste or garlic cloves, minced
grated Parmesan cheese
salt-free seasoning
preparation: No. 2:  Change olive oil to butter.  Add shredded Mozzarella or Monterey Jack cheese.  Add heavy cream (optional).

name: WHOLE WHEAT PRETZELS
ingredients:
3/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. honey
1  tsp. salt
1 3/4  c. whole wheat flour
1 1/2  tsp. dry yeast
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Knead until soft.  Rest in a warm place until twice the size.  Cut into 16 strips.  Roll.  Cover and let rise until twice the size, approximately 45 minutes.  Bring 2 quarts of water with 4 teaspoons baking soda to a boil.  Turn to light simmer.  Gently place pretzel in water with slotted spoon. Leave in water 1 minute, turning once.  Remove and place on an oiled cookie sheet.  Sprinkle with coarse salt, poppy seed or sesame seed, if desired.  Bake at 475° for 12 minutes.

name: CHEESE SAUCE
ingredients:
2  c. grated cheese
1/3  c. milk
6  drops Tabasco sauce
1/4  tsp. prepared mustard
boiling water
preparation: Place cheese in a double boiler top.  Cook over boiling water until cheese is melted.  Slowly add milk, stirring constantly, until sauce is smooth. Add Tabasco sauce and mustard. Blend thoroughly.  Yields 2 cups.

name: BAKED REDFISH YVONNE
ingredients:
1/2  c. cooking oil
3/4  c. flour
2  medium onions, chopped fine
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  bell pepper, chopped fine
2  cloves garlic, chopped fine
2  qt. stewed whole tomatoes, preferably homegrown or 2 cans tomato puree
1 1/2  qt. fish stock
3  bay leaves
3  Tbsp. chopped green onion tops
3  Tbsp. chopped parsley
2  Tbsp. sugar or substitute sweetener
salt and red pepper to taste
1 (8 oz.)  can whole mushrooms
6  to 10 redfish fillets
1  lemon, sliced thin
cooked rice
preparation: Stock:  Boil fish heads, bones and seasoning in 2 quarts of water; reduce to 1 1/2 quarts.

name: FROGMORE BROILED FISH
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. skinned fish fillet
1/4  lb. butter
1  Tbsp. Old Bay seasoning
preparation: Lightly butter broiler pan and lay fillets on pan.  Baste fish with butter and sprinkle Old Bay on top.  Place oven rack on highest level and turn oven on broil.  Broil for 5 minutes or until top of fish turns brown.  Serve hot.  Serves 4.

name: IC PILAF(Savory Rice)
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. rice
10  Tbsp. margarine
1 medium tomato or 1/2  c. tomato sauce
1  dessertspoon sugar
1  tsp. pine nuts
1  sprig dill
black pepper, mixed spices, cinnamon and salt
3  c. water or stock
1  medium onion
1/2  lambs liver or one chicken or turkey liver
1  tsp. currants
preparation: Remove the skin from the liver and chop up finely.  Fry the liver in 2 tablespoons of margarine.  Put to one side.  Put rice in hot water and let it cool.  Wash it in plenty of cold water.  Put 8 tablespoonfuls margarine in a pan and fry in it the pine nuts and onion until the onion is transparent.  Add the rice to this and fry for 10 minutes.  Add black pepper, cinnamon, mixed spices, 3 cups of water, currants, salt, sugar and finally chopped tomatoes or tomato sauce.  Cover with a lid.  Boil until the rice has absorbed the water and then turn down the heat and cook gently.  When the rice is done, add the fried liver.  Mix in the finely chopped dill. Fluff up the rice while serving.

name: MARSHMALLOW KRISPIES TREATS
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
40  marshmallows
5  c. Rice Krispies cereal
preparation: Melt  margarine  over  low  heat.  Add marshmallows and stir until  melted and well blended.  Remove from heat.	Stir in cereal until  well  coated.  Press into pan and cool, then cut into squares.

name: GOURMET CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, skinned
paprika
1  carton sour cream
1/2  box Cheese Nips
3/4 to 1  stick margarine
preparation: Place chicken breasts in baking dish and sprinkle liberally with paprika.  Completely cover chicken with sour cream.  Crush crackers and completely cover chicken with crackers.  Drizzle margarine on top.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: SPY GLASS SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  can deviled ham
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, cut up and softened
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper or celery
1  Tbsp. chopped pimiento (optional)
1/2  tsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Put all the ingredients for the ham and cheese filling in a small bowl.  Stir and mix everything well.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  white onion, diced
1  bag frozen broccoli cuts
1  bag Tater Tots
1 family size  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Brown hamburger and onions; drain.  Oil a 4-quart casserole dish.  Layer:  ground beef with onions, cream of mushroom soup, broccoli and Tater Tots.  Repeat until dish is full.  Preheat oven to 325°.  Cook for 30 minutes, uncovered.

name: CHINESE COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1  bag slaw mix or 1 medium head of cabbage, shredded
1/2  c. slivered almonds
2  Tbsp. sesame seeds
1/2  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. oil
1  pkg. Ramen oriental noodles
1  Tbsp. onion
1  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Mix oil, vinegar, and sugar in a saucepan.  Bring to boil. Remove from heat, and add flavor packet from noodles.  Toast almonds and sesame seeds in a small skillet in 1 Tbsp. margarine. Cool and add to slaw.  Break up noodles, and add to slaw along with dressing just before serving.

name: STRAWBERRIES IN THE SNOW
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. strawberry jello (dry)
3/4  c. Eagle Brand milk
1  c. coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix and refrigerate 1 hour.  Make into shape of strawberry and roll in red sugar.  Green leaves are slivered almonds dipped in food coloring.  Add water to green coloring.

name: BENSON'S ORANGE-CRANBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts, chopped
1/2  tsp. soda
1  c. raw cranberries, cut
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
1  c. boiling water
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. orange juice
1  egg
preparation: Place butter in cup.  Add boiling water to butter to equal 1/4 cup.  Add fresh orange juice to make 3/4 cup.  Add egg to dry ingredients, then add liquid and mix to blend.  Add nuts and cranberries.  Mix and pour into a greased and floured bread pan. Bake for 1 hour at 325°.

name: ORANGE CREAM MILK PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pt orange sherbet
1 (16 oz)  can lemon-lime flavored soda
1  qt cold milk
1  qt vanilla ice cream
preparation: Place the ice cream and sherbet in a punch bowl. Pour in the milk and lemon-lime soda. Stir gently and serve immediately.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. light brown sugar
1  c. canned pumpkin
1/2  c. salad oil
2  eggs
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. each salt, nutmeg and cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/4  c. water
preparation: Combine sugars, pumpkin, oil and eggs; beat until well blended. Sift flour, soda, salt and spices together.  Stir into pumpkin mixture.  Stir in nuts and water; spoon into well oiled 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until bread tests done.  Turn out on rack to cool.

name: GREEN BEANS WITH GARLIC
ingredients:
1  lb. green beans, washed and snapped
1/4  c. unsalted butter
1  clove garlic, peeled and bruised
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook beans in at least 4 quarts of salted, boiling water for 3 minutes or to taste.  They should remain a little crunchy.  Remove beans and immerse immediately in ice-cold water.  (This fixes the bright green color.)  Melt butter in saute pan; add garlic and thoroughly drained green beans.  Saute to warm beans and sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Remove garlic.  Serve.

name: BUTTERFINGER CAKE
ingredients:
4  or 6 large Butterfinger bars, crushed
1  angel food cake
4  egg yolks
1/2  c. butter
2  c. powdered sugar
14  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: In 9 x 13-inch pan, break 1/2 of angel food cake in bite size pieces.  Beat egg yolks and butter until creamy.  Add powdered sugar; beat well.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Spread 1/2 on cake pieces. Top with 1/2 of candy bars.  Repeat the 3 layers.  Chill.

name: LAYERED SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
3 (6 oz.)  cans small shrimp, rinsed and drained
1 (2 1/4 oz.)  can sliced ripe olives, drained
1  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
6  Tbsp. salsa, divided
1/2  c. cocktail sauce
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
sliced green onions
tortilla chips
preparation: Combine cream cheese and 3 tablespoons salsa. Spread in ungreased 9-inch pie plate. Combine cocktail sauce and remaining salsa. Spread over cream cheese. Place shrimp evenly on top. Sprinkle with olives. Combine shredded cheeses. Sprinkle over olives. Top with onions. Chill. Serve with tortilla chips. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

name: ZUCCHINI-APPLE BREAD
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
5  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2  c. shredded zucchini (about 3 medium or 1 large)
1  c. shredded apple
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine first 6 dry ingredients; set aside.  Combine eggs, sugars, oil and vanilla in large bowl.  Beat at medium speed until well blended.  Stir in zucchini, apple and nuts.  Add dry ingredients, stirring just to moisten.  Spoon batter into 3 greased and floured 8 1/4 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until wooden pick comes out clean.  Cool in pans for 10 minutes.  Remove to wire rack and cool completely.

name: HARLEYSVILLE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. cooking oil
2  c. cold water
2  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix together first 5 ingredients.  Make a well and add oil, water and vinegar.  Beat until smooth.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: BOURBON HOT DOGS
ingredients:
1  lb. hot dogs, cut into bite size
1/2  c. ketchup
3/4  c. bourbon
1/2  c. pkg. brown sugar
preparation: Mix all together and simmer 1 hour.  Serve hot.

name: TUNA FISH SALAD FOR A CROWD
ingredients:
5  eggs, boiled and chopped
1  apple, chopped
1/4  c. chopped sweet pickles
salt and pepper
4  cans tuna fish
1/2  onion, chopped
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. pickle juice
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl. Salt and pepper to taste. This will serve a large crowd.

name: PUMPKIN CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  can pumpkin (small)
2  eggs
1/4  c. water
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. pumpkin spice
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 45 minutes at 350°.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: CHICKEN ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1/3  c. crushed herb seasoned croutons
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese with chives, softened
2  Tbsp. margarine, softened
1/2  tsp. lemon and pepper seasoning
1  c. cubed cooked chicken
1/3  c. drained mushrooms
1  can Pillsbury crescent rolls
3  Tbsp. margarine, melted
1  pkg. chicken gravy mix
preparation: In small bowl, combine crushed croutons and set aside.  In medium mixing bowl, combine cream cheese, 2 tablespoons margarine and seasoning; mix well.  Stir in chicken and mushrooms.  Set aside.

name: BEEF AND EGGPLANT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1/2  tsp. dried basil
1/8  tsp. black pepper
2  medium eggplants, cut into 2-inch cubes
1/2  lb. Mozzarella cheese, sliced
preparation: Brown meat in heavy skillet.  Add onion and pepper; cook about 2 minutes, stirring frequently.  Add tomato sauce, salt, oregano, basil and pepper.  Stir well to blend.  Cook 5 to 10 minutes. Place eggplant in buttered 13 3/4 x 9 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Pour meat mixture over eggplant.  Bake in a moderate oven at 350° for about 20 to 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly.  Arrange cheese slices on meat.  Continue to bake 5 to 10 minutes or until cheese melts.

name: CROCK-POT MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  beaten eggs
2/3  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef
3/4  c. milk
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. sage
preparation: Combine all ingredients and shape into 6-inch ball. Place into crock-pot.  Flatten with hand or spoon so that meat will contour to the crock-pot.  Cook on low 5 to 6 hours.

name: BAKED SALMON FILETS WITH FENNEL AND LEMON
ingredients:
2  salmon filets, 1/2 lb each
1  large fennel bulb
1/2  lemon sliced thin with rind
several sweet onion rings or sliced leek
1/2  to 3/4 c maple syrup (don't use imitation)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Rinse salmon and pat dry.  Place in buttered, glass baking dish.  Rinse and slice fennel bulb and place on top of filets. Add lemon slices and onion/leek.  Lightly salt and pepper.  Pour maple syrup over both filets.  Bake in 350 degree oven approximately 30 minutes.  Test for doneness.  Veggies will be crunchy.  Serve with Mango Salsa, found in the Appetizers, Relishes and Pickles section of the cookbook.

name: BARBECUED RIBS
ingredients:
country style or bone in pork ribs (approximately 3 or 4 lb.)
onion
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
salt and pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (8 oz.)  can water
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour over ribs.  Bake at 350° until done.  Baste if necessary.  I never measure, just pinch and dump so use your own judgment and enjoy!

name: WHIRLIGIG COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  egg
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. flour
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream together the first 4 ingredients.  Add remaining ingredients, except chocolate chips.  Melt chocolate chips; cool slightly.  Spread on rolled out dough.  Roll up like jelly roll and chill.  Slice 1/4-inch thick.  Bake at 375° until lightly browned.

name: CREAMED ONIONS
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2 to 4  Tbsp. flour
milk
4 to 6  oz. Velveeta cheese
12  oz. bag frozen onions (do not thaw) or tiny onions, peeled and cooked slightly
bread crumbs or dry prepared stuffing
8  to 10 potatoes, peeled and boiled
8  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. sour cream
2  Tbsp. chives
garlic powder
salt
milk
melted butter
paprika
preparation: Cream the cream cheese.  Add sour cream and chives.  Stir in potatoes, one at a time while hot, adding milk if necessary to achieve creamy texture.  Add garlic powder and salt.  Put in baking dish.  Brush top with melted butter, then sprinkle with paprika.  Refrigerate or freeze for later.  Bake at 350°  for 1 hour.  Thaw before baking.

name: CHERRY PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  c. lard
1/2  c. sugar
pinch of salt
1  c. sour milk (add 1 Tbsp. vinegar to milk)
1  can Eagle Brand
2  tsp. baking powder
flour
sour cherries, drain juice
preparation: Put all ingredients in except the cherries.  Add flour until mixture is cake like.  Add amount of cherries you desire.  Bake at 350° until golden brown.

name: THIN MAPLE PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. maple syrup
1  egg, beaten
1  c. milk
3  Tbsp. melted shortening
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder and salt together.  Combine syrup, egg and milk; gradually add to other ingredients.  Beat until smooth, then add shortening.  Cook in frying pan on medium heat.

name: NEVER FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. shortening
1  egg
6  Tbsp. cold water
1  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Sift together 3 cups flour and salt.  Add shortening and mix until crumbly.  Add egg, water and vinegar.  Stir well.   Form 3 balls.  Chill or may use immediately.  The food processor is great for mixing.

name: NO COOK COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/4  c. cocoa (unsweetened)
3  c. oatmeal (uncooked)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In a large saucepan, mix margarine, sugar, milk and cocoa. Stir often and bring to a boil for 1 minute.  Remove from heat and let cool.  Stir in peanut butter and vanilla.  Mix well and add oatmeal.  Mix well and drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper to cool.

name: LEFTOVER CHRISTMAS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
leftover mashed potatoes
turkey or chicken
filling
gravy
preparation: You can make this recipe using any amount of ingredients desired.  Grease casserole and place in layers.  Bake, covered, in 350° oven for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1  onion, finely chopped
1  egg
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. Worcestershire
4  oz. can tomato sauce or catsup
1/2  tsp. garlic powder (optional)
3/4  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  tsp. mustard
preparation: Cook another 15 or 20 minutes.

name: BLACK-BOTTOM GOODIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
1  c. water
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  egg
1/2  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate mini morsels
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Make a well in center of mixture. Combine water, oil, vinegar and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients, stirring well. Spoon batter into paper-lined miniature muffin pans, filling 2/3 full. Combine cream cheese and next 3 ingredients, stirring well. Stir in chocolate morsels. Spoon about 1 teaspoon cream cheese mixture over chocolate batter. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes. Yield: 5 dozen.

name: SLICED BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  potatoes
1  tsp. salt
2-3 Tbsp. butter
2-3 Tbsp. fresh herbs, (parsley, chives, thyme or sage)
4  Tbsp. grated Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Clean potatoes, slice, but not completly through.  Place in baking dish.  Spread mixture over and bake for 10 minutes in microwave.  Sprinkle with cheese and bake 10 minutes more.

name: SAUSAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
8  oz. cream cheese, chopped
1  pkg. crescent rolls
preparation: Cook sausage and then drain and wash with hot water.  Return to skillet but get hot and add 8 oz. cream cheese.  Stir well. Roll out package of crescent rolls on cabinet.  Put sausage mixture on rolls.  Roll up.  Butter good and cook until brown. Sprinkle with cheese and serve.

name: SANDERS BUTTER CREME FROSTING
ingredients:
5  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
1/3  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. Crisco
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix flour and milk until smooth. Cook over low heat until paste is formed. Cool, stirring often. Cream butter and Crisco. Add sugar, salt and vanilla. Beat until light and fluffy. Add cooled mixture and beat until like whipped cream.

name: FLAKED GOULASH
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey
1 large  can chop suey vegetables
1 small  can bean sprouts
1/2  tsp. pepper
celery
2  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. Italian salad dressing
2  tsp. onion flakes
preparation: Brown turkey; drain off liquid.  Mix all ingredients together. Simmer until juice thickens, 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: HOBNAIL ICING
ingredients:
1  c. sifted confectioners sugar
2  to 3 egg yolks or 1 small egg
1/4  c. milk
3  sq. unsweetened chocolate (3 oz.), melted
1  Tbsp. soft shortening
3/4  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Place bowl in ice water.  Use mixer to beat until of spreading consistency.  Spread icing smoothly on cake.

name: SPINACH SOUFFLE SALAD
ingredients:
6  oz. lemon gelatin
1 1/2  c. boiling water
3  Tbsp. vinegar
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  c. ice water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped frozen spinach, thawed and drained
3/4  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  c. cottage cheese, drained
preparation: Add gelatin to boiling water and stir until dissolved.  Add vinegar, mayonnaise, salt and pepper and mix well.  Add ice cold water and stir well.  Refrigerate until it begins to thicken.  Add spinach, celery, onion and cheese.  Blend well, turn into 9-inch square pan and stir again.  Refrigerate until firm.  Serves 9.

name: JUNE HARRIS' PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1  large round steak, cut into strips
1  1/2 bell pepper, cut into strips
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1 (5 1/2 oz.)  can mushrooms
2  c. water
2  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  beef bouillon cube
preparation: Cook first 4 ingredients 20 minutes in oil.  Pour off oil and add last 4 ingredients.  Simmer until tender.  Next, mix 3 tablespoon flour with 1/2 cup water and add to mixture along with 1 cup water.  Cook until thick.  Serve over rice or noodles.

name: CHOCOLATE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2  c. heavy cream
4  egg yolks
10  packets sugar substitute
1/4  c. unsweetened cocoa powder
2  Tbsp. unsweetened chocolate syrup
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Heat cream in a heavy saucepan over low heat.  Whisk in egg yolks, one at a time.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture coats the back of a spoon.  Do not let boil.  Remove from heat.  Whisk in sugar substitute, cocoa powder, chocolate syrup and vanilla extract.  Cool to room temperature.  Pour custard into an ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturers instructions.

name: SQUASH DRESSING
ingredients:
2  c. cooked and mashed squash
1  large onion, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can chicken broth
1  Mexican cornbread mix, cooked
preparation: Boil squash and mash.  Bake cornbread.  Mix together.  Add soup and broth.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: HOLY COW CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate mix
1  jar caramel topping
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Prepare cake as directed on box. While hot from oven, punch holes in cake with straw.  Slowly pour Eagle Brand milk over cake. Do same with caramel topping.  Let cake cool to room temperature. When cake is completely cool, top with Cool Whip.  Keep in the refrigerator.  The longer the cake sits, the better it gets.

name: QUICK HOT DOG CHILI
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1 large  can Manwich
1  can Armour chili
1  onion, chopped
1  sweet pepper, chopped
preparation: Fry hamburger, onion and pepper.  Drain all fat; then add Manwich and chili.  Simmer 30 minutes.

name: LAYERED DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
3/4  c. margarine
1/2  c. chopped pecans
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1 small  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
1 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: First Layer:  With hands thoroughly mix flour, margarine and pecans; spread on bottom of 9 x 12-inch casserole dish.   Press firmly for dough to only cover bottom of dish.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes and let cool.

name: CRANBERRY ORANGE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2 3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. margarine (soft)
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. grated orange peel
1 1/2  c. chopped fresh or frozen cranberries (do not thaw)
1/2  tsp. salt
8  oz. sour cream
6  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour 12-cup tube pan.  In large bowl, beat sugar and margarine until light and fluffy.  Add vanilla and orange peel.  Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each.

name: PINEAPPLE SHERBET PUNCH
ingredients:
1- 46  oz. can pineapple juice
1  pint cranberry juice cocktail
1- 28  oz. bottle ginger ale
1  can pink grapefruit juice
1  pint pineapple sherbet
preparation: Chill juices and ginger ale.  Combine in punch bowl.  Float spoonful of slightly softened sherbet in punch bowl.

name: BUMSTEADS
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  can chopped chicken or tuna
3  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
2  Tbsp. green pepper, chopped
2  Tbsp. stuffed olives, chopped
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  lb. American cheese, cubed (1 c.)
2  Tbsp. sweet relish (optional)
preparation: Toss ingredients lightly.  Fill 8 hot dog rolls.  Wrap in foil and bake at 250° for 30 minutes.  Makes 8 servings.

name: PARMESAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  c. buttery cracker crumbs (like Club or Ritz)
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. fresh parsley, chopped
4  chicken breasts
1/2  c. melted oleo (add garlic if desired)
preparation: Combine crumbs, cheese and parsley.  Dip chicken breasts in oleo; roll in crumb mixture.  Place in greased dish.  Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour at 325°.

name: PINEAPPLE DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. shortening
1  tsp. salt
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg, well beaten
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. rolled oats
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. crushed pineapple
preparation: Blend shortening, salt and vanilla.  Add sugar and cream well. Add eggs and beat well.  Add flour and baking powder (which have been sifted together) and blend.  Add oatmeal, nuts and pineapple and blend.  Drop on cookie sheets.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes.

name: WYOMING ZUCCHINI BREAD("A Favorite From The 76 Cookbook.")
ingredients:
2  c. raw zucchini, shredded
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. ground cloves
1  c. walnuts, chopped (optional)
1  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Grease and lightly flour two 5 x 9-inch loaf pans.  In mixing bowl, combine oil, sugar, eggs, vanilla and shredded zucchini. Mix until blended.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1  garlic clove, minced
1  can tomato soup
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. oregano
preparation: Cook hamburg, onion and garlic until meat loses its color. Add rest of ingredients and simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN A LA KING
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter
6  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. chicken stock
1  c. milk
1  c. cut-up stewed chicken (chicken breasts)
1  c. sauteed sliced mushrooms
1/4  c. slivered green pepper (optional)
1/4  c. slivered pimento
1/2  c. green frozen peas, thawed
preparation: Melt butter; blend in flour, salt and pepper.  Cook over a low heat until smooth and bubbly.  Remove from heat, stir in stock and milk.  Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Stir in gently balance of ingredients.  Serve on buttered rice, noodles or toast.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
1  pt. real mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. (or more) dill weed
8  oz. sour cream
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  tsp. Beau Monde seasoning
preparation: Mix together the night before needed. Chill and serve with raw vegetables. Can be served with round rye bread. Hollow out a 6 x 3-inch hole and put in dip. Use vegetables and bread with dip.

name: M&M'S COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  c. M&M's
preparation: Mix sugars and butter until fluffy.   Blend in eggs and vanilla.  Add combined flour, soda and salt.  Mix well.  Stir in 1 1/2 cups of candies.  Drop dough by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.  Press remaining candies into cookies.  Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes 6 dozen cookies.

name: TUNA LOAF
ingredients:
2 (7 oz. each)  cans tuna
1  can cream of celery soup
1/4  c. milk
3/4  c. soda cracker crumbs
1/2  c. bread crumbs
4  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix well.  Put in greased bread pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

name: LASAGNA AL FORNO
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef or sausage
2  Tbsp. olive oil
3 1/2  c. (32 oz.) spaghetti sauce
1 (16 oz.)  box Ronzoni curly edge lasagna
2  c. (8 oz.) Mozzarella cheese, diced or shredded
4  c. (32 oz.) Ricotta cheese
3  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Brown beef or sausage, cut in small pieces, in oil in 3-quart saucepan; drain.  Add spaghetti sauce and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Cook lasagna; drain.  (Separate lasagna and lay out flat on wax paper or aluminum foil to keep pieces from sticking together as they cool.) Spread about half cup meat sauce on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Cover with layer of lasagna.  Add some Mozzarella and Ricotta cheeses and cover with sauce.  Repeat layers of lasagna, meat sauce and cheeses, ending with a layer of lasagna and sauce.  Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese.  Cover dish with aluminum foil.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.  Remove foil and bake 5 minutes longer.  Allow to stand about 10 minutes before cutting for easier handling.

name: JOHNNY MAZETTI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 small  can mushrooms
1  can tomato soup
1 small  pkg. cooked noodles
preparation: Saute meat in heavy skillet.   Add vegetables and cook 10 minutes.   Add soup and simmer for 30 minutes.   Add cooked noodles.  Pour into a casserole dish and sprinkle with 1/2 cup grated cheese.   Serves 6.

name: HORSERADISH CARROTS
ingredients:
1  lb. carrots, cut into narrow 3-inch strips
2  Tbsp. diced onion
2  Tbsp. horseradish
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. crumbs
2  Tbsp. oleo
preparation: Cook carrots until tender-crisp.  Reserve 1/4 cup liquid. Combine onion, mayonnaise, horseradish, salt and pepper.  Add liquid; put carrots into 1 1/2-quart casserole; fold in mixture. Cover with crumbs.  Dot with oleo.  Bake 15 minutes at 375°.

name: BUTTER CRUMB POTATOES(Microwave)
ingredients:
potatoes
bread crumbs
butter
preparation: Peel potatoes and slice in 1/4-inch pieces.  Roll potatoes in melted butter, then in bread crumbs.  Arrange in baking dish. Drizzle with butter.  Cover baking dish.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  c. raw peanuts
1  c. white sugar
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Stir together sugar and corn syrup in a deep microwave dish. Microwave on High 4 minute.  Stir in peanuts and salt.  Microwave on High 4 more minutes.  Add butter and vanilla to syrup and peanuts, blending well.  Microwave on High 2 minutes.  Remove from oven. Add baking soda and stir until light and foamy.  Pour mixture onto lightly greased cookie sheet.  Let cool 1/2 to 1 hour.  When cool, break into small pieces and store in airtight container.

name: SWEET POTATO CUSTARD
ingredients:
3  medium sweet potatoes
2  large eggs
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  sticks margarine
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
spices (if desired)
preparation: Boil potatoes; drain and peel.  Add butter.  Beat well.  Mix in sugar, eggs, milk and flavorings and spices.  Pour in pie crust (use deep), then bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: ICE CREAM
ingredients:
15  oz. can Eagle Brand milk
6  eggs
2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. vanilla
1  pt. whipping cream
3/4  gal. milk (about)
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients and some of milk.  Pour into freezer. Finish milk up to line.  If adding fruit, use about 2 cups.  If using fresh peaches, can change vanilla to almond.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  c. cooking oil
3  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
3  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. grated zucchini
1  c. pecans
preparation: Beat together sugar and eggs.  Add to egg mixture the cooking oil and vanilla.  Sift together the flour, salt, soda, baking powder and cinnamon.  Add to egg mixture.  Add grated zucchini and pecans.  Pour into greased and floured pans. Bake 1 hour or more at 325°.  Yields 2 loaves.

name: VEGIE BARS
ingredients:
1  pkg. (8) crescent rolls
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2 to 3/4  c. each diced: broccoli, tomato, green onion, shredded carrot, cauliflower, mushrooms and shredded cheese
1/2  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing (powder)
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: On cookie sheet, unroll crescent rolls and smooth with fingers to cover bottom.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes until lightly brown.  Cool 20 minutes.

name: ASPARAGUS AND ENGLISH PEA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen asparagus (can use fresh)
1 (6 oz.)  jar sliced mushrooms, drained (or fresh)
3/4  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. Italian bread crumbs
vegetable cooking spray
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas (can use fresh)
3  Tbsp. margarine
3  Tbsp. flour or whole wheat flour
1 (5 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
1/8  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. melted margarine
preparation: Cook asparagus and peas according to package directions, omitting salt.  Drain asparagus and peas, reserving 3/4 cup of asparagus cooking liquid.  Cut asparagus into 2-inch pieces and place asparagus, peas and mushrooms into a 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole, sprayed with vegetable spray.  Stir together.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2 chickens or 3 to 4  c. chicken meat
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. bread dressing
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts, sliced
1  c. chopped celery
1  stick margarine
preparation: Add all ingredients, except margarine and dressing mix.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Melt margarine and add to dressing mix.  Spread on top of chicken mix.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cocoa
1  c. buttermilk
1 1/2  c. oil (1 c. butter flavored oil and 1/2 c. regular oil)
1  tsp. vinegar
2  eggs
1  bottle red food coloring (1 oz.)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift together dry ingredients.  Add other ingredients in order and mix thoroughly.  Bake in layer cake pans that have been greased and floured.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: 6 WEEKS ORANGE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. white Karo
1  c. oleo, melted
1/2  c. buttermilk
4  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped dates
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
4  eggs, beaten
lemon or vanilla flavor
preparation: Put everything but the eggs into a large bowl and mix together.  Fold the beaten eggs in last.  Put in a covered bowl and store in icebox.

name: FUN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  tsp. baking soda
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. softened butter or shortening
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla extract
12  oz. pkg. M&M's candies
3/4  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Combine flour, baking soda and salt; set aside.  Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy.  Beat in egg and vanilla.  Blend in flour mixture slowly. Stir in M&M's candies and nuts.  Drop by heaping spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 8 to 11 minutes until browned.  Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet.  Place on wire rack for cooling.

name: BUTTER PECAN TORTE
ingredients:
60  Ritz crackers
1/2  c. butter
1 1/4  c. milk
2  pkg. instant pudding (butter pecan)
1  qt. vanilla ice cream
1  small (8 to 9 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Crush crackers and mix with melted butter.  Use 2/3 in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Save 1/3 for topping.

name: SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. hamburger or ground chuck
1  onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup (don't dilute)
1 to 2  cans green beans
instant or fresh mashed potatoes
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion.  Mix in soup and green beans; heat. Pour into casserole dish and cover the first four ingredients with the prepared mashed potatoes.  Put under broiler until mashed potato peaks are brown.  Makes 4 to 6 large servings.

name: COUNTRY POT ROAST
ingredients:
5  lb. chuck roast
flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. tomato juice
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire
12  small carrots, pared
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  clove garlic, crushed
1  tsp. dried oregano
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. wide noodles
preparation: Combine 1/4 cup flour, salt and pepper.  Coat roast.  In hot oil in a large skillet over medium heat, brown roast on all sides. Add onion, celery and garlic.  Saute until tender.  Add tomato juice, 1/4 cup water, Worcestershire and oregano.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, turning meat once.  Add carrots; simmer 30 minutes or until carrots are tender. Cook noodles according to package directions and drain.

name: FRENCH CUSTARD ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1  qt. milk (4 c.)
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  c. heavy cream
6  egg yolks
3/4  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Scald the milk.  Add the beaten egg yolks to which the sugar has been added.  Cook over hot water like custard, stirring constantly, until the mixture coats a wooden spoon.  Chill; add the cream and vanilla and freeze in hand or electric freezer, using 4 parts ice to 1 part ice cream salt.  Makes about 3 quarts.

name: MANHATTAN CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
2 (6 1/2 oz.)  cans minced clams
3  slices bacon, cut up fine
1  c. finely chopped celery
1  c. finely chopped onion
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
2  medium potatoes, peeled and chopped
1/2  c. chopped carrots
2  tsp. thyme
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Drain clams and reserve liquid.  Add enough water to liquid to measure 3 cups.  Partially cook bacon; add celery and onion.  Cook and stir until vegetables are tender.  Cut up tomatoes.  Stir in clam juice and water, undrained chopped tomatoes, potatoes, carrots and seasonings.  Boil and them reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes.  Mash vegetables slightly.  Add clams.  Turn into covered casserole and refrigerate 3 to 24 hours before serving.

name: PERFECT MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. uncooked oats
2  eggs, slightly beaten
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1/4  c. chopped onions
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease a 5 x 6-inch loaf pan.  Mix beef, oats, eggs, 1 can tomato sauce, onions, salt and pepper. Pack firmly into greased loaf pan.  Chill until meat loaf is firm. Bake 1 hour.

name: ONION ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton onion recipe soup mix
2  lb. potatoes, cut into large chunks
1/3  c. olive oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  In a large plastic bag, add all ingredients.  Close bag and shake until potatoes are evenly coated.  Empty potatoes into shallow baking or roasting pan; discard bag.  Bake, stirring occasionally, for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown.  Garnish, if desired, with chopped parsley.  Makes about 8 servings.

name: CAULICHEESE
ingredients:
1  medium head cauliflower, cooked halfway
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. (heaped) cornstarch
3  c. milk
1  tsp. hot English mustard
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. seasoned bread crumbs
4  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Strain and break cauliflower into pieces, then make 1 recipe of white sauce.  Put margarine and cornstarch in a pan; stir until melted.  Beat in milk, a bit at a time, until it has a custardy consistency (use a wooden spoon for this).  Add salt, pepper and mustard; pour over cauliflower in baking dish.  Sprinkle bread crumbs and cheese on top.  Bake at 350° until cheese is melted and golden brown.

name: TURKEY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. turkey, cooked
1/2  c. almonds
2  c. celery
1/3  c. bell pepper
2  Tbsp. pimento
1  c. (4 oz.) Swiss or Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  c. potato chips, crushed
preparation: Chop almonds, celery, bell pepper and pimento.  Combine with turkey and all other ingredients, except potato chips.   Pour mixture into greased 2-quart casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Sprinkle potato chips on top of casserole and bake until chips are lightly browned.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: HOT CRAB DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
10 to 12  oz. fresh crab meat
1/2  c. mayonnaise
pepper
dash of hot sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Put into buttered glass baking dish. Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Sprinkle with paprika.

name: ICEBOX FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1 large  box graham crackers
1  pkg. marshmallows
1 small  can Carnation milk
1  stick butter
1  c. flaked coconut
1 1/2  c. raisins
1/2  lb. green pineapple
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts
1/2  lb. red cherries
preparation: Crush  graham  crackers  fine.	Combine milk, marshmallows, butter  and vanilla in top of double boiler.  Heat until marshmallows  are  melted.	Pour  over  graham cracker crumbs. Mix well.  Add	fruit  and  nuts.  Line  cake  pan  with waxed paper. Grease  paper  with  butter.  Use  tube  or  loaf pan. Refrigerate 24 hours.

name: SOUR CREAM RAISIN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves or allspice
1/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. seedless raisins
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Combine sugar, spices, salt and eggs.  Mix well.  Blend in sour cream and vinegar.  Add raisins.  Pour in pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until set.

name: GRANDMA'S BEEF BARBECUE
ingredients:
4 to 6  lb. beef, roasted or cooked
1/2  tsp. garlic
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. basil
1  tsp. salt
3  onions
1  green pepper
preparation: After you cook beef, cut or pull apart into chunks. Season with garlic, salt and pepper. Simmer in frying pan the onions, green pepper and basil.  Add in beef chunks and 1 bottle or more barbecue sauce. Stir well over low heat for flavor to go through.

name: EASY COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white or yellow cake mix
2  pkg. frozen coconut
2 (16 oz.)  cartons sour cream
2  c. sugar
1 large  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cake according to package.  Bake in 2 layers.  When cool, split in 4 layers.  Mix coconut, sour cream and sugar; set aside 1/2 cup.  Spread the rest between cake layers.  Mix the reserved 1/2 cup with Cool Whip.  Spread over top and sides of cake. Refrigerate at least 3 days.  Keep refrigerated.

name: CORNED BEEF AND CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. cabbage
1 (12 oz.)  can corned beef, sliced
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
1 (5 1/3 oz.)  can evaporated milk
3  Tbsp. grated onion
1  tsp. mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
4  bread slices
2  Tbsp. melted butter
4  slices American cheese
preparation: Cover cabbage in small amount of water and cook 5 to 8 minutes or until tender. Drain well. Arrange alternate layers of cabbage and corned beef in shallow 2-quart casserole dish. Combine soup, milk, onion, mustard and salt.  Pour over cabbage and corned beef. Toss cubes cut from bread slices with butter. Arrange around edges of casserole. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Arrange cheese slices over center of casserole and return to oven for 5 minutes.

name: PUDDING DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  sticks oleo
3/4  c. chopped pecans
6  oz. Philadelphia cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2  large bowl Cool Whip
2 small  boxes butter pecan instant pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: Cut together flour and oleo; add pecans.  Put in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan and press flat to bottom.  Bake about 30 minutes at 350° and cool.  Cream together cream cheese and powdered sugar; add 1/2 bowl of Cool Whip.  Spread this mixture on baked crust.  Beat together pudding with milk on low speed for 2 minutes.  Spread on top of 1st mixture.  Chill for 5 minutes, then add the rest of bowl of Cool Whip on top and chill.

name: LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. Italian seasonings
1  clove garlic
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  Tbsp. basil
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. (2 c.) tomatoes
1  lb. lean beef
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
1/2  c. ketchup
10  oz. lasagne (broken) or wide noodles
1  lb. Mozzarella
1/2  c. two other kinds cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan
preparation: Cut up Mozzarella.  Brown meat, remove fat, add spices, tomatoes and ketchup and simmer 30 minutes.  Cook noodles in boiling salted water with a bit of oil until tender.  Drain and rinse in cold water.  Place 1/2 noodles in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle 1/2 cheese and cover with 1/2 sauce.   Repeat layers. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.  Let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

name: LOWER MANHATTAN
ingredients:
1/2  c. cola
1  oz. bitter lemon soda
1/2  tsp. syrup from maraschino cherries or to taste
1  maraschino cherry
preparation: In shaker, combine cola, bitter lemon soda and syrup to taste. Stir with ice and strain into a cocktail glass.  Garnish with maraschino cherry.  Makes 1 serving.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of mushroom or chicken soup
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
4  oz. Cheez Whiz
preparation: Melt butter. Sauté broccoli and onion in the melted butter. Add soup.  Cook for 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Add rice and cheese and mix well.

name: SPEEDY CHILE CON CARNE(Crock-Pot)
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  chile brick
1 (15 oz.)  can Ranch Style beans
garlic salt and pepper to taste
1  c. water
16  oz. tomato sauce
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain well.  (I brown mine by placing in a heatproof dish and season with garlic salt and pepper. Microwave on High for 3 minutes.  Stir well to break up the beef. Microwave an additional 2 to 3 minutes.   Pour into colander which has been placed over a large bowl and allow to drain completely.) Combine in the crock-pot the browned beef, chile brick (I use Owens, as in sausage packaged just like the sausage but it is chile.  If not available, any chile brick, usually found in refrigerated case at grocery), water, canned beans and tomato sauce.  Stir well and allow to heat on low for 4 to 6 hours. I use this chile for enchiladas, taco salad, chile with rice or just plain old chile!

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
4  eggs
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. water
2  c. pumpkin
3 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves and nuts
preparation: Combine all ingredients and mix.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until done.

name: TUNA-RICE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. rice, uncooked
10  oz. frozen chopped broccoli
1  egg, beaten
10  oz. condensed cheese soup, undiluted
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2-1/2  oz. (1 jar) sliced mushrooms, drained
1 (6-1/2 oz.)  can tuna, packed in water, drained and flaked
preparation: Cook rice according to package directions, omitting salt; set aside.  Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain well and set aside.  Combine rice and egg; mix well.  Press firmly on bottom and sides of a buttered 10x6x2-inch baking dish; set aside. Combine soup and Worcestershire sauce in a large sauce pan; bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat; stir in broccoli, mushrooms and tuna.  Pour into rice shell.  Cover and bake at 375 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.  Yield:  6 servings.

name: KOOL-AID PUNCH
ingredients:
4  pkg. strawberry Kool-Aid (presweetened, or add 1 1/2 c.  sugar)
1  gal. water
1 large  can orange juice
1 large  can pineapple juice
1  bottle ginger ale
preparation: Good for Christmas or Valentine.  Makes almost 2 gallons, 30 servings.

name: VEGETABLE LASAGNA
ingredients:
8  oz. pkg. lasagna noodles
1  Tbsp. olive oil
3/4  c. chopped onion
2  cloves garlic, chopped
1  jar spaghetti sauce (26 or 30 oz.)
8  oz. Ricotta or cottage cheese
10  oz. pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1/2  c. mushrooms or 1 small can, drained
1  lb. shredded Mozzarella cheese, divided
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1  egg, beaten
chopped parsley
preparation: Prepare lasagna according to package directions; drain. In saucepan, heat oil.  Saute onion,  garlic  and  mushrooms. Stir in spaghetti sauce; simmer 15 minutes.  In  bowl, combine Ricotta, spinach, 1/2 cup Mozzarella, Parmesan  and	egg;  mix well.  In 12 x 12-inch baking dish, layer 1  cup  sauce,  half the  lasagna noodles, half the remaining sauce,	all  of  the spinach  mixture, half of the remaining  Mozzarella	and  the remaining noodles and sauce.  Cover.  Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.  Uncover; top with remaining Mozzarella  and parsley. Bake 15 minutes longer. Let stand 10  minutes before serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: APRICOT CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 small  bottle French dressing
1 small  jar apricot jam
1  envelope French onion soup mix (dry)
4  chicken breasts (boneless)
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients in a casserole dish, then lay the chicken in the sauce.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Enjoy! Good with rice.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1  large tub Cool Whip
1 small  pkg. pistachio pudding
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  medium bag tiny marshmallows
chopped pecans
preparation: Add pineapple, marshmallows and pecans to Cool Whip and pudding.  Mix well	and  refrigerate  at  least  1 hour before serving.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. sugar
1  egg (unbeaten)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients and shape into 1-inch balls.  Bake at 325° for 15 to 18 minutes.  Makes 30 to 40 cookies.

name: TROPICAL AMBROSIA
ingredients:
2 (15 1/4 oz.)  cans pineapple chunks, divided
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. orange-pineapple gelatin
1  pt. orange sherbet
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  c. flaked coconut
1  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Drain pineapple and oranges, reserving liquid.  Add enough water to liquid to make 2 cups.  Bring liquid to a boil in a medium saucepan.  Add gelatin; stir until dissolved.  Remove from heat. Add sherbet, oranges and half the pineapple, stirring until sherbet is melted.  Pour into a 6-cup ring mold and chill until firm. Unmold onto serving platter.  Combine sour cream, coconut, marshmallows and remaining pineapple.  Spoon mixture into center of gelatin ring.  Enjoy!  Yields 10 to 12 servings.

name: QUICHE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bacon, diced
2  c. milk
1/2  c. chopped onion
4  eggs
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  c. Bisquick
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Grease 9-inch pie plate.  Mix milk, Bisquick and eggs. Sprinkle with onion, bacon and cheese.  Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: BLACK BEAN ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
12  tortillas
large can black beans, drained
2  c. grated Jack cheese
large can green chili enchilada sauce
cilantro
garlic salt
preparation: Pour a little enchilada sauce on bottom of 9 x 12-inch casserole dish.  Layer 6 tortillas overlapping (can be softened in a little oil).  Spread out beans.  Sprinkle with cilantro and garlic salt.  Layer with 1 cup cheese.  Put another layer of 6 tortillas.  Pour can of green chili enchilada sauce over casserole. Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Sprinkle with 1 cup of cheese, lightly covered with foil.  Bake until cheese topping is melted.

name: LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. broccoli (if frozen, thaw, chop and drain)
6  boiled eggs, chopped
8  slices bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
1/2  head lettuce, chopped
3/4  c. green onions, chopped
1  pkg. tiny frozen peas, thawed and drained
1  pkg. buttermilk dressing
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. mayonnaise
Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix dressing with milk and mayonnaise.  Spread over top of salad and sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.

name: SOUR CREAM CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. chicken broth
2  pkg. Ritz crackers
1  stick butter or oleo
preparation: Boil chicken breasts until done.  Debone breasts and place in casserole dish.  Mix sour cream, cream of chicken soup and chicken broth.  Pour over chicken.  Crumble Ritz crackers and pour over dish.  Melt oleo and pour over crackers.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: WHITE CLAM SAUCE
ingredients:
2  cans minced clams (one drained and one with liquid)
4 to 6  cloves chopped garlic
1/4  c. olive oil
1/2  c. dry white wine
1  small chicken bouillon cube
chopped parsley
chopped basil
oregano
black pepper
preparation: Saute garlic in olive oil until golden.  Add drained clams and saute for 5 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bring to a boil and then simmer for about 15 minutes or until half the liquid evaporates.  Season to taste.  Serve over linguine.  Top with grated cheese.

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. water
2  c. orange juice
1/2  c. lemon juice
3  c. tea
1/2  bottle ginger ale
mint leaves or peppermint candy
preparation: Mix sugar and water.  Bring to boil.  Cool.  Add remaining ingredients (except ginger ale).  Chill well.  Add ginger ale just before serving.  Add mint or pieces of candy to glass.

name: HAMBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  can tomato soup
1  can French-style green beans
1  small onion
mashed potatoes
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion.  Drain off grease.  Add soup and beans.  Put in a casserole dish.  Top with mashed potatoes, then the cheese.  Cook until cheese is brown in the oven.

name: CROCK-POT TACOS
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. ground meat, browned
1  can evaporated milk
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
2  cans kidney beans
1  can chili
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. lemon pepper
1/2  tsp. coriander
1/2  tsp. cumin
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  envelope taco seasoning mix
tortilla chips
shredded lettuce
diced tomatoes
grated cheese
chopped onions
preparation: Stir together meat and taco seasoning mix in crock-pot.  Add milk, cheese, beans, chili, tomatoes and spices.  Cook on low all day long.

name: MOTHER'S BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. melted margarine
1  c. sugar
2  large eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2/3  c. flour
1/4  c. cocoa
1/8  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine butter and sugar in large bowl; stir in eggs and vanilla.  Combine flour, cocoa and salt; stir into butter mixture. Add nuts; mix well.  Pour into 8 x 8-inch greased and floured pan. Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cool.   Spread Chocolate Frosting over top.

name: DOUBLE LAYER PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  graham pie crust or 12 graham cracker crust tarts
4  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  c. thawed Cool Whip
1  c. milk
2 (4 oz.)   pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. cloves
preparation: Mix in a large bowl with wire whisk the cream cheese, 1 tablespoon milk, sugar and Cool Whip. Spread in crust.  Mix pudding and 1 cup milk together with wire whisk.  Beat for 1 or 2 minutes. Stir in pumpkin.   Add cinnamon, ginger and cloves. Spread mixture over cream cheese layer.  Refrigerate 3 hours. Garnish with whipped cream.

name: FUDGE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2 (4 oz.)  pkg. regular pudding
1/2  c. milk
1  lb. confectioners sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt margarine. Stir in pudding and add 1/2 cup milk.  Heat until it boils (1 minute), stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Beat in sugar, then add vanilla.  Pour batter into a 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch pan. Chill.

name: AUSTIN'S BEST CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. finely ground graham crackers
1/4  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. butter, melted
2  lb. cream cheese, softened
2  c. sugar
2  c. sour cream
2  tsp. vanilla
6  eggs
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°. Combine crust ingredients and mix well. Press firmly into greased and floured 10 x 3-inch spring-form pan. Bake crust 6 to 9 minutes or until edges are brown. Cool. Reduce heat to 350°.

name: RUBY RED STRAWBERRY BURST
ingredients:
8  oz. Ocean Spray ruby red and strawberry juice drink
1/2  banana, cut into slices
3  medium strawberries, cut into halves
1/2  c. crushed ice
preparation: Put all ingredients in a blender.  Blend for a few seconds on high speed or until ingredients are thoroughly combined.  Pour into a large glass.  Garnish with a strawberry sliced halfway and placed on rim of glass.  Makes 1 serving.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
3  eggs, separated
dash of salt
1/2  c. flour
2  c. water
1/2  stick butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix flour, sugar and cocoa together.  Add enough of the water to make a paste.  Beat in egg yolks well.  Heat remaining water with butter and salt until melted.  Add water mixture to first mixture and cook until thick, stirring constantly.  Add vanilla; stir.  Remove and pour into baked pie crust.  Cover with meringue and brown, or serve with whipped cream.  Be sure to cook in a thick pot.  Triple the recipe to make 4 deep dish pies.

name: COWBOY BEANS
ingredients:
1  pound ground beef
2  cups chopped onion
2 (16 ounce)  cans pork and beans
1 (15 1/2 ounce)  can kidney beans, drained
1  cup catsup
2  tablespoons prepared mustard
2  teaspoons vinegar
1  teaspoon salt
preparation: Combine beef and onion in a skillet; sauté until browned.  Combine beef mixture and remaining ingredients, stirring well.  Spoon into a 2-quart casserole.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.  Yield 8 to 10 servings.

name: EASY SWEET CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
8  Hershey bars with almonds
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  precooked or graham pie shell
preparation: Melt candy in double boiler (not in microwave). Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into shell and refrigerate.

name: CHILI RELLENO APPETIZERS
ingredients:
3/4  lb. Monterey Jack cheese, grated (3 c.)
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated (2 c.)
1 (4 oz.)  can green chili peppers, rinsed, seeded and chopped
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Layer cheese and chilies on bottom of a 9-inch  square pan. In a bowl, beat eggs.  Add milk and flour.  Pour over cheese and chilies.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before cutting.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. oil
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. cocoa
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake at 325° to 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: LEMON BARS
ingredients:
1  cup all-purpose flour
1/2  cup butter or margarine, softened
1  cup powdered sugar
2  eggs
1  cup sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. lemon peel
2  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
preparation: Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Mix flour, butter, and powdered sugar.  Press evenly in bottom of ungreased square pan (8x8x2). Bake for 20 minutes.  Beat remaining ingredients about 3 minutes on medium speed or until light and fluffy.  Pour over hot crust. Bake about 25 minutes longer or just until no imprint remains when touched lightly in the center.  Cool.  Cut into 2 inch squares.

name: HOT CHIPPED BEEF DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
5  Tbsp. milk
3  Tbsp. finely chopped green pepper
3  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
2  (4 oz.) chipped beef, chopped fine
preparation: Blend cream cheese, sour cream and milk together well. Add chopped green pepper, onion and chipped beef. Blend all ingredients with mixer.  Pour mixture into ovenproof bowl.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes until hot and bubbly.  Serve hot with cut vegetables or crackers to dip.

name: MARINATED SHRIMP
ingredients:
2  c. vinegar
1/4  c. whole allspice
1/2  c. oil
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. powdered mustard
1  tsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. black pepper
enough water to make paste
5  lb. shrimp, cleaned and deveined
3  to 4 bay leaves
2  to 3 bell peppers, sliced thin
3  to 4 onions, sliced thin
preparation: Cook shrimp and layer the shrimp, onions and peppers until gone.  Add bay leaves.  Pour vinegar mixture over layers and refrigerate.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: SAUSAGE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising meal
2 eggs 1  c. milk
1 lg.  can whole kernel corn
1  lg. onion chopped
2  jalapeno peppers, chopped
1  lb. hot sausage, browned & crumbled
1  clove garlic, crushed
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Mix cornmeal, eggs, and milk; add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Pour into muffin pan.  Bake 25 minutes or until brown.  Makes 24.

name: RASPBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  boxes raspberry Jell-O
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple, crushed
1/2  c. sugar
1 large  carton (24 oz.) small curd cottage cheese
1 (12 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Combine Jell-O, pineapple and sugar.  Bring to a boil; cool. Add cottage cheese and Cool Whip.  Chill overnight in mold. Serves 24.

name: APRICOT NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. salad oil
1/2  c. milk
1  egg
3 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. orange peel, grated
3/4  c. orange juice
1  c. nuts, finely chopped
1  c. dried apricots, cut up
preparation: Measure all ingredients into large mixing bowl.  Beat on medium speed for 1/2 minute.  Pour into greased and lightly floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 55 to 65 minutes. Cool thoroughly before slicing.

name: PUMPKIN PATCH PIE(Frozen)
ingredients:
1  pt. orange sherbet (2 c.)
1  Tbsp. (8 oz.) Cool Whip, thawed
1  Oreo pie crust
9  Oreo cookies, cut in fourths
preparation: Mix sherbet in bowl until smooth.  Stir in 1/2 Cool Whip until blended.  Put into crust.  Sprinkle cookies over top.   Press into bottom layer.  Cover with remaining Cool Whip.  Freeze 4 hours. When ready to serve, let stand 10 minutes.

name: SWEET AND SOUR VEGETABLES
ingredients:
2  carrots
1  cauliflower
6  small cucumbers
2  Tbsp. salt
2  c. vinegar
1 1/2  c. sugar
fresh mushrooms (if desired)
preparation: Cut vegetables into bite size pieces. Wash and drain. Salt with 2 tablespoons salt and stir gently. Place in large glass container and refrigerate for 24 hours. Take out and drain.

name: ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. mandarin oranges, drained
1  small container Cool Whip
1  pkg. orange jello
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Pour jello over cream cheese. Pour 1 cup boiling water over cheese and jello. Let cool. Add oranges and pineapple. Add Cool Whip.

name: BACON CASSEROLE
ingredients:
10  slices buttered white bread, cubed
1  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1  qt. milk
6  eggs
2  tsp. dry mustard
2  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. bacon, fried crisp and crumbled*
preparation: Put bread into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Toss and cover in cheese.  Mix milk, eggs, mustard and salt, then pour over cheese.  Top with bacon and refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350° until brown.  Serves 8.

name: COLLACI(Serves 8)
ingredients:
1  lb. zucchini, thinly sliced
6  strips bacon, diced
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  medium onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1 medium  can Italian-style tomatoes, peeled
1 1/2  c. (12 oz.) corn Niblets
1  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1/2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. oregano
1/4  c. chopped parsley
preparation: In  a  large  skillet,	fry  bacon  until just browned; remove with a slotted spoon and drain on a paper towel.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Wesson oil
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
3  c. shredded carrots
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. black walnut flavoring
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. black walnuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: CHICKEN GUMBO
ingredients:
1  broiler fryer
1/4  lb. ham or smoked sausage
2  Tbsp. butter
1  lb. tomatoes (canned or frozen)
1 1/2  qt. water
1  lb. okra, sliced (optional)
1  c. sliced onions
3/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. minced parsley
1  Tbsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  small bay leaf
1  Tbsp. gumbo file (optional)
4  c. hot cooked rice
preparation: Boil chicken.  Debone.  Dice ham or thinly sliced sausage. Cook sausage or ham in melted butter until light brown.  Add tomatoes, water, okra, onions, green pepper, parsley, salt, pepper and bay leaf.  Bring to boil; reduce heat.  Cover and simmer 30 to 40 minutes.  Return chicken to soup.   Discard bay leaf.  Just before serving, sprinkle gumbo file powder lightly over soup, stirring constantly.  Heap hot rice in individual soup bowl. Ladle gumbo over rice.  Makes about 3 quarts.

name: CHICKEN AND WINE(Makes 4 to 6 Servings)
ingredients:
4  to 6 chicken breasts
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (3 oz.)  can mushrooms
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. white wine
preparation: Place chicken skin side up in baking dish 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch. Combine remaining ingredients.  Pour over chicken.  Sprinkle generously with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

name: SWISS TUNA-RICE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. hot cooked rice
1 1/2  Tbsp. butter/margarine
1  egg, slightly beaten
3  Tbsp. chopped stuffed olives
3/4  c. scalded milk
2  eggs, slightly beaten
4  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1 (7 oz.)  can tuna
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
preparation: Combine rice and butter.  Stir in 1 egg and chopped olives. Spread evenly over bottom and sides of greased 9-inch pie pan to make a shell.  Gradually stir scalded milk into 2 slightly beaten eggs.  Add onion, salt, pepper and tuna.  Pour into rice-lined pie pan and sprinkle cheese over the top.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.  Reduce heat to 300° and bake additional 15 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

name: HOT FUDGE CAKE WITH ICING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1/2  c. butter
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. water
1  egg
3/4  tsp. soda
1/3  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift sugar and flour together.  Bring butter, cocoa and water to a boil.  Remove from heat and add sugar and flour mixture.  Mix on slow speed until well blended.  Add egg, soda, buttermilk and vanilla.  Bake at 350° for 25 or 30 minutes in a baking pan.

name: EASY HOMEMADE PICKLES
ingredients:
2  lb. cucumbers (about 10)
2  c. cold water
2  c. white vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
2  cloves garlic, chopped
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. fresh dill
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Cover and let stand one hour at room temperature.  Place cut cucumber into jars.  Cover with liquid and let stand one week in refrigerator before using.  Will keep in refrigerator for three months.

name: IMITATION CRAB SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. imitation fully-cooked crab, chopped
3  c. shredded cabbage
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cole slaw dressing
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix together chopped crab and cabbage slaw; add salt. Mix in coleslaw dressing and mayonnaise.

name: SAVORY CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
5  lb. cooked chicken (boneless), pulled in pieces
1  c. pimento, diced
1 (#10)  can Veg-All mixed vegetables
1  c. chicken fat or margarine
1  c. flour
1  qt. milk
1  qt. chicken stock
2  tsp. sage
1  Tbsp. salt
2  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. marjoram
2  doz. drop biscuit dough
preparation: Fold chicken, pimento and Veg-All together.  Mix fat and flour together.  Cook until smooth and golden.  Add milk and stock, whipping until smooth and thick.  Add seasoning and fold into chicken vegetable mixture.

name: SWEET 'N SOUR CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  to 10 assorted chicken pieces without skin
8  oz. Russian dressing
8  oz. apricot preserves
1  envelope onion soup mix
1/4  c. water
1 small  can pineapple rings, drained
1  to 2 green peppers, sliced in rings
preparation: Dissolve onion soup mix in 1/4 cup hot water.  Add to mixture of Russian dressing and apricot preserves; set aside.  Arrange chicken pieces in pan and pour the sauce on top.  Bake, covered, for 1 hour at 350°.  Add garnish of pineapple and green pepper. Bake, uncovered, for 1/2 hour more.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: RAW VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1 large  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. chopped fresh parsley
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
raw vegetables
preparation: Blend all ingredients, except vegetables.  Refrigerate.

name: NACHO POTATO SLICES
ingredients:
2  medium potatoes
2  Tbsp. thinly sliced green onion
2  Tbsp. finely chopped green pepper
1/4  c. bottled taco, barbecue or spaghetti sauce
1/3  c. shredded American cheese
preparation: Scrub potaotes  and  trim  ends.  Cut the potatoes into 3/8-inch thick slices.  In  an  8  x 8 x 2-inch microwave safe baking dish  arrange the potato slices, putting smaller slices in the  center.  Sprinkle  with  green onion and green pepper. Cover with vented clear plastic wrap.  Microcook on 100% power (High) 7 to 10 minutes or until tender, giving the dish a half turn once. Drizzle  with  taco  sauce,  barbecue or spaghetti sauce; sprinkle  with  cheese.  Cook,  uncovered,  30  to  60 seconds more or until cheese is melted.

name: FROZEN CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. cocoa
1/3  c. milk
1 (8 oz.)  carton whipped topping
1  (9-inch) pastry shell, baked
preparation: In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth.  Add cocoa alternately with milk.  Mix well.  Fold in whipped topping.  Pour into shell.  Freeze for 8 hours or overnight.  Serve directly from the freezer.  (Pie does not need to be thawed to cut.)

name: RHUBARB CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1  c. sour milk
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
4  c. raw rhubarb
preparation: Mix together; pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli spears
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  can cream of mushroom soup
4  oz. Cheddar cheese, grated or shredded
1 (3 oz.)  can onion rings
preparation: Grease 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Cook broccoli; drain.  Add butter.  Place in dish; spread cheese over broccoli and add soup. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until bubbly.  Add onion rings and bake until browned.  Serves 6.

name: SPINACH AND MUSHROOM QUICHE
ingredients:
2  (9-inch) deep dish pie crusts
1  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
2 to 3  Tbsp. unsalted butter
12  oz. fresh mushrooms, sliced thin
1 (15 oz.)  carton Ricotta cheese
5  extra large eggs
1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. light cream
12  oz. shredded Swiss cheese
preparation: Prick crust with fork and bake at 400° for about 15 minutes or until golden.  Remove and cool.  Cook spinach according to directions and drain.  Press out water.  Set aside.  In large skillet, melt butter; add mushrooms and saute over low heat until soft (6 minutes).  In large mixing bowl, beat Ricotta cheese and eggs together until mixture is smooth.  Add flour, Worcestershire, salt and pepper; beat until well mixed.  Add cream and beat until smooth.  Fold in reserved spinach, mushrooms and Swiss cheese until well mixed.  Turn into crusts and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until set.  Let stand 15 minutes.

name: MICROWAVE PARTY MIX
ingredients:
2  c. Corn Chex cereal
2  c. Rice Chex cereal
2  c. Wheat Chex cereal (optional)
1  c. peanuts
2  c. small pretzels
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. salt
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Melt margarine and add seasonings.  In a large Ziploc plastic bag place cereals, nuts and pretzels.  Pour margarine mixture over cereal.  Zip up and shake until cereal is coated.  Pour into a long glass dish to fit your microwave and cook on High for about 6 minutes. Stir every 2 minutes.  Spread on paper towel.  When cool, store in covered container.

name: CHERRY PIE
ingredients:
3  c. fresh or frozen cherries
1  c. sugar
2 heaping  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Mix together and pour into unbaked pastry.  Add top crust. Bake in 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: ZERO DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. tomato juice
1/2  c. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. dried parsley
1  clove garlic, minced
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. chopped bell pepper (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a tightly covered container.  Shake to blend. Store in refrigerator.

name: SEASIDE SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Imitation crab
2  c. macaroni
4  c. water
1  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. oil
1  c. diced celery
1  c. frozen peas
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1/2 to 2/3  c. Italian salad dressing
preparation: Boil water, salt  and  oil; add macaroni and cook until tender (8 to 10 minutes).	Drain and cool.  Mix with remaining ingredients and  chill.  May  garnish with tomato wedge, hard-boiled egg wedge and/or parsley.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: PINEAPPLE-CHERRY WHIP
ingredients:
1 small  can (tidbit) pineapple, well drained
1  can Thank You cherry pie filling
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
pecans (optional)
marshmallows (optional)
preparation: Best made and chilled several hours before serving.

name: AUNT MAE'S RICE SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. rice, cooked
2  cans (20 oz.) crushed pineapple, drained
1  bag miniature marshmallows
1/3  c. sugar
1 small  jar maraschino cherries
1 large  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Cook the rice and cool.  Mix all ingredients.  Top with cherries.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2 large  bunches of broccoli flowerets, raw
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. raisins
1  lb. bacon, cooked and crumbled
1  c. toasted almonds
preparation: Place raw broccoli flowerets in bowl.  Mix mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar.  Toss all ingredients together.

name: EASY SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick
1  lb. sausage
10  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Crumble the sausage  and  mix with cheese.  Add biscuit mix, one cup at a time.  Form into small balls (about one inch in diameter) and bake  on  an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake in preheated oven at 350° to  375°  until  light  brown (13 to 15 minutes).  Cooking may take  a  few extra minutes if balls are frozen.  Makes 7 dozen.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
1  box Knorr vegetable soup mix
1  box frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained well
1/2  c. dried onions
1 to 2  lb. loaf rye bread (leave whole)
preparation: Mix all the ingredients except bread and refrigerate overnight. Carve out inside of rye bread and cut into serving pieces.  Fill the bread cavity with the spinach mixture when you are ready to serve.  Use the bread cubes to dip into the mix.

name: IRIS'S BAKED OATMEAL SURPRISE
ingredients:
1/2  c. cooking oil
2  beaten eggs
3  c. oatmeal
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1/2  c. honey
1  c. diced apples
1/2  c. raisins
1/3  c. pecans
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Combine oil, eggs and honey. Beat well. Add oatmeal, baking powder, salt and milk. Mix. Then add apples, raisins, pecans and cinnamon. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1/4  c. olive oil or salad oil
2  Tbsp. tarragon or wine vinegar
3/4  tsp. salt
1 small  clove garlic, crushed
1/4  tsp. monosodium glutamate
generous dash of freshly ground pepper
preparation: Toss salad greens (about 12 cups) with oil just until leaves glisten.  Combine vinegar, salt, garlic, monosodium glutamate and pepper; toss with garlic mixture.  Makes about 1/3 cup.

name: CHERRY SHERRY SAUCE FOR HAM
ingredients:
1 (6 to 7)  lb. boneless, fully cooked ham
1  can (about 1 lb.) black sweet cherries with or without pits
2  medium oranges (2/3 c. juice)
1  lemon (3 Tbsp.)
1  tsp. ginger
1  c. packed brown sugar
1  c. dry sherry
2 1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
