preparation: Drain juice from cherries into saucepan.  Add juice from oranges and lemon, then add ginger, brown sugar and sherry. Place on low heat and stir occasionally to make sure sugar is dissolved.   As ham bakes, spoon a couple of tablespoons of sauce over it at various intervals.

name: CRACKER PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/2  qt. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  square saltine crackers (1/4 lb.), crushed
1 small  box instant pudding
1 1/2  c. milk
Cool Whip
coconut
preparation: Put first  5 ingredients all together and cook until thick. Put in dish and cool. Mix instant pudding with milk. Spread on top of first layer, then spread this layer with Cool Whip. Spread coconut on top of Cool Whip.

name: EVERYDAY BROCCOLI CHEESE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. margarine
4  skinless boneless chicken breast halves
1  can Campbell's broccoli cheese soup
1/3  c. water or milk
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  c. broccoli flowerets
preparation: In a skillet over medium heat in hot margarine, cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on both sides.  Stir in soup, water and pepper.  Heat to boiling.  Add broccoli.  Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 10 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender and broccoli is done, stirring occasionally.  Serves 4.

name: PARMESAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. Italian bread crumbs
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
salt and pepper
1/2  stick melted butter
1/2  clove garlic, minced
5  chicken breasts, skinned and deboned
preparation: Mix together crumbs, cheese, salt and pepper.  Mix together butter and garlic.  Dip chicken in butter, then roll in crumb mixture.  Roll up and place in lightly greased pan.  Bake uncovered for 1 1/4 hours at 350°.

name: BOM BOMS
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1 (18 oz.)  jar peanut butter
1  box powdered sugar
1  bag chocolate chips
paraffin
preparation: Melt and mix margarine and peanut butter together (well).  Add powdered sugar and roll up into balls.  Cool for 30 minutes.  Melt chocolate chips and 1/2 stick paraffin and dip balls using a toothpick.  Better when chilled.

name: WILD GRAPE JELLY(Makes 4 to 5 Pints)
ingredients:
fruit (ground or vine variety)
water
4  c. juice
7  c. sugar
1/4 to 1/3  c. lemon juice
1  pouch Certo fruit pectin
1  pad margarine or butter
preparation: Boil fruit (ground or vine variety) in large saucepan, adding water to just cover fruit.  After squeezing and straining juice, measure 4 cups juice, sugar, lemon juice, Certo and margarine or butter.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
3  tsp. baking powder
2  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs
1/4  c. orange juice
2 1/2  tsp. vanilla
5  medium apples, peeled, cored and sliced
2/3  c. cinnamon
preparation: Sift together flour and baking powder.  In mixing bowl, combine 2 cups sugar, vegetable oil and eggs.  Beat well.  Beat in juice and vanilla while alternately beating in flour mixture. Combine well.

name: BLUEBERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  c. self-rising flour
3/4  c. stick butter
preparation: Melt butter in baking dish and put blueberries on top of melted butter. Mix sugar, milk and flour. Pour on blueberries. Bake at 350° until done.

name: SUMMER SQUASH SOUP
ingredients:
2  medium yellow squash*
2  small zucchini*
1 1/2  c. sliced celery and leaves
3  Tbsp. butter
6  c. chicken stock
salt or celery salt to taste
pepper to taste
1  tsp. curry powder
2  Tbsp. finely chopped parsley
preparation: * Or 4 of either, if one is not available.

name: SWEET AND SOUR PORK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. pork tenderloin, or pork roast
2-3 green peppers
5  slices pineapple
1/2  tsp. salt (to marinate pork)
2-3 Tbsp. Soy Sauce (to marinate pork)
1  Tbsp. cornstarch (to marinate pork)
1  egg, beaten (to marinate pork)
1  Tbsp. water (to marinate pork)
1  tsp. sesame oil (marinate)
preparation: Pound pork with the back of a cleaver (this is to tenderize the pork).  Then cut into one inch squares.  Marinate with above items for at least 20 minutes or more.

name: REFRIGERATOR ROLL DOUGH
ingredients:
1 1/2  pkg. dry yeast
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. Crisco
6  c. flour
2  c. lukewarm water
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: In a measuring cup, dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup water.  Set aside.  Cream Crisco in large bowl.  Alternately add flour with 2 cups lukewarm water and salt.  When half the ingredients have been mixed, mix in yeast mix.  When all ingredients have been added, cover and refrigerated.  Make and let rise at least 2 hours before baking.

name: SUNDAE CHOCOLATE CUPS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. (1 c.) semi-sweet morsels
1  Tbsp. shortening
9  foil cupcake liners
ice cream, softened
chocolate syrup
fresh fruit
preparation: Combine over hot (not boiling) water the chocolate morsels and shortening.  Stir until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth. Coat inside of each cupcake liner with chocolate mixture.  Place cupcake liner in hand.  Rotate gently, using rubber spatula to rush chocolate up sides.  Place in muffin pans.  Chill until firm.  When firm, peel off foil and return shells to muffin pan.  Chill until ready to serve.  Remove shells to serving plate.  Fill with scoop of ice cream.  Drizzle with chocolate syrup.  Garnish with fruit.

name: GREMOLATA BRUSCHETTA
ingredients:
8  oz. loaf Italian bread
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. freshly grated lemon peel
1 large  clove crushed garlic
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Cut 12 (1/2-inch) slices from bread; set aside.  In bowl, combine remaining ingredients.  Spread mixture over bread slices.  Arrange in single layer on cookie sheet.  Bake for about 15 minutes, until bread is golden brown.  Makes 12.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. grated zucchini
1/2  c. oil or melted butter
1/2  c. honey or brown sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. whole-wheat flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
1/2  tsp. nutmeg (optional)
preparation: Beat together oil and honey.  Add eggs, vanilla and zucchini; mix well.  Sift dry ingredients and add to liquid mixture; stir in nuts.  Bake in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes or until tests done.  Cool in pan 10 minutes.  Invert onto wire rack and cool.

name: CRANBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. boiling water
1 (1 pt.)  bottle cranberry juice cocktail (2 c.)
1  c. orange juice
1/4  c. lemon juice (fresh, frozen or canned)
2 small  bottles (about 2 c.) ginger ale, chilled
preparation: Add sugar to water, stirring to dissolve.  Add fruit juices; chill.  Just before serving, add ginger ale.  Makes 6 to 8 servings or 1 1/2 quarts.

name: 3 BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
5  qt. yellow wax beans
5  qt. green string beans
1  qt. small onions
2  qt. red kidney beans
12  large carrots
2  heads cauliflower
1 large  bunch celery
10  c. vinegar
5  c. sugar
10  c. water
1 1/2  Tbsp. pickle spices
5  sticks cinnamon
2  c. celery and onion water
preparation: Cut vegetables in 1-inch pieces and cook each separately until tender.  Drain all vegetables and discard all water except celery and onion water (save 2 cups).  Make a syrup with vinegar, sugar, water, spices, cinnamon and left over celery, onion water.  Boil until sugar is dissolved.  Pack mixed vegetables in sterile jars and pour syrup over to 1/2 inch of top of jar.  Cold pack 10 minutes for pint jars.

name: REAL CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1  chicken (2 1/2 to 3 lb.), boiled
1  tsp. pepper
3  tsp. salt, divided
4  to 5 medium potatoes, pared
5  stalks celery
1/2  lb. carrots
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1 (17 oz.)  can English peas, drained (I use frozen)
pie crust (dairy case red box)
2/3  c. flour
1  c. milk
1  chicken flavored bouillon cube
preparation: Boil chicken with  1/2  teaspoon  salt  and  1 teaspoon pepper until done.  Save  broth.  Debone  chicken.  Cut  potatoes, carrots and celery  in  broth to cook.  Keep broth; take out vegetables.  Keep  3  cups  broth.  Combine  chicken  and vegetables in bowl, including peas.

name: CREAM PUFFS
ingredients:
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. margarine or butter
1/2  c. flour
2  eggs
Cream Filling
powdered sugar
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Heat water and margarine to rolling boil in saucepan.  Add flour.  Stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball, about 1 minute; remove from heat.  Beat in eggs, all at once; continue beating until smooth.  Drop by 1/4 cupfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes. Cool; cut off tops and fill with cream filling.  Replace tops; dust with powdered sugar.

name: OREO DELIGHT
ingredients:
15  oz. Oreo cookies
3/4  stick margarine
1  c. powdered sugar
1  large Cool Whip
1  (6 oz.) instant chocolate pudding
2 1/4  c. milk
preparation: Crush cookies; add margarine.  Place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan (for crust).  Combine cream cheese and powdered sugar.  Mix well.  Fold in 1/2 of Cool Whip.  Spread over crust.  Chill 20 minutes.  Prepare pudding with 2 1/4 cups milk.  Spread over mixture.  Chill.  Spread remaining Cool Whip over filling.  Top with cookie crumbs.  Let chill 8 hours or overnight.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2 heaping  Tbsp. flour
2 heaping  Tbsp. cocoa
3  egg yolks, beaten
1 1/3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients together. Add beaten egg yolks, then add milk gradually. Place over medium heat; stir constantly until mixture thickens. Remove from heat, then add vanilla. Stir well. Place into baked pie shell.

name: QUICK DIABETIC PICKLED BEETS
ingredients:
1  can beet slices, chunks, julienned
3  packets sweetener
Salt and Pepper to taste
vinegar
preparation: Drain off one-half of beet liquid. Sprinkle sweetener, salt and pepper over beets. Add vinegar to cover. Cover and refrigerate.

name: TUNA HOT DISH
ingredients:
1  pkg. baking powder biscuits
2 small  cans tuna or 1 tuna and 1 chicken
1  c. milk
1  can mushroom soup
1 1/2  Tbsp. onion
1/2  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Butter large casserole or deep baking dish.  Line bottom with biscuits.  Mix rest of ingredients together and pour over biscuits.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes in 350° oven, until brown.

name: DIRT PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
3  c. milk
2 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
16  oz. Cool Whip
1  pkg. Oreo cookies
preparation: Cream the butter, cream cheese and powdered sugar; set aside. Mix milk and pudding.  Add creamed mixture to pudding.  Stir in a large tub of Cool Whip.  Crush 1/2 package of Oreos and sprinkle on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish.  Pour pudding over Oreos.  Crush the other 1/2 package of Oreos and sprinkle on top.  Refrigerate.

name: CREAM CHEESE CHERRY PIE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  boxes cream cheese, softened
3/4  c. sugar
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. almond extract
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Once cream cheese is softened, mix all ingredients together in large mixer bowl.  Grease a 9-inch glass pie plate with butter.  Pour batter into pie plate.  Bake for 50 minutes.  When cool, add about 3/4 of cherry pie filling to top of pie.

name: SHRIMP SCAMPI FOR TWO
ingredients:
12  jumbo shrimp, shelled, deveined and tails intact
1  c. olive oil
3  Tbsp. Marsala or dry white wine
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1  tsp. salt
several grindings of fresh pepper
preparation: Soak fish in buttermilk overnight or for 4 to 6 hours.  Wash well, removing buttermilk.  Drain on paper towels.  Squeeze lemon juice over fish.  Roll in mixture of cracker meal, flour and small amount of cornmeal if desired.  Fry in heavy skillet (cast-iron) in enough Crisco plus 1 tablespoon butter to cover bottom of pan well.

name: CABBAGE SALAD
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. sesame seed
1  c. slivered almonds
2  pkg. Ramen noodles, broken fine
1  head cabbage, shredded
4  green onions, chopped
4  Tbsp. sugar
4  Tbsp. wine vinegar
2  tsp. salt
1  pkg. chicken seasoning (from Ramen noodles)
1  c. oil
preparation: Toast sesame seed and almonds in a small amount of oil.  In a large bowl, add noodles, cabbage and green onions.  Add sesame seed and almonds.  In a jar, shake together the remaining ingredients.  Add to salad and toss.

name: MAMA'S CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1  can corn, drained
3  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
dash of salt
3 or 4  tsp. milk
4  pats butter
preparation: Drain corn; place in a bowl.  In another bowl, place eggs; beat well.  Add milk and sugar.  Mix well.  Add corn.  Add salt. Place 4 pats of butter on top of corn.  Bake at 350° about 1 hour or until brown.

name: BEEF BRISKET
ingredients:
1  brisket (3 to 4 lb.)
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1/2  c. Wish-Bone Italian dressing
4  oz. can mushrooms (with juice)
1  can beef gravy (10 1/4 oz.)
preparation: Mix last 5 ingredients together.  Wrap brisket in foil after pouring on ingredients.  Bake 1 hour per pound at 300°.  Cool and slice cold across the grain.  Heat gravy and pour over sliced meat.  Heat in oven about 30 minutes, until hot.

name: PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. white flour
1/2  c. salt
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
desired food coloring
1  tsp. alum (available at the drugstore)
less than 1/2 c. water
preparation: Add your food coloring to the water.  Mix all other ingredients in a bowl and add colored water, a little at a time, until it feels like dough.  It may be a little oily, so play with it on a sheet of newspaper.  Store in a plastic bag or airtight container and store in the fridge.

name: EASY BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. stew meat (1-inch cubes)
3  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  lb. fresh, sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. water
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. A.1. steak sauce
preparation: In skillet, brown beef in 2 tablespoons of margarine. Transfer meat to plate.  In same skillet, add remaining margarine to cook mushrooms and onion until tender.  Return meat to skillet. Add water to steak sauce.  Heat to a boil.  Reduce heat to low; simmer 50 to 60 minutes until meat is tender.  Stir in sour cream. Serve over noodles.  Makes 4 servings.

name: RAINBOW PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. Rainbow rotini pasta
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Italian dressing
1 (3.8 oz.)  can ripe sliced olives
1/2  c. diced Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. diced salami
1/2  c. diced ham
1  small red bell pepper
1/2  c. diced red onion
preparation: Cook pasta according to  package  directions; drain and cool by running cold water  over  pasta.  Add Italian dressing and toss pasta.  Add remaining  ingredients	and  toss  evenly through salad.  Chill in refrigerator for 1 hour.

name: DAZZLING STRAWBERRY 'N AVOCADO SALAD(Mother's Recipe)
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. milk
3/4  tsp. ginger
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen limeade, thawed
2  c. avocados, cut bite size
2  c. strawberry halves
romaine or other lettuce
preparation: In small bowl, with electric mixer at medium speed, beat cheese, milk, ginger and 3 tablespoons limeade concentrate until smooth.  Set aside.  In large bowl, toss avocado and strawberries with remaining limeade.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large head cabbage, shredded
1  onion, chopped
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
8  oz. processed American cheese, cubed
salt and pepper to taste
1/4  c. dry bread crumbs
preparation: Cook cabbage in boiling, salted water, until tender.  Drain thoroughly.  In a large skillet, saute onion in 5 tablespoons butter until tender.  Add soup and mix well.  Add cheese.  Heat and stir until melted.  Remove from heat.  Stir in cabbage, salt and pepper.  Transfer to an ungreased 2-quart baking dish.

name: CORNFLAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add rest of ingredients.  Drop by teaspoonfuls into crushed cornflakes.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE AND RICE CASSEROLE FOR MICROWAVE
ingredients:
1  lb. mild sausage
1  green pepper, chopped
4  oz. pimento, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  onion, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1  c. Minute rice
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Brown sausage on full power for 4 minutes; drain well. Combine all ingredients; mix well.  Microwave on full power or High for 14 minutes.  Do not cover.

name: PICCADILLY DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef or turkey
1 (2 lb.)  box Velveeta cheese
1  onion, chopped
2  cans Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1 or 2 (2 1/4 oz.)  cans black olives
1 (8 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
preparation: Brown meat and onion together.  Mix all ingredients and heat in microwave until cheese is completely melted or prepare in crock-pot on high for 1 1/2 hours before serving.  Stir occasionally.  Keep hot in crock-pot or chafing dish.  Serve with corn chips.

name: RANCH STYLE BEANS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  can kidney beans
1  can pork and beans
1  can pinto beans
1  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  c. ketchup
preparation: Brown onions and hamburger and drain fat off.  Mix rest of ingredients together in crock-pot.  Add hamburger and stir. Simmer on low 2 hours.

name: HAMBURGER NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3/4  lb. ground chuck
2  Tbsp. butter or bacon fat, melted
1  c. tomatoes
1  c. water
1 (No. 2)  can peas, with liquid
1  medium onion, diced
1  tsp. salt
1  (8 oz.) bag noodles
preparation: Brown  meat  in  butter; add onion, water, tomatoes and salt. Cover;  simmer  for  30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add  peas and  noodles;  cook for 10 minutes, stirring often. More seasoning may be added if desired.

name: CHICKEN ROTEL
ingredients:
4  boneless skinless chicken breasts
1  small velveeta cheese
1  can of Rotel
1  pkg rotini noodles
preparation: Boil the chicken for one hour.	Cool.  Melt cheese, Boil noodles until tender.  Tear chicken into pieces.  Mix cheese, noodles, rotel and chicken together.  Put into casserole dish and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1  c. pumpkin, mashed
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chocolate bits
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Beat in egg, pumpkin and vanilla. Mix rest of dry ingredients together.  Add to pumpkin mixture. Add bits and nuts.  Drop by teaspoon on greased sheet.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE CAKE WITH COCONUT PECAN FROSTING
ingredients:
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. Baker's German's sweet chocolate
1/2  c. boiling water
2  c. sugar
4  egg yolks
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
4  egg whites, stiffly beaten
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Melt chocolate in boiling water. Cool.  Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.  Add yolks one at a time; beat after each.  Blend in vanilla and chocolate.  Sift flour with soda and salt; add alternately with buttermilk to chocolate mixture.  Beat after each addition until smooth.  Fold in egg whites.  Pour in three 9-inch cake pans lined on bottom with paper.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes; cool.  Frost tops only with Coconut-Pecan Frosting.

name: CAMPFIRE POTATOES
ingredients:
5  potatoes
1  onion
6  Tbsp. butter
1/3  c. shredded cheese
2  Tbsp. minced fresh parsley
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1/3  chicken broth
preparation: Slice potatoes and onions on large piece of foil. Dot with butter. Combine cheese, parsley, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Sprinkle over potatoes; fold foil and seal. Grill 30 to 40 minutes.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  Tbsp. basil
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. parsley
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
24  oz. cottage cheese
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. parsley
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
3  oz. lasagna noodles
1  lb. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown meat.  Add next 5 ingredients.  Simmer, uncovered, 30 minutes.  Cook noodles as directed and drain.  Combine cottage cheese with next 4 ingredients.  Layer in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan 1/2 noodles, 1/2 cottage cheese mixture, 1/2 Mozzarella cheese and 1/2 meat sauce.  Repeat.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.  Let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

name: SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. celery seed
1/4  c. vinegar
1  small onion, grated
1/2  c. salad oil
preparation: Combine all ingredients and mix well.

name: BAKED TOMATOES
ingredients:
6  firm medium-sized tomatoes
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
2 1/2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh basil or 1 tsp. dried
1  clove garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. olive oil
preparation: Oil large shallow baking dish. Cut tomatoes horizontally and place cut side up in the dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Combine parsley, basil and garlic and sprinkle over the tomatoes. Drizzle 1/4 teaspoon of oil on each tomato half. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve warm or room temperature. Makes 6 servings, 1 tomato each.

name: CHICKEN ARTICHOKE
ingredients:
4  boneless breasts of chicken
2  c. flour
2  c. oil
1  Tbsp. crushed garlic
1/2  c. white cooking wine
1/2  c. sour cream
1 (16 oz.)  can whole peeled tomatoes
1 (14 oz.)  can artichoke hearts
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
mushrooms (optional)
broccoli (optional)
lemon (optional)
preparation: Wet breasts of chicken, then dip in flour.  Fry chicken in oil and garlic.  Add cooking wine last five minutes of frying.  Mix juice from frying pan with sour cream.  Put chicken, mushrooms, broccoli and artichoke hearts (cut in half and add all juice from can) in casserole dish.  Squeeze lemon on top if desired.  Break whole tomatoes and put on top (do not add juice).  Pour sour cream mixture over chicken.  Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on last five minutes.  Bake 35 minutes.

name: OLD-FASHIONED BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
2  egg yolks
1  handful of flour
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Mix flour and sugar together.  Add milk and egg yolks and extract.  Stir well and cook on medium heat until thick.  Layer graham crackers or vanilla wafers, then pudding, sliced bananas; (makes about 3 layers).  Beat egg whites until stiff and put on pudding.  Bake in oven until the meringue is brown.

name: ITALIAN STUFFED BREAD
ingredients:
1  loaf Italian bread
1  lb. sweet Italian sausage
1  box chopped frozen spinach
1  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown sausage in pan.  Pour off grease.  Cook spinach until dry.  Mix sausage, spinach and cheese together.  Cut bread lengthwise.  Scrape out middle, leaving crust.  Put ingredients in bread crust.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.  (Wrap in foil before baking.)  Let bread stand in foil 15 minutes before slicing.

name: CHRISTMAS SALAD
ingredients:
1  qt. fresh cranberries
2  oranges
1/2  c. water
2  c. sugar
3  envelopes unflavored gelatin
1  c. chopped pecans
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Grind cranberries and oranges.  Simmer fruit with water and sugar until sugar is dissolved.  Add gelatin and stir until dissolved.  Add rest of ingredients and mix well.  Pour into a mold on 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate to congeal.  Yields 20 servings.

name: DILLED CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  tsp. dried dill
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. curry powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Place chicken in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.  Mix soup, sour cream, mayonnaise and seasonings.  Pour over chicken, covering well.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  Cover with foil the last 30 minutes if it begins to brown too much.

name: CAJUN LIMA BEANS
ingredients:
6  strips bacon
4  Tbsp. flour
2  onions, minced
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen lima beans
water (to cover)
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. m.s.g.
salt and pepper
preparation: Fry bacon crisp.  Remove, crumble and reserve.  Add flour to drippings.  Blend well.  Add onions.  Cook and stir until onions are limp.  Add beans and cook until done.  Add seasonings with enough water to cover.  Mix well and cook 10 minutes.  Serve with bacon garnish.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: NINA OWEN'S LEMON CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. cornmeal
3  eggs
grated rind of 1 lemon
juice of 1 1/2 lemons
unbaked pie shell
preparation: Cream butter; add sugar gradually.  Add meal and eggs, one at a time, beating after each.  Add lemon juice and rind.  Pour into shell.  Bake at 325° for 35 minutes (until knife comes out clean).

name: POTATO DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
3  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. soft shortening
2 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. mace
1  c. mashed potatoes (unseasoned; without milk)
preparation: Beat eggs, sugar, shortening and potatoes.  Blend all dry ingredients and beat in until smooth.  Turn to lightly cover with flour on a flour covered cloth.  Roll gently 1/3-inch thick.  Cut into circles with doughnut cutter after chilling for 2 to 3 hours.

name: JALAPENO PICKLES
ingredients:
1  gallon hamburger dill sliced pickles
4  lbs. sugar
1  12-oz  jar Trappey's sliced jalapeno peppers
preparation: Drain juice from pickles.  Remove half the jar of pickles and save.  Pour sugar into jar with pickles.  Pour jar of peppers with juice on pickles and sugar.  Put remainder of pickles back into jar.  Seal extremely tight.  Invert jar - Place pan under jar just in case it isn't sealed good.  Turn jar upside down every day for 11 days.  Then chill.

name: CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can pineapple, drained
1/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  c. grated cheese
1  pkg. Dream Whip
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Fix Dream Whip by directions.  Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Combine pineapple and sugar; add to jello.  Chill until thickened.  Fold in cheese.

name: OREO DESSERT
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  stick margarine
1  c. powdered sugar
12  oz. Cool Whip
2  boxes large instant vanilla pudding
3  c. milk
1  pkg. Oreos, crushed
preparation: Combine cream cheese, margarine and sugar together.  Add Cool Whip.  In another bowl whip pudding with milk until thick and fold into cream cheese mixture.  Spread bottom of pan evenly with Oreos and spread batter over crumbs.  Top with another layer of crumbs. Let set overnight.

name: FORGOTTEN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  egg whites
2/3  c. sugar
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. mini chocolate chips
preparation: Beat egg whites until foamy; gradually add sugar. Beat until stiff. Add salt and vanilla. Mix well; add pecans and chocolate bits and drop by teaspoonful on ungreased foiled cookie sheets (2). Heat oven to 350°. Put in and turn off immediately and take out in morning. Makes 4 dozen.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise or Miracle Whip
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  large broccoli head, trimmed and washed
1  medium onion (red), chopped
1/2  c. macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped
5  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled (optional)
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients.  Add to the rest of the ingredients and refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight.

name: FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. applesauce
1 3/4  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
2  c. dates
2  c. nuts
1  c. candied fruit
1  tsp. vanilla (if desired)
preparation: Cream together sugar and margarine.  Dissolve soda into a little warm water and then into applesauce, letting it foam over the other ingredients.  Beat and add flour, fruit and nuts. Batter to hold it together.  Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350°.

name: SALSA IN A SHELL
ingredients:
1  round rye bread
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  c. salsa
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix cream cheese, sour cream and salsa until well blended. Stir in Cheddar cheese.  Cut top off bread and save.  Hollow out bread.  Spoon cheese mixture into bread and cover with bread top. Wrap in foil and place on cookie sheet.  Bake 1 1/2 hours at 400°.

name: TRIPLE CHOCOLATE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  box chocolate cake mix
1 large  box chocolate pudding
1  pkg. chocolate chips
1  pkg. nuts
preparation: Mix together cake mix and pudding and 1 to 2 cups water. Batter will be very thick.  Spread in cake pan.  Layer your chocolate chips and nuts on top.  Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350° until done.  Very rich, but very good!

name: QUICK APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine, at room temperature
1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  large apple, pared, cored and cut into 1/4-inch thick wedges
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. chopped almonds
preparation: Cream together margarine and the 1/2 cup sugar.  Add eggs and beat until fluffy.  Stir in vanilla and flour, mixing well. Spread evenly in buttered 9-inch round cake pan.  Place apple wedges into cake batter to form a circular pattern.  Mix together 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon.  Sprinkle over cake.  Sprinkle top with almonds.

name: Best Ever Fudge
ingredients:
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. regular chocolate pudding
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. regular vanilla pudding
1  c. evaporated milk
2  c. sugar
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
2  c. mini marshmallows
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine pudding, sugar and milk.  Heat over medium heat until boiling and cook 1 minute.  Remove from heat and add marshmallows, chips and vanilla.  Return to heat until melted.  Pour into 9-inch square greased pan.  Cool until set.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can sweet potatoes or 3 c. mashed sweet potatoes
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  stick margarine, melted
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased casserole dish.

name: HERB TOAST
ingredients:
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm very thin sliced bread
1 1/2  sticks butter
1/4  t. garlic
1/4  t. oregano
1  1/2 t. Jayne's Crazy Salt
Paprika
preparation: Cut bread loaf into thirds, making cuts in the already-sliced bread. Lay the slices on a cookie sheet. Mix all the ingredients together and brush on bread. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 225° for 1 hour.

name: 9 DAY SLAW
ingredients:
4  lb. shredded cabbage
1  onion
1  bell pepper
1  c. Wesson oil
1  c. apple cider vinegar
2  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. celery seed
2  c. sugar
preparation: Pour 2 cups sugar over cabbage, 1 onion and 1 bell pepper. Bring oil, vinegar, salt, sugar and celery seed to a boil.   Let cool and pour over cabbage mixture.  Chill 24 hours.

name: CABBAGE SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  qt. cabbage, finely chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
2  medium onions, chopped
1 small  jar pimentos, chopped
1  c. vinegar
1  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. celery seed
3/4  tsp. mustard seed
3/4  tsp. turmeric
preparation: Mix  cabbage, green pepper, onion and pimento together. Make a  sauce  of  vinegar, salt, sugar, celery seed, mustard seed  and turmeric.	Bring sauce to boil.  Pour over cabbage. Mix well. Refrigerate 12 hours.  Keeps for weeks.

name: ROADHOUSE POTATOES
ingredients:
3  c. half and half cream
1/2  c. butter
1  tsp. salt
2  lb. frozen hash browns, thawed
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Heat cream and butter.  Add salt.  Place potatoes in flat, greased glass 9 x 12-inch dish.  Pour cream mixture over potatoes. Sprinkle cheese on top.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: SATURDAY NIGHT SUPPER
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  can Spanish rice
1  can Ranch Style beans
grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown ground meat with chili powder.  Drain grease.  Add Spanish rice and beans.  Transfer to a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish and top with cheese.  Heat in oven until cheese melts, then serve with chips.

name: FRESH SUMMER BLUEBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1  egg, beaten
2 1/2  c. blueberries (fresh)
9-inch unbaked pie shell
3  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. margarine
3  Tbsp. pecans
preparation: Mix first 7 ingredients and put in pie shell and bake at 400° for 25 minutes.  Combine last 3 ingredients in saucepan.  Stir and melt.  Pour over pie and bake for 10 more minutes.  This is wonderful and easy!

name: PIZZA POCKETS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/4  c. pizza sauce
1/2  c. each Mozzarella cheese and Italian sausage
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
3  oz. pepperoni
2 to 3  Tbsp. pizza sauce
1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese
pizza dough
preparation: Roll pizza dough into 12-inch circle.  Fold loosely in half. Brush with oil and unfold.  Layer remaining ingredients on half of the circle.  Fold dough over filling. Pinch dough together. Prick top with fork.  Bake until golden brown for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: LAVENDER PUNCH
ingredients:
juice of 1 lemon
juice of 1 orange
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. tartaric acid
1  c. boiling water
2  qt. cold water
1/2  c. grape juice
1  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Combine juice of lemon and orange, sugar, tartaric acid and boiling water.  Allow to stand for 24 hours.  Add cold water and grape juice.  Pour into punch bowl.  Add ginger ale just before serving.

name: RICE AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chopped broccoli*
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. chopped celery
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. sliced almonds (optional)
1  c. Minute rice
1/3  c. regular rice (uncooked)
preparation: *Frozen broccoli can be thawed in small saucepan, if you don't like it crunchy.

name: 7 LAYER JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
7 small  boxes Jell-O (3 oz.; in 7 different flavors and colors)
36  oz. sour cream
7  c. boiling water
preparation: Dissolve 1 box Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water.  Place 1/2 cup in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Take other half of Jell-O and mix with 1/2 cup of sour cream.  Mix with fork or wire whisk.  Let first layer jell.  Put on sour cream layer and jell.  Allow 30 minutes between layers.  Repeat this for remainder of 6 boxes of Jell-O.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1  chicken, cooked and deboned
2  cans cream of chicken soup or 1 can soup and 1 can broth from chicken
1  medium bag frozen vegetables, cooked and drained (use fresh if available; microwave to soften)
1  medium onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix together and put in a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Cover with topping.

name: DIETETIC FRUIT BARS
ingredients:
1  c. water
1  c. raisins
2  apples, peeled and chopped
1/4  c. shortening
1  c. granulated sweetener
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped walnut meats
1  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt (optional)
preparation: Combine  water, raisins, apples and shortening.  Boil 3 minutes.  Cool.  Add egg,  vanilla	and nutmeats.  Sift flour, sweetener,	spices	and  soda together.  Add to fruit mixture. Spread  in	a  9  x  9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Yield: 25 bars.  Calories: 1 bar = 76 calories.

name: SHRIMP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. peeled shrimp
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  can French onion soup
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
6  oz. can white crab meat
1/4  c. parsley
2  c. Minute rice
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.  Chop shrimp if they are large.  Pour into a buttered casserole dish.  Cover and bake at 350° until all ingredients are done or approximately 1 hour.

name: PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. crushed pretzels
1  stick melted oleo
8  oz. cream cheese
2  c. whipped topping
1  c. sugar
2 small  pkg. strawberry gelatin
2  c. boiling water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
preparation: Mix together pretzels and oleo.  Press in 9 x 13-inch cake dish.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.  Cool.  Beat together cream cheese and sugar.  Fold in 2 cups whipped topping.  Spread on crust.  Chill.  Dissolve the gelatin in 2 cups boiling water. Stir in strawberries.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Pour over cheese filling.  Chill 2 hours.

name: LEMON FLUFF
ingredients:
2  c. vanilla wafer crumbs
1 (3 oz.)  box orange or lemon jello
1  can chilled evaporated milk
1  c. sugar
1  lemon
1 1/2  c. boiling water
preparation: Dissolve  jello  in  1	1/2  cups boiling water.  Cool. Whip chilled  evaporated  milk.	Add  sugar.  Mix  well.  Add juice of 1 lemon.  Add cooled jello.  Pour into a large baking dish that has  been  spread  with  1 cup of the vanilla wafer crumbs. Spread  remaining  crumbs  on  top.  Chill at least 3 hours.

name: CARAMEL CANDY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. molasses (Old Barrel)
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter
2  c. cream
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil together sugar, molasses and salt to 245°.  Add butter and cream; boil to 242°.  Remove from heat.  Add vanilla.  Be careful to stir often while cooking, especially near the end.  Pour into a well buttered 5 x 10-inch pan.  Cool until cold.  Cut in small squares and wrap in wax paper.

name: FRENCH GREEN BEANS AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
1  medium onion
1  can water chestnuts
1  c. Cheez Whiz
1/3  c. almonds
1 small  can mushrooms
1  can French green beans
preparation: Saute onions in butter and add mushrooms to brown a little. Add remaining ingredients; stir constantly while heating.  Bake at 300° to 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BAR-B-Q SPARERIBS
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. spareribs
2  onions, sliced
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3/4  c. catsup
1  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. chili powder
3/4  c. water
preparation: Make a sauce with all ingredients, except the spareribs and the onions.  Sprinkle the spareribs with salt and pepper. Cover with onions.  Pour the sauce over the spareribs.  Cover and  bake 1  1/2  hours at 350°.  Turn ribs once or twice and baste occasionally.

name: CHOCOLATE SURPRISE CAKE
ingredients:
12  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1 (18.25 oz.)  pkg. chocolate cake mix
1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate mini-morsels
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Butter and flour a 12-cup Bundt pan.  In a small mixing bowl, using an electric mixer, beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth.  Add egg and vanilla; beat until blended and set aside.  Prepare cake as label directs; fold in chocolate morsels.  Pour chocolate batter in prepared pan; evenly cover with cream cheese mixture.  Bake until a wooden pick inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean, 45 to 55 minutes.  Cool on a wire rack for 25 minutes.  Remove from pan; cool completely.  Dust with confectioners sugar.  Serve with whipped cream and raspberries if desired.  Serves 12.

name: JUICY MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. oatmeal
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. catsup
preparation: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and pack firmly into a loaf pan. Bake in a moderate oven (350°) 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing. Makes 8 servings.

name: DILL CRACKERS
ingredients:
1  box oyster crackers
2/3  c. oil (safflower or any)
2  tsp. dill weed
1  pkg. Good Seasons salad dressing (garlic-cheese)
preparation: Stir 10 minutes until dry, then marinate overnight.

name: PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  c. lard
1  c. very cold water
preparation: Mix, then roll out on pastry cloth.  Then bake.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken Rice-A-Roni
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  can chicken broth
3  c. cooked, cubed chicken
1  c. sour cream
2  c. grated sharp cheese
bread crumbs
paprika
preparation: Cook Rice-A-Roni according to package directions.  Mix in rest of ingredients except cheese, crumbs and paprika.  Spoon into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle remaining ingredients. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: 3 BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1 medium-size  can green beans
1 medium-size  can wax beans
1 medium-size  can kidney beans
1  green pepper, chopped
1  onion, chopped
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/2  c. vinegar
1/4  c. oil
preparation: Drain wax, green and kidney beans.  Add all other ingredients. Refrigerate at least 24 hours before serving.   Stir several times with a slotted spoon.

name: CABBAGE AND NOODLES
ingredients:
5  slices bacon
6  c. chopped cabbage
1  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
4  oz. noodles
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp.  Set aside.  Fry cabbage, sugar and salt.  Cook until tender.  Cook noodles and drain.  Combine cabbage, noodles and bacon.  Place in baking dish.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.  Spoon on sour cream; bake 5 more minutes.

name: PLUM CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
1  c. Wesson or other oil
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
2 small  jars baby strained plums
1  c. chopped nuts
4  eggs
preparation: Grease and flour tube pan.  Mix oil and sugar, then add eggs one at a time.  Sift dry ingredients; add plums and nuts.  Pour into tube pan and bake at 325° for 55 to 75 minutes.  Test for doneness between those times.

name: SPINACH WITH CREAM CHEESE
ingredients:
2  lb. fresh spinach or 2 pkg. frozen chopped
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, crumbled
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Cook and chop spinach.  Drain slightly.  Add crumbled cream cheese, melted butter, salt, pepper and nutmeg.  Mix well.  Reheat and serve.

name: BUTTERFLY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can sliced pineapple
1/2  doz. bananas
1  bottle red cherries
preparation: Cut slices of pineapple in half; arrange on lettuce leaf with half slice of banana in center.  On each piece of pineapple, arrange 2 or 3 cherries.  This will make an effective and pretty butterfly.  Serve with salad dressing.

name: MY FAVORITE BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  c. chopped pecans
3  crushed very ripe bananas
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Whip crushed bananas until very light. Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs and mix, then flour and soda and mix very well.  Add nuts and mix, then bananas.  Turn this mixture into a very well-greased bread pan (glass works better) and bake for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: BREAKFAST PIZZA
ingredients:
1  can crescent rolls
sausage
1  c. Mozzarella cheese
1  c. Cheddar cheese
6  eggs
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Spread rolls on cookie sheet and bake for 5 minutes.  Brown sausage and sprinkle on top.  Sprinkle cheese on top of sausage. Mix 6 eggs and milk.  Pour slowly on top.  Bake at 325° for about 30 minutes or until done.

name: MICROWAVE DIVINITY
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1/2  c. water
dash of salt
2  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2 to 1  c. chopped pecans, if desired
preparation: Combine sugar, syrup, water and salt in glass casserole. Microwave on High for 5 minutes.  Stir.  Place bowl back in microwave for 9 minutes on High.  Beat egg whites in mixer bowl until stiff peaks form.  Add cream of tartar.  Mix in well.  Pour hot syrup over egg whites, beating constantly at high speed.  Add vanilla.  Beat for 4 to 5 minutes or until mixture loses its shape and starts to lose its gloss.  Fold in pecans.  Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

name: CREAM CHEESE FROSTING
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
1 to 3  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Mix cream cheese (room temperature) with sugar, vanilla and salt.  Add milk to the desired texture.

name: CORN SALAD
ingredients:
1 (17 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1/2  green pepper, diced
1  c. sliced celery
1  c. diced fresh tomato
1/4  tsp. salt
1/3  c. French dressing
salad greens
red onion rings (optional)
preparation: Combine corn, green pepper, celery, tomato and salt with French dressing; chill.  Serve on salad greens; garnish with onion rings, if desired.

name: BROCCOLI PUFF
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1  beaten egg
1/4  c. crushed Ritz crackers or fine dry bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. melted margarine
preparation: Cook broccoli according to package directions, omitting salt. Drain thoroughly. Spray baking dish with cooking spray or butter dish. Place broccoli in the baking dish. Mix soup, cheese, milk, mayonnaise and egg. Pour over broccoli. Top with Ritz crackers or the bread crumbs mixed with the melted margarine. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly and the crumbs are lightly browned. Serves 6.

name: PEANUT BUTTER OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. shredded carrots
2  egg whites
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. rolled oats
preparation: In a bowl, stir together flour and baking soda.  In a large mixer bowl, beat margarine with electric mixer on medium speed for 30 seconds.  Add peanut butter, sugar and brown sugar.  Beat until fluffy.  Add carrot, egg whites and vanilla.  Beat well.  Add dry ingredients to beaten mixture.  Beat until well combined.  Stir in oats.  Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart onto a nongreased cookie sheet.  Bake in a 375° oven about 10 minutes or until done.  Remove cookies from cookie sheet.  Cool on wire rack. Makes 48 cookies (24 servings).

name: LAZY DAY LASAGNA(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can (14 1/2 oz.) tomatoes, undrained
1  can (6 oz.) tomato paste
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. basil leaves
1/2  tsp. oregano leaves
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. water
2  c. cottage cheese
1  egg
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
8  uncooked lasagna noodles
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Crumble   ground   beef  into  1  1/2-quart  casserole. Microwave (High)  5  to 6 minutes, until no longer pink, stirring once.  Stir  to  break meat into pieces.  Drain.  Stir in tomatoes,  tomato  paste,  salt, basil, oregano, garlic powder and water.  Cover.  Microwave  (High)  4 to 5 minutes or until mixture boils.

name: PUFFED POPCORN
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) bag puffed popcorn
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  c. butter (not margarine)
1/2  c. light syrup
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Pour popcorn in roaster. In a 2-quart saucepan, combine brown sugar, butter and syrup. Stir for 2 minutes. Add baking soda and stir. Pour over popcorn and bake at 250° for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes.

name: HOT DOGS
ingredients:
mustard
ketchup
chili
wieners
hot dog buns
preparation: You put the wieners in a pot, then you take them out and wash them off.  Put wiener in the hog dog buns.  Put mustard, ketchup and chili on hot dogs.  And eat it.  The daddy does the dishes and the kids go to bed when it's dark.

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large  can pineapple juice
1 small  pkg. lemon jello
1 small  can frozen concentrated lemonade
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. almond flavoring
preparation: Fill to 1 gallon with water.  Serves 20.

name: MUD-PIE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
5  Tbsp. oil
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. water
preparation: Sift all dry ingredients into a 9 x 9-inch pan.  Make 3 holes in the mixture.  Put the oil in the first hole, the vinegar in second hole and vanilla in the third hole.  Pour water over all. Stir until it is mixed and smooth.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  c. water
1 small  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
sliced berries
1  prebaked pie shell
whipped cream
preparation: Boil the first 3 ingredients until thick.  Add the Jell-O. When it begins to set, pour over the sliced berries that have been arranged in a prebaked pie shell.  Top with the whipped cream.

name: YOLIE'S WASSAIL
ingredients:
2  qt. water
1 2/3  c. sugar or to taste
1  large frozen orange juice
2/3  c. lemon juice
3  cinnamon sticks
1  whole ginger
10  allspice
10  cloves
1  gal. apple cider
preparation: Cook all ingredients except apple cider until thoroughly warmed.  Add apple cider.  Serve hot.

name: CHUNKY POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. small to medium size potatoes
4  slices bacon
1/4  c. onion
1/4  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. chopped dill pickle
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. dry vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. sugar
16  oz. pork and beans in tomato sauce
preparation: Cook potatoes with skins in boiling water until tender, about 35 minutes.  Peel and slice while hot.  Meanwhile, cook bacon in a skillet until crisp; remove, crumble and set aside.  Pour off all but 2 tablespoons fat.  Add onion, celery and pickle and saute until tender.  Blend in vinegar, mustard, salt, pepper and sugar. Gently stir in beans and bacon; heat through.  Turn beans into serving bowl; add hot, sliced potatoes.  Toss and serve immediately.  Makes 6 servings.

name: HOT CRAB DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1/4  c. slivered almonds
1  can crab meat
preparation: Beat cream cheese until smooth.  Add mayonnaise and beat until blended.  Stir in crab meat.  Pour into 1-quart baking dish.  Top with almonds.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Serve with crackers, Triscuits or party size bread pieces.

name: PIZZA BAKED SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
4  oz. (1/2 pkg.) spaghetti
1 26  oz. spaghetti sauce
1 4  oz. can mushrooms
1 4  oz. can black olives
1/2  medium onion, chopped (optional)
1 8  oz. pkg. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1 4oz.  pkg. pepperoni
preparation: Cook spaghetti as directed, drain and place in bottom of 8x8 baking pan.  Place mushrooms, black olives, and onions onto spaghetti.  Pour spaghetti sauce over top.  Place cheese on top of sauce, then place pepperoni.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

name: BEEFY BISCUIT CUPS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 14  oz. jar spaghetti sauce
2 8  oz. tubes large refrigerated biscuits
1  c. shredded cheddar cheese, more to taste
preparation: In a skillet, brown beef and drain.  Stir in spaghetti sauce. Cook over medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes.  Press biscuits into the bottom of and up the sides of greased muffin cups.  Spoon 2 tablespoons of meat mixture into center of each cup. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 to 17 minutes or until golden brown.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake 3 minutes longer or until cheese is melted.

name: TEXAS DESSERT
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate pudding
1  pkg. vanilla pudding
1  c. flour
1  c. pecan pieces
1  stick margarine, melted
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. Cool Whip
1  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Prepare the chocolate pudding and vanilla pudding as directed. Set aside and let cool.  Press in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan a mixture of the flour, pecan pieces and melted margarine. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Let cool.

name: PEANUT BUTTER SQUARES
ingredients:
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/3  c. margarine
3/4  c. brown sugar, packed
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat peanut butter, margarine, brown sugar and sugar until creamy.  Add eggs and vanilla and mix.  Add dry ingredients and mix.  Grease brownie pan and pour mixture in pan.  Bake at 325° until done, not firm.  Cool and frost.

name: ALMOND MACAROONS
ingredients:
3/4  c. whole almonds or 1 1/4 c. ground ones
3/4  c. sugar
3  egg whites
1  Tbsp. almond extract
preparation: Mix ground nuts, sugar and unbeaten egg whites together.  Cook over moderate heat, stirring constantly, for about 8 to 10 minutes; don't boil mixture.  A good test is to pull a knife through batter, if both sides stay clean, the batter has reached the right stage of thickness.  Remove from heat.  Add extract.

name: CRANBERRY NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. fresh cranberries, cut in half
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. grated orange peel
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. orange juice
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  egg, well beaten
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Generously grease and flour a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Prepare cranberries, nuts and orange peel; set aside.  In bowl mix together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and soda.  Cut in shortening.  Stir in orange juice, egg and orange peel.  Mix just to moisten.  Fold in cranberries and nuts.  Spoon into prepared pan. Bake for 60 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool on rack for 15 minutes. Remove from pan, cool completely.  Wrap and store overnight.

name: ELMA'S BAHAMIAN BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
2  c. warm water
1/2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. sugar
1/2  stick margarine or shortening
2 1/4  tsp. salt
8 to 10  c. flour
preparation: Mix yeast, water and 2 Tbsp sugar and let sit for 10 minutes. Add rest of sugar, margarine, salt and 3 c. of flour and beat with mixer for 2 minutes.  Add enough flour to make workable dough. Knead for 8 minutes.  Let rise until doubled.

name: RHUBARB UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. sliced rhubarb
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Place rhubarb in pan.  Sprinkle sugar over top.  Mix together remaining ingredients.  Pour mixture over rhubarb.   Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: PEACH COOLER
ingredients:
2  large peaches, skinned and stoned
juice of 1/2 lemon
2 (6 oz.)  carton peach yogurt
2  c. milk
ice cubes
peach slices to garnish
preparation: Put skinned peaches, lemon juice, yogurt and milk into a blender or food processor and process until completely smooth. Fill tall glasses with ice cubes and pour over peach cooler. Garnish the sides of the glasses with thin slices of peach. Serves 4 to 6.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
3/4  c. powdered sugar
1  pkg. Dream Whip, mixed as directed
1  graham cracker crust
your favorite pie filling
preparation: Mix together well the cream cheese and powdered sugar.  Beat Dream Whip.  Fold in cream cheese mixture and place in a graham cracker crust.  Top with your favorite pie filling.  Keep refrigerated.

name: SPARKLING PINEAPPLE DRINK
ingredients:
1  qt. pineapple juice
club soda or seltzer water
ice cubes
strawberries, lime slices or pineapple chunks (for garnish)
preparation: Fill each of 6 glasses 2/3 full of pineapple juice.  Add club soda or seltzer and ice cubes.  Garnish with strawberries, lime slices or pineapple chunks.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef (can use 1 lb. ground turkey and 1 lb.  ground beef)
1 large  can peeled whole tomatoes
2  cans kidney beans, drained
hot sauce to taste
6  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped (optional)
preparation: Cook and drain ground beef/turkey. Add other ingredients in slow cooker. Cook about 5 hours or more.  Serve with grated Cheddar or Parmesan cheese.

name: CRUSTLESS CRAB SPINACH QUICHE
ingredients:
8  oz. sliced fresh mushrooms
1  (10 oz.) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained well
4  oz. fresh crab
1  c. chopped green onion
8  eggs
1  c. milk
1  c. chopped sweet red pepper
2  c. Monterey Jack cheese
salt and pepper
preparation: Beat eggs; add remaining ingredients.  Bake in 9 x 13 dish at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: MERINGUE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  egg whites (at room temperature)
1/8  tsp. salt
2  drops peppermint or 1/2 tsp. vanilla or favorite flavoring
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. chocolate bits or chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Beat egg whites until stiff, gradually adding sugar and salt.  Beat until peaks form.  Add flavoring and chocolate bits.  Fold until well mixed.  Cover cookie sheet with waxed paper.  Drop batter by teaspoon onto cookie sheet.  Do not make too big.  Batter expands.  Place in oven; turn oven off! Leave overnight in oven.  If made in daytime, leave in oven at least 4 hours.  Makes 5 dozen.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
1  c. light corn syrup
1  c. butter (2 sticks)
2  c. peanuts (Spanish are good)
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Spray 2 cookie sheets with oil and keep warm in a low oven. Need candy thermometer.

name: EGGS AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
12  eggs
1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  lb. Monterey Jack cheese
1/2  lb. Longhorn cheese
1  pt. cottage cheese
4  oz. can chopped green chilies
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Beat eggs and add flour and baking powder.  Add all cheeses and chopped green chilies.  Melt 1/2 stick margarine in baking pan; leave enough in pan to coat well.  Pour the remainder into the egg mixture.  Pour in the pan and bake 25 minutes at 350°. This can be made the night before.

name: CRAB IMPERIAL
ingredients:
1  lb. crabmeat
equal parts mayo and cream (start with 1/2 c.)
1  to 2 eggs (depending on size)
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
dry mustard to taste
preparation: Put crab in casserole. Combine mayo and cream. Add to crab. Mix well. Crab mixture should be quite moist. Add more mayo and cream if it isn't. Add eggs and Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Mix.  Can put bread crumbs on top if you want. Bake at 350° until thickened (about 15 minutes).

name: CHEESEBURGER MACARONI
ingredients:
1 (7 1/4 oz.)  pkg. macaroni and cheese dinner
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
preparation: Prepare macaroni and cheese dinner according to directions on box.  Brown ground beef and onion; drain excess fat.  Combine thoroughly remaining ingredients with beef mixture and macaroni dinner.  Season to taste and place in 2-quart buttered casserole. Bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes at 350°.

name: CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. unsweetened cocoa
4 (10 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate, melted
2  oz. white chocolate, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  In mixing bowl, beat butter and sugar until smooth.  Add vanilla.  Gradually stir in flour and cocoa until well combined.  Form into a ball.  Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 20 minutes.  On lightly floured surface, roll out dough to 1/2-inch thickness.  Cut out any shape cookie and place on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake 20 minutes and remove. Cool completely on wire rack (approximately 15 minutes).  Use pastry brush and coat each cookie with melted chocolate, then drizzle white chocolate.  Must stand 15 minutes or until chocolate is set.

name: Jambalaya
ingredients:
1  lb. ham
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1 (28 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
1  Tbsp. shortening
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. thyme
1  Tbsp. flour
2 1/2  c. water
2  c. rice
1  lb. shrimp
preparation: In large skillet, cook ham 5 minutes.  Drain off all but 2 tablespoons fat.  Add pepper, onion and garlic.  Cook until tender.  Blend in flour and brown slowly stirring often.  Stir in tomatoes, water and parsley.  Bring to a boil and add rice, Worcestershire, salt, thyme and pepper.  Return to boil.  Reduce and simmer covered 20 minutes.  Add shrimp and cook 10 minutes longer.

name: CHESS PIE
ingredients:
3  c. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
3  eggs
1/4  lb. butter
3  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sweet milk
preparation: Mix all together and bake in shell for 25 minutes in slow oven at 325°.  Makes 2 pies.

name: WORMY STUFFED APPLES
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. Rice Krispies
1/2  c. grated carrots
gummy worms
4  apples
preparation: Mix peanut butter, Rice Krispies and grated carrots.  Core apples and stuff with the peanut butter mixture.  Poke hole in one end of apple and tuck one end of gummy worm in hole.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
4  c. flour
6  large ripe bananas
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.  Sift dry ingredients together and add to creamed mixture.  Add bananas and nuts.  Pour into two well-greased loaf pans.  Bake at 250° to 300° from 1 to 2 hours.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
2  c. sugar
1  c. sweet milk
2  c. plain flour
1  c. self-rising flour
pinch of salt
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon or butternut flavoring
preparation: Cream Crisco and sugar.  Then add eggs and mix until creamy. Sift the two flours together and alternately add the milk and flour to the creamed mixture, mixing well between two additions. Add flavoring. Bake in tube pan about 1 hour at 325°.  Test to see if cake is done.

name: RATATOUILLE SUPREME
ingredients:
1/2  c. olive oil
4  c. cubed, peeled eggplant
4  c. cubed zucchini
1/2  c. green pepper, cut in squares
1/4  c. sweet red pepper, cut in squares
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped garlic
4  fresh tomatoes, peeled and quartered
pinch of thyme
1  bay leaf
1  tsp. sweet basil
pinch of rosemary
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. white pepper
1/2  c. pitted small black olives
2  Tbsp. parsley, chopped
preparation: In a large skillet, heat oil; saute eggplant and zucchini for 8 minutes.  Add the peppers and onion and simmer uncovered for another 6 minutes.  Add garlic and simmer 2 minutes.  Add wine, tomatoes, herbs, salt, pepper and black olives and cook covered in a 350° oven for 20 minutes or until eggplant is tender.  Sprinkle with parsley and serve.   Yields 8 servings.

name: COLE SLAW DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Stir ingredients together; cover and chill.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1  large fryer, cooked and cubed
1  can cream of chicken soup
3  c. chicken broth
1  lb. can peas and carrots, drained
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine ingredients and place in 9 x 12-inch pan.  Pour crust over chicken mixture.  Bake at 400° for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until crust rises and browns.

name: NEW ENGLAND CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
2  slices bacon
1  c. finely chopped onion
2  c. cubed, pared potatoes
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  cans minced clams
2  c. half and half
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Chop bacon coarsely. Saute in a large kettle until almost crisp. Add onion.  Cook about 5 minutes. Add potatoes, salt, pepper and 1 cup water.  Cook, uncovered, 15 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender.  Drain clams, reserving liquid. Add clams, 1/2 cup clam liquid, half and half and margarine to kettle. Mix well.  Heat 3 minutes. Do not boil. Serves 4.

name: TEXAS CAKE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. cocoa
2  sticks butter
1  c. water
2  c. self-rising flour
2  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Melt together cocoa, butter and water.   Add flour, eggs, sugar and sour cream to chocolate mixture.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: ONE POT DINNER
ingredients:
1/2 to 1  lb. ground round
3/4  lb. bacon, cut in small pieces
1  c. chopped onion
2 (1 lb. 15 oz.)  cans pork and beans, drained (I use Campbell's country style)
1  can kidney beans, drained
1  can white beans, drained
1  c. ketchup
1/4  c. brown syrup
1  tsp. liquid smoke
3  Tbsp. white vinegar
1  tsp. salt and dash of pepper
preparation: Brown ground round in skillet and drain off fat.  Add bacon and onions; simmer.  Combine all ingredients in crock-pot; mix well.  Cook on low 4 to 6 hours.

name: OATMEAL PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. dark Karo
1  stick oleo
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. oatmeal
preparation: Melt oleo; mix all together.  Add oatmeal last.  Put in pie shell.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger meat
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can beef broth
1  pkg. taco mix
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
grated cheese
1  (11 oz.) bag Doritos
preparation: Place Doritos in dish. Heat other ingredients.  Pour over chips.  Top with cheese.  Melt cheese.  Serve.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can fruit cocktail
1  can mandarin oranges
3  large apples, diced
grapes (as you want)
1/2  c. maraschino cherries
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar
miniature marshmallows (as you want)
1 1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Drain canned fruit; combine with apples and grapes.  In separate bowl, mix softened cream cheese, sugar and sour cream. Pour over fruit.  Add pecans and marshmallows; mix well. Refrigerate.

name: FREEZER COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
2  c. sugar
8  oz. sour cream
12  oz. frozen coconut
1 1/2  c. cool whip
preparation: Prepare cake according to directions on box.  Making 2 round layers. Split layers in half making 4 layers after cooling.  Blend sugar, sour cream and coconut.  Spread all but 1 cup between layers.  Blend remaining cup of sour cream mixture with cool whip. Spread on top and sides of cake.  Seal in air tight container and place in freezer.  Leave in freezer for at least 2 days.  Set out 2 hours before cutting.  Refrigerate after cutting.

name: EASY TORTILLA BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1 (12 oz.)  can tomato sauce
12  corn tortillas, quartered
1  (16 oz.) container sour cream
1  medium onion, diced
2  c. grated Cheddar or Monterey Jack
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a large skillet brown beef and drain. Add chili and sauce; simmer 10 minutes.  Dip quartered corn tortillas in sour cream.  In a greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish, place 1/2 of tortillas to line bottom.  Top with 1/2 of meat, 1/2 of onion and 1/2 of cheese.  Repeat layers.  Bake 30 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: GRANDMA'S CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
1  green pepper, cut in strips
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/2  lb. lean ground chuck
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1  tsp. monosodium glutamate (optional)
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. sugar
1 (1 lb. 12 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  c. water
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. wide noodles
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese, sliced
preparation: In a Dutch oven, saute onion and pepper in butter for 3 minutes; add ground chuck and brown meat, breaking up meat with a spoon as it cooks.  Add salt, monosodium glutamate (if you desire), pepper and sugar; stir in tomatoes, tomato sauce and water.  Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.

name: LEMON CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs, beaten
1  stick butter, melted
1  Tbsp. cornmeal
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Filling will set more while cooling.

name: HONEY GLAZED CARROTS
ingredients:
4  large carrots, diagonally sliced in pieces
3  Tbsp. honey
salt and pepper to taste
chopped parsley for garnish
preparation: In medium saucepan bring carrots, honey and 1 cup water to a boil.  Reduce heat to low, cover with lid slightly ajar and simmer until water is evaporated and carrots are tender, stirring occasionally.  Season with salt and pepper.  Garnish with parsley.

name: QUICK NUT FUDGE
ingredients:
1  lb. confectioners 10x sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/4  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
4  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
1  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
preparation: Combine all ingredients except nuts in top of double boiler. Place over simmering water and stir until smooth.  Add nuts and mix.  Spread candy quickly in buttered 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  Cool. Cut in squares.  Yield:  2 dozen pieces.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. Bisquick
2  Tbsp. margarine
13  oz. can evaporated milk
2  eggs
16  oz. canned pumpkin
2 1/2  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease pie plate, 9 or 10-inch.  Beat all ingredients until smooth, 1 minute in blender on high or 2 minutes with hand beater.  Pour into plate. Bake 50 to 55 minutes, when knife inserted in center comes out clean.

name: SOUTHERN ICE CREAM-GRITS
ingredients:
1  c. grits
1  tsp. salt
1  stick butter
1 1/2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
2  eggs
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Cook the grits in salt water.  Add butter and grated cheese. Beat eggs and milk together and add to grits.  Pour into a buttered casserole and bake at 350° from 55 to 60 minutes.

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
8  medium size potatoes
1  stalk celery, diced
2  hard-cooked eggs, sliced
1  medium size onion, minced
4  slices bacon, diced
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  c. cider vinegar
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. minced parsley
preparation: Scrub and cook potatoes in their skin.  When tender, peel and dice.  Add the celery, hard-cooked eggs, and onion; toss lightly. Fry bacon in skillet until crisp and brown.  To the beaten eggs, add sugar, salt, pepper, mustard and a mixture of vinegar and water; mix well.  Pour egg mixture into the hot bacon and fat and stir until mixture thickens (about 10 minutes).  Pour over the potato mixture and toss lightly to mix thoroughly.  Chill several hours before serving.  Garnish with the minced parsley.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: BLACKBERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sweet milk
4  c. blackberries
1  c. water
1  c. sugar
preparation: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan; mix and pour batter into pan.  Mix blackberries, water and sugar in bowl; pour fruit on top of batter.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

name: ALFRED'S CHILI
ingredients:
3/4  lb. bacon
3  large yellow onions
3/4  lb. mushrooms
4  lb. ground chuck
3 (1 lb. 12 oz.)  cans Italian-style kind tomatoes (Romano)
2/3  c. chili powder
1  Tbsp. salt
4  c. red beans (1 lb. cans)
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
preparation: Cut up bacon coarsely.  Slowly cook in large kettle until tender.  Chop onions.  Add to bacon and cook until translucent. Add meat and chili powder now.  Cook a while and mix well.  Add chopped mushrooms.  Drain tomatoes and add.  Now put in salt and beans.  Stir mixture.  Add sauce.   Stir again.  Cook on low for at least one hour.

name: SESAME PRALINES
ingredients:
1/4  c. sesame seed
1  c. dark brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. cream
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  c. pecan halves
preparation: Toast sesame seed in 350° oven for 15 minutes.  In 3-quart saucepan, combine both sugars and cream.  Cook over medium heat, stirring until dissolved.  Wash crystals from sides of pan.  Cook to 230° on candy thermometer.  Add butter, pecans and sesame seed. Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, to 234° (soft ball stage).  Remove from heat.   Cool 2 to 3 minutes, then stir until thickened.  Working fast, drop from spoon onto buttered waxed paper.  Cool.

name: PERSIMMON PUDDING
ingredients:
1/4  tsp. soda
1  c. persimmon pulp
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1  beaten egg
1  c. flour
1 1/4  c. milk
1/8  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Mix together in a large bowl the first 7 ingredients to include soda, pulp, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, salt and beaten egg.  Blend thoroughly and gradually add flour.  Slowly add milk while stirring.  Finally, add melted margarine and pour into a greased pan.  Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.

name: HAM STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
16  large mushrooms
2  Tbsp. onion, finely chopped
1 (6.75 oz.)  can Hormel chunk ham, flaked
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. pimiento, diced
preparation: Wash mushrooms.  Finely chop stems and onion.  Saute in butter until tender, but not browned.  Add ham, bread crumbs and pimiento.  Stir until combined and crumbs are soft.  Place mushroom caps in buttered baking dish; spoon ham mixture into caps.  Bake, covered, at 375° for 15 minutes.

name: CHICKEN IN WINE
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3  lb. chicken, cut in pieces
2  medium onions, diced
1/2  c. grated carrots
1  clove garlic
1  can sliced mushrooms (3 oz.)
1 1/2  c. Burgundy wine
2  to 3 sprigs parsley
1/4  tsp. dried thyme
celery leaves
1  bay leaf
preparation: Brown cut up chicken coated with salt, pepper and flour. Remove chicken to 3-quart casserole.  In skillet, add onions, carrots and garlic. Cover and cook 5 to 10 minutes.  Add mushrooms and Burgundy wine.  Scrape up browned vegetables and simmer all together 2 to 3 minutes.  Dip out solid pieces from skillet and alternate in the casserole in layers with the chicken, adding 2 to 3 sprigs of parsley, 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme, celery leaves and one bay leaf to each layer.  Pour the heated wine over the casserole.  Cover and bake at 350° for 2 hours. Serve with snipped parsley.

name: WILD ROSE HIP JELLY
ingredients:
4 1/2  lb. wild rose hips, gathered in fall when soft
4  c. water
1  box Sure-Jel or 1 c. apple juice and 1 c. water
5 1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Remove blossom ends of hips; split and remove balls of seeds. Crush fruit thoroughly.  Add water.  Bring to boil and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.  Pour into cloth bag in large bowl; tie top of bag and hang over bowl until all juice has drained from bag.  This should yield about 4 cups juice.

name: MEATBALL STROGANOFF
ingredients:
2  slices white bread, crumbled
1/4  Cup milk
1  egg, beaten
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1 1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  lb. ground chuck
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  Cup chopped onion
2  Tbsp. flour
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed beef bouillon, undiluted
1 (9 oz.)  package frozen Italian green beans, cut green beans or a can of peas
1/2  Cup sour cream
3  Cups cooked white rice
preparation: In medium bowl, using a fork toss bread crumbs with milk, egg, garlic powder, salt and pepper.  Add ground chuck and mix well.  Shape lightly into balls.  In large pan melt 1 1/2 Tbsp. butter, sauté meatballs turning until brown all over.  Remove meatballs and add the rest of the  butter and onion, sauté about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Stir in flour.  Gradually stir in bouillon and bring to a boil, stirring; reduce heat.  Add meatballs and simmer for 30 minutes.  Meanwhile cook beans as directed on package, drain well.  Add beans and sour cream to meatballs, stirring to combine.  Reheat gently about 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

name: CHOCOLATE SKILLET CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. cold water
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. shortening
3  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk or sour milk
1  tsp. vanilla
6  thin milk chocolate bars
preparation: Mix cocoa with cold water.  Sift flour with soda and salt. Cream shortening with sugar until fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, and beat thoroughly.  Add cocoa mixture and half the flour and blend.  Add milk and blend.  Add remaining flour and vanilla and blend.

name: FRICADELLEN
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef *
1  small onion, finely chopped
2  slices white bread
2  c. water
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. ground nutmeg
2  Tbsp. oil
1  jar (12 oz.) mushroom gravy plus 1/4 c. water
1 1/2  c. Original Minute rice
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Combine beef, onion, bread, 1/2 cup of the water, 1/2 teaspoon salt, pepper and nutmeg in large bowl; mix well.  Shape into 4 patties.  Cook patties in hot oil in large skillet until browned. Stir in gravy and 1/4 cup of water.  Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until cooked through.

name: CREAM CHEESE FROSTING
ingredients:
1  box confectioners sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese (at room temperature)
1  stick butter
1  c. pecans
preparation: Thoroughly mix together butter, cream cheese and sugar.  Stir in pecans and frost.

name: HAWAIIAN CHEESECAKE BARS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. soft cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1  c. butter
4  Tbsp. sugar
4  Tbsp. milk
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained
2  c. flaked coconut
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Combine flour, 1 cup sugar and butter until particles are fine and crumbly.  Pat into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until lightly browned around edges.  Cool slightly.  Blend cream cheese, 4 tablespoons sugar, milk and eggs; fold in vanilla and pineapple.  Spread over crust.  Combine melted butter and coconut for topping; sprinkle over filling.  Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes or until coconut is toasted and filling is set.  Cool.  Cut into bars.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1  stick melted butter or margarine
3  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients, beat well.  Pour into 2 small unbaked pie shells.  Bake 10 minutes at 275° then 50 minutes at 300°.

name: GERMAN SWEET CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Baker's German's sweet chocolate
1/2  c. boiling water
1  c. margarine
2  c. sugar
4  egg yolks, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. sifted cake flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
4  egg whites, stiffly beaten
preparation: Melt chocolate in 1/2 cup boiling water; cool.  Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating after each.  Add vanilla and chocolate; mix until blended.  Sift flour with soda and salt.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
10  to 12 saltine crackers
1  or 2 dashes Worcestershire sauce
1  medium onion, chopped
1  egg
1/4  stick margarine
1  stalk celery, chopped
1/4  c. milk
salt and fresh ground pepper to taste
small amount catsup (on top)
preparation: Mix all together; shape into loaf and put into baking dish. Pour about 1/8 cup of water over the top and place in preheated oven at 350°; bake, uncovered, approximately 45 minutes.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
3/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. flour
5  c. hot chicken stock
1  c. sliced carrots
3/4  c. sliced celery
4  c. peeled and diced potatoes
1/4  c. chopped parsley
1  c. heavy cream or half and half
1  tsp. seasoned salt or to taste
1/4  tsp. pepper or to taste
preparation: Melt butter in a large soup kettle.  Add onion and saute until soft.  Add flour and cook, stirring, for 3 or 4 minutes.  Remove from heat and slowly stir in hot chicken stock.  Add and simmer gently for about 10 minutes.  Add potatoes and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.  Add parsley, seasoned salt and pepper.  Stir in cream or half and half.  Makes about 8 cups or 6 to 8 servings.

name: ITALIAN BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can green beans
1  can wax beans
1  can kidney beans
1  can garbanzo beans
1/2  green pepper, diced
1  small onion (red)
1  clove garlic
bacon (optional)
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/3  c. oil
2/3  c. wine vinegar
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Marinate for 24 hours.  Drain and serve.

name: VEGETABLE, PORK AND BEEF SOUP
ingredients:
1  pkg. or less bacon
1  lb. or more hamburger
1 or 2  cans each vegetable: green beans, corn and tomatoes
carrots
potatoes (Idaho)
onion (small)
preparation: Cook bacon and hamburger in stew pot. Add water to cover vegetables and meat (green beans, diced potatoes, sliced carrots, whole kernel corn, onions, diced tomatoes).  These are canned, drained vegetables with exception of the tomatoes. Cook until flavors blend together. You want a lot of juice. Serve hot with hot sauce, if desired. Next day more vegetables can be added.

name: SESAME CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  lb. boneless, skinless chicken, cut into small pieces
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. cornstarch
2  eggs
5  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  cloves garlic
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sesame seed
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except chicken.  Add chicken; marinate for 2 hours or more.  Stir well.  Dip pieces into hot oil; deep fry until browned.

name: CANDY CAKES
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  c. peanut butter
8  oz. Hershey bar, melted
2  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
