preparation: Grease and flour a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan.  Combine and beat eggs, sugar, milk and vanilla extract.  Add the sifted flour, baking powder and salt; mix well for 2 minutes.  Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes in a preheated oven.  As soon as it's done, spread peanut butter on and cool.  Melt Hershey Bar in a double boiler and spread on top.

name: ANISETTE TOAST
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. anise flavoring
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
2  c. flour
egg wash
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add baking powder, vanilla and anise flavoring; blend all these.  Add sugar and oil; blend.  Add flour.  Mix all of these ingredients.

name: CHINESE EGG ROLLS (SHRIMP)
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/4  c. chopped bean sprouts
1  Tbsp. chopped green onion tops
1/2  tsp. monosodium glutamate
3-inch square commercial egg roll wrappers
1/4  c. chopped water chestnuts
1  c. chopped, cooked shrimp
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except egg roll wrappers.  Place 1 tablespoon shrimp mixture in center of each wrapper.  Roll up. Fold edges in.  Seal by dipping finger in water and moistening wrapper edges.  Fry in deep, hot fat for 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown.  Drain on paper towels.  Yields about 25 rolls.

name: INSTANT SORBET
ingredients:
3  to 4 large ripe bananas
1  tsp. lemon juice
4 to 6  Tbsp. apricot brandy
1  Tbsp. confectioners sugar or to taste (optional)
sprigs of fresh mint for garnish (optional)
preparation: Peel bananas, wrap tightly in plastic wrap and freeze for 4 to 6 hours or overnight.

name: CHILI STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
15  oz. can chili with beans
1/2  c. uncooked instant rice
1/4  c. taco sauce
2  Tbsp. water
1/2  c. shredded cheese (any kind)
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  or 3 medium sweet bell peppers
preparation: Cut a thin slice from stem of peppers and remove all seed and membranes.  Wash inside and outside of peppers and set aside.  In a bowl, mix all ingredients.  Stuff the peppers and stand peppers upright in an ungreased baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: INSTANT RUSSIAN TEA
ingredients:
2  c. Tang
1  pkg. lemonade mix
1 3/4  c. white sugar
1/2  c. instant tea
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Mix all the ingredients, mixing well.  Put in airtight container. When serving, use about 2 tablespoons per cup of hot water.

name: VANILLA HAZELNUT BISCOTTI
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
1  c. hazelnuts, coarsely chopped
1  egg white, lightly beaten
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°; lightly butter and flour large baking sheet.  In medium bowl, beat eggs with a fork until foamy.  Add vanilla.  Slowly add sugar and salt, mixing with a fork until blended.  Set aside.

name: STUFFED ZUCCHINI
ingredients:
1/2  lb. sausage
1/4  c. rice
1/2  c. mushroom soup
zucchini
preparation: Mix sausage with raw rice.  Hollow out zucchini.  Place in baking dish and stuff mixture in hollow.  Pour 1/2 cup mushroom soup on top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until sausage is done and zucchini tender.

name: CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
unbaked 9-inch single pie crust
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. nutmeg
2 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Beat eggs in large bowl.  Add sugar, salt, vanilla, nutmeg and milk and mix well.  Pour in unbaked pie crust.  Preheat oven to 425° and bake about 30 minutes or until a knife in center comes out clean.

name: HOLMES BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  qt. vinegar
2  cans tomato paste
1/2  green pepper
2  medium onions
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
6  bay leaves
6  lemons
1/4  lb. butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  stalks celery
salt and pepper
preparation: Cut up the celery and onions. Cut lemons in half.  Squeeze the juice but throw in the rind, too.  Add all the other ingredients in a big pot.  Bring to a fast boil.  Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Strain out and it is ready to go on your ribs or chicken.

name: SOUR CREAM BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. salt
2  medium bananas
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix in order given and bake in oven at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes.  Makes 2 medium size loaves.

name: ZIPPY CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  c. orange-apricot juice
1/2  c. maple syrup
1 1/2  lb. chicken wings
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients.  Arrange wings in shallow baking dish and pour liquid over all.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: SAUERKRAUT BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  can chopped sauerkraut, drained
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  egg
3/4  c. oatmeal
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Roll into small balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 25 minutes.  Makes about 5 1/2 dozen.

name: SCALLOPS AU GRATIN
ingredients:
1  lb. scallops
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. soft breadcrumbs
1  small green pepper
1  medium onion
2  ribs celery
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  c. light cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Butter a 1-quart baking dish.  In a medium saucepan, cover scallops with cold water; bring to a boil and drain as soon as water boils.  Do not overcook.  Melt 2 tablespoons of the butter and mix with the breadcrumbs.  Set aside.  Cut green pepper, onion and celery into chunks and saute in the remaining butter about 5 minutes.  Layer scallops, vegetables and crumbs in the baking dish, making 2 layers of each, ending with crumbs.  Season each layer with salt and pepper.  Pour the cream over the top and bake 30 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
3 to 4  c. soft bread crumbs
2  c. milk
1/4  c. butter
1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  Tbsp. instant coffee
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. toasted almonds
preparation: Place bread crumbs in a 1 1/2 quart baking dish.  Scald milk with butter and chocolate chips.  Add to the scalded milk mixture the instant coffee, sugar, eggs, salt and almonds.  Pour over bread crumbs in baking dish.  Place baking dish in pan of hot water and bake in a 350° oven 40 to 45 minutes.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. White Lily white self-rising corn meal
2  eggs or 4 egg whites
3/4  c. milk or skim
3/4 to 1  c. grated cheese or fat-free grated product
8  oz. cream-style corn
2  to 5 (1 fresh) jalapeno peppers, chopped
1  large white onion, chopped
3/4  c. oil or canola
preparation: Mix all ingredients, beginning with eggs.  Pour into a well-greased, hot iron skillet.  Bake at 450° for approximately 40 minutes.  Can be doubled or made fat-free/low cholesterol.

name: MAYONNAISE ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. mayo
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Combine all ingredients and cut out like biscuits.  Or shape rolls.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: OVEN BAKED CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1  c. corn meal
1  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix well.  Pour in well-oiled pan.  Bake in a 400° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. fresh peanuts
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
pinch of salt
1  tsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Combine peanuts, sugar, corn syrup and salt in 1 1/2-quart glass casserole.  Microwave on High for 7 to 8 minutes, stirring well after 4 minutes.  Add butter and vanilla to syrup, blending well.  Microwave on High for 1 to 2 minutes longer.  Peanuts will be lightly browned and syrup very hot.  Add soda.  Stir gently until light and foamy.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
24  oz. hash browns, thawed
1  medium onion, chopped
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/8  c. wheat germ
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Bake all ingredients at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BAKED APPLES
ingredients:
3  lb. apples
1/4  c. sugar
butter
cinnamon and nutmeg
1  c. water
preparation: Peel and core the apples.  Place in baking dish in layers. On each layer put apples, sugar, dot with butter and sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.  Add the water to the dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

name: ORANGE JULIUS
ingredients:
1/3  c. frozen orange juice
6  ice cubes
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Combine all ingredients into blender.  Blend until smooth.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/4  c. sour cream
1/4  c. hot taco sauce
preparation: Mix well and spread on plate.  Refrigerate until firm.  Layer chopped lettuce, onion, olives, tomatoes and green pepper.  Top with shredded Cheddar cheese.  Leave set in refrigerator overnight. Serve with taco chips.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. crunchy peanut butter
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. milk (add gradually)
1  regular size Cool Whip
1  regular or graham cracker crust
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients.  Fill crust.  Freeze in freezer. Thaw 1/2 hour before serving.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. fillet of beef, 1-inch thick
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  lb. mushrooms, sliced
1  c. beef broth
2  Tbsp. tomato paste
1/2  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Cut beef across grain into 1/4-inch slices.  Cut slices to make 2 x 1-inch pieces.  Sprinkle with pepper.  Sear meat in 2 tablespoons hot oil over medium-high heat, until browned; remove beef.  Saute onion until tender.  Add mushrooms; continue cooking until tender.  Add broth and tomato paste; stir until smooth. Blend in sour cream.  Add beef, along with any juices in bowl and parsley.  Bring sauce to a simmer; cook 5 minutes or until meat is heated through and sauce thickens.  Serve with noodles.

name: DOUBLY BUBBLY
ingredients:
2  qt. orange juice
1  qt. sparkling water or seltzer
2  pkg. frozen melon balls
1  pkg. frozen pitted dark cherries (no sugar added)
preparation: Combine all ingredients; add 1 tray of ice cubes.  Serves 20.

name: MOIST COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
2  c. coconut
3 1/2  c. or 1 (8 oz.) carton Cool Whip topping
preparation: Prepare  cake  according  to  directions.  Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan.  Cool	15  minutes,  then  poke holes in cake with fork.

name: CHILI NON CARNE
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  cloves garlic, minced
3  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. cumin
2  c. finely chopped zucchini
1  c. finely chopped carrots
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes, drained and chopped
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can tomatoes, drained and chopped
1 (15 oz.)  can kidney beans, undrained
2 (15 oz.)  cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed
preparation: In large pot, saute onion and garlic in oil until soft.  Mix in chili powder, basil, oregano and cumin.  Stir in zucchini and carrots until well blended.  Cook about 1 minute over low heat, stirring occasionally.  Stir in chopped tomatoes, undrained and drained kidney beans.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 30 to 45 minutes or until thick.  Top with chopped onion, tomatoes and lettuce or green peppers.  Makes 8 (1 cup) servings.  Contains 157 calories per serving.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
4  c. sweet potatoes, drained, cooked and mashed
1  stick margarine
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
3  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook and mash potatoes and add all other ingredients.  Pour into 2 pie shells (uncooked).  Bake at 350° about 30 to 40 minutes.  Makes 2 pies.

name: SLAW DRESSING
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. Miracle Whip
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mix for salad dressing (optional)
preparation: Whisk for 1 minute; let rest 5 minutes.  Whisk again about 1 minute.  Pour over grated cabbage.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans French-cut green beans
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can milk
1  can French fried onion rings
preparation: Combine beans, soup, milk and half of onion rings.  Pour into casserole dish.  Cover with remaining onion rings.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  c. grated zucchini
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  Tbsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
3  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
1 1/2  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well.  Bake in 2 greased bread loaf pans at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

name: CORNBREAD RING(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  c. yellow cornbread
1  c. unsifted all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  c. milk
1/2  c. cooking oil
1  can finely crushed French fried onions (3 oz.)
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: In large mixing bowl, stir together cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.  Add egg, milk and cooking oil.  Beat until smooth, about 1 minute.  Place onions and cheese in well-greased 8-inch ring mold.  Tilt to coat all sides, reserving excess crumbs.  Pour batter into ring mold and sprinkle with reserved crumbs.  Microwave at Medium-high (7) for 9 to 11 minutes, until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Turn out on cooling rack or serving plate.  Serve warm.

name: SHRIMP SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can shrimp
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. catsup
1  small grated onion
preparation: Stir all ingredients together and serve with crackers.

name: CHERRY-CHERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1 (18 oz.)  pkg. white cake mix
large box cherry jello
1  can cherry pie filling
whipped topping
preparation: Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Set aside. Preheat oven to 350°.   Prepare the white cake as per ingredients and directions on box.  Pour in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake as directed on box.  Remove from oven and let cool.  Make holes in cake 1-inch apart and 1-inch deep.  Mix the cherry jello in 1 cup boiling water until dissolved.  Add 1 cup cold water and mix well.  Pour jello into holes in cake.  Refrigerate until set.  Spread the can of cherry pie filling over cake evenly.  Cover with whipped topping.  Serve.

name: STEAK DIANE
ingredients:
4  (3/4 oz.) tenderloin steaks, cut 1/2-inch thick
salt to taste
fresh ground black pepper
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. minced shallots
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. fresh lemon
1  Tbsp. minced parsley
1  Tbsp. minced chives or green onions
preparation: Pound steaks to 1/4-inch thickness and sprinkle with salt and pepper on both sides.  Combine 2 tablespoons butter and mustard in electric skillet and cook over medium heat until sizzling.  Add steaks and shallots and fry one minute on each side, long enough to cook the surface and brown slightly.  Place steaks on warm dinner plates.  To the pan where steaks were cooked, add quickly 1 tablespoon butter, Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice and cook over high heat until syrupy.  Stir in parsley, chives or green onions.  Pour over steaks and serve immediately.  Makes 2 servings.

name: CHICKEN MARYLAND
ingredients:
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
salt to taste
ground pepper to taste
1/2  tsp. paprika
1 1/4  lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1 1/2  Tbsp. light margarine (stick form)
8  oz. canned cream-style corn
preparation: On shallow plate, combine flour, salt, pepper and paprika. Coat chicken breasts on both sides with flour mixture.  In large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, melt margarine.  Add chicken; cook 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until browned, turning once.  Reduce heat to medium-low.   Cook 10 minutes longer or until chicken is cooked through.   Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.  To drippings in skillet, add corn; stir well to incorporate pan drippings.  Season with salt, pepper and paprika to taste.  Serve chicken with corn sauce on side.

name: SPINACH BALLS
ingredients:
2  boxes frozen, chopped spinach
2  c. stuffing mix (herb seasoned), finely chopped
5  large beaten eggs
2  small chopped onions
1  Tbsp. Beau Monde
1/2  tsp. marjoram leaves
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
3/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Cook and drain spinach.  Mix all other ingredients with spinach.  Form into small balls the size of a walnut.  Spray cookie sheet with Pam.  Bake at 350° for 16 to 18 minutes.  May be frozen and warmed in the microwave.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. corn syrup
3  Tbsp. butter
dash of salt
preparation: Blend all together in pan, stir until boiling, then boil 3 minutes without stirring.

name: ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
18  egg whites
1  lb. sugar
1  lb. sifted flour
3/4  lb. butter
1  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift flour 3 times.  Add soda and cream of tartar.  Cream butter and sugar until very light and add to the stiffly beaten egg whites gradually.  Add the flour, beating it lightly.  Flavor with teaspoon of vanilla.  Place in angel food pan and bake in slow oven at about 250°.  Top with fresh fruit.

name: CHRISTMAS GIFT BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1  c. unbleached flour
3/4  c. wheat germ
1/2  c. dried milk powder
2  Tbsp. sesame seed
2  Tbsp. brown sugar, packed
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1 3/4  c. water
preparation: Combine the flours, wheat germ, dried milk powder, sesame seed, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.  Stir in the water well.  Butter four 1 pound shortening cans.  Pour in the batter.  Smooth tops.  Cover each tightly with foil.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes or until tops are golden brown.  Immediately remove bread from cans.  Cool on racks.

name: APRICOT ROLL
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) softened cream cheese
2  Tbsp. apricot jam
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. sugar
15  dried apricots, snipped in small pieces
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients very well.  Fold in apricots.  Form into a ball or log, then roll in ground nuts.  Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate until cold.  Best served with Triscuit wafers.

name: MACARONI AND VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. shell macaroni, cooked and drained
1 1/2  c. Colby cheese, cubed
2  c. (1-inch) broccoli pieces
1  c. cherry tomato halves
1  c. cucumber slices, cut in half
3/4  c. Italian dressing
preparation: Add all ingredients; toss lightly.  Refrigerate several hours or overnight.  Toss before serving.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: BAKED CHICKEN BREAST FILLET
ingredients:
1  chicken breast fillet for each serving desired
melted butter
cheese cracker crumbs (Twigs are good as sesame seed add extra flavor)
preparation: Wash and pat chicken dry.  Dip in melted butter; coat with cracker crumbs.  Place on baking dish or pan.  Pour any extra butter or crumbs over top.  Cover lightly with aluminum foil. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CORNBREAD SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. Mexican cornbread mix
1 (15 oz.)  can whole corn, drained
1  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1  1/2 tomatoes, chopped
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
4 or 5  slices cooked bacon, crumbled
3  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
1  tsp. Italian salad dressing
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Cook cornbread according to package directions.  Cool completely and crumble into a large bowl.  Add corn, onion, pepper, tomatoes, cheese, bacon and eggs.  Mix mayonnaise and salad dressing together in a small bowl.  Combine with other ingredients in the large bowl and refrigerate for about 2 hours.

name: CHICKEN ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
2  c. cooked diced chicken
3  stalks chopped celery
1  small onion, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  pkg. crescent rolls
1  box seasoned croutons
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. chicken broth
1  stick margarine
preparation: Mix together chicken, celery, onion and cream cheese.  Set aside.  Lay out the crescent rolls and spread them out gently with fingers.  Put about 1/4 cup mixture into each crescent.  Close each up and roll in melted butter and crushed croutons.  Bake at 375°. Turn them after 15 to 20 minutes and bake 15 to 20 more minutes until golden brown.

name: TRADITIONAL PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
6  eggs
1 (29 oz.)  can solid-pack pumpkin
2  c. packed brown sugar
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. each: ground cloves, nutmeg and ginger
2  c. evaporated milk (undiluted)
2  (9-inch) deep-dish unbaked pie shells
preparation: Beat eggs in a mixing bowl.  Add pumpkin, sugar, cinnamon, salt, cloves, nutmeg and ginger; beat just until smooth. Gradually stir in milk.  Pour into pie shells.  Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to 350°; bake 40 to 45 minutes longer or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.  Cool on wire racks.  Yield: 2 pies (6 to 8 servings each).

name: SANDWORKS
ingredients:
sand
water
bucket or hose
work area
preparation: Visit the beach or river shore.  Find wet sand.  Explore and create.

name: POLISH NOODLES AND CABBAGE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. chopped onion
4  c. chopped cabbage
1  tsp. caraway seed
18  oz. Kluski noodles, cooked and drained
1/2  c. sour cream (optional)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Melt butter in large skillet; add onion and saute until soft. Add cabbage and saute until crisp and tender.  Stir in caraway seed, salt and pepper.  Stir noodles into cabbage mixture.  Add sour cream, if desired.  Cook 5 minutes longer.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. sour cream
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  small cream cheese, softened
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Chill and serve with fruit wedges.

name: SWEET POTATO BISCUITS
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. mashed sweet potatoes
3  c. flour
preparation: Work sugar, salt and shortening into potatoes.  Work in 2 1/2 cups of flour.  Reserve 1/2 cup flour to pat out biscuits.  Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: INDIAN FRY BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  Tbsp. salt
3  tsp. vanilla
5  Tbsp. baking powder
milk (as needed)
preparation: Add all ingredients in large bowl. Gradually add milk until you form a doughy substance. Knead for 5 minutes. Let stand for 30 minutes.

name: 1-2-3 CAKE
ingredients:
any box cake mix
1  can any fruit pie filling (except blueberry)
3  eggs
preparation: Add all the ingredients together and bake in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: FABULOUS CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  lb. creamed Ricotta cheese
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs, slightly beaten
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  lb. butter or margarine, melted
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Grease 9-inch spring-form pan.  In larger mixer bowl, at high speed, beat cream cheese with Ricotta cheese until creamy and well combined.  Gradually beat in sugar, then eggs until well combined. At low speed, beat in cornstarch, flour, lemon juice and vanilla. Add melted butter and sour cream.  Beat until just smooth.  Pour into prepared pan.

name: FROGMORE STEW
ingredients:
1/4  c. Old Bay seasoning
4  lb. small red potatoes
2  lb. kielbasa or hot, smoked link sauce, cut into 1 1/2-inch slices
6  ears fresh corn, halved
4  lb. unpeeled, large fresh shrimp
additional Old Bay seasoning
commercial cocktail sauce
preparation: Fill large container of a propane cooker halfway with water; add 1/4 cup Old Bay seasoning.  Bring to a boil, following manufacturer's instructions.  Add potatoes, return to a boil and cook 10 minutes.  Add sausage and corn; return to a boil and cook 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender.  Add shrimp; cook 3 to 5 minutes or until shrimp turns pink.  Remove with a slotted spoon onto a serving platter or newspaper-lined table.  Serve with additional Old Bay seasoning and cocktail sauce.  Yields 12 servings.

name: QUICK 'N EASY POTATO DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  c. leftover mashed potatoes
1  c. flour
1  egg
salt and pepper to taste
butter
onions, sliced or diced
preparation: Mix  mashed  potatoes,	flour,	egg, salt and pepper to form a soft  dough.  Shape  into a rope and cut into 1/2-inch pieces. Drop  into boiling water and remove when pieces float to top.  Fry in butter with onions and serve.

name: CAESAR SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. olive oil
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  garlic clove, minced
2  drops Tabasco
2/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
romaine lettuce
onion croutons
preparation: Cut up lettuce.  Sprinkle cheese over lettuce.  Combine rest of ingredients except croutons; pour over lettuce.  Add croutons.

name: FUDGY BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  squares unsweetened chocolate
1/3  c. butter
2/3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. sat
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt chocolate with butter in saucepan over very low heat, stirring constantly until smooth.  Remove from heat.  Mix flour, salt and baking powder.  Beat eggs thoroughly; gradually beat in sugar.  Blend in chocolate mixture and vanilla.  Add flour mixture, stir well.  Stir in nuts.  Spread in greased 8-inch square pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes (moist chewy brownies). Cool in pan.  Cut into squares or bars.  Makes about 20.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. zucchini, grated (with rind)
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
1  c. raisins
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix eggs, sugar and oil in bowl and beat. Sift flour, baking soda and spices. Add remaining ingredients, except sour cream. Make sure zucchini is well blended. Finally, fold in the sour cream. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until a toothpick pierced into the center of the bread comes out clean.

name: ROASTED RED POTATOES
ingredients:
6  Red Potatoes
1/2  stick butter
green onions and chives
bacon bits
lemon pepper (to taste)
seasoned salt (to taste)
garlic powder (to taste)
sour cream
shredded cheddar cheese
preparation: Wash potatoes and cut into quarters.  Place in medium size roasting pan.  Slice butter over potatoes.  Add spices to your taste.  Top with chopped garden onions and chives and baking bits. Bake in oven at 375 degrees for 35 minutes.  When finished top with shredded cheese and serve with sour cream.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick butter, melted
1  medium onion, chopped
1  lb. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  carton (8 oz.) sour cream
1  can (10 3/4 oz.) cream of mushroom soup
1  large bag Tater Tots
preparation: Saute onion in butter.  Mix together cheese, sour cream and soup.  Coat Tater Tots with cheese mixture, then add butter and onions.  You may save some cheese to sprinkle over the top of casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.  Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. sifted self-rising flour
1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. shortening
2  pkg. yeast, dissolved in 1/4 c. warm water
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Combine flour, soda and sugar; cut in shortening and stir in yeast and buttermilk.  Be sure to mix well.  Keep covered in refrigerator for at least an hour or two before using (this is important to the success of the recipe).  Roll out and cut as desired.  Place on greased pan.  Let rise for 2 hours.  Bake at 450° for about 10 minutes.

name: CROCK-POT BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. dry, small beans (white or pink)
2 ham hocks or 1/2  lb. bacon, cut in 2-inch pieces
1/4  c. catsup
1/4  c. prepared mustard
1/4  c. brown sugar or molasses
1/2  c. salsa
1  can beer
1  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a crock-pot.  Cover with water; cook slowly all day.  Add water if necessary.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: BAKED FLOUNDER WITH POTATOES
ingredients:
1  flounder (4 to 5 lb.), cleaned
1  onion
salt and pepper
6  potatoes, peeled and sliced
6  bacon strips
preparation: Wash flounder and place in baking pan.  Slice potatoes and onion and place on  top of flounder.  Salt and pepper to  taste. Place bacon strips on top of fish and potatoes.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° approximately 1 1/2 hours or until fish is flaky.

name: HARVEY WALLBANGER CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
4  eggs
1  c. oil
3/4  c. orange juice
1/4  c. Galliano
1/4  c. vodka
preparation: Grease and flour fluted Bundt pan.  Set oven to 350°.  Mix altogether; bake 55 minutes or more until cake springs back on top.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar when cool.

name: DIP FOR VEGETABLES
ingredients:
2/3  c. sour cream
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. dill weed
1  Tbsp. parsley
1/4  c. bacon bits
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: GINGER ALE SALAD
ingredients:
lemon jello
2  tsp. chopped ginger, divided
boiling water
3/4  c. ginger ale
grapes
1  sectioned grapefruit
1  sectioned orange
preparation: Place the jello in bowl with about 1 teaspoon chopped ginger. Pour boiling water over and stir.  Let stand about 5 minutes, then add the ginger ale.  Place in refrigerator until like maple syrup (about 45 to 60 minutes).  Place the grapes, grapefruit and orange in lightly oiled pan.  Sprinkle with about 1 teaspoon chopped ginger.  Lastly, pour jello over fruit and chill.  Serves 6.

name: EASY CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  can refrigerated biscuits
2  cans chicken broth
2  cans water
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  can water
12 1/2  oz. can chicken chunks
dash of black pepper (optional)
preparation: Combine chicken broth and 2 cans water in Dutch oven.  Bring to a boil. Add biscuits, halved or quartered, to broth. Drop biscuits slowly. Reduce heat slightly.  Add black pepper to taste preference.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine
2  eggs
3  very ripe mashed bananas
2  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. soda
1  c. nuts
preparation: Cream sugar and margarine, add eggs, beat well.  Add bananas, flour, soda and nuts.  Bake in greased loaf pan at 300° for 1 hour.

name: QUICK SPAGHETTI BAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
2  c. Ragu Homestyle spaghetti sauce
1  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. chili powder
6  oz. can drained mushrooms
6  oz. sour cream
6  green onions, chopped
3  oz. pkg. cream cheese
7  oz. box spaghetti
grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown meat; drain. Add spaghetti sauce, sugar, salt, chili powder and mushrooms. Cook spaghetti and drain. Mix sour cream, onions and softened cream cheese. In casserole, layer spaghetti, meat mixture and sour cream mixture, ending with spaghetti. Sprinkle cheese generously on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Freezes well. Serves 8.

name: CORNBREAD SKILLET CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  eggs, slightly beaten
2  tsp. baking soda
1 (17 oz.)  can creamed corn
1/4  c. vegetable oil
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  to 3 jalapeno peppers, chopped
1  c. yellow corn meal
1  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
preparation: Combine the first 7 ingredients in bowl; set aside.  Cook beef until browned; drain well and set aside.  Pour half of cornmeal mixture into greased 10-inch skillet.  Sprinkle evenly with beef. Top with cheese, onion and peppers.  Pour remaining batter over top.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.  Serves 6.

name: BARBECUE SMOKED SAUSAGE
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can tomato soup
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white vinegar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. onion powder
1  tsp. allspice
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/8  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1  lb. smoked sausage
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except sausage, in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil over medium heat.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Cut each sausage link every 2-inches with diagonal slits halfway through sausage. Place in 400° oven for 20 minutes or on grill until done.  Baste with barbecue sauce often.  Add remaining sauce before serving.

name: TURKEY TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
1/4  lb. mushrooms
1  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  c. turkey broth or 1 (14 1/2 oz.) can chicken broth
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  tsp. basil
1/2  lb. thin spaghetti
1/2  c. cubed leftover turkey
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Put 2 quarts salted water on to boil spaghetti.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Wash and slice mushrooms.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising corn meal
1  c. cream-style corn
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1 small  jar pimento
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. Wesson oil
2  eggs
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for approximately 30 to 45 minutes.

name: LIME SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  box or 2 small boxes lime jello
3  c. boiling water
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese (room temperature)
1  c. pecans, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, most of juice drained
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Mix jello and boiling water; let set in refrigerator until it starts to congeal.  Beat cream cheese until fluffy.  Add pecans. Mix in pineapple and Cool Whip.  Spread evenly in container; refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: VEGETABLE-BEEF SOUP WITH TINY DUMPLINGS(Gaisburger Marsch; Makes 4 Servings)
ingredients:
1  lb. boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes
1  lb. beef marrow bones, sawed, not chopped, into 1-inch pieces
2  qt. cold water
1  large onion, peeled and pierced with 2 whole cloves
1  bay leaf
1  tsp. salt
freshly ground black pepper
1  c. celery root, peeled and diced
1/2  c. carrots, scraped and diced
1/2  c. parsnips, scraped and diced
1  c. coarsely diced leeks, including 2-inches of green top
2 1/2  c. potatoes, diced
1  recipe Tiny Dumplings
1  Tbsp. finely chopped parsley
preparation: In a heavy 6-quart flame-proof casserole or soup pot, bring the beef, bones and water to a boil over high heat, skimming off the foam and scum as they rise to the surface.   Reduce the heat to the lowest point.  Add the onion pierced with cloves, bay leaf, salt and a few grindings of pepper and simmer, partially covered, for 1 1/2 hours, skimming whenever needed.  Then remove the onion and bay leaf.  Discard and transfer the bones to a plate.  With a small spoon or the tip of a knife, scoop out the marrow from the bones.  Add it to the soup and discard the bones.  Add the celery root, carrots, parsnips, leeks and potatoes and simmer, undisturbed, for 30 minutes or until the vegetables and meat are tender.  Stir the Tiny Dumplings into the simmering soup and cook for 1 or 2 minutes longer to heat through.  Add the parsley; taste for seasoning and serve either from a large heated tureen or in individual soup bowls.

name: BROWNIES ALA ANNIE
ingredients:
1  box Betty Crocker fudge brownies family size (21.5 oz.)
ingredients on box
1/2  c. chocolate chips
2 heaping  Tbsp. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and follow instructions on box. Don't worry about putting mayonnaise in brownies.  It  may sound strange but it's good.  Don't believe me, do you?  Well, fine. Make them and bring them to me.  I'll eat them.  Makes 10 to 12 big pieces.

name: SWEET AND SOUR SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1/4  c. water
2  lb. sausage
1 1/4  c. catsup
1/4  c. packed dark brown sugar
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, drained
preparation: Shape sausage into 1-inch balls and brown over medium heat in a large, deep skillet.  Drain on paper towels.  Remove all grease from skillet.  Add catsup, brown sugar, soy sauce, lemon juice and water.  Simmer, covered, for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add pineapple chunks.  Simmer, covered, until heated thoroughly. Serves 6.

name: SNACK CRACKERS
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  box oyster crackers
1 (12 oz.)  box Georgia crackers (Cajun flavored)
1/2  c. salad oil
2  pkg. Hidden Valley salad dressing mix (original)
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. lemon pepper
1/2  tsp. dill seed
preparation: Heat oil and mix, coating crackers, then add dry ingredients; mix well.

name: HAM AND BLACK-EYED PEAS
ingredients:
1  lb. dried black-eyed peas
1  (4 1/2 lb.) ham
1  medium onion
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  c. water
2  c. uncooked rice
preparation: Soak peas overnight in water.  Drain.  Combine all ingredients, except rice, in 6 quart pressure cooker.  Secure lid. Cook at 15 pounds of pressure for 35 minutes.  Remove pressure, then remove lid.  Place ham on carving board, trim fat; slice.

name: SWISS BACON PLEASERS
ingredients:
1  pkg. crescent rolls
4  slices natural Swiss cheese
3  eggs, slightly beaten
3/4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. minced onion
4  slices bacon, fried and crumbled
preparation: Separate dinner rolls into triangles.  Press into 9 x 13-inch pan (well-greased).  Place cheese over top of dough.  Combine eggs, milk and onion and pour over cheese.  Sprinkle with bacon and parsley flakes.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes.  Cool 5 minutes; cut into squares.

name: AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can chunk pineapple in juice or syrup
1 (11 oz.)  can Mandarin orange segments
1 1/2  c. seedless grapes
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. flaked coconut
1/2  c. nuts
3/4  c. dairy sour cream
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Drain pineapple and oranges.  Combine pineapple, oranges, grapes, marshmallows, coconut and nuts.  Mix sour cream and sugar. Stir into fruit mixture.  Chill.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
1 to 2  cans apple pie filling (cherry or blueberry can be substituted)
1  box Jiffy cake mix
4  Tbsp. margarine or butter
preparation: Coat bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Spread out pie filling to cover bottom about 1/2 to 3/4 inches thick.  Spread box of cake mix over pie filling.  Melt margarine/butter and drizzle over cake mix.  Bake at 350° for approximately 1/2 hour or until golden brown.  Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

name: CHEESY APPLE HAM GRILL
ingredients:
1  c. chopped apple
1/2  c. Miracle Whip dressing, divided
1/4  c. chopped walnuts
dash of ground cloves (optional)
8  slices raisin cinnamon bread
4  slices Kraft natural sharp Cheddar cheese, cut in half
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Oscar Mayer smoked, cooked ham slices
preparation: Mix apple, 1/3 cup of the dressing, walnuts and cloves.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  potatoes, sliced thin
2  carrots, sliced thin
2  onions, sliced thin
1  small stalk celery, cut fine
1  can green peas, drain and save juice
1  lb. hamburger, brown and pour off grease
preparation: Grease 3-quart casserole.  Alternate vegetables in casserole; salt and pepper each layer.  Put hamburger on top of vegetables. Mix juice with one can tomato soup and pour top of casserole.  Cook in 350° oven for two hours.

name: SAUERKRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
1  qt. kraut, washed
2  c. celery, diced fine
1  green bell pepper
1  large onion, diced fine
1 small  jar pimento, diced
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar (for a very sweet salad; I use 1 c.)
1/2  c. white vinegar
1/4  c. Mazola oil
preparation: I use  a  combination of different colored bell peppers if you don't want to use the pimento.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 to 9 oz.)  pkg. Mexican cornbread mix
1  can chopped green chilies
1  pkg. dry ranch dressing mix
8  oz. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
2  cans pinto beans, drained
1  c. chopped bell pepper
2  cans corn, drained
3  large tomatoes, chopped
10  slices bacon, fried and crumbled
8  oz. cheddar cheese, shredded
1  c. green onions, chopped
1  head lettuce, chopped
Ranch dressing
preparation: Prepare cornbread and add green chilies to batter, bake according to package directions. Make ranch dressing with dressing mix, sour cream and mayonnaise; set aside. Layer lettuce, crumbled cornbread, beans, bell pepper, corn, bacon and green onion in a large bowl. Repeat layers. Top with cheese and tomatoes. Serve with ranch dressing.

name: MAGIC COOKIE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened milk
1  (6 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can flaked coconut
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt butter.  Sprinkle crumbs over butter.  Pour sweetened milk evenly over crumbs.  Top evenly with remaining ingredients.   Press down gently.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.   Cool thoroughly before cutting.  Store loosely covered at room temperature.

name: KID'S FAVORITE FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
8  slices bread
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
butter for frying
preparation: Beat together milk and eggs.  Add salt and vanilla.  Dip bread into mixture until soaked.  Fry in butter on both sides until golden brown.  Serve with maple syrup or jam.

name: RECIPE SECRETS OVEN ROASTED VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets savory herb with garlic or Recipe Secrets onion soup mix
1 1/2  lb. assorted fresh vegetables
2  Tbsp. olive or vegetable oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  In plastic bag or bowl, shake or toss all ingredients  until vegetables are coated.  Empty into a 13 x 9-inch baking or roasting pan; discard bag.  Bake, stirring once, for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.  Makes 4 (1/2 cup) servings.

name: BEEF POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  (3 to 4 lb.) beef roast
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (1.25 oz.)  envelope dry onion soup mix
pepper to taste
preparation: Put half the can of undiluted soup on a double piece of aluminum foil large enough to wrap completely around roast.   Over the soup, sprinkle half the envelope of soup mix.  Place roast on top and cover with remaining soup, sprinkled with remaining onion soup mix.  Wrap roast completely in foil and place in shallow pan. Bake at 300° for 1 hour per pound.  This makes a delicious roast and gravy all in one.

name: CISSY'S GREAT EGG DISH
ingredients:
8  pieces bread, crust off and cubed
2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
2  lb. mild sausage, cooked
5  eggs, beaten
2 1/2  c. milk
3/4  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Place bread in buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.  Sprinkle cheese on bread.  Crumble sausage over cheese.  Beat eggs with milk and dry mustard.  Pour over all.  Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. broken pretzels
3/4  c. melted butter
3 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
8  oz. softened cream cheese
1  c. sugar
9  oz. Cool Whip
9  oz. strawberry Jell-O
3  c. boiling water
3 (10 oz.)  boxes frozen strawberries, thawed
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, pressing into the dish.  Bake at 350° for 5 minutes; cool.

name: OVERNIGHT RANCH ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. salad oil
1  Tbsp. salt
4  c. boiling water
10  c. flour
3  beaten eggs
1  pkg. yeast
preparation: 2:00 p.m.:  Put sugar, salad oil and salt in large bowl.  Add boiling water and stir until sugar is dissolved.  Let cool to lukewarm.  Add 5 cups flour and stir well.  Add 3 eggs and yeast (does not need to be dissolved).  Add 5 or more cups of flour until dough kneads into soft ball.  Cover with bowl with lid.  Let raise until 6:00 p.m.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH PIE
ingredients:
3  c. brown sugar
4  Tbsp. flour
3  c. sweet milk
4  egg yolks
4  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix ingredients together in medium size pan and bring to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens. Pour into prebaked pie shells.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
3  cans Hungry Jack biscuits, quartered
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. brown sugar
1  stick margarine
1  c. pecans
preparation: Shake quarters in sugar and cinnamon mixture.  Drop into Bundt pan.  Mix brown sugar, margarine and pecans; pour over sugar and cinnamon quarters mixture.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: CANDY CORN(Snack)
ingredients:
2  c. dark brown sugar
1/2  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  lb. lower fat margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Pop the corn and place in a large cake pan. Boil together sugar, Karo and margarine for 5 minutes.  Add vanilla, salt and soda.  Pour over popped corn and mix thoroughly.  Bake at 250° for 1 hour.  Stir every 15 minutes.

name: TUNA SALAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. Quaker oats (quick or old fashioned; uncooked)
1 (7 oz.)  can tuna, drained and flaked
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. milk
3  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. sweet pickle relish
preparation: Toast oats in large, shallow pan at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Combine with remaining ingredients.  Mix well and chill.

name: COCONUT CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  tsp. butter
3  eggs, lightly beaten
1 large  can evaporated milk
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  can flaked coconut
1  unbaked pie shell (deep pan)
preparation: Combine sugar and cornstarch in a bowl.  Add butter; cream well.  Add eggs, milk and vanilla; mix well.  Fold in coconut. Pour into pie crust.  Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

name: DUTCH POTATO FILLING
ingredients:
2  chicken bouillon cubes
1/2  c. hot water
4  c. mashed potatoes
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/3  c. minced parsley
preparation: Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot water.  Place mashed potatoes in large bowl.  Add slightly beaten eggs, bouillon cube mixture, onion, salt, pepper and parsley; blend well.  Place in a 1-quart greased casserole.  Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven with chicken, or until browned on top.

name: HOLIDAY MACARONI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked macaroni
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. milk
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. finely chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1/4  tsp. black pepper
2  c. diced chicken, turkey or ham
preparation: Prepare macaroni according to package directions and drain. Combine milk, soup and cheese and simmer until cheese is melted. Mix macaroni, cheese sauce, onion, green and black pepper.  Pour into 1 1/2 quart casserole dish and bake in 325° oven for 30 minutes or 6 to 8 minutes in microwave.

name: AUNT EM'S SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  can tomato sauce
1  grated onion
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1/3  c. catsup
1  tsp. salt
red pepper
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
dash of Worcestershire sauce
2  c. oil
dry mustard
preparation: Mix well and serve.

name: FRIED RICE
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. vegetable oil
3  eggs, beaten
dash of salt
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  lb. mushrooms
3  c. cooked, cold rice
soy sauce to taste
preparation: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in skillet.  Add eggs and salt.  Fry until firm.  Remove to plate.  Cut into strips and reserve.  Heat remaining 5 tablespoons of oil in skillet.  Add onion and mushrooms.  Saute just until tender and crisp.  Add rice.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until heated through.  Stir in soy sauce and eggs.   Taste.   Add more soy sauce, if desired.

name: PIE CRUST
ingredients:
4 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
2  c. (1 lb.) lard
1  egg
1/2  c. water
2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Cut lard into flour and baking powder.  Beat 1 egg.  Add 1/2 cup water and 2 teaspoons lemon juice; add to flour/lard mixture. This will keep in icebox for several weeks.  Makes 3 double crust pies.

name: CHICKEN CORDON BLUE
ingredients:
6  medium whole chicken breasts, skinned and boneless
6  Swiss cheese slices
6 thin  slices ham
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. whipped cream
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. paprika
6  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. dry white wine
1  cube chicken bouillon
preparation: Take one piece of chicken, ham and cheese in order; roll up and close with toothpick.  Coat in mixture of flour and paprika. Cook in butter until brown.   Add wine and bouillon cube.  Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.  Remove chicken from skillet (remove toothpick).   Blend cornstarch and cream in skillet; stir until smooth and thick.   Pour over chicken on platter and serve hot.

name: GRANNY'S PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2 1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1  c. sugar
1  c. Golden Eagle syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
preparation: Beat eggs and add butter, sugar, syrup and vanilla.  Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell; sprinkle pecans over filling.  Bake in a 350° oven approximately 40 minutes.  Makes 2 pies.

name: STEAK SEASONING
ingredients:
A-1 Sauce
garlic salt
seasoning salt
onion salt
imitation butter salt
lemon and pepper seasoning
broil steak seasoning
pepper
preparation: Mix all the ingredients together. Stick holes in the steaks. Pour ingredients over steaks. Melt some butter and worcestershire sauce, pour these over steaks too. Turn steaks every 5 minutes.

name: CRAWFISH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
1/2  c. chopped onions
2/3  c. green peppers, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
4  slices bread or 1 c. crumbs
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. crawfish tails
2  c. cooked rice
1  tsp. parsley
1  tsp. red pepper
preparation: Saute vegetables in margarine.  Mix vegetables, crawfish, soup, rice and seasonings well.  Place in a 2 or 3-quart casserole.  Top with seasoned crumbs.  Bake at 350° about 30 minutes.  Sometimes, instead of bread crumbs, I use Durkee fried onions on top.

name: SOMEBODY ELSE'S FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans apricot halves
2 (15 oz.)  cans pineapple chunks
3  bananas, chopped
1/2  c. maraschino cherries, halved
2 regular size  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
preparation: Drain canned fruit, reserve juice.  Add small portion of reserved juice to the mix; stir, then add remaining juice.  Pour over combined fruit.  Chill.  Salad is more flavorful if prepared several hours before serving.

name: GOLDEN LEMON CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (1 lb.)
1  egg, beaten
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
3  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1  envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets herb and lemon soup mix
1  c. water
4  lemon slices
preparation: Dip chicken in egg, then flour.  In skillet, melt butter and brown chicken 4 minutes, turning once.  Stir in golden herb with lemon soup mix, blended with water.  Arrange lemon on chicken. Bring to a boil.  Simmer, covered, 10 minutes or until chicken is done.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BEEF MACARONI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, chopped
1  Tbsp. paprika
2 (8 oz.)  cans Hunt's tomato sauce
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. (8 oz.) sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  box macaroni
preparation: Brown beef; add onion and garlic.  Add other ingredients. Turn into 2-quart casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serves 4.  Prep time:  40 minutes.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  c. apples, chopped
3  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
sprinkle of cinnamon
preparation: Beat oil, sugar and eggs for 3 minutes with mixer on medium speed.  Add flour and vanilla and mix.  Fold in apples and nuts. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.  Do not open door while cooking.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES(With Cream Filling)
ingredients:
2  c. butter
2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
4  eggs
3  c. sifted plain flour
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
6  c. quick cook oatmeal
preparation: Cream butter and both sugars until white and fluffy.  Stir in vanilla.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Sift flour, salt and soda together; add to mixture.  Stir in oatmeal.  Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: FROZEN NEAPOLITAN DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. frozen pound cake
1  pt. Neapolitan brick ice cream
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  pkg. frozen whipped topping, thawed
14  pecan halves
8  maraschino cherries
preparation: Cut pound cake lengthwise into 2 equal layers.  Place one layer on an 18-inch square sheet of heavy-duty Reynolds Wrap.  Cut ice cream brick lengthwise into 2 equal slices and place on cake layer.  Top with second cake layer.  Frost top and sides with whipped topping.  Decorate with pecans and cherries.  Place on foil in freezer for about 2 hours.  Remove from freezer.  Bring foil up; double fold over top and fold in ends.  Return to freezer until ready to serve.

name: RAINBOW JELLO
ingredients:
4  small Jell-O (orange, green, yellow and red)
1  c. hot water (for each box Jell-O)
1/2  c. cold water (for each box Jell-O)
2  envelopes Knox gelatine
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
2  c. sour cream
1  pt. half and half
preparation: Mix 1 box Jell-O with 1 cup hot water until dissolved.  Add 1/2 cup cold water.  Pour into glass 9 x 13-inch dish. Refrigerate until set.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (9 oz.)  cans green beans
3/4  c. milk
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can Durkee French fried onions
preparation: Combine all ingredients except 1/2 can of French fried onions. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.  Top with remaining onions and bake uncovered 5 minutes or until golden.

name: SHRIMP VICTORIA
ingredients:
1  small onion
1 (8 oz.)  carton mushrooms
1/2  c. butter
1  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of red pepper
1 1/2  c. sour cream
2  pt. shrimp, cleaned and deveined
1 1/2  c. rice, cooked
preparation: Saute onion in butter until soft; add mushrooms. Cook about 5 minutes.  Add shrimp, salt and red pepper; cook until shrimp are tender. Add flour and let thicken. When ready to serve, add sour cream and heat.  Do not boil.  Serve over rice.

name: PEANUT BUTTER DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/4  lb. butter
2/3  c. chopped, dry, roasted nuts
preparation: Mix and press into 9 x 13 pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Let cool.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. thin spaghetti, cooked according to pkg. directions)
1  c. fresh vegetables, finely chopped (celery, green pepper, carrots, broccoli, etc. whatever is in the refrigerator is fine)
2  Tbsp. poppy seed
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1 (16 oz.)  bottle Kraft Italian house dressing
3  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Pour dressing and vinegar over the other ingredients. Mix thoroughly and refrigerate at least 4 hours. Mix before serving.

name: SCALLOPED BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli cuts
1  c. wide egg noodles
1  (10 3/4 oz.) condensed Cheddar cheese soup
1/3  c. milk
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  small chopped onion
1  Tbsp. butter
2 1/2  oz. sliced mushrooms, drained
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Cook broccoli and noodles according to package directions.  Drain.  Saute onions with butter until tender.  In a greased 1 1/2 quart casserole mix in onions.  Stir in broccoli, noodles, cheese, pepper and mushrooms.  Combine crumbs with melted butter; sprinkle over broccoli mixture.  Bake covered for 15 minutes, then take cover off.   Bake 20 minutes more.

name: SAUSAGE GRAVY
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk pork sausage
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
6  Tbsp. flour
1  qt. milk
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Crumble sausage into large saucepan; cook over medium-low heat.  Add onion; cook and stir until transparent.  Drain, discarding all but 2 tablespoons of drippings.  Stir in flour; cook over medium-low heat about 6 minutes or until mixture bubbles and turns golden.  Stir in milk.  Add seasonings and cook, stirring until thickened.  Serve over sliced biscuits.

name: OLD-FASHIONED SUGAR CAKES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
5  c. flour
5  tsp. baking powder
1  c. melted butter
3  eggs
1  c. milk or cream
1  tsp. lemon
preparation: Sift together the first 3 ingredients.  Add butter and mix. Beat in the eggs, milk and lemon.  Add to dry mixture and blend well.  Drop by full teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375°.

name: BANANA SPLIT PIE
ingredients:
3  bananas
2  small graham cracker crusts
16 oz  can crushed pineapple, drained
8  oz cool whip
8  oz cream cheese
1/2  cup sugar
cherries
pecans, chopped
preparation: Mix cream cheese, sugar and cool whip.  Put into bottom of pie crust.  Spread pineapple over mixture, add sliced bananas, sprinkle pecans over all and top with cherries.  Chill and serve.

name: LEMON CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  eggs
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  (9-inch) pie shell
preparation: Beat margarine and sugar until smooth.  Add other ingredients and mix well.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake 45 to 50 minutes in preheated 350° oven.

name: BEEF DIP
ingredients:
2  cans beef and gravy, mashed
1  jar Ortega salsa (mild)
1  pkg. Lawry's taco mix
1  brick Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake until cheese melts at 350° for 20 minutes.  Serve with chips.

name: WHIPPED CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
deep-dish unbaked pie shell
1 1/2  c. low-fat cottage cheese
3  eggs, separated
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. light cream
nutmeg
preparation: Beat egg whites until foamy.  Add 1/4 cup sugar slowly and keep beating until stiff.  In separate bowl, beat cheese until smooth; add yolks.  Beat well.  Mix flour, salt and remaining sugar; add to mixture with vanilla.  Pour into unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle top generously with nutmeg.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then at 350° for 30 minutes.  Cool and chill.  Keep refrigerated.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. oil
4  eggs
2  c. flour
1 1/2  Tbsp. baking soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. grated carrots
8  oz. can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. golden raisins
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. margarine
8  oz. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
1  lb. confectioners sugar
preparation: Combine butter, cheese and vanilla.  Cream well.  Add sugar gradually, beating well.

name: CURRIED CHICKEN(Old Recipe Made Easy)
ingredients:
1  can each: cream of mushroom soup, cream of celery soup and cream of chicken soup
1  c. raw rice
salt and pepper
1  tsp. curry powder
chicken breasts (boneless and skinless, equivalent to 1 whole chicken)
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake for 3 hours at 275°.

name: HONEY-APPLE PANCAKES
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. baking soda
1  beaten egg
3/4  c. apple juice
2  Tbsp. honey
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
preparation: In a bowl, mix the first 5 ingredients.  In another bowl, mix the remaining ingredients.  Add the liquid mixture to the flour mixture, blending until slightly lumpy.

name: GROUND BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  medium onions, chopped
garlic powder to taste
1  can mushroom soup
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. beef bouillon
1 small  can tomato sauce
1 1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion, drain.  Add salt, pepper and garlic salt.  Add mushroom soup, bouillon, tomato sauce and sour cream.  Cook until sour cream is hot.  Serve over cooked broad noodles.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
10  chicken thighs
flour
oleo
oil
1  rib celery
2  medium onions
1 small  box frozen peas and corn, uncooked
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/3 to 1/2  c. milk
sweet paprika
preparation: Flour chicken thighs.  Brown in small amount of oleo and oil. Arrange in casserole.  In same pan saute onions and celery. Sprinkle over chicken the onions and celery and peas and corn.  Mix soups and milk.  Pour this mixture over chicken.  Sprinkle with sweet paprika.  Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: HALIBUT CADDY GANTY
ingredients:
3  lb. halibut fillets
dry white wine
fine dry bread crumbs
2  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. finely chopped onion
paprika
preparation: Cut halibut  in  serving  sized  pieces and marinate in wine for 2 hours.  Drain and pat dry.  Roll them each in bread crumbs. Place them in  a  single  layer in a baking dish that can be brought to	the table.  Mix together sour cream, mayonnaise and onion.  Spread  this  sauce over the fish, smoothing it out to the edges  of  pan.  Sprinkle  the top with paprika. Bake at 500° for 15	to  20	minutes  or until light brown and bubbly.  Serve immediately.

name: SCRIPTURE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. Jeremiah 6:20
1 1/2  c. Genesis 18:8
6  Jeremiah 17:11 (not partridges!)
1  c. Judges 4:19
1/2  c. Judges 5:25
1  Tbsp. Luke 24:42
1  c. Nahum 3:12
1  c. Samuel 30:12
1  c. Numbers 17:8
4 1/2  c. Exodus 29:2
1/4  tsp. Leviticus 2:13
1 1/2  tsp. 1 Kings 10:15
2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Combine as any other cake mixture.  Bake in moderate (350°) oven for approximately 1 hour.  Where different ingredients are mentioned in the same verse, use common cooking sense.  King James or Revised Standard contains the best terminology for translation of modern ingredients.

name: SYRIAN MEAT PIES
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  tsp. salt
dash of ground pepper
8  oz. plain yogurt
3  oz. pkg. pine or pignolia nuts
1  pkg. hot roll mix
preparation: Prepare roll mix according to directions on box.  While dough is rising, mix other ingredients in bowl and let stand a short while.  Refrigerate until ready for it.  After dough has risen, pinch off enough to make 1 to 1 1/2-inch balls.  Cover cookie sheet with wax paper or dish towel.  Place balls on cookie sheet, cover with another towel and let rise again.  Roll each ball into a circle about 4 inches in diameter.  Put 1 heaping tablespoonful meat mixture in center.  Bring up edges to center and seal.   Bake 30 minutes in a 350° oven or until lightly browned.  Reheat when needed.

name: CHOCOLATE PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
3  c. Rice Krispies
2  c. peanut butter
1  stick butter
1  lb. powdered sugar
1  (8 oz.) chocolate bar
1/2  bar paraffin
1  (6 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Mix Rice Krispies, peanut butter, butter and powdered sugar. Form into balls.  Place on tray; put in refrigerator at least 1 hour.  In double boiler, melt chocolate bar, paraffin and chocolate chips.  Stick toothpicks in balls and dip into chocolate.  Place on foil to cool.

name: HOLY GUACAMOLE
ingredients:
2  ripe avocados, peeled and diced
1 1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 to 2  cloves garlic, minced
1  tsp. basil, crushed
1/4  c. red pepper, diced
2  Tbsp. salsa
1 1/2  Tbsp. almonds, chopped
2  Tbsp. thinly sliced onion
sour cream
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. minced cilantro
preparation: Peel and mash 1 avocado, mix with lemon juice, cilantro, garlic, basil and salt.  Dice remaining avocado, fold into mixture with red pepper, salsa, green onion and chopped almonds.  Garnish with sour cream.  Serve with tortilla chips and fresh vegetables. Makes 2 1/2 cups guacamole.

name: TACO CASSEROLE FOR DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. mayonnaise
8  oz. sour cream
2  cans Frito-Lay bean dip
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1 small  bunch green onions
1 small  can black olives
1  lb. pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
3  medium fresh tomatoes
preparation: Combine bean dip, mayonnaise, sour cream and taco seasoning. Finely chop onions, olives and tomatoes.  Put shredded cheese on top.  Cover and refrigerate.  Serve with nacho chips.  Will serve 15 to 18.

name: CHOW MEIN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can Chinese noodles
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
1  clove garlic, chopped
1/2  c. raw rice or Minute rice
2  c. water
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can chicken rice soup
4  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: In frying pan, put the butter and lightly brown the onion, garlic and celery, only until soft, then remove from flame.   Then brown separately the ground beef and remove the grease.  Mix all ingredients and put in baking dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes, covered.  Add Chinese noodles on top, uncovered.  Bake for 15 more minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: BRIDAL SHOWER PUNCH
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen strawberries (fresh in season)
1  bottle Cold Duck
1 small  can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
1  can Hawaiian Punch
3  bottles (36 oz.) 7-Up
mint leaves (for garnish)
preparation: Chill all liquid ingredients. Pour all over ice mold, adding Cold Duck last. It is a light alcoholic punch for a ladies special function.

name: CHERRY ICEBOX CAKE
ingredients:
6  egg whites (room temperature)
2  c. sugar (white)
2  tsp. vanilla
3/4  tsp. cream of tartar
3  c. crushed saltine crackers (not too fine)
1  (9 oz.) tub Cool Whip
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Beat egg whites until foamy; beat in sugar a little at a time to make meringue like.  Beat in vanilla and cream of tartar.  Fold in the 3 cups crushed saltine crackers.  Lightly grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and spread in meringue/cracker mixture.  Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.  After cake is cooled, top with Cool Whip and cover that with the cherry pie filling. Refrigerate.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
3  ripe tomatoes (1/4-inch diced)
2 to 4 fresh or 1  can jalapeno or chilies, minced
1  c. fresh lemon or lime juice
1  small red onion, minced
2 to 3  Tbsp. cilantro, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
dash of salt and ground pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients in nonaluminum bowl.

name: CHINESE STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. beef, cut for stroganoff
1/8  c. salad oil
1  red Bermuda onion, chopped
1/2  c. green onions, sliced thin
1 (8 oz.)  can bamboo shoots, drained
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
4  oz. mushrooms, sliced
1/2  c. beef broth (make from cubes)
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. soy sauce
1 (1 lb.)  can sliced Freestone peaches, undrained
preparation: Brown meat in oil.  Add onions (both kinds), bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, mushrooms, broth and sugar.  Cover and simmer 5 minutes.  Blend cornstarch with 1 tablespoon water and the soy sauce.  Add to mixture and simmer, stirring occasionally so it doesn't stick, until juice thickens.

name: APPLE BARS
ingredients:
1  c. vegetable oil
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. raw apples, diced in small cubes
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
1/2  c. coconut or raisins
preparation: Place oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla in large mixer bowl; beat until combined.  Sift together flour, cinnamon, baking soda and salt; add to oil mixture.  Stir in apples, nuts and coconut or raisins.  Spread batter in lightly greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jelly roll pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes until top springs back when touched lightly.

name: NEVER FAIL DIVINITY FUDGE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. white Karo
1  c. walnuts or any nut
2  egg whites
1  Tbsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix sugar, syrup and water together and boil until mixture will spin a thread when dropped from a spoon.  Have egg whites beaten stiff and pour half of syrup into egg white a little at a time, beating hard.  Return other half of the syrup to heat and cook until it will form a ball when dropped in a cup of cold water.  Mix all together, beating well and add nuts, salt and vanilla.  Beat until creamy.  Pour into lightly greased pan or dish.  When cold, cut into squares.

name: FRIED CORN(For 2)
ingredients:
2  c. whole kernel corn (fresh or frozen; if fresh, approximately 4 ears)
3  Tbsp. bacon grease or butter
2  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Heat bacon grease or butter in skillet.  Add all ingredients and fry for 7 to 10 minutes.  Has 170 calories per serving.

name: CHEESY MANICOTTI
ingredients:
8  manicotti shells
16  conchiglioni shells
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
2  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. Ricotta cheese
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and fill noodle shells with about 2 tablespoons.  Cover with 2 cups of spaghetti sauce and sprinkle with 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese.

name: MOTHER BAKER'S FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  lb. butter
1  lb. pecans
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  lb. orange peel
1  box raisins
3  eggs
2  boxes chopped dates
1  lb. brown sugar
4  c. flour
1/2  lb. candied pineapple
1/4  lb. lemon peel
1  box currants
1/2  c. dark syrup
preparation: Cream butter and brown sugar well, adding well beaten eggs, flour and baking powder.  Add fruit that has been mixed with a cup of the flour.  Let pressure come to 5 open pet cock and cook one hour.  Close and raise to 15.

name: Tomato Sauce
ingredients:
18  lb. tomatoes
4 1/2  c. chopped onions
12  garlic cloves, chopped
2  tsp. bay leaves
3  tsp. oregano
3  tsp. sugar
12  tsp. sugar
1  can tomato paste
preparation: Simmer 1 hour after it comes to a boil.  Put in canning jars. Process in 15 minute water bath.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. shredded zucchini
4  eggs, beaten well
2  c. sugar
1  c. salad oil
3 1/2 to 4  c. flour (self-rising)
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  c. raisins
1  c. nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients and put in greased and floured loaf pans (2).  Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until done.

name: HERBED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. long grain and wild rice mix
3  large boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut in half
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  can cream of chicken soup
3/4  c. Sauterne
1/2  c. celery, sliced thin
1 (3 oz.)  can mushrooms (broil or saute fresh mushrooms)
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
preparation: Prepare rice according to package. Meanwhile, lightly season with salt and pepper the chicken breasts. Brown them in the butter in a large skillet.  Spoon rice into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Arrange chicken on the rice.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
4  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. milk
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip
graham cracker crust
preparation: Beat cream cheese, sugar and peanut butter until smooth, then add milk.   Beat until smooth.  Fold in Cool Whip and whip until no lumps.   Pour into graham cracker crust.  Store in freezer, take out 1/2 hour before serving.

name: SPOON BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. meal
2  c. boiling water
1  tsp. baking soda, in 2 c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bake in oven at 350°.

name: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
ingredients:
3  sticks butter
dash of salt
6  large eggs
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans (optional)
3  c. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3  c. sifted cake flour
preparation: Cream butter, cream cheese and sugar until light and fluffy. Add salt and vanilla; beat well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each egg.  Stir in flour.  Spoon mixture into greased 10-inch tube pan.  Bake at 325° for about 1 1/2 hours.

name: BLUEBERRY OR PEACH OR CHERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 1/2  sticks oleo
1 1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  lb. box powdered sugar
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip
1  can blueberry, peach or cherry pie filling
preparation: Crust:  Mix with mixer the oleo, flour, 1/4 cup granulated sugar and nuts.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.   Bake until golden brown at 350°.  Cool completely.

name: CURRIED RICE/BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. brown (white) rice, cooked
1 1/2  c. red kidney beans, cooked
4  green onions, chopped
1/2  green pepper, diced
2  stalks celery, diced
1/4  c. fresh parsley, chopped
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. plain low-fat yogurt
2  tsp. curry powder
black pepper to taste
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients.  Toss to mix.

name: POTATO PUFF
ingredients:
4  sizable, cut in large dice, potatoes
1/4  c. firmly packed parsley
1  c. onion, diced
1/2  c. green pepper, diced
1  c. milk
3  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. diced cheese
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Blend all ingredients until potatoes are finely grated and turn into buttered casserole.  Bake in a 350° oven for about an hour. If this seems too big a load for your blender, blend 2 cut potatoes and 1/2 cup milk first; turn into casserole.  Blend other ingredients and mix.

name: SANDWICH SPREAD
ingredients:
1  qt. ground green tomatoes
1  pt. ground onions
6  green mangos
6  red mangos
2  bunches celery
1/2  c. salt
1  pt. vinegar
1  lb. sugar
1  qt. mayonnaise
1 small  jar French's mustard
preparation: Mix the first 6 ingredients.  Add salt and let stand overnight in large pan.  Squeeze dry in jelly bag in morning.  Add vinegar and sugar.  Cook 25 minutes.  Take off fire and stir in mayonnaise and mustard.  Mix this while hot, let cool and put in small jars. Put paraffin and lids on the ones you won't use immediately.

name: HOT ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. warm water
2  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  c. shortening
6 to 8  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
5 to 6  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water; combine with remaining ingredients. Place in large bowl; set in warm place to rise until double in bulk. Punch down; knead for a few minutes. Pinch off and form into rolls.  Let rise again, then bake for 5 minutes in 400° oven, then reduce to 350° and finish baking.

name: SHORTBREAD COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. soft butter or margarine
5/8  c. sugar (1/2 c. plus 2 Tbsp.)
2 1/2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Cream butter until consistency of mayonnaise.  Add sugar gradually; cream until light and fluffy.  Combine flour and cornstarch; beat in slowly.  When all is added, mix thoroughly with hands.  Chill.  Roll out on lightly floured surface to about 1/4-inch thickness.  Cut with cookie cutter (about 2 1/2 inches). Bake on ungreased cookie sheets at 300° for 20 to 25 minutes. (Should be just barely browned.)  Makes about 36 cookies.

name: QUICK ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. sweet milk
4  c. self-rising flour
1/4  c. sugar
1  pkg. yeast, dissolved in 1/4 c. warm water
1/2  c. Wesson oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Drop in greased muffin tins and bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes.  Dough may be kept in refrigerator for 1 week.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CUPS
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. peanut butter
4  c. sifted powdered sugar
2  (1/2 lb.) Hershey bars
preparation: Melt butter and peanut butter; mix in vanilla.  Add powdered sugar and press into glass container (11 x 15-inch).  Melt Hershey bars and pour on top.

name: OREO PIE
ingredients:
16  to 20 Oreo cookies, crushed
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1/2  gal. ice cream
1  chocolate graham cracker crust
preparation: Fold in  cookies and pour into chocolate graham cracker crust. Freeze.

name: CONEYS
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. hamburger
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. garlic
6  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. red pepper
3 1/2  c. tomato juice
5  c. water
preparation: Brown hamburger; add salt.  Mix all other ingredients in a pan.  Bring to a boil.  Add hamburger and simmer.

name: PEANUT BUTTER NO BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/3  c. margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
2/3  c. peanut butter
3  c. instant oats
6  Tbsp. cocoa
preparation: Boil sugar, milk, margarine and vanilla and boil for 1 to 2 minutes and pour over peanut butter, oats and cocoa. Mix thoroughly and spoon drop onto wax paper to cool.

name: DIP RECIPE
ingredients:
1  pt. mayonnaise
5  drops Tabasco sauce
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. curry powder
5  drops Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. dried onion flakes
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

name: COMPANY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. noodles
1  Tbsp. butter
1  lb. ground chuck or round steak
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1/2  lb. cottage cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
1/4  c. sour cream
1/3  c. snipped scallions
1  Tbsp. diced green pepper
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Cook and drain noodles.  Set aside.  Saute chuck in 1 tablespoon butter until brown.  Stir in tomato sauce and remove from heat.  In a separate bowl, combine cheeses, sour cream, scallions and green pepper.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
1  c. shortening
3  c. sugar
4  eggs
5 1/2  c. flour
4  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. sugar
4  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix thoroughly the oleo, shortening, 3 cups sugar and eggs. Blend in flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt. May need to chill dough for a little while, then shape rounded teaspoonfuls into balls (whatever size you want your cookies). Then roll the balls of dough in the sugar and cinnamon mixture. Flatten a little and place about 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until set. Move immediately from baking sheet.

name: BETTER THAN SEX CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  c. water
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  c. sour cream
1 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1/2  c. oil
1  bar German chocolate bar, grated
6  oz. milk chocolate morsels
preparation: Mix all together.  Pour into Bundt pan.  Bake for 55 minutes at 350° in preheated oven.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  medium onion
white flour tortillas
grated cheese
2  cans mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken
1  can milk
1  pkg. taco mix
preparation: Fry hamburger and onion.  Add taco mix.  Roll up in white tortillas with cheese.  Put in casserole dish.  Pour soups and milk over enchilada casserole.  Cover with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI AND TOMATOES
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. extra virgin olive oil
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  can crushed tomatoes
1/4  c. chopped parsley
6  zucchini, halved lengthwise and then crosswise
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat; add garlic. Cook until golden.  Stir in crushed tomatoes and parsley.  Add zucchini; season with salt and pepper.  Cover; reduce heat and cook 20 to 30 minutes or until al dente.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: CHILI DIP
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can chili with no beans
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, cubed
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1  to 2 jalapeno peppers to taste, chopped
preparation: Combine all ingredients in casserole dish and bake at 225° for 1 hour.  Serve hot with corn chips.  Can be frozen.

name: BAKED SQUASH DELUXE
ingredients:
1  qt. canned squash or equivalent
herbal Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix
1  can cream of mushroom soup
grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Use canned squash or, if fresh, boil until tender.  In separate container, dilute mushroom soup with milk.  Layer ingredients, starting with squash and ending with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CHESS PIE
ingredients:
3  egg yolks
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. milk
1  c. sugar
1  stick oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat egg yolks; add sugar (being sure that it is a good full cup), then add flour.  Add a little at a time, melted oleo and milk.  Add vanilla.  Pour into unbaked pie crust.  Bake 45 minutes at 325°.

name: ZUCCHINI JAM
ingredients:
6  c. peeled, grated zucchini
6  c. sugar
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  c. drained, crushed pineapple
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. Jell-O
preparation: Gently boil zucchini for 15 minutes.  Add sugar and boil 6 minutes, stirring often.  Add lemon juice and pineapple.  Boil 6 minutes.  Reduce heat and add Jell-O.  Stir.  Pour in jars and seal.  Refrigerate.

name: BONBONS TEMPTATION PIE
ingredients:
15  chocolate creme-filled cookies
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  pt. softened ice cream
about 24 Bonbons brand ice cream nuggets
whipped cream
chocolate syrup
preparation: Crush cookies.  Combine with butter.  Press into buttered 8-inch pie plate.  Bake in 350° oven 8 to 10 minutes.  Cool.

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD(Club Member: Ben Steadman)
ingredients:
2  c. crushed pretzels
3/4  c. melted butter
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. confectioners sugar
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
8  oz. Cool Whip
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin
2  c. boiling water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed and sliced
preparation: Combine pretzels, butter and sugar. Put in 9 x 12-inch dish. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Let cool. Cream sugars and cream cheese. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread over pretzel crust. Seal around edges. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add strawberries. Let cool, but not gel. Pour over cream cheese layer. Chill at least 1 hour! Delicious salad or dessert!

name: CHEESY CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  broiler fryer, boiled and cut up
1  can enchilada sauce
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  large onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
dash of pepper
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  pkg. corn chips, crushed
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. chicken broth
