preparation: Cook chicken, remove from bones and cut into chunks.  Combine chicken, enchilada sauce, soup, onion, garlic salt and pepper. Place half of corn chips in a greased 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Layer with chicken mixture, then remaining corn chips.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Pour chicken broth over casserole.   Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: WEEKEND CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  chicken breasts, boned, skinned and diced
1  lb. spaghetti, cooked
1/2  c. celery, diced
1/2  c. onion, diced
2 small  cans pimento
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom or celery soup
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
1  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Cook chicken, celery and onion until tender.  Spray large, oblong baking dish with Pam.  Put drained spaghetti in dish.  Top with chicken, celery and onion.  Combine soups in bowl and whisk until blended.  (May need to add a bit of milk.)  Pour over spaghetti and chicken.  Layer cheese over top and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1 small  can pink lemonade concentrate
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1 small  can crushed, drained pineapple
1  graham cracker crust
preparation: Mix lemonade, Eagle Brand milk, Cool Whip and pineapple.  Pile into graham cracker crust.

name: MOMS OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. boiling water
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. oats
2 -2 1/2  c. sifted flour
preparation: Mix together shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla. Mix together water, soda and salt.  Stir into egg mixture.  Drop onto greased cookie sheet and bake at 400 degrees for 10 to 20 minutes.

name: BIG SOFT GINGER COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
2  tsp. ground ginger
1  tsp. baking soda
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
3/4  c. margarine, butter or shortening
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. molasses
preparation: Combine flour, ginger, soda, cinnamon, cloves and salt.  Set aside.

name: BISCUIT TOPPED ITALIAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. water
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato soup
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  Tbsp. oleo, melted
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
8  oz. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1 (10 oz.)  can Hungry Jack refrigerated buttermilk biscuits
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Grease a 12 x 8-inch (2-quart) baking dish.  In large skillet, brown ground beef and onion; drain.  Stir in water, pepper, tomato paste and tomato sauce.  Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring often.  Remove from heat; stir in vegetables and 1 1/2 cups of cheese.  Spoon mixture into greased baking dish. Separate dough into 10 biscuits.  Separate each biscuit into 2 layers.  Place biscuits near outer edge of hot mixture, overlapping slightly.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese in center and around edge.  Gently brush biscuits with oleo and sprinkle with oregano.  Bake at 375° for 22 to 27 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: SUGAR FROSTED FLAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. sugar
1  c. oil
1/2  c. oleo
2  eggs
2  c. oatmeal
2  c. Frosted Flakes, crushed
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Beat sugar, brown sugar, oil, oleo and eggs.  Add oatmeal, Frosted Flakes, flour, salt and baking soda.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines butter cake mix
1 small  can cream of coconut
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1 large  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Make cake according to directions on package and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  While still hot, make holes with fork.  Mix milk and cream of coconut together and pour over hot cake.  Let cool, then top with Cool Whip and coconut.  Keep in refrigerator.

name: SHRIMP PIZZA
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. cooked shrimp
1  bottle cocktail sauce
1 small  can pitted ripe olives
1  tomato, diced
4  oz. shredded Mozzarella
preparation: Soften cheese and spread on platter.   Spread on sauce, then sprinkle on shrimp, diced tomato, ripe olives (sliced) and then cheese.  Serve with firm crackers.

name: COCA-COLA CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1  c. Coke (12 oz. can)
3 heaping  tsp. cocoa
2  c. flour
pinch of salt
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. marshmallows
preparation: Bring butter, Coke and cocoa to a boil.  Pour over flour, sugar and salt; mix well.  Add eggs, soda, buttermilk and vanilla. Take out of mixer and add marshmallows.  Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.  Use a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: FEED "EM" ALL CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
bananas
2  cans pineapple, drained
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
3  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
4 1/2  c. milk
9  oz. Cool Whip
coconut
preparation: Bake cake mix in two 9 x 13-inch pans and cool.  Slice a layer of bananas on cake and top with crushed pineapple.  Mix in separate bowl cream cheese, pudding and milk.  Ice the top layer with this mixture.  Then ice the cake again with Cool Whip and sprinkle with coconut.  Refrigerate.

name: CHICKEN IN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can onion soup
1  can mushroom soup
1  can water
1 1/2  c. uncooked rice
6  to 8 pieces chicken
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix soups, water and rice in small roaster.  Lay pieces of chicken, skin side up, on mixture.  Salt and pepper to taste. Cover pan tightly.  Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.  Remove cover and bake at 450° for 20 minutes

name: CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. warm water (not hot)
3/4  c. sugar
5  Tbsp. yeast
1/3  c. 3 Tbsp. butter/oleo
2  tsp. salt
3  eggs beaten
7 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Mix water, sugar, yeast into large mixing bowl.  Let set 5-10 minutes until bubbles form.  Add eggs, butter, salt.  Then add flour gradually stirring with wooden spoon.  When too thick to stir add flour in small mounts, kneading until a soft dough and elastic. Let rise until double (about one hour).  Punch down and divide into pieces and let set covered 10 minutes.  Roll into triangles.  Brush on butter and sprinkle with cinnamon/sugar mixture.  Roll into jelly roll, cut into 3/4 inch to one inch pieces.  Place into cake pan or greased cookie sheet.  Let rise until double.  Bake at 375° for 25 minutes until good and brown.  Brush on frosting/glaze while hot so it melts.  Can be frozen.  To warm up heat oven to 350° and turn off.  Put in rolls for 30 minutes.  They will be just like fresh baked.  Makes about 45 rolls.

name: AUNT NINA'S FAMOUS GINGERSNAPS
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
3  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cloves
1  c. butter or oleo
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. molasses
1  egg
preparation: Sift together the flour, soda, cinnamon, ginger and cloves. Cream the butter or oleo. Gradually add the sugar; cream well. Blend in molasses and egg. Add dry ingredients, mixing thoroughly. If desired, chill for easier handling. Roll out on floured surface, 1/4 at a time, to 1/8-inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes with cookie cutter. Place on lightly greased baking sheets. Bake in moderately hot oven at 375° for 5 to 8 minutes. Remove from baking sheet immediately.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 small  can evaporated milk
1  can cream of celery soup
1  envelope onion soup mix
4  to 6 pork chops
3/4  c. uncooked rice
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Lightly brown pork chops; drain on paper towel.  In medium bowl, combine soup and milk (reserve 1/2 cup of mixture for topping).  Add rice and half of dry onion soup mix.  Pour mixture into a large, greased baking dish.  Place pork chops on top.  Pour reserved soup mixture over chops and sprinkle with dry soup mix. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Remove foil and bake 15 to 20 more minutes.

name: CHERRY OR BLUEBERRY "YUM YUM"
ingredients:
graham cracker crumbs
melted butter
2  cans cherry or blueberry pie filling
1  regular size container Cool Whip
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Make graham cracker crust from graham cracker crumbs and melted butter.  Pat firmly onto a cookie sheet.  Spread pie filling on crust.  Whip together the Cool Whip and cream cheese; spread on top of pie filling.  Chill for 1 hour.  Cut into squares and serve.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans green beans
3  to 4 potatoes
1  large onion, chopped
1  can celery soup
1  can mushroom soup
1 1/2  cans water
1 1/2 to 2  lb. ground beef
salt
preparation: Combine soups and water; set aside.  In a buttered baking dish, layer beans, potatoes and onions.  Pour half of soups on top of these.  Place browned beef over this and pour remaining soups over this.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  white cake mix
1/2  c. Mazola oil
1 small  box strawberry Jell-O
4  eggs
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
preparation: Mix  all  together and beat 4 minutes.  Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350° for about 1 hour or until "tests" done with toothpick.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2/3  c. sugar
4  eggs
dash of salt
3/4  c. coconut or other nuts, shaved
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. Bisquick
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend for about 1 minute.  Pour into large buttered pie pan.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

name: CRANBERRY FRUIT RELISH
ingredients:
3  c. fresh cranberries
1  small thin skin orange, remove seed
1  small thin skin lemon
1  medium apple, quartered and seeded
2  c. pecan halves
1 1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Use knife blade in processor and add lemon and orange until lemon and orange peel is finely chopped, 3 to 4 minutes.  Add cranberries, apple and pecans.  Pulse 4 to 6 times, scraping side of processor bowl between each pulse.  Remove cranberry mixture from processor and add sugar.  Mix well and cover and chill.  This keeps well in refrigerator.   Can also use blender.

name: FUDGE SUNDAE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. evaporated milk
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1  c. Kraft miniature marshmallows
1/4  tsp. salt
graham cracker crust or vanilla wafers
1  qt. vanilla ice cream
chopped peanuts or pecans
preparation: Put evaporated milk, chocolate morsels, marshmallows and salt into heavy 1-quart saucepan.  Stir over medium heat until chocolate and marshmallows melt completely and mixture thickens.  Take off heat and cool to room temperature.  Use a 9-inch pie pan.  Fill with a graham cracker crust or line bottom and sides of pan with vanilla wafers.  Spoon 1/2 of 1 quart vanilla ice cream over crust or wafers with 1/2 the chocolate mixture.  Repeat with rest of ice cream, then chocolate.  Top with chopped peanuts or pecans.

name: PORK CHOP ONION RICE BAKE
ingredients:
6  pork chops (1 to 1 1/2-inches thick)
2  Tbsp. lard
1  c. rice
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
1 (4 oz.)  jar mushrooms
3  c. hot water
preparation: Brown chops in lard.  Spread  rice  in	bottom	of  9 x 13-inch  baking dish.  Sprinkle  onion  soup  mix  over  rice. Arrange browned chops over	top  of  rice  mixture and add hot water.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes. Remove foil and cook 10 minutes longer.

name: CARAMEL APPLE PIE
ingredients:
10  caramel candies (each cut into 4 pieces)
1/3  c. flour
3  c. chopped (1/2-inch cubes) Jonathan or Rome apples
2/3  c. caramel ice cream topping
2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Combine candies, flour, apples, topping and lemon juice.  Mix well.  Pour mixture into frozen regular 9-inch pie crust and sprinkle with 1/2 cup pecan pieces.  Bake at 375° on preheated baking sheet for 40 to 45 minutes.  Store at room temperature.

name: HOT ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. light mayonnaise
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1  can artichoke hearts in water, drained
preparation: Mix together.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Serve with Wheat Thins or crackers.

name: HONEY COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. honey
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda, in 4 tsp. hot water
2  tsp. baking powder
4  c. flour
preparation: Combine sugar, salt and shortening.  Add eggs, honey, vanilla, soda and water, baking powder and flour.  Roll into balls, walnut size or use spoons to form equal amounts.  Bake at 350° for 8 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2  Tbsp. unsalted butter
6  Tbsp. chunky peanut butter
preparation: Generously butter a 12-inch plate.  Combine the sugar, milk and salt in a small saucepan.  Heat to soft ball stage (240° on thermometer); turn off the heat.  Stir in the vanilla, butter and peanut butter.  Mix well and pour onto buttered plate.  Let cool, then cut into squares.  Makes about 2 dozen pieces.

name: CREAM PUFFS
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo or margarine
1  c. boiling water
1  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. salt
4  eggs
preparation: Melt oleo in boiling water.  Add flour and salt all at once. Stir vigorously. Cook and stir until mixture forms a ball that doesn't separate.  Remove from heat. Cool slightly.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each until smooth.  Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls 3-inches apart on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 400° until golden brown and puffy (about 30 minutes).  Remove from oven and split.  Cool on rack.  Fill inside with pudding.  Place top on it and sprinkle with powdered sugar.  Makes 10.

name: YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. lukewarm water
1/2  c. Crisco, melted
1  pkg. Fleischmann's yeast
1/3  c. sugar
self-rising flour (enough to make soft dough)
preparation: Mix yeast  with  warm water.  Add sugar and Crisco. Mix in flour.  Let  rise  until double in size. Work down and make out into rolls.  Then cover with melted margarine and let rise to double  (about  1  1/2  hours).  Bake  in a 350° oven until done.

name: QUICK AND HEARTY VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove minced garlic
5  c. water
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can tomatoes, chopped
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
3/4  c. quick barley
1/2  c. celery
1/2  c. carrots
2  beef bouillon cubes
1/2  tsp. basil
1  bay leaf
preparation: In Dutch oven, brown meat, onion and garlic until tender; drain.  Stir in all remaining ingredients, except frozen vegetables.  Cover and bring to boil.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Add frozen vegetables and simmer 10 more minutes.

name: BEST WHOLE WHEAT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. milk
1/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. whole wheat flour
white flour
1  c. warm water
1  c. very warm water (to dissolve yeast)
3  Tbsp. yeast
2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
preparation: Scald milk.  Add shortening, sugar and salt and stir until dissolved.  Add whole wheat flour and beat rapidly with spoon. Add dissolved yeast and cold water.  Mix well, then add enough white flour to make a nice soft dough.  Let rise until double, then punch down and rise again.  Shape into 3 loaves.  Let rise and bake.

name: 7-UP CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo
1/2  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
3  c. sifted all-purpose flour
5  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
7  oz. 7-Up
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Add eggs and flour (add egg one at a time).  Fold in 7-Up and flavoring.  (Don't stir too much.) Bake in Bundt pan at 325° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.   Grease and flour pan.

name: STUFFED MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  pkg. Stove Top stuffing mix
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  lb. very lean ground beef
1  envelope onion soup mix
1/3  c. ketchup
1  egg
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Prepare stuffing mix per package directions.  Combine ground beef, soup mix, ketchup, egg and water in bowl.  Mix well.  Spread 1/2 of ground beef mixture into casserole dish. Spread stuffing mixture evenly over beef mixture.  Top with remaining beef mixture.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 hour, remove cover and bake for additional 15 minutes until top of loaf is brown.

name: PINEAPPLE ARKANSAS CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped walnuts
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple with juice
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.  Cake is done when toothpick inserted into center of cake comes out clean.  Cool completely.

name: PECAN PUFFS
ingredients:
2 1/2  sticks butter
1 1/2  c. pecans
2  tsp. vanilla
6  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. flour
preparation: Cream butter with flour; add sugar and mix.  Add flour, vanilla and nuts; mix well.  Pinch off large marble size and roll. Bake for 10 minutes at 375°.  Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.

name: BUTTERED NOODLES
ingredients:
9  c. wide egg noodles, uncooked
1/4  c. (1/2 stick) real butter
2  tsp. chopped fresh parsley
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground black pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Cook pasta according to package directions.  In saucepan over low heat, add remaining ingredients.  Heat until butter is melted; stir in hot pasta.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thoroughly heated.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: MORE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
8  oz. tomato sauce
2  oz. catsup
1 large  can cream-style corn
1 1/2  tsp. chili powder
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Brown beef, onions and celery.  Add tomato sauce, catsup, corn, chili powder, salt and pepper.  Cook 30 minutes.  Add cooked noodles.  Pour in casserole and top with grated cheese.  Bake at 350° for 10 or 15 minutes.

name: MARVELOUS COOKIES(3 Dozen)
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  c. olive oil
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1 to 2  Tbsp. water (if necessary)
3/4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. wheat germ
1 1/2  c. rolled oats
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Grease cookie sheet with margarine. Cream margarine, oil and brown sugar.  Add egg and vanilla and beat well.  Add whole wheat flour, salt, baking powder, wheat germ, rolled oats, raisins and nuts and mix well.  Add water if too dry.  Drop batter by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet and bake 10 to 12 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter or oleo
1  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  lb. 10x sugar
preparation: Melt butter and peanut butter over low heat, blending until smooth.  Add vanilla.  Remove from heat.  Stir in 10x sugar. Spread in buttered 8-inch pan.  Chill.  Cut into squares.

name: CHICKEN TORTILLA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  chicken, cooked, bones removed, cut into bite size pieces
chicken broth
1  can (8 oz.) evaporated milk
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  grated onion
1 small  can chopped green chiles, drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  lb. grated Jack cheese or mix with Cheddar
1  pkg. corn tortillas, cut into strips
preparation: Mix chicken, onion, chiles, milk and soups.  Put 2 to 4 Tbsp. chicken broth into bottom of casserole, then layer tortillas, chicken mixture and cheese, using half each time until cheese finishes on top.  Cover, refrigerate at least 24 hours.  Bake 1 hour at 300°.

name: CHARLIE BROWNS
ingredients:
1  stick butter
3  Tbsp. cocoa
3  c. oatmeal
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Combine butter, cocoa, sugar and milk to a boil.  Boil 3 minutes.  Remove from stove and add peanut butter and vanilla flavoring.  Mix in oatmeal.  Spoon on wax paper.

name: EASY AMBROSIA SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can fruit cocktail
1  can mandarin oranges
1 medium  can chunk pineapple
4  oz. flaked coconut
1/2  pt. sour cream
1/2  bag mini marshmallows
preparation: Drain all fruit; mix with sour cream.  Add coconut and marshmallows.  Chill for 2 hours.

name: AMARETTO CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  stick butter
2  cups grated cheddar cheese
1/2  cup raisins
8  ozs. cream cheese
1-2 Tbsp. Amaretto
1  pkg. slivered almonds or finely chopped pecans
preparation: Mix cheese, butter, cream cheese, raisins and amaretto. Shape into ball and roll in nuts.  Serve with assorted crackers.

name: BRENDA'S BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. hash browns
1  c. chopped meat (Italian or hot country sausage, ham, etc), cooked and drained
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. shredded cheese of choice
6  eggs
1/4  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
other seasonings of choice
preparation: Layer first 4 ingredients in casserole dish.  Mix milk with eggs and seasonings.  Beat well.  Pour egg mixture over the ingredients in casserole dish.  Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes or until mixture is set and firm to touch.   You may layer ingredients in the casserole dish the night before and refrigerate.  You may also mix the egg mixture in separate container and refrigerate.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  chicken breasts, split
1  c. long grain rice
1  c. chicken broth
1  c. cream of chicken soup
2  Tbsp. butter or oleo
3  Tbsp. minced onions
salt and pepper
preparation: Add rice, can of broth (and enough water to make 2 cups), 2 tablespoons butter or oleo and onions.  Cook according to rice directions.  Mix with cream of chicken soup; salt and pepper to taste.  Pour into casserole.  Top with chicken breasts; salt and pepper chicken.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: NUTS AND BOLTS(Great Snack.  Kids Love It!)
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3  tsp. garlic powder
1 to 1 1/2  c. good quality olive oil
1 large  box Rice Chex
1 large  box Wheat Chex
1 large  box Cheerios
2  bags Mr. Salty thin pretzel sticks
2  lb. peanuts or mixed nuts
preparation: Place in a large turkey roaster.  Pour liquid mixture over cereals and thoroughly coat, turning.  Bake at 200° for 2 hours, turning every 15 minutes.  Makes 2 largest Tupperware containers and stores well.  Excellent for Christmas gifts.

name: GRAPE SPARKLING PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can orange juice
1 (12 oz.)  can lemon juice
2 (12 oz.)  cans frozen grape
2 (20 oz.)  bottles ginger ale
1 1/2  gal. cold water
10  c. sugar
1  qt. boiling water
preparation: Mix sugar and boiling water and let cool, then add juices and cold water.  Put in freezer; stir every 10 minutes.  When ready to serve, add ginger ale.  Makes 80 servings (2 1/2 gallons).

name: FESTIVE STRAWBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  cans frozen lemonade
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
9  c. cold water
5  pt. pineapple sherbet
2  pt. vanilla ice cream
2  pkg. frozen strawberries (2 medium or 1 large)
preparation: Mix in order given.  Will serve 30 to 40.

name: FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
4  eggs
juice of 1 lemon
5  tsp. salt
1  pt. Wesson oil
2  Tbsp. mustard
1  c. sugar
4  tsp. paprika
1  qt. Miracle Whip
1/4  c. garlic powder
1/2  c. vinegar
3/4  c. tomato juice
preparation: Blend and refrigerate.  Makes over 2 quarts.

name: PORK STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1  lb. pork tenderloin, cut into thin strips
2  Tbsp. cooking sherry
2  tsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. dried basil leaves
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1  red pepper, cored and sliced into thin strips
1  c. thinly sliced mushrooms
1  small yellow onion, thinly sliced
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. spinach linguine, cooked al dente and drained
preparation: In a medium bowl, combine sherry, cornstarch and spices.  Add pork and toss until  meat is evenly coated.  Heat oil over medium-high heat in skillet.  Add pork mixture and cook, stirring frequently, about 5 minutes.  Add pepper, mushrooms and onion. Simmer, covered, for 5 minutes.  Serve over hot spinach linguine.

name: BAKED CORN
ingredients:
1  can cream-style corn
1  can or 1 pt. whole kernel corn
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. melted butter
2  eggs, lightly beaten
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Mix flour and sugar together.  Beat eggs; add to corn and to melted butter.  Blend well.  Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°, or until knife inserted in middle comes out clean.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. ground beef
2  cans tomato sauce
1  onion, diced
1 small  can mushrooms (stems and pieces)
2  tsp. oregano
garlic salt or powder
1  (16 oz.) container Ricotta cheese
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese
1 regular  pkg. lasagna noodles
salt and pepper (omit salt if using garlic salt)
preparation: Brown ground beef and diced onion; drain.  Add tomato sauce, oregano, garlic salt or powder and mushrooms; simmer for at least 1 hour.  Prepare lasagna noodles as directed on package, using 2 tablespoons oil in boiling water to prevent sticking together. Pour small amount of sauce in bottom of 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.  Lay one layer of noodles; cover with sauce.  Then, using a teaspoon, distribute 1/2 of the Ricotta cheese on the sauce.  Cut 1/3 of the Mozzarella cheese into chunks; distribute likewise.  Repeat noodle layer, sauce layer, then Ricotta and Mozzarella layers.  Lay remaining noodle layer; cover with sauce.  Shred the least 1/3 of the Mozzarella cheese to cover top.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, if desired.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: TUNA CAKES
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  can tuna, drained
1  small onion, minced
1  egg
5  or 6 saltine squares, crumbled
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Salt and pepper to taste. Pat out into patties and fry in 1 tablespoon oil.  May add a slice of cheese on top.

name: BUNNY RABBIT SALAD
ingredients:
lettuce
pear halves
cloves or raisins
almond halves
cottage cheese
preparation: Wash lettuce; dry.  Place leaf on each plate.  Place pear half upside down on each plate.  At small end, add raisins or cloves for eyes and 2 almond halves for ears.  Add 1 teaspoon of cottage cheese at base of large end for a tail.   Eat!

name: FRIED CORN
ingredients:
12  ears fresh corn
8  slices bacon (uncooked)
1/2  c. butter
2 to 4  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cut off tips of corn kernels into a large bowl; scrape milk and remaining pulp from cob with a paring knife.  Set aside.  Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove bacon, reserving about 1/4 cup drippings in skillet.  Crumble bacon and set aside.  Add corn, butter and remaining ingredients to drippings in skillet. Cook over medium heat 20 minutes, stirring frequently.  Spoon corn mixture into a serving dish and sprinkle with crumbled bacon.

name: CARROT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. salad oil
3  small onions
2 to 3  lb. carrots
preparation: Slice carrots.  Cook until tender.  Drain and pour liquid over carrots.  Let set overnight.  Can keep 5 weeks.

name: EASY BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. sour cream
1/2  onion, finely diced
1/2  lb. sliced mushrooms
preparation: Add onions and mushrooms to ground beef.  Then brown and drain.  Add remaining ingredients.  Stir and simmer for 10 minutes.  Serve over noodles or split hamburger buns.

name: STUFFED GREEN PEPPERS
ingredients:
5  to 6 medium green peppers
3/4  c. uncooked brown rice
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can (8 oz.) tomato sauce
1/4  tsp. dried basil
1/4  tsp. dried oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
1/2  tsp. instant beef bouillon
preparation: Remove tops and seed from peppers.  In a large kettle, bring water to a boil.  Cook peppers for 5 minutes.  Remove and drain. Cook rice according to package directions.

name: FLUFFY FROSTING
ingredients:
1 2/3  c. sugar
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar (optional)
4  egg whites
preparation: Mix the sugar with 1/4 cup water (or a little more). Cook on low heat until it spins a thread.  Beat the egg whites until stiff and fluffy.  Pour syrup over egg whites in a thin stream, beating all the time. Beat until cool. Add the vanilla and cream of tartar (optional).

name: SHRIMP AND CRAB CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/4  stick margarine, melted
1  c. boiled shrimp, peeled and diced
1  lb. crab claw meat
1  stalk celery, chopped fine
2  slices bread, moistened and drained
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
3 to 4  Tbsp. sour cream
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. packaged dressing
paprika to taste
additional margarine
preparation: Pour melted margarine in bottom of casserole dish. Mix all other ingredients, except dressing. Pour in dish. Top with dressing and dot with additional margarine. Sprinkle paprika on top. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
2  c. chopped cooked meat
2  c. mashed potatoes
2  c. gravy
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. paprika
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1 or 2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Combine meat, gravy and onion.  Line bottom of buttered baking dish with well beaten potatoes.  Add meat mixture, then cover with layer of potatoes.  Dot crust with butter.  Bake at 400° for about 1/2 hour, or until potatoes are brown.

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA
ingredients:
2  cans crescent rolls
2  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  c. Miracle Whip
dill weed
green onions
green pepper
cauliflower
broccoli
radishes
celery
carrots
cheese
crisp bacon
preparation: Spread crescent rolls on cookie sheet; bake and cool.  Mix together the cream cheese, Miracle Whip and dill weed; spread over cooled crust.  Chop the vegetables up finely; sprinkle on top. Sprinkle on cheese and bacon.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: CHERRIES JUBILEE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. red currant jelly
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. Kirsch, heated
2  c. canned tart cherries, well drained
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
preparation: Melt jelly in frypan.  Add butter; stir until melted and hot. Add cherries and heat through.  Pour Kirsch over cherries.  Ignite with long match.  Let burn until flame dies.  Spoon hot cherries over ice cream and serve.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BRAISED ORIENTAL MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
2  c. dried Chinese or Japanese shiitake mushrooms
2  Tbsp. oil
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. m.s.g.
1  tsp. minced ginger
preparation: Soak mushrooms in 3 to 4 cups boiling water and cover for 15 minutes.  Trim off stems, squeeze out water and cut into bite size pieces.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli, cooked and drained well
1  c. grated American processed cheese
1  small to medium onion, chopped
1  can mushroom soup
2  eggs, well beaten
1  c. mayonnaise
1/3  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix.
preparation: Mix together well, except Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix. Place in a 13 x 9-inch dish.  Cover with 1/3 package of Pepperidge Farms herb stuffing mix and dot with butter.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: HAYSTACKS
ingredients:
1 (5 oz.)  can chow mein noodles
1  c. salted peanuts
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
preparation: Melt butterscotch.  Add chow mein noodles and peanuts.  Stir until well coated.  Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.  Let cool. They will become hard so you can pick up easily.

name: SHARON'S STEAK AND PEPPERS
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. round steak, cut into bite size strips or pieces
2  large or 3 medium green peppers, sliced into strips
2  large onions, cut in medium wedges
2  Tbsp. oil
salt and pepper to taste
3  pkg. brown gravy mix
3  c. water
preparation: Brown round steak in oil.  Add green peppers and onions and cook until tender.  Blend gravy mix and water and pour over meat, peppers and onions.  Bring to boil, then lower heat and simmer 20 to 25 minutes.  Serve over rice.

name: CREAM CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1/2  c. butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3  c. sugar
3  c. flour
6  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together margarine, butter and cream cheese (must be at room temperature).  Add sugar, then eggs, one at a time.  Fold in flour and then vanilla.  Pour batter into a greased, floured angel food cake pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 30 minutes to 1 hour and 45 minutes.

name: OATMEAL CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. water
6  oz. chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
3  c. oats, uncooked
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Place shortening, sugars, egg, water and vanilla in mixing bowl; beat thoroughly.  Sift together flour, salt and soda; add to shortening mixture and mix well.  Blend in oats, chocolate chips and pecans.  Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake in 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (16 1/2 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1 (16 1/2 oz.)  can corn kernels
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  box corn muffin mix
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. margarine, softened
1  egg
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Coat 9 x 13 baking dish with cooking spray.

name: SCALLOPED SALMON
ingredients:
2  c. salmon
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1  c. thin white sauce
salt and pepper
preparation: Flake salmon and place half of it into a greased baking dish. Season with lemon juice.  Cover with half of bread crumbs and repeat in layers.  Pour white sauce on top and bake in oven for 20 minutes at 350°.

name: SUMMER SAUSAGE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1/4  tsp. mustard seed
1  c. water
1 or 2  Tbsp. liquid smoke
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
3  Tbsp. Morton Quick Tender salt
1/4  tsp. onion powder
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Divide mixture into 4 equal parts. Make a roll out of each part.  (Roll will be approximately 2 inches in diameter and about 3 inches long.)  Wrap each roll individually in foil, being sure the dull side is out. Refrigerate for 24 hours.  Punch holes on bottom of each roll and place on a broiler pan.  Put 1/2-inch of water in bottom of pan. Bake at 325° for 90 minutes.  Let cool enough to handle, re-wrap and refrigerate.  (Can also be frozen.)

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  clove garlic
1  Tbsp. basil
1/2  Tbsp. salt
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes (2 c.)
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
10  oz. lasagna noodles (6)
3  c. Ricotta or creamy cottage cheese
3/4  c. grated Parmesan
2  tsp. parsley flakes
2  beaten eggs
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown meat slowly; drain.  Add next 5 ingredients. Simmer, uncovered, 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cook noodles according to package directions; drain. Combine remaining ingredients, except Mozzarella.  Place half the noodles in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread 1/2 the cheese mixture on top, then 1/2 of the Mozzarella and 1/2 of the meat sauce.  Repeat layers. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

name: BAKED SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. margarine or butter
2 (8 oz.)  can tomatoes and juice, cut up
4  oz. can sliced mushrooms
2 1/4  oz. can sliced ripe olives, drained
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  tsp. dried oregano
1  lb. ground meat, browned and drained
12  oz. pkg. spaghetti, cooked and drained
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. water
preparation: In a large skillet, saute onion and green pepper in margarine until tender.  Add tomatoes, mushrooms, olives and oregano.  Add ground meat.   Simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes.

name: AUNT ROSE'S HARD SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  egg yolk
3/4  stick butter
preparation: Cream as for a cake; add whiskey to taste.  Fold in beaten egg white.  Pour over hot pudding.

name: PRUNE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. cooking oil
3  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. chopped prunes
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Blend sugar and oil.  Add eggs and mix well.  Sift dry ingredients together.  Add alternately with milk.  Add vanilla, prunes and nuts.  Bake in buttered and floured pan for 45 minutes at 300°.

name: CHICKEN CURRY
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
1  c. finely chopped, pared apple
1  c. sliced celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2 to 3  tsp. curry powder
3/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. cold chicken broth
2  c. milk
2  c. diced, cooked chicken
1 (3 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms, drained
hot, cooked rice
curry condiments
preparation: In saucepan, melt butter.  Add apple, celery, onion and garlic.  Cook until the onion is tender.  Combine cornstarch, curry, salt and broth.  Stir into onion mixture.  Add milk.  Cook and stir until mixture thickens and bubbles.  Stir in chicken and mushrooms.  Heat through.   Serve over hot, cooked rice and pass curry condiments.  Makes 5 or 6 servings.

name: SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
4 heaping  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  c. vinegar
1 1/2  c. water or little more if seems too thick
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Beat first 6 ingredients well and add vinegar and water.  Cook on stove until thick.  Add butter when removed from stove.  Add some pepper to taste.  Keeps well in refrigerator.  Good on garden lettuce.

name: 7 HOUR SALAD
ingredients:
1  medium head lettuce, broken into small pieces
1  small head cauliflower, broken into florets
1  small red sweet onion, thinly sliced
1/3  c. sugar
1 1/2 to 1 3/4  c. mayonnaise
Oscar Mayer real bacon bits
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Layer ingredients in long Pyrex or Tupperware container in order as listed, beginning with lettuce and ending with mayonnaise.  As the last layer, sprinkle bacon bits on top. Cover tightly and let stand in refrigerator at least 7 hours, overnight is better.  Toss about one hour before serving time.

name: APPLE PIE
ingredients:
apples
1  stick butter
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
preparation: Cook apples until tender, sweeten to taste.  Melt butter in baking dish.  Mix together the flour, sugar and milk, then pour over butter.  Add fruit on top of mixture, but not stir in.  Bake at 350° until crust comes to the top and browns.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. Wesson oil
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
4  eggs
3  c. grated carrots (use food grinder)
preparation: Sift dry ingredients;  add grated carrots and mix well. Bake in 2 round (9-inch) cake pans at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  qt. strawberries (sweetened), sliced
1  box yellow cake mix
1  box strawberry jello
Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake in two layers according to directions on box.  Prick holes in layers.  Mix jello according to directions on box and spoon jello over cake layers until moist.  Layer Cool Whip between layers and ice entire cake with Cool Whip.

name: GRANDMA'S YOGURT PANCAKES
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/8  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. sugar (omit if using flavored yogurt)
1/2  c. yogurt (we like plain, vanilla or lemon flavors)
1 egg or 1/4  c. egg substitute
1/4  c. water
preparation: Sift together the dry ingredients.  Beat together the yogurt, egg and water and add to dry ingredients gently.  Cook by 1/4 cupfuls on hot greased grill.  Makes 2 servings.

name: CINNAMON ROLLS (LOW-FAT)
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. sugar
4  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. skim milk
6  Tbsp. non-fat vanilla yogurt
1  c. powdered sugar, sifted
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. vegetable margarine, melted
2 1/2  c. Pioneer low-fat biscuit mix
1/2  c. nuts or raisins, optional
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spray a 9 x 13 pan lightly with vegetable cooking spray.  Blend 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl and set aside.  Blend 2 tablespoons sugar, 2 tablespoons margarine, milk, and low-fat biscuit mix in a medium bowl. Add a little milk if needed for dough consistency.  Turn dough onto a surface sprinkled with additional mix.  Roll into a 14 x 16 inch rectangle.  Spread yogurt over dough.  Sprinkle sugar/cinnamon mixture over top.  Sprinkle nuts or raisins across dough.  Roll dough from long side, gently.  Cut into 1 inch slices and place in prepared pan, cut side up.  Bake 25-28 minutes or until golden brown.  Blend powdered sugar, vanilla, and 3 tablespoons water.  Drizzle over cinnamon rolls.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. butter cake mix
1  can Mandarin oranges (do not drain)
3  eggs
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Beat cake mix, eggs, oranges and juice and margarine together for 3 minutes.  Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes in a 350° oven.  Cool and top with Mandarin Orange Frosting.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1  pkg. vegetable soup mix
1  c. mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. sour cream
3  green onions, chopped
8  oz. water chestnuts, drained and chopped
preparation: Thaw and squeeze spinach until dry.  Combine remaining ingredients and blend well.  Add spinach and blend.  Chill 2 hours, covered.

name: MANGO SHAKE
ingredients:
2  mangos
2  cups milk
5  Tbsp. sugar
7  (or more) cubes of ice
preparation: First, slice mangos in cubes and place in a blender.  Then, add 2 cups of milk and add sugar.  Lastly, put in 7 (or more) cubes of ice and blend well.  Pour in glass and enjoy!

name: CHEESY CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
16  chicken wings
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3/4  c. crumbled crackers or fine bread crumbs
3/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. dried basil leaves
1/2  tsp. dried oregano leaves
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
fresh basil or parsley (for garnish)
preparation: Wash chicken wings and pat dry.   In a bowl combine the crumbled crackers or bread crumbs, herbs and Parmesan cheese.  Add seasonings and mix well to blend.  Melt butter.  Dip chicken wings, first in melted butter, then into crumb coating.  Arrange chicken wings in lightly oiled ovenproof baking dish.  Bake chicken wings at 375° for about 30 minutes or until lightly brown and done.  Chicken wings should be tender.   Makes 4 servings.

name: NO CRUST APPLE PIE
ingredients:
7  large apples
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. + 2 Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
1  egg
preparation: Put sliced apples in a 9-inch pan.  Toss with sugar and cinnamon.  Mix together flour, sugar, melted margarine and egg. Pour over apples.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: BABY CARROT JUICE
ingredients:
3  small carrots
1/2  c. water
formula
preparation: Blend together and serve.

name: CEREAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
2  c. quick oats
1  c. crushed corn flakes or Rice Krispies
1/2 to 1  c. ground nuts
7  oz. pkg. chocolate or butterscotch chips
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream fat until soft.  Add sugar gradually; cream until fluffy.  Add the well beaten eggs.  Sift the soda with the flour. Add the remaining ingredients.  Drop on greased cookie sheets; bake in 350° to 375° oven.

name: TOFFEE
ingredients:
1-sleeve saltines - salted
2  sticks butter - unsalted
1-cup sugar
1 12  ounce package milk chocolate bits
1-cup ground nuts (optional)
preparation: Line cookie sheet with aluminum foil.  Line foil with crackers close as you can.  Melt sugar and butter on stovetop; cook 1 minute to dissolve.  Pour over saltines.  Bake at 325 degrees for 15 minutes.  Sprinkle milk chocolate bits over warm crackers and smear after a couple minutes.  While chocolate is warm sprinkle on nuts. Let cool or place in freezer and break into pieces several hours later.

name: FREEZER PICKLES
ingredients:
7  cucumbers, washed, sliced and peeled
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. celery seed
1  c. white vinegar
1  bell pepper, cut in strips
preparation: Mix sugar, vinegar, salt and celery seed and pour over cucumbers.  Add bell pepper and onions.  Stir every 10 minutes until there is enough liquid to cover.  Put in bags and freeze. May be eaten fresh as a salad.

name: MAKE A DREAM PIE
ingredients:
2  envelopes Dream Whip whipped topping mix
2  pkg. (4 serving) Jell-O chocolate flavor instant pudding and pie filling mix
2 3/4  c. cold milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  baked 9-inch pie shell, cooled
preparation: Combine whipped topping mix with 1 cup of the milk and vanilla in large mixer bowl.  Beat on high with electric mixer about 6 minutes or until topping thickens and forms peaks.  Add remaining milk and pie filling mix; blend on low.  Beat on high 2 minutes, scraping bowl occasionally.  Spoon into pie shell.  Refrigerate at least 4 hours.  Store any leftover pie in refrigerator.  Makes 8 servings.

name: HAMBURGER-ONE DISH MEAL
ingredients:
1/2  lb. hamburger
1/2  can tomato soup
1  c. mashed potatoes
1/4  c. chopped onions
2  Tbsp. chopped green peppers
1  c. mixed vegetables, cooked and drained
grated cheese
preparation: Brown hamburg, onions and pepper; add 1/2 can tomato soup to meat mixture.  Mix well.  Add cooked vegetables to meat mixture. Pour mixture into 1-quart baking dish.  Top with mashed potatoes. Bake at 375° until topping is browned.  Sprinkle with grated cheese.

name: HOG-HEAVEN CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. pork sausage ("hot")
1  medium onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, slivered
1 (10 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (13 oz.)  can tomatoes and chilies
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed tomatoes
1 (16 oz.)  can pinto beans
2 (16 oz.)  cans kidney beans
2 (16 oz.)  cans water
1  Tbsp. chili powder
2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. white vinegar
dash of pepper
preparation: Brown beef, sausage, onion and garlic until meat is crumbly. Drain off grease. Place mixture in 8-quart pot. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil, stirring often, then simmer for 3 hours. Add more water as moisture cooks down.  Serve topped with grated Cheddar cheese and a dollop of sour cream. Serves 12.

name: SOUR CREAM DRESSING IRELAND
ingredients:
2  hard-boiled eggs
2  tsp. dry mustard
2  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. malt vinegar
1  c. sour cream
1  head lettuce
salt
preparation: Mash eggs and mix with dry ingredients until well blended. Add vinegar and sour cream gradually.  Wash and tear apart lettuce and put in bowl.  Pour dressing over and serve immediately.

name: EASY BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
12  slices bread (cinnamon extra good)
1 1/2  sticks oleo
5  or 6 eggs (very custardy)
1 3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. milk
cinnamon to taste
dash of salt
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add melted butter; mix thoroughly.  Add sugar, vanilla and milk.  Mix in bread cubes.  Add raisins, if desired. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 300° for 50 minutes.

name: ASPARAGUS ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
25  slices white bread (remove crust)
3  oz. Bleu cheese
8  oz. cream cheese
1  egg, well beaten
14 1/2  oz. can asparagus, drained
1  c. melted butter
preparation: Flatten bread with rolling pin.  Combine cheeses and egg in small bowl; mix well.  Spread evenly on bread, covering to edge. Lay a piece of asparagus on each slice of bread.  Roll up tightly; secure with 3 toothpicks.  Dip in melted butter.  Put on baking sheet.  Freeze.  When ready to serve, thaw slightly.  Slice in 3 equal pieces.  Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.  Serve hot.  Makes 60 pieces.

name: CORN PONE PIE
ingredients:
1  pt. tomatoes
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. chili powder
3/4  tsp. salt
1  lb. hamburger
1/3  c. onion, chopped
1  can kidney beans
corn bread recipe
preparation: Cook hamburger and onion, then add tomatoes, Worcestershire, chili powder and salt.  Simmer for 15 minutes.  Add beans.  Put into greased pan and put corn bread batter (your own recipe or mix) on top.  Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.

name: PIZZA DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sour cream
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. crushed red pepper flakes (optoinal)
1/2  c. pizza sauce
1/2  c. chopped pepperoni
1/4  c. sliced green onions
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: In a small bowl mix cream cheese, sour cream, oregano and garlic powder.  Spread mixture in a 9-inch round baking pan. Spread pizza sauce on cheese mixture.  Sprinkle pepperoni, green onions, oregano and green peppers on top of the sauce.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Remove from oven and sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top.  Return to oven for another 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.  (Can be prepared ahead of time and refrigerated until ready for baking.)  Serve with white corn chips and sliced green peppers for dipping.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. Wesson oil
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  junior size baby food carrots
preparation: Mix eggs and Wesson oil.  Sift together flour, soda, sugar and cinnamon.  Add flour mix to the egg and oil.  Mix well.   Add the baby food carrots.  Mix and pour into cake pans.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Cool and frost with Cream Cheese Icing.

name: SUGAR-FREE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. raisins
2  beaten eggs
1  c. unsweetened applesauce
3  Tbsp. liquid sweetener
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped nuts
2  c. flour
3  c. water
3/4  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Combine and cook raisins and water until water is absorbed. Cool; combine eggs, applesauce, oil, vanilla and sweetener.  Sift flour, soda, salt and spices.  Add to egg mixture.  Add raisins and nuts.  Pour into greased and floured Bundt or tube pan.  Bake at 350° for one hour.

name: STRAWBERRY GLAZE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  oz. pkg. strawberry or cherry jello
preparation: Cook until clear (first 3 ingredients).  Add jello.  Cool. Add fresh strawberries.  Can pour over pound cake or angel food or ice cream.  Can also top with whipped cream if you wish.

name: HUNGARIAN EGG ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. egg roll wraps
1  lb. hamburger
1  tsp. Accent
3  small onions, chopped
medium head cabbage, chopped
1  shredded carrot (optional)
1  tsp. oil
1  egg
preparation: In skillet, brown hamburger and Accent. Drain and set aside. In another skillet, put 1 teaspoon oil. Add cabbage and onion; stir constantly until done. Mix with hamburger. Beat egg in small bowl. Take egg wraps and put about 2 tablespoons hamburger mixture in each wrap. Fold like you would a napkin. With finger, dip in egg and run finger around edge to seal. Fry in deep-fryer.

name: ANNIE'S CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  c. grated sharp cheese
paprika
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients; form into a ball.  Sprinkle with paprika.

name: HEAVENLY CREAM CHEESE BARS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. packed brown sugar
3/4  c. softened margarine
3  c. biscuit mix
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts (walnuts or pecans)
24  oz. cream cheese, softened
3/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
6  tsp. milk (or 2 Tbsp.)
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
preparation: Mix together until crumbly the brown sugar, margarine, biscuit mix and nuts.  Save 3 cups and press remainder into baking pan. Bake 12 minutes at 350°.  Meanwhile, mix together the cream cheese, sugar, lemon juice, milk, vanilla and eggs.  Spread over baked crust.  Sprinkle with reserved crumbs.  Return to oven and bake about 30 minutes or until center is firm.  Cut into 2-inch squares.  Store in refrigerator.  Makes 48 servings.

name: SUMMER SAUSAGE
ingredients:
5  lb. ground meat
5  tsp. Morton Tender Quick
3  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. coarse pepper
2 1/2  tsp. mustard seed
3  tsp. liquid smoke
preparation: Mix all ingredients and place in refrigerator for 4 days. Remove from refrigerator on the fourth day and mix well again.  On the fifth day, remove from the refrigerator and make into 5 rolls. Place on baking sheet and bake for 10 hours at 180°.

name: CARAMEL DIP
ingredients:
1 -  8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together softened cream cheese, brown sugar, and vanilla. Stir until creamy.

name: CHOCOLATE DROPS
ingredients:
1  stick butter
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk (evaporated)
6  Tbsp. cocoa
1/4  c. peanut butter
1  Tbsp. vanilla
3 or more  c. oatmeal
preparation: Mix  butter,  sugar, milk and cocoa together over medium heat. Let it  come to a full boil and boil for 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from  heat.  Add peanut butter and vanilla.  Stir until melted. Add oatmeal and stir until coated good.  Drop by spoon on wax paper and let cool.

name: CARAMEL POPCORN
ingredients:
8  qt. popped corn
2  c. brown sugar (1 box)
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. white syrup
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. water
1/3  c. butter or margarine
1 2/3  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Cook sugar, water, butter and vinegar in large pot until amber in center.  Do not stir!  When sugar mixture is amber, stir in corn and spread on flat pans to cool.  Break in pieces.

name: CRAB DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. mustard with horseradish
1 1/2  Tbsp. minced onion
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
dash of garlic powder
6 to 8  oz. crabmeat
preparation: Blend together cream cheese (softened), mayonnaise, mustard, onion and seasoned salt.  Fold in parsley, garlic powder and crabmeat.  Serve hot or cold with crackers or vegetables.

name: BLACK BOTTOM CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. plain flour
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. water
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/3  c. sugar
1  egg
1/8  tsp. salt
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients.  Stir in water, oil, vinegar and vanilla.  Spoon batter into paper lined muffin tins, filling 2/3 full with cream cheese and 1/3 cup sugar.  Add egg and salt, beating well.  Stir in chocolate morsels.  Spoon one heaping teaspoonful of this mixture into center of each cupcake.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 10 minutes in pan before serving.

name: STROMBOLI
ingredients:
frozen bread dough, thawed
vegetable oil
1/2 to 1  c. mushrooms
1/2 to 1  c. onions
1/2 to 1  c. green peppers
4 to 6  oz. sliced salami
4 to 6  oz. sliced roast beef
4 to 6  oz. sliced ham
1  c. pepperoni, sliced thin
1 to 2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Dice and saute mushrooms, onions and green peppers; set aside. Rub vegetable oil on both sides of bread dough and on the surface that you roll it out on.  Roll it into an oblong shape. Spread sauteed ingredients evenly over the dough. Leave a 1/2-inch border around the dough.  Layer meats and sprinkle generously with cheese.  Roll up and place on cookie sheet.  Let rise for about 2 hours.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bread feels done.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 to 2  c. cooked and cut-up chicken
1  c. celery, diced
1  small onion, diced
1  c. English walnuts
1  c. cream of chicken soup
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. lemon juice in 1/4 c. water
3  hard-boiled eggs, diced
3/4  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Cover with 2 cups crushed potato chips.  Bake 3/4 hour at 350° in 8 x 8-inch baking dish.

name: DEVILED EGGS
ingredients:
6  hard-cooked eggs
1/4  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. pickled jalapeno slices, minced
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/3  tsp. ground cumin
1/8  tsp. salt
chili powder and fresh parsley sprigs (garnishes)
preparation: Cut eggs in half lengthwise and carefully remove yolks. Mash egg yolks in a small bowl. Stir in mayonnaise and next 4 ingredients and blend well. Spoon or pipe yolk mixture evenly into egg white halves. Garnish if desired. Chill.

name: BRAN MUFFINS AND JAM
ingredients:
2/3  c. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. Calumet baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  egg, beaten
3/4  c. milk
3  Tbsp. shortening, melted
1 1/2  c. Post 40% Bran flakes
2 to 3  Tbsp. jam or marmalade
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.  Combine egg and milk; add to flour mixture, then add shortening and mix only enough to dampen flour.  Fold in cereal.  Fill greased muffin pans 1/3 full.  Spoon 1 teaspoon jam onto batter in each cup, then top with remaining batter.  Bake at 425° 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes 8 muffins.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked squash, mashed and drained
1  large onion, diced and cooked with squash
2  eggs, well beaten
1/2  pkg. crushed saltines
3  c. sharp/medium sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. milk
1/8  tsp. garlic salt
2  Tbsp. margarine
salt and pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients and pour into well-greased baking dish. Top with additional crushed saltines. Bake about 30 minutes at 350°.

name: PINEAPPLE COLESLAW
ingredients:
1  large cabbage, shredded
3  large carrots
1/2  c. crushed drained pineapple
2  tsp. raisins
1/4  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. pineapple juice
1  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients together, then mix rest of ingredients and pour over the others.  Cover and refrigerate.

name: JELLO ICE CREAM SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. Jell-O (any flavor or use 2 different flavors)
2  c. boiling water
3/4  c. cold water
sliced fruit (like bananas, strawberries or any fresh fruit)
1  c. ice cream
preparation: Dissolve 1 package gelatin in 1 cup boiling water.  Stir in cold water.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Stir in fruit.  Pour into mold; chill until firm.  Dissolve 1 package gelatin in 1 cup boiling water.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Stir in ice cream.  Pour over gelatin in mold.  Chill until thickened.  May use Cool Whip as garnish.

name: CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
2  c. clean clams
2  cans plain biscuits
3  Irish potatoes
3  strips fatback meat
2  medium onions
salt and pepper
preparation: Bring clams to a boil.  Drain water off.  Fry fatback meat and brown onion in the grease.  Add meat and onions to clams; add 6 cups water.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Dice up potatoes and add to clams.  Boil for 30 minutes.  Cut biscuits up into quarters and roll into balls.  Drop into boiling clam broth and cook until done.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. cubed zucchini
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of celery soup or cream of mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. shredded carrots
8  oz. pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb flavor stuffing
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
preparation: Combine soup, sour cream and carrots.  Fold in squash and onion.  In another bowl, combine stuffing and batter.  Spread 1/2 of the stuffing in the bottom of a 12 x 9-inch pan.  Spoon on the vegetable mixture.  Add remaining stuffing.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: GINGERBREAD COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1/2  c. Crisco
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1  egg
5  Tbsp. Brer Rabbit molasses
1  tsp. soda
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Add to remaining mixture.  Sprinkle crumbs on top.  Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes in greased and floured 8-inch square pan.

name: ZESTY NEW POTATOES
ingredients:
1  lb. new potatoes
3  Tbsp. chopped scallions
2  tsp. chopped parsley
1/3  c. sliced celery
1/4  c. prepared Good Seasons salad dressing
preparation: Boil unpeeled potatoes until just tender.  Drain and cut in chunks. Add celery and scallions. Add salad dressing and toss lightly. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve warm or chilled.   Makes 4 servings.  Contains 180 calories each.

name: CRESCENT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. almond flavoring
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. broken pecan pieces
preparation: Combine all  ingredients and mix well.  Make into small balls. Roll  slightly by hand and shape into crescents.  Bake on a lightly  greased cookie tin in a 325° oven for about 8 to 10 minutes.  When cool, roll in powdered sugar.

name: HOT COCOA MIX
ingredients:
1  c. nondairy creamer
1  c. nonfat dry milk
3/4  c. to 1 c. sugar
1/2  c. unsweetened cocoa
preparation: In medium bowl or jar combine ingredients.  Mix well.  Store in airtight container.  To serve, use 3 heaping tablespoonfuls mixture in mug.  Add 3/4 cup boiling water.

name: POTATO APPETIZERS COUNTRY STYLE
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton onion soup mix
1  c. warm mashed potatoes
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  In bowl, combine soup mix with potatoes, butter and flour.  On floured board, roll dough to 1/4 inch thickness.  Cut into shapes with cookie cutters.  Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 12 minutes.

name: SPICY PRETZELS
ingredients:
1  lb. broken large pretzels
1  c. oil
1  tsp. garlic powder
2  tsp. dill powder
2  tsp. lemon pepper salt
1  pkg. Ranch dressing
preparation: Mix oil, garlic, dill, lemon pepper and Ranch dressing.  Toss in pretzels (small pieces).  Place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Use all oil mixture.  Loose pretzel bits can be purchased at some markets.  Boxed ones can be used also.

name: CHRISTMAS BONBONS
ingredients:
1  can sweetened condensed milk
2  lb. powdered sugar
1  c. oleo or butter
1  pkg. (7 oz.) flaked coconut
2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. glace cherries
4  pkg. (8 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate
preparation: Combine milk, powdered sugar and oleo.  Mix until smooth and creamy.  Add coconut, walnuts and cherries; mix thoroughly.  Chill 1 hour.  Form into small balls.  Chill another 2 hours.  Melt chocolate.  Dip individually into chocolate.  Place on waxed paper to cool.  Chill in refrigerator.  Makes about 150 pieces.

name: NUT HORNS
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  pkg. active dry yeast or 1 cake compressed yeast
4  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  c. butter
4  eggs
preparation: Have all ingredients at room temperature.  In small saucepan heat milk to lukewarm (105° to 115°).  Stir in sugar and yeast. Let stand 10 minutes until bubbly.  Measure flour into large bowl. Add butter; cut in with pastry blender or 2 knives used scissor/fashion until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Stir in yeast mixture and egg yolks; knead until dough is smooth.  Shape into a ball.   Set aside.  Grease 2 large cookie sheets.

name: MEAT LOAF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
your favorite meat loaf (using 1 to 1 1/2 lb.) hamburger
1  can golden mushroom soup
1  qt. green beans, partially drained
1  large bag Tater Tots
preparation: Mix together your favorite meat loaf and put  in  a 9 x 13-inch pan (should be fairly thin).  Bake at  350° for 1/2 to 3/4 hour.  While hot, spread soup over  meat loaf, then spread on green beans.  Next add Tater Tots  in  rows.  (Sometimes  I use  a biscuit recipe and drop unbaked  biscuits  on  top  in rows.) Put back in oven and bake at 350° until all ingredients are hot or biscuits are done, approximately  25 to 30 minutes. You  can keep a meat loaf ready in the  9  x  13-inch  pan  in freezer.

name: CRANBERRY-APPLE KETCHUP
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans jellied cranberry sauce
1 (24 oz.)  jar applesauce
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
2  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
1  tsp. grated orange peel
preparation: In a large saucepan, using a wire whisk, whip cranberry sauce. Then add the remaining ingredients.  Place over medium heat, whisking occasionally until smooth, and flavors are blended, about 15 minutes.  Cool slightly.  Pour into gift bottle or jars and cover.  Refrigerate up to one month.  This is very good served with turkey, pork or game.

name: SOUTHWESTERN EGG BAKE
ingredients:
2  c. corn bread stuffing crumbs
1  can (15 1/4 oz.) whole kernel corn, drained
1  can (4 oz.) chopped green chilies
1/2  c. sour cream
7  eggs
1  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese (4 oz.)
Salsa, if desired
preparation: Heat oven to 400°. Spray rectangular baking dish, 13 x 9 x 2 inches, with nonstick cooking spray. Mix stuffing, corn, chilies, sour cream and 1 egg in large bowl. Spread evenly in baking dish. Make 6 indentations in stuffing mixture with back of spoon. Break 1 egg into each indentation. Pierce yolk of each egg with fork. Bake uncovered 20 to 25 minutes or until egg whites and yolks are not runny. Sprinkle cheese over stuffing mixture. Bake 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve with salsa.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
dash of salt
2 1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. milk with 2 Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: GRANDMA PONDEN'S COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
3/4  c. light Karo syrup
3/4  c. oatmeal
1/2  c. melted butter
1/2  c. milk
2  beaten eggs
1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Mix together all ingredients.  Pour into uncooked 9-inch pie shell of favorite crust.  Bake at 350° for about 60 minutes or until golden brown.

name: BACON-CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sour cream
1  bell pepper, finely chopped
1  jalapeno pepper, finely chopped
4  to 5 green onions, finely chopped
1  jar bacon bits
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
Tony Chachere Creole seasoning to taste
preparation: Add all of the ingredients together.  Mix well; chill.  Serve with Waverly crackers.

name: MAMMIE'S SEAFOOD FETTUCINI
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
2  onions
2  ribs celery
2  pods garlic
1  bell pepper
4  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. parsley
2  lb. seafood (crawfish, shrimp or crabmeat)
2  c. half and half (milk)
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
2  jalapeno peppers, chopped
sliced mushrooms (optional)
preparation: First saute in butter onions, celery, garlic and pepper in an iron skillet. Add the flour, parsley and seafood. Cook for 10 minutes. After that, add the milk (half and half), cheese, peppers and mushrooms. Cook until all is well blended.

name: PASTA SAUCE "CALIFORNIA STYLE"
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh tomatoes, diced
1 to 2  Tbsp. garlic powder (not garlic salt!!)
1/2  can tomato puree
1  tsp. sugar or honey
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1/3  c. parsley flakes
2 to 3  Tbsp. tomato paste
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat oil in a 3-quart saucepan or skillet with high sides. Add diced tomatoes.  Cook, covered, over medium heat for about 15 minutes or until tomatoes are soft.  Add parsley flakes or basil, garlic powder, sugar and tomato paste. If sauce is not liquid enough, add tomato puree to reach the desired consistency.  Just before serving, stir in salt.  Garnish pasta with fresh grated Parmesan cheese.

name: BROCCOLI PECAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. mayo
3/4  c. chopped pecans
2  eggs, well beaten
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1  c. bread crumbs, buttered
preparation: Cook broccoli according to directions on package.  Drain.  Add soup, mayo and chopped pecans.  Mix well. Add eggs and onion. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cheese and bread crumbs. Dot with butter.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: PEPPER RELISH
ingredients:
1  doz. red peppers
1  doz. green peppers
6  small onions
3  hot peppers
1  pt. vinegar
1  pt. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Put through food chopper.  Cover with boiling water; let stand 10 minutes.  Drain well.  Boil 1 pint vinegar, 1 pint water, 1 1/2 cups sugar and 1 tablespoon salt.  Put mixture in peppers and boil all together for 5 to 10 minutes.  Can and seal.

name: CHICKEN AND DRESSING
ingredients:
1  pan cornbread (2 c. meal, 1 c. flour)
1  chicken, cooked
2  medium onions, chopped
4  celery stalks, diced
4  boiled eggs, mashed
black pepper to taste
salt to taste
preparation: Debone chicken, cut into pieces.  Crumble bread in large bowl. Add all ingredients.  Pour broth from cooked chicken over all ingredients.  Bake in shallow pan about 30 minutes at 350°.

name: WHOLE WHEAT BUBBLE BREAD
ingredients:
2 to 2 1/2  c. bread flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  pkg. active dry yeast
1 1/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  egg
1 1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
4  tsp. sesame seed
preparation: Grease 2-quart deep casserole dish or 2 (8 x 4-inch) loaf pans.  Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup  and level off.  In large bowl, combine bread flour, sugar, salt and dry yeast.  Blend well.  In small saucepan, heat milk and margarine until very warm (120° to 130°).  Add egg and blend into flour mixture.  Beat at low speed until mixed and moistened with mixer blades.  Beat 3 minutes at medium speed.  By hand, stir in whole wheat flour to form stiff dough.  On floured surface, knead in 1 to 1 1/2 cups additional bread flour until dough is smooth and elastic (5 to 10 minutes).  Place in greased bowl; cover loosely with plastic wrap and cloth towel.

name: COCONUT POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
1  c. Crisco
6  eggs, separated
1  c. milk
3  c. flour
1  tsp. coconut flavoring
1  tsp. almond flavoring
2  c. coconut
preparation: Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside.  Cream shortenings, sugar and egg yolks.  Gradually add milk and flour; mix well.  Add flavorings.  Fold in coconut.  Fold in egg whites last.  Stir only until mixed well.  Bake in tube pan at 300° for 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 hours.

name: FRIED POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. potatoes, peeled and diced
1/2  lb. bacon
sweet pickle relish or dill pickles
3  stalks celery, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. mustard
2  boiled eggs, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Fry bacon crisp; put aside to drain on paper towel.  Fry potatoes in bacon grease. Stir together all other ingredients in large bowl.  Add crumbled bacon and fried potatoes.  Serve warm or refrigerate to cool.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
16  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. crushed pineapple, drained
2  Tbsp. grated onion
1/4  c. finely chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. season salt
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine 1st five ingredients. Put in refrigerator and chill. Take out and roll in pecans. Makes 2 balls.

name: PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can pizza sauce
1 small  can tomato sauce
2  c. rotini
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
your favorite pizza toppings
preparation: Cook rotini according to package.  Brown beef.  Add sauce to meat and mix with cooked rotini.  Pour 1/2 of mixture into 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Cover with 1 cup Mozzarella cheese. Pour rest of mixture into dish and top with remaining cheese and your favorite pizza toppings.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes, until cheese melts.

name: GUAVA JELLO
ingredients:
2 3/4  c. water
1/2  c. sugar
1  box strawberry jello
3  pkg. Knox gelatine
1  can frozen guava juice
preparation: Boil 2 cups of water.  Add sugar to boiling water and stir until sugar dissolves; add jello.  In another bowl, melt gelatine in 3/4 cup cold water.  Pour jello mixture into gelatine mixture and add guava juice.  Pour into 8 x 8-inch pan and refrigerate overnight.  Cut and serve.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PIE
ingredients:
3/4  stick oleo
2 2/3  c. sugar
3/4  c. self-rising flour
6  eggs
3  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. coconut
preparation: Mix all together and beat 1 1/2 minutes.  Pour into two 9-inch pie pans.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: TACO CASSEROLE(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
8  oz. cheese, shredded
1  can mushroom soup
1  can enchilada sauce
1  pkg. corn chips, crushed
preparation: Brown beef and onion in skillet, stirring until crumbly and drain.  Add cheese, soup and sauce, mixing well.  Place corn chips in glass baking dish; pour beef mixture over chips.  Microwave on High until cheese is melted.  Yields 5 to 6 servings.

name: BOSTON BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2  c. dried navy beans
1/2  lb. salt pork, halved
1/2  c. dark molasses
2  tsp. grated onion
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Soak beans overnight in water to cover. Bring to a boil in the same water, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 hour. Drain; save water. Put half of pork in 6-cup bean pot. Add beans, molasses, onion, mustard and 1/2 cup bean water. Put other pork half on top. Cover and bake in a slow oven (300°) for 5 hours, adding bean water if needed. Uncover. Bake for 1 hour. Serves 6.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE 5
ingredients:
1  qt. cooked squash
1  large onion, cooked
grated cheese
1  can cream of chicken or mushroom soup
12  saltine crackers (2-inch square)
preparation: Mash squash and onion and place in rectangular casserole.  Mix broken crackers and soup and pour over squash mixture.  Top with grated cheese.  Put in cold oven and turn heat to 350°.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes until cheese is brown.  Serves 8.

name: HAPPY HOME RECIPE
ingredients:
4  c. Love
2  c. Loyalty
3  c. Forgiveness
1  c. Friendship
5  spoons Hope
2  spoons Tenderness
4  qt. Faith
1  barrel of Laughter
preparation: Take Love and Loyalty; mix thoroughly with Faith.  Blend it with Tenderness, Kindness and Understanding.  Add Friendship and Hope; sprinkle abundantly with Laughter.  Bake it with Sunshine. Serve daily with generous helpings.

name: SOUP DE JOUR
ingredients:
finely chopped onion and green pepper
1  pkg. dry vegetable soup mix
leftovers
seasonings:  thyme, basil, your choice
bouillon cube (optional)
noodles
preparation: Lightly saute onion and peppers in a large pot.  Add soup mix and water and cook for awhile.  Add leftovers from refrigerator and freezer.  Let it simmer for a while.  Taste seasoning; add herbs. Add water as needed or V-8 juice.  Add noodles near end of cooking. A little white wine or dry sherry or a teaspoon or so of red wine vinegar might be nice.

name: RED CHRISTMAS CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/4  c. red food coloring
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. white vinegar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  Tbsp. cocoa
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, and beat.  Mix food coloring and cocoa together; add to creamed mixture, blending well.  Combine buttermilk and vanilla.  Add flour and salt alternately with buttermilk and vanilla to creamed mixture.  Combine vinegar and soda; add to mixture while still foaming.

name: BUTTERMILK CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
2  c. buttermilk
1/2  stick butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
6  eggs, separated (save whites for meringue)
1  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  deep dish pie shell
2  tsp. sugar
pinch of salt
preparation: In 2-quart saucepan on top of stove, add sugar, eggs and flour.  Mix very well.  Add milk.  Stir well.  Cook on low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thick.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Be sure to prick bottom of crust.  Bake at 350° until set.

name: VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  small  Tub Sour Cream
Equal amount of Hellman's Mayonnaise
4  minced whole Green Onions
1  can Water Chestnuts
1/2  tsp. Worchestershire sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Serve with fresh vegetables...cucumbers, carrots, celery etc or with chips as a dip.

name: STRAWBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1 large  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1  large Cool Whip
1  jar strawberry glaze
1 to 2  pt. fresh strawberries
preparation: Break cake up into pieces to fit bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Prepare pudding as directed on box and pour evenly over cake.  Cut strawberries into slices.  Mix well with glaze and spread over pudding.  Spread Cool Whip around outer edges on top of strawberry mixture, letting the strawberries show in middle.  Garnish with whole strawberries.  Refrigerate before serving.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening or butter (softened, not melted)
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla, almond or orange extract
3 2/3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
1/2  c. commercial sour cream
preparation: Mix butter or shortening and sugar together.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Mix until smooth.  Add flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt (optional) and sour cream.  Mix until all ingredients are blended and dough is in a ball form.

name: SOMBRERO DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2  c. minced onions
1  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. hot catsup
1  can red kidney beans or pinto, mashed slightly
1  can jalapeno bean dip
2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
finely minced onions
preparation: Simmer hamburger in small amount of fat until cooked, not brown.  Add and simmer slowly chili powder, minced onions, garlic and salt.  Add and simmer for 30 minutes hot catsup, kidney beans and jalapeno bean dip.  Place in chafing dish.  Sprinkle around edge, shredded sharp Cheddar cheese and finely minced onions.

name: SAUTEED SOFT CRABS
ingredients:
cleaned soft crabs
butter or 4 strips bacon
salt
pepper
1/4  tsp. dry mustard per crab
dash of Worcestershire sauce per crab
flour
toast
1/4  c. blanched almonds (if desired)
preparation: Pat cleaned soft crabs with paper to dry; salt and pepper each crab.  Lightly dust with flour.  Fold back shell on each side and sprinkle 1/8 teaspoon dry mustard on each side.  Heat butter in skillet (strips of bacon may be substituted for butter).  Brown crabs for about 5 minutes on each side.  Put a dash of Worcestershire on each crab.  Serve on toast (with bacon strip or sprinkle with sliced almonds which have been sauteed in butter).

name: CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
4  chicken bouillon cubes
1  c. chopped celery
2 1/2  c. cubed potatoes
1  (10 oz.) frozen California vegetables
2  cans cream of chicken soup + 1/2 can water
1  lb. diced Velveeta cheese
2  qt. water
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. diced carrots
preparation: Boil bouillon cubes, water, celery, carrots, potatoes and onions for 20 minutes.  Add frozen vegetables and cook until tender.  Add cream of chicken soup, 1/2 can of water and cheese. Stir until desired consistency.  Serves 8.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
1  pkg. Ranch dressing
1  Tbsp. dill weed
assortment fresh crisp vegetables
preparation: Mix and chill.  Serve with vegetables.

name: KIFLE
ingredients:
1  lb. Crisco
6  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
6  egg yolks
1  c. sugar
2  yeast cakes or dry yeast
1 1/2  c. warm milk
preparation: Mix flour, salt, sugar and Crisco like pie dough.  Dissolve yeast in warm milk, then mix egg yolks, yeast and vanilla in flour mixture with a little warm milk at a time.  Use more flour if needed.  Mix dough with hands until it doesn't stick.  Put in refrigerator for at least 3 hours.  Then roll out on pastry board a little at a time with flour and sugar on board.  Cut in small squares and fill with prune nut filling.  You can buy prune nut filling or you can make your own.  Bake at 350° until brown.

name: GOURMET POTATOES
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1/3  c. finely chopped green onions
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. butter
paprika
preparation: Cook potatoes in skins; cool.  Peel and shred coarsely.  In saucepan over low heat, combine cheese and butter, stirring occasionally until almost melted.  Remove from heat and blend in sour cream, onions and seasonings.  Fold in potatoes and turn into greased 2-quart casserole dish.  Dot with 2 tablespoons butter and sprinkle with paprika.  Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes or until heated through.  Serves 8.

name: CHOCOLATE SACK
ingredients:
1  sheet Pepperidge Farm frozen puff pastry
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate
1/3  c. walnuts, chopped
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  Tbsp. Grand Marnier (optional)
confectioners sugar
preparation: Thaw pastry 20 minutes.  Preheat oven to 425°.  On a lightly floured board, roll pastry to a 14-inch square.  In the center of the square, place chocolate, walnuts and butter; sprinkle with Grand Marnier.  Pull pastry edges together, twist and turn.  Place on ungreased baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.  Let stand at least 10 minutes.  Sprinkle with confectioners sugar and serve. Serves 6.

name: DOUBLE ALMOND COOKIES
ingredients:
1  recipe Basic Sliced Cookies
1 (8 oz.)  can almond paste
1/3  c. sugar
1/4  c. milk
2/3  c. sliced almonds
preparation: Prepare and chill dough for Basic Sliced Cookies as directed.

name: BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  chicken, cut up
Ritz cracker crumbs
1  c. melted butter
preparation: Dip the chicken in the butter, then roll it in the cracker crumbs.  Bake for 30 minutes, or until well done.

name: WELCH RAREBIT
ingredients:
1  lb. cheese, cut into cubes
1  c. beer
