2  egg yolks, well beaten
1  Tbsp. butter
paprika to taste
1 level  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Put beer in pan and boil.  Add cheese, butter and seasonings. Add eggs and cook a few minutes, until cheese is melted.  If thick, add more beer.  Serve over toast.

name: STAINED GLASS FRUITCAKE
ingredients:
11  oz. dried apricots, cut in half
16  oz. diced mixed fruit and peel
8  oz. whole candied cherries
1 1/2  c. halved pecans
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
4  large eggs
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix together  diced  fruit, apricots, cherries and nuts with 1/2 cup  flour.  Cream  butter  and  sugar well.  Beat in eggs, one at a  time.  Stir  in  lemon juice; add dry ingredients, blending well.  Pour into loaf pans lined with wax paper (9 x 5 x 3-inches).	Bake  at  250°	for 1 1/2 hours or until lightly browned.  This  freezes  really well and can be sliced and toasted any time.

name: CREAM CHEESE VEGGIE DIP
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  onion, diced
1/2  green pepper, diced
dash of salt
preparation: Combine beaten eggs, sugar and vinegar in medium saucepan. Over low heat, slowly melt cream cheese in pan.  Stir continuously with a whisk.  Continue heating until thickens.  Remove from heat and stir in onion and green pepper.  Chill and serve with veggies.

name: APRICOT SALAD
ingredients:
1 medium  can pineapple
2 small  pkg. apricot jello
2 small  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. ice water
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. pecans
1/2  c. sugar
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Mix pineapple and sugar, bring to a full boil.  Take off, add jello and cream cheese.  Stir in first mixture until cream cheese had dissolved.  Add ice water, celery and nuts.  Put in box, let thicken slightly and then add Cool Whip.

name: COMPANY BAKED FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
1  (8 to 9-day old) loaf French bread, cut into 1-inch slices
3  eggs
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
6  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. margarine
1  c. fresh or frozen blueberries
1  c. sliced strawberries
preparation: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Place bread slices in dish. Lightly beat eggs, sugar and vanilla.  Stir in milk; pour mixture over bread.  Turn bread to coat well. Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Combine flour, brown sugar and cinnamon.  Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Turn bread over again.  Scatter blueberries over bread.  Sprinkle evenly with crumb mixture.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Top with strawberries to serve.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream style corn
1  c. uncooked macaroni
1  can whole kernel corn, undrained
1  c. grated cheese
3/4  stick oleo
1/3  c. grated onion
1/3  c. grated green and red pepper (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Put in buttered casserole.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: CHOCOLATE GRAVY
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla flavor
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients in skillet; add small amount of milk to get ingredients stirred.  Gradually add remaining milk.  When gravy begins to thicken, remove from heat and add vanilla flavoring.  Spoon over hot biscuits.  Children love it!

name: BRANDIED PEACHES
ingredients:
5  lb. firm ripe peaches
5  c. sugar
5  c. water
brandy
preparation: Rub fuzz from peaches with a coarse towel.  Mix sugar and water in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil.  Add peaches and simmer for 5 minutes.  Drain peaches.  Place in sterilized quart jars (saving sugar).  Pour 1/4 cup brandy into each quart.  Pour syrup over peaches and seal.  Process in hot water bath for 15 minutes.  Store for 3 months in cool, dark place before using.

name: BLONDE BROWNIES
ingredients:
2 2/3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
2/3  c. butter
2 1/4  c. brown sugar
3  eggs
chocolate chips
1  c. walnuts
preparation: Melt butter in large saucepan.  Add and blend in well the brown sugar.  Let cool 10 minutes.  Beat in eggs one at a time. Add mixture of flour, salt and baking powder and blend.  Add chocolate chips and walnuts.  Spread on greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 25 to 30 minutes in a 350° oven.  Cut in squares while warm.

name: OATMEAL CHOCOLATE CHIP CAKE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. boiling water
1  c. uncooked oatmeal
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine
2  eggs
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. cocoa powder
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
3/4  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Pour water over oatmeal in bowl.  Let it stand for 10 minutes. Add brown sugar, sugar and margarine.  Add eggs and mix well.  In another bowl, mix flour, baking soda, salt and cocoa, then add this to oatmeal mixture.  Now add 2/3 of the chocolate chips and the walnuts.  Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle with remaining chocolate chips.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE CHESS PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  Tbsp. flour
1  stick oleo
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. corn meal
1 small  can pineapple (crushed)
preparation: Mix well and pour in unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Reduce oven heat to 325°  and bake for 30 minutes.

name: LEMON DILL CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  boneless chicken breasts
salt and pepper to taste
1/4  c. fresh chopped dill or 4 tsp. dried dill
1/4  c. chopped parsley
3  cloves garlic, minced
2  lemons
butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Pound chicken breasts until flattened. Place each on a sheet of foil.  Season with salt and pepper. Blend dill, parsley and garlic.  Sprinkle over breasts.  Place 3 lemon slices on each breast.  Dot with butter.  Seal chicken in foil.  Place on baking sheet.   Bake 30 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: SPAGHETTI WITH TUNA SAUCE
ingredients:
1  clove garlic, minced
5  Tbsp. olive oil
3  Tbsp. parsley, chopped
1 large  can crushed tomatoes
1  can tuna fish (packed in oil), drained
freshly ground pepper
3  Tbsp. butter
1  lb. spaghetti or linguini
preparation: In skillet, saute garlic with all the olive oil over medium heat. Add parsley and cook for 1/2 minute. Add tomatoes. Stir well.  Lower heat and cook at a gentle simmer for 25 minutes or until tomatoes separate from oil.  Add salt and pepper.  Mix in the drained tuna.  Mix well and cook for 5 minutes. Add butter and serve over pasta.

name: WINTRY DAY BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
2  c. beans
2  Tbsp. salt
2  qt. water
2  c. diced ham or sliced, smoked sausage
1  large onion, chopped
1  garlic clove
1  tsp. chili powder
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 to 2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Rinse beans.  Place in large kettle.  Cover with water.  Add salt and soak overnight.  Drain.  Add 2-quarts water and ham or sausage.  Simmer for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.  Add onion, garlic, chili powder, tomatoes and lemon juice.  Simmer 45 minutes.  Add salt and pepper, if desired.  Makes 2-quarts.

name: HAYSTACKS
ingredients:
28  caramels
3  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. water
1 (3 oz.)  can chow mein noodles
1  c. peanuts
6  oz. bag semi-sweet chocolate pieces
2  Tbsp. evaporated milk
preparation: Melt the caramels with margarine and water in saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally, until sauce is smooth.  Add noodles and peanuts (noodles can be broken and nuts chopped, if desired).  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet greased with margarine.

name: CRUSTLESS CRAB QUICHE
ingredients:
nonstick cooking spray
1  tsp. olive oil
1  yellow onion, chopped
4  roma tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
1  green onion, chopped
2  c. fresh or canned crab meat
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dried dill
1  c. chopped fresh parsley
1/4  tsp. white pepper
1 - 8  oz. carton fat free liquid egg substitute
3  Tbsp. grated parmesan cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Lightly coat a 10 inch glass pie pan with cooking spray.  Set aside.  In large nonstick skillet heat olive oil over medium low heat.  Add onion and sauté 2 to 3 minutes until soft.  Add tomatoes and green onion.  Cook 3-4 minutes until tomatoes give up moisture but not until soupy. Remove from heat and cool slightly.  In medium bowl combine crab, salt, white pepper, dill and parsley.  Stir in tomato and onion mixture.  Toss to mix evenly.  Pour egg substitute on top, stir well.  Transfer to pie pan.  Sprinkle parmesan cheese on top. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until set.  Cool 10 - 15 minutes before cutting.

name: NORWEGIAN MEATBALLS AND CELERY
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  c. chopped beef
1  c. chopped pork
1  c. chopped veal
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (13+ oz.)  can chicken broth
2  egg whites, beaten
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
8  c. sliced celery
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of celery soup
preparation: Cook onion in 2 tablespoons butter until transparent.  In large bowl, mix 1/2 chicken broth, onion, meats, salt, nutmeg and pepper.  Beat egg whites into soft peaks.  Mix lightly into meat mixture.  Shape into 18 balls.  Melt 3 teaspoons butter in heavy skillet, brown 9 meatballs.  Remove.  Add remaining 3 tablespoons butter and remaining meatballs.  Remove.

name: CHICKEN MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. mayonnaise
2  c. cooked macaroni
2  c. cooked chicken, diced
1  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. sweet pickle relish
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion or scallions
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Blend lemon juice into mayonnaise.  Combine with remaining ingredients.  Chill.

name: BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. boiling water
1  c. seedless raisins
2 1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. buttermilk
2 3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. nuts
2  c. All-Bran
1  c. 40% bran flakes
preparation: Pour the boiling water over the raisins. Add the soda.  Cool. Cream the shortening and sugar. Add the eggs and buttermilk.  Fold into the flour, salt, nuts, All-Bran and bran flakes.  Mix all only until moist. Store in covered bowl in refrigerator until ready to bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes in greased muffin tins. Batter will keep in refrigerator up to 6 weeks.

name: WALDORF SLAW SALAD
ingredients:
6  c. coarsely shredded green cabbage
bite size chunks of nice, big apple with peel
1/2  c. raisins
1  c. Marzetti slaw dressing (original or light)
apple slices for garnish, dipped in lemon juice to prevent browning
1/4  c. chopped walnuts for garnish
preparation: When you're tired of salads that taste like an afterthought, try this twist on a great American classic.  Combine cabbage, apple chunks and raisins.  Pour on slaw dressing and toss gently to coat everything with its delicious, tangy flavor.  Chill to let flavors blend.  Before serving, garnish with more apple slices and chopped walnuts.

name: SUKIYAKI
ingredients:
1/2  c. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. sugar
3/4  c. chicken broth
1/2  lb. fresh spinach
8  scallions
1  large onion, peeled
1  can sliced bamboo shoots
1  lb. thinly sliced beef tenderloin or sirloin
1/2  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
2  Tbsp. oil
rice
preparation: In bowl, combine soy sauce, sugar and broth.  Prepare spinach. Snip into small pieces.  Slice scallions into 2-inch lengths. Cut onion into 1/4-inch slices.  Heat oil in wok or skillet.  Add scallions, onion, mushrooms, bamboo shoots.  Pour sauce mix over it and cook on high for 4 minutes.  Push spinach and meat onto vegetables in wok.  Simmer for 2 minutes.  Push spinach and meat down into sauce.  Cook 3 minutes. Serve on top of hot rice. Serves 4 to 5.

name: LIGHT 'N FRUITY PIE
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. Jell-O
2/3  c. boiling water
2  c. ice cubes
3 1/2  c. thawed Cool Whip whipped topping
1  c. diced fresh or canned fruit, drained and diced
9-inch prepared graham cracker crumb crust
preparation: Dissolve gelatin completely in boiling water, stirring about 3 minutes.  Add ice cubes and stir constantly until gelatin is thickened, about 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove any unmelted ice.  Using a wire whip, blend in whipped topping; then whip until smooth. Fold in fruit and chill, if necessary, until mixture will mound. Spoon into pie crust.   Chill 2 hours.  Garnish as desired.

name: TACO PIE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. biscuits
1  lb. ground turkey
1  Tbsp. beef bouillon
2  Tbsp. onions, chopped
2  Tbsp. green peppers
salt and pepper to taste
3/4  c. tomato paste
3/4  c. water
1  packet taco seasoning
8  oz. grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Press biscuits into 9-inch pie tin.  Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, until crust is brown.  Each serving: 1 bread, 5 protein, 1/2 vegetable.

name: HERBED CHEESE AND ONION BREAD
ingredients:
1  envelope active dry yeast
1/4  c. chicken broth
1 1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. onion, finely chopped
1/4  tsp. crushed rosemary
1/2  tsp. dill
1/4  tsp. marjoram
1/2  c. lukewarm milk
1/4  c. chicken stock or broth
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: In a small bowl, proof yeast in 1/4 cup chicken broth for 10 minutes.  Into a large bowl, sift together the whole wheat flour and salt.  Add cheese, onion, rosemary, dill and marjoram and toss.  In another bowl, combine milk, the yeast mixture, chicken stock or broth, 1 egg and honey; when well combined, add to flour mixture, stirring until the dough is well blended.  Gradually add all-purpose flour and blend the dough until it forms a ball.  Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead it, adding more flour if it is too sticky, for 10 minutes, or until it is smooth and elastic.  Form the dough into a ball; put it in a buttered bowl and turn it to coat it with the butter.

name: SPICED TEA
ingredients:
3/4  c. instant tea
1  c. sugar
2  c. Tang
2  pkg. unsweetened lemonade (Kool-Aid)
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and store.  Mix 3 teaspoons of tea mixture to one cup of hot water.

name: M&M COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
2 1/4  c. plain flour
1 1/2  c. M&M's
preparation: Blend shortening and sugars.  Beat in vanilla and eggs.  Sift dry ingredients and add to mixture.  Stir in candies.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: REUBEN FOLDOVERS
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick or baking mix
1/2  c. cold water
5  oz. thin slice corned beef
8  oz. sauerkraut, well drained
3  Tbsp. Thousand Island dressing
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter, melted
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms.  Beat vigorously at least 20 strokes.  Gently smooth dough into a ball on a floured board; knead 5 times.   Roll dough into a rectangle at least 12 x 18 inches.  Cut into 6 squares.  Layer corned beef over the triangle half of each square.  Mix sauerkraut, dressing and cheese; spoon over corned beef.  Fold dough over sauerkraut mixture, forming a triangle.  Press edges with a floured fork to seal.  Brush tops with butter or margarine. Sprinkle with caraway seed or poppy seed, if desired.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet until golden brown, approximately 20 minutes.

name: APPLE TART WITH ALMONDS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
pinch of salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. cold butter, cut into small pieces
preparation: Place the flour, salt, sugar and butter in a bowl and mix to a fine crumb texture.  Gradually mix in 1/4 cup ice water.  The dough should hold together but not be sticky.  Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least a half hour.  On a floured board, roll dough into a circle and line a 9- inch pan with the dough, prick the bottom with a fork.  Preheat oven to 450°.

name: CHOP SUEY
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. veal and pork combined
1 big  bunch celery
3  big onions
1  can bean sprouts
1  can noodles
2  cans Chinese sauce
2  c. sugar
preparation: Cut meat in small pieces; put in pan with a little fat and brown good.  Add celery, onions, 2 tablespoons sauce, 2 tablespoons sugar and a little pepper.  Cook until done.  Add bean sprouts, a little thickening (1 tablespoon flour), 1 tablespoon sauce and a little water.  Garnish with noodles.

name: MARBLED BROWNIES
ingredients:
1 (family size)  pkg. Duncan Hines double-fudge brownie mix
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
5  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/3  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. flour
3/4  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Soften cream cheese and butter; beat together.  Add sugar, eggs, flour and vanilla; beat until smooth and set aside.  Mix cakelike brownies as directed on package. Pour half the brownie batter into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour all the cream cheese mixture over the brownie layer.  Spoon remaining brownie batter in spots over the top.  Swirl the two mixtures together with a knife or spatula.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes, or until done.  Cool.

name: BROWN EDGE WAFERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2/3  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg, well beaten
2  Tbsp. milk
1  c. sifted flour
preparation: Cream butter and sugar together.  Add remaining ingredients. Beat until thoroughly blended.  Makes a very thick batter.  Drop by scant teaspoon on greased cookie sheet, 2 inches apart. Sprinkle with ground blanched almonds or leave plain.  Bake at 350° for about 10 to 12 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  boxes frozen strawberries
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen pink lemonade
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen orange juice concentrate
4  pkg. strawberry Kool-Aid
2  c. sugar
6  qt. bottles Sprite
preparation: Put Kool-Aid and sugar in bottom of punch bowl.  Dilute with 1 cup of water.  Put in frozen strawberries, lemonade and orange juice.  Fill bowl half full with ice.  Pour in Sprite as served.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
2 (17 oz.)  cans cream-style corn
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. water
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Mexican cornbread mix
preparation: Melt the margarine in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Combine the corn, onion, sugar, eggs, salt, pepper, water and cornbread mix in a bowl; mix well.  Spoon into the prepared baking dish.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.  May serve as a main dish by adding 1 pound browned ground beef before baking.  Yields 10 servings.

name: MELINDA'S PARMESAN POTATOES
ingredients:
4  to 6 large potatoes, peeled and quartered lengthwise
1  stick margarine
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Combine in Ziploc bag the last 4 ingredients.  Melt the margarine in a large baking dish.  Rinse and drain the potatoes. Shake the potatoes in "flour mixture."  Place in baking dish and bake at 350° for about 20 minutes on each side.

name: BOURBON HOT DOGS
ingredients:
3/4  c. bourbon
2  lb. hot dogs, cut into desired size
1 1/2  c. catsup (14 oz. bottle)
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. grated onion
preparation: Combine all ingredients in ovenproof dish.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or use crock-pot.  Serve with toothpicks for a buffet.

name: MEAT EGG ROLLS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. sherry wine
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. grated fresh ginger
1  large onion, thinly sliced
1  c. thinly sliced celery
1  lb. ham, cooked and cut to matchstick pieces or 3/4 lb. cooked crab meat or canned flaked crab meat or 1 lb. fried ground pork, drained
1/2  c. bamboo shoots, cut to matchstick pieces
2  c. finely shredded cabbage
1  pkg. egg roll wrappers
1  egg
oil for deep frying
preparation: Combine  cornstarch,  salt,  soy sauce and sherry.  Set aside. Heat  wok or wide frying pan over high heat.  When pan is hot, add  salad	oil.  When oil begins to heat, add garlic and  ginger. Stir.  Add  onion	and  celery  and  stir-fry  1 minute.  Add meat,  bamboo  shoots and cabbage and stir-fry 2 minutes.  Stir cornstarch	mixture  and  add to pan and cook, stirring until sauce bubbles and thickens.  Cool.	Brush edges of wrapper	with lightly beaten egg after filling center with meat filling.	Roll and fold into elongated shape.  Fry in hot oil until golden brown. Remove and drain excess oil.

name: PARM-A-CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. (2 oz.) Kraft grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. salt
1  (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) broiler-fryer, cut up
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  Tbsp. milk
1/4  c. margarine, melted
dash of pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Combine cheese, flour and seasonings.  Dip chicken in combined egg and milk; coat with cheese mixture.  Place in 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish.  Pour margarine over chicken. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serve sprinkled with additional cheese. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

name: BACON-CHEESE BREAD
ingredients:
1  loaf French bread
4  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
4  green onions, chopped (use tops)
2  Tbsp. poppy seed
Kraft sliced Swiss cheese
15 to 20  slices raw bacon
preparation: Peel all crust off of the French bread.  Cut bread into 8 or 10 thick slices diagonally.  In a saucepan, melt 4 tablespoons margarine and add mustard, onions and poppy seed.  Spoon mixture between slices.  Place 1 slice of cheese between each bread piece. Drizzle 2 tablespoons melted margarine over loaf.  Arrange 1 to 2 slices bacon over each piece.  Bake on greased foil at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes or until bacon is crisp.

name: MERRY'S CINQO DE MAYO TEX-MEX DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
light cream cheese
1 small  can refried beans
1 large  can tomatoes
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix 1/2 package of taco seasoning mix with "light" cream cheese; spread in bottom of microwavable pie plate.  Mix remaining 1/2 package of taco seasoning with small can of refried beans. Spread as next layer.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. raw cranberries, ground
2  c. sugar
2  pkg. Jell-O (orange or cherry)
1 1/2  c. hot water
2  c. apples or pineapple
2  c. celery
1 small  can frozen orange juice or pineapple juice
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Prepare diced ingredients.  Dissolve Jell-O in water.  Add frozen juice and sugar.  Stir until dissolved.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Chill overnight.

name: SWEET ROLL CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
8  oz. sour cream
4  eggs
3/4  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour in greased and floured long pan.  Mix together 1 cup brown sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Sprinkle over the top of cake.  Swirl throughout the batter.  Bake at 300° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
3  c. biscuit mix
1  lb. sausage
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Mix ingredients and roll into small balls.  Bake on cookie sheet at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1  lb. shrimp, peeled and deveined
3  cans condensed tomato soup
Tabasco sauce
Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper
preparation: Melt margarine in large skillet.  Add bell pepper and onion. Saute until tender.  Add shrimp, soup and dash of Tabasco sauce. Season to taste with Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.  Cook on low heat for 30 minutes.  Serve over rice.

name: DILLY BEANS
ingredients:
2  lb. green beans
1  tsp. dill weed
1  tsp. cayenne pepper
4  garlic cloves
2 1/2  c. water
2 1/2  c. white vinegar
1/4  c. salt
preparation: Clean green beans and stuff them in pint jars, get as many in the jar as you can.  To each jar put garlic, cayenne pepper, garlic cloves and dill.  Boil water, salt and vinegar; pour into jar.  If jars are hot before you stuff them they will seal better. Let set for two weeks before eating.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  c. rice
1  small head cabbage, chopped
1  can tomato soup
1/2  can water
6  slices American cheese
preparation: Cook hamburger.  Drain.  Add  rice.  Cook until rice is tender.  In  casserole  dish,  place chopped cabbage; put hamburger  and rice  on  top.  Mix	soup  and  water.  Pour  over casserole.	Bake at  350° for 30 minutes.  Remove.	Add cheese and place in oven until cheese is melted.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  stick oleo
2  c. raw peanuts or pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients and cook on medium heat until syrup turns caramel color (approximately 10 minutes).  Remove from heat and add 1 1/2 teaspoons soda.  Stir well and pour onto well buttered tinfoil and spread with back of spoon.  Let cool and break into pieces.

name: HONEY BARS
ingredients:
3/4  c. oil
1/4  c. honey
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. soda
1 1/3  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. flour
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients,  then add rest of ingredients. Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes.

name: BARBECUED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  large potatoes
1  small onion
1 1/2  c. whole milk
1  Tbsp. butter
salt and pepper to tate
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  Tbsp. catsup
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
dash of Tabasco sauce
1/4  lb. American cheese, finely sliced
preparation: Put raw potatoes, thinly sliced, in a large skillet.  Cover with milk.  Add remaining ingredients and mix.  Cover and cook over low heat for 1 hour or until potatoes are cooked.

name: CHOCOLATE NO BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/3  stick oleo
2/3  c. peanut butter
3  c. quick rolled oats
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil sugar, milk and oleo for 1 minute.  Remove from heat. Add peanut butter, quick rolled oats, cocoa and vanilla.  Drop on waxed paper.

name: LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1  c. diced green pepper
1  c. diced celery
1/2  pkg. peas, cooked and cooled
1/2  c. diced onion
1  tsp. sugar
1  c. mayonnaise
6  oz. Cheddar cheese, shredded
6  slices crisp bacon, crumbled (or bacon bits)
preparation: In large bowl, layer in first 5 ingredients.  Sprinkle sugar on top.  Evenly spread mayonnaise on top.  Cover.  Refrigerate 24 hours.  Toss just before serving.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: SUMMERTIME SLUSH
ingredients:
3  oz. pkg. any red fruit-flavored gelatin
1  c. boiling water
3  c. cold water
2  c. cranberry juice cocktail
12  oz. can thawed frozen lemonade concentrate
12  oz. can thawed frozen orange juice concentrate
lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage, chilled
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  In nonmetal freezer container, combine dissolved gelatin with remaining ingredients except carbonated beverage; cover.  Freeze until slush consistency, about 8 hours or overnight.  To serve, spoon about 1/2 cup slush into serving glass.  Fill with carbonated beverage. Add vodka or gin, if desired.  Serves 20.

name: LIB HICK'S CHERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (No. 2)  can cherries or about 2 1/2 c. any fruit or berries
preparation: Mix the dry ingredients and then add milk, forming a batter. Melt 4 tablespoons butter in baking dish.  Pour batter on top of the butter.  Heat berries or fruit, mixing in extra 1/2 cup of sugar if fruit is not already sweetened.  Pour hot berries over the batter.  Bake in 350° oven.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH PUDDING PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. butterscotch pudding and pie filling
2  c. milk
3/4  c. miniature marshmallows
baked pie shell
preparation: Cook pudding mix and milk until mixture reaches a full boil, stirring often.  It will thicken as it cools.  After it cools, pour it in the baked pie shell.  Cover with the marshmallows.

name: SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1 large  can tomatoes
1  c. sliced carrots
1  c. tomato sauce
1  tsp. chili powder
5  c. spaghetti, cooked
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped onions
salt and pepper to taste
American cheese slices
preparation: Brown meat; combine spaghetti, meat, tomatoes, celery, carrots and onions in 11 x 15 x 2-inch baking dish.  Combine remaining ingredients except cheese in saucepan.  Heat, pour over spaghetti mixture and mix well.  Cover and cook at 350° for 1 hour or until carrots are done.  Top with cheese during last 2 or 3 minutes of baking.

name: HAWAIIAN BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
3  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. Crisco oil
2  c. mashed ripe bananas
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Combine  dry  ingredients;  stir in nuts and set aside. Combine  remaining ingredients.  Add dry ingredients, stirring until batter  is  moistened.  Spoon  batter  into  two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf  pans.	Bake  at  350° for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until done.  Cool  10  minutes in pans.  Remove to wire racks; cool completely.  Yields two loaves.

name: AUNT MARY'S SOUR CREAM COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour, sifted
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar. Beat in eggs. Fold in sour cream and vanilla. Mix in flour, baking powder and salt.

name: MEXICAN CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  can chili (without beans)
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
preparation: Drain the juice from the tomatoes.  Put in heavy saucepan and mash with potato masher.  Chop the cheese in the tomatoes and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, to prevent scorching.  When cheese is melted, pour in the chili and heat thoroughly.  (The chili may be subbed with 1 pound pork sausage, browned and drained.)  The dip may be prepared in a crock-pot and left on low as being served.  Serve warm with chips.

name: BAR SQUARES
ingredients:
6  c. Rice Krispies
4  c. miniature marshmallows
1/4  c. peanut butter
3  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix cereal and 1 cup marshmallows in a large mixing bowl. Place remaining ingredients in a saucepan over low heat until completely melted.  Pour over cereal mixture and press into a slightly greased pan.

name: METHODIST PUNCH
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3  c. orange juice
3  c. pineapple juice
1  c. lemon juice
1  qt. ginger ale
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
preparation: Boil sugar and 2 cups water.  Cool. Add remaining ingredients and 1 quart water.   Chill and pour over ice in punch bowl.  Add ice cream last just before serving.  Yields 25 servings.

name: HURRICANE CHOCOLATE FROSTING
ingredients:
6  sq. chocolate
1  lb. confectioners sugar
1/3  c. hot water
3  egg yolks
1/2  c. margarine
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt chocolate over hot water.  Place in small mixing bowl. Add sugar and water at the same time and beat until blended.  Add egg yolks, one at a time; beat well.  Add butter a little at a time.  Beat after each additional until smooth.  Add vanilla. Frosting for 2 layers.

name: CHERRY CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. condensed milk
8  oz. cream cheese
1  small container Cool Whip
1/3  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
graham cracker crust
preparation: Mix all together.  Pour in graham cracker crust.  Let set in refrigerator for about 1 hour.  Pour cherry pie filling on top.

name: TATER-TOPPED CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/3  c. sliced celery
1  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can cream of celery soup
1  pkg. Tater Tots
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a skillet, cook onion, celery and ground beef until meat is brown and vegetables are tender.  Drain.  Stir in salt and pepper. Spoon mixture into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.  Spread soup over meat mixture.  Top with frozen potatoes.  Bake at 400° for about 40 minutes until bubbly.  Remove from oven and top with cheese.  Return to oven and bake until cheese melts, about 5 minutes.

name: LEMON CHICKEN OREGANO
ingredients:
1/4  c. melted butter
1  tsp. lemon pepper seasoning
1  tsp. lemon juice
2 1/2 to 3  lb. chicken pieces
oregano
preparation: Combine butter, seasoning and lemon juice.  Put chicken in baking pan and brush both sides with seasoned butter.  Sprinkle with oregano.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: SWEET-SOUR GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
2  cans whole green beans, drained
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. water
3/4  c. cider vinegar
4  Tbsp. salad oil
2  cloves garlic, chopped
2  large white onions, sliced in rings
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Drain and rinse green beans to remove canned taste.  In a large mixing bowl, combine sugar, water, vinegar, salad oil, garlic and onions.  Add beans and mix gently.  Cover and let stand overnight in refrigerator.  Before serving, add salt and pepper to taste.

name: VERMICELLI WITH TOMATO-BASIL SAUCE
ingredients:
8  oz. vermicelli (uncooked)
1  medium onion, thinly sliced
5  c. peeled tomatoes
1/4  c. minced fresh basil
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
vegetable cooking spray
2  cloves garlic, minced
1 (8 oz.)  can no salt added tomato sauce
1/9  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook vermicelli according to package directions, omitting the salt and fat; drain well, then set aside. Coat a Dutch oven with cooking spray; place over medium heat until hot.  Add onion and garlic; saute 5 minutes or until onion is tender. Stir in tomato, tomato sauce, basil and pepper.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add vermicelli; cook, uncovered, until thoroughly heated, stirring occasionally. Transfer mixture to a large platter; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Yields 8 servings (155 calories and 8% fat per 1 cup serving).

name: BROCCOLI DELIGHT SALAD
ingredients:
5  c. chopped broccoli
1/2  c. raisins
1/4  c. chopped red onion
10  bacon slices, fried crisp and crumbled
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
2  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Combine broccoli, raisins, onion and pecans in large salad bowl.  Mix well.  In small bowl, combine sugar, vinegar and mayonnaise.  Stir until sugar is dissolved.  Pour over broccoli mixture until coated.  Chill until ready to serve.  Just before serving, sprinkle crumbled bacon on top of broccoli salad.  If preferred, bacon may be mixed in salad.

name: POTATO CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. flour
1/2  c. crushed potato chips
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and vanilla.  Add flour, chips and pecans.  Form batter about 1-inch in diameter.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet; press down with a lightly floured bottom of a small glass.  Bake in 350° oven for 12 to 14 minutes or until edges are golden.  Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

name: CHICKEN KELLY
ingredients:
6  boneless chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces
2  to 3 eggs, beaten
2  c. breadcrumbs
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
vegetable oil
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. fresh mushrooms
6  slices Muenster cheese
1  c. chicken broth
preparation: Marinate chicken in eggs for 2 hours in refrigerator.  Combine breadcrumbs, salt, parsley and garlic powder in plastic bag. Shake chicken in breadcrumbs and brown in oil.  Drain and place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Cover with a layer of mushrooms and layer of cheese and top with chicken broth.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes.   This can be made ahead of time, but do not pour chicken broth on until just before baking.  Yield: 6 servings.

name: CHOW CHOW
ingredients:
10  large green tomatoes
4  cups ground onion
4  cups ground cabbage
6  red bell peppers
6  green bell peppers
1/2  cup salt
6  cups sugar
2  cups water
4  cups vinegar
1  T celery seed
2  T mustard seed
1  1/2 tsp turmeric
preparation: Grind tomatoes and mix with other ground vegetables. Sprinkle with salt and let stand overnight.  Rinse and drain. Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Add vegetables and simmer for 4 minutes.  Do not overcook.  Pour into sterilized jars and seal.  Process in hot water bath (212 degrees) for 5 minutes. Remove jars and complete seal.

name: SIMPLY ELEGANT STEAK AND RICE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. boneless beef round steak
1 1/2  tsp. vegetable oil
2 large onions, cut in 1/2-inch  slices and separated into rings
1 (4 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms, drained (reserve liquid)
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. dry sherry
1 1/2  tsp. garlic salt
3  c. hot cooked rice
preparation: Cut steak into thin strips.  In a large skillet, brown meat in oil using high heat.  Add onions.  Saute until tender-crisp.  Blend soup, sherry, liquid from mushrooms and garlic salt.  Pour over steak.  Add mushrooms.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 hour or until steak is tender (or cover and bake at 350°).  Serve over beds of fluffy rice or noodles.  Serves 6.

name: SOUR CREAM ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
1  c. sour cream
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. chopped green onion
12  corn tortillas
hot vegetable oil
sliced black olives
preparation: Combine soup, sour cream, green chilies and seasonings in a saucepan.  Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until hot.

name: MINIATURE MOUNDS
ingredients:
1  stick butter, softened
1  lb. powdered sugar
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. coconut
1/4  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix butter, powdered sugar, Eagle Brand milk, coconut and vanilla.  Chill.  Form into balls.  Dip in melted chocolate Candi Quick and serve.

name: GREEN ONION DIP
ingredients:
1  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. sliced green onion
1/2  c. parsley sprigs
1  tsp. Dijon mustard
1  clove garlic, crushed
preparation: In blender or food processor, blend all ingredients until almost smooth.  Cover and chill.  Makes 2 cups.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
3  jalapeno peppers
1  small onion, chopped fine
1  small garlic clove
1  tsp. cilantro (Chinese parsley)
salt and pepper to taste
2  tsp. lime juice
1 large  can whole tomatoes
preparation: Chunky Salsa: Finely chop onion, garlic, cilantro and jalapeno peppers (removing seeds before chopping makes a milder salsa). Mix together and add tomatoes, lime juice, salt and pepper. Mix well.

name: BROCCOLI AND GARLIC SPREAD
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. extra virgin olive oil
1/4  tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
2  c. broccoli florets
16  to 20 crostini slices
4  cloves garlic, chopped
1  medium potato, peeled and diced (about 1/2 c.)
salt to taste
chopped pimento for garnish (optional)
preparation: Combine 2 tablespoons olive oil, garlic and red pepper flakes in a small skillet.  Cook over low heat, stirring, until garlic begins to sizzle.  Remove from heat.  Place a vegetable steamer over 1 inch of water in a medium size saucepan.  Add potato; cover and steam until almost tender, about 5 minutes.  Add broccoli and salt; cover and steam until broccoli and potato are tender, about 5 minutes more.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  German chocolate cake mix
1  (14 oz.) bag caramels
3/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Prepare cake mix according to package. Pour half of the batter into greased 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Meanwhile, melt caramels with butter and milk over low heat. Poke holes in baked cake. Pour caramel mixture over top of cake, then sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Pour remaining batter over all and bake for 20 to 25 minutes more. Serve with whipped topping or ice cream.

name: SAUERKRAUT SALAD(This salad goes great with Polish sausage.)
ingredients:
1  can sauerkraut, drained
1  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. salad oil
1  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. cider vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix the vegetables together in a large bowl.  Add the remaining ingredients to the vegetables, and mix well.  Cover and chill for 3 to 4 hours before serving.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: LIGHT DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
3/4  c. warm water
1/2  c. sugar
2  pkg. yeast
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1/2  c. soft shortening
4  c. unbleached white flour
preparation: Proof the yeast in the water and a little of the sugar.  Add the rest of the ingredients except for 2 cups of flour.  Beat well. Add the remaining two cups of flour.  Mix until very smooth and velvety.  Scrape down the sides of the bowl, cover with a cloth and let rise in a warm place until double in bulk.

name: CRANBERRY SALSA
ingredients:
1  minced serrano chili pepper, seeds and membranes removed
2  c. coarsely chopped cranberries
1  Tbsp. grated orange peel
3  Tbsp. chopped cilantro
3  Tbsp. orange juice
1  Tbsp. tequila
2  tsp. grated fresh ginger
1/4  tsp. cumin
1/4  c. honey
preparation: Combine all ingredients; mix well and taste.  You may need to add additional honey.  Store in refrigerator.  Makes 2 cups.

name: TAMALE PIE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
2  cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2  lb. ground beef, cooked
4  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. cumin
salt and pepper to taste
chopped green olives with 1/2 c. pimentos
1  c. tomato sauce
grated cheese
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients.  Add ground beef, chili powder, cumin and salt and pepper to taste.  Add green olives with pimentos and tomato sauce.  Bring 1 1/2 quarts water to boil.  When boiling, add 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal.  Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Pour half of cornmeal mixture into 9 x 13 baking dish sprayed with Pam.  Add all of meat mixture, then put rest of cornmeal mix on top of meat.  Sprinkle with grated cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: PASSOVER COOKIES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  c. oil
2  c. matzo meal
1  c. finely chopped nuts
preparation: Beat eggs and sugar. Mix in oil and matzo meal.  Add nuts and mix well.   Let stand 10 minutes.  Shape into 1/2 teaspoon balls. Put on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Flatten with fork dipped in sugar.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes until lightly brown.

name: PORK CHOP-N-POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
6  pork chops
vegetable oil
seasoned salt
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of celery soup
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1 (24 oz.)  pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded cheese (Cheddar)
1 (2.8 oz.)  can French fried onions
preparation: Brown chops in skillet with oil.  Sprinkle with seasoned salt and set aside.  Combine soup, milk, sour cream, pepper and 1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt.  Stir in potatoes, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can fried onions.

name: HUNGARIAN PORK PAPRIKA
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  lb. boneless lean pork, cut into 1-inch cubes (may substitute 1 lb. top sirloin or bottom round steak)
4  tsp. olive oil
2 (14 1/2 oz.)  cans stewed tomatoes
1/2  c. sour cream (room temperature)
preparation: Combine flour, paprika, salt and pepper.  Toss with meat.  In skillet, brown meat in hot oil.  Stir in tomatoes.  Cook, uncovered, over medium heat 20 minutes or until meat is tender, stirring frequently.  Remove pan from heat.  Remove 1/2 cup of sauce mixture from skillet and blend with sour cream.  Return mixture to skillet; blend well.  DO NOT BOIL!  Serve over hot cooked noodles.

name: SALAD DRESSING CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. soda
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. salad dressing
1  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, soda and cocoa.  Add salad dressing, water and vanilla.  Stir until smooth.  Put into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake for 35 to 40 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: QUICK FRANKFURTER STEW
ingredients:
1  small onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
2 (10 1/2 oz.)  cans condensed vegetable soup (undiluted)
1  c. water
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frankfurters, sliced diagonally
dash of hot pepper sauce (optional)
preparation: In large saucepan, saute onion in butter until tender.  Blend in flour.  Stir in soup, water, frankfurters and hot pepper sauce. Cook 5 minutes or until heated thoroughly, stirring occasionally.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. diced, cooked boneless chicken
1  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. black pepper
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  can chicken soup
2  c. cooked rice
preparation: Combine the first 6 ingredients.  Blend mayonnaise and soup and add to chicken mixture.  Layer rice in casserole dish. Top with chicken mixture.

name: PEACH ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
2 -8 oz  cans crescent dinner rolls
4  firm ripe peaches, peeled & quartered
2  sticks butter
1  1/2 C sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1-12 oz can Mountain Dew
preparation: Melt butter. Add sugar and cinnamon. Unroll crescent rolls. Place one peach slice on large end. Rollup. Place in a 12 x 10 x 2 baking dish. Pour butter mixture over top, then pour Mountain Dew over top. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Best served warm with vanilla ice cream.

name: CREAM CHEESE AND HAM TORTILLA ROLLS
ingredients:
4  oz. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. real lemon juice
3  Tbsp. Chef Paul Prudhomme's salt-free seasoning
1/4  c. marinated artichoke hearts, drained and finely chopped
1 (4 oz.)  jar pimentos, drained and finely chopped
2  (10-inch) tortillas
6  oz. cooked ham, sliced thin
4  oz. Provolone cheese, sliced thin
preparation: Combine cream cheese, lemon juice, seasoning, artichokes and pimentos in mixing bowl. Layer each tortilla with cream cheese mixture, ham and Provolone. Roll tortillas tightly and wrap in plastic wrap to hold form. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving. To serve, cut rolls into 1-inch thick slices.

name: PINK SUGAR CORN
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. Karo syrup
2  Tbsp. butter
2  dashes salt
food coloring
6 to 8  qt. popped corn
preparation: Cook the first 5 ingredients to the soft ball stage, stirring occasionally until soft ball forms in water.  Remove from heat. Add food coloring.  Pour over 6 to 8 quarts of popped corn.  Add a little at a time until all is coated.  Continue to stir until corn separates and sugars.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
16  oz. sour cream
chopped tomatoes
preparation: Stir all ingredients until well mixed.  Cover; chill.

name: NO BAKE FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  large size candied fruit
1  lb. chopped dates
1  lb. large marshmallows (40)
1  c. candied cherries, chopped
1  lb. raisins
1  lb. graham cracker crumbs
1 1/2  c. pecans, broken
1  can Pet evaporated milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except milk and marshmallows, in a large pan.  Heat Pet milk in double boiler.  Drop marshmallows in a few at a time.  When all marshmallows are melted, pour hot creamy mixture over dry ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Pack mixture into tube or Bundt pan lined with waxed paper.  Cover with waxed paper.  Use hand to press down smoothly and thoroughly.  Store in refrigerator overnight.  Turn out onto favorite cake plate. Decorate with halves of pecans and candied cherries.  Keep in refrigerator.  Additional fruit and nuts may be used, if desired.

name: CHOCOLATE ROLL
ingredients:
6  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Beat whites of eggs very stiff.  Add sugar and cocoa, then the yolks (well beaten).  Bake in jelly roll pan in moderate oven 20 minutes.  When cool, spread with Cool Whip.  Roll up like a jelly roll.

name: CHEESY CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1  c. cracker crumbs
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1  c. milk
3/4  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
preparation: Mix together all ingredients.  Reserve a few crumbs and cheese for topping.  Bake in a greased 8-inch pan at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: CONGO SQUARES
ingredients:
2  sticks butter, melted
2 3/4  c. self-rising flour
3  eggs
1  box brown sugar
1  c. pecans, chopped
1  (12 oz.) bag chocolate chips
preparation: Mix together melted butter and brown sugar; add flour and eggs alternately.  Stir in pecans and chocolate chips.  Pour into a greased and floured 9x13 baking pan.  Bake 40-45 minutes at 300°.  Cool and cut in squares to serve.

name: AUNT MARGIE'S SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Dream Whip
1 (5 oz.)  jar pimiento cheese
1 small  can crushed pineapple, well drained
1  c. miniature marshmallows
nuts as desired
preparation: Whip Dream Whip by directions, omitting vanilla.  Add cheese (whipped), pineapple, marshmallows and nuts.  I melt the marshmallows in the pineapple over low heat.  Let set 8 hours.

name: PECAN PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  slightly beaten egg
1  c. solid pack pumpkin
1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. pie spice
preparation: Spread	over  bottom  of uncooked pie crust, then cover with Pecan Mixture.

name: HOT CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  c. cooked rice
1  c. chicken, cut up
4  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. salt
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
1  c. pecans or almonds
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. mushroom soup
1  pkg. cheese
potato chips
preparation: Mix together and refrigerate overnight.  Remove 1 hour before baking.  Grate cheese over top.  Cover with potato chips.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes to 1 hour.

name: SALISBURY STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients.  Add dry ingredients and mix well.  Shape into patties and brown in frying pan with small amount of oil; drain off excess fat.  Add 1 can of mushroom soup and 1 can of water; pour over meat patties.  Cover and bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

name: "KILLER-BURRITOS"
ingredients:
1  pkg. (12) fajita shells
2  cans refried beans with sausage
1  medium size bag shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (8 oz.)  jar taco or picante sauce
preparation: Spray baking pan with no-stick oil.  In a large bowl, mix well:  refried beans with sausage and 1/2 bag Cheddar cheese. Spread (completely) on fajita shells.  Roll up like pinwheels.

name: BAKED CORN WITH CHIVE SAUCE
ingredients:
2 (12 oz.)  cans whole kernel corn, drained
1  (4 oz.) container whipped cream cheese with chives
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: In a 1-quart casserole, combine whole kernel corn, cream cheese with chives, salt and pepper.  Cover and bake at 325° about 45 minutes.  Serve baked corn in sauce dishes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: ROCKY ROAD FUDGE
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. unsweetened cocoa
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. vanilla
1  lb. confectioners sugar
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. chopped nuts
pinch of salt
preparation: Grease 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan.  In a 2-quart saucepan melt margarine over low heat.  Stir in cocoa, corn syrup, sugar, water, vanilla and salt until well blended and smooth.  Stir in marshmallows and nuts; turn into prepared pan.  Cover and refrigerate until cool.  Cut into squares.

name: BROCCOLI PUFFS
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  oz. sharp grated cheese
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1  beaten egg
1/4  c. bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Cook broccoli.  Combine soup, grated cheese, mayonnaise and egg.  Pour over broccoli.  Top broccoli with bread crumbs and butter.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: ICE CREAM DESSERT
ingredients:
3  c. crushed Rice Krispies
1/2  c. melted butter
1  c. chopped nut meats
1  can cherry pie filling
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. flaked coconut
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
preparation: Mix together the Rice Krispies, brown sugar, melted butter, coconut and chopped nut meats.  Press half of the mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Soften the ice cream and spread it over the layer of the Rice Krispie mixture.  Cover with the rest of the Rice Krispie mixture and press evenly over the top.  Put in freezer until firm. For serving, cut in pieces and top with a tablespoon of cherry pie filling.

name: CRANBERRY-ORANGE RELISH
ingredients:
1  lb. cranberries
2  oranges
2  c. sugar
preparation: Put cranberries through food chopper.  Slice oranges; remove seeds and put rind and oranges through food chopper.   Mix with berries and sugar.  Let stand in refrigerator for a few hours before serving.  This can be put up for future use in sterilized glasses covered with paraffin.

name: SWEET POTATO SOUFFLE
ingredients:
4  large sweet potatoes, boiled
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  egg
preparation: Mash potatoes and mix all ingredients together.  Beat until light and frothy.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: MEXICAN LAYERED TACO DIP
ingredients:
2  cans bean dip
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
1  pkg. taco seasoning
4  tomatoes
2  bunches green onions
1/2  can black olives (optional)
2  c. Cheddar cheese
1  bag nacho chips
preparation: Spread bean dip on a 14-inch round tray.  Combine mayonnaise, sour cream and taco seasoning.  Put that on top  of bean dip. Dice tomatoes, green onions (stems included) and black olives. Grate Cheddar cheese.  Layer tomatoes, green onions and black olives in order and top with cheese.   Keep in refrigerator until ready to serve.

name: COUNTRY VEGETABLE SIMMER
ingredients:
1/2  lb. fresh green beans
4  small new red potatoes, quartered
2  small onions
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
8  fresh mushrooms, halved
1  medium ripe tomato, cut up
1  tsp. basil leaves
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. thyme leaves
2  Tbsp. tomato paste
1/2  tsp. minced fresh garlic
1/4  c. chopped fresh parsley
preparation: In a 3-quart saucepan, combine beans, potatoes and onions. Add enough water to cover. Bring to a full boil.  Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are crispy-tender (15 to 20 minutes).  Drain.  Return to pan.  Add remaining ingredients, except parsley. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until heated through (10 to 12 minutes). Stir in parsley.

name: BROWN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. dark brown sugar
1  c. flour
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. bran flakes
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  c. chopped nuts
1/4  c. raisins
preparation: Combine sugar and flour, then add baking soda to buttermilk and mix.  Add bran flakes, nuts and raisins.  Pour into one 8 x 3 1/4 x 2 1/2 well-greased loaf pan.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

name: BLACK BEANS AND RICE
ingredients:
1  small bag black beans
1  c. chopped green pepper
2  bouillon cubes (chicken)
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. wine vinegar
1  Tbsp. oil
1  c. chopped onion
5  cloves garlic, minced
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. crushed red pepper
6  oz. can tomato paste
cooked rice
sour cream
chopped tomato and onion
preparation: Soak beans in water for 6 hours; drain.  Or for faster preparation, bring beans to a simmer; turn off and let sit for 1 hour, then drain.  Saute until tender the oil, onion, green pepper and garlic.  Add to drained beans.  Cover beans with water, just barely.  Add bouillon cubes, salt, pepper, crushed red pepper and wine vinegar.  Lamb shanks or pork can be added now (optional).

name: ELEPHANT STEW
ingredients:
1  medium size elephant
salt and pepper to taste
brown gravy to cover
2  rabbits (optional)
preparation: Cut the elephant into bite size pieces.  (Preparation time: approximately 2 months.)  Add the gravy to elephant pieces and cook over kerosene fire about 4 weeks at 465°.  Serves 3,800.  If additional guests drop in, 2 rabbits may be added, but do this only if necessary, as most people do not like to find hare in their stew!

name: CARAMELS
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2/3  c. Karo syrup
1/2  c. butter
1  pt. cream
preparation: Mix and cook until hard ball.  Pour into greased pan.  Cool and cut.

name: FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
2/3  c. cocoa
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  stick margarine
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix cocoa, sugar and milk.  Cook over medium heat until it comes to a boil, stirring constantly.  After it reaches boiling point, reduce heat and do not stir.  Test by dropping a small drop in a cup of cold water.  When it reaches a hard ball stage, it will be done.  Add butter, vanilla and nuts.  Beat until cool. Pour in buttered dish.   Cut into small squares.

name: SOUR CREAM CLAM DIP
ingredients:
1  c. real sour cream
1  c. grated Monterey Jack cheese
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can chopped clams, drained
2  Tbsp. chopped green onions
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine all.  Chill to let flavors "marry".  Serve with crackers or vegetables.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  tsp. seasoning salt
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix softened cream cheese with other ingredients until well blended. Chill. Great spread on crackers.

name: HAM LOAF
ingredients:
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. dry mustard
dash of clove
1/3  c. apricot preserves or orange marmalade
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
2  lb. ground ham
preparation: Combine eggs and milk. Add crumbs and soak 5 minutes.  Add ham, Worcestershire sauce, mustard and cloves; mix well.  Pack in a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Remove from oven and reset oven to 425°.  Invert loaf in center of greased and preheated plank.  Spread marmalade on top and sides of loaf.  Bake about 20 minutes until glazed.  Makes 8 servings.

name: CORN BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. cornmeal (not self-rising)
1/2  c. flour (all-purpose)
3  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1  egg
4  Tbsp. melted shortening
preparation: Beat egg; add soda to buttermilk and add to egg.  Mix in flour, cornmeal, baking powder and salt.  Add melted shortening. Pour in preheated and oiled skillet.  Bake at 475° until slightly browned.

name: LASAGNA ROLLS
ingredients:
1  tsp. salad oil
1  medium onion, finely chopped
1 (28 oz.)  can Italian plum tomatoes
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. Italian herb seasoning salt
8  oz. curly lasagna noodles (about 9)
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach
1  (15 oz.) reduced fat or fat-free Ricotta cheese
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1/8  tsp. ground black pepper
salt
3/4  c. water
preparation: Prepare sauce:  In 10-inch skillet over medium heat, cook onion in hot oil (until tender).   Add tomatoes and their liquid, tomato paste, sugar, herb seasoning, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 3/4 cup water.  Heat to boiling, stirring to break up tomatoes.  Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 15 minutes; stir occasionally.

name: BAKED BUTTERNUT OR ACORN SQUASH(Clara Deariso's)
ingredients:
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
2  tsp. fresh lemon juice
1  large squash
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. melted margarine
preparation: Pare, remove seeds and fiber and cut into 1-inch cubes. Place squash  cubes  in  a  2-quart  buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle with  spices  and  brown sugar.  Drizzle with melted butter and lemon juice.  Bake, uncovered, in 375° oven for 45 minutes or until tender.

name: GREEN AND WHITE SALAD
ingredients:
1  bunch fresh broccoli
1  medium head cauliflower
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
1  c. green onions, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. salad oil
1/3  c. white vinegar
1  tsp. dried mustard
1  tsp. salt
preparation: In a large salad bowl, coarsely chop the broccoli and cauliflower.  Add celery, onions and pepper.  Mix together mayonnaise and remaining ingredients.  Pour over vegetables.  Toss to coat.  Yields 8 to 10 servings.

name: CORNBREAD AND CHILIES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  can creamed corn
3/4  c. milk
1/3  c. oil
1  c. yellow cornmeal
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1 large  can Ortega chilies
3/4  c. Longhorn cheese, grated
preparation: Beat eggs, corn, milk and oil.  Add all dry ingredients.  Bake in a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: COOL WHIP DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  large container Cool Whip
1  bag miniature marshmallows
1  can mandarin oranges
1  can fruit cocktail
preparation: Add if desired, sliced apples, bananas and nuts.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  butter recipe cake mix
1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
3/4  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  pt. sour cream
preparation: Mix well.  Pour in tube pan and bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: SWEET AND SOUR SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. ketchup
1  c. pineapple juice
1  c. water
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Boil all ingredients, thicken with cornstarch and cold water.

name: M&M COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. M&M's (plain)
preparation: Blend shortening and sugars together in a bowl. Beat in vanilla and eggs.  Mix dry ingredients together. Stir in M&M's. Drop by teaspoon on baking sheet. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (2 lb.) bag frozen hash brown potatoes
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  stick margarine
2  c. crushed corn flake crumbs
3  c. grated cheese
16  oz. sour cream
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Melt  margarine.  To  this,  add soup and mix with hash browns,  2  cups  of  cheese,  sour  cream,  salt  and pepper. (Reserve  1  cup of cheese.) Place in long baking dish and top with the 1 cup of cheese.  Add corn flake crumbs on top of the cheese.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: GLAD'S OWN CUSTARD PIE(Ed's Very Favorite)
ingredients:
5  eggs (reserve 2 whites for meringue)
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Beat eggs; add sugar.  Scald milk and add to mixture.  Add nutmeg; pour into unbaked crust.  Bake at 350° until filling is firm.  Top with meringue.  Brown slightly.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. mayo
2  Tbsp. ketchup
2  tsp. yellow mustard
8  oz. cream cheese
2 small  cans shrimp, drained
1/2  c. chopped celery
4  Tbsp. onion
preparation: Mix together well the mayo, ketchup, mustard and cream cheese. Chop shrimp real fine. Make sure shrimp is drained.  Mix celery and onion. Line small bowl with Saran Wrap and fill with spread. Refrigerate a few hours.

name: PAVLOVA
ingredients:
2  egg whites
1  tsp. white vinegar or 1/4 tsp. cream of tartar
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. sliced or cut up fresh strawberries
1/3  c. thawed frozen whipped dessert topping
preparation: Line a baking sheet with foil.  Draw six (3-inch) circles on the foil.  Set aside.  In a small mixer bowl combine egg whites, vinegar and salt.  Beat with an electric mixer on medium speed until soft peaks form (tips curl).  Gradually add the 1/2 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating on high speed until very stiff peaks form (tips stand straight) and sugar is almost dissolved (about 4 minutes).  Use the back of a spoon to spread the meringue over the circles on the foil, building the sides up.  Bake in a 300° oven for 35 minutes.  Turn off oven.  Let meringue shells dry in oven, with door closed, for at least 1 hour.  Remove from foil.  To serve, spoon fruit into meringue shells.  Top with whipped topping.  Makes 6 servings.

name: GRANDMOTHER'S LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. water
1/3  c. lemon juice
1/3  c. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. margarine
3  beaten egg yolks
3  egg whites
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
3  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Add cream of tartar to egg whites and beat until frothy; gradually add sugar while beating the egg whites until the mixture will form peaks. Add to pie. (Be sure to seal the meringue around the pie crust.) Brown in a 400° oven just long enough to brown the mixture.

name: CHICKEN EPERCURINE
ingredients:
12  pieces chicken
3  or 4 onions, cut into small chunks
bouillon cubes
1  c. celery
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
9  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  c. green olives
preparation: Sear the chicken pieces in oil.  Cut onions into chunks; put them, some water and a couple of bouillon cubes in with the chicken.  Cook until tender (2 hours).  Add the celery.   Mix mayonnaise and soy sauce; set aside.  Add the green olives to chicken after 1 1/2 hours.  Mix in sauce.  Serve over rice.

name: ELAINE'S ZUCCHINI BARS
ingredients:
2  c. grated zucchini
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. oil
4  eggs
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bake in greased, floured jelly roll pan.  Bake 45 to 50 minutes in 350° oven.

name: DRIED BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (1/2 lb.)  pkg. dried beef
2  c. macaroni
2 1/2  c. cubed cheese
2  c. milk
2  c. (10 3/4 oz.) cream of mushroom soup
4  hard-boiled eggs
1  small onion, diced
preparation: Combine all ingredients and bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole, covered, for 1 hour at 350°.

name: FRUIT CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1  box yellow cake mix
1  c. chopped nuts
2  cans pie filling (any flavor)
preparation: Melt oleo in baking dish. Spread pie filling over oleo.  Mix cake mix and nuts until crumbly.  Spoon over the pie filling. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.  Turn heat up to 350° and brown 10 to 15 minutes.

name: PISTOLEROS
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1 1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  large bag frozen broccoli, chopped
Tony Chachere seasoning to taste
18  to 24 pistoleros (long shaped rolls)
butter and garlic (to brush on top)
preparation: Brown hamburger.  Add Tony Chachere to taste. Chop the broccoli finely. Drain meat and add broccoli and Velveeta cheese. Mix well. Set aside. Cut off one end of the roll; dredge out the inside of the roll to make a cavity. Stuff the roll with meat mixture. Brush the top of the roll with the garlic-butter mixture. Cook at 350° until rolls are browned.

name: MELT IN YOUR MOUTH SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar, sifted
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  tsp. almond extract
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Cream butter, egg and sugar together.  Add vanilla and almond extracts.  Blend in flour, baking soda and cream of tartar.  Roll into balls, 1-inch in size, or you may drop by a teaspoonful onto a greased cookie sheet.  Press flat with a bottom of a glass, that has been dipped into sugar.  Bake at 375° for 7 to 8 minutes or until lightly browned around the edges.  Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

name: HERB ROAST
ingredients:
3 1/2  lb. boneless bottom roast
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. cooking sherry
1/4  c. catsup
1  tsp. minced garlic
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  stick margarine
1/4  tsp. thyme
2  medium onions, sliced
1  bay leaf
1  pkg. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1/4  tsp. dried rosemary
preparation: You will also need vegetable cooking spray.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  qt. squash, cooked
3  Tbsp. butter
dash of salt and pepper
1  medium onion, grated
1  egg
preparation: Stir all together and add 12 or more soda crackers, crumbled, and add 1 large can of canned milk. Put in a buttered casserole dish and cook at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Five minutes before it is done, put 4 slices of cheese on top and sprinkle paprika on top.

name: THREE LETTUCE SALAD
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1 to 2  cloves garlic, minced
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  bunch romaine lettuce
1/2  bunch butter lettuce
1/2  bunch leaf lettuce
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin orange sections, drained
1  c. seedless red grapes
1/3  c. toasted, slivered almonds
preparation: In a screw-top jar, combine olive oil, vinegar, garlic and salt. Cover.  Shake until well blended.  Chill until serving.

name: HASH BROWN CHEESE POTATOES
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes (large bag)
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  tsp. salt (optional)
1/2  c. salted butter or margarine
1  can cream of chicken soup
8  oz. sour cream
2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  c. crushed corn flakes
1/4  c. melted butter or margarine
preparation: Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

name: HAWAIIAN KABOBS
ingredients:
1  can (20 oz.) unsweetened pineapple chunks
2  large green peppers, cut into 1-inch pieces
1  large onion, quartered (optional)
12  to 16 medium fresh mushrooms
16  to 18 cherry tomatoes
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. olive oil
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  tsp. ground ginger
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
cooked rice (optional)
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/2 cup juice.  Place pineapple chunks and vegetables in a large bowl; set aside.  In a saucepan, combine reserved pineapple juice with soy sauce, olive oil, brown sugar and seasonings; bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes.  Pour over vegetable mixture; cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, stirring occasionally.  Remove pineapple and vegetables from marinade and reserve marinade. Alternate pineapple, green pepper, onion (if desired), mushrooms and tomatoes on skewers.  Grill kabobs for 20 minutes or until soft, turning and basting with marinade frequently.  Serve over rice, if desired.  Yields 8 servings.

name: HOT MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. elbow macaroni
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. bell pepper
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. pimento
1  can cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. grated cheese
preparation: Cook macaroni according to directions; drain well.  Add all other ingredients, except 1/2 of cheese.  Bake in 350° oven for about 30 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and cook until bubbly.

name: BAKED CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
8  chicken breasts, boned and skinned
4  slices Swiss cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/3  c. white wine
1  c. Pepperidge Farm herbed crumbs
1/4  c. butter, melted
preparation: Top each chicken breast with 1/2 slice of Swiss cheese.  Mix soup and wine; pour over chicken.  Add crumbs; drizzle melted butter over all.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BUDDY BARS
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter (chunky)
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine, softened
1 1/4  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. chocolate chips
preparation: In a large bowl, beat peanut butter and butter until smooth. Add sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Beat until creamy.  Gradually beat in flour and salt.  Stir in 1 cup chocolate chips.  Spread in an ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan.

name: LINGUINE SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. linguine, cooked and drained
2  tomatoes, chopped
1  cucumber, chopped
1  onion, chopped
12  oz. Wish-Bone Italian dressing
3/4  jar Salad Supreme seasoning (McCormick's Red Cap)
preparation: Make sure linguine is dry.  Add all other ingredients and toss together.  Marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours.  Stays fresh for days.

name: GRANDMA'S CUPCAKES/YELLOW CAKE
ingredients:
3  cups plain flour
3 slightly heaping  tsp. of baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  cups sugar
1/2  cup Crisco
1/2  cup margarine
1  cup milk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.   Sift flour, baking powder and salt into bowl.  Cream sugar, Crisco, and margarine together.  Add 1 egg to cream mixture and mix well.  Add 2nd egg and mix well. Add 3rd egg and mix well.  Next, add 1/2 cup of milk and 1/3 of the dry ingredients.  Mix well.  Add another 1/2 cup of milk and 1/3 of the dry ingredients.  Mix well.  Add a little more milk, if needed (1/8 cup) and the rest of the dry ingredients.  Mix well. Add vanilla or replace some of vanilla with lemon flavoring.  Beat well.  Put in muffin tins in cupcake papers.  Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown.  makes about 36 cupcakes.

name: SALISBURY STEAK
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. ground meat
1  egg
1/2  c. can milk
1  pkg. onion soup mix
2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. water
1  can beef gravy
preparation: Mix the first 4 ingredients and make patties. Brown in a little fat. Remove browned patties. To the grease, add the flour. Stir until browned. Add the water and gravy.  Return patties to baking dish. Add gravy.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: SPICY TURKEY STIR-FRY
ingredients:
2  garlic cloves, minced
1  c. each:  red and green bell pepper, onion and carrot
1 1/4  tsp. olive oil
2 to 3  oz. uncooked turkey cutlet, cut into thin strips
4  tsp. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. chicken bouillon
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. crushed red pepper
preparation: In nonstick skillet, saute garlic and vegetables in olive oil. Add remaining ingredients.  Cook, covered, for 10 minutes, or until done.  Serve over rice with crispy chow mein noodles. Serves 2.

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA
ingredients:
1  can refrigerated crescent rolls
1 small  pkg. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. Blue cheese salad dressing
2  to 3 green onions, finely chopped
1/2 to 1  c. each finely chopped or grated vegetables: broccoli, carrot, green pepper (your choice)
preparation: Spread crescent rolls on a cookie sheet into a flat rectangle. Bake until light brown.  Combine cream cheese, salad dressing and green onions.  Spread over cooled crust.   Sprinkle with raw vegetables.  Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.  Cut in squares of desired size and serve.

name: FESTIVAL RICE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
2  stalks celery, diced
1/2  lb. mushrooms, sliced (about 2 1/2 c.)
1/4  tsp. each sage, marjoram and thyme
1  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1/4  c. finely chopped green onion tops
3  c. cooked brown rice
1/4  c. chopped pecans or almonds, toasted
1/4  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. minced parsley
preparation: In a large frying pan, heat oil and saute onion, green pepper and celery until soft. Add mushrooms, sage, marjoram, thyme and vinegar.  Simmer over low heat for 10 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine vegetable mixture with green onions and rice.  Stir in half the nuts and half the cheese.  Spoon into a 2 1/4-quart ovenproof casserole dish. Sprinkle top with remaining nuts, cheese and parsley.   Heat through for 15 or 20 minutes.  Makes 4 servings.

name: GARDEN CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP(Microwave Recipe)
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) chicken breast halves, skinned
1 1/2  qt. water
1  c. frozen green peas
1  medium size yellow squash, thinly sliced
1/2  c. thinly sliced carrot
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. chicken flavored bouillon granules
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. uncooked medium egg noodles
preparation: Place chicken in deep 3-quart casserole.  Add water.  Stir in peas and next 7 ingredients.  Cover with heavy duty plastic wrap and microwave at High for 20 to 25 minutes or until boiling.  Stir in noodles.   Reduce to medium (50% power).  Cover and microwave for 20 to 30 minutes or until noodles and chicken are tender, stirring every 10 minutes.

name: MOJAVE FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. cubed apples
2  c. orange sections
1 1/2  c. cubed sharp Cheddar cheese (Cracker Barrel)
1/2  c. chopped dates
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. grated orange rind
1/2  c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
preparation: Mix all fruit ingredients together.  Mix the orange rind into the salad dressing and toss with fruit.

name: ARTICHOKE APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1  loaf party rye bread
1  can artichoke hearts
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. white wine or cooking sherry
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Drain and squeeze liquid from artichoke hearts and chop them up.  Add other ingredients and mix well.  Spoon over bread.  Place under broiler about 2 minutes or until brown.

name: QUICK CHEESE BREAD
ingredients:
2  eggs
3/4  c. water
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. buttermilk biscuit mix
2  tsp. dry mustard
1 1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese, divided
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Beat eggs; stir in water.  Add biscuit mix and beat.  Add mustard and 1 cup cheese.  Mix thoroughly.  Pour into greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese and dot with butter.  Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.  Remove and cool on rack before slicing.

name: EDWARDS MANSION ORANGE MUFFINS
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1 1/2  Tbsp. baking powder
3/4  c. shortening
1/2  c. milk
1  c. diced orange sections
2  c. sugar
1 1/3  c. butter (room temperature)
5  eggs
1 1/4  c. orange juice
slivered almonds (optional)
preparation: Mix together all dry ingredients.  Add butter, shortening, eggs, milk and orange juice.  Mix thoroughly.  Spoon batter into greased muffin tins until 2/3 full.  Top each muffin with an orange section and slivered almonds, if desired.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Makes 3 dozen muffins.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
2 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Mix 1 1/2 cups sugar, butter, shortening and eggs.  Stir in flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt. Shape dough by rounded teaspoonful into balls.  Mix 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon; roll balls in mixture to coat.  Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake until set, 8 to 10 minutes.  Immediately remove from cookie sheet.  Makes about 6 dozen.

name: CHICKEN SALAD BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1/8  tsp. black pepper
2  c. finely chopped breasts of chicken
2  finely chopped boiled eggs
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
chopped pecans
preparation: Mix cream cheese, lemon juice, mayonnaise, salt, ground ginger and pepper  together  with  electric  mixer.  Stir  in chicken, eggs and onion.  Mix well and chill.  Shape into ball and roll in chopped pecans.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: HONEY MUSTARD BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  whole chicken, cut up
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. honey
1/4  c. Dijon mustard
1  tsp. curry powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Place chicken in shallow baking pan.  In a saucepan, melt butter and stir in remaining ingredients and heat through.  Brush glaze over chicken.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until chicken is golden brown, basting chicken frequently with glaze while baking.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. corn syrup (Karo)
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. pecan halves
6  eggs
preparation: Cream margarine; add sugar and cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs, syrup and salt; beat well.  Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake on lower shelf of oven at 350° for approximately 45 minutes or until set.  (I use deep pie shells; this makes two nice pies.  I use Golden Eagle syrup.)

name: SPINACH SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh spinach
1/4  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
3  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
1  bunch green onions, chopped
1/2  c. vegetable oil
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1/3  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/8  tsp. pepper
8  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
preparation: Remove stems from spinach; wash leaves thoroughly and pat dry. Tear into bite-size pieces.  Combine spinach, mushrooms, eggs and green onions in a large bowl.

name: HOT DOG SLAW
ingredients:
2  c. grated cabbage
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1 1/2  Tbsp. barbecue sauce
1  Tbsp. mustard
1/2  small onion
1  Tbsp. relish
preparation: Mix all ingredients; serve over hot dogs and hamburgers.

name: FRESH FRUIT SALAD WITH POPPY SEED DRESSING
ingredients:
3  c. assorted fresh fruit, cut into bite size pieces
1  c. low-fat or nonfat lemon yogurt
1/4  tsp. poppy seed
preparation: In a small bowl, mix the yogurt and poppy seed.  Pour over fruit and serve.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
1 large  can refried beans
16  oz. sour cream
Frito-Lay salsa
small head lettuce, shredded
16  oz. shredded cheese
2  medium diced tomatoes
1 small  can diced black olives
diced green onion
peppers (optional)
preparation: Layer ingredients in order listed.  Refrigerate for 2 hours before serving.  Serve with Tostitos.

name: EASY STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  c. bread crumbs
1  egg, beaten
1  can tomato soup
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Stuff into 6 peppers that have been cored and seeded.  Cover and boil in 1 1/2 inches salted water for 30 minutes.

name: GUILT-FREE CHEESE SAUCE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. reduced-calorie margarine
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  c. skim milk
2  slices low-fat processed cheese, torn into small pieces
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. white pepper
preparation: Melt margarine in a heavy saucepan over low heat.  Add flour, stirring until smooth (mixture will be dry).  Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
