Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, with a wire whisk until thickened and bubbly. Add cheese, salt and pepper; stir until cheese melts.  Serve sauce over broccoli or other vegetables.  Yield: 1 cup (about 20 calories per tablespoon).

name: STRAWBERRY CREAM CHEESE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2  beaten eggs
1 1/4  c. sugar
3  c. half and half cream
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
few drops red food coloring (optional)
2  c. whole strawberries
1  c. chopped strawberries
preparation: Combine eggs, sugar  and  1 1/2 cups half and half in a small saucepan.  Cook  and stir over medium heat until mixture just comes  to  boil.  Remove  from heat.  Transfer to a large bowl. Stir  in  remaining  half  and  half,  vanilla and food coloring. Cover and chill.  Mix cream cheese in a large mixer bowl until fluffy.  Gradually beat in the 2 cups berries until berries are coarsely  crushed.	Gradually  beat in the cooled egg mixture. Stir  in the 1 cup chopped berries.  Freeze in a 4 to  5  quart ice  cream freezer according to manufacturer's directions.	Makes 2 quarts.

name: GREEN TOMATO PICKLES
ingredients:
7  lb. small green tomatoes
3  c. pickling lime
5  lb. sugar
3  pt. vinegar
2  gal. water
1  tsp. ground cloves
1  tsp. ground ginger
1  tsp. ground allspice
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. ground mace
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Dissolve lime in water; let lime settle that does not dissolve and pour off.  Add sliced tomatoes and leave for 24 hours.  Rinse tomatoes and soak in cold water for 4 hours, changing water every hour.  Drain well.  Mix other ingredients and bring to boil.  Pour over tomatoes and leave overnight.  Place on stove and boil for 1 hour.  Place in jars.  Makes about 12 pints.

name: POPPY BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  pkg. instant toasted coconut pudding or regular
1/2  c. salad oil
4  eggs
1/4  c. poppy seed
1  c. hot water
preparation: Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.  Makes two loaves.

name: SILLY PUTTY
ingredients:
2  parts Elmer's white glue
1  part Sta-Flo liquid starch
preparation: Mix well.  Putty must dry a bit before it is workable.  It may be necessary to add a bit more glue or starch; you will have to experiment.   Beware of contact with clothes and carpet.  If you use Elmer's school glue instead of regular white glue, the putty will not bounce or pick up pictures.  Store in an airtight container.  Recipe may not work well on a humid day.

name: KARO PECAN PIE
ingredients:
5  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. light Karo syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. butter
1  c. chopped pecans
1  pie shell
preparation: Combine all ingredients and place in pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: WALNUT CLUSTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  sq. dark chocolate
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1  egg
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. soft butter or oleo
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. walnuts, pecans or almonds
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease cookie sheet.  Combine all but nuts.  Stir in nuts.  Drop by teaspoonful.  Bake 11 to 12 minutes. Check in between if cookies are small.  Frost.

name: GOULASH
ingredients:
1  1/2 lbs. ground beef
1  bell pepper (chopped)
1  large onion (chopped)
1  can tomato sauce
1 small  can tomatoes (mashed)
2  cloves garlic
salt and pepper to taste
tomato catsup to taste
worcestershire sauce to taste
preparation: Cook onion, garlic and bell peppers in oil. Add meat, salt and pepper. Cook until done. Drain. Add tomato sauce, tomatoes, worcestershire. Simmer about 1 hour. Cook elbow macaroni. Mix with meat sauce. Cover, turn heat off and let set. It if gets to dry just add a little water. Sprinkle cheese on each serving. Serve with salad and garlic toast.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
3  c. flour (self-rising)
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/3  c. shortening
1  c. warm water
1  pkg. yeast
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Work real good all ingredients and put all dough in Tupperware bowl.  Cook as needed.  Grease pan.  Turn biscuits in grease. Put in cold oven.  Turn to 450°. Bake approximately 20 minutes or until brown.

name: CHICKEN PIQUANT
ingredients:
chicken parts for 4 people (breasts are best)
1  lb. fresh mushrooms
3/4  c. Rose wine
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  crushed garlic bud
1/4  tsp. oregano
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch, mixed with 4 Tbsp. water
preparation: Place sliced mushrooms in bottom of casserole dish.  Top with chicken pieces.  Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over the chicken.  Bake, uncovered, for 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Serve with rice.

name: PUMPKIN SOMETHING
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1  T. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/3  tsp. cloves
3  eggs
1 large  can pumpkin
1/2  pkg. yellow cake mix
1 1/2  sticks oleo
1 1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix together:  milk, salt, cinnamon, ginger, cloves, eggs, and pumpkin.  Then add 1/2 pkg. cake mix, oleo and nuts.  Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 1 hour in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Top with Cool Whip and serve.

name: CHICKEN SPECTACULAR
ingredients:
3  c. cooked chicken, chopped
1  pkg. cooked Uncle Ben's wild and white rice
1  c. cream celery soup
1 medium  jar sliced pimento
1  medium onion, chopped and sauteed
1  can drained French-style beans
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  c. or can water chestnuts
salt to taste
pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all above and pour into 2 1/2 to 3 quart casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven.  Serves 16.  Can be divided and frozen, but do not cook before freezing.

name: CARAMEL CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines cake mix
3  eggs
2/3  c. water
1/3  c. butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Grease sides and bottom of pans. Flour lightly.  Soften butter to room temperature.

name: ACORN SQUASH-SAUSAGE BAKE
ingredients:
2  large acorn squash
1/2  lb. sausage
1  medium onion, chopped
1  small apple, chopped
2  c. shredded cabbage
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. sage
1/4  tsp. thyme
2  Tbsp. slivered almonds
preparation: Cut squash in half lengthwise.  Scoop out seeds.  Place cut side down in a baking pan.  Add 1/2-inch of water.  Bake 20 minutes at 400°.

name: SKILLET MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
6  to 10 stuffed olives, sliced
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1/2  c. rolled oats
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix beef, 1/3 cup of tomato sauce, olives, onion, oats, egg and seasoning.  Spread in heavy 10-inch skillet. Cover with remaining 2/3 cup tomato sauce.  Bake 1 hour.  Remove excess fat from skillet before serving.  Cut in wedges to serve.

name: FUDGE BROWNIE PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) unbaked pastry shell
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/4  c. margarine or butter
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1/2  c. biscuit baking mix
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Bake pastry shell 10 minutes.  Remove from oven. Reduce oven temperature to 325°.  In saucepan, over low heat, melt chips with margarine.  In large mixer bowl, beat chocolate mixture with remaining ingredients, except nuts, until smooth. Add nuts.  Pour into prepared pastry shell. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until center is set. Cool slightly.  Serve with ice cream, if desired.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: GRILLED ROAST BEEF AND SWISS SANDWICHES
ingredients:
rye or sourdough bread
roast beef, sliced thin from the deli (garlic roast beef is great)
Swiss cheese
mayonnaise
spicy mustard or horseradish
preparation: Mix equal parts mayonnaise with spicy mustard or horseradish. Spread this mixture on inside of bread. Add meat and cheese. Butter outside of bread and grill as you would a grilled cheese sandwich.

name: RED BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. red beans
1/2  lb. pork or ham
1  sprig thyme, parsley and celery
1/4  c. canned tomatoes
8  c. water
1  medium sized onion
1  tsp. salt
1  firm plantain
preparation: Wash beans and soak overnight.  Boil for 2 hours in water which beans are soaked.  Add all ingredients except plantain.  Add plantain after beans are soft.  Add dumplings and cook 10 minutes longer.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. rice
3/4  stick oleo
1  can onion beef stock soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can water
4  to 5 pieces chicken
preparation: Melt  oleo in pan;  add  soup  and  water.  Stir  until dissolved.  Mix in rice.  Place chicken on top.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Cover and cook  1  hour  and  15  minutes at 350°.  Uncover and brown chicken.

name: 7 LAYER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. coconut
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate semi-sweet bits
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch bits
1  can condensed milk
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan and spread.  Add in layers, in order, all remaining ingredients.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.  Quick, easy and yummy!

name: BAKED FISH WITH PARMESAN-SOUR CREAM SAUCE
ingredients:
1  1/2 pounds Orange Roughy, Tilapia, Flounder, or any white fish fillets
1  (8-ounce) container sour cream (fat free works well)
1/4  cup shredded Parmesan cheese
1/2  teaspoon paprika
1/2  teaspoon salt
1/4  teaspoon pepper
2  tablespoons Italian-seasoned breadcrumbs
2  tablespoons butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Place fillets in a single layer in a lightly greased 13x9-inch pan.  Stir together sour cream and next 4 ingredients; spread mixture evenly over fillets.  Sprinkle with breadcrumbs, and drizzle with butter.  Bake at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until fish flakes with a fork.  Yield:  4-6 servings.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 large  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. mayonnaise
2  eggs, well beaten
2  Tbsp. onion, minced
1  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. crushed cheese crackers or bread crumbs
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Cook broccoli.  Combine soup, mayo, eggs, onion and cheese.   Put into a greased casserole dish. Sprinkle crackers or crumbs on top.  Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.

name: SPINACH AND CHEESE BAKE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
1  c. milk
3  eggs
1  small onion, chopped
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. salt
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. chopped spinach, thawed and drained
preparation: Mix milk, flour, eggs, baking powder, salt and melted butter well, then add cheese, spinach and onion.  Butter well an oblong baking dish; pour in and bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: BETTY'S LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. onions, chopped
2  tsp. oregano
1  c. water
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
2  garlic cloves, minced
1  c. (4 oz.) Parmesan cheese
8  oz. lasagna noodles
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese slices
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
preparation: Brown meat; drain.  Saute onions in 1 tablespoon of oil.  Stir into beef the onions, tomatoes, tomato paste, water and seasonings.  Cover and simmer 30 minutes.

name: HEAVENLY SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. apricot jello
2  c. hot water
2  c. small marshmallows
2  c. cold water
2  bananas, mashed
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Save the juice from pineapple.  Pour the pineapple over the bananas (so they won't turn dark).  Melt jello and marshmallows in water; add cold water and chill.  Add fruit.  Chill until set.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can artichokes, drained and chopped or 2 jars marinated artichokes
oregano
black pepper to taste
1  c. mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese (New York white)
1  medium onion
garlic salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes until puffed up and brown on top.

name: MINI CHEESECAKES
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1/3  c. granulated sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
vanilla wafers
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine cream cheese, sugar, egg and vanilla in mixing bowl.  Beat with electric mixer until mixture is light and fluffy.  Place a vanilla wafer in the bottom of the baking cups, about 8.  Spoon cream cheese mixture evenly into cups.  Bake 15 minutes at 350°.  Cool.  When cool, they can be topped with pie filling or pineapple.

name: SCALLOPED PARSLEY POTATOES
ingredients:
4  to 6 potatoes
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/3  tsp. salt
dash of black or white pepper
3 to 4  tsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Peel potatoes.  Cut into wedges or slices.  Cook potatoes in a little water for about 10 minutes.  They should not get mushy.  In a saucepan, combine butter, milk and flour.  Whisk together.  Bring to a boil, stirring.  Cook for about 5 minutes.  Add salt, pepper, parsley and potatoes.  Heat slowly.  Season to taste.  Sprinkle with extra parsley when serving.  For a more pungent flavor, add a little grated nutmeg.  For a low-fat alternative, substitute 1/2 cup vegetable broth for 1/2 cup milk.  Preparation time 40 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE AND EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
6  slices bread
6  eggs
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2 soup  can milk
preparation: Brown sausage; drain.  Cube bread in a 13-inch glass baking pan, greased.  Then layer sausage, then cheese.  Mix eggs and milk; pour over sausage mixture.  Mix soup with milk and pour over mixture.  Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350° or until light brown and bubbly.

name: RAW APPLE MUFFINS(Makes 16)
ingredients:
4  c. diced apples, peeled or unpeeled
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. oil (corn)
2  tsp. vanilla extract
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  c. raisins
1  c. broken walnuts (large pieces)
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Grease 16 muffin tins.  Put 3 mixing bowls out.  Mix apples and sugar in one bowl and set aside. Mix eggs, oil and vanilla in second bowl and stir to blend.  In the third bowl, put flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.  Stir and blend with fork.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. all purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
6  medium potatoes, pared and thinly sliced (6 c.)
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
3  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Make white sauce of first 5 ingredients.  Place half the potatoes in greased 2 quart casserole.  Cover with half the onions and half the sauce.  Repeat layers.  Cover and bake about one hour.  Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: GREASELESS PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
pork chops
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Saute number of pork chops desired until nicely browned.  Mix water, vinegar and seasonings.  Pour liquid over meat; continue cooking until chops are adequately cooked.

name: EASY PEACH SALAD
ingredients:
1  large (12 oz.) Cool Whip
8  oz. sour cream
6  oz. peach Jell-O
16  oz. crushed pineapple
small can mandarin oranges
preparation: Mix sour cream and Cool Whip.  Add dry Jell-O and mix well. Stir in drained pineapple.  Place in large dish and top with mandarin oranges.

name: HOT POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
10  large potatoes
1 small  jar green olives, cut in half
1  small onion, diced
mayo to moisten
5 thick  slices Swiss cheese, cubed
preparation: Boil potatoes; peel and dice into small chunks.  Place potatoes, Swiss cheese, green olives and onion in large bowl. Mix.  Add just enough mayonnaise to moisten.  Pour ingredients into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Cook at 350° uncovered for about 30 minutes or until cheese melts.  Serves about 10 adults.

name: SLOPPY JOE QUICKIES
ingredients:
1  can Vita-Burger, reconstituted
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
2  Tbsp. oil
1 (6 oz.)  can V-8 juice
1/2  c. barbecue sauce
1/2  tsp. oregano
about 1/4 c. water
preparation: Saute onion and green pepper in oil.  Add remaining ingredients, adding enough water to make desired consistency. Simmer 15 minutes.  Serve on toasted buns.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: DELMA'S SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
2  lb. cooked shrimp
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  pt. Hellmann's salad dressing
1  large onion, grated
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
Tony Chachere's seasoning, optional
preparation: Chop or process shrimp. Mix cream cheese and salad dressing until well blended; add onion and bell pepper. Season with a small amount of Tony's seasoning if desired. Chill. Serve with crackers. Good!

name: TINY HAM-STUFFED TOMATOES(Makes 20 Appetizers)
ingredients:
1  pt. cherry tomatoes
2 (2 1/4 oz.)  cans deviled ham
2  Tbsp. sour cream
2  tsp. horseradish
parsley for garnish
preparation: Thinly slice tops from cherry tomatoes; remove pulp and drain shells upside down on paper towel.  In small bowl, combine ham, sour cream and horseradish.  Fill tomato shells with the ham mixture.  Refrigerate.  To serve, garnish with parsley.

name: DILL PICKLES
ingredients:
cukes
3  qt. water
1  qt. vinegar
1 scant  c. salt
dill
garlic cloves
preparation: I first scrub the cukes and get all picks off.  Bring the first 4 ingredients to a boil.  Pack in jars tight.  Put a piece of dill and a clove of garlic in jar.  Pour hot liquid over pickles.  Wipe jar rim and put on lid and seal.   Set whole jar in quite hot water until water cools.  Wait to eat at least 2 weeks. They are better if you wait longer.

name: MRS. MCMULLAN'S FRUIT CAKE(From the Files of Dessie Bell Hayes)
ingredients:
1  qt. pecans, chopped
1  carton each candied cherries (red and green)
1  lb. dates
2  c. coconut
1  lb. candied pineapple
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Chop everything good.  Using both hands, mix and mix until all mixed good.  Makes 2 loaves.  Put wax paper in pans and press cake until well packed.  Place in 250° oven for 1 hour.  Test to see if it sticks together.  If it does, remove from oven.  Let cool. When cooled, remove from pan and remove wax paper.  Wrap in a cloth soaked with grape juice or wine.  Store for future use.

name: ORANGE JULIUS
ingredients:
1/3  c. orange concentrate
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. milk
3/4  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
5  or 6 ice cubes
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a blender.  Serve and enjoy.

name: CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  jar chicken noodle soup mix
2-5 oz. can of chicken or 2 - 3 cups cooked chicken
10  C. water
preparation: Bring water to a boil.  Add soup mix and chicken.  Bring back to a boil; reduce heat and simmer uncovered 12 - 15 minutes.

name: KING RANCH CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  bag Doritos (entire bag will not be used)
1  large onion, chopped
2 1/2  c. grated cheese
6  to 8 chicken breasts (white)
preparation: Boil chicken (save chicken broth for sauce following) with celery strips, a few bay leaves and a little onion.   Then skin and bone the chicken.  Set aside.

name: CREAMED CORN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. yellow cornmeal
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking soda
2  Tbsp. cold butter or margarine, cut into pieces
2/3  c. buttermilk
1  egg
1 (8 1/4 oz.)  can cream-style corn
preparation: Mix flour, cornmeal and all dry ingredients together.  Cut in butter with pastry blender.  In large measuring cup, mix buttermilk, egg and corn.  Stir into dry ingredients.  Put into prepared muffin cups.  Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Let cool 5 minutes before removing from pan.

name: CHICKEN AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. frozen broccoli
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
4  chicken breasts
preparation: Slightly cook broccoli.   Place on greased casserole dish. Top this with cooked chicken breasts.

name: OVERNIGHT SLAW
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage
1  onion, thin sliced
7/8  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
3/4  c. salad oil
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Slice cabbage and onion and cover with sugar.  Bring remaining ingredients to a boil.  Pour over cabbage and let stand 4 to 6 hours or overnight.  Will keep 7 days.

name: GREEN TOMATO RELISH
ingredients:
2  qt. chopped green tomatoes
3  green peppers (sweet)
3  red peppers (sweet)
5  large onions
3  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. celery seed
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
1  Tbsp. allspice
1  Tbsp. turmeric
3  c. sugar
3  c. vinegar
preparation: Grind coarse tomatoes, peppers and onions. Put together in large pan; put the salt in and let stand 10 minutes. Drain, then mix all the spices, sugar and vinegar in it. Boil 10 minutes. Put hot in jars and seal.

name: ROLLS
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. boiling water
2  eggs
2  pkg. dry yeast
6  c. plain flour
preparation: In a large bowl, combine sugar, salt and shortening.  Add boiling water and stir until shortening melts.  Add beaten eggs. Stir.  Add 3 cups of flour and mix well.  In 1 cup of warm water, dissolve the yeast.  Add to first mixture, then add 3 more cups of flour.  Mix well and refrigerate overnight.   Place rolls in greased pan and let rise 2 to 3 hours.

name: OATMEAL CRISP
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. white sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
3  c. oatmeal
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Roll up and chill overnight.  Bake in ungreased pan at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: HOLIDAY BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can condensed milk
1 1/2  c. cold water
1 large  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1  pt. whipping cream, whipped until thick
1  box vanilla wafers
3  medium bananas, sliced
preparation: In bowl, combine milk and water. Mix with wire whisk. Add instant pudding. Mix well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 1 cup pudding mixture into 2 1/2-quart dish. Layer wafers and bananas. Repeat twice, ending with pudding. Cover. Chill.

name: MEATBALL CHILI
ingredients:
1  envelope chili seasoning mix
1  lb. can tomatoes
1/2  c. water
1  can meatballs and gravy
1/2  lb. egg noodles, cooked
3  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Combine all but noodles and butter; simmer for 10 minutes. Drain noodles and add butter.  Stir gently over low heat to melt butter and coat noodles.  Serve with meatball mixture.

name: AUNT SHARON'S YOGURT CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. nonfat plain yogurt
preparation: Place chicken breasts in baking pan.  Mix mayonnaise and yogurt together.  Spread mixture over chicken; cover pan with foil.  Cook at 350° for 1 hour.  Serves 4.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. sugar
2/3  c. shortening
2  c. buttermilk
5 1/2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. soda
1  pkg. yeast, dissolved in 1/2 c. warm water
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together and cut in shortening.  Mix yeast and water with buttermilk and mix into dry ingredients. Knead lightly. Store in greased, covered bowl in refrigerator.  To use, take out amounts needed. Roll and cut.  Bake at 450° for about 20 minutes until brown.

name: TEXAS HASH BROWNS
ingredients:
2  lb. pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  tsp. pepper
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
2  c. crushed corn flakes
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
preparation: Mix all but corn flakes and butter in saucepan.  Stir over low heat until blended.   Stir in potatoes.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Melt butter.  Stir in corn flakes.  Sprinkle over potato mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden brown.   Can prepare ahead and refrigerate.

name: CATO (POTATO PIE)
ingredients:
6 to 8  c. mashed potatoes or instant
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. milk
salt and pepper
2  to 3 eggs
1/2  c. chopped ham
1/2  c. diced cheese (Mozzarella)
3  Tbsp. grated cheese
parsley
preparation: Mix mashed potatoes with butter, milk, eggs, salt, pepper, ham, diced cheese and parsley.  Butter a medium roasting pan and pour mixture in.  Top with grated cheese and parsley.  Bake about 1/2 hour or until lightly brown on top.

name: ROLLED BUTTERMILK DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Sift flour with baking powder, soda and salt.  Add buttermilk and mix lightly with a fork.  Turn out on a floured board or pastry cloth.  Knead lightly 4 or 5 times.   Roll or pat out to 1/4-inch thick; cut into rectangles 1 x 3-inch with a floured knife.  Drop into boiling stew.  Cover and boil gently 10 to 12 minutes.  Do not uncover while cooking.

name: SOUFFLE POTATOES
ingredients:
2 2/3  c. mashed potato mix
1  egg beaten
1 (2.8 oz.)  can French fried onions
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Prepare potato mix according to package directions.  Add egg, onions and salt, stirring until blended.  Spoon mixture into greased 2-quart baking dish.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 10 minutes or until cheese melts.  Makes about 8 servings.

name: WESTERN POUND CAKE
ingredients:
6  eggs
3  sticks oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
1  box powdered sugar
1 sugar  box plain flour*
preparation: *Sift the flour 3 times, then measure sugar box full of flour.

name: SEAFOOD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
12  oz. noodles (spiral)
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese
8  oz. sharp Cheddar
8  oz. Muenster
dash of white wine
heavy cream (small carton; may use nondairy creamer)
scallops or other fish
bread crumbs for topping
preparation: Boil noodles until soft.  Drain and rinse.  Add cheeses and wine, mixing until blended.  Add cream, fish and  crab meat or other fish and blend well.  Top with bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: ENCHILADA
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  can Franco-American beef gravy
1 (10 1/4 oz.)  can enchilada sauce
12  taco shells
1 large  can refried beans
Cheddar cheese, grated
sour cream
preparation: Dip taco shells in gravy and enchilada sauce.  Fill with hamburger, beans, sour cream and cheese.  Fold over and place in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cover pan with foil and bake 20 minutes at 400°.

name: CHILI CON QUESO DIP
ingredients:
1  large onion, chopped fine
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. powdered oregano
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies, diced
1  clove garlic, minced
1 (No. 2)  can tomatoes, partly drained
1  lb. Old English Brick cheese, cubed
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add tomatoes with remaining juice, salt and oregano. Cook over medium heat until liquid cooks down. Add cheese and cook over low heat until cheese melts, stirring often. Add chopped chilies. Serve with tostados or corn chips.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. yellow cornmeal
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  c. (8 3/4 oz.) cream-style corn
1/3  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a mixing bowl, combine first 6 ingredients.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Add to dry ingredients and stir only until moistened.  Pour into a greased 9-inch square baking pan or 10-inch heavy skillet.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until bread is golden brown and tests done.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. white sugar
1 1/3  c. chopped pecans
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/3 to 1  Tbsp. vanilla
1 1/3  c. light syrup
6  eggs
3  Tbsp. self-rising flour
preparation: Mix  sugar,  flour  and  butter until smooth.  Then add syrup, eggs and pecans.  Add vanilla last.  Mix well and pour into cooked pie shells.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat  and bake at 300° for 25 minutes or until firm.  Makes 2 (9-inch) pies.

name: SIMPLE BEEF JERKY
ingredients:
4  very thin sliced pork chops, deboned
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/8  c. soy sauce
preparation: Place butter and soy sauce in frying pan and bring to a boil. Place slices in pan and cook until brown on both sides and in center.  Keep adding soy sauce until the meat soaks it up.  Place take into consideration that meat shrinks up a little.  Serve hot, warm or cold.  Makes only 1 serving.

name: BREAD AND BUTTER PICKLES
ingredients:
1  gal. cucumbers, sliced
8  small onions, sliced thin
1 1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. celery seed
5  c. sugar
2  green bell peppers, cut in rings
1/2  c. salt
3 1/2  c. cider vinegar
1 1/2  tsp. turmeric
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
preparation: Mix together cucumbers, bell pepper and onions; soak for 3 hours with 1/2 cup salt.  Mix together remaining ingredients. Drain cucumbers and add to  liquid  mixture.  Bring  to a boil, but do not boil.  Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal.

name: SLOW AND EASY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. beef stew
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. water
preparation: Place beef in buttered casserole dish.  Add soup and water, and then cover.  Bake at 250° for 2 hours or 2 hours and 30 minutes.  Yields 4 servings.

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  medium size onions, finely chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, finely chopped
2  cans tomatoes
preparation: Salt, pepper and flour steak. (Have it tenderized at the butcher shop); cut steak into pieces and brown on both sides. Place in roaster pan. Mix onions, oregano, sweet pepper and tomatoes together and pour over the steak. Cover and place in 375° oven for 2 hours.

name: CUPCAKE CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
vanilla wafers
preparation: Mix together all ingredients; then add 1 teaspoon lemon and 1 teaspoon vanilla.  Mix well.  Put vanilla wafers in bottom of cupcake papers.  Fill 3/4 full; bake and then cool.  Top with whipped cream after cooled.

name: EASY VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans Veg-All
1  c. chopped onions
1  can water chestnuts
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  c. or more shredded cheese
1  roll Ritz crackers, crumbled
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Drain Veg-All.  Mix the first 5 ingredients.  Place in casserole dish sprayed with vegetable spray.  Crush the roll of Ritz crackers.  Mix cracker crumbs with melted margarine; spread over top of vegetable mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SANDY'S SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream margarine, sugar and eggs.  Sift together dry ingredients and stir into creamed mixture.  Roll in small walnut size balls.  Roll in mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° to 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: SPICED BLUEBERRIES
ingredients:
1  c. fresh blueberries
5  c. sugar
1/2  c. cider vinegar
1/2  tsp. each:  ground cinnamon cloves and allspice
1  c. liquid fruit pectin
preparation: Mix all ingredients except pectin in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute.  Remove from heat and add fruit pectin.  Stir well.  Pack into sterilized jars.  Seal.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE PIZZA
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. half and half or evaporated milk
3  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips (18 oz.)
2  c. miniature marshmallows
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2 to 3  c. toppings, such as candied green or red cherry halves, pecan halves and coconut
preparation: White Chocolate Glaze or Vanilla Drizzle

name: GREEN PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. lime Kool-Aid
1 large  bottle ginger ale
2  qt. water
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
2  c. sugar
2  pt. lime sherbet
preparation: Mix.  Just before serving, add lime to float on top.

name: DILL WEED DIP
ingredients:
1  pt. sour cream
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. dill weed
1  Tbsp. Greek seasoned salt
1/2  c. fresh green onion, chopped
1  tsp. Worcestershire
preparation: Mix all.  Serve with fresh raw carrots, celery, radishes, cauliflower, etc.  Yields 2 cups, serves 15.

name: CANTONESE CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
4  lb. chicken wings
1  c. soy sauce
2  jars jr. apricots
1  Tbsp. ginger
1  clove garlic
preparation: Line 17 x 11-inch cookie sheet with foil.  Mix sauce ingredients and spread over chicken.  Marinate overnight.  Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 1 hour.

name: FRIED RICE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. rice
1/2  stick butter or margarine
3  c. bouillon (use 4 cubes to 3 c. water)
3/4  c. grated carrots
3/4  c. diced celery
3/4  c. chopped parsley or 2 tsp. dehydrated
1/2  c. slivered almonds
preparation: Brown rice in butter. add bouillon. Bake in covered 1 1/2-quart casserole 30 minutes in a 375° oven. Stir in vegetables and nuts. Cover and bake 10 minutes more.

name: SCANDINAVIAN RELISH
ingredients:
1  can French-cut green beans, drained
1  can Shoe Peg corn, drained
1  can small English peas, drained
1  jar pimentos, drained
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  purple onion, chopped
1/2  c. celery (optional)
preparation: Mix together and add the following dressing.

name: SPITINI
ingredients:
1  lb. thin sliced sirloin tip steak (from sirloin tip roast)
1/2  c. corn oil
1 1/2  c. seasoned bread crumbs (Progresso Italian)
1/4  lb. piece hard Italian cheese, cut in very small pieces
1  can Del Monte Italian style tomatoes (drain juice)
1  medium onion, cut in sections
preparation: You will need 6 to 8 meat skewers.

name: MEXICAN LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1 (16 oz.)  can refried beans
2  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. ground cumin
3/4  tsp. garlic powder
12  uncooked lasagna noodles
2 1/2  c. water
2 1/2  c. salsa
2  c. sour cream
3/4  c. finely chopped green onions
1 (2.2 oz.)  can sliced black olives
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Brown the ground beef and drain.  Mix with the next 4 ingredients.  Place 4 uncooked noodles into a 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish.  Spread 1/2 of beef mixture over noodles, then place 4 more noodles.  Spread remaining beef mixture over noodles.  Then put 4 more noodles on top.  Mix water and salsa and pour over the top of noodles.  Let sit overnight in fridge.  The next day, bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until noodles are tender.  Then mix sour cream, green onions and black olives.  Spread over lasagna and sprinkle with cheese.  Bake for another 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.	VERY DELICIOUS!

name: BANANA NUT BREAD(2 Loaves)
ingredients:
1  c. butter
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. mashed bananas
1  c. sour cream
3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream butter, eggs, sugar and vanilla.  Add bananas and sour cream.  Mix in flour, soda and salt.  Pour into greased loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH COOKIES
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
1/2  c. chunk peanut butter
5  c. corn flakes
preparation: Melt butterscotch chips and peanut butter together in a pan over hot (not boiling) water.  Stir to blend, then pour over corn flakes which have been placed in a large bowl.  Mix gently and well with two forks.  Drop by teaspoonful on wax paper.  Makes 4 dozen cookies.

name: BIG MAMA CARLISLE'S BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
wafers
bananas
1  c. sugar
1 heaping  Tbsp. flour
3  eggs
3 1/2  c. sweet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. oleo
preparation: Fix wafers and bananas.  Add sugar with flour.  Then add eggs, that have been slightly beaten.  Add milk.  Cook over low heat until thick.  Remove from heat; add vanilla and oleo.  Mix and pour over wafers and bananas.

name: HOUSE DEDICATION PUNCH
ingredients:
1  pkg. cherry powdered drink
1  pkg. lemon powdered drink
1  tsp. Schilling cherry flavoring
1  tsp. Schilling pineapple flavoring
1 large  can frozen lemonade
1 (1 qt. 14 oz.)  can pineapple juice
preparation: Make up the powdered drinks and the lemonade according to directions, except scant the water slightly (to compensate for melting ice).  Combine all of the ingredients.  Some of the punch may be frozen in ring molds to be used in the punch bowl.

name: JOAN CRAWFORD'S MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground sirloin
1  lb. ground veal
1  lb. bulk sausage
3  raw eggs, 2 if large
1  large onion, finely chopped
2  green peppers, finely chopped
1  Tbsp. seasoned salt
1  tsp. Worcestershire
1  tsp. steak sauce
4  hard-cooked eggs
2  Tbsp. seasoned salt
2  tsp. steak sauce
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. water
preparation: Combine meats, unbeaten eggs, chopped onion, chopped pepper, 1 tablespoon seasoned salt, 1 teaspoon steak sauce and 1 tablespoon Worcestershire.  Mix well.

name: AUNT IRENE'S POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3  c. flour
1  c. sweet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  sticks margarine
5  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Combine sweet milk, sugar, margarine and eggs and beat well. Then mix in vanilla and salt.  Add baking powder and flour.  Bake in 300° oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

name: RAW RHUBARB CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. soda
1  c. sour milk
2  c. + 1 tsp. flour
3  c. rhubarb, cut into small chunks
preparation: Mix well, put into 9 X 13 pan.	Sprinkle cinnamon & sugar over top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: GRAND PATE(Fried Dough)
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. sugar
water
preparation: Sift together the first 3 ingredients.  Mix well. Add water until dough is like biscuit dough. Roll on a floured board and cut in any shape you'd like.  Fry in deep fat or oil until golden brown. Sprinkle with powdered sugar, if desired.

name: MAXINE'S CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  cut up chickens
1  can celery
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. white wine or cooking sherry
1  small onion
1/2  lb. sharp cheese
1  c. long grain rice, cooked
bacon slices, crisp and crumbled
1  can bouillon soup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Place  chicken flat in baking dish,  salt  and	pepper, chop onion over top.  Mix soups and sherry; pour over chicken. Grate cheese and spread over top.  Bake 3 hours at 325°.	Cook rice according to directions.  Brown small onion  in  part  of bacon grease.  Blend bouillon soup  and  Worcestershire sauce; add in rice.  Add onion and bacon.  Cook  the  last 30 minutes that the chicken cooks.

name: DON'S DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/2  onion
1/2  bottle Salsa Brava
preparation: To increase, add everything double, but Salsa Brava add to taste.

name: 100 YEAR OLD CAKE RECIPE
ingredients:
1 2/3  c. sugar
2  sticks oleo or butter
vanilla
5  eggs
2  c. flour
salt
preparation: Cream sugar and oleo.  Add eggs and flour, one egg at a time, with a little flour, stirring about 2 minutes for each egg.  Bake in a tube pan at 350° until brown.

name: HOT ROLLS(Yields 50)
ingredients:
1/4  c. yeast
1  qt. water
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
1/8  c. salt
1  c. dry milk
3 1/2  lb. flour (about 10 c.)
preparation: Add yeast and sugar together, then add to very warm (not hot) water. Let yeast rise. In another bowl, add dry milk, salt and flour together. Add oil to yeast, then add flour mixture. Beat until mixture pulls away from bowl; cover and let rise, then knock down and let rise again. Make out into loaf or rolls. Let rise again and bake at 350° until done.

name: PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 large  cans pineapple chunks, drained
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
1  cylinder Ritz crackers, crushed
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Place pineapple chunks in dish.  Mix sugar, flour and cheese; place over pineapple.  Mix crackers and margarine; sprinkle over. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: BEEF AND BEAN HOMEMADE BURRITOS(Quick and Easy)
ingredients:
1  pkg. (10) tortillas
1  large ripe tomato, diced
1/2  onion, chopped
1  pkg. shredded cheese
1 large  can refried beans
1  lb. ground beef
shredded lettuce
salsa or picante sauce
preparation: In skillet brown ground beef. Salt and pepper to taste.  Add can of refried beans.  Stir until thoroughly mixed.  Simmer.  Heat tortillas individually.  Add meat mixture and toppings.

name: MICROWAVE CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/4  c. Karo corn syrup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
3  qt. popped corn
preparation: Combine sugar, butter, syrup and salt.  Cook on High for 3 minutes; stir.  Cook on High for 2 minutes.  Stir in baking soda. Place popped corn in brown paper grocery bag (large).  Pour mixture over popped corn; shake.  Cook on High for 1 1/2 minutes and shake.  Cook again for another 1 1/2 minutes and shake again. Pour into bowl; let cool.  Break up.

name: BERANS' BISCUIT BREAD
ingredients:
3  cans Hungry Jack biscuits
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. finely chopped nuts
preparation: Mix sugar and cinnamon together.  Cut biscuits into quarters and roll in sugar and cinnamon mixture.  Layer in Bundt pan, sprinkling chopped nuts on each layer.  Melt brown sugar and margarine together.  Pour over biscuits in Bundt pan.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: CHEESY POTATO SKINS
ingredients:
3  medium baking potatoes
seasoned salt
6  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
vegetable oil
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
sour cream
preparation: Scrub potatoes thoroughly and rub skins with oil.  Bake at 400° for 1 hour or until done.  Allow potatoes to cool to touch. Cut in halves lengthwise; carefully scoop out pulp leaving 1/4 to 1/8-inch shell.  Pulp may be used for mashed potatoes or reserved for another recipe.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1 2/3  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. salt
2 eggs, beaten with 1/2  c. oil
1  c. pumpkin pie mix (cooked pumpkin, not raw)
preparation: Combine all dry ingredients.  Mix in beaten egg mixture.  Add pumpkin.  Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CORNFLAKES
ingredients:
1/2  c. Karo
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. peanut butter
2  c. cornflakes
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bring to a boil the Karo and sugar.  Remove from heat.  Add the peanut butter, cornflakes and vanilla.  Drop by spoonful onto wax paper.  Cool.

name: CHOCOLATE CHESS PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs, well beaten
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  stick oleo, melted
2  Tbsp. cocoa
pinch of salt
6  oz. evaporated milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and pour into an 8 or 9-inch unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or longer.

name: MILLIONAIRE PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  carton Cool Whip (4 oz.)
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
1 medium  can mandarin oranges, well drained
1 regular  can fruit cocktail, well drained
1  qt. strawberries (in season) or frozen (no sugar)
preparation: Mix together first 3 ingredients and add the next 4 ingredients.  Pour into graham cracker crusts.  Refrigerate overnight or freeze.  Makes 2 pies.

name: HOMEMADE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2 or 3 large  cans Carnation milk
5  eggs, separated
1  pt. or 2 c. crushed pineapple or peaches
salt
preparation: Beat egg yolks, then add sugar and mix.  Add milk.  Beat egg whites until stiff; fold in egg whites and fruit to first mixture. Place in churn.  Place ice in churn.  Add salt on ice and churn until stiff.  Cover top of churn and let it set for approximately 30 minutes.

name: ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. egg whites (room temperature)
1 1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 additional  c. sugar
1  c. self-rising flour
preparation: In large bowl, beat egg whites with salt until foamy.  Add cream of tartar and vanilla and beat until it begins to get stiff. Add sugar and continue beating until very stiff (until when bowl is tilted on side it won't move).  Mix another cup of sugar with self-rising flour in a small Tupperware bowl; shake up to mix. Sprinkle that into egg white mixture and fold in by hand (not a mixer).

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening (or oleo)
1  c. light brown sugar
2  eggs
3  bananas
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
4  tsp. buttermilk
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix together shortening and brown sugar.  Mix beaten eggs and mashed bananas.  Add flour, salt, buttermilk and baking soda.  Mix all ingredients together, adding the walnuts.  Grease 2 loaf pans and bake at 350° about 40 to 45 minutes.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
1  stick butter
1/3  c. milk
3  c. oats
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bring sugar, cocoa, butter and milk to a boil;  continue  to boil  until  soft  ball  stage.  Then add oats, peanut butter and vanilla.  Mix well.  Spoon on wax paper.

name: CHICKEN NOODLE BARBECUE
ingredients:
1  lb. frying chicken
1/4  c. butter
1  Tbsp. chili powder
2  medium onions
1  clove garlic
1 (2 lb.)  can tomatoes
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. dry mustard
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. Tabasco
preparation: Brown chicken in butter.  Sprinkle with chili powder when pieces are turned.  Remove chicken.  Add onions and garlic; cook until tender.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bring to a boil.  Add chicken; cover and simmer.  Serve over cooked noodles.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
3  Tbsp. dill seed or add more to your liking
seasoned salt (until desirable)
onion salt (optional)
preparation: Mix altogether; refrigerate for 6 hours before serving.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  fryer, cut up
1  pkg. dried onion soup mix
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. rice
preparation: Mix onion soup mix with rice in oblong dish.  Place chicken on top of rice mixture.  Thoroughly mix soup with 1 can of water and pour over chicken and rice.  Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 300°.

name: RICE KRISPIE TREATS
ingredients:
6  c. Rice Krispies cereal
40  large marshmallows
1  stick butter
preparation: Melt the marshmallows and butter in pan over medium heat. Remove from heat and add Rice Krispies gradually.  Pour into a pre-greased 12 x 22-inch pan and flatten.  Let cool and eat.

name: BREAKFAST HASH
ingredients:
2  c. (12 oz.) frozen hash brown potatoes
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
8  Eckrich Smok-Y-Links, sliced
2  Tbsp. green pepper, finely chopped
6  eggs
preparation: Using a large skillet, brown the potatoes in melted butter. Season with salt and pepper, then stir in sausage and green pepper.  Beat the eggs until light.  Pour over mixture and cook, stirring frequently, until eggs are thickened but still moist. Makes 4 servings.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
4  eggs
1  c. plus 1 Tbsp. flour
1 (1 lb.)  can chocolate syrup
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix together oleo, sugar and eggs.  Add vanilla, chocolate syrup, flour and baking powder.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: LEMON JELLO CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon jello
3/4  c. water
3/4  c. oil
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
4  eggs
2  c. powdered sugar
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. milk
1/2  c. melted butter
preparation: Mix jello, water, oil, cake mix and eggs together well. Pour into  greased  9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake  at  350°  for  30 minutes. While cake is baking,  mix  powdered  sugar,  lemon juice,  milk and butter together well.  After  cake  is  done, (still hot) poke holes in the top  with  fork.  Pour  powdered sugar mixture over cake and return to oven for 5 minutes.

name: LAZY DAY SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  carton cottage cheese
2  pkg. dry orange jello
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  cans mandarin oranges, drained
1 large  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Chill overnight.

name: APPLE CRISP #2
ingredients:
4  c. sliced apples
1/4  c. water
3/4  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  stick margarine
preparation: Place apples and water in a baking dish. Sift flour, sugar, salt and cinnamon into a bowl.  Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until brown.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1 lg.  can crushed pineapple, undrained
1  box yellow cake mix
2  sticks butter
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Pour cherry pie filling in the bottom of an oblong glass baking dish, next add crushed pineapple, spreading out over the cherries, next add the dry cake mix over the fruit, then the pecans, slice the butter and place over the pecans, covering the whole top.  Bake at 350 degrees for 35 - 40 min. or until golden on top.  Serve with ice cream.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen, sliced peaches
1  stick oleo
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Thaw peaches beforehand.  Melt 1 stick of oleo in oven in Pyrex dish.  Mix flour, baking powder, sugar and milk.  Pour over melted margarine in baking dish.  Put thawed peaches on top of the batter.  Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar and pour 3/4 cup water over all.  Cook 40 to 50 minutes or until crust is browned.

name: BROCCOLI-CHEEZ WHIZ RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  can water (soup can)
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1 1/2  c. uncooked Minute rice
salt and pepper
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Thaw broccoli and place in a large mixing bowl with cream of mushroom soup and water.  Stir in Cheez Whiz and rice.  Add a dash of salt and pepper.  Cut margarine into chunks and distribute these.  Pour all into lightly oiled 2-quart casserole and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: COMMERCIAL PRECOOKED RICE(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. water
1 1/4  c. precooked rice
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a deep 3-quart casserole.  Heat 25 minutes covered or until rice is tender.  Let stand 10 minutes. Pour rice in colander and rinse with hot water.

name: POTATO MOUSSAKA
ingredients:
3  medium potatoes
2  medium onions, chopped
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  lb. lean ground beef
2  garlic cloves, minced
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. cinnamon
salt and pepper
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cut potatoes in 1/4-inch slices.  Brush lightly with oil and broil 5 minutes on each side.  Arrange half of potatoes in an even layer in shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish.  Saute onion in olive oil.  Set aside.

name: RITZY CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  c. boiled chicken breasts cut in cubes (reserve the broth)
1 1/2  c. crushed Ritz crackers
3/4  stick margarine, softened
1  can Cream of Chicken soup
8  oz. carton sour cream
2  c. chicken broth
preparation: Combine crackers and margarine, reserving 1 cup.  Spread the rest in 13x9x2 pan.  Spread the boiled chicken cubes over top of the Ritz layer.  In separate pan, combine soup, sour cream and chicken broth.  Pour this mixture over the chicken layer, sprinkle the cup of reserved crumbs on top.  Bake in 350° oven for 25- 30 mins.

name: LETOURNEAU CANDY
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. white Karo
3  c. whipping cream (canned evaporated milk can be substituted but is not as good)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together and stir carefully sugar, cream of tartar, salt and 1 cup of cream.  Wipe sides of bowl so no sugar sticks to sides.  Cook mixture on medium heat, stirring until it forms a soft ball when dropped into cold water or 238°.  Slowly add second cup of cream to mixture as it continues to boil.  Cook until it forms a soft ball again when dropped in cold water.  Slowly add the Karo and continue cooking until soft ball stage.  Slowly add the third cup of cream and continue boiling until it forms a hard ball when dropped into cold water or 248°.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Pour into well buttered pan.  Do not scrape bowl.  Have a buttered dish set aside to pour scrapings into.  When mixture is cool and well set, turn it out on a cutting board and cut in small squares.  Wrap each piece in waxed paper.  Do not let it set too long or it will be difficult to cut.

name: BEST CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. butter
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1 1/2  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream the butter, sugar and brown sugar.  Add egg and vanilla. Add baking soda and salt; mix well.  Add chocolate chips.  Add flour, 1 cup at a time, until mix is solid.  This means the mix will make a solid cookie ball.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: BUTTERMILK POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1  c. shortening
2 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
3 1/2  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. hot water
1 1/4  c. buttermilk
preparation: Put soda in hot water.  Mix with buttermilk.  Set aside. Cream oleo, shortening and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time.   Add flour and salt.  Mix well.  Add lemon juice.  Add buttermilk mixture.  Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: ITALIAN MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground pork
1  egg, beaten
3/4  c. cracker crumbs
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
2/3  c. tomato sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/3  c. tomato sauce
2  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Combine meat, egg, cracker crumbs, onion, 1/3 cup tomato sauce, salt, pepper and oregano.

name: SNOWBALL'S JEWELS
ingredients:
1  pkg. (14 oz.) flaked coconut
1  can (14 oz.) sweetened condensed milk
1  tsp. almond extract
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. M&M's (plain or peanut) chocolate candies
preparation: Combine all ingredients; mix well.  Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 9 to 11 minutes, or until edges are golden brown.  Immediately remove from cookie sheets.  Cool on wire rack.  Makes 3 dozen cookies.

name: EASY ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  stick margarine
1  onion, chopped
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.)  can taco sauce
1 (15 oz.)  can enchilada sauce
2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  pkg. corn tortillas
preparation: Brown ground beef.  Saute onion in the margarine.  Add sauces and soups to the onion and meat mixture.  Layer the meat mixture and tortillas in a large 9 x 13-inch casserole and top with grated cheese.  Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.  You may tear the tortillas into fourths and add them to the mixture instead of layering.

name: SEAFOOD AND PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. scallops
1  lb. cooked shrimp
1/2  lb. imitation crab
4  green onions
1  tsp. olive oil
4  boiled eggs
2  c. Best Foods mayonnaise
1  bag tri-colored rotini noodles, cooked and drained
preparation: Boil the noodles, then rinse and put in a bowl which you will be using for serving the salad.  Saute scallops in the olive oil. Add the scallops along with the rest of the seafood to the noodles.  Dice the green onions (exclude the chive part) and boiled eggs.  Add to the salad.  Add mayonnaise; use more or less for taste.  Mix ingredients together.  Ready to serve!

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  qt. strawberries
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 (10 oz.)  bottle 7-Up
red food coloring
preparation: Mix and boil everything but strawberries and food coloring until clear and very thick.  Cool completely.  Add to the mixture the quart of strawberries and food coloring.  Pour into a large baked pie shell.  Top with whipped cream or Cool Whip before serving.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  jar sharp Cheddar cheese spread
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  jar pimento cheese spread
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
few drops Tabasco sauce
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine cheeses, onion, Worcestershire sauce and Tabasco sauce. Mix 2 1/2 minutes. Chill overnight. Shape into ball. Roll in pecans.

name: STRAWBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. oil
2  (10 oz.) frozen strawberries
1 3/4  c. warm water
2  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
5 1/2  c. flour
1  egg
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Pour 1 cup warm water in large bowl.  Sprinkle in yeast.  Stir until dissolved.   Add sugar, salt and 1/2 the flour.  Beat with electric mixer on medium speed for 2 minutes.  Beat in egg and soft shortening.  Mix rest of flour until soft dough to handle.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can Shoepeg corn
1 (16 oz.)  can French-cut green beans
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped onions
1/4  c. chopped green peppers
1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. sliced almonds
salt and pepper
preparation: Drain corn and beans; mix all ingredients into 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Top with 2 cups cracker crumbs mixed with 1/2 stick melted butter.  Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

name: CHOCOLATE SHAKE
ingredients:
4  Cups Cold Skim Milk
1-4 oz. Sugarfree Chocolate Pudding Mix
3-4 Drops Vanilla
1/2  Cup Ice Cubes
preparation: In blender, combine milk, pudding mix and vanilla.  Cover and blend until smooth.  Add ice, cover and let stand 3 minutes to thicken.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
1  c. macaroni
1/4  c. margarine
1/2  c. finely chopped carrots
1/2  c. finely chopped celery
1  small onion, finely chopped
4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. shredded process American cheese
2  c. chicken broth
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. ground pepper
2  Tbsp. water
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
1/2  c. frozen peas
preparation: Cook macaroni according to package directions, omitting salt. Drain; rinse with cold water.  Drain and set aside.  Melt margarine in heavy skillet over medium heat.  Add carrots, celery and onions.  Cook and stir until tender.  Remove from heat and set aside.  Combine milk and cheese in heavy Dutch oven.  Cook and stir over medium heat until cheese melts, being careful it does not stick or scorch.  Stir in chicken broth and pepper. Combine cornstarch with water; mix until smooth.  Stir into milk mixture. Cook, stirring constantly, until comes to a boil.  Boil 1 minute. Stir in macaroni, vegetable mixture, corn and peas.  Heat thoroughly, stirring constantly.  Yields 8 cups.

name: CORN RELISH
ingredients:
12  ears corn
1  small head cabbage
4  medium onions, pared
3  sweet red peppers, seeded
3  Tbsp. salt
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. turmeric powder
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  qt. vinegar
preparation: Cook corn about 3 minutes; cut from cob.  Put cabbage, onions and peppers through food chopper, using coarse blade.  Combine all vegetables.  Blend salt, flour, turmeric, sugar and mustard; add vinegar gradually.  Bring to boil and add vegetables.  Simmer 25 to 30 minutes.  Seal at once in hot sterilized jars.  Makes about 8 pints.

name: CHOCOLATE RAVIOLI COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. (1 stick) butter at room temperature
1/2  c. packed light brown sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  large egg
2  sq. (1 oz. each) unsweetened chocolate
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Beat butter, sugar and vanilla in large bowl with electric mixer until pale and fluffy.  Melt chocolate and cool.  Beat in egg, chocolate and baking powder with mixer on low speed, beat in flour just until blended.  Pat dough into a disk, wrap in plastic wrap, refrigerate 1 hour until firm enough to shape and roll out. Heat oven to 350°.  Roll out dough on lightly floured surface to 1/8 inch thickness.  Cut in 2 1/2-inch squares.  Spoon 1 heaping teaspoon cherry pie filling in center.  Brush edges with beaten egg white.  Top with remaining square (dough may crack slightly). Press edges with fork to seal.  With a sharp knife, cut an X in the center of tops.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 15 minutes. Makes about 18.

name: STEAK KEBABS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. reduced-sodium soy sauce
2  Tbsp. honey
1  tsp. ground ginger
1  clove garlic, crushed
1  tsp. grated lemon peel
1/4  tsp. crushed hot red pepper flakes
12  oz. boneless sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch cubes
8  cherry tomatoes
4  large mushrooms, halved
1  green bell pepper, cored, seeded and cut into 8 squares
preparation: In a shallow glass dish, combine soy sauce, honey, ginger, garlic, lemon peel and red pepper flakes.  Mix well. Add beef; stir to coat.  Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally.  Preheat broiler. Remove beef from marinade. Discard marinade.  Using 4 (10-inch) metal skewers, alternately thread beef, tomatoes, mushrooms and bell pepper.  Place on broiler pan.  Broil 2-inches from heat, turning 2 to 3 times, until meat is medium-rare and vegetables are lightly browned, about 10 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: GROUND BEEF QUICHE
ingredients:
1  deep dish pie crust
1  lb. ground beef, browned
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
2  eggs
1  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown beef with onion and green pepper.  Mix eggs, milk and cheese; add to the meat mixture.  Put into crust and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: RIBBON SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime gelatin
5  c. hot water
4  c. cold water
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon gelatin
1/2  c. mini marshmallows, cut up
1  c. pineapple juice
8  oz. cream cheese
1  lb. 4 oz.  can crushed pineapple
1  c. heavy cream, whipped
1  c. mayonnaise
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cherry gelatin
preparation: Dissolve lime gelatin in 2 cups hot water.  Add 2 cups cold water.  Pour into 14 x 10 x 2-inch pan.  Chill until partly set. Dissolve lemon gelatin in 1 cup hot water in top of double boiler. Add marshmallows and stir to melt.  Remove from heat.  Add pineapple juice and cream cheese.  Beat well and stir in pineapple.  Cool slightly.  Fold in whipped cream and mayonnaise. Chill until thickened.  Pour in layer over lime gelatin.  Chill until almost set.  Dissolve cherry gelatin in 2 cups hot water. Add 2 cups cold water.  Chill until syrupy.  Pour over pineapple layer.  Chill until firm.  Makes 24 servings.

name: FRENCH STRAWBERRY PIE(No Sugar)
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. or envelope unflavored gelatin
1/4  c. cold water
1  qt. strawberries
3  Tbsp. liquid non-calorie sweetener
red food coloring
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  (9-inch) baked pie shell
preparation: Soften gelatin in cold water.  Wash and cap strawberries.  Add sweetener.  Press 1 1/2 cups strawberries through strainer.  Add food coloring.  If desired, add lemon juice and bring to boil. Remove from heat and soften gelatin, stirring to dissolve. Chill until mixture begins to thicken.  Fold in remaining whole strawberries.  Spoon in cooled pie shell.  Refrigerate until set. Garnish with whipped cream.

name: EXECUTIVE POWER DINNER
preparation: Call home first.  If your wife, daughter, neighbor or anyone else answers the phone, try talking them into cooking a real supper for you.  If no answer, try leaving a message as a last resort.  If the phone rings 12 times, assume no one is home and drive to the commissary.  Once inside, see if any company is passing out free cooked food samples.  If not, proceed to the frozen food section and select your microwave meal for the evening.  Do your best to pick a "healthy" meal by checking the back of the box (good luck). Pay.  Leave fast.

name: MAKE-AHEAD LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh spinach, torn
1  small head red leaf lettuce
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
1 (1.18 oz.)  pkg. creamy Italian salad dressing mix
2  hard-boiled eggs, sliced
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen English peas, thawed
1/2  c. chopped green onion
6  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
chopped green onion and crumbled crisp bacon for garnish
preparation: Combine spinach and lettuce; place half of salad greens in large clear glass salad bowl.  Combine sour cream, mayonnaise and salad dressing mix; stir well and spread half of mixture evenly over salad greens.  Layer (in order) the egg slices, peas, 1/2 cup green onion, 6 slices crumbled bacon and remaining salad greens. Spread remaining sour cream mixture over top, sealing to edge of bowl.  Cover and chill overnight.  Garnish with additional onion and bacon.  Yield:  8 to 10 servings.

name: STUFFED BELL PEPPERS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
1  jar chunky Manwich mix
1  pot cooked rice
shredded cheese of choice
preparation: Brown and drain ground beef.  Add Manwich mix.  Add rice and stuff green peppers with rice-beef mixture.  Top with cheese of choice.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: STUFFED CHICKEN BREAST
ingredients:
3  chicken breasts
3  slices Swiss cheese
6  slices ham, thin
cream cheese
6  slices bacon
mushrooms, drained
butter
preparation: Debone chicken breasts, then split in half; pound with mallet. Top with 1/2 slice Swiss cheese.  Add slice of ham.  Place cream cheese in center; roll up.  Wrap slice of bacon around rolls, secure with toothpicks.  Place in flat baking dish.  Cover with one can of mushrooms and one stick of melted butter.  Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes in 350° oven.

name: RASPBERRY ANGEL CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  angel food cake
1  (3 oz.) raspberry sugar-free jello
1  c. water
10  oz. frozen raspberries
1  carton low-fat raspberry yogurt
preparation: Prepare jello, using 1 cup water.  When slightly thickened, stir in raspberries and yogurt.  Pour over angel food cake which has been torn into 3/4-inch pieces.  Refrigerate.

name: FRESH PEACH ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs, beaten
4  c. milk, divided
1  c. whipping cream
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
1  c. sugar
6  c. mashed fresh peaches or frozen
preparation: Combine 1 1/2 cups sugar, flour and salt.  Add eggs and blend well.  Add 2 cups milk and cook slowly over low heat until slightly thickened.  Cool.  Add whipping cream, remaining 2 cups milk, vanilla and peaches, which have been sweetened with 1 cup sugar. Pour into a 4-quart container of electric or hand-turned freezer and freeze according to directions.  Yield:  1 gallon.

name: PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
1/4  c. salt
1/2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. cream of tartar
1/2  c. water
1/2  Tbsp. cooking oil
food coloring (to be added after cooking)
preparation: Mix together all ingredients.  Cook over medium heat until mixture pulls away from sides of pan.  Remove from heat.  Turn onto smooth surface and knead (it will be hot - be careful).  Add food coloring (to sectioned parts) of your choice.  Store in covered containers.

name: PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. beef top round or sirloin steak, 1-inch thick
1  medium onion, cut into thin slices
2  medium green peppers, cut into strips
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  medium tomatoes
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  c. water
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2 to 3  tsp. sugar (optional)
preparation: Serve with rice.  Cut beef into 1/4-inch strips (partially frozen beef, slices easier).  Heat oil in large skillet.  Add beef and cook about 5 minutes, turning frequently, or until brown.  Stir in water, onion, garlic salt and ginger.  Heat to boiling; reduce heat.  Cover and simmer 12 to 15 minutes.  Add green pepper last 5 minutes of simmering.  While beef simmers, cook rice as directed on package.

name: ENGLISH TRIFLE
ingredients:
1 large  pound cake
1  can mixed fruit
2  pkg. Jell-O, your choice
Jimmies, your choice
1  pkg. vanilla or chocolate pudding
1/2  c. Amaretto
preparation: Cut 1/2 the pound cake into slices and place in a large, deep glass dish.  Pour 1/2 cup of Amaretto on top of pound cake, then pour 1 packet of Jell-O on pound cake.  Add 1/2 can of mixed fruit, then chill for 1/2 hour.  Add remaining pound cake, second packet of Jell-O, remaining mixed fruit, and add pudding on the top.  Cover with Jimmies.  Chill for 1 hour, then ready to serve. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: PARTY POPCORN CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/4  c. oil
1/2  lb. marshmallows (2 1/2 c.)
20  caramels (1 c.)
1/2  lb. salted peanuts
10  c. popped corn
1/2  lb. M&M's
preparation: In microwave oven melt together butter, oil, marshmallows and caramels.  Place popcorn and peanuts in large mixing bowl.  Add melted ingredients and stir together until popcorn and peanuts are evenly coated.  Add candies last.  Press firmly into oiled 12 cup Bundt pan.  Let cool.  Remove.  Let set overnight for easier slicing.

name: COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
6  c. shredded cabbage
1  c. shredded carrots
1/2  c. thinly sliced green peppers
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients.  Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and chill.

name: FRUIT CAKE FOR THE HOLIDAY
ingredients:
2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. shortening
1  tsp. cloves
20  to 25 dates, cut up
2  eggs
3  c. flour
1 small  jar candied cherries
2  c. cold water
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. chopped nuts
1 heaping  tsp. baking soda, in 1/3 c. boiling water
preparation: Boil the sugar, shortening, spices, salt, dates and raisins for 15 minutes.  When cooled, add eggs, soda (dissolved in boiling water), flour, mixed fruit, cherries and nuts.  The mixture will be stiff (I use my clean hands).  Bake in greased pan in a 325° oven for about 1 1/2 hours.  (I add a little brandy or rum.)

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. angel hair spaghetti
1  diced green pepper
1  diced tomato
2  diced celery stalks
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/4 to 1/3  c. grated cheese
2  cruets of Good Seasons Italian mix
preparation: Cook spaghetti; add into a large bowl.  Add all the ingredients; mix well.  Keep refrigerated.

name: ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
2  c. grated cheese
1  can chopped green chilies
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. onion soup
1  can enchilada sauce
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. tortillas
preparation: Brown hamburger; mix with onion soup and cream soup.  Also place green chilies in mixture.  Layer tortillas, hamburger mixture and cheese.  The last layer should be cheese.  Bake until cheese is melted at 350°.

name: ROUND DEER STEAK
ingredients:
2  round deer steaks
1/2  stick butter or margarine
1  large onion
1  bell pepper
1/2  c. Montreal steak seasoning
preparation: Take your round deer steak and cut into strips.  Add your 1/2 cup of Dale's steak seasoning and the Montreal steak seasoning (sprinkle to your liking).  Let marinate for at least 2 hours. Then melt your butter or margarine and simmer strips with bell pepper and onion for about 1 hour.  (Cover your skillet.)

name: ASPARAGUS OR ARTICHOKE PIE
ingredients:
1  can artichokes, drained and cut in half or 1 lb. fresh asparagus, cut in 1-inch pieces
5  to 6 eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. oil
1  small onion, minced
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1 or 2  cloves garlic or 1/2 tsp. garlic powder
bottom crust of pie shell
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Fry artichokes or asparagus with oil, onion and garlic until tender and onion is transparent.  In a separate bowl, mix eggs, Parmesan cheese, Mozzarella cheese, salt, pepper, parsley and baking powder.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
5  lb. potatoes
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1 to 1 1/2  sticks butter
1  c. milk
1  onion, diced
salt
preparation: Peel and slice potatoes; wash well.  Place 1/2 of potatoes in dish and salt.  Slice cheese and place over bottom layer of potatoes.  Slice butter over cheese and spread 1/2 of onion on top.  Place remaining potatoes over 1st layer.  Repeat butter, onions, salt and cheese.  Pour 3/4 to 1 cup milk over it all and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients into a batter.  Line a 13 x 9-inch pan with fruit.  Pour batter over fruit.  Mix 1 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water; pour over batter.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CHOCOLATE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  3/4 c all purpose flour
1  tbsp baking powder
1/4  tsp salt
3  tbsp cocoa
1/2  c granulated sugar
6  tbsp melted butter
3/4  c creamy peanut butter
2/3  c milk
1  large egg
1  tsp vanilla extract
1/2  c semisweet chocolate chips
preparation: Heat oven to 375°. In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Stir in the cocoa and sugar. In a medium bowl, beat the peanut butter, melted butter, egg, and vanilla extract until the mixture is smooth. Pour the peanut butter mixture and  the chocolate chips into the flour mixture. Stir until blended. The batter will be stiff. Fill greased muffin tins full. Bake for 20 minutes or until a tester inserted in a muffin comes out clean. Makes one dozen muffins.

name: PEANUT BLOSSOMS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  egg
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
Hershey Kisses
preparation: Combine all  ingredients,  except  Kisses,  in	a large mixing bowl.  Mix	on  lowest  speed until dough forms.  Shape dough into balls and roll in sugar.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Remove from oven and immediately top each cookie with a candy Kiss.	Press down firmly so cookie cracks around edge.

name: QUICK COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  c. self-rising flour
1 large and 1 small  can sliced peaches (some of the juice removed)
butter
preparation: Mix sugar, egg and flour together until crumbly.  Spread over sliced peaches, with some of the juice removed, in a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish.  Dot with butter.  Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

name: RUM CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  pkg. vanilla instant pudding (small)
1/2  c. Wesson oil
1  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. rum (Bacardi)
1/2  c. water
4  eggs
preparation: Grease and flour tube pan.  Put pecans in bottom.  Mix all ingredients (batter will be thick).  Pour on top of pecans.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: ROCKY ROAD-PEANUT BUTTER SQUARES
ingredients:
3/4  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. peanut butter
6  c. Triples cereal
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. coarsely chopped peanuts
1/2  (8 oz.) bag semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  Tbsp. shortening
preparation: Heat syrup and sugar to boiling in heavy 2-quart pan over medium heat, stirring constantly.  Immediately remove from heat; stir in peanut butter until melted.  Place cereal in large bowl. Pour peanut butter mixture over cereal, stirring until well coated.  Cool 2 minutes.  Stir in marshmallows.

name: SHRIMP ANGEL HAIR
ingredients:
2  lb. shrimp, cleaned
1/4  lb. mushrooms
1/2  bell pepper
1  small onion
2 to 3  cloves garlic
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  lb. fresh angel hair pasta, cooked and drained
salt and pepper
4  Tbsp. butter
4  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. sherry
preparation: Saute  minced  bell pepper, onion and garlic in butter. Add flour  and	cook  about 2 minutes.	Stir in shrimp, mushrooms, milk  and  sherry.	Cook over low heat until shrimp is cooked and sauce is thick.  Season  with  cayenne pepper, salt and pepper to taste.  Serve over angel hair pasta.  Serves 6.

name: SEASHELL PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. large shell pasta, cooked according to pkg. directions, rinsed with cold water and drained
1 (28 oz.)  can Hunt's choice-cut tomatoes, drained
2  medium carrots, diagonally sliced
1/2  red bell pepper, cubed
1/2  green bell pepper, cubed
1/3  c. sliced green onions
1 (2.25 oz.)  can sliced ripe black olives, drained
1  c. Italian salad dressing
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: In a large bowl, stir together all ingredients until well mixed.  Cover and refrigerate 1 hour before serving.  Makes 10 cups of salad.

name: BAKLAVA
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. walnuts, ground
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  lb. phyllo dough
1  lb. butter, melted
1 1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Butter a 15 x 10 x 1 1/2-inch jelly roll pan.  In a large bowl combine walnuts, 1 1/2 cups sugar and cinnamon.  Lay 1 sheet phyllo in pan; brush with butter.  Repeat until 1/2 of phyllo is used.  Sprinkle with walnut mixture. Repeat phyllo layers with butter.  Using a sharp knife, cut halfway through layers of phyllo.  Bake in oven 1 1/4 hours or until deep golden brown.  Meanwhile, in a medium-size saucepan, heat water and 1 1/2 cups sugar over medium heat to boiling, stirring frequently.  Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.  Stir in lemon juice.  Remove from heat.  Cool.  Spoon over Baklava.  Let stand 4 hours before cutting.

name: CHERRY CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3  to 4 eggs
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  pt. sour cream
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix first four ingredients together, then pour into a greased 9-inch pie dish.  Bake at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes.  Then mix the next three ingredients and spread on top of pie.  Bake for 15 minutes more.  Let cool in oven with door open.  Top cooled pie with a can of cherry pie filling and refrigerate.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  lb. macaroni
1/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. water
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1  c. mayo
3/4  c. canned milk
chopped celery
chopped onions
salt and pepper
hard-boiled eggs
preparation: Bring vinegar and water to a boil and let cool.  Mix well and add to water and vinegar the sugar, egg, mayo and canned milk.  Add chopped onion, chopped celery, salt, pepper and hard-boiled eggs.

name: DILLY BRUSSEL SPROUTS
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. Brussel Sprouts
1/2  tsp. Dill Weed
1/2  c. Italian Dressing
1  Tbsp Green Onions (Sliced) or Fresh/Dried Chives
preparation: 1. Cook brussel sprouts using directions on package. Drain.   2. Mix Italian dressing, dill weed, and green onions or chives.   3. Pour over warm sprouts and chill several hours before     serving.

name: EASY BEER BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. self-rising flour
3  Tbsp. sugar
1 (12 oz.)  can beer
2 to 3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Combine flour and sugar in a large bowl.  Gradually add beer (at room temperature), stirring just until moistened; spoon into a greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until loaf tests done.   Brush top with butter. Cool loaf in pan 10 minutes.  Remove from pan and cool completely on wire rack.  Slice with electric knife.  Yield: 1 loaf.

name: MINI GERMAN CHOCOLATE BANANA LOAVES
ingredients:
2  ripe bananas, sliced (3/4 c.)
1 (18.25 oz.)  pkg. plain German chocolate mix
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. vegetable oil
3  large eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, mash bananas with mixer (30 seconds). Add cake mix, milk, oil, eggs and vanilla.  Blend on low for 1 minute, scrape down sides of bowl and beat 2 minutes on medium. Add chocolate chips.  Pour into 6 (6-inch) loaf pans that have been sprayed and floured.

name: BEEF DELICIOUS
ingredients:
1  c. tomato soup
1/4  c. chopped onions
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1 small  box macaroni
preparation: Grease skillet and add beef, onions, salt and pepper and cook until brown.  Cook macaroni and drain.

name: EASY PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2/3  c. milk
1/2  pt. marshmallow cream
1  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar with milk.  Cook to soft ball stage.  Remove from heat.  Quickly add marshmallow cream, peanut butter and vanilla.  Combine until mixed well.  Pour into 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan and cool.

name: WHITE BREAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. warm water
2/3  c. Crisco
2  c. scalded milk
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  egg, beaten
7 to 9  c. flour
preparation: Scald milk; add Crisco, sugar and salt.  Cool to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in warm water in large bowl.  Add milk mixture and egg; add enough flour to make soft dough.  Beat with mixer until dough looks elastic.  By hand, add enough flour to make stiff dough.  Knead until smooth.  Put in greased bowl; turn and grease top.  With kitchen fork, punch 8 holes in the dough.  Cover and let rise until doubled, about 2 hours.  Shape dough into 3 loaves. Brush tops with melted butter.  Cover and let rise until doubled. Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN WITH CURRY DILL SAUCE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
