1/8  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  c. milk
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1/4  tsp. curry powder
6  bone-in chicken breast halves
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
preparation: In a saucepan over medium heat, melt butter. Add the flour, salt and pepper; stir until smooth. Gradually add milk and bring to a boil. Boil and stir for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat. Add the mayonnaise, dill and curry; stir until smooth. Set aside.

name: EASY CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
4  split chicken breasts, cook chicken and bone
2  boxes frozen broccoli (use 1, if desired)
1  c. bread crumbs mixed with 2 Tbsp. margarine
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Mix undiluted soups thoroughly; add 1/4 cup cheese.  Mix in broccoli and chicken (cut into chunks).  Top with remaining buttered crumbs and cheese.  Bake at 325° until bubbly and browned.

name: QUICK BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  can mushroom soup
1  can chicken soup
1/2 (8 oz.)  box frozen broccoli, chopped
1 1/2  cans 2% milk
pat of butter
preparation: Cook broccoli for 5 minutes.  Add soup, milk, butter, salt and pepper to taste.

name: MACARONI 'N' CHEESE
ingredients:
1-1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
1  c. Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
2  c. cooked macaroni
Salt and pepper
preparation: Mix milk and eggs together in a medium bowl.  Add cheese, butter and cooked macaroni.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Pour into buttered baking dish.  Top with cheese.  Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

name: COD FISH FRITTERS(Bacalaitos)
ingredients:
1/2  lb. salted cod fish
2  c. flour
2  c. water
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. oregano, ground
oil for deep frying
preparation: Soak the cod fish in water for two hours to remove part of the salt.  Remove bones and skin and shred into small pieces.  Mix flour, baking powder, garlic, oregano and water and add the cod fish.  Mix well.  Drop by tablespoonful and deep fry until crispy. Remove and drain on absorbing paper.  Makes 24.

name: STEVE'S FAMOUS CHILI
ingredients:
2  lb. ground chuck
1  medium size chopped onion
1  Tbsp. fresh garlic, chopped or crushed
31  oz. can Brooks chili hot beans
16  oz. can Brooks "Just For Chili" diced tomatoes (medium)
16  oz. can Brooks "Just For Chili" tomato sauce
46  oz. can tomato juice
16  oz. jar Pace picante sauce (medium)
2 or 3  drops Tabasco sauce (for flavor, more for heat)
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Place ground chuck in skillet.  Combine chopped onion, chopped garlic, salt and chili powder.  Cook on medium high, stirring occasionally until meat is browned.;  Drain off grease.  Combine browned seasoned meat with the remainder of ingredients in a large soup kettle.  Cook on low to medium low heat.  After chili starts to bubble, allow it to simmer for at least 30 minutes before serving.  This will taste even better on the second day.

name: SCOTCH CAKE ICING
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  box powdered sugar
1  c. pecans
6  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
preparation: Five minutes before cake is done, place in saucepan used in making the cake.  Bring ingredients to a boil.  Remove from heat and add powdered sugar, vanilla, coconut and pecans.  Mix and spread on cake while both are still hot.

name: EASY HAMBURGER MACARONI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. macaroni
1  (28 oz.) Ragu
1  onion, diced
1  green pepper, diced
1  pkg. shredded mild Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Brown hamburger with salt, pepper, garlic, diced onion and green pepper.  Cook macaroni as directed on package.  Drain and rinse macaroni in cool water.  Put macaroni in a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Drain hamburger and add Ragu; mix well, then add to macaroni.  Stir in cheese and bake 20 to 30 minutes.

name: ALMOND BARK COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. peanut butter
1/4  lb. butter or oleo, softened
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. chopped dates
1  c. flaked coconut
1  pkg. white almond bark
preparation: Cream together sugar, peanut butter and butter. Mix with nuts, dates and coconut. When well mixed, roll into small balls with your hands. Refrigerate while melting almond bark over low heat. When melted, with 2 teaspoons dip the balls into the hot bark to coat, then place on wax paper. Place in refrigerator until hard on outside.

name: SAUTEED TOFU AND VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1  pkg. Na Soya French country tofu
1  head broccoli
3  carrots
1  onion
2  yellow squash or zucchini or both
2  cloves garlic, crushed
4  Tbsp. olive oil or vegetable oil
preparation: Cut up vegetables.  In large skillet saute onion until tender. Add carrots and cook a few minutes.  Add broccoli.  Cut tofu into small cubes and add to vegetables.  Press garlic into mix.  Stir well and serve.  Serves 2 to 4.

name: A HAPPY MARRIAGE
ingredients:
1  c. consideration
1  c. courtesy
2  c. milk of human kindness
1  gal. faith in God and each other
2  c. praise
1  small pinch in-laws
1  reasonable budget
3  Tbsp. pure extract (I'm sorry)
1  c. confidence
1  c. encouragement
2  children (at least)
1  hobby
1  c. blindness to each other's faults
dash of cooperation
preparation: Flour with frequent portions of recreation and a dash of happy memories.  Stir well and remove jealousy, temper and criticism. Sweeten well with generous portions of love.  Keep warm with a steady flame of devotion.  Never serve with cold shoulder or sharp tongue.

name: DAISY'S YUM YUM SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
juice of 1 lemon
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1 (2 oz.)  jar stuffed green olives, sliced
1 scant  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. plain gelatin
1/2  c. cold water
1/2  pt. cream, whipped
preparation: Soak gelatin in cold water for 10 minutes. Heat pineapple. Add sugar and lemon juice. Add soaked gelatin to hot mixture. When cool and beginning to set, add cheese, whipped cream, olives and nuts. Pour in a 9 x 13-inch pan and place in refrigerator to finish congealing. Serves 15.

name: HAM STRATA(Make Ahead Main Dish)
ingredients:
12  slices white bread
3/4  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
1  pkg. chopped broccoli, thawed
2  c. diced ham
3 1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. minced onion
salt and pepper to taste
dry mustard to taste
preparation: Cut 24 rounds of bread with cutter; set aside.  Fit scraps of bread in bottom of greased pan.  Place layer of cheese over bread, then layer of broccoli, then ham.  Arrange rounds on top of mixture.  Combine remaining ingredients; pour over mixture. Cover.  Refrigerate overnight.  Bake, uncovered, in a 325° oven for 55 minutes.  Serves 12.

name: MARY LEE'S PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1/2  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. white sugar
1/4  c. maple syrup
3  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. pecans
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Place nuts in empty pie shell.  Pour remaining ingredients, which have been mixed together, over nuts.  Bake at 350° for approximately 55 minutes.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
12  small flour tortilla shells
1 1/2  lb. shredded Cheddar cheese
4  to 6 chicken breasts
3  cans cream of chicken soup
2 small  cartons sour cream
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can chopped green chilies
green onions
preparation: Boil chicken and cut into pieces.  Mix soup, sour cream, onion, chilies and chicken.  Pour 1/2 of mixture into slightly greased baking dish.  Roll cheese in flour shells and place on top of chicken mixture.  Top with rest of chicken mixture, cheese and chopped green onions.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until good and hot.

name: CORNBREAD SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1 1/2  c. mayo
2  pkg. dry ranch dressing mix
1  pan Martha White Mexican cornbread mix (crumbled)
1 large  can pinto beans (rinsed and drained)
1 (16 oz.)  can whole kernel corn
2  c. shredded mild Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. chopped green onions
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
3  medium tomatoes, chopped
12  oz. pkg bacon, cooked and crumbled
preparation: Mix sour cream, mayo and dry dressing mix together; set aside. Bake cornbread. When cool, crumble portion into bottom of 3 qt. (or larger) clear bowl. Layer beans, corn, cheese, onions, pepper, tomatoes, bacon and dressing mix (thin layer-about a cup). Repeat layers. Top with remaining dressing mix. Add a little cheese on top.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick butter (1/2 c.)
1/3  c. shortening
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. sliced, fresh strawberries or drained, chopped frozen strawberries
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry-flavored gelatin
2 2/3  c. all-purpose flour
3 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla extract
4  egg whites
preparation: Cream the butter, shortening and sugar until fluffy.  Add strawberries and gelatin; beat well.  Combine dry ingredients and add alternately with milk.  Add vanilla; beat well.  Fold in egg whites.  Turn into 3 lightly greased and floured 8-inch cake pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Frost with strawberry frosting.  Yields three 8-inch layers.

name: FOOLPROOF PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. shortening
1  egg
2  tsp. vinegar
5  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Mix together the flour, salt and shortening until it's like coarse meal.  In a small bowl, beat the egg, vinegar and water. Add this to the flour mixture; mix together into form of a ball. Divide into 5 little balls, enough to make 5 shells.  Can be refrigerated for a week or more if placed in plastic bag and sealed.

name: CHEESE-PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
3  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. melted butter
1/2  c. Ritz crackers, crushed
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Drain pineapple.  Reserve 3 tablespoons juice.  Mix flour, sugar and cheese.  Gradually add juice and pineapple.  Pour into greased 1-quart dish.  Mix crackers and butter.  Cover mixture with cracker mixture.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: LADY BIRD JOHNSON STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1 10  oz. pkg miniature marshmallows
1 10  oz. pkg. frozen strawberries drained, save juice
1  c. whipped cream
1  baked pastry shell
preparation: Melt marshmallows with 2 Tbsp. of strawberry juice in a double broiler, remove from heat.  Mix in strawberries, chill for 2 hours.  Fold in whipped cream and place mixture in pie shell. Refrigerate for 4 hours.

name: CHICKEN, BROCCOLI AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked rice
1/4  c. cooked onion
1/3  c. chopped celery
1  can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1 small  can evaporated milk
1 small  jar plain Cheez Whiz
1  fryer, cooked
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, cooked
preparation: Add all ingredients to cooked rice and put into casserole. Cook 45 minutes at 325°.

name: QUICK CHEESE BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. Bix-Mix
3/4  c. milk or water
2  eggs, beaten
2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.  Empty Bix-Mix into a large bowl.  Stir in milk or water and eggs; beat with wooden spoon until smooth.  Add mustard and 1 cup of cheese; mix thoroughly.  Turn batter into prepared pan. Sprinkle with remaining cheese; dot with butter.  Bake for 45 minutes.  Cool in pan 15 minutes.  Remove from pan; cool on rack before slicing.  Especially good sliced, buttered and toasted.

name: CHERRY DREAM SQUARES
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix
1 1/4  c. oatmeal
1/2  c. oleo, softened
1  egg
1  can cherry pie filling
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.  In a large bowl, combine cake mix, 1 cup rolled oats and 6 tablespoons of oleo.  Mix until crumbly.  Reserve 1 cup crumbs for topping.  To remaining crumbs add egg; mix well.  Press this into prepared pan. Pour cherry pie filling over this crust, spreading to cover.

name: 7-UP STRAWBERRY CREME CAKE
ingredients:
1  white cake mix
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1/2  c. 7-Up
3/4  c. oil
4  eggs (room temperature)
1/2  c. frozen strawberries, thawed (with juice)
preparation: Set oven at 350°.  Generously grease and lightly flour pans. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.  Blend at low speed for 4 minutes.  Pour into prepared cake pans and bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: PONSIT
ingredients:
2  chicken breasts
1/3  c. vegetable oil
2  pieces garlic, diced
1  onion, diced
1  stalk celery, diced
1  head cabbage, shredded
1  green pepper, shredded
1 small  pkg. carrots, sliced
1  pkg. rice sticks
1/2  bottle soy sauce
preparation: Cook chicken breasts; cool and dice.  Save 2 cups broth.  Add oil to wok and cook on low heat.  Add garlic, onion, celery, cabbage, green pepper and carrots and stir-fry on high until tender.  Add 1 cup broth and steam for a few minutes.  When you start to stir-fry, add water to the rice sticks and let stand until frying is done.  Drain and add to veggies.  Add chicken and soy sauce.

name: CHEESE AND POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes
1  large onion, chopped
1  qt. water
1/4  c. butter or margarine
3  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. shredded cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. seasoned salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/8  tsp. ground pepper
preparation: Combine potatoes, onion and water in heavy saucepan.  Bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes.  In heavy skillet, melt butter; add flour.  Cook and stir until thickened.  Stir mixture slowly into potatoes; cook and stir until thick.  Add cheese and seasonings.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: CORNBREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  fat hen or 1 turkey
7  c. cornbread crumbs
2  sticks margarine
8  c. chicken (add water if needed)
3  Tbsp. poultry seasoning or sage
7  c. light bread crumbs
6  to 8 eggs
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
preparation: Boil or bake hen or turkey to make broth.  Mix remaining ingredients with potato masher to break up any large chunks of bread.  Dot top with another stick margarine and sprinkle with black pepper.  Bake for 1 hour at 375° if using a shallow pan.  If using a deep roaster pan, bake for 1 1/2 hours.

name: AUNT EVA'S COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
2  c. white sugar
2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. baking powder
3  c. flour
1  lb. Quaker natural cereal (yellow box)
4  c. quick oats (oatmeal)
1  lb. melted margarine
4  eggs, beaten lightly
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
1/2  c. shredded coconut (optional)
preparation: Combine dry ingredients.  Add margarine, eggs and vanilla to dry ingredients mixture, one ingredient at a time.  Mix in lightly (optional) raisins and coconut.  Use about one heaping tablespoonful for each cookie.  Press flat before baking.  Bake at 325° for 15 minutes on ungreased baking sheet.  Makes about 3 dozen large cookies.

name: FROSTED CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. cranberries, ground
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained (reserve juice)
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1/3  c. sugar
1  egg yolk
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Combine cranberries, sugar and drained pineapple and let stand 2 hours.  Dissolve Jell-O in 3 cups hot water.  When partially cool, combine with cranberry mixture and allow to set.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. yellow squash
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
1  onion, chopped
salt and pepper
herb seasoned bread crumbs
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Mash cooked squash and add onion, soup, sour cream, salt and pepper.  Butter casserole dish generously and sprinkle layer of crumb mixture on bottom.  Add squash mixture and top with crumb mixture and grated cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SPINACH LASAGNE
ingredients:
1/2 to 1  lb. lean ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped (optional)
1  qt. spaghetti sauce
2  c. water
1  c. cottage cheese
1  egg
2  c. chopped spinach
12  lasagne noodles, uncooked
2  c. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Baking Temperature: 350°.  Baking Time: 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: ONION ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton onion recipe soup mix
2  lb. potatoes, cut into big chunks
1/3  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  In large plastic bag, add all ingredients.  Close bag and shake until potatoes are evenly coated.  Empty potatoes into shallow baking pan.  Bake, stirring occasionally, 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown.  Makes 8 servings.

name: BEST EVER BARBECUE
ingredients:
4  c. shredded cooked turkey
1  c. ketchup
3  Tbsp. vinegar
3  tsp. mustard
4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/8  c. sugar
preparation: Combine all except turkey; cook over medium heat for about 3 minutes.  Add turkey; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.  Serve on hamburger rolls.  This is a great way to get rid of turkey leftovers.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or oleo
2 1/2 to 3  c. sugar
6  eggs, separated
3  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. soda
1/2  pt. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add egg yolks one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Sift flour with soda; add to butter mixture alternately with sour cream and vanilla.  Blend until smooth.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours.

name: PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  egg
1  Tbsp. soda
1  can Dole crushed pineapple (heavy syrup)
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix by hand.  Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken
2  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. oil
3  green onions
3  cloves garlic
1  apple
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. white wine
1  c. chicken broth
salt and pepper
thyme
basil
1/2  biscuit recipe
preparation: Dredge chicken pieces in flour; brown in butter and oil.  Add 1 tablespoon of flour and rest of ingredients, except biscuit recipe.  Cover and cook on low 30 minutes.  Add more stock as needed.

name: SOUTHERN PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. pecan halves
9-inch pie shell
preparation: In large bowl, slightly beat eggs; add sugar, corn syrup, milk and vanilla.  Blend well.  Add pecans.  Pour into 9-inch pie shell.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to 350° and bake for an additional 30 to 40 minutes or until filling is puffed in center and is well browned.

name: TEXAS SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo
1  c. water
4  Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Melt and bring to a boil oleo and water.  Add cocoa.  Cool a little, then add flour, sugar, salt, eggs, vanilla, vinegar, sour cream or buttermilk.  Butter and flour cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

name: SWEDISH POT ROAST
ingredients:
4  lb. beef roast
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. shortening
2  onions, sliced
1  clove garlic, diced
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. red wine
1/2  c. water
4  bay leaves
preparation: Combine spices and rub into meat.  Brown meat on all sides in shortening. Put meat in roasting pan and cover with onions and garlic.  Mix brown sugar, wine and water together and pour over meat.  Add bay leaves and bake, covered, at 350°  for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

name: FRIED ONIONS
ingredients:
3 or 4  Tbsp. butter
4  large onions
salt and pepper
1/4  c. water
preparation: Place butter and sliced onions in frying pan.  Stir and fry. When golden color, add 1/4 cup of water and cover.  Cook until tender.  May drain liquid before serving.

name: SWEET POTATO BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. mashed sweet potatoes (add a little butter and mash)
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. allspice
1 3/4  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
3/4  c. raisins (may omit)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake in 2 greased coffee cans for 1 hour at 350°.

name: JUDY'S QUICK POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  beef roast (any size)
small amount of water
1  envelope onion soup mix
preparation: Add roast and water to roaster.  Sprinkle onion soup mix on roast. Cover.  Set oven to 225°, cook all day.  About 1 hour before serving, add potatoes and vegetables of your choice.  Makes great gravy.

name: APRICOT SLUSH
ingredients:
6  oz. orange juice concentrate
12  oz. lemonade concentrate
6  oz. dry gin
6  oz. apricot brandy
1  qt. Squirt
preparation: For each drink, put in a wine glass, 3 ounces cranberry juice and 1/2 ounce Cointreau or Triple sec or Grand Marnier.  Add a few ice cubes and fill glass with champagne.

name: BAKLAVA
ingredients:
1  lb. filo dough
1/2  lb. unsalted butter, melted
1 to 1 1/2  c. nuts, coarsely chopped (pistachio, walnuts or almonds)
2 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix nuts with sugar and set aside.

name: SOUTHERN SPOON BREAD
ingredients:
3/4  stick butter
1  tsp. salt
1  c. boiling water
4  eggs
2/3  c. corn meal
2  tsp. baking powder
3  c. milk
preparation: Beat eggs (separate).  Melt butter in 3-quart saucepan.  Stir in meal.  Add boiling water, then milk, stirring constantly, until smooth.  Pour in egg yolks, then fold in egg whites to which has been added salt and baking powder.  When mixture begins to rise, pour in greased heated baking dish.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: MACARONI AND BEEF ITALIANO
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked macaroni
3/4  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  tsp. salad oil
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. each salt and sweet basil
2  tsp. butter or margarine
3  tsp. flour
2  c. milk
8  oz. pkg. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook and drain macaroni.  In large skillet, saute onion, green pepper and beef in salad oil.  Drain excess fat.  Stir in 1 1/4 cups spaghetti sauce, 1 teaspoon salt,  basil  and water. Bring to a boil, cook 5 minutes, stirring often.  In  a  saucepan, melt butter, add flour and gradually blend in  milk.  Cook until thick.  Remove from heat and add  cheese,  1/2  teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.  Stir	until  cheese melts.  Pour meat sauce into a 3 quart greased casserole dish or  13  x  9 x 2-inch pan. Spoon macaroni on top.  Smother with cheese sauce. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.  Drizzle  remaining  sauce on top. Serves 6 to 8.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. salad oil
4  eggs, beaten
2  c. pumpkin
3 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1 1/2  Tbsp. pumpkin pie spice
2/3  c. water
preparation: Cream sugar and oil together.  Add eggs and pumpkin.  Mix well.   Sift together flour and spice.  Add to pumpkin mixture with water.  Pour into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until tests done.  Let stand 10 minutes.   Remove from pan to cool.  Makes 2 loaves.

name: STRAWBERRY STACK CAKE
ingredients:
1  pound cake
2  large containers Cool Whip
3 large (12 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
preparation: Put 3 tablespoons strawberries in the bottom of a large, deep glass bowl.  Cut some of the cake and crumble over the strawberries.  Cover the crumbled cake with strawberries and the juice.  Drizzle the juice around the edges so it will show through the glass dish.  Over the strawberries, add a layer of Cool Whip. Then another layer of cake, strawberries and Cool Whip.  Finish with Cool Whip after filling the bowl.  This is better when made the night before.  It also freezes well.

name: STRAWBERRY PEACH PIE(Plan ahead.  Needs to chill.)
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. milk
1  graham cracker crust
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can sliced peaches, well drained
3  c. sliced fresh strawberries
1 (16 oz.)  carton strawberry glaze
preparation: In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese, sugar and milk until smooth.  Spread over the bottom and up the sides of the crust. Cut peach slices in half, if desired.  Arrange over cream cheese. Combine the strawberries and glaze.  Spoon over peaches. Refrigerate for up to 4 hours before serving.  Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

name: FROZEN SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. whipped cream (Cool Whip can be used)
1  c. fruit cocktail, drained
preparation: Blend softened cream cheese, lemon juice, mayonnaise, sugar and salt until smooth.  Drain fruit cocktail.  Fold in fruit and nuts.  Freeze for 1 to 2 hours.

name: CHRISTMAS CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. margarine (Parkay)
5  c. sugar
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1 (13 oz.)  can Carnation milk
1 (7 oz.)  jar marshmallow cream
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2 to 2  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Melt butter in large heavy saucepan. Add milk and blend.  Then add sugar, stirring constantly.  Bring to boil.  Boil vigorously for 6 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Add chocolate morsels and beat vigorously until morsels are melted. Then add marshmallow cream and continue beating until melted and well blended.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Blend well.  Turn into a well-buttered rectangular pan (12 x 7 x 2-inch).  Let sit at least 6 hours before cutting. Cut in large squares (the large ones stay much creamier and store in airtight container.  Yields approximately 4 pounds of fudge.

name: TOMATO PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. tomato puree
1  c. water
2  c. bread cubes, crust removed
1/2  c. butter, melted
preparation: Combine brown sugar, tomato puree and water.  Cook 5 minutes. While tomato mixture is cooking, put bread cubes in casserole and pour melted butter over them.  Pour on hot tomato mixture.  Do not stir.  Bake 50 minutes in 325° oven.

name: ORANGES
ingredients:
4  large oranges
1  c. orange juice
1  tsp. orange rind
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  tsp. brandy extract
preparation: Peel  4 large  oranges.  Remove  membrane  well.  Slice into bowl.  In  a  saucepan,  combine  remaining  ingredients. Simmer for 2  minutes,  stirring constantly.  Pour over sliced oranges and chill.	May  garnish  with  red or green cherries. Serves 8 people.

name: ORANGE SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. margarine, softened
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. grated orange peel
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/4  c. Egg Beaters 99% real egg product
preparation: In small bowl, combine flour and baking soda; set aside.  In large bowl with electric mixer at medium speed, beat margarine, 3/4 cup sugar, orange peel and vanilla until creamy.  Add egg product; beat for 1 minute.  Gradually stir in flour.  Mix until blended.  Chill dough for 1 hour.   Shape dough into 42 (3/4-inch) balls; roll in remaining sugar.  Place 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheets at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes or until light browned.  Cool on wire rack.  Wrap and store at room temperature for up to 4 days.  Makes 42.  Serving:  1 cookie.

name: CHOCOLATE WALNUT PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1 1/2  c. Karo light syrup
4 (1 oz.)  sq. melted semi-sweet chocolate
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: In a large bowl, stir together the eggs, syrup, chocolate, margarine, cornstarch, vanilla and salt.  Stir in nuts.  Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell.  Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes. (Do not overbake; filling should be slightly less set in center.)

name: BROCCOLI SUPREME
ingredients:
2  pkg. chopped broccoli
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. grated cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. stuffing crumbs
2  eggs
1  medium onion
1/4  c. oleo
preparation: Cook broccoli and drain.  Combine soup, mayonnaise, egg, and onion.  Blend with broccoli.  Pour into buttered dish.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Melt oleo and stuffing crumbs on top of broccoli. Sprinkle top with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30-45 minutes.

name: FRESH GREEN BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh string beans
2  medium-sized potatoes, diced
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. fat
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  c. cold water
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: String and cut up beans.  Cook cut beans and diced potatoes in 5 cups of salted water for 15 minutes.  In a frying pan brown flour in the fat; add black pepper and paprika.  Add 1/4 cup cold water and stir until smooth.  Add sour cream.  Add this mixture to the cooked beans and potatoes.  Bring to a boil and simmer for a few minutes.

name: SUE'S BAKED ONIONS
ingredients:
3  carrots
8  onions, halved
8  potatoes
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  Tbsp. Carmel "chicken" flavor (vegetarian)
1/2  c. soy milk
1 1/2 to 2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
Parmesan cheese
parsley
pepper to taste
preparation: Place onions, carrots and potatoes into a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix soups, starch, chicken flavor and soy milk. Pour mixture over the top.  Dot with butter.  Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over all.  Sprinkle with parsley.  Add pepper to taste. Cover with foil.  Bake at 375° for 40 to 50 minutes.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: NACHO DIP
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  can Ro-Tel diced tomatoes and green chilies
1  can Hunt's special sauce
2  lb. American cheese, diced
preparation: Cook hamburger until done, drain.  Put in large pan or crock-pot.  Add diced tomatoes and chilies, the special sauce with tomato bits, onions, celery and green peppers.  Add American cheese.  Stir often until cheese is melted.  Dip with tortilla, nacho or Dorito chips.

name: APRICOT SALAD
ingredients:
2  boxes apricot Jell-O
2  cans crushed pineapple
1  can mandarin oranges
1  (8 oz.) Philadelphia cream cheese
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water; drain juice from fruit and add enough water for 2 cups.  Add cheese while it's hot. Heat until dissolved, then add fruit.  Refrigerate.

name: TOMATO KETCHUP
ingredients:
1  1/2 pecks tomatoes
4  large onions
1 to 2  lb. sugar (to taste)
1  qt. vinegar
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
2  tsp. allspice
3 heaping  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
preparation: Cook  tomatoes and  onions  until  soft.  Strain.  Cook down to half the amount.  Add  sugar to taste.  Add vinegar to taste, starting  with  1   cup.  Add  more  as  desired.  Add remaining ingredients.  Cook  until  thick  enough.  Cold pack for 10 minutes.

name: PUNCH RECIPE
ingredients:
1  pkg. jello (any flavor)
1  c. ReaLemon
2  c. sugar
2  qt. water
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1  large ginger ale
preparation: Boil water and sugar 5 minutes.  Cool.  Mix jello according to directions.  Mix all ingredients (except ginger ale).  Freeze in plastic containers.  When ready to use, thaw and add ginger ale.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can pineapple, crushed (do not drain)
1  can Comstock pie fruit filling (any flavor)
nuts and coconut
1  box yellow cake mix
2  sticks margarine
preparation: Takes a  13  x  9-inch  pan  or dish (greased).  Spread pineapple well over bottom.  Spread fruit filling over pineapple. Sprinkle  nuts and coconut over top.  Sprinkle whole box of cake mix  over  top of mixture and cut margarine into pats and place over top of cake.  Bake for one hour at 350°.

name: CRANBERRY JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. any red jello
1  c. boiling water
3/4  c. pineapple juice
1 (8 oz.)  can whole cranberries
1  c. diced apple and celery
1/3  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Mix together and set in refrigerator until set.

name: ROAST BEEF(Carne Arrosto)
ingredients:
1  (5 lb.) beef roast
3  garlic cloves, cut in half
2  Tbsp. olive oil
salt and pepper
preparation: Wash and pat dry  roast.  Make  6  cuts  into roast and insert garlic halves into  cuts.  Rub roast with olive oil and sprinkle with salt  and  pepper.  Preheat  oven  to  500°; put roast in for 15  minutes.  Lower  heat  to  350°  and  cook 15 minutes per pound.  To  check  roast,  place a 2 prong fork in center and touch it to  your  tongue.  If it is warm, take out roast immediately.  This  process  will  give  you  a  perfect medium rare roast every time.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: SALMON BALL
ingredients:
1  can well drained red salmon
8  oz. cream cheese
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. onion
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. horseradish or Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. liquid smoke
1  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. parsley flakes
preparation: Mix walnuts and parsley; set aside.    Mix all other ingredients thoroughly; shape into ball.   Refrigerate until firm. Roll ball in nuts/flakes until coated.   Serve with Ritz crackers.

name: WASSAIL
ingredients:
1  gal. apple cider
1  qt. ginger ale
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. red hots
8  cinnamon sticks
6  to 8 whole cloves
preparation: Pour apple cider and ginger ale into bottom of a large electric coffee maker.  In top of basket, combine red hots, cinnamon sticks and cloves.  Perk until ready.

name: CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  egg yolks
1/2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. regular flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  egg whites, stiffly beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix in order given.  Bake in cupcake tins for 15 to 20 minutes at 375°.  Will make 16 cupcakes (makes wonderful tea cupcakes also).

name: MEXICAN LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  pkg. flour tortillas
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. salsa
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1  (16 oz.) cottage cheese
2  eggs
1  tsp. oregano
1 1/2  c. mixed, shredded Cheddar and Monterey Jack cheese
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Brown meat and drain.  Stir in salsa, tomato sauce and taco seasoning.  Simmer, stirring frequently for 5 minutes.  In separate bowl combine cottage cheese, eggs and oregano.  Line bottom of lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish with half of the tortillas, overlapping edges.  Top with half the meat mixture.  Spoon cottage cheese mixture over meat.  Arrange remaining tortillas over cheese mixture.  Spread remaining meat mixture over all and top with shredded cheese.  Bake for 30 minutes or until bubbly.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. ketchup
1  small onion, grated
1  can medium shrimp, drained
preparation: Wash shrimp; blend all ingredients together.  Serve with crackers.

name: SALMON PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  lb. can salmon
1  grated onion
1/4  c. bread crumbs
1/2  c. cold, mashed potatoes
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. oil
preparation: Combine grated onion with mashed potatoes.  Add salmon and egg.  Add bread crumbs to mixture so that it is firm, but not dry. Shape it flat on large spatula and slide it into preheated oil in frying pan.  Fry about 1 minute on each side until brown.  Serve hot.  (Can use leftover cooked fish instead of salmon.)

name: STUFFED ZUCCHINI
ingredients:
4  medium zucchini
1/2  c. chopped mushrooms
2  Tbsp. oil
1  onion, diced
1  clove garlic, crushed
1  slightly beaten egg (or 2 egg whites or egg substitute equivalent to 1 egg)
1/4  tsp. marjoram
1  tsp. minced parsley
freshly ground pepper
preparation: Wash zucchini and scrub lightly to remove any grit or wax. Parboil for 10 minutes; drain, cool and split lengthwise.  Remove pulp and chop it finely.  Saute garlic in oil until golden brown. Discard garlic and saute mushrooms in the oil with the onions. Add herbs, pepper and zucchini pulp.  Cool.  Mix in the slightly beaten egg and fill the cavity of each zucchini half with the mixture.  Place stuffed zucchini in an oiled shallow pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: DATE NUT BREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. chopped nuts
1  c. dates, chopped
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. margarine
3/4  c. boiling water
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
preparation: Combine nuts, dates, soda and salt in bowl.  Add shortening and boiling water; allow to stand 15 minutes.  Stir to blend. Beat eggs slightly and add to date mixture.   Do not overmix. Place in a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake for 1 hour, or until done, at 350°.  Turn out onto a wire rack to finish cooling after it has been in pan about an hour.

name: CRAB MOLD
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  Tbsp. unflavored gelatin in 3 Tbsp. cold water
6  oz. cream cheese
1  c. chopped celery
1  green onion, chopped
7 to 7 1/2  oz. can crab
1  c. mayonnaise (do not use salad dressing)
preparation: Heat soup.  Dissolve gelatin and water in heated soup.  Remove from heat and let cool slightly.  Add cream cheese.  Mix until cream cheese is thoroughly blended (no lumps).  Add remaining ingredients.  Pour into loaf pan or mold and chill (preferably overnight).  When mixture is set, remove from mold and place on bed of lettuce.  May be served as salad, dip or spread.

name: HAYSTACKS
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
1  stick butter
pinch of salt
3  c. oatmeal
1  c. nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. peanut butter
preparation: Mix sugar, cocoa, milk, butter, salt and vanilla in medium saucepan.  Bring to boil.  Boil 5 minutes.  Stir in oatmeal, peanut butter and nuts.  Drop stacks on wax paper.   Let stand until cool.

name: HUMMINGBIRD CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
3  eggs
1  tsp. almond
1  c. coconut
1  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  c. chopped bananas
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together in large bowl.  Add all other ingredients and stir by hand until mixed.  (Do not beat.)  Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.  Cool in pan.

name: CHICKEN-N-RICE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
1  c. uncooked rice
2  c. water
8  pieces chicken (breasts, thighs or pieces from 2 cut up chickens)
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients.  Pour into a large baking dish. Arrange chicken on top of this. Dot with butter. Bake in a 325° oven for 2 hours, uncovered, or until tender. Add more water if needed.  Do not salt as onion mix has plenty.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
4  c. dried beans, cooked
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. catsup
1  green mango, chopped
1/4  c. chopped onion
4 or 5  slices bacon
preparation: Fry bacon crisp; mix with onion.  Add to beans and the rest of ingredients.  Pour in casserole dish and bake 25 to 30 minutes.

name: APPLE CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  bag dehydrated apples
1  c. sugar
1  box dry cake mix
2  sticks margarine, melted
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cook apples until done.  Stir in 1 cup sugar.  Spread apples in bottom of 10 x 13-inch pan.  Top with dry cake mix.  Melt margarine and pour over cake mix.  Sprinkle nuts on top.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  pkg. dried beef (3 to 6 oz.), cut fine
2  bunches green onions
preparation: Mix cheese and dried beef together.  Add the whites of onion (chopped fine); form into ball.  Chop the green onion tops and roll cheese ball in them.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  pkg. ground chuck
1  pkg. ground sirloin
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. ketchup
1/2  tsp. yellow mustard
dash of onion salt/garlic salt
3  to 4 carrots, grated coarsely
1 small  can mushrooms, chopped
1  egg
1 small  pkg. Special K cereal
1/2 to 1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper
preparation: Bake at 350° for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Pour ketchup down middle of loaf and add Worcestershire sauce.  Spread over top and sides.

name: AUNT HELEN'S CHRISTMAS COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking soda, dissolved in 2 Tbsp. hot water
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cloves
2 to 3  c. flour
2  c. chopped pecans
1  pkg. chopped dates
3/4  lb. each candied pineapple and cherries (1 1/2 lb.  total)
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs and stir.  Stir in soda. Add everything else and mix.  Dough should be very stiff.  Drop golf ball sized balls on buttered baking sheet.  Bake at 325° for 15 to 18 minutes.

name: TOMATO KETCHUP
ingredients:
1  gal. tomato juice
sugar
spice
ground onions
salt
preparation: Take tomato juice.  Let stand in warm place 4 or 5 days until it really sours.  Skim off top and part of water from top.  Use remaining juice and add sugar and spice to taste, 1 onion (ground real fine) and salt.  No vinegar is used.  Boil slowly until thick. Pour in pint jars and turn upside down 24 hours to seal.

name: QUICK CORN FLAKE CANDY
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. dark Karo syrup
1 1/4  c. peanut butter
7  c. corn flakes
preparation: Combine sugar and syrup in heavy boiler.  Place over heat until small bubbles form around edges; do not boil.  Remove from heat.  Add peanut butter; stir until blended.  Stir in corn flakes.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan that has been lightly sprayed with Pam.

name: CHE-CHA
ingredients:
14  good size plum tomatoes
2 handfuls fresh basil, chopped or 1  Tbsp. dried basil
1 to 4  cloves garlic, minced (according to taste)
4  oz. fat-free Mozzarella cheese, shredded *
1  Tbsp. olive oil
16  oz. uncooked fusilli (corkscrew)
preparation: Blanch tomatoes 10 seconds.  Then peel and chop.  Mix tomatoes, basil, garlic and cheese with oil.  Let stand in covered bowl at room temperature for at least 3 hours (the longer the better).  Cook the fusilli according to package directions. Drain.  Add tomato mixture to the pasta.  Mix well.  Serve warm. Serves 5.

name: LEMON ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Betty Crocker yellow cake mix
3/4  c. salad oil
1  pkg. lemon Jell-O instant pudding
3/4  c. water
4  eggs
preparation: Mix at medium speed for 2 minutes.  Bake in ungreased sheet pan (9 x 13-inch) at 350°.

name: COOKIE SHEET PARTY CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
8  oz pkg cream cheese softened
1  c milk
1  pkg vanilla instant pudding
1  can crushed pineapple (drained)
1  cool whip
coconut
nuts
cherries
preparation: Mix cake according to directions on pkg and bake in a cookie sheet.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. zucchini, ground or chopped
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
3  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. nuts
1/2  c. raisins
3  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat together eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla.  Add dry ingredients, blending mixture as added.  Stir zucchini, nuts and raisins.  Grease and flour 2 loaf pans.  Pour mixture and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SWEET POTATO PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. mashed, boiled sweet potatoes
1  egg, well beaten
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
sugar
salt
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pile into a buttered baking dish. Sprinkle cinnamon on top, if desired.  Bake for 30 minutes at 450°.  Serves 6.

name: EASY TUPPERWARE BREAD
ingredients:
10  c. flour
3  pkg. dry yeast
3 3/4  c. warm water
6  Tbsp. sugar
4 to 5  tsp. salt
2  beaten eggs
1/3  c. oleo, melted
preparation: Measure 10 cups flour into big (Fix-N-Mix) bowl.  In large bowl, mix dry yeast with warm water.  Add sugar, salt and eggs. Seal, burp and shake until mixed.  Make a well in flour with large mixing bowl.  Pour liquid mixture into well.  Do not stir.  Seal Fix-N-Mix bowl.  Burp and place in sink in very hot water.  Seal will pop in 20 to 30 minutes.  Remove from sink.  Add 1/3 cup oleo, melted.  Stir with wooden spoon until thoroughly mixed.  Seal and replace in hot water.  Seal will pop in about 15 minutes.  Remove from sink.  Bake rolls at 350° until golden brown.  Makes 2 loaves or 3 dozen rolls.

name: ESCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
1  Can Whole Kernel Corn, not drained
1  Can Cream Style Corn
3/4  Cup Oil
4  Eggs
1 Small  Box Jiffy Corn Bread
1  Cup Shredded Cheddar Cheese
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.  Mix until well blended.  Pour into a 9 x 13 inch pyrex dish.  Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for one hour.

name: DILL PICKLES
ingredients:
cucumbers
1  qt. cider vinegar
3  qt. water
1  c. pickling salt
clove of garlic
sprig of dill
preparation: Cider vinegar, water and pickling spice is enough for approximately 6 quarts of dills.

name: PINK SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 large  can cherry pie filling
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Mix the first four ingredients.  Fold in the Cool Whip and mix well.  Chill.

name: "YOU GOT CHOCOLATE ON MY PEANUT BUTTER" CANDY
ingredients:
12  oz. peanut butter
1  lb. confectioners sugar
1 1/2  sticks margarine, softened
2  large chocolate bars
preparation: Mix together peanut butter, sugar and butter.  Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Melt chocolate bars over low heat, stirring constantly.  Smooth over pressed mixture.  Refrigerate.  When cooled, cut into squares.

name: ZUCCHINI PICKLES
ingredients:
2  lbs. fresh, firm zucchini
2  small onions
1/4  cup salt (pickling salt is best)
2  cups sugar
1  tsp. celery salt
1  tsp. tumeric
2  tsp. mustard seed
3  cups cider vinegar
preparation: Wash zucchini and cut into thin slices.  Peel and cut onions into quarters and then slice very thin.  Add to water and add salt.  Let stand for 2 hours.  Drain throughly.  Bring remaining ingredients to a boil.  Pour over zucchini and onions.  Let stand for 2 hours.  Bring all ingredients to a boil for 5 minutes.

name: PIE CRUST NO. 1
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients by hand in large bowl.  Work in milk with hand.  Roll out each pie crust on floured board.  Makes 4 crusts.

name: DAN'S PIZZA CRUST DOUGH
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. warm water (120~)
2 1/2  tsp. oil
2/3  tsp. salt
4  c. flour
2 1/2  tsp. yeast
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Add oil, salt and mix in flour. Knead and spread into pizza pan that has been oiled lightly.  Let dough rise for 20 minutes.  Apply sauce, toppings and cheese. Bake pizza in 450° oven until done, approximately 20 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
3  c. sugar
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. each: nutmeg and salt
2  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  c. each: nuts, raisins, coconut and diced dates
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. cooking oil
3/4  c. milk
2  c. cooked potato pumpkin, well drained
preparation: Use 1/2 cup flour to dredge nuts, raisins, coconut and dates. Sift all other dry ingredients together.  Cream sugar and oil. Add eggs, one at a time, beat well.  Add pumpkin, beat, then add flour mixture alternately with milk.  Add vanilla.  Stop mixer and pour in nut mixture and fold in well.  Bake in loaf pans in 325° to 350° oven for 45 minutes or until done.  Don't overcook.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
6  sliced apples
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
1  c. sifted flour
1  unbeaten egg
3/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Put in bottom of pan 6 sliced apples.  Mix together and pour the rest of the ingredients on apple slices.  On top of this, pour 1/3 cream and sprinkle with cinnamon.  Bake.  Serve with milk.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. sharp cheese, grated
1  lb. sausage
3  c. Bisquick
dash of Texas Pete
preparation: Mix and make into soft balls. Bake at 350° for 5 minutes.

name: PRALINE-N-CREAM PIES
ingredients:
7  oz. coconut
1/4  c. butter
1  c. pecans
8  oz. cream cheese
1  can condensed milk
16  oz. Cool Whip
2  (9-inch) baked pie shells
swirl butterscotch topping
preparation: Brown coconut, butter and pecans; divide into pie shells, saving small amount to garnish top of pies.  Mix cream cheese and can milk well; fold in Cool Whip.  Put in pie shells; top pie with sprinkling of coconut mixture and swirl butterscotch topping.

name: ZUCCHINI/TOMATO
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  c. sliced zucchini, cut 1/2-inch thick (about 3 small)
1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  c. tomato wedges
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Melt butter and saute green pepper and onion.  Add zucchini, bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper.  Turn into a 1 1/2-quart covered casserole.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.  Add tomatoes and bake 10 minutes more.  Melt Cheddar cheese on top and serve.

name: PORCUPINE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic
1/2  c. cooked rice
1  egg
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. onion, chopped fine
1/8  c. green pepper, chopped fine
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato juice or sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except tomato sauce.  Form into balls. Place in greased casserole dish.  Pour tomato sauce over balls. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. beef tenderloin or sirloin steak
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
2  tsp. instant beef bouillon granules
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  clove garlic, minced
2  c. cooked noodles
preparation: Partially freeze beef.  Thinly slice across the grain into bite size strips.  Combine flour and sour cream.  Stir in bouillon granules, 1/2 cup water and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.  Set aside.  In a large skillet, cook and stir half of the meat in margarine or butter over high heat until done.  Remove.  Add remaining meat, mushrooms, onions and garlic.  Cook and stir meat until done and onions are tender.  Return all meat to skillet.  Add sour cream mixture.  Cook and stir over medium heat until bubbly.  Cook and stir 1 minute more.  Serve over noodles.

name: SPICY DIPPING SAUCE FOR MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
2  c. salad dressing or mayonnaise
4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  c. steak sauce
preparation: Combine ingredients in a bowl.  Rinse and dry mushrooms. Halve the large mushrooms.  Makes 2 cups of sauce.  Also, good for other raw vegetables.

name: EYE OF ROUND WITH ROSEMARY
ingredients:
1  eye of round beef
seasoned salt
garlic salt
black pepper
1  tsp. rosemary, crushed
1  tsp. shortening
preparation: Season meat 2 days before cooking (or less).  Rub entire surface of meat liberally with mix of seasonings.  Wrap tightly in foil; refrigerate.  One hour before cooking, bring meat to room temperature.  Brown on all sides in 1 teaspoon shortening.  Place in shallow roasting pan.  Bake at 300° until done or 15 minutes per pound for rare, 20 minutes per pound for medium and 22 minutes per pound for well done.  Best served at room temperature.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER SQUARES
ingredients:
graham crackers (as many as needed to cover 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan)
1  c. dark brown sugar
1  c. butter or oleo
1  c. ground nuts (pecans or walnuts)
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips (may use peanut butter, butterscotch or vanilla chips)
preparation: Spray 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan with Pam.  Place graham crackers side by side.  Simmer sugar and butter about 3 minutes. Pour mixture quickly over crackers.  Bake in preheated 400° oven for 5 minutes.

name: MACAROONS
ingredients:
2  pkg. grated coconut
1/4  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla or 1/2 tsp. almond extract
2  egg whites
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Shape into small balls, flatten slightly and place on greased cookie sheet.  Let stand half hour. Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes until slightly browned.  Makes 18.

name: SOFT PRETZELS
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  egg, well beaten
1 1/2  c. warm water
4  c. flour
1  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water in bowl.  Add salt, sugar and flour. (If mixture is too sticky, add some more flour.  If too dry, add some water.)  Make 8 small balls from dough.  Roll into long strips; shape into pretzels.  Brush with beaten egg.  Sprinkle with salt.  Bake on greased cookie sheet at 425° for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE (HAM) SOUFFLE
ingredients:
6  eggs
2  c. milk
2  slices white bread, cubed
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  lb. sausage or little pieces ham
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown sausage and drain grease.  Mix and beat eggs.  Add milk, salt and dry mustard.  Add cubed bread and stir.  Add cheese and sausage (ham); put in greased baking dish (glass).  Refrigerate overnight.  Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.  Let stand.  Serves 8.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, melted
2  eggs, beaten
1  can whole corn, drained
2  cans creamed corn
8  oz. sour cream
1  box Jiffy corn muffin mix
preparation: Combine and bake in a greased casserole pan.  Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

name: FRENCH BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
3  c. bread flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter (sweet gives most authentic taste)
1  c. less 1 Tbsp. hot water
2  stiffly beaten egg whites
preparation: Whip egg whites and set aside.  Mix yeast, flour, sugar and salt together.  Add butter and water; mix until moist.  Add egg whites and mix.  Knead dough on floured surface about 10 to 15 minutes, until dough is elastic.  Put dough into lightly greased bowl and grease top lightly.  Cover bowl with clean cloth.  Let rise until doubled (about 1 1/2 hours).

name: RED CLAM SAUCE
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. olive oil
8  garlic cloves, minced
3  Tbsp. tomato paste
6  anchovies
2 (8 oz.)  bottles clam juice
4 (6 1/2 oz.)  cans minced clams (reserve juice)
6  Tbsp. chopped parsley
red pepper to taste
preparation: In a heavy skillet, heat oil over low-medium heat.  Add garlic and anchovies.  Cook a few minutes; add tomato paste.  Cook a few more minutes.  Add parsley and red pepper, stirring with a fork to blend.  Add clam juice from bottles and juice reserved from canned clams.  Stir again to blend.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat to simmer.  Cook slow for 15 minutes.  Add clams.  Heat and serve over pasta.

name: SLICED COOKIES
ingredients:
6  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
3  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1  jar citron fruit
1  c. Wesson oil
preparation: Beat eggs and then put in sugar.  Add oil.  Add flour mixed with baking powder.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Drop by teaspoon to form loaf on each side of pans.  Cook at 375° until they are brown.  Slice and toast.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: REFRIGERATOR ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1  c. warm water
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. melted Crisco
2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. buttermilk
self-rising flour
preparation: Mix in large bowl the yeast with warm water until dissolved. Then add sugar, melted Crisco and butter.  Add buttermilk; mix all ingredients, then add self-rising flour until thickness of biscuit dough.  Cover; place in refrigerator for at least 1 hour.

name: MAMA LUCY'S POUND CAKE
ingredients:
6  eggs
2  sticks butter*
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: *Do not change to low fat, or oleo.  It just isn't the same.

name: BUTTER BUDS
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. Crisco
2  eggs, beat together
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. rum flavor
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  c. walnuts
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients.  Add next 2 and next 4 ingredients. Mix well and add walnuts.  Roll into small balls.  Press cherry on top or walnut.  Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.  Holiday cookie.

name: INDIAN STYLE SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
2  oz. spaghetti, broken in small pieces and cooked
1  chopped onion
1  chopped tomato
1  Tbsp. oil
salt
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. cumin seed
lemon juice
preparation: Saute in hot oil, onions, tomatoes and spices.  Add cooked spaghetti.  Stir until well mixed.  Serve hot.

name: ONE HOUR ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. plain flour
1/4  tsp. soda
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  pkg. dry yeast
1  tsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. sugar
3/4  c. buttermilk
1/4  c. Crisco
1/4  c. warm water
preparation: Sift dry ingredients.  Cut in shortening.  Soften yeast in warm water; add buttermilk.  Stir milk mixture into flour mixture to form soft dough.  Turn on floured board and knead for one minute.  Roll to 1/4-inch thick.  Cut with biscuit cutter and place in greased pan.  Let rise for one hour.  Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: APPLE CRUMB PUDDING
ingredients:
6  to 7 sliced apples
1/2  c. butter or oleo
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. flour
2/3  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Grease baking dish 13 x 9 x 2-inches.  Put apples in dish. Cream butter and sugar; work in flour until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Sprinkle over apples.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to 325° for 20 minutes or until apples are tender.

name: CHERRY PIE
ingredients:
2 (1 lb.)  cans tart red cherries
3/4  c. sugar
3 1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  Tbsp. grated lemon peel (optional)
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
few drops red food coloring
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. mace
1/3  c. butter
preparation: Drain cherries.  Reserve 1 1/4 cups liquid. Combine 3/4 cup sugar, cornstarch and salt. Add reserved liquid.  Cook until thick, stirring constantly.  Add cherries, lemon peel, lemon juice and food coloring.   Pour into pastry shell. Combine flour, 1/2 cup sugar and spices.  Cut in butter until crumbly. Sprinkle over cherries.  Bake in a 400° oven about 30 minutes or until crust is brown. Serve warm.

name: SPICED TEA
ingredients:
1  c. Tang
1  c. instant tea powder
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. presweetened lemonade mix
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
preparation: Mix and store in jar.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER DESSERT
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  stick margarine, melted
6  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. powdered sugar
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  pkg. Dream Whip
fresh fruit or Thank You pie filling
preparation: Mix together the cracker crumbs, melted margarine and the sugar.  Press into a greased 9 x 13 pan (glass preferred) as a crust.  Cream together powdered sugar and cream cheese.  Prepare the Dream Whip and add to cream cheese mixture.  Blend thoroughly. Spoon mixture on crust.  Top with your choice of fruit.

name: PORK CHOPS 'N POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
6  pork chops
1/2  c. milk
1  can celery soup
1  c. Mozzarella cheese
seasoned salt
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1  can French fried onions
preparation: Brown chops in lightly greased skillet. Sprinkle with salt; set aside. Combine soup, milk, sour cream, pepper and 1/2 teaspoon salt.  Stir in potatoes, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can onions.  Spoon mixture into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Arrange chops over the potatoes. Bake, covered, at 350° for 40 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.

name: BARBECUED HAMBURGERS
ingredients:
3  or 4 large onions, sliced
3  or 4 green peppers, sliced
1  Tbsp. oil
salt and pepper
1  bottle catsup
1  bottle chili sauce
1 small  can tomato sauce
preparation: Pour oil into large pan.  Add onions and peppers.  Season to taste.  Cover and steam about 10 minutes, then add 1 bottle of catsup plus 1 bottle of water, 1 bottle chili sauce plus 1 bottle water and 1 small can tomato sauce plus 1 can water.  Simmer, uncovered, for about 15 minutes.  Mix and brown hamburgers and add to sauce.  Cook until hamburgers are done (well cooked).

name: ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. boiling water
1  c. oil
2/3  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. warm water
2  pkg. yeast
2  eggs
6  c. flour
preparation: Put oil, sugar and salt in a large bowl and pour boiling water over it. Dissolve yeast in cup of warm water. Add 2 cups of flour to bowl when lukewarm to make a batter. Stir well. Add eggs and yeast. Stir again. Add rest of flour and stir until it leaves sides of bowl. Cover with cloth. Set in warm place to rise double. Punch down. Let rise again, then make into rolls. Put in pan and let rise double. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.

name: CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. white or yellow cornmeal
1  c. whole wheat pastry flour
1  c. unbleached white flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. buttermilk or plain yogurt
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. maple syrup or brown sugar
2  large eggs, beaten
1/4  c. butter, melted and cooled
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Generously butter a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan or a 12-inch cast iron skillet.  Sift the dry ingredients into a large bowl.  In another bowl, combine the wet ingredients and stir until mixed.  Fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients.  Smooth the batter into the baking pan or skillet and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean.  Allow the cornbread to cool for at least 10 minutes before serving.

name: POLYNESIAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  lb. skinless, boneless chicken breasts
1/2  medium green pepper, cut into chunks
1/2  medium red bell pepper, cut into chunks
1/2  diagonally cut celery
1  medium onion, cut into eighths
1  snow pea pod
1 (12 oz.)  jar Heinz Homestyle mushroom gravy
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/8  tsp. ginger
1 (8 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, drained
hot cooked rice
preparation: Cut chicken into strips 1/2-inch wide.  Place chicken in a 2-quart casserole.  Cover dish with lid or vented plastic wrap. Microwave at High for 4 to 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink, stirring twice.  Remove chicken from casserole and set aside; discard juices.  In same casserole, combine green pepper and next 4 ingredients.  Cover dish and microwave at High for 4 to 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender-crisp, stirring once.  Drain if desired.  Combine gravy, soy sauce and ginger; stir into vegetables.  Return chicken to casserole; add pineapple.  Cover and microwave at High for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring twice.  Serve over cooked rice.

name: PASTA A LA CHEF ANDRE(Low-Fat)
ingredients:
1/2  lb. shrimp (optional)
4  turkey sausage (10 1/2 oz.) sweet Italian type, sliced or in chunks
1/4  lb. mushrooms (about 12), sliced
2  garlic cloves, finely minced or crushed
1  small onion, chopped
2  oz. smoked Mozzarella cheese, grated
1  tsp. dried basil
1  tsp. dried oregano
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  medium tomato, cubed
1  lb. pasta, fresh multi-colored if possible
preparation: In 1 tablespoon olive oil, saute onions, garlic and mushrooms, then add turkey sausage, basil and oregano.  Cook until lightly browned.  Add peeled shrimp and cook 3 to 5 minutes longer until shrimp are pink.

name: CHURCH PUNCH
ingredients:
8 (6 oz.)  cans pink lemonade
12  c. water
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice, unsweetened
3  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and freeze in 1/2 gallon milk cartons. When ready to serve, thaw enough to tear carton and break into slush in a bowl.  Add 1 quart well-chilled ginger ale to each 1/2 gallon fruit juice.  Yield:  Seventy 4 ounce servings or one hundred 3 ounce servings.

name: JEWISH COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
8  oz. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/3  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream oleo and sugar.  Add eggs, sour cream, vanilla, flour, salt and baking powder.  In another bowl, mix brown sugar, cinnamon and pecans.  Layer in a Bundt or cake pan some of the batter and then some of the dry mixture.  Repeat layers.  Note: Be sure to generously grease and flour pan.  Bake at 325° for 55 to 60 minutes.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar while still warm. Cool completely before serving.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1  can Eagle brand condensed milk
1 large  box instant vanilla pudding
1 8  oz. cream cheese
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1  box vanilla wafers
6  to 8 bananas
2  c. milk
preparation: Blend Eagle brand condensed milk and cream cheese until smooth.  Add vanilla pudding and mix.  Add milk and then add 1/2 to 3/4 container of Cool Whip, keep remaining Cool Whip for top of pudding.  The mixture will become thick.  Slice bananas.  Layer vanilla wafer cookies, bananas and pudding until gone.  Top with remaining Cool Whip and sprinkle some crushed vanilla wafers on top for garnish.

name: BRAISED SHRIMP WITH VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh shrimp
8  oz. fresh broccoli
2  cans (4 oz. each) whole button mushrooms
1  can (18 oz.) whole or sliced bamboo shoots
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/2  c. chicken stock or broth
1  tsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. oyster sauce
1/4  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. grated pared fresh ginger root
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Remove shells and back veins from shrimp.  Cut broccoli into pieces.  Drain mushrooms.  Cut whole bamboo shoots into thin slices.  Heat oil in wok over high heat.  Stir-fry shrimp in oil until tender, about 3 minutes.

name: PETE'S HAMBURGER PIE(A Variation)
ingredients:
1  can spaghetti or pizza sauce
1 1/2  lb. lean hamburger
1  can pizza dough
2  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Grease 9-inch square pan.  Put in pizza dough, covering sides. Brown hamburger, drain.  Mix in sauce, pour into pan.  Sprinkle top with cheese.  Bake at 350° until cheese melts and is brown, about 25 to 30 minutes.

name: JIMMIE'S FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  fryer, cut up
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
2  Tbsp. salt
1  egg
1  c. flour
2  c. Crisco oil
preparation: Heat oil in heavy skillet on medium.  Season fryer.  Mix thoroughly.  Drop egg on fryer.  Mix, coating every piece.  Place one at a time into flour, coating each piece.  Drop, skin side up, into medium hot oil.  Fry 3 minutes.  Turn and fry 3 more minutes. Cover with lid.  Check fryer and turn 3 or 4 times every 4 minutes.  Uncover and let chicken get golden brown and crispy.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
16  oz. milk
1/4  c. raw rice
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. raisins, soaked in water (optional)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Mix milk, rice, sugar and salt and put in a 6-cup buttered casserole.  Bake, uncovered, 2 hours.  Stir every 30 minutes.  At end, add raisins (soaked in water and drained).  Add vanilla.  Mix and bake 30 minutes more.

name: BACON, CHESTNUT APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1  lb. bacon, cut widthwise in half
1  can water chestnuts
1  bottle barbecue sauce
preparation: I use Bull's-Eye hickory flavored barbecue sauce.

name: CRABMEAT SHRIMP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pt. mayonnaise
2  tsp. prepared mustard
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
1/2  tsp. curry powder
3/4  c. onion, chopped
3  c. bread crumbs
1  lb. can crabmeat
3/4  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1/2  c. sherry wine
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. chopped parsley
3/4  c. celery, diced fine
1 1/4  c. water
1 1/4  lb. cooked shrimp
preparation: Put ingredients together; grease casserole.  Bake in 350° oven for 1/2 hour or until heated through.  Lovely luncheon dish with a green salad.

name: HOT FUDGE PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. melted shortening
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  cocoa
1 3/4  c. hot water
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix flour, sugar, 2 tablespoons cocoa, baking powder and salt in bowl.  Mix in milk and shortening; stir in nuts.

name: CHERRY BOUNCE
ingredients:
2  lb. sweet cherries
2  lb. hard rock candy (unflavored)
2 each 1/5  bottles of Crobys whiskey
Large glass jar with lid (Restaurant size pickle jar)
preparation: Make in summertime end of June when sweet cherries are in season.  Put cherries in large glass jar; add hard candy and whiskey.  Let set in a cool dark place until Christmas.  Strain and put back into whiskey bottles.  Can use over ice or mix a shot of Cherry Bounce with 7-Up.  Very good.

name: BUCKEYES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter or margarine
1 1/2  lb. powdered sugar (approximately 3 c.)
1  lb. smooth peanut butter (approximately 2 c.)
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1/8  cake paraffin (canning wax)
preparation: Melt chocolate and paraffin in the top of a double boiler. Pierce peanut butter balls with a toothpick and dip into chocolate, leaving a small area on top of ball not covered with chocolate.  Place coated balls on wax paper until set.

name: THREE WEEK COLE SLAW
ingredients:
3  lb. white cabbage, shredded
2  white onions, chopped fine
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  c. yellow vinegar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  green pepper, chopped fine
1  or 2 carrots, grated
1  c. cooking oil
2  Tbsp. celery seed
preparation: Combine cabbage, pepper, onions, carrots and sugar in large bowl; mix well.  Mix the oil, vinegar, celery seed and salt in saucepan.  Bring to a boil; pour over cabbage mixture.  Stir until very well mixed.  Store in airtight container in refrigerator. Let stand 3 days.  Flavor improves the longer it stands.  Will keep for a month in refrigerator.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
3/4  c. chopped onion
2  cloves minced garlic
1  lb. ground beef
1 (20 oz.)  can tomato juice
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
1  Tbsp. Sugar Twin
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. dried crushed basil
preparation: Heat the butter.  Cook the onion and garlic.  Add the ground beef and cook until browned.  Stir in the tomato juice, tomato paste, Sugar Twin, salt, pepper and basil.  Cook, uncovered, over low heat, about 1 hour.  Stir occasionally.  Makes 1 1/2 quarts. One-half cup serving contains 157 calories.  Great for diabetics.

name: CARNATION DISH
ingredients:
1  to 2 onions
1  green pepper
1  stick margarine
1  can mushrooms
1  can chicken noodle soup
1  pkg. noodles (medium)
2  cans whole kernel corn (undrained)
1  jar pimentos, drained
1  can chicken broth
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Fry onions and pepper in margarine until tender.  Mix with remaining ingredients in pan and sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes; turn oven off and leave 1 hour to linger.

name: CHOCOLATE SPIDERS
ingredients:
12  oz. semi-sweet chocolate, grated or finely chopped
1 (5 oz.)  can chow mein noodles
1  c. salted peanuts
preparation: Line a baking sheet with waxed paper.  Melt chocolate. Remove from the heat.  Add the noodles  and peanuts and stir and fold until the noodles are well coated.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto the prepared pan.  Chill for at least 8 hours or until ready to serve.

name: ALL IN ONE CHICKEN DELIGHT(A Fast, Easy Falcone Family Favorite)
ingredients:
4  boneless chicken breasts
1  pkg. stuffing mix
1/2  c. chicken broth
cranberry sauce
1  pkg. Pillsbury crescent rolls (4)
preparation: Prepare stuffing according to directions.  Set aside.  In baking dish, put 4 hard-packed mounds of stuffing.  Place chicken over stuffing.  Season with salt and pepper.  Pour in chicken broth.

name: CALIFORNIA BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
3  cold baked Idaho potatoes, cut into spears
1/2  c. Catalina Fat Free dressing
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Toss potato spears with dressing.  Sprinkle each spear with garlic powder and parsley.  Place on a cookie sheet.  Bake 20 minutes or until crispy.

name: CRAWFISH ETOUFFEE
ingredients:
2  lb. crawfish tail meat
2  onions, chopped
2  bell peppers, chopped
2  sticks butter
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can Ro-Tel diced tomatoes
Tony Chachere's seasoning to taste
preparation: Saute onions and bell peppers in butter.  Add mushroom soup and stir.  Add Ro-Tel tomatoes and stir.  Cook for 20 minutes on medium heat.  Add crawfish and cook for 15 minutes on medium heat.  Serve over rice.

name: HOT CRAB AND ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1  jar marinated artichoke hearts
1  can crab meat
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Drain crab meat and chop artichokes.  Combine with cheese and mayonnaise.  Heat in a small casserole at 350° for 20 minutes. Serve with small slices of garlic toast.

name: VALLEY FRESH TURKEY SUPREME
ingredients:
1 (12.5 oz.)  can Valley Fresh white turkey
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
1/4  tsp. sage
1/4  tsp. white pepper
1/4  c. celery, diced
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1/4  c. frozen peas
preparation: Drain and cut Valley Fresh white turkey into bite-size pieces. Mix together mayonnaise, mustard, sage and white pepper.  Combine all ingredients.  Cover and chill.  Serve with crackers.

name: HOT BACON DRESSING
ingredients:
4  slices bacon and fat, fried
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. vinegar
1  c. water
preparation: Mix sugar, salt and cornstarch; add egg and liquids.  Cook to thickness wanted.  Add crisp bacon and fat.  Use on Spinach Salad.

name: BALSAMIC GRILLED CHICKEN
ingredients:
5  lb. chicken in serving pieces
1  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. Balsamic vinegar
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. ketchup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
3  scallions, minced
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cracked pepper
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  minced garlic clove
Tabasco to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients and dip chicken in marinade.  Arrange in glass pans.  Pour remaining marinade over.  Refrigerate 6 hours or overnight.  Grill, basting with marinade.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  chicken, deboned
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. crushed potato chips
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/8  c. onion, finely chopped
preparation: Combine all ingredients except 1/2 cup crushed chips.  Pour into buttered casserole dish.  Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.  Remove and cover with 1/2 cup chips.  Bake 15 minutes longer.  Serve hot.

name: CURRIED CORN SOUP(Serves 8)
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  Tbsp. curry powder (more if desired)
1  tsp. powder freeze-dried shallots
2 (1 lb.)  cans cream-style corn (Del Monte)
1 (1 lb.)  can whole corn
2  c. medium cream or half and half
1/8  tsp. ground rosemary
2  Tbsp. chopped chives
preparation: Melt butter in pan.  Add curry.  Stir until smooth.  Add shallots and corn, stirring slowly.  Then add cream and rosemary. Garnish with chives.

name: CHICKEN BAKE
ingredients:
1  c. River rice (raw)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  envelope Lipton onion soup mix
1  Tbsp. parsley
6  chicken breasts
1  onion, chopped
1 small  can mushrooms
preparation: Combine all 3 soups  with onion, mushrooms, parsley and raw rice until well blended.  Spray  a  13  x  9-inch pan with Pam. Place rice mixture  in  pan;  top  with chicken breasts. (Be sure to remove all  fat from chicken.) Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 2 hours.

name: SWEET AND SOUR PORK
ingredients:
1/3  c. sugar mixed with 1/3 c. soy sauce
3/4  lb. lean pork loin cut into 3/4-inch cubes
peanut oil for frying
1/4  c. sifted cornstarch
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  clove garlic, peeled and minced
1  medium sweet green pepper, cut in 1-inch squares
1  medium carrot, peeled and julienne
1  c. chicken broth
1/4  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1 1/2  tsp. cornstarch blended with 1 Tbsp. cold water
2  pineapple rings, cut in 3/4-inch cubes
preparation: Heat soy sauce mixture, stirring until sugar dissolves.  Pour over pork.  Cover and chill 4 to 8 hours, turning meat occasionally.

name: DIABETIC APRICOT BREAD(A sweet loaf filled with bits of dried apricots.)
ingredients:
2  large eggs
1/3  c. mashed banana (mash ripe banana with a fork)
2/3  c. water
2  tsp. vanilla extract
1/3  c. vegetable oil
2  c. unbleached white flour
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. finely chopped dried apricots (see note)
preparation: Beat together the eggs and mashed banana until creamy.  Add water, vanilla extract and oil; beat.  Measure in flour, baking soda and baking powder; beat well.  Stir in chopped apricot until evenly blended.  Spoon batter into an oiled and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  Spread batter evenly in pan.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes, or until a knife inserted comes out clean.  Cool completely on a wire rack before slicing.  Serves 6.

name: SAUERKRAUT HOT DISH
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger, browned and seasoned
1  can sauerkraut, drained
1/2  c. rice
1  can tomato soup
1  can water
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake in a 350° oven.  For Minute rice, bake 30 to 45 minutes.  For regular rice, bake 1 1/2 hours.

name: NORWEGIAN LEFSETORTILLA-LIKE FLAT BREAD
ingredients:
8  c. Mashed Potatoes
1/2  c. Heavy Cream
1/4  lb. Butter, melted
1/2  tsp. Salt
1  tsp. Sugar
8  c. Flour (approximately)
preparation: Mix all ingredients using enough flour to make a soft dough. On a floured board, roll small balls of dough into pie-crust-size circles.  Use enough flour for each Lefse to keep from sticking to the rolling pin and board.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar
croutons
preparation: Mix together and sprinkle with croutons.  Bake 1/2 hour at 325°.

name: MEXICAN SALSA
ingredients:
1  lb. can tomatoes
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  can jalapenos
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. corn oil
1  Tbsp. white vinegar
1  bunch cilantro
preparation: Put all the ingredients in a blender; whip.  Keep in refrigerator.  Great with chips or over Mexican food.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. butter
2  c. sugar
2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
4  c. flour
5  c. oatmeal
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
24  oz. chocolate chips
8  oz. Hershey bar
3  c. chopped nuts (any kind)
preparation: Cream together the first 3 ingredients, then add the eggs and vanilla; mix together the next five ingredients.  Add chocolate chips and grated Hershey bar.  Add nuts.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 6 minutes at 375°.  Use dough in golf ball size and shape, place 2 inches apart.  Makes 24 dozen.

name: HARVARD BEETS
ingredients:
3  c. cooked sliced beets
2  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook and stir last 4 ingredients.  When clear, add beets and place pan, covered, over hot water for 1/2 hour.  Just before serving, heat beets and add butter.

name: OKRA FRITTERS
ingredients:
1  large egg, lightly beaten
1/4  c. cornmeal
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1/2  c. evaporated milk
3  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. red pepper
2  c. sliced fresh okra (about 2/3 lb.)*
vegetable oil
salt (optional)
preparation: *Two cups frozen, sliced okra, thawed, may be substituted for sliced fresh okra.

name: DOTTIE'S BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can wax beans
1  can green beans
1  can kidney beans
1  can garbanzo beans
1  can lima beans
1/2  c. celery, diced
1  medium green pepper, sliced
1  medium onion, sliced
3/4  c. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. salad oil
preparation: Drain beans well. Toss beans, celery, green pepper and onion together in a large bowl.  Thoroughly mix sugar, oil and vinegar. Pour over vegetables, tossing with fork evenly. Cover and set in refrigerator for at least 8 hours, tossing several times during this period.

name: MAYONNAISE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. Hershey's cocoa
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. pure vanilla extract
1 1/4  c. water
2  c. flour
preparation: Mix all ingredients except flour together.  Stir until smooth. Then add flour to mixture.  Stir until smooth.  Pour mixture into greased and floured oblong cake pan.  Bake in pre-heated oven at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  (20 oz.) roll sugar cookie dough
1  c. sugar
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  (16 oz.) sliced peaches
1  (20 oz.) sliced pineapple
1  (4 oz.) maraschino cherries
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
4  large bananas, sliced
preparation: Press dough into a 12-inch pizza pan.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes until light brown.  Cool.

name: CONEY ISLAND SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ring bologna
1  green pepper
2  medium onions
3  c. tomato juice
1/2  c. ketchup
1  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: Grind together the bologna, green pepper and onions.  Put in kettle.  Add the tomato juice, ketchup and chili powder.   Bring to a boil and simmer 4 hours.  Makes 1 quart.  Divide into small containers and freeze.

name: GLAZED CARROTS
ingredients:
1/2  bag Ideal whole baby carrots (frozen)
3  Tbsp. Louella butter
3  Tbsp. dark brown sugar
