preparation: Add carrots to salted boiling water.  Bring quickly to a boil. Cover; reduce heat.  Cook gently until tender (about 10 minutes). Melt butter in small pan.  Add sugar.  Cook until dissolved. Coat drained carrots well.  Serves 6.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  chicken, boiled and boned
1  onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  lb. grated cheese
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  pkg. tortillas
1  can green chilies
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Saute onion in butter.  Mix soups, cheese and chicken broth. Add onion, tortillas (broken into pieces) and green chilies (chopped).  Bake in 2-quart casserole at 350° for 30 minutes, uncovered.

name: HOMEMADE SEASONED CROUTONS
ingredients:
2  c. bread cubes (made from stale bread, mixture is best)
1/2  c. margarine
1  garlic clove, minced
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
pinch of dried herbs
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cut bread into medium-sized cubes, dry in the oven on a cookie sheet for 5 minutes.  Melt margarine and saute garlic until soft.  Place bread cubes in a large bowl.  Pour melted margarine over cubes and add remaining ingredients.  Toss well.  Return to the oven on cookie sheet and bake for about 3 minutes, until lightly browned.  Serve cooled croutons on salads or soups.  Store in a covered container in the refrigerator.

name: BLUEBERRY CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. heavy cream
1 (No. 2)  can blueberry pie mix
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  baked pie shell
preparation: Blend softened cream cheese, sugar and vanilla together until light and fluffy.  Beat heavy cream (best in chilled bowl and beaters) until whipped.  Fold in whipped cream.  Spoon mixture into cooked pie shell.  Put in refrigerator to chill for at least 1 hour.

name: LAZY JAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
3/4 to 7/8  c. milk
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil or melted butter or oleo
preparation: Lightly grease a 10-inch iron skillet or baker and heat in preheated 450° oven.  Mix ingredients and pour into heated pan. Mixture should be the consistency of a "batter." Bake until light golden brown.  Turn out immediately onto plate or platter.

name: TACO-FILLED PEPPERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (1 1/4 oz.)  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. salsa
1  c. kidney beans (8 oz.), rinsed and drained
4  medium green peppers
1  medium tomato, chopped
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In large skillet, brown the ground beef; drain.  Stir in the taco seasoning, kidney beans and salsa.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.  Cut peppers in half lengthwise; remove and discard seeds and stems.  Immerse peppers in boiling water for 3 minutes; drain.  Spoon about 1/2 cup meat mixture into each pepper half.  Place in an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Cover; bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, or until peppers are crisp-tender and filling is heated through.  Top each with tomato, cheese and a dollop of sour cream.  Yields 4 servings.

name: BEAN DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger, browned
1 large  can refried beans
1  can enchilada sauce (hot or mild)
1  can Mexican Thank You cheese sauce
1/2  pkg. Texas red chili seasoning
preparation: Combine all in a crock-pot and serve hot with nacho chips. Also great as a hot dog sauce and over a baked potato.

name: HOT PINEAPPLE-CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (No. 2)  cans chunky pineapple, drained
5  Tbsp. flour
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1  stick margarine
1  tube Ritz crackers
preparation: Layer 1:  Pineapple.

name: BAKED CHOP SUEY
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion
salt and pepper
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can chicken rice soup
1/2  tsp. celery salt
1/2  c. rice (uncooked)
2  c. water
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Brown beef, onion, salt and pepper. Put into baking dish; add celery, salt, soups and rice. Add water and soy sauce; stir all together and bake 1 hour, covered, and 1/2 hour more, uncovered, at 350°.

name: HOT COCOA MIX
ingredients:
1 large  box nonfat dried milk
1 large  jar powdered cream for coffee
1  box confectioners sugar
1 large  can Hershey's cocoa
preparation: Mix all together.  Put 3 to 4 large spoonfuls of mixture in large cup and add boiling water.

name: AMARETTO PUNCH
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  qt. boiling water
46  oz. can unsweetened pineapple juice
12  oz. can frozen orange juice, thawed and undiluted
6  oz. can lemonade, thawed
2  qt. water
2  c. Amaretto
2  Tbsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. almond extract
preparation: Dissolve sugar in boiling water.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Divide mixture evenly into 6 quart size, heavy-duty Zip-top plastic bags.  Freeze.  Remove each bag from freezer as needed.  Let stand at room temperature until mixture is slushy. This is just as good without the Amaretto liqueur.

name: ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
juice of 1 orange (save rind)
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  c. sour milk
1 1/8  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  c. raisins
preparation: In a bowl, mix together 1/2 cup sugar and juice from orange. Set aside.  Reserve orange rind.  In second bowl, cream together 1 cup sugar, salt and shortening. Add eggs and vanilla. Stir. Add sour milk (or 1 tablespoon vinegar in sweet milk).  Sift in flour and baking soda.  Grind together orange rind and raisins.  Mix into batter.  Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven.  Punch many holes with a toothpick all over the top of the cake. Spoon sugar and juice mixture over top. Serve with whipped topping or as is.

name: COLOSSAL CARAMEL APPLE TRIFLE
ingredients:
1 (18 1/4 oz.)  pkg. yellow cake mix
6  c. cold milk
3 (3.4 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1  tsp. apple pie spice
1 (12 1/4 oz.)  jar caramel ice cream topping
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans, toasted
2 (21 oz.)  cans apple pie filling
2 (16 oz.)  cartons frozen whipped topping, thawed
preparation: Prepare and bake cake according to package directions, using 2 greased 9-inch round baking pans. Cool for 10 minutes before removing to wire racks to cool completely.

name: ITALIAN COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
6  eggs
1  tsp. anise
6  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
4 to 5  c. flour
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, room temperature
1 1/2  c. milk
1 (3.9 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, well drained
1  Cool Whip (large)
preparation: Soften cream cheese with 1/2 cup milk; mix well until well blended and smooth.  Add instant pudding and remaining  1 cup milk.  Beat slowly 1 to 2 minutes, scraping sides of bowl.  Spread mixture over top of cooled cake (in pan).  Sprinkle well drained pineapple on top of pudding mixture.  Top with Cool Whip; spread evenly to cover.  Keep chilled.

name: NEW ENGLAND BOILED KIELBASA DINNER
ingredients:
1  lb. Eckrich Polska kielbasa, cut into 8 pieces
1  medium head cabbage, cut in wedges
4  medium carrots, peeled and cut in 2-inch pieces
4  c. water or half water and half beef broth
1  bay leaf
1  clove garlic
1  Tbsp. caraway seed
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Combine sausage  and  vegetables  in  large Dutch oven. Add water, bay leaf, garlic and caraway seed; bring to a boil. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes, until vegetables are tender. Remove bay leaf  and  garlic.  Arrange  sausage  and vegetables on platter.  Sprinkle  with  parsley.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: CATALINA TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
8  oz. mild Cheddar cheese
1  small bell pepper, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1  head lettuce, chopped
1  can pinto beans, drained
1  bag Doritos or corn chips, crushed
1  bottle Catalina dressing
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients. Add chips and dressing just before serving.

name: BURGUNDY BEEF
ingredients:
1/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3/4  lb. sirloin, cut into strips
2  Tbsp. oil
1  onion, cut into strips
1 small  clove garlic, minced
2/3  c. beef broth
2/3  c. Burgundy wine
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients.  Dredge steak in flour mix.  In large skillet, brown steak in hot oil.  Remove steak and set aside.  Add onion and garlic to skillet.  Cook until tender.  Add steak, broth and wine.  Cover and simmer 20 minutes.  Serve with noodles or rice.  May add sliced mushrooms if desired.

name: BROWN LENTIL SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. lentils
1  lb. salt pork or smoked ham
1  small onion, diced
1  carrot, diced
1  bay leaf
salt and pepper
crushed garlic cloves to taste
water
4  cubes beef bouillon
preparation: Soak lentils overnight.  Drain.  Place lentils in a deep pot. Add salt pork, onion, carrot, bay leaf, salt and pepper.  Add enough water to cover.  Add bouillon cubes.  Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1 hour.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo or butter
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. peanut butter
1  c. flour
1  c. oatmeal
preparation: Mix together well, adding flour and oatmeal last.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Don't overbake.

name: MICROWAVE BUTTERMILK PRALINES
ingredients:
3/4  c. buttermilk
2  c. sugar
2  c. pecans
1/8  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. oleo
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except soda, in 4 to 5-quart dish. Microwave on High for 4 minutes.  Take out and stir.  Microwave on High for 4 minutes again.  Take out and stir.  Microwave again on High for 4 minutes.  Take out and add 1 teaspoon baking soda until foamy.  Microwave for 1 more minute on High.  Whip until tacky (about 1 minute).  Drop by teaspoons on foil.  Cool.

name: CHICKEN PROVENCAL
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3  lb. broiler fryer chicken
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. dried marjoram leaves
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
16  pitted ripe olives
8  carrots, cut into fourths
8  small whole onions
4  medium potatoes, cut into fourths
1  c. chicken broth
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Cut chicken into pieces and remove skin.  Mix flour, paprika, basil, salt, oregano, pepper and marjoram.  Coat chicken with flour mixture.  Heat oil in 4-quart Dutch oven until hot.  Cook chicken until brown on all sides, about 15 minutes.  Add olives, carrots, onions and potatoes.  Pour chicken broth over vegetables.  Heat to boiling; reduce heat.  Cover and cook until chicken is done, about 45 minutes.  Remove chicken and vegetables and keep warm.  Mix cornstarch and cold water; stir into liquid in Dutch oven.  Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.  Boil and stir 1 minute.  Serve sauce with chicken.  Makes 8 servings; 298 calories per serving.

name: GRANDMA'S POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
1 2/3  c. sugar
5  eggs
2  c. flour, sifted
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter; add sugar gradually.  Beat constantly.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Beat hard after each egg.  Fold in flour and pour into a buttered and floured tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PEACH BLUEBERRY FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sliced, peeled peaches
2  c. blueberries
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
2  Tbsp. margarine
pie crust for two crust pie
preparation: In large bowl, combine peaches, blueberries, sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon and nutmeg; mix lightly.  Spoon into pie crust-lined 9-inch pan.  Dot with margarine.  Top with second crust.  Flute edges and slash design in top crust.  Sprinkle lightly with sugar.  Bake at 425° for 50 to 60 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve with vanilla ice cream if desired.  Frozen peaches and blueberries can be substituted for fresh.

name: HOMINY SAUTE
ingredients:
1  can hominy
oil or margarine
chopped onion
chopped green or red pepper
black pepper
preparation: Drain the hominy. Saute in a small amount of oil or margarine, the hominy, onion and green or red pepper.  Season with black pepper.

name: ZESTY ITALIAN SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. dried basil
1  Tbsp. dried oregano
1  Tbsp. dried thyme
2  Tbsp. dried parsley, chopped
6  cloves garlic
3  bay leaves
36  c. tomatoes
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 1/2  Tbsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
3  c. chopped onions
preparation: First wash and cut up tomatoes.  Let stand in a colander 15 to 20 minutes to drain.  In a 10-quart Dutch oven, combine tomatoes, brown sugar, salt and pepper.  Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.  When cooked, puree through a food mill.  Return puree to pan.  Add onions, parsley, thyme, oregano, basil, garlic and bay leaves.  Boil gently uncovered for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until thick.

name: SAUCY CHEESY BAKE
ingredients:
1/2 (16 oz.)  pkg. Dutch brand noodles
1  lb. ground beef
2  cans (15 oz.) tomato sauce
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/4  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. oregano
3  c. shredded Cheddar or Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook noodles according to package.  In medium skillet, brown ground beef; drain.  Stir in tomato sauce, onion, parsley, basil, garlic powder and oregano.  Simmer, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes.  In 3-quart oblong dish, layer 1/2 sauce, noodles and cheese, repeat ending with cheese.  Bake 25 minutes or until heated through.

name: BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can cut green beans
1  can cut yellow wax beans
1  can red kidney beans, drained and washed
1  whole onion, thinly sliced
1/2  c. celery, chopped (optional)
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
1/3 to 1/2  c. oil
1/2 to 2/3  c. white vinegar
1  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Combine vegetables; mix remaining ingredients and pour over salad.  Refrigerate for several hours or overnight.  Drain before serving.

name: PINTO BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2 to 3/4  c. cooked pinto beans
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Brown beef with 1/2 cup onion.  Add taco seasoning.  Add to already hot beans.  Cover with onions and cheese.  Heat well. Great over rice.  Great way to use leftover beans.

name: OKRA FRITTER
ingredients:
1/4  c. cornmeal
1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  large egg, slightly beaten
3  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. red pepper
2  c. sliced fresh okra
vegetable oil
salt (optional)
preparation: Combine first 9 ingredients; stir in okra.  Pour oil to depth of 2 inches into a Dutch oven; heat to 350°.  Drop mixture by tablespoonful into oil and cook until golden brown, turning once. Drain on paper towels.  Sprinkle with salt.  Serve immediately.

name: APPLESAUCE FRUITCAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
3  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. allspice
3/4  c. chopped nuts
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. raisins
3/4  c. dates, cut up
3/4  c. figs, cut up
3/4  c. candied fruit
2  c. applesauce
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Cream butter; add sugar gradually with spices, creaming until light.  Sift flour, soda and salt.  Dredge fruit and nuts in 1/2 cup of the flour.  Beat eggs until light.  Add butter mixture.  Mix flour mixture in; stir until well blended.  Put in fruit, nuts and applesauce.  Bake in a tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: RED VALENTINE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. coffee
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. red food coloring
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. buttermilk
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream  butter; add  sugar  and  beat  well.  Add  eggs. Combine next 3  ingredients; add, beat well.  Dissolve soda in buttermilk; add to mixture.  Pour batter into two 8-inch round cake pans.  Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.  Cool for 10 minutes. Spread on a cream cheese with pecans icing.

name: NAVY BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1  (1 lb.) bag bean mixture
2  medium chopped onions
2  large celery stalks, chopped
3  or 4 large carrots, chopped
ham bone
3  cloves garlic, chopped
2  tsp. chili powder
1 1/2  tsp. thyme
1/4  tsp. black pepper
juice of 1 lemon
1  bay leaf
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
preparation: Soak beans overnight in 2 quarts of water.  Drain beans the next day and rinse well. Saute onions, celery and carrots in olive oil. Add beans plus 2 quarts of fresh water, ham bone and garlic. Simmer 3 hours. Add chili powder, thyme, black pepper, lemon juice and bay leaf.  Simmer for 30 minutes, while removing meat from bone, throw away fat and bone and return the meat to the soup. Add tomato sauce and simmer 45 minutes or until tomato flavor is cooked throughout the soup.

name: LEMON LOVER'S DELIGHTS
ingredients:
1  box lemon cake mix
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  egg
confectioners sugar
preparation: Combine  all  ingredients  except  confectioners sugar. Mix well.  Shape into  small  balls.  Place  on  baking sheet. Bake in preheated 350° oven  for about 7 or 8 minutes or until lightly browned.  Roll in confectioners sugar.

name: PIE CRUST (3)
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  c. shortening
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  Tbsp. vinegar
cold water
preparation: Mix flour, shortening and salt.  Put egg in a cup; beat in vinegar and cold water.  Add to flour mixture.  After all is moistened, fold over three times, then divide and roll.

name: CHICKEN AND SAUSAGE JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
4  large onions, chopped
3  cloves garlic, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
1  small chicken, cut up
1  lb. smoked sausage, sliced
2  c. raw long grained rice
3  c. water
1/4  c. parsley, chopped
1/2  c. chopped green onion tops
salt, black and red pepper to taste
preparation: Fry chicken pieces and sausage in small amount of cooking oil until brown.  Add onions, celery and garlic and fry until brown. Add water and simmer until chicken is tender.  Add washed rice, parsley, onion tops, salt and pepper.  Stir lightly, lower fire, cover and cook until done (about 30 minutes).  Stir occasionally.

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
8  potatoes
1/2  lb. bacon
2  chopped onions
1/2  c. vinegar
1 1/2  c. water
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. flour, mixed in water
preparation: Cook, peel and slice potatoes.  Fry bacon; drain and cut up. Put bacon and onions in a bowl.  Add vinegar, sugar, salt and flour in water.  Add potatoes and serve.

name: GOOD APPLE PIE
ingredients:
6  medium tart apples
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  stick margarine
3  Tbsp. sifted flour
1/2  c. apple juice
1  c. brown sugar
juice of 1 lemon
1  tsp. cinnamon
dash of salt
preparation: Mix all together and place in uncooked pie shell.  Cook approximately 50 to 60 minutes at 350°.

name: BASIC EGGNOG
ingredients:
2  c. cold milk
2  eggs
nutmeg
4  tsp. sugar or Equal
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put ingredients except nutmeg into blender. If using electric mixer, put ingredients into deep narrow bowl.  If using blender, cover and run on high speed.  If using mixer, beat on high until blended.  Pour into serving glasses; sprinkle with nutmeg, if desired.  Makes 3 cups.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (20 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli
1 (12 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. mayonnaise
2  eggs, well beaten
1  medium chopped onion
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. seasoned bread crumbs
1/4  c. melted margarine
preparation: Cook broccoli in salted water according to package directions. Combine soup, mayonnaise, eggs and onions together.  Blend in broccoli.  Pour in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle on cheese. Top with buttered bread crumbs.   Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Can be made ahead of time and refrigerated until ready to cook.

name: SCHLISHKAS
ingredients:
7 1/2  c. mashed potatoes
4 1/2  c. flour
4  eggs
2  c. bread crumbs*
4  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Boil and mash potatoes.  Add eggs when potatoes cool, then add flour.  Place dough on a floured board.  Roll it out to 1/2 to 1-inch diameter.  Cut into 1-inch piece.  Put into boiling water for 10 minutes.

name: BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. beef stew meat
4  to 6 carrots
4  to 6 potatoes
1  c. diced celery
1  green pepper
1  medium onion
3  Tbsp. tapioca
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. pepper
24  oz. V-8 juice
preparation: Combine beef stew meat, sliced carrots, potato pieces, celery, green pepper and onion.  Sprinkle tapioca, sugar, salt and pepper on top.  Pour V-8 juice over all.  Cover and bake in 300° oven for 5 hours.  Do not mix or lift lid until done.

name: OVEN FRIED SQUASH
ingredients:
3  c. sliced squash (you may use either zucchini or yellow squash)
1/2  c. yellow corn meal
2  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. coarse ground pepper
preparation: Using only small amount of cooking spray, spray a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Preheat to 450°.  Beat eggs and water in a bowl and set aside.  Mix corn meal, salt and pepper.  Dip sliced squash in egg solution and then roll in corn meal.  Place one layer in baking pan.  Bake 20 minutes, then turn with a spatula.  Bake 20 more minutes.  The squash should be golden brown.

name: SALMON SOUFFLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1  C. milk
4  eggs
2  Tbsp. flour
1  C. flaked salmon
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Make a white sauce with the butter, flour, milk and salt. Add salmon.

name: BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
2/3  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1 1/4  c. mashed ripe bananas
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
1 1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2/3  c. buttermilk
preparation: Place shortening in bowl. Sift in flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt.  Mix. Add 1/3 cup buttermilk and 2 eggs.  Mix 2 more minutes. Bake at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan or two 9 x 1 1/2-inch pans, greased.  Cool.  Remove from pan and frost.  Sour cream or cream cheese frostings are very good.

name: HUMMINGBIRD CAKE
ingredients:
3  Cups flour
2  Cups sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cloves
1 1/2  sticks butter or oleo
3  eggs
2  Cups Mashed bananas
1 8  oz. can crushed pineapple (with juice)
1  Cup chopped pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat butter with sugar.  Add eggs, bananas, pineapple, and vanilla.  Combine dry ingredients.  Mix then fold in nuts.  Bake in bundt pan.  Cool in bundt pan for 10 minutes then turn out. Frost.

name: CREAMY TACO
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger, browned with onions
1/2  c. Milnot
1  box sour cream
1  can chili with beans
1  pkg. chili mix
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
lettuce
tomato
preparation: Serve over taco chips with lettuce and tomato  on top.

name: DEAN'S PRALINES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  c. granulated sugar
2  c. pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Cook over medium heat to 236° (soft ball stage) on a candy thermometer.  Stir constantly.  Cool slightly. Beat until mixture begins to thicken.  Drop candy rapidly from tablespoon onto waxed paper or buttered baking sheet.  If too stiff, add hot water.

name: GREEK SCALLOPS(Low-Fat Recipe)
ingredients:
2  tsp. olive oil
1  c. chopped onion
1  small garlic clove, minced
4  large plum tomatoes, chopped
2  Tbsp. chopped dill
2  Tbsp. fresh basil
7  oz. sea or bay scallops, cut in quarters
1 1/2  oz. uncooked orzo, cooked according to pkg.
2  tsp. lemon juice
3/4  lb. Feta cheese
Pam nonstick cooking spray
preparation: In a 9-inch skillet, heat oil.  Add onion, garlic and basil; cook 2 minutes.  Add tomatoes and dill.  Reduce to low and add scallops.  Cook until they turn opaque.

name: ITALIAN PIZZELLE COOKIES(Recipe Makes Approximately 30 Cookies)
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 3/4  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  lb. margarine
2  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. extract of anise or vanilla
powdered sugar
preparation: Beat eggs, adding sugar gradually.  Beat until smooth.  Add cooled, melted margarine and anise (or vanilla).  Sift flour and baking powder and add to egg mixture.

name: STEAK PIZZIOLA
ingredients:
1  medium onion
1  large red pepper
oil
1  can crushed tomtaoes
1  can Del Monte sauce
salt
pepper
parsley
2  club steaks
1 large  can sliced mushrooms, drained
preparation: Saute the onion and red pepper, cut up, in a little oil.  Add the tomatoes, sauce, salt, pepper and parsley.  Add the steaks. Cover; simmer for 45 minutes.  Add the mushrooms; simmer 5 more minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE ROLL COOKIE
ingredients:
12  oz. chocolate chips
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  c. nuts (optional)
1  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
4  c. flour
3  large eggs
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt chocolate chips in double boiler.  When melted, add sweetened condensed milk and nuts.  Stir until smooth; set aside to cool.  Mix together in bowl the margarine, sugar, eggs and vanilla; stir until smooth.  Add flour and baking powder.  You may need to add more flour if dough is too sticky.  Separate into fourths.  Shape into rectangle, then roll 1/4-inch thick.  Cover with chocolate filling and roll up.  Bake at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes.  Enjoy!

name: MANICOTTI
ingredients:
1/2  lb. Mozzarella, shredded
1  lb. Ricotta cheese
1 small  carton cottage cheese
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  can spaghetti sauce
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. parsley
1  pkg. pepperoni slices
1  box manicotti noodles
preparation: Follow directions on box of manicotti noodles.  While noodles cook, mix all other ingredients except pepperoni.  When noodles are done, drain off hot water and rinse with cool water.  Fill shells with cheese mixture.  Put filled shells in 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour spaghetti sauce over noodles.  Top with pepperoni slices. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: BRAUNSCHWEIGER BURGER
ingredients:
bacon
braunschweiger slices
preparation: Fry bacon (2 strips each burger) until crisp.  Drain, reserving fat.  Brown 1/2-inch braunschweiger slices in a little bacon fat over medium heat about 2 minutes per side.  Careful, don't overcook.

name: FRENCH FRIED ONION RINGS
ingredients:
3  or 4 Vidalia or Bermuda onions
1  c. milk
2  eggs
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. melted shortening
preparation: Heat deep fat to 380°.  Slice onions; separate into rings. Put remaining ingredients in blender; whip until smooth.  Dip onion rings into batter; drip excess from rings and drop into hot fat.  Fry until golden brown.  Drain on brown paper.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  small crushed pineapple, drained
2  tsp. minced onion
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  Tbsp. seasoned salt (Lawry's)
1  chopped mango (optional)
preparation: Mix well.  Mold into ball and roll in additional chopped pecans; chill.  (May be frozen.)

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger meat
1  jar Chef Boyardee sauce with meat
1  pkg. noodles
shredded cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger meat; drain grease.  In saucepan, add sauce, hamburger meat and noodles.  Fill empty jar of sauce mix with water and stir in meat mixture.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes. Cover with cheese and return to oven until cheese is melted.

name: LOW-FAT BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. light margarine
1  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
2  eggs
1/2  c. 1% milk
2  bananas, crushed
1  c. nuts, chopped (optional)
preparation: Mix ingredients together and bake in slow oven at 325° for about 1 hour.  Check with toothpick for doneness.

name: GINGERSNAPS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. oil
1/4  c. syrup
1  egg
2  c. plain flour
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt or less
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
preparation: Mix sugar, oil, syrup and egg in a bowl.  In another bowl, stir using spoon flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and ginger.  Now combine both mixtures.  Drop onto cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: LIME TORTE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/3  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. pistachio nuts, chopped
7  oz. jar marshmallow cream
1  c. sour cream
3  Tbsp. lime juice
1  tsp. grated lime peel (I grate 1 whole lime)
sliced lime (for garnish)
preparation: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy. Add flour and mix well. Press this onto bottom and halfway up sides of bottom. Bake at 375° for 12 to 14 minutes until lightly browned. Cool.  Reserve 2 tablespoons nuts for topping. Sprinkle remaining nuts on bottom of baked crust.

name: SEAFOAM CANDY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. dark brown syrup
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
2  egg whites
1  c. nuts (if desired)
preparation: Boil sugar, syrup and water until soft ball stage.  Test in cold water.  Pour over stiffly beaten egg whites.  Add vanilla. Beat until cool.  Add nuts.  Drop from spoon onto wax paper.

name: RASPBERRY FRUIT JELLO
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry gelatin
2  c. boiling water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
2  bananas, diced
1 (15 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add strawberries. Stir until thawed.  Add bananas and pineapple. Chill until firm.

name: OZARK APPLE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  egg
1/8  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1 1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. chopped apples
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake in greased and floured pan for 1 hour at 325°.  Serve warm with whipped cream.

name: WHITE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
2/3  c. shortening
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  c. milk
5  egg whites
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder and salt 3 times.  Cream the shortening and sugar until very light. Add flour mixture alternating with milk and beat until smooth and light.  Add vanilla and egg whites beaten very stiff; fold in well.  Bake at 375° for 25 minutes. Makes 3 layers.

name: POTATOES ROMANOFF
ingredients:
6  c. cooked, cubed potatoes
2  tsp. salt, divided
2  c. small curd cottage cheese
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. minced onion
dash of garlic powder
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
paprika
preparation: Cook potatoes only until tender.  Cool, cube and measure. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt.  Combine cottage cheese, sour cream, remaining salt, onion and garlic powder.  Mix thoroughly, then fold into potatoes gently.  Place in buttered casserole.  Top with shredded cheese and sprinkle with paprika.  At this point, it may be baked or refrigerated for later use.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly and slightly golden brown.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: RAW APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. Wesson oil
2  tsp. vanilla
2/3  c. half and half
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
3  c. raw apples (Golden Delicious)
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Beat together sugar, eggs, oil, vanilla and half and half. Stir together remaining ingredients and add to the first mixture. Bake 1 1/4 hours or until done in a well-greased tube pan in a 325° oven.  Cool 10 minutes and remove from pan.  Pour hot icing over cake.

name: DUMPLINS OR DROP BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. all purpose flour
3  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. vegetable oil
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Mix flour, baking powder and salt together with a fork. Then add milk and oil. Stir with a fork until it makes a ball in the bowl. For biscuits, spoon drop on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 450 for 10-14 minutes.

name: SHOO-FLY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
2  egg yolks, beaten
2  egg whites, beaten
1  c. raisins
2  c. water
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Cook raisins in water for 10 minutes or until water has cooked down.  Cool raisins.  Mix butter and brown sugar; add yolks and raisins.  Fold in egg whites.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 325° until done.

name: BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  small onion, chopped (optional)
1/3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. pepper
2 1/2  tsp. chicken bouillon
2  c. water
1  c. milk
3 to 4  c. bite-size broccoli florets
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. (2 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan over low heat; add onions, if using, and let brown slightly. Blend in flour and seasonings. Gradually add water and milk. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened slightly. Stir in broccoli. Simmer 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in Worcestershire sauce. Add cheeses and stir until melted.

name: LEMON MERINGUE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. boiling water
1/2  c. cornstarch or flour
4  egg yolks
1  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1/3  c. lemon juice
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
4  egg whites
grated rinds of 2 lemons
preparation: Combine sugar, cornstarch and lemon rind.  Add boiling water. Cook slowly until mixture thickens.  Add egg yolks, lemon juice and butter.  Cook 5 minutes.  Turn into baked pie shells and cover with meringue.  Place into oven to brown.

name: MEXICAN VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1.25  oz. pkg. taco seasoning mix
46  oz. can tomato juice (6 c.)
15  oz. can chili beans
16  oz. pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
12  oz. tomato paste or crushed tomatoes
2  c. crushed corn chips
8  oz. (2 c.) shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a 5-quart Dutch oven, brown ground beef; drain.  Add taco seasoning mix, juice, beans, vegetables and tomato paste.  Mix well.  Bring just to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 20 to 25 minutes until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.  Top each serving with crushed corn chips and Cheddar cheese.

name: FROSTED MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. small bread cubes
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
generous dash of pepper
2  c. mashed potatoes
1/4  c. water
1 to 2  Tbsp. drippings
preparation: Mix thoroughly  beef,  1/2  cup soup, bread, onion, egg, salt and pepper.  Shape  firmly  into  loaf.  Place  in shallow baking pan.  Bake  at  350°  for  one  hour.  Frost  loaf  with potatoes; bake  15  minutes more.  Blend remaining soup, water and drippings.  Heat, serve with loaf.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
30  tomatoes
8  green peppers
5  or 6 heads garlic
6  or 7 onions
12  hot peppers
salt to taste
1  bunch cilantro
3 or 4  cans tomato paste
preparation: Wash vegetables and cut into very small pieces (except tomatoes).  Wash tomatoes and dip in hot water to remove skin. Put everything in big pot to cook at slow temperature until it starts to boil.  Wash jars and lids and sterilize.  Fill jars with mix.  Cook for about 45 minutes in canning pots.

name: LEMON WHIPPER SNAPS
ingredients:
1 (18 1/2 oz.)  pkg. Pillsbury Plus lemon cake mix
2  c. Cool Whip
1  egg
1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Grease cookie sheet.  Combine cake mix, Cool Whip and egg in large bowl.  Stir until well mixed.  Roll in powdered sugar.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: HEAVENLY CLOUD BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. milk
1/2  stick margarine
4  slices bread
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1/4  c. sugar
1  can fruit pie filling
preparation: Heat milk and margarine until margarine melts.  Set aside to cool slightly.  Break bread into small pieces; place in ungreased casserole or souffle dish.  Separate eggs.  Beat yolks until lemon colored.  Slowly add yolks to milk; add vanilla.  Pour over bread. Bake in pan half filled with water 55 to 60 minutes at 325°. While pudding is baking, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Add sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time and beat until stiff.  Remove pudding from oven.  Spread choice of fruit pie filling on top. Cover completely with meringue.  Return to oven until meringue is lightly brown.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: MICROWAVE SQUASH PARMESAN
ingredients:
1  small onion, chopped
3  small yellow squash (1/4-inch thick slices; may use zucchini)
1/4  c. water
3  slices white bread, crumbled (crusts removed)
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. m.s.g. (optional)
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  c. milk
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
Italian flavored dry bread crumbs
preparation: Cook onion, squash and water, covered tightly, on Full power for 7 minutes.  Drain.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
3/4  c. white sugar
1  c. margarine
2  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. flour
2  c. flour
2  c. oatmeal
preparation: Set oven to 350°. Peel, core and slice 12 to 15 apples in a 9 x 13 cake pan. Use good cooking apple (Jonathan, Ida Red or Yellow Delicious).  Sprinkle with 3/4 cup of white sugar and lightly sprinkle with cinnamon. Add 1/3 cup flour.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 small  box Minute rice
2 (10 oz.)  boxes frozen chopped broccoli
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  can creamy chicken mushroom soup
1  medium onion, chopped and sauteed
1 small  can mushrooms
preparation: Cook rice and broccoli as directed.  In large bowl, combine rice and broccoli; add onion, mushrooms and 1 soup can of hot water.  Break up cheese and add, stirring until blended.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese on top.  Serves 18 to 20.

name: LOBSTER SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. lobster meat, cut bite size
3/4  c. celery, chopped (optional)
1/2  pt. mayonnaise
1/4  c. light cream or milk
1/4  c. Italian garlic dressing
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. basil
pinch of savory
2  Tbsp. ketchup or chili sauce (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except lobster and celery, in shaker. Add to lobster and celery, mixing as near to serving time as possible.  Serves 6.

name: TUILLES
ingredients:
1/3  c. plus 1 Tbsp. almonds, blanched and sliced
1 1/2  tsp. milk
1/3  c. plus 1 Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. unsalted butter
preparation: In a food processor, finely grate almonds and add flour. Blend well.  Add butter, milk and sugar; blend for 8 to 10 seconds, until a ball of dough forms.

name: COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines cake mix with butter
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. Wesson oil
4  eggs
1  c. nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
1  stick melted butter or margarine
2  tsp. brown sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix first 8 ingredients together.  Put one-half of batter into pan.  Mix together brown sugar and cinnamon.  Sprinkle on top of batter in pan.  Add other half of batter.  Bake 1 hour at 325°.

name: 4-H BANANA BREAD(State Fair Winners Book)
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. mashed bananas (2 or 3)
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. flour
1/2  c. nuts, chopped (optional)
preparation: Cream butter until soft; gradually add sugar and mix well. Blend in eggs, then bananas.  Sift together dry ingredients and stir into creamed mixture.  Bake in 10 x 5 x 3-inch greased loaf pan for 1 hour at 350°.   Cool for 10 minutes, then remove from pan.  Top with split slightly.

name: 24 HOUR COLESLAW
ingredients:
1  large head cabbage, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. onion, chopped
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. mustard seed
red or green pepper (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate 24 hours before using. Do not try to use before the 24 hours are up.

name: FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. flour
1 (16 oz.)  can Hershey's syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream sugar and margarine; add eggs, one at  a time and beat. Add flour slowly. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Use 13 x 9 pan or bake in 3 (8-inch) layers. Grease and flour pans.

name: AMARETTO SLUSH
ingredients:
12  oz. frozen orange slush
6  oz. frozen lemonade
3 1/2  c. water
3 1/2  tsp. instant tea
1  c. Amaretto
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Put into a container and freeze at least overnight.  To serve, put some slush in glass; add 7-Up or wine.

name: CARROT-PINEAPPLE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1/3  c. vegetable oil
3/4  c. grated carrots
1/3  c. drained crushed pineapple
1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Place doubler paper liners in muffin pan.  In medium mixing bowl, mix the flour, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, baking soda and salt. Mix in eggs and oil.  Beat on medium speed 3 minutes, scraping bowl often.  Stir in remaining ingredients until evenly distributed. Fill each muffin cup half full of batter.  Microcook on High 2 1/2 minutes, rotating after 1 minute.  Test for doneness by inserting wooden toothpick in center of cupcake; they are done when the pick comes out clean (the tops will appear moist).  Carefully remove cupcakes/muffins to rack and remove liners as soon as muffins are removed from pan.  Repeat.  Yields 15.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  c. sugar
4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs, lightly beaten
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. blueberries
preparation: Preheat the oven to 400°.  Mix together the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.  Combine the eggs, oil and milk and stir into the dry ingredients until just moistened.  Stir the berries into the batter and spoon into medium-size muffin tins lined with cupcake liners until about half full.  Bake 20 minutes. Yield:  2 dozen.

name: NUT HORNS
ingredients:
8  c. flour
4  egg yolks
4  cakes yeast (silver paper cakes)
5  sticks oleo
7  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. lukewarm water
4  lb. nuts, ground
preparation: Rub flour and oleo together.  Mix water, egg yolk, sugar and yeast together.  When ready, add to flour and oleo.  Divide into small balls.  Roll out onto floured surface.  Spread with nut filling.  Cut into wedges like a pie.  Roll, starting with wider end.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes if small, at 350° if a big roll. Rub with egg and sugar before baking.

name: PINWHEEL APPETIZERS
ingredients:
5  or 6 flour tortillas (10 or 12-inch)
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch original recipe dip mix (straight from envelope)
1  or 2 small onions, chopped fine
green sweet pepper, chopped
red sweet pepper, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped fine
preparation: Mix softened cream cheese, onion, peppers and celery with Valley Ranch powder.  Spread mixture on tortillas and roll up jelly roll fashion tightly.  Chill in refrigerator for a few hours.  Cut off ends of each roll and discard.  Slice tortillas into desired size slices and place on serving tray.  Sprinkle with paprika to make pretty.

name: EASY COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. flour (self-rising)
1  c. sugar
dash of baking powder
1  pt. jar thickened fruit
3/4  c. milk
1  stick butter or margarine
preparation: In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish melt butter or margarine.  In medium bowl, mix flour, sugar and baking powder.  Then add milk. Pour this over the melted margarine, then pour fruit over mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, or until nicely browned.

name: GOLDEN CREAM SOUP
ingredients:
3  c. diced potatoes
1  c. water
1/2  c. diced celery
1/2  c. carrot slices
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1  chicken bouillon cube
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1 1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  lb. Velveeta, cubed
preparation: In large kettle, combine potatoes, water, onion, celery, carrots, parsley flakes and bouillon.  Mix well.  Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Meanwhile, gradually add milk to flour, mixing until well blended. Add milk mixture to vegetables and cook until thickened.  Add cubed Velveeta.  Stir until melted.  Serve and enjoy.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: RICE BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. regular rice, cooked until dry
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. milk
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  stick oleo
preparation: Saute onion and celery in oleo for a few minutes.  Mix with other ingredients and bake 45 minutes at 350°.  Will make two casseroles, one can be frozen and baked later.

name: INSTANT CHOCOLATE MIX
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can Hershey's instant chocolate
1  lb. box powdered sugar
1 (8 qt. size)  box powdered milk
11  oz. jar cream (powdered)
preparation: Use three (3) heaping tablespoons per cup.

name: CUNNINGHAM CHARM SCHOOL PUNCH
ingredients:
2  quarts Light Rum
1  quart Dark Rum
1  quart orange juice
2  quarts grapefruit juice
1 large  can pineapple juice
1 small  bottle Real Lemon
1  pint Karo
block of ice or ice cubes
preparation: Mix Real Lemon and Karo together; add ice.  Pour remaining ingredients.  Drink and be Charming!

name: EASY BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. stew beef
1  large onion
2  carrots
3  to 4 medium potatoes
salt
1  pod cayenne pepper (if desired)
preparation: Cook stew beef until almost done with pod of pepper.  Add all other ingredients and salt to taste.  Remove pepper and serve.

name: SIX LAYER PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
1  c. sugar
5  eggs
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. plain flour
1  can Carnation milk
1  can crushed pineapple
preparation: In large bowl, combine butter and sugar; let butter soften a little.  Mix well.  Add egg yellows and mix; then combine flour and milk until mix is creamy.  Grease and flour 9-inch round baking pans.  Spoon in 3 large spoonfuls of batter with "large" spoon.  Bake at 325° until cake is golden brown.  Layers will be thin.  This is a six layer cake.

name: WHITE FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
5  eggs, beaten
1/2  lb. butter
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  lb. candied cherries
1  lb. candied pineapple
4  c. broken pecans
2  Tbsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. lemon
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs.  Coat fruits and nuts with 1/2 cup flour.  Add remaining flour; fold into creamed mixture. Add flavoring.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: AMISH SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. powdered sugar
2  eggs
1  c. oil
2  sticks oleo
4 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Place by teaspoonfuls on a baking sheet and bake until golden brown on bottom of cookies.  These are very good cookies.  They also freeze well.

name: SWEET AND HOT PICKLES
ingredients:
1  gal. dill pickles
5  lb. sugar
1  bottle Tabasco sauce
preparation: Drain vinegar off pickles; slice pickles. Put back in jar. Fill jar with sugar (usually only holds 4 pounds).  Add bottle of Tabasco sauce; replace lid. Place upside down in icebox. Take jar and shake once a day for a week.

name: JALAPENO-CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
2  c. sour cream
1  can jalapeno relish
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients and cook in a double boiler until thickened.  Makes approximately 1 quart.  This will keep in refrigerator for about 2 weeks.

name: CHICKEN AND NOODLES
ingredients:
6  egg yolks
1  whole egg
3  Tbsp. whole milk
preparation: With mixer beat in enough flour until thick.  With spoon, add enough flour for a stiff dough.  (Use Pillsbury flour for easier rolling.)  Divide dough in small enough pieces to roll easy.  Roll out each piece as thin as possible.  Place on cloth until dough is partially dry.  Roll as jelly roll and cut very fine.  Cook chicken until tender, remove from bone and cut in pieces.  Add noodles to boiling broth; cook until tender.  Add chicken last.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. margarine
2 2/3  c. sugar
3 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
8  eggs
1/2  c. Carnation milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream margarine, sugar and eggs.  Then add sifted flour alternately with milk, beginning with flour and ending with flour. Bake in large greased tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 300°.

name: MOCK EGGNOG
ingredients:
2  qt. cold milk
1 (3.4 oz.)  pkg. instant French vanilla or vanilla pudding mix
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. whipping cream
preparation: In a mixing bowl, beat milk and pudding mix on low speed for 2 minutes.  Beat in the sugar, nutmeg, vanilla and a pinch of salt if desired.  In another bowl, beat cream until thickened, about 3 minutes.  Stir into pudding mixture.  Refrigerate until serving. Sprinkle with additional nutmeg if desired.  Yield: about 2 1/2 quarts.

name: OLD FASHIONED RICE CUSTARD
ingredients:
1/2  c. uncooked long grain rice
4  c. milk, divided
1/4  c. butter or margarine
3  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
preparation: In the top of a double boiler, combine rice and 2 cups milk; cook, stirring occasionally, over boiling water until rice is tender and most of water has evaporated, about 45 minutes.

name: SHRIMP STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  can Campbell's condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/2  lb. deveined, shelled shrimp, cooked and chopped
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/3  c. dry bread crumbs
1/4  c. finely chopped celery
1/4  c. finely chopped green onions (spring onions)
2  Tbsp. prepared horseradish
2  Tbsp. chili sauce
40  large fresh mushrooms (about 2 1/2 lb.)
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter, melted
preparation: To prepare stuffing:  In a medium bowl, combine soup, shrimp, Parmesan, bread crumbs, celery, onions, horseradish and chili sauce until well blended.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PIE
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter, melted and cooled
2  eggs
1/4  c. flour (self-rising)
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  c. coconut
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix butter, eggs, flour and sugar.  Add milk, coconut and vanilla.  Pour in ungreased pie pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: WHIPPED DIP(For Fruit)
ingredients:
1 (13 oz.)  jar Marshmallow
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  orange (for juice)
grated orange peel (lemon or lime)
a sprinkle of ginger
preparation: Mix all ingredients together with a blender.  Garnish with an orange twist.

name: SKILLET CHICKEN PRIMAVERA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. raw chicken strips
1/3  c. flour
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  tsp. crushed basil
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  clove minced garlic
1 (19 oz.)  can Progresso vegetable soup
1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. sliced green onion
1/2  c. sliced zucchini
preparation: Toss chicken in flour, parsley and basil; coat well.  In a large skillet, heat olive oil and garlic.  Add chicken and cook until lightly browned.  Pour in soup, mushrooms, onion and zucchini.  Stir over medium heat until heated through.

name: MUSHROOMS WITH PARSLEY AND GARLIC(Funghi Triffolati)
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms
1/4  c. olive oil
3  cloves garlic
1/2  tsp. red crushed pepper
salt and pepper to taste
4  sprigs parsley
1/4  c. olive oil
preparation: Clean,  wash  and  dry  mushrooms thoroughly.  Cut each mushroom  in  half and parboil for 2 minutes in boiling water. Drain  well.  Heat oil in large skillet and add garlic.  Saute garlic until very brown, discard garlic and add mushrooms, hot pepper,  salt  and  parsley.  Cook  over  high  heat  browning mushrooms  slightly, about 10 minutes.  Lower heat and cook an additional 10 to 15 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: ELEGANT GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1/8  tsp. oregano
1/8  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  c. sour cream
2 (1 lb.)  cans green beans, drained
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine soup, onion, oregano, garlic salt and sour cream. Toss with beans.  Place in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Top with cheese.  Bake in moderate 350° oven for 30 minutes.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: BROCCOLI SLAW
ingredients:
2  pkg. shredded broccoli slaw
2  pkg. chicken-flavored Ramen noodles
1  c. slivered almonds, toasted
1  c. sunflower seeds
3/4  c. oil
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. cider vinegar
preparation: Mix oil, sugar, vinegar and flavor packets from Ramen noodles. Add crushed noodles, broccoli slaw, almonds and sunflower seeds. Let marinate for 30 minutes before serving. Great served with hamburgers or fish.

name: MICROWAVE PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. corn syrup
1  c. water
1/8  tsp. salt
2  c. raw peanuts
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, syrup, water, salt and peanuts in 2-quart glass bowl.  Microwave on High for 5 minutes; stir.  Microwave 13 minutes or until syrup separates into threads.   Stir in margarine, soda and vanilla until light and bubbling.  Pour onto greased cookie sheet.  Spread into thin layer.  Cool and break into pieces.  Yields 1 1/2 pounds.

name: LAZY DAISY OATMEAL CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. boiling water
1  c. oats
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Boil water and let oats set for 20 minutes.  Next add margarine and both sugars, eggs and vanilla.  Mix in dry ingredients and flour.  Pour into well greased and floured pan. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.  This makes a small cake.  For a big cake double your recipe.  Cover cake with your favorite pecan or walnut icing.

name: BROCCOLI CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. thyme
1  Tbsp. garlic salt
2  chicken bouillon cubes
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  c. cooked, chopped broccoli
preparation: In a pot, cook onion in butter until tender.  Blend in flour and seasonings.  Add milk, stirring constantly.  Cook slowly until thick.  Add cheese; cook until melted.  Remove from heat.  In a cup, dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water.  Stir into cheese mixture.  Blend in broccoli.  Cook until heated.  Serves 6.

name: MICROWAVE MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1  lb. macaroni
1 to 1 1/2  lb. extra sharp cheese
1/4  c. seasoned bread crumbs
12  oz. can evaporated milk
preparation: Cook macaroni according to package directions.  In microwave, melt cheese in a microwave-safe dish.  Set at Medium setting for 2 minutes.  Repeat, if necessary, to get cheese melted smoothly. Combine melted cheese, bread crumbs and evaporated milk, along with cooked macaroni in large bowl.  Place back in microwave for 3 to 5 minutes on High.

name: EDNA'S PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1/4  c. margarine, melted
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. pecans
1  (9-inch) deep dish pie crust, unbaked
preparation: Mix sugar, syrup and margarine.  Add eggs and pecans.  Fill pie shell with mixture.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to 350° and bake 30 to 35 minutes more.

name: BREAKFAST PIZZA
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage
1  pkg. (8) refrigerated crescent rolls
1  c. frozen loose pack hash brown potatoes, thawed
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar, Swiss or Monterey Jack cheese (4 oz.)
5  eggs
1 1/2  Tbsp. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: In skillet cook sausage until brown; drain off fat.  Separate rolls into 8 triangles.  Place in ungreased 12-inch pizza pan with points toward center.  Press over bottom and up sides; seal. Spoon on the sausage, then potatoes, then Cheddar.  In a bowl beat eggs, milk, salt and pepper.  Pour over crust.  Sprinkle on Parmesan.  Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: COPPER PENNIES
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots
1  small green pepper
1  medium onion
preparation: Peel and slice carrots. Boil in saltwater until tender. When cool, alternate layers of carrots, green peppers and onion rings.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
3  c. sliced peaches
1  c. sugar
1/2  stick butter
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder (if you use plain flour)
pinch of salt
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Prepare sliced peaches and mix with 1 cup sugar.  Set oven at 350°.  Put half stick of butter in a very deep baking dish.   Set in oven to melt.

name: BATTER BREAD(Shared By Mrs. Glenn Hill)
ingredients:
1  c. milk, scalded
2  Tbsp. margarine
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  c. very warm water
2  pkg. dry yeast
4 1/4 to 4 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Scald milk; add margarine, sugar and salt.  Dissolve yeast in warm water.  When milk mixture has cooled to lukewarm, add to yeast mixture.  Stir in flour and mix thoroughly.  Cover mixture with wax paper and a towel and allow to rise until double in bulk, about 40 minutes.  After dough rises, stir down with spoon and beat vigorously about 1/2 to 1 minute.  Divide dough into two well-greased loaf pans.  (Dough will be sticky and heavy.)  You may either bake immediately at 375° until golden brown or allow dough to rise to tops of loaf pans, then bake.

name: PASTA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked noodles
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
1  1/2 green peppers, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1  jar spaghetti sauce (2 c.)
1  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook pasta; drain.  Brown meat, onion, pepper and celery.  Stir in spaghetti sauce.  In microwave dish, add cottage cheese and cooked pasta.  Microwave uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes.  Stir a couple times, stir in cheeses.  Good and much easier than lasagna. Like it served with picante sauce.

name: WEDDING PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. Kool-Aid (strawberry)
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen Hawaiian Punch
1 large  pkg. frozen strawberries
preparation: Mix 2 packages Kool-Aid to 1 gallon water.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Add 1/2 cup of sugar or to taste.  You may freeze some of the mixture in ice cube trays.

name: RHUBARB CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. fresh rhubarb (5 c.)
1  c. sugar
1 small  pkg. strawberry jello
3  c. miniature marshmallows
1  box white cake mix
preparation: Slice raw rhubarb and put in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle sugar and jello over top.  Put marshmallows over top of this.  Mix cake mix according to directions given and pour over top.  Bake 50 to 55 minutes at 350°.  Turn out onto a platter. Serve warm with Cool Whip.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken breasts, cut in serving pieces
1  pkg. stuffing mix
1  stick margarine, melted
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
preparation: Cook chicken in salted water; save broth.  Pick meat from bones and arrange in bottom of bake pan or casserole dish.  Blend melted margarine with stuffing mix.  In large bowl, mix the 2 cans of soup with 2 cups of the broth left from the cooked chicken. Cover chicken with alternate layers of stuffing and soup mix, allowing a small amount of stuffing to sprinkle over top.  Bake at 350° to 375° about 20 to 25 minutes or until browned on top.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
2  c. sugar
5  eggs
2  Tbsp. baking powder
4  c. graham cracker crumbs
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beat well.  Mix baking powder and cracker crumbs.  Add to mixture, alternating with milk, beating well.  After each addition, beat 2 minutes.  Add vanilla and coconut.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes in greased and floured cake pans.  Makes 3 layers.

name: VENISON JERKY
ingredients:
flank steaks in 1/4-inch strips (venison flanks)
garlic salt
3 or 4  drops ReaLemon
1 small  bottle soy sauce
1 small  bottle Worcestershire sauce
lemon pepper
preparation: Mix lemon, soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce.  Soak meat in sauce mixture, 10 to 20 minutes, then season with lemon pepper and garlic salt.  Do not oversalt.  Bake 8 to 10 hours in warm oven (with door cracked), about 1 inch.

name: DIFFERENT DIP FOR FRUIT
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2/3  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Melt butter in small saucepan over low heat.  Add brown sugar, cook until sugar melts, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat, stir in sour cream and vanilla.  Serve dip with an assortment of fresh fruit.  Yield:  1 1/3 cups.

name: MEAT DUMPLINGS(Virtiniai)
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground lean beef
1/2  lb. ground lean pork
1  small onion, chopped
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Saute chopped onion in butter and add to the ground meat with egg and the spices.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
3  c. Bisquick
1  lb. hot sausage (raw)
1 (10 oz.)  stick Cracker Barrel cheese, grated
preparation: Mix all together with your hands.  Make into small balls and bake on ungreased baking sheet at 350° for about 25 minutes, until golden brown.  Serve hot.  These make such a hit with every one and are so easy.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (48 oz.)  can cranraspberry juice
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 (6 oz.)  can lemonade (frozen)
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
preparation: Freeze all together, then add 1 (2 liter) bottle ginger ale. If you make double, add another bottle of ginger ale.

name: SPRITE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  whole chicken or leg quarters
1  c. butter or margarine
1  lemon
1 (16 oz.)  bottle Sprite
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spray a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with nonstick spray.  Place chicken in bottom of baking pan.  Spoon melted butter over chicken pieces so that each piece receives at least 1 tablespoon.  Squeeze lemon juice over all chicken pieces. Salt and pepper chicken; pour in bottle of Sprite.  Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes or until done.

name: POT ROAST STEW
ingredients:
rump round meat
4  cans College Inn beef broth
5  lb. potatoes (approximately)
1  bag carrots
1  can string beans
2  bay leaves
parsley
pepper
flour
chopped onion
instant potatoes
Gravy Master
preparation: Use large pot.  Put flour and pepper on wax paper; roll pot roast until covered.  Brown on high heat all sides with chopped onion.  Add beef broth, bay leaf and spices and simmer for 2 hours. Add carrots and cook for 1 hour.  Add potatoes to cook for 20 minutes.  Add string beans to cook for 10 minutes.

name: IRISH SODA BREAD
ingredients:
4  c. unbleached flour
1  tsp. baking soda
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 3/4  c. buttermilk at room temperature
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  egg at room temperature
1/2  stick butter
1/2  c. raisins, softened, soaked in water and drained
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Combine dry ingredients.  Blend 1/2 stick butter and dry ingredients until mixture resembles dry cornmeal.  Beat egg with fork and combine with buttermilk.  If using raisins, add them to dry mixture.  Add 1/2 liquid ingredients to 1/2 dry ingredients.  Stir to combine.  Add remaining 1/2 and stir.  Turn batter into well-floured board and knead briefly until dough is no longer sticky.  Place loaf onto lightly greased baking sheet and with sharp knife, cut across top. Bake 40 minutes or until golden brown.

name: MICROWAVE PEANUT BRITTLE(Makes About 1 Pound)
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. dry roasted peanuts (about 7 1/2 oz.)
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1 1/4  tsp. baking soda
pinch of salt
preparation: Butter a large baking sheet or cookie sheet.  In microwave-proof bowl (allow room for expansion), combine peanuts, sugar, corn syrup and salt.  Microwave on High until mixture bubbles vigorously, about 6 minutes (cooking time may  vary slightly due to the differences in microwave power).  Remove mixture from microwave and stir in butter and vanilla.  Return to microwave and cook on High until candy turns light gold color (about 3 minutes).  Remove bowl from microwave (carefully, it's hot!).  Working quickly, add baking soda to mixture and stir briskly.  The mixture will foam up.  Immediately pour onto buttered baking sheet and shake from side to side to spread brittle as thin as possible.  Let stand until cold and hard (about 45 minutes).  Break into pieces and store in airtight container at room temperature for up to a month.

name: MEXICAN ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2/3  c. salsa (medium or hot)
chopped green onion
1/4  tsp. chili powder
dash of garlic salt
1  pkg. small flour tortillas
preparation: Mix all ingredients until smooth; spread on tortilla.  Roll up tightly.  Cut into bite size slices.  Make 1 day ahead.  They are better when they are a little soggy.  Serve with a bowl of salsa to dip tortillas in.

name: POTATO PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  egg
1/8  c. milk
1/2  tsp. instant minced onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
6  oz. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
preparation: Beat egg.  Add milk, onion, salt, flour and baking powder. Mix well.  Stir in potatoes.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Drop batter onto hot skillet.  Use 1/2 cup mixture per pancake.  Fry until golden brown.

name: FROZEN PINEAPPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker crust
8  oz. thawed Cool Whip
1  can condensed milk
12 to 15  oz. crushed pineapple
preparation: Stir together the condensed milk and Cool Whip until well blended.  Fold in the pineapple.  Pour into pie crust and freeze about 4 hours.  Serve.

name: SUNDAY SUPPER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. Crisco
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. mustard
1/4  lb. (1 c.) shredded American cheese
5  or 6 wieners (1/2 lb.), cut in 1/4-inch slices
3  c. sliced potatoes
preparation: Melt Crisco.  Add onion and cook until tender.  Stir in flour and salt.  Add milk and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thickened and beginning to boil.  Remove from heat.  Stir in mustard and cheese.  Arrange layers of potatoes, wieners and cheese sauce in 2-quart casserole which has been rubbed with Crisco.  Top with cheese sauce.  Bake in slow oven at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.  Serve hot.

name: CHOCOLATE PEANUT BUTTER CLUSTERS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. peanut butter
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch morsels
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet morsels
2  c. salted Spanish peanuts
preparation: Combine peanut butter, butterscotch morsels and chocolate morsels.  Microwave (50% power) for 3 to 4 minutes.  Add peanuts. Drop by teaspoonful on wax paper.  Chill until firm.  Store in refrigerator.

name: OLD FASHION EGG PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter, soften
1 small  can evaporated milk
2 heaping  Tbsp. flour
3  eggs, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cream sugar.  Add milk and flour.  Mix well.  Stir in well beaten egg yolks, vanilla, and cinnamon.  Fold in egg whites which have been beaten until thick, but not dry.  Pour custard in to 9 inch pie crust and bake at 325 degrees until done.

name: SKILLET CHOPS WITH RICE
ingredients:
4  pork chops (about 1 lb.)
salt and pepper
1  can Campbell's onion soup
1 soup  can water
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  tsp. thyme, crushed
1/2  c. rice
preparation: In skillet, brown chops; pour off fat.  Season with salt and pepper.  Add soup, water, celery and thyme.  Cover; simmer 30 minutes.  Stir in rice.  Cover; cook 20 minutes longer or until chops and rice are tender.

name: CHEESE AND SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
10  oz. sharp cheese
1  lb. hot sausage
1  Tbsp. paprika
3  c. Bisquick
preparation: Allow sausage and cheese to stand at room temperature for about 30 minutes for easier mixing.  Mix sausage, cheese and paprika; add Bisquick and shape into small balls.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes approximately 100 balls.  May be frozen.

name: REUBEN QUICHE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can sauerkraut, drained and rinsed
2  tsp. caraway seed
1/4  lb. corned beef, thinly sliced
1/4  lb. Gruyere or Swiss cheese, thinly sliced
1  c. half and half, warmed
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  pastry shell (made or purchased)
preparation: Squeeze small handfuls of sauerkraut to extract all moisture. Saute kraut in butter in skillet until it begins to brown and is covered in butter.  Add caraway seed.  Put kraut in prepared pie shell.  Top with corned beef; top that with cheese slices.  Pour custard of milk and eggs over everything.  Bake in preheated 375° oven for 40 to 45 minutes, or until custard is set.  Serves 4 adults.

name: COCOA APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
2  sticks oleo
1/2  c. water
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  apples, cored and grated (2 c.)
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. allspice
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs,  sugar,  oleo  and water until fluffy.  Sift flour, cocoa, soda and spices.  Add to creamed mixture and mix well. Fold  in  nuts,  apples, chips and vanilla.  Spoon into greased and floured  Bundt	pan  and bake at 325° for 60 to 70 minutes. Remove from  oven and let stand for 8 to 10 minutes. Place Bundt pan upside down on bottle and cool for 30 minutes.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
1  lb. carrots, cut in 1 1/2-inch chunks
2  bell peppers, cut in strips
1  medium onion, sliced in rings
1/2  c. salad oil
1  can tomato soup
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. white vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Cook carrots in salt water until tender and drain.  Layer carrots, peppers and onion in bowl.  Mix oil and soup together and pour over them.  Mix sugar, vinegar, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce together.  Heat, not quite to boiling, and pour over all.  Keep refrigerated.  The longer it stands, the better it gets.

name: DOUBLE LAYER PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
4  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. milk or half and half
1  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  c. Cool Whip, thawed
1  large graham cracker crust
1  c. milk or half and half
2 (4 serving size)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Mix cream cheese, milk and sugar in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth.  Gently stir in Cool Whip.  Spread on bottom of crust.  Pour 1 cup milk into bowl and add pudding mix.  Beat with wire whisk until well blended (1 to 2 minutes). Mixture will be thick.  Stir in pumpkin and spices with whisk and mix well. Spread over cream cheese layer.  Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Garnish with additional Cool Whip (and nuts, if desired).  Serves 8.

name: GERMAN'S SWEET CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. (4 oz.)  Baker's German's Sweet Chocolate
1/2  c. water
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. (2 sticks) margarine or butter, softened
2  c. sugar
4  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk
4  egg whites
Coconut-Pecan Frosting (recipe follows)
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Line bottoms of 3 (9-inch) layer pans with waxed paper.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. squash
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. bell pepper
1/2  c. grated cheese
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  stick margarine
1/4  c. bread crumbs
1  egg
1/2  c. pimento
preparation: Cook squash and onion until done.  Mix squash and all ingredients except bread crumbs together.  Place in a greased casserole.  Top with bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: SPANISH PEANUTS & GREEN PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen English peas, thawed
2  c. Spanish peanuts
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
1/2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Refrigerate at least two hours before serving.  Serves 8.

name: MINT CHEESECAKE BROWNIE BARS
ingredients:
1  pkg. fudge brownie mix
1 (8 oz)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle brand sweetened condensed milk
2  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. peppermint extract
green or red food coloring, optional
ready to spread chocolate frosting
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Prepare brownie mix as package directs.  Spread into well greased 13 x 9 inch pan; bake 15 minutes.  In mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.  Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.  Add eggs, extract and food coloring; mix well.  Pour evenly over brownie.  Bake 25 minutes or until lightly browned; cool.  Spread with frosting. Cut into bars.  Store covered in refrigerator.

name: COLD PICKLES
ingredients:
10  qt. cucumbers (whole or sliced)
1  gal. vinegar
1  oz. whole cloves
1  oz. cinnamon
1  oz. black pepper
1  oz. mustard seed
1  oz. dram saccharin
1  c. salt (scant)
preparation: Pack cucumbers in jars.  Mix vinegar and spices; stir thoroughly.  Pour solution over pickles in the jar and seal.

name: APALACHEE BAY CRAB QUICHE
ingredients:
8  oz. fresh crabmeat
1  c. grated sharp cheddar cheese
3  oz. cream cheese, cut into 1/4 inch pieces
1/4  c. sliced green onions
1/4  c. chopped bell pepper
1/4  c. chopped red pepper or pimento
1/2  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
2  c. milk
1  c. package biscuit and baking mix (Bisquick)
4  large eggs
3/4  tsp. salt
dash cayenne pepper
dash ground nutmeg
preparation: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  In a large bowl, gently combine crab, cheese, cream cheese, onions, peppers and mushrooms.  In a separate bowl, combine milk, baking mix, eggs, salt, cayenne pepper and nutmeg.  Using a mixer, blend 1 minute.  Pour crab mixture into a greased quiche pan.  Pour milk mixture over crab and bake 35 to 40 minutes or until  a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH DESSERT
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. flour
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  bowl Cool Whip
2  boxes instant pudding
pecan pieces (optional)
preparation: Mix cream cheese and Cool Whip.  Spread on crust.  Mix instant pudding as directed on box.  Put on Cool Whip and cheese mixture. Top with Cool Whip.  Garnish with pecan pieces if desired.

name: BANANA NUT CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter, softened
1 1/3  c. sugar
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1  c. sour cream
1  c. mashed bananas
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Beat butter until creamy.  Beat in sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Stir in vanilla.  Stir in flour, salt, baking soda and baking powder.  Set aside 1/4 cup flour mixture.  Add flour to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream.  Stir in mashed bananas and nuts with reserved flour to add to mixture and blend. Put in a 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish.  Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: APPLE BROWNIE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  large apples, chopped fine
1/2  c. pecans (optional)
1  c. flour
preparation: Cream butter, sugar, egg and dry ingredients.  Mix.  Mixture will be dry.  Add apples and nuts.  Spread in 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

name: CHICKEN RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  chicken leg quarters
salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. oil
1  tsp. onion flakes
water
1  c. cream of chicken soup
1  c. rice, raw (converted)
preparation: Sprinkle chicken pieces with salt, pepper and paprika.  Heat oil in skillet and brown chicken pieces. Set aside.  Rehydrate onion flakes in water for 10 minutes. Add to oil in skillet and saute for 5 minutes. Stir in soup, 1 3/4 cups water and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Bring to boiling, stirring to loosen browned particles in skillet.  Heat oven to 350°.  Pour rice into large baking dish. Stir in seasoning mixture from skillet. Arrange chicken pieces on rice. Cover and bake for 2 hours.

name: VIDALIA ONION DEEP DISH
ingredients:
1 1/8  c. regular rice
1/2  c. butter
3 1/3  lb. Vidalia onions, chopped
1 1/8  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1  c. whipping cream
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  Tbsp. paprika
preparation: Cook rice in a large pot of boiling water for 5 minutes. Drain well.  Melt butter in saucepan.  Add onions; cook, stirring, until tender.  Mix cheese and cream.  Add rice, parsley, salt and pepper.  Place in a greased buttered casserole dish.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake one hour at 325°.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen spinach (small pkg.)
2  c. mayonnaise
2  c. sour cream
1  small onion
1  can water chestnuts
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
preparation: Thaw and squeeze water from spinach.  Mince onion.  Chop water chestnuts.  Blend ingredients.  Chill 1 to 2 hours.  Hollow out round loaf of bread to form bowl for dip.  Serve with crackers.

name: BOLOGNA GRAVY
ingredients:
10  slices diced bologna
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. butter/margarine
4  c. milk
preparation: Melt butter/margarine.  Brown flour and diced bologna.  Add milk.  Stir until thickens.  Water may be added if too thick. Serve on toasted bread.  Good for breakfast or fast meal anytime.

name: PUMPKIN POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. allspice
3  c. sugar
1  c. salad oil
3  eggs
1 (16 oz.)  can or 2 c. fresh pumpkin
preparation: Sift  dry  ingredients together twice.  Blend salad oil and sugar thoroughly  with electric mixer.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating  well  after each addition.  Add pumpkin and mix well. Turn the  mixer  to  the  lowest speed and blend in dry ingredients.  Pour  batter  into  greased  and floured 10-inch tube or Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CREAM OF VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  medium onion
3/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
3 (10 1/2 oz. each)  cans chicken broth or 4 c. chicken broth
2  c. milk
2  c. light cream
1  tsp. dried basil
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
5  c. chopped leftover cooked mixed vegetables (such as broccoli, carrots and cauliflower)
preparation: In a large kettle or Dutch oven, saute onion in butter until tender.  Add flour; cook and stir until bubbly.  Gradually add chicken broth; cook and stir until thickened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the milk, cream, basil, salt, pepper and garlic powder. Add the vegetables; cook gently until heated through.  Yield:  8 to 10 servings (about 3 quarts).

name: CHIPPED CORNED BEEF ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. corned beef slices
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  tsp. milk
1  Tbsp. horseradish
garlic salt to taste
onion salt to taste
pepper to taste
preparation: Lay beef flat on cookie sheet.  Refrigerate.  Combine remaining ingredients.  If necessary, add a little milk for spreading consistency.  Lay 2 slices of beef side by side, overlapping a little.  Spread mixture over; roll together.  Refrigerate again (about an hour).  Before serving, slice and insert picks.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
2  c. warm buttermilk
5  c. flour
1/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  Tbsp. salt
1  c. shortening
preparation: Water and milk temperature should be 110° to 115°.  Dissolve yeast in water.   Let stand 5 minutes.   Stir in buttermilk and set aside.

name: CREAMY PINEAPPLE SLAW
ingredients:
6  c. shredded cabbage
1  c. shredded carrot
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. minced garlic
preparation: Combine cabbage and carrot in large bowl.  Combine mayonnaise and next 4 ingredients.  Add to cabbage mixture, tossing gently. Yield:  8 to 10 servings.

name: DIRTY RICE
ingredients:
1  c. rice (uncooked)
1  onion, chopped
1  pepper, chopped
1  can beef bouillon soup
1  can mushrooms, drained
3/4  stick butter
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients, but the butter, together.  Put into a baking dish.  Slice the butter into small slices and place on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: WAFFLES
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3  egg yolks, well beaten
1 1/4  c. milk
5  Tbsp. melted butter
3  egg whites, stiffly beaten
preparation: Combine dry ingredients; mix in egg yolks, milk and butter until well blended.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.  Cook in hot waffle iron.

name: SHRIMP FILLED CELERY
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. shrimp, boiled, peeled and deveined
6  oz. cream cheese, softened
3  hard-boiled eggs
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
1/2  c. green onions, chopped
1  Tbsp. green onion bottoms, chopped
3  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1 1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. red pepper
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. garlic powder
12  ribs celery (remove strings and cut into 2-inch lengths)
preparation: In a processor or food blender, put 1/2 pound of the shrimp, cream cheese, hard-boiled eggs, mustard and onions and blend to a puree.  Remove to a bowl.  Chop the remaining pound of shrimp and add to bowl.  Add the remaining ingredients except celery and mix well.  Fill celery pieces with the mixture and arrange on serving tray.   Chill before serving.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  chopped onion
2 to 3  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
garlic powder to your taste
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. vinegar (or as you like)
preparation: Brown beef and onion together.  Add other ingredients; cook until done.  Best to simmer on low for about 30 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
