ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3 1/2  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. soda
3  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. oil
4  eggs
2/3  c. water
2  c. pumpkin pie mix
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together in mixing bowl.  Add oil, eggs, water and pumpkin pie mix.  Pour into 3 (9 x 4 x 1/2-inch) loaf pans and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PORCUPINES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. dates, cut up
2  beaten eggs
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. Rice Krispies
nuts (optional)
preparation: Stir together in frying pan.  Melt shortening first.  Stir in dates, egg mixture.  Stir until thickens.  Cool a little and add 3 cups Rice Krispies in bowl.  Pour mixture over all.  Add nuts. Grease hands.  Roll into small balls.  Roll in coconut.

name: ANGEL NICOLE BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. self-rising flour
1/4  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
2 to 3  Tbsp. instant yeast
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Cut in shortening and buttermilk.  Mix well.  Knead and roll out dough on lightly floured surface.  Roll to 1/4-inch thickness.  Cut with biscuit cutter.  Brush with melted butter and fold in half.   Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until golden brown.  Brush tops with melted butter.  Makes about 75 biscuits, depending on size of biscuit cutter.

name: STRAWBERRY NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. oil
4  eggs, beaten
1  c. chopped nuts
2  c. strawberries
3  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
pinch of salt
preparation: By hand, mix sugar, oil and eggs.  Add dry ingredients, then nuts and strawberries.  Bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes.  Yields 2 loaves or 3 coffee-can rounds.

name: TRAVELIN CUPCAKES
ingredients:
4  sq. chocolate
2  sticks butter
1 3/4  c. sugar
1 3/4  c. chopped nuts
4  eggs
1  c. unsifted plain flour
preparation: Melt chocolate and butter over low heat.  Add remaining ingredients.  Pour into cupcake paper-lined muffin tins.  Bake at 325° for approximately 20 to 25 minutes.

name: RUTH'S CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  stick butter (don't use margarine!)
1/4  c. white Karo syrup
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. vanilla
4  qt. popped corn
preparation: Boil the first 3 ingredients together for four minutes. Remove from heat and add baking soda and vanilla.  Stir into the popped corn.  Put in a large pan in a 200° oven for one hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

name: RUSSIAN TEA COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. soft butter (2 sticks)
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. flour
3/4  c. chopped nuts (pecans)
preparation: Mix butter, sugar and vanilla.  Sift in flour.  Add nuts. Roll into small bars and chill (about 1 teaspoon of dough).   Bake at 400° until lightly browned.  Roll in confectioners sugar while warm.

name: STUFFED HAMBURGER BUNS
ingredients:
1  doz. hamburger buns
1 (12 oz.)  can Spam
1  lb. processed cheese
6  boiled eggs
1 small  can ripe olives, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
preparation: Grind up all ingredients and mix with tomato sauce.  Remove a small amount of dough from the center of the hamburger buns.  Fill the bun with filling.  Wrap with aluminum foil.  When ready to serve, heat in a moderate oven, bun and foil, until hot all the way through.  The cheese melts into the ingredients.  Delicious.

name: GRANDMA'S SPONGE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sifted flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
6  egg whites
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  c. sugar
6  egg yolks
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift flour, 1 cup sugar, baking powder and salt.  Beat egg whites until frothy.  Add cream of tartar.  Gradually beat in 1/2 cup sugar.  Beat until whites form stiff peaks.  In small bowl, combine egg yolks, water, vanilla and sifted dry ingredients. Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes.  Fold yolk mixture gently, but thoroughly, into beaten egg whites.

name: SPINACH FLORENTINE STUFFED MUSHROOM CAPS
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. fresh chopped spinach
1/2  tsp. instant chicken bouillon
18  large mushrooms
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. dry mustard
1/8  tsp. seasoned salt
Parmesan cheese, grated
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°. Clean mushrooms; separate stems and caps. Chop mushroom stems. Cook spinach with chicken bouillon added to the water. When spinach is cooked, drain well. Sauté chopped mushroom stems in butter. Combine spinach and seasonings with chopped mushroom stems. Lightly sauté mushroom caps in butter or margarine until slightly browned; drain. Fill caps with spinach mixture and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Place in a shallow pan and bake in a 375° oven for 15 minutes. Makes 18 appetizers.

name: GRAMS PLUM PUDDING
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1  egg
1/2  c. dark molasses
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  c. chopped fruit (combination of chopped, not peeled, apple, raisins and walnuts
preparation: Cream butter and brown sugar together until fluffy.  Beat in egg and molasses.  Sift together flour (resift), soda, baking powder, cinnamon and spices.  Add dry ingredients to butter mixture, alternately with buttermilk.  Stir in chopped fruit and nuts.

name: APPLESAUCE JELLO
ingredients:
16  oz. 7-Up (regular or diet)
1/2  c. red hots
1 large  box red jello
2  c. applesauce
preparation: Mix 7-Up and red hots in saucepan over medium heat until candy dissolves.  Remove from heat.  Add jello.  Stir and let sit until cool.  Add applesauce and stir well.  Pour into mold.  Refrigerate until chilled and firm.

name: SWEET-SOUR BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can kidney beans, drained
1 (No. 303)  can each of wax beans and green beans, drained
1  pkg. frozen baby lima beans, cooked and drained
1  c. chopped celery
1  onion, chopped
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
2  chopped pimentos
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
1/2  c. salad oil
salt and seasoned salt to taste
preparation: Cook the frozen lima beans until fork-tender.  Combine drained beans with chopped celery, onion, green pepper and pimentos. Combine sugar, vinegar and oil in a saucepan; bring to boil.  Add salt and seasoned salt; set aside to cool.  Pour dressing over salad.  Refrigerate and stir occasionally.  Prepare this salad the day before using.  Serve with slotted spoon.

name: MILLIONAIRE PIE
ingredients:
1  can condensed milk
1/4  c. lemon juice
1 flat  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  can coconut
1  c. chopped nuts (pecans)
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Put lemon juice in Eagle Brand.  Add other ingredients.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Pour into two cold crusts or graham cracker crusts.

name: NOODLES
ingredients:
1  beaten egg
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. milk
1  c. flour
preparation: Mix together the beaten egg, salt and milk.  Then stir that into the flour in a medium bowl.  Roll thin and let dry for 20 minutes.  Then roll again, cut and let dry for 2 hours.  Drop noodles into boiling mixture of chicken broth.

name: WHOOPIE PIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  egg yolks
5  Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/3  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients and drop by teaspoons on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until done.

name: SAUSAGE CHEESE BITES
ingredients:
3  c. Bisquick
1  lb. sausage
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Mix Bisquick and sausage to a coarse crumb mixture.  Add grated cheese.  Form into balls. Cook on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: HONEY-WHOLE WHEAT BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. stone-ground whole wheat or graham flour
1/3  c. honey
1/4  c. shortening
1  Tbsp. salt
2  pkg. regular or quick-acting active dry yeast
2 1/4  c. very warm water (120~ to 130~)
3 to 4  c. all-purpose or unbleached flour
preparation: Mix whole wheat flour, honey, shortening, salt and yeast in a 4-quart bowl; add warm water.  Beat on low speed, scraping bowl frequently, 1 minute.  Stir in enough all-purpose flour, 1 cup at a time, to make dough easy enough to handle.

name: ITALIAN MARINADE SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. spiral noodles
1  bottle McCormick Salad Supreme
1  premixed Good Seasons Italian dressing
1  medium onion, chopped
2  green peppers, chopped
1  c. chopped tomatoes
4 to 6  oz. brick cheese, cut into 1/4 to 1/2-inch squares
1/2  stick pepperoni, cut into 1/4 to 1/2-inch squares
preparation: The night before, cook noodles according to package instructions.  Rinse with cold water and drain.  Add bottle of McCormick Salad Supreme, Italian dressing and onion.  Toss and refrigerate overnight.  Add other ingredients a few hours before serving, then chill.  The longer it sets, the better it tastes. May also add chopped broccoli, cauliflower and black olives.

name: FROSTING MIX
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil and boil 10 minutes, stirring constantly.  Then add 1 teaspoon vanilla, 1 cup coconut and 1/2 cup chopped nuts.  Pour over cake while still warm.

name: ELLA'S ORANGE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. granulated sugar
2  large eggs
2  c. all-purpose flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. grated orange rind
4  Tbsp. sweet butter (unsalted)
4  Tbsp. orange juice
preparation: Cream sugar, eggs and butter with electric mixer until light in color.  Add all remaining ingredients, blend on low speed, scraping down sides of bowl several times.  The dough is sticky in appearance.  Drop by spoonfuls onto a greased sheet.  Bake in preheated oven for approximately 10 minutes.  Cookies will have a puffed surface and the edges will be lightly browned when done. Cool slightly on cookie sheet, then remove.  Ice while warm for a glazed look or cool for a regular iced look.

name: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1 (21 oz.)  can peach or cherry pie filling
1 (15 oz.)  can Mandarin oranges, drained
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
2/3  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
1  (8 oz.) frozen whipped topping, thawed
lettuce leaves (optional)
preparation: In large bowl, combine milk and pie filling.  Add oranges, pineapple and nuts.  Gently fold in whipped topping.  Spread into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Cover and freeze.  Remove from freezer 15 minutes before serving.  Cut into squares; serve on lettuce lined plates, if desired.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
3  large potatoes
1 3/4  c. sugar
1 small  can Carnation milk
3  eggs
1  Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  stick butter
preparation: Whip eggs with fork; set aside.   Mix rest with potatoes; add eggs.   Mix.   Preheat oven to 350°, then cut to 250°.   Put rack on bottom.   Cook until crust is brown.   Move rack up, turn oven to 200° and cook for 1 hour.

name: CHEESE STRAWS
ingredients:
1  c. Bisquick baking mix
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  egg yolk
2  tsp. water
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Blend biscuit mix, grated cheese, shortening, salt and cayenne pepper.  Mix with fork to consistency of coarse crumbs.  Add egg yolk and water to form stiff dough. Knead a few times and roll to 1/4-inch thickness on surface sprinkled with flour.  Cut into strips.  Place on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes.  Yields 19 (6 x 1/2-inch) straws.

name: GREEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can evaporated milk
1 large  pkg. lime jello
1  c. hot water
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. chopped cabbage
1  c. chopped walnuts
1 large  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Open milk and put in large bowl into freezer.  Dissolve jello in hot water.  Add marshmallows and dissolve.  Take off heat and add chopped cabbage, walnuts and pineapple.  Whip evaporated milk until thick, then fold into jello mixture.  Refrigerate.

name: BUFFET POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash brown potatoes
1  pt. sour cream
1/2  c. melted butter
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  can water
8 to 10  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Thaw potatoes for approximately 45 minutes.  Mix other ingredients, then add potatoes.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs.  Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: BONSAINT FAMILY MEATBALLS
ingredients:
6  to 8 hamburger rolls, crumbled
2  or 3 pieces of garlic, cut up small, minced
1  small onion, chopped fine
1/4  c. basil leaves
1/2  c. Romano cheese
salt
pepper
3  eggs or until it holds together
1  lb. hamburger
1 large  bottle spaghetti sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Roll into small balls.  Place on baking pan about 1-inch from each other.  Brown in 350° oven approximately 20 minutes.  Remove from oven and place in crock-pot with spaghetti sauce.  Let simmer in sauce about 1 hour before eating. Makes about 25 meatballs.

name: CELERY SEED DRESSING
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. celery seed *
dash of salt
1/3  c. honey
1/3  c. white vinegar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. grated onion
1  c. salad oil
preparation: *Poppy seed substitutes nicely for celery seed.

name: COUNTY RAISIN RYE BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. whole wheat flour, divided
2  c. rye flour, divided
1  Tbsp. active dry yeast
1  tsp. salt
2  c. water
1/2  c. plus 1 tsp. olive or canola oil, divided
1/2  c. molasses
1/2  c. honey
2  1/2 to 2-3/4 cups all purpose flour
1  c. raisins
preparation: In a mixing bowl, combine 1 cup whole wheat flour, 1 cup rye flour, yeast and salt.  In a saucepan, heat water, 1/2 cup oil, molasses and honey to 120° to 130°.  Add to dry ingredients; stir just until moistened.  Stir in remaining whole wheat and rye flours and enough all purpose flour to form a medium stiff dough.  Turn onto a floured surface; sprinkle with raisins.  Knead until smooth and elastic, about 8 to 10 minutes.  Grease a bowl with remaining oil.  Place dough in bowl, turning once to grease top.  Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 1/2 hours.  Punch dough down, turn onto a lightly floured surface.  Divide into four pieces; shape each into a round loaf.  Place 4 inches apart on two baking sheets coated with nonstick cooking spray.  Cover and let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes.  Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes 4 loaves of bread.

name: OVERNIGHT SALAD
ingredients:
head of lettuce, pulled apart
1/2  large or medium red onion, thinly sliced
1  lb. bacon, cooked and crumbled
head of cauliflower pulled apart (just heads)
2  c. mayo
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Place ingredients in bowl according to order shown.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.

name: FREEZER PICKLES
ingredients:
7  c. unpeeled cucumber, sliced thin
1  c. sliced onions
2  Tbsp. canning salt
2  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar (50%)
1  c. water
1  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Combine cucumbers, onions and salt in a crock or plastic bowl; let stand 4 to 5 hours in icebox.  Drain (do not wash) in a plastic colander (do not use an aluminum colander).  Combine sugar, vinegar, water and celery seed; mix well until sugar is dissolved.  Pour over cucumbers and onions; mix well.  Put in plastic container and freeze.  Lots of luck!!!

name: OATMEAL CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco or margarine, softened
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
3  c. quick cooking oatmeal
nutmeats or pecans (optional)
preparation: Mix Crisco, white sugar, brown sugar and eggs.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Drop by spoonfuls on a lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.

name: EASY-AS-PIE ECLAIR CAKE
ingredients:
2 small  boxes French vanilla pudding (instant)
graham crackers
8  oz. Cool Whip
canned chocolate frosting
preparation: Prepare pudding as directed on box.  When set, add Cool Whip and  beat  with  mixer.  Line  bottom  of  pan with whole crackers; pour 1/2 of pudding over this.  Put another layer of crackers and  the  rest  of  the  pudding.	Put a 3rd layer of crackers  and  refrigerate a few hours before covering the top layer of crackers with chocolate icing.

name: CATFISH PARMESAN
ingredients:
3/4  c. dry bread crumbs
3  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/8  tsp. EACH pepper, dried oregano, and basil
6 fresh or frozen catfish fillets, 3 - 5  oz. each
1/2  c. butter, melted
preparation: In a shallow bowl, combine the bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, parsley and seasonings.  Dip catfish in butter, then in crumb mixture.  Arrange in a greased 9 x 13 inch pan.  Bake uncovered at 375° for 20-25 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Serves 6.

name: APPLE SPICE CUSTARD CAKE
ingredients:
1  (18 oz.) spice cake mix
2  medium apples
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1/4  c. lemon  juice from concentrate
ground cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Prepare cake mix as package directs. Stir in apples.  Pour into well-greased and floured 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake for 30 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted near center comes out clean.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained well
1 (8 oz.)  box Jiffy corn muffin mix
4  eggs
4  oz. sour cream
preparation: Saute together margarine, onions and broccoli.  Mix together the corn muffin mix, eggs and sour cream.  Pour muffin mixture over sauteed ingredients into a cast-iron skillet.  Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
2 (1 lb.)  cans pumpkin
2 small  cartons whipping cream
2 1/4  c. sugar
8  eggs
2  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
dash of salt
preparation: Beat eggs with wire whisk.  Add sugar, salt and pumpkin pie spice.  Combine pumpkin and whipping cream and stir in the egg mixture.  Pour in 2 deep shell pie crusts and bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° until done.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (No. 303)  can whole kernel corn
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. corn bread mix
1  Tbsp. chopped pimiento
1/2  tsp. onion salt
1  Tbsp. parsley
2  eggs
2 or 3  drops Tabasco
6  lean pork chops
preparation: Roll chops  in flour to which salt and pepper have been added. Brown  chops and place in greased casserole dish.  Mix all other ingredients, stir well and pour over chops.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SEAFOOD STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
1 1/2  c. Oriental style vegetables
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  pkg. Crab Delight flakes
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
preparation: Heat oil in skillet.  Add Crab Delight and vegetables.  Stir over medium-high heat for 2 minutes.  Add seasoning.  Cook 1 minute.  Garnish with chow mein noodles.

name: COOKED SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
2 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
1 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. melted margarine
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. celery seed
2  egg yolks
preparation: Combine sugar,  mustard,  salt  and  celery seed.  Beat eggs; add melted margarine  and milk.  Mix well.  Add vinegar; cook slowly over hot water  until  thick.  Use over cabbage to make cole slaw.

name: PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  can (14.5 oz.) diced tomatoes with basil, garlic, and oregano
1  container (10 oz.) refrigerated pizza crust
2  cups (8 oz.) shredded mozzarella cheese, divided
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Coat a 9x13 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  In a medium skillet, brown the ground beef over medium-high heat, stirring and crumbling the beef until no pink remains; drain.  Add the tomatoes to the beef; cook until heated through.  Meanwhile, unroll the pizza crust; press over the bottom and halfway up the side of the baking dish.  Sprinkle 1 cup mozzarella cheese over the crust then top with the meat mixture. Bake uncovered for 12 minutes.  Top with the remaining 1 cup mozzarella cheese and sprinkle with the Parmesan cheese.  Bake for 5 minutes, or until the crust is golden and the cheese is melted. Cut into squares and serve.

name: BUTTERMILK PECANS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  qt. pecan halves
1/4  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil sugar and buttermilk until forms a soft ball.  Add soda, salt and vanilla.  Stir in pecans until coated.  Pour on wax paper and spread pecans out.

name: BRISKET OF BEEF
ingredients:
1  beef brisket (medium size)
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
preparation: Place brisket on sheet of heavy-duty foil, fat side down. Sprinkle soup mix on top of brisket.  Close foil tightly, no leaks.  Set oven at 200°.  Roast for 7 hours.

name: PILGRIM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
5  eggs
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Cream together margarine, Crisco, sugar and salt very well. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour, milk and flavoring; beat well. Grease and flour TUBE pan. Pour mixture in pan; place in COLD oven and set temperature at 300°. Bake for 2 hours.

name: CLASSIC FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
4  c. thinly sliced sweet onions
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
1/4  c. margarine or butter
5 1/2  c. water
1/3  c. dry sherry or white wine or water
8  tsp. Wyler's beef flavor instant bouillon or 8 beef flavor bouillon cubes
6 (3/4-inch thick)  slices French bread, buttered and toasted
6 (8 x 4-inch)  slices Swiss cheese, cut in half crosswise
preparation: In large saucepan  cook  onions and garlic in margarine until golden brown.  Add  water, sherry and bouillon; bring to a boil. Reduce heat;  cover  and  simmer  30 minutes to blend flavors. Place soup in  6  ovenproof  soup  bowls.  Top  each serving with a bread  slice  and  cheese.  Broil  until cheese melts.  Serve immediately.  Refrigerate any leftovers.  Makes 6 servings.

name: POTATO POTLUCK CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. melted oleo
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  pt. dairy sour cream
2  c. grated sharp cheese
2  lb. pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1  tsp. salt and 1/2 tsp. pepper
another 1/4 c. melted oleo
2  c. crushed corn flakes (or may use buttered bread crumbs)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together through the grated sharp cheese. Add potatoes and fold into first ingredients.  Put in a 3-quart greased casserole.  Mix oleo and corn flakes; put over top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CARROT SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. orange jello
3  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1 small  carton Cool Whip
3/4  c. grated carrots
1  c. hot water
1 small  can crushed pineapple, save juice
preparation: Cream together cream cheese and jello.  Add hot water.  Stir until dissolved.  Add juice from pineapple and let gel slightly. Add crushed pineapple, carrots and Cool Whip.  Pour into a mold and chill until firm.

name: BERRY DELICIOUS BREAD
ingredients:
10  oz. frozen strawberries, thawed
3/4  c. sugar
2/3  c. oil
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour pan (bread pan).  In large bowl, add strawberries, sugar, oil and eggs.  Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes.  Add remaining dry ingredients.  Mix and pour into pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Frost with powdered sugar glaze.

name: ROYAL SEAFOOD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 1/2 oz.)  cans of cream of shrimp soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  small onion, grated
3/4  c. milk
salt
white pepper to taste
ground nutmeg to taste
seasoned salt to taste
cayenne pepper to taste
1 1/3  c. white long grain rice, cooked until dry and fluffy
3  lb. shrimp, cooked and cleaned
1  (7 1/2 oz.) crabmeat, drained
1 (5 oz.)  can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
1 1/2  c. diced celery
3  Tbsp. fresh parsley
preparation: Blend soup and mayonnaise in a large bowl; add onion, then milk.  Add seasonings to taste.  Add the remaining ingredients. Turn into a large, shallow buttered casserole.  Sprinkle with paprika and scatter slivered almonds generously over top.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.  Freezes well.  Serves 10.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
1  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1 -10  oz. pkg. frozen chopped spinach (uncooked), thawed and liquid squeezed out
1 -8  oz. can water chestnuts, chopped coarsely
preparation: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight.

name: HELLO DOLLY SQUARES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can coconut
1  c. chopped nuts (I prefer pecans)
preparation: In a 13 x 9-inch pan, melt butter, then remove from heat. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over butter.  Pour Eagle Brand milk evenly over crumbs.  Then sprinkle chocolate chips, coconut and nuts.  Press down gently.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Cool and cut into squares.

name: PUMPKIN SOUP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or substitute
1  onion
1/2  stalk celery
2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. pumpkin puree, canned, fresh or frozen
2  c. chicken stock
2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. marjoram
1/4  tsp. freshly ground pepper
preparation: Melt butter in heavy kettle.  Cut onion and celery in chunks; chop finely in food processor.  Saute onion and celery until clear. Add flour.  Stir and cook over low heat 3 minutes.  Add pumpkin puree.  Mix thoroughly while heating 5 minutes.  Return to food processor.  Process until smooth.  Return to kettle; add stock. Heat to boiling, then simmer.  Five minutes before serving add milk and spices.  Continue heating but do not boil.  Serve with croutons.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stewed chicken, boned
1  dozen corn tortillas
7 to 11  oz. diced green chilies
4  Tbsp. minced onion
1  can cream of chicken soup (not diluted)
sliced black olives
3  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
3  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix chicken mixture.  If too dry, add chicken broth.

name: CHOCOLATE BANANA CREAM PIE(Diabetic)
ingredients:
1  chocolate graham cracker pie crust
2  c. sliced bananas, 2 medium bananas
1  pkg. (4 serving) sugar free chocolate instant pudding
2/3  c. non fat dry milk powder
1 1/3  c. water
1  c. low fat whipped topping
1 1/2  tsp. coconut extract, optional
2  Tbsp. flaked coconut, optional
preparation: Cut up bananas into pie crust.  Mix pudding, milk powder, water, 1/4 of the whipped topping and 3/4 teaspoon of coconut extract together.  Should be runny.  Pour over bananas.

name: CHEESE NIBBLES
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. margarine
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. caraway seed
coarse "pretzel" salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Blend cheese and margarine with mixer until creamy.  Stir in flour and baking powder, kneading until a stiff dough forms.  Knead in caraway seed.   Roll dough into large marble sized balls.  Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and flatten slightly with a fork.  Sprinkle with salt.  Bake about 15 minutes until pale golden.  Serve hot or at room temperature. Makes 40.  Store airtight or freeze unbaked, thawing to bake as directed.

name: HERSHEY BAR CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. all purpose flour
2  sticks butter or Parkay
1  c. buttermilk
1 large  can Hershey syrup (16 oz.)
3/4  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
8  small Hershey bars
2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt Hershey bars in top of double boiler.  Cream butter and sugar, add Hershey bars, Hershey syrup and eggs, beat well.  Mix well, all dry ingredients add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk, beating well, add vanilla and 1 cup nuts if desired. Pour into 2 (9 x 13-inch) pans, greased lightly and bake 30 minutes or until inserted wooden toothpick comes out clean, at 350°.  You can bake this in tube pan, bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  dash salt
1  stick margarine
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. Cool Whip
1  c. powdered sugar
2  regular size instant chocolate pudding mixes
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix the first 4 ingredients.  Spread in baking dish and bake 20 minutes at 350°.  Beat cream cheese with Cool Whip and powdered sugar.  Beat until fluffy and spread on cool crust.  Mix pudding with milk 3 minutes on low speed.  Spread on top of cheese mixture.  Cover with Cool Whip and sprinkle with chopped nuts. Refrigerate or freeze about 45 minutes before serving.

name: BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli
1  c. water
2  c. processed cheese
1/2  c. flour
2  chicken bouillon cubes
1  c. half-and-half
preparation: Cook broccoli in water.  Blend cheese, flour and bouillon cubes.  Add to broccoli.  Heat and add half-and-half.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
2  qt. apple juice
1 large  can pineapple juice
2 small  cans frozen limeade
2  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Mix all together.  Makes about 30 punch cups.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  stick butter
3  cans white corn
1  can chopped chilies (I use mild)
preparation: Melt butter and cream cheese together.  Mix together butter, cream cheese, corn (drained) and chilies.  Put in a casserole dish and heat until bubbly.

name: MUSHROOM AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked rice
mushrooms
1  stick butter
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
garlic salt
1  c. water
preparation: Mix ingredients and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cook at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CINNAMON ORNAMENTS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cinnamon
1  c. applesauce
preparation: Mix ingredients and spread on waxed paper.  Cut with cookie cutters.  Put a small hole at the top of each shape, using a small straw.  Allow ornaments to set until dry.  After set, put a ribbon through the ornament.

name: SILK FROSTING RECIPE
ingredients:
8  Tbsp. butter/margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. confectioners sugar
1  egg white, beaten
3  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Mix ingredients together until texture preferred.

name: HUNGARIAN GOULASH WITH NOODLES
ingredients:
1  lb. beef, cut into cubes
2  medium onions, minced
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1 1/4  tsp. paprika
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 1/4  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3/4  tsp. cider vinegar
6  Tbsp. ketchup
1 1/2  c. water
3  Tbsp. flour
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. noodles
preparation: Brown meat on all sides in heavy frypan or Dutch oven.  Add onions.  Combine mustard, paprika, brown sugar and salt.  Combine Worcestershire sauce, vinegar and ketchup and add to mustard mixture.  Add to meat.  Add 1 cup of the water; stir.  Cover. Cook over low heat 2 1/2 hours or until meat is very tender. Blend flour with remaining 1/2 cup of water; add to meat mixture. Stir until thickened.  Boil noodles in salted water until tender. Drain.  Serve mixture over noodles.  Serves 8.

name: TOASTED COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
3  beaten eggs
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine, melted
4  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/3  c. coconut
1  deep dish pie shell (unbaked)
preparation: Combine eggs, sugar, margarine, lemon juice and vanilla.  Stir in coconut.  Pour filling into unbaked pastry shell.  Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.  Cool before serving.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
10  oz. pkg. frozen spinach, chopped
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
8  oz. can water chestnuts, chopped
3  green onions, chopped
preparation: Thaw spinach and squeeze dry.  Combine soup mix, sour cream and mayonnaise.  Stir in spinach, water chestnuts and green onions.  Cover and chill for two hours.  Stir before serving. Serve with crackers.

name: HEAVENLY HAMBURGER
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. shortening
1  lb. ground beef
onion salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. fine dry noodles
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  lb. sliced American cheese
1 small  c. sliced ripe olives
1 (No. 2)  can stewed tomatoes
1/4  c. water
preparation: Melt shortening and brown meat slightly in skillet.  Season with onion salt, salt and pepper.  Add remaining ingredients, in layers, in order given.  Rinse tomato can with water and pour over ingredients.  Cover.

name: APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  pie crust (deep dish)
3  or 4 apples, sliced
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  stick oleo
3/4  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Slice apples in crust; sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon over apples.  Work together oleo, flour and 1/2 cup sugar. Sprinkle over apples.  Bake for 1 hour at 300°.

name: ENGLISH MUFFIN CRAB TRIANGLE
ingredients:
English muffins
3/4  stick margarine
1  can crab, rinsed and drained
1  jar Old English cheese
1/2  tsp. seasoning salt
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
preparation: Split English muffins.  Mix all remaining ingredients together and spread on halved English muffins.  Cut each half into quarters.  Heat under broiler until bubbly and brown, about 5 minutes.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. German chocolate cake mix
1/2  stick margarine, softened
1 1/2  c. water
1/2  c. oil
1  c. sweetened condensed milk
1  pkg. caramels (14 or 16 oz.)
1  can pecans
preparation: Combine chocolate cake, butter, water, oil and 1/2 of condensed milk in mixing bowl.  Mix well.  Pour 1/2 of batter into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch dish.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: *PINK PUNCH*
ingredients:
1  doz. lemons
1 large  can pineapple juice
2  pkg. cherry Jell-O
1 large  can orange juice
2  qt. ginger ale
1/2  gal. water
2 or 3  c. sugar
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups of boiling water, then add other ingredients.

name: FRENCH TOAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. (1 stick) butter (or margarine)
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1-1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  loaf unsliced French bread (ends removed)
Powdered sugar
Warm pancake syrup
6  large eggs
preparation: Melt butter in small saucepan.  Add brown sugar and cook until syrupy (don't worry if the brown sugar does not completely blend with the butter).  Pour mixture into a 9x13-inch pan.  Slice bread into 12 slices, about 1-inch thick, and place over sugar/butter mixture, completely lining the bottom of pan with slices.  Beat eggs, milk and vanilla and pour over bread slices.  Cover dish and refrigerate overnight.  Uncover and bake in preheated 350-degree oven for 45 minutes.  Sift powdered sugar over top when ready to serve.  Pass the warmed syrup.  OR skip the syrup and use your favorite "Simply Fruit" and sprinkle only a tiny bit of powdered sugar.

name: BEEF BURGUNDY
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak
1 (3 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms
1  Tbsp. flour
1  envelope dry onion soup mix
1 3/4  c. water
1/2  c. dry red wine
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cut steaks into 1-inch cubes.  Brown meat slowly in skillet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Transfer to 1 1/2-quart casserole, which has a tight fitting cover.  Add remaining ingredients.  Stir well.  Cover and bake for 1 1/2 hours.  Remove cover and bake an additional 15 minutes. Serve over rice or egg noodles.

name: BEEF RICE PILAF
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1  c. brown rice (uncooked)
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  beef bouillon cube
2  c. water
preparation: Saute onion in butter.  Add rice, cinnamon and bouillon cube. Add water.  Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes.  If desired, use chicken bouillon instead of beef and do not use cinnamon.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. washed rice
1/2  stick oleo
1  fryer
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. onion soup
1  c. water
preparation: Put rice in bottom of casserole dish.  Chip up oleo over rice. Season the fryer.  Cut up fryer and lay over rice.  Mix soups and water; pour over rice and chicken.  Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: GREEN TOMATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  green tomatoes, sliced
1  c. chopped green onions
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
lemon pepper
3/4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  roll buttery round crackers, crushed
1/2  stick margarine or butter
preparation: Place sliced tomatoes in a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cover with green onions. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and garlic powder. Sprinkle generously with lemon pepper.  Top with grated cheese and crushed crackers. Dot with margarine.  Bake, covered, at 400° for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 10 minutes.

name: PEA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can sweet peas, drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can pimento
1 large  can chicken
1  can sliced water chestnuts
3/4  stick margarine, melted
2  c. Pepperidge Farm mix (herb)
1  c. sharp cheese
preparation: Mix together first 5 ingredients.  Top with mixture of remaining ingredients.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. milk
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. biscuit mix
4  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine in electric blender.  Cover and blend 3 minutes on low speed.  Pour into 9-inch pie pan.  Bake at 350° for forty minutes. Can add coconut or 4 tablespoons cocoa, 1/4 cup sugar and a little margarine.

name: STRAWBERRY CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) crust
8  oz. cream cheese
14  oz. Eagle Brand milk
1/3  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
1  qt. fresh strawberries
1  pkg. strawberry glaze
preparation: Beat cheese until fluffy and gradually beat in Eagle Brand milk until smooth.  Stir in lemon juice and vanilla.  Pour into crust and chill 3 hours.  Top with strawberries and glaze. Refrigerate.

name: GERMAN SWEET CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. Baker's German's sweet chocolate
1/3  c. milk
2  Tbsp. sugar (optional)
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
3 1/2  c. (8 oz.) thawed Cool Whip
graham cracker pie crust
preparation: Heat chocolate and 2 tablespoons of the milk in saucepan over low heat, stirring until chocolate is melted.  Beat sugar into cream cheese.  Add remaining milk and chocolate mixture; beat until smooth.  Fold in whipped topping, blending until smooth. Spoon into crust.  Freeze until firm, about 4 hours.  Remove from freezer 30 minutes before serving; keep chilled in refrigerator. Garnish with chocolate curls, if desired.  Store leftover pie in freezer.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  sq. chocolate or 6 Tbsp. cocoa plus 2 Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. light corn syrup
2/3  c. milk
1/8  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, chocolate, corn syrup, milk and salt in a saucepan.  Cook on low heat until sugar dissolves.  Cook on medium heat until mixture reaches soft ball stage.  Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla.  Cool until mixture is lukewarm.  Beat with a wooden spoon until it loses its gloss.  Pour onto buttered pan.  Let it set until firm.

name: DROP SAND TARTS
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, melted
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. flour
preparation: Mix and cool 20 minutes before baking.  Drop on greased pan. Decorate and bake at 325° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  heads fresh broccoli, chopped
1/2  lb. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  lb. bacon, fried and crumbled
1  can water chestnuts, chopped
1 to 2  c. chopped pecans, equal to broccoli
preparation: Toss all ingredients together and combine with dressing and chill.

name: COCONUT CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. shredded coconut
3  egg yolks
1  c. evaporated milk
1  c. water
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Mix thoroughly in a saucepan the sugar, cornstarch, salt, shredded coconut and egg yolks.  Stir in gradually until smooth a mixture of evaporated milk and water.  Cook and stir over low heat until thickened, about 10 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in vanilla.  Cover and cool thoroughly.  Put in 9-inch baked pastry shell.  Spread with meringue.  Sprinkle with 1/2 cup coconut. Bake 7 to 8 minutes at 400°.  Cool completely before cutting with wet knife.

name: SWEET AND SOUR BEEF BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
3  Tbsp. diced green onions
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 (8 oz.)  can pineapple wedges
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. water
2  green peppers, cut in thin strips
preparation: Mix together the beef, egg, salt, pepper, green onions and 1 tablespoon of cornstarch.  Shape into marble size balls.  Drain pineapple, reserving the juice.  Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in skillet and brown meat balls on all sides.  Remove.  Add remaining cornstarch, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, water and pineapple juice. Add to skillet, stirring steadily until thickened.  Add pineapple, green peppers and meat balls.  Bring to a boil and cook 3 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  box spaghetti noodles
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can Ro-Tel, diced
1/2  box Velveeta cheese
4  boneless skinless chicken breasts
1  c. finely chopped mild Cheddar cheese
1  c. chicken broth
preparation: Boil chicken.  Season with salt, pepper and garlic powder. Cook spaghetti and drain.  Cut Velveeta cheese into chunks.  Stir into spaghetti.  Drain can of Ro-Tel.  Put with spaghetti mixture and add cream of mushroom soup.  Cut chicken breasts into pieces and add to other mixture.  Place in a casserole dish and top with cup of finely chopped mild Cheddar cheese.  Bake at 350° until cheese melts.

name: EASY PEACH PIE
ingredients:
1 (29 oz.)  can sliced peaches or any fruit (do not drain)
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. white sugar
1  c. sweet milk
1  egg (whole)
1  stick margarine
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Melt margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan in oven.  Combine flour, sugar, milk and egg in bowl.  Pour mixture into the pan with melted margarine.  Now spoon peaches (or fruit) over the top of mixture and put in oven.   Bake for approximately 40 minutes.

name: LOG CABIN TOAST
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  slices white or whole wheat bread
soft margarine or butter
preparation: Mix sugar and cinnamon in custard cup.  Toast bread.  Spread with soft margarine.  Sprinkle with sugar-cinnamon mixture.  Cut each slice of toast into 4 strips.  Put them together on plate like stacked logs to make the wall of a log cabin.  Start from the top and eat all the logs.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  stick melted butter
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. pecans
3  or 4 mashed bananas
preparation: Combine all ingredients and pour into well-greased and floured loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done.

name: LATIN COLESLAW
ingredients:
1  bag slaw mix
1  c. whole kernel corn
2/3  c. chopped bell pepper
1/3  c. chopped red onion
2  Tbsp. diced pimento
1/2  c. oil
1/3  c. red wine vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients.  Mix remaining ingredients for dressing. Toss all and chill.

name: NUT CAKE
ingredients:
6  eggs
3  c. mixed nuts, chopped
2  sticks margarine
3  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: S'MORES
ingredients:
1  pkg. graham crackers
1  pkg. marshmallows
1  king size Hershey bar
preparation: Place marshmallows and chocolate on top of graham cracker. Place another graham cracker on top if needed.

name: ANGEL AUNTIE'S ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. self-rising flour, unsifted
2  c. buttermilk
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. salad oil
1  pkg. active dry yeast, dissolved in 1/4 c. warm water
preparation: Preheat over 400°. Add yeast-water mixture to all other ingredients in a large bowl.  Stir until mixed well.  Add more flour if needed and knead on floured surface.  Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter.  Place on greased pan.  Use what you want and place unused dough in covered container; put in refrigerator. Keeps several days.  Biscuits are best when allowed to rise 30 minutes before baking.  Bake 400° oven for 7 to 10 minutes.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: CORN BREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
corn bread mix
giblets
green onions
3  to 4 raw eggs
1  pt. milk
preparation: Make corn bread the day before.  Put all your giblets in to boil with green onions.  While boiling and it gets tender, put bread in a pan you can bake in.  Pour all in one place, then put more green onions and 3 or 4 raw eggs.  Stir good.  Put in the milk and stir.  Bake long enough for eggs to cook, then serve.

name: LEMON BREAD
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. Crisco
2  Tbsp. grated lemon peel
1 1/2  C. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  C. chopped nuts
1  C. sugar
2  eggs beaten
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  C. milk
preparation: Cream Crisco and sugar.  Add eggs and lemon peel.  Sift dry ingredients and alternately add with milk.  Fold in nuts.  Bake until lightly brown on top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Cool 15 minutes.

name: ORANGE GLAZED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. finely shredded orange peel
1/2  tsp. grated ginger root
pinch of ground red pepper
1/2  c. orange juice
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
4  pork loin chops, cut 3/4 inch thick
1  tsp. cornstarch
preparation: For Glaze:  In a small pan, stir together the sugar, cornstarch, orange peel, ginger root and red pepper.  Stir in orange juice and soy sauce.  Cook and stir until thickened.  Cook and stir 2 minutes more.  Trim any separable fat from the chops. Place chops on the unheated rack of a broiler pan.  Broil 3 to 4 inches from the heat for 20 to 25 minutes.  Turn once.  Brush chops with the glaze frequently.  Use rest of glaze at serving.

name: REFRIGERATOR ALL-BRAN ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. Kellogg's All-Bran
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  c. boiling water
2  cakes yeast
1  c. lukewarm water
2  eggs
6 1/2 to 7  c. flour
preparation: Pour  boiling  water  over  shortening, bran, sugar and salt. Stir  until  shortening  is dissolved.  In the lukewarm water crumble  the  2 cakes of yeast.  Beat eggs and add yeast mixture. Add  this to the first mixture.  Add flour until the dough is just beyond the sticky or glazed look.  Cover tightly and store  in refrigerator  until 3 hours before using.  Work out into  rolls and  let  rise where the temperature is 75 to 80°.  Bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Makes 5 dozen rolls. If you  don't  need it  all at once, the remaining dough will keep in the refrigerator, tightly covered, for several days.

name: TRY THIS PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vinegar (white)
6  Tbsp. water
1  egg
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. lard or 1 1/2 c. shortening
preparation: Mix vinegar, water and egg together.  Cut lard or shortening into flour.  Mix together.

name: GRITS SOUFFLE
ingredients:
1  c. grits, cooked according to directions on box
1/2  stick margarine
1  roll garlic cheese
2  eggs
preparation: Slice cheese. Mix margarine and cheese with cooked grits. Beat eggs in measuring cup; finish filling cup with milk.  Mix with grits, butter and cheese.  Bake in a 350° oven in covered casserole dish until a little brown and mixture thickens.

name: WILLIAMSBURG CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
3  oz. salt pork, cubed
1  large onion, chopped
1  rib celery, chopped
1 1/2  c. potatoes, diced
2  c. canned chicken broth
2  c. cream-style corn
2  c. milk
1/4  c. butter
salt and white pepper to taste
preparation: Fry the salt pork until brown.  Add the onion and saute over medium heat 5 minutes, stirring often.  Add the celery, potatoes, chicken broth and 1 cup of water and simmer until the potatoes are done.  Add the corn and simmer 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Heat the milk and butter and add to the soup.  Add salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.  Serves 6.

name: GREEN PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. beef, fat trimmed (chuck or round)
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  clove garlic
1 1/2  tsp. grated fresh ginger or 1/2 tsp. ground
1  c. salad oil
1  c. green onion, thinly sliced
1  c. red or green peppers, cut into 1-inch sq.
2  stalks celery, thinly sliced
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. water
2  tomatoes, cut into wedges
preparation: With sharp knife, cut beef across grain into thin strips, 1/8-inch thick.  Combine soy sauce, garlic and ginger.  Add beef; toss and set aside while preparing vegetables.  Heat oil in a large frying pan or wok.  Add beef and toss over high heat until browned. Taste meat.  If it is not tender, cover and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes over low heat.  Turn heat up and add vegetables.  Toss until vegetables are tender-crisp, 10 minutes.  Mix cornstarch with water.  Add to pan and stir and cook until thickened, 30 to 40 minutes.  Add tomatoes and heat through.  Makes 4 servings.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can apricot or peach pie filling
1  can peaches
1  can mandarin oranges
1  can chunk pineapple
1  box strawberries
2  sliced bananas
preparation: Mix and chill.

name: LOW-FAT BANANA PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1  Pillsbury Lovin' Lites yellow cake mix
1  c. sugar
1 (15 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  pkg. Dream Whip, prepared as directed
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix (regular or sugar-free)
3  bananas
3  Egg Beaters
preparation: Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with nonfat cooking spray.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Prepare cake using Egg Beaters.  Pour in pan and bake until done.  While cake is baking, mix sugar and pineapple in saucepan.  Boil for 5 minutes.  Remove cake from oven.  Prick the top of cake with fork.  Pour the pineapple mixture over the top of the cake.  Cool completely.

name: DISHPAN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
2  c. white sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. Crisco oil
4  c. self-rising flour
4  c. corn flakes
1 1/2  c. quick oatmeal
1  c. coconut
2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients; add this to rest of ingredients that have been placed in large pan. Combine all together (you can divide the cookie mixture evenly and add chocolate chips or peanut butter chips, raisins, etc.). Drop on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes. Place on racks and cool. Since this makes such a large recipe, this can be divided.

name: COKE ROAST
ingredients:
beef roast (4 to 5 lb., boneless)
small bottle Coke
14  oz. chili sauce
salt and pepper to taste
4  cloves garlic
1  Tbsp. celery flakes
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. Tabasco sauce
preparation: Score roast.  Fill each slot with salt, pepper, garlic and celery flakes (you may sear your roast first.)  Place in a foil lined pan.  Combine Coke, Worcestershire sauce, Tabasco sauce and chili sauce and pour over meat.  Cover loosely with foil and bake at 325° for 3 hours.

name: BLACK FOREST CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. devil's food cake mix
1  can cherry pie filling
1  pt. heavy cream, well chilled
1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. grated orange rind
3  Tbsp. chocolate shavings
preparation: Prepare devil's food cake mix as directed. Bake batter in 2 greased and floured 9-inch pans. Cool on rack.  Place one cooled layer on a serving plate. Spread  1/2 can of cherries on cake layer. Top with second layer. Combine cream, sugar, vanilla and orange rind. Whip until cream is thick and holds its shape. Spread whipped cream on sides and top of cake.  Spread 1/2 can of cherries on top of whipped cream. Sprinkle with chocolate shavings. Chill before serving.

name: MARLA'S BANANA NUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. vegetable shortening
2 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs, separated
6  Tbsp. buttermilk
3  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. mashed ripe bananas
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with egg yolks and buttermilk.  Add vanilla, mashed bananas and nuts.  Fold in beaten egg whites.  Bake in large greased and floured tube pan at 325° for about 1 1/2 hours.

name: DILL PICKLES
ingredients:
cucumbers
garlic buds
dill seed
salt
white vinegar
water
preparation: Sterilize jars and lids.  Wash cucumbers and slice lengthwise or leave whole if small enough.  To each quart jar, add 1 teaspoon dill seed and 1 garlic bud.  Pack cucumbers in jars.  Bring 2 quarts water, 1 quart vinegar and 1/2 cup salt to a boil.  Slowly pour boiling liquid into jars, leaving 1/2-inch headspace.  Wipe jar rims clean and adjust lids.  Process in a boiling water bath for 20 minutes.  These pickles will be ready to eat in about 7 to 10 days.

name: CHOCOLATE CHERRY DROPS
ingredients:
1  pkg. cherry supreme cake mix
1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. cooking oil
1/4  c. water
1  egg
1  c. (6 oz. pkg.) chocolate chips
preparation: Preheat  oven to 350°.  Blend ingredients well.  Stir in chocolate chips.  Drop from a teaspoon onto an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake  at  350°  for  10  to  12  minutes until edges of cookies  just  begin  to  brown.  Cool  on cookie sheet about 1 minute.  Remove to rack or plate to finish cooling.

name: DEER STEAK AND GRAVY
ingredients:
6  medium venison steaks (1/2-inch thick)
3  large onions
6  cloves garlic
4  beef bouillon cubes
1  qt. water
2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. onion salt
1  Tbsp. garlic salt
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. cooking oil
preparation: Tenderize meat.   Add salt and pepper and roll in flour. Brown on both sides.   Put water, onion, salt, garlic cloves, garlic salt and bouillon cubes in Dutch oven.  Drop in meat. Simmer for 45 minutes or until gravy is thick and creamy.

name: MOLDED SALMON APPETIZER
ingredients:
1 (7 3/4 oz.)  can salmon, drained and flaked
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
2  envelopes unflavored gelatin
1/4  c. water
1/2  c. celery, finely chopped
1/2  c. green onions, finely chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. curry powder
preparation: Combine cream cheese and soup (undiluted) in double boiler. Heat and stir until smooth.  Dissolve gelatin in water according to package directions, then add soup mixture.  Fold in remaining ingredients.  Blend well.  Pour into 5-cup mold.  Refrigerate until firm.  Serve with fresh vegetables and crackers.

name: LEMON CHEESE SQUARES
ingredients:
1 1/2  sticks butter
1 1/2  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
12  oz. cream cheese
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
2  pkg. instant lemon pudding
3  c. cold milk
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients together.  Spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes, until light brown.  Mix next 3 ingredients together and spread on cooled crust.  Mix last two ingredients as directed on pudding box. Spread on cream cheese mixture.  Top with Cool Whip and refrigerate.

name: MOCK DATE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. grated apples
2  c. grated carrots
1 1/4  c. grated potatoes
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
4  c. flour
1  c. chopped dates
2  c. raisins
1/2  tsp. each:  nutmeg, allspice, cinnamon and ginger
1  Tbsp. soda
1/2  c. margarine, softened
preparation: Mix together in order given.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  This cake may be cooled, then cut in cubes and layered in a bowl with whipped cream and bananas.

name: MINESTRONE
ingredients:
16  oz. can cannellini (white kidney beans)
16  oz. can red kidney beans
16  oz. seasoned for pasta tomatoes
4  c. chicken broth
1  box frozen chopped spinach
1/2  c. orzo (rice shaped pasta)
preparation: Mix beans and tomatoes in a large pot.  Add broth, spinach and orzo.  Bring to a boil, stirring to break up spinach.  Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until orzo is tender.  Makes 10 cups.

name: CHEESE-EGGPLANT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant
1  egg, beaten
1  c. canned tomatoes
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  c. dry bread crumbs
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Peel eggplant; cut into 1-inch cubes.  Cook in boiling salted water for 5 minutes; drain.  Add cheese; mix gently until cheese melts.  Add butter; mix, then add rest of ingredients.  Place in a greased baking dish.  Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: SOUR CREAM DIP
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
preparation: Mix together and let set overnight in the refrigerator.

name: CHOCOLATE TORTE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
1  stick margarine
1 large or 2 small  boxes chocolate pudding
2 1/2  c. milk
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
preparation: Mix together the flour, nuts and margarine and spread in a 9 x 9-inch baking dish.  Bake 25 minutes at 325°.  Let cool.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash brown potatoes
1/2  c. melted butter
1  tsp. salt and pepper
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  pt. sour cream
1  can undiluted cream of chicken soup
preparation: Mix and put in greased casserole.  Top with crushed corn flakes mixed with melted butter.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  bunch broccoli, cut up
1  large cauliflower, cut up
1  pkg. frozen peas, thawed and drained
1  c. celery, sliced
2  bunches green onions, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
2  pkg. Ranch dressing mix
preparation: In large bowl, mix together all veggies.  In small bowl, blend sour cream, mayonnaise and Ranch dressing together.  Pour over vegetable mixture.  Refrigerate several hours or overnight before serving.

name: OATMEAL FRUIT CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
3/4  c. uncooked oatmeal
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. melted butter
1  tsp. cinnamon
fruit pie filling
preparation: Place fruit pie filling in bottom of 9-inch square pan. Mix other  ingredients together.  Pour this crumbly mixture on top.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  chicken
celery
pecans
1  bouillon cube
mayonnaise
preparation: Boil chicken in as little water as possible with bouillon cube. Chop celery and pecans to your taste and add 1/2 c. broth from chicken. After chicken is cooked dice it and add the celery and pecans. Add Hellmann mayonnaise to taste. Boiled eggs can also be added.

name: NO BAKE CHOCOLATE HAYSTACKS
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. instant oats
1  c. flaked coconut
1/2  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
2  c. sugar
1/3  c. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. margarine
preparation: In large bowl, combine first 4 ingredients; set aside.  In saucepan, combine last 4 ingredients, stir constantly until it comes to a boil.  Pour hot mixture over oat mixture.  Drop in small clumps onto waxed paper.  Let cool and store.

name: SIMPLE CHICKEN ITALIANO
ingredients:
3/4  lb. thin strips chicken breast
3/4  c. reduced calorie Italian dressing
16  oz. pkg.  Green Giant American Mixtures California style frozen vegetables
1  pkg. hot cooked pasta
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In large skillet, combine chicken and about 1/3 of the Italian dressing. Saute until chicken starts to brown. Add vegetables and remaining dressing. Cover; simmer 7 to 9 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender, stirring frequently. Serve over pasta; sprinkle with cheese. Makes 5 servings.

name: WIENER-SAUERKRAUT DISH
ingredients:
1  can sliced Linkettes
1  can mushroom soup or celery soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  c. sauerkraut
4  c. cubed, boiled, peeled potatoes
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Put cut Linkettes on bottom of a buttered dish.  Put sauerkraut on top.  Place potatoes on top of sauerkraut.  Mix soup, mayonnaise and margarine and pour over the potatoes. Sprinkle paprika on top, if desired.

name: POTATO CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  c. coarsely crushed potato chips
1  tsp. vanilla
2/3  c. sifted powdered sugar
preparation: Cream butter and sugar, beating until light and fluffy.  Add flour, potato chips and vanilla; beat well.  Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes, or until edges are lightly browned.  Cool 5 minutes on cookie sheet; remove to wire racks.

name: NO CRUST CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2/3  c. sugar
dash of salt
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  (9-inch) pie pan
preparation: Beat cream cheese.  Gradually add sugar and salt.  Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each egg.  Add vanilla.  Bak at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SCRIPTURE CAKE
ingredients:
Judges 5:25 (1/2 c. butter or margarine)
1 Kings 10:10 (3/4  tsp. ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp. each ground cloves, allspice and nutmeg)
Jeremiah 6:20 (1 c. sugar)
Isaiah 10:14 (3 eggs), separated
Judges 4:19 (1/3 c. milk)
Exodus 16:31 (1 Tbsp. honey)
Genesis 43:11 (1/2 c. chopped blanched almonds)
1  Kings 4:22 (2 c. sifted all-purpose flour)
1 Samuel 30:12 (1/2  c. dried figs, 1/2 c. chopped seedless raisins)
Leviticus 2:13 (1/2 tsp. salt)
1  Corinthians 5:6 (2 tsp. baking soda)
preparation: Cream butter and add sugar gradually. Beat until light. Separate egg whites from yolks. Add yolks, one at a time, beating thoroughly after each addition (see below for use of egg whites). Beat in honey.  Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk. Beat only until smooth. Stir in nuts and fruits.

name: CITRUS TAPIOCA(Fat:  1 Gram)
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. instant tapioca
2  c. orange-pineapple juice
1 1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. canned mandarin orange sections, packed in water, drained
1  c. canned pineapple in its own juice (crushed or tidbits), drained
preparation: Combine the instant tapioca and orange-pineapple juice in a saucepan.  Cook and stir over medium heat until the mixture comes to a boil.  Remove from heat.  Add lemon juice.  Cool; stir occasionally.  Add fruit and chill until firm.

name: RICE-NUT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cooked brown rice
1/2  c. wheat germ
3/4  c. chopped walnuts
1  large onion
2  c. Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
pepper
4  eggs, beaten
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients; pack into an oiled 9-inch loaf pan.  Bake for about 50 minutes, until firm. Let cool in pan for 10 minutes.  Unmold and slice.  Serves 6.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
2  cans (small) New Orleans shrimp
1 large and 1 small  pkg. cream cheese
1  medium onion, grated
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
dash of Worcestershire sauce
garlic salt
Tabasco sauce
preparation: Let cream cheese soften at room temperature.  Drain shrimp and smash with fork.  Add softened cream cheese.  Add all other ingredients.  You can either put this in a bowl or round into a ball and chill.  Enjoy!

name: HAWAIIAN CAKE MIX
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1 (5 1/2 oz.)  box instant vanilla pudding
1  c. cold milk
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip
2 (20 oz.)  cans crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. coconut
1  c. maraschino cherries
preparation: Bake cake mix in 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan, using egg yolks, at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Cool.  Blend pudding mix with milk. Beat in cream cheese.  Fold in whipped topping.  Spread mixture on cooled cake.  Spread pineapple over pudding mixture.  Sprinkle with nuts, coconut and cherries.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: CHILI MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
2 large  cans chili with beans
1  pkg. corn tortillas
grated cheese
1 large  can tomato sauce
preparation: Start with butter tortillas.  Cover with meat, beans and chili mixture.  Layer with cheese.  Repeat layer again.  After layers are done, pour tomato sauce on top and sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 350° for at least 1 hour.

name: FRESH TOMATO RELISH
ingredients:
2  lb. tomatoes, chopped
2  medium bell peppers, chopped
2  medium onions, peeled
salt to taste (or use no salt)
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. celery seed
salad oil to taste
preparation: Mix ingredients together several hours before serving. Refrigerate.  Makes 1 quart relish.

name: RHUBARB BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
2/3  c. oil
1  c. sour milk
1  tsp. soda in milk
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. rhubarb, finely chopped
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix ingredients together, adding rhubarb and nuts last.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: BLACK MAGIC CAKE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. cocoa
2  tsp. soda
1  c. sour milk*
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. coffee**
1/2  c. Crisco oil
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
preparation: Combine dry ingredients.  Add eggs, coffee, milk, oil and vanilla; beat for 2 minutes.  Bake in greased and floured pan at 350°.  Bake a 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 to 40 minutes.  Bake 9-inch layers for 30 to 35 minutes, or until toothpick comes out of center clean.

name: MARBLED PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
6  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. butter
1  can evaporated milk
1  jar Marshmallow Creme
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. semi-sweet real chocolate chips
1  c. peanut butter
preparation: Mix sugar, butter and milk in a heavy 4-quart saucepan.  Bring to a full boil.  Stir constantly.  Continue boiling 5 minutes over medium heat or until candy reaches 234° on candy thermometer, stirring constantly to prevent scorching.  Remove from heat.  Stir in Marshmallow Creme and vanilla until well blended.

name: BARBECUED MEATBALLS
ingredients:
3  lb. ground sirloin
1  c. onion, chopped
1  c. cracker crumbs
2  Tbsp. ketchup
1 large  bottle barbecue sauce
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Shape into meatballs.  Arrange meatballs in a greased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown.  Using a slatted spoon, transfer meatballs to a Dutch oven or large pan.  Pour barbecue sauce over meatballs and cook slowly for 3 to 4 hours.  Cocktail franks can be added at anytime if you wish.  (Also can be cooked in a crock-pot.  The secret is to make sure they are cooked thoroughly and slowly, so the sauce blends.)

name: HOT WATER CORN BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. white corn meal
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
2 or 3  c. boiling water
1/4 to 1/2  c. sweet milk
Crisco
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Add enough boiling water to make stiff dough.  Then add sweet milk to cool and mellow dough so you can form into thick or thin patties.  Fry in hot Crisco until golden brown on both sides.  Serve hot.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2 (16 1/2 oz.)  cans creamed corn
1 (12 oz.)  can corn Niblets, drained
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Dot with butter.  Bake for 1 hour at 350° or until top is golden brown.

name: "SHRIMPLY DELICIOUS" SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. sour cream
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. Italian salad dressing mix
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can shrimp
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Soften cream cheese.  Add sour cream, salad dressing mix and lemon juice.  Mix well.  Add shrimp and continue beating until shrimp are minced.  If you like a lot of shrimp and larger pieces, add another can and mix well, but do not mince.  Serve chilled.

name: HOT BUTTERED RUM
ingredients:
1  lb. dark brown sugar
1  lb. powdered sugar
1  lb. butter (melted and cooled)
1  qt. ice cream (vanilla), softened
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Beat all together.  Freeze in quart pail.

name: MICROWAVE PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Karo syrup
1  c. sugar
1  c. raw peanuts
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. margarine
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Have all  ingredients  at room temperature and measured in advance.  Butter  an  11 x 16-inch piece of foil.  Spray a quart size  microwave dish with Pam (I use Vision Ware with a handle). Cook sugar and syrup on High for 4 minutes.  Stir in margarine, vanilla  and  peanuts  with a wooden spoon sprayed with  Pam. Cook  4  more  minutes;  stir in soda with sprayed spoon.  Pour immediately  onto  foil  and spread quickly with sprayed spatula. Cool completely and break up.  This is easy, but you must have everything ready and work fast.

name: FRUIT  DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
orange juice
sugar to taste
preparation: Gradually beat orange juice into Cool Whip until the mixture is creamy, but not thin.  Add sugar to taste.  Serve with fresh or canned fruits.

name: DEEP-DISH APPLE PIE
ingredients:
6  c. apples, peeled and thinly sliced (2 lb. total)
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/8  tsp. salt
3/4  c. all-purpose flour or 1/2 c. all-purpose flour plus 1/4 c. whole-wheat flour
3  Tbsp. margarine
2 to 3  Tbsp. cold water
dash of nutmeg
skim milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Place apples in a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish.  In a small bowl, combine sugar and cinnamon; set aside 1 teaspoon of the mixture.  Stir cornstarch and salt into the remaining mixture and mix well.  Sprinkle evenly over apples in dish.  In a medium mixing bowl, stir together flour and nutmeg. Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Sprinkle 1 tablespoon water over part of the mixture; gently toss with a fork.  Push to side of bowl.  Repeat until all is moistened.  Form into a ball.

name: SQUASH PADDIES
ingredients:
2  c. grated squash
2  Tbsp. grated cheese
1  Tbsp. flour
4  saltine crackers
1  grated onion
1  egg
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Microwave grated squash a little bit before mixing all ingredients. Fry like pancakes.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. German chocolate cake mix
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. nuts
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. Kraft caramels
preparation: Mix cake mix as directed except omit 1/4 cup of water and add 1/2 cup Eagle Brand milk to mix.  Pour 1/2 the batter in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Take out of oven and have ready the caramel mixture.  Melt caramels in 1/2 can Eagle Brand milk.  Pour over first 1/2 of cake in pan, sprinkle nuts and chocolate chips over the caramel mixture.  Add remaining batter. Bake until done.  You may ice cake with chocolate icing.  This is a very rich cake.

name: SUNSHINE PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange-pineapple Jell-O *
1  c. boiling water
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice concentrate
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen pineapple juice concentrate
5  c. cold water
1  (28 oz.) ginger ale
ice cubes or ring
orange slices
preparation: Put Jell-O  and  1  cup boiling water in blender at low speed until  dissolved.  Add pineapple juice and orange juice concentrate and 1 cup cold water.  Blend until combined.  Pour in punch bowl.  Stir in remaining 4 cups cold water.  Add ice. Float orange slices.

name: CRANBERRY RELISH SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  box cranberry or cherry Jell-O
1 large  can crushed pineapple
2  c. sugar
1  bag cranberries (frozen)
2  large seedless oranges
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Prepare Jell-O according to package directions in large bowl. Refrigerate until partially set.  Chop nuts.  Wash cranberries and chop in food processor.  Put in a bowl.  Cut oranges in quarters and chop in food processor (include rind).  Blend everything together with the sugar and crushed pineapple and mix with the partially set Jell-O.  Chill thoroughly.

name: POTATO SKINS
ingredients:
3  medium baking potatoes
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
6  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
oil for deep frying
sour cream
preparation: Scrub potatoes thoroughly and rub skins with oil.  Bake at 400° for 1 hour or until done.  Cool potatoes.  Cut in half lengthwise. Carefully scoop out pulp, leaving 1/4 to 1/8-inch shell.  Pulp may be reserved for mashed potatoes.  Deep fry shells in oil for 2 minutes until light brown.  Drain on paper towels.  Place skins on baking sheet; sprinkle with cheese and bacon.  Place under broiler until cheese melts.  Serve with sour cream.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
1  pkg. Ore-Ida frozen hash browns
1  lb. pkg. Velveeta cheese
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Cover hash browns with water.  Salt and pepper to taste and add onion salt, if desired.  Boil until tender, about 10 minutes. Do not drain.  Add soups and Velveeta and simmer until all melted together.  May use cream of chicken soup instead of mushroom.  (I think mushroom is better.)

name: EASY LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  pkg. Kluski noodles
1 to 2  lb. hamburger
1  small onion
salt and pepper to taste
Mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses
garlic salt to taste
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 to 2  cans golden mushroom soup (depending on amount of hamburger used)
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion; add salt, pepper and garlic salt. Meanwhile cook noodles according to package directions.  Mix together noodles and soup; top with meat mixture; then tomato sauce.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: PUMPKIN CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
3/4  c. oil
1/2  c. water
2 1/2  c. flour
2 1/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1 1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. raisins
1  c. walnuts
preparation: Beat together eggs, pumpkin and oil, then add dry ingredients. Stir in raisins and nuts.  Pour into tube pan or loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes until tests done.  Ice with Cream Cheese Icing (recipe follows).

name: CRISP MIXED PICKLES
ingredients:
10  medium cucumbers
6  large carrots
6  sweet red peppers
6  green peppers
6  c. sugar
3  tsp. celery seed
3  tsp. mustard seed
2  tsp. turmeric
1  Tbsp. salt
4  c. vinegar
preparation: Cut cucumbers in 2-inch long thin sticks.  Cover with a brine of 1 cup salt to 2 cups water.  Let stand overnight.  Rinse and drain.  Pare carrots, cut in sticks like cucumbers.  Cook in a small amount of boiling salt water for 5 minutes.  Remove seeds from peppers and cut into sticks.  Combine remaining ingredients; pour over vegetables.  Heat just to boiling point.  Seal in hot, sterile jars.  Makes 8 pints.

name: PORCUPINE MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. uncooked rice
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2/3  c. tomato puree
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  c. tomato sauce
1  c. diced celery
1  green pepper, diced
1/2  tsp. mustard
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. hot water
preparation: Combine ground beef,  rice,  salt,  pepper  and  tomato puree; mix well.  Form into 8 balls.  Melt shortening in sauce pot and brown balls on  all  sides.  Add  onion, tomato sauce, celery and green pepper.  Combine  salt,  mustard and sugar in hot water. Pour over  meat  balls.  Simmer  45  minutes.  May also be done in pressure  cooker  for  8 minutes with pressure regulator rocking slowly.

name: SUGAR CRUSTED APPLES
ingredients:
6  large cooking apples
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. soft margarine
3/4  c. orange juice
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  egg, beaten
whipped cream
preparation: Peel and core apples.  Combine flour, sugar and cinnamon; cut margarine into flour mixture with 2 knives or pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse cornmeal.  Brush apples with egg and roll in flour mixture.  Place in greased baking dish.  Fill cavities of apples with any remaining flour mixture.  Pour orange juice in bottom of dish around apples.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour or until apples are tender.  Serve warm with pan liquids and whipped cream.

name: KAREN'S PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
3/4  cup sugar
1/2  Tsp. salt
1  Tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  Tsp. ground ginger
1/4  Tsp. ground cloves
2  large eggs
1  can (15 oz.) pure pumpkin
2  cups eggnog
1  unbaked 9 inch (4 cup volume) deep dish pie shell, or two 9 inch shells
preparation: Mix salt, cinnamon, ginger and cloves in small bowl.  Beat eggs in large bowl.  Stir in pumpkin and sugar - spice mixture. Gradually stir in eggnog.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake in preheated oven at 425 degrees for 15 minutes.  Reduce temperature to 350 degrees:  bake 40 to 50 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean.  Cool on wire rack for 1 hour.  Serve immediately or refrigerate.

name: COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  c. milk
3  egg yolks
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. coconut
preparation: In pot, add beaten egg yolks, milk, sugar, cornstarch, margarine, salt, and vanilla.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thick.  Remove from heat. Add coconut.  Mix well. Pour into a baked pie crust.

name: RICHARD'S RAGGING CAJUN TURKEY BREAST
ingredients:
2  lb. turkey breast fillet slices, slightly pounded flat
2  Tbsp. Cajun seasoning
3/4  c. seasoned bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. oil and 1 Tbsp. butter
2  cloves mashed garlic
thyme flavored vinegar or cider vinegar
preparation: Take turkey and swizzel a little vinegar on.  Rub on Cajun seasoning into meat and then in seasoned bread crumbs.  Heat pan; add oil, then butter and garlic.  Quickly fry fillets 1 minute on each side or until brown but still tender.  Remove to plate; add more vinegar to frying pan.  Deglaze the pan and return in juices to pan from fillets.  Boil and reduce by 1/2.  Pour onto platter; arrange turkey on top.

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA
ingredients:
1  large tube refrigerated crescent rolls or pizza dough in a tube
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. mayonnaise
dash of seasoned salt
dash of dill weed
chopped broccoli, cauliflower, sliced olives, mushrooms or your favorite vegetables
shredded cheese
preparation: Place dough on a cookie sheet or pizza pan, pinching perforations together.  Bake according to directions.  Cool. Blend the softened cream cheese with mayonnaise and seasonings. Spread on crust.  Top with veggies and cheese.  Refrigerate.

name: LEMON DILL PRETZELS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. pretzels, broken
1  Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
1  c. peanut oil
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. dill weed
1  tsp. lemon pepper
1  Tbsp. lemon juice (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and place on baking sheet.  Bake at 300° for 10 minutes.  Stir and bake for 10 minutes more.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. chopped frozen broccoli
2  Tbsp. oleo
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. celery
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  can milk (soup can)
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  c. uncooked Minute rice
salt to taste
1  can French fried onion rings
preparation: Cook and drain broccoli; set aside.  Saute onion and celery in oleo.  Add to broccoli.  Add soup, milk, Cheez Whiz, rice and salt and pepper to suit taste.  Place mixture in baking dish.  Bake 40 minutes at 350°.  Top with French fried onion rings and bake another 10 minutes.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can (16 oz.) sliced carrots
1  can (16 oz.) whole green beans
1  box frozen green peas
1  can (8 oz.) sliced water chestnuts
1  can cream of mushroom soup (1/2 can water)
1  jar sliced mushrooms
1  jar (5 oz.) Old English cheese
preparation: Melt cheese in soup.  Pour over uncooked vegetables in a 13 x 9-inch pan or dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: TOMATO KETCHUP
ingredients:
1 1/2 or 2  qt. chopped ripe tomatoes
1  c. vinegar
2  c. sugar
1  medium chopped onion
1  bell pepper, chopped
hot pepper to suit taste
preparation: Cook down to about 2 pints.  Cook slowly for 2 to 3 hours.

name: WEDDING PUNCH
ingredients:
2-1/2  cups pineapple juice, chilled
1  pt lime, lemon or raspberry sherbet
1  pt vanilla ice cream
1 (12 oz)  bottle ginger ale or 7-Up
preparation: Combine pineapple juice, sherbet and 1/2 of ice cream.  Beat until smooth.  Add 7-Up or ginger ale.  Spoon remaining ice cream into punch.  Serve immediately.  Yields:  14 (1/2 cup) servings.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
3  pkg. orange jello
2  cans mandarin oranges, drained
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 small  can frozen orange juice
preparation: Measure orange and pineapple juice.  Add water to make 3 1/2 cups.  Heat to boiling; dissolve jello.  Cool.  Chill until mixture begins to thicken, then stir in orange juice (partially thawed).  Chill until thickening.  Stir in fruit.  Chill until jello sets.

name: FRUIT ICES
ingredients:
lime or fruit juice
small fruit slices (strawberries, kiwi, apples and cherries)
preparation: You will need popsicle molds or small cups and lollipop sticks.  Push the lollipop sticks halfway in the mold or stand them up in small cups.  Fill each mold halfway with juice.  Freeze for 1 hour or until frozen.  Arrange fruit slices on top of frozen juice, then slowly fill to top with juice.  Freeze.
