name: FESTIVE LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  small eggplant, peeled and thinly sliced
1/4  c. flour
2 to 3  Tbsp. olive oil
4  c. marinara sauce, divided
8  oz. lasagna noodles
1  lb. Ricotta cheese
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese, divided
1  c. chopped and drained cooked spinach
1  egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. each:  dried basil and oregano
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Coat eggplant slices with flour.  Heat 2 tablespoons oil in large skillet over medium heat; quickly cook eggplant in oil until lightly browned, adding more oil if necessary.  Drain eggplant on paper towels.  Spread 1 cup marinara sauce on bottom of 9 x 13 baking dish; top sauce with 3 lasagna noodles.  Combine Ricotta, 1 cup Mozzarella, spinach, egg, basil, oregano, pepper and salt. Spread half of cheese mixture on noodles in baking pan.  Layer with half of eggplant slices, 1 cup marinara sauce, 3 lasagna noodles, remaining cheese mixture, remaining eggplant slices, 1 cup marinara sauce, 3 lasagna noodles, remaining 1 cup marinara sauce and remaining 1 cup Mozzarella cheese.  Cover with foil; bake in 350° oven for 1 hour 15 minutes.  Remove from oven; let stand, covered, 15 minutes before cutting.  Makes 8 servings.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. soda
1  c. raisins (optional)
1  c. chopped nuts
3  c. quick-cooking oats
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.   Mix thoroughly shortening, sugars, egg, water and vanilla.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 1-inch apart onto greased baking sheet.

name: HERBED TOMATOES
ingredients:
6  large ripe tomatoes
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. coarse black pepper
1/2  tsp. marjoram
1/4  c. finely snipped parsley
1/4  c. snipped chives
2/3  c. salad oil
1/4  c. tarragon vinegar
preparation: Peel tomatoes.  Cut crosswise in half.   Place in deep bowl, sprinkling each layer with seasoning and herbs.  Combine oil and vinegar.  Pour over tomatoes, tilting bowl so all tomatoes are covered.  Cover.   Chill an hour or so, occasionally spooning dressing over tomatoes.  Drain off excess dressing and arrange tomato halves on a platter.  Serves 6.

name: ZUCCHINI CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. salad oil
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts, chopped
3  eggs, beaten
2  c. grated raw zucchini
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Combine oil, eggs, sugar, zucchini and vanilla in large mixing bowl.  Mix well.  Stir in flour, soda, baking powder, salt and cinnamon.  Do not beat, stir in nuts.  Spoon batter into well-greased tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: FAT-FREE RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
6  c. water
3/4  c. rice (preferably Arborio or other short-grain rice)
3  c. nonfat milk
dash of salt
4 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. raisins or dried cherries
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
ground cinnamon for sprinkling (optional)
preparation: Bring 6 cups water to boil in large, heavy saucepan.  Add rice and boil, uncovered, 7 minutes.  Drain well.  Bring milk to boil in same saucepan over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally.  Add rice and salt.  Cook, uncovered, over medium-low heat, stirring often, until rice is very soft and absorbs most of the milk, about 15 minutes.  Rice should look creamy, not soupy and not dry.  When rice is cooked, stir in sugar.  Cook and stir 1 minute.  Remove from heat.  Stir in raisins and vanilla.  Serve warm, sprinkled with cinnamon.  Yield:  4 servings.

name: FOUR LAYER DESSERT
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
2  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt oleo and mix in flour and nuts.  Place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes until brown. Cool.

name: COPPER PENNIES (CARROTS)
ingredients:
2  lb. fresh carrots, sliced in rounds 1/4 inch thick
2  medium onions, thinly sliced and separated into rings
1  medium green pepper, cut into strips
1  can (10 3/4 oz.) tomato soup (undiluted)
3/4  c. vinegar
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. cooking oil
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook carrots for 8 to 10 minutes in a small amount of water. Drain; add remaining ingredients.  Mix well, cover and marinate in refrigerator overnight.  Serve hot or cold.   Makes a big bowl full.  Number of servings depends on size of servings.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  can pumpkin
1  c. brown sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. mace
4  eggs, slightly beaten
1 1/2  c. evaporated milk
2  Tbsp. brandy (optional)
preparation: Mix sugar and spices. Combine with the pumpkin, eggs and milk. Pour into a 10-inch pastry shell.  Place pecan halves around the edge.  Bake at 450° for 15 minutes and then reduce heat to 350° and bake for an additional 40 minutes.

name: HAMBURGER QUICHE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1  Tbsp. water
1/2  c. plain low-fat yogurt
1/2  c. skim milk
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. (2 oz.) sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  Tbsp. Vidalia onion, chopped
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1  (9-inch) deep-dish pie crust
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. In a microwave-safe dish, brown meat with water*, stirring occasionally. Drain and set aside.

name: CHICKEN PICATTA
ingredients:
4  boneless chicken breasts
1  egg
1/3  c. flour
1/8  tsp. paprika
1/2  c. boiling water
1/4  c. butter
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
salt and pepper
2  chicken bouillon cubes
preparation: Blend water, bouillon cubes and 2 tablespoons lemon juice and set aside.  Beat egg and 1 tablespoon lemon juice in one pan.  In another pan, blend flour, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Dip chicken in egg mixture, then in flour mixture and into skillet of melted butter; brown on both sides.  Add bouillon and lemon juice mixture into skillet and simmer for 20 minutes or until chicken is tender.

name: YUM YUM CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. water or tomato juice
1  c. Crisco
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  box raisins (8 oz.)
4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. walnuts
6  oz. maraschino cherries
preparation: Cook the first 7 ingredients together until raisins are soft. Allow to cool; add the next 5 ingredients and mix well by hand. Batter will be very stiff.  Grease and flour Bundt or 2 loaf pans. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
8  oz. sour cream
1/2  c. taco sauce (hot or medium)
1/2  c. mild taco sauce
shredded lettuce
tomatoes
green pepper
shredded cheese
black olives
preparation: Mix together cream cheese and sour cream.  Spread on a tray or pretty serving dish.  Mix together sauces and pour over top of cream cheese mixture.  Top with toppings of your choice.  Serve with nacho chips or tortilla chips.

name: JAPANESE FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  whole eggs
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  stick melted oleo or butter
1/2  c. raisins
1/4  c. chopped pecans
1/4  c. coconut
preparation: Mix all ingredients; beat well.  Pour into a unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA
ingredients:
1  pkg. crescent rolls
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. real mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. minced onion
any combination chopped vegetables *
preparation: *May use cauliflower, broccoli, green peppers (diced), green onions (chopped), cucumbers, grated carrots, tomatoes (diced) and olives.

name: SPICY TOMATO MINI-LOAVES
ingredients:
3  c. corn flakes
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's tomato soup
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1  egg
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef
2  Tbsp. firmly packed brown sugar
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1/4  tsp. parsley flakes
preparation: Combine corn flakes, half the soup, onion and egg.  Mix well, then mix into the ground beef.  Portion the meat mixture into 6 parts.  Shape into individual loaves.  Place on foil-lined baking pan.  Mix together remaining soup, brown sugar, mustard and parsley.  Spread evenly over meat.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: TORTELLINI SOUP
ingredients:
4  cloves garlic
1/2  pkg. fresh spinach, washed and torn or 10 oz. pkg.  frozen, cooked
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
3 (14 oz.)  cans chicken broth
2 (14 oz.)  cans stewed tomatoes
1  (15 oz.) frozen tortellini
3  tsp. fresh basil
margarine
preparation: Brown garlic in margarine.  Add broth and tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.  Bring to boil; add tortellini.  Reduce heat and simmer 7 minutes more.  Add spinach, basil and cheese.  Simmer a few more minutes.  Serve hot with extra Parmesan.

name: GLYNDA RAEF'S BLUE RIBBON CARAMEL FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. caramels
2  sticks oleo or butter
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1/3  c. cocoa
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Unwrap the caramels the night before starting.  Mix together the butter and sugar. Add eggs, then rest of ingredients.  Pour batter into a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

name: BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
1/2  c. powdered sugar
2 1/2  c. plain flour
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Cream oleo and sugar; add flour and salt, then vanilla and nuts.  Chill.  Roll in 1-inch balls.  Place on cookie sheet 1 inch apart.  Bake at 300° for 12 to 14 minutes.  Do not brown.  Roll in powdered sugar while warm.

name: 100 GOOD COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1  c. margarine
1  c. cooking oil
1  egg
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. Rice Krispies
1  c. coconut
1  c. quick oats
3 1/2  c. flour or add 1/2 c. more if needed
preparation: Mix in order.  Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: "NO-BAKE" OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  cube margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
4 1/2  c. quick oatmeal
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Boil sugar, milk and butter for 1 minute.  Add vanilla, quick oatmeal and chocolate chips.

name: RUTH ANN'S GOURMET POTATOES
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
2  c. shredded sharp cheese
1/4  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sour cream (room temperature)
1/3  c. chopped green onion
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook potatoes in skins.  Cool, peel and slice.  Fold all ingredients with potatoes and turn into a greased 2-quart casserole.  Dot with butter.  Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. ham, chopped
2  c. Cheddar cheese, cubed
1 large  can English peas, drained
2  c. cooked seashell macaroni
1  c. celery, sliced
3  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
spring onions
preparation: Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise.  Add all other ingredients and toss.  Let stand in refrigerator several hours or overnight.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  or 8 potatoes, cooked until done, drained and mashed really fluffy
8  oz. cream cheese
1/4  c. sour cream
preparation: Add cream cheese and sour cream slowly to hot, mashed potatoes.  Season with salt and pepper.  Put in baking dish and brush top with melted butter.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: RICE SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. cooked rice
2 small  cans shrimp, drained
1  tomato, finely chopped
1  small green pepper, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1  small cucumber, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  bottle Green Goddess Dressing
preparation: Mix all ingredients together. Prepare 24 hours prior to serving. Add additional dressing if necessary before serving.

name: SHOO-FLY PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. flour
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/8  tsp. ground cloves
1/8  tsp. ground ginger
1/8  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. shortening
1/2  c. molasses
3/4  c. boiling water
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  egg yolk, beaten
preparation: Mix together first 7 ingredients; cut in shortening with pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture is crumbly; set aside. Obtain 9-inch pie shell; set aside.  Combine 4 remaining ingredients.  Alternate layers in pie shell of crumbs and liquid mixture, ending with crumbs as top layer.   Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to 350° and bake about 20 minutes longer or until firm.

name: ONION SOUP
ingredients:
6  tsp. butter
6  large onions, thinly sliced
3 (10 1/2 oz.)  cans of condensed beef broth
3  c. water
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. salt
5 (1 inch)  slices French or Italian bread
3/4  lb. Swiss of Gruyer cheese, sliced thin
preparation: In 4-quart pan over medium heat, melt butter; add onions; cook until tender and golden, stirring occasionally.  Stir in undiluted beef broth, water, sugar, Worcestershire and salt.  Over high heat, heat to boiling.  Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 15 minutes. Preheat broiler, place bread on cookie sheet.  Toast both sides. Add cheese to bread and melt in broiler.  Put bread on top of bowl of soup.

name: DOUBLE CRUNCHIE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. white sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. corn flakes, crushed
1  c. quick oats
1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Sift together flour, baking soda and salt.  Cream together next 5 ingredients Mix together dry and creamed ingredients Add corn flakes, oats and coconut.  Mix well.  Shape into small balls and flatten onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 8 minutes. Cool on racks.

name: EASY ROLLS
ingredients:
butter (for greasing muffin tins)
2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. sugar
4 heaping  Tbsp. mayonnaise
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Lightly grease a 12-cup muffin tin with butter. In a large bowl, combine flour and milk, blending with a rubber spatula. Add sugar and mayonnaise. Stir until combined. Spoon batter into muffin tin. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

name: PAT'S TRIFLE
ingredients:
angel food cake, torn into bite size pieces
1 large  pkg. sugar-free instant vanilla pudding
skim milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
fresh strawberries
preparation: Prepare pudding with skim milk according to package directions.  Stir in Cool Whip, saving enough for topping.  Layer cake pieces, pudding and berries in a large glass bowl.  Top with remaining Cool Whip and a few whole berries.  You can vary the pudding flavor, the fruit and even the type of cake.

name: CHRISTMAS PUNCH
ingredients:
2  qt. cranberry juice
3/4  c. lemon juice
1  qt. orange juice
2  qt. chilled ginger ale
1/2  c. sugar
thin orange slices
thin lemon slices
maraschino cherries
preparation: Mix juices and sugar.  Pour into punch bowl over ice.  Add remaining ingredients and stir.

name: SWISS-ROSTI
ingredients:
1  large Idaho potato per person
cold water
2  tsp. butter per person
salt
pepper
onions, browned (optional)
preparation: Coarsely grate the potatoes into a dish of cold water.  Brown butter lightly in a large heavy pan.  Blot potatoes on a towel to dry them.  Add to hot butter and press firmly with a broad spatula.  Reduce heat and sprinkle salt and pepper to taste.  Cook covered for about 15 to 20 minutes, until bottom of potatoes are cooked and golden brown.  Turn into a hot serving plate, crusty side up.  Serve immediately.

name: SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 to 10 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti, broken
1  lb. ground meat
1  c. celery, finely sliced
1  onion, chopped
1  tsp. garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  can sliced black olives
1  can whole peeled stewed tomatoes
1  can tomato soup
1 large  can tomato sauce
1  can sliced mushrooms
1 (4 oz.)  jar pimentos, chopped
grated cheese (Cheddar, Monterey Jack, Mozzarella, etc.)
preparation: Place a large pan (Dutch oven type) 3/4 full of water on stove.  Heat to boiling.  Add the spaghetti; return to boil. Cover.  Remove from heat.

name: CHERRY-PINEAPPLE DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (20 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
2/3  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Grease 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Dump pineapple and juice, spreading evenly.  Pour cherry pie filling over the pineapple, spreading evenly.  Add dry cake mix and spread evenly over the fruit.  Add nuts, then slice butter and lay all over the top.  Do not mix!  Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: FOUR FRUIT COMPOTE
ingredients:
1  can pineapple chunks
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 - 11  oz. can mandarin oranges, drained - save juice
3  - 4 unpeeled apples, chopped
2  - 3 bananas, sliced
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving 3/4 cup juice.  In saucepan, combine sugar and cornstarch.  Add pineapple juice, orange juice and lemon juice.  Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly; cook and stir 1 minute longer.  Remove from heat; set aside.  In a bowl, combine pineapple chunks, oranges, apples and bananas.  Pour warm sauce over fruit.  Stir gently to coat.  Cover and refrigerate.

name: CAESAR SALAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. olive oil
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  garlic, cut in half
Tabasco to taste
3/4  grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
romaine lettuce
croutons
preparation: Mix liquid ingredients, plus garlic, together in jar.  Mix dry ingredients together.  Rub wood bowl with garlic half. Lettuce into bowl (romaine).  Dry ingredients and mix.  Liquid ingredients and mix.  Raw egg, beaten, and mix (if desired). Croutons (homemade are best).  More grated Parmesan cheese (if desired).

name: ROUND STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. top round steak (can be cut into strips)
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can chicken or beef broth
2  Tbsp. oil
1  or 2 medium onions, chopped
1  stalk celery, chopped
1/2  tsp. garlic
1/2  c. mushrooms, sliced
preparation: In 1 tablespoon oil, brown steak until done; remove from pan. Add 1 tablespoon oil and saute onion, celery, garlic and mushrooms at high temperature (stirring constantly) until light brown; remove from pan. Add cornstarch and slightly brown. Stir in 1/2 of the chicken broth; stir. Add all cooked ingredients and cook together. Cook 2 cups rice with 1/2 of the chicken broth and water.  Ready to serve.

name: OVERNIGHT SOUTHWESTERN EGG BAKE
ingredients:
12  eggs
1/2  c. half and half or milk
1 (11 oz.)  can Green Giant Mexicorn whole kernel corn and red and green peppers
10  (6-inch) soft corn tortillas, cut into quarters
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. Cheddar cheese or Monterey Jack cheese, shredded, or a combination of both
2  c. salsa
1  c. sour cream
1  c. guacamole
preparation: Generously grease 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  In large bowl, combine eggs and half and half; beat slightly.  Stir in corn. Place tortillas in bottom of greased dish.  Pour egg mixture over tortillas.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Cover; refrigerate overnight. Heat oven to 375°.  Cover casserole with foil.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until eggs are just set.  Let stand covered 5 minutes. Uncover; spoon salsa over eggs.  Serve with sour cream and guacamole.

name: EGGPLANT PARMESAN
ingredients:
1  large or 2 small eggplants
salt as needed
3  eggs
1/2  c. water
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. plain dry bread crumbs
oil or shortening for frying
1  qt. tomato sauce (warm)
1 1/2  lb. Mozzarella cheese, sliced
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Peel eggplant and slice lengthwise into 1/4-inch thick slices. Salt slices, place in colander and allow to stand for 30 minutes. Wash off salt and dry slices.

name: CHICKEN AND STUFFING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. chopped, cooked chicken
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1 (10 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
3/4  c. chicken broth
1  pkg. herb-seasoned stuffing mix
1/2  c. (1 stick) butter, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook mixture of chicken, onion, soup and broth in a saucepan over low heat just until heated through, stirring constantly.  Toss stuffing mix with butter in bowl. Layer chicken mixture and stuffing mixture 1/2 at a time in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Bake for 20 minutes or until bubbly.  Yields 8 servings.

name: PUMPKIN ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs, lightly beaten
2  c. sugar
1  c. canned pumpkin
1  c. butter or margarine, melted
1  Tbsp. vanilla
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  c. shredded zucchini
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Baking Temperature: 350°.  Baking Time:  45 to 50 minutes.

name: SALLY'S CHUCK WAGON
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (15 oz.)  can tomatoes (with liquid), cut
3  Tbsp. oleo
1 (15 oz.)  can dark red kidney beans
3/4  c. elbow macaroni
1/2  c. barbecue sauce
Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Scramble (cook) ground beef in oleo.  Add a few shakes of Worcestershire sauce.  Drain fat.  Add remaining ingredients, simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Serve with biscuits.

name: LOU KRIDELBAUGH'S FAMOUS LAYER CAKE
ingredients:
1  wedding or other special event
1  slice (good size) cake
preparation: Put cake in hand.  Locate Lou.  Slowly, quietly sneak up on Lou.  Smash cake in Lou's face.  Make sure the entire event is documented on film.  After smashing cake in Lou's face, run like the devil, all the while relishing your victory.  (Warning:  Be prepared to receive same.)

name: ORENG POPCICKLE
ingredients:
oreng juice
ice
clean popcickle sticks
one peice foil
preparation: Pore oreng juice into the ice tray.  Then put foil on the ice tray.  Push the clean popcickle sticks were the oreng juice is. Set the ice tray in the freezer for 3 hours.  Take them out and eat them!

name: GINGERBREAD PEOPLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. dark molasses
1  c. packed brown sugar
2/3  c. cold water
1/3  c. shortening
7  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. allspice
2  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix molasses, brown sugar, water and shortening.  Mix in remaining ingredients.  Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Heat oven to 350°.  Roll dough 1/4 inch thick on floured surface. Cut with floured cookie cutters.  Place about 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake until no indentation remains with touched, 10  to 12 minutes.  Cool.  Decorate.

name: SLICED BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  medium, even potatoes
1  tsp. salt
2 to 3  Tbsp. melted butter
2 to 3  Tbsp. chopped, fresh herbs (parsley or chives) or 2 to 3 tsp. dried herbs of your choice
4  Tbsp. grated Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Peel potatoes if the skins are tough, otherwise, scrub and rinse.  Cut potatoes into thin slices, but not all the way through.  Put in a baking dish; fan them slightly.  Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter.  Sprinkle with herbs.  Bake potatoes at 425° for 50 minutes.  Remove from oven; sprinkle with cheeses. Bake potatoes 10 to 15 minutes  until lightly browned (check with fork).

name: SCALLOPED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  large head cabbage
1  lb. American cheese
1  c. whole milk
1/2  stick butter
1  1/2 bags salt crackers
preparation: Take one 9 x 13-inch cake pan, layer bottom of cake pan with crackers.  Then layer cabbage on top of crackers.  Then put thin slices of butter on cabbage.  Then put layers of cheese over butter, then fill pan with milk until you can see it.  Bake at 350° until milk dries out of it.  Salt and pepper to taste.

name: DESSERT
ingredients:
milk
Cool Whip
chocolate wafers
preparation: Take a casserole dish and a cup.  Pour milk into cup.  Take chocolate wafers and dunk in milk for a second.  Then lay cookies in casserole dish until there is one layer of cookies.  Spread whipped cream over cookies.  Continue to layer in this order until dish is full with layers.  The last layer should have whipped cream on top.  Crumble cookie on top of whipped cream.  Put in refrigerator for about an hour or until cold.  Eat!

name: POUND CAKE(Moist, Whipped Margarine and Crisco)
ingredients:
3  c. plain flour
5  eggs
1  c. milk
2 3/4  c. sugar
2  sticks whipped margarine
1  c. Crisco
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream margarine, Crisco and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time. Add flour and milk alternately, then vanilla.  Save 1/2 cup of the batter for the icing.  Bake at 300° for approximately 1 1/2 hours or until done.

name: TRIPLE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1 (2 layer size)  pkg. chocolate cake mix
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. Jell-O instant chocolate pudding
1 3/4  c. milk
2  eggs
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Combine milk, eggs, cake mix, pudding and chips.  Mix by hand until well blended, about 2 minutes.  Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.  Do not overbake. Cool 15 minutes in pan.  Remove from pan and finish cooling on rack.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar, if desired.

name: TAKE ALONG BUTTERSCOTCH OAT BARS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. oil
2  eggs, slightly beaten
2/3  c. evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. quick rolled oats
1  c. (6 oz. pkg.) butterscotch chips
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix together sugar, oil, eggs and milk in a large mixer bowl. Beat until well blended. Sift together flour, salt, cinnamon and soda. Gradually add to liquid mixture. Beat until smooth.  Stir in oats, butterscotch chips, raisins and nuts. Spread into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Let cool. Spread icing over top. Cut into 24 squares.

name: SARAH'S LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1/3  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. milk
1/8  tsp. salt
3 1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. butter
3  egg yolks
preparation: Cook sugar, flour, milk and salt in double boiler until thick and smooth, stirring frequently.  Add beaten egg yolks; cook a minute or 2 longer.  Add lemon juice and butter; stir and remove from heat.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. macaroni
6  c. water
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter
1/3  c. mayonnaise
celery, chopped (optional)
2  hard cooked eggs
1  small onion, chopped
1  green pepper or pimento
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Add salt to water and bring to a boil.  Add macaroni.  Boil until tender, 10-14 minutes.  Drain.  Add butter.  Mix to season and prevent macaroni from sticking together.  Add mayonnaise, vinegar, chopped eggs, onion, and pepper.  Let set 2 hours or overnight.

name: TOMATO PRESERVES 2
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow or red cherry tomatoes
1 1/2  lb. sugar
1  lemon
1  tsp. ginger
preparation: Wash tomatoes; cover with boiling water and let stand until skins can be easily removed.  Peel.  Cover with sugar and let stand overnight.  Pour off syrup and boil until quite thick and clear; skim.  Slice lemon thin and then add tomatoes, lemon and ginger to syrup.  Cook until tomatoes are clear and thick.  Pour into sterile jars and seal.

name: MOM'S FAMOUS CHILI(Fast and Easy)
ingredients:
1/2  c. onions
2  lb. ground beef
1  bell pepper
30  oz. can tomato sauce
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  cans red kidney beans
1  clove garlic
1/4 to 1/2  c. molasses
2  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: Brown hamburger, onions and pepper.  Add remaining ingredients.  Simmer 15 minutes or until done or place in crock-pot or low until ready to serve.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER BARS
ingredients: whole graham crackers
preparation: Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with whole graham crackers.

name: CHICKEN IN SOY SAUCE
ingredients:
1  whole chicken
1  onion
1/2  c. oil
2  garlic cloves
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. water
preparation: Garlic chicken; set aside for 10 minutes. Sauté onion in oil, then add chicken. Fry chicken until brown on outside. Remove oil and add soy sauce and water. Cover and cook for about 45 minutes on medium.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
2  cans deveined shrimp (broken pieces)
1  can whole shrimp
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2 very thin  slices onion, chopped
1/2  c. chili sauce
1/2  c. mayo
2  tsp. horseradish
preparation: Let cream cheese soften and cream.  Add onion, chili sauce, mayo and horseradish and mix with mixer.  When all is mixed thoroughly, hand mix whole shrimp.  Chill.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
6  slices bacon
1  c. chopped onion
2  garlic cloves, chopped
1  can kidney beans, drained
1  can butter beans, drained
1  can lima beans, drained
1 (28 oz.)  can pork and beans
1/2  c. molasses
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  c. dry red wine
1  lb. smoked sausage
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp, remove from pan and cook the onion and garlic until tender, then drain.  Combine the remaining ingredients in a large casserole.  Add the crumbled bacon, onion and garlic.  Stir well.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (5 oz.)  jar Kraft Cheddar cheese with bacon
1  tsp. wine vinegar
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Have all cheeses at room temperature.

name: LEMON SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. margarine, softened
1/4  c. confectioners sugar
2  eggs
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Preheat oven at 350°.  Mix flour, butter and confectioners sugar together thoroughly.  Press into ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan building up a 1/2 inch edge.  Bake 20 minutes.

name: EASY LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (32 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1 1/2  c. water
2  eggs
2  c. cottage cheese
3  c. shredded mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. chopped parsley
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
8  oz. lasagna noodles
preparation: Brown ground beef in saucepan, stirring until crumbly.  Drain. Add spaghetti sauce and water.  Simmer for 10 minutes.  Combine eggs, cheeses, parsley and seasonings in bowl; mix well.

name: BLACK-EYED SUSANS
ingredients:
1  pkg. pie crust mix
1  tsp. tomato juice or water
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese
dash of red pepper
preparation: Mix and roll out and cut with a small biscuit cutter.  Put a date into each and fold over.  Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: ICEBOX FRUITCAKE
ingredients:
2  bottles maraschino cherries
1  pkg. pecans
1  box graham cracker crumbs
1  box raisins
1  can milk
1  pkg. marshmallows
preparation: Mix first four ingredients.  Melt marshmallows in milk in double boiler and then mix well.  Put in Bundt pan and chill.

name: RECIPE FOR A KISS
ingredients:
1/2  back seat
1  c. moonlight
3  tsp. foolishness
3  or 4 glances
preparation: In a car, use 1/3 of back seat, filter in 1 cup of moonlight. Then add 3 teaspoons of foolishness; set aside with 5 minutes of silences, followed by 3 or 4 romantic glances.  Press calmly on his hand, hesitate, then place lips on his increasing in force.  Draw away, blush lightly, flavor with a gentle squeeze.  Then, set aside to cool.

name: INDIAN BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2 1/2  Tbsp. cocoa
dash of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. chopped pecans
miniature marshmallows
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. sifted flour
2  eggs
3/4  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix butter, salt, cocoa, vanilla, sugar, flour and eggs until smooth.  Add pecans and chocolate chips.  Bake in greased 9-inch square pan for 20 minutes.  Remove from oven; cover top with miniature marshmallows.  Return to oven; bake until marshmallows are melted, or until done.  Cool completely; spread with frosting.

name: BASEBALL STEW
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. stew meat
salt and pepper
5  potatoes, sliced
2  Tbsp. sugar
4  carrots, sliced
1  (12 oz.) V-8 juice
1  medium onion, sliced
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Put meat in greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.  Add layer of onion, potatoes and carrots.  Salt and pepper.  Combine sugar, cornstarch and V-8 (shake).  Pour over vegetables.  Cover with foil.  Bake for 4 hours at 250° to 275°.

name: CHRISTMAS WASSAIL
ingredients:
1  gal. apple cider
1  qt. orange juice
1  pt. pineapple juice
1  c. lemon juice
1  c. sugar
24  whole cloves
4  sticks cinnamon
preparation: Mix all ingredients and simmer over medium heat and serve.

name: EASY COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick butter, melted
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. milk
1  can pie filling (any flavor)
preparation: Melt stick of butter in baking dish.  Meanwhile, mix remaining ingredients and pour over butter.  Add pie filling on top.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: 7-LAYER BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  stick butter
6  oz. butterscotch chips
6  oz. chocolate chips
1  c. coconut
1  c. nut meats
1  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Melt butter on cookie sheet; add cracker crumbs and press out onto sheet.  Layer other ingredients in order given and drizzle milk over all.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Cut into bars.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
2  sticks softened butter
1  lb. and 1 c. confectioners sugar
1  c. peanut butter
preparation: Mix this well and form into small balls.  Melt semi-sweet chocolate chips and paraffin in top of double boiler or melt chocolate bark and dip balls in either one.  Place covered balls on waxed paper to set.

name: CHRISTMAS SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. spinach, trimmed
2  oranges, peeled and sectioned
1  cup pomegranate seeds
2  tbsp. olive oil
2  tbsp. orange juice
1  Tbsp. balsamic vinegar
1  tbsp. honey
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper, crushed
preparation: In large bowl, combine first three ingredients.  In cup, whisk together remaining ingredients.  Pour over salad to coat.

name: HAMBURGER AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  c. finely cut celery
salt and pepper to taste
3/4  c. washed rice
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2 soup  cans water
1/3  c. soy sauce
preparation: Brown hamburger with onion and celery; season lightly.  Add remaining ingredients; mix well.  Place in baking pan or casserole.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.  Yields 8 servings.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. raisins
2 1/4  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. oats
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
6  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream shortening and brown sugar until fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add flavoring and salt.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  c. cornmeal
1  c. milk
1/2  c. oil
2  eggs
1  chopped onion
1  c. creamed corn
1  1/2 chili peppers and juice
1  lb. grated cheese
preparation: Mix together and bake in greased pan for 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.

name: VEGGIE BLEND
ingredients:
3 (16 oz.)  pkg. Green Giant San Francisco Blend frozen vegetables
2 (4 oz.)  jars Cheez Whiz
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  stick butter
1  c. crushed Ritz crackers
2  c. Eagle Thin brand potato chips
preparation: Steam vegetables 10 minutes; drain off water.  Place vegetables in casserole dish and add cheese and mayonnaise to vegetables.  Mix thoroughly.  Top with crushed crackers and chips. Melt butter and pour over vegetable casserole.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 minutes or until heated throughout casserole.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. chicken, diced
1/4  c. pimento
1  c. celery
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. onion, chopped
1 small  can water chestnuts
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 medium  can mushrooms
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. salt
3  boiled eggs
1/3  c. butter
1 1/2  c. crushed corn flakes
1/2  c. slivered almonds
preparation: Mix together first 12 ingredients and put in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Melt butter; pour over crushed corn flakes.  Add almonds.  Return to oven to brown.  This recipe may be frozen.

name: VIDALIA ONION CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. crushed Ritz crackers (for crust)
2  medium onions, cut in rings
3/4  stick margarine
1  egg
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Cover bottom of a 9 x 12-inch pan with crushed Ritz crackers. Saute onions in margarine; put on top of crushed crackers.  Beat egg and pour into a 1-cup measuring cup.  Fill remainder of cup with milk.  Add this mixture to cream of mushroom soup; pour over onions.  Sprinkle with crackers or cheese.  Bake at 350° for 3 minutes.

name: KRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can kraut
2/3  c. vinegar
2  c. sugar
2  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
preparation: Rinse and drain kraut.  Bring the sugar and vinegar to a boil. Let it cool.  Add remaining ingredients to kraut.  Pour sugar and vinegar over the kraut.  Refrigerate 24 hours.

name: "OLD VIRGINIA" APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. applesauce
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
1  egg
2 1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. allspice
1  c. chopped raisins
1/2  c. nuts
2  tsp. soda
1/2  c. boiling water
preparation: Cream shortening and add sugar gradually.  Add beaten egg and applesauce.  Sift flour before measuring.  Use a little of the same flour to sift over raisins and nuts.  Sift remaining flour with salt and spices.    Dissolve soda in boiling water and then add flour mixture alternately with the water to the creamed mixture.  Add the floured raisins and nuts.  Pour into cake tins or bake in mold, greased and floured.  Bake 1 hour in moderate oven at 350°.

name: STUFFED CABBAGE
ingredients:
3  lb. hamburger meat
2  tsp. salt
1  big onion
1/2  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. rice
1  can big whole tomatoes
1  c. sugar
1  c. lemon juice
preparation: Add and mix hamburger meat, salt, onion, lemon juice, sugar rice.  Roll in cabbage leaves. Put on top of mixture after cabbage is rolled the whole tomatoes, sugar and lemon juice.  If liquid is low, add water. Cook slowly for 4 hours.

name: ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  hard-boiled eggs, sliced
2 (14 1/2 oz.)  cans asparagus spears
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts, sliced
6  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1 small  jar pimento
1  c. seasoned bread crumbs
preparation: Drain asparagus spears and water chestnuts, saving 1 1/2 cups of the combined liquids. Mix the flour and milk until smooth. Add to reserved liquid with butter, cheese and seasonings; cook on medium heat until thick and add pimento. Arrange asparagus in shallow 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Place water chestnuts over asparagus; top with sliced eggs. Pour sauce evenly over all and top with bread crumbs. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: ICING FOR SPONGE CAKE OR ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
1  (9 oz.) crushed pineapple
1  pkg. (3 oz.) orange jello
1  pt. whipping cream
preparation: Blend and bring to a boil.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Chill 2 hours. Whip the cream and fold into jello mixture.  Cut cake in half and use some for filling.  Place other half of cake on top and use remaining icing to cover whole cake.

name: VEGGIE GRITS
ingredients:
1  c. quick cooking grits
4  c. water
11  oz. can drained Mexicorn
9  oz. pkg. thawed and drained frozen spinach
1  pkg. Taco Seasoning
2  T. reduced fat butter
2  c. reduced fat shredded cheddar
preparation: Follow package directions to cook 1 c. grits in 4 c. water. Combine cooked grits with remaining ingredients except 1 c. of cheese.  Pour into a buttered 9 by 13-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle remaining cheese on top.  Bake for 30 minutes at 375 degrees. Serve hot.

name: CHICKEN GLOP
ingredients:
4  to 6 skinless chicken breasts (boneless work best)
1  pkg. Lipton dry onion soup mix
1  can cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. sour cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 250°.  Mix the onion soup mix, cream of mushroom soup and the sour cream until blended (a few lumps are required).  Rinse the chicken breasts and pat dry (see, boneless are easier to work with, right?).  Place the breasts in a nonmetallic baking dish.  Spread the soup mixture evenly over the chicken.  Cover.  Place into oven.  (You did remember to preheat, didn't you?)  Cook for about 4 hours or until done.  This can be speeded up by cooking at 350°, but it leaves a yeechy crust around the edge.  Enjoy.

name: OLD FASHIONED BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. beef chuck, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
2  Tbsp. fat
2  c. boiling water
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  clove garlic
1  medium onion, sliced
2  bay leaves
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. paprika
6  carrots
1  lb. small white potatoes
dash of allspice or cloves
preparation: Thoroughly brown the meat on all sides in hot fat, turning often.  Add boiling water, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, sliced onions, bay leaves and seasonings.  Cover and simmer.  Don't boil for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally to keep from sticking. Remove bay leaves and garlic clove.   Add carrots, onions and cubed potatoes.  Cover and cook 30 minutes.

name: JANET'S 7 LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1  small head of lettuce shredded
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. shredded carrots
2  c. chopped broccoli
2  c. chopped cauliflower
1 small  box frozen peas-divided in half
1 8  oz. pkg. shredded cheddar cheese
Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
grated parmesan cheese
preparation: Layer first 7 ingredients in a casserole dish using 1/2 of the peas. Thaw remaining peas and mix with ranch dressing.  Spread the mixture on top and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.

name: GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. molasses
5  Tbsp. butter, melted
2/3  c. cold water
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. salt
whipped cream
preparation: Combine egg, sugar, molasses, butter and water.  Mix well. In a large mixing bowl, stir together flour, baking soda, ginger, salt and molasses mixture. Beat until well mixed.  Pour into a greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve warm with whipped cream.

name: KAHLUA LIQUOR
ingredients:
3  oz. instant coffee
2 5/8  c. boiling water
7  c. sugar
5  c. water
1/3  c. vanilla
fifth of vodka
preparation: Boil the instant coffee and 2 5/8 cups boiling water; set aside to cool.  Boil the sugar and 5 cups water for 5 minutes, then cool.  Mix together, then add the vanilla and vodka.  Mix all together; pour into 4 fifth size bottles and seal.  This liquor may not be refrigerated and will keep.  Makes 4 1/2 fifths.

name: BISCUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
2  rolls buttermilk biscuits
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1 (10 oz.)  can pizza sauce
pepperoni, green peppers, mushrooms or any topping desired
preparation: Cut biscuits in quarters.  In a bowl mix sauce and biscuits. Add 1 1/2 cups cheese and toppings.  Mix together.  Pour in a deep-dish pie glass dish sprayed with cooking spray.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  In the last few minutes of cooking sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup of cheese over the top and put back into the oven until cheese is melted.

name: KIDS' FAVORITE SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef, cooked and drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
3/4 soup  can milk
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup
pepper to taste
basil to taste
garlic to taste
mashed potatoes
Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: After meat is cooked and drained, put back in pan and add soups, milk and seasonings.  Heat until blended.  Put into 2 1/2-quart casserole and top with mashed potatoes.  Layer some shredded Cheddar on top and bake at 325° until heated through, about 45 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  oz. shredded cheese
1  c. long grain rice, cooked
1/2  c. sliced mushrooms, drained
1/2  c. diced onion
1/2  c. skim milk
1  Tbsp. and 1 tsp. light margarine
2  pkg. (10 oz. each) frozen chopped broccoli or 3 c. fresh broccoli, cut up and boiled 3 minutes
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients except broccoli and salt.  Cook, stirring constantly, until cheese and margarine are melted, about 2 minutes.  Add broccoli and salt.  Cook, stirring frequently, until heated, 2 minutes.  Turn in casserole.  Bake 30 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) bag broccoli, cooked just past warm and drained
1/2  c. rice (raw), cooked
1/4  c. chopped onion
8  slices Velveeta cheese
3/4  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4 to 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and place in a greased 8 x 8-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.  Stir every now and then.

name: PANSIT(Philippine Main Dish)
ingredients:
1  onion
4  cloves garlic
2  Tbsp. oil
1  c. slightly cooked chicken chunks
1  c. boiled ham chunks
1  c. cooked small shrimp
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  c. sliced cabbage
1/2  lb. cooked vermicelli
salt and pepper
lemon wedges
1  c. seasoned chicken stock
preparation: Saute onion, garlic and oil.  Brown together chicken, ham and shrimp.  Combine with onion mixture and simmer 2 minutes with soy sauce, cabbage and chicken stock.  Add cooked vermicelli, salt and pepper.  Serve with lemon wedges.

name: ZUCCHINI SQUASH BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. oil
1 1/2  c. pecans
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. nutmeg
2  c. grated squash
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Beat eggs first; add sugar, then other ingredients.  Mix well. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  box elbow macaroni
2 (4 oz.)  cans medium shrimp
2  stalks celery, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
3/4  c. mayonnaise
cherry tomatoes (as many as desired)
preparation: Cook noodles using package directions; drain.  Rinse with cold water.  Combine noodles, shrimp, celery, onion and mayonnaise in bowl; mix well.  Chill for 30 minutes to 1 hour before serving.

name: CREAM CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker crust
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
9  oz. cool whip
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Cream together cream cheese and sugar.  Fold in cool whip and pineapple.  Pour into graham cracker crust and chill.

name: ENGLISH TOFFEE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. sugar
1/2  lb. margarine
10  oz. (2 c.) sliced almonds
1/2  c. water
1/2  lb. butter
1/2  c. white syrup
melted Hershey bars and chopped nuts (to cover candy)
preparation: Using a minimum 5-quart heavy gauge pan, stir the above ingredients until the sugar and butter are melted. Allow it to come to a rolling boil and cook without stirring until it reaches the hard-crack stage. This is tricky, but is indicated by smoke coming up and the color turning much darker. If undercooked, it will not harden and if overcooked, it will have a burned taste. Good luck.

name: SCALLOPED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage
2  c. cracker crumbs (reserve some for top)
1  c. cheese, cubed (Longhorn or Cheddar)
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
preparation: Cook the cabbage until tender.  Layer the cabbage, cheese and crumbs in a 2-quart casserole.  Pour the milk over all and top with the remaining crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
3  chicken breasts, boiled and taken off bones
8  crescent rolls
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. milk
1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Open the rolls and fill with the chicken.  Mix the soup, milk and cheese and put half in bottom of dish.  Lay rolls on.  Pour rest of the mixture over top of the rolls.  Bake at 375° for about 25 minutes.  Makes a really good meal by itself.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. vanilla
3  eggs, separated
2  c. milk
1  pkg. vanilla wafers
4  to 6 bananas
preparation: Mix 1/2 cup sugar and flour.  Add milk; stir over low heat until hot, but not boiling.  Beat egg yolks to break up and until light yellow.  Pour some of the hot milk mixture, slowly, into egg yolks, then pour this mixture back into saucepan and cook until slightly thickened.  Add vanilla and pour hot mixture over vanilla wafers and sliced bananas.  Beat 3 egg whites until stiff peaks form.  Slowly add 6 tablespoons sugar, beating well after each. Spoon on pudding and put in oven until lightly browned.  Serve cold.

name: CURRIED CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  chicken breasts
1  pkg. frozen broccoli
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
cheese (optional)
preparation: Cook chicken breasts in salt water until tender.  Drain.  Cut chicken into bite-size pieces and place in bottom of a 1-quart casserole.

name: BROCCOLI  CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  10  oz. pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
4  eggs, beaten
1  large onion, chopped fine
1 1/2  sticks butter or margarine
9  oz. cottage cheese, small curd
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  boxes Jiffy corn muffin mix
preparation: Blend ingredients well, adding muffin mix last.  Bake in a 9x13 inch pan at 400°  for 25 minutes.

name: PRIZE WINNING MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. oatmeal
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. tomato juice
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Press firmly into ungreased 8 x 4-inch loaf pan.  Bake for about 1 hour.  Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

name: MORNING FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  medium size cantaloupe
2  ripe kiwi fruit
1  pt. ripe strawberries
1/2  pt. fresh raspberries or blackberries
2 to 3  Tbsp. chopped fresh mint plus 4 whole sprigs for garnish
1/4  c. freshly squeezed orange juice
preparation: Scoop out cantaloupe with a melon baller and place balls in bowl.  Pour any cantaloupe juice in bowl.  Peel kiwi and cut crosswise into thin slices, then quarter the slices.  Add to cantaloupe. Set aside 4 of the most attractive strawberries for garnish.  Hull and slice enough strawberries lengthwise to make 1 cup.  Place in bowl.  Add raspberries. Sprinkle fruit salad with chopped mint leaves and drizzle with orange juice. Toss gently. Refrigerate, covered, for 1/2 hour and garnish.

name: COUNTRY STYLE PASTA WITH RICOTTA
ingredients:
2 thick  slices bacon, coarsely chopped
1/4  c. extra virgin olive oil
1  medium onion, chopped
1  lb. part-skim Ricotta cheese
1/4  c. coarsely chopped flat leaf parsley
1/4  c. coarsely chopped fresh basil
1  Tbsp. finely chopped scallion green
1 1/3  c. freshly grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. freshly ground pepper
1  lb. penne rigati
preparation: In a large heavy skillet, cook the bacon over moderate heat, stirring occasionally until it is lightly browned and the fat is rendered, about 5 minutes.  Add the oil and onion.  Reduce the heat to low and cook until onion is softened and translucent, about 8 minutes.  Remove from heat and set aside.

name: ORANGE NUT CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
peel of 2 oranges, grated
1  c. pecans
1  c. dates
1  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Cream together margarine and sugar; beat in eggs.  Dissolve soda in buttermilk and add alternately with flour and salt.  Mix in orange peel, nuts, dates and coconut.  Cook in a 300° oven until done.  Bake in a ring pan.

name: STRAWBERRY CREAM SURPRISE(A Cookout And Buffet Favorite)
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. strawberry/banana jello
2  c. boiling water
3  mashed bananas
1  c. crushed pineapple with juice
1  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  pt. sour cream or Cool Whip (depending on sweet tooth)
preparation: Dissolve jello in water.  Add bananas, pineapple and nuts. Mix well.  Pour 1/2 of mixture into an oiled 5 cup mold; Bundt pan is perfect.  Keep remaining 1/2 of mix at room temperature.  Put in freezer for 1 hour.  Remove mold and drop by spoonfuls the sour cream or whipped topping (careful not to spread too close to edges) onto frozen mixture.  Put back into freezer for 45 minutes. Remove and pour remaining mix on top.  Refrigerate until set. Double for large crowds.  Can also use sugar-free jello for this recipe.

name: SNOW ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can condensed milk
1 (5.33 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1  tsp. vanilla
snow
preparation: Mix milks and vanilla.  Gradually beat in snow until ice cream is of desired consistency.  Serves 5.

name: ENGLISH TRIFLE
ingredients:
8  or 9-inch white or yellow cake layer
1/2  c. raspberry, grape or plum jam
1/4 to 1/2  c. sherry
16  oz. can fruits for salad, drained
1  pkg. vanilla pudding and pie filling mix
2 1/2  c. milk
1  c. whipping cream
1/4  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Split cake into two layers.  Fill with jam.  Cut or break into 12 to 15 pieces.  Place in 2 to 2 1/2-quart serving bowl.  Sprinkle sherry over cake.  Spread fruit over cake pieces.  Cook pudding as directed on package using 2 1/2 cups milk.  Cool to room temperature, pour pudding over fruit and cake.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 8 hours.  Three to four hours before serving, whip cream and sweeten with powdered sugar.  Spread over pudding.  Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE LUSH
ingredients:
1  stick softened butter
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. flour
8  oz. soft cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. instant chocolate or butterscotch pudding
1 3/4  c. milk
preparation: Meanwhile mix together and set aside the cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip.  Mix instant chocolate or butterscotch pudding (use only 1 3/4 c. milk).  Spread layer of cream cheese mixture over cooled crust.  Spread out pudding mixture.  Now spread remaining Cool Whip.  Refrigerate.

name: Carrot Casserole
ingredients:
3  c. sliced carrots, steamed or 2 (16 oz.) cans
4  slices bacon, fried and crumbled
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Drain carrots and combine all ingredients except sugar and butter.  Grease a 1-quart casserole dish and add ingredients. Sprinkle sugar and butter on top and cover.  Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

name: PEACH PIE
ingredients:
1  can condensed milk
1 (9 oz.)  can Cool Whip
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 small  pkg. peach Jell-O
2  c. ripe peaches
preparation: Put first 4 ingredients in mixing bowl and blend together, then add chopped peaches.  Pour into graham cracker crusts. Makes 2 pies.  Store in refrigerator 2 hours.

name: ANTS ON THE LOG
ingredients:
4  stalks celery
1  c. peanut butter
30  raisins
preparation: Cut celery into 2-inch lengths.  Stuff with peanut butter. Top each with 2 or 3 raisins.  Arrange on serving plate.  Yields 10 servings.

name: QUICK BEEF MINESTRONE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. lean ground beef or turkey
1  medium onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, crushed
2  cans beef or chicken broth
1  can (20 oz.) cannellini beans
1  can (16 oz.) tomatoes, broken up
1  bay leaf
1  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 large  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In large saucepan, saute meat, onion and garlic; drain off fat. Add broth, beans, tomatoes, bay leaf, basil and pepper; simmer 10 minutes.  Add 1 cup macaroni (elbow or shells, small) and bring to a boil; simmer 10 minutes.  Add vegetables; cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, 10 minutes.  Serve piping hot, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

name: BROCCOLI CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
16  oz. broccoli
garlic salt
1  c. milk
3  eggs
8  oz. Velveeta cheese
1  c. croutons (onion and garlic)
1/2  c. melted butter
preparation: Steam broccoli; place in casserole.  Add garlic salt.  Beat together milk and eggs; pour over broccoli.  Layer Velveeta, croutons and melted butter.  Bake at 350° until brown and bubbly.

name: PURPLE COW
ingredients:
1  C. Milk
3\4 C. Grape Juice
1\4 C. Sugar
1\4 C. Lemon Juice
preparation: Put all ingredients in a Blender, Mix well. Pour into glass, add ice. Enjoy!

name: BIG BUCKET IN THE SKY CHICKEN
ingredients:
3  c. self-rising flour
1  Tbsp. paprika
2  envelopes Lipton tomato Cup-a-Soup powder
2  pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing mix
1  tsp. salt
1/4  lb. butter
1  cut up fryer chicken
preparation: Combine dry ingredients in plastic food bag.  Mix well. Grease a 10 x 15-inch pan. Dredge chicken in dry mixture.  Place in pan, skin side up. Melt butter and drizzle over top. Bake at 375°, uncovered, 45 minutes.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  sticks margarine
3  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. sifted plain flour
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
dash of salt
6  large eggs
preparation: Cream sugar, cream cheese and margarine until light and fluffy.  Add salt and vanilla; beat well.  Add eggs, one at a time; beat well after each.  Add flour.  Bake in tube pan at 325° for about 1 1/2 hours.

name: SUMMER PUNCH
ingredients:
2  cans frozen lemonade
2  cans Awake frozen juice
1  qt. ginger ale
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
preparation: Mix all ingredients, diluting the frozen juices in the ginger ale and pineapple juice.  Pour over the frozen strawberries. Makes approximately 6 quarts.

name: WTTF CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  lb. cranberries
scant pt. water
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. soda
1  c. sugar
1 small  box strawberry Jell-O
15  small marshmallows
1  c. diced apples
1  c. diced celery
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and boil 10 minutes.  Add soda, sugar and Jell-O.  Stir until dissolved.  Add marshmallows.  Cool and add remaining ingredients.

name: MARINATED VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
1/2  c. salad oil
1  Tbsp. water
1  large bell pepper, diced
1  can water chestnuts
1  large purple onion, sliced
1  c. celery, coarsely chopped
1  can tiny English peas, drained
1  can French green beans, drained
1  can white Shoe Peg corn, drained
1  jar pimento, drained
preparation: Mix pepper, salt, sugar, vinegar, salad oil and water.  Bring to a rolling boil.  Set aside to cool.  Pour liquid over the combined vegetables.  Let this sit in the refrigerator overnight before serving.

name: BEEF ROAST AND GRAVY
ingredients:
1  boneless chuck roast
1  pkg. dehydrated onion soup
1  pkg. dehydrated mushroom soup
1  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Put oil in pan.  Heat on high until oil is hot.  Brown roast on each side; turn heat down to 300°.  Put 1 cup water in pan, add soup and put lid on or foil over.  Cook until meat is tender. Takes about 2 hours or more.  Makes its own gravy.  Can cook in oven or on top of stove.

name: TOMATO LOAF SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. tomato soup
2 1/4  Tbsp. plain gelatin
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. chopped olives
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. cold water
1/4  c. walnuts, chopped
1/4  c. green pepper, chopped
preparation: Dissolve gelatin  in  cold water.  Heat soup to boiling point and add cheese.  Add gelatin and beat until smooth.  Set aside to cool.  Add vegetables, nuts and mayo.  Pour into loaf tin and when firm, slice and serve on lettuce.  Can be made in small cupcake tins and unmold one on a lettuce leaf.

name: APPLESAUCE MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine (soft)
2  c. sugar
4  c. flour
2  eggs
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
2  tsp. vanilla
1  can applesauce
2  tsp. soda
4  oz. cream cheese (optional)
preparation: Cream sugar and margarine.  Beat in eggs.  Combine applesauce and soda; add to the creamed mixture with flour and spices.  Add vanilla and mix well.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  These are delicious served warm for breakfast.  If using cream cheese, add while creaming the sugar and margarine. I like to just cut a little chunk and insert into each muffin before baking.

name: ORANGE-SESAME DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. orange juice
1/4  c. red wine vinegar
1/4  c. olive oil
1  Tbsp. Ku
2  Tbsp. sesame oil
1/2  tsp. dry mustard or 1 tsp. Dijon mustard
1  orange, peeled, sliced and quartered
1  garlic clove, crushed
2 to 3  Tbsp. sesame seed
preparation: Good for spinach salad or lettuce salad (romaine, iceberg or green leaf mixture).

name: NEW YORK CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. cottage cheese
1  lb. cream cheese
1 3/4  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. flour
1/4  lb. melted butter
1  lb. sour cream
preparation: Blend the cottage cheese and cream cheese.  Add the sugar to cheese mixture.  Blend the eggs, lemon juice, vanilla, cornstarch, flour and butter to the cheese mixture.  Blend in sour cream. Pour into greased spring-form pan.  Place in a cold oven.  Set at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.  Turn off heat.  Let stay for 2 hours. Refrigerate for 6 hours.  Serve with fruit or plain.

name: SNOOKY'S BAKED SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can squash
1  egg
1  onion, diced
1  Tbsp. melted butter
1  c. Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix
preparation: Drain water from one can of squash.  Add one well beaten egg, diced onion, melted butter and stuffing mix.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Mix well.  Put in casserole and bake in moderate oven, 325°, until light brown and firm, approximately 20 to 30 minutes.

name: LENTIL LOAF
ingredients:
1  c. cooked lentils or beans
1/2 to 3/4  c. chopped celery
1  egg
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated skim milk
3/4  c. wheat bran
3/4  c. corn flakes or bread crumbs
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2 to 3/4  tsp. sage
3  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients together thoroughly.  Place in an oiled 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan and bake for 45 minutes.  Lentil loaf is so moist that it needs no gravy or sauce.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: TURTLES
ingredients:
2  pkg. caramels
1  can Eagle Brand milk
4  c. pecans
1  chocolate bark
preparation: Melt caramels in Eagle Brand milk.  Stir in pecans and spoon onto buttered pan.  Let chill in refrigerator.  Melt chocolate bark and dip and put on greased pan.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs, beaten
3  bananas
3  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
pinch of salt
1  c. walnuts
1  c. cherries
preparation: Cream sugar and butter.  Add remaining ingredients and mix. Pour into a bread pan and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. cottage cheese
1  (8 oz.) container plain yogurt
2  Tbsp. fresh dill weed, chopped or 1 Tbsp. dry dill weed
1/4  c. onion, finely chopped
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. white pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients and chill at least 1 hour.  Serve with raw vegetables or with crackers.  Yield: 2 1/2 cups.

name: SOUR CREAM RAISIN BARS
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. oatmeal
1 1/3  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  c. butter
4  egg yolks
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  c. raisins
2  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients.  Pat half of the mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: NEW ENGLAND CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
2 (15 oz. each)  cans Jake's soup
1  gal. whole milk
3  large onions, chopped
3  ribs celery, chopped
3  to 4 carrots, chopped
juice from drained clams
1  Tbsp. butter seasoning
2  pt. half and half
8  medium potatoes, chopped
1 (51 oz.)  can chopped clams
2  sticks butter or oleo
4  slices bacon, chopped
salt and pepper
preparation: Cut bacon into small bits; saute, but do not crisp.  Saute chopped onions with bacon, then add celery and saute.  Add juice from clams and water to make 2 cups.  Add chopped potatoes and chopped carrots and cook until tender.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Add chopped clams and cook 5 minutes.  Add butter or oleo. Add 2 cans Jake's soup if you need a larger amount.  Just before serving, add cream and milk to desired consistency.

name: APPLESAUCE BEEF LOAF
ingredients:
1  c. soft bread crumbs (about 1 1/2 slices)
1/2  c. applesauce
1  lb. ground beef
1  slightly beaten egg
1/4  c. finely chopped celery
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1  tsp. Dijon-style mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Blend thoroughly; shape into a round loaf in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan.  With spoon, make a crater depression in top of loaf.

name: MARSHMALLOW FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
7  oz. marshmallow cream
8  oz. cream cheese
color (any color)
preparation: Mix in container and chill.  Serve with fresh fruit.  Use as dip for fruit tray at parties.

name: ONE DISH MICROWAVE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo
6  Tbsp. oleo
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: In 8 x 8-inch microwave-safe dish, melt oleo and cocoa on stove.  Remove from heat and add sugar and eggs.  Stir in flour, baking powder and nuts.  Microwave for 5 minutes, turning once halfway.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. cooked rice
2  eggs, divided
1  Tbsp. powdered sugar
1  c. milk
1  c. canned cream
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
1/8  tsp. cinnamon or nutmeg (optional)
preparation: Beat  egg  yolks  until  thick  and  lemon colored in a mixing bowl;  add 2 tablespoons of the milk and cream mixture. Place remainder  of  milk  and cream in a double boiler.  Set over medium heat.  Wash raisins and put in the milk mixture in the boiler.  Cook  until  soft,  about 15 minutes.  Add rice. Cook 5 minutes longer, then stir in the yolks, salt, sugar and spice. Stir until well blended, about 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove from heat. Pour into 3-quart pudding pan.

name: CHICKEN AND STUFFING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. chicken
1  box of stuffing (Stove Top chicken flavored is good)
2  c. broccoli (frozen or fresh)
2  c. mushrooms (canned or fresh)
1  stick butter or margarine
preparation: Put chicken, broccoli, mushrooms and margarine in a large frying pan and cook until done.  Prepare stuffing as directed on package.  Mix stuffing and chicken mixture together in a casserole dish.  Add gravy to moisten.  Serves 4.

name: BARBECUED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
2 (12 oz.)  cans pork and beans
3/4  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. mustard
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
10  strips bacon
preparation: Brown beef and onion.  Add beans, catsup, vinegar, brown sugar, mustard and Worcestershire sauce.  Put in casserole dish. Top with bacon strips.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
2  medium size hens
2  pkg. spaghetti
1/2  lb. grated cheese
preparation: Cook hens slowly in a small amount of water until tender. Take meat off the bones and cut in bite size pieces.

name: NO-BAKE MINI CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  box Jell-O cheesecake
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/3  c. margarine, melted
1/2  c. cold milk
preparation: Mix cheesecake crumbs, sugar and margarine.  Press into bottom of each of 12 paper or foil-lined muffin cups with spoon or bottom of glass.  Beat milk and filling mix until blended.  Beat on medium speed for 3 minutes.  Filling will be thick.  Spoon over crumb mixture in muffin cups.  Refrigerate.  Garnish with fruit, nuts or chocolate.  Preparation time:  15 minutes.

name: CHERRY PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter
1  egg
2  c. flour
2/3  c. milk
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1  qt. cherries
1  c. sugar
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix sugar and butter, then add egg and stir.  Add flour and baking powder.  Add milk, vanilla and salt.  Mix all these things together.  Seed cherries and add.  Add next cup of sugar and mix and pour over top of batter.  Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes or until done.

name: CORNED BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can corned beef
1  c. milk
1/4  lb. Velveeta cheese, cut in pieces
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of chicken
8  oz. macaroni, uncooked
preparation: Mix together meat, soup, milk, chopped onion and cheese. Layer in casserole with cooked macaroni.  Top with buttered crumbs.  Bake at 375° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: CREAMY PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. canned pumpkin
1/2  c. cold milk
1 (6 serving)  pkg. Jell-O vanilla instant pudding
1  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
3 1/2  c. thawed Cool Whip
1  graham cracker pie crust
preparation: Combine pumpkin, milk, pudding mix and pumpkin pie spice in small mixer bowl.  Blend with wire whisk or electric mixer (low) for 1 minute.  Fold in 2 1/2 cups of the Cool Whip.

name: CALICO/HOBO BEANS
ingredients:
6  slices bacon
1  medium onion
1 to 2  cloves garlic
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. ketchup
1  can pork and beans, drained
1  can butter beans, drained
1  can dark red kidney beans, drained
1  tsp. mustard
salt and pepper to taste
2  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Fry bacon and pour off most of the grease.  Take the bacon out and fry onion until it is beginning to brown, adding garlic and hamburger.  Fry all on fairly high heat until it's golden brown. Drain off most liquid in the cans of beans and add beans to the skillet with the hamburger mixture. Add brown sugar, ketchup, mustard and vinegar.  Stir it all together.  Put in a buttered baking dish, crumbling the bacon on top.  Bake for 30 to 40 minutes and serve over rice or just by itself.  You could add celery or parsley to the hamburger, if you like.  Cheese is good melted on top while it's in the oven.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake mix
1  (14 oz.) bag caramels
3/4  c. butter
1  c. evaporated milk
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix cake per directions. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch cake pan and pour half the batter in. Bake 15 minutes at 350°.  In a saucepan, melt caramels over low heat. Add milk and butter. Remove cake from oven and pour mixture over cake.  Add chocolate chips and nuts. Pour remaining cake batter over the top and bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

name: BIBLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Judges 5:25 (of last ingredients, butter)
2  c. Jeremiah 6:20 (of second thing mentioned comes from a far off country, sugar)
6  c. Isaiah 10:14 (crack all 6 in batter, then mix, eggs)
3 1/2  c. 1 Kings 4:22 (first ingredients sift, then add, flour)
1/2  tsp. Leviticus 2:13 (ingredients mentioned 3 times, salt)
2  tsp. 1 Corinthians 5:6 (baking powder)
1/4  tsp. each of 3 different ones mentioned after camels that fare (cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves)
1  c. Genesis 24:11 (water)
1  Tbsp. Exodus 16:31 (last ingredient, honey)
2  c. 1 Samuel 25:18 (last ingredients mentions, raisins and figs)
1  c. chopped Genesis 43:11 (last thing, almonds)
preparation: Grease and flour 2 (9-inch) cake pans.  Follow Solomon's advice (2 Samuel 22:43, first choice, beat).  Mix well, then pour into pans.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: OLD-FASHIONED EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
4  eggs
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. melted oleo
1  deep dish pie shell (unbaked)
preparation: Combine dry ingredients.  Add beaten eggs and mix well.  Stir in oleo and milk.  Pour into pie shell and bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then reduce to 325° for 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND BROCCOLI
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
fresh or frozen broccoli
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. lemon juice
curry powder to taste
sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook chicken and debone.  Cook broccoli until done.  Chop up the chicken and then the broccoli.  Layer in a casserole dish. Mix in a bowl, soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder. Pour over chicken and broccoli.  Grate cheese and put on top. Bake at 350° until cheese melts.  Serve hot.

name: WESTERN POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  sticks (3/4 lb.) butter
1  lb. powdered sugar
6  eggs
1  lb. box sifted flour
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Have eggs and butter room temperature.  Cream butter; add sugar and beat until fluffy.  Add eggs one at a time; beat well after each addition.  Sift flour 3 times; add gradually to batter. Add flavorings.  Bake in well-greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.  Cool 4 minutes.  Then invert pan.

name: FABULOUS FUDGE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. Pet milk
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips or 1 c. peanut butter chips
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients in heavy 2-quart saucepan.  Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat to a boil (mixture will be bubbling all over top).  Boil and stir 5 minutes more; take off heat. Stir in until completely melted the chocolate chips or peanut butter chips.  Stir in vanilla and chopped nuts.  Spread in buttered 8-inch pan.  Cool and cut into 30 pieces.

name: EASY BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2 16  oz. cans Pork n Beans
1/4  C. chopped onions
1  C. brown sugar
2  tsp. yellow mustard
1/2  C. catsup
1/2  jar Hormel real bacon bits
preparation: Combine ingredients. Bake 30 minutes uncovered at 400 degrees.

name: CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can condensed milk
1  large Cool Whip
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  c. chopped pecans
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Mix all ingredients well; store in large container and refrigerate.

name: IT'S A WINNER CHILI
ingredients:
2  lb. lean ground beef
1 (18 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  large onion, finely chopped
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  c. chili powder
1  tsp. oregano
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. ground cumin
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
1/2 (6 oz.)  can beer
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/4  tsp. Tabasco sauce
preparation: Sear meat in covered 2-quart pan with vegetable oil. Add tomato sauce, onion and garlic powder. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Add water if necessary. Simmer for 30  more minutes. Serve with a side dish of pinto beans, chopped onions or Cheddar cheese for garnishes. Yield: 10 servings.

name: SWEET AND TARTY SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. raspberry Jell-O
1  can cranberry sauce
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 large  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Melt cranberry sauce with package of Jell-O.  Add other ingredients.  Pour in mold or bowl and chill until set.  Goes great with meat, especially at Thanksgiving or Christmas.

name: AMISH ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. granulated sugar
1  c. salad oil
3  eggs
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. grated, raw zucchini
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix sugar, oil and eggs together; stir well.  Sift together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon.  Stir in with the first ingredients.  Add vanilla, grated zucchini and nuts.  Put in 2 greased loaf pans.  Bake in 350° oven for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: HEARTY HAMBURG SOUP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. sliced carrots
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  lb. lean ground beef
2  c. tomato or V-8 juice
1  c. diced potatoes
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
4  c. milk
1/3  c. flour
preparation: In a large saucepan, melt margarine.  Add onion, carrot and green pepper.  Cook until onion is tender (not brown).  Add beef; cook until meat is crumbly.  Stir in tomato juice.  Add potatoes and seasonings.  Cook over low heat until vegetables are tender (25 to 30 minutes).  Combine flour with 1 cup milk (add milk to flour a little at a time and stir until free of lumps).  Stir into soup mixture.  Add rest of milk and heat; stir frequently.  Do not let boil.

name: COCA-COLA PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
1/2  c. ketchup
1  can Coke
pork chops
preparation: Mix ketchup and Coke well and pour over pork chops.  Cook in 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: YAYA'S CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/4  c. Heinz 57
1/4  c. lime juice
1/4  c. orange juice
1  tsp. paprika
1  c. water
preparation: Submerge 24 hours.  Discard marinade; cook.

name: DEVILED HAM SPREAD
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1 (2 oz.)  can deviled ham
1  Tbsp. sweet pickle relish
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1/4  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
preparation: Combine cream cheese and deviled ham in bowl; mix well.  Add relish, mustard, salt and pepper.  Mix well.  Chill until ready to serve.

name: SLAW
ingredients:
1  1/4 heads cabbage, grated
1  pt. canned tomatoes
1  large green pepper, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. vinegar
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mash tomatoes.  Mix all ingredients together.  Refrigerate. Will keep almost indefinitely.  Excellent on hot dogs or hamburgers.

name: "AWARD WINNING" SNOW COVERED CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box chocolate cake mix
1 1/4  c. water
1/3  c. vegetable oil
3  eggs
1 (3.5 oz.)  can coconut flakes (optional)
1 (16 oz.)  can vanilla frosting
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with shortening, butter, or margarine.  Beat cake mix, water, oil, and eggs in large bowl on low speed 30 seconds.  Beat on medium speed 2 minutes or 299 strokes by hand.  Pour into pan.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Check with toothpick.  Cool for 10 minutes.  Frost completely.  Add coconut flakes (optional).

name: LEMON SPONGE PIE
ingredients:
1  lemon
1  c. milk
1  c. sugar
pinch of salt
2  Tbsp. oleo
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Use lemon juice and grate 1/2 of peel.  Beat together lemon peel, sugar, oleo and flour.  Add egg yolks.  Slowly add milk. Beat egg whites stiff, then fold in.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: TAMI'S BEST CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
4  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
5  eggs
8  oz. sour cream
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. heavy cream
preparation: Beat softened cream cheese and add other ingredients in order listed, one at a time.  Pour into crust.  Bake at 300° at 1 1/2 hours or until set.  Chill and garnish with fruit.

name: LOBSTER MEAT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter
1  clove garlic, minced
2  lbs. lobster meat
1/2  c. cracker crumbs
3/4  c. Monterey Jack cheese
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  Melt butter, add garlic and cook 1 minute - do not brown.  Put lobster meat in buttered casserole dish and toss with melted butter.  Sprinkle with cracker crumbs then cheese.  Bake 12 - 15 minutes or until lobster is heated and cheese is melted.

name: HIDDEN VALLEY RANCH CRUNCHY PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, thawed
1  c. diced celery
1  c. chopped cauliflower
1/4  c. diced green onions
1  c. chopped cashews
1  c. prepared Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing original Ranch
bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Chill.  Garnish just before serving.

name: BAKED FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. flour
1  c. pecans
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. melted butter
4  eggs
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients together and then add the rest, mix well.  Bake in 11x8 inch pan placed into a 13x9 inch pan of shallow water.  Bake at 300° for 45-60 minutes.  Check for crispy top but soft inside.

name: OVEN BAKED POTATO CHIP CHICKEN
ingredients:
5  chicken breasts
2  c. crushed potato chips
salt and pepper
onion salt
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Wash chicken; remove skin and dip chicken in beaten egg. Place chicken in crushed potato chips and press both sides so chicken is evenly covered.  Place chicken in pan after putting a little oil in pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Makes 5 servings. Good with Easy Potato Bake.

name: CHEDDAR-BEER SPREAD
ingredients:
1/2  lb. grated Cheddar chez
1 chopped  clove garlic
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
Tabasco
1/4  c. beer
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix until smooth 'n serve on crackers.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE DILL ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg yeast
1/2  C water
2  C cottage cheese
4  tbsp sugar
2  eggs
2  tbsp onion
2  tbsp butter or margarine
4  tbsp dill seed
2  tsp salt
1/2  tsp soda
5  C flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  carton sour cream
preparation: Cream sugar and margarine; add eggs and beat.  Add other ingredients and beat well.  Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 15 minutes.  Reduce heat to 300° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: CHEESY POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
1  large bag frozen hash brown potatoes
1 large  carton sour cream
1  can cream of potato soup
1  large bag shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Butter or  spray  Pam  on  bottom  and sides of a large oblong baking dish.  Combine  potatoes, sour cream and soup in a large bowl;  salt and pepper  to	taste.	Put in baking dish and spread evenly.  Cover  top  with shredded cheese.	Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: HAWAIIAN SEAFOOD STIR-FRY
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. soy sauce, divided
