2  Tbsp. cornstarch, divided
1/2  lb. medium shrimp, shelled
1/2  lb. bay scallops
1/2  c. chicken broth
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil, divided
1  green pepper, cut in large chunks
1  onion, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
1  Tbsp. ginger root, minced
1/2  c. sliced carrots
preparation: Combine 1 tablespoon soy sauce and 1 tablespoon cornstarch. Add shrimp and scallops; mix well.  In small bowl, drain juice from pineapple.  Add broth, 3 tablespoons soy sauce and 1 tablespoon cornstarch.  In large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon oil; stir-fry seafood for 2 minutes and remove from pan.  Add 1 tablespoon oil and heat.  Stir-fry green pepper, onion, carrots and ginger for 3 minutes.  Add seafood, pineapple and sauce.  Cook and stir until mixture boils and thickens.  Serve over rice.  Makes 4 to 5 servings.

name: LEBANESE SALAD(Tabbouleh)
ingredients:
1  c. fine cracked wheat (bulghur)*
2 large  bunches parsley**
2  medium tomatoes
1  bunch scallions or onions
1/2  bunch green mint
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. olive oil
preparation: *Bulghur may be purchased from Andy's Deli on Park Lane or health food store.

name: CHOCOLATE CHERRY BARS
ingredients:
1  pkg. fudge cake mix
1  can cherry fruit filling
1  tsp. almond extract
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Grease 15 x 10-inch cookie sheet.  In large bowl, combine first 4 ingredients by hand.  Stir until well mixed.  Pour into pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: PANCAKES
ingredients:
3/4  c. milk
1  egg
1  Tbsp. margarine, melted
2  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix flour, baking powder, salt and sugar in large bowl.  Add milk, egg and margarine and stir until smooth.  Fry in skillet or griddle until brown on each side.  Yields 20 to 21 medium size pancakes.

name: CHOCOLATE PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. Baker's German's sweet chocolate
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1  c. corn syrup
1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. pecan halves
1  unbaked 9-inch pie shell
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Microwave chocolate and margarine or butter in a large microwavable bowl on High for 2 minutes or until margarine or butter is completely melted.  Stir in corn syrup, sugar, eggs and vanilla until well blended.  Stir in pecans, reserving 8 halves for garnish, if desired.   Pour filling into pie shell.  Bake for 55 minutes or until knife inserted 1-inch from center comes out clean.  Cool on wire rack.  Garnish with whipped topping and reserved pecan halves, if desired.

name: CHEESY POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash browns
1  pt. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. melted margarine
salt and pepper to taste
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Thaw hash browns apart. Combine all ingredients; bake 2 1/2 to 3 hours at 325°.

name: MARTHA'S COMPANY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1  tsp. salt
8  oz. noodles
1  Tbsp. green pepper
1  c. cottage cheese
8  oz. cream cheese
1/4  c. sour cream
1/3  c. green onions, chopped
preparation: Brown hamburger; stir in tomato sauce and salt.  Remove from heat.  Cook noodles, drain and rinse.  Combine cream cheese, cottage cheese, sour cream, onions and green pepper.  In a 2-quart casserole, spread half the noodles.  Cover with cheese mixture. Cover with remaining noodles.  Put hamburger mixture on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BLUEBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine, melted
2  c. flour (self-rising)
1  c. pecans chopped
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
1 1/2 to 2  cans blueberry pie filling
preparation: Whip the cream cheese until fluffy; beat in sugar and milk. Fold Cool Whip into mixture and spread over cooled crust.  Spread blueberry pie filling over top of this mixture.  Refrigerate.

name: ESCALLOPED PINEAPPLE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
4  c. soft bread crumbs
preparation: Mix eggs and sugar.  Blend in milk, margarine, pineapple and bread crumbs.  Pour into a well-greased casserole and bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes at 350°.  Especially good served with baked ham instead of sweet potatoes.

name: PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 large  cans drained chunk pineapple
4  Tbsp. flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. grated mild cheese
1  pack Ritz crackers, crushed
1/2  stick margarine or melted butter
preparation: Mix flour, sugar and grated mild cheese.  Layer all ingredients in order.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

name: HONEY-ORANGE GLAZED HAM
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ham
1/4  c. orange juice concentrate
1/4  c. honey
3  to 4 carrots
preparation: Place carrots in bottom of crock-pot to form rack.  Mix orange juice and honey together and pour over ham and carrots.  Cook on low heat for 6 to 8 hours.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. taco sauce mix
1/2  head lettuce
3  tomatoes
1  pkg. taco cheese
1  pkg. taco chips
preparation: Prepare ground beef and taco sauce according to directions on package.  Shred lettuce.  Chop tomatoes and drain.  Mix together all ingredients except taco chips.  At last minute before serving, crush taco chips and toss with other ingredients.

name: OXTAILS ROMANA
ingredients:
3 to 5  lb. oxtails
3/4 to 1  c. onion, finely chopped
3/4 to 1  c. celery, finely chopped
1/2  tsp. rosemary
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. thyme
3 to 5  c. water
1 to 1 1/2  c. dry vermouth
2  c. artichoke hearts
1  c. sliced mushrooms
3/4  c. pimento-stuffed olives, halved
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown oxtails in 1 tablespoon oil (they will make more as they brown), using ovenproof Dutch oven or other large pot that has a cover.  Turn oxtails with tongs until nicely browned on all sides.

name: MUSTARD DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. dry mustard
4  tsp. soy sauce
2  tsp. grated onion or instant onion flakes
1  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Let chill.  This dip is good for raw vegetables (carrots, cauliflower, celery, etc.).  Also good for crackers and chips.

name: HAM & CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  pkg. ham slices, chopped
2  slices American cheese, chopped
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. ketchup
Nuts or pecans (optional)
preparation: Mix by hand softened cream cheese, ham, American cheese, onion and ketchup. Shape into ball. Cover with nuts or pecans if desired. Refrigerate. Serve with crackers.

name: POOR MAN'S BAKED CUBED STEAK
ingredients:
3  lb. hamburger
1  c. milk
1  c. cracker crumbs
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Mix together the hamburger, milk and cracker crumbs.  Pat down in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Cut 3 across times 5 down.  Flour and brown.  Put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Pour the cream of mushroom soup and 1 cup water over hamburger mixture.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

name: BANANA SPLIT BROWNIE PIZZA(From Pampered Chef)
ingredients:
1 (approximately 21 oz.)  pkg. brownie mix
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2/3  c. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
banana slices
strawberry slices
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  oz. semi-sweet chocolate
1  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Prepare brownie mix according to package directions.  Using parchment paper on 15-inch baking stone, pour mixture on paper and spread into 14-inch circle.  (Do not bake without paper, or batter will run off.  If not using baking stone or paper, use a shallow pan.)  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until set.  Cool to room temperature.

name: OATMEAL PEANUT BUTTER CHOCOLATE CHIPS COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine, softened
1 (8 oz.)  jar chunky peanut butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
4  large eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
6  c. quick oats
2 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. (6 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate morsels
preparation: Beat margarine and peanut butter until fluffy.  Gradually add sugars, beating well.  Add eggs and vanilla and mix well.  Combine oats and soda.  Add to margarine mixture.  Mix well.  Add chocolate morsels.  Drop by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet.  Bake at 350° for 9 to 11 minutes.  Cool on cookie sheet 5 minutes; remove to wire rack to cool completely.  Yields 7 dozen.

name: CROCK-POT KIELBASA
ingredients:
3  cans beer
1 small  bottle ketchup
1 small  jar mustard
1  tsp. vinegar
3/4  c. brown sugar
2  or 3 kielbasa
preparation: Boil kielbasa in beer for 10 minutes.  Combine ketchup, mustard, vinegar and sugar in crock-pot.  Cut kielbasa in small bite size pieces and place in crock-pot.  Cook on high for 2 to 3 hours or low for 3 to 5 hours.  Enjoy.

name: BAKED ASPARAGUS
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. green pepper
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  lb. can asparagus
3  hard-boiled eggs
1/2  c. buttered bread crumbs
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook until thick first 7 ingredients.  Place in layers, asparagus, eggs, then sauce.  Top with bread crumbs and cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  stewing hen
3  c. flour (plain)
1  egg
broth from chicken
preparation: Place hen in large pot and add water to 2 or 3-inches above it. Cook until tender, adding water if necessary. Remove chicken from broth when tender. Mix flour and egg with enough broth to make a medium dough. Knead until stiff enough to roll. Roll with rolling pin and let stand for 5 minutes. Cut dough into thin squares and drop into boiling chicken broth. Simmer for 10 minutes and let stand in covered pot for 10 more minutes. Serve piping hot with chicken.

name: SCRIPTURE CAKE
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. sifted all-purpose flour (1 Kings 4:22)
1  Tbsp. baking powder (Galatians 5:9)
1/4  tsp. salt (Leviticus 2:13)
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. allspice (1 Kings 10:2)
1  c. butter, softened (Judges 5:25)
2  c. firmly packed brown sugar (Jeremiah 6:20)
2  Tbsp. honey (Exodus 16:31)
6  eggs (Luke 11:12)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. pitted dates, chopped (Deuteronomy 34:3)
2  c. raisins (1 Samuel 30:12)
1  c. walnuts, chopped (Solomon 6:11)
1  c. milk (Judges 5:25)
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and allspice onto wax paper.  Beat butter, sugar, honey and eggs in large bowl with electric mixer at high speed until light and fluffy.  Sprinkle 1/4 cup flour mixture over the fruits and nuts. Add remaining flour mixture alternately with the milk to the fluffy butter mixture, beating until smooth.  Stir in fruits and nuts. Spoon into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched.  Cool in pan on rack 20 minutes; loosen around edge and center with knife; turn out on rack; cool.  Wrap in foil or plastic.  Slices best the next day.

name: SUPER DIET MALT
ingredients:
8  oz. skim milk (liquid)
1  pkg. chocolate Alba 77
1/2  pkg. sugar substitute
1  Tbsp. vanilla
6  or 7 ice cubes
preparation: Put all in blender and let whip until thick.  Umm good.

name: SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. dried mustard (optional)
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. garlic
1  c. oil
2/3  c. vinegar
4  Tbsp. lemon (optional)
1  bottle empty, unrinsed ketchup bottle, small amount in bottle
preparation: Using funnel, pour ingredients into ketchup bottle.  Shake well before each use.

name: BLUEBERRY COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
4  c. blueberries
preparation: Beat first 7 ingredients for 1/2 minute; stir in blueberries. Fill two 9-inch cake pans halfway.  Sprinkle with topping.  Bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 375°.  Cool slightly before glazing (optional).

name: CHICKEN CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
1/2  cup chopped green onion
1 or 2  cloves garlic, minced
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  cans cream of potato soup
1 1/2 soup  cans milk
1  can corn (shoe peg used)
1  8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
4  boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1 inch pieces (raw)
preparation: In large soup crock pot cook onions and garlic in butter until tender.  Blend in soup, cream cheese and milk.  Add chicken and corn.  Sprinkle in cayenne.  Bring slowly to a boil, stirring frequently, as it tends to stick.  Simmer on low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

name: BATTER PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
sliced peaches
1  stick oleo
1  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Line 9 x 9-inch pan with sliced peaches.  Combine oleo, flour, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder, salt, milk and vanilla.  Pour over peaches.  Combine 1 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water; pour over batter. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BEEF 'N TATER BAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1  beaten egg
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/3  c. Heinz tomato ketchup
3  c. hot mashed potatoes
1  c. shredded American cheese
preparation: Combine first 7 ingredients.  Pat meat into an 8-inch square baking dish.  Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.  Remove from oven; drain excess fat.  Combine 3 cups hot mashed potatoes and 3/4 cup shredded cheese and spread over meat.  Top with 1/4 cup shredded cheese.  Bake for 20 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SPOON BREAD(Cornbread Souffle)
ingredients:
3  c. milk
1 1/4  c. white cornmeal
3  eggs
2  Tbsp. butter
1 3/4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Stir meal into rapidly boiling milk.  Cook until very thick. Stir constantly to prevent scorching.  Remove from heat.  Allow to cool.  Let mix become cold and stiff (if time permits).  Add well beaten eggs, salt, baking powder and melted butter.  Beat with mixer for 15 minutes (if time permits).  Pour into well-greased casserole pan or iron skillet.  Bake for 30 minutes at 375°. Serve immediately with lots of butter.  (The souffle will fall.)

name: CINNAMON CHIP GEMS
ingredients:
1  c. (2 sticks) butter or margarine, softened
2  pkg. (3 oz. each) cream cheese, softened
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. ground toasted almonds
2  eggs
1  can (14 oz.) Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1 1/3  c. Hershey Cinnamon chips, divided
preparation: Beat butter and cream cheese in large bowl until well blended; stir in flour, sugar and almonds.  Cover; refrigerate about 1 hour.  Divide dough into 4 equal parts. Shape each part into 12 smooth balls.  Place each ball in small muffin cup (1 3/4 inches in diameter); press evenly on bottom and up side of each cup.  Heat oven to 375°.  Beat eggs in small bowl.  Add Eagle Brand  and vanilla; mix well place 7 Hershey Cinnamon Chips in bottom of each muffin cup; fill a generous 3/4 full with Eagle Brand mixture.  Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until tops are puffed and just beginning to turn golden brown.  Cool 3 minutes. Sprinkle about 15 chips on top of the filling.  Cool completely in pan on rack.  Remove from pan using small metal spatula or sharp knife. Cool and store at room temperature.  Makes about 4 dozen.

name: TUNA BURGERS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can tuna
1  c. chopped celery (optional)
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  small onion, diced
1/4  c. mayonnaise
salt and pepper to taste
6  hamburger buns
preparation: Mix tuna, celery, cheese, onion, mayonnaise, salt and pepper in bowl. Blend thoroughly. Split hamburger buns and butter the insides. Fill buns with tuna mixture and replace tops. Line a 9 x 13 baking dish with aluminum foil and place filled buns in dish on foil. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with chips or French fries.

name: MOM'S DORCAS CAKE
ingredients:
1  box raisins
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening (1 stick butter)
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
4  c. flour
preparation: Boil raisins 15 minutes in 3 cups water, then add 1 cup cold water, shortening and sugar. Mix dry ingredients together and add to raisin mixture. Do not overmix. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan at 350° for 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center of cake comes out clean.

name: TEXAS-STYLE BEEF BRISKET
ingredients:
1  brisket of beef (4 to 6 lb. after trimming)
1  envelope onion soup mix
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can beef bouillon or beef broth
1/4  c. onion, finely chopped
1/2  tsp. hot red pepper, crushed
preparation: Spread dry soup mix over surface of brisket, then wrap securely, using at least 3 layers of heavy-duty foil.  Seal foil well to hold in all the juices.  Start fire in your barbecue. When coals are white hot, move them to one side.   Place foil wrapped brisket on rack, but not directly above coals.  Cover grill; cook brisket for 3 hours, turning once.  Remove brisket carefully from wrappings, pouring drippings off into glass measuring cup.  Return brisket to grill rack, directly over coals this time, and cook, uncovered, for 30 minutes, until crusty brown, basting with drippings from time to time.

name: AMBROSIA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
3  medium oranges, peeled and sectioned
1/2  c. maraschino cherries, halved and drained
1/2  c. flaked or shredded coconut
fresh mint leaves
preparation: Drain pineapple chunks, reserving 1/4 cup of syrup.  Combine pineapple chunks, reserved pineapple syrup or orange sections and maraschino cherries.  Cover; chill thoroughly.  Just before serving fold in coconut.  Garnish with fresh mint leaves, if desired. Makes 6 servings.

name: OLD FASHION TOMATO SOUP
ingredients:
2  qt. tomatoes
2  qt. water
1/2  stick butter
3  Tbsp. meal
dash of sugar
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Bring tomatoes and water to boil.  Add butter.  Mix meal in small amount of cold water.  When meal dissolves, then add small amount of hot water.  Add to tomatoes. Add salt, pepper and sugar. Boil until tomatoes are well done.

name: GARLIC BUTTER MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
2  doz. large mushrooms
1/2  c. butter
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  shallots, minced
1/2  c. minced parsley
juice from 1/2 lemon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Clean mushrooms, removing stems. Combine butter, shallots, garlic and parsley. Process. Add lemon juice, salt and pepper. Blend briefly. Place mushrooms in a shallow baking dish. Fill each mushroom with a dollop of garlic butter mixture (about 1/2 or 1 teaspoon each). Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: SEAFOOD MOLD
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  can crab meat or 1 (7 oz.) can salmon or 1/2 lb. surami
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. grated onion
1  c. finely chopped celery
1  c. mayonnaise
1 (10 oz.)  can mushroom soup
1  packet unflavored Knox gelatine, dissolved in 3 Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Dissolve gelatine in cold water.  Set aside.  Over medium heat bring soup to boil, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Stir in gelatine until dissolved.  Set aside to cool.

name: SOURDOUGH STARTER AND BREAD
ingredients:
1  envelope dry yeast
1  c. warm water
3/4  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. instant potato flakes
preparation: To make starter:  Mix ingredients in a glass jar or container. Cover loosely and let stand 24 hours at room temperature.  Put in refrigerator for 3 to 5 days.  On the fourth day, feed it with 3/4 cup sugar, 3 tablespoons potato flakes and 1 cup warm water.  Stir and keep at room temperature 24 hours.  One cup of starter is used to make the bread.  Store remaining starter in the refrigerator until the next feeding.

name: TRIPLE FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate pudding cooked
1  chocolate cake mix
1/2  c. walnuts
1/2  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Blend cake mix with cooked pudding.  Pour into prepared 9 by 13 pan.  Sprinkle with nuts and chocolate chips.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Can be served warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  bananas, mashed
2  Tbsp. water
2  eggs
2  c. self-rising flour
1/4  c. nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bake in loaf pan at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  medium onion
1  c. uncooked rice
1  jar Cheez Whiz
1  c. cream of chicken or mushroom soup
1  stick margarine
preparation: Melt margarine.  Add broccoli until separated.  Add onion and saute for 5 minutes.  Stir cooked rice.  Mix Cheez Whiz, soup and milk.  Add all ingredients and cook for 25 minutes at 400°.

name: CHICKEN TARRAGON(Makes 4 Servings)
ingredients:
2  chicken breasts (boneless)
1  c. white wine
1  Tbsp. dried tarragon
4  Tbsp. butter, divided
1/2  c. fresh mushrooms
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. heavy cream
preparation: Cut chicken into thick julienne strips.  Add tarragon to wine, let stand 30 minutes.  In skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat and saute mushrooms.  Remove mushrooms from skillet and set aside.

name: PINEAPPLE-CHEDDAR CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple chunks (preferably juice packed)
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. (about 25) crushed Ritz crackers
3  Tbsp. butter, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Drain the pineapple, reserving 3 tablespoons  juice.  Arrange  the pineapple on the bottom of a greased 1 1/2 quart baking dish.  Combine the flour and sugar; sprinkle over pineapple.  Drizzle the reserved pineapple juice on top.  Sprinkle  with Cheddar cheese.  Combine the crackers and melted  butter; sprinkle over cheese.  Bake, covered, for 15 minutes, then uncover and bake 10 minutes longer.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1  can Ranch Style beans
1  can cream of celery soup
12  corn tortillas
garlic powder
pepper
1  medium onion, chopped
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, sliced
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes with chilies
salt
chili powder
preparation: Saute onion and ground meat until brown; drain.  Add Ranch Style beans, salt, pepper and garlic powder.  Simmer on low.  Line a greased casserole dish with 6 corn tortillas, pour meat and bean mixture on top.  Add Velveeta cheese slices.  Add remaining tortillas.  Mix cream of celery soup and Ro-Tel tomatoes in separate bowl.  Pour on top of casserole and bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

name: WHITE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. butter
4  c. sugar
1/4  lb. white chocolate, melted
4  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. flaked coconut
1 small  can evaporated milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cream 1 cup butter, 2 cups sugar and chocolate.  Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Stir in flour, baking powder, dash of salt, 1 teaspoon vanilla and buttermilk.  Fold in pecans and coconut.  Bake in layer pans for 30 minutes or tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Mix remaining sugar, butter and vanilla in saucepan.  Add dash of salt and evaporated milk.  Let stand for 1 hour.  Stir occasionally.  Cook to soft ball stage.  Beat until creamy.  Spread on cake.

name: PEANUT CLUSTERS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
2/3  c. condensed milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. salted peanuts
preparation: Melt chips in microwave then add milk and vanilla.  Stir and add peanuts.  Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.

name: BROCCOLI AND DRESSING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm dressing mix
1  c. warm tap water
2  c. diced celery
1  c. chopped onion
1  stick oleo
2  c. milk
4  Tbsp. oleo
4  Tbsp. flour
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Cook broccoli; drain and set aside.  Saute celery and onion in stick of oleo.  Mix 1 cup warm water into dressing.  Add celery and onion mix to dressing.  Make paste of flour and butter over medium heat in saucepan.  Add milk and stir until white sauce is smooth.  Add broken chunks of cheese to white sauce and stir until melted.

name: FAVORITE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1  can stewed tomatoes
1/2  c. cottage cheese
preparation: Drain tomatoes.  Save juice. Add water to make 2 cups.  Heat 1 cup to boiling. Stir in Jell-O. Add the other cup when cool. Mix tomatoes and cottage cheese. Add to gelatin mixture.

name: FROSTING
ingredients:
1  c. milk
3  Tbsp. plain flour
1  c. Crisco
1  c. sugar
preparation: Cook milk and flour until thick, like a ball.  Mix Crisco and sugar.  Add your thickened flour and milk.  Mix well.  You may mix any type flavoring.  Top cake.

name: CRACKER SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. celery
1  bell pepper
1  small onion
2  boiled eggs
salt and pepper to taste
1  can tomato soup, undiluted
1  c. mayonnaise
18  crackers
preparation: Chop celery, pepper, onion and eggs.  Mix with soup, mayonnaise and broken up crackers.  Refrigerate until ready to eat.

name: SHRIMP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. medium shrimp (raw), shelled
1/4  c. butter
1 to 2  cans mushrooms (8 oz. size)
1  c. chopped onion
2  tomatoes, peeled and diced (1 1/2 c.)
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. paprika
1/3  c. dry sherry
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. light cream
2  Tbsp. flour
4  c. cooked, drained rice
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
preparation: Saute  mushrooms,  onion  and shrimp in 2 tablespoons of butter  until shrimp is just pink, no more than 3 minutes.  Add tomatoes,  salt,  pepper  and paprika.  Cover and simmer 5 minutes.  Stir  in sherry and Worcestershire sauce.  Combine cream and  flour into smooth paste.  Stir into shrimp mixture.  Bring to a boil, stirring, and simmer for 1 minute.  Add rice and mix gently  over  low  heat.  Pour into buttered 2 quart casserole. Melt  remaining butter and combine with bread crumbs.  Sprinkle over  casserole  and  place  under  broiler a few minutes until slightly browned.

name: FUDGE
ingredients:
1/4  lb. oleo
1  lb. confectioners sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
3/4  c. chopped nuts (optional)
1/2  size of small Velveeta or a piece 2 x 2 x 1 1/2-inches
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt oleo and cheese together.  Pour into sugar, cocoa and vanilla.  Mix well.  Add nuts if you want.  Mix well. Pour into 8 x 8-inch ungreased pan.  Chill for 15 minutes.  Cut in squares and serve.

name: FRANK-GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. frankfurters
1/4  c. shortening
1/4  c. sifted flour
2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. grated cheese
2  c. cooked green beans
2  c. diced cooked potatoes
preparation: Brown  franks  in  hot  fat  in  heavy skillet.  Remove franks.  Stir  flour  into remaining shortening, gradually add milk, stirring until thickened.  Blend in salt, Worcestershire sauce and 1/2 cup cheese.  Stir in drained beans and potatoes, arrange  franks on top, cover and simmer 15 minutes.  Sprinkle rest of cheese on top.

name: CAROL'S MUD BUGS
ingredients:
9  c. Chex cereal
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/4  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Pour Chex cereal into large bowl; set aside.  In a 1-quart microwave-safe bowl, combine next 3 ingredients.  Microwave High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until smooth, stirring after 1 minute.  Pour chocolate mixture over cereal.  Stir until all pieces are evenly coated.  Pour cereal into large Ziploc bag with powdered sugar. Seal and shake until all pieces are evenly coated.  Spread on wax paper to cool.

name: LOAF BREAD APPLE PIE
ingredients:
4  slices white bread
4  to 5 apples
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1/2  Tbsp. nutmeg
1  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Slice apples (thin) and place in a buttered 8-inch square dish. Mix together cinnamon and nutmeg and sprinkle on top of apples. Cut each slice of bread into 4 strips.  Arrange the 16 bread strips on top of the apples and spices.  Combine other ingredients, mixing well.  Pour over bread.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: BANANA STARS COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. soda
1  c. banana chips, crushed
1/2  c. dark brown sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. flour
2  c. rolled oats
preparation: Mix the ingredients well in large bowl.  Roll out and cut into star shapes.  Bake at 350° for 9 to 10 minutes.  Makes 2 to 3 dozen.

name: DRESSING FOR POTATO SALAD OR MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1  c. plus 3 Tbsp. Miracle Whip
2  tsp. mustard
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1 1/2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix all  ingredients  together.  Blend well.  Pour over warm potatoes or macaroni.

name: PICKLED EGGS AND BEETS
ingredients:
8  hard-boiled eggs
2 (16 oz.)  cans sliced red beets
1  c. sugar
1  c. cider vinegar
1  medium onion, cut in rings
preparation: Drain liquid from beets in a saucepan; add sugar and vinegar. Heat to boiling.  Place shelled eggs, beets and onion in a large bowl.  Pour hot beet juice mixture on top.   Cover and refrigerate for 2 days.  Makes a great side dish for Easter dinner.

name: MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
2  cans bean dip (Fritos, etc.)
8  oz. sour cream
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1/2  c. mayonnaise (for second layer)
large jar salsa (mild or hot)
chopped onions
black and green olives
about 3 tomatoes
8  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
Doritos, corn chips, etc.
preparation: Layer all ingredients, except Doritos, corn chips, etc., mixing sour cream, taco seasoning and mayonnaise for second layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Serve with Doritos, corn chips, etc.

name: ROLLED DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. oil
preparation: Sift together flour, salt and baking powder.  Add milk and oil.  Flour counter and top of dough before rolling.  Roll dough to 1/4-inch thick.  Cut into dumplings approximately 1 1/2-inch by 1 1/2-inch.  Dry slightly for easier handling.  Drop into boiling broth and chicken.  Simmer about 15 minutes.  Yields 4 large servings or 6 reasonable servings (9 grams of fat each).

name: GREEN PEPPER RELISH
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. bell peppers, ground
6 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. cider vinegar
1  pkg. Sure-Jell
green food coloring
preparation: Well drain the peppers; add sugar and vinegar.  Bring to a boil and then cool slowly for 5 minutes.  Add Sure-Jell and a few drops of food coloring.  Stir in completely.  Pour in jars and add paraffin wax to seal.  Can be stored in cupboard for a year.  Serve on crackers with cream cheese as an appetizer.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  large zucchini, sliced
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  c. grated carrots
8  oz. sour cream
1  can cream of mushroom or chicken soup
1  stick margarine
8  oz. Pepperidge Farm crumbs
preparation: Parboil zucchini and chopped onions in salted water for 4 minutes.  Mix  together grated carrots, cream of mushroom or chicken soup and  sour  cream.  Melt  margarine  and pour over Pepperidge Farm crumbs.  Put 1/2 crumb mixture in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.  Pour  in  vegetables and top with crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE AND EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
9  eggs
3  slices bread
3  c. milk
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Brown and drain sausage.  Beat eggs and add milk and dry mustard.  Cube bread and add sausage and cheese.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased dish and refrigerate overnight.  Put into cold oven and turn on to 350° for 35 to 40 minutes; until brown and bubbly.

name: CHOCOLATE CAKE(Thin Layer)
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
3  eggs
1 1/3  c. water
1/3  c. Crisco oil
preparation: Mix as directed on cake mix box.  Grease and line cake pans with wax paper.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Pour 1/2 cup batter in each pan.  Spread out over pan.  Cook only a few minutes.  Cool.  Repeat until all layers are made.  Use your favorite chocolate icing. Very good!

name: MISSISSIPPI MUD CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. flour
1/3  c. cocoa
4  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
6  oz. mini marshmallows
preparation: Cream sugar  and  shortening.  Add  eggs and beat.  Add next 6 ingredients  and  mix  well.  Pour  into  greased  and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 300° for 35 minutes.  Remove from oven and spread marshmallows over the top.  Increase oven temperature to 350°  and  return cake to oven for 10 minutes. Cool 1 hour.  Frost with chocolate frosting.

name: COOKED POTATOES
ingredients:
5  lb. Idaho potatoes
1/2 to 1 whole  stick butter
1/2  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Peel and quarter potatoes.  Cook until fork can go through potatoes.  Drain off half the water.  Add butter, milk, salt and pepper.

name: CLASSIC APPLE PIE
ingredients:
pastry for double-crust 9-inch pie
6  c. thinly sliced, peeled, tart cooking apples
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Prepare pastry and let rest while you prepare apples.  Slice apples into large bowl and sprinkle with lemon juice.   Add sugar, flour, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg to apples; mix well.  On a lightly floured board, roll out half of pie pastry to a 12-inch circle.  Place in bottom of a 9-inch pan and, using fingers, gently press dough to side of pan.  Trim any overlapping edges of dough.  Mix apples again with large spoon and turn into pastry-lined pan.  Dot surface with the butter.

name: RICE KRISPY TREAT
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. (about 40 regular) marshmallows or 4 c. miniature marshmallows
6  c. Rice Krispies cereal
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  c. peanut butter
preparation: Melt marshmallows and margarine.  Stir in peanut butter, then add Rice Krispies.  Press mixture into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Cool and cut into squares.

name: SHORTER MANSION PUNCH
ingredients:
3 large  cans frozen lemonade, diluted
dry sherry
1 to 2  bottles chilled soda water
ice ring of lemonade
preparation: Dilute lemonade as described on the can with dry sherry rather than water.   Add soda water as desired.  Serve from punch bowl in cups with shaved ice.  Ice ring of lemonade is attractive in punch bowl and will not dilute punch.

name: MARINATED EYE OF ROUND
ingredients:
1  tsp. finely chopped garlic
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  or 3 strips lean bacon
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. dry red wine
2  c. beef broth
1 1/2  c. coarsely chopped drained tomatoes
1  bay leaf
approximately 3 lb. eye of round of beef
preparation: Cut raw bacon into 1/2-inch pieces and roll in spices.  Cut many slits in eye of round.  Push coated bacon pieces into slits. Brown roast in olive oil and margarine.  Remove meat and brown the celery and onion.  Pour wine, broth and tomatoes into roasting pan.  Set beef into mixture which should come 1/3 to 1/2 way up on the roast.  Cover pan and place on middle rack of oven preheated to 350° for 2 or 3 hours, until meat is done.  I have used a 325° oven.  Slice to serve.  Serve strained sauce in gravy boat. Serves 10.

name: SCALLOPED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  chicken, cooked with onion, boned and diced
1  can mushroom soup
3  c. broth from chicken
3  beaten eggs
1  c. milk
3  c. cracker crumbs
1 small  jar pimentos, diced
salt to taste
preparation: Combine   all  ingredients.  Pour  into  buttered  9  x 11-inch  pan.  Top  with  1  1/2 cups cracker crumbs, combined with 1/4 cup melted butter.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: DOLORES FREDETTE'S FOOLPROOF PIE CRUST
ingredients:
4  c. flour or 3 c. white and 1 c. whole wheat
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt (optional)
1 3/4  c. Crisco (white or butter flavor)
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. white or cider vinegar
1  large egg
preparation: In large bowl, mix dry ingredients.  Cut in shortening until crumbly.  In small bowl, beat water, vinegar and egg.   Add to flour mixture and stir well until all ingredients are moistened. Wrap in wax paper and chill for at least 1/2 hour.  Then proceed as usual.  This dough will always be flaky, tender and delicious no matter how much it is handled.  Dough can be kept 3 to 4 days in the refrigerator.

name: SLAW
ingredients:
medium size cabbage, grated
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  bell pepper, diced
1  medium onion, diced fine
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
preparation: Soak cabbage in cold water a while if you have time.  Add salt to enough water to cover cabbage.  Put over cabbage and let set 15 minutes.  Stir occasionally, squeeze out real dry and add pepper and onion. Measure sugar and vinegar.  Add to cabbage. This slaw will keep in refrigerator for 3 weeks.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
4  c. sliced apples
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. water
3/4  c. flour
1  c. brown or white sugar
1/3  c. butter or margarine
preparation: Put apples into a 2-quart dish; sprinkle with spice, salt and water.  Work flour, sugar and butter together until crumbly. Spread over apples.  Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes or until apples are tender.

name: CHEESE THUMBPRINTS
ingredients:
2 (5 1/2 oz.)  pkg. buttermilk biscuit mix
8  oz. extra sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. red pepper
1  stick margarine, softened
sesame seed
preparation: Preheat  oven  to 425°.  Cream the biscuit mix, cheese, red pepper  and  margarine  well.  Shape  into  1 inch balls. Press down with thumb and sprinkle with sesame seed.  Bake 15 to 18 minutes.  Yield:  approximately 40 wafers.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
4  c. sirloin beef
2  Tbsp. parsley
4  Tbsp. butter
1  c. onion, chopped
2  c. sliced mushrooms
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. white wine (optional)
preparation: Trim fat from heat and cut in 1/2-inch strips.  Heat butter in large frying pan.  Add meat, onion and mushrooms to butter.  Saute over high heat until meat is nicely browned.  Add seasonings.  Add cream of mushroom soup.  Cook over low heat for 15 minutes.  Fold in sour cream.  Simmer 5 minutes.  Do not boil.  Serve with cooked egg noodles or rice.

name: BAKED GARLIC FOR 4
ingredients:
4 entire garlic  cloves (bunch)
1  jar basil paste in oil
4  medium tomatoes
Italian spices
1  pkg. farmer cheese
1  box Melba rounds
1  bottle olive oil
preparation: Peel loose skins off garlic bunch, slice top to a flat surface. Drizzle with olive oil; mound basil paste onto bunch.  Place on baking sheet, in 400° oven for approximately 40 minutes or until soft, with fork.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. cranberries, ground
1/2  orange, ground
1 1/2  c. sugar
2 small  pkg. cherry gelatin
1  Tbsp. plain gelatin
2  c. warm water
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. finely chopped apples
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
1  oz. cold water
preparation: Let ground cranberries, orange and sugar mixture set overnight.  Soak plain gelatin in cold water and add to cherry gelatin and warm water mixture.  When it starts to gel, add pecans, apples, celery and cranberry mixture.  Refrigerate until well set.  Serve on lettuce with mayonnaise.  Serves 8 to 12.

name: CURRY PORK DISH WITH APPLES
ingredients:
1  lb. pork
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  Tbsp. curry
2  onions
2  Tbsp. flour
salt
pepper
1 1/4  c. chicken bouillon
2  apples
4  to 5 tomatoes
chopped parsley
preparation: Cut up the meat in cubes and saute with curry in butter or margarine.  Saute for about 5 minutes while stirring.  Add onions and flour. Stir.   Add the salt, pepper and bouillon.  Simmer for about 10 minutes on low heat. Cut up the apples and tomatoes and add to the meat mixture. Cook for 15 minutes longer.  Correct seasonings, adding more spices to taste.  Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve over rice.

name: PEANUT, BACON, CORN MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising corn meal
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  c. sweet milk
12  slices bacon, fried and crumbled
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Mix meal, sugar and peanut butter.  In another bowl, mix rest of ingredients.  Add to first mixture, then put into a greased muffin pan.  Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.

name: COCONUT MACAROONS
ingredients:
2  egg whites (at room temperature)
1/8  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. almond extract
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. toasted coconut flakes, cooled
1/4  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Preheat  oven  to  325°.  In  large  bowl with electric mixer at high speed, beat first 2 ingredients until soft peaks form. Add  sugar, one tablespoon at a time.  Continue to beat until sugar  is  dissolved  and  mixture is stiff with glossy peaks, about  5  minutes.  Fold  in  extract  and flour until blended. Add  toasted  coconut.  Drop  macaroons  by  rounded tablespoonfuls  1  1/2 inches apart onto greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle  with  flaked  coconut.  Bake  15 to 17 minutes until lightly browned.  Remove to rack and cool.

name: ZUCCHINI BAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. grated zucchini
3/4  c. grated cheese
1/2  green pepper, chopped
3  eggs, well beaten
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. Bisquick
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bake in oiled casserole at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
3  oz. pkg. instant vanilla pudding
12  oz. pkg. butterscotch morsels
3/4  c. chopped pecans
4  eggs
1  c. sour cream
2/3  c. oil
1  c. coconut
preparation: Grease and flour Bundt pan.  Mix all ingredients well.  Pour into pan and bake at 325° for 1 hour and 5 minutes.  Cool in pan before removing.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1/4  c. plain flour
1  egg
1  onion (size of egg), chopped fine
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix well with sweet milk.  Have dough stiff.  Cook in deep oil, slow.

name: MEXICAN STUFFED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat, browned
2  c. cubed Velveeta cheese
1/4  c. picante sauce
preparation: Cube Velveeta cheese and melt in microwave.  Add picante sauce and mix.  Add this mixture to ground meat and spoon into baked potatoes.  If in a hurry, microwave potatoes and stuff with mixture.  Easy and fast!  Delicious too!

name: SEASIDE SHRIMP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. fish (such as cod or sole)
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  medium onion, thinly sliced
2  cloves garlic or equivalent garlic powder
salt and pepper to taste
lemon juice to taste
1  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. Dijon-style mustard
1 1/2  c. cooked shrimp, shelled and deveined
dill or parsley, chopped
preparation: Clean fish and wipe off excess water.  Cut into serving pieces or cubes; set aside.  Sauté onion in butter until soft but not browned.  Add garlic and fish to onions; heat to simmer.  Cook for 10 to 20 minutes until fish is just tender and flakes easily. Don't overcook.  Add salt and pepper.  Sprinkle with lemon juice; set aside.

name: ALMOND COCONUT BROWNIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. butter (no substitute)
4  squares (1 oz. each) unsweetened	chocolate
2 1/4  c. sugar
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. all purpose flour
3/4  c. chopped slivered almonds
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In a saucepan over low heat melt butter and chocolate, cool slightly. Add sugar, stir in flour, eggs, almonds and vanilla. Pour into 13x9 inch pan, greased. Bake 350° for 30 minutes or until a tooth pick comes out clean. Cool on wire rack.

name: MISSISSIPPI FUDGE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1/3  c. cocoa
4  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
dash of salt
2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. pecans (optional)
1  jar Marshmallow Creme
preparation: Melt together margarine and cocoa.  Cool.  Gradually add beaten eggs.  Sift flour, sugar and salt and stir into batter.  Add vanilla and pecans.  Bake at 375° for 25 minutes in 14-inch jelly roll pan.  Remove from oven and spread Marshmallow Creme over cake immediately.

name: FISH WITH LEMON SPINACH
ingredients:
2  small onion, cut 1/4-inch slices
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
1  tsp. instant chicken bouillon
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen fish fillet, thawed and separated
1/2  tsp. salt
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook and stir onions and margarine until tender.  Stir in flour.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until mixture is smooth and bubbly; remove from heat.  Stir in milk and instant bouillon.  Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.  Boil and stir 1 minute.  Arrange fillets in an oblong baking dish.  Sprinkle with salt.  Spoon spinach around fish; drizzle lemon juice over spinach.  Spoon sauce evenly onto fish and spinach.  Cook uncovered in a 350° oven until fish flakes with fork, about 20 to 25 minutes.  Sprinkle with cheese and paprika.  Makes 8 servings.

name: PIZZANIA
ingredients:
1  box spaghetti
1  pt. Ricotta cheese
1  lb. hamburg
1 (27 1/2 oz.)  can sauce
1  small onion
1  green pepper
1  lb. Provolone cheese
preparation: Cook spaghetti as directed on box, drain and set aside.  In a skillet cook onion and green pepper; add hamburg and cook thoroughly.  Add sauce and simmer.  Mix Ricotta cheese with spaghetti, then add hamburg mixture, mixing thoroughly.  Pour half into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Put on one layer of Provolone cheese, then pour in the rest and add another layer of cheese. Put into 350° oven until cheese starts to bubble.

name: STEAK AND BACON TORNADOS
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. flank steak
meat tenderizer
1/2  lb. bacon
1  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. parsley
1 to 1 1/3  oz. pkg. Hollandaise Sauce mix
1/4  tsp. tarragon, crushed
preparation: Pound  flank  to  even  thickness, about 1/2-inch.  Use tenderizer  according  to package directions.  Meanwhile, cook bacon  until almost done.  Sprinkle flank with garlic salt and pepper.  Score  steak  diagonally, making diamond shaped cuts. Place  bacon  strips lengthwise on flank steak.  Sprinkle with parsley.  Roll  up  in  jelly roll fashion, starting at narrow end.  Skewer  with  wooden  picks at 1-inch intervals.  Cut in 1-inch  slices  with serrated knife.  Grill over medium coals, 15 minutes,  turning  once  for rare.  Prepare Hollandaise by directions, adding tarragon.  Serve over flanks.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Rotini noodles
onion
green pepper
8  oz. Italian dressing
1  tsp. salad supreme
preparation: Cook noodles, drain and let cool.  Then mix onion, green pepper, and 8 oz. Italian dressing, mix well.  Add salad supreme. Mix and ready to serve.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  box strawberry Jell-O
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  can whole cranberry sauce
1 large  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix jello and water,  then  add mashed cranberry sauce, pineapple and nuts.  Pour in dish or mold.  Refrigerate.

name: BLUEBERRIES IN THE SNOW
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. grape jello or combine raspberry and cherry
2  c. boiling water
1 large  can crushed pineapple, undrained
1  can blueberry pie filling
preparation: Dissolve  jello  in  boiling water.  Then add pineapple and blueberry pie filling.  Chill until set.  After it chills, put topping on.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  (3 oz.) chicken breast halves, skinned
vegetable cooking spray
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1/2  c. skim milk
1/2 (8 oz.)  carton plain unsweetened low-fat yogurt
5  unsalted crackers, crushed
1  tsp. reduced-calorie margarine, melted
preparation: Combine chicken breast halves and water to cover in a medium saucepan.  Cover and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until chicken is done; drain well.   Remove chicken from bone and coarsely chop chicken.  Place coarsely chopped chicken in a 1-quart casserole, coated with vegetable cooking spray, and sprinkle with salt and pepper.

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. applesauce
4  tsp. soda
4  tsp. allspice
4  tsp. cloves
4  tsp. cinnamon
4  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
1  c. Crisco
3  eggs
4  c. flour
1  box raisins
1  c. nuts
1/2  c. strawberry or cherry preserves (mixed fruits if you prefer)
preparation: Heat applesauce and spices to boil.  Cream together Crisco, sugar and eggs, added one at a time.  Add flour and applesauce. Add other ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

name: CORN BREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  (9 x 13-inch) pan corn bread (made without sugar)
1  c. croutons or white bread, toasted
1  stick butter
3/4  c. celery, chopped
1/4  c. minced onion
3  tsp. pepper
3  tsp. Accent
3  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  c. green pepper
1  c. chicken broth
1 large  can cream of mushroom soup
2  tsp. paprika
1/4  c. sage
1/4  c. poultry seasoning
preparation: Bake corn bread and let cool. In a large pot or bowl, crumble corn bread up very fine. Add croutons or toasted white bread. Brown celery, onions and green pepper in melted butter until light brown and tender. Add to corn bread along with remaining ingredients. More or less of a certain spice may be added according to taste (more sage makes darker dressing). Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake in moderate oven at 325° to 350° for 1 hour. While baking, occasionally check and skim off any excess chicken base that rises to top during baking.

name: WILD RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box Uncle Ben's long grain rice
1/2  lb. sausage
1  small onion, diced
2  cans mushroom soup
1  can small Pet evaporated milk
1  can water chestnuts, diced
1/2  c. slivered almonds
preparation: Cook rice as directed on box. Brown sausage. Mix all ingredients together. Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
4  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. quick oats
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. margarine
2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1  c. chocolate chips
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine flour, oats, soda, cinnamon and salt; set aside. Cream margarine and gradually add sugars.  Beat until light.  Add egg and vanilla.  Mix well.  Alternate additions of dry ingredients and pumpkin.  Stir in chocolate chips.  Use ice cream scoop or 1/4 cup measure to drop dough onto cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes (until firm).  One cup of raisins can be substituted.

name: FAYE'S CUKES
ingredients:
6  cukes, sliced
1  sweet onion, sliced
1  bell pepper, sliced
1/2  c. lemon juice
3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Pour over cukes and let set 1 hour.  Will keep several days.

name: DAN PATRICK'S CRABMEAT MELTS(Celebrity Favorite)
ingredients:
2 (6 oz. each)  cans crabmeat, drained and flaked
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cracker Barrel sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
2  Tbsp. finely chopped red pepper
2  Tbsp. sliced green onions
4  drops hot pepper sauce
1/4  tsp. dill weed
36  crackers
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Mix all ingredients except crackers.  Top each cracker with 1 tablespoon of the crabmeat mixture.   Place on a cookie sheet.  Bake 10 minutes.  Makes 36.  These hot and spicy appetizers are fast and easy enough to make as a snack during halftime.  Enjoy!

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE(Microwave)
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, skinned and boned
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped water chestnuts
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  tsp. curry powder
1/2  stick butter
1/2  c. chicken broth
1  pkg. dry Stove Top stuffing mix
preparation: Cook and cube chicken breasts.  Set aside.  Mix together celery, water chestnuts and onions.  Set aside.  Make sauce of mayonnaise, soup and curry powder.  Melt butter.

name: JACK'S DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  can pineapple pie filling
8  oz. cream cheese
1  large Cool Whip
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  stick butter
pretzels
pecan halves
preparation: Break up pretzels with hands (enough to cover the bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish).  Put butter on top.  Put in 300° oven until butter melts and is absorbed by pretzels.

name: PINEAPPLE ANGEL PIE
ingredients:
1  c. water
1  c. sugar
1  c. crushed pineapple
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  stiffly beaten egg whites
baked pie shells
preparation: Bring to a boil the water, sugar and pineapple, then thicken with the cornstarch. When cool, add the two beaten egg whites. Fill baked pie shell and top with whipped cream sweetened with powdered sugar and vanilla. Chill in refrigerator.  Makes 2 pies.

name: JEN'S SANDWICH BREAD
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. active dry yeast
2  c. warm water
1/4  c. honey
1  Tbsp. salt
2  eggs
1/4  c. canola oil
2  c. whole wheat flour
4 to 4 1/2  c. white unbleached flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Stir into yeast, honey, salt, eggs, oil and 2 cups whole wheat flour.  Beat until smooth.  Add unbleached white flour until dough is easy to handle.  Knead on floured board 10 minutes or until elastic.  Place dough in greased bowl and cover.  Keep in warm place and let rise until doubled (45 minutes to 1 hour).  Punch down and divide the dough in halves. Shape into loaves and place in greased loaf pans.  Let rise until doubled (maybe 1 hour).  Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.  Can be made all white bread by using all white flour or rye bread by substituting 2 cups rye flour for the whole wheat flour and adding 1/4 cup caraway seed.

name: CURRY DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. sour cream
1/8  tsp. turmeric
1  Tbsp. curry powder
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  tsp. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1/8  c. chopped parsley
salt to taste
dash of Tabasco to taste
preparation: Combine all thoroughly and chill at least 6 hours.  Recipe is better if made day before use.  Makes 1 1/2 cups.

name: TEA CAKES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. butter
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. self-rising flour
preparation: Cream sugar and butter; add eggs, vanilla and flour.  Chill, roll out and cut.  Cook at 350° until lightly browned.

name: Best Brownies
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening or margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
5  tbsp. cocoa
3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening (or margarine). Add eggs and mix well. Stir in cocoa, flour, salt, vanilla and nuts.

name: JOSIE'S BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
2 large  boxes vanilla instant pudding mix
3  c. milk
1  (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
2  boxes vanilla wafers
6  or more large bananas
preparation: Mix pudding with milk.  Fold in the rest of the ingredients. Layer vanilla wafers, bananas and pudding mixture.  Sprinkle crumbled wafers on top.  Makes a punch bowl full.

name: MILLION DOLLAR RELISH
ingredients:
2  qt. ground cucumbers
1  qt. ground sweet onions
3  ground green bell peppers
1 large  can pimento
1  Tbsp. pickling salt
1  qt. vinegar
3 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
2  Tbsp. celery seed
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients, add salt and let soak overnight. Drain, do not squeeze.  Add vinegar, sugar and spices.  Boil 15 to 20 minutes.  Seal in sterilized jars.

name: ZESTY TOMATOES
ingredients:
6  tomatoes
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. minced green pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cut a slice from top of each tomato; hollow out small well in center.  Season with salt and pepper and parsley.  Put 1 teaspoon of mixture in well and on top of each tomato.  Broil 3 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and broil until lightly browned.

name: HONEY MUSTARD SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. prepared mustard
1/2  c. honey
4  tsp. soy sauce
preparation: About 10 minutes before serving or a day ahead, in a small bowl, combine mustard, honey and soy sauce until blended.  Serve over slices of baked ham or other meats and pour about 1 tablespoon over each slice.

name: LEMON BARS
ingredients:
2  sticks butter, melted
1  c. brown sugar
2  c. flour
preparation: Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: POTATO-BACON-CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces
2  c. cubed potatoes
1  c. chopped onions
1  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
thyme to taste
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  c. milk
1  c. sour cream
preparation: In 3-quart saucepan, cook bacon until brown.  Add onions and cook until tender.  Add potatoes, water and seasoning.  Continue cooking 15 to 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.  Reduce heat to low and add remaining ingredients.  Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until heated through.

name: ENCORE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  lb. ground round
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
salt
pepper
1/2  tsp. basil
1  c. cottage cheese
8  oz. cream cheese
3/4  c. sour cream
1/3  c. diced green onions
2  Tbsp. diced green pepper
8  oz. size medium noodles
2 1/2  qt. boiling water
2  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. melted margarine
preparation: Melt 1 tablespoon margarine in skillet and brown meat.  Add tomato sauce, salt, pepper and basil.  In a bowl, cream together the cheeses, sour cream, onions and green pepper.  Cook noodles with 2 tablespoons salt for 8 to 10 minutes.  Drain noodles and toss with melted butter.  Put half of noodles in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan.  Cover with cheese mixture.  Top with other half of noodles.  Pour meat sauce over top.  Bake for 40 minutes at 375°.  Serves 8.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. Shoe Peg corn (frozen)
1 (16 oz.)  can French-cut green beans, drained
1/2  c. shredded cheese
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1  stick Ritz crackers, crushed or 2 c. corn flakes
preparation: Combine chestnuts, onions, celery, green pepper, corn, green beans, cheese and soup.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Pour into 2-quart buttered casserole.  Combine margarine and crackers or corn flakes.  Sprinkle on top of casserole.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.  Yield:  8 to 10 servings.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) spaghetti
1  (8 oz.) salad dressing
1  medium tomato
2  carrots
1  c. broccoli
1  c. cauliflower
3/4  c. celery
1/2  c. onion
1/3  c. green pepper
1 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. dill weed
salt to taste
preparation: Cook spaghetti and drain in cold water.  Chop vegetables and add vegetables and dressing to spaghetti.  Chill for one hour.

name: SPANISH STRING BEANS
ingredients:
2  cans string beans
1  can hot sauce
4  strips bacon, cut up
salt to taste
pepper to taste
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  minced onion
preparation: Fry bacon.  Add hot sauce, spices and onion.  Bring to boil; simmer with beans.

name: SOFT SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  c. lard
1  c. sweet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cream of tartar
2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Beat eggs 1 minute.  Add sugar and shortening and beat 1 minute.  Add vanilla and milk.  Sift dry ingredients and combine with first mixture.  Drop by spoon onto cookie sheet and bake at 350° or 375° until they look done (ovens vary), 8 to 10 minutes. Ice tops when cool (optional).

name: ITALIAN FRITATTE
ingredients:
3  medium zucchini, diced
1  Vidalia onion, chopped
1/2  stick pepperoni, sliced
1  c. Bisquick
6  to 8 eggs
garlic, salt and pepper to taste
3/4  c. Parmesan/Romano cheese
preparation: Mix zucchini, onion, pepperoni and Bisquick together, then mix eggs and cheese with seasonings.  Now combine all ingredients. Bake in Pyrex dish approximately 20 minutes.

name: UN-HOT CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
Postum
Coffee-mate nondairy French vanilla
hot water
preparation: Combine these 3 ingredients for an "almost chocolate" taste treat (without the guilt).

name: KETCHUP AND COKE ROAST
ingredients:
1  roast
1/2  c. ketchup
1  c. Coke
1  c. onion, chopped
1  c. chopped bell pepper
preparation: Put roast in skillet and brown (don't cook all the way), then add ketchup, Coke, onion and bell pepper.  Cook until roast is completely done.

name: VEGETABLE BEEF SOUP
ingredients:
1  can corned beef
6  medium potatoes
2  stalks celery
1  onion
8  mini carrots, cut in half lengthwise
1  can green beans
1  can corn
1/2  bag frozen or canned peas
V-8 juice or tomato juice (large can)
preparation: Cook potatoes, celery and onion for 10 minutes in water; add drained corn, green beans, peas and corned beef.  Cook 10 minutes. Drain off excess water.  Add juice to cover vegetables.  Heat just enough to get juice hot.

name: FIESTA POTATOES
ingredients:
6  to 8 medium potatoes
1/4  c. milk or cream (I prefer cream)
4  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1  can Doritos Con Quesa dip
preparation: Peel and boil potatoes until tender, then drain.  Place in casserole dish.  Add rest of ingredients.  Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

name: HOMER'S CHILI
ingredients:
2  lb. chili meat (lean)
2 to 3  Tbsp. chili powder
3  to 4 medium onions
2  cans tomato sauce
3 to 4  c. water
preparation: Mix all together.  Cook slowly for hours.

name: PEANUT CLUSTERS
ingredients:
2  pkg. white almond bark
1 large  pkg. chocolate chips
3  Tbsp. cocoa
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
preparation: Mix together in crock-pot the white almond bark, chocolate chips, cocoa and vegetable oil.  Melt together, then blend in cocktail peanuts until somewhat stiff, probably 2 large packages. Then drop onto wax paper and cool.  Can add paraffin to make shiny.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. cooked macaroni, drained
1/2  c. mixed pickles
1  green pepper, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
4  eggs, boiled and chopped
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. chopped celery
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and serve.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2 or 3  lb. hamburger
1  large, chopped onion
1  pkg. crackers
1  can tomato sauce
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  can vegetable soup
pepper to taste
preparation: Add ingredients as listed.  Cover with ketchup before baking. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. chopped, frozen broccoli, cooked and drained well
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  c. mayonnaise (do not use salad dressing)
1  egg, well beaten
1  Tbsp. onion, chopped fine
1/2  c. cracker crumbs (I always use Ritz crackers)
preparation: Mix broccoli, mushroom soup, cheese, mayonnaise, egg and onion together in baking dish.  Crumble cracker crumbs on top and bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

name: VEGETABLE AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) bag frozen broccoli, carrots, cauliflower combination, drained
1 (4 oz.)  jar chopped pimento, drained (optional)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/3  c. sour cream
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee onion rings
preparation: Combine 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can onions with other ingredients in a 1-quart casserole.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onions and bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.

name: CORN BREAD CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. white sugar
4  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. light brown sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Blend first 3 ingredients in a separate bowl. Mix oil and eggs and add to dry ingredients. Stir until moistened, then stir in pecans last. Pour in sheet pan. Bake 45 minutes at 350°. Cut in squares when cool.

name: BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. stew beef, cubed 1-inch and browned
1  c. potatoes, cubed 1-inch
1  c. carrots (1-inch)
1  c. celery (1-inch)
1  c. onions (1-inch)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can tomato bisque soup
preparation: Mix all together and bake 3 hours at 325°.  Serve with hot bread and enjoy.

name: BONELESS CHICKEN BREAST IN CHICKEN-MUSHROOM CREAM SAUCE
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1  can cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
2  c. (16 oz.) sour cream
3/4  c. chicken broth
1/2  medium onion, chopped
6  to 8 boneless chicken breast halves
1  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/4  tsp. pepper
cooked noodles or rice
preparation: In 13 x 9-inch pan, combine soups, sour cream, broth, onion, mushrooms and spices.  Arrange chicken on top of sauce.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour or until chicken is tender.  Serve over noodles or rice.

name: MELISSA'S CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless skinless chicken breasts
4  cloves garlic, crushed
1/2  tsp. lemon pepper
2/3  c. white wine Worcestershire sauce (Lea & Perrins)
Pam cooking spray
preparation: Cut chicken into strips, set aside.  Heat skillet and spray generously with Pam.  Add garlic and stir; add chicken and spray chicken with Pam.  Season with lemon pepper and cook completely. About 25 minutes.  Add white wine Worcestershire sauce and cook about 5 minutes longer; arrange on platter and serve.

name: ICE CREAM DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. condensed milk
16  oz. can Hershey syrup
3/4  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
24  Oreo cookies
1/2  gallon of your favorite ice cream
small tub of Cool Whip
preparation: Blend the Oreo cookies in a blender. Mix the melted butter with the cookies, mixing until moist. Press into 13 x 9 pan. Freeze for 30 minutes.

name: CELERY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. sliced celery, boil in salted water for 8 minutes
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. diced pimento
3  oz. water chestnuts, sliced
1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
1/4  c. sliced sauteed almonds
preparation: Combine celery, soup, pimentos and water chestnuts in casserole. Top with crumbs and almonds.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. chocolate cookie crumbs
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter or margarine
preparation: Press in pie plate and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: NOODLES AND COTTAGE CHEESE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. noodles, boiled
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  c. raisins
3  tsp. cottage cheese
preparation: Boil noodles and drain.  Add rest of ingredients.  Mix thoroughly.

name: MEAL IN A BASKET
ingredients:
3  whole chicken breasts, skinned, boned and cut in strips
deviled eggs
ham biscuits
preparation: Stir-fry chicken in hot skillet; drain on paper towels.  Serve with deviled eggs and ham biscuits.

name: PARSLIED CARROTS
ingredients:
1  lb. baby carrots
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  packets Equal
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
preparation: In a medium saucepan, combine carrots, water, lemon juice, margarine, salt and pepper.  Bring to boil; reduce heat.  Cover; cook over low heat for 15 minutes or until just tender.  Continue to cook, uncovered, 5 to 10 minutes more or until most of the liquid has evaporated, carefully stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.  Remove from heat.  Stir in Equal and parsley.  Makes 4 servings.

name: STRAWBERRY PUDDING SHORTCAKE(Yields 6 Servings)
ingredients:
2  c. almond milk
1/4  c. brown rice syrup
2/3  c. yellow corn grits
1  tsp. vanilla extract
4  c. hulled and sliced strawberries
1/2  c. brown rice syrup
2  tsp. fresh squeezed lemon juice
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh mint
6  fresh mint leaves for garnish
preparation: Combine almond milk and rice syrup in a 2-quart saucepan and bring to a simmer.  Add grits and cook for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat and mix in vanilla.  Pour into 6 individual serving dishes or one large mold.  Cover and refrigerate immediately for 2 hours to chill and prevent drying. Mix strawberries, rice syrup, lemon juice and mint.  Spoon over chilled dessert.  Garnish with mint leaves and serve.

name: PARSLIED MUSHROOM PATTIES
ingredients:
3  eggs, slightly beaten
3  c. chopped fresh mushrooms (8 oz.)
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. seasoned dry bread crumbs
1/2  c. finely chopped onions
1  Tbsp. dried parsley flakes
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. cooking oil
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, combine eggs, mushrooms, flour, bread crumbs, onion, parsley and pepper; mix well.  In a 10-inch skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat.  Using 1/2 cup of mixture for each patty, shape mixture into 3 1/2-inch patties.  Using a spatula, place 4 patties at a time into hot oil; cook 3 to 4 minutes per side until brown.  Remove from skillet, drain on paper towels and keep warm in oven.  Yield: 8 patties.  Each pattie: 139 calories and 8 gm fat.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
9-inch baked pie shell
1/2 to 3/4  c. sugar
3  oz. pkg. strawberry jello
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  qt. hulled, washed strawberries
preparation: Mix sugar, cornstarch and water.  Cook until clear, stirring constantly.  Dissolve jello in liquid.  Let sit until thick but do not refrigerate.  Put berries in pie shell.  Let sit 4 to 6 hours. Serve with whipped cream.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can mushroom soup
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can tuna
1  c. cooked English peas
1/3  c. milk
2  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1  c. crumbled potato chips
preparation: Blend soup and milk in 1-quart casserole dish.	Stir in tuna. Add eggs, peas and milk.  Bake at  350° for 20 minutes. Top with potato chips and bake 10 minutes longer.

name: PUMPKIN CAKE BARS
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  can pumpkin
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  yellow cake mix
1/2  c. butter
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix eggs, pumpkin, sugar and spice together in mixing bowl. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle cake mix on top of mixture. Add chopped pecans. Layer cubes of butter on top. Cover with foil. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: SOUR CREAM SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
4 1/2  c. flour
1  c. sour cream
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix and let stand in fridge 1 hour.  Roll dough on lightly floured board and cut; sprinkle on sugar.  Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda (leave out with self-rising flour)
1  tsp. cocoa
1  c. buttermilk
1 1/2  c. oil (1/2 c. oil)
1  tsp. vinegar
2  eggs
1 (1 oz.)  bottle red food coloring
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift together dry ingredients.  Add all other ingredients in order and mix thoroughly.  Bake in floured and greased layer cake pans at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter, melted
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. grated onion
1  c. sour cream
2 (12 oz.)  pkg. frozen French-style green beans, cooked
1/2  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. corn flakes
preparation: Combine 2 tablespoons butter and flour; cook gently.  Remove from heat; stir in seasonings and cream.  Fold in beans.  Place in a shallow 2-quart dish.  Cover with cheese, then crumbs (corn flakes) mixed with 1 tablespoon butter.  Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serves 8.

name: CARROT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1  c. cooked, mashed carrots
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla extract
few drops of almond extract
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar.  Add carrots and egg.  Sift flour, salt and baking powder together; add to wet mixture.   Add vanilla and almond extract.

name: LASAGNE(Made With Uncooked Noodles)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  c. water
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. basil
2 3/4  c. cottage cheese (24 oz.)
4  oz. Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. oregano
8  oz. uncooked lasagne noodles
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown and drain ground beef and onion.  Mix meat with stewed tomatoes, tomato paste, water, sugar, parsley flakes and basil. Mix together cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese, parsley flakes and oregano.  Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan:  1/2 sauce mixture, 1/2 noodles, all cottage cheese mixture, 1/2 noodles, remaining sauce and top all with Mozzarella cheese.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour, covered, then 15 minutes, uncovered.  Let stand a few minutes before cutting.  Makes 8 servings.

name: EASY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  sticks butter
1  stick oleo
2  c. sugar
3  c. flour
2  Tbsp. lemon extract
6  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix in order given.  Bake at 325° in tube pan for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until cake comes away from sides of pan.

name: HEAVENLY COOKIES
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo
1  c. oil
1  c. white sugar
1  c. powdered sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cream of tartar
4 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Cream mixture until light and fluffy.  Drop by spoonful on ungreased cookie sheet.  Optional:  Sprinkle with sugar.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes.

name: BREAD AND BUTTER PICKLE
ingredients:
4  quarts sliced cucumbers
2  quarts of sliced onion rings
1/2  cup salt
1  quart vinegar
1  tsp. turmeric
2  tsp. celery seeds
1  Tbsp. mustard seed
1  Tbsp. white pepper
4  cups sugar
preparation: Mix 2 quarts ice cubes with cucumbers, onions, and salt.  Let stand for 3 hours and drain thoroughly.  Make a pickling syrup with the remaining ingredients and let come to a boil.  Add cucumber mixture and reheat to scalding, but do not boil.  Pour in jars and seal.

name: TURKEY CHIP SURPRISE
ingredients:
2  slices white bread
1  turkey breast
6  good-sized potato chips
preparation: Place the turkey with the chips on the bread and mash down hard.  Happy eating!

name: BARBECUE PIZZA
ingredients:
tomato sauce
barbecue meat
cheese
crust
preparation: Put on crust and cook.

name: MARINATED GARDEN SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. sliced celery
1/2  c. sliced cucumber
1/2  c. sliced carrots
1/2  c. radishes
1/2  c. bottled Italian salad dressing
5  c. torn salad greens
preparation: In a large bowl, combine the celery, cucumber, carrots and radishes.  Add the dressing and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Just before serving, add greens and toss.  Yields 5 servings.

name: BABY SQUASH
ingredients:
1  tsp. salt
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. garlic powder (I use fresh chopped garlic)
7  baby yellow squash, sliced or cubed
7  baby zucchini, sliced or cubed
preparation: Combine cheese and garlic.  Wash vegetables and roll wet vegetables in cheese/garlic/salt mixture.  Place on a cookie sheet that has been lightly sprayed with Pam and bake at 300° for 30 minutes.  (I broil for 5 to 10 minutes until a light golden brown). Can substitute 2 small squash and 2 small zucchini for baby yellow squash and zucchini; cut each into quarters and bake at 300° for 30 minutes.

name: POTATO PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
3  c. cubed raw potato
1/2  small onion
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Put eggs, onion, salt, flour, baking powder and 1/2 cup potatoes in blender or food processor. Process on low speed until potatoes have gone through blades. Stop and add remaining potatoes. Process on high speed only until all potato cubes have passed through blades. Use a spatula to guide potatoes if necessary. Do not overblend. Should see shreds of potato. Spoon onto a hot well-greased skillet.  Cook until golden brown on both sides over medium heat.

name: MACARONI/POT CHEESE AND BACON
ingredients:
1  lb. shell macaroni
1  (16 oz.) large curd cottage cheese
3/4  lb. bacon
1  medium/large onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook macaroni as directed.  Sauté bacon and onion until bacon is crisp and onions golden.  Drain most of drippings.  Mix and toss macaroni, cottage cheese, bacon and onions.  Serve immediately.

name: CRISPY ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. sharp cheese, grated
1  can (15 oz.) chili with beans
1 small  can tomato paste
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  pkg. (6 oz.) corn chips
1  c. sour cream
1  can (1 2/3 c.) enchilada sauce
preparation: Combine 1 1/2 cups grated cheese, enchilada sauce, chili, tomato paste, water, onion and all but 1 cup corn chips.  Pour into lightly greased oblong baking dish.  Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 30 minutes.  Spread sour cream over top, sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese.  Make a circle of remaining corn chips around edge.  Bake an additional 5 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: ALMOND BRICKLE DESSERT
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter
2/3  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 3/4  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. almond extract
1/3  c. milk
2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Prepare topping.  Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl.  Blend well.  Beat 3 minutes at medium speed.  Pour batter into greased 12 x 8-inch pan.  Spread with topping.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: BERNIE ARNOLD'S CHINESE PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. round steak, cut 1-inch thick
1/4  c. shortening
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
4  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. sugar
1  c. canned bean sprouts, drained
2 tomatoes, quartered or 1  c. canned tomatoes
2  green peppers, seeded and cut into 1-inch pieces
1 1/2  tsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. cold water
4  green onions, sliced
rice, cooked
preparation: Slice steak as thinly as possible and cut in crosswise pieces (for easier cutting, cut meat when partially thawed).

name: SWEET AND SOUR SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  jar currant jelly
1/4  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
preparation: Combine all ingredients in microwave-safe dish or bowl. Microwave on Medium-high for 1 minute.  Stir, then microwave until mixture is bubbly, stirring as needed.  Use as a dipping sauce for chicken wings or fingers, ham or pork cubes.

name: HAWAIIAN DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  Jell-O cheese cake mix
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 small  can fruit cocktail, drained
Cool Whip
Baker's angel flake coconut
preparation: Put graham cracker crust in bottom of ungreased 8 x 8-inch pan, following cheese cake directions.  Mix filling from cheese cake according to directions.  Mix in pineapple.  Spread over crust.  Layer of fruit cocktail.  Mix Cool Whip and coconut. Spread over top.  Refrigerate.  For 9 x 13-inch pan, use 2 packages of Jell-O cheese cake and large cans of pineapple and fruit cocktail.

name: HUMMINGBIRD CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking soda
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
3  eggs
1  c. oil
2  c. bananas
8  oz. crushed pineapple, undrained
1 1/2  Tbsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Add eggs and oil; stir to wet mixture. Do not beat.  Add other ingredients and mix.  Do not beat.  Put in 3 greased and floured pans.  Cook at 350° for about 25 to 35 minutes.

name: GRAPE-NUTS CUSTARD PUDDING
ingredients:
1  pt. milk
small piece of butter
1/2  c. Grape-Nuts
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
salt
preparation: Scald milk with small piece of butter added.  Cool.  Add rest of ingredients.  Pour into baking dish and cook in pan of hot water.  Bake in 350° oven until knife inserted in center comes out dry.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  chicken, cooked and shredded
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can canned milk
1 large  can chopped green chiles
1  medium onion, chopped
tortilla chips
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Grease casserole and put tortilla chips (crushed) in bottom of large casserole or 9 x 13-inch pan.  Put shredded chicken, soup, milk, green chiles and onion in a saucepan and heat until hot and bubbly.  Pour over chips and top with cheese.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: BARBECUE SLAW
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: Combine and heat until boiling.  Stir constantly.  Pour over 3/4 head of grated cabbage.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. fresh broccoli, chopped and cooked
4 to 6  c. cooked chicken, coarsely diced
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
6  Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  c. milk
1/2  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Layer broccoli on bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Layer chicken over broccoli.  In a saucepan, melt the 6 tablespoons butter.  Stir in the flour, salt and pepper.  Gradually stir in the milk and continue stirring until the white sauce is smooth and comes to a boil.  Remove from heat.
