Combine mayonnaise and lemon juice with white sauce and pour over chicken and broccoli. Sprinkle with cheese.  Melt 2 tablespoons butter.  Stir in bread crumbs and sprinkle over casserole.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: APPLE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1  stick butter
3  apples, sliced thinly
1  c. sour cream
1  egg
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: Melt the butter and mix into the cake mix until crumbly.  Take 2/3 cup of mixture out and set aside.  Take the rest of the mixture and dump into ungreased pan.  Pat down to flat on bottom of pan.  Then arrange apples over mixture so that it is covered. Take 2/3 cup mixture and mix egg, sour cream, cinnamon and brown sugar all together.  Sprinkle on top of apples.  Cook at 350° for 1/2 hour.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. salad oil
3  eggs
2  c. pumpkin
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Beat the sugar and salad oil until fluffy.  Add the eggs, one at a time.  Beat in the remaining ingredients.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour in small pans.

name: SOUTHWESTERN PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  (16 oz) pkg Penne Pasta
Creamy Southwestern dressing
lettuce leaves
1 (15 oz)  can black beans (rinsed & drained)
1  (8 3/4 oz) whole kernel corn (rinsed & drained)
1  sweet red pepper, chopped
3  green onions, sliced
1/4  cup chopped fresh cilantro
preparation: Cook pasta according to package directions; drain.  Rinse with cold water and drain.  Combine pasta and 1 3/4 cups creamy Southwestern Salad Dressing, toss.  Chill.  Spoon pasta mixture onto a lettuce lined platter. Top with black beans and next 4 ingredients.  Serve with remaining dressing.  6 servings

name: MARINATED DUCK BREAST
ingredients:
4  small filleted duck breasts
salt and pepper
2  apples, sliced
1  onion, chopped
2  c. orange juice
4  strips bacon
preparation: In a dish, place skinned duck breasts.  Season with salt and pepper.  Place sliced apples and onion in dish and pour orange juice over breasts.  Cover and marinate overnight.

name: VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  pt. low-fat sour cream
1  pkg. dry vegetable soup
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix and chill for at least 3 hours.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
6  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
6  Tbsp. water
1  c. chili sauce
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Brown meat first.  Add remaining ingredients.  Cook on high heat until steaming, then simmer 1 hour or until done.

name: GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
2 1/3  c. whole wheat flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  c. unsulfured molasses
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/2  tsp. ground allspice
1/2  c. soft butter
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
3/4  c. hot water
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.  Blend baking soda, ginger, cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice and butter.  Stir in sugar; beat in eggs.  Stir in molasses and add hot water.  Alternate with flour mix.  Pour in well-buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 45 minutes.

name: TARTE A LA BOUILLIE(Custard Pie)
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
Sweet Crust
preparation: Mix sugar, flour and salt; add eggs and beat well.  Bring milk to a boil; add egg mixture and cook over medium heat until thick. Cool and add vanilla; pour into unbaked Sweet Crust pie shell and top with lattice top crust.  Bake at 350° until golden brown, about 1 hour.  Serve warm.

name: BROWN BETTY
ingredients:
2  c. soft bread crumbs
3  Tbsp. butter, melted
3  c. stewed sweetened apples
preparation: Combine crumbs and butter. Arrange in layers in greased baking dish. First crumbs, then apples, having crumbs for top layer. Dot with additional butter and bake in 350 degree oven for about 20 minutes. Serve with light cream.

name: OLD FASHIONED PEANUT BUTTER SHEET COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. packed brown sugar
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
2 1/2  c. flour, sifted
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Optional:  You can add M&M's, Reese's pieces or butterscotch chips or all of these.

name: PEAR COBBLER
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/3  c. milk
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. chopped pears
cinnamon
1/2  c. margarine
2  c. sugar
2  c. water
preparation: Cut shortening into flour, add milk and roll dough out. Sprinkle pears onto dough.  Sprinkle with cinnamon.  Roll up  into a roll like a jelly roll and slice.  Melt margarine in an oblong pan; place slices in butter.  Bring to boil sugar and water.  Pour over dough mixture.  Bake in 350° oven until golden brown.

name: SPANISH RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck or beef
1  medium onion
1  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  pkg. chili seasoning mix
1  c. water
1  can chili hot beans
6  saltine crackers
1/2  c. catsup
1/4  c. Heinz 57 sauce
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion.  Drain.  Add cracker crumbs, catsup and 57 sauce to ground beef.  Add 1 cup water, chili mix, seasonings and beans.  Simmer for 35 minutes.  Serve over cooked rice.

name: LIGHT HERB CHICKEN WITH MUSHROOM SAUCE
ingredients:
4  to 6 boneless chicken breasts
poultry seasoning
cooking spray
red wine vinegar
1  large onion, diced
2  cans light cream of mushroom soup
1  can pineapple tidbits
preparation: Spray a 2-quart casserole dish with cooking spray.  Sprinkle the poultry seasoning over the chicken; bake for 20 minutes at 375°.  In a nonstick skillet, saute the onion in red wine vinegar (no oil).  Add the soup and 2 cans of water.  Stir in pineapple tidbits and 1/2 of the pineapple juice.  Pour mixture over chicken; bake for 25 to 30 more minutes.  Serve over rice or pasta.

name: PORTOFINO MOLD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry jello
1 1/4  c. boiling water
1  lb. 4 oz. can crushed pineapple, not drained
1  lb. can whole cranberry sauce
3/4  c. Port wine or apple juice
1  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Stir in pineapple, cranberry sauce and wine.  Chill until mixture thickens slightly. Fold in nuts and turn into 2-quart dish or 9 x 9 x 2-inch square dish.  Chill until firm.  Soften cream cheese and slowly add sour cream until mixture is smooth.  Spread over gelatin.  Chill until serving time.  Yields 8 servings.  Family favorite.

name: CORN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Shoe Peg corn
green onions
Tony Creole seasoning
1  or 2 cucumbers, sliced
mayonnaise
1  bell pepper, diced
2  tomatoes, sliced or chopped
1  egg, boiled
preparation: Drain corn.  Add other ingredients and mix.  Add mayonnaise when ready to serve.  Chill.

name: THE IMPOSSIBLE PIE(Quick and Easy)
ingredients:
1/2  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1  can (3 1/2 oz.) coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix everything in a blender.  Pour into 9-inch buttered pie plate.  Bake at 400° for 25-30 minutes or until custard sets. Serve cold.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
6  c. flour
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. warm water
1  pkg. yeast
2  c. sour milk
preparation: Mix flour, oil, soda, salt and sugar; set aside.  In large mixing bowl, mix 1/2 cup water and yeast; add sour milk.  Mix well with dry ingredients.  Refrigerate at least 6 hours before using. Use as needed.  Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

name: BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. stewing beef, cut up and seasoned with tenderizer, pepper and teriyaki
1  Tbsp. bacon fat
1 small  can tomato sauce
cleaned and cut celery, onions, carrots and potatoes
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  can water
preparation: Cover bottom of pot with oil; add the bacon fat and butter or margarine.  Saute onion. Add meat. Stir until brown. Add small can tomato sauce and 1/2 can water. Add celery and carrots. Simmer 1/2 hour.  Add potatoes and simmer another 1 hour.  Add peas.

name: TEXAS WHITE TRASH
ingredients:
4  c. Cheerios
4  c. Rice Chex
4  c. pretzels (round)
2  c. pecans
2  lb. white chocolate
1  Tbsp. Crisco
preparation: Melt white chocolate and oil in double boiler on low heat. Mix all ingredients together and pour melted chocolate over them. Stir well and pour out on wax paper.  Let set until firm.  Break apart to serve.

name: BUDGET STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. dried bread crumbs
3  Tbsp. onion, chopped
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix ingredients thoroughly.  Shape to look like 1 1/2-inch steak.  Place on broiler.  Broil 10 to 15 minutes on one side. Turn and broil on other side.  May freeze.

name: AMBROSIA PIE
ingredients:
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
1/4  c. fresh lemon juice
1  c. whipped cream
vanilla wafer or graham cracker crust
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients and place in vanilla wafer or graham cracker crust.  Chill overnight.

name: GREEN PEPPER JELLY
ingredients:
8  to 12 green peppers, blended or chopped fine
1/2  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. white vinegar
14  c. sugar
2  pkg. Certo fruit pectin (1 box usually contains 2 pkg.)
green food coloring
8  to 12 jelly jars
preparation: Combine lemon juice, vinegar and sugar in large pot and bring to a boil.  Boil 1 minute and add green peppers and boil for 5 minutes.  Stir in Certo and food coloring if desired.  Place in hot jars.  If you wish to strain the bits of peppers from the juice, do so before adding the Certo.  Also, if you like hot sauces, blend or chop 6 to 8 hot peppers with the green peppers. Delicious with cream cheese or meats.

name: MICROWAVE PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. raw peanuts
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white Karo syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Place peanuts and sugar in syrup in a glass bowl.  Stir. Microwave on High for 4 minutes.  Take out, stir well and microwave 4 more minutes.  Take out, add margarine, stir well and microwave 2 more minutes.  Take out; add vanilla and soda.  Mix well.  Pour onto buttered sheet of foil.  Cool and break into pieces.

name: FRIED ZUCCHINI
ingredients:
1  medium zucchini
2  tsp. seasoned salt
2  Tbsp. water
1  egg, beaten
1  c. biscuit mix
preparation: Peel zucchini; slice into 1/4-inch slices and beat egg and water.  Add 1 teaspoon seasoned salt; beat well.  Put biscuit mix into plastic bag with 1 teaspoon seasoning; shake well.  Heat 1/4-inch oil in frying pan; dip slices of zucchini into egg wash, then into biscuit mix in bag.  Fry until golden brown on both sides.  Serve with sour cream on side.

name: SPINACH SALAD
ingredients:
1  bunch fresh spinach
1  can bean sprouts
1  can water chestnuts
3  boiled eggs
mushrooms
bacon bits
1/4  c. vinegar
1  c. oil
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
preparation: Blend vinegar, oil, sugar, catsup and Worcestershire and add to salad just before serving.

name: PEAR HONEY
ingredients:
6  pears
2  apples
1  orange
1  1/2 lb Sugar
preparation: Peel apples, pears, and orange.  Remove seeds.  Grind pears, apples, and orange.  Add sugar and cook 20 minutes, stirring frequently.  Add grated orange rind.  Cook until thick.

name: MACARONI AND TOMATOES
ingredients:
8  slices bacon, fried and chopped
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped green pepper
2  qt. canned tomatoes
1  can tomato soup
4  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. macaroni, cooked
preparation: Cook onion, celery and green pepper in bacon grease.  Add bacon and cooked vegetables to tomato mixture.  Cook about 20 minutes. Drain macaroni and add to tomato mixture.  You will have a lot of tomato juice in your pan.  Don't be alarmed, just let the mixture sit on the stove for about an hour and during this time the macaroni will absorb all the juice.  (If you try to cook it down, it will stick badly.)  Put in a casserole dish and run in a 375° oven for about 45 minutes.  Serves 12.  If you have leftover chopped ham, this is a nice addition to this dish.

name: STOVE TOP POT ROAST
ingredients:
3  lb. roast
1 1/2  Tbsp. shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
2  small onions
preparation: Melt shortening in heavy pot large enough to hold roast (with cover).  When shortening is hot, place roast (which is rubbed with all the seasoning) into pot.  Brown roast on all sides.  Turn to low heat.  Cover and simmer 3 1/2 hours.  Add onions (sliced or chopped) to roast one hour before it is done.

name: POUND CAKE*
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
5  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
4  c. sifted flour
1/2  lb. butter
1  c. milk
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time and beat well.  Sift baking powder with flour.  Alternate milk and flour. Bake at 275° until done.

name: QUICK CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  oz. spaghetti
16 1/2  oz. can tuna or 2 c. cooked diced turkey or chicken or ham
1/4  c. chopped green onions
1  small chopped onion
1/2  c. water
1  can condensed mushroom soup
2  Tbsp. margarine
1 3/4  c. shredded cheese (save 1/2 c. of cheese for top of dish)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Sauté green pepper and onion in margarine for about 10 minutes.  Break spaghetti in pieces and cook in salt water until tender; drain.  Combine meat, onion and green pepper in casserole dish.  Mix water and soup and add to meat mixture.  Add 1 1/4 cups cheese and spaghetti.  Season to taste.  Toss lightly and coat with sauce.  Sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese.  Bake at 350° about 30 minutes.

name: CHILI CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1 medium  can Armor chili with no beans
1  pkg. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Melt cheese over low flame; add chili.  Place in crock-pot and keep warm.  Serve on chips, crackers or vegetable pieces.

name: WILD RICE AND SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hot sausage
1  medium onion
2  stalks celery, diced
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 small  jar chopped pimentos
1 (2 oz.)  can mushroom pieces
1  box Uncle Ben's long grain wild rice
preparation: Cook sausage until brown.  Add onion and celery and cook vegetables until clear.  Add 1 can cream of mushroom soup and stir. Add pimentos, mushrooms and rice.  Place in 3-quart greased casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: MICROWAVE PEANUT BUTTER CEREAL BARS
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. Karo
3/4  c. chunky peanut butter
6  c. favorite ready-to-eat breakfast cereal
preparation: Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan with foil; grease foil.  In a 3-quart microwavable bowl, stir together sugar, Karo and peanut butter.  Cook on High 3 1/2 to 4 minutes, stirring twice, or until mixture is smooth and sugar is dissolved.  Add cereal.  Stir to coat well.  Press evenly into prepared pan.  Cut into squares. Store tightly covered.  Yield:  4 dozen.

name: Cake Mix Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
2  pkg. yeast
2 1/2  c. warm water
4 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Batter will be stiff.  Knead lightly on floured board.  Place in greased bowl; cover.  Let rise 1 hour in warm, draft-free area.  Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness. Spread soft butter over dough and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Shape into roll, pinch edge to seal and cut into 1/2-inch lengths. Place, cut side up, in greased baking pan.  Cover and let rise again for 1 hour.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.  Frost with buttercream frosting.  Makes 36 rolls.

name: SUMMER BERRY PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. raspberries
1 1/2  c. strawberries
1  c. blueberries, picked over, rinsed and drained
1  (9-inch) baked pastry shell, cooled
3/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 1/2  c. water
1 (4-serving size)  pkg. Jell-O brand strawberry gelatin
1  (8 oz.) tub Cool Whip nondairy whipped topping, thawed
preparation: In a large bowl, mix berries.  Pour into prepared pastry shell.

name: QUICK SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  can crushed pineapple
1  can strawberry pie filling
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Mix all ingredients in large bowl and refrigerate.

name: STUFFED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  loin or rib pork chops (1 to 1 1/2-inches thick)
1 1/4  c. day old bread crumbs
1/4  c. minced onion
3/4  c. finely diced tart apples
1/4  c. raisins
1  tsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. melted margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper and sage
preparation: Cut chops to form a pocket. Chop raisins and combine with rest of ingredients. Stuff chops with dressing. Fasten opening with toothpicks. Flour chops; brown in hot fat and season with salt and pepper. Add a few tablespoons water; cover skillet. Cook at low temperature for 35 to 40 minutes until tender.

name: CRAB/CHEESE WEDGES
ingredients:
6  English muffins
1  stick margarine
1 1/2  tsp. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1 (5 oz.)  jar Old English cheese spread
1 (6 oz.)  can crab meat or shrimp
preparation: Combine all ingredients and spread on English muffin halves. Put in freezer until partially frozen.  Cut into six wedges. Return to freezer.  Put frozen wedges under broiler until golden crispy.  Yields 72 wedges.

name: ICE CREAM SANDWICH DESSERT
ingredients:
24  ice cream sandwiches
2  (8 oz.) containers whipped topping
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In the  bottom  of  a  9  x 13-inch casserole, place 12 sandwiches.  Spread  on  one  container  of  whipped  topping. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup chopped nuts.  Repeat layers.  Freeze.

name: CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
20  oz. (1 large can) pineapple, crushed
1/2  c. water
6  oz. (1 large box) jello, cherry
21  oz. (1 can) cherry pie filling
3/4  c. cola
preparation: Drain juice from pineapple.  Bring juice and water to a boil. Add jello to hot liquid and mix.  Add cherry pie filling and cola. Let partially congeal before adding pineapple.  Chill until firm.

name: LOW-FAT GINGER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. margarine, softened
2/3  c. plus 1 Tbsp. sugar, divided
1/4  c. molasses
1  egg
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. mace
preparation: Cream margarine and gradually add 2/3 cup sugar.  Beat with electric mixer until light and fluffy.  Add molasses and egg; beat well.  Combine flour and next 4 ingredients.  Gradually add to creamed mixture and stir well.  Divide dough in half and wrap both in plastic wrap.  Freeze for 30 minutes.  Shape into 1-inch balls, roll in remaining sugar and place 2-inches apart on cookie sheet coated with vegetable spray.  Bake at 350° for 12 minutes; cool. Store in airtight container.

name: PINEAPPLE PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large  can pineapple juice
1  qt. orange juice
1 small  can frozen lemon juice
2  c. sugar
1  c. water
4  bottles 7-Up
1  gal. pineapple sherbet
preparation: Add before serving:

name: QUICK AND EASY LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  pkg. hamburger meat
1  box lasagna noodles
1  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1  pkg. Cheddar cheese
1  jar Ragu spaghetti sauce
1 small  jar minced onions
4  Tbsp. mushrooms
1  can Parmesan cheese
preparation: Take lasagna noodles and put in big pot on medium-high to boil with 1 teaspoon of oil.  Then fry hamburger meat until done. Drain excess fat from meat.  When noodles are done, drain water, then put noodles first in a large casserole dish, then put hamburger meat and spaghetti sauce.  Put Cheddar cheese, then Mozzarella on top of it. Then you continue to layer with noodles, meat, mushrooms, cheese, sauce and minced onions.  (This should come out with hamburger meat on top.)  Then put Mozzarella cheese and Cheddar cheese on top of meat, then put the remaining Ragu sauce on top of cheese with a few sprinkles of Parmesan cheese.  Bake in oven for 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.  Cook until brown on top and mostly all cheeses have melted throughout lasagna.  Let it cool for 20 minutes.  Enjoy!

name: PARTY SPREAD
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1 1/2  c. Swiss cheese
1/3  c. Miracle Whip (salad dressing)
2  Tbsp. chopped green onions
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/3  c. sliced almonds
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients.  Mix well. Spread mixture in 9-inch pie plate.  Bake for 15 minutes.  Garnish with additional almonds if desired.  Serve with assorted crackers or Bagel chips.  Serve warm.

name: WHAT'S IN IT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime jello
1  c. hot water
1  doz. large marshmallows, quartered
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple, drain and save juice
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1/2  pt. whipping cream or 1 envelope Dream Whip or 1 c.  Cool Whip
1  c. shredded cabbage
1/4  c. chopped nutmeats
1  c. crushed pineapple
preparation: Dissolve first 3 ingredients over heat until  marshmallows have melted.  Remove from heat. Add 1 cup pineapple juice.  Allow to set until it begins to congeal. Fold in mayonnaise, whipped cream, pineapple, cabbage and nutmeats.   Mix carefully, but well. Place in an 8 x 8-inch dish or pan. Cover with Saran or foil. Refrigerate.  Serves 9.  Delicious!

name: PINEAPPLE TOPPING FOR LEMON CAKE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/3 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1 orange juice  can water
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. butter or oleo
preparation: Mix all together and cook until thickened.  Cool to serve on cake (enough for one large cake).  Very good!

name: ZUCCHINI QUICHE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. oil
4  eggs
1/2  c. Romano cheese, grated
3  c. thinly sliced zucchini
dash of salt and pepper
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
1/2  c. onion, finely chopped
1/8  c. parsley
preparation: Beat eggs. Add salt, pepper, oil, cheese, garlic, onion and parsley. Mix flour and baking powder together. Add to egg mixture, then fold in zucchini. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes. Cut into 2 x 2-inch squares.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. oil
5  eggs
2  c. pumpkin
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2 (3 oz.)  boxes coconut pie filling (regular)
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix oil, eggs and pumpkin.  Combine remaining ingredients and add to pumpkin mixture.  Divide mixture in two.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
5  apples
5  Tbsp. sugar
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
3  c. unsifted flour
4  eggs, unbeaten
1  c. cooking oil
1/3  c. orange juice
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Peel apples and cut into thin slices.  Mix 5 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over apples.  Set aside.  Blend all other ingredients, except baking powder and baking soda, with mixer on low speed for 1 minute and on medium speed for 3 minutes.  Add baking soda and baking powder.  Mix 1 minute more.

name: DON TRUITT'S FIRST PRIZE CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  lb. steak, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
2  or 3 large onions, chopped
2  cloves garlic, chopped
2 (15 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
2 (4 oz.)  cans diced green chilies
2  tsp. ground cumin or more to your taste
1 (1 lb. 14 oz.)  can red beans or pinto beans, drained (optional)
1/2 to 1  tsp. Angostura Bitters
1  c. red wine
salt to taste
preparation: Cook beef in a large skillet or heavy pan until meat loses redness. Remove. Cook onions and garlic separately and return beef to pan. Stir in tomato sauce, wine, chilies, salt, cumin and Bitters.  Partially cover and simmer 1 hour or more to desired thickness.  (Tip:  A grated potato is a good thickener and won't show or taste.)  Add beans, if desired, and simmer, uncovered, for 45 minutes. Serve with chopped onion, grated Cheddar and dollops of sour cream in each bowl. Freezes well.  Yields about 2 quarts.

name: PEACH CORNMEAL MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  cup butter
1/2  cup sugar
1  large egg
1  cup all-purpose flour
1/2  cup white cornmeal
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. ground nutmeg
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  cup milk
1  cup finely chopped
fresh peaches  (about 2 medium peaches)
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  In a large bowl cream butter and sugar, beating until light and fluffy.  Add the egg and beat well. In a separate bowl combine flour, cornmeal, salt, nutmeg and baking powder.  Mix well.  Add to butter mixture in two parts alternating with milk, stirring after each addition just until combined.  Add the fresh peaches and stir to blend.  Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full with the batter and bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until golden brown.  Cool for 5 minutes on wire rack, gently remove from muffin tins and allow to cool completely.  Yield:  1 dozen.

name: RICH BARS
ingredients:
2  c. oatmeal
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Melt butter.  Mix in oatmeal and brown sugar.  Pat mixture in a greased 9-inch square pan.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

name: SOUR CREAM COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening or oleo
2  eggs
1  c. thick sour cream
1/4  tsp. salt
1 3/4  c. white or 2 c. brown sugar
2  tsp. vanilla or lemon
4 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: May substitute whole wheat flour.  Add enough to make a drop cookie.  When using white flour, can be used as a rolled cookie. Mix in order of ingredients.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: SEVEN LAYER FINGER JELLO
ingredients:
4 small  boxes jello (different colors)
1  c. boiling water
1  pkg. unflavored gelatin (in 3/4 c. water)
1  can Eagle Brand
2  c. boiling water
preparation: To each box of jello, add 1 cup boiling water and 1 package unflavored gelatin (in 3/4 cup water).

name: AUNT MAXINE'S LOG CABIN CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/3  c. baking cocoa
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. leftover coffee
1  egg
1/2  c. oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Mix the first 5 ingredients.  Add remaining ingredients.  Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

name: SORGHUM CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  c. sorghum
1 1/4  c. buttermilk
2  c. flour
preparation: Mix well first 2 ingredients.  Mix well and add remaining ingredients.  Mix well and bake in 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: VELVET SALAD
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  large container Cool Whip lite
1  c. nuts
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  box orange or lime jello
preparation: Mix all ingredients and chill.

name: SQUASH PATTIES
ingredients:
2  c. cooked squash with onions, drained and mashed
1  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  egg
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and drop by spoonful into hot grease.

name: FLICK-ETTE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
2 1/4  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs
1/2  pkg. Flick-ettes (chocolate chips)
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter, sugars, eggs and vanilla. Combine flour, salt and soda; blend into creamed mix.  Stir in flick-ettes. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 8 dozen.

name: ELEPHANT STEW
ingredients:
1  medium size elephant
carrots
potatoes
onions
salt and pepper
1  rabbit
preparation: Cut elephant into bite-size chunks (this takes approximately 4 weeks).  Place in large black pot.  Cover with water; add salt and pepper to taste.  Simmer over a kerosene fire until tender (about 5 months).  Add potatoes, carrots and onions and cook for about 3 more days.  This serves about 5,000.  If more are expected, add the rabbit, but do so only if necessary, as not too many people like to find a hare in their stew.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  potatoes
4  pork chops
1  bell pepper, sliced
1  onion, sliced
salt and pepper
1/4  c. water
preparation: Brown chops in small amount of oil.  Set aside.  Peel potatoes, cut in half and season.

name: GLAZED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange flavored gelatin
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/3  c. water
dash of salt
2  tsp. margarine
4  small to medium size sweet potatoes, cooked until tender and sliced
preparation: In skillet, combine gelatin, cinnamon, water and salt.  Add margarine.  Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Add sweet potatoes; cover and cook 15 minutes or until sweet potatoes are glazed.  Makes 4 servings.

name: COCONUT LAYER CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sifted plain flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
5  eggs
1 1/4  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. coconut extract
preparation: Sift together flour and baking powder.  Cream shortening; gradually add sugar, creaming until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk, add extract.  Pour into three greased and floured 9-inch pans.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.  Remove from oven; place on cake racks and let cool in pans.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
small box lasagna noodles
1  lb. ground beef
Ragu Thick 'N Hearty style spaghetti sauce
Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Prepare noodles (boil until tender).  Brown and drain ground beef and add spaghetti sauce.  Grease bottom of dish.  Coat bottom of dish with small amount of sauce, layer of noodles to cover entire bottom of dish.  Then layer sauce over noodles (about 1 tablespoon per noodle), and sprinkle cheese over sauce.  Continue to layer noodles, sauce and cheese.  Sprinkle rest of cheese on top layer and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: CHICKEN STOCK
ingredients:
4  lb. chicken backs or a 4 to 5 lb. stewing chicken
1  onion, sliced
2  carrots, cut into thirds
1  stalk celery, cut into thirds
1  bay leaf
2  sprigs parsley
1/4  tsp. thyme
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can chicken broth, strained
preparation: In your largest pot, combine all ingredients; cover with water and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.  Remove chicken and vegetables and save for another use. Refrigerate stock in pot overnight.  Skim off fat.  Freeze in storage containers.

name: HIDDEN VALLEY POTATOES
ingredients:
4  to 6 potatoes
1  stick oleo, melted
1  pkg. original Hidden Valley salad dressing mix
preparation: Wash potatoes; do not peel.  Slice crosswise.  Layer in casserole dish.  Pour melted oleo over potatoes; sprinkle with Hidden Valley mix.  Cover; bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: ANGEL PIE
ingredients:
3  egg whites
1  c. pecans
1  c. unsalted crackers, crumbled up
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Beat egg whites until foamy.  Add sugar, a little at a time. In a separate bowl, mix crumbs, pecans (broken into pieces) and vanilla, a little at a time.  Combine all these ingredients and place in pie pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Let cool, then top with Cool Whip.  Refrigerate.

name: SIX-LAYER DINNER(It's simple to put together.)
ingredients:
3  c. sliced, peeled raw potatoes
1 (17 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  medium onion, sliced
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. sliced raw carrots
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
preparation: Layer potatoes, corn, onion, meat and carrots in a 3-quart casserole, seasoning each layer with salt and pepper.  Pour tomatoes over top.  Cover and bake at 350° for 1 3/4 hours or until vegetables are done.  Makes 6 servings.

name: RASPBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  stick butter
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. sour cream
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. almond extract
seedless raspberry jam
almond paste
preparation: Beat butter and sugar.  Add eggs and beat well.  Add sour cream and almond extract; mix.  Add flour, soda and powder.   Beat well.  Put one tablespoon batter in each muffin cup.  Add 1 teaspoon jam and 1/2 to 1 teaspoon almond paste.  Fill with more batter and bake at 350° for 25 minutes, until golden.  Makes 12 to 14 muffins.

name: GREEN SPLIT PEA SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. pkg. green split peas
1  medium carrot, diced fine
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
3  stalks celery, chopped
ham bone
salt and pepper
preparation: In soup kettle, melt 2 tablespoons butter.  Add carrot, onion and celery.  Heat just until tender.  When veggies are tender, add split peas and 2 quarts water and a ham bone or ham and 1/2 gallon of beef or chicken broth.  Boil rapidly for a few minutes and skim off residue which comes to top.  Reduce heat and allow to simmer for 2 hours, adding water if needed.  Season to taste.

name: BAKED CLAMS OREGANO
ingredients:
1  doz. top neck clams
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. seasoned breadcrumbs
1/2  c. oil
1  garlic clove, minced
1  Tbsp. oregano
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Wash and open clams, removing one side of shell from each.  Place in baking dish.  Mix onion, breadcrumbs, garlic, oregano and oil and spoon over each clam until all is used up.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes, until breadcrumbs turn golden brown.

name: COLORFUL VEG-ALL CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  box cornbread mix
1 (16 oz.)  can Veg-All mixed vegetables, drained
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/3  c. milk
1  egg, slightly beaten
preparation: Combine ingredients.   Spoon into lightly greased 8 x 8-inch pan.  Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.   Cool 5 minutes before cutting.  (Leftover chopped, cooked ham or sausage can be added.) Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: DATE DELIGHTS
ingredients:
1  c. chopped dates
1  c. chopped pecans
1  can eagle brand milk
1/2  stick butter
3  oz. cream cheese
2  c. confectioners sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  box ritz crackers
preparation: Combine date & milk in boiler.  Cook until thick.  Remove and stir in pecans.  Spread on crackers.  Bake 6-7 minutes in 325 degree oven.  Mix cream cheese, butter, confectioners sugar and vanilla.  Spread on cooled ritz crackers.

name: FRUITCAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. mixed candied fruit
1/2  c. flour (plain or self-rising)
1  pinch salt
1  can (3 1/2 oz.) coconut
2  c. chopped pecans
1  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Dredge fruit in flour.  Add salt, coconut and nuts.  Add milk and mix thoroughly.  Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in preheated 275° oven.  Store cooled cookies in an airtight container about 5 days before serving. Makes about 4 dozen.

name: BARBECUED SPARERIBS
ingredients:
4  lb. spareribs
2  medium size onions, sliced
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. ketchup
3/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/8  tsp. cayenne
1  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Arrange spareribs in large baking pan.  Add onions and sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Combine remaining ingredients and pour over spareribs.  Cover and bake in moderate oven (350°) about 1 1/2 hours, basting frequently.   Remove cover and continue to cook about 20 to 30 minutes longer.  Makes 6 servings.

name: GARDEN PEA MIXTURE
ingredients:
1  can drained garden peas with little onions (Green Giant)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  stick melted oleo
Club, saltine or Ritz crackers
preparation: Spray casserole dish with Pam.  Spread peas and soup evenly in casserole.  Crumble crackers in butter to absorb.  Bake at 325° until brown.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs
1  c. peanut butter
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. soda
preparation: Mix in order given.  Shape into small balls.  Press down with fork, first one way and then the other to form squares on top. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: GRAPE-NUTS PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  c. Grape-Nuts
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
2  c. milk
pinch of salt
preparation: Let Grape-Nuts stand in milk for 5 minutes. Add the remaining beaten ingredients. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: EASY CHERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (1 qt.)  bottle cherry punch mix
6  qt. cold water
1  pkg. cherry Kool-Aid
1  c. sugar
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 (1 pt.)  bottle lemon juice
preparation: Mix  punch  mix, cold water and Kool-Aid, stirring well. Add sugar;  stir until dissolved.  Add fruit juices; mix well. Serve from punch bowl with ice ring or ice cubes, if desired.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, drained
1  c. sour cream
1  pkg. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
garlic powder to taste
1  green or red bell pepper, chopped
1  c. water chestnuts, drained and chopped
5  whole green onions, chopped
preparation: Mix together sour cream, mayonnaise, soup mix and garlic; add peppers, onions and chestnuts, then spinach.   Chill and serve.

name: QUAKER CHOCOAT-CHIP COOKIES(Yields 5 Dozen Cookies)
ingredients:
1  c. (2 sticks) margarine, softened
1 1/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
2 1/2  c. Quaker oats
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. (2 c.) Nestle Toll House semi-sweet morsels
1  c. coarsely chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Heat oven at 375°.  Mix all dry ingredients together, then add all others.  Bake 9 to 10 minutes for chewy, 12 to 13 minutes for crisp.  Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet and remove to wire rack.

name: VEGETABLE BEEF PATTIES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
3  potatoes, sliced
3  carrots, sliced
1  onion, sliced
salt
pepper
butter
preparation: Divide ground chuck in half.  Make 2 patties.  Place potatoes, carrots, onions, salt, pepper and 1 pat of butter on each.  Wrap individually in tin foil, place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Serves 2.

name: MEXITALIAN LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can chili (no beans)
1 (16 oz.)  jar salsa sauce, drained
1  (14 oz.) sliced mushrooms
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1 1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning or spaghetti seasoning
1 1/2  c. cottage cheese
1 1/2  tsp. parsley flakes
9  lasagna noodles
2 1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: In a large bowl combine chili, drained salsa, mushrooms and Parmesan cheese.  In a small bowl, combine cottage cheese and parsley flakes.   Cook noodles according to package.  In greased or oiled 9 x 9-inch baking dish, layer noodles, chili, cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese.  Repeat 3 layers.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: BEEF AND VEGETABLE FRIED RICE
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
2  tsp. vegetable oil
1  red pepper, cut up
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. frozen pea pods
3  c. cold, cooked rice
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  tsp. dark sesame oil
1/4  c. sliced green onion
preparation: In a large skillet, brown beef, garlic and ginger over medium heat, 8 to 10 minutes.  Mix will be crumbly.  Drain beef of oil. Put in bowl; set aside.  In same skillet, heat vegetable oil. Stir in pepper and pea pods for 3 minutes or until crisp-tender. Add rice, soy sauce and sesame oil.  Mix well.  Add beef; heat about 5 minutes.  Stir in onion.  Garnish as desired.  Makes four 1 1/2-cup servings.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
8  large apples
lemon juice
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. flour
butter
preparation: Peel, core  and slice thinly 8 apples.	Sprinkle with a little lemon juice  and  1/2 cup sugar.  Pour in pie pan.	Mix brown sugar  and	flour and pour over apple mixture.  Dot with butter. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: NACHOS SUPREMOS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  lb. beef chorizo
1  lb. onions, chopped
hot pepper sauce
1 (30 oz.)  can refried beans
1 (4 oz.)  can diced green chiles
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. shredded Jack cheese
1 (7 oz.)  can Ortega green chile salsa
6  green onions, chopped
preparation: Crumble beef and chorizo into a large skillet.  Add onions and cook until meat is browned; drain and add several drops of hot pepper sauce.  Spread beans in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread meat mixture on top.  Sprinkle with green onions, chiles and cheeses. Drizzle salsa over all.  Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Serve with guacamole and sour cream.  Garnish with black olives.  Tuck tortilla chips around edges and serve.  Good hot or cold.  Serves 12.

name: SHIPWRECK
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  onion, chopped
1  c. diced celery
4  large potatoes, cut up as French fries
1  can kidney beans with liquid
1  can tomato soup
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Brown hamburger with salt, celery and onion.  Place in layers in baking dish (at least 2-quart) the meat, beans and potatoes; repeat.  Add tomato soup on top and dot with butter.  Cover dish and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: OATMEAL MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. oatmeal (quick), cooked
2  c. milk
1  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. soft shortening
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Mix together oatmeal and milk.  Let stand 1/2 hour.  Set aside.  Beat until light and fluffy the brown sugar, eggs, shortening and vanilla.  Add baking powder, salt and soda.  Mix well into creamed mixture.  Add flour; mix.  Add oatmeal mixture and blend in well.  Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Makes 18 muffins.

name: COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow or white cake mix with pudding in the mix
1  can of cream of coconut
1  c. coconut
1  carton of cool whip
preparation: Bake cake according to directions on box adding 1 teaspoon of coconut flavoring.  When cake is done, punch holes in top while still hot pour 1 -1 1/2 c. of cream of coconut over top, letting it soak in.  Top with cool whip and sprinkle with coconut.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
40  oz. Oreo cookies
1/2  stick margarine
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. confectioners sugar
3 1/2  c. milk
2  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
12  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Grind cookies in food processor.  Mix butter, cream cheese and confectioners sugar together.  In separate bowl, mix milk, pudding and whipped topping.  Fold mixtures together.   Layer in an 8-inch flowerpot.  Start and end with ground cookies.  Decorate with flowers.

name: EGGPLANT
ingredients:
1  large eggplant
1  onion, diced
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes with diced green chilies
salt
3  c. water
preparation: Put water, salt, onion and eggplant in pressure cooker for 5 minutes of pressure.  Remove all ingredients from cooker and transfer to another pan or wok.  Cook in wok until water is dissolved.  While dissolving, add Ro-Tel tomatoes and salt to taste.  Add red pepper if needed, but tomatoes are quite spicy!

name: HOT SAUCE
ingredients:
6  to 8 fresh jalapeno peppers, chopped
1 tall  can tomato juice
3  big white onions, chopped
2  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
preparation: Mix together in saucepan.  Cook until onion is done.  This is hot, but it is good on vegetables or with chips.

name: LIVER SAUSAGE PATE
ingredients:
1  lb. liver sausage
1  can beef broth
1  envelope Knox unflavored gelatine
1  small onion, cut into pieces
preparation: Cut liver sausage into chunks.  Heat beef broth until hot, remove; add 1 package of gelatine.  Let cool.  Add liver sausage and onion.  Put in blender and whip until pureed.  Put into small containers or serving dish.  Serve with crackers.

name: OLD FASHIONED APPLE PIE
ingredients:
3  lb. Macintosh apples
1/2  lb. salted butter
1  pkg. MyTFine vanilla pudding
1  c. dark brown sugar
2  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. nutmeg
apple pie spice (if wanted additionally)
Oronque frozen 9-inch deep-dish pie shells
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Slice up the apples into one-inch sections. Take a pie crust and layer in ingredients like so: layer of apples to line the bottom of the crust, sprinkle cinnamon, brown sugar and pudding mix on apples. Place pats of butter on top of the entire mixture. Follow this procedure until the pie crust is full (it should be like a sandpile, a mound).

name: HAWAIIAN FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
1  c. Hawaiian Fruit Punch
1 (32 oz.)  bottle ginger ale
3 lemons (juiced) or 1  can frozen lemonade concentrate
1  pt. strawberry ice cream (if desired)
crushed ice
preparation: Note: Partial mixing may be done ahead of time for serving.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. corn oil
4  eggs, well beaten
1 (No. 2)  can pumpkin (2 c.)
3 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped pecans or 1 c. white raisins (optional)
preparation: Cream sugar and oil well.  Add eggs; beat vigorously.  Add pumpkin and stir.  Mix dry ingredients together and add to first mixture, stirring well after each addition.   May add 1 cup chopped pecans and 1 cup white raisins, if desired.  Fresh pumpkin may be substituted for canned.  Put in greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.  Yields 1 loaf.

name: EASY BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. stew beef
3-4 cubed potatoes
1  lb. baby carrots
1  lg. onion, cut into rings
1  can tomato soup
1  can water
preparation: Place beef, potatoes, carrots and onion in deep casserole dish.  Mix soup and water and pour over all.  Bake at 275 degrees for 3 1/2 hours.  This is not a thick sauce; excellent served with cornbread.

name: CORN MEAL PIE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
4  eggs
4  Tbsp. flour
4  Tbsp. skim milk
1 1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all together in a greased dish and bake at 350°.

name: FRESH FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  c. powdered sugar
fresh fruit to taste, sliced
1  pkg. refrigerator sugar cookie dough
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: With floured hands, press cookie dough into rectangular cookie sheet.  Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes or until done. Let cool down.  Mix together cream cheese, sugar and vanilla. Spread on cooled crust.  Top with your favorite fresh fruits. Chill and serve.

name: LONG ISLAND ICED TEA
ingredients:
1/2  oz. vodka
1/2  oz. gin
1/2  oz. rum
1/2  oz. tequila
1/2  oz. Triple Sex
sour mix
splash Coke
preparation: Pour over ice in glass.  Stir.

name: CRANBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. orange rind
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/8  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. orange juice
1 1/2  c. cranberries, halved
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Mix sugar and butter.  Add eggs.  Stir in juice, vanilla and orange rind.  Blend dry ingredients; add to butter mixture.   Fold in cranberries and nuts.  Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

name: HOT SPICED FRUIT
ingredients:
3  cans (16 oz. each) of a combination of: cling peaches, pineapple chunks, apricot halves, pear halves
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. molasses
1/4  tsp. ginger
2  tsp. curry
3  Tbsp. butter, softened
preparation: Drain canned fruits.  Cut peach halves in two pieces. Arrange fruits in a 2 qt. shallow casserole dish.  Mix together sugar, cinnamon, molasses, ginger, curry and butter.  Dot fruit with small dabs of topping.  Heat fruit at 350° for 35-45 minutes. Good with ham or chicken.  Yield:  6-8 servings.

name: CHERRY CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  graham pie crust
8  oz. cream cheese
1/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
8  oz. sour cream
8  oz. Cool Whip
1  jar cherry pie topping
preparation: Soften cream cheese at room temperature.  Combine cream cheese, sugar, vanilla, sour cream and Cool Whip in bowl.  Beat with electric mixer until smooth.  Pour mixture into graham crust and chill for 2 hours.  Immediately before serving, cover with cherry pie filling.

name: EASY BARBECUPS
ingredients:
3/4  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. barbecue sauce
1/2  tsp. instant minced onion
1 (10-oz.)  can flaky biscuits
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown beef, stirring to crumble; drain.  Add barbecue sauce and onion; stir well and set aside.  Separate biscuits and place each in muffin cups, pressing up sides.  Spoon meat mixture evenly into biscuit cups.  Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 400 degrees for 8 minutes.

name: BAKED FISH FILLETS
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. frozen fish fillets, thawed
1  Tbsp. minced onion
4  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1 1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
1/4  c. grated American or Parmesan cheese
preparation: Place thawed fillets in shallow baking dish.  Saute minced onion in margarine.  To this, add salt, pepper, bread crumbs and cheese.  Toss onion mix with fork, then press small amounts over each fish fillet and press down firmly.  Pour 1/2 cup milk around fish; bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: STICKY BUNS
ingredients:
1/4  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. syrup
dash of cinnamon
favorite topping
1  can biscuits
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Put ingredients into greased pan.  Add biscuits on top.  Bake for 10 minutes. Turn upside down on plate for 2 minutes.

name: GOOD PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
1 1/2  gal. sherbet ice cream
1/2  gal. lime Kool-Aid
2  liter ginger ale
preparation: Put Kool-Aid in punch bowl.  Add ice cream.  Pour ginger ale in punch bowl last.  Be sure all ingredients are cold.

name: SHIRLEY'S FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (11 ounce)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 (15 - 1/2 ounce)  can fruit cocktail, drained
2  medium red apples, cored and chopped
small bunch red grapes, halved
2  cups miniature marshmallows
1  cup chopped pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl. Cover and refrigerate several hours for flavors to blend.

name: DIVINITY
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3/4  c. light corn syrup
1  c. boiling water
pinch of salt
3  egg whites, stiffly beaten
3/4  tsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans, finely chopped
preparation: Slowly bring sugar, water, syrup and salt to a boil.  Cook to hard-ball stage.  Pour mixture over stiffly beaten egg whites; beat until it starts to thicken.  Add pecans and vanilla.  Beat until thick enough to drop a small amount at a time onto waxed paper. Cool.  Yields 36 pieces of candy.

name: SPRING RHUBARB SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. diced, fresh rhubarb
1 1/2  c. water
1/2  c. sugar
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
1  c. orange juice
1  tsp. grated orange rind
1  c. sliced, fresh strawberries
preparation: Combine rhubarb, water and sugar in saucepan.  Cook and stir over medium heat until rhubarb is tender.  Remove from heat, add jello and stir until dissolved.  Add orange juice and rind.  Chill until syrupy.  Add strawberries.  Pour into 6 cup mold.  Chill until set.  Unmold on lettuce-lined plate.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER DREAM BARS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  sticks butter or margarine
1/2  c. milk
1  egg
1  c. chopped nuts (pecans)
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. coconut
preparation: Mix sugar, margarine, milk and egg.  Cook until it comes to boil.  Remove from heat.  Add coconut, nuts and graham cracker crumbs.  Line 9 x 13-inch pan with whole graham crackers.  On top of graham crackers, spread filling on graham crackers.  Put another layer of graham crackers on top of filling.

name: PARTY SIZE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. cocoa
1  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. white sugar
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
2 1/2  c. buttermilk
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift flour, soda, salt and cocoa together twice.  Cream shortening and add to sugar and beat until creamy.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Beat well after each addition.  Sift in dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk.  Blend until smooth.  Add vanilla. Bake in three 9-inch layer pans at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
1/2  bottle cherry vodka
1/2  gal. Pina Colada
1/2  gal. orange juice
2  qt. ginger ale
2  qt. Mountain Dew
ice
preparation: Mix all ingredients in punch bowl.

name: ORANGE-PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
20  oz. can crushed pineapple and juice
1 small  box vanilla instant pudding
12  oz. tub Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cake mix with eggs and oil.  Cut oranges in small pieces. Add oranges and juice to cake mix.  Mix in oranges by hand.  Pour into three 8-inch cake pans.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: SPUDS A LA ELEGANT
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
1  (8 oz.) softened cream cheese
1  beaten egg
1/4  tsp. salt
1/3  c. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. diced pimento
preparation: Peel, quarter and cook potatoes in boiling, lightly salted water for 20 to 25 minutes or until tender; drain.  Mash potatoes. Add cream cheese, egg, salt and dash of pepper; beat until smooth. Stir in onion and pimento.  If mixture seems dry, stir in 1 to 2 tablespoons milk.  Transfer to buttered, 1-quart, round casserole.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. chopped pimiento
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. lemon juice
chopped pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Shape into ball.  Roll in chopped pecans.  Chill until serving.

name: Clemmy's Hot Crab & Cheese dip
ingredients:
1 medium  box of Velveeta cheese  (cut into blocks)
1  LB butter  (cut into blocks)
1  LB fresh crab meat
preparation: In heavy sauce pan, melt butter, add cubes of cheese -- stir constantly.  Melt cheese until smooth. Add crab meat heat thoroughly serve with crackers or spoons (haha) SOOOOO  VERY GOOOD!!

name: ITALIANO MEAT PIE
ingredients:
1  deep dish pie shell
1/3  c. chopped green pepper
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1 (4 oz.)  can mushroom stems and pieces, drained
1/4  tsp. basil
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Mozzarella cheese, divided
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3  Tbsp. water
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Preheat oven and cookie sheet to 400°.  In large skillet, brown beef.  Drain well.  Add green pepper and cook 2 minutes. Stir tomato sauce, mushrooms, water, oregano, basil and garlic powder.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Sprinkle half the Parmesan cheese over bottom of pie crust.  Spread half the beef mixture over Parmesan cheese.  Sprinkle with 1 cup Mozzarella cheese.  Layer rest of beef and Parmesan cheese.   Bake on preheated cookie sheet for 25 minutes.  Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup Mozzarella cheese. Return to oven 5 minutes or until cheese melts.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.  Makes 6 servings.

name: PECAN PIES
ingredients:
6  eggs
1  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cornstarch or flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  stick margarine
1 small  bottle white Karo syrup
preparation: Beat eggs. Add sugar, cornstarch and vanilla. Add melted butter and Karo syrup.  Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shells. Sprinkle nuts on top (1/2 cup or more to each pie).  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: MARY ALICE'S FAVORITE CHICKEN
ingredients:
eight dollars
ninety-seven cents
car
gas
preparation: Drive to closest Kentucky Fried Chicken.  Go through the drive through window, order the family snack pack (my favorite is the original recipe, but you can get extra crispy, whichever you prefer).  Pay cashier and go home to a wonderful chicken dinner, with no mess to clean up.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. Crisco (not butter flavor)
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. cold water
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chips
3/4  cut up almonds (optional)
preparation: Spray cookie sheet with Pam.  Mix flour, soda and salt; set aside.  Add the rest, except eggs, to large mixing bowl.   Mix with wooden spoon, no mixer, until creamy.  Add eggs; add flour mixture.  Stir in chips.  Drop by walnut size pieces on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 11 minutes.

name: EASY BEEF PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. beef, drained
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese
6  oz. tomato paste
meat loaf seasoning mix
preparation: Mix and put into 9-inch deep dish pie crust.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. margarine
4  c. zucchini, grated
1  c. onion, finely chopped
4  eggs, beaten
2  c. cooked rice
4  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
3 1/2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Saute onion and zucchini in margarine until soft.  Place in 4-quart casserole.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CROCK-POT SPECIAL
ingredients:
2  medium potatoes, sliced
2  medium onions, sliced
2  or 3 carrots, sliced
2  or 3 stalks celery, sliced
1  1/2 -2 lbs. ground chuck
1  can tomato soup
1 soup  can of water
salt and pepper (optional)
garlic powder (optional)
preparation: Layer potatoes in crock-pot. Add onions, carrots, and celery. Brown ground beef in skillet and drain. Add salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste, if desired. Pour meat over vegetables in crock-pot. Add soup and water on top. Cover and cook on low for 7-8 hours. Stir and serve.

name: EASY PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
2/3  c. sugar
1  c. dark corn syrup
1/3  c. melted butter
1  c. pecan halves
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
preparation: Beat eggs thoroughly with sugar, salt, corn syrup and melted butter.  Add pecans (save some to lay on top).  Pour into pie shell and bake in a 350° oven for 50 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

name: SPONGE CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten light
2  c. granulated sugar
2  c. flour
2/3  c. boiling water
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. lemon extract
preparation: Bake in tube pan in 375° oven for approximately 45 minutes.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. sugar
1  c. Karo light or dark brown syrup
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. pecans
1  deep dish pie crust
preparation: Preheat oven to 350.  In a large bowl, stir first 5 ingredients until well blended.  Stir in pecans.  Pour into crust. Bake 50 to 55 minutes.

name: BRAISED HALIBUT
ingredients:
2  to 3 halibut steaks
salt and pepper
rosemary flakes
basil flakes
green onions, sliced thin
ginger, minced
garlic powder
2  Tbsp. oil
lemon slices
preparation: In nonstick frying pan, heat oil.  Sprinkle halibut with salt, pepper and garlic powder, followed by rosemary and basil flakes. Arrange in frying pan and cover for 3 minutes.  Turn halibut and cover for another 3 to 5 minutes or until flesh is opaque and flaky when touched with a fork.  Garnish with minced ginger and finely sliced green onions and lemon slices.  Serve with rice pilaf.

name: CHEESY HASH BROWNS
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen-style hash brown potatoes, thawed
1  pt. sour cream
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. melted butter
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. chopped onion
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
16  oz. English peas (frozen; optional)
1  head broccoli
1  head cauliflower
1  large sweet onion
preparation: Thaw frozen peas.  Chop broccoli, cauliflower and onion into bite size pieces.  Add peas if desired.  Mix ingredients together.

name: PERSIMMON PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. persimmon pulp
3  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. milk
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. allspice
preparation: Mix well.  Pour in buttered casserole dish and bake at 350° for about one hour.

name: DIABETIC GOLDEN SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. sifted cake flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. cloves
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. oil
7  eggs, separated
1  c. cooked or canned pumpkin
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
3  Tbsp. liquid Sucaryl
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Have eggs at room temperature for best volume when beaten.  In small mixing bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, spices and salt.  Make a well in the center. Add oil, egg yolks, pumpkin and Sucaryl; beat until smooth.  In larger mixing bowl, beat egg whites until foamy.  Add cream of tartar; beat until very stiff peaks form.  Gently fold batter into stiffly beaten egg whites until just blended; do not stir.  Turn into greased 9-inch tube pan.  Bake for 1 hour or until firm to touch.  Invert cake to cool.

name: EASY LASAGNE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1 large  jar Ragu sauce
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1  pkg. lasagne noodles, cooked
1 large  carton cottage cheese
1 large  pkg. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
preparation: Brown ground beef and onions.  Drain grease.  Combine ground beef, Ragu sauce and sugar in pan.  Simmer for 30 minutes.  In a 9 x 13-inch pan, cover bottom with sauce, layer of noodles, sauce and cheese.  Add another layer of noodles, sauce and cheeses. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: AUNT KATIE'S POUND CAKE
ingredients:
4  sticks butter
4  c. plain flour
3  c. sugar
10  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
pinch of baking soda
2  tsp. vanilla extract
2  tsp. lemon extract
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder and baking soda together 5 or 6 times.  Cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add flour mixture to creamed mixture and mix well.  If batter appears to be a little stiff, add a little cold water.  Pour into a 10-inch tube pan that has been greased and floured.  Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.

name: PASTA CHICKEN CARBONARA
ingredients:
8  slices bacon, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
1  medium onion, chopped (about 1/2 c.)
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
2  c. cut up cooked chicken or turkey
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. whipping (heavy) cream
1  pkg. (7 oz.) spaghetti, cooked and drained
preparation: Place bacon in 3-quart casserole.  Cover with paper towel and microwave on High 8 to 12 minutes, stirring after 5 minutes, until crisp.  Remove bacon with slotted spoon; drain and reserve.  Drain fat, reserving 1 tablespoon in casserole.  Stir onion and garlic into fat in casserole.  Cover tightly and microwave 1 to 3 minutes or until onion is tender.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Cover tightly and microwave 4 to 5 minutes or until heated through. Toss with bacon.

name: RICE COOKER CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef or ground turkey
1  lb. regular sausage or turkey sausage
1  small head cabbage
1  medium chopped onion
1  medium chopped bell pepper
1 small  bunch onion tops
small amount garlic or powder
1  tsp. salt
1  c. raw rice
1  c. water
preparation: Measure rice and water, using Hitachi cooker measuring cup. For low fat diet, I precook meat and sausage a little to remove excess fat.  Then put all ingredients in large bowl and mix well. Then pour in 8 to 10 cup Hitachi rice cooker.  Start cooker.  Let stand in cooker pot for 1 hour after bell rings before serving.

name: "GINGERBEARD" BEARS
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
3/4  c. molasses
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. salt
4 1/2  c. flour
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Refrigerate dough; then roll out and cut with cookie cutters (preferably bear-shaped ones). Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
2 small or 1 large  pkg. strawberry jello
2  c. hot water
3 (10 oz.)  pkg. strawberries
1  angel food cake
preparation: Dissolve jello.  Beat in frozen strawberries.  Let it set some.  Pour over torn up angel food cake pieces.  Can use regular or diet jello.

name: BAR-BA-ZEE PORK BARBECUE
ingredients:
2  lb. pork roast, boiled
2  large onions, cut up
1  large green pepper, cut up
1  bottle Heinz catsup (medium size)
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. pickling spice
preparation: Make tea of pickling spice and 1/2 cup water or more.  Combine tea and other ingredients, shredding the pork into rest after it has simmered an hour or so.  Serve on buns.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: WHITE POTATO PIE
ingredients:
3  c. water
1  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
2 (7 serving size)  envelopes instant potatoes
1 1/2  sticks margarine
3  c. sugar
3  tsp. vanilla
5  egg yolks
5  egg whites
preparation: Bring water, salt and milk to boiling point.  Add instant potatoes and margarine.  Cool slightly, then add sugar, vanilla and beaten egg yolks.  Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in other ingredients.  Pour into unbaked pie shells and bake 35 minutes or until set (knife comes out clean when inserted in center).  Bake in a 400° oven.  Makes 3 (9-inch) pies.

name: CHICKEN MAGNIFIC
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. chicken breasts
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can water
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  tsp. parsley, sage, rosemary, thyme and garlic
preparation: Cut chicken breasts into pieces or strips.  Melt margarine in frypan; add chicken and cook until white (covered on low heat). Add remaining ingredients.  Cook 30 to 40 minutes.  Serve over rice.

name: YELLOW JELLO CAKE
ingredients:
1  box of yellow cake mix
1  box of flavored Jello
1  container Cool Whip (regular or fat free)
1  toothpick
preparation: Mix and bake yellow cake according to package directions, in a 9 x 13 inch pan.  Let cool in pan. Take a toothpick and poke holes in the cake. Mix the Jello according to package directions and when it is lukewarm, pour 3/4 of Jello mix over cake. Cool in refrigerator. Top with Cool Whip before serving.

name: SAD CAKE
ingredients:
1  box light brown sugar
1  c. coconut
4  eggs
2  c. Bisquick
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Stir and bake in long pan at 350° until medium brown.  Cut in squares.

name: CORNFLAKE PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
18  oz. box cornflakes
2  lb. peanut butter
2  c. light Karo syrup
2  c. sugar
preparation: Melt sugar and Karo in a large pot.   Bring almost to a boil and add peanut butter and melt.  Turn off fire.  Pour in cornflakes and stir good.  Lay cookies in wax paper or tin foil.

name: CARROT SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. carrots
1  green pepper, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  can tomato soup
1/2  c. salad oil
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Cook carrots until tender-crisp. Drain and run under cold water.  Combine other ingredients.  Mix well.  Add carrots and marinate overnight.

name: SAVORY GROUND STEW
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. all-purpose spices
2  (1 lb.) bags frozen stew vegetables
2 1/2  c. water
preparation: Brown ground beef in a large pan; drain.  Combine stew vegetables and 2 cups of water to beef; cook over medium heat. Add tomatoes.

name: COCONUT CHESS PIE
ingredients:
3/4  stick melted margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1 large  can evaporated milk
4  oz. (1 c.) coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix flour and sugar with margarine.  Add eggs and other ingredients.  Mix well.  Pour into well-greased and floured pie pan.  Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CREAMED CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. buttered bread crumbs
1  cabbage
White Sauce
preparation: Cut  cabbage  fine.  Boil  in  salted water (1 teaspoon salt to	quart)	for  15  minutes.  Drain well.	Place 1/2 of cabbage in Pyrex dish; add layer of white sauce.  Add balance of cabbage and another layer of white sauce.  Cover with bread crumbs.  Cook 30 minutes at 300°.

name: CHILI SOUP
ingredients:
1/4  lb. hamburger
1/2  onion
1  can tomato juice
1  can pork and beans
1  can tomato soup
1  can kidney beans
2 to 3  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: Fry hamburger and onion together until brown. Add all ingredients together until boiling. Also good for a slow cooker.

name: "TEXAS" HASH
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  medium onions, chopped
2  green peppers, chopped
2 (1 lb.)  cans tomatoes
2 1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. long grain raw rice
preparation: Brown beef in skillet and drain off excess fat.  Put all ingredients in crock-pot.  Stir thoroughly.  Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES(Diabetic)
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter
4  tsp. liquid Sucaryl
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Sift together the dry ingredients. Cream butter; add Sucaryl, vanilla and egg, blending well.  Add flour mixture and beat well.  Stir in the chocolate pieces.  Drop onto a slightly greased baking sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. soft shortening
1/2  c. water
1  egg
1 3/4  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/3  c. dry milk
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix in a 2-quart bowl the shortening, water and egg.  Sift together the flour, sugar, cocoa, dry milk, soda and salt.  Add to first mixture and mix well.  Stir in nuts.  Drop about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake near center of oven about 10 minutes or until springs back.  Cool and frost with 1 tablespoon of frosting for each cookie.  Fudge frosting is best.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE PIES
ingredients:
6  eggs
3/4  c. margarine, melted
1 1/2  c. evaporated milk (1 can)
2 1/4  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. cocoa
4 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
pinch of salt
2  (9-inch) unbaked pie shells
preparation: Beat egg yolks with half of sugar and melted margarine.  Mix the other half of sugar, cocoa and flour with a little hot water (about 1/4 cup) just to blend together.  Put the 2 mixtures together and mix thoroughly.  Add milk, salt and vanilla; this mixture will be thin.  Pour into pie shells.  Bake until firm (30 to 40 minutes) at 325°.  Cool pies, then cover with meringue. Serve warm or cold.

name: VEGETABLE RICE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. garlic salt or powder
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. cooked rice
1  can green peas, drained
1/2  c. carrots, shredded
2  small cucumbers, diced
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients.  Add remaining ingredients.  Toss to coat well.  Cover and chill.

name: POPPY SEED CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
6  tsp. poppy seed
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  tube Ritz crackers
1 1/2  sticks margarine
preparation: Boil chicken until tender.  Bone and cut into small pieces. Spread over buttered casserole dish (9 x 13-inch).  Mix the soup and sour cream together.  Then spread over chicken.  Crush crackers, mix with poppy seed and spread over soup.  Melt margarine and drizzle over casserole evenly.  Cook 40 minutes at 350°.

name: CHINESE CHEWS
ingredients:
1  stick butter or margarine
1  box brown sugar
3  eggs
2  c. plain flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped dates
1/2  c. coconut flakes
preparation: Mix well and bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Remove from oven and sprinkle with confectioners sugar. When cool, cut in small squares.

name: CHOCOLATE NUT TOFFEE BARS
ingredients:
1  c. margarine or butter, softened
1  c. confectioners sugar
1 1/4  c. unsifted flour
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. (6 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/3  c. Hershey's cocoa
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Reserve 2 tablespoons margarine.  In large mixer bowl, beat remaining margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add flour and cocoa.  Mix well.  With floured hands, press into greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Bake 15 minutes.

name: HAWAIIAN BEANS
ingredients:
16  oz. can pork and beans
16  oz. can kidney beans
16  oz. lima or butter beans
1/4  lb. bacon
1  onion, chopped
1  c. catsup
3/4  c. brown sugar
10  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, cubed
3  tsp. Worcestershire
preparation: Drain beans. Fry bacon and onions, draining off fat. Add to beans. Add remaining ingredients, mixing well. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. salad oil
3  onions, chopped fine
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/3  c. sherry
1/4  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  star anise
5  lb. chicken wings
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.  Place each chicken wing in mixture, then place on a throw away cookie sheet.  Allow to marinate overnight.  Cook at 350° until each side is done, approximately 20 minutes on each side.

name: DESSERT KOLACHY
ingredients:
1/2  lb. margarine
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
Filling
confectioners sugar
preparation: Thoroughly blend margarine, softened cream cheese and sugar. Add flour, baking powder and salt; mix well.  Knead to form stiff dough; roll to 1/4-inch thickness on well-floured board.  Cut into 2-inch squares.  Place 1/2 teaspoon preserves in center; press opposite corners together.  Place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake in 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from racks and cool.  Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. soda
2  Tbsp. juice
2  eggs, beaten
1 (No. 303)  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Sift together salt, flour, sugar and soda.  Add beaten eggs. Add the fruit cocktail and the juice.  Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle the brown sugar and nuts on top of dough. Bake 1 hour in 300°  oven.

name: CHICKEN CHIP BAKE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked cubed chicken
2  c. diced celery, boiled until tender
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. toasted slivered almonds
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. grated onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. Accent (optional)
1/2  c. American cheese, shredded
1  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Mix and pile lightly in 8 1/4 x 13 1/4-inch Pyrex baking dish. Sprinkle cheese, then potato chips over contents of dish. Bake at 425° for 20 minutes. Serves 6.

name: MOIST CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. granulated sugar
3/4  c. cocoa
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  c. black coffee
1  c. milk
1/2  c. oil
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put all dry ingredients together.  Ad eggs and remaining ingredients one at a time.  Stir well after each addition.  Pour into well-greased 9 x 12-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: DRACHMA FRIED POTATOES
ingredients:
2  large potatoes per person
2  c. oil for frying
salt
preparation: Peel potatoes and slice into 1/2-inch rounds.  Dry with towel. Heat oil in a large frying pan until hot. Gently place potatoes in oil and fry 10 minutes or until ready.

name: SNOW PEAKS
ingredients:
4  c. white corn syrup
2  egg whites
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In small saucepan, heat corn syrup until boiling.  With electric mixer at high speed or with eggbeater, beat egg whites until they form soft peaks when beater is raised.  Add salt slowly. Pour in syrup continuing to beat until frosting is fluffy and forms peaks.  Fold in vanilla.  This is a frosting for any cake.

name: SUGAR COATED PEANUTS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
2  c. raw peanuts (skin on)
preparation: Dissolve sugar in water in saucepan over medium heat.  Add peanuts and continue to cook, stirring frequently.  Cook until peanuts are completely sugar coated and no syrup.  Pour on ungreased cookie sheet.  Separate peanuts with fork.  Bake at 300° for approximately 30 minutes, stirring at 10 minute intervals.

name: ZUCCHINI RELISH
ingredients:
10  c. ground or shredded zucchini
2  c. ground onions
3  red sweet peppers, ground (for color)
5  Tbsp. salt
2 1/2  c. vinegar
6  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. turmeric
2  Tbsp. celery seed
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients together in large bowl; add enough water to cover vegetables.  Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Next day, drain.  Add remaining ingredients (in large pan).  Bring to a slow boil over low heat (about 30 minutes).  Put into sterilized jars while hot.  Slow boil in hot water bath for 30 minutes.

name: CREAMY BAKED CHICKEN BREAST
ingredients:
8  chicken breast halves (boned)
8  slices (sandwich style) Swiss cheese
1  can Campbell's cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1/4  c. dry white wine or water
1  c. herb seasoned stuffing mix
1/4  c. melted butter or margarine
preparation: Place chicken in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish.  Top evenly with cheese slices.  Mix soup with wine or water and spread over cheese.  Top with stuffing mix and drizzle melted butter on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered.

name: BROCCOLI PUFF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1/2  c. shredded Velveeta cheese
1/4  c. fine dry bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. mayo
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. melted margarine
preparation: Cook broccoli according to package directions, omitting salt. Drain; place broccoli in baking dish.  Combine soup and cheese; add milk, mayo and egg.  Stir until blended.  Pour over broccoli. Combine margarine and bread crumbs.  Sprinkle over top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: QUICK MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. elbow macaroni
3  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1/2  c. tomatoes (canned or fresh)
1 (1/2 lb.)  pkg. Velveeta cheese (use as much cheese as you like)
preparation: Cook macaroni as directed on package.  In a 1 1/2 quart casserole, cook onion and butter in microwave on Medium-high for 1 to 2 minutes or until onions appear transparent.  Cube Velveeta cheese and cut up tomatoes.  Add all ingredients to casserole with onions.  Stir to mix.  Microwave on Medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minute intervals (stir in between) until cheese is melted.  Serve with Italian bread.  Makes 6 servings.

name: EASY PUNCH
ingredients:
4  pkg. lemon-lime Kool-Aid
4  qt. water
4  c. sugar
1 large  can pineapple juice
1 large  can apple juice
1  c. ReaLemon juice
1  or 2 large ginger ale
preparation: Mix all ingredients except the ginger ale.  Stir until sugar is dissolved.  Refrigerate or freeze.  Add ginger ale when ready to serve.

name: SWISS GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. chopped onions
salt
pepper
1/2  c. sour cream
2  cans drained green beans
2  c. grated Swiss cheese
1/2  c. corn flake crumbs
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients together in large saucepan.  Add sour cream. Stir constantly until bubbly.  Add green beans.  Spread in shallow casserole dish.  Top with grated Swiss cheese and corn flake crumbs (1/2 cup corn flakes and 2 tablespoons melted margarine).  Bake 20 minutes at 400°.

name: CHOCOLATE PEANUT BUTTER DESSERT(Weight Watchers Recipe)
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. skim milk
2  Tbsp. crunchy peanut butter
1  c. thawed lite Cool Whip
2  c. cold skim milk
1  small sugar-free chocolate instant pudding
preparation: Mix the 2 tablespoons milk into the peanut butter.  Gently stir in whipped topping.  Pour the 2 cups skim milk into large bowl.  Add pudding mix and beat with wire whisk 1 to 2 minutes or until blended.  Spoon whipped topping mixture and pudding alternately into 6 parfait glasses.  Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

name: BEEF BALL
ingredients:
3 large  pkg. cream cheese, room temperature
3  pkg. sliced smoked beef (save 1 pkg. to roll the ball in)
3  bunches green onions with green tops
2  Tbsp. Accent
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Chop fine onion and  half  of  the green tops; chop fine beef. Save 1 package  for the   ball.  Beef  and onions should look like confetti.  Do  not  use the blender or food processor on the onion.  Mix  cheese, Accent and the Worcestershire sauce until blended.  Add  onions  and  2  packages  of chopped beef. After thoroughly mixed form  the ball and roll in the remainder of the beef.  This  makes  one  large or two medium size balls. Serve or freeze for later use.

name: CANDIED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
1/3  stick margarine, sliced and scattered over the other layers
1 1/4  c. sugar
pinch of salt
preparation: Sprinkle a little nutmeg  over top.  Add 1/2 cup water, or slightly less.  Bake at 350°  for 30 to 40 minutes or until most of the liquid is gone.

name: PUMPKIN PIE CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix (reserve 1 c.)
1  stick oleo
1  egg
1 (13 oz.) large  can pumpkin (solid pack)
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/4  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  eggs, beaten
2/3  c. milk
