preparation: Pumpkin mix:  Mix together and pour over cake mixture.  Into the cup of reserved cake mix, add 1/2 cup of granulated sugar, 1/2 cup of chopped nuts and 1/2 stick oleo.  Mix like crumbs and sprinkle over pumpkin mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.

name: CREAM OF COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1  can cream of coconut
fresh or canned coconut
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake according to directions on box (9 x 13 pan). Combine Eagle Brand milk and cream of coconut. Punch fork holes in warm cake and pour liquid over cake. Let cake cool. Spread all of Cool Whip on cake and sprinkle with coconut. Store cake in refrigerator. Best if made the night before. Serves 12. Can do ahead.

name: VIDALIA ONION CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. chopped or sliced onion
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
3/4  stick margarine
2  c. cornflake crumbs
preparation: Melt half of the margarine in casserole.  Put onion in and top with soup.  Spread cornflake crumbs over this and dot with remaining margarine.  Cook at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: 7 LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, chopped
1  pkg. frozen peas, run cold water over
1/2  medium onion, chopped
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
1  stalk celery, chopped
1/2  head cauliflower, broken into pieces
4  to 5 strips bacon, fried and crumbled or bacon bits
3  to 4 eggs (hard-boiled), chopped
1/2 to 1  jar mayonnaise
1  c. Cheddar cheese
1 dry seasoning mix  pkg. Ranch dressing
preparation: Layer first 8 ingredients as listed.  Frost top with mayonnaise.  Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over mayonnaise.  Sprinkle Ranch dressing over all.  Refrigerate overnight.  Toss together before serving.

name: NEVER FAIL CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. vinegar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. oil
2  c. cold water
preparation: Blend well.  Place in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Place in oven. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: GREEN BEANS LIKE MOM CANNED
ingredients:
2  cans green beans (Del Monte is recommended)
3 to 4  slices bacon
salt and pepper to taste
onion (optional)
preparation: Render down the bacon in a heavy saucepan.  When the drippings are liquid, add carefully the 2 cans of beans.  Watch out for splatter!!  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Onion can be added at this time.  Cover with a tight lid and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes.  Do not add water.  Use only the liquid from the green bean can to cook.  Keep watch so that the liquids don't boil away. Stir often and reduce heat if the liquid amount gets too low before cooking time has elapsed.

name: BREAKFAST ON A BAGEL
ingredients:
8  eggs
1/4  c. cold water
2  green onions, thinly sliced
1/4  tsp. dried basil
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
4  bagels, cut in half
3  tsp. butter or margarine, divided
4 thin  slices ham
4  slices American cheese
preparation: In broiler or toaster oven, lightly toast bagels cut side up. In medium bowl, beat together eggs, water, green onions, basil, salt and pepper; set aside.  In large nonstick skillet, melt 1 teaspoon butter over medium heat.  Add ham and cook, turning often until lightly browned, about 1 minute.  Lay on 4 bagel halves. Melt remaining 2 teaspoons butter in skillet over medium heat. Stir eggs and add to skillet.  Cook 2 to 3 minutes.  Stir occasionally until fully cooked.  Divide up to put on bagel.  Add cheese and cover with remaining bagel halves.

name: HANKY PANKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. hot or mild sausage
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. hot red pepper (optional)
2  loaves party rye bread
preparation: Brown sausage and ground beef; drain off grease.  Add cheese (cut-up) and melt over meat.  After cheese melts, add spices and stir well.  Spread thinly on party rye bread.  Put on cookie sheet and brown under broiler or in oven at 350° for approximately 5 to 10 minutes.  Serve hot.  Great for parties!

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can onion soup
1  can water
1  fryer, cut up, salt and pepper it
1  stick margarine
preparation: Melt margarine.  Pour into a big casserole dish; sprinkle in 1 cup uncooked rice.  Lay cut up chicken on top.  Mix soups and water together.  Pour on top of chicken and rice.   Cook, uncovered, at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
1  can whole kernel corn (do not drain)
1  can cream-style corn
1  box Jiffy corn muffin mix
1  stick margarine, melted
1/4  c. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: CRUNCHY PEA SALAD
ingredients:
10  oz. frozen peas, thawed
1  c. chopped cauliflower
1/4  c. diced green onions
1  c. chopped cashews
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. Ranch dressing
5  strips bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
preparation: Combine all ingredients except bacon.  Chill until ready to serve.  Garnish with bacon just before serving.

name: CORNED BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  oz. noodles, cooked
2  Tbsp. butter
1  lb. can sauerkraut with juice
12  oz. can corned beef, shredded
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. diced onion
1  Tbsp. catsup
1/2  tsp. dill weed
2  c. Swiss cheese, shredded
preparation: Cook  noodles and butter.  Put	in  9  x  13-inch  pan. Layer sauerkraut, then  corned  beef;  mix rest of ingredients together except cheese and layer over meat, then layer cheese. Bake in 350° oven,  covered.  Bake  last 10 minutes uncovered. Should be 35 minutes total.

name: COUNTRY APPLE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. quick or multi-grain oatmeal
1  c. whole wheat flour
1  c. packed brown sugar
3/4  c. flour
1/3  c. toasted wheat germ
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. pie spice
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2 to 2  c. chopped apples
1 1/4  c. skim milk
1/3  c. oil
3  egg whites or 2 whole eggs, lightly beaten
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Add chopped apples and stir to coat with flour mixture.  In a small bowl, beat together milk, oil and eggs. Add to dry ingredients and stir only until moistened.

name: FRUITED MOLD
ingredients:
1  c. blueberries (1/2 pt.)
1  c. hulled strawberries, sliced (1/2 pt.)
1  nectarine, pitted and thinly sliced
1 1/2  c. cranberry apple juice
2 (1/4 oz. each)  envelopes unflavored gelatin
1  c. honey
preparation: Coat 8-cup mold with nonstick cooking spray.  Layer blueberries, strawberries and nectarine slices in mold.  Set aside.  In medium saucepan, combine cranberry apple juice, unflavored gelatin, honey and 1 1/2 cups water.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Cook juice-gelatin mixture over low heat for 5 minutes until gelatin is dissolved, stirring constantly.  Carefully pour mixture into mold with fruit.  Chill 3 hours until firm.

name: BAKED PORK CHOPS WITH TOMATO AND RICE
ingredients:
pork chops
Minute Rice
1  medium onion
tomato sauce
preparation: Salt and pepper pork chops on both sides.  Place in heavy skillet.  Put 1 teaspoon Minute Rice on each chop.  Place a slice of onion on each chop and pour enough tomato sauce to cover them. Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: REUBEN MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
20  large fresh mushrooms
1  (3 oz.) thin corned beef, chopped
1/4  c. sauerkraut, rinsed
1/4  c. shredded Swiss cheese
2  Tbsp. crushed rye crackers
2  Tbsp. Thousand Island dressing
preparation: Clean mushrooms; remove stems.  Arrange half the mushrooms, stem  side up, on a 10 or 12-inch round microwave-safe plate. Cover with plastic.  Cook on High for 2 to 4 minutes or until almost tender.  Invert caps on paper towels.  Repeat with remaining caps.

name: LEMON ICEBOX PIE
ingredients:
1  can condensed milk
1  (9 oz.) whipped topping
1 small  can frozen lemonade
preparation: Mix together and pour into graham cracker pie crust; chill before serving.

name: OREO COOKIE
ingredients:
1  lb. pkg. Oreo cookies
3/4  c. butter
2  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1 large  pkg. chocolate instant pudding
preparation: Crush cookies, all but 5.  Spread on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Melt butter.  Spread on top of cookies (do not mix).  Press with back of spoon.  Refrigerate.

name: NEVER FAIL DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Sift dry ingredients.  Add milk and egg.  Mix well.  Drop into boiling broth and cook, covered.  Do not remove lid for 5 minutes.

name: CHILI RELLENOS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (7 oz.)  cans diced chilies
1  lb. grated Jack cheese
1  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
3  eggs, beaten
3  Tbsp. flour
1 small  can evaporated milk
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  small onion, diced
preparation: Save 1/2 cup of cheese for the top.  Layer 1/2 of chilies in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Layer 1/2 cup of cheese.  Layer 1/2 of onion. Repeat layers.

name: COMPANY CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts, boneless and skinless
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
1/2  pkg. Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix
preparation: Place chicken in oblong casserole dish.  Mix sour cream and soup together and pour over chicken.  Sprinkle stuffing mix over all.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.  Serves 6.

name: SANGRIA
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  shot cognac
1/2  bottle red wine
1/2  bottle club soda
1  shot gin
oranges, lemons, limes and strawberries, sliced
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients and add fruit.  Pour into glasses and add ice.

name: PORK CHOP HOT DISH
ingredients:
6  medium pork chops
3  c. sliced raw potato
1  medium onion, sliced
4  slices cheese
6  Tbsp. milk
1  c. sliced carrots or may use other types of vegetables
salt and pepper
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Brown pork chops.  Place thinly sliced potatoes in greased baking dish.   Add sliced onion and top with cheese.  Over this, place carrots,  then pork chops.  Combine soup and milk, pour over chops.   Cover and bake at 350°  for 1 hour.  Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer.

name: CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce (torn)
1  head cauliflower (separated)
1  lb. bacon (fried crisp and crumbled)
1  c. Hellmann's mayo
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. parmesan cheese
preparation: In large bowl toss cauliflower and lettuce together. Mix together mayo, sour cream, sugar and cheese; pour over top of lettuce and cauliflower. Top with bacon and refrigerate (toss before serving).

name: HEARTS OF PALM AND CUCUMBER SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. unpeeled, thinly sliced cucumbers (about 2 medium)
1  medium size purple onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings
1 (14 oz.)  can hearts of palm, drained and cut into 1/2-inch slices
2  Tbsp. (1 oz.) Feta cheese
1/2  c. white wine vinegar
2  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. minced, fresh basil
1  clove garlic, minced
preparation: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a large, shallow dish; toss gently and set aside.

name: E-Z PUMPKIN MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
3  eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking powder
2  c. canned pumpkin
1  c. nuts
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat sugar, oil and eggs for 4 minutes.  Fold in pumpkin, nuts and vanilla; mix well.  Fold in dry mixture.  Pour into muffin cups.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.  Serves 12.

name: CHOCOLATE GOOEY BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  chocolate cake mix
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
2  c. Cheerios cereal
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Melt butter in a 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Sprinkle and pat dry cake mix over butter.  Sprinkle marshmallows, chocolate chips and cereal.  Drizzle milk over top.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  While warm, run knife around edge.  Cool 2 hours.  Makes 48 bars.

name: GUMMY GOOEY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
1  egg
1  stick margarine
preparation: Mix together.  This will be stiff.  Spread evenly in a long pan.

name: UNBAKED CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. Sugar
1/2  c. Peanut butter
1  tsp. Vanilla
1/3  c. Cocoa
1/2  c. Butter
1/2  c. Milk
3  c. Oatmeal
preparation: In a saucepan, bring the sugar, cocoa and milk to a boil, continue to boil for 30 seconds.  Remove from the heat and stir in the peanut butter, butter, vanilla and oatmeal, mix well.  Drop onto waxed paper and allow to cool.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BARS
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. peanut butter
2  c. self-rising flour
3  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix butter and peanut butter; add to other ingredients.  Bake in large pan because of rising.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Do not overbake.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked as directed
1  stick butter
1  chopped onion
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
1  egg
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  c. Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix
preparation: Mix onion,  soup,  egg and mayonnaise together and pour over broccoli.  Mix butter and toss in stuffing.  Put dressing mix on top of broccoli.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: SUPER CHERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
2  c. cold milk
1  c. thawed whipped topping
1  can cherry pie filling
14  graham crackers
preparation: Line oblong dish with graham cracker squares, fitting them in to cover the bottom.  Combine pudding mix and milk and beat well. Allow to stand 5 minutes.  Fold in whipped topping.  Put one half (1/2) pudding on crackers.  Add another layer of graham crackers. Top with remaining pudding and another layer of crackers.  Spoon cherry pie filling on top.  Refrigerate at least 3 hours.  Cut into squares and serve.

name: CHEESE BALL(2 Large Or 4 Small)
ingredients:
3/4  lb. medium sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1  lb. cream cheese, softened
1 small  can unsweetened crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  c. bell pepper, chopped fine
1/2  c. celery, chopped fine
1/2  c. crushed nuts
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. parsley flakes
preparation: I use Oscar and mince very fine the bell pepper, celery and nuts.  Grate cheese and mix by hand with cream cheese.  Add pineapple, pepper, garlic, salt and nuts.  Roll into ball or shape in a mold.  Refrigerate.  When ready to serve, roll in chopped nuts completely.  Serve with crackers.

name: QUICHE
ingredients:
assorted vegetables (zucchini, squash, mushrooms, bell pepper, onion, tomato, broccoli, etc.)
2  deep-dish pie shells
8  to 10 eggs (may use egg substitute)
2  c. milk
1  pkg. chopped spinach
1  pkg. Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. garlic salt, basil and celery salt
preparation: Chop vegetables, then sauté until tender. In large bowl, whip eggs and milk. Add spinach, cheese and sautéed vegetables to milk/egg mixture. Pour mixture into pie shells. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean when stuck into the middle of the quiche.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen artichoke hearts
8  oz. Mozzarella, shredded
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
garlic powder and pepper to taste
preparation: Drain artichokes well. Bake at 325° uncovered for 30 minutes. Bake in shallow 2-quart Corning Ware dish or 9-inch glass pie plate.  Dip with Bagel chips or crackers.

name: BARBECUE MEATBALLS
ingredients:
5  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. cocktail wieners
1  large family size catsup
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. vinegar
1/4  c. lemon juice
1 1/2  tsp. liquid smoke
preparation: Salt and pepper hamburger; fry slowly.  Drain grease.  Combine all ingredients and simmer for 3 to 4 hours.

name: BRUNSWICK STEW
ingredients:
2 small  cans chicken *
2  cans pork barbecue
1  can cream-style corn (large)
1  can whole kernel corn (large)
2  cans stewed tomatoes
1  small size ketchup
1  lb. ground beef
preparation: *An equal amount of fresh cooked chicken will do.

name: BAKED FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
1  loaf white bread, cubed
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, cubed
8  to 12 eggs (depending on size)
1/2  c. maple syrup
1  c. milk
preparation: Line bottom of an 11 x 13-inch pan with 1/2 the bread cubes. Layer cream cheese cubes on top of bread.  Arrange remaining bread on top.  In a large bowl, beat eggs together with maple syrup. Add milk to mixture.  Pour over bread, cover and refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350° until light golden brown, approximately 45 minutes.

name: PERSIAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
6  white potatoes
1 (15 oz.)  can sweet green peas
1  whole cut up boiled chicken
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. salt
1 small  jar green salad olives
cherry tomatoes (about 10)
preparation: Dice, boil and drain the potatoes.  Drain peas.  Debone and dice the chicken.  Mix all ingredients together, saving 1/2 cup mayonnaise.  Form into an oblong shape on a meat platter.  Spread leftover mayonnaise on top.  Decorate with olives and tomatoes. Serves 12.

name: ZUCCHINI RELISH
ingredients:
10  c. zucchini (about 5 lb.)
4  large onions
4  large green peppers
4  large red peppers
1/2  c. salt
2 1/2  c. cider vinegar
4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. turmeric
1  tsp. ground nutmeg
2  tsp. celery seed
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Grind zucchini, onions and peppers in food grinder or processor until medium coarse.  Sprinkle with 1/2 cup salt and let stand overnight.  Drain and rinse well in cold water.  Mix vinegar, sugar, cornstarch and spices.  Bring to a boil in a large kettle.  Add ground vegetables, then simmer 30 minutes.  Ladle into hot jars, leaving 1/2-inch at top.  Process in boiling water for 15 minutes.  Makes 7 pints.

name: PUMPKIN CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  lb. can solid pack pumpkin (or 2 c. fresh pumpkin)
1 large  can evaporated milk
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  box yellow cake mix
1  c. chopped pecans
2  sticks margarine
preparation: Melt margarine and spoon over top of nuts.  Bake at 350° for 50-60 minutes.

name: AVOCADO SALAD
ingredients:
1  small lemon Jell-O
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1 1/2  c. mashed avocado
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of Tabasco sauce
preparation: Mix Jell-O in water; allow to cool.  Mix in other ingredients.

name: APPLESAUCE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. white sugar
1  egg
1  c. applesauce
preparation: Sift flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Cream margarine, brown sugar and white sugar.  Beat egg and mix with applesauce.  Combine all ingredients.  Arrange by spoonful onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 425° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Cool and enjoy!!

name: APPLE-RAISIN STUFFED CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
1 (13 3/4 oz.)  can chicken broth
1/3  c. margarine
1  c. herb seasoned stuffing mix
1/3  c. chopped apples
1/4  c. seedless raisins
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
2  (1 lb.) whole chicken breasts (boneless, split and pounded)
1  tsp. dried tarragon
1/3  c. chopped pecans
preparation: In saucepan over medium-high heat, heat chicken broth and 2 tablespoons of margarine until margarine melts.  Stir in stuffing mix, apples, raisins and pecans. Divide mixture evenly among 4 chicken pieces.  Roll up.  Secure with toothpicks.

name: QUICK BEET BORSCHT
ingredients:
1  (10 1/2 oz.) condensed beef broth or one bouillon
1 (1 lb.)  can shoe string beets
1  c. cabbage, shredded
2  Tbsp. onion, minced
1  Tsp. sugar
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  (small pkg.) sour cream
preparation: Heat beef broth, if using a bouillon cube add  10 1/2-ounces water, beets with liquid, cabbage, sugar, and onion to boiling. Reduce heat; simmer gently five minutes.  Stir in lemon juice. Chill thoroughly.  Top each serving with a spoon of sour cream. Serve with Ritz crackers.  This borscht can also be served hot.

name: MAYONNAISE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  pt. mayonnaise
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. water
preparation: Put mayonnaise in bowl; add water and sifted dry ingredients alternately.  Add vanilla.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: BURGER BITES FOR CHILDREN
ingredients:
1  box vanilla wafers
1  bag thin mints
tubes of red, yellow and green frosting
preparation: Take two wafers and 1 mint.  Put a squirt of mustard (yellow frosting), a squirt of ketchup (red frosting) and a squirt of pickle (green frosting) on one side of vanilla wafer; put your hamburger together.  Have fun eating your candy hamburger.

name: CARAMEL APPLE BARS
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter, softened
1/4  c. shortening
1 3/4  c. flour
1 1/2  c. quick oats
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
4 1/2  c. chopped apples
3  Tbsp. flour
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. caramel candies
preparation: Mix brown sugar, butter and shortening together.  Stir in 1 3/4 cups flour, the oats, salt and baking soda.  Remove 2 cups of this mixture and reserve.  Press remaining mixture into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  In separate bowl, toss apples and 3 tablespoons flour.  Spread over mixture in pan.  In saucepan, melt candies over low heat, stirring occasionally.  Pour evenly over apples.  Top with reserved oat mixture; press lightly.  Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cut into bars while still warm.

name: PEA SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen peas
1  c. Velveeta cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2/3  c. evaporated milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients and top with Durkee onion rings.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
3  eggs
1  can cream of mushroom soup
20  crackers, crushed
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix together all ingredients.  Form into loaf and put in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked cubed chicken
2  c. chicken broth
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 (16 oz.)  can peas and carrots, drained
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. milk
preparation: Combine all ingredients; pour into lightly greased 2-quart pan.  Top with pastry (canned biscuits work well).  Cut slits into pastry to allow steam to escape.  Bake at 400° for about 40 minutes, or until crust is brown.  Makes about 6 servings.

name: MICROWAVE PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. raw peanuts
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1  Tbsp. oleo
few grains salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Use 2-quart glass mixing bowl safe for microwave.  Mix peanuts, sugar, syrup and salt.  Cook 3 minutes.  Stir; cook 4 minutes.  Quickly stir in oleo and extract.  Cook 3 minutes.  Add soda; stir fast.  Mixture will foam.  Pour out quickly on cookie sheet lined with aluminum foil.  Cool 15 minutes.  Break up into pieces.  Store in tight can or jar.

name: DATE CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can Dole pineapple
3/4  c. brown sugar, packed
4  eggs
1  (8 oz.) Dole chopped dates
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. margarine, softened
3/4  c. granulated sugar
1  lb. Dole carrots, shredded
2  tsp. vanilla extract
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. ground ginger
powdered sugar
preparation: Drain pineapple well.  Beat margarine and sugars until light and fluffy.  Beat in eggs.  Beat in pineapple, carrots, dates and vanilla.  Combine flour, soda, cinnamon, ginger and salt. Gradually beat in flour mixture until well blended.  Pour batter into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Bake in 350° oven 50 to 60 minutes until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool completely.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Serves 20.

name: FINGER Jell-O
ingredients:
5  envelopes unflavored gelatin in 2 1/2 c. water
2  c. boiling water
2  large gelatin (flavored)
1  c. sugar (optional)
preparation: Add 1 cup water to flavored gelatin mixture, then mix both bowls together.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Refrigerate, then cut into squares or shapes.  Terrific for kid's school lunches or summertime treats, because this doesn't melt fast.

name: BANANA SPLIT PIE
ingredients:
1  baked pie shell
banana, sliced
strawberry ice cream, softened
frozen whipped topping
chopped nuts
maraschino cherries
chocolate syrup
preparation: Cover bottom of pie crust with sliced bananas. Add thick layer of softened ice cream. Cover with softened frozen topping. Sprinkle on nuts and cherries. Drizzle chocolate syrup over top. Return to freezer until needed.

name: RICE-A-RONI SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Rice-A-Roni fried rice with almonds
1  jar artichoke hearts, cut up
lots of chopped green onions
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 small  can sliced ripe olives
1  pkg. slivered almonds (1/2 to 3/4 c.)
1  c. mayo
sliced water chestnuts (optional)
preparation: Make rice as instructed; cool.  Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.  Prepare at least 4 to 6 hours in advance.

name: CHILI POTATOES
ingredients:
3  slices bacon
1  c. chopped onion
6  medium potatoes, peeled and sliced
2  tsp. chili powder
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and set aside.  Saute onion until golden brown.  In a 3-quart microwave dish, add potatoes, chili powder, butter, salt, pepper and sauteed onion.  Cover dish with plastic wrap.  Microwave for 15 minutes until tender.  Stir halfway through cooking.  Add crumbled bacon and serve.

name: SUGARLESS CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. water
2  c. raisins
1  c. applesauce
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. liquid sweetener
3/4  c. oil
2  c. flour
1 1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook raisins in water until all water is gone.  Mix applesauce, sweetener, eggs and oil together.  Add remaining ingredients and stir together.

name: PORCUPINES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. uncooked rice
1/4  c. milk or water
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1/8  tsp. garlic salt
dash of pepper
1  Tbsp. shortening
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  c. water
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix beef, rice, milk, onion and seasonings.  Form into 4 balls.  Fry in melted shortening, turning so as to brown lightly, but not get crusty.  Add sauces and water.  Mix well.  Cover; simmer 45 minutes over low heat.  Add a small amount of water, if liquid cooks down too much.  Makes 2 servings.

name: EGGPLANT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant, peeled and cubed
1  med onion, diced small
2  slices toast, cubed
1  cup milk
4  to 5 Tbsp butter
1/4  tsp ground cayenne pepper
1  egg
3/4  cup grated cheese
black pepper and salt to taste
preparation: Cook eggplant with onion in a small amount of salted water until done, and drain.  Beat 1 egg and add to milk, pour over toast cubes and allow to set a few minutes. To eggplant add cheese, butter, black and red pepper.  Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1 (32 oz.)  can pork and beans
1/2  lb. hamburger
1  chopped onion
1/2  c. ketchup
4  tsp. brown sugar
2  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. mustard
preparation: Brown and drain beef and onions. Combine all ingredients and spread in casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BREAD AND BUTTER PICKLES
ingredients:
25  to 30 medium cucumbers
8  large white onions
2  large bell peppers
1/2  c. salt
5  c. cider vinegar
5  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
1  tsp. turmeric
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
4  to 5 trays ice cubes
preparation: Wash and slice cucumbers about 1/4-inch thick.  Peel and slice onions in thin slices.  Remove seeds from peppers and cut into strips.  Combine with cucumbers and onions.  Cover with ice cubes and let stand 3 hours.  Drain.

name: FLUFFY PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  Tbsp. baking powder (this is right)
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
2  Tbsp. oil
3/4 and 2  Tbsp. milk (more if too thick)
preparation: Combine dry ingredients, add rest and mix.  Let set a minute until mix fluffs up; if too thick add some more milk.  Cook on hot buttered griddle.  (This is the best pancake mix I've come across yet.)

name: BACON ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1 small  can sliced pineapple
1/2  lb. bacon, cut crosswise
preparation: Cut pineapple in 1-inch sections.  Take 1/2 slice bacon and roll up and secure with toothpick.  Place on cookie sheet and bake 15 minutes until bacon is brown.  Serve hot.   You may also use 1/2-inch pieces of cream cheese instead of pineapple.

name: ORANGE DREAM SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. vanilla pudding (not instant)
1 large  pkg. orange Jell-O
4  c. water
8  oz. Cool Whip
1 large  can mandarin oranges
preparation: Put first 3 ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil.  Boil until glossy, about 3 minutes, stirring constantly.  Pour into a large bowl and refrigerate overnight.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
3  cups of Bisquick
1-8 oz grated cheddar cheese
1  lb. sausage (browned)
preparation: Combine all ingredients. If mixture is too dry add a little water.

name: ZUCCHINI SQUARES
ingredients:
3  c. thinly sliced unpared zucchini
4  eggs, beaten
1  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. parsley
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
dash of pepper
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Spread mixture into pan.  Bake until golden brown.  Cut into squares. Eat warm or cold.  Cook about 40 to 45 minutes.

name: OYSTERS ROCKEFELLER
ingredients:
1  pt. oysters
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, cooked
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1/4  tsp. lemon pepper seasoning
6  drops Tabasco sauce
grated Parmesan Romano cheese (for topping)
1  Tbsp. instant minced onions
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
1/2  c. margarine, melted
preparation: Arrange oysters in single layer in a shallow baking dish.  Mix rest of ingredients, except cheese, with cooked spinach.  Spread on top of oysters.  Sprinkle 2 to 2 1/2 tablespoons of cheese on top.  Bake in a 400° oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until oyster edges curl.

name: BACON WATER CHESTNUTS
ingredients:
2  cans water chestnuts, drained
soy sauce
sugar
bacon, sliced in half or thirds
preparation: Place water chestnuts in shallow bowl and cover with soy sauce.  Marinate for 2 to 24 hours.  Roll chestnuts in sugar and wrap with bacon securing with toothpick.  Place on cookie sheet that has been lined with foil.  Bake in a 400° oven for 20 minutes, turning once.  Drain on paper towels.  Place on micro-safe platter.  When ready to serve, reheat in microwave until hot.

name: YELLOW SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow squash
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. minced onions or 1 Tbsp. dried onions
1 small  jar pimento bits
preparation: Cook squash and mash with a fork.  Drain as well as you can. Mix soup, sour cream, onions and pimentos together, then stir in squash.  Pour into a casserole dish that you have sprayed with Pam.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until bubbly.

name: MAYONNAISE
ingredients:
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. paprika
dash of cayenne
2  egg yolks
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  c. salad oil
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Blend in egg yolks.  Add vinegar; mix well.  Add salad oil, 1 teaspoon at a time, beating with rotary or electric beater until 1/4 cup has been added.  Add remaining oil in increasing amounts, alternating last 1/2 cup with lemon juice. Makes 2 cups.

name: GRANDMA WHITING'S CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  c. butter
2/3  c. sugar
1  egg
3  sq. melted chocolate
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: I melt the chocolate squares first, then put everything in a bowl and mix.  Use two teaspoons to drop onto cookie sheet.  Put sprinkles or walnut meats on top or put two cookies together with vanilla icing in the middle.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: POTATO SALAD VINAIGRETTE
ingredients:
2  lb. new red potatoes
4  Tbsp. dry white wine
2  Tbsp. wine vinegar
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
6  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. minced green onions
3  Tbsp. chopped dill
preparation: Boil potatoes carefully so as not to split or crumble them. Cool slightly and cut into quarters.  Do not peel.  Pour wine over potatoes and toss gently.  Mix vinegar, oil, herbs and spices. Pour over potatoes and season.  Serve with still warm or chill. Makes 6 cups.

name: CHITTERLINGS
ingredients:
10  lb. chitterlings
1/2  c. lemon juice
salt to taste
1  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  onion, sliced
1  clove garlic, crushed
3  bay leaves
vinegar
hot sauce
preparation: Clean chitterlings thoroughly, removing as much of the fat as possible.  Place the chitterlings in a pot and add cold water, a little lemon juice and salt.  Let stand for awhile.  Change water, adding more lemon juice and salt as necessary.  Rinse chitterlings thoroughly and put them back in the pot.  Add cold water to cover, juice and the remaining ingredients.  Bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer until chitterlings are thoroughly tender, about 4 hours. Serve hot with vinegar and hot sauce on the side.

name: CARAMEL APPLE DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. nuts
1  bag apples
1 large  can pineapple juice (to soak apples)
preparation: Mix all the ingredients together except the apples and pineapple juice.  Slice apples.  Put in bowl with pineapple juice to keep apples from turning brown.  Serve with toothpicks for dipping or bowls for apples with sauce on the side.

name: RICE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (9 oz.)  can crushed pineapple in heavy syrup
2/3  c. Minute rice
2/3  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. tiny marshmallows
1  ripe banana, diced
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  c. Cool Whip
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Drain pineapple, saving syrup.  In saucepan, combine rice, water, syrup and salt.  Mix to moisten.  Bring quickly to a boil. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat; let stand 5 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients; let cool.  Fold in whipped cream.  Chill.

name: GLORIA'S PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. peanut butter
2  c. powdered sugar
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. butter, melted
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Roll into balls and chill. Melt chocolate; dip balls.  Put on waxed paper.  Cool and chill. These can be frozen until needed.

name: CHEESE SCONES
ingredients:
2  cups all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  1/2 cups (6 oz.) shredded cheddar cheese
1  egg
1/2  cup sour cream
1/4  cup vegetable oil
3  Tbsp. milk
preparation: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda; stir in cheese.  In another bowl, combine egg, sour cream, oil and milk; stir into dry ingredients just until moistened.  Turn onto a floured surface and knead gently 10-12 times.  Gently pat out to 1/3 inch thickness. Cut with a 3 inch heart-shaped cookie cutter.  Place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 425° for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. blueberries (fresh or frozen)
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Combine flour, sugar and baking powder; set aside.  In medium bowl, combine butter, eggs, milk, vanilla and flour mixture.  Mix well.  Stir in blueberries with wooden spoon.  Fill paper-lined muffin pans.  Bake 20 to 30 minutes.  If using frozen blueberries, do not thaw.

name: LEMON POPPY SEED MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. lite or fat-free sour cream
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. poppy seeds
2  Tbsp. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  tsp. lemon extract
preparation: In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt; set aside. Combine remaining ingredients; mix well. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened. Fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until muffins test done. Cool in pan for 10 minutes before removing to a wire rack.

name: BUTTERMILK BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. lard, chilled and diced
2/3  c. buttermilk
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Sift together dry ingredients into mixing bowl.  Blend lard in with pastry blender until mixture is the consistency of coarse cornmeal.  Add all buttermilk and stir with fork to form a soft dough but not sticky.

name: ROTEL POTATOES
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup*
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Cheddar cheese soup
1/2 soup  can (or more) of water
1  Tbsp. onion, chopped
1/2  stick margarine
10  to 12 small potatoes, peeled and sliced
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. In a bowl, mix Ro-Tel tomatoes, cheese and cream of mushroom soups, water, onion, salt and pepper to taste. Pour mixture over potatoes in a greased baking dish. Place margarine slices on top and bake for 1 hour or until potatoes are fork-tender. (Cheese is salty enough.) Serve with cornbread or tortilla chips.

name: CHEESEBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
pie crust
preparation: In skillet, cook beef and onion until brown; drain.  Stir in the salt, oregano, pepper, bread crumbs, 1/2 cup tomato sauce and green pepper.  Prepare pie crust.  Pour meat mixture into pie plate.  Spread cheese topping over meat.

name: POPPY SEED WATER CRACKERS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. olive or salad oil
1  large egg white
1 1/2  tsp. poppy seed
3  tsp. coarse salt
preparation: About 30 minutes before serving, preheat oven to 400°. Lightly grease large cookie sheet.  Into medium bowl, measure flour, baking powder and salt with fork; stir in olive or salad oil and 1/3 cup water until well blended.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  can mini shrimp (in the tuna section of the store)
1/2  c. salad dressing or mayonnaise
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes until set.  Serve warm with a variety of crackers.  Can be made a day ahead.  Double recipe for a party.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. diced green pepper
1/2  c. diced celery
1/4  c. minced onion
3  Tbsp. melted butter
1  Tbsp. flour
1 3/4  c. canned tomatoes
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
dash of pepper
1  bay leaf
1  small sprig parsley
1 1/2  c. cooked shrimp
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire
1 1/3  c. cooked rice
preparation: Saute green pepper, onion and celery in butter until tender, about 5 minutes.  Add flour and blend.  Add tomatoes gradually; stir constantly.  Add salt, pepper, sugar, bay leaf and parsley. Cook gently 30 minutes.  Remove bay leaf and parsley.  Add shrimp and Worcestershire sauce.  Heat.  Serve Shrimp Creole over rice.

name: BARBECUE SPARERIBS
ingredients:
1  envelope onion soup mix
1 1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. sherry
1  clove garlic, minced
ribs
1/3  c. honey
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. ginger
preparation: In large bowl, combine soup mix, water, honey, soy sauce, sherry, sugar, garlic and ginger.  Add ribs; marinate 2 hours. Turn frequently.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Place ribs on rack in shallow roaster pan.  Roast 1 1/4 hours, or until tender and crisp.  (Turn and baste occasionally with marinade.)

name: BUCKEYES
ingredients:
1  lb. box powdered sugar
1  stick margarine or butter
1 (18 oz.)  jar creamy peanut butter
1  pkg. chocolate candy coating
preparation: Combine sugar, margarine and peanut butter until mixed well. Roll into small balls and chill.  Melt chocolate candy coating and dip buckeyes, leaving a small spot on top uncovered so the candy resembles the nut for which it is named.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIR CAKE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  box graham crackers
2 small  boxes instant vanilla pudding
9  oz. Cool Whip
3 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Line with graham crackers.  Try to fill bottom layer as close as possible.  Mix pudding and milk. Add Cool Whip to this mixture.  Begin layers of pudding and crackers.  First layer crackers, second layer 1/2 pudding, third layer crackers, fourth layer 1/2 pudding, fifth layer crackers, sixth layer chocolate frosting.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/4  c. vegetable shortening
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  egg
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/4  tsp. vanilla extract
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream shortening and butter or margarine together until light and  fluffy.  Add sugar and cream until smooth.  Add egg and  beat well.  Beat  in peanut butter and vanilla.  Combine flour, soda and salt; add to creamed mixture.  Roll dough into balls  about  1 inch  in  diameter.  Place  on greased cookie sheets and  flatten by pressing with tip of teaspoon.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Yield:  4 dozen.

name: PEANUT CLUSTERS
ingredients:
15  oz. peanut butter chips
6  oz. chocolate chips
1  c. crushed potato chips
1 (24 oz.)  jar dry roasted peanuts
preparation: Put chips in microwave 2 to 3 minutes until glossy.  Mix in potato chips and peanuts.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.

name: MOMMA'S PLAIN CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. flour
1  c. milk
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening together.  Add eggs and vanilla. Mix flour in and then add milk.  Mix for 2 minutes.  Bake in 350° oven for 20 minutes or until done.

name: PORK AND BEAN BAKE
ingredients:
7  strips bacon
1  large onion, chopped fine
1  medium bell pepper, chopped
2 (No. 202)  cans pork and beans
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. catsup
5  Tbsp. mustard
preparation: Fry 4 strips of bacon until crisp and crumble.  Saute onion and bell pepper.  Combine ingredients and season to taste.  Place in baking dish and place 3 strips of bacon over this.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° until bubbly and bacon is done.

name: CHOP SUEY CAKE
ingredients:
2  cups flour
2  cups sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp soda
1/2  tsp salt
1 large  can crushed pineapple, undrained
1  stick melted oleo
1  (8 oz) pkg cream cheese, softened
1  box powdered sugar
1  tsp vanilla
preparation: Mix and pour over cake immediately when removing from oven. Sprinkle coconut and/or pecans on top.

name: LEMON CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) baked pastry shell
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. grated lemon peel
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  c. milk
3  egg yolks, beaten
1  c. dairy sour cream
preparation: In saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch, lemon peel, butter, lemon juice, milk and egg yolks.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick.  Cover and cool.  Fold in sour cream. Pour into baked pastry shell.  Chill for 2 hours or more before serving.  Top with whipped cream.

name: RASPBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 2/3  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. chopped nuts
1/4  c. melted butter
50  large marshmallows
1  c. milk
1  c. whipping cream, whipped or 2 c. Cool Whip
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen or fresh raspberries
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. water
preparation: Combine crumbs, nuts and butter.  Pat in 8 x 10-inch pan. Place marshmallows and milk in double boiler over hot water.  Stir until melted.  Cool.  Fold whipped cream into marshmallows.  Pour over crust.  Cook raspberries, sugar, lemon juice and cornstarch with 1/4 cup water until clear; cool.  Pour over marshmallow mixture.  Best if made several hours before serving.  Garnish with more whipped cream, if desired.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
2  c. sugar
1/2  stick margarine, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. buttermilk
4  Tbsp. peanut butter
preparation: Mix together; pour in unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
6  to 8 medium potatoes, sliced 1/4-inch thin
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  can mushroom soup
1  can milk
2  tsp. salt
preparation: In casserole dish, alternate layers of potatoes, green pepper and onion.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Pour over potato layers.  Cook, covered, at 350° until tender, about 45 minutes. Uncover the last 20 minutes.

name: THERESA'S DEVILED EGGS
ingredients:
1  doz. boiled eggs
1  to 2 dashes Texas Pete hot sauce
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. sweet pickle relish
salt and pepper to taste
paprika to garnish
preparation: Halve eggs and scoop out yolks.  Combine yolks and all other ingredients; mix well with an electric mixer.  Fill egg white halves with mixture; garnish with paprika.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1 1/2  sticks oleo
2 large  cans peaches
3  c. sugar
water
2 1/4  c. flour
7 1/2  Tbsp. oleo
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Melt 1 1/2 sticks oleo in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Drain the peaches and add enough water to the juice to make 3 cups. Dissolve the sugar in the juice and add with the peaches into the melted oleo.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  cranberry orange relish
1 large  pkg. cherry Jell-O (diet or regular)
1 (8 or 10 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. pecans
preparation: Make Jell-O according to package directions minus 1/2 cup water.  Refrigerate.  When Jell-O is almost set, add cranberry-orange relish, crushed pineapple and pecans.  Stir several times before completely set.  Serves about 15.

name: STRAWBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. sugar
3  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped pecans
1 1/2  c. oil
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
2  eggs
preparation: Mix all together.  Spray 2 bread pans with Pam.  Fill each 1/2 full with mixture.  Bake in preheated 350° oven for about 30 to 45 minutes.  Serve hot or cooled.

name: GLAZE FOR DUCK
ingredients:
1  c. apricot juice
1/4  c. honey
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. ginger
preparation: Mix all together.  Pour over duck.  Roast at 450° for 15 minutes, then at 325° until done.

name: PORK CHOPS AND RICE
ingredients:
4  thick pork chops
1/2  c. uncooked rice
4  thick onion slices
4  thick tomato slices
salt and pepper to taste
2 1/2  c. water
2  bouillon cubes
1/2  tsp. marjoram
1/4  tsp. thyme
preparation: Saute chops on both sides.  Place chops in buttered casserole. Place 1 tablespoon raw rice on each chop, 1 slice onion and 1 slice tomato.  Dissolve bouillon cubes in 2 1/2 cups water; pour over all.  Sprinkle with herbs, salt and pepper.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes; cover and simmer.

name: BEAR TRACK COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  sticks margarine
2  sq. unsweetened melted chocolate
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2 1/3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. milk
peanut halves
preparation: Cream together sugar and margarine.  Blend in chocolate, vanilla and eggs, one at a time.  Sift in flour, baking powder and salt alternately with milk.  Blend well.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet.  Insert about halfway into fattest side of each, 4 peanut halves to resemble claws.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI SOUFFLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
2  c. well-drained cottage cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  beaten eggs
1  tsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook and drain broccoli.  Combine with cottage cheese and grated Parmesan cheese.  Add eggs, onion, pimento and salt.   Bake in a greased 2 1/2-quart casserole about 30 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box Kraft macaroni and cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. hamburger
1  can milk
preparation: Cook macaroni as directed.  Brown hamburger and drain.  Mix macaroni and cheese with hamburger meat and soup.  Add 1 can milk. Place in casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or microwave for 18 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
1  envelope gelatin
1/4  c. water
1  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. liquid food sweetener
1/4  c. water
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Soften gelatin in 1/4 cup water for 5 minutes.  Melt chocolate with cinnamon and sweetener.  Add milk and water slowly.  Add gelatin; stir until dissolved.  Remove from fire.  Add vanilla; cool.  When mixture begins to thicken, add nuts; turn into cold pan.  When firm, cut into pieces.

name: SNACK MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can evaporated milk
5  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  envelope onion soup mix
1  lb. ground meat
2  c. catsup
3/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: Combine milk, 2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce and soup mix; blend well.  Let stand for about 5 minutes.  Add beef; mix well. Mixture will be moist.  Shape into balls, using one tablespoon for each.  Place on rack in broiler pan.  Broil 5 to 6 inches from heat for 10 to 12 minutes; do not turn.  Combine remaining Worcestershire sauce and remaining ingredients in saucepan; cook, stirring until heated through.  Add meatballs; serve.  May be frozen and reheated.

name: BAKED EGGPLANT
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. salad oil
10 1/2  oz. can tomato puree
1  medium eggplant, peeled and thinly sliced
2/3  c. water
1 1/2  tsp. oregano
dash of pepper
2  c. grated cheese Parmesan (I use sharp Cheddar)
preparation: Saute onion in oil; add puree, water, salt, oregano and pepper.  Bring to boil.  Simmer 15 minutes.

name: MAKE-AHEAD FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can fruit cocktail, well drained
1  c. coconut
1  c. miniature marshmallows (colored or white)
1  (8 oz.) container whipped topping
preparation: Fold together in serving bowl.  Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

name: BAKED ZITI(Good meatless dish during Lent.)
ingredients:
your own or 48 oz. jar spaghetti sauce
2  tsp. dried Italian herb seasoning
12  oz. pkg. ziti pasta, cooked and drained
12  oz. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
1  large egg
1  (16 oz.) container Ricotta cheese
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. dried parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Lightly grease a 3-quart oblong baking dish.

name: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
1  can corn, drained
1  can cream-style corn
1/3  c. sugar
2  eggs
8  oz. sour cream
1/2  c. oil
1  box Jiffy corn muffin mix
preparation: Mix together all ingredients and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
10  oz. pkg. frozen, chopped spinach
1  c. sour cream
1/3  c. chopped onions
8  oz. can water chestnuts
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Drain spinach well, forcing out liquid.  Mix all ingredients together.  Refrigerate 8 hours prior to serving.

name: BRICKLE BLEND BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Heath Bits O' Brickle
1/2  c. white sugar
preparation: Cream butter with sugars.  Beat in one egg at a time.  Blend in vanilla.  Stir in dry ingredients.  Mix thoroughly.  Stir in brickle.  Bake 30 minutes in 350° oven in a 11 x 7-inch Pyrex.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
sugar cookie mix
8  oz. softened cream cheese
1/2  box confectioners sugar
1  medium container Cool Whip
1 large  can fruit cocktail
1  pt. fresh strawberries, soaked in sugar
preparation: Mix the sugar cookie mix as directed.  Put it on a pizza pan and cook for 10 minutes.  Let it cool.  (Make it look like a pizza.)  Mix together the cream cheese, confectioners sugar and Cool Whip; put on top of cookie crust.  Put the drained fruit cocktail on top, then the fresh strawberries.

name: VIVONS KENTUCKY PUDDING PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter
3  eggs, beaten
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. butter or oleo
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
4 1/2  c. unbleached flour (sift 1 time, measure, then sift 2 more times)
3  c. dried apples that have been stewed
1 1/2  tsp. soda (put in apples)
1/2  box white raisins
1 1/2  c. pecans
1 1/2  tsp. each: mace, cloves and cinnamon
1/2  lb. candied cherries
1/2  lb. candied pineapple
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Add 4 cups of flour alternately with stewed apples.  Dredge raisins and nuts with remaining 1/2 cup flour.  Add spices.   Fold in cherries and pineapple.  Add raisins and nuts last.  Line greased tube pan with wax paper.  Bake 2 hours at 250°.  Makes 2 large cakes.  Halve recipe for one.  Freezes nicely.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. soft peanut butter
1  c. confectioners sugar
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  large container Cool Whip (save enough for the top)
1  regular or graham cracker crust
preparation: Mix ingredients with mixer and put in pie crust.  Top with Cool Whip and nuts, if desired.  Keep chilled.

name: BLT SALAD
ingredients:
1  bag plain mini bagel chips
1  lb. bacon, cooked and crumbled
1  lb. cherry tomatoes or equivalent, diced
1 (32 oz.)  jar nonfat mayonnaise
1  packet Italian or herb Italian dressing
1/4  c. red wine vinegar
milk as needed (to thin dressing)
1  head crisp lettuce, torn into bite size pieces
1  to 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped (optional as garnish)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and let blend in refrigerator at least 1 hour prior to serving.  Mix in lettuce or serve dressing on side.  Top salad with bagel chips.

name: SEA ISLAND TUNA SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. macaroni
1/2  c. salad dressing
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. onion salt
1 (6 oz.)  can tuna, drained
1 (15 oz.)  can peas, drained
3/4  c. diced Cheddar mild cheese
2  Tbsp. minced green pepper
1  Tbsp. diced pimento
preparation: Cook macaroni; drain and chill.  Stir in salad dressing, which you have blended with sour cream and seasonings.  Gently stir in remaining ingredients.  Chill thoroughly.  Makes large dish.

name: YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/2  c. water
2  eggs
7  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. shortening (solid)
2  c. water
preparation: Combine the first 5 ingredients in mixing bowl.  Mix for 2 minutes at low speed with mixer; set bowl aside.  In large bowl, place 7 cups flour, sugar and water; mix for 3 minutes.  Add yeast mixture to flour mixture; mix at medium speed for 3 minutes.  Let rise for 2 to 3 hours.

name: MARTHA WASHINGTON CHERRY CREAMS
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, softened
2 (2 lb.)  boxes powdered sugar
1  can condensed milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. finely chopped pecans
2  c. coconut
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
2  oz. paraffin bar
preparation: Mix margarine, sugar, milk and vanilla.  Stir well.  Divide in half.  Put nuts in 1/2 mixture and coconut in other.  Form into balls, a little larger then gumballs.  Place on tray in freezer for 1 hour.  Melt chips with paraffin in double boiler.  Using toothpicks, dip chilled balls into chocolate.  Place on waxed paper to dry.  Store in airtight container.

name: BORSCHT
ingredients:
3  medium sized beets (organic)
2  small carrots (organic)
1  c. chopped red cabbage
1  medium size onion
2  Tbsp. miso or soup base
3  Tbsp. apple cider vinegar
2  tsp. tamari or 1 tsp. salt
sour cream
preparation: Chop beets, carrots and onion.  Cover with water in a saucepan and bring to a simmer.  Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes.  Add cabbage, miso and apple cider vinegar.  Cook for 10 more minutes. Add tamari or salt to taste.  Serve hot in bowls with a dollop of sour cream on top.

name: PARTY MIX
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1 1/4  tsp. salt
4 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2 2/3  c. corn cereal
2 2/3  c. rice cereal
2  2/3 wheat cereal
1  c. salted peanuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 250°.  Heat butter in roasting pan.  Stir in salt and Worcestershire sauce.  Add cereal and nuts, mix well. Heat in oven 1 hour.  Stir every 15 minutes.  Spread on absorbent paper to cool.

name: BAKED CHEESE GRITS
ingredients:
4  c. water
1  tsp. salt
1  c. grits
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1/2  c. butter
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
3  eggs, slightly beaten
2  garlic cloves, mashed
preparation: Cook grits in  water;  remove from heat.  Gradually add butter, cheese  and  Worcestershire sauce.	Gradually stir 1/4 cup grits into eggs;  then add the rest of the grits, stirring well. Pour mixture  in  slightly	greased  casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Garnish  with sliced mushrooms and parsley. Good stuff.

name: COOKED FROSTING
ingredients:
3 to 4  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
1  c. sugar
2  sticks oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook flour and milk until thick.  Cool.  When cool, add and beat with a mixer the sugar, oleo and vanilla until stiff and then frost your favorite cake with it.

name: HOBO DINNER
ingredients:
corn-on-the-cob
cabbage, quartered
whole potatoes, peeled
large carrots
sliced onion
smoked turkey or pork
1  qt. water (cover corn)
salt and pepper
preparation: Layer ingredients in order given in a large pot.  Simmer on low for 1 to 2 hours, according to amount you have in pot.  Do not overcook.  Do not let potatoes go to mush.  Meat will flavor the whole pot of vegetables.  When potatoes are tender, it is ready! Serve with cornbread.  Very convenient and very good!

name: SPICY PORK TENDERLOIN
ingredients:
1 to 3  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  tsp. ground thyme
1/2  tsp. garlic pepper
2  pork tenderloins (about 1 lb. each)
preparation: Combine the first 5 ingredients; rub over meat.  Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 4 hours.  Grill over hot coals for 15 minutes per side or until juices run clear or the internal temperature reaches 160°.  Yield:  8 servings.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  Tbsp. cream
3  ripe mashed bananas
1/2  c. pecans
preparation: Grease loaf pan.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs and blend.  Sift together dry ingredients. Alternately add cream, flour and bananas to butter mixture.  Add nuts; cool before slicing.

name: PUMPKIN BARS
ingredients:
1  c. presifted flour
1/2  c. rolled oats
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. oleo
2  c. pumpkin
2  eggs
13  oz. can evaporated milk
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/2  c. nuts
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. oleo
preparation: Mix flour, rolled oats, brown sugar and oleo with mixer until crumbly.  Press in ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  to 8 small yellow squash, sliced
2  onions, sliced
1  tsp. salt
water to cover, barely
1  egg (raw)
1 to 1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
3/4  stick margarine
1/2 to 1  c. cracker crumbs
preparation: Cook squash and onion in salted water until tender and water has cooked down.  Remove from heat and add egg, 1 cup cheese and margarine.  Mix well; until margarine melts.  Pour into casserole and sprinkle on bread crumbs and 1/2 cup cheese.  Bake 30 minutes in 350° oven.

name: CHICKEN OF THE GODS
ingredients:
1  Chicken, 2 1/2 to 3 lbs., boned
1  Egg, beaten
1/4  tsp. Salt
3  tsp. Sherry
1  tsp. Soy Sauce
Dash White Pepper
1/2  lb. Chestnut Flour
4  c. Chicken Stock
1/2  cube Butter
1/2  c. Flour
2  Tbsp. Cornstarch
1  c. Cream
Salt & Pepper to taste
1/2  c. Sliced Mushrooms
2  tsp. Browned Sesame Seeds
preparation: Marinate chicken in salt, egg, sherry and soy sauce for 15 to 20 minutes.  Cut up marinated chicken into large pieces and dip in flour.  Brown in oil and cook until done.  Melt butter over medium heat and blend in cornstarch.  Bring stock to boil and stir rapidly while adding butter and cornstarch mixture.  Reduce heat and add cream, seasonings and mushrooms.  Cut up cooked chicken into smaller strips.  Cover with cream sauce and sprinkle sesame seeds on top for garnish.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: RAISIN NUT COOKIE
ingredients:
2  c. margarine
2  c. white sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts
1  c. raisins *
2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
6  c. oats
preparation: Soak raisins in warm water while mixing other ingredients. Cream the butter, brown sugar, white sugar and vanilla; add eggs and beat well.  Sift flour, soda and salt;  stir into first mixture.   Add oatmeal, raisins and nuts; chill.  Make in roll about 2 1/2-inches thick.  Bake at 360° for about 20 minutes.  Can freeze and bake as needed.

name: DUMPED SALAD
ingredients:
1  can strawberry or cherry pie filling
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. chopped nuts
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Dump all ingredients together in  a large bowl.  Blend well. Chill before serving.

name: PARTY CAKE
ingredients:
1  boxed cake mix
1  c. cold water
1/3  c. vegetable oil
3  eggs
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Generously grease pan(s) with shortening and lightly flour.  If making cupcakes, grease and flour muffin pan or line with paper baking cups.

name: SEAFOOD PRIMAVERA
ingredients:
1/4  c. lemon juice
2  tsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. scallops
1/2  lb. shrimp, peeled and deveined
1/4  c. margarine
8  oz. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1  c. carrots, thinly sliced
3  cloves garlic, chopped
1/2  tsp. thyme
4  oz. fresh pea pods
1/4  c. green onions
preparation: Combine lemon juice, cornstarch and salt; mix well.  Add scallops and shrimp.  Cover, marinate in refrigerator 30 minutes. In a large skillet, over high heat, cook and stir mushrooms, carrots, garlic and thyme in margarine until tender-crisp, about 8 minutes.  Add seafood mixture; cook and stir 5 to 8 minutes until seafood is opaque.  Add pea pods and onions, heat through.  Serve over hot pasta.  Makes 4 servings.

name: STRAWBERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. vanilla wafers, crushed
1  stick margarine, softened
1 1/2  c. powdered confectioners sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  well-beaten eggs
1  qt. or more fresh strawberries, sliced
preparation: In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, make a layer of vanilla wafer crumbs.  Cream margarine, powdered sugar, vanilla and eggs.  Beat well.  Spread mixture over crumbs.  Cover with sliced strawberries or can mix berries in creamed mixture.  Chill for several hours or overnight before serving.  Serve with a whipped topping or Cool Whip on top.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. white sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs
1 (17 oz.)  can fruit cocktail with juice
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix together all ingredients in bowl for 3 minutes by hand. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.  Sprinkle top with 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup nuts (optional).  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: SKILLET CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. white cornmeal
1 to 2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  egg, beaten
about 1 Tbsp. oil (for skillet)
preparation: Combine all ingredients; stir until all dry ingredients are moistened.  Place cast-iron skillet in a 475° oven until skillet is hot.  When skillet is heated, spoon in mixture and bake for 20 minutes.  Serve hot, buttered.

name: EASY REFRIGERATOR ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. warm water
2  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. salt
6 1/2 to 7  c. flour
1  egg
1/4  c. oil
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water.  Add sugar, salt and half of the flour.  Add egg and beat.  Add rest of flour.  Place in a well oiled bowl and place in refrigerator.  Punch down occasionally. Use as needed.  Form into desired roll shapes and bake in moderate oven until lightly browned.

name: WALNUT APPLE PIE
ingredients:
4  to 5 large tart apples, peeled and sliced
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
2  Tbsp. quick-cooking tapioca
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
pastry for double-crust 9-inch pie
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: In a bowl, toss apples with lemon juice. Combine the sugars, nuts, tapioca, cinnamon and nutmeg. Add to apples and toss to coat. Let stand for 15 minutes. Line a 9-inch pie plate with bottom pastry. Trim even with edge. Add apple mixture. Dot with butter. Roll out remaining pastry to fit top of pie. Place over filling. Trim, seal and flute edges. Cut slits in top. Cover edges loosely with foil. Bake at 400° for 40 to 45 minutes or until crust is brown and filling is bubbly. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: POTATO 'N BROCCOLI SUPREME
ingredients:
3  c. hot mashed potatoes (5 or 6 medium potatoes)
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. milk
1  egg
2  Tbsp. butter
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli spears, cooked and drained
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded American cheese
preparation: Whip together the first 5 ingredients until smooth.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Fold in 1/2 can French fried onions. Spread potato mixture over bottom and up sides of a buttered 8 x 12-inch baking dish to form a shell.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Arrange hot broccoli spears in potato shell; sprinkle with cheese and remaining onions.  Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.  Makes 8 servings.

name: PEACH PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. flour
1/2  whipping cream (or half & half)
7  or 8 peaches, sliced
preparation: Mix flour and sugar well.  Add half & half milk.  Stir till mixed well.  Add peaches.  Pour into an unbaked 9-inch deep dish pie shell.  Use a regular 9-inch pie shell for top crust.  Bake 45 minutes at 375 degrees.

name: CHICKEN-LIVER LOAF
ingredients:
1/2  c. green onions, thinly sliced
2  eggs
1/3  c. yogurt or light sour cream
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  clove garlic, crushed
1  lb. chicken livers, cut into pieces
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: In skillet, saute onions and garlic in butter until lightly browned.  Add livers and cook 3 to 5 minutes or until juices no longer flow.  In food processor, puree liver mixture until smooth. In a large bowl, beat remaining ingredients.  Stir in liver puree (mixture will be thin).  Turn into greased 7 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan.  Cover with foil.  Bake for 1 hour at 300°.  Cool, then chill thoroughly in pan.  To serve, run knife around edge and unmold. Slice 1/2 inch thick.  Makes 14 slices (108 calories per slice).

name: PENUCHI COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2  Tbsp. brown sugar or 2 Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
3  c. quick oatmeal
1/2  c. peanut butter
preparation: In saucepan, combine margarine, brown sugar or  cocoa (fudge cookies), sugar and milk.  Bring to boil slowly; stir constantly. Boil 1 minute.  Remove from heat.  Add oatmeal and peanut butter. Stir until thick enough to drop from spoon.  Drop onto wax paper and allow to cool and harden.

name: BREAKFAST BAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. ham, chopped up
8  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients. Bake 30 to 40 minutes in low oven until firm in middle. Salt after cooking, if desired.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  whole chicken, cut up
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm stuffing
1  stick butter
1  c. chicken broth
preparation: Stew chicken and debone.  Mix both cans of soup and 1/2 stick of butter.  Heat until butter is melted.  Pour soup and butter mix over chicken.  Then take stuffing mix and pour over the top of that.  Make sure that it is even and smooth.  Then take cup of chicken broth and pour over that.   Dot the top with the rest of the butter. Bake at 375° for about 30 to 45 minutes.

name: THOUSAND ISLAND DRESSING
ingredients:
1  egg, boiled and chopped fine
1  oz. green onion, chopped fine
1/2  c. sweet relish
6  oz. chili sauce
1  pt. mayonnaise plus 1/2 c.
preparation: Mix well and chill overnight.

name: CHRISTMAS RAINBOW CAKE
ingredients:
1 (2 layer size)  pkg. white cake mix
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry gelatin
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime gelatin
2  c. boiling water
1  (9 oz.) container Cool Whip, thawed
preparation: Prepare cake mix as directed on package, baking in 2 well-greased and floured 9-inch layer pans at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cool in pans 15 minutes.  Poke with fork at 1/2-inch intervals.  Do not remove from pans.

name: NO BAKE CHOCOLATE FUDGE TART
ingredients:
3/4  c. half & half or light cream
3  Tbsp. sugar
6  oz. semisweet chocolate, chopped
2  oz. unsweetened chocolate, chopped
1  tsp. vanilla
1  (6 oz.) ready to use chocolate cookie piecrust
1/2  c. heavy or whipping cream
preparation: In microwave-safe bowl, combine half & half and 2 tablespoons sugar. Heat mixture in microwave on high 1-1/2 minutes. Add chocolates and vanilla, stirring until chocolate is melted. Pour mixture into pie crust. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Before serving, beat heavy cream until soft peaks form. Spread over chocolate filling.

name: CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
2  pkg. dry yeast
5  c. flour
2 1/2  c. hot water
1  stick oleo
4  Tbsp. white corn syrup
4  Tbsp. brown sugar
chopped nuts (if desired)
preparation: Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  I prefer to put frosting on rolls while they are still warm.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
2  egg yolks, beaten
3  Tbsp. peanut butter (may use more peanut butter, plain or crunchy)
1/8  tsp. salt
1  baked pie shell
preparation: Heat milk.  Mix sugar, flour and salt.  Add mixture to warm milk, stirring constantly.  Add beaten egg yolks, stirring as you add them.  When mixture thickens add peanut butter.  Pour into baked pie shell.  Meringue on top.

name: YUM YUM CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
2  c. milk
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
large Cool Whip
preparation: Prepare cake as directed on package.  Pour into greased and floured jelly roll pan.  Do not use 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  When cake is cool, blend in bowl milk, pudding and cream cheese until thick.  Pour over cake and let set. Spread pineapple over pudding mixture.  Top with Cool Whip. Garnish with cherries, nuts and coconut if desired.  Keep refrigerated.

name: PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
2  lb. (1/2-inch thick) boneless round steak
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  c. hot water
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. molasses
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1  clove garlic, crushed
1  medium onion, sliced
2  medium green peppers, cut into strips
1 (8 oz.)  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
1/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
10  cherry tomatoes, halved
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Partially freeze steak; slice diagonally across grain into 3 x 1/2-inch strips and set aside.  Heat oil in a large skillet; add steak and cook, stirring often, until steak is browned.  Combine 1 cup water, soy sauce, molasses, ginger and garlic; mix well and pour over steak.  Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.  Add onion; cover and simmer for 15 minutes.  Add green peppers and water chestnuts; cover and simmer for 10 minutes.  Combine 1/4 cup water and cornstarch; mix well and add to skillet.  Cook over medium heat, stirring, until smooth and thickened.  Stir in tomatoes.

name: SPICED ROAST CHICKEN(Gore Family Recipe)
ingredients:
1  (3 1/2 lb.) chicken
1  Tbsp. margarine
2/3  c. Marsala
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  onion, finely chopped
1  tsp. garam masala
4  oz. button, brown or chestnut mushrooms, chopped
1  c. coarsely grated parsnips
1  c. coarsely grated carrots
1/4  c. minced walnuts
2  tsp. chopped fresh thyme
1  c. fresh white bread crumbs
1  egg, beaten
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Prepare stuffing:  In a large saucepan, heat olive oil.  Add onion and saute 2 minutes or until softened.  Stir in garam masala and cook 1 minute.  Add mushrooms, parsnips and carrots; cook, stirring 5 minutes.  Remove from heat; stir in walnuts, thyme, bread crumbs, egg and salt and pepper.  Stuff and truss chicken. Place breast down in a roasting pan; add 1/4 cup water.  Roast 45 minutes; turn chicken breast up and dot with margarine.  Roast about 45 minutes or until a meat thermometer inserted in thickest part of thigh (not touching bone) registers 185° (85°C).  Transfer to platter; keep warm.

name: BUFFET SUPPER
ingredients:
1  onion, chopped
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli, thawed
1  Tbsp. butter
10  oz. Cheez Whiz Light
1  can cream of chicken and broccoli soup
6  oz. evaporated milk
2  chicken breasts (boneless), cooked and chopped
3  c. cooked white rice
preparation: In large skillet saute onion and broccoli in butter until tender.  Stir in Cheez Whiz, soup and milk until smooth.  Add chopped chicken.  Put rice into a greased 8-inch square baking dish.  Pour cheese mixture over rice.  Bake uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes at 325° or until heated through.

name: CHOCOLATE CHESS CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Swiss chocolate (German chocolate cake mix or substitute a white cake mix)
1  egg
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  stick margarine, melted
1  box 10x sugar
2  eggs
8  oz. cream cheese
preparation: Beat until smooth and pour over chocolate layer.  Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

name: HAMBURGER SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  c. cubed carrots
1  c. green beans
1 small  bottle Heinz 57 sauce
2  c. cubed potatoes
2  c. chopped cabbage
1 large  can chopped tomatoes
1  medium onion, chopped
preparation: Brown hamburger.  Pour in large Dutch oven pot.  Add tomatoes, 57 sauce, 2 cups water, cabbage and onion.  Cook for 1 hour and add remaining ingredients.  Cook for 2 more hours.  Any vegetables may be added. (I like to add macaroni to mine.)

name: ZUCCHINI APPETIZERS
ingredients:
3  c. zucchini (thinly sliced)
1  c. Bisquick mix
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1  finely chopped garlic clove
1/2  c. oil
4  eggs, slightly beaten
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease a 13 x 9 x 3-inch oblong pan.  Mix all ingredients.  Spread in pan.  Bake about 25 minutes until golden brown.   Cut into 2 x 1-inch squares.  Yields 4 dozen.

name: BARBECUED SQUIRREL
ingredients:
3  to 4 squirrels, dressed
flour
salt and pepper
cooking oil
1  c. vinegar
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. paprika
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. tomato juice
1/4  c. chili sauce
1/4  tsp. chili powder
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. hot pepper sauce
cayenne pepper
2  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Cut up the squirrels into serving size pieces.  Dredge in salted and peppered flour and brown in cooking oil.  Prepare barbecue sauce by combining remaining ingredients in a saucepan and cooking over low heat for 15 minutes.  Pour the sauce over the meat, cover and bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until tender. Uncover the pan and broil an additional 15 minutes.

name: KEY LIME PIE
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can condensed milk
1  Tbsp. grated lime peel
1/2  c. fresh lime juice
1/4  tsp. salt
2  egg yolks
1  (8-inch) graham cracker pie crust
1  c. heavy crem
1  Tbsp. powdered sugar
fine shreds lime peel
preparation: In large bowl mix milk (Eagle Brand), lime peel, juice and salt.  Add yolks.  Use mixer at high speed.  Beat 1 or 2 minutes or until thick.  Pour into crust.  Chill at least 2 hours or until set.

name: BREAKFAST BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
5  c. flour (unbleached)
2  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
3  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
4  eggs
1  qt. buttermilk
1  box Raisin Bran
preparation: Grease tins.  Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate. Batter will last  up to 6 weeks. When ready to bake, add nuts, raisins or dates.  Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes.

name: HARVARD BEETS
ingredients:
1  can beets
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. flour or cornstarch
preparation: Mix the ingredients with the juice of one can of beets.  Bring to a boil, then put beets in and let simmer for a few minutes, then serve.

name: GRETA'S FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  chicken
salt to taste
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. self-rising meal
vegetable oil
preparation: Skin chicken, then add salt.  Mix flour and meal; sift together.  Roll chicken in mixture.  Fill frying pan 1/3 full of vegetable oil.  Heat oil until hot.  Put chicken in oil.  Cover and brown.  Turn chicken until all sides are brown.  Turn heat down to a slow simmer for about 25 minutes.  Keep turning chicken; this lets chicken get tender.

name: CHIMI CHURI
ingredients:
1  small handful chopped garlic
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. chopped green onions
1/3  c. oregano
1  tsp. red chili peppers
2  tsp. salt
red wine vinegar
preparation: Combine ingredients and put in wine bottles. Top off with red wine vinegar.  Cork, making vertical grooves in corks to make shakers out of bottles.  Will keep for years if you keep adding oil and vinegar.

name: SPINACH CHEESE BAKE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach, thawed
1  (8 oz.) tomato sauce
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. (2 c.) shredded Mozzarella cheese
2  c. herb seasoned croutons
1  lb. bulk Italian sausage
2  c. cream-style cottage cheese
1  egg, slightly beaten
preparation: Drain spinach thoroughly, squeezing out liquid.  In skillet, cook sausage until brown; drain fat.  Stir in tomato sauce; set aside.

name: PINEAPPLE ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. shredded zucchini
1 (8 1/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, well drained
3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. raisins
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Beat first 4 ingredients until thick.  Stir in remaining ingredients gradually; blend well.  Pour into 2 greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Test with cake tester.  It should come out clean.

name: FRUIT CAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
2  c. brown sugar, packed
2  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk
3 1/2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  c. pecans, chopped
2  c. dates, chopped
2  c. cherries (candied), chopped
preparation: Mix well the shortening, sugar and eggs.  Sift together the dry ingredients.  Mix in pecans, dates and cherries.  Drop with teaspoon about 2 inches apart onto lightly greased baking sheet. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes at 300°.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: LEMON VELVET
ingredients:
2  c. heavy cream or half and half
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. freshly grated lemon peel
1/3  c. freshly squeezed lemon juice
preparation: In large bowl, combine cream and sugar; stir until sugar dissolves.  Blend in lemon peel and juice.  Pour into shallow pan (an 8 x 8-inch square pan is fine).  Freeze until firm (at least 4 hours).  Put in bowl.  Beat with mixer, then refreeze.  Serve in dessert glasses, lemon shells or boats.

name: PINEAPPLE-CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  boxes cream cheese
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/4  c. chopped bell pepper
1/4  c. diced onion (may use green onions)
1 to 2  tsp. seasoned salt
2  Tbsp. chopped pimiento
1  c. pecans
preparation: Mix all together except for pecans.  Roll the mixture in the chopped pecans.

name: MUSHROOM SPREAD
ingredients:
4  slices bacon
2  Tbsp. bacon drippings
1 1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms, chopped
2  medium onions, finely chopped
1  clove garlic (whole)
3  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. seasoned salt
1/4  tsp. lemon pepper
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, cut into cubes
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. soy sauce
1/2  c. sour cream
1  tsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Cook bacon  until  crisp;  drain  and  set aside.  In 2 tablespoons  of  drippings, saute mushrooms, onions and garlic until tender  and most of the liquid has evaporated.  Blend in flour, seasoned  salt  and  lemon  pepper.  Add  cream cheese, Worcestershire   and  soy  sauce.  Stir  until  cheese  melts. Remove  garlic.  Stir  in sour cream, crumbled bacon and parsley. Heat but do not boil.  Serve warm on Melba rounds.

name: SAUERKRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. sauerkraut
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
