1/2  c. vinegar
preparation: Combine kraut, celery, bell pepper, onion and pimento.  In a separate bowl, mix sugar, oil and vinegar.  Pour dressing over kraut mixture.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 12 hours, stirring once or twice.

name: LITTLE CHEESE CAKES
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
preparation: Beat cheese, sugar and vanilla together.  Continue beating. Add 1 egg at a time.  Put 1 vanilla wafer (salerno) per 2-inch foil baking cup.  Pour 3/4 full.  Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes.  Cool.  Makes approximately 36.  Spoon fruit pie filling on top and serve.

name: DOIE'S ONE-EGG CAKE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. Crisco
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  c. sweet milk
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix Crisco and sugar together; add egg and then sweet milk and vanilla.  Mix baking powder and flour well; add a little at a time to first mixture.  Bake in a 350° oven until done.

name: CORNED BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked macaroni
1  c. milk
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
1  tsp. mustard
1/2  c. grated cheese
1/4  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. pimento stuffed olives
1 (12 oz.)  can corned beef
preparation: Cook macaroni; drain.  Combine soup, milk and mustard.  Add macaroni and remaining ingredients.  Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: MINCEMEAT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  c. flour, unsifted
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. Non-Such condensed mincemeat (in a box), crumbled
preparation: Preheat oven to 370°.  In a large mixer bowl, beat shortening and sugar until fluffy.  Add eggs; beat well.  Stir together dry ingredients; gradually add to shortening mix.  Mix well; stir in mincemeat.  Drop by rounded teaspoon 2-inches apart on greased baking sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes until light brown.

name: FLAKY PINEAPPLE SQUARES(Unleavened)
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1  lb. butter
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. drained crushed pineapple
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
powdered sugar
preparation: Cut butter into flour.  Add sour cream and vanilla.  Heat pineapple, sugar and cornstarch until thick.  Roll 1/2 of dough into flat pan.  Spread cooled filling and cover with rest of dough, rolled out a little.  Bake until brown, cool and sprinkle top with powdered sugar.  Cut into squares.

name: CHOCOLATE DATE TRUFFLES
ingredients:
3/4  c. slivered almonds
2  sq. semi-sweet chocolate
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. chopped dates
preparation: Grind 1/4 cup almonds in blender.  Toast remaining almonds and chop finely.  Melt chocolate with butter in saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly.  Stir in almonds and sugar.  Add dates. Chill until firm, stirring occasionally (1 to 2 hours).  Shape into 3/4 inch balls.  Roll in toasted almonds.  Store covered in refrigerator.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. fresh cranberries
1  small frozen orange juice
2 large  pkg. raspberry jello
pecans, chopped (approximately 2 1/2 c.)
3  c. boiling water
1  c. sugar
preparation: Place cranberries in saucepan with enough water to just come even with berries.  Boil until berries fall to pieces.   Strain all juice and then discard pulp (should have about 5 cups of juice).  Dissolve jello and sugar in the 3 cups boiling water. Add strained juice to jello.  Add undiluted orange juice and pecans.  Mix well and place in mold.  Refrigerate until time to serve.

name: TERRI'S PEACH PIE
ingredients:
5 to 6  c. sliced peaches
3/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  (9-inch) pie crusts
preparation: Put peaches in bowl.  Stir in sugar, flour and cinnamon.  Pour into pie shell.  Dot with butter.  Add top crust and seal.  Cut vent in top crust.  Brush top crust with water.  Sprinkle with sugar.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until crust is done.

name: GOOD MORNING MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. All-Bran
1/2  c. wheat germ
1/2  c. oats
1/2  c. corn meal
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. buttermilk
1/3  c. melted butter
1  Granny Smith apple, chopped
1  egg
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Combine flour, bran, wheat germ, oats, cornmeal, sugar, walnuts, raisins, baking powder and soda, cinnamon, ginger and nutmeg in a large bowl.  Combine buttermilk, butter, apple and egg.  Mix until combined.  Pour and bake.

name: BETTY'S SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
1  pie crust
2  or 3 potatoes, boiled until tender
1  tsp. cloves
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  stick butter, melted
2  eggs, beaten
1 small  can evaporated milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil potatoes until tender; peel skins off and mash.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 350°.

name: CHOCOLATE MOUSSE
ingredients:
3 3/4  oz. pkg. chocolate pudding and pie filling mix
1 3/4  c. milk
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese, cubed
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine mix and milk in saucepan.  Cook over medium heat until it boils.  Stir constantly.  Add cheese.  Continue cooking; beat until well blended.  Stir in vanilla.  Pour into lightly oiled 1-quart mold.  Place wax paper on surface; chill until firm. Unmold.  Garnish with whipped cream.

name: TERIYAKI MARINADE
ingredients:
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/3  c. dry sherry
1/3  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  clove garlic
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Pour in enough marinade to immerse meat halfway; then cover dish.  Marinate in refrigerator overnight, but no longer than 24 hours.  Turn occasionally.  Cubed meats should be marinated only 2 to 3 hours.  Grill or broil to desired doneness.  Excellent on beef, chicken or pork.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/4  c. very finely chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. seasoned salt
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients reserving 3/4 cup nuts.  Shape into ball. Roll in the remaining nuts.  Chill until firm.

name: BAKED TURBOT FILLETS
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen turbot fillets, thawed
1  Tbsp. salad oil
salt and pepper to taste
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. dairy sour cream
3  Tbsp. milk
6  slices bacon, crisp cooked and crumbled or imitation bacon bits
cooked rice for 6
preparation: Cut fish into 6 portions.  Place in greased 11 x 7-inch baking dish.  Brush fish with oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake at 350° about 20 to 30 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

name: EASY BEAN BURRITOS
ingredients:
10  flour tortillas
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  can refried beans
1  can black olives, sliced
1  large ripe tomato, diced
1  c. sour cream
1  c. chunky salsa
1  c. shredded lettuce
preparation: Place 9 x 13-inch casserole dish beside cutting board.  Lay tortilla on cutting board and spread layer of refried beans on top.  In a line near middle of tortilla, sprinkle black olives, cheese and salsa.  Roll up tortilla and place in dish.  Repeat for remaining 9 tortillas.  Microwave on High for 5 minutes or cook in oven at 350° for 20 minutes.  Serve on plates with lettuce, tomatoes and sour cream on top.

name: COCONUT-PINEAPPLE PIE
ingredients:
6  eggs
2  c. sugar
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1 (3.5 oz.)  can coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
1  stick butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Mix eggs, sugar, pineapple, coconut and vanilla.  Add melted butter.  Pour in 2 unbaked pie shells.  Bake on bottom grate of oven for 45 minutes at 325°.  To keep edges of pie shells from browning too much, put tinfoil around top edge.

name: CREAMY POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
3  c. chopped (raw) potatoes
1  chicken bouillon cube
1  c. water
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. carrots, chopped
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1 1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese, cubed
preparation: In large saucepan, combine potatoes, water, celery, carrots, onion, parsley flakes, bouillon cube and seasonings.  Mix well. Cover; simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Gradually add milk to flour, mixing until well blended.  Add milk mixture to vegetables; cook until thickened.  Add cubed cheese; stir until melted.

name: PENNSYLVANIA 8 BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1/4  c. each:  pinto, navy, kidney, large lima, small lima beans, black-eyed peas, split peas, lentils and barley
2  Tbsp. salt
ham bone or hock
1  large onion, chopped
1 large  can tomatoes (28 oz.)
1/2 to 1  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Wash beans and barley.  Place in large kettle and cover with water to 2 inches above beans.  Add 2 tablespoons salt.  Soak overnight and drain in morning.  Add 2 quarts water and ham bone or hock.  Bring to boil and simmer slowly 2 hours, stirring occasionally.  Remove ham bone or hock.  Cut off meat; chop and return to soup.  Add onion, tomatoes, chili powder, lemon juice, sugar, salt and pepper.  Simmer 1 hour or more.  Serve with tossed salad and corn bread or crusty French bread.  Enjoy!

name: GREEN GODDESS SALAD
ingredients:
3  cans green beans, drained
1 small  can water chestnuts, sliced and drained
1 (16 oz.)  can artichoke hearts, drained
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Green Goddess salad dressing
preparation: Mix ingredients together and chill well before serving.

name: KING RANCH CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  fryer
1  pkg. tortillas
1  tsp. chili powder
1  chopped onion
1  chopped bell pepper
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  can mushroom soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  lb. grated cheese
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
preparation: Boil chicken until tender; debone and save broth.  Cook onions and pepper in a skillet until tender.  Mix soups, onion, pepper, chili powder and garlic.  Add tomatoes and chicken.  Place tortillas in hot broth to heat.  Layer tortillas in casserole dish.  Add chicken mixture, cheese and tortillas in layers with the top layer being the tortillas.  Bake at 350° until done.

name: BAKED CREAMED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped fine
3  Tbsp. green pepper, chopped
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  Tbsp. chopped pimento
2 1/2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
3  c. cubed, cooked potatoes
3/4  c. shredded sharp cheese
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook onion and green pepper in butter about 5 minutes.  Stir in pimento and flour.  Add milk gradually; stir and cook until thickened.  Season to taste.  Add potatoes.  Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Top with cheese.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until bubbly.  This can be prepared ahead of time, stored in refrigerator and baked before serving.

name: DIPPED PEANUT BUTTER SANDWICH COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. creamy peanut butter
1  (4 oz.) sleeve round butter-flavored crackers
1  c. (6 oz.) white, semi-sweet or milk chocolate chips
1  Tbsp. shortening
preparation: Spread peanut butter on half of the crackers; top with remaining crackers to make sandwiches.  Refrigerate.  In a double boiler over simmering water, melt chocolate chips and shortening, stirring until smooth.  Dip sandwiches and place on waxed paper until chocolate hardens.  Yields 1 1/2 dozen.

name: PUMPKIN SQUARES
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. pumpkin (1 large can)
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
preparation: Mix ingredients together and pour into a buttered Pyrex baking dish.

name: CARROT-PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  c. grated carrots
preparation: Drain juice from pineapple and add enough water to equal 2 cups.  Bring to boil.  Add Jell-O and stir until dissolved then add pineapple and carrots.  Refrigerate until Jell-O sets.

name: CABBAGE SALAD
ingredients:
1  medium sized head cabbage
1  tsp. salt
4  c. boiling water
black pepper
1  medium onion, thinly sliced
2  carrots, grated
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Trim and shred cabbage.  In a bowl add cabbage, onion, salt and boiling water.  Let stand for 1 hour.  Drain into colander and press water from vegetables.  Put into large serving bowl.  Add vinegar and toss.  Season with pepper and serve.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2 - 20  oz. cans chunk pineapple, drained, (reserve juice)
2 - 15  oz. cans mandarin oranges, drained, (reserve juice)
1 - 10  oz. jar maraschino cherries, drained
1 - 3  oz. box (cook type) vanilla pudding
1 - 3  oz. box (cook type) tapioca pudding
4  bananas, sliced (add just before serving)
preparation: Place pineapple, oranges and cherries in a large bowl. Mix juices from oranges and pineapple (approximately 3 1/2 cups) with pudding and tapioca. Bring to a boil, stirring to prevent scorching. Pour over fruit and gently stir thoroughly.  Chill. Fold in bananas just before serving.

name: SEAFOOD AND VEGETABLE STIR-FRY
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  medium red or yellow bell pepper, cut into strips
1  medium onion, cut into thin wedges
18 snow peas, cut into diagonal  slices (halves)
1  tsp. minced garlic
10  oz. cooked medium shrimp (6 per person)
3  Tbsp. stir-fry sauce
preparation: Heat oil in nonstick skillet.  Add vegetables; stir-fry 4 minutes.  Add garlic; stir-fry 1 minute or until vegetables are tender-crisp.  Add shrimp and stir-fry sauce; stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes until hot through.  Serve over rice.

name: QUICK AND EASY TEX-MEX CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
1  medium onion, diced
salt and black pepper to taste
1  can Ranch Style beans
1  can drained whole kernel corn
1/4  c. picante sauce
1  c. diced tomatoes
1  pkg. cornbread mix
preparation: Place ground chuck, onion, salt and pepper in a large frying pan.  Brown mixture.  When done, add beans, corn, picante sauce and tomatoes; simmer 15 minutes.

name: FRIED SQUASH
ingredients:
5  small squash
1  c. corn meal
1  c. corn oil
salt and pepper
preparation: Slice squash into 1/8-inch slices.  Batter in corn meal and salt and pepper to taste.  Heat corn oil in skillet until bubbling.  Fry slices in single layer until golden brown.

name: BAKED BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. vinegar
1  medium onion
1  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. mustard
2 (8 oz.)  cans pork and beans
garlic to taste
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain.  Combine all ingredients in 2-quart casserole dish.  Cover.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SAUTE OF FRESH SPINACH
ingredients:
4  lb. fresh spinach
1 1/2  sticks butter (not margarine)
preparation: Wash spinach and thoroughly pat dry.  Strip the spinach from stems.

name: ORANGE CRUSH POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. Crisco
7  eggs
2 to 3  Tbsp. orange flavoring
1  tsp. vanilla
little food coloring (few drops yellow and red make orange)
preparation: Blend sugar, margarine and Crisco thoroughly.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Beat all the ingredients 5 minutes.  Add orange flavoring and vanilla.  (I also add a little food coloring, a few drops of yellow and red make orange.)

name: CHICKEN POTPIE(Chicken N' Dumplin's)
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
2  c. flour
1  c. milk
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix eggs and milk together; add dry ingredients.  Stir until fairly smooth.  Add more flour to be able to handle dough.  Roll out on floured board to pie crust thickness.  Cut into squares (about 1-inch).  Drop squares into rapidly boiling broth one at a time.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until done, 20 to 30 minutes.

name: LEMON AMONIA COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
2  eggs, separated
2  c. sweet milk
2  tsp. baking amonia
2  tsp. lemon oil
5  c. flour
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Add egg yolks and beat.  Add lemon oil; dissolve amonia in milk and add to mixture.  Use enough flour to make batter the consistency of cake.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg white.  Add remainder of flour to make a stiff dough. Roll on floured board and cut with cookie cutter into desired shape.  Bake at 350° for approximately 15 minutes or to a light brown.

name: COOKED DRESSING
ingredients:
1 1/2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. mustard
few grains cayenne
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. vinegar
2  egg yolks
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Add egg yolks (slightly beaten), melted butter and milk.  Very slowly, add the vinegar.  Cook in top of double boiler until mixture thickens.  Cool.  Straining the dressing makes it fine grained.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIR CAKE
ingredients:
1  box graham crackers
9  oz. carton Cool Whip
2  boxes instant vanilla pudding
1  can light chocolate frosting
1  c. powdered sugar
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix pudding, powdered sugar and milk together with electric mixer, about 2 minutes, on low speed.  Fold Cool Whip into pudding mixture; set aside.

name: QUICK AND EASY CHILI DIP
ingredients:
2  cans hot dog chili sauce
1  c. sour cream
1/2 to 1  c. grated Monterey or Cheddar cheese
preparation: Stir together and heat in microwave until cheese melts.  Serve with dip size tortilla chips.

name: PORK CHOP-RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. rice (uncooked)
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can milk
1  envelope dry onion soup mix
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of celery soup
6  pork chops
preparation: Place rice in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Mix together soups and milk.  Pour over rice.  Sprinkle onion soup mix over soups.  Top with pork chops.  Cover tightly with foil.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Remove foil the last 15 minutes to brown chops.  Yields 6 servings.

name: STRAWBERRY DIP
ingredients:
16  oz. marshmallow cream
16  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  pt. strawberries or sliced fruit
1  whole pineapple
preparation: Mix marshmallow cream and cream cheese together.  Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.  Cut top of pineapple.  Set aside for use as decoration.  Core pineapple and cut the core into chunks. Set aside.  Place dip into pineapple.  Put pineapple on a round plate and place the strawberries, pineapple chunks or other sliced fruit around the pineapple.  Serve and enjoy.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen broccoli
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can mushrooms
1  c. raw rice, cooked
1  small onion (optional)
preparation: Cook broccoli in casserole dish in microwave according to directions on package.  Drain.  Add cream of mushroom soup, mushrooms, Cheez Whiz and onions.  Heat.  Add rice.  Bake 15 minutes.

name: SHOO-FLY CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1  lb. light brown sugar
1  c. soft butter
1  c. King syrup
2  c. boiling water
2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix flour, brown sugar and butter.  Take out 1 1/2 cups and set aside for top of cake.  Mix syrup, water and baking soda until blended.  Add dry mixture and mix.  Sprinkle 1 1/2 cups of crumbs on top of cake.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: ENGLISH TRIFLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix, cooked
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
1  pkg. vanilla pudding, prepared
1  pkg. whipped topping (13 1/2 oz.)
1/4  slivered almonds, toasted
preparation: Bake cake in oblong pan according to directions on box.  This only uses half the cake (you can find someone baking on the same day and share).  Break 1/4 of the cake into large pieces and place in a 2-quart serving bowl.  Pour half the thawed strawberries over the cake.  Spread with half of prepared pudding.  Repeat layers. Chill at least 8 hours.  Right before serving, spread whipped topping on top and sprinkle with almonds.  Spoon into dessert dishes to serve.

name: JAN'S GRAPE PIE
ingredients:
6  c. Concord grapes
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. butter
1  lemon, juiced
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  pie crust
preparation: Separate grape pulp from skins.  Cook pulp until you can strain out seeds.  Mix all ingredients and skins.  Put in pie shell with lattice top and dot with butter.  Bake at 400° to 425° for 30 to 35 minutes.  The grapes cook down.

name: BEST BEET PICKLES
ingredients:
1  c. water
1  c. sugar
2  c. vinegar
cooked beets
preparation: Bring water, sugar and vinegar to a boil.  Add beets and boil until beets are hot.  Put in jars and seal.

name: HARVARD BEETS
ingredients:
1/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. beet juice
1/4  c. vinegar
2  c. cooked, sliced beets
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Combine sugar, cornstarch and salt.  Gradually stir in vinegar and beat until smooth.   In a saucepan, bring beet juice to a boil.  Add vinegar and sugar mixture.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until clear and thickened.  Add beets and butter.  Simmer a few minutes.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
1 1/3  c. oil
2  c. sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch morsels
3  c. diced apples
preparation: Sift together first 5 ingredients.  Beat eggs and add vanilla, oil and sugar.  Add dry ingredients to egg mixture.  Stir in nuts, apples and butterscotch morsels, reserving a few to sprinkle on top.  Pour into greased and floured tube or Bundt pan.  Bake about 1 hour at 350°.

name: BIG SOFT GINGER COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. ground ginger
1  tsp. baking soda
3/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. molasses
preparation: Combine flour, ginger, soda, cinnamon, cloves and salt. Set aside.

name: ALFREDO SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2/3  c. light cream or sour cream
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  egg yolks, slightly beaten
preparation: Melt butter until hot in medium saucepan.  Remove from heat. Gradually stir in cream, Parmesan cheese and yolk.  Pour over hot pasta to coat.

name: CERRA CHILI
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  medium onions, chopped
1  qt. water
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 1/2  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. Worcestershire
1  Tbsp. chili powder
2  tsp. ground cumin
1 1/2  tsp. ground allspice
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cayenne
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
2  bay leaves
cooked rice
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. chopped onion (optional)
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans, heated (optional)
preparation: Combine the ground beef, onions and water in a saucepan. Simmer the ingredients until the beef browns.  Add the tomatoes and their juice along with the vinegar, Worcestershire, chili powder, cumin, allspice, salt, cayenne, cinnamon, garlic powder and bay leaves.  Cover and simmer for 3 hours.

name: CHINESE HAMBURG
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. hamburg
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. celery, diced
1 1/2  c. water
1 large  can chow mein noodles
1 (20 oz.)  can bean sprouts
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. rice
1  tsp. soy sauce
preparation: Cook hamburg and onions partially; add celery and cook partially.  Add water, bean sprouts, soy sauce and heat through. Add soups and heat.  Add rice and cook uncovered 10 minutes.  Serve over noodles.

name: GREEK ROAST LAMB
ingredients:
leg of lamb
2  cloves garlic, slivered
1/4  c. olive oil
1/4  c. fresh lemon juice
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
3  tsp. dried oregano
lemon slices and mint (for garnish)
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Cut slits in roast and insert half of the garlic slivers.  Combine remaining garlic, oil, lemon juice, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon pepper and 2 teaspoons oregano in a small saucepan.  Heat and stir until well blended.  Brush lamb with the sauce.  Sprinkle remaining spices over the meat.  Roast 30 minutes per pound, basting with the oil mixture frequently. Let rest 10 minutes before carving.  Garnish platter with lemon slices and sprigs of mint.

name: LAZY MAN PIE
ingredients:
1  qt. sweetened, canned fruit (fresh fruit cooked in sweet water may be used)
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Heat fruit to almost boiling.  Mix up a batter of sugar, flour and milk (should be slightly thicker than cake batter).  Melt margarine in a pie pan on top of stove.  Pour batter into hot margarine.  Pour hot fruit over batter.  Bake in a 375° oven until brown.

name: BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. oatmeal
2  c. shredded wheat
2  c. Raisin Bran
1  c. oil
4  eggs, beaten
5  tsp. baking soda
5  c. flour
1  lb. brown sugar
1  qt. buttermilk
1  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Pour 1 cup boiling water over oatmeal, wheat and bran.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Store in covered bowl in refrigerator and bake as desired.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.  You may add raisins, nuts or blueberries to batter for variation in your muffins.  Muffin mix may be kept 2 to 3 weeks.

name: Tess' Bean Pot
ingredients:
2  cans lima beans
2  cans kidney beans
2  cans baked beans (not pork and beans)
2  large onions
1/2  lb. bacon
1  c. brown sugar
1 1/4  c. catsup
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. Tabasco sauce
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Drain all but baked beans.  Brown onions and bacon.  Add brown sugar, catsup, garlic powder, prepared mustard, Tabasco sauce and Worcestershire sauce.  Combine all and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  bunch broccoli, chopped
1  small red onion, thinly sliced, separate rings
12  slices of crisp fried bacon, crumbled
1  c. sunflower seeds
1  c. white raisins
1  can sliced water chestnuts
preparation: Mix all of the above ingredients together.

name: EGG WHITE DROP SOUP
ingredients:
4  c. water
4  pkg. low sodium chicken flavored broth mix
4  egg whites
2  Tbsp. chopped green onion (green part only)
preparation: In a mekium sauce pan, combine water and broth mix.  Bring to a boil over medium heat.  Beat egg whites with a fork until slightly frothy.  Gradually pour egg whites into boiling soup, stirring briskly with the other hand, in a circular motion.  Pour soup into bowls.  Garnish with green onions.

name: THREE BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can yellow wax beans
1  can green beans
1  can kidney beans
1 small  bottle zesty Italian dressing
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Drain beans, put in deep serving bowl.  Dissolve sugar in small bowl with Italian dressing.  Pour over beans and chill overnight.

name: OVEN STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. stew beef
1  envelope onion soup mix (dry)
1  c. water
1/2  c. red wine
cut up celery, carrots and potatoes (enough to serve 4)
preparation: Mix all together and bake in oven at 350° for 2 1/2 hours.

name: SNACK CRACKERS
ingredients:
2 (12 oz.)  boxes oyster crackers
1  c. oil
1  tsp. dry dill weed
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1  envelope Ranch salad dressing mix
preparation: Put crackers in a large bowl.  Add seasonings and pour oil over all.  Stir every 15 minutes (5 times).  Bake on cookie sheet in a 275° oven for 15 minutes.

name: CHERRY FLUFF
ingredients:
1 (9 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (22 oz.)  can cherry pie filling (or strawberry)
1 (3 1/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
vanilla instant pudding, as directed on box (optional)
1  c. chopped mix
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well.  Place in refrigerator. Better if made ahead of time.  Can be placed in graham cracker crust and served as pie (optional).

name: ROCKY ROAD
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) milk chocolate candy bars
3  c. miniature marshmallows
3/4  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
preparation: In medium saucepan, melt chocolate over very low heat, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Beat until smooth.   Stir in marshmallows and nuts.  Spread in buttered, 8-inch square pan; chill.  Cut into squares.  Yields about 1 1/2 pounds.

name: SPICED CIDER
ingredients:
1  qt. apple cider
1/4  c. firmly packed light brown sugar
1/2  tsp. whole cloves
1/2  tsp. whole allspice
1  cinnamon stick
dash of salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients in 2-quart microproof casserole.  Cook on 50 (defrost) for 17 to 20 minutes or until hot.  Remove spices. Serve hot, garnished with slices of red apple, if desired. Cooking time:  17 to 20 minutes.

name: JAY'S FAVORITE COOKIES
ingredients:
3  egg whites
pinch salt
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. light brown sugar
1  c. chopped filbert nuts
preparation: Beat egg whites until peaks form.  Add salt and sugars.  Beat until batter has glossy look.  Fold in nuts.  Grease cookies pans. Drop tablespoon of batter onto cookie sheets.  Bake at 250° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: HOMEMADE PIZZA CRUST
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1  c. hot water
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. oil
2 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Mix in order given.  Spread on oiled pan that has been sprinkled with corn meal.  (This makes bottom crispy.)

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. mushroom soup
1  container sour cream
2  small zucchini, diced large
1/2  c. grated carrots
1/2  c. onion, chopped small
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  small bag stuffing mix
preparation: Heat together soup and sour cream.  Add salt and pepper for taste.  Set aside.  Boil together zucchini, carrots and onion until tender; drain and mix together with soup and sour cream.

name: LINDBURG RELISH
ingredients:
3  or 4 medium cabbage
12  carrots
6  red bell peppers
6  green bell peppers
12  medium onions
1/2  c. salt
preparation: Put all vegetables through a food chopper and add all of the salt.  Let it set for 2 hours and then place it in a colander and drain.  Mix sugar, vinegar and celery seed.  Let stand until sugar dissolves (do not heat).  Put both mixes together and mix well. Place in freezer containers and enjoy later.

name: PECAN PRALINES
ingredients:
3/4  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. Pet milk
1/2  block butter
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped pecans
pinch of salt
2  or 3 shakes cream of tartar
preparation: Cook sugar, salt and milk until a rolling boil. Add butter and stir until butter is melted. Turn off heat and beat until mixture begins to get thick. Add pecans, vanilla and cream of tartar. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper or foil and let cool.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can fruit cocktail
1  can pineapple chunks
1  pt. frozen or fresh strawberries
3  sliced bananas
1  box strawberry instant pudding
preparation: Mix and refrigerate.

name: FANCY EASY COFFEECAKE
ingredients:
3  tubes biscuits
melted butter
brown sugar
preparation: Dip each biscuit in butter and sugar.  Lay in a circle in a Bundt pan.  Stagger the next circle of biscuit on top to fill empty spaces.  You add nuts, cinnamon and raisins.  Use Bundt pan and bake at 375° until brown.

name: BAKED CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. diced, cooked chicken
1  c. cooked macaroni (small shell)
1  c. diced celery
1  Tbsp. diced onion
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  can water chestnuts, diced
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  can cream of chicken soup
3  boiled eggs, diced
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and put in baking dish.  Cover with crushed potato chips.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage
3/4  c. uncooked rice
2  c. canned tomatoes
3/4  c. finely chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. chili powder
2  c. hot water
1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
preparation: Break sausage into pieces in a cold skillet.   Fry slowly for 12 to 15 minutes, until evenly brown, pouring off fat as it accumulates.  Add rice to fat in skillet.   Cook and stir over low heat until rice is lightly browned.   Stir in tomatoes, onion, salt, chili powder, hot water and sausage.     Pour into a baking dish and cook, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.   Sprinkle cheese on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: MICROWAVE BLUEBERRY SYRUP
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. water
2  tsp. lemon juice
2  c. blueberries
preparation: Combine sugar and cornstarch in a 1-quart casserole.  Add water and lemon juice.  Stir in blueberries.  Cook on High (full power) for 4 1/2 to 5 minutes.  Great on waffles or pancakes.

name: JELLO CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Betty Crocker sour cream cake mix
1  c. frozen strawberries
1 large  box strawberry Jell-O
2  c. boiling water
1  (8 oz.) bowl Cool Whip
preparation: Mix Jell-O and boiling water together and set aside; let cool. Bake cake as directed on package.  When cake is cool, poke holes in it with a fork, then pour Jell-O over cake.  Mix Cool Whip and strawberries together.  Drain strawberries a little; spread over cake.  For best results, use oblong pan.  Refrigerate 4 hours.

name: FRENCH RICE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  can French onion soup (undiluted)
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  jar sliced mushrooms (undrained)
1 (8 oz.)  can sliced water chestnuts (undrained)
1  c. uncooked regular rice
preparation: Combine soup and butter or margarine; stir well.  Drain mushrooms and water chestnuts, reserving liquid.  Add enough water to reserved liquid to equal 1 1/3 cups.

name: KILLER BEANS
ingredients:
1  qt. size can baked beans
1/4 to 1/2  lb. bacon
3/4 to 1  c. Open Pit barbecue sauce
1 to 2  tsp. Durkee red hot sauce
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  c. onion, chopped
preparation: Brown and drain bacon.  Save bacon grease.  Chop bacon and blend with all other ingredients in a 2-quart baking dish.  Bake at 250° for 2 to 3 hours.

name: GRANNY'S SQUARES
ingredients:
1  can Eagles Brand condensed milk
1  c. chopped dates
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. coconut
preparation: Preheat oven at 350 degrees.   Mix all ingredients and pour into a 9x9 square pan. Bake 45 minutes until edges along side of pan are golden brown.

name: CHEESY MIXED VEGETABLE BAKE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed broccoli, carrots and cauliflower
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped pimiento, drained and divided
1 (10 oz.)  can golden mushroom soup
1/3  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1 (3 oz.)  can French fried onions, divided
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese, divided
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a large casserole dish. Combine vegetables, half of the pimiento, soup, sour cream, pepper, half of the fried onions and half of the cheese in a bowl; mix. Spoon mixture into prepared casserole dish. Bake for 20 minutes. Sprinkle remaining fried onions and cheese on top of casserole. Bake casserole for 5 minutes longer. Remove casserole from oven. Sprinkle with remaining pimiento. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
2  c. light brown sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
2  sticks butter
1/2  tsp. soda
pinch of salt
pinch of cream of tartar
12  qt. popped corn
preparation: Bring mixture of sugar, syrup, butter and salt to a boil; cook to soft ball stage.  Remove from heat; add 1/2 teaspoon soda and cream of tartar.  Pour over popped corn; mix well.  Put in pan; bake in oven for 1 hour at 200°.  Remove from oven; place on waxed paper and separate.  After it is cool, place in sealed jar or plastic bag.

name: MOTHER'S BROWN BREAD(Mors Grovbrod)
ingredients:
1  cake fresh yeast
4  c. lukewarm water
1/2  c. molasses
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  c. melted shortening
6  c. white flour
2  c. whole wheat or graham flour
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup lukewarm water; let stand for 15 minutes.  In a large bowl, add 3 1/2 cups lukewarm water, molasses, salt, sugar and shortening.  Add enough flour to make a soft sponge.  Beat thoroughly.  Add remainder of flour to make stiff dough.  Knead dough well.  May add some shortening to kneading surface to help kneading.  Place dough in greased bowl; cover and let rise in a warm place.  When double in bulk, knead again.  Let rise once more, then shape into 4 loaves.  Place in loaf pans.  Let dough rise until loaves are double in size.

name: SEASON'S GREETING PUNCH
ingredients:
4  qt. cranberry-apple drink
2 (12 oz.)  cans frozen lemonade
3/4  c. orange flavor instant breakfast drink
8 (12 oz. each)  bottles ginger ale
8  c. water
preparation: Combine all ingredients, chill and serve.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. (1 stick) butter (room temperature)
1/2  c. grated Monterey Jack cheese
1/2  c. grated mild Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  can green chilies (4 oz.), chopped
1  (16 oz.) cream corn
1  c. flour
1  c. yellow corn meal
4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream 1/2 cup butter with sugar until light and fluffy.  Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Mix in chilies, corn and cheese.

name: FABULOUS TURKEY BREAST
ingredients:
3  oz. frozen orange juice concentrate (do not dilute)
3  garlic cloves, minced
1/4  tsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. no-sugar added orange marmalade
1/2  tsp. tamari or low-sodium soy sauce
1  (3 lb.) turkey breast
2  tsp. cornstarch, mixed with 2 Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Combine orange juice concentrate, garlic, paprika, marmalade and tamari in a small bowl.  Cut 2 pieces of plastic wrap at least 18-inches long and overlap them about 2-inches, to create a very large piece of plastic wrap.  Place turkey in center of this sheet and cover turkey completely, on all sides, with orange mixture. Wrap turkey very tightly with wrap.  Use extra piece if you think it needs it.  (Repeat with foil.)

name: SPICED NUTS
ingredients:
1  egg white, slightly beaten
2 1/2  Tbsp. water
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. allspice
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
3  c. pecans and walnuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 250°.  Mix together all ingredients except nuts.  Add nuts to mixture and toss lightly until well coated. Arrange in a single layer on a greased cookie sheet.  Bake 45 minutes or until golden and crusty.  Remove from oven. Immediately remove nuts from cookie sheet.  Store in covered container.

name: CLASSIC GREEN BEAN BAKE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  cans green beans
1  can French fried onions
dash of pepper
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. soy sauce
1  chopped onion
preparation: Combine soup, milk, soy sauce, onions and beans in a 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Add 1/2 can fried onions.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes, until hot and bubbly.  Stir.  Top with remaining fried onions.  Bake 5 minutes more.

name: CHICKEN WITH HONEY BUTTER SAUCE
ingredients:
3  lb. chicken
1  c. flour
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. paprika
1/4  c. melted butter
1/2  c. honey
1/4  c. lemon juice
preparation: Shake chicken in dry ingredients and flash fry.  Bake chicken 30 minutes at 400°.  Mix butter, honey and lemon juice.  Pour over chicken and bake for 30 minutes more.

name: SHRIMP OR CRAB DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. minced onion
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1 heaping  Tbsp. salad dressing or mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. ketchup
1/2  tsp. salt
1  small tin of shrimp or crab
preparation: If using crab, rinse in colander and remove all shell and cartilage.

name: FRESH GARDEN VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  head fresh cauliflower
1  bunch fresh broccoli
1  large green pepper
1  can pitted black olives
1 (16 oz.)  bottle Italian salad dressing
preparation: Marinate vegetables in salad dressing for 12 hours.  Grate 1 pound sharp Cheddar cheese over top before serving.

name: FROZEN LAYERED CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can whole berry cranberry sauce
3  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
1  c. heavy cream, whipped
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. powdered sugar
1  c. finely chopped nuts
mayonnaise (for topping, optional)
preparation: Mash cranberry sauce with fork.  Mix in lemon juice.  Spread a little of this mixture into individual molds, paper  muffin cups or 1 larger mold.  Mix remaining ingredients.  Spread this on top of cranberry layer.  Freeze.  Unmold red side up on lettuce leaves.  May be served with a dash of mayonnaise on top.  Yields 8 to 10 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. flour
dash of salt
1 small  can evaporated milk
1 small  can chocolate syrup (5.5 oz.)
1/2  c. milk
4  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
4  eggs (save 3 whites for meringue)
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except vanilla and butter, in saucepan. Cook slowly, stirring constantly, until thick (just to a boil). Remove from heat.  Add vanilla and butter.  Pour into baked pie shell.  Top with meringue and brown.

name: TRADITIONAL PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
whipped topping and nuts (optional)
9-inch unbaked pie crust
preparation: In a large bowl, combine filling ingredients, mixing well. Pour into pie crust and bake 15 minutes at 425°.  Reduce oven temperature to 350° and continue baking 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean.  Cool pies down and garnish with whipped topping and nuts.

name: BREAKFAST FRITTATA
ingredients:
2  c. potatoes, raw and shredded
2  c. chopped broccoli, raw
1/2  c. diced onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. butter flavored Crisco
6  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. water
preparation: Mix together potatoes, broccoli, onion, green pepper and butter in skillet.  Cook spuds in butter until tender.  Add onions and peppers; cook until onions are tender.  Add broccoli; cover and cook on low for 5 minutes.  Add to mixture eggs, Parmesan cheese, basil, salt, pepper and water.  Cover and cook on low for 10 to 15 minutes (until edges are set).  Sprinkle 1/4 cup Monterey Jack cheese on top (optional).  Take off heat; cover and let set for 5 minutes.  Serve.

name: MUFFIN BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. milk
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
preparation: Stir and  drop	into  muffin  tins.  Bake at 350° until brown.

name: BANANA TEA BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. shortening
2/3  c. sugar
2  eggs, well beaten
1  c. mashed bananas (2 to 3)
preparation: Sift together flour, baking powder, soda and salt.  Beat shortening until creamy.  Add sugar gradually and continue beating until light and fluffy.  Add eggs and beat well.  Add flour mixture alternately with bananas, a small amount at a time, after each addition.  Put in loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

name: BAKED - STUFFED SCROD
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. cod fillets
2  pkg. Ritz crackers
1  stick butter
1  Tbsp. lemon pepper seasoning
parsley and paprika
preparation: Crumble crackers in medium sized bowl.  Add melted butter and spice.  Mix together.  Place fish fillets in baking dish.  Spread cracker mixture evenly over fish.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 30 minutes.

name: HOT FUDGE PIE
ingredients:
2  sq. chocolate or 1/2 c. cocoa
1/4  lb. butter or margarine
2  whole eggs
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
a pinch of salt
preparation: Melt chocolate (or cocoa) and butter or margarine together. Cool slightly and add eggs, sugar, flour, vanilla and a pinch of salt.  Beat until smooth and pour into buttered pie pan.  Bake 25 minutes at 350°.  Serve hot with ice cream or whipped cream.

name: APPLE SALSA AND CINNAMON CHIPS
ingredients:
2  Granny Smith apples
1  c. strawberries
1  kiwi, peeled and chopped
1  small orange
2  Tbsp. packed brown sugar
2  Tbsp. apple jelly
preparation: Peel, core and chop apples into a 1-quart bowl. Cut strawberries into small pieces and add to apples. Add kiwi. Cut orange and squeeze juice into bowl; then remove as much pulp as you can and add to juice.

name: BROCCOLI CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. nonfat cottage cheese
1/2  c. liquid Butter Buds
4  egg substitutes
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. corn muffin mix
preparation: Combine broccoli and onion in glass bowl.  Microwave, covered, on High for 2 to 3 minutes or until broccoli thaws.  Add cottage cheese, butter and eggs; mix well.  Add muffin mix; stir just until moistened.  Pour into greased 9 x 9-inch baking pan.  Bake at 400° for 35 minutes or until golden brown.  Yields 9 servings.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  slices bread
1  lb. sausage
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
6  eggs
2  c. milk
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Tear up the bread slices and put in greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Brown and drain the sausage and then spoon sausage over bread.  Sprinkle with the grated Cheddar cheese.  Beat together the eggs, milk, dry mustard, salt and pepper.  Pour over mixture in the baking dish.  Bake at 350° uncovered for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: SUGAR AND SPICE COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. brown sugar
2/3  c. shortening
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
2  eggs
preparation: Mix well and pour into 2 round greased and floured cake pans; sprinkle with the reserved 1/2 cup of mixture for topping.  Bake in preheated oven at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes until browned.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs, well beaten
3  Tbsp. sour cream
3  large ripe bananas, mashed
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Pour into greased loaf pans and bake at 350° for 1 hour (approximately).

name: CHEDDAR AND TURKEY PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) folded refrigerated unbaked pie crust
1  lb. ground raw turkey, thawed
2  c. loose pack frozen mixed vegetables
1 (11 oz.)  can condensed Cheddar cheese soup
1 (5 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1/2  tsp. dried thyme, crushed
1  beaten egg white
1  Tbsp. water
preparation: In a 3 quart saucepan, brown turkey.  Drain off any fat.  Stir in vegetables, soup, milk and thyme.  Bring to boil; reduce heat. Simmer 5 minutes.  Spoon into 8-inch round baking dish.  Unfold crust; cut decorative cutouts or slits in crust so steam can escape.  Place crust on top of dish.  Turn edge under; flute. Combine egg white and water; brush over crust.  Sprinkle sesame seed on top.  Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden. Let stand 5 minutes.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2  c. cracker crumbs (saltines)
1  can asparagus, drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese, grated
preparation: Melt  margarine;  grate cheese.  Place 1/2 asparagus in greased casserole;	add  1/2  peas,  1/2 grated cheese and 1/2 melted  margarine.	Cover  with  1/2  cracker  crumbs.  Repeat layers, except  for  cracker  crumbs.  Add	mushroom  soup and sprinkle remaining	cracker  crumbs.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.  Serve hot.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. oil
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  oz. red food coloring
1  tsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. cocoa
preparation: Cream oil, sugar and eggs.  Sift flour, salt and cocoa together.  Add soda to milk.  Add milk and dry ingredients alternately to creamed mixture.  Blend well; add vanilla and food coloring.  Add vinegar last.  Pour into 3 layer pans and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.

name: CHEESEBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  Can Refrigerated Biscuits
1  lb. Ground Beef
1/4  Cup Onions, chopped
3/4  Tsp. Salt
1/8  Tsp. Pepper
1/4  Cup Ketchup
1-8 oz. Tomato Sauce
1-8 oz. American Cheese
preparation: Brown beef and onion in skillet; drain and add salt and pepper.  Stir in ketchup and tomato sauce and heat thoroughly. Turn into an 8 inch square casserole dish.  Cut cheese into strips and sprinkle over meat.  Top with biscuits.  (If desired, use 6 biscuits in casserole and bake remainder.)

name: FROZEN PUNCH
ingredients:
2 small  boxes cherry Jell-O
2  c. sugar
6  c. hot water
4 (6 oz.)  cans pineapple juice
1 small  can frozen lemonade
4  Tbsp. sherbet (pineapple or lemon)
preparation: Mix cherry Jell-O, sugar and hot water until dissolved. Mix all ingredients and freeze.  When getting ready to serve, defrost until it  makes  a mushy mixture.  Add about 20 ounces ginger ale and  4  tablespoons  sherbet.  Mix  until mushy and serve.  Serves 30.

name: MAYONNAISE
ingredients:
1  egg
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. mustard
dash of pepper
preparation: Beat thoroughly while pouring a pint of Wesson oil into it. This is good homemade mayonnaise.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. ground raw cranberries
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. sugar
1  c. pineapple syrup
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. pecans
1  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. hot water
preparation: Dissolve jello in hot water.  Add pineapple syrup.  Add sugar to cranberries; let stand.  Add all ingredients to jello when it becomes syrupy thick.  Chill in mold.

name: BAKED TOFU
ingredients:
1  block tofu, drained and mashed, squeeze out water
1  c. ground pork
1  c. fish cake mix (surimi)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. round or green onion, chopped
1  small carrot, grated
2  eggs, slightly beaten
3/4  c. bread crumbs (save 1/4 c. for top)
2  Tbsp. shoyu
1  tsp. salt
dash of m.s.g.
preparation: Mix  all ingredients together in a casserole.  Top with 1/4 cup bread crumbs.  Bake, covered, for 1 hour at 375°.

name: CHEESY TURKEY RICE SQUARES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
3/4  c. uncooked long grain rice
4  oz. sharp process American cheese, shredded (1 c.)
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. finely chopped, drained, cooked spinach
1/4  c. finely chopped green onions and tops
2  c. diced, cooked turkey
2  beaten eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed Cheddar cheese soup
1/3  c. milk
preparation: Substituting chicken broth for water, cook rice according to package directions, omitting salt and butter.  Stir cheese and 2 tablespoons butter into hot rice.  Add spinach, onions and turkey and mix well.  Beat eggs well.  Add with 1 1/2 cups milk to rice mixture.  Blend lightly.  Turn into well-greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish.  Bake at 350° about 40 minutes or until knife comes out clean.  Cut in squares and serve with cheese sauce.  To make cheese sauce, blend cheese soup with milk in saucepan and heat thoroughly.  That's all there is to it!

name: BUTTERSCOTCH OATMEAL CRISPIES
ingredients:
1  c. packed brown sugar
1  c. all-purpose flour
3  c. quick oats
1  c. shortening, melted (part butter for flavor)
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  c. hot water
granulated sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large bowl, combine brown sugar, flour and oats.  In small bowl, mix shortening, vanilla, salt, soda and hot water.  Beat into sugar mixture.  Chill.   Roll dough in 1/2-inch balls.  Place on cookie sheet.  Flatten with bottom of glass dipped in sugar.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes.  Remove to rack to cool.  Makes 5 1/2 dozen.

name: JAM CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs, separated
1  tsp. soda
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. butter
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  tsp. each: cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and allspice
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. jam (any flavor) *
1  c. nuts, chopped
3  c. flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Beat egg yolks until thick; add soda, both sugars and butter.  Beat until creamy; add spices and vanilla.  Add jam, nuts and beaten egg whites.  Fold in flour and milk.  Pour into tube or loaf pan.  Bake.

name: FRIENDSHIP TEA
ingredients:
14  oz. Tang powder mix
1  c. instant tea powder (regular or decaf)
1 (.32 oz.)  pkg. dry lemonade mix
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Mix ingredients together very well.  Homogenize in a blender. Use two level teaspoons per cup.

name: MILDRED'S BRUNSWICK STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  cans barbecue pork
2  can chicken white meat
1  can creamed corn
1  can whole kernel corn
6  c. potatoes, small pieces, boiled
1  or 2 large onions, chopped and boiled with potatoes
1  jar hot tomato catsup
2 large  cans tomatoes, mashed
salt and pepper to taste
hot pepper sauce if desired
preparation: Cook  beef  until   no	longer	pink.  Drain  off  fat. Combine all ingredients and simmer about 2 hours.

name: PUMPKIN APPLESAUCE BREAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. Crisco
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  c. applesauce
1  c. pumpkin
3 1/3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. mace
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
6  oz. apple juice
nuts and raisins
preparation: Beat all ingredients together, except nuts and raisins, until well combined.  Add nuts and raisins.  Divide the mixture into 2 loaves.  Bake at 350° until done.

name: SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3/4  lb. ground beef
1  lb. spaghetti
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
3  Tbsp. oil
1 (No. 2)  can tomatoes
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
salt and pepper
preparation: In a heavy skillet, brown ground beef.  Add onion and celery. Cook for a few minutes.  Drain off fat.  Add tomatoes, brown sugar, salt and pepper to taste.  Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water for 10 minutes.  Drain and rinse.  Layer spaghetti and meat mixture in casserole dish.  Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350°.  Serves 8 generously.

name: BEEF STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1  lb. boneless sirloin steak
1/2  c. water
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. oyster sauce
cooking spray (vegetable)
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  large onion, quartered
3  stalks celery, sliced diagonally
1/2  lb. sliced fresh mushrooms
1  green pepper, cut in strips
1/2  lb. fresh snow peas
1/2  bunch broccoli flowerets
1  can sliced water chestnuts
preparation: Trim fat  from  steak.  Cut  across  grain into strips. Combine water,  cornstarch, soy sauce, sugar and oyster sauce. Set aside.  Coat wok or skillet with cooking spray and heat on medium-high for 2  minutes.  Add  steak  and  stir-fry about 3 minutes.  Remove meat.  Place onion, celery, mushrooms, pepper and water chestnuts to  pan drippings in wok.  Stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes. Add meat,  broccoli  and snow peas.  Cover and reduce heat to medium.  Simmer  2  to  3  minutes.  Stir in soy sauce mixture.  Cook  on  medium,  stirring constantly until bubbly. Serve over hot rice.

name: BARBECUE MEATBALL BITES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/3  c. fine bread crumbs
1  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/2  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. brown sugar, packed
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Mix ground beef, bread crumbs, egg and poultry seasoning. Shape into about 2 dozen 1 1/2-inch balls. Brown balls slowly in a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat. Pour off excess fat.

name: HEAVENLY HASH CANDY
ingredients:
6  c. sugar
1  pt. white corn syrup
1  can Pet milk
vanilla and almond extract
1  lb. almonds
1  lb. walnuts
preparation: Boil sugar, syrup and milk until it forms a soft ball.  Remove from fire and add flavoring and nuts.  Beat as long as you can. Pour into buttered pan.

name: WHITE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
3  eggs
1  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
3  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. almond extract
3  c. flour
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix butter and sugar; add extract and eggs.  Sift dry ingredients alternately with milk.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: BINGO BARS
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. salad oil
1 (4 oz.)  jar baby food strained applesauce
1 (4 oz.)  jar baby food strained apricots
1 (4 oz.)  jar baby food strained carrots
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. pecans or walnuts
preparation: Beat eggs and gradually add sugar and mix well.  Add salad oil and blend in.  Sift all dry ingredients. Combine (3) baby foods in bowl, alternating dry ingredients and baby food to egg and sugar mix.  Pour in greased and floured jelly roll size pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  While bars are cooling, prepare icing.

name: NEVER FAIL FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2/3  c. milk
1/2  stick butter
8  marshmallows (optional)
2  Tbsp. dark Karo syrup
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix first items together and cook until soft ball stage. Remove from heat.  Add vanilla, butter and marshmallows and beat until very stiff.  Add nuts.  Pour in buttered dish and cut.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE MIX
ingredients:
1  lb. powdered sugar
1 - 8  oz. box powdered milk
1  lb. box chocolate milk mix
8  oz. coffee creamer (may use flavored)
1  box instant chocolate pudding
preparation: Mix well and store in air tight container.  Use 1/4 c. in 8 oz. coffee mug.

name: BARBECUE BEEF(30 Buns)
ingredients:
5  lb. chuck roast
1 large  can tomatoes
1/2  c. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. salt
1  large green pepper, chopped
1  clove garlic, chopped
4  pieces celery, chopped
1  onion, chopped
preparation: Dump into big roaster pan.  Cover.  Bake 6 hours at 300°. After 3 hours, take forks and shred.  Remove fat and bones.  Every hour or so, do this until all is removed.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1/2 to 1  c. chopped, boiled shrimp
8  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. sour cream
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  very small onion, diced
1/4  tsp. horseradish sauce
dash of Worcestershire sauce
dash of Tabasco sauce (optional)
preparation: Mix together cream cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise, lemon juice and Worcestershire and Tabasco sauces.  Stir until smooth.  Add horseradish, onion and shrimp.  Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.  Serve with chips.

name: CHERRY CHEESE PIE(Makes One 9-inch Pie)
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) graham cracker crumb crust or baked pastry shell
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1/3  c. ReaLemon lemon juice from concentrate
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1 (21 oz.)  can Thank You brand cherry filling and topping, chilled
preparation: In large mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.  Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.  Stir in ReaLemon brand and vanilla.  Pour into prepared crust.  Chill 3 hours or until set.  Top with cherry filling before serving.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: OATMEAL CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. oatmeal
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. boiling water
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. oil
1 1/3  c. flour
preparation: Pour  boiling  water  over oatmeal; cool.  Cream sugars, oil and  eggs.  Add  rest  of ingredients.  Mix well.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: LASAGNE ITALIANO
ingredients:
1  lb. Italian sausage or hamburger
1/2  cup chopped onion
1  clove of garlic, crushed
1 16  oz. can, whole tomatoes
1 15  oz. can, tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. dried parsley flakes
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. dried basil leaves
1/2  tsp. salt
9  uncooked lasagne noodles
1 16  oz. carton of ricotta or creamed cottage cheese
1/4  cup grated Parmesan Cheese
1  Tbsp. dried parsley flakes
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. dried oregano leaves
2  cups shredded Mozzarella Cheese, about 8 oz.
1/4  cup grated Parmesan Cheese
preparation: Cook meat, onion and garlic in skillet til brown.  Drain.  Add tomatoes with liquid, tomato sauce, parsley, sugar, basil, 1/2 tsp. salt, stirring occasionally.  Lower heat.  Simmer uncovered til mixture thickens, about 1 hour.  Cook noodles.  Save 1/2 cup of sauce mixture.  Mix Ricotta Cheese, 1/4 cup of Parmesan Cheese, 1 Tbsp. parsley, 1 1/2 tsp. salt and the oregano.  Layer 1/3 each of the noodles, remaining sauce mix, Mozzarella Cheese and Ricotta Cheese mix in ungreased 9 X 13 X 2 pan.  Repeat twice.  Spoon reserved sauce mix on top, sprinkle with 1/4 cup Parmesan Cheese. Cook uncovered at 350° for 45 minutes.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.  Makes up to 10 servings.

name: HAMBURGERS AND ONION GRAVY
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
1  egg
1/4  c. bread crumbs
dash of pepper
1  tsp. Worcestershire
1  pkg. onion soup mix
2  Tbsp. oil
2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. juice from mushrooms and water
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
preparation: Mix meat with egg, crumbs, seasoning and half of the onion soup mix.  Make patties and fry until brown on both sides.  Remove when brown.  Add the flour to frypan and stir until it browns lightly.  Put in remaining onion soup mix and mushrooms; cook 5 minutes.  Put meat back in gravy and cover.  Cook another 5 or 10 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: OVEN FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  frying chicken
2  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. salt (more or less)
1  c. flour
2  tsp. paprika
1  stick oleo
preparation: Cut chicken into pieces.  Shake chicken pieces in bag with flour, salt, pepper and paprika.  Melt oleo in shallow baking pan in 375° oven.  Add chicken.  Turn to coat.  Then arrange in pan, skin side down.  Bake in 375° oven for 30 minutes.  Turn chicken. Bake 20 to 30 minutes longer.  If chicken cannot be served immediately, brush with melted oleo and leave in oven, reducing heat to 300°.

name: PARTY MIX
ingredients:
1  box Wheat Chex
1  box Rice Chex
1  box Cheerios
1  box Corn Chex
1  bag pretzels
4  c. pecans
1  jar peanuts
4  sticks butter
1  tsp. garlic salt
3  tsp. celery salt
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Melt butter in large pan.  Mix garlic salt, celery salt and Worcestershire sauce.  Mix in the rest of ingredients and stir and shake several times during cooking.  Cook at 250° for 3 to 4 hours.

name: PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. Biscuit Mix
1  c. water
1/4  c. oil or butter
preparation: Make batter of Biscuit Mix and water.  Brush heavy skillet with oil or butter.  Drop 1/4 cup batter at a time into skillet. Cook until bubbly with dry edges.  Flip and brown other side.

name: CHAMPION CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
4 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
16  oz. sour cream
1/4  lb. (1 stick) sweet butter
5  eggs
1 1/4  c. sugar
1 1/4  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Let cream cheese, sour cream, butter and eggs stand at room temperature for at least one hour.

name: BROCCOLI-CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2/3  c. (about 1/2 jar) homestyle chicken gravy
2/3  c. milk
1  c. fresh chopped broccoli florets
pepper to taste
nutmeg to taste
1/2  c. (2 oz.) grated Swiss cheese
chicken stuffing mix or herb stuffing mix (optional)
preparation: Place onion and butter in 1 1/2-quart microwave-safe casserole.  Cook at High, uncovered, for 1 minute.  Stir in gravy, milk, broccoli, pepper and nutmeg.  Cook, covered, at High for 2 minutes; stir.  Cover and cook 2 to 3 minutes longer or until broccoli is tender.  Stir in cheese.  Cover and cook at Medium (50%) for 1 to 2 minutes or until cheese is melted.  Stir. Garnish with stuffing mix, if desired.  Makes 2 servings.

name: SKYLINE CHILI DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. frozen Skyline chili
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Press cream cheese thinly into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare chili according to package directions and allow to cool. Pour cooled chili over cream cheese and top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350° until the cheese is melted.  Serve with taco chips.

name: WORLD'S BEST CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
2 1/2  Tbsp. active dry yeast
1 1/2  c. warm milk
1 1/2  c. warm water
1 1/2  c. granulated sugar
1 1/2  c. butter (3 sticks)
6  eggs
10  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. melted butter
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water and let stand for 5 minutes. Dissolve sugar and butter in warm milk.  Add eggs, 2 cups of flour and yeast mixture and beat until smooth.  Continue adding flour gradually, working dough until all flour is moistened.  Dough should be dry and not too moist.  Turn out on lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 8 to 10 minutes. Place dough in lightly greased bowl, turning to coat.  Cover, and let rise until double in bulk (about 1 hour).  Turn dough out on lightly floured surface, knead until smooth, and let rise again until double in size (about 1 hour).

name: FROSTED MOLASSES CREAMS
ingredients:
1/2  C. hot coffee
1/2  C. shortening
3/4  C. molasses
2  eggs
2 1/2  C. flour
1  C. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
preparation: Pour coffee over shortening; add molasses and eggs; mix well. Add to dry ingredients in mixing bowl and beat till smooth at low speed 2 minutes.

name: BACON VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bacon
1 small  can peas
1 small  can whole kernel corn
1 small  can string beans
1 medium-size  can crushed tomatoes
1 medium-size  can green butter beans
dash of black pepper
preparation: Fry bacon until fully cooked and crisp.  Get medium-size pot. Put all vegetables in pot.  Heat for 15 minutes on medium-high. Then put in bacon with bacon oil.  Mix all together in the pot and serve.

name: BACON WRAPPED ASPARAGUS BUNDLES
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. asparagus spears, trimmed 4 - 5 inches long tips
extra-virgin olive oil, for drizzling
fresh ground black pepper
4  slices bacon or pancetta
chopped chives or scallions (optional garnish)
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°. Lightly coat asparagus spears with olive oil and season with black pepper. Gather 3 - 4 asparagus spears together and wrap with a slice of bacon. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Place bundles of asparagus spears on a slotted broiler pan. Bake for 12 minutes.

name: HAWAIIAN SUPREME CAKE
ingredients:
1  box lemon supreme cake mix
1 small  box vanilla pudding (cooking kind)
4  eggs
3/4  c. oil
1  (10 oz.) 7-Up
preparation: Sift cake mix and pudding together.  Add eggs, one at a time, then oil, then 7-Up.  Mix all together and pour in three 9-inch pans.  Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: PEPPERONI BITES
ingredients:
1  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. chopped pepperoni
1/2  c. pizza sauce
2 (10 each)  pkg. refrigerated biscuits
1  Tbsp. milk
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: For filling, in a bowl, combine Mozzarella cheese, pepperoni and pizza sauce.  Set aside.

name: IOWA BOILED BEEF DINNER
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. lean boneless beef chuck roast
1  Tbsp. salt
2  peppercorns
1  bay leaf
6  c. water
6  small yellow onions, peeled
6  medium-size carrots, pared and quartered
1  medium size cabbage (about 2 lb.)
6  small potatoes, scrubbed
preparation: Place meat in a large pot.  Add salt, peppercorns, bay leaf and water.  Cover; heat to boiling.  Simmer 1 1/2 hours.  Remove meat; let any fat rise to top of broth.  Skim; return meat to pot. Cut off a band of skin around middle of each potato.  Place potatoes, onions and carrots around meat in pot.  Simmer 1 hour or until meat is fork-tender.

name: CHERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
1  c. cherry pie filling
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. coconut
1  c. nuts
1  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix all five ingredients, then add Cool Whip last. Refrigerate.

name: NORDIC DELIGHTS
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. butter, softened
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. flaked coconut
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except coconut.  Beat at low speed until well mixed, 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in coconut. Divide dough in half.  Shape each ball into a 12 x 2-inch roll. Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate until firm, at least 2 hours.

name: BUBBLE SOLUTION(Do Not Drink!)
ingredients:
1/3  c. dish soap or baby shampoo
1 1/4  c. water
2  tsp. sugar
1  drop food coloring (optional)
preparation: Combine ingredients and pour into unbreakable bottle.  To blow bubbles, experiment using plastic straws, pipe cleaners formed into loops, strawberry baskets, spoons with holes in them and other items you think of.  Have fun.

name: STACKED SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  can green peas
1  head lettuce, cut real fine
4  to 6 boiled eggs
1  lb. bacon
1  medium onion
1  tomato
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Layer of lettuce, cut up eggs, rest of lettuce, sliced onions, bit pieces of tomato, green peas and crumbled bacon. Mix mayonnaise and sour cream together and put on top. Put grated cheese on top. Let set in refrigerator overnight.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground round steak
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. bread crumbs
3/4  c. ketchup
1  tsp. Accent
1/2  c. warm water
1  pkg. onion soup mix
2  strips bacon (optional)
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
preparation: Mix all but last two ingredients together thoroughly.  Put into loaf pan.  Cover with bacon if you like that flavor.  Pour tomato sauce over all.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.  Serves 6.

name: SHRIMP OREGANATA
ingredients:
shrimp
butter
olive oil
oregano
parsley
salt
pepper
garlic
seasoned bread crumbs
preparation: Mix together equal amounts of butter and oil.  Add oregano, parsley, salt and pepper and a generous amount of fresh chopped garlic.   Pour over raw, shelled shrimp.  Top with seasoned bread crumbs and broil for 5 minutes.

name: ZESTY MEXICAN SOUP
ingredients:
2  cups cubed cooked chicken
1 (14-1/2 oz.)  can ready-to-serve chicken broth
1 (11.5 oz.)  can vegetable juice cocktail
1 (11 oz.)  can mexicorn (whole kernel Corn with red and green peppers), undrained
1  cup thick 'n chunky salsa
1 (4.5 oz.)  can chopped green chilies, drained
1/4  cup chopped fresh cilantro
preparation: In large saucepan, combine all ingredients except cilantro; mix well.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat; simmer 10 minutes or until thoroughly heated.  Stir in cilantro.  Serves 6.

name: BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can green beans
1  can wax beans
1  can kidney beans
1  can garbanzo beans
1  chopped green pepper
1  chopped onion
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. oil
1/2  c. vinegar
preparation: Heat sugar, oil and vinegar just until sugar is dissolved. Drain green, wax and garbanzo beans, then rinse and drain kidney beans.  Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate overnight.

name: CRANBERRY NUT COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. biscuit mix
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  egg
2/3  c. water or milk
2/3  c. whole cranberry sauce
preparation: Mix brown sugar, nuts and cinnamon. Set aside. Combine baking mix (biscuit), egg and water. Beat vigorously 1/2 minute.  Spread batter in greased square 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle with nut mix. Spoon cranberry sauce over the top. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400°. While warm, spread with Confectioners Sugar Icing.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1  c. soft shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Mix shortening, sugar and eggs together.  Sift together remaining ingredients.  Blend the 2 mixtures.  Roll into balls the size of walnuts.  Then roll in a mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon.  Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.  These cookies puff up at first, then flatten with a wrinkled top.  Yields 5 dozen.

name: HOT PINEAPPLE SIDE DISH
ingredients:
1  can (20 oz.) pineapple chunks
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. margarine, melted
1 1/2  c. (6 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese, divided
2/3  c. coarsely crushed saltines
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/4 cup juice; set aside.  In medium bowl, combine sugar and flour.  Add butter or margarine and 1 cup cheese.  Mix well.  Gently stir in pineapple.  Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish.  Sprinkle crushed crackers on top; drizzle with reserved juice.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Remove and sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Yields 6 servings.

name: SOMBRERO DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. diced onion
1/2  c. catsup
1  tsp. chili powder
salt and pepper
1  can red chili beans, mashed
1/4  c. onion
1/4  c. green olives
8  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients and simmer 10 minutes.  Add red chili beans.  Pour in 8 x 8-inch dish; cover with remaining ingredients in order.  Bake at 350° to melt the cheese.

name: CHOCOLATE CANDY
ingredients:
1 1/2  boxes powdered sugar
1  can condensed milk
1  stick butter, melted
1  box coconut
2  c. walnuts or almonds
1  tsp. vanilla or almond extract
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and chill. Melt in double boiler 1/3 to 1/2 block paraffin wax, 1 large package chocolate chips and 1 large package milk chocolate chips.  Take out preparation and roll into walnut-sized balls. Dip candy into chocolate mixture and place on wax paper.

name: RICE A LA MALTA(Swedish Recipe)
ingredients:
2  c. cold cooked rice
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. whipping cream, whipped
1/2  c. slivered, blanched almonds
1 1/3  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine all ingredients, folding together gently.  Chill completely.  Serves 6 to 8. May be served with raspberry or strawberry sauce.  Canned mandarin oranges is my favorite.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE OR PEACH PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. strawberry jello
1  c. water
dash of red food coloring
preparation: Boil until thickened and clear.  Cool.  Put in graham cracker shell or regular pie shell.  Refrigerate.  Serve with whipped cream or soft ice cream.

name: BRAZILIAN BLACK BEANS
ingredients:
5  c. black beans
1  lb. smoked beef sausage
1/2  lb. smoked pork shoulder or Canadian bacon
2  large onions, chopped
3  garlic cloves, crushed
salt to taste
preparation: Wash beans and pick over.  Cover with water; soak overnight. Slice meats; add to beans with rest of ingredients.  Add more water if not completely covered.  Bring to boil.  Lower heat and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until beans are te nder.  Remove 1 cup of the beans and puree in blender or food processor.  Return to pot.  Add water if beans are too thick or dry.  Bring to simmer; cook for 5 minutes.  Serve with rice; garnish with orange slices.

name: ONE BOWL BROWNIES
ingredients:
4  sq. Baker's unsweetened chocolate
3/4  c. margarine
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Microwave chocolate and margarine 2 minutes on High or until margarine is melted.  Stir until chocolate is completely melted.  Stir sugar into chocolate.   Mix in eggs and vanilla until well blended.  Stir in flour and nuts. Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out with fudgy crumbs.  Cool in pan.  Cut into squares.

name: MAPLE HAM
ingredients:
1  ham slice, 1 1/4 to 1 1/2-inches thick
cloves
1  c. maple syrup
preparation: Cut off excess fat.  Stud the meat with cloves every inch or two.   Place in greased baking pan the same size as ham slice. Pour syrup over. Bake, uncovered, in 300° oven for 1 hour or until meat is very tender.  Baste occasionally.  Easy.  Serves 2 to 3.

name: DARLIN' STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3  c. water
chili powder to taste
1  beef bouillon cube
4  potatoes, large cube
3  carrots, sliced
3  celery stalks, chopped
1 large  can chopped tomatoes or can of Ro-Tel
Worcestershire sauce to taste
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Put browned beef in large stew pot.  Add all ingredients at once and cook on low simmer for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, until potatoes are tender.  Can add other vegetables, corn, cauliflower, green beans, okra and broccoli.  Serve with corn bread.

name: JUDY KNIGHT'S CHAFING DISH MEATBALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground chuck
1  slightly beaten egg
1  large grated onion
1  bottle chili sauce
1/2  jar large grape jelly
juice of 1 lemon
salt to taste
preparation: Combine chuck, egg, onion and salt.  Shape into 50 or 60 small balls. Combine chili sauce, jelly and lemon juice in a skillet. Simmer meatballs in mixture until brown. Serve warm.

name: APPLE CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. pure vegetable oil
3  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  c. shredded carrots
1  c. coarsely chopped apple
1  c. golden raisins
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients in large bowl.  Blend thoroughly. Sift together dry ingredients.  Add to first mixture and mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients.  Pour into 2 greased and wax papered 9-inch cake pans.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes, until center of cake is firm to touch.  Cool in pans for 10 minutes.  Remove from pans and finish cooling on cake racks. Frost with Pecan Cream Cheese Frosting.

name: VEGETABLE BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1/4  c. corn oil
2  cloves garlic, minced
3  ribs celery, chopped
2  lb. ham hocks or ham bone
1  bay leaf
2  whole, peeled potatoes
1/3  c. chopped parsley
2  onions, chopped
4  carrots, chopped
3  qt. water
1  lb. navy or pea beans, soaked and drained
2  tomatoes, peeled and chopped
salt and pepper
preparation: Heat oil in large kettle.  Cook onions and garlic over medium heat until onions are soft.  Add carrots.  Continue cooking and stirring.  Add water, ham bone, beans, bay leaf and potatoes. Bring mixture to a boil; reduce heat and simmer, covered, about two hours, or until beans are tender.

name: ZESTY ITALIAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  to 8 chicken breasts
1 (16 oz.)  bottle Zesty Italian dressing
salt to taste
preparation: Place chicken in a baking dish.  Add salt and dressing.  Cover with foil and bake in a 400° oven for 45 minutes.  Remove foil; baste and bake chicken until lightly brown.  Serve over rice if desired.

name: CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, torn into pieces
1  head cauliflower, cut into pieces
1 (8 oz)  pkg. shredded cheddar cheese
bacon bits
2  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. dry ranch dressing mix
preparation: Mix mayo and ranch dressing mix and set aside.  In large bowl layer the following in order - lettuce, cauliflower, mayonnaise mixture, cheese and bacon.  Cover and refrigerate for several hours.  Toss before serving.

name: OLD CANTON CAFE EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
1  qt. milk
6  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
dab of butter
nutmeg
preparation: Mix sugar, milk and butter; let steam, but nut boil.  Beat eggs with fork; stir into milk mixture.  Add vanilla.  Pour into baking dish.  Sprinkle top with nutmeg.  Bake at 325° until inserted knife comes out clean.

name: SAUSAGE AND RICE BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
3  c. hot, cooked rice
1/2  c. milk
4  oz. can mushrooms
2  tsp. Creole mustard
2  c. cheese
3  eggs, beaten
1  can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1/4  tsp. onion powder
preparation: Fry out and drain sausage.  Mix all ingredients together, saving 1/2 cup cheese  for	topping.  Top  with  reserved cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CAPE COD LOBSTER NEWBURG
ingredients:
2  c. cooked lobster
1/4  c. butter
1/2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. sherry
1/2  c. cream
salt and pepper
2  egg yolks, beaten
paprika
preparation: Cut lobster into bite size pieces; toss in flour.  Saute in butter for 3 minutes.   Add wine; cook for 1 minute.  Add cream, salt and pepper.   Add egg yolks and stir.  Cook just under boiling point until thick.  If allowed to bubble, Newburg may break.  Serve on golden brown toast.

name: VELVEETA DIP
ingredients:
2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  lb. hot sausage
1  small onion, grated
1 (10 oz.)  can green chilies with tomatoes
chili powder to taste
preparation: Brown sausage and onion together. Add cheese and green tomatoes with chilies and heat over very low heat until cheese is melted. Stir often. Add chili powder. Eat with snack crackers.

name: CRAB PUFFS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  jar Old English cheese spread
1 (8 oz.)  can crabmeat
1/4  c. butter or margarine, softened
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
10  English muffins, halved
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients.   Blend well.   Spread about 2 tablespoons of cheese mixture on each muffin half.  Place on baking sheets.   Cover and place in freezer.  When you are ready to serve them, take out of freezer and cut into 8 pieces and broil 5 to 7 minutes or until crisp.

name: PEACH JELLO
ingredients:
1  large peach jello
1  small crushed pineapple
1/4  c. sugar
2  c. buttermilk
1 (12 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients together and bring to a boil.  Cool, then add the buttermilk and Cool Whip.  Put in Pyrex dish which has been sprayed with Pam.  Sprinkle chopped nuts on top and refrigerate until firm.
