name: POPPY SEED DRESSING FOR FRESH FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. honey
1  tsp. salt
1  medium onion, cut up
3/4  Tbsp. poppy seed
2  c. Wesson oil
dash of pepper
preparation: Blend all ingredients (except poppy seed) in blender. Stir in seed. Keeps 2 to 3 months.

name: MEXICAN RICE
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked regular white rice
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  medium onion, finely chopped
1  medium green pepper, finely chopped
2  tsp. chili powder
2  tsp. salt
1  c. canned tomatoes
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Wash and dry rice between towels.  Heat shortening in heavy skillet over medium heat (325° to 350°) on controlled burner.  Add onion.  Cook, stirring frequently, until rice is browned and onion is tender.  Add remaining ingredients.   Cover and bring to a boil; reduce to low heat (175° to 200°).  Cook for 30 minutes. Makes about 6 servings.

name: PARMESAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. Italian seasoned bread crumbs
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/3  tsp. salt
4  boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients in large Ziploc bag. One at a time, dip chicken breast in buttermilk, then place in bag and shake to coat. Place in pan coated with nonstick spray. Cover and bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake for 20 minutes more.

name: FIVE CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. mandarin oranges
1  c. pineapple tidbits
1  c. coconut
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Drain oranges and pineapple. Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Chill before serving.

name: HEARTY ROAST AND VEGETABLES
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3  lb. beef chuck roast
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. dried marjoram leaves
1/4  tsp. celery seed
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
1/2  c. water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen Brussels sprouts
4  medium carrots, cut into 3 x 1/2-inch strips
2  medium potatoes, cut into 1-inch slices
2  medium turnips, cut into eighths
1  medium onion, sliced
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Trim excess fat from beef. Rub Dutch oven with fat cut from beef; cook beef in Dutch oven until brown. Sprinkle with seasoned salt, marjoram, celery seed, pepper and garlic; add water. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (1 lb.)  cans cut green beans, drained
3/4  c. milk
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/8  tsp. Durkee ground black pepper
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
preparation: Combine beans, milk, soup, pepper and 1/2 can of French fried onions; pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer.  Makes 6 servings.

name: BEEF BARBECUE CUPS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. barbecue sauce
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1 to 2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 (10 count)  can refrigerator biscuits
shredded cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Grease 10 muffin cups.  Brown ground beef; drain.  Stir in barbecue sauce, onion and brown sugar.  Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.  Separate dough and press in bottom and sides of prepared pan, forming a 1/4-inch rim.  Spoon 1/4 cup meat mixture into each cup.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes, until golden brown.  Cool 1 minute; remove from pans.  Serves 10.

name: CORN FRITTERS *
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. sugar
2  c. (12 oz. can) whole kernel corn, drained
1  Tbsp. melted shortening
1/2  c. milk
1  egg, slightly beaten
preparation: Mix and sift flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.  Beat egg, melted shortening and milk together.  Add corn to dry ingredients, then add to egg mixture.  Mix well.  Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and fry until golden brown.  Drain.  Makes about 12 fritters.

name: OATMEAL MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. quick-cooking oats (uncooked)
1  c. buttermilk
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Combine oats and buttermilk in a large bowl.  Let stand one hour.  Add egg, sugar and oil, stirring well.  Combine remaining ingredients, except raisins, in a medium bowl.  Add to oats mixture, stirring just until moistened.  Stir in raisins.  Spoon into greased muffin pans, filing 3/4 full.  Bake at 400° for about 18 minutes.  Yield: 18 muffins.

name: CLAM QUICHE
ingredients:
2  regular pie shells or 1 deep dish
1/2  lb. bacon, cooked and crumbled
1 (15 oz.)  can Snow's clam chowder
4  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. sour cream
2  tsp. parsley flakes
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Bake pie shell at 400° for 8 minutes and remove.  Reduce oven to 325°.  Combine bacon, chowder, eggs, onion, sour cream, flakes and pepper.  Pour in shell.  Add cheese.  Bake 50 to 55 minutes. Wait 20 minutes before serving.

name: FOUR LAYER CHERRY CHEESE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 1/2  sticks butter
1 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  c. plain flour
3/4  c. pecans
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  small Cool Whip
2  pkg. cherry pie filling or 1 can cherry pie filling
preparation: Mix butter, sugar, flour and pecans; spread with fingers in pan and bake until light brown at 350° for about 15 minutes.

name: PINK LEMONADE PIE(Low-Fat Recipe)
ingredients:
1  c. evaporated skim milk
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
2  Tbsp. water
1 (6 oz.)  can pink lemonade, defrosted
1 (8 oz.)  carton low-fat lemon yogurt
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. grated lemon rind
6  drops red food coloring
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  (9-inch) pie shell, baked and cooled
preparation: Place evaporated milk in a plastic bowl in freezer just until ice crystals begin to form around edges.  Let gelatin and water stand in a large glass measuring cup for 5 minutes for gelatin to soften.  Stir in lemonade concentrate.  Heat in small saucepan over medium-high heat (or in microwave on High for 3 minutes) to dissolve gelatin.  Set aside for 5 minutes to cool.

name: MEXICAN SALSA SALAD
ingredients:
3  oz. cooked elbow macaroni
1  c. chunky salsa
1  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1  tsp. chili powder
4  oz. drained pinto beans
3  oz. diced Monterey Jack cheese
12  large olives (black), sliced
preparation: Mix ingredients and chill before serving.

name: SAUSAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
1  sheet frozen puff pastry
1  lb. seasoned sausage meat
preparation: Thaw pastry 20 minutes.  On a lightly floured surface, roll to a 15 1/2 x 9-inch rectangle.  Cut into 3 strips, each 3-inches wide.  Divide sausage meat into thirds; roll each into a "snake" the length of the pastry.  Place each roll along one edge of a pastry strip.  Roll the pastry around the sausage.  Wet edges with ice water and press and seal tightly.  Chill the rolls for 1 hour. Cut sausage rolls into 3/4-inch slices; placed on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake for 12 minutes or until pastry is puffed and golden.  Serve warm.  Makes about 60 hors d'oeuvres.

name: SMOKY CHEESE-OLIVE SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  (6 oz.) roll process cheese food with hickory smoke flavor, softened
1/4  c. sliced pimiento-stuffed green olives
assorted crackers
preparation: Advance preparation:  Line a 2-cup mold or bowl with clear plastic wrap or foil.  Beat cheeses together until well blended; stir in olives.  Turn into mold.  Chill 4 hours or overnight.

name: ICE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. crushed filled Oreo cookies
1/4  c. melted butter
2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. sugar
2/3  c. evaporated milk
vanilla ice cream
preparation: Mix and bake for 10 minutes at 350° the crushed Oreo cookies and 1/4 cup melted butter.

name: THE NEXT BEST THING TO ROBERT REDFORD
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. butter
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1  large container Cool Whip
1 large  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1 large  pkg. chocolate instant pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: Combine the first three ingredients and press into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Cool.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
16  oz onion dip
2-8 oz cream cheese
1  1/2 lb browned hamburger
1  pkg taco seasoning
1/3  c water
shredded lettuce
diced tomato
shredded cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix onion dip and cream cheese, place in a 9x13 pan.  Brown hamburger and add taco seasoning and water, simmer for 5 minutes. Let cool.  Put on top of cream cheese, top with cheddar cheese, shredded lettuce and tomatoes.  Chill and serve with corn chips.

name: CREAMY COLE SLAW
ingredients:
4  c. cabbage, shredded
1/2  c. finely sliced celery
1/4  c. finely sliced green pepper
1/4  c. chopped carrot
2  Tbsp. finely sliced green onion
3/4  c. sour cream
3  Tbsp. vinegar
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. celery seed
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients together.  Mix remaining ingredients well and pour over cabbage.  Mix lightly and refrigerate.

name: VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
5  to 6 stalks celery, diced
3  carrots, diced
1  medium onion, chopped
1  parsnip, sliced
1  turnip, sliced
3  to 4 sprigs parsley, chopped
1  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  qt. chicken broth
1/2  c. barley
preparation: Saute celery, carrots and onions in olive oil (about 5 minutes).  Add parsley.  Sprinkle with seasonings (Italian and garlic).  Add parsnip and turnip.  Saute lightly (about 3 minutes).  Add broth and simmer until vegetables are tender (20 plus minutes).  Add barley and cook until tender (about 10 minutes).

name: ORANGE JULIUS - BREAKFAST ON THE RUN
ingredients:
6  oz. can (1/3 c.) frozen orange juice concentrate
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
5  or 6 ice cubes
preparation: Combine all ingredients in blender container. Cover and blend until smooth, about 30 seconds.  Serve immediately.  Makes about 3 cups.

name: BLOODY MARY'S
ingredients:
3/4  c. Worcestershire
1  tsp. white pepper
1  tsp. onion salt
1  tsp. celery salt
3  beef bouillon cubes
2  Tbsp. horseradish
3  qt. tomato juice
2 1/2  c. water
1  fifth vodka
preparation: Boil first 6 ingredients 10 minutes and simmer.  Add tomato juice, water and vodka.  Makes 1 gallon.

name: SUN BUNDT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. butter recipe yellow cake mix
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange Jell-O instant vanilla pudding
3/4  c. Wesson oil
3/4  c. water
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. butter extract
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. chopped pecans
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Beat first 4 ingredients well.  Add eggs one at a time.  Add vanilla and butter extract.  Mix sugar, pecans and cinnamon in a small bowl.  Stir well and add to batter.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour or until done.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. smooth peanut butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/3  c. butter
2  beaten eggs
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
preparation: Cream the peanut butter and sugar.  Add beaten eggs.  Stir in vanilla.  Add dry ingredients alternately with milk.  Beat well. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased cake pan.  Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.  Cool.

name: MEXICAN DINNER
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  jar taco sauce (hot or mild)
1  can enchilada sauce (hot or mild)
1  can chopped green peppers (optional)
1  block cheese (Cheddar or Colby)
1  bag nacho cheese chips
2 to 3  lb. ground meat
preparation: Brown ground meat.  Drain.  Add all canned ingredients to meat.  Grate cheese.  Layer in a large dish: chips, meat sauce and cheese.  Microwave until cheese melts.

name: SOUR CREAM SQUASH
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow squash
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. sugar
7  Tbsp. butter, divided use
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. sour cream
1 1/2  c. grated New York Cheddar sharp
1/3  c. grated Romano cheese
1/4  c. dry white wine
1  c. dry bread crumbs
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cut squash into 1/4-inch slices.  Bring 2 cups of water to a boil; add squash, salt and sugar. Cover saucepan and cook over moderate  heat  20	minutes  or until tender.  Meanwhile, melt 4 tablespoons  of  butter  in a small skillet.  Add onion and cook until  transparent;  set aside.  When squash is done, drain, pressing to  force out  excess  liquid.  Stir onion and butter into the  squash.  One at a time, add the Cheddar, sour cream, Romano, white wine and salt and pepper to taste, mixing thoroughly after  each  addition.  Pour  mixture  into a large casserole or individual ramekins.

name: QUICK TOMATO-PEPPER SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  small sweet red pepper, cored, seeded and cut into chunks
1  green onion top, cut into 1-inch lengths
1 (8 oz.)  can low-sodium tomato sauce
4  drops red hot pepper sauce
preparation: In a blender or food processor, whirl the sweet red pepper, onion, tomato sauce and red pepper sauce fo 2 minutes or until smooth.  Makes about 1 cup.

name: CHEESECAKE BROWNIES(Makes 24 Large Brownies)
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines brownie mix (family size)
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs (total in recipe)
1/2  c. water
preparation: Cheese	Layer:	Allow  cream  cheese  to soften at room temperature.  Mix  cream  cheese,  sugar, 1 egg and vanilla in small bowl until well blended.  Set aside.

name: CREAM CHEESE OMELET
ingredients:
4  eggs
milk
cream cheese
butter or margarine
salt and pepper
ketchup (optional)
preparation: Whip eggs with a little milk until frothy.  Add 7 lumps of cream cheese and mix in lightly.  Pour into frying pan containing sizzling butter or margarine.  Stir lightly while cooking until egg mixture is soft and cream cheese is melted into eggs.  Do not overcook.  Place on large plate.  Add salt, pepper and ketchup to taste.  Serves 3 or 4.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising meal
1  c. cream-style corn
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1/2  c. cooking oil
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
1  c. sweet milk
preparation: Pour oil in deep mixing bowl.  Add milk, then meal.  Stir, then add corn, pepper and onion.  Mix well.  Last, add cheese and mix.  Bake at 425° until brown, about 30 minutes.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. butter
4  c. plain flour, sifted
2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. soda
10  eggs
flavoring of choice
preparation: Cream butter.  Add sugar; mix until not grainy.  Beat eggs until lemon color.  Add sugar and butter.  Beat at high speed 10 minutes.  Sift flour and soda.  Add to eggs mixture small amounts at a time.  Grease a tube cake pan.  Pour batter in pan and bake at 250° until a straw inserted comes out clean.

name: SILK PIE
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  c. confectioners sugar
1  (8 oz.) whipped cream
2  cans fruit topping
2  pie shells, baked and cooled
preparation: Mix cream cheese and confectioners sugar together, then add whipped cream.  Chill in pie shell.  Later add fruit on top. Recipe makes 2 pies and takes 2 cans of fruit topping.

name: WHITE CHOCOLATE CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
5  Tbsp. melted butter
1 to 2  Tbsp. sugar
2  lb. cream cheese (room temperature)
1/2  c. butter (room temperature)
4  eggs (room temperature)
10  oz. white chocolate, melted
4 1/2  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix graham cracker crumbs, melted butter and sugar in large bowl.  Press into bottom and sides of 9-inch spring-form pan. Refrigerate.

name: CORN RELISH
ingredients:
2  qt. fresh corn kernels
3  c. cider vinegar
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. chopped red pepper
1  c. chopped celery
1  Tbsp. pickling salt
1  Tbsp. mustard seed
2  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. turmeric
1  clove garlic, minced
preparation: In a large saucepan, cover corn with water.  Bring to boiling. Simmer 5 minutes.  Drain.

name: BROCCOLI CHEEZ WHIZ RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup with 1/2 can water
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1 1/2  c. uncooked Minute rice
1/2  c. onions, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  stick margarine
preparation: Thaw broccoli and place in a large mixing bowl with soup and water.  Stir in Cheez Whiz and rice.  Add onions and celery with salt and pepper.  Pour into baking dish and cut margarine into chunks and place over top.  Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. refrigerated sliceable peanut butter cookie dough
1  (8 oz.) container cream cheese (with pineapple)
1 (5.4 oz.)  box dried fruit snack mix
1/2  c. flaked coconut
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Press cookie dough evenly onto an ungreased 12-inch pizza pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 22 minutes or until done.  Cool 5 minutes. Spread gently with cream cheese and sprinkle with fruit mix, coconut and marshmallows. Bake 8 additional minutes or until marshmallows are lightly browned.  Cool on a wire rack.

name: LAZY DAY LASAGNA
ingredients:
8  oz. lasagna noodles
1/4  tsp. oregano
13 to 18  oz. jar spaghetti sauce
1  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
1  c. cottage cheese
16  oz. pkg. Mozzarella cheese, grated
preparation: Cook noodles as directed and drain.  Add browned meat and oregano to spaghetti sauce.

name: OVEN CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1 (4.7 oz.)  pkg. Rice-A-Roni (chicken and vegetable flavor)
1 3/4  c. water
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1  (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) broiler-fryer chicken, cut up
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Combine rice-pasta mix, seasoning packet, water and soup in 11 x 7-inch glass baking dish.  Mix well with wire whisk or fork.  Arrange chicken on top of rice mixture.  Bake 1 hour or until juices run clear when chicken is pierced with a fork.

name: PEPPERONI PIZZA CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
1 (15 oz.)  can pizza sauce
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can Italian stewed tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 1/2  c. water
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. sliced pepperoni
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  tsp. salt
cheese
preparation: Cook the beef and drain. Stir in the beans, pizza sauce, tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, pepperoni, pepper and salt. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Serve over Fritos chips. Garnish with cheese.

name: JESSICA'S POTATOES
ingredients:
10  medium size potatoes, cooled with skin on, peeled and grated
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  stick margarine
1/2  pt. sour cream
preparation: Mix all the ingredients together.  Put into a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish (glass is okay).  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: COCA-COLA PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
1/2  c. ketchup
2  liter cola
6  pork chops
preparation: Wash pork chops.  Lay in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan.  Mix ketchup and 1/2 cup cola; stir until blended.  Pour over pork chops.  Cover pork chops thoroughly with cola.  Cook in oven at 350° until tender.

name: BEEF AND BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
onions
green peppers
1  can pork and beans
1  can kidney beans
1  can tomatoes
1  can tomato soup
1  can mushrooms, diced
preparation: Brown the ground beef in skillet with onions and green peppers.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Pat in baking dish.  Bake until bubbling hot.  Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese; bake about 5 minutes.

name: OAT CRUST
ingredients:
1  c. rolled oats
1/4  c. whole wheat flour
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. melted butter or margarine
preparation: Mix all together well. Press into bottom and sides of pie pan. Add filling and bake. For an unbaked pie crust, bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes. Cool slightly; add filling. For cheesecake; press into bottom of spring form pan. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes. Cool, then add filling. This is a good crunchy pie crust or as a topping for fruit crisp. Makes 1 crust.

name: 100 SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. margarine or soft butter
1  c. vegetable oil
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. each: salt, soda and cream of tartar
4 1/4  c. flour
preparation: Cream together the sugars, margarine, oil, eggs, vanilla, salt, soda and cream of tartar.  Add flour, one cup at a time, beating after adding each cup.  Roll dough into small balls or drop by teaspoon.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Press down each cookie ball with the bottom of a glass, dipping glass in melted margarine and then in sugar.   Bake at 350°, about 10 minutes or until light golden brown on edge.

name: CHEESY POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
3  c. potatoes
1/2  c. carrots
1  c. water
1  tsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/2  c. celery
1/4  c. onion
1 1/2  c. milk
1  chicken bouillon cube
2  Tbsp. flour
dash of pepper
preparation: Peel potatoes and cut in cubes; slice celery and carrots.  Chop onion and put all in cooking pot.  Add water, parsley, bouillon, salt and pepper.  Cook until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes.  Mix together milk and flour.  Add to pot and cook until thick.  Cut cheese into cubes and add to soup mixture.  Cook until cheese melts.

name: BEEF BOURGUIGNON
ingredients:
2  oz. salt pork
12  small white onions
2  lb. round steak, cut into 2-inch cubes
2  Tbsp. flour
1/8  tsp. marjoram
1/8  tsp. thyme
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. Burgundy
1  c. beef bouillon
8  oz. mushrooms, sliced
preparation: Render salt pork in saucepan.  Add onions.  Saute until brown. Add beef.  Cook until brown.  Sprinkle with flour, marjoram, thyme, salt and pepper; mix well.  Stir in wine and bouillon. Simmer for 4 to 5 hours.  Add mushrooms.  Cook for 45 minutes longer.  May reserve sauteed onions and add with mushrooms.  May bake in oven at 250° until done to taste.  Serve with hot noodles, rice or small potatoes.  Yield:  6 servings.

name: GINGER CRINKLES
ingredients:
3/4  c. margarine
1  c. brown sugar
2 1/4  c. flour
1  egg
1/4  c. molasses
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cloves
preparation: Beat together margarine and brown sugar, add egg and molasses. Sift dry ingredients together and mix well.  Chill 1 hour.  Make into small ball and roll in granulated sugar.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Cool on rack.

name: PINEAPPLE DELITE
ingredients:
1  carton Cool Whip
1 large  can crushed pineapple, undrained
1  box lemon jello
preparation: Add pineapple to jello and heat.  Cool to room temperature. Fold in Cool Whip.  Chill well at least 30 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: WHITE RICES(Serves 4)
ingredients:
3  c. rice
1  Tbsp. oil
salt to taste
3  c. water
preparation: Put water in pan.  Bring to a boil.  Add oil and salt and cook until done.  Serve with chicken or beef.

name: BLONDE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1 1/3  sticks oleo
1  box brown sugar
2  eggs
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Melt oleo in 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Pour melted butter into mixing bowl.  Add sugar, eggs, flour, baking powder and nuts.  Mix together.  Pour mix into baking dish and sprinkle chocolate chips on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CREAMY COLESLAW
ingredients:
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. sour cream
1/4  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. seasoned salt
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1/2  tsp. mustard
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. slaw
preparation: Mix all ingredients well, except slaw. Add slaw to mixture and stir. Refrigerate.

name: CATHEDRAL CANDY
ingredients:
4  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1/2  c. butter
1  pkg. colored marshmallows
1  c. pecans
1  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Melt  chocolate  and  butter  over low heat; cool.  Add marshmallows  and  nuts  to  chocolate.  Shape in rolls, 1 1/2 inches  in  diameter.  Roll  in coconut.  Refrigerate in foil. Slice in 1/2-inch slices.

name: BOURBON BONS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. ketchup
1  c. whiskey
2  pkg. Smok-Y-Links wieners, cut into 1/4-inch
preparation: Cook at low heat for 3 hours.  Do not uncover.  Serve in chafing dish.

name: CHERRY OPERA FUDGE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3  Tbsp. milk
1  pkg. our creamy white frosting mix
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. candied cherry halves
preparation: Butter loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch).  In top of double boiler, melt butter in milk.  Stir in frosting mix (dry) until smooth. Heat over rapidly boiling water 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in nuts and cherries.  Spread mixture evenly in pan.  Let stand until firm.  Cut into 1-inch squares.  Makes 32.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Add shortening.  Mix with a fork.  Add eggs and vanilla; mix well.  Roll out dough very thin on floured board.  Use floured cookie cutters.  Place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 8 minutes.  Cool and frost.

name: PUFF PANCAKES
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter, melted
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs, slightly beaten
touch of grated nutmeg
powdered sugar
1/2  lemon
marmalade or jams
preparation: Melt butter in skillet.  In mixing bowl, combine flour, milk, eggs and touch of grated nutmeg.  Do not beat too much.  Scrape mixture into skillet.  Put in 425° oven for 15 or 20 minutes. Sprinkle xx sugar on top.  Squeeze 1/2 lemon over all.  Serve with marmalade or jams, lingonberries on top are best.

name: E Z BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. butter
1  c. sugar
4  c. flour
preparation: Mix butter until very, very soft.  Add sugar and beat until well blended.  Add flour slowly until well blended.  Press evenly onto two cookie sheets.  When still warm, cut into sticks.  You can press chopped nuts or sesame seed onto top before baking. Bake at 350° until very light brown.  Watch them as they brown very quickly.

name: MARIE'S MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. chopped onion
3/4  c. oatmeal
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. milk
preparation: In bowl, combine all ingredients.  Shape into balls.  Put in a 10 x 10-inch baking dish.  Top with the following sauce.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple
12  oz. Cool Whip
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. chopped pecans
1 small  pkg. pistachio pudding mix (instant)
preparation: Do not drain pineapple.  Mix all together and chill.  May need to add a few drops of green food coloring.

name: PARTY MIX
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. vegetable oil
1 small  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch powder dressing mix (original)
2  lb. bag M&M's
1  jar dry roasted peanuts
1  box Honey Graham Chex or Golden Grahams cereal
1  box Crispix cereal
1  box Honey Nut cereal
1  bag gold fish
1  bag pretzel sticks
preparation: Mix oil and Hidden Valley Ranch in bowl; heat until warm in microwave.  Use 2 brown paper bags (double bag them); pour in all dry ingredients.  Pour oil mixture over and shake well.  Let it sit 2 to 3 hours and toss occasionally during that time.  Put M&M's in last.  Makes a lot.  Can be placed in Tupperware and frozen.

name: MARINATED BEANS
ingredients:
1  can cut green beans
1  can cut wax beans
1  can red kidney beans
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
1/3  c. oil
1  medium onion, chopped or ringed
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Drain all beans; mix together with other ingredients and chill.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  minced garlic clove
1  chopped onion
1  lb. ground beef
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  cans tomato paste (6 oz.)
3  c. hot water
1/2  lb. lasagna noodles, cooked and drained
1/2  lb. Ricotta or cottage cheese
1/2  lb. natural Swiss or Mozzarella cheese
preparation: In hot oil in heavy frypan, brown garlic and onion until soft.  Add beef.  Cook and stir until crumbly.  Mix in salt, pepper and tomato paste blended with hot water.  Simmer sauce uncovered for 30 minutes.  In shallow baking dish, put a thin layer of sauce, half the lasagna noodles, the Ricotta and thin slices of Swiss or Mozzarella.  Repeat with half the remaining sauce, the lasagna, the last of the sauce and Swiss or Mozzarella. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.  Leave out of oven 15 minutes and cut in squares.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: CREAM CANDY
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. syrup
1  c. milk
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, syrup, milk and salt.  Cook until it forms a soft ball.  Remove from heat; add butter and vanilla; set aside until lukewarm.  Beat until it thickens and is creamy.

name: TERIYAKI CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
5  lb. chicken wings
2  c. brown sugar
1 (10 oz.)  bottle teriyaki sauce
1/2 small  bottle lite soy sauce
8  oz. honey
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  In large bowl, stir together all ingredients except chicken wings.  Set aside.  In large roasting pan, bake chicken wings in oven for 45 minutes or until browned. Drain oil from pan.  Pour teriyaki sauce mixture over wings and bake for an additional hour, turning every 20 minutes until fork-tender.  Sauce will continue to thicken after wings are done. Makes about 60 pieces.

name: HOLIDAY GREEN SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  box lime jello
1  c. boiling water
16  large marshmallows
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/3  c. Miracle Whip
1 small  can crushed pineapple (not drained)
1  banana, chopped
1  tsp. lemon juice
1 small  can milk
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Dissolve the first 5 ingredients over medium heat, then cool. Add the remaining ingredients; mix together.  Pour into mold. Chill overnight.

name: MEATLESS SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. olive oil
1  medium onion, finely chopped
1  small dried hot red chili, crushed
1 or 2  cloves garlic, minced or pressed
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can Italian-style tomatoes
1  Tbsp. capers
1/4  tsp. oregano leaves
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/4  c. slivered ripe olives
little garlic powder for more flavor
preparation: Heat olive oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat.  Add onion and chili and cook until onion is soft.  Mix in garlic, tomatoes with their liquid (break up with spoon), tomato sauce, olives, capers and oregano.  Adjust heat so that mixture boils gently.  Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until sauce is slightly thickened (15 to 20 minutes).  Use over spaghetti or any pasta.

name: UNCLE TERRY'S TOO-GOOD TOMATO GRAVY
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  sticks oleo
1  lb. mild sausage (fried & drained)
1  lb. quality bacon (fried & drained)
3  (16 oz) diced stewed tomatoes
kitchen bouquet (enough to darken gravy)
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Fry & drain bacon and sausage.  Add sugar, tomatoes, and 1 cup water (you may cut water back to 3/4 c. and add 1 can rotel tomatoes if you want a little kick to your gravy).  Make up your rue and add to this mixture.  Add enough kitchen bouquet to give it a rich gravy color then add lawry's seasoned salt & pepper to taste.

name: DELUXE MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  box elbow macaroni
2  c. cream-style cottage cheese
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  egg, slightly beaten
3/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  c. (8 oz.) sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
paprika (topping)
preparation: Cook macaroni per package directions.  Rinse and set aside. Combine the next 6 ingredients; add macaroni and stir well.  Spoon into lightly greased 2-quart casserole.  Sprinkle with paprika and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Yield:  6 to 8 servings.

name: CATFISH CHOWDER
ingredients:
fish
potatoes
onions
pepper
salt
butter
tomatoes
preparation: Boil catfish until tender;  take  out all bones. To your broth, add cubed potatoes, onions, butter, tomatoes, pepper and salt.  Let all simmer for an  hour  or  more.  Then  serve with crackers.   The  amount of  these  ingredients  may  be  varied according to the number of people you want to serve.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. broccoli, chopped
3  boiled eggs
7  oz. diced green salad olives
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can water chestnuts or artichokes
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix ingredients together and refrigerate overnight. Serve next day chilled.

name: STROGANOFF STYLE PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
4  boneless butterfly pork chops 1 inch thick
2  tbsp vegetable oil
1  large chopped onion
8  fresh mushrooms sliced
1/2  c. water
2  tsp mustard
1/2  tsp salt
1  tbsp flour
1/2  c. sour cream
3  c. hot cooked egg noodles
preparation: In a large skillet on medium heat brown pork in oil for 5 minutes.  Remove; keep warm.  In the drippings sauté onion and mushrooms until tender, stir in water, mustard and salt; bring to boil.  Return chops to pan; reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, until chops are tender.  Remove and keep warm.  Combine flour and sour cream until smooth; add to skillet.  Bring to a boil; cook and stir 1-2 minutes or until thicken.  Serve pork chops and mushroom sauce with noodles.

name: HOBO STEW
ingredients:
1  can whole potatoes
1  can peas
1  can carrots
1  can zucchini
1  can corn
1  can string beans
1  can mushrooms
1  can whole tomatoes
1  can beef bouillon
3/4  c. ketchup
1 or 2  Tbsp. Old Bay seasoning
2  lb. ground beef or beef cubes
salt and pepper
1  stalk celery, chopped
3  or 4 banana peppers
1  medium, chopped onion
preparation: Mix and cook until done.

name: JEWISH APPLE CAKE(Yields 12 Servings)
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
3  apples
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Beat eggs and gradually add sugar and oil.  Mix dry ingredients together.  Add to egg mixture.  Then add vanilla.  Fold in sliced apples and chopped nuts.  Put into greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Sprinkle 2 teaspoons of sugar and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon on top. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.  Recipe may be doubled and put in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

name: RED DEVIL'S FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour (all-purpose)
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. water
2  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. shortening (Spry or Crisco)
1 3/4  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs, separated
3/4  c. sour milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Add cocoa and soda to water; let stand until rest of cake is mixed.  Cream butter and sugar gradually.  Add well beaten egg yolks.  Add sifted flour alternately with milk.  Add cocoa mixture.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.  Add vanilla.  Pour into well greased loaf or layer cake pans and bake in 350° oven. Frost with fudge frosting.

name: MEATBALLS ON CRISP NOODLES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1 1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. frozen pea pods
1  small red pepper, chopped (1/2 c.)
1  tsp. beef bouillon
3/4  tsp. salt
chow mein noodles
preparation: Mix ground beef, soy sauce and ginger.  Shape by rounded tablespoonfuls into balls.  Cook and stir meatballs in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat until brown, about 15 minutes; drain.

name: BREAKFAST BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
2  Tbsp. Crisco
1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Combine flour and Crisco until crumbly.  Add buttermilk.  Mix until smooth and flour as needed.  Knead into a ball and roll out on floured surface.  Cut in small biscuits and bake at 400° until brown.

name: CHOCOLATE-COCONUT DROPS
ingredients:
2 (1 oz.)  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1 (15 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
2  c. flaked coconut
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Melt chocolate in saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat and stir in sweetened condensed milk, coconut and walnuts.

name: CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1 2/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
5  Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. milk
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
2  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Chill dough.  Drop by spoonfuls or roll into balls.  Roll in powdered sugar.  Put on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Don't overbake; will look wet on top.

name: CRANBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
1  qt. bottle cranberry juice
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
2  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Mash ice cream and pour juice over it.  Add ginger ale and serve.

name: SAND TARTS
ingredients:
1  c. pecans
1 1/2  sticks butter or margarine
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. ice water
2  c. cake flour
confectioners sugar
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add flour, nuts and other ingredients, except confectioners sugar.  Mix well.  Pinch off small bits and roll into finger shape pieces.  Bake in very slow oven (300°).  Do not brown.  When done, remove and roll in confectioners sugar while still warm.

name: CREAMY PEACH PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. diced fresh peaches or drained canned peaches
1/2  c. creamed cottage cheese
1/2  c. low-fat plain yogurt
1  Tbsp. honey
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Arrange fruit in the bottom of a shallow 1-quart serving dish. Place remaining ingredients in an electric blender.  Cover and blend at medium speed, 10 seconds or until smooth and creamy.  Pour sauce over fruit and stir gently to mix.  Cover and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.  Makes 4 servings.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
oil
ground meat
salt and pepper to taste
onion, cut up finely
celery, cut up finely
green peppers, cut up finely
garlic salt to taste
2  cans tomatoes
2  cans tomato paste
2  cans tomato sauce
pinch of sugar
1  to 2 bay leaves
sprinkle of oregano, basil and a little ketchup
preparation: Put enough oil in frying pan to coat the bottom.  Add ground meat and salt and pepper to taste.  Cut up onion finely and add to meat.  Cut up celery finely and add to meat.  Cut up green peppers finely and add to meat.  Sprinkle in garlic salt for taste.  Fry until meat loses redness.  Add tomatoes, tomato paste, tomato sauce and rinse cans with water.  Add pinch of sugar and bay leaves.  Sprinkle in oregano, basil and a little ketchup.  Simmer slowly all day.

name: WILD RICE CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked chicken
1  pkg. Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice
1  can cream of celery soup
1  jar pimentos
1  medium onion
1  can French-style green beans, drained
1  c. mayonnaise
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix up and place in casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: GINGERBREAD UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple slices, drained (reserve syrup)
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1  c. brown sugar, packed
10  maraschino cherries
1  egg
1/2  c. dark molasses
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Drain pineapple.  Reserve 1/2 cup syrup.  Melt 1/4 cup butter in a 10-inch ovenproof skillet.  Blend in 1/2 cup sugar.  Remove from heat.  Arrange pineapple in skillet.  Place cherry in center of each slice.  Cream remaining butter and sugar until light and fluffy.  Beat in egg and molasses.  Combine remaining ingredients. Bring reserved pineapple syrup to a boil.  Add flour mixture to creamed mixture alternately with hot syrup.  Pour batter over pineapple.  Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes, until cake tests done.  Cool in skillet 5 minutes.  Invert onto serving plate. Serves 6 to 8 people.

name: PINEAPPLE NUT CAKE
ingredients:
2 (20 oz.)  cans crushed pineapple
1  box yellow cake mix
3/4  c. pecans, chopped
2  sticks butter, cut into pieces
whipped cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spread the pineapple into a greased 10 x 12-inch pan.  Spread the cake mix over the pineapple; scatter the pecans over the cake mix and top with butter pieces.  Bake for 45 minutes.

name: ONE GALLON REFRIGERATOR PICKLES
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
4  c. vinegar
1/2  c. salt
1 1/3  tsp. turmeric
1 1/3  tsp. mustard seed
1 1/3  tsp. celery seed
3  onions, sliced very thin
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients and stir to dissolve.  Make alternate layers of onion and sliced cucumbers in gallon jar. When sugar is all dissolved, pour liquid over onion and cukes. Refrigerate for several days before using.  Keep in refrigerator. Will be good for several months.  These are very good.

name: HAMBURGER CHOWDER
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1  large onion
4  to 5 carrots, sliced
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  lb. ground meat
2  c. tomato juice
3  to 4 medium potatoes, diced
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/3  c. flour
1  qt. milk
preparation: Melt butter in a large saucepan or Dutch oven.  Add onion, carrots, celery and green pepper.  Cook until tender, but not too brown.  Add beef; cook until crumbly.  Stir in tomato juice, potatoes and seasonings.  Cover and cook over low heat until vegetables are tender, 20 to 30 minutes.  Combine flour with 1 cup milk.  Beat until free of lumps.  Stir into soup mixture.  Add remaining milk; heat, stirring frequently, but do not boil.  Makes 10 servings.

name: BIRDS' NEST PIE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  c. mashed potatoes
1/4  c. dry bread crumbs
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. shredded cheese
pepper to taste
preparation: Mix  thoroughly:  1/2  cup  soup,  beef, onion, egg and bread crumbs.  Press  firmly  into 9-inch pie plate.  Bake at 350°  for 25	minutes and spoon off fat.  Frost with potatoes and top with remaining soup and cheese.	Bake 10 minutes more.

name: CHEESE LOG
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. wafer beef, corned beef or ham
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  tsp. dried onion flakes
2  tsp. dried chive flakes
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce or A. 1. sauce
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all ingredients, using only 1 package of wafer meat which has been chopped.  Spoon onto a plate in a mound or make a log. Slice remaining meat in squares and cover mound or log.  Needs to be made a day or several hours before serving.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
chicken
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. melted butter
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Boil chicken until tender; remove from pot and cool.  Save broth.

name: PICKLED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  lb. whole fresh mushrooms
1/2  c. red wine vinegar
1/4  c. salad oil (use olive oil, if desired)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. Lawry's lemon pepper
1/2  tsp. Knorr-Swiss aromat seasoning (for meat)
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  clove garlic, cut in half or 1/8 tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Cut the stems off the mushrooms.  Wash and place in a saucepan and cover them with water.  Bring water to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. Drain immediately.  Put mushrooms in a quart jar and add all the remaining ingredients.  Refrigerate for several hours or longer, but remove garlic after 48 hours.  Can be stored in refrigerator for weeks.  Makes 36 or 5 cups.

name: LEMON BUNDT CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. butter or margarine
2 1/4  c. sugar
7  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
2 1/2  tsp. lemon or orange extract
preparation: Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs, one at a time.  Add flour all at once. Beat well. Add flavoring. Pour batter into greased Bundt cake pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

name: KAREN'S LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  tsp. minced garlic
1  (28 oz.) whole tomatoes
1  (6 oz.) tomato paste
3  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1/2  tsp. dried basil leaves
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  (16 oz.) small curd cottage cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  eggs
1  (16 oz.) cooked lasagna noodles
1  lb. Mozzarella cheese, coarsely grated
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In skillet, heat oil over moderate heat. Add beef, onion and garlic and cook 7 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally until meat is no longer pink.  Drain off any fat.  Add tomatoes, tomato liquid, tomato paste, 1 tablespoon of parsley, oregano, salt, basil and pepper to skillet.  Reduce heat to low and simmer about 1 hour, stirring occasionally, until thick. Meanwhile, in a medium size bowl, mix cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese, eggs and remaining 2 tablespoons parsley with a fork until well mixed.

name: BROCCOLI/CHICKEN/RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken tenders, cut into bite size
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. broccoli florets
1  c. quick Minute rice, uncooked
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can fiesta nacho soup
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  can small mushrooms
1  can sliced water chestnuts
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. mild cheddar cheese, shredded
1  (sleeve) saltines
preparation: Cook chicken in melted butter until no longer pink.  Cook broccoli according to package directions.  Mix rice, soups, sour cream, mushrooms, water chestnuts, cooked chicken and broccoli. Grease 9x13 baking dish.  Pour in ingredients.  Cook for 40 minutes at 350°.  Remove from oven.  Crush saltines and spread on top.  Place cheese on top of crackers.  Place back in oven for 5 minutes.  Serves 8.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. butter
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Grease and flour a tube pan. Cream butter and sugar together well. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each one. Then add dry ingredients one at a time, mixing in a third of the buttermilk after each one. Bake in a tube pan at 350° for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked sweet potatoes, mashed
2/3  c. sugar
1 small  can evaporated milk
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  egg
1/4  c. butter or margarine, softened
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour into an unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes or until brown and firm.

name: TEXAS STYLE LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1  pkg. (1 1/4 oz.) taco mix
1  can (14 1/2 oz.) diced tomatoes, undrained
1  can (15 oz.) tomato sauce
1  can (4 oz.) chopped green chilies
2  c. (16 oz.) small curd cottage cheese
2  eggs, beaten
12  corn tortillas
3 1/2 to 4  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: In a large skillet, brown meat; drain.  Add seasoned salt, taco seasoning mix, tomatoes, tomato sauce and chilies; mix well. Simmer uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes.  Combine cottage cheese and eggs.

name: RICE DISH
ingredients:
2  cut up fryers or pork chops (10 to 12)
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
2  c. rice, uncooked
2  cans celery soup
4  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
grated cheese (optional)
preparation: Mix rice, water, soup, onion mix, salt and pepper to taste. Place chicken or pork chops on mixture.  Sprinkle cheese on top. Cover and bake at 350° for 50 minutes.  Uncover and bake additional 10 minutes.

name: PEPPY TOMATO SLUSH
ingredients:
2  c. tomato juice or vegetable juice
2  Tbsp. lime or lemon juice
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. prepared horseradish
few drops bottled hot pepper sauce
celery sticks (for garnish; optional)
preparation: In a small pitcher, stir together tomato juice or vegetable juice, lime juice or lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, horseradish and hot pepper sauce.  Pour tomato mixture into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.  Cover and freeze for 1 to 2 hours or until slushy.  Spoon into glasses. If desired, garnish with celery sticks.  Makes 2 (8-ounce) servings.

name: CHINESE STYLE CHICKEN CURRY
ingredients:
1  pkg. skinless thighs or legs of chicken, chopped in half
2  cloves garlic
shredded ginger
1/2  onion
3  Tbsp. oil
dried chillies
1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2  tsp. sugar or 1/2 tsp. honey
1/2  gr. chilli
1  tomato, chopped
1/2  c. soy sauce
preparation: In a large pan or wok, brown oil, onion, dried chillies, garlic, salt, ginger and tomato.  Add some water and stir to make a soup.  Add chicken; cook completely over low heat.  Cover.  Add soy, sugar and Worcestershire sauce.  Stir.

name: RED HOTS
ingredients:
7  lb. cucumbers, peeled, sliced and seeded
1  c. lime
1  Tbsp. alum
3  c. vinegar
10  c. sugar
8  sticks cinnamon
1  pkg. red hot candies
2  bottles red food coloring
preparation: Soak cucumber slices in lime and water for 24 hours.  Wash and soak in ice water for 3 hours.  Mix 1 cup vinegar, alum and water to cover and simmer for 2 hours.  Pour off liquid.

name: BRAN APPLE COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
3  c. whole bran cereal (Bran Buds)
2  eggs
1 (8 oz.)  can (1 c.) applesauce
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. butter or margarine
1  c. buttermilk
2 1/2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Combine 1 cup flour, brown sugar and cinnamon.  Cut in 1/2 cup butter.  Combine 1 cup cereal with 1 cup boiling water; set aside. Cream the granulated sugar and 1/3 cup butter.  Beat in eggs. Mix in milk, applesauce and softened bran.  Combine the remaining flour, soda and 1/2 teaspoon salt.  Add the remaining cereal and egg mixture; blend well.  Pour into two greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pans.  Sprinkle half of the cinnamon mixture atop each. Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PIE(Forms Its Own Crust)
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1/2  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put all ingredients in a blender for one minute.  Pour into well-greased 10-inch pie pan.  Sprinkle with nutmeg before placing in oven.  Bake at 350° for forty-five minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
2  c. sugar
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. oil
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. sliced strawberries
preparation: Put strawberries in blender and puree.  Combine first 5 ingredients and mix well.  Combine eggs, oil and strawberries, add to dry ingredients and mix well.  Pour batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.   Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean.  Makes 2 loaves.

name: SACHERTORTE
ingredients:
5  oz. sweet chocolate, broken in small chunks
3/4  c. butter of margarine
6  egg yolks, beaten
6  egg whites
1  c. powdered sugar
1 1/4  c. sifted cake flour
1/3  c. apricot jam
preparation: Melt chocolate in top of a double boiler.  Add butter, stirring until melted.  Add egg yolks, beating constantly.  Add sugar and beat until well mixed.  Cool.  Beat egg whites until stiff.  Fold in chocolate mixture and flour alternately.  Pour into a greased 8 inch square pan lined with greased waxed paper. Bake in a preheated 325° oven for 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Remove from pan.  Cool.  Melt jam in hot water.  Spread on top of cake.  Let stand 20 minutes and then decorate with frosting.

name: FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
chicken pieces
milk
Bisquick
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Dip chicken pieces in milk and then in Bisquick.  Place in lightly coated (with oil) pan.  Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour or until nice and golden brown.

name: SALMON VEGETABLE LOAF
ingredients:
1  can salmon
1  c. green beans, cooked
salt and pepper to taste
tomato sauce
2  c. mashed potatoes
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  egg whites, beaten
preparation: Mix salmon and vegetables all together with salt and pepper. Then fold in egg whites. Put in baking dish and pour tomato sauce over it. Bake for 30 minutes at 350° or until done.

name: SAUCE FOR CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
1  stick butter
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  to 3 shakes garlic powder
1  Tbsp. Tabasco sauce or more to taste
preparation: Put on cooked wings.  Bake for 5 minutes at 350° to set sauce.

name: SINFUL CHOCOLATE DESSERT
ingredients:
1  dark chocolate cake mix
2  pkg. dark chocolate instant pudding
4  to 6 Skor or Heath bars, crushed to pea size (save crumbs for top)
2  oz. bag slivered almonds
1  large container La Creme or Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake and tear into bite size pieces.  Prepare pudding according to package  Layer cake, pudding, nuts, candy and Cool Whip.  Make sure the top layer is Cool Whip.  Before final Cool Whip top, poke holes and pour Kahlua or Amaretto into holes.  Save crumbs from candy bars to sprinkle on top.  Makes large container of dessert.  Recipe can be cut in half.

name: ONION DIP
ingredients:
3/4  c. mayonnaise (can be light)
1 1/2  tsp. spices (Beau Monde, dill weed, onion flakes and parsley flakes)
3/4  c. sour cream (can be fat-free)
preparation: Mix and chill. Serve with vegetables and/or chips.

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
8  to 10 medium potatoes
3  boiled eggs
1  medium cucumber (optional)
6  sweet pickles
4  ribs celery
2  green onions
1/4  to 1/2 bell pepper
1  Tbsp. vinegar
celery seed (optional)
salt and pepper to taste
mayonnaise
preparation: Wash potatoes and boil in skins until tender.  While potatoes are cooking, boil the eggs and cut all other ingredients very fine.  Peel potatoes and put in a large bowl.  Add vinegar and let stand 15 minutes.  Cube potatoes and combine all ingredients. This is better if you can serve before refrigerating.

name: SAUSAGE AND CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  lb. roll sausage
milk
preparation: In double boiler melt cheese with a little milk.  In skillet brown sausage, stirring until crumbly.  Mix with cheese.  Serve with your favorite chip.

name: MACARONI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. cooked macaroni
1 1/2  c. scalded milk
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
1/4  c. melted oleo
1  Tbsp. parsley
1  Tbsp. chopped onions
3  eggs
salt and pepper
preparation: Pour milk on crumbs and let stand.  Butter baking dish and put in macaroni; add remaining ingredients to milk mixture and pour over macaroni.  Bake at 325° for one hour.

name: PEANUT BUTTER AND PUMPKIN SOUP(A Thick and Filling Chef Style Soup)
ingredients:
1  c. peanuts, unsalted and shelled
1  small pumpkin
1  Tbsp. peanut oil
1  Tbsp. water
4  stalks celery, chopped
2  medium leeks, white part only, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
salt and pepper to season
6  c. chicken stock
7  Tbsp. unsalted butter, softened
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
4  Tbsp. peanut butter, creamy
1  c. heavy cream
preparation: Toast peanuts  on  a baking sheet in a 300° oven for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown.  Hold in a warm oven.

name: CHICKEN SUPREME
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. cut up chicken, cooked
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  c. milk
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1/2  lb. cut up Velveeta
2  to 4 cut up, hard-boiled eggs
8  oz. can mushrooms
1  onion, diced
1/2  stick oleo
9  oz. uncooked macaroni
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Place in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Refrigerate overnight.  Next day, top with bread crumbs.  Cover and bake 45 minutes in 350° oven.  Remove cover and bake another 15 to 20 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. shredded carrots
1  c. flaked coconut
1  c. chopped walnuts
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Sift flour, soda, baking powder, salt and cinnamon into a large bowl.  Make a well in the center and add in order sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla; beat with wooden spoon until smooth.  Stir in carrots, coconut, walnuts and pineapple until well blended. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Cool completely on wire rack.  Spread with cream cheese frosting.  Store in refrigerator.

name: COMPANY EGGS(Recipe from Bill Banks)
ingredients:
8  slices bread
2/3  c. mild Cheddar cheese
8  eggs
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
4  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cube bread.  Place bread in buttered (greased) 9 x 13-inch pan.  Add cheese on top.  Beat eggs well and add milk, salt, pepper and mustard.  Pour over bread and cheese.  Refrigerate overnight.  Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 325° to 350°.  May add chopped ham, dried beef or bacon chips.

name: OLD FASHION EGG SALAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. chopped onions
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
6  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped fine
preparation: In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, onions, salt and pepper.  Stir in eggs and celery.  Cover and chill.

name: ZUCCHINI PICKLES
ingredients:
3  or 4 zucchini, sliced thin
1  medium green pepper, chopped fine
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1/2  c. white vinegar
preparation: Mix zucchini, green pepper, onion, salt and celery seed and let stand for 1 hour.  Then add sugar and vinegar.  Put into jars.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. plain flour
3  sticks oleo
6  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Cream butter, add sugar; add eggs one at a time and beat well. Stir in cream and add flour. Stir in vanilla. Pour into well greased floured tube or bundt pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. frozen hash browns
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped bell pepper
1  lb. sausage, browned and drained
3  c. grated Cheddar cheese
12  eggs
2  c. milk
salt
pepper
preparation: Use a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.  Layer hash browns, sausage, cheese, pepper and onions.  Combine eggs and milk, beating well.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Pour over layers. Bake at 350° about 50 minutes.  Can be refrigerated or frozen. Makes 12 servings.

name: NITA'S CHOCOLATE SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
3  Tbsp. cocoa
2  sticks oleo
1  c. water
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
preparation: Combine sugar, flour and cocoa in large bowl.  Bring oleo and water to a boil.  Pour over dry ingredients and mix.  Add buttermilk, eggs, soda, vanilla and salt to mixture.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400°.

name: OVEN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  frying chicken, cut up or 8 chicken breasts
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can water
1/2  c. margarine (1 cube)
1 1/2  c. rice, uncooked
preparation: Mix soups, water and margarine in saucepan.  Heat until margarine melts.  Reserve 1 cup sauce.  Stir rice into remaining sauce and pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Place chicken on top and pour  reserved  sauce  over  chicken.  Bake  at 275° for 3 hours.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. stew meat
1  small onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. sour cream
noodles or rice
salt and pepper as desired
preparation: Cook meat and onion until  tender, about 2 hours.  Drain water and add sour cream and soup.  Cook on low heat 20 minutes more. Serve on noodles or rice.

name: MARY TYLER MOORE'S ITALIAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  cans corn kernels (16 oz. size)
2  cans tomato soup
4  cans water
2  large onions
2  large green peppers
1 (16 oz.)  can black olives
2  sticks butter
1  (16 oz.) bag broad egg noodles
grated Parmesan or Romano cheese
1  Tbsp. tomato paste
preparation: In  large  skillet,  saute diced onions and  slices  of green peppers until  onions  are clear and peppers are  soft. Remove from skillet and discard leftover butter.  Add  ground beef and saute until cooked.  Empty beef, onions  and  peppers into	large soup  pot.	Add tomato soup, water,  noodles  and tomato  paste; boil  until noodles are soft.  Add	corn  and olives  that	have been sliced into rings and place  in  large casserole.

name: PORK PIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lean ground pork
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1  small onion, finely chopped
5  large potatoes
2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. pepper
seasoning to taste
1  (9-inch) deep dish pie crust, double
preparation: Place all ingredients, except potatoes, in large pan.  Cook on medium heat until meat is done.  Boil potatoes in salted water, then drain.  When meat is cooked, add potatoes and mash together.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 small  can Pet milk
1/2  pkg. Velveeta cheese, cut up
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli, thawed
1  c. uncooked Minute rice
1/2  cube butter
1  onion, chopped (or to taste)
preparation: Saute onion in butter.  Add milk, soup and cheese.  Cook until blended.  Mix with thawed broccoli and rice.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour, uncovered.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow squash, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1  large onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. water
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can nacho cheese soup, undiluted
1 (8 oz.)  carton commercial sour cream
1/2  c. round buttery cracker crumbs
paprika
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients in a 2-quart casserole. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap, vent and microwave on High 10 to 12 minutes or until tender. Drain.  Combine soup and sour cream; add to squash mixture, stirring gently to mix.  Microwave, uncovered, on Medium-high (70% power) 10 to 12 minutes or until heated thoroughly, giving dish a half turn after 6 minutes. Top with crumbs and sprinkle with paprika.   Yields 6 servings.

name: EASY PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
3 oz  pkg. raspberry gelatin
3  oz. pkg. cherry gelatin
3  c. boiling water
5  c. cold water
3  c. pineapple juice
12  oz. frozen orange juice
2  pt. pineapple or lemon sherbet
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add next 3 ingredients. Stir in one tray ice cubes until melted.  Spoon in sherbet.  Serve immediately or let stand at room temperature.

name: SUMMER SAUSAGE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  c. water
2  tsp. liquid smoke
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. onion powder
1  tsp. mustard seed
3  Tbsp. Tender Quick (Morton)
preparation: Mix all together real well.  Make into 3 rolls in Reynolds Wrap (shiny side in).  Refrigerate for 24 hours, then bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325°.  Before baking, punch holes in bottom of rolls and bake on rack so grease will drain while rolls are baking.

name: EASY ONE DISH HAM BAKE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli cuts, rinsed and drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed Cheddar cheese soup
1  c. milk
3  c. cut up cooked ham (chicken, turkey or beef)
1/2  tsp. onion powder (or dry onion flakes to taste)
1  c. Bisquick baking mix
1  c. milk
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Mix broccoli, soups, 1 cup milk, ham and onion in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Mix baking mix and milk.  Pour evenly over soup mixture.  Bake 27 to 30 minutes or until light golden brown.  Let stand for at least 5 minutes before eating.

name: EARTHQUAKE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. flaked coconut
6  oz. chocolate chips
1  stick margarine
1  box powdered sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
1  German chocolate cake mix
preparation: In greased 9 x 13 pan, sprinkle nuts, coconut and chocolate chips. Blend margarine, powdered sugar and cream cheese and set aside. Mix German chocolate cake mix as directed and pour over nuts, coconut and chips. Drop cream cheese mixture by spoonfuls over cake mixture as evenly as possible. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes. Can be spread with icing if you wish.

name: MOZZARELLA SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. Mozzarella
3  small tomatoes
3/4  lb. zucchini
1/2  c. red onion, thinly sliced
6  Tbsp. olive oil
3  Tbsp. wine vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. chopped fresh parsley
1/4  tsp. oregano
black pepper
preparation: Cut Mozzarella into thin strips.  Slice tomatoes into thin wedges.  Cut zucchini into 1/4-inch slices and drop in boiling water for 2 minutes; drain and cool under running water.  Combine all ingredients and toss.  Let chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

name: 7 LAYER PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1  large head lettuce
1/2  c. red onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
4  hard-boiled eggs, sliced
1  pkg. frozen peas
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. sugar
4  oz. grated cheese
1/2  jar or 2 oz. bacon bits
preparation: Place ingredients as listed in a 9 x 15-inch dish.  Spread mayonnaise over top.  Sprinkle with sugar, cheese and bacon.  Do not toss.  A great salad for family or church gathering.  I usually double everything except lettuce.  Chill 6 to 8 hours.

name: SEASONED SEEDS
ingredients:
1  c. pumpkin seeds
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. onion salt or seasoned
preparation: Remove membrane from seeds.  If seeds are washed, pat dry. Place in a 9-inch glass pie plate.  Add remaining ingredients. Microwave on High for 8 to 10 minutes, until lightly toasted, stirring 4 to 5 times.  Cooking time will depend on size of seeds and moistness.

name: CHEESY SAUSAGE QUICHE
ingredients:
9-inch unbaked pastry shell
3/4  lb. pork sausage
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. light cream or evaporated milk
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Bake shell for 7 minutes.  Remove from oven and reduce temperature to 350°.  Brown sausage and drain. Reserve 2 tablespoons fat and cook and stir onion and green pepper in reserved fat.  Stir in sausage.  Spoon into pastry shell. Sprinkle with cheese.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can corn
1  can green beans
1  can peas
1  can carrots
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
2  pkg. Tater Tots
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine hamburger and onion soup mix.  Spread meat in bottom of baking pan.  Scatter all vegetables over meat mixture.  Spread soup over vegetables.  Spread your Tater Tots over top.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Bake at 350° for about 1 1/2 hours.  Good for covered dish church supper or family affair.

name: ORANGE CHIFFON SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. small curd cottage cheese
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. dry orange Jell-O
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 small  can crushed pineapple, well drained
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well (add in order ingredients are listed).  Refrigerate.

name: MEXICAN POOR MAN DESSERT(Also Known As Capitutada)
ingredients:
1  loaf French bread (day-old)
2  medium onions
4  cloves
4  medium tomatoes
4  sticks brown sugar (pilonsillo)
4  sticks cinnamon
1/4  c. cooking oil
1/2  c. walnuts
1/4  c. white Jack cheese, crumbled
preparation: Take day-old French bread and slice in 4 x 4-inch squares. Lightly brown two sides of bread in small amount of oil; add more oil, if needed.  Place each slice in layer form.  Place in Pyrex or baking dish large enough to fit bread squares.

name: BUTTERMILK WAFFLES
ingredients:
2  beaten egg yolks
2  stiffly beaten egg whites
2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Preheat waffle iron.  Sift together dry ingredients.  Combine yolks, milk and oil; stir into dry ingredients.  Fold in whites. Bake.

name: QUICHE
ingredients:
2 1/3  c. sweet milk
2  c. half and half
1  c. whipping cream
2  Tbsp. flour
10  eggs
salt and pepper
2  deep dish pie crusts
ham or bacon, chopped
sprinkle of Lawry's seasoned salt/pepper
1  box frozen or fresh broccoli
1  can mushrooms (if desired)
Swiss cheese
preparation: Sprinkle ham or bacon, broccoli and mushrooms in deep dish unbaked crust.  Put a layer of grated or sliced Swiss cheese.  Mix all remaining ingredients together.  Beat good with fork.  Pour over vegetables and cheese in shell.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until top is brown and quiche is firm.

name: MERINGUE THAT CAN'T SLEEP OR WON'T WEEP
ingredients:
3  beaten egg whites
6  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
pinch of salt
preparation: Cook all, except sugar and egg whites, until clear.  Cool. Add egg whites which have been beaten until foamy and standing in peaks.  Continue beating and add sugar.  Gradually beat until very creamy.  Pile on pie and bake in 325° oven.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  lb. spaghetti
1  1/2 cucumbers
2  ripe tomatoes
1  small red onion
1  green pepper
1  c. Italian salad dressing
preparation: Boil and drain spaghetti.  Cut cleaned vegetables in small pieces.  Toss in a large bowl.  Add spaghetti and Salad Supreme to taste.  Add Italian salad dressing, about 1 cup, a little at a time.  You may need more dressing according to size of vegetables.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, grated
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  pkg. of frozen tater tots
1  can cream of celery soup
1  c. water
preparation: Brown meat and drain. Line a large casserole dish with meat. Sprinkle onions on top of meat. Add mushroom soup and one layer of tater tots. Mix celery soup and water. Pour over meat and tater tots. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until tater tots are done.

name: DIABETIC CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. NutraSweet or fructose
1/2  c. butter (soft)
4  tsp. cocoa
1/2  c. sour milk
1  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. boiling water
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine ingredients in a large bowl.  Bake in a medium-sized pan at 350° for about 25 minutes.

name: GLAZED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/4  c. margarine
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
2  lb. cooked sweet potatoes, peeled
preparation: Combine sugar, margarine, cinnamon and salt in thick skillet and cook over moderate heat, stirring constantly until mixture blends and bubbles.  Arrange sweet potatoes in skillet; cover and cook 10 minutes over low heat.  Uncover; cook about 5 minutes longer, basting frequently until potatoes are glazed.

name: BANANA SPLIT PIE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  stick margarine
2  c. powdered sugar
2  sticks margarine
2  eggs
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1  c. chopped nuts
1 small  jar cherries
5  bananas, sliced
chocolate syrup
preparation: Combine bananas, pineapple, Cool Whip, cherries and pecans. Pour into pie crust.  Drizzle chocolate syrup over top.  Chill until time to serve.

name: BEST BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
3 (1 lb.)  cans pork and beans
1  c. brown sugar, packed
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. chili powder
1/2  c. dark molasses
1/2  c. bottled chili sauce
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Combine  pork  and  beans, sugar, Worcestershire, chili powder, molasses,  chili sauce and vinegar in a crock-pot with lid.  Cook on  high  for  several hours or on low overnight or most of  the  day.  Add crumbled bacon bits, if desired before serving.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: TAMALE MEAT PIE
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
4  c. lukewarm water
1  tsp. salt
3  lb. ground chuck, scrambled and drained
1  Tbsp. salt
2  tsp. chili powder
2  tsp. black pepper
16  oz. whole tomatoes
5  oz. tomato paste
1  medium onion, chopped
1  large green pepper, chopped
paprika
preparation: To Prepare Mush:  Cook cornmeal, water and salt in double boiler until thick.  Cover and let set until filling is ready.

name: CRANBERRY ORANGE BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. orange juice
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  c. each:	raw whole cranberries and chopped nuts
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg, beaten
grated rind of 1 orange
2  Tbsp. hot water
preparation: Combine flour, baking powder, soda, salt and sugar in a large bowl;  set	aside.	Mix  beaten  egg with orange juice, rind, butter  and  hot  water.  Fold  flour  mixture into egg mixture until  blended.  Do  not  beat.  Gently fold in cranberries and walnuts.  Spoon into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake  at 325°  for  60  minutes.  Cool  on  rack for 15 minutes before removing from pan.

name: STRAWBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
2 (18 oz.)  cans unsweetened pineapple juice (4 1/2 c.)
1  qt. ginger ale
2 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen sliced strawberries, partially thawed
preparation: Shortly before serving time, combine in the punch bowl the chilled pineapple juice and 1 cup lemon juice.  Add the strawberries and their syrup.  Stir to blend thoroughly.  Add the chilled ginger ale and blend.  Add ice cubes or molded ice block.

name: RAISIN SOUR CREAM PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. Sun-Maid raisins
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  homemade pie shell
preparation: In top of double boiler, blend together sugar, cornstarch and salt. In small bowl, combine beaten eggs, 1 1/2 cups of the sour cream, the raisins and the lemon juice. Stir in sugar mixture. Set over hot, not boiling, water and cook until thick, stirring frequently. Pour into baked pie crust.  When cool, top with remaining 1/2 cup sour cream. Chill several hours. Makes one 9-inch pie.

name: JENNIFER'S PIZZA DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
`1/3 c. chile sauce
1  Tbsp. mustard
sprinkle of basil
1  small, chopped tomato
1/2  green pepper
2  oz. pepperoni, chopped
1/3  c. grated cheese
preparation: Spread cream cheese on large plate with edges slightly up. Spread chile sauce, mixed with mustard, on top of cream cheese. Sprinkle basil, tomato, pepper, pepperoni and cheese on top.  Add crackers around edge of pizza before serving.

name: CHERRY CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  pkg. cake mix
1  stick butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spread pie filling in bottom of 9-inch square pan.  Sprinkle lemon juice and mix with filling.  Combine dry cake mix and melted butter.  Sprinkle over pie filling.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until golden brown.

name: SHRIMPEE
ingredients:
1 (4 oz.)  can shrimp, drained
1 (5 oz.)  jar Old English spread
1 1/2  tsp. mayonnaise
1 1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. garlic salt or powder
1/2 to 1  stick margarine, softened
6  to 8 English muffins
preparation: Mix  the  first  6 ingredients together.  Spread shrimp mixture  on  English  muffins  and bake or broil until bubbly. Cut into quarters.

name: LOUISE'S TEA CAKES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. butter
2  eggs
3  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. butter flavoring
preparation: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, flour, vanilla and butter flavoring.  Set in freezer for 45 minutes.  Dip balls in teaspoon and put on greased cookie sheet.  Space out.  Bake for 7 minutes at 325°.

name: PIZZA PIE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. wide egg noodles
1 (12 oz.)  can cheese soup
2  lb. ground beef
14  oz. jar Pizza Quick sauce
1  large bag shredded Mozzarella cheese
pepperoni slices
preparation: Boil egg noodles and drain.  Brown ground beef and drain. Pour Pizza Quick sauce into ground beef and mix well.  Butter well a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Pour noodles into pan; dilute soup with 1/4 cup water and heat; pour over noodles.  Then pour meat and sauce over this.  Top with cheese; add pepperoni slices over top. Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes or until bubbly.

name: PINEAPPLE "THING"
ingredients:
2  cans chunk pineapple
1 1/2  pkg. Ritz crackers, crushed
1  c. flour
1  stick margarine
preparation: Butter baking dish.  Set oven for 350°.  Drain juice from pineapple.  Mix sugar, flour and just enough juice to make sugar and flour into a paste.  Add pineapple to mixture.  Melt margarine and add crushed crackers.  Pour over pineapple mixture and bake about 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
3  to 4 boneless chicken breasts
1  pkg. Pillsbury all ready pie crusts
1  can Veg-All, drained
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  cans condensed cream of chicken soup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Let crusts thaw at room temperature for 10 minutes.  Cook chicken; cut into small pieces.  Spray bottom of pie plate with cooking oil.  Line bottom of pie plate with pie crust; poke holes with fork.  Mix chicken and all other ingredients in pie shell. Top with other crust; tuck edges under first crust.  Press with fork to seal edges; make slits in top crust.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serves 8.

name: BEAN DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  can refried beans
1  c. sour cream
1 large  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  bottle green chilies
1  jar red salsa
preparation: Fry ground beef until browned.  Drain very well.  Add taco seasoning.  Mix well and add refried beans.  Place in a baking dish.  Add a small amount of Cheddar cheese on top.  Mix sour cream, green chilies and red salsa together.   Spread over cheese. Spread rest of cheese over entire dish.  Bake in a 400° oven until cheese is lightly browned and bubbly.  Serve with nacho chips.  Very good.

name: SUMMER SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. squash, sliced (6 c.)
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. melted butter
1  c. sour cream
1  c. shredded carrots
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. stuffing mix
preparation: Cook squash and onion in salt water for 5 minutes; drain. Combine soup and sour cream; stir in carrots.  Fold squash and onion in.  Combine stuffing mix and butter; spread 1/2 in bottom of a 12 x 7 x 2-inch dish.  Spoon vegetables on top.  Sprinkle with remaining stuffing over vegetables.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes until heated through.

name: QUICK LOW-FAT PASTA SAUCE(For Two)
ingredients:
1 1/2  Tbsp. olive oil
2  crushed fresh garlic cloves
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  tsp. sugar
salt to taste
oregano (optional)
4 small quartered fresh tomatoes or 1  can cooking tomatoes
pepper to taste
basil (optional)
preparation: Saute garlic in olive oil.  Add tomatoes, parsley, sugar and seasonings.  Cook slowly for 5 minutes on low heat.  Pour over angel hair pasta or any other pasta.  Sprinkle top with freshly grated Parmesan cheese.

name: CRUMB CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. butter
2  eggs
3/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together. Add butter.  Mix and rub together to form crumbs. Remove 3/4 cup of crumbs for topping. Add eggs, milk and vanilla to rest of crumbs. Beat until smooth.

name: SHIPWRECK
ingredients:
4  large potatoes
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  can kidney beans
1  small onion
1  can tomato soup
1/4  c. water
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Peel and slice potatoes.  Place half of the slices in a greased 2-quart casserole.  Add ground beef, salt, pepper, drained kidney beans and onion.  Arrange remaining potatoes on top.  Combine tomato soup and water and spoon over all.  Cover and bake for 1 1/2 hours.

name: BLUEBERRY TORTE
ingredients:
1 (1/4 lb.)  pkg. finely crushed graham crackers
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. melted butter
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  can blueberry pie filling
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Mix together the first 3 ingredients.  Line a 9 x 13-inch pan on bottom with mixture.

name: CHEESECAKE STRAWBERRY SAUCE
ingredients:
1 16  oz. pkg. frozen unsweetened strawberries, thawed
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 3/4  tsp. Equal for Recipes
preparation: Process strawberries in food processor or blender until smooth.  Stir in lemon juice and Equal, refrigerate until serving time.  Makes about 2 cups.

name: 3 BEAN TOFU CHILI
ingredients:
1/3  c. olive oil
1  Tbsp. chopped garlic
4  Tbsp. chili powder
1  small hot chili pepper, chopped fine
8  oz. baby carrots, chopped extra fine
2  c. rough chopped onions
1  c. rough chopped bell pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
8  oz. tofu crumbles
salt and pepper to taste
1 (29 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. dark molasses or sorghum
2 (16 oz.)  cans small pink beans
1 (16 oz.)  can pinto beans
1 (16 oz.)  can garbanzo beans
preparation: Heat olive oil in cooking pot on medium high.  Add to hot oil the garlic, chili powder, chili pepper, carrots, onions, bell pepper, celery, tofu crumbles and salt to taste.  Cook until tender (approximately 10 minutes).  Add tomato and molasses.  Cook on low heat until all ingredients are blended together (approximately 5 minutes).   Drain all beans and add to mixture. Continue to cook on low heat until beans are heated through (10 to 15 minutes).

name: DUTCH MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1  small onion, chopped fine
1/3  c. green pepper, chopped fine
2  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. tomato sauce, divided
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1 1/2  tsp. prepared mustard
chopped parsley
preparation: Combine beef, bread crumbs, onion, green pepper, eggs, salt, pepper and 1/2 cup tomato sauce.  Press into an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Unmold on rack of broiler pan.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
