2  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. oil
4  eggs
2  c. plain flour
2  tsp. soda
3  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
3  small or 2 large strained carrots (baby food)
preparation: Beat sugar, oil and eggs well.  Then add the rest of the ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: LEMON SPONGE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. melted butter
juice of 1 lemon
2  egg yolks
4  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
preparation: Add lemon juice mixed with egg yolks, flour and milk to sugar and melted butter.  Add stiffly beaten egg whites.  Bake 40 to 50 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. flour
2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
2 (20 oz.)  cans pineapple chunks, drained and 6 Tbsp. pineapple juice reserved
1  c. Ritz cracker crumbs
8  Tbsp. butter, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Spray a medium size casserole dish with nonstick coating. In a large bowl, stir together the sugar and flour. Gradually stir in cheese. Add the drained pineapple chunks. Stir until ingredients are well combined. Pour into the prepared casserole dish.

name: CHOCOLATE LUST
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
3/4  c. stick oleo
2/3  c. nuts
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
6  oz. chocolate instant pudding
3  c. milk
13  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix flour, oleo and nuts by hand.  Spread in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 300°, until lightly brown. Cool.

name: ONE DISH MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground round
salt and pepper
2  large potatoes, sliced thin
1  can vegetarian vegetable soup
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. dry oatmeal
1  egg
1  c. catsup
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Mix ground round, salt, pepper, soup, onion, oatmeal and egg. Spray casserole or loaf pan.  Slice potatoes thin and lay on bottom of casserole dish.  Place ground beef on top.   Mix brown sugar, catsup and dry mustard.  Spread on top of meat loaf.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Drain grease.

name: WILD RICE SOUP
ingredients:
2  c. chopped celery
2  c. sliced, fresh mushrooms
1  c. (1 medium) chopped onion
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil or bacon fat
2  c. cooked wild rice
2  c. water
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans cream of mushroom soup
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans cream of chicken soup
8  slices cooked, crumbled bacon
2  c. milk
1/2  c. dry white wine
preparation: In a 3-quart saucepan, combine celery, mushrooms, onion and oil.  Cook over medium heat; stir occasionally until vegetables are tender (10 to 12 minutes).  Stir in rice, water, soups and bacon.  Reduce heat to low.  Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, for 30 minutes.  Stir in milk and wine.  Continue cooking until heated through (2 to 4 minutes).

name: CHICKEN BAKED IN SOUR CREAM
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen chicken breasts
2/3  pt. sour cream
1  can mushroom soup
2 small  cans mushrooms
preparation: Dredge chicken in flour and salt and pepper.  Put in casserole or baking dish.  Pour sour cream, soup and mushrooms over.  Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 375° to 400°.

name: SWEDISH MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
3/4  c. milk
3  Tbsp. onion, minced
4  Tbsp. butter
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/4  c. flour
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. stock or cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Soak bread crumbs in milk.  Add to beef along with egg, seasonings and onion.  Form into small balls.  Roll in flour. Saute in butter until brown.  Add small amount of water (1/2 cup) and soup or stock.  Cook a few minutes (10) on low heat.  Serve over rice or noodles.

name: STRAWBERRY SPINACH SALAD
ingredients:
2  bunches spinach or romaine lettuce (torn)
4  c. sliced strawberries
1/4  c. slivered almonds
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. white wine vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. paprika
2  Tbsp. sesame seeds
1  Tbsp. poppy seeds
1/4  tsp. worcestershire sauce
preparation: In large bowl, toss together salad leaves, strawberries and almonds.

name: MONSTER COOKIES
ingredients:
2  sticks butter or margarine
1  lb. brown sugar
2  c. sugar
9  c. Quaker oats (old-fashion)
2  c. (12 oz.) chocolate chips
1 1/2  lb. peanut butter (creamy)
1  large bag M&M's (for tops)
6  eggs (one at a time)
2  tsp. Karo syrup
2  tsp. vanilla
4  tsp. baking powder
2  c. M&M's (plain)
preparation: Cream the first 3 ingredients, then gradually beat in eggs. Add Karo syrup and vanilla, mixing well. Add peanut butter, mixing well with beater. In separate bowl, blend oats and baking soda together. (Put oats in bowl first, baking soda will stick to bottom of bowl.) Add this mixture gradually to peanut butter mixture, mixing well (with spoon, not beater). Add chocolate chips and M&M's, blending them throughout dough. Drop by heaping spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Press several M&M's onto tops of each cookie. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Cool on cookie sheet 5 to 10 minutes. Move to paper towels on table or counter.

name: QUICK MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising cornmeal
1/4  tsp. red pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  c. milk
2  eggs, beaten
1 (8 oz.)  can cream-style corn
preparation: Combine first 3  ingredients.  Add  remaining  ingredients, mixing well.  Pour	into well-greased 8-inch baking pan. Bake at 450° for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden.

name: BAKED CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
8  chicken breasts
8  slices bacon
1  pkg. dried beef
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Line bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with layer of dried beef. Place 1 slice of bacon inside skinned and boned chicken breast. Spoon over top the mushroom soup and sour cream. Bake, uncovered, at 275° for 3 hours.

name: SUGARLESS APPLE PIE
ingredients:
6  c. sliced apples
1  (12 oz.) frozen apple juice
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
2/3  c. flour
1/3  c. oleo
1/3  c. Sugar Twin
preparation: Mix apples, apple juice, cornstarch, cinnamon and nutmeg together.  Place in pie tin containing unbaked pie crust.  Sugar Twin may be added to apple juice if a sweeter filling is desired. Mix flour, oleo and Sugar Twin together and crumble over sliced apple mixture.  Instead of crumb crust, a regular top crust may be used.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: CHEESE-GARLIC BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick
2/3  c. milk
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1/2  c. margarine
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Combine baking mix, milk and cheese. Stir until soft dough forms; beat vigorously for 30 seconds. Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown.

name: CHOCOLATE FROSTING
ingredients:
1/2  c. Crisco
1  egg
1/2  c. cocoa
1/4  tsp. salt
4  c. powdered sugar
1/3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Blend Crisco, egg, cocoa and salt.  Add sugar alternately with milk and vanilla; mix until smooth and creamy.  Add more sugar to thicken or milk to thin frosting if needed for good spreading consistency.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, beat well
1 1/2  c. pumpkin
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
1 1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. milk (sweet or evaporated)
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Pour into shell and bake.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1/2  c. peanut butter
3  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1  c. sifted powdered sugar
8  oz. chocolate flavored coating
preparation: Mix peanut butter, margarine and sugar in food processor. shape into 1-inch balls. Let stand a minute until dry.  Dip into melted coating.

name: CLASSIC SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, thawed
1 1/2  c. dairy sour cream
1  c. Hellmann's mayo
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts, finely chopped
3  green onions, finely chopped
preparation: Squeeze spinach until dry.  In medium bowl, stir together spinach, sour cream, mayo, water chestnuts and green onions. Cover; refrigerate 2 hours.  If desired, serve with pumpernickel bread or crackers.  Makes 3 cups.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
4 1/2  tsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. diet mayonnaise
1 3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. parsley
2  tsp. paprika
2  Tbsp. sliced black olives
3  medium tomato wedges
8  oz. cooked pasta, drained
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
preparation: Combine onion and vinegar and let set for a while.  Add mayonnaise, salt, pepper and paprika; mix.  Mix pasta and other ingredients with sauce and toss.  Chill for several hours. Garnish with parsley.

name: SKINNY PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
water as needed
oil as needed
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Continue adding water until mixture resembles heavy cream.  With a soup ladle, drop mix into hot oil (1/4-inch) to form small pancakes.  Cook until edges are brown; flip.  Repeat.

name: SWISS 'N CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. chopped, cooked chicken
2  c. celery
2  c. croutons
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Kraft Swiss cheese
1  c. Miracle Whip
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. chopped walnuts, toasted
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients, except walnuts. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole dish; sprinkle with walnuts.   Bake for 40 minutes, or until thoroughly heated.  Makes 6 servings.

name: MUSHROOM PATTIES
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  eggs
saltine crackers
cooking oil
preparation: Mix cream of mushroom soup and eggs.  Add enough crackers to make patties.  Put enough cooking oil in skillet to cover bottom. Drop mushroom mixture in skillet by tablespoon. Fry until golden brown on both sides.

name: FUDGE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  egg yolks
2  oz. chocolate
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
2  egg whites
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream butter until soft and gradually add sugar.  Blend until creamy.  Beat in the egg yolks.  Melt the chocolate over hot water and when slightly cool, add to mixture.  Add flour gradually; add vanilla.  Whip the egg whites until stiff.  Add salt and fold into the first mixture.  Bake in a slow oven, 325°, for 30 minutes. Serve the pie topped with a scoop of ice cream.

name: SCOTCHIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Melt margarine in a saucepan over low heat.  Blend in brown sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.  Stir in vanilla and flour.  Mix thoroughly; stir in nuts.  Pour into a greased and floured 10 x 13-inch pan.  Bake in a preheated 375° oven for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. light brown sugar
2  eggs
1  c. peanut butter (smooth or crunchy; I prefer crunchy)
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Cream sugars and shortening and then eggs. Add peanut butter and vanilla. Sift flour and baking soda and add. Roll in small balls. Flatten with fork. Bake at 325° for approximately 13 to 14 minutes.

name: BUTTERY PULL-APART BREAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1 (30 oz.)  pkg. (24) frozen rolls
3  Tbsp. sesame seed (optional)
1/4 to 1/2  c. melted margarine
preparation: Grease Bundt pan.  Combine cheese, sesame seed and margarine. Coat each frozen roll in this mixture and place in pan.  Cover, thaw and rise overnight in refrigerator.  Then let stand at room temperature until completely risen, 2 to 4 hours.  Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven for 20 minutes.  Cover with foil and bake additional 10 to 15 minutes more.  Serves 12.

name: EASY CRISP SWEET PICKLES
ingredients:
7  lb. cucumbers, sliced
1  c. lime
1  c. pickling salt
1  box alum
12  c. sugar
6  c. vinegar
pickling spice to taste
preparation: If you start pickles at 6 or 7 P.M., you can be finished by after lunch the next day.

name: PARISIAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1 1/2  c. Italian bread crumbs
6  boneless, skinned chicken breast halves
1  lb. sliced fresh mushrooms
2  c. chicken broth
1/2  c. white wine
fresh chopped parsley
preparation: Preheat oven to 475°.    Melt butter in pan.  Coat chicken with bread crumbs.  Arrange halves in pan of melted butter.   Bake for 10 minutes; turn over.  Bake 10 minutes longer.  Reduce oven temperature to 350°.  Arrange mushrooms around chicken.  Pour broth and wine over chicken.   Bake, covered, for 15 minutes. Serve with noodles or rice; garnish with parsley if desired.

name: PATIO SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen green peas
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. water
1 1/3  c. Minute rice
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. chopped dill pickles
1  tsp. grated onion
1  c. cooked ham, chopped
1  c. Swiss cheese, grated
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Add frozen peas and salt to boiling water; boil 2 minutes. Add rice; cover and remove from heat.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Stir in mayonnaise, pickles, onions and pepper.  Mix lightly with fork and chill.  Before serving, add ham and cheese.  Mix lightly. Serve on crisp greens; garnish with tomatoes, olives and carrot strips.

name: RICE KRISPIES TREATS
ingredients:
6  c. Rice Krispies or store brand crispy rice cereal
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. Nestle's butterscotch chips
1  c. peanut butter (chunky or smooth)
preparation: Place the cereal in a large bowl. Line a 13 x 9-inch pan with wax paper. Melt the butterscotch chips in a double boiler (or 1 small saucepan set into water inside a larger one), stirring constantly until smooth. Then add the peanut butter and mix until smooth. Remove from heat and immediately pour into the cereal. Mix thoroughly. Pour mixture into the pan, spread with spoon or spatula until it is even. Refrigerate. Cut into squares to serve.

name: CRANBERRY RELISH
ingredients:
1-1/2  pack (12 oz. package) cranberries
1  orange
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  cup light raisins
preparation: Grind the cranberries and orange in a grinder or food processor.  Combine the remaining ingredients and mix with the cranberry and orange mixture.  Let stand for 48 hours before serving.  This relish freezes well.

name: SCALLOPED EGGPLANT
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant
1/2  c. minced onion
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. cracker crumbs
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1 1/4  c. milk
6  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cut eggplant in cubes.  Boil with 1 teaspoon salt and onion, covered, for about 5 minutes.  Drain.  Make layers of eggplant, 1 teaspoon salt, pepper and crackers.  Pour in milk; dot with butter.  Bake at 375° for about 45 minutes.

name: AUNT DOROTHY'S CHICKEN IN WINE SAUCE
ingredients:
4  to 6 chicken breast halves
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. white wine
1  can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1  jar Armour dried beef
preparation: Skin chicken breast, flour and fry in small amount of shortening.  Remove from skillet.  Make gravy with drippings by adding 3 to 4 tablespoons flour.  Mix with drippings, then add about 1 1/2 cups of water.  Stir gravy and cook until smooth.  Chop dried beef and add to gravy, then add remaining ingredients to make sauce.  Stir until well blended.  Place fried chicken in casserole dish.  Pour sauce over chicken.  Cook in oven for 30 minutes at 350°.  Serve over rice.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. plain low-fat yogurt
2  Tbsp. brown sugar or equivalent brown sugar substitute
2  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  lb. broccoli, cooked tender
preparation: Heat yogurt with brown sugar (or substitute), vinegar, salt and mustard and hot broccoli.  Serve immediately.  Yields 6 servings.

name: MIDNIGHT PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1  c. grenadine
42  oz. 7-Up
2  trays ice cubes
orange rind curls
1  c. rum (optional)
preparation: Chill fruit, fruit juice, grenadine and 7-Up.  At serving time, combine crushed pineapple and strawberries in a punch bowl. Add pineapple juice and grenadine.  Slowly pour in chilled 7-Up. Add ice cubes.  Garnish punch bowl with curls of orange rind. Makes about 30 servings.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash browns, partly thawed
1  stick melted oleo
1  c. chopped onion
1  pt. sour cream
1  can celery soup
1  c. grated cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Can top with crumbs.

name: SHIPWRECK
ingredients:
1  small Onion
1  LB. Hamburger
1  can Tomato Soup
4-5 medium Potatoes
1 (15.8  oz.)  can Kidney Beans
1 soup  can of Water
Salt and Pepper
preparation: Grease a 9x11 casserole dish with margarine.  Make 1 layer of onions sliced, 1 layer of potatoes sliced thin, 1 lb. hamburger browned, kidney beans, tomato soup and water.  Salt and pepper to taste.

name: GLAZED CARROTS
ingredients:
4  c. carrots (cut in 2-inch or bite size pieces)
1  c. orange juice
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter, melted
1  c. brown sugar or less
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. lemon juice concentrate or may use vinegar
preparation: Cook carrots in boiling water, salted to taste, until still a little crisp.  Drain well and place in a shallow baking dish.

name: LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
frozen peas
fresh broccoli
fresh cauliflower
fresh mushrooms
purple onions
shredded Cheddar cheese
bacon bits
Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
preparation: Layer all ingredients, ending with dressing.  You can add any ingredients.  Sometimes I add colored spiral pasta and tomatoes. Layer each item.

name: FROSTED PINEAPPLE SQUARES
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1  egg yolk, beaten
2 (14 oz.)  cans pineapple (chunks or crushed), drained
2/3  c. milk
1  tsp. sugar
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
4  c. flour
1  c. butter
4  egg yolks, beaten
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in heavy saucepan.  Cook over medium heat.  Stir constantly until thick and smooth; set aside to cool.  Scald milk and add sugar.  Set aside to cool.  Mix yeast and warm water; let it sit for a few minutes.  Cut butter into flour and add eggs.  Combine flour, yeast and milk mixtures. Dough will be moist.  Divide in half.  Roll each half out on a floured surface to fit the bottom of a jelly roll pan.  Spread cooled pineapple filling and cover with second half.  Seal edges; snip surface of dough to let steam escape.  Cover with clean towel and let rise in a warm place for about one hour.  Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Frost with confectioners sugar frosting.  May want to use 2 cans of canned pie filling or substitute other canned fruit or fresh fruit or pineapple.

name: DILL PICKLE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. salt
1  qt. vinegar
3  Tbsp. pickling spices, put in cheesecloth bag
30  to 40 medium cucumbers, sliced or cut into fourths, lengthwise
green dill weed
1  qt. water
preparation: Combine sugar, salt, vinegar, water and spices.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Pack  cukes  into  hot jars leaving 1/4-inch head space. Put a  head  of dill weed in each jar on top of cucumbers.  Heat brine  to  boiling;  pour  over cukes.  Seal jars. Process in boiling water  for  15  to 20 minutes.  Remove from water; place on  towels.  Cover with towels until cool.  Store in cool dark place.

name: BURRITO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
18  flour tortillas
2  lb. hamburger meat
1  pkg. taco seasoning
2  cans chili
1  can refried beans
1  c. picante sauce
grated cheese
preparation: Brown meat in skillet.  Drain.  Add can of beans and taco seasoning.  Stuff tortillas and place in casserole dish.  Mix chili and picante sauce in separate bowl.  Pour over tortillas. Top with cheese and bake at 375° until bubbly.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  c. peeled and sliced zucchini
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  c. cream of chicken soup
1  c. shredded carrots
1  c. dairy sour cream
8  oz. pkg. stuffing mix
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: In saucepan, cook zucchini and onions in boiling water for 5 minutes.  Drain well.  Combine soup and sour cream.  Stir in carrots and onion and zucchini mixture.  In bowl, combine stuffing mix and butter.  Spread 1/2 of mixture in bottom of 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish.  Spoon vegetable mixture over stuffing mix. Sprinkle rest of stuffing over top.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  May add sausage to stuffing, if desired.  Also may top with shredded cheese before serving.

name: QUICK BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat (or turkey)
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
1  can cream of mushroom soup (2 for extra creaminess)
1  pkg. Tater Tots
preparation: Press meat into 9 x 12-inch (or similar) casserole dish. Sprinkle with soup mix.  Spread with cream of mushroom soup. Cover with Tater Tots.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.   Serve hot; freeze leftovers.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. cottage cheese
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
2 3/4  c. flour
1/2  c. raisins or dates
preparation: Mix ingredients in order given.  Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: CHEESEBURGER RICE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
1 1/2  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. Minute original rice
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown meat and onion in large skillet on medium-high heat; drain fat.  Stir in water, catsup, mustard, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil.  Stir in rice; cover.  Remove from heat.  Let stand 4 minutes.  Fluff with fork.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Cover.  Let stand 3 minutes or until cheese melts.  Garnish with lettuce leaves, pickle and tomato slices.  Makes 4 servings.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  qt. tomato juice
1  onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic, chopped or 1 tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. thyme
1/4  tsp. marjoram
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
pepper to taste
preparation: Mix together and simmer 30 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. margarine
1  medium onion, chopped
16  to 20 Ritz crackers, crumbled
preparation: Cut slice from top of baked potato or half a large one lengthwise.  Scoop out inside; mash and add hot milk, butter and seasonings.  Beat until fluffy.  Pile lightly into shells and return to oven to brown slightly, if desired.  Add finely chopped onion, stiffly beaten egg white or cheese before returning to oven.

name: COCONUT CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  stick margarine, melted
6  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
2  pie crusts (9-inch)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine sugar and melted margarine, then add eggs, buttermilk and vanilla.  Combine coconut to mixture.  Pour into pie shells.  Makes 2 pies.  Bake 45 to 55 minutes.

name: LOUISIANA SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
1  1/2 cups cooked mashed sweet potatoes
2/3  cup brown sugar (packed)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. allspice
2  eggs (beaten)
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
9  inch unbaked pie shell
preparation: Mix all ingredients and put mixture into pie shell.  Bake in preheated oven at 450° for 15 minutes.  Reduce heat to 325° and bake 30 minutes longer.  Cool before serving.

name: CHRISTMAS CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. cherry jello (small)
1  can cherries, drained (keep juice)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (15 oz.)  can pineapple, drained
1 (20 oz.)  can Coke
preparation: Juice and water make 2 1/2 cups; cook juice and jello until dissolved.  Add all ingredients.  Chill!

name: HEARTY BEEF 'N CHEESE CRESCENT PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. ground beef
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. cut green beans, drained
1  c. tomato sauce (with mushrooms, optional)
1/4  tsp. cumin seed (if desired)
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. salt
1 (8 oz.)  can Pillsbury crescent rolls
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  c. shredded Mozzarella, Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese
paprika
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  In large frypan, brown ground beef, onion and green pepper; drain fat.  Stir in tomato sauce, beans, cumin seed, garlic salt and salt.  Simmer while preparing crust. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles.   Place triangles in ungreased 9-inch glass pie pan; press over bottom and up sides to form crust.  Combine egg and 1 cup cheese; spread over crust. Spoon hot meat mixture into crust.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese and paprika.  Bake at 20 to 25 minutes.  Makes 5 to 6 servings.

name: CHICKEN DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
3 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. butter
1  egg
3/4  c. milk
1  whole chicken
preparation: Simmer chicken in 4 cups water for 1 hour.  Remove chicken from broth.  Sift flour, baking powder and salt together.  Cut in butter.  Beat egg and add milk; stir this into dry ingredients (batter should be quite stiff).  Drop by spoonfuls into chicken broth (or roll in flour like biscuits).  Cover pot.  Raise flame to 1/4 flame.  Steam for about 20 minutes without lifting cover. Remove cover and serve with or without chicken.

name: APPLE SQUARES
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  c. Crisco
1  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  egg yolks
milk
2  cans prepared apple pie filling
2  egg whites
confectionary sugar
water
preparation: Mix flour, Crisco, salt and sugar as you would for pie crust. Beat egg yolks and add enough milk to make 2/3 cup.  Add to crust mixture and refrigerate for 1/2 hour.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1/4  lb. thinly sliced pepperoni
1/4  lb. chopped salami
1  green pepper, chopped
Provolone cheese
2  tomatoes, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  stalk celery, chopped
1 small  can black olives, chopped
1  lb. spiral macaroni, cooked and drained
garlic powder and oregano to taste
Italian salad dressing
preparation: Combine meats, cheese and vegetables as desired.  Add macaroni; season to taste with garlic powder and oregano.  Add salad dressing just prior to serving.

name: SIMPLE CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1  c. milk
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. cornmeal
1  Tbsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased 8 x 8-inch pan.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.  Check center for doneness.

name: BRUNCH-BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. Jimmy Dean sausage
1 1/2  doz. eggs
1  c. Cheddar cheese soup
1  large bag O'Brien hash browns
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  can mushrooms
1  large bag shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown and drain the sausage.  Place sausage in a large bowl. Add eggs, soup, hash browns, mayonnaise and mushrooms.  Mix together.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan and bake at 350° until done.  Sprinkle with shredded Cheddar cheese and place back in oven until melted.  Cut in squares and serve.  This freezes well.

name: CRISCO POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
2 1/2  c. self-rising flour
5  large eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix Crisco  and  sugar.  Blend	milk,  flour,  eggs and vanilla with  the Crisco and sugar.  Bake at 300° for approximately 1 hour or until done.

name: APPLE BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. biscuit mix
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg
3  Tbsp. oil
3/4  c. milk
1  apple, finely chopped
preparation: Combine biscuit mix and sugar.  Combine egg, oil and milk. Beat well.  Stir in biscuit mix and sugar.  Mix well.  Stir in apples.  Pour into greased loaf pan.  Bake at 400° for 35 minutes.

name: NEVER FAIL FROSTING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
3  Tbsp. water
2  egg whites
preparation: Mix together.  Beat with mixer while cooking, about 3 minutes, until light fluffy.  Add 1 teaspoon vanilla.  Good with crushed pineapple for layer cake.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. yellow corn meal
1/3  c. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1 (8 3/4 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1/3  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a mixing bowl, combine corn meal, flour, sugar, salt, baking powder and baking soda.  Combine remaining ingredients and then add to the dry ingredients.  Stir only until moistened.  Pour into a greased 9 x 9-inch baking pan or 10-inch heavy skillet. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes, or until bread is golden brown and when toothpick in center comes out clean.

name: CRAB DIP
ingredients:
1  can crab meat
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
horseradish to taste
chili sauce
preparation: Mix. Spread in shallow dish. Spread chili sauce on top. Chill.

name: MARINATED BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. onions, thinly sliced
1/2  c. carrots, thinly sliced
1  clove garlic, peeled and crushed
2 3/4  c. red wine (dry)
1/2  tsp. bay leaves, crushed
1/2  Tbsp. black pepper
3  lb. lean beef (1-inch cubes), fat trimmed
1/4  c. flour
1  c. beef stock
preparation: Combine oil, onions, carrots, garlic, wine, bay leaves and pepper to form marinade.  Place beef in stainless steel bowl and pour half of marinade over beef.  Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours.  Turn meat once during marinating process.  Save rest of marinade in refrigerator for future use.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. diced, cooked chicken
1/2  c. finely diced apple
1/2  c. chopped ripe olives
1/2  c. diced celery
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. sour cream
preparation: Sprinkle lemon juice over chicken and apple, mixing lightly. Combine mayonnaise and sour cream.  Add olives and celery and mix. Then toss this mixture with chicken and apples.  Serve cold on lettuce leaf.

name: BEEF AND OLIVE SPREAD
ingredients:
1  tsp. dried minced onion
1  Tbsp. milk
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1 (2 1/2 oz.)  pkg. smoked sliced beef, chopped
1/4  c. chopped stuffed olives
preparation: In a small bowl, soften onion in milk.  Stir in cream cheese and mayonnaise.  Add beef and olives; mix well.  Chill.  Serve on crackers.  Yield:  1 1/2 cups.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white Karo
1  c. raw peanuts
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. butter
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix sugar and white Karo; cook 4 minutes on High.  Add peanuts and cook for 3 1/2 minutes.  Add vanilla and butter, then cook 1 1/2 minutes.  Remove from microwave and add soda; stir and mix. Pour onto buttered cookie sheet.  It should make 4 patties.  Let cool and it will come up.

name: PORK CHOPS WITH TOMATOES AND CREOLE MUSTARD
ingredients:
8  small or 4 large loin pork chops
1/4  c. olive oil
1/4  c. onion, minced
1/4  ??? green onions, minced
2  cloves garlic, minced
1/4  c. bell pepper, minced
1  c. tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
2  Tbsp. Creole mustard or coarse brown mustard
1/4  c. white wine
1  Tbsp. thyme
1  bay leaf
salt and pepper
preparation: Allow the chops to come to room temperature.  Heat the oil over moderate heat.  Brown the chops on both sides and reduce heat.  Cook slowly until done.  Do not overcook.  Remove chops and set aside.

name: HANKIE PANKIES
ingredients:
8  oz. ground beef
8  oz. sausage
8  oz. Velveeta cheese
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
2  loaves party rye
preparation: Brown ground beef and sausage in skillet, stirring until crumbly.  Drain.  Add cheese.  Stir until melted.  Stir in oregano and garlic powder.  Cool for several minutes.  Spread on bread slices.  Arrange slices on rack in broiler pan.  Broil until cheese is bubbly.  Place on serving platter.  Serve hot.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE 2
ingredients:
1  chicken
1 1/2  c. macaroni
1  can cream of chicken soup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook chicken and debone.  Cook macaroni in 1 cup of chicken broth and water.  Cook until tender.  Mix macaroni, chicken and soup together.  Add salt and pepper.  Add 1/2 cup of milk, if needed.  Pour in a 9 x 12-inch baking dish.  Bake about 30 minutes at 350°.  Cracker crumbs may be added the last 10 minutes of baking.

name: CUCUMBER SALAD
ingredients:
2  cucumbers or more, sliced
1/3  c. vinegar
2 to 3  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix cucumbers with sour cream, then mix vinegar and sugar. Add to cucumbers.  Let set in refrigerator until chilled.

name: PINEAPPLE NUT CAKE(Side Dish Served with Meat Dishes)
ingredients:
1 - 20  oz. can pineapple plus juice
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  c. chopped walnuts
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix all ingredients in order by hand.  Pour into greased loaf pan.  Bake at 350 degrees for 35 to 45 minutes.  To be served as a side dish with meat dishes.

name: MELT IN MOUTH COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. packed light brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. finely chopped nuts
preparation: Cream butter and sugar, vanilla and egg; beat until light. Add dry ingredients and nuts.  Bake at 400° for 5 minutes.

name: CRISP CRUSTED BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  (3 to 3 1/4 lb.) frying chicken, cut up
1  egg
2  Tbsp. milk
1  c. instant potato flakes
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. butter or margarine
celery leaves and thinly sliced celery (for garnish)
preparation: Wash chicken pieces and pat dry.  Set aside.  Beat egg and milk in a bowl.  In another bowl, mix potato flakes, garlic powder and cheese.  Roll chicken first in egg mix, then in the potato flake mixture.  Melt butter in a shallow baking pan.  Roll coated chicken pieces in the butter and place skin side up in a pan. Bake at 400° for 45 to 50 minutes or until juices from thighs run clear when pierced with a fork.

name: COLESLAW WITH FRUIT COCKTAIL
ingredients:
1  head shredded cabbage
1 large  can fruit cocktail, drained
Miracle Whip or mayonnaise
preparation: Shred cabbage.  Add drained fruit cocktail and mix with Miracle Whip or mayonnaise.  Mix well to have a coleslaw salad. Reserve a few cherries to put on top.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  can tomato paste
juice of 3 lemons
1  c. vinegar
1  bottle ketchup
1/2  bottle hot sauce
1  pt. water
1/2  c. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Let come to a boil.

name: BROCCOLI CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
4  c. chicken broth
1  c. water
1  c. half & half
4  slices Kraft Cheddar singles
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. dried minced onion
1/4  tsp. ground black pepper
4  c. broccoli florets, bite size
1/2  c. shredded cheddar cheese
2  tsp. fresh parsley, minced
preparation: Combine chicken broth, water, half & half, cheese, flour, onion and pepper in a large saucepan.  Whisk to combine and to break up any lumps of flour, then turn heat to medium/high.  Bring soup to a boil, then reduce heat to low.  Add broccoli to soup and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until broccoli is tender, but not soft.  For each serving spoon one cup of soup into a bowl and garnish with a tablespoon of shredded cheese and a pinch of parsley.  Makes 6 servings.

name: FRUIT SALAD(Mary Chalker)
ingredients:
1  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 1/2 to 2  c. miniature marshmallows
8  oz. sour cream
preparation: Mix together. Congeal overnight.

name: BLACKBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
5  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. berries and juice
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Cream together butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.  Combine dry ingredients and add alternately with berries and juice.  Add vanilla.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Makes 3 layers or can be baked in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Suggest icing with confectioners sugar icing flavored with cinnamon.

name: HOBO DINNER
ingredients:
1/4  lb. ground beef
1  big potato
1  sliced onion
1  sliced bell pepper
salt and pepper
preparation: Lay aluminum foil on pan.  Place beef, sliced potato, onion, bell pepper, salt and pepper.  Bake in oven for 1 hour at 375°. Serve with rice.

name: CORN BREAD SALAD
ingredients:
1  medium pan corn bread
1  lb. bacon
1  onion
1  bell pepper
4  tomatoes
1/2  c. pickles
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. pickle juice
preparation: Mix and drizzle over the salad.

name: SUGAR CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  egg
1  stick margarine, melted
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  eggs
1 (16 oz.)  box powdered sugar
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix next 3 ingredients and pour over mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: HAM HOCKS AND BLACK-EYED PEAS
ingredients:
1  lb. black-eyed peas
2  lb. ham hocks
2  onions, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
1  small bay leaf
1  clove garlic
1  hot red pepper
1  small tomato puree
2  tsp. chili sauce
boiling water
preparation: Wash peas.  Cover with boiling water.  Cook for 2 minutes and remove from heat.  Let soak 1 hour.  Boil the meat for 30 to 45 minutes in water and cover.  Add peas; cover and simmer until tender, about 3 hours.

name: NEVER FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
1 1/4  c. shortening
1  egg
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. salt
5  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Sift flour, blend in shortening until crumbs are the size of peas.  Beat egg; add vinegar, salt and water.  Mix with fork until mixture leaves the sides of bowl and forms a ball.  Roll out on floured surface.  Makes pastry for one 2-crust pie.

name: CONGEALED LIME SALAD(Weight Watchers)
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. lime jello
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
1  lb. cottage cheese
1  (8 oz.) pineapple yogurt
preparation: Drain pineapple juice in a cup and add enough water to equal 1 cup.  Heat and pour over jello.  Let cool and add the rest of the ingredients.

name: CREAM TACOS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can drained Ranch Style beans
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes with chives and chilies
1  can chili
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, diced
preparation: Brown and drain ground beef.  Place in crock-pot.  Add remaining ingredients to crock-pot.  Cook 2 hours on low.  Serve over chips of your choice.

name: KARIDOPETA(Walnut Cake)
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sugar
6  eggs, separated
1 1/2  c. ground zwieback (not fine)
1 1/2  c. ground walnuts
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. cinnamon (level)
2  tsp. baking powder (level)
preparation: Use 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.

name: SCOTCH BROTH
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lamb (boneless shoulder)
6  c. water
1/2  c. uncooked barley
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. carrots, sliced
2  stalks celery, sliced
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. diced turnips
preparation: Trim fat from lamb; cut into 3/4-inch pieces.  Heat lamb, water, barley, salt and pepper to boiling in Dutch oven.  Remove heat; cover and simmer for 1 hour.  Add vegetables.  Cover and simmer until lamb and vegetables are tender (approximately 30 minutes).  Skim fat from broth if necessary.

name: YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. warm water
1  egg
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. shortening
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. hot water
preparation: Mix yeast with warm water; let sit. Mix egg, sugar, shortening, flour and hot water. Add yeast mixture.  Add flour; work dough.  Brush top with oil; cover with cloth. Let rise until double in size. After dough rises, may refrigerate until ready to use.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2 1/4  c. sugar
2  c. grated zucchini
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. oil
3  tsp. vanilla
3  c. plain flour
2  tsp. soda
3  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Beat eggs; add oil, sugar, vanilla and zucchini.  Mix well, and add flour, salt, soda, cinnamon and baking powder.  Stir in nuts. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: SWEET POTATO PIEDallas, Texas
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. mashed sweet potatoes
3  eggs, beaten
1/3  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. Allspice
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. orange extract
1/2  c. milk
2  tsp. melted margarine
preparation: Stir together and add to unbaked pie crust.  Pre-heat oven to 450°.  Cook 10 minutes.  Reduce heat in oven to 350° and cook for 25 minutes.

name: ROOT BEER ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Betty Crocker white angel food cake mix
1 (12 oz.)  can root beer
preparation: Put cake mix into bowl and substitute root beer for water. Follow mixing instructions and baking instructions on label.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  eggs
1  c. tomato paste
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. cracker crumbs
salt to taste
pepper to taste
preparation: Mix together all ingredients and make a loaf. Bake in moderate oven at 350° about 1 1/2 hours. Serves 8.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
7  chicken breasts
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. onions, chopped
1 medium (16 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (2 lb.)  box Velveeta cheese, cut into chunks
chicken broth
preparation: Boil chicken until done; reserve the chicken broth.  Debone chicken and cut into pieces.  Saute celery and onions in butter until done.  Cook spaghetti in the reserved broth until done.  Add celery, onions, soup, cheese and chicken to spaghetti and broth. Cook until cheese is melted.  Serve hot.

name: MUSHROOM STEAK
ingredients:
1  pkg. round steak
2  cans golden mushroom soup
1/2  can water
1/2  can milk
mushrooms and onions (if desired)
preparation: Cut round steak in slices; put in crock-pot.  Mix soup, milk, water, mushrooms and onions; pour over steak.  Stir together. Cook 6 hours on high.

name: FRIED RICE
ingredients:
1/2  c. minced onion
3  Tbsp. cooking oil
6  c. cooked rice
1/2  c. cooked ham, chicken, pork or shellfish
1/4  c. water chestnuts or bamboo shoots
mushrooms, sliced or chopped
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  eggs, slightly beaten
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook onion in oil until it colors slightly.  Add rice and cook, stirring, over low heat 2 to 3 minutes, then add meat and water chestnuts (slivered or chopped).  Sliced or chopped mushrooms may be added with any of the ingredients or used alone. Mix well, then add soy sauce, eggs and seasonings to taste.  Cook, stirring, over low heat until the eggs are cooked (this will take only 2 or 3 minutes).  Trim with sliced green onions or more of same meat, slivered, that is used in the rice.  Makes 6 main dish servings or more as a side dish.

name: RIPE CUCUMBER PICKLES
ingredients:
7  lb. peeled cukes
3 1/2  lb. sugar
1  pt. vinegar
1/2  tsp. oil of cloves
1/2  tsp. oil of cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
2  tsp. alum
preparation: Cover cukes with cold water; add 1 teaspoon soda.  Soak overnight.  Drain.  Cover with cold water.  Add 2 teaspoons alum; boil 10 minutes.  Bring syrup of remaining ingredients to a boil; pour over fruit.  Let stand overnight.  The third day, repeat again.  The fourth day, reheat syrup and cukes together and seal in hot jars.

name: CORN MEAL TORTILLAS
ingredients:
3/4  c. corn meal
1 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Combine corn meal, flour and salt. Stir in shortening and boiling water. Shape to form 12 balls.  Roll out and press between wax paper to make 5-inch circles.  Bake on hot grill.

name: STUFFED ARTICHOKES
ingredients:
2  artichokes
5  c. plain bread crumbs
2  c. Romano cheese, grated
1  c. water
1  large onion, chopped
5  cloves garlic, minced
1  c. oil
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Wash and drain artichokes.  Rap artichokes (top) against countertop to open leaves.  Mix cheese, onions, garlic and bread crumbs.  Season to taste. Mix well. Stuff between leaves.  Place in a heavy gauge pot.  Add 1 cup water.  Pour oil over artichokes. Place in water.  Cook, covered, until one leaf can be pulled off. Serve hot.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. grated carrots
2 1/2  c. regular flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
4  eggs, well beaten
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine first 7 ingredients.  Stir in eggs, oil and vanilla. Mix well.  Pour into 9 x 13 pan.  Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.  Frost cake while warm.

name: CUCUMBER ONION SAUCE
ingredients:
3/4  c. Kraft cholesterol-free reduced-fat mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. Kraft pure prepared mustard
2 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Good on onions or cucumber.  Chill.

name: PICKLED BEANS
ingredients:
fresh green beans
1  (8 oz.) vinegar
1  (7 oz.) coarse salt
1  gal. water
preparation: Cook beans until tender.  Place in quart jars.  Bring vinegar, salt and water to a hard boil.  Pour over beans in jars and seal.

name: TEA CAKES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. shortening
4  Tbsp. milk
4  c. flour (self-rising)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar, milk, eggs and flavoring.  Add enough flour for stiff dough.  Roll 1/4-inch thick.  Cut with a biscuit cutter.  Chill dough.  (Make in morning, bake in evening.)  Bake on greased cookie sheet until golden brown.  You can put the remainder in rolls and put in freezer wrapped in waxed paper.

name: ORIENTAL CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  (3 lb.) fryer, halved, quartered or pieces
1 (13 1/2 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
1  c. Basic Barbecue Sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. soy sauce
2  tsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. pineapple syrup or water
1/2  diced green pepper
1 (11 oz.)  can drained mandarin oranges
6  maraschino cherries, halved
preparation: Place chicken, skin side down, in shallow baking dish.  Drain pineapple, measure 1/2 cup syrup.  Add to Basic Barbecue Sauce in a saucepan.  Stir in salt, ginger and soy sauce.  Blend cornstarch with tablespoon pineapple syrup or water; blend with sauce.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.  Brush chicken with mixture.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour, brushing occasionally, with sauce and turn once after 30 minutes.  Add pineapple, green pepper, oranges and cherries to remaining sauce.  Heat and pour over chicken the last 5 minutes of baking time.

name: BISCUIT SNACKS
ingredients:
1 small  can pork and beans
3  cut up hot dogs
1/4  c. barbecue sauce
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1/4  c. shredded cheese
1  can biscuits
preparation: Mix pork and beans, hot dogs, barbecue sauce, brown sugar and onion all together.  Set off to side and put biscuits in muffin tins.  Make a big dent in the middle of each.  Pour your mixture in the dent.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes on 425°.  Take out and sprinkle with cheese.

name: RHUBARB NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. light brown sugar
2/3  c. oil
1  egg
1  tsp. soda
1  c. sour milk
1/2  c. white sugar
1  Tbsp. margarine
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. diced raw rhubarb
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream oil, sugar and eggs well.  Add the soda to the sour milk, stirring to dissolve.  Add to creamed mixture.  Pre-sift flour and salt.  Add to creamed mixture; blend well.  Add vanilla, rhubarb and nuts.  Pour into 2 greased bread pans.  Mix white sugar and margarine and sprinkle over top.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. rice, cooked until water gone
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. flour
1  can milk, diluted
2  egg yolks
preparation: Mix last 5 ingredients together.  Mix in rice and bring to a full boil.

name: ORIENTAL CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  pkg. Oriental beef noodles (Oodles of Noodles)
1  pkg. frozen peas
1/2  red pepper, cut up
1/2  green pepper, cut up
1/2  c. cider vinegar
1/2  c. slivered almonds (optional)
2  pkg. Equal
1/2  c. oil
1/2  head red cabbage
1/4  head white cabbage
preparation: Mix  peas,  peppers,  cabbages  and  crushed noodles in bowl.

name: GRANDMA'S PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  can or 3 c. pumpkin
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. salt
8  eggs, well beaten
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  Tbsp. ginger
1  can evaporated milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake in pastry shell at 450° for 10 minutes.  Lower oven to 325° and bake for 30 to 40 minutes. Makes 1 large or 2 small pies.

name: HOT ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. sweet milk
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. Crisco
1  c. lukewarm water
1  pkg. Fleischmann's dry yeast
4  c. flour
preparation: Put milk, sugar, salt and Crisco in pan and heat to lukewarm. Set aside.

name: WILLY'S BARBECUED KRAUT
ingredients:
5 to 6  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
1  large onion, chopped
2  cans tomatoes, chopped
1  c. brown sugar
dash of A.1. sauce
2 (2 lb.)  cans chopped kraut
1 1/2  c. barbecue sauce
preparation: In iron skillet, cook and crumble bacon.  In bacon grease, cook onion until tender.  Add 2 cans tomatoes.  Add brown sugar and A.1. sauce.  Simmer 10 to 15 minutes.  Mix in kraut.  Mix and put in 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.  Pour barbecue sauce over kraut.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: DIRT PUDDING
ingredients:
2 small  boxes vanilla pudding (instant)
3  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
24  oz. Cool Whip
2 large  pkg. cream cheese
1 (10 oz.)  box confectioners sugar
2  pkg. Oreo cookies
preparation: Run Oreo cookies through a blender or food processor.  Cream together the cream cheese and sugar.  Set aside.

name: SWEET AND SOUR SPINACH DRESSING
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. celery seed
paprika and salt to taste
preparation: Combine sugar and vinegar in small microwave bowl.  Microwave on High 2 to 3 minutes, stirring once or until sugar dissolves. Pour vinegar mixture into jar and add oil, celery seed, paprika and salt. Cover tightly and shake well. Chill.  Pour over salad and toss.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1/3  c. syrup (white)
2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook sugar, milk and syrup to soft ball stage; remove from heat.  Beat in chocolate and nuts.  Add vanilla.  Beat until creamy.  Turn into 8 x 8-inch buttered pan.  Yields 25 servings.

name: CREAMED CORN(Ala Ruth)
ingredients:
10  ears sweet corn
1  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar (optional)
1/4  tsp. black pepper
3  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cut corn off cob to about 3/4 of the ear's depth.  Remove remaining corn from cobs with a flat blade knife by scraping the cob.  Yield approximately  5 cups corn.  Stir in milk, salt, sugar and pepper until blended.  Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish and dot with butter.  Bake in 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until corn is tender.

name: CHRISTMAS BARK CANDY
ingredients:
1 (10 to 12 oz.)  pkg. vanilla chips or milk chocolate chips
2  tsp. vegetable oil
1 1/4 to 1 1/2  c. M&M's miniature baking bits or broken pretzel pieces
preparation: In a microwave-safe bowl, heat chips and oil at 70% power for 1 minute; stir.  Microwave 10 to 20 seconds longer or until chips are melted, stirring occasionally.  Cool for 5 minutes.  Stir in baking bits or pretzels.  Spread onto a waxed paper-lined baking sheet. Chill for 10 minutes.  Remove from the refrigerator; break into pieces.  Store in an airtight container at room temperature. Yield:  about 1 pound.

name: HONEYED CARROTS WITH BACON
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. sliced carrots
1 1/2  Tbsp. margarine
4  slices cooked, crumbled bacon
2  Tbsp. sliced scallion
1  Tbsp. honey
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. soy sauce
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: In a medium saucepan, bring 3/4 cup water to a boil.  Add carrots.  Cover and simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally, 10 to 12 minutes or until tender.  Drain carrots. In same saucepan, melt butter.  Stir in carrots and remaining ingredients.  Cover and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 5 to 7 minutes or until heated through.  Serves 6.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  (9 oz.) pie crust mix
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
3  Tbsp. water
preparation: Mix well.  Roll into  small  balls.  Press with a fork. Cook at 350° for 8 minutes.

name: HAYSTACK EGGS
ingredients:
1 3/4  oz. can shoestring potatoes
4  eggs
4  oz. shredded  Cheddar cheese (1 c.)
6  slices bacon, crisply cooked and crumbled
1  tsp. finely chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Butter 8 or 9-inch glass pie plate or round baking dish.  Spread shoestring potatoes evenly over bottom of pan. Makes 4 indentations into potatoes, down to bottom of dish, each about 1 1/2-inches across.  Carefully break 1 egg into each indentation.  Bake at 350° for 3 to 10 minutes; add cheese and parsley.  Return to oven and bake until cheese melts and eggs are set.  Cut into 4 wedges and serve immediately.

name: MEAT LOAF WITH GRAVY
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  envelope Lipton dry onion soup mix
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix hamburger, salt and pepper.  Shape into a loaf.  Tear a long piece of foil and place on cookie sheet or a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Place the meat in middle of foil.  Mix the two soups together and pour over the meat.  Sprinkle the dry soup mix on top.  Bring foil over the top and seal all edges.  Put in a preheated 350° oven and bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. squash
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  egg
1/2  stick butter
1/2  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. bell pepper
salt and pepper to taste
Ritz cracker crumbs
preparation: Cook squash and drain.  Add other ingredients except crumbs. Put in casserole dish.  Top with cracker crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: BRUNCH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. Owens sausage
1 (8 oz.)  can crescent dinner rolls (refrigerated)
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Mozzarella cheese
3  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Crumble sausage in medium skillet; cook over medium heat until brown, stirring occasionally.  Drain well.  Line bottom of buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with crescent rolls, firmly pressing perforations to seal.  Sprinkle with sausage and cheese. Combine remaining ingredients; beat well and pour over sausage. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until set.  Let stand 5 minutes. Cut into squares and serve immediately.  Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: GOODY BARS
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
1  c. peanut butter
1  pkg. small marshmallows
1  c. peanuts
preparation: Melt all ingredients together.  Spread on a cookie sheet. Chill and cut.

name: BREAKFAST RING
ingredients:
2  lb. pork sausage
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped
1 1/2  c. toasted bread crumbs
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Lightly butter a 9-inch tube or Bundt pan. Mix ingredients well; pack into pan.  Bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven; drain off fat.  Return to oven; bake 20 minutes more.  Turn onto heated platter; fill center with scrambled eggs. May be served with country fried or hash brown potatoes.

name: EGGPLANT
ingredients:
1  eggplant, peeled and cut in 1-inch cubes
1/2  c. milk
1  small onion
1/2  c. buttered crumbs
1  egg, beaten
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Cook eggplant in boiling salted water for 8 minutes, drain. Add egg, milk, butter, onion and dry crumbs.  Place in greased casserole and top with buttered crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SWEET POTATOES-AND-APPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  small sweet potatoes (1 1/2 lb.), peeled and sliced
2  cooking apples (1 lb.), cored and sliced
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
dash of white pepper
2  Tbsp. reduced calorie margarine, melted
preparation: Layer half each of sweet potatoes and apples in an 8-inch square baking dish coated with vegetable cooking spray.  Combine sugar, cinnamon and white pepper. Sprinkle half of mixture over potatoes and apples. Drizzle with half of the margarine.  Repeat procedure with remaining ingredients.  Cover casserole and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Yields 8 servings with 120 calories per 1/2 cup.

name: ANTS ON A LOG
ingredients:
fresh celery
peanut butter
raisins
preparation: Cut celery in 6-inch sticks.  Fill with peanut butter and add raisins on top of peanut butter.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. grated zucchini
1  c. grated carrot
1  onion, chopped fine
1  bell pepper, chopped fine
1  c. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick butter or margarine
1  pkg. herbed stuffing mix
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Pour melted butter over stuffing mix; set aside.  Combine all other ingredients in a large bowl.  Stir in half of the stuffing mix; toss to mix.  Spread vegetable mixture into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Sprinkle the remaining half of the stuffing mixture on top.   Bake for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: PERSIAN MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef, turkey or lamb or any combination
2  eggs
juice of 1/2 lemon
1  medium onion, finely chopped
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. green onion, finely chopped
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. parsley, finely chopped
1/2  tsp. cracked peppercorns
3  whole pimentos, cut up
1  orange, peeled, seeded and diced
preparation: Mix ingredients together in a bowl with your fingers.  Pack into buttered pottery loaf pan, bake at 350° for about one hour (or more if you like it nice and brown).

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. margarine
1  can mushrooms, sliced (3 to 4 oz.)
1  c. seasoned chicken broth
3  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. half and half
3  oz. Swiss cheese, grated
2  c. diced chicken breasts
8  oz. vermicelli, cooked and drained
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
salt and pepper
1/4  oz. milk
preparation: In a large saucepan, saute the mushrooms in margarine until golden. Add chicken broth with milk to measure 1 1/4 cups. Set aside. Blend flour into mushrooms, then gradually blend in broth, milk and half and half.  Cook and stir until thickened.  Stir in Swiss cheese and stir until it melts. Fold in chicken. Season with salt and pepper.  Put vermicelli in greased 2-quart baking dish. Top with Parmesan.  Bake in a 375° oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly and top is golden.

name: CHEESE LOG
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
4  oz. chopped green chilies
4  oz. chopped pimientos
4  to 5 chopped ripe olives
4  oz. cream cheese
preparation: Velveeta cheese and cream cheese need to be at room temperature.  Roll Velveeta cheese out to 1/4 inch thick between 2 sheets of wax paper.  Spread cream cheese on top.   Sprinkle with green chilies (drained), chopped pimientos (drained), and chopped olives (drained).

name: SWEDISH NUT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (juice included)
preparation: Mix together, by hand, all the ingredients.  Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: APPLESAUCE TREAT
ingredients:
1  can applesauce
2 to 3  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
raisins (optional)
preparation: Pour applesauce into a saucepan and add remaining ingredients. Heat through over medium heat until butter melts and mixture is hot.  This can be served at breakfast as well as lunch and dinner.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. cooking oil
2  c. sugar
2  c. grated zucchini, drained
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Beat eggs, then add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla, creaming together.  Sift together dry ingredients.  Add to creamed mixture and mix thoroughly.  Add nuts.   Bake in 2 greased loaf pans at 325° for 1 hour.

name: HAMBURGER SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger meat
1  can tomato soup
1/2  moon Cheddar cheese
1  onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. spaghetti, cooked
preparation: Brown onion, drain grease and brown meat.  Add cheese.  Add soup.  Mix spaghetti and top with cheese.  Bake at 300° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: BLUEBERRY HOT BREAD
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1/4  c. melted butter
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking powder
2  c. blueberries (fresh or frozen without syrup)
preparation: Beat together eggs and sugar. Add milk and melted butter. Add flour, salt and baking powder. Mix until just combined; do not try to get it smooth. Toss blueberries in a little flour to keep them from sinking to the bottom of the bread. Fold blueberries into mixture. Pour into 2 small, very well greased bread tins. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: RUTH'S QUICHE LORRAINE
ingredients:
9-inch pie crust
12  slices bacon
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1/3  c. onion
4  eggs
2  c. whipping or light cream
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. sugar
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
preparation: Cook bacon crisp and crumble.  Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion on pastry.  Blend remaining ingredients with rotary beater and pour into pie shell.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.  Lower heat to 300° and bake for 30 minutes.  Insert knife; when it comes out clean, it is done.  Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting.

name: PASTRY FOR 9-INCH PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour, sifted
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
4 to 5  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Sift flour and salt into a bowl. Cut in shortening using a pastry blender or fork until the pieces are the size of small peas. (For extra tender pastry, cut half the shortening into the flour and salt until the mixture looks like cornmeal. Then cut in remaining shortening until the mixture looks like small peas.) Sprinkle 1 tablespoon water over part of  mixture. Gently toss with fork; push to side of bowl. Sprinkle next tablespoon of water over dry part; mix lightly. Push to moistened part at side. Repeat until all is moistened. Form into ball. Flatten ball on lightly floured surface. Roll from center to edge until dough is 1/8-inch thick. Fit pastry into 9-inch pie plate. Trim 1/2 to 1-inch beyond edge; fold under and flute. Prick bottom and sides well with a fork. Bake in 450° oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden.

name: PUNCH FOR 100 PEOPLE
ingredients:
2 (46 oz.)  cans pineapple juice
4 (12 oz.)  cans frozen lemonade
4  pkg. Kool-Aid (orange)
2  qt. bottles ginger ale
5 1/2  c. sugar
1  gal. water
preparation: Mix ingredients.

name: TURKEY CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey
1  chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can tomatoes
1  can Ranch Style beans
preparation: Sear ground turkey and onion in skillet. Drain off any grease. Put in saucepan and add salt, pepper, chili powder, Ro-Tel and tomatoes.  Cook about 20 minutes.  Add the beans.  Cook 15 more minutes.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  large chicken breasts
2  pkg. frozen broccoli
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2 to 1  c. Miracle Whip
3/4  tsp. curry powder
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 large  pkg. sharp Cheddar cheese
Ritz crackers
preparation: Steam chicken with onion and celery leaves until tender (about 1 hour), then bone chicken.  Cook broccoli.  In buttered pan (9 x 13-inch), layer broccoli.  Mix together soup, Miracle Whip, curry powder and lemon juice. Spread over chicken.  Spread grated cheese (save some) over soup mixture, then crumble Ritz crackers over grated cheese and then rest of cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes, covered with foil.  Uncover and bake another 10 minutes. Cool 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

name: MEAL-IN-A-DISH
ingredients:
Irish potatoes
onions
1  can cream-style corn
catsup
sausage patties
salt
pepper
preparation: In a baking dish, place 3 or 4 layers of Irish potatoes (sliced) and about 2 layers of sliced onions.  Salt to taste.  Add cream-style corn and blobs of catsup.  Top with sausage patties.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. cooked rice
2  c. milk
1  c. sugar or a little more
1/4  stick butter
2  eggs, separated
pinch of salt
raisins
preparation: Beat egg yolks lightly.  Add salt and sugar.  Mix in the butter.  Stir in the milk.  Add cooked rice and raisins.  Stir in vanilla.  Fold in egg whites, stiffly beaten.  Pour into greased pan; bake in a 450° oven until light brown.

name: BANANA MUFFINS
ingredients:
3  sticks margarine
1  c. sugar
5  bananas
4  c. flour
4  eggs
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  c. raisins
1  c. walnuts
1  Tbsp. nutmeg
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream the sugar and margarine.  Add eggs and pureed bananas. Cream all of them well. Pour in flour and baking powder. Add all the rest of the ingredients.  Grease muffin tin and bake at 450° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: CHRISTMAS CANDY
ingredients:
2  lb. almond bark
1  c. crunchy peanut butter
2  c. dry roasted peanuts
2  c. miniature marshmallows
3  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Melt Almond Bark and peanut butter together in heavy saucepan. Stir constantly.  Pour over remaining ingredients and mix well. Drop by tsp. on waxed paper.

name: WARM CRANAPPLE CINNAMON PUNCH
ingredients:
1  qt. cranapple juice
4  cinnamon sticks
1  pkg. red cinnamon candies
vodka to taste
preparation: Warm the cranapple juice and cinnamon sticks, stirring occasionally.  Next, add cinnamon candies to taste.  Add vodka. Stir until cinnamon candies dissolve.  Serve warm, keeping punch over low flame.  Do not bring to boil.

name: PUMPKIN ROLL
ingredients:
3/4  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. pumpkin
preparation: Sift flour, soda, cinnamon and salt together.  Mix eggs, sugar and pumpkin together; add to flour mixture; stir, mixing well. Grease a 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet and line with waxed paper; grease paper also and pour in batter.  Sprinkle with nuts.  Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.  Before done, take a kitchen towel, sprinkle with powdered sugar and rub in.  When done, turn onto towel and roll up with paper on.  Let cool 30 minutes.

name: CHIPPED BEEF DIP
ingredients:
1/4  c. green pepper
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. milk
1 (2 1/2 oz.)  pkg. chipped beef
2  Tbsp. onion flakes
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  c. pecans
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Finely chop green pepper and mix with cream cheese, milk, chipped beef, onion, sour cream and garlic.  In a pan, saute pecans, butter and salt.  Spread pecan mixture over beef mixture and bake at 350° for 20 minutes or longer if dip has been refrigerated.

name: EASY PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, lightly beaten
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. light or dark syrup
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
1 1/2  c. pecans
1  unbaked 9-inch pie shell
preparation: In a large bowl, stir together all ingredients but pecans. Stir until well blended.  Pour into pie shell. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.  Cool.

name: BEEF AND BEAN ROUND-UP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion or 1 Tbsp. instant minced onion
1  c. barbecue sauce
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 (16 oz.)  can Green Giant baked style beans
1 (10 oz.)  can Hungry Jack refrigerated flaky biscuits
1/2  c. (2 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  In skillet, brown ground beef and onion; drain.  Stir in barbecue sauce, brown sugar and beans; heat until bubbly.  Pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole.  Separate dough into 10 biscuits; cut each biscuit in half crosswise.  Place biscuits cut-side-down over hot meat mixture in spoke fashion around edge of casserole.  Sprinkle cheese over biscuits.  Bake at 375° for 22 to 27 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.  Serves 6.

name: IRISH FRUIT CAKES
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. flour
1  lb. sugar
1  lb. butter or margarine
3  lb. raisins
1 1/2  lb. mixed peel
10  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. lemon rind
1/2  c. whiskey or brandy
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar well.  In separate bowl, mix salt, cinnamon and nutmeg with flour.  Alternately add eggs and flour mixture to creamed butter and sugar.  Add fruit, lemon rind, whiskey and lemon juice.  Place in a well-greased pan and bake at 350° for an hour, then at 300° for another hour.  Remove from oven and let cool.  When cool, pour more whiskey on top and wrap in foil.  Store in airtight tin.  Makes 3 cakes.

name: 8 LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  head lettuce
1  small sweet onion, sliced thin
1  green pepper
3  celery stalks, cut small
1  pkg. frozen peas, cooked, drained and cooled (10 oz.  size)
1/2  pt. Hellmann's mayonnaise (spread on)
5 or 6  oz. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1/2  lb. bacon, cooked crisp, drained and broken up fine
preparation: Layer each ingredient in order listed.  Do not stir.  Let stand overnight.  Cover with foil.  Put ingredients in a large bowl or pan.

name: SOUTHERN NUT DESSERT
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
2  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
fresh berries or fruit
whipped cream
preparation: In large bowl, beat eggs until light.  Slowly beat in sugar and baking powder.  Continue beating for 5 minutes, until light and lemon colored.  Mix in nuts.  Generously butter 8-inch square pan.  Pour in mixture.  Smooth top evenly.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes until top feels dry.  Cool.  Press dry "shell" on top down.  Cut into squares.  Top with fruit and whipped cream.

name: CHICKEN PRIMAVERA
ingredients:
1  can cream of celery soup or 1 can cream of chicken soup
1/3  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. paprika
2  whole chicken breasts, split, skinned and deboned
2  c. thinly sliced vegetables (celery, green pepper, sweet red pepper or green onions)
preparation: In skillet, blend first 3 ingredients.  Stir in chicken and vegetables.  Over medium heat, heat to boiling and reduce heat to low.  Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until chicken is tender, stirring occasionally.  Serve over hot cooked rice.  This is quick and very good.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
1/2  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1  c. milk
1/4  tsp. black pepper
3/4 to 1  c. chopped onions
1  egg
2  Tbsp. ketchup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. paprika
preparation: Mix together beef, onions, crumbs, egg, ketchup, milk and seasonings.  Mold into a round flat loaf and bake in a 9-inch pan at 350°.

name: STRAWBERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. chopped strawberries
3/4  c. sugar
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. margarine, melted
2  eggs
2  c. La Creme whipped topping with real cream
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  tsp. milk
preparation: Combine strawberries and 1/4 cup sugar.  Combine remaining dry ingredients.  Add margarine, eggs and strawberry mixture.  Fold in 1 1/2 cups whipped topping.  Pour in a greased 9 x 15-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Combine the cream cheese and milk. Mix at medium speed until well blended.  Fold in remaining topping and spread on cooled bread.

name: CABBAGE SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. tomato juice (or V8 juice)
2  c. water
2  c. beef bouillon
1  medium head cabbage, chopped
3  or 4 celery stalks, chopped
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook all ingredients until cabbage and celery are tender. Add chunks of cooked chicken for a variation.

name: HUMMUS
ingredients:
2  c. canned chickpeas, drained (reserve liquid)
1 1/2  tsp. salt
4  minced garlic cloves
1/3  c. tahini (sesame paste)
6  Tbsp. freshly squeezed lemon juice
2  Tbsp. liquid from chickpeas
8  dashes Tabasco sauce
preparation: Place all ingredients in a food processor with a steel blade and process until hummus is coarsely pureed. Taste for seasoning and serve chilled or at room temperature with pita chips or pita bread.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. meal
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. buttermilk
2  eggs
1/4  c. jalapeno peppers
1/2  c. onions
1/2  c. creamed corn
1/2  c. oil
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Mix dry ingredients. Add onions and peppers. Stir in buttermilk and eggs; mix well. Add creamed corn and oil. Stir, then add cheese. Bake at 425° for 25 minutes.

name: CREAMY ORANGE DESSERT
ingredients:
1 (8 serving)  pkg. orange flavored gelatin
1 1/2  c. warm water
1 1/2  c. mini-marshmallows
2  c. vanilla ice cream or frozen yogurt
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin orange segments, drained
preparation: Mix gelatin and water in 2 1/2 to 3-quart microwavable bowl. Microwave on High 1 1/2 minutes.  Stir to dissolve completely.  Add marshmallows; microwave 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until marshmallows are puffed and almost melted.  Stir mixture slowly until marshmallows are completely melted and mixture is smooth.  Add ice cream.  Stir with wire whisk until melted.  Stir in oranges; pour into 6 cup ring mold.  Refrigerate 45 minutes or until set.  To unmold, dip in hot water 10 to 15 seconds.  Gently pull gelatin from edges with moist fingers.  Place moistened serving plate on top of mold.  Invert, holding mold and plate together.  Shake slightly to loosen.  Gently remove mold.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
2  cans beans
2  onions
2  lb. hamburger, browned
1  bell pepper
2  cans tomatoes (1 stewed and 1 sauce)
salt, pepper, cinnamon and garlic
2  cans water
chili seasoning mix (McCormick)
preparation: Mix all together.  Put food in crock-pot.  Cook on low for 10 to 12 hours, on high for 6 to 7 hours or on auto 6 to 8 hours.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. melted margarine
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  unbaked 9-inch pie shell
preparation: Beat eggs slightly and add sugar and flour. Then add melted margarine and mix well. Add buttermilk and vanilla. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325° until custard is set.

name: LOW-FAT ORANGE BRAN MUFFINS*
ingredients:
1  c. whole wheat flour
3/4  c. wheat bran
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1/8  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. grated orange peel
1  egg white
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. dark molasses
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In small bowl, combine flour, bran, baking soda, salt and orange peel.  In large mixing bowl, beat egg white; whip in oil, molasses and buttermilk.  Add dry ingredients to liquid mixture, mixing just until moistened.  Fold in raisins. Spoon batter into paper-lined muffin pans or pans prepared with nonstick vegetable spray.   Serve warm or cold.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  to 8 chicken breasts
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  carton sour cream
1  roll Ritz crackers
2 1/2  tsp. poppy seed
1 1/2  sticks margarine
preparation: Cook chicken; debone and tear into pieces.  Put chicken in a 7 x 11-inch buttered casserole; mix the soup and sour cream and pour over chicken.  Crush the Ritz crackers and combine with the poppy seed.  Sprinkle over soup mixture.  Melt margarine and pour over top.  Cook 40 to 45 minutes at 350°, until bubbly and brown. Serves 8.

name: SWISS STEAK RANCH STYLE
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak (3/4-inch thick), cut into 6 pieces
1/2  c. flour
3  Tbsp. shortening
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  garlic clove, crushed
1  medium onion, sliced
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. onion salt
1  c. water
preparation: Cut round steak into 6 pieces.  Pound flour into the meat. Brown well in shortening.  Season with salt and pepper.  Add garlic and onion and continue cooking until the onion is tender and browned.  Add paprika, onion salt and water.  Cover and bake in a moderate oven (375°) for 2 hours, or until meat is tender. Add more water if necessary.  Makes 6 servings.

name: COCONUT BONBONS
ingredients:
2  boxes powdered sugar
1  stick margarine
1  c. coconut
1  c. nuts
1  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Mix with hands and roll into bite size balls.  Melt 1/4 bar paraffin with 1 (6 ounce) bag chocolate morsels.  Dip balls into heated mixture and place on wax paper.

name: HOT COCOA MIX
ingredients:
2  lb. cocoa mix (for adding milk)
7  qt. packets powdered milk
1 large  jar powdered cream (e.g. Coffee-mate)
preparation: Carefully blend together all ingredients (will throw  dust if stirred rapidly) and store in gallon jar.  Use 2 tablespoons mix per mug with very hot water to make hot cocoa.  Great for camping and retreats.

name: PRIZE WINNING APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
5  raw apples
1  c. chopped pecans
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening together.  Add eggs and mix well. Add dry ingredients and then nuts and apples that have been well chopped.  Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: CHOCOLATE ZUCCHINI CAKE
ingredients:
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. oil
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  egg whites
1/2  c. skim milk
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/4  c. white flour
1 1/4  c. whole wheat flour
1/4  c. cocoa powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. grated zucchini
1/2  c. chocolate chips (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine vanilla, oil, sugar, egg whites and skim milk.  Sift together baking soda, flours, cocoa, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt.  Add dry ingredients alternately with zucchini to the first mixture.  Stir in 1/2 cup chocolate chips, if desired.

name: CALIFORNIA VEGETABLE PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. chopped beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  c. sliced zucchini
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  tsp. dill seed
2  Tbsp. oleo
1 (8 oz.)  can crescent rolls
1  c. shredded Cheddar
tomato slices
preparation: Brown  beef  and onion, then drain.  Saute zucchini and green pepper  in oleo for 5 minutes, stirring often.  Stir in dill seed.  Separate  dough  into  triangles  and  press into bottom of	a 9-inch ungreased pie plate to form crust.  Spoon in  meat mixture.  Sprinkle 1/2 cup Cheddar over meat.  Spread zucchini, green pepper and  dill over meat and top with tomato slices. Bake 10 minutes  at  375°.	Take  out  of  oven  and sprinkle remaining cheese  over  tomatoes  and bake 15 minutes more.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. cooked squash
1  onion
8  oz. sour cream
1  bag Pepperidge Farm mix
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick margarine
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mash squash; add salt, diced onion, sour cream, soup and 3/4 bag of dressing mix.  Put in buttered baking dish.  Melt margarine and mix with remaining crumbs.  Spread over top of squash.  Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 50 minutes.  Serve warm.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage (hot, mild or sage)
1  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
3  c. Bisquick
preparation: Mix all of the ingredients well.  Pinch of small pieces and roll into balls smaller than ping-pong balls.  Bake on an ungreased sheet at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown. These are great served warm.

name: GRILLED FISH WITH GARLIC MAYONNAISE
ingredients:
4  (6 to 8 oz. each) fish steaks, 1-inch thick (halibut, salmon, etc.)
3  cloves garlic
1 1/2  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. ground red pepper
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Place garlic, paprika, red pepper and salt in blender and add 1/4 cup mayonnaise.  Blend until garlic is minced and mixed into sauce.  Add remaining mayonnaise and process until smooth.

name: DESSERT PANCAKES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter, melted
3/4  c. milk
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
water
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, butter, milk and eggs together.  Add just enough water to be able to pour batter.  In a nonstick pan, pour batter, 1/4 cup per pancake.  Cook at 350° until bubbles form. Turn and cook until second side is brown.

name: CHERRY-WALNUT BARS
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. butter/margarine (soft)
2  eggs
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (2 oz.)  jar maraschino cherries
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
1/2  c. coconut
1  Tbsp. soft butter
1  c. powdered sugar
cherry liquid
preparation: Combine soft butter and powdered sugar with enough cherry liquid to spread.  Frost.  Sprinkle with coconut, if desired.

name: STICKY BUNS
ingredients:
24  frozen dinner rolls
1  (3 oz.) regular butterscotch pudding
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. pecans
1  stick margarine, cut up
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Combine butterscotch, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, pecans and margarine.  Sprinkle over rolls.  Put in a large pan.  Let raise overnight.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  cans crushed pineapple
1 small  can mandarin oranges
maraschino cherries
1/2  pkg. miniature marshmallows
