1/4  pt. sour cream (or whipped cheese)
1/2  c. walnuts
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Chill until ready to serve.

name: TOFU MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3/4  c. onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (1 1/4 oz.)  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  pkg. tortilla chips
1  lb. Jack cheese, grated
1 (17 oz.)  pkg. tofu, crumbled
1/2  c. cheese, grated
preparation: Saute onion in oil until tender. Add tomatoes, taco seasoning mix, salt and green chilies.  Simmer, uncovered, 10 to 15 minutes. In a  lightly greased 2-quart casserole, arrange 1/2 of each of the following in layers:  tortilla chips, sauce, cheese and tofu. Repeat layers.  Bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and bake an additional 10 minutes.  Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting into squares.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  pkg. yeast
1  c. shortening
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: The above measurements may be cut in half for smaller families.

name: ANGEL FOOD SURPRISE
ingredients:
1  angel food cake mix
1 1/2  c. strawberries
8  oz. strawberry yogurt
12  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake as directed; cool.  Cut cake in half.  Cut out 1- inch trench on bottom.  Spoon in 1 cup of sliced strawberries. Put top of cake on.  Mix yogurt, Cool Whip and 1/2 cup of crushed strawberries.  Cover cake with this mixture.  Keep refrigerated.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  stalk celery
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  green onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Roll into ball.  Just before serving roll into pecans, sunflower, walnuts or whatever you choose.

name: CHERRY-COKE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. black-cherry Jell-O
1  c. hot water or drained pineapple juice and cherry juice (hot)
1  c. Coca-Cola
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  can pitted black Bing cherries, drained
2  Tbsp. coarsely chopped pecans
1  c. petite marshmallows
preparation: Dissolve gelatin by adding 1 cup hot liquid.  Add Coca-Cola. Put in refrigerator until gelatin begins to set.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Pour mixture in individual molds or square (8 x 8-inch) dish.

name: PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. water
1  tsp. oil
desired food coloring, or 1 pkg. of unsweetened Kool-Aid can be used tomake a nice aroma as well as color
1  c. flour
1/2  c. salt
2  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Mix water, oil, and coloring. Mix in flour, salt, and cream of tartar. Cook on stovetop until dough adheres, stirring constantly (about 6-7 minutes). Store in Ziploc bags or an airtight container.

name: FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. pecans
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. raisins
1  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Bake at 350° until golden brown.  Makes 1 pie.

name: BARBECUED SPARERIBS
ingredients:
2  pounds spareribs
1/2  cup light molasses
1/2  cup ketchup
1/2  cup chopped onions
1  clove garlic, minced
3  whole cloves
4  - diced narrow strips of orange rind
juice of 1/2 orange
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp salad oil
1/2  teaspoon prepared mustard
1/4  teaspoon salt
1/4  teaspoon pepper
1 Tbsp  bottle meat sauce (A-1)
1/2  teaspoon Tabasco
1  Tbsp butter or margarine
preparation: Start heating oven to 325°.  Place spareribs that have been cut into single ribs into shallow open pan.  Cover with foil. Roast 1/2 hour.  Pour off fat.  Roast 1/2 hour longer.

name: CHINESE EGG ROLL PANCAKES
ingredients:
6  eggs (beaten)
1  c. water
2  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. fat
preparation: Beat the eggs and water in bowl.  Sift in the flour and salt; beat until smooth with a rotary beater.

name: KIM'S EGG SOUFFL{2E
ingredients:
16  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled (reserve drippings)
2  sliced onions
12  slices white bread, quartered
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
8  eggs, beaten
4  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Saute  onions in bacon drippings until soft.  Place 1/2 of bread  on  bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle 1/2 bacon, onions and cheese on bread.  Repeat.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans mixed vegetables, drained
1  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  tube Ritz crackers
canned chicken or ground beef, browned
preparation: Mix. Put in casserole dish.  Crumble Ritz crackers on top and dribble 1 stick or less melted oleo over all.  Cook at 350° until bubbly (about 25 minutes), then brown top under broiler.

name: BUTTERNUT SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. mashed butternut squash
3  beaten eggs
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/3  c. margarine, melted
2  Tbsp. flaked coconut
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. coconut flavoring
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Pour into lightly greased casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CARAMEL PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  c. sweet milk
1/4  c. white sugar
1  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Add enough flour to make a stiff dough to the sweet milk, white sugar, butter and baking powder.  Drop by spoonfuls into sauce.

name: PINTO BEAN PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. evaporated milk
2  c. mashed cooked pinto beans
2/3  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves
whipped cream
single 9-inch unbaked pie crust
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  For filling, combine eggs and evaporated milk in large bowl.  Stir until well blended.  Add pinto beans, sugar, salt, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and cloves.  Beat at low speed until well blended.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake for 15 minutes.  Reduce oven temperature to 350° and bake 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.  Serve warm with whipped cream.

name: PIZZA DOUGH
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. warm water
1  pkg. RapidRise
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
3  c. flour (approximately)
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Mix in rest of the ingredients. Mix flour in 1 cup at a time.  Knead dough until almost not sticky.  Put in buttered bowl. Cover and let rise 30 minutes. Punch down.  Divide into 2 balls (add flour to hands as it will be sticky). Shape dough onto greased pizza dishes.  Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.  Makes 2 pizzas.

name: LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1  c. celery, sliced
5  eggs, boiled and sliced
1 (10  oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, uncooked
1/2  c. green pepper, diced
1  med. sweet onion, diced
8  slices bacon, cooked and diced
2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. sugar
4  oz. cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Tear lettuce into bite-size pieces. Place in a casserole dish. Layer the rest of the ingredients in order given. Add sugar to mayonnaise and spread over the top, as you would frosting. Top with grated cheese.  Cover and refrigerate 8 - 12 hours. At serving time, garnish with additional bacon and parsley.

name: FRITO SALAD
ingredients:
1  small onion
1  bell pepper
1  bag shredded cheese
1  bag Fritos
2 regular  cans kidney beans
1  bottle Catalina dressing
preparation: Chop onion and bell pepper.  Drain cans of kidney beans and add to onion and bell pepper.  Add shredded cheese, Fritos and Catalina dressing.  Mix thoroughly.

name: WASSAIL(Punch)
ingredients:
1/2  gal. apple cider
1 1/2  c. cranberry juice
1  1/2 cinnamon sticks
1/2  tsp. whole cloves
1/2  tsp. whole allspice
preparation: In large pot add apple cider, cranberry juice and cinnamon sticks.  Heat slowly until it starts to froth.  Do not boil. Place whole cloves and whole allspice in a tea ball.  Dip in hot liquid to taste.  This drink is good both warm and chilled.

name: SPICED CRANBERRY TEA
ingredients:
1  qt. cranberries
2  lemons, sliced
1  orange, sliced
1  stick cinnamon
12  whole cloves
preparation: Cook in 2 to 3 quarts water; strain and add 3 cups sugar. Keep refrigerated to thin and serve hot.  Makes 1 to 2 gallons tea.

name: MIXED NUT BARS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. margarine
13  oz. can mixed nuts (cut up the larger ones)
2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. white corn syrup
6  oz. butterscotch chips
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients like pie crust and pat in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Cover with the mixed nuts.  Melt the remaining ingredients.  Pour melted mixture over nuts and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: FRESH APPLE BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. Wesson oil
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
1  c. plain flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  c. pecans
2  c. finely chopped apples (about 3 medium apples)
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients together, then add the eggs, flour, salt and soda.  Fold in the pecans and apples.  Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
2  pkg. chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1  bunch chopped green onions and tops
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
1  can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
preparation: After spinach has drained, squeeze any remaining moisture out with hands.  Mix with other ingredients and chill overnight.  Best when served with Hawaiian bread.

name: ICE CREAM PUDDING DESSERT
ingredients:
60  Ritz crackers
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream *
1 1/2  c. milk
2 (4 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding *
preparation: *Variation:  Use any flavor.

name: COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1/2 to 1  c. sugar (for sprinkling fruit)
preparation: Cream together until light and fluffy the butter and first cup of sugar.  Sift together the flour, baking powder and salt.  Stir into butter and sugar mixture with 1 cup of milk.  Beat until smooth.  Pour fruit over batter and sprinkle with sugar.  Pour over the top 1 or 2 cups of the fruit juice.  Use a 13 x 9-inch cake pan.  Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: CRAZY FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
10  Tbsp. melted shortening
3  c. flour
5  Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. vinegar
2  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Blend dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Mix until smooth. Bake for 35 minutes at 350°.

name: MYSTERY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, drained
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges
2  bananas, sliced
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1 small  box vanilla instant Jell-O pudding mix
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
Cool Whip
preparation: Drain pineapple and oranges; reserve liquid.  Mix bananas and marshmallows with half of fruit juices.  Mix rest of juices with pudding mix.  Combine fruit, marshmallows and nuts.  Pour mix over fruit and nuts.  Chill.  Top with Cool Whip upon serving.

name: CHERRY MOUNTAIN PIE
ingredients:
margarine
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
2/3  c. milk
1 large  can cherry pie mix, which has been sweetened to taste
preparation: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Mix sugar, flour, baking powder and milk.  Pour batter over margarine in pan and add to center of batter the pie mix.  Do not stir.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CUCUMBER SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1 8  oz. carton cream cheese, softened
1  pkg. Italian seasoning mix
Lemon juice, small amount
1  tbsp. mayo
3  cucumbers, peeled and sliced in thin circles
1  loaf white bread
preparation: Mix all ingredients and serve on white bread circles.

name: RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can light cream of mushroom soup
1  can onion soup
1  c. rice
1  stick margarine
preparation: Mix ingredients into casserole dish. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: GRANNY'S SUGAR COOKIES(Use with cookie cutters.)
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  large egg
2  c. flour (all-purpose)
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together butter and sugar. Blend in egg. Sift together and add to mixture flour, powder, salt and vanilla. Divide dough into 2 parts. Chill for 1 to 2 hours. Roll dough to 1/8-inch thickness and cut out cookies. Preheat oven to 375°. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

name: HAMBURGER AND POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 or 2  lb. hamburger meat
potatoes, cut up, boiled and drained
onion, chopped
2 to 3  cans cream of celery soup or cream of mushroom soup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown hamburger meat and onions until done.  Drain grease. Combine this mixture with other ingredients and mix well.  Put into casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Always a hit! Quick and easy for those who work!!! Children love it!!

name: COKE SALAD
ingredients:
1  large cherry Jell-O
1 1/2  c. pecans
8  oz. Cool Whip
4  c. Coke
1 (10 oz.)  bottle maraschino cherries
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups boiling Coke.  Then add other 2 cups of room temperature Coke.  Chill long enough to thicken.  Add chopped cherries, pecans and Cool Whip.  Put back into fridge to jell.

name: CORN LIGHT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising meal
1  c. plain flour
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. cooking oil
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix and bake in well-greased loaf pan at 350° until brown, about 50 to 55 minutes.

name: CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1  can cherry pie filling
1  can (medium) crushed pineapple, drained
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix milk, pie filling, pineapple and lemon juice.  Let stand overnight.

name: COCONUT, PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1 yellow cake mix, prepared as  box directs
1  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. sugar
2  boxes instant pudding
3  c. milk
Cool Whip
coconut
preparation: Cook pineapple and sugar for 10 minutes.  When cake is done, poke holes in top and pour pineapple mixture over top.  Cook pudding and milk.  Spread over top of cake/pineapple.  Mix Cool Whip and coconut together and spread on top.

name: SCALLOPED CRAB
ingredients:
12  oz. canned crab
4  oz. chopped mushrooms
1/2  c. finely chopped green peppers
1/4  c. finely shredded cheese
lemon slices
paprika
3  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. white sauce
1  Tbsp. catsup
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper or less
1/2  c. finely crushed saltines
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
preparation: In one bowl, mix white sauce, catsup, Worcestershire, salt and pepper. In 2nd bowl, crab, mushrooms, peppers, cheese and crackers. Combine both bowls and pour in casserole dish. Sprinkle paprika and cut pieces of margarine across top of casserole. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: POPOVER PANCAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/4  c. butter
2  Tbsp. confectioners sugar
juice of 1/2 lemon
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Combine flour, milk and eggs.  Batter will be lumpy.  Put butter into 12-inch round frypan.  Place pan in oven and allow to become very hot.  Pour batter into pan.  Bake for 20 minutes or until the pancake is puffed and golden brown. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar and lemon juice.

name: BONNIE'S EGG BAKE
ingredients:
16  slices white bread
8  oz. Cheddar or American cheese
2  c. cubed cooked ham
6  eggs
3  c. milk
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. Wheaties or Corn Flakes
2  oz. butter
preparation: Remove crust from bread slices.  Generously butter sides and bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.	Butter 8  slices  of  bread and place, buttered side, down.  Sprinkle ham over bread.  Sprinkle Cheddar (or place American slice) cheese over  ham	and  bread. Top with remaining 8 slices of bread, unbuttered.  Beat together eggs, milk, mustard and salt.  Pour over	bread.	Make  sure to  cover well.   Cover  and	refrigerate  overnight.  Combine Wheaties  and 1/4  cup  melted  butter.	Sprinkle  over	bread immediately before baking.  Bake at 350° for  one  hour, uncovered.  Freezes well for later use.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  c. bread crumbs
1/4  c. prepared mustard
1  onion, chopped
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. water or milk
1/4  c. Heinz 57 sauce
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix well.  Spray pan with Pam.  Add meat mixture and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CARROT-BASIL BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. carrots
1  small onion, minced
3  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. water
1/2  tsp. dried parsley flakes
1/2 to 3/4  tsp. crushed dried sweet basil
preparation: Peel and shred carrots.  Melt butter; add water, salt and parsley flakes and basil.  Stir into carrots.  Microwave on High power for 15 to 17 minutes.  Stir twice during cooking time.

name: MILLION DOLLAR PIE
ingredients:
1  container (large) Cool Whip
2  graham cracker or vanilla wafer crusts
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix Cool Whip, pineapple, nuts and lemon juice.  Pour into crust and chill for 3 hours (better if overnight).

name: CAULIFLOWER(Yields 4 Servings; Pan Size: 2-Quart)
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1/2 to 1  tsp. dry mustard
1  c. shredded American cheese
preparation: Wash cauliflower.  Place undrained cauliflower in glass baking dish.  Microwave, tightly covered, on High for 7 to 8 minutes. Combine mayonnaise, prepared mustard and dry mustard in bowl; mix well.  Spread over cauliflower.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Microwave on High for 1 minute or just until cheese is melted.

name: COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. sugar
1 1/3  c. water
2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
2  (6 oz.) coconut
9  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cake mix, eggs, vanilla, 1/4 cup sugar and water and pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: SPEEDY LITTLE DEVILS
ingredients:
1  Duncan Hines Deluxe devil's food cake mix
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
3/4  c. creamy peanut butter
1 (7 or 7 1/2 oz.)  jar Marshmallow Creme
preparation: Combine melted butter and dry cake mix.  Reserve 1 1/2 cups of this topping for top crust.  Pat remaining crumb mixture into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Top that layer with combined peanut butter and Marshmallow Creme and spread evenly.  Crumble remaining mixture over that.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.  Cool. Makes 3 dozen bars.

name: DUMP SALAD
ingredients:
small cottage cheese
small can oranges - mandarin
small orange jello mix
small marshmallows
8  oz. cool whip
preparation: Drain mandarin oranges.  Mix jello and cool whip.  Add marshmallows to thicken as desired.  Add cottage cheese and mandarin oranges.

name: HEAVENLY HASH
ingredients:
2  pkg. strawberry jello, mixed as usual
1  c. tiny marshmallows
1  box frozen strawberries
1  carton whipping cream
1  c. pecans
1 small  can drained crushed pineapple
preparation: Chill jello until it begins to thicken, then add all the rest of ingredients and chill.

name: OLD SETTLER'S BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1/2  lb. bacon, chopped
1  onion, sliced
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  can butter beans
1  can pork and beans
1/2  tsp. chili powder
3  Tbsp. molasses
salt and pepper to taste
1  can red beans
1/2  c. catsup
1/4  c. barbecue sauce
2  Tbsp. mustard
preparation: Brown and drain hamburger and bacon.  Add onion, brown sugar, catsup, barbecue sauce, salt, pepper and molasses.  Mix well.  Add the beans.  Mix well.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA
ingredients:
1  pkg. Pillsbury crescent rolls
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
1  c. salad dressings
3/4  c. each of the following: green pepper, broccoli, tomatoes, cauliflower, mushrooms, chopped fine
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
3/4  c. grated carrots
preparation: Cover bottom of jelly roll pan with crescent rolls.  Bake 7 to 8 minutes at 350° until lightly browned.  Beat cream cheese, salad dressing and Ranch dressing until smooth.  Spread on cooled crust. Mix vegetables together; sprinkle on top of dressing.  Add grated carrots and grated cheese over all.

name: QUICK SALAD
ingredients:
1  bowl Cool Whip
1  pkg. lime Jell-O
1 small  carton cottage cheese
1 small  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Spoon Cool Whip into larger bowl.  Sprinkle lime Jell-O over Cool Whip.  Mix in remaining ingredients.  Chill and it's ready to serve.

name: CARROTS WITH ACETO BALSAMIC VINEGAR
ingredients:
5  or 6 medium carrots, peeled and thinly sliced
1/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. butter
salt
2 to 3  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. Balsamic vinegar
preparation: Place carrots in the 1/4 cup water.  Add butter and salt. Cover tightly and simmer over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.  Carrots should have absorbed water.  Combine the brown sugar, water and vinegar in a saucepan.  Cook until well blended and pour over carrots.  Serves 4.

name: CHOCOLATE SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. water
1/2  c. cocoa
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. Crisco
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. chopped pecans
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. sour milk (1 tsp. vinegar will sour milk)
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  stick oleo
2  Tbsp. cocoa
pkg. powdered milk
3  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Bring to boil the first 4 ingredients; sift in a bowl the sugar and flour.  Combine the two mixtures; add the eggs, sour milk and 1 teaspoon vanilla.  Beat well and bake in a jelly roll pan for 20 minutes at 400°.

name: BARBECUE TURKEY
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. liquid garlic
2  tsp. liquid smoke
1  c. warm water
1  c. lemon juice
1/4  c. salt
2  Tbsp. Tabasco sauce
preparation: Mix water and salt together, then add remaining ingredients. Inject into turkey the night before preparation.  (Inject with a large needle syringe a little in a spot; don't stick the whole syringe full in one spot.)  Set in the refrigerator overnight. Bake as you usually do or put in pan on grill and baste frequently.

name: STRAWBERRY SHORTCAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. Crisco, melted
2  eggs
2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. flour
1  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Add, in the order listed, and mix well.  Pour into oblong baking pan or dish.  Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.  Cool and add fresh strawberries and milk, if so desired.

name: MEXICAN CHILI DIP
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  box Velveeta mild Mexican cheese
2  Tbsp. chopped pickled jalapeno peppers
1  tsp. ground cumin (generous)
1  Tbsp. chili powder (generous)
1  lb. ground beef, cooked and drained
1/2  c. shredded cheese for tacos
1 (6 oz.)  can spicy tomato sauce (at least and then some) *
1  Tbsp. taco seasoning mix (optional)
preparation: *You can use V-8 or any Bloody Mary mix.

name: ALMOND JOY CANDY
ingredients:
2  (14 oz.) bags coconut
2  sticks margarine
1  can sweetened condensed milk
2  (12 oz.) bags chocolate chips
1  bar paraffin
preparation: Heat the batter and milk until batter is melted.  Add coconut. Cool completely in fridge.  Ball this mixture up.   Next, melt the chips and paraffin.  Dip candy in the melted chocolate.  Cool before serving.

name: WAYNE'S HODGE PODGE
ingredients:
1  1/2 lbs. ground beef
3/4  c. chopped onions
3  cans condensed Minestrone Soup
1  can (31 oz.) Pork & Beans
3  c. water
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
1  tbsp. worcester shire sauce
1/2  tsp. dried Crushed Oregano
preparation: Brown ground beef & chopped onions together till onion is tender. Stir in 3 cans of Minestrone Soup, Pork & Beans, 3 cups water, celery,  worcester shire sauce, and oregano. Cover and simmer until celery is tender. Can cook the celery with the ground beef and onion. It gets tender that way. Refrigerates well.

name: PUMPKIN DESSERT
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  can evaporated milk
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cloves
1 (29 oz.)  can pumpkin
1  yellow cake mix
1  c. melted oleo
preparation: Mix eggs, sugar, brown sugar, evaporated milk, salt, cinnamon, ginger, cloves and can pumpkin together.  Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle the cake mix over top.  Pour the melted oleo over top. Do not mix.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.  If not done, bake longer. Serve with or without whipped topping.

name: HOOT OWL PIE
ingredients:
1 (28 oz.)  can hominy, drained
2  c. cooked, diced hoot owl or chicken if desired
1  can cream of mushroom soup
4  Tbsp. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
1/4  c. bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. margarine
paprika
preparation: Butter casserole dish.  Place layer of hominy in bottom, then a layer of hoot owl.  Continue layering until all hominy and hoot owl are gone.  In a pan heat soup, milk, salt and pepper.  Pour over casserole.  Sprinkle with bread crumbs.  Dot with margarine and paprika.  Bake in 375° oven for 30 minutes.

name: MOIST CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. unsweetened cocoa
2  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
1  c. hot coffee
1  c. milk
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift together all dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl.  Add oil, coffee and milk; mix at medium speed for 2 minutes.  Add eggs and vanilla; beat 2 more minutes.  Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans (or two 8-inch pans and 6 muffin cups).  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cover with favorite icing.

name: EL GRANDE
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix (dry)
1  pkg. yellow rice
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
lettuce
tomato
Cheddar cheese
Fritos
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain.  Add tomato sauce and seasoning mix plus 1 can of water.  Cook yellow rice according to package. Heat soup plus 1/2 can of milk.  Layer these ingredients in casserole dish.  Bake at 350° until bubbly.  Spoon onto plate and top with lettuce, tomato, cheese and Fritos.  You may want taco sauce.

name: DIABETIC RICE WITH BLACK BEANS
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. oil
1  can (14 1/2 oz.) stewed tomatoes
1  can (16 oz.) black beans, undrained
1/2  tsp. dried oregano leaves
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1 1/2  c. Minute instant brown rice
preparation: Cook and stir onion in hot oil in saucepan until tender but not browned.  Add tomatoes, beans, oregano and garlic powder. Bring to boil.  Stir in rice.  Return to boil.  Reduce heat; cover.  Simmer 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Let stand 5 minutes.

name: EASY DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can cherry pie mix
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple and juice
1  regular yellow cake mix
1  cube oleo
preparation: Pour the 2 cans of fruit in a long baking pan.  Pour dry cake mix over fruit and cut up oleo over top.  Bake 40 minutes or until brown at 350°.  When cool, cut in squares and top with topping or ice cream.

name: CARAMEL CORN(Cracker Jacks)
ingredients:
3  qt. popped popcorn
1/2  c. honey or white syrup
1  c. brown sugar
1  stick margarine
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Lightly salt popcorn and set aside.  In a 3-quart saucepan bring honey or white syrup, brown sugar and margarine to a boil. Boil 5 minutes over medium heat.  Take off heat and add vanilla and baking soda.  Stir until well mixed.  Pour over popcorn; add peanuts, if desired, and stir.  Butter a roasting pan and pour in caramel corn.  Bake at 250° for 30 minutes.  Butter a sheet of aluminum foil and place corn on this to cool.

name: OATMEAL HERMITS
ingredients:
3/4  c. margarine
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  c. oatmeal
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream  margarine.  Mix  in  sugars.  Add  eggs, milk and vanilla.  Sift  together  flour,  soda,  salt  and spices; add. Stir  in oatmeal, raisins and nuts.  Drop by spoon on ungreased cookie tins.  Cook 10 minutes at 375°.

name: APRICOT BARS
ingredients:
1  c. golden brown sugar, packed
1  c. butter
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. apricot jam
preparation: Beat brown sugar, butter, egg and vanilla until smooth.  Add in nuts and flour.  Pour half the batter in 9-inch square pan. Spread 1/2 the jam.  Pour in rest of batter.  Cover with remaining jam.  Bake at 325° about 45 to 50 minutes.  Let cool.  Cut into squares.

name: CHEESE MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  c. corn flakes, crushed
1/2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. milk
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. chopped olives or green pepper
3  slices bacon
juice of 1 lemon
preparation: Mix all ingredients except bacon.  Place in 1-quart baking dish.  May be frozen at this point.  If frozen, thaw slightly and top with bacon.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: ITALIAN "LITE" POTATOES
ingredients:
8  to 10 red potatoes
8  oz. bottle fat-free Italian dressing
preparation: Wash potatoes and cut into large chunks.  Place in pan and cover with water.   Add a little salt and bring to a boil.  Cook until tender.  Drain.  While hot, cover with dressing to taste. Serve hot.

name: ITALIAN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  qt. whole canned tomatoes
2  medium onions
1  green pepper
2  Tbsp. parsley
1  bay leaf
1/4  tsp. oregano or more (if desired)
1/2  tsp. marjoram
1/2  tsp. basil leaves
1/4  tsp. thyme
salt and pepper to individual taste
garlic to individual taste
preparation: Brown beef and drain well.  Add other ingredients.  Simmer slowly 1 hour or more, depending on how much time you have.  Cook spaghetti separately.  Drain when spaghetti is tender.  Serve meat sauce over spaghetti.

name: MARTHA WASHINGTON CANDY
ingredients:
2  boxes powdered sugar
1  can Eagle Brand milk
2  sticks margarine
1  (8 oz.) coconut
3  c. pecans
1/4  lb. paraffin wax
18  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Melt margarine; add milk, sugar, coconut and pecans.  Mix well. Chill before making balls.  Chill after you roll balls.  In double boiler, melt together paraffin wax and chocolate chips.  When melted, dip balls of candy into chocolate mixture using a toothpick.  Put onto foil-lined tray.

name: FOILED FISH DINNERS
ingredients:
6  fish steaks or fillets (any kind)
dash of salt
dash of pepper
lime or lemon juice
2  medium potatoes, cooked 10 minutes and sliced
2  onions, sliced
butter or margarine
preparation: Place fish steaks on squares of heavy foil.  Sprinkle with seasonings and lemon or lime juice.  Put several slices of potatoes and onions over fish.  Add more salt and pepper, if desired.  Top with a pat of butter.  Seal the pockets with a double fold of foil and grill over charcoal for about 20 minutes or bake in oven at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN FAJITAS
ingredients:
4  to 6 boneless chicken breasts
1 medium  jar salsa (mild)
2  green peppers
1  large bag Cheddar cheese
1  large bag Mozzarella cheese
16  to 20 small flour tortillas
sour cream
preparation: Skin and chop chicken and peppers.  Cover bottom of frying pan with salsa; brown chicken and peppers (no oil).  Simmer on low until chicken is fully cooked.  Heat tortillas by flipping them directly on hot burner.  Fill tortillas with small amounts of chicken and peppers.  Top with both cheeses.  Roll up like a burrito and place on microwave plate.  Sprinkle rest of cheese and salsa over tortillas.  Microwave until cheese is melted.  Serve with sour cream.

name: APPLE PIE(Nanny Helen's)
ingredients:
5  to 6 apples
3/4 to 1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
lemon juice
butter (2 Tbsp.)
preparation: Pare, core and slice apples.  Combine sugar, cinnamon, salt and cornstarch.  Arrange apples in closely packed layers in pastry lined pie plate, sprinkling sugar mixture over each layer. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon lemon juice over apples.  Dot with butter. Place top crust over filling.  Seal with flute.  Brush top with cream.  Bake at 450° for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to 375° for 40 or 50 minutes.

name: GRANNY'S BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  to 5 bananas, mashed
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: In large bowl cream sugar and shortening.  Add eggs and vanilla; beat until fluffy.  Add bananas.  In small bowl, combine flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt.  Add to banana mixture. Stir in nuts.  Pour into a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan (for smaller loaves use 2 pans).  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Cool in pan 10 minutes, then on rack.  Cool thoroughly.  Serve plain, with cream cheese or butter.

name: CHEESE ROLL
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1 small  box cream cheese
1  c. chopped pecans
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Soften cheese and blend all ingredients.  Shape in a roll and roll in chili powder.  Chill 2 hours.  Slice and serve on Ritz crackers.

name: RHUBARB PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. cornstarch
2  tsp. orange rind
5  c. rhubarb, cut up in small pieces
1  Tbsp. margarine
1 to 2  tsp. almond flavoring (optional)
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Add to rhubarb in prepared 10-inch pie pan. Cover with lattice strips.

name: CORNED BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. potatoes, sliced
1  c. onions, sliced
4  c. shredded cabbage
1 (12 oz.)  can crumbled corned beef
1/2  stick margarine, melted
1  can cream of celery soup
preparation: Put in casserole dish in layers as listed and pour undiluted soup over.  Put foil on top or cover with lid.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until potatoes test done.  Serves 8.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1  stick margarine, melted
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie crust
preparation: In large bowl, combine sugar and flour.  Blend well.  Stir in buttermilk, add beaten eggs, margarine and vanilla.  Beat until well blended.  Pour into unbaked crust.  Bake at 350° for 60 minutes or until firm when tested in the center.

name: JAG/JIGGY PORTUGUESE RICE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  medium onion
2 1/2  c. hot water
1  c. Uncle Ben's converted rice
4  oz. can lima beans
preparation: In a 3-quart saucepan combine olive oil and onion.  Simmer until transparent (not brown).  Add water, rice and lima beans. Simmer until water evaporates and rice is tender (approximately 30 minutes).  Delicious as side dish with any poultry, meat or fish. Serves 4 to 6.

name: MARVELOUS MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour (white or whole wheat)
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  egg or 2 egg whites
1  c. milk (whole or skim)
1/4  c. butter, margarine or olive oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Mix flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.  Beat egg until frothy; stir in milk and butter.  Make "well" in center of flour mixture.  Pour all of milk mixture.  Stir quickly until just mixed but still lumpy.  Fill large muffin cups 2/3 full.  Bake at 425° for 25 minutes.

name: HEAVENLY SEVEN LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1  1/2 quarts shredded lettuce
2  cups chopped tomatoes
2  cups mushroom slices
1  (10 oz) pkg frozen peas, thawed, drained
4  oz mild cheddar cheese, cubed
1  cup red onion rings
2  cups Miracle Whip
preparation: In 2 qt. serving bowl, layer lettuce tomatoes, mushrooms, peas, cheese, and onions.  Spread salad dressing over onions, sealing to edge of bowl; cover.  Chill several hours or overnight. Garnish with bacon or shredded cheese.  Serves 8.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. onion
1/2  stick butter
1  c. cooked rice
1/2  c. shredded cheese or 1 jar Cheez Whiz
1 (8 oz.)  box frozen broccoli
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Saute celery and onions in butter. Add cooked rice and pour into buttered casserole dish. Add broccoli and soup.  Mix well. Sprinkle cheese on top or mix in Cheez Whiz. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. This recipe can be doubled.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising cornmeal
1/2  tsp. soda
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. grated sharp cheese
1/3  c. cooking oil
3  eggs
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can creamed corn
1  or 2 pods jalapeno peppers, chopped or 1 tsp. Tabasco sauce
1  small bell pepper, chopped
preparation: If using jalapeno, chop fine and remove seeds.

name: SAUSAGE BREAD
ingredients:
1  lb. hot sausage
1/4  c. minced onions
1  egg
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
salt
parsley flakes
2  c. biscuit mix
milk
2  Tbsp. hot picante sauce
preparation: Saute sausage and onions until lightly brown.  Mix other ingredients together.  Add sausage and onion.  Spread into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: GREEN BEANS ON THE GRILL
ingredients:
1  lb. green beans
1  medium onion, sliced or diced
1/2  green pepper, sliced or diced
1  c. fresh mushrooms, chopped (I used 4 oz. can, drained)
1/3  c. butter
2 or 3  tsp. horseradish
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
pepper (as much as desired)
preparation: Mix butter, horseradish, brown sugar, salt and pepper.  Dab this mixture over green beans and wrap in heavy-duty foil and put on grill for 20 minutes.  Remove and cut up 1 or 2 tomatoes into wedges and place over top of beans, return to grill for 10 to 15 minutes more.  Unwrap and enjoy!

name: CHICKEN AND SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  fryer hen
1  c. chopped celery
1  large bell pepper, chopped
2  c. tomatoes
1  jar pimentos
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. American cheese
preparation: Boil hen.  Debone and dice meat.  Take 3 1/2 quarts of broth and all other ingredients.  Simmer until done.  Cook spaghetti as directed on package and add to broth.  It thickens and absorbs broth as it sets.

name: RUSSIAN TEA CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. melted oleo
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix oleo, sugar and vanilla good. Sift flour and salt together.  Add nuts.  Mix well.  Chill dough. Roll into balls the size of walnuts.  Bake on ungreased baking sheets at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes; not too brown. While still warm, roll in powdered sugar. When cool, roll again in powdered sugar.

name: SEAFOOD GUMBO
ingredients:
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. flour
2  large onions, chopped
3  to 4 stalks celery, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes, chopped
2  c. stock (seafood, chicken or canned chicken broth)
1  qt. water
2 (10 oz.)  boxes frozen cut okra
1  tsp. each: salt, crushed bay leaves and thyme
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
2 to 3  lb. raw seafood (shrimp, crayfish tails, crabmeat, etc.)
file (optional)
preparation: Brown flour in oil in large heavy pot slowly, stirring to make mahogany brown roux. Add chopped vegetables and saut until soft. Add tomato sauce, tomatoes, chicken stock, water, okra and seasoning. Stir and simmer about 45 minutes. Add seafood and cook another 20 to 30 minutes. Serve around scoop of hot rice. Offer file at table. Serves 8 to 10.

name: MAYONNAISE/WHEAT ROLLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1/4  c. wheat flour
6  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
preparation: Half the recipe for 6 muffins.  Pam spray the pans (Bundt or tube).  Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.  You can use 2 cups of self-rising flour and omit the wheat flour.  Quick and easy!

name: CHILI DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  can Hormel chili (no beans)
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: In 8 x 8-inch pan, spread cream cheese. Spoon chili over cream cheese. Cover with lots of Velveeta cheese. Heat (microwave) until cheese melts. Serve with corn chips.

name: DIABETIC CANDY
ingredients:
1  pkg. Sweet 'N Low white frosting mix
4  packets Equal sweetener
dash of salt
1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter
1 (3 oz.)  can chow mein noodles
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix frosting, sweetener and salt with milk.  Add peanut butter, noodles and pecans.  Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper and refrigerate.  Makes about 20 cookies.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1 (6 or 12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1 (14 or 16 oz.)  pkg. caramels
2/3  c. evaporated milk
3/4  c. melted butter
chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Melt caramels in double boiler with 1/3 cup evaporated milk. Stir frequently.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1/3 to 1/2  c. sweet milk
1  c. diced, cooked chicken
2  hard-boiled eggs, sliced
1  c. cooked English peas
1  c. slightly crumbled potato chips
preparation: In a 1-quart casserole, blend soup and milk; stir in chicken, egg and peas.  Top with chips.  Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: HOLIDAY FROZEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. fruit juice
1/2  c. butter
1/8  c. sugar
1/16  tsp. salt
1  egg
3/4  c. pineapple chunks
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
miniature marshmallows
8  maraschino cherries
1/2  pt. whipped cream
preparation: Add juice to flour to make a paste in double boiler. Add butter, sugar and salt. Cook 10 minutes. Add egg slightly beaten and cook 4 minutes, stirring constantly. Let cool and add fruit, nuts and marshmallows. Fold in whipped cream. Place in freezer.

name: LAZY DAISY OATMEAL CAKE
ingredients:
1  1/4 c boiling water
1  c. oats, uncooked
1/2  c. butter or margarine, soft
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Pour water over oats; cover; let stand 20 minutes.  Beat butter until creamy; gradually beat in sugars.  Blend in vanilla and eggs.  Stir in oats mixture.  Sift together flour, soda, salt and spices.  Add to creamed mixture; blend well.  Pour batter into greased and floured 9-inch square baking pan.  Bake in preheated moderate oven (350°) for 50 to 55 minutes.  Do not remove cake from pan.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. boneless, skinless chicken breast
1  (12 oz.) sour cream
poppy seed (optional)
1  pkg. Ritz crackers
1/2  stick butter
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Boil chicken until white in the middle (about 15 minutes).  Then cut into pieces and mix with the cream of chicken soup, sour cream and 1 teaspoon of poppy seed (in casserole dish).  Crumble Ritz crackers on top and pour melted butter over top.  Sprinkle poppy seed over the top.  Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 30 minutes.

name: HOMEMADE BREAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. active dry yeast
4 1/2  c. warm water (110~ to 115~)
6  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. salt
1/4  c. shortening, melted and cooled
12 to 12 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in water.  Add sugar, salt and shortening.  Stir until dissolved.  Add half the flour; beat until smooth.  Mix in enough remaining flour to form a soft dough that does not stick to sides of bowl.  Turn onto floured surface.  Knead 8 to 10 minutes.  Place in a greased bowl, turning once to grease top.  Cover and allow to rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour.  Punch down dough.  Cover and let rest for 15 minutes.  Divide dough into 4 parts.  Shape into loaves.  Place in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch pans.  Let rise until doubled, about 30 to 35 minutes.  Remove from pans and cool on wire racks.

name: QUICK CHEESEBURGER BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. chopped onion
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed Cheddar cheese soup
1  c. frozen mixed vegetables (optional)
1/4  c. milk
2  c. Bisquick original or reduced fat baking mix
3/4  c. water
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Generously grease a 3 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Cook beef and onion in 10-inch skillet until beef is brown; drain.  Stir in soup, vegetables and milk.  Stir baking mix and water in the baking dish until moistened; spread evenly. Spread beef mixture over batter; sprinkle with cheese.  Bake 30 minutes.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: MISSISSIPPI MUD CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. cocoa
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. pecans, chopped
dash of salt
1 small  pkg. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Melt margarine.  Add cocoa with beaten eggs, flour and milk. Add salt and sugar.  Beat well, then add nuts and beat more.  Pour in greased pan 13 x 9 x 2-inches.  Bake for 35 minutes at 350°. Pour marshmallows over cake while still hot.  Put cake in warm oven until marshmallows melt.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1 3/4  c. oil
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1 3/4  c. shredded carrots
1  c. drained, crushed pineapple
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. raisins (if desired)
preparation: Sift and mix together the first 4 ingredients.  Mix oil, sugar and eggs; mix well, then add carrots and mix.  Mix in all the dry ingredients, then add the pineapple, nuts and raisins.  Put in a 10 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: SAVE-YOUR-MARRIAGE SUPPER
ingredients:
1  large baking potato
2  lamb chops or pork chops
3  medium carrots
1  medium onion, chopped
1  medium bell pepper, quartered
salt and pepper
preparation: Cut two pieces of foil (about 12 x 18-inches).  Split potato in half and put in center of foil.  Place chop on top; stack with other vegetables and salt and pepper.  Fold foil, sealing tightly. Bake at 450° for 1 1/2 hours.  Serve with green salad, tea and dinner rolls and a little dessert later.  Hugs and kisses go a long way.  Good luck.  Yield:  2 servings.

name: COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
3/4  c. coconut
preparation: Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
3  large eggs
3  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
3  c. diced apples
3/4  c. coconut
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Mix sugar and oil.  Add eggs; beat well.  Combine flour, salt and soda.  Add to oil mixture.  Stir in vanilla, apples, coconut and nuts.

name: ITALIAN STIR-FRY
ingredients:
eggplant, zucchini squash, onion, green pepper and red pepper (use as much as you like)
tomatoes
basil (fresh)
olive oil
Italian seasoning
Parmesan cheese (fresh), grated
preparation: Chop vegetables in bite size pieces.  Stir-fry in olive oil with dry Italian seasoning to taste.  Add tomatoes and basil at end.  Serve over a bed of pasta.  Sprinkle with fresh Parmesan cheese.

name: THUMBPRINT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  egg yolks (save whites)
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sifted flour
chopped nuts
preparation: Mix shortening, sugar, egg yolks and vanilla.  Stir in flour and salt.  Roll 1 teaspoon dough into ball and dip in slightly beaten egg whites.  Roll in chopped nuts.  Place on baking sheet and press thumb in middle.  Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.  Let cool and fill the center with filling.   Refrigerate after a couple of days.

name: CHAMPAGNE JELLY
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
2  c. pink champagne
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. liquid pectin
preparation: Combine sugar and champagne in large Dutch oven.  Cook over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves (do not boil).  Remove from heat; stir in liquid pectin.  Skim off foam with metal spoon. Quickly pour hot jelly into hot sterilized jars, leaving 1/4 inch of headspace; wipe jar rims.  Cover at once with metal lids and bands.  Process in boiling water bath 5 minutes.  Let stand 8 hours.  This jelly makes a nice party favor or gift.  Yield:  5 half pints.

name: SHERRY'S POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  large potatoes, peeled and sliced
1 small  can mushroom soup
1  c. milk
1  pkg. brown gravy mix
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. onion powder
6  slices American cheese
salt and pepper
preparation: Set oven at 375°.  Spray casserole dish with nonstick spray.

name: PEAR SALAD
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can pear halves, drained
4  lettuce leaves
4  Tbsp. mint jelly
mayonnaise
4  cherries
preparation: Place pear halves on lettuce.  Fill centers with mint jelly. Top with 1/4 teaspoon mayonnaise and a cherry.  Yields 4 servings.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1 (5 oz.)  can evaporated milk
3/4  c. oats
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3  Tbsp. vinegar
3  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  c. water
1  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Combine ground beef, 2 tablespoons chopped onion, evaporated milk, oats, salt and pepper in bowl; mix well.  Shape into loaf. Place in a 7 x 12-inch baking dish.  Mix Worcestershire sauce with vinegar, 3 tablespoons onion, water, catsup and sugar in bowl. Pour over loaf.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Yield: 6 servings.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. boneless chicken breast, cooked and cut up
1/2  c. dry white wine
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. seedless grapes, cut in halves (green)
1  c. seedless red grapes, cut in halves
1 1/2  c. diced celery
1/2  c. nuts (pecans)
preparation: Combine wine and lemon juice.  Pour over chicken mixture. Chill 2 hours or overnight.  Drain.  Reserve marinade.  Combine mayonnaise and reserved marinade.  Put salad on lettuce and serve with mayonnaise mixture.

name: GARLIC GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
1  bunch fresh green beans (from garden is best), cleaned and rinsed
2  garlic cloves, crushed and chopped
olive oil
preparation: Steam green beans for 15 minutes. In frypan, heat olive oil. Add garlic and green beans; dry beans until done. Salt and pepper to taste.

name: STUFFED CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  fryer, cut up
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. Accent
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. corn oil
1  pkg. (7 oz.) Stove Top stuffing
1  jar (8 oz.) fresh oysters
1  pkg. (10 oz.) chopped broccoli
paprika
preparation: Grease a 9 x 12-inch baking dish.  Combine stuffing, oysters and broccoli.  Mix well and spread in dish.  Season chicken with salt, Accent and pepper.  Place chicken on top of stuffing. Combine oil and enough water to make 2 cups of liquid.  Pour over stuffing; sprinkle with paprika.  Cover and bake 45 minutes at 375°.  Uncover and bake 10 to 15 minutes more.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: QUICK RAISIN BREAD(A Very Old Family Recipe)
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. milk
2  eggs, beaten
4  Tbsp. melted table fat
1 1/2  c. seedless dark raisins
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and cinnamon. Add milk to eggs.  Stir liquid into dry ingredients and mix just until smooth.  Stir in melted fat and raisins (and nuts if desired).  Pour into greased loaf pan.  Let stand 20 minutes. Bake at 350° about 1 hour.

name: MEXICAN LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  can fat-free refried beans
2  tsp. dried oregano
1  tsp. ground cumin
3/4  tsp. garlic powder
9  uncooked lasagna noodles
1 (16 oz.)  jar salsa
2  c. water
2  c. (16 oz.) fat-free sour cream
1 (2 1/4 oz.)  can sliced ripe olives, drained
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded reduced fat Mexican blend cheese
preparation: Brown meat and drain.  Add the refried beans, oregano, cumin and garlic powder; heat through.  Place 3 noodles in a 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish coated with Pam.  Cover with 1/2 of meat mixture. Repeat layers; top with remaining noodles.  Combine salsa and water; pour over noodles.  Cover; bake at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes.  Spread with sour cream; sprinkle with olives and cheese.

name: SNOWBALL CAKE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  stick margarine, softened
2  c. powdered sugar
1 regular  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  can shredded coconut
1  c. pecan pieces
1  pkg. vanilla wafers
1 large  carton Cool Whip
maraschino cherries
crushed nuts
preparation: Cream first 3 ingredients.  Add pineapple, coconut and pecan pieces.  Break, but don't crush wafers and layer with mixture in large loaf cake pan.  Top with Cool Whip.  Decorate with cherries and crushed nuts.  Refrigerate.

name: GRAND MARNIER SMOOTHIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. softened vanilla ice cream
1 1/2  c. fresh orange juice
1  oz. (2 Tbsp.) Grand Marnier or to taste
1/2  tsp. freshly grated orange zest plus orange slices for garnish
preparation: In a blender, blend ice cream, orange juice, Grand Mariner and zest until smooth, but still thick.  Pour mixture into 2 chilled stemmed glasses and garnish with orange slices.  Makes 2 drinks.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. dark molasses
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. pumpkin puree
1 2/3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
1  Tbsp. grated orange rind
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. coarse walnuts
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Beat sugar, molasses, vegetable oil, eggs and salt together. Add remaining ingredients and mix just until all ingredients are moist.  Bake in lightly oiled loaf pan for 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Let cool 1/2 hour before removing from pan or bake in 2 pans and cook for 40 minutes.

name: BARBECUED SPARERIBS
ingredients:
3  to 4 large spareribs
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1 1/2  c. apple juice
2  Tbsp. mustard
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. ketchup
preparation: Cut spareribs in half.  Brown on all sides in frying pan.  Set aside. In small dish, add flour to mustard to make a paste. Add remaining ingredients, mixing well.  Place ribs in baking dish. Pour sauce mixture over ribs.  Cover.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour. Remove cover.  Bake 1 hour longer. Baste every 15 to 20 minutes, until done.

name: CARROT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. carrots
1  can mushroom soup
3/4  c. cubed Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. finely chopped pepper
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
2  chopped hard-boiled eggs
cracker crumbs
preparation: Slice carrots crosswise and cook  until  tender; drain. Mix all ingredients and place in buttered  baking  dish.  Pour mushroom  soup  over mixture (do not dilute  soup).  Top  with cracker crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 to  40 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: HOPPIN' JOHN
ingredients:
6  c. water
1  lb. dried black-eyed peas
1/4  c. Crisco shortening or Crisco oil
1  large green bell pepper, chopped
1  large onion, chopped
6  cloves garlic, minced
1  tsp. ground cumin
1  tsp. dried thyme leaves
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. chili powder
2  lb. brown rice
8  slices cooked bacon, crumbled
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Combine water and black-eyed peas in large saucepan.  Cook until almost tender, about one hour.  Add more water, if needed. Heat Crisco shortening or Crisco oil in medium skillet on medium heat.  Add green pepper, onion, garlic, cumin and thyme.  Cook and stir until browned.  Add tomato paste and chili powder.  Stir. Add a little water.  Stir.  Pour into beans.  Add rice, bacon, salt and pepper.  Stir.  Add enough water to cover by 1 1/2-inches.  Cover.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat.  Simmer 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.  Contains 740 calories, fat 15 g (131 cal or 18% of total calories), sat fat 3 g (<5% of total calories), carb 129 g, protein 26 g, chol 5 mg and sodium 365 mg.

name: VICKY'S PEACH ECSTASY
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. melted butter
preparation: Mix together and press into 13 x 9-inch pan.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. corn flakes, crushed
1/4  c. margarine
4  c. shredded cabbage
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  can cream of celery soup
1 1/2  c. sharp cheese, grated
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt and pepper
preparation: Mix together corn flakes and melted margarine.  Put 1/2 of mixture in a greased casserole dish.  Mix soup, mayonnaise, milk, salt and pepper.  Steam cabbage and onions together until almost done.  Spread cabbage and onions over crumb mixture and pour soup mixture over this.  Spread cheese over this and add remaining corn flake mix over cheese.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: GRANNY'S COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
fruit of your choice
preparation: Melt butter in a baking dish.  Mix flour, sugar and milk; pour into melted butter in baking dish.  Spoon fruit in baking dish throughout batter.  Don't stir.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE 2
ingredients:
2  lb. cooked yellow squash
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. mayonnaise
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  c. chopped green peppers
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake on 325° for approximately 35 minutes.

name: RHUBARB-ORANGE SLICE JAM
ingredients:
3  pt. rhubarb, cut in pieces
5  c. sugar
1  lb. candy orange slices, cut up
preparation: Cover rhubarb with sugar and let stand 1 hour.  Cook until thick and tender.  Add candy pieces.  Cook until thick.  Pour into sterilized jars.  Adjust rings and lids according to manufacturer's directions and process in water bath 15 minutes.

name: BANANA WALNUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
1 1/3  c. bananas (about 3 large)
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. nuts, chopped
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening.  Add eggs, then add bananas.  Add flour, soda and salt.  Add nuts.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Makes 20 to 30 slices.

name: SMALL ORANGE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs, well beaten
1 1/2  c. flour
juice of 1 orange
1  c. nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1  c. raisins
peel from 1 orange
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar until creamy.  Alternate adding beaten eggs, then the mix of vanilla-buttermilk-soda-juice of 1 orange.  Grind raisins, nuts (I use pecans) and orange peel.  Mix in 1/2 cup flour and add to the first mixture.  Cook in greased and floured tiny muffin tins.  Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

name: DOT'S POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
2  sticks butter or margarine
1/2  c. shortening
5  eggs
3  c. sifted plain flour
7  oz. bottle 7-Up or Sprite
1  tsp. lemon and coconut flavoring
preparation: Beat sugar, butter or margarine and shortening together well. Add eggs, one at a time.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Bake in tube or long loaf pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.

name: M&M'S COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs, well beaten
2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  lb. bag M&M's candy
preparation: Mix  shortening  and sugars until fluffy.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Add flour and M&M's.  Put teaspoonful of batter onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: STROMBOLI WRAPS
ingredients:
4  Zesty Garlic Herb wraps
1/3  c. butter or margarine, soften
6  Tbsp. shredded parmesan cheese
4  oz. provolone cheese, thinly sliced
4  oz. salami, thinly sliced
4  oz. capicolla or ham, thinly sliced
1/2  c. (4 oz jar) roasted bell peppers, rinsed and cut into strips
4  oz. mozzarella cheese, shredded
Marinara or pizza sauce, heated
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Lightly spread one side of each Wrap with softened butter; sprinkle with 1 Tbsp. parmesan.  Arrange one fourth each of provolone, salami, capicolla (or ham) and roasted peppers over center of wraps, leaving border around edges. Sprinkle each wrap with one fourth of the mozzarella.

name: QUICK LIME PIE(Makes One Pie)
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1/2  c. lime juice from concentrate
green food coloring (optional)
1  c. (1/2 pt.) whipping cream, whipped
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. graham cracker crumb pie crust
preparation: In medium bowl, stir together sweetened condensed milk, lime juice and food coloring if desired.  Fold in whipped cream.  Pour into crust.  Chill 3 hours or until set.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: SPICY PECANS
ingredients:
1  egg white, beaten
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. sugar
dash of salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves
2  c. pecans
1  Tbsp. water
preparation: Beat 1 egg until frothy and 1 tablespoon water.  Melt butter in pan; stir a lot.  Add sugar, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves. Put pecans in egg white and coat well, then put them into sugar and spices; cover well.  Place in pan with butter and bake at 250° until done.

name: BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs, separated
1 1/4  c. sugar
1 3/4  c. flour
3 bananas, mashed with 6  Tbsp. sour cream
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. Crisco (solid)
1/4  c. nuts, chopped (optional)
preparation: Mix sour cream, bananas and baking soda together.  Combine all dry ingredients; set aside.  Mix beaten egg yolks, sugar and Crisco well for about 2 minutes at medium speed.  Alternately add mashed banana mixture and dry ingredients to the sugar mixture.  Mix about 2 to 3 minutes more.  Fold in beaten egg whites.  Add nuts, if desired.  Pour batter into a greased and floured Bundt pan.  Bake at 325° for 50 to 55 minutes.  If making loaves, reduce baking time to 35 to 40 minutes.

name: CHILI LOUSIANA STYLE
ingredients:
4  lb. ground chuck
2 (no. 2)  cans red chili beans
2 (no. 2)  cans peeled tomatoes
2  c. onions, chopped
2  c. bell pepper, chopped
1 lg.  jar Mexene chili powder
1/2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. salt
4  pods garlic
3  jalapeno peppers
preparation: Cook meat until gray.  Blend (in blender) garlic, jalapeno peppers, tomatoes, flour, chili powder.  Mix all this with meat. Saute onions and bell pepper with 2 tablespoons cooking oil. Add this and beans with above. Cook slowly 1 & 1/2 hours. Add water for desired thickness. Stir often.  Makes approximately 15 pints.

name: COUNTRY CHICKEN 'N BISCUITS
ingredients:
8  slices bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
2 1/2  c. cubed, cooked chicken
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, cooked and drained
1  c. chopped tomatoes (2 medium)
1 1/2  c. (6 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1  can condensed cream of chicken soup
3/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. biscuit mix
2/3  c. milk
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
preparation: In a greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish combine first 4 ingredients and 1 cup cheese.  Blend soup and 3/4 cup milk.  Pour over casserole.  Bake, covered, at 400° for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, combine biscuit mix, milk and 1/2 can French fried onions.  Mix thoroughly.  Drop by spoonfuls to form 6 biscuits around edge of casserole.  Bake, uncovered, 15 to 20 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.  Top with remaining cheese and onions.  Bake 2 to 3 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: OLD FASHIONED COUNTRY BEEF STEW
ingredients:
4  lb. beef stew meat
2  onions, chopped medium
4  carrots (medium)
2  turnips, cut in small quarters
1  gal. water
1  small stalk celery, chopped medium
1 (16 oz.)  can green peas
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 small  can tomato juice
3  large white potatoes, cut in small quarters
3  c. flour
4  Tbsp. salt
3  Tbsp. pepper (white or black)
preparation: Mix flour, salt  and  pepper.  Roll meat in flour until well covered.  Place  in  roasting pan.  Add water;  cover and cook in 350°  oven  for  1  1/2  hours.  Add  onion,  carrots, turnips, tomatoes,  tomato  juice,  peas, celery and potatoes. Cover and cook  45  minutes, stirring slowly occasionally.  If stew seems to be too loose, make a mixture of 4 tablespoons of flour and add to 3/4  cup  water.  Make  a smooth mixture and stir in slowly. Serves 10 to 14 people.

name: FROSTY PEACH PUNCH
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. peach flavored gelatin
2  c. boiling water
1  c. sugar
2  c. cold water
4 (.23 oz.)  pkg. unsweetened pink lemonade flavored drink mix
2 (46 oz.)  cans pineapple juice
2 (2-liter)  bottles lemon-lime carbonated beverage, chilled
preparation: Combine the first 3 ingredients, stirring until gelatin dissolves.  Add water, drink mix and pineapple juice.  Stir until lemonade dissolves.  Divide mixture into two 1-gallon size, heavy-duty, Ziploc plastic bags.  Seal and freeze.  Place frozen mixture in a punch bowl; let thaw partially.  Add 1 bottle lemon-lime beverage to each bag of peach mixture in bowl.  Stir gently.  Yields 2 gallons.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen broccoli
1/4  c. butter
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  roll Ritz crackers
1/4  c. butter, melted
preparation: Prepare broccoli as directed on package; put in pan and stir in 1/4 cup butter.  Add cubed Velveeta cheese.  Roll out Ritz crackers.  Melt butter.  Mix crackers and butter together.  Put over broccoli.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

name: MICROWAVE BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1 3/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  egg, beaten
sliced bananas
vanilla wafers
preparation: Mix sugar and cornstarch in bowl for microwave.  Add milk. Dissolve and microwave on High for 3 to 4 minutes.  Add beaten egg.  Stir in well.  Return to microwave for 4 to 5 minutes.   Add vanilla.  Return to microwave (Medium heat) for 3 to 4 minutes or until thickened.  Stir and put over layer of bananas and vanilla wafers, repeating until each layer is covered.

name: CHICKEN FRICASSEE
ingredients:
1  chicken, cut into serving pieces
salt and pepper to taste
4  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. paprika
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 small  can evaporated milk
preparation: Place chicken pieces in a casserole dish; salt and pepper.  In pan or microwave dish, melt butter and add flour and paprika.  Mix well, then brush over chicken.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.  Mix soup and milk and pour around and over chicken; bake 30 minutes at 350°.  Serve with rice or mashed potatoes.  Serves 6.

name: WINE BAKED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
8  (1/2-inch) pork chops
flour to coat
2  Tbsp. oil
4  medium potatoes, peeled and quartered
1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced thin
1  large pepper, sliced
2  cloves garlic
2  medium tomatoes, quartered
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. sage
salt and pepper
1/2  c. white wine
preparation: Coat pork chops with flour.  Brown well in oil on both sides. Transfer to large ovenproof casserole.  Top with potatoes.  Brown mushrooms, peppers and garlic in drippings.  Transfer to casserole.  Top with tomatoes.  Sprinkle with oregano, sage, salt and pepper.  Pour wine over.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 hour.

name: HAM OR TURKEY ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
6  slices ham or turkey
3  stalks broccoli, cut lengthwise (12 pieces)
12  carrot sticks
1  jar Cheez Whiz
preparation: Cook vegetables until tender.  Wrap 1 slice of ham around 2 pieces of broccoli and 2 carrot sticks.  Heat until warm.   Heat Cheez Whiz and pour over roll-ups when ready to serve.

name: TANGY CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  fryer, cut up
2  Tbsp. oleo
1/2  c. Heinz 57
1/2  c. water
preparation: Brown chicken in oleo.  Combine Heinz 57 and water.  Pour over chicken.  Cover and cook 30 to 40 minutes.  Remove cover the last 10 minutes.  Spoon sauce over chicken.

name: LONE STAR CAVIAR DIP
ingredients:
3  c. black-eyed peas with jalapeno
1 small  bottle Italian dressing
1 small  jar pimentos, chopped
1  bunch green onions
Tabasco
salt and pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: DUTCH MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. sausage
1  c. fresh bread crumbs
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. tomato sauce
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
other 1/2 of tomato sauce
1  c. water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Bake in a 350° oven for 1 1/4 hours, basting occasionally. Serves 6 or more.

name: MUSHROOM CROUSTADES
ingredients:
24  slices thin white bread
2  Tbsp. soft butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°. Cut bread in rounds. Butter. Place in small muffin tin. Bake 8 minutes to toasty color. Let cool. (Can freeze.)

name: POLISH EASTER CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. butter
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. raisins
1  Tbsp. milk
1/2  c. warm water
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  lemon peel, grated
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/2  c. chopped almonds
1  c. confectioners sugar
whole candied cherries
preparation: Scald milk.  Stir in sugar, salt and butter.  Cool to lukewarm.  Pour lukewarm water into a large bowl. Sprinkle yeast over top and stir until dissolved.  Add milk, eggs and flour. Beat vigorously for 5 minutes.  Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 1/2 hours or until doubled.  Stir down batter.   Beat in almonds, raisins and lemon peel.  Pour batter into greased and floured Charlotte mold or deep cake pan.  Let rise for 1 hour. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.  Let cool in pan for 20 minutes, then remove.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
3  Tbsp. sour cream
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar together; mash three bananas into this.  Add cream, eggs and lastly flour with soda in it.  Bake in loaf pans at 350° until toothpick comes out clean.

name: VENISON STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. venison, cut in strips
milk
1  egg, beaten
cracker crumbs
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: Soak venison in milk  for  30  minutes.  Dip in egg and roll in cracker crumbs.  Fry  in  skillet  with  more oil than usual. When brown, remove  from oil and place in baking dish. Pour mushroom soup over and bake 1 hour at 300°.

name: SQUASH FRITTERS
ingredients:
2  c. cooked, mashed yellow squash
2  eggs, beaten
1  small chopped onion
1/2  c. cracker crumbs
salt and pepper to taste
hot salad oil
preparation: Combine all ingredients except oil.  Drop by tablespoon into hot oil.  Cook until golden brown.

name: OZARK PIE
ingredients:
1  egg
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped pecans
3  or 4 Heath bars
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. chopped apples
1  qt. ice cream
preparation: Combine egg, sugar, salt, baking powder and flour; beat well. Stir apples and nuts into beaten mixture.  Pour into greased pie pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes.  Spoon on the ice cream. Spread the crushed candy bars over the top and freeze.

name: GRANDMA'S BREAD AND BUTTER PICKLES
ingredients:
4  qt. sliced medium cucumbers
6  medium white onions, sliced
2  green peppers, chopped
3  cloves garlic
2/3  c. coarse salt
5  c. sugar
3  c. cider vinegar
1 1/2  tsp. turmeric
1/2  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Do not peel cucumbers. Slice; add onions, peppers and whole garlic. Add salt; let stand for 3 hours. Drain. Combine sugar, vinegar, turmeric and celery seed and pour over pickle mixture. Heat just to a boil; then seal in pint jars. Yields 8 pints.

name: 6 MINUTE FUDGE
ingredients:
1 large  can evaporated milk
4 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
2  sticks margarine or butter
3 (18 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate bits
vanilla
1  c. nuts
preparation: In a large saucepan, bring to a boil the sugar, cream of tartar and evaporated milk.  When it comes to a boil, cook for 6 minutes by the clock, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon.  Remove from heat.  Pour over bits of margarine.  Stir until completely dissolved.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Stir.  Pour into a greased pan (I use margarine).  Allow to stand at room temperature for approximately 1 hour.  Cut in squares or refrigerate overnight and cut the following day.

name: LIME-TOMATO SIPPER
ingredients:
1  tsp. chicken-flavored bouillon granules
1  c. boiling water
3  c. tomato juice
2  Tbsp. lime juice
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1/4  tsp. basil
celery sticks (garnish)
preparation: Combine bouillon granules and boiling water, stirring until granules dissolve.  Add tomato juice and next 5 ingredients; stir well.  Cover and chill thoroughly.  To serve, pour into glasses. Garnish.  Yields 4 cups.

name: ANN'S CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  tsp. salt
1  c. minute rice
5  c. shredded cabbage
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. milk
1/2  c. grated cheese (can add more)
preparation: Brown meat, celery, onion and salt.  In a kettle, cook cabbage for 5 minutes.  After it starts boiling, drain and add meat mixture.  Then add rice and 1/2 of grated cheese.  Put in casserole dish and top with remaining cheese.  Bake at 350° for one hour.  You may substitute bell pepper for celery and chicken soup for mushroom if you desire.

name: STRAWBERRY OR RASPBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. Karo syrup
2  Tbsp. jello (strawberry or raspberry)
preparation: Cook  sugar, water, cornstarch and Karo until clear and add jello.  Pour over berries in a baked pie shell.

name: CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter
1 1/2  c. granulated sugar
4  eggs
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. corn meal
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar well. Add eggs and stir until well blended, but do not beat.  Add lemon juice and corn meal.  Pour into pastry shell or 8 individual unbaked tart shells.  Bake at 350° until lightly brown (about 30 minutes).

name: GARLIC-CHEESE BISCUITS
ingredients:
1/4  c. (1/2 stick) butter, melted
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. minced onion
2  c. Bisquick mix
2/3  c. milk
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Blend together butter, garlic powder, minced onion and set aside.

name: MEAT FILLED MUSHROOM CAPS
ingredients:
2  doz. fresh mushrooms
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. bread crumbs
1  egg yolk
1  tsp. minced onion
garlic salt
black pepper
preparation: Marinate mushrooms  in	soy  sauce  for  1  hour.  Chop stems. Mix ground beef, green pepper, bread crumbs, egg yolk, onion, garlic  salt  and  pepper.	Drain caps, stuff and mound high. Brush tops with soy sauce and broil 8 to 10 minutes and freeze. Bring to room temperature and bake at 350° (preheated oven) for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: HARVARD BEETS(Microwave)
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can diced, sliced beets
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. wine vinegar
preparation: Drain beets, reserving liquid.  In 1 cup glass measure, pour beet liquid and add enough water to make 1 cup of liquid.  In 1-quart microproof casserole or bowl, combine sugar, cornstarch, salt, pepper and vinegar.  Stir in hot liquid.  Cook, uncovered, on High for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mixture thickens and is clear.   Add beets and stir gently.  Cook, covered, on High about 5 minutes or until beets are hot.  Makes 4 servings.

name: MY FAVORITE MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
2 (7 oz.)  boxes shell macaroni, cooked and cooled
1  c. shredded raw carrots
2  c. frozen peas, thawed
2  c. cubed ham
onion and green pepper to your taste
1 small  jar pimento
1  c. chopped celery
2  c. cubed cheese
preparation: Mix all the above together.

name: Herb Coated Radishes
ingredients:
1 large  bunch trimmed radishes
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. thyme
1/8  tsp. fennel seed
1/8  tsp. basil
dash of white pepper
preparation: Place radishes in a small saucepan.  Cover with salted water. Simmer over low heat, covered, until tender (10 to 12 minutes). Drain well.  Add butter, thyme, basil, fennel seed and white pepper.  Stir over medium heat until radishes are well coated. Serve immediately.

name: MYRTLE'S TURTLES
ingredients:
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. coconut
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. condensed milk
preparation: Grease 8 x 8-inch pan with butter.  Layer ingredients as listed.  Pour milk over all.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until golden.

name: SPINACH AND SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach
1/2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
4  oz. spaghetti, cooked and drained
1  beaten egg
1/4  c. milk
2  tsp. dried onion
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook and drain spinach and combine egg, sour cream, milk and first 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese.  Add cheese, drained spinach and spaghetti.  Bake in 10 x 2 x 6-inch casserole for 15 minutes covered at 350°.  Add rest of Parmesan cheese.  Bake covered for 15 minutes at 350°.  Then uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes or more.

name: MISS CARRIE MAE'S BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
3  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1 1/2  tsp. salt
8  to 9 medium bananas, mashed
4  Tbsp. milk with 1 Tbsp. vinegar
3  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  For bread, pour into loaf pans and adjust baking time.  May be frozen.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. crescent rolls
6  eggs
1  lb. sausage
2  pkg. shredded cheese
1  c. milk
preparation: Brown and drain sausage.  Press rolls in a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.  Spread sausage over rolls.  Next put cheese, then pour beaten eggs and milk over cheese.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: PIMENTO CHEESE
ingredients:
1 small  box Velveeta cheese (lite)
2  tsp. pimento or to taste
1/2 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  Tbsp. salad dressing
1  boiled egg white, finely chopped
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Soften cheese and add other ingredients.  Low-fat!

name: HEAVENLY CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand
1  can cherry pie filling
1  pkg. miniature marshmallows
1  large Cool Whip
1  can crushed pineapple
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. coconut
preparation: Mix and chill.

name: A FAVORITE RECIPE FOR A HAPPY HOME
ingredients:
4  c. love
2  c. loyalty
3  c. forgiveness
1  c. friendship
5  Tbsp. hope
4  qt. faith
1  barrel of laughter
2  Tbsp. tenderness
preparation: Take love and loyalty and mix thoroughly with faith.  Blend it with tenderness, kindness and understanding.  Add friendship and hope; sprinkle abundantly with laughter.  Bake it with sunshine. Serve daily with generous helpings.

name: ASPARAGUS ROMANOFF
ingredients:
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can Cheddar cheese soup
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. sour cream
2  lb. fresh asparagus, cooked or 2 cans (19 oz. each) asparagus spears, heated
preparation: In a saucepan over low heat, combine soup, Worcestershire sauce and sour cream.  Stir constantly and heat to just below boiling.

name: MINIATURE CHEESECAKES
ingredients:
1  box vanilla wafers
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. grated lemon peel
1/4  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
strawberry preserves
preparation: Combine cream cheese, sugar, juice, peel and vanilla, mixing at medium speed.  Blend in egg.  Pour over vanilla wafers in cupcake papers in cupcake pan.  Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.  Cool in pans, then chill.  Then top with strawberry preserves.

name: HONEY-BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  chicken breasts or thighs
1/2  c. honey
1/2  Dijon mustard
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. garlic or onion powder
1  tsp. curry powder or to taste
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Arrange chicken skin side up in shallow baking pan.  Mix honey, mustard, lemon juice, garlic, or onion powder, and curry powder.  Pour mixture over chicken.  Cover pan with foil.  Bake at 400°  for 1 hour and 30 minutes.  Uncover. Baste meat with sauce.  Bake uncovered another 10 minutes. Yield: 4 servings.

name: MEXICAN LAYER DIP
ingredients:
1 large  can refried beans
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt and pepper
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  bunch green onions
2  medium tomatoes, chopped
1  can pitted ripe olives, chopped
8  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: In 9 x 12 dish, spread beans. Mix lemon juice, salt, pepper and mayonnaise. Spread over beans. Sprinkle taco seasoning. Layer remaining ingredients in listed order. Serve with tortilla chips.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE #9
ingredients:
1  pkg. broccoli
1/2  c. grated cheese
1/2  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. dried onion
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Cook  broccoli	according  to package directions; drain well. Mix  all  other  ingredients and add to broccoli.  Pour into casserole and top with Ritz cracker crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  (Recipe can easily be doubled.)

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
4  c. cooked rice
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  c. milk
1  c. raisins
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
4  eggs, slightly beaten
dash of salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a large bowl, combine the rice, sugar, milk, raisins, nutmeg, eggs and salt.  Mix well and pour into a buttered casserole.  Bake for 1 1/2 hours, or until the top is browned.  Serve warm.  Yield: 8 servings.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
3  eggs, whipped
2/3  c. butter, melted
