2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix flour and sugar.  Add eggs, butter, vanilla and milk. Cook in unbaked pie shell in 350° oven until lightly browned.

name: HERBED CREAM CHEESE APPETIZER
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  oz. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh chives
1/4  tsp. black pepper
3  red peppers
1  pkg. Mozzarella cheese slices
1/4  c. fresh parsley leaves, chopped
2  Tbsp. sour cream
1  bundle green onions
1  bunch celery
1  bunch fresh chives
wheat crackers
preparation: Combine cream cheese, chopped parsley leaves, grated Parmesan cheese, 2 tablespoons sour cream, chopped chives and black pepper. Mix well.  Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

name: CHERRIES IN THE SNOW
ingredients:
honey graham crackers
Cool Whip
cherry pie filling
preparation: Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with honey graham crackers, then pour cherry filling over the crackers, then a layer of Cool Whip on top.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
3  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. nutmeg
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
3  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. grated zucchini
preparation: Measure dry ingredients.  Add butter, oil, eggs, milk and vanilla; blend well.  Fold in grated zucchini.  Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan one hour at 350°.  Dust with powdered sugar while warm.

name: MINTED BROWNIE PIE
ingredients:
14  chocolate mint Girl Scout cookies, crushed
3  egg whites
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
1/2  pt. whipping cream (you must use the real thing)
2  tsp. confectioners sugar
preparation: Set crushed cookies aside.  Beat together egg whites and salt until soft peaks form.  Add sugar to egg whites and beat until peaks form.  Add vanilla, nuts and cookies to egg mixture with a light, folding motion.  Spread in a buttered 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.  Cool thoroughly.  Whip whipping cream to peaks.  Add confectioners sugar to beaten cream. Spread this on cooled pie.  Garnish with chocolate curls.  Chill 3 to 4 hours before serving.

name: HAMBURGER-VEGETABLE CASSEROLE DELUXE
ingredients:
1  pkg. hash browns, thawed
1  lb. hamburger
1  envelope brown gravy mix
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. California mixed vegetables
1  can sliced water chestnuts
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese (save 1/2 for topping)
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/2  c. chopped onion
salt and pepper
1  pkg. frozen onion rings
1  c. water
preparation: Mix thawed hash browns with the oil, salt and pepper to taste. Spread in bottom and up sides of an 8 x 8-inch baking dish to make a shell.  Bake in a 350° oven until lightly browned, about 20 minutes.  Prepare meat while potatoes are baking.  Brown hamburger with salt, pepper and chopped onion.  Drain well.  Add gravy mix plus water.  Add package of frozen vegetables.  Steam with meat until vegetables are tender.  Add mushroom soup and 1/2 cup cheese.  Also, add water chestnuts.  Spoon over top of baked potato crust.  Spread other 1/2 cup cheese over top.  Place onion rings over top of all.  Bake 20 to 35 minutes in a 350° oven. Recipe may be doubled.  Use large 11 x 15-inch baking dish.

name: JALAPENO CORN MUFFINS
ingredients:
6  to 8 navel oranges
7  oz. box corn muffin mix
2 to 4  oz. canned chopped jalapeno chillies
butter
preparation: Cut off top 1/4 of oranges.  With serrated grapefruit knife, free the whole orange from its rind.  Be careful not to pierce skin.  Reserve oranges for grilling.

name: CREOLE POTATOES
ingredients:
2  c. peeled, cubed potatoes
1  green pepper, sliced
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. tomato juice
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Simmer potatoes in boiling water for 5 minutes.  Drain and add green pepper, onion and tomato juice.  Simmer 10 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender.  Add salt and pepper to taste while simmering.  Yields 6 servings.

name: NO BAKE PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2/3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
4 heaping  Tbsp. chunky peanut butter
1  sleeve soda crackers, broken up fine (do not roll)
1  c. coconut
preparation: Boil sugar and milk exactly three minutes and remove from heat.  Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well.  Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.  Let cookies set up.  Store in airtight container.

name: SAUSAGE EGG BREAKFAST
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. herb croutons or frozen hashbrowns
2  c. shredded cheese
2  lb. bulk sausage
4  eggs
3/4  tsp. dry mustard
2 1/2  c. milk
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Place croutons in 9 x 13 inch greased dish.  Top with cheese and browned sausage.  Beat eggs with mustard and 2 1/2 cup milk. Pour over and refrigerate overnight.

name: BROCCOLI STEM - MARINADE
ingredients:
3  c. broccoli stems
2  Tbsp. white vinegar
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. Oriental oil
2/3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
preparation: Peel broccoli stems and slice thin.  Combine remaining ingredients to make marinade. Pour marinade over broccoli stems. Marinate 6 hours.  Very good and crunchy in salads.   Keeps up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.

name: SPINACH LASAGNA
ingredients:
1/2  lb. pkg. lasagna, uncooked
2  (26 oz.) spaghetti sauce
1  (15 oz.) Ricotta cheese
1  (10 oz.) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1  lb. shredded Mozzarella cheese, divided
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  eggs, beaten
chopped parsley
preparation: Cook lasagna according to package directions.  In a medium bowl, combine Ricotta, spinach, 1/2 cup Mozzarella, Parmesan cheese and eggs.  Mix well.  In a 15 x 9-inch pan, layer:  2 cups sauce, 1/2 lasagna, 1/2 remaining sauce, spinach mixture, 1/2 remaining Mozzarella, remaining lasagna and remaining sauce.  Cover.  Bake at 350° until bubbly (45 minutes).  Uncover.  Top with remaining Mozzarella and parsley.  Bake 15 minutes.  Let stand 10 to 15 minutes before cutting.  Makes 12 to 15 servings.

name: HARVARD BEETS
ingredients:
1 16  oz. can of sliced beets
2  Tbsp lemon juice
dash of salt
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Drain liquid from beets into sauce pan.  Season liquid with the remaining ingredients.  Bring mixture to a boil, then thicken with:  2 Tbsp. Argo Starch that you have mixed with a little water.  Stir into hot liquid and cook until thickened the way you want it.  Pour beets into hot liquid and cook.  Stir until thickened.

name: BUTTER ROLLS
ingredients:
8  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  c. milk
4  c. self-rising flour
1  stick butter
4  c. sugar
preparation: Mix cooking oil, milk and flour together.  Divide dough into fourths then roll each out to 7 by 5 inches until as thin as a pie crust.  Cut stick of butter long way in four strips.  Then sprinkle 1/4 cup of sugar on each piece.  Roll up 4 times and pinch the ends together.  Bake at 300 degrees until golden brown.

name: CHEESE TEA SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1/2  c. whipped cream cheese
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. prepared mustard
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/8  tsp. ground red pepper (optional)
16 unpeeled cucumber  slices (optional)
16  slices white sandwich bread
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients.  Add red pepper, if desired.  Set aside.  With a 1 3/4-inch cookie cutter, cut 2 rounds out of each bread slice.  Spread half of bread rounds with cheese filling.  Top with cucumber slices if desired and remaining bread rounds.  Place in shallow container and cover with plastic wrap.  Top with a damp dish towel and refrigerate 8 hours.  Yields 16 sandwiches. Sandwiches may be frozen, omitting cucumber.  Thaw in refrigerator and add cucumber before serving.  Flavored cream cheese may be substituted for the cheese filling.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE FOR GRILLING CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  c. vinegar
1/2  c. water
1  stick butter
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients until hot.  Brush on chicken upon turning on grill.  Makes enough for 2 chickens.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. mashed bananas
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  c. sifted flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. nutmeats
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar together.  Beat eggs until light, then add bananas that have been pushed through a sieve.  Add lemon juice.  Blend with creamed mixture.  Sift flour, baking powder and salt together and mix quickly into banana mixture.  Add nuts. Bake in greased loaf pan in moderate oven at 375° for about 1 1/4 hours.  Makes a 1 pound loaf.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
12  potatoes, cooked and mashed
2 small  cartons cottage cheese
1 small  carton sour cream
2  Tbsp. chopped chives
1/4  tsp. dill weed
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Mash potatoes.  Add milk and salt and pepper to taste.  Add cottage cheese, sour cream, chives and dill.  Place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Top with cheese.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: OVEN BARBECUE RIBS
ingredients:
3  lb. ribs
salt
pepper
1  chopped onion
sauce
preparation: Salt and pepper ribs.  Cook for 20 minutes in large, flat, foil-covered pan at 500°.  Drain grease and add onion and sauce. Cover with foil again and cook at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or longer.

name: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  tsp. vanilla
1 (16 oz.)  can sliced peaches, drained
1 (16 oz.)  can fruit cocktail, drained
2  c. miniature marshmallows
few drops red food coloring
1/3  c. powdered sugar
1/3  c. salad dressing or mayonnaise
1/3  c. maraschino cherry halves
1  (8 oz.) crushed pineapple, drained
1/3  c. whipping cream
additional whipping cream for garnish
preparation: Whip the cream cheese. Add powdered sugar and mix until well blended.  Add vanilla and blend in salad dressing or mayonnaise. Fold in fruit and marshmallows. Whip the cream and fold into fruit mixture. Add food coloring and mix.  Salad should be pale pink. Ladle into 5-ounce serving or souffle cups.  Freeze immediately, at least overnight.  Defrost about 15 minutes before serving. This is really good.

name: CAKE THAT DOESN'T LAST
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts
2  c. mashed bananas
1  (8 oz.) crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients in big bowl.  Drain pineapple and mix with eggs, oil, vanilla, nuts and mashed bananas in medium bowl. Add the moist mixture to dry mixture.  Spray the Bundt pan with Pam or Baker's Joy.  Bake at 325° to 350° for 70 to 75 minutes.

name: E Z CRESCENT ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1  c. water
3  eggs
2/3  c. oil
1/2  c. sugar
4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water and 1/4 cup sugar.  Mix together the eggs, oil, remaining water and sugar.  Combine yeast and egg mixture.  Add flour and salt.  Knead dough until it forms a smooth ball.  Refrigerate overnight.   Divide dough into two parts.  Roll out to a circle.  Spread with melted butter or margarine.  Using a pizza cutter, cut wedges.  Roll up; bend into a crescent shape.  Bake at 350° until golden brown.

name: SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
2  eggs
1/2  c. Crisco oil
1  stick oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. water
4  tsp. cocoa
1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Sift flour and sugar, bring Crisco, oleo, water and cocoa to rapid boil and pour over sugar and flour.  Mix well buttermilk, soda, vanilla and eggs and add to mixture.  Pour into 9 x 16-inch pan.  Bake 20 minutes at 425°.

name: "SPOONBREAKER" CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES(Ask Greg how these got their name!)
ingredients:
2  c. butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
5  c. oatmeal
4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
24  oz. chocolate chips
1  (8 oz.)  Hershey bar
3  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
preparation: Grind oatmeal and Hershey bar (broken into small pieces) in food processor or blender until oatmeal resembles coarse flour.  In large bowl, cream butter and sugars; add eggs and vanilla.  Add dry ingredients; mix well, then add chips and nuts.  Put spoonfuls 2 inches apart onto cookie sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375°. Makes 9 to 10 dozen.

name: BROCCOLI CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
6  c. water
8  oz. fine egg noodles
1  tsp. salt
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli
3/4  c. chopped onion
6  c. chicken bouillon cubes
1  lb. cheese (Velveeta, Cheez Whiz or American)
pepper to taste
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
6  c. milk
preparation: Saute onion in butter for 3 minutes.  Add water and bouillon cubes.  Heat to boiling until cubes are dissolved.   Gradually add noodles and salt until mixture boils.  Cook, uncovered, for 3 minutes.  Stir in broccoli and garlic, cook 4 minutes.  Add milk, cheese and pepper and continue cooking until cheese melts, stirring constantly.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. Bisquick baking mix
2  eggs
2 1/2  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
2  Tbsp. oleo
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
2 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease pie plate.  Beat all ingredients until smooth, 1 minute in blender on high or 2 minutes with hand beater.  Pour into plate.  Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean, 50 to 55 minutes.   Let cool and garnish with whipped cream.  Sprinkle a little cinnamon on top if desired.

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. cider vinegar
1/3  tsp. white pepper
6  medium warm boiled potatoes, peeled and cubed
1/2  minced yellow onion
1/2  c. sweet green bell pepper
1  c. coarsely chopped celery
3 to 4  slices crisp cooked bacon
4  hard-cooked eggs, peeled and diced
3/4  c. cold water
2  Tbsp. sugar
2/3  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Blend flour and 2 tablespoons water in a small saucepan; add remaining water, vinegar, sugar, pepper and 2 teaspoons salt.  Stir until mixture boils.  Place potatoes, onion, green pepper and celery in a large bowl and toss lightly.  Pour in hot dressing and mix well.  Cool to room temperature; add crumbled bacon and eggs. Toss again.  Taste for salt; add more if needed.  Serve at room temperature.  Serves 6, about 250 calories per serving.

name: BEEF WELLINGTON
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
9  oz. chopped broccoli
1  cup Mozzarella cheese, shredded
1/2  cup sour cream
1  small onion, chopped
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2- 8  oz. pkg. Crescent rolls
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Brown ground beef.  Add broccoli, cheese, sour cream, onion, salt and pepper.  Mix well.  Spread crescent rolls out.  Spoon meat mixture onto rolls.  Roll up.  Brush with egg and bake at 375° until rolls are brown.

name: VENISON CHINESE PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. thin venison steaks
1/4  c. corn oil
1  clove garlic
1/2  c. coarsely chopped onion
2  c. bite-size pieces of green pepper
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. stock or bouillon
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
cooked rice
preparation: Cut steaks diagonally across the grain into thin slices, then cut strips about 2 inches long.  Heat oil in skillet over medium heat.  Place garlic clove in hot oil.  Remove after 3 minutes. Add meat to oil.  Cook over medium heat, turning as needed, until browned.  Mix in onion, green pepper, salt, pepper and ginger. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until just tender, about 3 minutes.  Blend cornstarch with stock and soy sauce.  Stir into mixture in skillet.  Bring to boil and cook, stirring constantly, until liquid is thickened.  Serve over rice.

name: JOHNNY APPLESEED FILLED COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. soft shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. cream
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
thick apple butter
preparation: Mix shortening, sugar and eggs. Stir in cream and vanilla. Stir in flour, baking soda and salt until blended.  Chill at least 1 hour.  Heat oven to 400°.  Roll dough 1/8-inch thick on lightly floured board.  Cut rounds.  Place apple butter on one round and place another round on top.  Press edges together. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.  Makes 2 dozen cookies.

name: CHICKEN STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. skinless, boneless chicken, cut into strips
2  c. sliced mushrooms
1  celery stalk, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. sour cream or plain yogurt
margarine
preparation: In skillet, in 1 tablespoon hot margarine, cook half of the chicken until browned; stir often.  Remove.  Repeat with remaining chicken.  In an additional 1 tablespoon hot margarine, cook mushrooms and celery until tender and liquid is evaporated; stir often.  Add soup and sour cream; heat to boiling.  Return chicken to skillet; heat through.  Stir often.  Serve with rice or noodles.  Serves 4.

name: GRANDMOM'S MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms
2  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. melted butter
1/3  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
preparation: Clean mushrooms; remove stems, leaving caps whole.  Slice stems.  Combine mushrooms and flour in a plastic bag; shake to coat.  Saute mushrooms in butter about 10 minutes.  Add cheese and sour cream, stirring until cheese melts and mixture is blended. Do not boil.

name: STRAWBERRY SHORT CAKE
ingredients:
1  Duncan Hines Strawberry cake mix
1/2  c. oil
1  c. milk
1  instant vanilla pudding mix
4  eggs
preparation: Cook cake mix as box directs.  Cool.  Stack cake with large cool whip and frozen strawberries.  Makes 2 layers.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar (cut 1/2 sugar, not as sweet)
1  c. boiling water
3  tsp. cornstarch
1  small strawberry jello
1 1/2  qt. strawberries
2  frozen pie shells
preparation: Mix sugar, cornstarch, jello and boiling water on double boiler.  Cook until thickened, then let cool.  Cook 2 pie shells. Place strawberries in bottom of pie shells.  Pour strawberry mix over top and chill.  Top with Cool Whip.

name: DELICIOUS PORK AND BEANS
ingredients:
onion, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. molasses
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1/3  c. brown sugar
1  can pork and beans
5  slices bacon
preparation: Cut up one slice of uncooked bacon.  Fry remaining 4 slices until crisp.  Combine all ingredients into an ovenproof casserole and bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. (hot) sausage
10  oz. sharp Cheddar
3  c. Bisquick or Jiffy mix
preparation: Mix together raw sausage and grated cheese.  Allow mix to come to room temperature before slowly working in Bisquick.   Roll into balls and place on cookie sheet.  Cook for 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.  Makes approximately 3 dozen sausage balls.

name: SCALLOPED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  medium cabbage, shredded
24  soda crackers
1/2  stick butter
salt and pepper to taste
2  c. milk
preparation: Layer cabbage and ground soda crackers with pats of butter or margarine and add salt and pepper to each layer.    Fill your casserole with the layers.   Top with butter or margarine.   Pour milk over this until the crackers are all soaked and not too much milk.   Bake at 350° until light brown and cabbage is tender.

name: DILL PICKLES
ingredients:
1  qt 5% white vinegar
2  qt water
1  c plain salt
2  fresh dill heads or tsp Dill seed
2  qt jar
Large clove garlic
1/4  tsp powdered alum
Grape Leaf
preparation: Wash small whole cucumbers.  Soak in ice water 5 hours. Place fresh dill or dill seed, garlic, and clove in bottom of jar. Pack cold cucumbers in jar.  Put 1/4 tsp alum on top.  Mix solution of vinegar, salt, and water.  Bring to a boil and pour over cucumbers.  Place grape leaf on top of cucumber and seal. Pickles must work.  They won't spoil if you store them in a dark place. They are ready in 8 weeks.

name: RUDOLPH'S SALAD
ingredients:
1  small head red cabbage, shredded
1 small  can pineapple tidbits, drained
1  c. grated cheese
2  apples, chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Add 1/4 cup mayonnaise, dash of sugar and 2 tablespoons of water.  Mix and top salad.

name: MARVELOUS NUTTY MARBLED CHEESE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1/4  c. light brown sugar
1/4  c. dark brown sugar
1/4  c. butter
1  c. flour
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/4  c. chopped dry roasted peanuts
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1  c. whipping cream
1  jar Hershey's fudge sauce
preparation: To make crust, combine the first 6 ingredients.  Press 3/4 of this into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Cool. Bake the remaining 1/4 of the mixture separately and crumble to save for a top garnish.

name: CREOLE PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
8  pork chops (1/2-inch thick)
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/3  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 large  clove garlic, minced
2  c. crumbled corn bread
1  egg, slightly beaten
1 (8 oz.)  can whole tomatoes (undrained), cut up
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. packed brown sugar
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. cayenne
1  bay leaf
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons butter.  Add 4 chops.  Brown both sides over medium heat.  Repeat with remaining chops.  Remove from skillet and set aside.

name: SLIPPERY DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. Crisco
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. milk or a little more if needed
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and roll out thin between wax paper.

name: DEVIL CRABS
ingredients:
1  lb. can crab meat
1  c. milk
2  or 3 peppers, ground up
3  onions, ground up
2  hard-boiled eggs
bunch fresh parsley
2  or 3 stalks celery
1/2  loaf bread, ground
preparation: Clean crab meat well and put in a pan.  Bring to a boil with 1 cup of milk.  Set aside.  Then add salt and pepper, dried red peppers and Worcestershire sauce to taste.  Mix all together.  If too mushy, add cracker meal.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. squash
2  medium carrots, grated
1  medium onion, chopped
1 (2 oz.)  jar pimentos
salt and pepper to taste
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  pt. sour cream
1  stick margarine
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm stuffing (herb seasoned)
preparation: Cook squash, carrots and onions until tender and water cooks out.  Turn off heat and add soup, pimentos and sour cream and mix. Melt margarine and mix with stuffing.  Alternate layers of stuffing and squash mixture, starting with stuffing on bottom of casserole.  Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: LEMON SURPRISE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. pecans, chopped finely
1  stick butter
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
4 1/2  c. milk
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
3 small  boxes instant lemon pudding
preparation: Mix together melted butter, nuts and flour.  Press into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Set aside and cool.  Mix cream cheese and sugar until creamy.  Add Cool Whip and mix well.  Spread on crust.  Mix pudding and milk together.  Beat until thick.  Pour on top of cream cheese mixture. Refrigerate.

name: STRAWBERRY NUT PIE
ingredients:
1  vanilla wafer pie crust
1  pkg. marshmallows (24)
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
1/2  pt. whipping cream, whipped
preparation: Heat marshmallows and juice of strawberries in top of double boiler until marshmallows are dissolved.  Set this mixture aside until it begins to thicken.  Add strawberries, nuts and whipped cream.  Pour this filling into the pie shell and keep the pie in refrigerator overnight.

name: SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. cooked spinach or 1 pkg. frozen spinach, thawed
1  lb. cottage cheese
8  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
3  eggs, beaten
3  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Mix cheeses with beaten eggs.  Stir in flour until smooth. Add spinach until well blended.  Bake at 350° in 1-quart casserole sprayed with vegetable oil.  Bake one hour.  Cool about 10 minutes before serving.  Serves 4.

name: ORANGE BLOSSOM CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. cake flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. salad oil
2  egg yolks (unbeaten)
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. orange rind
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. egg whites (4 or 5)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Measure the first 3 ingredients into sifter.  Measure the next 5 ingredients into mixing bowl.  Measure the egg whites, salt and cream of tartar into another mixing bowl.  Sift dry ingredients over oil, egg yolks, water and vanilla.  Beat until smooth.  Beat egg whites, salt and cream of tartar with beater until mixture stands in very stiff peaks.  Fold egg whites thoroughly into batter.  Do not stir or beat.  Bake in an ungreased 9-inch square pan at 350° for 30 minutes (glass dish at 325° for 30 minutes). Remove from oven.  Cool by turning pan upside down.  (I put a spice can on each corner to hold it up so it doesn't touch the cupboard.) To remove, run knife around the edge and loosen.  Split cake in two layers and spread whipped cream between layers and top.  Sprinkle with coconut and garnish with orange sections, if desired.

name: CAPE COD SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1 (No. 1)  can jelly cranberry sauce
1 (No. 1)  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  banana, sliced
1 1/4  c. cold water
preparation: Heat water and cranberry sauce until liquified.  Add Jell-O and chill until slightly thick.  Add fruit cocktail and banana. Set until firm, preferably overnight.

name: LOW-FAT CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  pkg. fat-free flour tortillas
1  Tbsp. margarine
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can fat-free condensed cream of chicken soup
1  fresh garlic clove, minced
1 (4 oz.)  can diced green chilies, drained
1/2  c. non-fat sour cream
1 1/2  c. cubed, cooked chicken breast (without skin)
1  c. (4 oz.) reduced-fat shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. skim milk
preparation: Remove tortillas from refrigerator; set aside.  Heat oven to 350°.  In nonstick skillet, melt margarine.  Cook onion and garlic until tender.  Stir in green chilies, sour cream and soup; mix well.  Reserve 3/4 cup sauce; set aside.  Stir in chicken and 1/2 cup cheese to remaining sauce in skillet.  Warm tortillas according to package directions.  Fill tortillas with chicken mixture; roll up.  Place seam-side down in ungreased 12 x 8-inch baking dish.  In small bowl, combine reserved sauce and milk; spoon over rolled tortillas.  Top with remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until bubbly.

name: PICANTE DIP
ingredients:
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese, softened
1  jar Chi-Chi's picante sauce (any strength)
grated Cheddar cheese
chopped tomatoes
chopped little green onions
preparation: Mix cream cheese and picante sauce thoroughly. Top with layer of Cheddar cheese, followed by tomatoes and then green onions.

name: RAISIN-DATE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. grated orange peel
2  tsp. grated lemon peel
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  pkg. raisins
1  pkg. dates, chopped
1  c. chopped almonds, toasted
preparation: Beat margarine and sugar until fluffy.  Beat in eggs, orange and lemon peel.  Combine flour, baking soda, cinnamon and nutmeg. Beat into margarine mixture until blended.  Stir in raisins, dates and almonds.  Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet.  Spread slightly with back of spoon or fork.  Bake 15 minutes.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: RODEO ROUND UP PIE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. chocolate chips
1/2  c. butterscotch chips
1  pie crust
preparation: Cream margarine, sugar and eggs. Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° until knife comes out clean, approximately 35 to 40 minutes.

name: FREEZER PICKLES
ingredients:
12  c. cucumbers, sliced real thin
2  c. onions, sliced real thin
3  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Mix onions and cucumbers with salt and water.  Cover and let set 3 hours before draining.

name: CATFISH STEW
ingredients:
5  lb. catfish
5  lb. potatoes, diced
3  lb. onions, diced
3  slices salt-fat meat (fatback)
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of tomato soup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cover catfish in water; cook until meat will separate from bone.  Remove catfish from stock (reserve stock).  Use a 3 gallon pot.  Saute onions in oil.  Add potatoes and cover with fish stock.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  small onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  cans Ro-Tel tomatoes
cheese (approximately 1 lb., the more the better), grated
1  pkg. Doritos (can use corn chips)
preparation: Brown the hamburger meat with the onions and drain well.  Mix the soups and Ro-Tel tomatoes; add to the meat.  Simmer about 10 minutes.  In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, layer the meat, chips and cheese until you have used it all.  Top with more cheese and heat in a 350° oven until steaming hot and the cheese is bubbly.

name: REFRESHING CUCUMBER DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. grated onion
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/3  c. finely chopped cucumber
preparation: Combine all ingredients except cucumbers, mixing until well blended.  Stir in cucumbers.  Chill several hours or overnight. Serve with chips or vegetable dippers.

name: CRISP CRUSTED BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  boneless skinless chicken breasts
1  egg
2  Tbsp. milk
1  c. instant mashed potatoes
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. margarine
preparation: Beat egg.  Add milk in bowl.  In another bowl, mix potatoes, cheese and garlic.  Roll chicken, first in egg then in potato mixture.  Melt butter in shallow, glass baking pan.  Roll coated chicken in butter and arrange in pan.  Bake at 400° for 45 to 50 minutes.  Time may vary depending on size of breasts.  Serves 6.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. vegetable oil
3/4  c. milk
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  (8 oz.) crushed pineapple, drained
2  c. grated carrots
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can flaked coconut
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Generously grease cake pan.  Sift flour, soda, cinnamon and salt together; set aside.  Combine eggs, oil, milk, sugar and vanilla; mix well.  Add flour mixture, pineapple, carrots, coconut and nuts.  Stir well; pour into pan.  Bake for 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.  Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting, if desired.

name: GRAHAM YOGURT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. graham flour
1/2  c. all-purpose flour (unsifted)
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. unflavored yogurt
1/2  c. molasses
1  c. seedless raisins
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Remove one end from each of four 1-pound cans (the kind used for canned fruits and vegetables); rinse cans, dry and grease well.  In a large bowl, combine the graham and all-purpose flours, soda and salt.  Stir in yogurt, molasses, raisins and walnuts; mix well.  Divide batter evenly between cans.  Bake in a 350° oven for about 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean.  Cool in cans 10 minutes; then turn out and stand loaves upright on a wire rack to cool completely.  Cut loaves crosswise to make thick or thin slices as you prefer.  Makes 4 small loaves.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/3  c. salad oil
4  eggs
2 1/4  c. flour
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
3  c. coarsely grated carrots
1 1/3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine sugar, oil and eggs; beat at medium speed for 2 minutes.  Sift together dry ingredients; add to oil mixture.  Beat at low speed for 1 minute.  Add grated carrots and nuts.  Spread batter in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 300° for about 1 hour, until cake tests done with toothpick.

name: CAJUN BOILED SHRIMP
ingredients:
3 to 5  lb. shrimp (raw in the shell)
1  pkg. Zatarain's seafood boil
3 to 6  ears of corn-on-the-cob, shucked and silked
6  to 12 new red or white potatoes, depending on size of potatoes, more or less may be needed (do not peel potatoes, just wash well)
1  lemon, sliced
1  medium onion, quartered and peeled
2  to 6 dashes red cayenne pepper (optional)
preparation: Fill a large pot 1/2 to 2/3 full of water.  Start water heating.  Put the corn-on-the-cob and potatoes in hot water and cook until almost done.  Bring water to a boil.  Add onion, lemon, seafood boil and cayenne pepper.

name: SAUCE FOR LEFTOVER MEAT
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
1/4  c. green pepper, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Saute onion, celery and green pepper in oil or whatever you prefer.  Add  tomato sauce and mushrooms.  Season with soy sauce and Worcestershire,  add  pepper and whatever spices you desire. Simmer for	about  20  minutes.  Add  sliced leftover meat and simmer for about 15 minutes more.

name: FAVORITE POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  cans potatoes (15 to 16 oz.), drained and sliced
1 1/4  c. mayonnaise
2  c. grated cheese
1  c. milk
8  slices bacon
green olives
preparation: Fry bacon and cut up.  Mix mayonnaise, cheese, milk, olives and bacon.   Layer potatoes, then cheese mixture in 2-quart casserole (use 1-quart casserole for 1/2 recipe).  Bake at 250° for 35 to 40 minutes.   Whole recipe serves 6 to 8.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. unsweetened orange juice
2  c. mashed bananas
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 (32 oz.)  bottle ginger ale
12  fresh strawberries
1  c. sugar
preparation: Combine ingredients in a large mixing bowl.  Can be placed in decorative mold for freezing.  If frozen, place in punch bowl and add the ginger ale.  Garnish with fresh strawberries.

name: CABBAGE ROLL
ingredients:
1  head cabbage
1  medium onion, chopped
2  lb. hamburger
2  eggs
1/4  c. regular rice or 1 c. cooked
1  green pepper, chopped
1/8  tsp. garlic salt
salt and pepper to taste
1 large  jar Ragu sauce
1/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: Heat cabbage until tender.  Combine next seven ingredients; make into balls.  Peel off cabbage leaves and wrap around balls. Place in loaf pan.  Cover with Ragu sauce, sprinkle with brown sugar.  Cover with foil, bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Uncover, bake 30 minutes longer.  Can add cheese to top.

name: BETTY'S COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix (Duncan Hines)
1  (12 oz.) Cool whip
1  (12 oz.) coconut
1  can condensed milk
preparation: Cook cake mix according to directions on the side panel for a pound cake.  Take out of oven when it gets done; quickly punch holes in it with knife, then pour condensed milk over it.  Let cool.  Put Cool Whip on top.  Sprinkle coconut over Cool Whip.  Let sit in fridge overnight.  Use long loaf pan.

name: Breakfast Doughnuts
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. melted shortening
1  c. sour milk or buttermilk
4  c. flour
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. soda
1  tsp. nutmeg
4  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix eggs, sugar, shortening and sour milk until smooth.  Sift together flour, salt, soda, nutmeg and baking powder.  Add to mixture until doesn't stick to hands.  Let rise on floured board for about 20 minutes.  Roll and cut.  Deep fry at 390°, about 1 minute per side.

name: CREAM OF POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
3  c. chopped potatoes
1  c. water
1/2  c. celery slices
1/2  c. carrot slices
1/4  c. parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  chicken bouillon cube
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Combine potatoes, water, celery, carrots, onions, parsley flakes, seasonings and bouillon.  Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.  Gradually add milk to flour, stirring until well blended.  Add flour mixture to hot vegetables.  Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture boils and thickens.  Add cheese and stir until melted.  You can also add ham to this soup if you would like.

name: LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
1  chopped onion
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
4 tomato paste  cans water
1  pkg. spaghetti sauce mix
1  lb. Cheddar cheese
Mozzarella cheese
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. lasagne noodles, cooked
salt and pepper
preparation: Brown meat with salt, pepper and onion; add tomato paste, water and spaghetti sauce mix and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.  In a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan, alternate layers of meat sauce, Cheddar cheese, noodles and Mozzarella cheese until all ingredients have been used.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.  Cool 10 minutes before serving.

name: CINNAMON QUICKIES
ingredients:
2  loaves thin white sandwich bread
16  oz. cream cheese
butter, melted
cinnamon
sugar
preparation: Cut crust off bread.  Flatten bread with a rolling pin. Spread each piece with a light layer of cream cheese.  Roll slices of bread tightly.  Cut rolls into quarters.  Prepare a mixture of cinnamon and sugar.  Dip each roll into melted butter, then roll in the cinnamon and sugar mix.  Place rolls on a cookie sheet and freeze.  When rolls are frozen, store in plastic baggies.  When ready to serve, place rolls on a cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° until rolls are bubbly and puffy.

name: SWEET AND SOUR STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. lean beef, cut in 1-inch cubes
1  Tbsp. oil
1  tsp. salt
1  chopped onion
1  c. water
3  cloves garlic, minced
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2/3  c. catsup
1  bell pepper (large slices)
2/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. mustard
6  potatoes, cut up
preparation: In a large pan, brown meat.  Add onion and garlic.  Add water and cover.  Simmer 1 hour.  Add remaining ingredients and cook until tender.

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
1  large fryer
1  diced onion
1  chopped celery stalk
1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
1 1/2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1 small  can milk
1 small  jar chopped pimentos
8  oz. spaghetti noodles
preparation: Boil chicken until tender; cook and remove bone.  Boil noodles in broth.  Saute onion, celery and mushrooms in 1 tablespoon of butter until tender.  Add noodles, chicken, mushroom soup, pimentos, chopped vegetables and milk to casserole dish.  Bake in oven for 30 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg or 2 egg whites or egg substitute to equal 1 egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. flour
preparation: Cream together the margarine and peanut butter. Add white and brown sugar.  Stir in egg, vanilla, flour and baking soda.  Place dough, a teaspoon at a time, on cookie sheet.  Press each spoonful flat with a floured fork. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Cool a minute or two before removing from cookie sheet.  Yields 5 dozen.

name: VIRTUOUS CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. fat-free cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. nonfat sour cream
3  egg whites
1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  pt. sliced strawberries
preparation: Blend first 4 ingredients with hand mixer on medium speed. Mix in sour cream and egg whites.  Spray a pie pan with nonfat cooking spray and sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs.  Pour cheesecake mixture into pan. Bake for 40 minutes at 325°.  Let cool and serve with sliced strawberries or desired sliced fruit.

name: CHERRIES JUBILEE
ingredients:
1  c. pitted dark sweet cherries, drained and reserved
1/4  c. syrup
1/4  c. rum
3/4  c. currant jelly
1  tsp. grated orange peel
1/4  c. brandy
vanilla ice cream
preparation: Combine syrup and rum.  Pour over reserved cherries and refrigerate for 4 hours.

name: CONGEALED STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 regular  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
2  c. boiling water
1 1/2  c. frozen strawberries (sweetened and sliced)
1 small  can crushed pineapple
2  mashed bananas
1  carton sour cream
preparation: Combine  Jell-O, water, strawberries and pineapple in a bowl. Let  thicken and then add bananas.	Pour 1/2 of mixture into cold Pyrex dish.  Refrigerate.  When thick and firm, pour whole carton of sour cream on top of Jell-O and spread evenly. Pour  other half  of Jell-O mixture on top.  Serve with salad dressing or whipped cream.

name: UNCOOKED FUDGE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. cocoa
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. quick oats
1  c. coconut and/or pecans
preparation: Mix  cocoa and sugar; add margarine and milk.  Bring to a boil;  add vanilla.  Pour over other ingredients; mix well. Drop by spoon and cool.

name: HAM AND CHEESE NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  oz. wide noodles
1  tsp. salt
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese
1/3  c. green pepper, chopped
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped
2 1/2  c. (3/4 lb.) cooked ham, diced
1  c. dairy sour cream
preparation: Cook noodles as directed on package; drain.  Put in a large mixing bowl.  Add all remaining ingredients; mix well.  Turn mixture into a 2-quart casserole dish.  Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes, or until cheese melts and casserole is heated through.

name: EASY LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1  (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
6  oz. can frozen lemonade
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1  tsp. grated lemon rind
yellow food coloring
8-inch or 9-inch Graham Cracker Crust
preparation: Beat together the first 3 ingredients; add food coloring to give the mixture a pleasant yellow color.  Pour into a prepared Graham Cracker Crust and chill for at least 4 hours before serving.  Keep leftover pie in the refrigerator.

name: CHEESE SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. buttermilk
2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Add grated cheese as desired.

name: CHOCOLATE SAUCE
ingredients:
2  sq. bitter chocolate
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter or oleo
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt all ingredients slowly over low heat; mix thoroughly and bring to a boil.  Cook until it starts to thicken.  Serve over ice cream or cool and beat until smooth and use as frosting.

name: CURRIED APPLE SALAD
ingredients:
4  Granny Smith apples
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. walnuts, coarsely chopped
1/2  c. golden raisins
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. curry powder
preparation: Core and cube apples.  In a large bowl, combine apples, celery, nuts and raisins.  In a small bowl, blend together remaining ingredients.  Pour over apple mixture; toss lightly with fork until apple pieces are well coated.  Serve on crisp greens. Garnish with apple wedges, if desired.  Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

name: SHRIMP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
1  lb. cooked shrimp
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  can mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. catsup
preparation: Mix all ingredients; put in greased casserole.  Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.

name: BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. granulated sugar
3  c. flour
2  c. bananas (very ripe), mashed
1 1/2  tsp. soda
4  egg whites (unbeaten)
1  c. shortening
6  Tbsp. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
dash of salt
preparation: Grease 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan and a small loaf pan.  Place large marshmallows 2 inches apart in pan.  Mix sugar, flour, soda and salt together.  Add mashed bananas, shortening, buttermilk and vanilla.  Mix thoroughly.  Add unbeaten egg whites and mix thoroughly.  Stir in chopped nuts. Carefully spoon over marshmallows in greased pans.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes, according to pans used.

name: BLUEBERRY COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine, softened
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. cinnamon
2 1/4  c. blueberries
2  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
1 3/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  brown sugar
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar; add eggs.  Fold in sour  cream and vanilla.  Add baking powder, salt and flour.  Fold in berries. Now combine brown sugar, cinnamon and nuts.  Pour 1/3 of cake batter into greased and floured tube pan, then sprinkle brown sugar mixture.  Add last of cake batter.  Now take a knife and lightly swirl or cut through cake mixture.  Bake  at 350° for 60 minutes.

name: FLAVORY POT ROAST
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. boneless chuck or round roast of beef
1 (1 3/8 oz.)  envelope Lipton onion soup mix
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place meat on foil and sprinkle soup mix on all sides.  Wrap in foil, sealing edges airtight with double fold.  Place in shallow baking pan.  Bake until desired doneness, about 2 1/2 to 3 hours.  Makes about 8 servings.

name: SKIPPY BURGERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
4  hamburg buns
lettuce
1  tomato
onion
1  kosher dill pickle
mayonnaise
preparation: Make ground beef into 4 patties (not too thick) and fry. Split buns and toast.  Shred lettuce.  Slice tomato and onion. Slice pickle longwise into thin slices.  Spread mayonnaise on buns. Top with meat, lettuce, tomato, onion and pickle and serve.

name: CRANBERRY JEWEL SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. boiling water
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. sugar-free raspberry jello
1 (16 oz.)  can whole cranberries
preparation: Stir jello in 1 cup boiling water until dissolved.  Mix in cranberry sauce.  Pour into 1 1/2-quart mold. Put in refrigerator until set.

name: FROZEN PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen peas
1  c. salted peanuts
1/3  c. mayo
1/3  c. Miracle Whip
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix and serve.

name: WHISKEY BALLS
ingredients:
40  vanilla wafers, rolled fine
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
1  Tbsp. cocoa
1/3  c. whiskey
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients; add whiskey. Form into small balls. Roll each ball in additional powdered sugar. Store in covered container.

name: POTATO FLAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  stick butter or oleo, softened
1  egg
1  envelope (approximately 1 c.) biscuit mix
1  envelope (approximately 1 c.) potato flakes
1  tsp. vanilla or coconut flavoring
preparation: Cream together sugar and butter and add remaining ingredients. Cover cookie sheet with aluminum foil.  Form 3/4-inch balls with mix; place on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: COLD RED RASPBERRY SOUP
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen red raspberries
1/2  c. Rose wine
1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. raspberry sherbet
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Combine raspberries, wine, sour cream, sherbet and milk in blender container.  Process until well blended.  Strain, if desired.  Pour into small bowls.  Float lime slices on top.   Add several drops of fresh lime juice.  Serves 8.

name: BABY PEARL TAPIOCA
ingredients:
2  gal. boiling water
6  c. tapioca
6  boxes Jell-O (any flavor)
6  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine and heat  to  boiling,  stirring all the while. Boil for 5 minutes.  Pour  in  cans  and cold pack 20 minutes. Can add fruit cocktail and Cool Whip after opening.

name: BROCCOLI CHEESE RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  boxes Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, prepared as directed
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can chicken broth (low salt variety)
2 (8 oz.)  cans whole water chestnuts, drained
2 (8 oz.)  cans chopped mushrooms, drained
2  c. grated nonfat Cheddar or 16 oz. Kraft Free cheese slices, chopped
1  c. homemade low-fat prepared croutons, crushed
1  to 1 1/2  tsp. Mrs. Dash salt-free extra spicy seasoning
preparation: Prepare rice as directed on package.  Add the cooked broccoli, mushrooms, water chestnuts and chicken broth to the rice mixture. Add seasoning and the grated nonfat cheese.  Spoon into large casserole dish that has been sprayed with a nonfat cooking spray. Top with homemade low-fat croutons.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes, covered.  Remove cover the last 10 minutes.  Serves 12 to 14.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. broccoli
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. sesame oil
1  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. sesame seed, toasted
preparation: Cut broccoli lengthwise.  Halve spears crosswise.  Cook in 1 inch of boiling salted water for 10 to 15 minutes or until just done.  Drain.  Chill broccoli in screw-top jar.  Combine vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil and sugar.  Cover and shake to mix well. Drizzle vinegar mixture over broccoli.  Toss gently.  Sprinkle with toasted sesame seed.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: YOGURT PARFAIT
ingredients:
1/4  c. vanilla yogurt
1/4  c. Grape-Nuts
preparation: In tall glass, place layers of yogurt and then cereal.  Makes 1 serving.  Kids love it!

name: LAZY DAISY CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. self-rising flour
1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. shortening
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
preparation: Heat milk and shortening until shortening melts.  Mix all together; pour in oiled small pan.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1  can creamed corn
20  saltine crackers
1  c. milk
1  egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. butter, melted
salt and pepper
1  tsp. sugar (optional)
preparation: Soak crackers in the milk.  Mix rest of the ingredients.  Add to soaked crackers.  Bake in greased casserole 45 minutes at 350°.

name: LANIER'S LONE STAR CAVIAR
ingredients:
1  can black-eyed peas, drained
2  c. Italian salad dressing
2  c. diced green peppers
1 1/2  c. diced onion
1  c. chopped jalapeno peppers
1 (2 oz.)  jar drained diced pimento
1  Tbsp. chopped garlic
salt to taste
hot pepper salt to taste
1/4 to 1/2  c. calantro (for extra zest)
preparation: Drain black-eyed peas well.  Transfer to a large bowl.  Blend in dressing and remaining ingredients and mix well.  Makes about 7 1/2 cups, gets better with time.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese (room temperature)
1 large  jar marshmallow cream
preparation: Mix together with mixer.  Taste great with any type fruit. Makes enough for a large fruit tray.

name: PINEAPPLE REFRIGERATOR CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1  yellow cake mix
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  can Cool Whip
preparation: Mix up vanilla pudding and keep in refrigerator until ready to use.  Make cake mix and bake in a 9 x 12-inch pan.  When it comes out of the oven, poke holes all over cake with fork and pour juice from pineapple over cake.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  qt. fresh yellow squash
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. Ritz wheat crackers, crushed (save 1/4 c.)
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
6  Tbsp. margarine, divided
preparation: Cook squash and onion in a small amount of salted water until tender; drain. Add cracker crumbs (reserving 1/4 cup for top), cheese, eggs, salt, pepper and 3 tablespoons margarine. Spoon into a greased casserole dish (2-quart). Top with remaining cracker crumbs and margarine. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until brown. Yields about 8 servings.

name: SQUASH PICKLES
ingredients:
12  c. yellow and zucchini squash (about the size of a half dollar)
2  c. chopped onion
2  large green peppers
2 small  jars pimientos
6  tsp. salt
3 1/2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. white vinegar
2  Tbsp. celery seed
preparation: Slice squash rather thin; sprinkle with salt and let stand overnight.

name: SAUSAGE PINWHEELS
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  can crescent rolls
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
preparation: Brown sausage.  Drain. Roll off 4 triangles of crescent roll. Pinch dotted line to form 1 long sheet.  Spread cream cheese. Sprinkle with sausage and roll up jelly roll style in wax paper. Chill 1 hour or overnight.  Do same to remaining 4 triangles. When ready to serve, slice in pinwheels and bake until brown by directions on crescent roll can.

name: HOMEMADE LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  lb. lasagna noodles
3/4  c. finely chopped onions
1  clove garlic
2  c. water
1 (12 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. salt
3 (6 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1  lb. cottage cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook noodles in 6 quarts boiling water to which has been added 2 tablespoons salt.  Cook rapidly for 15 minutes.  Stir gently.  Remove from heat and drain.  Pour cold water over to cool.  Cook hamburger in heavy saucepan until color changes.  Add onions, garlic, tomato paste, water and salt.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.  Grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch pan.  Start with a layer of noodles, then Mozzarella cheese, then cottage cheese, then meat sauce.  Continue layering in that order until all is used up.  Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

name: CHOCOLATE CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
2  c. chocolate cookie crumbs
5  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Mix together and press into a 9-inch spring-form pan.

name: RIVERBOAT PIE
ingredients:
3  graham cracker pie crust shells
1  large container Cool Whip
1  can evaporated milk
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  stick butter, melted
1/2  c. sugar
juice of 1 lemon
preparation: Melt butter and sugar together.  Stir in evaporated milk.  Let cool.  Add pineapple and chopped pecans when mixture is room temperature.  Add Cool Whip.  Last, put in lemon juice.  Divide among 3 pie crusts.

name: ROCKY ROAD CANDY
ingredients:
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
2  c. dry roasted peanuts (salted)
10 1/2  oz. bag mini marshmallows
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: On  low  heat,	melt together milk, chocolate chips and butter.  Pour  into bowl with peanuts and marshmallows.  Blend well.  Pour  into  a  9  x	11-inch pan. Refrigerate. Cut into squares and serve.

name: EASY HOT SPICED CIDER
ingredients:
1/2  gal. sweet cider
1/2  c. brown sugar
2-inch stick cinnamon
6  whole cloves
1/4  tsp. allspice
preparation: Simmer for 20 minutes.  Remove the stick cinnamon and cloves. Serve in punch cups.

name: CHOCOLATE MARSHMALLOW COOKIES
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. shortening
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. fine chopped nuts
1  pkg. large marshmallows
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Beat well by hand the shortening, sugar, egg, vanilla and milk.  Then add to the dry ingredients. Add nuts.

name: DATE LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. dates, cut in small pieces
1/2  lb. pecans
10  Tbsp. white (fine) cracker crumbs
2  tsp. baking powder
6  eggs
2  c. white sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. canned milk
preparation: Beat egg yolks.  Add canned milk.  Add sugar and beat.  Add fruit and nut mixture with crumbs.  Mix together, then fold in the egg whites which have been beaten well.  Pour in 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Bake in slow oven for 40 minutes.

name: BANANA BREEZE PIE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can condensed cream
1/2  c. lemon juice
2  bananas
1  graham cracker crust
preparation: Soften cream cheese.  Add condensed cream and lemon juice; mix well.  Slice bananas into crust.  Pour cream cheese mixture over bananas.  Chill several hours.  Slice and enjoy!

name: DOG BISCUITS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. wheat flour
1/2  c. powdered milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. onion powder
2  tsp. brown sugar
1  beef bouillon cube, crushed
6  Tbsp. bacon drippings
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. water
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine first seven ingredients.  Mix in bacon drippings and egg.  Add enough water to form a ball.  Pat dough to 1/2-inch thick.  Cut with cookie cutters.  Bake on a greased cookie sheet for 25 to 30 minutes.  Bone appetite.

name: NO COOK ICING
ingredients:
1/4  stick butter or oleo
1  egg white
2  c. 10x sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. milk
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  caps vanilla
preparation: Beat egg white and 1 cup 10x sugar until stiff.  Add remaining ingredients.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. zucchini, grated
preparation: Mix the flour, cinnamon, salt, soda and powder together in a bowl. Cream together the eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla.  Combine both bowls and add zucchini. Bake 1 hour at 350° in greased loaf pans.  Makes 2 loaves.

name: CHINESE CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  to 6 chicken breasts
1/2  c. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  clove garlic, minced (can use garlic powder)
preparation: Mix ingredients and marinate chicken.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes if bone-in or 30 minutes if boneless.  Baste while baking. Serves 4 to 6.

name: BROCCOLI CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
3 to 4  c. chicken, cubed and cooked
2  cans cream of broccoli soup
2/3  c. milk
1 to 1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. melted butter
4  Tbsp. dry bread crumbs
preparation: Line 9 x 13-inch pan with broccoli.  Place chicken on top of broccoli.  Combine soup and milk and pour over chicken.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Combine butter and bread crumbs and sprinkle on top of casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: EXPANDING PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 (46 oz.)  can apricot nectar
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1  qt. ginger ale
1  qt. mint ginger ale (pale)
1  qt. water
1/2 to 3/4  c. sugar
1  qt. orange sherbet
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Yields 2 gallons.  Can add rum to taste, if desired.

name: MINI-CHICKEN PIZZA MELT
ingredients:
1 (5 oz.)  can chicken breast, drained
1 (8 count)  pkg. fat-free hamburger buns
1  jar Healthy Choice spaghetti sauce
8  oz. pkg. Healthy Choice Mozzarella cheese
thinly sliced vegetables (such as zucchini, onion, pepper or sliced olives to taste)
preparation: Lay out opened hamburger buns on cookie sheet and spread each with heaping tablespoonful of the spaghetti sauce.  Divide the chicken pieces evenly over the sauce.  Add vegetables, if desired. Top with Mozzarella cheese and bake about 10 minutes at 350° to melt and brown cheese. Serve warm.

name: CRANBERRY CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  to 10 boneless chicken breasts
salt and pepper to taste
garlic powder
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Catalina salad dressing
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
1 (16 oz.)  can whole berry cranberry sauce
preparation: Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper and garlic powder.  Mix dressing, soup mix and cranberry sauce together and pour over chicken.  Place in a 14 x 11-inch dish (do not stack or crowd pieces).  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Baste every 15 minutes.

name: PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen baby peas (10 oz.)
1  c. diced celery
1  c. chopped cauliflower
1/4  c. diced green onions
1  c. chopped cashews
1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. Ranch dressing
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Chill.  Garnish with crisp-cooked bacon that has been crumbled.

name: CRANBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
2  c. water
1  c. sugar
12  cloves
3  (2-inch) cinnamon sticks
1 (48 oz.)  bottle cranberry juice
1 small  can frozen lemonade
1 small  can frozen orange juice
preparation: Boil first 4 ingredients together for five minutes, then remove spices.  Add remaining ingredients.  Chill and serve.

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
8  boiled potatoes (boiled in skins)
1  stalk celery, diced
2  hard-boiled eggs, sliced
1  large onion, minced
1  tsp. minced parsley
2  eggs, well beaten
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar and 1/2 c. water, mixed
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
4  slices cooked bacon, diced (reserve bacon fat)
preparation: Peel potatoes and slice. Add celery, sliced eggs and onion. Beat eggs and add sugar, spices and vinegar mixture.   Mix well. Pour egg mixture into hot bacon fat and stir until mixture thickens.  Pour over potatoes and mix lightly. Top with bacon. Serve warm or chilled.

name: REAL ITALIAN THICK PIZZA(Campania)
ingredients:
dough (see recipe)
solid Crisco
olive oil
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes
2  large Bermuda onions, sliced very thin
Parmesan cheese
oregano
salt and pepper
preparation: This pizza is what my Mom  use to say is the real pizza of Italy.  It was served in  our home when we were growing up. As we got older and seeing American pizza, we wanted different toppings on our pizza.  Mom would  always  let  us make one or two with "our toppings".  As  I  have  gotten older, my tastes have changed and I prefer  the  plain  pizza  of  my heritage. This pizza was a real family favorite on New Year's Eve.

name: STRAWBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
2  small or 1 large pkg(s). strawberry jello
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  qt. ginger ale (if desired)
1  pkg. strawberry presweetened Kool-Aid
1  can apricot nectar
3  or 4 bananas, cut up or mashed
preparation: Mix jello in 1 cup of hot water and the Kool-aid according to instructions.  Add mashed or cut-up bananas and other ingredients. This may be frozen, if so, take out of freezer and place in refrigerator for approximately 5 hours to thaw to a mushy consistency.  Just before serving, add 1 quart of ginger ale, if desired.

name: EASY FRUIT 'N NUT GRANOLA
ingredients:
1/2  c. honey
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
4  c. Team flakes
1 3/4  c. unsalted peanuts
1/2  c. sunflower seeds
1/2  c. pumpkin seeds
1/3  c. flaked coconut
1/2  c. chopped dates (optional)
preparation: Preheat  oven  to  350°.  Grease  15  1/2 x 14 x 1-inch jelly roll  pan;	set  aside.  In  large	bowl,  using rubber spatula, blend  together  honey and oil; stir in flakes, peanuts, sunflower  seeds  and  pumpkin  seeds.  Mix  until well coated. Turn  mixture into prepared pan; spread evenly.  Bake 10  to  12 minutes, stirring 2 or 3 times.  Spoon immediately into  large bowl;  stir  in  flaked  coconut and, if desired, chopped  dates. Cool  completely,  stirring  occasionally  to break granola into small pieces.  Store in airtight container, in cool, dry place until ready to use.  This mixture will keep up to 3 weeks.	Makes 6 cups.

name: CHUCK WAGON STEW(Easy and Hearty)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  chopped onion
1  can vegetable soup
1  can red kidney beans
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion. Add vegetable soup and beans. Heat for 15 minutes. Serve piping hot with rolls and a tossed salad.

name: BUTTERMILK YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
1/2 cake (1 oz.) compressed yeast or 1  pkg. active dry yeast (I use RapidRise)
1/4  c. warm water (110~ to 115~)
3  c. buttermilk (room temperature)
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
about 8 c. flour
preparation: Crumble yeast into warm water in large mixing bowl.  Stir to dissolve.  Add buttermilk and sugar; let mixture stand 15 minutes. Add warm butter and eggs; mix.  Sift soda and salt with 4 cups of flour; add to liquid mixture.  Beat until smooth and batter forms. Add remaining sifted flour, stirring with spoon until dough is no longer sticky.  Knead on floured board.  Place in large greased mixing bowl.  Cover; let rise until double, about 1 hour.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. buttermilk
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  whole eggs
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. flour (plain)
1/2  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Combine all ingredients. Mix well with electric mixer. Pour into an unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until firm.

name: LARGO SEASHELLS
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. seashell macaroni
1  large onion, diced
1  Tbsp. diced green pepper
1/2  c. butter or margarine
salt to taste
1 (1 pt.)  carton cottage cheese
preparation: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain.  Saute onion and green pepper in butter until tender.  Add macaroni; season with salt.  Stir in cottage cheese.  Serve immediately.

name: SAUERKRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
1  jar kraut, washed and drained
1  bell pepper
1  c. celery
2  oz. jar pimento, drained
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. oil
salt and pepper
preparation: Heat last four ingredients.  Add to the vegetables and chill.

name: CANNED GARDEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can LeSueur peas, drained
1  can white shoe peg corn, drained
1  can French green beans, drained
1 small  jar pimento peppers, drained and chopped
1  c. celery, chopped fine
1  c. onion, chopped fine
1  c. green pepper, chopped fine
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. olive oil
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. vinegar
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Put all vegetables into a large bowl and toss together. Boil together the sugar, olive oil, pepper, vinegar and salt and pour dressing over the vegetables; toss all together and refrigerate several hours or overnight.  Serve cold or at room temperature.

name: GREEN AND WHITE SALAD
ingredients:
1  head broccoli
1  head cabbage
1/2  c. celery
6  green onions
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. whipping cream
2  Tbsp. sugar
salt and pepper
preparation: Chop vegetables.  Mix mayonnaise and whipping cream with sugar, salt and pepper.  Add vegetables and let stand overnight.

name: AMARILLO PUNCH
ingredients:
6  c. water
4  c. sugar
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
5  bananas, mashed
2  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Combine water and sugar.  Bring to a boil; cook 3 minutes. Let cool.  Stir in pineapple juice, orange juice and bananas. Freeze until ready to serve.  Mash the frozen mixture and add ginger ale.  40 servings.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. salad oil
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  c. grated zucchini
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. soda
3  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  c. raisins
1  c. walnuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and bake at 375° for one hour.  Bake in two greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.

name: ITALIAN SWEET PIE(Ricotta Cheese Cake)
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
4  eggs
4 to 5  c. flour
1  c. orange juice
1  Tbsp. vanilla
4  tsp. baking powder
4  beaten eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. orange extract
1  tsp. lemon extract
2  lb. Ricotta cheese
preparation: Make shell first; soften margarine with hand.  Mix eggs, orange juice and vanilla.  Add sugar, flour and baking powder. Knead until dough holds together and forms a ball.  Roll dough out to make crust and place in 9-inch pie pan.

name: APPLE CAKE - DAIRY FREE
ingredients:
2  c. apples (Granny Smith)
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. sugar
1  c. cooking oil
4  eggs
1/4  c. orange juice
2  tsp. vanilla extract
3  c. flour, sifted
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Peel, core and chop the apples into small pieces.  Mix together with 3 tablespoons sugar and the cinnamon.  Set aside.

name: SWEET TOAST
ingredients:
1  egg, beaten
2/3  c. granulated sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. evaporated milk
pinch of salt
1  loaf sandwich bread
preparation: Mix egg and milk.  Set aside.  Mix sugar, salt and cinnamon. Combine the liquid and dry mixtures.  Mix well.  Lay slices of bread side by side on cookie sheet until cookie sheet is filled. Spread the prepared mixture over the bread slices, covering each well.

name: VEG DIP
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
1  pkg. dry Ranch dressing
preparation: Mix well together.  Pour back into carton and refrigerate overnight.  Serve with mixed raw vegetables.

name: CREAMY FRUIT MOLD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can fruit cocktail, drained
preparation: In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and gelatin. Add water. Stir until gelatin is dissolved. Refrigerate until thickened, about 1 hour, stirring frequently. Add mayonnaise. Whisk until smooth. Stir in fruit and pecans. Pour into a 1-quart mold that has been coated with nonstick cooking spray. Chill until firm. Unmold onto a serving platter. Yield: 6 servings.

name: PARTY CHEESE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
1  lb. cream cheese
1/2  c. chopped olives
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. Accent
1/4  tsp. soda
1/2 small  can evaporated milk
1  large garlic clove, chopped fine
preparation: Blend  all ingredients.  Store in a cheese crock.  Will keep in	the refrigerator for 3 weeks.  Sprinkle with paprika before serving.

name: HASH BROWN POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (32 oz.)  pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
3/4  c. margarine, melted
1/2  onion, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1  c. (4 oz.) Cheddar cheese, shredded
2  c. corn flakes
preparation: Combine  potatoes, 1/2 cup margarine, onion, soup, sour cream and  cheese.  Stir	well  and  spoon into greased 1 1/2 quart casserole.

name: WHIPPING CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
2  sticks butter (room temperature)
6  eggs
3  c. Swans Down flour
1/2  pt. heavy whipping cream
1  Tbsp. vanilla (lemon  if you like)
preparation: Cream sugar and butter together.  Add eggs, one at a time, then add flour, whipping cream and vanilla.  Flour and grease cake pan and bake at 375° until done.  Test with toothpick and if it comes out clean, it is done.

name: SWEET MILK GRIDDLE CAKES
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. sugar
2  c. milk
1  egg
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Mix and sift dry ingredients.  Beat egg, add milk and pour slowly on first mixture.  Beat thoroughly and add butter.  Cook as sour milk griddle cakes.

name: GRANDMA'S QUICK BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. oil
2/3  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten slightly
1 3/4  c. sifted flour
2 3/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. mashed banana
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Beat shortening until creamy; add sugar.  Beat until thick to lemon colored.  Sift dry ingredients; add granulated sugar with bananas.  Blend thoroughly after each addition.  Add nuts.  Grease bottom of bread pan only.  Bake 60 to 70 minutes at 350°.

name: SPICED ORANGE GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
1 2/3  c. all-purpose flour
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. light molasses
1/4  c.water
1/4  c. orange juice
1  egg
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  c. orange marmalade
sweetened whipped cream
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients except orange marmalade and whipped cream.  Beat at low speed 1 to 2 minutes. Pour into greased and floured 9-inch baking pan.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

name: LITE FRUIT COOLER
ingredients:
1 (17 oz.)  can lite fruit cocktail, drained
1 (8 oz.)  can lite crushed pineapple, drained
1 (12 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
1  c. lite Cool Whip
1 small  box sugar-free jello (any flavor)
1/3  c. chopped pecans (optional)
preparation: Drain the fruit and combine with the cottage cheese and Cool Whip in a medium mixing bowl.  Sprinkle the jello over the top and stir to mix well.  Add pecans, if desired.  Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes.

name: JALAPENO CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising corn meal
3  eggs
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  onion
1 small  can cream-style corn
8  oz. sour cream
5  jalapeno peppers, chopped
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Grease iron skillet.  Bake at 450° for 20 minutes.  Brown under broiler a few minutes.

name: BOILERMAKER BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  medium onion, finely chopped
2  large garlic cloves, minced
1 (12 oz.)  bottle chili sauce
3/4  c. beer
1/4  c. unsulfured (light) molasses
3  Tbsp. cider vinegar
3  Tbsp. bourbon whiskey
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. hot pepper sauce (such as Tabasco)
preparation: Heat oil in saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; saut until tender, about 8 minutes. Reduce heat. Add chili sauce, beer, molasses, vinegar, bourbon and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer until reduced to 2 cups, stirring occasionally, about 25 minutes. Stir in hot pepper sauce. Brush on during the last 10 minutes of grilling. If making ribs, brush them often during the first part of cooking with a mixture of one part cider vinegar to 10 parts of water and a pinch of dried crushed red pepper; that will keep them moist (covers 3 pounds of meat). Can be made up to 1 month ahead. Cover; chill.

name: RICE DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. raw rice
1  small bell pepper
1  lb. ground meat
salt and pepper to taste
1  small onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes, covered.

name: TARTAR SAUCE
ingredients:
1  qt. mayonnaise
2  dill pickles, grated
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. hot sauce
1  tsp. horseradish
1  large onion
juice of 1/2 lemon
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate overnight in a closed container.

name: MELT IN YOUR MOUTH BLUEBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. blueberries
preparation: Grease and flour an 8-inch square pan.  Heat oven to 350°.

name: EASY CHEESE SOUFFLE
ingredients:
white bread
sharp cheese
eggs
milk
preparation: Grease a shallow casserole.  Remove crust and butter enough slices of white bread to cover bottom of casserole.  Put a slice of sharp cheese on each slice.  Beat 3 eggs for each 2 cups milk; enough to cover bread and cheese.  Soak in fridge overnight.  In morning, place casserole in pan of boiling water.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes until knife comes out clean.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sage
3 to 4  lb. boned, boiled chicken
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  c. celery, chopped
2  eggs
4  c. chicken broth
1  c. chopped onion or equivalent of onion flakes
1  can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. box Hi Ho crackers, crushed
preparation: Combine all ingredients in 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: QUICK 'N EASY SALMON
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. salmon fillet
1/2  tsp. seafood spices
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. lite soy sauce
1/4  tsp. m.s.g. (Accent, optional)
preparation: Rinse fillet and place it in a Pyrex casserole dish.  Pierce repeatedly with fork, then pour on soy sauce and lemon juice. Sprinkle on salt, m.s.g. and spices.  Cover dish with plastic wrap.  Set aside overnight or for 30 minutes.  To cook, place in microwave for 12 minutes on High or wrap in foil and place on grill for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: RICE AND CHERRIES IN THE SNOW
ingredients:
2  c. water
1  c. rice
pinch of salt
3 1/3  c. milk
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. almond extract
1  c. heavy cream, whipped or 1 container Cool Whip
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Cook rice in water 15 minutes.  Add salt, sugar, butter and 3 cups of milk.  Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Using the 1/3 cup of milk, soften gelatin.  Cook rice until mixture thickens slightly.  Add softened gelatin, cook 1 minute. Remove from heat and add almond extract.  Cool.  When cool, fold in whipped cream or Cool Whip.  Refrigerate until firm.  Put cherry pie filling on top.

name: REMARKABLE FUDGE
ingredients:
4  c. white sugar
1  c. butter
1  pt. marshmallow cream
1  c. chopped walnuts
14 1/2  oz. (1 2/3 c.) can evaporated milk
1  (12 oz.) chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: You will also need a 3-quart saucepan, a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and a candy thermometer.

name: CREAMY CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts
4  potatoes
1  can Campbell's creamy chicken soup
1  small sweet onion
salt and lemon pepper (your own preference)
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Line pan with Reynold's Wrap and 1/2 cup of water and butter.  Let melt and mix together.

name: NO NAME CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1 (16 oz.)  can sliced peaches, drained (reserve the juice)
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. peach syrup
whipped topping
cinnamon
preparation: Mix cake mix according to directions. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Next, take the peach slices and place on top of the cake mix. Combine peach syrup, cream cheese and sugar. Mix well. Finally, drop the cream cheese mixture by the spoonful all over the cake mix. Bake according to the mix directions. Let cool. Spread whipped topping on top and sprinkle cinnamon. Serve cool. DELICIOUS!

name: JELLY MEATBALLS
ingredients:
3  lb. hamburger
2  eggs
2  pkg. dry onion soup mix (Lipton)
2 (8 oz.)  bottles chili sauce
2  c. grape jelly
preparation: Mix hamburger, eggs and soup mix.  Make into meatballs.  Put in a baking dish.  Mix chili sauce and grape jelly.  Pour over meatballs.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
dash of lemon juice
1 (10 oz.)  box frozen broccoli
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. Pepperidge Farm herb dressing
3/4  c. grated cheese
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Cook and drain broccoli; combine all other ingredients except cheese and margarine.  Add broccoli and pour into casserole dish. Cut margarine in small pieces and spread over broccoli.  Sprinkle cheese on top and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: TASTY CHICKEN LIVERS
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  large onions, sliced
2  large green peppers, cut into bite-size chunks
1  lb. chicken livers
1/2  c. chili sauce
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: In 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat in hot butter or margarine, cook onions and green peppers 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

name: NAN'S TACO DIP
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  pkg. Fiesta Ranch taco dip
1  jar mild taco sauce
1  green pepper, diced
1  medium onion, diced
1  tomato, diced
shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Have the cream cheese and sour cream at room temperature. Place in mixing bowl with the taco dip and blend well until smooth. Spread in a 9 x 12 glass dish. Cover with a thin layer of taco sauce. Sprinkle onion, peppers and tomatoes over the sauce. Top with shredded cheese. Place in refrigerator overnight. Serve with tortilla chips to dip into it.

name: BERRIES AND CREAM
ingredients:
1  medium angel food cake, cut in pieces
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  c. powdered sugar
1  large Cool Whip
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. dry strawberry jello
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
preparation: Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip together until smooth. Mix with angel food cake.  Then bring cornstarch, dry jello, sugar and water to a boil.  Cook until it thickens.   Cool and pour over cake mixture.  Top with strawberries.

name: POTATO-DATE BAKE
ingredients:
1 (1 lb. 2 oz.)  can sweet potatoes
1/4  c. light cream
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped pitted dates
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Heat sweet potatoes; mash while hot.  Add cream, cinnamon, salt, dates and butter.  Mix well and turn into a buttered 1-quart casserole.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until light brown.  Makes 6 servings.

name: TACO SURPRISE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped chicken
1/2  c. broccoli
1/2  c. cauliflower
1/4  c. onion
1 1/2  c. rice (white or brown)
1  pkg. corn or flour taco shells
preparation: You need to chop up cooked chicken.  (You can use leftover chicken or stir-fry some.)  Chop up broccoli, cauliflower and onion.  Stir-fry chicken and all vegetables.  Meanwhile, cook some rice.  When rice is done, mix everything together.  Start cooking taco shells.  You can fry them with butter spray or warm in microwave.  Fill taco shells just like a regular taco.

name: BARBECUE SPARERIBS
ingredients:
2  lb. spareribs
1  medium onion
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1/4  c. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. water
1/2 to 1  c. catsup
dash of salt and pepper
preparation: Place ribs in baking pan.  Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 1 hour.  Chop onion and brown in oil.  Add juice, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, water, catsup, salt and pepper. Cook slowly for 20 minutes.  Pour over ribs.  Continue baking for 1 hour.

name: HOT GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bacon
5  medium size potatoes
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
preparation: Cook bacon; save drippings.  Set bacon aside and crumble. Dice potatoes.  Combine with onion and bacon.  In drippings, add salt, pepper, sugar and vinegar.  Heat thoroughly.  Pour over potato mixture, stirring slightly to blend.  Serve immediately.

name: EASY CHOCOLATE CHEX MIX
ingredients:
1  lb. white chocolate (almond bark)
2  c. Cheerios
2  c. Rice Chex
2  c. Wheat Chex
1  c. peanuts
1  c. pretzels, broken up
