preparation: Melt chocolate in dish in 200° oven, no hotter or will burn (will scorch very easy in microwave).  Stir occasionally.  Combine all dry ingredients in large container.  Pour melted chocolate over all; stir until covered good.  Spread on waxed paper until dry. Break up and store in containers.  Great at Christmastime.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  zucchini
2  medium tomatoes
1  large onion
bacon bits
bits of margarine
preparation: Cut zucchini into lengthwise pieces about 2 to 3 inches long and quartered.  Boil in salty water until tender.  Drain.  Cut up tomatoes and onion.  Mix all 3 ingredients.  Top with heavy layer of bacon bits.  Scatter bits of margarine on top of bacon bits. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY MARGARITA
ingredients:
1 1/2  oz. tequila
1/2  oz. Triple Sec
1/2  oz. strawberry Schnapps or liqueur
1  oz. lime juice
5  to 6 fresh or frozen strawberries
preparation: Mix all ingredients except strawberries in blender with cracked ice and pour into a wire goblet  rimmed with salt. Garnish with strawberries, or mix all ingredients including the strawberries in blender with ice.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
6  eggs
3  sticks margarine
1  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese
3  c. plain flour
1/4  tsp. salt
3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon or vanilla flavoring, or both
preparation: Combine ingredients and pour into pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  May need to bake an additional 5 to 15 minutes.

name: HAMBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1  can vegetable soup
1/2  can water
season to taste
1  can biscuits
preparation: Brown meat; drain and add soup and water.  Put into baking dish deep pie pan.  Cover with biscuits and bake in hot oven at 350° until biscuits are done.

name: HOLIDAY APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  unbaked pastry shell
4  c. sliced apples
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Line pie plate with pastry; arrange apples in pie plate. Combine sugar, flour, cinnamon and salt.  Sprinkle mixture over top of apples.  Dot with butter.  Bake in preheated oven of 425° for 20 minutes.

name: LEMON BASIL CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  c. Miracle Whip dressing
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. honey
1  tsp. dried basil leaves
1  (about 3 lb.) chicken, cut up
preparation: Heat oven to 375°. Mix salad dressing, juice, honey and basil. Place chicken in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Spread with dressing mixture. Bake 45 minutes or until done.  Serves 4.

name: SHRIMP JAMBALAYA(Serves 4 to 6)
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
2  medium onions
1  Tbsp. flour
2  c. water
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/4  tsp. thyme
1  bay leaf
1  chopped green pepper
1 (16 oz.)  can chopped tomatoes
1 small  can tomato sauce
dash of garlic powder
1 1/4  c. raw rice
2  c. cooked shrimp
1/2  c. dry white wine
preparation: Sauté onion in butter lightly. Add flour and stir until browned. Add water and stir constantly, forming a smooth paste. Add parsley, thyme, bay leaf, tomatoes, tomato sauce, garlic powder and rice. Add and cook over low heat until rice is tender, stirring as needed. Add shrimp and white wine and warm thoroughly.

name: CREAMY BAKED CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. margarine, melted
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
3  eggs
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  (8 oz.) container sour cream (room temperature)
fruit (for topping)
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine; press firmly on bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan.  In large bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.  Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.  Add eggs and lemon juice; mix well.  Pour in prepared pan.  Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until center is set.  Top with sour cream.   Bake 5 minutes longer.  Cool. Chill.  Top with fruit.

name: DOREEN'S CORN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. Bisquick
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. oil
1 1/2  c. milk
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  block butter, melted
preparation: Combine dry ingredients.  Make a well and add liquid ingredients, except for butter.  Mix.  Pour in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.  Immediately after coming out of oven, drizzle 1 block melted butter over.

name: SAUSAGE RICE STUFFING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage
2  c. chopped celery
2  c. chopped onion
2  c. sliced fresh mushrooms or 1 (16 oz.) can, drained
1  c. chicken broth
4  c. cooked browned rice
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
3  tsp. crushed dried sage
1  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/2  c. slivered almonds
preparation: Cook sausage, celery, onion and mushrooms in large skillet until meat is browned; drain.  Combine with remaining ingredients and place in a greased 3-quart casserole.  Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  (May be used to stuff a large turkey.)  Yields 8 to 10 servings.

name: WHOOPIE PIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
5  tsp. cocoa
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. milk
2  egg yolks (save whites)
1/2  c. shortening
preparation: Cream together shortening, sugar and egg yolks.  Put all dry ingredients in sifter; add to creamed mixture.  Alternately add milk and mix ingredients together.  Spoon on cookie sheet by teaspoon about an inch apart.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: 30 MINUTE ROLLS
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. warm water
1  c. oil
6  Tbsp. yeast
3/4  c. sugar or honey
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs
10 1/2  c. flour (wheat or white or 1/2 and 1/2)
preparation: Mix  first  four  ingredients  and let rest 15 minutes. Add salt  and  eggs.  Gradually  add flour. Shape immediately into rolls  or  roll  out  into  a  rectangle  and spread with margarine,  cinnamon  and sugar.  Roll up and slice.  Place in pans; let rest for 10 minutes or until double in size.  Bake 7 to 10 minutes at 325° to 350°.  Serve.

name: PISTACHIO SUPREME
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1  c. flour
1  c. powdered sugar
1  large container Cool Whip
2  pkg. instant pistachio nut pudding
3  c. milk
1  stick butter
1 (18 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: You will need a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: APRICOT NECTAR SALAD
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can apricot nectar
1  pkg. (large) orange jello
1  envelope plain gelatin
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. chopped nuts
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Dissolve jello in hot nectar.  Dissolve plain gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water.  Mix together.  Add enough cold water to make 3 1/2 cups.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Add grated cream cheese, pineapple and nuts.  Chill until set.

name: FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
8  slices day-old bread
syrup, jelly or 10xxx sugar
preparation: Beat eggs, milk, sugar and salt together in shallow dish. Heat shortening in skillet or on griddle.  Dip bread slices, one at a time, into egg mixture.  Turn and coat evenly.  Fry until lightly brown on both sides.  Serve with syrup, jelly or 10xxx sugar.

name: EARTHQUAKE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans
1  German chocolate cake mix
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  lb. box confectioners sugar
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
Pam spray
preparation: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, spray with Pam.  Mix together coconut and pecan pieces.  Pour in pan.  Mix cake mix as directed on box. Pour over coconut and pecans.

name: FRIED RICE
ingredients:
2  boil-in-bag rice
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. ham or other meat, chopped
1  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. shredded carrots
1  egg, scrambled
preparation: Cook rice as directed.  Set aside to drain.  Put veggies in skillet with small amount of oil.  Stir fry.  Add 3 tablespoons soy sauce.  Add rice.  Stir fry until hot.  Ready to eat.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) graham cracker crust
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1/3  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat cream cheese until light and fluffy.  Add sweetened condensed milk; blend thoroughly.  Stir in lemon juice and vanilla.  Pour in crust.  Chill 3 hours.  Top with favorite pie filling.

name: CHERRY JUBILEE PIE
ingredients:
1  baked 9-inch pie crust
1  can cherry pie filling
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  pkg. whipped topping
1/4  c. sugar
1  c. commercial sour cream
maraschino cherries
preparation: Combine pie filling, sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg; set aside. Prepare whipped topping mix as directed on box except omit 2 tablespoons of milk.  Beat until stiff.  Add the 1/4 cup sugar at low speed; gently fold in sour cream.  Spoon 1/2 the cherry mixture into baked pie shell.  Spread 2/3 whipped topping mixture over cherries, then gently spoon the remaining cherries over whipped topping mixture.  With remaining topping mixture, swirl a spoonful on each serving and top with a cherry.  Chill until firm.

name: SOUR CREAM MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter, softened
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
2  c. Bisquick
preparation: Cream butter.  Stir in sour cream.  Gradually add Bisquick. Stir until dry ingredients are moist.  Spoon mixture into greased muffin pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Small muffin pan works best.  You will want to make a double batch of these.

name: BIRDIES IN THE NEST
ingredients:
3  slices of bread
3  eggs
1  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Using a small juice glass or cookie cutter, cut a hole in the center of each slice of bread.  (Save these for bread crumbs or feed the birds.)  Melt 1 tablespoon of margarine in a large skillet on medium low.  Place 3 slices of bread in skillet.  Crack an egg and place it in the hole in one of the slices of bread.  Repeat with other two slices.  Cook for about 1 to 2 minutes and then flip slices with spatula.  Cook 1 to 2 minutes more.

name: GREEN PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1  can tiny green peas
1  c. diced sharp cheese (very small cubes)
1/2  c. diced celery
1 small  jar pimentos (optional)
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Toss all ingredients except the peas and add mayonnaise; mix well.  Add peas and toss gently.  Refrigerate before serving.

name: VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1/4  c. boiling water
2  c. chicken bouillon cubes, dissolved in boiling water
8  oz. cream cheese
2  tsp. onion powder
2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix until creamed together.  Serve with fresh vegetables.

name: CHICKEN ON RICE
ingredients:
3/4  stick oleo
1  can onion soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  can water
1 1/2  c. rice
1  fryer
salt
1  bell pepper
1 small  jar pimento
4  sprigs parsley
preparation: Melt oleo.  Combine all ingredients and place in roaster. Place cut up chicken on top.  Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. dry corkscrew macaroni
1  medium zucchini, thinly sliced
1  c. cherry tomatoes, cut in quarters
2 small  cans ripe olives
1/2  tsp. dried basil leaves
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. fat free red wine vinaigrette
preparation: In 4-quart saucepan, prepare macaroni according to package directions.  In colander, rinse with cold water; drain well.  In large bowl, combine macaroni, zucchini, tomatoes, olives, basil and garlic powder.  Add vinaigrette; toss to coat.  Cover; refrigerate at least 30 minutes before serving.

name: BUTTERCREAM FROSTING
ingredients:
1  lb. confectioners sugar
1  stick butter, softened
1/2  c. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
4  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Mix sugar and cocoa.  Cream butter and part of sugar mixture. Blend vanilla, milk and remaining sugar mixture into creamed mixture until desired spreading consistency.

name: CHOCOLATE SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. Wesson oil
1  c. water
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat oleo, oil and water to boiling.  In mixing bowl, combine remaining ingredients.  Pour boiling mixture over dry ingredients. Mix well.  Add 1/2 cup buttermilk to which 1 teaspoon baking soda has been added.  Stir and add 2 eggs and 1 teaspoon vanilla.  Mix well.  Mixture will be thin.  Pour in a jelly roll pan (or 10 x 15-inch pan), greased with butter.  Bake 20 minutes at 400°.

name: BOURBON SLUSHIES
ingredients:
2  c. water
2  tea bags
1  c. sugar
6  oz. frozen orange juice concentrate
12  oz. frozen lemonade concentrate
6  c. water
2  c. bourbon
preparation: Blend frozen bananas and frozen strawberries and serve.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. ground beef
1 large  jar Ragu with mushrooms
1  onion, minced
2  garlic cloves, minced
oregano to taste
1  to 2 bay leaves
8  oz. cream cheese
1 to 1 1/2  c. sour cream
2  medium onions, chopped fine
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. egg noodles
preparation: Brown meat in a large skillet with a little olive oil.  Add onion, garlic, oregano, bay leaves and Ragu.  Simmer 10 to 15 minutes.  Mix cheese, sour cream and onions.  Set aside.  Cook noodles as directed.  Add a little olive oil to water.  Drain. Spread 3/4 of noodles into a large rectangular pan.  Pour meat sauce over noodles.  Spread the cheese, sour cream and onions over sauce.  Put remainder of noodles over all.  Sprinkle with grated Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese.  Cover with foil and cook for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: LEMON CUSTARD PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. plain flour
6  Tbsp. margarine, melted
2  c. sugar, divided
4  eggs, separated
1 1/2  c. milk
grated peel of 1 lemon
2  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
10x sugar
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, butter and 1 1/2 cups sugar.  Beat egg yolks.  Add to mixing bowl along with milk and lemon peel.  Mix well.  Add lemon juice.  In another bowl, beat egg whites until stiff, slowly adding remaining 1/2 cup sugar while beating.  Fold into batter.  Pour into a greased 2-quart baking dish.  Place in a shallow pan of hot water and bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until slightly browned.  Serve warm or chilled with 10x sugar dusted on top.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. spiral macaroni (7 oz.)
2  c. zucchini
1  c. ripe olives (omit if watching salt in your diet)
onion (if desired)
1  medium tomato, seeded and chopped
1  c. fresh mushrooms
1  c. cauliflowerets
2  c. broccoli flowerets
thin carrot sticks
preparation: Cook macaroni according to directions.  Rinse in cold water. Drain well.  In a large bowl, combine macaroni, zucchini, olives, onions, mushrooms, cauliflower and broccoli.  Cover and chill several hours.  At serving time, toss with tomato and 2/3 cup low or nonfat Italian or Ranch dressing.

name: PEANUT BUTTER SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. creamy peanut butter
2  c. crushed corn flakes
1/2  c. white Karo
1/2  c. sugar
4  sq. almond bark
preparation: Mix together peanut butter and crushed corn flakes.  Heat Karo and sugar until bubbly.  Do not boil.  Pour over peanut butter and corn flakes mixture.  Mix well.  Press into 8 x 12-inch pan. Cool.  Melt almond bark in microwave.  Spread over pressed mixture in pan.   When firm, cut into squares.

name: LEG OF LAMB
ingredients:
1  leg of lamb
2  cloves garlic
Lawry's seasoned salt
paprika
pepper
3  onions, sliced
1  c. water
1  c. tomato juice
4  Tbsp. brown sugar
4  Tbsp. ketchup
preparation: Make slit in the leg of lamb and put garlic pieces inside. Season outside of lamb with salt, pepper and paprika.  In bottom of pan, put sliced onions and mixture of water and tomato juice. Cook 3 1/2 hours in 325° oven.  After first 1 1/2 hours, mix brown sugar and ketchup together and spread over meat; do not baste, sauce will form gravy.

name: CRABMEAT APPETIZER
ingredients:
1- 16  oz. can crabmeat
1  stick margarine
1- 6  oz. kraft old english cheese
2  T. mayonnaise
1/2  t. garlic powder
6  english muffins, split
preparation: Combine all ingredients and spread on muffins.  Place on cookie sheet in freezer for one hour.  Cut in half or quarters. Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: POTATO CUPS
ingredients:
8  potatoes
1  tsp. salt
1  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Grate your potatoes finely.  Mix grated potatoes, flour, salt and baking powder.  Heat butter on griddle and fry until golden brown.

name: SHRIMP SCRAMBLE
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  can shrimp
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. prepared mustard
2  English muffins, split
butter or margarine
preparation: In medium bowl with fork, beat eggs and milk slightly.  Stir in shrimp, salt, pepper and mustard.  Meanwhile, toast English muffins.  Spread with butter; keep warm.  In an 8-inch skillet over medium heat, melt 1 tablespoon butter or margarine.  Add egg mixture and cook, stirring once or twice with fork, until eggs are set.  Spoon over muffin halves.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
3  c. Bisquick
1  lb. sausage (hot or mild)
1/2  lb. sharp cheese
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
little water
preparation: Combine all ingredients; mix thoroughly and make into small balls the size of a large marble.  Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake for 12 to 15 minutes at 350°.

name: SAUSAGE LASAGNA WRAPS
ingredients:
6  lasagna noodles
1  lb. smoked sausage
Mozzarella cheese
1 (16 oz.)  jar Italian cooking sauce
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook and drain 6 lasagna noodles.  Divide 1 pound smoked sausage into 6 pieces.  Split lengthwise and stuff with 1/2 slice of Mozzarella cheese.  Wrap each piece in a noodle.  Place in baking dish and cover with Italian cooking sauce.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serve with grated Parmesan cheese.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: THYME JELLY
ingredients:
1  tsp. thyme
1/2  c. boiling water
1 1/2  c. unsweetened grape juice
2  tsp. lemon juice
3  c. honey
1  bottle liquid pectin or 1 box powdered pectin
preparation: Make infusion of thyme and water.  Strain and add enough water to make one half cup.  Combine with juices and honey in large saucepan.  Bring to full rolling boil and add pectin, stirring constantly.  Boil hard 30 seconds and give sheet test for jellying point.  Remove from heat and skim.  Pour into hot, sterilized glasses and seal.  A very pretty jelly to highlight venison, game, poultry and cheese dishes.

name: CHICKEN CURRY
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken thighs or drumsticks
2  onions
1/4  c. vegetable oil
4 large  cloves garlic and ginger (1-inch pieces), ground to paste
3  medium tomatoes
1/2  spoon chili powder
salt to taste
1/2  c. water
preparation: Remove the skin from the chicken and clean very well.  Slice onion and saute in 1/4 cup vegetable oil to a golden brown.  Add ginger and garlic paste and chicken pieces.  Stir a while and then add chili powder, salt and water.  Cook in low-medium heat with cover on it.  Let it cook for a few minutes (10 to 15 minutes). Add chopped tomatoes.  Now, cook in low heat for 10 minutes more.

name: CHERRY LIMEADE
ingredients:
2 12  oz. cans frozen limeade concentrate
1  2 liter lemon lime soda
1 10  oz. jar cherries
1  lime
preparation: Mix limeade and soda together. Add juice from cherries. Squeeze in juice from lime. Mix well. Garnish with cherries.

name: PEANUT BUTTER APPLE DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs (about 24 squares)
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. plus 1/3 c. peanut butter, divided
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
1  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
3/4  c. sugar
1  carton (16 oz.) frozen whipped topping, thawed
2  cans (21 oz. each) apple pie filling
3/4  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: In a bowl, combine crumbs, brown sugar, 1/2 cup peanut butter, and butter; spoon half into a 3 qt. bowl.  In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth; fold in whipped topping.  Spread half over crumb mixture in the bowl.  Top with one can of pie filling.  Combine powdered sugar, cinnamon, and remaining peanut butter until crumbly; sprinkle half over pie filling.  Repeat layers.  Refrigerate until time to serve.

name: BROCCOLI-RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. Minute rice
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
2  Tbsp. oleo
1/2  c. milk
1  small onion, sliced
1  can cream of celery soup
1  c. Cheez Whiz
preparation: Combine all ingredients. Bake in uncovered baking dish at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots (frozen, fresh or canned)
1 green pepper, diced or 10  oz. frozen peas
1  onion, diced
1  c. celery, diced
1  can tomato soup (Campbell's regular)
1/2  c. Mazola oil
3/4  c. white vinegar
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix together soup, oil, vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.  Pour over carrots and let set for at least 8 hours, stirring occasionally.

name: CHICKEN AND DRESSING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, cooked and deboned
1  stick margarine, melted
1 small  pkg. Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Combine margarine and stuffing mix.  Spread 3/4 of stuffing mix in casserole dish.  Layer chicken over stuffing mix.  Pour 1 cup chicken broth and cream of chicken soup over that.  Sprinkle rest of stuffing mix over all.  Pour 1/2 cup chicken broth over stuffing mix.

name: PINEAPPLE PECAN LOAF
ingredients:
1  egg, beaten
1/3  c. milk
1/3  c. butter, melted
1  c. crushed pineapple (not drained)
1  c. chopped pecans
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. pitted dates
2 3/4  c. sifted flour
3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine egg, milk, butter, pineapple, nuts and dates.  Sift dry ingredients and add to egg mixture.  Blend thoroughly.  Pour into greased and floured loaf pan, 9 x 5 x 2 1/2-inch.  Bake at 350° for 75 minutes or until loaf tests done.

name: SWEET BROCCOLI SLAW
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. apple cider vinegar
1/4  c. water
1/2  tsp. mustard seeds
1/2  tsp. celery seeds
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. broccoli
slaw mix
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a small saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves.  Remove from heat.  Pour over broccoli slaw mix, stirring gently.  Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours, stirring occasionally.  Serve with a slotted spoon.

name: POTATO ROLLS
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
7  tsp. baking powder
2  medium cold boiled potatoes, mashed
milk, about 1 1/2 c.
preparation: Sift dry  ingredients together; add potatoes.  Add milk to make a  stiff  batter  or  soft  dough.  Divide  into small pieces and shape  into  rolls.  Place in greased pan and brush with melted butter.  Let  stand 15 to 20 minutes.  Bake in hot oven.

name: JIM'S TROPICAL FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
64  oz. pine-orange banana juice
32  oz. lemon-lime soda
6  oz. frozen limeade concentrate, thawed
16  oz. frozen peaches
12  oz. frozen raspberries
2  firm medium bananas, peeled and sliced
2  oranges, peeled and sliced
preparation: Gently combine liquid and thawed ingredients.  While facing north and standing upright, add banana slices.  While sitting with knife in hand, add orange slices.  Grip firmly a large spoon and stir briskly all ingredients in a large punch bowl or small wash tub.  Serve while still swirling.  If swirling stops, well, stir it again!

name: TEXAS TORTILLA SOUP
ingredients:
1  medium chopped onion
2  cloves minced garlic
1  Tbsp. oil
2  lb. ground meat
14 1/2  oz. can stewed tomatoes
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can beef bouillon
1  can chicken broth
1  can tomato soup
2  c. water
1/2  tsp. ground cumin
1  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. seasoned pepper
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. Tabasco
1  large bag plain Doritos
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: In large pot, saute onion, garlic and ground meat in oil.  Add remaining ingredients, except chips and cheese.  Simmer 1 hour. Place chips in bottom of bowl, then soup and top with cheese.

name: MAINE POTATO CANDY
ingredients:
4  c. confectioners sugar
4  c. flaked coconut
3/4  c. cold mashed potatoes
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1  lb. dark candy coating
preparation: In a large bowl, combine sugar, coconut, potatoes, vanilla and salt. Mix well. Line a 9-inch square pan with foil. Butter foil. Spread coconut mixture into pan. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Cut into 2 x 1-inch rectangles. Cover and freeze. Melt candy coating and dip bars. Place on waxed paper.

name: MOUNTAIN LODGE PANCAKE SYRUP
ingredients:
1  c. water
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1  Tbsp. maple flavor
1  tsp. vanilla flavor
preparation: Combine all ingredients in saucepan; heat until sugar is dissolved.  (Do not boil.)  Serve hot.

name: ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  can green chilies, chopped
1  can enchilada sauce
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, cut in small pieces
2  lb. ground beef, browned
1 large  can evaporated milk
12  to 15 tortillas, broken in pieces
preparation: Mix all  together  and	bake in a shallow pan (9 x 13 x 2-inch) at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Spray pan with cooking spray for easier cleaning.  All ingredients may be mixed in a baking pan. Cover  pan	with aluminum foil before baking.  Let set a few minutes before serving.

name: MARINADE MEAT
ingredients:
1/2  c. salad oil
3/4  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. Worcestershire
2  tsp. dry mustard
2 1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. black pepper
1/2  c. vinegar
1 1/2  tsp. parsley flakes
2  tsp. garlic
1/3  c. lemon juice
preparation: Put all ingredients in jar and shake.  Pour over any cut of meat.  Leave overnight.  Grill; slice thin.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
3  c. chicken, cooked and diced
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
1  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1  c. chicken broth
1  stick margarine
1  c. flour
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients together and put in 9 x 13 inch pan. Melt butter, mixing in flour and milk; pour over chicken mixture. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until top is brown.

name: PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
yellow cake mix or one made from scratch
1/2  can sweetened condensed milk
1  can crushed pineapple, well drained
whipped topping
preparation: Bake cake according to directions.  While warm, prick all over with fork and spread with condensed milk.  Let cool.  Spread drained pineapple over cake, then spread whipped topping. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. white Karo syrup
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  stick butter
2  Tbsp. milk (or cream)
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Beat  the eggs until they are well mixed; add the sugar and Karo syrup.  Stir well.  Add butter, milk and pecans.  Mix well. Pour  in a 9 or 10-inch unbaked pie shell.	Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

name: DELUXE CHOCOLATE MARSHMALLOW BARS
ingredients:
3/4  c. margarine
3  eggs
1 1/3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
1 1/3  c. (8 oz.) chocolate chips
2  c. crisp rice cereal
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3  Tbsp. baking cocoa
4  c. miniature marshmallows
3  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. peanut butter
preparation: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs and vanilla; beat until fluffy.  Combine flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa.  Add to creamed mixture.  Stir in nuts if desired. Spread in a greased jelly roll pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes.  Sprinkle marshmallows evenly over cake.  Return to oven for 2 to 3 minutes.  Using a knife dipped in water, spread the melted marshmallows evenly over cake.  Cool.

name: PARTY POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash brown potatoes
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  c. shredded cheese
1  pt. sour cream
1/4  c. melted butter
1/2  c. crushed corn flakes
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except butter and corn flakes.  Place in well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with crushed corn flakes and then melted butter.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
yellow cake mix
oil
eggs
3  mashed ripe bananas
preparation: Use inexpensive yellow cake mix.  Use oil and eggs as directed.  Substitute 3 mashed ripe bananas for liquid (no milk or water).  Bake per mix instructions in loaf pan.

name: CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. milk (sweet)
1  egg
2  Tbsp. mayo
meal (to thicken)
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 400° to 450°. Put oil in iron skillet (small) and put in the oven to heat. Mix milk, egg, mayo and meal in bowl. Pour hot grease from skillet into mixture and stir. Pour into skillet and return to oven. Bake until brown.

name: BLACK FORREST CAKE
ingredients:
1  (18 oz.) devil's food cake mix
21  oz. can cherry pie filling
1  Tbsp. almond flavoring
1  (5.1 oz.) vanilla instant pudding
2  Tbsp. vanilla extract
8  oz. whipped topping
2  Tbsp. chocolate sprinkles
maraschino cherries
preparation: Bake cake according to directions in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Mix pie filling and almond flavoring. While cake is still warm, poke top with fork and spread cherry filling over top. While cake cools, prepare pudding, adding extra vanilla flavoring. Fold in whipped topping. Spread pudding mixture over cake carefully, covering cherry pie filling. Decorate with chocolate sprinkles and maraschino cherries. Cover and refrigerate.

name: BASIC EGG NOODLE PASTA
ingredients:
4  large eggs (7/8 c. egg)
1  Tbsp. water
3 1/2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
preparation: Place eggs, water and flour in bowl.  Attach bowl and flat beater.  Turn to speed 2 and mix 30 seconds.  Remove flat beater and attach dough to hook.  Turn to speed 2 and knead 2 minutes. Hand-knead dough for 30 seconds to 1 minute.  Cover with dry towel and let rest 15 minutes before extruding through Pasta Maker, following cooking instructions "to cook pasta."

name: HONEY DIJON CHICKEN(Fat:  3 Grams Per Serving)
ingredients:
1/2  c. honey
1/3  c. Dijon mustard
1  Tbsp. curry powder
1/3  c. soy sauce
4  boneless, skinless chicken breasts
preparation: Combine honey, mustard, curry powder and soy sauce.  Place chicken in a food storage bag with zipper-type closure.  Pour in marinade.  Marinate in refrigerator overnight.  In a 9 x 13-inch baking pan, place chicken breasts.  Pour marinade over chicken. Cover and bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.  Remove cover and bake 15 minutes, uncovered.  Serves 4.

name: PIZZA CUPS
ingredients:
3/4  lb. ground meat
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (10 oz.)  can refrigerated biscuits
1/2 to 3/4  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown and drain beef.  Stir in tomato paste, onion and seasonings (mixture will be thick).  Cook over low heat for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.  Place biscuits in a greased muffin tin, pressing to cover bottom and sides.  Spoon about 1/4 cup of meat mixture into biscuit lined cups and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400° for 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Yields 12 pizza cups.

name: FRIED FRESH CORN
ingredients:
4  c. corn (fresh)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  small minced green pepper
4  Tbsp. shortening
preparation: Measure flour, wheat germ, baking soda and salt into large bowl; stir to blend.  In bowl of food processor, combine the eggs, bananas, honey, vegetable oil, lemon juice and vanilla until well blended.  Pour over flour mixture; add walnuts.  Stir with rubber spatula just until blended.  Pour into a greased and floured 8 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° until sides pull away from pan and pick inserted into center comes out clean, 45 to 55 minutes. Cool before removing from pan.

name: COMPANY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. oil
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
8 oz  pkg. noodles
1  c. cottage cheese
8  oz. cream cheese
1/4  c. sour cream
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/3  c. sliced green onion
preparation: Pan-fry onion in oil.  Add beef, salt and pepper.  Cook until pink disappears.  Add tomato sauce.  Remove from heat.  Cook noodles according to package directions.  Mix together cottage cheese, cream cheese, sour cream, green pepper and green onion. In a 3-quart casserole, spread half of the noodles.  Cover with cheese mixture.  Top with remaining noodles.  Pour meat sauce over top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.  May be frozen and baked later.

name: MARSHMALLOW MARBLE TOP FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. (1 1/2 pkg.) Hershey's semi-sweet chocolate chips
4  Tbsp. butter, divided
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk (condensed)
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
1 or 2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cover bottom of square pan with foil.  Set aside.  In heavy saucepan over low heat, melt chocolate chips and 2 tablespoons butter with sweetened condensed milk, vanilla and salt.  Remove from heat, stir in nuts.  Spread evenly in prepared pan.

name: BANANA PUDDING(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1 large  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
3  large eggs
1/3  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put in microwave and cook until thick.  Pour over banana and vanilla wafers.

name: ALMOND TEA
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemonade Kool-Aid (presweetened)
2  Tbsp. instant tea
1  Tbsp. almond extract
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
2  qt. water
preparation: Mix together.  Chill and serve over ice.

name: BREAKFAST MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  egg
1  c. milk
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  c. quick oats
1/2  c. raisins
1/3  c. peanut butter
1  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat  oven  to  400°.  In  mixing bowl slightly beat egg; beat  in milk, sugar and oil.  Blend in oats, raisins and peanut butter.  Combine  and  mix	thoroughly  flour,  baking powder and salt.  Add milk mixture and stir until just blended.  Mixture will  be  lumpy.  Spoon into greased muffin tins and bake for 16 to 18 minutes.  Makes 12 muffins.  Real good!

name: BEST MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
3/4  c. ketchup
1  tsp. Accent
1/2  c. warm water
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients; beat thoroughly.  Pack into a loaf pan. Pour one 8 ounce can tomato sauce over all and bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: SAUSAGE BREAD
ingredients:
2  cans biscuits, quartered
1  lb. sausage
bell pepper
onion
Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook sausage with bell pepper and onion. Drain grease well. Line bottom of Bundt pan with biscuits. Cover with half of the cooked mixture. Cover with cheese. Repeat. Cover with foil and cook 45 minutes in a 350° oven. Remove foil and cook additional 15 minutes.

name: HUNGARIAN MACARONI
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. mayonnaise
3/4  c. onion, chopped
3/4  c. green peppers, chopped
1 small  can mushrooms and juice
1 small  jar pimentos and juice, chopped
1  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cooked macaroni (2 c.)
bread crumbs
preparation: Cook macaroni and drain.  Combine soup, mayonnaise, mushrooms with juice and pimentos and juice.  Toss macaroni with onion, pepper, mushroom and pimentos.  Arrange in 2 layers.  Macaroni, cheese and sauce.  Top with crumbs and bake for 35 minutes at 350°.

name: ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
baking potatoes
seasoned salt
pat of margarine
preparation: Cut baking potatoes in half lengthwise.  Sprinkle cut sides with seasoned salt.  Top with a pat of margarine.  Turn, cut side down into baking pan and roast at 425° for 30 minutes or until done.  The longer they cook the browner and crispier the cut sides will become.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. cooking oil
2  c. sugar
2  c. grated zucchini
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Grease and flour 2 loaf pans.  Beat eggs; add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla.  Cream together.  Add flour.  Add salt and baking powder.  Add to creamed mixture and bake at 300° for 1 hour.

name: CHOW MEIN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. or more ground beef
2  onions, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/4  c. rice (uncooked)
1  can mushroom soup
1  can chicken rice soup
1  c. water
1  can bean sprouts, drained
1  can water chestnuts, sliced
preparation: Lightly  brown	beef,  onions and celery. Add remaining ingredients  and  stir  well.  Pour into greased casserole and bake 1 1/2 hours in 350° oven.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS ALA PARMIGIANA
ingredients:
2  whole chicken breasts
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. nutmeg, freshly grated
salt and freshly ground black pepper
2  eggs, lightly beaten
3/4  c. bread crumbs
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
1/3  c. butter, melted
4  lemon wedges
preparation: Split and bone chicken breasts.  Remove and discard the skin. Season the flour with salt and pepper to taste; add nutmeg. Dredge the breasts lightly in the flour mixture.  Dip the breasts into the eggs and then in a mixture of bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese, coating thoroughly.  Brown on all sides in the melted butter.  Serve hot with lemon wedges.  Serves 4.

name: HOT FUDGE SAUCE
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
3/4  c. cocoa
1/2  c. cornstarch
1  tsp. salt
1/4  lb. butter
4  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook all ingredients slowly (low heat) until it thickens. Great over ice cream.

name: BROCCOLI CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  c. unsifted flour
3  c. water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. broccoli, thawed and drained
4  tsp. or 4 cubes chicken bouillon cubes
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
3  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  c. half and half
preparation: Cook onion in margarine until tender; stir in flour. Gradually stir in water, broccoli, bouillon and Worcestershire sauce.  Over medium heat, cook and stir until thickened and broccoli is tender (about 10 minutes).  Add cheese and half and half.  Cook until smooth and creamy.  Do not boil.

name: ITALIAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  boneless and skinless chicken breast
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Italian salad dressing
6  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Wash chicken breast and place in baking dish. Coat each piece with salad dressing and sprinkle with lemon juice. Place 1 Tbsp. butter on each chicken breast. Cover and bake at 300° for 2 hours.

name: LIGHT CRISP WAFFLES
ingredients:
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. buttermilk
1/4  c. milk
6  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  egg, separated
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Heat oven to 200°.  Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, baking powder and baking soda in a medium bowl.  Measure buttermilk, milk and vegetable oil in a 2-cup measuring cup; mix in yolk and set aside.

name: NO BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  stick butter
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  Tbsp. cocoa
3  c. quick oats
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix the sugar, milk and butter together.  Put on stove.  Bring to a boil and boil 1 minute.  Take off heat and add the peanut butter and vanilla.  Mix together the cocoa and oats and add to the mixture.  Stir well.  Take a spoon and drop spoonfuls onto wax paper to cool.  When cool, place cookies in airtight container.

name: FISH AND VEGETABLES(Serves 1)
ingredients:
4  oz. fish
3/4  c. mushrooms
1/4  c. celery
oregano to taste
onion powder to taste
garlic powder to taste
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place fish and all other ingredients in foil.  Bake for 30 minutes.

name: SAUCY BEEF AND RICE
ingredients:
1  lb. sirloin steak, cut into strips
1/2  c. water
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  envelope onion soup mix
1 (14 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. cooked rice
preparation: You will need one large oven bag.

name: PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1  can sweet peas, drained
1  box macaroni (1 lb. box)
1  tomato, diced or chopped
1  small onion, diced
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Cook macaroni according to directions; drain.  Mix all together and chill and serve.

name: GEORGIA'S DIVINITY
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1/2  c. syrup
2/3  c. water
2  egg whites
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, syrup, water and salt together.  Cook over medium heat to hard ball stage using candy thermometer.  Pour hot syrup slowly over egg whites which have been stiffly beaten.  Beat with an electric mixer until candy starts to hold its shape.  Drop by teaspoonful onto cookie sheet.  Cake coloring can be used to give it color.  Pecans can be used for decoration.

name: SOUR CREAM LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. margarine
1  Tbsp. grated lemon rind
3  eggs, separated
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix sugar, margarine, lemon juice and rind, cornstarch, milk and egg yolks.  Cook until thick, cool slightly and add sour cream.  Stir.  Pour into baked pie shell.  Use egg whites to make meringue and put on pie.  Brown in oven.

name: BLUE SHERBET PUNCH
ingredients:
4  qt. pineapple sherbet
4 to 5  qt. lemon-lime soda
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. blue coloring
preparation: Mix  ingredients.  This  will  not stay blue unless you use the  lemon	lime  soda.  Serves  20 to 30. Great for baby showers!

name: DURKEE'S CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  chicken breast halves
1/2  c. melted margarine
1/2  c. Durkee famous sauce
3  c. cooked rice
preparation: Place chicken breasts in single layer in shallow baking dish. Blend butter and Durkee's.  Pour over chicken.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes.  Uncover and bake 15 minutes more or until brown.  Serve chicken atop bed of rice.  Pour drippings over all, if desired.

name: MILLION DOLLAR RICE
ingredients:
3  c. chicken broth
1/2  c. wild rice
1/2  c. basmati rice
5  Tbsp. butter
1/2  lb. fresh shiitake mushrooms, stems trimmed
salt to taste
freshly ground pepper to taste
preparation: Cook rice for 25 minutes or until water is gone.  Add 2 tablespoons of butter and set aside after transferring to baking dish.  Use remaining butter to saute mushrooms for 4 minutes. Stir into rice and season with salt and pepper.  Cover baking dish and bake for 20 minutes at 250°.

name: MOCK COTTAGE CHEESE
ingredients:
4  c. grated tofu
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. SOY MAYONNAISE
2 1/4  tsp. onion powder
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
chives
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients  together with a potato masher or fork. Stir in fresh chopped chives.  Chill.  Serves 6.

name: APPLE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  c. shortening
1  egg yolk plus enough milk to make 2/3 c.
2  handfuls crushed cornflakes
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  to 3 egg whites
slices apples
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients like pie crust.  Beat egg yolk in measuring cup; add enough milk to make 2/3 cup.  Add to crust mixture.  Roll out 1/2 of crust to fit large cookie sheet.  Put crushed cornflakes over it.  Fill with sliced apples.  Sprinkle the sugar and cinnamon over the apples.  Roll out the other 1/2 of the crust.  Put over the top and pinch edges together.  Beat egg whites until stiff.  Spread over top of crust.  Do not add sugar to egg whites.  Bake in 400° oven for 1 hour.  Remove from oven and pour following glaze while hot.

name: SUMMER TOMATO SALAD
ingredients:
2  medium ripe tomatoes
8  oz. Mozzarella or goat cheese, sliced thin
6  large fresh basil leaves, finely chopped
1/2  tsp. pepper, divided
Tarragon Vinaigrette (see Misc.)
1  medium cucumber, sliced
1  onion, sliced
basil leaves (optional)
preparation: Layer tomato and cheese slices in a shallow dish.  Sprinkle with 1/2 basil and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.  Drizzle with 1/4 cup Tarragon Vinaigrette.  Top with cucumber and onion slices. Sprinkle with remaining basil, pepper and dressing.  Cover and chill for 4 hours.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
2  lb. Ground Beef
1  lb. Hot Jimmy Dean Sausage
2  onions, chopped
2  bell peppers, chopped
1  jalapeno pepper, chopped
2  cans Chili Magic (Texas)
1  can Chili Beans, hot
1  can Dark Red Kidney Beans
2  cans Diced Tomatoes
3  cans Tomato Paste
1  c. sugar
salt
pepper
chili powder
garlic powder/salt
onion powder/salt
sweet basil
oregano
preparation: Brown meat together.  About half way through browning, add onion and bell pepper.  Drain grease from meat mixture.  Pour mixture into large stockpot.  Add all other ingredients.  Bring slowly to a boil.  Simmer for at least an hour.  Serve with shredded cheese, sour cream and oyster crackers.  Yields approx. 15-20 bowls.  Freezes well.

name: CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. corn meal
1/2  c. margarine
3  eggs
1  unbaked pastry shell
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. milk
preparation: Melt margarine in pan.  Add sugar and meal; cream well, then add 1 egg at a time and beat thoroughly after each addition.  Add vinegar, vanilla and milk.  Beat well.  Pour in an unbaked pastry shell and bake at 400° for 10 minutes.   Reduce heat to 325° and continue cooking for 30 minutes.

name: SUGAR-FREE PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. sugar-free instant vanilla pudding
2  c. cold milk
1/2  c. sugar-free peanut butter
1  pie shell, baked
preparation: Mix pudding according to directions on packages.   Add peanut butter and pour directly into pie shell.  Chill 1 hour before serving.

name: CHILI IN AN HOUR
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. white vinegar
2 (15 oz.)  cans pinto beans
1 (14 oz.)  bottle ketchup
2 (14 oz.) ketchup  bottles water
preparation: Brown  ground  beef  in a large pot.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Cook  and  simmer for 45 minutes.  Chili will be soupy.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
1  lb. peeled and deveined shrimp
6  stalks celery, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
4  Tbsp. shortening
1 (No. 303)  can tomatoes
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can tomato soup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. Tabasco sauce
preparation: Cook, clean and devein shrimp.  Cook celery, pepper, onion and garlic in shortening until tender.  Add all other ingredients except shrimp and simmer for 45 minutes.  Add shrimp and simmer for 15 minutes longer.  Serve hot over hot cooked rice.  Yield:  6 to 8 servings.

name: BARBECUED SAUSAGE AND NOODLES
ingredients:
1  pkg. egg noodles
1  pkg. smoked sausage
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1/2  onion, chopped
1/2  mango, cut in strips
1  c. barbecue sauce
1/2  c. catsup
preparation: Cook 1/2 package of egg noodles by directions on package.

name: CHAMPION SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
3/4  c. sugar
2  diced bananas
12  oz. fresh or frozen strawberries
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  c. chopped pecans
10  oz. container Cool Whip
preparation: Combine cream cheese and sugar; mix well.  Add diced bananas, fresh or frozen strawberries, crushed pineapple and chopped pecans.  Fold in container of Cool Whip.  Freeze until 1 1/2 hours before serving.

name: PICANTE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  gal. tomatoes
4 to 5  cloves garlic
4  to 5 hot peppers
5  to 6 medium onions
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. ice cream salt
preparation: Grind garlic, peppers and onions in meat grinder.  Cook tomatoes and other vegetables together with sugar and salt until it thickens as you like your sauce, stirring constantly.  Put in hot jar and seal.  Put sealed jars in hot water bath for 5 minutes. Make sure they are sealed.

name: CRANBERRY AND APPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  bag fresh cranberries
1 1/4  c. sugar
3  tart apples, cored and cubed
1/2  c. water
preparation: Toss first 3 ingredients and put in casserole dish. Pour water over the fruit.  Mix topping and pour over fruit and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: QUICK AND EASY JAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  box spice cake mix
4  eggs
1/3  c. oil
1  c. seedless blackberry jam
2/3  c. raisins
2/3  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease and lightly flour three 9-inch cake pans. Combine the cake mix, eggs, oil, and jam.  Mix well. Stir in the raisins and pecans.  Pour into the prepared pans. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into center of the layers.  Remove from the pan and cool on a rack. Frost with Easy Caramel Frosting.

name: BAKED PINEAPPLE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter, melted
4  c. soft bread crumbs
preparation: Remove crust from bread and drain pineapple.  Mix eggs and sugar.  Blend in rest of ingredients.  Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: CHURCH SALAD
ingredients:
fresh spinach, thoroughly washed and dried
sliced Bermuda onions
bacon strips, fried and crumbled
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1  beaten egg
preparation: Toss ingredients together.  Cook until thick.  Keep refrigerated.

name: ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. orange Jell-O
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  (16 oz.) cottage cheese
1  (16 oz.) Cool Whip
1/2  c. chopped pecans (save some for top)
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
preparation: Mix Jell-O, cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Add pineapple, oranges and pecans. Mix well. Pour into a dish and chill. Top with pecans and orange slices. Keeps well.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. crushed pineapple
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. sugar
2  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. gelatin
1/2  pt. whipped cream
maraschino cherries
preparation: Let pineapple and sugar come to a boil, then add gelatin dissolved in water.  Remove from heat.  When mixture begins to set and cool, add cream cheese, smoothed out and whipped, whipped cream and cherries.  Let cool and set in refrigerator.

name: BLUEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can blueberry pie filling
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. pecans, crushed
2  boxes Jell-O (black raspberry or grape)
2  c. water
1  c. sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Stir Jell-O in boiling water until dissolved.  Add fruit and nuts.  Let congeal for several hours.  Whip sour cream and cream cheese and pour over firm Jell-O mixture.  Garnish with extra nuts.

name: HAYSTACKS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch morsels
2  tsp. salad oil
1 (3 oz.)  can chow mein Chinese noodles (2 c.)
1  can small salted peanuts
preparation: In top of double boiler over hot (not boiling) water, melt butterscotch morsels.  Stir in salad oil.  In a large bowl, mix chow mein noodles and peanuts.  Pour on butterscotch and mix thoroughly with a fork.  Drop mixture by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper on greased cookie sheet.

name: GERMAN POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
12  potatoes
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, diced
1  c. Hellmann's mayo
1/2  lb. bacon, cooked and diced
1/2  c. chopped olives
preparation: Cook potatoes with skins on.  After cooked, peel and cut up. Combine all ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 60 minutes.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2  cans whole kernel corn
1  can cream-style corn
3  eggs (unbeaten)
4  Tbsp. Argo cornstarch
1/2  stick butter
1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until it sets and is browned.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: SOUTHERN BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
2  c. dried Northern beans
12  c. water
1  meaty ham bone, trim fat if possible
1  c. finely chopped onion
2  cloves minced garlic
1  small bay leaf
1  c. cooked mashed potatoes
1  c. thinly sliced celery
1  c. diced raw carrots
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. evaporated skim milk or more to taste
preparation: Pick and wash beans; add beans to water.  Bring to a boil and boil for 2 minutes only.  Cover and remove from heat and allow to stand 1 hour.  (This is equal to 12 hours of soaking in cold water.)  Add ham bone, garlic and bay leaf to water and beans. Bring back to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer about 2 hours or until beans are almost done.  Add remaining ingredients.  Cover and simmer another hour.  Remove ham bone and cut off meat and return meat to pot.  Add skim milk.  Delicious soup.

name: EGG CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
1/3  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. vanilla
4  whole eggs
preparation: In a quart measuring cup, add flour, sugar, nutmeg and vanilla.  Add enough milk to make a paste.  Add eggs and beat with electric mixer.  Add enough milk to fill your measuring cup; mix well.  Put in a 9-inch unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until firm.

name: CHERRY SPOON CAKE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
1 (8 1/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, undrained
1 (18 1/2 oz.)  pkg. yellow cake mix (no pudding in mix)
2  sticks butter or margarine
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can flaked coconut
1  c. chopped pecans or other nuts
preparation: Spray a 9 x 3 x 2-inch pan with Pam.  Line pan with cherry filling and spread pineapple over this.  Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over pineapple.  Pour melted butter evenly over the mix. Sprinkle the coconut and nuts on top.   Bake 1 hour at 325°.  Cool completely before serving.   Can use other fruit filling.

name: ALBERT'S PEAR RELISH
ingredients:
1  peck pears
5  medium onions
6  bell peppers (large; 3 red and 3 green)
2  lb. sugar (4 1/2 c.)
5  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. mixed spices
1  Tbsp. turmeric
preparation: Put pears, onions and peppers through food chopper.  Add all other.  Cook for 30 minutes after it reaches a hard boil.  Put in jars and seal while hot.

name: ZESTY MEXICAN CAULIFLOWER
ingredients:
1-1/2  cups cauliflower florets
1/2  cup low-fat sour cream
1  tbsp low-fat mayonnaise
1  tsp hot pepper sauce
1/2  cup salsa
1/4  cup low-fat shredded cheddar cheese
1-1/2  cups cooked fresh corn
preparation: Cook cauliflower florets; drain and set aside.  Combine sauce ingredients in large saucepan and cook over medium heat until bubbly, stirring constantly.  Add cooked cauliflower and corn. Toss well and serve.  Serves 6.

name: ENGLISH SHEPHERD PIE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburg
3  lb. potatoes
1  lb. carrots
1  large onion
1  can garden peas
preparation: Cook and drain hamburg.  Cook potatoes, carrots and onion. When cooked, mash potatoes with butter and milk.  Place half of the sliced carrots and onion in roasting pan on bottom.  Layer hamburg, then potatoes, followed by carrots and onion, then hamburg, then mashed potatoes on top.  Spray with Mazola or Pam.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Delicious.

name: MOM'S CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  Tbsp. flour
3  egg yolks (set whites aside)
2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring
Meringue:
3  egg whites
6  tsp. sugar
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Cook in heavy sauce pan or skillet until thick.  Place in baked pie shell.  For meringue: Beat eggs and sugar until stiff.  Spoon on pie.  Place in 400 degree oven until brown.  (Watch closely.)

name: SWEET POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
2 to 2 1/2  lb. sweet potatoes
1/4  C. butter or margarine, melted
1/4 to 1/2  C. sugar
1/4  C. raisins
1/3  C. chopped nuts
1/3  C. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Place sweet potatoes and enough water to cover in a large saucepan or Dutch oven.  Cover and cook for 25-35 minutes or just until tender.  Drain; cool slightly and peel.

name: "OLD TIMER'S" CHILI SAUCE
ingredients:
2  gal. ripe tomatoes, peeled and cut up
2  c. red pepper (bell)
3  tsp. ginger
salt to taste
2  tsp. nutmeg
3  c. onions, peeled and cut up
6  pods hot pepper, seeded
3  c. sugar
2  tsp. cloves
3  tsp. cinnamon
1  qt. white vinegar
preparation: Mix ingredients together well.  Bring to boil and cook 2 hours on medium heat, stirring often to prevent sticking as it thickens. Makes 12 pints.  Pour into jars and seal.

name: RIBBON O'FUDGE BARS
ingredients:
4  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. butterscotch chips
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3  qt. popped corn
1 (12 oz.)  jar hot fudge sauce
preparation: In large Dutch oven, over low heat, melt marshmallows with butterscotch chips and butter; stir occasionally until smooth. Add popcorn; toss until well coated.  Press half mixture firmly into greased 9-inch square pan.  Spread fudge evenly over mixture. Press remaining popcorn over fudge.  Allow to cool and harden. Slide spatula under entire mixture and slice onto cutting board to cut into bars.  Makes 16 bars.

name: FIVE HOUR BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. stew meat
1  c. chopped celery
4  carrots, chopped
4  potatoes, quartered
1  slice bread, broken
2  Tbsp. tapioca
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  can stewed tomatoes
1  can water
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients in large Dutch oven (no need to brown meat).  Cover and  bake  4 to 5 hours at 275° or cook in crock-pot.	Delicious and easy make ahead meal.

name: 1-2-3 PASTRY
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
1/2  c. corn oil
1  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Mix flour and salt.  Blend oil in thoroughly with a fork. Sprinkle water over mixture; mix well.  Press dough firmly into a ball with hands.  If too dry, mix in 1 or 2 tablespoons more oil.

name: IMPERIAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
3/4  c. granulated sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. vinegar
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
preparation: Mix together margarine, sugar and baking soda.  Add vinegar, flour and nuts.  Blend well.  Drop with teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 300° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Yield:  4 to 4 1/2 dozen.

name: BLUEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. blackberry or grape gelatin
2  c. boiling water
1 large  can blueberry pie filling
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. crushed pineapple (undrained)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Add pie filling and pineapple.  Pour into flat dish and refrigerate until set. Combine sugar, sour cream, cream cheese and vanilla.  Spread over gelatin layer.  Sprinkle with nuts.

name: NO COOK BANANA OR PINEAPPLE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  small instant vanilla pudding
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
1 8  oz. sour cream
3  c. cold milk
4  or 5 bananas or 1 large pineapple tidbits
large pack vanilla wafers
preparation: Combine Cool Whip and sour cream (mix well with mixer). Pour in cold milk and pudding mix until thickens.  Add bananas or pineapple tidbits by hand.	Layer with wafers, then pour in pudding.  Crumble wafers on top.

name: BEEF BARBECUE
ingredients:
6  lb. beef brisket
1/4  c. liquid smoke
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. minced onion
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. water
preparation: Put brisket in roasting pan.  Add remaining ingredients to beef.  Bake at 275° for 5 to 6 hours.  Reserve 1 cup juice.   Let meat cool and refrigerate.

name: RUSSIAN TEA CAKES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1/2  c. powdered sugar
2 1/4  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Cream the butter until light and fluffy.  Add powdered sugar; mix well.  Add sifted flour; mix well.  Add vanilla and nuts; mix well.

name: GRANDMA DAIGLE'S RICE DRESSING
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
3  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1  large chopped bell pepper
3  c. cooked rice
1/2  c. chopped green onion tops
1/2  c. chopped parsley
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. water
2  Tbsp. Kitchen Bouquet (optional)
preparation: Cook meat in oil in a large pot until brown.  Add onions, celery and bell pepper.  Reduce heat and cook until wilted.   Add water and add more water if needed to keep about the same amount of juice that you started with.  Add to cooked rice and keep warm until ready to serve.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE MARTIN
ingredients:
2  c. diced, cooked chicken
1  c. cooked rice
1  c. thinly sliced water chestnuts (1 can)
1  c. sliced celery
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1/2  c. slivered almonds
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1  c. stuffing mix
1/2  c. melted margarine
preparation: Mix all ingredients except butter and stuffing.  Spread mixture in casserole dish.  Combine butter and stuffing; sprinkle on top.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°, uncovered.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. macaroni
1  c. cream soup
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  can tuna
3/4  stick extra sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
crushed chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients together (except chips).  Put in a casserole dish and top with chips.  Cover and bake in oven for 1 hour.  Remove cover and bake for an additional 15 minutes.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

name: EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
3  large eggs, beaten slightly
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. milk, scalded
nutmeg
preparation: Preheat oven to 415°.  Mix eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla. Pour into scalded milk and stir well.  Pour into unbaked pie shell and sprinkle with nutmeg.  Bake for 15 minutes.  Reduce heat to 350° and bake about 20 minutes longer or until custard is set.  Test with a knife an inch or so from the center of the pie.

name: MOM'S CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
1  unbaked 9 inch pie shell
4  eggs
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
preparation: Line unpricked pie crust with a double thickness of heavy-duty foil.  Bake at 450° for 8 minutes.  Remove foil, bake 5 minutes longer.  Remove from oven and set aside.

name: RHUBARB CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. shortening
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sour milk (add 1 tsp. vinegar to sour)
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sliced rhubarb
preparation: Cream together brown sugar, white sugar, shortening and egg. Add vanilla, sour milk and flour to creamed mixture.  Stir in rhubarb.  Bake at 325° for about 45 minutes.

name: MIRACLE SHAKE AND BAKE MIX
ingredients:
1/2  c. grate parmesan cheese
1  tsp. onion salt
3  c. dried bread crumbs
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. sage
1/2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix thoroughly dried bread crumbs with rest of ingredients. Store in jar in refrigerator.  Use as needed for chicken, pork chops, or fish.  Brush meat with melted margarine and coat with this mixture.  Bake until done.

name: MEXICAN FRANKS
ingredients:
10  tortillas
1  can (15 oz.) chili without beans
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. minced onions, divided
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  tsp. hot sauce
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped chilies
10  frankfurters
preparation: Combine chili,  1/4  cup  tomato  sauce,  onion and hot sauce. Place  a  frankfurter in center of each tortilla.  Top with 2 tablespoons chili mixture.  Roll up and place seam side down  in lightly  greased  11  x  7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Repeat procedure with remaining tortillas; set aside.  Combine remaining chili mixture and tomato sauce; pour over tortillas. Sprinkle with chilies.  Cover and bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Uncover  and sprinkle with cheese.  Bake 5 additional minutes. Yields 10 servings.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
8 1/2  oz. can crushed pineapple, drained
1/4  c. green pepper, finely chopped
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. seasoned salt
2  c. pecans, chopped and divided
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients; add one cup pecans and mix well. Refrigerate until firm and shape into a ball.  Roll in remaining pecans before serving.   Serve with assortment of crackers.

name: STRAWBERRY CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
3 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry flavored gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen sliced strawberries, partially thawed
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
3  medium bananas, mashed
1/2  c. coarsely chopped pecans
1 (8 oz.)  carton commercial sour cream
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Stir in fruit and pecans. Pour 1/2 of gelatin mixture into oiled 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Chill until firm.  Store remaining mixture at room temperature. Spread sour cream over congealed fruit mixture.  Spoon remaining gelatin mixture over sour cream.  Cover and chill until firm. Yields 12 servings.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped nuts
3  large bananas
1  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.  Add salt.  Pour soda into mashed bananas and add to first mixture.  Add vanilla, nuts and flour.  Mix well.  Bake in a well-greased and floured loaf pan at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BOK CHOY
ingredients:
1  lb. bok choy (Chinese celery)
1  tsp. olive oil
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. creptalliged fructose
1  tsp. low sodium soy sauce
1  tsp. sesame oil
preparation: Rinse bok choy in cold water.  Cut stalks diagonally in 1-inch pieces and leaves into thin shreds.  In a large nonstick skillet, heat oil and the stems first and saute, tossing about 2 minutes. Add garlic, leaves, fructose, soy sauce and sesame oil. Continue cooking over high heat 2 minutes more.  Contains 40 calories, 0 cholesterol, 5 g carbohydrates, 1 g protein, 59 mg sodium and 2 gr fat.

name: EASY FISH DINNER
ingredients:
6  large fish fillets
6  pats or 1 tsp. low salt margarine
1 1/2  c. barbecue sauce
6  white onion slices
preparation: Stack one of each ingredient in piece of foil large enough to wrap and seal.  Pepper to taste.  Wrap and place on grill for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: RED BEANS & RICE
ingredients:
3  cans red beans
1  stalk celery
3/4   c. chopped green pepper
1/2   tsp. cayenne pepper
5  dashes hot sauce
1  8-oz.  can tomato sauce
1/2   tsp. thyme
1  large onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1/2  tsp. oregano
2   lb. smoked sausage
hot rice
preparation: Mix first 14 ingredients in a large pot.  Cook over low heat for one hour and serve over hot cooked rice.

name: EXTRAORDINARY CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. butter, softened
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. baking soda
1  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix butter, sugars, vanilla and eggs in large bowl with spoon.  Stir in flour, baking soda and salt. Stir in chocolate chips.  Drop dough by rounded spoonful (about 1 tablespoon) about 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes.  Yield: 4 dozen cookies.

name: DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk or water
preparation: Mix dry ingredients together.  Add liquid and mix to a batter that will drop from spoon.  Drop from teaspoon into boiling stew or soup pot, being careful that there is plenty of liquid and no possibility of boiling dry.  Cover tightly and cook, undisturbed, from 10 to 20 minutes, depending on size of dumplings.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIPPERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sifted all-purpose flour
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
6  oz. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
preparation: Cream shortening, sugars, egg and vanilla until light and fluffy.  Sift together dry ingredients; stir into creamed mixture and blend well.  Add chocolate pieces.  Drop from teaspoon 2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet.  Bake in moderate oven at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Remove from sheet immediately.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: FRUIT PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. acini de pepe pasta
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
4  eggs, beaten
8  oz. Cool Whip
2  (10 oz.) Mandarin oranges
20  oz. crushed pineapple
preparation: Boil macaroni in 3 quarts boiling water.  Drain fruit (save juice).  Bring juice, sugar and flour almost to a boil.  Blend in 4 beaten eggs until thickened.  Cool macaroni and juice mixture.  Mix together.  Add in fruit and Cool Whip.  Blend well.  Add in more drained fruit as desired.

name: FRENCH FRIED ONION RINGS
ingredients:
2  Bermuda onions
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  egg, slightly beaten
2/3  c. milk
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
vegetable oil (for frying)
preparation: Cut off root ends of onions.  Peel and slice crosswise into 1/4-inch slices.  Separate slices into rings.

name: "BEA-BEAS" CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
3  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. corn oil (Mazola or Wesson)
1 small  can cream-style corn
1  c. sour cream
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix all  together.  Bake  in greased pan at 400° for 30 minutes.  Cut in squares.  Can be frozen to use later.

name: POTATO CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
5  lb. potatoes, peeled and sliced
2  medium onions, chopped
garlic powder
parsley flakes
salt and pepper
2  lb. Velveeta cheese, cubed
1/2  c. wine or cooking sherry
preparation: Wash and peel potatoes and onions.  Dice the potatoes and onions and place in a large saucepan of water.  Add garlic powder, parsley, salt and pepper to the saucepan.  Cook until tender.  Do not drain water.  Use the blender to blend about 2 cups of the soup and return to the saucepan.  (This is done to thicken the soup.)  Add cheese and continue to cook over low heat until the cheese is melted.  Add wine or sherry just before serving. Garnish soup with bacon bits, green onions and extra grated cheese, if desired.

name: MY ROLLS
ingredients:
2  oz. (3 pkg.) yeast
3 1/2  c. lukewarm water or milk or small can evaporated milk and potato water to make 3 c.
1 to 1 1/4  c. sugar
1  c. shortening or lard
1  stick butter
1/2  c. Crisco
1  Tbsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
8 to 10  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve the yeast in water (100° to 115°), about 10 minutes. Add all except the flour and mix well.  Add flour, stir and knead as dough becomes stiff.  Knead until smooth, about 8 to 10 minutes.

name: PARMESAN CHEESE SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
medium lemon
garlic clove
3/4  c. oil
1/4  lb. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Whip together lemon juice and pulp with finely chopped garlic clove.  Slowly mix in oil.  Let stand for 1 hour.  Mix in cheese after 1 hour.  Great with an Italian entree and a light and lively salad.

name: BUTTER ROLLS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
2 1/4  c. Bisquick
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
3 1/2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. water
dash of salt
preparation: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, mix 2 cups of the water, milk, 1 1/2 cups sugar and vanilla.  Set aside.  In a mixing bowl, mix Bisquick biscuits according to box directions*.  Take half the dough and roll out in a rectangle about 3/8-inch thick.  Slice 1 stick butter over dough; sprinkle 3/4 cup sugar over butter.  Roll up from long side.  Repeat with remaining dough.  Place in pan with milk mixture.  Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar on top of rolls.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes or until golden brown.

name: WAR CAKE
ingredients:
1 - 12 oz  box raisins
2  c water
3/4  c brown sugar
3/4  c white sugar
1  Tbsp lard
1  tsp cinnamon
1  tsp baking soda
1  tsp vanilla
2  1/2 to 2 3/4 c flour
chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Bring raisins, water, sugars, lard and cinnamon to a boil, turn heat down and boil for approximately 1 minute.  Turn off and cool completely.  Add baking soda, vanilla flour and nuts.  Mix well.  Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13 cake pan at 350 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.

name: GIANT COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. M&M's
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. any of the following:  marshmallows, coconut and Reese's pieces
preparation: Beat margarine and sugar together until light and fluffy. Blend in egg and vanilla.  Combine flour, cocoa, soda and salt together.  Add to margarine and sugar.  Stir in 1/2 cup candies and 1/4 cup nuts.  Place dough on foil lined, lightly greased 12 to 13-inch pizza pan.  Spread dough to within 1 1/2-inch of edge of pan.  Sprinkle remaining candies, etc. over dough.

name: REFRIGERATOR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. lard
2  c. brown sugar
3 1/2  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
3  eggs, well beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Cream lard and sugar together.  Add eggs, 1/4 cup water and flavor.  Add the dry ingredients and stir.  If too soft, add a little more flour.  Bake at 450°.

name: GRAM SPENCER'S GINGER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. molasses
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. sour milk
2  tsp. soda
preparation: Mix all together.  Flour enough to roll into balls, so you can handle  it.  Place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: HAMBURGER - SPAGHETTI BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
garlic salt to taste
pepper to taste
1/2 to 3/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. diced green pepper (optional)
1/2  lb. spaghetti
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can tomato soup
1 to 1 1/2 soup  cans milk
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook spaghetti according to package directions.  In a 4-quart casserole dish, place hamburger, cooked spaghetti, soups, milk and cheese.  Mix well and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: CHICKEN ROTEL
ingredients:
1  chicken, boiled and deboned
1  pkg. egg noodles, cooked and drained
1  small bell pepper, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese, chopped
1 1/2  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Layer egg noodles, chicken and bell pepper in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Combine all other ingredients and pour over top. Top with grated cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: YELLOW SQUASH/SOUR CREAM
ingredients:
2  3/4 small summer squash
salt to taste
3/4  c. butter
2/3  c. finely chopped onion
2  tsp. vinegar
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh dill weed
1  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. paprika
preparation: Wash squash. Cut in quarters, lengthwise.  Scoop out seeds. Cut in strips. Sprinkle with salt.  Let stand 1 hour. Drain squash to remove excess moisture. Saute onion until tender. Stir in squash with remaining butter, paprika, pepper, salt, dill and vinegar.  Cook, uncovered, over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until tender. Stir in sour cream. Reheat gently.

name: BAKED SAUERKRAUT AND SPARERIBS WITH DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. spareribs
2  lb. sauerkraut
1  egg, well beaten
2  c. sifted flour
1  c. milk
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Cut spareribs into serving size portions and place in a roaster.  Cover with sauerkraut (which has been rinsed in cold water) and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: TAFFY
ingredients:
2  c. molasses
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. water
4  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. soda
preparation: Cook molasses, sugar and water until it reaches hard ball stage.  Stir as mixture cooks.  Remove from heat and add soda, butter and vanilla.  Stir only enough to mix thoroughly.  Pour into greased pan.  When taffy becomes cool enough to handle, pull until it becomes a light color.   Stretch into long ropes and cut into small pieces.

name: QUICK PEACH PIE
ingredients:
5  peaches, sliced
5  slices white loaf bread, trim crust
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. flour
1  stick margarine, melted
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. almond
preparation: Place sliced peaches in a pie plate and sprinkle a little sugar over them to keep them from turning brown.  Cut each slice of bread into 4 fingers and weave into a lattice crust on top of peaches. Mix sugar, flour, melt butter, egg and flavorings well.  Coat crust with mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Serves 6; 17 grams fat, 394 calories.

name: SPICY CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower
3  or 4 chopped green onions
1/2  box frozen peas, thawed
1/2  c. bacon bits
1  pkg. buttermilk salad dressing mix
1  c. salad dressing
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients in salad bowl, mixing well.  Blend remaining ingredients in another bowl.  Pour over vegetables, tossing to mix.  Chill overnight.  Makes 10 servings.

name: MICROWAVE FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. semi-sweet or peanut butter chips
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Microwave the ingredients for 5 minutes on Medium.  Stir and pour into a greased 8 x 8-inch pan.  Refrigerate overnight.  Cut and enjoy.

name: REFRIGERATOR (RAISIN) BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  box Raisin Bran
5  c. all-purpose flour
3  c. sugar
5  tsp. soda
2  tsp. salt
4  eggs, beaten
1  qt. buttermilk
1  c. shortening, melted
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in large bowl; make a well in center of mixture.  Add eggs, buttermilk and shortening; stir just enough to moisten dry ingredients.  Cover and store in refrigerator until ready to bake.  (Will keep 5 to 6 weeks.)  When ready to bake, spoon batter into greased muffin tins 2/3 full for 20 minutes at 350°.

name: STIR-FRIED BEAN SPROUTS
ingredients:
2/3  lb. bean sprouts
2/3  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Heat wok.  Add 2 tablespoons oil.  Stir-fry bean sprouts over high heat for 2 minutes.  Add salt; stir.  Stir-fry until thoroughly mixed for a minute.

name: PUMPKIN PIE CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs, slightly beaten
1  can pumpkin (16 to 20 oz.)
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 large  can evaporated milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients in the order listed.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch ungreased  pan.  Sprinkle  1  box of yellow cake mix over batter.  Drizzle  1  cup  melted margarine and 1 cup nuts over cake mix.  Bake  in 350° oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  When done, knife will come out clean.

name: TUNA PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can tuna
16  oz. seashell pasta
1  cucumber, sliced and quartered
1  c. mayo (more or less to taste)
1  small onion, diced
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook and drain pasta.  Toss pasta and tuna together.  Mix in mayo, cucumber and onion.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Onion salt can be substituted for onion and salt.

name: ICE CREAM CONE CAKES
ingredients:
ice cream cones (cake cones)
cake mix
frosting mix
cake decorations
muffin pan
preparation: Prepare  the  cake  mix according to directions.  Spoon the batter into  the cones until they are 2/3 full.  Place the cones in  the  muffin  pan  and  bake according to the package directions.  When the cakes are cool, frost and decorate them.

name: OVEN-BAKED BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can potatoes, drained
1 1/2  lb. beef for stew or boneless chuck, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
1  medium-size onion, sliced
1  tsp. vegetable oil
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can mushroom gravy
1/2  pkg. (1 envelope) onion soup mix
1/3  c. water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas
preparation: Slice potatoes.  Place half in a large baking dish.  Brown meat, a few pieces at a time, with onion in oil in a large skillet.  Remove meat and onions as they brown to baking dish. Top with remaining sliced potatoes.

name: VEAL SCALOPPINE(Scaloppine di Vitello)
ingredients:
1  lb. veal cutlets, cut very thin (scallopini style)
1/3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. butter
1/4  lb. mushrooms, sliced thin
3  Tbsp. Marsala or any white wine
1/2  c. chicken broth
lemon wedges
preparation: Pound veal between  2  pieces  of  wax paper until very thin. Mix flour, salt  and pepper; coat veal.  Melt butter in frying pan and brown  veal lightly on both sides.  Remove veal and set aside. Add  mushrooms  and  saute  for a few minutes. Add wine and cook over high heat for 2 minutes, scraping pan. Add chicken broth and bring to a boil.  Return veal to pan and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Place veal in platter and pour sauce over top.  Serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.  Garnish with lemon wedges and parsley sprigs, if desired.

name: SALADE NICOISE
ingredients:
8  new potatoes, well scrubbed (about 1 lb.)
2  lb. green beans, cooked
10  very ripe Italian plum tomatoes, washed and quartered
1  small purple onion, peeled and thinly sliced
1/2  c. Nicoise olives
1/4  c. chopped Italian parsley
pinch of salt
1  tsp. freshly ground black pepper
3/4  c. Our Favorite Vinaigrette
6  hard-cooked eggs, shelled and quartered
12  oz. canned oil packed white tuna, well drained
2  oz. anchovy fillets (optional)
preparation: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender, but not mushy, about 10 minutes.  When cool enough to handle, quarter the potatoes and transfer them to a large bowl.  Add green beans, tomatoes, onion, olives, parsley, a pinch of salt and the pepper. Pour 1/2 cup of the Vinaigrette over vegetables and toss gently but well.

name: CARAMEL BROWNIES
ingredients:
40 caramels or 10  oz. bag
evaporated milk 1/3 c. and 1/2 c.
German chocolate cake mix
