1  bag chocolate chips (12 oz.)
1  c. nuts
3/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Melt caramels and 1/3 cup evaporated milk in double boiler; set aside.  Mix cake mix, butter, 1/2 cup evaporated milk and nuts.  Put half of mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Remove and add chocolate chips and then caramel mixture.  Crumble on remaining batter and bake for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
4  pkg. Kool-Aid
1  gal. pkg. Wyler's lemonade mix
4 (46 oz.)  cans pineapple juice
2 (12 oz.)  cans frozen orange concentrate
1 1/2  gal. water
sugar to taste
preparation: Mix in large bowl.  Chill and serve.  Makes 100 (4 ounce) servings.

name: EGG AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/3  c. flour
1  tsp salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. milk
2  c. shredded american cheese
2  tbsp. diced pimento
5  hard cooked eggs
scalloped crackers
preparation: Melt butter over low heat.  Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Remove from heat and gradually stir in milk.  Return to heat and cook, stirring constantly until thick and smooth.  Add cheese, stirring until melted.  Add pimento and eggs.  Turn into a greased 1 1/2 qt. baking dish and top with scalloped crackers.  Bake at 350° 20-25 minutes.  Makes 6 servings

name: SPINACH MARIA
ingredients:
2  pkg. spinach
1  medium onion
1  Tbsp. butter
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2 to 3/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
3/4 to 1  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook spinach according to package. Drain. Saut onion in butter and add cream cheese and Parmesan cheese. Cook until cream cheese is melted. Add cayenne pepper. Mix in spinach. Put in baking dish. Cook 30 minutes at 350°.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
2  pkg. broccoli
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1/8  tsp. curry powder
1/4  c. shredded cheese
1/4  c. buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Pound chicken breasts to tenderize.  Brown.  Put in casserole dish.  Spread broccoli on top.  Mix all other ingredients, except crumbs, and pour over chicken and broccoli.  Sprinkle with bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: FRANCES' PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped pecans
3  eggs, well beaten
1  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. melted butter
1  frozen pie crust (not deep dish)
preparation: Mix together dry ingredients.  Add all other ingredients, adding pecans last.  Pour mixture into pie crust.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then turn oven temperature down to 350° and bake for 30 to 40 minutes more or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

name: CHICKEN CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter
1/3  c. flour
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/2  tsp. celery salt
2  c. milk
2  c. cooked chicken, cut up
1  can cream-style corn
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Melt butter over low heat.  Stir in flour, salt, pepper and celery salt.  Cook until smooth and bubbly.  Remove from heat.  Add milk and boil 1 minute.  Combine sauce, chicken and corn.  Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Top with crumbs.  Dot with butter. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, until browned on top.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sifted self-rising flour
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. lukewarm buttermilk
1/4  tsp. soda
1  pkg. or cake yeast
1/3  c. shortening
preparation: Sift flour and sugar.  Dissolve yeast in buttermilk.  Cut shortening into flour mixture, then stir in buttermilk quickly. Knead until smooth and roll very thin.  Cut and place one on top of another.  Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: SWEET POTATO BISCUITS
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. vegetable shortening
4  c. mashed sweet potatoes
2  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
4  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.  Add sugar and the shortening and sweet potatoes while hot.  Combine potato mixture.  Knead for 1 minute.  Roll or pat to 3/4-inch thickness. Cut and bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE COOKIES 2
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake mix
1  cup coconut
1  cup pecans
2  eggs
1/2  cup oil
2  tablespoons water
preparation: Mix all ingredients. Place in greased 15 x 10 inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350°. Cool and cut into bars.

name: KRISPY LUNCH SLICES
ingredients:
25-30 cucumbers, sliced
8  large white onions, sliced
2  large sweet peppers, sliced
1/2  c. pickling salt
5  c. cider vinegar
5  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
2  tsp. turmeric
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Combine cucumbers, onions, peppers and pickling salt.  Let stand 3 plus hours, then drain.  Combine sugar, mustard seed, turmeric and cloves.  Bring to a boil.  Add to first mixture. Heat thoroughly.  Do Not Boil!  Place in jars and seal. SWEET PICKLES FROM DILLS

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
2  lb. boneless chicken thighs
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
1  c. cream of celery soup
8  oz. fresh mushrooms
1  onion, diced
black pepper to taste
2  lb. Velveeta cheese
16  oz. spaghetti
preparation: Boil chicken until done. Cool and shred. Set aside chicken and the broth. Sauté mushrooms and onions in butter. Combine mushroom and celery soup in big pot. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes, then add mushrooms and onions. Add Velveeta cheese until melted. Boil chicken broth and cook spaghetti until done. Drain and add spaghetti and chicken to your mixture. Mix well and serve.

name: APPLE-WALNUT SALAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
3  red apples
1  c. diced celery
1/3  c. chopped walnuts
salad greens
sliced oranges and grapes
preparation: Combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, sugar and salt.  Peel and dice apples (leave skin on half an apple to add color).  Stir into mayonnaise.  Add celery and walnuts. Serve on salad greens and garnish with sliced oranges and grapes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: MARINATED LAMB KABOBS
ingredients:
1  onion, chopped
1/4  c. olive oil
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  bay leaf
1/4  tsp. thyme
salt and pepper
preparation: In bowl, combine all marinade ingredients.  Add lamb cubes and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours.  Stir from time to time.

name: GOLDEN RICE SALAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. salad oil
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
4 1/2  c. hot cooked rice, cooked in chicken broth
1  c. ripe olives, cut in large pieces
2  hard-cooked eggs, diced
1 1/2  c. celery, diced
1/4  c. dill pickles, chopped
1  small onion, minced
1/2  c. margarine
preparation: Blend together salad oil, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper. Pour over hot rice; toss and set aside to cool.  Add remaining ingredients and toss.  Chill thoroughly.  Serve on lettuce leaf and garnish with extra sliced eggs.  Makes 8 one cup servings.

name: CHILI CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can chili (without beans)
Tabasco to taste
preparation: Soften cream cheese in microwave.  Add chili and Tabasco. Heat 2 minutes on High.  Top with Cheddar cheese.  Heat 1 minute. Serve with chips (Tostitos)

name: PORK BARBECUE
ingredients:
3  lb. Boston butt
1  small onion
1/2  c. vinegar
4  Tbsp. hickory smoke
4  Tbsp. red crushed pepper
1 small  jar mustard
1 large  bottle barbecue sauce
4  Tbsp. oregano
4  Tbsp. cayenne pepper
4  Tbsp. garlic powder
preparation: In a large pot, cut up Boston butt; put in onion, vinegar, hickory smoke, oregano, cayenne pepper, red crushed pepper and garlic powder.  Cover the Boston butt with water.  Cook until tender.  Drain the Boston butt and save.  To this, add mustard and barbecue sauce and pour back over your Boston butt.

name: DATE NUT BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. firmly packed light brown sugar
1  egg
1 1/3  c. milk
1/4  c. shortening, melted
1/2  c. nuts
1  c. chopped dates
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder and salt together.  Add brown sugar. Combine egg and milk; add milk mixture and shortening to flour. Mix enough to dampen flour.  Fold in nuts and dates.  Pour into 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan.  Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 1 hour and 5 minutes.  Cool.

name: SOUTHERN GRITS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. breakfast sausage
1  c. or more Velveeta
1  c. grits
5 1/2  c. water
preparation: Fry sausage and crumble.  Drain and set aside.  Cut Velveeta into small chunks.  Slowly stir grits into briskly boiling water. When mixture thickens, stir in sausage and cheese.  Stir until cheese melts.  Serve at once.  Good as supper dish with vegetable, salad and bread.  Serves 4.

name: TEXAS TUMBLEWEEDS
ingredients:
1  lb. almond bark
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. peanut butter chips
1 (12.5 oz.)  can peanuts
2 (1 5/8 oz. each)  cans potato sticks
preparation: Combine almond bark and peanut butter chips in a 2-quart microwave dish.  Microwave at 50% power 4 minutes or until melted. Stir in peanuts and potato sticks.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax-lined cookie sheets.  Chill until set.  Makes about 4 dozen.

name: CRISP CRUSTED BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  frying chicken (3 to 3 1/4 lb.), cut up or 6 to 8 chicken breasts
1  egg
2  Tbsp. milk
1  c. instant potato flakes
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. butter or margarine
celery leaves and thinly sliced celery for garnish
preparation: Wash chicken and pat dry, then set aside.  Beat egg and milk in bowl.  In another bowl mix potato flakes, garlic powder and Parmesan cheese.  Roll chicken first in egg mix, then in the potato flake mixture.  Melt butter in shallow baking pan.  Roll coated chicken in the butter and place skin side up in pan.  Bake at 400° for 45 to 50 minutes or until done.  Transfer to serving platter and garnish with celery leaves and slices.

name: NO BAKE CHOCOLATE OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. peanut butter
2  c. uncooked Minute oats
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients.  Boil 3 minutes.  Remove from stove.  Add peanut butter and oats.  Stir until well mixed.   Drop onto waxed paper.  Let cool.

name: HONEY-WHOLE WHEAT BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. wheat flour
1/3  c. honey
1/4  c. shortening
1  tsp. salt
2  pkg. active dry yeast
2 1/2  c. very warm water
3 to 4  c. flour
preparation: Mix wheat flour, honey, shortening, salt and yeast together with mixer; add warm water.  Mix 1 minute on low speed, then 1 minute on medium speed.  Stir in flour, 1 cup  at a time, until dough can be handled.  Knead dough 10 minutes on flour.  Put in greased bowl.  Cover 1 hour.  Punch down, divide in half, rise 5 minutes and flatten to form rectangle.  Place in greased pans. Brush with butter.   Sprinkle with oats.  Let rise.  Bake at 375° for about 40 minutes.

name: FORGOTTEN CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1  c. raw rice, mixed with 1/2 pkg. dry onion soup
1  can mushrooms (optional)
1  chicken
salt and pepper
1  can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
2 1/2  cans water
preparation: Put rice mixed with onion soup and mushrooms in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cut up chicken; salt and pepper the pieces and place on top of rice mixture.  Mix cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup with 2 1/2 cans water.  Pour over chicken on rice.  Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

name: HARVEST CHUTNEY
ingredients:
2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  c. cider vinegar
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. each:  mustard seed and whole black peppercorns
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
2  lb. each:  tomatoes and tart green apples, peeled, cored and diced
3  medium zucchini, diced
2  medium onioins, thinly sliced
1  c. raisins
1/3  c. coarsely chopped candied ginger
preparation: In a 5-quart kettle or Dutch oven, combine sugar, vinegar, salt, ground ginger, mustard seed, peppercorns and cayenne.  Bring to boiling.  Mix in tomatoes, apples, zucchini and onions.  Boil gently, uncovered, stirring frequently until almost thickened, about 1 hour.  Add raisins and candied ginger.  Continue cooking, boiling gently uncovered, stirring often until thickened, 10 to 15 minutes.  Fill hot clean canning jars to within 1/4-inch of rims with boiling hot chutney.  Run a spatula down edges between chutney and jars to release air bubbles.  Wipe rims and place scalded lids on top.  Screw on bands.  Place jars on a rack in a canning kettle half full of hot water to cover jars by 1-inch.  Bring to a gentle boil and process 5 minutes.  Remove from water and cool thoroughly.

name: WHITE BEANS
ingredients:
4 to 5  cans white beans
1  can evaporated milk
1  medium onion
1/4 to 1/2  c. sugar
3 heaping  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix all together.  Spray oven bowl with nonstick spray.  Pour in bowl and cook at 350° for about 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. (20 oz.) mixed frozen vegetables
1  c. cream of chicken soup
about 2 or 3 small potatoes, diced
small amount onion, chopped fine
4  or 5 chicken breasts
preparation: Cook chicken.  Save broth.  Boil vegetables in water until tender.  Cut up chicken in casserole, drain vegetables and pour over chicken. Pour cream of chicken soup over vegetables.  Pour chicken broth on it.  Salt and pepper and stir.  Make biscuit dough.  Roll and cut in thin strips, put on top.  Bake at 450° until golden brown.

name: EASY GRANOLA MIX
ingredients:
5  c. quick-cooking rolled oats
1 1/2  c. wheat germs
1  c. shredded coconut
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. maple syrup
1/2  butter, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. raisins and/or chopped walnuts
preparation: Mix oats, wheat germ, coconut, brown sugar and cinnamon in a large bowl. Add maple syrup and mix well. Stir together melted butter and vanilla and mix in the mixture. Turn into a large shallow pan. Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring after 10 minutes. Cool. Add raisins and/or nuts. Store in airtight container.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. butter
2  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
2 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Cream sugar and butter together.  Drop in whole eggs and mix. Sift together the salt, flour, cream of tartar and baking soda. Add first mixture and beat until smooth.  Make a small ball.  Put in sugar-cinnamon mixture and bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: BATTER FOR FRIED SHRIMP OR ONION RINGS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. water
2  Tbsp. oil
1  egg white, beaten
preparation: Sift dry  ingredients;	add  water  and oil; beat until smooth.  Fold in egg  white  just before frying.  Coat fantail shrimp or onion rings and fry in deep fat until brown.

name: BLUEFISH CAKES
ingredients:
1  lb. or 2 c. cooked bluefish
2  slices white bread, crusts removed and bread crumbled
1  egg
1 1/2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. spicy mustard
1  Tbsp. fresh chopped parsley
dash of Old Bay seasoning (seafood seasoning)
oil for frying
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl (except oil). Form mixture into cakes.  Fry or saute fish cakes in hot oil until golden brown.

name: CHICKEN STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1/2  c. Miracle Whip dressing, divided
4  chicken breasts (about 2 lb.), cut into strips
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. garlic powder
3  c. fresh cut-up vegetables (or frozen)
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Heat 2 tablespoons dressing in large skillet on medium-high heat.  Add chicken and garlic powder.  Stir-fry 3 minutes.  Add vegetables; stir-fry 3 minutes until chicken is cooked through. Reduce heat to medium.  Stir in remaining dressing and soy sauce; simmer 1 minute.  Serve over hot cooked rice.  Makes 4 servings.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can shrimp soup
1  can baby shrimp
1  tsp. lemon juice
dash of paprika
dash of garlic powder
preparation: Soften cream cheese.  Whip to soften.  Wash shrimp in cold water.  Mix well and refrigerate 4 to 6 hours.

name: TOMATOES BLUE
ingredients:
6 (1-inch)  slices large, ripe tomato
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  oz. Blue cheese
1  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. dried parsley
dry breadcrumbs
preparation: Place tomato slices on a baking sheet.  In a small bowl, combine butter, Blue cheese, Parmesan cheese and parsley with a fork until well blended.  Add enough crumbs to make a crumbly dough.  Divide evenly among tomato slices and press to form a "crust" on each.  Broil until topping is brown and bubbly and tomatoes are heated through.  Serves 6.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  bunches broccoli, chopped
1/2  c. sunflower seeds
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1  c. mayo
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  lb. bacon, fried and crumbled
preparation: Mix together mayo, sugar and vinegar. Stir into remaining ingredients until coated. Chill.

name: COMMUNION BREAD
ingredients:
5  lb. flour minus 1 pt.
1  lb. butter
2  tsp. salt
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  c. half and half
1  pt. milk
preparation: Cut butter into flour and salt mixed together.  Add whipping cream, half and half and milk.  Divide dough into thirds.  Knead for 15 to 20 minutes.  Divide each third of dough in half.  Roll out on cookie sheet.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes in 375° oven until lightly brown, just on edges.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1  small onion, sliced and separated into rings (about 1/4 c.)
1  can (10 3/4 oz.) Campbell's condensed broccoli cheese soup
1/3  c. milk
1/8  tsp. pepper
4  medium potatoes (about 1 1/4 lb.), cooked and sliced (about 3 1/2 c.)
3  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled (optional)
snipped fresh parsley (optional)
fresh parsley sprig for garnish
preparation: In  10-inch skillet over medium heat, in hot margarine, cook onion  until tender, stirring often.  Stir in soup, milk and pepper.  Add  potatoes;  stir  gently  to  coat.  Heat to boiling. Reduce  heat to low.  Cover; cook 5 minutes or until hot  and bubbling, stirring occasionally.  Sprinkle with bacon and snipped parsley.  Garnish with parsley sprig, if desired.

name: MIMI'S FUDGE
ingredients:
1  c. milk
2  c. sugar
4  oz. unsweetened Baker's chocolate
1/2  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In a saucepan, melt together the milk, sugar and chocolate and bring to a boil, stirring gently.  Let the mixture boil over medium heat until the foam subsides, about 15 minutes.   Drop a small amount into a cup of ice-cold water.  If you can form it into a ball, the mixture is ready for the next step.  Beat in the butter until the mixture thickens and loses its sheen.  Beat in the vanilla.  Pour into 8 x 8-inch buttered pan and chill.

name: IMPOSSIBLE VEGETABLE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. chopped frozen broccoli (10 oz.)
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese (4 oz.)
1 1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. Bisquick
3  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Lightly grease a pie plate (10 x 1 1/2-inch).  Heat 1-inch salted water (1/2 teaspoon salt to 1 cup water) to boiling.  Add broccoli; cover and heat to boiling.  Cook until almost tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain thoroughly.  Mix broccoli, onion, green pepper and cheese into pie plate.  Beat remaining ingredients until smooth (15 seconds in blender on high, or 1 minute with hand beater).  Pour into pie plate.  Bake until golden brown and knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

name: MEXICAN HAMBURGERS
ingredients:
1  lb. pork, cubed
1 small  can chopped green chilies
tomatoes (fresh)
2  Tbsp. oil
1  small jalapeno pepper, chopped
lettuce, shredded
salt to taste
dash of garlic
2  lb. hamburger meat
flour or corn tortillas
2  Tbsp. flour
1  can tomatoes (undrained)
grated cheese
preparation: Brown pork in oil until done.  Add garlic, flours, chopped chilies, jalapeno pepper and canned tomatoes.  Simmer until flavors blend.  Brown hamburger, seasoned with salt, in separate skillet until done.  Serve on flour or corn tortilla with layer of burger meat, layer of pork mixture, lettuce, fresh tomatoes and topped with cheese.  Nacho chips may be substituted.

name: ITALIAN PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. pasta shells
1  can medium pitted black olives
2  raw tomatoes
16  oz. cooked ham
16  oz. bottle Italian dressing
preparation: Cook pasta; rinse and set aside in large serving bowl.  Dice tomatoes and chop ham.  Add Italian dressing to pasta and stir well.  Add tomatoes, ham and black olives.  Stir well.  Chill and serve with favorite meat.

name: HAM, CABBAGE AND NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  large onion, sliced
garlic
1/2  red pepper, cubed
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
cabbage, cut in 1-inch cubes
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
6  oz. noodles
12  oz. ham, cut in 1/2-inch cubes
preparation: Heat oil in skillet.  Add onion, garlic and red pepper.  Cook until soft.  Sprinkle with sugar; cook 5 minutes, then sprinkle with vinegar.  Add cabbage, salt and pepper.  Reduce to medium heat and cook, covered, for 20 minutes, or until cabbage is tender.  Cook noodles; drain and add to cabbage mixture, along with ham.  Stir over heat until noodles are golden and ham is heated through.  Mm, mm good!!

name: MAKE AHEAD FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, melted
1  loaf Pepperidge Farm or Arnold bread
5  eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
1  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix together eggs, milk, brown sugar and cinnamon.  Using a 13 x 9-inch pan, put some melted margarine in bottom of pan. Sprinkle a bit of the cinnamon and brown sugar mixture, then lay down six slices of bread (dunk in egg and milk mixture) and repeat the layers.  Do three layers of bread, six slices each.  Prepare the night before.  Cook, uncovered, at 350° for one hour.

name: PEANUT KRISPIES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2  c. peanut butter
1 (16 oz.)  box powdered sugar
3 1/2  c. Rice Krispies
3/4  c. chopped peanuts
preparation: Melt margarine in a large saucepan. Add peanut butter and mix well. Add powdered sugar, Rice Krispies and peanuts. Mix. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.

name: HOT CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. chicken, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can green peas, drained (small can)
1  tsp. lemon juice
3  hard-cooked eggs, diced
1/4  c. saltine cracker crumbs (5 saltines)
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  can fried onion rings
2  Tbsp. onion, minced
preparation: Mix all the ingredients except fried onion rings.  Spoon into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 375°. Top with onion rings and return to oven until onions are golden brown.

name: HONEY BUN CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
3/4  c. oil
1/2  c. melted margarine
4  eggs
8  oz. sour cream
1/2  c. raisins
1/3  c. brown sugar
3  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Put cake mix, oil, margarine, eggs and sour cream in a mixing bowl.  Heat 2 minutes at high speed.  Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch pan.  Pour half of mixture in pan.  Mix raisins, brown sugar and cinnamon together.  Sprinkle over batter in pan.  Add rest of batter.  Bake at 275° for 1 hour or until done.

name: EASY TUNA DISH
ingredients:
1 small  can tuna, drained
1  pkg. macaroni and cheese
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 small  can mushrooms, drained
1  can cream of celery soup
preparation: Cook macaroni and cheese as directed adding a little extra milk.  Saute onions, green pepper in 2 to 3 tablespoons butter and add to macaroni.  Also add tuna, soup and mushrooms.  Cook until hot.  May be cooked in microwave.

name: SPICY PECANS
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. cayenne
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
Tabasco (a good dash)
1  lb. shelled pecan halves
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Melt butter in a large saucepan; remove from heat.  Add seasonings and mix well.  Gently toss in nuts. Place seasoned nuts in a single layer in a jelly roll pan.  Bake at 300° for 25 to 30 minutes, turning frequently, until browned and crisp.  Store, tightly sealed, in the refrigerator.

name: FUDGE BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  sq. baking chocolate
1  stick margarine
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
dash of salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt chocolate and margarine in saucepan. Cool.  Beat eggs and sugar until pale yellow. Add the cooled chocolate; stir well. Add flour and salt; blend until smooth.  Stir in vanilla.  Pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan, greased and floured on the bottom only. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Do not overbake.

name: WATER CHESTNUT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. sliced celery
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  tube Ritz crackers
1  can water chestnuts
1  stick butter
preparation: Slice celery and place in baking dish.  Add soups and stir. Dice or slice water chestnuts.  Add to mixture.  Bake until boiling.  In a saucepan melt butter.  Crumble tube of crackers and place in pan with butter.  Place cracker mixture over celery mixture and bake on low heat for 5 minutes.  Top with sliced almonds, if desired.

name: THIMBLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
1/2  c. butter
1/4  c. sugar
1  egg, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
nuts, finely chopped
jelly or jam (raspberry jam is good)
preparation: Cream butter and  sugar  until  smooth.  Add beaten egg yolk, flavoring and flour.  Shape into small balls the size of a small walnut.  Dip  in egg white and then into nuts.  Place on greased cookie sheet.  Make a dent in dough with a thimble or something similar.  Bake  in 350° oven for 5 minutes, take out  and  dent again.  Bake  approximately  12  minutes more. Remove from oven and fill dent with jam while hot.

name: GOURMET OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine or butter
1  c. packed brown sugar
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
3  Tbsp. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. 3 minute brand old fashion oatmeal
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
2  c. butterscotch chips
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add eggs, milk and vanilla; mix well.  Combine oats, flour, baking soda, baking powder and 1 teaspoon salt, if desired, in separate bowl.  Add to margarine mixture; mix well.  Stir in chips and pecans.  Chill dough 1 hour.  Drop by rounded teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake for 10 to 12 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes before removing to racks to cool.  Makes 5 dozen.

name: BEER BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. self-rising flour
3  Tbsp. sugar
1 (12 oz.)  can cold beer
1/2  c. melted butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix flour, sugar and beer well.  Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan or casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Pour butter over top and cook 10 minutes more or until brown.  Best when eaten warm.

name: 7 GRAIN GLUTEN STEAKS
ingredients:
1  c. 7 grains
2  c. gluten flour
2  Tbsp. brewer's yeast flakes
1  tsp. garlic powder
2  tsp. onion powder
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Soak grains with water at 1 cup level line (1/2 cup more water) overnight (equals 2 batches).  Blend until fine in blender all except flour.  Mix in the flour in a bowl.  May be made into 2 rolls and wrapped in Saran Wrap and frozen.  Slice 1/4-inch thick and boil in broth 45 minutes.

name: CHRISTMAS BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans green beans, drained
6  strips bacon
1  can mushrooms
1  medium onion, thinly sliced
pimento
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. slivered almonds
preparation: Cook green beans; drain. Fry bacon until crisp. Drain mushrooms, reserving liquid.  Cook mushrooms and onion in margarine for 1 minute.  Stir in flour and salt.  Add mushroom liquid and sour cream.

name: GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
2  cans French-style green beans
3  slices bacon, cut up
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
preparation: Brown bacon, add onion and simmer until tender.  Drain 1 can of beans, add to bacon and onion.  Then add second can with most of the liquid.  Add mushroom soup and simmer until hot.

name: PINEAPPLE-ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
3  eggs, beaten
2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained
2  c. shredded zucchini
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1  c. raisins
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Beat together sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla.  Stir in the pineapple, zucchini, walnuts and raisins.  In a separate bowl, combine the flour, baking soda, baking powder and cinnamon.  Add to zucchini mixture. Mix just until well blended.  Pour into 2 greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pans.   Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHINESE SPONGE CAKE(Gai Don Go)
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Swans Down cake flour, sifted
9  eggs, separated, put yolks in bowl and set aside
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla (banana)
preparation: Beat egg whites until slightly foamy, then add 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar.  Beat again to stiff foam.  Sift together flour, baking powder and sugar, then add to egg yolks.  Then add water, oil and vanilla and beat until creamy.  Pour over egg whites gently; fold until well blended.  Bake at 350°, in 9 x 13-inch pan approximately 20 minutes and in tube pan 35 to 40 minutes.  Invert tube pan upside down to cool.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
10  oz. frozen, chopped spinach, cooked and drained
1  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
16  oz. sour cream
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup
2  stalks green onions, chopped
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  round loaves rye or pumpernickel bread
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients.  Hollow out 1 loaf of bread and place dip in center.  Use bread for dipping.

name: DANISH PASTRY PUFFS
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, divided
2  c. flour, divided
2  Tbsp. ice water
1  c. water
1  tsp. almond extract
3  eggs
frosting (recipe follows)
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cut  1/2  cup  butter  into  1  cup  flour with a pastry blender   until  mixture  resembles  coarse  meal.  Sprinkle  2 tablespoons  ice  water,  1  tablespoon  at a time, evenly over surface.  Stir with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened. Divide dough  in  half  and  pat  each  half into a 12 x 2 inch rectangle  on  a  lightly greased baking sheet.  Set the pastry aside.  Place  remaining  1/2  cup  butter and 1 cup water in a saucepan;  bring  to  a  boil.  Stir in almond extract.  Reduce heat  to low and add remaining 1 cup flour, stirring vigorously until  mixture  leaves  sides  of  pan and forms a smooth ball. Remove from  heat and allow to cool slightly.  Add eggs, 1 at a time,  beating  with  a  wooden spoon after each addition; beat until  batter is smooth.  Spread evenly over pastry rectangles; bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until golden.  Spread with frosting; sprinkle with chopped pecans.  Yields 12 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP POUND CAKE
ingredients:
4 to 6  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. (1 stick) butter, softened
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Heat oven to 325°.  Grease and flour loaf pan.  Beat butter, cream cheese and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Stir in vanilla.  Blend in combined flour and baking powder.  Stir in chocolate chips.  Pour batter into prepared pan.  Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until cake pulls away from sides of pan.  Cool 10 minutes; transfer cake to wire rack.  Cool completely.

name: HOLIDAY SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can drained, crushed pineapple
1/2  c. chopped cherries
1  c. small marshmallows
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
preparation: Soften cream cheese, then beat in mayonnaise and sugar.  Fold in pineapple, cherries, marshmallows and Cool Whip.  Put in refrigerator to set.  I normally make a double batch.

name: RHUBARB PIE
ingredients:
rich pastry for 2-crust pie
1 1/2  lb. rhubarb
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. dry strawberry jello
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Have pie crust made and ready. Wash and cut rhubarb into small pieces. Add to pie shell, rounding to 1-inch deep. Combine sugar, flour, salt and jello. Mix well and sprinkle over rhubarb; dot with butter. Add top crust and make a few slits in the top crust with knife for air vents. Bake in preheated 425° oven for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: INDIVIDUAL PINEAPPLE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKES
ingredients:
1  cube butter or margarine
1 1/4  c. brown sugar
1  pineapple or yellow cake mix
preparation: Melt together in skillet until bubbly the first 2 ingredients. Mix cake mix according to package directions.  Cover the bottom of a tuna can with 1 tablespoon of the brown sugar mixture. Place a pineapple slice on top of brown sugar, then place a maraschino cherry in the middle of the pineapple. A few walnuts can be placed around for added taste. Pour 1/2 cup of cake batter on top of pineapple. Bake in 350° oven 15 to 20 minutes; turn upside down on cookie sheet to cool. Makes 12 to 15 cakes.

name: MEXICAN RICE
ingredients:
1  c. dry long cooking rice
1 (10 or 12 oz.)  jar picante sauce (mild)
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. onion powder (or dry chopped onion)
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. chopped dry chives
1  c. water
1  tsp. margarine
preparation: Rinse rice; drain.  In 2-quart boiler, add rice and all ingredients.  Bring to boil; reduce to low heat.  Cover and cook 25 to 30 minutes.  Remove from heat and fluff.  Serve with additional picante sauce if desired.

name: OLD-FASHIONED CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
pastry for single crust pie
4  eggs
2 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  tsp. almond extract
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground nutmeg
preparation: Line pie plate with pastry; flute edges.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, beat eggs in a large bowl.  Add remaining ingredients; mix well.  Pour into crust.  Cover edges with foil. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.  Cool completely.  Store in the refrigerator.

name: HOMESTYLE CHICKEN AND BISCUIT AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
4  medium carrots, sliced
6  to 8 drumsticks or breasts
1 (10 oz.)  can refrigerated buttermilk biscuits
1 (15 to 16 oz.)  pkg. chicken gravy mix
1 1/2  c. water
2  stalks celery, sliced
seasoned salt and pepper
preparation: You will need 1 Reynolds oven cooking bag, large size (14 x 20-inches).

name: CRANBERRY FLUFF
ingredients:
2  c. raw cranberries, ground
3/4  c. sugar
2  c. chopped apple
1/4  tsp. salt
3  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. heavy cream, whipped
preparation: Combine cranberries, marshmallows and sugar;  cover and chill overnight.	Add apples, nuts and salt.  Fold in whipped cream and chill.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: STRAWBERRY-PINEAPPLE JELL-O SALAD
ingredients:
2 - 3  oz. pkgs. strawberry Jell-O  (3 pkg. for a large dish)
1  c. hot water
2 - 10  oz. pkg. frozen strawberries with juice
1 - 8  oz. can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. pecans
2 - 8  oz. sour cream
preparation: Mix strawberry Jell-O, hot water, frozen strawberries with strawberry juice and crushed pineapple.   Set aside to cool for a short time.

name: VEGETABLE BEEF SOUP
ingredients:
5  qt. water
4  to 5 ribs celery
2  large carrots, peeled and diced
1 (16 oz.)  can creamed corn
1  tsp. pepper
1  c. rice (uncooked)
1  lb. soup meat
2  medium onions, sliced
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, mashed
1  can tomato soup
4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. celery salt
preparation: Simmer soup meat in water for 2 hours.  Add all, except rice. Simmer 1 hour; add rice.  Cook 30 minutes longer.

name: RAE'S PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. syrup
1/2  c. water
2  tsp. soda
2  c. raw peanuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients together (except soda).  Cook until peanuts turn a little brown or until syrup forms a soft ball in ice water.  Beat mixture, adding soda 1 teaspoon at a time.  Pour onto buttered cookie sheet.  Break up when cool.  Raw peanuts may be purchased at grocery.

name: CHICKEN AND NOODLES
ingredients:
6  medium chicken breasts or 1 large fryer, cut up
1  can cream of mushroom soup
4  oz. can drained mushrooms
3 to 4  c. cooked noodles
1  c. sour cream, mixed with 1/4 c. flour
paprika
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. water
1/2  tsp. ground thyme
preparation: Sprinkle chicken pieces with  salt, pepper and paprika. Place in crock-pot.  Mix water with  soup and pour over chicken.	Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours  or on high 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

name: PINK FRUIT
ingredients:
1  can fruit cocktail
1  can crushed pineapple
2  bowls  Cool Whip
12  oz. pkg. cottage cheese
1  pkg. cherry jello
preparation: Drain fruits and pineapple, then mix all together. Put into bowl and cover, then refrigerate.

name: PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple
2 round  Tbsp. plain flour
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  lb. grated cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and place in a shallow casserole. Top with three slices of crumbled bread.  Place in oven and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CHINESE "NOT FRIED" RICE
ingredients:
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
2  c. chicken broth
1  Tbsp. dry sherry
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. sesame oil
4  drops hot sauce
1  c. uncooked rice
1/3  c. sliced green onion
1  Tbsp. pine nuts, toasted
preparation: Coat medium saucepan with cooking spray.  Place over medium heat until hot.  Add onions and saute 2 minutes.  Add chicken broth and next 4 ingredients, bring to a boil.  Stir in rice and simmer 25 minutes.  Remove from heat, stir in green onion and pine nuts.

name: VANILLA WAFER CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
2  c. sugar
6  eggs
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. vanilla wafers, crumbled
1/2  c. milk
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each.  Add vanilla wafer crumbs and milk alternately.  Add coconut and pecans.  Bake at 350° in a well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until cake slightly pulls away from sides of pan.

name: TOMATO PUDDING
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  can tomato puree
1/4  c. boiling water
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. fresh bread crumbs
1/2  c. melted butter (6 Tbsp. works just fine)
1/4  tsp. Tabasco
preparation: Mix puree, water, sugar, salt and Tabasco. Boil 5 minutes. Place bread in casserole. Pour butter over it. Let soak in. Pour tomato mixture over bread. Bake 30 minutes at 375°. Can be made several hours ahead. Cook 45 minutes if refrigerated.

name: TACO TWIST SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1  medium onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. ground cumin
3  c. beef broth
1 1/2  c. picante sauce
1 (14 oz.)  can diced tomatoes (in juice)
1  c. uncooked rotini (twisted pasta)
1  small green pepper, chopped
shredded cheese
tortilla chips
preparation: In a large pot, brown meat with onion and garlic. Drain. Sprinkle chili powder and cumin over meat.  Cook and stir 30 seconds. Add other ingredients except cheese and chips.  Bring to a boil, stirring often. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 15 minutes or until pasta is done.  Place in bowls and top with cheese and chips.

name: SEVEN LAYER DINNER
ingredients:
1  c. rice
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. tomatoes
1/3  c. ketchup
1/2  c. chopped bell peppers
1/3  c. chopped onions
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Place in casserole dish as listed.  Salt and pepper to taste as you add layers. Cook, uncovered, at 300° for 2 hours.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cherry Jell-O
1  c. hot water
1  can whole cranberry sauce
1/2  c. diced celery
1/4  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Put Jell-O in hot water; stir until dissolved.  Add cranberry sauce.  Chill until it starts to jell, then add celery and nuts.

name: SASSY ZUCCHINI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onions
2  c. tomatoes (either fresh or canned), sliced
3/4  c. water
1  envelope spaghetti mix
1  tsp. salt
1  c. rice (uncooked)
4  c. zucchini, sliced
preparation: Brown ground beef and onions; drain off excess fat.  In large Dutch oven, add browned beef, onions and all other ingredients together.  Mix well.  Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until rice is done and vegetables are soft.  If too soupy, add 3 teaspoons flour.

name: STRAWBERRY SHORTCAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  c. shortening
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. milk
1  qt. strawberries, washed and drained
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, stir together with  a fork, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.  With a pastry blender, cut in margarine and shortening until the mixture looks like small peas. In a small bowl, whip with a fork the beaten egg and milk.  Pour the mixture from the small bowl into the large bowl and lightly stir with a fork.  Lightly flour the counter and pour mixture out on the counter and knead about 12 times.  With a light amount of shortening (if needed), roll dough to 1/2-inch thickness. Carefully cut 9 biscuits as close together as possible and bake at 425° on an ungreased cookie sheet for 10 minutes.  Slice strawberries on a cutting board and put in bowl with about 2 tablespoons sugar, or to your taste.  Split open biscuits and put strawberries inside and on top.  Top with whipped cream or ice cream.

name: APPLE PUDDING
ingredients:
6  apples, peeled and sliced
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. water
nutmeg
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Place apples in buttered baking dish.  Add water and sprinkle with nutmeg.  Cover with crumb mixture made by creaming together cracker crumbs, butter and brown sugar.  Bake until done.

name: TRINITY BREAD(Original Recipe)
ingredients:
2  pkg. yeast
1  c. warm water
1  c. warm canned milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/3  c. honey
1/2  c. oil
1  egg
2  tsp. salt
2  c. whole wheat flour
1  c. medium rye flour
3  c. white flour
preparation: Put yeast, water and milk into a large bowl.  Add sugar and let stand for 10 minutes.  Add honey, oil, egg and salt.  Then add flours.  Mix and let rise until double.  Punch down.  Knead and form into desired shape.  Let rise again.  Bake at 350° about 30 minutes or until done.  Makes 2 loaves.

name: SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped spinach
1  pkg. dried onion soup mix
1  c. herb seasoned stuffing mix
2  c. sour cream
3  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Cook spinach as package directs.  Drain.  Add soup mix and sour cream.  Put in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Top with stuffing mix and dribble with butter.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
chicken pieces
1  can cream of chicken soup
2 1/2  tsp. onion flakes
1  Tbsp. parsley
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. thyme
1 1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. Minute rice
preparation: Saute chicken pieces in butter until golden.  Remove from heat.  Combine in same skillet soup, onion flakes, parsley, salt, thyme and water.  Bring to boil.  Pour rice into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.  Pour all but 1/2 of soup mixture over rice.  Top with chicken, then remaining soup mixture.  Cover and bake 30 minutes.

name: CHEDDAR HERB BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
4  oz. Cheddar cheese, shredded (about 1 c.)
2  Tbsp. finely chopped fresh parsley
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground black pepper
1/4  c. butter or margarine
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  In bowl, combine flour, cheese, parsley, baking powder, salt and pepper.  With pastry blender or knife, cut in butter until mixture forms coarse crumbs.  Stir in milk.  Quickly mix until mixture forms soft ball.  Transfer dough to lightly floured surface.  Knead slightly to combine thoroughly. Roll or pat dough to 1/2-inch thick.  Cut biscuits and place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until golden. Makes 1 1/2 dozen biscuits.

name: METHODIST MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. green pepper (optional)
3/4  c. chopped onion
1  pkg. macaroni
2  Tbsp. bacon fat
1  tsp. salt
1  can tomato soup
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Saute or fry onions until brown.  Add celery.  Pour over this 1 can of tomato soup.  Fry meat until done.  Add to onions, celery and soup.  Cook 1 package macaroni.  Mix all together by turning gently.  Over this pour mushroom soup.  Pour into baking dish. Bake 20 minutes at 325°.  Fold in the sour cream and sprinkle with cheese.  Cook until the cheese is melted.  Serves 12 people.

name: QUICK AND EASY SALAD DRESSING CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. cocoa
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1  c. salad dressing
1  c. cold water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Bake at 350° for about 20 to 25 minutes or until toothpick test is good.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening or oil
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
3  very ripe bananas, mashed
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix ingredients in order.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CHEDDAR BEER SOUP
ingredients:
10  oz. frozen mixed vegetables
4  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
2  c. milk
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  c. shredded cheese (medium sharp Cheddar or your favorite)
1  c. beer (preferably English ale, i.e.  Bass Ale)
preparation: Cook vegetables and drain. Melt margarine; stir in flour, salt and mustard. Cook over low heat until smooth. Remove from heat. Add milk and Worcestershire. Heat mixture until it coats the spoon. Add cheese. Cook over medium heat until cheese melts. Stir in beer and vegetables; bring to a simmer. Cook about 15 minutes. Serve with preferred garnishes (croutons, paprika, whatever).

name: SWEETENED CONDENSED MILK
ingredients:
1  c. powdered milk
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. boiling water
3  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Put all ingredients into blender and mix at high speed until smooth. Use this in any recipe that calls for Eagle Brand milk. Makes 14 ounces.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  stick oleo, melted
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
2  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
3  c. cold milk
1 medium  pkg. Cool Whip
1/2  c. pecans
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients together and pat in pan.  Bake 15 minutes at 375° and cool.  Mix next 3 ingredients together and spread for next layer.  Mix the next 2 ingredients and spread for third layer.  Spread the next 2 ingredients for fourth layer. Sprinkle with few more pecans.  Chill several hours or overnight.

name: CHRIS' SALTED NUT SQUARES
ingredients:
3  c. salted peanuts (without skins), divided
3  Tbsp. margarine
2  c. (12 oz.) peanut butter chips
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Place half of the peanuts in an ungreased 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking pan; set aside.  In a saucepan, melt margarine and peanut butter chips over low heat.  Add milk and marshmallows; cook and stir until melted.  Pour over peanuts.  Sprinkle the remaining peanuts on top.  Cover and refrigerate.  Cut into bars.  Yield: 5 to 6 dozen.

name: CUSTARD MOCHI
ingredients:
4  c. mochiko
3  Tbsp. baking powder
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  block soft butter
4  eggs
2  cans coconut milk
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients  together.	Grease	and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pour mixture into pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: TUNA DIP
ingredients:
2 (6 1/8 oz.)  cans tuna packed in spring water, drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1 or 2  tsp. hot Texas Pete sauce or according to taste
preparation: Blend together until well mixed.  Serve with crackers.

name: BROCCOLI RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
4  Tbsp. margarine
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. cubed Velveeta cheese
preparation: Cook broccoli.  Saute onion and celery in margarine.  Combine soup and cheese and add to onion and celery mixture.  Mix well. Pour sauce, broccoli and rice into buttered casserole dish and mix thoroughly.  Bake at 350° until bubbly and light brown.  (Mama always says to eat your veggies!)

name: CRUSTLESS SPINACH QUICHE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
3  eggs
1  c. milk
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed to drain
1  lb. grated sharp Cheddar cheese (or a mixture of Cheddar and Mozzarella)
1/4  c. chopped onion
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan in oven; spread evenly over bottom of pan (and halfway up sides). Beat eggs; add milk, flour, salt and baking powder.  Mix well. Stir in spinach, cheese and onions.  Spoon into buttered baking pan.  Bake for 35 minutes.  Remove from oven and let stand for 45 minutes.  Cut into squares.  (Quiche will be relatively flat and quite firm in texture.)

name: HOT ASPARAGUS CANAPES
ingredients:
20  slices thin white bread
3  oz. Blue cheese
1  egg
20  spears fresh cooked asparagus
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. butter, melted
preparation: Trim crusts and flatten bread with rolling pin.  Blend cheeses and egg.  Spread evenly on bread.  Roll an asparagus spear in each slice.  Fasten with toothpick.  Place on cookie sheet and freeze. When firm, slice each roll into thirds.  When needed, bake at 350° until brown, about 10 minutes.  Makes a lot.  Can be made ahead and stored in freezer until needed.

name: ITALIAN SAUSAGE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. Italian sausage
1  c. chopped onions
2  cloves garlic, sliced
5  c. beef broth
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. dry red wine
2  c. chopped peeled tomatoes
1  c. sliced carrots
1/2  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. oregano
8  oz. tomato sauce
1 1/2  c. sliced zucchini
8  oz. frozen meat or cheese tortellini
3  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  medium green pepper
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Brown sausage and remove from pot.  Saute onions and garlic in 1 tablespoon of sausage drippings.  Add broth through sausage. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes.  Skim the fat from the top of the soup.  Stir in zucchini through the pepper.  Simmer covered for 35 to 40 minutes until the tortellini are tender.  Serve with Parmesan sprinkled on top.

name: DECORATING CAKE ICING
ingredients:
1  c.Crisco
2  lb. powdered sugar
1/2  c. water
food coloring (if desired)
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. almond
preparation: Cream Crisco.  Add powdered sugar and water alternately.  Mix well.  Add flavoring.  Mix well.  Add food coloring, if desired. (Paste food coloring works the best.)  If the humidity is high, you may have to add a little more powdered sugar or icing will be too watery.

name: FRUIT BALLS
ingredients:
1  can Angel Flake coconut
1  lb. dates
2  sticks margarine
2  c. light brown sugar, packed
2  c. chopped nuts
4  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Put brown sugar, margarine, chopped nuts and dates in boiler and cook for about 6 minutes, stirring constantly, until hot. Cool about 15 minutes and then add Rice Krispies and nuts. Roll into balls and drop into confectioners sugar. Makes about 100 small balls.

name: BANANA SLUSH
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
6  c. hot water
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
3 juice  cans water
3/4  c. lemon juice
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
2  liters ginger ale
5  or 6 bananas
preparation: Dissolve sugar in hot water in large covered freezer container.  Cool.  Add orange juice concentrate, water, lemon juice, pineapple juice and bananas; mix well.  Freeze.  Thaw for 2 to 3 hours before serving.  Stir in ginger ale just before serving.  Ladle into cups.

name: LASAGNE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
2  cans tomato paste
4  cans water
1  pkg. American Rose spaghetti sauce mix (any brand will do)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. lasagne noodles
16  oz. small curd cottage cheese
16  oz. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger; add tomato paste, water and spaghetti sauce mix.  Layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan:  noodles, meat mixture, cottage cheese, noodles, meat mixture and Mozzarella.  Repeat; Mozzarella on very top.  Serves 8 persons; 1/2 to 4 persons.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. flour
2  eggs
3  Tbsp. butter
2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  baked pie shell
preparation: Combine sugar, cocoa and flour.  Mix well.  Beat egg yolks, butter, milk and first mixture.  Cook until smooth and creamy. Add vanilla.  Pour into pie shell.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE CANDY
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. light corn syrup
3  tsp. butter
2  tsp. soda
3  c. peanuts
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. water
preparation: Combine sugar, water and syrup.  Boil until it spins a thread. Add peanuts, stirring constantly.  Cook and stir until it turns brownish gold.  Remove from heat.  Add butter, salt and soda. Pour onto buttered board to cool.  As candy cools, work up from board with spatula.  When cool, break into pieces.

name: BEEF CUBES IN WINE
ingredients:
3  lb. beef cubes
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can onion soup
1  c. red wine (Port)
1  can mushrooms
1  tsp. salt (optional)
preparation: Brown beef.  Add other ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 3 hours. Serve with rice or noodles.

name: LOW CHOLESTEROL STUFFING FOR TURKEY
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey
1  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  c. celery, chopped
1 to 1 1/2  c. onions, chopped
1  loaf (1 lb. size) slightly dry bread
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
1  tsp. dried thyme leaves
preparation: Brown ground turkey, celery and onions in olive oil and margarine.  Add rest of ingredients and mix.  Makes enough for 12 pound turkey.  This is a good substitute for those who like a sausage dressing at holiday time.

name: CHINESE PRETZELS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. cornstarch
1  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. evaporated milk, undiluted
1 1/4  c. water
1  egg, beaten
dash of salt
oil for frying
preparation: Heat oil to 385°.  Sift cornstarch with flour, sugar and salt. Combine milk, water and egg.  Stir into dry ingredients; mix until smooth.  Heat rosette iron in fat until hot.  Dip hot iron into batter and return to fat.  Cook until pretzels are delicately browned, turning once.  Drain on absorbent paper.  Makes 6 dozen.

name: RAISIN PIE
ingredients:
2  c. raisins
2  c. water
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Boil raisins in 1 3/4 cups water for 5 minutes.  Combine brown sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon and salt.  Moisten with 1/4 cup water and add to raisins, stirring until mixture boils.  Remove from fire.  Add butter and vinegar.  Pour into pastry lined pie pan and cover crust.  Bake 25 minutes at 425°.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1 small  can cream of mushroom soup
approximately 6 medium size potatoes, cubed, parboiled and drained
1  can corn, peas or green beans (your choice), drained
1  pkg. saltine crackers
cheese for topping (your choice)
1/3  c. melted butter
preparation: Brown ground beef in skillet; drain.  Sprinkle and mix with flour (about 1/4 cup); stir in milk to make gravy.  Cook on medium heat, stirring occasionally, until thick.  Salt and pepper to taste.

name: HAM AND NOODLES IN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. noodles
1 1/2  c. cooked ham, diced
2  beaten eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Cook  noodles in salted boiling water until soft.  Pour into colander; drain and wash.  Into a well-greased casserole, put alternate  layers  of noodles and ham.  Beat eggs with the milk and  pour  over noodles and ham.  Set casserole in pan of hot water and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
6  eggs
2  sticks butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Grease and flour pan.  Mix all ingredients together until well blended.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SPAGHETTI MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  egg
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can spaghetti in tomato sauce with cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients and put in a greased casserole dish. Press down with spoon and bake 1 hour.

name: INSTANT RUSSIAN TEA MIX
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. orange flavored instant breakfast drink (Tang)
1/2  c. sugar
2/3  c. instant tea
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Mix together.  Keep in airtight container.  Use 2 heaping teaspoons per cup of hot water.

name: PINEAPPLE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1 large  can pineapple rings
1 small  jar maraschino cherries
1  box brown sugar
1  stick margarine
1  yellow cake mix
preparation: Slice bananas crosswise.  Make layer of bananas, one of cookies (vanilla wafers) until bowl is full.  Pour over one cooked box of vanilla Jell-O pudding, cooked per directions on box.  Does better on cooked pudding. Instant is just not as good.  Cool and serve.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. sour cream
1  pkg. dry taco mix
shredded lettuce
chopped onion
chopped tomato
shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients with wire whip very well.  Spread on serving dish and place in refrigerator until ready to serve.  Then top with shredded lettuce, chopped onion, chopped tomatoes and shredded Cheddar cheese.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE CAKE MIX COOKIES
ingredients:
1 (18.25 oz.)  pkg. pudding included German chocolate cake mix
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. (1 c.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  c. rolled oats
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. oil
2  eggs, slightly beaten
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In large bowl, combine all ingredients; blend well.  Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until set.  Cool 1 minute; remove from cookie sheets.

name: CHICKEN AND PENNE PASTA WITH KALAMATA OLIVES
ingredients:
about 5 Tbsp. extra virgin olive oil
red pepper flakes
4  to 6 garlic cloves, chopped or sliced
3  or 4 boneless chicken breasts
freshly ground black pepper to taste
grated Romano cheese (optional)
basil leaves
preparation: Cut white meat chicken up into 1-inch pieces.  Pit the kalamata olives and cut each olive into 3 or 4 pieces.  Chop or slice garlic.  Cut the basil leaves into strips.  Begin heating a large pot of salted water to boiling.  When water begins to boil, add pasta.  Don't overcook!  When done, drain pasta and put in a large pasta bowl.  Drizzle liberally with olive oil, then salt and pepper to taste (I like plenty of pepper here) and stir.

name: DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
4  egg yolks or 2 whole eggs
4  c. flour
1  c. buttermilk or sour milk
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. mace
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Mix butter and eggs thoroughly.  Add buttermilk and sifted dry ingredients.  Stir until smooth.  Roll out on a lightly floured board to 1/2-inch thickness.  Let set for 20 minutes.  Cut with a floured 2 1/2-inch doughnut cutter.  Drop into a kettle of hot oil.  Turn when they rise to surface, then turn again when they brown.  Drain on an absorbent cloth or paper towels.  Cool.  Dust with either powdered sugar or cinnamon/sugar.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sifted cake flour
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. shortening
3  c. sugar
5  eggs, separated
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon extract
preparation: Sift together cake flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt; set aside.  Cream margarine and shortening until smooth.  Add sugar gradually, beating well.  Add egg yolks, one at a time and continue beating until very creamy.  Add dry ingredients to the creamed mixture alternately with sour cream, beginning and ending with dry ingredients, stirring until well blended after each addition.  Add flavoring and beat egg whites until they hold stiff peaks.  Add 1/3 at a time and carefully fold into batter.  Spoon batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan and bake in a 325° oven for about 1 1/2 hours (top will be brown and crusty). Cool in pan for 10 minutes.  Remove from pan and finish cooling. Let stand overnight to enhance flavor.

name: SWEDISH MEAT BALLS #3
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
1  lb. ground lean pork
2  eggs, beaten to a lemon yellow
1  c. bread crumbs
3/4  c. mashed potatoes
1  tsp. salt
1  c. condensed milk
1  tsp. brown sugar
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. allspice
4  twists of pepper mill
3  Tbsp. butter (for frying)
2  c. half and half cream
preparation: Mix very well all of the ingredients, except the butter for frying and the cream, in the order in which they are listed. Using the large end of a melon ball maker, form into tiny meat balls.  Saute the meat balls in the butter until they are well browned.  Shake the pan from side to side so that they roll and brown evenly on all sides.  Pour off any excess drippings which may accumulate during the frying.  Stir in the cream; simmer for 20 minutes, or until the sauce is thickened.  Serve with boiled potatoes or with broad noodles.

name: VEGETABLE CHILI
ingredients:
3  Tbsps. instant minced onion
1/4  tsp. instant minced garlic
water
2  Tbsps. salad oil
2 1/4  c. tomatoes, peeled and chopped
1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
2  c. zucchini, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
2  green peppers, seeded and cut into 1 inch pieces
2-3 tsps. chili powder
1  1/4 tsps. salt
1/8  tsp. ground black pepper
1  1/2 Tbsps. flour
1- 8.75  oz. can red kidney beans, drained
preparation: In a small bowl, combine onion and garlic with an equal amount of water; set aside 10 minutes to soften.  In a large skillet, heat oil until hot.  Add onion and garlic; saute until lightly browned, about 3 minutes.  Add tomatoes, mushrooms, zucchini, green peppers, chili powder, salt, and black pepper.  Simmer, covered until vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.  Combine flour and 3 Tbsp. water.  Add to chili along with kidney beans.  Cook and stir until thickened, about 5 minutes.  Sprinkle with cheddar cheese, if desired.  Makes 4 servings each with 199 calories, 2 g. fat and 0 mg. cholesterol.

name: VEG-ALL CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  cans Veg-All
1  small onion
1  c. mayo
1 small  jar pimento (optional)
1  can cheese soup
1/4  lb. crackers
1/2  stick oleo, melted
preparation: Drain 2 cans Veg-All; then add all 3 cans with liquid.  Mix all together except crackers and oleo.  Cook 20 minutes; then add crushed crackers.  Drizzle oleo on top.  Bake until crackers are a little brown in a 350° oven.

name: CHERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
10  double graham crackers, crushed
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  lb. box confectioners sugar
1/2  c. broken pecans
2  pkg. Dream Whip
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: In a saucepan, melt margarine.  Add crushed graham crackers and mix well.  Press mixture into 8 x 8-inch glass dish.  Combine softened cream cheese and confectioners sugar together and pour over layer of graham cracker crust.   Sprinkle pecans over cream cheese mixture.  Next, gently spoon cherry pie filling over nuts. Whip Dream Whip according to package directions and spread over pie filling.  Garnish with crushed graham crackers.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: PIMENTO CHEESE
ingredients:
1  lb. cheese
1 large  jar pimentos
mayonnaise
little garlic salt
pepper
preparation: Grate cheese fine.  Add cut up pimentos.  Add mayonnaise and mix well.  Add garlic salt, pepper, a little salt and a drop or two of Tabasco sauce, if desired.  Makes 1 quart.

name: COWBOY COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
2  c. oatmeal
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 small  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients together in one bowl and beat.  Spread evenly on a greased cookie sheet.  Bake for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: SPRITZ
ingredients:
1  cup butter (2 sticks)
2/3  cup sugar
3  egg yolks
1  tsp vanilla
2  1/2 cups flour (Do not use self rising Flour in this recipe)
preparation: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Mix butter, sugar, egg yolks and vanilla thoroughly.  Measure flour by dipping method or by sifting.  Work in the flour.  Using 1/4 of the dough at a time, force dough through cookie press onto ungreased baking sheet in desired shapes.  Bake 7 to 10 minutes or until set but not brown. Cookies may be decorated with colored sugar or cherries before baking.

name: SAUSAGE AND PEPPER LASAGNA
ingredients:
2  tsp. olive oil
6  oz. Italian turkey sausage
1/2  c. red bell pepper, chopped
1/2  c. green bell pepper, chopped
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. dried oregano
2  c. canned tomatoes, crushed
1  c. Ricotta cheese
1 1/2  oz. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1  egg
3/4  oz. Parmesan cheese
1/4  tsp. dried red pepper flakes
4  lasagna noodles, cooked
preparation: In large saucepan,  heat oil;  add turkey sausage, bell pepper, onion and  oregano.  Cook,  stirring  over medium heat until turkey is  browned  and  vegetables  are cooked, about 7 minutes.  Add  tomatoes.  Bring  to  boil.  Simmer  20  to  25 minutes.  In  medium  bowl,  combine  cheeses, oregano and red pepper  flakes.  Arrange noodles on work surface; spread equal amounts  of  cheese  mixture  over  each noodle.  Roll up from short  end.  Carefully  slice noodle in half, making two "pinwheels."  Spread  1/2  cup  sauce  in  bottom of 8-inch square baking  dish.  Arrange cut noodles over sauce (cut side down). Spoon  remaining  sauce  over  top.  Cover with foil.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until bubbly.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.  Serves 4.

name: KEY WEST GRILLED CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. honey
1  Tbsp. olive or vegetable oil
1  tsp. lime juice
1  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Place the chicken in a shallow dish; set aside. In a small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients; mix well and pour over the chicken. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour, turning occasionally.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. vegetable shortening
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. quick or old-fashioned oats, uncooked
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Heat the oven to 350°.  Beat the shortening, sugar, egg, water and vanilla until creamy. Add the combined dry ingredients and mix well. Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Cool on a wire rack and cool completely. Store tightly covered.

name: ITALIAN VEGETABLE TOSS
ingredients:
2  medium zucchini, sliced
2  medium yellow squash, sliced
10  medium mushrooms, quartered
1  Tbsp. margarine, diced
1  Tbsp. fresh basil leaves, snipped or 1 tsp. dried basil
1/4  tsp. cracker black pepper
2  medium tomatoes, cut into 8 wedges
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
preparation: In a shallow 2-quart casserole, place zucchini, yellow squash, mushrooms, margarine, basil and pepper. Cover with a sheet of wax paper.  Microwave on High until squash is tender-crisp, 8 to 10 minutes, rotating halfway through cooking time.  Add tomato wedges and sprinkle with cheese.  Microwave on High 2 to 3 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

name: TACO SHELLS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. cornmeal
1/2  tsp. salt
2 1/3  c. cold water
2  eggs
preparation: Mix and fry.  Top with favorite taco topping (lettuce, tomatoes, grated cheese, hamburger, onion, green peppers, etc.).

name: 24-HOUR SALAD
ingredients:
1  small head lettuce, torn into bite size pieces
1  lb. fresh spinach, chopped
10  oz. frozen tiny peas, thawed but not cooked
1  c. cooked spring onions, chopped
10  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
2  c. mayonnaise
2  c. sour cream
1  pkg. Ranch Style dressing mix
preparation: Layer the first 5 ingredients in a dish.  Combine mayonnaise, sour cream and dressing mix.  Spread dressing over salad, making sure the salad is completely covered.  Chill 24 hours.

name: SHRIMP AND CRAB QUICHE
ingredients:
1  unbaked 9-inch pie crust
4  oz. tiny shrimp
4  oz. drained crab meat
4  oz. shredded natural Swiss cheese
1/3  onion, finely chopped
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. half and half
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Sprinkle crab meat, shrimp, cheese and onion in pie shell. Beat eggs slightly and stir in remaining ingredients.  Pour egg mixture into pie crust.  Cook, uncovered, for 15 minutes at 425°. Reduce temperature to 300° and cook for 30 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.  Allow to cool at least 10 minutes before serving.  Serves 6.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, well beaten
1  c. white sugar
1/2  stick melted butter
2/3  c. white Karo syrup
1 1/2  c. coarsely chopped pecans
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Pour into an unbaked pie shell and bake at 325° until pie is firm, about 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE RICH CRESCENT CROISSANTS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can refrigerated quick crescent dinner rolls
1  (4 oz.) bar sweet cooking chocolate, broken in pieces or chocolate morsels
1  egg, slightly beaten
1 to 4  Tbsp. butter, softened
2  Tbsp. powdered sugar
2  Tbsp. sliced or slivered almonds
preparation: Separate dough into  triangles.  Press	each to enlarge slightly.  Spread butter on each triangle.	Place equal amount of chocolate on shortest  side  of  each  triangle.  Roll  up, starting at shortest side.	Place  rolls  point  side  down on ungreased baking sheet; curve into crescent shape.	Brush each roll with beaten egg;  sprinkle each with almonds.	Bake 11 to 13 minutes or until golden brown.  Let  them cool for a while. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve.  Bake in 375° oven.

name: LEMON BUTTER CHICKEN
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. chicken pieces
1/2  c. margarine, melted
2  lemons
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Rub chicken with lemon.  Mix margarine, juice of 1 lemon and garlic salt.  Pour over chicken and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Baste occasionally. Serves 4 to 6.

name: PARTY CHOPS
ingredients:
12  boneless chops
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. catsup
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
9  oz. crushed pineapple
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Place chops in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix all ingredients and pour over chops.  Bake uncovered at 300° for 2 hours.  Serves 12.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. chopped broccoli
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  eggs, well beaten
1  can sharp cheese, grated
1  medium chopped onion
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1/2  pkg. Pepperidge Farm stuffing
preparation: Cook broccoli.  Mix soup, mayonnaise, eggs, onion, salt and pepper.  Add to drained broccoli.  Pour into an 8 x 12-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle cheese over mixture.  Mix butter with stuffing. Sprinkle over mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: MARVELOUS CHEESE STRAWS
ingredients:
1  lb. extra sharp cheese, grated
1 1/2  sticks real butter, melted
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. red pepper (to taste)
preparation: Sift flour.  Pour melted butter over grated cheese.  Add flour, salt and pepper.  Work it together using hands until it forms a good ball.  Press through a cookie press on ungreased cookie sheets.  Cut across in 3 in. strips before cooking.  Bake 20 minutes at 325-350° until they stop sizzling.  Do not brown, but bottoms should be golden.

name: S'MORE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
3/4  c. flour
1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  (7 oz.) milk chocolate bar, melted
2  c. Kraft miniature marshmallows
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Beat margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add combined flour and crumbs; mix well.  Press onto bottom of greased 9-inch square pan.  Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, or until golden brown.  Spread chocolate over crust.  Top with marshmallows.  Broil 4 inches from heat for 1 to 2 minutes, or until marshmallows are lightly browned.  Cool; cut into bars.

name: WEDDING BROWNIES
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
2  sq. butter
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Melt butter and cocoa; add to eggs and sugar and mix.  Then add salt, flour and baking powder.  Mix together and put in greased dripper pan.  Bake at 370° for 27 minutes.

name: MOMS OLD-FASHIONED BOILED CUSTARD
ingredients:
1  gal. whole milk
1  doz. jumbo eggs
1 - 2   tsp. vanilla
preparation: Make in 2 batches. Place 1/2 gal. milk on stove in heavy pot. Bring almost to boil; do not allow to boil. Add vanilla to taste, about 1 tsp. Separate eggs. Beat egg yolks and whites separately. Add 3/4 cup sugar to each batch. Then add egg yolks.

name: WHITE CASTLE HAMBURGER(Clone)
ingredients:
1/4  c. dry minced onion
1/4  c. hot water
1  lb. ground sirloin
3  oz. jar beef baby food
2/3  c. canned beef broth
1  pkg. hot dog buns, cut in thirds
mustard, pickles and catsup
preparation: Mix the first 5 ingredients; fry in hot skillet.  Serve on buns (cut in thirds).  Garnish with condiments.

name: 3 DAY COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1  head cabbage
1  medium onion
1  green pepper
1 small  can pimento
1/2  c. honey
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. cooking oil
2  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine vegetables; set aside.  Combine others and bring to boil.  Pour over vegetables.  Pack in jars and cover.  Let stand for 3 days in refrigerator.

name: SALISBURY STEAK DELUXE
ingredients:
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. prepared horseradish
1  egg
1/4  c. dry bread crumbs
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 to 2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley (fresh, if available)
preparation: In a bowl combine the soup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and horseradish; blend well.  Set aside.  In another bowl lightly beat the egg.  Add bread crumbs, onion, salt, pepper and 1/4 cup of the soup mixture.  Add beef and mix well.  Shape into six patties.  In a large skillet, brown the patties in oil; drain. Combine remaining soup mixture with water; pour over patties. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until meat is done.  Remove patties to a serving platter; spoon over meat. Sprinkle with parsley.

name: BUTTERMILK POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  tsp. lemon
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
3  c. plain flour
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Blend all ingredients, adding flour and buttermilk.  Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.  Check it at 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: EASY CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. salad dressing
1  c. cold water
preparation: Sift together flour, sugar, cocoa and baking soda.  Add salad dressing and water.  Mix all ingredients well.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: POPPY SEED PREPARED ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. Pepperidge Farm country style classic dinner rolls
1  stick butter or oleo
2  Tbsp. poppy seed
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. Durkee sauce
8  slices ham
8  slices cheese (Monterey Jack or other of choice)
preparation: Slice bread in half; fill with cheese and ham.  Melt butter; add poppy seed, minced onion, sugar and Durkee sauce.  Pour over rolls.  Cook in oven at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes (will look a little burnt, but aren't).  Each roll can be cut in half and served as finger sandwiches.

name: MARTHA'S POTATOES
ingredients:
8  or 9 large potatoes
1/2  c. butter
1  tsp. salt
1  pt. half and half or milk
1/4  lb. Cheddar cheese
1  c. fresh bread crumbs
preparation: Boil potatoes only 10 minutes with jackets on; cool.  Peel and grate potatoes.  Melt 1/2 cup of butter or oleo and add cream. Grate the cheese.  Layer potatoes, cream mixture and cheese in 3 layers.  Top with fresh bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: WIGGLES
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  c. peas
1  c. tomatoes or tomato soup
1  c. mushroom soup
1  c. cooked spaghetti
grated cheese
preparation: Fry hamburger until brown.  Put in bottom of casserole; add peas, tomatoes or soup and spaghetti.  Pour mushroom soup into hamburger skillet and thin with milk.  Heat this and pour over casserole.  Sprinkle with grated cheese.  Bake for 1/2 hour at 350°.

name: CABBAGE DINNER
ingredients:
1  lb. round steak
1  head of cabbage
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Chop steak into squares.  Fry in pan with a little oil.  While meat is cooking, chop up cabbage and cook in oil on low heat.  When meat is done, add to cabbage.  Use meat juice and water to make a simmering sauce.  Cover.  Cook about 30 minutes.  Stir often.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Serve with rice and crackers.

name: ORANGE FLUFF
ingredients:
1 large  box orange jello
2  c. boiling water
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 small  can Mandarin oranges, drained
1  pt. orange sherbet
preparation: Dissolve jello in the boiling water and cool.  Add sherbet and fruit.  Chill until set.  Serves 8.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
2/3  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. margarine
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. caramels
1  c. pecans
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix cake as directed on box.  Add 1/3 cup evaporated milk and 1/2 cup margarine to batter.  Pour 1/2 batter into prepared 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Melt caramels and 1/3 cup evaporated milk.  Pour this over first layer of cake after baked.  Sprinkle chocolate chips and pecans on next.  Pour rest of batter over this.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: PECAN-OATMEAL PANCAKES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. oatmeal
1  c. flour
1/2  c. chopped nuts
2  Tbsp. light brown sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients and cook on hot griddle.  Makes 12 to 16 pancakes.

name: BARBECUE BEEF
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  oz. (2 Tbsp.) table fat
1 3/4  c. water
2 1/2  c. catsup
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
8  oz. (2 c.) chopped celery
preparation: Mix together and grill or broil.  Makes 25 burgers.

name: LOIS' CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. cocoa
2  eggs
dash of salt
2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, flour, salt, cocoa and eggs; add milk and thicken. Add margarine and vanilla.  Pour into 2 baked pie shells.  Top with Cool Whip or meringue.

name: SWISS MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  egg
1/2  c. grated Swiss cheese
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. dry bread crumbs
1  tsp. caraway seed
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can (8 oz.) tomato sauce
Swiss cheese slices
chopped parsley
preparation: Combine first 8 ingredients with 1/4 cup tomato sauce and form into loaf.  Bake in shallow baking dish at 350° for 45 minutes. Spoon remaining tomato sauce over top, cover with cheese slices and garnish with parsley, continue baking 15 minutes.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  stick butter or margarine
preparation: Pour pineapple into long pan, 9 x 12-inch.  Sprinkle dry cake mix over pineapple.  Cut margarine into pieces over the pineapple and dry cake mix.  Bake at 350° to 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: SHRIMP AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked rice
1  can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1/2 to 1  lb. shrimp, shelled and deveined
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese cubes
2  Tbsp. melted butter
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix together and put in a casserole dish. Bake uncovered for 40 minutes at 375° to 400°.

name: CREAM OF CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1 (16 oz.)  carton sour cream
3 soup  cans milk
1 small  can Ortega chilies (mild)
1  can black olives, chopped
