3  c. chopped, cooked chicken
3/4  can French green beans
2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  doz. yellow corn shells
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients except for sharp cheese and corn shells.  Take 1/2 cup of mixture, spread on bottom of casserole dish.  Warm up corn shells until soft.  Take one shell at a time in hand, put a scoop of mixture in the middle. Sprinkle on sharp cheese.  Roll up; place face down in dish.  When dish is full, put remaining mixture over the top and sides.  If you find the mixture thick, add more milk.  You need at least 2 1/2 to 3 cups for the top.

name: CHERRY YUM YUM
ingredients:
3  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 1/2  sticks oleo
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  pkg. Dream Whip
1  c. cold milk
2  cans Thank You cherries
preparation: Combine the cracker crumbs and oleo and line bottom of pan.

name: MINI MEAT LOAVES AND VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
1  egg
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
6  small red potatoes, thinly sliced
1  (16 oz.) bag frozen vegetable combination (broccoli, corn and red pepper), thawed and drained
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  In a medium bowl, combine ground beef, egg, 1/2 can tomato sauce, 1/2 can Durkee onions, 1/2 teaspoon salt and Italian seasoning.  Shape into 3 mini meat loaves and place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Arrange potatoes around loaves.  Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 35 minutes.  Spoon vegetables around meat loaves; stir to combine with potatoes. Lightly season vegetables with salt and pepper, if desired.  Top meat loaves with remaining tomato sauce.  Bake, uncovered, 15 minutes or until meat loaves are done.  Top loaves with remaining onions; bake, uncovered, 3 minutes or until onions are golden brown.

name: EASY AND DELICIOUS CHERRY CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling (any pie filling desired)
1  deep-dish graham cracker pie shell
2  (8 oz.) Philadelphia cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Soften cream cheese. Add powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Blend until well moistened. Pour into pie shell. Top with pie filling and chill.

name: NO BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick butter or oleo
2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Boil together for 1 1/2 minutes.  Stir in 1/2 cup peanut butter, 1 teaspoon vanilla and 3 cups oatmeal.  Drop on wax paper and cool completely.

name: EASY BARBECUE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  small chicken
14  oz. ketchup
12  oz. Pepsi
salt
pepper
preparation: Place chicken in pan; salt and pepper to taste.  Pour ketchup and Pepsi over chicken.  Cook at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PITA PIZZA WEDGES
ingredients:
2  (6 1/2-inch) pita bread rounds
1/2  c. pizza sauce
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped mushrooms, drained
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese (2 oz.)
preparation: Split each pita round in half horizontally.  Quarter each round, forming 16 triangles total.  Place on a baking sheet.  Bake in a 325° oven for 18 to 20 minutes or until crisp and golden. Spread pizza sauce over toasted triangles.  Top with mushrooms and cheese.  Return to oven and bake about 5 minutes more or until cheese melts.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CREAM CHEESE FROSTING
ingredients:
2  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. butter or margarine, softened
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1  tsp. milk
preparation: Mix and spread.  Decorate with sprinkles or nuts, etc.

name: BEEFY MEXICAN LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  pkg. taco seasoning (1 1/8 oz.)
1  can French fried onions
1 (12 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
1  tomato, chopped
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  eggs, beaten
12  flour or corn tortillas (6-inch)
shredded lettuce
preparation: In large skillet, brown beef; drain.  Add Ro-Tel tomatoes and taco seasoning.  Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes.  Stir in 1/2 can of French fried onions.  In bowl, combine cottage cheese, 1 cup of Cheddar cheese and eggs.  Place 3 tortillas on bottom of greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish.  Overlap 6 tortillas around sides of baking dish.  Spoon meat mixture evenly in dish.  Top with 3 tortillas, then cheese mixture.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Place remaining onions in center of casserole.  Bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes longer.  Before serving, arrange tomatoes and lettuce around edge of casserole.

name: BAKED BEANS WITH FRANKS
ingredients:
2  cans pork and beans (16 oz. each)
10  franks, cut in 1-inch pieces
1/4  medium green pepper
1/2  medium onion
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. ketchup
1/2  c. water
1/4  Tbsp. mustard
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  strips bacon
preparation: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except bacon.  Mix to blend.  Pour into 2-quart casserole and top with bacon. Bake 20 minutes or until heated through.

name: CHOPS FOR HUNGRY CHAP
ingredients:
6  pork chops
2/3  c. uncooked rice
1  c. water
2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can chopped tomatoes
1  c. whole kernel yellow corn
1/4  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Trim fat from chops.  Fry in a large skillet; add chops and brown very slowly on both sides.  Leave out.  Add water; sprinkle with salt and arrange chops over rice.  Sprinkle with remaining salt.  Add onion and tomatoes.  Spoon on corn; sprinkle with pepper.  Bring to a boil.  Turn heat down to low and cover and simmer 25 to 35 minutes or until rice is tender.  Add small amount of water if mixture cooks dry.

name: NO CHOLESTEROL HONEY BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
no stick corn oil cooking spray
1  c. unsifted whole wheat or all-purpose flour
1  c. whole bran cereal
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. raisins
2  egg whites
1  c. skim milk
1/3  c. Mazola corn oil
1/4  c. honey
preparation: Spray 12 muffin cups with cooking spray. In large bowl, stir flour, bran cereal, baking powder, salt and raisins.  In small bowl, stir egg whites, milk, corn oil and honey until well blended. Stir into flour mixture just until moistened. Let stand 3 minutes. Spoon into muffin cups.  Bake in 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 12 muffins. Delicious when topped with Mazola margarine.

name: CRAB DELIGHT DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sour cream
1  tsp. chopped parsley
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can crabmeat
1  tsp. sherry
1  tsp. lemon juice
salt and pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Chill.  Serve with crackers.

name: BLACK FOREST MOUSSE
ingredients:
1 (1 oz.)  sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1  c. cold water
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. instant chocolate pudding mix
3/4  tsp. almond extract
2  c. (1 pt.) whipping cream, whipped
1  (21 oz.) cherry filling, chilled
preparation: In large bowl, beat chocolate with condensed milk.  Beat in water, then pudding mix and 1/2 teaspoon almond extract.  Freeze 5 minutes.  Fold in whipped cream.  Spoon into dishes.  Stir remaining 1/4 teaspoon extract into cherry filling; spoon over dessert.

name: COCONUT OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
1  c. packed brown sugar
1  c. shortening
1/2  c. dairy sour cream
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. flour
2  c. coconut
2 1/2  c. oatmeal
sugar and cinnamon
preparation: Put sugars, shortening, sour cream, eggs, soda, baking powder, salt and vanilla into large mixing bowl.  Mix well, using a pastry blender.  Add flour, coconut and oatmeal, mixing well as before. Push through a cookie press, using the 3/4-inch tube.  Cut dough into 2-inch logs.  Roll in a mixture of cinnamon and sugar.  Put on ungreased cookie sheets and bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1  c. cream-style corn
1 small  can chopped green chili peppers
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
2/3  c. buttermilk
2  eggs
1/3  c. oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into well-greased skillet or muffin tins.  Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.  Makes 12 muffins.

name: FRIDAY NIGHT DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes with chilies
1  can chili (optional)
preparation: Cut cheese into chunks.  Add tomatoes (cut up if whole). Microwave on High, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted. Add chili and stir well.  Great with tortilla chips.

name: FANTASY FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3/4  c. Parkay butter
2/3  c. evaporated milk
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1 (7 oz.)  jar Kraft Marshmallow Creme
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, butter and milk in heavy saucepan.  Bring to a full rolling boil, stirring constantly.  Continue boiling 5 minutes over medium heat, stirring constantly to prevent scorching.  Remove from heat.  Stir in chocolate pieces until melted.  Chill after putting in pan for 2 hours or until hard.

name: RICE WITH ONION AND BAY LEAF
ingredients:
1  c. rice
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1 small  clove garlic, minced
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  bay leaf
preparation: Melt 1 tablespoon margarine; add onion and garlic.  Cook, stirring, until onion is wilted.  Add rice and stir to coat grains.  Add broth and bay leaf.  Bring to boil and cover.  Cook exactly 17 minutes.  Remove bay leaf and stir in remaining 1 tablespoon margarine.  Serves 6.

name: MAUI MIST(Punch)
ingredients:
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 (46 oz.)  can apricot nectar
3 (6 oz.)  cans frozen limeade
3 (28 oz.)  bottles ginger ale
1  qt. vodka (optional)
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and chill.  Add chilled ginger ale and vodka (optional).  Makes 1 1/2 gallons.

name: PRITIKINISH BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  nice clump broccoli (about 3 stems)
4  to 5 toes peeled garlic
about 1 gal. water
salt to taste or salt substitute
12  oz. thin spaghetti
1 large  can or freshly grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Bring water to a boil.  It should be salted and include garlic.  Add chopped broccoli.  Boil for about 7 minutes and remove broccoli so it doesn't soften too much.  Boil spaghetti in the same water for about 10 minutes.  When spaghetti is tender, add the broccoli.  Make sure you can taste the salt or salt substitute.  Serve in soup bowls covered with a layer of Parmesan cheese.  Serve with hot bread and a salad.

name: GOOD THINGS
ingredients:
1  tube (8 count) crescent dinner rolls
3  oz. cream cheese
1 (2 1/2 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained and chopped
3  Tbsp. water
2  Tbsp. minced dehydrated onions
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. thyme
1  egg white, slightly beaten
sesame seed
preparation: Divide crescent rolls into 4 rectangles.  Mix all remaining ingredients together, except egg white and sesame seed.  Spread on rolls.  Roll up lengthwise and cut into 8 pieces.  Brush top with egg white and sprinkle with sesame seed.  Bake at 350° for 17 to 18 minutes.  Yield: 32.

name: OVERNIGHT CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen dinner rolls (I use Rich's brand)
1  pkg. butterscotch pudding (not instant)
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  lb. (1 stick) butter
maraschino cherries, chopped or halved (optional)
preparation: Butter a Bundt pan.  Put cherries in bottom of pan.  Place the rolls in a circle on top of the cherries.  Mix dry ingredients together.  Pour melted butter over rolls, then sprinkle on dry ingredients.  Cover with greased foil.  Set on counter to rise. Bake the next morning for approximately 15 minutes in a preheated 350° oven.  Cool in pan for 10 minutes.  Turn out on plate to serve.  Be sure to remove foil to bake rolls.  These smell and taste divine!

name: CHICKEN HOT DISH
ingredients:
2  c. cooked, cut up chicken
1 (16 oz.)  can French cut green beans
1 (6 oz.)  box Uncle Ben's wild rice mix, cooked
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. water chestnuts
1/2  c. sliced fresh or canned mushrooms
1  Tbsp. pimento
1  Tbsp. chopped onions
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Place in greased casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Recipe can be doubled and a second casserole frozen.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: ZUCCHINI-MUSHROOM BAKE
ingredients:
3  slices bacon, diced
1/4  lb. mushrooms, sliced
1/2  tsp. salt or to taste
1/2  tsp. oregano
2  medium zucchini, thinly sliced
1  large tomato, diced
1/2  tsp. freshly ground pepper
preparation: Cook bacon until done and drain on paper towel.  Get a skillet and put 1/2 inch of water in it.  Cook zucchini in water until it softens.  Stir in mushrooms, tomato, salt, pepper and oregano. Cook until vegetables are tender, about 10 to 15 minutes.  Stir and sprinkle with crumbled bacon before serving.

name: OVEN FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
12  slices bread
6  eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
salt to taste (if desired)
preparation: Melt margarine, brown sugar and cinnamon in bottom of 9 x 13-inch aluminum pan (not a glass pan).  Cover with 2 layers of bread.  Mix  eggs,	milk and salt.	Pour over bread layers. Cover with  aluminum foil and refrigerate overnight.  Uncover and bake at	350°  for 30 minutes.  Remove from pan promptly. Turn pan upside down.  This is a good breakfast item.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: CHICKEN CACCIATORE(Low-Fat)
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts, skinned
2  Tbsp. olive oil
3  c. fresh mushrooms
2  red peppers, sliced
1  large onion, sliced into rings
2  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  c. white wine
1/4  tsp. red pepper flakes
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
2  Tbsp. tomato paste
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. dried basil, crushed
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. dried thyme
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: In a heavy 12-inch skillet or Dutch oven, brown chicken in hot oil on both sides (4 to 5 minutes total).  Remove chicken; set aside.  Add mushrooms, red pepper, onion and garlic to skillet drippings.  Cook until the vegetables are tender.  Add wine and crushed red pepper into vegetable mixture.  Bring to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer, uncovered, until almost all liquid evaporates.  Add undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, lemon juice, basil, sugar, thyme, salt and pepper.  Return chicken to pan. Simmer uncovered 15 minutes or until chicken is tender.

name: GREEN NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  chicken
1  stick butter
1  large chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped bell pepper
1/4  lb. Velveeta cheese
1 (6 oz.)  jar stuffed olives, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. noodles
preparation: Boil the chicken, bone and save broth.  Saute the onion, celery and bell pepper in the butter for 5 minutes.  Cut up the Velveeta cheese and stir into above mixture until melted.  Add the olives. Add the mushroom soup to the chicken, then add to sauteed ingredients.  Boil the noodles in the chicken broth.  Drain and mix all ingredients in a large casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.  Can make 1 day ahead of time and keep refrigerated.

name: CAVATINI
ingredients:
1  pkg. Williams spaghetti sauce
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1/2  onion, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1  box mostaccioli noodles, boiled and drained
2  lb. hamburger, browned
preparation: Bring spaghetti sauce, tomatoes, onion and green pepper to a low boil.  Then mix noodles and hamburger.  Put in a 9 x 13-inch dish.  Top with Mozzarella cheese and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: ARTICHOKE HEART CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (15 oz. each)  cans artichoke hearts, drained
1  tsp. basil flakes
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. minced garlic
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. Italian bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. olive oil
4  c. chicken stock
1  medium cauliflower
1  large broccoli
1/2  lb. carrots
1/4  c. sliced green onions
1  stick butter
1  can Campbell's cream of chicken soup
1  Tbsp. cornstarch and 1/2 c. water
salt and pepper to taste
1/4  c. margarine
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: First, pour the chicken stock into a vegetable steamer and bring it to a rolling boil.  Then, one ingredient at a time, begin steaming the cauliflower, broccoli and carrots in the chicken stock until they are tender-crisp (not raw, but not soft either). When each vegetable is cooked, dip it quickly in ice cold water to stop the cooking; drain it in a colander and set it aside in a buttered 11 x 17-inch baking pan.

name: BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  qt. beans
2  Tbsp. salt
good sized piece of salt pork
preparation: Put beans in  large  kettle  filled  half  full of cold water; bring to a	boil.  Add  salt and salt pork.  Boil until tender, keeping kettle half full of water.

name: TAHITIAN SUPPER
ingredients:
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
juice from 1 (13 1/4 oz.) can pineapple chunks
1  c. water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  can Treet or Spam, cubed
green bell pepper strips
preparation: In  saucepan,  combine	1/2  cup  packed  brown  sugar, cornstarch,  pineapple  juice, water and vinegar.  Cook, stirring until clear and thick, then stir in the Treet or Spam cut in 1-inch  cubes  and	bell pepper strips.  Keep cooking until hot (about  10 minutes).  Serve over hot, cooked rice.	Serves 4.

name: BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. bran
2/3  c. raisins or nuts
2  Tbsp. molasses
1  c. sour milk
1  egg, beaten
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Sift flour and measure.  Add sugars, salt, soda and baking powder to flour and sift twice.  Beat egg.  Add oil, milk, butter and molasses.  Add dry ingredients and apples.  Stir only to moisten.  Add raisins and nuts.

name: BURRITO BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can refried beans
1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. Cheddar cheese
1/2  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1  c. Bisquick
16  oz. jar chunky salsa
preparation: Brown and drain ground beef.  Add 1/4 cup of water to taco seasoning mix.  Blend well and add to ground beef.  Mix together the refried beans, Bisquick and 1/4 cup water.  Spread in well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Then layer the seasoned meat and chunky salsa.  On top, sprinkle Cheddar cheese and salsa, if any left.  You may layer Cheddar cheese with meat and salsa. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 375°.  Let sit a few minutes before serving.

name: QUICK SHERBET
ingredients:
1  gal. pineapple sherbet
2  pkg. frozen strawberries
4  large bananas
preparation: Soften sherbet and thaw strawberries.  Combine.  Add bananas and re-freeze.  This is so refreshing.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs, slightly beaten
2 1/4  c. milk
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. day old 1-inch bread cubes
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Combine eggs, milk, vanilla, cinnamon and salt. Stir in bread cubes.  Stir in sugar and raisins.  Pour mixture into an 8-inch round glass ovenware dish.  Place dish in a large shallow pan on oven rack.  Pour hot water into pan 1-inch deep.  Bake at 350° about 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean.  Can be served with the following Vanilla Sauce.

name: SIMPLE CUSTARD DELIGHT
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. self-rising flour
1  c. skim milk
2  tsp. canola oil
2  tsp. egg substitute
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  egg whites
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a medium-size bowl, combine sugar and flour.  Mix well with a wire whisk.  Add milk, oil, egg substitute, salt and vanilla.  Mix well with wire whisk.

name: VEGETABLE BEEF SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef or ground turkey
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  c. diced onion
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1 1/2  c. chopped carrots
2  c. chopped celery
1  c. diced green pepper
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/4  tsp. black pepper
3  c. beef broth
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed tomatoes
1  c. hominy or corn (optional)
preparation: In large pan, brown meat in margarine.  Add onion, garlic, carrots, celery and green pepper.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Add beef broth, tomatoes, salt and black pepper.  Simmer on low for 35 minutes.  Add hominy or corn.  Cook 10 minutes more.   Yields 4 quarts.  May be refrigerated several days or frozen.

name: PEACH PIE
ingredients:
1 large  can peach halves
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/3  c. margarine
1/2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Place drained peach halves in pastry shell, cut sides up.  Mix all ingredients to crumble consistency.  Spoon on top of peaches 30 minutes at 375°.  Reach in oven.  Break up crust on top.  Bake at 300° for 25 minutes.

name: CRABMEAT SPREAD
ingredients:
8  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
1  lb. crabmeat
3  Tbsp. prepared horseradish
1  dash Tabasco sauce
preparation: Mix together and put into pie plate.  Sprinkle cheese on top. Put under broiler until bubbly.  Makes 2 cups.

name: MEXICAN HOMINY
ingredients:
2  onions, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  qt. chicken broth
1  lb. lean boneless pork, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
3  dried red chiles, washed, stemmed, seeded and finely chopped
1  tsp. dried whole oregano
1/2  tsp. coarsely ground black pepper
1/4  lb. hot Italian sausage, sliced
1 (15 oz.)  can white hominy, drained
preparation: Saute onion and garlic in oil in a large Dutch oven until tender.  Add chicken broth, pork, chiles, oregano and pepper; bring to a boil.  Cover, reduce heat and simmer 2 hours.

name: BLUEBERRY - BANANA PIE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  baked 9-inch pastry shell
1  c. blueberry pie filling
1  c. whipped cream, whipped
1/3  c. sugar
2  bananas, sliced
preparation: Combine cream cheese and sugar.  Beat at high speed with an electric mixer until light and fluffy.  Spread evenly in bottom of cooled pastry shell.  Arrange banana slices on cream cheese layer. Spread pie filling over bananas.  Top with whipped cream and chill.

name: PINK PUNCH
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  large strawberry jello
1  qt. boiling water
1 large  can pineapple juice
1 large  can frozen orange juice
1 small  can frozen lemonade
2 litter size  bottle 7-Up, Upper 10 or lemon lime drink
preparation: Dissolve sugar and jello in boiling water.  Add juices (do not dilute juices).  Freeze.

name: CHICKEN CORDON BLUE
ingredients:
6  boneless, skinned chicken breasts
6  slices Swiss cheese
6  slices thin ham
2  eggs
1/4  c. oil
2  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Beat chicken between pieces of wax paper with flat side of meat cleaver until 1/4-inch thick.  Arrange slice of ham and cheese on inside of each chicken breast.  Roll and secure with a toothpick. Dip rolled chicken in mixture of beaten eggs and oil, then roll in bread crumbs.  Arrange in pan and cook at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: BOTTOM'S UP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can ready to spread chocolate icing
1  c. chopped nuts
1  devil's food cake mix
1 1/4  c. water
1/3  c. oil
3  eggs
preparation: Heat oven to 350° and flour 13 x 9-inch pan.  Spread frosting into bottom of prepared pan.  Sprinkle nuts over frosting.  In large bowl blend cake mix, water, oil and eggs.  Beat 2 minutes at highest speed.  Pour batter over frosting in pan.  Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Immediately invert pan onto serving plate.  Serve warm or cold. Yields 12 servings.

name: BLUEBERRY SALAD(Congealed Salad)
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. grape jello
2  c. boiling water
1 large  can blueberry pie filling
1 large  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
8  oz. cream cheese (softened)
8  oz. sour cream
1/2  c. sugar or to taste
1  c. chopped pecans
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add pie filling and pineapple.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch container.  Place in refrigerator to congeal.  With mixer blend cream cheese, sour cream, sugar and vanilla.  Stir in pecans.  Pour on top of congealed layer.  Allow to chill before serving.

name: KEY LIME PIE
ingredients:
1  (8 or 9-inch) baked pastry shell
3  egg yolks
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1/2  c. ReaLime lime juice concentrate
yellow or green food coloring (optional)
whipped topping or whipped cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a medium bowl, beat egg yolks.  Stir in sweetened condensed milk, ReaLime and food coloring, if desired. Pour into prepared pastry shell.  Bake 8 minutes.  Cool.  Chill. Spread with whipped topping.  Garnish as desired.  Refrigerate leftovers.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: VANILLA FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. milk (cows)
2  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. vanilla
12  oz. jar peanut butter
7  oz. jar marshmallow cream
preparation: Cook first 3 ingredients until soft ball forms in cold water (at least 20 minutes after it starts to boil).  Remove from heat and add vanilla, peanut butter and marshmallow cream.  Mix well together and pour into buttered dish.  Place in fridge to cool, then cut into squares.  Keep in fridge or a cool place.

name: ORANGE GELATIN SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. orange Jell-O (sugar-free)
1  can mandarin oranges
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 (8 oz.) small  carton sour cream
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1/2  c. coconut (optional)
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients.  Mix well.  Fold in sour cream.  Add Cool Whip.  Chill.

name: BAKED LIMA BEANS
ingredients:
2  cans Seaside lima beans
6  slices bacon
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1/2  green pepper, chopped fine
1/3  bottle chili sauce
3/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: Fry bacon crisp; remove from pan.  Fry onion and pepper in bacon fat until soft.  In large pot or casserole, combine lima beans, onion, pepper, chili sauce and sugar.  Add bacon.  Mix well and bake, uncovered, in a 300° oven for 1 hour.  Stir occasionally.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  to 6 yellow squash
4  to 6 zucchini squash
8  oz. sour cream
2  carrots, grated
1  medium onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  box Stove Top stuffing
1  stick butter
preparation: Slice squash and cook in water; drain and mash.  Mix next 4 ingredients into squash.  Prepare stuffing mix according to directions on box, except use 1 stick butter instead of 1/2 stick. Mix stuffing into squash mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Makes 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

name: DOLE AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can Dole pineapple chunks in juice
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges
1  banana, peeled and sliced
1 1/2  c. seedless grapes
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. flaked coconut
1/4  c. chopped almonds
1  (8 oz.) vanilla yogurt
preparation: Drain pineapple and oranges.  Combine pineapple, oranges, banana, grapes, marshmallows, coconut and almonds.  Fold in yogurt and chill.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: BAKED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  thick pork chops
3  c. soft bread cubes
2  Tbsp. chopped onions
1/4  c. melted butter
1/4  c. water
1/4  tsp. poultry seasoning
1  can cream of celery soup
1/3  c. water
preparation: Brown the pork chops on both sides and arrange in a shallow 13 x 9-inch pan.  Lightly mix the bread cubes with the onions, butter, 1/4 cup water and the poultry seasoning.  Place a mound of stuffing on each chop.  Combine the soup and 1/3 cup water.  Pour over the chops.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until tender.

name: 5 MINUTE SNACK
ingredients:
10  slices bread
1  lb gr beef
1  med onion chopped fine
salt and pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 500°. Toast bread; spread with prepared mustard or catsup. Mix ground beef and onions; spread evenly on each toast slice making sure edges are covered.  Season with salt and pepper. Place meat side up on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 3-5 min. or until meat is done. Cut in half and serve.

name: CHEX MIX
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. Worcestershire sauce
garlic salt
4  c. Rice Chex
4  c. Wheat Chex
4  c. Corn Chex
4  c. Bran Chex
4  c. pretzel stix
4  c. Chinese noodles
4  c. Cheerios
preparation: Melt butter; add Worcestershire sauce.	Sprinkle garlic salt in liquid.	Put  Chex,  pretzels, noodles and Cheerios in very large bowl.  May  want  to	use  2 large bowls.  Sprinkle liquid over Chex and  toss  gently.  Be  sure  they  all  get coated. Put mixture in  baking  pans.  Bake  at  225°  until crispy, tossing lightly once  in  awhile,  1  to  1  1/2 hours (sometimes I put back	in  bowls  to toss).  May sprinkle with more garlic salt, liberally.

name: HONEY OATMEAL CHEWS
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo or butter
1/2  c. honey
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
2/3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. quick rolled oats
1  c. flaked coconut
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream butter, honey and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add egg and vanilla; beat well.  Sift flour, soda, baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture.  Stir in oatmeal, coconut and nuts.  Spread in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.  When cool, cut into bars about 1 1/2 x 2 1/2-inches.

name: YUMMY COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 lg.  can Creme of Coconut
1  lg. Cool Whip
1  sm. bag coconut
preparation: In a 9 x 13 cake pan bake cake according to package directions. After it cools 5 minutes, poke holes throughout cake with the handle of a wooden spoon.  Mix Eagle Brand milk with Creme of Coconut and pour over cake while warm and then cool completely.  (You may not need quite all of this mixture.)

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. shortening (half butter or margarine, softened)
2  eggs
2 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: If using self-rising flour, omit cream of tartar, soda and salt.

name: STRING BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans string beans
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can French fried onion rings
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Drain string beans; place in dish.  Mix in cream of mushroom soup and 1/2 can onion rings (mix all together).  Place remaining French fried onion rings on top of casserole.  Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: ELEANOR'S APPLE NUT SQUARES
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. nuts, chopped
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
3  c. diced apples (do not peel)
preparation: Break eggs into mixing bowl and beat until foamy.  Add sugar and beat until thick and lemon colored.  Add vanilla.   Mix flour, salt, baking powder and cinnamon and blend in mixture.  Fold in apples and nuts.  Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.  Cut into squares and serve with whipped topping, whipped cream or ice cream.  Top with maraschino cherry.

name: SAVORY OVEN POT ROAST
ingredients:
3  lb. round rump or sirloin roast
salt and pepper
pinch of nutmeg
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. oil
4  large onions, sliced
1  clove garlic, crushed
2  c. hot beef bouillon
2  Tbsp. tomato paste
1  Tbsp. each:  sugar and vinegar
1  tsp. thyme
4  sprigs parsley
2  celery tops
1  bay leaf
preparation: Dust beef with seasonings and flour.  Heat oil in a heavy oven-proof bag.  Brown meat; then remove.  Brown onions and garlic lightly in pan.  Replace meat on top of onions.  Add remaining ingredients.  Cover and bake at 350° until meat is tender, about 2 1/2 hours.  When roast is done, remove parsley, celery tops and bay leaf.  Serve with pan gravy.  Makes 10 servings.

name: PARTY CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  chicken breasts boneless and skinless
8  slices bacon
1  pkg. (4 oz.) chipped beef
1  can mushroom soup (undiluted)
1/2  pt. sour cream
preparation: Wrap each chicken breast with a slice of bacon.  Cover bottom of flat, greased baking pan (8x12x2) with chipped beef.  Arrange chicken breasts on chipped beef.  Mix soup and sour cream and pour over all.  Bake at 275 for 3 hours, uncovered.

name: BRICKLE BARS
ingredients:
saltine crackers
2  sticks butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
12  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
chopped walnuts
preparation: Line cookie sheet with tinfoil.  Lay saltines on bottom of pan. Melt butter or margarine; add sugar.  Cook on stove, stirring until it is thick and comes to a boil.  Pour over saltines and bake at 400° for 6 to 8 minutes.  Sprinkle with chocolate chips (or any flavor).  Spread when melted.  Sprinkle chopped walnuts.  Freeze 2 hours and peel off foil and break into pieces.

name: HAMBURGER AND NOODLE SKILLET SUPPER
ingredients:
3  c. egg noodles or 1 c. small pasta
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1  zucchini, cut in 2-inch long strips
1  sweet green or red pepper, cubed
1 1/4  c. sliced mushrooms (optional)
4  tomatoes, cubed
1/2  c. tomato sauce
1/4  c. fresh parsley
1  tsp. dried basil
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
salt and pepper
preparation: In large pot of boiling water, cook pasta until tender, but firm; drain.

name: CHUCK WAGON COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chunky peanut butter
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  apple, pared and grated
preparation: Cream butter and sugar; add lightly beaten egg and vanilla. Stir in peanut butter.  Sift dry ingredients and add to mixture. Add grated apple.  Form into balls and place on greased cookie sheet.  Press flat with fork.  Bake in 375° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  c. tomato juice
3/4  c. Quaker oats
1  egg
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  lb. ground pork
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients except ground beef; mix well.  Add ground beef; mix lightly but thoroughly. Press into 8 x 4-inch loaf pan; bake 1 hour.  Drain; let stand 5 minutes.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. milk
2 small  pkg. vanilla pudding
2 large  cans crushed pineapple, drained
4  to 5 bananas
1  container Cool Whip (large)
preparation: Prepare cake mix as directed.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 18 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Cream together cream cheese, milk and pudding.  Spread mixture on top of cooled cake.  Cover with crushed pineapple.  Slice the bananas on top.  Frost with Cool Whip.  Sprinkle with nuts.  Garnish with cherries.  Store in refrigerator.

name: HOMEMADE OREO ICE CREAM
ingredients:
6  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1  qt. half and half
1  pt. heavy cream
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. Oreos, crushed
milk
preparation: Beat the eggs with electric mixer until thick.  Add sugar and beat until creamy, about 15 minutes.  Add sweetened condensed milk, half and half and cream.  Fold in Oreos.  Pour mixture into ice cream freezer and finish filling container with milk if needed.  Prepare according to ice cream freezer directions.  Makes 1 1/2 gallons.

name: FREEZER PICKLES
ingredients:
7  c. thinly sliced cucumbers
1  c. sliced onions
1  c. bell pepper, chopped
3  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Sprinkle salt over cucumbers, onions and bell pepper.  Let stand 1 hour; drain.  Let sugar, vinegar and celery seed come to a boil; pour over cucumbers.  Let cool a little.  Put into containers and freeze.  Thaw before serving.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans tuna
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1/2  bag egg noodles
1/2  block cheese
preparation: Cook noodles.  Mix everything together and top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHOCOLATE ZUCCHINI CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. soft margarine
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1 3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sour milk or buttermilk
2 1/2  c. flour
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
2  c. grated zucchini
6  oz. bag chocolate chips
preparation: Cream margarine, oil and sugar.  Add eggs, vanilla and milk. Mix with electric mixer.  Combine dry ingredients.  Add to egg mixture.  Stir well.  Add zucchini.  Pour batter in greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.  Put chocolate chips on top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: CHEESE TORTE
ingredients:
2  c. crushed graham crackers
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. melted butter
preparation: Mix all together and pat into greased spring-form pan.

name: CINNAMON BARS
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
1  c. sugar
1  egg, separated
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  c. chopped pecans
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Cream butter in a large mixing bowl. Add sugar, beating until light and fluffy. Add egg yolk, flour and cinnamon; mix until well blended. Press mixture into an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Pour egg white over surface; drain off excess. Sprinkle chopped pecans over top. Press lightly into dough. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into 3 x 1-inch bars; cool on wire racks. Yield: about 4 dozen.

name: SOUTHERN STYLE OVEN BARBECUED CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (about 1-1/2 lb.)
2  Tbsp. Crisco shortening or Crisco oil
1  c. finely chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
1  c. ketchup
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/4  c. honey
2  Tbsp. worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. dry mustard
1-2 tsp. hot pepper sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
2  drops liquid smoke (optional)
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Place chicken in baking dish.  For barbecue sauce, heat crisco shortening or crisco oil in medium skillet on medium heat.  Add onion and garlic.  Stir fry until soft but not browned.  Remove from heat.  Cool slightly. Stir in ketchup, lemon juice, honey, worcestershire sauce, dry mustard, hot pepper sauce, salt and liquid smoke, if used.  Stir until well blended.  Pour over chicken.  Bake at 450° for 20 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink in center.  6 servings.

name: MARINATED MUSHROOMS 2
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil
3  Tbsp. minced onion
1  clove garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. tomato sauce
1/4  c. dry white wine
1/4  c. water
2  cloves
1/8  tsp. saffron
salt
freshly ground pepper
1/2  lb. very small mushrooms, washed and stems removed
preparation: Heat the oil in a small, deep casserole and saute the onion and garlic until onion is transparent.  Stir in tomato sauce, wine, water, cloves, saffron, salt and pepper.  Simmer, covered, for 45 minutes, adding more water, if necessary.  Add the mushrooms to the cooking liquid and simmer 5 minutes more.  Turn off heat, cover and let cool.  Refrigerate overnight.  Serve cold or at room temperature.

name: RANCH DIP
ingredients:
24  oz. carton fat-free cottage cheese
8  Tbsp. fat-free sour cream
1 (1 oz.)  pkg. dry Ranch dressing mix
raw vegetables for dipping
preparation: In blender or food processor, pour all cottage cheese and blend until smooth and creamy.  Blend about 5 minutes longer after getting smooth and creamy.  Add no fat sour cream and blend until mixed well.  Add dry dressing mix and blend together.  Can use with raw vegetables or on baked potato.

name: ONION PIE
ingredients:
1  c. crushed saltine crackers
1/2  c. butter
2  c. sliced onions
2  Tbsp. butter
3/4  c. milk
2  eggs, slightly beaten
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. grated cheese
dash of pepper
paprika
preparation: Mix cracker crumbs with melted butter (1/4 cup).  Press into pie plate.  Cook onions in butter (1/4 cup), stirring to separate, until tender.  Press into cracker shell.  Combine eggs, milk, salt and pepper.  Pour over onions.  Top with cheese.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: CHEDDAR BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
3  large baking potatoes
1/2  stick butter
1  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. onion, grated
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated or 1/4 c. Blue cheese, grated
3  Tbsp. Cheddar cheese, grated
paprika
preparation: Bake potatoes for 1 hour at 400° or until done.  Cut hot potatoes in half lengthwise.  Scoop out potatoes and save the shells.  In a mixing bowl, mash the potatoes.  Add butter, cream, onion and salt.  Beat until fluffy.  Mix in 1/2 cup cheese.  Divide into shells and sprinkle with cheese and paprika.  Serves 6.

name: CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  cup Martha White self-rising cornmeal mix
1  egg
2  Tbsp. bacon grease (vegetable oil may be substituted)
1/2  cup onion, chopped fine
1/4  cup pimento, chopped fine
1  cup buttermilk*
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Place all ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix thoroughly. Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Coat a well-seasoned black iron skillet or corn-stick pan with enough bacon grease to cover. IMPORTANT:  Place greased skillet or pan in preheated oven until it begins to smoke (three to four minutes) to create a crunchy crust on the bottom.  When the pan is ready, add the cornbread mixture and return to the hot oven.  Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown (bake muffins and corn-sticks 15-20 minutes).  Serve while hot with softened butter.

name: TURKEY ALMOND SUPREME
ingredients:
4  c. diced cooked turkey
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  oz. chopped pimento
10  oz. cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. noodles
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. water
1  c. dairy sour cream
1/2  c. sliced almonds
preparation: You can use leftover turkey or roast a 2 pound turkey roast; cut turkey into bite size pieces.  Cook together butter, onion, celery and green pepper for 5 minutes.  Stir in turkey, soy sauce, water, pimento and mushroom soup.  Cook noodles and drain, stir sour cream into noodles and combine with the turkey mixture.  Put in a 3-quart casserole.  Sprinkle the almonds over all.  Bake at 350° for about an hour.  Makes 8 generous servings.

name: SHISH KABOB
ingredients:
1  c. vegetable oil
1  c. red wine
2  Tbsp. wine vinegar
3  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. pepper
6  lb. chuck steak, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1  lb. large fresh mushrooms
9  medium white onions, peeled and quartered
6  large green peppers, cut into 1-inch pieces
1  pt. cherry tomatoes
preparation: In a bowl, stir together first 5 ingredients to make marinade. Place steak cubes in a large, shallow pan.  Pour marinade over steak and stir to coat.  Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours, stir occasionally.  Oil 12 long skewers.  Skewer meat alternately with vegetables, beginning and ending with meat.  Broil or grill for about 20 minutes.  Brush with marinade while cooking.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: CHICKEN IN A GARDEN
ingredients:
2  c. cooked chicken, cut in cubes
1  can Durkee French fried onions
1  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, thawed
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Combine all ingredients and pour in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 375° for 45 minutes.  Serve over noodles or rice.

name: DILL MEAT - FRICASSEE
ingredients:
about 2 lb. lamb (on the bone)
water (enough to cover the meat)
salt
8  white peppercorns
1  small peeled carrot
1  leek, cut into pieces
preparation: Take lamb on the bone; e.g., from the shoulder or back.  If necessary, rinse the meat under cold running water.  Place it in a saucepan.  Measure enough water to cover the meat.  Add 2 teaspoons salt per 1 quart of water.  Bring to a boil.  Skim off thoroughly.  Add peppercorns, carrot and leek.  Cover the saucepan and let the meat simmer over a low heat until tender (1 to 1 1/2 hours).  Strain the liquid.  Keep the meat hot.  Make the gravy.

name: SNOW BALL CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  pkg. unflavored gelatin
2 1/2  c. sliced pineapple, drained
1  c. sugar
5  pkg. whipped topping
1  angel food cake
1  c. chopped pecans
1  can flaked coconut
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in 5 tablespoons water.  Add 1 cup boiling water.  Add pineapple, sugar and lemon juice.  Mix well. Refrigerate until thick.  Whip 4 packages whipped topping.  Break cake into bite-sized pieces.  Add cake to topping.  Add nuts and vanilla.  Add to refrigerated mixture.  Mix.  Transfer to buttered tube pan.  Refrigerate overnight.  Whip remaining topping.  Ice cake.  Sprinkle with coconut.

name: QUICK AND EASY BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1 (16 to 18 oz.)  can pork and beans
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
2  slices bacon, cut in 1-inch pieces
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/4  c. catsup
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Bake, covered, in greased casserole at 350° for 20 minutes.  Uncover and continue baking 20 minutes. Serves 4.

name: HONEY NUT CRUNCH
ingredients:
3  c. corn bran cereal
1  c. Quaker oats
1  c. pecans
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. margarine
1/3  c. honey
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  In large bowl, mix cereal, oats, nuts, cinnamon and salt.  In small saucepan, mix butter, honey and brown sugar.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until butter is melted and ingredients are well blended.  Pour honey and butter mixture over cereal; mix until thoroughly coated.  Spread into 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until mixture is golden brown, turning occasionally.  Immediately spread mixture onto waxed paper.  Stir in raisins.  Cool completely.  Store in tightly covered container.

name: AUNT ERNA'S EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  c. sugar
2  c. milk
1  (9-inch) deep dish pie shell
nutmeg (optional)
preparation: Combine eggs, salt and flavoring.  Beat, beat, beat until mixture begins to look thick.  Gradually add sugar and beat constantly.  Scald milk and pour into mixture, stirring as you pour milk in.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  This will seem to be too much, but add it all.  It does not bubble or run over.  Bake for 40 to 50 minutes at 350°.  The pie will shake like jello when done. Sprinkle top with nutmeg if desired.

name: BARBECUE MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1/2  c. milk
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
4 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. ketchup
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
preparation: Mix bread crumbs with milk in bowl. Add ground beef and salt. Mix well. Shape into balls. Put in baking dish. Mix well the remaining ingredients and pour over meat balls. Bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes until done.

name: HEARTY VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
5  qt. water
2  pkg. Manischewitz lima bean soup mix with barley
1  c. large lima beans
6  chicken bouillon cubes
6  carrots
6  medium potatoes
10  oz. fresh mushrooms
2  cans stewed tomatoes
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: In a large soup pot, add water, soup starter, lima beans and bouillon cubes.  Simmer for 1 hour.  Cut vegetables and add after first hour.  Simmer on low for 1 hour.  Stewed tomatoes can be added at this time, along with flavor packs from soup mix.  Season to taste with pepper and extra bouillon.  Continue simmering for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
3  c. water
3  c. sugar
2  pkg. strawberry jello (dry)
1 large  can strawberry drink
6  qt. water
preparation: Take 3 cups water and sugar.  Bring to a boil and boil one minute.  Then add dry jello, strawberry drink and 6 quarts of water. Put in freezer until frozen, then chop up good, it  will be a slush.

name: STRAWBERRY-NUT SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1  c. boiling water (combine and mix well)
2  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1 medium  can crushed pineapple
3  bananas, mashed
1  c. nuts
preparation: Combine Jell-O and boiling water and mix well.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Spread 1/2 mixture in a glass baking dish.  Chill well until set.  Spread with 1 pint of sour cream. Carefully spoon rest of strawberry mixture over top.  Chill until solid.  Serve plain or on lettuce.

name: "YUMMY" STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
2 1/2  c. boiling water
1 small  pkg. frozen strawberries
3  bananas, sliced (medium)
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  pt. sour cream
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Add strawberries and stir until thawed.  Add sliced bananas and chopped pecans.  Pour half of mixture into 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan and hold in refrigerator or freezer until firm.   Jell remaining half only to thicken.

name: SUPER POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  large potatoes
4 to 5  Tbsp. green pepper, chopped
1  tsp. salt and 1/2 tsp. black pepper
6  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  stick oleo, melted
1 1/2  Tbsp. chopped pimento (optional)
1  c. grated cheese
1/4  c. milk
preparation: Cook potatoes in jackets.  Cool.  Peel and cube.  Stir in green pepper, onion, milk, cheese, salt and black pepper.  Mix well.  Turn into greased casserole; sprinkle with chopped dried parsley.  Pour all of melted oleo over potato mixture.  Bake at 400° for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: FILLMORE STREET OATMEAL PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
3  eggs plus 1 yolk
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1 1/4  tsp. vanilla
juice of 1/2 lemon
1  c. quick oats
1  prepared pie crust
preparation: Partially bake crust.  Beat eggs.  Gradually add sugar, syrup, vanilla and juice.  Stir in oats.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.  Freezes well.

name: TATER TOT RECIPE
ingredients:
2  lb. bag Tater Tots, defrosted
1  can cream of chicken soup
16  oz. sour cream
2  c. shredded Cheddar
chopped onion (medium)
salt and pepper
corn flake crumbs with melted butter
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients  in  an oblong baking dish. Sprinkle buttered crumbs on top.  Bake  at  300° for 1 hour or higher degree for less time.

name: MOTHER MAC'S GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  egg
1/2  c. shortening
1/4  c. molasses
1  tsp. ginger
dash of cloves
dash of mace
dash of cinnamon
preparation: Mix well.  Pour into a greased pan (square).  Bake about 15 or 20 minutes at 350°.  Serve with whipped topping or lemon sauce.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. bag frozen hash brown potatoes
1/2  c. margarine
1  can cream of chicken soup or cream of mushroom
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  pt. sour cream
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  c. American cheese, shredded
preparation: Melt margarine.  Warm soup; add margarine, sour cream, salt and pepper.  Pour over hash browns, cheese and onions; mix well. Bake in large casserole at 350° for one hour.

name: SPOON BURGERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2/3  c. chopped onions
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed chicken gumbo soup, undiluted
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. catsup
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1/3  c. bell pepper
preparation: Brown onions and beef together.  Add soup, salt, pepper, water, catsup and mustard.  Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes.  Spoon on hamburger buns.

name: BLACKBERRY BUTTER
ingredients:
1/2  lb. (2 sticks) unsalted butter, at room temperature
1/2  c. ripe blackberries (fresh or frozen), drained
preparation: In food processor, process the butter and berries to a smooth puree.  The butter will be a deep pink color.  Spoon butter into cute serving dish and refrigerate 1 hour before serving.  Serve with a small butter spreader, to accompany scones or homemade rolls.

name: HOT FRUIT DRINK
ingredients:
6  qt. water
2 cinnamon  sticks or 1 tsp. cinnamon
1 large  can frozen orange juice
1  pt. ReaLemon juice
2  c. sugar
preparation: Boil the water and cinnamon together for 10 minutes.  Add orange juice, lemon juice and sugar.  Simmer all ingredients until sugar is dissolved.  Serve hot.  Makes a large recipe.

name: CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
4  beaten eggs
1/2  c. sugar
2 1/4 to 2 1/2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. almond extract
nutmeg (as desired)
preparation: Mix 1/2 cup milk with beaten eggs.  Heat 2 cups of the milk, then dissolve sugar in the milk.  Add salt, vanilla and almond. Pour into a pie shell that has been baked for 5 minutes.  Top with nutmeg.  Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 400°.  Cool.

name: NEVER FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
dash of salt
1/3  c. cold water
3/4  c. shortening
preparation: Cut flour, salt and shortening together until well blended and in small pieces.  Add water.  Stir just until mixed.  Dough will be sticky and if needed, can be rolled twice without worry.  Makes 2 crusts.

name: CRAB PUFFS
ingredients:
7  oz. can crabmeat
1  jar Kraft Old English sharp cheese spread
1  stick margarine
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. seasoned salt
1  pkg. English muffins
preparation: Mix everything.  Spread mixture on muffins and then cut in fours.  Broil 6 to 8 minutes.

name: MOM'S BLUEBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. unsifted flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
4  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  c. drained crushed pineapple
2  c. fresh blueberries
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Sift flour with baking powder, soda and salt.  Cream shortening until light and fluffy.  Gradually beat in sugar.  Stir in eggs, milk, lemon juice and pineapple.

name: PINEAPPLE NUT PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  large Cool Whip
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. chopped pecans
2  graham cracker crusts
preparation: Mix together and pour into crusts.  Chill overnight.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1  can Ranch Style beans, washed and drained
Catalina dressing
tomatoes
onion
olives, green and black
boiled eggs (optional)
avocado
Cheddar cheese, grated
1 large  pkg. Doritos, crushed
preparation: Add cheese, dressing and chips last, just before serving.

name: FRIED RICE
ingredients:
6  strips bacon
1  large carrot, grated
1  large onion
1/2  c. celery
1/2  c. cabbage
1/2  c. green pepper
2  eggs, scrambled
4  c. cooked rice
3  Tbsp. soy sauce + powdered ginger
1 small  can shrimp
preparation: Fry bacon until crisp.  Divide drippings in thirds.  Cook eggs in first drippings; take out of pan.  Add second drippings and cook vegetables.  Remove; add third drippings and stir-fry rice.  Add eggs and vegetables to rice.  Add seasoning.

name: EASY HAYSTACKS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can peanuts
1 large  can Chinese noodles
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch morsels
preparation: Melt the butterscotch morsels in double boiler, being careful not to let water boil.  Add nuts and noodles.  Mix and drop on wax paper to cool.  Enjoy!

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  qt. fresh strawberries (crush half)
3/4  c. water
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Cook crushed berries with the other 4 ingredients until thickened.  Pour over the whole berries in a baked pie shell. Cool and serve with whipped cream.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  large tomato sauce
1  large tomato paste
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
2 (1 qt.)  cans tomatoes
1/4  c. sugar
minced garlic
1  bay leaf
1  pepperoni stick, chopped (optional)
preparation: Brown ground beef, onion and pepper (optional).  Add sauce, paste, tomatoes and remaining ingredients.  Add pepperoni and simmer until ready.

name: CHOCOLATE COVERED CHERRIES
ingredients:
1  box powdered sugar
1/4  c. butter
1/4  can Eagle Brand milk
18  oz. chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pinch salt
2  jars cherries
1  stick paraffin wax
preparation: Cream sugar and butter.  Add vanilla, salt and milk (small amount at a time).  (Mixture will be dry.)  Melt chocolate and wax until it begins to thicken.  Dip cherries in chocolate.  Put on wax paper.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked squash, chopped
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1 1/2  c. cracker crumbs
1/2  c. herb stuffing mix
1  c. evaporated milk
1/4  c. chopped mushrooms (optional)
1/2  c. chopped pecans (optional)
4  strips crisp bacon bits
1  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. sugar
3/4  c. margarine
1  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour into greased 2-quart casserole dish.  Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

name: SMOKED PORK WITH KRAUT
ingredients:
1  tsp. flour
1  (3 lb.) smoked boneless pork shoulder butt
1 (27 oz.)  can Libby's sauerkraut, drained
1/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  medium apple, peeled and diced
1/2 to 3/4  tsp. caraway seed
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Place flour in a 14 x 20-inch cooking bag. Shake to coat inside.  Place pork in bag. Close with twisted tie. Place slits in top of bag.  Bake at 350° for 2 hours.  Remove from oven and open bag.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Mix well. Spoon over and around pork.  Re-tie bag and bake for 40 minutes longer.

name: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD LO-CAL AND FAT FREE!
ingredients:
8  to 10 packets Equal
1  qt. buttermilk
1/8  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 (17 oz.)  can fruit cocktail or mixed fruit, drained
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients well.  Gently fold in fruit.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze.  Cut in squares and serve. Serves 12 to 15.

name: KAHLUA
ingredients:
8  c. sugar
4  c. water
1 1/2  c. instant coffee (dry)
1/2  gal. vodka
2  vanilla beans, cut up
preparation: Boil sugar, water and coffee.  Cool.  Add vodka and vanilla beans.  Pour into 2 1/2 gallon bottles.  Turn upside-down for one week.  Reverse for one week, then upside-down again.  Finished at the end of third week.

name: NO-BAKE BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
1  (12 oz.) bakery made angel food cake
1 (5 oz.)  pkg. instant banana pudding, made according to directions
3  bananas, sliced and diced
1  (12 oz.) container whipped topping (Cool Whip)
preparation: Break the angel food cake into small pieces.  Place about 1/3 of the cake in a rinsed 1 1/2-quart mold.  Make banana pudding according to directions.  Fold sliced bananas in pudding, then fold pudding with whipped topping (reserving enough to top each slice of cake).  Spoon some of the pudding mixture over the cake, alternating pudding and cake pieces until the mold is filled. Chill in refrigerator overnight if possible.  When ready to serve, unmold on cake plate and cut in slices.  Top each slice with whipped topping.

name: MAID'S NIGHT OUT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  thick loin pork chops
2  large Idaho Russet potatoes
1  large onion
salt
pepper
whole sage leaves, crushed
paprika
butter
preparation: Butter a large baking dish and cover with one layer of thinly sliced potatoes and onion.  Sprinkle with salt, pepper, crushed particles of sage leaves and small pieces of butter.  Repeat until potatoes are used up.  Place pork chops on top and sprinkle with salt, pepper, sage, paprika and butter.  Bake at 350° for one hour.  Turn chops and bake until brown.

name: BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. All-Bran
1 1/4  c. milk
1  egg
1/4  c. oil
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix All-Bran and milk; set aside for 3 minutes.  Add egg and oil; mix.  Add rest of ingredients.  Pour into 12 muffin cups and bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: RED CABBAGE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. of lard or peanut oil
1  head of red cabbage, cored and shredded
1  apple, peeled and diced
1  Tbsp. vinegar
Salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Melt the lard, or use oil, in a large pot.  Add the cabbage and the apple to the pot and stir to mix with the oil.  Cover the pot and cook over medium low heat for about 45 minutes.  Stir occasionally.  Add salt and pepper, mix.  Add the vinegar and stir well.

name: CHEESY CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
1  envelope taco seasoning
1 (16 oz.)  jar chunky salsa
1 (15 oz.)  can black beans, rinsed and drained
1 (8.75 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
2  c. Mexican Blend shredded cheese, divided
1 (15 oz.)  can enchilada sauce, divided
8  flour tortillas
2  Tbsp. sliced ripe olives
preparation: Prepare chicken with taco seasoning as directed on package of taco seasoning mix; cool 10 minutes. Stir in salsa, beans, corn and 1 cup cheese. Spread 1/4 cup enchilada sauce on bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Place 2/3 cup chicken mixture down center of each tortilla; roll up. Place in dish seam side down, on top of sauce.  Pour remaining enchilada sauce over tortillas; sprinkle with remaining cheese and the sliced ripe olives. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and filling is hot.

name: MOCHA FROSTY
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
2/3  c. water
1  Tbsp. instant coffee granules
2  c. milk
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
frozen whipped topping, thawed
preparation: Combine the first 3 ingredients in a small saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Add coffee granules, stirring to dissolve.  Chill.  Combine chocolate mixture, milk and ice cream in container of electric blender; process until smooth.  Top each serving with a dollop of whipped topping.  Serve immediately. Yields 5 cups.

name: CORN AND SPINACH BISCUITS
ingredients:
4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2/3  c. shortening
1  c. buttermilk *
3  large eggs
1 (11 oz.)  can vacuum-packed white corn, drained
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese (1 c.)
preparation: About 45 minutes before serving or early in day:  Preheat oven to 425°.  In large bowl, mix flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda.  With pastry blender or two knives used scissor-fashion, cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.

name: BASIC SWEET DOUGH
ingredients:
3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  pkg. active dry yeast
1/3  c. warm water (105~ to 115~)
3  eggs (at room temperature)
5 1/2 to 6 1/2  c. all-purpose flour (I use 5 c. and check to see how tight the dough is)
preparation: Combine milk, sugar, salt and butter in small saucepan.  Heat over low heat until butter melts and sugar dissolves.  Cool. Dissolve yeast in warm water in a warmed bowl.  Add lukewarm milk mixture, eggs and 5 cups flour.  Attach bowl and dough hook; mix 2 minutes on speed 2.  Continue beating.  Add remaining flour 1/2 cup at a time until dough clings to hook, about 2 minutes.  Knead and place in greased bowl.  Grease top.  Cover and let rise in warm place until double in bulk, about 1 hour.  Punch down.  Make cinnamon rolls.

name: SWEETENED CONDENSED MILK
ingredients:
1/2  c. boiling water
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1 1/3  c. instant dry milk
preparation: Measure all ingredients and have ready before starting.  Pour boiling water into blender.  Add butter or oleo, then sugar, then dry milk.  Blend once, briefly, and scrape down the sides of container.   Then blend until smooth, about 30 seconds.  Pour and let stand until cool and thickened.  Use immediately or cover and refrigerate.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP KISS COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. (2 sticks) butter or margarine, softened
1/3  c. granulated sugar
1/3  c. packed light brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. Hershey's mini semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  (9 oz.) bag Hershey Kisses or Kisses with almonds; milk chocolate, unwrapped
Chocolate Drizzle (optional)
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  In a large mixing bowl, beat the butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla until well blended.  Add flour to butter mixture; blend until smooth.  Stir in small chocolate chips.  Mold scant tablespoonful of dough around each unwrapped Kiss, covering completely.  Shape into balls; place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set.  Cool slightly; move from cookie sheet to wire rack.  Cool completely.  Prepare Chocolate Drizzle, if desired.  Drizzle over each cookie.  Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. raw cranberries
1  c. Jonathan apples
1  c. sugar
1  c. pineapple juice
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. purple seedless grapes
1 large  box cherry jello
1  c. hot water
preparation: Grind cranberries, apples and grapes.  Dissolve jello in hot water.  Combine all ingredients and let sit overnight.

name: CHUCK WAGON BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bacon slices
3  lb. ground beef
3  c. chopped onion
1  c. finely chopped celery
2  beef bouillon cubes
2/3  c. boiling water
1 1/2  cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2  c. catsup
3  tsp. prepared mustard
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2 (29 oz. each)  cans any style beans
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  In a large skillet, fry bacon until crisp. Set aside. Drain fat from pan.  In the same pan, cook and stir ground beef, onion and celery until meat is brown and onion is tender.  Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water. Stir bouillon and remaining ingredients into meat mixture.  Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until hot and bubbly.  Crumble bacon and sprinkle over beans.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked rice
1  lb. ground chuck
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can chopped chilies (small size)
1  medium onion, chopped
1  medium bell pepper, chopped
1  large cabbage, cut up
salt and pepper
preparation: Cut up cabbage.  Chop onion and bell pepper.  Mix cabbage, onion and bell pepper in large bowl.  Brown ground chuck and mix with cabbage.  Yield:  6 servings.

name: LOBSTER
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. lobster
boiling water
salt
1  c. cold water
preparation: Plunge lobster into boiling water to cover; remove.  Place salt, 1 cup water, cooking rack and lobster into pressure cooker. Close cover securely and place regulator on vent pipe.  Cook 4 to 5 minutes.  Cool pressure at once.  Plunge lobster into cold water; remove.  Crack shell.  Makes 2 to 3 servings.

name: BLUEBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  butter cake mix
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  pt. blueberries (sprinkle with flour)
3  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix everything but blueberries.  Fold in blueberries.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CRACKLE TOP GINGER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  egg
2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. molasses
4  c. sifted flour
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Add egg and mix well.  Stir in molasses.  Sift together dry ingredients.  Combine with molasses mixture.  Chill thoroughly.  Roll dough in small balls about 1 inch in diameter.  Roll in granulated sugar.  Place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet and bake at 325° about 18 to 20 minutes. Yield:  8 dozen.

name: 5 MINUTE CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  stick margarine
1/2 soup  can water
1 1/2  c. rice (not instant or Minute)
1  cut up chicken
preparation: You can throw this together in 5 minutes!

name: MONGOL SOUP
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup
1  can consomme
1  can green pea soup
1 soup  can water
1  Tbsp. sherry or Madeira
preparation: Mix all ingredients and heat until hot.  Very simple.  Great in winter!

name: SWEDISH MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  egg
1  slice bread, crumbled
salt to taste
1  medium onion, chopped
1/4  tsp. allspice
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. vinegar
ketchup
1  Tbsp. flour
1  can tomato sauce
1  can water
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except meat.  Let sit for a few minutes, then add meat.  Roll into meat balls.  Brown in skillet, turning often.  Remove from skillet and place in a large pot.

name: ENGLISH PEA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 large (1 lb.)  can LeSueur peas, drained
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts, sliced
1  medium onion, chopped or grated
2  oz. jar pimento, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup, diluted
1  c. grated sharp cheese
3/4  stick melted margarine
1  c. Ritz crackers, crushed
preparation: Combine peas, chestnuts, onion, pimento and soup.  Mix together the margarine and crackers and sprinkle over the top. Add cheese.  Bake at 400° until top is bubbly.

name: ZESTY VEGGIES
ingredients:
1 (2 1/2 oz.)  jar mushrooms
1 1/2  c. cauliflowerets
1  c. broccoli flowerets
1  c. celery, cut into 2-inch strips (about 2 stalks)
3/4  c. tarragon vinegar
1/3  c. oil
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Drain the mushrooms and reserve the liquid.  Add enough water to liquid to make 1 cup.  In large skillet, combine all ingredients.  Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.  Simmer about 5 minutes.  Cool and refrigerate in a tightly covered bowl for at least 24 hours.

name: RECIPE FOR A HAPPY HOME
ingredients:
1  c. love
1  c. thoughtfulness
1  c. friendship
preparation: Blend together with a pinch of tenderness and 1 big dash of loyalty.  Blend in faith, hope and charity.  Add a spoonful of compassion and one of ability to laugh at little things.   Moisten with tears of joy, sorrow and sympathy.  Bake in a pan of good nature and serve repeatedly.

name: THREE CHEESE VEGETABLE LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
1  garlic clove, minced
1  c. sliced mushrooms
1  c. chopped carrots
1/2  c. diced green pepper
3  c. canned tomatoes, crushed
8  cooked lasagna noodles
1  Tbsp. dried parsley
1/2  tsp. each: basil, oregano and chili powder
1/4  tsp. dried rosemary
pepper to taste
3  oz. grated Romano cheese
5  oz. Mozzarella cheese
1 1/3  c. cottage cheese
preparation: Saute the first 5 ingredients in nonstick skillet until vegetables are softened.  Add tomatoes and spices.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Mix cheeses.  Spoon half of sauce in bottom of a sprayed 12 x 8-inch casserole dish.  Place 1/2 noodles on top.  Spread with half cheeses; place noodles on top, and top with remaining sauce and cheeses.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: SWEET AND SOUR ROAST
ingredients:
1  onion, finely chopped
1/2  c. margarine (or less)
6  slices bread, cubed
5  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/4  tsp. Accent
1/2  lb. (2 c.) grated cheese
19  oz. vegeburger
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients and press into greased casserole.  Top with sauce.

name: MAGIC COOKIE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. graham crackers
1 1/4  c. coconut
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped pecans
1  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place  butter  in  a 13 x 9-inch pan. Place in oven to melt. Remove pan. Sprinkle coconut over crumbs. Add layer of  chips  and pecans.  Pour condensed milk over top. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.	Cut. Makes 30 bars.

name: HUNGRY JACK BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. salt (optional)
16  oz. can pork and beans
1/2  c. barbecue sauce
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1 (9.5 oz.)  can Hungry Jack flaky biscuits
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain.  Stir in the next 6 ingredients. Heat until bubbly.  Pour into 2-quart casserole dish.  Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles.  Place cut side down around inside edge of casserole.  Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top of biscuits.  Preheat oven to 375°.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.  Refrigerate any leftovers. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1 1/3  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. dried parsley
2  tsp. Lawry's seasoned salt
2  tsp. dried dill weed
1  tsp. Accent
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
8  drops Tabasco sauce
preparation: Make day before serving.  Serve with your favorite vegetables.

name: PLAIN OLE VANILLA WEDDING CAKE
ingredients:
800  lb. sugar
75  gal. butter
25  c. vanilla
600  lb. sifted cake flour
2 1/2  lb. baking powder
94  gal. milk
7200  stiffly beaten egg whites
preparation: Cream together sugar, vanilla and butter in bathtub.  Stir together flour and baking powder in a separate tub.  Find a larger container perhaps an unused grain silo.  Add cake flour to creamed mixture, alternately adding milk.  Fold in egg whites.  Pour into as many number 12 washtubs as you can find, making all layers about the same size.  Cover washtubs and place in a building that will take 28 to 30 minutes to burn down.  Remove from debris.  Frost with relatively new rowboat oars.  Serves everybody.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1 large  can pumpkin
1  c. oil
4  c. sugar
3  eggs
5  c. flour
3  tsp. soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. clove
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix together  the first 4 ingredients.	Add the remaining ingredients.  Mix real well.  Put in 3 loaf pans.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
1/2  c. shortening
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
3  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  1/4 c milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter, shortening and sugar in a bowl until light and fluffy.  Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Sift dry ingredients together and add, alternating with milk; beat well after each addition.  Stir in vanilla.  Spoon into a greased, floured Bundt pan.  Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours or until done.  Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes and turn onto a cake plate.

name: STUFFED SWEET BANANA PEPPERS
ingredients:
1  loaf sliced Italian bread (day old)
1  onion
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1  fresh garlic clove
1  egg
grated cheese
banana sweet peppers
salt and pepper
preparation: Wet bread with water.  Squeeze out excess water.  Break into small pieces in bowl.  Grind onion, parsley flakes and garlic together in a blender with a little water.  Strain.  Saute in a skillet with small amount of butter and olive oil.  Add to pieces of bread.  Add egg, cheese, salt and pepper.  Take seeds out of peppers.  Fill with stuffing.  Rub peppers with oil.  Rub bottom of pan with oil.  Cook on lowest heat.  Turn often.  Cook 1 hour.

name: CHILLI BEANS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground chuck, browned and drained
1/2  green pepper
1/2  onion
1  pkg. Chili-O mix
1  can tomatoes
1  can (small) tomato sauce
2 (16 oz.)  cans Luck's pinto beans
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans
small amount of oil
Italian sausage (optional)
preparation: Drain liquid from beans.  Chop onion and pepper and set aside. Mix beans, browned chuck and Chili-O mix (follow directions on package); pour in oil.  Stir; add pepper.  Cook in crock-pot for 1 1/2 hours.

name: GATOR OLLIE'S BLACK BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
2  c. black beans
3  qt. water
2  sticks chopped celery
2  large onions, chopped
1  stick butter
1  bay leaf
1 1/4  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. chopped fresh parsley
1  tsp. fried meat seasoning or ham hock
1  1/2 scallions, finely chopped
1/2  c. sweet red wine
salt to taste
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
1/4  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Soak beans overnight; rinse.  Add water to cover and cook over low heat for 1 1/2 hours.  In soup kettle, saute celery and onions with butter until tender.  Blend in flour and parsley and cook 1 minute.  Slowly stir in beans and liquid.  Add fried meat grease, scallions, bay leaf, salt and pepper.  Simmer 4 hours on low heat; remove bay leaf and any bones.  Puree beans in blender.  Add pureed beans back to broth with wine; bring to boil.  Remove from heat and serve.

name: MARIE'S GINGERED CARROTS
ingredients:
8  to 10 carrots
2  c. water
dash of salt
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. ginger
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Peel and slice carrots. Place in saucepan with water and salt. Cook on medium heat until almost done. Add sugar, butter and ginger. Simmer until most of the liquid is gone.   Serve hot.

name: PORK CHOPS AND RICE
ingredients:
10  pork chops
1  lb. rice (not instant)
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  cans onion soup
3 soup  cans hot water
preparation: Brown  chops  in  14-inch Dutch oven.  Remove and place them on	Dutch  oven  lid.  Mix	rice,  soups  and  3 soup can measures of	hot water in 14-inch Dutch oven.  Lay the browned chops on this  mixture.  Bake  in  Dutch oven for 45 minutes, covered.

name: STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
12  to 16 mushrooms
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
3/4  c. mayonnaise
10  strips bacon, fried and crumbled
seasoned salt to taste
preparation: Wash mushrooms, break off caps.  Stuff mushrooms with mixture. Broil 7 to 10 minutes (watch, do not burn).

name: GREEN ENCHILADAS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  medium onion, diced
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 soup  can milk
1 flat  can chopped green chilies
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  pkg. Doritos corn chips
preparation: In skillet brown hamburger and onion.  Set aside.  In a saucepan heat remaining ingredients, except corn chips, until cheese is melted.  In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish alternately layer meat, corn chips and cheese sauce.  Repeat.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: PEACH PUSHOVER
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can peach halves
1/4  tsp. orange extract
1  Tbsp. melted butter
1 (1 layer)  pkg. white cake mix
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Pour undrained peaches into 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Stir in orange extract and 1 tablespoon butter.  Sprinkle with cake mix. Dot with remaining 1 tablespoon butter.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Yield:  6 servings.

name: URSULA'S COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. butter
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  egg yolk
3/4  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. milk
1/4  tsp. almond flavoring
preparation: Sift together flour and baking powder; set aside.  Cream butter and confectioners sugar.  Add egg yolk and beat 1 minute. Add milk, vanilla and almond flavoring to creamed mixture.  Blend together.  Add dry ingredients and mix well.

name: EGG-IN-A-HOLE
ingredients:
1  slice bread
1  egg
butter
salt and pepper
preparation: Tear an egg size hole in the middle of the bread.  Grease the top of the hot tin-can stove with margarine.  Lay bread on the stove and break the egg into the hole of the bread.  Cook until egg begins to harden on the bottom and bread turns brown underneath. Insert pancake turner under to peek; put more margarine on the stove top.  Turn over the bread and egg to cook the other side. Add salt and pepper to taste.  Remove to a plate to eat.

name: STREUSEL MIX
ingredients:
1/2  c. light brown sugar (firmly packed)
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. ground cinnamon
3  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. pecans, finely chopped
preparation: Combine sugar, flour and cinnamon in a bowl.  Cut in butter with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal.  Stir in pecans.  Yields about 1 1/3 cups.

name: COCOA SUISSE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. Borden Cremora
1/2  c. nonfat dry milk
1/3  c. cocoa
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl; blend well.  Store in airtight container.  Makes 2 cups of mix.

name: CHICKEN PARMESAN
ingredients:
1  egg
2  lb. chicken parts
1/2  c. Italian flavored bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1  can cream of tomato soup
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. oregano
shredded Mozzarella cheese
grated fresh Parmesan cheese
preparation: Beat egg with 1 tablespoon of water.  Dip chicken in egg mixture and roll in bread crumbs.  Brown in oil in a frypan. Drain fat.  Stir in soup, 1/4 cup water, onion and seasonings. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes or until done.  Stir occasionally.  Just before serving, sprinkle with cheeses and heat until cheese melts.  Sprinkle with additional oregano leaves or parsley, if desired.  Serves 4.

name: SPINACH SPREAD OR SALAD(Serves 15)
ingredients:
4  boxes frozen chopped spinach
1/2  c. celery, finely chopped
1/2  c. onion, finely chopped
3/4  c. Cheddar cheese
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. Miracle Whip
1 1/2  tsp. vinegar
2  dashes Tabasco sauce
1  Tbsp. horseradish
2  hard-boiled eggs
preparation: Thaw spinach and squeeze out all water.  Combine all ingredients except eggs.  If serving as salad use diced Cheddar cheese (1/2 inch cubes) and garnish top with sliced eggs.  If a cracker spread is desired, change Cheddar cheese to shredded variety and add a little more Miracle Whip for easier spreading. Eliminate eggs. Extra horseradish and Tabasco give it some real zip.  Also crumbled bacon as a garnish is an option.

name: TUNA MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. macaroni
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 (7 oz.)  can tuna, drained and flaked
1  green onion, chopped
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook macaroni in pan according to directions.  Combine all ingredients in bowl; toss gently to mix well.  Cover; refrigerate for 1 hour.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
1  10 inch unbaked pie crust
1  c. cottage cheese
dash salt
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
2  eggs separated
1  c. cream or evaporated milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together cottage cheese, salt, sugar, flour, egg yolks and cream. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites and pour into pie shell. Bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour. Delicious served with maple syrup.

name: BROCCOLI RICE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. margarine
