1  medium onion, minced
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1 (8 oz.)  jar cheese spread
1 (10 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
3  c. cooked rice
1 (3 oz.)  can French fried onion rings (optional)
preparation: In a medium saucepan, gently cook onion in margarine until wilted.  Stir in the mustard, then the cheese spread.  Gradually stir in the soup.  Add broccoli and rice; stir gently.  Put in buttered casserole dish and bake in a 350° oven for about 20 minutes.  Put onion rings on top of casserole before baking.

name: KAHLUA
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
3  c. water
1/2  c. instant coffee
1  qt. 100 proof vodka
3  Tbsp. pure vanilla (not imitation)
preparation: Boil sugar and water.  Simmer 1 hour.  Mix coffee and 1 cup boiling water; let cool.  Add vodka and vanilla.  Makes 2 quarts.

name: CHICKEN DE MAYONNAISE
ingredients:
2  c. diced chicken
1  can tiny green peas
1  c. chopped celery
4  boiled eggs
2  Tbsp. capers
2  Tbsp. chow chow pickles
preparation: If you can't get capers and chow chow pickles, use 2 tablespoons Durkee dressing and 1/2 cup chopped sour pickles. Salt and pepper to taste.

name: PINEAPPLE SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Mix sugar, flour, soda and salt.  Add eggs, oil and pineapple. Spread in greased and floured sheet pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
10  strips lasagna noodles
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. favorite spaghetti sauce
1/4  c. sour cream
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  lb. creamed cottage cheese
1 1/2 (8 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella, thinly sliced
preparation: Cook noodles as package directs; drain, then toss with 2 tablespoons oil until well coated.  In skillet, brown ground beef, then drain very well.  Add salt, pepper and spaghetti sauce and stir well.  Combine cottage cheese with sour cream.  Arrange half of noodles in 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish; cover with half of meat-sauce mixture, next a layer of cheese slices (using 1 package); then all of cottage cheese mixture.  Top with remaining noodles, then rest of Mozzarella in 1/2-inch strips, laid "lattice-fashion" across top.  Then spoon rest of meat-sauce mixture into lattice spaces.  Cover tightly with Saran or foil and refrigerate.  About a half hour before serving, start heating oven to 350°.  Brush surface of cheese strips with oil.  Bake 30 minutes or until cheese melts and is golden.

name: NO-BAKE CHOCOLATE COOKIES(Avoid The Heat)
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. quick oats
1/2  c. flaked coconut
1/4  c. chopped walnuts
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. margarine
3  Tbsp. unsweetened cocoa
flaked coconut, if desired, to coat cookies
preparation: In small bowl, combine oats, coconut, walnuts and set aside. In 2-quart saucepan, combine sugar, milk, margarine and cocoa. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture comes to a full boil, 3 or 4 minutes.  Remove from heat.

name: PEANUT BUTTER DESSERT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick margarine, softened
finely chopped peanuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  (16 oz.) container Cool Whip
1  pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
1  pkg. chocolate instant pudding mix
2 1/2  c. cold milk
chocolate syrup
preparation: Combine first 2 ingredients and 1 cup peanuts in bowl, mixing well.  Press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

name: PEPPER JELLY
ingredients:
6 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. bell pepper, chopped
1 1/2  c. cider vinegar
3/4  c. hot pepper, chopped
1 (6 oz.)  bottle Certo
red or green food coloring
preparation: Combine sugar, vinegar and peppers; bring to a rolling boil. Cook 7 minutes.  Add Certo and stir.  Take off heat; let stand 5 minutes.  Add a few drops of food coloring; pour into jars and seal.   This is good with beans, meats, etc.  It can also be used as a snack.  Spread Ritz crackers with cream cheese and top crackers with Pepper Jelly.

name: CHEWY CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. Crisco
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
2  c. flour
3/4  c. cocoa
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  pkg. peanut butter chips
preparation: Cream together Crisco, sugar and vanilla.  Add eggs and mix well.  Add flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt.  Mix well.  Stir in peanut butter chips.  Drop tablespoon sized dough onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Makes approximately 3 dozen.

name: PORK LOIN ROAST - AMERICANA
ingredients:
4 to 6  lb. pork loin roast
1  c. applesauce
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. salt (optional)
preparation: Place roast, fat side up, on a rack in an open roasting pan. Combine applesauce, onion, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, brown sugar and salt.  Spread applesauce mixture over meat. Insert meat thermometer so tip reaches the center of the thickest part.  Be careful that tip does not rest in fat or on bone.  Do not add water.  Do not cover.

name: NELL'S CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  deboned chicken
1  can cream of chicken, celery or mushroom soup
1  medium size sour cream
1  can water chestnuts, cut as desired
1  roll Ritz or HiHo crackers, crushed fine
1  stick margarine or butter, melted
preparation: Combine sour cream and undiluted soup.  Mix with chicken and water chestnuts.  Place in casserole dish.  Sprinkle crackers on top.  Drizzle butter on top.  Sprinkle with paprika and/or parsley. Bake in conventional oven at approximately 350° or microwave until bubbling along sides of container, approximately 2 to 3 inches in toward center.

name: BACON CURRY COLESLAW
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. curry powder
preparation: Combine, cover and chill several hours or overnight.

name: BLACK FOREST PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
2  devil's food cake mixes, baked
2  pkg. chocolate instant pudding, prepared
2  cans cherry pie filling
1 large  box Cool Whip
1  Hershey bar, grated
1  jar maraschino cherries (optional)
preparation: Put a layer of cake in punch bowl.  Top with pudding.  Spread cherry pie filling over pudding.  Ice with Cool Whip.  Repeat until punch bowl is full.  Top with Hershey bar and cherries.

name: CASHEW CHICKEN
ingredients:
10  oz. boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into 1 x 1/2-inch pieces
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. dry white wine
1  Tbsp. reduced sodium soy sauce
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. vegetable oil
6  green onions, cut into 1-inch pieces
2  c. sliced mushrooms
1  red green pepper, thinly sliced
1  can (6 oz.) sliced water chestnuts, rinsed and drained
2  Tbsp. Hoisin sauce
2  c. hot, cooked white rice
1/4  c. roasted cashews
preparation: Place chicken in large resealable plastic food storage bag. Combine cornstarch, wine, soy sauce and garlic powder in small bowl, whisk until well blended.  Pour over chicken pieces.  Seal bag, toss to coat.  Marinate in refrigerator 1 hour.  Drain chicken, discard marinade.  Heat oil in wok or large nonstick skillet until hot.  Add onions, stir fry 1 minute.  Add chicken, stir fry 2 minutes or until browned.

name: ANTIPASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  box small seashell pasta, cooked
1/4  lb provolone cheese, cubed small
1/4  lb pepperoni, cubed small
1/4  lb salami, cubed small
3  tomatoes, diced
1  green pepper, diced
2  small onions, diced
1  bottle italian dressing
olives
preparation: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together except dressing.  Keep in refrigerator until ready to serve.  Just prior to serving toss the ingredients with dressing.

name: PINEAPPLE REFRIGERATOR PIE
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  large bowl Cool Whip
1/2  c. real lemon juice
1  c. pecans or walnuts
preparation: Blend and fold together until mixed well.  Pour into 2 (9-inch) graham cracker crusts.  Refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. mashed sweet potatoes (fresh potatoes are better)
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. margarine
milk (enough to moisten potatoes; 1 to 2 Tbsp. if needed)
preparation: Mix together and pour in greased casserole dish.

name: AMBROSIA CREAM CHEESE MOLD
ingredients:
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
1/2  c. cold water
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  can unsweetened pineapple chunks (undrained)
1/3  c. sugar
juice of 1 lemon
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  orange, peeled, sectioned and diced
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Soften gelatin in water; let mixture stand 5 minutes.  Drain pineapple and reserve juice.  Add enough water to juice to make 1 cup.  Pour juice into saucepan; heat to boiling.  Add gelatin mixture; stir until dissolved.  Remove from heat.  Stir in sugar, lemon juice and cream cheese (a wire whisk helps to blend).  Chill until gelatin is partially set.  Fold in pineapple chunks, orange, pecans and coconut.  Spoon mixture into lightly greased 1-quart mold.  Chill until firm.  Unmold.

name: QUICK WHITE CORN CHILI
ingredients:
3/4  lb. lean ground beef
1 (15.25 oz.)  can whole kernel white corn, drained
1 (14.5 oz.)  can diced tomatoes with garlic and onions
2  c. salsa
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans, drained
preparation: Brown meat in large saucepan; drain.  Add remaining ingredients.  Simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes.  Top with shredded Cheddar cheese and sliced green onions, if desired.  Serve with tortilla chips or warm bread.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. oil
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. frozen blueberries
preparation: Beat eggs; add sugar and oil.  Beat until creamy.  Add milk, vanilla and dry ingredients that are sifted together.   Fold in blueberries that are frozen.  Put into muffin pan liners and fill half full.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: CHRISTMAS DIVINITY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. water
2  egg whites, beaten stiff
3/4  c. chopped nuts
3/4  c. candied cherries
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, corn syrup and water.  Stir over heat until mixture dissolves.  Cook without stirring until syrup reaches light crack stage (270°).  Pour syrup slowly over egg whites. Beat constantly until mixture holds its shape.   Add chopped nuts, candied cherries and vanilla.  Drop by teaspoonful onto buttered sheet.  Garnish with candied cherry halves.

name: MUSHROOMS MARSALA
ingredients:
1  lb. mushrooms
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. Marsala wine
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. parsley
preparation: Wash mushrooms in warm, salted water and pat dry.  Cut off stems; leave caps whole.  Heat butter in skillet and saute mushrooms until lightly browned (still firm).  Add lemon juice, Marsala wine, salt, pepper and parsley.  Serve.

name: APRICOT NECTAR CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
3  tsp. lemon juice or flavoring
4  eggs, separated
3/4  c. oil
3/4  c. apricot nectar
preparation: Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside.  Mix remaining ingredients, then fold in egg whites.  Bake in a tube pan at 300° for 50 minutes.

name: DAWN'S GARLIC BREADSTICKS
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1 1/2  c. warm water
1  Tbsp. honey
1  tsp. garlic powder
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
coarse salt
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large mixing bowl.  Add honey and garlic powder and mix well.  Gradually add flour, beating until smooth. Knead 3/4 to 1 cup additional flour into the dough until smooth and elastic (about 10 minutes).   Divide mixture into 4 dozen equal parts.  Shape each into an 8-inch long rope.  Place on greased baking sheet (not Teflon).  Brush with melted butter and sprinkle lightly with coarse salt.  Let rise in  warm place, free from drafts 30 minutes or until doubled in bulk.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden.  Transfer to cake rack and brush with melted butter (add garlic powder to butter to taste for a more garlic intensity).

name: BAILEY'S IRISH CREAM
ingredients:
1  c. Irish whiskey
1  c. sweetened condensed milk
1/2  c. whipping cream
1  Tbsp. Hershey syrup
1/8  tsp. extract of coconut
3  eggs
preparation: Blend all ingredients in blender and refrigerate.  Keeps well for several weeks.  Shake well before serving.  Serves 6 (regular) people or 1 Irishman.

name: MINIATURE FRUIT CAKES
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1/4  c. dairy sour cream
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
1/8  tsp. allspice
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. golden raisins
2  c. candied fruit
1  c. nuts
preparation: Cream butter.  Gradually add sugar; beat until light and fluffy.  Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Add sour cream and blend. Add flour and spices.  Stir in fruit and nuts.  Fill small "Midget" baking cups 3/4 full.  Top with 1/4 candied cherry.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Makes about 48.

name: LINGUINI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. linguini
1  cucumber
2  tomatoes
1  onion
1  pkg. salad crunchies
1  bottle Italian dressing
preparation: Cook linguini.  Cut the cucumber, tomatoes and onion into small pieces.  Mix together the linguini, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, salad crunchies and dressing.  Chill overnight.

name: PARSLEY BREAD
ingredients:
1  loaf French bread
1/4  c. finely minced parsley
1  tsp. finely minced garlic
6  Tbsp. butter
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Split bread in half lengthwise.  Heat butter in saucepan.  Add garlic.  Stir in parsley, salt and pepper; remove from heat. Brush 1/2 of bread with mixture.  Cover with second side.  Wrap in heavy-duty foil and bake for 10 minutes at 375°.

name: COKE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. Coke
2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Combine first 7 ingredients.  Combine next 4 ingredients. Combine the two.  Grease 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish.  Put miniature marshmallows in dish.  Pour mixture over and bake 40 minutes at 350°.

name: OLD-FASHIONED CANDIED YAMS
ingredients:
3  medium yams
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. nutmeg
1/8  c. (1/4 stick) butter
1  tsp. vanilla flavor
pinch of salt
1 1/2  c. water
preparation: Peel and cut yams in quarters.  Sprinkle with sugar and nutmeg.  Add butter, vanilla, salt and water.

name: CHOCOLATE GRAVY
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. cocoa
1  Tbsp. flour
4  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  c. water
dash of salt
preparation: Mix cocoa, flour, salt and sugar thoroughly.  Then add water a little at a time to make a thick smooth paste.  Add rest of water. Place over medium heat and cook until thick gravy.  Serve over biscuits or pancakes.

name: BRIDAL PUNCH
ingredients:
2  c. vodka
2 large  pkg. frozen strawberries
4 large  bottles cream soda
2  qt. vanilla ice cream
preparation: Add ice cream to a punch bowl.  Add cream soda.  Add vodka. Add frozen strawberries.  Serve in small glasses (plastic if you like).  Enjoy!

name: CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, well drained
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  tsp. seasoned salt
2  tsp. chopped onion
preparation: Mix together and mold into ball.  Roll in chopped nuts.  Can be frozen.

name: PARMESAN POTATOES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/3  c. Parmesan
1/3  c. flour
6  large potatoes
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Place butter on cookie sheet.  Heat until melted.  Slice potatoes.  Combine Parmesan, flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.  Add potatoes and shake or toss to coat.  Place on cookie sheet and bake 1 hour until tender, turning once.

name: FAVORITE DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour (self-rising)
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1 or 2  pkg. dry yeast
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Mix 3/4 cup flour, sugar, salt and yeast in mixing bowl.  Heat milk, water and margarine to lukewarm.  Gradually add to dry ingredients.  Beat 2 minutes with electric mixer.  Add 1/4 cup flour; beat at high speed for 2 minutes.  Stir in enough flour to make dough and knead for 2 to 3 minutes or until elastic.  Make out in rolls and let rise for 15 to 20 minutes.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple
1  can cherry pie filling
1  box yellow cake mix
1  c. chopped nuts
2  sticks butter
whip cream
preparation: Place crushed pineapple in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Spread cherry pie filling over the crushed pineapple.  Sprinkle the yellow cake mix over cherries.  Sprinkle chopped nuts over cake mix.  Slice the butter and lay over nuts.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.  Top with whip cream.

name: JALAPENO PEPPER CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  1/2 c self- rising corn meal
1  c shredded cheddar cheese
1  c diced onions
1  can whole kernel corn, including liquid
1/2  c cooking oil
1/2  jalapeno pepper, chopped (or more if want  hotter)
3  eggs, well beaten
preparation: Mix and bake in iron skillet at 400 degrees.

name: DRIED APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. dried apples, mashed and unsweetened
1  c. raisins
1  c. nuts
3  tsp. soda
flavoring (all kinds)
4  eggs
1  c. shortening or butter
2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. flour (1/4 c. flour extra to roll nuts in)
preparation: Bake in tube or loaf pan.  Frost as desired.

name: ONE BOWL PLAIN CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. sifted cake flour
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening, at room temperature
1  tsp. vanilla
2/3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. milk
2  eggs, unbeaten
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Sift flour, salt, baking powder and sugar together into a large bowl.  Add shortening, vanilla and 2/3 cup milk.  Beat 2 minutes on slow speed of electric mixer.  Add 1/3 cup milk and eggs.  Beat 2 more minutes.  Bake in two 9-inch well-greased cake pans.

name: SAUERBRATEN HAMBURGER PATTIES
ingredients:
3  slices dry white bread
1  lb. ground round
1  medium onion, chopped fairly fine
1  egg, lightly beaten
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cider vinegar
2  c. (plus) water
10  cloves
5  bay leaves
8  gingersnaps, finely crushed
preparation: Crumble bread well; mix with meat in a fairly large bowl.  Add onion, egg and salt; mix thoroughly.  Shape mixture into small patties, approximately 1/2-inch thick by 2 inches diameter.  Brown well on both sides, in either oil or margarine, in a large skillet.  Brown 2 or 3 batches.  Drain well on paper towels; set aside.

name: TAYLOR'S MACARONI
ingredients:
3  c. uncooked macaroni
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese
grated or shredded Parmesan cheese
grated or shredded Romano cheese
12  slices American cheese
6  slices Swiss or butter Swiss
1  egg
1 3/4  c. milk
2  tsp. butter
salt to taste
preparation: Cook noodles until done; drain.  Mix milk and egg.  In the bottom of a 3-quart casserole dish, put 1/2 noodles.  Then pour 1/2 egg and milk over noodles.  Then 1/2 Cheddar and Mozzarella cheese.  Lay 6 slices American and 3 slices Swiss cheese next. Then sprinkle with Parmesan and Romano cheese.  Then repeat all layers.  Makes 2 layers.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.  (Add salt and butter on top of layer before cooking.)  Serves 4 to 6.

name: HOT DOG CHILI
ingredients:
5  lb. hamburger
3  onions, chopped
5  pkg. chili mix
5  cans tomato sauce
preparation: Brown and drain hamburger a skillet at a time.  Add to all other ingredients in crock-pot.  Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

name: GLAZED CARROTS
ingredients:
1  lb. carrots (whole)
1  c. orange juice
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Parboil carrots.  Mix juice and brown sugar.  Pour over carrots.  Cook in a 325° oven for 20 minutes.

name: ENERGY BARS
ingredients:
1  block margarine
1  c. oats
5  c. Rice Krispies
1  c. peanuts
1  c. raisins
2  pkg. large marshmallows
1  c. peanut butter
preparation: Melt margarine	in  large pot.	When melted, add peanut butter and   marshmallows.  In  large  bowl,  bake  oats	and Krispies at 300°.  When  marshmallows  are melted, add all dry ingredients in bowl.  Working fast, mix dry and wet mixtures.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  lb. hamburger
1 (10.5 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (10.5 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
Velveeta
1  large bag Tater Tots
preparation: Brown hamburger in skillet.  Drain.  Add both cans of soup and stir well.  Pour into a 9 x 13 pan.  Slice enough Velveeta cheese to cover the top of the pan and place on top of the hamburger mixture.  Cover the top with Tater Tots.  Bake in the oven for 15 minutes or until the Tater Tots are brown.  The oven temperature should be 425°.

name: BARBECUED BEEF
ingredients:
3  lb. cooked and shredded beef
1  chopped onion
1  Tbsp. fat
1/2  c. celery
1/2  c. green pepper
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  c. barbecue sauce
1  tsp. mustard
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Saute onions, celery and green pepper in fat.  Add rest of ingredients except meat.  Simmer slowly for 15 minutes, stirring often.  Add meat; simmer 10 minutes.  Serve on hamburg or hot dog buns.

name: MARINATED HORN BUTTON MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  lb. small mushrooms
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1/2  c. French dressing
1  clove garlic, cut in half
preparation: Lightly brown mushrooms in olive oil.  Cover with French dressing; add garlic.  Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Makes 4 servings.

name: CREAM-STYLE LIMA BEANS WITH MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  can mushrooms, sliced
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen baby lima beans
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. each:  sugar and salt
1/2  c. cream
preparation: Combine liquid from mushrooms, plus enough water to cook lima beans.  Add beans, onion, sugar and salt.  Cook until beans are tender.  Stir in mushrooms and cream; heat thoroughly, but do not boil.  Makes 4 servings.

name: DADDY'S FAVORITE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter or shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  sq. baking chocolate
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Cream shortening with sugar, vanilla and cinnamon. Continue creaming until light and fluffy. Beat eggs and blend in. Add melted chocolate when cooled. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk, beating until smooth. Pour batter into 2 well-greased 8-inch cake pans. Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  lb. round steak, cut 1-inch thick
2  Tbsp. shortening
1 (4 oz.)  can mushroom pieces
1  medium onion, finely chopped
1/2  green pepper, finely chopped
1  c. tomato (canned or fresh)
preparation: Combine flour with salt and pepper and pound into meat.  In preheated skillet at 325°, melt shortening.  Brown meat on both sides.  Add remaining ingredients.  Reduce heat to 225°.  Cook, uncovered, for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  Serve with vegetable gravy. Makes 6 servings.

name: MICROWAVE CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. chocolate chips
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  c. chopped nuts (if desired)
preparation: Microwave on Medium for 2 minutes.  Stir.  Microwave for 1 more minute.  Pour in 8 x 8-inch pan.  Refrigerate.

name: WHISKEY SOURS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1 (6 oz.)  can of whiskey
2 (12 oz.)  cans of Sprite
preparation: Mix well, chill and Enjoy!!

name: BROCCOLI AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  bunch broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. Velveeta cheese
3/4  c. rice
1/4  c. onions
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook broccoli in one pot; drain well.  Saute butter and onions in small frypan or in a bowl in the microwave.  Cook 3/4 cup rice as package directs in another pot.  In a large pot or bowl, mix together cooked and drained broccoli, sauteed onions, 1/4 cup Velveeta cheese and one can of soup.  Fold in rice.  Pour mixture into your favorite casserole dish.  Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until casserole is bubbly.

name: BANANA SPLIT DESSERT (FROZEN)
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. graham crumbs
3  Tbsp. butter
3  bananas, sliced
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. chocolate chips
2  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. evaporated milk
12  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Combine graham cracker crumbs and 3 tablespoons butter.  Pat into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cool in refrigerator or freezer until firm.  Place slices of banana on crust.  Top with slices of ice cream.  Top ice cream with nuts.  Freeze.

name: MRS. WAGNER'S NO BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. nonfat dry milk
1/2  c. honey
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. cornflakes, crushed
preparation: Mix  the  first  4 ingredients.  Roll into small balls. Roll in cornflakes.  Set up time is 20 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
2  c. sugar
3  c. flour
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. oil
2  c. grated zucchini
1  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix ingredients in order.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour in greased, floured pans.  Makes 2 loaves.

name: EASY CHICKEN FAJITAS
ingredients:
4  (approximately 1 1/4 lb.) boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips
1/4  c. lime juice
1  garlic clove, minced
1  tsp. chilli powder
1/2  tsp. cumin
2  Tbsp. oil
1  medium onion, cut into thin wedges
1/2  c. each red, yellow, and green pepper strips
1/4  c. salsa
8  flour tortillas, warmed
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Marinate chicken in juice, garlic, and seasonings 15 minutes. Cook chicken in oil 2 to 3 minutes or until chicken loses pink color.  Add onion and peppers.  Continue cooking 3 minutes or until chicken is tender.  Stir in salsa.  Spoon onto tortillas. Top with cheese.

name: COCONUT CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
3  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
4  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/3  c. coconut
preparation: Mix sugar, flour and salt; add 3 cups milk gradually.  Mix until thick and bubbly.  Add one cup of mixture to 4 egg yolks. Mix, then return to mixture and cook a little longer.  Add vanilla and coconut; pour into baked pie shell.

name: BROWN RICE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. raw rice
1  can beef consomme (Campbell's)
1  can French onion soup (Campbell's)
1/2 to 1  stick margarine (just as good with half)
1  can mushrooms, drained
preparation: Mix all this in a casserole.   Cover and bake 1 hour at 350°. This can also be microwaved for 8 minutes on High, then 12 minutes on Medium.   These times will vary with each microwave. Serves 6 to 8.

name: CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  Tbsp. finely minced bell pepper
1  Tbsp. finely minced onion
1 small  can crushed pineapple, well-drained
3/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine all ingredients; mix well.  Shape into ball and roll in 1/2 to 3/4 cup more chopped pecans.

name: CAESAR SALAD(Serves Four)
ingredients:
2  heads romaine lettuce
3  cloves garlic
1/2  tsp. capers, rinsed
6  anchovy fillets
2  egg yolks
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. coarse black pepper
1/2  c. olive oil
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
croutons
preparation: Tear romaine into 2-inch pieces; wash, dry and refrigerate. Combine in processor garlic, capers, anchovies, egg yolks, dry mustard, lemon juice and 1/2 teaspoon pepper.  Add olive oil and process until dressing is like mayonnaise.  Refrigerate 30 minutes.  Place romaine in bowl with 1/2 teaspoon pepper.  Pour dressing down the sides of the bowl, lifting the lettuce to coat leaves evenly.  Add croutons and Parmesan cheese and serve.

name: MOM'S SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
5  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. butter or margarine
3  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Sift flour with 1 cup of sugar and next 4 ingredients, in a large bowl.  Cut in butter (use hands).  Beat eggs slightly and add rest of sugar to eggs, gradually.  Blend in buttermilk and vanilla.  Add and mix into first mix of flour.  Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes, or until lightly browned on the bottom.  Do not overbake.

name: GRANNIE'S PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
2  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. rolled oats
1  c. bran
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. peanut butter (creamy or chunky)
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. granulated sugar
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  c. butter or margarine
preparation: Melt butter.  Beat together with sugars, vanilla, peanut butter and eggs.  In a separate bowl, combine the flour, bran, oats and baking soda.  Stir mixture into butter mixture.  Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes.  Cool.

name: CHEESE PANCAKES
ingredients:
8  oz. creamed cottage cheese
1  egg
1/8  tsp. salt and pepper
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1/3  c. flour
1/3  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix ingredients in order given.  Fry on both sides until golden brown.  Serve with syrup on hot cakes.

name: ABC SNACK MIX
ingredients:
4  c frosted letter oat and corn cereal, any variety
3  c assorted festive candies
2  c caramel popcorn
1  c peanuts
1  c small pretzels
preparation: Other ingredients to use or for substitution; miniature marshmallows, chocolate chips, popcorn, mixed nuts, raisins, dried fruit or M&M's.

name: SCALLOPED ONIONS
ingredients:
2  lb. onions, sliced and cooked
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Drain onions.  Add cheese with a small amount of milk. Thicken with thin white sauce.  Put in casserole and top with bread crumbs.  Put in oven until bread crumbs are a golden brown.

name: JIFFY CHICKEN OR TURKEY PIE
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. melted butter
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  (10 1/2 oz.) cream of chicken soup
1  (10 1/2 oz.) chicken noodle soup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  (8 oz.) biscuits
1  tsp. poultry seasoning
preparation: Saute onion in butter; blend in flour and stir well until frothy.  Add soup; heat until thickened.  Add chicken and seasonings.  Heat thoroughly.  Pour into greased shallow 3-quart casserole.  Arrange biscuits on top.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes or until biscuits are brown.  Yields 6 servings.

name: DATE LOAF CAKE
ingredients:
1  box pitted dates
1  c. hot water
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. butter
pinch of salt
1  c. pecans
1  egg
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Cut dates into small pieces and put into mixing bowl.  Put soda and butter over dates, then pour hot water over this and let stand for 10 minutes.  Then, mix in other ingredients.  Pour into baking pan and bake 1 hour in 375° oven or until done.

name: PUPPY CHOW CRISPY MUNCHIES
ingredients:
6  oz. pkg. chocolate chips, heat to melt
1/4  c. peanut butter
6  c. different cereals, not sugared
1/2  c. walnuts or almonds or both, more if you like
1  c. powdered sugar, in a plastic bag
preparation: Mix cereals and nuts with melted chocolate.  Place 1/2 the cereal mix into the powdered sugar and shake to coat and separate. Remove cereal and spread on cookie sheet to dry.   Separate chunks to single layer.  Continue with other half of cereal mix. (I use a disposable plastic glove to coat cereal).

name: BOUILLABAISSE
ingredients:
3  fillets of any white solid fish
2  (1 lb.) lobsters, split and cleaned
1 to 2  lb. mussels (about 2 dozen)
1 1/4  lb. sea scallops
1 1/4  lb. shelled raw shrimp
1/2  c. olive oil
2  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
2 to 3  cloves garlic, minced
1  c. beef bouillon
2  c. dry white wine
1/2  c. chopped parsley
2 large  cans tomatoes
4  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. thyme
3/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. saffron
1/2  tsp. fennel
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
preparation: Separate lobster tails and claws.  In heavy kettle, heat oil; add onion, celery and garlic.  Cook until golden.  Add parsley, tomatoes, bouillon and wine.  Season with salt, thyme, paprika, saffron, fennel and pepper.  Bring to a boil.  Add shrimp, scallops and lobster.  Cover and simmer 15 minutes.

name: SUNSET SODA
ingredients:
1  envelope Kool-Aid (any flavor)
1  c. sugar
1  c. cold water
1 (28 fluid oz.)  bottle club soda, chilled
1  pt. vanilla ice cream or fruit-flavored sherbet
preparation: Dissolve soft drink mix and sugar in water. Stir in soda. Place a small scoop of ice cream in each of 6 tall glasses. Stir in soda mixture; top with a second scoop of ice cream.

name: COCOA BROWNIES(Club Member: Nicholas)
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
6  Tbsp. cocoa
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  c. margarine
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Sift flour with baking powder and cocoa. Melt margarine; remove from heat. Add melted margarine to sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each. Stir in nuts, vanilla and sifted dry ingredients. Spread in well-greased 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool. Cut in squares.

name: MAYONNAISE CAKE AND TOPPING
ingredients:
1  c. water with 2 tsp. soda
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
2 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Mix together water with soda and mayonnaise. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well; pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350°.

name: CHICKEN ALA CORNFLAKES
ingredients:
1  cut up chicken
1  c. milk
2  c. cornflakes, crushed
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. seasoned salt
preparation: Wash and drain chicken.  Place on paper towel.  Pour cup of milk in bowl; dip chicken in milk.  Place on plate and season with salt, pepper and seasoned salt.  Roll chicken in crushed cornflakes and place on slightly greased pan; bake in oven at 350° for about 45 minutes or until nicely brown.

name: SALMON LOAF
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1/2  c. fine, dry bread crumbs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  lb. can salmon
1  c. cream
3  beaten eggs
1  tsp. lemon juice
pepper to taste
preparation: Heat milk to scalding in double boiler.  Add bread crumbs and cook until a thin, smooth paste is formed.  Add salt, then salmon which has been mashed to a pulp after all bones and undesirable portions have been removed, then add cream.   Heat to scalding and pour over beaten eggs.  Season with lemon juice and pepper and pour into buttered loaf pan.  Set in another pan containing hot water and bake in a slow oven (325° to 350°) for 1 hour.  Remove from oven.  Let stand a few minutes.  Unmold and serve on a hot platter and serve with Hollandaise Sauce.

name: HOT FRUIT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can sliced peaches
2 (No. 2)  can pineapple chunks
1 (No. 2)  can apricot halves
1  jar apple rings
1  c. brown sugar
4  Tbsp. flour
2  sticks margarine
1 3/4  c. fruit juice
1/4  c. cooking sherry
preparation: Drain fruit, saving all  juices  from fruit except from apple rings (can use  small  amount for color).  Arrange fruit in alternate layers in a  9 x 13-inch casserole dish.	Combine sugar, flour, margarine, juice and cooking sherry in saucepan. Cook, stirring until smooth  and	thickened.  Pour  over fruit and cover.  Let stand overnight in refrigerator.  Heat oven at 350°. Cook until hot  and  bubbly (approximately 25 minutes). Excellent with pork or poultry.

name: JOAN'S BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. dried northern beans (navy), washed
1  shank end ham with some bone
1  bay leaf
1  medium onion, diced
1  c. chopped carrots
4  stalks celery, diced
preparation: Let beans soak in water for about an hour until they start to swell. Pour off the water, add ham bone or ham hocks.  Add enough water to cover the ham bone and beans.  Add the rest of the ingredients.  Bring to a boil and let simmer for about 4 or 5 hours.

name: "FAILURE PROOF" CREAM SAUCE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1 2/3  c. undiluted Carnation evaporated milk
preparation: Put the butter, flour and salt into a medium-sized saucepan. Turn the heat to "low."  Put the saucepan on the stove.  Stir the butter and flour mixture over low heat until the butter and flour are smooth and well mixed (that will take about 2 minutes). Gradually pour the large can of Carnation evaporated milk into the saucepan.  Stir your cream sauce with a wooden spoon until the sauce is smooth and creamy.  It will take 3 to 5 minutes.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. butter
1  lb. beef sirloin, cut in 1/4-inch wide strips
1  c. thinly sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. tomato paste
1 1/4  c. beef stock or 1 can condensed beef broth
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. cooking sherry
preparation: Combine 1 tablespoon of the flour with the salt. Dredge meat in mixture. Heat skillet, then add 2 tablespoons of the butter. When melted, add the sirloin strips and brown quickly, flipping meat to brown on all sides. Add mushroom slices, onion and garlic. Cook 3 to 4 minutes or until onion is barely tender. Remove the meat and mushrooms from skillet. Add rest of butter to pan drippings. When melted, blend in rest of flour. Add tomato paste. Slowly pour in meat stock. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens. Return meat and mushrooms to skillet. Stir in sour cream and sherry. Heat briefly. Serve with noodles. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

name: ELOISE'S POTATOES
ingredients:
potatoes
1  stick butter
parsley flakes
2  onions
1  c. milk
flour
American cheese
preparation: Fill 6-quart kettle almost full with potatoes and onions (sliced).  Cook until done, then pour off water.  Heat milk and butter; thicken with flour and add lots of cheese.  Pour over potatoes and stir.  Sprinkle with parsley flakes and brown in oven at 350° to 400°.

name: FRIED SQUASH BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1  egg
1/4  c. buttermilk
2  summer squash, diced
water
preparation: Cook squash in water until soft; leave 3/4 cup water in pot. Combine other ingredients with squash and water; mix together. Fry in hot oil until golden brown.

name: SOUR CREAM CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1  c. sour cream
1 small  can cream-style corn
4  tsp. baking powder
3  eggs
1/2  c. Wesson oil
preparation: Heat iron  skillet lightly oiled on top of stove.  Heat, hot. Pour in batter  and  bake at 425° for about 25 minutes or until done.  Test center with toothpick method.

name: TUNA GUMBO SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon gelatin
1  can chunk tuna
1  can condensed chicken gumbo soup
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped celery
1/2  c. mayonnaise
4  oz. container Cool Whip
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in 1/2 c. boiling water.  Fold in remaining ingredients.  Chill to set.

name: GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
2 1/2  c. all purpose flour, sifted
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1  c. Steen's syrup
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening until fluffy.  Add eggs, then previously sifted dry ingredients alternately with the syrup and water.  Add one cup chopped nuts if desired.  Beat enough to mix thoroughly.  Pour into a well greased 12 1/2 x 8 x 2-inch pan and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: PRESSED CHICKEN(Salad Type)
ingredients:
1  chicken or stewing hen
1  to 2 stalks celery, chopped up or cut up fine with celery leaves
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1  tsp. parsley, dried
1  pt. boiled down juice
1 small  pkg. gelatin
preparation: Boil chicken or stewing hen well until meat is done and falls off the bones.  Remove chicken from bones and chop into small pieces.  Use boiled down juice; skim off fat from chicken broth. Add gelatin.  Pour over chicken; mix well and chill.

name: DEVIL'S FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. cocoa
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
1  c. buttermilk
3/4  c. hot water
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening together.  Add eggs.  Add dry ingredients.  Alternate with buttermilk.  Mix well.  Add hot water.  Bake at 350°.  Makes 36 cupcakes or 3 large layers.

name: SAUSAGE AND SAUERKRAUT
ingredients:
2  lb. Polish sausage
1 (16 oz.)  can sauerkraut, rinsed and drained
1  can tomatoes with chives in liquid
1  chopped onion
1  chopped green pepper
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  bay leaf
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cut the sausage into 1-inch slices.  Saute until fully cooked and brown.  Drain.  Add sauerkraut, tomatoes with liquid, onion, green pepper, brown sugar and seasonings.  Mix well.  Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes.  Remove bay leaf.  Serve.

name: STRAWBERRY COOL WHIP CAKE(Annette's Birthday Cake)
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  box Jell-O (strawberry)
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
1  qt. fresh strawberries or 2 (10 oz.) frozen
1  angel food cake
preparation: Mix Jell-O with water; let set in refrigerator until 1/2 jelled.  Then add Cool Whip and mix well.  Add strawberries.  Then cut angel food cake into small pieces.  Put cake pieces into Jell-O mixture or add whole angel food ring and push into mixture.

name: KENTUCKY CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped onions
1  can Healthy Request cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. skim milk
3 to 4  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Cook first 3 ingredients in salted water until tender.  Drain, then combine the next 3 ingredients and add to the cabbage mixture.  Stir well.  Put in a Pyrex dish.  Can be topped with Premium fat free crackers.  Cook in 350° oven until bubbly. Contains approximately 410 calories.

name: SAUSAGE QUICHE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) pastry shell
1  lb. sausage
1  medium onion, finely chopped
8  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. light cream
3  eggs
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Brown sausage in skillet; drain.  Cut into small pieces.  Add onion to skillet and cook until soft.  Combine onion with sausage and sprinkle over bottom of pastry shell.  Sprinkle on cheese. Combine egg, salt, light cream and milk.  Beat slightly.  Pour over ingredients in pastry shell.  Bake in preheated 375° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: TEXAS HASH
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. ground chuck
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. raw rice
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. chili powder pepper (to taste)
preparation: In heavy skillet (and use moderate heat), toss the ground pork back and forth until fat starts to fry out.  Push pork to one side and fry onion for five minutes, then mix with beef, stirring until beef loses its color.  Add rest of ingredients and turn into greased casserole.  Cover and bake 1 hour.  Pour off grease.  Bake for 45 minutes.  Serve with grated cheese.  Serves 6.

name: TRIFLE
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1/2  c. sherry
large can sliced peaches
1  pkg. banana cream instant pudding
1 small  carton of heavy cream
colored sprinkles
preparation: Break cake into pieces and place in bottom of decorative bowl. Soak with sherry.  Drain peaches and place on top of cake.  Cover with prepared pudding.

name: BEST EVER CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream-style corn
2  cans whole kernel corn, drained
1/3  c. oil
1 small  carton sour cream
1  pkg. Jiffy corn muffin mix
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix oil, sour cream and muffin mix; add corn and cheese.  Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes. Add 1 cup grated cheese on top; bake until cheese is melted.

name: FRED'S FAVORITE GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. applesauce
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg, well beaten
3/4  c. molasses
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. hot water
preparation: Mix applesauce and sugar together; add egg.  Add molasses and dry ingredients.  Add hot water.  Place in 8 x 8-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Yield:  9 servings.

name: PENN-CUMBERLAND'S SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. uncooked sausage
4  c. biscuit mix
1/2  lb. grated cheese
2  t. crumbled sage
preparation: Work 1 lb. uncooked sausage into 4 cups biscuit mix, 1/2 lb. grated cheese, and 2 teaspoons crumbled sage.

name: CAULIFLOWER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower
2  tsp. mustard
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook cauliflower.  Strain.  Place in baking dish.  Cover with the mixture of the remaining ingredients.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and browned.

name: FESTIVE PUMPKIN OR SWEET POTATO BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. each cloves, cinnamon, allspice, ginger and nutmeg
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
2  eggs
1  c. pumpkin or mashed sweet potato
1/2  c. each raisins and chopped nuts
preparation: Sift first 9 ingredients together.  Cream the sugar and oil in a large bowl.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Blend 1/3 cup water and pumpkin or sweet potato in bowl. Add pumpkin or sweet potato mixture alternately with dry ingredients to sugar mixture, blending well after each addition. Stir in raisins and nuts. Pour into 2 small greased and floured loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bread tests done.

name: SAUSAGE CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. hot sausage
1 1/2  lb. sharp cheese, grated
3  c. Bisquick
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Form into 1-inch diameter balls. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.  Makes about 150 small balls.

name: MEXICAN LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  tsp. cumin
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. red pepper
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
16  oz. can tomatoes, chopped
1/2  c. chopped tomatoes
3  green onions, chopped
10  to 12 corn tortillas
2  c. small curd cottage cheese, drained
1  c. grated Monterey Jack cheese with peppers
1  egg
1/2  c. grated Cheddar
2  c. shredded lettuce
1/4  c. sliced black olives
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain thoroughly.    Add cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, red pepper, salt, pepper and tomatoes. Heat through.

name: CANDY STRAWBERRIES
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1  c. flaked coconut
1/2  tsp. vanilla
blanched almonds, diced
1  c. ground pecans
3/4  c. sweetened condensed milk
red decorator's sugar
green food coloring
preparation: Combine Jell-O, pecans and coconut.  Stir in condensed milk and vanilla; mix well.  Chill 1 hour.  Shape mixture into strawberries. Roll in red decorator's sugar, if desired.  Insert sliced almonds, colored with green food coloring, in top of berries to form leaves.

name: BEST COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  large container Cool Whip
12  oz. frozen coconut
preparation: Follow directions on the back of the box to bake cake.  After baking the cake, pierce the top of it with a knife.  Pour the Eagle Brand milk on top; let it soak in.  Put Cool Whip on top of that, then add the frozen coconut.

name: LIME PICKLES
ingredients:
2  c. powdered lime
1  gal. water
7  lb. sliced cucumbers or peeled
3  qt. vinegar
10  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
spices to taste
preparation: Mix powdered lime with 1 gallon water.  Add sliced cucumbers. Soak 24 hours.  Rinse well.  Place in cold water and soak 2 hours. Bring to boil remaining ingredients.  Drop cucumbers in solution and boil 1 1/2 hours.  Pack and seal in jars.

name: HOT CHIPPED BEEF DIP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. milk
1  c. sour cream
1 (2 1/2 oz.)  jar chipped beef, minced
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. green pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Blend milk, cream cheese and sour cream in a bowl.  Add remaining ingredients and mix.  Put in casserole and cover with pecans which have been sauteed in the butter.  (Skip the sauteing and toss them on top to save the calories.) Need not be exact on amounts.  Bake in small casserole for 20 minutes at 350°. Eliminate baking to serve cold.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE SYRUP
ingredients:
1/2  c. cocoa or 4 sq. chocolate
2  sticks oleo
2  c. sugar
1 (6 oz.)  can Pet milk
preparation: In a saucepan, melt together the cocoa or chocolate squares and oleo; add sugar and Pet milk and bring to a boil.  Serve over cake and ice cream or a plain cake.

name: MEXICAN PINWHEELS
ingredients:
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (4.5 oz.)  can chopped green chilies, drained
1 (2 1/4 oz.)  can sliced ripe olives, drained
2/3  c. chopped green onions
1  clove garlic, pressed
1/4  tsp. seasoned salt
8  (8-inch) flour tortillas
commer salsa
preparation: Combine the first 8 ingredients.  Spread 1/2 cup mixture over each tortilla; roll tortillas jelly roll fashion.  Wrap each separately in plastic wrap.  Refrigerate up to 8 hours.  Cut each roll into 12 slices.  Secure pinwheels with wooden picks.  Serve with salsa.  Yield:  8 dozen.

name: TOFFEE BARS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. margarine, softened
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg, separated
2/3  c. finely chopped walnuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 275°.  Grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jelly roll pan.  Into a large bowl, measure all ingredients, except egg white and walnuts.  With mixer at medium speed, beat ingredients until well mixed, occasionally scraping bowl.  Pat evenly into pan.  In a cup with fork, beat egg white slightly.  Brush over top of dough and sprinkle with nuts.  Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes or until golden.  Immediately cut into 48 bars and remove from pan to cool on wire racks.  Store in tightly covered container.  Makes 48 bars.

name: NOODLES AND GROUND BEEF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, diced
1  small green pepper, diced
1 small  can peas, drained
1 small  can corn, drained
1 small  can green beans, drained
1  tsp. oregano (optional)
2  bay leaves
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  tsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. soy sauce
1  can whole peeled tomatoes
1  can pure
preparation: In a large saucepan, saute meat, onions and green pepper.  Add peas, corn, green beans, oregano, bay leaf, salt, pepper, tomatoes, Pure, Worcestershire, soy sauce and enough water to cover.  Simmer, uncovered, about 45 minutes.

name: ALMOND CRESCENTS OR ROUNDS
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1/2  Tbsp. almond extract
3/4  c. powdered sugar
2  c. flour
1/2  Tbsp. salt
1  c. Quaker oats
1/2  c. almonds, chopped
preparation: Beat margarine and almond extract until fluffy.  Gradually beat in sugar.  Add flour and salt; mix well.  Stir in oats and almonds. Shape to form crescents or roll walnut size piece and flatten with floured glass bottom.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake in 325° oven for 15 to 18 minutes.

name: LAYERED TORTILLA PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1 (2 1/4 oz.)  can sliced ripe olives, drained
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
6  tortillas, buttered
2  c. shredded Longhorn Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. water
preparation: Brown meat, onion and garlic in margarine.  Drain.  Add salt, pepper, chili powder, olives and tomato sauce.  In a round 2 quart casserole, alternate layers of tortillas, meat sauce and 1 1/2 cups cheese.  Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup cheese over top.  Pour water at edge of casserole into bottom.  Cover.  Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.  Remove cover and allow to stand 5 minutes before cutting into wedges.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: HEALTHY CRAB DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. nonfat yogurt or sour cream
2  Tbsp. fat-free mayonnaise
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. fat-free cream cheese
1  tsp. horseradish
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. (4 oz.) fat-free shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  lb. imitation crabmeat
preparation: Combine yogurt, mayonnaise, cream cheese and seasonings.  Mix well.  Stir in Cheddar cheese and crab.  Cover; chill for 2 hours.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. broccoli spears
1/2  c. cream of mushroom soup
1  egg, well beaten
1/2  c. mayonnaise (Kraft)
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1/2 to 3/4  c. cheese crackers, crumbled
preparation: Put in a buttered casserole.  Cook broccoli and drain.	Mix all other ingredients and pour over broccoli.  Cover with cheese crackers.  Bake at 350°.

name: DOUBLE LAYER PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
4  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  c. thawed Cool Whip
1  c. cold milk
1  graham cracker pie crust
2 (4 serving size)  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Mix cream cheese, 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in large bowl with a wire whisk until smooth.  Gently stir in whipped cream. Spread on bottom of crust.  Pour 1 cup milk into bowl.  Add pudding mixes.  Beat with wire whisk 1 minute.  (Mixture will be thick.)  Stir in pumpkin and spices with wire whisk until well mixed.  Spread over cream cheese layer.  Refrigerate 4 hours, until set.

name: HERBED BUTTERMILK DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. basil leaves
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. thyme leaves
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. onion powder
preparation: Combine ingredients in a small bowl and mix well.  Chill to blend flavors.  Serve with salads or as a vegetable dip.

name: APRICOT SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. water
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1/4  c. sugar
1  pkg. apricot jello
1  large tub Cool Whip
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Bring water, pineapple and sugar to a boil.  Add jello; let set until mixture congeals.  Mix cream cheese and Cool Whip together.  Add the cream cheese mixture to the jello mixture.  Add pecans.  Pour into a mold.  Refrigerate until firm in mold.

name: ROCKY ROAD CANDY
ingredients:
18  oz. chocolate bits
3/4  c. chopped nuts
3  c. tiny marshmallows
preparation: Melt chocolate bits in saucepan.  Stir in marshmallows and nuts.  Spread in buttered 8 x 8-inch  pan.  Chill until firm.  Cut into squares.  Enjoy.

name: CHICKEN-VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cubed, cooked chicken
16  oz. pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. chopped onions
1 tube or 1  c. crushed Ritz crackers
2  tsp. sesame seed
1  stick oleo, melted
preparation: Cook  slightly  frozen vegetables and drain.  Mix cream of chicken  soup  with sour cream.  Pour over chicken, onions and vegetables.  Place  in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan or casserole dish.  Top with mixture of crushed crackers, sesame seed and melted  oleo.  Bake  at  350°  for 25 to 30 minutes until bubbly hot.  Great for a covered dish dinner.

name: SECRETS
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. white sugar
1  sq. oleo
4  Tbsp. coconut
15  double graham crackers, crushed
1/2  c. coconut
24  marshmallows (pastel), cut in 4 pieces (or 240 small marshmallows)
preparation: Beat eggs; add sugar, oleo and 4 tablespoons coconut.  Cook in double boiler 20 minutes.  Let cool and pour over marshmallows, graham cracker crumbs and 1/2 cup coconut.  Press in 8-inch pan and frost with plain or chocolate icing.

name: INDIVIDUAL MEAT LOAVES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. catsup or barbecue sauce
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  egg
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Shape in 4 loaves.  Bake in 350° oven for 25 minutes.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1 small  box vanilla wafers
1 large  box instant pudding (vanilla or banana)
4  to 5 large bananas, sliced
4  c. milk
Cool Whip
preparation: Mix pudding  and  milk  until  well blended and pudding becomes thick.  In  a  dish,  cover  bottom with thin layer of pudding.  Add layer of banana slices, then top with a layer of wafers.  continue  layering  process  in  the same order until ingredients are gone.

name: PASTA-IN-A-POT
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  chopped onion
1  minced garlic clove
1 (14 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1 (11 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
8  oz. shell macaroni
1  pt. sour cream
1 1/2  c. Provolone cheese
1 1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown beef; drain.   Add onion, garlic, spaghetti sauce, stewed tomatoes and undrained mushrooms.    Mix and simmer for 20 minutes.   Cook macaroni; drain and rinse with cold water.

name: BLUEBERRY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour, divided
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
2  c. fresh blueberries, rinsed and drained
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat until light and fluffy. Add vanilla. Sift 2 cups flour, salt and baking powder together. Add sifted ingredients to creamed mixture, stirring thoroughly. Dredge berries in remaining flour. Fold berry mixture gently into creamed mixture. Pour mixture in tube pan that has been greased and coated with sugar. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: QUICK, EASY PRETZELS(Kids Can Make Em!)
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1 1/2  c. very warm water
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
4  c. flour (may use 2 c. wheat and 2 c. white)
1  beaten egg
coarse salt
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water.  Stir in sugar, salt and flour. Knead until smooth, shiny and elastic.  The kids may pound, turn, stretch and punch to their delight for 8 to 10 minutes.  Cut into smaller pieces and roll into ropes, coil, whatever shapes you desire.  Do not let rise.

name: BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. lean beef, cut up
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. fat
2  c. water
1  can tomato sauce
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
6  onions, chopped
6  carrots, chopped
6  potatoes, chopped
1  c. green peas
preparation: Wipe beef with damp cloth.  Roll meat in flour; brown in fat in heavy saucepan.  Add water, tomato sauce and seasonings.  Cover tightly and cook over low heat until almost tender, about 1 hour and 30 minutes.

name: BRUSCHETTA CON POMODORI
ingredients:
1  loaf French bread
1  lb. fresh plum tomatoes
1/2  c. extra virgin olive oil
4  cloves chopped garlic
1/4  c. chopped fresh basil
1/4  c. fresh grated Parmesan cheese
salt (optional)
pepper, freshly ground
preparation: Cut bread in 1/4-inch slices on a diagonal; toast on oven rack at 350° for 10 minutes; flip at 5 minutes.  Cut tomatoes in half and push seeds out with your thumb.  Dice the tomatoes.  Combine tomatoes with garlic and basil, then olive oil.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Put 1 tablespoon of mixture on toasted bread; sprinkle with cheese.  Return to 350° oven for 15 to 30 seconds.

name: CHICKEN PARMESIANA
ingredients:
1/2  c. cooking oil
3  broiler chickens, cut up
1 1/2  tsp. oregano
1 1/4  tsp. salt
paprika
2 (4 oz.)  cans mushrooms and liquid
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Line a  15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with aluminum foil. Pour oil  into  pan.  Place  in  a  425°  oven for 10 minutes. Remove from  oven.  Place  chicken  skin side down in the hot oil. Sprinkle  with  half  of  the oregano, salt and paprika. Place  in oven; bake 30 minutes.  Turn chicken;  sprinkle with other  half of  oregano,  salt  and paprika.  Bake 15 minutes longer.  Baste with  juice in pan.  Pour mushrooms and liquid over chicken. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake additional 5 minutes.  Makes 12 servings.

name: OREO COOKIE DESSERT
ingredients:
30  Oreo cookies
8  oz. cream cheese
2  c. powdered sugar
3/4  c. peanut butter
1  (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
preparation: Crush  cookies  and  reserve  1 cup for topping.  Press remaining cookies into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: OLD-FASHIONED CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. white sugar
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  beaten egg
1  Tbsp. water
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. self-rising flour
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream together the shortening and sugars.  Add beaten egg, water and vanilla; mix well.  Pour in flour and stir.  Add chocolate chips and nuts.  Grease 2 cookie sheets.  Place dough about 1 1/2 inches apart.  Bake at 350° for 7 minutes or until desired brownness.  Dough will be soft.  Let set in pan until firm, then remove.  Yields about 3 dozen.

name: FRUIT RIPPLE COOKIE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
4  eggs
1/2  c. softened margarine
1/4  c. cooking oil
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  can fruit pie filling
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In bowl, mix all ingredients, but pie filling.  Spread half of batter in a 9 x 13-inch pan (greased on bottom).  Top with the pie filling.  Dollop remaining batter over fruit, covering as much of filling as possible.  Swirls in batter and uncovered fruit peeking through are to be expected.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until top is browned for ultimate flavor.  Serve warm.

name: HONEY BRAN COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. whole wheat flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. honey
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. Bran Flakes
1/2  c. sunflower seeds
preparation: Combine flour and baking powder. Cream butter and add honey gradually. Add egg and vanilla and beat well. Stir in bran and add dry ingredients. Add seeds. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 12 minutes.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: MOLASSES GINGER COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. molasses
4  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. ginger
preparation: Mix.  Form into 1-inch balls.  Roll in sugar to coat.  Bake in a 375° oven on greased cookie sheet for 12 minutes.   Yield:  8 dozen.

name: SHRIMP IN WINE SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. dry white wine
1/2  c. clam juice or water
1  bay leaf
2  lb. fresh or frozen shrimp
1  small onion, finely chopped
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. tomato paste
1  c. half and half cream
1  pkg. frozen puff pastry shells, baked following label instructions
preparation: Combine water, clam juice and bay leaf in large saucepan; bring to boiling.  Add shrimp.  After mixture comes to boil again, lower heat; simmer 3 minutes or until shrimp are firm tender. Drain, reserving cooking liquid.

name: MEATBALLS AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion (chopped (about 1/4 c.)
1/3  c. dry bread crumbs
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
3/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  egg
2  pkg. (about .75 to .90 oz. each) brown gravy mix
1  pkg. (10 oz.) frozen mixed vegetables
preparation: Prepare meatballs. Combine first 8 ingredients and shape into about 24 meatballs. Prepare gravy mix as directed on packet using 10 inch skillet.  Stir in frozen vegetables, breaking apart with fork; stir in Meatballs.  Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Prepare Dumplings. 4 - 6 servings.

name: PRUNE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. each:  nutmeg, cinnamon and cloves
3  eggs
1  c. Wesson oil
1  jar junior baby prunes
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Mix and bake in greased tube pan for 1 hour at 350°.

name: LO-CAL FRUIT TRIFLE
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1  large diet Cool Whip
1 large  box diet vanilla instant pudding mix
any kind fresh fruit
1  can light crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix pudding according to directions on box.  Break up angel food cake.  Put layer of cake, layer of pudding, layer of fruit; repeat.  Last layer, top with Cool Whip and garnish with fresh fruit.

name: ARTICHOKE NIBBLES
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  jars marinated artichoke hearts
1  small onion, finely chopped
1  clove garlic, crushed
4  eggs
1/4  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. each: pepper, oregano and Tabasco
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
preparation: Drain liquid from 1 jar artichokes into a frying pan.  Drain other jar.  Chop artichokes and set aside.  Add the onion and garlic to the frying pan and saute until onion is limp.

name: PUMPKIN ICE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
9-inch pie shell, cooked
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
1  c. canned pumpkin
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. each:  nutmeg, ginger and cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. whipping cream
preparation: Line pie shell with ice cream.  Make layer 1/2-inch thick. Place in freezer.  Blend together the pumpkin, sugar, nutmeg, ginger, cinnamon and salt.  Whip cream until stiff; fold into pumpkin mixture.  Spoon over ice cream in pie shell.  Return to freezer for at least 2 hours.  Let stand at room temperature 5 minutes before cutting.

name: NO BAKE FUDGIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. oleo
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. cocoa
3/4  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. oatmeal, uncooked
preparation: Bring sugar, oleo, milk and cocoa to a boil.  Now mix in the following to hot mixture:  peanut butter, vanilla and oats.  Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper and cool.

name: FAST FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sliced peaches, drained
1  stick butter (1/2 c. melted)
preparation: Combine flour, sugar and baking powder in a 2-quart baking dish.  Stir in milk and vanilla to make a thin batter.  Place fruit slices over the batter and drizzle the melted butter over the top.  Do not stir.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes according to depth of dish or until nicely browned.  Try berries or fruit in season.

name: BRUNSWICK STEW
ingredients:
3  c. cooked, chopped chicken (save chicken stock)
1 1/2  lb. coarsely ground chuck
1/2  lb. coarsely ground lean pork
1  large onion, chopped
1 large  bottle catsup
2  cans tomatoes, mashed
2  cans yellow cream-style corn
1  tsp. ground red pepper
preparation: Cook chicken and pull from bones.  Cook together beef, pork and onion in 1 cup chicken stock and just enough water to cover meat.   Cook slowly for 1 hour.  Salt to taste.  Add catsup and tomatoes; cook another hour.  Add corn, chicken and 1 teaspoon ground red pepper.  Cook slowly another hour and stir often. (Three hours cooking time.)

name: Grandma T's Date and Nut Cookies
ingredients:
1  c. butter or half margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
2  tsp. baking soda
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  lb. pitted dates, chopped
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time, and mix well. Mix together the flour, soda and salt; add all at once and blend well.  Mix in vanilla, then add dates and nuts.  Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for approximately 12 minutes, just until lightly browned.  Cookies should be soft. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

name: PINEAPPLE SAUCE FOR HAM
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
pinch of ground cloves
preparation: Heat all ingredients together and serve over ham.

name: VELVEETA CONSOMME NOODLES
ingredients:
Velveeta cheese
1  can beef consomme soup
1  lb. spaghetti
preparation: Cut your Velveeta cheese into chunks and slowly add to your consomme soup that you have heating over low heat.  Melt the cheese slowly, stirring constantly until all the cheese is melted and is a creamy sauce.  Cook spaghetti and drain well.  Add your sauce mix together thoroughly.  Ready to serve.

name: EASY BLUEBERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
1  pkg. Martha White blueberry muffin mix
1/2  c. milk
1  can blueberry pie filling
preparation: In small bowl, combine muffin mix and milk until blended.  Pour pie filling into round baking dish.  Put dollops of muffin mix on top, close together.  Bake at 425° for 10 to 15 minutes until brown and bubbly.

name: 12 LAYER CAESAR SALAD
ingredients:
1  green pepper, chopped
1  cauliflower, chopped
1 large  can black olives, sliced
1  bunch green onions, chopped
sliced fresh mushrooms
1  bunch broccoli, chopped
2  large tomatoes, chopped
1  pkg. sharp Cheddar cheese
1  jar bacon bits
1 small  box croutons
Parmesan cheese
1 large  bottle Caesar dressing
preparation: After chopping all vegetables, layer in order that they are given.  Add cheese, bacon bits, croutons and dressing when ready to serve.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburg
1 large  jar spaghetti sauce with meat
1  pkg. lasagna noodles
1  small container cottage cheese
1/2  lb. shredded American cheese
preparation: Brown hamburg  in  skillet;  add  sauce.  Cook  noodles soft and drain.  In a  9 x 12-inch pan, put layers of hamburger,  sauce and  noodles.  Sprinkle  grated  cheese,  cottage cheese; alternate until all is used, using sauce on top last. Cover with Parmesan  cheese and American cheese.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

name: KRAUT
ingredients:
cabbage, shredded
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. white vinegar
water
preparation: Put water in large kettle and bring to a boil.   Pack cabbage in hot jars.   Add salt, sugar and vinegar to each packed jar of cabbage.    Pour hot water over packed jars.   Don't pack too tight!   Take air bubbles out by running a table knife around inside of jar after you pour hot water in packed jars.   Clean top of jar well.  Seal.

name: PAM'S CARROT SOUP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1  small onion, chopped fine
1  medium potato, diced
1  lb. carrots, chopped
3  c. vegetable stock
1  pinch sugar
2/3  c. half and half
salt and pepper
preparation: Melt butter in pan.  Add onion, potato and carrots.  Cover and cook on low heat for 10 minutes.  Add stock and sugar.  Boil, then simmer for 30 minutes.  Puree in blender.  Return to pan and stir in half and half and heat (do not boil).

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  (12 oz.) chocolate chips
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. plain M&M candies
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. butter
3/4  c. brown sugar
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. raisins
2  eggs
preparation: In a small bowl, combine the flour, baking soda and salt; set aside.  In a large bowl, beat together the butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla until creamy.  Beat in eggs.   Gradually blend in the flour mixture.   Stir in chocolate chips and raisins.  Drop mixture by a tablespoon on an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake in 375° oven for 9 to 11 minutes.  Remove from oven and press the M&M's on top of the cookies while they are still hot.

name: BANANA COLADA
ingredients:
4  oz. unsweetened pineapple juice
2  oz. cream of coconut (from canned mix)
3  oz. Bacardi rum *
1  c. ice cubes or shaved ice
preparation: *You want it more potent?  Use 151 proof Ron Rico rum.

name: MOM'S BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1 1/2  c. mashed bananas
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. nuts
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix margarine and sugar.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Mix in bananas and buttermilk.  Sift dry ingredients and add to beaten mixture.  Add nuts last.  Bake at 325° in greased loaf pans for 1 1/4 hours or until done.

name: MINI-BLINIS
ingredients:
1  whole white bread (Arnold or Pepperidge Farm, don't use plain bread)
1  lb. cream cheese, softened
2  egg yolks
1/2  c. sugar plus separate 4 Tbsp. for roll-ups *
1  Tbsp. cinnamon (for rolling) *
2  sticks margarine
preparation: *Four tablespoons sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon should be mixed together for rolling bread.

name: OYSTER CRACKER SNACK
ingredients:
1  pkg. Ranch dressing mix
1  c. oil
1  tsp. dill
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. lemon pepper
2 (12 oz.)  pkg. oyster crackers
preparation: Mix oil, dressing mix and spices. Pour over 2 packages of crackers and toss to coat. Bake at 300° for 15 minutes.  Store in airtight container.

name: MARIAN'S SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
2  to 3 lbs. round steak
1  cup flour
1 small  can cream of mushroom soup
1  cup ketchup
1 to 2  Tbsp. oil
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cut round steak into 6 or 7 pieces.  Flour pieces on both sides and sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Pour oil in heavy skillet.  Brown steak on both sides.  Put meat in crockpot.  Cook on high for 1 hour.  Reduce heat to low.  Add undiluted cream of mushroom soup and ketchup.  Cook on low until tender (approx. 2 hours).

name: HARVEST RICE
ingredients:
1  c. sliced carrots
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1  c. sliced green onions, including tops
2  c. cored, chopped, peeled or unpeeled apples
3  c. cooked brown rice (Minute brown rice)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. seedless raisins
1  Tbsp. sesame seeds
preparation: In a large skillet, cook carrots in oil about 5 minutes over medium heat. Add green onions and apples. Cook 3 - 5 minutes longer. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook until thoroughly heated. Makes 6 servings. 193 calories per serving.

name: ASHLEY'S DILLY BEANS
ingredients:
fresh green or yellow beans
red pepper
fresh garlic
fresh dill
2  c. vinegar
1  c. water
1/4  c. salt
preparation: Place 1/4 teaspoon red pepper, 1 clove garlic and 1 head of dill into each sterilized pint jar.  (I use wide-mouth jars.)  Cut off ends of beans and place vertically into jars.  Boil vinegar, water and salt.  Pour over beans and seal.  Water bath for 10 minutes.  Let them set for about 4 weeks before opening.

name: SUPERB MEAT LOAF(Diet)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. carrots, grated
1/4  c. celery, very finely diced
1/4  c. onion, diced
1/2  green pepper, diced
1/2  c. tomato juice
salt
pepper
garlic powder
preparation: If possible, put vegetables through blender.  Combine with ground beef, tomato juice and seasonings.  Bake at 350° for about 1 hour and 10 minutes.  Immediately pour  off all liquid.  Cool meat loaf before slicing.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  medium onion, diced
1  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. catsup
1/2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. celery, diced
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire
salt
pepper to taste
preparation: Brown onion in butter; add remaining ingredients.  Simmer until thick.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. milk
3 heaping  tsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. smooth peanut butter
1/3  stick butter
preparation: Put sugar, cocoa and  milk  into  a  saucepan  and boil until it reaches a soft ball  stage  or until a little dropped in ice water forms a soft  ball.  Take  off  of  stove and add peanut butter, vanilla and  butter.  Let  it  stand  until  it cools  and beat until stiff  enough  to  pour  on  a  buttered platter and cut into squares when cool.

name: ORIENTAL CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
chicken wing pieces
1/4  c. dark brown sugar
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. white wine
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. dry sherry
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. ginger
1 1/2  tsp. cornstarch
preparation: Mix and blend all ingredients, except chicken wings.  Place chicken in a glass pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: GRAINOLA CEREAL
ingredients:
4  c. rolled oats
3/4  c. wheat germ
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. salad oil
1/4  c. honey
preparation: Mix in microwave bowl. Coat everything thoroughly with the honey. Cook in microwave 6 minutes. Stir every 2 minutes. Put out on cookie sheet to cool. Store in plastic airtight bag or container.

name: HAMBURGER LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  loaf French bread
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
salt
pepper
garlic salt
Cheddar or American cheese slices
preparation: Cut off top of bread.  Save.  Clean bread out of center, tear center bread into pieces, set aside.  Brown hamburger, add soups, salt, pepper and garlic salt to taste.  Stir.  Add bread pieces. Layer cheese in bottom of loaf.  Spoon in hamburger mixture.  Top with more cheese.  Place top back on loaf.  Wrap in foil.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH PIE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. brown sugar
4  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  egg yolks, slightly beaten
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. milk
1  (9-inch) baked pie shell
preparation: Melt butter in heavy kettle over low heat.  Mix sugar, salt and flour; add to melted butter, stirring until mixture is heated. Add the milk and cook over medium heat.   When the mixture begins to thicken, add the beaten egg yolks.  Cook until smooth and thickened.  Cool slightly and add vanilla before pouring into a baked pie shell.  Add meringue, if desired.  I use filled soybean milk (8 ounce can).

name: HARD-COOKED EGGS WITH MUSHROOMS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
12  hard-boiled eggs
1  lb. chopped, sauteed mushrooms
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. paprika
2  c. white sauce
1/4  c. grated cheese
1  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Cut eggs in half. Remove yolks and put through sieve.  Add seasonings and 1/3 of the chopped mushrooms which have been sauteed in a small amount of butter.  Re-fill whites with yolk mixture.  Press 2 halves together.  Place in casserole.  Pour the cream sauce over them mixed with the remaining mushrooms. Sprinkle with cheese and bread crumbs. Bake at 350° until brown.

name: CHOC-OAT-CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. (2 sticks) margarine or butter, softened
1 1/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2 1/2  c. oats (uncooked)
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1  c. coarsely chopped nuts
preparation: Beat margarine and sugar until creamy.  Add eggs, milk and vanilla.  Beat well.  Add flour, baking soda and salt.  Mix well. Stir in oats, chocolate morsels and nuts.  Mix well.   Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 9 to 10 minutes at 375°.  Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet.  Remove to wire rack.

name: TUNA PATIO SALAD
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. Creamettes elbow macaroni (2 c. uncooked)
1 (7 oz.)  can tuna, drained and flaked
1 1/2  c. tomatoes, chopped
1  c. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1  c. cucumber, chopped
1/2  c. celery, sliced
1/4  c. green onion, sliced
1/4  c. green pepper, diced
1/2  c. bottled Italian dressing
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Prepare macaroni according to package directions. Drain. Combine macaroni, tuna, tomatoes, mushrooms, cucumber, celery, green onion and green pepper.  Blend Italian dressing, sour cream, seasoned salt and pepper.  Toss with macaroni mixture.  Chill. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: KOREAN MON-DU
ingredients:
1  pkg. bean sprouts
1  pkg. spinach
3  bunches green onions
1  pkg. bean cake
sesame oil
salt and pepper
beef round, chopped
preparation: Boil spinach and bean sprouts.  Dice onions.  Chop beef thinly.  Combine cooked vegetables, bean cake and beef.  Chop finely together.  Add sesame oil until mixture can make a ball. Add salt and pepper and mix more.  Put small mound on Mon-Du or egg roll square and make rectangle.  Seal edges tightly together with water.  Steam until dough is tender.  Dip in soy sauce and vinegar to taste.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef
2/3  c. oatmeal
1  egg
1  c. milk
salt and pepper
onion (if desired)
preparation: Mix together all ingredients and put into baking dish.

name: VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise
6  oz. cream cheese
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
dash of pepper
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  hard-boiled egg
preparation: Blend mayonnaise and cream cheese; add egg white.  Add remaining ingredients and blend until well mixed.  Put in serving dish and sprinkle egg yolk on top.

name: Szekely Gulyas
ingredients:
1/3  c. instant minced onion
water
3  Tbsp. bacon fat
2  lb. boneless pork shoulder, cut in 1-inch cubes
2  lb. sauerkraut, rinsed and well drained
3/4  c. dry white wine
1  Tbsp. paprika
1  tsp. caraway seed
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. tarragon leaves, crumbled
1/4  tsp. ground black pepper
1  chicken bouillon cube
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
preparation: Rehydrate minced onion in 1/3 cup water for 10 minutes; set aside.  In a large heavy saucepot, heat bacon fat.  Add pork; brown on all sides, a few pieces at a time; remove and set aside. To drippings left in saucepot, add sauerkraut and rehydrated onion; saute until golden, about 5 minutes.  Return pork to saucepot.  Stir in 1 cup water, wine, paprika, caraway, salt, tarragon, black pepper and bouillon cube.  Bring to the boiling point.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until pork is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.  Stir in sour cream.  Heat until hot.  Sprinkle with parsley flakes.  Serve with cooked noodles, if desired. Yields 6 to 8 portions.

name: ZUCCHINI AND PASTA
ingredients:
2  zucchini, chopped
olive oil Pam
1/2  c. onions, chopped
1/2  c. red pepper, chopped
1  Tbsp. butter
