1  tsp. garlic powder
6  oz. vermicelli or any thin spaghetti
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Bring a pot full of water to a boil.  Break up the vermicelli and cook until tender.  Drain and set aside.  Spray pan with olive oil Pam and saute onions, peppers, zucchini and garlic until fork-tender.  Toss with pasta and add butter, then coat with Parmesan.

name: Armadillo Eggs
ingredients:
1  lb. raw sausage
1  lb. grated cheddar cheese
3  c. bisquick
1 small  can chopped green chilies
Fresh jalapenos, seeded
box of Pork `Shake & Bake' Mix
preparation: Mix sausage, bisquick, cheese and chilies together. Form egg shape around jalapenos; roll in `Shake & Bake'. Bake at 350 degrees until done.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  lb. American Cheddar cheese
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  jar bacon flavored cheese
2 small  pkg. dried beef
1/2  small onion, minced
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
liquid smoke to taste
dash of garlic powder
preparation: Soften cream cheese and bacon flavored cheese.  Cheddar may be softened or chopped in food processor.  Chop dried beef and onion. Combine all together.  Shape into balls and chill.  Serve with assorted crackers.

name: OLD FASHIONED BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. dried peas
6  c. water
1 1/2  tsp. dried mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. salt
2  large onions, sliced
1/4  c. brown sugar and 1/3 c. maple sugar or 1/4 c. brown sugar and 1/4 c. molasses
2  Tbsp. sweet pickle juice or vinegar
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/2  c. catsup
1/4  lb. salt pork or bacon
preparation: Pick over your dried beans and rinse. Add beans to large bowl and add water. Let soak 8 hours or overnight. Place in large pot and boil uncovered. Add the remaining ingredients, except for the pork. Stir until blended. Lay the bacon or pork slices on top. Cover and simmer 6 to 8 hours, stirring occasionally. Add enough liquid while simmering to barely cover the beans, as necessary. Test for tenderness. Serves 4 to 6.

name: SAUSAGE SPINACH LOAF
ingredients:
3/4  lb. bulk sausage
1  (16 oz.) loaf frozen bread, thawed
1/2  lb. Mozzarella shredded cheese
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach, thawed
1  slightly beaten egg
1  Tbsp. water (optional)
caraway seed (optional)
preparation: Cook sausage until not pink.  Drain.  On floured surface roll dough to 15 x 8-inch rectangle.  Sprinkle cheese on dough, leaving 1-inch  border.  Top  with spinach and sausage.  Bring long sides  of  dough together.  Pinch to seal edges and ends. Place loaf  seam  down  on  greased baking sheet.  Combine egg white and  water.  Brush  over  loaf.  Sprinkle  with caraway. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden.  Let stand 8 to 10 minutes.

name: SHRIMP FAJITAS(Serves 8)
ingredients:
1  tsp. sweet paprika
1  tsp. onion powder
1  tsp. garlic powder
3/4  tsp. cayenne
1/2  tsp. dried thyme
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
2  lb. (about 45) shrimp, shelled and deveined
1  small onion, sliced thin
1  green pepper, sliced thin
1  red pepper, sliced thin
1/2  c. olive oil
3/4  c. lime juice
8  flour tortillas, heated
accompaniments (if desired):  guacamole, salsa, refried beans and sour cream
preparation: In a bowl, combine all seasonings plus salt and pepper to taste. Toss shrimp in mixture.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
3  c. milk
2  medium potatoes, pared and cubed
1  tsp. salt
1/2-inch  sliced onion
2  Tbsp. bacon fat
2  slices bacon, fried crisp
1  stalk celery, cut into 2-inch pieces
preparation: Place all ingredients in blender in order listed:  milk, potatoes, salt, onion, bacon fat, bacon and celery.  Cover and run on low speed, until vegetables and bacon are chopped.  Pour into saucepan.  Simmer over low heat 30 minutes.

name: BUTTER BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  c. light brown sugar
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
dash of Tabasco sauce
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan.  Add onions and saute until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients.  Simmer 5 minutes.  Use on your favorite meat.

name: PEPPER NUT SANDWICHES
ingredients:
2  (8 oz) pkgs cream cheese, softened
1  med bell pepper, chopped
1/2  c onion, finely chopped
1/2  c pecans, finely chopped
1/2  c sour cream
1/4  c mayonnaise
preparation: Blend all ingredients together.  Spread on trimmed whole-wheat or white bread.  This yields 5 dozen finger sandwiches.

name: OLIVE ROYALE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. sliced black olives
6  medium size mushrooms, sliced
6  cherry tomatoes, halved
1/2  c. French dressing
1  bag fresh spinach, washed
3  Tbsp. green onions, chopped
1  Tbsp. toasted sesame seed
1/4  tsp. curry powder
preparation: Combine first six ingredients.  Mix dressing with curry powder.  Pour over salad and toss well.  May prepare ahead of time but do not add dressing until just before serving.

name: MY SURPRISE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  regular size bag Tater Tots
preparation: Combine ground chuck and cream of mushroom soup thoroughly. Spread out in a 9-inch square baking dish.  Layer the Tater Tots on the top.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: ORANGE DATE NUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
3 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. grated orange rind
1  pkg. chopped dates, dredged in 1/2 c. flour
preparation: Combine shortening and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating until fluffy.  Sift flour, salt and soda together.  Add dry ingredients alternately with the milk to the first 3 ingredients.  Add the dates, orange rind and nuts; mix.  Pour into a tube pan and bake at 350° for an hour and 15 minutes, or until firm.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1  egg
salt and pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  c. water
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. mustard
3  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix  ground beef, egg, onion, bread crumbs, salt, pepper and 1/2 tomato sauce.  Shape into a loaf.  Mix remaining tomato sauce and  other  ingredients.  Pour  over meat loaf.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.

name: ZUR
ingredients:
1/2  lb. whole wheat flour
1/4  lb. bacon
2  sections garlic
3  c. boiling water
salt and pepper
1  piece sour rye bread
2  c. lukewarm water
1  lb. potatoes
1  can mushrooms
preparation: Cover the flour with lukewarm water.  Add a piece of sour rye bread of approximately 2 inches diameter.  Leave the mixture in a warm place for 24 hours.  When the mixture is well soured, take out the bread and pass the rest through a sieve.  Bring to a boil, 3 cups of water and slowly pour over the mixture, stirring constantly.  Leave it on low flame until it boils.  On the side, chop the bacon and the mushrooms and fry until lightly browned. Squeeze in the garlic and add both to the soup.  Serve with boiled potatoes.

name: SWISS BLISS
ingredients:
1/2  Tbsp. margarine
2  lb. chuck steak (1 inch thick)
1  envelope onion soup mix
1/2  lb. mushrooms, sliced
1/2  green pepper, sliced
1  lb. can tomatoes, drained and chopped (reserve juice)
1/4  tsp. salt
black pepper
1/2  c. juice from tomatoes
1  Tbsp. A.1. sauce
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: You also need 20-inch sheet of heavy-duty wrap.

name: CHEESY CORN
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
2  cans whole corn
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies
1/2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Drain corn.  Melt butter and cheese together.  Mix all together and cook at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SPINACH PETA "SPANOKOPETA"(Greek Spinach Pie)
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. spinach
6  eggs
2  lb. phyllo
3/4  lb. butter
1/2  lb. cottage cheese
1 1/4  lb. Greek cheese
preparation: Preheat oven at 350°.   Grease a 14 x 20-inch pan.  Melt butter.  Mix spinach, eggs, Greek cheese and cottage cheese together.   Place four phyllo sheets into a pan, brushing each sheet with melted butter.  Spread spinach mixture evenly on fifth sheet, alternating with butter and spinach mixture, on each sheet, with the exception of the last four phyllo, which should be buttered only.  Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.

name: MEX CHIQUITO CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo
4  Tbsp. flour
1 heaping  tsp. paprika
1 heaping  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. cumin powder
1  tsp. chili powder
1  Tbsp. ketchup
1  tsp. jalapeno juice
1  pod jalapeno pepper, chopped
2  c. milk
1  clove garlic or powder
8  oz. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Mix first 2 ingredients into paste.  Add remaining ingredients.  Combine all and bring to boil for 1 minute.  Remove from heat.

name: TACO SALAD DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburg
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pt. sour cream
1  jar picante sauce
chopped lettuce
tomato
onions
olives
shredded cheese
taco chips
preparation: Cook and drain hamburg.  Mix well with taco seasoning mix and spread in pan.  Mix cream cheese and sour cream; spread.  Spread with picante sauce.  Top with lettuce, tomato, onions, olives and with shredded cheese.  Serve with taco chips.

name: HEAVENLY ORANGE FLUFF
ingredients:
2  pkg. orange Jell-O
2  c. hot water
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice (undiluted)
1 medium  can crushed pineapple (not drained)
preparation: Mix ingredients and put in refrigerator to congeal.

name: PAELLA
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
4  (2 lb.) chicken breasts
1  lb. chorizo sausage
1 1/2  c. uncooked long grain rice
1  medium onion, cut 1/4-inch
2  (14 1/2 oz.) chicken broth
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. coarsely ground pepper
1/2  tsp. dried oregano leaves
1/16  tsp. powdered saffron
1  tsp. finely chopped fresh garlic
1  c. frozen peas
2  ripe tomatoes, cut 1-inch cubes
8  oz. large fresh or frozen shrimp, deveined
8  fresh whole clams (in shells), scrubbed
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In 10-inch skillet, heat 2 tablespoons oil over medium heat (1 to 2 minutes).  Add chicken and sausage; cook until chicken is lightly browned and sausage is no longer pink (15 to 20 minutes).  Remove chicken and sausage; set aside.  Drain off fat.  Reserve 2 tablespoons.  Stir rice and onion into fat.  Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until rice is golden (3 to 5 minutes).  Gradually stir in chicken broth, salt, pepper, oregano, saffron and garlic.  Continue cooking until mixture comes to a full boil (10 to 12 minutes); place mixture in roasting pan. Top with chicken and sausage.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until rice is tender.  Stir in peas and tomatoes; top with shrimp and clams.  Cover; continue baking, stirring occasionally until shrimp turn pink and clams open.  Discard any clams that do not open.

name: BEEF MUSHROOM STEW
ingredients:
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2 1/2 to 3  lb. beef round steak, cut into cubes
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  c. beef broth
3/4  c. water
1 (8 oz.)  jar whole mushrooms, drained
cooked rice or noodles
1  Tbsp. dried parsley
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  bay leaves
1  garlic clove, minced
preparation: Place flour, salt and pepper in plastic bag.  Add beef cubes and shake to coat on all sides.  Brown beef in oil in large saucepan.  Stir in broth, water, mushrooms, onion, bay leaves, garlic and parsley; bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender.  Thicken, if desired. Serve over rice or noodles.  Yields 8 to 10 servings.

name: DIVINITY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/3  c. water
1/3  c. light corn syrup
1/4  tsp. salt
2  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine sugar, water, corn syrup and salt in 1-quart casserole and cover.   Microwave at 100% power 5 minutes.  Stir well. Microwave, uncovered, at 100% power until a hard ball forms when a small amount is dropped in cold water, 4 to 6 minutes.  Cool 3 to 4 minutes.   Beat egg whites until very stiff.  Pour sugar mixture in a steady stream over egg whites, beating constantly until mixture holds its shape and starts to lose its gloss.   Stir in vanilla and nuts.  Drop by teaspoons onto wax paper.

name: HEATH BAR COOKIE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. chocolate chips
cooking spray
1  c. granulated sugar
soda crackers (about 30)
preparation: Line cookie sheet with sides (or jelly roll pan, or broiler pan bottom) with aluminum foil. Spray foil with cooking spray. Cover bottom of pan with single layer of crackers. Set aside.

name: RUMAKI
ingredients:
3  cans water chestnuts
3  lb. bacon
1 small  bottle barbecue sauce
1 small  bottle sweet and sour sauce
4  Tbsp. honey
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
1/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: You will also need 2 boxes of round toothpicks.

name: CROUTE PROVENCALE(Serves 4)
ingredients:
2  large onions
5  Tbsp. olive oil
4  ripe tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped (if using canned, add sugar)
salt and ground black pepper
1/2  tsp. dry thyme
1/2  tsp. oregano
1  green pepper, seeded and minced
4  slices firm white bread (large French or Italian), remove crusts
4  Tbsp. butter
4  anchovy fillets
4  black olives, pitted and sliced
1/2  c. grated Swiss cheese
1/4  c. fine dry bread crumbs
garlic (optional)
preparation: Mince the onions and saute them in 3 tablespoons of olive oil until tender and lightly browned.  Add the tomatoes to the pan and season with salt and pepper; mix well.  Add the thyme and green pepper and cook the mixture, stirring constantly, until all of the liquid has evaporated and the mixture is thick.

name: CHICKEN AND BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
2  (10 oz.) chopped frozen broccoli
4  Tbsp. butter
6  Tbsp. flour
3  c. milk
2/3  c. shredded cheese (Cheddar)
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
6  c. cooked, diced chicken
preparation: Cook broccoli according to directions.  Place in a 9 x 12-inch dish.  In saucepan, melt butter.  Saute onion until tender.  Blend in flour, salt and pepper to form smooth paste.  Gradually add milk.  Beat, stirring until thickened.  Add chicken and pour sauce over broccoli.  Top with cheese.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

name: VEGETABLE PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. 2 frozen deep-dish pie shells
1 large  pkg. crushed Mozzarella cheese
1 large  pkg. sliced Swiss cheese
2  large tomatoes, sliced
1  large onion, chopped in chunks
3  medium zucchini, sliced
1  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1  bell pepper, chopped in chunks
1  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. hot water
preparation: Saute onions, mushrooms, bell pepper and zucchini until color brightens.  Season with salt and pepper and drain in colander. Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook empty shells until they are lightly golden.  Line pie shells with Swiss cheese and then tomato slices. Fill with vegetables.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow squash
1  large onion
salt and pepper to taste
1 small  carton sour cream
1 1/2  sticks butter or margarine
1  can mushroom soup
2  c. Pepperidge Farm herb and spice mix
preparation: Chop squash and onion; cook until tender.  Add salt and pepper.  In a saucepan over low heat, mix well the sour cream, butter and soup.  In a casserole, layer the herb and spice mix, drained squash and onion and the sauce mix.  Continue to layer in order until all of the ingredients are used.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly and slightly brown.  Serves 6.

name: BLUE CHEESE BITES
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour, sifted
2  tsp. dried chopped chives
1/4  c. shortening
1/3  c. crumbled Blue cheese
1/2 to 3/4  c. milk
1  egg white
3  Tbsp. water
1/2  c. fine dry bread crumbs
preparation: Stir together flour and chives.  Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Add Blue cheese, then blend in enough of the milk to make a soft dough.  Turn onto lightly floured board and knead gently about 20 times and then shape into 1 inch balls.  Now, combine egg white and water.  Dip balls into egg white mixture; roll in crumbs.  Bake in preheated oven at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes about 4 dozen appetizers.

name: BLACK BOTTOM CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/3  c. granulated sugar
1  c. chocolate chips
1  unbeaten egg
1/8  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. water
1/2  Tbsp. white vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. cooking oil
preparation: Beat together the first 5 ingredients; set aside.  In another bowl, sift together the next 5 ingredients.  Add to this the water, vinegar, vanilla and cooking oil.  Beat until well blended. Fill paper lined muffin tins 1/3 to 1/2 full with chocolate batter.  Top with 1 heaping teaspoonful cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle top with granulated sugar.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: CREAMY VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lg. onion, chopped
1/4  c. margarine
3  med. zucchini, chopped
2  med. potatoes, chopped
3  med. sweet potatoes, peeled and chopped
2  qt. chicken broth and chicken breast
2  c. cream or milk
1  bunch broccoli, chopped
1  tsp. celery seed
1 to 2  tsp. ground cumin
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Sauté onions in margarine, add sweet potatoes and broccoli, add chicken broth and chicken breast.  Cook 10 minutes, add potatoes (sweet and white) and seasonings.  Cook till chicken is done add milk last.

name: MEXICAN STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. lean ground meat
1  medium size onion
3  cans minestrone soup
2  cans Ro-Tel tomatoes
2  cans Ranch Style beans
preparation: Sauté meat and chopped onion; drain and add to other ingredients. Simmer in large pot for about 15 minutes.

name: FRUIT ROLL(No Cooking)
ingredients:
1  lb. marshmallows, chopped
1  lb. dates, chopped
15  graham crackers, rolled into crumbs
1/2  c. nuts (pecans and walnuts)
1  c. coconut
1  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Mix in large bowl; shape in rolls and roll in graham cracker crumbs from 15 additional crackers.  Roll in foil and store in refrigerator.

name: LENTIL SPINACH SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. pkg. lentils
1  pkg. frozen spinach
1  small chopped onion
1  stalk celery, chopped
1  carrot, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
8  c. water
1  bouillon cube
2  Tbsp. vinegar
freshly ground pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a large soup pot or crock-pot. Cook on low for 6 hours.  If using a crock-pot, set crock-pot to high and cook 6 hours.  Add ground pepper to taste.  Can also add two chopped Italian sausages to ingredients for different flavor before cooking.

name: PISTACHIO JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. pistachio Jell-O pudding mix (dry)
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  c. small marshmallows
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 large  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix  dry  pudding  mix with pineapple, marshmallows and lemon juice.  Then add Cool Whip and mix well again.  Refrigerate.

name: BUTTER CAKE
ingredients:
3  sticks margarine or butter
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter and sugar together.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.  Sift flour, soda and baking powder together.  Add milk and flour mixture to the butter mixture. Cream together.  Bake at 350° until pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Frost.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1  lb. can cream-style, whole or 1 pt. frozen corn
2  eggs
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
preparation: To the corn, add flour and sugar.  Mix well.  Beat eggs well and add milk.  Stir the 2 mixtures together.  Add butter, which has been melted in a baking pan.  Bake until golden brown (about 45 minutes at 350°).

name: DATE BALLS
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. chopped dates
1  stick margarine
pinch of salt
1  well beaten egg
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. Rice Krispies
chopped nuts
1  pkg. coconut
preparation: Place dates, margarine, salt, egg and vanilla in saucepan. Cook 10 minutes; cool.  Add Rice Krispies and nuts.  Grease hands and roll into balls.  Roll in coconut.

name: SQUASH AND APPLE BAKE
ingredients:
2  butternut or buttercup squash
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  c. melted butter or margarine
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. mace (optional)
2  baking apples, cored and cut into 1/2-inch slices
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Cut each squash in half.  Remove seeds and fibers; pare squash.  Cut into 1 1/2-inch slices.  Stir together remaining ingredients, except apple slices.  Arrange squash in ungreased baking dish, 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inches.  Top with apple slices.  Sprinkle sugar mixture on top; cover with foil. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until squash is tender.  Yield:  6 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. self-rising flour
1/3  c. cocoa
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
2  egg yolks
1  whole egg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, flour, cocoa and salt.  Add milk to mixture slowly. Beat egg yolks slightly and add to filling.  Stir in vanilla. Cook slowly in a double boiler until thick.  Pour in a baked pie crust and add meringue while filling is still hot.  Bake in a slow oven until light brown.

name: NUTEENA A LA KING
ingredients:
1  can Nuteena, cubed
2  medium onions, minced
4  Tbsp. margarine
3  Tbsp. minced parsley
1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
2  c. white sauce
1/2  c. grated mild cheese
seasoning
4  hard-boiled eggs, sliced
6  slices buttered toast
preparation: Saute onions and mushrooms in margarine until tender.  Season to taste.  Add parsley and Nuteena and continue to brown at a low temperature.  Prepare white sauce and when mixture is slightly thickened, add grated cheese.  Stir until thoroughly blended.  If mixture becomes too thick, add more milk.  Combine the sliced eggs and Nuteena mixture with the white sauce and serve over the toasted bread.

name: MOLASSES OATMEAL BREAD
ingredients:
4  c. boiling water
2  c. oatmeal
10-12 c. flour
2  pkg. yeast
2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. molasses
1/2  c. honey
1/2  c. oil
2  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. almonds, ground
preparation: Pour boiling water over oatmeal, let stand one hour. Mix 2 cups of the flour, yeast and salt. Heat molasses, honey and oil to lukewarm, and stir in dry ingredients. Stir in oatmeal and beat until smooth. Add beaten eggs and nuts. Mix in enough of remaining flour to make dough stiff enough to handle. Knead well. Let rise in covered bowl until double in bulk. Divide into 3 loaf pans. Let rise again. Bake in 350 degree oven for 30 minutes or until loaf sounds hollow when tapped.

name: PEANUT BUTTER SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo
1  c. water
1  c. peanut butter
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk mixed with 1 Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
preparation: Bring to a boil: oleo, water and peanut butter.  Quickly add in sugar, flour, soda and salt. Mix well. Add milk mixture, vanilla and eggs.  Bake in a greased pan at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. fresh broccoli (or may use frozen)
1  c. mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. mild Cheddar cheese, grated
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  eggs, well beaten
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  pkg. Pepperidge Farm cheese and garlic croutons
preparation: Do not add additional salt!!!  Cook broccoli and drain. Combine eggs, soup, mayonnaise and onion.  Mix these with broccoli and pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.  Sprinkle cheese over top.  Melt butter and mix with croutons.  Spread croutons over top of broccoli mixture.  Bake 45 minutes to an hour at 350°.  Very good for freezing.  Leftovers are excellent!

name: CUCUMBER AND CREAM CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. horseradish
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. hot sauce
2  tsp. minced onion
1/2  medium cucumber, peeled  and chopped
preparation: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Add next 4 ingredients and mix well. Stir in onion and cucumber. Spoon into covered container. Chill until ready to use.  Makes 2 cups.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (3 lb.) frying chicken, cut up
salt and pepper
1/4  c. Wesson oil
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (15 oz.)  can Hunt's tomato sauce
2  c. water
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. regular rice
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, thawed
1/2  c. sliced ripe olives
preparation: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper; brown in Wesson oil in skillet.  Add onion; saute.  Stir in tomato sauce, water, salt, pepper and rice.  Bring to boil.  Cover; simmer for 45 minutes. Add peas and olives; continue cooking, covered, for 15 minutes. Serves 4.

name: CHICKEN-SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (4 lb.) broiler-fryer
1  bay leaf
8  oz. uncooked spaghetti
1  large onion, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes, drained and chopped
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
4  drops hot sauce
1/8  tsp. pepper
salt to taste
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded medium Cheddar cheese
preparation: Place chicken and bay leaf in a large Dutch oven and cover with salted water.  Bring to a boil; cover.  Reduce heat and simmer 1 hour or until tender.  Remove chicken and let cool. Discard bay leaf.  Bone chicken and cut meat into bite-size pieces; set aside.  Reserve 1/4 cup chicken broth; set aside.

name: TUNA POT PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. refrigerated all-ready pie crusts
1 - 12 1/2oz.  can tuna, drained
1 - 10oz.  pkg. frozen peas and carrots
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 - 10 3/4oz  can Cream of Potato or Cream of Mushroom soup
1/3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning or dried thyme
preparation: Line 9-inch pie pan with 1 crust; set aside.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Pour filling in pie pan.  Top with second crust.  Seal and crimp edges.  Slit top of crust to vent and bake at 375° for 45-50 minutes or until golden brown.

name: PICKLED CARROTS(Diabetic)
ingredients:
4  or 5 carrots, chunked or baby carrots
1  c. sugar or NutraSweet
1/2  c. olive oil
3/4  c. seasoned vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  can tomato soup
1  medium onion, sliced
1  medium diced green pepper
preparation: Cook carrots until tender.  Do not overcook.  Combine everything and let set overnight.  May add cucumbers or cauliflower, etc.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
4  eggs
1  c. vegetable oil
3  c. sugar
2/3  c. water
2  c. canned pumpkin
2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
3  tsp. baking powder
1  c. mashed ripe bananas
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  c. sifted flour
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Beat eggs until light and add. Press bananas and add lemon juice.  Blend with creamed mixture. Sift flour, baking powder and salt together, then combine.  Add nuts.  Bake in greased 1 pound loaf pan.  Bake at 375°  for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. oil or 3/4 c. melted shortening
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. grated zucchini, unpeeled
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix eggs, oil and sugar.  Add all other ingredients in order given.  Cook in 2 loaf pans, greased.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Sometimes I add 1/2 cup chopped nuts, chocolate chips or raisins.

name: BURGUNDY BEEF
ingredients:
1  onion, wedged
8  oz. pkg. fresh mushrooms
1 1/2 to 2  lb. round steak
tarragon
1  can golden cream of mushroom soup
Burgundy wine
preparation: Place onion wedges in bottom of crock-pot.  Cut steak into 2-inch pieces.  Place on top of onion.  Mix golden cream of mushroom soup with 1/4 soup can of Burgundy.  Pour over meat. Sprinkle in 1/4 teaspoon of tarragon.  Cook on high for 5 to 6 hours.  Slice mushrooms and add to pot.  Cook 30 minutes longer. Serve over egg noodles.

name: HOT FUDGE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. hot water
1/2  c. butter or margarine
preparation: Mix sugar, cocoa and cornstarch; add hot water.  Place in top of double boiler, bring to boil, stirring constantly.  Cook 2 or 3 minutes until thick.  Remove and cool slightly; add margarine or butter.  Keep warm.

name: RAMSEY MCMUFFINS(Breakfast Or Luncheon)
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  box Pepperidge Farm seasoned croutons
12  oz. bacon, fried and diced or crumbled
1 to 1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
12  eggs
preparation: In medium bowl, break down (smash) the croutons so they are almost crumblike.  Add enough water to moisten so it is doughlike. Spray 12 muffin cup tin with Pam.  Divide crouton mixture among the 12 cups; press croutons into the bottom 1/3 of each cup. Divide bacon among the cups, adding that layer next.  Now, crack 1 egg into each cup, breaking the yolk.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.   Top with shredded cheese, mounding over each egg.  Bake in a 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes (until egg looks solid under melted cheese).  Serves 12.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
3/4  c. celery, chopped
1  c. cooked rice
1 (4 oz.)  can pimento, chopped
1 1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Brown sausage and onion; drain well.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: APPLESAUCE SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. allspice
1  c. raisins
1/3  c. warm water
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. applesauce
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Soak raisins in warm water.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Combine first 6 ingredients; set aside.  In a large bowl, cream sugar and margarine at medium speed. Beat until light and fluffy.  Add eggs; beat well.  Reduce speed to low.  Add flour mixture alternately with applesauce, beating after each addition, just until smooth.  Stir in nuts and raisins (drained of water from raisins).  Pour batter into pan.  Bake 35 to 45 minutes.  Cool on wire rack.

name: JESSICA'S QUESADILLAS
ingredients:
2  (large) flour tortillas
1  cup of grated cheese (Monterey Jack and cheddar)
salsa
sour cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Lightly coat baking sheet with cooking spray.  Place 1 flour tortilla on baking sheet.  Spoon cheeses over tortilla.  Place another tortilla on top.  Bake 1 minute and turn tortilla over and cook another minute or until cheese is melted.  Cut quesadilla in quarters and serve with sour cream and salsa.  Serves 2.

name: MEATBALLS FOR A PARTY
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. mild sausage
1  egg, beaten
1/4  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic
1  c. heated salsa
1  c. barbecue sauce
cold Chinese sweet and sour sauce
2  Tbsp. horseradish mixed with 1 c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all together.  Make 1-inch meatballs.  Cook at 350° about 20 minutes.  Serve on toothpicks with any one of these dipping sauces:

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
4  to 5 fresh peaches, peeled and sliced thin
5  slices day old bread, cubed
1  stick margarine, melted
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  egg
preparation: Butter a 9 or 10-inch dish, 1/2-inch deep.  Place peaches in dish.  Spread bread cubes evenly over peaches.  Mix butter, sugar, flour and egg together.  Pour evenly over bread, making sure all bread is covered.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until golden brown.

name: PASTA SHELLS WITH ARTICHOKES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. shells, cooked
1  yellow pepper, cut into strips
1  red pepper, cut into strips
1  green pepper, cut into strips
2  large minced garlic cloves
1/2  c. fresh chopped basil
2  jars drained marinated artichokes
red wine vinegar
salt and pepper
1/2  c. freshly grated Parmesan
preparation: Saute peppers in oil, garlic and basil until crisp and tender. Chop artichokes and add to peppers to heat.  Add pasta, salt and pepper.  Follow sparingly with a few good dashes of wine vinegar. Drain excess oil.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Toss and transfer to platter.  Serve with a goblet of your favorite wine and hearty loaf of bread!  Bon appetit!

name: QUICK YEAST MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1 1/2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. sugar
4  c. self-rising flour
2  c. very warm water
1  beaten egg
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water and set aside.  Melt margarine and cream with sugar.  Add yeast and beaten egg.  Gradually add flour. Stir until well mixed.  Spoon mixture into greased muffin pans, filling two-thirds full.  Bake at 375° for about 25 minutes or until golden brown.

name: HOLIDAY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. chopped nuts
1  can green olives
chopped onion, sauteed
chili powder to taste
salt and pepper
1/2  c. sweet relish
bacon, cooked and crumbled
preparation: Mix all together.  Roll into a ball; garnish by rolling in pecans and 1/2 of bacon.  Be creative and design or decorate with olives and pimentos.  Chill for 1 hour.  Serve with fancy crackers.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2/3  c. Pet milk
16  regular marshmallows
1/2  c. oleo
few grains of salt
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. cut up nuts (optional)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, milk, marshmallows, oleo and salt.  Cook, stirring constantly over medium heat to a boil; mixture should be bubbling all over top.  Boil and stir 5 minutes more.  Take off heat.  Add remaining ingredients and stir until completely melted. Spread in buttered 8-inch square pan; cool.  Cut into 30 pieces.

name: PEANUT BUTTER SPECIAL TREAT
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  lb. 2 oz. confectioners sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/4  c. peanut butter
2  Tbsp. milk
1 1/4  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt butter.  Add confectioners sugar, cocoa, peanut butter, milk and vanilla.  Mix until smooth.  Roll into balls.  Roll in confectioners sugar, if desired.

name: CHESS CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  stick soft margarine
1  egg
1  box powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  eggs
preparation: Cut cake mix, margarine and egg together until mixture is soft like dough.  Press into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Beat together powdered sugar, cream cheese and eggs until smooth.   Pour over pressed mixture and bake at 350°  for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: SPICY DOG BITES
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. franks
1/2  c. currant jelly
1/2  c. chili sauce
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. dried minced onion
preparation: Cut each frank crosswise into 5 or 6 pieces.  Place in chafing dish or stove top casserole over low heat.  In a small saucepan, combine jelly, chili sauce, mustard and onion.  Stir over low heat until jelly melts.  Pour over franks and heat through.  Serve warm.

name: CRANBERRY/ORANGE NUT SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. hot water
1  pkg. raspberry flavored gelatin
1/2  c. cold water
1/2  c. mandarin orange slices (canned)
1  lb. can jellied cranberry sauce
1/4  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Pour hot water over gelatin; stir until dissolved.  Add cold water.  Break up jellied cranberry sauce and fold into gelatin mix and mix thoroughly.  Add orange and nuts.  Chill until firm.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. white sugar
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1  c. extra crunchy peanut butter
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil.  Boil for 6 minutes.  Add peanut butter; beat until cool.  Pour into buttered dish.

name: STRAWBERRY JELLO CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow or white cake mix
4  boxes strawberry jello
1  lb. fresh or frozen strawberries, crushed
16  oz. whipped topping
preparation: Prepare jello according to package directions, reducing water by 2 cups, to use a total of 6 cups water.  Add strawberries and juice.  Chill.  Prepare cake according to package directions.  Bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan.  When cake is done, remove from oven and, while still hot, cut into random squares (1 to 2-inch squares). Pour slightly thickened jello over cake and gently press cake into pan and flatten top.  Chill until firm.  Spread whipped topping over cake and serve.

name: ASPARAGUS(Serves 8)
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
4  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. soy sauce
preparation: Scrape sides of asparagus. Cut into 1-inch pieces. Heat butter and cook asparagus for one minute.  Sprinkle with sugar and cook for 30 seconds.  Sprinkle with soy sauce and cook for 30 seconds.

name: STRAWBERRY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  lb. grated sharp cheese
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. onion, finely chopped
dash of cayenne pepper
strawberry preserves
preparation: Mix cheese, mayonnaise, onion and pecans. Form into a mound and make an indentation on top. Spread preserves all over the top, inside indentation. Serve with crackers of any kind. (This can be placed in a mold. When firm, turn out on a dish and put the preserves in the hole in the center.)

name: PRALINE GRAHAMS
ingredients:
1  pkg. graham crackers
3/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Separate each graham cracker into 4 sections.  Arrange in a jellyroll pan with edges touching.  Melt butter in a saucepan; stir in sugar and pecans.  Bring to boil; cook 3 minutes, stirring frequently.  Spread mixture evenly over graham crackers.  Bake at 300° for 12 minutes.  Remove from pan, cool on wax paper.  Yield: 3 1/2 dozen.

name: CARAMEL POPCORN
ingredients:
2/3  c. popped popcorn
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white corn syrup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Combine  margarine,  brown  sugar  and	corn syrup in a large saucepan;  bring  to a boil.  Boil for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally,  so  it doesn't scorch.  Remove from heat. Add baking  soda;  mixture will foam.  Pour over popped corn; mix well.  Pour  into  unbuttered  large pan (a roaster works well); place  in  a 200° oven for 1 hour, stirring about every 15 minutes.  Store in covered container.

name: RAISIN CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. oil
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. raisins, cooked
1  tsp. salt
4  c. flour
1  tsp. cloves
2  c. raisin water, cooled
chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Boil raisins in 2 cups water for 5 minutes.  Cool and drain, reserving the raisin water.  Sift all dry ingredients; add sugar, oil and raisin water.  Mix well.  Add raisins and mix well.  Add nuts, if using them, and mix well.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: NEW ORLEANS RED BEANS AND RICE
ingredients:
1  lb. red kidney beans, soaked
1  meaty ham bone
1/2  lb. sliced smoked sausage
1/2  lb. sliced pickled or salt pork
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1 minced  clove garlic
2  bay leaves
1/2  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. ground black pepper
1  pinch cayenne
1  pinch Creole seasoning
1  c. raw rice
preparation: Soak beans in cold water overnight.  Drain beans.  Put all ingredients except for rice in large stock pot.  Add cold water to cover ingredients.  Bring to boil, cover and lower flame.  Simmer over low heat for about 1 1/2 hours.  Prevent sticking by stirring and scraping sides every 1/2 hour.  If too thick, may add water. Cook rice as instructed and serve with beans.

name: SEVEN-LAYER DIP
ingredients:
1  can refried beans, mixed with 1 pkg. taco seasoning
shredded Cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese
chopped purple onion
chopped tomatoes
sliced black olives
sour cream
salsa
preparation: Layer in order listed.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: ZUCCHINI LASAGNA
ingredients:
4  c. thinly sliced zucchini
1  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. diced onion
4  eggs, well beaten
parsley, fresh or flakes
fresh pepper slices (optional)
1/2  tsp. salt
oregano and garlic flakes or Italian seasoning
pepper
1/2 to 1  c. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients in large bowl.  Add zucchini slices.  Mix together.  Bake in 9 x 13-inch dish at 350° until done.

name: AUNT MATT'S PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large  can pineapple juice
12  oz. can frozen orange juice
1/2  gal. lemonade or lemonade Kool-Aid, mixed up
1 large  box jello (any flavor)
preparation: Mix jello with water as directed on package. Add all juices and mix well. Chill in refrigerator.

name: HOT ROLLS
ingredients:
5  c. flour
2  pkg. dry yeast
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. soft oleo
1 1/2  c. hot tap water
2  eggs
preparation: Combine 2 cups flour, yeast, sugar and salt in large bowl. Stir well to blend.  Add oleo and hot tap water.  Beat with electric mixer for 2 minutes.  Scrape sides of bowl occasionally. Add eggs and 1 cup flour.  Beat with electric mixer for 1 or 2 minutes until thick and elastic.  Gradually stir in just enough remaining flour with wooden spoon to make a soft dough which leaves the side of bowl.  Turn out on a floured board.  Knead for 5 to 10 minutes or until dough is smooth and elastic.

name: CREME PUFF DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. water
1  stick butter
1  c. flour
4  eggs
1  large vanilla instant pudding
3  c. milk
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Combine 1 cup water and 1 stick butter and bring to boil. Stir in 1 cup flour and mix until blended.  Remove from burner. Beat in 4 eggs, one at a time, until blended.  Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.  Let fall and cool. Then beat 1 large vanilla instant pudding with 3 cups milk and 1 large 8 ounce package of cream cheese.  Refrigerate 15 minutes. Spread Cool Whip on top.  Refrigerate until ready to eat.  Cut into squares.  Serves 8 to 10 persons.

name: POPPY SEED CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  chicken breasts or 1 whole chicken
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
3  Tbsp. poppy seed
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  c. crushed Ritz crackers
1 1/2  sticks oleo
preparation: Season and cook chicken.  Bone and cut in bite-size pieces. Place in buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.  Mix soup and sour cream and heat.  Pour over chicken.  Mix crackers and poppy seed and place on top of meat.  Drizzle melted oleo on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes, until bubbly.

name: HERB-MARINATED CHICKEN(Makes 6 servings)
ingredients:
2 to 2 1/2  lb. meaty chicken pieces
2  Tbsp. oil
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  c. white wine
2  tsp. dried basil
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. onion salt
2  cloves garlic, minced
preparation: Place cleaned chicken in a heavy plastic bag.  For marinade, in a bowl combine wine, oil, vinegar, basil, oregano, onion salt and garlic.  Pour over chicken in bag.  Close bag and coat chicken well.  Marinate for 5 to 24 hours in refrigerator, turning bag occasionally.

name: "UNDER THE SEA" SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can pears
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime Jell-O
1  tsp. vinegar
1  c. boiling water
1/4  c. cold water
1  Tbsp. lemon or lime juice
1/2  c. pear syrup
2  pkg. (3 oz.) cream cheese
1/8  tsp. ground ginger
preparation: Drain pears, reserving 1/2 cup syrup.  Dice pears and set aside.  Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.  Add cold water and pear juice, vinegar and lemon juice.  Measure 1 1/4 cups into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan.  Chill until set, but not firm (will be sticky to the touch).  Meanwhile, soften cheese.  Beat in remaining Jell-O. Blend in ginger.  Fold in pears.  Spoon over set Jell-O in pan. Chill overnight or until firm.  Unmold on crisp lettuce.  Makes 6 servings.

name: TOASTED COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter, melted
1 1/3  c. flaked coconut
4  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pie shell
preparation: Thoroughly beat eggs and combine with sugar, butter, lemon juice and vanilla.  Stir in coconut and pour filling into uncooked pie crust.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI STUFFING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  bunch fresh broccoli
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  box stove top stuffing
cheddar cheese
preparation: Prepare stuffing mix as directed on box.  Layer as follows: broccoli, 1 can soup, stuffing mix, remaining can of soup.  Top with cheddar cheese.  Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 1/2 hour.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FINGERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  unbeaten egg
1/3  c. peanut butter
1/2  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  c. quick cooking oats
1  c. chocolate chips
1/2  c. powdered sugar
2 to 4  Tbsp. evaporated milk
1/4  c. peanut butter
preparation: Cream butter; add both sugars.  Blend in egg, peanut butter, soda, salt and vanilla.  Stir in flour and oats.  Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Sprinkle with chocolate chips; let stand 5 minutes.

name: FROZEN PINK SALAD
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sugar
4  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. pecans, chopped
1  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  pint whipping cream, whipped well
red food color
preparation: Thoroughly mix cream cheese, mayonnaise and sugar together. Add marshmallows, pecans and fruit cocktail.  Add desired amount of red food color to the whipped cream.  Fold in colored whipped cream.  Freeze in thin layer in serving dish.  Cut into small squares before serving.  Serve frozen or only partially thawed. (This was served on a restaurant buffet on Sundays.)

name: CHICKEN MOO GOO GAI PAN
ingredients:
1  lb. fat trimmed chicken breast
1  Tbsp. light soy sauce
1  tsp. salad oil
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1  c. sliced onion
1/2  c. thinly sliced mushrooms
1  c. fat-skimmed, undiluted condensed chicken broth, divided
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen Oriental mixed vegetables, thawed
1  tsp. cornstarch
preparation: Cut poultry into 1-inch cubes.  Combine with soy sauce, oil and ginger; mix well.  Spray nonstick electric frypan or large skillet with cooking spray.  Add poultry in single layer.  Cook and stir over medium-high heat until lightly browned.  Stir in onion and mushrooms.  Mix well.  Stir in 3/4 cup broth.  Add mixed vegetables.  Cover and simmer 5 minutes.  Mix remaining broth with cornstarch until smooth; stir into skillet.  Cook and stir until sauce is thick.  Serve over hot rice.  Makes 4 servings, approximately 190 calories each.

name: SUPPER IN FOIL
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. roast or chuck steak
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  envelope onion soup mix
3  medium carrots, quartered
2  stalks celery, cut into 2-inch pieces
3  medium potatoes, pared and quartered
2  tsp. water
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Place 24 x 18-inch piece of foil in baking pan.  Place meat on foil.  Stir together mushroom soup and onion soup mix (dry).  Spread on meat.  Top meat with vegetables. Sprinkle water on vegetables.  Fold foil over and seal securely. Cook 1 1/2 hours or until tender.

name: PINTO BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. beans
1/4  tsp. cumin
1/4  tsp. oregano
1  large onion, chopped
2  or 3 ribs celery (with tops), chopped
1  bay leaf
1  jalapeno pepper
1  garlic pod
1  grated carrot
ham pieces or ham hocks
preparation: Cover with water and simmer until done.

name: PEAR CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. oil
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
4  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. nutmeg
3  c. grated pears
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: FOOLPROOF PIE CRUST
ingredients:
6  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. shortening
2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  egg
2  Tbsp. vinegar
water
preparation: Mix together first four ingredients with fork or pastry blender.  Set aside.  Stir together egg, vinegar and enough water to make 1 cup.  Add to flour mixture.  Chill 15 minutes, or shape into balls; flatten and freeze.  Thaw and roll out for pie crust. Mixture may be stored in refrigerator for 3 weeks.  Makes 7 crusts.

name: SCALOPPINE AL LIMONE(Sauteed Veal Or Chicken With Lemon)
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. veal or chicken scallops, pounded thin (1/4-inch)
salt
freshly ground pepper
flour
3  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. butter
3/4  c. beef stock
6  slices lemon (paper thin)
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. soft butter
preparation: Season scallops with salt and pepper. Coat with flour.  Melt butter in 10 to 12 inch skillet over moderate heat.  Add oil. Saute scallops for about 2 minutes on each side (until golden). Transfer scallops to platter. Pour off most of fat leaving just a film.  Add 1/2 cup beef stock.  Boil for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Return scallops to pan. Arrange lemon slices on top. Cover pan and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: SHONEY'S STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  baked pie shell
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. water
1/4  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2 small  pkg. strawberry gelatin
1  qt. strawberries
preparation: Combine sugar, water, salt and cornstarch.  Cook, stirring, until thick and clear; remove from heat.  Add strawberry gelatin, stirring until dissolved.  Cool.  Pour over sliced berries in pie shell.  Refrigerate.  Cover with whipped cream before serving.

name: HAWAIIAN BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. apple pie spice
1/2 to 3/4  c. chopped nuts
3  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. oil
2  c. mashed ripe bananas
8  oz. crushed pineapple, drained
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine dry ingredients.  Stir in nuts; set aside.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Add to dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened.  Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 5 minutes.  (I usually bake it 55 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean when tested in center of loaf.)

name: OREO SURPRISE
ingredients:
Oreos
1 large  box chocolate pudding
1  small bowl Cool Whip
preparation: Crush Oreos in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Use enough to cover bottom. Mix pudding according to package directions.  Spread on top of Oreos.  Top with Cool Whip.  Sprinkle with more crushed Oreos. Chill.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BROILED FROSTING
ingredients:
4  Tbsp margarine
3/4  c light brown sugar
1/2  c peanut butter
1  Tbsp milk
preparation: Beat margarine until creamy.  Add brown sugar, peanut butter and milk, beat.  Spread on warm cake layers.  Place 4 inches from broiler unit.  Broil until topping bubbles.  (This happens quickly.)  Great on angel food cake.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  or 5 boneless chicken breasts
1  c. rice
1  can mushroom soup
1  can milk
1  envelope dry onion soup
preparation: In large casserole dish, pour in 1 cup rice, then add mushroom soup and milk (save a little to pour over chicken).  Then sprinkle package dry onion soup over rice and soup-milk mixture.  Layer chicken breasts over this and add the remaining soup and milk and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  This is good served with small salad.  This will serve 4 to 6 people.

name: MAKE YOUR OWN BUTTER
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. whipping cream
bread or crackers
preparation: Pour 1 tablespoon whipping cream in a baby food jar.  Shake. Shake until solid butter forms.  Spread on bread or crackers.

name: FAVORITE HAWAIIAN DESSERT
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
3 (3.4 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
4  c. cold milk
1 1/2  tsp. coconut extract (may substitute vanilla)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, well drained
4  packets Dream Whip, made by the directions
2  c. flaked coconut, toasted
preparation: Mix cake batter according to directions on box.  Pour into 2 greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pans.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until cake tests done.  Cool completely.

name: ROYAL FROSTING
ingredients:
1  box confectioners sugar
3  egg whites
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Beat sugar, egg whites and cream of tartar until very thick and very fluffy.  Keep covered with a damp towel at room temperature.  When dry, this frosting is like a hard candy.  Use to decorate cookies and to hold a gingerbread house together.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
9  slices white bread
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
4  egg yolks
1/3  c. melted butter
4  egg whites
1  pinch cream of tartar
preparation: Break bread in small pieces.  Place in mixing bowl with 1 cup sugar, evaporated milk, milk, vanilla, egg yolks and butter.  Mix well.  Pour into 10 x 8 x 2-inch size baking pan.  Bake in oven at 325° for 45 minutes.  Remove and make meringue.

name: HOT GERMAN POTATO SALAD FONDUE
ingredients:
1/4  lb. bacon
3/4  c. thinly sliced celery
1/2  c. green onion, chopped
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. water
1/3  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. mustard
1/4  tsp. celery seed
dash of pepper
4  c. sliced cooked potatoes
2  Tbsp. parsley
preparation: Brown bacon and then remove from pan and drain.  Add celery and onion to drippings.  Cook until onion is limp.  Stir in remaining ingredients except potatoes, parsley and bacon.  Cook until thickened.  Stir constantly.  Fold in potatoes, parsley and bacon.  Cover and heat.  Serves 6.

name: SEAFOAM SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime gelatin
1 medium  can pears, drained (reserve juice)
1  carton cottage cheese (small)
preparation: Heat 1 cup of the pear juice to boiling; remove from heat and add gelatin.  Add cottage cheese and whip with electric mixer. Mash pears with a fork and add to whipped mixture.  Fold in whipped topping.  Pour in an 8-inch square dish.  Chill until firm.  If desired, garnish with blueberries, which I do and makes it better.

name: SAND TARTS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. ground pecans or almonds
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. softened butter
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine flour, nuts, 1 cup sugar, butter, salt, cinnamon and vanilla with an electric mixer.  Divide dough into 36 balls.  Form into the crescent shape.

name: THE BEST SUGAR COOKIE YOU EVER ATE OR SNITCHED
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. butter
2  eggs
1  c. oil
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
5  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Cream sugar and butter; add next 4 ingredients.  After measuring flour, sift together with remaining dry ingredients; mix well.  Roll into balls the size of walnuts.  Dough will be soft. Roll balls in sugar.  Then flatten with palm of hand and mark with a fork or decorative cookie marker.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Makes 5 dozen.

name: OREO ICE CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. Oreo chocolate cookie crumbs
1  c. Planters pecan pieces, toasted and crushed
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. Blue Bonnet margarine, melted
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream or frozen yogurt, softened
prepared whipped topping
maraschino cherries
mini Oreo bite size chocolate sandwich cookies (for garnish)
preparation: In medium bowl, combine crumbs, pecans, sugar and margarine. Reserve 1 cup crumb mixture.  Press remaining crumb mixture on bottom and 2 inches up sides of 9-inch springform pan.

name: SHEPHERD'S PIE(One of my husband's favorites.)
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef or ground lamb
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. finely chopped onions
1/2  c. coarsely chopped celery
1/2  c. coarsely chopped carrots
1/4  c. freshly chopped parsley
3  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. tomato paste
1/2  c. dry red wine
1 1/2 to 2  c. beef broth
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. frozen corn kernels
3 or more  c. mashed potatoes
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Heat the butter in a saucepan and add onions, carrots and celery.  Cook, stirring until onions are wilted.  Add the 3 tablespoons of flour and stir with wire whisk. Add tomato paste, wine, beef broth and Worcestershire sauce.  Stir rapidly for two minutes and let simmer slowly for 10 minutes.  Set aside.

name: BLUEBERRY SWIRL(Diet)
ingredients:
3/4  c. fresh or frozen blueberries
1  c. low-fat cottage cheese
2  small ripe bananas, sliced and frozen
1  Tbsp. Equal
preparation: Put the brains in hot water to loosen the veil of skin covering them.  Put grease in skillet and cook slowly until brains are done. Add about 4 eggs for each hogs brain, salt and pepper and scramble them all together.  Delicious.

name: BLACK WALNUT PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. light corn syrup
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. melted butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. walnuts
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add sugar, corn syrup and salt; mix well.  Stir in butter, vanilla and walnuts.  Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes or until silver knife comes out clean.

name: Chicken Divan
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. broccoli, cooked
3  chicken breasts, cooked and boned
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1/2  c. American or Cheddar cheese, shredded
1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. oleo, melted
preparation: Lay broccoli in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish.  Place chicken pieces on top.  Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry and mix well.  Pour over chicken and sprinkle with cheese. Combine bread crumbs and melted oleo and sprinkle over top.  Bake in 350°  oven for 30 minutes.  This serves 6.  Fluffy rice is an excellent accompaniment.

name: CHARCOAL STEAKS
ingredients:
1-inch cut steaks (club, T-bone, sirloin, etc.)
soy sauce
preparation: Marinate steaks with soy sauce and sprinkle with garlic powder.  Use fork with sharp tines to pierce meat, about a quarter of an inch as you sprinkle soy sauce on so it will penetrate meat. Let marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes to 1 hour.  Get charcoal hot.  Add small amount of water soaked hickory chips. Cook steaks, covered, to desired doneness.

name: SHERBET PUNCH
ingredients:
1  can Hawaiian Punch
1  liter ginger ale
1/2  (1/2 gal.) rainbow sherbet
preparation: Pour punch and ginger ale together.  Spoon in as much sherbet as desired.

name: BARBECUED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
8  pork chops
1/2  c. ketchup
1  c. water
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/3  c. vinegar
preparation: Place pork chops in casserole dish.  Combine other ingredients and pour over chops.  Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SPECIAL K BARS
ingredients:
1  c. Karo syrup
1  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. peanut butter
6  c. Special K
8  oz. chocolate bits
8  oz. butterscotch bits
preparation: Bring syrup and sugar to a slow boil and boil for 1 minute. Add peanut butter.  Stir in Special K and pat into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Melt chocolate bits and butterscotch bits together and then spread over top of all.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  roll sugar cookie dough
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  pkg. strawberry glaze
2  bananas
1  pkg. strawberries
preparation: Mix fruit cocktail, strawberries and glaze in a bowl. In a separate bowl, mix cream cheese and a little sugar to taste. Mix until smooth. Press cookie dough into a pizza pan and bake until just slightly brown. (You want the cookie crust to be soft, so don't let it bake very long at all). Let cool. Spread cream cheese over the cookie crust. Put fruit mixture over that and then slice bananas over the top.

name: MY FAVORITE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  stick butter or margarine
1/2  c. Crisco oil
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. water
2  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix  together  flour,  sugar  and  salt.  In a saucepan combine water,  oil,  margarine  and cocoa.  Bring to boil and pour  over	flour mixture.	Stir well.  Combine buttermilk and soda.  Add	to mixture.  Blend in eggs and vanilla.  Pour into greased and floured 9 x  13-inch  pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: PINA COLADA CAKE
ingredients:
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  can creme coconut
1  can crushed pineapple
1  tub whipped cream
1  pkg. shredded coconut
1  box cake mix
preparation: Bake cake in a glass oblong dish, following directions on box. When cooled, punch holes every 1/2 inch through out cake.  Pour into holes of cake 1 can condensed milk, followed by 1 can of creme of coconut.  Follow this with 1 can crushed pineapple and top with one tub of whipped cream, sprinkle with shredded coconut and refrigerate immediately.  Best served after cake has set for 24-28 hours.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. shortening
3  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  c. white sugar
3  eggs, slightly beaten
3/4  c. water
3  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour, sifted
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
4  c. oats
1  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream the shortening, sugar and eggs.  Add water and mix well. Add vanilla; mix.  Add remaining dry ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: BRITTANY DRESSING
ingredients:
8  strips bacon
5  Tbsp. sugar
4  Tbsp. cider vinegar
2  c. sour cream (16 oz.)
preparation: 1/2 hour before serving, combine sugar and vinegar and stir into sour cream.  Fry bacon until crisp.  Save all grease.  Dry bacon on paper towel and chop into small pieces.  Put bacon bits and all the grease into the sour cream mixture.

name: OAT BRAN PANCAKES
ingredients:
1/4  c. oat bran
1/4  c. whole wheat flour
1/4  c. unbleached flour
1/4  c. nonfat dry milk
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. sugar (if desired)
1  Tbsp. corn oil
1  egg
2/3  c. water
no-stick vegetable spray (Pam)
preparation: Place dry ingredients in a mixing bowl.  Stir to mix.  Make a well in center; place oil, egg and water in well.  Mix to form batter.

name: PIE CRUST(Makes 4 Crusts)
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1 3/4  c. Crisco shortening
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Cut shortening into flour.  Mix vinegar and water.  Add together with egg.  Mix well.  Separate into four equal parts. May be frozen or keeps well in refrigerator.  Form into balls to store.  Roll out crust on floured pastry sheet.

name: STRAWBERRY-NUT DESSERT
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1  c. boiling water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
3  medium bananas, sliced
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Bring 1 cup water to boil.  Stir in gelatin until dissolved. Add juice from frozen strawberries and pineapple.  Chill until thickened but not set.  Fold in remaining ingredients.  Chill until firm.

name: EASY PRALINES
ingredients:
1  pkg. butterscotch powder (not instant)
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. butter or oleo
preparation: Mix well in a heavy 1 1/2-quart saucepan.  Cook and stir to a full boil, then slowly for 3 to 5 minutes, until mixture reaches soft ball stage.* Remove from heat.  Stir in 1 1/2 cup pecans (broken).  Beat mixture until it begins to thicken, but still looks shiny.  Drop tablespoonful of mixture quickly onto waxed paper to form 3-inch pralines.  Let cool.  If mixture thickens and starts to lose its shine while dropping pralines, add a few drops of evaporated milk.  Makes about 18 pralines.

name: HUNGARIAN CHICKEN PAPRIKASH
ingredients:
2  whole chickens, cut up
1 1/2  qt. milk
1  large onion
salt and pepper
flour and paprika
2  Tbsp. Crisco
1  qt. light cream
1  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Melt Crisco in large frypan.  Season chicken with salt, pepper, paprika and flour.  Brown chicken.  Transfer chicken to large pot.  Saute onion.  Put with chicken.  Rinse frypan and put enough water in pot to cover chicken.  Cook over medium heat for about 1 1/2 hours.  Mix milk, light cream and flour thoroughly. Cook over medium heat until boils.  Pour immediately over chicken. (If too thin, add more flour.)  Salt to taste; sprinkle with paprika.  Cook until sauce thickens.  Serve over waffles.

name: EGG ROLLS
ingredients:
4  oz. meat (pork)
1  lb. cabbage
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soy sauce
1  pkg. egg roll skins
1/2  lb. onions
2  lb. bean sprouts
2  tsp. sugar
2  oz. peanut butter (optional)
preparation: Shred all ingredients.  Season meat with soy sauce.  For filling, cook seasoned meat with oil in frying pan to bring up flavor.  Then add all ingredients together and stir briskly.  Drain exesss water, add peanut butter and mix evenly.  Put filling on egg roll skins.  Wrap fillings.  Fold both ends and roll skin to form egg roll.  Moisten edge of egg roll skin with cold water to seal the roll.  Deep fry in oil (350° to 400°).  Serve with sweet and sour sauce or soy sauce.

name: RANGER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. coconut
2  c. oatmeal
2  c. flour
2  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Cream the first 5 ingredients together.  Add the rest of ingredients.  Mix well together.  Drop on cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° until light brown.

name: PUL KO-KEE
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. flank steak
3  green onions, chopped (use tops, too)
1  Tbsp. oil
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. sesame seed, toasted in skillet for a few minutes until light golden brown
1/3  c. soy sauce
preparation: Slice meat in thin strips across the grain.  Add all other ingredients and marinate at least 1 hour.  Brown in pan on top of stove, or grill over charcoal.  Serve with plain rice.

name: OUR GOOD FRUITCAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. pecan halves
1/2  lb. California walnuts
3/4  lb. candied cherries
1/2  lb. candied pineapple
1  pkg. chopped dates
1/2  c. chopped prunes
1  c. flour
1 1/2  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  oz. lemon extract
2  c. plain flour, sifted
3/4  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix fruit and 1 cup of flour, then set aside.  Beat margarine, then add sugar and beat well.  Add eggs and lemon extract. Gradually add sifted flour and baking powder.  Add floured fruit to egg mixture and put into greased and floured tube pan.  Cover with foil and bake at 300° for 2 1/2 hours.  Put a pan of water in the oven while cake bakes.  Uncover for last 5 minutes to brown.  Let cake cool slightly before removing from pan.

name: SWEET POTATO BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  c. cooked mashed sweet potatoes
1/4 to 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter, soft
3  Tbsp. shortening
about 2 c. flour
preparation: Combine egg, sweet potatoes, sugar, butter and shortening in a mixing bowl; mix well.  Stir in enough flour to make a soft dough. (Dough will be softer than regular biscuit dough.)  Turn out on a floured surface; knead lightly a few times.  Roll to 1/4-inch thickness; cut with a 2-inch biscuit cutter.  Place on an ungreased baking sheet and bake at 350° for about 15 minutes. Yields about 16 biscuits.

name: GEORGIA'S ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
3  eggs, beaten
3  c. plain flour
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. chopped, shredded zucchini
preparation: Mix all ingredients until well blended.  Pour into two greased and floured loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHOCOLATE LAYER CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
2  c. sugar
2  c. plain flour
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sweet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
4  eggs
preparation: Cream the Crisco and sugar together until very smooth.  Add eggs one at a time.  Add sifted flour and milk alternately.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Makes three 9-inch layers.

name: VIOLA'S WATERGATE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
2  tsp. sugar
1/2  c. butter, melted
8  oz. cream cheese
2/3  c. powdered sugar
Cool Whip
2 1/2  c. milk
2  boxes pistachio pudding
preparation: Mix in square 8 x 8-inch pan the flour, pecans, sugar and butter, then pat down good, making crust.  Bake until brown (light) at 350°.  Next, mix cream cheese and powdered sugar and spread on cooled crust.  Then spread some Cool Whip on top of cheese.  In medium bowl, mix milk and the two boxes of pudding until thick; pour over Cool Whip.  Spread a thin layer of Cool Whip over pudding and sprinkle with a few chopped pecans.

name: REFRIED BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can refried beans
8  oz. sour cream
1  lb. Colby cheese
preparation: Divide ingredients into three parts; beans, sour cream and Colby cheese.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

name: ITALIAN EGGPLANT PARMESAN
ingredients:
1  large eggplant
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. bread crumbs
cooking oil
1 1/2  c. tomato sauce
garlic
1  tsp. dried basil
Mozzarella cheese
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Season tomato sauce with garlic and basil.  Wash and cut eggplant into 1/4-inch rounds. Dip slices in egg and coat with bread crumbs.  Fry in heated oil until tender.

name: SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground lean beef
1/2  c. seasoned dry bread crumbs
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1  egg, lightly beaten
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  Tbsp. water
1/4  tsp. ground black pepper
2  c. hot prepared instant mashed potatoes
8  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, cut in 1/4-inch cubes
1  c. cooked mixed peas and carrots
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  In a medium bowl place beef, bread crumbs, onion, egg, 2 tablespoons water, Worcestershire sauce and black pepper.  Mix with hands until well combined.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1/4 to 1/2  c. crunchy peanut butter
1/2  c. milk
1 (9 oz.)  carton frozen whipped topping
1  graham cracker crust or regular pie crust
preparation: Whip the cream cheese until soft and fluffy.  Beat in peanut butter.  Add sugar slowly.  Add milk.  Fold in whipped topping. Put in crust and freeze.  Keeps frozen for several months.

name: PEACH JELLY
ingredients:
5  c. peaches, mashed
3 1/2  c. sugar
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. peach or orange jello
preparation: Mash peaches.  Add sugar and cook 20 minutes.  Add jello and cook 1 minute more.  Pour into jars; when set, place in freezer. Makes about 1 quart.

name: ORANGE STRAWBERRY JUICE FROTH
ingredients:
2  c. orange juice
1 1/2  c. apricot nectar
1  c. frozen sweetened strawberries
preparation: In blender, process ingredients for about 20 seconds or until smooth and frothy.  Serve immediately.

name: PINEAPPLE CRUNCH
ingredients:
56  Ritz crackers
6  egg whites
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. baking powder
2  c. sugar
preparation: Crumble crackers.  Beat egg whites with baking powder until foamy.  Add sugar; beat until stiff.  Add cracker crumbs and pecans.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Top with topping.

name: JALAPENO VEGETABLE CHOWDER
ingredients:
2  Tbsp salad oil
2  cloves garlic, pressed or minced
1  large onion, chopped
1/2  tsp each ground cumin and dry oregano
3  Tbsp seeded, minced fresh or canned jalapeno chilies
1  large red bell pepper, seeded and diced
2  Tbsp all-purpose flour
1  qt regular strength chicken broth
1  large sweet potato (about 2 1/2 lb), peeled and cut into 1/2 in cubes
2 large  ears corn, husked, or 1 c kernels
1/2  c whipping cream or half and half cream
salt and pepper to taste
Fresh cilantro sprigs
1  c shredded cheddar or jalapeno cheese
preparation: In a 5-6 qt pan, combine oil, garlic, onion, cumin, oregano, chilies (use smaller amount for milder flavor, more if you like it hotter), and bell pepper.  Stir over medium heat until onion is limp.  Stir in flour, then broth.  Bring to boiling; add sweet potato.  Cover and simmer until potato is tender when pierced, 10 to 15 minutes.

name: HONEY BARS
ingredients:
3/4  c. oil
1/4  c. honey
1  c. sugar
2  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. allspice
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  egg
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix first 8 ingredients well, then add egg and chopped nuts. Press by hand into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: INDIA POTATOES AND TOMATOES
ingredients:
1/2  tsp. mustard seeds
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
3  large potatoes, cooked, peeled and diced
3  medium tomatoes, finely diced
2  tsp. minced green pepper
1  tsp. turmeric
1/4  tsp. grated ginger
pinch of cayenne
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. chopped coriander leaves
preparation: Fry mustard seeds in hot oil (be careful they can burn quickly).  Add diced potatoes and fry 5 minutes.  Add tomatoes, green pepper, turmeric, grated ginger, cayenne, salt and coriander leaves.  Cook slowly until tomatoes are done.  Remove from fire and serve hot.

name: THELMA'S CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Crisco
2  sticks butter
3  c. sugar
3  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cocoa
5  eggs
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Sift together dry ingredients; add alternately with the milk, beginning and ending with dry ingredients.  Add vanilla.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
1  lemon cake mix
2  pkg. dry yeast
2 1/2  c. warm water
approximately 2 1/2 c. flour
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Roll out.  Melt butter and spread over dough.  Sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon on butter.  Roll up like a jelly roll.  Cut into rolls.  Bake at 350° until golden brown. Frost, if desired.

name: MOM'S GREEN RICE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Minute rice
1  pkg. broccoli, thawed and chopped
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. water chestnuts, chopped
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
2  cans water
preparation: Pour rice on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Add thawed broccoli on top.  Add water chestnuts and celery.  Mix the cheese into this, then the soup and butter.  Add 2 cans of water.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: MAMA'S BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
5  or 6 medium bananas
3  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
Nilla wafers
preparation: Slice bananas.  In large dish, make layers with bananas, then wafers.  Set aside.  In double boiler, combine sugar, flour, milk, 1 egg and 3 egg yolks.  Boil until thick.  Pour over layers.  Beat egg whites with mixer until stiff.  Add 1/2 cup sugar and beat well.  Top pudding and brown under broiler.

name: BEEF BURGUNDY STEW
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
1  c. raw bacon, chopped
3  lb. lean beef, cut into medium pieces
1  Tbsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
12  to 15 small onions
6  medium carrots, cut in pieces
2  shallots, chopped
1  clove garlic, crushed
2  Tbsp. flour
1  pt. red burgundy wine
1  c. beef stock (condensed beef broth works well)
3  sprigs parsley, finely chopped
2  stalks celery, halved
1  bay leaf
pinch of ground thyme
1/2  lb. small fresh mushrooms
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/8  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a large pan, heat the oil; add the bacon and saute until golden brown.  Remove from pan and set aside.  Season the 3 pounds of beef with 1 tablespoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.  Saute the beef, onions and carrots until golden brown.  Drain off the fat and add the shallots, garlic and the flour.  Mix well and allow to stand in the oven for a few minutes until the flour becomes golden brown.  Remove pan from oven and add the burgundy and the beef stock.  Be sure that the meat is covered by the liquid.  Add the parsley, celery pieces, the bay leaf and the thyme to the pot; bring to a boil and then cook over low heat for 2 hours or until meat is well done.  If the sauce is too thick, you may add a little stock to thin it out.  While all this is going on, saute the mushrooms in the butter on high heat for 3 minutes, then add lemon juice, salt and pepper.  Cook for 2 more minutes and add to beef.  When the beef is ready, remove the bay leaf and the 4 pieces of celery before serving.  Serve with boiled potatoes or noodles.

name: BAKED CORN
ingredients:
2  c. corn, drained
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  eggs
preparation: Melt butter and add flour.  Gradually add milk, sugar, salt, pepper and corn.  Cook thoroughly.  Take off heat and add egg, stirring constantly.  Put in a greased pan at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN BARS
ingredients:
1  box Pillsbury Plus yellow cake mix
1  c. pumpkin
3  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
1  can Pillsbury vanilla frosting
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
candy pumpkins
preparation: Follow the directions on a box of Pillsbury Plus yellow cake mix except reduce the water to 1/2 cup.  Add canned pumpkin and pumpkin pie spice.  Spread into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan and bake as directed on cake mix box.  Cool and frost with frosting mixed with cinnamon.  Decorate with candy pumpkins.  Good any season.

name: 3 BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. hamburger
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. bacon, cooked
1 (16 oz.)  can butter beans
1 (16 oz)  can kidney beans
1 large  can Bush's baked beans
2  Tbsp. molasses
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  Tbsp. dry mustard
1/4  c. ketchup
preparation: Fry bacon to a crisp.  Brown onion and hamburger.  Discard all grease.  Drain kidney beans and butter beans.  Add all ingredients together and cook to blend.

name: SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
6  oz. spaghetti
2  eggs
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. butter
1/3  c. chopped onion
1  c. sour cream
1  lb. Italian sausage
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  c. water
4  oz. Mozzarella cheese, sliced
preparation: Break spaghetti into  pieces;  cook and drain.	Combine spaghetti, eggs and  Parmesan  cheese.  Pour  into	a  greased 10-inch pie plate.	Melt butter and saute onion.  Stir in sour cream and spoon over spaghetti.  Brown sausage in pan and cook until  done.  Cut in  1-inch  pieces.  Add	tomato	paste  and water.   Simmer 10 minutes.  Put  this  mixture  on  the  sour cream.   Bake at  350°  for  25  minutes.  Arrange	Mozzarella cheese on top; return to oven until cheese melts.

name: BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. all-bran cereal
1 1/4  c. milk
1  egg
1/4  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Stir together flour, sugar, salt and baking powder.  Set aside.  In a large bowl, combine bran cereal and milk.  Let stand about 3 minutes or until cereal softens.  Add egg and oil; mix well.  Add flour mixture, stirring only until combined.  Portion batter evenly into 12 lightly greased 2 1/2-inch muffin pans. Bake in a 400° oven for about 20 minutes.

name: MOM'S TOMATO SOUP CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. Crisco
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
2  eggs
1  can tomato soup
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix baking soda and soup in a bowl; set aside. Cream sugar and Crisco. Add eggs and soup mix; mix well. Sift together dry ingredients; mix all together. Bake in 9 x 9 or 8 x 9 greased and floured pan at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: ICED TEA
ingredients:
5  tea bags
2  c. water
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. sugar
preparation: Microwave first 3 ingredients for 5 minutes.  Let stand 1 minute, then add sugar (more or less to taste).  Add to ice cubes and cold water to make one gallon.

name: BAKE RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
3  c. cooked rice
3  c. evaporated skim milk
6  Tbsp. raisins
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
1/8  tsp. each:  nutmeg and cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  In mixing bowl, combine rice, milk, raisins, sugar, vanilla, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon.  Turn into 2-quart casserole dish coated with nonstick spray.  Bake 30 minutes.  Stir and bake 30 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings.

name: HAWAIIAN CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1 big  can white meat or 1 c. chopped chicken
1  c. purple seedless grapes, cut in half
3/4  c. pecans, chopped
1  c. pineapple tidbits
1  c. celery, finely chopped
1/2  c. raisins
2  c. lite mayo
preparation: Serve with wheat crackers.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  cup canned pitted ripe olives
2  packages cream cheese
2  oz. Blue cheese
8  oz. grated sharp Cheddar cheese (2 cups)
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
dash liquid red pepper seasoning
1/4  cup chopped parsley
preparation: First: Chop 3/4 cup olives coarsely. Soften cream cheese. Add Blue cheese, grated Cheddar cheese, Worcestershire sauce and liquid pepper seasoning, beat until smooth. Mix chopped olives with cheeses.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESECAKE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
2/3  c. margarine or butter
1/2  c. almonds, finely chopped and toasted
1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients  in  medium  bowl  with  fork until crumbly.  Press firmly  and  evenly  in  bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° until set, 15 to 20 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  lb. hot sausage
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. self-rising corn meal
1  can cream-style corn
1/4  c. vegetable oil
