2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  large onion, chopped
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Grease skillet.  Brown sausage and onion.  Drain.  Combine eggs, cornmeal, corn, milk and oil.   Pour half of cornmeal mixture in skillet, then put sausage and onion mixture, then cheese, then pour remaining batter over all.  Bake at 425° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: 6 WEEKS MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  box Raisin Bran cereal
1  c. Crisco, melted
3  c. sugar
4  eggs, beaten
1  qt. buttermilk (or put 4 Tbsp. vinegar or lemon juice into regular milk and let set to make 1 qt.)
5  c. flour
5  tsp. soda
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix cereal, flour, sugar, soda and salt.  Add beaten eggs, Crisco and buttermilk.  Mix well.  Fill muffin tins 2/3 full and bake at 400° for 16 minutes.  Batter will be thick.  It keeps at least 6 weeks in the refrigerator.

name: VEGGIE BARS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  cans crescent rolls
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sour cream
1  oz. pkg. Ranch dressing mix
3/4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. of some or all chopped broccoli, onions, peppers, carrots and cauliflower
preparation: Unroll dough. Press lightly into greased 15 x 10 x 1 jelly roll pan, pressing edges together to line bottom of pan. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. sugar
1  large egg
1  tsp. vanilla
sugar as needed
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Combine peanut butter, sugar, egg and vanilla to thoroughly blend.  Drop by teaspoon 2 inches apart on cookie sheet.  Flatten with bottom of glass dipped in sugar.  Bake 14 to 16 minutes until lightly browned.  Cool on rack.

name: SPINACH MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped spinach
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1  clove garlic, chopped fine
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3  Tbsp. Parmesan or Romano
3  Tbsp. fine dry bread crumbs
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. water
preparation: Defrost spinach and drain.  Combine spinach, onion, garlic, beef, cheese, crumbs, egg, salt and pepper.  Mix well.    Form into golf ball size balls.

name: HUMMINGBIRD CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
2  c. chopped bananas
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
3  eggs, well beaten
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped pecans or walnuts (add 1, save 1)
preparation: Mix dry ingredients. Add eggs and oil. Stir until moist. Do not beat. Add vanilla, pineapple, 1 cup nuts and bananas. Stir but do not beat. Spoon into 3 well-greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

name: CHRIS'S EASY CHEESY ASPARAGUS BAKE
ingredients:
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can asparagus
1/4  c. chopped red pepper
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. sliced green onion
1  egg white, beaten until stiff
preparation: Mix asparagus with pepper in shallow 1-quart dish.  Combine mayonnaise, cheese and onion and fold in egg white.   Spread over asparagus.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: WINTER STEW DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  small head cabbage, chopped
4  medium onions, diced
4  medium potatoes, diced
1 (28 oz.)  can diced tomatoes
1  lb. carrots, peeled and diced
2  lb. Italian sausage, fried and drained
4  c. beef broth
1  c. tomato juice
1 (15 oz.)  can kidney beans
salt to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine all ingredients in a large, oven proof stew pot. Cover and bake 11/2-2 hours until tender, stirring occasionally. If necessary, add more broth or tomato juice. Serve with homemade bread or biscuits.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
margarine
bread crumbs (I use cornbread)
2  c. mashed squash
1  c. sour cream
1  c. grated carrots
1  can cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup
1  chopped onion
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Butter a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish and sprinkle a layer of bread crumbs on bottom. Combine rest of ingredients and place on top of bread crumbs. Top with bits of butter and cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: FRIED TOMATOES
ingredients:
3  tomatoes (firm or unripened)
2  c. corn meal
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Slice tomatoes into thick crosswise slices.  Combine all dry ingredients.  Coat tomatoes with dry mixture.  Drop in hot oil until golden brown.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: APPLE DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. shortening
2  c. flour
2  c. water
6  apples
3/4  c. shortening
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. milk
2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine sugar, water, cinnamon and nutmeg to make sauce.  Cook 5 minutes.  Add butter.  Pare and core apples.  Sift flour, salt and baking powder; cut in shortening.  Add milk all at once.  Stir fast until flour is moistened.  Roll dough to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut six 5-inch squares.  Place 1 apple on each square; dot with butter.  Fold corners and pinch edges.  Place 1 inch apart in greased pan.  Pour sauce over dumplings.  Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

name: MACARONI SAUTE
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked elbow macaroni
1/2  c. chopped green bell pepper
1  tsp. chopped onion
1/2  c. cooking oil
1 (No. 2)  can tomato juice
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Saute macaroni, green pepper and onion in cooking oil over low heat for 5 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned.

name: CHOCOLATE NUT - BUTTER BARS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1/3  c. softened butter
2  eggs
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1  c. chocolate pieces
1/2  c. nut meats (optional)
preparation: Combine cake mix, butter and one of the eggs in a large mixing bowl.  Beat until mixture is crumbly.  Press evenly into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Beat remaining egg with the sweetened condensed milk in a small bowl until well blended.  Pour over crumb mixture crust.  Sprinkle chocolate pieces and nuts on top. Bake in a 350° oven for 35 minutes or until golden brown.  Cool.

name: WESTERN BEANS
ingredients:
3  cans pinto beans
1  can refried beans
2  cans chopped green chilies
1  onion, chopped
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
2  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. cumin
2  Tbsp. sugar
red pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Simmer on low, stirring often, until heated.

name: SYRUP COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter Crisco
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1/3  c. ribbon cane syrup or molasses
1/3  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
4 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Add egg, syrup, buttermilk and vanilla.  Mix well.  Sift flour, soda, baking powder, ginger, cinnamon and salt.  Add to creamed mixture and stir until mixed well.  Roll into balls.  Dip into sugar.  Press down slightly with glass dipped in sugar.  Bake on greased cookie sheet at 375° until slightly brown around edges.

name: FETTUCINI ALFREDO
ingredients:
1/2  lb. margarine
1  c. flour
4  cloves garlic
1  qt. half and half
1/2  lb. Mozzarella
1/2  lb. Provolone
1  can precooked small shrimp
cooked noodles
preparation: Blend margarine, flour and garlic until pasty.  Add half and half and both cheeses.  Simmer over low heat, stirring constantly, until melted.  In a small pan, boil shrimp in own juices until cooked through.  Drain and add shrimp to mixture.  Stir well and pour over noodles.

name: KEY LIME PIE
ingredients:
1  box lime jello
1 (8 oz.)  c. Key lime yogurt
1  small Cool Whip
1  graham cracker pie crust
preparation: Dissolve jello in yogurt. Mix well. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker pie crust and refrigerate overnight.

name: BEEF AND BEANS ROUND-UP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  c. barbecue sauce
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 (16 oz.)  can baked beans
1  can flaky biscuits
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  In skillet, brown ground chuck and onion; drain.  Stir in barbecue sauce, brown sugar and beans; heat until bubbly.  Pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Separate biscuit dough into 10 biscuits; cut each in half.  Place biscuits cut side down over hot meat mixture.  Sprinkle cheese over biscuits.  Bake at 375° for 22 to 27 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Makes 6 servings.

name: CRAB MEAT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. soft bread crumbs
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  can flaked crab meat or fresh (as crabby as you like)
whites of 3 hard-cooked eggs, diced
yolks of 3 hard-cooked eggs, mashed
3/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. dry mustard
dash of cayenne or Tabasco
3  Tbsp. butter, melted
buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Mix milk and bread crumbs.  Gently stir in crab meat and egg whites.  Blend in remaining ingredients.  Place in greased (Pam) 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan or 1 1/2-quart dish. Sprinkle with buttered crumbs.  Bake 15 minutes.  Serves 2 generously.

name: MINTS
ingredients:
1  box 10x sugar
1/8  lb. butter, melted
3  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. mint flavoring
preparation: Mix.  Roll into small balls and press with fork.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PIE
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk
1 1/2  c. water
1/2  c. biscuit baking mix
3  eggs
1/4  c. margarine or butter, softened
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In blender container, combine all ingredients, except coconut.  Blend on low 3 minutes.  Pour mixture into greased 10-inch pie plate.  Let stand 5 minutes. Sprinkle coconut over top.  Carefully place in oven; bake 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted near edge comes out clean.  Cool slightly.  Serve warm or chilled.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: BLUEBERRY STREUSEL COBBLER
ingredients:
1  pt. fresh or frozen blueberries
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)
2  tsp. grated lemon peel
3/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. cold butter or margarine
2  c. biscuit baking mix, divided
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts
vanilla ice cream
Blueberry Sauce (recipe follows)
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°. In a bowl, combine blueberries, Eagle Brand and peel. In a large bowl, cut 3/4 cup butter into 1 1/2 cups biscuit mix until crumbly; add blueberry mixture. Spread in greased 9-inch square baking pan. In a small bowl, combine remaining 1/2 cup biscuit mix and sugar; cut in remaining 2 tablespoons butter until crumbly. Add nuts. Sprinkle over cobbler. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes or until golden. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream and blueberry sauce. Refrigerate leftovers.

name: STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1/4  head cabbage
2  carrots
1  bell pepper
3  onions
2  stalks celery
small amount of red cabbage
1  c. any cooked meat
1  c. cooked rice
2 1/2  Tbsp. oil
soy sauce
salt and pepper
preparation: Place oil in very hot skillet or wok.  Add chopped vegetables and stir-fry for a few minutes.  Add rice; stir well.  Sprinkle soy sauce liberally; salt and pepper to taste.  Add meat.  Stir a few minutes longer.  Remove and serve.

name: CLASSIC MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  box elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1 (2 oz.)  jar chopped pimento, drained
preparation: Combine all ingredients and chill.

name: OVEN SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. Crisco
1  can stewed tomatoes
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped carrots
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. oil
3  Tbsp. vinegar
3  Tbsp. ketchup
preparation: Process 2 hours at 15 pounds pressure.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  German chocolate cake mix
1/3  c. milk
1  (16 oz.) bag caramels
1  stick butter or margarine
1  bag chocolate chips
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix German cake mix according to package directions.  Pour half of the batter into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  While this is baking, in microwave or over low heat, melt butter and caramels with milk.  Pour on top of cake. Sprinkle chocolate chips and pecans over caramel layer.  Spoon rest of batter over this.  Bake at 250° for 20 minutes and then at 350° for 10 minutes.  Let cool, cover and refrigerate.

name: FRANK'S FANTASTIC HAWAIIAN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can fruit cocktail
1  can mandarin oranges
1  c. sour cream
Baker's coconut
preparation: Drain all the juice out of both cans of cocktail and oranges. In a large bowl combine these two followed by the sour cream.  You can add the coconut with as much as you like.

name: SOUR CREAM COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen coconut, thawed
2 small  cartons sour cream
2  c. sugar
1  white cake mix with pudding added
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and store in refrigerator overnight.

name: BEST EVER BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  oz. unsweetened chocolate
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
3/4  c. flour
??? c. butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Melt together butter and unsweetened chocolate.  To that mixture, add sugar; beat well.  Then add eggs; beat again.  Add flour and beat.  Finally add vanilla and blend well.  Pecans are optional.  Add at the last and mix well.  Bake in an 8 or 9-inch square pan for 25 minutes.

name: DEEP DISH HAMBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can green beans, drained
1  can tomato soup
1  c. mashed potatoes or cooked rice
shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Brown meat and onion; stir in seasonings, beans and soup.  Put in casserole dish.  Put mashed potatoes on top (or mix in rice).  Top with cheese and bake about 30 minutes.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
1 3/4   c. brown sugar, packed
2 1/3  c. water
2  Tbsp. margarine
1 3/4  c. biscuit mix
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix 1 cup brown sugar, 2 cups water, and 2 Tbsp. margarine and bring to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes. Pour into an 8 x 8 x 2 inch baking dish. Mix the biscuit mix, raisins, chopped pecans, 3/4 cup brown sugar and 1/3 cup water together and pour over syrup mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Serve with ice cream.

name: CHEDDAR BAKED POTATO SLICES
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's cream of mushroom soup
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. pepper
4  medium baked potatoes
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In small bowl, combine soup, paprika and pepper.  Cut potatoes into 1/4 slices (about 4 cups).  Grease 2-quart oblong baking dish.  Arrange potatoes in overlapping rows.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Spoon soup mixture over cheese.  Cover with foil. Bake at 400° for about 45 minutes.  Uncover and bake 10 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CHILI(For 25 People)
ingredients:
1  c. chili blend or powder
1/2  c. paprika
1/3  c. comino (cumin)
2  Tbsp. powdered garlic
1  tsp. red pepper
2  Tbsp. salt
2  chopped onions
2  c. flour
2  c. water
10  lb. chili meat
preparation: Put meat and water in covered pot with chopped onions.  Let cook until tender, then add chili powder, paprika, cumin, red pepper, salt and garlic.  Let cook 5 minutes, then turn the heat down and add flour.  Let cook 5 minutes longer, then place in pan to mold.  The chili must be hard to cut in blocks.

name: AUNT JANET'S HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
onion (small)
celery
3  c. water
3/4  c. rice
1  pkg. dry vegetable soup
preparation: Brown hamburger, onion and celery in skillet; drain fat.  Pour hamburger into baking dish, 2 1/2-quart dish.  Add 3 cups boiling water, rice and dry vegetable soup.  Cook 1 hour at 350°.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  head cabbage (small)
1  onion
1  can tomato soup
salt and pepper
preparation: Cut cabbage up.  Fry beef until lightly browned; drain well. In a 3-quart casserole dish, place 1/3 of coarsely cut cabbage, top with 1/2 of beef and 1/2 onion.  Top with 1/3 cabbage, then rest of beef and onion.  Then finish with cabbage.  Pour can of soup on the top.  Do not stir.  Bake at 350° for one hour.

name: FUNNEL CAKES
ingredients:
3  eggs, well beaten
2  c. milk
4  c. sifted flour
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. baking powder
fat or oil (for deep frying)
powdered sugar
preparation: Beat eggs with milk; gradually beat in flour, sugar, salt and baking powder.  Beat until very smooth.  Holding the opening of a funnel closed, fill funnel with the batter.  Open the end of the funnel; let dough run out in a stream into deep, hot fat (375°). Move the funnel to make a pattern, starting at the center of the pan and swirling batter outward in a circle.  Fry 2 to 3 minutes, or until golden brown.  When cakes are done, drain on paper towels and sprinkle with powdered sugar and cinnamon.  Very delicious.

name: CHERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
1  can unsweetened cherries with juice
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  stick butter
1/2  c. flour (all-purpose or plain)
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
1/4  c. milk
preparation: Mix cherries with 2/3 cup sugar.  Melt butter in iron skillet. Combine flour, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder, salt and milk.  Pour batter over the melted butter in skillet.  Pour cherries on top. Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 45 minutes or until nicely browned. (If recipe is doubled, use the juice from only 1 can of cherries.) Easy and delicious!

name: WOOD CHUCK
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1/2  c. + 2 Tbsp. flour
1  qt. milk
1  c. grated cheese (4 oz.)
2 small  cans mushrooms
1/2  c. diced celery
2 1/2  c. cooked turkey or chicken, diced
3  hard-boiled eggs
1 large  can plus 1 small can chow mein noodles
2  tsp. butter
preparation: Make a roux of flour and melted butter.  Add milk.  Cook to thicken.  Add cheese and remove from heat.  Stir until cheese melts.  Saute mushrooms and celery in 2 teaspoons butter; add to sauce.  Add turkey or chicken meat (cooked and diced) and 2 hard-boiled eggs (diced).  Serve on plates over the Chinese noodles.  Garnish with slices of the 3rd egg.

name: TEXAS PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3/4  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3/4  tsp. chili powder
3  eggs, separated
3/4  c. fresh or canned corn kernels, drained
3  medium potatoes
pinch of cream of tartar
oil, for frying
chili salsa
green pepper rings (optional)
preparation: In skillet heat butter.  Add onion and garlic; cook over low heat until tender, but not brown.  Turn into mixing bowl; cool. Stir in egg yolks, mixing to blend well.  Combine flour, salt, pepper and chili powder.  Stir into onion mixture.  Stir in corn. Peel and grate potatoes; place in cold water for 5 minutes. Squeeze as dry as possible, then drain thoroughly on paper towels. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff but not dry.  Add potatoes to corn mixture; blend well.  Fold in egg whites.  In skillet heat about 1/4 inch oil.  Form batter into 3 inch pancakes. Cook until brown; flip over.

name: TOMATO JUICE FREEZE
ingredients:
4  cups tomato juice
1/4  cup fresh lemon juice
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Pour into an ice cube tray and freeze until quite firm.  This will take less than an hour in most refrigerators.  Spoon mixture into sherbet glasses.  Top each serving with a sprig of parsley.  Serve immediately.  Serve with a couple of crackers or at Christmastime, serve with Scramble (toasted cereals).

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. juice from an orange
1  jar marshmallow cream
preparation: Mix together and refrigerate.  Great for apples, grapes, strawberries, bananas, etc.

name: PARMESAN FISH
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. thick fish fillets
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. celery seed
pepper to taste
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. minced onion
1/2  tsp. basil
4  Tbsp. parsley
4  Tbsp. fine bread crumbs
paprika to color
preparation: Score  fillets.  Put  in buttered baking dish. Salt and pepper.  Mix  mayonnaise,  cheese,	onion,	basil and parsley. Spread  on fish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and paprika.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 6.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 1/2  sticks margarine or butter
2  c. flour
1  c. chopped pecans
13 1/2  oz. carton Cool Whip
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
2  c. milk
grated chocolate
preparation: Melt butter or margarine and mix with flour and nuts (use your hands to do it!).  Spread in a 13 x 9-inch ungreased pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Cool thoroughly.

name: DIM SUM PORK
ingredients:
1  c. water
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. dry sherry wine
2  tsp. chicken bouillon
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. oil
2  tsp. ginger root
1  tsp. fresh garlic
9  oz. pork strips
1/8  c. scallions
1 to 2  c. snap peas
1/4  c. green peppers
1/4  c. red onions
rice
cornstarch and water mixture
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Make sauce by combining first 8 ingredients, bringing them to a boil and then adding a cornstarch and water mixture to thicken. (Thicken to the point where sauce will cling to pork, but not too thick.)  Saute pork in pan of melted butter until 1/2 done.  Now add vegetables and finish cooking.  When pork and vegetables are done, add sauce and toss, then serve over a bed of rice.

name: STIR-FRY BEEF WITH BROCCOLI AND MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1/3  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. cider vinegar
3/4  tsp. granulated sugar
1  beef bouillon cube
1/3  c. water
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  garlic cloves, peeled and halved
3/4  lb. beef flank or round steak, cut in thin strips
1  large onion, cut in 1/4's and separated
1 1/2  c. broccoli stems
2 1/2  c. broccoli florets
preparation: Mix soy sauce, vinegar and sugar in a small bowl; set aside. In another bowl, mix bouillon cube, water and cornstarch. Assemble remaining ingredients to cook.  In a wok, heat 1 1/2 tablespoons oil over high heat. Add garlic and cook a few seconds to season oil. Add meat; stir-fry 2 minutes until slices are brown outside but still pink inside. Remove meat and juices from pan to bowl. Discard garlic.  Wipe out wok.  Add 1/2 tablespoon oil around pan edge.  Add broccoli florets and mushrooms. Stir-fry 2 minutes. Add meat and juices  to vegetables, then soy mixture. Stir, cover and cook 2 minutes. Stir cornstarch mixture and pour into wok with vegetables and meat.  Cook, stirring constantly, 2 to 3 minutes until thick.

name: CHOCOLATE CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1 (1 oz.)  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  unbaked shell
preparation: Beat sugar and eggs until fluffy.  Melt margarine and chocolate over low heat.  Cool.  Stir in sugar and egg mixture.  Mix well. Add vanilla.  Put into an unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

name: APPLE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
3  eggs
2  c. coarsely grated apples
2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. walnuts
1  c. raisins
preparation: Beat sugar and oil together.  Add eggs.  Sift dry ingredients and add to egg mixture. Stir in apples.  May also use zucchini, walnuts and raisins.  Bake at 350° in paper cupcake holders 15 to 20 minutes or until done.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
2  pkg. Pillsbury chocolate cookie dough
3  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar *
1  tsp. vanilla *
3  eggs
preparation: *This can be adjusted based on personal taste.

name: CONSTANCE'S PLAIN VANILLA SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  stick butter
1  egg
1  c. flour (all-purpose)
1/2  c. nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter and sugar together.  Add a little milk if too stiff.  Add egg, vanilla and nuts.  Bake at 350° in small, well-greased pan for about 30 minutes.  Let cool for about 10 minutes before removing from pan.

name: GARDEN CHICKEN AND STUFFING
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
1  c. celery
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped carrots
1/4   c. all-purpose flour
1  can condensed chicken broth
1  c. milk
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. herb cubed stuffing
2  c. cooked chicken, cubed
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a 3-quart saucepan over medium heat in hot margarine, cook celery, onion and carrots until tender.  Add flour.  Cook 1 minute more, stirring constantly.  Gradually stir in broth and milk. Cook until mixture boils and thickens, stirring constantly.

name: 7 LAYER BARS
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1  pkg. chocolate chips
1  pkg. or small can coconut
1  pkg. butterscotch chips
1  c. chopped pecans
1  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°. Melt in baking pan 1/4 cup butter. Press in 1 cup graham cracker crumbs.  Add one at a time the chocolate chips, coconut, butterscotch chips and pecans.  Pour condensed milk over top and bake 30 minutes.  Use a 9 x 12-inch pan.

name: RANGER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2 scant  tsp. soda
2  c. Rice Krispies
2  c. quick cooking oatmeal
preparation: Cream Crisco, brown sugar and white sugar.  Add vanilla and eggs.  Sift together plain flour, baking powder, salt and soda. Mix both together.  Fold in Rice Krispies and oatmeal.  Bake at 350°.

name: CINNAMON BREAKFAST BUNS
ingredients:
2  loaves frozen bread dough
4  Tbsp. brown sugar
generous sprinkle of cinnamon
handful raisins or nuts (optional)
1  pkg. regular butterscotch pudding mix (cooking kind)
1  stick melted margarine
preparation: Night Before:  Grease a seamless angel food cake pan or Bundt pan.  About 5 p.m., remove the frozen bread dough from freezer. About 9 p.m., cut one loaf into about 20 pieces and place in pan. Cover with 2 tablespoons brown sugar, cinnamon, raisins or nuts, 1/2 of the pudding mix and 1/2 of the melted margarine.  Repeat on top of this layer with second loaf of bread dough and toppings. Leave overnight on kitchen table or counter, covered with a towel. Do not refrigerate.

name: BONNIE'S POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
2  medium onions
1  carrot
preparation: Peel and slice vegetables.  Place in a 2-quart saucepan. cover with water and cook until very tender.  Pour in blender (water too); add salt, pepper, milk and butter to taste, leaving a few vegetables out to add at the last for some body.  Blend until smooth.  Reheat in saucepan.  (You may add Polish sausage to this to make it a heartier soup.)

name: FRUIT COBBLER #1
ingredients:
1  stick margarine at room temperature
1  c. sugar
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. milk
2  c. desired fruit
preparation: Stir in  all  ingredients  except  fruit  until most of lumps have dissolved.  Add  fruit.  Bake	at  350° for 1 hour. If using apples, sprinkle with cinnamon.

name: CHOCOLATE SNOW BEARS
ingredients:
ice
2  shots creme de cacao
1  shot Amaretto
1/2  shot maraschino cherry juice
dash of chocolate syrup
a couple scoops of vanilla ice cream
preparation: Fill blender 1/2 full with ice.  Add creme de cacao, Amaretto, cherry juice and chocolate syrup.  Blend, then blend again with ice cream.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
3  c. sugar
6  large eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. all-purpose flour
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat butter and cream cheese at medium speed on mixer until creamy, about 2 minutes. Gradually add sugar, beating 5 to 7 minutes. Add eggs, one at a time, beating each just until the yellow disappears. Add vanilla, mixing well.

name: LO-CAL-NONFAT BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. skim milk
1  pkg. Jell-O sugar-free banana pudding (instant)
1  c. plain nonfat yogurt
12  pkg. Equal
preparation: Blend.  Line dish with vanilla wafers and top with 4 or 5 sliced ripe bananas.  Pour pudding on top and chill.  Serve with Cool Whip.

name: SWISS VEGETABLE MEDLEY
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) bag frozen broccoli, carrots and cauliflower
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. Swiss cheese, shredded
1/3  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (4 oz.)  jar chopped pimentos
1  can French onions
preparation: Combine vegetables, soup, 1/2 cup cheese, sour cream, pepper, pimento and 1/2 can onions.  Pour into a 1-quart dish.  Bake, covered, for 30 minutes at 350°.  Top with remaining cheese and onions.  Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE PECAN PIE
ingredients:
2  large eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. unsalted butter, melted
1/4  c. bourbon
1/4  c. Kahlua
1/4  c. cornstarch
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. chocolate chips
1  unbaked 9-inch pie crust
preparation: Mix all filling ingredients together until well blended.  Pour into the pie shell.  Bake in the middle of the oven at 350° for 45 minutes or until set.  Garnish with whipped cream if desired.

name: ZUCCHINI BAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. zucchini, cut in 1/4-inch slices
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped fine
salt to taste
dash of oregano and garlic (if desired)
1  c. uncooked rice
1  pt. small curd cottage cheese
1  can mushroom soup
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Parboil zucchini 5 minutes.  Drain.  Dip in cold water.  Saute ground beef and onion and drain.  Salt to taste.  Add oregano and garlic if desired.  Butter a 9 x 13-inch casserole.  Put layer of zucchini on bottom, meat and rice next, then cottage cheese (dab here and there).  Spread mushroom soup on top.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: CRANBERRY FRAPPE
ingredients:
2  qt. whole cranberries
8  c. water
5  c. sugar
juice of 2 lemons
preparation: Cook cranberries in water slowly.  Strain and put through colander.  Add sugar and lemon juice.  Freeze in ice cream freezer when cooled.  Serve in place of cranberry jell.

name: TEXAS PRIZE CAKE
ingredients:
4  sticks butter
2 2/3  c. sugar
9  eggs
3  c. flour
1  Tbsp. flavoring (vanilla or lemon)
preparation: Grease and flour bottom of 10-inch tube pan.  Cream the butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each.  Sift flour and add to creamed mixture.  Add vanilla.   Pour in pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.  Cool in pan 5 minutes.

name: SAUERKRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. salad oil
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can sauerkraut
1  c. green bell pepper, diced
1  c. celery, diced
1  c. onions, diced
1  carrot (optional)
preparation: Mix sugar, vinegar and salad oil; bring to boil.  Cool.  After squeezing juice from sauerkraut, cut fine with shears or scissors. Toss green pepper, celery and onions with sauerkraut.  Pour cooled liquid over vegetables.  Seal in container and refrigerate for 24 hours.

name: GARLIC BREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter or margarine
2  garlic cloves, minced very fine
preparation: Cream butter and add minced garlic; mix very well.  Spread over bread and bake until golden brown.

name: ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  stick melted margarine
4  Tbsp. self-rising flour
2  c. milk
2  c. grated cheese
2 tall  cans drained asparagus
cracker crumbs
preparation: Combine margarine, flour and milk and cook until fairly thick. Remove from heat and add grated cheese.  Pour this mixture over drained asparagus.  Cook at 350° for 20 minutes.  Spread the top with cracker crumbs and brown.

name: HOT CLAM DIP
ingredients:
2  cans minced clams with juice
1  stick butter
1  green pepper
1  onion
1  Tbsp. oregano
1  Tbsp. parsley
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. bread crumbs
2  slices American cheese
preparation: Melt butter; put onion and pepper (chopped) in it with oregano and parsley.  Simmer until onion and peppers are soft.  Add clams with lemon juice.  Cook for 10 minutes more.  Add bread crumbs and mix well.  Put into a square tin dish and add American cheese on top of it.  Bake at 350° until cheese is melted.  Serve warm with crackers.  And enjoy!!!

name: BROCCOLI-CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
1/4  tsp. crushed rosemary
1  large round rye loaf
preparation: Saute celery and onion in margarine until tender.  Add Velveeta and stir over low heat until cheese is melted.  Stir in broccoli and rosemary.

name: SUNSHINE SALAD
ingredients:
1 -6  oz. box orange jello
1  c. sugar
2  c. boiling water
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
2 small  cans mandarin oranges, drained
1 -16  oz. sour cream
preparation: Dissolve sugar and jello in boiling water.  Add sour cream, drained mandarin oranges, and drained pineapple.  Pour into 2 quart dish.  Chill before serving.

name: MY FRIEND EMMA'S CRANBERRY ORANGE RELISH
ingredients:
2  c. fresh cranberries
2  large oranges
2  large apples
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  c. sugar
preparation: Grind cranberries, apples and oranges together.  Add pineapple and sugar.  Mix well.  Refrigerate at least 24 hours before serving.

name: APPLE BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or oleo
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  Tbsp. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. apples, peeled and diced
preparation: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy; add eggs.  Beat well. Stir in flour and salt.  Dissolve soda in buttermilk; add to batter, mixing well.  Stir in vanilla and apples.  Spoon into well-greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Sprinkle on topping (recipe follows).  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes, or until done.

name: HERB STUFFED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  thick pork chops, cut to form pocket
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. butter
3/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  c. bread cubes
1/2  c. parsley
1 small  can evaporated milk
2  Tbsp. shortening
3/4  c. dry white wine
preparation: Rub pork chops inside and out with salt and pepper.  Heat butter in a skillet to saute onion and celery.  Remove from skillet; add bread, parsley and milk to onions and celery.  Stuff pork chops with mixture and close with toothpicks.  Heat shortening in skillet and brown on both sides.  Place pork chops in a slow cooker and add wine.  Cook on low heat 8 to 10 hours.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. cake flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter or shortening
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs, separated
1  c. milk
15  graham crackers, rolled fine (about 1 1/8 c.)
preparation: Sift flour, measure and resift 3 times with baking powder and salt.  Cream butter.  Add sugar gradually and beat until soft and smooth.  Add vanilla and egg yolks one at a time and beat until fluffy and light.  Add milk and flour mixture alternately, beginning and ending with the flour, and stir well after each addition.  Fold in graham cracker crumbs and stiffly beaten egg whites alternately.  Pour batter into two 8-inch layer pans with bottoms lined with thin plain paper and bake in a 350° oven about 25 minutes or until frosting tests done.  Good with peanut butter frosting.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. white sugar
1/3  c. butter
1  can evaporated milk
pinch of salt
12  oz. chocolate bits
5  Hershey bars
7  oz. jar marshmallow cream
2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Put sugar, butter, milk and salt in large heavy pan.  Bring to rolling boil for 9 minutes.  Take off heat and add chocolate bits, bars, marshmallow cream and nuts (one item at a time).  Stir continually until mixture starts to set up.  Pour into a buttered 9 x 13 pan.  Cool; cover and store in refrigerator.

name: CRAB APPLE JELLY
ingredients:
1  gal. crab apples
1 1/2  gal. water
3  c. sugar
preparation: Wash and cut ends off crab apples.  Cover with water and boil until tender.  Pour juice through strainer into other container to make clear jelly.

name: BEEF AND BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. beef stew meat
3  Tbsp. salad oil
1  pkg. Lawry's beef and bean burrito seasoning mix
2  medium onions, cut in wedges
2  c. water
1  can tomatoes, cut up
1  can corn, drained
4  medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and cut in 1/2-inch slices
lemon wedges
preparation: Cut stew meat into 1 1/2-inch cubes.  Brown meat in salad oil in a Dutch oven.  Add beef and bean seasoning mix, onions and water.  Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes.  Add tomatoes and zucchini, cover and simmer 15 to 30 minutes.

name: CHERRY PIZZA
ingredients:
Pie crust for 2 pies
1 8  oz. softened cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  cans cherry pie filling
1  container Cool Whip
chopped nuts
preparation: Roll out pie crust together to fit a large cookie sheet. Bake at 350 for 15 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  qt. whole strawberries
1  baked 9-inch pie shell
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 1/2 to 2  c. crushed strawberries
preparation: Stem whole strawberries.  Place in pie shell.  Combine remaining ingredients in saucepan.  Cook until thickened and clean, stirring constantly.  Pour over pie.  Chill for several hours.  Serve with whipped cream.

name: BARBECUED MUSSELS AND CLAMS WITH TOMATO-CAPER SAUCE
ingredients:
8  to 10 mussels per person, well washed and scrubbed
3  to 4 large cherrystone clams per person, well washed and scrubbed
1  onion, peeled and finely chopped
1/4  c. olive oil
4  large tomatoes, coarsely chopped
2  Tbsp. drained capers
1/2  c. chopped fresh basil
1/2  c. chopped fresh Italian parsley
1/2  c. dry white wine
salt and fresh ground pepper
preparation: Saute the onion in olive oil until soft but not browned.  Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes; add the capers, chopped herbs, wine and season to taste.  Set aside.  Broil the mussels and clams about 2 minutes or until the shells open. Discard one side of the shell.  Spoon on topping on each mussel and clam and heat for three minutes.  These can be served hot or cold.

name: EARTHQUAKE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
1 1/2  c. flake coconut
1  box German chocolate mix, prepared as directed on box
1/2  c. margarine
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  box powdered sugar
preparation: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Mix coconut and nuts together. Sprinkle onto bottom of cake pan. Mix and pour cake mixture over nuts and coconut. Melt margarine and cream cheese in saucepan. Add powdered sugar; mix well.  Pour over top of cake mixture. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  "Looks like an earthquake on top, but delicious."

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box frozen broccoli, chopped
3/4  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
1  stick margarine
1  can mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
preparation: Cook broccoli and drain.  Melt margarine; cook onions and celery until clear.  Mix all ingredients in a casserole dish. Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CURRIED CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. diced cooked chicken breast
1  lb. seedless grapes (halved if large)
1/2  c. mayonnaise
curry powder to taste
preparation: Mix ingredients together and refrigerate until served.  May be served on lettuce or any type plate or platter.  Can also be put on roll or bread.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  baked chicken with meat picked from bone
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  pkg. slivered almonds
1  can chicken or mushroom soup
2  c. crushed plain potato chips
1 1/2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Set oven to 350°.  In a bowl combine chicken, mayo, onion, celery, lemon juice, almonds, soup and 1 cup shredded cheese. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan (greased).  Sprinkle chips, the rest of the cheese and garnish with paprika.  Bake 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CACCIATORE
ingredients:
1  whole chicken, cut up
1/3  c. olive oil
1  medium onion, thinly sliced
1  clove garlic, minced
1 (1 lb. 13 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Brown chicken in oil.  Add onion and garlic; cook until onion begins to turn golden.  Add tomatoes, salt, oregano and pepper. Simmer 40 to 50 minutes.  Add a little water if it gets dry. Serve over rice or spaghetti.

name: EASY SPOON ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
2  c. very warm water
1 1/2  sticks butter, melted or 1 c. oil
1/4  c. sugar
4  c. self-rising flour
1  egg
preparation: Place yeast in  2  cups warm water.  Melt butter, cream with sugar in  large  bowl.  Add  beaten egg, add flour.  Next add yeast, mix well.  Then refrigerate.

name: CORNBREAD SALAD
ingredients:
12  oz. cornbread mix
1  green pepper, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1  ripe tomato, chopped
1  c. whole kernel corn, drained
3  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1  c. cubed ham
1/4  tsp. salt
1  pt. buttermilk salad dressing
grated cheese
preparation: Bake cornbread according to package directions.  Cool and break into pieces in a large bowl.  Add remaining ingredients; toss and chill for 2 hours or longer before serving.

name: APPLE AND OAT BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. whole wheat flour
1  c. oat bran
1/3  c. packed brown sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. buttermilk
2  egg whites
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
3/4  c. shredded, peeled apples
nonstick spray
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: In medium bowl, stir flour, oat bran, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon.  In small bowl, combine buttermilk, egg whites and oil.  Add to dry ingredients and stir just until moistened.  Stir in apple.  Store batter in refrigerator tightly covered for up to 5 days.  Spray muffin pans. Spoon about 1/4 cup batter into each. Bake at 375° for 18 to 20 minutes or until done.  Yields 12.

name: THREE CHEERS FOR CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  chicken breasts
salt and pepper
3/4  stick margarine
1  onion, chopped
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
1 small  jar chopped pimentos
1  c. uncooked rice
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
2  cans water or less
1  can sliced water chestnuts
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Salt and pepper chicken and place in a large 11 x 14-inch Pyrex.  Melt margarine and add onion, bell pepper, pimentos, rice, soups, water and water chestnuts.  Pour over chicken breasts. Cook at 350° for 15 minutes, then turn oven down to 300° and cook for 1 hour more.  Add cheese 5 minutes before dish is done and return to oven for the last 5 minutes.

name: CORNBREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
3  onions
2  bell peppers
3  eggs
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can onion soup
2  boxes Jiffy cornbread mix
1  block butter
preparation: Saute meat and seasonings until tender.  Add both soups. Simmer 30 minutes.

name: CHEESE AND GARLIC GRITS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. grits, prepared according to directions
1/4  lb. butter, melted
3/4  lb. Cheddar or American cheese, grated
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
Tabasco sauce
1/2 to 1  clove garlic, minced
2  egg whites, stiffly beaten
preparation: Fold butter, grated cheese, Worcestershire sauce, Tabasco sauce and garlic into prepared grits.  Beat egg whites to form stiff peaks; fold into grit mixture.  Pour into greased casserole dish.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: SOUR CREAM CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. yellow cornmeal
4  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  egg, beaten
1/3  c. milk
4  Tbsp. margarine, melted
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  In large bowl, combine flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.  In medium bowl, beat together the egg, milk and margarine.  Add egg mixture and sour cream to flour mixture.  Stir just until blended.  Pour mixture into an 8-inch square pan coated with vegetable cooking spray. Bake 20 to 25 minutes.  Yields 9 servings.

name: EASY BAKE CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  large graham cracker crust
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
dash of salt
3/4  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, cheese, juice, salt and vanilla.  Begin to blend, then beat eggs in one at a time.  Pour mixture into crust. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until the center levels with the edges.  Chill before serving.

name: STIR-FRIED CHICKEN WITH LINGUINE
ingredients:
4  boneless, skinned chicken breasts, cubed
2  c. broccoli florets
1 to 2  c. cauliflower or broccoli florets
1  c. carrots, sliced
1  small green pepper, cut in strips
1 1/2  c. celery, sliced
1/2  c. sugar snap or snow peas
1  onion, sliced in rings
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  c. chicken stock (1 to 2 Tbsp. bouillon and 1 c. hot water)
1/2  c. soy sauce
1  tsp. ginger
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Stir-fry chicken in hot oil until just done.  Add all ingredients and stir-fry until crisp-tender.  Combine cornstarch, ginger and soy sauce.  Add to stock and mix well.  Add to vegetables and chicken.  Cook 2 minutes, until thickened.  Serve over cooked linguine or with cooked rice.

name: LEMON POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. oleo
1/2  c. shortening
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
3  c. flour
1  c. milk
2  tsp. lemon extract
powdered sugar
lemon juice
preparation: Cream oleo and shortening.  Cream in sugar.  Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Add flour.  Stir in milk and lemon extract.   Pour into Bundt pan sprayed with cooking spray.  Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes.  Mix together powdered sugar and lemon juice.  Glaze cake.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
1 2/3  sticks butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. flour
1  c. pecans, chopped (optional)
1  Tbsp. vanilla
4  tsp. cocoa
preparation: Mix melted butter and sugar until creamy, then add rest of ingredients.  Bake at 350° until done.

name: FAVORITE PUNCH
ingredients:
1 tall  can pineapple juice
1  qt. apple juice
1  gal. water
3  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. citric acid
ginger ale
preparation: Mix all together (except ginger ale).  Put in containers and freeze.  Take out of freezer about 2 hours before serving time. Put punch in punch bowl and pour in ginger ale.

name: MICROWAVE LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground round or turkey
1  lb. cottage cheese
1  egg or egg white
1  Tbsp. oregano or Italian seasoning
1  (32 oz.) spaghetti sauce
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
1/2  c. water
1  lb. Mozzarella
8  lasagne noodles (uncooked)
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef or turkey; drain.  Add spaghetti sauce, water and mushrooms.  Blend cottage cheese, egg and oregano in a small bowl.  Place a thin layer of meat sauce in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish.  Add 4 noodles, uncooked, half cheese mixture, half Mozzarella and Parmesan, a little meat sauce and more noodles. Repeat layers, ending with meat sauce.  Cover with plastic wrap and vent.  Cook on High for 15 minutes and Medium for 30 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIR CAKE
ingredients:
graham crackers
3 small  boxes instant vanilla pudding
4  c. milk
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
chocolate frosting
preparation: Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers.  Mix pudding with milk.  Heat per directions.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Put 1/2 of pudding on crackers.  Add another layer of crackers, then remaining 1/2 of pudding and end layering with more crackers. Frost with can of chocolate frosting.  Refrigerate 24 hours.  Cut into squares.

name: GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. dark molasses
1/2  c. warm milk
2  Tbsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. mace
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
5  Tbsp. coffee
3  beaten eggs
3  c. flour
3/4  tsp. salt
juice and grated rind of large orange
1 level  tsp. soda, dissolved in 2 Tbsp. warm water
preparation: Cream butter and sugar; add molasses and milk.  Mix and sift flour, salt and spices and add to mixture alternately with beaten eggs.  Add orange juice, and last, the soda dissolved in warm water.  Beat until smooth.  Bake in a loaf pan in a moderate oven 45 to 60 minutes.

name: CRESCENT DOGS 'N CHEESE
ingredients:
1  pack wieners
cheese
1  can crescent rolls
preparation: Slit wieners and stuff with cheese.  Roll in crescent rolls. Bake for 25 minutes at 300°.  Serve with mustard or ketchup. Great lunchtime snack.

name: TOMATO CAKES
ingredients:
1  qt. jar canned tomatoes
2  eggs, beaten
1  pkg. crackers (1/4 lb.)
salt and pepper
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Mash whole  tomatoes in bowl;  add eggs, crackers, salt and pepper to  taste,  and  sugar.  May  need more crackers to make mixture  just  stiff  enough to hold together like salmon cakes. Fry until  golden on each side.  A different dish with bacon or ham for breakfast or lunch.

name: GRANNY GIBBS' GRAPE WINE
ingredients:
1 large  bottle (38 oz.) Welch's grape juice
4  c. sugar
1/2  pack yeast
preparation: Chase wild bullfrogs 3 miles and gather up hops.  To them, add 10 gallons of tan bark, 1/2 pint of shellac and 1 bar of homemade soap.  Boil 36 hours, then strain through an I.W.W. (I won't work) sock to keep it from working.  Add 1 grasshopper to each pint to give it a kick.  Pour a little into the kitchen sink. If it takes the enamel off, it is ready for bottling.

name: Chicken-Spinach Toss
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
8  c. torn spinach
2  c. cubed cooked chicken
1  c. fresh or canned bean sprouts
1 (8 oz.)  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
1/3  c. salad oil
1  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. sesame seed, toasted
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/3 cup juice.  In a bowl combine the pineapple, spinach, chicken, bean sprouts and water chestnuts. In screw-top jar, combine the reserved pineapple juice, oil, sugar, soy sauce, lemon juice and pepper.  Shake well.  Pour over salad; toss.  Sprinkle with sesame seed.  Serves 4.

name: CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. hamburger
1/2  lb. bacon
1/2  c. onions, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans, drained
1 (16 oz.)  can B&M baked beans
1 (10 oz.)  box frozen baby limas, cooked
1/2  c. ketchup
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. mustard
preparation: Brown hamburger. Cook bacon crisp and break into small pieces. Brown onions lightly in hamburger grease.  Drain off excess fat in hamburger, bacon and onions.   Combine all ingredients in casserole dish and bake uncovered for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: MEXICORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. hamburger
1  onion, cut fine
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  can Mexicorn
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Brown meat and chopped onion; drain.  Add rest of ingredients and cook on top of stove for 35 minutes.  Serve over noodles cooked in salt water.

name: PUMPKIN COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. white sugar
1  egg
1  c. pumpkin (canned solid pack; not pumpkin pie filling)
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped English walnuts
preparation: Blend margarine, sugar and egg. Then add pumpkin and vanilla. Sift flour, cinnamon, baking powder, soda and salt. Add walnuts. Drop with spoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for almost 12 minutes.

name: TEA CAKES
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
3  c. sugar
5  c. self-rising flour
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Then add eggs and flour. Stir in vanilla flavoring. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350° until light brown.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chopped, frozen broccoli, thawed
1  medium onion, chopped very fine
1  stick oleo
1  can creamy chicken mushroom soup
1  c. milk
1 small  jar Kraft Cheez Whiz
1  c. uncooked rice
preparation: Cook rice according to directions.  Melt oleo in skillet and add broccoli and onion.  Saute for 15 minutes.  Stir while cooking. Mix Cheez Whiz, soup and milk and add to broccoli.  Add together with rice.  Place in baking dish and bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: SUCCOTASH
ingredients:
1  c. cooked corn kernels
1  c. cooked lima beans
butter
cream
salt
freshly ground pepper
preparation: Heat the corn and lima beans in butter and a little cream in a saucepan.  Season to taste.

name: TEXAS HASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  large onions, diced
2  stalks celery, sliced
2  green peppers, diced
3  Tbsp. shortening
1 1/2  lb. ground round
2  c. diced tomatoes
1/2  c. rice (uncooked)
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Sauté onions, celery and green peppers slowly in shortening. Brown meat and add to onion mixture.  Add tomatoes, rice and seasoning.  Arrange in large casserole.  Cover and bake in oven at 375° for 45 minutes.

name: STARRIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
preparation: You will need star-shaped cookie cutters or any shape you prefer.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg lemon jello
1  1/2 tsp lemon juice
1  c. sugar
1  can carnation milk
1  box cinnamon crisp
1  stick butter- melted
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. boiling water
1- 16  oz. package cream cheese
preparation: Freeze carnation milk to mesh state.  Pour boiling water over jello an lemon juice.  Stir good, let cool.  Mix sugar, cream cheese and vanilla.  Mix cinnamon crisp with melted butter and line pan with crisp mixture.  Whip carnation milk.  Blend together milk, jello and cream cheese mixtures.  When mixed together good pour over crisp and chill in refrigerator over night.

name: ZUCCHINI JELLY
ingredients:
6  c. grated zucchini
6  c. sugar
2  tsp. lemon juice
1 (16 oz.)  can pineapple
1  box Pen-Jell
1 (6 oz.)  box Jell-O apricot or strawberry
preparation: Boil grated zucchini and sugar for 6 minutes; add lemon juice, pineapple and Pen-Jell.  Boil 6 minutes more.  Put in sterilized jelly jars.  Melt paraffin and pour on top to seal.

name: CALIFORNIA SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1  box thin spaghetti
1  large green pepper
1  medium onion
3  medium tomatoes
1/2 (2.75 oz.)  jar McCormick seasoning (or less to taste)
1 (16 oz.)  bottle Italian dressing
preparation: Chop all vegetables very small.  Cook spaghetti and let cool. Toss all ingredients into spaghetti.  Refrigerate for 8 hours before serving.  Serve cold.  This is a really good salad!

name: BLACKBOTTOM CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/3  c. sugar
1/4  c. cocoa powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. water
6  oz. semi-sweet chocolate chips
5  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  egg
preparation: Heat oven to  350°.  Grease  muffin tins.  Mix flour, 1 cup of sugar, cocoa  powder,  soda  and  salt in a large bowl. Make  well in	the  center.  Blend  water,  oil,  vinegar  and vanilla.  Pour into  well.  Gradually  add  flour into liquid, whisking until smooth.  Spoon batter into pans.

name: BUTTER APPLE SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. oleo
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. peeled apples, finely chopped
2  c. brown sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. soda
1  c. sour cream
1  large egg
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Lightly spoon flour into cup; level off.  In large bowl, combine flour, sugar and oleo and stir in nuts.  Press 2 3/4 mixture into ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan.  To the remaining mix, add other ingredients; spoon evenly over base. Bake 25 to 30 minutes.  Cut into squares; serve with whipped cream.

name: TWENTY MINUTE SOUP
ingredients:
4  carrots, diced
4  stalks celery, diced
1/2  onion, diced
1/2  large tomato, diced
1/2  c. water
1  can chicken broth
1  can Northern beans
1/2  bouillon cube
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Boil vegetables until tender in 1/2-cup water.  Save the water and add 1 can chicken broth; add Northern beans, salt and pepper; cook 10 minutes.  If more soup is desired, add 1 more can of broth and 1/2 bouillon cube.  Also can add zucchini or any other vegetable or noodles rather than beans.  Makes about 6 servings.

name: SHRIMP PARTY SPREAD
ingredients:
1  c. finely chopped cooked shrimp
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
6  ripe olives, chopped
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1  Tbsp. crumbled blue cheese
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. dairy sour cream
preparation: Toss together shrimp, green peppers, olives, pimento, blue cheese, lemon juice, salt and pepper.  Gently blend in sour cream.

name: WHITE FUDGE
ingredients:
2 1/4  C. sugar
1/2  C. sour cream
1/4  C. milk
1  Tbsp. white Karo syrup
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. vanilla
1  C. chopped nuts
1/4  C. candied cherries
preparation: Combine all but nuts and vanilla. Boil to 238 degrees on candy thermometer. Remove and beat when temperature is 110 degrees and until shine is gone. Add nuts and vanilla. Pour onto buttered dish.

name: "DESSERT NACHOS"
ingredients:
11  graham crackers or 50 to 60 vanilla wafers
3 1/2  c. (8 oz.) thawed Cool Whip (nondairy whipped topping)
1  c. chopped strawberries
1  c. chopped kiwi fruit
strawberry, butterscotch or caramel topping
1  c. sliced bananas
preparation: Break graham crackers in half.  Mark a diagonal line on each half with knife; break apart to form triangles.  Place 1/2 of the triangles in a single layer on a serving plate.  Spread evenly with 1/2 of the whipped topping, then top with 1/2 of the fruit. Drizzle with strawberry, butterscotch or caramel topping.  Repeat layers and serve immediately.  Makes 6 (2 ounce) servings. Preparation time: 15 minutes.

name: HEARTY POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
6  peeled medium potatoes
2  carrots, diced
1  rib celery, finely chopped
2  qt. water
1  onion, chopped
6  Tbsp. margarine
6  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Combine potatoes, carrots and celery in a large pot. Add water. Cook for 20 minutes or tender. Drain liquid. Set vegetables aside. Sauté onion in butter in small pot. Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Add milk gradually. Stir gently. Pour into vegetables. Add a cup or more of liquid.

name: JARDINARE
ingredients:
cauliflower flowerets, cook al dente
carrots, sliced and cooked al dente
raw celery (string it), cut in pieces
1  green pepper, cut in pieces
1  red pepper, cut in pieces
celery seed
allspice (whole, optional)
white vinegar (save your pickle juices for this)
preparation: Put prepared vegetables in large bowl.  Add 1 cup white cider vinegar and 1/3 cup water and pickle juice if necessary.  Add celery seed and allspice.  Marinate 24 hours minimum.

name: GRANDMA PEARL'S BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  stick butter, softened
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
3  to 4 ripe bananas, mashed
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. flour
2  c. chopped walnuts (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Blend first 5 ingredients until smooth. Mix in last 4 ingredients and blend well.  Pour into greased loaf pan and bake for 40 minutes or until knife inserted into center comes out clean.

name: SWISS CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  chicken breast halves
8  slices Swiss cheese
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. dry white wine OR 1/2 c. orange juice
2  c. seasoned croutons
preparation: Skin the chicken breasts and place in a greased baking pan. Place a slice of Swiss cheese over each.  Mix together the soup and the wine; spoon over the chicken.  Crush the croutons and sprinkle over the chicken mixture.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 50-60 minutes.

name: GREEN PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak
2  c. boiling water with 3 bouillon cubes
1/4  c. onion
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. celery
2  Tbsp. oil
3  Tbsp. pimento
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  tsp. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. water
2  green peppers
preparation: Cut  steak  and  green peppers into thin strips.  Brown steak in  oil.  Pour  off  grease and add water to meat.  Cook until meat  is  tender.  Add  onion,  celery,  pimento, green peppers, salt,  pepper and garlic powder to steak.  Cover and cook  another 30  minutes.  Stir  water into cornstarch along with soy sauce. Add slowly to meat, stirring until thickened. Serve over cooked noodles or rice.

name: BROWN SUGAR BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  box light brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  c. plain flour
4  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt butter and sugar in saucepan at low heat.  Remove, add other ingredients in order.  Bake at 300° for 30 to 40 minutes. Cut into squares while hot.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
16  oz. sour cream
2  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
Miracle Whip
fresh dill (at least 1 c.)
preparation: Mix the sour cream and 1 1/2 packages Hidden Valley dressing. Fill sour cream container half full with Miracle Whip.  Add more, if desired.  Chop dill and add more, if needed.

name: JENNY'S OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine, softened
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. flour
3  c. 3-minute oats
preparation: Cream the margarine. Add sugars gradually and mix well.  Add beaten eggs and vanilla. Stir in soda, salt, flour and oats.  Form dough into small balls. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: TEX-MEX CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked white rice
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen whole kernel corn, thawed
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
1/3  c. sliced green onion
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. liquid red pepper seasoning
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  large tomato, thinly sliced
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 2-quart casserole.  Mix rice, corn, garlic, green onion, milk, chili powder, red pepper seasoning, salt, pepper and 1 1/2 cups Cheddar cheese.  Pour into casserole.  Arrange tomato slices on top, overlapping slightly. Bake 35 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese during the final 5 minutes of cooking.  Let stand for 15 minutes.

name: SOUR CREAM CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  lb. grated Monterey Jack cheese (reserve 1 c. for topping)
1/3  c. margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. chicken broth
1  large onion, chopped
1  pkg. chicken breasts, cooked and shredded
14  to 16 corn tortillas
1 1/4  c. sour cream
chili powder
jalapenos
preparation: Sauce:  Blend margarine, flour and chicken broth over medium heat.  Add sour cream and blend until thoroughly warm.  Do not boil.

name: GOOEY BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  box yellow butter cake mix
1  stick butter
1/4  tsp. vanilla
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  egg
powdered sugar
preparation: Mix with mixer until well blended. Chill dough. Roll into balls. Roll in powdered sugar. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: SOUTHWEST SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
8  oz. lean ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  c. packaged instant mashed potatoes
2  c. water
1/4  c. skim milk
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can low-fat condensed cream of tomato soup
1 (12 oz.)  can no-salt-added whole-kernel corn, drained
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chili peppers,	drained
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. ground cumin
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1/4  c. shredded low-fat Cheddar cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook ground beef and onion until meat is brown and onion is tender, about 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, prepare potatoes according to package directions, but use 2 cups water and 3/4 cup skim milk and omit butter or margarine and salt.	Place cooked meat mixture in a colander and rinse under hot water.  Drain well.  Wipe skillet with a paper towel.  Return meat mixture to skillet over medium heat.  Stir in remaining ingredients, except cheese, and heat through, about 7 minutes.	Transfer meat mixture to a 2-quart casserole.	Drop potato mixture in mounds on meat mixture or spread it over meat mixture.  Bake, uncovered, 25 to 30 minutes or until hot.	Sprinkle with cheese.

name: STRAWBERRY QUICK BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. sugar
2  c. thawed frozen strawberries with juice
4  eggs
1 1/4  c. cooking oil
1  1/4 chopped pecans (if desired)
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Mix remaining ingredients. Stir just to mix and moisten.  Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for one hour or until knife comes out clean.  Keep refrigerated.

name: TAMMIE'S "STRAWBERRY" COOKIES
ingredients:
10  oz. dates, chopped
1  c. flaked coconut
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter/margarine
1  egg
1  c. chopped pecans
2  c. Rice Krispies
red and green sugar crystals
preparation: In a large skillet over medium heat, combine sugar, butter, egg, dates, coconut and pecans; stirring constantly until thoroughly melted and blended together.  Remove from heat, stir in Rice Krispies.  With well-greased hands, shape mixture into strawberry shapes and roll in red sugar crystals.  Dip "stem" end in green crystals.

name: SHEATH CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. shortening
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. water
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar and flour; set aside.  Mix margarine, shortening, cocoa and water in a saucepan and bring to a rapid boil.  Pour over dry ingredients and stir well.  Add remaining ingredients. Mix well.  Pour into a greased 16 x 11-inch pan and bake 20 minutes at 400°.

name: BASIC DRESSING
ingredients:
3  c. cold cornbread
1/2  stick margarine
2  c. broth (from cooking any meat or canned chicken bouillon)
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground sage
seasonings (others, as desired)
3  c. cold biscuits
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  medium onion, chopped fine
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Spread in a greased pan and bake at 375°.  Use in other recipes as directed.

name: BUTTERMILK PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  tsp. Wesson oil
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. flour
1 1/2 to 1 3/4  c. buttermilk
preparation: Blend eggs and oil with wire whip.  Add soda, salt, baking powder and sugar and mix well with whip.  Add alternately flour and buttermilk.  Beat well with wire whip.  Cook on griddle over medium heat until bubbles begin to pop and turn to bake other side.

name: BROWNIE MIX
ingredients:
4  c. flour
4  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. cocoa
1 1/4  c. powdered milk (dry form)
6  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix thoroughly and store in a cool place.

name: MUENSTER CHEESE BATTER PUDDING
ingredients:
1  egg
3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
dash of pepper
1/4  lb. Muenster cheese
preparation: Beat egg lightly in bowl with a whisk.  Add the flour, half the milk, salt and pepper.  Stir in remaining milk.  Let batter stand for an hour.  Coarsely grate the cheese and stir half of it into the batter.  Grease an 8-inch Pyrex pie plate; pour the batter into it and bake in a preheated 425° oven for 30 minutes or until puffed and brown.  Scatter remaining cheese on top and bake just until it is melted.  Cut into 24 narrow wedges.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. water
3/4  stick margarine
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  c. flaked coconut
2 1/3  c. miniature marshmallows
German chocolate cake mix with pudding
preparation: Boil  water,  margarine  and sugar for 10 minutes, then add flaked  coconut.  Pour  this mixture into ungreased sheet cake pan.  Sprinkle 2 1/2 cups miniature marshmallows over top of mixture, then sprinkle 1 cup of chopped nuts over marshmallows.

name: OMELET
ingredients:
1  doz. eggs
1/2  c. ham or thin sliced meat
1  c. milk
1/2  can mushroom soup
1  tsp. salt
pepper
cheese
preparation: Beat all together; put in skillet.  Stir occasionally until done.  Top with cheese.  Serves 7 people.

name: MARY ANN'S OVEN BAKED CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising corn meal
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
water (add enough for medium consistency)
preparation: Mix all ingredients in bowl.  Pour in a greased skillet in center rack of oven at 375° until golden brown.  Mm-mm good.

name: O' HENRY CANDY BARS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  c. crunchy peanut butter
1  c. light corn syrup
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
6  c. corn flakes
preparation: Mix sugar and corn syrup and bring to boil.  Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and corn flakes.  Spread in a 9 x 11-inch buttered pan.  Let cool, but don't refrigerate.  Melt chocolate chips; spread over mixture.  Cool and cut into bars.

name: CORN FRITTERS
ingredients:
2  c. leftover creamed corn
1  egg
enough flour to thicken
preparation: Stir together and drop by spoonfuls into hot oil until golden brown.

name: LILLIAN'S STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
cut up stems
small onion
1  lb. sausage
1/2  c. cracker crumbs
little sage
preparation: Stuff mushrooms.  Cook slowly in butter until done.  If desired, stick under broiler until brown.

name: CHICKEN CORDON BLEU
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts
8  oz. pkg. Swiss cheese
8  oz. pkg. ham
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. paprika
6  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. dry white wine
1  chicken bouillon
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. heavy cream
preparation: Place cheese and ham slices on chicken; fold over and fasten with toothpicks.  Mix flour and paprika; coat chicken.  Cook chicken over medium heat in butter until brown on all sides.  Add wine and bouillon.  Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until tender.  Remove toothpicks.  Blend cream and cornstarch. Remove chicken from skillet.  Add cream mixture to pan and stir until thickened.  Serve over chicken.

name: NON-ALCOHOLIC PUNCH
ingredients:
2  cans frozen orange juice
2  cans frozen lemonade
8  cans plain water
2  c. grenadine
juice of 3 fresh lemons
3  qt. pre-chilled ginger ale
maraschino cherries
preparation: Mix together the first 6 ingredients.  Float orange slices on top. Add cherries.

name: MIRACLE PIE CRUST
ingredients:
4  c. flour
2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
1 3/4  c. Crisco
1  egg
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  c. water
preparation: Mix together first 5 ingredients.  In a cup, mix egg, vinegar and water.  Add to flour mixture.  Makes 5 to 7 crusts.  Can be frozen.

name: STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1  lb. beef, sliced
1  onion, sliced
1  green bell pepper
1  red bell pepper
1  carrot, sliced
2  cloves garlic, mashed
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
dash of salt and pepper
preparation: In wok on medium-high heat, brown garlic in 2 tablespoons oil. Add beef (chicken, pork and shrimp); brown.  Add vegetables, then soy sauce, salt and pepper.  Cook for 15 to 20 minutes.  Serve over rice.

name: INSTANT RICE DRESSING
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1 1/4  c. long grain rice (uncooked)
1  can onion soup
bell peppers and onions
salt and pepper
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 large  can mushrooms (including juice)
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients  together.  Place in well-greased baking dish  or  pan with tight fitting cover.  Bake 1 hour at 325°. Salt and pepper are optional because the condensed soup is  used undiluted and is well seasoned.  This recipe serves 8 to 10 people.

name: OUTRAGEOUS CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES(Yields About 2 Dozen)
ingredients:
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/3  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. (1 stick) margarine, softened
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  egg
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. quick-cooking oats
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Beat sugars, margarine, peanut butter, vanilla and egg in medium bowl with wooden spoon until creamy and well blended.  Mix in flour, oats, baking soda and salt.  Stir in chocolate chips.  Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls, about 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes.  Cool 1 minute before removing from cookie sheet.

name: BROWN SUGAR WHOOPIE PIES
ingredients:
3  eggs
3  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  c. melted margarine
1  c. boiling water
2  tsp. soda (put in water)
1  Tbsp. vanilla
5  c. flour
preparation: Blend sugar and eggs together, then add melted margarine.  Add boiling water, soda and vanilla.  Last, add flour gradually; mix until well blended.  Bake on insulated pans for about 15 minutes at 400° or uninsulated pans at 375°.

name: RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, melted
1  c. rice
1  can French onion soup
1  can mushroom soup
1  can water chestnuts, chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PORK CHOPS AND RICE
ingredients:
4  pork chops
1  c. rice
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  envelope onion soup mix
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
2 soup  cans water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown pork chops in large, heavy skillet.  Remove from skillet and stir in rice.  Add soups, drained mushrooms, water, salt and pepper.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: PARMESAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  (4 oz.) skinned, boned chicken breast halves
1/3  c. fine, dry breadcrumbs
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/4  tsp. dried basil
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
3  Tbsp. frozen egg substitute, thawed
1 (8 oz.)  can no-salt tomato sauce
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. dried basil
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. (1 oz.) shredded part-skim Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Place chicken between 2 sheets of plastic wrap; flatten to 1/4-inch thickness, using a meat mallet or rolling pin.  Combine breadcrumbs and next 3 ingredients.  Dip chicken in egg substitute; dredge in breadcrumb mixture.

name: MEXICAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat, crumbled, dried and drained
1  head lettuce, torn into pieces
2  to 3 tomatoes, cut into pieces
1  can Ranch Style pinto beans (juice and all)
1  pkg. Doritos or Fritos, coarsely crushed
1  onion, chopped
1  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Layer and toss.  If you want a dressing, use Catalina.  Good fresh or left over until the next day.  It is a meal alone. Serves 14 plus.

name: HUNGARIAN PASTRY
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
1  c. sugar
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. vanilla
4  egg yolks
preparation: Cream oleo  and  sugar; add rest of the ingredients and knead well.  Press  on  ungreased lipped cookie sheet.  Spread on top 2 cans  pie  filling.  (We like cherry best.) Top with meringue.

name: FRENCH APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. flour
pinch of salt
1  egg, well beaten
2  c. chopped apples
preparation: Mix the dry ingredients.  Add melted margarine and beaten egg; mix well.  Add apples.  Place in unbaked pie shell; bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
black pepper
1/2  stick margarine
1/2  box brown sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
preparation: Combine ingredients and cook until it gets a little syrupy. If not enough sauce, add more vinegar.  When chicken is almost done; split and brush, especially good on leg quarters.

name: CRACKLING CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  c. White Lily self-rising cornmeal
1/2  c. crackling
1  c. buttermilk
1  egg
preparation: Mix and pour into well-greased iron skillet sprinkled with cornmeal. Bake at 450° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. colored pasta twists
1/4  lb. pepperoni, sliced
1  medium tomato, diced
1/2  block sharp Cheddar, diced
small jar green olives, sliced
small can black olives, sliced
1  bottle Italian dressing
preparation: Cook pasta according to directions.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Add enough dressing to coat.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  bunches broccoli, chopped
1  small chopped onion
1  c. grated cheese
1/3  c. bacon
1  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Add broccoli, onions and bacon. Mix mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar together. Pour over vegetable mixture and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.

name: FRIED OKRA
ingredients:
fresh okra
cornmeal
flour
salt and pepper
bacon grease
preparation: Use tender, young pods.  Slice about 1/8-inch to 1/4-inch thick.  Use 2 parts cornmeal and 1 part flour to bread okra.  Put in bag; add sliced okra and shake until coated.  Fry in bacon grease until golden brown, turning often so it will not burn.  Salt and pepper to taste.

name: BOILED COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick butter
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  c. oatmeal
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook first 4 ingredients for 1 1/2 minutes; remove from heat and add peanut butter, oatmeal and vanilla.  Drop with a spoon onto waxed paper to cool.

name: SPEEDY GAZPACHO SOUP(Makes 6 cups or 8 first course servings.)
ingredients:
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans condensed tomato soup
water
2  beef flavored bouillon cubes
1/4  c. red wine
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  Tbsp. salad oil
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/8  tsp. hot pepper sauce
2  medium size tomatoes, diced
1  small green pepper, diced
corn chips for garnish
preparation: Two and half hours before serving, pour into large bowl undiluted tomato soup.  In small saucepan, heat 2 soup cans water to boiling; remove from heat.  Stir in bouillon until dissolved. Add broth to tomato soup, stirring until well blended.  Stir in vinegar and next 7 ingredients; cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, until well chilled.  Serve with corn chips.

name: AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
2  c. boiling water
1 (8 serving size)  pkg. Jell-O orange flavor
1 3/4  c. thawed Cool Whip
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 1/2  c. mini marshmallows
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving liquid; add cold water so liquids equal 1 cup.  Stir Jell-O and boiling water until completely dissolved (about 2 minutes).  Stir in the juice/cold water. Refrigerate 1 1/2 hours until slightly thickened.  Mix in the Cool Whip with whisk until smooth.  Refrigerate 15 minutes.  Stir in oranges, pineapple and marshmallows.  Refrigerate 4 hours.  Serves 10!

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1  can cream corn
1/2 to 3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. flour (heaping)
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Butter casserole pan; mix all ingredients together.  Bake at 350° for about 1 hour or until lightly brown.

name: BABA AU RHUM
ingredients:
1/2  c. scalded milk
1  cake compressed yeast
1/2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. butter
6  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. grated lemon rind
3  eggs, well beaten
1 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Cool scalded milk to lukewarm.  Add crumbled yeast, 1/2 cup flour and 2 tablespoons sugar.  Stir until smooth.  Cover and let rise in a warm place about 1 hour.  Cream butter, gradually adding 6 tablespoons sugar.  Beat until light.  Add salt, lemon rind, eggs, 1 1/2 cups flour and yeast mixture.  Beat well, about 15 minutes.  Half fill special molds which are well buttered both on the bottom and on the sides.  Cover and let rise until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour.  Cook 40 minutes in a moderate oven (350°).

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
2  c. mashed sweet potatoes
1  stick oleo, melted
2  egg yolks
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. each ginger, nutmeg and cinnamon
1/2  c. milk
2 egg whites, beaten stiff with 1/4  c. sugar
1  uncooked pastry shell
preparation: Mix the first 6 ingredients; add milk.  Fold in beaten egg whites.  Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350°.  Bake until firm.  Sprinkle top with nutmeg sugar if desired.

name: QUICK AND EASY BOURBON BARBECUE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  (3 lb.) chicken, cut up
1 (14 oz.)  bottle smoked barbecue sauce
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. bourbon
2  Tbsp. Dijon-style mustard
preparation: Arrange chicken pieces in 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  In a bowl combine rest of ingredients.  Pour over chicken.  Cover and marinate at least 2 hours or overnight, turning once.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Bake uncovered, basting every 15 minutes for 1 hour and 15 minutes until chicken is tender.  Makes 4 servings.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. seasoned croutons
2  c. cubed sharp cheese
4 eggs, beaten with 3/4  tsp. dry mustard
2  c. milk
1 1/2  lb. sausage, browned and drained
1  can mushrooms
1  can mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
preparation: Combine all but last 2 ingredients and put in 9 x 13-inch buttered pan.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
1  medium onion, minced
2  Tbsp. salad or olive oil
1 3/4  c. tomato puree
1 3/4  c. chopped tomato
2  cloves garlic, mashed
2  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. cumin
