1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
black olives
2 small  can green chilies
preparation: Saute onion in oil; add puree and spices and all other ingredients.  Simmer 30 minutes.

name: MA'S ROLLS
ingredients:
3/4  c. milk
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  c. oil
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. warm water
3  c. plain flour
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Scald milk and let cool. Dissolve sugar, salt and yeast in milk. Add cooking oil and 1/2 flour to milk mixture. Beat until smooth. Work in remaining flour and knead 5 minutes. Set in warm place for 1 hour to rise. Punch dough down. Shape rolls in favorite roll shape. Let rise 5 minutes. Bake at 400°.

name: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
ingredients:
6  large potatoes, cut in large chunks
1/4  c. flour
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
3/4  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
1  stick margarine
preparation: In plastic bag, mix flour, cheese, salt and pepper.  Shake potato chunks in mixture to coat.  Melt margarine in baking dish. Put coated potatoes in butter in 1 layer.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes, turning once during cooking.

name: "EASY" BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
8  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. catsup
6  Tbsp. vinegar
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Simmer until onion is done.  Good for grilling, baking, etc.

name: HELEN SCOTT'S MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. oil
1/4  c. dark molasses
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
2 1/4  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. cloves
preparation: Blend oil, molasses, sugar and eggs well.  Sift together dry ingredients and combine with oil mixture.  Chill 1 hour.  Roll into walnut-sized and roll in extra granulated sugar.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Yields 4 dozen.

name: ORANGE JUICE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box lemon supreme cake mix
4  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
2/3  c. Crisco oil
1  c. orange juice
preparation: Beat 4 minutes.  Pour in Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Needs no icing.

name: BOILED CUSTARD
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  qt. milk
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs well and mix in sugar; add milk.  Cook until it coats a wooden spoon. Refrigerate and serve cold.

name: ROAST CHICKEN AND SAUERKRAUT, MICROWAVED(Serves 6)
ingredients:
1  cleaned chicken (weighing 3 to 4 lb.)
salt
pepper
1  lb. sauerkraut (fresh or canned), drained
1/4  c. low-calorie margarine, melted
paprika
poultry seasoning
preparation: Rinse chicken and drain well.  Sprinkle inside lightly with salt and pepper.  Fill cavity lightly with sauerkraut.   Place chicken in 2-quart microwave-safe baking dish with roasting rack, breast side down.  Brush skin with 1/2 the melted margarine. Sprinkle with paprika and poultry seasoning.  Tent slightly with waxed paper.

name: SOUR CREAM COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
1  c. butter
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs
4  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla or lemon extract
preparation: Combine and dip by spoon onto greased cookie sheet.  Dip glass bottom in water, then sugar, and flatten cookies.  Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. squash, diced and boiled
1  medium onion
2  tsp. butter
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  lb. soda crackers, crumbled
preparation: Combine  ingredients in order listed.  Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1  c. sugar
pinch of salt
1/2  bar German chocolate
3  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. Angel Flake coconut
1/4  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Melt chocolate, butter and sugar in top of double boiler or in microwave.  Let cool slightly.  Add eggs, cornstarch, then other ingredients.  Bake in unbaked pie shell at 375° for 20 minutes.

name: ORANGE SLICE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. orange slices
1/2  c. nuts
pinch of salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs; add brown sugar.  Chip orange slices and nuts in flour; mix and then combine with egg mixture.  Roll out or drop onto cookie sheet.  Sprinkle top with powdered sugar.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: B.B.Q. COUNTRY RIBS
ingredients:
1  c. honey
1  c. catsup
1  clove minced garlic
1  minced onion
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  c. vinegar
1/4  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. thyme
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and boil for 5 minutes.  Roll ribs in flour & brown in oleo.  Put into a cooking bag.  Pour sauce over meat and bake 2 1/2 hours at 325°.  Makes 6 servings.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
5  c. carrots, cut in 1-inch pieces
1  medium onion, diced
1  green pepper, slivered
1  can tomato soup
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1/2  c. salad oil
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. cider vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook  the  carrots  until just tender.  Combine with all ingredients.  Marinate 12 hours.  Drain and serve.

name: ITALIAN MEAT SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground round
2  c. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1/2  c. onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
1/4  c. dry red wine
2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/4  tsp. each salt and pepper
1/8  tsp. cayenne
28 oz  can tomato puree
preparation: Crumble meat in skillet and brown, breaking to crumble.  Drain and discard drippings. Combine mushrooms, onion and garlic in saucepan and cook until onion is tender. Add beef and remaining ingredients, stirring well.  Cook to thoroughly heat through, stirring twice.  Serve over hot pasta. Yields 6 cups.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) block cream cheese
1 7  oz. jar marshmallow cream
1  box confectioners sugar
preparation: Sift confectioners sugar.  Heat marshmallow cream in microwave 30 seconds.  Let cream cheese get to room temperature. Mix all ingredients together.  Cover and refrigerate until used.

name: GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter or shortening
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs, well beaten
1  c. molasses
3  c. plain flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. ginger
1  c. sour milk
2  tsp. soda
preparation: Cream  butter  or  shortening and brown sugar.	Add eggs and molasses.  Sift  together flour, cinnamon and ginger.  Add flour mixture  and milk alternately. When well mixed, add soda dissolved in  small	amount of hot water.  Stir well.  Bake in moderate oven  until  knife	comes  out clean.  Serve with hot lemon sauce or whipped cream.

name: BAKED SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1 small  box spaghetti, cooked
2  lb. ground chuck
Italian seasoning
garlic powder
Parmesan cheese
1 large  jar spaghetti sauce
4  c. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cook spaghetti.  (May need to use a little more than a small box of spaghetti.)  Brown and drain ground chuck.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Add Italian seasoning and garlic powder to spaghetti sauce to taste.  Grease 11 x 13-inch dish and layer spaghetti, Parmesan cheese (light coating), ground chuck, Parmesan cheese, spaghetti sauce, Parmesan cheese and shredded Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CHICKEN BREAST DIANE
ingredients:
4  large boneless chicken breasts
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
2  Tbsp. margarine
3  Tbsp. chopped green onion
juice of 1/2 lemon
2  tsp. Dijon mustard
1/4  c. chicken broth
preparation: Place chicken breasts between sheet of waxed paper and pound slightly.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Heat 1 tablespoon each of oil and butter in large skillet.  Cook chicken 4 minutes on each side.  Do not overcook or they will be dry.  Transfer to warm platter.  Add green onion and lemon juice and mustard to skillet. Cook 15 seconds, whisking constantly.  Whisk in broth.  Stir until sauce is smooth.  Whisk in remaining butter and oil.  Pour sauce over chicken.  Serve immediately.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
4  c. grated zucchini
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1 1/4  c. oil
1 1/2  tsp. salt
4  eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. nuts
preparation: Combine and pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, shredded
1  bunch green onions, chopped
2  or 3 tomatoes, chopped
2  cans Bush chili beans, well drained
2  c. low fat cheddar cheese, grated
1  large bag Fritos, crushed
1 large  bottle fat free Catalina dressing
preparation: Put lettuce in the bottom of a large bowl.  Add in order listed, green onions, tomatoes, chili beans, and cheese.  Punch holes in the bag of Fritos and crush them with your hands, add to salad.  Just before serving pour dressing over all and toss real good.  This can be made ahead of time and  Fritos and dressing added just before serving.

name: HOT PUNCH
ingredients:
1  gal. apple cider
2 large  cans pineapple juice
1 large  can apricot juice
1  Tbsp. whole cloves
2  sticks cinnamon
1  c. brown sugar
preparation: Bring cider, brown sugar, cloves and cinnamon to a boil.  Boil 10 minutes, then add other juices.

name: STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
6  to 8 green peppers
1 to 1 1/2  lb. hamburg
1  large onion, diced
1  c. Minute rice
1 (12 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
2  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  small (6 oz.) Hunt's sauce (optional)
preparation: Cut peppers in half; remove seeds.  In a large skillet, fill half with water; parboil peppers until tender.  Mix in bowl hamburg, rice, garlic powder, diced onion and stewed tomatoes; mix well.  Spoon mixture into pepper halves; place in baking pan. (Cover stuffed peppers with sauce, if desired.)  Cover with aluminum foil.  Bake 40 minutes in preheated 350° oven.  Serves 6.

name: LIME JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. lime Jell-O
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
1/2  bag small marshmallows
1/2  pt. whipping cream or 1 envelope Dream Whip, prepared
preparation: Mix Jell-O and water.  Let stand until jelled slightly (thick, but not solid).  In the meantime, drain pineapple very well and soak marshmallows in this until Jell-O is ready. When Jell-O is ready to be beaten, beat until it is foamy. Whip the cream very well. Fold into the Jell-O the pineapple, whipped cream, marshmallows and juice.  Put into an 8 x 8-inch dish or pan and let stand overnight in refrigerator. Cut, serve and enjoy.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  head broccoli (bite size)
1/2  lb. bacon
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese, grated
1  small red onion, chopped
preparation: Mix ingredients for salad and keep cold until almost ready to serve.  Fry bacon crisp and crumble in salad.

name: FRUIT SMOOTHIES
ingredients:
1  frozen banana
3  frozen strawberries
1  c. apple juice
preparation: Add yogurt or other berries or fruit. Blend, pour and serve.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. flaked coconut
1  German chocolate cake mix
1  stick margarine
8  oz. cream cheese
1  lb. confectioners sugar
preparation: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle 1 cup chopped pecans and 1 cup flaked coconut into prepared pan.  Mix one German chocolate cake mix by directions and pour over nuts and coconut. Melt one stick margarine and 8 ounces cream cheese; add 1 pound of confectioners sugar and whisk until smooth.  Pour over cake mix. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: CLAM FRITTER
ingredients:
1  pt. Clams or Quahogs
1-3/4  c. Sifted Flour
1  Tbsp. Baking Powder
1/2  tsp. Nutmeg
1/2  tsp. Salt
2  Eggs, beaten
1  c. Milk
2  tsp. grated Onion
1  Tbsp. Butter
preparation: Drain Clams and chop.  Sift all dry ingredients together. Combine Eggs, Milk, Onion, Butter and Clams, pour into dry ingredients.  Stir until smooth.  Drop batter by teaspoonfuls into hot fat (350 degrees).  Fry about three minutes or until golden brown.  Drain.  Serves 6.

name: BEET SALAD
ingredients:
1  can shoestring beets, drain but save juice
1  pkg. lemon gelatin
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1  tsp. horseradish
preparation: Measure beet juice and add water to make 1 1/2 cups.  Bring this to a boil. Remove from heat. Add gelatin, sugar, vinegar and horseradish.  Stir and add beets.  Chill until firm.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CITRUS SALAD
ingredients:
2  envelopes gelatin
1/2  c. cold water
1/2  c. hot water
1/2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. orange juice
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  c. orange segments
3  c. bananas
1/2  c. coconut (optional)
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in  cold  water;  add	to  hot  water. Combine  remaining	 ingredients.  Stir  in  gelatin  mixture. Chill.

name: PUMPKIN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/3  c. oil
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. milk
3/4  c. pumpkin
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
3/4  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. ginger
preparation: Grease muffin tins.  Combine oil, beaten egg, milk and pumpkin.  Beat well.  Stir together all remaining dry ingredients and stir into liquid ingredients until well blended.  Do not beat. Fill tins 3/4 full.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350° until lightly browned.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  c. peanut butter
2 1/4  c. flour
4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream shortening and sugars together.  Beat in eggs and vanilla.  Stir in the peanut butter.  Mix in well the flour, baking powder and salt.  Spoon onto cookie sheets and cross tops with sugared fork.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes in a 375° oven.

name: VEGETABLE CHRISTMAS SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. Knox gelatine
1/2  c. cold water
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. boiling water
2  stalks celery, cut
juice of 1 lemon
1/3  c. vinegar
1  c. celery
1 small  jar cut pimento
1 large  can asparagus
preparation: Soften gelatine with 1/2 cup cold water.  Add cup of boiling water, sugar, lemon juice, vinegar and 13 drops of green food coloring.  Let set until cool.  Get other foods ready.  Dice celery, add asparagus and pimento and chill.  Serve on lettuce leaves.

name: PEPPERMINT FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
20  peppermint hard candies
1  (8 oz.) tub Cool Whip chocolate whipped topping, thawed
2  baked (9-inch) chocolate cake layers, cooled
preparation: Crush 8 mints; set aside remaining mints for garnish.  Spread 1 cup of the whipped topping on 1 cake layer; sprinkle with crushed mints.  Top with second cake layer.  Frost entire cake with remaining whipped topping.  Garnish with remaining mints before serving.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.  Yield:  12 servings.

name: RHUBARB SALAD
ingredients:
3 or 4  c. cooked rhubarb
1  c. sugar
2  boxes cherry jello
1  c. juice (pineapple or grapefruit)
1  c. crushed pineapple or applesauce
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Cook rhubarb; while hot, stir in sugar and jello.  Add other ingredients and chill.

name: GROUND TURKEY JOES(Diet)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey, uncooked (white meat)
1/3  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. barbecue sauce
preparation: Brown turkey in Teflon skillet.  Add ingredients and simmer.

name: KERR KRISPY LUNCH PICKLES
ingredients:
25  to 30 medium cucumbers
5  to 8 large white onions
2  large bell peppers
1/2  c. salt
5  c. vinegar
5  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
1  tsp. turmeric
1/2  tsp. cloves
preparation: Wash cucumbers and slice as thin as possible.  Chop onions and peppers.  Combine with cucumbers and salt.  Let stand 3 hours and drain. Combine vinegar, sugar and spices in a large preserving kettle. Bring to a boil.  Add drained cucumbers.  Heat thoroughly but do not boil.  Pack while hot into sterilized jars and seal at once.

name: SLUSH PUNCH
ingredients:
6  c. sugar
4  c. water
2 (32 oz.)  cans unsweetened pineapple juice
1  gal. cold water
1 (8 oz.)  jar ReaLemon juice
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice (undiluted)
1 1/2  oz. almond flavoring
2 large  pkg. lemon Jell-O
preparation: Mix sugar  and  water;  bring  to  a  boil; add Jell-O, dissolve.  Add  other  ingredients.  Freeze.  Thaw  to a slush before serving.  Yields 2 gallons.

name: SLOW COOKER BARBECUE BEEF SANDWICHES
ingredients:
3  lb. beef boneless chuck roast
1  c. barbecue sauce
1/2  c. peach or apricot preserves
1/3  c. chopped green bell pepper
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
2  tsp. packed brown sugar
1  small onion, sliced
kaiser or hamburger buns, split
preparation: Trim excess fat from beef. Cut beef into 4 pieces. Place beef in 4 to 5-quart slow cooker. Mix remaining ingredients, except buns; pour over beef. Cover and cook on low heat setting 7 to 8 hours or until beef is tender. Remove beef on low heat setting 20 to 30 minutes longer or until beef is hot. Fill buns with beef mixture.

name: PINEAPPLE-PEAR MOLD
ingredients:
2  envelopes unflavored gelatin
2 1/2  c. orange juice
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (juice packed)
2  medium pears, peeled, cored and chopped
6  packets Equal
preparation: In a small saucepan, soften gelatin in 1/2 cup of the orange juice.  Stir in undrained, crushed pineapple and remaining orange juice.  Chill until partially set.  Fold in pears and Equal and turn mixture into a 6-cup mold.  Chill until firm.  Unmold onto a plate.  Makes 8 servings.  Calories per serving:  111.  Diabetic exchanges per serving:  milk 0, vegetable 0, fruit 2, bread 0, meat 0 and fat 0.

name: SAWMILL GRAVY
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. bacon drippings
1 1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. flour
salt to taste
preparation: In heavy skillet  brown flour with drippings.  Add milk and salt.  Cook and  stir  until  thick.  Add  hot  water  if mixture is too thick.

name: JERRY GOYER'S ROAST BEEF
ingredients:
sirloin tip or rolled beef roast
salt and pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 500°.  Select meat and add salt and pepper. Place on roasting pan with rack.  Bake 6 minutes per pound.  After roasting time is completed, do not open oven door for 2 hours. Slice and serve.  Garnish with miniature beets filled with horseradish.

name: CHICKEN WITH COLORFUL RICE
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. each basil, oregano, thyme and pepper
6  skinless boneless chicken breasts
3  Tbsp. oil
3  Tbsp. margarine
1 1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. chicken broth
2  Tbsp. white wine
3  c. hot cooked rice
12  cherry tomatoes
1/2  c. chopped fresh spinach
preparation: In plastic bag mix together flour, salt and spices.  Add chicken, shaking to coat.  In large frying pan, heat oil and margarine.  Add chicken and cook, turning for about 20 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes.  Combine broth and wine; add to frying pan.  Cover, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until fork-tender.  Remove chicken; keep warm.  Pour off fat; return 1 tablespoon fat to pan.  Stir hot rice into mushrooms and drippings.  Add tomatoes and spinach to rice mixture; carefully toss until warm throughout (3 minutes). Transfer rice to platter and arrange chicken on rice.

name: CHESS CAKE *
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines yellow butter cake mix
1  egg
1  stick margarine
1  box powdered sugar
3  eggs
8  oz. cream cheese
preparation: Combine cake mix, egg and margarine.  Dough is thick, about the consistency of cookie dough.  Pat dough into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and 3 eggs.  Pour over dough in pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.  Cake falls in middle and is a bit gooey.

name: SUGAR-FREE FAT-FREE PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  can natural pumpkin
2  pkg. sugar-free vanilla Jell-O instant pudding
1  c. skim milk
pumpkin pie spice to taste
ginger and nutmeg to taste
1  graham cracker crust
preparation: Whisk the pudding mix in cold milk.  Stir in pumpkin and spices.  Pour into pie shell and chill.  Top with nonfat topping.

name: SWEET EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon
3  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  c. milk
1  ready made crust
preparation: Beat eggs, then add vanilla, lemon and sugar; beat together real well.  Add milk and pour mix in crust.  Bake at about 300° until done.  Serve with ice cream on top of pie.

name: HOMEMADE ORANGE SHERBET(4 Quart Recipe)
ingredients:
6 (12 oz.)  cans orange soda
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (15 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drain
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in ice cream freezer.

name: LIKE ORANGE JULIUS
ingredients:
1/2 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice concentrate (1/3 c.)
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
6  ice cubes
preparation: Blend all ingredients in a blender until smooth, about 30 seconds.  Serve immediately.  Makes about 3 cups.

name: WATERMELON RIND PICKLES
ingredients:
10  lb. rind
7  lb. white sugar
5  pt. apple vinegar
2  oz. stick cinnamon
1  oz. whole cloves
1  oz. ginger root
preparation: Cut rind up and let stand in cold water overnight.  Next morning, cook until clear in same water.  Make syrup; tie spices in a bag.  When the syrup gets thick, drop in drained rind and let come to a boil.  Take out fruit and drain.  Next morning, heat syrup; pour over fruit.  Let boil.  Pack in hot jars and seal.

name: AUSTIN'S FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  handful miniature marshmallows
1  handful coconut
preparation: Mix everything together and put in refrigerator until time to eat.

name: FANNIE MAE FUDGE
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
1  c. whole milk
1  c. butter or oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
25  marshmallows
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. milk chocolate chips
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
2  oz. Baker's chocolate
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix sugar, butter and milk; bring to rolling boil and boil for 2 minutes.  Add marshmallows, 5 at a time, then chips, vanilla and nuts.

name: GRANOLA
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. regular rolled oats
1  c. shredded coconut
1/2  c. coarsely chopped walnuts or almonds
1/2  c. sesame seed or wheat germ
1/2  c. shelled sunflower seeds
1/2  c. honey
1/4  c. cooking oil
1/2  c. snipped dried apricots
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: In a bowl, stir together oats, coconut, almonds or walnuts, sesame seed or wheat germ and sunflower seeds.  Combine honey and oil.  Stir into oat mixture.  Spread out evenly in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Bake at 300° for 45 to 50 minutes.  Stir every 15 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Stir in apricots and raisins. Remove to another pan.  Cool, stirring often to prevent lumping. Store in tightly covered jars.

name: BEAU MONDE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. Hellmann's
1 1/2  tsp. Beau Monde
1 1/2  tsp. parsley
1  c. sour cream
1 1/2  tsp. dill weed
1 1/2  tsp. scraped onion
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Keep chilled.  Serve with fresh vegetables.

name: RED VELVET POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. shortening
7  eggs
3  c. plain, all-purpose flour
1  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1  oz. bottle red food coloring
2  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Cream shortening; add sugar and beat well.  Add eggs, one at a time and beat well.  Add dry ingredients and milk alternately. Add flavoring and red food coloring.  Bake 1 1/2 hours in a tube pan at 325°.

name: Super Meat Loaf
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef or chuck
1  slice bread
1  stalk celery
1  small onion
2  Tbsp. water
1  egg
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Place bread in blender until finely ground.  Add to meat. Combine water, celery and onion in blender until blended.  Add egg and blend.  Add to meat mixture and place in loaf pan and score top.  Top with mixture of 2 tablespoons brown sugar and 2 tablespoons catsup.  Cook 18 to 20 minutes in microwave.  Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.  Can be baked in regular oven at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

name: CHERRY CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) graham cracker crumb crust or baked pastry shell
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (4 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1/3  c. ReaLemon juice from concentrate
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling, chilled
preparation: In a large bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.  Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.  Stir in ReaLemon juice and vanilla.  Pour into prepared crust.  Chill 3 hours or until set. Top with cherry pie filling before serving.

name: RED BEANS AND RICE
ingredients:
2  c. Uncle Ben's long grain rice, cooked
1 (16 oz.)  can red chile beans in chile gravy
1  tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. cumin
dash of garlic salt
preparation: In saucepan, heat beans without letting them boil. Stir in chili powder, cumin and garlic salt. When piping hot, add warm rice and gently mix.

name: TURKEY AND VEGETABLE STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
1  turkey tenderloin, thinly sliced (about 3/4 lb.)
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli, carrots, water chestnuts and red peppers
1  medium onion, cut into thin strips
1/4  c. prepared stir-fry sauce
3  c. hot cooked rice
preparation: Heat large nonstick skillet or wok over medium-high heat until hot.  Add oil; heat until it ripples.  Add turkey; cook and stir 4 to 5 minutes or until no longer pink.  Add frozen vegetables and onion; cook and stir 6 to 8 minutes or until vegetables are crisp and tender.  Add stir-fry sauce; cook until thoroughly heated. Serve over hot cooked rice.  Makes 4 (1 1/4 cup) servings.

name: QUICHE LORRAINE(Egg, Bacon and Cheese Pie)
ingredients:
Unbaked Deep Dish Pie Shell
12  slices of bacon (about 1/2 lb), crisply fried and crumbled
1  cup shredded natural swiss cheese (about 4 ounces)
1/2  cup minced onion
4  eggs
2  cups Carnation evaporated milk
3/4  tsp salt
1/4  tsp sugar
1/8  tsp ground cayenne red pepper (powder)
preparation: Heat oven to 425 degrees.  Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in pie shell.  Beat eggs slightly, beat in remaining ingredients. Pour mixture into pie pan.  Bake 15 minutes.  Reduce oven temperature to 300 degrees and bake 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted 1 inch from edge comes out clean.  Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.  Makes 6 meal size servings or 8 appetizer size servings.  Left overs can be reheated in microwave.

name: CHOW MEIN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1 large  can chow mein noodles
2  c. diced celery
1  Tbsp. oil
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed tomato soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
preparation: Brown beef and onion in oil.  Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole.  Add noodles, soups and celery.  Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.  Serves 6.

name: PEPPERONI BREAD
ingredients:
1  loaf frozen bread dough
3  eggs, lightly beaten
2/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. Italian seasoning
1/4  lb. pepperoni
1/2  lb. Swiss cheese
mild or hot pepper rings
preparation: Thaw and roll bread dough to 12 x 16-inch rectangle.

name: RUSSIAN FLUFF
ingredients:
1  large onion, cut up
2  cans tomato soup
2  lb. hamburg
2  c. cooked rice
2  cans peas
2  c. water
preparation: Fry hamburg and onion.  Add other ingredients and mix.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: BRUNCH EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  eggs, slightly beaten
8  oz. Cheddar cheese, shredded
3 1/2  c. milk
1 (6 oz.)  box seasoned croutons or homemade if you wish
1/2  lb. bacon, cooked until crisp
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: In the bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish (greased), place croutons.  Combine in large bowl eggs, milk,  cheese, salt and pepper.  Mix until blended.  Pour about 1/2 inch of egg mixture over croutons and let sit for about 5 minutes (just to let croutons soften a bit).  Pour rest of egg mixture over croutons. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon.  Bake at 325° for 50 minutes or until set.  Cut into squares and serve hot with toast, muffins, etc.  So easy to make and convenient for company.  Just prepare and cook the night before.  Cool and refrigerate.  Bring to room temperature and reheat the next day!

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can mushroom soup
2 (10 oz.) frozen or 1  bunch broccoli
1  c. Cheddar cheese
1  c. Ritz cracker crumbs (approximately 16 crackers)
1 small  can water chestnuts, drained (optional)
1/2  c. butter or oleo
preparation: Cook broccoli.  Drain, chop and if using chestnuts, add to broccoli.  Combine soup, mayonnaise, eggs and cheese.  Add to broccoli mixture.  Put in 9-inch square baking dish or 2-quart casserole.  Sprinkle cracker crumbs on top and dot with butter. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

name: PAELLA
ingredients:
1  c. rice
1  (3 lb.) chicken
1  qt. water
4 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  onion, sliced
2  sprigs parsley
1 1/2  tsp. olive oil
1/4  tsp. saffron
1  lb. shrimp
1  c. peas
12  clams or mussels
1  lb. sausages
2  cloves garlic
preparation: Cook chicken in water until tender with 2 teaspoons salt, the pepper, onion, parsley and celery.  Remove from broth; take chicken off bones in large pieces.  Strain broth and save.  Cook rice and garlic in olive oil until straw-colored.  Add 1 1/2 cups broth, saffron, peas, shrimp and 2 1/2 teaspoons salt together.  Bring to a boil.  Pour into 2-quart casserole dish; add sausages.  Bake for 1 hour in moderate oven.  Add clams or mussels and bake until clams open.

name: CHESS BARS
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  egg, beaten
1  stick margarine, melted
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese (room temperature)
1  box sifted confectioners sugar
3  eggs, beaten
preparation: Mix together cake mix, egg and melted margarine.  Pat in a well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix together cream cheese (room temperature), confectioners sugar and eggs (beaten) and pour over the top of cake mixture.  Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.  Cool and cut into squares.

name: DONNA'S NO EGG ICE CREAM(For those with allergies.)
ingredients:
5-qt. ice cream freezer
3  cans Eagle Brand condensed milk
dash of salt
peach or strawberry pie filling (if desired)
2  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring
milk (complete to fill line)
preparation: Place condensed milk, flavoring, salt and pie filling (if desired) in freezer pail.  Add milk to fill line and stir until mixed with other ingredients.  Freeze and pack for 1 t 2 hours if desire firmer texture or may be eaten as soon as frozen. Delicious!

name: LEMON BARS
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter *
1/3  c. powdered sugar *
1 1/2  c. flour *
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. flour
preparation: *I usually use 1 1/2 times this much.

name: BAKING POWDER DUTCH CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
1  beaten egg
1  c. milk
2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix together as pie crust and take out 3/4 cup of crumbs, then add 1 beaten egg and 1 cup milk and 2 teaspoons baking powder. Mix together and bake in pie tins.  Sprinkle crumbs over batter. Bake in greased pans 25 to 30 minutes in 350° oven.

name: BARBECUED WATER CHESTNUTS
ingredients:
1  lb. sliced bacon
2  cans water chestnuts, drained
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
1 (16 oz.)  bottle catsup
preparation: Cut bacon slices into 3 pieces.  Wrap bacon piece around each water chestnut; secure with toothpick.  Place in baking dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Mix sugars with catsup in bowl.  Dip each wrapped water chestnut in sauce; arrange in baking dish. Pour remaining sauce over top.  Bake for 30 minutes longer.

name: CHOCOLATE CREAM CHEESE CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
1  (6 oz.) chocolate or graham cracker ready crust
preparation: In large bowl with mixer at medium speed, beat cream cheese and mayonnaise until smooth.  Gradually beat in sugar.  Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Beat in chocolate and vanilla until smooth. Pour into pie crust.  Place on cookie sheet and bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until set.  Chill 4 hours.

name: TUNA DIP
ingredients:
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1  can tuna, drained
1  c. celery
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  hard-boiled eggs
preparation: Place all but eggs in blender.  Mix in blender.  Then in blender chop in hard-boiled eggs.  Good for vegetables or chips.

name: CRUNCHY POPS
ingredients:
2  ripe bananas
1  jar honey
crispy rice cereal
4  ice cream sticks
wooden board
preparation: Peel the bananas. Then cut them in half.  Put an ice cream stick into the end of the bananas.  Put the pops in the freezer for an hour.  Take out the pops. Spread honey on each pop with a table knife.  Pour some rice cereal on the wooden board.  Roll each pop in the cereal.  Enjoy.

name: SHAKE AND BAKE
ingredients:
4  cups dry bread crumbs
1/2  cup salad oil
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. celery salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients together with a fork in a large bowl. Store in a container with tight fitting lid, preferably in the refrigerator. Use to coat chicken,fish, or pork.  Moisten the meat or fish with water or milk before coating.  Bake at 375° for 30 to 45 minutes depending on thickness.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
3  c. finely grated carrots
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Combine oil and sugar in large mixing bowl using electric mixer.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add grated carrots to mixture.  Add flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon.

name: BROCCOLI AND BEAN SPROUTS
ingredients:
1/4  c. vegetable or olive oil
1  head broccoli
1  can drained bean sprouts
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Saute the broccoli in the oil.  Add stems first, sliced thin, then add tops, chopped.  Add the bean sprouts and soy sauce. Cover; steam for 10 minutes.

name: STUFFED GREEN PEPPERS(And Stuffed Zucchini and Stuffed Cabbage Rolls)
ingredients:
2  lg. green peppers OR 4 medium zucchini OR 8 medium to large cabbage leaves
3/4  lb. sausage or ground beef
1/3  c. chopped onion
1 7-1/2  oz. can tomatoes, undrained and cut up OR 1 15-oz. can of tomato sauce for stuffed cabbage
1/3  c. long grain rice
1/2  c. water
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. dried basil OR 1/2 tsp. dried oregano
1/2  c. shredded American cheese, divided
1/2  tsp. sugar for stuffed cabbage
preparation: Halve the peppers lengthwise, removing stem ends, seeds and membranes.  Immerse peppers in boiling water for 3 minutes. Sprinkle insides with salt and invert on paper towels to drain. In a skillet, cook the sausage or ground beef with the onion until the meat is brown and the onion is tender.  Drain the fat.  Stir in the undrained tomatoes, uncooked rice, worcestershire sauce, water, and salt and pepper.  Bring to a boil then reduce the heat, cover, and simmer for 15-18 minutes, or until the rice is tender. Stir in 1/4 c. cheese.  Fill the peppers with the meat mixture and place them in an 8 x 8 inch baking dish with any remaining meat mixture.  Bake at 375° about 15 minutes, or until heated through. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese.  Let stand a couple minutes before serving.

name: TEX MEX DIP
ingredients:
3  medium ripe avocados
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
2  cans bean dip
1  c. chopped green onions
2  c. chopped tomatoes
6  oz. can black olives, chopped
8  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1  bag Tostitos or plain nachos
preparation: Spread dip in bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish.  Mash avocados with lemon juice and salt and pepper.  Drain off lemon juice.  Spread over bean dip.  Mix sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning. Spread over previous layer.  Top with onions, tomatoes and olives. Cover with cheese.  Chill overnight if possible.

name: WINE CAMEMBERT CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  Camembert cheese
3/4  c. white wine
7  Tbsp. butter
few drops Tabasco
3  oz. flaked almonds
preparation: Place Camembert in small bowl and cover with wine.  Cover; leave overnight.  Next day, drain off wine; chop Camembert roughly.  Put into small bowl.  Add softened butter and Tabasco and beat on medium speed until smooth and well blended. Refrigerate 15 to 20 minutes.  Shape cheese into original shape of Camembert.  Roll top and sides in almonds, patting on firmly. Refrigerate until firm.

name: SHRIMP SCAMPI
ingredients:
1  stick of butter
5  cloves crushed garlic
1/4  cup chopped parsley
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  cup dry white wine
1/2  tsp dried mustard
2  lb. raw shrimp
preparation: Melt butter in large sauté pan.  Sauté remaining ingredients, except shrimp.  Add shrimp to mixture and sauté just until the shrimp turn pink.

name: COCONUT CRISPS
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
1/2  c. oleo
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. quick cooking oats
1/2  c. chopped pecans (optional)
1  c. toasted coconut
preparation: Spread coconut in shallow pan and toast in 325° oven for 2 to 3 minutes.  Cream butter; add sugar and mix.  Add egg and beat, then vanilla.  Sift flour, baking powder and salt together and add to butter mixture.  Stir in oats and toasted coconut and pecans. Drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 325° until brown on edges.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. Baker's German's sweet chocolate
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1 2/3  c. (13 oz. can) evaporated milk
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  eggs
1  unbaked (9-inch) pie shell (highly fluted)
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 1/3  c. coconut
preparation: Melt chocolate with butter over low heat until blended or in microwave.  Mix in milk.

name: MICROWAVE PEPPERMINT CANDY
ingredients:
1  lb. almond bark
12  peppermint candy canes
preparation: Chunk up the almond bark into pieces.  Put the pieces into a 2 quart bowl and microwave, stirring occasionally, for about 3 minutes.  Now pound up the candy canes into fine granular state. Mix the fine peppermint into the melted almond bark and spread out on wax paper to cool.  When cool, break into pieces.

name: CHOCOLATE RITZ TREATS
ingredients:
Ritz crackers
peanut butter
chocolate bark
preparation: Spread peanut butter between 2 Ritz crackers.  Dip into melted chocolate bark until well coated.  Lay on wax paper until cool. Chill in refrigerator, if desired, or eat at room temperature.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. 2 oz. cream cheese (room temperature)
3  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. lemon (juice and rind)
3  rolled graham crackers (full size)
1/2  c. sugar
1  pt. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream the cheese. Gradually add eggs, 3/4 cup sugar and lemon juice.  Butter spring-form pan. Coat with graham crackers. Gently pour in cream cheese mixture.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: HAM AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. macaroni or Risotto pasta
1  c. cubed ham
1  c. cubed Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. milk
buttered croutons
preparation: Cook pasta according to directions; drain.  Mix in casserole with rest of ingredients.  Top with croutons.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, until bubbly.

name: SLOW BAKING BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. beef stew meat
1  medium onion
1  stalk celery
6  carrots
2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. instant tapioca
1/2  c. tomato juice or low sodium V-8 vegetable juice
1  pkg. frozen stew vegetables (can use a second pkg. if desired)
preparation: Place 2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/4-inch cubes, in a pan 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inches.  Peel and slice 1 medium onion. Diagonally slice 1 stalk of celery.  Pare 6 carrots and cut into chunks.  Add vegetables to the baking pan.

name: BELGIUM WAFFLES
ingredients:
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3  beaten egg yolks
2  c. half and half or milk
1/2  c. vegetable oil
3  stiffly beaten egg whites
1  tsp. cardamon (optional)
preparation: Sift together dry ingredients.  Combine yolks, milk and oil; stir  into  dry  ingredients.  Fold  in  egg yolks.  Make waffles.

name: EASY HERBED LOAF
ingredients:
1  (16-inch) loaf French bread
1/2  c. lo-fat melted butter
1/4  c. minced green onions
1/4  c. minced parsley
1/8  tsp. thyme
1/8  tsp. marjoram
garlic salt to taste
preparation: Slice the loaf into 1-inch thick slices, cutting to but not through bottom.  Combine butter, green onions, parsley, thyme, marjoram and garlic salt in a small bowl; mix well.  Spread on bread slices.  Wrap in foil.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.  Yields 16 servings.

name: CHEESE AND EGG BISCUIT WICHES
ingredients:
10  oz. can Hungry Jack flaky biscuits
6  eggs
1  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1/8  tsp. pepper (if desired)
1  Tbsp. margarine
2  slices American cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Prepare biscuits according to package directions.  In medium bowl, combine eggs, milk, green pepper and pepper.  Beat well.  In large skillet, melt margarine; stir in egg mixture.  Cook until set but moist, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat.  Cut cheese into 20 triangles.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH SUPREME
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Blend oleo with flour and nuts.  Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

name: COCKTAIL SAUCE FOR SEAFOOD
ingredients:
1/2  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. prepared horseradish
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  tsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. onion juice
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. monosodium glutamate
3  drops Tabasco sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and blend thoroughly.  Chill before serving.  Makes about 3/4 cup.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening or 3/4 c. margarine, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
12  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream the shortening, sugars and vanilla until light and fluffy.  Add eggs one at a time; beat well. Combine flour, soda and salt and add to creamed mixture.  Stir in chocolate chips. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: LAZY PIE
ingredients:
1  can peach pie filling
1  stick butter
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. sweet milk
preparation: Mix sugar, flour and milk.  Pour mixture on top of meringue. Pour in pie filling.  Melt butter in baking dish.  Mix; do not stir.  Makes its own crust.  Bake at 350 for 40 minutes.

name: MOM'S VANILLA WAFER CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  sticks margarine
4  eggs
12  oz. vanilla wafers, crumbled
1/2  c. sweet milk
1  c. pecans
7  oz. coconut
preparation: Mix sugar, eggs and margarine.  Mix crumbled wafers with milk. Combine with other ingredients.  Bake in 325° oven for 1 hour or until done.

name: EASY PEANUT BUTTER CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
4  eggs
3/4  c. water
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1/3  c. creamy peanut butter
1 1/2  c. Hershey's semi-sweet chocolate chips, divided
1/4  c. chopped, unsalted peanuts
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and lightly flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Prepare cake batter according to directions using eggs, water and oil.  Blend in peanut butter.  Spoon half of batter into pan.  Sprinkle 3/4 cup of chocolate chips over batter. Gently spread remaining batter over top.  Sprinkle remaining 3/4 cup chips and peanuts over batter.  Bake 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean; let cool in pan.

name: SPINACH AND ARTICHOKE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans canned artichoke hearts or frozen
3 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach
1/2  lb. cream cheese
4  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. mayo
6  Tbsp. milk
1/3  c. Parmesan or Romano cheese
pepper
preparation: Place artichokes on bottom of casserole pan.  Squeeze moisture from spinach and layer on top of artichokes.  In mixer, blend cream cheese, mayo and butter until fluffy.  Gradually add milk; spread this over top of spinach.  Sprinkle with pepper and cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 40 minutes or until top is lightly browned.  Serves 10.

name: PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. crushed pretzels
1/3  c. sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
20  oz. crushed, drained pineapple
16  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, put first 3 ingredients.  Bake at 400° for 7 minutes; let cool.  Mix together cream cheese, sugar, pineapple and Cool Whip.  After baked pretzels have cooled, add to cream cheese mixture.  Serve immediately (pretzels get soft if not served within an hour or so).

name: BAKED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
thick pork chops
salt and pepper to taste
lemon, sliced
brown sugar
1  c. catsup
1  c. water
preparation: Place pork chops in a baking dish.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Place a slice of lemon on each chop.  Sprinkle brown sugar on chops.  Mix catsup and water; pour around chops until they are just covered.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour, or until well done.

name: FOXY FRANK APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. apricot preserves
1/4  c. tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. cooking sherry
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. honey
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1  lb. frankfurters, cut into bite-size pieces
preparation: Simmer in electric frying  pan	on low for 1 hour or in oven at 275° for 2 hours.

name: BAKED PHEASANT WITH SAUCE
ingredients:
8  oz. Catalina dressing
1  envelope dry onion soup mix
1/2  pt. apricot jam
2  pheasants, cut in pieces
preparation: Mix dressing, soup mix and jam.  Pour over pheasant pieces. Let marinate 2 to 3 hours.  Place in baking pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour, or until tender.

name: DIABETIC DINNER - STUFFED GREEN PEPPERS
ingredients:
6  medium green peppers
1  lb. lean ground beef
onion powder to taste
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  lb. can tomatoes
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. uncooked long grain rice
1 1/2  tsp. chopped parsley
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
sugar substitute to taste (if desired)
preparation: Cut off tops of green peppers; remove seeds and membrane. Precook green pepper shells in boiling salted water about 5 minutes; drain.  Sprinkle inside of shells generously with salt.

name: GARLIC ROSEMARY CHICKEN
ingredients:
whole chicken (leave skin on)
10  cloves of garlic
rosemary
preparation: Wash chicken. Push garlic and rosemary under skin and in cavity. Cook in Brown N Bag  1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours at 375°.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE(Serves 12 to 16)
ingredients:
1  stick melted margarine
2  c. graham crackers, crushed
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Mix and pat into 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: COWBOY STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can chili (with beans)
1  can pork and beans
1  can creamed corn
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
preparation: Brown ground beef.  Drain and put in crock-pot.  Empty all other ingredients.  Stir and mix all together and cook for 3 hours. Serve with crackers.

name: SAUSAGE AND CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
1  tsp. paprika
3  c. Bisquick
1  lb. fresh sausage
8  oz. Cheddar (sharp) cheese
preparation: Leave cheese and sausage out to soften at room temperature for several hours.  Mix cheese and sausage together.  Add paprika. Add Bisquick (1 cup at a time).  Mix well.  Roll in small balls. Cook at 350° for 15 minutes or until brown.  Makes about 125 balls.

name: FROZEN JUICE PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lime juice
4  c. water
1 large  bottle ginger ale
preparation: Mix ingredients just before serving.  Pour over ice or frozen ice ring.  Makes 12 to 15 servings.

name: GUACAMOLE DIP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  small green chili
1/2  tsp. Tabasco sauce
2  large avocados, peeled and cut in 1-inch pieces
1  small onion
2  cloves garlic
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Put all ingredients into blender and process at high speed until smooth.  Serves with corn chips or tostados.  Makes 2 cups.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CANDY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. butter
1  c. peanut butter
2  c. rolled oats
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook sugar, milk, butter and peanut butter over low heat to boiling.  Cook 2 minutes longer.  Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients.  Stir until blended.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.  Let stand until firm, about 1 hour.  Yields 24 servings.

name: VENISON IN BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
2  venison steaks or 6 chops
1  c. chopped onions
1 1/2  c. ketchup
3/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  lb. bacon
preparation: Brown bacon and remove from skillet. Brown venison and onions in bacon grease. Combine ketchup, water, Worcestershire sauce and brown sugar in separate bowl; crumble bacon and add to mixture. Pour over meat. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans French-style green beans, drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. French fried onions (Durkee)
1  can water chestnuts, drained
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole dish.  Reserve a few French fried onions to add later.  Cover dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Pour remaining onions on top.  Leave uncovered. Bake another 5 minutes.  Serve.

name: ZESTY MEATBALLS
ingredients:
3  lb. ground chuck
3  medium onions, finely chopped
1 1/3  c. soft bread crumbs
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. black pepper
1 1/2  tsp. chili powder
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. milk
3/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. cider vinegar
3 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
preparation: Combine first 7 ingredients, mixing well.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Cook meatballs in skillet until lightly browned; drain. Place meatballs in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.

name: FRUIT AND OAT BARS
ingredients:
2  c. Quaker oats, uncooked
1  c. plain flour
3/4  c. margarine or butter, melted
1/3  c. brown sugar (packed)
1/3  c. chopped nuts
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
1 (10 to 12 oz.)  jar favorite fruit preserves
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease 11 x 7-inch glass baking dish. Combine all ingredients, except preserves.  Mix well.  Reserve 3/4 cup oats mixture, press remaining mixture into bottom of prepared dish.  Bake 10 minutes.  Spread preserves evenly over partially baked base to within 1/2-inch edge of pan.  Sprinkle with reserved oats mixture.   Bake 20 to 22 minutes or until golden brown.

name: BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
1  c. bananas, mashed
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. sour milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Cream shortening, add sugar gradually and cream together until light and fluffy.  Add bananas and eggs and beat well.   Mix and sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk and vanilla to sugar mixture.  Add nuts last.  Bake in 2 (9-inch) layer pans which have been greased.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Frost with favorite icing.

name: 5-CUP SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. crushed pineapple
2  c. coconut or more
2  c. miniature marshmallows
2  c. sour cream
2  c. maraschino cherries (may use less)
nuts (if desired)
preparation: Blend well.  Can be served at once or kept in the refrigerator for several days.  Also freezes well.

name: DILLIE BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast, dissolved in 1/4 c. warm water
1  c. cottage cheese, heated to lukewarm
1  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  egg
1  Tbsp. instant minced onion
2 1/4 to 2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
2  tsp. dill seed
preparation: Soften yeast 10 minutes.  Combine in large bowl the cheese, butter, sugar, salt, soda, onion, dill, egg and yeast.  Beat well. Add flour gradually.  Cover; let rise in warm place until double (about 1 hour).  Punch down.  Turn into well-greased loaf pan. Let rise until light, 35 to 40 minutes.  Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: FRIENDSHIP SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime Jell-O
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon Jell-O
2  c. boiling water
1 1/2  c. cottage cheese, creamed
3/4  c. crushed pineapple (do not drain)
1 (16 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in  boiling  water.  Chill  until thick but not set.  Combine  remaining  ingredients.	Add to Jell-O; mix well.  Pour into 9	x 13-inch pan.	Chill until set, about 1 hour.

name: SEVEN LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
shredded lettuce
onions, diced
tomatoes, diced
green peas, frozen and thawed
Miracle Whip
cheese, grated
imitation bacon bits
preparation: Make a layer with each ingredient in a glass bowl.  Start with a layer of lettuce, then onions, tomatoes and green peas.  Spread Miracle Whip over peas; sprinkle the cheese on top of the Miracle Whip and then top with bacon bits.  You can substitute any of the ingredients with other things if you do not like some of these ingredients.  Mushrooms, green pepper or red peppers are also good in this salad.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1  3/4 cups sugar
Dash salt
3  Tbsp. flour
3/4  stick margarine, melted
4  eggs, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
2  1/2 cups milk
3  or 4 bananas
Vanilla Wafers
preparation: Mix sugar, flour and salt, add to melted margarine.  Mix well.  Add egg yolks and beat after each one.  Add milk and vanilla flavoring.  Cook until well thickened.  Make 2 layers of bananas and wafers, beginning with wafers and ending with bananas. Cover each layer with pudding mix.  Beat egg whites until stiff. Add 1/2 cup sugar.  Spread on top of pudding, sealing edges around dish.  Bake until egg whites are brown.

name: PEPPERY VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. Miracle Whip light
2  Tbsp. grated onion
2  tsp. tarragon vinegar
2  tsp. chopped chives
2  tsp. chili sauce
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. ground thyme
preparation: In a small bowl, stir all ingredients; cover and refrigerate. Chill at least 2 hours.  Serve with fresh vegetables such as broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, celery and squash.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
3  large cooking apples, peeled, cored and sliced
1/2  c. orange juice
3/4  c. sugar and flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1/3  c. butter
ice cream (optional)
preparation: Spread apples in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; sprinkle with orange juice.  Mix sugar, flour, cinnamon, salt and butter until crumbly.  Spread over apples.  Bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes or until browned.  Serve warm with ice cream.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CANDY
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. sugar
12  oz. can cream
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. peanut butter
7  oz. jar marshmallow cream
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Mix sugar and cream.  Bring to a boil and boil 15 minutes. Take off stove and add butter, peanut butter, marshmallow cream and vanilla flavoring.  Mix well.  Pour into a buttered dish and refrigerate.

name: LEB KUCHEN(Good Cookies)
ingredients:
1  pt. honey
1  pt. cane molasses or sorghum
2  c. dark brown sugar
1  lb. flour
6  eggs
1  lb. light brown sugar
1/2  lb. chopped pecans
1/2  lb. citron, finely diced
1  Tbsp. ground mace
1  Tbsp. ground cinnamon
2  Tbsp. soda
2  lb. flour
preparation: In saucepan, bring honey, molasses or sorghum and dark brown sugar to boil.  Let cool, then add 1 pound flour.  Combine eggs, light brown sugar, pecans and citron.  Sift together mace, cinnamon, soda and 2 pounds flour.  Mix all together, bringing to bread dough consistency.  Add extra flour as needed.  Put in covered container and let sit at room temperature for 3 days. (Don't peek!)

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. macaroni
1  c. mayo
1  onion, chopped
3  pickles, chopped
1/2  t. salt
1/4  t. pepper
preparation: Cook macaroni until done.  Cool.  Add all the above ingredients and mix well.  Chill and serve.

name: SUMMER SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  c. sliced yellow squash
1  medium onion
1/2  c. margarine, divided
approximately 15 to 16 saltine crackers, crushed and divided (2 squares each)
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
salt and pepper to taste
1 generous  c. sharp cheese, diced
preparation: Cook squash and onion in salted water until tender.  Drain well. Add margarine (reserving 2 tablespoons to dot top).  Mash until smooth.  Add 2/3 of crackers, eggs, milk, sugar, salt and pepper and mix well.  Add cheese.

name: HEATH BAR CAKE
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake mix
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  can Hershey's chocolate syrup
1  large container Cool Whip
4  Heath bars
preparation: Make chocolate cake as directed.  While hot, poke lots of holes in cake.  Mix Eagle Brand milk and Hershey's chocolate syrup; pour over hot cake.  Put in fridge until cool.  Then add Cool Whip. Crush Heath bars and put over top of cake.  Leave in fridge.  The longer it sets, the better it is.

name: BREAKFAST PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  c. milk
3  slices American cheese
1/2  lb. sausage
1  frozen pie shell
salt and pepper
preparation: Brown sausage and set aside.  Bake pie shell until brown. Place cheese slices in bottom of pie shell and cover with sausage. Combine eggs and milk, beating well, and pour over sausage.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Bake 45 minutes in a 325° oven.

name: BREAD AND BUTTER PICKLES
ingredients:
8  c. thinly sliced cucumbers
2  Tbsp. salt
3  c. sugar
2  tsp. turmeric
4  peppers, thinly cut (red and green)
2  c. vinegar
2  c. thinly sliced onion
2  tsp. celery seed
3 inches  stick cinnamon
preparation: Mix cucumbers, onions and salt together.  Let stand for 2 hours.  Drain. Mix remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.  Add drained cucumbers and onions.  Boil for 15 minutes.  Jar and seal.

name: BARBECUE CHUCK ROAST
ingredients:
1  chuck roast (3 to 7 lb.)
2  Tbsp. liquid smoke
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
3  Tbsp. celery salt
1  medium onion, quartered
1/4 to 1/2  c. water
preparation: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, place meat. Pour 2 tablespoons liquid smoke over roast.  Sprinkle with celery salt and garlic powder. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.

name: BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1  pkg. cubed beef
4  or 5 large potatoes
about 3 or 4 c. water
1  pkg. beef stew mix
4 whole carrots or 1  can sliced carrots
preparation: Brown stew meat in electric skillet or in deep pan. After meat is brown on all sides, add the beef stew mix. Stir this in meat until it starts to thicken, about 30 seconds.  Now add the water, enough to cover the meat real good.  Add the peeled potatoes (cut into small cubes) and sliced carrots. Canned carrots may be used. Now make sure you have enough water for the size pot you are using. Bring to a boil and then turn down to simmer.  Let simmer for several hours or until beef is very tender.

name: FRENCH PUFFS
ingredients:
1  egg
1/3  c. soft shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. milk
6  Tbsp. butter, melted
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix first 7 ingredients together; stir in milk.   Put in muffin pan and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Cool a few minutes.  Dip tops and sides of muffin in melted butter, then roll them in sugar and cinnamon mixture.  Makes 12.

name: MEXICAN STUFFED SHELLS
ingredients:
12  pasta stuffing shells, cooked
1  lb. ground beef
1 (12 oz.)  jar picante sauce
1/2  c. water
8  oz. tomato sauce
4  oz. can green chilies, drained
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1  c. Durkee French fried onions
preparation: Brown meat and drain.  Combine picante sauce, water and tomato sauce.  Stir half of cup of combined sauce and green chilies into browned meat and add 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 cup of onions.  Mix well.  Pour 1/2 of remaining sauce on bottom of 10-inch round baking dish.  Stuff cooked shells with meat mixture and arrange in dish.  Pour remaining sauce over shells.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onions.  Bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes longer.  Makes 6 servings.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
5  to 6 apples
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  unbeaten egg
1/3  c. melted butter
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Slice apples into buttered baking dish.  Mix with fork until crumbly all remaining ingredients.  Spread over apples.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.  Serve sprinkled with powdered sugar. Optional, but great topped with vanilla ice cream.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs, slightly beaten
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk or 1 2/3 c. half and half
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell with high fluted edge
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Mix filling ingredients in order given. Pour into pie shell.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.  Reduce temperature to 350° and continue baking for 45 minutes or until knife inserted near center of pie filling comes out clean.

name: HOT DOGS ON A STICK
ingredients:
oil or shortening (for deep frying)
1  c. bottled barbecue sauce
1  c. packaged pancake mix
2  Tbsp. cornmeal
1  Tbsp. sugar
8  frankfurters
preparation: Slowly heat oil at least one-inch deep to 375°.  In small saucepan, gently heat barbecue sauce.  Combine pancake mix, cornmeal, sugar and 2/3 cup water.  Beat with rotary beater just until smooth.  Let batter stand for about 10 minutes to thicken. Dip frank into batter to coat all over lightly.  In hot oil, fry franks a few at a time for two to three minutes, or until crisp and golden brown.  Lift out with a slotted spoon and drain well on paper towels.  Insert wooden skewer into one end of each frank. Serve at once with barbecue sauce for dipping.

name: PITA PIZZA
ingredients:
1  whole wheat pita bread
2  Tbsp. low-salt spaghetti sauce
2  Tbsp. finely chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. finely chopped mushrooms
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  black olives
2  Tbsp. nonfat Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Spread sauce on one side of the unsliced pita bread.  Sprinkle green pepper, mushrooms, onion and black olives over sauce.  Sprinkle cheese over vegetables.  Place on ungreased pizza pan or cookie sheet.  Bake 5 to 10 minutes or until done.

name: APRICOT BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. dried apricots, chopped
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can flaked coconut
1/2  c. coarsely chopped nuts
preparation: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Spread crumbs and apricots in dish.  Pour condensed milk over all.  Top with coconut and nuts, pressing gently.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

name: ACORN SQUASH DELIGHT
ingredients:
2  acorn squash
1/4  c. butter
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. sugar
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
3/4  c. water
preparation: Cut squash in half; remove seeds.  Put 1 tablespoon butter,  1 teaspoon sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon in each squash half. Place squash, cut side up, in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Pour water into dish and cover.  Bake at 400° for about 45 minutes or until squash is tender.  Serves 4.

name: COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
3  c. self-rising flour
1  egg
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add flour and egg.  Shape into rolls and chill.  Slice and bake at 400° until brown.  Nuts, chocolate chips or coconut may be added for variations.

name: GREEN BEAN BUNDLES
ingredients:
3  cans whole green beans
1  cup melted butter
1  cup brown sugar
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. soy sauce
1  pkg. bacon, cut in half
preparation: Heat butter, brown sugar, garlic salt and soy sauce in sauce pan until melted.  Wrap 10 beans in 1/2 slice bacon and secure with a toothpick.  Place in casserole and pour mixture over beans. Let refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BUTTERMILK FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  sticks butter
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. buttermilk
2  Tbsp. white corn syrup
1  c. nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix in a 6-quart saucepan.  Cook until soft ball stage on a candy thermometer. Cool until just warm.  Beat well.  Add nuts and vanilla. Pour into buttered pan.  Cut when firm.

name: EASY PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. peanut butter
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix and roll into balls.  Place on a greased cookie sheet. Dip a glass into a bowl of sugar (bottom of glass) and smash cookie. Do each cookie this way, then go back and crisscross them with a fork.  Bake at 350° for about 10 minutes.

name: CREAMY CORN
ingredients:
3  oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. oleo
1/2  tsp. onion salt
2 (16 oz.)  cans whole kernel corn, drained
preparation: Combine cream cheese, butter, milk and onion salt in a small saucepan; cook over low heat, stirring often, until cheese melts. Stir in corn; cook, stirring constantly, until thoroughly  heated. Yields 8 servings.

name: BREAKFAST PIZZA
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1 small  pkg. Cheddar cheese
1  egg
1  c. hash browns
1  lb. sausage
1  can crescent rolls
bacon (optional)
preparation: Roll crescent rolls in a pan.  Brown and drain sausage. Spread sausage over rolls.  Add hash browns and cheese.  Stir egg in milk; pour over mixture.  Bake at 425° about 20 minutes, until rolls are brown.

name: BETTY'S HAWAIIAN RIBS
ingredients:
4  lb. spareribs, cut into 1 1/2-inch strips
3/4  c. cornstarch
1/4  c. molasses
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
3/4  c. water
3/4  c. pineapple juice
1  can pineapple chunks
2  green peppers, cut into 1-inch cubes
preparation: Brown ribs in heavy frypan or Dutch oven.  Combine cornstarch, molasses and soy sauce to make paste. Spread paste on both sides of ribs. Re-brown quickly in hot fat.  Combine sugar, vinegar, water and pineapple juice. Heat until sugar dissolves.  Pour over ribs.  Cover and cook 25 to 30 minutes. Add pinapple chunks and green pepper cubes.  Re-cover. Simmer 5 minutes longer.  Makes 8 servings.

name: MARBLE CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  lb. butter
1/4  lb. margarine (Fleischmann's unsalted), softened
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs, separated
3  c. cake flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  c. Hershey's chocolate syrup
preparation: Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour or until cake comes out dry when tested by straw.  Mix butter, margarine, sugar and egg yolks together until smooth.  Sift cake flour and baking powder together and alternate milk and flour.  Beat egg whites until firm and fold into batter.  Measure chocolate syrup and then take half of batter and pour in syrup.  Then put white batter and chocolate, alternating until finished.  Take spatula and mix to form marble. Bake in 10-inch angel like form.  Butter form.

name: STRAWBERRY FLUFF
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1 large  box strawberry jello
1 large  box vanilla pudding
2  pkg. frozen strawberries
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Crumble angel food cake in bottom of pan.  Dissolve strawberry jello with 1 cup of boiling water and 1 cup of cold water.  Add strawberries.  Pour over crumbled cake.  Let chill.  Make vanilla pudding and pour over cake mixture.  Frost with Cool Whip.

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
round steak
4  medium onions
6  Tbsp. shortening
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped carrots
1  clove garlic, minced
3/4  c. stewed tomatoes
3/4  c. water
1  green pepper
1  yellow pepper
preparation: Combine flour, salt and pepper; run into both sides of steak. Preheat skillet; add half of shortening, then add onions (sliced). Brown lightly and remove from skillet.  Add remaining shortening. Brown steak on both sides.  Reduce heat, add carrots, celery, garlic, tomatoes and water.  Cover, simmer 1 hour.  Cut pepper into slices.  Add onions and pepper to meat.  Cook 30 minutes.

name: WEDDING PUNCH
ingredients:
1/2  gal. Kool-Aid
1 large  can unsweetened pineapple juice
1  qt. ginger ale
sherbet ice cream
preparation: Mix Kool-Aid, juice and ginger ale together.  Add large spoonfuls of sherbet to liquid.

name: CHICKEN SUPREME
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2  cups chopped onions
2  cups chopped celery
1 8  oz. pkg. Pepperidge Farm Stuffing Mix w/herbs
3  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. cooking sherry
1/3  c. chicken broth
1 8  oz. can sliced water chestnuts
3  Tbsp. parmesan cheese
7  c. cooked, diced chicken (8 breasts)
preparation: Saute celery and onions in margarine.  Add stuffing mix, reserving 5 Tbsp.  Add balance of ingredients.  Mix and place in 3 qt. casserole or 9x13-inch baking pan.  Add parmesan cheese to reserved 5 Tbsp. stuffing (add paprika liberally if desired). Sprinkle over top of casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: MUSHROOM PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. mushrooms
1/4  c. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour (scant)
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1  egg
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Saute onions in butter.  Add mushrooms; cook 8 minutes or until juicy.  Add flour and cheese.

name: ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. lukewarm water
1  pkg. yeast
1  tsp. sugar
1/4  c. shortening
2 rounded  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. milk
flour as needed (usually 4 to 6 c.)
preparation: Combine yeast and teaspoon of sugar in a cup.  Add warm water. Stir until dissolved.  Set aside.  Put shortening in a large plastic bowl that will fit in microwave.  Microwave for approximately 1 minute to melt shortening.  Add salt and sugar. Microwave milk 1 to 2 minutes and add to shortening mixture.  Stir in yeast mixture.  Begin stirring in flour, 1 to 2 cups at the time. Continue until dough is no longer sticky but is still soft. Cover bowl and refrigerate overnight or until needed.

name: CHICKEN FRICASSEE
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. stewing chicken or fryer, cut into serving pieces
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. paprika
2  medium onions, sliced
2  stalks celery, sliced
2  carrots, pared and sliced
1  bay leaf
1  c. chicken broth
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. water
1  pkg. noodles, cooked and drained
chopped parsley
preparation: Rinse chicken pieces and pat dry.  Season with salt and paprika.  Place sliced vegetables and bay leaf in crock-pot. Place chicken pieces on top of vegetables.  Pour in chicken broth. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 12 hours.

name: CHEESE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. medium cream sauce
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
dry mustard to taste
preparation: To increase sauce, add 1 c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese, grated.

name: LIME GELATIN SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. lime gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1 (15 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. lemon-lime soda
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 (8 oz.)  carton frozen whipped topping, thawed and divided
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in water.  In a  mixing bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy.  Stir in gelatin mixture and beat until smooth.  Stir in vanilla, oranges, pineapple, soda and pecans. Chill until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from a spoon. Fold in three-fourths of the whipped topping.  Pour into a 13 x 9-inch dish.  Refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours or until firm.  Cut into squares; garnish with remaining whipped topping.  Yields 16 to 20 servings.

name: BEEF JERKY
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. flank steak
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/3  tsp. garlic
1/3  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. onion powder
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. soy sauce
preparation: Trim fat from steak.  Semi-freeze for ease in slicing.  Slice with the grain into 1/8-inch strips.  Marinate overnight in glass dish, thoroughly covering the meat with sauce made from other ingredients.  Lay strips of marinated meat in single layer on oven racks.  Placing a cookie sheet underneath will catch drippings. With oven door opened a crack, roast at lowest possible temperature (125° to 140°) for 8 to 12 hours.  Taste occasionally until desired chewiness is attained.  Keep in covered jar.  Yields 1/2 pound of jerky.

name: OREO CAKE
ingredients:
22  Oreo cookies
1/4  c. butter, melted
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
4  oz. bar german chocolate
5  oz. evaporated milk
1/2  c. butter
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
Cool Whip
preparation: Scrape filling from cookies. Mix cookies with butter in 9 x 13 pan. Cover cookies with ice cream.

name: YELLOW CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. margarine or shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  pinch salt
2  eggs
preparation: Mix flour, baking  powder  and	salt;  set  aside.  Add sugar slowly to shortening, beating well.  Beat in egg smooth, then add other egg  and beat well.  Add half the flour, mixing half of the milk and  the  vanilla, then add rest of the flour and milk.  Mix well.  Bake  at 375° for 25 to 35 minutes until cake springs back when lightly touched near center.

name: DOUBLE CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's condensed cream of celery soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's condensed New England clam chowder
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can clams, undrained
1 soup  can milk
1 soup  can water
chopped fresh parsley for garnish
preparation: In a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, combine all ingredients except parsley.  Heat through, stirring occasionally. Do not boil.  Garnish with parsley.  Makes about 5 1/2 cups or 5 servings.

name: MAPLE MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. maple syrup
1/3  c. melted butter or margarine
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1 (11 oz.)  pkg. refrigerated bread sticks
4  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine syrup and melted butter in a saucepan and mix well.  Heat until bubbly.  Add nuts to this mixture.  Separate breadsticks by slicing rolled dough in half. Combine the sugar and cinnamon.  Generously grease a tube pan or a bread pan.  Pour a small amount of syrup mixture into bottom of pan (enough to cover bottom).  Dip pieces of dough into remaining syrup mixture, coating well, then roll in the cinnamon sugar and place in the tube pan.  Pour remaining syrup mixture on top of dough.  Bake about 35 minutes or until dough is light brown, covering with foil for the last 10 minutes to prevent overbrowning.  Let stand 1 minute only.  Invert onto a serving platter.  Serve warm.

name: MARINATED CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
pinch of curry powder
1  chicken bouillon cube
1/2  c. hot water
2  Tbsp. sherry
3  Tbsp. honey
1  Tbsp. butter
pinch of dry mustard
1/2  clove garlic, minced
preparation: Mix all ingredients in large bowl.  Add chicken wings; marinate at least 24 hours.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1  can garbanzo beans
4  medium potatoes, diced
1/2  green pepper, diced
1/2  small cabbage, shredded
1  roll pepperoni, sliced and quartered
2  c. diced ham
1/4  tsp. saffron or turmeric
3  diced garlic cloves
3  bay leaves
salt
pepper
preparation: Put potatoes in large pot with enough water to cover.  Cook until almost done.  In meantime, cut up all other ingredients. Add rest and simmer for about 20 minutes.  Don't drain potatoes; may need to add water.  This is great for crock-pot.  Just put all ingredients in crock-pot with water to cover well.  Cook on low all day.

name: RICH LEMON PIE
ingredients:
2  pie shells
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  can evaporated milk
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. lemon juice
preparation: Chill evaporated milk, then whip.  Add Eagle Brand milk and sugar.  Add lemon juice.  Pour into baked pie shells or graham cracker crusts.  Makes 2 pies.

name: UNCLE LOUIE'S MEXICAN RICE
ingredients:
1/2  c. cooking oil
1  c. long grain rice
5  cloves garlic, crushed
1  medium onion, minced
1/2  green pepper, minced
2 large  cans tomatoes
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. cilantro, chopped
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1/8  tsp. cumin
water (hot)
salt and pepper to taste
1  lb. cooked, crumbled ground meat, drained (optional)
preparation: In a large skillet, saute rice in hot oil, stirring constantly.  As rice turns gold, lower heat; add onion, garlic, chili powder, cumin and green pepper.  Saute until onion is glazed.  Add tomatoes, sauce, cilantro, salt and pepper, then add hot water to rice slowly, covering over the top 1/2-inch.  Bring to a boil; turn down heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes.  Add more hot water during cooking if needed.  If you choose to add meat, add during simmer stage.

name: EASY CHERRY CRISP
ingredients:
21  oz. can cherry pie filling
2  Tbsp. oleo
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. light brown sugar
1/4  c. flour
1/4  c. uncooked oats
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Pour pie filling into an 8-inch square pan.  In small bowl, combine flour and oleo (use fingers to cut in oleo).  Add oats, brown sugar and spices and mix well.  Sprinkle mix over cherries and bake at 350° for 35 minutes until hot and bubbly.  Serve plain or with ice cream or Cool Whip.

name: PILAF
ingredients:
2  c. Uncle Ben's converted rice
4  c. water
1  pkg. Lipton noodle soup (chicken, dry mix)
1  bouillon cube
1 1/4  c. margarine
preparation: Brown rice and vermicelli (from soup) in margarine until golden brown.  Add bouillon cube and seasoning from soup to water; bring to boil with browned rice.  Simmer and let steam until dry, about 45 minutes.  Use Uncle Ben's converted rice as it doesn't get sticky and gummy.  Serves 10.

name: GREEN PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1  can LeSueur peas
6  oz. sharp cheese, grated
1  small onion, minced
2  hard-boiled eggs, chopped fine
mayonnaise
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Add enough mayonnaise to combine ingredients.  Chill overnight before serving.

name: HOSPITALITY PIE
ingredients:
3  graham cracker crusts
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  (16 oz.) Cool Whip
1  stick margarine
2  c. coconut
1  c. almond slices
1  jar butterscotch topping
preparation: Toast coconut and almonds in melted margarine until brown (325°, about 10 minutes); cool.  Combine cream cheese and Eagle Brand milk and fold in Cool Whip.  Using 1/2 of the cream cheese mixture, divide equally between the 3 crusts.  Top with 1/2 of the coconut/almonds.  Drizzle 1/2 butterscotch topping over the 3 crusts.  Repeat for second layer.  Freeze.  Makes 3 delicious pies!

name: CHEESECAKE, NEW YORK STYLE
ingredients:
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. melted butter
1 1/2  c. sour cream
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1  lb. cream cheese, broken into small pieces
preparation: Blend the cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and the 1/4 cup of melted butter and line the bottom of an 8-inch or 9-inch ungreased spring-form pan. Blend the sour cream, 1/2 cup of sugar, the eggs and vanilla in a food blender for 1 minute.  Add cream cheese. Blend until smooth.  Pour the remaining 2 tablespoons of melted butter through the top of the blender. Pour into spring-form pan. Bake in the lower third of a 325° oven for 45 minutes.  When baking is finished, remove the cake from the oven and turn the oven to broil.  Broil the cheesecake just until the top begins to show attractive spots of brown.  Refrigerate for 4 hours or preferably overnight before cutting and serving.  Cut in small pieces, this is very rich.

name: MARINATED VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can green peas, drained
1 (No. 2)  can green beans, drained
1 (No. 2)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  c. diced celery
1/2  c. diced green pepper (optional)
1/2  c. pimentos, drained and diced
1  large onion, chopped
3/4  c. sugar
2/3  c. white vinegar
1/2  c. vegetable or canola oil
2/3  c. water
1/2  tsp. paprika
salt to taste
preparation: Refrigerate while veggies are marinating. The flavor improves the longer the vegetables are kept. The dish can be added to without losing its flavor.

name: FETTUCINI PAGLIA EN FIENO
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  box fettucini
1 (12 oz.)  box spinach fettucini
1 small  pkg. frozen peas
2  pt. heavy cream
2  egg yolks, beaten
3/4  lb. Italian Prosciutto, sliced thin
1/2  lb. bacon, sliced
dash of salt and white pepper for seasoning
preparation: Boil fettucini	(all  together)  according  to	package directions.  Cook peas  according  to package directions.  Set aside, keeping warm.  While  fettucini  cooks,  cut  bacon and Prosciutto and fry until  bacon  is  almost  crisp.  Drain	to remove as much grease  as  possible;  return  to saucepan.	In bowl, blend beaten egg yolks  and cream well.  Add to meats in saucepan and warm gently.  Add  cooked peas.  Season to taste. Place fettucini in large  pasta  bowl;  pour sauce over.  Toss just a little.  Serve hot with grated cheese.  Serves approximately 6.

name: CARAMEL APPLE DIP
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
