1  pkg. (14 oz.) caramels
preparation: Put in microwave container and melt in microwave until caramels are melted.  Stir well. Cut up apples and dip and eat.

name: CHOCOLATE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. chopped nuts
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Mix together first 5 ingredients.  Spread this mixture evenly over batter; pour boiling water over all.  Do not stir.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Cover dish with foil during the last half hour. Serve with whipped cream.

name: MICRO FUDGE
ingredients:
4 3/4  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. butter, chunked
1/4  c. + 1 tsp. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. mini marshmallows
preparation: Put all ingredients in large microwave-safe bowl.  Cook on High 2 minutes.  Mix well and pour into wax paper lined loaf pan and cool in refrigerator.

name: BEIJING CHICKEN
ingredients:
3  lb. frying chicken pieces
1/2  c. teriyaki sauce
1  Tbsp. dry sherry
2  tsp. minced fresh ginger root
1/2  tsp. fennel seed, crushed
1/2  tsp. grated orange peel
1/2  tsp. honey
preparation: Rinse chicken pieces and pat dry with paper towels.  Place in large, plastic bag.  Combine teriyaki sauce, sherry, ginger, fennel, orange peel and honey; pour over chicken.  Press air out of bag.  Tie top securely.  Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight, turning bag occasionally.

name: PANCAKE SYRUP
ingredients:
1  c. hot water
1  lb. sugar
1/2  tsp. maple flavoring
preparation: In 2 quart glass  casserole  boil  water  (about  2 1/2 minutes).  Add brown sugar and heat 2 to 3 minutes until sugar is dissolved,  stirring  frequently as mixture boils.  Stir in flavoring.  Makes 2 cups.

name: FRENCH CREPES
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
2  large eggs
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. melted butter
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix flour and salt in large bowl.  Make a well in center and add eggs, melted butter and half of milk.  With a whisk or wooden spoon, gradually stir the flour into the liquid mixture.  While stirring, gradually add more liquid until consistency is that of cream.  When all liquid is added, beat or whisk to remove all lumps.  Pour 1/4 cup of crepe batter into preheated pan.  Cook both sides on low heat until lightly browned.  Makes 6 to 8 crepes. Fill with fruit, ice cream, or scrambled eggs.  Fold and enjoy.

name: RECIPE FOR LOVE
ingredients:
2  c. friendship
2  c. love
2  c. kindness
1  c. cheer
1  c. goodness
preparation: Mix well and serve with smiles and laughter daily.

name: CHOCOLATE MOUSSE(Makes 8 Servings)
ingredients:
4  (4 oz.) bars Hershey's unsweetened baking chocolate, broken into pieces
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
2  tsp. vanilla extract
2  c. (1 pt.) cold whipping cream
preparation: In heavy saucepan over medium-low heat, melt chocolate with sweetened condensed milk.  Stir in vanilla.  Pour into large bowl; cool to room temperature about 1 1/2 hours.  Beat until smooth. In large mixer bowl, beat cream until stiff; fold into chocolate mixture.  Spoon mousse into dessert dishes.  Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  eggs, beaten slightly
6  slices bread crumbs, cubed
1  lb. sausage, cooked
2  c. milk
1  c. Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour into greased 9 x 13 pan. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until set and brown.

name: BITE SIZE CRAB CAKES
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) container fresh lump crab meat
1  small red or green pepper
1  small celery stalk
1  small onion
2  eggs
1/4  c. dried bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. hot pepper sauce
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1/2  lemon
preparation: Pick over crab meat to remove any pieces of shell.  Mince red or green pepper and celery; place in medium bowl with crab meat. Grate onion; add to crab meat.  Add eggs, bread crumbs, mustard, Worcestershire, mayonnaise and hot pepper sauce; mix well.  Shape crab mixture into oval patties using approximately 2 teaspoons of mixture for each patty.  Place patties on large platter, cover and refrigerate.  About 20 minutes prior to serving, in 12-inch skillet over medium heat, add butter and cooking oil.  Cook 1/3 of crab cakes until brown on both sides, drain and keep warm until all crab cakes are cooked.  Serve with your favorite seafood cocktail or tartar sauce.

name: APRICOT LOAF
ingredients:
1  c. dried apricots
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  egg, well beaten
1/4  c. water
1/2  c. orange juice
1/2  c. walnuts
preparation: Soak dried apricots in warm water for 15 minutes.   Drain water and cut apricots into pieces.  Set aside.   Cream in shortening and sugar together.   Add eggs; blend well.  Add sifted flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt alternately with water and orange juice.  Fold in apricots and nuts.  Pour batter in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.   Push batter into corners of pan, leaving center slightly hollow.  Let stand for 20 minutes before baking.  Bake at 375° for 60 to 65 minutes.

name: COOL AND CREAMY FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. grated lemon rind
1/2  c. whipping cream
1/4  c. powdered sugar
2  c. peaches, sliced
2  c. blueberries
2  c. strawberry slices
2  c. grapes
2  Tbsp. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine cream cheese, juice and rind, mixing until well blended.  Beat whipping cream until soft peaks form; gradually add sugar, beating until stiff peaks form.  Fold into cream cheese mixture.  Chill.  Layer fruit in a 2 1/2-quart bowl.  Spoon cream cheese mixture over fruit; sprinkle with nuts. Chill.  Makes 8 servings.

name: CHINESE BEEF
ingredients:
2  c. chopped onions
1  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 medium  can mushrooms
1/3  c. rice (uncooked)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  can bean sprouts
1  can water
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Brown onions and celery in small amount of oil; set aside. Brown beef and rice until "grey."  Add onions and celery; mix in soup and water.  Add soy sauce, mushrooms and pepper; mix well. Toss in bean sprouts.  Pour into casserole.  Cook for 30 minutes at 350°, then cook for 30 minutes, uncovered.  Can be made ahead and frozen.  Serves 6 to 8 people.

name: INSTANT CAPPUCCINO
ingredients:
1  c. instant coffee creamer
1  c. instant chocolate drink mix
2/3  c. instant coffee
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
preparation: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Store in airtight container.  When ready to use mix 2 tablespoons per coffee cup of hot water.  Top with whipped cream, sprinkle with nutmeg or chocolate shavings.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  stick butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. milk
1 medium  can crushed pineapple
1  large container Cool Whip topping
4  bananas
1/2  c. nuts
cherries
preparation: Melt butter in Pyrex dish (flat glass dish).  Add crumbs.  Mix cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and milk together; pour over crumbs. Slice bananas over cream cheese mixture, then add pineapple (using juice).  Top with nuts and cherries.  Store in refrigerator.

name: BEST BEAN DIP EVER
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can refried beans
4  oz. softened cream cheese
12  oz. sour cream
1  bunch green onions, fine chopped
1/2 (12 oz.)  can Ortega salsa
1  (1 1/4 oz.) packet taco seasoning
1/2 (4 oz.)  can diced green chili peppers
1  c. grated Longhorn or Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine all ingredients except cheese in a baking dish. Sprinkle with grated cheese.  Bake one hour at 300°.

name: CHUNKY CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  (3 lb.) broiler-fryer, skinned or 2 1/2 lbs. chicken pieces
6  c. water
3  fresh celery leaves
1/4  tsp. dried thyme
1/3  c. sliced green onions
1/2  c. sliced celery
1/2  c. sliced carrots
2  Tbsp. minced fresh parsley
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. coarsely ground pepper
1  tsp. chicken bouillon granules or 1 chicken bouillon cube
1  c. uncooked fine egg noodles
1  bay leaf
preparation: Combine first four ingredients in a Dutch oven; bring to a boil.  Cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 45 minutes.  Remove chicken from broth, and cool.  Strain broth; discard celery leaves and solidified fat.  Return broth to Dutch oven; add green onions and next 8 ingredients.  Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.  Bone and chop chicken; add to broth.  Cook 5 more minutes.  Discard bay leaf.  Sprinkle soup with pepper, if desired.  Yield 7 cups.

name: BEEF ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  c. zucchini
1  c. chopped onion
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, chopped
1 1/2  c. (6 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  c. cooked elbow macaroni
2  Tbsp. imitation bacon bits
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Saute ground beef with zucchini and onion in Dutch oven until beef is browned. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Uncover and cook 5 minutes longer or until vegetables are tender.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. buttermilk*
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
2  c. Wesson oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1  oz. bottle red food coloring
preparation: *Add 1 tablespoon vinegar to milk and let stand 1 minute.

name: SPECIAL ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. orange pineapple jello
1/2  c. boiling water
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  bag mini marshmallows
1  c. shredded carrots
1 large  can pineapple, drained
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
preparation: Add jello to boiling water.  Mix on low speed the cream cheese.  Add marshmallows, carrots and pineapple.  Let set until it starts to get firm, then whip in Cool Whip.

name: MOIST CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2/3  c. cooking oil
2  c. cold water
2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. vinegar
preparation: In a bowl, mix flour, sugar, cocoa, soda and salt; add cooking oil, cold water, vanilla and vinegar.  Mix by hand (not with a mixer).  Do not beat too hard to have a good cake.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch loaf pan at 325° for 45 minutes, or until it starts drawing away from the edge of pan.  Serve with your favorite icing.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  stick oleo
8  marshmallows (big)
6  qt. popped popcorn
preparation: Pop popcorn while melting other ingredients, stirring until marshmallows are melted.  Pour over popcorn and stir well, then eat!  Delicious!

name: LEMON LIME PUNCH
ingredients:
3  pkg. lemon lime Kool-Aid
juice of 3 lemons
1 1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix together with enough water to make 1 quart.

name: DATE STICKS
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  c. nut meats, broken
2  c. dates, pitted and finely cut
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, well beaten
1  Tbsp. hot water
preparation: Sift flour once; add baking powder and salt gradually to eggs; add butter.  Beat in dates and nuts.  Add flour alternately with hot water, beating well.  Divide mixture into two greased pans, 8 x 8 x 2-inches, spreading batter thin.  Bake in slow oven, 325°, for 30 to 35 minutes.  Cool; cut in strips, 2 3/4 x 1-inch. Remove from pans and roll in powdered sugar.  Makes about 48.

name: GLAZED CORNED BEEF
ingredients:
3  lb. corned beef
1  garlic clove
1  bay leaf
4  peppercorns
1/4  c. apple juice
1/3  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Cover beef with water.  Add garlic, bay leaf and peppercorns. Cover.  Bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 3 hours until tender.  Remove.

name: PUMPKIN BUNDT CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. cooking oil
2  c. flour
2  c. pumpkin (one 16 oz. can)
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Beat together all ingredients, mixing well.  Pour into lightly greased (spray with vegetable oil spray) Bundt pan.   Place, uncovered, in microwave.  Cook 10 minutes on 50% power or cook 10 minutes on 100% power.  Let stand 10 minutes before inverting on serving platter.  Can frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

name: ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  white cake mix
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1 large or 2 small  pkg. orange Jell-O mix
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Bake and cool cake in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix Jell-O with 2 1/2 cups hot tap water.  Poke holes in top of cake with large fork and pour Jell-O over it.  Mix the Cool Whip, pudding and milk.  Spread over top of cake. Cool in refrigerator.

name: CHAMPIONSHIP CHILI
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  pkg. chili mix
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. red pepper
1  large onion, finely chopped
3  tsp. green chilies
1 small  clove garlic, minced
1  large rib celery, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can pinto beans
1  lb. beef stew chunks
1 (14 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
3  Tbsp. chili powder
1  bay leaf
1 1/4  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans
preparation: Brown stew meat and  ground  beef; drain.  Mix the rest of the ingredients, except beans,	and  add to ground beef and beef chunks.  Cut tomatoes very	fine.  Simmer  for 1 hour and then add beans; simmer for  2  or  more hours, (the longer the better). Remove the bay leaf before serving.

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA
ingredients:
2  pkg. crescent dinner rolls
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
4  (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1  pkg. Ranch dressing
chopped fresh veggies (carrots, green pepper, cauliflower, broccoli, etc.)
preparation: Press rolls  into  jello  roll	pan.  Bake for 10 to 13 minutes at	325°.  Spread  cream cheese mixture over dough and sprinkle veggies and cheese on top.  Cut into squares.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
1  c. sliced mushrooms
1/4  c. Parkay margarine
1  c. sliced celery
1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. Kraft barbecue sauce
2  c. tomatoes (1 lb. can)
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  lb. cooked shrimp
preparation: Saute mushrooms in butter; remove from pan and set aside.  Add celery to remaining butter; stir until crisp and tender.  Blend in flour, gradually.  Add barbecue sauce and mix well.  Add tomatoes, onions and salt.  Mix well until thick.  Cover and simmer fifteen minutes.  Add shrimp and mushrooms.  Cook ten more minutes.  Serve over rice.

name: PINK SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (9 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges
2  c. canned instant cherry pie filling
1/2  c. nuts
1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Whip milk and Cool Whip.  Add other ingredients and mix well.

name: CANDY CANE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix
1/4  c. oil
3  egg whites
1/2  tsp. red food coloring
1/2  tsp. peppermint extract
1  c. vanilla frosting
crushed candy canes
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour 12-cup Bundt pan.  Beat cake mix, oil, water and egg whites on low speed until moistened. Beat at medium speed, scraping bowl often for 20 minutes.  Pour approximately 2 cups batter into pan.  Pour approximately 3/4 cup batter into small bowl.  Stir in food coloring and extract. Carefully pour red batter over white batter in pan.  Carefully pour remaining white over red.  Bake until cake pulls away from sides of pan, 40 to 50 minutes.  Cool 10 minutes.  Invert on serving plate.  Cool completely.

name: CREAMED SPINACH
ingredients:
1  c. well drained, cooked and chopped spinach
1/4  c. canned milk
1  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. margarine
1/4  tsp. salt and pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients in small saucepan.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture becomes thick.  Serves 2.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. sweet milk, plus 2 Tbsp.
preparation: Mix well and roll out thin.  Cut in strips.  Have chicken boiling.  Drop in a few at a time until you have all of them. Boil gradually and then turn down on low and cover.

name: SPAGHETTI WITH RED CLAM SAUCE
ingredients:
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1  small onion, minced
1/3  c. olive oil
2 (6 1/2 oz.)  cans minced clams
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  c. dry red wine
1  tsp. basil leaves, crushed
1/2  tsp. oregano leaves, crushed
1/3  c. fresh parsley, chopped
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti, vermicelli or linguine, cooked and drained
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Saute garlic and onion in olive oil until wilted.  Add juice from clams, tomato sauce, wine, basil and oregano.  Simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes.  Add clams and cook 1 minute longer. Stir in parsley.  Toss sauce with hot pasta and serve with Parmesan cheese.  Yield:  4 to 6 servings.

name: CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
3  lb. hamburger
1  lb. bacon
1  c. onion
1  c. catsup
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
3  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. mustard
3  Tbsp. liquid smoke
1  can pinto beans
1  can lima beans
1  can butter beans
1  can kidney beans
1  can red beans
1  can chili beans
any other beans you want to add
preparation: Cook hamburger, bacon and onion; drain.  Combine remaining ingredients and cook for 1/2 hour.  Serve and enjoy!

name: NEW ENGLAND PUMPKIN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. pumpkin puree
1  c. thick white sauce
1 1/3  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
2  c. diced ham
2  hard-boiled eggs, sliced
1/2  c. broken soda crackers
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Mix pumpkin, white sauce, ham and 1 cup cheese.  Place half of mixture in 2-quart casserole.  Cover with sliced eggs.  Cover with remaining mixture.  Sprinkle with coarsely crumbled crackers, remaining cheese and dot with margarine.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN PICADO
ingredients:
2  green peppers
1  green onion, sliced
2  Tbsp. oil
4  chicken breasts, cut into strips
4 to 6  cloves garlic
1  c. Monterey jack cheese
3 to 4  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Brown chicken slices in ovenproof pan.  Remove with slotted spoon.  Saute green peppers over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes.  Add chicken back, cook until just done, remove from heat.  Preheat broiler to high.  Top chicken mixture with butter, garlic and cheese.  Place under broiler 6 to 7 minutes, until well browned. Garnish with sliced green onion.  Serve with warm tortillas and Spanish rice.  Serves 4.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
1 heaping  Tbsp. flour
1  lb. shrimp (precooked)
1  clove garlic
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. thyme
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2 to 1 small  can tomato sauce
1/2 to 1  c. water or dry white wine
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1/2  to 1 onion
1/2  lemon
1/4  tsp. thyme
preparation: Make a roux by mixing the flour in with the hot oil in a frying pan until browned. Add onion, chopped and garlic.  Stir until soft. Add water and simmer until thick (like gravy).  Add tomato sauce and spices with salt and pepper to taste.  Stir in shrimp and heat thoroughly.  Serve over white rice.  Serves 4.

name: EASY FALL RATATOUILLE RECIPE
ingredients:
Cut 1 each, medium eggplant, onion, red pepper and zucchini into chunks
1/4  c. Kraft Special Collections Sun-Dried Tomato Dressing
1  can (16 oz.) undrained low-sodium diced tomatoes
2  Tbsp. reduced fat Parmesan cheese, shredded
1/2  c. reduced fat Mozzarella cheese, shredded
preparation: Sauté vegetables in sun-dried tomato dressing in large ovenproof skillet until tender.  Add diced tomatoes, cook about 15 minutes, allowing some of the liquid to evaporate.  Top with cheeses and bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked chicken
4  hard-boiled eggs
2  c. cooked rice
1/2  c. gravy
1 1/2  c. celery, cut fine
1  small onion, cut fine
1  c. mayonnaise
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. slivered almonds (3 oz.)
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix well and put in buttered 3-quart baking dish. (May be frozen at this time.) Cube 4 slices of day old bread. Toss lightly with melted butter and put on top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: HOT CHERRY PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. Bisquick
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. milk
1  can cherries, drain cherries from can
1 1/4  c. cherry juice and water, mixed
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  To Bisquick add sugar and the drained cherries.  Stir in milk to make a stiff dough.  Spread in greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch pan or 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.  Heat the juice from the cherries with water added to make 1 1/4 cups and the remaining cup of sugar.  Also add 1/2 teaspoon almond extract and a few drops of red food coloring.  Add butter and bring to a boil.  Pour over the dough and bake for 30 minutes.  Serve hot with vanilla ice cream.

name: BAKED WEST VIRGINIA HAM
ingredients:
10 to 12  lb. ham
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1 or 2  tsp. mustard
1  Tbsp. white vinegar
juice of 3 oranges
juice of 2 small grapefruit
juice of 1 jar maraschino cherries
juice of 1 medium size can pineapple
1  c. white corn syrup
1  c. brown sugar
whole cloves
preparation: Wrap  ham  in  foil or brown wrapping paper.  Place fat side up  in  roaster  and  bake  in slow oven, about 300°, 25 minutes per  pound.  Take  from  oven 45 minutes before done. Remove paper and rind.  In a bowl, mix 1 1/2 cups brown sugar, mustard  and white vinegar.  Rub into and all over ham, using all the mixture.

name: OLD FASHIONED LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  c. olives
1  lb. extra lean ground beef
1/4  c. olive oil
1  c. chopped onion
2 minced  cloves garlic
1 large  can tomatoes
2 large  cans tomato paste
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. each: dried basil and dried oregano
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/2  bay leaf
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. lasagna noodles
1/2  lb. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cut olives in large pieces.  Set aside.  Brown ground beef in olive oil.  Add onion and garlic to ground beef and cook until transparent.  Add next six ingredients.  Cover and simmer one hour or until sauce is thickened, stirring occasionally.  Stir in olives.  Meanwhile, cook lasagna in boiling salted water for 20 minutes.  Drain.  Grate Mozzarella cheese.

name: GREENS GUMBO
ingredients:
1  bunch each: collard, turnip, mustard, kale, carrot tops, radish tops, watercress
2  bunches beet tops
1  head cabbage
3  lb. spinach
2  lb. slab bacon, cut into 4 pieces
2  medium onions, chopped
1  c. chopped celery, green pepper and sliced scallions
1  bunch parsley
10  c. water
5  cloves chopped garlic
1  lb. smoked ham, cut in bite size pieces
1  lb. Creole sausage, bite size pieces (I use any type of spicy sausage available)
4  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. thyme and sweet basil
3  bay leaves
1/2  tsp. allspice and cayenne pepper
1/8  tsp. ground cloves
salt and freshly ground pepper
8  Tbsp. butter (1 stick)
5  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Pick the greens, removing all dead leaves and large stems. Wash them several times.  Place the greens in a large pot along with the bacon, onions, parsley, celery, green pepper and water. Bring to a boil; lower the heat and cook, covered, for 1 to 2 hours until the greens are tender.  Drain the greens, reserving the cooking liquid.  Discard the bacon.  When the greens are cool enough to handle, divide them in half.  Coarsely chop half and put the other half through a blender or processor.  In the pot, without liquid, saute the scallions, garlic, ham and sausage in the vegetable oil for 10 minutes.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick butter, melted
8  oz. cream cheese
3  oz. cream cheese
3  bananas
1  (9 oz.) container Cool Whip
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. sugar
5  Tbsp. milk
1 large  can crushed pineapple, well drained or strawberries
preparation: Use 9 x 13-inch pan.  Melt butter; add graham cracker crumbs to make first layer.  Mix and beat cream cheese, sugar and milk until fluffy (about 10 to 15 minutes).  Spread on crumbs as second layer.  Next layer is bananas, sliced.  Add crushed pineapple as next layer.  Garnish with cherries and nuts.  Spread Cool Whip over pineapple as last layer.

name: PAT'S CHOCOLATE PECAN TOFFEE BAR
ingredients:
3/4  c. canola oil
1  c. lite brown sugar
1  egg yolk
1/2  c. coarsely chopped pecans
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In medium-sized bowl, cream the oil and sugar and beat well.  Stir in flour and vanilla.  Litely spray an 11 x 14-inch baking sheet with vegetable oil.  Press the dough onto the sheet.  Bake for 25 minutes, until golden brown.  Let cool.  Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler.  Spread the melted chocolate evenly over the cooled toffee bars and sprinkle with pecans.  Makes 48 (1-inch) squares.

name: BROCCOLI-ONION DELUXE
ingredients:
1  lb. broccoli or 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen
2  c. small whole onions
1/2  c. margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1  c. sharp shredded cheese
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Cook broccoli; drain.  In saucepan, melt half of the margarine.  Blend in flour, salt and a dash of pepper.  Add milk. Cook, stirring constantly, until thick.  Reduce heat; blend in cream cheese until smooth.  Place broccoli and onions in a 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Pour sauce mixture over and mix lightly. Top with cheese.  Melt remaining butter; toss with bread crumbs. Sprinkle atop casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: BEAN SOUP(Crock-Pot Cooking)
ingredients:
1  lb. Great Northern (navy) beans
10  oz. ham, diced
9  oz. beef, ground or diced and precooked
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1  stalk celery, chopped
1  onion (large), chopped
1  lb. (No. 303 can) tomatoes (include all liquid plus 1 c.  tomato juice and 2 1/2 c. water)
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. black pepper (to taste)
1  tsp. salt to taste
preparation: Soak beans for 8 hours (overnight).  Chop (coarse) green pepper, celery and onion.  Add these and broken up tomatoes to drained beans.  Add precooked beef, ham and seasoning; simmer until the beans are done (to taste).

name: CREAM CHEESE DESSERT
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. granulated sugar
1/2  lb. butter
11  oz. cream cheese
12  oz. La Creme
2  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients into dough and press on cookie sheet or pizza pan and bake for 15 minutes in 350° oven.  Cool.  Mix cream cheese, La Creme and confectioners sugar and spread on cooled crust.  Put cherries or whatever fruit you want on top and serve.

name: CHEDDAR NUT BREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. biscuit mix
1 1/2  c. (6 oz.) shredded sharp cheese
1/4  tsp. salt
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large bowl.  Set aside. Combine egg, milk and water; add to dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened.  Stir in pecans.  Spoon batter into a lightly greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Let cool in pan for 10 minutes.

name: DELICIOUS CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked, cubed chicken
1  c. chicken broth
1/2  stick butter
1  can cream of celery soup
1 1/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. Bisquick
preparation: Layer chicken in bottom of a large oblong Pyrex dish (baking). Heat celery soup (no water), 1/2 stick butter and 1 cup chicken broth together.  Pour over cubed chicken; add 1 package frozen vegetables (cauliflower, broccoli and carrot mixture).  Mix Bisquick and milk.  Will be thin.  Pour over all.  Bake at 325° or 350° for 1 hour.  Serves 8.

name: BAKED CORN
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. Crisco
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
2  c. cooked or canned corn
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  eggs
preparation: Melt Crisco; add flour and mix well.  Add milk gradually and bring to the boiling point, stirring constantly.  Add corn, sugar, salt and pepper and heat thoroughly.  Remove from fire; add well beaten eggs and pour into a greased baking dish.  Bake in oven at 350° for 25 minutes, or until corn is firm.

name: SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  oz. fat-free Cheddar cheese, grated
1 (16 oz.)  carton fat-free cottage cheese
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped spinach, drained
3/4  c. egg substitute
preparation: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Spoon into casserole sprayed with nonstick spray. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, chopped
1  chopped onion
1  green pepper, diced
2  tomatoes, diced
1  can kidney or chili beans, drained
1  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese (2 c.)
8  oz. bottle Western dressing
1  bag smashed taco chips
1  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. taco seasoning
preparation: Brown hamburger.  Add taco seasoning until blended.  Mix in additional ingredients and moisten with Western dressing.  Mix in taco chips just before serving.

name: BAKED APPLES
ingredients:
4  large red cooking apples
3/4  c. granulated sugar
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  c. water
cinnamon
preparation: Prepare apples.  Wash and core; peel 1/3 of the way down from the top.  Place, stem side down, in a baking dish.  Boil the granulated sugar and water for 10 minutes.  Pour over the apples. Sprinkle with cinnamon.  Bake in a 350° oven for about 45 minutes, until apples are tender when pierced with a fork.  Remove from oven and sprinkle with brown sugar.  Return to oven until sugar is melted.

name: PAZCZKI
ingredients:
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. butter, melted
1  c. flour
dash of salt
6  eggs
fat
powdered sugar
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Bring water to boil with the butter.  Add flour gradually, mixing constantly, until the butter forms a ball.  Remove from stove and cool.  Add salt and granulated sugar and beat in eggs one by one.  Form round balls, greasing your hands in melted butter each time and fry in hot deep fat under cover, on a low flame for about 15 minutes or until evenly browned, turning once.  Drain on absorbent paper in a warm place.  Cover with powdered sugar.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (1 lb.)  cans Veg-All
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
2  sticks butter
1  stack Ritz crackers
preparation: Drain Veg-All well and place in casserole dish.  In small saucepan, melt together 1 stick butter and Cheez Whiz until it makes a sauce.  Fold into Veg-All casserole.  Crush crackers and place on top.  Melt the other stick of butter and pour over top. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: PEAR SALAD
ingredients:
1  can pear halves, drained
Miracle Whip
grated Cheddar and Monterey cheese
maraschino cherries
salad greens
preparation: Place pear halves in a single layer on a platter of your favorite greens (lettuce, baby spinach, etc.). Put a dollop of Miracle Whip in the center of each pear half. Sprinkle generously with the two cheeses.  Top with cherries, if desired.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE WITH STUFFING AND PEAS
ingredients:
3  whole chicken breasts, cooked and cubed
1  box Stove Top stuffing
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  c. cooked rice
1  c. cheese (any kind)
1  can Durkee French onions
1  small bag frozen peas
3  Tbsp. butter or oleo, melted
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix milk, soup, peas, chicken, rice and cheese; set aside.  In separate bowl mix stuffing, French onions, butter, and seasoning pack for stuffing.  Pour chicken mixture into baking dish.  Put stuffing mixture on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: FRANKS 'N BEANS SKILLET SUPPER
ingredients:
2  slices bacon
6  frankfurters
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can Campbell's cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. water
3  c. sliced, cooked potatoes
1  c. cooked, cut green beans
1/8  tsp. leaf thyme, crushed
preparation: In skillet, cook bacon and then remove and crumble.  Cut each frankfurter into thirds.  In drippings, brown frankfurters and cook onion until tender.  Stir in soup, water, potatoes, green beans and thyme.  Heat, stirring now and then.  Garnish with crumbled bacon.  Serves 4.

name: APRICOT NECTARINE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines Butter Recipe cake mix
1 large  box vanilla instant pudding
3  eggs
1/3  c. oil
1  c. apricot nectarine juice (add just a little more)
1  c. sugar
1  stick butter
preparation: Mix together first 5 ingredients and pour in Bundt cake pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: MICROWAVE TRUFFLES
ingredients:
24  oz. semi-sweet or milk chocolate pieces, melted
2  tbsp butter, softened
2  tbsp. sour cream
1/2  tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Bring all to a soft boil.  Remove from heat.  As mixture firms, roll into small balls and roll in favorite topping (1/2 c. chopped roasted nuts, 1/4 c. coconut, instant mocha, etc.).

name: POWDERED SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. milk
2  c. sugar
1  c. Crisco
2  eggs
1 to 2  tsp. vanilla
4  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
5  c. flour
10x sugar
preparation: Cream sugar and Crisco together.  Add eggs.  Mix baking powder and baking soda with flour.  Add flour mixture and milk into creamed mixture.  Add vanilla.

name: NINA'S FUDGE
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
1  can Carnation milk
3 -6  oz. pkg. Nestle semi-sweet morsels
4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Bring sugar and milk to a boil.  Boil slowly for 5 minutes. Add chocolate morsels and pecans.  Stir just enough to mix well. Drop by teaspoons on wax paper or pour into non-stick dish to cut into squares.

name: MAMA O'S MACARONI PIE
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. medium Cheddar cheese, grated
1  egg, beaten
1  can milk
1  c. macaroni (small elbow)
2  Tbsp. butter
salt, pepper and paprika to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Cook macaroni as directed on box.  Drain water from cooked macaroni and mix in butter, salt and pepper. Pour half macaroni in 2-quart casserole dish; spread evenly. Sprinkle layer of grated cheese, using half cheese.  Repeat layer of macaroni and layer of cheese.  Add milk to beaten egg and pour over macaroni and cheese layers.  Place pats of butter around on top of mixture.  Sprinkle paprika on top.  Bake for about 30 minutes.

name: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can creamed corn
1 (16 oz.)  can whole corn
1  (8 oz.) Jiffy cornbread mix
8  oz. sour cream
1 1/4  sticks melted butter
3  eggs, beaten
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: QUICK AND EASY CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In mixer bowl, beat until smooth.  Pour into a 9 x 9-inch greased and floured pan.  Bake at 350° for 5 to 10 minutes.

name: DOUBLE APPLE BARS
ingredients:
3/4  c. packed brown sugar
3/4  c. applesauce
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  egg
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped, unpeeled apple
powdered sugar
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix brown sugar, applesauce, oil and egg in large bowl.  Stir in flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.  Stir in apple.  Spread batter in ungreased square 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean; cool.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar.  Cut into 2-inch squares.  Makes about 2 dozen bars.

name: CARAMEL APPLE SALAD
ingredients:
3  Granny Smith apples, diced
3  red apples, diced
6  pkg. chocolate-covered caramel peanut nougat bars, chopped
3 1/2  c. Cool Whip, thawed
preparation: Mix apples and candy until well blended.  Gently stir in Cool Whip.  Refrigerate 1 hour or until ready to serve.  Garnish with apple slices and additional chopped candy bars, if desired.  Makes 20 servings.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. (1 qt.) cranberries
1 1/2  c. water
2  envelopes gelatin (clear)
1/2  c. hot water
2  c. sugar
1  c. grapes
1  c. celery
1  c. pineapple
1  c. nuts
preparation: Cook cranberries in  water.  Soak gelatin in hot water. Add sugar to gelatin  while  hot.  Add rest of ingredients and mix all together while hot.

name: STRAWBERRIES
ingredients:
2  boxes wild strawberry jello
1  can Eagle Brand milk
2  c. coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients and chill.  Shape into strawberries and roll in red sugar.  Place a green tinted almond piece to make the stem.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  bag vermicelli or angel hair pasta, cooked and drained
oil (enough to coat)
m.s.g.
green onion
bell pepper
celery
black and green olives
3/4  bottle McCormick Salad Supreme
preparation: Chop fresh vegetables.  Other vegetables could also be used, i.e. broccoli, cauliflower or carrot.  Mix vegetables and pasta together well.  Pour on salad dressing.  Mix again.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  to 6 chicken breasts, cooked and boned
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  1/2 stack packs Ritz crackers, crushed
1  stick margarine, melted
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Grease bottom of 9 x 13 dish. Break chicken in pieces and place in dish. Mix together soup and sour cream. (Add little broth to keep from getting too dry.) Spread over chicken. Spread cracker crumbs over all. Pour margarine over crackers. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve hot.

name: B C ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
2  slices bread
2  tsp. mayonnaise
2  slices bologna
1  slice American cheese
1  slice Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Roll each slice of bread with a rolling pin until flattened. Spread each slice with mayonnaise and top with one slice of bologna and one slice of cheese.  Roll each into a log and cut crosswise into about 5 pieces.  Keep together with a toothpick, if necessary.

name: CHILI CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  can Hormel chili no beans or with beans
1  box of philadelphia cream cheese-8 oz. (1/3 less fat can be used)
1  Bag shredded cheddar cheese or cubes
1  Bag of Tortilla Chips
1 small  can of chilies, cut up and drained (optional)
preparation: Spread the cream cheese in the bottom of a glass pyrex pan. Open can of chili and spread that over the cream cheese and heat in the microwave oven for about 7-8 minutes.   After the chili is hot, spread cheddar cheese over and microwave until the cheddar cheese is pretty well melted.  Serve with chips.  It's a great and easy party dish!

name: CHIFFON CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. vegetable oil
7  egg yolks
3/4  c. cold water
2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. grated lemon rind
7  egg whites
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.   Blend flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in bowl.  Make a well and add in order: oil, egg yolks, water, vanilla and rind.  Beat with spoon until smooth.  Beat egg whites and cream of tartar in a large mixing bowl until the whites form very stiff peaks.*  Pour egg yolk mixture over egg whites, gently folding with a rubber spatula just until blended.  Pour into ungreased tube pan.  Bake at 325° for 55 minutes, then at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes more.  Let it hang until cold.

name: CHOCOLATE GRAVY
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1/2  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.  Heat and stir until thick.  Serve hot over fresh biscuits or pancakes.

name: HAM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cubed ham
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can English peas
4  slices cheese
1/2  c. onion
1/3  c. milk
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix all together and bake at 400° for 15 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Place split biscuits on top and brown.

name: SHRIMP WITH BROCCOLI RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
10  oz. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed slightly
1  c. instant rice, uncooked
2  tsp. dried onion flakes
10 3/4  oz. can cream of mushroom soup
10 3/4  oz. can Cheddar cheese soup
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. oleo, melted
4  oz. can sliced mushrooms, drained
8  oz. pkg. frozen shrimp, thawed slightly
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: CHICKEN ASPARAGUS
ingredients:
4  cooked chicken breasts
1  medium onion, chopped
1/4  c. margarine
8  oz. can mushrooms, drained
1  can cream of asparagus soup
2  cans asparagus
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
2  tsp. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. sliced almonds
5  oz. evaporated milk
preparation: Spray a 13 x 9-inch pan with Pam. Spread chicken in pan.  Top with asparagus.  Combine remaining ingredients; pour over chicken. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with almonds the last few minutes of baking.  Serves 8.

name: HOT CRABMEAT APPETIZER
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. milk
1  can frozen crab or 8 oz. imitation crab
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. horseradish
salt
pepper
almonds (optional)
preparation: Mix  all ingredients  and  place  in  small  casserole. Layer chopped almonds on top (if wanted).  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Serve on crackers.

name: EASY SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  c. cooked potatoes
2  eggs
unbaked pie shell
1  c. milk
1  stick margarine
1  pkg. instant pudding
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: BAKED CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. rice
1  can cream of mushroom soup plus 1 can water
1  can cream of chicken soup plus 1 can water
1  pkg. dry onion soup
1  whole chicken (1 cut up chicken or chicken parts to cover rice)
preparation: Put rice in bottom of baking pan.  Add chicken, then pour premixed soups and water over chicken and rice.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Bake 2 to 2 1/2 hours at 350°.  Leave uncovered 1 1/2 hours.  Cover with aluminum foil for last hour.

name: FROZEN CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1 flat  can drained crushed pineapple
1 large  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and freeze.  (Does not have to be refrozen, but may be kept in the refrigerator.)

name: WONDERFUL BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  box any brownie mix (follow directions)
1/2  bag small marshmallows
1/2 to 1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2 to 1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix together and bake as directed.

name: CRAB SALAD
ingredients:
12  to 16 oz imitation crab
2  celery stalks
2  green onion
1  can sliced black olives
1/2  lemon
2  Tbsp. Mayonnaise (will not work with miracle whip)
1/2  bag small macaroni shells
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook macaroni according to package directions, and drain. Tear crab into pieces, slice celery and green onions. Add these and black olives together.  Squeeze lemon over mixture.  Add just enough mayo to moisten.  Salt and pepper to taste.

name: VIDALIA ONION PIE
ingredients:
4  Vidalias, sliced in 1/4-inch rings
1  stick butter
3  eggs
1  c. sour cream
Tabasco to taste
salt and pepper to taste
Parmesan cheese
unbaked pie shell
preparation: Saute onions in butter until limp, add these to eggs, well beaten with sour cream.  Add several shakes of Tabasco and salt and pepper.  Mix all well and pour into an unbaked pie shell.  Top heavily with Parmesan cheese and bake in 400° oven for 25 minutes.

name: CARAMEL APPLE DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped, salted peanuts
1  (8 oz.) Philly lite cream cheese
1/2  c. dark brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put peanuts in food processor and chop.  Add other ingredients and mix well.  Serve with apple slices for a caramel apple taste. (Sprinkle apples with Fruit-Fresh to keep from turning dark as quick or dip in pineapple juice.)

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
preparation: Place potatoes in casserole dish and dot with butter.  Mix together sour cream and cream of chicken soup.  Spread over potatoes. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: EIGHT MINUTE LIGHT AND FRUITY PIE
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. jello gelatin (strawberry)
2/3  c. boiling water
2  c. ice cubes
3 1/2  c. or 1 (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  c. fresh strawberries
1  graham cracker pie shell
preparation: Completely dissolve gelatin in boiling water, stirring for about 3 minutes.  Add ice cubes (6) and stir constantly until gelatin is thickened, about 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove any unmelted ice.  Using wire whip, blend in whipped topping; whip until smooth. Fold in strawberries.  Chill, if necessary, until mixture will mound.  Spoon into pie shell.  Chill in refrigerator for 3 hours.

name: BAKED PANCAKES
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs, lightly beaten
pinch of nutmeg
4  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. confectioners sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Combine flour, milk, eggs and nutmeg. Beat lightly.  Leave batter a little lumpy.  Melt butter and pour in 9 x 13-inch baking dish; pour batter over butter.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.  Sprinkle with sugar and return to oven for a minute.

name: BROWN SUGAR BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. margarine softened
1/4  c. apple sauce
2  eggs
3/4  c. packed light brown sugar
1  c. mashed bananas (2-3 med)
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. chopped nuts
2  Tbsp. skim milk
1 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Beat margarine, applesauce, eggs, milk, and brown sugar in large bowl until smooth.  Add bananas and blend at low speed; beat on high speed 1-2 minutes.  Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt mix into batter.  Mix in nuts.  Pour into greased loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 55-60 minutes.

name: CHEESY POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
32  oz. pkg. frozen hash browns
1  small onion, chopped
1  pt. mayonnaise
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Melt cheese and mayonnaise; mix in hash browns with onion. Place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered.

name: SALMON CROQUETTES
ingredients:
1  can pink salmon
1  egg, beaten
3  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. corn meal
chopped onion (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Spoon mixture into hot fat and fry until brown.

name: SWISS STYLE GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
2  green onions, chopped
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
4  c. French-style green beans, drained
1/2  lb. Swiss cheese, grated
2  c. corn flakes, crushed
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Make sauce for first seven ingredients and cook until thick. Add to green beans.  Place in greased casserole and cover with cheese.  Melt 2 tablespoons butter, add corn flakes and sprinkle on top of bean mixture.  Cook at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: FRESH BLUEBERRY PIE
ingredients:
2  c. blueberries
1  c. sugar
4  pats butter
1  double crust pie crust
preparation: Wash berries and drain. Mix berries and sugar.  Place in crust.  Place 4 pats of butter on top and cover with top crust. Bake at 350°.  Be sure to slit top crust.

name: SPINACH BALLS
ingredients:
2  boxes frozen spinach, cooked and drained
1  box chicken flavored Stove Top stuffing
3/4  c. melted butter
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese or Monterey Jack
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  large onion
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Chill 1 hour.  Make into balls.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: EGGPLANT PARMESAN
ingredients:
1 (2 lb.)  can whole Italian tomatoes
1 large size  can tomato sauce (Delmonte or Hunts)
2  cloves garlic
4  Tbsp. olive oil (can be mixed with vegetable oil if lighter oil is desired)
preparation: Beat tomatoes in blender for a few minutes.  Season with the following spices to taste:  salt, pepper, parsley, fresh basil (chopped) and oregano.  In a heavy pot, brown garlic in oil; remove.  Add tomatoes, sauce and spices.  Simmer about 1 1/2 hours.  Skim oil from top of sauce.

name: BUDGET PUNCH
ingredients:
1  pkg. cherry Kool-Aid
sugar
2  qt. water
1 (No. 3)  can Hawaiian Punch
1 (No. 3)  can pineapple juice
1  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Can add sherbet.

name: LEMON POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 2 3/4  c. sugar
3  c. Swans Down cake flour
1/2  lb. butter or 2 sticks margarine
6  eggs
1  carton whipping cream
3  Tbsp. lemon extract
preparation: Beat sugar and margarine until creamy.  Add alternately the eggs and flour, beating well until mixed.  Beat in lemon extract. Stir in whipping cream.  Do not beat after adding whipping cream. Cook in greased and floured tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

name: DO-DAD
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter
2 1/2  tsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. onion or garlic powder
2  c. Corn Chex
2  c. Rice Chex
2  c. Wheat Chex
1  c. pretzel sticks or salted peanuts
preparation: Melt  butter  in  electric skillet  at	200°.  Stir  in seasoning;	blend  well.  Add Chex	and  pretzels;	mix  until pieces  are coated;  cover skillet,  leaving  lid  vent  open. Heat to 250° for  15 minutes;  stir midway.  Cool on absorbent paper.

name: POKE SALLET
ingredients:
2  slices bacon
poke greens, very young, cut in bite-sized pieces
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  eggs
preparation: Saute bacon until crisp, remove from drippings and set aside to drain.  Parboil poke greens and drain.  Add poke and soy sauce to hot bacon drippings.  Simmer, tightly covered, until poke is wilted.  Drop eggs individually on poke.  Cook, covered, until eggs are firm.  Using spatula, cut around each egg and place on warm plates.  Crumble bacon pieces over eggs and serve.  Serves 2.

name: APPLE BAR
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. shortening or 1/2 c. oil
1  egg yolk and enough milk to make 2/3 c.
1  handful crushed cornflakes
8  to 10 apples
1  c. sugar with 2 tsp. cinnamon
1  egg white
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Sprinkle  crushed cornflakes  over  the  dough.  Spread apples over the dough.  Sprinkle  sugar with cinnamon over the apples. Cover apples with  other  half  of	dough.	Beat  egg white and pour over  the  dough.  Mix  vanilla, powdered sugar and enough water to make  glaze.  Spread over apple bar.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.  Apples can be fresh or frozen.

name: APPLE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
2  medium-large apples, peeled and cored
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/3  c. light or dark corn syrup
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
2 1/4  c. buttermilk baking mix
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. ground allspice
1  large egg
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Cut apples crosswise into 9 slices.  In a saucepan, melt margarine over medium heat.  in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish, combine melted margarine, corn syrup, brown sugar and cinnamon. Arrange apple slices in bottom of dish.  Sprinkle with nuts.  Bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes.

name: Spatzle(Drop Noodles)
ingredients:
2  qt. water
2  tsp. salt
2 1/3  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  c. water
1/4  c. butter, melted
preparation: Bring to boiling in 3 to 4 quart saucepan 2 quarts water and 2 teaspoons salt.  Meanwhile, sift together and set aside flour and 1 teaspoon salt.  Combine in bowl and mix together egg and 1 cup water.  Gradually add flour mixture to egg mixture.  Stir until smooth.  (Batter should be very thick and break from a spoon instead of pouring in a continuous stream.)  Spoon batter into the boiling water by 1/2 teaspoon, dipping spoon into water each time. Cook only one layer of noodles at one time; do not crowd.  After noodles rise to the surface, boil gently 5 to 8 minutes or until tender when pressed against side of pan with spoon.  Remove from water with slotted spoon, draining over water for a second and place in warm bowl.  Toss butter lightly with noodles.  Serve hot.

name: JAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2 1/2  c. sugar
3 1/2  c. plain flour
6  eggs, separated
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. each allspice, cloves, nutmeg and cinnamon
1  c. pear preserves
1  c. strawberry preserves
1  c. blackberry jam or preserves
1  c. chopped raisins
1  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream the butter. Add sugar; beat well.  Add beaten egg yolks. Sift together the flour and spices. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Add flour mixture and milk alternately. Add remaining ingredients except egg whites.  Stiffly beat egg whites and add last.  Pour into greased and floured pans.  Bake in 4 (9-inch) pans in a 325° oven for 45 to 50 minutes.  Ice with Caramel Icing.

name: GLADYS SMITH'S BAKING POWDER BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. sugar (if desired)
1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
4 level  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. Crisco
1  egg
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Sift all dry ingredients; beat egg into milk.  Cut Crisco into dry ingredients.  Pour milk over mixture.  Roll on floured board. Don't roll dough too thin.  Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: FINGER JELL-O
ingredients:
4  envelopes Knox gelatin
1  c. cold water
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3 small  pkg. Jell-O
3  c. boiling water
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix together  the  gelatin, lemon juice and cold water; set aside.  Mix  Jell-O,  boiling  water,  sugar  and  add the gelatin mixture.  Stir  until  dissolved.  Put  into a shallow pan and chill  until  set.  Cut  into  small  squares  or into shapes with cookie cutters.

name: CUCUMBER AND TOMATO SALAD
ingredients:
3  large cucumbers
3  large tomatoes
1  medium onion, diced
2/3  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
2  cloves garlic, diced or 1 1/2 tsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. oil
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Slice and peel cucumbers into thin circles.  Slice tomatoes (peel if you wish).  Mix all ingredients together.   Serve chilled.

name: CHOCOLATE BANANA PUDDING PIE
ingredients:
4  sq. Baker's semi-sweet chocolate
2  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  prepared graham cracker crust
2  medium Dole bananas, sliced
2 3/4  c. cold milk
2  pkg. Jell-O vanilla or banana cream flavor instant pudding
1 1/3  c. thawed Cool Whip
preparation: Microwave chocolate, milk and margarine on High for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds.  Stir until chocolate is completely melted.  Spread evenly in crust.  Refrigerate 30 minutes or until chocolate is firm.  Arrange banana slices over chocolate.  Pour milk into large bowl.  Add pudding mixes.  Beat with wire whisk for 1 minute.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Spoon over bananas in crust.  Spread with whipped topping.  Refrigerate 4 hours or until set.  Store leftover pie in refrigerator.

name: STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
3  Tbsp. uncooked rice
1  c. corn flakes
2  beaten eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
6  green peppers
1 large  can tomato soup
preparation: Cut tops off peppers; clean and soak for 5 minutes in hot water.  Mix first 5 ingredients and put into peppers.  Place peppers in greased baking dish and pour tomato soup over the top. Bake for 1 hour at 300°.

name: ORENE'S FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large  can Hawaiian Punch*
1 large  can pineapple juice
1 large  can orange juice
1 small  bottle ReaLemon juice
1/2  gal. water
sugar to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Makes 2 gallons.

name: DELICIOUS PERFECTION SALAD
ingredients:
2  envelopes unflavored gelatin (may use one of lime jello)
1/2  c. cider vinegar
1  tsp. curry powder
2  green onions, finely chopped
1 1/4  c. celery, finely chopped
1/4  c. cold water
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. salt
dash of cayenne pepper
1 1/2  c. cabbage, finely chopped
1/2  c. carrot, grated
1/2  c. green pepper, finely chopped
preparation: Sprinkle gelatin in cold water; add boiling water, stirring until gelatin dissolves.  Add sugar, vinegar, curry powder and cayenne pepper.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Stir in vegetables.  Pour into 8-cup mold, chill until firm.  Serve with mayonnaise for garnish.  Yield: 8 to 10 servings.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  small onion
1  can broccoli cheese soup
1/3  c. milk
1/8  tsp. pepper
4  medium potatoes, cooked and sliced
chopped parsley
preparation: Cook onions in margarine until tender.  Add remaining ingredients.  Heat to boiling.  Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 5 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

name: SEED CAKES QUEEN BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sugar
1  1/2 blocks oleo
1/4  c. milk
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sesame seed (to roll)
preparation: Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.  Mix all ingredients.  More flour will be needed to work.  Roll into strips and into 1-inch pieces. Roll into sesame seed before baking.

name: SCALLOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  slices white bread, cubed
10  oz. Cheddar cheese, cubed
1  lb. sea scallops, cut up
1/2  stick butter, melted
2  c. milk
3  eggs
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Layer the first three ingredients in large casserole dish (the casserole will "puff" when cooked).  Drizzle melted butter over the bread, cheese and scallops.  Beat milk, eggs, salt and mustard together.  Pour over mixture in casserole.  Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for one hour.

name: FRESH APPLE BARS
ingredients:
1/3  c. Crisco
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
3/4  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1  c. finely chopped apples, peeled
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In mixing bowl, cream Crisco and 3/4 cup sugar.  Add eggs and beat well. Combine flour, salt, baking powder, soda, nutmeg and ginger.  Blend into creamed mixture; mix well.  Stir in the apples.  Spread in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Sprinkle with a mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cool, cut into bars.  Yields 36 bars.

name: SAWDUST PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. pecans
1 1/2  c. coconut
7  unbeaten egg whites
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. crushed graham crackers
1  unbaked pie crust
preparation: Mix above ingredients, pour into pie crust and bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE BROWNIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. Hershey's cocoa
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2/3  c. butter or margarine, melted and divided
1/2  c. boiling water
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 1/3  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease rectangular pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch) or 2 square pans (8 x 8 x 2-inch).  Bake 30 to 35 minutes.  In medium bowl, combine cocoa and baking soda.  Blend in 1/3 cup melted butter or margarine.  Add boiling water; stir until mixture thickens.  Stir in sugar, eggs and remaining 1/3 cup butter or margarine.  Stir until smooth.  Add flour, vanilla and salt and blend.  Pour into pan or pans and bake until it begins to pull away from sides of pan.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
canned or fresh peaches
1  stick melted margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
loaf bread, trimmed and cut into finger size slices
preparation: Place peaches in bottom of dish.  Mix sugar, flour, melted margarine, egg and flavoring.  Place loaf bread over peaches. Pour mixture over bread.  Bake at 325° until brown.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  Cup Miracle Whip
1/4  Cup Sour Cream
1 Small  Can Mandarin Oranges, drained
1 Small  Can Chunk Pineapple
1  Cup Coconut
1  Cup Miniature Marshmallows
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Add a banana right before serving.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3 1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. boiling water
1 (3 oz.)  box strawberry jello
strawberries
preparation: Combine sugar, cornstarch and boiling water in saucepan and cook until clear.  Stir constantly to prevent scorching.  Remove from heat and stir in jello; let cool.  Pour over strawberries arranged in a baked pie shell and refrigerate until filling is firm, approximately 1 hour.

name: SIMPLE PUNCH
ingredients:
1  (1 liter) ginger ale
1  can cranberry juice
1  (1/2 gal.) orange juice
1  (1/2 gal.) pineapple juice
1  (1/2 gal.) rainbow sherbet or 1 bag frozen strawberries
10  c. ice (approximately)
preparation: Exactly divide in half all ingredients except sherbet or strawberries and mix together.  Add sherbet or strawberries to top of punch with ice.  Sherbet is great for kid's party, while adults love the strawberries.  Makes 2 bowls.

name: CHEESED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh mushrooms
10  strips bacon, fried crisp
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sharp Cheddar, grated
1  medium onion, chopped
seasoned salt
preparation: Remove stems and wash mushrooms.  Cook caps in salt water for 15 minutes.  Drain mushrooms thoroughly and place in buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Combine ingredients and fill mushrooms with mixture.  Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.  Serve hot.  May be prepared ahead and baked later.

name: ONION SOUP
ingredients:
4  large yellow onions
2  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. flour
6  c. beef broth
salt and pepper to taste
6  slices French bread
3/4  c. Swiss cheese, grated
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
preparation: Simmer beef broth in saucepan on low, while preparing onions. Peel onions and slice thinly.  Separate slices into rings.  Saute onion rings in hot butter in skillet until softened.  Lightly stir in flour.  Add cooked onions to simmering broth.  Cover and simmer another 20 minutes.  Ladle soup into bowls.  Place a round of bread on soup.  Sprinkle with combined cheeses.  Place bowls on cookie sheet and brown cheese under preheated broiler for 3 minutes, until cheese is bubbly.  Serve immediately.

name: MINI-BLINIS(Makes 4 Dozen; Recipe May Be Cut In Half)
ingredients:
2  loaves white bread (remove crusts)
2  egg yolks
1  lb. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1  lb. melted butter
sugar and cinnamon
preparation: Combine yolks, cheese and sugar.  Roll bread thin (remove crusts).  Put 1 tablespoon filling in the center of each slice of bread.   Melt butter.  Make mixture of cinnamon and sugar.  Dip in butter, then in cinnamon/sugar.  Drain on paper towels.  Bake until crispy (lightly toasted) and warm.

name: MAYONNAISE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1/2  c. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. Miracle Whip
2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Bake at  350° until done (30 to 35 minutes).  Frost with your favorite frosting.

name: SAGE POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  boneless beef chuck roast
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
1 to 2  tsp. rubbed dried sage
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. beef broth
6  medium potatoes, cut in half
3  to 4 carrots, cut into pieces
2  medium onions, quartered
5  tsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. water
preparation: In a Dutch oven, brown roast on both sides in oil.  Season with sage, salt and pepper.  Add beef broth.  Cover and bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours.  Add potatoes, carrots and onions.  Cover and bake 1 hour longer or until the meat is tender and vegetables are cooked.  Remove roast and vegetables to a serving platter and keep warm.  Combine cornstarch and water; stir into pan juices. Cook until thickened and bubbly.  Serve with the roast.  Yields 12 servings.

name: SPREAD DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1/3  c. chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
dash of salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients and serve as spread on cucumber slice, carrot rounds, crackers or toast.  Makes 2 cups.

name: RHUBARB CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening (Crisco)
1  egg
1  c. buttermilk or sour cream
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. diced rhubarb
1/2  c. nuts
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix together 1 1/2 cups sugar, shortening and egg.  Alternately add buttermilk and flour, soda and salt (sifted together).  Blend in vanilla, rhubarb and nuts.  Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle with 3 tablespoons sugar mixed with cinnamon.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.  Very good for a brunch.

name: ORIENTAL NOODLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. spaghetti (thin)
1/2  bottle Kikkoman soy sauce
1/4  bottle stir-fry sauce (House of Tsang if possible)
1  medium red pepper, diced
1  small green pepper, diced
2  stalks scallions, chopped
1  Tbsp. ground ginger
preparation: Boil  spaghetti.  While  the spaghetti is boiling, dice peppers and  scallions  and  mix  in  a  bowl  with soy sauce, stir-fry sauce  and  ginger.  When  spaghetti is cooked, drain and toss  with  other  ingredients.  Cover  and  refrigerate. Serve cold.

name: MOM'S ORANGE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. orange juice (fresh)
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. oleo
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. orange rind
3  egg yolks
1/2  c. water
preparation: Cook all ingredients until thick.  Pour into baked pie shell and put oleomargarine on top and brown.

name: HELLO DOLLIES
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
2  sticks oleo
2  c. coconut
2  c. chocolate chips
2  c. chopped nuts (walnuts or pecans)
2  cans Eagle Brand condensed milk
preparation: Melt oleo; add oleo and cracker crumbs to a 9 x 13-inch pan. Press into bottom.  Layer remaining ingredients, except milk, in order listed.  Pour milk evenly over top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: MEXICAN ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1  pkg. large flour tortillas
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
4  to 5 green onions, finely chopped
1 (4 oz.)  can diced green chiles
1 (7 oz.)  can green chile salsa
2  c. shredded Cheddar or Jack or 1 c. each
garlic salt to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients together; spread on tortillas and roll up. Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight.  Slice and serve.

name: DATE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
3  c. boiling water
butter (size of egg)
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/4  c. flour
1  c. nuts, chopped
1  c. dates, cut fine
preparation: Put first three ingredients in pan you are going to bake your pudding in.  Bring to boiling point and boil ten minutes. Combine the rest of the ingredients.  Drop in spoonfuls into syrup if thick and bake in a hot oven at 450° for 15 minutes.  Serve with whipped cream.  Makes about 12 servings.

name: HOLY SMOKE CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, softened
1/2  c. chopped nuts
8  oz. cream cheese
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
1  c. flour
1  c. powdered sugar
8  oz. Cool Whip
2 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Combine margarine, flour and chopped nuts.  Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Dot with butter on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown.  Cream powdered sugar and cream cheese and 1 cup of Cool Whip.  Spread over top of cooled crust.  Mix pudding with milk; spread over cream cheese layer.  Cover with remaining Cool Whip.  Chill overnight.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 -3 1/2  oz. can crushed pineapple, drained
2  c. chopped pecans
1/4  c. finely chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
preparation: With fork, beat cream cheese until smooth. Stir in crushed pineapple, 1 cup of the pecans and rest of ingredients. Shape into ball and roll in remaining cup of nuts.

name: HOT BROWN
ingredients:
1/4  lb. Velveeta
Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. Cheddar or Colby
1/3  c. flour
3  c. milk, hot
1  Tbsp. butter
1  medium onion, chopped
1/3  stick butter
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. red pepper
2  eggs
preparation: Melt 1/3 stick butter until clear. Add milk, salt, red pepper and flour.  When mixed, add eggs, Velveeta, Colby or Cheddar and 1 tablespoon butter.  Stir until dissolved. Do not boil.  Assemble 4 slices toast, turkey and slice of ham. Top with cheese sauce, slice cooked bacon and slice of tomato.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Broil until bubbles.

name: VENISON STEAKS
ingredients:
4  or 6 venison steaks
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. steak seasoning
preparation: Put steaks in deep dish. Sprinkle the Worcestershire sauce, garlic and steak seasoning on both sides. Cover with foil and let sit overnight. Roll in flour and cook in cooking oil. Cover with onion rings while cooking. Cover with lid while cooking over low fire.

name: REFRIGERATOR SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon supreme cake mix
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. lime jello
preparation: Mix lime jello in 3/4 cup boiling water and 1/2 cup cold water. Let stand at room temperature until cake is ready.  Mix and bake cake as directed in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan for 40 to 45 minutes.  Cool 20 minutes.  Refrigerate while mixing topping.  Take and poke holes with a meat fork about an inch apart.  Pour lime jello over cake.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. mild sausage
6  eggs, beaten
2  c. milk
1  c. grated cheese
2  slices bread, cut into cubes (crusts too)
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Put bread cubes on bottom of pan.  Fry and drain sausage. Place sausage on top of bread in a 10 x 1 3-inch baking dish. Blend all ingredients and pour over sausage and bread cubes.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BUTTERMILK CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. white cornmeal
1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  egg, beaten
1  c. buttermilk or soured milk
2  Tbsp. hot oil or shortening
preparation: Combine dry ingredients.  Add egg and buttermilk.  Mix well. Last, add hot oil.  Mix and pour quickly into greased 9-inch square baking pan.  Bake at 450° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Makes 9 servings.

name: TEMPEH MEXICALI
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  tsp. whole cumin seed
cayenne or red pepper to taste
1  large onion, chopped
3 to 4  cloves garlic, minced
6  oz. tempeh, shredded or crumbled
5 very ripe tomatoes or 1 (32 oz.)  can tomatoes
1/4  lb. mushrooms, halved
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
preparation: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet.  Add the cumin seed and cayenne or red pepper, starting with 1/4 teaspoon.  Allow to sizzle for a moment.  Add the onion and garlic.  Saute until relatively soft.  Add the tempeh and continue to cook, stirring frequently for another 5 minutes.

name: MUSTARDY FRIED CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of black pepper
1  egg
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. oil
1  green pepper, seeded and sliced
parsley sprig for garnish
preparation: Wipe chicken breasts with damp paper towel.  Sprinkle with salt and black pepper.  In a bowl, beat together egg and mustard. In separate bowl, combine Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs, mixing well.

name: HOMINY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  cans hominy, drained (reserve liquid)
1  can mushroom soup
1  can hominy liquid
2  Tbsp. sweet pepper
2  Tbsp. green pepper
2  Tbsp. green onion
pinch of sugar
salt to taste
1  lb. jalapeno cheese
preparation: Mix together all ingredients except cheese.   Grate cheese and put 3/4 of it on top of first mixture in baking dish.  Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.   Remove from oven and place remaining cheese on top.

name: LEMONADE PIE
ingredients:
1 small  can lemonade, thawed
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Mix together lemonade and Eagle Brand milk.  Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into a graham cracker crust.  Chill.

name: BLACK BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can black beans, drained and rinsed
1  c. chopped onion
1 (16 oz.)  can fat-free chicken broth
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. picante sauce
fat-free sour cream (optional)
preparation: Blend all ingredients until smooth.  Place mixture in large saucepan. Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes.  Each serving can be garnished with teaspoon of fat-free sour cream.  Yields 3 servings.  Has 170 calories, less than 1 g. fat. Goood!

name: CREAM OF BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  c. water
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
2  c. milk
2  c. Velveeta cheese
2  chicken bouillon cubes
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. half and half
croutons (optional)
preparation: In large saucepan, cook broccoli in 1 cup water.  Do not drain.  Blend milk, cheese and flour in blender on grind.  Add mixture to broccoli.  Add half and half.  Cook over medium heat until thick.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: CINNAMON SPICED TEA
ingredients:
8  Chinese-style red or black tea bags or 1/4 c. regular black tea
4  c. boiling water
ground cinnamon
1/2  c. sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Place tea in a teapot; pour water over tea.  Let steep for 5 minutes.  Pour into 4 cups.  To each serving, add a dash of cinnamon and about 2 tablespoons of the condensed milk.  Stir to blend.  Makes 4 servings.

name: MY BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. bacon
1  large onion
4 (No. 202)  cans pork and beans
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. cumin
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  c. molasses
1/4 or less  c. ketchup
preparation: Cut bacon in small pieces and fry.  When fairly crisp, add diced onion and fry with beans.  Cover and simmer until onions are transparent.  Mix rest of the nine ingredients well in bowl.  Add bacon/onion and all liquids.  Mix again.  Put in baking dish in 350° oven and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: CABBAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
2  cabbage heads
2  lb. hamburger
1  lb. ground pork
1  c. raw rice (not minute rice)
salt and pepper to taste
bacon strips
46  oz. can tomato juice
1/2  c. flour
preparation: Mix hamburger, pork, rice, salt and pepper. Stuff cabbage leaves. Put in large roaster. Cover with lean bacon strips. Heat tomato juice and flour until thick. Pour over rolls. Bake at 350 degrees for two hours.

name: LEMON BUSH
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. flour
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. whipped cream (Cool Whip)
2 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. lemon instant pudding
3  c. cold milk
preparation: Mix together margarine, flour and walnuts and press into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Mix together cream cheese and sugar; fold in Cool Whip and spread on top of cool crust.  Mix pudding and spread on top of filling.  When pudding has set, spread Cool Whip on top.   Sprinkle with finely chopped nuts.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: PARMESAN CHICKEN(Low-Fat)
ingredients:
6  boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. Italian style bread crumbs
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
nonstick cooking spray
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Spray baking dish with nonstick spray. Remove fat from chicken; dip in warm water.  Roll in combined bread crumbs, cheese, salt, pepper and paprika.  Place into prepared dish.  Spray with spray lightly.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.

name: CHRISTMAS COOKIES AND ICING
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  sticks butter
2  cups sugar
1/2  cup evaporated milk
1  tsp. baking soda
1  Tbsp. almond extract, or 2 tsp. nutmeg, or 1 1/2 Tbsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking powder
7  1/2 cups flour
preparation: Beat eggs. Add butter, sugar, milk and mix.  Mix soda and a little water (enough to stir) and add to mixture.  Sift flour and baking powder together and blend gradually into cookie mixture. Grease and flour cookie sheets.  Roll dough into 1/4 inch thickness and cut with Christmas cookie cutters and place on cookie sheets.  Bake at 375 degrees for 10-12 minutes.

name: BRIDIE'S REALLY GREAT CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  broiler-fryer, cut up (3 lb.)
1  can golden mushroom soup
1  leek, thinly sliced or 1 large onion, chopped (1 c.)
1 (3 or 4 oz.)  can chopped mushrooms
1/4  c. dry white wine
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Arrange chicken pieces in a single layer in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.  Combine soup, leek or onion, wine and lemon juice in a medium-sized bowl.  Spoon sauce over the chicken pieces.  Bake in a moderate oven (375°) for 1 hour, or until chicken is tender and richly browned.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
2  pie crusts
5  Tbsp. butter or margarine
5  Tbsp. flour
2  c. chicken broth
1 (16 oz.)  can Veg-All
2  c. cubed, cooked chicken
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Prepare pie crust and line a 9-inch pie pan with bottom crust. Melt butter in large skillet.  Add flour as you would for gravy. Slowly add broth to make the gravy base.  Make sure base is thick. If you need to, add some cornstarch.  Add Veg-All (drained), cooked meat, salt and pepper, if desired.  Pour into pie shell and add top crust.  Pinch edges and cut several slits in top.  Bake in a 400° oven for 45 minutes or until crust is brown.  Let cool to warm before serving.

name: PEACH AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1 (29 oz.)  can Hunt's peach slices, drained
1 1/2  c. sliced bananas
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/3  c. shredded coconut
preparation: Combine the first four ingredients.  Chill at least 30 minutes.  Sprinkle with coconut and spoon into sherbet glasses.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter or margarine
3/4  c. sugar
2  bananas, sliced
1  egg
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream together the butter, sugar and bananas.  Add eggs and beat well.  Combine dry ingredients; stir gently, alternating with liquid, into the creamed mixture.  Add nuts.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour in loaf pan.

name: LOUISIANA CORNBREAD SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. cornbread mix, cooked and crumbled
2  cans pinto beans, drained
2  c. large tomatoes, chopped
1  c. green onion, chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1  jalapeno, minced
12  strips bacon, cooked and crumbled
2  c. grated Monterey Jack cheese
1  c. sour cream
1  c. salsa
preparation: In a 2-quart casserole or larger, layer the ingredients twice in this order:  cornbread, beans, vegetables and bacon.  Top with cheese.  Mix sour cream and salsa together and spread over entire top of dish so no air holes are showing.  Cover and chill 2 to 3 hours.

name: PAELLA
ingredients:
2  c. rice (yellow)
2  c. chicken chunks
1/2  c. sliced black olives
1  c. scallops
1  c. shrimp
2  to 3 muscles
6  clams
lobster tails (if desired)
other seafood of desire (optional)
preparation: Steam or boil all seafood.  Cook rice.  Mix all ingredients together and bake 20 minutes.

name: MACARONI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oil
1/4  c. onions and peppers, chopped
1  lb. hamburg
1 large  can tomatoes
1/2  c. Karo syrup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1  bay leaf
pepper to taste
1  Tbsp. cornstarch (mix in water)
3  c. cooked macaroni or rice
shredded Cheddar cheese (about 1 c.)
preparation: Brown onions and peppers with hamburg.  Add tomatoes, syrup, salt, pepper, chili powder and bay leaf.  Simmer 15 minutes. Blend cornstarch in meat mixture; add macaroni or rice.  Put in 2-quart dish.  Bake at 350° about 1 hour.  Add 1 cup cheese over last 15 minutes.

name: MOCK PRIME RIB
ingredients:
eye of round roast or any rolled roast
salt and pepper
seasonings to taste
preparation: Place roast in glass pan.  Rub in salt, pepper and any seasonings you prefer.  Place, uncovered, in 375° preheated oven for 1 hour.  (Do this mid-afternoon.)  After 1 hour, turn off oven but do not open oven door.

name: BUTTERMILK RAISIN SCONES
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1/3  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
3/4  tsp. salt
12  Tbsp. butter (1 1/2 sticks)
1  c. buttermilk
1/4  c. raisins
1  Tbsp. orange zest
preparation: Sift together flour, baking powder, soda and salt.  Set aside. Cream together sugar and butter until it is the texture of sand. Add alternately the flour and buttermilk.  Fold in raisins and orange zest.  Line a 9 inch cake pan with plastic wrap.  Put dough in and cover up.  Refrigerate until firm, or can be frozen at this point (wrap well).  Cut into 8 wedges.  Place on a lightly greased cookie sheet or a parchment lined cookie sheet.  Bake in 350° oven for about 15 minutes or until brown.

name: QUICK CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
4  to 6 boned, skinned chicken breasts
white wine
1 large  clove diced garlic
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. sour cream
preparation: Marinate chicken in white wine and diced garlic clove.  Mix cream of mushroom soup and sour cream together.  Spray pan with nonstick spray.  Place chicken in pan.  Pour soup mixture over chicken.  Bake 45 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Pour remaining sauce over baked potato or wild rice.  M-m-m good!

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak
1/2  c. flour
