1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
3  Tbsp. chopped onion
4  Tbsp. ketchup
1  c. water
preparation: Have steak cut 1 1/2-inch thick.  Pound flour into both sides of steak.  Heat fat in a frying pan.  Add and brown meat and onions in hot fat.  Sprinkle with salt and paprika.  Add rest of ingredients, cover and cook slowly for 1 1/2 hours until very tender.  Turn frequently to allow even cooking.

name: LEMON LUST
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  stick oleo
dash of salt
1  c. powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (9 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
2  pkg. instant lemon pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix and press in long baking dish the flour, nuts, sugar, oleo and salt.  Bake 15 minutes at 350°.  Cool.  Mix and spread over crust the powdered sugar, cream cheese and Cool Whip.  Mix and spread over mixture the lemon pudding and milk.  Top with Cool Whip and chopped nuts.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: PARKER HOUSE ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1/3  c. shortening
3  eggs
1/4  c. sugar
2/3  cake compressed yeast
1/2  c. water
4  c. flour
preparation: Scald and cool milk and shortening.  Mix yeast, water and some sugar in pan; let rise.  Add eggs and rest of sugar to yeast mixture, then pour in milk and shortening mixture.  Add flour; stir well.  Put in refrigerator to cool and rise.  It can be used some hours later, but better to leave in refrigerator overnight.  Form in circle (like 8-slice pie).  Roll from the outside to the center. Put on pans.  Let rise.  Bake at 350° until golden brown.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
4  tart apples, peeled and sliced
cinnamon and nutmeg
1/4  c. white sugar
3/4  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. white flour
1/4  lb. margarine or butter
preparation: Put sliced apples in square pan with white sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Mix butter, brown sugar and flour together and sprinkle over apples.  Bake 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: SWISS VEGETABLE MEDLEY
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) bag frozen broccoli, carrots and cauliflower combination, thawed and drained
1 (10 1/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded low-fat Swiss cheese
1/3  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  can Durkee French fried onions
preparation: Combine vegetables, soup, 1/2 cheese, sour cream, pepper and 1/2 onions.  Pour into a 1-quart casserole.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onions.  Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.

name: ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
3  qt. half and half
3/4  c. milk
4  eggs, beaten
preparation: Dissolve sugar in milk; heat, but do not boil.  Add beaten eggs and vanilla.  Add enough half and half to fill can.  This is for a 1-gallon hand turned or electric freezer.

name: RHUBARB CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, lightly beaten with whisk
3  Tbsp. milk
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
4  c. rhubarb
1  Tbsp. butter
2  (9-inch) unbaked pie crusts
preparation: In 9-inch unbaked pie crust, place these ingredients: Combine eggs and milk; add sugar, flour and nutmeg, then rhubarb.  Dot ingredients in shell with butter.  Add top crust.  Bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 400°.  (May cover lightly with foil.)

name: EGG SALAD
ingredients:
1  envelope Knox gelatine
1/4  c. cold water
4  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. pickle relish
1  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Soften gelatine in cold water; place bowl over boiling water and stir until gelatine is dissolved.  Cool and beat into mayonnaise.  Add other ingredients.

name: CREAM CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 large  pkg. cream cheese
2 small  pkg. thin lunch ham, chopped fine
6  green onions, sliced fine (a little of the green part)
1  dash hot sauce
1  dash Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Chop 1 package of ham (fine) and put in a bowl.  Chop the other package of ham (fine) in another bowl and set aside.  Mix cream cheese, 1 package ham, onion, hot sauce and Worcestershire.  Mix well and shape into a ball.  Roll ball into other package of ham to cover.  Refrigerate until firm.  Serve with your favorite crackers.

name: MARY CATHERINE'S CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  pt. whipping cream
1  can Hershey's syrup (16 oz.)
2  cans Eagle Brand milk
milk to fill ice cream can
Nestle Quik liquid
preparation: Mix the ingredients and put in ice cream can (1 gallon). Finish filling can with milk and add 5 teaspoons Nestle Quik (liquid) for each 4 cups of milk added.  Follow instructions for your ice cream freezer to make the ice cream.

name: ROLLS
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. shortening
1  pkg. yeast
1 1/2  c. warm water
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  egg
preparation: Mix flour and shortening like making biscuits.  Mix all ingredients together.  Dissolve yeast in warm water, then add to flour and shortening mixture.  Mix well and let set for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Roll the dough out and cut with biscuit cutter.  Fold each one in half and brush with melted butter.  Bake at 400° until brown.

name: CORN WAFFLES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. corn meal
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  egg
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. water
1  c. corn
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix flour, corn meal, sugar, baking powder and salt.  In another bowl, whisk egg, melted butter, water, corn and vanilla. Stir into flour mixture.  Cook waffles.

name: DIABETIC ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  carton low-fat cottage cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1  pkg. artificially sweetened orange gelatin
preparation: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Chill for several hours. Yields 6 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE COVERED PEANUTS
ingredients:
1  pkg. white almond bark
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
3  Tbsp. cocoa
preparation: Melt ingredients together, mixing well.  Stir in a large jar of dry roasted peanuts.  Stir well and drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.

name: NO PEEK MYSTERY STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. stew meat
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1  c. ginger ale
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can sliced mushrooms
preparation: Mix all ingredients in pan with tight fitting lid (a heavy Dutch oven).  Cover first with foil, the put tight fitting lid over foil.  Cook 3 hours at 300°.  Don't peek while cooking. Serve over buttered noodles or rice.

name: COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. buttermilk
1/3  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. margarine
2  c. sugar
5  eggs, separated
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine buttermilk and baking soda; stir and allow to become foamy.  Set aside.  Sift flour and then measure amount needed for recipe.  Add baking powder to flour and set aside.  In a large mixing bowl, cream the margarine and sugar.  Add beaten egg yolks, vanilla, buttermilk and salt; mix.  Add flour mixture a little at a time; beat well.  In separate bowl, beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into batter.  Pour batter into 3 greased and floured round cake pans.  Bake in a 350° oven until done.  Cool.  Frost with Seven Minute Frosting.

name: LAYERED BEAN DIP (PIZZA)
ingredients:
1  (31 oz.) refried beans
1  (4 oz.) green chilies, chopped and drained
1  envelope taco seasoning mix (1 1/4 oz.)
2  ripe avocados, peeled, pitted and mashed
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  (16 oz.) taco sauce
1 1/2  c. sour cream
3  c. shredded lettuce
1 1/2  c. (6 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1 small  can black olives, chopped
tortilla chips
2  tomatoes, chopped
preparation: Mix refried beans, green chilies and taco seasoning mix. Spread on 12-inch round platter.  Blend avocados, lemon juice and 1/2 cup taco sauce until smooth.  Spread on top of mixture. Spread sour cream on top of avocado mixture.  Top with shredded lettuce, cheese, taco sauce, tomatoes and black olives (will resemble a pizza).

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 -15  oz. can fruit cocktail
2  or 3 sliced bananas
1 large  can chunk pineapple
marshmallows - desired amount
1  cup whipping cream
preparation: Mix fruit, marshmallows and cream together.  Beat egg, sugar and vinegar together and cook in double boiler until thickened, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Add lemon juice and mustard, mix well.  (Fruit can be substituted or more added according to taste.)  Pour cooled dressing over fruit, adding bananas just before serving. 10 to 12 servings.

name: MARILYN'S LASAGNA
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. olive oil
1 small  can tomato paste
1  lb. Ralph's Italian sausage
2 large  cans tomato sauce
2  large onions, chopped
6  cloves garlic, chopped
salt and pepper
Parmesan cheese
American cheese, shredded
Mozzarella cheese, shredded
lasagna noodles
preparation: In a large deep pot, place olive oil, tomato paste and crumbled sausage. Brown mixture for about 6 minutes, stirring frequently. Add tomato sauce, onions, garlic, salt and pepper. Cover and simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Boil lasagna noodles. Use olive oil to grease bottom and sides of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Place a layer of noodles on the bottom. Drop spoonfuls of gravy over them.  Sprinkle cheeses over this. Repeat layers until dish is full. Top with Parmesan cheese. Bake in a 350° oven for about 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. oats
1/4  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. tomato juice
1  egg, beaten
1/2  lb. sausage
preparation: Combine all ingredients and pack into an ungreased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: RAISIN NUT OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. (1 stick) margarine, softened
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg white
1/2  c. low-fat milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. oatmeal
2/3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. raisins
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix ingredients. Drop by teaspoons on greased cookie sheet.  Bake 12 to 14 minutes.  Cool one minute on cookie sheet.  Makes 5 dozen.

name: SALMON PATTIES
ingredients:
15  oz. can salmon, drained (reserve 2 Tbsp.)
1  egg
1/3  c. chopped onion
flavored bread crumbs
1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  Tbsp. shortening
preparation: Combine salmon, egg and onion.  Stir in flour.  Stir baking powder into salmon liquid; add to salmon and onion mixture.  Form mixture into 6 patties.  Heat shortening in skillet and fry patties on each side until golden brown.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIR CAKE
ingredients:
1  box graham crackers
2  boxes instant vanilla pudding
1  c. powdered sugar
3  c. milk
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  can light chocolate frosting
preparation: Mix pudding, powdered sugar and milk for 2 minutes on low speed.  Fold in Cool Whip into pudding mixture; set aside.  Lightly grease (with Pam) bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.  Line bottom of pan with a layer of whole graham crackers (break in half to make fit, if needed).  Pour half of pudding mixture over crackers.  Put another layer of graham crackers.  Pour remainder of pudding over that.  Put another layer of graham crackers on top, then frost with chocolate frosting.  Refrigerate; cut into squares to serve.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. (6 medium) squash, boiled 4 to 5 minutes
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. green pepper, chopped fine
1/4  tsp. thyme
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Beat eggs.  Blend in mayonnaise, onion, green pepper and thyme.  Mix well.  Add to cooked squash.  Butter a casserole. Sprinkle cheese over top and dot with butter.  Put in fridge after it is covered with Saran Wrap.  Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 25 minutes or until lightly brown.

name: TEXAS HASH
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oleo
1  medium onion
1  bell pepper
1  can tomatoes
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. raw rice
preparation: Brown onion and bell pepper in oleo, then add ground beef and brown.  Remove from fire.  Mix with tomatoes and uncooked rice. Add salt and pepper to taste.  Put in casserole and bake at 300° for about 1 hour.

name: YOGURT CORN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
1  c. whole wheat flour
2  Tbsp. honey
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. plain low-fat yogurt
1  egg
1/4  c. safflower oil
1/4  c. water
preparation: Combine cornmeal, flour, honey, baking powder and salt.  Add yogurt, egg, oil and water, mixing just until dry ingredients are moistened.  Fill 12 oiled or paper-lined muffin cups 3/4 full. Bake at 425° for 15 to 18 minutes.

name: COOKIE PRESS SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/2  sticks margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
3 1/4  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar well.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Add flour gradually; cream well.   Add vanilla and mix well.   Force through cookie press into desired shapes onto an ungreased cookie sheet.  Decorate with colored sugars, chocolate chips or colored candies before baking.  Bake at 375° until lightly browned.

name: MINI CHEESECAKES
ingredients:
12  vanilla wafers
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
cherry pie filling (optional)
crushed vanilla wafers (for topping, optional)
preparation: Line muffin tin with foil liners.  Place 1 vanilla wafer in the bottom of each.  Mix cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and eggs until smooth.  Fill cups and add toppings.  Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.

name: DORITO'S CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 chicken breasts or 2  cans chicken
1  bag Doritos
1  can Ro-Tel chilies and tomatoes
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  small chopped onion
preparation: Cook chicken breast; layer bottom of casserole dish with Doritos. Mix chicken, soup, Ro-Tel and onion; pour over Doritos. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: PEAS AND BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. cornmeal
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1  onion, chopped
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  can black-eyed peas, drained slightly
1  can green chilies
1 small  can cream-style corn
1  lb. ground meat, browned with onions and drained
preparation: Add soda to buttermilk and set aside.  Mix cornmeal, flour, salt, eggs, oil and buttermilk.  Add peas, green chilies, corn, meat and all the grated cheese except a small amount for top. Pour into a well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: PAT'S CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
2  cans chili beans
2  cans kidney beans
1  can mushrooms
1  medium onion, chopped
1  medium green pepper, chopped
1  can whole tomatoes
1  can tomato juice
1 to 2  Tbsp. crushed red pepper
chili powder to taste
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown ground chuck with onion and green pepper.  Add rest of the ingredients.  Let simmer on stove or crock-pot for 3 to 4 hours.

name: LEMON BISQUE
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. lemon jello
1 1/2  c. hot water
1  c. sugar
1 large  can Carnation milk
2  lemons
crushed vanilla wafer crumbs
preparation: Dissolve jello in hot water.  Stir in sugar while hot.  Let stand until mixture cools.  Whip Carnation milk until it stands in a peak, then stir in jello and sugar.  Add juice of 2 lemons and mix well.  Pour into a pan (9 x 11-inch) lined with crushed vanilla wafer crumbs.  Sprinkle crumbs on top; refrigerate.

name: PEPPER HASH
ingredients:
12  large red sweet peppers
12  large green peppers
15  medium sized onions
3  pods hot pepper
3 1/2  c. vinegar
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. celery seed
preparation: Use coarse grinding blade and grind all together.  Then cook all together for one hour.  Pour into hot jars and seal.  Makes 6 pints.

name: "CHOCOLATE CHEESE CAKE TO DIE FOR"
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. melted butter
3  pkg. (8 oz. each) softened cream cheese
1 1/3  c. chocolate chips
4  eggs
1/4  c. flour
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  carton sour cream
1  Tbsp. grated lemon rind
1 1/3  c. sweetened condensed milk
fruit topping (for garnish if desired)
preparation: Combine cracker crumbs and sugar; stir in butter.  Press on the bottom and 2-inches up the sides of a 9-inch spring-form pan.

name: POPPY SEED CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  to 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts
1 family size  can cream of chicken soup
16  oz. sour cream
2  sleeves Ritz crackers
1/2  stick butter
poppy seeds
preparation: Prepare chicken breasts in a pan of oil or use an inside grill. When chicken breasts are done, take them off and dice them. Place them in bottom of glass casserole dish. Crush Ritz crackers. In a shallow baking pan, place butter to melt. Mix butter with Ritz crackers and sprinkle poppy seeds in. Bake in oven until lightly toasted. Take out and set aside.

name: FRYPAN COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. dates
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. butter
2  beaten eggs
2  c. Rice Krispies
3/4  c. chopped nuts
coconut
preparation: Combine dates, sugar, butter and eggs in frypan.  Cook 8 to 10 minutes.  Add nuts and Rice Krispies.  In another bowl, shape into balls and coat in coconut.

name: BAKED APPLES
ingredients:
4  baking apples (such as McIntosh or Rome)
cinnamon red hot candies
brown sugar
7  oz. bottle ginger ale
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Core apples and peel 1/3 of the way down.  Arrange in baking dish.  Fill cavities with cinnamon candies and top with generous sprinkling of brown sugar.  Pour the ginger ale into the dish.  Bake, uncovered, for 40 minutes, basting apples with liquid from time to time.

name: PERFECT CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. cocoa
2  c. boiling water
2 3/4  c. sifted all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. butter, softened
2 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In medium bowl, combine cocoa with boiling water, mixing with wire whisk until smooth.  Cool completely.

name: ZUCCHINI BARS
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. grated zucchini
1  c. coconut
3/4  c. nuts (these last two optional, but very good)
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs and vanilla; stir in flour and baking powder.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Spread real well in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Spread with Cinnamon Frosting.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
3  egg yolks
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. lemon extract
preparation: Mix in order given and pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake  at 450° for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and continue baking for 40 minutes.

name: FORGOTTEN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  egg whites
pinch of salt
pinch of cream of tartar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Note:  You might want to prepare in the late evening.

name: HAM DELIGHTS
ingredients:
1  lb. boiled ham (may use baked ham)
5  oz. Swiss cheese, at room temperature
1/4  lb. margarine, at room temperature
3  Tbsp. prepared mustard
3  Tbsp. poppy seed
1  small onion
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Grind ham and grate cheese.  Mix together with all other ingredients.  Spread in Pepperidge Farm buns (small).  Place in bun pan.  Cover with aluminum foil.  Heat for 10 minutes in oven at 400° or until warm.  One recipe makes approximately 30 buns. Excellent to freeze and serve later.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans chunk pineapple, drained
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. plain flour
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  stack Ritz crackers, crushed
1  stick butter
preparation: Use a 2-quart casserole.  Put drained pineapple in bottom of dish.  Mix flour, sugar and cheese and put on top of pineapple. Then put on Ritz crackers and pour melted butter over crackers. Preheat oven to 350°.  Bake 30 minutes.

name: FUDGE BROWNIE PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) unbaked pastry shell
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips (6 oz.)
1/4  c. margarine or butter
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk*
1/2  c. biscuit baking mix
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: *Note:  Do not use evaporated milk.

name: POPPY SEED CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix
4  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. cold water
1  jar poppy seed
preparation: Combine the first 6 ingredients and add poppy seed.  Pour into a Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philly cream cheese
1  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. lemon juice
chopped pecans
preparation: Mix well.  Form small balls and roll in chopped pecans.

name: FUDGE'S FUDGE
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter
3  c. sugar
2/3  c. evaporated milk
12  oz. pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
7  oz. jar marshmallow creme
1  c. nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Grease 13x9 in. pan.  Mix margarine, sugar and milk in heavy 2 1/2 qt. pan.  Bring to a full rolling boil on medium heat; stirring constantly.  Continue boiling 5 minutes on medium heat or until candy thermometer reaches 234 degrees.  Remove from heat. Stir in chips until melted.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Pour into pan.  Cool at room temperature.

name: CHOCOLATE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar (granulated)
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: This can be used for cream pies by omitting the chocolate chips and adding bananas, coconut, pineapple, etc.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. oil
3  c. brown sugar, packed
1  c. white sugar
2  c. grated zucchini
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. cinnamon
3  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Beat eggs until foamy in mixing bowl.  Add sugars, oil, vanilla, cinnamon, salt, soda, baking powder, zucchini and flour. Mix well.  Turn batter into 2 greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pans and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Remove from pans and cool on rack.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS IN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
split chicken breasts
1 large  can Great American Heinz chicken rice with mushroom soup, chunky chicken vegetable soup or golden mushroom soup
1 small  can sliced mushrooms
dash of salt, pepper and garlic salt
preparation: Remove skin from split breasts and place in casserole.  Pour soup and sliced mushrooms over chicken.  Add salt, pepper and garlic salt.  Cover and cook in oven at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Ready to serve.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FINGERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1/3  c. peanut butter
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  c. quick cook oats
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1/4  c. peanut butter
2 to 4  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and brown sugar; blend in egg, peanut butter, baking soda, salt and vanilla.  Stir in flour and oats. Spread in 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle with chocolate chips; let stand 5 minutes.

name: ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 large  can asparagus
4  hard-boiled eggs, sliced
1  can mushroom soup
1/2 to 1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Arrange half of  the  asparagus  in  bottom  of greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Top  with  slices of egg, and sprinkle with cheese.  Spoon in half of soup.  Repeat layers.  Top with bread crumbs and bake  in  moderate  oven (350°) about 30 minutes. Serves 6.

name: HAM ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. Pepperidge Farm party rolls
8  oz. sliced ham
6  oz. Swiss cheese (deli thin)
1  stick margarine, melted
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. onion flakes
1 1/2  tsp. poppy seed
preparation: Slice rolls.  Put on cheese and ham.  Put top on.  Mix other ingredients and pour over rolls.  Leave uncovered until margarine sets. Cover and bake 15 minutes at 350°.  Can be frozen.

name: TOSTITOS
ingredients:
2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
6  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/4  c. minced onion
garlic powder to taste
1  large bag Tostitos
preparation: Mix all ingredients and spread each chip with cheese mixture. Place 10 to 12 Tostitos on serving plate.  Microwave at 50% power for 1 minute or until cheese is melted. Serve warm. Give dish 1/4 turn during cooking.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
2  or 3 small bananas, mashed
1 3/4  c. sifted all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. shortening or butter, softened
2  eggs, unbeaten
1/2  c. nut meats, chopped (optional)
preparation: Sift flour once before measuring. Grease a loaf pan, 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch size.  Preheat oven to 350°.  In a small bowl, slice bananas and beat until mashed.  Measure out 1 cup.  Sift together in a large bowl the flour, baking powder, baking soda, sugar and salt.  Add shortening or butter, eggs, nuts and mashed bananas. Beat together until well blended.  Pour into prepared loaf pan and bake about 1 hour or until done.

name: CRANBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. shortening, melted
1  egg, beaten
1  c. sugar
1  c. cranberries
1/2  c. nuts
2  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Bake for 1 hour in a greased and floured loaf pan at 350°.

name: MAN'S SOUP
ingredients:
2  pt. fresh oysters
1/4  c. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
2  c. light cream
parsley, chopped
1/2  tsp. butter
preparation: Drain oysters and save liquid.  Melt butter in large pot. Cook oysters 5 minutes or until edges curl.  Add salt, pepper, oyster liquid and cream.  Heat on medium until bubbles begin to form.  Sprinkle with parsley.  Serves 4.  Preparation time:  5 minutes.  Cooking time:  15 minutes.

name: SHRIMP CHOWDER
ingredients:
1  c. potatoes, diced
1  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. leeks, chopped
1/2  c. carrots, chopped
1  c. clam juice
1  c. chicken broth
2  Tbsp. tomato paste
1/2  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. thyme
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. low-fat yogurt (plain)
2  Tbsp. flour
1  lb. shrimp, cleaned
preparation: Combine potatoes, celery, green pepper, leeks, carrots, clam juice and broth in large pan. Bring to boiling. Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes. Place half of vegetable liquid mixture in bowl of blender. Cover and process until pureed. Blend in tomato paste and seasonings. Combine yogurt and flour. Stir a small amount of pureed mixture into yogurt. Combine yogurt mixture with remaining vegetable mixture. Stir in remaining mixture and shrimp. Heat through, but do not boil. Serve with oyster crackers.

name: SPAGHETTI WITH WHITE CLAM SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. olive oil
4  cloves garlic, crushed
1/2  c. chopped fresh parsley
3 (10 1/2 oz.)  cans minced clams
1  lb. spaghetti or linguine
2  Tbsp. butter
Parmesan cheese
preparation: In a large skillet, saute garlic in oil until brown.  Discard garlic.  Add parsley, salt and pepper.  Drain juice from clams and add to oil mixture.  Bring to a boil.  Add clams and heat through. Cook pasta.  Toss with butter.  Top with 1/2 clam sauce.  Serve with remaining sauce and grated cheese.  Serves 4.

name: TUTTI-FRUTTI ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. sugar
3  ripe bananas, mashed
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained and chopped
1 (6 oz.)  jar maraschino cherries, drained and chopped
3  c. milk
1  c. water
preparation: Combine sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice, sugar and fruit; blend well.  Add 3 cups milk and water.  Pour mixture into freezer can of a 1-gallon hand-turned or electric freezer.  Freeze according to manufacturer's instructions.  Allow ice cream to ripen at least 1 hour.  Yields 2 quarts.

name: ROAST PORK WITH FENNEL
ingredients:
2  lb. pork tenderloin or boneless chops (6)
1  bottle fennel seeds
garlic powder
salt
pepper
onion powder
2  Tbsp. extra virgin olive oil
preparation: Sprinkle generous amounts of garlic powder, salt, pepper and onion powder on all sides of meat and roll in fennel seeds.

name: CONFETTI SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen hashbrown potatoes
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1 soup  can milk
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1  small green pepper, cut up
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
dash of pepper
1  c. cheese cracker crumbs, divided
preparation: In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat.  Saute onion until tender.  Stir in potatoes, soup and milk.  Add cheese, green pepper and 1/2 cup of the crumbs and pimento.   Pour in a shallow casserole.  Top with remaining crumbs.  Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: LEMON PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. grated lemon rind (1 lemon)
1/4  c. lemon juice
2  eggs
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix together flour, sugar and salt.  Stir in lemon rind, juice, well beaten egg yolks and milk.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.  Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole or 6 custard cups.  Set in pan of water (1-inch deep).  Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°. Serve warm or cold.  Good with whipped cream.

name: BANANA PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. lime Kool-Aid
2  c. sugar
3  bananas, whipped
1 liter  bottle Sprite
2  qt. water
1 large  can pineapple juice
1 small  can frozen orange juice
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  May freeze if desired (may leave bananas out).

name: BANANA BRAN BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
3/4  c. honey
2  eggs
4  or 5 mashed bananas (1 1/2 c.)
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. bran
1 1/2  c. plain flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Cream together the butter and honey.  Blend in eggs, bananas and vanilla.  Add bran and let stand 5 minutes.  Mix all dry ingredients and blend into banana mixture.  Pour into 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan, greased and floured.  Bake at 350° for 65 minutes.  Cool 10 minutes.

name: MELBA'S DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. plain flour
1  c. margarine
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine ingredients and press in 9 x 14 Pyrex pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Cool.

name: EASY STRAWBERRY JAM
ingredients:
2  c. mashed strawberries
1  box Sure-Jell fruit pectin
4  c. sugar
3/4  c. water
preparation: Mix strawberries and sugar thoroughly.  Set aside 10 minutes. Stir Sure-Jell with water in saucepan.  Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Boil 1 minute.  Remove from heat.  Stir mixtures together until sugar is completely dissolved and no longer grainy. Pour into plastic containers.  Cover.  Let stand at room temperature 24 hours.  Store in freezer.  After opening, store in refrigerator.  Makes about 4 (8 ounce) containers.

name: BAKED PINEAPPLE AND CHEESE
ingredients:
2 large (15 1/2 oz.)  cans pineapple chunks
2  c. sharp cheese
1  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. flour
1  cube Ritz crackers
1  stick margarine
preparation: Partially drain pineapple and mix with grated cheese.  Mix sugar and flour and add all together. Butter lightly a 9 x 13 x 2-inch dish.  Pour mixture in dish and top with cracker crumbs. Pour melted butter over crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Reduce sugar if pineapple is sweetened.

name: CHEW CAKES
ingredients:
1  box light brown sugar
1  stick margarine, melted
3  eggs
2  c. self-rising flour
1  Tbsp. milk
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, mix well after each.  Add remaining ingredients. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.  Cool and cut into squares.

name: ERMINE ICING
ingredients:
5  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
preparation: Cook  flour  and milk until thick, stirring constantly. Cool until completely cold.  Add sugar, shortening and vanilla and beat until  icing is of spreading consistency.	It should be fluffy, almost like whipped cream.

name: WORKING GIRL'S COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  box pudding
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. oil
4  eggs
1  c. water
8  oz. sour cream
12  oz. coconut
2  c. sugar
1  container Cool Whip
preparation: This cake is best made a few days before serving.  Bake cake combining cake mix, pudding,  mayonnaise,  oil,  eggs and water; mix well and bake at 350°.  When cake is cool, cut into 2 or 3 layers or use layer pans to bake 2 or 3 layers.

name: SOY SAUCE AND SESAME SEED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. chicken (legs and thighs, breasts do not work as well)
soy sauce
sesame seed
preparation: Spray a flat pan with nonstick spray.  Add chicken and cover pan with soy sauce (it needs plenty of sauce).  Shake sesame seed over; cover with foil.  Bake at 375° for about 1 hour.  Uncover; baste.  Turn oven down to 350°; cook about 30 minutes or until well done.  It will stay hot a long time and seems to be a favorite every time.

name: FANTASY FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3/4  c. butter
2/3  c. evaporated milk
1-12 oz pkg chocolate chips
1 7 oz  jar marshmallow cream
1  tsp vanilla
preparation: Melt butter over medium heat in a pan.  Add sugar, milk; stir until a full rolling boil stirring all the time.  Continue boiling 5 minutes; remove from heat.  Stir in chocolate chips and cream, vanilla.  Mix together until smooth putting into greased pan.  Cool and cut into squares.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. softened cream cheese
1 (9 oz.)  can cream of coconut
1  family size Cool Whip
small can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Mix well.  Place in serving bowl.  Serve with cut fresh fruit.

name: OLD FASHION CARAMEL PIE
ingredients:
2  c. milk
1  c. sugar
3  eggs, separated
pinch of salt
1/2  stick margarine
4  Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. vanilla
9-inch baked pie crust
preparation: In heavy skillet, add sugar, flour and salt.  Place on heat and heat without stirring until 3 to 4 small puffs of smoke rise out of mixture.  Have milk ready to pour in at that moment and stir, stirring frequently.  The sugar, flour mixture hardens, but will dissolve with slow heat and stirring, cook and stir until crystals melt and is thickened.  Beat egg yolks until creamy. Lift out several spoonfuls of caramel.  Mix with egg yolks.  Add egg yolk.  Mix to caramel in skillet.  Add butter and vanilla. Mix well.  Pour into pie crust.

name: TIGER BUTTER
ingredients:
1  lb. white chocolate
1  lb. semi-sweet chocolate, melted
1 (12 oz.)  jar chunky peanut butter
preparation: Combine white chocolate and peanut butter in double boiler. Bring water to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cook until mixture melts, stirring constantly. Spread in waxed paper lined pan.  Pour semi-sweet chocolate over top and swirl with knife to marbleize. Chill until firm.  Cut into desired size. Refrigerate.

name: CONGO SQUARES
ingredients:
2 3/4  c. flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. shortening
2 1/4  c. brown sugar (1 pkg.)
3  eggs
1  c. nuts
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix and sift flour, baking powder and salt.  Melt shortening. Add brown sugar.  Stir until well mixed.  Allow to cool slightly. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.  Add dry ingredients, then nuts and chocolate chips.  Bake in greased pan (10 1/2 x 15 1/2-inch) at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  unbaked pie shell
1 1/4  c. pecans, chopped
3  eggs, lightly beaten
1  c. dark corn syrup
1  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. melted butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream butter and sugar together.  Add remaining ingredients and pour into pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: CUCUMBER SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
garlic salt
grated onion
1  large cucumber
mayonnaise
1  large loaf white bread
preparation: Trim crust edges off bread.  Grate cucumber; drain well on paper towel.  Mix softened cream cheese with garlic salt and grated onion according to taste.  Blend in cucumber.  Spread very light coat of mayo on bread slices for easy spreading.  Spread mixture thinly on bread.  Cut sandwiches in fourths or halves.  Refrigerate until served.  (Good for parties.)

name: PUMPKIN AND SPICE ROLL
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. canned pumpkin
1  tsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. finely chopped nuts
1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: For Cake:  In a large bowl, beat eggs for 5 minutes at high speed.  Gradually add sugar, mixing well.  Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice.  In a separate bowl, combine flour, cinnamon, baking soda, ginger, nutmeg and salt.  Fold into the pumpkin mixture.

name: INSIDE OUT RAVIOLI
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  jar Ragu spaghetti sauce with mushrooms
1  (8 oz.) tomato paste
1  (6 oz.) tomato sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  c. shredded American cheese
1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
2  well beaten eggs
1/4  c. salad oil
1  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
7  oz. elbow macaroni
1  lb. ground meat
1  medium onion
1  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Cook macaroni and drain.  Brown ground meat and chopped onion in oil.  Cook spinach.  Drain; save liquid and add water to make 1 cup.  Set aside.

name: HANNAH'S FROZEN FRUIT RING
ingredients:
16  large marshmallows
1  c. crushed pineapple
3  bananas, sliced
1  c. maraschino cherries, quartered
1  c. peaches, diced
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  pt. whipping cream, whipped
1  c. small marshmallows
chopped pecans (optional)
preparation: Steam large marshmallows and pineapple until melted (double boiler).  Cool and add mayonnaise and whipping cream.  Add rest of ingredients except small marshmallows.  Last, fold in small marshmallows.  Turn into mold and freeze.

name: NO PEEK PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
1/2  stick melted oleo
2  c. sugar
2  c. milk
1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla extract
coconut
preparation: Beat eggs  well,  add  melted oleo, sugar, milk, flour, salt, baking  powder,  vanilla  and desired amount of coconut. Mix all this together and pour into two 8-inch pie pans.  Bake at 350° for 30 or 35 minutes.  You can also use chopped pecans instead of coconut.

name: NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. noodles, cooked according to directions
1  can tuna or chicken, or ham or salmon or beef
1  can cream of mushroom soup
bread crumbs or crushed potato chips
preparation: Arrange alternate layers of cooked noodles, tuna and soup in greased casserole. Begin and end with noodles. Cover with 1/2 cup soft bread crumbs or potato chips. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: PORK CHOPS WITH MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. cornmeal
3  Tbsp. fine dry bread crumbs
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
salt and pepper to taste
4  lean pork chops, cut 1/2-inch thick
1/2  lb. mushrooms, sliced
1  clove garlic, crushed
1/4  tsp. rosemary
1/2  c. whipping cream
1/4  c. thinly sliced green onions
preparation: In a paper bag, combine Parmesan, cornmeal, bread crumbs, garlic salt and oregano.  Melt butter in a skillet; dip each chop into butter.  Drain briefly, then shake each chop in the bag. Shake off excess coating and arrange chops on rack of a broiler pan.  Bake, uncovered, in 400° oven about 40 to 50 minutes. Meanwhile, heat the butter remaining in skillet over medium heat; add mushrooms and garlic and saute 5 minutes.  Stir in rosemary and cream and cook over high heat until liquid is reduced to about 1/4 cup.  Stir in green onions and salt and pepper to taste.  Pour into a bowl and pass at the table with pork chops.

name: SNOWBALL CAKE
ingredients:
2  envelopes unflavored gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1/4  c. cold water
1 large  can crushed pineapple with juice
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. lemon juice
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and let stand.  Then add remaining ingredients.  Mix well and refrigerate for 1 1/2 hours.

name: ROLLER COASTERS
ingredients:
sliced ham
sliced American cheese
preparation: Lay one slice cheese on one slice ham.  Roll up and secure with toothpick.  Serve as finger food.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
4  Cups Flour
2  tsp. Baking Soda
1  Cup Margarine, Softened
1  tsp. Salt
1 1/2  Cup Sugar
2  Eggs
5  mashed Bananas
1/2  Cup Chocolate Chips
preparation: Sift together four, soda and salt.  Mix in a separate bowl. Set aside.  Mix margarine and sugar in another bowl.  Add eggs and bananas to margarine and sugar mixture.  Mix in dry ingredients. Add chocolate chips.  Put in 2 loaf pans or 5 foil pans.  Bake 1 hour at 350 for loaf pans and foil pans at 350 for 40-50 minutes.

name: MOTHER'S OATS SPICE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. shortening
4  c. quick Mothers oats
1  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. raisins
1  egg
1 1/3  c. sweet milk
2  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Sift flour before measuring.  Mix all dry ingredients, adding rolled oats last.  Melt shortening and mix with brown sugar.  Add egg and beat well.  Pour in milk, then add dry ingredients and raisins.  Drop on greased pan.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.  This was our grandmother Folks' recipe.

name: CHERRY CHEESE PIZZA
ingredients:
pastry for two crust 9-inch pie
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/3  c. pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
2 (1 lb.)  cans cherry pie filling
1  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Roll pastry in 14-inch circle; put in 12-inch pizza pan. Flute edges; prick.  Bake at 300° for 15 minutes.  Blend cheese and sugar; add eggs and beat well.  Add nuts and vanilla.  Pour into partially baked crust and bake for 10 minutes; cool.  Spread pie filling over cheese layer and chill.  Top with Cool Whip before serving.

name: MEATBALL SOUP
ingredients:
4  lb. ground beef
2  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1  c. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. parsley
2  cloves garlic
1/2 to 1  c. milk
2  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  large onion, diced
2  or 3 (24 oz.) bags mixed vegetables
4  cans beef noodle soup
4  cans tomato soup
6 beef bouillon cubes, dissolved in 4  c. vegetable water
1/2 to 1  c. water
preparation: In large cooking pot, prepare mixed vegetables.  When tender, drain and set aside the cooking  water from vegetables.  To vegetables add noodle soup, tomato soup and beef bouillon dissolved in vegetable water.  Add meatballs as they brown.  After browning meatballs, pour off fat.  Add 1/2 to 1 cup water to pan and scrape meat pieces. Add to soup.  More vegetable water can be added, depending on how thick you like it.  Freeze leftovers.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked rice
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  pkg. Lipton onion soup
6  c. hot water
3  or 4 uncooked chicken breasts, cut into pieces
preparation: Spread rice in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine onion soup with the boiling water and cream of chicken soup. Stir into rice in baking dish.  Place chicken pieces on top.  Cover dish lightly with foil. Bake at 350° for 2 hours.  Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer or until all liquid is absorbed.

name: SWEET AND TANGY BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
3  cloves garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. red wine vinegar
1/3  c. water
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. instant beef bouillon
1  tsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Combine onion, garlic and oil in a 1-quart casserole.  Cover with lid.  Microwave on High for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes, or until tender.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Cover; microwave on High 5 to 6 minutes.  Sauce can be covered and refrigerated for up to 2 weeks.

name: FUDGE MICROWAVE
ingredients:
1  lb. powdered sugar
3/4  c. peanut butter
1/3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Put powdered sugar, peanut butter, oleo and milk in microwave bowl.  Cook on High for 1 minute.  Remove.  Add vanilla and beat until smooth.  Put in 8-inch square pan and refrigerate.

name: PAMPERED BEEF FILLETS
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  can chopped mushrooms, drained (1/2 c.)
1/4  c. snipped green onion
1  c. Burgundy
1  tsp. salt
9  (4 oz.) beef fillets (1 inch + thick)
9  fresh mushroom crowns
preparation: In saucepan, combine chopped mushrooms, onion and 1/2 cup of water; simmer 5 minutes.  Stir Burgundy, salt and dash of pepper. Place in plastic bag.  Pour in wine sauce.  Fasten bag securely. Marinate in refrigerator for several hours.  Remove fillets, reserving sauce.  Broil 3 inches from heat for 7 minutes.  Turn and broil 6 minutes.  Top with mushroom crowns (X-shape in top) last few minutes of broiling.  Sprinkle with snipped parsley. Heat sauce and serve.

name: BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour, sifted
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs
1/3  c. sour milk
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  large bananas, mashed
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift together the flour, salt and baking powder.  Beat remaining ingredients together until fluffy.  Add dry ingredients to batter; mix.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
2 large  pkg. Oreos, crushed
1/3  c. powdered sugar
2 small  pkg. instant French vanilla pudding mix
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. butter, softened
4  c. milk
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip or more
preparation: Mix pudding and set aside.  Mix the cream cheese, sugar and butter.  Add to pudding mix and then fold in Cool Whip.  Layer; start and finish with crushed cookies.

name: Pineapple Cheese Ball
ingredients:
16  oz. Cream cheese, room temp
8 1/2  oz. Crushed pineapple, drained
1/4  c. chopped bell pepper
1  tbsp. season salt
2  tbsp. finely chopped onion
2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine all ingredients except for 1 c. pecans and mix well. Refrigerate until firm. Shape into a ball and roll in remaining pecans.

name: SOUR CREAM AND RAISIN PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/3  c. shortening
4 to 5  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Mix flour and salt. Cut in shortening until pieces are pea size. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the cold water over the mixture and blend together. Continue with the rest of the water, one tablespoon at a time. Form dough into a ball. Roll out into a 12-inch diameter circle. Put into pie plate and prick the bottom of the shell with a fork. Line pastry with a double thickness of foil. Bake in a 450° oven for 8 minutes. Remove foil. Bake 5 to 6 minutes more or until golden. Cool on a wire rack.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1  can artichokes, drained and chopped
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1  c. grated pizza cheese
1  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven. Sprinkle with parsley flakes.  Serve with crackers.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  stick butter, melted
3  Tbsp. self-rising flour
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  unbaked (still frozen) pie shells
coconut
preparation: Beat eggs and add sugar.  Beat well and add butter, flour, buttermilk and vanilla; mix well.  Pour into pie shells.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.  Sprinkle coconut over pies about 5 minutes before removing from oven.

name: SWEET POTATO MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 1/4  c. canned sweet potatoes, mashed
1 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. milk
1/4  c. pecans or walnuts, chopped
1/2  c. raisins, chopped
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Grease 1 1/2-inch muffin tins.  Cream the butter and sugar.  Add the eggs and mix well.  Blend in the sweet potatoes.  Sift the flour with the baking powder, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Add alternately with the milk.  Do not overmix.  Fold in the nuts and raisins.  Fill the greased muffin tins 2/3 full.  Bake for 25 minutes.  Makes about 6 dozen.  These muffins freeze well.

name: CHERRY CENTER BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. confectioners sugar
2  Tbsp. evaporated milk
1  stick oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. coconut
cherries
graham cracker crumbs
preparation: Mix ingredients except crumbs, together until smooth with electric mixer.  Form ball and put cherry in center.  Roll in graham cracker crumbs.  Refrigerate.

name: COCONUT CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  baked 9-inch pastry shell
1/4  c. Argo cornstarch
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flaked coconut
6  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix cornstarch, 2/3 cup sugar and salt in a double boiler top. Slowly stir in milk.  Cook over boiling water, stirring constantly until thick enough to mound slightly when dropped from spoon. Cover; cook 10 minutes longer, stirring occasionally.  Stir a little hot mixture into beaten egg yolks; then stir all into remaining hot mixture.  Cook 2 minutes, stirring constantly.

name: MACARONI WITH CHEESE
ingredients:
12  c. water
4 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. olive oil
1/2  lb. macaroni
1/4  lb. (4 oz.) butter
1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. salt
1  qt. (4 c.) milk
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: While macaroni is boiling, prepare the sauce as follows: In saucepan, melt butter slowly.  Blend in flour and salt.  Add milk gradually and stir with a wooden spoon over moderate heat until mixture boils and thickens.  Remove from heat.

name: APRICOT JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. apricot jello
1/3  c. sugar
1 large  can crushed pineapple
2  pkg. Dream Whip or 8 oz. container Cool Whip
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream, cheese, softened
3  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Bring jello and sugar to a boil.  Add pineapple.  Cool.  Cream milk and cream cheese.  Add Dream Whip.  Add to pineapple mixture. Refrigerate.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. Wesson oil
2  eggs
1/4  c. water
2/3  tsp. soda
1/3  tsp. cinnamon
1/3  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. sugar
1  can pumpkin
preparation: Mix until smooth.  Bake for 1 hour at 350° in loaf pan.

name: HOT DOG SAUCE
ingredients:
3/4  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. water
1  beef bouillon cube
1/2  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. 57 sauce
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. celery seed
2  Tbsp. mustard
seasoning to taste
preparation: Brown ground beef and onions; drain. Add all other ingredients. Heat well.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots, sliced
1  large onion
1  bell pepper
1/2  c. vinegar
1  can tomato soup
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
preparation: Cook carrots until tender; drain and cool.  Cut onions and pepper; add to cooked carrots.  Mix together tomato soup, sugar, oil and vinegar; pour over vegetables.  Let stand overnight.

name: TOMATO SALAD MOLD
ingredients:
3  envelopes Knox gelatine
1  can (1 pt. 2 oz.) tomato juice
1/8  c. Italian dressing
1  tomato, peeled and diced
1  green pepper, diced
1  cucumber, pared and diced
preparation: In medium saucepan, sprinkle gelatine over tomato juice.  Cook over low heat, stirring, until gelatine is dissolved.  Add dressing and stir.  Chill mixture until it begins to thicken. Fold in tomato, green pepper and cucumber.  Pour in 1 1/2-quart mold or 6 individual molds.  Chill until firm.

name: POPPY SEED CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  chicken breasts, cooked, boned and cut up
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
16  oz. sour cream
2  stacks Ritz crackers
poppy seed
1/2  stick butter, melted
preparation: Mix  soup  and  sour  cream.  Crush  crackers.  In  a 1 1/2-quart casserole alternately layer chicken soup mixture and 1/2 of  cracker  crumbs.  Sprinkle  poppy  seed over crackers until lightly   covered.  Repeat  layering.  Drizzle  melted butter  on top.  Bake at 350° until it bubbles.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: CHICKEN DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  chicken with or without skin
1  pt. fresh mushrooms (whole or sliced)
3  medium potatoes
2  c. white wine
dash of salt
2  cubes chicken bouillon (optional)
1  onion, sliced or diced
5  carrots
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Boil chicken in large pot; may add bouillon cubes if you like. Melt butter or margarine and slowly saute mushrooms and onions until onions are transparent.  Add to boiling chicken.  Slice potatoes (about 1 1/2-inch slices).  Add to chicken pot.  Slice carrots (1 to 1 1/2-inch slices).  Add to chicken pot.  Add 2 cups of white wine to chicken pot.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Cover pot and turn heat on low.  Cook for 1 hour or until chicken is done and vegetables are tender.  A complete meal can be served, as a soup in bowls or on plates with individual pieces of chicken and vegetables with broth spooned over the top.  Truly delightful chicken.

name: MIKE'S STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
8  jumbo mushrooms
1/2 to 3/4  lb. raw shrimp, cut into bite size pieces
1 1/2  c. Italian seasoned bread crumbs
1  stick butter, melted
salt
pepper
preparation: Wipe mushrooms off with paper towel to clean.  Scoop out inside of mushroom (everything) and reserve it.  Create a hollow. Chop up insides of mushrooms; mix with bread crumbs, melted butter, 3/4 of the cut up shrimp and salt and pepper.  (A few more bread crumbs may be needed to form a solid ball.)  Form into ball and gently press into hollow of mushroom.  Place a few reserved shrimp (whole) on top of a few mushrooms.  Place in baking pan and bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until whole shrimp turn pink.

name: MINT TEA
ingredients:
1/2  c. lightly packed fresh mint leaves (about 2 Tbsp., crushed)
4  c. water
preparation: Pour boiling water over the bark, first breaking it into bits. Cover the pitcher containing it and let stand until cold.  Add lemon juice if desired and sweeten to taste.

name: SHRIMP CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  oz. soft cream cheese
1 1/2  tsp. chopped celery
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. soy sauce
dash of hot pepper sauce
4 1/2  oz. can tiny shrimp, rinsed and drained
snipped parsley
preparation: Combine cream cheese, celery, garlic, soy sauce and pepper sauce.  Stir in shrimp.  Shape mixture into ball.  Chill 4 to 24 hours.  Before serving, coat with parsley.

name: BOURBON SAUCE
ingredients:
1 small  can evaporated milk
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/4  stick butter (2 Tbsp.)
pinch of salt
1/4  c. bourbon
preparation: Mix milk, sugar, egg, butter and salt in top of double boiler. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.  Cool slightly.  Add bourbon.

name: NO BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. oats
2  c. sugar
1  cube oleo
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook and stir together until mixture thickens. Drop on wax paper.  Be sure to let cool!

name: CORN PONE PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. canned or stewed tomatoes or tomato paste
whole kernel corn
1/3  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chili sauce
1 (15 oz.)  can red kidney beans, drained or pinto beans
cornbread batter
preparation: Combine meat, onion, sugar and chili sauce and saute in butter until meat changes color.  Add tomatoes and beans and simmer for 15 minutes.  Place meat mixture in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Spread cornbread batter on top of meat mixture.  Bake at 425° for 25 minutes or until brown.

name: SLUSH PUNCH
ingredients:
3  oz. pkg. jello
2  c. sugar
66  oz. water (11 (6 oz.) cups)
1  oz. almond extract (I don't use)
1  (46 oz.) pineapple juice
1  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Bring sugar and 2 cups water to boil.  Add jello and allow to cool.  Add the rest of the water, almond extract and pineapple juice.  Mix well and freeze.  Remove from the freezer 4 hours before serving.  The mixture will become slushy.  Do not thaw too much.  Add ginger ale and serve.

name: TANGY FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
1  can (46 oz.) pineapple juice
1  can (12 oz.) frozen orange juice
1  can (12 oz.) frozen lemonade
1  c. water, divided
1/2  c. sugar
2  large ripe bananas
1  pkg. (12 oz.) frozen strawberries, thawed
2  liters ginger ale
preparation: Place 1/2 c. water with bananas & strawberries in blender and process till smooth. Stir in rest of ingredients except ginger ale. Refrigerate and serve with ginger ale.

name: SPICED CARROTS
ingredients:
1  bag carrots, sliced
1/2  c. raisins
1/4  c. butter or margarine
2 1/2  Tbsp. chopped onions
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Cook all ingredients, except brown sugar, in 3/4 cup water until carrots are fork-tender.  Add brown sugar; cook until dissolved.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. oil
1/4  c. minced onion
1/3  c. vinegar
1/2  c. catsup
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. canned fruit juice
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. red pepper
1/4  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes.

name: CAKE MIX COOKIES
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1  box instant pudding, vanilla
1  c. oil
1  egg, beaten
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Combine all ingredients except nuts, mix well. Fold in nuts. Make into small balls and place on cookie sheet, 2-inches apart. Bake 8-10 minutes in 350 degree oven. Makes 6 to 6 1/2 dozen.

name: COCA-COLA CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  fryer, cut up
salt and pepper
1  c. catsup
12  oz. Coca-Cola
preparation: Place fryer in saucepan; add Coca-Cola, catsup, salt and pepper.  Cook for about 45 minutes over medium heat.

name: ROTEL POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  can Rotel tomatoes
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cheddar cheese soup
1/2 soup  can water
1  tbsp. onion flakes or fresh chopped onion
1/2  stick margarine
10  to 12 small potatoes, peeled & sliced
preparation: In a bowl, mix Rotel tomatoes, cheddar cheese soup, cream of mushroom soup, water, onion, and salt & pepper to taste. Pour mixture over potatoes in a greased baking dish. Place margarine slices on top & bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until potatoes are soft.

name: PARMESAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  eggs
4  boneless chicken breast halves
1/2  c. Italian bread crumbs
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  stick butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Scramble eggs with a small amount of water in a bowl; wash chicken then dip in eggs then in bread crumbs mixed with Parmesan cheese.  Place in shallow baking dish.  Drizzle with melted butter or margarine.  Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

name: MACARONI AND GROUND BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  box elbow macaroni
1  lb. ground beef
1  green pepper
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  medium onions
1 small  can mushrooms
1/2  c. chopped black olives
1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water.  Brown onion, pepper and meat in skillet in a small amount of fat.  Add soup, undiluted.  Add cooked macaroni, mushrooms and olives.  Place in buttered casserole.  Sprinkle grated cheese over top and cook in 325° oven 20 minutes.

name: PORKYPINE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. lean hamburger
3/4  c. Minute rice
1  egg, beaten
1 level  tsp. salt
1  small onion, chopped or instant minced onion
1/2  ??? milk or just enough to make mixture hold together so balls won't fall apart
1  can tomato soup, diluted with 1 can water and stirred until smooth
1  Tbsp. barbecue sauce
a little chopped or minced onion
salt to taste
preparation: Add water, enough to cover meat balls.  Pour over meat balls and bake in 375° oven for 1 hour or until done.  Serves 6.

name: PARADISE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. cherry gelatin
3  c. water
1  c. chopped apples
1 medium  can pineapple, crushed or tidbits
1  pkg. lemon gelatin
2 small  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. chopped nuts
1  pkg. lime gelatin
preparation: Dissolve cherry gelatin in 1 1/2 cups water; add apples.  Chill until firm.  Drain pineapple, reserving juice.  Dissolve lemon gelatin in reserved juice; add cream cheese.   Pour over firm cherry gelatin.  Chill until firm.  Dissolve lime gelatin in remaining water.  Add pineapple and nuts.  Pour over firm lemon gelatin; chill until firm.  Servings: 15.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CHEWIES
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. sugar
1  c. white Karo syrup
5  c. cornflakes
preparation: Put ingredients into a saucepan.  Stir constantly until it comes to a boil.  After it comes to a boil, stir in 5 cups of cornflakes.  Pour ingredients into an 8 1/2 x 12-inch greased pan. Let harden.  Cut into squares.

name: SWEET PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can green peas
1 small  can pimento
3  green onions (including tops)
1  stalk celery
1/4  c. chopped sweet pickles
3  boiled eggs
2  slices cheese, cut in small squares
mayonnaise
preparation: Chill peas in can.  Drain water and all ingredients.  Add mayonnaise to taste.  Sprinkle with paprika and garnish with egg.

name: SPINACH-MUSHROOM SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. spinach leaves, washed well
2  Tbsp. each: red wine vinegar and water
1 1/2  tsp. granulated sugar
2  tsp. olive oil
1  c. each: quartered mushrooms and julienne-cut red bell peppers (thin strips)
1  tsp. Dijon-style mustard
1/8  tsp. each: salt and pepper
preparation: In medium salad bowl, combine spinach with mushrooms and red pepper strips.  In small bowl, combine vinegar with water, sugar and mustard.  Add oil, salt and pepper; mix well.  Pour dressing over salad and toss to coat.

name: CABBAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
1  lb. chopped beef
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  c. rice, cooked
1  egg
8  large cabbage leaves
1  can tomato soup
1  c. water
preparation: Pour boiling water over cabbage leaves.  Let stand for 5 minutes.  Season meat; add onion, rice and egg.  Roll a portion of filling into each leaf; fasten ends with toothpicks.  Place the cabbage rolls in the pressure cooker.  Pour tomato soup and water over rolls.  Cover, set control and cook 8 minutes after pressure is reached.  Let pressure go down normally.

name: BUTTERMILK BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
1/3  c. oil
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together into bowl.  Add buttermilk and oil; blend well.  Knead on floured surface.  Pat out to 3/4 inch thickness.  Cut with biscuit cutter.  Place on greased baking pan. Bake at 450° until lightly browned.

name: BURGERS 'N SPROUTS
ingredients:
2  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. bean sprouts, chopped
1/3  c. finely chopped water chestnuts
2  tsp. salt
2 1/2  tsp. soy sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients together. Shape into 8 patties.  Broil patties 3-inches from heat about 5 minutes on each side. Serves 8. Contains 190 calories.

name: EASY GRAPE JUICE
ingredients:
1  c. grapes, crushed
1/2  c. sugar (1/4 to 1/2 c. depending on sweetness of grapes)
preparation: Put grapes in quart jar; add sugar and fill jar with boiling water.  Process in boiling water bath canner, boiling 10 minutes. Let stand at least 4 to 6 weeks before serving by straining through sieve.

name: HOT AND TANGY GARLIC CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  skinned and boned chicken breasts
2  Tbsp. cornstarch, divided
1  Tbsp. dry sherry, white wine or water
2  large garlic cloves, minced
1  c. chicken broth
4  tsp. white vinegar
1/2  tsp. crushed red peppers
2  Tbsp. oil, divided
2  carrots, cut into strips
1  large green pepper, cut into strips
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
hot rice, cooked
preparation: Cut chicken into thin strips, coat with mixture of 1 tablespoon of cornstarch, sherry and garlic.  Let stand 10 minutes.

name: BOSTON CREAM
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. white Karo
3/4  c. half and half
nuts (if desired)
preparation: Cook the first 3 ingredients until soft ball (234° to 240°). Beat until creamy and thick.  Add nuts, if desired.   Pour out into buttered pan.  Stir until sugar dissolves, then no more. Cool; cut into squares.

name: LADYFINGERS
ingredients:
2  stick butter or margarine, softened
5 rounded  Tbsp. 4x sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. cold water
1  c. fine chopped pecans
3  c. plain flour (do not sift)
preparation: Whip butter  or  margarine  with  a  fork, then mix all ingredients.   Roll  cookies  into	finger	shapes.  Place	on cookie sheet  and  refrigerate  for  10 minutes.  Then bake in 350° oven  until  golden brown, about 15 minutes.  Let cool 10 minutes before rolling in 4x sugar.

name: CHOCOLATE CLUSTERS
ingredients:
2  c. (12 oz.) semi-sweet morsels
2  c. raisins or cereal or nuts
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Mix morsels and milk in a saucepan and stir until morsels are melted.  May be microwaved, stirring occasionally, on High, until morsels are melted.  Remove from heat, add nuts, cereal or raisins and stir.  Drop on wax paper by teaspoon.  Cool.

name: FIESTA FAJITA OR STEAK MARINADE
ingredients:
fresh lime juice
soy sauce
Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Use equal portions of the ingredients to marinate the quantity of meat you are cooking.  Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours, turning steaks occasionally.  You can also marinate green peppers and onions before grilling.

name: DOUBLE LAYER PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
4  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. milk or half and half
1  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  c. Cool Whip
1  graham cracker crust
1  c. cold milk or half and half
2  pkg. jello vanilla instant pudding
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. cloves
preparation: Beat cream cheese, 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in large bowl until smooth.  Stir in whipped topping.  Spread on bottom of crust.  Pour  1 cup milk into bowl.  Add pudding and mix.  Beat 1 or 2 minutes (mixture will be thick).  Stir in pumpkin and spices. Mix well.  Spread over cream cheese layer.  Refrigerate 4 hours or until set.  Garnish as desired.

name: MRS. FIELD'S COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. butter
2  c. sugar
2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
4  c. flour
5  c. old-fashioned oats
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
24  oz. chocolate chips
8  oz. grated chocolate
6  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 350° to 375°.  Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Add dry ingredients.  Last add chips, chocolate and nuts.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 11 to 12 minutes. Cookie will be slightly doughy when first removed from oven. Dough or cookies freeze well.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1 1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. shortening
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
1  c. mashed bananas
3/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Stir together flour, baking powder and baking soda and 3/4 teaspoon salt.  Set aside.

name: STRAWBERRIES FOR PARTIES
ingredients:
4 small  pkg. strawberry jello
1  c. chopped pecans
1 small  can Angel Flake coconut
1  can Eagle Brand milk
decorator red and green sugar
preparation: Mix together all ingredients, except sugar.  Refrigerate overnight.  Then shape small amounts in little balls, shaped like strawberries.  Dip bottom of the shaped strawberry in the green sugar and top top in the red sugar.   Cover well.  These store well in refrigerator over a long period of time.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can creamed corn
1 (16 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
2  eggs, beaten
8  oz. sour cream
1  tsp. dried onion
1  stick margarine, melted
1/4  to 1/2 green pepper
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1 to 1 1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
1  pkg. Jiffy corn muffin mix
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except cheese.  Bake, uncovered, 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.  Spread cheese on top and bake 30 minutes more, until knife comes out clean.  Serves 15 to 20.

name: CHICKEN TORTILLA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  cooked, cut up chicken breasts
2  cans cream of mushroom soup, plus 1 can water
1  large onion, chopped or grated fine
8  oz. sour cream (pourable)
1 large  can mushrooms
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
5  flour tortillas
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Layer in buttered large oblong dish (2 layers) the torn up tortillas, chicken, cheese and mixture of all other ingredients. Sprinkle with cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SUGARLESS BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. blueberries
1 3/4  c. plus 2 tsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  grated orange (rind)
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
2 eggs or 1/2  c. egg substitute
1/4  c. oil
3/4  c. orange juice
preparation: Rinse and drain berries well and toss lightly with 2 teaspoons flour.  In large bowl, stir flour, salt, baking powder, cinnamon and nutmeg.

name: BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. boiling water
4  c. Kellogg's All-Bran
2  c. Nabisco 100% bran
1  qt. buttermilk
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. oleo
4  eggs
5  c. flour
5  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. raisins
2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients.  Cream together sugar and oleo. Add beaten eggs to sugar and oleo mixture and then add to bran mixture.  Sift dry ingredients.  Add to mixture with raisins and nuts only until dry ingredients are damp.  Fill muffin pans about 2/3 full.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.  Makes about 5 dozen.  May cut recipe in half.  Freezes well.  Warm in microwave 10 to 15 seconds.

name: BAKING POWDER BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour, sifted
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. milk
4  Tbsp. shortening
preparation: Mix dry ingredients, cut in shortening with pastry blender or two knives until consistency of coarse meal.  Stir in milk to make smooth dough.  Turn onto floured board, pat or roll lightly to 1/2 inch thickness.  Cut in rounds.  Bake on ungreased sheet at 450 degrees for 10 to 16 minutes.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine or butter
2  c. flour
1/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  c. milk
1  c. blueberries
preparation: Melt and set aside butter.  Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.  Blend in egg and milk.  Add butter.  Mix altogether no more than 25 strokes quickly, just until moist.  Add blueberries. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 425°.

name: BASIL CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
1/2  lb. cream cheese (room temperature)
1/2  lb. goat cheese (room temperature)
1  lb. (4 sticks) butter (room temperature)
1  c. pesto
basil sprigs
1/4  c. toasted pine nuts
preparation: In a food processor blend cream cheese, goat cheese and butter.  Line  a  1  quart souffle dish with damp cheesecloth, allowing  it  to hang over the sides.  Spread about 1/4 of the cheese  mixture  in  the  souffle dish, followed by 1/3 of the pesto.  Repeat  with  remaining  cheese and pesto, ending with cheese.  Fold  ends  of  cheesecloth  over top and smooth with fingers.  Chill 3 hours  or  until	firm.  Unfold cheesecloth. Press pine nuts around  sides  and	garnish with basil leaves. Refrigerate, cheese keeps 7 to 10 days.

name: POOR MAN'S STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1/2  c. minced onion
1  clove garlic
1/2  c. butter
1  lb. ground beef
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 (3 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup (do not dilute)
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
preparation: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat.  Add meat and brown.  Add flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms.  Cook about 5 minutes.  Add soup and simmer, uncovered, about 10 minutes.  Stir in sour cream.  Heat through.  Sprinkle with parsley.  Serve with noodles.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: GOLDEN SQUASH BAKE
ingredients:
8  c. sliced yellow squash
6  slices cooked, crumbled bacon
2  eggs
1  c. cottage cheese
2  Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. instant chicken bouillon
1  c. (4 oz.) sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. In large bowl, combine eggs, cottage cheese, flour and bouillon. Add squash; mix well. Turn into greased 12 x 7-inch baking dish. Top with Cheddar cheese and bacon. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

name: RAISIN BARS
ingredients:
1  c. raisins
1  c. water
1/2  c. oil
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/8  tsp. cloves
preparation: Bring raisins and water to a boil.  Add oil.  Cool.  Add sugar and beaten egg.  Mix flour, soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves. Add to first mixture.  Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 375° for 20 minutes or until tested with toothpick.  Frost with thin confectioners sugar frosting.

name: SPICY WALNUTS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. English walnut halves
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Heat walnuts halves in moderate oven (375°) 5 minutes, stirring once.  Butter sides of heavy 2-quart saucepan.  In saucepan combine sugar, water, cinnamon and salt.  Heat and stir until sugar dissolves and mixture comes to a boil.  Cook without stirring to soft ball stage (236°).  Remove from heat.  Beat by hand one minute or until the mixture begins to get creamy.  Add vanilla and warm walnuts.  Stir until coated.  Turn mixture out onto buttered platter.  Separate at once, using two forks.  Yields 1 pound.

name: AUNT JEAN'S JEWELS
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1/4  c. sorghum molasses
1  stick oleo
1  c. nuts
1  can Angel Flake coconut
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  beaten egg
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
preparation: Put milk and sorghum  in double boiler and let thicken. Add remaining  ingredients.  Drop on greased cookie sheet and bake at 325° for 15 minutes.

name: BEAN DIP
ingredients:
2 - 8  oz. philly cream cheese
2 - 15  oz. hormel chili with beans
1  pkg. kraft Mexican shredded cheese
1  bag nacho chips
preparation: Spread cream cheese on the bottom of 8x8 pan, add  one can chili then shredded cheese, but not all of it, add other can of chili and remaining cheese on top.  Cook at 350 for 20 min. or until cheese is melted.

name: PICKLES - PICKLES
ingredients:
1  wild grape leaf
1  clove garlic
1  small pepper
lots of dill
1  or 2 green grapes
1/2  c. salt
1  pt. vinegar
preparation: In each quart jar, put grape leaf, garlic, pepper and dill. One or two green green grapes are good, too.  Heat 3 quarts of water and when it comes to a boil, add salt and vinegar.  Bring to a boil.  Then pour over your prepared jars of pickles.  This will cover about 8 quarts.

name: REECE'S CUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  box confectioners sugar
1 (12 oz.)  jar crunchy peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
2  sticks oleo
preparation: Melt butter and add other ingredients.  Press in 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: FRITO PIE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. Fritos
1  medium onion, chopped
1 (15 oz.)  can chili (no beans)
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Line bottom of casserole dish with 1 1/2 cups Fritos. Sprinkle onion evenly over Fritos. Top with 1/2 cup grated cheese. Pour heated chili on top and cover with another layer of Fritos and cheese.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

name: PRESSED COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. margarine
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg yolk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift together the flour and salt; set aside.  Blend margarine and sugar.  Beat in egg yolk and vanilla.  Add to flour mixture. Put through cookie press.  Bake for 10 minutes at 375°.  Makes 50 cookies.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CANDY
ingredients:
1  c. canned milk
3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. peanut butter
preparation: In a medium saucepan cook milk, sugar and vanilla until soft ball stage.  Take mixture off heat.  Beat in peanut butter with mixer on high speed.  Pour in greased cake pan.   Let cool, then cut.

name: BROWN SUGAR BROWNIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. butter
2  c. brown sugar
3  eggs
1  c. self rising flour
dash of salt
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt butter and sugar; cool.  Add unbeaten eggs and mix well. Add other ingredients.  Bake in a greased shallow pan at 325° to 350° for 30 minutes.  Yields about 2 dozen.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  cups flour
1  teaspoon salt
1  teaspoon baking soda
3  teaspoons cinnamon
1/4  teaspoon baking powder
3  eggs
2  cups sugar
3  teaspoons vanilla extract
1  cup vegetable oil
3  cups grated zucchini
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Sift flour, salt, soda, cinnamon and baking powder. Beat eggs; add sugar, vanilla and oil. Then add zucchini. Add dry ingredients. Mix well. Pour into 2 ungreased loaf pans. Cook about 1 hour.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.)  jar jalapeno Cheez Whiz
1  c. regular rice
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Cook broccoli and rice as directed on each package. Drain any juice that is left after cooking. Combine with all other ingredients and turn into a 3-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with paprika and bake at 350°.

name: POLISH CRULLERS
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. canned milk
preparation: Cream shortening until fluffy; add remaining ingredients and enough flour to make a soft dough.  Roll and cut.  Fry in hot oil until brown.

name: CHICKEN STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1  c. Bisquick
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  c. diced, uncooked chicken breast
2  slightly beaten eggs
1/4  c. oil
3  medium carrots, cut diagonally in 1/2-inch pieces
1  green pepper, cut in strips
1  onion, sliced
1 (20 oz.)  can drained pineapple chunks, reserve juice
preparation: Mix Bisquick and pepper in plastic bag or bowl.  Stir chicken into eggs.  Remove chicken with slotted spoon and place in bag or bowl with baking mix.  Coat chicken.  Remove chicken.

name: FRENCH BREAD
ingredients:
1  loaf French bred
2  c. cheese, grated
1  pkg. Ranch dressing mix
preparation: Spread cheese and dressing mix on bread.  Place in broiler and broil until brown.

name: CLAM DIP
ingredients:
2 small  jars Kraft Old English sharp cheese
8  oz. cream cheese
1  can clams
1  Tbsp. worcestershire sauce
1/2  green pepper, finely chopped
3  green onions, chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients and put in baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Stir every 10 minutes.  Best served with corn chips.

name: 15 MINUTE CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. hot milk
dash of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add sugar, hot milk, salt and vanilla.  Pour into 9-inch pie crust (uncooked).  Sprinkle nutmeg.  Bake in 475° oven for 5 minutes.  Reduce heat to 350° and bake 10 minutes.

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
2 to 2 1/2  lb. round steak, cut 1/2 to 3/4-inch thick
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 to 2  Tbsp. oil
1  large onion, sliced
8  oz. can tomatoes, undrained and cut up
8  oz. can tomato sauce
preparation: Cut meat into serving pieces.  In small bowl, combine flour, salt and pepper.  Coat meat with seasoned flour.

name: CABBAGE SLAW
ingredients:
1  c. white vinegar
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. mustard seed
2/3  c. sugar
2  lb. grated cabbage
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. pimento, chopped
1/2  medium onion, chopped
preparation: Heat vinegar, celery seed, salt, mustard seed and sugar. Let cool. Pour over cabbage, green pepper, pimento and onion. Let stand overnight. Serves 10 to 12.

name: GUACAMOLE
ingredients:
3  large ripe avocados
6  small seeded jalapeno chiles, finely chopped (or less to suit your taste)
1 (7 oz.)  can Ortega green chile salsa
1/4  c. finely chopped onions
garlic salt to suit taste
preparation: Mash avocados with fork.  Add all other ingredients. Refrigerate to blend flavors.  Serve with chips or over Mexican food.  Great on tacos.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
1  can enchilada sauce
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  can chili without beans
1  can refried beans
1 1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Cook all day on low in crock-pot.

name: QUICK BLUEBERRY PIE-COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick butter or margarine
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  qt. blueberries
preparation: Melt margarine and mix flour, sugar and milk.  Pour into pan and add blueberries on top of mixture.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes. Brown lightly.

name: VENISON ROAST
ingredients:
3  lb. venison
5  carrots
6  potatoes
2  onions
salt
pepper
garlic salt, if desired
1/2  c. water
preparation: The night before, place venison, salt, pepper, garlic salt and water in crock-pot.  Cook all night on low.  Next morning, add vegetables and cook on low until tender.  About 30 minutes before serving, remove soup stock to saucepan.  Add flour, cook to thicken.  Pour over meat and vegetables.  Cook on low until ready to serve.

name: PISTACHIO FLORENTINES
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. dark corn syrup
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. pistachios, coarsely chopped
1/2  c. slivered almonds, coarsely chopped
1/3  c. glazed cherries, coarsely chopped
