1  tsp. lemon juice
4  oz. semi-sweet chocolate, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.  In a pan, gently heat butter and syrup until melted.  Stir in flour, nuts, cherries and lemon juice.

name: PINA COLADA MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. coconut
1  egg
1/4  c. margarine
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Cream sugar, egg, margarine and sour cream.  Add dry ingredients.  Fold in coconut and pineapple.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.  Makes 12 muffins.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jiffy cornbread mix
4  eggs, beaten
1  stick butter, melted
1  onion, diced
6  oz. cottage cheese
1  c. cooked broccoli, chopped
preparation: Mix well.  Bake in a large, greased iron skillet at 350° until well done.

name: CAULIFLOWER-BROCCOLI MEDLEY
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower
1  bunch broccoli
2  small onions, sliced and pulled apart into rings
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1/3  c. vinegar
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
preparation: Separate cauliflower and broccoli into bite size pieces. Combine all vegetables in a large mixing bowl.  Combine remaining ingredients, except bacon; add vegetables gently.   Chill several hours or overnight.  Toss vegetables several times during the marinating period.  Garnish with crumbed bacon.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: FRESH FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2  apples
2  oranges
1  pineapple
2  pears
2  peaches
other fruit in season
2  c. plain or vanilla yogurt
2  Tbsp. honey
preparation: Cut various fruits into bite-size pieces; mix together in large bowl.  Mix honey into yogurt and pour over fruit salad.

name: MRS. FIELD'S CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES(The Original Secret Recipe)
ingredients:
2  c. (1 lb.) butter
2  c. sugar
2  c. (1 lb.) brown sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
5  c. oatmeal
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
1  (24 oz.) bag semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  (8 oz.) grated Hershey bar
3  c. chopped nuts (optional)
coconut (optional)
preparation: Measure oatmeal; then put small amounts in blender or food processor.  Mix until powdered; combine with flour and set aside. Cream together butter, sugar and brown sugar.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Set this mixture aside.  Add salt, baking powder and baking soda to flour/oatmeal mixture.

name: HAM APPETILLAS
ingredients:
1  pkg. super size tortillas
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
2  Tbsp. green onion, chopped
1/4  c. black olives, chopped
2 (2 1/2 oz.)  pkg. sliced, pressed cooked ham
1/3  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Remove tortillas from refrigerator.  Combine cream cheese, mayonnaise, onions and olives.  Spread thin layer of mixture on tortilla. Arrange four slices of ham over cheese. Tightly roll up tortilla.  Wrap individually in plastic wrap.  Place in refrigerator at least 3 hours or overnight.  To serve, cut into 3/4-inch slices.  Makes about 64 appetillas.

name: STUFF BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  baked potatoes
1/2  c. sour cream
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. instant onion or 1/4 c. onion
1/4  tsp. paprika
preparation: Cut baked potatoes in half and scoop out the pulp.  Place in mixing bowl.  Add sour cream, cream cheese, onion, salt and pepper.  Combine ingredients and stir.  Gradually increase speed of mixer.  Beat until potatoes are fluffy.  Spoon potato mixture into shells.  Place on baking sheet and sprinkle with paprika. Bake in a preheated oven at 400° for 15 minutes.  Grated cheese may also be sprinkled on top, if desired.

name: CHICKEN ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
1 1/2  tsp. Accent
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. oil
2  pkg. frozen asparagus
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2-1  tsp. curry powder
1  c. shredded sharp cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Sprinkle chicken with flour, salt and pepper and Accent.  Fry breasts in oil until light brown.  Cook asparagus and drain. Place in bottom of large casserole.  Place chicken over asparagus.

name: EASY-MAKE FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
3/4  stick butter or margarine
preparation: Mix flour, salt, baking powder and milk.  Mix fruit, vanilla and sugar.  Options:  1/2 cup peaches, 1/2 cup blackberries or 3/4 cup cherries.  Heat oven to 450°; put butter in pan; place pan in oven.  Heat until bubbly, almost brown.  Quickly pour in batter, then fruit.  Cook for 30 minutes at 450°.  Reduce temperature to 350°, cook 30 more minutes.

name: CARAMEL ICING
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
2  sticks oleo
1  c. Pet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bring first 3 ingredients to boil.  Brown 1/2 cup sugar in iron  skillet  and	pour  into mixture.  Cook to soft ball. Add vanilla.  Beat  with  mixer until light color and ready to spread. May use  as  fudge  by  adding  nuts and placing in a buttered dish.  I always use Duncan Hines Butter cake mix.

name: GERMAN POTATO PANCAKES
ingredients:
5  to 6 large potatoes
1  medium onion
1  egg
4  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper
oil
preparation: Grate potatoes (smaller than julienne) and onion very fine. Add 1 egg; mix.  Add salt, pepper and flour.  In frying pan, add 1/4 inch oil.  When oil is hot, add 1 tablespoon mixture to oil and fry until potatoes are brown.   Turn over and fry other side. Drain on paper towel and taste.  You may need to add more salt and pepper.

name: CARROT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  medium carrots
2  small onions, chopped
4  Tbsp. butter
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
salt and pepper to taste
1/3  c. bread crumbs
1/3  c. American cheese, grated
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Wash and peel carrots.  Boil in salted water until tender.  Saute onions in butter until golden.  Place carrots in greased 1-quart baking dish and mash.  Add onions and soup.  Blend well, adding salt and pepper.  Sprinkle with bread crumbs and cheese.  Bake until bubbly, 25 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: ALMOND FLOAT
ingredients:
3  envelopes (.25 oz. each) gelatin
3  c. water
3/4  c. sugar
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
4  tsp. almond extract
2  cans (17 oz. each) fruit cocktail or fruit for salad, drained
preparation: Sprinkle gelatin over 1 cup water; let stand 1 minute.  In a large saucepan, bring the remaining 2 cups water to a boil.  Add sugar and stir until dissolved.  Remove from heat and add evaporated milk and almond extract.  Stir in dissolved gelatin. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Refrigerate until set.  When set, cut into 1/2-inch cubes.  Place almond gelatin in a bowl and add fruit; toss gently.  Makes 12 servings.

name: JELLO CANDY
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. Jell-O (strawberry or lime)
1  can condensed milk
2  c. pecans
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. coconut
preparation: Mix well. Form into balls.  Refrigerate.  May be rolled in red or green sugar.

name: FETTUCCINE WITH HAM
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. fettuccine noodles
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. thinly sliced ham
1 (8 oz.)  can mushroom stems and pieces, drained
3/4  c. half and half
3/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook fettuccine as directed on package; drain.  Cook mushrooms in butter, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are light brown. Stir in half and half and cheese; heat just until hot.  Stir in ham that has been chopped coarsely; toss with fettuccine.  Serve with additional grated Parmesan cheese, if desired.

name: MOIST MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
1/4  c. chopped bell pepper
1  egg
1  c. crushed saltines
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a mixing bowl; pour into a loaf pan. Spread ketchup over top of meat loaf.  Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.  Remove foil and bake about 5 more minutes.

name: VEGGIE PIZZA
ingredients:
2  pkg. Pillsbury crescent rolls
12  oz. cream cheese, softened
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. Hidden Valley original
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. dill weed
1/2  head broccoli
1/2  head cauliflower
1  green pepper
2  carrots, grated
1  lb. Mozzarella cheese, grated
preparation: Pat roll dough out on jelly roll tin; bake according to instructions and cool.  Mix cream cheese, mayonnaise and spices and spread on cooled dough.  Chop vegetables very fine and spread over cheese topping.  Pat down; top with grated cheese.  Pat down. Cut into squares and serve.

name: CHEESY MIXED VEGGIES
ingredients:
2  bags mixed vegetables
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can dried onions
preparation: Cook veggies, then pour into dish.  Melt Cheez Whiz and soup together.  Pour over veggies.  Bake 1/2 hour at 300°.  Sprinkle can of onions over top.  Bake another 5 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3 heaping  Tbsp. flour
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix sugar, cocoa and flour and set aside.  In saucepan, heat milk and egg yolks, then add sugar, cocoa and flour mixture.  When done, add butter and vanilla.  Pour into baked pie shell; top with Cool Whip.

name: RISOTTO WITH SEAFOOD
ingredients:
2  large onions, finely chopped
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  pt. shucked oysters or clams, liquid reserved
5 to 6  c. chicken or fish stock
1  c. dry white wine
2  c. Arborio or Vialone rice
2  Tbsp. fresh thyme leaves
1/4  tsp. saffron (optional)
1  lb. shrimp, cooked or raw, shelled and deveined
1/2  lb. scallops
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Saute onions in hot oil in heavy-bottomed pot large enough to hold all ingredients.  Meanwhile, drain liquid from oysters or clams and add the stock.  Heat mixture and keep warm.  When onions are soft, add wine and cook over high heat until liquid has evaporated.  Add rice and cook, stirring, until rice is coated. Add about a cup of simmering stock to the rice along with the thyme and saffron and cook over high heat, stirring often, until the liquid has been absorbed into the rice, stirring almost continuously.  You may not need all the liquid.  If using clams, and they are large, cut in half or smaller.  If scallops are large, cut in half.  If shrimp is uncooked, add along with the oysters, clams and scallops to risotto about three minutes before it is ready.  Add salt and pepper.  Stir and continue to cook.  If shrimp is cooked and large, cut in halves or thirds.  Add one minute before risotto is ready, just long enough to heat through. Yields 4 servings.

name: CHICKEN FRIED STEAKS
ingredients:
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  pkg. (approximately 4) cubed beef steaks
1  large egg, slightly beaten
2  tbsp. milk
1  c. saltine crackers, crumbled
vegetable oil
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1 1/4  c. chicken broth
1/2  c. milk
dash of Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine the first 3 ingredients; sprinkle on both sides of steaks.  Combine egg and milk in a shallow bowl.  Dip steaks in egg mixture, then dredge in cracker crumbs.  Pour oil to depth of 1/2 inch into large, heavy skillet.  Fry steaks in hot oil over medium heat until brown, turning once.  Remove steaks; drain off drippings, reserving 3 tablespoons.  In skillet, add flour, stirring until smooth.   Cook 1 minute.  Add broth and 1/2 cup milk; stir constantly until thick.  Add Worcestershire sauce; stir.  Serve gravy with steaks and cooked rice or mashed potatoes.

name: CHEESE GARLIC BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick baking mix
2/3  c. milk
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese (2 oz.)
1/4  c. margarine, melted
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Mix baking mix, milk and cheese until soft dough forms.  Beat vigorously 30 seconds.  Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.  Mix margarine and garlic powder; brush over warm biscuits before removing from cookie sheet.  Serve warm.  Yields 10 to 12 biscuits.

name: FUDGE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
2/3  c. milk
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans (optional)
2  Tbsp. Karo syrup
2  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: Boil all ingredients except nuts until it forms a soft ball in a glass of water; remove from heat and add nuts.  Stir until it starts getting hard to stir; pour into greased pan to harden.

name: PASTA CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. shell macaroni
5  oz. can chunk chicken
1/2  cucumber, diced
6  to 8 radishes, sliced thin
1/4  c. green onion
6  oz. Cheddar cheese, cubed
1  c. mayo or salad dressing
1  c. bottled Italian dressing
preparation: Mix together first 6 ingredients.  Mix together salad dressings and pour over pasta mix.  Toss, refrigerate for 4 hours to blend flavors.

name: APPLE DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. lard
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix flour, salt, sugar and baking powder.  Blend in lard.  Add beaten egg and lemon juice.  Add enough water to make dough.  Roll between wax paper.  Cut dough into squares big enough to cover an apple.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
3/4 to 1  lb. shrimp, cooked and chopped fine
1  green pepper, chopped fine
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
1 to 1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
1 to 2  Tbsp. horseradish
1 (7 oz.)  jar chili sauce
salt and pepper to taste
garlic powder to taste
chili powder to taste
preparation: Mix well. Chill thoroughly.  Serve with assorted crackers.

name: CREAM CHEESE SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
preparation: Sift flour and set aside.  Cream butter and cream cheese with extract and add sugar, gradually, beating until fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating thoroughly after each addition.  Add flour in fourths, mixing well until just blended after each addition. Chill dough in refrigerator 1 hour.  Shape into small balls or drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets 2-inches apart.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

name: PARMESAN CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
6  boneless skinless chicken breast halves (about 2 lb.)
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. dry bread crumbs
1  tsp. dried oregano leaves
1  tsp. dried parsley flakes
1/4  tsp. each: paprika, salt and black pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Spray 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray.  Dip chicken in spread (margarine).   Coat with combined remaining ingredients.  Place in prepared pan.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes until tender.  Makes 6 servings.

name: POT PIE DOUGH
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. mashed potatoes
2  c. flour
preparation: Measure flour; add potatoes.  Stir in eggs.  Mix well.  Roll 1/4 inch thick.  Cut in squares.  Drop in boiling broth.  Be sure you stir each layer as you drop it in the boiling broth, because if you drop dry pot pie squares on top of dry layers, they will stick together and you will have lumpy pot pie.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. margarine, melted
2  eggs
1/3  c.sugar
3/4  c. white Karo syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
1 to 1 1/2  c. pecans
9-inch crust (homemade or bought)
preparation: In bowl, put 2 eggs, beat slightly.  Add sugar and mix well. Add syrup and mix well.  Add melted margarine and pecans; mix well.  Pour into crust.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes, then turn oven temperature down to 325° and bake 30 additional minutes.

name: MASHED POTATO DONUTS
ingredients:
1  c. cold mashed potatoes
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. melted lard
1/2  c. milk
1 level  tsp. nutmeg
3 1/2  c. flour plus 3 1/2 tsp. baking powder (sift and use all of the sifted flour)
preparation: Combine.  Dough will be soft.  Chill thoroughly.  Pat out to 1/4-inches.  Cut and fry at 375°.  Turn when donuts come to top.

name: FROZEN BANANA PUNCH
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
6  c. hot water
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 (46 oz.)  can orange juice
5  large bananas
juice of 2 lemons
2  quarts of ginger ale
preparation: Dissolve sugar in hot water in bowl; cool.  Add pineapple juice and orange juice.  Mash bananas in bowl.  Add lemon juice. Combine with juices; mix well.  Pour into freezer container. Freeze until firm.  Remove 3 to 4 hours before serving.  Mash until slushy.  Combine with ginger ale in large punch bowl; mix gently.  Makes 50 servings.

name: RAISIN PUMPKIN CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
1/2  tsp. salt
4  eggs, beaten
2  c. pumpkin (16 oz. can)
3/4  c. vegetable oil
2  c. All-Bran cereal
1  c. raisins
1  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
confectioners sugar for topping
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large bowl combine flour, sugar, baking powder, soda, spice and salt.  In another large bowl mix together eggs, pumpkin, oil and cereal.  Add flour mixture to egg mixture, mixing just until combined.  Stir in raisins and nuts. Pour mixture evenly into a 10 x 4-inch tube pan or a 12-cup Bundt pan that has been sprayed with Pam.  Bake for about 65 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool completely and remove from pan.  Dust with confectioners sugar.

name: JOANN'S CREAM OF SPINACH SOUP
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. oil
1  medium onion, minced
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach
2  Tbsp. flour
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can chicken broth
2  c. half and half
1/2  tsp. fresh ground white pepper
1/2  tsp. fresh ground nutmeg
1/2  lb. bacon, chopped and fried crispy
preparation: Melt butter and oil in large saucepan; add onion and saute until transparent, about 5 minutes.  Press defrosted spinach in strainer.  Reserve liquid.  Add spinach to onion.  Mix well. Sprinkle with flour.  Stir.  Cook about 3 minutes.  Blend in broth and reserved spinach liquid.  Simmer for 10 minutes.  Stir in half and half, pepper and nutmeg and simmer 5 more minutes.  Add bacon and serve.

name: MONSTER COOKIES
ingredients:
12  eggs
1  lb. butter
18  c. oatmeal
3  lb. peanut butter
1  lb. M & M's
1  lb. chocolate chips
2  lb. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. corn syrup
8  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and drop by rounded tablespoon on a greased cookie sheet.  Bake in 375° oven until done.  These get better with age when stored in a tight container.  Makes 22 dozen.

name: CITRUS SPICE POTPOURRI
ingredients:
1/2  c. dried orange and lemon peels
1  cinnamon stick, broken
2  bay leaves
1  tsp. rosemary
preparation: To Dry Peels:  Slice peels into very thin strips.  Place on a cookie sheet and bake in oven on its lowest possible setting. Bake several hours or until dried and hard.

name: PINEAPPLE COOL WHIP CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 large  can crushed pineapple, well drained
1  large container Cool Whip
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs (omit 1 yolk)
2  tsp. soda
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple and juice (unsweetened)
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix all together.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes in 350° oven.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
5  or 6 cold homemade biscuits, torn in pieces
2  eggs
1/4  c. margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. sugar
enough milk to make moistened enough to mix well
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Put in baking dish.  Bake until golden brown.

name: MEXICAN LAYERED DIP
ingredients:
15  oz. can black beans, rinsed and drained
2  Tbsp. thick and chunky salsa
1  (8 oz.) container light sour cream
1  c. thick and chunky salsa
2  c. shredded lettuce
4  oz. (1 c.) shredded reduced fat Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese
1 (2 1/4 oz.)  can olives
1  medium tomato, chopped
1/2  c. sliced green onions
1  recipe Easy Tortilla Chips
preparation: In medium bowl, combine black beans and 2 tablespoons salsa; mash with fork and stir until smooth.  On 12-inch serving plate, spread bean mixture into 10-inch circle.  Top with sour cream; spread to within 1/4-inch of edge of beans.  Top with one cup salsa, lettuce, cheese, olives, green onions and tomato.  Serve with Easy Tortilla Chips.  Makes 5 cups; 12 to 16 servings.

name: JELLO DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. orange jello
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. boiling water
8  ice cubes
preparation: In a large mixer bowl, cream the cream cheese and drained pineapple together, then beat in the Cool Whip.  After dissolving jello in 1 1/2 cups boiling water, add about 8 ice cubes to cool jello, then add to rest of the mixture.  Pour into an 8 1/2 x 12 1/2-inch Tupperware with lid or same size oblong glass dish with lid.  Refrigerate 2 hours.   Best made the night before for next day.  Can be a salad or dessert.

name: OATMEAL CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1  c. packed brown sugar
2  unbeaten eggs
2  c. quick cooking oats
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Sift together flour, soda, salt.

name: HAM AND CHEESE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter (no oleo)
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  clove garlic, minced
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. freshly ground pepper
1  c. milk
2  eggs
1  c. finely diced ham
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, cubed
1/4  c. sunflower seeds, roasted and shelled
preparation: Grease or paper muffin cups. In a skillet, melt butter and saut onion, green pepper and garlic until tender. In large bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, salt and pepper. In a small bowl, beat the milk and eggs together. Add the liquid mixture to the dry along with vegetable mixture, ham and cheese. Stir until moistened. Spoon into muffin cups. Sprinkle sunflower seeds over the tops. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

name: BLUEBERRY PANCAKES
ingredients:
1 small  box pancake mix
1  c. blueberries
1/2  c. cooking oil
maple syrup
1  c. water
1  can whipped cream
preparation: In a medium-size mixing bowl, mix pancake mix with water. After mixed until smooth, add 1 cup fresh blueberries. Pour 3 x 3 size circle into the greased frying skillet. Cook until brown, then flip. Cook until brown. Serve with syrup and whipped cream topping.

name: GRAMMY KEEF'S HOMEMADE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening (Crisco)
4  sq. semi-sweet baking chocolate
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
2  c. pastry flour (Softasilk)
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Add shortening to chocolate.  Melt in a double boiler.  Beat eggs.  Add sugar gradually.  Add chocolate mixture and beat well. Sift flour and salt together; add to mixture.  Add vanilla.  Bake in a greased 8 x 12-inch pan for 35 minutes at 350°.

name: LIME SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lime jello or orange
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
15  marshmallows (or more)
1/2  c. whipping cream
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  diced apple
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Beat  jello  using  1  cup hot water to mix.  Add cream cheese;  whip.  Add  whipped  cream.  Whip.  Fold  in  crushed pineapple, apple and nuts.  Add marshmallows on top;  chill.

name: CHOP SUEY
ingredients:
slivers of meat (chicken, beef or pork and shrimp)
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  segment garlic
1/2  onion
dash of Accent
black pepper
veggies (broccoli, cabbage, carrots, cauliflower, sweet pea pods and sweet potato slices)
preparation: Cut meat into strips.  If using shrimp, shell and devein. Marinate in soy sauce.  Prepare vegetables by slicing diagonally or into flowerets.  Slice onions and crush garlic and heat in 2 to 3 tablespoons oil in medium to large skillet.  Reduce heat when oil starts to smoke.  Saute onions and garlic until transparent but not burnt.  Add meat pieces.  Saute for at least 5 minutes. Add 2 cans of broth or 2 cups of tap water.  (I use a bouillon cube.) Simmer until meat is tender.  Add soy sauce to taste.  Add vegetables.  It's up to you if you want your veggies half or fully cooked.

name: SUGARPLUMS
ingredients:
15  oz. pkg. seedless raisins
11  oz. pkg. dried mixed fruit
8  oz. pkg. dried figs or pitted prunes
1 1/2  c. chopped walnuts
sugar
preparation: Chop all fruit and nuts in food grinder, using coarse blade. Shape mixture in 1 inch balls and roll in sugar.  Let dry on waxed paper overnight.  Store in tightly covered container.  Makes 72 balls; 50 calories each.

name: SLUSH MARGARITAS
ingredients:
25  oz. bottle Margarita mix
10  oz. tequila
1/8  c. Triple Sec
18  oz. water
preparation: Mix well in plastic container and freeze overnight.  Take out an hour before serving.  Will keep for months and is wonderful especially with Mexican appetizers!

name: GREAT GRANDMA'S CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  can evaporated milk (fill up with water to 2 c.)
preparation: Mix flour, sugar and cocoa; stir.  Mix eggs and milk in with it.  Keep stirring over low heat.  Add vanilla and butter. Continue stirring until mixture thickens.  Pour in cool pie crust. Cover tightly with Saran Wrap to keep top of pie smooth and creamy.

name: CORNSTARCH CLAY
ingredients:
1  c. cornstarch
2  c. salt
1 1/3  c. cold water
preparation: Put the salt and 2/3 cup of water into a pot and bring to a boil.  Mix the cornstarch with the remaining water.  Stir well. Blend these two mixtures together and knead into clay.  Mold into shapes and let dry several hours.  They can be painted when dry. Store the clay in airtight container in refrigerator.

name: CREAMED CARROTS
ingredients:
4  carrots or 1 can
1/2 to 1  Tbsp. sugar
2 1/2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Filling; when read to serve, thicken with flour and milk.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
1/2  c. grated onion
1/2  c. diced green pepper
1 1/2  c. instant rice (uncooked)
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1 1/2  c. water
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: In a large frypan saute onion, green pepper and rice in the vegetable oil until rice is golden brown.  Add water, tomato sauce, sugar, salt, pepper and lemon juice.  Cover and bring mixture to a rolling boil.  Uncover and reduce heat; simmer 10 minutes.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (5 oz.) bag wide egg noodles, cooked
1  lb. sausage (medium hot)
1  small onion, chopped
1  can nacho cheese soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (5 oz.)  can Pet milk
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, grated
preparation: Cook noodles according to package directions.  Brown sausage and onion; drain very well.  Mix together soups and Pet milk; add soup mixture to meat.  Put mixture into baking dish and place cooked noodles on top.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°, then add Velveeta cheese on top and bake another 10 minutes.

name: BLACKENED SEASONING
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. paprika
2 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. onion powder
1 1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1 1/2  tsp. cayenne
2  tsp. lemon pepper
1  tsp. thyme
1 1/2  tsp. basil
preparation: Mix all ingredients, then stir in 1 stick melted butter before covering meat or fish.

name: BLUEBERRY OR CHERRY YUM-YUM
ingredients:
2  pkg. Dream Whip powder
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. half and half
2  c. blueberry pie filling or cherry
1 1/4  sticks butter
preparation: Mix heated butter and graham cracker crumbs together for crust.  Pat into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Mix sugar, vanilla and cream cheese into bowl #1.  In bowl #2, mix half and half and Dream Whip.  Beat.

name: 2-MINUTE FUDGE(Microwave)
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  box confectioners sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  c. butter (do not use margarine)
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In 1 1/2-quart casserole, stir sugar, cocoa, salt, milk and vanilla together until partially blended (mixture is too stiff to thoroughly blend in all of dry ingredients). Put butter over top in center of dish. Microwave at High 2 minutes (some ovens may need less time, so start with 1 1/2 minutes) or until milk feels warm on bottom of dish. Stir vigorously until smooth. If all the butter has not melted in cooking, it will as mixture is stirred. Blend in nuts. Pour into wax paper lined 8 x 4 x 3-inch dish. Chill 1 hour in refrigerator or 20 to 30 minutes in freezer. Cut into squares. Makes about 36 squares.

name: NACHO DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. sour cream
1  can bean dip
1  pkg. chili seasoning
2  tsp. parsley
5  drops hot sauce (Texas Pete)
1/4  c. taco sauce
8  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
8  oz. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Blend the cream cheese and sour cream until smooth.  Add the remaining ingredients, but save some of the shredded cheeses as topping.  Mix well!  Pour into 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: COOKED FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can chunk pineapple, drained (reserve liquid)
2  cans mandarin oranges
1  jar maraschino cherries
1 small  pkg. vanilla pudding
4  bananas, sliced
1/4  c. Tang
preparation: Mix together the Tang, vanilla pudding and 1 cup of the pineapple juice; if there isn't enough liquid to make a cup, use water  or juice from fresh orange juice.  Cook the pudding mixture until it becomes clear and slightly thickened.  Add the pudding mixture to the fruit and let stand for 1 hour or overnight.  Keep in refrigerator.

name: SIS VERA'S CANNED GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  c. white vinegar
1  gallon water
5  Tbsp. salt
green beans
jars for canning
preparation: Put vinegar, water, and salt in large boiler.  Bring to boil. Add your home grown green beans and boil for 12 - 15 minutes. Pack your jars and seal.  When ready to serve, drain beans, season and cook.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  envelope Knox unflavored gelatine
1/4  c. cold water
1  can whole berry cranberry sauce
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (in heavy syrup), undrained
chopped pecans (optional)
preparation: Soften gelatine in 1/4 cup cold water, then dissolve over hot water.  When gelatine is melted, add all remaining ingredients. Pour into mold.  Chill until set.

name: KENTUCKY BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. butter, margarine or shortening
3/4  c. buttermilk
1  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and sugar in a mixing bowl.  Cut in butter or shortening with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Add buttermilk.  Mix to make a soft dough.  Turn out onto lightly floured surface.  Knead a few times to make a soft dough.  Don't overknead or the biscuits will turn hard and dry.  Roll out to a 6 x 6-inch square.  Place on ungreased baking sheet.  With knife cut dough into 12 even portions.  Do not separate.  Bake at 400° until golden, about 15 minutes.

name: HAM AND POTATO AU GRATINO
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. diced, cooked ham
3  c. sliced, cooked potatoes
4  Tbsp. margarine
1  small onion, minced
2  Tbsp. fine dry bread crumbs
3  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Put ham and potatoes in a shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Melt 3 tablespoons of margarine and add the onion.  Cook until golden. Blend in flour.  Gradually add milk and cook, stirring until thickened. Season with salt and pepper to taste.  Pour over ham and potatoes.  Sprinkle with cheese and bread crumbs. Dot with butter.  Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes.

name: ZIPPY SHRIMP SPREAD
ingredients:
3  c. water
1  lb. unpeeled, medium size fresh shrimp
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. catsup
1  tsp. grated onion
1  tsp. prepared horseradish
1/2  tsp. ground red pepper
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Bring water to a boil; add shrimp and cook 3 to 5 minutes or until shrimp turn pink.  Drain well; rinse with cold water. Chill.  Peel; devein shrimp.  Reserve 3 shrimp for garnish. Coarsely chop remaining shrimp.  Set aside.

name: CRANBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. fresh cranberries
1 2/3  c. sugar, divided
1  c. water
1/3  c. shortening
2  large eggs
1 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. mashed ripe banana
1/2  c. coarsely chopped walnuts
preparation: Line a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan with wax paper.  Set aside.  Combine cranberries, 1 cup sugar and water in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, or until cranberry skins pop. Drain and set aside.  Beat shortening at medium speed until creamy, gradually adding remaining 2/3 cup sugar.  Beat well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.  Combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt; add to shortening mixture, alternating with banana, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix after each addition.  Fold in reserved cranberries and walnuts.  Spoon batter into prepared pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour, or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack for 10 minutes.  Remove from pan.  Remove wax paper and let cool completely on wire rack.  Makes 1 loaf.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. cloves
2  eggs
1 (15 oz.)  can pumpkin
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1  (9-inch) deep-dish pie shell
preparation: Mix sugar, salt, cinnamon, ginger and cloves in small bowl. Beat eggs in large bowl. Stir in pumpkin and sugar/spice mixture. Gradually add evaporated milk, stirring well. Pour into pie shell. Bake in a preheated 425° oven for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350°; bake for an additional 40 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Cool and serve. Refrigerate any leftovers.

name: BLAKE'S GRILLED POTATOES
ingredients:
red potatoes
Lawry's seasoned salt
preparation: Place potatoes in water and boil until fork-tender.  You want to keep skin on potatoes.  Drain water; cover with cold water for a minute.  Cut potatoes in half; spray all over with Pam.  Sprinkle with Lawry's seasoned salt to taste.  Place on outdoor grill; turn once or twice with prongs.  Ready when face(s) of potatoes are lightly charred.  Serve as usual.

name: STOVE TOP CROCK-POT CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  whole chicken*
1  small sour cream
1  can of cream of mushroom, or cream of chicken soup
1  box Stove Top stuffing (chicken)
preparation: When using a whole chicken:  cook until done, remove skin, remove chicken from bones.  Keep broth that chicken made while cooking.  Add to the chicken broth:  sour cream, and soup.  Add the stuffing.  (Do not mix the Stove Top as you usually do.)  Just add to the broth and chicken with the other ingredients.  Mix all together.  Let cook for about an hour in the crock-pot, or to as hot as you desire.  Ready to eat.

name: FRESH CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
4 to 5  ears fresh corn
2  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. finely diced onion
1/4  c. finely diced green pepper
1 1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  tsp. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
1/16  tsp. pepper
1  c. milk
3  eggs, beaten
preparation: Cut corn kernels from cobs.  Measure 2 2/3 cups without packing down.  In a small skillet saute butter, onion and bell pepper until wilted.  In a medium bowl sift together cornstarch, sugar, salt, pepper, milk and eggs.  Mix well, then add the corn and onion mixture.  Pour in a pan and bake in a 300° oven about 1 hour or until knife inserted into center comes out clean.  Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before cutting and serving.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CARAMEL NUT ACORNS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
7/8  c. butter
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. finely chopped pecans
1/2  lb. caramels
1/4  c. water
3/4  c. finely chopped pecans
preparation: Melt  butter  in  2-quart square casserole pan over low heat. Stir in brown sugar, vanilla  and  1/3 cup pecans.  Add dry ingredients,  mixing  well.  Shape  into  balls  using  a rounded teaspoon.  Flatten on one side.  Pinch top to resemble an acorn. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 15 to 18 minutes at 350°.  Melt caramels and water in  top  of double boiler or microwave.  Dip bottom of acorn in  caramel  1  1/4 inch deep. Then in crushed pecans.

name: ROAST CORN
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2  Tbsp. chives
2  Tbsp. parsley
8  ears corn
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Melt butter with chives and parsley.  Brush corn with butter mixture, salt and pepper.  Wrap in foil and bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

name: MRS. MOON'S PINEAPPLE SHERBET
ingredients:
1  can juice packed pineapple, drained
3  Tbsp. sugar substitute
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Combine all the ingredients and freeze until slushy.  Beat on high speed with an electric mixer, then refreeze before serving. Yields 8 servings.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. pkg. Bisquick
1/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1  c. sour cream
1  c. blueberries
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. grated lemon peel
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Grease muffin tins.  Combine Bisquick and 1/4 cup sugar in bowl.  Make a "well" in center of mixture. Add sour cream and egg.  Beat with a fork until well combined. Fold in blueberries with rubber scraper.  Scoop 1/4 cup batter into each muffin cup (12 muffins).

name: HOMEMADE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
6  eggs, well beaten
2  handfuls brown sugar
2  c. white sugar
1 (3 oz.)  box instant pudding (French vanilla)
3  c. cream
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Add brown sugar  to  eggs; beat well.  Add white sugar, pudding, cream and vanilla.  Add milk until mixture is about 4 inches from top of	ice cream freezer.  This recipe is for a 6 quart freezer.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  (10 oz.) frozen chopped broccoli
2 (8 1/2 oz.)  pkg. Jiffy corn meal mix
4  eggs
1  c. cottage cheese
1  onion, chopped
2  sticks oleo, melted
preparation: Cook broccoli as directed on package and drain.  Combine by hand with remaining ingredients.  Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 400° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: COLESLAW
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage, shredded
2  medium carrots, shredded
1/2  small onion, finely chopped
5  Tbsp. vinegar
5  tsp. sugar
5  Tbsp. mayonnaise
pepper to taste (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.  Adjust vinegar, sugar and pepper to taste.  Chill.  Serve cold.

name: BLACKBERRY JAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
4  eggs, beaten
1  c. blackberry jam
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. each:  allspice, cloves, nutmeg, cinnamon
1  c. buttermilk
pinch of salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Cream butter and sugar together until fluffy; add eggs and jam. Sift dry ingredients together twice. Add to first mixture alternately with the milk. Depending on whether layers are to be thick or thin, prepare 3 or 4 (9 inch) pans. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until done. Stack with Caramel Icing.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening (part butter)
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1 small  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Add eggs, vanilla and peanut butter.  Add flour and soda.  Add chocolate chips.

name: ALMOND PUNCH
ingredients:
1  (46 oz.) unsweetened pineapple juice
1 pineapple juice  can water
1  (28 oz.) ginger ale
1/2  oz. almond flavoring
1 1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients in gallon jar.  Let punch chill overnight in the refrigerator, and it's ready to serve.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  c. oatmeal
1/2  c. lard
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Stir flour, sugar, oatmeal, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a mixing bowl.  Then stir in lard, buttermilk, vanilla, eggs, peanut butter, and chocolate chips.  Bake till golden brown or until done.

name: MOTHER'S CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. flour (heaping)
3  Tbsp. cocoa
dash of salt
1 1/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. hot water
3  egg yolks
1/2  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
baked pie shell
3  egg whites
3  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: In a saucepan, cook the first 5 ingredients. Add the egg yolks and cook for a few minutes more. Add margarine and vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell. Prepare meringue using the egg whites and sugar. Brown lightly under broiler.

name: CHOW MEIN NOODLE CLUSTERS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
1 (3 oz.)  can chow mein noodles
2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Melt chips over hot water.  Add rest of ingredients.  Drop onto wax paper.  Chill until set.  Keep refrigerated.  This can be served as candy.

name: SPRING TEMPTATION PIE
ingredients:
1  c. boiling water
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. Jell-O brand lemon flavored gelatin
1  c. orange or lemon sherbet
2  c. thawed Cool Whip
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  (9 oz.) prepared graham cracker crumb crust
preparation: Stir boiling water into gelatin in medium bowl for 2 minutes or until dissolved.  Stir in sherbet; mix until melted. Refrigerate for 25 minutes or until gelatin mixture is slightly thickened.  Fold in whipped topping, marshmallows and pineapple. Pour into crust.  Freeze until firm.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: SWEET AND SOUR MEATBALLS
ingredients:
30  meatballs to 1 lb.
1  slice bread, soaked in milk for each lb. hamburger
1  little chopped onion
a little bit garlic salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and form into balls. Put the meatballs on a cookie sheet and brown in oven for 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  jar Ragu thick and hearty spaghetti sauce
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  (24 oz.) container small curd cottage cheese
1  egg
1  box lasagna noodles
preparation: Brown hamburger; take grease off.  Stir in spaghetti sauce; heat on low until warm.  Cook lasagna noodles in large pan.  Add some vegetable oil to water so noodles don't stick; stir while cooking.  Run cold water over noodles; let drain.  Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam.  Lay noodles down on bottom of pan so pan is covered, then spread 1/2 of your meat sauce over noodles.  Stir in 1 egg to cottage cheese; spread 1/2 of cottage cheese evenly over spaghetti sauce, then sprinkle 1 1/2 packages Mozzarella cheese over cottage cheese.  Do your second layer of noodles, sauce, cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese again.  Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: MOOSE SHOULDER
ingredients:
2  lb. moose shoulder
1  clove garlic
fat
3  c. stock (boiled from bones)
cattail shoots
preparation: Cut meat into 1-inch cubes.  Chop garlic.  Brown meat in fat. Add garlic and cover with stock.  Cover and simmer for 2 hours. Add cattails for the last 20 minutes of cooking.

name: ORANGE-CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
6  oz. cherry Jell-O
1 (1 lb.)  can cranberry sauce
2  c. water
1 (10 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1  c. sour cream
1/3  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Heat cranberry sauce and water until dissolved.  Remove from heat and add Jell-O, stirring until dissolved.  Gel until partially set.  Add nuts, oranges and sour cream.  Pour in a 2-quart mold and let set in refrigerator.

name: HONG KONG CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  cut up chicken
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  clove crushed garlic
2  Tbsp. sugar (white)
1  tsp. Accent
1  tsp. ginger
preparation: Mix together;  put  in  bowl with chicken.  Marinate in refrigerator overnight (24 hours).  Bake at 350° for one hour, covered, then  15  minutes  or  so, uncovered.  Watch and turn often.  For 6 or 8 breasts I double recipe.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. Crisco
2  c. flour
3  c. oats
1  c. coconut
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts
preparation: Cream sugars and Crisco together.  Add eggs one at a time and mix well.  Add vanilla.  Add dry ingredients.  Drop by a teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 8 minutes.  Do not brown.

name: SPINACH SOUFFLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. skim milk
1/2  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, cooked and drained
1  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
3/4  c. Egg Beaters
preparation: Melt margarine.  Blend in flour and salt.  Cook over low heat; stir until smooth and bubbly.  Remove from heat and gradually stir in milk.  Return to heat and bring to boil, stirring constantly. Cook 1 minute.  Remove from heat.  Stir in spinach and onion. Beat Egg Beaters; fold in spinach mixture.  Put in greased casserole.  Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.

name: 3 FRUIT CHUTNEY
ingredients:
2  c. cranberries
1  tart apple, peeled, cored and chopped
1  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. vinegar
1/8  tsp. ground ginger
1/8  tsp. ground allspice
1/8  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. snipped dry apricots
1/4  c. water
preparation: Combine cranberries, apple, apricots, brown sugar, vinegar, ginger, allspice, dry mustard, 1/4 cup water and 1/4 teaspoon salt.  Bring to boiling.  Reduce and simmer, uncovered, 15 minutes.  Stir frequently.  Spoon into containers.  Cover, seal and refrigerate or freeze.  Makes 2 cups.  Good accompaniment to cold cuts, such as ham, turkey and roast beef.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. syrup
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. nuts
3  eggs
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. oleo or butter
1  (9-inch) pie shell, unbaked
preparation: Beat eggs and all ingredients, except nuts.  Pour into pie shell.  Chop nuts and sprinkle in pie shell.  Bake 1 hour at 325°.

name: FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
1  egg
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix all ingredients. Dip bread in mixture and fry in melted butter. Makes 4 slices.

name: AUNT DEB'S EASY LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 small  box lasagna noodles (1 lb.)
1 (16 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1  large container cottage cheese (2 lb.)
2  c. (at least) Mozzarella cheese
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 small  can mushrooms (optional)
preparation: Prepare lasagna noodles according to package directions. While noodles are cooking, brown ground beef in large skillet; drain. Add spaghetti sauce to ground beef. Lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer as follows: Noodles, cottage cheese, ground beef mixture, 1/2 of the Mozzarella cheese, noodles, 1/2 of the Mozzarella cheese. Mushrooms may be added if desired. Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.

name: SOUTHERN PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. corn syrup
1/4  c. butter, melted
3  eggs, well beaten
1  c. pecan halves
1  unbaked 9-inch pie shell
preparation: Mix sugar, syrup and butter.  Add eggs and pecans.  Fill unbaked pie shell with mixture and bake in 325° oven for 45 minutes.  Makes 1 (9-inch) pie.

name: CATTLEMEN'S HOUSE DRESSING
ingredients:
1  qt. real mayonnaise
1/2  c. grated American cheese
2  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
finely chopped garlic to taste (approximately 2 small cloves)
preparation: Mix well and thin with milk or cream.

name: PINEAPPLE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. cold water
1/4  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
5  slices pineapple
preparation: Melt butter for topping in a 9-inch pan or a square pan. Sprinkle brown sugar on butter, then place pineapple in pan.  Mix butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla, flour, baking powder, salt and water together.  Place batter on topping.  Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

name: APRICOT POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  Duncan Hines butter recipe cake mix
4  eggs
3/4  c. oil
1/2  c. brown sugar
1 large  jar apricot baby food
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients  until smooth.  Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan.  Bake at 325° for 45 to 60 minutes.

name: GINATAANG PINOY
ingredients:
1/4  kg. spring or string beans, cut 2 inches long
1/4  kg. pumpkin or squash, cut in cubes (may substitute carrots or cauliflower)
2  onions, 1 sliced in cubes and 1 in rings
2  red tomatoes, sliced
1  small piece ginger
2  pieces fresh red or green peppers
1/2  lb. chicken, pork or shrimp
1 1/2  c. thick coconut milk
salt
1  Knorr or any other powder/cube seasoning
preparation: Add 1/2 cup coconut milk in a pan.  Add Knorr cube seasoning and gently boil.  Add ginger, sliced onions and tomatoes for 3 minutes.  Add chicken (meat), salt and boil  until half cooked. Add vegetables and cook another 5 to 10 minutes.  Add the remaining coconut milk and cook 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Add fresh peppers on top.  Transfer to a platter and place onion rings on top.  Serve with rice and potatoes.

name: CABBAGE ROLLS (CHICKEN)
ingredients:
1  large head green cabbage
1  c. barley
1 1/2  lb. chicken thighs
1  stick butter or oleo
1  c. light sour cream
1  envelope onion soup
1  to 2 leeks, diced fine
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Core and blanch cabbage to loosen leaves, yields about 8 large plus 8 medium size leaves.  Cook barley per package directions. Saute leeks in 1/2 of the margarine.  Skin and bone chicken; slice into strips.

name: OYSTER CRACKER MIX
ingredients:
1  c. oil
1  tsp. lemon pepper
2  tsp. ground dill seed
1  tsp. garlic powder
1 1/2  pkg. Ranch House salad dressing mix
3  pkg. oyster crackers
preparation: Put seasoning in heated oil and pour over crackers; mix thoroughly and set aside.  It will look oily.  Stir them every once in a while and they will lose the oily look.  Be patient, stirring may last two or three hours.  Keep stored in an airtight container.

name: OATMEAL CHEWIES
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. oatmeal (dry)
1 1/2  c. flour
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  sticks margarine, melted
1  c. (6 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1 (12.5 oz.)  jar caramel topping
1/4  c. flour
preparation: Lightly grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Combine oats, 1 1/2 cups of flour, brown sugar, soda and salt; mix well.  Stir in margarine; mix until well blended.  Reserve 1 cup.  Press remaining onto a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes until light brown.  Cool 10 minutes.  Top with nuts and chocolate pieces.  Mix caramel and 1/4 cup of flour until smooth (easier if warmed slightly).  Drizzle over nuts and chocolate pieces to within 1/4 inch of pan edges.  Sprinkle with reserved mixture. Bake at 350° for 18 to 22 minutes.  Cool and cut.

name: PORK ADOBO
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. pork, cut in large chunks
4  cloves garlic, diced fine
1  yellow (medium) onion, diced fine
4 to 5  Tbsp. pickling spice
1/2  c. apple cider vinegar
1/4  c. soy sauce
preparation: Rinse pork and set aside.  In large pot brown fat from parts of pork chunks.  When oil is hot (released from pork chunks), remove fat and sauté garlic and onion.  Add pork chunks and brown, stirring periodically.  When pork has browned, drain oil and add vinegar, soy sauce and pickling spice.  Cover and set heat at medium and let pork steam.  When steaming, the meat will release its own juice.  Check periodically and stir.  When juice has turned to basically oil, adobois ready (about 20 minutes).  Drain oil and serve.

name: PEAS AND PEANUT SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen peas, defrosted and not cooked
3  oz. unsalted peanuts
3  Tbsp. oil
1  Tbsp. wine vinegar
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
preparation: Combine peas and peanuts in a mixing bowl.  In a small bowl, blend oil and vinegar.  Add to peanut-peas mixture.  Stir until well coated; then drain off excess oil-vinegar mixture.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste; add the mayonnaise.

name: CARAMEL CRUNCH SUNDAES
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. soft butter
1/3  c. brown sugar, packed
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
preparation: Spread butter on baking sheet (15 1/2 x 11-inch), leaving a 1 1/2-inch border on all sides.  Sprinkle sugar on buttered area. Set oven control at broil.  Broil sugar 3 to 4 inches from heat for 1 to 2 minutes.  (Watch closely; mixture burns quickly.) Crunch will have a lacy appearance.  Cool a few minutes on baking sheet.  Remove with spatula and break into pieces.  Divide ice cream in 4 dessert dishes; sprinkle broken crunch over ice cream. Makes 4 servings.

name: BAKED EGGPLANT PARMESAN
ingredients:
medium-sized eggplant
egg
bread crumbs
1/3  c. olive oil
1  pt. spaghetti sauce
Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cut 1/2-inch slices from peeled, medium-sized eggplant.  Dip in beaten egg and bread crumbs and fry until crisp in olive oil. Place fried slices of eggplant in casserole dish and cover with spaghetti sauce.  Cover with thin slices or shredded Mozzarella cheese.  Bake in moderate oven 15 to 20 minutes.  One-half pound of browned meat can be added.

name: MARES' ROAST
ingredients:
1  rump roast or eye of round roast
oil
4  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  Tbsp. salt
1/2  Tbsp. pepper
1/2  stick margarine
3  Tbsp. vinegar
2  to 3 onions, sliced thick
preparation: Preheat oven  to 350°.	Brown roast on all sides in oil on stove top  in  Dutch  oven	or  roaster.  In  a small bowl, combine  Worcestershire  sauce,  salt  and	pepper. Spoon over roast.  Attach  onion  slices to roast with toothpicks.  Place margarine on  top.	Pour  vinegar over roast.  Cover with lid. Bake for  approximately  45  minutes to 1 hour per pound until tender.  Add water to roast, as necessary.	Remove roast.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow pudding cake mix
3/4  c. oil
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
4  eggs (large)
1 small  pkg. chocolate chips
1 small  can (3/4 c.) Hershey's chocolate
preparation: Grease  pan generously.  Mix  all  ingredients,  except chocolate and  chips.  Take  out  1/3  of  batter and mix with chocolate  and  chips.  Layer  yellow cake, chocolate cake and yellow  cake.  Swirl through several times with spatula.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.  Let remain in pan until cool.

name: HUNGRY JACK BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. salt
1 (16 oz.)  can pork and beans
3/4  c. barbecue sauce
1  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  can Hungry Jack biscuits (9 1/2 oz.)
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Brown ground beef and drain.  Stir in next 5 ingredients; heat until bubbly.  Pour into 2-quart casserole.  Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles.  Place cut side down around edge of casserole.  Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: HOMEMADE POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
6  to 10 large potatoes, peeled and cut into cubes
2  leeks, washed and cut into bite-size pieces (optional)
2  onions, chopped
1  celery stalk, sliced
4  chicken bouillon cubes
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
5  c. water
1  Tbsp. salt and pepper to taste
1/3  c. butter
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
chopped chives
preparation: Put all ingredients except evaporated milk and chives in crock-pot or large pot on stove.  Stir in evaporated milk and chives when soup is done.

name: COUNTRY APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  egg
1/3  c. melted butter
1 (20 oz.)  can apple pie filling
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. chopped nuts
1  c. sour cream
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together first 3 ingredients and pour into baking dish (I spray with Pam).  Pat to cover bottom of dish.   Pour in apple pie filling.   Spread over cake mixture.   Mix brown sugar, cinnamon and chopped nuts.   Pour over mixture.   Mix sour cream, 1 egg and vanilla.   Drizzle over cake.    Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: SCRAMBLED EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. cubed ham
1/4  c. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. melted butter
1  doz. eggs, beaten
1/8  tsp. paprika
preparation: Saute ham and onion in 3 tablespoons butter in a large skillet until onion is tender.  Add eggs and cook over medium-high heat; stir to form large, soft curds.  When eggs are set, stir in Cheese Sauce (recipe follows).  Spoon eggs into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Sprinkle with paprika and chill overnight.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.  Serves 8.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  egg
1  c. sugar
1  c. peanut butter (great if you use 1/2 c. creamy peanut butter and 1/2 c. crunchy peanut butter)
preparation: Mix together well.  Roll into small balls.   Put on cookie sheet.  Press out with fork.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Great for kids!

name: BEV'S POPOVER PANCAKE
ingredients:
1  egg
1/4  c. flour
1/4  c. milk or up to 1/2 c.
nutmeg
butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Beat egg.  Add flour.  Gradually add milk until smooth.  Melt butter in shallow pan until bubbly; pour in batter.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.  (If you have used extra milk, lower temperature to 350° after 10 minutes; bake until done.)  Top with maple syrup, powdered sugar, fruit or jam.

name: DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. lukewarm milk
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. salt
2  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. lukewarm water
2  beaten eggs
1/2  c. shortening
7  c. flour
preparation: Soak yeast in lukewarm water 5 minutes without stirring; stir well before adding to milk mixture.  Add eggs and shortening; stir well.  Gradually add flour; knead well.  Place in greased bowl; let rise.  Punch down; let rise again.  Punch down; shape into rolls. Let rise and bake 25 to 30 minutes at 375°.

name: PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
3/4  c. Crisco shortening
1/2  Tbsp. salt
2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. water
preparation: Mix sugar, salt and flour.  Cut in shortening; add water. Flour board and roll the pie crust out thick.  Put in greased 9-inch pie pan.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. Instant Knorr Leek Soup Mix (or vegetable)
1  can (8 oz.) water chestnuts, sliced
1  pt. sour cream
1 1/2  c. - 2 c. Best Foods mayonnaise
1  pkg. (16 oz.) frozen spinach - cook and squeeze out water
1  round sourdough bread
preparation: Mix all ingredients together except water chestnuts and bread.  Mince water chestnuts and add to mixture.  Refrigerate overnight for best results.

name: HOW TO BE A GOOD NEIGHBOR
ingredients:
1  tongue that does not slander
2  ears closed to gossip
1  heart generous and kind
1  mind full of tolerance
1  dash smile
2  eyes overlooking others faults
2  hands, extended to help others
1  dash sunny disposition
1  dash cheerfulness
preparation: Blend all together; form into one being and serve generous portions daily to everyone you meet.

name: QUICK FLUFFY FROSTING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cold milk
1  envelope Dream Whip
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. instant pudding (any flavor)
preparation: Pour milk into deep narrow bowl.  Add Dream Whip and pudding mix.  Beat until forms peaks.  Makes 3 cups.  Store frosted cake in refrigerator.

name: STRAWBERRY COW(A/K/A  Purple Cow)
ingredients:
2 small  boxes of raspberry jello
2  c. boiling water
1  can of crushed pineapple and juice
1  can blueberry or strawberry pie filling
preparation: Chill until set.

name: STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
6  green peppers
2  c. cooked rice
2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. chopped hamburger
1  chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4 to 1/2  bottle chili sauce
1  c. buttered crumbs
preparation: Trim peppers and boil shells for 5 minutes in salted water; drain.  Stuff with rest of ingredients; cover with crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until peppers are tender and crumbs brown.

name: SPANISH RICE PRONTO
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. (or 5 oz. pkg.) Minute rice
1/4  c. fat
2  cans (8 oz. each) tomato sauce
1  medium onion, thinly sliced
1/2  medium green pepper, diced
1 3/4  c. hot water
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  tsp. prepared mustard (optional)
preparation: Melt fat in skillet.  Add onion, green pepper and Minute rice (right from the package).  Stir over high heat until lightly browned.  Add water, tomato sauce and seasoning.  Mix well.  Bring quickly to a boil.  Cover tightly and simmer 10 minutes.  Serve it steaming, and sit back for applause from four muchos happy people.

name: FROSTY LIME COOLER
ingredients:
1/2  c. bottled lime juice
1/4  c. granulated sugar
1  qt. sparkling water, chilled
1  pt. lime sherbet
1  pt. pineapple sherbet
1  pt. lemon sherbet
lime slices and juice of 1 lime
mint leaves
preparation: In a blender, combine lime juice and sugar; whirl until sugar is dissolved.  Add sparkling water, lime juice and several tablespoons of pineapple, lime and lemon sherbet.  Mix well. Fill chilled glasses 3/4 full of mixture.  Add scoops of sherbet and garnish with lime slices and mint leaves.

name: POPOVERS
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1  c. Gold Medal Wondra flour
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat oven to 425° (hot).  Heavily grease 6 deep custard cups. Beat eggs slightly and add milk, Wondra flour and salt.  Stir with fork just until smooth.  Do not overbeat.  Fill greased custard cups 1/2 full.  Bake 40 to 45 minutes.   Serve with honey butter. Mix honey in butter and whip together; chill.

name: BRAISED BEEF AND NOODLES
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. boneless stew beef, cut into bite size pieces
1 large (16 oz.)  can tomato puree
1  can water
1  can beef consomme soup
1/2  c. chopped onion
6  toes garlic, chopped fine
1/2  c. chopped celery
2  bay leaves
dash of cinnamon, salt and pepper
preparation: Salt, pepper and flour stew beef.  Brown in small amount of oil. Add onion, garlic and celery. Cook until clear.  Add soup and stir. Add tomato puree and stir. Add water.  Add bay leaves, cinnamon, salt and pepper.  Let cook 1 1/2 hours. Serve over hot cooked noodles.  Makes 6 generous servings. Sauce freezes well.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  bag (32-oz.) frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1  pint sour cream
1  can condensed Cheddar cheese soup or 2 c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. margarine, melted
Crushed corn flakes
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients together.  Spoon into a large baking dish; sprinkle crushed cornflakes on top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI PIE
ingredients:
zucchini
1  c. sugar
1  egg
2  Tbsp. (heaping) flour
1  c. Carnation milk
1 1/2  tsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
nutmeg
8-inch uncooked pie shell
preparation: Peel, cut out seeds and make one cup cooked zucchini.  Put in blender and add sugar, egg, flour, milk, butter and vanilla. Sprinkle nutmeg on top.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake at 425° for 10 minutes, then at 300° for 20 minutes.

name: COCONUT CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
2  egg yolks, lightly beaten (save egg whites for top)
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix dry ingredients with a little milk, then mix this with the remaining milk and boil and stir until thick.  Mix small amount of thickened mixture with egg yolks and put this back in the thickened mixture.  Add butter and vanilla and cook a little longer.  Add 1/2 cup shredded coconut.  Put in baked pie shell or graham cracker crust.

name: SWEET AND SOUR CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. corn oil
1 1/2  c. cooked apples
1/2  tsp. baking soda
20  packets Sweet 'N Low
2  c. self-rising flour
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix flour, soda and Sweet 'N Low together; set aside.  Mix eggs, oil, apples and vanilla.  Mix with dry ingredients and bake until done.

name: CHOCOLATE CRACKLES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. melted butter
4  oz. unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled or 12 Tbsp.  cocoa and 4 Tbsp. oil, mixed
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
powdered sugar
preparation: Mix flour, salt and baking powder.  Mix melted butter, melted chocolate and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, and mix well.  Add vanilla and stir.  Add dry ingredients and mix until combined. Dough will be soft.  Chill.  Drop by teaspoons into powdered sugar.  Shape into ball.  Place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet.  Bake 12 minutes at 350°.

name: OATMEAL FUDGE
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
3/4  c. cocoa
1  c. milk
2  sticks margarine
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. peanut butter
4  c. quick oats (uncooked)
coconut to taste (if desired)
preparation: Mix first four ingredients together.  Bring to boil.  Boil for 5 minutes.  Do not stir!  Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter, vanilla and oats, then coconut.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. Enjoy!

name: DEVILED PECANS
ingredients:
4  c. pecans
1 1/2  tsp. onion salt
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/8  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1  tsp. Accent
preparation: Spread pecans in a shallow pan, and roast in a slow oven (325°) for about 10 minutes.  Pecans should be crisp, but not really browned.  Stir pecans twice during baking.

name: APPLE DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  can Hungry Jack biscuits
4  apples, chopped
1  stick butter
10  oz. 7-Up
1  c. sugar
cinnamon
preparation: Roll out biscuits.  Place apples in center.   Sprinkle cinnamon on apples; fold over and seal the edges of biscuits. Place in large glass dish.  Bring to boil the butter, 7-Up and sugar.  Pour over dumplings and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: TON-KATSU (JAPANESE PORK CUTLETS)
ingredients:
4  to 5 pork chops (without bones)
1  to 2 eggs
bread crumbs (homemade is better)
flour
oil
preparation: Debone pork chops; make small slit around each piece so they don't shrink and roll up.  Tenderize them if you wish.  Massage in salt, pepper and garlic powder into both sides of each pork chop. Roll them in flour, dip in egg liquid and roll into bread crumbs. Let them rest in refrigerator for at least an hour.

name: MEAT CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  medium chopped onion
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. finely shredded carrots
3  c. finely shredded cabbage
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1 (16 oz.)  jar herb spaghetti sauce
dash of black pepper
1  Tbsp. chopped chives
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: In medium skillet, saute onion in butter until soft, but not brown.  Add ground beef; cook, breaking up the meat until meat loses its pink color.

name: FRESH TOMATO SALSA
ingredients:
2 large  bunches green onions, chopped
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies for mild flavor or 1 (3 1/2 oz.) can diced jalapeno peppers for hotter flavor
5  large tomatoes, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Italian salad dressing
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.  Chill overnight.

name: CRISPIX CARAMEL MIX
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. soda
8  c. Crispix
2  c. peanuts
preparation: Combine first four ingredients.  Bring to a boil on High in the microwave (2 to 3 minutes).  Boil 2 to 3 minutes longer, stirring several times.  Remove and stir in soda.  Mix well.  Pour over cereal and peanuts in a paper sack.  Put sack in microwave 3 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds.   Spread out to cool on cookie sheet.  Stir often while cooling.

name: CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. gin
1  Tbsp. sugar
garlic to taste
12  to 15 wings
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Double or triple according to number of wings.  Marinate 8 hours, turning a few times.  Bake in shallow pan for 1 hour at 350°.

name: CHEESE - SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage
1  lb. sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
3  c. Bisquick
preparation: Mix together until crumbly.  Form into small balls.  Bake on cookie sheet for 10 minutes at 400°.

name: CRAB NEWBERG
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
2  c. crab meat, cooked
3  oz. dry sherry
1  c. cream
pinch of cayenne pepper
pinch of nutmeg
salt to taste
3  egg yolks, beaten
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan.  Add crab meat and spices and simmer on slow heat for 3 minutes.  Add 2 ounces of sherry and let it reduce by one-half, about 2 minutes, then add cream.  Dilute egg yolks with 1 ounce sherry.  Add and mix carefully.  Cook and stir until thickened.  Serve over rice.  Serves 4 people.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs
1/3  c. chopped nuts
3  bananas, mashed
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream shortening & sugar. Add eggs. Dissolve soda in the bananas. Add flour, baking powder, salt, and nuts. Stir in bananas and mix well. Pour into greased pans. Makes 2 loaves. Fill 8 inch loaf pans half full and bake at 350° about an hour.

name: COLD SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. thin spaghetti
8  oz. Italian dressing
1 1/2  oz. McCormick Salad Supreme
1/2  green pepper
3  scallions
1  small cucumber
1  stalk celery
1  small tomato, diced
black olives, sliced
preparation: Day Before Serving:  Cook spaghetti.  Don't use salt or oil. Rinse in cold water and drain.  Marinate overnight in 4 ounces of Italian dressing.

name: GRANNY'S PUNCH
ingredients:
1  box strawberry Jell-O
1  c. boiling water
1 (48 oz.)  can pineapple juice
2  cans frozen lemonade
2  cans frozen orange juice
2 large  bottles ginger ale
preparation: Mix Jell-O with boiling water.  Add the juices. Chill and when ready to serve, add ginger ale.  This will serve 50 people.

name: SWEET ONION CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  c. chopped Vidalia sweet onions
1/4  c. chopped bell pepper (optional)
4  Tbsp. cooking oil or margarine
3  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. heavy cream
1  egg plus 2 yolks
1  Tbsp. chopped pimento (optional)
1  tsp. seasoned salt
paprika as garnish
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Saute onions and bell pepper in cooking oil for 15 minutes on medium-low heat.  Place half of grated cheese in 2-quart casserole dish.  Top with saute and pepper.  Add remaining cheese on top of onions and pepper.  Combine heavy cream (unwhipped), eggs, pimento and salt to make a sauce.  Pour sauce over cheese and onions.  Sprinkle paprika as a garnish.  Bake in 400° oven for 10 minutes, lower heat to 325° and bake 25 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

name: LIME AND ICE CREAM JELLO
ingredients:
1  qt. vanilla ice cream, melted
6  oz. lime jello
2  c. boiling water
20  oz. can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. ground nuts (optional)
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add melted ice cream and mix well.  Mix in pineapple and nuts.   Thic can be mixed in a 9 x 13-inch dish.  Refrigerate.

name: CRAWFISH FETTUCINI
ingredients:
3  sticks butter
3  medium onions, chopped
3  ribs celery, chopped
2  bell peppers, chopped
1/4  c. flour
4  Tbsp. parsley
3  lb. crawfish tails, peeled
1  qt. half and half
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, cubed 1/2-inch thick
3  cloves garlic, pressed
salt and pepper to taste
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. fettucini noodles
Parmesan cheese to taste
preparation: Melt butter in large, heavy saucepan.  Add onions, celery and bell peppers.  Cook for 10 minutes, until onions are clear.  Add flour; blend in well.  Cover; cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add parsley and crawfish tails.  Cover; cook for 20 minutes, stirring often.  Add cream, cheese and garlic; mix well. Add salt and pepper (I use Tony Chachere, too).  Cook, covered, on low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Cook noodles according to package directions.  Drain and add sauce mixture; mix thoroughly.  Pour into 3 lightly buttered casserole dishes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.  (You can use 1 pound crawfish and 1/3 recipe for smaller amount.)

name: PEPPERMINT CHOCOLATE BONBONS
ingredients:
1  c. (6 oz.) milk chocolate chips
1/3  c. margarine
1/4  c. whipping cream
1  c. unsifted powdered sugar
1/4  tsp. peppermint extract
preparation: Mix chocolate chips, margarine and cream in heavy saucepan. Place over very low heat and stir until chips and margarine are melted and mixture is smooth and thick.  Remove from heat.  Beat in powdered sugar until mixture is smooth again.  Stir in peppermint extract.  Cover and chill 1 to 2 hours until mixture is thick enough to shape or drop into small candy cups.  Divide mixture into 24 portions.  Drop with No. 70 small scoop or roll into small balls before placing in candy cups.  Makes about 24 bon bons.

name: FILLED COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
1  c. sour cream
2  eggs
2  tsp. soda
dash of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
approximately 5 1/2 c. flour
preparation: Note:  When the batter gets hard to mix with a mixer, stir in remaining flour.

name: SPINACH BALLS
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  boxes chopped spinach, cooked and drained
2  c. dry bread crumbs
2  medium onions, chopped well
6  beaten eggs
3/4  c. melted butter
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Make into 1-inch balls.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Makes 40 balls.

name: ORANGE WINE SAUCE(Serve With Pork)
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. orange juice
1/2  c. white wine
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. salt or less
preparation: Melt butter, add flour.  Stir in juice, slowly, then wine. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly.  Add brown sugar and salt.

name: CHOCOLATE CHERRY BARS
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate cake mix
21  oz. can cherry pie filling
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Mix all three together (by hand).  Spread in jelly roll pan. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.

name: SALISBURY STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  egg, beaten
2  c. bread crumbs
1  small onion, chopped
1  small bell pepper, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Mix first five ingredients well.  Shape into patties and fry. When done, top with soup and simmer.

name: LIFE-LINE COOKIE DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
4  Tbsp. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
5  c. flour
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and eggs very well.   Mix eggs into batter, one at a time.  Add vanilla and dry ingredients.  Mix very well.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. light cream cheese, softened
1  (8 oz.) light sour cream
1  pkg. dry Good Seasons regular Italian dressing mix
2 (6 1/2 oz.)  cans small shrimp
preparation: Drain shrimp.  Rinse lightly.  While draining mix all other ingredients together and add shrimp.  Chill.  Serve with crackers or bagels.  Makes large bowl.  Enjoy!

name: PEPPERONI PIZZA ROLLS
ingredients:
1  package of Pillsbury Crusty French Loaf
1/4  cup pizza sauce
1  package of pepperoni slices
1  cup shredded mozzarella cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350. Unroll French Loaf on cookie sheet. Brush bread with olive oil and then spread pizza sauce, leaving about a 1/2 inch edge around bread. Place pepperoni slices and then top with shredded cheese. Begin rolling bread lengthwise and pinch seam and edges.  Brush with olive oil and sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Bake seam side down for about 20 minutes or until golden brown.  Let cool slightly and then cut in 1 1/2 inch slices with a serrated knife. Makes a great party favorite.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large (1 qt. 4 oz.)  can pineapple juice
6 2/3  c. sugar
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1 heaping  tsp. citric acid
2 (2 liter)  bottles ginger ale
preparation: In  an	enamel	pot  add  enough  hot water to dissolve sugar. Add   citric  acid.  Add	orange	juice.	Stir  until completely dissolved.  Add  pineapple juice; stir.  Divide in half  equally and put into 2 (1 gallon) containers.  Add cold water  to fill up rest of the way.  Add food color if desired. Freeze.  Add  64 ounces ginger ale per gallon frozen punch in punch	bowl.  This punch  is its own ice.  Just chop it up in ginger ale.  One gallon will serve 25 people.

name: BEANS
ingredients:
2  cans string beans, drained
1 small  can mushrooms
1  can mushroom soup
bread crumbs
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Sprinkle with bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.  Put 3 pats butter.   Bake 1/2 hour.

name: MOTHER'S LIFETIME RECIPE
ingredients:
2  heaping cups of patience
1  heart full of love
2  hands full of generosity
dash of laughter
1  head full of understanding
preparation: Sprinkle generously with kindness.  Add plenty of faith and mix well. Spread over a period of a lifetime and serve everybody you meet.

name: ONE BOWL CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
2  pkg. (8 sq.) semi-sweet chocolate
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Microwave chocolate and milk in large microwavable bowl on High 2 to 3 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted, stirring halfway through heating time.  Stir until chocolate is completely melted.  Stir in vanilla and walnuts.

name: POPEYE'S BISCUITS
ingredients:
3  c. Pioneer baking mix (blue box)
1/2  c. Sprite
8  oz. sour cream
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Mix baking mix, Sprite and sour cream.  Roll out onto floured pastry sheet to 1 inch thickness.  Cut with biscuit cutters and place on cookie sheet.  Melt 1/4 cup butter. Brush over biscuits. Bake at 375° until brown.

name: CALEB'S FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2  bananas
1  orange
10  to 20 strawberries
1  to 2 peaches
1  c. watermelon pieces
1/4 to 1/2  c. coconut
1/4  c. sunflower seeds or other nuts (optional)
1/2  can condensed orange juice or other juice
preparation: Peel and cut fruit.  Mix together in bowl.  Add juice and toss to coat ingredients thoroughly.  You can substitute, add or delete any of the fruits according to personal likes or what is in season.

name: CHOCOLATE SAUCE FOR ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) Hershey bar
1  carton whipped cream
orange flavor liqueur
preparation: Melt candy in a bowl in the microwave with about half of the whipping cream (you don't want the sauce too thin).  Add liqueur to your taste and mix.  Pour over ice cream while warm.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
2  cans (16 oz) pork and beans
1/2  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  tsp. mustard
2  tsp. worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. white sugar
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. ketchup
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion; drain.  Mix all other ingredients together in 2 quart casserole.  Add beef and onion. Bake uncovered at 375 degrees for 1 hour.

name: ANGELS BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. flour, sifted
1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1  c. shortening
preparation: Sift dry ingredients.  Cut in shortening.  Dissolve dry yeast in	warm water and combine with buttermilk.  Add to dry ingredients.  Stir	well  and  knead,  adding  more  flour	if necessary.	Roll  out  on  floured board about 1/2-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter.  Brush tops with melted butter.  Bake at 450° until golden brown.

name: MEXICAN BEEF AND RICE
ingredients:
1 (6.8 oz.)  pkg. Rice-A-Roni beef flavor
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef or turkey
salsa
1 (12 oz.)  can Mexican style corn, drained
salt
pepper
sour cream
preparation: Prepare Rice-A-Roni as package directs.    Stir in corn during last 5 minutes of cooking.   Shape meat into six 1/2-inch thick patties.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. flour
2 1/3  c. sugar
6  eggs
1 1/3  c. milk
1 1/3  c. oil
2  tsp. lemon
2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix eggs, sugar and oil together.  Put rest of ingredients together.  Put in tube pan at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: BLUEBERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
16  graham crackers (not crumbs)
1  large vanilla instant pudding
1  large cool whip
1  can blueberry pie filling
preparation: Line bottom of 9x13 in  cake pan with graham crackers. Mix pudding according to pkg directions. Add cool whip to pudding and spread half of mixture on top of crackers. Add another layer of crackers and other half of filling. Top with blueberry filling. Refrigerate a few hours before serving.

name: MEAT LOAF(Microwave)
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  egg
1  c. Minute rice
1  Tbsp. onion flakes
1  can tomato soup
1  Tbsp. Lawry's salt
pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients in large bowl.  Place in microwave-safe dish, preferably tube-style.  Cook on High 15 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: HAMBURGER-CORN BAKE
ingredients:
3  oz. medium noodles
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
2  c. corn
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
