1  c. soft bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. margarine, melted
preparation: Cook noodles until done; drain.  In a large skillet, brown hamburger and onion; drain off fat.  Stir in soup, corn, sour cream, milk, salt and pepper.  Mix well.  Stir in cooked noodles. Put mixture into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Toss bread crumbs with melted butter on top of casserole.  Bake, uncovered, about 50 minutes at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. chopped broccoli
6  slices American cheese
1 1/2  sticks butter or oleo
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1/4  lb. Ritz crackers, crushed
preparation: Cook broccoli as directed.  Drain.  Mix into hot, drained broccoli, the American cheese (in pieces), 1/2 stick butter and minced onion.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes, covered.

name: OREO ICE CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  package oreos or oreo crumbs (found in baking section)
1/2  gallon vanilla ice cream, (box, not in a tub), slightly softened
hot fudge
cool whip
1/4  stick butter or margarine, melted
2  tablespoon sugar
preparation: Crush oreos; reserve 1/2 cup for top and mix with butter and sugar. Press into a 9 x 13 inch pan. Cut ice cream into slabs and lay on crust. Freeze 1 - 2 hours. Pour a thin layer of hot fudge on the ice cream. Top with cool whip and oreos.

name: LEMON SLUSH
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. nuts, chopped
1  stick oleo
1  c. confectioners sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. Cool Whip
2  pkg. instant lemon pudding mix
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and pat in bottom of pan.  Bake 20 minutes.  Mix next 3 ingredients and spread over crust.  Mix pudding mix and milk and beat until thick.  Spread over cream cheese layer.  Put rest of an 8 ounce Cool Whip on top.

name: FRENCH PASTRY
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1 1/4  c. shortening
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
5 1/2  Tbsp. cold water
1  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Sift and measure flour.  Add salt.  Cut in shortening until the size of peas.  Beat egg with water and vinegar.  Add to dry ingredients and mix.  Makes enough for 2 (2 crust) pies or 4 (1 crust) pies.

name: PISTACHIO SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. instant pistachio pudding
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple and juice
1  (12 oz.) small curd creamed cottage cheese
1  (13 1/2 oz.) Cool Whip
1/2  c. finely chopped maraschino cherries
preparation: Mix all together and let stand overnight before serving.

name: DELECTABLE DOO-DADS
ingredients:
5  c. flour (unsifted)
2  c. granulated sugar
2/3  c. brown sugar
1 (15 oz.)  box Raisin Bran
5  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. allspice
4  eggs, beaten
1  c. oil
1  qt. buttermilk
preparation: Mix the flour, sugars, soda, salt and spices together in a large bowl.  Blend in Raisin Bran.  Add eggs, buttermilk and oil; blend well.  Bake in paper muffin cups or greased tins for 15 minutes, or until done, at 400°.  Makes about 4 dozen muffins. This batter will keep 4 to 5 weeks in the refrigerator.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
2  c. sour cream
2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. dill weed
2  Tbsp. parsley
2  Tbsp. minced Bermuda onion
1  Tbsp. Accent
1  Tbsp. celery seed
2  pkg. corned beef (Hillshire Farms deli style)
1  (2 lb.) round rye or Italian bread
preparation: Mix first 7 ingredients together.  Shred corned beef and stir in to mixture.  Cut top of bread in circle and dig out inside of bread.  Place dip in bread bowl.  Tear remaining bread in bite size pieces and place around "bowl" for dipping.  May want to buy extra bread.

name: RASPBERRY MOLDED SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple (yellow label)
1 large  pkg. raspberry jello
1 medium size  carton cottage cheese
1  medium size container Cool Whip
preparation: Bring pineapple and juice to boil.  Add jello; stir until dissolved.  Remove from heat.  Cool.  Add cottage cheese.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Pour into mold.

name: TARIN'S TOSTADA DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1/4  jar mild salsa (may add more)
preparation: Mix together and serve with Mexican chips.

name: CHILI STEWED HEN
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. oil, divided
4  cloves garlic, minced
2 1/2 to 3  lb. chicken, cut up
1  c. chicken broth
2  bay leaves
1  tsp. oregano leaves, crushed
1  tsp. thyme
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. flour
2  c. chicken broth
3  Tbsp. Red Chili Puree or 1 to 2 Tbsp. mild pure chili powder
salt and pepper
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Saute onion and garlic; set aside.  Dust chicken with flour and brown on both sides.  Stir in onion, garlic mixture, chili puree, bay leaves, oregano, thyme, salt and pepper.  Cover and cook 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.  Remove bay leaves.  In a small bowl, blend cornstarch and water until smooth.  Combine with mixture in skillet and cook over low heat, stirring until thickened.  Pour sauce over chicken.  See recipe for Red Chili Puree.

name: RAISIN-CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) loaf frozen bread dough, thawed
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted and divided
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/3  c. raisins
2  Tbsp. chopped almonds, toasted
2  tsp. grated lemon rind
1/2  c. sifted powdered sugar
2 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Roll dough on a lightly floured surface to a 14 x 8-inch rectangle.  Brush surface of dough with 2 tablespoons melted butter.  Combine 1/2 cup sugar and next 4 ingredients in a small bowl; sprinkle over dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border on all sides. Starting with long side, roll up jelly roll fashion.  Pinch seam to seal (do not seal ends).  Cut roll into 12 slices; place cut side down in a lightly greased 9-inch square pan.  Brush with remaining butter.  Cover and refrigerate 8 hours.  Remove pan from refrigerator and let rolls rise in a warm place (85°), free from drafts, 50 minutes or until doubled in bulk.  Bake rolls at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Combine powdered sugar and lemon juice; drizzle over warm rolls.  Yields 1 dozen.

name: SCALLOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pt. scallops, cut up
1  c. cracker crumbs
1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
1/2  c. butter, melted
2/3  c. cream
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix crumbs and butter.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Alternate layers of crumbs and scallops in buttered casserole.  Drizzle cream over the casserole.  Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
3  eggs, well beaten
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed and drained
1 1/4  c. pecans, chopped
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1 1/4  c. oil
preparation: Combine flour, salt, soda, cinnamon and sugar.  Make "well" in center of dry ingredients.  Add eggs and oil, stirring only until dry ingredients are moistened.  Stir in strawberries and pecans. Spoon batter into 2 lightly greased 8-inch loaf pans.

name: CARROT SQUARES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. Crisco oil
4  eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
3  c. grated carrots
1  c. walnuts
preparation: Beat sugar and oil; add remaining ingredients and mix.  Bake at 300° for 40 to 50 minutes in ungreased 10 x 15 x 1-inch pan. Cool; frost with cream cheese frosting.

name: BREAKFAST SAUSAGE PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jimmy Dean regular sausage
9-inch pie shell (pre-made)
1 1/2  c. grated Swiss cheese
1/4  c. chopped green bell pepper
1/4  c. red bell pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
4  eggs, lightly beaten
1  c. light cream
preparation: Cook sausage until done.  Crumble then drain.  Prepare 9-inch pre-made or "from scratch" pie shell.  Mix cheese and sausage. Sprinkle in shell.  Lightly beat eggs in bowl.  Combine remaining ingredients and add to egg mixture.  Pour in shell.  Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes.  Cool on rack 10 minutes.  Yields 8 servings.

name: MAMA'S "T" CAKES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. Crisco
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder (I use Clabber Girl)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix  sugar  and  Crisco.  Blend well.  Add soda, baking powder and  vanilla.  Slowly  sift flour into mixture until a soft dough  is  formed.	Divide	dough  onto a pile of flour. Knead until  it  can be rolled out and cut cookies with a jar lid.  Put on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350° until brown.

name: GREEN "STUFF"
ingredients:
1  lb. cottage cheese
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. Cool Whip
1  pkg. instant pistachio pudding
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple in its own juice
preparation: Mix it all together and chill.  Can be made into a mold.

name: ORANGE JULIUS
ingredients:
1  c. cold water
1  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
6  oz. can orange juice (undiluted)
9  ice cubes
preparation: Mix together in blender and serve.  Serves 4.

name: CAESAR CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1 (8 oz.)  bottle fat free salad dressing
1  ripe tomato
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese (Healthy Choice fat free)
preparation: Wash chicken breasts and place into a bowl.  Pour salad dressing over chicken and cover all sides of each breast well. Put in fridge for at least 1 hour.  Cover cookie sheet with tinfoil.  Place chicken breasts on cookie sheet; sprinkle with shredded cheese.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Slice tomato; place one slice on each breast.  Bake for 5 more minutes.  Serve on a bed of brown rice.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. paprika
1/3  tsp. black pepper
3  tsp. vinegar
4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. ketchup
1  tsp. yellow mustard
4  tsp. sugar
preparation: Cook onions until clear and mix with all other ingredients into the onions. Use with pork or chicken.

name: CHUCK'S CAESAR SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. oil
3  Tbsp. wine vinegar
1  egg
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
salt
pepper
1  Tbsp. Durkee sandwich and salad spread
2  cloves garlic
1  to 2 anchovies
preparation: Use blender.  Blend all ingredients in blender until dressing consistency.  Use over fresh romaine lettuce  and croutons. Sprinkle salad with Parmesan cheese.

name: SENATOR SALAD
ingredients:
1  can French-style green beans
1  can Shoe Peg corn
1  can small peas
1 small  jar pimentos
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped onion
1  green pepper, chopped
3/4  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
preparation: Put all the vegetables into a large bowl.  Place vinegar, sugar and oil in pan and simmer until it reaches the boiling point.  Stir and pour over vegetables.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: CORN BREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onions
1  c. chopped celery
1  (9-inch) skillet corn bread, crumbled
6  slices bread, broken into pieces
4  eggs, beaten
salt and pepper to taste
chicken or turkey broth
preparation: Add all of the ingredients together.   Add enough broth to make batter runny.   Pour in pan and bake at 400° for 1 hour.

name: MEXICAN LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  (16 oz.) refried beans
1  pkg. taco seasoning
12  uncooked lasagna noodles
2 1/2  c. water
2 1/2  c. salsa
2  c. sour cream
1 to 2  c. shredded cheese
3/4  c. chopped green onions
1  can olives, sliced
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain off grease. Add beans and taco seasoning. Mix well. Place 4 noodles in bottom of 9 x 13 pan (lightly grease bottom of pan). Spread 1/2 beef mixture over noodles. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup cheese. Cover with remaining noodles; pour water over all, then salsa over top. Cover with foil and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350° or until done.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL DESSERT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. soda
1  egg
1 or 2  cans fruit cocktail
3/4  c. brown sugar
broken pecans (optional)
preparation: Place the egg in a bowl and beat.  Add the fruit cocktail, then add dry ingredients (except brown sugar).    Mix well.  Put in ungreased pan.   Sprinkle with the brown sugar.  Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.  Broken pecans can be added on top of brown sugar before baking.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  to 5 pork chops
4  to 5 medium potatoes*
1  small onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can water
preparation: Spray Dutch oven with non-stick pan spray, place pork chops in bottom. Slice potatoes 1/4 inch, place over pork chops. Add chopped onion. In a bowl mix soups and water. Stir and pour over layers. Bake at 375 degrees until potatoes and meat are tender. If casserole gets dry before it is done, add a little water and finish baking.

name: LEMON LUSCIOUS PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) baked pastry shell
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. grated lemon peel
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  c. milk
3  egg yolks, slightly beaten
1  c. dairy sour cream
preparation: In saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch, lemon peel, butter, lemon juice, milk and egg yolks.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thick.  Cover and cool.  Fold in sour cream. Pour into baked pastry shell.  Chill at least 2 hours before serving.  Top with whipped cream, if desired.

name: MISSISSIPPI MUD CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  sticks margarine
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
1/3  c. cocoa
dash of salt
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
miniature marshmallows
1/2  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. milk
1/2  c. cocoa
1  box powdered sugar
preparation: Melt butter and cocoa and add other ingredients.  Beat until smooth and spread over the marshmallows.

name: OVERNIGHT SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1  c. celery, diced
1  c. green pepper, diced
1  c. onions, diced
1  can drained water chestnuts
1 1/2  c. Miracle Whip
8  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
bacon bits
preparation: Layer vegetables in order.  Then spread over with Miracle Whip.  Top with cheese.  Cover with Saran Wrap and let set overnight.  Put bacon bits on the next morning.

name: CALDO DE QUESO(Cheese Soup)
ingredients:
1  to 2 whole green onions
1  to 2 canned tomatoes, chopped
3  to 4 medium potatoes, peeled and chopped (bite size)
garlic salt and salt to taste
1/2 to 1  c. Colby or Cheddar cheese, thinly sliced
preparation: Cover bottom of saucepan with oil.  Add onions and saute.  Add chopped tomatoes and water for desired amount of soup.  Season to taste with garlic salt and salt.  Add potatoes and cook until tender, about 5 to 10 minutes.  Remove from heat and add cheese. Cover and let sit 1 to 2 minutes until cheese is melted.  Serve immediately.

name: BROWNIE CANDY CUPS
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines chocolate lover's double fudge brownie mix
2  eggs
1/3  c. water
1/4  c. Crisco oil
30  miniature peanut butter cups
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Line 30 muffin cups with foil baking liners or place on baking sheets.  Combine brownie mix, fudge packet from mix, eggs, water and oil in large bowl.  Stir with spoon until well blended, about 50 strokes.  Place 2 level measuring tablespoons batter in each foil liner.  Bake 10 minutes. Remove from oven.  Push one peanut butter cup candy in center of each cupcake until even with surface of brownie.  Bake 5 to 7 minutes longer.  Remove to cooling racks.  Cool completely.

name: CHERRY PIE FILLING
ingredients:
1  qt. sour cherries
1 1/4  c. sugar
3 big  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. tapioca
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. almond flavoring
few drops red coloring
several Tbsp. margarine, sliced thin on top of pie
preparation: Will make 2 pies.

name: SALMON CROQUETTES
ingredients:
1  can salmon (don't remove bones)
2  stirred up eggs
salt and pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion (1 medium)
1/2  c. cracker crumbs
preparation: Mix ingredients and make into patties or rolls. Roll in water, then roll in cornmeal. Fry in oil.

name: VEGETABLE AND CHEESE ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  red pepper, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. sliced zucchini
1  tsp. olive oil
1 1/2  c. cooked pinto beans
1 1/2  c. chopped tomatoes
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. cumin
1/4  tsp. ground coriander
6  corn tortillas
2  oz. (1/2 c.) grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. part skim Ricotta cheese
1/4  c. nonfat yogurt
preparation: Saut pepper, onion, garlic, mushrooms and zucchini in olive oil over medium heat until onion is translucent.  Add beans, tomatoes, chili powder, cumin and coriander.  Remove from heat. Mix Ricotta and yogurt together in a small bowl.  Soften tortillas by steaming in the microwave for 20 seconds on High power.  On each tortilla, place three teaspoons grated cheese and two tablespoons yogurt mixture.  Roll tortilla around cheese mixture and place in baking dish, seam-side down.  Repeat with remaining tortillas.  Top tortillas with bean mixture.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese melts.  Serve hot.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  medium onion, diced
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
dash of cayenne pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  can water (4 oz.)
preparation: Saute onion in cooking oil until transparent.  Then add remaining ingredients in order given.  Simmer about 30 minutes before using.  Makes 2 cups.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1  chopped onion
2  ribs sliced celery
1  green pepper, diced
2  c. rice
2  cans chicken broth
1  chicken, cut into 1/4 or 1/8
2  Tbsp. oil
paprika
garlic powder to taste
preparation: Saut onion, celery and pepper in oil until tender.  Place in roasting pan.  Spread 2 cups uncooked rice over vegetables.  Pour chicken broth over all.  Place chicken pieces on top and season with garlic powder and paprika.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: HOLY COW CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  jar caramel topping
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
preparation: Prepare cake as directed on box.  While hot from the oven, punch holes in cake; slowly pour Eagle Brand milk over cake.  Then do the same with caramel topping.  Let cake cool at room temperature.  When cake is completely cool, top with Cool Whip. Keep in refrigerator.  The longer this cake sits, the better it gets.

name: FRENCH STEW
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. stew meat
1  c. celery
1  lb. carrots
9  onions cut in half
10  potatoes cut in half
1  Tbsp. salt
2  tsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. tapioca
1 large  can of V-8 juice
1 small  can of whole tomatoes and mush them in your hand
preparation: Mix all together and put in large roaster.

name: FRUITED CREAM SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
1 (6 oz.)  jar cherries, drained and quartered
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in water.  Add ice cream and stir until melted.  Add cherries, pineapple and pecans.  Place in 2-quart mold and refrigerate.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: HAWAIIAN BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. all purpose flour
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  c. pecans or walnuts, chopped
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. vegetable oil
2  c. mashed ripe bananas
1 - 8  oz. can crushed pineapple, drained
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients.  Stir in nuts.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Add to flour mixture stirring just until moistened.  Spoon batter into two greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove and let cool on wire racks.

name: SUNSHINE SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
1  c. salad dressing
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
3  carrots, shredded
2  stalks celery, chopped
preparation: Dissolve jello in water.  Stir in salad dressing; blend with mixer.  Let set in refrigerator until slightly thickened.  Add remaining ingredients.  Pour in mold.  Congeal.

name: FRUIT SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. flour
2/3  c. sugar
juice of 1 lemon
juice of 1 orange
1  c. pineapple juice
1/2  c. heavy whipping cream
preparation: Cook all ingredients except whipping cream until thick, cool. Add whipping cream; beat well.  Refrigerate.

name: COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter, melted
1/3  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/3  c. coconut
1  unbaked (9-inch) pastry shell
preparation: Beat eggs first.  Add the next 4 ingredients.  Stir in coconut last.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until set.

name: CROCK-POT PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. round steak
2  Tbsp. oil
1  clove minced garlic
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  tsp. sugar
1  c. bean sprouts, drained
1  c. tomatoes
2  green peppers, cut in strips
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. cold water
4  green onions, sliced or 1 onion
preparation: Slice steak into narrow strips.  In skillet, brown steak in oil.  Combine with garlic, salt, pepper, soy sauce and sugar in crock-pot.  Cook on low 6 to 8 hours.  Turn control to high.  Add bean sprouts, tomatoes and green peppers.  Dissolve cornstarch in water and stir into pot.  Cover and cook on high 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 4.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  c. sliced yellow squash
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
1  c. shredded carrots
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. herb-seasoned stuffing mix
1/2  c. melted butter
preparation: Cook squash and onion in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain. Combine soup and sour cream; stir in carrots.  Fold in squash and onions.  Combine stuffing mix and butter.  Spread half of stuffing mix on bottom of 12 x 8-inch baking dish.  Spoon vegetable mixture on top.  Sprinkle remaining stuffing over vegetables.  Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

name: GERMAN SWEET CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
1  c. buttermilk
2 1/2  c. plain flour
1/2  c. boiling water
4  eggs, separated
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1  bar German chocolate
preparation: Whip egg whites and set aside.  Dissolve 1 bar chocolate in 1/2 cup boiling water.  Set aside.  Cream shortening and sugar well.  Add beaten egg yolks; mix well.  Add 3/4 cup of milk alternately with flour.  Add soda to 1/4 cup milk; add to batter and mix well.  Add vanilla and chocolate.  Fold in egg whites. Bake at 350° in four 9-inch layer pans until done.

name: TEX-MEX TAMALE SKILLET(Prep Time: 30 Minutes)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (16 oz.)  jar Old El Paso salsa or use Debra's canned salsa (it's better!!)
1 (11 oz.)  can Green Giant Mexicorn corn with red/green peppers
4  (6-inch) tortillas, halved and cut into 1/2-inch strips
4  oz. (1 c.) shredded hot pepper Monterey Jack cheese
2  Tbsp. chopped cilantro
preparation: Brown beef in skillet over medium-high heat. Drain. Add salsa, corn and tortilla strips; mix well. Reduce heat to medium; cover and cook 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with cheese; cover and cook an additional 5 minutes, until cheese is melted. Sprinkle with cilantro.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. boneless chicken breast*
2  cans cream of corn soup
1  pkg. rice and broccoli mix
1  can sweet peas**
1  can honey glazed carrots**
1  can whole kernel corn**
preparation: *Can also use steak.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/3  c. margarine, melted
1/4  c. granulated sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1/3  c. peanut butter
3  c. thawed whipped topping
1/4  c. peanuts (optional)
1/4  c. hot fudge topping, heated
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Stir together the crumbs, margarine and granulated sugar; press onto bottom and 1/2 inch up sides of a 9-inch spring-form pan.  Bake 10 minutes and cool.

name: LEMON POPPY SEED BREAD
ingredients:
1 (1 lb. 2 oz.)  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  c. hot water
1/2  c. corn oil
1/4  c. poppy seed
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. instant lemon pudding
4  eggs
preparation: Combine all the ingredients, except the poppy seed, in a bowl. Beat with a mixer for 4 minutes.  Add poppy seed and stir in with a spoon.  Spray bread pans with Pam.  Pour batter into 2 regular or 4 small bread pans.  Do not fill more than halfway (you will have a little left over).  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until when a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.  Cool in pan for 10 minutes.

name: ITALIAN GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. green beans
olive oil
1  clove garlic
1/4  tsp. oregano
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook beans until partially tender.  Drain and saute in olive oil.  Add garlic and oregano. Add salt and pepper.  Cook until tender.

name: PECAN CRISPIES
ingredients:
1/4  c. shortening
3/4  c. butter
2 1/2  c. soft brown sugar
2  well beaten eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. whole pecans
preparation: Cream the shortening and sugar thoroughly.  Add eggs and beat well.  Sift all dry ingredients and add them to the butter, sugar and egg mixture.  Stir in chopped nuts.  Drop from teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart.  Top each cookie with a whole pecan.  Bake in preheated oven at 350°  from 12 to 15 minutes.  Yields 5 dozen.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  heads broccoli flowerets, chopped
1  bunch green onions, chopped
8  oz. Cheddar cheese, shredded
4  oz. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
1  lb. fried bacon, crumbled
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Combine broccoli, onions, cheeses and bacon.  Set aside.

name: CHIP ONION DIP
ingredients:
1/3  c. sour cream
1/3  c. mayonnaise or light Miracle Whip
1  Tbsp. dry onion soup mix
preparation: Mix together ingredients.

name: CHILI CON QUESO
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. hot pork sausage
32  oz. Velveeta cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
3  jalapenos, seeded and chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1  tomato, chopped
preparation: Brown ground beef and sausage in skillet, stirring until crumbly; drain.  Combine ground beef mixture, cheese, soup, jalapenos, onion and tomato in crock-pot; mix well.  Heat until cheese is melted.  May add a small amount of milk if desired. Serve warm with tortilla chips.  Yield:  128 servings.

name: GOLDEN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. plain corn meal
1  c. all-purpose flour
3  Tbsp. sugar
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1  egg
1/4  c. oil
2  Tbsp. butter Crisco
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Melt Crisco in 8 or 9-inch square pan.

name: BAKED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
4  pork chops
4  onion slices
4  Tbsp. uncooked rice
1 (1 lb.)  can whole tomatoes
preparation: Place pork chops in baking dish.  Place 1 slice of onion and 1 tablespoon rice on each pork chop.  Pour tomatoes over top.  Bake at 350° for 90 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. shortening
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. grated orange peel
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  egg
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar and vanilla; add egg.  Beat until light and fluffy.  Stir in milk.  Sift dry ingredients; blend in mixture.  Chill one hour.  On lightly floured surface, roll 1/8-inch thick.  Cut in desired shapes.  Bake at 375° for 6 to 8 minutes.  Cool.  Makes 2 dozen.

name: ORANGE JULIUS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
10  to 12 ice cubes
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except ice cubes, in a blender. Cover and blend until smooth.  Add ice cubes, 1 to 2 at a time, and continue blending until ice is completely crushed.  Serve immediately.

name: OLD FASHION TEA CAKES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and eggs.  Add flour gradually.  Add baking powder in last cup of flour.  Work like pie crust.  Roll out to desired thickness and cut.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Makes 50 cookies.

name: OLD-FASHIONED CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1 - 3  lb. broiler-fryer
2  quarts water
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  cups all purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. shortening
3/4  cup buttermilk
preparation: Cook chicken in water and 2 tsp. salt until tender. When cool enough, bone the chicken and cut into bite size pieces, set aside. Bring broth to a boil, add pepper. Combine flour, soda, and 1/2 tsp. salt. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add buttermilk, stirring with a fork until dry ingredients are moist. Turn dough out on to a well floured surface, and knead lightly 4 or 5 times. Pat dough to 1/2 inch thickness. Pinch off dough in 1 1/2 inch pieces and drop into boiling broth. Reduce heat to low setting and simmer about 8 to 10 minutes or until desired consistency, stirring occasionally. Stir in chicken.

name: LEFT-OVAH GOULOSH
ingredients:
2  qt. watah
1  tsp. salt
6  peppercorns
1  bay leaf
3  small taters, diced
3  carrots, diced
3  ribs celery, diced
2  medium onions, chopped
1/4  c. raw rice
1/4  c. barley
1  Tbsp. parsley, chopped
basil
garlic
salt
oregano
thyme
preparation: Grab a large kettle, 'n dump a turkey carcass (skin, giblets, leftover gravy, etc.) in it.  Add watah, 1 teaspoon salt, peppercorns and bay leaf.  Brang to a boil.  Reduce heat, covah 'n simmer fur 'bout 1 1/2 hours or 'til you have made a rich stock. Strain 'n return to pot.  Pick all the meat off 'n add to this (you gotta have sum meat!) the remaining ingredients.  Kiver agin 'n simmer fur anothah 1 1/2 hours.

name: STUFFED EGGS
ingredients:
8  hard-cooked eggs
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  c. salad dressing
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. parsley, finely chopped
2  Tbsp. pickle relish
1/4  tsp. white pepper
1/2  tsp. paprika
preparation: Slice hard-cooked eggs in half, lengthwise.  Place yolks in mixing bowl and mix well.  Combine powdered mustard, salt, salad dressing, pickle relish and white pepper; mix until smooth.  Fill each cavity of egg white with yolk mixture.  Mound up slightly. Sprinkle with paprika and garnish with fine chopped parsley.

name: HOT FRUIT
ingredients:
1  can apricots, drained
1  can pineapple chunks, drained
1  jar apple rings, drained (reserve 6 Tbsp. juice)
1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1  stick melted butter
1  stack crushed Ritz crackers
preparation: Layer the fruit in casserole dish.  Mix the flour and sugar and sprinkle over the fruit.  Next, add butter and crackers (mixed).  Sprinkle 6 tablespoons reserved liquid on top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: LICKETY SPLIT CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1  pkg. cake mix (white)
2  c. sour cream
1  jar strawberry preserves
preparation: Prepare cake mix according to package.  Add sour cream.  Stir by hand until well blended.  Fill lined muffin tins 1/2 full, reserving 1 1/2 cups batter.  Make indentation in center of each cup with spoon and fill with preserves.  Spoon reserved batter over preserves, filling to 3/4 full.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes. Cool completely and store in fridge.

name: MA MA'S CHILI SAUCE
ingredients:
25  large tomatoes
6  red peppers
2  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. salt
6  green peppers
12  onions
4  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. pickling spice
preparation: Grind tomatoes, peppers and onions finely.  Add vinegar, sugar and salt.  Stir well.  Add spices tied in cheesecloth.  Bring to boil, then simmer 3 to 4 hours.  Stir often.  Should cook down to 1/2 starting amount.  Pack in sterilized jars.

name: STRAWBERRY CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
2  boxes strawberries
2  boxes strawberry jello
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  banana, chipped or mashed
1 small  carton sour cream
1  c. hot water
preparation: Pour 1 cup hot water over jello.  Add strawberries, banana and pineapple.  Pour half jello mixture in dish; chill.  Pour sour cream over this mixture, then pour remaining jello mixture over cream (three layers).  Chill in refrigerator overnight.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. macaroni
1  qt. milk
1/4  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Melt 3 tablespoons margarine in 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Add macaroni, stirring enough to coat macaroni with margarine. Cover with 1 quart milk.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Top with slices of Velveeta cheese.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.  Do not stir. Check to see if macaroni is done.  If not, bake 5 or 10 minutes longer.

name: CHICKEN, BROCCOLI, RICE AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chopped broccoli
1  (8 oz.) Cheddar cheese
1  c. brown rice
6  chicken breasts
1/3  c. Pepperidge Farm bread crumbs
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. Miracle Whip
2 to 3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Cook broccoli, rice and chicken separately (as you would normally cook them).  I boil 6 boneless, skinless chicken breasts and then tear them into pieces.  In a separate bowl, mix eggs, soup and Miracle Whip.  Put broccoli, rice, chicken and 1/2 the shredded cheese in a bowl.  Add 1/2 the soup mixture.  Put mixture in a glass casserole dish.  Pour remaining soup mixture on top and top with remaining cheese.  Sprinkle bread crumbs on top and dot with butter.  Microwave on High approximately 15 minutes with paper towel on top.

name: WISCONSIN CHEDDAR AND VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
c. chopped cauliflower
2  large Russet potatoes, chopped
2  c. homemade chicken stock or canned
1  qt. milk
1/8  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/8  tsp. ground pepper
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. sherry
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
Tabasco sauce
Worcestershire sauce
preparation: In a large soup pot, melt butter. Sauté onion, celery, cauliflower and potatoes over low heat until soft. Add stock, milk, nutmeg and pepper. Bring mixture to a simmer. Let simmer until vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes. Puree soup in batches in a blender; return to the pot and bring to a boil. Turn off heat. Gradually add the Cheddar. Gradually reheat soup, stirring, being careful not to boil. Add the sherry, mustard and Tabasco and Worcestershire sauces to taste. Garnish with croutons and more shredded cheese. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

name: FRESH SAUSAGE PATTIES
ingredients:
2  lb. turkey ground meat
1 1/2  tsp. dried sage, crumbled
1  tsp. salt to taste
1/2  tsp. dried thyme, crumbled
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper or to taste
1/4  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Mix all the ingredients.  Brown patties on both sides over medium heat, about 15 minutes.

name: BREAKFAST PANCAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
dash of nutmeg
1/2  cube butter
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients.  Put butter in black cast-iron skillet and melt in oven at 400°.  Remove skillet from oven, pour in mixture and return to oven.  Bake at 400° for 15 or 20 minutes. Serve with syrup.  Grandkids love these.

name: WALK TO SCHOOL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. butter
4  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Roll in rolls about 2 inches in diameter and roll up in wax paper.  Will make about 4 to 5 rolls. Refrigerate.  Slice in 1/4-inch thick slices.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes only until light brown.  Do not bake beyond this light brown color.

name: LUBY'S CAFETERIA CARROT-RAISIN SALAD
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots, peeled
1  c. raisins
1  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1  c. canned crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Shred carrots, using large holes of grater. In a large bowl, combine carrots, raisins and pineapple. In a small bowl, mix mayonnaise and powdered sugar until well blended. Pour over carrot mixture and toss lightly to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Yield: 8 servings.

name: LEMON CHEESE CAKE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  c. vanilla wafer crumbs
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine, melted
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
3  eggs
1/2  c. ReaLemon juice from concentrate
3/4  c. strawberry preserves
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine; press firmly on bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake 8 minutes. Cool.  Reduce heat to 300°.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
3  sticks margarine or butter
2  eggs
3  c. confectioners sugar
5  ripe bananas
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1 large  carton Cool Whip
pecans
cherries
preparation: Mix cracker crumbs with 1 stick margarine.  Spread into 13 x 9-inch pan.  Beat eggs, confectioners sugar and 2 sticks margarine in mixer bowl about 15 minutes.  Pour over crust.   Slice bananas. Drain pineapple and pour small amount of pineapple juice over bananas.  Add pineapple.  Spread with Cool Whip.  Garnish with pecans and cherries.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: FLAKE CANDY
ingredients:
1  c. white syrup
1  c. cream
3  c. Rice Krispies cereal
1  c. coconut
1  c. sugar
5  c. corn flakes
2  c. salted roasted peanuts
preparation: Combine syrup, sugar and cream in a saucepan and cook to soft ball form stage.  Mix with the corn flakes, rice cereal, peanuts and coconut.  Put in a buttered pan, cool and cut.

name: CHOCOLATE PISTACHIO CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white or yellow cake mix
1  (3 1/2 oz.) instant pistachio pudding
1/2  c. orange juice
1/2  c. water
4  eggs
1/2  c. vegetable oil
3/4  c. chocolate flavored syrup
confectioners sugar
preparation: Combine cake mix, pudding, orange juice, water, eggs and oil in large mixing bowl.  Blend well, then beat 2 minutes at medium speed with electric mixer.  Pour 3/4 of batter into well-greased and floured Bundt or tube pan.  Add syrup to remaining batter. Mix well and pour over batter in pan.   Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.  Cool in pan for 10 minutes on wire rack.  Remove from pan and when cake is cool, sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

name: CON QUESO-CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. Mexican Velveeta cheese (mild or hot)
1  lb. sausage or hamburger, browned and drained
1  lb. regular Velveeta cheese
1 (12 oz.)  jar salsa
1  Tbsp. chopped onions
preparation: In a crock-pot:  Cut cheese up in blocks and melt.  Brown sausage or hamburger and onion then drain.  Dump salsa and meat in with cheese and mix all together.  Stir occasionally until all cheese is melted.  If dip is thick, then add a little milk.  Serve with tortilla chips as dip or over baked potatoes.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground chuck
1  c. onion
1  slice bread, broken up
3  Tbsp. A.1. steak sauce
1  large egg
4  Tbsp. milk
catsup
parsley
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix the ground chuck, onion, bread, A.1. steak sauce, egg and milk together and shape. Spread the catsup over all the meat loaf.  Sprinkle parsley over the meat loaf.  Bake for approximately 1 hour at 350° or microwave for approximately 30 minutes or more.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans pork and beans
1  medium onion, diced
2  Tbsp. pickle relish
4  Tbsp. molasses
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. ketchup
1/4  c. spiced mustard
preparation: Mix ingredients in medium saucepan.  Simmer until bubbling. Place in 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Add 3 strips of bacon on top.  Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

name: BUTTER HERB BAKED FISH
ingredients:
1/2  c. real butter (oleo, if desired)
2/3  c. crushed saltines (16 individual crackers)
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. dried basil
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1  lb. frozen fish fillets (perch), thawed
preparation: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Mix crushed saltines, Parmesan, herbs, salt and garlic powder in bowl.  Dip fish fillets in butter, then in saltine mixture.  Place in butter in baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Brown under broiler a few minutes to crisp crust.

name: FILLED ICEBOX COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
4  c. flour
1  tsp soda
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar and eggs, beat thoroughly.  Add dry ingredients.  Mix and roll out 1/2 inch thick and spread with filling.

name: BARBECUE CUPS
ingredients:
3/4  c. ground beef
1/2  c. barbecue sauce
2  tsp. instant onion
dash of garlic powder
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. refrigerator biscuits
2  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain excess grease.  Add barbecue sauce, instant onion and garlic powder and mix well.

name: SOUTHERN BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
4  Tbsp. shortening
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Sift together all the dry ingredients and work in the shortening.  Add the liquid to make a soft dough, then roll it out on a lightly floured board to a thickness of 1/2-inch.  With a biscuit cutter, cut the dough before putting it into a greased pan and baking it in a hot oven at 425°, for 15 minutes.

name: FROZEN FRUIT CUP
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
3  bananas, mashed
1  (8 1/4 oz.) crushed pineapple, undrained
1/4  c. chopped cherries
1/4  c. pecan pieces
preparation: Mix and freeze.

name: HOLLY FARMS POTATOES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, melted
1/4  c. flour
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. chicken seasoning
3  to 4 large potatoes
preparation: Cut potatoes lengthwise into quarters.  Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix together with flour, Parmesan cheese and chicken seasoning. Coat potatoes with mixture and then arrange potatoes in baking dish.  Bake at 400° for approximately 45 minutes.

name: FUDGSICLES
ingredients:
1/4  c. cocoa
3/4  c. sugar
2  c. milk
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients except vanilla.  Stir and bring to boil. Boil 1 minute.  Let cool.  Add vanilla.  Put into tray or forms and freeze.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. Crisco
1/2  c. sugar
2  beaten eggs
1  c. bran
2  Tbsp. water
1 1/2  c. bananas, mashed
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix Crisco and sugar.  Add eggs and vanilla; mix.  Add bran. Mix water and bananas together and add.  Mix dry ingredients and add nuts, if wanted.  Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour and then check with toothpick.

name: MAYONNAISE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. salt
1 heaping  tsp. flour
2  eggs
preparation: Mix the ingredients in a saucepan.  Add 1/2 cup vinegar and 1/2 cup water.  Cook until thick.

name: VEGGIE ROLLS
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/2  tsp. garlic salt with parsley
1/2  tsp. lemon pepper
6  large or 12 regular size flour tortillas
1 large  bunch fresh spinach leaves, cleaned and stems removed
1 1/2  c. (6 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. shredded carrots
preparation: In a small bowl, blend together cream cheese, garlic salt with parsley and lemon pepper. On each tortilla, spread a layer of cream cheese mixture. Layer spinach leaves, Cheddar cheese and carrots over cream cheese; roll up tortillas. Slice each tortilla into 1/2-inch pieces. Serve with salsa. Makes 3 dozen.

name: FREEZER COLESLAW
ingredients:
1  medium cabbage, shredded
1  carrot, shredded
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  Tbsp. salt
2  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. mustard seed
1  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Combine cabbage, carrot and pepper in large bowl.  Add salt. Let stand for 1 hour.  Drain excess liquid.  Boil sugar, vinegar, water, mustard and celery seed.  Pour over cabbage mixture.  Cool. Put into containers and freeze.

name: GOOEY BUTTER SQUARES
ingredients:
1  box butter cake mix
1  egg
1  stick margarine
8  oz. cream cheese
1  box confectioners sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat until creamy.  Pour over first mixture.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

name: PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. fat
1  lb. round or flank steak
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  clove garlic, minced
1/4  c. water
2  green peppers, diced
1  c. canned beef bouillon
1  c. drained canned tomatoes or  3 tomatoes, quartered
1 1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  tsp. soy sauce
preparation: Melt fat in frypan.  Cut meat into 1-inch strips.  Place meat, onion and garlic in frypan; brown.  Add peppers and bouillon; cover and cook 30 minutes.  Add tomatoes; simmer 5 minutes. Combine cornstarch, soy sauce and water; add to meat mixture. Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Makes 4 servings.

name: ROTEL CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/2  can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies
Worcestershire sauce
Tabasco sauce
preparation: Melt cheeses together.  Remove from heat and add 1/2 can Ro-Tel tomatoes and chilies.  Add Worcestershire and Tabasco sauces (to taste).  Serve warm with Fritos or tostados.

name: EASY CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese (lite or regular), softened
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1 ready to use graham cracker crumb crust (6  oz. or 9-inch)
preparation: Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla at medium speed with electric mixer or blender.  Add eggs; mix well.  Pour into crust. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until center is almost set.  Cool, then refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.  Then add favorite topping (cherry, pineapple, blueberry).

name: AFTER DINNER MINT PINEAPPLE
ingredients:
1  fresh pineapple
1/4 to 1/2  c. creme de menthe
preparation: Cut fresh pineapple into chunks and marinate in creme de menthe for about 2 hours.  Spear each chunk with pick and serve from deep bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap until ready to serve.

name: SWEET NOODLES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  cans condensed tomato soup
12 to 16  oz. noodles
preparation: Brown beef and onion.  Drain.  Place in Dutch oven.  Add soup and 2 to 2 1/2 quarts water.  Bring to a boil.  Add noodles. Cook until tender. Simmer until thick. Add sugar to taste.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
5  c. milk
3  small instant vanilla puddings
8  oz. sour cream
8  oz. whipped cream
6  to 8 bananas
1  box vanilla wafers
preparation: Mix milk and pudding until pudding starts to get thick.  Add sour cream.  Mix well, stir in whipping cream.  Layer bananas and wafers, then pudding until last layer is pudding on top.

name: STRAWBERRY POP CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix, prepared according to directions
2  boxes strawberry Jell-O
1 1/2  c. hot water
1  c. strawberry pop
preparation: Mix Jell-O and	water;	let cool while cake bakes.  Add pop. Punch holes in cake and pour Jell-O over it.

name: HOLIDAY BUFFET CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/4  lb. Smithfield or country ham, sliced thin
8  to 10 single boneless chicken breasts, skinned
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
2 to 3  oz. half and half
1 to 1 1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Line bottom of a baking dish with ham; position chicken breasts over.  Combine soup, half and half and pepper.  Pour over chicken.  Top with cheese.  Cover with aluminum foil and bake 1 1/2 hours.  Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly before serving.  Sauce thickens as the dish cools.  Serve with a rice casserole or rice.  Serves 6 to 10, depending on the size of the chicken breasts.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  stick oleo
4  Tbsp. cocoa
2 1/2  c. quick cooking oats
1/4  c. chopped nuts
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. peanut butter
preparation: Measure oats, nuts, vanilla and peanut butter and set aside. Bring sugar, milk, oleo and cocoa to boil.  Boil 1 1/2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat; add oats, nuts, vanilla and peanut butter.  Beat until well blended.  Drop small amounts on greased cookie sheet or wax paper.  Makes about 30 to 32 cookies. Do not use instant oats.

name: LAZY STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  envelope dried beefy onion soup
1 to 2  cans cream of celery soup
1 1/2  lb. stew meat, cubed
1/2  can water
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix soups and water, then mix with meat.  Bake, covered, at 275° for 3 to 4 hours.  Stir in second can of soup if cooked noodles are added.  Stir in 1/2 cup sour cream just before serving.  Serve over rice or noodles.

name: CURRIED LENTILS AND RICE
ingredients:
1/2  c. brown rice
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  tsp. curry powder
1/2  c. lentils
pinch of salt
1  onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. oil
2  c. water
1/4  lb. spinach, chopped
preparation: Saute rice, onion and garlic in oil until sizzling.   Add curry and water, then lentils.   Cover and simmer about 30 minutes.  Stir in chopped raw spinach.  Serves 4 to 6 people.

name: CRACKED CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. packed brown sugar
2/3  c. vegetable shortening
1  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
1/3  c. unsweetened baking cocoa
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips (12 oz. pkg.)
1  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Combine brown sugar, shortening, water and vanilla in large bowl.  Beat on medium speed until blended.  Beat eggs into creamed mixture.  Combine flour, cocoa, soda and salt.  Mix into creamed mixture at low speed just until blended.  Stir in chocolate chips. Shape dough into 1 1/4-inch balls.  Roll in powdered sugar.  Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets.  Bake one sheet at a time.  Preheat oven to 375°.  Bake 7 to 9 minutes until cookies are set, do not overbake.

name: STUFFED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. toasted bread
1/4  c. raisins
1/2  tsp. sage
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. applesauce
12  thin pork chops, (rib or loin)
1/4  c. butter
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. parsley
preparation: Combine  ingredients  in  single  layers in baking dish. Place stuffing on each chop.  Add second chop over top.  Secure with toothpicks.  Cover  and  roast  in  oven  at  400°  for 40 minutes.  Remove cover, reduce heat to 350° and continue baking until tender, 1 hour in all.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
2  c. cornmeal
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1  egg
3  Tbsp. sugar
3/4  c. water
1/2  c. melted Crisco
1/2  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. chopped onion
preparation: Mix well and drop by tablespoon into deep hot oil.  Fry until golden brown.

name: PINEAPPLE SURPRISE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. drained pineapple juice
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
Ritz crackers, crushed
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Spray pie pan.  Preheat oven to 325°.  Mix pineapple, sugar, flour and juice well.  Spread in pie plate.  Top with cheese.  Mix crackers and butter, then spread on top.  Bake for 25 minutes, or until bubbly on bottom and golden brown on top.  Delicious!!

name: MARSHMALLOW SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
8  medium sweet potatoes
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. hot milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon or nutmeg
1/4  tsp. paprika
1  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  lb. marshmallows
preparation: Cook sweet  potatoes  until  tender,  remove  skins and mash. Add butter, milk, salt, cinnamon or nutmeg and paprika. Beat until free  from	lumps  and  light  and fluffy.	Fold in walnuts.  Turn into a greased casserole, cover with marshmallows and bake  in  a moderate  oven  (350°)  until mixture is heated through and marshmallows are brown.  Serves 8.

name: FROZEN DAIQUIRIS
ingredients:
1  qt. light rum
1  qt. 7-Up
1  c. sugar
3 (6 oz.)  cans frozen lemonade concentrate
6  cans water
3 (6 oz.)  cans fresh limeade concentrate
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Place in large plastic container.  Cover and freeze.  When ready to serve, spoon some of mixture into glasses and add the same amount of extra 7-Up.

name: STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
8  oz. fresh mushrooms
3  slices bacon, chopped
1/3  c. finely chopped green onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. whipping cream
3  drops red pepper sauce
2  Tbsp. Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Wash mushrooms and remove stems and chop fine.  Place mushroom caps on paper towel.  Microwave on Medium-high for 3 minutes. Drain and set aside.  Microwave bacon until crisp.  Drain.  Add mushroom stems, onion, salt, pepper and red pepper sauce. Microwave on High until mushrooms and onion are tender (2 to 3 1/2 minutes).  Blend in flour; stir in cream until smooth.  Microwave on Medium-high 2 to 3 minutes, stirring once or twice during cooking time.  Stir in cheese.  Fill each cap with bacon/mushroom mixture.  Place on microwave-safe plate and microwave on High for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes.  Rotate plate 1/2 turn.

name: CROCK PICKLES
ingredients:
1/4  c. canning salt
4  c. water
1  c. vinegar
dill
garlic
cucumbers
preparation: Mix ingredients; stir until salt is dissolved.  In a gallon crock, lay dill and garlic in bottom of crock.  Lay a row of pickles, then dill, garlic and pickles again.  Repeat until 3/4 full.  Add brine.  Cover with a plate.  Let stand 2 to 3 days at room temperature, then refrigerate in containers.

name: RICE KRISPIES PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2  c. peanut butter
1  (6 oz.) bag chocolate chips
3  c. Rice Krispies
1  box powdered sugar
4  oz. milk chocolate bar
1/2  block paraffin wax
preparation: Mix the margarine, powdered sugar, peanut butter and cereal together.  Form into small balls.  Melt chocolate chips, chocolate bar and paraffin in double boiler.  Dip balls into chocolate with toothpicks.  Cool on wax paper.

name: CRAB DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  pkg. frozen crab pieces or 2 (6 oz.) cans crab pieces
1  tsp. lemon juice
dash of garlic powder
cocktail sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients except cocktail sauce together and spread on plate.  Refrigerate several hours.  Before serving, pour cocktail sauce on top.  Serve with Triscuits crackers.

name: CHERRY-PINEAPPLE CAKE(Dump Cake)
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  can crushed pineapple with juice
1  box yellow cake mix
2  sticks margarine, melted
pecans
preparation: Do not mix!  Layer in glass 9 x 13-inch dish in order given. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: SNOWBOUND HOT CHOCOLATE MIX
ingredients:
2  c. nonfat dry milk
1/4  c. unsweetened cocoa
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and store in a closed quart jar.

name: EASY TRIPLE-CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
16  oz. (2 2/3 c.) milk chocolate chips
1  (3 oz.) bar bittersweet chocolate, coarsely chopped
1  (3 oz.) bar white "chocolate", coarsely chopped
1/2  c. coarsely chopped toasted walnuts
preparation: Line an 8 or 9-inch square pan with foil or waxed paper, letting liner extend a few inches above pan on 2 sides.  Stir condensed milk and butter in a medium-size saucepan over low heat until butter melts.  Remove from heat; add chocolate chips and stir until melted and smooth.  Stir in remaining ingredients. Spread in prepared pan and refrigerate 8 hours, or until firm enough to cut.  Lift foil by ends onto cutting board.  Cut fudge in 1-inch squares.  Store airtight with waxed paper between layers.

name: MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can bean dip
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  can picante sauce
1 1/2  c. guacamole dip
chopped green onions
preparation: Layer in 8 x 8-inch dish.  Sprinkle with chopped onions.  If you like black olives you can add a layer sliced on top of sour cream along with chopped green onions.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE OF THREE MEATS
ingredients:
1  lb. beef, cut up
1  lb. chicken, cut up
1  lb. pork, cut up
1  onion, sliced
4  cloves garlic, crushed
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (28 oz.)  can Italian tomatoes
3  bay leaves
1  Tbsp. basil
1  c. parsley, chopped
juice of 1/2 lemon
1 1/2  lb. Italian meatballs
1  lb. spaghetti
preparation: Brown meat pieces in hot fat with the sliced onion and garlic. Add the strained tomatoes and paste. Stir in the seasonings and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  Add lemon juice to taste.   Cook spaghetti.  Heat the meatballs.  Remove meat from sauce and slice. Combine sauce, meat and meatballs.  Serve.  Freezes well.  Serves 12.

name: CORN FRITTERS
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. oil
1  c. drained corn
preparation: Beat eggs.  Stir in milk.  Add dry ingredients, oil and corn. Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil and fry (375°).  Drain.  Makes 12 to 15 small fritters.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. cream cheese
1  lb. creamed cottage cheese
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  lb. melted butter
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Mix flour and cornstarch in a cup.  In a large mixing bowl, cream the cream cheese until fluffy.  In a blender, cream 1/2 of the cottage cheese adding 2 eggs.  Pour into the cream cheese. Cream the other half of the cottage cheese and 2 eggs. Add to the cream cheese along with the lemon juice and vanilla.  Slowly add the sugar, flour and cornstarch mixture.   Add melted butter and sour cream.  Pour into a 9-inch spring pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.   Turn oven off and let it set in the oven for 2 hours. Remove to room temperature and refrigerate.

name: GRAN'S CABBAGE SLAW
ingredients:
1  large head of cabbage
1  large onion, chopped finely
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. celery seed
1/2  c. white vinegar
1  tsp. sugar
3/4  cup corn oil
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
Pepper to taste
1  carrot, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
2  celery ribs, chopped
1  tsp. salt
preparation: 1 med. head of cabbage, shredded

name: TWICE BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  baking potatoes
2  eggs
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
4  Tbsp. whipping cream
dash of salt and pepper
3/4  c. shredded Cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Rinse and scrub potatoes and pat dry.  Prick a few times with a fork and bake at 375° for about 1 hour or until soft.  Cut a thin slice off the top of each potato and carefully scoop out the pulp into a bowl.  Separate eggs and add yolks to potato pulp.  Stir and blend until smooth.  Add butter and cream, then season to taste with the salt and pepper.  Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form, then fold into potato mixture.  Fill potato shells with mixture. Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake in oven at 375° for about 15 minutes or until heated through.

name: HARVEST FRUIT BARS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. diced dried mixed fruit
1  c. chopped bananas (about 2 medium)
2/3  c. orange juice
1  tsp. apple pie spice or ground cinnamon
1  c. margarine or butter, softened (2 sticks)
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1 1/2  c. Quaker oats (uncooked)
1/2  tsp. apple pie spice or cinnamon
1 3/4  c. whole wheat flour
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Combine first 4 ingredients in medium bowl; set aside, stirring occasionally.  In large bowl, beat together margarine and sugar until creamy.  Add combined flour, oats and 1/2 teaspoon apple pie spice; beat until crumbly. Reserve 3/4 cup oat mixture for topping.  Press remaining oat mixture onto bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Bake 15 minutes. Spread fruit evenly over crust to within 1/4-inch of edge. Combine nuts and reserved oat mixture; sprinkle evenly over fruit. Pat down lightly.  Bake 16 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely; cut into bars.  Store loosely covered.  Makes 32 bars.

name: SAUCY CHICKEN AND PASTA DINNER
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine, divided
4  (about 1 1/4 lb.) boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1-inch pieces
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms, undrained
1  c. frozen peas, thawed
8  oz. wide noodles, cooked and drained
4  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In a large skillet, over medium-high heat, melt 1/4 cup margarine.  Add chicken and garlic powder.  Cook, stirring occasionally for 4 minutes.  Stir in remaining margarine, mushrooms and peas.  Cook 2 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.  Stir in hot cooked noodles and cheese.  Toss and cook until cheese is melted.  Season with salt and pepper.  Serve.

name: COCONUT SOUR CREAM LAYER CAKE
ingredients:
1 (18 1/2 oz.)  pkg. butter flavored cake mix
2  c. sugar
1 (16 oz.)  carton sour cream
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. bagged coconut
1 1/2  c. frozen whipped topping, thawed (Cool Whip)
preparation: Prepare cake mix as directed.  When completely cool, split both layers; combine sugar, sour cream and coconut, blending well. Chill.  Reserve 1 cup sour cream mixture.  Spread remainder between layers of cake (split side).  Combine reserved sour cream mixture with Cool Whip until smooth.  Spread on top and sides of cake.  Seal in airtight container and refrigerate for 3 days.

name: QUICK BEEF BURGUNDY
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. stew beef
8  oz. can mushrooms, drained
1  can mushroom soup
1  envelope Lipton onion soup mix
1  jar whole onions
3/4  c. Burgundy wine
preparation: Mix all ingredients except onions.  Place in covered casserole and bake 2 1/2 to 3 hours at 325°.  About half hour before done, add drained onions.  Serves 5.

name: APRICOT CANDY
ingredients:
24  oz. almond bark
1 1/2  c. chopped dried apricot halves
2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Melt almond bark.  Add chopped dried apricots and chopped pecans.  Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper and let harden.  Cut or break apart in bite-sized pieces and store in container.

name: 5 CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. mandarin oranges
1  c. pineapple pieces
1  c. coconut
1  c. dairy sour cream
1  c. mini marshmallows
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Cover and let set 24 hours before serving.

name: CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  medium cauliflower
1  c. sliced radishes
1/2  c. sliced green onions
1/2  c. sliced celery
1  c. diced carrots
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts
3/4  c. sour cream
3/4  c. Miracle Whip
1  pkg. (dry) salad dressing
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients.  Mix sour cream, Miracle Whip and dry dressing together.  Add to the salad and toss.  Chill and serve.

name: APPLESAUCE NUGGETS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. allspice
1  c. broken walnuts
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. canned applesauce
1  egg, well beaten
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch pieces
preparation: Mix and sift flour, salt and spices.  Add nuts.  Cream shortening and sugar.  Add baking soda to applesauce.   Add egg. Add to creamed mixture.  Add dry ingredients.  Stir in butterscotch pieces.  Drop by teaspoons two or three inches apart on greased baking sheet.  Bake in moderate oven at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.  Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

name: PIZZELLES
ingredients:
5  c. flour
2 1/2  c. sugar
4  sticks margarine
4  tsp. anise and some anise seed
1  doz. eggs
dash of salt
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar; add eggs, salt, anise flavoring and anise seed, then add flour.  Place on a pizzelle griddle.

name: HIDDEN VALLEY OYSTER CRACKERS
ingredients:
1  c. vegetable oil
1  pkg. Hidden Valley original salad dressing mix
1  tsp. lemon pepper
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. dill weed
2 (12 oz.)  pkg. oyster crackers
preparation: Mix oil with dry ingredients.  Heat and mix well.  Pour over oyster crackers.  Toss with spatula every hour or so.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. cooking oil
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
2  c. shredded carrots
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. raisins
preparation: Mix oil and sugar together.  Add eggs, carrots and pineapple. Mix in dry ingredients and blend well.  Add vanilla, nuts and raisins.  Bake in 2 greased and lightly floured cake pans.  Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: WILD DUCK
ingredients:
2  ducks
1/2  c. flour
salt and pepper
1/4  c. butter
1  onion, minced
2  bay leaves
1  c. mushroom caps
1  green pepper, thinly sliced
1  c. water
1/2  c. Burgundy wine
preparation: Cut ducks into bite-size pieces, no bone, no skin.  Dredge in flour well seasoned with salt and pepper.  Saute in butter, adding onion, bay leaves, mushroom caps and pepper rings as meat is browning.  Add water and wine and simmer for 1 hour.  A pair of mallards will serve 3 to 4 people.  Can be served over wild rice, noodles or plain rice.

name: UNCOOKED OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cocoa
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. milk
1  c. chopped nuts
3  c. uncooked oatmeal
preparation: Put the first 4 ingredients in a pot and boil for 1 minute. Remove from fire. Add nuts and oatmeal and stir. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet. Let cool.

name: BRAISED SIRLOIN TIPS OVER RICE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. shortening
2  lb. beef sirloin, cut into pieces
1  can condensed beef consomme
1/2  c. Burgundy wine
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. onion salt
2  tsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. water
4  c. hot cooked rice
preparation: Melt shortening, brown meat on all sides in skillet.  Stir in consomme, wine, soy sauce, garlic and onion salt.  Heat to boiling, reduce heat, cover and simmer 1 hour.  Blend cornstarch and water.  Stir gradually into meat mixture.  Stirring until thickened.  Serve over rice.  If you need to reduce salt, use less soy sauce (1/2) and place onion salt with onion flakes or minced onion.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SUPER EASY PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. peanut butter
1  egg or egg substitute
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Mix sugar, peanut butter, egg and vanilla in a bowl with spoon. Shape into 1-inch balls.  Place on nonstick cookie sheet.  Bake  at 300° for 15 to 18 minutes or until light.  Remove to wire rack to cool.  (Be careful, cookies have a tendency to burn on the bottom.  Watch carefully.)  Yields approximately 2 dozen cookies.

name: OVERNIGHT FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
1  (10 oz.) loaf French bread
8  large eggs
3  c. milk
1  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. vanilla
1/4  c. butter
syrup
preparation: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cut bread into 1-inch slices and lay in pan.  Beat eggs with milk, sugar, salt and vanilla.  Pour over bread.  Cover with foil and refrigerate.  Next day, uncover and dot with butter.  Bake at 350° until puffy and brown.  Serve with syrup.  Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: EGGPLANT ROLLS
ingredients:
1  eggplant
1/2  cup seasoned bread crumbs
3  Tbsp. olive oil
1  (6.5 oz.) garlic and herb cheese spread
1  jar spaghetti sauce
8  oz. spaghetti, uncooked
1/3  cup Parmesan, grated
preparation: Per-heat oven to 350°F.  Trim both ends from eggplant and slice into rounds.  Soak slices in salted water for 10 minutes then drain.

name: SEAFOOD PARISIENNE
ingredients:
2 (9 oz. each)  pkg. frozen artichoke hearts or canned
2  c. Minute rice
1 1/2  lb. cooked shrimp, lobster or crab meat (about 3 c.) or use 2 (7 3/4 oz. each) cans crab meat
2  cans Cheddar cheese soup
2 2/3  c. water
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. dried dill weed
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Cook artichoke hearts as directed on package. Drain and place in 3-quart ovenproof casserole. Stir in rice and shrimp.  Mix remaining ingredients; pour into casserole.  Cover and bake at 400° for 35 minutes or until most of the liquid has been absorbed. Stir before serving. Garnish with lemon wedges, if desired. Serves 8.

name: EASY CHOCOLATE NUT CRUNCH
ingredients:
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  c. chocolate chips
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Sprinkle nuts over bottom of greased 8 or 9-inch square pan. Combine sugar and butter in saucepan.  Bring to rolling boil, stirring constantly, 4 to 5 minutes or to 270°.  Pour over nuts in pan.  Sprinkle with chocolate chips.  Cover for a few minutes, then evenly spread melted chocolate chips.  Chill.  Remove from pan, break into pieces.

name: NEIMAN-MARCUS CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
2  eggs
1  stick melted butter
1  box powdered sugar
2  more eggs
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour sheet cake pan (or spray with Pam). Mix cake mix, 2 eggs and melted butter together. The batter will be very thick.  Pat into cake pan.  Mix the sugar, 2 eggs and cream cheese in another bowl.  Pour over first layer. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes until done.  (Do not cook until it is very hard.)

name: CORN BREAD SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. corn bread mix
1 1/2  c. green onions, chopped
1  medium green pepper, chopped
3  medium tomatoes, chopped
8  slices bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
1 1/2  c. cubed cheese
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix well.  Makes large salad.

name: HOMEMADE YEAST
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes, sliced and peeled
1/2  c. sugar
1  small cake yeast (1/4 oz. pkg.)
3  pt. boiling water
2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. lukewarm water
preparation: Cook potatoes until soft in boiling water.  Mash in liquid. There should be one quart.  Add sugar and salt.  Cool to lukewarm. Blend yeast and lukewarm water.  Add to potato mixture.  Put in glass jar.  Keep at room temperature for 24 hours.  Then cover with lid, refrigerate.

name: SARA'S CHEESE STRAWS
ingredients:
10  oz. extra sharp New York Cheddar cheese (Cracker Barrel)
2  sticks oleo
2  c. plain flour
1/8  tsp. red pepper
dash of salt
preparation: With cheese and oleo at room temperature, mix well.  Add other ingredients.  Place on pan with cookie press.  Cook in 350° oven until light brown.  If you prefer, you can roll in small ball, dip fork in flour and press ball flat.

name: FLUFFY PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. pineapple juice
1  pkg. Knox gelatine
1  c. cold water
1/8  tsp. salt
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
sugar or sweetener to taste
1/2  c. chopped maraschino cherries
preparation: Heat pineapple juice.  Add gelatine dissolved in 1 cup cold water.  Add salt, pineapple and sugar or sweetener.  Add chopped maraschino cherries.

name: A. J.'S COOKIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. butter
2/3  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  egg yolk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix butter, sugar and egg yolk well.  Add vanilla; mix well. Gradually add flour, mixing well.  Roll into small balls or drop from teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for about 10 minutes.  Fun to decorate.

name: WHITE CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
3/4  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. milk
5  egg whites
preparation: Sift flour and sugar.  Add shortening, 3/4 cup milk and vanilla; beat 2 minutes.  Add egg whites and remaining milk.  Beat 2 more minutes and bake at 350° until done.

name: CHERRY CHICKEN PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. (uncooked weight) chicken breasts, sautéed in olive oil and cubed
16  oz. spiral pasta
3/4  c. celery, thinly sliced
3/4  c. red onion, chopped
5  oz. (or more, if you like) dried cherries
preparation: Cook pasta and drain.  Rinse with cold water.  Combine chicken, pasta, celery, onions, and cherries.

name: OLD FASHION SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  Tbsp. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. self rising flour
sugar
preparation: In a large mixing bowl cream together butter, sugar, egg, milk and vanilla.  Stir in flour and mix well.  Cover dough and let chill two to three hours.  Preheat oven to 375°.  After chilling, roll dough into small balls, placing on a lightly greased cookie sheet two inches apart.  Flatten tops lightly with a buttered glass dipped in sugar.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned around edges.  Makes about three dozen.

name: HORSERADISH CARROTS
ingredients:
6  to 8 carrots (for large groups 14 to 16)
1/4  c. liquid from cooked carrots
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. horseradish
1/2  c. mayonnaise
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. butter
bread crumbs
preparation: Scrub and slice carrots (diagonally).  Cook.  Drain and save liquid.  Mix together onion, horseradish, mayonnaise, salt and pepper and the liquid.  Put carrots in casserole; add the mixture over top of carrots.  Cover with bread crumbs.  Add small amount of melted butter to bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: SPLIT PEA SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. green split peas
1  medium onion
2  c. diced ham
3  qt. water
1  raw carrot, grated
2  tsp. salt
1  raw potato, diced (optional)
preparation: Sort peas.  Place in kettle with water and salt; bring to a boil.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 2 to 3 hours.  Add water from time to time as necessary.

name: NO-BAKE FRUITCAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. graham crackers, finely crushed
1  lb. raisins
1  lb. orange slices, cut small
1  lb. chopped dates
1  lb. mini marshmallows
1  lb. chopped nuts
1 large  can Milnot
preparation: Mix graham crackers and Milnot in large bowl until milk is absorbed.  Add rest of ingredients, mix well and press tightly into buttered angel food cake pan.  Refrigerate 6 hours.  Loosen around edge of pan and turn onto plate.  Store in refrigerator.

name: APPLE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. Crisco oil
2 1/4  c. sugar
3  c. diced apples
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Grease 13-inch baking pan.  Beat sugar, eggs, vanilla and oil. Sift dry ingredients.  Add to wet ingredients.  Mix well by hand. Add nuts and apples.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

name: BEEF-VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes, diced
2  carrots
1  onion, cut in rings
2 to 3  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
2  c. leftover roast, cut up
1 large  can tomato sauce
preparation: Cover potatoes and carrots with water and cook over medium heat until tender (about 20 to 30 minutes).  Add all ingredients and cook on low heat for 30 minutes.  Great with corn bread!

name: AZTEC CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
chopped jalapeno peppers (if desired)
Doritos
Velveeta cheese
1  medium bell pepper, chopped
preparation: Brown meat. Add chili powder, onion, bell pepper, jalapenos and corn. Layer Doritos, sliced Velveeta cheese and meat mixture; end with Doritos and cheese on top. Bake at 350° until cheese melts.

name: JAMASETTA
ingredients:
3  to 4 pork steaks, cut up in small pieces
1/2  chopped onion
1  tsp. chili powder
1 large  can tomatoes, cut up
1  pkg. noodles, cooked
12  slices Velveeta cheese
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Fry pork and set aside.  Saute onions.  Add tomatoes, salt, pepper and chili powder.  Place pork in sauce and simmer 20 minutes.  In oblong baking dish place layer of cooked noodles, layer of meat sauce, layer of cheese and sprinkle with Parmesan. Repeat layers.  Bake in moderate oven at 350° for a few minutes to melt cheese.

name: BLUEBERRY COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. Crisco
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. drained blueberries
preparation: Mix the first 7 ingredients first, then add blueberries; stir by hand.  Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
6  strips bacon, fried crisp and crushed with rolling pin
1  large onion
1  bottle clam juice
2 to 3  cans minced clams, drained
4  to 5 potatoes, cubed
2  c. milk
2  c. heavy cream
salt and pepper to taste
2  chicken bouillon cubes
preparation: Saute onion in bacon fat and remove.  Boil potatoes in clam juice until just tender.  Add onion, bacon and chicken bouillon. Add rest of ingredients.  Simmer 20 to 30 minutes.  Do not allow to boil.

name: CHICKEN PIE DELUXE
ingredients:
4  lb. cut up chicken
3  c. carrots, sliced
3  c. potatoes, cubed
1  small onion, chopped
1  stalk celery, chopped
parsley flakes
gravy
baking powder biscuits
preparation: In bit kettle, put chicken and add water to cover.  Cook on medium for 1 1/2 hours.  Remove chicken from kettle.  To broth, add the carrots, potatoes, celery and onion; cook for 15 minutes. Remove chicken from bones, cutting into pieces, and add to the broth.  Simmer 5 more minutes.  Remove everything from broth and put in a large roaster.  Mix cornstarch and water to make gravy; add to chicken broth which is boiling.

name: HOT SHRIMP SALAD OR SCALLOP APPETIZER
ingredients:
1  head leafy lettuce (romaine, bibb, red or green leaf)
1/4  lb. butter
1  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. chopped shallots
1  Tbsp. chopped garlic
1/2  tsp. kosher or sea salt
1/2  tsp. ground black pepper
shrimp (5 large per person)
scallops (5 large per person)
preparation: Clean lettuce, dry and arrange on salad plates.  Heat saute pan, add olive oil and melt butter.  Saute shallots first, then add garlic and saute until wilted.  Saute shrimp or scallops until done.  Serve on bed of lettuce and dress with pinch of salt and ground black pepper.  For more intense flavor, brown 1/2 pound lean bacon, reserve bacon and substitute bacon drippings for butter.

name: MANDARIN CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2 to 3  c. diced chicken, cooked
1  c. diced celery
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. seedless green grapes
1/2  c. toasted, slivered almonds
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  tsp. salt
1/3 to 1/2  c. mayonnaise
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
preparation: Combine chicken, celery, lemon juice, onion and salt.  Chill well.  Add mayonnaise, grapes, oranges and almonds to chicken mixture.  Toss until well mixed.  Place on lettuce leaves to serve.

name: 7 MINUTE ICING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white syrup
4  egg whites
4  Tbsp. water
preparation: Cook sugar, syrup and water at 250°, then pour over egg whites and beat until thick.

name: QUICK LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  jar spaghetti sauce
6  to 9 lasagna noodles
1  small container cottage cheese
Parmesan cheese
16  oz. Mozzarella cheese
1  egg
preparation: Brown and drain ground beef.  Mix with spaghetti sauce and cottage cheese.  Cook 5 minutes longer.    Grease pan and pour in 1/2 cup of sauce, then 1 layer of noodles, sauce and cheese; repeat layers.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Uncover and bake for 15 minutes.  Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting.

name: DIVINITY
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1/2  c. water
2  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Place syrup, sugar and water in heavy saucepan and cook over low  heat.	Stir  only  until  sugar  is dissolved.  Cook until syrup  mixture  reaches  soft ball stage.  Check this by dropping syrup  into ice water.  Beat egg whites on high speed until stiff. Continue beating egg whites and pour off half of syrup  (soft ball  stage)  over egg whites.  Continue cooking remaining half of	syrup  until  it  forms a hard crack.  Add remaining  syrup and  vanilla.  Beat  until	mixture is stiff enough to spoon onto wax paper.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. strawberry jello
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Bring to boil, then set pan in cold water. Chill in refrigerator for 1 hour.  Then add 1 pint of hulled strawberries, saving some for garnish.  Pour into pie shell.  Top with Dream Whip.  Garnish with remaining strawberries.

name: SUPER SESAME CHICKEN
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. boned chicken
1/4  c. sesame seed
3  Tbsp. salad oil
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
3/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  cloves garlic
4  green onions, chopped
preparation: Cut chicken into chunks.  In frying pan, combine sesame seed and oil; cook until golden.  Cool.  Stir in soy sauce, sugar, ginger, pepper, garlic and 1/2 the green onions.  Mix in chicken. Cover and chill 1 to 4 hours (I have chilled overnight).  Pour meat and marinade onto cookie sheet in a single layer.  Broil until golden; stir often.  Serve over rice or noodles.

name: RAINBOW JELLO
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. black cherry Jell-O
1 small  pkg. cherry Jell-O
1 small  pkg. lime Jell-O
1 small  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1 small  pkg. orange Jell-O
1 small  pkg. orange-pineapple Jell-O
1 small  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Make Jello in the order given.  Use a 9 x 13-inch glass pan and make sure a layer is well set before adding a new layer.  Layers 1, 3, 5 and 7; mix Jell-O with 3/4 cup hot water and 3/4 cup cold water.  Layers 2, 4 and 6; mix Jell-O with 1/2 cup hot water, 1/2 cup cold water and 1/3 can sweetened condensed milk.

name: PERSION CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  chicken breasts, cooked, cooled and chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  grated onion
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour into buttered casserole. Cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
about 2 lb. zucchini
1  onion, chopped
2  eggs
1/4  c. sour cream
1  c. grated yellow cheese
