cracker crumbs
salt
pepper
preparation: Wash, peel and slice zucchini.  Cook in small amount of water until tender.  Drain and blend in blender or use potato masher. Add onion, eggs, sour cream and 1/2 cup cheese.  Add salt and pepper and blend or mix with hand egg beater.  Pour mixture into shallow baking dish.  Top with 1/2 cup cheese and cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.   Serves 8 to 10 people.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
4  to 5 tart cooking apples
cinnamon
nutmeg to taste
1/3  c. granulated sugar
1  c. quick rolled oats
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. packed brown sugar
3  Tbsp. oil
1/4  c. cornflake crumbs
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Peel apples and slice into a deep baking dish. Sprinkle with spices (if desired) and granulated sugar.  Blend together the oats, flour, brown sugar, cornflake crumbs and oil.  Press this mixture on top of the apple slices. Bake for 30 minutes or until apples are tender when tested with a fork.  Yields 6 servings.  Fat:  None.

name: KATERINA COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. powdered sugar (without dextrose)
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. baking soda
4  c. flour
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs, vanilla and sour cream. Sift together flour, soda and baking powder.  Add to creamed mixture.  Freeze for 2 hours, then shape into small balls and roll in powdered sugar.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400°.

name: JALAPENO QUICHE APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1  lb. Cheddar cheese
1/2  lb. Swiss cheese
6  eggs, beaten
1 (8 oz.)  jar jalapenos, sliced
Muenster cheese slices
preparation: Grease an 8 x 12-inch glass pan.  Grate Cheddar cheese and Swiss cheese.  Add to beaten eggs.  Mix well.  Spread jalapenos on bottom of pan; add egg and cheese mixture.  Pat down evenly.  Top with Muenster cheese slices.  Bake at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes. Let set 10 minutes.  Cut into small pieces.

name: TOLL HOUSE PAN COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. packed brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla in mixing bowl until light and fluffy.  Beat in eggs.  Add mixture of flour, soda and salt gradually.  Mix well.  Stir in chocolate chips and pecans.  Spread in greased 10 x 15-inch baking pan.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.  Cool on wire rack.  Cut into 2-inch squares.

name: ROAST BEEF
ingredients:
8 to 10  lb. sirloin tip roast
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Place roast in Pyrex dish.  Place on rack in electric roaster. Set meat thermometer at 150°.  Place on top of meat.  Cook 24 hours.

name: QUICK AND EASY DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
1  pt. sour cream
dash of Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix together in bowl and put back into sour cream container until serving time.  Will keep for 2 weeks.

name: CHEESE STRAWS
ingredients:
2  c. grated New York extra sharp Cheddar cheese
2  sticks butter
2 2/3  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. cayenne
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 275°.  In food processor, using steel blade, cream together 1 cup cheese and 1 stick butter.  Add 1 1/3 cups flour, 1/8 teaspoon cayenne and 1/4 teaspoon salt.  Process until ball forms around blade.  Remove from processor, form into ball, and refrigerate 1 hour.  Repeat same procedure with the other half of ingredients.  Put dough in pastry gun and form into straws. Bake on ungreased cookie sheets for 20 to 25 minutes or until crispy.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: CHILI CON CARNE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  envelope Lipton onion soup
2  Tbsp. chili powder
2 (1 lb.)  cans red kidney beans
1/2  c. water
1  lb. canned tomatoes
preparation: In a large skillet, brown meat well.  Then stir in Lipton onion soup, tomatoes and water.  Simmer, covered, for 30 to 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.

name: PINEAPPLE SPREAD FOR SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Drain the pineapple.  Combine juice, eggs, sugar and flour. Cook until thick.  Cool.  Add mayonnaise and stir into pineapple.

name: QUICHE
ingredients:
1  deep dish pie shell (prick and bake)
2  oz. shredded sharp cheddar cheese
2  oz. shredded Mozzarella cheese
2  c. cooked white chicken, chopped
3  eggs
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
dash pepper
preparation: Layer cheddar cheese, Mozzarella cheese, and cooked chicken in baked pie shell.  Mix together eggs, milk, flour, salt, and pepper.  Pour over layered cheese and chicken.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: MICROWAVE BEETS
ingredients: 4  to 5 medium beets
preparation: Wash fresh beets well and remove stem and root ends.  Place beets in a 2-quart microwave dish with water to cover.  Cover dish with plastic wrap.  Cook for 30 to 35 minutes on full power.  When beets can be easily pierced with a sharp knife, drain and peel off skins.  Serve whole or diced.  Serves 4.

name: OATMEAL CRUNCHIES
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. shortening
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
3  c. old-fashioned oatmeal (not instant)
preparation: Cream shortening with sugars.  Add beaten eggs and vanilla. Sift flour, baking soda and salt.  Add dry ingredients and oatmeal to creamed mixture.  Shape into roll and chill.  Slice into thin pieces.  Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: EVELYN'S PICKLE RELISH
ingredients:
3  lb. green tomatoes
3  lb. red tomatoes
1  medium head cabbage
3  sweet red peppers
3  green peppers
1  qt. onions
1 1/3  bunches celery
9  Tbsp. salt
1 1/2  qt. vinegar
4 1/2  c. brown sugar
4 1/2 inches  stick cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. whole cloves
1 1/2  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Place in a cheesecloth bag and add to the mixture.  Boil all ingredients together for 30 minutes.  Remove the bag of spices. Put into sterilized jars and seal.

name: LEMON COOKIES
ingredients:
1  box lemon cake mix
4  oz. Cool Whip
1  egg
10x sugar
preparation: Mix cake mix, egg and Cool Whip together. Roll 1 teaspoon dough into ball; roll in 10x sugar. Bake at 350° on greased cookie sheet 10 to 15 minutes or until set.

name: CAJUN BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. dry baby or large lima beans
1  medium onion, chopped
1  medium bell pepper
3  medium ripe tomatoes, chopped
1  lb. sliced Polish sausage
salt and pepper to taste
1  Tbsp. Cajun seasoning
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
preparation: Wash beans thoroughly and boil according to directions for 30 minutes.  Add all other ingredients and cook until tender.

name: HOT DOG SAUCE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburg
1  small onion
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. red pepper
2  tsp. cumin powder
3  tsp. paprika
8  oz. tomato sauce
1/2  pt. hot water
3  Tbsp. oil (optional)
preparation: Fry hamburg with onion.  Add all other ingredients except oil. Simmer 1/2 hour.  Add oil, if desired.  Cool some, then put in blender until right consistency.

name: PEPPY DRIED BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. dried beans (of choice)
1/2  lb. chopped smoked ham
3/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/3  c. chopped green bell pepper
1 to 2  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
2  bay leaves
2  cloves garlic, crushed (optional)
1/4  c. butter or margarine
Black pepper, to taste
Salt, to taste
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
4 to 6  drops Tabasco sauce
preparation: Cover the beans with water and soak overnight or at least 6 hours.  Drain.  Add ham, onion, celery, bell pepper, parsley, bay leaves and garlic.  Cover with water and bring to a boil.  Reduce to low heat and cook for about 2 hours. Add the butter, black pepper, salt, Worcestershire sauce and Tabasco sauce.  Continue cooking over low heat for an additional hour or until tender. Remove bay leaves before serving.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  bunches fresh broccoli, chopped
1  medium Vidalia onion, chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  c. raisins
1  c. chopped nuts
1  lb. bacon, crisp and crumbled
preparation: Mix well and let sit overnight before serving.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
2  c. chicken, cut in pieces
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick oleo
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sweet milk
preparation: Line dish with foil (have enough foil to cover top of dish). Skin chicken and cut up.  Rub in oil and soy sauce.   Place in dish.  Put celery, onions and bell pepper (sliced) on top.  Grate Cheddar cheese on top and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Pour rest of oil over chicken.  Cover and seal foil around the edges. Cook 1 hour at 350°.   Uncover and brown 10 minutes at 400°.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. fresh corn
2  eggs
1  c. thin cream
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
preparation: Beat eggs, sugar, salt, butter and flour; beat until smooth. Add corn and stir in cream.  Pour in a greased baking dish.  Bake slowly for 30 minutes or until done.  Stir from the bottom several times while baking.

name: PIZZA HOT DISH
ingredients:
1  can pizza sauce (10 1/2 oz.)
1  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
1  lb. hamburger, browned
1  c. milk
1 1/2  c. uncooked egg noodles
1  can sliced mushrooms
1  tsp. garlic salt
1 1/2  tsp. oregano
preparation: Butter 9 x 13-inch loaf pan or casserole.  Mix all the ingredients all together and refrigerate 3 hours.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BUSTER BAR DESSERT
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1  pkg. Oreo cookies, crushed
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
salted peanuts
1  can chocolate syrup
preparation: Mix butter and Oreo cookie crumbs.  Spread in pan.  Spread ice cream over cookie mixture.  Sprinkle peanuts over ice cream.  Pour chocolate syrup on top.  Freeze until hard.

name: CREAM CHEESE CORN
ingredients:
3  cans whole corn, drained
1  jalapeno pepper, chopped fine
1  onion, chopped fine
1  stick oleo
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

name: SNOW ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1  large bowl freshly fallen snow
preparation: Beat egg until it is foamy.  Add sugar and continue beating. Pour in milk and vanilla.  Go out and get large bowl of clean, fresh snow.  Add large spoonfuls to egg mixture.  Keep stirring until thick.  Eat and enjoy.

name: CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
1  stick butter
10  large marshmallows
2  tsp. cinnamon
10  buttermilk biscuits
preparation: Melt butter in pan or bowl in microwave.  Add cinnamon.  Stir in well.  Dip marshmallows in butter and cinnamon.  Put biscuits in cupcake pan, flat and thin.  Add one marshmallow to each biscuit, then wrap biscuit over marshmallow.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook 5 to 10 minutes.  Makes 10 cinnamon rolls.

name: FIESTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat, cooked
1  can red beans, drained
1  red onion, chopped
1  head of lettuce, chopped
Shredded cheddar cheese
1  bottle Thousand Island dressing
1  pkg. Doritos, crushed
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and serve.

name: MINNIE ANN'S POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
5  medium potatoes
5  boiled eggs
2 heaping  Tbsp. pickle relish
1  medium onion, chopped
1 very small  can pimentos
1/2  pt. Kraft mayonnaise
1  big serving spoon mustard
preparation: Boil potatoes with skin on (do not overcook, just firm).  Skin potatoes and cut in chunks.  Boil eggs; peel and cut up smaller than potatoes.  Add sweet pickle relish with a little juice.  Add onion, chopped up.  Add pimentos, mayonnaise and mustard.  Stir up; add more mayonnaise if needed.  Salt and pepper to taste.

name: HOT CHICKEN SUPPER SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. cut up cooked chicken
2  c. thinly sliced celery
1  c. toasted bread cubes
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. toasted, slivered almonds
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients except cheese, bread cubes and potato chips.  Pile into ungreased 2-quart casserole.  Sprinkle with bread cubes, potato chips and cheese. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly.  Serves 4 to 5.

name: STUFFED JUMBO SHELLS
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. jumbo shells
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. ground pork
1/3  c. minced onions
1/4  c. minced celery
2 (14 oz.)  jars spaghetti sauce
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Mozzarella cheese
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1  clove garlic, minced
1/3  c. cooking sherry
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. dry bread crumbs
preparation: Prepare jumbo shells according to directions on box.  Drain. In large skillet, melt margarine.  Add beef and pork.  Cook until lightly brown.  Add onion, celery and garlic.  Cook until tender. Remove from heat.  Stir in sherry, cheese, salt and bread crumbs. Cool mixture for 10 minutes.  Stuff shells with mixture.  Pour 1 jar spaghetti sauce in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.  Arrange shells in pan.   Pour remaining sauce over the shells.  Top with cheese. Cover and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: COPPER COIN SALAD
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots
1  can tomato soup
1/2  c. salad oil
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dill seed
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  large green pepper, diced
1  large onion, diced
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
preparation: Peel carrots; slice in 1/4-inch rings.  Cook or steam until tender-crisp; drain.  Combine soup, salad oil, sugar, vinegar, salt, dill seed and pepper in saucepan; bring to a boil to dissolve.  In 1/4 cup of water, dissolve 1 envelope gelatin and stir into hot soup until melted.  In 2-quart container, combine carrots, green pepper and onion.  Pour soup mixture over vegetables; mix well and let stand overnight.

name: SOUFFLE
ingredients:
3  c. mashed sweet potatoes (canned or fresh)
1  c. sugar
1  stick butter
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix ingredients. Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: RANGE-TOP ROAST
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. beef chuck roast
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. seasoned pepper
1  envelope onion soup mix
preparation: Preheat 10-inch skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes.  Add roast and brown on both sides.  Sprinkle roast with salt, pepper and onion soup mix.

name: LEMON CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. corn meal
4  unbeaten eggs
1/4  c. melted butter
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. lemon juice
4  Tbsp. lemon rind (optional)
preparation: Combine sugar, flour and corn meal.  Add eggs, melted butter, milk, lemon juice and rind.  Beat until smooth and thoroughly blended.  Pour into pastry-lined 9-inch pie pan.   Bake in moderately hot oven (375°) for 35 to 45 minutes or until top is golden.

name: SAURBRATEN
ingredients:
rump roast
water
whole cloves
1  onion, sliced
1/2  c. raisins
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
butter
red wine vinegar
peppercorns
bay leaf
allspice
1/2  c. sliced almonds
2  Tbsp. flour
gingersnaps
preparation: Cover the rump roast with the vinegar and let stand overnight. In the morning, take half the vinegar and as much water.  Add a few peppercorns, cloves, bay leaf, onion, a little allspice, raisins and almonds.  Let beef stew in this liquid until tender.  Take out beef and slice.  Brown the flour in a piece of butter.  Add to liquid and stir until smooth.  Thicken with 2 to 3 gingersnaps stirring to a smooth paste.  Add hot water, if necessary.  Put the sliced meat in with the liquid and simmer slowly until ready to serve.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen broccoli
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. bread crumbs
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  Tbsp. grated onion juice
preparation: Cook broccoli in boiling water until not quite done.  Mix mushroom soup with 1/2 cup milk and add onion juice.  Place layer of broccoli in casserole dish, layer of bread crumbs, layer of mushroom soup mixture and layer of cheese.  Repeat, making 2 layers.  Top with buttered crumbs and Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: SWEET POTATO BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ground cloves
1  tsp. nutmeg
3  beaten eggs
1  c. peanut oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. mashed cooked sweet potatoes
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Stir dry ingredients and set aside.  Combine eggs, oil, vanilla and potatoes.  Stir in dry ingredients.  Fold in pecans.  Divide batter into 2 greased loaf pans.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.  Makes 2 loaves. Contains 180 calories, 2 g protein, 9 g fat, 25 g carbohydrates, 48 mg sodium and 23 mg cholesterol.

name: BEAN SOUP *(Old Indian Recipe)
ingredients:
1  lb. Northern beans
1 large  can tomatoes
3  onions, chopped
4  green onions
1  green pepper
2  celery stalks and leaves
parsley flakes
salt and pepper
1  tsp. red pepper
1  tsp. chili powder
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire
2  c. water
ham (optional)
preparation: Cook beans in water for 1 hour.  Add remaining ingredients and cook until beans are done.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. dried beans (your choice)
1  bottle ketchup
1  big onion, chopped
1  c. brown sugar
cinnamon to taste
salt and pepper to taste
bacon
preparation: Soak beans overnight.  Cook over medium heat until done.  Put everything together, bacon on top, and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: JENNIE'S GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. allspice
2/3  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. brown sugar or molasses
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix together all ingredients and pat out as you would biscuits.  Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
4  lb. hamburger
2  large onions
1  green pepper, chopped
4  medium potatoes, cubed
1 large  can V-8 juice
6 ripe tomatoes or 2  cans tomatoes
2  c. fresh corn or 1 can Green Giant
4  c. cabbage, chopped
1  can French-style green beans
1  can mixed vegetables or frozen vegetables
4  medium carrots, chopped
6  pieces celery, chopped
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1 1/2  tsp. garlic powder
2  or 3 dashes of Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Brown meat, onions and peppers, then add ingredients, potatoes, etc.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Add water as desired.  Makes 8 to 10 quarts.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, well drained
1/4  c. minced green bell pepper
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  tsp. seasoned salt
2  c. finely chopped pecans or walnuts, divided
1  maraschino cherry
preparation: Combine the first 5 ingredients and mix well. Blend in 1 cup of the chopped nuts. Mixture will be soft. Chill until firm; shape into a ball. Roll in remaining nuts. Place on serving plate and press the cherry into the top. Serve with crackers.

name: TURNIP RELISH
ingredients:
10  lb. turnips, peeled
1  large head cabbage
10  medium onions
1  bunch celery or 1 Tbsp. celery seed
6  c. vinegar
5  Tbsp. salt
4  sweet red peppers
4  sweet green peppers
6  Tbsp. horseradish
2  oz. mustard seed
5  c. sugar
preparation: Grind all vegetables through a food chopper.  Add salt and mix well.  Let stand one hour.  Mix together sugar, mustard seed and vinegar (also celery seed if you use it).  Heat just to boiling point and sugar is melted; cool.  Drain salted vegetables thoroughly; combine with cooled vinegar mixture.  Stir until well blended.  Let stand for one hour.   Pack in sterile jars and seal, but do not cook.  Store in cool place.

name: GLAZED PECANS
ingredients:
1  egg white
1  Tbsp. water
4 1/2  c. or 1 lb. pecans
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat together in a bowl, the egg white and water.  Pour in the pecans and using a wooden spoon, stir until all pecans are coated. Sift together the sugar, cinnamon and salt.  Stir pecans in mixture until they are well coated.  Spread on a cookie sheet and bake at 300° for 40 minutes.  Stir every 10 minutes.  Store in a cake tin or glass jar.

name: BUNS
ingredients:
2  c. scalded milk
1/2  c. sugar
1  pkg. dry yeast in 1/4 c. lukewarm water
white flour
1/3  c. melted shortening
2  tsp. salt
1  egg
preparation: Pour milk into bowl with sugar.  When lukewarm, add yeast in water.   Stir in enough flour to make pancake batter texture. This is called the "sponge".  Let stand until bubbly, about 1/2 hour in warm place.  Then mix in rest of ingredients and set with flour.  Leave it sticky.  Let rise 1 hour in warm place.  Punch down and let rise 1 more hour.   Form into buns and put in greased pan.  Let rise, then bake.  Butter tops when done.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

name: SQUASH GARDEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
7  small squash, coarsely chopped
2  small onions, chopped
1/8  tsp. garlic salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
salt to taste
3  canned tomatoes, chopped
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. melted margarine
1/4  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Cook squash, onions, garlic salt, pepper and brown sugar in small amount of salted water in saucepan until squash is tender; drain.  Add tomatoes; mix well.  Spoon into casserole.  Sprinkle with cheese and mixture of margarine and bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Yield:  6 servings.

name: GIANT PANCAKE
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter
4  eggs
1  c. milk
1  c. flour
1  tsp. sugar
sugared strawberries
whipped cream for topping (if desired)
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Place butter in an 11 3/4-inch cast-iron skillet and put in oven to melt and heat while mixing batter.

name: CHESS CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  egg
1  stick margarine, melted
1  box confectioners sugar
2  eggs
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients and place in bottom of baking pan. Mix the remaining ingredients and place over the first layer of ingredients in the baking pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: GRAHAM PRALINES
ingredients:
1  pkg. (1/3 box) graham crackers
1  c. chopped pecans
3/4  c. margarine
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Break crackers along perforated lines.  Line bottom of a cookie sheet with crackers.  Set aside. Mix pecans, margarine and sugar in a heavy saucepan.  Bring to a boil over medium heat and boil 3 minutes.  Pour mixture over crackers.  Bake at 300° for 12 minutes. Cool slightly.  Break apart.

name: GRAPE PUNCH
ingredients:
1  can grape drink (46 oz.)
1  can pineapple juice (46 oz.)
1  qt. ginger ale
2  pkg. grape Jell-O plus water
2  lemons
1 1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix ingredients well.  Chill and serve.

name: MEXICAN PIZZA
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
2  tsp. vegetable oil
1/4  tsp. ground cumin
1/4  tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies, drained
8  flour tortillas
1  c. salsa (from jar)
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
10  small pitted black olives, sliced
4  oz. shredded part-skim Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Lightly oil or spray with nonstick spray a large baking sheet.  Place kidney beans and oil in a medium bowl and mash with a fork or a potato masher.  Sprinkle evenly with cumin, chili powder and garlic powder.   Mix well. Add green chilies, mix again.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. broccoli
1  c. cauliflower
1  c. slaw dressing
1/2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Chop broccoli and cauliflower into bite-size pieces.  Mix all ingredients well.

name: CHICKEN CURRY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  lb. chicken
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. melted butter
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3/4  tsp. curry powder
preparation: Bake chicken, until fully cooked, and dice.  Mix chicken with all other ingredients in a casserole dish.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serve over rice.  Serves approximately 6.

name: CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. yellow cornmeal
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. sugar
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1 1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. cooking oil
preparation: Mix all together and bake in greased pan (9 x 5-inch) or 12-cup muffin pan at 425° until golden brown, about 25 minutes.

name: COWBOY EGGS
ingredients:
6  slices bacon
1  large potato, diced
1/2  lb. sausage links, sliced
1/2  bell pepper, diced
1/2  medium onion, diced
6  to 8 eggs, beaten
shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook bacon. Add potatoes and sausage.  Fry until nearly done and add bell pepper and onion.  Cook until soft. Pour in eggs. When eggs are scrambled, turn off and add cheese. Let melt. Add salt and pepper to taste.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. rice
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. butter
1 large  can evaporated milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  to 3 eggs, beaten
1  c. raisins
2  Tbsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Cook rice 10 minutes.  Remove from heat. Add sugar, eggs, butter and vanilla. Mix well until eggs are cooked in hot rice. Add milk and raisins. Return to low heat, stirring continuously for about 5 minutes.   Pour into serving dish.  Sprinkle with nutmeg and brown sugar.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
1 (46 oz.)  can chicken broth
1  large onion, diced
1  c. diced celery
1  c. diced carrot
4  large potatoes
2  Tbsp. thyme
1  c. milk
1/2  stick butter
salt and pepper
1  c. white corn
preparation: Put chicken broth, celery, carrots, onions, potatoes and thyme in pot with just enough water to cover.  When tender, add milk and white corn.  Cook 10 more minutes.  Put through masher.  If needs thickening, add small amount of flour.  Takes about 1 hour.

name: JASON'S GREEN BEAN-POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
2  cans potato soup
1  can water
6  links breakfast sausage, cooked and drained
1  c. cut green beans, drained
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine all ingredients; cook until heated thoroughly.

name: ASPARAGUS SOUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  can cream of asparagus soup
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime jello
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. salad dressing or mayonnaise
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
3/4  c. chopped celery
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Heat soup and water.  Add jello; add cream cheese while water is still warm.  Cool and add other ingredients; grease mold and pour mixture in mold.  Chill and unmold.

name: FRESH FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
2  c. sour cream
1  pkg. strawberry Kool-Aid with NutraSweet
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Mix well and chill.  Serve with fresh fruit.

name: RICE KRISPIE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. margarine or 1/2 c. margarine and 1/2 c. Crisco
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. flour
1  c. Rice Krispies
2  eggs
2  c. quick rolled oats
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Cream the sugars, Crisco and eggs.  Sift flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda. Add vanilla.  Lastly add the rolled oats, Rice Krispies and nuts.  Roll into balls. Bake at 325°.

name: HOT MILK CAKE
ingredients:
4  whole eggs
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  stick butter or margarine
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sweet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs; add sugar gradually.  Add flour (sifted 3 times with baking powder and salt) in 3 portions, beating well after each addition.  Heat milk and butter.  Add to mixture.  Add flavoring.  Bake at 325° until brown, about 45 minutes.

name: EGG ROLLS
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. lukewarm water
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. oleo
1/4  tsp. salt
5  c. plain flour
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. lukewarm milk (that has been heated)
butter
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water.  Mix with remaining ingredients to make a soft dough.  Let rise until double in bulk. Refrigerate overnight.  Roll on floured board; cut into rolls. Fold over a thin slice of butter.  Let rise overnight.  Bake at 350° until slightly brown.

name: CRANBERRY RELISH
ingredients:
1  bag fresh cranberries
1  whole orange
1  c. sugar
preparation: Wash berries.  Cut orange into quarters; remove seeds.  Do not peel orange.  Grind berries and orange.  Add sugar.  Refrigerate.

name: ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
tortillas
cheese (dip type)
chili powder
cheese, grated
butter
preparation: Put butter on the tortillas, then sprinkle with chili powder. Prepare half the cheese and butter, then put it in the tortilla. Put tortillas in pan.  Mix cheese with grated cheese and sprinkle on top.  Cook 15 to 20 minutes.

name: TOMATO-BASIL BISQUE
ingredients:
3  c. peeled, seeded, chopped tomatoes
1  c. vegetable or chicken broth
1 8  oz. can tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. snipped fresh basil or 1 tsp. dried crushed basil
preparation: Blend all in a blender. Chill. May be eaten hot or cold.

name: DOUBLE DELICIOUS COOKIE BAR
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine or butter
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. Hershey semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  c. Reese's peanut butter chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 350° (325° if a glass dish).  In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt margarine in oven.  Sprinkle crumbs evenly over the margarine.  Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Top with chips and press down firmly.   Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.  Cool.   Garnish as desired.  Cut into bars.  Store, loosely covered, at room temperature.

name: DIRT
ingredients:
1  pkg. Oleo cookies (2 rows only)
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. confectioners sugar
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
3 1/2  c. milk
1  (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Crush Oreos and set aside.  Mix pudding and milk until thick and put in refrigerator.  With mixer, cream together cream cheese, confectioners sugar and butter.  Then add with mixer Cool Whip, pudding and vanilla to cheese mixture.  Layer in bowl 1/3 crushed cookies, 1/2 pudding mix, 1/3 crushed cookies and 1/2 pudding mixture.  Cover with remaining cookies and refrigerate.

name: CUCUMBER SALAD WITH BUTTERMILK DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. low-fat yogurt
3  Tbsp. chopped fresh dill
1  tsp. cider vinegar
1/2  tsp. honey
1  seedless cucumber, thinly sliced (about 2 c.)
1/2  c. chopped red onion
2  Tbsp. finely diced carrots
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
1/2  tsp. black pepper
preparation: In a medium bowl, stir together the buttermilk, yogurt, dill, cider vinegar and honey.  Add remaining ingredients; stir until blended.  Chill.

name: PEANUT BUTTER HONEY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/4  c. honey
1/4  c. milk
preparation: In a large bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, salt and brown sugar.  In another bowl, combine melted butter, peanut butter, eggs, honey, vanilla and milk.  Combine the two mixtures, pouring the liquid ingredients into the dry.  Stir only until blended.  Spoon into buttered muffin cups.  Bake at 375° for 18 to 20 minutes.   Cool a minute before removing from pan.  Serve slightly warm.

name: MICROWAVED PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. raw peanuts
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Mix together the sugar, corn syrup and salt in a 1 1/2-quart glass casserole.  Microwave on High setting 8 minutes, stirring once after 4 minutes.  Stir in butter and vanilla.  Microwave 2 minutes more.  Stir in baking soda.  Pour onto greased baking sheet.  Stretch until thin using 2 forks.  Cool and break into pieces.

name: KALE SOUP
ingredients:
1  large onion
2  tsp. vegetable oil
1  large potato, cubed
2 (15 1/2 oz.)  cans red kidney beans
16  oz. can chopped kale with liquid or equivalent amount of fresh or frozen
3  c. water
16  oz. can tomatoes or fresh
1/4  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. liquid smoke
hot pepper sauce to taste
1/2  tsp. crushed garlic
2  large carrots, sliced
preparation: Saute onion and garlic in oil; add carrots, potatoes, water and kidney beans.  Add tomatoes and juice; add kale and let simmer for about 45 minutes, until carrots and potatoes are soft.  Add vinegar, liquid smoke and hot pepper sauce.  May substitute spinach for kale.

name: HOP'S HEAVENLY PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  c. sour cream (room temperature)
4  eggs (room temperature)
5  Tbsp. cake flour
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix sour cream, eggs, flour, sugar, baking soda and salt in blender or processor until smooth.  Transfer batter to bowl. Cover and chill several hours or overnight.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1/2  c. onion chopped
1  1/2 lbs. ground beef
1  clove garlic or powder
Salt and Pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. parsley
1  tsp. fennel seed
2  tsp. sweet basil
1  Tbsp. oregano
2  cans (28 oz.) whole tomatoes
8  oz. tomato paste
1  lb. lasagna noodles
1/2  lb. Mozzarella cheese
1 1/2  c. cottage cheese
1 1/2  c. parmesan cheese
preparation: Sauté onion, add ground beef, garlic, and spices.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Add tomatoes that have been mashed lightly and tomato paste.  Simmer another 20 minutes.  Cook noodles according to directions.

name: GOOEY
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger meat
1  onion, chopped
1  can Ranch Style beans
1  can Spanish rice
1  can Ro-Tel (drain off 1/2 juice)
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion together. Drain. Salt and pepper to taste. Add the rest of the ingredients. Mix well and heat in oven or on top of stove until cheese is melted.

name: CHOCOLATE DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. melted butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1 1/2  c. cake flour
1/2  c. cocoa
3/4  c. sour milk
1/2  tsp. baking soda
dash of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Add ingredients in order given; beat well with each addition. Drop tablespoon for each cookie onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.  When cookies are cool, ice each with chocolate icing.

name: SWEET POTATO SUPREME
ingredients:
2 large  cans sweet potatoes
1  stick melted oleo
1/4  c. light brown sugar
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. crushed pineapple
1/2  c. broken nuts (optional)
pineapple juice
potato syrup
marshmallows
preparation: Mash potatoes; mix with oleo, sugar, raisins and pineapple. Add enough pineapple juice and potato syrup to moisten.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Top with marshmallows.  Broil until slightly melted and brown.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: CHEESE POTATOES
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes, peeled and quartered
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
3/4  stick butter or margarine
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix cheese, flour, salt, pepper and garlic powder together in a plastic bag.  Toss wet potatoes to coat with cheese mixture. Place butter in an 8 x 10-inch baking dish to melt in a preheated 350° oven.  Add potatoes to melted butter and bake uncovered for 45 to 50 minutes or until tender and golden brown.  Turn potatoes once during baking time.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: SPINACH ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
2  c. mozzarella cheese (divided)
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  c. fresh Parmesan cheese, grated and divided
1/2  tsp. pepper
3  cloves crushed garlic
1- 14  oz. can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
2- 8  oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened
1- 10  oz. frozen spinach, thawed and drained
preparation: Combine 1 1/2 c. mozzarella cheese, sour cream, 2 Tbsp. Parmesan cheese, and next 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Blend well. Spread into baking dish. Top with remaining cheese.

name: YUSCAN BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup
1/2  c. red wine
1 (14 oz.)  can diced Italian-style tomatoes
1  tsp. seasoning, crushed
2  cans (16 oz.) white kidney beans, drained
1  can condensed beef broth
2  lb. beef stew, cut into 1-inch pieces
3  large carrots, cut 1-inch pieces
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix soup, broth, wine, beef, tomatoes, carrots, Italian seasoning and garlic in a 3 1/2-quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 8 to 9 hours. Stir in beans; turn to high heat and cook 10 minutes. You can cook on high for 4 to 5 hours.

name: RAW VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. onion flakes
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1 1/2  tsp. dill weed
preparation: Combine, but do not mix in blender.  Serve with fresh veggies.

name: MARIE'S CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  jar apricot preserves
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Russian salad dressing with honey (1 c.)
1  envelope onion soup mix
3  (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) broiler fryer chickens, cut up
preparation: Combine preserves, salad dressing and soup mix.  Place chicken pieces in baking pan; spread sauce over.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or grill chicken over medium coals until nearly tender, about 45 minutes; turn occasionally.  Brush with sauce, grill 15 minutes more basting occasionally.  Makes 12 servings.

name: FLAN
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sugar
8  eggs
4  c. milk
1  stick cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Heat 3/4 cup sugar until it turns light brown on low heat. Pour into 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Coat the bottom and side of dish.  In a large bowl, beat eggs, then add 1 cup sugar slowly, while beating mixture; set aside.  In a saucepan, heat milk on medium heat with cinnamon stick until bubbly.  Take cinnamon stick out.  Pour into dish that has the caramel.  Place dish inside a bigger pan.  Pour hot tap water around the flan in the bigger pan until water is an inch deep.  Cook at 325° in oven uncovered for 1 hour or until knife comes out clean.

name: CARROTS IN ONION SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. finely diced onion
2  Tbsp. oil
2  c. diced carrots, cooked and drained
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Cook onion in hot oil until limp.  Stir in carrots, milk, salt and pepper.  Cook over low heat, stirring gently until sauce coats the carrots and is slightly thickened.

name: "MOCK COCKTAIL" SCARLET DAIQUIRI
ingredients:
4  oz. Ocean Spray cranberry juice cocktail
8  fresh or frozen whole strawberries
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. lime juice
preparation: In a blender or food processor container, process cranberry juice cocktail, strawberries, sugar and lime juice until blended. Serve over crushed ice.  Makes 1 serving.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup
1  envelope Knox gelatine
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  cans small shrimp
1  c. mayonnaise
3/4  c. finely chopped onion
3/4  c. finely chopped celery
preparation: Heat the soup and gelatine.  Remove from heat.  Add cream cheese, shrimp, mayonnaise, onion and celery.  Mix together and pour in a mold.  Chill about 4 hours.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream style corn
2  eggs, lightly beaten
1  box Jiffy corn muffin mix
1/4  c melted butter
1  c sour cream
shredded cheddar cheese
preparation: Stir muffin mix into melted butter; add remaining ingredients. Place in greased shallow baking dish. Bake at 350° about 35 minutes. Top with cheese during last 5 minutes of baking time.

name: MEXICAN STUFFED SHELLS
ingredients:
12  pasta stuffing shells, cooked and drained
1  lb. ground beef
1  jar (12 oz.) mild or medium picante sauce
1/2  c. water
1  can (8 oz.) tomato sauce
1  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1  can (2.8 oz.) French fried onions
preparation: Brown beef, drain.  Combine picante sauce, water and tomato sauce.  Stir 1/2 cup into ground beef, 1/2 cup cheese, 1/2 can onions.  Mix well.  Pour 1/2 remaining sauce on bottom of 10-inch round or 8 x 12-inch baking dish.  Stuff shells, arrange in baking dish.  Pour remaining sauce over shells.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onion.  Bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes longer.

name: HOT ONION DIP
ingredients:
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
1 large  pkg. frozen chopped onions or medium onion, chopped finely
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. mayo
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°. Stir together all ingredients. Place in 2-quart souffle dish. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with corn chips or crackers.

name: ORANGE-PEPPER STEAKS
ingredients:
4  beef tenderloin steaks, cut in 1-inch thick strips
2  tsp. coarse grind black pepper
1/2  c. orange marmalade
4  tsp. cider vinegar
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
preparation: Press pepper into both sides of steaks.  Place on rack in broiler pan so surface of the meat is 2 or 3-inches from the heat. Combine marmalade, vinegar and ginger.  Brush top of steaks with half of marmalade mixture.  Broil steaks 10 to 15 minutes for rare (140°) to medium (160°F), turning once and brushing with remaining marmalade mixture.  Serves 4.

name: RABBIT IN SOUR CREAM AND MUSTARD SAUCE
ingredients:
3  rabbits, cut up
5 to 6  Tbsp. flour
salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
4  Tbsp. lard or oil
4  medium onions, diced
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  bay leaves
1  tsp. marjoram
1/2  tsp. powdered thyme
1 1/2  tsp. dry mustard
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. chicken broth
1/2  c. dry vermouth
1/2  lb. mushrooms, sliced and sauteed in butter
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Shake the rabbit pieces with flour, 1 teaspoon salt and pepper.  In a large casserole or Dutch oven, saute the rabbit in lard or oil over medium heat until browned on all sides, about 10 minutes. During this browning, add onion and garlic.

name: SAUSAGE/LIMA BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1  c. dry lima beans
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes, cut up
1/2  lb. smoked pork sausage or kielbasa, cut in 1-inch pieces
2  qt. water
8  beef bouillon cubes
1 1/2  c. chopped onions
1/4  c. barley
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Wash beans.  Add with water to large kettle.  Bring to boil; boil 2 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Let stand 1 hour.   Add tomatoes, bouillon cubes and onion; cover and simmer about 1 1/2 hours.  Add sausage, barley, salt and pepper.  Simmer 30 minutes more.  Makes 2 1/2 quarts.

name: CURRIED CARROTS
ingredients:
4  carrots (3 c.)
1  can mandarin oranges
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. curry powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  lemon juice
1  green onion, thinly sliced
preparation: Cut carrots into 1/4-inch slanting slices.  Drain the oranges, reserving 3 tablespoons juice.  In a wide frying pan over medium-high heat, melt butter.  Add carrots and orange juice. Cook, covered until carrots are tender and most of the juice has evaporated.  In a cup, stir together curry powder, salt and lemon juice.  Add and let cook for 1 minute, then add the remaining ingredients and cook three minutes more.

name: GLAZED CHERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  can frozen cherries (20 oz.)
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. cornstarch
1/8  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix together and cook until thick and clear; stir constantly. Let cool and pour into a baked pie shell.  Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.  Because of the cornstarch this filling does not hold or stand very long.  The pie should be served the day it is made.

name: PARMESAN ZUCCHINI
ingredients:
3  to 4 large, sliced zucchini squash
1  large, chopped bell pepper
1  large, chopped onion
4  stalks chopped celery
4 medium  cloves garlic
1/4  c. ground Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/2  tsp. ground oregano
4  medium tomatoes, peeled and chopped (1 large can tomatoes may be used instead)
2  Tbsp. vegetable cooking oil
preparation: Heat oil in covered frying pan to medium heat.  Add garlic (chopped) and saute.  Add bell pepper, celery and onion.  Saute until onion is tender.  Add squash, tomatoes and seasoning to mixture.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Cover and let simmer on medium heat until vegetables are tender and mixture has thickened. Serve in dish with Parmesan cheese covering top.

name: LEMON PIE FILLING
ingredients:
juice of 2 lemons (grated rind)
1  c. sugar
2  egg yolks
1  Tbsp. oleo
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  pt. hot water
preparation: Mix juice and rind with egg yolks, sugar and cornstarch in pan.  Gradually add hot water and oleo.  Cook until thick.  Pour into baked pie shell.  Use whites for meringue; top and brown.

name: WALNUT OR PECAN FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
2/3  c. orange juice
2/3  c. milk
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
8  slices thick French bread (1-inch)
1/2  c. butter, melted
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients; mix well.  Arrange bread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pour egg mixture over bread.  Refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight.  Pour melted butter in jelly roll pan.  Arrange bread.  Sprinkle with nuts.  Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.  Sprinkle with xxx sugar.

name: BAKED FLOUNDER
ingredients:
1  lb. flounder fillet
1/2  lb. caesar salad dressing
1  c. cracker crumbs
preparation: Arrange fish in 9 x 13 inch baking dish,  lightly greased or sprayed with Pam.  Drizzle dressing over fish, then sprinkle crumbs on top.  Bake 10 minutes at 400° or until fish are flaky.

name: VEGETABLE MEDLEY
ingredients:
1  pkg. California Blend vegetables
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. Cheddar cheese
1/3  c. sour cream
1 small  can French fried onions
preparation: Mix ingredients using 1/2 of cheese and 1/2 onion.  Put in a casserole dish.  Bake 25 minutes at 350°.  Add rest of onion and cheese.  Put back in oven another 5 minutes.

name: BACON RICE STUFFING
ingredients:
4  slices bacon
1  large onion, thinly sliced
4  ounces sliced mushrooms
1  1/2 cups uncooked long-cooking rice
1  cup chicken broth
2/3  cup dry white wine
2 1/2  tsp. sage
Salt and pepper to taste
1  egg, slightly beaten
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp.  Drain, reserving drippings.  Sauté onion and mushrooms in bacon drippings until onion is transparent, but now brown.  Add rice and cook until golden.  Stir in broth, wine and seasonings.  Mix well.  Simmer until rice is tender.  Add egg, mixing lightly.  Crumble in bacon.  Yield:  6 servings.

name: BLENDER PANCAKES OR WAFFLES
ingredients:
1  c. cream-style cottage cheese
6  eggs
1/2  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. oil
preparation: Put all ingredients in blender.  Blend on high one minute. Stop to stir once.

name: DEVILED EGG DIP(Makes 1 1/2 Cups)
ingredients:
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese (room temperature)
1  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. prepared horseradish
1  tsp. chopped chives
4  hard-cooked eggs, finely chopped
preparation: In a medium bowl, beat mayonnaise, cream cheese and milk until smooth.  Stir in mustard, salt, pepper, horseradish, chives and hard-cooked eggs.  Spoon into a small serving dish.  Serve with crackers or raw vegetables.

name: EASY STIR-FRY
ingredients:
2 to 3  Tbsp. cooking oil
1/4  c. chopped carrots
1/4  c. chopped mushrooms
1/4  c. pea pods
1/2  c. chopped boneless chicken or pork
2 to 3  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Add cooking oil to frypan over medium to medium-high heat. Add mushrooms and cook approximately 3 minutes.  Add carrots, pea pods and meat. Stir-fry approximately 5 minutes. Add soy sauce. Let simmer for 5 minutes. Eat as is or with prepared rice. Serves 2.

name: PINK LIMA BEANS
ingredients:
1 12  oz. bag large lima beans
6  to 8 hot sausage
1  onion chopped
preparation: Soak beans over night.	Put beans in large crock pot and cover with water.  Add onions and sausage.	Cook on low heat while at work.  You can also eat this over rice.	Great for winter time.

name: BLONDE FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. white sugar
pinch of salt
1/3  c. corn syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1/4  c. margarine
1  c. nuts (pecans or walnuts)
preparation: Combine everything except nuts in a 3-quart saucepan.  Place over medium heat.  Stir continuously as it sticks easily.  Cook until a firm ball forms in cold water.  Remove from heat and let cool for a few minutes.  Add nuts and beat until thick.  Pour into buttered 12 x 12-inch pan.   Cool and cut into squares.  Makes 2 pounds.

name: EASY CHOCOLATE-OATMEAL DROP COOKIES(Another Home Ec Favorite!)
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1/4  c. cocoa
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. quick cooking oats
preparation: Bring sugar, evaporated milk, cocoa and margarine to a boil in a saucepan.  Boil for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes.  Do not stir.  Remove from heat.  Add peanut butter, vanilla and oats.  Drop by small spoonfuls onto a greased pan or waxed paper.  Let cool and enjoy! (Easy no-bake recipe.)

name: SEVEN SEAS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. cream of celery or mushroom soup
1 1/3  c. water
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
pepper
1 1/3  c. Minute rice
1 1/2  c. cooked peas
1  (7 oz.) tuna, drained and flaked
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine soup, water, salt, onion and pepper; bring to boil, stirring occasionally.  Pour 1/2 of mixture into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Make three layers in casserole, using Minute rice (right from the box), peas and tuna.  Add remaining soup. Sprinkle with grated cheese.  Bake, covered, at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes, cutting through mixture with knife after baking 10 minutes.  If desired, garnish with strips of pimiento.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BAKED SWEET AND SOUR BRUSSELS SPROUTS
ingredients:
1  pt. fresh or 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen Brussels sprouts, cooked
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1/4  c. cider vinegar
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Arrange sprouts in shallow baking dish.  Combine oil, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper; blend well.  Pour over sprouts and sprinkle with cheese.  Cover and bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes or until sprouts are tender.  (If possible, marinate sprouts in vinegar 1/2 hour to 1 hour before baking.)

name: RICH VANILLA ICE CREAM
ingredients:
6  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  pt. whipping cream
1  qt. half and half
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Separate eggs; beat whites until stiff.  Add sugar, cream, half and half, vanilla, Eagle Brand and egg yolks.  Add enough milk to fill churn to fill line.  Churn according to directions. Makes 5 quarts.

name: NEVER FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. Crisco
1  egg, beaten
1/3  c. cold water
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix flour and salt.  Cut in shortening.  Combine remaining ingredients and stir into shortening mixture.  Let stand a few minutes.  Roll dough out onto a floured surface to desired thickness.  Yield:  4 (9-inch) pie shells or pastry for 2 double crust pies.

name: RAISIN SPICE BARS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. seedless raisins
1  c. cold water
1/2  c. margarine or butter
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In 2-quart saucepan combine sugar, raisins, water, margarine, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg and salt.  Bring to a boil and cook 3 minutes.  Cool.  Add remaining ingredients, blend well.  Spread evenly in greased 10 x 15-inch pan.  Sprinkle topping evenly over top.  Press down lightly.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
6  eggs
2  c. granulated sugar
1  bottle dark Karo syrup
1/2  stick margarine, melted
2  c. pecan pieces
preparation: Beat eggs; add melted margarine, sugar and syrup.  Mix well. Add pecans.  Pour into 2 pie shells.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

name: CREAMY SCRAMBLED EGGS
ingredients:
36  eggs
1 1/3  c. half and half cream
1/4  c. butter
2  c. medium thin white sauce or canned white sauce
preparation: Beat eggs lightly with cream, salt and pepper.  Melt butter in a very large frying pan, pour in egg mixture.  Cook slowly, stirring until almost set.  Fold in hot white sauce while eggs are still creamy.  Keep hot in very low oven (220°) or place over hot water on top of stove.  Sprinkle with chopped parsley if desired. Serves 24.

name: CHERRY PINEAPPLE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  can crushed pineapple
1  box yellow cake mix
2  sticks melted butter
2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix pie  filling  and  pineapple  in  bowl.  Pour  into buttered  baking  dish.  Drizzle  with  butter.  Sprinkle with pecans.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: WALNUT CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 1/3  lb. whole chicken breasts
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  tsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. chicken broth
1  tsp. each grated ginger root and sugar
1/2  tsp. each salt and crushed red pepper
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
2  medium green peppers, cut into 3/4 inch pieces
4  green onions, bias-sliced into 1 inch lengths
1  c. walnut halves
preparation: Skin, halve and bone chicken breasts.  Cut chicken into 1 inch pieces.  In a small bowl stir soy sauce into cornstarch; stir in chicken broth, ginger root, sugar, salt and red pepper.  Set aside. Preheat a wok over high heat; add cooking oil.  Stir-fry green peppers and green onions in hot oil for 2 minutes or until crisp-tender.  Remove from wok.  Add walnuts to wok; stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes or until just golden.  Remove from wok.  Add half of the chicken to the hot wok; stir-fry 2 minutes.  Remove from wok. Stir-fry remaining chicken 2 minutes.  Return all chicken to wok. Stir soy mixture into chicken.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.  Stir in vegetables and walnuts; cover and cook 1 minute more.  Serve chicken and vegetables at once with hot cooked rice. Garnish with whole red peppers and fresh cilantro, if desired.

name: RICE AND CHICKEN ALMONDINE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked rice
2 1/2  c. cooked chicken, diced
1/2  c. slivered almonds
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1/4  c. butter or chicken fat
6  Tbsp. flour
2  c. chicken bouillon
1  c. heavy cream
1  Tbsp. parsley
preparation: Saute almonds and onion in butter for 10 minutes.  Stir in flour.  Add bouillon and cream, stirring until thickened.  Add chicken and remaining ingredients.  Pour into casserole.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: STOVE TOP BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  pkg. hickory smoked bacon, diced
4 (16 oz.)  cans pork and beans
1/2  c. to 3/4 c. brown sugar, to your taste
1 rounded  tsp. of yellow mustard
1/4 to 1/3  c. favorite B.B.Q. sauce
1 heaping  tbsp. of minced dried onions
3 - 4  tbsp. bacon grease
preparation: Brown the diced bacon. Remove from grease and place into a pan containing the pork and beans. Add the brown sugar, yellow mustard B.B.Q. sauce, and dried onions. Mix well. Add 3 tbsp. bacon grease. Taste. You should be able to lightly taste the bacon, if not, add 1 more tbsp.   Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring often. When it begins to boil, cover and lower the heat. Let simmer at least 1 hour at lower temperature. Stir often. Turn off heat, remove lid and let stand for 10 minutes. Eat and enjoy.

name: SHAKE
ingredients:
1  c. chilled mandarin juice
1/4  c. powdered milk
1/2  tsp. honey
1  c. crushed ice
preparation: Combine all ingredients in blender and mix.

name: TASTY VEGIES
ingredients:
2  pkg. or bags California or Florentine mix vegies
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  tube Ritz crackers
1  stick margarine
preparation: Microwave bags 2 or 3 minutes per bag on High or just defrost. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch buttered dish.  Cut cheese into cubes and add to top.  Crush crackers and add to the top.  Pour melted margarine over all.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: APRICOT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. Wesson oil
2 junior  jars apricot with tapioca baby food or 3 small jars
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. chopped nuts (English or pecans)
preparation: Mix together sugar, eggs, oil and baby food.  Add flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and nuts; bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.  Make sure cake is completely cooled before frosting it.

name: SHERRIED SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3 (18 oz.)  cans sweet potatoes
1  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. shredded orange peel
2  c. orange juice
1/2  c. raisins
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/3  c. dry sherry
1/4  c. chopped walnuts
additional salt (to taste)
2  lb. yellow squash or zucchini, sliced
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (11 1/2 oz.)  can celery soup (undiluted)
1  c. dairy sour cream
1  c. shredded raw carrots
1/2  lb. butter or margarine, melted
8  oz. stuffing mix
preparation: Boil squash and onion in salted water for 5 minutes.  Drain. Mix soup, sour cream and carrots together and add to squash.  Stir butter and stuffing mix together until all butter is absorbed. Spread half of stuffing mix in greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.  Pour squash mixture over it.  Top with remaining stuffing. Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: TEXAS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. sugar
salt and pepper
8  oz. bow tie or other pasta
1  c. sour cream
4  oz. cream cheese
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion.  Drain grease.  Add tomato sauce, sugar and salt and pepper to taste.  Simmer 5 minutes.  Cook pasta according to package directions.  Mix sour cream and cream cheese together.

name: SAUSAGE SNACKS ITALIANO
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can Pillsbury quick crescent dinner rolls
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. oregano
8  Brown 'N Serve sausage links
preparation: Separate crescent dough into 4 rectangles; press perforations to seal.  Combine cheese and oregano; sprinkle over dough.  Cut each dough rectangle crosswise to form 2 squares.  Place a sausage link on each square; roll up.  Cut each roll into 3 to 4 pieces. Secure each with a toothpick.  Place cut side down on an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes until golden brown.  Refrigerate any leftovers.  Yield:  2 dozen appetizers.

name: SQUASH PUFFS
ingredients:
4  c. sliced squash
1  c. onion
1  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. milk
1  slightly beaten egg
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt (optional)
preparation: Cook squash, onion and green pepper until tender; drain well. Mix other ingredients.  Combine all ingredients and mix well. Drop into fryer by teaspoons and brown.

name: PISTACHIO PUDDING DESSERT
ingredients:
2  c. small marshmallows
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  can pineapple with juice
1  can mandarin oranges with juice
1  qt. Cool Whip
1 small  box instant pistachio pudding
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

name: VEGETABLE MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
2  tsp. oil
1  pkg. cooked and drained chopped spinach
1  c. grated carrots
1/4  c. cooked tomatoes or sauce
1/3  c. bread crumbs
1  egg
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Shape into loaf. Bake for 1 hour at 400°.

name: CINNAMON APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. red cinnamon candies (see tip)
1  c. boiling water
6  medium apples, peeled, cored and thinly sliced
1  pkg. Duncan Hines moist deluxe white cake mix
1  c. light brown sugar, firmly packed
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
frozen whipped topping, thawed
crushed red cinnamon candies
mint leaves for garnish
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Dissolve 1 tablespoon cinnamon candies in boiling water. Arrange apple slices in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Pour cinnamon flavored water over top. Combine cake mix, brown sugar and melted butter in a large bowl. Stir until thoroughly blended (mixture will be crumbly).  Sprinkle crumbs over apple slices. Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbly.  Serve with whipped topping, crushed cinnamon candies and mint leaves, if desired.

name: HOLIDAY HAM
ingredients:
8 to 10  lb. fully cooked ham
2  c. pineapple juice
2  c. Burgundy wine
1  box dark brown sugar
2  cinnamon sticks
12  whole cloves
1  c. raisins
preparation: Trim off most of rind from ham.  Place ham in Dutch oven.  Add 6 cups of water, 1 cup of pineapple juice, 1 cup of Burgundy wine, half the brown sugar and cinnamon sticks.  Bring to a boil. Gently simmer for about 20 minutes.  Cool.  Refrigerate in liquid, covered, overnight, turning once in liquid.

name: CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken
1  pie crust
2  c. cream of chicken soup
preparation: Cook chicken and debone.  Mix chicken and soup.  Pour into pie crust.  Bake until crust is brown at 350°.

name: CHURCH WINDOWS
ingredients:
12  oz. chocolate chips
1  stick butter
1  c. chopped pecans
1 large  pkg. colored marshmallows
preparation: Mix together the chocolate chips and butter.  Combine colored marshmallows and pecans in a bowl.  Pour chocolate over marshmallows and mix.  Pour mixture out on waxed paper; shape into a log.  Place in refrigerator until chilled.

name: PECAN SANDIES
ingredients:
2  c. plain flour
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all real good with a fork and make into little balls. Bake at 250° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Cool and roll in powdered sugar.

name: 6 MINUTE CARROTS
ingredients:
3  slender carrots
1  Tbsp. salad oil
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. ginger
1  Tbsp. water
preparation: Slice carrots at an angle, very thin, enough to measure 1 cup. Heat oil in skillet.  Add carrots and other ingredients; cover and lightly steam for 6 minutes, or until tender, stirring once or twice.  Makes 2 servings.  May have to add more water.

name: INNIE'S EGG NOG
ingredients:
6  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
1  pt. whipping cream
1  pt. half and half
preparation: Beat  yolks and whites of eggs separately.  Add 1/2 cup sugar to	yolks  while  beating.	Add 1/4 cup sugar to whites after they have been beaten very stiff.  Mix whites and yolks gently together.  Add whipping cream and half and half.  Stir thoroughly. Serve  very cold with dollop of whipped cream and sprinkle of nutmeg.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. diced, cooked chicken
2  c. diced celery
1/2  c. slivered, blanched almonds
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. grated onion
1/2  c. shredded, medium sharp yellow cheese
2/3  c. broken potato chips
preparation: Mix all ingredients except cheese and chips.  Turn into a shallow, buttered casserole dish.  Combine cheese and chips; spread over top.  Bake, uncovered, for 20 minutes at 375°.  Yields 6 servings.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  can pork and beans
1/2  onion, chopped
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
1/4  c. ketchup
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 heaping  tsp. mustard
1/2  c. pancake syrup
1/4  c. barbecue sauce
preparation: Brown a slice or two of bacon.  Slice up to give it flavor. Mix together and put on stove for 10 to 15 minutes on top of stove.

name: AUNT DENE'S BAKED LEMON PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs, separated
1/4  c. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. water
1  c. sugar
1  pie shell
preparation: Put yolks and 1/2 cup sugar in double boiler.  Mix well and add lemon juice.  Cook until thick.  Cool.  Beat egg whites until stiff.  Add 1/2 cup sugar.  Fold 1/2 of the egg white mixture into cooled filling.  Put in cooked pie shell.  Top with the other egg whites and brown lightly.

name: SHORTBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. unsalted butter, at room temperature
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  c. plus 1 Tbsp. sugar
3  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large mixing bowl, beat the butter with the vanilla until smooth.  Gradually add the sugar and beat for about 5 minutes until smooth.  Continue beating while adding the flour, about 1/4 cup at a time until completely incorporated. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 3 minutes until smooth balls form.

name: ITALIAN TOMATOES
ingredients:
1/3  c. salad oil
2  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. sugar
3  tomatoes, cut into wedges
1  green pepper, sliced
preparation: Combine oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, oregano and sugar.  Pour over tomatoes and peppers.  Let set to marinate 1/2 hour to 3 hours.  Serve chilled.  Yields 3 to 4 servings.  Can be served over spaghetti noodles.

name: TOMATO JELLY
ingredients:
tomatoes
sugar
preparation: Strain juice of tomatoes to remove the seeds.  Mix 1 part tomato juice with 1 part sugar.  Cook until desired consistency.

name: TOMATO SAUCE
ingredients:
1 large  can Italian-style tomatoes
1 medium  can tomato sauce
1/2  large pepper
1/3  c. parsley, chopped finely
1/3  c. olive oil
1  tsp. basil (may be more)
2  large crushed garlic (can add more)
1  Tbsp. fennel seed, ground, or whole seed crushed with mortar and pestle
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Put tomatoes and sauce in saucepan, adding chopped pepper and finely chopped parsley.  Add crushed garlic cloves, 1/3 fennel.  Sweeten with sugar (approximately 2 tablespoons, according to taste).  Add basil.  Simmer, uncovered, for one hour. Stir frequently.  Add sugar at last of cooking time.  Taste for possibly more basil or sugar.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  can Hormel chili without beans
shredded nacho cheese or Cheddar
preparation: Beat the cream cheese until softened.  Spread on bottom of microwavable casserole dish.  Spread can of chili on top of cream cheese.  Sprinkle shredded cheese on top.  Put in microwave on High for 10 minutes.  Serve hot with nacho chips.

name: AUNT JACQUE'S FAVORITE PUNCH
ingredients:
1  can Tropical Hawaiian Punch
1  liter Sprite or 7-Up
1/2  gal. orange or strawberry sherbet
preparation: Mix together in a punch bowl.

name: LEMON DROPS
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon cake mix
1  (4 oz.)  Cool Whip, thawed
1  egg
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Shape into balls and roll in powdered sugar.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. stew meat, cut into small pieces
6  potatoes, diced
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can green peas
1  can carrots
1  c. salsa
1 large  can V-8 juice
preparation: Brown meat in a large pot.  Add all the vegetables and V-8 juice.  Simmer until potatoes are tender.

name: PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  jar pizza sauce
1/2  c. chopped onion (optional)
1/2  c. chopped green pepper (optional)
1  large bag shredded pizza cheese
3/4 to 1  c. baking mix (Bisquick)
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Invent your own combination:  Start with 1 item from each group 1-4, then add other items as listed.

name: CAULIFLOWER AU GRATIN
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  to 2 garlic cloves, minced
4  oz. cooked ham, chopped
1  head cauliflower, broken into florets
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  c. whipping cream
1/4  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
pinch of cayenne pepper
1 1/2  c. (4 to 6 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese
2 to 3  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Melt butter in a large skillet. Sauté garlic and ham for 2 minutes. Add cauliflower and cook just until crisp-tender. Combine flour and cream; stir into skillet and blend well. Add salt, pepper and cayenne pepper. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly; cook and stir 1 minute more. Pour into a 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese.  Place under a preheated broiler until lightly browned, about 2 to 4 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve immediately. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

name: CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
2  c. cooked clams, drained
1  medium onion, chopped fine
3  slices crisp fried bacon, crumbled
2  to 4 medium potatoes, thinly sliced
2  c. boiling salted water
salt and pepper
3  c. milk or half and half
preparation: Fry bacon, then saute onions in 2 tablespoons bacon fat. Simmer potatoes in water until tender.  Add bacon, onion, salt and pepper to cooked potatoes.  Simmer 5 to 10 minutes.  Add milk and bring to boil.  Add clams and barely heat.  Serve with a dollop of butter and a pinch of thyme.  Top with parsley.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. oil
1/3  c. water
2  c. sugar
1 (29 oz.)  can pumpkin
3 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  c. raisins
preparation: Grease and flour three 1 pound coffee cans.  In a large bowl, beat eggs; add oil and water.  Stir in sugar and pumpkin.  Sift together flour, soda and seasonings and add to first mixture.  Mix well.  Add nuts and raisins.  Pour into prepared coffee cans.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Cool on rack at least 10 minutes before removing from cans.

name: OREO COOKIE DESSERT
ingredients:
15  oz. Oreo cookies, crushed
1/3  c. butter, melted
1/2  gal. ice cream
1 (6 oz.)  can Hershey's topping
9  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Crush cookies and mix with butter. Reserve 1/2 cup for top later. Spread crumbs over bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Slice ice cream and place over crumbs. Top with fudge topping, then put on Cool Whip. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top. Cover and freeze.

name: BIG MAC SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. Miracle Whip
1/2  c. creamy French dressing (orange colored)
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. dry minced onion
1/3  c. relish
preparation: Combine all ingredients; mix well.  Refrigerate well before serving.

name: CHOCOLATE AMARETTO TRIFLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Devil's food cake mix
1  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
1/2  c. Crisco vegetable oil
2/3  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
4  eggs
1/2  pt. sour cream
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate bits
3/4  c. Amaretto
3 (3 oz.)  pkg. dark chocolate pudding
5  c. milk
6  Tbsp. Amaretto
3  (10 oz.) whipped cream
6  Heath bars, chopped fine
preparation: Combine pudding, milk and Amaretto; stir until thick.  Cover with plastic wrap and chill.

name: BOW TIES
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
3  Tbsp. Crisco
3  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. milk
powdered sugar
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and Crisco.  Mix like you would for a pie crust.  Beat the egg, vanilla and milk together. Make a well with the flour.  Put the eggs, vanilla and milk; mix well.  Roll out the dough a little at a time and cut in strips. Make a slit in the middle and pull through like a bow tie.  Deep fry in oil and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: SHIRLEY'S RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  qt. whole milk
1  c. sugar
1  c. rice
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  egg
1/4  c. milk
cinnamon
preparation: Put first five ingredients into pot on low flame.  Stir frequently for two hours until thick.  Remove from heat.  Add egg that's been beaten with 1/4 cup milk.  Pour into serving dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon and refrigerate.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
powdered milk (8 qt. size)
box Nestles Quick
6  oz. Cremora or Coffee-mate
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.  Store in airtight container. When ready to drink, place as much as you desire in a mug and fill with hot water.

name: Hurry-Up Chicken(Yield: 6 Servings)
ingredients:
6  Skinless, boneless Chicken Breasts
6  Strips Uncooked Bacon
1  Can Campbell's Tomato Bisque Soup*
1  Pint Sour Cream
Paprika
preparation: 1. Wrap 1 strip bacon around each chicken breast half.

name: STRAWBERRY CREAM PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
3/4  c. sugar
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen pink lemonade concentrate, thawed
2 1/4  c. water
8 1/2  c. ginger ale
1  qt. strawberry ice cream
preparation: Combine pineapple juice, sugar, lemonade concentrate and water in punch bowl; mix well.  Stir in ginger ale.  Spoon in ice cream. Serve immediately.  Yields 40 (4 ounce) servings.

name: LO-CAL COFFEE LIQUEUR CHOCOLATE CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
6  crushed chocolate wafers
1  c. sugar
1  c. low-fat cottage cheese
1/4  c. unsweetened cocoa
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1 1/2  c. light cream cheese
1/4  c. flour
1/4  c. coffee liqueur or substitute your favorite liqueur
1  egg
2  Tbsp. semi-sweet chocolate mini morsels
preparation: Sprinkle wafer crumbs in the bottom of an 8-inch pan.  Set aside.  In a mixing bowl, blend all ingredients except the egg and mini morsels until smooth (blender preferred).  Add egg and mix until blended.  Fold in the chocolate morsels.  Pour the entire mixture over crumbs in the pan and bake at 300° for 45 minutes until the cake is set.  Let cool.  Cover and chill for several hours.  Transfer to a serving flat platter.  Garnish with mint sprigs, chocolate curls or strawberries.

name: OATMEAL PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
2/3  c. sugar
2/3  c. white Karo syrup
2/3  c. melted oleo
2/3  c. oatmeal
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix well.  Put in pie shell.  Sprinkle with nuts.  Bake 50 minutes.

name: ICE CREAM SNOWBALLS
ingredients:
1  qt. ice cream
1/2  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Shape ice cream into 6 balls.  Roll in coconut.  Place ice cream balls on tray covered with wax paper.  Freeze until firm. Serves 6.

name: SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. spaghetti
1  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
salt and pepper to taste
8  oz. tomato sauce
1/2  lb. cottage cheese
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. sour cream
1/3  c. green onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. green pepper, minced
preparation: Cook spaghetti to desired doneness and add melted butter. Brown meat, add tomato sauce, salt and pepper. Combine cottage cheese, cream cheese, sour cream, onion, and green pepper.  Spread 1/2 of the spaghetti in bottom of casserole dish.  Add 1/2 meat, then cheese mixture, remaining spaghetti and ending with remaining meat.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 - 3  oz. pkg. cherry jello
2  cups hot water
1  can cherry pie filling
1/2  cup chopped pecans
1 #2  can crushed pineapples
1 8  oz. pkg. cream cheese (soft)
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Let set 5 minutes.  Add cherry pie filling and pineapples.  Pour 1/2 of mixture into a 9 x 13 glass dish and let it congeal.  Cream the cheese (add a little milk if necessary to make smooth) spread over the congealed mixture.  Sprinkle nuts over the cheese.  Add other 1/2 of gelatin mixture and chill.  Let set overnight.

name: CREAMY STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cold milk
1  pkg. Jell-O vanilla instant pudding
2  c. Cool Whip, thawed
1  c. fresh strawberries, sliced
1  baked 9-inch pie shell, cooled
1  c. fresh whole strawberries
preparation: Pour  milk  into  bowl.  Add  pudding mix.  Slowly beat with rotary  beater  or	at  low speed of electric mixer until well blended  (1  to  2 minutes).  Blend in 1/2 cup Cool Whip. Fold  in sliced  strawberries.  Pour  into pie shell.  Chill. Top with remaining Cool Whip and garnish with whole berries.

name: PINEAPPLE PIZZA
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. French vanilla cake mix
1/2 (15 oz.)  can pineapple, drained
less than 1/4 c. sugar, sifted
liquid butter
1  Pillsbury pizza crust
preparation: Spread cake mix onto thoroughly buttered pizza crust.  Place sliced pineapple into mix evenly.  Sprinkle sifted sugar over pizza.  Cook at 300° for about 10 minutes.

name: HOT SPICED TEA
ingredients:
3/4  c. instant tea (dry)
2  c. Tang (dry)
1  pkg. lemonade Kool-Aid (dry)
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. mixed fruit Jell-O (dry)
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. allspice
preparation: I double spices.

name: CHEESE-GARLIC BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. baking mix
2/3  c. milk
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  c. melted margarine
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1 small  envelope Good Seasons Italian dressing or 1 envelope Hidden Valley Ranch
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Combine baking mix, milk, cheese and 1/4 teaspoon garlic in a mixer bowl.  Mix until soft dough forms.  Beat for 30 seconds.  Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheets.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.  Combine margarine and 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder in bowl.  Brush over warm biscuits.  Serve immediately.  Yields 10 to 12 servings.

name: OLD FASHIONED LEMONADE
ingredients:
2  c. granulated sugar
1  c. water
1  c. freshly squeezed lemon juice
preparation: Boil sugar and 1 cup water in small saucepan 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice. Cool, then pour into a jar and refrigerate.  To serve, stir 2 tablespoons syrup into 3/4 cup water.  Add ice.  Makes enough for 20 servings.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  c. chopped pecans
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1 small  can pineapple, well drained
1/8  chopped green pepper
1 1/2  tsp. seasoning salt
preparation: Add pineapple, half of pecans to cream cheese.  Add rest of ingredients.  Roll cheese ball in rest of pecans.  Wrap for storage.  I use a few more pecans.  You may want to chill cheese ball before rolling in the pecans.

name: CORNED BEEF SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. Jell-O (lemon Jell-O)
2  c. hot water
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. Miracle Whip
3  Tbsp. onion, finely chopped
6  Tbsp. green pepper, finely chopped
1 1/2  c. celery, finely chopped
1  can corned beef, shredded
preparation: Blend together the first 4 ingredients. While warm, add rest of  ingredients.  Put in oblong dish and refrigerate.

name: GRANDMA BENNETT'S NUT WAFER COOKIES(Born 1895 and Still Going)
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  c. melted shortening
3  large eggs, beaten well
1  tsp. cinnamon
5  c. flour
1  c. white sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream shortening with sugar.  Add eggs slowly, mixing thoroughly.  Add nuts and then dry ingredients.  Shape into 1 foot rolls (like shaping long thin meat loaf).  Put in icebox overnight.  When ready to bake, slice in 1/4-inch pieces.  Bake in a 375° oven for approximately 10 to 15 minutes or until brown on bottoms.  These will be very crunchy when cool.

name: GERMAN EGG NOODLES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
flour
chicken or beef broth
preparation: Beat eggs with salt.  Add enough flour to be able to knead dough.  Roll on floured board until very thin.  Dry and cut to desired width.  Cook in boiling broth with lid on pot for 20 minutes.  Be sure to have enough broth to cover noodles while cooking.  Serves 4.

name: PINK LADY SALAD
ingredients:
9  oz. carton Cool Whip
14  oz. can Eagle Brand milk
21  oz. cherry pie filling
8  oz. can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. coarsely chopped pecans (optional)
preparation: Mix and chill.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
1  medium onion (about 1/2 c.)
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. bell pepper
1/4  c. diced celery
1  bay leaf, crushed
1  tsp. parsley
1/8  tsp. cayenne red pepper
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste (use half)
2  c. water
1/4  c. flour
2  c. cleaned shrimp
3  c. hot cooked rice
preparation: Cook and stir onion in butter until onion is tender.  Stir in remaining ingredients except shrimp, rice, flour and water.  Cook until pepper and celery are tender.  Add flour, shrimp and last of all water.  Cook over low heat until shrimp are tender.  Serve over rice.

name: ORANGE-PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
4  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1 (10 oz.)  can mandarin oranges (including juice)
1/3 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding (no milk)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Cool Whip
2/3  can crushed pineapple (remaining)
preparation: Mix together cake mix, eggs, oil, oranges and 1/3 can pineapple.  Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan and bake according to package directions.  Cool.

name: HELLO DOLLIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate chips
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  c. coconut
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
3  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix melted butter with graham cracker crumbs.  Put crumbs in bottom of 9 x 11-inch pan.  Layer Eagle Brand milk, coconut and chocolate chips over crumbs.  Bake on 325° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: APPLE PIE FILLING
ingredients:
21  c. peeled apples
4 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. cornstarch
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in a large boiler and let come to a boil.  Cook 20 minutes, stirring constantly.  Have lids hot. Pack in cans and seal.

name: LAZY LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
6  oz. cottage cheese
2  c. sour cream
3 (6 oz.)  pkg. sliced Mozzarella cheese (12 slices)
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  c. water
1 (32 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
8  uncooked lasagna noodles
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.    Brown meat, stirring occasionally, to separate meat; drain.    Stir in spaghetti sauce.  Reduce heat to low; leave on low and set aside.  Combine cottage cheese and sour cream in medium bowl; blend well.

name: BEETS WITH ORANGE SAUCE
ingredients:
