3/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
3/4  c. orange juice
3  c. canned sliced beets
preparation: Mix salt, cornstarch and orange juice in a saucepan.  Cook mixture, stirring constantly, until it has thickened.  Add beets to the sauce and stir carefully.  Heat mixture through and serve. Makes 6 servings.

name: EASY BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
4  slices bacon
1/2  c. chopped onions
2 (1 lb.)  cans (4 c.) pork and beans with tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1 3/4 to 2  lb. baby beef ribs
preparation: For 4 servings you will need:

name: AMERICAN DREAM FROSTING
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
1  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. Crisco shortening
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
preparation: Cook flour and milk, beating until smooth, thick and stiff (I use whisk). Set aside to cool.  Beat remaining until fluffy, then mix in the flour mixture on slow until well mixed. Excellent on strawberry or chocolate cake.

name: TOP OF STOVE BISCUITS
ingredients:
3  c. self-rising flour
1 1/2  c. buttermilk or milk or water
1/2  c. shortening
preparation: Make hole in center of flour with knuckles.  Put shortening in the mix as in regular biscuits.  Then pinch off enough for size of biscuit.  Roll up in hand.  Place in slightly greased frying pan (on top of stove); continue with rest of dough.  Cook on low heat, covered with lid until lightly brown on bottom, then turn over to other side.  Let top side brown, uncover about 5 minutes before done.  Makes 6 to 8 biscuits.  Cooking time approximately 45 minutes.

name: CREAMY ONION COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1  c. onion, chopped
4  c. cabbage, finely shredded
1/2  c. green pepper, diced
3/4  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. vinegar
2  tsp. prepared mustard
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Toss onion, cabbage and green pepper together in a large bowl. Combine remaining ingredients separately.  Pour over vegetables. Toss well.  Chill 1 hour.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
15  c. popped popcorn
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/4  c. light corn syrup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix sugar, butter, syrup and salt in saucepan and heat until it bubbles.  Simmer 5 minutes longer.  Remove from heat; add baking soda until foamy, then add the popped popcorn.  Mix until the popped corn is coated, then divide into two 9 x 13-inch pans and bake for 1 hour at 200°.  Stir every 15 minutes.

name: SALMON CAKES
ingredients:
1/4  c. finely chopped red or green bell pepper
1/4  c. finely chopped onions
1/4  c. mayonnaise*
1  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
1/4  tsp. seasoned salt
cayenne (red) pepper
1  beaten egg
1  c. dry bread crumbs
2 (6 oz.)  cans skinless, boneless pink salmon
3  Tbsp. butter
preparation: In small mixing bowl, combine chopped peppers, onions, mayonnaise, lemon juice, seasoned salt and cayenne pepper. Taste and adjust seasonings to personal preference. Stir in egg, well drained salmon and 4 tablespoons of the bread crumbs. Divide and form mixture into 6 to 8 balls. Roll salmon balls in remaining bread crumbs; flatten into cakes (about 1/2-inch thick). Fry salmon cakes in melted butter in skillet over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side.

name: OLD FASHION EGG CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix eggs and milk and beat well.  Add sugar and vanilla.  Put in a deep pie pan and cook at 350° until done.

name: PEANUT BUTTER-BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/8  tsp. salt
2  large eggs, lightly beaten
3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  c. creamy peanut butter
12  oz. box vanilla wafers
6  medium bananas, sliced
8  oz. Cool Whip, thawed
1/2  c. unsalted roasted peanuts
preparation: A good many husbands are entirely spoiled by mismanagement in cooking, and some are tender and good.  Some women keep them too constantly in hot water, others freeze them and others keep them constantly in a pickle.

name: FAT-FREE FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. fat-free cream cheese
8  oz. marshmallow cream
apples, sliced
orange slices
banana slices
grapes, etc.
preparation: Combine cream cheese and marshmallow cream.  Stir about 30 strokes, or until mixed well.  Chill about 1 hour before serving. Dip fresh fruit into fruit dip.

name: COLORFUL RICE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, thawed
3  c. cooked rice
1 (4 oz.)  jar diced pimento, drained
6  green onions, chopped
4  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar
1/2  c. sliced stuffed olives
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/3  c. sweet pickle relish
1/2  c. mayo or salad dressing
lettuce leaves (optional)
cherry tomatoes (optional)
preparation: Combine first 9 ingredients and stir well.  Add mayo, tossing until well mixed.  Cover and chill thoroughly.  Serve on lettuce leaves and garnish with cherry tomatoes, if desired.  Yield:  8 servings.

name: SPICY CHICKEN AND PEPPERS
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken breasts, cut in strips
1 1/2  Tbsp. olive oil
4  Tbsp. Cajun spice
1  Tbsp. black pepper, freshly ground
1  Tbsp. chili powder
2  sweet red peppers, thinly sliced
1  large Vidalia onion, thinly sliced
2  cans stewed tomatoes
preparation: Saute chicken breasts in 1 tablespoon olive oil until no longer pink.  Remove from pan; set aside.  Add 1/2 tablespoon olive oil and spices; mix together.  Add red peppers and onion; saute until onion is transparent.  Add the chicken and stewed tomatoes; simmer for approximately 1 hour.  Serve on split kaiser rolls.

name: SPOONBURGERS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  medium onion, chopped
2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. Dr.  Pepper
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
dash of hot pepper sauce
hamburger buns, toasted
preparation: In a heavy skillet, brown meat over medium heat.  Add garlic, onion and salt.  Cook 5 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients except buns.  Simmer about 20 minutes or until thick.  Spoon onto toasted buns.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. macaroni
2 or 3  Tbsp. Miracle Whip dressing
2  hard-boiled eggs, cut up
1/4  c. green peppers
1/2  tsp. salt
Cheddar cheese, cubed
pimento (optional)
preparation: Cook macaroni until tender.  Mix with Miracle Whip dressing, eggs, green peppers, some pimento for color (optional), salt and Cheddar cheese cubes.

name: HOMEMADE HOMINY
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. lye
1  pt. cold water
1  gal. boiling water
2  qt. shelled corn (yellow or white)
preparation: Put lye in iron kettle.  Add one pint of cold water.  When lye is dissolved, add one gallon boiling water and stir thoroughly. Add shelled corn.  Bring to boiling point; boil 20 minutes, stirring constantly.  If mixture cooks down, add more boiling water.  When the husk is off corn, it is ready to wash.  Wash corn. Fill the kettle with cold water.  Wash 4 or 5 times.  Cover with cold water; bring to boil and cook 4 hours.  When done, you should have 7 quarts of hominy.

name: BLUEBERRY DESSERT PIZZA(Serves 12 Or More)
ingredients:
1  pkg. white or yellow cake mix
1 1/2  c. quick rolled cooking oats
1 2/  c. soft margarine
1  egg
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
21  oz. can blueberry pie filling
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. grease 12-inch pizza pan or 13 x 9-inch pan.  In large bowl, combine cake mix, 1 cup oats and 6 tablespoons margarine.  Mix at low speed until crumbly.  Reserve 1 cup crumbs for topping.  Add egg to remaining crumbs.  Press into pan and bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

name: CRUSH PUNCH
ingredients:
3 small  boxes lemon jello
9  c. hot water
4  c. cold water
ginger ale
4  c. sugar
2  (46 oz.) pineapple juice
2  c. real lemon juice
preparation: Mix  jello  and hot water together.  Chill for 2 hours. Mix the rest of the ingredients together and freeze in 4 equal parts. Remove  2  hours  before serving.  Pour 1 quart ginger ale over frozen punch before serving (1 quart ginger ale per 1 part punch).

name: PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
14  oz. pizza sauce
6  oz. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
1/2  c. Bisquick biscuit mix
1 1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain the grease.  Place in an 8 x 8-inch baking dish.  Pour pizza sauce over meat.  Top with Mozzarella cheese.  Mix biscuit mix, milk and eggs together; pour over top of meat.  Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can pineapple chunks
2  apples, cut up
1  can mandarin oranges
1  can fruit cocktail
1  c. mini marshmallows
1 small  box instant vanilla pudding
1/2  c. raisins
1/4  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. grapes (optional)
1/2  c. coconut (optional)
preparation: Drain oranges and fruit cocktail. Save juice from pineapple. Mix all other ingredients, except pudding.  Stir well; place in a bowl.  Mix dry pudding with pineapple juice.  Pour over fruit. Chill before serving.

name: CHOCOLATE OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
4  Tbsp. cocoa
2 1/2  c. uncooked oatmeal
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients and boil for 1 minute.  Remove from heat and combine remaining ingredients.  Spoon onto waxed paper.

name: VEGGIE BARS
ingredients:
2  cans crescent rolls
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. Ranch dressing (dry powder)
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. garlic powder
1 1/2  c. shredded cheese
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
seasoning salt (to taste)
3 to 4  c. fresh veggies
preparation: Lightly grease bottom of jelly roll pan and spread crescent rolls (about 1 1/2 cans).  Bake 15 to 20 minutes until brown. Flatten with a spoon as baking.  Mix cream cheese, dressings and seasonings and spread on cooled rolls.  Add veggies and press into mixture.  Add cheese and cut into squares.	Serve.

name: ALABAMA CORN BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 (17 oz.)  can creamed corn
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. Crisco oil
2  pkg. Martha White Cotton Pickin cornbread mix
preparation: Mix all together and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

name: ORANGE-DATE-CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. orange slice candy, cut up
1  pkg. dates, cut up
1  c. coconut
3  c. flour
2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. flour (put over dates, pecans and candy)
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Mix flour and baking soda.  Add flour mixture and buttermilk alternately. Add pecans, dates and orange slice mixture.   Add coconut.  Bake in tube pan at 300° for 1 hour or until firm.  Remove from pan and pour glaze over.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  slices bread
1  lb. sausage, cooked and drained
1  c. grated cheese
3  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Tear bread into pieces and put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cook sausage and drain.  Put over bread.  Put cheese over sausage.

name: KENTUCKY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. sifted self-rising flour
4  egg yolks
2  Tbsp. hot water
1 1/2  c. Wesson oil
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. crushed pineapple and juice
1  c. chopped nuts
4  egg whites
preparation: Mix sugar, flour, egg yolks, hot water, oil, cinnamon and nutmeg; beat well.  Fold in nuts and pineapple with juice.  Beat egg whites until stiff; add to mixture.  Bake in tube pan for 1 1/4 hours at 300°.

name: CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. hamburg
1  lb. bacon
1/2  c. ketchup
1  large onion, chopped
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. prepared mustard
4  tsp. cider vinegar
3/4  c. brown sugar
1 large  can baked beans
1  can chick beans, drained
1  can red kidney beans, drained
1  can green limas, drained
preparation: Fry bacon until crisp.  Remove, crumble and reserve.  Brown hamburg with bacon fat.  Add onion, ketchup, salt, mustard, vinegar, brown sugar and bacon. Simmer 5 minutes.  Mix beans together and add sauce. Bake in baking dish at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: NO STIR PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1 1/2 to 2  c. fresh, cut up peaches
preparation: Melt margarine in a 2 1/2 to 3-quart dish.  Mix flour, sugar and milk and pour mixture into center of melted butter; do not stir.  Add peaches that have been sweetened with another cup of sugar.  Do not stir.  Bake for 45 minutes or until golden brown at 350°.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1 large  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 large  can cherry pie filling
1 large  can crushed pineapple with juice
1 large  carton Cool Whip
chopped pecans (optional)
cherries, drained (optional)
preparation: Break up angel food cake in small pieces and place in a large deep bowl (punch bowl works well).  Next mix instant pudding according to package directions.  Pour pudding over cake.  Next, spread the cherry pie filling.  Seal with Cool Whip.  Sprinkle chopped pecans and decorate with drained red or green cherries, if desired.

name: GRILLED PORK TENDERLOIN
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Italian dressing
2  tsp. rosemary
2  (1 lb.) pork tenderloins
preparation: Mix salad dressing and rosemary in shallow bowl.  Add pork, coating well.  Marinate in refrigerator for 6 to 8 hours, then drain.  Grill over hot coals for 15 to 20 minutes or until done to taste.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. broccoli spears
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Cook  broccoli  10  to 12 minutes and drain well.  In a separate  bowl,  mix milk and soup until smooth.  Put broccoli in a  1  1/2-quart  baking  dish.  Pour  soup  over broccoli. Sprinkle  cheese  over  soup.  In small bowl, mix Bisquick and butter  until crumbly.  Sprinkle this over cheese layer.  Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
4  oz. macaroni, cooked
1/4  c. onion
1 1/4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  Tbsp. flour
2  c. cheese
preparation: Cook macaroni and onion until tender.  Stir in tablespoon of margarine and flour.  Cook on low heat and stir in milk.   Cook until bubbly and thick.  Add cheese and stir until melted.

name: BAKED POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. red potatoes, unpeeled and quartered
1  c. Miracle Whip
4  slices bacon, chopped and crisply cooked
2  boiled eggs, chopped
1/4  c. green onion, sliced
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Place potatoes in a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan sprayed with no-stick cooking spray.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes, stirring once.  Mix dressing in bowl.  Add potatoes and mix all together lightly.  Refrigerate.

name: 7-UP SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. lemon Jell-O
2  c. hot water
2  c. 7-Up
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 1/2  c. small marshmallows
2  large bananas, sliced
1  c. pineapple juice
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  egg
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.  Add 7-Up.  Drain pineapple and add to Jell-O mixture.  Add marshmallows and bananas.  Cool until firm.  Mix pineapple juice, sugar, flour and egg.  Cook until thick; add butter and spread on the Jell-O.

name: RHUBARB BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
2/3  c. oil
1  c. sour milk
1  tsp. baking soda
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1 1/3  c. chopped rhubarb
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients.  Add milk with baking soda.  Add flour and salt.  Fold in rhubarb and nuts.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until done in a 9 x 5-inch pan.

name: TEN LAYER MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
2  cans bean dip
1 (12 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  pkg. dry taco seasoning mix
1  can small cooked shrimp
1 small  can chopped black olives
3/4  c. mild or medium salsa
3/4  c. chopped green onion
1  c. chopped fresh tomatoes
1/2  lb. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. guacamole
preparation: In the bottom of a large platter, spread all of the bean dip. The next layer will be the sour cream. Top that layer with the guacamole.  Next sprinkle the taco seasoning mix.  On top of that, will be the shrimp layer. The black olives go on top of the shrimp.  Spoon the salsa over the olive layer.  Next make a layer using the chopped green onions.  On top of the green onions, you will make a layer of chopped tomatoes.  The last layer will be the shredded Cheddar cheese.  You may omit any layer that you personally do not care for.

name: LONG JOHN SILVER FISH BATTER
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  slightly beaten egg
1  c. ice water
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Have fish  dry on both sides.  Fry in deep fat at 400°. Can be  used  for  mushrooms,  cauliflower  or other deep fry foods.

name: CINNAMON SQUARE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
preparation: Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.  With pastry blender, cut in butter.  Mix milk and vanilla.  With fork, beat in egg.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  to 6 sweet potatoes
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1  stick butter
1  pkg. small marshmallows
2/3  c. sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. raisins
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cook, drain and mash potatoes.  Melt butter; add sugar and cinnamon.  Add slightly beaten eggs to milk.  Mix all ingredients well and bake in a greased casserole dish at 400° for 30 minutes. Top with marshmallows and put back in oven until melted.  Serve.

name: IRISH BREAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. margarine
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. raisins
1  Tbsp. caraway seed (optional)
preparation: Sift the flour and dry ingredients together.  Cream the shortening and sugar.  Add egg and sour cream.  Add to flour mixture.  Stir until just blended.  Fold in raisins and caraway seed.  Place in greased loaf pan.  Bake at 375° for about  50 minutes.  Rub a little butter over the top of the bread.  Happy St. Patrick's Day!

name: CHEESY BRUNCH PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. sour cream
8  oz. cooked crumbled bacon
1 1/2  c. (6 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
2  tsp. fresh parsley, chopped
1  deep dish pie crust
preparation: Beat eggs and sour cream until blended.  Stir in bacon, cheese and parsley.  Pour into unbaked crust.  Bake in preheated 375° oven on baking sheet for 45 to 50 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.  Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Serves 8 approximately.

name: FRESH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  stick butter
1 large  can peaches or fresh peaches
preparation: Mix first  4  ingredients.  Place peaches in 9 x 9-inch baking dish.  Melt  butter  and  pour  over peaches.  Pour the mixed ingredients  over the peaches.  Bake at 350° until done, about 1 hour or 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: HOMEMADE FACE PAINT I(Child-Approved)
ingredients:
1  tsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. water
1/2  tsp. cold cream
food coloring (variety of colors)
small yogurt container, clean and dry (one for each color paint)
small paintbrush
preparation: Face painting done in creative shapes and designs is a nice alternative to wearing a mask on Halloween night (masks can be very frightening to preschoolers and they obscure vision when a child is walking up and down steps or when crossing the street).  In addition to using face paint to complete a Halloween costume, kids will enjoy this recipe for birthday parties, staging a backyard play and for dress-up on a rainy day.

name: HOOTENANNY CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1  box instant vanilla pudding
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. salad oil
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. water
1  c. nuts
2  tsp. cinnamon
4  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Grease bottom of tube pan. Mix together cake mix, instant pudding, eggs, vanilla, salad oil, baking powder and water. Combine nuts, cinnamon and sugar in separate bowl.  Layer in pan as follows:  1/3 nut mixture, 1/2 batter, 1/3 nut mixture, remaining batter and remaining nut mixture. Bake at 350° until tested done.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. cream-style corn
1  c. whole kernel corn (undrained)
1  stick butter, melted
8  oz. sour cream
1  egg, beaten
1  pkg. Jiffy corn muffin mix
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. milk
salt
pepper
garlic powder
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until golden brown.

name: EASTER EGGS
ingredients:
1  lb. oleo
3  lb. peanut butter
3  lb. confectioners sugar
1  jar marshmallow cream
dipping chocolate
at least 1/2 cake paraffin wax
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients in large bowl with hands.  Shape into form of eggs.  Dip into dipping chocolate melted together with paraffin wax.  Keep hot while dipping eggs.  Cover eggs well with chocolate.  Put on wax paper to cool.  Makes about 40 eggs.

name: LEMON PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
2  egg whites, beaten stiff
1 1/2  tsp. lemon zest
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1/4  c. lemon juice
preparation: Sift together first 3 ingredients.  In separate bowl, beat egg whites.  To first mix, add lemon zest, egg yolks, milk and lemon juice.  Add egg whites.  Pour into 1-quart baking dish or 6 custard cups; place in cake pan with 1-inch of water.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.  Serve hot or cold with dollop of whipped cream.

name: MOP SAUCE FOR BARBECUE
ingredients:
1  lb. margarine
1  medium onion, chopped
1 1/2  c. vinegar
1  c. water
1/4  c. lemon juice
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook onion in margarine until clear.  Add other ingredients. Bring to a boil.  Mop onto meat while grilling.

name: ITALIAN TURNOVER
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti, cooked and drained
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. heavy cream
2  oz. hard salami, sliced thin
8  oz. Provolone cheese, sliced
preparation: Combine onion, garlic, salt, oregano, pepper and heavy cream. Add spaghetti and toss thoroughly.  Place 1/2 mixture in 10-inch frying pan.  Arrange salami on top, then 1/2 slices of Provolone. Top with remaining spaghetti mixture, then remaining cheese. Cover and cook over medium-low heat 25 to 30 minutes until bottom is a crusty golden brown.  Invert into serving plate.  Garnish with additional salami, pimento-stuffed olives and parsley as desired.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1/2  c. green pepper
1/2  c. onion
1 1/2  c. long grain rice, uncooked
1 1/2  c. water
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Brown sausage.  Layer in order as ingredients are listed.  Put sausage in after water, except for a small amount. Add the celery soup and chicken soup on top of sausage.  Put small amount of sausage on top.  Bake in a 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours.

name: TUNA FISH SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can tuna (canned in water)
2  diced, hard-cooked eggs
sugar substitute = to 1 tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. chopped unsweetened pickles
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Toss all ingredients together lightly.  Chill.  Makes 4 servings; 1 serving = 2 meats.

name: TOMATO FISH SWIRLS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  medium tomato, finely chopped
1  tsp. thyme leaves or 1/2 tsp. ground thyme
1  tsp. instant minced onion
1/2  tsp. each garlic powder and salt
1/8  tsp. ground black pepper
1/4  c. plain dry bread crumbs
4  fillets of sole or flounder (about 1 lb.)
preparation: In medium skillet, heat oil on medium-high.  Saute tomatoes and seasonings 2 minutes until saucy.  Stir in bread crumbs. Cook, stirring, 1 minute longer.  Spread filling evenly on fillets.  Roll up fillets; secure with toothpicks.  Place upright in greased baking dish.  Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork.  Sprinkle with thyme if desired.  Total Time:  30 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: SCRIPTURE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Judges 5:25 (butter)
2  c. Jeremiah 6:20 (sugar)
1  tsp. 1 Samuel 14:25 (honey)
6  Jeremiah 17:11 (eggs)
1/2  c. Judges 4:19 (milk)
4 1/2  c. 1 Kings 4:22 (flour)
2  tsp. Amos 4:5 (baking powder)
1  c. 1 Samuel 30:12 (raisins)
1  c. Nahum 3:12 (figs)
2 Chronicles to taste (1  tsp. cinnamon, 1/2 tsp. nutmeg and cloves)
preparation: Cream the butter, sugar and honey. Beat eggs until frothy. Add milk to eggs. Add this to creamed mixture. Beat thoroughly. Sift together flour, baking powder and spices.  Add to creamed mixture. Add chopped figs and raisins.  Bake in a 375° oven in tube pan for 30 minutes.  Cool, ice and serve.

name: BAKED CATFISH
ingredients:
1  dressed catfish (3 to 4 lb.)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  c. soft bread cubes (or corn bread)
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
broth (recipe follows)
1  Tbsp. pickle relish
1  small onion, finely chopped
1  egg, beaten
1/2  tsp. butter or margarine, melted
6  slices lean salt pork
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Wash catfish in cold water; pat dry with paper towels.  Rub cavity with salt and pepper.  Mix bread cubes, parsley, pickle relish, egg, salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.  Spoon lightly into cavity.  Close opening with skewers; lace with string.  Brush fish with butter.  Cut 3 slits in each side and place a slice of salt pork in each slit.  Place fish in greased shallow baking dish; bake uncovered, spooning broth over fish occasionally until fish flakes easily with fork (45 to 60 minutes).  Makes 6 servings.  Note:  Can substitute trout, bass or red snapper.

name: PASTRY PUFFS
ingredients:
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. margarine
1/2  c. sifted plain flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs
preparation: Bring water  to  boil  on  high  heat  in saucepan. Add butter; stir  until melted.  Turn heat down to low.  Add flour and salt;  stir  in vigorously.  Cook until mixture draws away from sides of  pan.  Remove  from heat and cool 1 minute;  add eggs, one at  a time and beat after each one until smooth.  On greased baking  sheet, drop by teaspoon 2-inches apart in 400° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: MAW PORTER'S MILD SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. tomatoes, drained
1  can tomato puree
1  can tomato paste
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. paprika
preparation: Saute onion in butter until soft.  Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 10 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
2/3  c. catsup
1/2  c. water
2/3  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
dry mustard
1  medium onion
pat of butter
dash of vinegar
some Worcestershire sauce
2  bay leaves
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and simmer.

name: Boston Baked Beans
ingredients:
1  lb. (2 c.) dried marrow, Great Northern or navy beans
2  qt. water
1  onion, chopped
1/4  lb. salt pork
3/4  c. Grandma's unsulphured molasses
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Rinse beans in cold water and drain.  Bring to a boil and boil for two minutes.  Remove from heat.  Cover loosely and let stand for 1 hour.  Return to heat and bring to a boil.

name: ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
10  oz. tortilla chips
1  lb. hamburger, cooked and drained
1  can milk enchilada sauce
2 (15 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
2  cans cream of chicken, broccoli or mushroom soup
Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix together the enchilada sauce, tomato sauce and soup.  Add hamburger.  Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Spread some sauce-hamburger mixture on bottom of pan.  Add tortilla chips.  Put rest of mixture on chips, making sure chips are coated well.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Cook at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Let stand 15 minutes.

name: SOUR CREAM CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising cornmeal
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. cooking oil
2/3  c. cream-style corn
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Mix first 4 ingredients well.  Fold in sour cream, mixing well.  Preheat skillet and pour in mixture and bake until a golden brown.  Let cool about 5 minutes before cutting to serve.

name: BAKED CARROTS
ingredients:
8  carrots
1/3  c. butter
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/3  tsp. cinnamon
1/3  c. boiling water
preparation: Scrape and pare carrots and place in casserole.  Cream butter, sugar, salt and cinnamon together.  Add water and blend well. Pour over carrots, cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: CHICKEN SOUFFLE
ingredients:
9  slices white bread, crust removed
4  c. diced, cooked chicken
1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
1/4  c. butter
1  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
1/2  c. mayonnaise
9  slices American cheese
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1 (2 oz.)  jar pimento
1  can each:  cream of mushroom and celery soup
2  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Line 9 x 13-inch buttered pan with bread; top with chicken. Add mushrooms, then water chestnuts, then cheese.   Combine eggs, milk and salt and pour over chicken, etc.  Mix soups, melted butter, mayonnaise and pimento and spread on top.  Refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Remove from oven and sprinkle crumbs on top.  Bake 15 minutes longer at 325°.

name: ONIONY DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. warm water
2  pkg. dry yeast
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. molasses
1  envelope onion soup mix
1  egg, well beaten
6  c. unsifted flour
6  Tbsp. melted shortening
preparation: Measure warm water into large bowl.  Sprinkle in yeast.  Stir to dissolve.  Add sugar, molasses and onion soup.  Add egg and 3 cups flour.  Beat well.  Add shortening and remaining flour.  Beat well.  On lightly floured board, knead bread until smooth.  Cover and let rise in warm place until double in bulk, about 45 minutes. Punch down.  Shape into rolls.  Cover; let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Brush tops lightly with melted butter.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: CRANBERRY-CREAM CHEESE FROSTIES
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can jellied cranberry sauce
2 to 3  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. mayo or salad dressing
1/4  c. powdered sugar
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  c. whipping cream, whipped
preparation: Crush cranberry sauce with fork.  Add lemon juice. Pour into paper cups or 1-quart refrigerator tray or 1-quart flat dish. Whip cream cheese.  Add the mayo, powdered sugar, walnuts and whipped cream.  Pour over the cranberry sauce and freeze. If in paper cups, split and peel off paper.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: RICE KRISPIE TREATS
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. margarine
1  pkg. marshmallows
6  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat.  Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted.  Add cereal.  Stir until well coated.  Spread evenly in a buttered 9 x 13 inch pan. Cut into squares when cool.

name: PEPPERONI SQUARES
ingredients:
2  pkg. crescent rolls
1/2  lb. sliced pepperoni
8  oz. Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Unroll 1 package of crescent rolls.  Put layer of pepperoni on top.  Put layer of cheese on top of pepperoni.   Top with remaining package of crescent rolls.  Cut into squares, pinching edges.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: TUNA MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
4  green onion tops
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. (4 oz.) elbow macaroni, cooked, drained, cooled
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can chunk white tuna, drained, flaked
1/4  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. grated carrot
preparation: Place oil, mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl.  Whisk until blended.  Gently stir in macaroni, tuna, celery, and carrot until well coated.  Mound in center of platter. If desired, garnish with slices of tomato and zucchini or cucumber around outer edge of platter.  Cover and chill before serving.

name: CINNAMON COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
2 3/4  c. sugar, divided
2  tsp. vanilla extract
4  eggs
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. sour cream (16 oz.)
2  Tbsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, cream the butter and 2 cups of sugar until fluffy.  Add vanilla.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Add alternately with sour cream, beating just enough after each addition to keep batter smooth.  Spoon 1/3 of batter into greased 10-inch tube pan.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  jars Old English cheese
1-inch square brick Blue cheese, crumbled
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. onion powder
crushed walnuts
parsley flakes
preparation: Mix first six ingredients and mold into ball.  Chill.  Roll in crushed walnuts and/or parsley flakes.  Makes 1 large ball or 2 small balls.

name: COWBOY BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
2  large onions
2  bell peppers
2 1/2  lb. hamburger meat
2  cans vegetable alphabet soup
2  cans whole kernel corn
2  cans Ranch Style beans
2  cans enchilada sauce
preparation: Saute onions and bell peppers.  Brown hamburger meat, add all other ingredients.  Simmer 1 hour.

name: CHEDDAR PUFFS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese
1  stick unsalted butter
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  egg, beaten
poppy seed, to sprinkle
preparation: Grate cheese and cut butter into bits.  Add all other ingredients and stir the mixture with a wooden spatula until it forms a ball.  Knead the dough lightly to distribute the fat evenly and reform it into a ball.  Dust with flour, then chill for 1 hour (wrapped in waxed paper).  Roll out between two sheets of waxed paper into 1/4 inch rectangle and cut out rounds with a 1-inch fluted cutter.  Arrange these 1 inch apart on baking sheets.  Brush with 1 large egg beaten with a pinch of salt.  Sprinkle rounds with poppy seed and bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes, until puffed and golden.  Let cool for 5 minutes, then transfer to rack to cool completely.

name: WON TON
ingredients:
1/2  lb. hamburger
1  bell pepper
1  onion, chopped fine
1  egg, beaten
4  Tbsp. soy sauce
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook all ingredients together.  Let cool, then put 1/2 teaspoon in won ton wrappers and deep fry.

name: LOUISIANA FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
10  oz. frozen strawberries or 1 pt. fresh strawberries
2 large  cans peach pie filling
2  cans mandarin oranges, drained
2  cans chunk pineapple, drained
4  bananas, sliced
preparation: Mix fruit.  Pour pie filling over mix and chill.  Will keep for 2 weeks.  Try cherry pie filling or strawberry pie filling and add sliced peaches.  Use as a salad, dessert or serve over ice cream.

name: STRAWBERRY CRUMBLES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. walnuts
1  c. oleo or butter
preparation: Cream oleo and add the brown sugar, flour and nuts.  Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 400° for 20 minutes.  When cool, crumble and pat back into the pan.  Save 2 tablespoons of crumbles for top.

name: BETTER THAN ANYTHING CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix (with pudding in mix)
1 large  can crushed pineapple with juice
1  box vanilla instant pudding
4  or 5 bananas
Cool Whip
coconut
crushed nuts (optional)
preparation: Make cake according to package directions.  Bring crushed pineapple to a boil.  When cake is done, poke holes in top of cake; pour pineapple over cake while still warm.  When cool, slice bananas over top of cake.  Make vanilla pudding according to package directions; spread over bananas.  Spread Cool Whip over pudding.  Sprinkle with coconut and crushed nuts.

name: GRANDMA LUTZ NOODLES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
4  eggs (1 whole egg and yolks of remaining 3)
1/2  eggshell milk (little more if needed)
salt (couple shakes)
pepper to your liking
about 1/8 tsp. baking powder
preparation: Break eggs in bowl and beat.  Add milk, salt (pepper if you like), baking powder and a little yellow food coloring.   Mix well.  Put flour in large bowl.  Pour egg mixture in middle of flour and mix with fork until sticks together to work by hand (like pizza or pie dough).

name: STICKY OVEN-FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 (32 oz.)  pkg. frozen fried chicken
1  pouch Campbell's onion and recipe mix
1/2  c. apricot or peach preserves
1/4  c. barbecue sauce
1/4  c. water
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Place frozen chicken in a single layer in a shallow baking dish for 20 minutes.  In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients.  Spoon over chicken pieces.  Continue baking for 15 to 20 minutes more.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: DATE BARS
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, melted
1/2  tsp. baking soda
8  oz. dates, cut
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
1  c. brown sugar
2  c. flour
2  c. oatmeal
preparation: Cook dates, sugar and water until thick (low temperature).  Add baking soda to melted butter.  Mix melted butter into mixture of brown sugar, flour and oatmeal.  Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.  Preheat pan to 325°.  Put 1/2 crumb mixture on bottom of pan; press down. Add date mixture.  Crumble rest of crumb mixture on top.  Cook for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. hot sausage
10  oz. grated cheese
3 1/2  c. Bisquick mix
preparation: Mix.  Roll into balls.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pt. sour cream
1  pkg. almonds
1/2  box Stove Top stuffing mix
3/4  stick margarine
1 1/2  c. chicken broth from cooked chicken
preparation: Boil chicken breasts until done and then tear chicken into cubes.  Put in dish.  Heat cream of celery and cream of mushroom soups, margarine, sour cream and chicken broth.  After heated, pour over cubed chicken.  Put stuffing mix and almonds on top.  Cover dish and cook in oven at 350° for 30 minutes.  Take off top of dish and brown.

name: HAMBURGER CORN PONE PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
1  stalk celery, chopped
1  small sweet pepper, chopped
2  c. tomatoes
1/4  tsp. each: oregano and marjoram
1  c. cornmeal mixture
8  oz. tomato sauce
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1  can kidney beans
preparation: Brown beef and onion.  Add celery, pepper, tomatoes, sauce, salt and herbs.  Add beans last.  Simmer for 20 minutes and pour into oblong baking pan.  Drizzle thin cornmeal mixture over top and bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.   A salad is all you need to add for a complete meal.

name: GERMAN APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. salad oil
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
2  tsp. apple pie spice
1/2  tsp. soda
4  c. chopped raw apples
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Beat the eggs until foamy.  Add the remaining ingredients, except apples and chopped nuts; mix.  Add the chopped raw apples and chopped nuts.

name: FUDGE PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/4  c. flour
1  stick butter, melted
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1  unbaked pie shell
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix all together and pour into pie shell; bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: FRUITY SALAD
ingredients:
1  honeydew melon
1  cantaloupe
1  bunch red grapes
1  jar raspberry or strawberry preserves
1  can or container whipped cream
preparation: Skin melon and cantaloupe.  Cut in half and scoop out insides. Chop melon and cantaloupe and place in a large bowl.  Pull grapes off stem and add to bowl; toss gently.  Add 3 to 4 tablespoons of preserves and toss until well mixed.  Serve in wine glasses topped with whipped cream.

name: SALMON LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. can Demings salmon
1/3  c. celery, chopped fine
1/3  c. onion, chopped fine
1  sprig parsley, chopped fine
1/2  c. fine bread crumbs
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. mayonnaise
pepper to taste
paprika
preparation: Drain and save liquid.  Flake salmon.  Combine bread crumbs and seasonings with liquid.  Mix thoroughly.  Pack into small greased loaf pan.  Sprinkle generously with paprika.  Bake 45 minutes in moderate oven (350°).  Makes 4 servings.

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
1  whole chicken or chicken breasts
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  whole onion (optional)
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
8  oz. pkg. vermicelli noodles
1  tsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. butter, cut up into mixture
preparation: Boil chicken about 45 minutes to an hour.  Remove from bone. Precook noodles.  Take at 9 x 11-inch casserole dish and butter it.  Mix all ingredients together, except cheese and paprika. Pour half of the mixture into the casserole dish.  Top with 1/2 cup grated cheese.  Then add other half of mixture.  Top with remaining cheese and paprika.  Bake at 350° for half an hour, covered.  Then bake half an hour, uncovered.

name: RUSSIAN TEA
ingredients:
8  to 9 lemons or 1 container frozen Minute Maid
8  to 9 oranges
1 small  can frozen orange juice
1 large  can pineapple juice
2  c. sugar
12  c. water
1  tsp. whole cloves
6  to 8 cinnamon sticks
3  family-size tea bags
preparation: Boil spices in 6 cups of water for 15 minutes.  Boil sugar, tea and other 6 cups of water.  Let steep for 20 minutes.  Squeeze lemons and oranges.  Mix everything together.  More water may be added, if needed.  Heat to serve.

name: BROCCOLI CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
10  oz. broccoli, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1 1/2  c. half and half or light cream
1  c. water
1  c. chicken broth (or vegetable)
2 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
4  Tbsp. butter
5  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: In a large saucepan, melt the butter over low heat.  Add the flour and mix well.  Then add the liquids.  Increase the heat to medium and allow to cook for a few minutes, stirring often to prevent sticking until it begins to thicken.  Add the broccoli, onion and garlic powder.  Allow to cook for an additional 15 minutes.  Add the cheese and cook for another 5 minutes.  You can garnish with additional grated cheese or croutons if you desire.

name: WAFFLES
ingredients:
4  eggs, separated
3  c. flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. melted butter
preparation: Beat egg whites until stiff.  Add them first before butter. Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into hot waffle iron.  Cook until light brown.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sliced zucchini
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  egg, beaten
3/4  c. milk
1  green pepper, diced
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. cracker crumbs
Parmesan cheese
catsup
preparation: Mix all ingredients except Parmesan cheese and catsup.  Pour into greased casserole; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese; dot with catsup.  Bake, uncovered, at 425° for 25 minutes.

name: GRANDMA OLSON'S GERMAN CHOCOLATE CAKE(Very Easy Cake to Make Plus Serves a Large Crowd)
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. plain flour
1/2  c. cocoa
2  eggs
1/2  c. corn oil
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Put all ingredients into large mixing bowl.  Boil 1 cup water; add 1 teaspoon baking soda.  Add to mixture, beating with a spoon until smooth.  Mixture will be very thin.  Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 325° for about 35 minutes; check for doneness with a toothpick.

name: MELLOW FUDGE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  sticks melted margarine
1/3  c. cocoa
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix melted butter and cocoa and set aside.  Beat eggs. Gradually add sugar and salt.  Fold flour into egg mixture.  Next fold in cocoa and butter mixture above, the vanilla and chopped pecans.  Bake in greased, floured, large, oblong cake pan at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Remove from oven and immediate cut large marshmallows in half and place, cut side down, on cake.  Return to oven (5 minutes) until melted.  Let cool.

name: HOLLIBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
12  oz. can frozen lemonade
12  oz. can frozen orange juice
10  c. water
1 1/2  c. grenadine syrup
2  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Mix and put in punch bowl.

name: SAUSAGE SOUFFLE
ingredients:
6  slices bread, cubed
2  c. milk
6  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. salt
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  lb. sausage, fried and drained
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Combine all ingredients; refrigerate overnight.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.  Start in a cold oven.

name: HOT FUDGE SAUCE(Microwave)
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. baking cocoa
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
2  tsp. oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
preparation: Mix cocoa, cornstarch, sugar and water and microwave on High for  1 1/2 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds.  Add oleo, vanilla and salt.  Microwave until thick, stirring occasionally.

name: SWEET PICKLED BEETS
ingredients:
85  small to medium beets
4  c. cider vinegar
4  c. beet juice
5  lb. sugar
preparation: Cut beet tops off, leaving 1-inch stem.  Leave on roots.  Wash beets.  Cover with water and boil until tender (like a potato). Pour out juice through strainer, saving 3 to 4 cups.  Rinse beets with cold water.  Clean skins and bottoms off.  Cut into pieces, preparing remaining ingredients and bring to boil.  Add beets and boil 1/2 hour.  Jar and seal.  Makes 12 pints.

name: CARROT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  carrots, sliced thin
2  medium onions, sliced thin
salt and pepper
1/2  stick butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Alternate carrots and onions in layers.  Put dots of butter on top. Cover and cook at 400° for 1 hour. Stir once after butter melts.

name: LIGHT ANGEL FOOD DESSERT
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1  pkg. vanilla pudding (sugar-free)
1  c. light Cool Whip
fresh strawberries
preparation: Slice angel food cake in half to make two layers.  Prepare pudding as directed on package.  Cool.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Spread pudding mixture on top of bottom layer.  Replace top layer.  Serve with more Cool Whip and fresh strawberries.

name: MAGNOLIA GRILL CREAM OF VIDALIA ONION SOUP(Serves 8)
ingredients:
4  oz. smoked country bacon, julienned
1/2  c. (1 stick) unsalted butter
3  lb. Vidalia onions, thinly sliced
8  slices garlic, peeled and left whole
2  c. dry white wine
1  qt. chicken stock (preferably homemade)
1  bay leaf
1  Tbsp. fresh thyme
1  c. evaporated milk
1  c. sour cream
2  c. croutons
1  bunch chives, snipped
salt to taste
freshly ground pepper to taste
hot pepper sauce to taste
nutmeg to taste
1  c. table wine
preparation: Bake bacon until crisp; remove to paper toweling.  Add butter, onions and garlic to bacon.  Cover; cook over low heat, stirring often, until onions are translucent and lightly caramelized.  Add wine, stock, bay leaf and thyme.  Bring to a boil; simmer for 30 minutes.  Remove bay leaf and puree soup in food processor or blender.  Pass soup through fine blade of food mill (optional). Chill.  Whisk in cream or creme fraiche or sour cream.  Season with salt, pepper, hot pepper sauce and nutmeg.  Serve in chilled bowls. Garnish with bacon, croutons and chives.

name: QUICK BUTTERSCOTCH SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. (2 c.)  Nestle Toll House butterscotch flavored morsels
2/3  c. whipping cream
preparation: In small heavy gauge saucepan, combine butterscotch morsels and cream.  Cook over low heat, stirring, until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth.  Serve warm over ice cream.  Makes 1 1/2 cups.

name: SPREAD APPLE PIE
ingredients:
6  apples, peeled and cut up
2  c. water
1  c. sugar or more if apples are sour
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Cook until apples are done, but not dry.  If you have to, add water.  Take leftover homemade biscuits and slice in halves.  Put layer of biscuits and layer of apple mixture.  Repeat layer, ending with apples on top.  Make as many layers as you have apples and biscuits.

name: MODELING DOUGH(Kid's Sake)
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. salt
1  tsp. alum
food coloring
1  c. water
1  Tbsp. salad oil
preparation: Mix together in a saucepan flour, salt and alum.  Boil water and salad oil in another pan.  Pour over dry mixture.   Mix well. Knead when cool.  Add choice of food colors.  Store in tight container.  This is fun stuff.  Try it with the kids.

name: CANDY BAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg yolk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. maple flavoring
2  c. flour
Hershey chocolate candy bar
preparation: Cream oleo and sugar.  Add egg yolk and cream well.  Add flour, a little at a time.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

name: SEVEN COURSE DINNER
ingredients:
3  medium potatoes, peeled and sliced
3  medium carrots, peeled and sliced
1/8  c. uncooked rice
1  lb. lean hamburger, browned with 1 chopped onion
1  qt. chopped tomatoes
buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Layer ingredients in order given in buttered casserole, adding salt, pepper and rice each time.  Sprinkle with crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

name: HOT CHEESE CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour, sifted
1  c. yellow cornmeal
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. sharp cheese, shredded
1  c. milk
1  egg
1/4  c. shortening
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Sift together flour, cornmeal, sugar, salt and baking powder.  Add cheese, milk, egg and shortening. Beat with rotary beater about 1 minute or until smooth.  Pour into greased 8-inch square pan.  Bake 30 minutes.  Cut into squares and serve while hot.

name: GOURMET MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  c. onion, finely chopped
1  Tbsp. garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2/3  c. ketchup
1 1/2   lb. ground chuck
3/4  lb. ground pork
1  c. bread crumbs
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Pre-heat oven to 350°.  In a skillet, cook onions and garlic in butter.  Add salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce, and 1/3 c. ketchup.  Cook for 2 - 3 minutes until onions are tender.  In a large bowl, combine meats, bread crumbs, and eggs.  Add onion mixture and mix.  Pat into a baking dish.  Spread remaining 1/3 ketchup over the top and bake for 1 hour.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. packed brown sugar
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. margarine
3  eggs
2 1/3  c. flour
1 1/2  c. canned pumpkin
1/2  c. water
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
2  c. (12 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: In a mixing bowl, cream sugars, butter and eggs.  Add flour, pumpkin, water, baking soda, cinnamon, salt and cloves.  Mix thoroughly.  Fold in chocolate chips.  Pour into four greased and floured 6 x 3 x 2-inch loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bread tests done.  Yields 4 mini loaves.

name: CINCO DE MAYO BEAN DIP
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can refried beans
1  c. medium chunky salsa
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2/3  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1/4  c. chopped green onions
1 1/2  Tbsp. minced cilantro
1/4  tsp. each: garlic powder and salt
tortilla chips
preparation: In a large saucepan, combine all ingredients, except chips. Heat until cheeses are melted and beans are bubbling.  Serve with tortilla chips.  Makes 3 cups dip.

name: ADVENT COOKIES(Adventski Kolacoco, Croation)
ingredients:
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. sugar
3  whole eggs
grated lemon rind
1 3/4  c. sifted flour
1  handful coarsely cut walnuts
preparation: Beat the sugar, eggs and lemon rind together for 15 minutes until light and fluffy.  Add flour and walnuts.  Mix.  Drop by spoonful on a well-greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° until done.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
2  cans tomato paste
2  cans whole tomatoes
2  cans stewed tomatoes
2  cans tomato soup
1  can mushrooms
1  chopped onion
2  lb. hamburger meat
preparation: Brown hamburger meat and drain.  Add all ingredients together in large boiler.  Can double recipe.  Cook on low heat 1 1/2 hours or until done.  Continually Stir.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
2  c. cornmeal
1  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
6  Tbsp. chopped onion
1 1/2 to 2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix dry ingredients together.  Add onion, then buttermilk and egg.  Mix well.  Drop by spoonful in deep, hot cooking oil. Brown, turning to make sure they are brown all over.  Drain on paper towels.

name: CHEDDAR BAKED POTATO SLICES
ingredients:
1  can Campbell's cream of mushroom soup (10 3/4 oz.)
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. pepper
4  medium baking potatoes, cut into 1/4-inch slices (about 4 c.)
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In small bowl, combine soup, paprika and pepper.  In greased 2-quart oblong baking dish, arrange potatoes in overlapping rows. Sprinkle with cheese; spoon soup mixture over cheese.  Cover with foil; bake at 400° for 45 minutes.   Uncover and continue baking for 10 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender.  Makes 6 servings.

name: BROCCOLI HAM AND CHEESE RING
ingredients:
1  pkg. crescent rolls
1  Tbsp. parsley
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. mustard
2  Tbsp. sour cream
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  c. broccoli, chopped
1  c. ham (1/4 lb.)
1 1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Mix mustard, lemon juice and sour cream in a bowl.  Add chopped onion, parsley, ham and broccoli.  Add grated cheese. Arrange the crescent rolls in a circle with points out like a star and the center overlapping.  Place mixture in center and fold the ends of the rolls into the middle.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

name: FISH BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. haddock fillets
1/2  lb. scallops
1  can frozen shrimp soup
1/3  c. milk
preparation: Cook haddock and scallops.  Heat 1/3 cup milk and add the shrimp soup.  Pour over fish and bake 350° oven as casserole.

name: LEMON BARS(Goofy Bars)
ingredients:
1  yellow or lemon cake mix
1  stick margarine, melted
2 1/2  c. powdered sugar
2  eggs
8  oz. cream cheese
nuts
preparation: Mix cake mix and melted margarine.  Pat into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  In mixer, mix powdered sugar, eggs and cream cheese. Beat well and pour over crust in pan.  Put nuts on top.  Bake 45 minutes at 300° or until mixture is light brown in color.

name: NINA'S FLUFFY RICE
ingredients:
1  c. long grain rice
2  c. water
Salt to taste
preparation: Place all ingredients in microwavable dish with tight fitting lid and place in microwave.  Cook on high power for 5 minutes.  Do not open container.  Then cook on 50 per cent power for 10 minutes.  Allow to set 5 minutes without opening.  Open, fluff, and serve.	Microwaves vary, so times may vary slightly.

name: PINEAPPLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1  can crushed pineapple with juice
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. coconut
preparation: Mix shortening, sugar and eggs.  Stir in pineapple.  Measure flour by dipping or sifting.  Stir together flour, baking soda and salt.  Blend in nuts and coconut.  Chill at least 1 hour.  Bake at 350°.

name: LEMON SHERBET
ingredients:
juice of 6 lemons
3  c. sugar
2  lemons, sliced paper thin
milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except milk.  Let stand several hours. Stir often to dissolve sugar.  Add milk and pour into ice cream churn/freezer.  Freeze until firm.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cherry jello
2  c. boiling water (can use pineapple juice)
1  can whole cranberry sauce
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. orange juice
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Serves 10 to 12 people.

name: CORN PUFF
ingredients:
2  c. corn, cooked and cut from cob
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients together, combining well.  Bake in greased casserole dish in 375° oven for 45 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: ZUCCHINI RAISIN COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  egg
1  c. shredded, peeled zucchini
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. raisins
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar together.  Add egg, beat well.  Add zucchini and set aside.  Combine all dry ingredients and add to zucchini mixture.  Stir thoroughly, then add raisins.  Drop rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.  Yield:  3 dozen.

name: EGGPLANT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  large eggplant
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  large onion
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Peel eggplant and cut into slices.  Boil in salt water until tender; drain and mash.  Chop onion and saute in margarine. Combine other ingredients and top casserole with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BRAISED PORK CHOPS AND APPLES
ingredients:
4  to 6 pork chops (about 3/4 to 1 inch thick)
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. chicken broth or dry white wine
1/2  tsp. dried thyme, crushed
4  Rome Beauty apples or other cooking apples, cored and sliced
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Brown pork chops in oil on both sides until golden brown in a large skillet.  Pour off fat.  Sprinkle chops with salt and pepper.  Add broth and thyme; reduce heat to low.  Cover and simmer for 50 minutes, spooning pan liquid over chops occasionally.  Add apples.  Cover and cook 5 to 10 minutes longer or until done.  Garnish with parsley, if desired.  Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: BETH'S CHEESY CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  to 8 pieces chicken breast (boneless and skinless)
season salt to taste
1  medium onion, sliced
1/2  c. cooking white wine
2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Day 1: Wash and place the chicken in a 9 x 13 glass baking dish. Add season salt and onion slices. Cover with foil and place in fridge overnight.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP DATE TORTE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sifted flour
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped dates
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. chopped nuts (if desired)
1  c. boiling water
1  tsp. soda
1/2  c. oleo
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
16  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Sift flour, cocoa and salt.  Mix dates, boiling water and soda.  Cool.  Cream oleo; add sugar and beaten eggs.  Add flour mixture alternately with date mixture.  Blend well.  Add vanilla. Put mixture in a large 9 x 13-inch loaf pan, greased.  Sprinkle top with chips and nuts.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BEEF OR PORK BARBECUE
ingredients:
beef or pork
2  medium onions (optional)
1  chopped pepper
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  c. ketchup
1 1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. horseradish
preparation: Boil 5 minutes.  Simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  Serve on hot dog or hamburger bun.

name: POTATO CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. butter
1  c. sugar
3 1/2  c. plain flour
1  c. crushed potato chips
chopped nuts (about 1/2 c. or to taste)
confectioners sugar
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in the chips and flour, then mix in the nuts.  Roll by heaping teaspoonfuls into small balls. Bake about 10 minutes at 350° until lightly browned around the edges.  Roll in confectioners sugar while warm.  Makes about 5 dozen.

name: SPANISH BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
2  cans Garcia's garbanzo beans
2  or 3 smoked sausages, sliced thin
2  large onions, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1  can tomatoes
1  or 2 chopped potatoes
1 or 2  pkg. yellow rice
food coloring
preparation: Saute sausages, onions and pepper.  Add other ingredients. Season with garlic powder, salt and pepper to taste.  Add 1 bean can of water.  Cook about 30 minutes.  (Use Garcia's bean soup if can't find the beans.)

name: CROCK-POT STEW
ingredients:
stew meat
carrots
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  can water
garlic (to taste)
onion (cook with meat)
3  cloves
1  bay leaf
1  can stewed tomatoes
1  tsp. sugar
potatoes
preparation: Brown meat with onions in a skillet.  Place in crock-pot (low) with all other ingredients except potatoes.  Cook 3 hours (up to 6 hours on low).  Add potatoes approximately 45 minutes prior to being served.  To thicken, add a little flour and water (in a shaker mix) to mixture.  The longer you can let simmer, the better. (Don't forget the corn bread!)

name: BLUEBERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
2 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. butter
3  c. blueberries
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except blueberries.  Pour batter into 13 x 9-inch pan.  Sprinkle blueberries on top; bake at 350° until brown.

name: CRAWFISH DIP
ingredients:
2  c. boiled crawfish tails
1/2  pt. sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. celery, minced
1/2  c. minced onions
salt and pepper to taste
juice of 1 lemon
preparation: Combine sour cream with cream cheese.  Add celery, onion, salt, pepper and lemon juice to taste.  Mince crawfish tails and add to the cheese mixture.  Sprinkle with paprika and serve.

name: SALMON AND SHRIMP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can salmon
1  (4 1/2 oz.) baby shrimp
1  can mushroom soup
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
2  c. mashed potatoes
1  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Drain  and  flake  salmon  into  large  pieces.  Put in shallow  baking  dish.  Add  drained shrimp and mushroom soup. Melt  margarine;  stir  in  flour.  Add milk, salt and pepper. Cook  until  thickened.  Pour  over  fish  and  mushroom soup. Spoon mashed potatoes around edge of casserole.  Sprinkle with chili  powder.  Bake  in  hot 425° oven for 20 minutes.  Makes six servings.

name: SOUR CREAM BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg, beaten
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. molasses
1 1/2  c. raisins
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. bran cereal
preparation: Cream oleo; gradually add sugar, beating well.  Add eggs, sour cream and molasses.  Mix well.  Stir in raisins.  Combine flour, baking soda and salt.  Add to mixture.  Add bran, stirring just until moist.  Spoon into baking cups or greased muffin tins.  Fill 3/4 full.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.  Very good!

name: FOUR WAY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/4  c. brown sugar, packed firmly
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  stick melted oleo
preparation: Mix in a 9 x 11-inch Pyrex dish all ingredients.   Press evenly in bottom of dish and brown at 350° for 15 minutes.  Cool.

name: LEMONADE PIE
ingredients:
1 small  can frozen lemonade
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  ready made graham cracker pie crust
preparation: Blend first three ingredients and pour into crust. Chill before serving.

name: CHEESE STICKS
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen puff pastry (Pepperidge Farm)
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Remove frozen pastry from the package; allow to thaw at room temperature for 20 minutes.  Preheat oven to 400°.  Slice pastry into 1/2-inch wide x 4 1/2-inches long strips.  Brush with beaten egg.  Place pastry strips on ungreased cookie sheet.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Twist each strip twice.  Bake for 10 minutes.

name: HOT ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise (can use light mayo)
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1  can artichoke hearts, cut up
1 small  can mushrooms, chopped
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Combine all ingredients; heat at 350° for 15 minutes.  Serve warm with a mild cracker for dipping.

name: CARAMELS
ingredients:
1  lb. or 2 c. light brown sugar
1/2  lb. butter (not margarine)
pinch of cream of tartar
1  c. light Karo syrup
1  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Mix all together and cook over low heat for 20 minutes.  Stir all the time.  Take off of stove and add 1 cup of pecans that have been cut up.  Pour contents into a well-greased pan.  Let cool and cut into squares and wrap in wax paper.

name: HAM AND CHEESE SPECIAL
ingredients:
1  doz. hamburger buns
12  slices boiled ham
12  slices Swiss cheese
1  stick margarine
2  Tbsp. grated onion
2  Tbsp. mustard
1 to 2  Tbsp. salad dressing
preparation: Split sandwich	buns  in  half.  Heat margarine, grated onion, mustard  and salad dressing in saucepan.  Spread dressing on buns. Place  slice  of  ham  and Swiss cheese in buns. Wrap in aluminum foil.  Heat in a 350° oven for 20 minutes.

name: CHILDREN'S FAVORITE COLESLAW
ingredients:
1  medium cabbage, chopped fine
2  red apples, cored and chunked
1/4  c. walnuts, chopped
1/2  c. raisins, soaked
mayonnaise
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Soak raisins in 1/4 cup water for about 10 minutes.  Drain raisins.  Add cabbage, apples and walnuts.  Spoon in 3 to 4 tablespoons mayonnaise and mix.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Adjust the amount of mayonnaise as needed.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  whole chicken breasts, cooked
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  jar salsa
1  can chopped chillies, drained
12  corn tortillas
1 small  can evaporated milk
1  large onion, chopped
1  lb. shredded cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix soup, onion, chillies evaporated milk and salsa.  Cut tortillas in squares.  Put one layer of tortillas, one layer chicken then part of the sauce.  Repeat layers until all is used and you have ended with sauce on top.  Spread cheese on top and bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees.  This recipe can be made a day or two ahead and then baked if kept refrigerated.

name: BUTTERMILK CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  egg
1  tsp. soda
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/2  Tbsp. cocoa
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake in two 8-inch pans at 350°.

name: EASY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. margarine
1  lb. powdered sugar
6  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. yellow food coloring
3 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Cream margarine and powdered sugar well.  Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Add vanilla and food coloring.  Add flour, stirring in a little at a time.  Bake 1 hour in 350° oven.

name: LO-CAL BREAKFAST BAR
ingredients:
2 2/3  c. dry milk
2  c. applesauce
2 2/3  c. oatmeal, uncooked
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. raisins
4  Tbsp. peanut butter (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients, but peanut butter.  Pour in a 9 x 13-inch sprayed dish.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Cool.  Spread with peanut butter, if desired.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. flour (if needed)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Roll out into small balls. Place on cookie sheet and flatten with fork.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Cool about 10 minutes.  Enjoy!

name: PEACH BLUEBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  pie crust
4  c. sliced fresh peaches
2  c. blueberries
2/3 to 3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. mace
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. grated lemon peel
2  tsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Prepare pie crust.  Combine peaches and blueberries.  Combine sugar, flour, cinnamon, mace, salt, lemon peel and juice; add to fruits.  Toss with fork and pour into pie pan, heaping slightly in center.  Dot with margarine.  Cut 10 strips about 11 inches long and 1/2 inch wide.  Arrange lattice fashion over fruit.  Trim and flute edges.  Bake at 425° for 45 minutes.

name: WHOOPIE PIE FILLING
ingredients:
3/4  c. confectioners sugar
3/4  c. Crisco
1  tsp. vanilla
6  Tbsp. marshmallow fluff
preparation: Mix all together until fluffy.

name: HOT DISH
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. catsup
1  can biscuits
preparation: Brown hamburger; drain.  Place rest of ingredients, except biscuits, with hamburger.  Pour in baking dish.  Heat in 350° oven until cheese melts.  Place biscuits on top and bake until biscuits are done, about 20 minutes.

name: SALMON LOAF
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can (2 c.) salmon
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
2  c. soft bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. grated onion
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. salt
few grains of pepper
preparation: Mix salmon, milk and crumbs; add beaten eggs.  Add onion, parsley, lemon juice, salt and pepper.  Pack in greased loaf pan; bake in moderately hot oven (375°) for 40 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: PINK CLOUD PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  (3 oz.) red jello or any flavor you wish
1  lb. container cottage cheese
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. Cool Whip
preparation: First, drain pineapple.  Add jello.  Mix, then add cottage cheese and Cool Whip.  Place in large bowl and refrigerate. Salad will keep well for about 1 week.

name: STIR-FRIED VEGETABLES WITH CURRY
ingredients:
1 1/2  tsp. vegetable oil
2  cloves garlic, minced
7  c. coarsely shredded cabbage
1  c. sliced celery
1/3  c. chopped green onions
2  c. fresh bean sprouts
1  Tbsp. reduced-sodium soy sauce
1  tsp. curry powder
1/4  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Add oil to heavy skillet or wok and heat to medium-high for 1 minute.  Add garlic; stir-fry 1 minute.  Add cabbage, celery and green onions.  Stir-fry 3 minutes or until crisp-tender.  Add remaining ingredients; stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. Crisco oil
2  c. grated zucchini (unpeeled), coarsely grated
2  tsp. vanilla flavoring
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. chopped pecans
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Beat eggs; add oil, sugar, zucchini, nuts and vanilla.  Mix lightly, but well.  Add flour, salt, baking powder, soda and cinnamon which have been sifted together.  Mix until well blended. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Makes 2 loaves.

name: MOMO'S PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. Karo syrup
4  eggs
pinch of salt
4  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Mix together all ingredients and pour into uncooked shell. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until done.

name: BAKED BREAKFAST
ingredients:
6  eggs
1  c. milk
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. cubed ham
3  slices bread, torn in pieces
preparation: Beat milk, salt and mustard.  Add bread, cheese, ham; mix.  Put in well-greased 9 1/2 x 13 inch glass baking dish.  Dot with butter.  Cover with foil.  Must refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serves 8.

name: ORANGE CHOPS AND RICE TANGO
ingredients:
4  to 6 pork chops
3  envelopes chicken broth
1/4  tsp. each:  pepper and ginger
1/4  c. catsup
2  tsp. dry mustard
1  medium onion
2  c. water
1  c. orange juice
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Season chops with one envelope of chicken broth, black pepper and ginger.  Brown chops; drain excess fat.  Stir in onion and saute.  Stir in remaining ingredients; bring to a boil.  Stir in 1 cup rice; place chops on top.  Cover, lower heat and simmer 30 minutes.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: EASY LOW-FAT PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  half cut pork chops
1  can fat-free sweet and sour sauce
dash of salt
pepper to taste
preparation: Foil line a 9 x 13 pan or baking dish. Place chops flat and pour the sauce evenly over meat, adding enough water to cover, if necessary. Bake at 400° about 1 hour, until tender. If you like, you may brown by turning on broiler for about 5 minutes.

name: Chocolate Chip Cheese Squares
ingredients:
2 (20 oz.)  pkg. Pillsbury refrigerated chocolate chip cookie dough
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
preparation: Grease bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan and place 1 package chocolate chip cookie dough in pan evenly.  Mix together your cream cheese, vanilla, sugar and eggs until well blended.  Pour cream cheese mixture over cookie dough in pan.  Take second package of cookie and make 3/4-inch slices laying the slices on top of the cream cheese mixture.  Place pan into oven and bake at 350° for about an hour or until golden brown.  Let cool in pan and then cut into squares.  Tastes better when refrigerated.

name: MARINATED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  lb. mushrooms
1/4  c. olive oil
1/2  c. oil
1/4  c. wine vinegar
2  bay leaves
1  tsp. oregano
1  Tbsp. dried parsley
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. dry white wine
preparation: Place all ingredients, except mushrooms and wine, in a large pot.  Bring to boil.  Add mushrooms and wine; boil 5 minutes. Place in hot jars; cover with the marinated juice.  Will keep in fridge for about 2 weeks.

name: ITALIAN PEA SOUP
ingredients:
4 to 6  cloves garlic, minced
oregano
garlic powder
salt and pepper to taste
1  can crushed, peeled tomatoes
2  to 3 onions, chopped
basil
crushed red pepper
3  cans green peas
preparation: Sauté onions and garlic in oil until translucent.  Add celery and sauté.  Add pea juice, tomatoes and spices; simmer 10 minutes. Add peas.  Serve with cooked pasta shells.

name: BREAKFAST PIE
ingredients:
2  c. shredded cheese
2  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. sausage, cooked and drained
1 1/4  c. milk
3  eggs, beaten
salt and pepper to taste
1  deep dish pie crust
preparation: Toss flour and cheese together.  Add eggs, milk, sausage, salt and pepper.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: STRAWBERRY CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
2 1/2  c. boiling water
1  pkg. (10 oz.) crushed strawberries
12  oz. Cool Whip
1  angel food cake
preparation: Mix strawberry Jell-O with boiling water.  Add crushed strawberries.  Put in refrigerator until firm.  When firm, fold in Cool Whip.  In 9 x 13-inch pan, break up angel food cake into pieces.  Pour Jell-O mixture over cake.  Serve with extra cream.

name: LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1  small green pepper, diced
1  small onion, diced
1 1/2  c. diced celery
2  c. frozen peas, thawed
2  c. Miracle Whip
1/2  pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing mix (I usually use the whole pkg.)
preparation: Layer lettuce, celery, green pepper and onion in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle the peas on top.  Mix Miracle Whip and Good Seasons salad dressing together and spread on top of lettuce mixture. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and bacon.

name: COCKTAIL WIENERS
ingredients:
6  oz. jar mustard
1  lb. wieners
10  oz. jar currant or apricot jelly
preparation: Melt jelly and mustard together in saucepan over low heat. Slice wieners into bite-size pieces.  Add to sauce and heat thoroughly.  Serve with toothpicks.

name: APPLE DIP
ingredients:
1/4 to 3/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Whip until smooth.  Let stand overnight or at least 2 hours. Use with sliced apples.  You can add a little cinnamon for a yummy taste.

name: JOANNE'S LO-CAL ICE CREAM DESSERT
ingredients:
2  pkg. jello (strawberry)
2  c. light vanilla ice cream
2  Tbsp. lite Cool Whip
1  medium banana
preparation: Boil 1 1/2 cups water.  Dissolve with jello.  Add 1 1/4 cups cold water.  Mix with lite ice cream until dissolved.  Refrigerate until jelled.  Serve with lite Cool Whip and sliced banana.  (Make your own treat; try a different flavor jello and fruit topping.)

name: MILLIONAIRE PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. vanilla
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. chopped pecans
1 (16 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
2  (8-inch) pie shells, cooked
preparation: In a large bowl combine powdered sugar, cream cheese and salt. Beat until light.  Stir in vanilla.  Drain pineapple and add pineapple with chopped pecans, mix well.  Fold in whipped topping. Pour into pie shells.  Chill until ready to serve.

name: HOMEMADE BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2  cans cooked dry butter beans (15 oz.)
1/2  c. catsup
1/3  c. dark brown sugar
4  to 5 strips bacon, cut in small pieces
preparation: Drain 1 can of beans.  Add second can with juice.  Stir in catsup and brown sugar.  Mix well.  Place bacon on top of beans in casserole dish or small roasting pan.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

name: SQUASH PICKLES
ingredients:
8  c. yellow squash (thinly sliced)
2  c. onions
2  lg. bell peppers
1 sm.  jar Pimentos
1/4  c. salt
3  c. sugar
2  c. vinegar
2  tsp. celery seed
2  tsp. mustard seed
preparation: Mix yellow squash, onions, bell peppers, and Pimentos and cover with salt, add ice, let stand 1 1/2 hours, drain. Mix sugar, vinegar, celery seed, and mustard seed. Simmer about 5 minutes. Add vegetables, bring to boil. Pack in jars and seal.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/4  c. milk
3  medium potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced (3 c.)
preparation: For Sauce:  Cook onion in the margarine until tender.  Stir in flour, salt and pepper.  Add milk all at once.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.  Remove from heat.

name: CHOCOLATE CRESCENT BARS
ingredients:
8  oz. can refrigerated crescent rolls
2/3  c. brown sugar
2/3  c. butter
1  c. chopped pecans
6  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Separate rolls into 2 large rectangles. Place dough into 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan (or a small cookie sheet).  Gently press dough to seal perforations.

name: SUNSHINE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can 20 oz. pineapple tidbits
1  can 11 oz. mandarin oranges
1  pkg. 3 oz. instant lemon pudding
1  c. quartered strawberries
1  c. sliced bananas
preparation: Drain pineapple and oranges, reserving liquid.  Prepare pudding using liquid from the fruit in place of milk.   In a bowl, gently fold fruit into pudding. Chill for 2 hours.  Add bananas just before serving.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: STRAWBERRY DELIGHT PUNCH
ingredients:
1/2  c. instant tea
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
6  oz. frozen concentrated lemonade, thawed
6  c. cold water
1/2  c. sugar
ice
lemon slices (optional)
preparation: In a 2 1/2-quart punch bowl, combine tea and water; set aside. In blender, combine strawberries, lemonade concentrate and sugar. Process on high speed for about 15 seconds, or until smooth. Pour into tea mixture; mix well.   Add lemon slices.  Serves 15.

name: EASY CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage meat
1  lb. ground round
2  lb. Velveeta cheese, cut in cubes
1 (10 oz.)  can Ro-Tel whole tomatoes
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown the sausage and ground round in a large frying pan over medium heat and drain off the grease.  Add the cheese, tomatoes and salt and pepper.  Cook over low heat, stirring, until the cheese has melted and the liquid from the tomatoes has cooked away, about 15 minutes.  If you want to make this dip a bit more elaborate, add a total of 1 cup sauteed onion, green pepper or fresh tomatoes.  Serve hot with tortilla chips.

name: GRANDMA'S CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1 1/3  c. sugar
1  c. packed brown sugar
4  eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. oatmeal
3  c. flour
2 large  pkg. chocolate chips
2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Beat together, on high, shortening, butter, sugar and brown sugar for about 5 minutes.  Beat in the eggs, one at a time mixing well after each egg.  Add vanilla and lemon juice.

name: MOCK PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. white Karo syrup
1  c. crunchy peanut butter
8  c. corn flakes
preparation: Melt sugar and Karo syrup.  Add peanut butter and cornflakes. Mix.  Press into pan.

name: MOUNTAIN DEW SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. lemon gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1 (12 oz.)  can cold Mountain Dew
1 (15 oz.)  can pineapple tidbits, drained and juice reserved
1  pkg. lemon pudding (cooked type)
1  c. whipping cream, whipped, or Cool Whip
1  c. colored mini marshmallows
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add Mountain Dew and juice drained from pineapple; chill until it begins to thicken.  Cook pudding according to package instructions; cool.  Mix gelatin, lemon pudding and whipped cream, beating together.  Add drained pineapple and marshmallows.  Pour into a large 2-quart bowl and chill.

name: CARAMEL-COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1  (16 oz.) frozen whipped topping, thawed
1  (12 oz.) caramel ice cream topping
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. flaked coconut
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
2  baked 9-inch pastry shells
pecan halves (garnish)
preparation: Melt butter in a large skillet; add coconut and 1/2 cup pecans. Cook until golden, stirring frequently. Set aside and let cool slightly. Combine cream cheese and sweetened condensed milk; beat at medium until smooth. Fold in whipped topping. Layer 1/4 of cream cheese mixture in each pie shell.
