Drizzle 1/4 of caramel topping over each pie. Sprinkle 1/4 coconut mixture evenly on each pie. (Repeat layers cream cheese, caramel and coconut.) Cover and freeze at least 8 hours. Let frozen pies stand at room temperature 5 minutes before serving. Makes 2 pies.

name: COUNTRY SKILLET DINNER
ingredients:
3/4  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, chopped
10  oz. tomato paste
about 3/4 c. water
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. cumin
2  c. thin noodles
Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Put first 3 ingredients in frying pan and cook until beef is brown.  Drain excess grease.  Add tomato paste, water, oregano, cumin and noodles.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Put 1/2 of mixture in large casserole dish.  Cover with Mozzarella cheese.  Use remainder of mix and more Mozzarella cheese on top.  Bake until cheese is melted at 350°.

name: GLAZED FRESH APPLE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1/2  c. soft shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground cloves
1  egg (unbeaten)
1  c. finely chopped, unpared apple
1/4  c. apple juice or milk
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. dark or light raisins, chopped
preparation: Start heating oven to 400°.  Sift the flour with baking soda. Mix  shortening,  brown  sugar, salt, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg and  egg  until  well  blended.  Stir in half of flour mixture, then nuts, apple and raisins.  Blend in apple juice, then remaining flour mixture.  Onto greased cookie sheet, drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart.  Bake 11 to 14 minutes  or until  done.  While cookies are still hot, spread thinly with Vanilla Glaze.  Makes about 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

name: FROZEN PEANUT BUTTER AND JELLY PIE
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. thawed whipped topping (8 oz.)
1  pkg. (4 serving size) vanilla instant pudding
1  (9-inch) graham cracker crust
1/3  c. strawberry jam
1  c. cold milk
1/2  c. chunky peanut butter
preparation: Note:  Sugar-free pudding, skim milk, light jam and light topping may be used.

name: PLAY DOUGH (COOKED)
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1 1/2  c. salt
3  c. water
3  Tbsp. oil
3  tsp. cream of tartar
food coloring or unsweetened Kool-Aid
preparation: Cook 3 minutes to consistency of mashed potatoes.  Knead a bit.  Store in plastic bag or airtight container.  (Not edible.)

name: BANANA FRITTERS
ingredients:
4  oz. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/2  oz. butter
6  Tbsp. milk
1  egg white
1  oz. sugar
3  Tbsp. rum or brandy
6  ripe bananas, cut lengthwise and then into quarters
oil or fat for frying
icing sugar
flour for dipping bananas
preparation: First make batter.  Sift flour and salt; stir in beaten egg and melted butter.  Add milk and mix well.  Beat egg white until stiff, then fold into batter.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. white sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/4  c. light corn syrup
3  Tbsp. butter
1/4  tsp. salt
3  eggs, beaten lightly
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix sugar and flour in saucepan.  Add syrup, butter and salt. Warm  over	low heat until butter is melted.  Beat eggs and vanilla.  Stir  into  sugar mixture.  Turn into pie shell and sprinkle pecans on top.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until filling is set in center.  Cool before serving.

name: LIME JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. lime jello
1  c. hot water
1  c. cottage cheese
1  c. evaporated milk
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Mix jello and water and let cool.  Mix remaining ingredients into jello and pour into oblong baking dish.  Chill.

name: SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped frozen spinach
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
1/3  c. cracker crumbs
1 1/2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1 to 2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Thaw spinach and drain very well.  Combine the spinach, sour cream and onion soup in buttered casserole.  Combine cracker crumbs, butter and cheese.  Put cracker mixture over top of spinach.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: RICE KRISPIES PEANUT BUTTER CANDY
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. sugar
1  c. Karo
6  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Mix peanut butter, sugar and Karo together.  Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Then stir in Rice Krispies; mix well. Spread on greased cookie sheet.  Let cool.

name: ORANGE JULIUS
ingredients:
6  oz. frozen orange juice
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. milk
12  to 14 ice cubes
1  c. water
preparation: Add orange juice, sugar, water, vanilla and milk in blender, then add ice cubes a handful at a time.  Blend, then add the rest of the ice cubes slowly.  After all ice cubes are blended in, serve right away.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs, well beaten
1  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar.  Add beaten eggs, peanut butter and vanilla. Sift flour and soda together and add to mixture.  Mix well.  Roll into balls and press with fork.  Bake in preheated oven at 375° for about 10 minutes.

name: OATMEAL RAISIN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  c. raisins, ground
1 1/2  c. oatmeal
2 1/3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream sugar, shortening and eggs.  Add ground raisins.  Add flour, soda and salt.  Add oatmeal.  Make into balls and flatten a little.  Cookies stay moist and makes a big batch.

name: LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
lettuce
red onion
mayonnaise
green peas, uncooked (frozen)
1  tsp. sugar
julienned Swiss cheese
crumbled bacon, cooked and drained
preparation: Layer in order given in quantities desired.  Chill.  Toss when ready to serve.

name: SNACK PIZZAS
ingredients:
oil
1  pkg. flaky refrigerator biscuits
1/2  c. tomato sauce
1  tsp. oregano
sliced pepperoni
grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Put a little grease or oil on the baking sheet.  Pat each biscuit into a 4-inch circle.  Put each circle on baking sheet.  Mix tomato sauce and oregano in a measuring cup.  Spoon some on each biscuit.  Put pepperoni on top of the sauce.  Sprinkle with the cheese.  Bake about 8 minutes or until crust is lightly brown.

name: LAZY DAISY CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Combine eggs, sugar and vanilla. Beat until thick.  Add sifted dry ingredients.  Heat milk and butter to boiling point.  Add to mixture. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: CROCK-POT DRESSING
ingredients:
1  (8-inch) pan cornbread
8  slices day-old bread
4  eggs, beaten
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  Tbsp. sage
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  cans chicken broth
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
chopped cooked chicken
preparation: Crumble breads together. Add all other ingredients, except butter. Pour into crock-pot. Dot with margarine. Cover and cook on high for 2 hours, then turn to low and cook for 3 to 4 hours. Makes 16 servings.

name: HEALTH BREAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. active dry yeast
1/2  c. warm water
1  c. quick cooking oats
2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  c. raisins
2 2/3  c. boiling water
1  c. bran
3/4  c. molasses or sorghum
1  c. stirred whole wheat flour
6 or more  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Soften yeast in warm water.  Combine next 6 ingredients and cool to lukewarm.  Add softened yeast and molasses.  Stir in whole wheat flour; beat well.  Gradually add enough flour to make a soft dough.  Turn out on lightly floured surface.  Knead until smooth. Place in a greased bowl and turn once.  Cover with damp cloth. Let rise in warm spot until double in bulk, 1 or more hours. Punch down.  Let rest for 10 minutes.  Shape into 2 loaves in greased 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch bread pans.  Let rise until double, approximately 45 minutes.  Bake for 40 to 50 minutes in 350° oven. Great toasted.

name: APPLE PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1  spice cake mix
2  c. chopped apples
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. lemon juice
preparation: Prepare cake mix according to directions on box, folding apples in.  Pour into 9 x 12-inch pan and bake according to directions on box.  Mix Eagle Brand milk, sour cream and lemon juice.  Spread on baked cake and return to oven for 10 minutes.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. stew beef, cut into pieces
1  can mushroom soup
2  cans water
1  envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets onion soup
preparation: Mix everything together. Cover and bake at 300° for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.  Serve over noodles.

name: COCONUT MACAROONS
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
6  c. coconut
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Spoon one inch apart on greased baking sheet.  Bake 8 minutes at 350°.  Remove at once.  Makes 5 dozen.

name: ROAST POTATO WEDGES
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. oil
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
4  medium potatoes, scrubbed and wedged
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Melt butter and oil in baking pan in 425° oven. Toss in potatoes;  add  seasonings.  Bake until tender and browned, 30 to 35 minutes.

name: CRAZY CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
6  Tbsp. applesauce
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Pour 1 cup cold water over all and mix.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in a 9-inch square pan.

name: DELICIOUS PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  c. and 1 Tbsp. shortening
1/3  c. water
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Combine flour and salt; cut in shortening until resembles corn meal. Combine water, vinegar and egg. Add a little at a time to flour to form soft dough. Cover and refrigerate 3 to 4 hours. Roll out pastry and trim.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
1 small  box strawberry Jell-O
1 small frozen  can lemonade
1 large  can pineapple juice
3  c. boiling water
3  c. cold water
3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. almond extract
2 large  bottles ginger ale
preparation: Mix Jell-O in boiling water. add sugar and mix thoroughly. Add cold water, lemonade, pineapple juice and extract. Freeze in plastic container. Thaw, but not completely and add ginger ale.

name: PASTA BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
2  cloves garlic
1 (28 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1  c. beef broth
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. grated Parmesan
1  tsp. dried oregano
1/2  tsp. dried whole rosemary
1/2  lb. uncooked rigatoni noodles
1 to 2  c. mixed Mozzarella and sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook pasta while doing the following: In a large pan brown meat with garlic; drain fat.  Add all remaining items except cheeses.  Cover and simmer at least 15 minutes.  Add cooked pasta and simmer about 5 minutes.  Pour into buttered 10 x 13-inch pan and top with cheeses.  Bake uncovered for 25 minutes.

name: SARA'S FAVORITE POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
6  large baking potatoes
some water
1  Tbsp. tarragon
1  Tbsp. dill
1  Tbsp. thyme
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Peel potatoes; cut in wedges.  Put potatoes in large pot and cover with water.  Add herbs.  Cook potatoes until done (10 to 15 minutes).  Spoon 1/3 of mixture into blender and puree.  Pour back into pot.  Stir soup.  Spoon 1/3 of stirred mixture into blender and puree.  Pour back and stir.  Ladle soup into bowls; garnish with one handful cheese.  Serve.  (Serves approximately 4, depending on appetites!)

name: GRANOLA
ingredients:
6  c. quick oats
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white germ
1  c. coconut
1  c. nuts
1  c. nonfat dry milk
1  c. vegetable oil
1  c. dark corn syrup
1  c. black coffee
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. honey
preparation: In a large bowl, combine oats, brown sugar, wheat germ, coconut, nuts, and dry milk.  Add honey, vegetable oil, syrup, coffee, and vanilla.  Stir to coat ingredients well.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  bottle Catalina Dressing
1  jar Taco Sauce
1  lb. Hamburger
1  pkg. Taco Seasoning Mix
1  Head Lettuce
1  Tomato
1  Onion - sliced
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  Can Kidney Beans
2  c. Shredded Cheddar Cheese
1  bag Dorito Nacho Cheese Chips
preparation: Brown together Hamburger & Taco Seasoning  Mix. Mix with other ingredients.

name: GREEN LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
lettuce, shredded
large sweet onion, sliced thin
celery, chopped
1  pkg. frozen peas, slightly cooked and cooled
6  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  lb. bacon, fried, drained, cooled and crumbled
preparation: In a large salad bowl, place a layer shredded lettuce, layer of onion, layer of chopped celery and layer of cooled peas. Continue to layer but end up with lettuce on top.

name: CHEESE BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. shortening
1/3  c. grated sharp cheese
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Combine flour, baking powder and salt.  Cut in shortening until it feels like cornmeal.  Stir in cheese.  Add milk; blend just to combine ingredients.  Roll out dough on floured surface. Cut with cutters and place on greased sheet.  Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.  Makes 18 biscuits.

name: MARINATED FLANK STEAK
ingredients:
1  c. consomme or beef bouillon
1  c. red wine
2/3  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. green onion, sliced
1  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. lime juice
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Score steak on both sides in 1 1/2-inch squares.  Marinate in other ingredients for 8 hours in refrigerator.  Grill to desired degree of doneness.  Slice across grain into thin slices.

name: CHEESECAKE DREAMS
ingredients:
1/3  c. light brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/3  c. oleo, melted
1/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. unsifted all-purpose flour
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  egg
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease an 8-inch square baking pan. In small bowl, mix brown sugar, flour and walnuts.  Stir in melted oleo until well combined.  Reserve 1/3 cup crumbs.  Pat remaining gently into pan.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes.

name: EASY MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  can Spanish rice
salt
pepper
preparation: Mix hamburger with however much salt and pepper you like.  Add can of Spanish rice and mix together thoroughly.  Put into a loaf pan that has been sprayed with Pam.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  You have to keep draining grease.  Pour your own special thick hot sauce over it before serving.

name: FUDGE
ingredients:
5  c. sugar
2  sticks butter
1 large  can Carnation milk
2  c. nuts
2  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  jar marshmallow cream
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil milk, sugar, and butter for 7 minutes, stirring constantly, until it forms a soft ball.   Remove from heat and add nuts, chips, marshmallow cream, and vanilla.  Beat until thick.

name: TACO PIE
ingredients:
1  tube refrigerated biscuits (8 to 10)
1  lb. ground turkey
1  onion
2  Tbsp. green pepper, seeded and chopped
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
6  oz. water
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
8  oz. shredded Mozzarella
preparation: Place biscuits in a 10-inch pie pan and press together to form a crust like pie. Set aside. Saut in large skillet the turkey, onion and green pepper for 5 minutes. Add tomato paste and water. Sprinkle with taco seasoning. Simmer for 3 minutes. Layer half of the meat mixture on top of biscuit crust. Top with half of the cheese. Top with remaining meat mixture and cheese. Bake in preheated 400° oven for 15 minutes.

name: POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
20  c. popped corn (about 1 c. unpopped popcorn)
2  c. sugar
1  c. water
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1  tsp. vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Remove all unpopped kernels and place popped corn in a large roasting pan in oven.  Keep warm in oven at 300°.  Butter sides of a 2-quart saucepan.  Combine sugar, water, corn syrup, vinegar and salt in buttered saucepan.  Cook on stove top to a soft crack stage, stirring frequently (mixture should boil gently).  Remove from heat and stir in vanilla.  Pour mixture over warm popcorn. Stir gently until mixed.  Butter hands and use a butter coated cup to shape into 3-inch balls.  Let cool!    Yields 13 to 15 (3-inch) balls.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. Webber regular sausage
1  lb. Webber hot sausage
preparation: Mix together and make into small cocktail balls; brown. Pour barbecue sauce over and bake at 350° until hot. Serve on toothpicks.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. plain flour (White Lily brand makes lighter cake)
2  sticks Blue Bonnet margarine
1  c. milk
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. Crisco shortening
2  tsp. vanilla (may use 1 tsp. vanilla and another favorite flavor, lemon, etc.)
preparation: Cream butter and shortening together in mixer until smooth. Add eggs, 1 at a time.  Add sugar, one cup at a time, and add slowly.  Add flour, 1 cup at a time, mixing in 1/2 cup milk as needed.  After mixture is all mixed, add another 1/2 cup milk with 1 teaspoon baking powder dissolved into milk.  Add vanilla.  Bake in large pan, 9 x 12-inch character pans.  (Recipe may be cut in half if a large cake is not desired.)  Bake at 325° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, depending how deep pan is.  A 9 x 12-inch takes only 1 hour.  Check at 50 minutes.

name: HOLIDAY CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  lb. white almond bark
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. crisp rice cereal
1  c. peanuts
1 (6 oz.)  jar red maraschino cherries, drained and cut in half
3  Tbsp. green maraschino cherries, drained and quartered
1/3  c. flake coconut
1  tsp. oil
preparation: Microwave chips and 14 ounces of almond bark in bowl on High for 2 minutes.  Stir, continue microwaving 1 to 2 minutes, or until smooth when stirred.  Stir in marshmallows, cereal and peanuts. Pour into greased 11 x 14-inch dish.  Top with cherries; sprinkle with coconut.

name: FAJITA MARINADE
ingredients:
1  c. red wine vinegar
1  c. Crisco oil
1  Tbsp. chili powder
2  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. oregano
2  tsp. basil
1  tsp. coriander
1  tsp. cumin
2  cloves garlic, crushed
preparation: Mix all ingredients in plastic container.  Pierce flank steak, or venison steak, thoroughly with a fork.  Place in marinade and refrigerate overnight.  Turn meat every 3 or 4 hours to marinate evenly.  Meat can be cooked on grill or under your broiler.  Serve on warmed flour tortillas with sauteed onions and peppers, shredded cheese, sour cream, salsa and guacamole.  (I substitute white wine vinegar when marinating chicken breasts.)

name: JEWISH COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine, creamed
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. chopped nuts
1  c. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Grease and flour a 10-inch spring-form pan or angel food pan. In a large bowl, cream together 1/2 cup butter and the sugar until light and fluffy.  Add the eggs, beating well.  Mix in the 2 cups flour, baking powder, soda, salt, sour cream and vanilla, blending well.  In a separate bowl, combine the nuts, brown sugar, 3 tablespoons of flour, 3 tablespoons butter and cinnamon.  Mix together to form a crumb topping.  Spread half of the batter into prepared pan and sprinkle with half the topping.  Cover with remaining batter and topping.  Bake in 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: LEMONADE PIE
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can lemonade concentrate (if frozen, thawed)
1  (8 oz.)  Cool Whip
1  (14 oz.)  Eagle Brand milk
1  pie shell (graham cracker or baked)
preparation: Mix ingredients and put in pie shell.  Freeze until solid. Thaw and serve.

name: Chicken A La King
ingredients:
2  c. diced cooked chicken
2  tsp. shortening
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. mushrooms
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper
preparation: Melt shortening and fry onion, green pepper and celery until tender.  Remove.  Melt butter in skillet; add flour until it makes a paste.  Add milk gradually, stirring constantly until mixture thickens.  Add salt, pepper, chicken, sauteed vegetables, pimento, mushrooms and parsley.  Reduce heat and cook additional 5 minutes.

name: MICROWAVE MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce, divided, or substitute ketchup and Italian seasoning
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. prepared mustard
2  eggs, lightly beaten
1  medium onion, minced (optional)
1/4  c. cracker crumbs or oatmeal
2  lb. lean ground beef
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: In small bowl, combine tomato sauce, brown sugar and mustard; set aside.  In large mixing bowl, combine eggs, onion, cracker crumbs, ground beef, salt and pepper.  Add 1/2 cup of tomato sauce mixture; stir thoroughly.  Place meat mixture in glass ring mold or 2-quart microproof round casserole.  Pour remaining tomato sauce over top of meat.  Cook, uncovered, on High for 12 to 14 minutes.  Let stand, covered, 5 to 10 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

name: BROWN SODA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2 1/4  c. whole wheat flour
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/3  c. buttermilk (approximately)
preparation: Put all-purpose flour in bowl; add salt and baking soda and stir together with fork.  Add whole wheat flour and mix.  Blend butter into flour mixture with pastry blender.  Make a well in center and add buttermilk; stir until blended (dough should be dry enough to knead, but not too dry).  Knead on floured board about 30 seconds.  Pat into greased 8-inch pan (black frying pan).  Cut gashes to form a cross.  Bake in preheated oven at 400° for about 30 minutes.  Cool on rack.  Makes a small loaf.

name: EASY BREAD AND BUTTER PICKLES
ingredients:
12  medium cucumbers, sliced thin
6  medium onions, sliced thin
4  c. sugar
4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. mustard seed
1  tsp. turmeric
1  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Mix sugar, vinegar,  mustard  seed, turmeric and celery seed. Bring  to rolling  boil.  Add  drained  cucumbers  and onions. Return to rolling boil.  Remove from heat and pack in sterile jars.  They will seal themselves.  Makes 5 pints.

name: MELTING MOMENTS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
1 1/3  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Mix flour, cornstarch and sugar in a bowl.  Blend in butter or margarine until a soft dough is formed.  If dough is too soft to handle, cover and chill for 1 hour.  Shape into 3/4-inch balls. Roll in the coconut.  Place 1 1/2 inches apart on an ungreased baking sheet.  Bake at 300° for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick or Jiffy mix
2/3  c. milk
3  overripe bananas
handful of nutmeats
1  egg
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients to moisten well.  Fold into loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until nicely browned.

name: CREAMY TATER SOUP
ingredients:
4  c. defatted chicken broth
1  c. chopped onion
3  c. chopped celery, including leaves
2  small potatoes, peeled and cubed
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of cayenne pepper
1  c. low-fat milk
preparation: In a large saucepan, combine all ingredients, except milk. Cook until vegetables are very tender, about 10 minutes.  Cool slightly.  Transfer to blender and blend until smooth.    Stir in milk.

name: CLAM DIP
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  can minced clams, drained into cup
1  Tbsp. clam broth
1/2  tsp. grated onion
preparation: Combine cream cheese, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, clams, clam broth and onion.  Mix well.  Pile into bowl and refrigerate for 2 hours or more.

name: BUBBLING PINEAPPLE PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (46 oz.)  can Dole pineapple juice, chilled
3  c. apricot nectar
1  qt. club soda
1  qt. pineapple sherbet
preparation: Combine chilled pineapple juice and apricot nectar in large punch bowl.  Add soda and sherbet just before serving.  Makes 25 to 30 servings.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. mild pork sausage
10  eggs, beaten
10  slices bread, cubed
10-12-oz grated sharp cheese
3/4  C milk
Salt & pepper
preparation: Brown sausage and drain. Mix remaining ingredients in 9 x 12 glass baking dish. Refrigerate overnight. Bake 30 minutes at 375 degrees.

name: "HALL'S BANANA NUT BREAD"
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. shortening (Crisco butter)
1 1/2  c. nuts
2 1/2  c. flour
7  overripe bananas
2  tsp. soda
dash of salt
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Beat eggs, sugar, shortening and vanilla extract until smooth. Add flour, soda, salt and overripe bananas.  Fold in nuts.  Bake in two greased and floured loaf pans at 350° to 375° for one hour or until done.  Add some nuts on the top before baking.

name: NEVER FAIL DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. shortening
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. flour
2  eggs, well beaten
preparation: Mix thoroughly; roll to 1/4-inch thickness.  Cut and fry in deep fat at 375°.

name: CORN DOG BITES
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
2/3  c. cornmeal
1  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. melted bacon drippings
1  egg, beaten
1 to 1 1/4  c. buttermilk
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  lb. frankfurters
vegetable oil
prepared mustard, catsup, picante sauce (optional)
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients; stir in bacon drippings.  Combine egg, buttermilk and soda; mix well.  Stir into flour mixture, mixing well.  Cut each frankfurter into 10 pieces.  Dip frankfurter sections into batter, covering completely.  (Wooden picks work well for dipping.)  Drop into 3 to 4 inches deep hot oil (375°) and cook until golden, turning once.  Drain on paper towels.  Insert party picks and serve immediately.  Serve with mustard, catsup or picante sauce, if desired.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. margarine
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can celery soup
8  oz. Velveeta cheese
2  pkg. chopped broccoli
preparation: Saute celery and onion in margarine.  Add soup and cheese. Mix and simmer slowly.  Add broccoli which has been slightly cooked.  Pour into buttered casserole dish.  Top with dried bread crumbs and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BOAT STEERERS
ingredients:
1  qt. shucked clams
1/2  c. milk
4  tsp. baking powder
1  egg (slightly beaten)
1  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter or oil
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Chop clams; add egg, oil  and  milk.  Mix  and sift dry ingredients;  add  clams,	stirring  until  smooth.  Drop	by spoonfuls into deep fat and fry until golden brown.

name: ANGEL FOOD DESSERT - SO QUICK
ingredients:
1  large round angel food cake
2  cans cherry pie mix
1 large  can pineapple tidbits, drained
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: You will need 1 large bowl.

name: RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. raw rice
2  cans Campbell's Beef Consomme Soup
2  cans of water (soup can)
1 sm.  can mushroom pieces
2  sm. chopped onions
1  lg. green pepper - chopped
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

name: GRAPE WINE(Old Recipe, Fun to Make)
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  pkg. dry yeast
2  cans frozen Welch's grape juice (concentrate)
preparation: Dissolve ingredients in warm water.  Pour into gallon jug; finish filling with water.  Place large balloon on mouth of jug; it will blow up as fermentation takes place.  Be careful that balloon doesn't burst.  Takes about 3 weeks.

name: VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. sour cream and chives
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. Blue cheese
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  pkg. Good Seasons garlic mix
preparation: Mix sour cream, Blue cheese and vinegar well.  Add Good Seasons mix.

name: GUMDROP CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  lb. gumdrops, cut up
1  lb. white raisins
1  c. chopped nuts
1 1/2  c. applesauce
preparation: Cream first 4 ingredients and set aside.  Sift together dry ingredients.  Stir gumdrops, raisins and nuts into flour mixture. Add flour mixture to creamed mixture, alternating with applesauce. Beat well after each addition.  Pour batter into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan lined with triple layers of waxed paper.  Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour, or until it tests done.  Let set in pan for 30 minutes. Cool thoroughly and store in foil.  Makes one 5-pound cake.

name: BAKED SAUSAGE AND EGGS
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage, cooked, broken up and drained
2  cans sliced mushrooms, drained
1  onion, chopped
1  tomato, chopped
1  loaf French bread, cut in 1/2-inch cubes
6  eggs, beaten
1  qt. milk
2  tsp. dried basil
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder (optional)
2  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
chopped parsley for garnish
preparation: Grease a 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish.  Combine cooked and drained sausage, onion, tomato, mushrooms and bread cubes in baking dish.  In large bowl combine eggs, milk and basil, pepper and garlic powder and mix well.  Pour egg mixture over sausage mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.  Preheat oven to 350° and bake, uncovered, for 1 hour.  Remove from oven and sprinkle both cheeses evenly over egg mixture.  Bake 15 minutes longer or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.  Let stand about 10 minutes before serving.  Garnish with parsley.

name: COCONUT FRUIT SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. graham crackers
1/4  c. melted margarine
1  can (14 oz.) sweetened condensed milk
1/2  tsp. grated lemon or lime rind
1/3  c. lemon or lime juice
5 1/4  c. (12 oz.) Birds Eye Cool Whip topping
2 2/3  c. (7 oz.) Baker's Angel Flake coconut
1  can (11 oz.) fresh or canned fruit
preparation: Combine graham cracker crumbs and melted butter.  Press firmly into bottom of 9-inch square pan.

name: CHOCOLATE POUNDCAKE
ingredients:
2 3/4  c. sifted cake flour
3/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  c. soft shortening
milk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  medium eggs, unbeaten
1  egg yolk, unbeaten
3  sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted
confectioners sugar
preparation: Start heating oven to 350°.  Line with wax paper bottom of a 3 1/2-inch deep 9-inch tube pan.  Into large bowl sift flour, cream of tartar, soda, salt and sugar.  Drop in shortening; pour in milk and vanilla.  With electric mixer at low speed to medium speed, beat 2 minutes, scraping bowl and beaters as needed.  Add eggs, egg yolk and chocolate; beat 1 minute.  Turn into pan.  Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes.

name: APRICOT PRESERVE BREAD
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
3/4  tsp. salt
1/3  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. oil
1  egg
1  c. apricot preserves
1/2  c. orange juice
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Sift together all dry ingredients, including sugar.  Stir in remaining ingredients, just until moistened, not smooth.   Pour into greased and floured loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until done.

name: GRANDMA'S REFRIGERATOR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  c. nuts
1  c. butter
1  c. chopped dates
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  tsp. soda
3  c. flour
preparation: Mix together.  Roll in wax paper.  Chill overnight.  Slice and bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken, cooked and cut in pieces
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 small  can evaporated milk
1 small  can pimento
1  c. celery
sliced almonds
2  c. Chinese noodles
1 small  can mushrooms
preparation: Mix and put in baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CREAM OF TOMATO SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  large onion, minced
6  large fresh tomatoes, peeled and chopped
1  Tbsp. fresh basil, chopped (or 1 tsp. dried)
1  tsp. salt (or to taste)
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  c. heavy cream
preparation: Melt the butter in a large skillet.  Sauté the onion until tender but not brown.  Add the chopped tomatoes, basil, salt and pepper.  Cover and cook over low heat until the tomatoes are soft. Don't let them get mushy.  This will probably take about 10 minutes.  Pour the mixture into the bowl of a food processor and while the machine is running, gradually add the heavy cream. Continue processing until the mixture is smooth.  Best served slightly warm.  A sprinkling of grated cheese over the top adds a nice taste boost.

name: HOT CHEESE BISCUITS
ingredients:
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1/2  c. butter flavor Crisco
1  c. flour
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream together cheese and Crisco.   Add flour and salt.  Mix well.   Roll into balls and chill for 1 hour.   Place on ungreased cookie sheet.   Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.  Balls will flatten as they cook.

name: GREEN-AND-WHITE TUNA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3.5 oz.)  can tuna, drained
1/4  c. finely chopped scallions (onions)
1/4  c. finely chopped celery
1/4  c. finely chopped green pepper
1/4  c. finely chopped fresh parsley
1  Tbsp. plain yogurt
1  tsp. Dijon-style mustard
1  tsp. lime juice
preparation: In a medium bowl, combine first 5 ingredients. In a small bowl, whisk together yogurt, mustard and lime juice. Pour over the tuna mixture; toss lightly and serve. Makes 2 servings.

name: HARD ROLLS
ingredients:
1 cake fresh or 1  pkg. dry yeast
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  egg whites, beaten stiff
1  c. lukewarm water
2  Tbsp. shortening
4  c. flour
preparation: Soften yeast with 1/4 cup lukewarm water; add remaining water. Add sugar and shortening.  Add 1 cup flour; beat well.  Add yeast and egg whites; mix through.  Add remaining flour and salt to make soft dough.  Rise once; punch down and let rise again.  Brush with egg yolk diluted with water.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE-CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
8  Tbsp. flour
2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
2  c. crushed pineapple, drained
1  roll Ritz crackers, crushed
1  stick butter, melted
preparation: Mix together sugar, flour, cheese and pineapple.  Pour into a casserole dish.  Spread crackers on top.  Pour melted butter over crackers.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: PEAR PRESERVES
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. processed pears
1  box Sure-Jell
5  c. sugar
1  tsp. allspice or cinnamon
preparation: Wash, pare and core pears.  Run through grinder or processor until fine.  Measure out 4 1/2 cups.  Mix with 1 box of Sure-Jell. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring constantly.  Add all at once, 5 cups sugar and teaspoon of allspice or cinnamon.  Bring to full rolling boil again and time 1 minute, stirring constantly. Cool 5 minutes.  Skim foam and seal into sterile jars.  Can process 10 minutes in boiling water bath for safety.  Makes 4 pints.

name: CHEESE WRAPPED OLIVES
ingredients:
1  block Kraft Cracker Barrel sharp cheese (grated)
1  c. flour
1  stick butter (melted)
1  jar small olives with pimiento
3-5 drops Tabasco or 1/2 tsp. red cayenne pepper
preparation: Dry olives.  Combine all ingredients in food processor and work around each olive.  Freeze for at least 3 hours before baking to prevent them from crumbling.  Bake for 15 minutes.  Better if served hot.

name: QUICK BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
3  or 4 bananas, depending on size
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  c. sifted flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts (pecans or walnuts)
preparation: Blend shortening and sugar.  Beat eggs well and add to mixture.  Mash bananas until smooth; add lemon juice and blend with mixture.  Mix flour, baking powder and salt; quickly add to the banana mixture.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: ITALIAN BREAD
ingredients:
5  c. flour
2 1/2  tsp. yeast (1 pkg.)
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  Tbsp. corn oil
2  c. warm water
preparation: Put flour in bowl and mix in yeast, salt and oil.  Add water and work/knead until velvety smooth.  Put in bowl; cover with cloth and let rise until doubled in size.  Punch down.  Knead 5 minutes. Shape into 2 loaves in greased pans.  Cover with cloth and let rise until doubled.  Preheat oven to 450°.  Bake for 25 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and bake 45 minutes more.  It will sound hollow when tapped.

name: WATERGATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1  box pistachio pudding
3  eggs
1  c. ginger ale (7-Up does fine)
1  c. Crisco oil
1/2  c. pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bake in 3 layers for about 20 minutes at 350°.

name: ELECTRIC CHICKEN
ingredients:
cut up chicken
flour to cover
1/4  c. oil
3/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  c. canned tomatoes
chunks of green pepper
chunks of pineapple
garlic, salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Flour chicken and brown in oil at 250°.  Drain chicken and pour off oil.  In a bowl, mix small amount of water with 2 tablespoons of flour, then add rest of ingredients; mix well. Return chicken to skillet and pour liquid mixture over chicken. Simmer for 30 minutes.  Serve with rice or noodles and green vegetable.

name: TOMATO GRAVY
ingredients:
1/4  c. sausage or bacon grease
1/2  onion
1/2  can tomatoes
milk (use your judgement)
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Add milk to grease, onion, flour and tomatoes.  Let brown. Serve over hot biscuits.  Delicious!

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
2  c. freshly grated Parmesan cheese
2  c. mayonnaise
2 (14 oz.)  cans artichoke hearts, drained and shredded
preparation: Combine all and heat just to melt cheese.  Serve with firm potato chips.

name: CREAMY RICE AND TOMATOES
ingredients:
3  c. Minute rice
1  (10.5 oz.) container Spreadery cheese snack Neufchatel cheese (Classic Ranch flavor)
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can tomatoes, drained and cut up
preparation: Cook rice according to package directions.  Stir in cheese and tomatoes.

name: "LITTLE" QUICHE
ingredients:
3  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. oleo
1  c. flour
4  slices bacon, crumbled
1/2  c. cooked ham, chopped
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped
1/3  c. shredded Swiss cheese
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix and chill cream cheese, oleo and flour.  Roll into 24 balls.  Press into tassie cups.  Combine bacon, ham, onion and Swiss cheese.  Place equal amounts of mixture into cups.  Beat eggs and milk.  Pour 2 teaspoons of mixture over filled cups. Bake at 400° for 18 minutes.

name: TASTY TACO PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1 (8 oz.)  can refrigerated crescent rolls
1/2  lb. Velveeta, cubed
1  c. shredded lettuce
1/2  c. chopped tomato
red pepper powder
crushed red pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Brown meat; drain.  Stir in tomato sauce and seasoning mix; simmer 5 minutes.  Unroll dough; press onto bottom and sides of 12-inch pizza pan.  Prick with fork.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Cover crust with meat mixture.  Top with Velveeta.  Sprinkle sparingly with red pepper powder and crushed pepper.  Continue to bake until Velveeta melts. Top with remaining ingredients.  Serve with sour cream.

name: PORK CHOPS CALIFORNIA
ingredients:
8  pork shoulder chops
8  thin lemon slices
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
2/3  c. ketchup
1/2  c. water
preparation: Brown chops in skillet.  Drain excess fat.  Place slice of lemon on each chop.  Combine brown sugar, ketchup and water.  Pour over chops.  Cover.  Simmer 30 minutes.  Remove cover.  Simmer 10 minutes, basting chops occasionally.

name: BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
1 2/3  c. sugar
1 1/4  tsp. baking powder
1 1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2/3  c. butter
2/3  c. buttermilk
1 1/4  c. bananas, mashed
3  eggs
2/3  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt.  Blend in butter, 1/2 of the buttermilk and mashed bananas.  Beat well for 3 minutes.  Add eggs and remaining buttermilk; beat well again for 3 minutes.  Stir in nuts.  Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Cool.  Frost with Banana Icing.

name: PINEAPPLE PUDDING
ingredients:
20  oz. can crushed pineapple, undrained
3  eggs, well beaten
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
4  slices bread, cubed
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Combine pineapple and eggs.  Mix together sugar, flour and salt.  Add to pineapple mixture.  Pour into a greased baking dish. Toss bread cubes in melted butter.  Place on top of pineapple. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

name: KAL BI (KOREAN BBQ) MARINADE
ingredients:
1  c. soy sauce
1  c. water
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. garlic
1  Tbsp. sesame oil
dried red chile pepper (Japanese or Korean), to taste
sesame seeds, to taste
1/2  c. spring onion
preparation: Combine ingredients and marinate beef strips for a few hours. Cook beef strips in a pan or barbecue on the grill.

name: HEARTY POTATO SOUP(Serving Size: 10)
ingredients:
6  c. potatoes, peeled and chopped
3/4  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. pimento, diced
2  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  chicken bouillon cubes
2  c. hot water
1/4  c. plain flour
3  c. milk, divided
preparation: Combine first 8 ingredients in Dutch oven.  Dissolve bouillon cubes in the hot water and add to potato mixture.  Bring to a boil over medium heat; cover and reduce  heat to simmer for 8 minutes or until vegetables are tender.  Dissolve flour in 1/4 cup milk and stir into soup.  Add remaining milk and cook over medium heat until thickened, about 25 minutes.

name: OIL-FREE MUFFINS
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. oat bran
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. dried fruit (raisin, dates or prunes)
1 1/2  c. skim milk
2  egg whites
2  Tbsp. corn syrup
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Mix the milk, egg whites and corn syrup and blend with dry ingredients.  Line muffin pans with paper baking cups and fill with batter.  Bake 13 to 15 minutes; test for doneness with toothpick.

name: GREEN OR RED SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. green or red jello
10  marshmallows
1  can crushed pineapple
1  c. shredded cheese
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  pt. whipping cream
preparation: Drain pineapple and add juice to water to make 2 cups.  Add jello.  Heat until very hot.  Add marshmallows and dissolve.  Let congeal in refrigerator.  Beat mixture until it looks like whipped cream.  Fold whipped cream into jello with cheese, pineapple and nuts.  Chill this overnight.

name: ITALIAN MACARONI CASSEROLE(Makes 8 to 10 servings.)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
3  strips bell pepper, chopped
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2 large  cans tomato sauce (15 oz.)
1  can of water
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
7  oz. pkg. elbow macaroni
1  pkg. grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef in large pan. Add onion, bell pepper, Worcestershire sauce, tomato sauce, water, salt and pepper. Add uncooked macaroni. Let mixture boil until macaroni is thoroughly mixed and coated in sauce. Bake in 350° oven about 30 minutes and until macaroni is tender. Sprinkle with cheese and bake until it melts. Great for company.

name: HIDDEN VALLEY RANCH PARTY WHEEL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. soft cream cheese
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch original dry mix
2  green onions, chopped
1  pkg. 12-inch flour tortillas (need to keep moist)
1/2  c. diced red hot cherry peppers
1/2  c. diced celery
1  can sliced black olives (optional)
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients.  Spread on tortilla.  Sprinkle on remaining ingredients.  Roll tightly.  Chill at least 2 hours. Cut off end waste.  Slice 1/2 to 1-inch thick.  Arrange on tray and enjoy!

name: FREEZER FUDGE
ingredients:
2  sticks melted butter
1 (1 lb.)  box powdered sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. peanut butter
walnuts (optional)
preparation: Mix well.  Put in greased pan and freeze 1/2 hour.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  can French onion soup
1  can cream of mushroom
2  c. raw rice
pork chops
3  c. water
preparation: Melt butter in a large baking dish.  Add soups, rice and water.  Arrange seasoned pork chops on top and cover.  Bake, covered, at 325° for 45 minutes.  Uncover and bake for 45 more minutes.

name: M&M COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
3/4  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. white sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. hot water
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  c. oatmeal
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Spray cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.  Cool on rack.

name: ORIENTAL OMELET
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. cream
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. cooked rice
preparation: Beat eggs, cream and seasonings until thoroughly mixed.  Heat butter in skillet.  Pour in eggs and cook quickly, lifting edge of omelet so uncooked egg can drain under cooked portion.  When egg is almost done, add rice and roll omelet.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. Crisco or butter, melted
2  eggs (unbeaten)
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  c. mashed ripe bananas
preparation: Mix all ingredients above approximately 7 minutes.  Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

name: RHUBARB FREEZER JAM
ingredients:
5  c. rhubarb
4  c. sugar
1/4  c. water
1 small  pkg. strawberry jello
preparation: Combine rhubarb and sugar. Let stand overnight (to make own juice).  If not enough juice, add 1/4 cup water.   Cook rhubarb and sugar until rhubarb is tender.  Add jello and put into jars. Freeze.

name: GOOD RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. cooked rice
1/2  c. sugar
3  beaten eggs
3  c. milk
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. raisins (if desired)
preparation: Pour into buttered casserole dish.  Set in pan of hot water in oven and bake (preheated oven) at 350° for 50 minutes (until knife comes out clean).

name: MOZZARELLA CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  pkg. 4 boneless chicken breasts
1  medium bell pepper, sliced
1  medium onion, sliced
3  Tbsp. butter
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella, sliced
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper.  Place in frying pan with butter over medium heat.  Cook one side for 10 minutes.  Turn breasts and add peppers and onions on top of chicken.  Cover and cook 5 minutes.  Then add Mozzarella cheese slices and cook, covered, until cheese is melted (at least 5 minutes).  Remove and serve.

name: ASPARAGUS AU GRATIN
ingredients:
2 (15 ounce)  cans cut asparagus
1  Tbsp finely chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp butter
1-1/2  Tbsp flour
1/2  tsp salt
dash pepper
1/2  cup light cream
2  Tbsp diced pimento
1/4  cup grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven 400 degrees.  Drain asparagus, reserve liquid. Sauté green pepper in butter in skillet until tender.  Stir in flour and seasonings.  Add cream and 1/2 cup asparagus liquid. Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens.  Add pimento. Arrange asparagus in shallow baking dish.  Pour sauce over asparagus; sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes, until asparagus is heated and cheese is lightly browned. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: FROZEN DAIQUIRIS
ingredients:
1  fifth rum, vodka or gin
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen limeade
1  qt. 7-Up
3 (6 oz.)  cans frozen lemonade
3 (6 oz.)  cans of water
preparation: Blend well and store in freezer.

name: INSIDE OUTSIDE RAVIOLI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach or broccoli
1 (1 lb.)  can spaghetti sauce
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. or 2 c. medium shell or elbow macaroni
4  oz. sharp Cheddar or American cheese (1 c.)
salt and pepper
1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
2  well beaten eggs
1/4  c. salad oil
preparation: Brown first 3 ingredients in a large skillet. Cook spinach or broccoli and drain, reserving liquid. Add water to make 1 cup. Add spinach or broccoli liquid, salt, pepper, chopped spinach or broccoli, spaghetti sauce, tomato sauce and tomato paste to meat mixture. Simmer 10 minutes.  Combine spinach or broccoli with macaroni and remaining ingredients. Spread in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with meat sauce. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

name: TWINKIE DESSERT
ingredients:
8  Twinkies, cut in half lengthwise
small box vanilla instant pudding mix
1  c. milk
1  can Eagle Brand
1  small container Cool Whip
2 small  pkg. frozen or fresh strawberries (if frozen, thaw and drain)
preparation: Line pan with Twinkies, filling side up.  Mix pudding mix with milk.   Add Eagle Brand and Cool Whip.  Pour over Twinkies. Top with strawberries.

name: NEVER FAIL DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  egg, lightly beaten
1/2  Tbsp. salt
1  c. sweet milk
1  Tbsp. baking powder
2  c. flour
preparation: Beat egg, salt, milk and baking powder together.  Add flour to stiffen the batter.  Let stand one hour before cooking.  After one hour, drop dough from spoon into boiling broth.

name: MUSSEL BISQUE
ingredients:
2  lb. mussels
2  chopped shallots
2  onions, quartered
2  sprigs parsley
salt and pepper
1  c. dry white wine
2  Tbsp. butter
1  bay leaf
1/2  tsp. thyme
2  c. heavy cream
1  egg yolk, beaten
preparation: Scrub mussels.  Simmer them with spices, wine, butter and onions for 5 to 10 minutes, until shells open.  Strain.  Discard mussels.  Bring liquid to a boil.  Add cream and egg to thicken slightly.  (Do not boil.)  Serve hot.

name: TEX-MEX DIP
ingredients:
1  can refried beans
8  oz. sour cream
1  pkg. taco seasoning
diced tomato
sliced black olives
1  can avocado dip
1/4  c. mayonnaise
shredded Cheddar cheese
diced scallions
preparation: Use a quiche size dish.  Layer ingredients from bottom to top as follows:

name: SOUTHERN SPOON BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. melted shortening
1  c. milk
3  beaten egg yolks
3  stiffly beaten egg whites
preparation: Cook corn meal and 2 cups milk until consistency of mush. Remove from heat.  Add salt, baking powder, shortening and remaining 1 cup of milk.  Add egg yolks and fold in egg whites. Bake in greased two-quart baking dish in moderate oven (325°) for 1 hour.  Spoon into warm dishes; top with butter.  Serves 6.

name: PEAR RELISH
ingredients:
1  peck or 8 lb. pears
4  bell peppers
3  red hot peppers
3  green hot peppers
5  medium onions
2  lb. sugar
4  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. ground allspice
1  can pimientos
1  Tbsp. turmeric
preparation: Peel and coarsely grind pears in food chopper.  Mix with rest of ingredients and boil for 30 to 45 minutes.  Place in sterilized containers.

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA
ingredients:
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese
1  c. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
1/4  c. zucchini, sliced 1/4-inch thick
1/4  c. carrots, shredded
1/4  c. peppers
1/4  c. broccoli
1/2  c. olives
1/2  c. onion
14  oz. pizza sauce
preparation: May use any type of pizza crust.  Put sauce on crust, then layer ingredients any way you prefer.  Top with cheese.  Bake at 250° to 300° until crust is done and toppings melt together.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
1  pie shell
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. mashed potatoes
1  c. sweet milk
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
2  eggs
preparation: Add sugar and lightly beaten eggs to milk.  Beat until smooth. Bake until set firm.  Egg whites may be left out and used in meringue.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  c. rice
1  can mushroom soup
1  (8 oz.) Cheez Whiz
2  c. chopped chicken
preparation: Melt butter in skillet.  Pour small amount in pan.  Saute onion and celery.  Add uncooked rice, broccoli, 1 1/2 cups water, soup and cheese.  Add chicken.  Mix and heat together.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: FEEDER LEMONADE
ingredients:
1  part Jack Daniels
1  part Triple Sec
1  part sweet and sour mix
4  parts 7-Up
preparation: Add ice and stir.  Garnish with lemon slices and cherries.

name: SMOKED HAM OR TURKEY(To be cooked in charcoal smoker.)
ingredients:
1  large turkey or ham (you can do both at one time)
1  (20 lb.) bag charcoal (not with matchlight)
Cajun seasoning
cooking oil
charcoal lighter fluid
preparation: Season meat and rub with oil.  Soak 5 charcoals in charcoal lighter.  Place in pan of smoker and light.  Allow the 5 charcoals to turn white.  Put 1/2 of the 20 pound bag of charcoal on top of the original 5 charcoals.  Put these in gently by hand.  Do not dump quickly.  Install water pan and fill with water.  Install bottom grill.  Fill bottom rack first, if needed.  If you are only doing one meat, use the top rack only.  Cover with lid.  Allow to cook for 8 to 10 hours.  After 8 hours, check water.  Add water, if needed.  You may also add more charcoal at this time and leave meat on smoker until you are ready to eat.  Meat will not dry out as long as you keep water in pan.  It's best to smoke meat at night while you're sleeping and it will be ready in the morning (you may also add hickory chips for extra flavor, if wanted).

name: CHILI CON CARNE
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. margarine
6  onions
3  lb. ground beef
2  cans tomato sauce (6 oz.)
1  can tomato juice (large can)
1/2  tsp. Tabasco
2 to 4  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. Accent
preparation: Brown meat and onions in margarine. Add other ingredients and cook until done.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE BAKE
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
1  c. uncooked rice
1  fryer, cut up and seasoned
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Melt margarine in large casserole pan.  Add rice and soup and 3 cups water.  Mix well.  Place fryer in and bake, covered, at 325° for 2 hours.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped celery
1  large onion, chopped
3/4  stick oleo
3  c. broccoli (2 pkg.)
1 1/4  c. Minute rice (not cooked)
1  (8 oz.) Cheez Whiz
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  can mushrooms and liquid
preparation: Saute celery and onion with oleo.  Cook broccoli and drain. Mix all together.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: NUTTY SNACK MIX
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  box Quaker Oat Squares
2  c. pecans
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. margarine (1/2 stick)
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Put cereal and pecans in a cake pan.  Melt light corn syrup, brown sugar and margarine until boiling in the microwave for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, depending on the microwave.  Mix all well together and bake at 250° for approximately 1 hour, stirring every 20 minutes.  Cool and break into pieces.  This is a good recipe for gift giving at the holidays.

name: ROCK CANDY
ingredients:
3 3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. light corn syrup
1  c. water
preparation: Mix in large saucepan; stir until all sugar is dissolved, then cook to 310°.  Take off heat; add flavoring and food coloring. Pour onto powdered sugar covered cookie sheet.  Use your choice of flavoring.

name: EGGPLANT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  eggplant
1/2  lb. bread crumbs
1 small  can evaporated milk
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped pepper
1/4  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. oleo
dash of salt
2  eggs, slightly beaten
pepper to taste
sage to taste
1  tsp. pimento
dash of Accent
preparation: Peel, slice and soak eggplant in salt water overnight; drain well.  Soak bread crumbs in evaporated milk.  Saute remaining ingredients.  Combine all ingredients and pour into a casserole dish.  Top with grated Cheddar cheese.  Bake at 350° until done.

name: POTATOES AU GRATIN(Low-Fat)
ingredients:
4  c. peeled, finely chopped potatoes
1/2  c. low-fat cottage cheese
1/2  c. nonfat buttermilk
1  Tbsp. chives
2  tsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. shredded part skim Mozzarella cheese
1/2  tsp. paprika
vegetable spray
preparation: Cook potatoes in boiling water to cover for 8 minutes, or until tender (do not overcook).  Drain and set aside.  Combine cottage cheese and buttermilk in container of an electric blender or food processor; process until smooth.  Transfer to a large bowl.  Stir in potatoes, chives and next 3 ingredients.  Spoon into 1-quart casserole coated with cooking spray.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Sprinkle with cheese and paprika; bake an additional 5 minutes.

name: BOILED CHICKEN
ingredients:
chicken breasts
celery with leaves
onion
carrot
piece of fresh ginger
preparation: Remove skin from chicken breast; debone if desired.  Place chicken in a small stock pot; add some celery, onion and carrot and a piece of fresh ginger.  Add enough cold water to cover by 2 inches; bring to a boil.  Cook for 10 to 20 minutes or until chicken is tender and no sign of pink remains.  Do not overcook.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cooked, cut up chicken breasts
1  pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked
1  c. Miracle Whip
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  tsp. curry powder
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  c. shredded Cheddar
1 1/2 to 2  c. Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: In a 2-quart casserole dish put broccoli in, then cooked, cut up chicken.  Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over chicken and broccoli.  Bake 35 minutes in a 9 x 12-inch pan or 40 minutes for 2-quart deep dish at 350°.

name: EASY SWEET-N-SOUR MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
3  Tbsp. grape jelly
1 (12 oz.)  jar chili sauce
12  oz. water
1  egg
1/2  c. cooked rice
2  c. cooked rice
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix meat, salt and pepper, 1/2 cup rice and egg.  Make small meat balls (set aside).  In a large pot, combine chili sauce, grape jelly and water.  Mix well.  Add meat balls.

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA
ingredients:
2  cans crescent rolls
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
broccoli
frozen peas
grated or shredded cheese (Mozzarella and Cheddar)
8  oz. sour crem
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
cauliflower
frozen carrots
preparation: Lay out crescent rolls on a cookie sheet and bake.  Mix dressing ingredients.  Spread on crust when cooled.  Cut up veggies and put over crust.  Add cheeses.  Put under broiler until the cheese is melted.

name: LASAGNA ROLLS
ingredients:
9 lasagna noodles, cooked according to  pkg. directions
1  (15 oz.) container Sorrento Ricotta cheese
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, thawed and drained well
1  c. (4 oz.) Sorrento Mozzarella shredded cheese
1  egg, slightly beaten
1 (26 oz.)  jar Classico tomato/basil pasta sauce
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a medium bowl, combine Ricotta cheese, spinach, Mozzarella,  Parmesan and egg. Spread about 1/3 cup cheese mixture on each noodle.  Roll up lengthwise. Pour 1/2 cup pasta sauce into bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Arrange lasagna rolls, seam side down, in the dish. Top with remaining sauce. Cover with foil and bake 35 minutes. Garnish as desired.

name: SAUSAGE BREAD
ingredients:
frozen loaves bread dough
hot sausage
extra sharp shredded Cheddar cheese
egg
garlic salt
pepper
preparation: Mix egg, garlic salt and pepper.  Thaw bread dough at a time you can begin work on the dough as soon as thawed.  Fry sausage (two loaves of sausage bread are made from 1 1/2 pounds sausage). Drain off all grease and finely crumble.  Butter hands and spread bread dough out into a uniform (as possible) large rectangular shape.  Spread with mix with brush or hands on inside of bread dough.  Place crumbled sausage evenly down middle of rectangle. Sprinkle cheese down middle of rectangle on top of sausage (use 4 ounce minimum of cheese per loaf).  Carefully roll dough, using long side of rectangle into a loaf.  Pinch ends together.  It will be very big.

name: THREE BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can cut green beans
1 (1 lb.)  can cut wax beans
1 (1 lb.)  can kidney beans
1  small onion, sliced
1/2  green pepper, sliced (optional)
3/4  c. sugar
2/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. salad oil
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Drain and combine beans.  Add onions and peppers.  Mix the balance of the ingredients and pour over vegetables.  Toss and chill overnight or for a comparable time.  Toss again to coat ingredients and drain.

name: FRENCH BREAD
ingredients:
7 to 8  c. unsifted flour
1  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
3  pkg. yeast
3  Tbsp. margarine
sesame seed
2 1/2  c. very warm water
corn meal
peanut oil
1  egg white, beaten
1  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Mix 2 1/2 cups flour, sugar, salt and yeast; add margarine. Gradually add water and beat about 2 minutes.  Add 1 cup flour; beat.  Stir in enough flour to make stiff dough; knead a few times.  Divide into 4 equal pieces.  Roll each piece into a 15-inch long loaf.  Place on greased baking sheet sprinkled with corn meal.  Brush with peanut oil.  Cover with plastic wrap and freeze until firm.  Remove from baking sheet and wrap each loaf with plastic wrap; may keep frozen up to 6 weeks.  Remove from freezer; place on ungreased baking sheets, corn meal side down. Let stand, covered with plastic wrap, at room temperature, about 1 1/2 hours.  Let rise until double, about 1 1/2 hours more.  Gently brush with combined egg white and cold water and sprinkle with sesame seed.  Bake at 450° for 20 minutes.

name: SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients:
3 (7 oz.)  pkg. small frozen precooked shrimp
3 small  boxes macaroni, cooked
1  green pepper, diced
1 1/2  c. diced celery
2 small  jars diced pimento
1  onion, chopped
1  c. Western French dressing
Miracle Whip
preparation: Cook, drain and cool macaroni.  Combine first 6 ingredients. Mix together Western dressing and Miracle Whip.  The color should become a pale pink when enough Miracle Whip has been added.  Stir into first 6 ingredients.

name: HOMINY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  bell pepper
1  onion
1 large  can hominy, drained
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
preparation: Brown sausage, pepper and onion.  Add hominy and Ro-Tel tomatoes.	Simmer	30  minutes.  Pour  into  casserole  dish. Grate cheese over top.  Let cheese melt.

name: RUSSIAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
Chicken breasts
Canola oil for frying
Russian Salad Dressing
1  can apricots, drained
preparation: Brown chicken breasts in pan with canola oil.  Place in baking dish skin side up.  Brush Russian salad dressing over the chicken and add one can of drained apricots.  Bake at 350° until golden brown and tender (approximately 1/2 to 3/4 hour).  Serve over a bed of wild rice and garnish with steamed broccoli.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen broccoli or fresh broccoli, sliced lengthwise
chicken breasts, sliced and cooked
2  cans cream of chicken soup
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
shredded cheese
bit of paprika
preparation: Cook broccoli if frozen; drain.  Line baking dish with broccoli.  Place chicken on broccoli.  Mix soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice; pour over chicken.  Top with shredded cheese; sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  chicken, boiled and removed from bone
1  pkg. spaghetti, cooked in chicken broth
1  can tomato soup
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
grated cheese
1/2  stick butter
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
preparation: Saute butter, onion and celery in large skillet.  Add chicken and mixture of 1 1/2 cups broth, 1 can tomato soup, 2 tablespoons soy sauce and salt and pepper to taste.  Simmer while cooking spaghetti.  Mix spaghetti and sauce together.  Top with Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

name: CINNAMON BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  egg
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Roll into small balls about 1/2 size of a walnut.  Roll into cinnamon sugar.  Place on cookie sheet and bake at 250° for 15 minutes.

name: ICED ALMONDS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. blanched whole almonds, pecan halves, walnut halves or cashews
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Line baking sheet with foil; butter the foil.  In heavy 8-inch skillet, combine nuts, sugar and margarine.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly 9 minutes or until sugar melts and turns a rich brown color.  Remove from heat.  Spread mixture onto prepared baking sheet.  Cool completely.  Break into clusters. Store tightly covered.

name: MOM'S PENNSYLVANIA DUTCH OYSTER PIE
ingredients:
1  qt. oysters
3  ribs celery
1  small onion, chopped
3  to 4 medium potatoes
4  to 5 hard-boiled eggs
salt and pepper
water
milk
bought or prepared double crust pie pastry
preparation: Clean and chop celery and onion.  Wash, pare and dice potatoes.  Simmer celery, onion and potatoes together in skillet in enough water to cover and cook just until tender.  Add oysters and a little of the oyster liquor, salt, pepper and 1/2 cup milk; gently heat through.

name: FUDGE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
pinch of salt
1  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
2  Tbsp. light corn syrup
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients in large glass mixing bowl.  Add milk; stir.  Add margarine and corn syrup.  Microwave on High for 3 to 4 minutes or until thickened.  Stir in vanilla, mix well and serve hot or cold over ice cream or cake.

name: LEMONADE PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  can frozen pink lemonade
1  carton Cool Whip
1  graham cracker pie crust
red food coloring
preparation: Mix first three ingredients well.  Add a few drops of food coloring.  Pour into pie shell.  Refrigerate before serving.

name: MINESTRONE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. lean hamburg
4  oz. Italian sausage
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1  large sliced carrot
2  cloves garlic, chopped
1 (14 oz.)  can tomatoes, chopped
1  can kidney beans
3/4  c. uncooked macaroni
2  c. sliced cabbage
4  c. water
salt and pepper
1 large  tsp. chili powder
1  Tbsp. oregano
preparation: Brown hamburg and sausage together, then drain off fat.  In large pot, mix all together; bring to a boil.  Turn down heat and simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: PEANUT BLOSSOM COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. margarine
1  c. peanut butter
2  eggs
1/4  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
3 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. chocolate kisses
preparation: Mix sugars, margarine and peanut butter until creamy.  Add remaining ingredients, except kisses.  Mix well.  Roll into balls and roll in sugar.  Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes in an ungreased pan.  While hot, press chocolate kisses in center.

name: NEW MEXICO HOT CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
1 1/2  c. cold water
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
6  c. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
whipped cream for topping
preparation: Combine  sugar,  cocoa,  water  and  spices.  Cook over medium heat;  add  milk  and  scald.  Stir until smooth.  Add vanilla and  top  with  whipped cream.  Sprinkle with dash of nutmeg and cinnamon.  Makes 6 servings.

name: FREEZER DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
3  c. plain flour
1 1/4  sticks margarine
1/2  c. milk
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt margarine; cool, then add milk to margarine, then add egg and milk mixture to flour.  Mix together.  Make 3 balls.  Cool in icebox for 10 minutes.  Roll on floured board until thin.  Cut into strips and small pieces.  Place on cookie sheets that are covered with wax paper.  Freeze.  Next day, place in Ziploc freezer bags.

name: RANCH MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. finely chopped celery
1/4  c. finely chopped green pepper
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. soft bread crumbs
1/2  c. catsup
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Combine all ingredients in medium mixing bowl; mix well.  Pat into an 8 x 4-inch glass loaf dish.  Microwave on Roast (4) for 25 to 30 minutes or until well done in center.  Let stand, covered, 5 minutes before serving.  Drizzle with catsup and garnish with parsley.  Serves 5 to 6.

name: PECAN TURTLES
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. caramels
2  Tbsp. evaporated milk
2  c. broken pecans
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1  bar paraffin
preparation: Melt caramels and evaporated milk in a double boiler.  Then add broken pecans.  Beat with a wooden spoon until creamy.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased plate and let cool for 15 minutes. Melt semi-sweet chocolate along with paraffin in a double boiler. Using a toothpick dip caramel pecan turtle in the chocolate.  Then put back on waxed paper; let cool.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE(Club Member: Kristi Mayfield)
ingredients:
3  c. squash
1  onion, chopped
1 small  box Ritz crackers
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. grated cheese
preparation: Boil squash and onion until squash is tender; drain.  Mix onion, soup and squash.  In casserole dish, grease and crumble (1 pack out of box) Ritz crackers in bottom, then layer 1/2 of soup mixture, layer 1/2 of cheese, layer crackers, soup and cheese again.  Bake at 350° for about 25 minutes.

name: CHOW CHOW
ingredients:
2  c. ground tomatoes (green)
1  medium onion
1  hot pepper
1/4  tsp. turmeric
1/2  tsp. mustard seed
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  c. vinegar
1 1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Grind tomatoes, onion and pepper; drain juice.  Put spices in cheesecloth bag.  Add remaining ingredients and boil 15 to 20 minutes.  Pour in jars and seal.

name: VEGETABLE MARINATED SALAD
ingredients:
1  can mixed vegetables, drain well
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  can green beans, drained
1  can carrots, drained
1  chopped onion
Mrs. Dash seasoning (special blend)
1  bottle diet Italian dressing
6 to 7  Tbsp. white vinegar
preparation: Mix together and refrigerate for at least an hour.

name: PICNIC CAKE
ingredients:
1 (29 oz.)  can sliced peaches (undrained)
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  c. shredded coconut
1  c. pecans, chopped
3/4  c. melted oleo
whipped cream or ice cream
preparation: Arrange peach slices and juice evenly on bottom of ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly on top of peaches.  Sprinkle coconut evenly over cake mix and top with chopped nuts.  Drizzle melted butter evenly over top of mixture. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.  Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

name: CLYDE'S SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. mustard (dry)
1  small onion, grated
2  cans Campbell's tomato soup
3/4  c. cider vinegar
3  c. Mazola oil
preparation: Mix dry ingredients first, then add other ingredients.  Mix or shake well.  Store in refrigerator.  Makes approximately 1 1/2 quarts.  Delicious!

name: SUMMER SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. water
6  to 8 medium zucchini, sliced (6 c.)
1  c. shredded carrots
1/2  c. diagonally sliced celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. dairy sour cream
1/2  tsp. dill weed
10 3/4  oz. can condensed cream of chicken soup
6  oz. pkg. (4 c.) herb seasoned stuffing mix
1/2  c. margarine, melted
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease 3-quart casserole.  In 3-quart saucepan, bring water to a boil.  Add zucchini, carrots, celery and onion.  Cover and cook over medium heat about 5 minutes or until celery is crisp-tender.  Drain.  In small bowl, combine sour cream, dill weed and soup.  Add to cooked vegetables; mix.  In large bowl combine stuffing mix and margarine.  Spoon half of stuffing in bottom of prepared casserole.  Spoon vegetable mixture over stuffing mixture; sprinkle with remaining stuffing.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown and thoroughly heated.

name: THREE LAYER WATER CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  c. warm water
2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
preparation: Mix all together; bake at 350° in round pans.

name: LEMON JELLO CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jell-O cake mix
1  pkg. lemon Jell-O
3/4  c. oil
3/4  c. water
4  eggs
preparation: Mix cake mix and Jell-O.  Add oil and water.  Blend well.  Add eggs one at a time.  Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes in 9 x 12-inch pan or tube pan.

name: LIME JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. hot water
1 small  pkg. lime jello
1  c. evaporated milk
1 small  can crushed pineapple
3/4  pt. cottage cheese
nuts (if you like)
preparation: Dissolve jello in hot water.  Cool, then add other ingredients.  Mix well and chill.

name: LONG JOHNS
ingredients:
1  yeast
2  c. scalded milk or warm water
3/4  c. butter or shortening
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. lemon extract or orange
3  well beaten eggs
flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 3/4 cup lukewarm water; add 1 teaspoon sugar and let stand for 5 minutes.  Mix all ingredients and add enough flour to make a soft dough.  Let rise 3 times, then roll to about 1/4 inch thickness and cut into desired shape.  Bake in very hot grease.  Frost with powdered sugar frosting, crushed crackers and nuts.

name: CHUNKY POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
3  medium red potatoes
2  c. water
1  medium onion
3  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. flour
pepper
3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. sugar
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. cubed cooked ham
preparation: Peel potatoes and cut into 1-inch cubes.  Bring water to a boil in large saucepan.  Add potatoes and cook until tender.  Drain, reserving liquid.  Set aside potatoes.  Measure 1 cup reserved liquid, adding water if necessary; set aside.  Peel and finely chop onion.  Melt butter in saucepan over medium heat.  Add onion.  Cook until sautéed.  Add flour; season with pepper.  Gradually add potatoes, reserved 1 cup liquid, milk and sugar.  Stir well.  Add cheese and ham.  Simmer 30 minutes.

name: CRAB AND SHRIMP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. crabmeat
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. minced onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
butter
1  c. shrimp, cooked and peeled
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
pepper
bread crumbs
preparation: Mix all ingredients together except bread crumbs and butter. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.  Sprinkle bread crumbs on top and dab with butter.  Bake an additional 5 to 10 minutes, until bread crumbs are crusty.

name: TUNA MELT SANDWICHES
ingredients:
2 (6-oz.)  cans solid, white tuna, drained and chunked
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1 1/2  Tbsp. chopped celery
1  Tbsp. sweet pickle relish
8  slices bread
4  slices cheese
preparation: Combine tuna, mayonnaise, onion, celery and relish; mix well. Top 4 slices bread with one cheese slice.  Spread tuna mixture over the cheese and top with remaining bread.  Spread each sandwich with a wee bit of soft butter; slice in skillet.  Cook on medium heat until lightly browned on both sides.

name: STRAWBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. oil
1  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
4  eggs, beaten
3  c. sliced strawberries
preparation: Combine all dry ingredients.  Add eggs, oil, nuts and strawberries.  Stir until all ingredients are moistened.  Pour into 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes.

name: PORK CHOP SKILLET DINNER
ingredients:
6  pork chops
2/3  c. uncooked rice
1  c. water
2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can tomatoes
1  can whole corn
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Brown chops; remove from skillet and drain fat.  Spread rice over bottom of skillet.  Add water and salt.  Arrange chops over rice.  Add onion and tomatoes.  Spoon on corn.  Add pepper.  Bring to a boil.  Cover and turn heat to simmer.  Cook, covered, for 25 to 35 minutes.

name: HEARTY CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
1  (3 to 4 lb.) chicken
3  medium onions, sliced
1/2  c. rice, washed
1/4  c. barley, washed
1  can Veg-All
1/2  c. fresh string beans
3  celery stalks (whole)
4  large carrots, cut in half
preparation: Thoroughly rinse chicken.  Place all ingredients in a large pot.  Add salt, pepper, parsley and garlic to taste.  Add 1 tablespoon Gravy Master for color.  Cook for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

name: OVEN STEW
ingredients:
1  can cream of celery soup
2  cans water
carrots (as you like)
onions
1  can tomato soup
1  lb. lean stew meat
potatoes (as you like)
preparation: Combine  all  ingredients  in large bowl or Dutch oven. Salt and pepper to taste.  Cook 4 hours at 275°.

name: FISH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. haddock
8  oz. Velveeta cheese
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  c. cream of shrimp soup
2  Tbsp. bread crumbs
preparation: Boil fish in salted water until done.  Melt Velveeta, milk and shrimp soup until smooth.  Mix in fish.  Put in casserole dish; top with crumbs.  Keep warm in oven.

name: MIXED VEGETABLE PILAF
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
1/4  tsp. dried basil leaves, crushed
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can Campbell's condensed chicken broth
3/4  c. water
1  c. regular rice (uncooked)
1  small zucchini, halved lengthwise and sliced
1/2  c. shredded carrot
preparation: In 10-inch skillet over medium heat, in hot margarine, cook mushrooms and basil 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add broth and water; heat to boiling.  Stir in rice; return to boiling. Reduce heat to low.  Cover; simmer 15 minutes.   Stir in zucchini and carrot.  Cover; simmer 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Let stand covered 5 minutes before serving.  Makes about 5 cups or 6 servings.

name: SANDWICH SPREAD
ingredients:
1  ring bologna
1  medium onion
3  dill pickles
garlic powder
black pepper
1/2  c. Miracle Whip (maybe more)
preparation: Chop first 3 ingredients in food processor.  Add and mix garlic powder, black pepper and Miracle Whip.

name: PASTA VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. rainbow pasta, cooked
1  c. chopped carrots
1  c. chopped cauliflower
sliced mushrooms
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. whipping cream
1  c. peas
1  c. chopped broccoli
1  lb. ham, cubed
1/4  c. French dressing
1  can mushroom soup
salsa to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Heat at 350° for 40 minutes until hot.

name: NO BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  cup sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/4  cup milk
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  cup peanut butter
1 1/2  cup quick cooking oatmeal
dash of salt
preparation: Mix sugar, cocoa, milk and margarine in sauce pan.  Place on medium heat until it starts to boil;  boil for 1 minute and remove from heat.  Add vanilla, salt, peanut butter and oatmeal.  Stir well.  Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.  Cool.

name: SHRIMP COCKTAIL
ingredients:
1  lb. cooked small shrimp
1  chopped tomato
1/2  chopped, peeled, small white onion
1  minced, peeled, garlic clove
1  sliced seeded, fresh, jalapeno
1/2  c. extra-virgin olive oil
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
salt
white pepper
avocado
preparation: Peel shrimp.  Mix together shrimp, tomato, onion, garlic, and jalapeno.  Stir in olive oil and parsley; season to taste with salt and pepper.  Top with sliced avocado.  Serves 4.

name: BANANA BREAD SQUARES
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter
1/2  c. honey
1  egg
1/3  c. yogurt
3/4  c. unbleached flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1/4  c. rolled oats
3/4  c. mashed bananas
1/3  c. chopped nuts or sunflower seeds
preparation: Set oven to 350°.  In large mixing bowl, cream butter and brown sugar.  Add egg and yogurt.  Combine white flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon and sift into creamed mixture.  Add whole wheat flour, rolled oats, mashed bananas and nuts or seeds. Mix just to blend.  Turn into a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch or 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Bake 30 minutes at 350° or until center springs back to the touch and sides shrink away from pan.

name: DORIS' PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix flour, baking powder, soda and salt.  Add vanilla, egg and buttermilk; mix well.  Makes 1 quart.

name: CHERRY CRISP
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  box white cake mix
1  stick margarine
preparation: Melt margarine; mix with cake mix.  Will be crumbly.  Spread cherry pie filling in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle cake mixture over cherries evenly.  Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.

name: JEWISH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  or 4 apples, peeled and sliced thin
2  tsp. cinnamon
5  Tbsp. sugar
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
3  tsp. baking powder
6  oz. orange juice
4  eggs
1  c. vegetable oil
