2 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all together.  Pour a little of the batter in a pan.  Add some of the apple mixture.  Repeat until all is used up, ending with batter on top.  Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350°.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. raw apples
1  c. pecans
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. white sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
3  eggs
1  c. Wesson oil
1/2  c. water
preparation: Mix ingredients well and bake for 1 hour or until done at 350°.

name: WHIPPING CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. plain flour
3  c. sugar
2  sticks butter (not margarine)
6  eggs
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  tsp. lemon extract
preparation: Cream  sugar  and  butter.  Add  eggs,  one  at a time, beating   after  each  addition.  Add  flour;  mix  well.  Add extracts  and  cream.  Mix  thoroughly.  Bake  1  hour  and 25 minutes at  300°  in greased oblong cake dish.

name: CAJUN CABBAGE(Makes 10 Servings.  Prep Time: 20 Minutes.)
ingredients:
1  small cabbage, coarsely shredded
1  lb. mild sausage
1  lb. ground chuck
1  small onion, chopped
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can stewed tomatoes
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Brown sausage and ground beef with onion; drain. Mix Ro-Tel, stewed tomatoes, garlic powder, sugar, salt and pepper.

name: CHICKEN TROPICAL
ingredients:
3  lb. chicken fryer
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. red pepper
1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. cooking oil
1  (9 oz.) chunk pineapple with liquid
1/2  c. blanched almonds
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Wash chicken and pat dry.  Mix salt, pepper and flour.  Coat chicken.  Brown in oil.  When golden brown, add pineapple, raisins and almonds.  Cook in oven until tender, about 1 hour.  Remove chicken from sauce.  Put chicken in oven to crisp.  Serve sauce as gravy.

name: MARIA VILLA'S GINGER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. Shortening
1  c. Brown Sugar
1  Egg
1  c. Flour
1/2  tsp. Vanilla
1  tsp. Ginger
preparation: Mix ingredients well.  Spoon out on greased cookie sheet, about 1 teaspoon of dough per cookie.  Put 1/2 pecan on top of each.  Bake about 10 minutes at 350°.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup
3  Tbsp. sweet pickle relish
1/4  c. chopped onions
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: In saucepan, combine all ingredients.  Cover and simmer 10 minutes.

name: HOAGIE SANDWICH
ingredients:
ground chuck
onion
salt
pepper
garlic salt
spaghetti sauce
Mozzarella cheese
hoagie rolls
preparation: Chop onion.  Make hamburger balls, mixing in onion.  Add salt, pepper and garlic salt to taste.  Cook in 400° oven until done. Heat sauce.  Toast rolls.  Put hamburger on roll and cover with sauce.  Add cheese.

name: INDONESIAN CRAB CANAPES
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
1/4  c. roasted unsalted peanuts
1/2  lb. lump crabmeat
3  Tbsp. minced scallion
2  Tbsp. minced fresh parsley
1  minced garlic clove
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
1/2  c. mayonnaise
6  slices homemade white bread, toasted and quartered
preparation: Process everything except crab, scallions and mayonnaise until the peanuts are minced.  Mix with other ingredients.  Spread 1 tablespoon on each toast and bake in a preheated 450° oven for 10 minutes, or until they are browned lightly on top.  Garnish with parsley.  Serves 24.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CREME PIE
ingredients:
3  oz. cream cheese, soft
1/4  c. peanut butter
1  c. powdered sugar
9  oz. Cool Whip
graham cracker crust
preparation: Mix cream cheese with peanut butter until smooth.  Add powdered sugar and mix well (will be stiff).  Add Cool Whip, mix well.  Pour into prepared crust.  Chill before serving.

name: TEXAS BLUEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 3  oz. pkg. raspberry jello
1  c. boiling water
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1  can blueberries
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1 8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix jello in boiling water. Add blueberries, pecans and pineapple. Let mixture set. Mix cream cheese, sugar, sour cream and vanilla. Spread over jello and sprinkle with 1/2 cup pecans. Let set overnight.

name: CHINESE PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak
2  onions
2  green peppers
1  Tbsp. salad oil
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. apple cider vinegar
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Marinate strips of steak for 30 minutes in ingredients.  Heat a little oil in skillet and brown meat.  Add water to make gravy, then add onion and green pepper.  Simmer 45 minutes or longer. Serve over rice.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FINGERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1/3  c. peanut butter
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  c. quick oats
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1/4  c. peanut butter
2 to 4  Tbsp. evaporated milk
preparation: Mix these and spread on top with melted chocolate bits.  This makes the icing.  When cooled, cut into strips the size of a finger.

name: BEST BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. instant rice
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli, thawed
1/2  c. diced American cheese
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped celery
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of celery soup
preparation: Bring water and salt to a boil.  Add rice, cover and remove from heat.  Let sit for 5 minutes.  Melt butter in skillet; saute onion and celery until tender.

name: ITALIAN SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
2  tbsp. olive oil
3/4  cup chopped onion
1/4  cup finely chopped green pepper
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  lb. ground beef
1  can (1 lb.) tomatoes, chopped
1  can (15 oz.) tomato sauce
1  tbsp. chopped parsley
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1 12  oz. pkg. spaghetti
Parmesan cheese, grated
2  tsp. sugar
preparation: Heat oil in heavy skillet.  Add onion, green pepper and garlic and cook until onion is lightly browned.  Add meat and brown.  Then add tomatoes, tomato sauce and seasonings.  Cover and simmer slowly 1 1/2 - 2 hours, stirring occasionally.  Cook spaghetti according to package directions.  Serve with Parmesan cheese.

name: BUTTER BUNDT CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. butter
2 1/4  c. sugar
7  eggs
2 1/2  c. self-rising flour
2 1/2  tsp. pure vanilla
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add one egg at a time.  Stir in well. Stir in flour all at once.  Add vanilla.  Pour into prepared Bundt pan.  Bake 1 hour at 325°.  Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

name: SOUR CREAM CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising cornmeal
2  eggs
1  c. oil
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  can cream-style corn
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: BEEF AND VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lbs. ground chuck
2 -3  c. carrots, thinly sliced
2 - 3  c. potatoes, thinly sliced
1  can cream of celery soup
1/4  c. chopped onion
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Add chopped onion to ground chuck and cook until no pink is left. Drain well. Season with salt and pepper and place in the bottom of a casserole dish. Cover with sliced carrots and then potatoes. Mix soup with enough water to make 2 cups. Pour over the potatoes. Cover and bake at 350 until potatoes are done, approximately 35-40 minutes.

name: BROILED SANDWICHES
ingredients:
4  slices bread
mayonnaise
4  slices cheese (Swiss or Cheddar)
4  slices onion
4  slices tomato
4  slices bacon, cut in two
preparation: Spread mayonnaise on the bread and place on a baking sheet covered with aluminum foil and sprayed with Pam.  Add ingredients in the order listed.  Broil until the bacon is sizzling and crisp. Watch closely to be sure the cheese does not burn.  Serves 4.

name: NISSUA
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  c. milk
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/2  c. water
1 to 2  tsp. ground cardamon seed
6 to 7  c. flour
4  beaten eggs
preparation: Scald milk and butter in saucepan.  Pour over sugar and dissolve.  Mix yeast and water.  Add to slightly cooled sugar mixture.  Stir in cardamon, eggs and salt.  Add to this mixture flour, 2 cups at a time.  Cover and let rise.  Pour onto well floured surface.  Fold and knead.  Pour into greased loaf pans. Let rise again.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Upon removing from oven, rub top of loaf with butter.  Sprinkle lightly with granulated sugar.  Cool.  Makes 3 to 4 loaves.

name: SUE CROUCH'S PUNCH
ingredients:
1  qt. apple juice
1  can pineapple juice
2  large frozen lemonade (less water)
1  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Combine apple juice, pineapple juice and lemonade.  Sweeten to taste.  Add chilled ginger ale just before serving.

name: PEANUT BUTTER MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. Touch of Butter spread, melted
1  egg
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
3/4  c. peanut butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in large bowl.  Beat milk, peanut butter, spread, egg and vanilla; stir into flour mixture, just until moistened.   Spoon into greased muffin pan, filling each cup 3/4 full.  Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.  Cool 5 minutes, remove from pan. Makes 12

name: SUPER BOWL DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
15  oz. can chili
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
corn chips
preparation: Spread cream cheese on bottom of glass pie dish.  Spread on chili; top with Cheddar cheese.  Cover with wax paper and microwave for 3 minutes or until cheese melts.

name: CRANBERRY TEA
ingredients:
1  pint cranberry juice
6  oz. can frozen orange juice
6  oz. can frozen lemonade
1  c. sugar
2  c. water
3  sticks cinnamon
preparation: Boil the sugar, water and cinnamon together and then add the juices.  Color with red food coloring.  Mix equal parts with hot water to serve.

name: SOUR CREAM APPLE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1  c. chopped nuts
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  egg, beaten
2  c. chopped, peeled apples
whipped cream (optional)
preparation: In a mixing bowl, combine flour, brown sugar and butter. Blend at low speed until crumbly.  Stir in nuts.  Press about 2 3/4 cups into the bottom of an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.

name: PIZZA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1  clove garlic, minced
1  (8 oz.) tomato sauce
1  onion
1/2  lb. Mozzarella cheese, sliced
1 (6 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Mix ground meat and minced garlic.  Pat into a round 12-inch pan to form crust.  Mix tomato sauce and seasoning.  Spread over hamburger crust.  On top, add onion slices, cheese slices and drained mushrooms.  Sprinkle top with oregano and Parmesan cheese.  Bake with oven temperature at 375° for 20 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

name: VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
4  chicken bouillon cubes
1 1/2  c. diced potatoes
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  c. chopped carrots
20  oz. California Blend vegetables
2  cans cream of mushroom or chicken soup
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Dissolve bouillon in 1 quart of water.  Add potatoes, celery, onion and carrots; cook 15 minutes. Add the vegetables and cook 6 to 8 minutes. Add your soup and Velveeta cheese. Simmer until cheese melts.

name: QUICK APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/3  c. milk
2  tsp. baking powder
6  Tbsp. sugar or light brown sugar
3/4  c. whole wheat flour
small pinch of salt
1/3  c. oil
4  apples, peeled, cored and cut in thick 1/4-inch slices
1/2  c. cream or condensed milk
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Butter an 8-inch baking pan.  Beat eggs well; add milk.  Combine dry ingredients (not cinnamon) and beat into egg mixture; beat in oil.  Dough is quite firm and thick. Spread dough in pan.  Stand the apple slices on edge over entire surface of dough.  Bake 15 minutes.  Remove from oven; pour cream over surface and sprinkle with cinnamon.  Return to oven for another 25 minutes.

name: GROUND BEEF AND SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti
1 1/2  c. (6 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1  lb. hamburger
1  lb. hot sausage
1/4  c. onion
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. catsup
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Cook spaghetti;  drain.  Place  in  buttered  11  x 7 x 2-inch baking   dish.   Cover  spaghetti  with  cheese.  Cook hamburger, sausage  and  onion  until  brown;  drain.  Stir in tomato  sauce, catsup  and  Worcestershire  sauce  and  salt. Simmer 5  minutes. Pour meat over cheese;  refrigerate. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25 to 30 mintues.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  can refried beans
1  can black olives, chopped
1  pkg. taco mix
1  jar salsa
Cheddar cheese
1  bag tortilla chips
preparation: Brown hamburger; drain off grease.  Mix with remaining ingredients.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: BREADED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
1/2  c original bisquick
12  saltine crackers (1/2 c), crushed
1  tsp seasoned salt
1/4  tsp pepper
1  egg
2  Tbsp water
8  pork boneless loin chops 1/2 thick (about 2 lb)
preparation: Mix bisquick, cracker crumbs, seasoned salt and pepper in one bowl.  Mix eggs and water in another bowl.  Drop pork chops into egg mixture then coat with bisquick mixture.  Spray a 12 inch non-stick skillet with cooking spray, heat over medium high heat. Cook pork in skillet 8-10 minutes, turning once until pork is slightly pink in the middle.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box Escort crackers
1  chicken, boiled, deboned and cut up
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup (I use celery sometimes)
1  onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
margarine
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Saute onion and bell pepper in margarine.  Spray casserole with Pam.  Put in good layer of crushed crackers and dot with margarine.   Mix soups, chicken, sour cream, onions and pepper. Pour over crackers.  Add another layer of crackers and dot with butter.  Bake at 350° until bubbly.

name: DIRT DESSERT
ingredients:
1  1/2 large bags Oreo cookies
1/2  stick margarine
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
3  c. milk
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: You will need a new, clean clay or plastic flower pot and a new garden trowel and a bouquet of plastic flowers.

name: BANANA SPLIT PIE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
3  sticks oleo, softened
9  oz. whipped topping
5  bananas
1/2  c. chopped pecans
2 1/2  c. crushed pineapple, drained
2  eggs
2  c. powdered sugar
1 small  bottle maraschino cherries, cut into halves
preparation: Mix 1 stick oleo and crumbs together.  Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix eggs, 2 sticks oleo and sugar; beat for 15 minutes. Pour into crust.  Cut bananas and put on top.  Pour pineapple on top. Cover with whipped topping. Decorate with cherries and pecans.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE WHIP(Quick And Refreshing!)
ingredients:
1  c. prepared whipped topping
8  oz. carton orange flavored yogurt
11  oz. can mandarin orange sections, drained
macaroon crumbs or chopped nuts
preparation: In medium bowl, combine whipped topping and yogurt; stir until thoroughly mixed.  Fold in orange sections.  Spoon into serving dishes.  Garnish with macaroon crumbs.  Refrigerate until serving.

name: APPLE CRUMB LOAF
ingredients:
3  medium size tart apples
1  c. margarine
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. sour cream
2 2/3  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
4  tsp. cinnamon
dash of nutmeg
preparation: Quarter, core and peel apples.  Cut into 1-inch cubes.  Spread evenly on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until apples are tender but not mushy.  Remove from pan and cool.  Beat 1/2 cup margarine until creamy; add 1/2 cup sugar.  Beat well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Blend in sour cream.  Sift together 2 cups flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt and 2 teaspoons cinnamon.  Fold into margarine.  Add apples, folding in gently.  Pour half of the mixture into a greased, wax paper lined and greased again 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Cut remaining margarine into remaining flour, sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg until crumblike.  Sprinkle half of the crumb mixture over the batter; pour in remaining batter.  Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes until browned, pulled away from the edges and a toothpick inserted near center has no sticky dough adhering to it.  Cool in pan on rack 10 minutes. Carefully remove from pan.

name: TACO CORN BREAD
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  egg
1/2  onion, diced
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  pkg. corn meal muffin mix
2  Tbsp. sliced olives
1  can corn
1  c. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Combine beef, egg, onion, tomato sauce and taco seasoning. Brown in skillet until done.  Prepare corn meal muffin mix according to package.  Combine meat on bottom layer and then add corn and cheese to muffin mix.  Pour muffin mix over meat mixture. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until done.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  cooked pie crust (9-inch)
2  c. sliced strawberries
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. water
1  c. sugar
2 heaping  Tbsp. flour
2 heaping  Tbsp. strawberry Jell-O
3 or 4  drops red food coloring
preparation: Mix Jell-O and flour  with  sugar.  Put  in medium pot. Add water.  Cook until thickened.  Add food coloring and cool. Mash cream cheese.  Add a  little milk.  Spread over bottom of cooled crust.  Add  sliced  strawberries.  Pour  cooled  sauce over all. Chill and then spread top with Cool Whip.  Enjoy.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. hamburger
1/2  c. diced potatoes
1/2  c. diced carrots
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. rice
1  can tomato soup
1  c. boiling water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix and bake in greased, covered casserole for 1 hour at 350°. Grated cheese may be added during the last 10 minutes.

name: MACARONI AND SAUSAGE BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk pork sausage
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. elbow macaroni
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of celery soup
2/3  c. milk
3  beaten eggs
1 1/2  c. shredded processed American cheese
preparation: Cook macaroni according to package.  Cook sausage and onion until browned.  Drain off excess fat.  Combine sausage mixture, macaroni, soup, milk, eggs and cheese.  Place in 2-quart casserole.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: ONE-MINUTE DROP CANDY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. cocoa
1/4  c. butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. Quick cooking oats
pinch of salt
1/4  c. peanut butter
preparation: Bring first 4 ingredients to a rolling boil and boil for 1 minute.  Add remaining ingredients.  Drop on waxed paper.

name: VELVEETA CHEESE FUDGE
ingredients:
1  lb. oleo
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
4  lb. powdered sugar
1  c. cocoa
1  Tbsp. vanilla
chopped nuts
preparation: In pan, melt margarine and cheese.  Sift together sugar and cocoa.  Add cheese mixture.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Makes 2 (9 x 12-inch) pans.

name: CARROT BARS
ingredients:
2  eggs, well beaten
3/4  c. oil
1 large  jar junior size baby carrots (baby food)
3/4 to 1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
dash of salt
1 1/4  c. flour
preparation: Mix in order given; beat well.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan at 350°.  When cool, frost.

name: CARAMEL NUT CORN
ingredients:
12  c. popped corn
3  c. pecan halves
1  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/4  c. light corn syrup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Divide popcorn and nuts between two ungreased pans.  Cook brown sugar, butter, corn syrup and salt over medium heat until bubbly around edges.  Continue cooking for 5 minutes.   Pour over popcorn and nuts, stirring until corn is well coated.  Bake, uncovered, at 200°, stirring every 15 minutes for 1 hour.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
2  c. flour
2  tsp. vanilla
1 (16 oz.)  can fruit cocktail (including juice)
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. nuts
1/2  c. flaked coconut
1  stick margarine, melted
3/4  c. evaporated milk
preparation: Mix 1 1/2 cups sugar with eggs. Add salt, flour and baking soda. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla and fruit cocktail. Beat until fruit cocktail is in small pieces. Put batter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together brown sugar, nuts and coconut. Sprinkle over batter. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: NORMA'S HOT ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. warm water
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1  stick melted margarine
2  eggs, slightly beaten
2  pkg. dry yeast
6  c. flour
preparation: Combine yeast and warm water and stir until yeast is dissolved.   Add salt and sugar and stir until dissolved.  Add rest of ingredients at once.  Mix well (use hands if necessary). Let rise until doubled.  Punch down and form into any type roll desired.  Place in greased pans.  Let rise until doubled.  Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

name: CHOCOLATE PECAN DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. chopped pecans
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
1 small  box vanilla instant pudding
1 small  box chocolate instant pudding
3  c. milk
1  tub Cool Whip
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325° for 10 minutes; cool.

name: DAD'S SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger meat
1/2  onion, chopped
1  potato, sliced
1  can pork and beans
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 small  can tomato paste
1  Tbsp. barbecue sauce
1  Tbsp. ketchup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown hamburger in skillet.  Add everything, except the beans. Bring to a boil, then simmer on low for 1 hour.  Add pork and beans.  Simmer 5 more minutes.  Serves 6+.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. mashed bananas
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. buttermilk
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream sugar and butter.  Add eggs and beat well.  Sift flour, salt, baking powder and baking soda together and mix with butter mixture.  Add mashed bananas and vanilla, mix well.  Add buttermilk and nuts and stir well. Pour in 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch lightly greased loaf pan and bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until done.

name: TORTILLAS
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
enough water to make stiff
1/4  c. oil
preparation: Roll out.  Cook in skillet or on top of stove.

name: HEAVENLY SALAD
ingredients:
1  large Cool Whip
2 large  cans chunky fruit
1  c. mandarin oranges
1  pkg. walnuts, chopped
1 large  can diced pineapple
1  pkg. miniature marshmallows
5  large bananas, sliced
preparation: Drain all fruit.  Mix fruit well together.  Stir lightly so as not to mash fruit.  Add sliced bananas and chopped nuts.  Blend gently together.  Add marshmallows and blend in Cool Whip. Refrigerate overnight and serve.  Will fill a 9 x 13-inch glass cake dish.  Serves 12 to 16.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. melted margarine
1 1/4  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chocolate bits or finely chopped pecans or walnuts (optional)
preparation: Stir by hand.  Mix margarine and sugar.  Add eggs.  Stir in dry ingredients.  Add vanilla, chocolate bits or nuts (if using). Grease and flour pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes if using an 11 x 7-inch pan.  Bake at 325° for 25 minutes if using a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cut after the brownies have been out of the oven for 2 to 3 minutes.  Makes 18 brownies.

name: CHOW MEIN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. diced celery
2  c. water
1  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
1  medium onion, chopped fine
2  Tbsp. bacon drippings
1  can mushroom soup (undiluted)
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 (3 oz.)  can chow mein noodles
preparation: Saute beef, onion and celery in bacon drippings for 10 minutes, stirring frequently.  Add remaining ingredients except noodles.  Put into casserole and bake at 350° for one hour. Sprinkle noodles on top after baking and serve.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SOUTHWESTERN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  c. flour
1  c. cornmeal
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
2  egg whites
3/4  c. fat-free milk
1/4  c. canola oil
1  c. shredded reduced-fat Cheddar cheese
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies
preparation: In a food processor or blender, coarsely chop corn; set aside. In a bowl, combine flour, cornmeal, baking soda and salt. In a small bowl, combine egg, egg whites, milk and oil. Stir into dry ingredients until moistened. Add cheese, chilies and corn. Pour into a 9-inch square baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Serve warm.

name: MS. ICIE'S CORNBREAD
ingredients:
3  c. self-rising corn meal
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  large egg
2  c. buttermilk
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Grease skillet or muffin pan.  Place corn meal in large mixing bowl.  Stir egg and milk into the same bowl.  Mix these ingredients very well.  Add vegetable oil and sugar.  Stir until batter is pourable.  Pour batter into prepared skillet or pan.  Bake for 35 minutes or top surface is golden brown.  Yields 8 servings per mixture.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. bag frozen hash brown potatoes
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  stick margarine (cubed)
salt and pepper to taste
1  pt. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  c. shredded Colby cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Cover with foil and bake until bubbly.  When casserole is about done, top with 1 cup crushed corn flakes and 1/2 stick melted margarine, mixed.  Leave foil off and continue to bake until lightly brown.

name: TWINKIE CAKE
ingredients:
2  boxes of Hostess Twinkies
1 Lg.  box of Strawberry Jello
2  sm. containers of Cool Whip
1  pkg. of strawberries - washed & sliced
preparation: Arrange Twinkies in a 13x9 pan.  Make jello according to package directions.  When jello begins to stiffen after approximately 30 minutes in refrigerator, add 1 container of cool whip to jello and mix together using mixer.  Use 1/2 of the strawberry slices to layer over Twinkies.  Then pour jello/cool whip mixture over Twinkies & strawberries.  Chill for 2-4 hrs. before serving.  Top with 1/2 tub cool whip and rest of strawberry slices.

name: SWEET POTATOES WITH PECAN TOPPING
ingredients:
1 large  can sweet potatoes, drained
3/4  stick butter
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. Carnation milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. pecans
1/2  c. plain flour
3/4  stick butter
preparation: Combine the first 6 ingredients in a saucepan.  In a separate pan, mix the brown sugar, pecans, flour and 3/4 stick butter and heat.  Put sweet potato mixture in casserole dish.  Pour second mixture over them.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: INSTANT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  piece bread
1  piece cheese
1  tomato
preparation: Place piece of bread on a small pan.  Put on 1 sliced tomato first and then a slice of cheese.  Place in oven for 2 minutes. Great for afterschool snack.

name: GARLIC SOUFFLE(6 Persons)
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter
5  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  c. half and half
1  c. heavy cream
salt
bouquet garni (1 small onion, peeled and quartered, 1 clove unpeeled garlic, 1/2 tsp. dried thyme, 1 bay leaf, 4 sprigs parsley, 10 black peppercorns, tied in cheesecloth)
2  large heads garlic
1/2  c. light olive oil
1/2  c. water
2 1/2  tsp. dried thyme
2  bay leaves
5  egg yolks
3  oz. freshly grated Gruyere
5  oz. freshly grated Parmesan
1 heaping  Tbsp. garlic puree
salt, cayenne and black pepper to taste
1  c. unbeaten egg whites
preparation: In a double boiler, make a roux of the butter and flour and cook it slowly for 5 to 8 minutes.  Mix the creams together and scald.  Remove the roux from the heat and whisk in the scalded creams.  Add the bouquet garni; cover and cook over slowly simmering water for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally.  Cool slightly before adding the rest of the ingredients.  Remove bouquet garni.  (Can be made ahead.)

name: BACON WRAPPED SHRIMP AND CHESTNUTS
ingredients:
1  lb hormel black label bacon
20  lb shrimp  peeled and deveined
8  oz c whole water chestnuts
1/2  c teriyaki sauce
1/2  c BBQ sauce
Toothpicks
preparation: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Cut bacon in half and cook. Don't let it get crispy. Wrap Bacon around shrimp and chestnuts (separately not together).  Place shrimp in 8 in glass baking dish. Brush shrimp with teriyaki sauce. Place chestnuts in separate glass baking dish and brush with BBQ sauce.  Place in oven and bake for 10 to 20 minutes or until the bacon is crisp.

name: NO-FAIL FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3/4  c. margarine
1 (5 oz.)  can evaporated milk (2/3 c.)
1 (7 oz.)  jar marshmallows (2 c.)
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Butter a 13 x 9-inch pan.  In large saucepan, combine the first 3 ingredients.  Heat to boiling, stirring frequently. Reduce heat; simmer for 5 to 8 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Add marshmallows and chocolate chips; blend well.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Pour into prepared pan.

name: CHEESE SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage
1  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
3  c. Bisquick
preparation: Mix all ingredients together until crumbly.  Form into small balls.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 400° for 10 minutes.

name: SCRIPTURE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Judges 5:25 (last clause)
1  c. Jeremiah 6:20
1  Tbsp. 1 Samuel 14:25
3  Jeremiah 17:11
1  c. 1 Samuel 30:12 (second food)
1  c. Nahum 3:12, chopped
1/4  c. Numbers 17:8, blanched or chopped
2  c. 1 Kings 9:9
2  Chronicles 9:9
pinch of Leviticus 2:13
1  tsp. Amos 4:5
3  Tbsp. Judges 4:19 (last sentence)
preparation: Sift together 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Leviticus and Amos.  Add to first mixture.  Lastly, add Judges.  Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

name: BANANA FIZZ FAVORITE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jell-O (any flavor)
3/4  c. boiling water
1/2  c. cold water
ice cubes
1  banana, sliced
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.  Combine cold water and ice cubes to make 1 1/4 cups.  Add to Jell-O; stir until thickened. Remove any unmelted ice.  Put banana slices into glasses.  Measure out 1 1/3 cups Jell-O and spoon over banana slices.  Whip remaining Jell-O with electric mixer until fluffy, thick and about doubled.  Pour over Jell-O in glasses.  Refrigerate until firm, about 1 hour.  Makes 4 servings.

name: MEAT CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. finely shredded carrots (optional)
3  c. finely shredded cabbage
1  tsp. salt
dash of black pepper
1 (16 oz.)  jar herb style spaghetti sauce
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce (optional)
1  Tbsp. chopped chives
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: In medium skillet, saute onion in butter until soft, not brown.  Add ground meat.  Cook until meat loses pink color.   In a 2-quart casserole, layer the carrots and half the cabbage. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Add meat mixture.   Press down slightly.  Add remaining cabbage to spaghetti sauce.  Add Worcestershire sauce and chives; pour sauce over top of casserole. Cover and bake at 350° for about 1 hour.  Add cheese on top. Bake uncovered for 5 to 8 minutes until cheese is melted.  Serve immediately.

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drain some of the juice
1  can chopped pecans
1  can strawberry pie filling
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Mix all ingredients together, mixing well.  Refrigerate.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. chopped apples
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. oil
3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix apples and sugar.  Let set for 1 hour.  Then add and mix together the rest of the ingredients.  Grease and flour Bundt cake pan or 2 loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes.

name: CANDIED PECANS
ingredients:
4  egg whites
2  c. sugar
1/2  lb. butter
8  c. pecans
preparation: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan with 2-inch sides.  Beat egg whites.  Add sugar.  Fold in pecans.  Add to pan with melted butter; mix well.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.  Pour out onto wax paper.  Break apart; cool.  Store in airtight container.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bag Doritos chips
1  chicken, cooked, deboned and cut in small pieces
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. chicken broth
1 small  jar taco sauce (mild)
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies
2  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Place Doritos and then chicken on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients except for cheese and pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 325°.

name: CHERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained
1  carton Cool Whip
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.

name: CHOCOLATE PUDDING DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick butter
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  c. powdered sugar
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 small  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
2  c. milk
preparation: Mix softened butter, flour and pecans.  Press in 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Bake 15 minutes at 350°; cool completely.

name: CANNED SALSA
ingredients:
10  lb. tomatoes (before cored)
4  medium size green peppers
5  medium size onions
8  hot banana peppers
4  jalapeno peppers (good size)
3  nice garlic cloves
1/2  c. vinegar
1/4  tsp. coriander
1/2  tsp. cilantro
1/2  tsp. seasoned pepper
preparation: Peel and chop tomatoes; bring to a simmer 10 minutes.  Add cut up vegetables, spices and vinegar.  Cook over low heat until desired thickness.  Put in sterile jars; place jars in hot bath and boil for 20 minutes.  Makes 7 to 8 pints.

name: APPLESAUCE-OAT MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. Cheerios cereal, crushed (about 1 c.)
1 1/4  c. self-rising flour
1/3  c. packed brown sugar
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  c. applesauce
1/3  c. skim milk
1/2  c. raisins
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  egg white
preparation: Mix cereal, flour, brown sugar and cinnamon in a large bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients just until moistened.  Heat oven to 400°.  Grease bottoms only of 12 medium muffin cups.  Bake until golden brown, 18 to 22 minutes.

name: RED CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Crisco
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. cake flour
1  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  oz. red food coloring
1  c. buttermilk
1  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs and make paste of cocoa, coloring and vanilla and blend into fat mixture.  Add salt, flour and buttermilk.  Mix soda and vinegar; add this while foaming and mix well.  Bake at 350° about 35 minutes or until done.  Use 2 (8-inch) cake pans.  Split layers to make four.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
2/3  cup sugar
1/3  cup margarine
2  eggs
1-3/4  cup flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  cup mashed banana
preparation: Mix sugar, margarine and eggs until fluffy.  Sift flour, baking powder and baking soda together.  Add 1 cup mashed bananas and stir ingredients together until smooth.  Pour into two 7-1/2 x 3-1/2 inch bread pans.  Bake at 350 degrees for 35 - 40 minutes.

name: LAZY MAN'S LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  large green pepper
1  medium onion
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1 large  jar spaghetti sauce
garlic powder
shredded cheese
macaroni
mushrooms, if desired
preparation: Brown green pepper, onion and hamburger in skillet.  Season to taste with garlic powder.  Cook macaroni as specified on box.  Mix hamburger mixture, spaghetti sauce, shredded cheese and macaroni in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan (add mushrooms, if desired).  Bake at 350° for 1/2 to 3/4 hour, or until cheese is melted.

name: CHICKEN CORN SOUP
ingredients:
1  small stewing chicken
1/2  c. chopped celery
2  tsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
6  qt. corn (more if needed)
preparation: Cook  chicken  until  tender.  Bone  and  remove  skin. Remove fat.  (This  can be done early).  Combine all ingredients and add to  chicken and broth.  Simmer for approximately 1/2 hour.  You may season to suit your taste.

name: APRICOT NECTAR CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
1/2  c .sugar
3/4  c. Wesson oil
1  c. apricot nectar
1  box lemon supreme
preparation: Mix and bake as directed on box in angel food cake pan.

name: NUT ROLL
ingredients:
1  box vanilla wafers, crushed
3  c. pecans, broken up
1  c. red cherries, cut up
1  c. green cherries, cut up
1  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Mix well by hand. Roll in coconut.  Makes 4 rolls.  Put in foil and let stay overnight.

name: GELATIN SHAKERS
ingredients:
4 regular or 2 large  pkg. gelatin, any flavor
2 1/2  c. boiling water
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill until firm, about 3 hours.  Cut into squares or press cookie cutters into gelatin.  Lift shapes from pan and serve.

name: MELTING MOMENTS - ENGLAND
ingredients:
1/2  c. cornstarch
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. sifted flour
3/4  c. margarine
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Sift cornstarch, confectioners sugar and flour together.  Blend in margarine with spoon.  Mix until soft, smooth dough forms.  Shape into balls, logs or crescents.

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. cocoa
3/4  tsp. salt
3  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. dates, chopped
1 1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. applesauce
preparation: In a large mixing bowl combine eggs, sugar, shortening and applesauce; stir well.  Sift dry ingredients; add a little at a time to the mixture.  Stir until smooth.  Bake at 350° until light brown.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  c. water
4  c. peanuts
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix sugar, syrup and water; cook until mixture spins a thread. Pour in peanuts.  Cook until light brown.  Add salt, butter, soda and stir.  Mixture will foam.  Pour immediately on buttered aluminum foil.  Let spread.  Best stored in glass containers. Will freeze.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. oil
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  jars jr. baby carrots (stage 2)
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Sift together first 4 ingredients and set aside.  Beat oil and sugar together; add eggs, one at a time.

name: CHICKEN/STUFFING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 to 3  c. chopped cooked chicken
1  pkg. stuffing mix, prepared according to pkg. directions
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  small container sour cream
salt and pepper to taste
butter
preparation: Combine chicken with soup and sour cream, salt and pepper and mix well.  Put into buttered casserole dish.  Top with prepared stuffing mix.  Put small pats of butter, 3 to 4, on top of stuffing around casserole.  Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes until bubbly.  Serves 4 to 6 people.

name: EASY PARTY FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
2 (29 oz.)  bottles ginger ale
1  large seedless lemon
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen pineapple juice
5  c. water
1  large seedless orange
strawberries
preparation: Mix frozen juice concentrates and water in punch bowl.  Five minutes before serving, add ginger ale and ice cubes or ice frozen in ring mold.  Cut orange, lemon and strawberries into thin slices and float in punch.

name: BANANA SALAD
ingredients:
1  tsp. flour
1  egg
pinch of salt
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
3/4  c. water
salted peanuts
bananas
preparation: Mix the flour, salt, egg, brown sugar and vinegar.  Add water and cook until thickened, stirring constantly.  Cool.   Spoon over sliced bananas and sprinkle with peanuts.

name: CHICKEN MARINADE
ingredients:
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. red wine vinegar
1  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. garlic powder with parsley
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Combine ingredients and pour over chicken in nonmetal dish. Cover and refrigerate overnight and turn occasionally.  Use marinade to baste chicken while cooking/grilling.

name: GRANDMA'S BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. butter
1  c. sugar
3  c. flour
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Cream butter and sugar together.  Add beaten eggs, then flour. Mix well.  Drop by spoonful on cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for about 10 minutes, but watch carefully.

name: GRANNY OYZORT'S FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. soda
2  c. sugar
3  c. diced apples
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. flour
preparation: Cream the eggs, sugar and margarine.  Add diced apples and vanilla.  Mix in dry ingredients.  Bake in an 18 1/2 x 11-inch pan until brown and springy to touch.

name: CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. butter
4  c. milk
3  c. 1/4-inch sliced, boiled potatoes
2  c. canned corn
salt and pepper
dash of cayenne
preparation: Saute onion in butter to a golden brown.  Combine in saucepan. Bring to boiling.

name: CREAM CHEESE CHILI DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can Hormel chili (no beans)
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
tortilla chips
preparation: Spread cream cheese in bottom of a 9-inch baking dish.  Spread chili over cream cheese.  Top with grated Cheddar cheese.  Bake at 375° until Cheddar cheese is melted and mixture bubbles.  Serve with your favorite tortilla chips.

name: SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN
ingredients:
2/3  c. pineapple juice (no sugar added)
1/4  c. each: teriyaki sauce and rice vinegar
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. each: honey and prepared mustard
1  garlic clove, sliced
1-inch piece ginger root, pared and sliced (optional)
3  lb. chicken parts, skinned
preparation: In glass or stainless steel bowl, combine all ingredients except chicken; add chicken and toss to coat.  Cover bowl and refrigerate for at least 8 hours, occasionally tossing chicken in marinade.  Remove chicken from marinade; remove and discard garlic and ginger.  In blender container, process marinade.  Arrange chicken parts in disposable aluminum roasting pan; grill over hot coals until tender, basting occasionally with some of the marinade. Transfer chicken and pan juices to serving platter.  In small saucepan, bring remaining marinade to boil; serve with chicken. Makes 4 servings.

name: HOMEMADE EGG NOODLES
ingredients:
3  egg yolks
1  whole egg
3  Tbsp. cold water
1  tsp. salt
2  c. flour
preparation: Beat yolks and egg well.  Beat in water and salt.  Stir in flour with spoon (dough is stiff).  Knead in last of the flour. Divide into 3 parts.  Roll each piece as thin as possible on lightly floured working area.  Place on paper towels until dough is dry enough for cutting with a thin, sharp knife.  Cut into strips of desired widths (1/8-inch to 3/8-inch).  Shake strips and allow to dry before using, storing or freezing in sealed container.  Cook in desired amount of chicken or turkey broth until tender.  Makes 6 cups or 10 ounces.

name: FUDGE
ingredients:
2/3  c. undiluted evaporated milk
1 2/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. marshmallows
1 1/2  c. chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix first three ingredients in a saucepan over low heat. Bring to a boil.  Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Add last 4 ingredients to the pan.  Stir one to two minutes until it is all melted.  Pour into 9-inch pan.

name: CREAM PUFFS
ingredients:
1  c. water
1/4  tsp. salt
4  large eggs
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. flour
preparation: Place water, butter and salt in medium saucepan.  Bring to a boil.  Remove from heat.  Stir in flour.  Beat until mixture leaves sides of pan.  Cool 1 minute.  Add eggs, one at a time until mixture is smooth and glossy.  Use pastry bag or cookie shooter and make 1 to 1 1/2-inch mounds, 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet.  Bake 15 minutes at 450°.  Reduce heat to 350° and continue to bake for 30 minutes or until puffs are golden brown with dry rigid sides.  Make slit in the side of each puff with a small knife.  Cool. Fill with pudding, whipped cream or whatever you desire.

name: GOLDEN MACARONI RING
ingredients:
shells and Cheddar
1 1/2  c. hot milk
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
2  well beaten eggs
2  Tbsp. each:  minced parsley, minced onion and chopped pimiento
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Pour into well-greased ring mold; set in pan of water (1-inch deep).  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes, or until set.  Unmold on hot platter; fill center with creamed seafood, chicken, ham or vegetable.  Makes 8 plentiful servings.

name: KIELBASA AND VEGGIES OVER LINGUINI
ingredients:
1  lb. turkey kielbasa
1  pkg. low-salt chicken broth with water
1  zucchini, sliced in strips
1  summer squash, sliced in strips
1  tsp. basil
1  small onion, cut in wedges
preparation: Put chicken broth and water in skillet over medium heat. Add zucchini, squash, onion and basil.  Cover; simmer until veggies become tender.   Add kielbasa.   Put on low.    Cook up linguini.   Drain.   Add kielbasa and veggies to linguini.   Serve in plates and enjoy.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
1 1/3  C. mayonnaise
1 1/3  C. sour cream
2  Tbsp. dill weed
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. onion salt
1  round loaf rye bread
preparation: Mix and fill the loaf of bread.

name: CHILI SAUCE MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  1/2 lbs. ground chuck
1  egg
1  tsp. garlic powder
2  Tbsp. parmesan cheese
8-10 cracker crumbs
preparation: Mix above and form into balls.    Brown, turning often to brown all sides.    Remove from pan and drain grease.

name: MACARONI MAGIC CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. salt
3  qt. boiling water
2  c. elbow macaroni
1  c. diced turkey, chicken or tuna
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Add 1 tablespoon salt to rapidly boiling water.  Gradually add macaroni so that water continues to boil.  Cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally until tender; drain.  Combine macaroni and remaining ingredients.  Mix well; turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake in 375° oven 20 to 25 minutes.  Makes 4 servings.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow squash
3  medium onions, chopped
1  stick oleo
2  Tbsp. self-rising cornmeal
3  Tbsp. sugar
8  crackers, crushed
1  c. grated cheese
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Combine lightly.  Pour into buttered casserole dish.  Cover with more crumbs and cheese.  Bake at 350°  for 20 minutes or until brown.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  can tuna, drained and flaked
2  c. cooked macaroni, drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk or more
1  c. green peas
1/2  c. grated cheese
1 1/4  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Cook macaroni and drain.  Empty soup into small casserole dish; add milk, tuna, peas, cheese and macaroni.  Stir.  Top with crushed potato chips.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

name: BARBECUED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
8  or 10 pork chops
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green peppers
1/2  c. catsup
1/3  c. vinegar
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
pepper to taste
preparation: Mix and pour over pork chops.  Cook in oven.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
2  boxes vanilla instant pudding
1  box banana instant pudding
1 small  carton sour cream
1  tub Cool Whip
vanilla wafers
bananas
5  c. milk
preparation: Mix pudding and milk according to directions on box.  Then mix in sour cream and Cool Whip.  Layer this mix in a large bowl along with vanilla wafers and bananas.  This mix keeps well in the refrigerator and then layer with cookies and bananas when ready to serve.

name: HOT LEMON SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2 or 1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 or 2  c. water
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  tsp. grated lemon rind
2  Tbsp. lemon juice or juice from 2 lemons
dash of salt
preparation: Mix well all ingredients.

name: BOSTON BROWN BREAD MUFFINS(Low-Fat)
ingredients:
1/2  c. rye flour
1/2  c. yellow cornmeal
1/2  c. whole wheat flour
3/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  egg
1/3  c. molasses
1/3  c. dark brown sugar
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. raisins
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Pam spray a 12 cup muffin tin.  Mix together flours, cornmeal and baking soda in large bowl until blended.  In a small bowl, combine egg, molasses, brown sugar, oil and buttermilk.  Stir or beat to blend.  Stir the egg mixture into the flour mixture and mix well.  Add raisins and stir.  Fill muffin tins about 1/2 to 2/3 full.  Bake for 15 minutes, or until a tester comes out clean when inserted into the center of a muffin.  Don't overbake.  Serve hot.  Makes 1 dozen muffins.

name: SAUERKRAUT AUF BAYISCHE ART(Bavarian Style Sauerkraut)
ingredients:
2  lb. sauerkraut
1  or 2 onions, sliced
2 or 3  slices bacon, diced
2  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. caraway seed
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. beef bouillon
1/2  c. white wine
preparation: Rinse sauerkraut with warm water 2 times; drain well.  Cook onion and bacon in butter until onion is soft.  Add the drained kraut, caraway seed and sugar.  Cover tightly.  Cook 1/2 hour. Add bouillon and wine.  Simmer 1/2 hour longer or until kraut is cooked to your taste.  Serve as vegetable with sauerbraten of Kalbshaxe, or top with a selection of pork products such as boiled thick slabs of bacon, Bratwurst, frankfurters or Regensburg sausage.  On such a plate, Ernspuree and mashed potatoes are always served.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: SAD CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Light Crust buttermilk biscuit mix
1  box (1 lb.) dark brown sugar
4  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes.  If desired, when cake is done sprinkle top with powdered sugar.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
1  pkg. Knorr dry vegetable soup mix
1 small  can chopped water chestnuts, drained
1  can diced Ro-Tel tomatoes (optional)
preparation: Thaw and drain spinach very well.  Mix all ingredients together and chill.  Serve with crackers or Hawaiian bread.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can tuna fish
1  can condensed soup (cream of chicken)
1/2 plus  c. liquid
1  c. peas or mixed vegetables
1  oz. or 1 c. potato chips or crackers
1/2  tsp. margarine for pan
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Crush potato chips.  Flake tuna into bite-size; add soup and vegetables.  Pour into greased pan.  Bake 10 to 25 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI PUFFS
ingredients:
2  medium zucchini
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. basil
preparation: Slice zucchini in 36 (1/4-inch) rounds.  In small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients.  Spread each zucchini slice with a thin layer of mayonnaise mixture and place in broiler pan. Broil 5-inches from heat in preheated broiler 30 to 60 seconds or until top is golden brown.  Each round is about 20 calories.

name: PORK CHOPS ITALIAN
ingredients:
4  to 6 pork chops
1  can cream-style corn
2  Tbsp. green peppers, cut into small pieces
1  Tbsp. onion, chopped
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1  egg, beaten
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
salt and pepper
preparation: Brown pork chops lightly.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Place pork chops in baking pan and cover with combined corn, peppers, onions, bread crumbs, egg, butter, salt and pepper.  Add just enough water to cover the bottom of the pan.  Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour in 350° oven.

name: EIGHT VEGETABLE RELISH(My Mother Called This:  Hayden Salad)
ingredients:
2  qt. peeled, cored, chopped green tomatoes
1  qt. peeled, cored, chopped ripe tomatoes
1  qt. coarsely chopped cabbage
3  c. chopped onion
2  c. chopped celery
1  c. peeled and chopped cucumber
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. chopped sweet red pepper
1/2  c. pickling salt
2  qt. vinegar (5% acidity)
4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1  Tbsp. whole mustard seed
1  Tbsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
2  cloves garlic, minced
preparation: Combine first  8  ingredients  in  a large mixing bowl; add salt, mixing well.  Cover and let stand in a cool place 12 to 18 hours.  Drain well and set aside.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH ROLLS
ingredients:
18  unbaked frozen rolls
1  pkg. cooked-type butterscotch pudding
1/2 to 1  c. nuts
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Grease Bundt pan or tube cake pan. Arrange rolls.  Sprinkle pudding mix and nuts over rolls.  Melt butter and mix with brown sugar.  Pour over rolls.  Set in cold oven overnight.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Let set for 5 minutes, then turn out.

name: EASY COLOR COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. Crisco
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. granulated sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. water
1  egg
1  c. plus 2 tsp. flour (all-purpose)
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. M&M's plain chocolate candies
preparation: Blend Crisco and sugars. Beat in vanilla, water and egg.  Sift remaining dry ingredients together; add to the sugar and egg mixture. Mix well. Stir in M&M's candy. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Makes about 3 dozen 2 1/2 inch cookies. For additional color, press M&M's candies into cookies before baking.

name: CHOCOLATE SCRATCH CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
3  c. flour
1  c. milk
4  tsp. baking powder
3  Tbsp. cocoa or to taste
preparation: Cream shortening; add sugar and cocoa.  Add unbeaten egg and vanilla; beat thoroughly. Sift flour and baking soda.  Add flour mixture alternately with milk to sugar mixture.  Pour in well-greased pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch) or layered pan.  Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

name: UGLY DUCKLING PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. lemon instant pudding
1 (16 oz.)  can fruit cocktail including syrup
1  c. Angel Flake coconut
4  eggs
1/4  c. oil
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Blend together well all ingredients except brown sugar and nuts in a large bowl.  Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.  Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed.  Do not underbake.  Cool in pan 15 minutes.  Spoon hot butter glaze over warm cake.

name: ORANGE SLICE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. pecans
1  c. coconut
1  c. orange slice candy, chopped
2  c. dry oatmeal
preparation: Mix all ingredients in the order they appear.  Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 325°.   Do not overbake.

name: POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. hash browns
8  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can celery soup
1  medium onion, grated
1/2  pt. sour cream
Ritz crackers
preparation: Combine all ingredients except crackers in a greased casserole.  Mix and top with broken cracker crumbs.  Bake at 350° until bubbly.

name: BAKED PORK CHOPS AND MUSHROOM SOUP
ingredients:
4  to 5 pork chops
2  cans mushroom soup
salt and pepper
onions (if desired)
preparation: Brown pork chops in a little oil.  After browning, put in a baking pan and pour mushroom soup over chops (spread soup around to cover chops good).  You can add onions also for added flavor. Bake at 350° for about an hour or until done.  This is good with mashed potatoes because the soup is going to make a tasty gravy.

name: HAMBURGER STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. brown gravy mix
1  large onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Season ground beef with salt and pepper.  Shape into 4 large patties.  Brown in large skillet.  Mix brown gravy as directed on package plus 1/2 more cup of water.  Bring to a boil.  Drain grease from the hamburger patties.  Pour gravy mixture over the meat. Slice onion thin and arrange on top of patties.  Bring to boil. Cover pan and reduce heat to a simmer.  Simmer for 15 minutes.

name: DRIED BEEF AND CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (5 oz.)  jar dried beef (slices)
4  chicken breasts, skinned, boned and halved
1  pt. sour cream
1  can cream of mushroom soup (10 1/2 oz.)
8  strips lean bacon
preparation: Butter lightly flat casserole (13 x 9-inch) dish.  Layer beef slices in bottom of dish.  Wrap each chicken breast with bacon; place on top of dried beef.  Mix soup and sour cream.  Pour over chicken.  Bake at 275°, uncovered, for 3 hours or 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

name: SAVANNAH OYSTERS
ingredients:
1  qt. oysters
1  c. chopped celery
12  oz. Ritz crackers, crushed
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. heavy cream
preparation: Butter shallow casserole dish.  Layer 1/3 of crackers. Carefully place half of oysters on top of crackers and half of celery.  Add salt and pepper.  Place another layer of crackers, rest of oysters and celery.  Top with crackers.  Just before baking, add cream.  Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.

name: SEVEN LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1  small head lettuce, coarsely chopped
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1  bell pepper, chopped fine
2  stalks celery, chopped fine
1  can LeSueur peas
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. grated cheese
bacon bits to cover top
preparation: Layer each ingredient, beginning with the lettuce.

name: SEVEN MINUTE CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients in blender.  Pour into well-greased 10-inch pie plate.  Bake 1 hour at 325°.  If in glass dish, lower heat to 300°.  Cool.  Top with canned cherries, strawberries, etc.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 - 12  oz. cans white corn (yellow can be substituted)
1 - 16  oz. can French style green beans, drained
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped bell pepper
3/4  c. grated sharp cheese
1  can cream of celery soup
1 - 8  oz. carton sour cream
salt and pepper to taste
1  stick margarine
1  stack butter flavored crackers, crushed (Ritz)
preparation: Thoroughly mix all ingredients except margarine and crackers. Place the vegetable mixture in a 9 X 13 casserole dish.  Melt margarine and mix with crushed crackers.  Spread evenly over the vegetable mixture.  Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.  Serves 12 to 15.

name: IMPOSSIBLE MEXICAN PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  envelope taco seasoning mix
1 (4 oz.)  can whole green chilies, drained, seeded and chopped
1  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese (4 oz.)
1 1/4  c. milk
3/4  c. Bisquick
3  eggs
1/8  tsp. red pepper sauce
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Lightly grease 10-inch pie plate.  Cook and stir ground beef and onion in skillet until beef browns, then drain.  Stir in seasoning mix.  Spread beef mixture in pie plate. Sprinkle with chilies and cheese.  Beat remaining ingredients until smooth and pour into pie plate.  Bake until golden brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean, about 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

name: MUFFIN PIZZAS
ingredients:
1 Large  Can Tomato Sauce
English Muffins (Cut in Half)
Parmesan Cheese
Salt (To Taste)
Pepper (To Taste)
Oregano (To Taste)
Mozzarella Cheese Slices
preparation: Season tomato sauce to taste with salt, pepper, and oregano, or any other favorite spices.  Spread 2 Tbsp. of mixture on each muffin half.  Add slice of mozzarella cheese and sprinkle with parmesan cheese and anything else you like.  Preheat oven to 350. Bake for 15-20 minutes.

name: SPINACH CONTINENTAL
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach
3/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3 sandwich size  slices American cheese
1  egg
1  clove garlic, mashed
4  Tbsp. (1/2 cube) butter or margarine
2  slices bread, toasted and cut into 1/2-inch cubes
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Let spinach thaw; drain well, then arrange in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Heat milk slowly with the 2 tablespoons of butter and American cheese until cheese melts.  Cool, then stir in well beaten egg.  Pour cheese sauce over spinach.  Saute garlic in the 4 tablespoons of butter until browned; add toast cubes and stir until they absorb the butter.  Drain toast cubes on absorbent paper and sprinkle with grated cheese.  Arrange over top of sauce.  Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: APPLE COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
1  egg
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped apple
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Combine eggs, sugar and oil.  Mix well until light yellow. Sift together flour and cinnamon. Stir into egg mixture.  This will be very stiff.  Add vanilla, apples and walnuts, stirring until well mixed.  Pour into greased 9-inch cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: CHRISTMAS WREATH COOKIES
ingredients:
1/3  c. margarine
32 large marshmallows or 3 1/4  c. mini marshmallows
1  tsp. green food color
1  tsp. almond extract
1  tsp. vanilla
4  c. corn flakes
red cinnamon candies
preparation: Melt margarine and marshmallows in large bowl in microwave. Add color and extracts.  Stir in flakes until well coated.  Use about 1 tablespoon for each cookie.  Dip fingers in cold water (not butter) so it doesn't stick.  Shape into a wreath and decorate with candies while sticky.   Place on wax paper.  Allow to dry uncovered at room temperature for 8 hours.  Makes 12 to 18 wreaths.  Make only one batch at a time, don't try to double the recipe.

name: CALICO SALAD
ingredients:
1 l.  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
1 s.  box frozen lima beans
1 s.  can sliced black pitted olives
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  pkg. original Hidden Valley dressing
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Cook vegetables in salted boiling water 8 minutes.  Drain well.  Add all other ingredients and chill.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. self-rising flour
3/4  c. shortening
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1  c. milk
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Cut shortening into flour until well mixed.  In another bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water; add sugar.  Let stand 2 or 3 minutes.  Add  milk  and  stir  well.  Add this to flour and shortening mixture.  Stir until ingredients are moistened.

name: NO BAKE CHERRY CHEESE SQUARES
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/2  c. sugar, divided
1/3  c. melted butter
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  tsp. grated lemon peel
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2  c. whipped cream
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
1/2  tsp. almond extract
preparation: In a medium bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and butter; mix well.  Press firmly to bottom of 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Chill crust.

name: YULETIDE MINTY FUDGE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. butter
3  Tbsp. water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. (1 1/2 c.) mint-flavored semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
3  eggs
1  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  In small bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt; set aside.  In medium saucepan, combine sugar, butter and water; bring to boil.  Remove from heat.  Add the mint-flavored chocolate morsels and vanilla extract; stir until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth.  Transfer to large bowl. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Gradually blend in flour mixture.  Stir in the nuts.  Spread into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until tests done.  Cool; cut into 1 1/2-inch squares. Makes 4 dozen.

name: PUMPKIN CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. cloves
1  c. fresh pumpkin puree
1/4  c. milk
1  c. walnuts
3/4  c. raisins
preparation: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.  Beat in eggs and vanilla.  Sift flour with baking soda, baking powder and spices. Stir into butter mixture alternately with pumpkin, ending with flour.  Stir in milk, walnuts and raisins.  Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.  Cool in pan 30 minutes, then turn out onto a cake rack to finish cooling.

name: STUFF AND CLUTTER
ingredients:
2  c. salted peanuts
1  c. pecan halves
1  box pretzels (sticks)
1 (12 oz.)  box Cheerios
1 (12 oz.)  box Wheat Chex
1 (12 oz.)  box Wheat Thins
1  lb. butter or margarine
1/2  c. bacon grease
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
4  tsp. garlic salt
1  Tbsp. celery salt
1  Tbsp. sesame seed
preparation: Use two large roaster pans to heat in oven.  Mix first seven ingredients.  Melt butter and bacon grease with remaining ingredients.  Pour over cereal mixture, stirring to coat all ingredients.  Bake at 300° until brown (1 hour).  Cool completely before putting in airtight containers.  Stir every 15 minutes.

name: RICE PILAF
ingredients:
3/4  cup butter
3/4  cup onion
3  cups rice (raw)
2 (8 oz)  cans mushroom pieces
3  cups diced celery
3/4  cup celery leaves
1  Tbsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3/4  tsp. marjoram
1/4  tsp. sage
1/4  tsp. thyme
6  cups water
preparation: In a 3 quart saucepan, sauté rice, onion, mushroom pieces, celery, celery leaves and spices in butter.  Add water.  Bring to boil.  Simmer for 15 minutes.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (2 oz.)  pkg. taco sauce mix
3/4  lb. processed cheese
1/3  c. Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies
3/4  head lettuce, shredded
2  tomatoes, chopped
1/2  medium onion, chopped
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. corn chips
preparation: Prepare taco filling with ground beef and taco sauce mix according to package directions. Melt cheese with tomatoes and green chilies.  Mix shredded lettuce, tomatoes, meat and 1/4 of the corn chips in a salad bowl.  Pour cheese mixture over top with remaining corn chips.  Serve immediately.  Serves 4.

name: PARSLEYED NEW POTATOES
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. new potatoes (10 to 12 small)
3  Tbsp. melted butter
1  Tbsp. snipped parsley
preparation: Prepare and cook new potatoes. Just before serving, toss with butter and sprinkle with parsley.

name: TORTA RUSTICA
ingredients:
2  tsp. olive oil
13  oz. hot Italian turkey sausage, casings removed
1  tsp. dried basil
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. part-skim Ricotta cheese
2  Tbsp. skim milk
8  oz. refrigerated pizza dough
1/2  c. chopped onion
2 1/2  c. blanched broccoli florets
1/4  tsp. crushed fennel seed
1/2  c. egg substitute
1  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In large nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Add sausage; cook 6 to 7 minutes, stirring to break into small pieces until browned.  With slotted spoon, remove sausage from skillet; set aside.  Add onion to skillet; cook, stirring frequently, for 2 to 3 minutes, or until tender.  Stir in broccoli, basil, fennel seed and salt.  Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, or until broccoli is tender.  Transfer mixture to medium bowl.  In small bowl, combine Ricotta, egg substitute, milk and Parmesan cheese; set aside.

name: BEST QUICK SALAD
ingredients:
1  box frozen peas
2  tomatoes
1/2  c. vinegar
1/4  c. oil (Wesson)
1  Tbsp. sugar
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  red onion
1  c. chopped celery
preparation: Cook peas; drain and cool.  Chop tomatoes, onion and celery. Add together.  In shaker, mix oil, vinegar and sugar; shake.  Pour over and mix.  Cool.  Pretty, colorful and kids love it.

name: EGGNOG
ingredients:
8  eggs, separated
1  c. sugar
1  c. bourbon
2  pt. whipping cream
preparation: Stir sugar into egg yolks.  Add bourbon and mix well.  Whip egg whites and whipping cream.  Add sugar, bourbon and egg yolk mixture; mix very slowly.

name: FRITO CHILI CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  bag of Frito chips
2  cans Van Camp chili
1  bag cheddar cheese
preparation: In a greased baking bowl, put a layer of Frito chips, add layer of chili, then cheese.  Repeat process until you get to the top of the bowl, top with cheese and bake at 375 degrees until cheese is melted.  Children love this.

name: CHICKEN AVOCADO MELT
ingredients:
4  chicken breast halves, boned and skinned
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. ground cumin
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  Tbsp. water
1/2  c. cornmeal
cherry tomatoes
3  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  avocado, peeled and sliced
1 1/2  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1/2  c. sour cream, divided
1/4  c. sliced green onion (tops only)
1/4  c. chopped sweet red pepper
parsley sprigs
preparation: Flatten chicken breast.  In shallow dish, mix together cornstarch, cumin and garlic salt; add chicken, one piece at a time, dredging to coat.  Mix egg and water.  In another bowl, place cornmeal.  Dip chicken first in egg and then in cornmeal, turning to coat.  In frypan, place oil and heat to medium temperature; add chicken and cook 2 minutes on each side.  Remove chicken to baking pan; place avocado slices over chicken and sprinkle cheese.  Bake in 350° oven about 15 minutes or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease and cheese melts.  Top chicken with sour cream, dividing equally; sprinkle with green onion and red pepper.  Garnish with parsley and cherry tomatoes. Makes 4 servings.

name: GRILLED CORN ON THE COB
ingredients:
6  ears fresh corn
1/4  c. butter
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Remove and discard husks and silks from corn.  Brush corn with butter; sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Wrap each ear tightly in aluminum foil.  Grill, covered with lid, over medium coals 15 to 20 minutes, turning often.  Yield:  6 servings.

name: SPARERIBS BARBECUED IN SOULFUL SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. water
1/2  c. prepared mustard
5  lb. fresh spareribs
2  onions, quartered
5  garlic cloves, crushed
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  c. tomato catsup
2  Tbsp. pepper sauce
1  tsp. paprika
2  Tbsp. hickory salt
2  Tbsp. chili powder
juice and grated rind of lemon
2  Tbsp. butter or bacon fat
1  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. sweet basil
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. thyme
1  tsp. cumin seed
salt, pepper and paprika to taste
preparation: Wipe ribs with clean, damp cloth; cut into pieces for individual servings.  Sprinkle with salt, pepper and paprika; set aside.  Place all other ingredients, except ribs, in a large frying pan.  Simmer for 20 to 30 minutes; cool.  Place ribs in a large, shallow flat dish; marinate well with sauce on both sides. Cover; store in refrigerator for several hours.  Cook until well done, basting occasionally.

name: EASY CHICKEN PARMESAN
ingredients:
4  skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  c. spaghetti sauce
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
hot, cooked spaghetti noodles
preparation: Dip chicken into egg.  Coat with bread crumbs.  In skillet over medium heat, heat oil.  Cook chicken 10 minutes or until done; set aside.  In same pan, heat spaghetti sauce to a boil; return chicken to skillet.  Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes or until chicken is done.  Top chicken with cheese and heat until cheese is melted.  Serve with spaghetti.

name: ONION CRESCENTS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can crescent dinner rolls
1 1/2  tsp. instant minced or chopped onion
1  tsp. melted butter or margarine
preparation: Unroll dough; separate into 8 triangles.  Evenly sprinkle 1 teaspoon onion over the 8 triangles.  Roll each and place on cookie sheet.  Brush rolls with butter.  Sprinkle remaining onion over tops.  Bake as directed.

name: Pepper Steak
ingredients:
1  lb. (1/4-inch) sirloin tips, cut in serving-size pieces
2  Tbsp. fat
1/4  c. chopped onions
1  garlic clove
1  Tbsp. salt
1  beef bouillon cube
1  c. hot water
2  c. cooked tomatoes
1  large green pepper, sliced in rings
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. cold water
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Brown meat.  Add onions and garlic last minute.  Season. Dissolve bouillon cube in hot water and add meat.  Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes.  Add tomatoes and green pepper.   Cook 10 minutes longer.  Combine remaining ingredients and stir into meat. Bring to boil.  Cook, stirring constantly, 5 minutes longer. Serve with hot Chinese noodles or rice.

name: FRUIT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter (2 sticks)
2  c. brown sugar
3  eggs
1/4  c. honey
1  tsp. lemon  juice
1  tsp. vanilla
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
2  c. raisins
1  c. chopped dates
2  c. chopped pecans
1  c. chopped almonds
1/2  c. red cherries
1/2  c. green cherries
1/2  c. pineapple
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add one egg at a time. Mix flour, honey, lemon juice, vanilla, soda, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg and fold in with butter and sugar. Then fold in raisins, dates, pecans, almonds, cherries and pineapple.  Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet and bake 15 minutes at 350°.

name: KAHLUA HOT SPICED APPLE CIDER
ingredients:
1 1/2  oz. Kahlua
8  oz. hot cider or apple juice
cinnamon stick
preparation: Pour Kahlua into hot cider or apple juice.  Stir with cinnamon stick.

name: APPLESAUCE DATE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. dates, finely cut
1  c. nuts, chopped
1 1/2  c. applesauce
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
powdered sugar for rolling cookies
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease a shallow baking pan.  Sift dry ingredients; set aside.  Cream butter, sugar, egg and vanilla. Stir in dates, nuts and applesauce.  Add dry ingredients; blend well.  Pour into pan.  Bars should be only 3/4-inch thick when baked.  Bake about 20 minutes or until done.  Cool, cut into squares and roll in powdered sugar.

name: EGG ROLLS
ingredients:
1  chicken leg
1/4  lb. ham
4  fresh shrimp
1 small  can bamboo shoots
1 small  can water chestnuts
1/4  lb. bean sprouts
1  bunch watercress
1/2  box mushrooms
1  green pepper
1  bunch green onions
1  stem celery
salt and pepper
soy sauce
Mochiko (rice flour)
preparation: Chop all vegetables fine.  Cover bottom of pan with oil, ham, shrimp, then chicken, salt, pepper, mushrooms, green onion, celery, water chestnuts and bamboo.  Stir after each addition.  Add pepper and 2 tablespoons shoyu.  Sprinkle 3 tablespoons Mochiko; stir. Add bean sprouts and watercress; toss.  Place back on platter. Spread out so as not to cook the bean sprouts any more.  Spoon mix on egg roll skin.  Wrap and dab the end with water; fry in deep oil.  Makes 18 egg rolls.

name: CHICKEN CORDON BLEU
ingredients:
4  whole boneless chicken breasts
1  c. flour
2  beaten eggs
2  tsp. Season-All
3  c. vegetable oil
1/2  lb. thick sliced ham
1/2  lb. thick sliced Swiss cheese
2  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Place a slice of Swiss cheese and ham inside of each chicken breast.  Fold meat together and freeze.  When meat has been frozen, dip in beaten eggs, then batter with flour that has been mixed in with Season-All.  Deep fry until light brown.  Do not cook until cheese comes out.  Place chicken on a sheet pan and bake 45 minutes.  Serve hot.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. pecans
1  stick butter (soft)
preparation: Mix and press in pan (8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch).  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple tidbits
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges
1  c. pecans, chopped
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
1  large orange Jell-O
18  oz. small curd cottage cheese
3  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Thoroughly mix all the ingredients in a large bowl. Then chill. This makes  a lot of fruit salad. You may want to put in 2 containers.

name: CRAB QUICHE
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. flour
2  beaten eggs
1/2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  can crab
8  oz. shredded Swiss or Jack cheese
1/3  c. green onions
preparation: Mix  mayonnaise, flour, eggs, milk and salt.  Add crab, cheese and  onions.  Bake in a 9-inch pastry shell at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: MEATBALL SURPRISE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. Stove Top dressing
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. catsup
preparation: Prepare Stove Top per package directions; cool.  Form the dressing into balls and wrap them with ground beef.  In a saucepan, combine the milk, mushroom soup, Worcestershire sauce and catsup; heat.  Pour over meatballs and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: "CAN-OPENER" CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  large whole chicken breasts
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 small  can evaporated milk
1 small  can mushrooms, cut
1  c. celery, diced largely
1  medium bell pepper, chopped
pimento
1  can sliced almonds
1 to 2  c. Chinese noodles
preparation: Cook chicken breasts; cool and cut into chunks.  Mix mushroom soup, chicken soup, evaporated milk, mushrooms, chicken, celery, green pepper, pimento and almonds.  Put into casserole dish and cover with Chinese noodles.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. paprika
1  tsp. salt
1  c. Wesson or olive oil
1/3  c. wine vinegar
1/2  c. powdered sugar
juice of 1 orange or 1 lemon
1  tsp. French's prepared mustard
preparation: Beat with an eggbeater.  Cut 1 clove of garlic and add.  Let stand about 2 hours and then strain.  Chill until ready to toss with your favorite green salad.

name: RICE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Veg-All (or 2 small), drained
1 medium  can Mexicorn, drained
2  c. chopped onion
2  c. chopped celery
2  c. chopped green pepper
2  c. cooked Minute rice
1  diced tomato
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  c. salad dressing
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix  oil,  salad  dressing,  salt  and pepper together. Refrigerate  all  day  or  overnight.  Use	amounts desired of onion, celery and green pepper.

name: EASY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  tsp. seasoned salt
2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Whip cream cheese.  Add pineapple, pepper, onions, salt and 1 cup chopped pecans.  Chill for 2 hours.  Form into a ball and roll in the rest of the nuts.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. lasagna, cooked
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, minced
1  clove garlic, chopped
parsley to taste
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
2  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. to remember
2  eggs
3/4  lb. Ricotta or cottage cheese
8  oz. grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown meat in olive oil with onion, garlic and parsley.  Add tomato paste, water, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon to remember and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.  Mix eggs, Ricotta or cottage cheese and grated Mozzarella cheese.  Arrange lasagna in baking dish in layers, alternating with layers of sauce, Mozzarella cheese and Ricotta until lasagna is all used.  Sprinkle with grated Mozzarella cheese.  Bake in moderate oven at 375°  for about 20 minutes.

name: NO BAKE PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
3  oz. cream cheese (at room temperature)
1/2  c. smooth peanut butter
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. milk
8  oz. Cool Whip, thawed
1  prebaked graham cracker pie crust
preparation: In a large bowl with an electric mixer, combine cream cheese, peanut butter, sugar and milk. Beat until smooth.  Gently fold in Cool Whip.  Pour into pie shell. Freeze 4 to 6 hours.  Thaw 10 minutes before serving.

name: WINTER GUACAMOLE
ingredients:
