3  ripe avocados
3  Tbsp. fresh lime juice
3  scallions, trimmed and minced
2  small jalapeno chiles, stemmed, seeded and minced
4  sun dried tomatoes (packed in oil), drained and minced
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
5  slices bacon, cooked crisp and coarsely crumbled
3  Tbsp. minced fresh coriander
salt to taste
preparation: Pit and peel avocados; mash pulp in medium bowl to chunky consistency.  Add lime juice, scallions, jalapeno chiles and tomatoes, then fold in cheese, bacon and coriander.  Season to taste with salt.  Serve as soon as possible to keep bacon crisp. Use your favorite chips for dipping.

name: SALMON BAKE
ingredients:
salmon fillets
Wish Bone salad dressing
sliced tomatoes
sliced lemons
preparation: Place salmon fillets in aluminum foil (skin side down).  Baste with Wish Bone salad dressing.  Place thin slices of tomatoes and lemons on top of fish.  Roll in foil and broil slowly on grill 15 to 20 minutes.

name: QUICK CHOCOLATE CANDY
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
3/4  c. salted peanuts
preparation: Melt the chocolate pieces in a saucepan over water.  Stir in the peanuts.  Turn into small pan.  Chill before breaking into pieces.

name: CRAB LOAF
ingredients:
1  pkg. spaghetti
1  Tbsp. butter
1  c. milk
1 1/4  c. cream of mushroom soup
1/2  lb. American cheese, grated
1 1/2  c. crab meat
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook spaghetti in boiling, salted water until tender.  Drain. Heat soup, stirring until smooth.  Add butter and milk.  When hot, remove from heat and stir in grated cheese, saving some to sprinkle on top.  Combine cheese sauce with spaghetti, crab meat and pepper.  Place in a greased shallow casserole and sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Bake in hot 400° oven, about 30 minutes.

name: JELLO CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix
1  small orange jello
1/2  c. Crisco oil
1/2  c. water
3  eggs
1/2  c. orange juice
preparation: Mix cake mix and jello.  Add oil and water, mix well.  Add eggs one at a time.  Then add orange juice.  Do not use electric mixer; mix by hand.  Put in tube pan.  Bake at 350° until done.

name: NO-PEEK BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. stew meat
1  c mushrooms
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c water
preparation: Mix in crock pot.  Cook on high 6-8 hours.  Serve over rice or noodles.  "Don't peek while cooking."

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1  c. boiling water
1/4  c. orange juice
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  can whole berry cranberry sauce
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Dissolve first 3 items and mix well.  Add next 3 items.  Mix well and chill.

name: QUICK PIE
ingredients:
1  baked and cooled pie shell
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  large Cool Whip
juice of 3 lemons
1/2  c. Mandarin oranges
preparation: Mix  milk  and  Cool  Whip well;  add fruit.  Add lemon juice last.  Pour into pie shell; chill.  Yummy!

name: MAMAW'S BIRD NEST
ingredients:
1  egg
1  slice bread
margarine
preparation: Spread margarine thinly on both sides of bread.  Make hole in middle of bread big enough to put egg in.  Place in your skillet over medium heat.  Break egg in hole.  When egg is halfway cooked, flip and cook other side.

name: PUMPKIN BARS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. oil
4  eggs
2  c. pumpkin (1 can 16 oz.)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour a jelly roll pan.  Mix together.  Bake 25 minutes.

name: LETHA LAVERTY'S FAMILY RECIPE FOR APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  large eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
3  c. apples
1  c. pecans
preparation: Blend oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Add flour, soda and baking powder.  Add apples and pecans.  Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

name: IRRESISTIBLE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  sticks butter
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels, divided
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven  to  350°.  In  3	quart saucepan over low heat, melt butter. Remove from heat.  Add sugar, cocoa, baking powder, salt,  eggs and vanilla.  Stir with spoon until batter is smooth. Stir  in  1  1/2  cups chocolate morsels and nuts. Spread in 13  x 9-inch  baking  pan.  Sprinkle  with  1/2 cup chocolate morsels. Bake  for  30  to 35 minutes. Cool on wire rack.  Cut into 2-inch squares.  Makes 24 brownies.

name: CHEESE STRAWS
ingredients:
1  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese
1  stick margarine
2  c. flour
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Grate cheese and mix with soft margarine.  Add flour sifted with salt and pepper. Press into ball and roll out on floured pastry cloth to 1/4-inch thick.  Cut into strips with fluted roller.  Cut strips into 2 to 3-inch lengths.  Sprinkle lightly with paprika.  Slide pieces gently onto cookie sheet.  Bake in 350° to 375° oven for about 10 minutes.  Watch carefully as they burn easily.  Cool on wax paper.

name: CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can chicken broth
1  c. chopped onion
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1/4  c. flour
1 (12 oz.)  can whole kernel corn
1  sweet pepper, chopped
1  can minced clams (optional)
preparation: In a medium saucepan, combine broth, onion and sweet pepper. Bring to boiling.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until onion and sweet pepper are tender.

name: FRIED COD(Baccala)
ingredients:
boneless baccala, already soaked
eggs
flour
seasoned bread crumbs
oil for frying
preparation: Amounts depend on quantity of baccala.

name: PINEAPPLE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1  can (14 oz.) unsweetened crushed pineapple in juice, undrained
1/4  c. pecan pieces (optional)
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 3/4  tsp. Equal Measure or 6 packets Equal sweetener or 1/4 c. Equal Spoonful
1  tsp. cornstarch
4  Tbsp. margarine, at room temperature
3 1/2  tsp. Equal Measure or 12 packets Equal sweetener or 1/2 c. Equal Spoonful
1  egg
1  c. cake flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/8  tsp. ground ginger
1/3  c. buttermilk
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/4 c. juice.  Mix pineapple, pecans, 1 Tbsp. lemon juice, 1 3/4 tsp. Equal Measure or 6 packets Equal sweetener or 1/4 c. Equal Spoonful and cornstarch in bottom of 8" square or 9-inch round cake pan; spread mixture evenly in pan.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked mashed sweet potatoes
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. melted margarine
preparation: Mix together and put in 2-quart baking dish.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  pork chops
1  can cream of mushroom soup
4  red potatoes, sliced round
1  large onion, sliced round
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown pork chops. Remove from pan. In same pan, pour soup. Add 1/2 cup water. Layer chops, potatoes and onion in baking dish. Pour soup over this. Cover and bake 3/4 hour at 350° until potatoes are done.

name: SHAKE-A-SACK CRACKER SNACK
ingredients:
3  c. small square cheese crackers (Cheez-Its)
3  c. oyster crackers
2  c. bite-size pretzel nuggets
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. buttermilk salad dressing mix
1/2  tsp. dried dill weed or dried oregano, crushed
1/4  c. cooking oil
preparation: In a lunch size paper sack or plastic bag, combine the cheese crackers, oyster crackers, pretzels, dry salad dressing mix and dill weed. Close bag and shake well. Pour oil into sack and shake again. Store in airtight container.

name: SAUCE PROVENCALE FOR BROILED STEAK OR ROAST PRIME RIB
ingredients:
4  tomatoes, peeled, cut into 6 wedges each and seeded
1/2  tsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. chopped green onion
1/2  c. dry white wine
1/2  c. butter
3  cloves garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
preparation: Sprinkle tomatoes with sugar and set aside.  Melt 2 tablespoons of butter.  Add onion and heat through.  Add wine; cook and stir until liquid is slightly reduced.  Add tomatoes; heat through.  Add remaining ingredients; heat, stirring gently until butter melts.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: SKILLET CORN FRITTERS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
2  c. corn
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  tsp. black pepper
2  beaten eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
2  dashes hot sauce
2 or 3  Tbsp. oil
preparation: In medium pan, melt butter.  Add corn, green pepper and onion. Cook 8 minutes.  Cool slightly.  Combine flour, baking powder, salt and pepper.  Add eggs, milk and hot sauce.  Mix well.  Stir in cool vegetable mixture.

name: ARTICHOKE APPETIZERS
ingredients:
2 (14 oz.)  cans artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
dash of garlic powder, Worcestershire and hot sauce or cayenne pepper
preparation: Combine, stirring well.  Spoon into lightly greased one-quart casserole.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Serve with crackers.

name: UNUSUAL PASTA
ingredients:
2 large  cans tomato sauce
1  can tomato paste
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  onion, chopped
garlic powder to taste
pasta shells or noodles, cooked
white navy beans, cooked
preparation: Simmer first 5 ingredients for several hours.  Cook pasta according to box directions (use desired amount).  Cook beans or use leftover beans.  Mix everything together and serve.

name: PORK CHOPS AND APPLE AND SAUERKRAUT
ingredients:
4  pork chops (boneless)
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1/2  clove garlic
1/4  c. onion, sliced
1/2  tsp. sage
1  apple, cored and quartered
1/4  tsp. pepper
2 or 3  c. sauerkraut
1/4  c. white wine
preparation: Brown chops in oil and margarine.  Add garlic, onion, sage and apple.  Saute few minutes.  Stir in pepper and wine.  Place sauerkraut on top of chops.  Cover; heat to boiling.  Reduce heat to simmer.  Cook 40 to 45 minutes.

name: CANNIBAL "TATERS"
ingredients:
6  to 8 sliced potatoes
1  medium onion, sliced
salt and pepper
1/2  stick margarine
water
preparation: In a large skillet with lid, put about 1-inch water.  Layer 1/2 of potatoes, onion, salt and pepper.  Place pats of margarine on top.  Repeat.  Bring to a boil.  Cover and reduce heat to low or simmer.  Cook 30 to 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork.  Yields 6 servings.

name: APPLE SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box spice cake
3  eggs
1/3  c. oil
1/2  c. water
1  can apple pie filling
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake according to box directions.  Frost with canned cream cheese frosting or make cream cheese frosting yourself.

name: CHICKEN NUGGETS
ingredients:
5  to 6 boneless chicken breast
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1  c. flour
1  Tbsp. garlic salt
2  Tbsp. onion salt
2  Tbsp. pepper
2  tsp. paprika
1/4  c. potato flakes
1  c. oil
preparation: Cut chicken into 1-inch strips; combine milk and egg.  Dip chicken pieces into mixture.  Mix flour, garlic salt, onion salt, pepper, paprika and potato flakes.  Dip chicken in flour mixture. Heat oil (test oil with drop of water; if it pops, it's ready). Put in chicken pieces; fry for 5 minutes on both sides.  Drain on paper towels.  Serve with mashed potatoes and gravy or sauces.

name: BROCCOLI AND CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  bunch raw broccoli
1  head raw cauliflower
1  medium onion
1  basket cherry tomatoes (about 2 c.)
2/3  c. salad dressing
1/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Wash vegetables.  Cut up all but tomatoes; add tomatoes whole. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables.   Marinate overnight.  Makes 10 to 15 cups.

name: TUNA NOODLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. seashell noodles, boiled, drained and cooled
1 large  can tuna, drained
2  stalks celery
1  green onion
4  radishes
1  c. peas (unfrozen)
1  c. Miracle Whip
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a large mixing bowl.  Add Miracle Whip, more or less to taste.  Refrigerate immediately.

name: DRIED BEEF DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch style dressing
1 small  jar dried beef
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Onion may be added if so desired.  Add milk to the consistency desired for vegetables or chips.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. Oreo cookies
8  oz. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. milk
2  small vanilla pudding mix
1  c. powdered sugar
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Crush cookies.  Line dish 13 x 9 x 2-inch with half of cookies.  Mix sugar, vanilla and cream cheese until smooth.   Add pudding mix and milk.  Beat until creamy.  Pour over cookies.  Add remainder of cookies.  Press the cookies down.  Cover with Cool Whip.  Top with nuts or crushed cookies.  Chill overnight.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
4  c. biscuits
2  c. sugar
4  tsp. cinnamon
1  stick butter or margarine
preparation: Mix sugar and cinnamon in a large bowl.

name: $100.00 CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. warm water
1  c. miracle whip
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in layer or loaf pans. Grease pan and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: SKILLET CANDIES
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
1 1/2  c. light brown sugar
2  c. chopped dates
2  Tbsp. milk
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
4  c. Rice Krispies
coconut
preparation: Melt oleo.  Add sugar and dates.  Cook over low heat.  Add milk and slowly stir in beaten eggs.  Bring to boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat.  When cool, add nuts, vanilla and cereal.  Stir to mix well.  Form candy into ball and roll in coconut.  Makes about 6 dozen.

name: MILLIONAIRE PIE
ingredients:
3  well beaten eggs
1  c. sugar
1/2  stick butter or margarine
1  c. chopped pecans
3  Tbsp. water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. raisins
preparation: Mix all ingredients in saucepan.  Bring to a boil and boil until thickened.  When cool, pour into a baked pie shell.  Serve with whipped cream.

name: GROUND BEEF AND SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. tomato soup
1 small  can tomato paste
1  lb. elbow spaghetti, cooked
1/2  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
4 or 5  slices bread (make into crumbs)
preparation: Slightly brown ground beef, onion and green pepper in skillet. Salt and pepper to taste.  Drain off fat.  Add tomato paste and tomato soup into meat and stir in well.  Add 1/2 cup water and stir in.  Add cooked spaghetti.  Stir in.  Put into casserole. Add bread crumbs on top.  Bake in a 375° oven for 15 minutes or until crumbs are brown.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, drained
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
1 small  can chopped water chestnuts
1  pkg. Knorr's vegetable soup mix
2  green spring onions, chopped
1  loaf pumpernickel bread, scoop out middle, save pieces to use as dippers
preparation: Mix all ingredients in order given.  Thoroughly stir together. Cover and refrigerate.  (Make sure spinach is dry.)  When ready to serve, place bread on serving plate.  Fill center with dip and place the bread pieces around the plate to dip with.  Attractive and very good.

name: CAJUN HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cornmeal mix
2/3  c. milk
1  egg
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
1/4  tsp. each: white and black pepper
1/2  tsp. thyme leaves
1/8  tsp. oregano leaves
1  minced garlic clove
1  c. finely chopped green onions
preparation: Drop in preheated oil at 375° for 2 minutes or until golden brown.

name: BETTY'S TOFFEE BARS
ingredients:
saltine crackers
1  c. sugar
2  sticks butter (must be butter)
1  pkg. milk chocolate chips
crushed nuts
preparation: Line a cookie sheet with foil and spray well with nonstick spray. Line the cookie sheet with saltine crackers. Boil the sugar and butter until it comes to a rolling boil. Stir well. Pour sugar mixture over saltines. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and spread the chocolate chips evenly over the cookie sheet. Return tray to warm oven just long enough to melt the chips. Add crushed nuts and let the tray cool in the refrigerator for several hours. Break into pieces.

name: COCOA BROWNIES
ingredients:
4  egg whites
1/2  c. canola oil (Puritan)
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Heat oven  to 350°.  Oil bottom of 9 x 9-inch pan;  set aside. Place  egg whites in large bowl, beat with spoon until slightly frothy.  Add  oil and vanilla; mix thoroughly.  Stir in sugar  and cocoa;  mix  well.  Stir  in  flour  until well blended.  Pour into  pan.	Bake at 350° for 22 to 26 minutes. Avoid overbaking. Cool before cutting.  Makes 1 1/2 dozen.

name: HEAVENLY HASH CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo, melted
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
4  tsp. cocoa
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
1  jar marshmallow creme
1  can chocolate frosting
preparation: Beat eggs and sugar; add sifted flour, cocoa, and vanilla; mix well. Add melted oleo and chopped nuts. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan at 350° until done. While hot, spread on marshmallow creme and then the chocolate frosting.

name: LAZY DAISY CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. margarine
pinch of salt
1/2  c. boiling sweet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs and sugar together well.  Add flour with baking powder and salt.  Add milk with margarine melted in it.  Beat well.  Add vanilla.  Bake at 350° until done.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. peanut butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
3  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3 3/4  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Stir together margarine, peanut butter and sugar until blended.  Beat in eggs and vanilla.  Sift together flour, baking powder, soda and salt over sugar mixture.  Stir well until blended.  If necessary, chill dough until it can be easily handled.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Place about 2 inches apart on greased baking sheet; flatten with floured fork, making crisscross pattern.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: WHITE CHILI
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. boned skinless chicken breasts (4)
1 large  can (49 1/2 oz.) chicken broth
1 large  jar (48 oz.) undrained Northern beans
2  c. chopped white onion
1/2  bulb garlic, chopped
1 (4 oz.)  can green chili peppers, chopped (may omit)
2  tsp. cumin
2  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. white pepper
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
olive oil for sauteing
preparation: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil.  Microwave chicken until done and dice.  Simmer chicken broth and beans.  Add onion, garlic, chicken and seasonings to broth mixture and slow cook for 2 to 3 hours.  (This is spicy and hot.  Use seasonings to your taste.)

name: DORITO DIP
ingredients:
2  large tomatoes, chopped
3  or 4 green onions, chopped
1 small (4 oz.)  can black olives
1 small  jar peppers
3  Tbsp. olive oil
1  tsp. garlic salt
1 1/2  tsp. vinegar
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix together; refrigerate for 12 to 16 hours.

name: LIME JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
16  marshmallows
1  c. milk
1 (3 oz.)  box Jell-O (lime or lemon Jell-O)
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. Dream Whip
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. undrained crushed pineapple
preparation: Heat marshmallows and milk in heavy pan and stir until melted. Pour over Jell-O and stir until dissolved, then add cream cheese and beat with electric mixer until smooth.   Stir in pineapple and let cool.  Blend in Dream Whip and nuts and refrigerate for a few hours or overnight.

name: RESCIE'S VANILLA WAFER CAKE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  box vanilla wafers
1 (2 1/2 oz.)  can coconut
1/2  c. pecans
3/4  c. butter
2  c. sugar
2/3  c. milk
6  eggs
preparation: Crush vanilla wafers.  Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Bake in a tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: HOMEMADE EGGNOG
ingredients:
12  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  qt. milk, divided
2  Tbsp. vanilla extract
1  tsp. ground nutmeg
2  c. whipping cream
Additional nutmeg, optional
preparation: In a heavy 4-qt. saucepan, whisk together eggs, sugar and salt. Gradually add 1 qt. of milk. Cook and stir over low heat until a thermometer reads 160°-170°, about 30-35 minutes. Pour into a large heatproof bowl; stir in the vanilla, nutmeg and remaining milk. Place the bowl in an ice water bath, stirring frequently until mixture is cool. If the mixture separates, process in a blender until smooth. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. when ready to serve, beat the cream in a mixing bowl on high until soft peaks form. Whisk gently into the cooled milk mixture. Pour into a chilled 5 qt. punch bowl. Sprinkle with nutmeg if desired.

name: ENGLISH OLIVE APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1 1/2  c. black olives (8 oz.), minced
1  Tbsp. onion, minced
6  English muffins
preparation: Combine all ingredients except muffins; mix well.  Spread mixture on muffin halves; cut each in four wedges.  Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for about 10 minutes.  Serve warm.

name: CHOCOLATE MOUSSE
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate bits
2 1/4  Tbsp. Grand Marnier
2  whole eggs + 2 egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. (1/2 pt.) whipping cream
preparation: Melt the chocolate in the liqueur over very low heat and set aside.  Combine eggs + extra yolks, vanilla and sugar in container of blender and blend for 2 minutes.  Add cream and blend for another minute.  Add the chocolate mixture and blend until smooth. The mousse must be made at least three hours ahead and chilled thoroughly.  It will keep for several days in the refrigerator and for months in the freezer.  If frozen, thaw in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours.

name: MICROWAVE SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1  pkg. round steak, cut into serving size pieces
1  can water
salt to taste
pepper to taste
1  can chopped chili peppers
2  cans tomato sauce
preparation: Put steak in microwave casserole dish.  Add tomato sauce and green chilies.  Mix.  Add water.  Mix.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Cover and cook for 20 minutes in large oven (15 in small oven) on High.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKED ICING
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. flour (I use 4 very large Tbsp.)
1  c. milk
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. Crisco
1  c. sugar
about 1 c. peanut butter
preparation: Beat margarine and Crisco.   Cook over medium heat until very thick, stirring constantly.  Will be very thick, like paste.  Put in refrigerator until cool.

name: EGG PIE
ingredients:
1  can milk
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  stick butter
1  Tbsp. flour
4  eggs
preparation: Mix all ingredients together, put on an open pie crust and bake for 30 minutes.

name: ITALIAN ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. zucchini, cut in 3/8-inch slices
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 (3 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
1  pkg. dry spaghetti sauce mix
1  c. water
1  (6 oz.) tomato paste
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella, shredded
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook zucchini covered in boiling water until tender-crisp (4 to 5 minutes); drain and set aside.  Cook onion and green pepper in butter until tender; remove from heat.  Stir in mushrooms, dry sauce mix, water and tomato paste.  Mix well.  Gently stir in zucchini and Mozzarella cheese.  Turn into casserole.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: CORN FRITTERS
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  c. corn
1  c. flour, sifted
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. oil
preparation: Beat eggs; stir in milk.  Add corn and beat in flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and oil.  Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil (375°). Turn to brown; drain.  Serve hot with maple syrup or sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: OLD-FASHIONED CHOCOLATE LOAF CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  oz. unsweetened chocolate
4  oz. semi-sweet chocolate
1/2  lb. unsalted butter
2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. sugar
5  large or extra large eggs, separated
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Need a bread loaf pan with an 8-cup capacity.  Line or spray pan and set aside.  Sift together flour, baking powder and salt and set aside.  Melt chocolate in double boiler until smooth and set aside to cool slightly.  In large bowl, cream butter.  Add vanilla and 1 cup sugar (reserve 1/4 cup sugar).  Beat thoroughly.  Add egg yolks and beat well.  Add chocolate and beat until blended.  Add sifted dry ingredients and beat.  Beat egg whites on moderately high speed until whites hold a soft shape.  Fold whites into thick chocolate mixture.  Turn mixture into prepared pan.  Bake in preheated oven.  Cool.  Wrap cake in plastic wrap and let stand at room temperature overnight before serving.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pound hamburger meat
1  small onion, chopped
1  can Rotel
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
Green chilies
Corn tortillas
Shredded cheese
preparation: Brown meat and onion, salt and pepper to taste.  Add Rotel, cream of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup and green chiles. Picante sauce can be substituted for chilies.  Mix well.  In a casserole dish, put a layer of the meat sauce.  Cover with pieces of the corn tortillas, quarter or eighths.  Repeat until all meat sauce is used.  Cover with cheese.  Bake 15 minutes at 350.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  egg
1  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. brown sugar
1  pkg. biscuit mix
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Lightly grease baking sheet.  Beat egg, milk and vanilla.  Blend in sugars.  Add biscuit mix and mix well. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.  Drop by level tablespoonfuls onto baking sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes.  Cool on wire rack. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

name: MERINGUE PINEAPPLE BARS
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix
2  beaten egg yolks
3  Tbsp. melted butter
1  tsp. vanilla
2  egg whites
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. shredded coconut
1/2  c. well drained crushed pineapple
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients together well and put into a well greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pat mixture down firmly.

name: BAKED SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, browned
1  box spaghetti
1  onion
2  pkg. cheese
1  can spaghetti sauce
preparation: Brown hamburger and diced onion; add sauce with diced onion. Cook spaghetti 1/2 hour.  Put hamburger, sauce and onion mixture in a large bread pan.  Add layer of spaghetti, then sauce.  Top with cheese.  Repeat until pan is full.  Cook at 350° until done or cheese has melted.

name: CARAMEL POPCORN
ingredients:
7  qt. popped popcorn
2  c. brown sugar
1  c. butter
1  c. peanuts or pecans
1/2  c. white corn syrup
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Combine  sugar,  butter,  syrup  and  salt.  Boil for 5 minutes.  Beat in soda and stir.  Stir in nuts.  Place popcorn in large  shallow  pan;  pour sugar mixture over corn.  Stir. Bake at 200° for 1 hour.  Stir every 15 minutes or until done. When done, popcorn will no longer be sticky.  Time of preparation: 1 hour.

name: QUICK AND EASY LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. (1 envelope) unflavored gelatin
2  c. water
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon pudding and pie filling mix
1/2  c. sugar
2/3  c. undiluted Carnation evaporated milk
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
9-inch baked pie shell
preparation: Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup water in a large saucepan.  Stir in remaining 1 1/2 cups water, pudding mix and sugar.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil and thickens.  Chill until mixture mounds from spoon.  Pour Carnation into ice cube tray or 8-inch metal cake pan.  Chill in freezer compartment until sift ice crystals form around edges of tray (10 to 15 minutes).  Whip until stiff (about 1 minute).  Add lemon juice.  Whip very stiff (about 2 minutes longer).  Fold into cooled pudding.  (If pudding is lumpy, beat until smooth.)  Spoon into pie shell; swirl top.  Chill 2 hours or until firm.

name: MICROWAVE SEASONED POTATOES
ingredients:
potatoes, sliced
1/2  stick butter
Lawry's seasoned salt
preparation: Slice potatoes and put in flat microwave dish with a lid.  Add 1/2 stick butter and season with Lawry's seasoned salt. Microwave on High for 20 minutes, stirring potatoes every 5 minutes.

name: POTATOES AND BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
4  c. hash browns
12  oz. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. milk
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. Swiss cheese
10  oz. chopped broccoli
1  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Cook broccoli until tender and set aside. Mix cream cheese, milk, Swiss cheese, Cheddar cheese and margarine. Add hash browns. Put half cheese mixture in baking dish. Add broccoli and then remaining cheese mixture. Put bread crumbs on top and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: HOT SPICED TEA
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. orange flavored Tang
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. instant tea
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Makes 2 cups of dry mix or enough for 6 quarts of tea.  For one serving, place 1 to 2 teaspoons of mix in a cup or mug and fill with boiling water.  Stir until dissolved.

name: RUSSIAN TEA
ingredients:
2  large tea bags
1  qt. hot water
2  c. sugar or sweetener
juice of 3 oranges
juice of 3 lemons
1/2 large  can pineapple juice
1  Tbsp. whole cloves
1 or 2  sticks cinnamon
preparation: Simmer cloves and cinnamon in hot water for 20 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients.

name: OVEN FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) broiler fryer, cut up
1/3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  egg, beaten
2  Tbsp. water
3/4  c. corn flake crumbs
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. soft margarine, melted
preparation: Coat  chicken  in  combined flour and  seasonings.  Dip chicken in egg and water;  coat with crumbs and cheese.  Place in 13	x  9-inch  baking pan.	Drizzle margarine over chicken. Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until tender.

name: CHICKEN STEW WITH DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3  lb. chicken, cut up
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes (dried)
1  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can chicken soup
2/3  c. milk
2  c. buttermilk baking mix
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Arrange chicken pieces in a medium size baking dish, thicker pieces facing toward the outer edge of dish.  Sprinkle with parsley flakes, paprika, salt and pepper.  Cook, covered with waxed paper, in microwave at power level "High" for 19 to 20 minutes.  Drain off all liquid.  Combine soup and 2/3 cup milk and pour over chicken.  Cover and microwave for 6 minutes, stirring once.

name: RIGATONI, BROCCOLI AND MOZZARELLA MELT
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
2 to 3  cloves garlic, chopped fine or pressed
4  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1  bunch fresh broccoli, cut into florets (5 c.)
2  Tbsp. olive oil, divided
12  oz. rigatoni, cooked as pkg. directs
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Make a sauce, melting butter in a heavy, medium saucepan.  Add garlic and cook until softened.  Stir in flour.  Cook until mixture is smooth and bubbly.  Stir in milk and salt.  Cook and stir until thickened.  Remove from heat.  Cook broccoli florets 2 minutes in boiling water, drain and rinse.  Return to pan.  Toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil and set aside.  Toss cooked rigatoni with 1 tablespoon olive oil.  Place 3/4 cup sauce into oiled 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Put 1/2 of the rigatoni over sauce and scatter 1/2 of the broccoli on top.  Drizzle 3/4 cup sauce over all and repeat with remaining rigatoni, broccoli and sauce.  Sprinkle evenly with shredded cheese.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 350° oven.

name: LIME SHERBET PUNCH
ingredients:
2  cans Hawaiian Punch
2  bottles ginger ale (qt. size)
1/2  gal. lime sherbet
preparation: Have your punch and ginger ale cold and pour into large punch bowl with ice and lime sherbet.  Stir until mixed well.  Serves about 20.

name: RHUBARB DESSERT
ingredients:
1  stick of butter
1  cup flour,
1  tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix and press into pan.  Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes.

name: MICROWAVE PRALINES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1/3  c. white Karo syrup
1 1/2  c. pecans
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. water
preparation: Mix sugars, water and syrup in glass 2-quart measuring cup. Cook 7 minutes in microwave.  Stir in butter, pecans and vanilla, just until mixture changes to a slight creamy color, not long.

name: SEASONED SALT
ingredients:
6  boxes salt
1/2  c. pepper
1/4  c. white pepper
1  Tbsp. cayenne pepper
1/4  c. ground ginger
1  c. chopped garlic
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl; let stand, uncovered, for at least 6 hours or overnight.  Store in airtight containers.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs, well beaten
2  c. cooked squash
1 1/2  c. grated cheese (sharp Cheddar)
1 1/4  c. cracker crumbs
1  can cream of onion or cream of chicken soup
preparation: Combine soup, milk and beaten eggs; stir until well blended, then add squash, 1 cup cracker crumbs and 1 cup of cheese.  Stir until well blended.  Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Mix together the remaining cheese and cracker crumbs.  Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: TACO SOUP
ingredients:
1  can kidney beans
1  can pinto beans
1  can shoe peg corn
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
preparation: Brown beef and drain. Add rest of ingredients and mix together. Add water to desired consistency. Bring to boil and simmer 30 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
3/4  stick butter
1  bunch green onions, chopped
3  stalks celery, chopped
1  can mushrooms
1  pkg. garlic cheese spread
1  can mushroom soup
2  Tbsp. flour
bread crumbs or crackers
preparation: Cook broccoli; drain.  Mix all remaining ingredients except crumbs or crackers.  Pour mixture over broccoli.  Sprinkle crumbs over top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: J'S BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. corn oil
1  large onion, sliced
1/4  c. catsup
1/2  c. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. Evangeline sauce
pepper to taste
1/3  c. molasses (for pork)
preparation: Sauce onion in oil until limp.  Combine ingredients.  Blend before using.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES(By Walt Swisher)
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1  c. flour
preparation: Cream butter, beat in sugars, add other ingredients and more flour  (about  1/2 cup) to make mixture stiff enough for drop cookies.  Arrange by spoonfuls on buttered cookie sheet. Press flat  with	spoon  and mark with floured fork.  Bake in moderate 350° oven until golden brown about 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 60.

name: ORANGE AND TOMATO SOUP
ingredients:
4  medium onions, finely chopped
1  medium potato, peeled and finely chopped
4  cloves garlic, minced
3  Tbsp. butter
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, chopped
juice and grated rind of 1 orange
1 (10 oz.)  can chicken broth
1/2  c. whipping cream
salt and pepper
sugar
orange peel curls
sour cream (garnish)
preparation: In a large saucepan slowly saute onions, chopped potato and garlic in butter.  Add tomatoes, orange juice, orange rind and broth.  Simmer 30 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  boxes Jiffy cornbread mix
4  eggs
10  oz. chopped broccoli, thawed
8  oz. cottage cheese
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  sticks margarine, melted
1/2 to 3/4  c. milk
preparation: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan.  In a large bowl mix corn muffin mix, eggs, cottage cheese, salt and thawed broccoli.  Add melted margarine, then add milk and pour into the 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 425° about 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Freezes well.

name: CRANBERRY RELISH
ingredients:
2  c. fresh cranberries, ground
2  c. sugar
2  oranges, cut up finely
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix and set aside.  (Refrigerate until served.)  Good to make ahead; it's better when set 24 hours.  Will keep a week to 10 days. Serves 12.

name: STUFFED GREEN PEPPERS
ingredients:
3  c. cooked rice
1  lb. ground meat (beef or turkey)
4  or 5 large peppers
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  tsp. parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. celery flakes
dash of garlic powder
chopped onion
2 small  cans tomato sauce
preparation: In large frypan, sauté onion.  Add meat and remaining ingredients, except rice and tomato sauce.  Cover with lid and reduce heat.  After 10 minutes, add 1 can tomato sauce.  Stir well. Cook another 10 minutes with lid on pan.  Set aside.  Wash and cut peppers in half.  Remove membranes and seeds; parboil peppers (upside down) in salted water 10 minutes.

name: HOLIDAY CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon jello
2  c. fresh cranberries, cut into cubes
1  apple, cored and cut into cubes
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
2  c. boiling water
1  orange, peeled and cut into small cubes
1  c. celery, cut into small cubes
preparation: Mix jello with boiling water.  Stir until dissolves.  Chill for 25 minutes or until thick. Add all remaining ingredients to the jello mixture.  Spoon into mold or dish.   Chill overnight.

name: EMMY'S PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti, cooked and drained
1  large bell pepper
1  large onion
1  large cucumber
1  large tomato
preparation: Cut vegetables fine.  Mix with pasta.  Add 1 bottle McCormick Salad Supreme and 1 (12 ounce) bottle Italian dressing.  Mix well.

name: BONZO SQUARES
ingredients:
2 3/4  c. sifted flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  lb. brown sugar
4  eggs
2/3  c. butter, softened (stick is best)
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix flour, baking powder and salt together in one bowl. Mix butter until smooth, then add brown sugar. Mix. Add eggs one at a time, mixing after each egg. Add dry ingredients, nuts and chocolate chips. Mix. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

name: A FRIENDSHIP RECIPE
ingredients:
2  cups peace
1/2  cup joy
10  cups love
4  cups friendliness
2  cups thankfulness
3  cups warmth
8  Tbsp. happiness
4  cups helpfulness
3  1/2 cups health
preparation: Mix ingredients well. Sprinkle with delight.  Serve with a big smile.

name: CHOCOLATE-HAZELNUT COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter, softened
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1 (13 oz.)  jar chocolate-hazelnut spread
1  oz. unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. semi sweet chocolate pieces
1  c. chopped toasted and skinned hazelnuts
5  oz. white chocolate baking square, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Beat butter and sugars; add chocolate-hazelnut spread and chocolate. Add vanilla; beat. Add eggs. Combine flour, cinnamon, soda, baking powder and salt. Stir in any remaining flour. Stir in chocolate pieces and hazelnuts. Drop 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes. Drizzle cooled cookies with white chocolate. Let stand until chocolate is set.

name: CROCK-POT ROAST
ingredients:
3 1/2 to 4  lb. beef roast (chuck, round or rump)
1/2  tsp. salt
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  envelope Lipton dry onion soup
1/4  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Put roast into crock-pot.  Sprinkle with salt, pepper and soup mix.  Do not add water.  Cover and set crock-pot on high for 1 hour, turn to low and cook 6 to 8 hours.  This gravy is real good with rice or creamed potatoes.

name: BAKED PEACH PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. sliced raw peaches
3/4  c. plus 1 c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
4  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. flour
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Place sliced peaches in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Combine 3/4 cup sugar and margarine.  Add baking powder, flour and milk. Spread over peaches.  Mix 1 cup sugar, cornstarch and salt. Sprinkle mixture over batter in pan.  Pour boiling water over all and bake at 325° for 50 minutes.  Serve warm.

name: DIVINITY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. water
few grains of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts
2  egg whites
preparation: Place sugar, syrup, water and salt in a saucepan over low heat. Stir until sugar is dissolved.  Cook to a very hard ball.  Before it reaches this stage, beat egg whites until stiff.  Pour the syrup into the egg whites (beat while pouring).  Do not scrape bottom of pan.  Continue beating until the mixture holds its shape.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Drop on a piece of wax paper from a teaspoon.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  c. butter, melted and cooled to room temperature
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1  (9-inch) ready made pie crust
preparation: Preheat  oven  to 325°.  In large bowl, beat eggs until foamy. Add  flour,  sugar  and  brown sugar;  beat until well blended. Blend  in  melted butter.  Stir in chocolate morsels and pecans. Pour into  pie  shell.  Bake  for  1 hour.	Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream, if desired.

name: BOURBON PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  (9 or 10-inch) pie crust
1/3  c. bourbon
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. margarine
3  eggs, beaten
1 1/4  c. pecan halves
1  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. dark corn syrup
preparation: Toss pecans and bourbon until coated; let stand 1 hour, until most of the bourbon is absorbed.  Heat oven to 325°.  Mix brown sugar and flour; beat in margarine until creamy.  Beat in corn syrup, eggs and salt; stir in pecan mixture.  Pour into pie shell. Cover edge with 1/2-inch aluminum foil strip to prevent excessive browning.  Bake for 45 minutes.  Remove foil last 15 minutes.

name: EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
3  whole eggs
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1 large  can evaporated milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Melt margarine in a 9-inch pie pan.  Beat eggs, sugar and flour, then add milk and stir.  Add vanilla and melted margarine. Pour in pie pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: GLORIFIED CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising corn meal
1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. cream-style corn
1/2  c. cooking oil
2  eggs
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Place approximately 2 tablespoons cooking oil in 10-inch ovenproof skillet or 8-inch or 9-inch square baking pan.  Place pan in hot oven until oil is hot.  Tilt pan to coat bottom evenly.  Mix all ingredients.  Pour mixture into hot greased pan.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

name: KRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
1  qt. kraut, drained (shredded)
1/3  c. diced onion
1  c. diced sweet pepper
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
preparation: Mix  kraut, onion, sweet pepper, sugar and vinegar well and serve.

name: JUDY'S "APRICOT" JAM
ingredients:
6  c. zucchini
1  c. water
6  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. apricot Jell-O
preparation: Peel and grate the zucchini.  Add 1 cup water; bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and cook for 6 minutes.  Add the sugar, lemon juice and crushed pineapple.  Cook for 6 more minutes.  Add the Jell-O; mix well.  Pour into jars and seal, or cool and pour into plastic containers and freeze.  Makes about 4 plus pints.

name: CURRY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  C. cheddar cheese, shredded
1  lrg. white onion, chopped
2  pkgs. softened cream cheese
tabasco
2  Tbsp. curry
1  jar mango-chutney
1/2  C. chopped walnuts
preparation: Mix together:  shredded cheese, onion, cream cheese, tabasco. Form into a ball.  Sprinkle curry on outside of ball.  Pour mango-chutney over ball and top with chopped walnuts.

name: SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. light cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. light sour cream
1/4  c. light mayonnaise
1  c. seafood cocktail sauce
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded light Mozzarella cheese
2 (4 1/4 oz.)  cans shrimp, rinsed and drained
3  green onions, sliced
3/4  c. finely chopped tomato
preparation: In a small mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese, sour cream and mayonnaise until smooth.  Spread on a 12-inch round serving platter.  Cover with seafood sauce.  Sprinkle with cheese, shrimp, onions and tomato.  Cover and chill.  Yields 8 to 10 servings.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots
1  green pepper
1 (10 oz.)  can tomato soup
1/2  c. salad oil
1  tsp. salt
1  large onion, sliced
1  or 2 medium zucchini
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. cider vinegar
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Wash, scrape and cut carrots into thick slices.  Cook in salt water until barely tender, do not overcook.  Into large bowl put sliced onion, sliced pepper and sliced zucchini and drained, cooked carrots.  In pan, put in soup, sugar, salad oil, vinegar, salt and pepper.  Bring to boil, then pour over vegetables.  Cool, cover and refrigerate.  Will keep two weeks.

name: CAMPING CHICKEN WITH RICE
ingredients:
1  c. instant rice
1  can mushroom soup
1  can peas
1/2  tsp. garlic salt (optional)
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3  boneless chicken breasts
preparation: Place 1 tablespoon rice on a square of heavy-duty foil. Arrange chicken on top.  Season soup with spices; spoon 2 tablespoons soup mixture over chicken.  Wrap and seal tightly. Cook over medium coals for 45 minutes, turning occasionally. Serves 6.

name: APPLESAUCE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  egg
2/3  c. applesauce
1/3  c. milk
1/4  c. oil
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. raisins
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. flour
1/4  c. brown sugar
4  tsp. margarine
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Spray Pam on muffin tins (makes 12 or so).  Combine egg, applesauce, milk, oil, sugar and raisins in mixing bowl.  Stir in flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon until well blended.  Do not beat.  Spoon into greased muffin tin sprayed with Pam.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes.  You may want to put a sprinkle of streusel on top before baking.

name: POT PIE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1/2  c. shortening
1  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1  egg
preparation: Beat egg in milk.  Mix together dry ingredients.  Add to egg mixture. Roll thin and cut in squares. Drop in broth until done.

name: BREAKFAST BURRITO
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. light margarine
2  c. frozen O'Brien potatoes, thawed
3/4  tsp. chili powder
1  c. egg substitute
1/4  c. salsa
1/4  c. chopped green onions
4  (7-inch) fat-free flour tortillas
1/4  c. light or fat-free sour cream (optional)
preparation: Melt margarine in large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add potatoes and chili powder. Cook potatoes until tender, stirring occasionally.

name: STRAWBERRY BREAD WITH STRAWBERRY CREAM CHEESE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. thawed frozen strawberries (reserve 2 Tbsp. juice)
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  large egg white, lightly beaten
1  oz. coarsely chopped pecans
1/2  c. light cream cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spray 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray.  In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.  Make a well in center of flour mixture; pour strawberries, oil, egg white and pecans into well.  Mix until thoroughly combined.  Spoon batter into prepared pan.  Cool completely on rack.

name: VIRGINIA'S HAMBURGER SOUP
ingredients:
3  onions, chopped
3  Tbsp. oil
1  lb. hamburger meat
1  clove garlic, chopped
3  c. beef bouillon stock
2 large  cans tomatoes
1  can corn
1  c. potatoes, cut up
1  c. celery, chopped
1  c. carrots, cut up
1  pkg. frozen okra
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/2  tsp. thyme
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Sauté onions in the oil. Add meat and garlic; cook until brown. Add rest of ingredients except okra. Bring to a boil and simmer 1 to 1 1/4 hours until potatoes and carrots are tender. Let frozen okra set out on counter while soup is cooking so it will be thawed. Add okra and cook just until it is done.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. plain flour
1  stick margarine
1  c. chopped nuts (save a few for the top)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (12 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1 large  pkg. Jell-O instant chocolate pudding mix
1  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Melt margarine.  Mix flour, melted butter and nuts.  Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan or baking dish.  Bake in 325° oven for 25 minutes. Cool.  Mix softened cream cheese with confectioners sugar.  Blend and fold in 1 cup of the Cool Whip.  Spread carefully on the crust. Mix pudding according to directions on box and spread on top of Cool Whip mixture on the crust.  Spread remaining Cool Whip on top and sprinkle with rest of nuts.  Chill, cut into squares and serve.

name: SUNDAY PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  to 8 thick pork chops
2  chicken bouillon cubes
1  onion
1  green bell pepper
1  can sliced mushrooms
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. self-rising flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. pepper
salt to taste
preparation: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, spray with Pam. Put in pork chops.  Cut up onion and bell pepper. Put on top of chops.  Put mushrooms on top.

name: GOOEY SQUARES
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  egg
1  stick butter, melted
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  eggs
1  lb. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix cake mix, egg and butter together.  Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix the cream cheese, 2 eggs and powdered sugar. Pour 1/3 cup of the cream cheese mixture over cake batter. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Sprinkle 1/3 cup powdered sugar mix over top. Cool and cut into squares.

name: CREATES ITS OWN CRUST COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs, well beaten
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/2  stick margarine, melted
2  c. milk
1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. vanilla
7  oz. coconut
preparation: Combine all ingredients; mix well.  Pour into two 9-inch pie pans.  Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until browned.

name: CALIFORNIA COCOA
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar
3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. almond extract
1/4  c. cocoa
2  tsp. grated orange rind
preparation: In a quart bowl, combine sugar and cocoa.  Add about 1/2 cup of milk to make a paste.  Stir in the remaining milk, orange rind and almond extract.  Blend and microwave on high for 6-7 minutes. Pour into cups and add cinnamon sticks for stirring.

name: CLAM DIP
ingredients:
3 6  oz. cans chopped clams
2  sticks butter
2  rolls Ritz crackers crumbled
2 1/2  tsp. parsley
2  tsp. oregano
1 large  clove garlic
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Melt butter in skillet.  Add clams and juice.  Add Ritz crackers and spices.  Put in a buttered dish.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

name: ONION MUSHROOM GRAVY
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets Onion Mushroom Soup Mix
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
2  c. cold water
preparation: In medium saucepan, combine soup mix and flour, stir in water.  Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to medium and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, 5 minutes or until gravy is thickened.  Makes 2 cups.

name: BARBECUED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1  c. tomato puree or catsup
1/3  c. fat
1/2  c. hot water
1/3  c. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Blend salt, pepper, paprika and sugar in saucepan.  Add onion, tomato, fat and water.  Heat to boiling.  Remove from heat; add lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce.  Cut up chicken; arrange in shallow baking pan.  Brush with hot barbecue sauce.  Cover and bake in moderate oven until about half done.  Uncover; continue cooking and baste frequently with hot sauce until chicken is tender and browned.  Total cooking time is 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

name: CINCINNATI CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can crushed tomatoes
1  large onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. chili powder
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  lb. spaghetti
chopped onion
oyster crackers
3 1/2  c. water
1  can tomato paste
2  bay leaves
1  Tbsp. unsweetened cocoa powder
1  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  tsp. ground cumin
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
1  can kidney beans
finely shredded Colby cheese
preparation: Simmer ground beef and water for 15 minutes, breaking up meat. Skim foam with spoon.  Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, onion, bay leaves, chili powder, cocoa powder, garlic, vinegar, cinnamon, cumin, salt and cloves.  Simmer for 1 1/2 hours on low heat, stirring occasionally.  Cover pan halfway through cooking so sauce does not get too thick.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. sirloin
2  Tbsp. margarine
1 1/2  c. beef broth
2  Tbsp. catsup
1  tsp. salt
1 small  clove garlic, mashed
8  oz. mushrooms, sliced
1  medium onion, chopped
3  Tbsp. flour
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Cut beef across grain into strips.  Cook and stir beef in margarine in 10-inch skillet over low heat until brown.  Reserve 1/3 cup of broth, stir in remaining broth, catsup, salt and garlic into skillet.  Heat to boiling and reduce heat.  Cover and simmer until beef is tender, 45 minutes.  Stir in mushrooms and onion. Cover and simmer until onion is tender.  Shake reserved broth and the flour in a tightly covered container.  Gradually stir into beef mixture.  Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.  Boil and stir 1 minute.  Reduce heat, stir in sour cream and heat through. Serve over noodles or rice.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. fresh corn, cut off the cob or frozen corn, thawed
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. milk
2  egg yolks, lightly beaten
2  egg whites, beaten to soft peaks
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: In mixing bowl, stir together the corn, flour, sugar, salt, pepper and milk. Fork in beaten egg yolks, then fold in beaten whites. Pour into a buttered 1-quart casserole. Dot top with butter. Bake, uncovered, in a moderate oven (350°) for about 45 to 50 minutes just until middle is set.

name: DILL PICKLES
ingredients:
1/8  tsp. powdered alum
1  clove garlic
grape leaves
3  qt. water
2  heads dill
1  hot red pepper
1  c. salt
1  qt. vinegar
cucumbers
preparation: Wash cucumbers.  Cover with hot water and let stand until hot through.  Pack into hot jars.  To each quart, add the listed amounts of alum, dill, pepper and garlic with a grape leaf or two. Combine vinegar, salt and water.  Heat to boiling, fill jars and seal.  Makes 6 to 8 quarts.  Put in hot water in a large pot on stove for 20 minutes or more, then remove from water.

name: MERRY BERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. raspberry gelatin
1 1/2  c. boiling water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen raspberries or strawberries
1  tsp. lemon juice
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. cherry gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1 (13 to 15 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (1 lb.)  can whole berry cranberry sauce
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Dissolve raspberry gelatin in water.  Add frozen raspberries and lemon juice, stirring until thawed.  Pour into 13 x 9-inch and 6 x 6-inch Pyrex dishes and refrigerate until firm.  Cover with sour cream.  Dissolve cherry gelatin in water and add remaining ingredients.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Pour over sour cream.  Chill thoroughly.

name: NEVER FAIL ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. yeast with 1 c. warm water
3/4  c. Crisco
1  c. boiling water
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
6  c. self-rising flour
preparation: Mix  yeast  with  warm	water.	Set aside.  With mixer, beat Crisco  and  boiling  water.  Add  sugar.  Add eggs;  mix well. Add yeast  mixture	and mix well.  Then add flour.	Mix all this together and cover.  Refrigerate until ready to use. Roll out 1/4-inch thick;  dip in melted butter.  Fold over and bake at 450° until brown.

name: DONNA'S POPPY SEED CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon cake mix
1 (3 3/4 oz.)  pkg. lemon pudding
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. poppy seed
4  eggs
1  c. warm water
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Mix all ingredients together.  Beat 4 minutes.  Pour into 2 floured and greased loaf pans.  Bake 45 minutes.  Needs no frosting.

name: CHILE SAUCE
ingredients:
24  red skinned tomatoes, chopped
6  onions, chopped
2  green peppers, chopped
1 1/2  c. sugar
3 to 4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ground cloves
pinch of cayenne
pinch of dry mustard
preparation: Boil in uncovered kettle for several hours, stirring occasionally.  Can.  Makes about eight 1/2-quart jars.

name: CHOCOLATE MINT DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. oleo, softened
4  eggs
16  oz. can Hershey's syrup
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.   Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

name: CHICKEN CORDON BLEU
ingredients:
chicken breast
bread crumbs
ham slices
white or yellow cheese
preparation: Cover chicken breast with bread crumbs.  Partly cut chicken to the middle, then put ham and cheese inside chicken and bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.  Makes one sandwich.

name: ONION CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  to 6 onions
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. milk
1  c. buttered cracker crumbs
preparation: Slice and quarter onions; boil until tender.  Drain.  While onions are cooking, make white sauce.  Melt margarine in saucepan. Add flour, salt and pepper.  Cook 1 minute.  Slowly add the milk and stir until boils; boil 1 minute.  In a  1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole dish, layer onions, white sauce, cracker crumbs, onion, white sauce and cracker crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. dairy topping
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. sour cream
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. cottage cheese
1 (13 oz.)  pkg. jello (orange or peach)
1  c. fruit cocktail, drained
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients well.  Add drained fruit and pecans. Refrigerate overnight.

name: COLE SLAW
ingredients:
8  c. finely chopped cabbage
1/4  c. shredded carrot
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. buttermilk
1 1/2  Tbsp. white vinegar
2 1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. finely chopped onion (optional)
preparation: Finely chop cabbage and carrots.  Combine sugar, salt, pepper, milk, mayonnaise, buttermilk, vinegar and lemon juice.  Beat until smooth.  Add cabbage and carrots; mix well.  Cover and refrigerate approximately 2 hours before serving.  Refrigeration is necessary to enhance the flavor.

name: TACO SALAD CUPS
ingredients:
1  can (more or less) vegeburger
1/4  c. (more or less) barbecue sauce
2 1/2  tsp. minced onion
1 to 2  tsp. brown sugar
4  medium tomatoes (I like to use little tomatoes and make individual salad cups)
3  c. shredded lettuce
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/3  c. coarsely crushed taco chips
sour cream
sliced ripe olives
commercial taco sauce
preparation: Crumb vegeburger into mixing bowl or casserole dish.  Cover tightly and microwave at High for 3 to 5 minutes (may need to add a little oil to dish).  Stir in barbecue sauce, onion and sugar; set aside.

name: FROZEN COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  can cream of coconut
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  pkg. frozen coconut
1  medium Cool Whip
preparation: Take coconut out of freezer to thaw.  Bake cake as directed on box.  Remove from oven and take a fork and punch holes all over cake while it's still in the pan.  Pour cream of coconut over cake.  When this has soaked in (approximately 30 minutes), pour Eagle Brand milk over cake.  After this has soaked in (approximately 30 minutes), spread container of Cool Whip over top of cake.  Sprinkle with entire package of thawed coconut. Refrigerate for approximately 2 hours or until chilled. Refrigerate after serving.

name: CANDY BAR PIE
ingredients:
6  Hershey bars with almonds
1  large tub Cool Whip
1  chocolate pie crust
preparation: Melt Hershey bars.  Fold into Cool Whip.  Mix well.  Spoon into pie crust.  Freeze.  Serve frozen.

name: CHEESE CARROTS
ingredients:
1/2  tsp. plain gelatin
1  Tbsp. cold water
1/4  c. pimiento cheese spread
1/8  tsp. salt
dash of Worcestershire sauce
1/3  c. freshly grated carrots
parsley
preparation: Soften gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes; melt over hot water.  Cool slightly.  Blend with the cheese, salt and Worcestershire sauce.  Chill just enough to stiffen slightly. Divide into 1/2 teaspoon portions; roll in the grated carrots until well coated.  Place on wax paper and chill.  Stick a sprig in the end of each.

name: MOM'S BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  stalk chopped celery
6  onions, chopped
3  bell peppers, chopped
1  bulb chopped garlic
2  Tbsp. mustard
1  (32 oz.) catsup
1  can tomato sauce
1  pt. oil or less
salt and pepper to taste
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Saute first 3 ingredients in a large pot.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 3 to 4 hours.  Very chunky.  Yum!

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2 3/4  c. sifted all-purpose flour
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Cream butter and 1 1/2 cups sugar until fluffy.  Add eggs and vanilla; beat well.  Mix together flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt; blend into creamed mixture. Combine cinnamon and 2 tablespoons sugar in small bowl.  Shape dough into 1-inch balls.  Roll in cinnamon-sugar mixture.  Place on greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until light golden brown.  Cool on wire racks.

name: SANDY'S CHOCOLATE MOUSSE
ingredients:
3/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. instant coffee granules
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. miniature marshmallows
1  c. chocolate chips
1  Tbsp. almond flavoring
3  c. heavy cream
raspberry jelly
2  pkg. ladyfingers, split
preparation: Combine  water  and  instant coffee granules.  Bring to boil. Add marshmallows, chocolate chips and almond flavoring. Mix well. Let set for 1/2 hour to cool.  Whip cream to peaks. Fold chocolate  mixture into whipped cream.  Line spring-form pan bottom  and  sides  with  split ladyfingers.  Spread with jelly. Pour  mousse  in.  Chill  overnight.  Remove from pan. Garnish with whipped cream.

name: RANCH POTATOES
ingredients:
5  lb. new potatoes
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. white pepper
3  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1 (16 oz.)  bottle Ranch dressing
1  c. cooked bacon, crumbled
1  c. green onion tops, chopped
preparation: Peel and slice potatoes and boil until tender.  Drain potatoes and place in a pan that has been sprayed with a nonstick coating spray.  With potatoes spread flat, pour butter over hot potatoes and sprinkle with salt and white pepper.  Sprinkle cheese evenly over potatoes.  Pour Ranch dressing onto cheese.  Spread dressing evenly over potatoes/cheese.  Sprinkle bacon and green onions on top of Ranch dressing.  Serve warmed or chilled.

name: WALNUT DELICACIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. plain sifted flour
1  c. finely chopped nuts
preparation: Mix butter, sugar and vanilla.  Gradually stir in flour and nuts.  Chill dough.

name: QUICK AND EASY DIP FOR FRUIT
ingredients:
16  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  pt. marshmallow cream
1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Combine all ingredients and blend until smooth with an electric mixer.

name: BUNCHES OF BLOODYS(May prepare ahead.  Serves 25.)
ingredients:
1 (46 oz.)  can V-8 juice
1 (10 oz.)  can beef broth or bouillon
5  oz. Dr Tillit Suit's Bloody Mary seasoning
1 (32 oz.)  can tomato juice
32  oz. vodka or gin
1/2  c. fresh squeezed lemon juice
lots of crushed ice
lime wedges
fresh ground pepper
2 (1-liter)  bottles ginger ale
2 (12 oz.)  cans frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
2 (12 oz.)  cans frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
2  c. cranberry juice
1  c. powdered sugar
1  fifth gin or vodka
fresh fruit for garnish
3  oz. Kahlua
2  oz. brandy
2  oz. Grand Marnier
2 heaping  Tbsp. dark brown sugar
8  c. freshly made, strong, hot Espresso
2  c. heavy cream
1 (6 oz.)  jar instant nondairy creamer (1 1/2 c.)
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  c. instant coffee crystals
dash of salt
preparation: Thoroughly mix all ingredients together.  Store in airtight container.  When ready to serve, mix 1/4 cup mix with 2/3 cup boiling water.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2 or 1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
3  large bananas, crushed
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. pecans
preparation: Cream first 3 ingredients.  Combine last 4 ingredients. Combine in order given including bananas.  Bake in an oiled and floured loaf pan at 350° for 40 minutes.  Allow to stand until following day before cutting.

name: TATE'S ZUCCHINI BAKE
ingredients:
3  medium size zucchini, diced
2  large onions
2  bell peppers (1 red, 1 green)
1  Jiffy corn muffin mix
1  Tbsp. minced garlic
2 1/2  lb. ground chuck
1 1/2  lb. American cheese, diced (Velveeta may be used)
preparation: Saute ground beef in a skillet until browned.  Add peppers, garlic and onions and cook for another 2 minutes.  While meat is cooking, make corn muffin mix batter according to directions. Place half of the batter in a greased bread pan.  Over the batter, place a layer of the meat mixture.  Add a layer of zucchini, then cheese.  Keep layering until mixture is gone.  Finally, add the rest of the corn muffin mix.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: MASHED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  c. mashed potatoes
1/3  c. diced onion
1  beaten egg
8  oz. cream cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Blend cream cheese in with potatoes until melted.  Add diced onion and salt and pepper to taste.  Add egg and mix well.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: Vegetable Noodle Casserole
ingredients:
1  can (10-3/4 oz) condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1  can (10-3/4 oz) condensed cream of broccoli soup, undiluted
1-1/2  cups milk
1  cup grated Parmesan cheese, divided
3  garlic cloves, minced
2  tablespoons dried parsley flakes
1/2  teaspoon pepper
1/4  teaspoon salt
1  package (16 oz) wide egg noodles, cooked and drained
1  package (16 oz) frozen broccoli, cauliflower and carrot blend, thawed
2  cups frozen corn, thawed
preparation: In a bowl, combine soups, milk, 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese, garlic, parsley, pepper and salt: mix well.  Add noodles and vegetables: mix well.  Pour into a greased 13-in. x 9-in. x 2-in. baking dish. Sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan.  Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes or until heated through.  Yield 12-14 servings.

name: SPINACH WITH GROUND BEEF
ingredients:
4  bunches fresh spinach
1  lb. ground beef
8  gloves minced garlic
1/2  c. pine nuts, fried
3  Tbsp. chopped cilantro
2  Tbsp. butter
4  c. water
salt, pepper and allspice
1/2  c. lemon juice
preparation: Wash spinach very good; cut medium.  Heat butter; add ground beef and fry until brown.  Add garlic and cilantro.  Fry together for five minutes, then add salt, pepper and allspice, then add water.  Bring to boil, then reduce heat.   Cook for 5 minutes, then add spinach.  Stir good.  Cook for 1/2 hour; turn heat off, then add lemon juice.  Garnish with fried pine nuts.  Eat with cooked rice.  Serves 6 people.

name: PIZZA PASTA
ingredients:
1/2  lb. pork sausage
2/3  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green bell pepper
1/3  c. chopped fresh mushrooms
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can Chunky Tomatoes Pasta Style
1 (15 oz.)  can Pizza Sauce, flavored with Pepperoni
2  c. water
1/3  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/3  c. sliced ripe olives, optional
6 to 8  oz. Rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained
Parmesan (best if freshly grated)
preparation: Combine sausage, onion, bell pepper and mushrooms in large skillet.  Cook until sausage is fully cooked.  Drain any excess grease.  Add tomatoes, pizza sauce, and water.  Cook over low heat for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Stir in cheese, olives and cooked pasta.  Continue to cook over low heat until cheese melts. When serving, top with a sprinkling of Parmesan.

name: ZUCCHINI STUFFING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. zucchini and/or yellow summer squash, sliced 3/8 inch thick (7 c.)
1/4  c. chopped onion
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  c. shredded carrot
2  c. herb-seasoned stuffing mix
1/4  c. butter, melted
preparation: In a large saucepan, cook zucchini and onion in boiling salted water for 5 to 10 minutes or until crisp-tender.  Drain zucchini mixture well.  In a large bowl combine soup and sour cream; stir in carrots. fold in zucchini mixture.  Toss stuffing mix with margarine or butter.  Spread half the stuffing mixture in a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish.  Spoon zucchini mixture atop.  Sprinkle with remaining stuffing mixture.  Bake in a 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through.  Makes 6 servings.

name: ELEGANT LEMON CAKE ROLL
ingredients:
4  eggs, separated
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. lemon extract
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/2  c. sugar
2/3  c. sifted cake flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
powdered sugar
Creamy Lemon Filling
1/2  c. flaked coconut
1/4  tsp. water
1 to 2  drops yellow food coloring
preparation: Beat egg yolks until light and lemon colored; gradually add 1/4 cup sugar, beating constantly.  Stir in lemon extract and vegetable oil; set aside.  Beat egg whites until foamy; gradually add 1/2 cup sugar, beating until stiff, but not dry.  Fold yolk mixture into whites.  Combine flour, baking powder and salt.  Fold into egg mixture.  Grease a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jellyroll pan and line with waxed paper; grease and flour waxed paper.  Spread batter evenly in pan.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Sift powdered sugar in a 15 x 10-inch rectangle on a linen towel.  When cake is done, immediately loosen from sides of pan and turn out on sugar.  Peel off waxed paper.  Starting at narrow end, roll up cake and towel together; cool on a wire rack seam side down. Unroll cake; spread with half of creamy lemon filling and re-roll. Place on serving plate, seam side down, and spread remaining filling on all sides.  Combine coconut, water and food coloring in a plastic bag.  Close securely and shake well.  Sprinkle colored coconut over cake roll.  Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

name: ROCKY ROAD S'MORES BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. flour
1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
2  c. miniature marshmallows
6  oz. semi-sweet chocolate
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Grease a 9-inch square pan.  Beat margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add combined flour and crumbs; mix well.  Press onto bottom of pan.  Sprinkle with remaining ingredients.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Cool and cut into bars.  Makes 16 servings.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
3/4  tsp. soda
2  eggs
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  c. shortening (soft)
1 1/3  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. raisins
preparation: Sift flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg into bowl; add shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Beat well.  Stir in oats and raisins.  Drop on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE WITH ALMONDS
ingredients:
3  or 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1  c. sour cream
1  can celery soup
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. slivered almonds
1  tube Ritz crackers
2  Tbsp. poppy seed
1/2  stick butter, melted
preparation: Boil chicken.  Cut into bite size pieces.  Mix sour cream, soups and almonds with chicken.  Put in buttered baking dish. Cover with cracker crumbs and sprinkle 1 teaspoon poppy seed over crackers.  Pour melted butter over.  Bake at 350° until bubbly, usually 30 to 45 minutes.

name: OYAKO DONBURI(Rice With Chicken And Egg Topping)
ingredients:
5  c. cooked white rice (short grain)
1 1/2  c. chicken, thinly sliced
1 1/2  c. chicken stock
1/3  c. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. sake
3  or 4 sliced mushrooms
1/2  cake Kamaboko, sliced (steamed fish cake)
5  eggs, well beaten
green onions, chopped
1/4  lb. snow peas or Chinese pea pods, parboiled
preparation: Cook chicken in stock. Season with soy sauce, sugar and sake. Add mushrooms and Kamaboko.  Bring to a boil and add eggs. When eggs are well coddled, spoon mixture over hot rice in individual bowls.  Garnish with green onions and snow peas.

name: MICROWAVE POTATO CHIPS
ingredients: 1  potato, thinly sliced (peel or don't peel)
preparation: Spray a dinner plate with Pam.  Place slices on plate in a single row.  Microwave on High for 4 minutes.  Turn slices over and continue to microwave on High another 3 to 5 minutes.  Potatoes are done when lightly browned.  If they aren't browned, they won't get crisp.  This may take longer depending on your microwave's wattage, but you'll be safe with the initial 4 minutes of cooking. You need to watch them carefully after that.  Now comes the hard part.  Remove from plate and toss in a bowl with salt or seasoning of your choice and let cool!  It's important to let cool so they can crisp up.

name: FIESTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  large head lettuce
1 (15 oz.)  can Ranch Style beans, rinsed and chilled
1/2  onion, chopped fine
1 (11 oz.)  pkg. corn chips
2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
2  tomatoes, diced
3/4  bottle Catalina dressing
preparation: Prepare lettuce as for a tossed salad.   Drain and rinse chilled beans.   Combine lettuce, diced tomatoes, onions, beans, grated cheese and Catalina dressing.  Chill for 30 minutes.   Add crushed corn chips and mix well before serving.   Serves 12.

name: MAZOLA SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/3  c. Mazola corn oil
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg plus milk to equal 1/3 c.
preparation: Mix flour, baking powder and salt.  Add Mazola oil.  Beat sugar, vanilla and egg mixture with mixer until light and fluffy. Add flour mixture and mix well.  Chill dough 1 hour.  Roll out on floured board; cut into desired shapes.  Cook at 400° for 9 minutes.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: FRIED CORN
ingredients:
4  ears corn
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. Crisco
1 1/2  c. water
preparation: After corn is cut from the ears, put in pot with Crisco, on medium heat, stirring to keep from sticking, for ten minutes.  Add flour; cook for 10 minutes longer, then add water.  Simmer and season to desired taste for 25 minutes longer.

name: CHOW CHOW
ingredients:
1  gal. chopped cabbage
1  doz. large onions
1  doz. red sweet peppers
1  doz. green peppers
1  oz. cloves
3  tsp. ground mustard
1/2  gal. chopped green tomatoes
2  lb. sugar
3  tsp. ground ginger
preparation: Sprinkle lightly  with	salt  the  chopped ingredients. Let stand  1/2 hour  or  longer.  Press  juice	from  chopped ingredients.  Put chopped  ingredients,  sugar and spices in a pot.  Cover with vinegar and boil slowly for 1/2 hour.  Put in jars while hot.

name: ROASTED GARLIC
ingredients:
8  whole heads fresh garlic
1/3  c. olive oil
1 1/2  tsp. freshly ground pepper
1 1/2  tsp. dried thyme
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Trim off each garlic head to expose the tops of the cloves.  Place heads in shallow baking dish, such as a 9-inch pie plate.  Drizzle garlic with oil and sprinkle with pepper, salt and thyme.  Roast garlic for 30 minutes.  Reduce heat to 250° and cook for 1 hour longer.  Serve garlic with slices of crusty French bread, butter and goat cheese, such as Feta.  Pop the cloves out of the skins and spread on bread.  Yield:  8 servings.

name: TEXAN-SIZE ALMOND CRUNCH COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. butter, softened
1  c. oil
1  tsp. almond extract
2  eggs
3 1/2  c. flour
1  c. whole wheat flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cream of tartar
2  c. coarsely chopped almonds
6  oz. pkg. almond brickle baking chips
preparation: Blend sugar, powdered sugar, margarine and oil until well mixed. Add almond extract and eggs; mix well. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. Gradually blend in all flours, soda, salt and cream of tartar at low speed. By hand, stir in almonds and brickle chips. For easier handling, refrigerate dough about 30 minutes. Shape into balls; roll in sugar. Place 5 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets. With fork dipped in sugar, flatten in crisscross pattern. Bake at 350° for 12 to 18 minutes or until light golden brown around edges. Cool cookies 1 minute before removing from cookie sheet. Makes 3 1/2 dozen (4 inch) cookies.

name: SNOW PEAS WITH GARLIC DIP
ingredients:
3/4  c. lite sour cream
1/4  c. lite mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. minced green onion
2  small garlic cloves, minced
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
1  tsp. fresh lemon juice
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. freshly ground pepper
1/2  lb. snow peas, trimmed
preparation: Combine first 8 ingredients in bowl and mix well.  Refrigerate 1 hour.  Serve with snow peas.  Yield:  1 cup.

name: EGGPLANT VERMICELLI
ingredients:
4  oz. vermicelli
1  tsp. olive oil
1  c. peeled and cubed eggplant
1  c. finely chopped onion
2  cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2  tsp. dried basil
1 1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1/4  tsp. crushed red pepper
1  small zucchini, thinly sliced
1/4  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
2  large tomatoes, chopped
1  Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook vermicelli.  Drain and set aside.  Coat a large skillet with cooking spray.  Add olive oil and place over medium-high heat until hot.  Add eggplant and next 5 ingredients.  Saute until vegetables are tender.  Add zucchini, mushrooms and tomatoes; saute 2 minutes or until mixture is thoroughly heated.

name: PRETZEL STRAWBERRY
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. coarsely crumbled pretzels
1  stick margarine
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 large  box strawberry Jell-O
2  c. boiling water
1  c. cold water
2 small  boxes frozen or thawed strawberries
1  small container whipped topping
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. sugar
preparation: Melt margarine and brown sugar together and remove from heat. Blend in pretzels and spread in a greased 13 x 9-inch glass pan. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes in preheated 350° oven. Cool and set aside.

name: HAPPINESS CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. good thoughts
2  c. sacrifice
3  c. forgiveness
1  c. consideration
2  c. our own faults
preparation: Beat thoroughly.  Add tears of joy, sorrow and sympathy. Flavor with love and kindly sympathy.  Fold in 4 cups of prayer, faith and enthusiasm.  Spread all into your daily life.  Blend well with human kindness.  Serve with a smile at all times, and it will satisfy the hunger of many people less fortunate than ourselves.

name: PAN COAT
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
1  c. Crisco oil
1  c. flour
preparation: Mix together and brush on cooking pans when needed.

name: ORANGE GLAZED COOKIE BARS
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. packed light brown sugar
2 1/2  c. Post 40% Bran Flakes
1/3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
2  tsp. grated orange rind
1/4  c. softened butter
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. chopped raisins
preparation: Beat eggs until thick and lemon-colored.  Add sugar, gradually beating until blended and thick.  Add cereal, flour, salt, nutmeg, rind and butter.  Mix well.  Stir in nuts and raisins.  Spread in greased 9-inch square pan.  Bake in oven at 375° about 25 minutes. Then spread with glaze.  Cool before cutting.  Makes 24 bars.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  German chocolate cake mix
1  can Eagle Brand milk
2  sticks butter
1  c. chopped pecans
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. Kraft caramels
preparation: Mix cake mix as directed on box.  Divide cake mix in half. Mix half of cake with 1/2 can of Eagle Brand milk and 1/2 cup of butter (1 stick).  Bake for 20 minutes.

name: HONEY-OATMEAL MUFFINS(Nonfat)
ingredients:
2/3  c. skim milk
1/2  c. applesauce
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. honey
2  c. Quaker oats
1  c. flour
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. nuts
1/3  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
preparation: Add milk, applesauce, egg and honey to combined remaining ingredients, mixing just until dry ingredients are moistened. Fill 12 greased or paper-lined size muffin cups.  Bake in preheated 400° oven for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

name: SHAWN'S CHILI(Prep Time: 2 Hours)
ingredients:
3  lb. ground beef
