1 1/2  c. salsa
2  (6 oz.) tomato paste
1  (28 oz.) tomatoes
3 to 4  Tbsp. chili powder
2  tsp. salt
2  cloves garlic
3/4  c. chopped onions
3/4  c. green peppers
2 (12 oz.)  cans chili beans
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
pepper to taste
hot sauce to taste (optional)
preparation: Brown ground beef with onions and green peppers.  Combine all ingredients in 3 to 4-quart saucepan and simmer on stove for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until beans are hot.  Serve as a chili spread for chili dogs or on crisp tostadas, filler for burritos and just plain chili.  This tastes even better the next day!!

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2 or 3 fresh  bunches broccoli (depending on size you want)
2  lb. bacon, fried crisp, drained and chopped
2  medium onions, chopped
2 or 4  c. raisins (uncooked)
1  c. sunflower seeds
mayo
lemon juice
sugar
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients.  Blend a sauce with mayo, little lemon juice and sugar.  Blend into salad.  Salt and pepper to taste.

name: BARBECUE
ingredients:
3  lb. hamburger
onion to taste
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/3 to 1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. mustard
1 1/2 to 2  c. or more ketchup
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion.  Add rest of ingredients.  Simmer on low for two hours.

name: BREAD AND BUTTER PICKLES
ingredients:
6  qt. sliced medium cucumbers
1  c. salt
6  onions (medium size), sliced (optional)
1 1/2  qt. vinegar
6  c. sugar
1/2  c. mustard seed
1  Tbsp. celery seed
preparation: Combine seasoning and vinegar and boil.   Add cucumbers and onions.  Heat to simmering and pack hot in hot jars.  Be careful to avoid boiling as that makes pickles soft.

name: TACOED EGGS
ingredients:
8  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
2  Tbsp. finely chopped green pepper
1 to 4  drops hot pepper sauce
1/2  c. leftover cooked taco-seasoned ground beef
flour or corn tortillas
picante sauce
preparation: In a bowl, combine eggs, cheese, onion, green pepper and hot pepper sauce.  Cook and stir in a nonstick skillet until eggs begin to set.  Add taco meat; cook until eggs are completely set. Spoon onto warmed flour or corn tortillas and roll up; top with picante sauce.  Yield: 4 servings.

name: CORN AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  chopped onion
1/2  green pepper
1  stick margarine
1 small  jar pimento
4  Tbsp. flour
2  c. cooked rice
2  c. whole kernel corn
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
2  boiled eggs
preparation: Mix green pepper with onion and butter.  Cook until soft.  Mix with other things and put in big casserole dish.  Put grated cheese on top and cover with bread crumbs.  Bake at 300° until it bubbles.

name: TROPICAL CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. cubed, cooked chicken
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2 to 1  tsp. curry powder
1 (20 oz.)  can chunk pineapple, drained
2  large, firm bananas, sliced
1/2  c. flaked coconut
salad greens
3/4  c. salted cashew halves (optional)
preparation: Place chicken and celery in a large bowl.  Combine mayonnaise and curry powder.  Add to chicken mixture and mix well.  Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes.  Before serving, add the pineapple, bananas, oranges and coconut.  Toss gently.  Serve on salad greens.  If desired, sprinkle with nuts.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
1  broiler-fryer
1  medium, sliced onion
1  qt. water
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/2  lb. sliced mushrooms
1  pkg. thin spaghetti
1  Tbsp. butter
2  chopped celery stalks
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  beaten egg yolks
1/2  c. whipping cream
1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Combine chicken, celery, onion, salt and water in large pot. Bring to a boil and simmer 1 hour or until chicken is tender. Remove from broth; cool, debone and chop meat.  Set aside.  Strain broth and discard vegetables.  Refrigerate broth until fat rises to top; skim off.  Reserve remaining broth.  Melt 3 tablespoons of fat in heavy saucepan over low heat.  Add flour; stir until smooth.  Cook 1 minute; stir constantly and gradually add 1 1/2 cups of broth.  Cook until thickened.  Combine yolks and cream; stir well.  Gradually stir about 1/4 of the broth mixture into egg mixture.  Stir into remaining hot mixture.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is smooth and thickened.  Saute mushrooms 2 minutes and add mushrooms, salt and chicken to cream sauce; stir well.

name: WHITE SALAD
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
2 large  cans crushed pineapple, drained
2  cans mandarin oranges, drained
1  c. pecans
preparation: Mix together.  Chill for at least 30 minutes.

name: BEEF NACHO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (12 oz.)  jar chunky salsa
1  c. corn, drained
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. chili powder
2  c. crushed tortilla chips, divided
2  c. Kraft shredded Colby/Monterey Jack cheese, divided
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Brown meat; drain.  Stir in salsa, corn, dressing (mayonnaise) and chili powder.  Layer 1/2 each of meat mixture, chips and cheese in a 2-quart casserole.  Repeat layers. Bake 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated.  Top with shredded lettuce and chopped tomatoes if desired.  Makes 6 servings.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. catsup
1/2  c. cider vinegar
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. celery seed
1 1/2  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Mix well.  Keeps up to 2 weeks in the fridge.

name: ICEBOX COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. butter
2 1/4  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. soda, in 1 Tbsp. Karo
5 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. cloves
3/4  tsp. allspice
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Sift the flour with the cinnamon, cloves and allspice.  Mix as butter cake. Form dough in rolls and wrap in waxed paper. Refrigerate, slice and bake as needed.

name: SAUSAGE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
8  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. sour cream
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  medium onion, chopped
preparation: Brown sausage and onion; drain.  Add other ingredients. Simmer until heated through, but do not boil.  Put in crock-pot on low to keep warm.  Serve with warm tortilla chips.

name: REFRIGERATOR PICKLES
ingredients:
12  c. thinly sliced cukes
1  large onion, thinly sliced
1  large green pepper, diced
3 1/2  c. sugar
2  c. white vinegar
2  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Scrub cucumbers; don't peel.  Put in a large bowl all the ingredients.  Stir to dissolve sugar.  Cover and refrigerate. Next day, mix thoroughly.  Pack in jars with some liquid.  Will keep up to 6 months refrigerated.  Makes approximately 5 pints.

name: KNOX BLOX
ingredients:
4  envelopes unflavored gelatin
3 (3 oz.)  pkg. jello
4  c. boiling water
preparation: Pour water over gelatin and jello, stirring well.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Place in refrigerator until set.  Cut in squares or other choice of design.

name: ORANGE JULIUS
ingredients:
1/2  container frozen orange juice
1  c. milk
1  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sugar
10  to 15 medium ice cubes
preparation: Mix all ingredients in blender.  Blend until desired consistency.

name: VANILLA WAFER CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
2  c. granulated sugar
6  eggs
1 (12 oz.)  box vanilla wafers
1/2  c. milk
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. flaked coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Beat in eggs, one at a time, then continue beating until smooth and fluffy.  Crush vanilla wafers fine with a rolling pin or in food processor.  Add the vanilla wafers to the butter and sugar mixture.  Fold in coconut and pecans.  Pour in a greased and floured pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done.

name: EASY CHERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
2  cans tart cherries, not drained
1  stick margarine
1  pkg. white cake mix
1  c. nuts
preparation: Pour cherries in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan; sprinkle dry cake mix over cherries (do not stir).  Pour melted margarine over cake mix and sprinkle nuts on top; do not mix.  Bake in a 400° oven for 30 minutes or until set.  Top with ice cream to serve.

name: STIR-FRY CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  lb. chicken
2  carrots, sliced
1  c. sliced celery
2  Tbsp. oil
3  c. rice, cooked
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
1  c. mushrooms, sliced
3  Tbsp. sweet and sour sauce
2  red peppers (optional)
water (approximately 1 c.)
preparation: Saute chicken 5 minutes on each side in oil.  Remove chicken; saute sliced vegetables.  Add chicken and water.  Let stream 15 minutes and add sauce.  Let cook 3 minutes and serve with rice.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. shortening
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
1  c. mashed ripe bananas
1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Stir together flour, baking powder, soda and 3/4 teaspoon salt.  Set aside.  In a mixer bowl, beat sugar and shortening with electric mixer until light.  Add eggs, one at a time, then milk, beating until smooth.  Add flour mixture and banana alternately to creamed mixture, beating until smooth after each addition.  Fold in nuts.  Turn batter into a lightly greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 60 to 65 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.  Cool in pan 10 minutes.  Remove from pan; cool.   For easier slicing, wrap and store overnight.

name: PEANUT BUTTER MONSTERS - CHEWY(Cookies)
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. margarine
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2  tsp. soda
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. corn syrup
1 1/3  c. smooth or chunky peanut butter
1/2  c. chocolate chips
4 1/2  c. quick oatmeal (not instant)
1  c. brown sugar
preparation: In a large mixing bowl cream margarine.  Add sugars and beat until light.  Add eggs and beat again.  Then add syrup, vanilla and peanut butter.  Mix well.   Add oatmeal.  Sprinkle the soda over dry oatmeal and blend into mix.  Add nuts and chips.  Drop by tablespoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.

name: PARALEE SARGENT'S STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple
2 small  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1 large  carton cottage cheese
1 large  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Put pineapple in pan.  Let come to a boil.  Add Jell-O.  Let it thicken.  Fold in gently large cottage cheese.  Add Cool Whip. Refrigerate to congeal.

name: BEST CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. plain flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. water
3/4  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
4  oz. unsweetened chocolate
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Bake for 30 minutes in round 8-inch pans. It takes longer for larger pans.  A very moist cake.

name: SNOWY COCONUT TREATS(For Children)
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. soft margarine
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. flaked coconut
6  graham crackers
preparation: Put margarine in bowl; stir in sugar.  Mix until smooth.  Stir in coconut.  Spread mixture on graham crackers.  May be put under broiler for a minute to brown.

name: SAUCY ASPARAGUS
ingredients:
1  can Campbell's cream of asparagus soup
2  pkg. (10 oz. each) frozen asparagus cuts
preparation: In 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, combine soup and milk. Heat to boiling, stirring often.  Add asparagus.  Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes or until asparagus is tender, stirring often.  Serve with grated Parmesan cheese, if desired. Makes 8 servings.

name: ICE CREAM DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flaked coconut
6  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. nuts
2  c. Rice Krispies
6  oz. semi-sweet chocolate chips
13  oz. can evaporated milk
10 1/2  oz. bag mini marshmallows
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
preparation: Brown 1 1/2 cups coconut in margarine.  Add nuts.  Toss in Rice Krispies.  Melt chocolate chips; add evaporated milk and marshmallows.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. squash
1  medium onion
1  grated carrot
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
1/2  pkg. Pepperidge Farm dressing
1  stick butter
4 to 6  slices cheese
preparation: Preparation time:  15 minutes.

name: STUFFED PEPPER POT
ingredients:
4  large green peppers
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
2  c. cooked rice
8  oz. can tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. celery, chopped
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Cut thin slice from stem end of pepper and remove seed.  In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish combine onion and ground beef.  Place in microwave and cook 2 to 3 minutes on High or until beef is slightly brown.  Add remaining ingredients, except peppers.  Mix well. Stuff peppers with mixture and place on baking sheet.  Cover with plastic wrap and microwave 12 to 15 minutes on Medium-high.  Make sure baking sheet is microwavable.

name: OVERNIGHT SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. mandarin oranges drained
1  c. coconut
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. chunk pineapple
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix together and refrigerate overnight.

name: CREME DE MENTHE SQUARES
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. margarine, divided
1/2  c. unsweetened cocoa powder
3 1/2  c. powdered sugar, sifted
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/3  c. green creme de menthe
1 1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
preparation: Bottom Layer:  In saucepan, combine 1/2 cup of the margarine and cocoa.  Heat and stir until well blended.  Remove from heat; add 1/2 cup of sugar, egg and vanilla.  Stir in graham cracker crumbs.  Mix well.  Press into bottom of ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.

name: BEAN AND BACON SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. dried beans
3  qt. water
10  slices bacon
2  c. chopped potatoes
2  c. chopped carrots
4  tsp. salt
1  bay leaf
2  c. onions
2  c. celery
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  qt. tomato juice
preparation: Rinse beans and soak in 3 quarts water.  Fry bacon until crisp and add to beans.  Cook onions in bacon drippings until soft.  Add to beans along with drippings.  Add all the other ingredients. Boil soup to a boil until vegetables are soft.  Remove bay leaf. Put in jars and pressure cook 10 pounds for 30 minutes.

name: PARMESAN CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. chicken wings, cut up
1/2  c. melted butter
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  Tbsp. oregano
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. paprika
preparation: Dip chicken wings in butter then in combined dry ingredients. Put on foil-lined cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for about 45 to 50 minutes.  Yum!

name: PERKY PECANS
ingredients:
1  lb. pecan halves
1  egg white
1  tsp. cold water
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Beat egg whites and water until frosty.  Add pecans and coat well.  Mix sugar, salt and cinnamon in a bowl.  Add nuts and mix. Bake in a jelly roll pan at 225° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

name: MONJO
ingredients:
5  c. flour
2  sticks margarine
1 1/2  c. white sugar
6  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. vanilla
4  eggs
1  pkg. red and yellow mung beans
preparation: Boil beans to dry and add sugar to taste.  Mix all the ingredients together thoroughly except the boiled beans.  Make small balls of the mixed dough.  Flatten each ball wide and thin enough to fill each with spoons of sweetened beans.  Put ends of dough towards the center to close and place invertedly on greased baking pan (looks like stuffed buns). Dab with beaten egg yolk. Bake at 350° until dough is cooked.

name: CHOCOLATE DESSERT
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. butter (2 sticks)
1  c. chopped pecans
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. Cool Whip
1  c. confectioners sugar
2 (4 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
3  c. milk
Cool Whip (for topping)
preparation: Cream butter and flour; add nuts.  Press into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes until light brown.

name: CHEDDAR CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
3  oz. cream cheese
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. sherry extract
dash of onion salt
dash of garlic salt
dash of celery salt
1/4  c. chopped ripe olives
3  Tbsp. minced dried beef
3  Tbsp. minced fresh parsley
preparation: Combine  cheeses,   mayonnaise,  Worcestershire  sauce, sherry extract and onion,  garlic  and  celery  salts.  Blend until smooth.  Add olives.  Cover and chill until firm.  Shape cheese mixture into  a  ball.  Combine dried beef and parsley. Then roll cheese ball in mixture.  Cover and chill.

name: CHILI PEPPER PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
Mushrooms, fresh and sliced
Medium Onion - Chopped not diced
Red Chili Peppers, sliced (need enough to cover meat and to put in sauce)
Worcestershire Sauce
Salt & Pepper
Parsley
Garlic Powder
8  Center Cut Pork Chops
Alfredo Sauce (Note:  You can double this if you want more sauce)
1  pt. heavy cream (whipping cream will work if you cannot find heavy cream)
1  stick butter (butter works better than margarine)
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1 1/2  c. of the chili peppers, sliced and seeded
preparation: Get an oblong baking dish and marinate your pork chops for 3 hours, by covering with Worcestershire sauce.  Enough just to season, do not drench the pork chops in it.  Sprinkle with salt & pepper and garlic powder when ready to bake.  Cover with sliced mushrooms, chili peppers and chopped onions.  Sprinkle with parsley.  Bake until done in a 375 degree oven.  While pork chops are baking, make alfredo sauce.  Keep sauce simmering on low until [pork chops are done.  This will cook the flavor of the chili peppers into the sauce.  When serving the pork chops, cover with the sauce.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground chuck
2  stacks Ritz crackers, crumbled (2 c.)
1/2  tsp. onion powder
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
3  eggs
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake at 350° for 2 hours.  Put about 1 cup water in bottom of pan.

name: GARLIC-SAUTED TOMATOES
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. olive oil
3  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. dried basil
1  lb. firm tomatoes, cored and cut into chunks
minced fresh chives
freshly grated Asiago or Romano cheese
preparation: In a large skillet, heat oil over low heat.  Add garlic, basil and tomatoes and saut over low-medium heat until just wilted, maybe about 2 1/2 minutes. Add Asiago and serve hot with grill chicken or pork chops.

name: CHEESE TARTS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
vanilla wafer cookies
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Combine cream cheese with sugar; add eggs and blend.  Add vanilla and whip until smooth.  Place a vanilla wafer cookie in the bottom of each cupcake baking liner.  Fill each cup 3/4 full with cream cheese mixture.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.  When cool, top with cherry pie filling.  Refrigerate.  Makes 18 to 20 tarts.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. salad dressing
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. milk
1 1/2  c. cubed ham
1  c. shell macaroni
1  c. chopped tomato
1  c. green pepper chunks
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
lettuce
preparation: Cook and drain macaroni.  Combine salad dressing, Parmesan and milk; mix well.  Add all remaining ingredients.  Chill well. Serve on lettuce.

name: SUKIYAKI
ingredients:
1  c. sliced green onions
1  c. sliced celery
1  can bean sprouts
1/2  lb. sliced mushrooms
1/2  lb. thin-sliced or cubed chicken
2  bouillon cubes
2  c. water
2  Tbsp. molasses
1/8  tsp. each:  ginger and cloves
1/2  tsp. powdered garlic
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. oil
1  can sliced water chestnuts
preparation: In a large pot, combine bouillon cubes and water.  Heat until cubes dissolve.  Add molasses, spices, oil and flour.   Stir and heat until slightly thickened.  Add remaining ingredients.  Cook over fairly high heat, stirring, for 10 minutes.  Serve.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. pecans or walnuts, crushed
4  cans buttermilk biscuits, cut in 4 quarters
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
1  c. dark sugar
preparation: Set oven at 350°.  Grease Bundt or tube pan well with Crisco. Sprinkle nuts in bottom of pan.  Mix cinnamon and sugar in paper bag.  Add quartered biscuits and shake until covered.  Drop biscuit quarters ni pan.  Melt the margarine and add the dark sugar.  Pour this mixture over top of biscuits and bake 30 to 35 minutes.  Let cool.

name: SKILLET BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. chopped dates
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. oleo
1  egg, well beaten
2 1/2  c. rice crispies
3/4  c. chopped pecans
1  c. Angel Flake coconut
preparation: Mix dates, sugar, oleo and egg in large iron skillet and place over low heat.  Cook until dates are melted, stirring occasionally.  Turn off heat and add rice crispies and pecans. Mix well and let cool.  Roll into small balls and roll each ball in coconut.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  head cabbage
salt and pepper to taste
1  can tomato soup
1  can mushroom soup
diced onion
raw ground beef
preparation: Into large casserole, shred cabbage; salt and pepper to taste. Next, in mixing bowl, put soups.  Mix together thoroughly and pour over cabbage.  Next, add a layer of onion, then a layer of ground beef.  Cover very tightly with foil and steambake for about 2 hours.  Do not remove or disturb covering during baking.  Set oven at 350°.

name: EASY POT ROAST
ingredients:
3  lb. roast
1 1/2  c. water
2  pkg. brown gravy mix
preparation: Put roast into crock-pot.  Mix gravy mix and water together and pour over roast.  Cook on high 6 to 8 hours.  Can add potatoes 2 hours before roast is done.

name: BUSY DAY BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
6  slices bacon, diced
1  medium onion, chopped
2  cans pork and beans
1  can tomato soup
1/4  c. brown sugar
16  slices bread
ham or sausage
1  c. diced Colby cheese
6  eggs
3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  c. bread crumbs
1/2  c. oleo
8  slices bread, crust removed
8  oz. (2 c.) Swiss cheese, grated
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. smoked sliced ham
6  eggs
1  tsp. dry mustard
2  c. milk
preparation: Distribute bread crumbs in dish.  Sprinkle grated cheese evenly over bread.  Snip smoked ham with scissors over cheese. Beat eggs lightly and add mustard and milk; stir to blend.  Pour this mixture in casserole.  Dot with butter; sprinkle with paprika.  Cover and refrigerate several hours or the night before. Bake uncovered at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  bottle catsup
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. pepper
1  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. chili powder
2  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. garlic salt
1  c. brown sugar
preparation: Boil 20 minutes and add 1 tablespoon celery salt.  This keeps a long time unrefrigerated.

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
18  small potatoes
3  slices bacon, cut in cubes
1 round  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. vinegar
3/4  c. water
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  small onion
preparation: Cook potatoes until soft.  Peel and slice.  Add sliced onion (optional).  Fry bacon until crispy.  Remove from pan.  To the bacon fat, add the butter and flour.  Stir and add vinegar, water, sugar, salt and pepper.  Let come to a boil and pour over potatoes.  Sprinkle bacon cubes on top of salad.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: TRI-BERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, sliced strawberries
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. red raspberries
1  can whole cranberry sauce
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. red gelatin dessert
1  c. water
preparation: Mix both jello packages with 1 cup of boiling water.  Add thawed berries.  Mix well and add cranberry sauce.  Chill and serve.

name: CINNAMON ROLL GOOD
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white syrup
1/2  c. oleo
preparation: Bring to a boil, cool slightly.  Pour in baking pan.  Add nuts, if desired.  Place rolls, cut side down.  Let rise and bake.

name: NUT CRESCENTS
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/3  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. chopped salted peanuts or pecans, toasted
sifted powdered sugar
preparation: Cream first 3 ingredients and 1 tablespoon water.  Stir in flour and nuts; mix well.  Shape into crescents.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.   Cool on a rack; roll in powdered sugar.  Makes 60 crescents.

name: SLIM JIM CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef or turkey
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
4  c. undrained canned tomatoes
1/2 to 1  Tbsp. chili powder
2  c. sliced celery
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1 3/4  c. (15 oz.) can kidney beans (undrained)
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  bay leaf
preparation: Brown meat and onion in Dutch oven; drain.  Add remaining ingredients.  Simmer, covered, 1 to 2 hours.  Remove bay leaf. Serve hot.  Freezes well.  Can use crock-pot.  Makes 8 (1 cup) servings with 156 calories each.

name: MOON CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. milk
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/4  c. chocolate syrup
2 (3.4 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1  (8 oz.) frozen whipped topping, thawed
2  graham cracker pie crusts
preparation: In a large bowl, combine pudding mix, milk and cream cheese. Mix with electric mixer until smooth. Spread evenly over pie crust. Top with whipped topping and drizzle with chocolate syrup. Chill in refrigerator and serve cold.

name: CARROT TEA LOAF
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. nonfat dry milk
1/2  c. coarsely chopped nuts
1/3  c. Sugar Twin
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs, slightly beaten
2  c. shredded or grated carrots
3/4  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spray loaf pan with Pam.  In a large mixing bowl, combine dry ingredients and blend.  Stir in remaining ingredients together; add to dry ingredients and beat only until well mixed.  (Batter is very thick.) Pour into prepared pan.  Bake 1 hour until golden brown and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Turn loaf out onto rack to cool.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP RICOTTA COOKIES
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine *
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking soda
1  lb. Ricotta cheese
4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1 large  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream together margarine and sugar.  Add all other ingredients except chocolate chips.  Mix well, then stir in chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 No. 2  can fruit cocktail (20 oz.)
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream eggs and white sugar. Add canned fruit cocktail with juice and vanilla. Sift flour, salt and soda. Stir into first mixture. Pour in well greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan. Mix brown sugar and chopped pecans. Sprinkle on top of batter. Bake 45 minutes at 300°.

name: SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Wish-Bone Italian dressing
1  (12 oz.) apricot preserves
1  pkg. onion soup mix
preparation: Mix well and pour over 2 chickens, cut up.  Bake in casserole dish at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Baste once during cooking. Serve over rice.

name: ROCKY ROAD PIE
ingredients:
peanut pie shell
1/2  c. peanut butter
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips (1 c.)
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1 1/2  gal. chocolate or vanilla ice cream
2  Tbsp. chopped salted peanuts
preparation: Bake pie shell.  Cool.  Heat peanut butter and chocolate chips in 1 1/2-quart saucepan over low heat stirring constantly just until chocolate is melted.  Remove from heat.  Fold in marshmallows.  Cool 10 minutes.  Spoon and spread 1/2 cup marshmallow mixture in pie shell.  Lightly pack half of ice cream into pie shell.

name: APPLE CAKE IN A JAR
ingredients:
2/3  c. shortening
2 2/3  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. all-purpose flour
2/3  c. water
3  c. peeled apple, grated
2/3  c. raisins
2/3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix together ingredients in order given. Sterilize 7 to 9 wide-mouth pint jars and lids. Grease them with shortening. Fill the jars half full. Bake on the middle wire rack in the oven for 45 minutes at 325°. As soon as cake is done, remove jars one at a time from oven. Wipe the rim of the jar clean with a damp cloth and put on the hot sterilized lid. Screw down bands and let cool. Do not use small-mouth jars. Do not add any other ingredients. As the cake cools in the sealed jar, it will pull away from the sides of the jar and come out easily when ready to serve. Cakes have a one-year shelf life.

name: TAMALE ENCHILADA SAUCE
ingredients:
3/4  c. Vegetable Oil
1  Clove Garlic
1/2  c. All Purpose Flour
6  c. Chicken Broth
4  Tbsp Paprika
4  Tbsp. Chili Powder
1/2  tsp. Powder Cumin
1/2  tsp. Powder Oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: 1. In medium saucepan cook oil, flour, and seasonings over low heat. 2. Gradually add chicken broth and simmer the mixture about 30 minutes or until it's thick.  Makes about 6 cups.

name: 5-LAYER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. lean ground beef
1  can golden mushroom soup
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
1  pkg. mild Cheddar cheese
1  pkg. Tater Tots
preparation: Break ground beef (uncooked) into pieces and spread into 9-inch baking dish.  Spread mushroom soup over meat; sprinkle onion soup mix over mushroom soup; sprinkle Cheddar cheese over onion soup mix.  Place Tater Tots on cheese.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SUMMER SQUASH SOUP
ingredients:
2  cans beef broth or 2 cans chicken broth
1  can gazpacho soup
1/4  c. plain yogurt for garnish
4  medium yellow squash *
4  medium green zucchini *
2  medium onions
fresh pepper
1  tsp. dill
1  tsp. cilantro
1  tsp. garlic powder
salt to taste (if needed)
shredded carrots (as garnish)
preparation: *Even a few more veggies are good.

name: HOT SPICED APPLE CIDER
ingredients:
1  gal. apple cider
4  cinnamon sticks
1  Tbsp. whole cloves
1  orange, sliced thin
1  lemon, sliced thin
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Put cider into a large kettle and add sugar and spices.  Heat to the boiling point, then reduce and add fruit slices.  Keep just below boiling point.  It will perfume your house for the holidays and be ready to serve guests.

name: BEEF ROAST
ingredients:
3  lb. eye of Round Roast
Cracked peppercorns
Garlic to taste
Pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 500 degrees.  Roll Roast in peppercorns and season with pepper and garlic if desired.  Place in baking dish and bake 5 to 6 minutes per pound.

name: MACARONI AND CHEDDAR BAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Leonardo macaroni and Cheddar
1  lb. ground beef
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. milk
preparation: Brown the meat and onion. Combine rest of the ingredients and add to the prepared macaroni, cheese and the beef.  Put in 2-quart casserole and bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 25 minutes.

name: SHERRIED BLACK BEAN SOUP(Serves 6 To 8)
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. dried black beans
2  medium carrots, peeled and chopped
1  c. peeled and chopped fresh pumpkin or hard squash (optional)
1  c. chopped celery with leaves
1  c. chopped onion
2  cloves garlic
2  Tbsp. minced fresh parsley
8  c. cold water
1  Tbsp. ground cumin
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  tsp. minced fresh thyme
1  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
1/2  c. dry sherry
1/2  c. finely chopped hard-boiled egg white
6  very thin lemon slices
preparation: Place first 9 ingredients in a stock pot over heat; bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer for about 2 hours or until beans are very soft.  When beans are mushy, add spices, thyme and lemon juice.  Cook over low heat and puree in batches in a food processor fitted with a metal blade.  Return puree to stockpot and stir in sherry.  Adjust seasonings to taste.  Cook over low heat for about 5 more minutes or until heated through.  Serve immediately and garnish with egg white and lemon slice.

name: DIABETIC BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
4  c. Raisin Bran cereal
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
2  c. buttermilk
1  packet Butter Buds (made into liquid)
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  In large bowl, mix cereal, flour, sugar, baking soda and salt.  Add eggs, buttermilk and Butter Buds and mix well.  Spray muffin tins with nonstick coating agent.  Fill muffin cups 2/3 full and bake 15 to 20 minutes.

name: HOT BEEF DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, browned
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
8  oz. tomato sauce
hot sauce
preparation: Brown hamburger; drain grease.  Add cheese and tomato sauce. Heat on stove or in microwave until smooth.  Add hot sauce to taste.  Serve with Fritos, nachos, etc.

name: SPICY RAMEN
ingredients:
Ramen noodles
1  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. hot sauce
sausage, cooked and drained
preparation: Boil Ramen noodles until done.  Add seasoning that comes with Ramen noodles.  Put 1 teaspoon mustard and hot sauce to taste. Add crumbled sausage.  Mix and enjoy!

name: MOIST 'N EASY CREAMY COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow (or white) cake mix
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
2  c. coconut, divided into 1/2 cup, 1/2 cup and 1 cup
3 1/2  c. (8 oz.) whipped topping
preparation: Prepare cake mix as directed on package, baking in a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Cool 15 minutes, then poke holes through the cake with utility fork.

name: PUPPY CHOW
ingredients:
1 (18 oz.)  box Crispix cereal
2  c. hot chocolate mix
1  stick margarine
1  c. peanut butter
1  box powdered sugar
preparation: Mix chocolate mix, butter, and peanut butter in a saucepan. Stir over low heat until melted and thin.  Coat cereal with mixture.  Put in brown sack with powdered sugar and shake to coat. Store in airtight container.

name: HOBO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
ground beef (lean)
3  large potatoes, sliced thinly
Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  large onion, diced
1  large green pepper, diced
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Spray casserole dish lightly with Pam.  Layer potatoes, onions, peppers and cheese.  Add a layer of ground beef and cream of mushroom soup.  Continue to layer ingredients until they are gone.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH FUDGE
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chip morsels
1  c. peanut butter
1  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Melt butterscotch chips in pan; add a cup of peanut butter and 1 can milk.  Mix well.  Pour into pan and cool.

name: 5 HOUR STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. chuck cubes
2  c. diced potatoes
2  c. carrots
1  c. celery
1  medium onion
1  c. V-8 juice
2  Tbsp. tapioca, mix and soak 3 minutes
1  Tbsp. bourbon
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a casserole with a tight lid.  Cook in a 250° oven for 5 hours.  Do not stir.

name: CHICKEN SUPREME DIJON
ingredients:
2  skinless, boneless chicken breasts (4 fillets)
2  Tbsp. butter
salt and pepper
1 medium  clove garlic, finely minced
1  Tbsp. finely minced fresh onion
1/4  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1/4  c. Grey Poupon Dijon mustard
1  c. heavy cream
preparation: In a large skillet, cook chicken in butter.  Remove to heated platter.  Keep warm.  To drippings in pan, add garlic, onion and mushrooms.  Cook, stirring, until onion is tender.  Stir in mustard and heavy cream.  Simmer, stirring, until sauce is slightly thickened.  Add chicken, turning to coat in sauce.  Serve over rice.  Serves 4.

name: SOUR CREAM RHUBARB PIE
ingredients:
3  c. rhubarb, cubed
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
3  eggs, beaten
1/8  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
dash of cloves
1  unbaked crust
preparation: Pour the 1/2 cup sugar over rhubarb in an unbaked shell; set aside.  Mix sour cream, beaten eggs, salt, sugar, cinnamon and cloves.  Pour over rhubarb.  Bake at 450° for 10 minutes, then at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: LIME CHICKEN (LITE CHOICE)
ingredients:
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. lime juice (2 limes)
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. thyme
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
2  lb. boneless chicken breasts
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients and marinate chicken breasts for several hours or overnight in a covered bowl.  Bake for 40 minutes at 350° or cook on grill.

name: PINA COLADA WEDGES
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. rum or 1/2 tsp. rum extract
3 1/2  c. thawed Cool Whip whipped topping
1 (8 1/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple in syrup
2 2/3  c. (7 oz.) coconut
preparation: Beat cream  cheese  with  sugar  and  rum until smooth. Fold in 2  cups  of  the whipped topping, pineapple with syrup and 2 cups  of coconut.  Spread in 8-inch layer pan lined with plastic wrap.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/4  lb. oleo
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. nuts
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
3  c. milk
2 small  pkg. chocolate instant pudding
preparation: Mix flour, oleo, sugar and nuts.  Press in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip.  Spread over cooled crust.  Mix pudding and milk. Spread over first layer.  Top with rest of Cool Whip.  Sprinkle with nuts.

name: CHEESY GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
10  bacon slices
2 (16 oz.)  pkg. cut green beans
1  lb. mushrooms, sliced
3/4  c. chopped onion
3/4  tsp. ground black pepper
1 (16 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
1/4  c. bacon drippings
preparation: Cook bacon in skillet until crisp.  Drain bacon, reserving 1/4 cup bacon drippings.  Crumble bacon.  Reserve 2 tablespoons. Microwave green beans; drain.  Add mushrooms and onion to reserved 1/4 cup drippings in skillet.  Cook and stir on medium heat 10 minutes; drain.  Add bacon, hot cooked green beans and pepper; mix lightly.  Spoon into 2-quart dish.  Microwave processed cheese spread as directed on label.  Pour over green beans mixture. Sprinkle with reserved 2 tablespoons crumbled bacon.  Makes 10 servings.

name: PICKLES
ingredients:
cucumbers
4  Tbsp. alum
4  Tbsp. salt
4  Tbsp. pickling spice
vinegar
3  lb. sugar
preparation: Wash cucumbers, dry them and put in a gallon jar. Add the alum, salt and pickling spice.  Fill jar with vinegar.  Leave in jar 3 months. Drain off vinegar.  Slice cucumbers and put back in jar. Add the sugar and let sugar melt.

name: HOLIDAY BREAKFAST
ingredients:
8  eggs, slightly beaten
6  slices bread, cubed (including crust)
1  lb. hot sausage, cooked and crumbled
2  c. milk
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Mix milk, salt, mustard and eggs and pour over other ingredients, tossing lightly.  Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Refrigerate 12 hours.  Bake 35 minutes at 350° for a souffle breakfast.

name: TROPICAL SCREAM
ingredients:
6  oz. orange or pineapple juice
4  oz. diet Sprite or 7-Up
1/2  c. orange or pineapple sherbet
preparation: Put desired juice in shaker container.  Select a sherbet and fill to 12 ounce line.  Place cap on container and shake vigorously.  Remove cap; pour in soda and stir.  Makes 2 servings.

name: RAMEN NOODLES
ingredients:
1  pkg. Ramen Oriental noodles
4  c. chopped cabbage
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. olive oil
dry soup base packet
preparation: Cook noodles according to package and drain.  Mix sugar, vinegar, dry soup base and olive oil.  Add to cabbage and drained noodles.  Toss gently and chill.  May add nuts, chicken or shrimp.

name: PEANUT BLOSSOMS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. sugar (for rolling cookies)
chocolate "Kisses" (for decoration)
preparation: Cream butter, peanut butter, sugar and egg together. Add vanilla. Mix together the flour, soda and salt and gradually add to creamed mixture. Shape into balls and roll in 1/4 cup of sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 8 minutes. Remove from oven and press a chocolate "Kiss" in each cookie so cookie cracks around the edges. Return to oven and continue to bake for 2 or 3 minutes. Makes about 7 dozen cookies.

name: MOM'S DONUTS
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter, melted
1  c. buttermilk
about 4 c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and chill dough at least 1 hour. Fry in hot Crisco oil.  Sugar while warm.

name: KRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can kraut
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. grated carrots
1 small  jar pimentos (chopped)
2/3  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
preparation: Mix together the first 5 ingredients.  Put in glass jar.  Mix the vinegar and sugar; bring to a boil.  Pour over kraut mixture. Chill and serve.  Makes 1 quart.

name: VERMICELLI SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. pkg. cooked and cooled spaghetti (vermicelli)
1  medium head cabbage, shredded finely
2  grated carrots
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  pt. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. vinegar
salt to taste
preparation: Mix cabbage, carrots, celery, green pepper, and onions together.  Add vermicelli and mix thoroughly.  Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, and salt.  Add to other mixture and stir to mix.  Make one day ahead.  Will keep in refrigerator for several days.

name: NUT BALLS
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2  Tbsp. powdered sugar
1  c. plain flour
1  c. nuts
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add salt, nuts and flour.  Roll into small balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake about 15 minutes or until brown in 300° oven.  Let cool and roll in powdered sugar.

name: BROCCOLI QUICHE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
2  eggs, beaten
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of broccoli soup
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
4  oz. (1 c.) shredded Swiss cheese
preparation: Line unbaked pie shell with foil.  Bake at 450° for 8 minutes. Remove foil.  Bake for 4 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Reduce oven temperature to 375°.  Saute mushrooms and onion for 5 minutes; drain.

name: WILD RICE AND SHRIMP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  chopped green pepper
1  chopped onion
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. cheese, grated
1  pkg. wild rice
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  lb. shrimp
preparation: Cook rice according to directions on package, using 1/4 cup less water.  Mix all ingredients well and pour into casserole. Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: PRALINE CONFECTIONS
ingredients:
24  whole graham crackers
1  c. packed light brown sugar
1  c. butter
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Line a 10 x 15-inch pan with graham crackers.  Combine brown sugar and butter in heavy saucepan.  Bring to a rolling boil. Boil for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Cool slightly.  Stir in pecans.  Spoon mixture over graham cracker layer.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Cool slightly before cutting into small squares.   Yield: 80 servings.

name: CHINESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  c. chopped celery
1  large onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. cooked rice
1  can bean sprouts
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. water
1  can Chinese noodles
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion.  Add other ingredients.  Rinse out cans with water.  Put in casserole dish and cover.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with noodles and brown.

name: STRAWBERRY SURPRISE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. crushed pretzel sticks
1  stick oleo
3  tsp. sugar
2  c. boiling water
2 small  boxes strawberry Jell-O
2  c. fresh strawberry slices
8  oz. softened cream cheese
12  oz. Cool Whip
1  c. sugar
preparation: Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and sugar.  Spread on pretzel crust.  Then Jell-O and strawberry on top.  Chill overnight in refrigerator.  Any fresh fruit with Jell-O may be used, such as: peaches/peach Jell-O, orange slices/orange Jell-O, sweet cherries with cherry Jell-O, raspberries with raspberry Jell-O.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground round
salt to taste
pepper to taste
1 (10.5 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
2  tsp. dry onion soup mix
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. American cheese
1  large (32 oz.) bag Tater Tots
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Brown ground beef and drain. Add salt and pepper. Add mushroom soup and dry onion soup. Spread mixture evenly in the bottom of a 9 x 13 pan. Lay American cheese slices over the top. Cover the top with Tater Tots. Bake at 350° until food thermometer reads 165°, about 20 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  large head fresh broccoli, chopped
1/2  c. salted sunflower seeds
1/2  c. raisins
8  strips bacon, cooked and crumbled
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
1  Tbsp. cider vinegar
preparation: Combine broccoli, sunflower seeds, raisins, bacon and onions in a large bowl.  Mix together remaining ingredients and toss with broccoli mixture.  Chill until serving time.

name: MEXICAN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
2  cans jalapeno refried beans
2  can cream of mushroom soup
1  bag Doritos, crushed
1  onion, chopped
1  can Rotel tomatoes
1  lb. grated cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown meat with onions and drain.  Mix in beans, tomatoes and soup.  Pour into greased casserole dish; put crushed chips and end with grated cheese on top.  Bake at 400 degrees till cheese is melted.

name: CABBAGE SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. salad dressing
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Boil sugar and vinegar 1 minute.  Cool.  Add salad dressing, salt and pepper.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. flour
3/4  c. granulated sugar
3/4  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. shortening, softened
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2 to 4  Tbsp. hot water
1  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Drop from teaspoon on non-greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 325° for 5 to 10 minutes or until done.

name: CITRIC PUNCH
ingredients:
2  oz. citric acid crystals or sour salt
2  qt. boiling water
1 large  can frozen orange juice, undiluted
1 large  can unsweetened pineapple juice
5  c. sugar
2  qt. water
preparation: Dissolve crystals in 2-quarts boiling water.  Let set for 24 hours.  Mix orange juice, pineapple juice, sugar and 2-quarts water together and mix well.  Combine both mixtures and mix thoroughly.  Divide into three containers and freeze.

name: PERFECT POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine, softened
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
5  eggs
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Heavily grease Bundt pan. With an electric mixer, beat margarine until light and fluffy.  Gradually beat in sugar and vanilla.  Add eggs, one at a time, along with flour.  It is important to beat well. Pour batter in prepared pan. Bake 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.  The cake forms a crisp outside crust.

name: Wolverine Wash
ingredients:
1 1/2  oz. gin
1  oz. pineapple-orange juice
1  tsp. sugar
juice of 1 lime
dash of bitters
preparation: Shake with ice and strain over ice cubes in an old-fashioned glass rimmed with salt.

name: CHRISTINE'S BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
chicken parts
butter pats
garlic powder
Johnny's seasoning salt
preparation: Wash cut up chicken parts and place in a shallow baking dish. Dot with pats of butter.  Sprinkle generously with seasonings. Bake at 375° for one hour or longer, until chicken is golden brown and falling off the bone.  A family favorite.

name: CREAM PIE(Double for 2 Pies)
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. cornstarch
1/3  tsp. salt
2  c. milk, scalded
3  eggs
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  baked shell or 1 graham cracker crust
preparation: Blend  sugar,  cornstarch and salt.  Slowly stir in hot milk. Cook  and  stir over boiling water until mixture thickens.	Add 1/3  of mixture to well beaten egg yolks, then stir egg yolks into custard.  Stir and cook for 2 minutes.  Remove from stove; cool.  Add	butter	and  vanilla.  Pour  into pie shell.  Cover with  meringue.  May also be served with sweetened whipped cream, adding a few drops of vanilla.

name: PACIFIC RUM SALAD
ingredients:
1  head iceberg lettuce
3  chicken breasts, cooked and shredded
3  to 4 chopped green onions
1/3  pkg. rice sticks (found in Asian food section)
small pkg. slivered almonds, sauteed
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. salad oil
1  Tbsp. sesame oil
3  Tbsp. rice vinegar
preparation: Chop lettuce and green onions; add chicken and browned rice sticks.  Brown the rice sticks by frying in small amount of oil in pan.  They will swell and pop when put in the pan.  Mix remaining ingredients for dressing.  Toss with lettuce mix just before serving.

name: PREGO MIRACLE LASAGNA
ingredients:
1(28 oz.) jar Prego spaghetti sauce
6  dry lasagna noodles
1  (15 oz.) container Ricotta cheese
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In 2-quart baking dish (11 x 7), spread 1 cup sauce.  Top with 3 dry noodles, Ricotta cheese, 1 cup Mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese and 1 cup sauce.  Top with remaining dry noodles and sauce. Cover.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour.  Top with remaining Mozzarella cheese.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: GRANOLA CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
dash of salt
3  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1  c. granola
2/3  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar.  Combine the flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, ginger and granola.  Stir into the butter mixture, combining thoroughly.  Add chocolate chips.   Drop from teaspoon onto lightly greased cookie sheets.  Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes or until browned.  Remove from sheets.  Cool on racks. Makes 36 cookies.

name: HEATH CANDY CAKE
ingredients:
German chocolate cake mix
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  jar Smuckers caramel ice cream topping
6  crushed Heath bars
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Bake German chocolate cake according to directions on box in 9 x 13-inch pan.   Poke holes in cake using the handle of a wooden spoon.   Make lots of holes, but don't overlap.    While cake is still warm, pour Eagle Brand milk over cake.   Then pour caramel topping over cake.   Let set in the refrigerator to cool.  Crush 3 Heath bars; sprinkle over top.   Cover with Cool Whip.   Sprinkle 3 more crushed Heath bars over Cool Whip.

name: BROILED SHRIMP WITH GARLIC BUTTER
ingredients:
2  lb. shrimp in shells
1/4  lb. butter
1/2  c. olive oil
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. scallions, chopped
1  Tbsp. garlic, chopped
black pepper, ground
4  Tbsp. parsley, chopped
preparation: Shell the uncooked shrimp but do not remove the tails.  Split them down the back and remove the intestinal veins.  Wash under cold water and dry.  Preheat broiler to the highest temperature. In a pan melt the butter; then add the oil, lemon juice, scallions, garlic and pepper.  Add shrimp and broil 3 to 4 inches from the heat for 5 minutes.   Then turn and broil 5 minutes on the other side.  Serve on a platter with parsley and strained juices from the pan.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. vegetable oil
4  c. sugar
4  c. canned pumpkin
1  tsp. cinnamon
4  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
5  c. flour
2  c. date pieces
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix in order listed.  Fill 5 ungreased 1-pound coffee cans a little more than half full of batter.  Bake at 350° for 70 minutes.  Cool in the cans.  Snap plastic lids on for easy storage.  This freezes very well right in the can.

name: CRUNCHY NUT COOKIE(Good for Dunking)
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream together sugars, shortening, eggs and vanilla.  Mix in flour, baking soda, salt and nuts.  Shape 1 level tablespoon dough into balls; place on ungreased pan.  Flatten with bottom of greased glass dipped in sugar.  Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda in 1/2 c. buttermilk
1  c. mashed bananas
1/2  tsp. butternut vanilla flavoring
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. walnuts
1  tsp. lemon juice (optional)
preparation: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, flour and salt. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: MEAT LOAF(Diabetic Recipe)
ingredients:
2  lb. lean ground beef
1/4  c. onion, grated
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1  egg
1/4  c. parsley, finely snipped
1 1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
dash of thyme
dash of marjoram
1  tsp. evaporated milk
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Add just enough water to form a firm ball.  Press into baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. round steak, cut into pieces
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  bell pepper
1  small onion
cooking oil
preparation: Salt and pepper steak to taste.  Brown steak in a small amount of oil.  Remove steak from skillet.  Add flour; brown flour, then add 2 to 3 cups of water and tomato sauce.  Stir until smooth. Put steak back into gravy.  Add bell pepper and onion (either sliced in rings or chopped).  Works great to simmer in electric skillet about 1 1/2 hours at 250° or 300°, or all day in a crock-pot on low.

name: CHEESY GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
10  slices bacon
2 (16 oz. each)  pkg. frozen green beans
3/4  c. chopped onion
1 (16 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz cheese spread
1  lb. mushrooms, sliced
3/4  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp, drain bacon.  Reserve 1/4 cup drippings.  Crumble bacon, reserve 2 tablespoons.  Microwave beans as directed on package, drain well.  Add mushrooms and onion to reserved 1/4 cup drippings in skillet.  Cook and stir on medium-high heat 10 minutes, drain.  Add bacon, hot cooked green beans and pepper; mix lightly.  Spoon into 2-quart serving dish. Microwave cheese spread.  Pour over green beans mixture.  Sprinkle with reserved 2 tablespoons crumbled bacon.

name: CHOCOLATE-CARAMEL-NUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. German chocolate cake mix with pudding
1  (14 oz.) bag caramels
1/2  c. butter
1/3  c. milk
1  c. chopped dry roasted peanuts
3/4  c. milk chocolate morsels
preparation: Prepare cake mix according to package directions.  Spoon half of batter into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  (Cake will  not test done.)  Cool cake for 10 minutes.

name: FRUITED TURKEY SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. cut up, cooked turkey
1/3  c. toasted, slivered almonds
2  medium stalks celery, sliced (about 1 c.)
1  c. seedless grapes or 1 (11 oz.) can mandarin orange segments, drained
preparation: Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt and pepper in mixing bowl. Add turkey, almonds and celery; toss.  Stir grapes into salad just before serving.  Serve on salad greens.

name: STEAK SUPPER
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. chuck steak
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
3  carrots, cut up
2  stalks celery, cut up
3  potatoes, cut up
1  Tbsp. water
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Place a piece of foil in bottom of baking dish.  Place meat on foil.  Stir together mushroom soup and onion mix.  Pour over top of meat.  Top with vegetables; sprinkle with water.  Fold foil and seal.  Cook for 1 1/2 hours or until tender.

name: CHESS BARS
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  stick soft margarine
3  eggs
1 (1 lb.)  box powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: With electric mixer, beat together cake mix, butter and 1 egg. Mixture will be thick.  Press into 13 x 9-inch pan sprayed with Pam vegetable spray.

name: CHICKEN-BACON SANDWICHES
ingredients:
3  c. shredded cooked chicken
2  c. minced celery
3  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
salt and pepper
1  c. crumbled cooked bacon
1/3  c. chopped sweet pickles
mayonnaise
white bread slices
whole wheat bread slices
shredded lettuce
preparation: Combine chicken, celery, eggs, salt, pepper, bacon and pickles; moisten with mayonnaise.  Trim crusts from bread.  Spread chicken mixture on white bread slices; add lettuce.  Top with whole wheat bread; press down lightly.  Cut sandwiches in half diagonally.

name: PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
1/2  c. onion (chopped)
1/2  c. sliced mushroom (optional)
1/2  c. chopped green peppers (optional)
8  oz macaroni (cooked)
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1 (24 oz)  can pizza sauce
1 (8 oz)  pkg. cheese (grated)
1  c. sharp cheddar cheese (grated)
1 (4-6 oz)  pkg. pepperoni slices
preparation: Brown beef, onion, green peppers, mushroom; drain off fat.  Add pizza sauce, pepper and salt to beef, then put in macaroni.  In casserole dish alternate layers of cheeses, pepperoni and meat mixture; ending with cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. If dry add a little V-8 or tomato juice.

name: ONE BOWL BROWNIES
ingredients:
4  sq. Baker's unsweetened chocolate
3/4  c. margarine
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Stir sugar into melted chocolate mixture.  Mix in eggs and vanilla until well blended.  Stir in flour and nuts.  Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until toothpick inserted into brownies comes out with fudgy crumbs.  Do not overbake.  Cut into squares.  Makes 24 brownies.

name: CREAMY GREEN ONION SPREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg cream cheese
2  tbsp milk
2  green onions with tops, chopped
crackers
preparation: In a small bowl, beat cream cheese and milk until smooth.  Stir in onions, serve with crackers.

name: BREAKFAST BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. corn flakes
2  c. all-purpose flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. margarine or butter
1/3  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. orange peel
1  c. orange juice
1/2  c. finely chopped nuts
1/2  c. seedless raisins
preparation: Measure corn flakes.  Crush to 3/4 cup.  Stir in flour, baking powder and salt.  Set aside.  Measure margarine and sugar into large mixing bowl.  Beat until light and fluffy.   Add eggs and orange peel.  Beat well.  Stir in orange juice.  Add dry ingredients, mixing only until combined.  Stir in nuts and raisins.  Spread in well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake in oven at 350° for about 50 minutes or until wooden pick inserted near center comes out clean.  Cool about 10 minutes before removing from pan.  Cool completely before slicing.  Yield:  1 loaf.

name: RASPBERRY JAM "THUMBPRINT COOKIES"
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. butter (3 sticks)
1  c. brown sugar
2  large eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
2 2/3  c. flour
approximately 1 c. finely chopped pecans
approximately 1 c. thick raspberry jam
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Separate yolk from egg white (discard white).  Add yolk, vanilla, salt and flour.  Mix well. Shape into balls.  Roll in pecans.

name: NACHOS AND CHILI
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  can Hormel chili
grated cheese
nachos
preparation: Layer each ingredient, beginning with cream cheese.  Microwave just until cheese melts.  Serve with nachos.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hash browns
1  pt. sour cream
2  c. Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  stick butter
salt, pepper and onion (optional)
preparation: Spray a 9 x 12-inch pan with vegetable spray.  Mix hash browns (thawed), sour cream, soup and spices of choice.  Put mixture in pan; dot with butter and top with Cheddar.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes until brown and bubbly.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE WITH HAM
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. elbow macaroni
3  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
8  oz. American cheese
bell pepper
ham, chopped (optional)
preparation: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until tender; drain. In saucepan, melt butter; blend in flour, salt and dash of pepper. Add milk. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly. Add cheese. Stir until melted. Mix cheese sauce with macaroni. Turn into 1 1/2 -quart casserole. Garnish top with rings of bell pepper. Bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: EGG MCMUFFINMicrowave
ingredients:
1  English Muffin
1  Slice Cheese
1  Slice Bacon, Ham, Sausage Patty
1  Egg, beaten
preparation: Toast muffin. Cook bacon between paper towels (1 min per slice). Put beaten egg in custard cup, cook 30 sec. per egg. Assemble McMuffin. Melt cheese in microwave, if desired.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. thin spaghetti
1 small  bottle Italian dressing
1  bottle McCormick's salad supreme
4  tomatoes (diced)
1  cucumber (diced)
1  large red onion (diced)
4  green onions
preparation: Boil spaghetti according to directions.  Drain and rinse with cold water.  Add all ingredients.  Toss and chill.

name: SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef or turkey
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 (15 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1  tsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (14 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti, broken up
3  tsp. butter or margarine, melted
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1  egg, well beaten
1  (8 oz.) container cottage cheese
1  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: In a deep saucepan, brown the ground meat; drain. Mix in the next 8 ingredients and set aside.

name: CINNAMON FLOP
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix together dry ingredients.  Cut in butter.  Add milk.  Beat well.  Pour into greased 9 or 10-inch pan.

name: ROAST PORK AND SAUERKRAUT
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. pork drippings
3  c. sauerkraut
4  servings cooked roast pork
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Cook drippings in a 2-quart casserole oven until boiling.  Add sauerkraut and water.  Cover.  Cook in microwave oven for 7 minutes.  Place servings of roast on top.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Cover.  Cook 3 to 4 minutes or until meat is heated through.  Total cooking time: 10 to 12 minutes.

name: TEXAS BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. (1 stick) butter or margarine
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. strong brewed coffee or water
1/4  c. dark unsweetened cocoa
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  Tbsp. dark cocoa
1/4  c. milk
3 1/2  c. unsifted powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and sugar.  In heavy saucepan, combine butter, shortening, coffee or water and cocoa. Stir and heat to boiling.  Pour boiling mixture over the flour and sugar.  Add the buttermilk, eggs, baking soda and vanilla.  Mix well using a wooden spoon or high speed on electric mixer.  Pour into well buttered 17 1/2 x 11-inch jelly roll pan.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until brownies test done in the center.

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA
ingredients:
2  rolls refrigerated crescent rolls
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sour cream
1  tsp. dill weed
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
small broccoli and cauliflower florets
fresh mushroom slices
1  chopped green pepper
cucumber or zucchini slices
cherry tomatoes, halved
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Open rolls and place 4 rectangles on ungreased jelly roll pan.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes until browned. Cool.  Beat cream cheese, sour cream and seasonings until smooth. Spread evenly over cooled crust; cover.  Refrigerate 2 hours. Before serving, top with vegetables cut into squares.

name: CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
juice of 1/2 lemon
1 medium  can crushed pineapple
2  pkg. Knox gelatine
1/4  c. cold water
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 small  bottle maraschino cherries
1/2  pt. heavy cream, whipped
preparation: Heat sugar, lemon juice and pineapple.  Dissolve gelatine in cold water.  Mash cream cheese and cut up cherries until smooth. Mix the gelatine and pineapple mixture; blend in cream cheese mixture.  Cool until it starts to thicken.  Blend in whipped cream and chill.

name: HONEY MUSTARD DIPPING SAUCE
ingredients:
3/4  c. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. honey
3  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Combine  all  ingredients.  Stir well.	Cover and chill for 3 hours.  Good  with	chicken  and ham.  Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  stick melted butter
2  c. confectioners sugar
2  eggs
2  sticks butter
3  to 4 bananas
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
1  large Cool Whip
1/2  c. pecans
1/2  c. maraschino cherries, chopped
preparation: Mix graham cracker crumbs and melted butter. Press in 13 x 9 x 1-inch pan. Have eggs and butter at room temperature. Beat eggs, butter and sugar for no less than 15 minutes. Spread over crust. Slice bananas and layer over mixture. Spoon pineapple over bananas (be sure each banana is covered so it won't turn brown). Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts and cherries. Refrigerate.

name: CHEESE TREATS(Tom's Grandmother's)
ingredients:
1  c. plain flour
2  c. corn flakes
cayenne pepper to taste (1/2 to 1 tsp.)
1/2  lb. grated cheese
1/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Mix flour with corn flakes.  Add cayenne pepper.  Grate into this sharp	cheese.  Mix  well.  Pour in melted butter or margarine (a little  more butter makes them easier to handle). Put in small balls on ungreased cookie sheet.  Press down flat with fork  tines.  Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.	Cut off oven and  let them  stay 10 minutes longer.  Makes 2 cookie sheets full.

name: SPAGHETTI PIZZA
ingredients:
16  oz. uncooked spaghetti
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
4  c. (16 oz.) shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
3 1/2  c. (32 oz. jar) thick spaghetti sauce
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. basil
4  oz. sliced pepperoni
preparation: Break spaghetti into 2-inch pieces.  Cook according to package directions; drain.  Beat eggs in large bowl; add milk, 1 cup Mozzarella cheese, salt and garlic salt.  Stir in cooked spaghetti; mix well.  Spread mixture evenly in an oiled 10 1/2 x 15 1/2-inch pan with sides.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.  Remove from oven; reduce temperature to 350°.  Spread sauce evenly over spaghetti; sprinkle with oregano, basil and 3 cups Mozzarella cheese.  Top with pepperoni. Return to oven and bake for 30 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

name: LOW-FAT QUICK MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. low-fat baking mix (such as Pioneer)
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/8  tsp. ground cloves
1/2  c. egg substitute or 2 egg whites
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/4  c. applesauce
3/4  c. milk
3/4  c. of 2 of the following:  berries, apples, raisins, nuts, dried cranberries, etc.
preparation: Mix first 8 ingredients. Add milk and mix. Blend in fruit and nuts. Spoon into muffin cups and bake at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: GREEN CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lime Jell-O
1 medium  can fruit cocktail, drained
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2/3  c. nuts
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Soften cream cheese to room temperature.  Cream the Jell-O and cream cheese together and add boiling water. Dissolve well.  Put mayonnaise in bowl. Add a little of the Jell-O mixture.  Mix well. Add rest of Jell-O mixture.  Add nuts and fruit cocktail. Refrigerate and let "set."

name: OLD FASHION TEA CAKES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
5 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs well in a large mixing bowl.  Add milk, sugar, salt, baking soda and vanilla.  Warm shortening and add it into the bowl with other mixture and beat well, then begin to add the flour to make a very stiff dough.

name: DOUBLE-CHOCOLATE SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels, divided
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
1  c. sugar
1  large egg
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Melt 1 cup chocolate morsels in a heavy saucepan over low heat, reserving remaining morsels.  Set melted morsels aside. Beat butter at medium speed with an electric mixer until fluffy; gradually add 1 cup sugar, beating well.  Add egg, milk and vanilla, mixing well.  Add melted morsels, mixing until blended. Combine flour and next 3 ingredients; gradually add to butter mixture, mixing well.  Stir in remaining chocolate morsels.  Roll dough into balls, one tablespoon at a time.  Roll balls in 1/2 cup sugar.  Place on lightly greased cookie sheets.  Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.  (Cookies will be soft and firm up as they cool.) Remove to racks to cool.  Yields 4 1/2 dozen.

name: CARROT CAKE 1
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. salad oil
4  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  c. finely grated carrots
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix together flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon.  Add sugar, oil and eggs; beat well.  Add carrots, pineapple, and nuts; blend thoroughly.  Pour into greased and floured 10 x 14-inch pan or 3 (9-inch) round layer cake pans. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes for layer pans, 40 to 50 minutes for 10 x 14-inch pan.  Cool 5 minutes in pan before turning out to cool thoroughly.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1  qt. strawberries
1 (6 oz.)  box instant vanilla pudding mix, mixed as directed
1 large  can crushed pineapple
3  bananas, sliced
1 small  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake as directed on box; allow to cool completely. Crumble half of cake in a punch bowl or other large glass bowl. Layer pineapple, banana slices, strawberries and pudding.  Repeat layers and top with Cool Whip.  Chill at least 4 hours before serving.

name: MISSOURI EARTHQUAKE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. shredded coconut
1  c. finely crushed pecans
1  German chocolate cake mix
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  stick melted margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1  box confectioners sugar
preparation: Baste bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with margarine.  Sprinkle bottom of pan with pecans, then coconut.  Mix the cake mix according to directions on box; pour over coconut mixture.  Mix the cream cheese, melted margarine, vanilla and confectioners sugar to pouring consistency; pour over cake mixture.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: MRS. HITCHCOCK'S UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. butter
1  qt. fruit
preparation: Put in pan or skillet brown sugar, butter and fruit.  Let boil up good and set aside while making cake batter.  Use apricots, peaches, pineapple or any good fruit.

name: FUDGE
ingredients:
1/3  c. cocoa
3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. butter
4 to 6  Tbsp. peanut butter
preparation: Combine cocoa and sugar.  Add salt and milk.  boil until forms soft round ball in water.  Remove from heat; add vanilla, butter and peanut butter.  Beat until creamy; can put pan in cold water to help cool down but beat constantly.  Pour on buttered platter.

name: MACARONI PIZZA
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked wide noodles
15 1/2  oz. jar spaghetti sauce
1  egg
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
4  oz. mushrooms
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cook noodles until tender.  Beat eggs.  Add milk, 1 teaspoon Parmesan cheese and salt.  Mix with noodles.

name: STOVE TOP BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2  cans pork and beans
1/2  c. brown sugar
1 small  can tomato sauce
1/3  c. barbecue sauce
1  small onion, chopped fine
preparation: Put all ingredients in 2-quart pan. Cook on low on top of stove for 20 to 30 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: BELIEVE IT OR NOT COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. peanut butter
2  c. sugar
2  large eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all the ingredients lightly until evenly blended. "Do not overmix." Portion with teaspoon on ungreased baking sheet. Press flat with fork dipped in water. Bake at 325° for 7 to 10 minutes, until lightly brown. Let cool a few minutes before removing from pan.

name: BROCCOLI - CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
2 (1 lb.)  pkg. broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of shrimp soup
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, cubed
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz (jalapeno)
preparation: Cook broccoli in just water until just tender.  In a heavy saucepot or slow cooker, combine soups, cheeses and 2, 3 or 4 cans water (water to personal preference consistency); heat on low to medium until cheese is completely melted.  Drain broccoli and add to soup and cheese.  Serve hot!!

name: ATLANTIC PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
4  pork chops
2  Tbsp. Wesson oil
1 1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  c. uncooked regular rice
1/4  c. diced celery
2 (8 oz.)  cans Hunt's tomato sauce with onion
1/2  tsp. basil
preparation: In large skillet, brown pork chops in hot oil at 375°.  Remove chops; add celery and cook lightly.  Drain fat.  Stir in remaining ingredients; add chops.  Bring to boil.  Simmer covered for 30 minutes.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
3  c. sugar
6  eggs, separated
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. soda
1/2  pt. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift flour, salt and soda.  Set aside.  Cream butter with 2 1/2 cups sugar, then add egg yolks, one at a time.  Turn in sour cream and flour mixture.  Add vanilla.  Beat whites until stiff and add 1/2 cup sugar to eggs, then fold into batter.  Mix well. Pour into greased and floured tube pan.   Cook 1 hour and 25 minutes at 300°.  Cool on wet cloth after removing.

name: LAYERED TACO BEAN DIP
ingredients:
1  can refried beans
1  pkg. dried taco seasoning mix
1  medium chopped onion
1 small  can chopped green chilies
1 small  can diced black olives
1  layer chopped tomatoes
1  container sour cream
1  pkg. shredded taco cheese
jalapeno peppers and guacamole dip (optional)
preparation: In 9 x 13 dish, layer ingredients as listed, starting with the refried beans as the bottom layer. Chill and serve with tortilla chips.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large chicken or 6 chicken breasts
1  c. chicken broth
1  can Ro-Tel
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  diced onion
large bag Doritos
grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Crush 1 large bag of Doritos and put half in bottom of large dish.   Add all other ingredients.  Top with remainder of Doritos. Put Cheddar cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. rice, uncooked
2 1/4  c. boiling water
1/2  c. milk
1/3  pkg. Lipton Onion Soup or 1 pkg. Lipton Cup-O-Soup onion soup
1/2  can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1/2  stick butter
Paprika
preparation: Cook rice in boiling water until tender.  Add other ingredients.  Sprinkle top with paprika for color.	Bake uncovered at 350° for about 30 minutes.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
2  cans (10 3/4 oz. each) Campbell's condensed Cheddar cheese soup
2 soup  cans milk
2  tsp. prepared mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
4  c. hot cooked corkscrew macaroni (about 3 c. dry)
2  tsp. dry bread crumbs
1  tsp. margarine, melted
preparation: In a 2-quart casserole combine soup, milk, mustard and pepper. Stir in macaroni.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PUMPKIN PIE(Makes Its Own Crust)
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. pumpkin spice
1/2  c. flour
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. cloves
1 1/2  c. pumpkin
1 2/3  c. (1 large can) undiluted evaporated milk
2  eggs
preparation: Add all ingredients to blender.  Blend several seconds.  Pour into greased and floured 10-inch pie dish or two 8-inch pans. Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350°.

name: BUSY LADY'S LOUKOUMADES
ingredients:
1  can refrigerated buttermilk biscuits
cinnamon, ground
honey or maple syrup
oil (for deep frying)
preparation: Cut  biscuits  into quarters.  Drop into preheated oil. Drop biscuits  into  oil  occasionally,	turning until golden brown. Remove.  Drain  on	paper towel.  In individual bowls, add 5  to 6  biscuits.  Drizzle  with  honey	or maple syrup. Sprinkle with cinnamon.  Serve immediately.

name: GOURMET CRAB RING
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. chunk-style crabmeat
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. or 1 envelope Knox unflavored gelatine
3/4  tsp. Durkee flavored seasoning (no salt)
1  jar pimentos, chopped
1  tsp. parsley flakes
preparation: Mix ingredients together in double boiler.  Stir until smooth. Pour into mold.  Refrigerate 1 hour.  Spread for party crackers.

name: CITRUS PUNCH
ingredients:
2 (32 oz.)  bottles Ocean Spray cranberry juice cocktail, chilled
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen pink lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
4  c. cold water
1  qt. ginger ale, chilled
preparation: In a large punch bowl, mix cranberry juice cocktail, lemonade concentrate, orange juice concentrate and water.  Just before serving, add ginger ale.  Garnish with lemon and orange slices. Makes 36 (4 ounce) servings.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1  jar marshmallow cream
1  container Philadelphia cream cheese with strawberries
preparation: Soften cream cheese with strawberries. Mix with marshmallow cream.  Serve with fresh fruit.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
16  oz. box thin spaghetti
1/2  jar salad seasoning (2 1/2 oz. size)
8  oz. Italian Good Seasons mix, prepared following packet directions
fresh vegetables
preparation: Cook spaghetti until tender (do not overcook).  Drain well after rinsing with cold water.  Allow to cool.

name: SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef or 1 lb. bulk sausage (beef, milder; sausage, spicier)
6  oz. spaghetti
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  eggs, well beaten
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
1  tsp. oregano
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1  c. cottage cheese, drained
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cook spaghetti according to directions on package.  Drain (approximately 3 1/2 cups).  Stir in margarine.  Add eggs and Parmesan cheese.  Press spaghetti mixture in buttered 10-inch pie plate, forming crust.

name: LINGUINI WITH FRESH CLAM SAUCE
ingredients:
20  cherrystone clams
2  cloves garlic
pepper
1/3  c. chopped parsley
1/3  c. olive oil
preparation: Chop garlic and brown in skillet with olive oil.  Shuck clams, reserving the juice.  Chop clams and add to garlic and oil.  Cook for 3 minutes.  Add parsley and pepper; simmer for 5 minutes. Serve over freshly cooked linguini.

name: BEEF TIPS AND GRAVY
ingredients:
2  pkg. beef tips (stew meat)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
preparation: Brown beef tips.  Transfer to crock-pot.  Make a flour gravy; add to crock-pot.  Mix cream of mushroom soup and Lipton onion soup mix to gravy and beef tips.  Cook in crock-pot for 6 to 7 hours on medium setting.  Serve over rice.

name: 6-WEEK MUFFINS
ingredients:
5  c. flour
5  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. salt
3  c. sugar
1 (15 oz.)  box Raisin Bran
1  c. melted shortening
4  eggs, beaten
1  qt. buttermilk
preparation: In a large bowl, mix flour, baking soda, salt and sugar, being sure that baking powder is well blended.  Stir in the Raisin Bran, then the shortening, eggs and buttermilk.  Store in a tight container in the refrigerator.  Bake in greased muffin pans as desired at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: MUSHROOM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  slices buttered toast, cubed
1/2  lb. Old English cheese, cubed
1 (4 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms
4  eggs, slightly beaten
2/3  can mushroom soup
1/2  can milk, measured in soup can
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Alternate toast, cheese and mushrooms in baking dish.  Mix remaining ingredients.  Pour this mixture over toast, cheese and mushrooms.  Cover and bake one hour at 350°.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick melted butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1 (No. 303)  can sliced or halved peaches
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon (optional)
