preparation: In 13 x 9-inch baking dish, place melted butter.  Add sugar, flour and milk; mix until dry ingredients are well moistened and smooth.  Add drained peaches and sprinkle with cinnamon, if desired.  Bake in a 350° oven for approximately 30 minutes or until golden brown.

name: WHITE TEXAS SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. water
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. sour cream
1  tsp. almond extract
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: In a large sauce pan, bring butter and water to a boil. Remove from heat; stir in flour, sugar, eggs, sour cream, almond extract, salt, and baking soda until smooth.  Pour into a greased 15 x 10 x 1 inch jelly roll baking pan.  Bake at 375 degrees for 20 to 22 minutes or until cake tests done.  Cool for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare frosting.  Pour and spread over warm cake.

name: BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. stew (beef) meat
5  to 6 baking potatoes
5  to 6 carrots
1  whole (small) onion
1/2  c. olive/corn oil
1/2 or 1  pt. water
1/2  c. flour
preparation: Cut stew meat in small bite size pieces.  Brown the meat in large frying pan with 1/2 cup olive or corn oil.  Cut up potatoes in quarter sizes and slice carrots in bite size pieces.  After meat is browned, add 1/2 cup flour to meat (still in pan) and work in with grease.  Add 1/2 to 1 pint cold water to make gravy. (Salt and pepper to taste.)  Put all (meat and gravy, carrots and potatoes) into Dutch oven with a whole onion.  Bake at 350° for an hour or 3 to 4 hours on low in a crock-pot.  Serve with biscuits.

name: GINGERSNAPS
ingredients:
2  c. white sugar
1 1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. molasses
2  eggs
4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
4  tsp. soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1 1/2  tsp. ginger
preparation: Cream sugar, shortening and eggs and add molasses.  Add combined and sifted dry ingredients.  Roll into small balls dipped in sugar.  Bake at 350° until done.

name: BANANA BREAD CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2/3  c. honey
3  beaten eggs
1  c. mashed bananas
1/3  c. milk
3  Tbsp. Tia Maria
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. whole wheat flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Butter and flour loaf pan.  Mix butter and honey in large bowl with beaters until fluffy.  Beat in eggs, bananas, milk and Tia Maria.  Sift together salt, baking powder, baking soda and flour.  Gradually mix all ingredients into banana batter.  Spoon into loaf pan.  Bake for 1 hour.  Cool before removing.

name: PACE CHICKEN CHIMICHANGAS(Chi-mee-chon-gahs)
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. shredded, cooked chicken
2/3  c. Pace picante sauce
1/3  c. green onion slices
3/4 to 1  tsp. ground cumin
1/2  tsp. oregano leaves
1/2  tsp. salt
8  (8-inch) flour tortillas
1/4  c. melted butter
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine chicken, picante sauce, onion, cumin, oregano and salt in saucepan; simmer 5 minutes or until most of the liquid has evaporated.  Brush 1 side of tortillas with butter.  Spoon 1/3 cup chicken mixture onto center of unbuttered sides, top with 2 tablespoons cheese.  Fold 2 sides over filling; fold sides down. Place seam sides down.  Bake in preheated oven at 475° about 13 minutes until brown.  Top with guacamole and picante sauce to serve.  Makes 4 servings.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. evaporated milk
2  Tbsp. light corn syrup
1/8  tsp. salt
1/4  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Grease an 8-inch square pan.  Stir sugar, milk, corn syrup and salt in a heavy saucepan.  Bring to a boil, stirring constantly (candy thermometer 234°) or to soft ball stage.

name: ZUCCHINI PICKLES(Bread and Butter)
ingredients:
2  lb. fresh firm zucchini
2  medium onions
1/4  c. salt (pickling salt is best)
2  c. white sugar
1  tsp. turmeric
2  tsp. mustard seed
3  c. cider vinegar (4 to 6% acid strength)
preparation: Wash zucchini and cut into thin slices.  Peel and quarter onions, then slice very thin.  Add to zucchini.  Cover with water and add salt; let stand 2 hours.  Drain thoroughly.  Bring remaining ingredients to boiling.  Pour over zucchini and onions. Let stand 2 hours.  Bring all ingredients to boil and boil for 5 minutes.  Pack into clean pint or quart jars.  Leave 1/8-inch headspace.  Process in water bath canner for 15 minutes; cool. Test for seal; store.

name: HEARTY BACON POTATO CHOWDER
ingredients:
8  slices bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces
2  c. cubed 1/2-inch new red potatoes
1  c. onions, chopped
1  c. dairy sour cream
1 1/4  c. milk
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. thyme leaves
preparation: In 3-quart saucepan, cook bacon over medium heat for 5 minutes. Add potatoes and onions. Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender (15 to 20 minutes). Add remaining ingredients. Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until heated through (10 to 12 minutes). Preparation time is 40 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

name: GERMAN SOUR CREAM TWISTS
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. shortening (use part butter or oleo)
1  pkg. active dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
3/4  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
1  whole egg and 2 egg yolks, beaten
preparation: Sift flour and salt together; cut in shortening (as for pie crust).  Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Stir into flour mixture with sour cream, eggs and vanilla.  Mix well.  Cover with a damp cloth and refrigerate for 2 hours.  Roll out dough on sugar.  Roll out oblong about 1/4 inch thick.  Fold dough up from each short side to middle; roll out again and repeat once again.  Cut into 1 x 4-inch strips.  Twist and put on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.

name: TROPICAL DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 medium  jar maraschino cherries, chopped
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. coconut
5  Tbsp. lemon concentrate
1  can Eagle Brand milk
9  oz. carton Cool Whip
2  (9-inch) graham cracker crusts
preparation: Mix all together.  Keep refrigerated.  Makes two pies.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
10  oz. grated sharp cheese
3  c. Bisquick
1  lb. mild sausage
preparation: Mix ingredients and shape into balls.  Bake for 30 minutes; first 15 minutes, bake at 350°, then reduce heat to 325° for 15 minutes.

name: DRESSING FOR CHICKEN OR TURKEY
ingredients:
6  c. cornbread crumbs
4  c. biscuit crumbs
1  c. onion, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
1  stick margarine
3  eggs
1  Tbsp. sage
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
4  c. broth
preparation: Crumble the bread in a large bowl.  Simmer the celery and onion in the melted margarine until tender.  Add the rest of the ingredients to the crumbs and mix.  The mixture should have the consistency of uncooked cornbread.  Bake in greased pan at 350° until lightly browned.

name: TART-RIFFIC DELIGHTS
ingredients:
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding and pie filling
2  c. cold milk
1  pkg. (6 shells) single serving crust shells (4 oz.)
1 1/2 to 2  c. any combination  favorite fresh fruits such as blueberries, strawberries (sliced), red or green seedless grapes, cut up kiwi or sliced peaches
1/4  c. apple jelly
preparation: Combine instant pudding and cold milk in a mixing bowl according to package directions.  On a plate, set out approximately two cups of any fresh fruits you wish to use.   Pick fruits with different colors to make the tarts more attractive. Using a spoon, fill each tart half-way full with the pudding. Arrange fruit on top of the pudding in an attractive pattern. Measure out 1/4 cup of apple jelly and put it into a small saucepan.  Place the saucepan on the stove and melt the apple jelly over low heat for 15 minutes or until melted.  Stir occasionally.  Using a pastry brush, spread the apple jelly over the fruit tarts for a pretty glaze.  Chill for at least one hour before serving.

name: MEAT LOAF WITH A TWIST
ingredients:
4  lb. hamburger
1  large onion
1  green pepper
Lawry's seasoned salt
celery seed
salt and pepper to taste
A.1. steak sauce
preparation: Combine all of the ingredients in the hamburger.  Form into a loaf in a large bread pan.  Cover with aluminum foil and place in oven for approximately 1 to 1 1/2 hours until done.  Take off aluminum foil and let brown in oven for 10 minutes.

name: BEEFY BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger meat
1  lb. sausage
1  green pepper
1  large onion
2 large  cans baked beans
bacon bits
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Fry hamburger meat and sausage until brown.  Drain excess fat.  Add peppers and onion.  Cook until done.  Pour in beans and sugar.  Mix well.  Put in pan.  Put bacon bits on top.  Bake 350° for 45 minutes.

name: LEMON WHIPPERSNAPS
ingredients:
1  pkg. any lemon cake mix
2  c. frozen whipped topping, thawed
1  egg
1/2  c. sifted powdered sugar
preparation: Grease cookie sheets.  Combine cake mix, whipped topping and egg in large bowl.  Stir until well mixed.  Drop by teaspoons into powdered sugar; roll to coat.  Place balls 1 1/2-inches apart on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes until light golden brown (for chewy cookies do not overbake).  Remove from cookie sheet; cool.  Store in tightly closed container.

name: FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
15  spoons sugar
15  spoons flour
15  spoons milk
10  spoons vegetable oil
3  eggs
2 to 3  drops vanilla
1  lb. fruit (berries or plums or peaches), cut in cubes, lightly coated with flour
preparation: In a large bowl, mix all the ingredients and pour batter in an oven pan after being greased and floured.  Add the fruits on the top and bake it at 375° to 400° for 1/2 hour.   Pierce with a toothpick to check doneness.  Cool for 15 minutes before cutting.

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
6  c. cubed cooked potatoes
1  pt. salad dressing
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
4  eggs hard-boiled and chopped
1  c. chopped celery
1  tsp. celery seed
1  small chopped onion (optional)
preparation: Mix together and pour over potatoes and eggs.

name: PURPLE COW
ingredients:
6  oz. can grape juice frozen concentrate
1  qt. ice cream
1  c. milk
preparation: Blend all together in blender.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
1  egg, beaten
1  can cream-style corn
1  c. milk
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. coarse fresh bread crumbs
1/4  c. (1 oz.) sharp American cheese, grated
preparation: Beat egg in a butter casserole dish.  Heat corn and milk, then gradually stir into beaten egg.  Add salt, bread crumbs and cheese.  Mix thoroughly.  Place directly on the rack of a moderately low (325°) oven and bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until custard test done.

name: PRALINE PECAN CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Betty Crocker butter pecan cake mix
1/2  c. self-rising flour
4  eggs
1  c. milk
3/4  c. oil
1  c. chopped pecans
1  can Betty Crocker coconut pecan frosting
preparation: Grease and flour Bundt pan or three small loaf pans. Sprinkle some of the pecans on bottom of pan. Mix all ingredients except frosting.  Beat two minutes. Fold in frosting. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: MOLASSES CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. molasses
1 3/4  tsp. soda
1  c. sour milk
1/2  c. melted shortening
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ginger
preparation: Beat all together; add enough flour to make a batter and bake.

name: NO BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. peanut butter (creamy or crunchy)
3  c. oatmeal (instant)
preparation: Melt butter.  Add milk, sugar and cocoa.  Cook on medium heat until it starts to boil, stirring constantly.  Cool 1 minute.  Add vanilla, peanut butter and oatmeal.  Stir well.  Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper.  Cool in refrigerator and serve when set.

name: LEMON LUSH
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. chopped nuts (pecans)
1  stick butter, melted
1  c. powdered sugar
1  (8 oz.) softened cream cheese
1  c. Cool Whip
2 small  pkg. instant lemon pudding mix
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into long baking dish.  Bake for 15 minutes at 350° until brown; cool.

name: CRACKLIN' CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. diced cracklings
1 1/2  c. self-rising corn meal
3/4  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sour milk
preparation: Mix corn meal and flour.  Add milk.  Stir in cracklings.  Pour into greased iron skillet. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until brown.

name: CABBAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
8  large cabbage leaves
1/2  c. cracker crumbs
1/2  c. rice
1  egg, beaten
1  can tomatoes
salt to taste
garlic powder to taste
1  lb. ground meat
minced onions to taste
1  green pepper, chopped
1  can tomato sauce
2  tsp. sugar
pepper to taste
preparation: Boil cabbage leaves in water in saucepan until tender; drain and set aside.  Combine next 7 ingredients in bowl with enough tomato sauce to moisten; mix well.  Roll this mixture in cabbage leaves.  Put in baking dish.  Combine remaining ingredients in saucepan; simmer for 5 minutes, then pour over cabbage leaves. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CROCK-POT CANDY
ingredients:
2  lb. white chocolate
2  c. peanut butter
4  c. Cap'n Crunch
4  c. Rice Krispies
1  pkg. marshmallows
2  c. pecans
preparation: Melt in crock-pot on high the white chocolate and peanut butter.  Add Cap'n Crunch, Rice Krispies, marshmallows and pecans. Drop by tablespoonful on wax paper.  Makes 160 pieces.

name: PEPPERMINT BROWNIES
ingredients:
4  sq. baking chocolate
1  c. margarine
4  eggs, beaten
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. peppermint extract
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. flour
4  Tbsp. margarine
2  sq. baking sweet chocolate
2  c. sifted confectioners sugar
1 1/2  tsp. peppermint extract
preparation: Melt chocolate and margarine.  Stir in sugar and extract.  Cut into small squares.  Freeze well!

name: CHERRY DREAM CREAM
ingredients:
16  oz. Cool Whip
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (16 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
1 medium  can crushed pineapple
1 medium  can pineapple chunks
preparation: Drain both cans of pineapple and put in bowl.  Mix remaining ingredients with pineapple.  Refrigerate.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. or 1 pkg. cranberries, ground
2  c. sugar
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. nuts
1  c. heavy cream or Cool Whip
preparation: Combine cranberries and sugar.  Let set overnight; drain and add 2 cups red grapes or white ones.  Add pineapple and nuts. Fold in whipped cream.  Keep chilled until time to serve.

name: FILET OF SOLE WITH CHEESE SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. filet of sole
1  c. milk
3/4  tsp. salt
dash of white pepper
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. sherry
1/4  c. grated cheese
preparation: Thaw lobster tails by separating them and setting out (room temperature) for approximately 4 hours.

name: SPICY BROILED POTATOES
ingredients:
2  red or white potatoes (per person)
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted (per person)
seasoned salt
garlic powder
preparation: Scrub potatoes with soft brush. Cut lengthwise in half and then in quarters. Spread skin side down on baking sheet.  Drizzle with butter and sprinkle with seasonings. Broil 4 to 6-inches from heat until a fork glides in easily, 15 to 25 minutes, depending on thickness.

name: FROZEN CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  Tbsp. Miracle Whip salad dressing
1  can whole cranberry sauce
2  c. or more Cool Whip
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix and freeze.  Keep in freezer when not being served.  Makes a most delicious salad for the holidays.

name: APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  pie crust (unbaked)
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. spice of your choice
1  beaten egg
3/4  stick margarine, melted
2  c. apples, grated
preparation: Mix the egg, margarine and apples with the mixed dry ingredients.  Pour into crust and bake at 325° for about 45 minutes.  This has no top crust and looks like toasted coconut when done.

name: CORN PUDDING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1/4  c. sweet bell pepper, finely chopped
1/4  c. onion, finely chopped
2  eggs, well beaten
1/2  stick butter
1  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients in casserole dish.  Bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: NICARAGUAN FRIED RICE
ingredients:
1  onion (medium), chopped
1  carrot, grated
1  green pepper, chopped
1  c. rice
salt to taste
2  Tbsp. oil
1  tomato, chopped
preparation: Wash and drain rice.  Set aside.   In skillet, heat oil and saute onion, green pepper and carrot.  Add 2 cups water and salt on medium heat until rice is done.  Three minutes before, spread chopped tomato on top.  When rice is done, top with lid.

name: 5 FLAVOR POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1/2  lb. butter
1/2  c. shortening
5  eggs
3  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  tsp. butter flavoring
1  tsp. coconut flavoring
1  tsp. rum flavoring
preparation: In medium bowl cream sugar, butter and shortening.  In small bowl, beat eggs until lemon in color.  Mix in large bowl flour, salt and baking powder.  Add eggs, sugar mixture, flavorings and milk.  Blend well.  Bake in greased, floured tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: HELLO DOLLY CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. coconut
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nut meats
1  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: In 9 x 12 1/2-inch pan, spread cracker crumbs, coconut, chips, nut meats and milk.  Sprinkle with 1 stick melted oleo.  Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.  Cool and cut.

name: COMPANY SWISS CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  chicken breast halves, skin removed
salt and pepper
4  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
12  slices bacon
6  oz. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1 1/2  c. Swiss cheese, grated
preparation: Place chicken, skin side up, in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Pour 3 tablespoons of the melted butter over top.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: PECAN PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
3  slightly beaten eggs
1  c. canned or mashed cooked pumpkin
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. dark corn syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  unbaked 9-inch pastry shell
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: In small mixing bowl, combine the first 7 ingredients; mix well.  Pour into unbaked pastry shell.  Top with chopped pecans. Bake in a 350° oven for about 40 minutes, or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.  Chill; served topped with whipped cream.

name: BRUSSELS SPROUTS AND BACON
ingredients:
2  pt. Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
1  Tbsp. sugar
salt and pepper
4  slices bacon
1  onion, finely chopped
3  Tbsp. white wine vinegar
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Steam sprouts 5 minutes or until tender.  In a small skillet, cook bacon until crisp.  Drain and crumble. Add onion to drippings in skillet. Saute 5 minutes or until tender. Cook, stirring until mixture boils.  Stir in bacon.  Pour over Brussels sprouts.

name: DANISH PUFF COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1  c. flour
3  Tbsp. cold water
1  c. water
1  stick oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
3  eggs
preparation: Mix 1 stick oleo, 1 cup flour and 3 tablespoons cold water as for pie dough.  Divide into 2 parts.  Pat or roll in long strips on cookie sheet.  Boil together for 1 minute the 1 cup water, 1 stick oleo and 1 teaspoon vanilla.  Remove from heat and add 1 cup flour. Stir and add eggs, one at a time. Spread this mixture on top of strips. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.  Frost with powdered sugar on top.  Sprinkle with nuts on top.

name: HEAVENLY CHEESE AND PASTA
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  medium onions, chopped
1  clove garlic, crushed
1 (14 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1 (3 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms
1  (6 oz.) shell macaroni
1 1/2  pt. sour cream
1  lb. Provolone cheese, grated
1  lb. Mozzarella cheese, grated
preparation: Fry beef until cooked through.  Drain off grease. Add onion, garlic, spaghetti sauce, tomatoes and undrained mushrooms.  Mix well. Simmer 20 minutes.

name: HAWAIIAN DESSERT
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
3  pkg. (3.4 oz.) vanilla instant pudding
4  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. coconut extract
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  c. heavy cream, whipped and sweetened
2  c. flaked coconut, toasted
preparation: Mix cake according to directions.  Make two 9 x 13-inch cakes. Cool.  Mix pudding, cream cheese, milk and extract.   Beat well. Stir in pineapple.  Spread on cooled cakes.  Top with whipped cream.  Sprinkle with coconut.  You can use Cool Whip instead of whipping cream.  May be frozen up to 1 month.

name: SHRIMP SCAMPI
ingredients:
2  lb. large, raw shrimp
1/2  c. liquid Butter Buds
1/2  tsp. lite salt (optional)
6  cloves garlic, crushed
1/4  c. chopped parsley
2  tsp. grated lemon peel
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
6  lemon wedges (1 lemon)
4  c. cooked plain white rice
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Remove shells from shrimp, leaving shell on tail section only.  Devein; wash under running water and drain on paper towels.  Spray a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with a nonfat cooking spray.  Blend together liquid Butter Buds, lite salt, garlic and parsley.  Pour into a prepared dish.  Arrange shrimp in single layer in baking dish.  Bake uncovered, 5 minutes.  Turn shrimp.  Sprinkle with lemon peel, lemon juice, and remaining parsley.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes longer or until just tender. Arrange shrimp over plain, cooked white rice.  Pour garlic- Butter Buds mixture over shrimp.  Garnish with lemon wedges.  Do not overcook the shrimp or they will be tough.  If using smaller shrimp, cut down on cooking time.  Serve with sourdough or French bread to soak up the sauce.  Serves 8.

name: MARINATED SLAW
ingredients:
1  cabbage head, sliced or shredded
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
3/4  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. mustard
2  sliced onions
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. celery seed
preparation: Arrange cabbage  and  onions  in  layers in large dish. Bring other  ingredients	to  boil  and  pour over cabbage and onions. Store, tightly covered, in refrigerator for 3 days.

name: RICE AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3/4  c. chopped celery
1  medium chopped onion
2  c. cooked rice
1 small  can Milnot or chicken broth
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 large  jar Cheez Whiz
1 to 2  pkg. chopped frozen broccoli
1  lb. hamburger
preparation: Brown hamburger meat and drain.  Partially cook broccoli as directed.  Saute onions and celery in a small amount of butter. Gently add this to the rest of the recipe.  Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°, until set.  Use a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: CARIBBEAN PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  trimmed pork chops
3  Tbsp. salad oil
1  large onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1/4  c. peanut butter
1 1/2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. curry powder
2  tsp. soy sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. warm water
1/2  c. orange juice
1  small orange, sliced
1  small pepper, cut in rings
preparation: Brown chops in oil and drain off fat.  Sprinkle onion and garlic over and around chops.  Combine next 7 ingredients.  Mix well.  Stir in juice and pour over chops.  Place orange slices and pepper rings on chops.  Simmer covered about 50 minutes or until chops are tender.  Stir sauce and baste occasionally.  Add small amount of water if needed.

name: CAMPER'S COOKOUT SOUP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. leaf thyme
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
2  lb. beef for stew, cut in 1-inch pieces
2  c. hot water
2 (17 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1  lb. can tomatoes
1  lb. can green beans, drained
1  lb. can small whole or sliced potatoes, drained
preparation: Place 1 loaf frozen bread dough on cookie sheet to raise overnight.  Heat oil in Dutch oven.  Break off small pieces of dough and fry in oil.  Turn pieces and remove when brown.  Toss in bag with powdered sugar or make glaze by melting sugar in small amount of water and dip Bannock in before serving.

name: HAWAIIAN BEANS
ingredients:
28  oz. can Bush beans
1  c. pineapple chunks, drained
3  pineapple rings, cut in half
1 1/2  lb. cooked ham, cubed
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Combine beans, ham and pineapple chunks.  Pour into casserole dish.  Top with pineapple slices and sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: AUTUMN APPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple (20 oz.)
2/3  c. sugar
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. diced apples
1/2 to 1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. whipped topping
lettuce leaves
preparation: Combine sugar and pineapple.  Let come to a boil.  Boil for 3 minutes.  Add Jell-O and stir until dissolved.  Add softened cream cheese.  Mix thoroughly.  Cool.  Fold in apples, nuts, celery and whipped topping.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. brown sugar
1  c. oleo
4  eggs
4  c. flour
1  c. coconut
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Mix brown sugar, oleo and eggs.  Add rest of ingredients. Make into long rolls about 3 inches wide.  Chill overnight.   Next day, slice thin slices and put on greased cookie sheet.  Make a thin icing of water and powdered sugar.  Brush over each slice with pastry brush.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: PARMESAN FONDUE
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
3  cloves grated garlic
2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
preparation: Soften cheese.  Add milk and heat.  Add garlic and Parmesan.

name: SHRIMP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  tsp. prepared mustard
2  hard-boiled eggs, minced
1/2  c. buttered bread crumbs
1  tsp. horseradish
1  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
2  cans tiny shrimp, drained
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan; add flour.  Stir until smooth.  Add parsley, lemon juice, mustard, horseradish, salt and milk.  When smooth, add shrimp and eggs.  Put in either scallop shells or small oven container.  Sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes (or 375° for 20 minutes).

name: CREAM OF CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
2  medium size skinless, boneless chicken breast halves (about 3/4 lb.)
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1  medium size onion, finely chopped
4  medium size potatoes (about 1 1/2 lb.), cut into bite size chunks
1 (13 3/4 to 14 1/2 oz.)  can chicken broth
1/2  lb. spinach
1  c. half and half
1  tsp. salt
preparation: About 45 Minutes Before Serving:  Cut each chicken breast half lengthwise in half, then cut crosswise into 1/4-inch thick strips. In 4-quart saucepan over medium-high heat, in hot salad oil, cook chicken strips just until they lose pink color throughout, stirring frequently. With slotted spoon, remove chicken to bowl and set aside.

name: PIE PUMPKINS
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. cloves
3/4  c. brown sugar
2  c. cooked squash
preparation: Pour into 9-inch pie crust.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 325° for 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

name: MOM'S RAW RIPE TOMATO RELISH
ingredients:
8  lbs. ripe tomatoes
1  green pepper
1  c. chopped celery
3  lg. onions
1/4  c. salt
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. mustard seed
1  c. vinegar
preparation: Chop tomatoes and drain them overnight in a colander set in a large, deep container.  Chop the green, pepper, onions and celery and mix them together and stir them into the drained tomatoes. Mix the remaining ingredients and pour over the vegetables.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
hamburger
1  onion
1  mango (green pepper)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
Tater Tots
preparation: Line bottom and sides of baking dish with hamburger.  Put layer of chopped onion and chopped mango (green pepper) and layer of cheese.  Pour can of cream of mushroom soup over cheese, then top with Tater Tots.  Bake in 350° oven, uncovered, about an hour.

name: COLONIAL INNKEEPER'S PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1/2  c. water
2/3  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. soft margarine
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Melt chocolate in water.  Add 2/3 cup sugar and bring to a boil.  Remove from heat and stir in 1/4 cup butter or margarine and 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla.  Set sauce aside.  Mix and stir flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.  Add margarine, vanilla and milk. Beat 2 minutes.  Add 1 egg and beat 2 more minutes.  Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell.  Pour sauce over batter and sprinkle top with 1/2 cup pecans or walnuts.  Bake 55 to 60 minutes at 350°. Serve with whipped cream.

name: OUR FAVORITE CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. chicken
12 or 16  oz. noodles (medium)
1  c. celery, cut fine
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 small  can mushrooms (if desired)
1  can peas, plus juice
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese, cubed
preparation: Cook the chicken until tender; remove from stock and cool. Drain the stock to remove any bones or chicken pieces, saving the stock. Cook noodles in stock until tender.  Drain. While chicken in cooking, saute celery, onion and green pepper in margarine in microwave until tender. Cream the soups together and add to noodles. Bone the entire chicken and  fold into noodle mixture. Stir in the cheese, mushrooms and sauteed vegetables.  Fold peas and juice in gently. If you have Dutch rusk, crumble on top or use fine cracker crumbs and dot with butter.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour until bubbly.  (If using 16 ounces of noodles, you may wish to add 1 more can of soup for moisture.)

name: ROTINI
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  green pepper, chopped
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  c. onion, chopped
1 (28 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms w/liquid
1/2  tsp. each basil, oregano and garlic powder
2  c. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
12  oz. bag rotini noodles
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Brown hamburger, then combine all ingredients except cheese and noodles.  Prepare rotini noodles in pot of boiling water until tender.  Drain.  Mix sauce with cooked noodles.  Pour 1/2 of mixture into a casserole dish.  Layer with 1/2 of Mozzarella cheese, then mixture and top with remaining cheese.  Bake for 40 minutes or until cheese is melted and golden brown.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. Minute Rice
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
8  oz. jar Cheez Whiz
1  stick margarine
1  can golden mushroom soup
preparation: Cook rice according to package directions.  Cook broccoli in water; do not drain.  Saute onions and celery in margarine.  Add Cheez Whiz and soup.  Mix well.  Add rice and broccoli.  Pour mixture in baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  (Casserole can be made ahead and refrigerated until ready to heat.)

name: HAM & CHEESE OMELET ROLLS
ingredients:
4  oz. cream cheese, softened
3/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. all purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
12  eggs
8  oz. ham, finely chopped. (1 1/2 cups)
1 1/2  c. cheddar cheese
1/4  c. green onions (with tops) thinly sliced
2  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
preparation: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  In a bowl combine cream cheese and milk, whisk until smooth.  Add flour and salt, mix well.  In a separate bowl gently whisk eggs then add cream cheese mixture, mix well.  Pour in a long cookie sheet (parchment paper may be used). Bake for 30 to 33 minutes or until eggs are puffy and golden. Meanwhile, finely chop ham.  Remove omelet from oven, immediately spread dijon mustard, and sprinkle 1/2 of cheese, ham and green onions.  Sprinkle the rest of the cheese and roll up, (like a jelly roll).  Let stand 5 minutes allowing cheese to melt.  Slice and serve.

name: MOIST AND FRUITY RAINBOW CAKE
ingredients:
2  baked 8 or 9-inch white cake layers, cooled
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. Jell-O gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1/2  c. cold water
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip, thawed, or your favorite frosting
preparation: Place cake layers, top side up, in 2 clean layer pans.  Prick each cake with serving fork at 1/2-inch intervals.  Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Add cold water and pour carefully over cakes.  Chill 3 to 4 hours.  Dip 1 cake pan in warm water for 10 seconds.  Turn out onto serving plate.  Top is 1 cup whipped topping or frosting.  Unmold second cake layer.  Place carefully on first layer.  Frost top and side with remaining whipped topping or frosting.  Garnish as directed.

name: FUNNEL CAKES
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. flour
1 1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. sugar
3/4  Tbsp. baking powder
1  beaten egg
2/3  c. milk (more if batter is too thick)
preparation: Mix egg and milk together; add dry ingredients and beat until smooth.  Hold finger over bottom of funnel; pour in some of the batter, then remove finger and let batter drop in a spiral motion into pan filled with 1-inch of hot oil.  Fry until golden brown, turning once.  Remove from pan and drain on paper towels.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve hot.

name: BAR CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. pimento cheese spread
3  Tbsp. horseradish
9  Tbsp. mayonnaise
6  shakes Tabasco sauce
chopped chives to taste
preparation: Melt cheese in top of double boiler over boiling water. Combine the horseradish, mayonnaise, Tabasco sauce and chopped chives.  Stir into melted cheese.  Pour into jar.  Cool.  Cover and let stand in refrigerator 24 hours.  Makes a generous pound of cheese spread.

name: SOURDOUGH BREAD
ingredients:
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. corn oil
1  Tbsp. salt
1  c. starter
1 1/2  c. warm water
6  c. Pillsbury bread flour
preparation: In a large bowl make a stiff batter of the ingredients.  Grease another bowl with corn oil.  Put dough in bowl and turn over to coat.  Cover lightly with paper towel and let stand overnight (not in refrigerator).

name: STUFFED SALISBURY STEAK
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. celery
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  c. water
1  c. Pepperidge Farm seasoning mix
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1  Tbsp. catsup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan and saute celery and onion until tender.  Add water and bring to a boil; add stuffing mix.  Remove from heat and stir until blended.  Combine evaporated milk and meat.  Divide into 6 portions on waxed paper.  Pat into a 5-inch circle.  Put 1/6 of stuffing mix in center of each patty.  Draw edges of meat over mix and seal.  Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over meat.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  c. Crisco
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  egg
1/4  tsp. baking powder
5  Tbsp. water
preparation: Break egg into a bowl.  Add vinegar and water.  Beat well. Cut shortening into flour and salt.  Add the egg mixture and stir to form a ball.  This makes 4 crusts.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
1  pkg. Kool-Aid
2  c. hot water
6  c. cold water
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  lemons
1 large  can pineapple juice
1 large  bottle ginger ale
preparation: Dissolve Kool-Aid and sugar in hot water; add juice of 2 lemons, pineapple juice and ginger ale.

name: PASTA SALAD PARMESAN
ingredients:
1/4  c. oil
2  c. broccoli flowerets
1/4  c. sliced scallions
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. basil leaves
1/2  lb. pasta, cooked and drained (curly kind)
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1  c. cherry tomatoes, halved
preparation: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat.  Add broccoli, scallions, garlic and basil.  Toss and stir until broccoli is tender-crisp, about 4 minutes.  Remove from heat. Toss in bowl with pasta, Parmesan cheese and tomatoes.  Chill well before serving.

name: PRAIRIE DOGS
ingredients:
6  hot dogs
3  slices American cheese, cut into halves
6  slices bacon
6  hot dog buns
preparation: Slit hot dogs lengthwise, leaving one side hinged.  Insert a thin strip of processed American cheese in slits and wrap each hot dog in a slice of bacon.  Grill hot dogs over medium heat, turning several times, until bacon is done as desired.  Serve in toasted buns with your favorite barbecue sauce.

name: TACO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  clove garlic
1/4  c. water
1/4  tsp. whole cloves, crushed
2  c. corn chips, crushed
1  c. chopped onion
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  can kidney beans (undrained)
1 3/4  c. shredded lettuce
preparation: Combine ground beef, onion and garlic in a large skillet; cook until meat is browned.  Drain.  Combine meat mixture, tomato sauce, water and seasonings in a medium bowl; stir well.  Place half of meat mixture in a lightly greased 2-quart casserole.  Top with half of kidney beans.  Sprinkle with half of crushed corn chips.  Repeat layers.  Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 5 minutes.  To serve, top with shredded lettuce.

name: CAULIFLOWER WITH CORN FLAKES
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower (1 1/2 lb.)
1  tsp. finely chopped onion
1/2  c. corn flakes, coarsely crushed
2  Tbsp. butter
dash of salt
preparation: Cook cauliflower until just tender or from 6 to 8 minutes. Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients in a small skillet and brown slightly for 5 minutes.  Drain cauliflower and arrange on a serving plate, then sprinkle with the hot crumb mixture.  Serve at once.  Makes 4 servings.

name: SOY SAUCE MARINADE
ingredients:
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. salad oil
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  clove garlic
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Place pork steak or other pork in marinade.  Put in fridge overnight.  Turn occasionally.  Cook as desired.  Good on grill also.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CRISSCROSSES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. peanut butter (crunchy)
3  c. sifted plain flour
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Thoroughly cream the shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla. Stir in peanut butter.  Sift dry ingredients; stir into creamed mixture.  Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Press crisscross pattern with floured fork.  Bake for 10 minutes on top oven shelf at 350°.

name: BAKED PINEAPPLE(Excellent For Diabetics)
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple (in own juice)
8  pkg. Equal or 1/2 c. NutraSweet
2  tsp. flour
3  eggs
4  slices bread
2/3  stick oleo
preparation: Pour pineapple into dish (do not drain).  Add Equal and flour. Beat eggs and add.  Spray 2-quart casserole with Pam and pour in mixture.  Crumble bread over the top.  Cut oleo very thin and lay over top of bread.  Bake 1 hour in oven at 375°.  If getting too brown, reduce heat a little.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
2  pkg. broccoli, cooked and drained
2  c. chicken, diced
2  cans cream of mushroom soup or cream of chicken soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1/2  c. cheese, grated
1/2  c. buttered bread crumbs
3  tsp. margarine
preparation: Layer broccoli and chicken. Combine soup, mayonnaise, curry powder and lemon juice. Pour over layers and sprinkle with cheese, then bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked chicken, cut up (4 breasts)
1  bag frozen peas and carrots
1  c. chicken broth
1  c. flour
1  c. milk
1/2  c. melted margarine
2  cans cream of chicken soup
4  medium potatoes, cut up small
preparation: Mix chicken, vegetables and potatoes together.  Mix cream of chicken soup with 1 cup of hot broth.  Pour over chicken mixture and stir.  Pour into 13 x 9-inch greased Pyrex dish.

name: EASY HAM GLAZE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. brown sugar
1/2  c. cider vinegar
1 1/2  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Mix and boil one minute.  Baste ham with this sauce often while baking.  Makes enough glaze for a 4 pound ham.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
1  cooked chicken, cut in bite-size pieces
1  c. cream of chicken soup
1  c. cream of celery soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. curry powder
2  pkg. broccoli pieces
mashed Ritz crackers
1  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Mix together soups, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder and add to the cooked chicken.  Spray a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with Pam.  Add broccoli; pour chicken mixture over the top.  Top with Ritz crackers and melted butter and bake 1/2 hour to 45 minutes at 350°.

name: GELATIN GEMS
ingredients:
4  envelopes unflavored gelatin
1 3/4  c. unsweetened fruit juice
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Add juice to gelatin.  Add water and stir until gelatin is dissolved.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and chill until firm.  Cut into squares.

name: JULIA'S COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. oleo
2  large or 3 small eggs
preparation: Sift flour, salt, baking soda and baking powder together. Cream oleo and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, and beat.  Add flour and sour cream by alternating.

name: FAYE'S FRENCH COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
9-inch unbaked pie shell
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. buttermilk
1/4  c. butter, soft
1 1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Heat oven to 325°.  In medium bowl, beat eggs until fluffy. Add sugar, vanilla, buttermilk, butter and coconut.  Mix thoroughly and pour into pie shell.  Bake until golden brown (about 45 minutes).

name: EASY CHICKEN BAKE
ingredients:
1  fryer, cut up
1  can mushroom soup
3  to 4 potatoes, peeled and cut in chunks
preparation: Combine in a casserole and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Salt and pepper to taste.

name: SWEDISH MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. Ground Beef
1/2  lb. Ground Pork
1/2  c. Minced Onion
3/4  c. Fine Dry Bread Crumbs
1  Tbsp. Minced Parsley
1  tsp. Salt
1/8  tsp. Pepper
1/2  tsp. Garlic Powder
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire Sauce
1  Egg
1/2  c. Milk
1/4  c. Oil
preparation: Combine meats, onion, bread crumbs, parsley, salt, pepper, garlic powder, Worcestershire sauce, egg and milk.

name: CRAB DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. crab meat (special picked)
16  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. sour cream
2  Tbsp. hot mustard
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3  Tbsp. mayo
4 shakes garlic salt or use  clove of garlic, crushed
1 1/2  c. grated sharp cheese (on top of mixture)
preparation: Mix together all ingredients (except grated cheese).  Spread into oblong baking pan like lasagna pan.  Grate cheese on top. Bake at 325° for 1 hour, uncovered.  Let sit; serve with crackers or little pieces of bread.  Great for taking to a party.

name: PEPPERONI BREAD
ingredients:
1  Pillsbury pizza crust
1/4  lb. pepperoni, sliced thin
1/4  lb. Provolone or Mozzarella cheese, shredded or broken into bits
1  egg
preparation: Roll out dough. Layer pepperoni and cheese.  Roll dough back up.  Place on greased cookie sheet.  Beat egg with a little water. Brush top of dough with egg.  Bake at 400° until golden brown, about 15 to 20 minutes.  Slice to serve.

name: SHRIMP PARTY MOLD
ingredients:
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
2  Tbsp. milk
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of shrimp soup, undiluted
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. finely chopped celery
1 (4 1/3 oz.)  can shrimp, drained and chopped
4  green onions, chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. curry powder
preparation: Soften gelatin in milk.  Heat soup and cream cheese until melted.  Stir in softened gelatin.  Add remaining ingredients. Pour into lightly greased 4-cup mold.  Chill several hours.  Serve with crackers.  May also mold in individual molds and served as salad.  (May substitute chicken for shrimp and use cream of chicken soup. Dilute curry powder.)  Yields 4 cups.

name: CRACKLING CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. corn meal
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. sugar
1  egg, well beaten
3  tsp. baking powder
1 1/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. cracklings
preparation: Add flour, corn meal, sugar, salt, baking powder, egg and milk.  Add cracklings.  Beat thoroughly.  Bake in well-oiled shallow pan in hot oven at 450° about 20 minutes or drop by teaspoonfuls on a hot well-oiled griddle.  Fry until golden brown. Makes 6 servings.

name: ICICLE PICKLES
ingredients:
1  qt. cider vinegar
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. canning salt
1  Tbsp. mustard seed
1  Tbsp. celery seed
cucumbers
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients and bring to boiling point.  Cut cucumbers lengthwise into narrow strips, leaving peeling on. Place in large bowl and cover with water and ice cubes.  Leave for 3 hours, adding more ice if necessary.  Drain and pack upright into jars.  Add 1 or 2 onion slices and a stalk of celery.  Cover with syrup and seal.

name: AUTUMN SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onion
3 to 4  c. water
1  c. cut-up carrots (or more)
1  c. diced celery
1  c. cubed potatoes (or more)
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. bottled brown bouquet sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  bay leaf
1/8  tsp. basil
6 tomatoes, peeled and chopped or 28  oz. canned tomatoes with juice
preparation: In a large pot, cook ground beef; drain fat.  Cook onions with meat until tender.  Stir in remaining ingredients; heat to boiling.  Cover, reduce heat and simmer until tender.  Serves 6.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger or ground chuck
1  onion
1  green pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
1 small  can sliced mushrooms
1 small  can tomatoes
1 small  can tomato sauce
preparation: Cook 1/2 package egg noodles.  Drain and put in bottom of deep baking dish.  Cook crumbled hamburger until brown.  Add onion, green pepper, 1/2 cup celery, mushrooms and tomatoes (chopped). Use 1/2 package of Sloppy Joes mix and 1 small can tomato sauce. Dash 3 or 4 teaspoons tomato catsup in; salt and pepper.  Cook until thick and pour over noodles.  Put some strips of cheese over this and put in oven at 350° until cheese melts.

name: PINEAPPLE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
pinch of salt
1/2  lb. marshmallows
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1/2  c. pecans
1  c. grapes
preparation: Put pineapple and juice in pan and heat.  Add beaten eggs, flour and sugar; cook 5 minutes.  Let cool.  Later, add marshmallows, chopped nuts and halved grapes.  Thin with whipped cream.

name: NUTTY WILD RICE
ingredients:
1  c. pecans, chopped
1/4  c. butter
3  stalks celery, sliced
3 to 4  c. cooked wild rice
2 to 3  Tbsp. parsley, chopped
1  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: In skillet, sauté pecans in butter until lightly toasted. Add celery and sauté about 3 minutes longer. Add rice, parsley and garlic salt. Cook until heated through, stirring constantly.

name: APRICOT CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) pkg cream cheese, softened
16  to 20 dried apricots, cut up
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. apricot preserves
chopped nuts
preparation: Mix first five ingredients together. Push into ball shape in bowl with wooden spoon. Refrigerate for 20 to 30 minutes, enough to stiffen slightly. Roll in chopped nuts.

name: NO COOK COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. evaporated milk
3  c. oatmeal
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix margarine, sugar, cocoa and milk.  Heat to a boil for one minute.  Add oats, peanut butter and vanilla.  Mix well and drop on wax paper.

name: FLUFFY FROSTING
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. Crisco solid
1/4  c. butter
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook milk and flour until paste over medium heat.  Set aside to cool.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3/4  c. diced green pepper (optional)
3  c. sliced celery (optional)
1  c. onion (optional)
1/4  c. butter
3  cans condensed mushroom soup (2 cans will be enough)
1 1/2  c. milk
3  c. shredded cheese (I use American, you can use what you like)
18  oz. pkg. medium size noodles, cooked and drained
1 (9 1/4 oz.)  can tuna in water (I use 2 to 3 cans, depending on how much meat you want)
1 1/2  Tbsp. mayo (optional)
3/4  c. chopped pimento (optional)
preparation: I mix a can of early June peas in with mine, sometimes green beans.

name: COLD CRABMEAT DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
1  stalk celery, chopped finely
1  lb. crabmeat, chopped
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
dash of red pepper
preparation: Blend all ingredients together.  Serve with crackers of your choice.

name: BEST EVER BROWNING SAUCE AND MARINADE
ingredients:
1  c. soy sauce
2  large onions, coarsely chopped
2  Tbsp. bottled chopped garlic in oil
1/4  c. browning sauce
2  tsp. Beau Monde seasoning
preparation: Combine ingredients and chop in blender.  Store in jar in refrigerator.  Keeps indefinitely.  Wonderful painted on steaks, chops, hamburgers and roasts before cooking.

name: COMPANY BAKED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
4  medium pork chops
4  medium potatoes
2  medium onions
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Place pork chops in a 9 x 13-inch pan and season with salt and pepper.  Sprinkle 1/2 cup of Cheddar cheese over pork chops. Slice a layer of onions, then a layer of potatoes, then season with salt and pepper.  Put the can of mushroom soup over potatoes and onions.  Then sprinkle the rest of the grated cheese over the soup.  Cover pan and bake at 350° for 2 hours.  Makes 4 servings.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  Butter Recipe yellow cake mix
4  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1  can mandarin oranges
preparation: Mix all ingredients together (including juice from oranges). Mix for 2 minutes.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cake will be kind of soft set.

name: CHAMPAGNE SALAD
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  (10 oz.) frozen strawberries with juice
4  bananas, diced
1  (12 oz.)  Cool Whip
preparation: Cream together the cream cheese and sugar.  Add pineapple, strawberries and bananas.  Mix together, then add 1 (12 ounce) Cool Whip.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan; freeze overnight.  Take out 1/2 hour before serving.  Cut into squares.  Enjoy.

name: CARROTS LYONNAISE
ingredients:
1  pound medium carrots (about 6)
1 chicken bouillon cube dissolved in 1/2  cup boiling water
1/4  cup butter or margarine
3  medium onions, sliced
1  Tbsp. all purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
Dash of pepper
3/4  cup water
preparation: Pare and cut carrots into julienne strips. Cook in bouillon, covered, for 10 minutes. Melt butter. Add onions and cook, covered, for 15 minutes. Stir occasionally. Stir in next 4 ingredients. Bring to boil. Add carrots and stock. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Add pinch of sugar. Serve.

name: CREAMY CHICKEN RICE
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can water (fill soup can)
1  can Minute rice (fill soup can)
preparation: Combine soup and water; whisk together.  Bring to a boil. Take off heat; add rice.  Let stand 10 minutes; serve.  Can be made over campfire.

name: SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  boxes frozen spinach, drained
2  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. oleo, cubed
1 1/2  c. American cheese, cubed
3  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Cook in crock-pot on low for 4 to 5 hours or on high for 1 hour.

name: VANILLA CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. Crisco shortening
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
3/4  c. cocoa
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
10  oz. pkg. vanilla chips (1 2/3 c.)
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In large bowl, cream Crisco and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla.  Combine flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt and gradually blend into creamed mixture.  Stir in chips and drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.   Bake 8 or 9 minutes.  Cool slightly.  Remove from cookie sheet.  Makes about 4 dozen.

name: HARDTACK CANDY
ingredients:
3  c. white sugar
1  c. white syrup
1 1/2  c. water
flavoring
coloring
confectioners sugar
preparation: Boil first 3 ingredients until hard crack or 300°.  Add flavoring and coloring and pour out on confectioners sugar.   Roll into strings thin enough to cut with scissors.  Work quickly to prevent hardening.

name: LIME-PINEAPPLE PUNCH
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. sugar
4 1/2  qt. water
3  pkg. lime Kool-Aid
1  can pineapple juice
ginger ale
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except ginger ale.  Add 1 bottle ginger ale for each quart of punch.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  c. finely cut onion
3  Tbsp. shortening
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. leftover mashed potatoes
2 1/2  c. Pet milk
3/4  c. grated American cheese
preparation: Cook onion in shortening slowly until yellow.  Blend in flour, salt and pepper.    Stir in water.  Boil and stir 2 minutes.  Add and mix mashed potatoes until smooth.  Stir in Pet milk.  Add grated cheese.  Heat slowly until cheese melts.  Do not boil. Serve hot.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  bushel tomatoes
3  lb. onions or 6 c. chopped
2  or 3 hot peppers
1/2  c. salt
2  c. Wesson oil
6  bay leaves
4 (12 oz.)  cans tomato paste
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. basil
2  Tbsp. parsley
2  garlic bulbs
preparation: Cook tomatoes, chopped onion and peppers for 1 hour.  Run through blender.  Add all the other ingredients and cook another hour.

name: ONION ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. red potatoes, cut into 1-inch chunks
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1  envelope dry onion soup mix
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a large plastic bag; shake until well coated.  Empty bag into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Cover and bake at 350° for 35 minutes, stirring occasionally. Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer, until potatoes are brown and tender.  Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

name: FRITO PIE
ingredients:
1  large ground beef
1 (1 1/2 oz.)  pkg. chili mix
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 tomato sauce  can of water
1  large regular size Frito corn chips
1  lb. medium cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Brown ground beef in skillet and drain; add package of chili mix and stir well. Add tomato sauce and water. Cook over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Stirring occasionally. Pour corn chips into a 9x9x2 inch baking dish. Cover corn chips with meat mixture and top with grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until cheeses melts.

name: CARROT SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. carrots
1/2  c. golden raisins
1 (15 oz.)  can pineapple, drained
1  (8 oz.) container yogurt (pina colada)
preparation: Scrape carrots and grate in food processor.  Add raisins and pineapple.  Mix with yogurt.

name: SOUTHWESTERN SQUASH CASSEROLE(Calabacitas)
ingredients:
4  small zucchini, sliced
1  medium onion, sliced
1  tsp. minced garlic
1 1/2  tbsp. olive oil
1/2  c. sharp cheddar, grated
1/2  c. Monterey Jack, grated
1 1/2  c. white corn (fresh, frozen, or canned)
1/2  c. canned mild green chilies, diced
preparation: Sauté the zucchini, onion, and garlic in the oil until just soft.  Mix together all ingredients and put in an oiled casserole dish.  Bake in a pre-heated 375 degree oven.  Cook for 20-25 minutes or until top begins to brown.  Serves 4-6.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
20  oz. bag Oreo cookies
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1 large  box instant vanilla pudding
3  c. milk
1/2  stick margarine
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Break up cookies; place in blender until dirt like.  Set aside.

name: SWEET POTATO BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1/3  c. shortening
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. cooked sweet potatoes, mashed
3/4  c. buttermilk
preparation: Sift flour.  Cut or mix in shortening.  Add sugar and sweet potatoes.  Stir in buttermilk.  Use a little more flour if necessary to make a stiff dough.  Toss dough on floured board and knead lightly.  Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness.  Cut with floured cutter or roll out with hands.   Bake at 450° until golden brown. Butter biscuits while warm and serve.

name: AVOCADO MAGNIFICENT
ingredients:
1  avocado, cubed
1  tomato, diced
1  lime
Garlic salt
preparation: Place cubed avocado and diced tomato in a bowl.  Squeeze lime juice over mixture.  Lightly salt with 2 dashes of garlic salt. Blend well.  Serve with garlic pita chips.  Serves 2.

name: CHICKEN QUESADILLAS OLE
ingredients:
1  c. cooked chicken
green peppers, onions, mushrooms
Monterey cheese, shredded
flour tortilla shells
preparation: Saute peppers, onions and mushrooms in butter until tender. Place some pepper mixture on flour shell.  Sprinkle with cheese. Fold in half; secure with toothpick.   Place in a hot buttered skillet; heat until golden brown on both sides.  Serve hot with sour cream and salsa.  This recipe is great with leftovers or can increase to feed many.

name: EGG-SAUSAGE BRUNCH
ingredients:
7  slices bread with crust removed.
1  lb. sausage, browned and drained
3/4  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
6  eggs
2-1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Put cubed bread in a greased 9 x 13 baking dish and spread browned and drained sausage over bread cubes, then put cheese over top.  Beat eggs with milk and dry mustard.  Pour this over sausage, bread and cheese.  Cover with saran wrap and refrigerate overnight.  Next morning mix 1 can cream of mushroom soup with 1/2 cup of milk.  Pour over other ingredients.  Garnish with mushrooms and bake approximately 1-1/2 hours at 325°.

name: NO BAKE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. evaporated milk
10  oz. marshmallows, quartered
3  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
3  c. graham cracker crumbs
3/4  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In heavy saucepan, add milk, marshmallows, chocolate, sugar and salt.  Bring to full rolling boil over medium heat, stirring continuously.  Boil for 5 minutes.  Continue stirring.  Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients.  Spread in buttered 9-inch square pan.  Chill until firm.  To cut, use knife dipped in hot water.

name: CARAMEL TOPPING
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla (little less)
1/2  jar caramel topping
preparation: Mix together and serve with apple slices or pineapple slices.

name: CASTLETON TUNA MAC SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans tuna in water, drained and flaked
2/3  lb. small elbow macaroni, cooked
1  can Del Monte peas, drained
2  Tbsp. chopped red onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
dash of seasoned salt or to taste
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. plain yogurt
preparation: Mix tuna, macaroni, peas, onion, celery and salt.  Mix mayonnaise and yogurt.  Stir into tuna mixture.

name: BARBECUE
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped fine
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. ketchup
3  Tbsp. white vinegar
1  Tbsp. mustard
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. chili powder
1/4  c. water
beef roast or stew beef
preparation: Cook onions and margarine for 5 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients (mix together these ingredients before adding to onions and margarine).  Simmer for 10 minutes.  Double recipe if using large roast or large amount stew beef.  Cook stew beef or roast in crock-pot.  Remove and cut into bite size pieces.  Put meat into barbecue sauce.

name: PLAIN CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1/2  c. shortening
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. coconut (optional)
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter and shortening together; add sugar.  Cream with shortening until blended.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Sift flour and baking powder.  Add coconut and mix.  Mix into preceding, alternating flour and milk until all used.  Add vanilla.  Bake in angel cake pan, greased and floured, at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: DOVE FEAST
ingredients:
apples, unpeeled and diced
onions, diced
celery, diced
dove breast
margarine
preparation: Cut up meat and coat in a mixture of flour, ginger, salt and pepper.  Brown on all sides in hot oil.  Put browned meat in a large covered casserole dish.  Add 3/4 cup hot water.  Cover and put in 325° oven for 2 hours.

name: OLD FASHIONED SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  c. milk
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
4  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together sugar,  shortening  and	eggs.  Sift dry ingredients.  Roll dough, cut and sprinkle lightly with sugar.

name: FIVE-MINUTE FUDGE
ingredients:
2/3  c. evaporated milk
1 2/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1 1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine evaporated milk, sugar and salt in medium saucepan. Heat over high heat to boiling, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat and continue to boil for five minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in nuts, chocolate chips, marshmallows and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into buttered baking pan. Cool completely. Cut into squares.

name: SOUTHERN PARMESAN FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. pepper (black)
1  c. bread crumbs
2  c. Parmesan cheese
2  to 4 eggs (depending on how much chicken)
preparation: Add and mix all dry ingredients together.  Beat eggs and add some milk.  Dip chicken in egg and milk, then cover with dry mixture.  Redip in egg and milk mixture and then cover again with dry mixture.  Fry chicken in oil on stove and cook until done. Serve with vegetable of choice.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  head broccoli, cut up small
1  c. chopped celery
1  bunch green onions, chopped
1  c. Cheddar cheese, cut in small cubes
6  strips fried, crumbled bacon
1  c. sliced water chestnuts (optional)
cauliflower, cut up small (optional)
1/2  c. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix all 3 ingredients together.

name: EASY FETTUCINI(Very Delicious And Easy!!)
ingredients:
1/2  lb. fettucini, cooked al dente
2  shallots, chopped
1  Tbsp. butter
1  c. chicken broth
1/2  c. heavy cream
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. grated Parmesan
2  Tbsp. fresh chives
preparation: While your pasta is cooking, saute the shallots in butter for about 2 to 3 minutes.  Now stir in the chicken broth.  Boil gently for about 3 minutes.  Remove from the heat and stir in the heavy cream.  By this time the pasta should be ready to be drained.  The last step is to add the drained pasta, sour cream, cheese and chives.  Toss and heat through but don't boil.  Go get a nice glass of wine and mangia!!

name: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. water
2 1/2  c. sugar
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  can water
6  bananas, sliced
1  jar maraschino cherries
preparation: Bring water, sugar and orange juice to a boil.  Add all other ingredients.  Pour in pan and freeze.  Take out 1 hour before you want to serve.

name: BUSY DAY LEMON CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. whole milk
1  pkg. lemon instant pudding
9-inch graham cracker crust
preparation: Stir cream cheese until very soft; blend in 1/2 cup milk.  Add remaining milk and pudding mix.  Beat slowly until well mixed (about 1 minute).  Pour at once into graham cracker crust. Sprinkle crumbs lightly over top.  Chill 1 hour.

name: BISCUIT PUDDING
ingredients:
5  medium-sized biscuits
1  c. sugar
2  c. milk (sweet)
3/4  stick butter
3  eggs
preparation: Crumble  biscuits  together  and put in bowl.  Mix eggs and sugar.  Melt  butter;  pour in eggs.  Add milk.  Then pour in biscuit  crumbs  and  bake  at  350°  until  thick.  Do not overcook.

name: MRS. BRANDT'S CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1/2  c. dark brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs, separated
1  Tbsp. cold water
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. dark brown sugar, packed
6  oz. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Cream shortening and add sugars, blending until light.  Beat in egg yolks to which the cold water has been added.  Add vanilla.  Combine the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt and add gradually, beating after each addition.  Pat the dough into a 17 x 11-inch pan.  Beat egg whites until stiff.  Add 1 cup brown sugar gradually and beat until meringue is stiff and glossy.  Stir in chocolate chips and spread topping over the dough.  Bake 30 minutes.  Allow to stand 1 hour before cutting into squares.

name: CHOCOLATE DROP PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter
3  c. quick rolled oats
3  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Boil together for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes the margarine, cocoa and milk.  Remove from heat and add other ingredients.  Drop on waxed paper immediately and let set.

name: SIMPLE COUNTRY COLESLAW
ingredients:
1/3  c. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. sour cream
1  tsp. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vinegar
2  tsp. grated onion
1  tsp. mustard
1  large head cabbage
1  carrot, grated
preparation: Whisk all ingredients, except cabbage and carrot, together in a large mixing bowl.  Add cabbage and carrot.  Toss well to coat. Refrigerate 30 minutes to allow flavors to blend.

name: ROAST YOUNG STUFFED PIG
ingredients:
1  suckling pig (approximately 35 lb.)
3  stalks celery, chopped
3  medium-sized apples, coarsely chopped
2  pkg. stuffing mix and seasoning
2  medium-sized onions, chopped
2  c. long grain brown rice
2  sticks butter or margarine, melted
2  c. seedless raisins
1  medium bell pepper, chopped
1  small red apple (for garnish)
2  pkg. roasting skewers with nylon cord
preparation: Note:  Must use large commercial oven, 3 x 3-foot.

name: ALL-PURPOSE BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  (15 oz.) Hunt's tomato herb sauce
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients in saucepan.  Bring to boil.  Use basting.  Makes 2 1/2 cups sauce.

name: LARRY'S POT ROAST
ingredients:
4-5 lb. boneless chuck roast
1  can beer
1/2  Cup flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. Italian seasoning
3  Tbsp. shortening
1  Cup dry red wine
1  large onion, chopped
1  can campbell's golden mushroom soup
1  can campbell's beefy mushroom soup
1  package onion soup mix
2  cans water
1 7  oz. can mushrooms
preparation: Wash meat and pat dry.  Put in plastic bag with 1 can of beer and marinate overnight.  Remove from marinade and rub the roast with the flour, salt, pepper, garlic powder and italian seasoning. brown in shortening on all sides in roasting pan.  Make mixture of soups, wine, onion, onion soup mix, water and can of mushrooms. pour over the roast and simmer for 2-3 hours or until done in a 350 degree oven. remove the roast and add extra water if needed to make a gravy.  Good over mashed potatoes or noodles.  Serves 6-8.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
2 small  boxes instant chocolate pudding
2  envelopes Dream Whip
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
2  (9-inch) deep dish pie crusts, baked
Baker's chocolate, grated
1  tsp. instant coffee
preparation: Bake pie shells as directed; let cool.  In large bowl, combine the instant pudding, Dream Whip, milk and vanilla.  Mix with hand mixer.  Add instant coffee; mix.  Add Cool Whip, mixing thoroughly.  Pour into pie shells.  Top with grated chocolate and refrigerate.

name: BROCCOLI-CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
3  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. herb-seasoned crumb stuffing mix
1 (17 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1/2  tsp. onion salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
dash of paprika
preparation: Place broccoli in a shallow 1 quart microwavable dish.  Cover with a glass lid or plastic wrap, turning 1 edge back.  Microwave at 100% power for 4 to 5 minutes or until no longer icy, stirring after 2 minutes.  Drain well; set aside.  Microwave margarine in a 2-cup Pyrex bowl at 100% for 45 to 60 seconds or until melted. Stir in stuffing mix until well coated.  Stir the corn, 1/2 cup of the buttered stuffing mix, onion salt and pepper into the broccoli until well blended.  Microwave uncovered at 100% power for 3 minutes.  Stir, then sprinkle remaining stuffing mix over top and sprinkle with paprika.  Microwave at 100% power for 3 to 4 minutes or until heated.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. dark Karo
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. butter
3  eggs
1  Tbsp. flour
1  c. nuts (more or less)
preparation: Mix all together and bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. hamburger
1/2  lb. bacon
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. ketchup
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vinegar
dash of pepper
dash of celery salt
1 (No. 2)  can pork and beans
1 (No. 2)  can kidney beans
1 (No. 2)  can butter beans
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Brown hamburger and bacon.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix well and bake in a casserole dish at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SQUASH DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  yellow squash, sliced (about 3 c.) *
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  c. sour cream
2  c. herb seasoning stuffing mix
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. grated carrots
preparation: *Can use spaghetti squash or any variety of pumpkin squash.

name: PEPPER JELLY
ingredients:
6  medium peppers (2 c. juice)
3/4  c. cider vinegar
1  Tbsp. hot pepper sauce
1  pkg. Sure-Jell powder
3 1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Bring pepper juice, Sure-Jell, vinegar and hot sauce to a hard boil (boil that can't be stirred down).  Boil 1 minute, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat; continue to stir every 5 minutes or so until cool.  Pour into jars.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
3  qt. popcorn, popped
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. Karo light corn syrup
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Place popped corn in a large roasting pan.  In heavy 1-1/2 qt. sauce pan stir sugar, margarine, and corn syrup together. Stirring constantly, bring to a boil over medium heat.  Without stirring, boil 5 minutes.  Remove from heat, stir in vanilla and soda.  Pour over corn stirring to coat well.  Bake at 250 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes.

name: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2 large  cartons Cool Whip
1/2  pt. sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  jar maraschino cherries, drained
1 large  can pineapple tidbits or crushed pineapple, drained
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. pecans, chopped
5  bananas, mashed
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Put lemon juice over bananas.  Mix remaining ingredients together.  Put into container and freeze overnight.

name: CHICKEN POT PIES
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. ground sage
3/4  c. milk
3 chicken bouillon cubes or 3  tsp. instant bouillon
2  c. water or broth
3  c. cubed, cooked chicken or turkey
1 (2 oz.)  jar pimiento, drained (optional)
1/4  c. chopped fresh parsley
pastry for double-crust pie
preparation: Cook frozen vegetables according to package directions; drain. In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat; saute onion and mushrooms until tender.  Stir in flour, salt, pepper and sage. Combine milk, bouillon and water.  Slowly pour into saucepan, stirring constantly.  Cook and stir until mixture boils.  Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes.  Stir in chicken, pimiento and parsley. Spoon into 6 individual casseroles.  Roll and cut pastry into circles 1 inch smaller than top of casseroles.  Place atop filling.  Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes or until the crust is lightly browned.  Yields 6 servings.

name: TALLERINA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can corn (any style)
1  green pepper
1  pkg. egg noodles
1  can tomatoes
1  c. grated Cheddar
1  large onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: Cook beef in skillet until brown.  Add bell pepper and onion. Cook until tender.  Add chili powder, tomato and corn.  Cook 15 minutes.  Boil noodles as directed; drain.  Add meat mixture.

name: DRIED SWEET CORN
ingredients:
8  pt. corn, cut off cob
1/2  c. sweet cream
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. salt
preparation: Cook on top of stove on a low heat for 20 minutes or more. Stir often as this will stick and scorch very easily.  Put in dryer; stir often as it dries.  Store in freezer if kept for any length of time.

name: CHESS SQUARES
ingredients:
1  box powdered sugar
1  box yellow cake mix
4  eggs
1  stick butter, melted
1  oz. cream cheese
preparation: Beat cake  mix,  butter  and  1  egg.  Press into a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Mix cream cheese, 3 eggs and confectioners sugar  together  and  pour	over  crust.  Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. strawberry Kool-Aid
2  c. sugar
1  large frozen lemonade
1  large frozen orange juice
2  qt. water
1 large  can pineapple juice
1  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Mix in large container.  Makes 2 gallons.

name: EASY APPLESAUCE MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. corn flakes, crumbled
3/4  c. applesauce
salt and pepper
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  c. water
preparation: Mix beef, corn flakes, applesauce, salt and pepper.  Make fist size balls.  Mix catsup and water.

name: CHOCOLATE MAYONNAISE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  c. all-purpose flour
2/3  c. unsweetened cocoa
2 1/4  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  c. real mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. water
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Grease 2 (9 x 1 1/2-inch) layer pans.  Line bottoms with waxed paper.  Sift together dry ingredients into large bowl.  Stir in mayonnaise.  Gradually stir in water and vanilla until smooth and blended.  Pour into prepared pans.   Bake in oven at 350° (moderate) for about 30 minutes or until cake springs back when touched.  Cool completely.  Remove from pans.  Frost as desired.

name: CORN BREAD SALAD
ingredients:
1  pan cornbread
1  large bell pepper
1  medium grated onion
1  c. mayonnaise
8  slices bacon
3  boiled eggs
2  medium ripe tomatoes
preparation: Bake cornbread and set aside to cool.  Then crumble coarsely. Cook bacon crisp and cool.  Finely chop bell pepper.  Chop eggs. Grate or finely chop onion.  Crumble cooked bacon; add this to cornbread with 1 cup mayonnaise.  Gently add finely chopped tomatoes.  Mix well and refrigerate a few hours before serving.

name: YAM BALLS
ingredients:
1  can sweet potatoes or baked potatoes, mashed or cooked
1/3  c. brown sugar
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  bag large marshmallows
1  can coconut
preparation: Mash  potatoes;  add  brown  sugar and pineapple.  Roll potatoes  around  marshmallow and then roll in coconut.  Place in buttered dish.  Bake in oven for 20 minutes.

name: PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  c. milk
pinch of salt
2  tsp. sugar
few drops yellow food coloring
self-rising flour, sifted
preparation: Mix egg yolks, vegetable oil, milk, salt, sugar, food coloring and self-rising flour until batter is right consistency.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites to batter.  Cook in slightly buttered electric skillet.

name: LEMON DESSERT
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1  c. boiling water
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  pkg. Dream Whip, whipped
20  graham cracker halves
1/2  stick butter, melted
preparation: Line pan with a mixture of graham crackers and melted butter. (Keep some for crumbs on top of Jell-O.)  Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.  Combine crushed pineapple, sugar and lemon juice and bring to a boil.  Add to Jell-O and let congeal (not too stiff).  Add whipped Dream Whip.  Pour over graham mixture in pan and sprinkle with reserved graham crumbs.  Refrigerate for 2 hours.

name: SUPER EASY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1  can coconut or pecan frosting
preparation: Mix cake according to package directions.  Add and mix in frosting.  Bake in tube or Bundt pan at 350° for 1 hour.  (Also good, chocolate cake mix and cherry pie filling.)

name: HEAVENLY HASH
ingredients:
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. pineapple tidbits
1  c. mandarin oranges
1  c. coconut (Angel Flake)
1  c. sour cream or 1 c. cottage cheese or 1 c. Cool Whip
nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix together.  Cool before serving.

name: BAKED ZUCCHINI SQUASH
ingredients:
zucchini
sour cream
grated Cheddar cheese
seasoned salt
paprika
preparation: Cut zucchini into halves, lengthwise.  Scoop out seeds.  Line 8 x 11-inch baking pan with aluminum foil.  Place into zucchini halves pinch of seasoned salt, layer of sour cream and layer of grated Cheddar cheese on top.  Sprinkle paprika.  Place zucchini slices, side by side, in pan.  Bake at 325° for 30 to 40 minutes (until cheese melts).

name: "IRISH STEW" - STEAK SOUP(Serves 8 to 10)
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. flour
1/2  gal. water
2  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped carrot
1  c. drained, chopped tomatoes
1  Tbsp. McCormick beef flavor base
1/2  Tbsp. pepper
1  c. potatoes
1  c. green beans or peas or both
1  c. corn
preparation: Add more potatoes, if needed.  Add all ingredients to water mixture.  Bring to boil and then simmer for 1 or 2 hours.

name: MISSION FACT TREATS
ingredients:
1 small  jar peanut butter
1  jar marshmallow cream
graham cracker crumbs
preparation: Mix peanut butter and marshmallow cream in a bowl until smooth.  Roll dough into small balls.  Roll balls in graham cracker crumbs.  Place balls on waxed paper.  Stick toothpicks into the balls.

name: A LA GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  Tbsp. onion, finely chopped
4  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. lemon juice
1 (16 oz.)  can French-style green beans, drained
5  medium mushrooms, sliced
preparation: Using a medium saucepan, saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients.  Heat through and serve.  Makes 4 servings.

name: STIR-FRY CHICKEN AND BROCCOLI
ingredients:
2  chicken breasts, skinned, boned and thinly sliced
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
4  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. peanut oil
1/2  lb. broccoli, broken into small pieces
1  medium onion, sliced or chopped
1/4  lb. mushrooms, sliced
2  c. fresh bean sprouts
1  c. chicken broth
preparation: Place chicken, cornstarch and soy sauce in a bowl; stir until chicken is thoroughly coated.  Let stand 15 minutes.  Heat oil in wok over high heat.  Add chicken and stir-fry until browned. Remove chicken from wok.  Add broccoli and onion to wok; stir-fry 2 minutes.  Add mushrooms and bean sprouts.  Return chicken to pan.  Stir in chicken broth; cover and cook gently for 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.  Serve with rice.

name: RASPBERRY MERINGUE SQUARES* * * * *
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour, sifted
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. butter, softened
2  egg yolks
3/4  c. raspberry jam
1/2  c. sugar
4  egg whites
1 1/2  c. ground blanched almonds
preparation: A friend in Colorado, who is a wonderful cook, gave me this recipe.  It really is as good as it is pretty.  At the time, walnut oil was very hard to find, but now it is very common.  The bread should be sliced, buttered, wrapped in foil and heated through before serving.

name: BAKED CORN DISH
ingredients:
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can cream-style corn
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  stick butter
1  box Jiffy corn mix
2  eggs
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Melt butter.  Combine all ingredients and melted butter; mix together well.  Pour into a large baking dish.  Bake at 350° for one hour.

name: SCOTCH TEA TARTS
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
2  c. sifted flour
6  oz. cream cheese, softened
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. melted butter
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
chopped pecans
preparation: Mix butter, flour and cream cheese; chill for 30 minutes. Place a rounded teaspoonful of dough in each tart cup.  Press dough to bottom and sides with thumb.  Sprinkle each cup with chopped pecans.  Mix the brown sugar, eggs, melted butter, salt and vanilla together.  Spoon in the cups, over top of the pecans. Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN DIP
ingredients:
4  c. powdered sugar
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
2 (16 oz.)  cans pumpkin pie filling
1  tsp. ginger
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Combine sugar and cream cheese, beating until well blended. Beat in remaining ingredients.  Store in airtight container in refrigerator.  Serve with purchased gingersnap cookies.

name: PAN FRIED CHICKEN
