ingredients:
One 2-1/2 lb. frying chicken cut into serving pieces (6 - 8 pieces)
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. regular flour
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1-1/2 - 2  c. of Crisco or Crisco oil (for 10 inch pan)
preparation: Dip chicken pieces in milk, then shake in bag containing salt and pepper.

name: STEAK WITH HEARTY MUSTARD MARINADE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Dijon-style mustard
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. dry sherry wine
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. Tabasco pepper sauce
2  lb. round steak (1 1/2 inches thick)
preparation: In medium bowl, combine mustard, soy sauce, sherry wine, sugar, vegetable oil, garlic and Tabasco sauce; mix well.  Place steak in large shallow dish or plastic bag; add marinade.  Cover; refrigerate at least 5 hours; turn meat occasionally.  Remove meat from marinade; place on grill about 5 inches from source of heat. Brush with marinade.  Grill 15 minutes; turn meat and brush with marinade.  Grill 10 minutes longer or until desired doneness. Makes 8 servings.

name: BAKED ITALIAN POTATOES
ingredients:
4  potatoes (1 per serving)
Italian salad dressing (oil blend) not creamy.
preparation: Slice  potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through. Place in baking dish and fan slices slightly.  Pour salad dressing over potatoes.  Cover dish with saran wrap and microwave on high for 5 minutes.  Rotate potatoes, cover and cook on high for 5 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes, then microwave on high for another 4-6 minutes or until potatoes are soft when tested with a fork.

name: TACO SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. ground meat
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can green chilies
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  can pinto beans
2  c. water
1  pkg. Ranch dressing mix
1  can hominy, drained
3  cans stewed tomatoes
1  can kidney beans
preparation: Brown meat; drain.  Add onions and chilies.  Mix all together; heat and serve.

name: GRATED SWEET POTATO PUDDING
ingredients:
3  c. fine grated sweet potatoes
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Blend ingredients.  Bake at 350° until well done.  Straw comes out clean.

name: TEA COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. shortening
2/3  c. sugar
1  egg (unbeaten)
2 1/2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and shortening thoroughly. Add egg and blend well. Sift together flour and baking powder. Add with vanilla extract to first mixture; blend thoroughly. Drop mixture by tablespoonfuls on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in oven at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes, depending on thickness of cookie. If desired, press cookies with fork before baking.

name: CHICKEN KABOBS
ingredients:
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. unsweetened pineapple juice
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. garlic powder
2  tsp. ground ginger
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. green pepper
boned chicken breasts
green peppers
mushrooms
cherry tomatoes
onions
preparation: Combine soy sauce, pineapple juice, vegetable oil, sugar, garlic powder, ginger, mustard and pepper and bring to a boil. Simmer 5 minutes.  Cool.  Pour over 1-inch cubes of boned chicken breasts in a shallow dish.   Cover and marinate at least 1 hour. Skewer chicken and vegetables and grill, basting with marinade sauce.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2 1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. sour milk
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs
2  bananas, mashed
3/4  c. nut meats
preparation: Cream shortening. Add sugar and eggs.  Mix baking soda into sour milk.  Add to mixture.  Put salt and baking soda in flour and sift into batter.  Add bananas and nuts. Bake at 300° or 350° for about 1 hour.

name: WHITE CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. plain flour
4  tsp. baking powder
2  c. sugar
1  c. oleo
6  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sweet milk
preparation: Sift together flour and baking powder.	Beat egg whites until foamy  and	add 1/3 cup sugar.  Beat until stiff and set aside. Cream  oleo.  Add sugar gradually.	Add flour and milk alternately.  Add egg whites and vanilla.  Line 3 round 9-inch or two  10  x	6-inch	cake pans with waxed paper.  Grease and flour. Pour  batter  in  equally.  Smooth  it  and  break air bubbles. Bake at 325° about 30 minutes.  Cool on racks.

name: MARINATED TURKEY BREAST
ingredients:
1  (6 to 7 lb.) turkey breast, thawed
1  c. cider vinegar
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. salt
1/4  c. pepper
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
preparation: You will need a large Reynolds oven bag.  Rinse and pat dry turkey.  Place in bag in baking pan.  Pour over vinegar and oil. Then sprinkle spices over turkey.  Close bag and cut 4 small slits in top to vent.  Bake at 300° for 4 hours.

name: CHEESE PUDDING
ingredients:
6  slices toast
1/4  c. soft butter
2 1/2  c. milk
2 1/2  c. cheese
3  slightly beaten eggs
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Spread toast with butter and cut each slice in 4 pieces. Alternate layers of bread and cheese in greased baking dish, ending top layer with cheese.  Combine milk, eggs and seasonings to pour over bread and cheese.  Bake at 325 degrees for 40 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3  cans pork and beans
1  can tomato sauce
1  small onion, chopped
1  green bell pepper, chopped
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. mustard
preparation: Brown ground beef along with the chopped onion and bell pepper until the onion and pepper are tender.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can onion stock soup
enough water to rinse soup cans
1  c. rice
chicken pieces, skinned
preparation: Mix soups and rice in greased baking dish.  Add chicken pieces on top.  Sprinkle chicken pieces with paprika.  Bake 2 hours at 350°.  (Ovens vary; keep checking to make sure when chicken is done and that the rice is not becoming too dry.)  An extra can of mushrooms can be added if you like.

name: CHEESE SPREAD (SANDWICH)
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/2  lb. butter or oleo
5  to 6 eggs
1 (2 oz.)  jar pimentos
preparation: Melt cheese and butter in double boiler. Beat eggs well. Stir into melted cheese and butter, stirring constantly, until eggs are well cooked and thick. Add pimentos.

name: ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 small  cans asparagus tips
3  hard-boiled eggs
1 small  can Pet milk
1/2  lb. cheese
salt and pepper
cracker crumbs
butter
preparation: Drain asparagus and reserve juice.  Place in baking dish layer of asparagus, grated cheese, slices of eggs, cracker crumbs, salt, pepper and butter to taste.  Repeat until all ingredients have been used, leaving a layer of cheese on top.  Pour juice and milk over top and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: EASY CHINESE CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1  cucumber
1  bunch green onions
1  bunch Chinese parsley
1  c. unsalted peanuts
1  pkg. won ton chips
6  frozen boneless, skinless chicken thighs
1/2  bottle Tropics Oriental dressing
preparation: Cut lettuce and cucumber into bite-sized pieces.  Cut green onions into 1/2-inch pieces (separate green tops from white bottoms).  Cut Chinese parsley into 1/2-inch pieces (separate leaves from stems).  Completely cover chicken in pot with water. Add in white bottoms of green onions, stems of parsley and dash of salt.  Boil for 1/2 hour.  Remove chicken to cool.  Strain liquid to have clear chicken stock.  Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Put lettuce, cucumber, green onions, parsley, peanuts and chicken into large container.  Add Oriental dressing and toss completely so dressing is well spread.  Add won ton chips to top.  Serve.

name: CHEESY POTATOES
ingredients:
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. hash browns
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
2  c. corn flakes
2  sticks margarine or butter
preparation: Spread potatoes over 1 stick of melted butter or margarine. Mix sour cream, soup and cheese and pour over potatoes.  Melt 1 stick butter or margarine and add corn flakes.  Sprinkle on top. Bake one hour at 350°.

name: SALLY'S MOCHA SAUCE
ingredients:
1  can evaporated milk
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. instant coffee
4  sq. chocolate, grated
preparation: Put ingredients in fondue pot.  Stir until boiling point. Reduce heat and simmer gently for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Stir in 2 tablespoons rum.

name: OLD FASHIONED JELLY ROLL
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/4  c. cold water
3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp.salt
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking powder
jelly or jam
nuts
cream icing
preparation: Beat eggs until light. Add sugar and continue beating until fluffy. Add water and vanilla. Cream. Sift dry ingredients together and add gradually.  Pour batter in a 15 x 11-inch jelly roll pan lined with greased wax paper.  Bake in a 375° oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Turn out immediately on a tea towel which has been sprinkled with powdered sugar.  Cut off edges of cake and remove wax paper.  Spread liberally with jelly or jam and roll up.  Wrap with towel until cool.  Remove towel and spread with cream icing and garnish with nuts or cherries.  Yields 10 servings.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter, soft
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. vanilla flavor
2 1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Cream butter  and  peanut  butter; gradually add sugar, beating  well after  each  addition.  Add  eggs  and  vanilla, mixing well.  Combine flour, salt, soda and baking powder; add to peanut butter  mixture  and  mix  well.  Shape  dough  into 1-inch balls and  place  about  2	inches	apart  on ungreased baking sheets.  Press each  ball with fork.  Bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: LIME JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lime Jell-O (3 oz. pkg.)
1  c. hot water
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  c. small curd cottage cheese
1/2  c. celery, diced
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1  Tbsp. chopped olives
3  oz. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
a little sugar
preparation: Mix cream cheese with lemon juice and a little sugar.

name: NO PEEKIE STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. boneless beef stew, cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes
1  can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1  c. water
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In 3-quart casserole, combine stew meat, mushroom or chicken soup, onion soup mix and water.  Mix well. Cover; bake for 3 hours.

name: SAVORY FRESH MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
2  Tbsp. dry sherry
1  tsp. margarine
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. seasoned salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a large skillet.  Cover and cook over medium heat 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Yields 4 servings (about 43 calories per serving).

name: SOUR PICKLES
ingredients:
1  gal. vinegar
4  c. sugar
2  c. canning salt
preparation: Slice cucumbers. Place in pint jars. Pour cold water over them; seal. Put in refrigerator overnight. Next morning, drain water off. Bring to a boil all ingredients; pour over slices. Seal again. Ready to eat in 3 weeks.

name: MAMA'S IRISH POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
Irish potatoes
sharp Cheddar cheese (grated)
1 or 2  cans cream of chicken soup
preparation: Boil potatoes until tender (about 15 minutes).  Slice in medium slices and put 1 layer of potatoes in casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese over potatoes and pour cream of chicken soup over cheese, continue layers of potatoes, cheese and soup, as desired. Bake at 300° until lightly brown.  Serve hot.

name: PECAN BUTTER FINGERS
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix butter and sugar until creamy and fluffy.  Gradually mix in flour.  Stir in salt, vanilla and pecans.  Using a level tablespoon of dough, shape into 2-inch long fingers.  Place on an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 15 or 20 minutes or until light brown.  Remove from oven and cool completely.

name: BARBECUED STUFFED FISH
ingredients:
8 to 10  lb. fish (salmon, cod, snapper or lake trout), cleaned
salt
pepper
Garden Vegetable Stuffing (recipe follows)
salad oil
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
1/4  c. lemon juice
preparation: Wash fish quickly in cold water and pat dry.  Rub cavity with salt and pepper.  Stuff with Garden Vegetable Stuffing.  Close opening with skewers and lace with string.   Brush fish with salad oil.  Place fish in wire basket 4 to 6-inches from medium coals. Cook 45 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork, turning 3 times and basting with mixture of butter and lemon juice.

name: OVERNIGHT CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. cooked, diced chicken
2  c. elbow macaroni (uncooked)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 soup  can milk
1 soup  can chicken broth
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese, cubed
1  small onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Sprinkle 1 cup of buttered bread crumbs on top.  Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°; let stand 10 minutes before serving.

name: ORANGE APPLE ICE(Low Calorie)
ingredients:
1 (23 oz.)  Jar Regular Applesauce
1/3  Cup Orange Marmalade
3  Egg Whites Beaten Stiff
preparation: In medium bowl mix applesauce and marmalade.  Mix well. Carefully fold in egg whites.  Pour into 8 or 9 inch square pan. Cover and freeze until firm, Scoop frozen mixture into 5 oz. cups or dessert dishes.  Makes 12 - 1/2 Cup Servings, 1 Point.

name: ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 small  can asparagus
1 small  can English peas
1  can mushroom soup
1 scooping  Tbsp. mayonnaise
crushed cracker crumbs
preparation: Mix asparagus, peas, mushroom soup and mayonnaise and pour into a casserole dish.  Top with cracker crumbs and bake at 300° to 350° until bubbling (approximately 30 minutes).

name: MOM'S MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  c. molasses
1  c. buttermilk
2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon and 1 tsp. ginger (can be added)
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening.  Add 2 eggs and molasses. Alternate milk and next 4 ingredients.  Add more flour (enough to make dough firm enough to roll and cut).  Bake at 350°.  Watch closely as they burn easy.  Makes a large batch and works well for gingerbread boy cookies.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  oz. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
1  small onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2 (12 oz.)  pkg. grated cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. butter, melted
1  c. Ritz cracker crumbs
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In casserole dish, combine all ingredients, except butter and crackers.  Mix crackers and butter until well blended.  Sprinkle over top of macaroni mixture and bake until cheese is melted.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  pt. sour cream
2  medium green peppers, chopped fine
2  medium onions, chopped fine
2  medium tomatoes, chopped fine
1  pkg. Cheddar cheese
1  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1 or 2  pkg. nacho chips
8  oz. jar taco sauce
preparation: In a large bowl, combine cream cheese and sour cream; blend well.  Spread mixture into large serving platter.  Smooth taco sauce over mixture.  Next, layer green peppers, onions and tomatoes (black olives may be added also).  Cover veggies with cheese.  Garnish with nacho chips.

name: MICROWAVE PRALINES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
2/3  c. half and half
1/8  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  c. pecan halves
preparation: Combine sugar, half and half and salt in a deep 3-quart bowl. Mix well. Stir in butter. Microwave at High for 7 to 9 1/2 minutes or until mixture reaches soft-ball stage (235° on candy thermometer), stirring once after 3 minutes of cooking. Stir in pecans. Cool about 1 minute. Beat by hand with wooden spoon until mixture is creamy and begins to thicken, about 3 minutes. Drop by tablespoons onto waxed paper. Let stand until firm. Wrap in Saran Wrap when cool. Makes 2 dozen.

name: PISTACHIO MOUSSE
ingredients:
2  pkg. Jell-O instant pistachio pudding
1  large container Cool Whip
1 (16 oz.)  can pineapple in juice
preparation: Combine and blend all ingredients.  Refrigerate for a minimum of 2 hours to set.  Serve with grated almonds/nuts on top in large bowl.  Serves 4.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
2  c. plain corn meal
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. soda
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. chopped onion
preparation: Sift dry ingredients into a bowl. Add egg, water and milk. Mix well. Drop by tablespoonfuls into hot fat.  Fry until brown.

name: GWEN'S GREEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
3-4 lb. ground beef
2  cans green chilies
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. corn tortillas
10  oz. Mexican shredded cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Cook ground beef until no longer pink.  Drain liquid from beef.  Layer as you would lasagna. Beginning with beef mixture, tortillas, then cheese ending with cheese.  Cook for 30 minutes in 350 degree oven.

name: SOUR CREAM COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
3/4  c. dairy sour cream
2  c. (one-half 18 1/2 oz. pkg.) Pillsbury banana cake mix
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  pkg. Pillsbury coconut pecan or coconut almond frosting mix
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Generously grease and lightly flour an 8 or 9-inch square pan. In small mixing bowl, combine eggs and sour cream.  Add 2 cups dry cake mix.  Stir by hand until well combined.  Spread about half of the batter in prepared pan.  Sprinkle about 1 cup of dry frosting mix over batter in pan.  Repeat with remaining batter and frosting mix.  Dot with margarine.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes, until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Serve warm.

name: NO BAKE FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. mini marshmallows
1  c. Pet milk
1  c. sugar
1  lb. finely crushed graham crackers
1  lb. candied cherries
1/2  lb. candied pineapple
1  lb. raisins
1  lb. coconut
1  qt. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix together in a heavy saucepan the marshmallows, milk and sugar.  Boil until the mixture reaches a rolling boil; can boil slightly longer.  Let mixture cool slightly.  Place graham crackers in a large bowl and add the cherries, pineapple, raisins, coconut and pecans.  If desired, more nuts and fruit can be added.  Pour the marshmallow, milk and sugar mixture over these ingredients. Mix well.  Pour into Pyrex dishes and place in refrigerator.

name: COCOA PEBBLES GOODIES
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/3  c. creamy peanut butter (optional)
3  c. miniature marshmallows
3  c. Cocoa Pebbles cereal
preparation: Melt butter and peanut butter in saucepan, stirring frequently.  Add marshmallows and cereal.  Stir until marshmallows start to melt and stick to cereal.  Remove from heat.  Press mixture firmly into buttered 8-inch square pan.  Chill 1 hour. Cut into squares.  Store in cool place.  Makes 16 squares.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3 to 4  c. mashed sweet potatoes
1  c. chopped dates
1/4  c. butter or oleo
1/4  c. maple syrup
preparation: Saute chopped dates in oleo or butter about 2 minutes.  Add mashed potatoes and heat through.  Put mixture in a casserole. Smooth top and pour syrup over mixture.  Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: NO FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1 1/3  c. shortening
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. water
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix flour and salt together.  Cut in shortening.  Add the rest of the ingredients.  Stir with a fork until a ball forms.  Divide the dough in half.  Roll out on floured board; place into pie pans.  Bake at 350° until golden and flaky.  Makes 2 crusts.

name: BEETS AND HORSERADISH
ingredients:
3 (1 lb.)  cans small beets
5  oz. jar horseradish
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. sugar
salt to taste
preparation: Empty cans of beets; grate the beets.  Add horseradish, vinegar, sugar and salt.  Put in jars and refrigerate.  Serve with meat dishes.

name: CARAMEL BARS
ingredients:
14  oz. pkg. light caramels
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
3/4  tsp. soda
1/2  c. nuts
7 1/2  Tbsp. canned milk or half and half
1 1/2  c. quick oatmeal
1  c. margarine
pinch of salt
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Melt caramels in a heavy saucepan or in microwave with the cream.  Combine rest of ingredients, except chocolate chips and nuts.  Press 3/4 in greased 9 x 19-inch pan.  Bake 10 minutes. Then sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts.  Dribble the caramel mixture and then the remaining crumbs.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.  Cool before cutting.

name: CHIPPED BEEF DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1/3  c. sour cream
3  oz. chopped pressed beef
2  Tbsp. milk, add one at a time
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Use as a spread on crackers or Pepperidge Farm mini bread slices.

name: CLAN MORRISON RUM CAKE
ingredients:
1 or 2  qt. rum
1  c. butter
1  tsp. sugar
2  large eggs
1  c. dried fruit
baking powder
1  tsp. soda
lemon juice
brown sugar
nuts
preparation: Before you start, sample the rum to check for quality.  Good isn't it?  Now go ahead, select a large mixing bowl, measuring cup, etc.  Check the rum again, it might be just right.  To be sure rum is of the highest quality, pour one level cup of rum into a glass and drink it as fast as you can; repeat.  With an electric mixer, beat 1 cup of butter in a large fluffy bowl.  Add 1 seaspoon of sugar and beat again.  Meanwhile, make sure that the that the rum is of the finest quality.  Try another cup, open second quart if necessary.  Add 1 arge leggs, 2 cups fried druit and beat till high.  If druit gets stuck in beaters, just pry it loose with a drewscriber; sample the rum again.  Sift 1/2 pink of lemon juice, fold in chopped butter and strained nuts.  Add 1 bablespoon of brown thugar, or whatever color you can find.  W'as Mel. Grease over and turn cake pan to 350°.  Now pour the whole ness into the oven and ake.  Check the rum again and ho to ged.

name: MIMI'S PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
1  box brown sugar
2  c. granulated sugar
1  can evaporated milk
1/2  stick butter
1  c. marshmallow cream
1  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In large, heavy saucepan over medium heat, stir together sugars and evaporated milk.  Stir until it starts to boil, then don't stir while it cooks to soft ball stage.  Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla.  Add marshmallow cream and beat well.  Add peanut butter and beat quickly, it will start to set up quickly after peanut butter is added.  Pour into buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.  (Do not make this on a real rainy or humid day!)  When cool, cut in squares.  Store airtight.

name: STIR-FRY PEAS AND MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. peas
1/2  lb. mushrooms
1/2  tsp. salt
soy sauce
vegetable oil
1  onion
preparation: Mix peas, sliced mushrooms, salt and diced onions in wok or frypan with oil.  Add soy sauce to taste.  Fry and serve.

name: BROWNIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
2  c. sugar
2/3  c. butter
nuts
1/2  tsp. salt
4  eggs
4  chocolate squares
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Sift flour, baking powder and salt together.  Melt butter and chocolate.  Beat eggs and sugar; then add melted chocolate and flour mixture.  Then add vanilla and nuts, mix all together.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan for 25 minutes.

name: HAMBURG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck or round
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. medium noodles
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  bunch scallions or medium onion, grated
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1 large  clove garlic or garlic salt (optional)
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. salt
8  oz. grated American cheese
preparation: Take cream cheese out of refrigerator a few hours before to soften.  Cook noodles and set aside.  Put cream cheese together with sour cream.  Cook beef, onion, oregano, garlic and salt to taste.  Brown, then drain off grease.  After browning, add tomato sauce and simmer.  Layer in casserole noodles, meat and cream cheese.  Cover with grated cheese and bake 1/2 hour at 350° (1 hour if frozen).

name: SPOON BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. milk
3/4  c. yellow cornmeal
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  stick butter
4  eggs, separated
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Stir milk into cornmeal, sugar and salt in 2-quart saucepan. Cook over medium heat until thick as mush; remove from heat. Stir in butter. Beat egg yolks slightly. Mix some of the hot mixture to the eggs before stirring the eggs into saucepan, mixing well. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into cornmeal mixture. Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole "floured" with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes. Serve hot with butter. A truly Southern dish.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  medium onions, sliced
6  medium potatoes, sliced
salt to taste
1  can mushroom soup
1/4  c. water
6  large lean pork chops
preparation: In a casserole dish,  place alternately layers of onions and potatoes.  Sprinkle with salt.  Spread  half  soup over and add water.  Place chops on  top  and  spread  remaining soup on top. Sprinkle with salt.  Bake at 350° until chops are tender.

name: SWEET POTATO BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. sweet potatoes, mashed
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. shortening
3  c. flour
preparation: Wash, peel and cut up fresh sweet potatoes.  Cook until soft. Drain and mash.  (May freeze extra potatoes to be used later.)

name: SIMPLE POTATOES
ingredients:
1  pkg. hash brown squares, defrosted
1  can cream of chicken soup (or mushroom)
1  c. sour cream
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  green onions, chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients; place in baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour (salt and pepper may be added).

name: FAMILY RECIPE FOR MARINATED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. vinegar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. garlic
preparation: Mix and marinate pork chops for 2 to 4 hours.  Stir often. Cook on grill until done.  Very tender.

name: BEAN HOT DISH
ingredients:
1/4  lb. bacon, cubed
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. mustard
1 (15 oz.)  can lima beans
1 (15 oz.)  can butter beans
1 (15 oz.)  can kidney beans
1 (15 oz.)  can baked beans
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Brown bacon, ground beef and chopped onions in a frying pan. Mix all together; bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 350°.

name: LIGHTER PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  unbaked 9-inch deep-dish pie shell
3/4  c. granulated sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. salt
2  egg whites
1 3/4  c. (16 oz. can) solid pack pumpkin
1 1/2  c. (12 oz. can) evaporated skimmed milk
preparation: Prepare pie shell.  Heat oven to 425°.  Combine sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon, ginger and salt in small bowl.  Beat egg whites lightly in large bowl.  Stir in pumpkin and sugar mixture. Gradually stir in evaporated milk.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, lower temperature to 350° and bake 30 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

name: MILKY WAY ICE CREAM
ingredients:
6  Milky Way bars
1 tall  can evaporated milk
1 tall  can whole milk
1  can sweetened condensed milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Melt Milky Way bars in milk.  Mix with condensed milk.  Cool. Fold in Cool Whip.  Finish filling freezer with whole milk.  Makes 4 quarts.  Freeze in ice cream freezer until firm.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1/8  tsp. salt
3  eggs, well beaten
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  unbaked (9-inch) pie shell
preparation: Combine sugar,  flour  and  salt.  Blend  in eggs.  Add butter, buttermilk  and  vanilla; mix well.  Pour in shell and sprinkle with cinnamon.  Bake  at 350° for 35 minutes or until set.

name: AGAR AGAR SRIKAYA(A Cool, Refreshing, Typical Java Dessert)
ingredients:
1  pkg. Agar-Agar powder (contains 2 pkg.)
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. granulated sugar
2  c. coconut milk
3  c. water
pinch of salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients together and bring to a boil.  Pour into a 7 x 7-inch pan or dish.  Let cool in refrigerator until firm.  Cut and serve.

name: BAKED HALIBUT STRIPS
ingredients:
1  lb. halibut
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  c. grated cheese (any kind)
1  c. croutons (seasoned)
paprika
preparation: Cut  halibut  into  2  x  4-inch  strips.  Place garlic powder into  oil  and dip the halibut strips to coat.  Roll in grated cheese  and  seasoned croutons that have been crushed. Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 400°.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. Karo (white)
1  c. crunchy peanut butter
2  c. Cocoa Krispies
preparation: Bring sugar and Karo to boil, stirring.  Mix peanut butter and Cocoa Krispies together.  Add mixtures together.  Roll into balls. Dip in melted almond bark chocolate (this is optional).

name: Broccoli and Cheese
ingredients:
4  packages chopped frozen broccoli
16  ounces Velveeta cheese
2  sticks margarine
2  columns Ritz crackers
preparation: Cook broccoli per package directions.  Add Velveeta and 1 stick margarine to the broccoli.  Crumble crackers and mix with 1 stick melted margarine.  Spray 9x12 pan and pour broccoli and cheese on the bottom, top with crackers, and bake to warm at 350 for 15-20 minutes.

name: TURKEY PIE WITH CORNBREAD TOPPING
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 3/4  c. milk
1  c. cooked peas
1/3  c. cooked thin sliced carrots
1/4  c. chopped pimientos
1 1/2  c. diced cooked turkey
3/4  c. sifted flour
3/4  c. yellow cornmeal
2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. shortening
1  egg, slightly beaten
preparation: Combine soup, 1 cup milk, peas, carrots, pimiento and turkey in saucepan; heat through.  Pour into 2-quart baking dish. Combine flour, cornmeal, baking powder and salt; cut in shortening.  Mix egg and remaining milk; add to flour mixture. Mix well; pour over turkey mixture.  Bake at 425° for 25 minutes or until topping is golden brown.

name: CURRY DIP FOR VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. horseradish
1  tsp. curry powder
1  tsp. tarragon vinegar
1  tsp. grated onion
1  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients; chill.  Serve with celery sticks, carrot sticks, cauliflower, green peppers, etc.

name: MINT TEA
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. tea
1  bunch fresh mint (spearmint)
12  lemons (juice of)
3  c. sugar
1  qt. boiling water
6  oranges (juice of)
preparation: Pour boiling water over tea, sugar and mint; let cool. Strain, add fruit juices and enough water to make a gallon. Serve over crushed ice.

name: CARAMEL FROSTING
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1 1/4  stick margarine
1  c. evaporated milk
1  Tbsp. shortening
1/3  c. powdered sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Brown 3/4 cup sugar in iron skillet, add margarine and then 1 cup sugar, mix well and add milk. Bring to a boil and add remaining sugar. Let boil until soft ball forms in water. Remove from heat and beat with mixer for a few minutes, beating in powdered sugar, shortening and vanilla. Beat until spreading consistency. When cake is cool, spread onto layers. This will cover a 3 layer cake.

name: JUST LIKE FRESH COOKED GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
2  cans cut green beans
1  tsp. brown sugar
6  slices bacon
1  Tbsp. onion soup mix
preparation: Fry 6 slices of bacon.  Break bacon into pieces and set aside. Put beans, 3 tablespoons grease, onion soup mix and brown sugar into pan.  Boil 15 to 20 minutes.  Add bacon pieces.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. butter
1  doz. eggs
1  lb. sugar
4  oz. bottle vanilla
12  oz. good Port wine
3  lb. graham crackers, rolled fine
1  lb. seeded muscat raisins
1  lb. white raisins
1  lb. dates, chopped
1 1/2  lb. walnuts, chopped
1/2  lb. candied cherries
1/2  lb. candied pineapple
1/4  lb. candied orange peel
1/4  lb. candied lemon peel
preparation: Soak fruits overnight in the Port wine and vanilla.  In the morning, cream the butter and eggs and sugar; mix well.  Add the rest of the ingredients and mix very well.  Be sure to put a pan of boiling water on the floor of the oven to keep the cakes from drying out during the long baking time.  Line the pans with wax paper, greasing pan and paper and fill 3/4 full with the batter. Bake in 250° oven for 2 hours.  Let set in pans for ten minutes. Turn cakes out on racks and cool leaving the paper on.

name: LINGUINI SALAD
ingredients:
1  jar McCormick Salad Supreme
1 (16 oz.)  bottle Zesty Italian salad dressing
4  tomatoes, cubed
2  cucumbers, peeled and diced
1  small onion (1/2 onion)
1 small  bottle Parmesan cheese
1  box linguini noodles
preparation: Boil noodles and drain.  Cut up the tomatoes and cucumbers and add vegetables and juice to a bowl.  Add onions.  Add 1/2 jar of Salad Supreme and 1/2 jar of salad dressing and mix well.  Add noodles.  then add 1/2 jar of Salad Supreme and 1/2 jar of salad dressing. Mix well.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and let it set overnight.

name: TASTY CHEESE APPETIZERS
ingredients:
2  glasses Old English cheese spread
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  egg, beaten
1/4  lb. butter
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  loaf unsliced bread, cut in bite size chunks
preparation: Melt cheese and butter.  Add other ingredients (except bread) and blend thoroughly.  Dip each bread chunk in mixture.  Place on cookie sheet and refrigerate overnight or freezer for later baking. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: SUGAR BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  egg, well beaten
2  c. flour, sifted
1/2  c. plus 1 Tbsp. real butter
1 heaping  c. white sugar
1  Tbsp. cream
preparation: What You Need:  Mixing bowl, spoon, measuring cups and cookie sheet.

name: BREAKFAST SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage, brown and drain
5  eggs
1  tsp. salt
2  c. half and half
1  tsp. dry mustard
6  pieces buttered bread slices
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix eggs, salt, half and half and mustard.  Layer in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan:  bread slices, sausage, cheese and egg mixture.  Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: MARINATED ZUCCHINI SALAD
ingredients:
6  small zucchini, thinly sliced
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. diced celery
1/2  c. diced onion
1/2  c. diced red pepper
2/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. white wine vinegar
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Combine zucchini, green pepper, celery, onion and red pepper in a medium bowl.  Set aside.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. warm water
1  pkg. dry yeast
1 1/2  sticks melted margarine
1/4  c. sugar
1  egg
4  c. self-rising flour
preparation: Mix water and yeast; mix sugar and butter.  Combine all ingredients.  Put  into  airtight bowl in refrigerator.  Dough is better when good and cold or made the night before.  Grease muffin pan;  spoon  tablespoons of dough.  Bake at 350° until done.  Use large enough container for rising.

name: WHIPPING CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
6  large eggs
3  c. sugar
3  c. cake flour
2  sticks butter
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon
pinch of salt
preparation: Cream sugar and butter well.  Add eggs one at a time and cream well.  Add flour and cream alternately to creamed mixture.  Beat well.  Add vanilla and lemon.  Pour into a greased and floured 16 x 5-inch loaf cake pan or tube cake pan and bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.  Put in a cold oven.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
1  stick margarine
2 1/2  c. sweet potatoes
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Beat with a mixer until light and fluffy.  Pour into unbaked pie crust.  Cook at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can tomato soup
1  c. corn
2  c. noodles or macaroni
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger and drain.  Cook noodles.  Add noodles, corn and tomato soup with hamburger.  Put in baking dish.  Put cheese on top.  Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

name: SNOWBALL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. soft butter
1/2  c. powdered sugar
2  c. flour
3/4  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
extra powdered sugar to roll cookies in
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients together and roll into small balls. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.  Roll in extra powdered sugar while hot and again when cool.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. all-purpose flour
3  tsp. baking powder
3  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. vegetable shortening
1  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. lukewarm water
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Sift together into a mixing bowl, flour, baking powder, sugar, soda and salt.  Cut in shortening.  Dissolve yeast in water.  Add to flour mixture.  Then add buttermilk.  Work together with a large wooden spoon until flour is moistened.  Cover bowl.  Store in refrigerator until ready to use.  Roll out the amount to be used on a floured board to 1/2-inch thickness.  Cut out and put on greased cookie sheet.  Let rise for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  (I cover with a clean dish towel.)  Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.  This dough will keep for several weeks in refrigerator.

name: CHICKEN MARBELLA
ingredients:
4  chickens (2 1/2 lb. each), quartered
1  head garlic, finely chopped
1/4  c. dried oregano
coarse salt and pepper (freshly ground) to taste
1/2  c. red wine vinegar
1/2  c. olive oil
1  c. pitted prunes
1/2  c. pitted Spanish green olives
1/2  c. capers (optional)
6  bay leaves
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white wine
1/4  c. Italian parsley, finely chopped
preparation: In a large bowl, combine chicken quarters, garlic, oregano, pepper, salt, vinegar, olive oil, prunes, olives, capers and bay leaves. Cover and let marinate, refrigerated, overnight.  Preheat oven to 350°.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. bacon drippings
2  cloves garlic, minced
3  medium onions, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can pork and beans
1 (15 oz.)  can red kidney beans
1 (8 oz.)  can lima beans, drained
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
1/2  c. ketchup
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook onions and garlic in drippings.  Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into greased 2-quart casserole.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: CREAMY BAKED CARROTS
ingredients:
4  c. sliced, cooked carrots
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. butter, melted
1/2  c. ripe olives, chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1/4  c. onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
1/3  c. American cheese, grated
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except cheese. Bake in baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes or until hot and cheese is melted. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: PLAY DOUGH FOR CHILDREN
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. salt
1  c. water
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Heat together until ingredients form ball.  Add food coloring if desired.  Work it in until all is soft and pliable.  Keep tightly closed when not in use.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
1  pkg. egg noodles, cooked and drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
8  oz. sour cream
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
1 small  jar pimento, chopped
dash of Accent
preparation: Mix all ingredients and put in casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: FIRE HOUSE SPECIAL
ingredients:
macaroni and cheese, prepared according to box directions
cream of mushroom soup
tuna
peas
preparation: Combine ingredients in proportions in keeping with number to be served.  (One box and 1 can each for family of four; increase for more servings.)  Bake in casserole dish, or heat together on stove until heated through.

name: PATTY'S POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
4  c. chicken broth or 4 c. water 4 bouillon cubes
8  medium potatoes
4  medium carrots
1  tsp. parsley, chopped
1  tsp. salt (optional)
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. crushed red pepper
sprig parsley (garnish)
preparation: If using bouillon cubes, prepare as directed on package.  Dice potatoes and carrots; add to broth.  Add salt and pepper, if desired.  Boil 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender.  Add chopped parsley and crushed red pepper.  Using a mixer, blend for 1 minute.  Serve with a parsley garnish.

name: CHEESE FRENCH LOAF
ingredients:
3 to 4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. minced green onion
1/2  c. mayonnaise (add more if needed)
garlic powder
pepper
1  loaf French bread, sliced lengthwise
preparation: Mix together cheese and minced green onion.  Stir in enough mayonnaise to make mixture spreadable.  Season with garlic powder and pepper to taste.  Spread over each half of the bread to edges. Bake at 350° for 12 to 17 minutes until mixture bubbles.

name: COUNTRY STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak (3/4-inch thick)
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. water
preparation: Pound steak.  Cut into serving size pieces.  In skillet, brown steak in oil.  Pour off fat.  Stir in soup and water.   Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until done.  Stir often.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: FISH STEW
ingredients:
3  lbs. flounder filets
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  lb. bacon
1 - 8  oz. can tomato paste
1  bottle ketchup
1/2  oz. Tabasco sauce (1 Tbsp.)
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Fry bacon.  Remove from pan.  Brown onions in drippings. Place 3 c. water in large pot.  Bring to boil.  Pour onion and drippings into pot.  Add fish, Tabasco, Worcestershire and salt and pepper.  Cook until fish is done.  Add ketchup and tomato paste.  Cook 2 hours.  Serve over rice.

name: NEW MEXICAN POSOLE(A Christmas Traditional Soup)
ingredients:
1  lb. coarse ground beef
1  lb. coarse ground pork
1  (32 oz.) bag posole
3  Tbsp. New Mexican hot chili powder
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. oregano
1  Tbsp. saffron (optional)
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 small  can enchilada sauce
preparation: Add posole to water (rinse it first) and boil until it pops. Add meat and cook until tender.  Add spices and enchilada sauce. Simmer.

name: GREEK PASTA AND SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. shell pasta
1/2  lb. medium shrimp, peeled and cut into thirds
4  Tbsp. butter
4  Tbsp. olive oil
2  minced garlic cloves
2  tsp. oregano, crushed to release flavor
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. fresh ground pepper
1  c. crumbled Feta cheese
preparation: Cook pasta until al dente; drain and toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil.  In skillet, melt butter; add olive oil and garlic. Stir until garlic colors slightly.  Add shrimp, oregano, salt and pepper and cook until shrimp turns pink; remove from heat.  In large serving bowl, combine pasta and cheese.  Fold in shrimp mixture.  Let stand at room temperature to blend flavors.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. brown and white sugar, mixed
1/4  lb. butter or oleo
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  c. Rice Krispies
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
6  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix sugar and butter together until soft and smooth.  Beat in egg and vanilla.  Mix in other 4 ingredients and drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet.  Bake in a 350° oven for about 8 minutes.  Do not overcook.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  stick butter, melted
3 1/2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. flour
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
1/2  c. pecans
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, cocoa and salt together.   Add slightly beaten eggs, butter and vanilla.  Mix.  Add pecans and cook at 350° until done.

name: HOT TACO DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1 (16 oz.)  can chili with meat
diced green pepper
diced tomatoes
diced onions
12  oz. Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Line bottom of square glass pan with cream cheese.  In mixing bowl, combine chili with green peppers, tomatoes and onions. Pour onto cream cheese.  Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese on top. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.  Scoop up with taco chips.

name: UPSIDE-DOWN HAMBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1  Tbsp. oil
1  onion, chopped
3/4  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can Hunt's tomato sauce
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  c. Bisquick
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/2  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Brown meat in oil; drain.  Add onion, celery and green pepper; cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Stir in tomato sauce, salt, pepper and Worcestershire.  Make biscuit dough (add parsley and celery seed to flour if desired). Roll; make into biscuits or 1 eight-inch circle.  Place on hot meat.  Bake 15 minutes.  Remove from oven; let stand 5 minutes. Invert over hot serving plate.

name: CHINESE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  can Chinese noodles
1  c. peanuts
2  pkg. chocolate or caramel chips
preparation: Melt chips over hot water.  Add balance of ingredients.  Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper and cool.

name: CHICKEN BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. oil
2  c. vinegar
3  Tbsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
3  tsp. poultry seasoning
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Can be stored in refrigerator.  Makes enough for 10 chicken halves.

name: CREAMY PARMESAN DRESSING
ingredients:
1  Cup Best Foods Mayonnaise
1/4  Cup Milk
2  Tbsp. Cider Vinegar
2  Tbsp. Parmesan Cheese
preparation: Combine all ingredients until smooth. Cover & Chill. Makes 1 1/4 cups.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
6  boneless chicken breasts
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
4  Tbsp. margarine
6  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1/2  c. cream
1/2  c. and 3 Tbsp. white cooking wine
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Flour chicken and saute until brown.  Cook broccoli until unfrozen and separable.  Drain and set aside.  Melt margarine; add flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper.   Add broth and cook until thick.  Stir in cream and wine.  Place broccoli in shallow baking dish.  Pour half of sauce over this.  Next, put chicken in. To remaining sauce, add Parmesan cheese.  Pour remaining sauce over chicken and sprinkle with more cheese.  Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until lightly browned on top.  Very good!

name: PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
3/4  c. milk
3  eggs
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
1  box Duncan Hines butter cake mix
preparation: Beat all ingredients for 3 minutes.  Pour into 3 cake pans and bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: COUNTRY CLUB SALAD
ingredients:
2  heads romaine lettuce
4  strips crisp bacon, crumbled
2  hard-cooked eggs, diced
1  tomato, diced
1  avocado, diced
1  Italian red onion, sliced
2  (3 oz.) Roquefort cheese, crumbled
French dressing
preparation: Carefully wash and chill lettuce.  (Other greens may be substituted or  added.)  Tear into bite-size pieces in a large round salad bowl.  Arrange bacon, eggs, tomato, avocado, onion and cheese separately in pie-shaped sections over greens.  Add dressing just before serving.

name: CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP
ingredients:
chicken
2  stalks celery, chopped
5  c. diced potatoes
3  tsp. chicken bouillon
3  c. sliced carrots
1  onion, diced
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  lb. sour cream
1  can evaporated milk
12  oz. pkg. cooked egg noodles (dumpling noodles)
preparation: Boil  chicken  with just enough water to cover chicken. Debone and  cut  up  in  pieces.  Skim  off fat from broth and return cut up chicken to broth.  Add celery, potatoes, chicken bouillon, carrots  and onion to broth.  Cook until vegetables are tender. Then  add  soup,  sour cream, evaporated milk and egg noodles. Mix together.  Do not boil.

name: TOMATO SOUP:  THEME AND VARIATIONS
ingredients:
1  medium onion, diced
3  celery ribs, diced
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. tomato puree
1  Tbsp. sugar
5  c. tomato juice
1  Tbsp. salt
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Saute onion and celery in butter until light brown.  Add tomato puree and sugar.  Saute 1 minute.  Add tomato juice.  Simmer 8 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients.  Strain.  Serve as is either hot or well chilled.  Serves 6.

name: PICKLED GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
3  gal. green beans
1  gal. water
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. salt
1  c. vinegar
preparation: Boil 30 minutes.  Put in can and turn upside-down to seal.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. white Karo
1/2  c. hot water
2  c. raw peanuts
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Cook the first 3 ingredients until it makes a long thread, then add the raw peanuts and vanilla and cook until it turns a light brown and you can hear peanuts crackling.  It will be very stiff.  Add soda; stir well and pour onto buttered pans.  Will not hurt to stir after peanuts are added.

name: EASY BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
4  slices bacon
1  large onion, chopped (1 c.)
2 (16 oz.)  cans pork and beans in tomato sauce
3  Tbsp. molasses
1  tsp. prepared mustard
preparation: In a 2-quart saucepan, cook bacon until crisp; remove bacon. Drain off fat, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings in pan.  Cook onion in reserved drippings until onion is tender.  Crumble bacon. Stir bacon, pork and beans, molasses and mustard in saucepan with onion.  Bring to boiling.  Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, about 20 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: OUTBACK STEAKHOUSE COCONUT SHRIMP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. large raw shrimp
1/2  c. all purpose flour
1/2  c. cornstarch
1  T. salt
1/2  T. white pepper
2  T. vegetable oil
1  c. ice water
Vegetable oil for frying
2  c. unsweetened coconut, short shredded
preparation: Peel and devein shrimp. Dry well on paper towels and set aside. In a bowl, combine all dry ingredients for batter. Add 2 tablespoons of oil and ice water. Stir to blend.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 1/2  c. uncooked regular rice
2  tsp. salt
1  bay leaf
dash of red pepper
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1 (10 oz.)  can beef broth (undiluted)
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Cook garlic and celery in hot oil in a large kettle until tender.  Drain tomatoes, reserving juice.  Add enough hot water to tomato juice to equal 2 cups.  Combine tomatoes, tomato juice, tomato paste, rice, salt, bay leaf and red pepper.  Add to garlic and celery mixture; stir well.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.  Remove bay leaf.  Cook ground beef and green pepper until beef is browned; drain.  Stir in chili powder, sugar and beef broth.  Combine rice and meat mixture. Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Yields 8 to 10 servings.

name: CHURCH EGGS
ingredients:
8  beaten eggs
1 scant  qt. milk
1  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  tsp. mustard
white bread with crusts removed
preparation: Cut bread into 1-inch squares and cover bottom of 6 x 9-inch cake pan.  Mix ingredients (minus bread) and pour over bread squares.  Bake in 350° oven for 20 minutes, or until center is dry.

name: FROZEN CORN
ingredients:
4  qt. corn (16 c.)
1/2  c. sugar
1  qt. water
preparation: Combine all; boil lightly for 10 minutes.  Cool, bag and freeze.

name: SCRUNCHIES
ingredients:
1  stick oleo, softened
1  box powdered sugar
1 (18 oz.)  jar crunchy peanut butter
3 1/2  c. Rice Krispies
4  (1 oz.) Hershey candy bars
6  oz. chocolate chips
1/2  bar paraffin
preparation: Mix together the oleo, powdered sugar, peanut butter and Rice Krispies.  Form into balls and chill overnight.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
3  crushed bananas
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs.  Mix well.  Add soda, salt and flour.  Mix well.  Fold in bananas, walnuts and vanilla.

name: QUICK CARAMEL SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. butter (no substitutes)
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. fresh lemon juice
1 1/2  c. whipping cream
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over medium heat; add sugar and lemon juice, and cook, stirring constantly, 6 to 8 minutes or until mixture turns a deep caramel color.  Gradually add cream, and cook, stirring constantly, 1 to 2 minutes or until smooth. Remove from heat.

name: BLUEBERRY SUPREME
ingredients:
2  jars blueberry pie filling
1  envelope Dream Whip
5  c. cubed angel food cake
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Beat the cream cheese and sugar; add to prepared package of Dream Whip.  Mix well.  Grease glass bowl.  Place a layer of cubed cake on bottom of bowl.  Spread half of cream cheese mixture on cake.  Top with half of the blueberry filling.  Repeat layers again.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
30  oz. can pork and beans
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1 1/2  c. catsup
1/2  c. dark corn syrup
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
4  slices bacon
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain.  In large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients, except bacon.  Put ingredients into greased baking pan.  Place bacon on top.  Bake 40 minutes at 400°.

name: OREO COOKIE FREEZE
ingredients:
28  Oreo cookies, crumbled
1/4  c. melted margarine
1/2  gal. coffee ice cream, soft
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
6  Tbsp. margarine
1 small  can Pet milk
4  sq. semi-sweet chocolate
preparation: Mix the cookies and melted margarine.  Put in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish and freeze.  Add the ice cream to the crust and freeze. Bring to a boil the sugar, vanilla, margarine, milk and chocolate and boil for 1 minute. Add to the ice cream and re-freeze. Add Cool Whip and toasted almonds.  You can freeze Cool Whip but it is better to add almonds just before serving.

name: BERRY PUDDING
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. lard
1  c. milk
2 heaping  tsp. baking powder
2  c. flour
little salt
2  c. berries
preparation: Mix and bake at 350°.

name: MOM'S SHIPWRECK STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  c. potatoes, sliced
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. rice
1  can red kidney beans
1  can whole tomatoes, diced
1  can tomato sauce
1  can corn
preparation: Brown hamburger with sauteed onions.  Then layer ingredients. Cook 1 1/2 hours on top of stove on medium to low heat.

name: SPICE TEA
ingredients:
2  c. Tang
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. instant tea
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Serve hot.

name: COFFEE ICE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. instant coffee
1  pt. vanilla ice cream, softened
4  oz. Cool Whip, thawed
1  baked graham cracker crust
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Brush beaten egg white onto crust and bake at 375° about 5 minutes sealing the bottom of crust.  Cool.  Dissolve coffee in warm water until clear and cool.  Blend into soft ice cream, fold in the Cool Whip.  Fill and freeze.  May be garnished with strawberries.

name: APPLESAUCE
ingredients:
8  large apples
1/2  c. water
3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Peel and cut up apples.  Put in saucepan with water and lemon juice.  Cover tightly and simmer until tender.  Add sugar and cook a few minutes longer.  (If you want smooth applesauce, put through strainer.)

name: BUTTERMILK BLUEBERRY MUFFIN
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. grated lemon peel
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  c. blueberries
1  c. nonfat vanilla yogurt
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: In a large bowl, combine the first 6 ingredients. Gently fold in blueberries. Combine yogurt and buttermilk. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened. Fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes. Yield: 1 dozen.

name: MOIST POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. butter
2 2/3  c. sugar
3 1/2  c. sifted cake flour
8  Tbsp. coffee cream
1 small  bottle lemon flavoring
8  medium size eggs
preparation: Separate eggs, whip the whites and add 6 tablespoons of the sugar.  Place this mixture in refrigerator until rest of cake is mixed.  Cream the butter; add gradually remainder of sugar and beat until light.  Add yolks 2 at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add flour and cream alternately; beat well.  Beat in egg whites and pour batter in greased, floured cake pans and bake 1 hour and 25 minutes at 300°.  Makes 2 medium size cakes.

name: CREAM PUFFS - ECLAIRS
ingredients:
1  c. boiling water
1  stick margarine
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. flour
4  eggs
preparation: Add margarine to boiling water.  When margarine is melted, add the flour and salt together to the liquid mixture.  Stir, it will form into a ball.  Keep stirring and continue to cook for 2 minutes.  Take off stove and cool slightly, about 5 minutes.  Add 1 egg at a time, beating thoroughly between each one.

name: WHITE SAUCE(Medium)
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan over low heat.  Blend in flour, salt and dash of pepper.  Add milk all at once.  Cook quickly, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and bubbles (a wire whisk works well).  Remove sauce from heat when it bubbles.  Add cheeses or other flavorings at this point.

name: TOASTY EGG
ingredients:
1  slice bread
1  egg
butter
salt
pepper
preparation: Take 1 slice of any bread you like.  Take piece about size of half dollar from center of bread.  Butter both sides and place in skillet.  Cook and turn to slightly brown both sides.  Break egg into hole in center of bread.  Fry, turning over until approximately "over easy."  Salt and pepper both sides to taste.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. broccoli, cooked for 5 minutes and drained
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. grated cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  Tbsp. minced onion
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE AND PEANUT BUTTER CHEESECAKES
ingredients:
3/4  c. chocolate covered graham crackers made into crumbs
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
1/2  c. chocolate chips, melted
1/3  c. peanut butter
preparation: Line muffin tins with paper liners.  Put 1 tablespoon crumbs in bottom of each paper.  In small bowl, beat cream cheese.  Add sugar and vanilla; beat until fluffy.  Beat in milk, then beat in eggs.  Divide mix in half.  Stir one half into melted chocolate. Repeat with peanut butter.  Put 2 tablespoons peanut butter mix in each cup.  Top with 2 tablespoons chocolate mix.

name: OLD FASHIONED CREAM PIE
ingredients:
2  unbaked pastry shells (9-inch)
2 2/3  c. sugar
1  c. sifted flour
1  pt. whipping cream
1 1/2  c. whole milk
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
1  stick butter
nutmeg
preparation: Mix together sugar and flour.  Add cream, milk, vanilla and salt.  Blend with mixer and pour into pastry shells.  Melt butter and dribble over top.  Sprinkle with nutmeg.  Bake 10 minutes at 425°.  Reduce to 350° and bake 50 minutes.

name: MAPLE PECAN CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs, separated
1/2  c. sugar
2 1/4  c. sifted cake flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1/3  c. oil
1  c. skim milk
1  tsp. maple flavoring
1/2  c. finely chopped pecans
preparation: Beat egg whites until frothy.  Gradually beat in white sugar until stiff and glossy.  Stir flour, baking powder and salt into another mixing bowl.  Add brown sugar, oil and half  of milk. Beat 1 minute on medium speed.  Add remaining milk, egg yolks and flavoring.  Beat 1 minute more.  Fold in egg whites and pecans. Bake in greased and floured pans at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes for two 8-inch layers or 30 to 35 minutes for oblong 13 x 9 1/2-inch pan.

name: EILEEN'S CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1  bunch broccoli
1  can cream of celery soup
1 1/2  cans water
4  oz. Stove Top stuffing
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
4  oz. mild Cheddar cheese
preparation: Clean chicken; set aside.  In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, empty the can of cream of celery soup and add 1 1/2 cans of water plus salt and pepper.  Mix well.  Add the stuffing mix; stir until the stuffing is even in the dish.  Add only the heads of the broccoli to the mixture.  Add the chicken to the dish.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes, or until chicken is done.  Remove the dish; sprinkle the grated Cheddar cheese on top.  Return to the oven for 10 minutes, or until the cheese has melted.

name: REUBEN SPREAD
ingredients:
4  pkg. corned beef, chopped
1  can chopped sauerkraut
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  c. black olives, sliced
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. grated Swiss cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. grated American cheese
1/4  c. mayonnaise, to moisten
preparation: Combine all ingredients. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve with party rye or crackers. Makes about a 2-quart casserole.

name: OATMEAL SCOTCHIES
ingredients:
1  c. (2 sticks) margarine, softened
3/4  c. granulated sugar
3/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla or 2 tsp. grated orange peel
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
3  c. quick or old fashioned uncooked oats
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch flavored morsels
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Beat margarine, sugar, eggs and vanilla until creamy.  Gradually add combined flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon; mix well.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Drop by level measuring tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 7 to 8 minutes for a chewy cookie or 9 to 10 minutes for a crisp cookie. Cool 2 minutes on cookie sheet and remove to wire rack.  Cool completely.

name: CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  egg, beaten
1  stick margarine
preparation: Mix to ball.  Spread in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 350°.

name: PISTACHIO SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple and juice
1  box sugar-free pistachio instant pudding
1 (8 oz.)  carton lite Cool Whip
1 (8 oz.)  carton fat free vanilla yogurt
1  c. miniature marshmallows
crushed nuts (optional)
preparation: Stir together pineapple and pudding mix.  Then add next three ingredients.  Sprinkle with crushed nuts.  Refrigerate and enjoy. Lo-cal and low-fat.

name: HERBED CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  whole chicken breasts
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. melted margarine
8  oz. pkg. herb seasoned stuffing mix
2  c. chicken broth
preparation: Stew chicken breasts and cool.  Reserve 2 cups chicken broth; remove chicken from bone and tear chicken into bite-size pieces. Place meat in shallow 3-quart baking dish.  Combine soups and 1 cup broth; pour over chicken.  Mix butter and remaining cup of broth; stir in stuffing mix.  Spoon over chicken.  Bake in 400° oven for 30 minutes.

name: COCONUT MACAROONS
ingredients:
2  2/3  c. (7 oz.) coconut
2/3   c. sugar
6  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
4  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Heat oven to 325. Mix coconut, sugar, flour, and salt in a large mixing bowl. Stir in beaten egg whites and vanilla until well blended. Drop by spoonful onto greased cookie sheets. Bake 20 minutes or until edges of cookies are golden brown. Remove from cookie sheets. Makes about 3 dozen.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  cube butter, softened
1  (8 oz.) cube cream cheese, softened
1  cube butter (soft)
2  eggs
2  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
4  to 5 bananas, sliced
1  large Cool Whip
nuts
maraschino cherry halves
strawberries, sliced
2 to 4  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix graham cracker crumbs and 1 cube butter together.  Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Don't bake.

name: FRUIT SMOOTHIE
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can orange juice concentrate
1 large ripe banana, sliced or 1 1/2  c. fresh or frozen strawberries or 1 1/2 c. fresh or frozen or drained canned peaches
1  c. skim milk
1  c. water
2  Tbsp. honey
5  ice cubes
preparation: Combine juice concentrate, fruit, milk, water and honey in a blender. Blend at high speed until thick and smooth, about 1 minute. Add ice cubes, one at a time, and blend until smooth and frothy. Garnish with a whole strawberry if you wish. Yield: 5 servings.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CUPS
ingredients:
1  c. margarine, softened
1 1/2  c. peanut butter
1  lb. powdered sugar
2  c. crushed graham crackers
2  c. melted chocolate chips
preparation: Mix margarine, peanut butter, powdered sugar and graham crackers.  Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pour chips over top and chill.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
20  qt. box powdered milk
2 (1 lb.)  cans instant chocolate
22  oz. jar powdered creamer
2  lb. bag powdered sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients in large container. For a cup of hot chocolate, put 1/3 cup of mix and 2/3 cup hot water in a mug. Makes 4 gallons.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. cherry Jell-O (large)
1  c. hot water
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. pineapple syrup
1  orange, ground
1 (8 oz.)  can drained crushed pineapple
1  c. ground raw cranberries
1  c. nutmeats
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.  Add sugar, lemon juice and pineapple syrup.  Stir; dissolve and chill until partially set. Add remaining ingredients.	Chill overnight.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift all  dry ingredients together.  Cut in shortening. Beat eggs with sugar and vanilla and add to flour mixture; mix well. Shape into small balls.  Place on cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Flatten each with bottom of glass.	Bake at 375° for 8 or 10 minutes.

name: HAM
ingredients:
cloves
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  can sliced pineapple
preparation: Score ham, place cloves on ham.  Wrap in foil and bake 15 minutes per pound at 350°.

name: OLD FASHION TEA CAKES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  stick oleo
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
2  eggs
pinch of salt
3  Tbsp. milk (more or less)
preparation: Mix until dough is stiff.  Roll out and cut.  Place on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° until done.

name: CREAMED SPINACH
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
2  Tbsp. Crisco
1  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
preparation: Cook spinach in boiling water and salt for 10 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  In pan, melt Crisco.  Add flour to make a roux. Add milk and cook until mixture thickens.  Add spinach; stir thoroughly and heat.

name: RANCH SALSA
ingredients:
1 (10 oz)  can tomatoes with green chiles
1 (2 oz)  can chopped black olives, drained
4  green onions, chopped
1/2  c shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1/2  c Italian salad dressing
preparation: Combine the tomatoes with green chiles, olives, green onions, cheese and salad dressing in a bowl and mix well. Chill until serving time. Serve with tortilla chips.

name: POTATO DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. mashed potatoes
1  pkg. active dry yeast
1/2  c. warm water
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. vanilla
6 1/2 to 7  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Scald milk, stir in shortening, sugar and mashed potatoes. Cool to lukewarm.   Blend well.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP-CREAM CHEESE BARS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  rolls chocolate chip cookies
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
preparation: Put 1 row of chocolate chip cookies in bottom of square pan, 9 1/2 x 13-inch, and press down.  Blend cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and egg altogether.  Put on top of chocolate chip cookies and press down, then add 2nd package of cookies on top.  Add nuts, if you want to.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: AUNT ALICE'S SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1/2  chopped onion
4 to 5  slices bacon, browned and crumbled
1  lb. ground beef
1  can tomato soup
1  can tomato sauce (large Hunt's)
1  can tomato paste (small)
4 to 5  slices Velveeta cheese
salt and pepper to taste
1  lb. pkg. elbow macaroni
preparation: Brown beef; take off grease.  Add onion, bacon, tomato soup, tomato sauce, tomato paste, cheese, salt and pepper.  Cook elbow macaroni.  Mix with beef mixture and pour into casserole.  Bake in oven at 350° for one hour.

name: SPRINGERLE COOKIES
ingredients:
4  large eggs
2  c. sugar (granulated)
20  drops anise oil or 4 Tbsp. anise seed
4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Beat eggs until light, gradually add sugar and continue beating at a high speed for 15 to 20 minutes until batter is thick and lemon colored.  Add anise.  Sift flour and soda and blend with egg mixture at a low speed.  Cover bowl with wax paper or foil and let stand 15 minutes (so it is easier to work with).  Divide into 3 parts.  On lightly floured surface roll dough to 8-inch square, 1/4 inch thick.  Let rest 1 minute.  Flour mold and press design, cut and place on lightly floured surface.  Cover with a towel all night.  Grease a cookie sheet well.  Brush off excess flour from the cookie sheet.  Bake about 15 to 20 minutes at 300°.  Yield 6 dozen cookies.

name: MEXICAN-STYLE BAKED CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1 (16 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. green pepper
2  pimientos or 1 fresh red pepper
2/3  c. milk
1  beaten egg
4  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. Mexican cornmeal mix (Martha White)
1  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. sugar
pepper
preparation: Combine and pour into well-greased 7 1/2 x 11-inch Pyrex baking dish.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: SWEDISH NUT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
20  oz. crushed pineapple
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
8  oz. cream cheese
1  stick butter
1 3/4  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together flour, baking soda, sugar, eggs, crushed pineapple, vanilla and chopped walnuts.  Bake 35 minutes at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  While cake is still warm, combine the following ingredients and ice cake:

name: CHEWY FUDGE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
2  beaten eggs
1  stick melted margarine
preparation: Mix together  flour,  sugar and cocoa.  Add beaten eggs and melted margarine  last.  This makes them chewy rather than like cake.  Bake  in 350° oven until done (approximately 25 to 30 minutes).

name: GRANNY'S HASH BROWNS
ingredients:
2  lb. pkg. hash browns, thawed
1/2  c. butter, melted
8  oz. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. half and half
Ritz crackers
preparation: Mix butter, sour cream, soup and half and half together, then add thawed hash browns.  Pour in casserole dish and top with crumbled Ritz crackers and melted butter.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: GOOD SLOPPY JOES
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  small pickle, chopped fine
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  small onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. ketchup
2  Tbsp. mustard
preparation: Brown hamburger, onion and pickle. Then add ketchup, mustard, brown sugar and mushroom soup.  Simmer for 15 minutes and serve.

name: BRUNCH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. crescent rolls
2  c. Mozzarella cheese
6  eggs
3/4  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Brown sausage and drain well.  Line bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with crescent rolls, firmly pressing together to form crust.  Add crumbled sausage and cheese.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. shortening
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
3  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream the butter and shortening. Add sugar.  Beat eggs and add.  Add remaining ingredients.  Make sure to add the milk before the flour. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Reduce heat to 325°, then bake 30 minutes longer.

name: BACON AND CHEESE CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. yellow corn bread mix
1 1/2  c. milk
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. butter, softened
1/4  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. crushed red chilies (optional)
1  c. shredded sharp cheese
5  slices bacon, cooked
preparation: Heat cornmeal and milk over medium heat until thick and dry, stirring frequently for about 3 minutes.  Spoon cornmeal mixture into a bowl.  Add the remaining milk, butter and eggs and beat until smooth.  Stir in salt and baking powder (eliminate if you use a yellow corn bread mix).  Add red chilies, if used.  Stir in cheese and bacon and pour into a casserole dish or cake pan.  Bake at 325° for about 35 minutes or until brown.

name: WALTERSPIEL(Potato, Leek Soup)
ingredients:
3  large potatoes, sliced thin
4  slices lean bacon, diced
6  leeks, sliced thin
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. flour
4  c. chicken broth
2  egg yolks, beaten
1  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
2  Tbsp. chopped chervil
preparation: Saute bacon in a deep saucepan for 5 minutes.  Add leeks and onion and saute for 5 minutes.  Stir in flour.  Add chicken broth slowly, stirring constantly.  Add potatoes and simmer for 1 hour. Combine egg yolks and sour cream and stir them into soup.  Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring constantly.  Add parsley and chervil. Makes about 2 quarts.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
7  oz. Marshmallow Fluff
dash of cinnamon
fruit juice
preparation: Mix together; add enough fruit juice to achieve desired consistency.

name: DELICIOUS COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
1  c. margarine or butter
1  c. vegetable oil
1  egg
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. soda
1  c. crisp rice cereal
1  c. quick cooking oats
1  c. coconut
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix in the order given.  Shape dough into balls and place on baking sheet.  Dip a fork or glass bottom in granulated sugar, then use to flatten cookies.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. This is a large recipe which will make about 100 cookies.

name: JEWEL SLAY'S SCALLOPED EGGPLANT
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. melted butter
1  small chopped onion
1 1/4  c. grated cheese
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1  c. bread crumbs
1/2  c. buttered cracker crumbs
preparation: Pare eggplant.  Slice and boil in salted water until tender; drain.  Add egg, butter, onion, cheese, garlic powder, milk and bread crumbs.  Place in buttered 1-quart baking dish.  Top with cracker crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: OKTOBERFEST RIBS
ingredients:
2  lb. pork ribs
2 (32 oz.)  jars sauerkraut, drained
2  yellow onions, peeled and cut in half
2  tart green apples, cored and wedged
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. caraway seed (optional)
preparation: Layer ingredients into a large Dutch oven in this order: sauerkraut, onions, apples, brown sugar (sprinkle evenly over) and ribs.  If using caraway seed, bury them evenly in the sauerkraut layer.  Bring to a boil.  Lower heat, cover and simmer gently for 2 to 3 hours, until ribs are very tender.

name: HAMBURGER FOR TACOS
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger, fried and drained
2  tsp. chili powder
3/4  tsp. garlic salt
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped onion
8  oz. tomato sauce
preparation: Simmer all for at least 15 minutes.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
4  egg yolks
2 1/2  c. cake flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pkg. German's sweet chocolate, melted in 1/2 c. boiling water
3  egg whites, beaten stiff
preparation: Cream margarine, shortening and sugar together.  Beat in egg yolks.  Sift together cake flour and salt.  Stir in alternately with mixture of buttermilk and soda.  Stir in vanilla and chocolate.  Fold in egg whites.  Bake 25 minutes at 350° in 3 greased, floured and wax paper lined 8-inch round layer pans. Cool on racks.  Frost.

name: CREAMY CHICKEN PRIMAVERA
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. margarine
3/4  lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. sour cream
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. Green Giant Pasta Accents primavera pasta and vegetables
preparation: In large skillet, melt margarine.  Add chicken; cook until no longer pink.  Add pasta and water.  Cover; cook over medium heat 7 to 9 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.  Stir in sour cream; heat thoroughly.

name: LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  small onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
2  lb. ground beef
4  cans mushroom pieces
2  cans tomato sauce
1 small  can tomatoes
2  tsp. oregano
12  oz. lasagne noodles
1  lb. Mozzarella cheese
3  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Brown onion and garlic in oil.  Add beef, salt and pepper; brown.  Add mushrooms, tomato sauce, tomatoes and oregano.  Simmer 1/2 hour.  Cook lasagne noodles as directed on package.  Arrange in large buttered baking dish a layer of noodles, meat sauce and cheese until the ingredients are used up, ending with cheese.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

name: MAPLE SYRUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. corn syrup
1/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. maple flavoring
preparation: Combine ingredients in medium saucepan.  Bring to a boil; boil 2 minutes.  Cool at room temperature.  Store in refrigerator. Warm slightly before reusing.  Yield:  1 pint.

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
6  small potatoes, boiled
6  slices bacon, fried
1  stalk celery, chopped
1  onion, chopped
3  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. vinegar
preparation: Combine celery and onion and cook until done.  Add flour, sugar, water and vinegar.  Cook until thickened.  Add potatoes and crumbled bacon.  Enjoy!

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. vinegar
1/2  c. celery, chopped
3/4  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
2  hard-boiled eggs
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1/4  c. sweet pickles, chopped
1  tsp. salt
paprika
preparation: Cook potatoes in their jackets about 25 to 30 minutes, until done.  Remove from heat and drain water.  Let cool before dicing. Sprinkle potatoes with sugar and vinegar.  Add celery, onion, pickles and salt.  Stir gently to combine.  Add mayonnaise by folding into mixture.  Add sliced eggs.  Sprinkle top with paprika.

name: SURPRISE FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Del Monte tropical fruit
2  bananas
1  orange (sweet)
8  oz. jar maraschino cherries, drained and halved
8  oz. tub Cool Whip
1  c. coconut
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Chill for at least an hour.  Serve as a main course or a light dessert.

name: EASY GRILLED HAM
ingredients:
1  2 inch thick, fully cooked ham steak
1/2  c. ginger ale
1/2  c. orange juice
1/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1/8  tsp. ground cloves
1/2  tsp. white vinegar
preparation: Place steak in a large shallow dish.  Combine ginger ale, orange juice, brown sugar, vegetable oil, vinegar, mustard, ginger and cloves.  Stir until sugar dissolves.  Pour over steak.  Cover and refrigerate 8 hours, turning meat occasionally.

name: CANDIED YAMS
ingredients:
4  medium yams, cooked
dash of cinnamon
1/4  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
2  Tbsp. butter or oleo, melted
preparation: Cut yams in halves. Blend butter, sugar and cinnamon.  Spread over yams.  Bake in 350° oven until hot.

name: CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
1  can biscuits
1/2  c. sugar
cinnamon
1  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. butter
preparation: Flatten biscuits into long strips.  Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon on top of strips.  Roll strips and place in pan.  Bake 12 minutes at 325°.  Melt butter into glaze. Pour lightly over cooled rolls.

name: CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
2  Tbsp. oil
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. vanilla
4  eggs
1 or 2  cans cherry pie filling or your favorite
