preparation: Reserve 1 cup of dry cake mix.  Combine remaining cake mix, 1 egg and oil.  Press into bottom and sides of lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  (Mixture may be crumbly.)

name: PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. water
1/2  c. salt
2  Tbsp. cream of tartar (alum)
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
food coloring
preparation: Mix dry ingredients; add food coloring, water and oil.  Cook in heavy pan for 3 minutes or until mixture pulls away from pan. Cool and knead.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  chicken breasts, cooked
1  stick margarine
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. chicken broth
1 small  pkg. cornbread stuffing mix
preparation: Melt margarine in large casserole dish.  Add chicken.  Mix 1/2 can of soup and 1/2 cup chicken broth; pour over chicken.  Mix stuffing mix and rest of soup and broth together to moisten the stuffing.  Spread over top.  Bake at 350° until brown.  Serves 6.

name: BAKED BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  bacon slices
4  large onions, chopped
1/2 to 1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cider vinegar
2 (15 oz.)  cans dried lima beans
1  lb. can green lima beans
1  lb. can red kidney beans
1 (1 lb. 11 oz.)  can New England-style baked beans
preparation: Fry bacon until crisp.  Remove from skillet.  Brown onions. Add all other ingredients except beans.  Cook 15 minutes, uncovered.  Drain the lima and kidney beans.  Mix with the can of New England-style baked beans and crumbled crisp bacon.  Mix onion and bean mixture.  Pour into 3-quart casserole.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serves 15.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. of butter
2  cups sugar
5  eggs
1  pkg. graham crackers, crushed
1  cup coconut
1  tsp. baking powder
1  cup chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
1  cup milk
preparation: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time, beating after each. Add all the other ingredients. Mix well. Bake in three greased and floured cake pans.

name: BEAN AND CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. sour cream
1  can Shoe Peg corn, drained
1  can green beans, drained
1  stick margarine, melted
1  stack Ritz crackers, crumbled
3/4  c. grated cheese
preparation: Mix soup, vegetables and sour cream.  Sprinkle cheese on top. Mix melted butter with crackers.  Spread on the casserole.  Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

name: DEBBIE KEYS POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo (soft at room temperature)
1/2  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
1  tsp. butter and vanilla flavoring
6  eggs, room temperature (one at a time)
3  c. cake flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk (room temperature)
preparation: Combine the cake flour, salt and baking powder.  Add to first mixture, alternating with the milk.  Pour into a greased and floured angel food cake pan.  Put in a cold oven in center.  Turn oven on and bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

name: MICROWAVE SWEET AND SOUR FRANKS
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  jar currant jelly
1/2  c. prepared mustard
1  lb. frankfurters, canned Vienna sausages, or cocktail wieners
preparation: Microwave jelly in a serving container until melted, about 30 seconds.  Stir in mustard.  Slice franks into bite-size pieces, then add to jelly mixture.  Microwave for 3 to 4 minutes until heated through.  Serve warm with toothpicks.

name: HEARTY BEEF BARLEY SOUP
ingredients:
3  lb. boneless cubed chuck steak
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1  lb. beef bones
3  c. beef stock
3  c. water
3/4  c. chopped parsley
3  bay leaves
1  tsp. dried thyme
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. pearl barley
8  small peeled white onions
3  sliced carrots
8  oz. sliced mushrooms
preparation: Cut beef into 1/2-inch cubes.  Heat oil in Dutch oven until hot.  Cook and stir beef in oil until beef is browned.  Add beef bones, beef broth, water, parsley, bay leaves, thyme, pepper and barley.  Simmer, covered, 1 hour.   Add onions; cover.  Simmer 30 minutes.  Add carrots and mushrooms; cover.  Simmer until beef and vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes longer.  Strip beef from bones and add to soup.  Discard beef bones and bay leaves.  Skim off any grease on surface.  Season with salt and pepper.

name: OVEN FRIED CORNMEAL CATFISH
ingredients:
4  catfish steaks (about 1 lb.)
4  Tbsp. cornmeal
salt and pepper to taste
1  egg
1  Tbsp. salad oil
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Defrost fish, if frozen.  Spray a nonstick pan until slick with cooking spray.  Sprinkle cornmeal on plate.  Fork whip egg, oil and lemon juice together in another dish.  Dip fish in the egg mixture, then the crumbs, coating both sides.  Arrange fish in a single layer on the nonstick pan.  Place the pan on the bottom shelf and bake at 475° for about 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily and is golden brown.

name: APPLE CRUMB CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. quick-cooking oats
3/4  c. melted butter
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.  Add 1 teaspoon vanilla.  Pare 6 medium apples.  Slice thin and add to cooked mixture.  Toss lightly to mix.  Spread evenly over crumbs; pat remaining crumbs over apples.  Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 50 to 55 minutes.

name: LOW COUNTRY SHRIMP BOIL
ingredients:
4  qt. water
2  lemons, quartered
2  onions, quartered
1 to 2  oz. special seasoning (Old Bay or Old Savannah)
2  bay leaves
2  pieces long sausage
2  potatoes, quartered
2  corn-on-cob
1 1/2 to 2  lb. shrimp (heads off, tails on)
preparation: Combine water, lemons, onions and seasonings; cook at a rolling boil for 15 minutes.  Lower to medium boil; add sausage. Cook 15 to 20 minutes, then add potatoes.  Cook 15 to 20 minutes, then add corn.  Cook 15 to 20 minutes; add shrimp.  Cook 1 to 3 minutes; drain and serve.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/3  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
2  eggs
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  pkg. chocolate bits
1/2  tsp. vanilla
chopped nuts
preparation: Mix peanut butter and margarine until blended.  Gradually add sugar; beat until fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.  Add dry ingredients; mix well.  Stir in chocolate bits, nuts and vanilla.  Spread in greased and floured 9-inch pan.

name: BANANA BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. plain flour
2  tsp. soda
1  c. Post Raisin Bran
1  egg
1  c. mashed bananas
1/4  c. low-fat milk
2  Tbsp. oil
1/3  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix dry ingredients; stir in remaining ingredients just until moist.  Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: MEAL IN ONE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb ground chuck
1/4  c chopped peppers
1/4  c chopped onion
1  can mixed vegetables
1  can cream corn
1  can cream of mushroom or chicken soup
1  pkg noodles
1/2  c cheese
preparation: Brown ground chuck with peppers and onions; drain. Add mixed vegetables, corn,  soup and cheese. Heat until cheese is melted. Cook noodles until tender, mix with other ingredients. Bake until hot.

name: BEEF AND CABBAGE ROLLS IN SAUERKRAUT
ingredients:
large cabbage leaves, steamed to wilt
1  lb. lean ground beef
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. hot turkey sausage
1/2  c. uncooked rice
1  egg
salt and pepper
3  Tbsp. flour
2 to 3  Tbsp. oil
1  pkg. beefy onion soup mix
1  tsp. beef bouillon
1  tsp. caraway seed
garlic powder, salt and pepper
1 (16 oz.)  can sauerkraut
1  can water
preparation: Combine ingredients in a large Dutch oven.  Bury cabbage beef rolls in this mixture.  Cook on low heat 4 to 5 hours.

name: POTATO ROLLS
ingredients:
6 to 7  c. flour
2  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. lukewarm water
1  c. warm, mashed potatoes
2/3  c. shortening and butter, mixed
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. lukewarm water
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup lukewarm water and set aside. Combine potatoes, sugar, salt and 1 cup lukewarm water in bowl. Add yeast mixture, eggs and shortening-butter mixture.  Stir in flour gradually.  Mix well.  Place in a greased bowl and let rise until double its size.  Punch down and form rolls.  Let the rolls rise until double in size.  Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

name: PISTACHIO SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  box instant pistachio pudding
1  can crushed pineapple
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
maraschino cherries (optional)
1  container Cool Whip
preparation: Dissolve pudding in pineapple juice.  Let it set slightly. Mix with Cool Whip.  Add nuts and marshmallows.  Add pineapple and cherries, if desired.

name: VANILLA WAFER CAKE
ingredients:
12  oz. box vanilla wafers, crushed
1/2  lb. butter
2  c. sugar
6  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  c. coconut
1  c. walnuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Crush wafers until consistency of flour.  Cream butter and sugar together.  Add eggs one at a time.  Add milk, wafers, nuts and coconut.  Bake for two hours at 275°.   Cool in pan.  Use tube pan.

name: PINEAPPLE DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
2  eggs
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
4 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts
preparation: Cream oleo, sugars, eggs and vanilla.  Stir in pineapple.  Mix together flour, baking powder, soda and salt.  Stir flour mixture into creamed mixture.  Add 1 cup nuts.  Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie pan.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: HOT CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
2 1/4  lb. chicken wings (about 12 to 15 wings)
4  Tbsp. Durkee Red Hot sauce
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
1  Tbsp. catsup
1/4  tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. ground cumin
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Split wings at joint and discard tips; cut skin off.  Wash and pat dry.

name: ITALIAN MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1 (16 oz.)  jar garden style tomato sauce
1  c. Italian flavored bread crumbs
1  egg
preparation: Mix all ingredients and place in loaf pan.  Cook at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.  While still hot, cut, sprinkle grated Mozzarella cheese on each piece and serve.

name: SWEET POTATO DISH
ingredients:
4  c. sweet potatoes, cooked, drained and mashed
1/2  c. sugar
1  stick oleo, melted
1/3  c. milk
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix well and pour into baking dish.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
5 1/2  c. milk
4  c. bread pieces (2 days old)
5  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. melted butter
3/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Into large size mixing bowl, combine Eagle Brand milk and other hot milk.  Add bread and let stand until mixture is lukewarm.  Stir in the next five ingredients.  Turn into large casserole or baking dish.  Bake in 350° (moderate) oven until a sharp bladed knife inserted near center of pudding comes out clean, about 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Serve hot or cold.

name: NUTTY CHEESE RING
ingredients:
1  lb. sharp cheese, grated
1  c. finely chopped pecans
1  c. mayonnaise
1  small onion, finely grated
black pepper
dash of cayenne
strawberry preserves (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients except preserves; season to taste with pepper.  Mix well and place in a 5 or 6 cup lightly greased ring mold.  Refrigerate until firm for several hours.  Unmold and fill center with strawberry preserves, or serve plain with crackers.

name: SHRIMP AND EGGPLANT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large eggplant
1  lb. shrimp
1  medium onion
2  garlic cloves
6  sprigs parsley (leaves only)
salt and pepper
1  Tbsp. olive oil
bread crumbs
preparation: Peel and cube eggplant.  To eggplant, add half same amount of water and dash of salt.  Boil for 15 minutes.  Grind remaining ingredients, except olive oil and bread crumbs, together with salt and dash of cayenne (or pepper).  Strain eggplant and press out water.  Add 1 tablespoon olive oil in skillet.  Add all ingredients; cook for 10 minutes.  Put into casserole dish.  Cover with bread crumbs.  Bake in moderate oven for 15 minutes.

name: CRISPY POTATO PANCAKES (LATKES)
ingredients:
4  medium russet potatoes, peeled
2  medium onions
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
2  egg whites, lightly beaten
1/4  c. finely chopped chives
Vegetable oil for frying
preparation: Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate potatoes and onions. Put grated potatoes and onions together in cheesecloth or a tea towel and twist it to squeeze out the excess liquid. Put the dry potatoes and onions in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Fold in the egg whites and chives to bind the mixture together. Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat and coat with 1/4 inch of oil. For each pancake, take about 2 Tbsp. of potato mixture and drop into the hot oil; gently flatten with a spatula so they fry up thin and crispy. Fry for 3 to 4 minutes on each side, until golden. Remove to paper towels to drain; season with salt while the potato pancakes are still hot. Continue frying, adding more oil as needed, until all the mixture is used up. Serve immediately with applesauce, if desired.

name: AUNT LILL'S OVERNIGHT SALAD
ingredients:
1  (10 oz.) bag small marshmallows
1 (1 lb. 4 oz.)  can pineapple (no juice)
1  can Queen Ann white cherries
1  can pears
1/2  pt. whipped cream
2  egg yolks
1  lemon, juiced
1  pinch dry mustard (scant 1/4 tsp.)
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Cook egg yolks, juice of 1 lemon, dry mustard and sugar in double boiler until thick.  Cool.  Cut pineapple and pears into small pieces.  Whip cream and mix with dressing.  Add cream to fruit.  Add cherries and marshmallows gently.  Let stand overnight in refrigerator.

name: PICKLED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage
2  stalks celery
1  green or red bell pepper
1  tsp. celery seed (optional)
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Grate head of cabbage in food processor.  Dice celery and pepper.  Add celery seed.  Dissolve the sugar and salt thoroughly in the vinegar and water.  This stores in the refrigerator very well.  Just use enough to liberally coat the grated cabbage. Refrigerate several hours.  Stir once or twice to season well. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/3  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. milk
1  egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Heat fruit to boiling point; sweeten to taste.  Sift flour, baking powder, sugar and salt into mixing bowl.  Add milk, beaten egg and melted butter; mix lightly.  Arrange fruit in bottom of baking dish.  Spread batter over hot fruit.  Bake until brown.

name: SWEET AND SOUR SAUCE
ingredients:
2/3  c. brown sugar, packed
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. pineapple juice
2/3  c. white vinegar
1/2  c. ketchup
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Combine ingredients in saucepan.  Cook over medium heat until thick, stirring constantly.

name: NUT ROLLS
ingredients:
1  lb. butter, melted
1 (14 oz.)  can milk
6  eggs
1/2  cake household yeast
1/2  tsp. salt
8 to 9  c. flour
preparation: Combine first five ingredients.  Add enough flour to make firm dough.  Chill overnight.  Break off pieces of dough the size of a walnut.  Roll very thin in granulated sugar.  Spread with nut filling and roll as for jelly roll.  Place on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 -8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1 -8  oz. can crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Place chopped green pepper, onion and pineapple on paper towel to absorb liquid.  Blend all ingredients well.  Refrigerate and chill at least 1/2 hour.  Shape into ball.  Roll in additional chopped pecans, if desired.

name: TABLE SYRUP
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
2  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Dissolve sugar in water and cook until it thickens slightly. When cool, add vanilla or maple flavoring.

name: CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. Snack-Cake Mix
1/4  c. unsweetened cocoa
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. ice water
preparation: In an 8-inch pan, stir cake mix and cocoa with rubber spatula until well blended.  Briskly stir in egg, vanilla and ice water until well blended.  Scrape down sides of pan.  Bake according to directions.  This has 190 calories.   Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: OLD-FASHION CRACKLIN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. pork cracklings, soak overnight
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. yellow cornmeal
1  c. milk
1  egg
1  stick butter, melted
preparation: In a large bowl, mix flour and corn meal.  Add cooled butter with back of spoon in rubbing fashion until butter is well mixed. Then add milk and eggs once batter is mixed. Drain all liquid off of cracklins. Pat them dry, then add to batter.  Mix well and bake in greased 10-inch skillet until top is golden brown.

name: MAYONNAISE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together first 6 ingredients.  Add mayonnaise, milk and vanilla.  Beat well.  Pour into greased 9 x 1 1/2-inch layer pans lined with wax paper.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until cake springs back when touched.  Cool completely.  Remove from pans.  Makes 2 layers.

name: 7-UP RED SATIN PUNCH
ingredients:
1  qt. cranberry juice
1  qt. apple juice
2  qt. 7-Up
2  trays 7-Up ice cubes or ice ring
preparation: Chill fruit juices and 7-Up.  Prepare 7-Up ice cubes or 7-Up ring.  At serving time, combine cranberry and apple juice in punch bowl.  Slowly pour in chilled 7-Up.  Add "ice cubes" or "ice ring." Makes 35 punch cup servings.

name: NO FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. flour (all-purpose)
1/3  tsp. salt
1/3  c. Puritan oil
3  Tbsp. ice water
preparation: Mix salt and flour.  Whisk together oil and water; pour into flour mixture and stir with fork until blended.  Form into a ball and roll between 2 sheets of waxed paper.  Makes 1 pie crust (9-inch); 125 calories per serving.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
2  eggs
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3  c. chopped apples, peeled
2  Tbsp. milk
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
1 1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  c. chopped pecans
2  c. powdered sugar
1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Combine sugar, oil, lemon, vanilla, eggs and salt.  Beat well.  Add flour, baking soda, cinnamon, pecans and apples.  Mix lightly.  Pour into a greased and floured 12-cup fluted tube pan.  Bake for 1 1/2 hours.  Combine powdered sugar and milk, adding more milk until glaze is of proper consistency. Drizzle over cooled cake; sprinkle with nuts.  Store in a covered container.  Makes 12 servings.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
3  c. pumpkin
2 1/2  c. sugar
1 large  can Carnation milk
4  eggs
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  tsp. lemon flavoring
1   stick margarine
preparation: Mix all ingredients together while pumpkin is warm.  Use electric mixer.  Pour in 2 brown pie shells.  Cook at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
2  (9-inch) pie shells, cooked and cooled
3  pt. fresh strawberries
2  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 (3 oz.)  box strawberry jello
2  c. boiling water
few drops red food coloring
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Fill baked and cooled pie shells with fresh strawberries.  (If strawberries are very large, they may be sliced.)  Cook sugar, cornstarch, jello, water and food coloring until thick.  Cool and pour over strawberries.  When set, top with Cool Whip.  Delicious!

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3/4  stick margarine
1/2  c. chopped onion
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli
2  c. cooked rice
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Melt margarine.  Add onion and cook until tender.  Add broccoli.  Add mushroom soup, cheese and cooked rice. Pour into casserole dish and bake about 30 minutes at 350°, or until bubbly and slightly brown.

name: ICE CREAM SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1  egg
1/2  c. shortening
1/4  c. butter, softened
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pkg. devil's food cake mix
vanilla ice cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Beat egg, shortening, butter, vanilla and 1/2 of cake mix until smooth, then stir in remaining cake mix until smooth.  Roll dough out; cut squares.  Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.  Poke fork holes in when fresh out of oven.  Put ice cream between and freeze.

name: SPICY-ORANGE-HONEY BUTTER
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  tsp. grated orange peel
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
2  Tbsp. honey
preparation: Beat all ingredients until fluffy.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. butter
2  c. mashed sweet potatoes
1  pie shell
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Bake at 450° for ten minutes. Reduce to 350°.  Bake until done.

name: FIESTA SANDWICH
ingredients:
1  lb. round loaf sourdough bread
1/2  c. prepared refried black bean dip
4  oz. sweet red pepper, in strips
4  oz. County Line Monterey Jack cheese with jalapenos, cubed
1/4  c. black olive slices
1  small tomato, cubed
4  oz. County Line Cheddar cheese, sliced
1  small avocado, thinly sliced
4  oz. County Line shredded taco cheese
2  Tbsp. Ranch style salad dressing
preparation: Cut off the top 1/3 of loaf of bread and set aside.  Hollow out, leaving 1/2-inch thick crust all around.  Spread cut surfaces with bean dip.  Layer as follows: Colby Jack, half the red pepper, Monterey Jack with jalapenos, olive slices, tomato cubes, Cheddar and avocado.   Top with remainder of red pepper.  Combine shredded taco cheese with salad dressing and spoon on top.  Replace top of bread loaf.  Wrap tightly in foil and keep cool until ready to serve.  If desired, heat in oven or over coals to warm and melt cheese.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.   Serves 6 to 8.

name: CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can cream-style corn
3  to 4 medium potatoes, peeled, cubed and partially cooked
3  Tbsp. oleo or margarine
2 (5 oz.)  cans evaporated milk
6  c. whole milk
preparation: Peel potatoes and cut into cubes.  Place in boiling water and cook 5 minutes to soften slightly.  Drain.  In large kettle, place potatoes, cream-style corn and oleo.  Add evaporated milk and whole milk.  Cook on medium to low heat until oleo is melted and milk is warm.  Don't boil.  Stir occasionally to avoid sticking.

name: BEEF BARBECUE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  can corned beef
1 small  bottle catsup
1  c. water
1  medium onion
1/4  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  tsp. chili powder
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion.  Add other ingredients and cook 2 hours.  Makes 15 to 20 sandwiches.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. white corn syrup or honey
1/4  c. butter
3  eggs, well beaten
1/2  c. sugar (white or brown)
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans, finely chopped
preparation: Cream syrup or honey with butter, add sugar and well beaten eggs. Beat all thoroughly, then add vanilla and pecans.  Pour into unbaked pastry shell and bake in slow oven, 350°, for 30 minutes.

name: MEXICAN VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. fresh or frozen whole kernel corn
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. green pepper strips
1/2  c. water
1  c. chopped yellow summer squash or zucchini
1  large tomato, chopped (1 c.)
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese (4 oz.)
2/3  c. cornmeal
1/2  c. milk
2  slightly beaten eggs
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
several dashes bottled hot pepper sauce
tomato slice, halved
thin green pepper slice
preparation: In a medium saucepan, combine corn, onion, green pepper and water.  Bring to boiling; reduce heat.  Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.  Do not drain.

name: DOUBLE LAYER PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
4  oz. Philly Brand cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. milk or half and half
1  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  c. thawed Cool Whip non-dairy whipped topping
1  c. cold milk or half and half
1  Keebler Ready Crust graham cracker pie crust
2 (4-serving size)  pkg. Jell-O vanilla flavor instant pudding and pie filling
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Mix cream cheese, 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in a large bowl with a wire whisk until smooth.  Gently stir in whipped topping. Spread on bottom of crust.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1 (7.5 oz.)  jar marshmallow cream
1  jigger Grand Marnier liqueur
preparation: Mix  cream  cheese  and  marshmallow cream together and beat until smooth.  Place in refrigerator.  Prior to serving, mix  the liqueur  and  stir.  Excellent  dip  for  fruits and strawberries.

name: CHOCOLATEY VELVET ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2  c. whipped cream
1/2 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk (2/3 c.)
2/3  c. chocolate-flavored syrup
1/3  c. coarsely chopped walnuts
preparation: Combine whipping cream, sweetened condensed milk and chocolate syrup.  Beat with an electric mixer until soft peaks form.  Fold in chopped nuts.  Transfer to an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan; freeze until firm.  Makes 1 quart (8 servings).

name: MEXICAN HOMINY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans hominy
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz (with jalapenos)
crushed corn chips
preparation: Drain hominy.  Place in 2-quart casserole dish.  Heat soup (undiluted).  Add Cheez Whiz and let melt.  Pour over hominy. Sprinkle chips on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, uncovered.

name: ONION YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. dry yeast
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. warm tap water
1/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
2  c. room temperature whole milk
3  c. thawed frozen chopped onion
1/3  c. oil
1  egg
5  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1 tablespoon sugar and warm tap water in a large measuring cup.  Meanwhile, measure dry ingredients.   When yeast is dissolved, add measured dry ingredients, then add 5 cups flour.  Beat until smooth.  Mix in enough remaining flour (3 cups) to make dough easy to handle.  Turn dough on floured surface; knead until smooth.  Place in greased bowl with enough oil to coat dough.  Turn greased side up.  Cover with plastic wrap; let rise until double in size.  Punch down and refrigerate.  Cover with plastic and foil.

name: MIDGE'S APPLE DIP
ingredients:
3/4  c. brown sugar
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together.

name: PREACHER COOKIES
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. dry cocoa
3  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
1  c. milk
pinch of salt
5  c. quick cooking oats
1  c. peanut butter
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix cocoa, sugar, margarine, milk and salt in saucepan. Heat to boiling. Boil 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat and add all other ingredients. Mix well and drop by heaping teaspoonful onto waxed paper.

name: DIABETIC COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped dates
1/2  c. raisins
3/4  c. margarine
4  tsp. sweetener
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  medium bananas, mashed
1/2  c. chopped nuts
3/4  c. Quick cooking oatmeal
preparation: Pour 1/2 cup boiling water over dates and raisins; let stand. Cream margarine; add sweetener; add egg.  Sift flour, soda, spices and salt together; add to creamed mixture.  Add vanilla, fruit, nuts and oatmeal.  Drop from teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes in 400° oven.  Yields 24 cookies.  Each equals 1 bread plus 1 1/2 fat exchange.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHTS
ingredients:
1  lb. sweet milk chocolate
2 (1 oz.)  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. chopped dates
1/4  tsp. salt
5  c. corn flakes
preparation: Melt both chocolates over hot water.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Add to chocolate; mix well.  Drop from teaspoon onto waxed paper.  Chill until firm.  Makes 6 1/2 dozen.

name: BLACK AND WHITE CHEESECAKE BITES
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  To make crust, melt chips and butter in a medium pan over very low heat, stirring until smooth.  Stir in crumbs.  Remove 1/4 cup for later use.  Press remaining mixture evenly in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch dish.

name: GREEN PEA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can sliced mushrooms
2  cans LeSueur peas
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
1/2  stick melted margarine
8  oz. sour cream
1  tsp. salt
fried onion rings
preparation: Drain mushrooms and peas.  Combine ingredients.  Cook 30 to 45 minutes.  Sprinkle top with onion rings.

name: FEATHER DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  egg, well beaten
3  Tbsp. melted butter
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Add egg, butter and enough milk to make a moist, stiff batter.  Drop by teaspoon into boiling liquid.  Cover and simmer for 18 minutes.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  can condensed tomato soup
2  c. cornflakes, crushed into crumbs
2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Shape into loaf.  Bake in a shallow bowl or pan at 350° for about 1 1/4 hours.

name: BAKED OATMEAL
ingredients:
1/2  c. melted butter
1  c. brown sugar
2  beaten eggs
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. oatmeal
preparation: Bake on greased cookie sheet at 350°F 20 - 25 min.  In microwave, 10 min. on HIGH.  Good with blackberries or peaches.

name: TERIYAKI STEAK
ingredients:
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  lb. sirloin or round steak (1/2 inch)
1/2  c. soy sauce
1 1/2  tsp. ground ginger
preparation: Combine all ingredients except meat together and heat in saucepan to boiling.  Score both sides of meat, 1/4 inch deep. Slash fat on edges.  Place meat in shallow dish.  Pour soy sauce mix over meat.  Cover with plastic and refrigerate at least 2 hours, turning 4 times.  Grill or broil 2 to 3 inches from heat, 7 to 8 minutes on each side.  Meat should be brown and have a crust on the outside and rare inside.  To serve, cut diagonally across grain into 1/4 inch slices.  Serves 8.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1/2  c. minced onion
1  clove garlic, minced
1/4  c. butter
1  lb. sirloin
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms, drained
1  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1 (8 oz.)  can sour cream
1  beef bouillon cube
preparation: Cut sirloin in thin strips about 1/4-inch thick.  Put in saucepan with just enough water to cover.  Add 1 beef bouillon cube.  Cook over heat until just done (about 10 minutes).  Drain; set aside.  Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat. Stir in meat and brown.  Stir in flour, pepper and mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes.  Stir in soup.  Simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream.  Heat thoroughly.  Serve over noodles.

name: MAYONNAISE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
8 heaping  tsp. cocoa
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. water
preparation: Mix together.  Grease cake pan, then put in flour so cake does not stick in pan.  Put mix in pan.  Set oven at 350° and leave in oven for about 30 to 40 minutes.

name: PICKLE RELISH
ingredients:
3  qt. unpeeled ground cucumbers
6  carrots
3  onions
2  peppers (red or green)
3  c. vinegar
4  c. sugar
1/4  c. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. turmeric
preparation: Grind cucumbers. Add salt and cover with water. Let stand 3 hours. Grind all vegetables and add to other ingredients. Cook 20 minutes (after hot through). Put in hot sterile jars and let seal.

name: POACHED FISH FILLETS WITH RICH WINE SAUCE
ingredients:
4  large or 8 small fish fillets
1  part dry white wine and 1 part water (enough to cover fillets)
1  onion, sliced
tarragon to taste
grated Parmesan cheese
4  Tbsp. margarine or butter
4  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk (for richer sauce, use evaporated skim milk)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In a shallow pan or skillet, bring to a boil enough wine and water to cover the fish, adding a pinch of salt, tarragon and the sliced onion.  Add the fillets and simmer gently (do not boil) until fish flakes easily.  This will take about 5 minutes.  Test for doneness with a fork or toothpick.

name: TANDY CAKES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salad oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. salt
4  eggs
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
8  oz. peanut butter
12  oz. milk chocolate
1  Tbsp. Crisco
preparation: Heat the peanut butter.  Spread over hot cake, then refrigerate for 1 hour.  Melt the milk chocolate and Crisco in a double boiler.  Spread this over the chilled peanut butter.  Chill for another hour and cut into squares to enjoy.

name: 7-UP CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
1/2  c. solid shortening
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
1 small  bottle 7-Up
preparation: Cream the butter, shortening and sugar.  Add eggs and continue beating.  Add flour gradually.  Add vanilla and lemon flavoring, then slowly add 7-Up.  Pour into large tube pan, greased and floured.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. rainbow salad curls
1  c. diced Mozzarella cheese
1  c. pepperoni
1  c. carrot, sliced
1/2  c. green pepper, sliced
1  c. sliced or whole olives
1 1/2  c. broccoli flowerets
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. Italian seasoning
1  tsp. oregano
1  c. Italian salad dressing
preparation: Cook pasta according to package directions; drain and cool. Place in large bowl and add all ingredients.  Mix well.  Chill and serve.

name: EASY LASAGNA
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1 (32 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. cottage cheese
8  lasagna noodles (uncooked)
1/2  lb. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Microwave cook ground beef on High for 2 to 3 minutes.  Mix beef, water and spaghetti sauce.  In oblong baking dish, spoon 1/2 cup sauce.  Layer noodles, cottage cheese, Mozzarella and meat sauce.  Repeat layers, saving sauce to pour over top of casserole. Top with Parmesan cheese.  Cover with 2 layers of plastic wrap, sealing completely.  Microwave on High for 8 minutes, then medium-low or 4 power level for 32 minutes or until noodles are tender.  Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

name: CAVATINI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  oz. sliced pepperoni
1  c. chopped onions
2  small green peppers, chopped
1 medium  can sliced mushrooms
1  jar Ragu or Prego sauce
1  (16 oz.) tomato sauce
1  can tomato soup
1  pkg. spiral noodles
1  lb. shredded Mozzarella
dash of garlic
preparation: In large skillet or Dutch oven brown the beef.  Prepare noodles as package directs.  To the beef add onions, mushrooms, garlic, pepperoni, green peppers, Ragu, tomato sauce and tomato soup.  Serve with noodles.

name: GERMAN SPATZEL
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
3  eggs
3  Tbsp. water
pinch of salt
4  oz. Gouda cheese, grated
1  lb. bacon
onion
preparation: Mix together flour, eggs and salt.  Add water and mix.  Let stand 10 to 15 minutes.  Fill noodle press 2/3 full and squeeze into salted boiling water and cook 1 to 2 minutes.  Drain. Meanwhile, fry 12 ounces of bacon (cut into small pieces) and 1/2 onion.  Drain fat; set aside.  Add 4 ounces Gouda cheese to noodles, then bacon, stirring until melted.   Serve immediately.

name: ITALIAN TOMATO MEAT SAUCE
ingredients:
olive oil
onion
1/2  lb. beef chuck
1/2  lb. pork shoulder
7  c. tomatoes, sieved
1  Tbsp. salt
1  bay leaf
3/4  c. tomato paste
preparation: Set out a large saucepan with tight fitting lid.  Heat in saucepan 1/4 cup olive oil.  Add and cook until lightly browned 1/2 cup chopped onion.  Add and brown, turning occasionally, beef chuck and pork shoulder.  Add slowly a mixture of 7 cups tomatoes, sieved, 1 tablespoon salt and bay leaf.  Cover and simmer over low heat about 2 1/2 hours.  Add tomato paste.  Simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, uncovered about 2 hours more, until thickened.  Before serving remove bay leaf and meat.

name: RIBBON SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. lime jello
1  pkg. lemon jello
2  pkg. cherry jello
1  c. water
1/2  c. marshmallows
1  can crushed pineapple (reserve juice)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. whipped cream
preparation: Prepare lime jello per directions and let set up until firm in large flat casserole.  After set, dissolve lemon jello in water in pan over heat; add marshmallows and melt.   Add pineapple juice (1 cup) and cream cheese, beat until blended.  Stir in 1 cup drained pineapple and cool.  Then fold in mayonnaise and whipped cream. Pour over set lime jello and when this is set firm, prepare cherry jello per directions.  Pour over firm cream cheese layer.  Chill. It takes over one day to get this set good.

name: 1, 2, 3 BROWNIE PIE
ingredients:
1  stick melted margarine
2  large slightly beaten eggs
2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. granulated sugar
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. cocoa
preparation: Mix together margarine, eggs and vanilla.  Mix together sugar, flour and cocoa.  Combine all ingredients; beat 1 minute and pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  medium squash
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  (6 oz.) container sour cream
1 small  pkg. chopped almonds
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm dressing
1  small onion
preparation: Dice squash and onion and steam until tender.  Drain excess water.  Mix squash, soup, sour cream and almonds.  Spread evenly into casserole dish.  Sprinkle dressing mix over top and bake in oven at 350° until topping is brown.

name: Salmon Loaf
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can red salmon
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
2  egg yolks
1  tsp. parsley, chopped
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. hot milk
2  egg whites
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
preparation: Add all ingredients, except egg whites.  Mix well.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.  Bake in buttered mold in 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN "QUICKIE"
ingredients:
1 (tuna size)  can chunk chicken
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can chicken with rice soup
1  can (small size) chow mein noodles
1 small  jar sliced mushrooms
1 small  jar pimentos (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients, saving some chow mein noodles to sprinkle on top.  Bake in casserole dish at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes (or until bubbly).

name: FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1 (46 oz.)  can unsweetened pineapple juice
1  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Dilute	frozen	juice as directed on can. Add pineapple juice and  mix.  At  serving  time, add ginger ale.  Yields 40 servings.

name: ONE BOWL CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
8  oz. semi-sweet chocolate
2/3  c. sweetened condensed milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: This is so easy, I am almost embarrassed to submit it.  But for someone who works and has little time, it is a real blessing.

name: HONEY MUSTARD DRESSING
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. cider vinegar
3  Tbsp. honey
6  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
1 1/2  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
3/4  c. vegetable oil
pinch of salt
1  Tbsp. finely minced onion
preparation: Heat vinegar and honey in heavy small saucepan until honey is dissolved.  Pour into bowl and cool.  Whisk in mayonnaise, mustard, onion, parsley and salt.  Gradually whisk in oil.  Cover and refrigerate.  Can be prepared 3 days ahead.  Makes 1 1/2 cups dressing.

name: CRAB MEAT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can water chestnuts (optional)
1  green pepper, diced
1  c. celery, diced
1  lb. shrimp, chopped
1  lb. crab meat
1  c. mayonnaise
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. salt and pepper
1  can mushrooms, chopped (optional)
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
buttered bread crumbs (crushed croutons)
preparation: Mix all together and bake 30 minutes at 450°.  Add buttered bread crumbs and bake 20 minutes longer.  Serve with crackers.

name: TOMATO, ONION AND TUNA SALAD(Insalata di Tonno e Cipolle di Pomodori)
ingredients:
1  can solid chunk tuna
2  firm ripe tomatoes
1  red onion, sliced
1/4  c. olive oil
3  Tbsp. wine vinegar
pepper to taste
preparation: Mom's favorite.

name: ICE CREAM CONE CAKE
ingredients:
your favorite two layer cake batter
14  flat-bottomed ice cream cones
white frosting
food coloring
shortening
preparation: You will need aluminum foil, in strips 9 inches wide by 9 1/2 inches long (one per cone).

name: CHINESE MARINATED VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. vinegar
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1 (17 oz.)  can peas, drained
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  can French green beans, drained
1 (16 oz.)  can bean sprouts, drained
1 (10 oz.)  can white Shoe Peg corn, drained
1 (15 oz.)  can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
1 (4 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms, drained
1 (2 oz.)  jar chopped pimento, drained
1  small cauliflower, broken into flowerets
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  purple onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings
preparation: Combine vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper.  Blend well.  Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl.  Pour marinade over vegetables.  Refrigerate at least 2 days before serving.  Drain marinade from vegetables to serve.  Yields 12 to 15 servings.

name: DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. active dry yeast
2  Tbsp. sugar
2 1/2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  c. hot water (not hot)
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water in large mixing bowl; stir in sugar, salt and 1/2 the flour.  Beat until smooth. Add egg and shortening. Beat in remaining flour until smooth.  Scrape sides of bowl and let rise in warm place until double in size (approximately 45 minutes).

name: BEEF AND SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh yellow or zucchini squash, sliced
1  c. onion, chopped
1  c. green pepper, chopped
1  lb. lean ground beef
3  c. cooked rice
2  eggs, beaten
1  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. sour cream
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. cheese, grated
preparation: Cook squash and onion in salted water, about 5 minutes.  Drain well.  Cook green pepper and meat until meat is no longer pink. Stir in rice.  Blend eggs, soup, sour cream and seasonings; stirring into meat mixture.  Fold in squash mixture.  Turn into a greased 11 1/2 X 7 1/2 X 1 1/2 baking dish.  Top with cheese. Sprinkle with paprika, if desired.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.  Makes 8 servings.

name: MICROWAVE DIVINE DIVINITY
ingredients:
2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/3  c. water
1/8  tsp. salt
2  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. chopped walnuts (optional)
preparation: In 2-quart glass measuring cup with handle, combine sugar, syrup, water and salt.  Microwave on High 5 minutes.  Stir until sugar dissolves.  Cook on High 6 minutes.  In large mixer bowl, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form.  While beating at low speed, slowly pour hot syrup into egg whites.  Continue beating until mixture loses its gloss, about 10 to 12 minutes.  Blend in vanilla (and nuts, if desired).  Quickly press candy mixture into buttered 9-inch square dish.  Let stand until firm.  Makes 1 1/2 pounds.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1  chicken
1  c. mixed vegetables
1  c. cream of chicken soup
2 1/4  c. chicken broth
1  c. self-rising flour
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. milk
1/2  stick butter
preparation: Boil and cut chicken into small pieces.  Heat soup, broth and vegetables until boiling.  Place cooked chicken into an 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan.  Pour hot mixture over chicken.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. crushed graham crackers
1  stick margarine, melted
1 (16 oz.)  box powdered sugar
1  stick margarine, at room temperature
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
4  or 5 large bananas
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
12  oz. whipped topping
1  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
10  oz. red cherries
preparation: Mix graham cracker crumbs with melted margarine.  Line a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with this mixture, pressing firmly into pan. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.  Mix powdered sugar, cream cheese, vanilla and softened margarine.  Beat 15 minutes at medium speed on electric mixer.  Spread on top of crumb pastry.  Slice bananas over top.  Spread pineapple over bananas.  Top with whipped topping, pecans and cherries.  Chill several hours before cutting into squares.   Keep covered in refrigerator.  Serves 20.

name: NANCY LUTHY'S FIX AND FORGET IT PORK CHOPS AND RICE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. quick cooking rice
11  oz. can corn with sweet peppers
1  Tbsp. dried minced onion
10 3/4  oz. can low-fat cream of mushroom soup
1/2  tsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. melted margarine
1 1/3  c. water
1  medium carrot, shredded
1/2  tsp. thyme, crushed
4  pork chops (1/2-inch thick)
1/4  c. fine dry seasoned bread crumbs
preparation: In saucepan, combine uncooked rice, water, undrained corn, carrot, onion and thyme.  Bring to boiling.  Stir in soup. Transfer mixture to 2-quart rectangular baking dish.  Trim excess fat from chops.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Arrange on rice and cover with foil.  Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.

name: CHICKEN NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  chicken, cooked and deboned (reserve broth)
8  oz. noodles
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. milk
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. parsley
1/2  c. Ritz crumbs
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook and debone chicken.  Cut into small pieces.  Using reserved broth, cook noodles.  Stir together chicken, noodles, sour cream, milk, soup, salt, pepper and parsley.  Turn into a 9 x 13-inch ungreased baking dish.  Sprinkle top with Ritz crumbs and Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 350° until bubbly, about 40 minutes.

name: LEMON HERB CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. freshly ground pepper
1/4  c. Mazola corn oil
2  Tbsp. dried dill weed, rosemary or tarragon, crushed
3  lb. broiler-fryer chicken parts
preparation: In large shallow baking dish, mix lemon juice, corn oil, parsley, dill weed, salt and pepper.  Add chicken; turn to coat. Cover; refrigerate, turning occasionally, several hours or overnight.  Remove chicken from marinade.  Grill or broil 6 inches from heat, turning and brushing frequently with marinade, 35 to 45 minutes or until tender.   Makes 4 servings.

name: 7-UP CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix (Duncan Hines)
1  box lemon instant pudding mix
4  eggs
3/4  c. Wesson oil
1 (12 oz.)  can 7-Up
preparation: Mix together and beat well.  Makes 3 layers.  Cook at 350° about 25 to 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  whole chicken, cut up
1  pkg. cornbread stuffing
1  stick margarine
2  cans Cream of Chicken Soup
preparation: Boil chicken, no salt.  Pick meat off of bones and save broth. Melt margarine in casserole dish.  In large separate bowl, mix 2 cans cream of chicken soup with 2 cans broth.  In casserole dish, layer dressing, chicken, soup mixture.  Continue layers until all ingredients are used (usually 2-3 layers).  Top layer needs to be soup mixture.  Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour or until bubbly and browned.

name: SET BLUEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry jello
2  c. boiling water
3  oz. cream cheese
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple (juice and all)
1 (No. 2)  can blueberries (juice and all)
1/2  c. whipping cream
preparation: Combine the jello and boiling water.  Add the cream cheese while jello is warm; beat until smooth.  Mix all together and let set.  When set, spread topping on top.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
1  small container sour cream
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. lemon or vanilla
preparation: Separate eggs and beat whites until fluffy.  Set aside. Cream butter, sugar and egg yolks.  Beat real good.  Add sour cream. Beat real hard.  Add flavoring and mix in 1 cup flour; beat real hard.  Fold in egg whites.  Again, beat real hard.  Sift together remaining flour, salt and soda.  Add to batter.  Again, beat real hard.  Pour into large greased tube pan and bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: SUE'S CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh cranberries
1  orange
1  c. nuts
1  pkg. cherry Jell-O
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  can pineapple
1  c. celery
1  c. apples
preparation: Grind cranberries with whole orange and sugar.  Add dissolved Jell-O and other ingredients.  Let chill.

name: CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
1  can condensed tomato soup
1 1/2  Tbsp. unflavored gelatin
1/2  c. cold water
6 to 8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. chopped celery
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Heat  soup.  Soften  gelatin  in the 1/2 cup cold water and pour in the heated soup.  When cool, add all other ingredients. Pour into dish and refrigerate until set.

name: CABBAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
1  cabbage
1  lb. ground beef
1  diced onion
1 1/2  c. uncooked rice
1  can tomato soup
1/4  c. water
preparation: Cook cabbage until tender.  Mix all other ingredients together and put in leaves of cabbage. Pour 1 can tomato soup over top.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix (Duncan Hines)
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. caramels
3/4  c. oleo
1/2  c. evaporated milk (Carnation)
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. pecans
preparation: Mix cake mix as instructed on box.  Pour 1/2 of batter in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch sheet cake pan.  Bake 15 minutes at 350°.  Melt caramels, oleo and evaporated milk in a double boiler.  Pour over warm cake.  Sprinkle chocolate chips and pecans over cake.  Pour remaining cake mix over top of chips and nuts. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Cool and serve with whipped cream.

name: GROUND BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped celery
1  onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. fat
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  can cream of tomato soup
1 medium-size  pkg. noodles
few olives
a little olive juice
preparation: Brown  meat,  celery  and  onion  in 2 tablespoons fat. Cook the  noodles.  Mix noodles, soups, meat, celery and onion together.  Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.  Cut up stuffed olives and sprinkle  on  top.  Pour  some of the olive juice over top and cook 15 minutes longer.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. onion
1  c. carrots
2  c. sliced raw potatoes
1/2  c. uncooked rice
1/2  c. sliced green pepper
2  c. tomatoes
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. hot water
preparation: Brown hamburger in butter.  Put layer of meat in 2-quart casserole.  Top with a layer of each vegetable and rice.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Pour hot water over all ingredients.  Bake at 325° for 2 hours.

name: WARMED CRANBERRY BRIE
ingredients:
1/3  c. crushed cranberry sauce
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/4  tsp. rum or orange extract
1/8  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  8 inch round brie cheese
2  tbsp. chopped pecans
Assorted crackers
preparation: Combine cranberry sauce, brown sugar, extract and nutmeg.  Peel off top rind of brie cheese, leaving 1/4 inch rim.  Top brie with cranberry mix.  Sprinkle with chopped pecans.  Bake 500° for 4 to 5 minutes.  Serve with assorted crackers.

name: SWEET CARROTS
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen sliced carrots
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  pkg. Equal
1  tsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon or nutmeg
preparation: Steam carrots in microwave to the consistency you prefer. Toss with lemon juice, Equal, brown sugar and cinnamon.

name: SUGAR FREE BLACKBERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
Blackberries
2  T. butter
Nutra-Sweet or Equal, sweeten to taste
preparation: Boil berries and sweetener with plenty of water.  Make crust and put in bottom of pan  Add berry mixture on top of crust and cover with another layer of crust.  Bake until crust is brown.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIR CAKE
ingredients:
2  pkg. instant French vanilla pudding mix
3 1/2  c. milk
1  (9 oz.) container Cool Whip
margarine
whole graham crackers
preparation: Grease a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan with margarine.  Line the pan with a layer of whole graham crackers.  Spread half the filling over the crackers.  Cover with another layer of whole graham crackers.  Spread the rest of the filling over the grahams and top with another layer of whole graham crackers.

name: QUICK BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  lb. ground chuck
1  c. chopped onion
1  can tomatoes, chopped and undrained
2  c. water
2  c. cubed potatoes
1  c. sliced carrots
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. mixed vegetables
season to taste with salt, pepper, oregano, garlic powder
preparation: Combine oil, chuck and onion in large Dutch oven.  Cook over high heat until beef is browned.  Cover, reduce to low heat and cook 10 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients and bring to boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.  Makes 9 cups.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  lb. box powdered sugar
3  sticks butter
2  eggs
3  bananas
1  large Cool Whip
1  can crushed pineapple, well drained
1  jar cherries
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix graham crumbs with 1 stick melted butter and put in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan.  Next, beat eggs, 2 sticks butter and powdered sugar for 13 minutes at high speed and put on top of crumbs.  Put a layer of sliced bananas and a layer of pineapple. Top with thawed Cool Whip and garnish with cherries and pecans.

name: CREAMY CUCUMBER SAUCE
ingredients:
1  medium cucumber, peeled and seeded
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. grated onion
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: On wax paper, shred cucumber; pat dry.  In medium bowl, stir cucumber and remaining ingredients until blended.  Makes about 1 1/2 cups sauce.

name: MEAT PIE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  c. sour cream
1  medium onion
1 1/2  lb. sharp cheese
2  cans crescent rolls
lemon pepper
preparation: Brown ground beef.  Add the can of cream of mushroom soup and sour cream.  After mixing, add the onion.  Let crescent rolls get room temperature.  Spread crescent rolls on cookie sheet (1 can). Then take meat mixture and make layer.  Cover the layer with lemon pepper, shredded cheese and the second can of crescent rolls. Bake at 375° until brown.

name: APPLE RELISH
ingredients:
7  lb. apples
2  oranges
2  lb. raisins
7  c. sugar
1  pt. vinegar
1  tsp. ground cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Peel apples and oranges and grind them; also raisins.  Add all other ingredients to this and cook for 35 minutes.  Seal while hot.

name: FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
3  large Spanish onions
3  cans College Inn beef broth
3  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper
3  Tbsp. butter
French bread
Parmesan cheese
Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Slice onions thin; melt butter in frying pan.  Add onion and fry until transparent, not brown.  Stir in flour, a tablespoon at a time.  Add the onions to broth in large saucepan.  Simmer 45 minutes.  Cut bread into 1-inch pieces.  Spread garlic powder and butter on bread.  Broil until golden.  Add cheese and bread.

name: CHOCOLATE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1/2  gal. chocolate milk
1  can sweetened condensed milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix and freeze in electric freezer.

name: GRECIAN LEMON CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Betty Crocker lemon cake mix with pudding in mix
4  eggs
3/4  c. oil
3/4  c. water
1 small  box lemon instant pudding mix
2/3  c. granulated sugar
2/3  c. water
1  Tbsp. lemon concentrate
preparation: Mix 1st five ingredients on low speed for 2 minutes.  Bake in 325° oven for about 45 minutes in 9 x 13-inch baking pan.

name: GREEN PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, chopped
1  c. frozen peas
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. bacon bits
1/2  c. green peppers
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Put green peas in microwave for 2 minutes to cook, then add to mixture and refrigerate.

name: RANGER JOE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. shortening or margarine
2  c. granulated sugar
2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
5  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
4  c. Rice Krispies
4  c. oatmeal
2  c. coconut
1  c. nuts
2  c. raisins or chocolate chips
preparation: Mix shortening or margarine, granulated sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla well.  Mix flour, salt, soda, salt and baking powder together.  Add the well mixed dry ingredients to sugar mixture.  When thoroughly combined, add Rice Krispies, oatmeal, coconut, nuts and raisins or chocolate chips (for variation, use butterscotch chips).  Dough will be very stiff.  Bake in moderate oven about 10 minutes.  Do not overbake if you like chewy cookies!

name: FRENCH COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
5  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  stick oleo, melted
3/4  c. buttermilk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2 to 1  c. coconut
2  unbaked pie shells
preparation: Lightly toast coconut on baking sheet.  Beat eggs.  Add sugar, oleo, buttermilk and vanilla.  Add coconut.  Pour into unbaked pie shells.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Makes 2 pies.

name: MARSHMALLOW SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. mini marshmallows
1 small  bunch red seedless grapes
English walnuts
1  small tub whipping cream
preparation: Cut grapes in half.  Cut English walnuts into medium pieces. Combine first 3 ingredients.  Pour whipping cream over mixture.

name: CRUSTY CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1/2  c. shortening
3  c. sugar
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
3  c. flour
6  eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter and shortening; gradually add sugar, beating well, at medium speed.  Add cream cheese, beating until light and fluffy.  Alternately add flour and eggs, beginning and ending with flour.  Stir in vanilla.  Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Cool pan 10 minutes.  Remove from pan and let cool completely on a wire rack.

name: COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
1 3/4  cup sugar
1/2  stick margarine
2  cups milk
1 - 7  oz. can coconut, or small frozen bag
1  tsp. vanilla or lemon
preparation: Mix together ingredients. Pour into pie plate and bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°. No crust is needed.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  clove garlic, minced
3  Tbsp. salad oil
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. cold water
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. chili powder
dash of Tabasco
1  tsp. cornstarch
1 1/2  lb. cleaned raw shrimp
preparation: Cook onion, celery and garlic in hot oil until tender.  Be careful not to burn garlic.  Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, salt, sugar, chili powder, Worcestershire and Tabasco.  Simmer, uncovered, 45 minutes.  Mix cornstarch with water; stir into sauce until mixture thickens.  Add shrimp and green pepper.  Cover; simmer about 5 minutes.  Serve over rice.  Makes 4 servings.

name: HOMINY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. onion powder
2  c. milk, heated
1  c. grated processed cheese
1 (29 oz.) + 1 (12 1/2 oz.)  can hominy drained
1  c. Ritz cracker crumbs, buttered
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Melt butter over low heat; blend in flour and onion powder.  Slowly stir in the heated milk.  Stir with a wire wisk or wooden spoon over low heat until thickened and smooth.  Remove from heat and stir in the cheese until melted; add hominy.  Pour into greased casserole dish; top with buttered cracker crumbs.  Bake for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

name: EMMA'S APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  sticks butter
2  eggs
3  c. applesauce
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. warm water
5  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
3/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. raisins
walnuts or pecans
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs.  Beat well.  Dissolve soda in water; add to applesauce.  Add additional spices to butter mixture.  Sift together flour, baking powder and salt, then add nuts and raisins to flour mixture and add to other mixture.  Bake in a tube pan for 1 hour at 350°.  This cake can be served warm with whipped cream or allowed to age.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  stick real butter
2 small  pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix, mix with 2 1/2 c. milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
1  c. sugar
1 large  pkg. Oreo cookies
1 small  pkg. gummy worms
preparation: Prepare pudding; let thicken.  Grind cookies.  Soften cream cheese and butter.  Add sugar to cream cheese mix.  When pudding is thick, add to cream cheese mix.  Add Cool Whip to mixture.  Stir until mixture is creamy.  Using a plastic flowerpot, put lid to Cool Whip in the bottom of pot.  Start with cookies and layer them and pudding mixture, starting and ending with cookies.  Add gummy worms as you layer.  Place silk flowers, with plastic stem, to the finished layered pot.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. white Karo syrup
3  eggs
1  c. nuts (whole or chopped)
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. butter, melted
preparation: Beat eggs; add sugar and mix well.  Add melted butter.  Add syrup and vanilla.  Mix well and add nuts.  Bake for about 10 minutes at 400°, then about 30 minutes at about 350°.  Times vary with ovens.

name: BRUNSWICK STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. ground chicken
2  lb. ground beef
2  lb. ground pork
3  bottles catsup
3  lb. green onion
3  cans creamed corn
2  cans tomatoes
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Blender chop green onion, corn and tomatoes.  Combine all ingredients and simmer 2 hours.  Stir to keep from sticking.

name: DORIS ARCHER'S IRISH PLUM CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. flour
2 level  tsp. baking powder
1/2  lb. currants or raisins
1/2  lb. raisins or sultanas
2  (3 oz.) candy peel
1/2  lb. sugar
6  oz. butter or lard
2  eggs
a little milk (sour or fresh)
a jigger of liquor (rum is good)
preparation: Mix dry ingredients; rub in butter.  Add other ingredients and make to a sticky consistency with milk.  Put in a greased 8-inch tin and bake for approximately 1 1/2 hours at 375°.  Reduce heat slightly after first 3/4 hour.

name: GREEN BEANS WITH TOASTED ALMONDS
ingredients:
2 (1 lb.)  cans French-style green beans
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. blanched almonds
preparation: Cook  beans  with  salt  and  pepper  about 10 minutes. Toast the  almonds in the butter and set aside.  When ready to serve, toss  the  toasted	almonds over the hot beans.  If you want to be	fancy  with  these  beans,  add a little shredded cheese before you sprinkle with almonds.  (This is a good dish to serve with baked chicken and herbed rice.)

name: APPLE PUDDING
ingredients:
6  large apples
1/4  c. water
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. flour
6  Tbsp. butter or oleo
preparation: Pare, core and slice apples into deep casserole.  Mix together lemon juice, water, cinnamon and 1/2 cup of the sugar; add to the apples.  Combine remaining sugar with flour and salt; work in the butter.  Sprinkle this over apples.  Bake at 375° about 40 minutes or until apples are tender and the crust is crisp and golden brown.

name: EIGHT LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1  c. chopped celery
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cooked frozen peas
1  c. mayonnaise
6  hard-cooked eggs, sliced thin
1  large red onion, sliced thin
1  c. grated Cheddar or favorite cheese
1  lb. bacon
preparation: Tear up lettuce.  Cook bacon well and crumble.  Layer salad in bowl as follows:  lettuce, celery, peas, mayonnaise, eggs, onion, grated Cheddar or desired cheese and bacon.

name: ITALIAN BEEF
ingredients:
4 to 5  lb. beef roast
2  c. water
1  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. thyme
2  bay leaves
2  cloves garlic
1/8  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
2  beef bouillon cubes
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1  large or 2 small onions
1/4  tsp. basil
1  tsp. ???
preparation: Salt and pepper meat; brown on all sides under broiler or in frying pan on stove.  I use a crock-pot now and after browning the meat, add all ingredients and cook all day.  It can be baked in oven at 350° for 30 minutes per 1 pound also.  Cool after cooking. Slice very thin and return to juices.

name: RED APPLES
ingredients:
2 (20 oz.)  cans apple slices (Comstock or Lucky Leaf)
1 (3 oz.)  box strawberry Jell-O
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Stir all ingredients.  Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.  Serve hot or cold.

name: LITTLE PIZZA APPETIZERS
ingredients:
2  doz. hamburger buns
1  jar pizza or spaghetti sauce
assorted pizza toppings (pepperoni, mushrooms, onions, olives, peppers, etc.)
oregano
shredded cheese
preparation: Place buns on cookie sheet.  Spread with sauce and top with favorite toppings and cheese.  Bake at 400° until cheese melts and buns brown at edges.  Serve immediately.

name: CARROT AND PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. pitted dates
2  c. whole-wheat flour
8  oz. crushed pineapple, unsweetened
1  stick corn oil margarine or butter
1/2  c. coconut
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. raisins
1  c. chopped nuts
2  eggs
1  c. grated carrots
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. water
preparation: Chop and blend dates, pecans and raisins.  Add water and boil 3 minutes.  Add corn oil margarine; stir and cool.  In mixing bowl, blend date mixture with flour, soda, eggs and vanilla; mix well. Add pineapple, carrots and coconut; mix.  Bake in oblong pan at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CRISCO NO-COOK CAKE FROSTING
ingredients:
2  c. powdered sugar
1  egg
1/2  c. Crisco
3  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. sweet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
preparation: Beat together sugar and egg.  Mix well.  Then add Crisco, milk, flour, vanilla and salt.  Beat until creamy (about 10 minutes).  Spread on cake.  You can sprinkle with nuts or coconut.

name: SUGAR COOKIE DESSERT
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. sugar cookie dough
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
sliced fruit
preparation: Bake sugar cookies according to directions.  Cool.  Beat cream cheese until softened; add sugar.  Spread on cookies.   Top with your favorite fruit.

name: OUT OF THIS WORLD CAKE
ingredients:
1 (13 oz.)  pkg. graham cracker crumbs
2  c. sugar
2  sticks margarine, melted
4  eggs
1  c. milk
2  tsp. baking powder
1  can coconut
1  c. pecans, chopped
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple (fruit and juice)
preparation: Combine all ingredients except the pineapple.  Beat until well blended.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  While cake is hot, pour pineapple over it.  Allow to soak through.  Let cake cool before frosting.

name: MARINATED MIXED VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
1  c. finely cut celery
2  green onions (tops and all), chopped
1/2  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. vinegar
1/2  c. Best Foods mayonnaise
salt and pepper to taste
1 heaping  tsp. dill weed
preparation: Barely cook the mixed vegetables in salted water.  Drain and cool.  Add the remaining ingredients.  Mix together and marinate overnight.

name: VALENTINE CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
3 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. Crisco
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. cherry juice
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. almond extract
4  egg whites
18  cherries, well drained and finely chopped
1/2  c. walnuts
preparation: Sift dry ingredients into a mixing bowl and add shortening. Combine milk and cherry juice in a separate cup.  Add 3/4 cup of liquid to dry ingredients.  Add flavorings and beat for 2 minutes. Add remaining liquid and egg whites; beat for 2 minutes.  Add cherries and nuts; blend.  Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 375° for 1 hour in a tube pan for 20 to 25 minutes for layers.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2 1/2  c. grated carrots
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. flour
1  c. cooking oil
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Stir in eggs and oil.  Stir in carrots. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

name: CAIPIRINHA
ingredients:
1  shot Cachaca (Brazilian spirits made of sugar cane) or vodka
1/2  lime, cut into 4 pieces or juice of 1 lime
sugar (as much as you like)
ice
preparation: Mix the sugar and the lime in a small pitcher and crush it. Add "Cachaca" or vodka and mix.  Add ice.  Serve.

name: AVOCADO OMELET
ingredients:
6  eggs
2  Tbsp. water
2  Tbsp. raw milk butter
1/2  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. chopped avocado
1/2  c. alfalfa sprouts
preparation: Beat eggs. Add water.  Pour eggs into heated buttered skillet and cook on low to medium heat, gently lifting edges to let liquid run under, until all is set.  Spoon vegetables onto 1/2 of the omelet. Top with cheese and fold over.  Remove to plate and serve.

name: TACO SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
1/2  tsp. salt
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
5  cans water
2  pkg. taco seasoning mix
8  oz. spaghetti
preparation: Brown hamburger meat in large skillet.  Drain and add salt, tomato sauce, water and taco seasoning mix.  Bring to a boil and add spaghetti.  Simmer 25 to 30 minutes.  Stir often.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY OR PEACH PIE
ingredients:
1  baked pie shell
1  qt. fruit
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
3 1/2  Tbsp. strawberry or peach Jell-O
1  c. water
preparation: Mix sugar and cornstarch, add 1 cup water and cook until thick and clear.  Take from heat and add Jell-O, mix well and cool.  Add a few drops of red food coloring, if not as red as you like.  Cap berries or fruit and put in baked pie shell.  Pour Jell-O mixture over fruit and chill.  Serve with Cool Whip.

name: TAFFY
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. Karo
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Boil until it forms a hard ball in hot water or 260°.  Pour into buttered platter.  Pull when cool.

name: BARBECUE CHICKEN
ingredients:
enough chicken pieces to fill a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. paprika
4  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  large onion, chopped (optional)
2  c. catsup
4  Tbsp. butter (not oleo)
2  c. water
2/3  c. lemon juice or vinegar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Brown the chicken on both sides and drain on paper towels. Blend together all other ingredients and heat until butter and sugar have melted.  Put chicken in the pan and pour the sauce over the chicken.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
1  c. light brown sugar
1/2  c. light Karo syrup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
6 to 7  qt. popped corn
preparation: Pop the corn; pour into large, oversized bowl.  Combine butter, sugar, syrup and salt in heavy pan; bring to boil, stirring constantly.  Stir in condensed milk.  Cook over medium heat to thread or soft ball stage.  Remove from heat.  Add vanilla; toss lightly and quickly with popped corn.  Form into balls or press into baking dish to cut into squares.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  boxes chopped broccoli
1  large onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. mayonnaise
2  eggs
1  stick butter
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm cornbread stuffing mix
salt and pepper to taste
1 to 1 1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Cook and drain broccoli.  Mix soup, mayonnaise, onion, eggs, salt and pepper.  Add broccoli.  Place in bottom of baking dish. Cover with grated cheese.  Melt butter and mix in stuffing mix. Place on top of cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CARAMEL ICING
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
2  sticks butter
1 1/2  c. milk
2  beaten eggs
preparation: Place 1 cup sugar in an iron skillet over medium heat.  Cook and stir over low heat.  After the butter melts, increase heat until a rapid boil.  Meanwhile, sugar in iron skillet has begun to melt.  When melted sugar is light brown and completely melted, pour into the boiling mixture.   Stir constantly.  Cook to soft ball stage.  Remove from heat and add 2 teaspoons vanilla flavoring.  Beat until icing has begun to cool and thicken.  Icing will begin to turn dull in color.  When at good spreading consistency, spread between layers and on sides.

name: FIRE AND ICE TOMATOES
ingredients:
6  small tomatoes
4  small onions
2  green peppers
1  c. vinegar (wine)
1/4  c. water
3/4  c. sugar
dash of red pepper
preparation: Slice tomatoes, onions and peppers into small thin rings.  Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

name: FLUFFY ICING
ingredients:
1  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Bring to a rolling boil. Beat 3 egg whites stiff. Pour syrup over egg whites. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Beat until cooled.

name: EGGPLANT ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
2  large eggplants
1/4 to 1/2  c. olive oil
16  slices boiled ham, sliced thin
2  c. Ricotta cheese
3  garlic cloves, minced
1/2  c. minced fresh parsley
3/4  lb. Mozzarella cheese, sliced thin
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Peel eggplants and slice lengthwise into approximately 8 (1/4-inch thick) slices.  In a large frying pan, heat oil and brown slices on both sides.  Add more oil as needed. To make eggplant rolls, fold slices of ham in half lengthwise and place one on each slice of browned eggplant.  In small bowl, mix Ricotta, garlic and parsley.  Spoon the cheese mixture on top of ham; spread evenly to the edges.  Top with slice of Mozzarella. Roll eggplant and place, seam side down, in baking dish.  Makes approximately 16 rolls.  Spoon tomato sauce over rolls and sprinkle with cheese.  Bake 30 minutes.

name: FRIED VENISON
ingredients:
cubed venison steaks
2  c. buttermilk
2  c. flour
salt
pepper
preparation: Soak venison slices in buttermilk for at least 10 minutes. Mix flour with salt and pepper.  Dip venison in flour or place flour in plastic bag.  Add venison and shake to coat.   Fry in oil until well done.  Drain.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. unpeeled chopped apples
2  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. Crisco oil
3  eggs, unbeaten
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts
1  box dates
3  c. flour
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well and cook in loaf pan at 350° for 1 3/4 hours.

name: BEEF AND TATER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  onion, chopped
1  lb. frozen Tater Tots
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spread ground beef in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Season with salt and pepper; sprinkle onion and spread soup over ground beef.  Cover mixture with Tater Tots.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
8  Tbsp. butter
6  Tbsp. flour
1  qt. rich milk
2  c. grated cheese
2  c. chicken stock, seasoned to taste
1/2  c. celery
1/2  c. green pepper
1/2  c. onion
1/2  c. grated carrots
several drops hot pepper sauce
salt to taste
preparation: Melt 6 tablespoons butter.  Add flour, blending well.  Pour milk in gradually, blending well.  Bring to a boil.  Add cheese and remove from heat, but keep warm.  Melt remaining butter in another pan.  Add celery, green pepper, onion and carrots, all of which have been finely chopped or grated.  Cook until transparent, then pass these through a sieve.  Add chicken stock and mix well. Combine two mixtures and season with hot pepper sauce and salt. Do not boil.

name: PECAN RUM PIE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1 1/2  c. pecan halves
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. dark corn syrup
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1  tsp. rum flavoring
1  baked 9-inch pie shell (in microwave dish)
preparation: Melt butter in 2-quart dish glass measuring cup.  Blend in nuts, sugar, corn syrup, egg and rum.  Pour into pie shell.   Cook 10 to 12 minutes until center is set.  Cool.  Serve warm with whipped or ice cream.

name: MULLET BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
2  lb. mullet fillets
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  box frozen broccoli
1  pkg. Italian salad dressing mix
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Place  fillets	in  greased baking dish.  Sprinkle with lemon juice.  Cook broccoli as directed, adding onion.  Drain; spread over fish.

name: PIZZA SALAD
ingredients:
4  oz. scroddle macaroni (color ones)
1/2  green pepper
1/2  onion
1  jar mushrooms
1 small  can black olives
1/2 (5 oz.)  jar stuffed olives
12  cherry tomatoes
pepperoni slices
celery
2  c. shredded Mozzarella
preparation: Pour over Viva Italian dressing (whole bottle).  Marinate overnight.

name: BANANA BREAD(Diabetic Recipe)
ingredients:
1/2  c. oil
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
3  ripe bananas, mashed
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  eggs
1/2  c. apple juice concentrate
preparation: Put all ingredients into bowl and mix well.  Spray pan well with Pam.  Bake in loaf pan at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. oil
2  c. vanilla
sugar or brown sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. unbleached flour
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  Tbsp. pure vanilla extract
2  c. shredded carrots
1  c. nuts, coarsely chopped
preparation: In a medium-size bowl, mix flour, baking powder, soda, spices and nuts.  In another bowl, blend oil, sugar and eggs.  Beat until smooth and creamy.  Add vanilla and carrots.  Add flour mixture and mix until thoroughly blended.  Generously grease pans.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan or 2 (8 or 9-inch) rounds pans for 25 minutes or until tester comes out clean.  Delicious with cream cheese icing!

name: APPLE SQUARES
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
3  c. apples, sliced
1  c. walnuts or raisins
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine flour, cinnamon and soda together.  Mix sugar, eggs and oil together.  Add to dry ingredients.  Add apples (large chunks) and nuts or raisins last. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 50 minutes.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked peanuts
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  stick oleo or butter
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, butter and syrup together and cook to a rolling boil.  Then add peanuts.  Cook until peanuts start to pop.  Then cook 5 minutes.  Turn off heat, add baking soda and vanilla.  Pour in well-greased cookie sheet.  Cool, then break and eat.

name: ORANGE PECANS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. grated orange rind
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. orange juice
4  c. pecan halves
preparation: Combine rind, sugar and orange juice in a heavy saucepan. Cook until it comes to a full boil. Stir in pecans.  Continue to cook, stirring until pecans are coated and all syrup is almost absorbed.  Remove from heat. Stir until pecans are separated. Spread on waxed paper.  Yields 5 1/2 cups.

name: BLOODY MARYS
ingredients:
1 (40 oz.)  can tomato or V-8 juice
3  oz. lime or lemon juice
3  oz. Worcestershire sauce
1 to 2  Tbsp. horseradish
1/8  tsp. Tabasco sauce
salt and pepper to taste
1  pt. vodka
preparation: Mix all ingredients except vodka and correct seasoning.  Add vodka and pour into a 3-quart container.  Can be kept for a month in refrigerator.  Improves with age.  When ready to serve, pour over ice and add a twist of lime.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: TURKEY AND VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
24  large red skinned potatoes
3/4  c. water
1 (No. 10)  can green beans
3  qt. cooked turkey, cut into bite size pieces
6  stalks celery, diced
3  c. plain yogurt
1 1/2  c. light mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. dried parsley
1 1/2  c. chopped spring onions
2  Tbsp. celery seed
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. white pepper
celery leaves (as garnish)
preparation: Wash and slice potatoes. Cook until tender. Drain potatoes after cooking and place in a large salad bowl. Drain beans.  Add beans, turkey and celery to the salad bowl.  In another small bowl, combine all remaining ingredients, except celery leaves. Toss dressing with turkey and vegetables just before serving. Garnish with celery leaves. Serves 24.

name: SPAGHETTI WITH CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken thighs
olive oil
garlic
oregano
basil
Italian seasoning
hot pepper, crushed or fried
tomato sauce
linguini
fresh Peccarino or Locatelli Romano cheese
cracked pepper to taste
preparation: Cover bottom of pan with olive oil.  Skin thighs and brown in oil.  Add copious amounts of garlic, basil and hot pepper.  Add slightly less oregano and Italian seasoning.
