Just as the garlic starts to brown, add the tomato sauce (large can) and stir.  Simmer lightly over low heat for 45 minutes.

name: GRAMMY'S CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
2  c. cornmeal
1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. shortening
2  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. flour
preparation: Put sugar, soda, salt and baking powder in large bowl and add buttermilk.  Stir well.  Add cornmeal alternately with flour. Melt shortening in loaf pan and add to mixture.  Sprinkle a little cornmeal in loaf pan.  Heat pan and pour mixture into hot pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.  Serve with whipped butter and whipped honey.

name: BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. Crisco
preparation: Mix  flour and shortening together.  Add milk, salt and baking powder.  Roll  thin  and spread Crisco over top.  Fold together and  cut  biscuits  out of folded dough or drop biscuits.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

name: S-P-M YUMMIES
ingredients:
saltine crackers
peanut butter
marshmallows (large)
preparation: Spread peanut butter on saltine crackers.  Top each with marshmallow.  Toast until marshmallow begins to brown.  Be careful marshmallows burn easily.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
dried beef (small jar)
onions
preparation: Cut up beef and mix with onions and cream cheese.  Form in a ball.  Place in refrigerator.

name: SLOPPY JOES
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburg
1  chopped onion
1/3  c. chopped celery
1/3  c. chopped green pepper
1/3  c. ketchup
1/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. salt
5  hamburg buns, split and toasted (if desired)
preparation: Cook and stir hamburg and onion in skillet until hamburg is light brown; drain.  Stir in remaining ingredients, except buns. Cover and cook over low heat just until vegetables are tender, 10 to 15 minutes.  Fill buns with beef mixture.

name: GERMAN GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  can green beans
3  strips bacon
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. wine vinegar (white)
1  tsp. sugar
salt
pepper
1/4  c. chopped fresh onion
preparation: Cut bacon into small cubes.  In small saucepan, add bacon and chopped onion.  Cook and stir until bacon is semi-crisp.  Add flour; stir until well mixed (bubbly).  Add vinegar, sugar and juice from can of beans.  Mix well and allow to boil for about a minute.  Add beans and season with salt and pepper.

name: FIESTA LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1  green pepper, finely chopped
1/2  c. celery, diced
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
1  loaf French bread (unsliced)
preparation: Cook meat and combine with the rest of the ingredients. Simmer.  Slice bread in half, lengthwise.  Pinch out 2 cups of bread crumbs from both halves.  Mix this with the meat mixture. Fill the hollowed out bread with the meat and crumb mixture; top with Cheddar cheese and place on an ungreased baking sheet to heat.  Let the cheese melt; put top back on loaf to slice.

name: EASY NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1 1/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. nuts, chopped (English walnuts)
3  c. biscuit mix (Bisquick; do not pack in the cup)
preparation: Combine sugar, egg, milk and nuts in mixing bowl; mix well. Stir in biscuit mix; beat vigorously for 1/2 minute.  Pour into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes (more or less).  Keep checking after 30 minutes.  Check for sides pulling away like cake, then it's done.

name: TAMALE CORN BREAD PIE
ingredients:
2  medium onions, chopped
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  lb. lean ground beef
2 (16 oz.)  cans chili beans in chili gravy
1 (16 oz.)  can whole corn, drained
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
2 (4 oz.)  cans chopped green chilies
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (15 oz.)  box corn bread mix
preparation: Sauté onions in oil over medium-high heat until limp.  Add beef and cook just until brown.  Drain off liquid.  Place meat in large bowl.  Add beans in gravy, corn, tomatoes, green chilies, chili powder and salt.  Mix well.  Divide mix between two 2-quart oblong baking dishes.  Cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours or freeze 3 months.

name: MOTHER'S PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. broken pecans
1  c. white Karo syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  stick oleo, melted
preparation: Put pecans in pie shell.  Mix all other ingredients and pour over pecans.  Bake at 325° until nuts are crisp.

name: CHOCOLATE COATING
ingredients:
2  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate
1/4  sq. paraffin
preparation: Melt in double boiler and coat candy, pretzels, etc.

name: CREAMY FUDGE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. milk chocolate morsels
1  c. sweetened condensed milk (Borden Eagle Brand)
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Place chocolate in 1-quart casserole and melt 2 to 2 1/2 minutes on High power.  Turn 1/4 turn halfway through.  Add rest of ingredients.  Pour into buttered container.  Chill until firm. Makes 1 pound.

name: STRAWBERRY ICEBOX CAKE
ingredients:
1  box vanilla wafers
1  qt. strawberries
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
1/4  lb. butter
1/2  pt. whipping cream
preparation: Crush vanilla wafers; put 1/2 in bottom of pan.  Cream butter and sugar; add eggs.  Mix well.  Spread berries in halves and spread over butter, egg and sugar mixture.  Whip cream and spread over berries.  Top with remaining vanilla wafers.  Place in refrigerator overnight.

name: CORN-CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (17 oz.)  cans whole kernel corn, drained
4  oz. (1 c.) shredded medium Cheddar cheese
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. Dixie Crystal sugar
2  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
1  tsp. salt
2  oz. pimento, drained and chopped (optional)
1/2  small onion, chopped (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: ONE BOWL MACAROONS
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. Baker's Angel Flake coconut
1/3  c. sweetened condensed milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine all ingredients, mixing well. Drop from teaspoon (1-inch apart) onto well-greased baking sheets.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove at once from baking sheets.  Makes about 2 dozen  macaroons.

name: DRESSING FOR TURKEY
ingredients:
11  x 16-inch loaf corn bread
1  c. cream of chicken
4  boiled eggs
1 large onion or 2  Tbsp. onion salt
salt and pepper to taste
1  stick margarine
4 top 6  c. turkey broth
preparation: Make cornbread loaf the night before.  Crumble cornbread and mix ingredients.  Preheat oven on 500°.  Pour cornbread in pan and bake at 500° for 10 minutes.  Cut down to 300° and bake for 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN SALAD SUPREME
ingredients:
3  cantalope shells, halved
5  c. diced, cooked chicken
1  tsp. salt
1  c. seedless green grapes
1 (5 oz.)  can slivered almonds
1/3  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. diced cantalope
preparation: Combine chicken, salt, grapes, almonds, mayonnaise and cantalope.  Drizzle with lemon juice.  Fill cantalope shells with chicken mixture.  Serves 6.

name: CRUMB CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
4  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
3/4  c. buttermilk
1  egg, beaten
1  apple, cut fine
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix brown sugar, butter, cinnamon and flour; reserve 3 tablespoons of mixture. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Add egg. Add buttermilk mixture to remaining flour mixture. Beat just enough to mix well. Stir in apples and nuts. Pour in greased 9 x 10-inch pan. Sprinkle top with reserved flour mixture. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

name: COCONUT BONBON
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
2  sticks butter
2  boxes powdered sugar
1 (14 oz.)  can coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix and put in refrigerator until firm.  Roll in ball and dip in chocolate, which consists of 1 stick paraffin and 2 packages chocolate chips melted in double boiler.

name: PRIZE WINNING CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pt. sour cream
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Prepare graham cracker crust using about 2 cups crumbs and 1/4 cup melted margarine.  Press on bottom of spring-form pan. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1 large  box instant chocolate pudding
1  large bowl Cool Whip
preparation: Cook cake according to package directions, using 2 round layer pans.  Cool and remove from pans, putting each layer on separate plates.  Cover tightly (each plate) with aluminum foil.  Set aside.

name: HERBED CHEESE AND SPROUT SANDWICHES
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1/3  c. chopped chives
1  tsp. thyme
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
16 thin  slices pumpernickel bread
1 1/4  c. alfalfa sprouts
preparation: Blend first 5 ingredients.  Let stand at room temperature for about an hour to blend.  Spread mixture on half the slices.  Top each with sprouts and another slice of bread.   Serve as is or cut to desired size.

name: ORANGE JELLO MOLD
ingredients:
2 family size  pkg. orange Jell-O
1  envelope Knox gelatine
1  pt. orange sherbet
1  (2 1/2 pt.) container heavy cream
1  can mandarin oranges
preparation: Mix Knox  gelatine  with  the  Jell-O (dry), then add 2 cups hot  water.  Stir  until  dissolved, then add 2 cups cold water; stir.  Add the orange sherbet;  blend thoroughly.  In a separate bowl,  whip  container  heavy cream until thickened. Add to Jell-O  mixture; blend on low speed with mixer.  Drain the mandarin oranges; add to the Jell-O mixture.  Refrigerate in bowl until almost thickened.  Stir and pour into Bundt pan.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can apple pie filling or favorite fruit
1  c. coconut
1  box yellow cake mix (dry)
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
3  Tbsp. water
preparation: Lightly grease an 8 x 13-inch baking dish and spread apple pie filling on bottom.  Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons water.  Layer in the following order:  coconut, cake mix and pecans.  Slice 2 sticks margarine over this and bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes. Can be served warm with whipped cream or cooled.

name: Tomato Vinaigrette
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. olive oil
1 1/4  c. cider vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
24  oz. diced canned tomatoes, drained
1/3  c. white onion, chopped fine
1  tsp. white pepper
1 1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. minced fresh thyme
1  tsp. minced fresh basil
preparation: With mixer on slow, blend oil and vinegar.  Gradually add sugar; mix until sugar is dissolved.  Stir in tomatoes; add remaining ingredients.  Store in refrigerator for 24 hours prior to use.  Makes 1 quart.

name: SUNDAY STEW BEEF
ingredients:
2  lb. lean stew beef
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
1  can mushroom soup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Let beef  begin  to  boil.  Add  both  soups,  salt and pepper.  Continue  to  cook until done.  Has a very good brown gravy.

name: WACKY CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
3 heaping  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
5  Tbsp. melted shortening
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. water
preparation: Mix flour, cocoa, sugar, salt and soda.  Make 3 wells in these dry ingredients.  In one well, put melted shortening.   In second well, put the vanilla.  In third well, put the vinegar.  Pour water over entire mixture.  Beat thoroughly with fork.  Bake in square baking dish for 40 minutes at 350°.  Bake cupcakes for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. corn kits
1  can creamed corn
1  egg
1  large onion, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  jar jalapeno Cheez Whiz
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Saute ground beef until done and brown.  Wash and drain to remove grease.  Put back on heat, add salt and pepper.  Mix corn kit, corn, egg and onion.  Add Cheez Whiz and beef.  Mix well until Cheez Whiz is melted.  Pour into 9 x 12 x 2-inch well-greased pan. Bake in 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until brown.

name: JELLO PUNCH
ingredients:
2  boxes jello (strawberry or lime)
2  c. sugar
1  qt. boiling water
1  qt. cold water
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1/4  c. lemon juice
1 (32 oz.)  bottle ginger ale
preparation: Mix jello, sugar,  hot water and cold water; add pineapple juice and lemon;  stir  very well.	Put in gallon container and freeze.  When ready  to  serve,  add ginger ale.  Very good for parties and special occasions.

name: QUICK APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. diced, peeled tart apples
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. sugar
1  c. nuts, chopped
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Spread apples over bottom of pan. Pour over beaten eggs; mix.  Add sugar, oil, nuts and vanilla, turning with fork.  Add flour, cinnamon, soda and salt.  Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 325°.  Serve with Cool Whip.

name: CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
1  whole chicken
1 large  can tomato sauce
1  c. celery, diced
1  c. carrots, diced
5  lb. potatoes, cut in 1-inch cubes
1  pkg. lima beans
1  lb. pkg. egg noodles
any desired vegetables
preparation: Boil chicken in large pot until cooked.  Remove chicken and dice into small pieces.  Add tomato sauce and vegetables to chicken stock.  Cook until tender.  Add chicken and noodles.  Boil 10 minutes.

name: SALSA SAUCE
ingredients:
6  c. tomatoes, chopped & peeled
2  c. seeded chopped green pepper
1  c. seeded jalapeno peppers
3/4  c. chopped onions
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  cloves garlic, chopped
1 1/2  c. white vinegar
preparation: Combine ingredients, bring to boil for 30 minutes in open kettle.  Simmer 20 minutes. Put in jars and process for 20 minutes in boiling water.

name: CREOLE RICE AND TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. raw rice
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. oil
2  Tbsp. bacon drippings
1  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
1 (7 oz.)  can tuna
chopped green onion
preparation: Cook the rice and set it aside to cool.  Cook the eggs in the oil like you would for an omelet.  Remove it from the skillet and cut into small pieces.  Cook the onion, green pepper and celery in the skillet with the bacon drippings until just tender.  Add the rice, eggs and soy sauce and stir gently to mix.  Next, add the tuna which you have drained and flaked.  Place in casserole.  Bake at 425° until thoroughly heated.

name: VEGETABLE BEEF SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped potatoes
1  c. chopped carrots
1  c. chopped cabbage
1  c. chopped celery
1 (20 oz.)  can tomatoes
1/4  c. barley
6  c. water
1/2  tsp. basil
5  tsp. salt
1  bay leaf
1/2  tsp. thyme
pepper to taste
preparation: Brown the beef and onions. Add all the chopped vegetables and tomatoes; bring to a boil. Add the barley, water and all spices. Simmer for 1 hour.

name: COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
2  c. coconut
2  sticks margarine
2  c. milk
6  tsp. flour
preparation: Beat eggs and butter; add sugar and milk, one cup at a time. Then add flour and coconut.  Pour in a 9-inch pie shell.  Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
4  cloves garlic
1  large green pepper
16  oz. can tomatoes
1 small  can tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. basil
4 to 5  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
2 to 3  c. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  lb. hot sausage
1  large onion
1  lb. fresh mushrooms
12  oz. can tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. oregano
2  Tbsp. Italian seasoning
1  lb. box lasagna noodles
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Grease a large, deep baking dish or pan.  Cook noodles according to package directions and set aside.  Preheat oven to 400°.  Brown hamburger and sausage.  Mince garlic cloves and add to meat.  Chop onion, pepper and add to meat; cook until tender. Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and tomato paste.  Then add sliced mushrooms and dry seasonings.  Simmer about 30 minutes.  Layer in deep dish pan:  meat sauce, noodles, meat sauce, both kinds of cheese, noodles, meat sauce, cheeses, noodles, meat sauce, etc. until all is gone (2 to 3 layers).  End with cheese on top.  Bake until top is brown, approximately 20 to 30 minutes.  Serve hot.

name: BANANA PUNCH
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
6  c. water
5  bananas
1 (46 oz.) tall  can pineapple juice
3  lemons
6  oz. can frozen orange juice concentrate
preparation: Boil the first 2 ingredients until clear, then cool.  Mash the bananas to pulp (I use blender).  Add the bananas to the pineapple juice, juice of lemons and orange juice.  Add water to the orange juice as on can. Combine all juices and bananas with the syrup and freeze.  Before serving, thaw to slush and add 4 quarts of 7-Up.

name: OLD FITZGERALD BOURBON BALLS
ingredients:
5  c. crushed vanilla wafer crumbs
2  c. confectioners sugar
1/4  c. cocoa powder
2  c. chopped nuts
1/4  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. bourbon whiskey
additional powdered sugar
preparation: In a large bowl, combine crumbs, sugar, cocoa and nuts.  Stir with a large spoon.  Combine the liquids, whiskey and corn syrup. Mix them well with the dry ingredients.  Roll about a tablespoon of dough between the palms of your hands to form a ball. Roll the ball in additional powdered sugar.   Store in refrigerator or freezer.  Good keepers in storage.  Makes about 48 bourbon balls.

name: EASY CRANBERRY-APPLE SAUCE
ingredients:
3  tart apples
1/3  c. water
1  can whole berry cranberry sauce
preparation: Peel and cut apples (about eighths).  Boil apples in water for 10 minutes.  Add cranberry sauce.  Heat.  Serve warm.

name: CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
8  oz. box Cheddar cheese loaf (Velveeta)
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
8  oz. jar sharp Cheddar cheese spread
1/2  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. garlic powder (optional)
chili powder
paprika powder
preparation: Have all ingredients at room temperature.  Mix well with mixer.  Form into 2 or 3 balls.  Roll ball in 1/2 chili powder and 1/2 paprika or roll in chopped nuts.  Can be frozen for future use.

name: CABBAGE WITH CARAWAY
ingredients:
1  tsp. margarine
vegetable cooking spray
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. chicken flavored bouillon granules
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. caraway seed
8  c. shredded cabbage
preparation: Melt margarine in nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray. Add shredded cabbage and next four ingredients.  Cover and cook over medium heat 5 minutes.  Sprinkle with caraway seed.  Cover and cook 1 minute.

name: VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  container plain yogurt
1  plain yogurt container full of Hellmann's mayonnaise
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and dip prepared raw vegetables. Note!  Good on chips, too.

name: CRANBERRY SAUCE FOR ALL OCCASIONS
ingredients:
2  c. cranberries
3/4  c. water
2  c. applesauce (unsweetened)
9  packets Sweet 'N Low
2 to 3  drops orange extract
cinnamon
preparation: Combine cranberries, Sweet 'N Low, water and extract in saucepan.  Simmer until skins of berries pop open and sauce thickens.  Add applesauce and cinnamon and simmer again.  When thickened, divide evenly into 6 portions.

name: SHRIMP NADINE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ready to eat shrimp
2 to 3  Tbsp. onion
2 to 3  Tbsp. green pepper
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can mushroom soup
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: In a large frying pan, saute onion and pepper in 2 teaspoons butter. Add soup, sour cream and shrimp.  Stir until well blended. Serve over white rice.

name: SPRINGTIME SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime jello
3/4  c. boiling water
1  c. Carnation evaporated milk
9  oz. crushed pineapple, drained
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  c. creamed cottage cheese
1/4  c. chopped celery (originally 1/2 c. used)
1/4  c. mayonnaise (originally 1/2 c. used)
preparation: Mix the  jello	and boiling water; cool slightly.  Beat the Carnation milk  into  the  jello  mixture.	Fold  in  the remaining ingredients.  A very light and ono salad.

name: SPICE TEA
ingredients:
3  qt. water
1 1/2  tsp. allspice
1 1/2  tsp. whole cloves
4  sticks cinnamon
1 1/2  Tbsp. loose tea
1  can frozen lemon juice
1  can frozen orange juice
1  c. sugar or to taste
preparation: Bring water to a rolling boil.  Add allspice, cloves, cinnamon and tea.  Stir well.  Turn off and steep 20 minutes.  Strain, or spices and tea can be put in tea ball.  Add lemon juice, orange juice and sugar.  Mix well.

name: PIG PICKIN CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines Butter Recipe cake mix
1  can mandarin oranges (do not drain)
3  eggs
1/2  c. oil
preparation: Mix well at medium speed.  Bake in 325° oven.  Makes 2 long layers.  Frost with Pig Pickin Cake Frosting.

name: BEAN BURRITO BAKE(Serves 8)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (16 oz.)  can refried beans
1  c. baking mix
1/4  c. water
1  avocado, sliced
1  c. thick salsa
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Brown ground beef in skillet, stirring until crumbly; drain. Combine beans, baking mix and water in bowl; mix well.  Spread over bottom and halfway up side of greased 10-inch pie plate. Layer ground beef, avocado, salsa and cheese in prepared pie plate.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.   Cut into wedges; top with sour cream.

name: BEER NUTS
ingredients:
20  oz. bag raw Spanish peanuts with skins on
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
preparation: Electric skillet at 350°.  Combine all ingredients, and stir until dry.  Put on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Cool and store in airtight container.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
2  c. grated sharp cheese
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
chopped nuts
preparation: Combine first three ingredients together to form a ball.  Roll in chopped nuts and refrigerate.

name: UPSIDE-DOWN PIZZA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  can or jar pizza sauce
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
2  eggs
1/4  tsp. dried oregano leaves
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese, grated
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. oil
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. flour
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Meanwhile brown ground beef and onion. Pour off fat.  Blend in pizza sauce, garlic salt and oregano.  Put mixture in greased 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.

name: APPLE PIE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. hot water
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. chopped, raw apples
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar and egg.  Add sifted dry ingredients. Add hot water, vanilla, apple and nuts.  Grease pie pan and add mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Serve warm with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream or enjoy plain.

name: SKILLET CABBAGE SALAD
ingredients:
4  slices of bacon
1/4  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
4  c. shredded cabbage
1/2  c. finely chopped parsley
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp.  Remove from skillet and crumble.  Add vinegar, sugar, salt and onion to fat in the skillet.  Add crumbled bacon.  Heat thoroughly, take from stove and toss cabbage and parsley in the hot dressing.

name: SMORES FOR ONE
ingredients:
2  graham crackers
2  marshmallows
1  Hershey bar
preparation: Put marshmallows and chocolate bar between two layers of graham crackers. Eat warm or room temperature.

name: HAMBURGER HASH CHINESE STYLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  Tbsp. oil
2  medium onions, chopped
1  c. thickly sliced celery
1  can mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. rice
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can Chinese noodles
preparation: Brown ground beef in oil in skillet, stirring, until crumbly. Drain.  Add next 7 ingredients and 1 1/2 cups of warm water; mix well.  Put in baking dish.  Bake, covered, for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake another 30 minutes.  Top with noodles and bake 15 minutes longer.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. light Karo syrup
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
6  qt. cooked popcorn
preparation: Melt butter.  Stir in sugar, syrup and salt.  Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Boil without stirring for 5 minutes.  Take pan off heat and put in soda and vanilla.  Slowly pour over popcorn.  Bake at 250° for 1 hour.  Stir every 15 minutes.

name: COCONUT BON BONS
ingredients:
2  boxes powdered sugar
1  stick melted margarine
1  can Eagle Brand milk
2  c. chopped pecans
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. coconut
1  block paraffin wax
12  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl (except paraffin and chocolate chips); shape into balls (quarter size).  Chill in freezer about 10 minutes.  Melt wax and chips together in top of double boiler over 1 inch boiling water.  Dip balls in chocolate and place on wax paper.

name: GUATEMALAN CHICKEN AND RICE(Arroz Con Pollo Chapina)
ingredients:
3  lb. chicken, skin removed and cut into pieces
1  Tbsp. oil
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/2  cup chopped onion
1  garlic clove, minced
1/2  cup tomato, chopped
1  cup carrots, sliced
1/3  cup green olives
1  Tbsp. capers
2  1/2 cups chicken broth
1  cup green peas
1/2  cup red pimiento pepper cut in strips
1  hard boiled egg, sliced
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1  1/2 cups rice, optional
preparation: In a large skillet brown the chicken in the oil over medium heat for 20 minutes.  Sprinkle 1/2 tsp. salt and 1/4 tsp. black pepper over chicken.  Remove from skillet and set aside.  In the same skillet fry the onion, garlic and tomato for 2-3 minutes.  Add the carrots, olives and capers and mix well. pour in chicken broth and add cooked chicken back into skillet.  Bring to a boil, cover skillet and reduce heat.  Cook until broth has been absorbed, about 10-15 minutes.  Add peas.  Heat oven to 300F.  Cook rice.  Place chicken in baking dish and cover with foil, poke 6-8 holes in top of foil to allow the steam to escape.  Bake for 30 minutes, spoon mixture over chicken one time during baking.  Garnish with red pimento slices, egg slices and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Serve with rice, salsa and vegetables.  Serves 6.

name: BEEF BROTH
ingredients:
7  lb. beef bones or 3 1/2 lb. beef shanks
10  c. water
4  stalks celery, diced (may also include leaves)
1  large onion, chopped
3  carrots, diced
2  medium tomatoes, chopped
2  bay leaves
2 to 3  cloves garlic
1/4  tsp. thyme
1/4  tsp. marjoram
7  to 8 peppercorns
1  tsp. salt (optional)
preparation: Put beef bones or shank and water in a large stock pot. Simmer, uncovered, for 3 hours. Do not boil.  Strain.  Remove any meat from bones and save to use later in a soup.   Chill stock overnight.

name: MOM'S FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
butter
oil for frying
French bread or Italian bread or rolls (round or long)
preparation: Mix eggs and milk well; add cinnamon.  Cut bread into thick 1-inch slabs.  Dip bread into mix and allow to soak until saturated (about 30 seconds).  Fry in a large skillet in mix of oil and butter.  Eat plain, or with maple syrup, sprinkled with white or powdered sugar, or with more butter.

name: FROSTED NUT DELIGHT
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, whipped
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy.  Fold in eggs and sifted dry ingredients.  Add vanilla; mix well.   Spread batter onto a baking sheet as thinly as possible.  Frost.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  chicken (about 3 lb.)
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  pkg. frozen or fresh broccoli
grated cheese
crushed potato chips
preparation: Simmer chicken until tender.  Cook broccoli.  Remove chicken from bone, then layer chicken and broccoli alternately in a large casserole dish.  Combine soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice.  Pour mixture over chicken and broccoli.  Top with grated cheese and crushed potato chips.   Casserole can be made the night before but leave potato chips and cheese off until you are ready to put casserole in the oven.  Bake at 350°  for 1 hour.  Serves 10.

name: OLD FASHIONED HEAVENLY HASH
ingredients:
2  c. coconut
4  oranges
2  c. canned peaches
24  marshmallows
2  c. red cherries
2  c. canned crushed pineapple
2  c. whipping cream
preparation: Cut cherries, pineapple, oranges, marshmallows and peaches into very fine pieces.  Mix with coconut and refrigerate and chill for  1 hour.  Remove from refrigerator and fold in whipped cream. Put in trays or rectangular containers and freeze for 4 hours. Cut into squares and serve on lettuce leaves with mayonnaise as salad or alone as dessert.

name: SPARKLING FRUIT
ingredients:
3  medium peaches
2  c. sliced strawberries
2  c. blueberries
2  c. melon balls
3  medium bananas
1 (25.6 oz.)  bottle pink sparkling catawaba
grape juice, chilled
preparation: Slice peaches into bowl.  Top with other fruit.  Cover and refrigerate.  Just before serving, slice bananas into fruit mixture.  Pour catawaba over fruit and serve. Makes 10 portions.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
3  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. finely chopped green onions
8  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
3 large  pkg. Carl Buddig beef
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Chop beef finely.  Save one package for topping.  In large bowl, mix together well.  Roll into ball.  Cover ball with remaining package of chopped beef.  Serve with Ritz crackers.

name: GRILLED CHICKEN ORIENTAL
ingredients:
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. plus 3 tsp. honey, divided
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. Chinese sesame oil
1  inch piece ginger root, pared and mashed
1  small garlic clove, mashed
4  chicken cutlets (1/4 lb. each)
preparation: In 1/2-cup metal measure or other small flameproof container, combine soy sauce with 2 tablespoons honey and the oil, ginger and garlic and cook, stirring frequently, until mixture is warm, about one minute.  Transfer to self-sealing plastic bag or medium bowl (not aluminum).  Add chicken and turn to coat with marinade. Seal bag or cover bowl and let stand 10 minutes to marinate.  In small metal measuring cup heat remaining 2 teaspoons honey over low heat until melted; set aside.

name: ZUCCHINI DELUXE
ingredients:
3  large or 4 medium zucchini squash
6  slices bacon
1  small onion, sliced
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese, grated or sliced
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp.  Cool to touch, then crumble.  Saute zucchini in small amount of light olive oil, along with the sliced onion.  When zucchini is tender, add crumbled bacon to skillet and mix with zucchini and onion.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Cover skillet and cook over low heat until cheese melts.  Delicious!

name: BARBECUE BOATS
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. cut up celery
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. catsup
1/3  c. water
1/4  c. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. white vinegar
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3/4 to 1  lb. whole bologna, cut into strips
preparation: In skillet, cook onion and celery in butter until tender. Stir in catsup, water, brown sugar, vinegar, mustard and Worcestershire sauce.  Add the cut bologna strips into large skillet pan.  Simmer, uncovered, for about 15 minutes.  Put in a bun and enjoy.

name: FROZEN PEACHES AND CREAM MOUSSE
ingredients:
4  c. peaches (fresh) or 1 (16 oz.) frozen peaches, thawed
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
raspberry sauce
1/4  c. sugar
1  qt. vanilla ice cream
preparation: Puree peaches in  food processor or blender.  In medium mixing bowl, combine  pureed  peaches,  sour  cream, sugar and lemon juice.  In large mixing bowl, stir ice cream, just until softened; fold in peach mixture.  Turn into the Jel-ring mold. Apply seal and  freeze  several hours or overnight until firm. If desired, fill  center  of unmolded dessert with fresh raspberries;  drizzle with  some  of  the  raspberry sauce.  Spoon remaining mixture over  and  around the dessert.  Garnish with peach slices and mint leaves; serve.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: STUFFED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburg
3/4  c. cooked long grain rice
1  small onion
salt and pepper
1  egg
1 large  can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. water
1  large cabbage
preparation: Mix hamburg with beaten egg. Add rice, grated onion, salt and pepper.  Soften cabbage in hot water.  Mix tomato sauce, sugar, vinegar and water. Take leaf of cabbage and add meat mixture. Make rolls.  Tuck cabbage ends in.  Place in liquid and cook about 3/4 hour.

name: CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger, browned
1  lb. hot sausage, browned
1  chopped onion, cooked with meat
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Mix together and melt cheese over low heat.  Serve with corn chips.

name: MEXICAN FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
1  (20 oz.) crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, soda and salt.  Add beaten eggs, pineapple and nuts.  Bake in a 9 x 12-inch pan at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
6  cups water
4  cups chopped broccoli or cauliflower
1  c. diced onion
6  chicken bouillon cubes
1/2  lb. butter
16  oz. cheese whiz
1  c. shredded cheddar cheese
1  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook broccoli and onion in 2 cups water.  In another pan add bouillon cubes and 4 cups water.  Bring almost to a boil.  Make a roux of butter (flour 1/4 c.).  Stir into bouillon mixture, add broccoli, onion, water, cheese and stir until melted.

name: APPLE CAKE WITH VANILLA PUDDING(Eplekake Med Vanilje Pudding)
ingredients:
250  gr. margarine (2 sticks plus 2 Tbsp.)
90  gr. powdered sugar (slightly less than 1 c.)
250  gr. flour (2 c.)
preparation: Cook your favorite vanilla pudding and let it cool.  Grease a 9 x 1 1/2-inch spring-form pan.  Blend flour, sugar and margarine and mix as for a pie crust.  Divide dough; take 2/3 and press on bottom and sides of the pan.  Peel 4 big apples and slice; arrange them in the pan.  Pour cooled pudding over the apples.  Roll out the rest of the dough and cover the cake.  Bake at 400° for about 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
3  lb. chicken
1  onion, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. margarine
1/3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
pepper
1 1/3  c. water
1 1/3  c. Minute rice
preparation: Flour chicken and brown in butter.  Combine other ingredients. Pour half over rice prepared according to box directions.  Lay chicken on top and pour remainder of liquid over the chicken. Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 30 minutes or longer.

name: EASY BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Mix flour, salt and baking powder in a bowl.  Measure oil and milk in same measuring cup; add to flour mixture.  Make into biscuits.  Bake in a 450° oven for 10 minutes.

name: JEAN'S PIE CRUST(Makes 13 Double Pie Crusts or 26 Individual Crusts)
ingredients:
1 (3 lb.)  can Crisco
1  tsp. salt
3  c. cold water
5 to 6  lb. flour
preparation: Mix together Crisco, salt and cold water.  Gradually add into flour mixture.  Work in good with hands.  Can freeze in individual balls or roll into single shells or double crust.

name: CHERRY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3 3/4  c. plain flour
1 1/2  c. Crisco
3/4  c. milk
6  eggs
1  tsp. almond flavoring
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped cherries
preparation: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Add milk and flour alternately.  Add flavorings and cherries.  Bake at 275° 2 hours in a greased tube pan.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  bag frozen hash brown potatoes (with onions and red peppers)
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  stick melted margarine
1/2  stick melted margarine
1 1/2  c. Kellogg's corn flakes
preparation: Thaw hash browns.  Mix first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour, covered with foil.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bacon, sliced in bite size pieces
3  Tbsp. bacon drippings
1  c. rice
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  lb. can tomatoes
2  c. water
1/4  c. catsup
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and reserve 3 tablespoons drippings.  Saute rice, onion and green pepper in drippings.  Add bacon and remaining ingredients.  Cover and simmer 45 minutes.

name: CHICKEN/CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  small onion, minced
1/4  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Boil chicken breasts until tender (season with salt and pepper as desired), then dice.  Mix all ingredients together; form into one large or two smaller balls.  Roll in chopped pecans mixed with parsley flakes.  Chill.  Serve with crackers.

name: BANANA DATE-NUT COOKIES
ingredients:
3  medium, ripe bananas
2  c. rolled oats
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. chopped pitted dates
1/3  c. frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
1/4  c. canola oil
1/2  tsp. almond or vanilla extract
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Mix all ingredients thoroughly in a large bowl and let stand about 5 minutes to absorb moisture.  Drop cookies by large spoonfuls onto lightly oiled baking sheet about 1 inch apart.  Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

name: EASY BROWN SUGAR COBBLER(Serves 8)
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. milk
1  c. brown sugar
2  c. fresh sliced fruit or berries, peaches, pears, apples, pineapple, blueberries, blackberries, raspberries, strawberries or any combination
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and place in oven to melt.  Mix together the flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, brown sugar and milk to make a batter. Remove the hot dish with the melted butter from the oven and pour in the batter.  Evenly spoon the fruit with its juices over the batter.  Place the dish back in oven and bake until batter is browned and has risen up and around the fruit, about 35 to 45 minutes.  Serve warm with vanilla ice cream, if desired.

name: ROCKY ROAD CAKE
ingredients:
1  box devil's food cake mix with the pudding in it
1  c. chopped walnuts, raisins or currants
1  c. miniature marshmallows
6  oz. pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
4  eggs
1  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1  c. water
preparation: Grease and flour 12-cup Bundt pan.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix cake mix, mayonnaise, eggs and water until blended.  Turn mix 2 minutes at medium speed.  Blend in nuts, etc.  Bake 50 to 60 minutes.  Serve plain or dust with 10x sugar.

name: PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. top round steak
1  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  beef bouillon cube
1/2  c. hot water
1  green pepper, cut in 1-inch squares
2  c. fresh sliced mushrooms
2  Tbsp. dry white wine
salt and pepper
preparation: Slice steak diagonally into 1/8-inch thick strips.  (Steak will slice easier if nearly frozen.)  Melt butter in skillet.  Add onion and cook until limp.  Remove from pan.  Add meat to skillet and brown on either side.  Return onion to skillet.  Dissolve bouillon in water; add to meat, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Add green pepper and mushrooms.   Cover and cook 5 minutes.  Add salt, pepper and wine; let cook 5 minutes longer.

name: 1-2-3 CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. softened butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  can frosting (chocolate or vanilla)
preparation: Beat shortening until fluffy, then gradually beat in sugar. Next, beat in eggs, one at a time, then vanilla.  Sift dry ingredients together.  Beat into creamed mixture alternately a little at a time with milk.  Bake in greased tube pan for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out dry.  Bake at 350°.  Cool on rack for 10 minutes, then turn out on rack to cool completely, then frost.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
2  eggs
1  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. pumpkin
1 2/3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Mix all together well.  Bake in two greased loaf pans for 45 to 60 minutes or until done at 350°.

name: MARINATED SALAD
ingredients:
3 medium  bunches broccoli (broken in bite size)
1  large cauliflower
1  c. vinegar (cider)
1 1/2  c. salad oil
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. dill
1  Tbsp. Accent
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Mix ingredients well.  Pour over broccoli and cauliflower. Marinate several hours, stirring occasionally.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
2  cans artichokes, chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
1  pkg. Italian dressing mix
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Serve warm or cold with Melba toast or tortilla chips.

name: REUBEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  qt. sauerkraut, drained
8  oz. noodles, cooked
1 (12 oz.)  can corned beef, shredded
3/4  c. chopped onions
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  c. Swiss cheese, shredded
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. mustard
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
seasoned bread crumbs
preparation: Layer in a 9 x 12-inch baking dish:  sauerkraut, noodles, onions and corned beef.  Mix soup with mayonnaise and mustard; pour over layered ingredients.  Sprinkle cheeses on top.  Cover with seasoned bread crumbs.  Drizzle melted margarine over top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: NO BAKE STRAWBERRY OR RASPBERRY TORTE
ingredients:
25  graham crackers
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/4  c. sugar
1  lb. miniature marshmallows
1  c. milk
1  qt. raspberries or strawberries, drained
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  pt. Cool Whip
preparation: Crush graham crackers, saving 1/4 cup for top.  Melt butter or margarine.  Mix butter, graham crackers and sugar.  Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: BLONDE BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. salt
2/3  c. margarine
2  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. nuts
1  c. chocolate chips
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add eggs, then chips and nuts, then dry ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in cake pan (20 minutes in a heavy roaster lid).  Cut into squares.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. bell pepper, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  can mushroom soup
1  can tomato soup
1  can tomato paste
1  can tomato sauce
1  c. celery, chopped
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
garlic to taste
2  sticks butter
preparation: Melt butter and brown pepper, onion and celery.  Mix together tomato soup, paste, sauce and mushroom soup.  Heat ground beef in small amount of water and drain when cooked.  Add to sauce Worcestershire sauce and garlic; cook for 2 hours slowly.  Add salt and pepper, if desired.

name: SOFT SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
2  tsp. vanilla
3 1/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening.  Add eggs.  Combine dry ingredients and add alternately with milk.  Add vanilla.  Drop from teaspoon onto a cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Ice with powdered sugar icing while warm.

name: HI-HAT SALADS
ingredients:
sliced pineapple
cottage cheese
cranberry sauce
lettuce
preparation: Place 1 slice of pineapple on each lettuce leaf.  Spread each slice of pineapple with cottage cheese.  Add a thick sliced of jellied cranberry sauce.  Top with a dollop of cottage cheese in the center.

name: FRUIT CAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. cherries
1/2  lb. pecans
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  lb. pineapple
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. butter
2  eggs
preparation: Cut cherries, pineapple and chopped nuts.  Cream together butter and sugar.  Add eggs.  Add flour mixture which is flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon.  Then add fruits and nuts.  Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: TARAMASALATA, FISH ROE DIPGREECE
ingredients:
1/3 of an 8  oz. jar Tarama
1  small Onion, finely grated
1-2 c. Olive oil
4-5 slices White bread
2-3 Lemons, juice of
preparation: Mash the Tarama and add the grated onion. Add a little of the olive oil and beat thoroughly to a smooth paste.  Moisten the bread and squeeze out the excess water.  Continue beating Tarama mixture, adding alternately small bits of moistened bread, olive oil and lemon juice.  Taramasalata should be beaten until cream colored. Serve as a dip with crackers or spread on toast. Makes 1 1/2-2 cups.

name: TARTAR SAUCE
ingredients:
1  tsp. grated onion
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1 small  bottle stuffed green olives, chopped very fine
1  bunch parsley, chopped
preparation: Mix together all ingredients.  Chill.  Serve with seafood or steaks.

name: EASY VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. Ranch dressing
16  oz. cottage cheese
16  oz. sour cream
16  oz. mayonnaise
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Serve with raw veggies.

name: MILE HIGH STRAWBERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. flour
1/4  c. chopped nuts
2  egg whites
1  tsp. lemon juice
15  oz. pkg. frozen strawberries with juice, thawed
1  c. sugar
preparation: Beat ingredients for no less than 15 minutes.  This mixture should fill a large mixing bowl.  Fold into this mixture 1/2 pint of whipping cream, whipped, or 8 ounces Cool Whip.  Pour into pan, over prepared crumbs, and cover with remaining crumbs.  Put into freezer until frozen.

name: ORANGE MARMALADE
ingredients:
1  grapefruit, sliced thin
1  orange, sliced thin
1  lemon, sliced thin
sugar
preparation: Cover fruit with 3 times its bulk of cold water.  Let stand overnight.  Boil for 10 minutes.  Let stand overnight.  Bring to rolling boil; add equal quantity sugar.  Cook until jelled.  Pour in open dish for 24 hours.  Place in jars or dishes without reheating.

name: APPLE PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. apples, cut fine
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  egg
preparation: Sprinkle sugar over apples.  Let stand while mixing together flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Break egg over apples; mix well.  Then mix with other ingredients and bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: TEXAS HASH(Very Good! Try It)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3  large onions
1  large bell pepper
1/2  c. instant rice (Minute)
1  can tomatoes
2  tsp. chili powder or 1/2 pkg. chili seasoning
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown meat, onions and pepper.  Add rice; add tomatoes, seasoning, salt and pepper to taste.  Pour mixture into casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
3/4  stick butter
1  c. self-rising flour
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. sweetened fruit (blueberries, peaches or apples)*
preparation: *I usually use more fruit than it calls for.

name: CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
2 or 3  c. boiled chicken, deboned
4  boiled eggs, sliced
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  can cream of chicken soup or cream of celery soup
1  stick margarine
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. milk
black pepper to taste
preparation: Place chicken in casserole dish.  Add eggs.  Mix broth and soup.  Pour over chicken.  Melt margarine.  Add flour and milk and mix.  Pour over chicken.  Bake at 375° until crust is brown. Batter will form crust.

name: GREEK SALAD FOR TWO
ingredients:
1  c. romaine lettuce
1  c. iceberg lettuce
1/4  cucumber, sliced
1/4  green pepper, sliced
1/4  red onion, sliced
1/2  stalk celery, chopped
4  wedges tomato
2  Tbsp. Feta cheese
1/2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. Italian dressing
black olives (garnish)
croutons (garnish)
preparation: In large bowl, mix both lettuces and two cheeses.  Place on salad plates and arrange vegetables so they look nice.  Pour dressing over and serve with croutons.

name: TAMALE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
1  onion, diced and browned (optional)
1  can diced tomatoes
2  cans Ranch Style beans
1 large  can tamales, peeled and sliced or 1 doz. fresh tamales, peeled and sliced
2  cans cream style corn
preparation: Dump all ingredients together in a large stew pan. Cover and simmer to taste.

name: MINTS
ingredients:
1  stick real butter
2  tsp. cream, heated
1  lb. confectioners sugar
mint flavoring oil or extract to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients in mixer.  Add more sugar to make firm. Roll between wax paper.  Cut with center of doughnut cutter. Decorate as desired.  May also be tinted with food coloring. Makes 125 to 150 mints.

name: BRANDY SLUSH(Wonderful For Holidays Or Parties!)
ingredients:
7  c. water
2  c. sugar
2  c. water
4  tea bags
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1  fifth brandy
preparation: Boil and cool 7 cups water and sugar in large pot.  In another pot, put 2 cups water.  Add tea bags.  Boil and cool.  When both pots are cool, mix together and add orange juice, lemonade and brandy.  Freeze overnight.  Fill 1/2 glass with slush and 1/2 with ginger ale.  Garnish with a cherry.  Wonderful!

name: PINEAPPLE PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. sugar
1  c. whipping cream
preparation: Beat eggs thoroughly.  Add sugar, pineapple and flour.  Cook in a double boiler until thick.  Let cool.  Whip the cream and add to the mixture.  Pour into baked pie crust and top with vanilla wafer crumbs.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1  box plain macaroni
3  large eggs
1  green pepper
1  small onion
1  Star-Kist tuna
pinch of salt and pepper
mayonnaise or salad dressing
preparation: Wash all vegetables.  Boil water until it starts bubbling. Pour macaroni out of box into boiling water.  While noodles are cooking, boil your eggs.  Let macaroni cook 15 minutes, or until desired tenderness.  Drain macaroni, peel eggs, cut eggs into macaroni, then add mayonnaise, diced green pepper, onion and tuna. Add to the macaroni, then add a pinch of salt and pepper.  Mix together and refrigerate and serve cool.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
3  eggs
1 (16 oz.)  can (2 c.) canned pumpkin
1  c. seedless raisins
1  c. salted peanuts
preparation: Mix  sugar,  eggs,  vegetable oil and pumpkin together. Sift all  dry  ingredients  together and add to first mixture. Grease and  flour two loaf pans or 10-inch tube pan.  Bake for 1 hour and 15  minutes  at 350°.  Cool for 10 minutes on rack before removing from pan.

name: CHICKUMBER CHOWDER
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/4  tsp. white pepper
3  c. chicken broth
5  medium cucumbers, peeled, halved lengthwise, seeded and diced
1  c. cubed cooked turkey or chicken
1/2  c. long grain rice
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  bay leaves
1  c. light cream
1/4  c. snipped parsley
preparation: In a three quart saucepan, saute onion in butter or margarine until tender but not brown.  Blend in flour, salt and pepper. Stir in chicken broth.  Cook and stir until thick and bubbly.  Add cucumber.  Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.  Pour half the mixture at a time into a blender or food processor.  Cover and blend on medium for 30 seconds.  Return all the mixture to saucepan.

name: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry flavor Jell-O gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen concentrated lemonade
3  c. thawed Cool Whip
1 (16 oz.)  can sliced peaches
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can pear halves
preparation: Drain and chop fruits.  Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.  Add concentrate and stir until thickened.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Blend in whipped topping and fold in fruit.

name: RUSSIAN TEA
ingredients:
3  qt. water
6  family size tea bags
4 oranges or 1 small  can frozen orange juice
4  lemons
4  or 5 cinnamon sticks
a few whole cloves
1 large  can pineapple juice
1  bottle ginger ale
preparation: While tea is simmering, put in lemon, cinnamon and cloves. Strain and add juices.  Sweeten to taste.

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA
ingredients:
2  cans biscuits
1  c. raw broccoli
1  c. raw cauliflower
1  c. raw shredded carrots
1  c. shredded cheese
16  oz. sour cream
8  oz. cream cheese
1  pkg. Ranch dressing mix
preparation: Place biscuits on cookie sheet.  Let cool.  Open biscuits on cookie sheet.  Mix with mixer until blended well sour cream, cream cheese and Ranch dressing mix.  Spread on top of a biscuit, then sprinkle carrots, cauliflower, broccoli and cheese on top.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE FOR CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. water
1  c. vinegar
1/2  butter
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients together; place in a spray bottle. Spray over chicken as it is cooking.

name: WALNUT PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. corn syrup
1/4  c. melted butter
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. broken walnuts
preparation: Mix in order given.  Pour in a 9-inch unbaked pie crust.  Bake 50 minutes at 375°.

name: STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
1 (12 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. cooked rice
1/4  c. A.1. steak sauce
1/4  tsp. ground black pepper
6  large green peppers
preparation: In skillet, over medium heat, brown meat and cook onion until done;  pour off drippings.  Stir in corn, tomato sauce, rice, steak  sauce  and pepper; set aside.  Cut tops off peppers; remove seeds.  Spoon meat mixture into peppers; arrange in a 9 x 9-inch baking pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until peppers are done.

name: ANGELA PIA
ingredients:
3  eggs, separated
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  tsp. vanilla
1  envelope Knox unflavored gelatine
1/2  c. sugar
1  oz. brandy
1  oz. rum
preparation: Beat egg yolks until light and lemon colored.  Add sugar gradually and continue beating until creamy mass results.  Add brandy and rum.  Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry.  Whip cream until stiff enough to stand in firm, shiny peaks.  Add vanilla.

name: BUFFALO CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. Chicken wings
1/3  cup all purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. Ground black pepper
3  c. vegetable oil
3  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. Red wine vinegar
2  Tbsp. Hot red pepper sauce or to taste
Celery Sticks
Blue cheese dressing or Ranch dressing
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Remove and discard the wing tips and separate each wing into 2 pieces at the joint.  Trim excess fat and skin. On a plate, stir together the flour, salt and pepper.  Coat the wings with the flour mixture and shake off the excess.  Heat oil in a deep fryer or deep, heavy pot to 375°.  Heat over medium heat until a corner of a wing held in oil makes a lively sizzle.  Add as many wings as will fit in a single layer without crowding; fry, turning once, until golden brown and cooked through, about 10 minutes.  Drain on paper towels and keep warm on a baking sheet in the oven.  Repeat with remaining wings.  Heat butter in a small saucepan over low heat until foaming.  Remove from the heat and stir in red wine vinegar and hot red pepper sauce.  Transfer the wings to a large mixing bowl, pour the sauce over the wings and toss until evenly coated.  Taste and adjust the seasonings.  Serve hot with celery sticks and dressing of your choice.

name: BRUNCH FOR A BUNCH
ingredients:
1/2  lb. pan sausage
1 1/2  c. hash browns
6  eggs
1  c. milk
1/4  c. bell pepper
1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Place hash browns in pan; salt lightly.  Brown sausage and drain.  Place over potatoes.  Put pepper and cheese over sausage. Beat eggs; add milk and a little salt.  Pour over all.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: SOFT AND CHEWY MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. plus 3 Tbsp. butter
1 1/4  c. sugar, divided
1/4  c. molasses
1  egg
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. ground ginger
3/4  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and 1 cup sugar; blend in molasses and egg.  Combine flour, baking soda, cinnamon,  ginger and cloves; add to creamed mixture and blend well.  Shape dough into 1 1/4-inch balls.  Roll balls in remaining sugar.  Place on greased cookie sheets.  Press flat with a fork.  Bake at 350° for about 10 to 12 minutes.  Yields about 4 dozen.

name: CHICKEN IN WINE
ingredients:
pieces of cut-up chicken
flour
salt
oregano
margarine
2  red onions, sliced
1  c. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1  green pepper, chopped
1  can frozen orange juice concentrate
1 juice  can red wine
preparation: Dust the chicken in mixture of flour, salt and oregano.  Brown lightly.  One at a time, saute the vegetables.  Place chicken pieces in a casserole dish and place the sauteed vegetables on top.  Add the orange juice and wine.  Cover and bake at 350° at least 2 hours, basting occasionally.  Serve with rice prepared as follows:  To cooked rice, add 1 stick margarine, 1/2 cup salted, chopped peanuts, cinnamon and ginger.

name: CHICKEN-BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  whole chicken
1  small onion
salt and pepper
1  container sour cream
1  can cream of broccoli soup
1/2  pkg. Stove Top chicken stuffing
preparation: Cook chicken with onion, salt and pepper until tender.  Let chicken cool.  Pick meat from bones and cut into small pieces.

name: WACKY CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. melted shortening or oil
1  c. cold water
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Sift flour, cocoa, sugar, soda and salt together in a bowl. Add shortening or oil, water and vinegar; mix well.  Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch baking pan.  Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.  This is a very soft cake, best frosted in the baking pan.  Use any frosting, or top with whipped cream.  Also good plain.

name: SQUASH AU GRATIN
ingredients:
2  c. squash
1/2  stick butter
2  eggs
1/3  c. grated cheese
toasted bread crumbs
salt and pepper
preparation: Boil tender squash with a little onion.  Cream well while warm.  Add butter, cheese, eggs (beaten lightly) and 1 tablespoon bread crumbs to make light batter.  Reserve a little of the bread crumbs and cheese.  Put in casserole; cover with bread crumbs and the cheese.  Bake.

name: SEVEN LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head iceberg lettuce, torn in pieces
2 (9 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, cook peas in microwave first, then cool
2  bunches celery, chopped fine
2  sweet onions, cut in half and sliced thin
1/4  Tbsp. sugar
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
sliced mushrooms
bacon bits
preparation: Layer the following in a deep glass dish:  lettuce, peas, celery, onions and sugar.  Dollop mayonnaise on top.  Cover with Saran Wrap.  Refrigerate overnight.  Next day add mushrooms and bacon bits.  Toss.

name: SWEET PICKLES
ingredients:
2  c. lime
2  gal. water
8  lb. cucumbers
9  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. salt
2  qt. whole vinegar
1  tsp. whole cloves
1  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Tie spices in a bag.  Dissolve lime in water.  Put in cucumbers which have been sliced.  Let soak for 24 hours.  Remove and wash well in 3 or 4 changes of water.  Make a solution of the sugar, salt, vinegar and spices.  Pour over pickles and let soak 3 hours, then boil 30 minutes to seal.

name: SQUARE CHOCOLATE BIT
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  Tbsp. water
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. coconut
1  Tbsp. cocoa
40  graham crackers or 3 1/2 c., crushed fine
1/2  c. walnuts, cut fine
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix butter, cocoa, water, sugar and eggs in casserole.  Place on light fire, boiling 1 minute.  Add the rest of ingredients and mix in vanilla.  Place in square dishes of 8-inch.  Cool off and frost or use your own choice of icing.

name: TUNA-CHIP SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, torn
3  stalks celery, chopped
4  green onions, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1/2  cucumber, chopped
6  radishes, sliced
1 (10 oz.)  can white tuna, drained
1 medium  pkg. potato chips, crushed
mayonnaise
preparation: Combine  lettuce,  vegetables  and  tuna in a bowl; mix well. Chill.  Add chips and enough mayonnaise to moisten just before serving; mix well.	Yields 6 servings.

name: PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. crushed pretzels
1 1/4  c. melted oleo
3  Tbsp. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. sugar (optional)
2  c. whipped topping
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
preparation: Mix the crushed pretzels, oleo and 3 tablespoons sugar.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes. Mix the cream cheese, sugar and whipped topping; spread on cooled mix.  Mix well the strawberry jello, boiling water and frozen strawberries.  Pour over cheese layer.  Let mixture jell slightly 10 minutes in refrigerator.

name: SWEDISH ANGEL LEMON PIE
ingredients:
4  egg whites
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. sugar
4  egg yolks
1/4  c. sugar
juice and grated rind of 1 lemon
1  c. whipping cream, whipped
preparation: Beat the egg whites until frothy, then add cream of tartar. Beat until stiff and then gradually add 1 cup sugar.  Spread in a buttered 9-inch pie pan and bake at 300° for about 25 minutes or until meringue is set and slightly brown.  Beat egg yolks until thick.  Add 1/4 cup sugar, lemon juice and rind.  Cook in double boiler, stirring until thickened.  (If after cooking the filling becomes too thick, add 2 tablespoons hot water.)  When meringue and filling are cool, whip the cream.  Blend half of the whipped cream with the filling and spread over meringue.  Spread with remaining whipped cream.  Serves 8.

name: CHICKEN A LA
ingredients:
3  lb. chicken wings
1/2  c. butter
1/4  c. honey
1/4  c. prepared mustard
1  tsp. curry powder
preparation: Melt butter.  Combine rest of ingredients, except chicken, with butter.  Coat chicken wings with mixture.  Bake wings skin side down, for 1/2 hour at 350°.  Turn and continue baking for 15 to 20 minutes or until browned and tender.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1  bottle McCormick Salad Supreme
1  lb. spaghetti, cooked
1  bottle Italian dressing
carrots, chopped
celery, chopped
green peppers, chopped
preparation: Cook spaghetti and drain.  Mix Salad Supreme, dressing, spaghetti and vegetables.  Refrigerate.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1 large  can pineapple, drained
1 large  can cherry pie filling
1  c. shredded coconut
1  box yellow or white cake mix
1  c. chopped nuts
2  sticks margarine, melted
preparation: Grease	a  9 x 13-inch pan.  Layer pineapple and cherry pie filling.  Sprinkle coconut on top.	Add dry cake mix.  (Do not mix!)  Sprinkle  the  nuts	and  then  drizzle the melted margarine  over  the  top.	Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

name: TEXAS HASH
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. shortening
2  large onions, sliced
2  green peppers, sliced
1  lb. ground beef
2  c. canned tomatoes
1  c. cooked rice
1  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Melt shortening in a skillet.  Saute the sliced onions and green peppers until tender.  Add ground beef; cook until there is no pink left in the meat, stirring with a fork to make it crumble. Add tomatoes, rice and seasoning.  Arrange in a 9-inch square baking dish; top with bread crumbs.  Brown slowly in a 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: MICROWAVE WILTED LETTUCE/SPINACH
ingredients:
1  lb. leaf lettuce
2  spring onions
1/2  grated carrot
grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. Zesty Italian dressing
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
black pepper
preparation: Wash lettuce or spinach well.  Remove thick stems and discard. Spin in salad spinner to remove all water.  Slice the white part of the onions thin and cut the tops in 1/2-inch pieces.  Mix onion and carrot in dressing.  Put in microwave until hot and bubbly.  Add lettuce and toss until lettuce is all wilted.  Serve with pepper and cheese sprinkled on top.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD(Easy, Delightful, Cold Summer Salad)
ingredients:
4  heads broccoli
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. sour cream
1/2  c. sunflower seeds
1/2  lb. bacon (optional)
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Steam broccoli flowerheads until just crisp.  Add Feta cheese. Pour vinaigrette dressing over all.  Serve warm or cold.

name: SESAME TOPPED BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1 medium  bunch broccoli
2  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/3  c. water
2  tsp. toasted sesame seed
preparation: Cut broccoli in 2-inch pieces.  In 10-inch skillet over high heat, heat butter, soy sauce and water to boiling.  Stir in broccoli.  Reduce heat to low, cover and cook approximately 7 minutes or until tender-crisp.  Sprinkle with sesame seed.

name: BAKED CARROT RING
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots, cut in 1-inch pieces
3  eggs
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/8  tsp. white pepper
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. (1 stick) melted margarine
cooked carrot slices for garnish (optional)
preparation: Cook carrot pieces until tender.  In a blender or processor, puree the carrots until smooth, about 30 seconds.  Blend in the eggs, one at a time, then add the sugar, flour, salt, cinnamon, pepper, milk and butter.  Bake in buttered 10-cup casserole dish in 350° oven for 50 minutes to 1 hour or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

name: APPLE BUTTER
ingredients:
3  bushels apples (Stamen or Roman Beauty)
1  gal. water
25  lb. sugar
1 1/2  bottles cinnamon
3  bags cinnamon candy
preparation: You will need a brass kettle.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  or 3 medium zucchini, chopped
1/2  lb. sausage
1/4  c. onions
1/2  c. crackers, crushed
1/4 to 1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. thyme
dash of garlic salt
preparation: Cook zucchini and reserve 1/3 cup liquid.  Fry sausage and onions.  Drain.  Combine all ingredients and top with cracker crumbs and butter.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CREAM CHEESE FROSTING
ingredients:
3  oz. cream cheese (1/3 c.)
4  tsp. fruit juice or cream
1/8  tsp. salt
2 1/2  c. sifted 10x sugar
preparation: Stir in cream cheese with juice or cream.  Add salt. Gradually add enough 10x sugar to give a good spreading consistency; beat until creamy.  Makes enough for 1 1/2 dozen cupcakes or 2 layer cake.

name: OATMEAL CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. water
1  tsp. soda
1  c. quick oats
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Bring water to boil; add oats.  Let stand 30 minutes.  Cream butter and sugar.  Beat eggs into mixture.  Sift dry ingredients together.  Add to creamed mixture.  Add oats; beat well.  Bake for 35 minutes at 350°.

name: APPLESAUCE SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. water, divided
2 1/2  c. unsweetened applesauce
2  Tbsp. Sweet 'N Low
3  Tbsp. ground cinnamon
2  Tbsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. raisins
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. vegetable oil
3  c. self-rising flour
1/4  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Combine 2 1/2 cups water and raisins in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil.  Boil until water evaporates.  Remove from heat. Add applesauce, eggs, Sweet 'N Low, oil and remaining 1/2 cup water.  Stir until well combined.  Sift flour, cinnamon and soda. Gradually add to applesauce with vanilla, stirring after each addition.  Spoon into a 10-inch Bundt pan coated with Pam.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.  Cool in pan 10 minutes.  Remove and cool on a wire rack.

name: COPPER PENNIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. salad oil
1  c. tomato soup
3/4  c. vinegar
1  small pepper, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt
pepper
sliced carrots
preparation: Cook carrots until done.  Mix everything else together.  Pour mixture and carrots together and refrigerate 1/2 hour.   Better if carrots are barely tender.

name: MICROWAVE PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/8  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1 to 1 1/2  c. roasted, salted peanuts
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Combine sugar, syrup and salt in 2-quart microwave casserole and microwave on High 5 minutes.  Stir in peanuts.  Microwave 3 to 5 minutes, stirring after 3 minutes until syrup and peanuts are lightly browned.  Stir in butter, vanilla and soda until light and foamy.  Spread 1/4-inch thick on large, well buttered cookie sheet.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1  c. frozen shrimp soup
3  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. lemon juice
dash of garlic powder
dash of paprika
preparation: Thaw shrimp soup and soften cream cheese.  Add lemon juice, garlic powder, dash of paprika and soup.  Do not overbeat (makes dip thin).  Chill.  Makes 1 1/2 cups.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Cheddar cheese, grated
1 small  can deviled ham
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  tsp. parsley flakes (optional)
chopped nuts
preparation: Have cheese at room temperature.  Grate sharp cheese.  Mix all together.  Put in refrigerator and let cool.  Take out and form into balls (one large or two or three small ones).   Roll in chopped nuts.  Wrap in Saran Wrap and store in refrigerator.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
2 1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. milk
3  egg yolks, beaten
1/2  c. peanut butter (creamy)
1  (9-inch) pastry shell
whipped cream or topping
preparation: In saucepan, stir together sugar, cornstarch, flour and salt. Gradually add milk.  Cook; stir over medium-high heat until thickened and bubbly.  Reduce heat; cook and stir 2 minutes longer.  Remove from heat.  Stir about 1 cup of mixture into egg yolks.  Return all to saucepan.  Return to heat.  Bring to a gentle boil, stirring constantly.  Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter until smooth.  Pour into pastry shell; cool.  Cover and refrigerate.  Garnish with whipped cream or topping.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BLOSSOMS
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
4  Tbsp. milk
3 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and chill.  Roll dough in small balls and roll in sugar.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Take out of oven and place a Hershey's Kiss on top immediately.

name: SHANGHAI HAM
ingredients:
4  lb. fresh pork ham, butt or shoulder
1  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. sugar or less
1  Tbsp. dry sherry
2  slices ginger root or 2 cloves garlic
3 to 4  cloves star anise
1/2 to 1  c. water
preparation: Sear and scald the pork by soaking it in boiling water to cover for a few minutes.  When the water returns to a boil, drain and rinse with cold water.  Place pork with all ingredients in a large saucepan or Dutch oven.  Bring to a boil, cover and simmer. Turn pork occasionally until tender, about 2 hours.  Remove cover and increase heat.  Baste pork until about 1 cup of liquid remains, about 15 to 20 minutes.  Skim fat and serve.

name: CHOCOLATE TRUFFLES
ingredients:
1  c. chocolate chips
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  pkg. chocolate instant pudding
1 (14 oz.)  can milk
1  Tbsp. orange extract
finely ground walnuts
preparation: Over low heat or microwave, melt chips with margarine.  Mix in pudding,    extract and milk.  Mix well.  Refrigerate for 2 hours. Shape in 1-inch balls; roll in finely ground nuts.  Store in refrigerator.

name: WIENERS CREOLE
ingredients:
2  large onions
1  bell pepper
1 small  can tomato paste
1 large  can tomato sauce
3  Tbsp. cooking oil
1/2  bunch celery
3  cloves garlic
salt to taste
2  pkg. wieners, cut
rice, cooked
preparation: Chop  onions, celery, bell pepper and garlic.  Saute in cooking  oil.  When  onions  are transparent, add tomato paste and sauce.  Let simmer for 1 1/4 hours.  Add wieners.  Cook 15 minutes.  Serve over rice.

name: PEACH MELBA PARFAIT
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry gelatin
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. peach gelatin
2  c. hot water
1/2  c. cold water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen raspberries
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
1 1/2  c. diced fresh peaches
preparation: Dissolve raspberry gelatin in 1 cup hot water in bowl.  Add unthawed raspberries.  Stir occasionally to separate berries.  Let thaw (it will begin to set).  In another bowl, pour 1 cup hot water over peach gelatin; stir to dissolve.  Add 1/2 cup cold water.  Add ice cream in 8 chunks; stir to melt.  Refrigerate until thick enough to mound.  Spoon lightly thickened raspberry mixture into 8 dessert dishes or parfait glasses.  When ice cream mixture has thickened, fold in peaches and spoon over raspberry mixture.  May put dollop of Cool Whip or whipped cream on top. Chill.

name: SHRIMP GUMBO
ingredients:
3  c. salsa
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. frozen, peeled, deveined shrimp
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen cut okra
1  c. cubed, fully cooked ham
1  c. water
1  tsp. instant bouillon granules
2  c. hot, cooked rice
preparation: In a large saucepan, stir together all the ingredients except the rice.  Bring the mixture to a boil and reduce the heat; simmer, while covered, for 5 minutes or until shrimp turn pink. Serve over rice or with rice aside.

name: CHICKEN SUPREME
ingredients:
1  jar dried beef
4  to 6 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1  lb. bacon
8  oz. sour cream
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: First, cut dried beef into small pieces and sprinkle into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch greased casserole dish.  Next, wrap the chicken breasts with a strip of bacon.  In a bowl, mix the sour cream and the cream of mushroom soup together.  Place your chicken breasts in the casserole dish; pour the soup mixture over the chicken.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: TEX-MEX CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can mild enchilada sauce
1 small  can chopped green chiles (jalapeno)
1  pkg. large 10-inch flour tortillas
2  c. grated Cheddar/Longhorn cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion.  Drain off grease.  In large bowl combine the soups, undrained green chiles and ground beef mixture. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Spread 1/2 cup soup mixture over bottom. Tear 1/2 of tortillas into pieces about 3 x 3 inches and randomly place overlapping in pan.  Spoon 1/2 of soup mixture over this. Cover with 1 cup cheese.  Tear and randomly place remaining tortillas over this.  Cover with remaining soup mixture.  Pour enchilada sauce over top.  Take large, sharp knife and make 6 to 8 "cuts" down into casserole so that enchilada sauce "leaks" down into casserole.  Top with remaining cheese.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for about 30 minutes until all is light brown and "bubbly." Take out of oven and let set about 10 minutes before serving.

name: MEAT LOAF DINNER
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburg
2  eggs
1  can vegetarian vegetable soup (10 3/4 oz.)
cracker crumbs (enough to make the mixture hold together)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and place in greased casserole dish. Bake, covered, at 350° for about 45 minutes.  Uncover and bake an additional 15 minutes.  Serve with bread warmed in oven or hot rolls and a tossed salad with a light dessert.

name: QUAIL WITH BLUEBERRIES
ingredients:
8  quail
oil
lemon juice
salt and pepper
4  c. blueberries
4  tsp. sugar
8  Tbsp. butter
4  cloves garlic, minced
8  bay leaves
preparation: Rub quail generously inside and out with a mixture of oil and lemon juice.  Season with salt and pepper.  Stuff each quail with 1/2 cup blueberries and 1/2 teaspoon sugar.  Close with skewers or thread.  Place each on square of aluminum foil, large enough to fold well.  Melt butter, add to minced garlic and bay leaves. Pour equal amount of mixture over each bird. Wrap loosely and fold edges to seal.  Roast, breast down, in 425° oven for 1 hour or until tender.  Serve with juice.  Serves 4.

name: SHRIMP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6 to 8  oz. very thin noodles, cooked just until tender
1  can cream of shrimp soup
3/4  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. mayonnaise
3  green scallions, chopped (tops and all)
sliced fresh mushrooms
garlic, minced
3/4  c. shredded sharp cheese
2  c. cooked, peeled shrimp, cut in half
1/4  c. chow mein noodles
preparation: Combine soup, milk, salt and mayonnaise.  Lightly saute the onions and mushrooms; add soup mixture.  Blend well.  Stir in cheese, shrimp and cooked noodles.  Pour into buttered 2-quart casserole.  Bake, uncovered, for 35 minutes at 325°.  Top with Chinese noodles; bake another 10 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  bunch fresh broccoli
1/2  lb. bacon
1  Tbsp. red onion, chopped
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vinegar
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. nuts
1/2  c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
preparation: Cut broccoli into flowerets.  Peel stalk and slice thinly. Cover raisins with hot water.  Soak 5 minutes.  Drain.  Cook bacon until crisp.  Crumble into salad.  Blend salad dressing, sugar and vinegar.  Pour on salad and mix well.  Marinate 4 hours before serving.

name: CHOCOLATE CRUNCH PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate instant pudding
1  c. cold milk
3 1/2  c. (8 oz.) Cool Whip
20  chocolate sandwich cookies, ground
1 1/2  c. rocks (use any combination of chocolate chips, peanut butter chips, chopped nuts and granola bar chunks)
1  chocolate crumb crust
preparation: Prepare pudding mix as directed with 1 cup milk.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Stir 1 cup cookies and the "rocks" into pudding mixture. Spoon into pie crust.  Sprinkle with remaining cookies.  Freeze until firm, 4 hours.  Garnish with gumdrop flowers or gummy worms. Let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes before serving.

name: BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. stew meat, cut in small pieces
8  carrots, cut in chunks
1  c. diced celery
2 (16 oz.)  cans stewed tomatoes
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
5  Tbsp. quick tapioca
2  slices bread, cubed (no crust)
1 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
dash of pepper
dash of thyme
dash of rosemary
dash of marjoram
preparation: Mix well in covered casserole or covered roaster.  Bake 6 hours at 250°.  Stir every 2 hours.  The last hour you can add cubed new potatoes.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia brand cream cheese
1 flat  can crushed pineapple, well drained
2  c. chopped pecans
1/4  c. finely diced green pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. seasoned salt
preparation: Soften cheese.  Mix ingredients, using 1 cup nuts.  Chill. Form a ball and roll in remaining 1 cup nuts.

name: CREAMY CHICKEN PRIMAVERA
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3/4  lb. boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut in strips
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. Green Giant pasta accents primavera (or any flavor pasta and vegetables)
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. dairy sour cream
preparation: In large skillet, melt butter.  Add chicken; cook until pink. Add pasta and vegetables and water.  Cover; cook over medium heat 7 to 9 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender, stirring occasionally.  Stir in sour cream and heat thoroughly.  Makes 4 servings.

name: RED RASPBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. red raspberry gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen red raspberries
1 (16 oz.)  jar applesauce
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water in a bowl.  Stir in raspberries and applesauce.  Spoon into dish or mold.  Chill overnight.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
2  fryers or 1 fat hen
1  pkg. onion soup
2  c. rice
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Stew chicken and bone (save broth).  Mix onion soup in chicken broth (should have at least 5 cups of liquid).  Add rice and boned chicken.  Cook as for rice, on low for about 30 minutes, or until rice is done, stirring occasionally.  You can cook in oven at 325° for 1 hour.  (If you cook in oven, you don't have to watch as closely.)

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. stew beef
1  sliced onion
1  clove garlic
1  can golden mushroom soup
1  cup sour cream
3  Tbsp. catsup
2  tsp soy sauce
egg noodles
