preparation: Brown beef in oil, add sliced onion and garlic.  Simmer five minutes.  In separate bowl combine other ingredients.  Add mixture to beef, cook on low 10 to 15 minutes.  Serve over noodles.

name: EXECUTIVE MEETING CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  box wild rice, prepared
1  whole cooked chicken, cut bite size
1  c. sliced water chestnuts
1  c. sliced ripe olives
1 large  can mandarin oranges or seedless grapes
1/2  c. onion, grated finely
1 small  pkg. sliced almonds
1  c. mayonnaise (may use 1/2 c. heavy cream and 1/2 c.  mayonnaise)
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Season to taste with salt and pepper or Greek seasoning.  Let stand overnight in refrigerator.  Serves at least 12, depending on size of servings.  Excellent!

name: TACO TATER WEDGES
ingredients:
4  baking potatoes, cut into wedges
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1 (2 1/8 oz.)  pkg. taco seasoning mix
preparation: Dip wedges into melted margarine.  Shake with seasoning mix in plastic bag, coating well.  Place skin side down on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until tender.

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. round or sirloin tip steak
1  large onion
1  large green pepper
1 large  can tomatoes
garlic powder
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. soy sauce
salt and pepper
preparation: Cut steak into serving pieces; salt and pepper.  Sprinkle with garlic powder.  Dredge in flour; brown on both sides in two tablespoons vegetable oil.  Pour off oil.  Slice onion and pepper into thin rings and put on top of steak in pan.  Mix Worcestershire sauce and soy sauce with enough water to cover steaks.  Stir well.  Chop tomatoes in small pieces and add to pan. Simmer until steak is tender, stirring occasionally.  Add water as needed.  Makes a great gravy to serve over rice.

name: CROCK-POT ROAST
ingredients:
3  lb. roast
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. liquid smoke
1  tsp. powdered garlic
preparation: Season roast with the listed seasoning.  Wrap in 2 layers of foil.  Put in crock-pot and cook on low for 12 to 16 hours.

name: CHOCOLATE NOODLE CANDY
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate morsels (1 c.)
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch morsels (1 c.)
1  c. Chinese noodles
3/4  c. walnuts, chopped
preparation: Melt all morsels over hot water.  When melted, add Chinese noodles and nuts.  Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper.  Chill in refrigerator.  I usually double this recipe.  They go fast!

name: MICROWAVE CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. Karo syrup (dark)
1  tsp. stick butter
1  tsp. baking soda
1  gal. popped corn (I use hot air popper)
preparation: Put sugar, salt, butter and syrup in bowl and microwave for 2 minutes.  Take out and stir.  Put back in microwave for 2 more minutes.  Take out.  Add baking soda and stir until it changes color and almost doubles in consistency.

name: LEMON CRACKERS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/4  tsp. baking ammonia (found at your pharmacy)
8  c. flour
1  c. shortening
4  eggs
1  tsp. oil of lemon
preparation: Mix sugar, shortening,  milk, eggs, salt, lemon oil and ammonia.  Add flour until stiff.  Chill 2 hours.  Roll out until it is 1/4 inch thick on floured board.  Cut as desired and poke with fork.  Bake until light brown, about 8 minutes.  Store in covered containers.

name: CURRIED RABBIT
ingredients:
rabbit
onions
carrots
1  c. chicken noodle soup
1 soup  can milk
curry powder to taste
preparation: Boil rabbit with salt.  Cool and separate from bone.  Fry meat in butter until brown.  Add onions and carrots and simmer.  Add soup and milk.  Let simmer until meat is tender.  Add curry powder to taste.  My favorite (if you like rabbit).

name: ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. lean hamburger meat
1  clove garlic
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
salt and pepper
1  doz. corn tortillas
1  c. grated Longhorn cheese
1  medium to large, chopped onion
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  can mushroom soup
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Brown meat, onion and garlic; drain.  Add sauce and seasoning mix.  Heat well.  Line bottom of  9 x 13-inch pan with 6 tortillas.  Pour meat mixture over them; cover with the other 6 tortillas.  Pour soup and milk on top of last tortillas and sprinkle with grated cheese.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: OVERNIGHT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
2  eggs, beaten
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. shredded coconut
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar.  Add the eggs, mixing well.  Add the dry ingredients, sifted together.  Stir in the coconut and the nuts.  Form into a roll; cover with wax paper and place in the refrigerator overnight.  Slice and bake in a moderately hot oven, 375°, for about ten minutes.   Makes about forty cookies.

name: HOLIDAY SPICED TEA
ingredients:
5  tea bags
2  tsp. whole cloves
2  whole cinnamon sticks
1  c. sugar
1 (6 oz.)  can orange juice
1 (6 oz.)  can lemonade
1 (12 oz.)  can apricot nectar
preparation: In tea pot, put in tea bags, cloves and cinnamon sticks.  Fill pot with boiling water and steep for 30 minutes.  Then remove tea bags, cloves and cinnamon sticks and stir in sugar until dissolved.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped green peppers
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  egg
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. red pepper
1  stick margarine, melted
1  c. buttermilk
3  c. cornmeal
1  can cream-style corn
1  pkg. Colby cheese, cut in chunks
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake just like regular cornbread.  Goes great with the Beef-n-noodles and the linguini.

name: PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
20  oz. can crushed pineapple
1  c. sugar
3  oz. French vanilla instant pudding
1  c. shredded coconut
8  oz. whipped cream or Cool Whip
chopped nuts
preparation: Prepare cake as directed and bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Meanwhile, simmer pineapple and sugar.  Remove baked cake from oven and, with a fork, poke holes all over cake.  Cover with pineapple mixture and chill.  Prepare pudding as directed and stir in coconut.  Spread over cake.  Cover with whipped topping and sprinkle with nuts.

name: PINEAPPLE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. melted butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  can sliced pineapple
3  eggs, separated
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
5  Tbsp. pineapple juice
preparation: Put melted butter in bottom  of iron skillet.  Sprinkle brown sugar onto butter and then  lay  pineapple  slices  onto brown sugar.  Beat egg whites until stiff.  Set aside.

name: SHRIMP IN SOUR CREAM SAUCE
ingredients:
1  lb. peeled deveined rock shrimp or regular shrimp
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms, drained
2  Tbsp. chopped green onions
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter, melted
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of shrimp soup
1  c. sour cream
1/8  tsp. white pepper
patty shells or toast points
preparation: Saute mushrooms and onions in margarine until tender but not brown. Blend in flour. Add soup; cook over medium heat until thickened, stirring constantly.  Add shrimp; cook 5 minutes. Stir in sour cream and pepper. Heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally. Serve in patty shells or on toast points. Serves 6.

name: SUNDAY BEST PANCAKES
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1  Tbsp. melted butter
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/4  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Separate eggs, beat whites until stiff.  Put yolks in large bowl and beat well.  Add buttermilk and melted butter, beat.  Sift dry ingredients and add to liquid in bowl and mix until smooth. Fold in beaten egg whites.  Fry on hot grill.  `May use regular milk, instead of buttermilk.

name: GRAM SCHRAUDER'S SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sour cream
4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Cream together Crisco, sugar, eggs, vanilla and sour cream. Sift together flour, baking soda, baking powder and nutmeg.  Blend dry ingredients into creamed mixture.  Drop from spoon onto greased pan and sprinkle with sugar.  Bake 12 minutes in a 325° oven.

name: FRANK'S GOURMET LOW-FAT OVEN CRISPY CHICKEN AND CHOPS
ingredients:
4  skinless boneless chicken breasts or 4 closely trimmed lean pork chops (boneless)
2  tsp. all-purpose seasoning
4  Tbsp. Kraft Fat-Free mayonnaise
4  c. Rice Krispies cereal, ground semi-coarse
preparation: The first thing you do is take the chicken breasts or the pork chops and remove all traces of excess fat.  Take your time and trim it all away with a sharp paring knife.

name: CHICKEN ALOUETTE
ingredients:
1 (17 1/2 oz.)  pkg. puff pastry sheets, thawed
1  (40 oz.) container garlic and spice Alouette cheese or cream cheese with garlic and spices
6  skinned and boned chicken
1/2  tsp. salt and pepper
1  egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. water
preparation: Unfold pastry sheets into 14 x 12-inch rectangle on floured surface.  Cut one sheet into 4 (7 x 6-inch) rectangles.  Cut second sheet into two.  Set aside.  Shape into oval (cut off corners). Spread evenly with cheese.

name: OLD FASHIONED POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. butter (at room temperature)
3  c. sugar
5  eggs (at room temperature)
3  c. cake flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla extract
2  tsp. lemon extract
preparation: Grease and flour a tube pan.  In a large bowl cream together the shortening, butter and sugar.  Add the eggs one at a time, beating after each addition.  Sift the flour and baking powder together and add the mixture to the creamed mixture alternately with the milk and extracts.  Bake in a 325° oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes.  Let the cake cool in the pan for about 15 minutes. Serves 8.

name: NECK BONES IN BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
4 to 5  lb. meaty pork neck bones
1 large  bottle barbecue sauce (your choice; I like Kraft honey mustard)
preparation: Wash neck bones.  Put small amount of oil in heavy pot or skillet.  Brown neck bones in oil.  Remove neck bones; place in a bowl.  Continue until all are browned.  Pour off fat; return bones to pot.  Cover with water.  Add dash of salt; simmer until almost done, approximately 1 1/2 hours.  Remove to a baking dish.  Bake, uncovered, in a 375° oven until slightly browned.  Pour on barbecue sauce and cook until slightly thickened.

name: BARBECUED MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. fresh bread crumbs
1  onion, finely chopped
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
4  oz. tomato sauce
preparation: Form loaf and put into shallow pan.

name: EASY MICROWAVE POTATOES
ingredients: 2  to 4 baking potatoes
preparation: You will need a Ziploc bag.

name: RHUBARB PRESERVES
ingredients:
5  c. rhubarb, cut into pieces
4  c. sugar
2  boxes (4 oz.) strawberry or raspberry Jell-O
preparation: Cover rhubarb with sugar and let set 2 hours or until sugar dissolves.  Boil 5 minutes.  Remove from heat, stir in Jell-O. Pour into jars, let cool and freeze.  Keep in refrigerator after opening.

name: BUTTERNUT SQUASH SOUP
ingredients:
4  c. cubed, peeled butternut squash
2  c. water
2  c. chicken broth
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
3 chopped fresh basil leaves or 1  tsp. dried
3 sprigs marjoram or 1  tsp. dried
2  Tbsp. cooking wine
2  bay leaves
2  bouillon cubes
1  tsp. dried coriander
1  tsp. powdered cardamom
preparation: Cook the squash in water with herbs and bouillon cubes.  Saute onion and garlic.  Add to squash and puree in a processor.  Return to pan.  Add broth, soy sauce and cooking wine.  Cook for 5 minutes.  Remove bay leaves.  If the soup is too thin, thicken with 1 to 3 tablespoons cornstarch moistened in 1 to 3 tablespoons water.  Serves 4.  Serve warm or cold with a dollop of sour cream or yogurt.

name: RICE STUFFED FLOUNDER
ingredients:
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. sliced mushrooms
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. chicken broth
1/2  c. half and half
1 1/2  tsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. dill weed
1 1/2  c. Minute instant brown rice
3/4  c. each: grated carrot and zucchini
4  flounder fillets (4 oz. each)
1/4  tsp. each: salt and paprika
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Brown onion and mushrooms in hot margarine.  Mix broth, half and half, cornstarch and dill; add to pan.  Bring to a boil.  Add rice; return to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.   Stir in carrot and zucchini.  Let stand 5 minutes.

name: SIMPLE, DELICIOUS, FRESH APPLE DIP
ingredients:
3/4  c. dark brown sugar
8  oz. Neufchatel or fat-free cream cheese
1/4  c. salted, skinned peanuts, chopped
preparation: Bring cream cheese to room temperature.  Beat cheese and brown sugar until completely mixed and smooth.  Chill at least 2 hours. Quarter apples, then slice each quarter into thirds.  When ready to serve, spread cheese mix in shallow bowl, then sprinkle chopped peanuts on top of cheese mixture.

name: LIVER PATE
ingredients:
2 (4 1/2 oz.)  cans liver pate
1/4  c. softened butter
8  oz. softened cream cheese
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onions
1  Tbsp. curry powder
2  Tbsp. brandy
1/4  c. chopped parsley
preparation: Cream the pate and cream cheese.  Add other ingredients.  Mix well and chill. Serves 12.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) unbaked pastry shell
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin (about 2 c.)
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk
2  eggs
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  In large bowl, combine filling ingredients.  Mix well and turn into pie shell.  Bake 15 minutes; reduce temperature to 350° and continue baking for 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted one inch from edge comes out clean.  Cool before cutting.  Garnish with whipped cream.

name: SPICY CLAMS AND RICE
ingredients:
1  medium chopped onion
2 finely chopped  cloves garlic
1  Tbsp. salad oil
2  tsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. parsley
1/8  tsp. white pepper
1  Tbsp. crushed hot pepper
2 (10 oz.)  cans whole baby clams
1  c. uncooked rice
1  Tbsp. white or pink wine (optional)
salt to taste
preparation: Drain clam liquid into large measuring cup.  Add water to equal 2 cups.  Set aside.  In 3-quart saucepan, saute onion and garlic until onion is transparent.  Stir in paprika, parsley, white pepper, crushed pepper, wine and clams.  Add rice and clam juice/water mixture and bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer until all liquid is absorbed (15 to 17 minutes).  Serves 4 to 6.

name: BARBECUE BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. Bob Evans bulk pork sausage (hot)
1 (16 oz.)  can pork and beans
1  can green beans, drained
1  can wax beans, drained
1  can lima beans, drained
1  can kidney beans
1  can tomato soup
1  can paste (optional)
1  onion, chopped
1  c. brown sugar
1 to 2  Tbsp. mustard
1  tsp. chili powder or to taste
preparation: Fry and drain sausage.  Mix all well.  Mix in fried bacon. Bake, covered, for 1 hour or more.  Uncover for 1/2 hour.

name: CREAM OF BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh chopped broccoli or 2 pkg. frozen broccoli
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
12  oz. chicken broth
4  Tbsp. butter
4  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
1  c. half and half
1  c. whipping cream
1/2  tsp. basil
1/8  tsp. white pepper
preparation: Combine broccoli, celery, onion and chicken broth.  Heat to boiling; lower heat and simmer 10 minutes.  In medium saucepan, melt butter.  Add flour and mix.  Then add 1/2 cup milk to make white sauce.  Stir white sauce into broccoli mixture.  Add rest of milk, half and half and cream.  Add seasonings and mix well.  Heat about 20 minutes until soup thickens.

name: YEAST BISCUIT
ingredients:
1  c. warm water
1  pkg. dry yeast
1  egg, beaten
3/4  c. oil (I use Crisco)
1/4  c. sugar
2  c. buttermilk
6 1/2  c. self-rising flour
preparation: Mix water, sugar and yeast.  (I mix sugar and dry yeast and then add water.)  Add all other ingredients.    Mix well.

name: LIMA BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen lima beans, cooked and drained
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes at 325°.  Add paprika on top before serving.  May also add a little butter.

name: BAKE SALE BROWNIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  lb. sticks butter (room temperature)
2  c. granulated sugar
1  c. light brown sugar
2/3  c. dark corn syrup
6  large eggs
6  sq. (6 oz.) unsweetened chocolate
2  c. fork-stirred all-purpose flour
2  c. pecan halves or coarsely broken walnuts
preparation: Line the bottom and sides of a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan with a sheet of foil.  Mix until blended with wooden spoon butter, sugars and syrup.  Stir in eggs, one at a time.  Melt chocolate. Stir into sugar mixture.  Add flour mixture and stir until smooth. Add nuts.  Spread in pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes; cool. Refrigerate.  Invert onto board and cut into 30 brownies.

name: RUMAKI
ingredients:
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. packed brown sugar
2 thin  slices ginger root or 1/8 tsp. ground ginger
1  clove garlic, crushed
10  water chestnuts, cut in half
10  chicken livers, cut in half
10  slices bacon, cut in half
preparation: Mix soy sauce, brown sugar, ginger root and garlic in glass or plastic bowl.  Stir in chicken livers and water chestnuts.  Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally; drain.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIFFON CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. boiling water
1/2  c. cocoa
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1 3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cooking oil
8  unbeaten egg yolks
2  tsp. vanilla
8  egg whites, stiffly beaten
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Heat oven to 325°.  Bake for 65 to 70 minutes.  Combine boiling water and cocoa.  Cool.  Sift flour, sugar, soda and salt into mixing bowl.  Make a well; add in order the oil, egg yolks, cocoa mixture and vanilla.  Beat with a spoon until smooth.  In a large bowl, beat egg whites and cream of tartar to very stiff peaks, about 12 to 15 minutes.  Do not underbeat.  Pour egg yolk mixture over egg whites.  Fold in with a rubber spatula until blended.  Pour into ungreased 10-inch tube pan.  Cool upside down in pan on a funnel for 4 hours.

name: SOCK-IT-TO-ME CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow butter recipe cake mix
4  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
2/3  c. oil
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  c. pecans
brown sugar
cinnamon
preparation: Mix all ingredients (except brown sugar and cinnamon) together. Pour 1/2 of mixture into stem pan.  Sprinkle a layer of brown sugar and cinnamon over mixture.  Pour in remaining batter.  Cook 1 hour at 350°.

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
1 1/2  tsp. horseradish
1  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. salt
8  medium potatoes, thinly sliced
2  medium onions, chopped
1  c. parsley, chopped
preparation: Boil potatoes until done.  Combine mayonnaise, sour cream, horseradish, celery seed and salt in small bowl and mix well. Place half the potatoes, onions and parsley in serving bowl. Spoon half of the sour cream mixture over the top.  Spoon remaining sour cream mixture over the next layer of potatoes. Sprinkle with remaining parsley over sour cream.  Chill in refrigerator for 12 hours or longer.

name: CHICKEN AND DRESSING
ingredients:
1  large fryer, boiled
4  c. cornbread
5  day old biscuits
2  c. cornflakes
5  eggs, slightly beaten
2  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. chopped celery
3/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  Tbsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. salt
4  Tbsp. sage (adjust to your taste)
hot broth from boiled chicken
preparation: Boil chicken; debone and remove skin.  Cut in bite-size pieces.  Crumble cornbread, biscuits and cornflakes in large bowl. Add onions, celery and pepper.  Stir in 4 cups broth.  Add beaten eggs, salt and sage; stir well.  Add more broth until mixture is the consistency of pudding.  Add chicken.  Pour into 10 x 15 x 2-inch pan greased with butter.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour 20 minutes.  Good for Sunday dinner.  Bakes while you're in church.

name: CREAMY SCRAMBLED EGGS
ingredients:
15  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. white pepper
2/3  c. light cream or milk
1/4  c. (1/4 stick) margarine
preparation: Beat eggs with salt and pepper in a large bowl with wire whip until foamy.  Beat in the cream or milk until smooth.  Heat the margarine in the top of a double boiler over simmering water.  Add the egg mixture and cook, stirring often, for 15 minutes or until eggs are creamy and set.  Serve immediately.  Make for New Years parties.

name: THREE BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can green beans, drained
1  can wax beans, drained
1  can dark red kidney beans, drained
1  onion, sliced or diced
1  green mango, sliced or diced
preparation: Toss together.  Add dressing.

name: APRICOT SYRUP
ingredients:
2  c. canned apricots in juice or make from dried
1  c. light corn syrup
dash of salt
preparation: In blender or food processor, puree apricots and juice until smooth.  Combine apricots, syrup and salt in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil, stirring constantly; boil gently, still stirring, for 5 to 7 minutes.  Serve warm.  Makes 2 cups.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. cherry Jell-O
1  can whole berry cranberry sauce
2  c. boiling water
1  c. frozen orange juice
1  can crushed pineapple with juice
3/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O with boiling water.  Add all other ingredients.  Pour into mold.

name: CHEDDAR MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground red pepper
1  egg (beaten)
3/4  c. milk
1/3  c. oil
6  strips bacon, crisply fried, drained and crumbled
preparation: Grease or spray muffin pan.  Stir together flour, cheese, sugar, baking powder, salt and pepper.  Make a well in center.  In a small bowl, combine egg milk and oil.  Add egg mixture to flour mixture.  Stir just until moistened.  Batter should be lumpy. Fold in crumbled bacon.  Fill prepared muffin pan cups.  Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden.  Remove from pan.  Serve while warm.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  lb. butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
6  large eggs
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
3  c. granulated sugar
3  c. cake flour, sifted before measuring
preparation: Cream butter with cream cheese until smooth.  Add sugar and beat until thoroughly blended.  Add eggs, one at a time, with portions of flour, beating well after each addition.  Stir in vanilla flavorings.  Spoon into a tube pan; bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours in a 325° oven.

name: ROLLED BEEF BITES
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. dry onion soup
3  Tbsp. sour cream
preparation: Mix thoroughly together and spread on thin slices of roast beef, turkey or ham.  Roll up and refrigerate to blend.  To serve, cut rolls in 1-inch slices and serve with a toothpick in each one.

name: CABBAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
3  lb. ground beef
2  c. rice, uncooked (I precook 5 minutes)
3  tsp. onion powder or 1 large onion
1  tsp. garlic powder
3  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. parsley
2/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1  can tomato sauce
2  large heads cabbage
1  can sauerkraut
1 large  jar Ragu
preparation: Scald the heads of cabbage in boiling water.  Cutting away the leaves, put a big serving spoon of filling in each leaf and roll. Chop remaining cabbage and put in pan with the sauerkraut (washed and drained).  Add the Ragu and 1 jar water or make your same sauce you would for spaghetti. Cook on top of stove for 1 1/2 hours or in oven for 1 1/2 hours.  Cook 6 to 8 and freeze the rest.  Makes 40 rolls.

name: CRAB AND CORN SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. crab meat
1  1/2. corn kernels
6  c. chicken stock
2 1/2  Tbsp. sherry
2  eggs, separated
2  tsp. cornstarch
2 1/2  tsp. water
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Shred crab meat.  Mix corn with chicken stock and bring to a boil.  Stir in crab meat and sherry.  Gradually stir in beaten egg yolks.  Mix cornstarch with water and stir into soup.  Bring to a boil constantly.  Beat egg whites and fold into soup.  Cook for a few minutes.  Add salt and pepper.

name: CONCH OR CLAM SAUCE WITH LINGUINE
ingredients:
1  pint chopped conch or sea clams or whole shucked steamer clams
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
4  Tbsp. olive oil
2  ounces salt pork, diced (omit for meatless meal)
4  cloves garlic mashed
1/4  cup chopped fresh parsley
2  Tbsp. flour
pepper to taste
1  1/2 cups clam juice (fresh or bottled, no sand from bottom of bottle)
dash Tabasco (optional)
1  lb. linguine (or pasta of choice)
1  lb. edible pea pods, broccoli or frozen peas
preparation: Sauce:	Cook salt pork in skillet until brown and crispy. Remove salt pork scraps and set aside.  Add butter (or margarine) and olive oil to skillet and heat until butter is melted.  Mash garlic and parsley together and add to skillet, cooking slowly until soft.  Add conch or clams and heat through.  Add flour and pepper, stirring well, and cook for 3 minutes.  Slowly add 1 cup clam juice and Tabasco and bring to boil stirring constantly.  Thin the sauce with more clam juice if it becomes too thick; however, be careful not to make it too liquid.

name: BREAD AND BUTTER PUDDING
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. margarine or butter (1/2 stick softened)
12  slices firm white bread
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/3  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1/4  tsp. salt
4  large eggs
3  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Grease an 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Spread margarine or butter on bread slices.  Arrange 4 slices of bread in dish in one layer, overlapping slightly, if necessary. Sprinkle lightly with 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon.  Repeat, making 2 more layers.

name: CHERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  medium angel food cake
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3  c. powdered sugar
2  pkg. Dream Whip, whipped
2  cans cherry pie filling
preparation: Tear cake into bite-size pieces and place in 9 x 13-inch pan. With mixer, beat cream cheese and powdered sugar together until light.  Add to whipped Dream Whip and blend well by hand.  Spread over cake pieces.  Lift cake pieces with fork so cream cheese mixture gets down around cake pieces.  Chill for 2 hours.  Spread cherry pie filling over all and chill 2 or 3 more hours.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion
1  green pepper
garlic
2  cans tomato sauce
1 small  can tomato paste
1  can Ro-Tel
1  tsp. sugar
salt, pepper, basil, oregano and garlic
2  lb. Ricotta cheese
2  eggs
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
lasagna noodles
3  c. Mozzarella, shredded
preparation: Brown beef with chopped onion and green pepper, garlic and pepper.  Drain grease.  Add tomato sauce, paste and Ro-Tel.  Add sugar, then spices.  Simmer 20 to 30 minutes.  In separate bowl, combine Ricotta with eggs and Parmesan.  Cook noodles with a little oil.

name: BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, cubed
2  c. milk
2  chicken bouillon cubes
1 1/2  c. boiling water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Saute onion in butter.  Add cream cheese and milk; stir over low heat until cream cheese is melted.   Dissolve bouillon in boiling water; add to cream cheese mixture.  Stir in broccoli, lemon juice and seasonings.  Heat thoroughly.  Top each serving with a little grated Cheddar cheese.

name: ITALIAN STYLE MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. hot sausage
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can Italian style stewed tomatoes
1  c. fresh bread crumbs
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
preparation: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients; mix well.  Place in a glass Pyrex bread loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Drain.

name: FRESH BROCCOLI AND PASTA COMBO
ingredients:
1  small onion, chopped
1 medium  clove garlic, minced
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1  tsp. instant chicken bouillon
1  Tbsp. flour
1  c. water
grated peel and juice of 1 lemon, separated
1/2  c. sour cream
1  lb. broccoli, separated into florets, cooked and drained
1 1/2  c. spiral macaroni, cooked and drained
preparation: In skillet, saute onion and garlic in butter with bouillon until tender.  Remove from heat; stir in flour.  Gradually blend in water and lemon juice.  Cook over medium heat until thickened. Blend in sour cream. Stir in broccoli and macaroni and lemon peel; heat until steaming.  Makes 4 servings (5 1/2 cups).

name: HOMEMADE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2  cans Eagle Brand milk
1  carton half and half
2  cartons whipping cream
4  Tbsp. vanilla
whole milk (add enough to fill freezer)
fruit (peaches, bananas, strawberries, etc.)
1  c. sugar*
preparation: *Add sugar if using peaches or strawberries.

name: CHICKEN TOSTADAS
ingredients:
1  can (16 oz.) refried beans
6  corn tortillas
4  oz. Cheddar cheese, cut in strips
ripe olives
2  c. shredded lettuce
1  tomato, sliced
3  or 4 chicken breasts
1  avocado
4  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Cook chicken, cut into strips.  Fry tortillas crisp.  Drain on paper towels.  Spread each tortilla generously with beans, chicken, lettuce and cheese, olives, tomato and avocado.  Top tostada with hot sauce.

name: BEEF-RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground round, browned
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  c. rice, uncooked
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Put in baking dish and bake uncovered. Serves 4-6.

name: HOLIDAY FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  can pineapple (reserve juice)
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  egg, beaten
1  c. pecans, chopped
3  bananas, sliced
2 (11 oz. each)  cans mandarin oranges, drained
1/2  lb. red seedless grapes, halved
preparation: Drain pineapple and put juice in small saucepan.  Add sugar, flour and egg to juice.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and thickened.  Cool.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1  c. rice
1  chicken
1/4  lb. butter
3  cans cream of chicken
1  can water
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. seasoned pepper
preparation: Melt butter in large flat casserole dish.  Add soup, water, seasoning and rice.  Lay chicken on rice mixture.  Sprinkle with salt and 1 teaspoon paprika.  Bake for 3 hours at 250°.

name: CUBAN CUSTARD
ingredients:
2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
6  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook slowly, stirring it almost constantly until it thickens. Spray on top ground cinnamon.

name: MOIST DEVIL'S FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1/2  c. buttermilk
1 level  tsp. soda
dash of salt
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Mix all together.  It will make 2 big layers.

name: CHICKEN CORDON BLEU
ingredients:
4  (4 oz.) boneless chicken breast halves
4  (1 oz.) reduced fat ham slices
4 (1 oz.)  slices low-fat cheese
1  Tbsp. fat-free mayonnaise
1  tsp. warm water
Progresso Italian-style bread crumbs
vegetable cooking spray
parsley flakes
oregano
black pepper
onion salt
preparation: Flatten chicken pieces to 1/4-inch thickness. Sprinkle with parsley, oregano, onion salt and black pepper.  Place a ham slice and a cheese slice on each chicken breast. Roll up from short side and secure rolls with wooden picks.

name: OATMEAL MACAROONS
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3  c. oats
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes.  Let set on cookie sheet for 5 minutes before removing.

name: RED, WHITE, BLUE CAKE(Blueberry Pie)
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
2  or 3 cups blueberries, fresh or frozen
1  box French Vanilla Cake Mix
2  tbsp butter, melted
1  cup chopped walnuts
preparation: Grease a 9 X 13 inch dish.  Spread cherry pie filling over bottom.  Spread the blueberries evenly over the cherries. Sprinkle the dry cake mix over the blueberries.  Drizzle the melted butter over the top.  Sprinkle with chopped walnuts.

name: BEST BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. rolled oats
1  c. flour
1  c. whole wheat flour
1/2  c. all-bran cereal
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. molasses
3/4  c. buttermilk
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple in natural juices, undrained
1/2  c. chopped nuts, dates or raisins
preparation: In a mixing bowl, combine first 7 ingredients.  Make a well in the center.  Combine the egg, oil, molasses, buttermilk and pineapple with juice.  Pour into well.   Mix until dry ingredients are moistened.  Stir in nuts, dates or raisins.  Fill 18 greased muffin cups 2/3 full.  Bake at 400° for 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Yield: 18.

name: SISTER MARTHA HOLLAND'S CHICKEN AND DRESSING
ingredients:
1  baking hen
1  onion
2  large skillets corn bread
poultry seasoning
sage
preparation: Cook hen overnight in a large crock-pot.

name: BEST BROWNIES EVER
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine, melted
3/4  c. cocoa
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. flour
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chocolate chunks
1  c. nuts
preparation: Stir in order:  margarine, cocoa, sugar, eggs (all at once), flour, vanilla, chocolate chunks and nuts.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch glass pan at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. whole cranberries, ground
1/2  c. sugar
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
6  oz. tiny marshmallows
1/2  pt. whipping cream, whipped
nuts
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients and let stand 1 hour.  Add whipped cream and fold gently.  Sprinkle nuts on top.

name: CHEESE STRAWS
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose buttermilk biscuit mix
1  c. grated All-American cheese
2  Tbsp. shortening
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
1  egg yolk
1  tsp. water
preparation: Blend biscuit mix, grated cheese, shortening, salt and cayenne pepper.  Cut with fork, mixing to a consistency of coarse crumbs. Add egg yolk and water to form stiff dough.   Knead slightly. Roll into 1/4-inch thickness on floured board.  Cut into narrow strips and place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: HOT BUTTERED RUM
ingredients:
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
1  lb. powdered sugar
1  lb. brown sugar
1  lb. butter
cinnamon sticks
nutmeg
preparation: Melt butter in pan, stirring in sugars.  Stir constantly until melted.  Pour mixture over soft ice cream in big bowl.  Mix well and store in refrigerator.  In a mug, pour 1 part mixture, 1 part rum and 2 parts boiling water.  Decorate with cinnamon stick and nutmeg.

name: CHERRY-PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/2 to 1  c. nuts, chopped
1 medium size  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix together with spoon.  Refrigerate.  Can be served on lettuce.

name: PUMPKIN ALMOND BISQUE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. chopped celery
3  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  c. cooked pumpkin puree
1  Tbsp. tomato paste
2  Tbsp. almond paste
3  c. chicken broth
1 1/2  c. light cream (half and half)
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. white pepper
3  Tbsp. Amaretto
salt to taste
toasted pumpkin seeds
preparation: Remove flesh from pumpkin.  Keep shell as a serving container. Simmer pumpkin flesh in a small amount of broth until tender. Puree in blender.  Melt butter in heavy pan.  Add celery and onion. Simmer 5 minutes.  Add to pumpkin in blender along with tomato paste and almond paste.  Blend until smooth.  Return to pot and simmer 30 minutes.  Blend cream into soup.  Cook until hot.  Season with nutmeg, pepper, salt and Amaretto.  Float pumpkin seeds on each serving.

name: KEY LIME PIE
ingredients:
3  egg yolks
2 (14 1/2 oz.)  cans sweetened condensed milk
1  tsp. finely shredded lime peel
1  (9-inch) pie shell, baked
whipped cream
lime slices
preparation: In large mixer bowl, beat egg yolks with electric mixer until thick and lemon colored.  Add the sweetened condensed milk and the lime peel.  Gradually add the lime juice, beating at medium speed until mixed.  Turn mixture into baked pastry shell.  Cover and chill 4 hours.  Before serving, top with whipped cream and garnish with lime slices.  Makes 8 servings.

name: CHEESE AND KRAUT CRESCENT POCKETS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  cans crescent rolls
1  Tbsp. caraway seed
8 (3 1/2 x 3 1/2-inch)  slices Swiss cheese
16  oz. can sauerkraut, well drained
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Separate dough into 8 rectangles.  Press or roll each to an 8 x 5-inch rectangle, sealing perforations. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed over them (reserve 1/2 teaspoon for tops).  Press or roll seeds into dough.  Place 1 slice Swiss cheese, 1/4 cup kraut and 1 slice American cheese on one end of each rectangle.  Fold dough over filling and press edges to seal. Brush tops with egg; sprinkle with seeds and place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 12 to 18 minutes.

name: CHINESE CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
3  chicken wings, separated
1/3  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. oil
3  Tbsp. cooking sherry
1/3  c. honey
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. ginger (root grated)
3 or 4  cloves garlic, grated
4  shakes Tabasco sauce
preparation: Separate chicken (the part that has 2 bones); cut slightly at both ends and peel bone out.  Mix ingredients and marinate chicken overnight.

name: JESSICA'S CHEESE STICKS
ingredients:
1  loaf regular sliced bread (crust removed)
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. paprika
preparation: Slice bread into thin sticks.  Roll in melted margarine, then in Parmesan and paprika.  Place on cookie sheet.  Bake for 20 minutes at 325°.  Enjoy.

name: GRILLED CHICKEN FETTUCINI ALFREDO FOR 2
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken cutlet
1/2  lb. fettucini
3/4  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. shiitake mushrooms
1/4  c. broccoli florets
1/2  stick butter
1/3  c. roasted peppers
1  egg yolk
preparation: Cook fettucini in salted water until al dente (slightly hard). Saute mushrooms, broccoli and peppers in a little butter for about 2 to 3 minutes.  Season chicken with salt and pepper and grill on grill or cook in broiler.  When chicken is done, cut into long strips and add to vegetables.  Saute for 1 more minute.  Add heavy cream, grated cheese and butter to mixture.  Let cook and reduce until thick.  Add fettucini and mix well in pan.  Beat in egg yolk rapidly so egg doesn't cook.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. squash
1  c. sour cream
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb dressing mix
preparation: Grease shallow pan and line with dressing mix.  Boil squash in water until tender. Drain and mash.  Mix squash, sour cream, onion and soup.  Salt and pepper to taste. Pour this over layer of dressing. Sprinkle dressing mix on top.  Dot with butter.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: MARVELOUS MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. pkg. macaroni
1  c. chopped onions
1  c. diced sweet pepper
1  c. grated cheese
salt
black pepper
salad dressing
preparation: Cook  macaroni  until just done.  Drain well.  Toss with onions, sweet pepper and cheese.  Add salt and pepper to taste. Add salad dressing for desired consistency.

name: UPSIDE-DOWN SAUSAGE CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage
1  pkg. corn muffin mix (Jiffy or equivalent)
1  can mushroom soup
1  egg (as muffin mix pkg. directs)
1/3  c. milk (as muffin mix pkg. directs)
1/4  lb. cheese (I use Velveeta but real cheese is fine)
preparation: Crumble sausage into small pieces and brown.  Drain off fat and spread about 3/4 of it on the bottom of an 8 x 8-inch baking pan.  Prepare cornbread mix according to package directions (i.e., mix with egg and milk) and pour over sausage, spreading evenly in the pan.  Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes (until done).  While cornbread is baking, add the soup (undiluted) to the pan with the remaining sausage.  Stir over low heat until bottom of pan is clear of sausage; add cheese (shredded, cubed or otherwise broken into pieces) and stir until cheese is melted and cheese and sausage are uniformly distributed through the sauce.  When cornbread is done, invert pan over large plate to remove it; cut into squares and serve with sauce.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. wide egg noodles
2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. black pepper
2  lb. ground beef
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. garlic salt
4  c. tomato sauce
1  c. chopped onion
preparation: Brown meat and onion.  Stir tomato sauce and seasonings into meat mixture.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Cook noodles 3 to 5 minutes; drain and combine with sour cream.  Start with noodles and alternate layers of noodles, meat and cheese.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Remove foil and sprinkle cheese on top and cook for additional 15 minutes.

name: SONYA'S PRETZEL DESSERT
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. slightly crushed pretzels
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. soft butter
preparation: Blend the sugar and butter.  Add pretzels and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Cool.

name: CREAMY CORN SLAW
ingredients:
1  can whole kernel corn
2  grated carrots
1  diced green pepper
1/2  onion, diced
1/4  c. sour cream
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. mustard
2  tsp. vinegar
2  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
pepper
preparation: Combine vegetables in bowl.  Mix rest of items and pour over salad; chill 1 hour or more.

name: APPLE SALAD
ingredients:
12  apples, chopped
1 large  can crushed pineapple
12  bananas, chopped
1  c. chopped peanuts
1  c. fruit cocktail
preparation: Mix together and add sugar to taste.

name: EASY SHERBET
ingredients:
4  c. milk
1  c. sugar
1  pkg. unsweetened Kool-Aid
preparation: Mix milk, sugar and Kool-Aid in a bowl.  Place in freezer for 4 hours or until partially frozen.  Beat with electric mixer quickly until large particles are fine.  Return to freezer.  Ready to serve in about 1 hour.  Should not be frozen too firmly for best consistency.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: MICROWAVE HAM AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. fresh or frozen broccoli flowerets, thawed
1 1/2  c. Kraft natural shredded sharp Cheddar cheese, divided
1 1/2  c. ham cubes
1 1/2  c. rotini, cooked and drained
1/2  c. Miracle Whip or Miracle Whip Light salad dressing
1/4  c. each chopped green and red pepper
1/4  c. milk
3/4  c. seasoned croutons (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients except 1/2 cup of the cheese and croutons. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart microwavable casserole.  Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cheese.  Microwave on High 8 to 10 minutes or until thoroughly heated.  Top with croutons.

name: ZUCCHINI YELLOW SQUASH
ingredients:
2  lb. squash or 2 medium squash
1/4  chopped onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. (8 oz.) sour cream
1  c. shredded carrots
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. seasoned stuffing mix
1/2  c. butter or margarine
preparation: Cook sliced squash and onion in boiling water, slightly salted, 4 minutes.  Squash must be a little crisp; drain.  Combine chicken soup and sour cream; stir in carrots, squash, onion and salt to taste.  Combine stuffing mix with butter; spread half in baking dish.  Spoon in vegetable mixture.  Sprinkle on rest of stuffing.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: SNOW SALAD
ingredients:
30  large marshmallows
1/2  c. hot milk
1  pkg. whipped topping
1/2  c. shredded coconut
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Melt marshmallows in hot milk.  Let cool.  Add whipped topping to beat.  Cut drained orange slices into small pieces to add to mixture, along with drained pineapple.  Stir in coconut.  Spoon into dish and refrigerate.

name: MARINATED FLANK STEAK
ingredients:
1  beef flank steak (about 2 lb.)
3  Tbsp. catsup
1  Tbsp. oil
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  tsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  garlic clove, minced
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Place steak in a glass dish.  Combine ingredients; pour over meat.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.  Remove meat, discard marinade.  Grill over hot coals until meat reaches desired doneness.  Slice into thin strips across the grain to serve.

name: PORK CHOPS PAPRIKASH
ingredients:
8  boneless pork chops
salt and pepper to taste
1  tsp. paprika
2  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1/2  c. dry white wine
1/2  c. chicken broth
3/4  c. sour cream
finely chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Place meat on flat surface and pound with mallet to flatten. Sprinkle meat on both sides with salt, pepper and paprika.  Heat butter in skillet.  Brown meat over high heat for about 3 minutes on each side.  Transfer meat to platter.  Pour excess fat from skillet and cook onion until wilted.  Add wine and stir to dissolve brown particles.  Add chicken broth and simmer about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in sour cream.  Pour sauce over meat and sprinkle with parsley.  Good with rice or buttered noodles.

name: SWEET AND SOUR SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. apple jelly
2/3  c. mustard
preparation: Mix according to taste. This is a very inexpensive and quick sauce for meatballs, chicken fingers, etc.

name: SOUR CREAM CUCUMBERS
ingredients:
2  to 3 cucumbers
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. sour cream
1  Tbsp. apple cider vinegar
1 1/2  Tbsp. dill weed
1  Tbsp. finely grated onion
1/2  tsp. white pepper
preparation: Peel cucumbers and thinly slice.  Layer slices in a bowl, salting each layer well.  Set aside for 15 minutes.

name: AMISH SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
1  c. oil
1  c. sugar
1  c. powdered sugar
2  eggs
4 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients.  Beat well.  Add 2 eggs.  Sift together flour, soda and cream of tartar.  Add slowly to batter. Add vanilla.  Drop small balls on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: FRUIT AND PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1-1/2  c. corkscrew macaroni
1/2  c. nonfat mayonnaise or salad dressing
1/2  c. low-fat lemon flavored yogurt
1/3  c. low calorie orange marmalade
1/2  tsp. poppy seeds
2  c. strawberries, halved
1-1/2  c. cantaloupe or honeydew melon, cubed
1  c. seedless green or red grapes, halved
2  Tbsp. green onion, sliced
preparation: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Drain and rinse with cold water.  Stir together the mayonnaise or salad dressing, yogurt, marmalade and poppy seeds.  Fold into cooked pasta the strawberries, cantaloupe or honeydew, green or red grapes and green onions.  Cover and chill 2-8 hours.  Each 3/4 cup serving has 1 gram fat and 157 calories.

name: CREAMY TACO SALAD
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1  pkg. chili seasoning mix
1  can pork and beans
1  pt. hot salsa
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
16  oz. sour cream
tomatoes, diced
onions, diced
grated cheese
picante sauce
lettuce, shredded
preparation: Brown and drain beef.   Add remaining ingredients, except cheese and lettuce.   Top with cheese and serve on lettuce with chips.

name: CHEESE PUFFS
ingredients:
1/4  lb. grated American cheese
1/4  lb. butter
1  c. all-purpose flour, sifted
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Blend all ingredients.  Mix with fingers or pastry blender. Roll into balls the size of marbles.  Place on cookie sheets and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: HOT WATER CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  c. hot (not boiling) water
3  c. corn meal
salt to taste (just a pinch)
preparation: Heat water in a small saucepan.  Put 3 cups of corn meal in large bowl and after water is very hot, pour in bowl.  Mix.  Take handfuls of mixture and form under stream of cold water.  Use a teaspoon for putting oil in skillet.  Fry until golden brown. Enjoy!

name: GRAHAM GEMS
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
44  Keebler graham crackers
preparation: Bring to boil 2 sticks butter and 1/2 cup sugar.  Boil for 3 minutes.  Add vanilla.  Place graham crackers on cookie sheet. Pour mixture over graham crackers.  Sprinkle pecans all over graham crackers.  Place in 325° oven for 10 minutes.  Cool on waxed paper.

name: SQUIRREL AND DUMPLINS
ingredients:
1  squirrel (for each person), cleaned well
water
butter
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Put  squirrel into a pressure cooker; cover with water. Cook at	10  pounds pressure for 30 minutes.  Let pressure go down slowly.  Lift  meat  out;  set aside.  Season broth with butter, salt and pepper.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. cooked chicken, chopped
1 small  jar pimento, drained
1  c. crushed potato chips
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. celery, chopped
1  can whole kernel corn
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Mix all ingredients except 1/2 cup potato chips and cheese. Put these on top. Bake at 325° until hot and bubbly.

name: HOT ROLLS
ingredients:
1 heaping  Tbsp. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  yeast pkg.
2  c. warm water
5  c. flour
preparation: Mix ingredients. Cover 20 minutes. Roll on floured surface. Cut out rolls. Makes about 65 rolls. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. plain flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
3  beaten eggs
2  tsp. vanilla flavoring
3  c. chopped apples (of choice)
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix dry ingredients. Add all other ingredients. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan or tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: MEXICAN LASAGNA
ingredients:
1/4  c. sliced black olives
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  tsp. ground cumin
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. red pepper
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. black pepper
1 (16 oz.)  can chopped tomatoes
10  to 12 corn tortillas
2  c. small curd cottage cheese, drained
1  c. grated Monterey Jack cheese with peppers
1  egg
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  c. shredded lettuce
1/2  c. chopped tomato
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain thoroughly.  Add cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, red pepper, salt, pepper and tomatoes.  Heat through.  Cover bottom and sides of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with tortillas.  Pour beef mixture over tortillas. Place a layer of tortillas over meat mixture and set aside.

name: QUICK CRAWFISH JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  c. each:  chopped green pepper and sliced celery
1  c. sliced green onions (including tops)
1  c. uncooked rice
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can peeled whole tomatoes, chopped
1  tsp. each:  salt and poultry seasoning
1  clove garlic, minced
1/4  tsp. ground red pepper
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  lb. (2 1/2 c.) peeled crawfish tails
preparation: Melt butter in large skillet.  Add green pepper, celery and onions.  Cook over medium heat until tender, but not brown.  Stir in remaining ingredients, except crawfish.  Bring to a boil.  Stir once or twice.  Reduce heat; cover and simmer 25 to 30 minutes or until rice is tender.  Mixture should be slightly moist.  Stir in crawfish and cook until thoroughly heated, about 2 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: BRAUNSCHWEIGER DIP BALL
ingredients:
1  lb. braunschweiger
1/3  c. chopped dill pickles
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. dill pickle juice
3  drops Tabasco sauce
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Mash sausage; add mayonnaise, 1/3 of cream cheese and rest of ingredients.  Pack firmly into a 2 cup bowl (or smaller margarine tubs) lined with plastic wrap.  Chill several hours.  Turn out and frost with remaining softened cream cheese.  Add cream or milk if too firm.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  box cherry jello
2 small  boxes orange jello
2  c. boiling water
1  c. sugar
1  pt. can crushed pineapple
1  bag cranberries
1  c. chopped celery
2  oranges, peeled and seeded
2  apples
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water; add sugar and stir until dissolved.  Chill until jello thickens but is not set.  Chop cranberries (washed and drained), celery, oranges and apples very finely.  Add these, pineapple and nuts to jello mixture.  Stir well.  Can be put in fancy mold.  Refrigerate until firm.

name: GRANNY'S MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  c. tomato juice
3/4  c. Quaker oats
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  lb. lean ground chuck
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients except ground chuck. Add ground chuck to mixture.  Press into 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake 1 hour.  Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

name: NEVER FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. plain flour
1  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. shortening
1  egg
5  Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Cut shortening into flour and salt.  Combine egg, water and vinegar and beat.  Pour liquid into flour mixture all at once. Blend with spoon until flour is moistened.  Can be kept in refrigerator or frozen up to 2 weeks.  Roll out on floured dough board.  Line pie plate and bake.

name: PUMPKIN CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. salad oil
2  c. canned pumpkin
1  tsp. baking soda
3  eggs
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cloves, ground
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix oil and sugar, then eggs.  Stir in pumpkin and dry ingredients.  Pour into tube pan that has been greased and floured.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  (Bake about an hour and check.)

name: HERB ROASTED CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. ground sage
1/4  tsp. dried thyme
4  skinless, boneless chicken breast halves (1 lb.)
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1  can Campbell's cream of chicken soup
preparation: On waxed paper combine flour, sage and thyme.  Coat chicken lightly with flour mixture.  In skillet over medium-high heat, in hot margarine, cook chicken until browned bits.  Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.  Serve hot over cooked rice.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
7  oz. catsup
2  Tbsp. vinegar
4  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
7  oz. 7-Up or Sprite
salt, to taste
chili powder, to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients in saucepan.  Cook until it begins to thicken (about 30 minutes).  Add cooked beef, pork or chicken and simmer at least 15 minutes.

name: MICROWAVE STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
4  green peppers, halved and cleaned
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1 small (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
salt and pepper
1  medium onion
8  oz. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  can corn
2  c. cooked rice
preparation: Brown ground beef with onion, salt and pepper.  Drain.  Cook rice.  Combine beef, rice, Parmesan cheese, 1/2 can tomato sauce and corn.  Stuff peppers with mixture.  Sprinkle each pepper with Parmesan cheese and evenly pour remaining tomato sauce over each pepper.  Cover with Saran Wrap and cook on High in microwave for 20 to 25 minutes.  Remove wrap and sprinkle grated cheese on top. Re-cover and cook just long enough to melt cheese.

name: MISSOURI COOKIES(Cow Plops)
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
1  cube margarine
2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. crunchy peanut butter
3  c. quick oats
preparation: First gather and measure all ingredients.  Mix together in large saucepan:  milk, margarine, sugar and cocoa.  Stirring constantly over medium heat, bring to a rolling boil.  Let boil for 1 minute.  Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and peanut butter.  Pour mixture over the oats and stir until blended.

name: TEXAS CHILI
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. red pepper (optional)
3  tsp. salt
3  lb. chili meat
1/4  c. olive oil
1 1/2  tsp. cumin
3  Tbsp. paprika
6  Tbsp. cornmeal
6  cloves garlic
preparation: Sear meat in olive oil until gray colored.  Simmer in water to barely cover meat, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  Add spices and cook 30 minutes longer.  Mix cornmeal with 1 cup cool water.  Add to mixture and cook 5 minutes longer.

name: ALPHABET SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. alphabet macaroni
1 large  can mandarin oranges
1  c. white sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1 large  can crushed pineapple
2  eggs
1  (9 oz.) container Cool Whip
preparation: Cook and cool  macaroni.  Drain juice from both cans of fruit. Add to  the  juice: sugar, eggs and flour.  Cook until thickened. Let cool.	Mix macaroni, fruit and sauce together. Let set overnight.	Stir in Cool Whip.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. mashed potatoes
1 (5 oz.)   can pet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  stick margarine
2  small pie shells or one deep dish pie shell, unbaked
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Mix ingredients.  Bake in unbaked pie shell for 1  1/2 hours or until done.

name: QUICK AND EASY BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese (at room temperature)
1  c. mashed ripe bananas
2  eggs
2  c. packaged biscuit mix
1/2  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
preparation: Cream together sugar and cheese until light and fluffy.  Beat in mashed bananas and eggs.  Add biscuit mix and nuts by hand. Stir until mix is moistened well.  Pour into well-greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake for 1 hour at 350° or until done.

name: ARMADILLO EGGS
ingredients:
3/4  lb. Monterey Jack cheese, grated
1  lb. Owens hot sausage
2 1/2  c. buttermilk biscuit mix
10  medium jalapenos
1  box Shake 'n Bake for pork
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Slit peppers and remove seeds.  Stuff small amount of cheese into pepper halves.  Mix remaining cheese with sausage.  Knead mixture.  Gradually add biscuit mix and continue kneading to make dough.  Pat out small amount of dough and shape around stuffed pepper half to form egg shape.  Roll in Shake 'n Bake, in beaten eggs, then in Shake 'n Bake again.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: APRICOT BARS
ingredients:
2/3  c. dried apricots
1/2  c. soft butter
1/4  c. sugar
1 1/3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. brown sugar, packed
2  eggs, well beaten
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts
confectioners sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. You will need an 8 x 8 x 2 pan.

name: GEORGIA BURGERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped pecans
1  small onion, grated
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. ground cloves
1  jar baby food peaches
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  tsp. vinegar
1/8  tsp. ground ginger
preparation: Mix ground beef with pecans, onion, salt, cloves and 3 tablespoons peaches.  Shape into 4 patties about 1-inch thick. Broil 4 inches from heat for 6 minutes.  While meat is cooking, season remaining peaches with brown sugar, vinegar and ginger. Brush over patties while hot.  Turn and brush again.  Broil 6 minutes longer for medium or more for well done.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 family  pkg. frozen broccoli spears
1  big onion
1  c. uncooked Minute rice
preparation: Cook broccoli spears first; barely cover with water in a 9 x 13-inch buttered casserole per package directions.  Add and mix all other ingredients.  Do not drain water from broccoli.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: TORTELLINI SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. tortellini, cooked in salted water and drained
2  c. broccoli flowerets
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese
1  red onion
1/2  c. pimento stuffed olives
1/2  c. Ranch dressing
tomato wedges
Bac*Os
preparation: Combine cooled tortellini with broccoli flowerets, cheese (cut in bite size pieces), red Spanish onion (cut in rings) and drained olives.  Pour Ranch dressing on top and toss lightly.  Line a salad bowl with lettuce leaves and place salad mixture on lettuce. Garnish with Bac*Os and tomato wedges.  Chill 1 hour before serving.

name: SIX WEEK BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
5  eggs, well beaten
3  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
1 (16 oz.)  box Post Raisin Bran or Post Bran cereal
2  c. English walnuts or pecans
3  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. salt
4 1/2  c. flour
1  qt. buttermilk
1  c. raisins or chopped dates
preparation: Mix and refrigerate overnight before baking.  Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.  For 6 muffins, you may add 1/4 cup crushed pineapple, cranberry-orange relish or applesauce.  Will keep for up to six weeks in refrigerator.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1  lb. chicken (boneless breasts)
2  c. broccoli flowerets
1  medium red pepper
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts, sliced
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
2  c. Minute rice (uncooked)
preparation: Cut the chicken breasts into strips.  Cut the pepper into thin strips.  Heat the oil in a large skillet.  Add chicken; cook and stir until it is thoroughly browned.  Add the broccoli, red pepper and water chestnuts.  Cook and stir until tender-crisp.  Mix in broth, soy sauce, cornstarch, garlic powder and ginger into the mixture.  Bring to a boil; let it boil for 1 1/4 minutes.  Prepare the rice as directed on the package, omitting the margarine and salt.  Pour mixture over rice and serve.

name: CORN BREAD OR MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. Kitchen Craft corn meal
1  c. Kitchen Craft flour
3 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  egg
1  c. milk
1/4  c. melted shortening
preparation: Sift flour, measure and sift again with corn meal, baking powder, sugar and salt.  Beat egg slightly; add milk and shortening.  Combine with dry ingredients, stirring only until moist.  Pour into well-greased square pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch).  Bake in moderately hot 425° oven for 30 minutes or until done.

name: BROWN SUGAR FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. cake flour, sifted
1  tsp. soda
3/4  tsp. salt
2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. Crisco
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
2  sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted
preparation: Sift flour, soda and salt into bowl.  Add brown sugar, shortening, 2/3 of the buttermilk and vanilla.  Beat 2 minutes. Add the rest of the buttermilk, unbeaten eggs and melted and cooled chocolate.  Beat 2 minutes.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cake tests done.  Makes 2 (9-inch) layers.  Frost with Fudge Frosting when cool.

name: BREAKFAST-BRUNCH EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage, browned and drained
6  to 8 bread slices
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar
6  eggs, beaten
2  c. milk
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
preparation: Cut bread into squares and place in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Layer sausage, then cheese over bread crumbs.  Mix remaining ingredients and pour over layers in dish.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until set.

name: FESTIVE HAM AND CHEESE SQUARES(Quick Hors d'Oeuvre)
ingredients:
8  oz. crescent rolls
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. mustard
1/2  c. chopped ham
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. red pepper
3/4  c. shredded Cheddar
3/4  c. shredded Monterey Jack
preparation: Unroll dough into 2 long rectangles.  Place rectangles in 9 x 13 inch baker or baking sheet; press seams together to form crust. Combine butter and mustard; brush on crust.  Sprinkle evenly with remaining ingredients.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Cut into squares.

name: SUGAR-FREE APPLE PIE
ingredients:
4  to 5 medium apples, peeled, cored and sliced
1  can frozen concentrated apple juice
3 to 4  Tbsp. cornstarch or arrowroot powder
cinnamon
butter
double 9-inch pie crust
preparation: Mix apples, juice and cornstarch in a large saucepan and bring to a boil.  When thickened, pour into pie shell.  Sprinkle with cinnamon and dot with butter.  Put top crust on and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Cool thoroughly before slicing.

name: CORN CHOWDER NO. 2
ingredients:
6  chicken broth cubes
6  c. water
4  or 5 potatoes, cubed
3/4  c. onion, chopped
1/2  lb. bacon in pieces
3/4  c. celery, chopped
parsley
salt
pepper
2  cans cream-style corn
2  cans whole kernel corn, drained
1  c. heavy cream
preparation: Cook potatoes in water with broth cubes in soup pot until tender.  Meanwhile, cook onion, bacon and celery in skillet.  When browned, add to potato/water pot.  Add parsley, salt, pepper and corn.  Cook several hours.  During last 1/2 hour, add cream.

name: SEASONED OYSTER CRACKERS
ingredients:
24  oz. oyster crackers
2  Tbsp. dill weed
2  envelopes Hidden Valley Ranch (original)
1/2  c. oil
preparation: Mix and stir well and leave open 2 hours or so.  Then cover container to keep fresh.

name: ALMOST HEAVEN CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  can (20 oz.) crushed pineapple, undrained
1  pkg. (3 oz.) instant vanilla pudding
2  c. cold milk
1  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  container (13 oz.) whipped topping
chopped nuts or coconut
preparation: Prepare cake mix as directed.  Bake in a 13 x 9-inch sheet cake pan.  After baking, prick cake with fork while cake is still warm.  Pour undrained pineapple over hot cake.  Blend pudding with milk and beat in cream cheese, a small amount at a time.  Spread over pineapple.  Cover with whipped topping.  Garnish with chopped nuts or coconut or both.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.  The longer the cake is refrigerated the better the flavor.

name: LIL' PORKERS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1  c. cabbage, chopped
2  Tbsp. onion, diced
1  carrot, diced fine
1  lb. leftover pork shoulder, ground
3/4  c. Velveeta, shredded
1/3  c. water
2  tsp. prepared mustard
2  pkg. crescent rolls
preparation: In a skillet over medium heat, in hot oil, cook cabbage, onion and carrot until tender.  Stir in pork, water and mustard, then add shredded cheese.  Separate crescent dough and cut each triangle in half.  Press to flatten slightly.  Spoon 1 tablespoon of pork mixture into the center of triangle.  Pull corners to center over pork mixture.  Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Makes approximately 32.

name: FAVORITE FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can chunk pineapple
1 large  can mandarin oranges
2  large bananas, sliced
nuts and cherries (as desired)
1 small  box vanilla Jell-O pudding and pie filling
preparation: Reserve juices from pineapple and oranges.  If necessary, add enough water to make 1 cup of liquid.  Mix with pudding and pie filling.  Heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens.  Cool and pour over fruit mixture.  Stir well.  Chill 3 to 4 hours before serving.

name: MINUTE RICE(Microwave)
ingredients:
2  c. water
1  Tbsp. butter
3/4  tsp. salt
2  c. Minute rice
preparation: In a 2-quart casserole, combine water, butter and salt. Microwave for 5 minutes at High (100% power) until it comes to a boil.  Add rice and stir well.  Microwave for 1 minute, covered, at High.  Let stand for 5 minutes, covered.  Fluff with a fork before serving.

name: CHICKEN CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  can tomato soup
1  can mayonnaise
12  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  can cooked chicken
1/2  c. chopped green onions
shredded Cheddar cheese (for the top)
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix soups, mayonnaise and cream cheese together in saucepan. Stir over low heat until liquified. Add chicken, salt, pepper and green onions. Pour ingredients into casserole dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with Fritos. Enjoy!!!

name: EGGPLANT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  large or 3 small eggplants
1  large onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  small garlic button, minced
2  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  can tomatoes and chilies
salt and pepper to taste
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  stick grated cheese
2  c. fine cracker crumbs
preparation: Cook  eggplant   until  tender;  drain  and  mash.  Add remaining  ingredients  except  cheese and crackers; mix well. Alternate  layers  of  eggplant  mixture,  cheese  and cracker crumbs  in  greased  casserole  dish.  Butter  last  layer  of cracker crumbs; sprinkle on top.  Bake 50 minutes at 325°.

name: CHOCOLATE MINT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1  stick melted oleo
4  eggs
1 (16 oz.)  can Hershey's chocolate syrup
preparation: Mix together sugar, flour, melted oleo, eggs and Hershey's chocolate syrup.  Bake 20 minutes at 350° in large, sided cookie sheet (17 x 11-inch), greased and floured.  Cool this layer.  Can put in refrigerator.

name: CRANBERRY CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  c. quick rolled oats
1/2  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1  can cranberry sauce
preparation: Mix oats, flour and sugar.  Add margarine and stir until mixture is crumbly.  Place half the mixture in well greased 8 x 8-inch pan and cover with cranberry sauce.  Top with the  balance of the oat mixture.  Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.  Serve warm, topped with whipped cream.

name: CLAM DIP
ingredients:
1  fresh bud garlic
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese (room temperature), softened in microwave
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese with chives
6  oz. can minced clams
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
dash of Tabasco sauce
preparation: Rub bowl with garlic; then put garlic on toothpick to put into dip when mixed later. Pour juice off clams and mix with cheese (save clam juice to use if dip is too thick). Add lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Tabasco sauce and clams.  Mix well; place garlic bud in center and let set in refrigerator overnight. Next morning, remove garlic bud and stir dip well. Serve with chips or crackers.

name: SAUSAGE BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen bread
1  lb. Mozzarella, grated
1  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1 medium  can Parmesan cheese
1 large  jar olives with pimentos, chopped
2  cans black olives, chopped
1  lb. smoked sausage, thinly sliced
1  stick butter, melted
bell pepper, jalapeno pepper and onion, chopped
preparation: Divide loaves and ingredients into 6 parts.  Butter loaves and place in pan or bowl to rise.  Roll out dough lengthwise.  Rub with butter.  In center of each loaf, layer sausage, cheeses, olives, peppers and onions.  Pull ends and sides over and fold long sides over.  Butter again and let sit for 30 minutes.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: HOT SPICED TEA
ingredients:
2  qt. boiling water
6  to 8 whole cloves
1  Tbsp. tea leaves (about 2 bags)
3/8  c. orange juice
1/3  c. lemon juice
1  c. sugar
preparation: Pour boiling water over tea and cloves.  Let stand 10 minutes. Strain and add sugar, lemon and orange juices.  Heat piping hot.

name: JELLO PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1 small  can crushed pineapple and juice
1  pkg. strawberry Jell-O (do not add water)
1 large  can evaporated milk
2  cracker crumb pie crusts
preparation: Stir sugar, crushed pineapple and Jell-O together.  Heat in saucepan until mixture comes to a boil.  Remove from heat and cool for about 5 minutes.  Whip chilled evaporated milk until double in volume.  Combine boiled mixture and whipped milk.  Pour into pie crusts and chill at least 4 hours.

name: NO BAKE CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. powdered cocoa
1/2  c. milk
3  c. Quaker oats
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. peanut butter
preparation: Combine butter, sugar, cocoa and milk; bring to a boil.  Boil 1 minute and remove from heat.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.  Let cool and serve.

name: NO ROLL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  tsp. milk
preparation: Stir dry ingredients into pie pan.  Add milk and oil.  Stir flour with fork until completely dampened.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. plain flour
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
3  Tbsp. shortening
2  pkg. yeast
1  c. warm water
2  c. buttermilk
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Sift flour, sugar, salt and baking powder together.  Dissolve yeast in warm water; dissolve soda in buttermilk.  Mix dry ingredients, shortening and yeast mixture together; knead on floured board for few minutes.  Cover in a bowl and let rise; pinch off as wanted for biscuits.  This will keep in icebox for several days.  Bake at 400° until brown.

name: EGG BREAD FOR DRESSING
ingredients:
2  c. cornmeal
3/4  c. plain flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2 1/4  c. buttermilk
3  eggs
1/4  c. cooking oil
preparation: Heat a 10-inch skillet in a 450° oven for 5 minutes.  Combine all dry ingredients and mix.  Gradually add all liquids; mix well with spoon or hand.  Remove skillet from oven and coat with cooking spray.  Pour batter into skillet.  Bake at 450° for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.  Let cool.  Yields 8 cups crumbled bread crumbs.

name: CHEESY ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  cooked and deboned chicken
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  bag Doritos
preparation: Put chicken and chips in an oblong pan.  Heat soups and melt cheese.  Pour this over the chicken and chips;  then bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.  Yum Yum!

name: ORANGE GLAZED CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless chicken breast halves
1  Tbsp. oil
1  c. carrots (fresh or thawed frozen)
1  c. celery, sliced
1  c. orange juice
1  c. chicken broth
1 1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. onion powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. Minute original rice (uncooked)
2  Tbsp. orange marmalade
preparation: Brown chicken on both sides in hot oil in a large skillet. Move chicken to side of skillet.  Add carrots and celery; cook and stir until carrots are crisp-tender.  Meanwhile, mix orange juice, broth, cornstarch, onion powder and salt; add to skillet.  Bring to boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer until the chicken is thoroughly cooked, 10 minutes.  Stir in rice, spoon marmalade over chicken; cover.  Remove from heat.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Fluff with fork.  Serves 4.

name: CHOW MEIN COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. white syrup
2  c. chunky peanut butter
1 large  can chow mein noodles
preparation: Bring syrup and sugar to a good boil.  Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter.  Add noodles; mix well.  Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

name: PEANUT PIE
ingredients:
4  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  c. confectioners sugar
1/2  c. creamy peanut butter
1/2  c. milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
1  (9-inch) graham cracker crust
1/4  c. finely chopped salted peanuts
preparation: Whip cheese until soft and fluffy.  Beat in sugar and peanut butter.  Slowly add milk, blending thoroughly into mixture.  Fold topping into mixture.  Pour into pie shell.  Sprinkle with chopped peanuts.  Freeze until firm before serving.  If not used, can be frozen.  Wrap in sealing wrap after frozen.

name: PORK AND BEAN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. raisins
1  c. boiling water
2  c. sugar
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (15 oz.)  can pork and beans
3  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Add raisins to boiling water and set aside.  Mash beans with a fork in a large bowl until very smooth.  Add sugar, eggs, oil and vanilla.  Mix well.  Sift together dry ingredients and fold in.  Drain raisins and fold in with chopped nuts.  Spoon batter into three greased and floured loaf pans.  Bake in a 325° oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.

name: CHEESY BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
3  c. water
3 chicken bouillon cubes or 3  c. stock
1  head broccoli
1  small onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1/2 to 1  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. salt
8  oz. Velveeta cheese
1/4 to 1/2  c. cornstarch
preparation: In a stew pot, add water, bouillon cubes, chopped onion, broccoli and spices.  Boil 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Add diced Velveeta cheese and whip until melted.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
1  c. ground nuts
3  bananas
1  egg
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Mash bananas with fork.  Add flour, butter, sugar, vanilla, salt and egg.  Mix well and add nuts.  Mix again.  Pour into well-greased bread pan and bake 35 to 45 minutes in oven preheated to 325°.

name: OUR FAVORITE WINGS
ingredients:
3  lb. chicken wings (about 35 to 40)
1/4  c. Louisiana hot sauce (not Tabasco)
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
celery sticks
Blue cheese dressing
preparation: Deep fry wings at 400° for 12 minutes or bake at 425° for 1 hour.  Turn halfway.

name: PARTY POTATOES
ingredients:
Potato Buds
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2/3  tsp. garlic salt
1/3  tsp. onion salt
milk
1/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Prepare Potato Buds for 8 people as directed on package, except decrease liquid by 1/2 cup.  Mix cream cheese, garlic salt and onion salt; add to potatoes.  Pour into baking dish (buttered).  Pour 1/2 cup butter over top and sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: HUNGARIAN CAULIFLOWER
ingredients:
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  oz. crushed cornflakes
4  c. cauliflower florets, parboiled
2  large egg whites, lightly beaten
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Spray a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.

name: SWISS CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
6  slices Swiss cheese
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1/4  c. milk
2  c. herb-seasoned stuffing mix
1/4  c. melted margarine
preparation: Arrange chicken in a baking dish.  Cover with Swiss cheese slices.  Combine soup and milk; pour over chicken.  Sprinkle dressing and butter over casserole.  Cover and bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: SEASHORE LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  box large shell pasta
1  container Ricotta cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan
1  egg
1  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
grated Mozzarella cheese
1  jar spaghetti sauce
preparation: Cook spinach and drain.  Cook pasta, drain and cool.  Mix Ricotta, egg, spinach and Parmesan with salt to taste.  Stuff cooled shells with spinach mixture and place in casserole.  Cover with spaghetti sauce and layer of Mozzarella.  Repeat layers. Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: PIE CRUST
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. cold water
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. shortening
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients in plastic bowl with cover on. Shake well. Add cold water; shake well.  Put on floured board.  Makes 2 crusts.  Never fail.

name: ICEBOX ROLLS
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. salt
6  c. flour
2  pkg. yeast
1  c. boiling water
1  c. cold water
preparation: Dissolve shortening, sugar, and salt in boiling water.  Add eggs.  Dissolve yeast in cold water.  Add flour, 3 cups at a time. Sift flour 3 times.  Make early in the morning and let rise a number of times, until about noon.  Put in refrigerator for 2 hours.  Make out dough about the size of a walnut.  Place 3 to a Pyrex custard cup.  This makes a cloverleaf roll.  Let rise until the dinner hour.  Bake in a 400° oven.

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
5  lb. cooked diced potatoes
1  c. diced celery
1  c. diced onions
4  diced hard-boiled eggs
1  lb. bacon (regular, not turkey)
preparation: Mix potatoes, celery, onions and eggs. Cut bacon in small pieces and fry until done (little crispy). Do not drain fat.

name: QUICK ROLLS
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  pkg. quick rise yeast
1  c. very warm water
1  Tbsp. shortening
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix 1 1/4 cups flour, sugar, yeast and water.  Stir well.  Add shortening, egg, salt and remaining flour.  Cover for 30 minutes in bowl.  Stir down and put in muffin pan.  Let rise.  Heat oven to 375°.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly brown.

name: MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
1  lb. Velveeta cheese block
1  can Hormel chili (no beans)
1  bunch green onions
1  can chili peppers
preparation: Brown hamburger meat and drain.  Cube cheese and slice onions. Mix all ingredients together in a baking dish.  Bake for 1 hour at 275°.

name: CABBAGE TSUKEMONO
ingredients:
5  lb. cabbage, washed and cut into wedges
1  c. hot water
1  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. salt
1/4  c. vinegar
1/4  c. whiskey (any kind you have on hand)
preparation: Heat  hot water, brown sugar, salt and vinegar until it comes to a boil.	Cool.  Add the whiskey and pour the mixture over the cabbage.  Put into a container (such as a crock) that a  weight can be put on top of the cabbage.  It will be ready to  eat in two days.  Remove from the weight and put into jars or plastic container and refrigerate.

name: SOFT SUGAR-FREE COOKIES
ingredients:
