1  pkg. fruit bits (1 1/2 c.)
1/4  c. raisins
1  c. water
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
3  beaten eggs
1  c. nut meats
1/4  c. coconut
preparation: Bail  the  fruit  bits, raisins and water until tender. Cool and  add the rest of the ingredients.  Mix well and chill for  30 minutes.  Drop  by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Do not overbake.

name: HEARTY POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
1  large onion
1 large  can evaporated milk
1/3  lb. bacon
1  lb. can corn, drained
salt, pepper, parsley
preparation: In a large kettle, place sliced potatoes and onions.  Add water to cover and cook until potatoes are soft.  Use masher to break potatoes into smaller pieces.  Let simmer on low heat to boil down a bit.  Fry bacon until crisp and break into bits.  Add bacon, milk, corn, salt, pepper and parsley to potatoes.  Add some of the bacon drippings for flavor.  Heat thoroughly (do not boil).

name: CHOCOLATE CHERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box devil's food cake mix
2  eggs
1  can dark sweet cherries in water and corn syrup
1  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Mix cake mix and cherry juice.  Add eggs and extract.  Mix with spoon and fold in cherries.  Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: CHICK'S FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. vinegar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. powdered garlic
1  can tomato soup
1  c. Wesson oil
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients.  Add soup and oil.  Shake and chill.

name: BEST RICE
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice
1  onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic, chopped
small amount of salt to taste
white pepper to taste
1  can consomme with gel
1  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
coarsely ground black pepper to taste
1 small  jar mushroom stems and pieces (do not drain)
preparation: Mix everything together.  Pour into a large casserole dish with tight-fitting lid.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIR CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. graham crackers
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. French vanilla instant pudding
8  oz. Cool Whip
3 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan.  Line bottom of pan with crackers. Mix pudding with milk; beat 2 minutes.  Stir in Cool Whip.   Put 1/2 mixture over crackers.  Layer crackers and rest of pudding. Final layer of crackers.  Chill in refrigerator while making frosting.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIR
ingredients:
2  boxes vanilla instant pudding
3  c. milk
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  box Keebler honey graham crackers
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
1/4  c. Pet milk
1  stick oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, cocoa and milk.  Slowly bring to a boil.  Boil 1 minute.  Add butter and vanilla.  Take off stove.  Beat until thick enough to spread.  Spread on top.

name: HOMEMADE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
dash of salt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  can Milnot
1  box half and half
1  box instant pudding (any flavor)
preparation: Combine 2 tablespoons white vinegar and cane sugar with 1 quart of water.

name: QUICK VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 large  can tomato puree
2  c. potatoes, diced
2  carrots, diced
1/2  c. celery, diced
1  onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. salt
1/4  c. uncooked rice
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 3/4  c. water
preparation: Brown ground beef in large pan.  After browning, add remaining ingredients.  When mixture is steaming, reduce heat to low setting and cook 45 to 60 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: BUTTERMILK POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
3  c. sugar
3  c. flour
1  c. buttermilk
6  eggs
1  tsp. salt (optional)
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar, salt and vanilla.  Mix well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.  Add to remaining milk the 1/4 teaspoon soda.  Fold into mixture.

name: PORTABELLA MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
10  portabella mushrooms, cleaned and dried
1  Tbsp. sliced shallots
1  tsp. chopped garlic
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. raspberry vinegar
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Saut mushrooms, shallots and garlic in butter and olive oil for 6 to 7 minutes. Add raspberry vinegar and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese. Stir until melted. Top with 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese and serve immediately.

name: CORNFLAKE CANDY
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. Karo syrup
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. crunchy peanut butter
6  c. cornflakes
preparation: Bring syrup and sugar to good boil. Take off burner and mix in peanut butter. Mix well, then add cornflakes, stirring until coated. Drop by teaspoonful onto waxed paper.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1  large Cool Whip
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. instant pistachio pudding mix
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple, not drained
1 1/2  c. small marshmallows
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix Cool Whip and dry pudding mix.  Stir well.  Add undrained pineapple, marshmallows and nuts.  Mix thoroughly.  Pour into a serving dish and place in refrigerator for 2 hours.

name: ZUCCHINI SOUP
ingredients:
4  medium zucchini, quartered and sliced
2 (15 oz.)  cans chicken broth
bunch of green onions, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
dill weed to taste
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sour cream with chives
chives, chopped or paprika
preparation: In  a  saucepan,  add  zucchini,  chicken  broth, green onions,  salt, pepper and dill weed.  Cook mixture until soft, approximately  20  to  30 minutes.  Blend the cream cheese and sour  cream in a blender until smooth.  Then blend in zucchini mixture,  a  portion at a time, until smooth.  Chill overnight or until very cold.  Garnish with chopped chives or paprika.

name: PESTO CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. basil
1/2  c. parsley
1 1/2  tsp. olive oil
1/8  tsp. garlic
1/4  tsp. lemon juice
8  oz. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. milk
1/8  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. parmesan
preparation: Mince parsley and basil in food processor until fine.  Add rest of ingredients.  Process until smooth.  If using as a dip, add more milk until right consistency.  Place in sourdough round and serve.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. oil
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. self-rising flour
dash of cinnamon
3  c. sliced apples
1  c. pecans
preparation: Mix the first 4 ingredients together, then add flour, spice, apples and pecans.  Bake in tube pan for approximately 1 hour.

name: FESTIVE GREEN PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1  can green peas (16 oz.)
5  slices fried crisp
bacon, crumbled
1/2  c. red onion
1/4  c. shredded cheese (Cheddar)
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. wine vinegar
1/2  tsp. sweetener
1  tsp. pimento
preparation: Drain peas.  Add bacon, onion and cheese.  Mix milk, mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar.  Add to peas.  Stir gently.  Garnish with pimento.  Serves 8 to 10.  Good potluck dish.  Can make ahead of time.

name: OVERNIGHT VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can green peas, drained
1 (No. 2)  can French green beans, drained
1 (No. 2)  can whole corn, drained
1  c. celery, diced
1/2  c. green pepper, diced
1  medium onion, diced
2  oz. jar pimento
salt to taste
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
1/2  c. salad oil
1/2  tsp. paprika (optional)
1  tsp. water
preparation: Combine first 8 ingredients in a large bowl.  Mix sugar, vinegar, salad oil, paprika and water.  Pour mixture over vegetables.  Stir well and chill 24 hours.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: AU GRATIN POTATOES
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. onion, grated
1/2  pt. sour cream
9  to 10 medium potatoes, peeled, cooked and grated
1  c. crushed cornflakes
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Melt butter in a large saucepan, and add soup, grated cheese, onion and sour cream.  Stir until well mixed.  Pour over grated potatoes in large baking dish and mix lightly.  Top with crushed cornflakes and bake, uncovered, in preheated oven for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: CORN FLAKE CANDY
ingredients:
1  cup sugar
1  cup peanut butter
1  cup white karo syrup
6  cups corn flakes
preparation: Heat sugar and syrup until it melts completely.  Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter.  Add corn flakes, spoon desired size pieces onto wax paper.

name: SWEET POTATO YAMS
ingredients:
4  medium sweet potatoes
1  stick butter
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. light brown sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. milk
miniature marshmallows (as desired)
preparation: Peel and cut pototoes into 2-inch slices.  Put in saucepan with enough water to cover potatoes; add salt.  Cook until half done; drain potatoes.  Melt butter in microwave 1 minute.  Then mix sugar, cinnamon and milk into butter.  Pour over potatoes; bake at 400° until tender.  Remove from oven and put marshmallows on top. Put back in oven until marshmallows are golden brown.

name: CHERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
9 1/4  oz. crushed vanilla wafers
1/2  c. butter, melted
1 (9 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
6  Tbsp. sugar
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  cans cherry pie filling
preparation: Mix vanilla wafer crumbs and butter.  Pour 1/2 of crumbs into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Whip Cool Whip and cream cheese with sugar.  Put 1/2 of this on top of buttered crumbs.  Pour pie filling over this.  Add other half of Cool Whip and cream cheese. Top with remaining crumbs.  Cool until ready to serve.

name: GOOEY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  stick margarine
1  egg
1  box powdered sugar
1  stick margarine
1  egg
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan (mixture will be dry).  Mix next 4 ingredients and pour on top of cake mixture.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE PECAN PIE
ingredients:
4  oz. pkg. German sweet chocolate or 4 sq. semi-sweet chocolate
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. light or dark Karo syrup
1/3  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. pecan halves
9-inch unbaked pastry shell
preparation: Melt chocolate and let cool slightly.   In large bowl, combine chocolate, eggs, syrup, sugar, butter and vanilla.   Blend well. Stir in pecans.    Pour into pastry shell.   Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.   Cool.  Serves 8.

name: RICE PLUS
ingredients:
1  c. rice
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
marshmallows
nutmeg
preparation: Wash and cook rice.  Add sugar and butter.  Place in shallow baking dish.  Cover top with marshmallows and sprinkle with nutmeg.  Bake in oven until marshmallows are brown and puffed.

name: COCA-COLA CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Coca-Cola
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
2  c. plain flour
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  eggs, beaten slightly
2  c. sugar
2  sticks oleo
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put oleo, cocoa and Coca-Cola in boiler.  Bring to a boil. Combine flour and sugar and pour mixture over.  Mix well.  Add buttermilk, soda, salt, eggs and vanilla.  Add marshmallows.  This is a thin batter and marshmallows will float. Pour into a greased and floured pan (13 x 9-inch).  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  pkg. dried beef, chopped
1  tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. sour cream
2  tbsp. chopped onions
preparation: Combine all and shape into ball.  Roll in parsley or nuts.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  can whole kernel corn
1 (3 oz.)  can cream style corn
1  Tbsp. green pepper, diced
1  stick oleo
2  eggs, beaten
1  pt. sour cream
2  c. shredded cheddar cheese
1  box Jiffy corn bread mix
1  small onion, diced
preparation: Sauté onion and pepper in the oleo.  In a separate bowl, mix the eggs and corn.  Mix the sautéed onion and pepper with sour cream and corn bread mix.  Add eggs and corn to the mixture and spread in a greased 7 x 12 inch baking dish.  Cover mixture with shredded cheese and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
2  avocados
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. soft cream cheese
1 1/2  tsp. Beau Monde
1 1/2  tsp. Lawry salt
1 (8 oz.)  bottle taco sauce
1  chopped green pepper
2  chopped tomatoes
1  bunch green onions, chopped
shredded Cheddar cheese
round Tostitos chips
preparation: Mix in blender avocados, cream cheese, Beau Monde and Lawry salt.  Spread on large platter about 1/2-inch thick.  Top with remaining ingredients and serve with Tostitos chips.

name: YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. warm water
2  pkg. dry yeast
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
6  c. flour
preparation: Mix warm water, sugar and yeast.  Let stand about 5 minutes. Add shortening and stir until melted.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Knead about 10 minutes or until dough is smooth and bubbles form under dough.  Let rise about 45 minutes in warm place. Punch down and shape into rolls.  Bake in greased 9 x 9-inch pans or 9 x 13-inch pan.  Let rise for about 20 minutes.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden brown.  Rolls will have a hollow sound when thumped gently on bottom when done.

name: QUICK SPINACH LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  jar Prego spaghetti sauce
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1/2  c. water
1  lb. lasagna noodles
1  pkg. frozen spinach, chopped
2  eggs
1 (16 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese, grated
preparation: Mix and heat in saucepan the Prego, tomato paste and water. In large mixing bowl, combine together the frozen spinach, 2 eggs, cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese.  In large baking pan, layer sauce, raw noodles, cottage cheese mixture and Mozzarella cheese until you reach the top of the pan.  End up with sauce.  Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.  Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: TACO BEEF SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
3  c. water
2 large  cans stewed tomatoes
2 small  cans red kidney beans
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1  pkg. taco seasoning
preparation: In large saucepan, cook ground beef and onion until meat is browned; drain off excess fat.  Add water, undrained tomatoes, undrained kidney beans, tomato sauce and taco seasoning mix. Simmer, covered, for 30 to 45 minutes.  Serve with cheese, corn chips and sour cream.

name: ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. tomato sauce
1  tsp. shortening
dash of pepper and garlic salt
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  lb. ground chuck
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. grated sharp cheese
preparation: Brown chuck. Add other ingredients. Roll in tortillas and bake at 300° for 25 minutes. Remove from oven. Pour sauce over enchiladas. Sprinkle cheese on top and return to oven for 10 minutes or until cheese melts.

name: LEMON SESAME CHICKEN
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. broiler-fryer chicken, cut up
1/4  c. fresh or bottled lemon juice
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. rosemary, thyme, marjoram, sesame seed and pepper
preparation: Mix oil, juice and seasonings and brush on chicken pieces. Let sit for an hour in the refrigerator.  Cook slowly on the grill until done, 45 to 60 minutes.

name: RHUBARB PIE
ingredients:
2  c. rhubarb
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, separated
lump of butter
1  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Separate eggs and reserve egg whites for meringue.  Mix remaining ingredients and cook slowly until like jelly.  Bake pie shell.  Put mixture in pie shell and cover with meringue made from the egg whites.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE CAKE(Uncommonly Good; 3-Layer)
ingredients:
5  oz. semi-sweet chocolate
1/2  c. boiling water
1  c. butter
2 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Melt chocolate in boiling water. Cool. Cream butter and sugar; beat in egg yolks. Stir in vanilla and chocolate. Set aside. Mix flour, soda and salt. Beat chocolate mixture into flour alternately with buttermilk. Beat in sour cream. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry; fold into batter. Pour batter into 3 (9-inch) round cake pans, lined on the bottoms with waxed and greased paper; grease and flour sides of pans. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool 15 minutes in pan; remove and cool on racks. Spread coconut pecan filling between layers and chocolate or white frosting on top and sides.

name: MACARONI CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. cooked and diced chicken breast
2  c. large cooked pasta shells
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. frozen green peas
1/2  c. cashew halves
preparation: Mix together mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt and pepper.  Toss with remaining ingredients.  Chill and serve.

name: BOSTON CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1  box (4 serving size) vanilla instant pudding
1/2  c. whipped topping
preparation: Prepare cake mix as directed.  Bake in two 8 or 9-inch cake pans, greased and floured well.  When cool, split each layer in half horizontally.  Prepare pudding as directed.  Fold in 1/2 cup whipped topping.  Divide this filling between the two cake "bottoms."  Place cake "tops" on.  Frost.

name: RECIPE FOR FRIENDSHIP
ingredients:
2  heaping measures of trust
2  well rounded scoops of respect
2  generous portions of affection
2  equal amounts of sharing
preparation: Stir together until lumps and bumps are dissolved, then carefully pour into heart-shaped containers.  Sprinkle abundantly with patience, understanding, tolerance, humor, caring, compassion, tenderness, and dependability.  Warm gently and serve generously.

name: HOE CAKES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising cornmeal
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1 1/4  c. buttermilk
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  Tbsp. Crisco shortening, melted
1/4  c. Crisco shortening
preparation: Combine cornmeal and baking soda in medium bowl.  Add buttermilk, egg and 1 tablespoon melted shortening.  Stir just until moistened.  Heat 1/4 cup shortening on medium-high heat in large, heavy skillet.  Pour 1/4 cut batter into skillet for each hoe cake.  Fry 1 to 2 minutes or until golden brown on each side. Add additional shortening, if necessary.  Drain on paper towel. Serve immediately.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SPICY SAUSAGE AND POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. thinly sliced potatoes
1/2 to 3/4  lb. Italian sausage, cut in pieces
1/2  c. green pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
6  eggs
1/2  c. milk
3/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. tomato sauce
4  oz. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Butter 2-quart casserole.  Arrange first 4 ingredients in casserole.  Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.  Beat together next 4 ingredients.  Add salt and pepper.  Pour over first mixture. Reduce heat to 325°.  Bake for 30 minutes.  Drizzle with sauce. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.  Bake additional 10 minutes.

name: PINA COLADA PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1  (12 oz.) orange juice
1  (15 1/2 oz.) cream of coconut
7 1/2  c. water
preparation: Mix well.  Finish filling gallon jug with water.

name: ZUCCHINI FRUIT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. shredded zucchini
1  Tbsp. orange juice
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. cloves
2  c. flour
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
1/2  c. dates, chopped
1/2  c. raisins
peel of 1 orange, grated
preparation: Cream sugar, oil, egg and vanilla; mix well.  Grate zucchini. Combine with orange juice and peel; set aside.  Combine all dry ingredients and blend with creamed mixture.   Fold in zucchini mixture, nuts, dates and raisins.  Pour into Bundt pan that has been well-greased and floured.  Bake in preheated 325° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean.  Wrap in foil, when cool, to keep moist.  This freezes well.

name: PAULINE'S APPLE BUTTER
ingredients:
3  c. applesauce
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cook applesauce and 1 cup sugar for 20 minutes on medium heat. Add remaining ingredients.  Cook on low to medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently.  Pour into scalded jars and seal. Early transparents and Lodis make the best apple butter.

name: RAW APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  tsp vanilla
2  cups sugar
1  1/2 cups oil
2  eggs
3  cups flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp soda
1  tsp. salt
3  cup peeled and diced apples
1  cup chopped pecans
2/3  cup coconut (optional)
1/2  cup candied cherries (optional)
preparation: Combine all together. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours in tube or bundt pan.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  or 5 chicken breasts, boiled, deboned and cut in small pieces
1  bell pepper
1  large onion
1  stick butter
1 small  can Pet milk
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  bag taco chips, crushed
1  lb. Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Saute pepper and onion with butter; remove from heat.  Add soups, Ro-Tel and milk.  Butter bottom of baking dish.  Add half bag of chips, chicken and all of cheese, except 1/3 cup.  Pour mixture on top of chicken, then the last of cheese and chips. Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: CHEWY CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. margarine, softened
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
3/4  c. cocoa
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
2  c. peanut butter chips (optional)
preparation: Cream butter or margarine and sugar in large mixer bowl.  Add eggs and vanilla; blend well.  Combine flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt; gradually blend into creamed mixture.   Stir in nuts and peanut butter chips, if desired.

name: SCRAMBLED OMELET
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
8  eggs, slightly beaten
5  slices bacon
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. chopped onion
dash of pepper
preparation: Stir soup until smooth.  Blend in eggs and pepper.  In skillet, cook bacon until crisp.  Remove from skillet and crumble into bowl.  Pour off all but 2 tablespoons drippings.  Cook green pepper and onion in drippings until tender.  Pour in egg mixture and scramble.  Sprinkle bacon on eggs when done.  You can also add shredded cheese to hot scrambled eggs, if you like.

name: SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  (10 oz.) chopped, frozen spinach
1/4  c. water
3  slices bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1  clove garlic, minced
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. coarse fresh bread cubes
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
3  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Heat spinach with water until thawed.  Add butter.  Heat until butter melts.  Remove from heat.  Do not drain.  Stir in bread cubes and seasonings.  Turn into casserole.  Toss crumbs, Parmesan cheese and butter.  Spread over spinach.  Bake in preheated 400° oven for 10 to 15 minutes, until hot through.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: BLACKBERRY JAM
ingredients: 2  c. sugar to 1 c. blackberries
preparation: Mash blackberries with a potato masher. Add sugar to mashed berries. Cook 1 hour. Place in hot sterilized jars.

name: CHEESY POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
Betty Crocker mashed Potato Buds (for 8 servings)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  Tbsp. snipped parsley
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. corn flakes, crushed
2  Tbsp. soft butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. each: dry mustard, paprika, salt
preparation: Prepare Betty Crocker mashed Potato Buds for 8 servings, except decrease salt to 1/2 teaspoon and add 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt.  Stir parsley and cheese into potatoes.  Put into 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over potatoes.  Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

name: UNBELIEVEABLE PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chunk-style peanut butter
preparation: Beat the egg slightly in a bowl.  Add the sugar, peanut butter and vanilla and beat together until smooth. Drop by teaspoon on a greased cookie sheet. Bake in a slow oven at 325° for 20 minutes or until nicely brown.  Makes about 40 cookies.

name: VIRGINIA TURNER'S BROWNIES(Memory To Cheryl Carson's Mom)
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. pecans
preparation: Melt margarine in saucepan.  Remove from heat; add sugar and cocoa and stir.  Add eggs and stir well.  Add flour and stir.  Add vanilla and eggs and stir again.  Pour in greased and floured pan, approximately 8 x 10-inch, and cook for 25 minutes at 350°.  When done, take from oven and turn upside down immediately on paper sack.  Use icing recipe.

name: UPSIDE-DOWN PIZZA
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onion
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1 (1 1/4 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti sauce mix
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. refrigerated crescent rolls
preparation: Cook beef and onion until meat is browned; drain well.  Stir in tomato sauce and sauce mix; cook over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently.  Spoon into a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Top with sour cream; sprinkle with cheese.  Unroll crescent rolls and place on top of cheese.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 minutes.  Makes 8 servings.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti, broken in 4 lengths
3  small tomatoes, diced 1/2-inch squares
1  cucumber, peeled, diced and quartered
1  red onion, peeled, sliced and quartered
1  green pepper
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Wish-Bone salad dressing (Italian type)
1/4  container Salad Supreme
preparation: Cook spaghetti until tender, but firm.  While cooking, cut up vegetables.  When cooked spaghetti is done, drain and then run under cold water for several minutes so spaghetti is cold.  Drain again.  Place in large bowl.  Add vegetables and dressing after mixing well and add Salad Supreme.

name: GERMAN CABBAGE
ingredients:
2 1/2  sticks butter or butter flavored Crisco
2  heads cabbage
2  pared apples
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. red wine vinegar
2  chopped onions
preparation: Saute cabbage and onions in butter.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer.

name: A. P. CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. flour
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. lard or Crisco
1  c. milk
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: MEATBALL DINNER
ingredients:
3  slices bread
1/2  c. milk
1  egg
1  lb. ground beef
3  Tbsp. grated onion
3  Tbsp. snipped parsley (optional)
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. tomato juice
1  c. water
1/2  c. chopped carrots
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Soften bread in the milk.  Beat the egg and add it.  Mix the ground beef, onion, parsley, 1 teaspoon salt and pepper together. Combine the bread and meat mixture and form into 18 balls.  Brown balls in skillet in 2 tablespoons hot oil.   Drain off excess fat. Add tomato juice, water, carrots, celery and salt.  Cover; simmer 45 minutes.  Serve over rice, if desired.

name: CHICKEN SUPREME
ingredients:
1  stewed hen
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. noodles
1  small onion, diced
2  Tbsp. pimento
1/2  tsp. oregano
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1/2  lb. cheese, grated
preparation: After stewing chicken, remove meat from broth (when cool), bone and dice.  Set aside.  Cook noodles in broth according to package directions.  Drain.  Mix onions, pimento, oregano and a dash of pepper and soup.  Add milk.  Stir together and add chicken, drained noodles and half of the grated cheese to soup mixture.  Place in 9 x 13-inch casserole.  Top with remaining grated cheese.  Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes or until bubbly.

name: JELLY DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
1  c. warm milk (105~ to 115~)
1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. margarine
1/4  c. warm water
1  pkg. active dry yeast
3  eggs, at room temperature
5 1/2 to 6 1/2  c. flour
1 to 2  tsp. whiskey
jelly
preparation: Combine warm milk, sugar, salt and margarine.  Measure warm water into large warm bowl.  Sprinkle in yeast; stir until dissolved.  Add milk mixture, eggs, whisk and 3 cups flour; beat until smooth.  Add enough additional flour to make a stiff dough. Turn out onto lightly floured board; knead until smooth and elastic, about 8 to 10 minutes.  Divide dough into 3 equal parts. Roll each piece into a circle 1/4-inch thick.  Cut into 3-inch rounds, using top of glass.  Place on greased baking sheets; cover with dish towel.  Let rise in warm place free from draft, until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour.

name: TEXAS HOT DOG SAUCE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  qt. ice water
1  onion, chopped fine
1 1/2  oz. chili powder (start out less and add to taste)
2 small  cans tomato paste
preparation: Simmer 3 hours, then add 3/4 stick of oleo and simmer another 1/2 hour.

name: CHOCOLATE DESSERT
ingredients:
3  c. milk
1  c. flour
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. chopped nuts
8  oz. cream cheese
4  oz. instant chocolate pudding
4  oz. instant vanilla pudding
1  c. powdered sugar
16  oz. Cool Whip
1  small Hershey bar
preparation: Mix flour, margarine and nuts; press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°; cool.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  large chicken breasts
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. milk
1  box Stove Top mix
preparation: Cook chicken until done.  Remove from bones. Cut in bite size pieces.  Cream together soups and milk until smooth.  Add chicken. Mix the Stove Top mix and put on top of chicken in a 10 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: SAUERKRAUT CAKE
ingredients:
2/3  c. margarine
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. Hershey's cocoa
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped sauerkraut
1  c. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Cream together margarine, eggs and vanilla.  Sift flour.  Add alternately with water.  Beat well.  Drain and rinse kraut.  Fold into batter.  Grease and flour pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Test at 25 minutes.  Don't overbake.

name: EASY PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. self-rising flour
3/4  c. milk
1  can sliced peaches, undrained
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Stir sugar and flour together and place in cooking dish. Add milk and stir until relatively smooth. Add peaches, including juice.  Do not stir. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: RAISIN NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. seedless raisins
1  c. boiling water
1  tsp. soda
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Pour boiling water over raisins. Stir in soda then cool. Combine sugar, butter and egg. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Add to egg mixture. Stir in raisins and nuts. Pour into greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: ZUCCHINI PINEAPPLE BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3 1/2  c. plain flour
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
4  eggs
1  c. vegetable or Crisco oil
2  c. shredded zucchini, unpeeled
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. raisins
1  c. pecans or walnuts
preparation: Mix all together and bake in two well-greased/floured loaf pans for 55 minutes at 350°.  Let stand for 10 minutes before removing from pan.

name: SOLE FOR FOUR
ingredients:
4  fresh sole fillets
4  Tbsp. butter
4  Tbsp. frozen orange concentrate
4  green onions
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Lay 4 pieces of foil, each 10 inches long, on counter shiny-side up.  Place one fillet in center of each.  Place 1 teaspoon butter, 1 tablespoon orange concentrate and chopped green onion on each.  Wrap and seal.  Place on baking sheet.  Bake for 15 minutes.  The extra juice makes a nice sauce. Serve with rice and mandarin orange salad.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
5  Tbsp. melted butter
2  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  stick butter
2  eggs
3  large bananas
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Mix crumbs with melted butter.  Press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish.  Beat powdered sugar, vanilla and butter for 10 minutes. This step is very important.  Add eggs and continue to beat. Spread over crumbs.  Peel bananas and cut in lengthwise halves. Place over cream layer.  Spoon pineapple over bananas.  Cover with Cool Whip.  Sprinkle with nuts.  Chill for 4 hours.

name: MA'S HERSHEY CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1/2  c. corn oil
4  eggs
1/2  pt. sour cream
1/2 to 1  c. nuts
3  to 4 Hershey bars, cut up
preparation: Mix all ingredients together except sour cream, nuts and candy.  After batter is well mixed, then add sour cream, nuts and chocolate.  Bake in tube pan, greased and floured, at 350° for 1 hour.

name: ORANGE BALLS
ingredients:
5  c. flour
1  c. sugar
3  or 4 eggs
pinch of salt
5  tsp. baking powder
1/2  lb. Crisco
juice of 2 oranges and their rind
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift dry ingredients.  Mix like a pie crust.  Put rind with dry ingredients.  Make a hole in the dough and put in eggs and juice.  Dough should be soft like a pie crust.  If more liquid is needed for dough, milk may be added.  Roll into small balls for they get bigger while baking.  Bake at 300° to 375° until brown. Frost, leave plain or cover with chocolate jimmies.

name: FAT-FREE CUCUMBER SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  small cucumber, peeled
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. plain low-fat yogurt
1  Tbsp. reduced calorie mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. fresh parsley, chopped
1/4  tsp. dried dill weed
preparation: Shred cucumber. Spread on paper towel and sprinkle with salt. Squeeze out excess moisture from cucumber.

name: MARINATED VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can French-style green beans
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can green peas
1  jar pimentos, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. sugar
1  c. oil
1  c. vinegar
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Drain vegetables and pour them in a large bowl.  Bring sugar, oil and vinegar to a boil.  Pour over vegetable mix.  Add salt and pepper.  Refrigerate at least overnight.

name: VEGETABLES CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. California frozen mixed vegetables
1/2  c. sour cream
1  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1  can mushrooms soup
1/2  can French fried onions
preparation: Mix vegetables.  Put mushroom soup and sour cream and cheese. Bake 30 minutes in 350° oven.  Take out.  Put French fried onions on top.  Bake 15 minutes more.

name: TRIPLE DECKER STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
shortening (to grease pan)
1  plain white cake mix (no pudding)
1  (3 oz.) strawberry Jell-O
4  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. whole milk
4  large eggs
1/2  c. finely chopped strawberries and juice
preparation: Bake at 350°, center rack in oven; use 3 x 9.

name: CLASSIC BAKED MOSTACCIOLI
ingredients:
1  lb. mostaccioli, uncooked
1  lb. ground beef, cooked & drained
2 26  oz. jars spaghetti sauce
4  c. 1 lb. shredded mozzarella
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Prepare pasta as directed.  Combine pasta, meat, spaghetti sauce and 2 c. of cheese in large bowl and mix well.  Turn into greased 9x13 pan.  Cover and bake 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly.  Uncover and top with remaining cheese. Bake additional 10 minutes until cheese is melted.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. rigatoni noodles, cooked and drained
1  c. oil
1  onion, chopped fine
1  cucumber, sliced very thin
1  grated carrot
1  pkg. sliced pepperoni
1  can sliced black olives
preparation: Cook and drain noodles.  Add oil and mix well.  Add onion, cucumber, carrot, pepperoni and black olives.

name: LICKETY-SPLIT BANANA SPLIT PIE
ingredients:
1  (6 oz.) graham cracker pie crust
2  small bananas
1  qt. vanilla ice cream, softened
maraschino cherries
hot fudge sauce (unheated)
pineapple preserves
whipped topping
preparation: Slice bananas into bottom of crust.  Spoon softened ice cream on top.  Freeze for 2 hours.  Top with unheated hot fudge, pineapple preserves, a dollop of whipped topping and a maraschino cherry.

name: STIR-FRIED GINGER AND ORANGE BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1  recipe Steam Ahead Broccoli
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil or a light coating of pan spray
2  medium sized scallions, thinly sliced
1 large  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. fresh ginger, minced or 1/4 tsp. dried ginger
2  tsp. finely shredded orange zest (orange colored outer layer of the peel)
preparation: Coat the bottom of a saut pan or wok with vegetable oil or cooking spray. Heat the pan over high heat until it begins to lightly smoke. Add the broccoli and stir-fry until heated through. Add the scallions, garlic, ginger and orange zest. Stir-fry another minute and serve immediately. Serves 4 to 6 people as a side dish.

name: SHRIMP BOULETTES OR PATTIES
ingredients:
1  qt. shrimp (raw; about 3 c.) or crabmeat or crawfish
1  onion
3  to 4 green onions
1/2  tsp. parsley flakes
1/2  bell pepper (optional)
1  tsp. minced garlic
2  raw eggs
1 to 1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
Tony's
1  medium to 2 small potatoes
preparation: In food processor, place onions, bell pepper and green onions. Do these first and then process potatoes and shrimp. Add eggs when all is processed and mix well. Now add your seasoning to the mixture and drop by teaspoon in hot oil and cook until brown.

name: RICH SILVER CAKE
ingredients:
3 1/3  c. Softasilk flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
5  tsp. baking powder
1  c. Crisco
1 1/3  c. milk (half water)
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients and beat 2 minutes.  Add 6 egg whites and beat 2 minutes more.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350° in 2 round cake pans.

name: STEWED CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  fryers, salted and peppered
1  stick margarine
flour (enough to take up grease)
2  large onions, chopped
2  or 3 toes garlic
1  bunch parsley, chopped
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
preparation: Steam chickens in small amount of water until meat falls off bones. Do not let water boil away completely as you will need it. Cook on low fire. Make a roux using the stick of butter and enough flour to take up grease. Add the onions to roux. Cook until onions are clear. Add remaining chopped seasonings and saut. Add chicken broth to make a gravy. Adjust seasoning salt and pepper. Pour gravy over deboned chicken (which has been placed in a large casserole dish). If needed, add more water. Cook in slow oven (250° to 300°) for 3 hours.

name: FUDGE
ingredients:
2/3  c. cocoa
1/8  tsp. salt
1/4  c. butter
3  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine cocoa, sugar and salt; gradually add milk.  Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.  Wait until fudge becomes a little ball.  Take off stove and stir until shiny.

name: QUICK CANDIED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
1  can yams
2 or 3  Tbsp. brown sugar
2 or 3  Tbsp. melted butter
mini marshmallows or large ones, cut in half (enough to cover)
preparation: Cook yams, brown sugar and butter in microwave dish until hot. Put marshmallows to taste on top and place under broiler until toasty brown.

name: CHICKEN A LA KING
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken or mushroom soup
1/3 to 1/2  c. milk
1  c. cubed, cooked chicken or turkey (more meat is better)
2  Tbsp. diced pimiento
dash of pepper
toast, mashed potatoes or noodles
preparation: Cook onion and green pepper in butter or oleo until tender. Blend in soup and milk.  Add chicken, pimiento and pepper.  Heat slowly; stir often.  Serve over toast, mashed potatoes or cooked egg noodles.  You may add 2 boiled eggs, cut, after you're finished cooking.  Makes 4 servings.

name: RUTH'S CORNED BEEF SALAD
ingredients:
1  lemon Jell-O (small)
3/4  c. boiling water
1  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. pickle relish
1  c. mayonnaise
3  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1/2  c. corned beef
preparation: Mix together and refrigerate.

name: THREE BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger, browned
1 (16 oz.)  can pork and beans
1 (16 oz.)  can lima beans
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  tsp. salt and pepper
1  Tbsp. mustard
3  strips bacon (lay on top)
preparation: Brown hamburger. Mix with rest of ingredients.  Put in casserole dish.  Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: 30-MINUTE CARAMEL ICING
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
2  sticks oleo
2  Tbsp. white corn syrup
1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Dissolve soda in buttermilk.  Mix well sugar, syrup and milk. Bring this to a boil on medium to high heat.  When it reaches first boiling, turn to simmer and cook 30 minutes.  Do not stir while cooking.  Cool and whip to desired consistency.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. water
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  c. quick oatmeal
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Cook raisins until soft.  Drain.  Save 5 tablespoons of the raisin water for later.

name: CHICKEN AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
2  c. diced chicken, cooked and deboned
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. curry powder
1/2  pkg. stuffing mix, tossed in 1/2 stick butter, melted
preparation: Cook broccoli according to package instructions.  Drain and lay in bottom of baking dish.  Cover with chicken.  Mix next 4 ingredients and spread over chicken.  Sprinkle with stuffing mix. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: PEPPERMINT BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  squares unsweetened chocolate
1/2  c. margarine
2  eggs, well beaten
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
14  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt butter and chocolate, cool. Add remaining ingredients to eggs. Add cooled chocolate. Pour into greased 8 X 8 pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: FROZEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, well drained
1  ripe banana
4  drops red food coloring
1/4  c. chopped pecans
1  can pitted Bing cherries, well drained
preparation: Combine sour cream, lemon juice, sugar, salt, drained pineapple, banana and red food coloring to make mixture pink.

name: CHICKEN AND DRESSING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  boneless chicken breasts
1  pkg. Stove Top dressing
1  jar Heinz Home Style chicken gravy
preparation: Invite all friends and family that you know.  Fish slow for 50.  Mix up hush puppies from Martha White Hush Puppy mix.  Get Mutt and Chris to fry 3 or 4 gallons of crappie fillet.  Have everyone bring a dish of anything.

name: 1 DISH PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
4  pork chops, well trimmed
2  apples, cored and halved
1  onion, cut in 4 thick slices
2  medium yams, cut in half
1/4  c. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Mix brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce and soy sauce together for sauce.  Quickly brown pork chops on both sides in a deep skillet and put onion slice, then the apple, then the yam on top of each pork chop.  Pour the sauce over.  Put lid on and cook on low on top of the stove or 325° in oven for 1 hour.  You may add raisins if desired.

name: PIE CRUST FOR DOUBLE CRUST
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. shortening
4  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Mix flour and salt together in a bowl. Add the shortening and mix it into the flour and salt with a fork or your fingertips until the mixture has the texture of coarse crumbs. Mix in the water, a little at a time. Refrigerate to chill before rolling out the dough.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
16  oz. cream cheese
1  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. Accent or m.s.g.
4  green onions, chopped
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. garlic salt
3/4  tsp. mustard
finely chopped pecans
preparation: Blend  all  together  except onion.  Add onions.  Shape into ball.  Put on serving dish.  Pat pecans on top.

name: PLAIN  POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
3  c. plain flour
1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/4  c. sweet milk
1   tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together Crisco and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, and beat until light and fluffy.  Sift together flours and baking powder.  Add to creamed mixture along with milk and vanilla.  Pour into deep tube pan which has been well greased and floured.  Place in 350° oven and bake 1 1/2 hours without opening the oven.

name: FROZEN PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
8  oz. softened cream cheese
2  c. powdered sugar
2/3  c. peanut butter
1  c milk
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
2  (9-inch) graham cracker pie shells
1/2  c. chopped peanuts
preparation: Beat until fluffy cream cheese, sugar and peanut butter.  Add milk and blend well.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Put in pie shells and sprinkle top with chopped peanuts.  Freeze.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
1  stick oleo (margarine)
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese (room temperature)
3/4  c. sugar
1 (12 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
2  pkg. chocolate instant pudding mix
3  c. milk
preparation: First Layer:  Work together flour, margarine (oleo) and pecans.  Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Brown lightly at 400° and let cool.

name: CHICKEN ALA KING
ingredients:
1  plump fryer or 4 breasts
1  large onion, sliced
2  stalks celery, sliced
1  can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
1  jar pimento
1  pkg. frozen peas
1  can sliced mushrooms
1  c. sour cream
pastry shells
preparation: Put salted turkey in roaster.  Pour over turkey 1 cup boiling water with 1 stick of melted margarine.  Cover airtight with lid or tent made of heavy-duty Reynolds Wrap.   Place in a 450° preheated oven.  Bake for 1 hour.  Do not open oven door.  Leave in oven overnight, or until oven is cold.  (I cook mine last thing before going to bed.)  This time is for a 12-pound turkey.  Add about 5 minutes per pound for larger turkey.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1  Tbsp. flour
2  cans Shoe Peg corn (white)
1/2  pt. whipping cream
salt
pepper
preparation: Melt butter in casserole dish in the oven.  Add flour to butter.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serves 4 people.

name: SPINACH CAKES
ingredients:
2  boxes chopped frozen spinach, cooked and drained
2  c. Pepperidge Farm stuffing
2  large onions, chopped
6  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. melted butter
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. garlic salt, thyme and black pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients into drained spinach.  Freeze in individual mounds (ice cream scoop).  When ready to thaw, place on thick slice of tomato.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350° (30 minutes if frozen).  Serves 16.

name: STRAWBERRY WHIP
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
juice of 3 lemons
2  eggs
1  carton frozen strawberries
1  box vanilla wafers
preparation: Mix together milk, lemon juice and 2 egg yolks.  Beat egg whites into the mixture.  Chop the strawberries and add to mixture.  Crush vanilla wafers.  Place a layer in bowl, then a layer of mixture.  Repeat until all is used.  Put in refrigerator until ready to serve.  Serve in sherbet dishes and garnish with whole strawberries.

name: CAVATINI
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger or sausage (or both 1/2 lb. each)
7  oz. cooked macaroni (1 c. raw)
32  oz. spaghetti sauce
4  oz. pepperoni
12  oz. Mozzarella cheese
mushrooms
preparation: Brown meat and drain.  Layer ingredients in 9 x 13-inch pan (macaroni, meat, pepperoni, mushrooms, spaghetti sauce, then cheese).  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: PATE HUSH-HUSH
ingredients:
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can beef consomme, undiluted
1 large  can or 2 small cans Sell liver pate
1  envelope plain gelatin
6  oz. cream cheese
dash of cayenne pepper
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper to taste
Accent to taste
3  Tbsp. cold water
1  Tbsp. sherry
1  Tbsp. bourbon
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in cold water.  Heat consomme; add gelatin and sherry.  Put aside to cool.  Mix cream cheese, pate, bourbon, Worcestershire sauce and seasonings thoroughly (an electric mixer is easiest).  Oil a flat mold with vegetable oil.  Pour cooled consomme into the mold to the depth of about 1/4 inch and put it into the freezer to set quickly.

name: CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. white cornmeal
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs
2  c. buttermilk
4  Tbsp. Crisco shortening
preparation: Mix dry ingredients together, then add eggs and buttermilk. Mix together well.  Best to use iron skillet.  Put Crisco in iron skillet; heat in oven until melted.  Add about half of melted Crisco to cornbread mix; mix well.  Pour into iron skillet.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 425°.

name: PIA COLADA
ingredients:
1/2  c. coconut milk
1  c. pineapple juice
6  oz. light rum
16  ice cubes, crushed
fresh pineapple wedges
maraschino cherries
preparation: Place coconut milk, pineapple juice, rum and ice in blender container. Blend until frothy. Pour into 4 tall glasses. Garnish each drink with pineapple wedge and maraschino cherry. Makes 4 drinks.

name: ORANGE GOODIES
ingredients:
2  c. Cookie Mix
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. orange juice
preparation: Mix ingredients well.  Drop cookie dough by teaspoon 2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: CHEESE AND BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh broccoli, cut into 1-inch pieces
1/3  c. fresh onion, diced
1 1/4  sticks margarine
1  c. flour
2 1/2  qt. chicken stock (10 c. water to 10 tsp. powdered chicken broth)
1  c. whipping cream
6  oz. grated Parmesan cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook broccoli with a little salt until tender.  Drain.  Melt margarine in a pan and add flour to make roux.  Stir well.  Cook 5 minutes.  Blend in cream, stirring constantly, to make a smooth sauce.  Add stock and cook to make desired creamed soup consistency.  Add broccoli and cheese; mix well.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. flour (cake flour)
3  c. sugar
6  large eggs, beaten
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla (or lemon)
1/3  c. milk
4  sticks butter
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix well.  Bake at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  eggs
4  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. Ritz cracker crumbs
preparation: Mix all ingredients except cracker crumbs.  Pour into a square, well-buttered baking dish.  Sprinkle top with crumbs and dot with butter.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
2  boxes pistachio pudding mix (Jell-O)
1  large (16 oz.) container Cool Whip
1 large (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, undrained
1  c. pecans or walnuts
preparation: Put Cool Whip in a large bowl.  Add pudding mix, pineapple and nuts.  Mix and store in refrigerator.  May be topped with cherries.

name: WAFFLES
ingredients:
2  c. flour (sift before measuring)
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
3  egg yolks
6  Tbsp. oleo
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Make a  hole in the sifted ingredients.  Pour in liquid. Combine with a few strokes.  The batter should have a pebbled look.  Fold in 3 egg whites, beaten stiff, last.

name: COLEY'S CHICKEN CURRY SPREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. mayonnaise
2  c. chicken spread
1  c. coconut
2 1/2  tsp. curry powder
1  tsp. minced onion
preparation: Mix together and chill for about an hour.  Serve with Triscuits.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
10  oz. frozen spinach, let thaw
8  oz. water chestnuts
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. Homestyle soup mix
3/4  c. onion (optional)
preparation: Hollow out a loaf (round) of pumpernickel bread; use as bowl for dip. Cube bread from loaf to dip.

name: CHOCOLATE MARSHMALLOW SLICES
ingredients:
2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips (12 oz. pkg.)
1/2  c. butter or margarine
6  c. miniature marshmallows (10 1/2 oz. pkg.)
1  c. finely chopped nuts
additional chopped nuts
preparation: In medium saucepan, over low heat, melt chocolate chips and butter, stirring constantly, until blended.  Remove from heat; cool 5 minutes.  Stir in marshmallows and 1 cup nuts; do not melt marshmallows.

name: PEANUT BUTTER AND JELLY COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. shortening
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/4  c. applesauce
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1  c. rolled oats
3  Tbsp. grape jelly
preparation: In large bowl combine  all  ingredients  except  1  cup flour, oats and jelly;  mix  well.  Stir  in  1  cup flour and oats. Shape into 1 inch  balls,  place  2  inches  apart	on ungreased cookie sheet.  Flatten  and place 1/8 teaspoon jelly in center of each cookie.  Bake	at  350° for 12 to 24 minutes or until golden brown.

name: CRANBERRY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. apples, chopped
2  c. cranberries, chopped
1 1/2  c. white sugar
1 1/2  c. oatmeal
1/3  c. flour
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Mix together apples, cranberries and white sugar and place in baking dish.  Mix together well oatmeal, flour, brown sugar, nuts and margarine.  Sprinkle over cranberry mixture.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: NO-FAT PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1 to 1 1/2  c. warm water
preparation: Mix dry ingredients together, then add water.  Mix well, then pour by spoonful in skillet sprayed well with nonstick spray. Turn when bubbles form, then turn and cook on other side.

name: SAUSAGE AND ACORN SQUASH BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. roll sausage
2  acorn squash, well scrubbed
2  to 3 carrots, grated
2  c. uncooked rice
2  c. hot water
1/4  onion, chopped
1/2  stick margarine
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Brown the sausage (as you would ground beef).  Drain grease.  Slice squash in half lengthwise and remove seeds.  Combine rice, hot water, onion, margarine, salt and pepper in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Stir until margarine is melted.  Mix in sausage and carrots.  Place the four squash halves on top of the sausage/rice mixture with the shell side up.  Cover pan and bake 50 to 60 minutes until the squash is tender.  I also make this using 1 cup of wild rice and 1 cup of regular rice.  Since the wild rice takes longer to cook, I cook it in the microwave for 10 minutes in 1 cup of water while I'm getting the rest of the ingredients ready. Serves 6 to 8.

name: LEMONADE PIE(Summertime Pie)
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen Country Time lemonade, thaw
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
3 1/2  c. or 1 (8 oz.) container Cool Whip, thawed
1  (9-inch) cracker crumb crust (chocolate)*
preparation: *Buy the crust already made.

name: STOLEN SQUASH
ingredients:
6  to 8 small squash
salt
pepper
butter
preparation: Go gather some squash out of Rick's garden when he's not home. Clean and cut into medium pieces to boil.  Boil until real tender and drain.  Fry in skillet with butter until it turns a light brown.  Salt and pepper to taste and serve.  This dish is very good and cheap!  Then you can have your pastor over for supper.

name: VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. stew meat
6  c. water
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. celery, chopped
2  medium potatoes, cubed
3/4  c. sliced carrots
1 small  can whole kernel corn
1 small  can sweet peas
2  medium onions, quartered
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes
1/3  head cabbage
preparation: Combine  first	4  ingredients	in  a large Dutch oven. Bring to	a boil and cook over low heat about 30 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

name: CHICKEN DINNER
ingredients:
4  boneless chicken breasts, split (8 pieces)
8  slices Swiss cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing, crushed (not cubed)
preparation: Place boneless chicken in casserole.  Top each breast with 1 slice of Swiss cheese.   Mix chicken soup and mushroom soup (undiluted).  Pour over chicken and cheese.  Cover with stuffing. Bake 1 1/2 hours uncovered at 350°.

name: BUTTERNUT SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. squash, cooked
1/2  c. brown sugar
3  eggs
1  c. milk
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Mix well in mixer, pour into unbaked pie shell or casserole. Bake at 350° at least 1 hour or until set in center.  If desired, cover with meringue or miniature marshmallows.

name: CREAMED GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine, divided
1/2  c. cornflakes, crumbled
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. instant minced onion
1  tsp. sugar
4 to 6  c. French-style green beans, cooked and drained
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar or Swiss cheese
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. sour cream
preparation: In a small saucepan melt 1 tablespoon butter.  Stir in cornflakes and set aside.  Melt remaining butter in a large saucepan.  Stir in flour, salt, pepper, onion and sugar.  Heat and stir until bubbly.  Reduce heat and add sour cream.  Stir until smooth.  Cook and stir over low heat for 2 minutes (do not boil). Fold in the beans; spread into a greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle cheese evenly over top.  Sprinkle with cornflakes mixture.  Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 minutes or until heated through.  Yield:  6 to 8 servings.

name: FRENCH TOAST IN MICROWAVE OVEN
ingredients:
1  egg
bread
butter, syrup or favorite topping
preparation: Beat egg in bowl.  Dip a slice of bread in the egg, turning it until it's well coated.  Place bread on a plate.  Pour any remaining egg from the bowl on top.  Cook at High power for 1 minute.  Serve with butter, syrup or other favorite topping.

name: GREEN ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. sharp cheese
1  large onion, chopped
1  tsp. ground comino
salt and pepper
1  pkg. tortillas
1/2  stick butter
4  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
1/2  lb. Velveeta
1 small  can green chilies
preparation: Brown  beef,  onion  and  spices.  Soften  tortillas in grease.  Roll  meat  and  cheese in each tortilla.	Pour sauce over tortillas and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: FRUIT SLUSH
ingredients:
2  c. milk
2  c. strawberries
3  Tbsp. confectioners sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: In a plastic or ice cube tray, freeze milk until almost solid. Turn into blender container.  Add remaining ingredients.  Blend until smooth and frothy.  Serves 2.

name: MIDNIGHT CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. cocoa
1  c. hot water
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Blend shortening and sugar until creamy; add eggs.  Then put cocoa in hot water and add to shortening, sugar and egg mixture. Then add flour, soda, salt and baking powder.  Blend well.  Add vanilla and blend.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until done.  Place in greased square pan.

name: HOBO BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. raisins
2  c. boiling water
4  tsp. soda
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1/2  tsp. salt
4  c. flour
1  egg
preparation: Soak raisins in boiling water with soda.  Stir and cover; let stand overnight.  Next day, add egg, sugar, vegetable oil, salt and flour (1 cup at a time), mixing well.

name: LEMON CHICKEN FETTUCCINE
ingredients:
4  boneless, skinless chicken breast fillets
2  Tbsp. butter
lemon herb seasoning
1/3  c. dry wine
fettuccine
Parmesan cheese, grated
juice of 1 lemon
salt substitute
2/3  c. cream
preparation: Prepare fettuccine for 4 servings according to directions. While cooking, prepare chicken.  Melt butter in a medium-size heavy skillet.  Sprinkle chicken with salt substitute and lemon juice, cover, reduce heat and cook chicken about 6 minutes. Uncover and brown chicken slightly.  Remove chicken and keep warm. Add wine and scrape skillet and add cream.  Simmer, stirring constantly until volume is reduced by half.  Arrange fettuccine on serving platter, add chicken and pour sauce over all.  Sprinkle with cheese.

name: RHUBARB SAUCE
ingredients:
1 3/4  lb. rhubarb (6 c.), sliced in 1/2-inch pieces
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Combine rhubarb with sugar in a heavy saucepan.   Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes.  Remove cover; raise heat and cook, while stirring, until liquid evaporates and rhubarb has an applesauce consistency (about 10 minutes).  Remove from heat and cool.   Store, covered, in refrigerator until ready to serve. Makes 2 cups.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. onion
1/2  c. bell pepper
2  cans corn (whole)
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown meat, onions and pepper together.  Add other ingredients.  Mix well.  Pour into baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: APPLE CINNAMON CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  can apple pie filling
3  eggs
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Blend together cake mix, pie filling and eggs.  Beat at medium speed 2 minutes.  Combine sugar and cinnamon. Spread half the batter in greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Sprinkle with half the cinnamon-sugar.  Repeat with remaining batter and cinnamon-sugar.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes until wooden pick inserted in center of cake comes out clean.  Cool.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
10  crispy cooked bacon slices, crumbled
1/4  c. green onion slices
preparation: Combine cream cheese and mayo in a food processor, mixing until well blended.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Chill. Form into a ball and serve with crackers.

name: SWEET PICKLES
ingredients:
any size cucumber
1  c. canning salt to 1 gal. water
1  tsp. powdered alum to 1 qt. water
3  pt. sugar
1  qt. vinegar
1  tsp. each ground cloves, celery, seed and ground cinnamon
preparation: Place cucumbers in crock jar or large kettle.  Pour scalding hot salt water over them.  Let stand 3 days.  Pour off water and slice cucumbers thin.  Soak in alum water.  Let stand 3 hours. Drain and make a syrup of 3 sugar and vinegar.  Cook syrup and boil 1 minute.  Pour over cucumbers in crock jar or large kettle.  Let stand 24 hours.  Pour off heated syrup and again pour over cucumbers.  Let stand 24 hours.  The third time heat syrup and add ground cloves, celery seed and ground cinnamon.  Pack cucumbers into jars.  Pour hot syrup over them.  Seal.  Ready to use in 6 weeks.

name: APRICOT POPPY SEED MUFFINS
ingredients:
16  oz. apricot baby food
1  tsp. baking soda
1  stick margarine, softened
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. poppy seed
preparation: Empty baby food in a small bowl.  Add soda.  Stir mixture.  It will be foamy.  Set aside.

name: OREO DELIGHT
ingredients:
3  c. milk
12  oz. Cool Whip
8  oz. Philadelphia cream cheese
2 small  boxes vanilla instant pudding
1  lb. Oreos
preparation: Mix together milk, Cool Whip, cream cheese and pudding until smooth.  Next, crush one row of Oreo cookies with a fork into small pieces.  Then put the pieces of cookie in the bottom of a deep dish.  Pour half of the mixture over the bottom row of crushed cookies.  Put another row of crushed cookies in the middle.  Pour the other half of mixture on top.  Then put last row of crushed cookies on top.

name: CHEESY SPINACH PINWHEELS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can Pillsbury crescent rolls
4 (1 oz.)  slices thinly sliced ham
1/3  c. gourmet spreadable cheese with garlic and herbs
1/2  c. packed spinach leaves
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°. Separate dough into 4 rectangles on smooth side of cutting board. Press seams to seal. Using spatula, spread each rectangle with about 1 1/2 tablespoons of cheese to within 1/4-inch of edges. Top with 1 slice ham and spinach leaves. Starting at short side, roll up each rectangle; pinch edges to seal. Cut each roll crosswise into 6 slices for a total of 24 slices. Place cut side down. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Remove and serve warm. Yield: 24 pinwheels.

name: DILLY MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked elbow macaroni
1  c. cubed no-fat cheese
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
3  Tbsp. chopped and drained pimento
1/2  c. no-fat mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1/2  tsp. dried dill weed
salt to taste
preparation: Cook macaroni as directed on package.  Drain well and cool. Combine the next 4 ingredients.  Blend together remaining ingredients, then toss lightly together.  Cover and chill well. Serves 6.

name: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients:
6  eggs
3  Tbsp. flour
1  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
2  lb. frozen chopped broccoli
16  oz. cottage cheese
2  Tbsp. chipped onion
8  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook broccoli.  Drain and set aside.  Beat eggs.  Stir in remaining ingredients except the broccoli and butter.  Melt butter over broccoli and mix with remaining ingredients.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serves 12.

name: SOUTHERN PARTY POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash browns
1/2  c. melted butter
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of chicken or cream of celery soup
1  carton sour cream
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz or 2 c. grated cheese
1/4  c. melted butter
2  c. crushed corn flakes
preparation: Defrost potatoes.  Combine butter, salt, pepper, onion, soup, sour cream and cheese.  Mix thoroughly.  Pour over potatoes in 3-quart casserole.  Mix 1/4 cup butter and corn flakes; sprinkle over top.  Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Serves 16.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1 lg  can crushed pineapple
1 (7 oz)  box pistachio pudding
1  (8 oz) tub whipped topping
1  c nuts
1  c miniature marshmallows
preparation: Mix pineapple with pistachio pudding mix.  Stir by hand.  Add to other ingredients and pour into covered bowl.  Chill in refrigerator for about 6 hours before serving.

name: STRAWBERRY BUTTER
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. strawberries, thawed
1  c. butter, softened
1  c. sifted confectioners sugar
preparation: Puree all ingredients in blender until creamy.  Give in decorative container for gift.

name: APPLE PIE FILLING
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. cornstarch
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. salt
5 1/2 to 6  lb. tart apples
preparation: In a large saucepan, blend first 4 ingredients with 10 cups of water.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.  Add lemon juice and salt.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  can blueberry pie filling
2  cans cherry pie filling
2  or 3 bananas
1 large  can crushed pineapple
2 large  cartons Cool Whip, thawed
nuts and coconut for garnish
preparation: Bake cake as directed.  Divide into 4 parts.  Layer ingredients in punch bowl in the following order:  1/4 cake, 1/2 can blueberry filling, Cool Whip, 1/4 cake, 1/2 can cherry pie filling, Cool Whip, bananas, pineapple, 1/4 cake, 1/2 can blueberry filling, Cool Whip, 1/2 cherry, etc., until all ingredients are used.  Garnish with nuts and coconut.  Make ahead and refrigerate.  Tasty and beautiful.  Serves 24+.

name: PORK CHOPS WITH RICE
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice
1  onion, sliced
2  Tbsp. parsley, snipped
1/2  c. celery, sliced
2  c. tomato juice
1  c. water
4  or more pork chops
preparation: In a deep pan or iron skillet place uncooked rice.  Place onions, parsley and celery on top of rice.  Pour tomato juice and water over rice.  Place pork chops on top of rice mixture and bake, covered, at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BUMSTEAD BURGERS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/4  lb. cubed cheese
1 (7 oz.)  can tuna
1/2  c. salad dressing
2  Tbsp. chopped stuffed olives
3  hard-boiled eggs
2  Tbsp. chopped sweet pickles
chopped celery (if desired)
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Fill hamburger buns and wrap in foil. Bake in a 250° oven for about 30 minutes.

name: MOMS BEER MOP
ingredients:
1  can beer
1/2  cup cider vinegar
1/2  cup water
1/4  cup corn oil
1/2  onion chopped
2  garlic cloves
1  tablespoon worcestershire sauce
1  tablespoon any dry rub
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Heat the mop and use it warm.

name: GARDEN PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1  can garden peas (medium or small), drained
3  eggs, boiled and diced
1  small onion
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
tomatoes (optional)
cucumber (optional)
lettuce (optional)
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Serve with any meal.

name: SHRIMP CANAPES
ingredients:
1  can Orleans shrimp, drained (small or medium)
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
bread triangles
preparation: Toast bread triangles on one side.  Mix mayonnaise, cheese and mustard.  Spread mayonnaise, cheese and mustard mixture on untoasted side of bread triangle.  Place shrimp on top and spread a small amount of additional mayonnaise, cheese and mustard on top.  Place under broiler until lightly browned.

name: LEMONADE STANDS TEST OF TIME(Recipe of 1850; Portable Lemonade)
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
2 to 3  c. water
2  Tbsp. grated lemon rind
lemon juice
preparation: In small saucepan, stir together sugar, corn syrup, 2 to 3 cups water and lemon rind.  Bring to a boil; boil 5 minutes.  Pour through a fine mesh strainer.  Cool.  Store in a tightly covered jar in the refrigerator until needed.  Makes 1 1/4 cups lemon syrup base.

name: HAMBURG STUFFING
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small chopped onion
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1  c. cracker crumbs
salt and pepper to taste
1  tsp. sage
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix together.  Add to saucepan and cook slowly over low heat until meat is browned.  Add to turkey or serve as is.

name: THUMBPRINT COOKIES
ingredients:
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  c. shortening
1/4  c. margarine or butter, softened
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  egg, separated
1  c. all-purpose flour *
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. finely chopped nuts
jelly
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix brown sugar, shortening, margarine, vanilla and egg yolk.  Stir in flour and salt until dough holds together.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Beat egg whites slightly. Dip each ball into egg white; roll in nuts.  Place about 1-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Press thumb deeply in center of each.  Bake until light brown about 10 minutes.  Immediately remove from cookie sheet; cool.  Fill thumbprints with jelly. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. (2 sticks) butter or margarine, softened
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2  eggs
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. (2 c.) semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  In small bowl, combine flour, soda and salt; set aside.  In large mixer bowl, beat butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla until creamy.  Beat in eggs.   Gradually beat in flour mixture.  Stir in chocolate morsels and nuts.  Drop by rounded measuring tablespoon onto ungreased cookie sheets.  Bake 9 to 11 minutes, until edges are golden brown.  Makes about 5 dozen 2 1/4-inch cookies.

name: DUTCH ALMOND COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. almond flavoring
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Cream the butter, sugar, egg and almond flavoring, then add flour.  Make round balls with teaspoonful of dough.  Beat another egg. Take a glass and dip in raw egg and flatten balls of dough. Top with sliced almonds. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: BANANA CARAMEL SPICE PIE
ingredients:
1  large ripe banana, sliced
2  c. cold milk
1  Keebler Ready-Crust shortbread pie crust (6 oz.)
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
2  pkg. (4-serving size) Jell-O white chocolate or vanilla flavor instant pudding
1  (8 oz.) tub Cool Whip whipped topping, thawed
caramel dessert topping
preparation: Place banana slices in bottom of crust. Pour milk into large bowl. Add pudding mixes and cinnamon. Beat with wire whisk 1 minute. Gently stir in whipped topping. Spoon into crust. Refrigerate 4 hours until set. Serve with caramel topping. Makes 8 servings.

name: CRANBERRY RELISH
ingredients:
1  large cherry Jell-O
1  c. boiling water
1  can whole cranberry sauce
1  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix all together and pour into mold and refrigerate.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  bag hash browns
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
chopped onion
1  c. cheese
1/2  c. cheese for top
preparation: Mix cheese, soup and sour cream, then add onion and hash browns.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes and melt the cheese on the top.

name: HOT COCOA
ingredients:
2  c. dry milk
1/3  c. cocoa
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. peppermint extract
preparation: Mix vanilla and peppermint together and sprinkle over sugar and salt mixture.  Stir until well absorbed by sugar mixture.  Add cocoa; mix well.  Add dry milk; mix well.  Store in airtight container.  To serve, add 2 heaping tablespoons of cocoa mixture to one cup of boiling water.  Enjoy!

name: SUNDAY GLAZED CARROTS
ingredients:
1  lb. medium carrots
2  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. brown sugar, packed
2  Tbsp. cold water
1 1/2  tsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. pecans
preparation: Wash and cut carrots into 1/2-inch diagonal slices.  Place in 1-quart casserole dish with butter and brown sugar.  Cover and microwave on High 9 to 11 minutes, stirring after 5 minutes.  Mix water and cornstarch until smooth.  Stir into carrot mixture.  Add pecans.  Cover and microwave on High for 2 to 4 minutes, until thickened.  Stir before serving.  Makes 3 to 4 servings.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1 (No. 300)  can kidney beans
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. chopped green chilies
2  tomatoes, diced
1/2  sliced ripe olives
1  head lettuce, torn into bite size pieces
preparation: Cook ground beef until done, stirring to break up into small pieces. Drain well on paper towels. Salt and pepper lightly. Allow to cool.  Combine beef, drained beans, onion, chilies, tomatoes and olives.  Put lettuce in a large bowl and top with beef-been mixture. Sprinkle on 8 ounces Cheddar cheese, grated and 1 bag taco chips, crumbled.  Pour an 8 ounce bottle Russian dressing over all and toss well. Serve at once.

name: CARAMEL ICING
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
1/8  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. cream
1  egg white
preparation: Combine sugars, soda and cream.  Cook stirring constantly, to 238° or until a small amount forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water.  Cool to lukewarm without stirring.  Beat until creamy, add unbeaten egg white and beat until thick enough to spread.  Will frost 3 (8-inch) layers.

name: HAWAIIAN CAKE
ingredients:
1 (18.5 oz.)  pkg. Butter Recipe golden cake mix
1/2  c. margarine, softened
2/3  c. milk
3  eggs
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained and chopped
1 (3.4 oz.)  pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (in heavy syrup)
3  c. frozen, thawed whipped topping or 2 c. whipping cream, whipped
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°. Combine first 4 ingredients in a large mixing bowl.  Beat at low speed of electric mixer until blended. Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes. Stir in oranges. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch round pans.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool on rack completely. Combine pudding mix and pineapple in large bowl.  Mix well. Chill. Fold in whipped topping. Spread frosting between layers, sides and top.  Refrigerate immediately. Store in refrigerator after cutting.

name: MAMA'S CORNBREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  (10-inch) pan cornbread (made with yellow cornmeal)
2  large onions, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb seasoned stuffing mix
2  Tbsp. dried parsley
salt and pepper to taste
2  cans cream of celery soup
broth from baked turkey plus enough water to make 2 qt.  (Swanson chicken broth may be used if necessary)
6  eggs
preparation: Mix crumbled cornbread, stuffing mix, onions, parsley, salt, pepper, celery soup and well beaten eggs together with enough broth to make it rather soupy.  Bake at 375° to 400° for about an hour or until done and brown.

name: TACO FRANKS
ingredients:
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. crushed corn chips
1/2  c. finely chopped onions
1/4  c. salsa or green chile salsa
6  all beef frankfurters, split lengthwise
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Combine cheese, chips, onion and salsa. Stuff each dog with 1/4 cup of mixture. Place in 10 x 6-inch baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.  Enjoy!

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
3  to 4 boned chicken breasts
1  c. water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. broccoli
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1/2  c. bread crumbs/melted margarine
preparation: Simmer chicken in water until tender; drain.  Cook broccoli in salted water; drain.  Arrange broccoli in greased casserole dish. Place halved chicken breasts on top of broccoli.  Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder and pour over chicken. Sprinkle cheese and bread crumbs on top.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: DOUBLE DECKER DELIGHT
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3/4  c. margarine
2/3  c. evaporated milk
6  oz. semi-sweet chocolate chips
7  oz. jar Marshmallow Creme
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. peanut butter
preparation: Combine 1 1/2 cups sugar, 6 tablespoons margarine and 1/3 cup milk in saucepan; bring to full boil, stirring constantly. Continue boiling 4 minutes over medium heat; stir to prevent scorching.	Remove from heat and stir in chocolate chips until melted.  Add 1 cup Marshmallow Creme and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla; beat until well blended.  Pour into buttered 9 x 13 pan.  Repeat with the remaining ingredients substituting peanut butter for chocolate chips.  Spread over chocolate layer.  Cool at room temperature; cut into squares.  Makes 3 pounds.

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can strawberry pie filling
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. pecans
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Mix by hand.  Freeze in 9 x 13-inch baking dish or pan.  Serve frozen.

name: DATE BALLS
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
2  c. light brown sugar
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. dates, cut in two
1  can flaked coconut
2  c. pecans
4  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Cook butter, sugar and dates until the dates melt.  Remove from heat.  Add nuts and Rice Krispies.  Roll in coconut.  Delicious!

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
4  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1 1/3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt oleo and chocolate in microwave.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Place in 9 x 13-inch pan which has been lightly sprayed with nonstick spray.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Can be frosted, if desired.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake mix
1  large tub Cool Whip
2 small  boxes instant chocolate pudding
6 Heath bars, crumbled (I use the  pkg. of snack size bars)
preparation: Bake cake in 9 x 13-inch pan according to directions.  Let cake cool.  Divide cake in thirds.  Crumble up cake.

name: JAM CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. oil
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. strawberry jam
preparation: Mix the first 8 ingredients.  Add nutmeg, allspice, cloves and vanilla.  Mix and add strawberry jam.  Pour batter into well-greased and floured tube or Bundt pan or 2 regular pans. Bake 40 minutes at 375°.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. potatoes, diced
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick butter
1  pt. sour cream
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, diced
2  c. crushed cornflakes
1/4  c. melted butter
