preparation: Boil potatoes until almost tender.  Drain.  Add 1 stick of butter, salt, pepper, soup, sour cream, onion and cheese.  Blend together and pour into greased 5-quart casserole dish.  Top with cornflakes mixed with melted butter.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: TOMMY'S MINTS
ingredients:
1  stick margarine or butter
1  box confectioners sugar
2  Tbsp. cream
1  Tbsp. peppermint extract
preparation: In saucepan, melt margarine.  Add sugar, cream and peppermint extract; mix well.  Mold into desired shape and place on wax paper to dry.  Store in refrigerator.

name: BAKED ZITI
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  box ziti or masticotti pasta
1 large  jar spaghetti sauce
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Ricotta cheese
1  lb. grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cook pasta according to directions on box.  Mix pasta, Ricotta cheese and sauce together.  Hold back approximately 1 cup sauce. Spread into a glass 9 x 12-inch casserole and level.  Pour remaining sauce over top and spread evenly.  Cover with Mozzarella.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: GILHORN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
3/4  c. margarine
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. maple syrup
1  tsp. water
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix.  Drop cookies on sprayed cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for approximately 10 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines yellow deluxe cake mix
1  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. cooking oil
2  Tbsp. water
2  eggs
Hershey Kiss candy (1 per cookie)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients and mix well. Drop from a teaspoon onto an ungreased cookie sheet.  Press a crisscross on each cookie with a fork, that has been dipped in water.  Bake for 12 minutes.  Remove from oven and place a Hershey Kiss candy on each cookie.  Cool for 1 minute and remove from cookie sheet.

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. pretzels, crushed
3/4  c. melted margarine
3  Tbsp. sugar
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  c. sugar
8  oz. whipped topping
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin
2  c. boiling water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
preparation: Combine pretzels, margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar.  Mix well and pat into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Bake at 400° for 8 minutes.  Cool.

name: MAYONNAISE CAKE(Chocolate)
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa (not instant)
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1  c. cold water
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Measure into bowl the dry ingredients.  Add water, mayonnaise and vanilla.  Pour into 9-inch square pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Nice and moist.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. water
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. strawberry Jell-O
whipped cream
preparation: Cook sugar, water and cornstarch in double boiler until very thick, stirring constantly.  Turn off and add strawberry Jell-O. Set aside to cool.  Slice strawberries and sprinkle with sugar and put in refrigerator for a while.  Dip strawberries out of bowl with spoon with holes in it so as not to use the juice and fold strawberries in mixture.  Pour into baked pie shell.  Cool and cover with whipped cream.

name: TINY TOFU CHEESECAKES
ingredients:
1  pkg. regular tofu, drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
24  vanilla wafers
dark sweet cherry pie filling and topping
preparation: Place tofu on paper towel and gently squeeze out excess moisture.  Crumble and place in blender along with cream cheese, egg, sugar and almond extract.  Whirl until smooth and creamy.

name: BUTTERED BAKED POTATO SLICES
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo, melted
4  small Idaho potatoes
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. pkg. bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Pare and slice potatoes 1/2-inch thick.  Pour half the melted oleo into a shallow baking dish.  Place sliced potatoes into dish. Baste well with part of the remaining oleo.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

name: CHEESY BUTTON APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1  c. biscuit mix
1/4  c. butter
3  Tbsp. boiling water
3  Tbsp. sesame seed
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Mix baking mix and butter; stir in water and sesame seed until dough ball forms.  Drop by teaspoonful into cheese; coat dough with cheese.  Place about 1 inch apart on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake until golden brown, 7 to 10 minutes. Serve warm.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: STRAWBERRY SHAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. skim milk
2  Tbsp. orange juice concentrate
1/2  banana, broken into pieces and frozen
2  c. fresh strawberries (frozen whole)
1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Put the milk and juices into a blender.  Add banana pieces and strawberries one at a time.  Blend until the shake is smooth.

name: LINGUINE AL PESTO
ingredients:
2  cloves garlic
2  c. fresh basil, cleaned and stems removed
3  Tbsp. pine nuts
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. olive oil
1  Tbsp. chopped Italian parsley
1  lb. thin linguini
4  Tbsp. Pecorino Romano cheese
preparation: Method 1:  Drain 1 can of pinto beans.  Mash.   Cook in bacon grease or lard.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. evaporated milk
2  eggs
1 1/2  Tbsp. baking powder
2  tsp. pimento strips
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen corn, thawed and drained
preparation: Melt butter; blend in sugar and flour.  Stir in milk; mix smooth.  Add eggs and baking powder.  Fold in corn.  Turn into buttered baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  box sugar cookie mix
1  c. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can crushed pineapple
fruits
coconut
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cookie mix; bake in pizza pan.  Let cool.  Mix sugar and cream cheese; spread over cooled crust.  Spread the crushed pineapple.  Slice apple, banana and peaches; sprinkle fresh fruit with a few drops of lemon juice.  Spread over crust in layers. Sprinkle with coconut.  (Can use strawberries or any other kind of fruit.)  Top with Cool Whip.  Sprinkle with pecans, coconut and cherries.

name: PASTA AND VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
1  tsp. Italian seasoning
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1/4  c. water
2  tsp. beef flavor bouillon
2  c. broccoli flowerets
2  c. sliced zucchini
1/2  lb. mushrooms, sliced
1  medium red pepper, in thin strips
8  oz. fettucini, cooked
preparation: In large skillet, cook and stir onion, garlic and Italian seasoning in oil until onion is tender.  Add water, bouillon and vegetables.  Cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.  Toss with hot fettucini.  Serve immediately.  Makes 4 servings.

name: SUPER CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
4  sq. bitter chocolate
1/4  lb. butter
1  c. hot water
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
pinch of salt
1/2  c. buttermilk
1 1/4  tsp. soda
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler in the cup of hot water. Bring to a boil.  Mix the chocolate and melted butter.  Sift the flour, sugar and salt.  Pour the chocolate and butter all at once into the dry ingredients and blend well.  Add buttermilk and soda and mix well.  Then add the eggs and vanilla.  Bake in a 350° oven for almost 30 minutes.  While the cake is in the oven, prepare the frosting.  Frost while warm.

name: LAMB KEBOBS
ingredients:
1  lb. lamb chunks
1/4  c. olive oil
1/2  squeezed lime
2  Tbsp. grated onion
1 1/2  tsp. paprika
1 1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  large bay leaf, crumbled
preparation: Marinate lamb chunks in rest of ingredients for four hours or more. Skewer chunks onto bamboo skewers and bake over charcoal for 15 minutes.

name: "SURPRISE" BREAKFAST COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. packed light brown sugar
2  tsp. plus 1/3 c. butter or margarine, softened
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
10  fig bars, crumbled
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix brown sugar, 2 teaspoons soft butter, cinnamon and crumbled fig bars; set aside.  Mix flour, baking powder and salt.  Beat eggs until frothy; beat in sugar and 1/3 cup melted butter until well combined.  Add vanilla and milk.  Beat in flour mixture until well combined.  Pour half of mixture into greased and lightly floured 9 x 9-inch pan.  Spread half of fig mixture over cake batter and top with remaining cake mixture and fig mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  (The blueberry and apple bars are good too!)

name: MICROWAVE PARTY MIX
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter
4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. seasoned salt
2  c. Corn Chex
2  c. Wheat Chex
2  c. Rice Chex
2  c. thin stick pretzels
1 1/2  c. mixed nuts (12 oz.)
preparation: In 13 x 9-inch dish, place butter, Worcestershire and salt. Microwave at High 1 minute or until butter melts.  Stir well.  Add cereals, pretzels and nuts, mixing thoroughly to coat.  Microwave at High 5 to 6 minutes, stirring after 3 minutes, until evenly toasted.  Makes about 2 1/2 quarts.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs, well beaten
3  c. plain flour
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. peanut butter
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream shortening thoroughly; gradually add sugar.   Add beaten eggs and peanut butter.    Sift flour, soda and salt several times. Add gradually; mix well.  Shape into balls the size of walnuts.  Place on aluminum cookie sheet.   Flatten with fork. Bake at 350° until light brown.

name: MOM'S BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. milk
1/2  c. Crisco or 1/2 c. oil
2  eggs
1  c. ripe bananas
1/2  c. nuts
1/2  c. wheat germ
1/2  tsp. banana extract
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda.  Mix wheat germ; set aside.  Cream shortening and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.  Stir in bananas, milk and banana flavoring.  Add dry ingredients, mixing well.  Mix in nuts.  Turn into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch well-greased pan.  Bake in 350° oven for 60 to 70 minutes.

name: HARD CINNAMON CANDY
ingredients:
3 3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. white corn syrup
1  c. cold water
cinnamon oil
red food coloring
preparation: Place sugar, corn syrup and cold water into medium saucepan. Bring to slow boil and cook to hard ball stage (350°).  Turn off; beat and add 10 drops of cinnamon oil and food coloring.  Stir and pour onto cookie sheet dusted with cornstarch.  When cool, break into chips.

name: FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. water
3  c. cranberry juice
3  c. orange juice
3  c. pineapple juice
3/4  c. lemon juice
1  qt. 7-Up
preparation: Dissolve sugar in the water.  Add fruit juices and the lemon juice to sugar water.  When ready to serve, add the 7-Up slowly.

name: CHEESE STRATA
ingredients:
12  slices bread
3/4  lb. cheese, sliced
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. broccoli, cooked and drained
2  c. diced and cooked ham
6  beaten eggs
3 1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cut  12  doughnuts  and  holes	from  bread; set aside. Layer scraps  of	bread  in bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Layer  cheese,  broccoli and ham.  Arrange bread doughnuts and holes on top.  Combine eggs, milk, onion, mustard and salt.  Pour over all.  Refrigerate 6 hours or overnight.  Bake at 325° for 55 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1/2  c. onion dip
4  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
6  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/4  lb. Velveeta cheese, grated
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
dash of garlic salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients, shape into ball and roll in chopped pecans.  Chill before serving.

name: PECAN CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. white chocolate bark (3 sq.)
1  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. coconut
preparation: Melt bark and water.  Let stand to cool.  Cream sugar and butter.  Add eggs and white bark, then add dry ingredients and buttermilk.  Fold in coconut and pecans.

name: POLYNESIAN PORK ROAST
ingredients:
pork roast
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. honey
1/2  c. ketchup
garlic salt
preparation: Season pork roast with garlic salt.  Mix soy sauce, honey and ketchup.  Pour over pork roast.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25 minutes per pound, basting periodically with sauce.

name: DELICIOUS LI'L SMOKIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. Li'l Smokies
1 small  jar grape jelly
1  bottle chili sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients and simmer in crock-pot or covered pan on stove.

name: CHOCOLATE COVERED CHERRIES
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
2  lb. confectioners sugar
1/4  lb. softened butter
3 (10 oz.)  jars maraschino cherries, drained
16  oz. chocolate morsels
1/2  bar paraffin
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine milk, butter, sugar and vanilla.  Let stand for 1 hour.  Press some of the mixture around each drained cherry.  Let dry.  Combine chocolate morsels and paraffin in top of double boiler over hot water.  Heat until chocolate and paraffin are melted.  Cool slightly.  Dip balls into chocolate, then place on waxed paper to harden.  Age for 2 weeks.  Yields 75 to 100 pieces.

name: SALMON BALL
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can Alaskan red sockeye salmon, drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. finely chopped green onion
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. horseradish
1/2  c. chopped or dried parsley
1/2  c. chopped nuts (pecans or walnuts)
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Blend all ingredients but parsley and nuts.  Wrap in waxed paper to form ball.  (It will be quite soft.) Refrigerate overnight.  Remove and roll in parsley and nuts.  Refrigerate until ready to use.

name: THE NEXT BEST THING TO TOM SELLECK
ingredients:
1  pkg. German chocolate cake mix
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  jar butterscotch caramel ice cream topping
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
2  or 3 Heath candy bars
preparation: Bake cake as directed in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Take out of oven and poke holes in the cake with a wooden spoon.  Pour milk in holes, then ice cream topping.  Frost with Cool Whip.  Sprinkle with crushed candy bars.  Refrigerate.

name: RABBIT AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  rabbits (approximately 3 lb. each)
2  c. chicken broth
water as desired
6  cans biscuits (10 to can)
1/2  c. margarine
salt to taste
pepper (until you can see black pepper)
preparation: Cut  up rabbits in serving pieces.  Put in a large pot. Cook until  done with some butter, salt and pepper.  Cook and debone. Clean  the	pot.  Put  meat  back  in  the	pot.  Add chicken broth,  water, butter, salt and pepper and bring to a boil. Quarter  and  pull	apart  the biscuits.  Drop into the meat mixture one at a time and cook until done.	Serve hot.

name: HOMEMADE PIZZA CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. flour
water
1/2  c. melted shortening
preparation: Mix flour and melted shortening together.  Add just enough water to make it doughy.  Spread crust on a large 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake for 17 minutes at 350°.

name: PERSIMMON PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. persimmon pulp
1  c. white sugar
1  c. sifted flour
1  egg
1/2  c. buttermilk
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  stick butter
1/4  c. sweet milk
preparation: Mix pulp, sugar, egg and butter, then stir in all dry ingredients together.  Add the milk and beat until smooth.  Bake at 350°  for 45 minutes.

name: TORTILLA SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1  can kidney beans (with liquid)
2  cans diced tomatoes
1  can tomato sauce plus 1 can water
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1/2  pkg. Ranch dressing mix
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion.  Add rest of ingredients and continue cooking.  Serve with taco chips, lettuce, sour cream and cheese.

name: SHIRLEY SNIDER'S MOM'S MERINGUE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. water
3  egg whites, beaten
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Microwave cornstarch, sugar and water until thick, approximately 2 minutes.  Set aside to cool.

name: CREAM CHEESE TARTS
ingredients:
vanilla wafers
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  eggs
1  can cherry pie filling
3/4  c. sugar
Cool Whip
preparation: Let cream cheese soften; beat with eggs and sugar until smooth.  Place vanilla wafers in foil cupcake papers in muffin tin.  Fill about 1/2 to  3/4  full.  Bake at 325° for 10 to 15 minutes, until puffed.  Cool  3  to 5 minutes, then cover with cherry pie filling.  Chill  and  top  with  Cool  Whip.  Makes about 18 tarts.

name: PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. crushed unsalted pretzels
1 1/2  sticks margarine
1/4  c. sugar
1  pkg. Dream Whip
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  sugar
6  oz. strawberry jello
20  oz. bag frozen strawberries
preparation: Blend first 3 ingredients together.  Put in 2-quart baking dish.  Bake 8 minutes at 350°.  Cool.  Mix Dream Whip, cream cheese and 1/2 cup sugar together.  Spread on pretzel base.

name: COCKTAIL WIENERS
ingredients:
3  pkg. hot dogs
1  bottle Heinz 57
1 small  jar mustard
1 large  jar grape jelly
preparation: Cut hot dogs into thirds.  Pour Heinz 57, mustard and grape jelly over hot dogs.  Cook in crock-pot for 6 hours on low.  Stir occasionally.

name: DELICIOUS DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch Dressing Mix
1  c. mayonnaise (I use Hellmann's)
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix together with a wire whisk and chill at least 4 hours. Serve with vegetables or chips.

name: BOILED COOKIES
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. cocoa
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  stick butter
3  c. Minute oatmeal
1  c. peanut butter
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine cocoa, sugar, milk and butter; bring to a boil and boil 3 1/2 minutes.  Take off heat and add oatmeal, peanut butter and vanilla.  Mix well.  Drop on waxed paper with teaspoon.

name: FERN'S SPINACH NOODLE PUDDING
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. wide noodles, cooked
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach, thawed and drained
1  small onion
3  cloves garlic, minced
6  Tbsp. butter, melted
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. sour cream
salt and pepper to taste
3  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Combine all ingredients except Parmesan cheese; mix well. Spread mixture in oiled 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour, cut in squares.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

name: GIANT NACHO
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can refried beans
1  lb. hamburger, cooked with taco seasoning
8  oz. mild picante sauce
black olives, chopped
green onions, chopped
3  c. grated Cheddar and Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Layer, in a 9 x 13-inch pan, refried beans, hamburger, mild picante sauce, black olives, green onions and grated Cheddar and Monterey Jack cheeses.  Bake 20 minutes at 400°.  Top with guacamola or sour cream.  Serve with plain Doritos chips or tostado chips.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
3  c. sugar
6  large eggs
dash of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. almond
3  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Cream the margarine and sugar until fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, and beat well after each one.  Add flavorings and mix well.  Add sifted flour and salt; mix well.  Bake in a well-greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.  Start in a cold oven.

name: PEPPER JELLY
ingredients:
3/4  c. chopped bell pepper
1/4  c. chopped hot pepper
6  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. apple cider vinegar
1  bottle Certo
preparation: Mix all but Certo.  Boil for 1 minute.  Add Certo and boil for 2 minutes.  Put in clean jars and seal.

name: HOT CHICKEN SANDWICHES
ingredients:
4  c. cubed chicken or turkey
1/4  c. diced celery
2  Tbsp. diced onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Mix together and fill hamburger buns.   Can wrap in foil and warm in oven for 15 minutes at 350° or warm in microwave carefully.

name: OVERNIGHT EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  slices bread, cubed
3/4  lb. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  lb. pork sausage
2 1/2  c. milk
4  eggs
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. water
preparation: Place bread into a greased 9 x 13-inch dish and sprinkle with cheese; set aside.  In skillet brown sausage and drain fat. Crumble sausage over the cheese and bread.  Beat eggs, milk, mustard, soup and water together and pour over sausage mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: BAKED FISH
ingredients:
1  (2 to 3 lb.) bass
1  box regular stuffing type dressing
preparation: Soak fresh fish in milk 1/2 hour.  Prepare dressing as per instructions on package.  Bake, covered, 1 1/2 hours.  Uncover fish and baste with butter.  Bake an additional 1/2 hour.

name: GOOD SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1 (9 or 10 oz.)  carton whipped topping
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

name: FRESH FRUIT CRISP
ingredients:
1/2  c. quick cooking rolled oats
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
dash of salt
1/4  c. butter
5  c. sliced peeled peaches, apples or pears
vanilla ice cream or light cream
preparation: Combine oats, brown sugar, flour, cinnamon and salt; cut in butter until mixture is crumbly.  Set aside.  Place fruit in a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle oat mixture over fruit.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° until fruit is tender, about 40 minutes.  Serve warm with ice cream or light cream.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
2 1/3  c. confectioners sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  c. peanut butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
6  oz. chocolate chips
4  Tbsp. Crisco
preparation: Mix the first five ingredients together and beat well.  Spoon into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Melt the chocolate chips and Crisco over hot water and spread on top.  Cut into pieces before chocolate sets completely.

name: PEAR PIE
ingredients:
6  c. peeled and sliced fresh pears
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. grated lemon rind
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. nutmeg or cinnamon
butter or margarine
pastry for 2-crust 9-inch pie
preparation: Mix pear slices with sugar, rind, juice and spice.  Arrange in a 9-inch unbaked pie shell.  Dot with butter.  Cover with top crust.  Slit pastry to allow steam to escape.  Bake at 375° for 40 to 60 minutes.

name: COCONUT MACAROON PIE
ingredients:
1/2  stick oleo, melted
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
3  eggs
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can flaked coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased and floured glass pie plate.  Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until firm.

name: ALISON'S SOUTHERN MACARONI & CHEESE
ingredients:
1  c. macaroni cooked in boiling salted water until tender
1/2  c. breadcrumbs
1 1/2  c. milk
1/4  Tbsp. salt
1/4  Tbsp. pepper
1/4  stick butter
1/4  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs
8  oz. Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
preparation: Combine milk, salt, pepper, butter, sugar, eggs, cheese and onion in blender.  Grease casserole dish and pour in sauce.  Drain macaroni and add.  Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.  Set casserole in pan of water while baking (keeps casserole moist).  Serves 6.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. mashed potatoes
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. coconut
1/2  c. milk
1  stick butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar
1  stick butter
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: PIZZA MUFFINS
ingredients:
8  oz. Cheddar cheese
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese
8  oz. Monterey Jack cheese
1  can black olives, drained and chopped
1  jar green olives, drained and chopped
1 large  can mushrooms, drained and chopped
1  large onion, diced
1/4  c. oil
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. thyme
tomato paste
sourdough or English muffins
preparation: Shred the cheeses.  Mix all ingredients together except tomato paste and muffins.  Spread tomato paste on muffin halves; then spread on topping mixture.  Bake at 425° for 8 to 10 minutes. Topping mixture can be covered and refrigerated and used as needed.

name: TACO SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger, browned and drained
1  can black beans
1  can Ranch style beans
1  can kidney beans
1 small  jar Picante sauce
1  can Mexican corn
1  pkg. Ranch dressing
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  can Ro-tel
1  can tomatoes, diced
preparation: Put hamburger, beans, picante sauce, corn dressing, seasoning and tomatoes in a large pan.  Bring to a boil.  Serve with Fritos and cheese.

name: WINTER FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
20  oz. can pineapple chunks, drained (reserve juice)
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. grated orange peel
1/3  c. orange juice
11  oz. can mandarin oranges, drained
2  apples
2  bananas
preparation: Mix all fruit together.  Stir sugar and cornstarch together in saucepan.  Blend in 3/4 cup pineapple juice, lemon juice, orange peel and orange juice.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils.  Boil and stir 1 minute.  While hot pour over fruit mixture.  Refrigerate uncovered several hours. Serves 12.

name: PEPPERMINT PATTY DRINK
ingredients:
6  tsp. milk
1/4  c. vanilla ice cream
2  sprigs fresh peppermint
6  Tbsp. chocolate syrup
1  small chocolate peppermint patty
preparation: Process milk, ice cream and peppermint sprigs in blender. Swirl chocolate syrup in glass.  Pour ice cream mixture over. Serve with peppermint patty.

name: ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. red potatoes
1/4  c. butter, melted
1 1/4  tsp. seasoned salt
1/4  c. Worchestershire sauce
preparation: Quarter the potatoes.  Toss in the melted butter and seasoned salt.

name: GUACAMOLE DIP
ingredients:
2  soft ripe  avocados, mashed
1/4  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1  large tomato
salt and seasoning to taste
preparation: Peel, finely chop and drain tomato.  Combine all ingredients; cover tightly and chill.  Serve with crisp tortilla corn chips or raw carrot and celery sticks.  Yields approximately 2 cups.

name: TUNA ITALIANO
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella (1/2 shredded, rest 1/2-inch cubes)
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  can tuna packed in water, flaked and drained
1  medium red onion, thinly sliced and quartered
1  basket cherry tomatoes, quartered
2  large stalks celery, diced
2  Tbsp. oil
1  Tbsp. leaf basil, crumbled
1/8  tsp. black pepper
3  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. red pepper flakes, crushed
4  whole-wheat pita breads
preparation: Combine cheese, tuna, onion, tomatoes and celery in large bowl.  Mix next 6 ingredients in small screw-top jar.  Pour over tuna mixture and toss.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  To serve, cut pitas in half, fill and enjoy.

name: BUTTERMILK BISCUIT MIX
ingredients:
7  lb. flour
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. salt
2  c. baking powder
1 1/2  lb. Crisco (4 c.)
buttermilk
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except buttermilk.  This makes a large amount and may be stored in an airtight container until ready to use.  When ready to use, add enough buttermilk for amount of mix used.

name: MICROWAVE FUDGE
ingredients:
1  c. cocoa
2  lb. powdered sugar
1/2  c. homogenized milk
2  sticks margarine
1/2 to 1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Do not stir any of the ingredients in the first step.  Sift cocoa and sugar in a large mixing bowl.  Add milk and lay margarine sticks on top.  Do not stir.  Cook on High for 6 minutes. Remove from microwave and stir thoroughly.  Add vanilla flavoring and nuts.  Stir until well mixed.  Pour into buttered platter.  Cool in refrigerator for one hour.  Cut and serve. Do not double this recipe.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) whole berry cranberry sauce
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Mix well and freeze in a 9 x 13-inch covered dish.  Cut in squares when ready to serve.

name: HOMEMADE CHILI RELLENOS
ingredients:
4  to 6 large sweet or hot green peppers (not bell peppers)
1  lb. baby Swiss cheese, grated
1  large onion, grated
1  c. flour
4  egg whites, beaten until stiff
4  egg yolks
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Mix cheese and onion together.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Boil peppers for 2 minutes; cool.  Slit peppers down side and remove seeds; rinse loose seeds out with cold water.  Stuff peppers with cheese mixture (save 1/4 cup for topping).  Close peppers tightly.   Roll gently in flour.  When all peppers are covered with flour, set aside.

name: SAUSAGE PUFFS
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage meat
1/2  lb. freshly grated Parmesan cheese
1 (17 1/4 oz.)  pkg. puff pastry, thawed
1  egg
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Mix sausage and cheese together until thoroughly blended.  On lightly floured surface, roll each pastry rectangle until it's about 8 inches by 14 inches.  Divide sausage mixture in half and form each into tube shape, about 13 inches long.  Lay each sausage roll along one long edge of pastry rectangle and roll up, jelly roll fashion, to form two long logs.  (Recipe may be made to this point up to 24 hours before serving.  Cover sausage roll with plastic wrap until ready to finish and serve.)

name: BEEFY JALAPENO CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. plus 1 Tbsp. yellow cornmeal
1  c. milk
2  eggs
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  c. bacon drippings
1  (17 oz.) cream-style corn
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
4  jalapeno peppers, finely chopped
preparation: Combine 1 cup cornmeal, milk, eggs, salt, soda, bacon drippings and corn in a bowl. Set aside. Cook ground beef until lightly browned; drain well and set aside. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon cornmeal in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle evenly with beef. Top with onion and cheese. Sprinkle peppers over top. Pour corn mixture over peppers. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until golden brown.

name: ROTEL POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
7  to 8 potatoes, boiled with skins
1  lb. Velveeta
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  onion, chopped
1  stick margarine
preparation: After potatoes have cooled off, slice with skins into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Melt the Velveeta with the Ro-Tel, onion and margarine in the microwave.  When melted, pour over potatoes. Bake at 350° until bubbly.

name: TWO EGG CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. Crisco
2  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Mix well.  Heat oven to 350°.  Will make 3 layer cake.  Top with favorite frosting.

name: HAM AND CHEESE SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
6  Tbsp. mustard
1  onion, chopped fine
dash of poppy seed
preparation: Cream the  ingredients	and spread on top and bottom of buns. On the  top piece, put one slice of Swiss cheese and on the bottom piece, put a slice of ham. Bake in 300° oven for 15 minutes or until cheese melts.

name: SCRIPTURE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Judges 5:25 (last clause)
2  c. Jeremiah 6:20
2  tsp. 1 Samuel 14:25 (last clause)
6  Jeremiah 17:11
1/2  c. Judges 4:19 (last clause)
4 1/2  c. 1 Kings 4:22
2 heaping  tsp. Amos 4:5
1  c. 1 Samuel 30:12 (second clause)
1  c. Nahum 3:12
2  Chronicles 9:9 (second clause)
preparation: Cream the first 3 ingredients.  Beat 6 Jeremiah 17:11 until frothy and add sifted dry ingredients.  Add to creamed mixture the remaining ingredients.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes for good reading (and eating).

name: UNCOOKED NUT FUDGE
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter
1/4  c. milk
3  sq. unsweetened chocolate or 9 Tbsp. cocoa and 3 Tbsp.  water
1  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. salt
1  lb. confectioners sugar
walnuts (if desired)
preparation: Put butter, milk and chocolate in saucepan and melt.  Remove and add vanilla, salt, confectioners sugar and nuts (if desired). Place in 8 x 8-inch buttered pan and chill.

name: HOME STYLE ROAST SQUAB
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. hoisin sauce
1/2  tsp. brown bean sauce
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  green onions, cut 1/2-inch in length
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. sherry wine
6  eggs
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of monosodium glutamate
preparation: Cook in thin layers in a lightly greased pan.  If you use nori, make each sheet 4 x 7-inches.  Use any of the following ingredients as a filling:

name: SUMMER SAUSAGE
ingredients:
5  lb. ground chuck
1  Tbsp. liquid smoke
5  tsp. Mortons Tender Quick Salt
2 1/2  tsp. mustard seed
2 1/2  tsp. garlic salt
2 1/2  tsp. red or black pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.  (I use a Tupperware mix and fix bowl.)  Refrigerate in a tightly cover bowl.  Mix each day for 3 days.  On fourth day shape into 5 rolls, place on a broiler pan and bake at 175° for 8 hours.  Great for cheese trays, and as good if not better than store bought.

name: QUICK SOUP
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
1  can vegetable soup
1  can Ranch Style beans
1  c. catsup
1  c. onion, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
1 to 2  lb. hamburger and smoked sausage
1  c. carrots (optional)
1  c. potatoes (optional)
preparation: Mix in a large pot and cook until done.  Serve with crackers or corn bread.

name: GREEN BEANS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen green beans
1/2  tsp. salt
1  can cream soup (chicken or mushroom)
1  jar white onions, drained
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2 soup  can water
3  Tbsp. grated cheese
preparation: Cook beans according to package directions; drain.  Arrange beans and onions in alternate layers.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.    Mix soup and water.   Pour over vegetables.   Top with cheese.   Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: WHITE CHILI
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans navy beans
2 (14 1/2 oz.)  cans chicken broth
1  c. water
1 1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove minced garlic
2  c. chopped cooked chicken breasts
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies
1  tsp. ground cumin
1/2  tsp. ground red pepper
3/4  tsp. oregano
3/4  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Combine beans, broth, water, onion and garlic in Dutch oven. Add chicken, chilies, cumin, oregano and red pepper.   Cover and cook 30 minutes.  Taste and adjust seasonings.  Spoon  into serving bowls; top each with cheese.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. milk
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. Bisquick
1/4  c. melted butter
4  eggs
preparation: Mix all together in blender for 3 minutes on high.  Pour into a 10-inch greased pie pan.  Sprinkle with about 1/2 cup coconut. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: APPLE CARAMEL ROLLS(Makes 12 rolls.)
ingredients:
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. margarine or butter
36  pecan halves
2  c. Bisquick baking mix
1/2  c. cold water
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter, softened
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1  c. finely chopped apple
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Place 2 teaspoons brown sugar, 2 teaspoons margarine and 3 pecan halves in each of 12 medium muffin cups; place in oven until melted.

name: FLYIN' A CHILI, KEEN BURRITO
ingredients:
3  pounds lean hamburger
30  roasted green chilies
2 large  cans tomatoes diced with green chili
40  tortillas
2 large  cans refried beans (optional)
preparation: Brown and crumble 3 pounds hamburger in a large skillet.  Add 30 skinned green chilies, seeds and all.  Add 2 cans tomatoes diced with chili.  Simmer and serve as beanless chili.

name: HAM AND BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. dry navy beans
1 1/2  lb. meaty ham bone
1 1/2  qt. water
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped carrots
3/4  c. potatoes
3/4  c. onions
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Rinse beans.  Place in Dutch oven with ham bone and water. Bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until beans are tender, 3 to 3 1/2 hours.  Remove ham bone and meat.  Cool until it can be handled.  Chop meat and return to soup along with remaining ingredients.  Discard bone.  Simmer 30 minutes or more until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.  Add water if it gets too dry.

name: BARBECUES
ingredients:
3  medium onions, diced
1  stalk celery, diced
1  Tbsp. fat
1  c. ketchup
2  c. water
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  can corned beef
preparation: Brown onions and celery in the fat.  Add remaining ingredients and cook until thick.  Serve on buns or other rolls.  Good with potato salad or chips.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
3  oz. pkg. strawberry gelatin
red food coloring
2  cooled baked pie shells
1  qt. fresh strawberries
1/4  c. cornstarch
1  c. 7-Up cola
6  Tbsp. light corn syrup
2  c. sugar
1  c. water
preparation: Combine sugar, cornstarch, cola, water and syrup.  Cook until mixture thickens.  Remove from heat.  Add gelatin and food coloring as desired.  Let cool.  Place berries in crusts and pour cooled sauce over top.  Refrigerate until completely cooled. Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

name: GARLIC MASHED POTATOES
ingredients:
8  baking potatoes, peeled and quartered (about 4 lb.)
1 3/4  tsp. salt, divided
1/2  c. butter, softened
3/4  c. half-and-half
3  large garlic cloves, minced
1/2  tsp. ground white pepper
1/4  c. chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Bring potatoes, 1 teaspoon salt, and water to cover to a boil in a Dutch oven or stockpot; cover, reduce heat, and simmer 30 minutes or until tender; drain.  Beat potatoes, remaining 3/4 teaspoon salt, butter, half-and-half, garlic cloves, and pepper at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth.  Stir in fresh parsley. Serve immediately.  Makes 8 servings.

name: 7-UP LAYER CAKE
ingredients:
1  pineapple cake mix
3/4  c. oil
1  box vanilla instant pudding mix
4  eggs
1  (10 oz.) 7-Up or Sprite
preparation: Mix all ingredients and beat 4 minutes at medium speed. Grease and flour pans well (3 layers or large oblong).  Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: CHOW MEIN
ingredients:
3  pounds hamburger, salted and browned
4  cups celery
3  large onions, chopped
3/4  cup soy sauce
1  1/2 cups uncooked rice
3  cans cream of mushroom soup
3  cans cream of chicken soup
4  cups warm water
3  cans Chinese noodles
preparation: Brown and salt hamburger.  Add remaining ingredients except noodles.  Mix and bake 1 hour at 350 degrees.  Sprinkle Chinese noodles over top and bake an additional 15 minutes.

name: SWEDISH SAUSAGE RING
ingredients:
2  lb. bulk pork sausage
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. grated onion
1 1/2  c. fine dry toast (or bread crumbs)
1/4  c. chopped parsley (if desired)
preparation: Heat  oven to 350°.  Lightly butter a 9-inch ring mold. Mix ingredients  well  and  pack into mold.  Bake 20 minutes. Take from oven and pour off excess fat.	Bake 20 minutes more. Turn onto  a  heated  platter and fill with scrambled eggs if desired.

name: SAUSAGE GRAVY
ingredients:
refrigerated buttermilk biscuits
1  lb. bulk sausage
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. sage
1/2  tsp. fresh ground pepper
4 heaping  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Bake biscuits according to package directions.  Meanwhile, break sausage into chunks in a medium skillet.  Add sage and brown over medium heat.  Add flour and stir to coat meat and soak up the oils.  Season with salt and pepper.  Over low heat, slowly add milk, stirring constantly.  Continue cooking and stirring until thickened.  Serve immediately over warm biscuits.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. shredded zucchini
preparation: Combine dry ingredients and set aside.  Beat eggs lightly in large bowl.  Add sugar, oil and vanilla.  Beat until creamy.  Stir in zucchini and flour mixture; stir only until moistened.  Pour into 2 greased and sugared 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.  Cool 10 minutes before removing from pans.  Yield:  2 large loaves.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. white Karo syrup
1  c. pecans, chopped
1  regular size unbaked pie crust
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add beaten eggs, flour, salt, vanilla and syrup.  Stir well.  Add pecans and pour into crust.  Bake for 30 minutes in moderate oven.

name: BURRITOS
ingredients:
2  lb. extra lean ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1/4  tsp. oregano
parsley to taste
20  flour tortilla shells
1  c. lite sour cream
2  lb. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
3/4  c. taco sauce
preparation: Brown beef and onion.  Add taco seasoning, pepper (if desired), oregano, parsley and sour cream. Add 1/2 the cheese and 1/2 of the taco sauce, mixing well. Place 2 or more tablespoons of mixture on tortilla shell and roll up.  Place, seam side down, in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with remaining cheese and taco sauce. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until cheese melts and the burritos are heated through.  This freezes well.

name: TANGY BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1/2  c. onion
1  Tbsp. oil
1 to 1 1/2  lb. beef, cubed
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1 1/2  Tbsp. paprika
1/2  c. red wine vinegar
salt and pepper to taste
1/4  c. tomato paste
1  can beef broth
1 1/2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
6  medium potatoes
6  to 7 carrots
zucchini
1  bay leaf
preparation: Saute onion and pepper in shortening in a large skillet.  Add ground beef and brown well. Add tomato juice, rice, chili powder and seasonings.  Stir well. Pour into casserole; cover.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes. Serves 4.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
fruit (enough of the kind you would use to make a cobbler)
sugar to taste (usually 1 c. is enough)
1  c. water (1 1/2 c. if fruit is dry)
1  pkg. dry cake mix (lemon, yellow or white)
1  c. pecans, chopped fine
1 1/2 or 2  sticks margarine
preparation: If you don't have enough fruit of one kind, you may add apples or pears.

name: BUTTERFINGER BROWNIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. melted butter
2 1/4  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
3  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
4  (2.1 oz.) Butterfingers, crushed
preparation: Combine butter and sugar.  Mix in eggs and vanilla.  Add combined dry ingredients and Butterfingers.  Mix well.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Cut while warm.

name: TAPIOCA MANDARIN
ingredients:
2 small (3 oz.)  boxes American vanilla tapioca pudding
1 small (3 oz.)  box orange jello
2 (11 oz.)  cans mandarin oranges, drained
1  (8 oz.) tub Cool Whip
3  c. boiling water
preparation: Mix pudding and jello with rapidly boiling water.  Remove from heat and chill for 2 hours.  After 2 hours, whip mixture, then fold in drained mandarin oranges and the Cool Whip.  Chill and serve.

name: CHOC-PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
2/3  c. cocoa
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla extract
3/4  c. peanut butter
preparation: Add sugar, cocoa, salt, milk, butter and vanilla. Stir.  Bring to a boil about 4 minutes until it becomes a soft ball. Add peanut butter until it starts to thicken.  Pour into buttered pan. Chill for 1 hour.

name: GOURMET POTATOES
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar
1/4  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1/3  c. chopped green onion
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook potatoes in their skins.  Cool.  Peel and shred coarsely. Over low heat, combine cheese and 1/4 cup butter, stirring occasionally until almost melted.  Remove from heat and blend in sour cream, onions, salt and pepper.   Fold in potatoes and turn into a greased 2-quart casserole.  Dot with 2 tablespoons butter and bake at 350` for 25 minutes or until heated through.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: CHRISTMAS PUDDING
ingredients:
2/3  c. shortening
1 3/4  c. sugar
3  eggs
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. water
2 1/8  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. buttermilk
2 large  boxes vanilla pudding
preparation: Cream together shortening and sugar; beat in thoroughly the eggs.  Mix cocoa with water; add to the above.  Add and beat until thoroughly mixed the flour, soda, salt, vanilla and buttermilk. Pour into loaf pan; bake at 300° for 35 to 45 minutes.  While cake is baking, prepare vanilla pudding according to directions.  When cake is done, cut it into squares immediately.  Put layer of cake in bottom and around sides of large serving dish.  Alternate layering of pudding and cake.  Cover with whipped topping. Decorate with maraschino cherries.

name: GRANDMA'S PINEAPPLE NOODLE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  lb. medium wide noodles, cooked and drained
1  pt. creamed cottage cheese
1/2  lb. melted butter
1  pt. sour cream
4  eggs, beaten
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1 large  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Cook noodles; drain well.  Add to remaining ingredients and mix well.  Pour into well greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until golden brown.  Cut into squares.

name: SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
onion powder
salt and pepper to taste
1  lb. grated cheese
mashed potatoes
preparation: Cook ground beef and seasonings.  Drain on paper towel. Spread meat on bottom of glass pan.  Add cheese, mashed potatoes, then more cheese over potatoes.  Put in oven until cheese melts.

name: CRACKER JACKS
ingredients:
1  c. pecans
1  c. peanuts
7  c. popcorn, popped
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. soda
1/4  c. light corn syrup
preparation: Heat oven to 300°.  Divide popcorn into two ungreased pans. Place butter, brown sugar, syrup and salt in saucepan.  Cook until bubbly and then cook 5 more minutes.  Remove from heat and add soda.  Pour over popcorn and stir.   Bake 1 hour; stir every 15 minutes.

name: CHOCO-SCOTCH POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. German chocolate
1  c. butterscotch baking bits
1  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk
3 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt chocolate and butterscotch bits over hot water or in microwave.  Cool.  Cream shortening and sugar.  Add eggs, vanilla and buttermilk.  Sift dry ingredients and add to egg mixture and cooled chocolate mixture and stir well.  Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Cool on rack.  Remove from pan.   Dust with powdered sugar or glaze, if desired.

name: SUBSTITUTE FOR EAGLE BRAND MILK
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. powdered milk
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. boiling water
3  tsp. melted butter
preparation: Blend well in blender; store in refrigerator.  This will work well in any recipe.

name: SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
3  eggs, well beaten
buttered stuffing mix
preparation: Cook spinach and onion for 5 minutes.  Drain well.  Put in colander and mash gently.  In large bowl, combine soup, cheese and mayonnaise.  Add spinach and egg.  Top with buttered stuffing. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: BLOND BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
5  oz. white chocolate
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. coarsely chopped walnuts or pecans (or a mix of the two)
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Prepare an 8 x 10-inch (for thicker) or 9 x 12-inch (for thinner brownies) baking dish by spraying it with vegetable oil.

name: CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can sour red cherries
dash of salt
1/2  c. sugar
1 small  pkg. cherry jello
1/2  c. pecans
1 small  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Boil  cherries,  salt  and  sugar about 5 minutes.  Add cherry jello,  pecans  and  pineapple.  Pour  into  mold	and refrigerate until set.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
4  slices bacon
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  cans pork and beans
2  Tbsp. packed brown sugar
2  Tbsp. mustard
2  Tbsp. catsup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp; save drippings.  Remove bacon, crumble and set aside.  Cook onion in drippings until tender.  Combine with beans, brown sugar, mustard, catsup and Worcestershire sauce. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Sprinkle with crumbled bacon.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CINNAMON CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  lb. margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. milk
3  tsp. baking powder
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together all ingredients.  Pour into greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan.  Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour, sifted
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine or butter
2  eggs
1  c. mashed bananas
3/4  c. (coarsely cut) nuts
Sugar
preparation: In a bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, salt and soda, and set aside.  In another bowl, cream together the sugar and the margarine or butter.  Add the eggs and beat well.  Stir in the mashed bananas.  Add the dry ingredients and the nuts.  Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan and sprinkle with sugar.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes, then reduce the heat to 325° and bake another 35 minutes.  Let set 20 minutes before inverting onto a rack to cool.

name: NOODLE DOODLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. Ramen noodles
1  c. green peas
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/4  c. sweet red pepper or pimento
1/4  c. dill pickle, chopped
preparation: Prepare noodles as directed on package.  Add soup, peas, celery, pepper, pickle and mayonnaise.  Mix well and chill.   Good for picnics.  Add mayonnaise just before serving.

name: PINEAPPLE DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. crushed pineapple, well drained
1  c. chopped nuts
2  eggs
4  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients well; make drop cookies (makes at least 6 dozen) by dropping by spoonfuls on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350°.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
4  c. shredded sharp cheese
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/8  tsp. garlic salt
1/8  tsp. celery salt
1/8  tsp. onion salt
1/2  c. chopped pimento
1/4  c. chopped olives
1/4  c. parsley flakes
1/2  jar dried chipped beef
preparation: Mix all ingredients except chipped beef and parsley.  Chill for 1 hour.  Shape in ball.  Roll in chipped beef and parsley until well coated.  Keep in refrigerator.  Serve with cracker (any kind).

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3 (4 oz. each)  pkg. grated sharp, mild and Colby cheese
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  pkg. finely chopped pecans
preparation: With all ingredients at room temperature, mix, shape and store in covered container in refrigerator.

name: CHERRY KOLACKY COOKIE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  egg yolk, beaten
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  can Solo cherry filling
preparation: Cream together butter, cream cheese, milk and sugar.  Add beaten egg yolk.  Sift together flour and baking powder.  Add to creamed mixture and blend well.  Refrigerate until dough is thoroughly chilled, 4 hours or overnight.  Roll or pat out on a well-floured board to 1/4-inch thickness and cut with a cookie cutter into 2-inch rounds.  Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and make a depression with thumb or spoon in center of each round. Fill centers with scant teaspoon Solo cherry filling.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.  Sprinkle with confectioners sugar before serving.  Makes approximately 36.

name: SAWDUST SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon jello
1  pkg. orange jello
2  c. boiling water
1 1/4  c. cold water
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained
2  or 3 bananas, sliced
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add cold water.  Add pineapple and bananas.

name: TOMATO PIE
ingredients:
1  pie crust, lightly baked
3  to 5 tomatoes
6  pieces cooked bacon or any meat (including pepperoni, beef or chicken)
1  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  onion
preparation: Alternate layers of sliced tomatoes and other ingredients in crust. The tomatoes may produce a lot of juice, so sprinkle a little cornstarch in layers if tomatoes are real ripe.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  lb. squash
1  large onion
1  lb. Italian sausage
1  tsp. Italian seasoning
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1 large  can tomato sauce
1  lb. ground beef
dash of salt
2  c. cracker crumbs
2  c. water
preparation: Chop squash and onion. Boil in water until onion is clear. Drain off water. Fry sausage and beef until browned.  Drain off fat. Combine zucchini mixture with meat, seasoning, salt and tomato sauce.  Place mixture in a baking dish.  Sprinkle cracker crumbs and cheese on top.  Bake at 357° until brown (approximately 45 minutes).

name: COCONUT PIE(Forms Its Own Crust)
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  stick butter
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. self-rising flour, sifted
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. coconut
2  c. milk
preparation: Combine flour and sugar.  In a separate bowl, combine eggs, vanilla, coconut and milk.  Grease a large pie plate with butter, then place remainder in the liquid mixture.  Mix the liquid ingredients with the flour and sugar, then pour into pie plate. Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

name: CRABMEAT DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon gelatin
1  c. hot water
1  c. tomato soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1 large and 1 small  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
grated onion (to taste)
1  can crabmeat
1  can small shrimp
preparation: Dissolve the gelatin in hot water.  Beat together the soup, mayonnaise and cream cheese.  Add the gelatin water.  Stir in the remaining ingredients and pour into one large or two small molds. Refrigerate overnight.  Serve with crackers or cut up vegetables.

name: EGGPLANT ANTIPASTO
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant, chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
3/4  c. mushrooms, chopped
1  c. tomato paste
2  cloves garlic
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
1/3  c. olive oil
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. pimento olives, chopped
2  Tbsp. wine vinegar
1  Tbsp. oregano
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. water
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bring to boil and simmer about 30 minutes.  Use as dip or over rice.

name: WAFFLES
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
1/2  c. melted margarine
4  eggs
preparation: Preheat waffle machine.  In large bowl with wire whisk, mix first 4 ingredients.  Add remaining ingredients and beat until well blended.  When waffle maker is ready, pour batter over (it takes about 1 cup of batter).  Cook until done, about 4 to 5 minutes until nicely brown.  Makes 4 cups of batter.

name: TERIYAKI SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  minced garlic clove
1  tsp. honey
1/2  tsp. ginger
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Heat in microwave so honey will blend in with soy sauce.  Great for marinating beef, chicken and fish. Great for barbecue grills after marinating.

name: TATER, HAM N BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
1 (28 oz.)  pkg. frozen steak fries
1  (10 oz.) frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
1 1/2  c. diced fully cooked ham
1  can cream of broccoli soup
3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a greased 9 x 13 baking dish, layer the first 3 ingredients in the order listed. Combine the soup, milk and mayonnaise and whisk until smooth. Pour this mixture over first 3 ingredients. Cover and bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle with cheese. Bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly.

name: FRENCH COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  can coconut
1  pie shell
preparation: Melt margarine.  Mix  ingredients.  Bake  at 325° for 1 hour.

name: VEGETARIAN FOUR-BEAN CHILI
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  large onions, chopped
1  medium sweet green pepper, cored, seeded and chopped
3  cloves garlic, finely chopped
2  medium-size carrots, pared and cut into 1/2-inch dice
1  small zucchini, halved lengthwise and thickly sliced
1  small summer squash, halved lengthwise and thickly sliced
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. leaf oregano, crumbled
1  tsp. ground cumin
2  cans (28 oz. each) tomatoes in puree
1  can (12 oz.) beer
1  can (16 oz.) black beans, drained and rinsed
1  can (16 oz.) kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1  can (16 oz.) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
1  can (16 oz.) black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed
preparation: Heat oil in large pot over medium heat.  Add onion, green pepper and garlic; saute 4 minutes or until onion is softened.  Add carrot; cover and cook 2 minutes.  Add zucchini, summer squash, chili powder, oregano and cumin; saute 1 minute.  Add tomatoes, breaking up with wooden spoon the beer and salt.  Bring to boiling. Lower heat; simmer, partially covered, 15 minutes.  Stir in all the beans, stirring until heated through.

name: STUFFED CHICKEN SHELLS
ingredients:
1/2  box jumbo shells
2  chicken breasts, boiled and cut into small pieces
1  box Stove Top chicken stuffing
1  c. Miracle Whip
3  cans cream of chicken soup
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook shells as directed on box; cool.   Mix cooked chicken, stuffing and Miracle Whip together.   Mix separately 3 cans of soup and 1/2 cup water.   Pour 1/3 of soup/water mixture on bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish.   Stuff shells with chicken mixture and arrange shells over soup mixture in bottom of dish.  Pour remaining soup mixture over shells and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.   Cover and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: LEMON BARS(Low Cholesterol)
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. Egg Beaters
1/4  c. lemon juice
2  tsp. grated lemon rind
powdered sugar
preparation: In medium  bowl, combine 1 cup flour and 1/4 cup sugar. Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Place crumbs on bottom  of greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until slightly brown.

name: TACO PIE
ingredients:
1  can Hormel chili (no beans)
1  can chopped, peeled green chilies, drained (if you can't find chopped, chop the whole ones)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese (mild)
tortilla chips
preparation: In a 9 x 13-inch baking pan, layer the whole can of Hormel chili.  Then add the chilies on top.  Slice the cream cheese and lay on top of the chilies.  Add shredded cheese.   Bake at 350° until hot and bubbly and lightly browned.  Serve with tortilla chips.  (Also may be microwaved in a pinch.)

name: PECAN CRUNCH COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped pecans
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
preparation: Cream together oleo, sugar and vanilla.  Add pecans; stir in flour.  Form into small balls.  Use about 1 teaspoon for each ball.  Put on ungreased cookie sheet.  Press balls flat; top with sugar.  Bake 15 to 18 minutes in a 350° oven.  Makes 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

name: MOM'S CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  stick butter (1/4 lb.)
2  c. shredded chicken
onion
cilantro (optional)
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. frozen peas and carrots
1  Tbsp. chicken broth
preparation: In a pan, cook the onion and cilantro (chopped).  Add the shredded chicken, peas and carrots, tomato sauce and the chicken broth.  Add 1/2 cup of water.  Mix and cook for approximately 30 minutes, until it gets a little juice.  Set aside.  Mix the baking powder and the flour.  Add the stick of butter.  Cutting it with a knife, cut it in until it gets very crumbly.  Knead the dough with your hands, until it is easy to handle and doesn't stick to your hands.   Roll it out and divide it in two.  Cover a pie plate with half of it.  Bake at 350° for approximately 15 minutes, or until light brown.  Set aside to cool.

name: CREAMY ORANGE-PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange jello
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. whipping cream or 8 oz. Cool Whip
1  grated carrot
preparation: Drain pineapple; reserve juice.  Add water to juice to make 1 cup; heat to boil.  Add boiling liquid to jello and cream cheese; beat until smooth.  Cool, stirring occasionally.  Fold cream, carrot and pineapple into cooled gelatin.  Pour into mold.  Chill.

name: RANCH STYLE BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  cans pork and beans (16 oz. each)
1  can kidney beans (15 oz.)
1/2  pkg. onion soup mix (Lipton)
1  c. ketchup
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. mustard
2  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Brown the ground beef in skillet.  Pour off excess grease.  Mix all other ingredients together with the ground beef in large casserole dish.  Bake in oven at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes or until bubbly.

name: SWEET SOUR SPARERIBS
ingredients:
4  lb. spareribs
flour (to coat ribs)
5 +  cloves garlic
2  slices ginger root
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. shoyu
1/3  c. cider vinegar
dash of ajinomoto and black pepper
1 small  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Lightly coat spareribs with flour.  Fry with ginger and garlic.  In separate pot, combine the rest of the ingredients except for the pineapple.  Bring to a boil.  Add the ribs and simmer until tender.  Last 10 minutes of cooking, add the pineapple.

name: CHICKEN DIP
ingredients:
1  can white chicken (small)
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
diced jalapenos to taste
preparation: Heat mixture; stir and serve with chips.

name: PINEAPPLE BANANA PIE(Diabetic)
ingredients:
1 (4 serving)  pkg. sugar-free vanilla pudding (not instant)
1  banana
3  pkg. sugar substitute
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed unsweetened pineapple
1  c. skim milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook pudding mixed with sugar substitute, pineapple juice and milk until it thickens.  Remove from heat; add pineapple and 1 teaspoon vanilla.  Mix well.  Slice banana over a cooked pie crust.  Pour pudding over banana.

name: MINCED CLAM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3 small  cans minced clams
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. green peppers, chopped fine
1/4  lb. cooked bacon, cut fine
1/4  tsp. tabasco sauce
35  (or more) Ritz crackers - crushed
1/4  c. butter, melted
1/2 small  can pimentos, chopped fine
preparation: Bake in 375° oven, 1/2 hour or until golden brown.  If too moist, add more crackers.

name: CORNBREAD CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. cornbread mix
1  can cream-style corn
1  can mushroom soup
1  jar pimento
1  chopped onion
1  stick oleo
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Bake cornbread mix according to directions on package and crumble in baking dish.  Add corn, soup, onion and pimento.   Mix well.  Sprinkle one cup of cheese on top.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: CHICAGO DEEP-DISH PIZZA
ingredients:
1  (1 lb.) frozen white bread dough, thawed
1  lb. Italian sausage
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  tsp. dried oregano
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. 100% natural Kraft low moisture part-skim Mozzarella cheese slices
Kraft grated Parmesan cheese
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
preparation: On lightly floured surface, allow dough to stand, covered, at room temperature for 1 hour or until doubled in volume.  Remove sausage from casing.  Brown meat; drain.  Add onions and cook until tender.  Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste and oregano; simmer 15 minutes.  Roll out dough to 15 x 11-inch rectangle; press onto bottom and 1-inch up sides of greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Cover with half of Mozzarella cheese and meat sauce.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.  Let stand 15 minutes before serving.  Makes 8 servings.

name: PIZZA
ingredients:
cheese
some of that red stuff
pizza (shell)
preparation: Make it into a circle.  Throw it in the air.  Put on the red stuff and cheese.  Bake it really hot.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
16  oz. cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
3  eggs
28  graham crackers
1/4  c. butter
1  c. sour cream
4  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix cream cheese, sugar and 3 eggs together.  Butter a 9 x 9-inch pan.  Line sides and bottom of pan with crumbs.  Bake for 25 minutes at 350° after filling with cream mixture.

name: STRAWBERRY BROWNIE TORTE
ingredients:
1  pkg. fudge brownie mix
1  (14 oz.) sweetened condensed milk
1/2  c. cold water
1 (4 serving)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1  (4 oz.)  whipped topping
1  qt. fresh strawberries, hulled and halved
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Grease two 9 inch round cake pans.  Line with wax paper, extending up sides of pans; grease wax paper.  Prepare brownie mix as directed for cake like brownies; pour into prepared pans.  Bake 20 minutes or until springs back when touched.  Cool.  In large bowl, mix sweetened condensed milk and water, beat in pudding; chill 5 minutes.  Fold in whipped topping.  Place one brownie layer on serving plate.  Top with half of pudding mixture and strawberries.  Repeat.  Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. oil
4  eggs
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
3 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. nutmeg
2/3  c. water
1 1/2  c. nuts or raisins
preparation: Mix: sugar, oil, eggs and pumpkin.  Add rest of ingredients. Bake in 4 (1 pound) coffee cans at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BARBECUE BAKED POTATO
ingredients:
2  slices bacon, browned and crumbled
1  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
4  c. potatoes, thinly sliced
1/2  c. chopped onions
2  oz. American cheese, shredded
1/2  c. ketchup
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2  c. skim milk
3  drops "hot" pepper sauce
preparation: Mix flour, salt and pepper in a 2-quart casserole dish.  Layer potatoes, flour, onions and half of the cheese.  Combine last four ingredients over potatoes.  Bake at 375° for 50 minutes.  Stir gently and sprinkle remaining cheese and bacon.  Bake 5 minutes more.

name: ROLLED LASAGNE WITH PESTO
ingredients:
1  box lasagne noodles
1  egg
2  c. (1 lb.) Ricotta cheese
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Jack cheese
3/4  tsp. oregano leaves
3  Tbsp. minced parsley
2  cloves garlic, minced or pressed
2/3  c. each:  whipping cream and Pesto (recipe follows)
preparation: Cook noodles according to directions on package.  Drain and set aside.  When cool enough to handle, carefully separate noodles.  In medium size bowl, beat egg, then blend in Ricotta and Jack cheese, oregano, parsley and garlic.  Spread Ricotta mixture evenly over each noodle.  Roll from end to end.  Stand rolled noodles on end in a greased shallow 8 x 10-inch baking dish. Blend cream and Pesto; pour evenly over lasagne rolls.  Cover and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: JIFFY SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1 (28 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
1  Tbsp. instant minced onions
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. uncooked instant rice
preparation: Brown ground beef in a large skillet, stirring to crumble. Drain and return to skillet.   Add remaining ingredients, except rice, stirring to mix.  Bring to a boil.  Add rice.  Cover and remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes.  Yields 4 servings.

name: BROCCOLI AND CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head broccoli
1  head cauliflower
1  lb. bacon
1  lb. Cheddar cheese
8  oz. Mozzarella or cheese of your choice
1/2  c. sweet onion
1  Tbsp. sugar or to taste
1  c. Miracle Whip
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp.  Drain and set aside.  Chop broccoli and cauliflower into pieces, cubed or diced, small enough to mix. Add shredded cheeses and diced onion.  Add Miracle Whip and sugar to taste and consistency desired.

name: DRIED APRICOT FRUITCAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. pitted dates, cut up
1 (15 oz.)  pkg. dried apricots, cut up
2/3  c. white raisins
1/2  c. currants
1 1/4  c. boiling water
1 1/4  c. light brown sugar
3/4  stick butter, melted
2  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. flour
2  eggs
3  Tbsp. Grand Marnier
preparation: Soak dates, apricots, raisins and currants in boiling water for 1 hour.  Stir often.  Mix together brown sugar, butter and pecans; add baking soda, flour, eggs and Grand Marnier.  Mix well.  Divide batter into 2 well-buttered bread pans.  Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 hours; then test for dryness.  Bake 10 minutes longer, if necessary, and test again.  Cool for 10 minutes and remove cake to rack to cool.

name: SUPER-EASY BLACK FOREST CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. devil's food cake mix
1  can cherry pie filling
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Cool Whip
preparation: Prepare cake mix per package directions.  Make two 8-inch layers.  Let cake cool completely.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
chicken parts
1  box Minute rice or 1 c. cooked regular rice
1  stick oleo
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In a 9 x 13 baking dish, place chicken parts.  Add rice. Cover with heated soup mixture.  (Heat soups, oleo, water to pour over chicken rice.)  Bake at 275° for 3 hours.  May need to add water.

name: RED DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. oil
2  c. ketchup
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  minced onion
preparation: Mix together; shake well.  Makes 1 quart.

name: RAPID MIX ROLLS
ingredients:
5 to 6  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  pkg. yeast
3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. margarine
3  eggs
preparation: Mix 2 cups flour, sugar, salt and yeast in saucepan until warm.  Add dry ingredients.  Beat 2 minutes at medium speed.  Add eggs and 1/2 cup flour.  Beat on high 2 minutes.  Stir in enough flour to make soft dough.  Let rise until double in bulk.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: OLD FASHIONED LEMON CREAM SCONES
ingredients:
2  c. unbleached all-purpose flour, unsifted
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
grated zest of 2 lemons
1/4  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. cold, unsalted butter, cut into pieces
2  eggs
1/2  c. heavy cream
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon, mixed with 2 Tbsp. sugar for sprinkling (optional)
preparation: Preheat the oven to 400°.  In a medium bowl, combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, lemon zest and salt.  Cut in the butter with a fork or a heavy-duty electric mixer until the mixture resembles coarse bread crumbs.  In a small bowl or 1-cup measure, whisk together the eggs and cream.  Add to the dry mixture and stir until a sticky dough is formed.

name: NO-BAKE CHOCOLATE ECLAIR
ingredients:
1  box graham crackers
2 (4 oz.)  pkg. instant French vanilla pudding
3  c. cold milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
2  oz. Choco-bake
3  Tbsp. soft margarine
2  Tbsp. corn syrup
3  Tbsp. milk
2  Tbsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Line a buttered 13 x 9-inch pan with whole graham crackers. Mix pudding, milk and Cool Whip together until smooth.  Let set about 5 minutes or until thickened.  Pour 1/2 over graham crackers; make another layer of crackers on top of your pudding mixture.  Pour remaining pudding over crackers.  Top with a third layer of graham crackers.

name: YUM YUM
ingredients:
1  yellow or chocolate cake mix
1  egg
1  stick margarine, softened
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  box powdered sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
2  eggs
1  c. coconut
preparation: Combine mix, egg and margarine until crumbly.  Press into 9 x 13-inch dish.  Blend cream cheese, powdered sugar, nuts, eggs and coconut.  Pour over crust and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool and cut like brownies.

name: MANICOTTI
ingredients:
1  box manicotti noodles
1  lb. hamburger
1/2  lb. mozzarella cheese, diced
3  slices bread, cubed
1/2  c. milk
1  egg
1 large  jar of meatless spaghetti sauce
Parsley, salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown hamburger and drain well.  Add diced cheese, parsley, salt, pepper, bread, milk and egg.  Mix well.  Boil noodles and stuff with meat mixture.  Put some spaghetti sauce on bottom of cake pan and put noodles in (tightly).  Top with remaining sauce. Cover with foil and bake 1/2 hour at 350 - 375 degrees.  Remove foil and top with parmesan cheese and a bit of parsley for color. Bake an additional 15 minutes.

name: CHICKEN HONEY NUT STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1  lb. boneless chicken breast
3/4  c. orange juice
1/3  c. honey
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil, divided
2  large carrots, diagonally cut
2  stalks celery, diagonally cut
1/2  c. cashews or peanuts
hot rice
preparation: Cut chicken into thin strips and set aside.  In a small bowl, combine orange juice, honey, soy sauce, cornstarch and ginger; mix well.

name: PIMENTO CHEESE
ingredients:
1  qt. Dukes mayonnaise
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. sliced Kraft cheese
4  oz. pimento
salt and pepper
preparation: Blend all ingredients in food processor.  Will keep in closed container in fridge for 2 weeks.

name: HOMEMADE BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. salt
1 1/2  c. warm water
13 to 14  c. sifted flour
6  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
4  pkg. yeast
preparation: Combine milk, sugar, salt and shortening in saucepan.  Heat until bubbles appear around the edge and shortening is melted. Cool to lukewarm.  Measure warm water into large mixing bowl. Sprinkle in yeast and stir until dissolved.  Add lukewarm milk mixture.  Add 6 cups flour; beat until smooth.  Add enough flour to make dough easy to handle.  Knead for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.  Put into greased bowl.  Turn over with greased side up.  Cover with damp towel.

name: BAKED SLICE OF HAM
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  slice ham, 3/4-inch thick
1/2  c. vinegar
14  cloves
preparation: Place ham in pan just about the size of the slice.  Pour mixture over ham and bake in moderate oven for 45 minutes.  Baste frequently.

name: CREOLE STEAK
ingredients:
Flour
2  pounds round steak, cut in 1-inch strips
1/4  cup oil
1  medium onion, chopped
2  bell peppers, chopped
1 16-ounce  can tomatoes
1  8 -ounce  can tomato sauce
1  can water
2  cups corn, cooked
2  cups butterbeans, cooked
1  cut okra, sliced
1  bay leaf
dash tabasco
salt and pepper
2  cups cooked rice
parsley
preparation: Lightly flour meat and brown in hot oil; set aside.  Saut onion and pepper.  Combine all ingredients except parsley, simmer 45-50 minutes.  Serve over steamed rice tossed with parsley. Serves 8.

name: Sunday Morning Bloody Mary
ingredients:
10  ice cubes
15  oz. your favorite vodka
46  oz. your favorite Bloody Mary mix
preparation: Chill Bloody Mary mix prior to putting in thermos.  Serve with pickles or celery.  Yields 1/2 gallon.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
2  c. pumpkin
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. ginger
2  pie shells
preparation: In large mixing bowl, mix pumpkin, Eagle Brand milk, eggs, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and ginger.  Mix all ingredients good. Pour into pie shells and cook in preheated oven at 350° for about 35 to 40 minutes.  Take out and let cool before serving.

name: CHEESE ROLL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. Cheddar cheese, grated
2  tsp. lemon juice
dash of garlic salt
dash of chili powder
dash of lemon pepper
preparation: Mix with hands until well blended.  Shape into rolls and chill.  Rolls can be rolled into finely chopped nuts or paprika before chilling.  Serve with a variety of crackers.

name: SHRIMP SCAMPI
ingredients:
1  lb. large, uncooked shrimp, peeled and butterflied
5  Tbsp. butter
1/3  c. olive oil
4  cloves garlic, finely chopped
3  Tbsp. chopped parsley
3  Tbsp. chopped green onion
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  tsp. basil
1  tsp. oregano
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
cooked pasta or rice
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  In a bowl, melt butter.  Add olive oil, garlic, parsley, onion, lemon juice, basil, oregano and salt. Place shrimp in one layer on large, shallow baking pan.  Pour butter mixture over shrimp.  Sprinkle with pepper.  Bake 5 minutes in oven.  Place pan closely under heated broiler briefly, just until shrimp are flecked with brown.  Serve with noodles or rice.

name: CHOCOLATE MINT TRUFFLES
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. mint chocolate chips
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
finely chopped nuts, flaked coconut and chocolate sprinkles
preparation: In heavy saucepan over low heat, melt chips with sweetened condensed milk.  Chill 2 hours or until firm.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Roll in any of the coatings.  Chill 1 hour or until firm. Makes about 6 dozen.

name: CHERRY PIE
ingredients:
pecans
2  pie shells
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
2  pkg. prepared Dream Whip
1  pinch salt
preparation: Bake pecans into pie shells.  Mix together cream cheese, powdered sugar, Dream Whip and salt.  Put mixture into pie shells and top with cherry pie filling.

name: CRANBERRY CHRISTMAS PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cherry gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
3  c. cold water
1  qt. ginger ale, chilled
preparation: Mix.  You can also use pineapple-orange concentrate.

name: OLD-FASHIONED APPLE PIE
ingredients:
pastry (for 9-inch two-crust pie)
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. fresh lemon juice
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
dash of salt
6 to 7  c. thinly sliced, pared tart apples (about 6 medium)
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Prepare pastry.  Mix sugars, flour, lemon juice, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt.  Stir in apples.  Turn into pastry-lined pie plate.  Dot with butter.  Moisten rim of bottom crust and place top crust with slits cut in it, over filling. Fold edge of top crust under bottom crust, pressing to seal.  Make a decorative edge.  Cover edge with 3-inch strip of aluminum foil to prevent excessive browning; remove foil during last 15 minutes of baking.  Bake until light brown and juice bubbles, 40 to 50 minutes.

name: MEATLESS LENTIL SOUP
ingredients:
3  c. raw lentils, rinsed
7  c. water or chicken stock
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. minced garlic
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. minced celery
1  c. chopped carrots
1  Tbsp. wine vinegar
1 1/2  c. chopped tomatoes
2  Tbsp. red wine (sherry)
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  Tbsp. brown sugar
pinch of thyme, oregano or basil
preparation: Cover and simmer lentils, water and salt for 3 to 4 hours. Saute garlic, onion, celery and carrots.  Add to lentils after 3 hours.  Add tomatoes, wine, vinegar, sherry, lemon juice, brown sugar and seasonings after 3 1/2 hours.  Cook 30 minutes more. Serves 4 to 6 generously.

name: PECAN CLUSTERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  Tbsp. corn syrup
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and stir over medium heat until mixture boils and bubbles to top; stir for 2 minutes.  Remove from heat; add chocolate morsels.  Stir until melted; add pecans.  Drop with teaspoon on waxed paper.  Chill until set.  Makes 24.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1 1/2  sticks margarine
preparation: Cream together.

name: DEVILED EGGS
ingredients:
10  eggs
1 1/2  Tbsp. mustard
2  Tbsp. sweet relish
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
pinch of sugar
salt
pepper
preparation: Boil eggs until hard-boiled.  Cook; peel and slice in half. Take yolk and mix other ingredients with yolk.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Put yolk mixture into egg halves.

name: DONNA'S STRAWBERRY STUFF
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  c. sugar
1  large instant vanilla pudding
2  boxes frozen strawberries
2  small containers Cool Whip
1  egg
1  box vanilla wafers
preparation: In large bowl mix pudding according to directions on box.  In another bowl mix cream cheese, sugar and egg until smooth.  Add to pudding mixture.  Add Cool Whip and strawberries.  Mix well.

name: MEXICAN STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3  cans Campbell's minestrone soup
2  cans Ranch beans
2  cans Swanson beef broth
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1 large  can tomatoes
preparation: Brown beef.  Add remaining ingredients.  Simmer.  Serve with crackers.

name: POPSICLES
ingredients:
1  pkg. flavored Jell-O
1  pkg. same flavored Kool-Aid
2  c. boiling water
2  c. cold water
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O and Kool-Aid in boiling water; add cold water. Pour into paper cups and place in a freezer.  When mushy, put in a plastic spoon or stick.  When frozen, peel off paper and eat. May use molds.

name: QUICK CROISSANTS
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1  c. warm water
3/4  c. evaporated milk
1 1/2  tsp. salt
