1/3  c. sugar
1  egg
5  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. melted butter, cooled
1  c. firm butter
1 egg, beaten with 1  Tbsp. water
preparation: Soften yeast in warm water.  Add milk, salt, sugar, egg and 1 cup flour.  Beat until smooth.  Blend in melted butter; set aside. In a large bowl, cut the butter into 4 cups of flour until the size of dried kidney beans.  Pour yeast batter over the top and carefully turn mixture over with spatula to blend, just until flour is moistened.  Cover with plastic and refrigerate 4 hours to 4 days.

name: RHUBARB CHERRY PIE
ingredients:
3  c sliced rhubarb
1/3  c minute tapioca
1-lb can cherry pie filling
1  3/4 c sugar
5  drops red food coloring
1  recipe for plain pastry crust
preparation: Combine all ingredients except for pastry.  Let stand for 15 minutes.  Line a 9 inch pie plate with pastry, add filling, arrange top crust.  Bake at 400 degrees for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: HONEY CRUNCH COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. butter or margarine
1  c. honey
2  eggs
1  c. shredded coconut
1  c. butterscotch chips
4  c. crisp rice cereal
preparation: Sift together first 3 ingredients; set aside.  In a large mixing bowl, cream butter.  Add honey, a little at a time; mix well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Mixture will appear to separate.  Gradually add dry ingredients; mix until moistened.  Fold in coconut, chips and cereal.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets.  Bake at 350° for about 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove cookies to cooling rack. Makes about 5 dozen.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. mashed yams
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/4  c. coconut
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
1/3  c. flour
1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Sprinkle on top of casserole.  Pour evenly 1/2 cup melted butter over top and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  c. nuts
juice of 1/2 lemon
1  c. cooking oil
2  eggs, well beaten
3  c. apples, peeled and chopped fine
preparation: Combine sugar, oil, vanilla, eggs and lemon juice in bowl; beat well.  Add flour; beat well.  Add apples and nuts; mix well. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 315° for 1 hour.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  egg
1/2  c. fresh onion
3 to 5  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  lb. lean ground beef
1 (8 oz.)  can red kidney beans
1 (8 oz.)  bottle taco sauce
2  small tomatoes
4  c. torn mixed salad greens
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
plain tortilla chips
preparation: In a large bowl, use fork to slightly beat egg.  Add onion. If desired, stir in chili powder, then stir in salt and pepper. Add meat.  Mix together.  In large skillet, cook meat over high heat until beef is brown, then drain off fat.  While meat is cooking, drain beans, then stir beans and taco sauce into the cooked meat.  Bring to boiling, then reduce heat.  Cover and simmer for 3 minutes.   While mixture is simmering, cut each tomato into 8 wedges.   Place salad greens on large salad plates. Spoon warm meat mixture on top of greens.  Sprinkle cheese. Arrange tomatoes and chips around outer edges of plate.  If desired, serve with avocado dip, sour cream or salsa.  Makes 2 servings.

name: SHRIMP AND RICE
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  chopped onion
3/4  c. thin sliced celery
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
2  lb. cooked shrimp
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
2  cans mushroom soup
1/2  c. Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can sliced water chestnuts (optional)
sliced mushrooms, fresh or canned
preparation: Mix, put in buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole.  Cover with foil. Bake at 350° until bubbly hot.  Uncover, top with buttered crumbs. Bake 5 minutes more.

name: CHOCO-DOT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. packed brown sugar
2/3  c. shortening
2/3  c. oleo or butter, softened
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. plain M&M's
1  c. chopped nuts (if desired)
preparation: Mix sugars, shortening, oleo, vanilla and eggs in large bowl. Stir in flour, soda and salt.  Stir in candies and nuts.  Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls, about 2-inches apart onto ungreased sheet. Press 3 or 4 candies in each cookie (if desired).  Bake 10 to 12 minutes.  Makes about 3 dozen.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can Veg-All
1  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. chopped celery
1  stick melted butter
8  to 10 Ritz crackers
1  medium onion, chopped
preparation: Mix Veg-All, cheese, mayonnaise, celery, onion and mushroom soup together.  Place in casserole dish and cover with cracker crumbs.  Drizzle butter over cracker crumbs and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINS
ingredients:
2  whole chickens, cut up
2  cans cream of chicken or mushroom soup
black pepper
salt
2 or 3  cans biscuits
pats of butter
flour
preparation: Put cut up chicken to boiling in a large pot.  Cook until well done.  When done, take chicken out and let cool to touch, then debone chicken.  Don't discard the water and broth mixture.  Roll out biscuits in flour; cut up each biscuit into 4 sections.  Drop biscuits into water/broth mixture.  Alternate biscuits, butter and black pepper.  Have heat on medium-high.  After adding biscuits, it will tend to boil over, so adjust your heat accordingly.  Add the cans of soup and the chicken.  Simmer for about 10 minutes.  Salt to taste.

name: VELVEETA CHEESE FUDGE
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  lb. butter or oleo
1  c. cocoa
2  Tbsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt cheese and oleo.  Mix other ingredients thoroughly.  Pour in pan.  Cool.  Real yummy!

name: TACO CORN-RICE SALAD
ingredients:
1 20 oz  can pineapple chunks, reserve juice
1 17 oz  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  red bell pepper, sliced thin
1/3  c thinly sliced red onion
oil free tortilla chips
5  c cooked, hot rice
8  cherry tomatoes
1 sm  can (2 1/2 oz) black olives, sliced and drained
salad greens
1  c bottled salsa
1/4  c cider vinegar
1/4  c reserved pineapple juice
1  1/2 t chili powder
preparation: Combine salsa, vinegar, pineapple juice and chili powder in bowl, then mix with rice and let cool.  Add pineapple, corn, olives, tomatoes, pepper and onion and toss well.  Line a shallow serving bowl with salad greens.  Toss salad into bowls and serve with tortilla chips.

name: REFRIGERATOR PIE
ingredients:
20  graham crackers
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. butter
1  egg
1  c. whipping cream
8  oz. can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Crush crackers; roll very fine.  Line glass pie plate with half of cracker crumbs, but do not butter plate.  Cream butter; slowly add sugar.  Mix well.  Add unbeaten egg; whip thoroughly. Smooth mixture over plate with crumbs.  Whip cream, fold in pineapple and cover pie.  Cover with remaining crumbs.  Cool 6 hours before serving.

name: BARBECUE BEEF(15 Minute Preparation)
ingredients:
1  lb. beef round tip steak
1  medium onion, sliced thin
2  tsp. vegetable oil
3/4  c. barbecue sauce
preparation: Cut steak into 1/8 to 1/4-inch strips, 1-inch wide.  Put aside.  Cook and stir thin sliced onions in oil in large skillet on medium high heat for 3 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove and keep warm.  Add beef strips (1/2 at a time).  Cook and stir 3 minutes.  Add barbecue sauce and onions.  Heat until hot.

name: BANANA SPICE BREAD
ingredients:
3  ripe bananas, well mashed
2  eggs, beaten until light
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
2  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
1/8  tsp. cloves, ground
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: In medium bowl, mix together bananas, eggs and butter. Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and cloves. Add banana mixture; blend well. Stir in nuts. Place in greased loaf pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool 15 minutes. Remove from loaf pan. Cool completely before slicing.  Makes 1 loaf.

name: MAPLE SNOW(Vermont Style)
ingredients:
fresh fallen snow
real maple syrup
preparation: Fill a cereal bowl with fresh fallen snow. Top with real maple syrup and eat with a spoon!

name: PASTA AND VEGETABLES
ingredients:
small eggplant
diced onion
1  red pepper, cut up
1  green pepper, cut up
1  yellow pepper, cut up
1  can ready to use diced tomatoes
olive oil
pasta (angel hair)
preparation: Cook up onion in olive oil until it's transparent.  Saute onion and diced eggplant until soft.  Add other ingredients and cook about 20 minutes.  Cook pasta.  Add the vegetables to pasta; toss.  Serve hot.

name: DAY BEFORE BREAKFAST
ingredients:
1  lb. mild pork sausage
6  eggs
2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
3  slices bread, cubed
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Saute sausage and drain.  Beat eggs with milk and salt.  Layer bread cubes, sausage and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour egg mixture on top.  Refrigerate overnight.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.  Serves 8.

name: OLD-FASHIONED YEAST BREAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. yeast
1  c. lukewarm water
1  tsp. sugar
1  c. milk, scalded and cooled
1/2  c. shortening, yeast and butter
2/3  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
7  c. or more flour
preparation: Put yeast in a cup of warm water with a teaspoon of sugar. Let stand 5 minutes.  Cream together shortening, sugar and salt. Add well beaten eggs.  Knead; let rise and bake.

name: Jambalaya
ingredients:
1  cut-up chicken
3  chopped onions
1  sliced carrot
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. basil
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 (14 oz.)  can cut-up tomatoes
1  lb. shelled raw shrimp
2  c. cooked rice
preparation: In slow cooking pot, combine chicken with onions, carrot, garlic, oregano, basil, salt, pepper and tomatoes.  Cover and cook on low 4 to 5 hours.  Turn control to high.  Add shrimp and rice. Cover and cook on high for 30 to 40 minutes or until shrimp is done.

name: APPLE COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1/2  c. milk
32  oz. canned apples
1/2  c. raisins
1  tsp. cinnamon
sugar (to sweeten apples if unsweetened)
1  stick butter
preparation: Melt butter  in  a  13 x 9-inch cake pan.  Heat oven to 350°. Stir raisins, cinnamon and sugar into apples. Heat until hot.  Mix together  1 cup sugar, flour and milk.  Pour batter over melted butter.  Pour  apples  over all. Bake 45 minutes. Serve warm.

name: PORCUPINE MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. raw rice
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. finely chopped green pepper
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed tomato soup
preparation: In mixing bowl, combine ground beef, rice, onion, green peppers, egg, salt and pepper.  Mix well to blend.  Shape mixture in 24 meatballs about 1 1/2-inches in diameter.  Place in slow cooking pot.  Pour soup over meatballs.  Cover and slow cook, 7 to 8 hours.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
4  c. macaroni
1  c. Velveeta cheese
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Cook macaroni until done, then drain.  Add rest of ingredients.  Cook until cheese is melted (simmering for 10 minutes).

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  chicken
1  pkg. egg noodles
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  stick melted margarine
bread crumbs
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook chicken until tender.  Remove from pot and cut into small pieces.  Cook noodles in broth until tender.  Mix chicken, cream of chicken soup and cream of mushroom soup with noodles.   Salt and pepper to taste.

name: COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1  head cabbage, shredded (about 6 c.)
2  carrots, shredded
1  green pepper, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
3/4  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  tsp. sugar
1/4  c. cream
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Mix the first 4 ingredients together; set aside.  Combine the remaining ingredients.  Add to vegetables, mixing well.   Keeps several days in refrigerator and is best made day before serving.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1 (5 oz.)  can evaporated milk
2  c. sugar
1 (7 oz.)  jar Marshmallow Creme
1 (12 oz.)  jar creamy peanut butter
preparation: Melt butter over low heat.  Add milk and sugar and mix well. Boil for 3 minutes.   Remove from heat.   Add Marshmallow Creme and peanut butter.  Mix thoroughly.  Pour onto lightly buttered platter.  Cook for 1 hour.

name: BEEF STEAK OR ROAST MARINADE
ingredients:
1/2  c. red wine vinegar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. dried basil
1/3  c. catsup
1  tsp. sugar
2  cloves garlic, minced (optional)
1  c. fresh orange juice
2  Tbsp. peanut oil
1/4  c. white wine vinegar
3  Tbsp. tamari or soy sauce
1  Tbsp. raw honey
freshly ground white pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.  Whisk to emulsify. Marinate poultry from 1 to 4 hours before grilling.  Marinate flank steaks and ribs overnight.

name: NOODLE PUDDING(Sweet)
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  box noodles (medium width)
3/4  stick butter
3  eggs
2/3  c. sugar
4  oz. cream cheese, mashed
1  c. apricot nectar
1  c. milk
preparation: Cook noodles as directed on box (in large pot of salted, boiling water until soft).  Drain noodles thoroughly.  Add to drained noodles the butter, eggs, cream cheese, sugar, apricot nectar and the milk.  Mix together well.  The mixture will be quite loose.  Grease either a square or oblong pan (about 8 x 10-inch).  Grease with butter well; put mixture in.

name: ELK OR DEER ROAST
ingredients:
1  (3 to 5 lb.) roast
2  small onions, cut in chunks
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2 soup  cans red wine
salt
pepper
garlic powder
preparation: Cut roast into serving size chunks; pour soup and wine in crock-pot.  Add onions and seasonings to your taste.  Mix well and add meat.  Cook on low 6 hours or on high 3 hours until done.

name: AUTUMN SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onions
2  c. hot water
3/4  c. chopped celery
3/4  c. cut-up potatoes
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  bay leaf, crumbled
pinch of basil
3  whole fresh tomatoes (stems removed)
preparation: Brown ground beef slowly in a little fat in a heavy kettle. Add onions and cook 5 minutes more.  Add remaining ingredients, except tomatoes, and mix thoroughly, loosening the brown crustiness from the bottom of kettle.  Bring to a boil, cover, then simmer 20 minutes.  Add tomatoes and, if necessary, more water.  Simmer 10 minutes longer.  Makes 2 generous servings.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can French fried onions
1  can mushrooms
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. sour cream
1  can buttermilk biscuits
1  egg
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of celery seed
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain.  Add can of French fried onions (less 1/2 cup) and can of mushrooms.  Put in ungreased 2 1/2 to 3 quart casserole.  Heat can of mushroom soup (undiluted) to a boil. Stir in 1/2 cup sour cream.  Pour over meat in casserole.  Top with remaining 1/2 cup French fried onions.  Cut biscuits in half and edge casserole with cut side down.  Mix egg, 1/2 cup sour cream, salt and celery seed; pour over biscuits and across top of casserole.  Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: AMBROSIA MOLD
ingredients:
1  can (8 oz.) crushed pineapple (undrained)
1 large  pkg. or 2 small pkg. orange gelatin
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
2  c. boiling water
1  (3/4 c.) thawed Cool Whip
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1/2  c. Angel Flake coconut
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving liquid.  Add cold water to make 1 cup.  Stir boiling water into gelatin in a large bowl (2 minutes to completely dissolve).  Stir in measured liquid.  Refrigerate until slightly thickened.  Stir in whipped topping; stir until smooth.  Refrigerate until mixture will mound (about 10 minutes). Stir in oranges, pineapple, marshmallows and coconut.  Pour into mold or molds.  Refrigerate until firm.

name: RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1  small onion, chopped
1  can beef consomme
1  can beef bouillon or onion soup
1 heaping  c. rice
1  c. water
preparation: Brown rice in small amount of margarine.  Brown onion in 1/2 stick margarine.  Combine all in casserole.  Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.  Change casserole by adding pork chops.  Brown pork chops lightly and place on top of rice before baking.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. cooked, diced chicken breasts
1/2  c. sliced almonds
2  Tbsp. grated onion
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. mayonnaise (Best Foods)
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  c. potato chips, crushed
1  c. sliced water chestnuts
2  c. chopped celery
preparation: Mix all ingredients; put in Pyrex dish.  Top with potato chips, crushed.  Bake in a 425° oven for 20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN KIEV
ingredients:
4  medium size chicken breasts, split lengthwise, skinned and boned
salt
1  Tbsp. chopped green onion
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/4  lb. margarine
2  beaten eggs
flour
dry bread crumbs
preparation: Place each piece of chicken between two pieces of waxed paper. Pound with wooden mallet to form cutlets not quite 1/4-inch thick.  Peel off paper and sprinkle with salt.  Place a piece of butter at each end of cutlet.  Sprinkle with parsley and onion. Roll meat as for jelly roll, tucking in sides and ends.  Dust each roll with flour and dip in beaten egg, then roll in bread crumbs. Chill thoroughly at least 1 hour.  Fry in hot fat about 15 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve with mushroom sauce if desired.

name: CHOCOLATE CHERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. devil's food cake mix
1  can cherry pie filling
1  tsp. almond extract
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a 13 x 9-inch greased pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Mixture will be very thick.

name: MARINATED VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can small green peas, drained
1 (12 oz.)  can tiny Shoe Peg corn, drained
1 (16 oz.)  can French-cut green beans, drained
1  medium onion, chopped
3/4  c. finely cut celery
preparation: Mix all salad ingredients together.

name: CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  egg
1  c. milk
dash of salt
1 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1  c. cornmeal
2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix egg, milk, salt and sugar.  Add flour, cornmeal and baking powder.  Bake in hot, greased pan, 8 x 8 x 2-inch, or small skillet, at 425° for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

name: CHOW CHOW
ingredients:
1  gal. chopped cabbage
2  large onions, chopped
3  sweet peppers, chopped
2  or 3 cucumbers, cubed
1/3  c. coarse salt
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. mustard seed
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in a large kettle.  Cook for 10 minutes.   Stir occasionally.  Put in sterilized jars and seal.

name: DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour (1/2 pastry flour, if you have it)
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. lukewarm milk
1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. melted butter
confectioners sugar
Crisco
preparation: Sift.  Add egg, milk, sugar and butter.   Add dry ingredients and just enough flour so doesn't stick.  Chill.

name: CHICKEN PARMESAN
ingredients:
3  tsp. oil
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove chopped garlic
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, drained
1  Tbsp. tomato paste
1/8  tsp. oregano
1/8  tsp. basil
1/8  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  lb. boneless chicken breasts
2  Tbsp. seasoned dry bread crumbs
3  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
3  oz. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Saute onion  and  garlic  5 minutes or until soft.  Add tomatoes, breaking	up  with  fork,  oregano, salt, pepper and basil.  Simmer,  uncovered,  for  about  10  minutes  or until mixture is thick.  Preheat oven to 375°.

name: SPICED APPLE CIDER
ingredients:
1/2  gal. apple cider
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. whole cloves
1  whole nutmeg
2  c. orange juice
1/2  c. lemon juice
preparation: Stir apple cider and sugar together in Dutch oven.  Tie cloves and nutmeg in a cheesecloth. Add to the cider mixture.  Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Remove spice bag and add juices.  Simmer until heated.  May be served with cinnamon stick stirrers.

name: COCOA BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/3  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/4  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. flour
1/3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Soften margarine; combine in order listed.  Pour into greased and floured 8-inch square pan.  Can be frosted or nuts omitted.

name: HAMBURGER GOULASH
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
1 (No. 2)  can tomatoes
2  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
1  tsp. sugar
1  c. canned bouillon (beef)
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Brown meat and onion.  Add rice, tomatoes and other ingredients.  Stir to blend.  Cover and simmer until rice is tender.  Stir occasionally.  Cook about 45 minutes.  Bake at 350°.

name: SWISS ALMOND DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  c. grated Swiss, Cheddar and Mozzarella
1/3  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix and put in pie plate or quiche dish.  Cover with sliced almonds.  Cook at 350° for 20 minutes or bubbly.  Serve with Ritz or Town House crackers.

name: SUGAR COATED PEANUTS
ingredients:
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. water
2  c. raw shelled peanuts
preparation: Dissolve sugar in water in a saucepan over medium heat.  Add peanuts and continue to cook over heat, stirring frequently.  Cook until peanuts are completely sugared (coated and no syrup).  Pour on ungreased cookie sheet.  Separate peanuts with a fork.  Bake at 300° for approximately 30 minutes, turning the peanuts over at 10 minute intervals.

name: CHICKEN SPECTACULAR
ingredients:
3  c. cooked chicken, bite-sized pieces
1  can French-style green beans, drained
1  box long grain and wild rice
chicken broth
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1 small  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
2  Tbsp. chopped pimiento
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook rice in chicken broth after removing fat.  Mix together with other ingredients and place in a 2-quart casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: ALL-DAY MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
8  oz. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
4  c. (16 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese, divided
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Place the cooked macaroni in a 3 1/2-quart (or larger) slow cooker that has been coated with nonstick cooking spray. Reserve 1 cup of the cheese. Add the remaining cheese and the other ingredients to the macaroni. Mix well. Sprinkle with the remaining 1 cup cheese. Then cover and cook on a low setting for 5 to 6 hours or until the mixture is firm and golden around the edges. Do not remove the cover or stir until the mixture has finished cooking. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

name: FETTUCCINE ALFREDO
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter
2/3  c. heavy or whipping cream
1/2  tsp. each: salt, pepper and nutmeg
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. fresh chopped parsley
3/4  lb. fettuccine, cooked and drained
preparation: Placed butter in cream in heavy skillet and cook until butter is melted and bubbles. Stir in salt, pepper and nutmeg; remove from heat and stir in cheese. Reheat if necessary. Pour over fettuccine in pot; toss with 2 forks over low heat 2 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley. Serves 4.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  box elbow macaroni or shells
1  onion
1  or 2 stalks celery
2  or 3 hard-boiled eggs
mayonnaise
Salad Supreme seasoning
1 small  can shrimp
preparation: Cook macaroni, drain and cool.  Chop onion, celery, hard-cooked eggs and add to macaroni.  Drain shrimp and wash and add.  Mix with mayonnaise and Salad Supreme seasoning to taste.

name: CHEESEBURGER PIE NO. 1
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  stick margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. Bisquick mix
3  eggs
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2 tomatoes, sliced or 1 small  can tomatoes
preparation: Heat  oven  to	400°.  Grease  10-inch pie plate.  Brown beef and onions; drain.	Add butter.  Stir in salt and pepper. Spread in	plate.	Beat  milk,  baking mix and eggs smooth, 15 seconds on high speed.  Pour into plate.  Bake 25 minutes.  Top with tomatoes, sprinkle with cheese.  Bake until knife inserted in center  comes  out	clean, 5 to 8 minutes.	Cool 5 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: BROCCOLI, BACON AND MUSHROOM SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. broccoli florets
1/2  lb. bacon
1  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. lemon pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Steam broccoli until tender but still crunchy; cool.  Cook bacon until crisp.  Cool on paper towels and then crumble. Combine broccoli, bacon, and mushrooms in a large bowl.  In a small bowl combine remaining ingredients to make dressing.  Pour over the broccoli mixture.  Toss to combine. Chill for at least 30 minutes before serving.

name: PAM CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. cooked chicken fajita meat
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  c. crushed corn chips
1  c. shredded cheese
preparation: In casserole dish, mix all ingredients except the cheese. Mix well, then sprinkle with cheese. Bake about 20 minutes. Serve hot.

name: PRUNE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. Wesson oil
3  eggs
1  c. cooked prunes, chopped
1  tsp. each: cinnamon, allspice and nutmeg
1  c. nuts
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake about 1 hour at 300°.

name: CHRISTMAS SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. butter
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
4  tsp. milk
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Thoroughly cream butter, sugar and vanilla.  Add egg; beat until light and fluffy.  Stir in milk.  Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.  Blend into creamed mixture.   Divide and chill 1 hour.  On lightly floured surface, roll and cut into shapes with cookie cutters.  Bake at 375° for 5 to 8 minutes. Always double or triple this recipe because it only makes 2 dozen.

name: MIRACLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  bag Hershey's Kisses (optional)
preparation: Combine peanut butter and sugar; mix well.  Stir in egg and vanilla.  Roll dough in 3/4-inch balls.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Flatten with floured fork or press unwrapped Kiss in center.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Allow to cool before removing from cookie sheet.  Yields about 4 dozen.

name: JEFFERSON DAVIS PIE
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. half and half cream
4  eggs, slightly beaten
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. grated lemon peel
1/2  c. butter or oleo, melted
1  (9-inch) pie shell
preparation: In large bowl, blend sugar, flour and nutmeg.  Stir in cream; add eggs.  Mix well.  Add lemon juice, lemon peel and butter. Beat well.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake in preheated oven at 375° for 45 minutes or until center is almost firm.  It is very rich.

name: AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1  c. mandarin oranges, drained
1  c. pineapple tidbits, drained
1  c. flaked coconut
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Combine all ingredients and chill.

name: CHICKEN CRESCENT SQUARES
ingredients:
3  oz. cream cheese, softened
1 or 2 (5 oz.)  cans chicken
1  Tbsp. milk
3  Tbsp. butter
bread crumbs
1  roll crescent dinner rolls
preparation: Heat oven according to crescent roll package.  Mix cream cheese, 1 1/2 tablespoons butter and milk.  Add drained chicken and mix (salt and pepper to taste).  Unroll crescent rolls and break at perforations to form 4 squares (2 diamonds per square). Pinch perforations together.  Place chicken mixture on flattened roll.  Bring corners of rolls together; pinch to seal.  Melt remaining butter and drizzle over squares.  Sprinkle top with bread crumbs.  Bake as directed on crescent roll package (approximately 17 minutes).

name: CHEESE-HAM PIE
ingredients:
6  slices crisp bacon
1/2  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1 1/2  c. canned milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. diced ham
4  eggs
1  small, sliced onion
preparation: Mix all ingredients, then pour in unbaked pie shell.  Makes 2 (9-inch) pies.  Bake both pies at same time at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage (mild)
1  lb. mild Cheddar cheese, grated
4  c. Bisquick
enough water to mix batter
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and roll into balls.  Bake at 350° for about 25 minutes.

name: LEMONY CHEESE CAKE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  c. vanilla wafer crumbs
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine or butter
preparation: Combine vanilla wafer crumbs, sugar and margarine; mix well. Press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 375° for 8 minutes.  Cool.

name: CORN RELISH
ingredients:
18  ears corn, cut off
4  c. sugar
2  c. vinegar (white)
2  Tbsp. celery seed
1  large green pepper
1  large red pepper
4  medium onions
2  Tbsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. salt (to each 4 c. corn)
preparation: Mix all of the ingredients and bring to boil.  Cook 3 to 5 minutes.  Pack in clean, hot jars and seal.

name: ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
1  large orange jello (no water)
2  cans mandarin oranges, drained
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  can cottage cheese
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Stir all this together.  That's it!

name: APPLE CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can sliced apples
4  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. flour
1  lb. grated mild Cheddar cheese
preparation: Place apples in a buttered casserole dish.  Cream margarine, sugar and flour.  Add cheese.  Mix.  Spoon over apples.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Yields 8 to 10 servings.

name: SWEET POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
2 to 2 1/2  lb. sweet potatoes
1/4  c. butter
1/4 to 1/2  c. sugar (to taste)
1/4  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped nuts (walnuts or pecans)
1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Place potatoes and enough water to cover in a saucepan and cook until tender.  Cool slightly and peel.  In a large bowl, mash potatoes.  Stir in butter, sugar and raisins.  Place in a 2 qt. baking dish, and sprinkle with nuts and marshmallows.  Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or heated through and marshmallows brown.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
2 (12 oz.)  cans Shoe Peg corn, drained
1/4  tsp. salt
6  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
preparation: Saute onion in butter until tender.  Stir in flour and cook 1 minute over low heat, stirring constantly.  Gradually stir in sour cream, corn and salt; cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly until thoroughly heated (do not boil).  Stir in half the bacon; pour into a greased shallow 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle remaining bacon over top.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: REECE'S PEANUT BUTTER CANDY
ingredients:
2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. melted butter
2  pkg. graham crackers
preparation: Mix and pat into bacon or deli keeper.  Melt 12 ounce package chocolate chips and spread on top.  Cool in refrigerator.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked mashed sweet potatoes
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. milk
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Combine sweet potatoes, sugar, eggs, vanilla, milk and butter. Beat with mixer until smooth.   Spread into a greased 2-quart dish.

name: ZUCCHINI MARMALADE
ingredients:
6  c. peeled, shredded zucchini
5  c. sugar
1/2  oz. lemon juice
6  oz. crushed pineapple with juice
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. apricot jello
preparation: Place zucchini in small amount of water and cook for 6 minutes.  Add sugar, lemon juice and pineapple with juice and cook 6 more minutes.  Remove from heat and add the jello.  Stir until jello is dissolved.  Place in jars and freeze.

name: RIPE OLIVE CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
8  oz. cream cheese (not fat-free or light)
4  to 6  oz. Blue cheese
1/2  tsp. grated onions
1 (2.25 oz.)  can pitted ripe olives, drained and chopped
1  pkg. sliced almonds
preparation: Fits on salad size plate.  Blend softened butter, cheeses, onion and olives.  Shape in ball and roll in almonds. Refrigerate.  This also freezes well.  Serve with crackers.

name: PORK-CURRY POCKETS
ingredients:
2/3  c. sandwich spread
1/4  tsp. curry powder
1 1/2  c. finely chopped cooked pork or chicken
1/3  c. shredded carrot
1/4  c. coconut
2  Tbsp. finely chopped green pepper
2  large pita bread rounds, halved crosswise or 8 slices bread
preparation: In a small bowl, stir together the sandwich spread and curry powder.  Stir in the finely chopped pork or chicken, carrot, coconut and green pepper.  Mix well.  Spoon into pita halves or use bread to assemble into sandwiches.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE CLOUD FAT-FREE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. unsweetened cocoa powder
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
4  (2 1/2 oz.) baby food pureed prunes
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. nonfat milk
1  c. water
Fat-Free Chocolate Frosting (optional)
preparation: Sift together flour,  cocoa, sugar, baking soda, baking powder and salt into  mixing  bowl.  Stir	until blended.	Add prunes, vanilla, eggs and  milk  and  stir just until blended. Stir water into batter  until	blended.  Pour	batter	into  2 (9-inch) round cake pans  sprayed	with vegetable spray.  Bake at 350° 30 to 35 minutes, or until center tests done with wood pick.  Let cakes cool in  pans  10  minutes.  Invert onto wire rack to cool.  Frost if desired.

name: PEAR PIE
ingredients:
pear halves, pared and cored
unbaked pie crust
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter
4  Tbsp. flour
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Fill unbaked crust with pared and cored pear halves, cut side down and wheel designed.  Mix the remaining ingredients well and pour over pears.  Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: CURRIED SALAD SUCCOTASH
ingredients:
1 (12 or 16 oz.)  can whole kernel corn
1  medium onion, chopped (1/2 c.)
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
dash of cloves (optional)
1 (1 lb.)  can baby lima beans
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. diced pimento
1  Tbsp. curry powder
1  c. cider vinegar
preparation: Drain liquid from corn and beans into 2 cup measure.  Combine corn, beans, onion, celery, green pepper and pimento in a bowl. Combine 1/2 cup of the vegetable liquid, brown sugar, curry powder, celery seed, salt and vinegar in medium saucepan.  Heat, stirring constantly, to boiling.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Pour (or strain, if preferred) over vegetables.  Cool, then chill overnight.

name: CHUCK WAGON HAMBURGERS
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
2  slices dry bread
1  egg
2/3  c. water
1  medium onion
salt
pepper
dash of garlic salt
preparation: Crumble bread in bowl.  Add water and egg and mix until bread is moist.  Add hamburger, onion, salt and pepper to taste and a dash of garlic salt.  Mix and shape into patties.  Put on wax paper.  Stack and store until ready to cook.

name: BEEF AND BURGUNDY
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. stew beef, cut in bite-size pieces
1  can golden mushroom soup
1  can onion soup (not dry)
3/4  c. red wine
rice, cooked
preparation: Place all ingredients in large casserole.  Cover very tightly with foil and another cover.  Cook 3 1/2 hours in 350° oven.  Serve over rice.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: APPLESAUCE AND PEANUT BUTTER CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking soda
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
2 1/2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. applesauce
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cloves
3/4  c. melted butter
3  eggs
1  c. peanut butter
nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix well all of the ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Good moist cake.

name: CHOCOLATE EGG NOG
ingredients:
1  qt. egg nog
1/2  qt. chocolate milk
3/4 to 1  c. creme de cocoa
3  Tbsp. chocolate syrup
preparation: Mix together and garnish with whipped cream and chocolate shavings.

name: EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
3  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  (9-inch) deep-dish pie shell (unbaked)
preparation: Combine evaporated milk, eggs, sugar and vanilla, blending well.  Pour into pie shell and bake on bottom rack of oven at 400° for 35 minutes.  Yield:  One pie.

name: CHRISTMAS CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. water
3/4  c. sugar
2  c. cranberries
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  tart apple, diced
3/4  c. walnut meats, chopped fine
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cherry gelatin (dry)
preparation: Cook cranberries in water 10 minutes. Stir and add sugar and jello. Stir well. Cool slightly. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into bowl and refrigerate.

name: BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
2  c. water
1  lb. frozen broccoli
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. melted margarine or butter
1/2  c. plain flour
6  c. milk
4  chicken bouillon cubes
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Boil  water.  Add  broccoli,  cover  and  reduce  heat. Simmer 5 minutes.	Remove from heat.  Saute onion in margarine or	butter until  tender.  Add  flour,  stirring  constantly. Gradually  add milk  and	bouillon.  Cook  over  medium heat, stirring constantly.

name: SALMON CROQUETTES
ingredients:
1  can salmon
2  small potatoes, cooked and mashed
1  egg
salt and pepper
corn meal
flour
preparation: Stir potatoes and salmon together.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Mix together with flour and corn meal until thick.  Drop by tablespoons into hot greased frying pan.

name: SAUSAGE CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  lb sausage
1  large onion chopped
2  eggs beaten
1 1/2  c. self rising cornmeal
1 (17 oz)  can cream corn
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. oil
8  oz shredded sharp cheddar cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Grease 10 inch skillet.  Brown sausage and onion; drain.  Combine eggs, cornmeal, corn, milk and oil.  Pour one half batter into pan; sprinkle with sausage and onion.  Add cheese.  Pour remaining batter over top.  Bake for 30 40 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

name: FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/3  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. milk
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. butter, melted
fresh or canned fruit, sweetened
preparation: Sift dry ingredients; add milk, egg and fat.  Mix lightly. Arrange fruit in bottom of baking dish.  Spread with butter.  Bake in moderately hot oven (400°) until brown.  Serve with vanilla, lemon or fruit sauce or cream.

name: SPAETZLE DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
3  eggs
1  c. water
1  tsp. salt
preparation: In a medium bowl mix all ingredients together.  Prepare a firm dough.  Beat until it comes easily away from the sides of the bowl.  With a spoon press the dough through a dumpling sifter into salted boiling water.  Cook 10 to 15 minutes.  Skim them out and dip in cold water.  Spaetzle dumplings can be also browned lightly in butter before serving and they are my favorite accompaniment to meat with sauce.

name: BROCCOLI WITH CHEESE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen broccoli spears
1  c. grated cheese
1  stick oleo
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. mushroom soup
2  eggs, beaten
1  medium onion, chopped
preparation: Cook and drain broccoli.  Blend all ingredients in large bowl. Fold in broccoli; pour in baking dish.  Cover with cracker crumbs.  Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 325°.

name: MINT TEA
ingredients:
14  sprigs fresh mint
1 1/2 to 2  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
6  oz. fresh lemon juice
preparation: Boil all for 5 minutes.  Toss out mint.  Mix into pitcher of iced tea to taste.

name: PARTY HAM SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  can deviled ham (or leftover ground up ham)
1/4  c. finely chopped celery
1/4  c. finely chopped dill pickle
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise or salad dressing
4  slices white bread
4  slices rye bread
1  (4 oz.) container whipped cream cheese
snipped parsley
pimento strips
preparation: Combine ham, celery, dill pickle and mayonnaise or salad dressing.  Cover and chill.  Remove crusts from bread (if desired).  Spread white bread slices with ham mixture; top with rye bread slices.  Frost tops with cream cheese.  Cut each sandwich diagonally into quarters.  Decorate sandwiches with parsley or pimiento.  Makes 16 sandwiches.

name: PORTABELLO PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
4  portabello mushroom caps
1  c. balsamic vinegar
1/2  c. olive oil
1/2  c. feta cheese or freshly grated parmesan
Fresh ground pepper
1  lb. ziti or penne pasta
preparation: Marinate washed and patted dry mushrooms in balsamic vinegar for about an hour. While cooking pasta, grill mushrooms.  Drain pasta and mix with olive oil, cheese, pepper, and chopped mushrooms.

name: STICKY BUNS
ingredients:
18  frozen dough balls
1  stick margarine
1/2 to 1  pkg. butterscotch pudding (not instant)
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Using greased Bundt pan, plunk dough balls into pan night before. Sprinkle rolls with pudding and cinnamon. Melt margarine and stir in brown sugar and nuts. Pour this mixture over rolls and cover pan with foil.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1  large bag small marshmallows
1  box pistachio jello
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  large bowl Cool Whip
pecans (if desired)
preparation: Mix all together and chill.

name: FAYE'S HAMBURGER SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
2  cans tomatoes and 2 cans water
1  can tomato sauce
2  or 3 beef bouillon cubes
1  medium onion, chopped
4  carrots, thinly sliced
1  c. coarsely chopped cabbage
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Crumble hamburger and brown.  Drain.  Add tomatoes (chopped up), tomato sauce, bouillon and onions.  Simmer 1 hour.  Add carrots and cabbage; continue cooking until tender.  Do not overcook vegetables.

name: TURKEY SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1  lb. ground turkey
1 (1 lb.)  can crushed tomatoes
1 (3 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 1/4  c. water
1  1/2 garlic cloves, minced
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. crushed basil
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/4  c. chopped onion (optional)
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Heat olive oil; add turkey, but do not brown.  Stir in the rest of the ingredients, except cheese.  Mix well.  Bring to a boil and simmer for 1 hour.  Serve over pasta, rice or mashed potatoes.  Top with Parmesan cheese.  Yield: 4 servings.

name: CHICKEN CACCIATORE
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2 1/2 to 3  lb. chicken
1/4  c. oil
16  oz. tomatoes
8  oz. tomato sauce
1  c. mushrooms
1/4  c. water
1  medium onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  bay leaf
preparation: Mix flour with 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.  Coat chicken with flour mixture.  Heat oil and cook chicken over medium heat until brown, 15 minutes.  Drain.  Mix tomatoes, tomato sauce, mushrooms, water, onion, garlic, 1 teaspoon salt, oregano, 1/4 teaspoon pepper and bay leaf.  Break up tomatoes; pour over chicken.  Heat to boiling; reduce heat.  Cover and simmer about 30 minutes; serve with spaghetti.

name: RED NEW POTATOES WITH MUSTARD DRESSING
ingredients:
1/3  c. red wine vinegar
3  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
1  c. extra-virgin olive oil
2  lb. small, red, new potatoes
3  scallions, thinly sliced
1/2  c. parsley (whole flat-leaf)
preparation: Cook potatoes in boiling, salted water about 20 minutes. Drain; cool and cut into quarters.  Place potatoes in a large bowl.  Pour the dressing over the potatoes.  Season with salt and pepper.  Toss carefully, using a large rubber spatula. Sprinkle with scallions and parsley.  Toss to combine.  Be sure to cover the potatoes with plenty of dressing as the potatoes absorb it quickly.

name: OVEN FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
6  slices bread
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Dip bread slices and place on greased baking sheet.  Bake in hot oven at 500° for 10 minutes or until browned.

name: VEGGIE PIZZA
ingredients: 2  cans crescent rolls
preparation: Roll out on cookie sheet and bake at 375° for approximately 20 minutes.

name: SWISS VEGETABLE MEDLEY
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
1/3  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  (16 oz.) bag frozen farm fresh mixtures (broccoli, cauliflower, red pepper, onions, mushrooms), thawed and drained
1 1/3  c. (2.8 oz. can) French fried onions, divided
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese, divided
preparation: In a 2-quart shallow baking dish, combine soup, sour cream and pepper; stir until well blended.  Add vegetables, 2/3 cup French fried onions and 1/2 cup cheese.  Mix well; cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through and vegetables are tender.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese and onions.  Bake 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown.

name: SWEET AND SOUR SAUCE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. honey
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Heat until flavors are blended.  Yield:  2/3 cup.

name: POPPY SEED CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. poppy seed
3/4  c. milk
3/4  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
2 1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
4  egg whites
preparation: Soak poppy seed in milk overnight.  Cream butter, sugar and poppy seed mixture.  Sift dry ingredients, then add to creamed mixture.

name: SNOWBALLS
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
preparation: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients, stirring until mixture forms a sticky dough.  In a deep skillet, heat 1-inch of cooking oil to 375°.  Drop batter by teaspoonfuls a few at a time into hot oil.  Fry until browned.  Drain on paper toweling.  Roll in confectioners sugar.

name: SEVEN LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. shredded lettuce
2  c. mushroom slices
1 1/2  c. red onion rings
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  bacon strips, cooked and crumbled
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In 2 1/2-quart salad bowl, layer lettuce, mushrooms, onions and peas.  Combine mayonnaise, sugar and lemon juice.  Spread over salad to seal.  Cover; refrigerate overnight.  Top with bacon and cheese before serving.

name: PATRA'S CHOCOLATE TORTE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
4  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  lb. butter, melted
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
4  Tbsp. sugar
6  Tbsp. water
6  egg yolks
6  egg whites, beaten
1 (12 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients together; pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  (Reserve about 1/2 cup for topping.)  Melt chips in microwave.  Add sugar and water.  Stir in egg yolks.  Let cool. Beat egg whites until stiff; add to cooled mixture.  Add whipped cream to mixture; fold all together.  Pour over crust; sprinkle with remaining crumbs.

name: MADRAS CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  garlic clove, minced
1  Tbsp. butter
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can whole tomatoes, drained
1/2  tsp. dried thyme leaves
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese spread, cubed
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 to 2  tsp. curry powder
4  boneless chicken breasts (1-inch cubes)
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/8  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Cook and stir bell pepper, onion, garlic and curry powder until vegetables are crisp and tender.  Add chicken; cook and stir 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.  Stir in tomatoes, juice, thyme and black pepper.  Reduce heat to low; simmer 5 minutes.  Add Velveeta spread.  Stir until melted.  Serve over cooked rice, if desired.  Makes 4 servings.

name: PASTA WITH SAUSAGE AND SUN-DRIED TOMATOES
ingredients:
6  oz. dry pasta (flat or spiral; whole wheat pasta is very good with this recipe)
1/2  lb. sweet or hot Italian sausage (use turkey sausage, much better for you)
3  oz. sun-dried tomatoes
1  c. chopped fresh basil leaves
3  garlic cloves, diced fine
1/4  c. freshly grated Parmesan cheese
good olive oil
preparation: First:  Cook sausage in microwave (6 minutes on High) or by steaming in a covered pan over medium-low heat until cooked.  Cut sausage into small, bite-sized pieces.  Reserve.

name: BETTER THAN SEX CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
2  c. sugar
3  to 4 bananas
1 1/2  c. coconut
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. soft cream cheese
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix cake according to directions, using milk instead of water. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Remove from oven.  Poke holes with large fork in cake.  Heat pineapple and sugar to just boiling. Pour into cake, let cool.  Mix pudding according to directions. Blend in cream cheese.  Spread this mixture on cake.  Refrigerate until set.  Slice 3 to 4 bananas on top of pudding.  Cover with Cool Whip.  Sprinkle with coconut and chopped pecans.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH PIE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. milk
2  egg yolks
1/3  c. flour
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Mix ingredients together and place in ready made pie crust.

name: LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1  can (small size) lemon concentrate (lemonade)
16  oz. Cool Whip
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
2  graham pie shells
preparation: Mix well the lemon concentrate, Cool Whip and Eagle Brand condensed milk.  Pour into 2 graham pie shells.  Chill several hours or overnight.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: SWEET AND SOUR MARINADE
ingredients:
1/2 to 2/3  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Stir until sugar dissolves.  Pour over desired vegetables (chopped).  Cover and chill 8 hours. Drain before serving.  Yields about 1 2/3 cups.

name: SHRIMP MOLD
ingredients:
2  cans shrimp (6 oz. each)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can tomato soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. finely chopped onions and green onions
1  c. finely chopped celery
2  packets Knox gelatine
red pepper to taste
Worcestershire sauce to taste
preparation: Drain and mash shrimp with a fork.  In a double boiler, cream tomato soup and cream cheese.  In a large bowl, mix celery, onions, shrimp and mayonnaise.  Mix well.  Add soup mixture.  Add 2 or 3 dashes Worcestershire sauce and red pepper to taste.  Stir well.  Pour into well-greased mold and chill for 3 to 4 hours (preferably overnight).  Serve with crackers.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (15 oz.)  can blueberry pie filling
1  stick melted margarine
1  yellow cake mix (dry)
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Spray a 13 x 9-inch pan with Pam.  Dump pineapple in pan and spread evenly.  Dump blueberry pie filling evenly on top of the pineapple.  Sprinkle dry cake mix on this.  Sprinkle on pecans. Drizzle melted margarine over the top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: LEMON SQUARES
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines lemon yellow cake mix
1  egg
1  stick margarine, melted
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  box 10x sugar
preparation: Mix cake mix, egg and margarine and press into loaf pan or casserole dish.  Mix with mixer, cream cheese, 2 eggs, vanilla and box of sugar until well blended.  Spread over cake mixture.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Be sure to cool before slicing.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
3  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
2/3  c. water
2  c. pumpkin (1 can)
1  c. oil
4  eggs
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Mix dry ingredients in mixing bowl (flour, sugar, salt, soda, cinnamon and nutmeg).  Add water, pumpkin, oil, eggs and nuts. Stir until mixed smooth.  Divide into 3 greased and floured loaf pans.  Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350°.

name: CHOCOLATE MERINGUE PIE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. sugar
??? Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2 1/2  c. evaporated milk
3  egg yolks, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
3  egg whites
6  Tbsp. sugar
1  baked 9-inch pie shell
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Combine cocoa, 1 cup sugar, flour, salt and milk in double boiler.  Cook until thickened.  Stir while cooking.  Stir in beaten egg yolks.  Cook 2 minutes and add butter and vanilla. Cool.  Pour into baked pie shell.  Beat the egg whites with cream of tartar until foamy.  Add 6 tablespoons sugar, 2 tablespoons at a time, beating until mixture stands in peaks.  Spread on pie. Bake in oven at 300° for 20 minutes or until brown.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2  cans cream-style corn
2  eggs
4  Tbsp. grated onion
1/2  c. milk
3/4 to 1  c. bread crumbs
butter
preparation: Can be assembled in pan in which it is to be baked.  Grease 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.  Break in eggs and beat with fork.  Add milk and stir until blended.  Stir in corn; scrape onion into mixture and stir until smooth.  Sprinkle bread crumbs over top and dot with butter.  Bake in 350° oven for approximately 30 minutes.

name: HOMINY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. hominy
1  c. mushroom soup
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
corn flake crumbs
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix hominy, soup, Worcestershire sauce and salt.  Pour into buttered casserole and sprinkle with corn flake crumbs and butter. Bake at 300° until brown.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
3  medium onions
4  to 5 stalks celery
1  lb. ground beef
1  can tomato soup
1/2  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1/2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  tsp. chili powder
1  bell pepper
3  Tbsp. oil
1  can tomatoes
1/2  can water
preparation: Chop onions, bell pepper and celery.  Cook these in oil for 2 to 3 minutes.  Add meat and cook until meat crumbles.   Add all remaining ingredients and cook on low heat for 1 hour.  If chili is too thick, add a little more water.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: NACHO DIP
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
1  small onion, chopped
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1 (4 oz.)  can tomatoes, chopped and drained
3/4  lb. Velveeta cheese
2  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Saute onion in butter. Add ground beef and brown.  Drain well. Combine meat mixture with remaining ingredients in a crock-pot. Heat until cheeses melt.  Serve with corn chips.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. plain flour
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1  large Cool Whip
2 small  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
preparation: Crust:  Mix flour, melted margarine and pecans together.  Press into long baking dish (9 x 13-inch) and bake 25 minutes at 350°. Cool.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. cherry Jell-O
2  c. boiling water
1  can whole cranberry sauce
1  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. nuts (pecans are good or shelled, fresh walnuts)
1/2  pt. sour cream
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; add cranberry sauce.  Chill until syrupy.  Add nuts and celery.  Stir in sour cream.  Chill at least 4 hours in a mold.

name: PUMPKIN CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. cooking oil
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. pumpkin
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix eggs and sugar; beat well.  Add oil, flour, spices, soda and salt; beat well.  Add pumpkin.  Bake in a well-greased tube pan at 350° for 1 hour.

name: LACHSSTEAKS MIT ZITRONENSCHAUM(Salmon Steaks with Foaming Lemon Sauce)
ingredients:
4  salmon steaks (7 oz. each)
salt
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
4  tsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Rinse the fish under cold running water if necessary, pat dry and season with salt.  Heat the oil in a pan and add the butter or margarine.  When the butter or margarine has melted, fry the salmon steaks on each side.  Place in a warmed dish and keep warm.

name: CHICKEN TORTILLA SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  c. onion, finely chopped
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
2  Tbsp. plus 1/2 c. oil
4  c. chicken broth
1/4  c. red bell pepper, finely chopped
1  tsp. ground red chilies
3/4  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
15  oz. tomato puree
10  corn tortillas, in 1/2 in. squares
2  c. cooked chicken
preparation: Cook onion and garlic in 2 Tbsp. oil until tender.  Stir in broth, bell pepper, chilies, basil, salt, pepper, and puree.  Heat to boiling, reduce heat and summer, uncovered, for 30 min.  Heat 1/2 c. oil in skillet and cook tortilla squares and chicken into 6 bowls and pour soup over.  Top with shredded cheese, if desired.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. salt
2  c. ripe mashed bananas
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. butter, melted
1/2  c. milk
2 2/3  c. chopped nuts
2  c. butterscotch morsels
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In small bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt.  Set aside.  In large bowl, combine bananas, sugar, eggs and butter.  Beat until creamy.  Gradually add flour mixture alternately with milk; mix until well blended.  Stir in 2 cups chopped nuts and butterscotch flavored morsels.  Pour batter equally into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.  Sprinkle tops equally with remaining 2/3 cup chopped nuts.

name: BARBECUE MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
3  lb. ground beef
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1  c. oatmeal
1  c. cracker crumbs
2  eggs
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  c. ketchup
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. liquid smoke
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  c. chopped onion
preparation: To make meatballs, combine all ingredients (mixture will be soft) and shape into walnut size balls.  Place meatballs in a single layer on wax paper-lined cookie sheets; freeze until solid. Store frozen meatballs in freezer bags, until ready to cook.  To make sauce, combine all ingredients and stir until sugar is dissolved.  Place frozen meatballs in a 13 x 9-inch pan; pour on sauce.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Yields 80 meatballs.

name: WHITE VELVET CUT OUT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. margarine or butter
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  c. sugar
2  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
4 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cream together cream cheese and sugar. Add sugar and egg yolks, mixing well.  Add remaining ingredients; mix well.  Chill 1 hour.  Roll out on lightly floured board or linen tea towel.  Do not roll too thin.  Place on greased cookie sheet; bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Be careful not to overbake.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  tsp. oregano
water (as needed)
1 small  can chopped chilies
1  can Ranch Style beans
1  diced onion
1  tsp. cumin
1  can tomato sauce and bits
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  can chili
1  can Ranch Style Spanish rice
preparation: Brown the hamburger meat.  Add the remaining ingredients. Simmer until cooked well.  Pour over corn chips; top with grated cheese.  Bake until cheese melts and all is hot.

name: BURGER DOGS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
2  tsp. mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Roll into shape of hot dog and wrap a slice of bacon around each one.  Broil 3 inches from heat until cooked.  Serve on a hot dog bun.

name: HOMEMADE VEGETABLE SOUP(Or Just Good Stew Beef)
ingredients:
2  lb. lean chuck roast
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. sugar
salt and pepper to taste
boiling water
preparation: Note:  This is to be cooked in pressure cooker, 2, 4 or 6-quart size.

name: COCONUT SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  sticks butter
3  c. sugar
3  c. plain flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. soda
6  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. frozen coconut
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs one at a time.  Sift dry ingredients.  Add alternately with sour cream.  Add vanilla.  Add coconut.  Bake in tube pan at 300° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: POSOLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. posole
1 1/2  lb. chili meat
1  small onion
salt
garlic salt
preparation: Wash  and  clean posole; put to boil in large pot.  Add meat, onion, salt and garlic salt.  Boil until tender, about 6 to 7 hours.

name: LEMON BREAD
ingredients:
1  box lemon cake mix
1 small  pkg. lemon instant pudding
4  eggs
1  c. water
1/2  c. oil
1/4  c. poppy seed
preparation: Mix together and bake in 2 loaf pans at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Mix 3/4 cup powdered sugar with a little lemon juice and drizzle over bread.

name: PAY DAY CANDY
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. honey
1/2  c. peanut butter
3  c. Cheerios
1  c. peanuts
preparation: Combine and bring to a boil the sugar and honey.  Add peanut butter.  Mix and pour over   Cheerios and nuts.  Stir together. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cool before cutting.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. milk
1  c. flour
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
1 1/2  c. boiling water
preparation: Cream 3/4 cup sugar with 2 tablespoons butter.  Stir in milk. Sift flour, 2 tablespoons cocoa, baking powder and salt together. Add sifted ingredients to the creamed mixture and mix until smooth.  Add chopped walnuts and spread in a buttered 9-inch pan. Mix well 1/2 cup sugar, brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa.  Sprinkle over the batter.  Pour boiling water over the top and bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: CORN FRITTERS
ingredients:
Crisco shortening (for frying)
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs, well beaten
1/2  c. milk
2  tsp. Crisco, melted
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen whole kernel corn, thawed and chopped
syrup
preparation: Heat 2 to 3 inches of Crisco in deep fryer or deep saucepan. Combine flour, baking powder, sugar and salt in large bowl. Combine eggs, milk and 2 teaspoons melted shortening in medium bowl.  Stir in corn.  Add to flour mixture.  Stir until moistened. Drop by tablespoon, a few at a time, in hot shortening heated to 365°.  Fry 3 to 4 minutes or until golden brown.  Turn as needed. Drain on paper towels.  Serve warm with syrup.  Makes 8 servings.

name: BREAKFAST PIZZA
ingredients:
10  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. dry mustard
black pepper to taste
1/2  c. milk
2  tubes crescent rolls
1  lb. ground sausage, browned or any preferred meat
hash browns (any flavor)
shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Note:  You can substitute any meat, cheese or potatoes to your taste.

name: FRESH SALSA
ingredients:
2  tomatoes
1  large onion
3  fresh jalapeno peppers
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. ground coriander
1  Tbsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Chop tomatoes, onions and peppers fine.  Add garlic, coriander, parsley, salt and vinegar.  Stir and chill in covered dish.

name: MOLDED SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup
1  envelope Knox gelatine
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. finely chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  cans small shrimp
preparation: Heat soup.  Stir in gelatine.  Add softened cream cheese. Beat with beater until smooth.  Add other ingredients except shrimp.  Add shrimp last.  Pour into mold.

name: EASY PUNCH
ingredients:
2  cans Hawaiian Punch (red)
1  (2 liter) 7-Up or Sprite
1  qt. rainbow sherbet
preparation: Mix cold cans of punch with 7-Up and stir, then when ready to serve, add the sherbet.

name: CHOCOLATE AMARETTO CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
6  chocolate wafers, finely crushed
1 1/2  c. light cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1  c. 1% low-fat cottage cheese
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. unsweetened cocoa
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. Amaretto
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/4  tsp. salt
1  egg
2  Tbsp. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
chocolate curls (optional)
preparation: Sprinkle chocolate wafer crumbs in bottom of a 7-inch spring-form pan.  Set aside.  Position knife blade in food processor in bowl.  Add cream cheese and next 7 ingredients; process until smooth.  Add egg; process until blended.  Fold in chocolate morsels.  Slowly pour mixture over crumbs in pan.  Bake at 300° for 65 to 70 minutes, or until cheesecake is set.  Let cool in pan on wire rack.  Cover and let chill at least 8 hours. Remove sides of pan and transfer cake to a platter.  Garnish with chocolate curls.

name: HOT BUTTER SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
3/4  c. light cream
sugar
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan over medium heat.  Brown slightly. Add sugar and cream, mixing well.  Cook 3 to 4 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Serve immediately or reheat to serve later.  Yield: Sauce for 8 to 9-inch square cake.

name: JUNE'S SAUCY SANDWICH ROLLS
ingredients:
12  hot dog buns
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1/4  c. flour
dash of pepper
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. grated cheese
1  lb. wieners, chopped
3  Tbsp. hot bacon fat
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  c. water
1  c. chopped celery
preparation: Brown wieners and onions in fat.  Take from heat; blend in remaining ingredients except cheese.  Cook until center is tender, about 5 minutes.  Add cheese and heat until cheese melts; remove from heat.  Split buns and fill with mixture.   Wrap each in foil; heat in 350° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: SOUR CREAM COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
3  eggs
1  c. water
1/3  c. Crisco oil
12  oz. fresh frozen coconut
1 1/4  c. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
preparation: Mix cake  mix,	eggs,  water and oil.  Pour into 3 cake pans. Bake  at 350° for 15 minutes or until done.  While cake is cooking,  mix  the	sour  cream,  sugar  and coconut with a spoon. Frost while cake is still hot.

name: THUMB COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. unsalted fat
1/4  c. white sugar
1  egg yolk, unbeaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. lemon extract
1  c. all-purpose flour
raspberry jam
preparation: Cream vanilla and lemon extract into the fat; add sugar gradually.  Beat eggs into the mixture thoroughly.  Put flour in all at once.  Stir to a thick dough.  Shape the dough into small balls, using about 1 teaspoon of the mixture each time. Put on an ungreased cookie sheet.  Make a dent in each ball with your floured thumb.  Place a small amount of raspberry jam in each dent.  Bake cookies about 15 minutes at 400°.  Makes about 24 cookies.

name: PIKELETS
ingredients:
1  egg
1/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  oz. butter, melted
preparation: Mix egg and sugar until thick.  Add with milk to sifted flour, baking powder, and salt.  Lastly add melted butter.  Mix until smooth.  Drop by spoonful onto hot greased pan.  Fry like mini-pancakes.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. shredded zucchini
3  eggs
1  c. pecans
3  c. flour
1  c. oil
2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Beat eggs, sugar, salt, baking soda, cinnamon, vanilla, zucchini and oil.  Add flour and nuts.  Pour into greased bread pans. Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: CHICKEN CAROLINA
ingredients:
1  c. Pepperidge Farm dressing (dry)
1  cut up chicken
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
1  c. dressing
3  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  c. chicken broth
preparation: In a buttered casserole put first 4 ingredients, then pour dressing, butter and chicken broth over (don't mix).  Spread over the top.  Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CHARLOTTE RUSSE
ingredients:
1  envelope Knox gelatine
2  egg yolks
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  small container Cool Whip
preparation: Make a custard of the egg yolks, sugar and milk.  Soften gelatine in 1/4 cup water and dissolve in hot custard as it is removed from stove.  Chill and, when mixture is just about set, fold in Cool Whip.  Return to fridge.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
6  c. stale French bread
4  eggs
1  qt. milk, scalded
1/2  c. butter, melted
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. bourbon
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped pecans
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Soak the bread which has been broken into small pieces in the milk.  Cream well the butter and sugar and add the eggs, one at a time.  Stir in the vanilla, raisins, pecans and bourbon.  Mix with soaked bread.

name: BEEF 'N CHEESE FILLING(For Mexican Pizza)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
8  oz. can tomato sauce
1  c. shredded Monterey Jack or American cheese
preparation: In a large frying pan, lightly brown ground beef with onion; drain.  Stir in remaining ingredients; simmer one minute.  Spoon over crust.  Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes until filling is hot and bubbly.

name: MA BEA'S PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. white sugar
1  c. salad oil
3  eggs
2  c. pumpkin
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Beat liquid ingredients together, then add the dry ingredients.  You can add chopped nuts, chopped dates or raisins. This makes one large loaf or 3 small ones.  Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 325°.

name: LAYERED MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1 large  can refried beans
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. sour cream
1  c. picante sauce or salsa
2  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Cook ground beef until browned (season as you like).  Layer ingredients in order listed in large casserole dish.  Melt cheese on top, if desired.  Serve with Doritos or Tostitos corn chips.

name: HOLIDAY DELIGHT CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. Healthy Choice fat free cream cheese, softened
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. Healthy Choice cholesterol-free egg product
1 (8 oz.)  carton nonfat lemon yogurt
Reddi Whip lite topping
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar and margarine, mix well.  Pat onto bottom of 9-inch or 10-inch spring-form pan.  Set aside.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. shortening
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
4  tsp. milk
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together shortening and sugar.  Add vanilla; beat in egg and milk.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Bake at 375° on lightly greased cookie sheet for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. cooked, chunked chicken
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. salt
2  c. chopped celery
4  sliced hard-boiled eggs
3/4  c. cream of chicken soup
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1 small  jar chopped pimento
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2/3  c. chopped walnuts
1 1/2  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Refrigerate overnight or 4 to 5 hours.  Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

name: OLD FASHIONED POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  lb. of butter (3 sticks)
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
4  c. all-purpose flour (add 1/2 c. if using cake flour)
3/4  c. milk
1-1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter; slowly add sugar, beating well at medium speed with electric mixer.  Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition.  Add flour to creamed mixture alternately with milk, ending with flour.  Mix until well blended.  Fold in flavoring.

name: SWEET POTATO CROQUETTES
ingredients:
2  c. mashed boiled sweet potatoes
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg, well beaten
1/4  c. raisins or 3/4 c. chopped nuts or 1/4 c. raisins plus 1/2 c. chopped pecans
flour
bread crumbs
vegetable oil
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except flour, bread crumbs and oil. Shape mixture into rolls measuring approximately 1 x 2. Roll in flour, then in bread crumbs. Fry in very hot oil until brown. Drain on paper towels.

name: TANGY STUFFED PEPPER SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. shredded cabbage
1  c. diced fully cooked ham or cooked beef
1/2  c. coarsely shredded carrot
1/4  c. sliced radish
1/4  c. chopped cucumber
1 (8 oz.)  carton plain yogurt
2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. onion salt
dash of pepper
2  large green peppers
preparation: In a bowl combine shredded cabbage, cooked meat, carrot, radish and cucumber.  Combine next 7 ingredients; mix well.   Pour over vegetable mixture, tossing to coat.  Cover and chill at least 1 hour.  Remove tops from green peppers.  Cut peppers in half lengthwise and remove seeds.  Spoon vegetable mixture into pepper cups.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CORN DOGS
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. melted shortening
2  eggs
1  c. milk
2  lb. hot dogs
grease for frying
preparation: Sift dry ingredients.  Blend shortening with eggs, then add milk.  Mix well.  Add to dry ingredients.  Now you're ready to dip hot dogs in batter.  Have your pan ready with grease to float hot dog (350°).  Done when they come back to top.

name: BURGER BALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger meat
2  eggs
2  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Mix ingredients together; roll into balls. Fry in hot grease until done. Remove and drain.

name: HOLIDAY GARLIC OLIVES
ingredients:
2 (7 1/2 oz.)  jars large or jumbo, pitted, ripe olives (undrained)
1 1/2  tsp. chili powder
2 large  cloves garlic, crushed
2  bay leaves, crumbled
1/4  c. virgin olive oil
1/2  tsp. whole black pepper
1  small onion, sliced
1 (4 oz.)  jar pimientos, drained and chopped
preparation: Drain olives; save liquid.  In small saucepan, combine 1 cup olive liquid, chili powder, garlic, bay leaves, olive oil, pepper and onion.  Heat to boiling.  Reduce heat; simmer 5 minutes, uncovered.  Stir in pimientos.  Place olives in a large jar; pour seasoning mixture over.  Cover.  Refrigerate.  Make at least 3 to 4 days prior to serving.  Makes about 3 cups.

name: GRATIN DAUPHINOIS(Dauphine-style Potato Gratin)
ingredients:
1  clove garlic
3/4  c. (200 m.) milk
6  tsp. heavy cream
1  lb. (500 g) boiling potatoes
salt and freshly ground pepper
4  pinches freshly grated nutmeg
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190° C).  Peel the garlic and crush in a garlic press into a large saucepan.  Add the milk and cream and bring to boil over low heat.  Add salt, pepper and nutmeg. Meanwhile, peel the potatoes, wash them and pat dry.  Using the shredder attachment of a food processor, slice them very thinly. Butter a 10 x 7-inch baking dish.  Add the potatoes and pour the mixture on them.  Smooth the surface with a wooden spoon.  Bake until golden brown, about 50 minutes.  Serve hot from the baking dish.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: CREAM CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  jar dried roast beef, shredded or chopped
1  Tbsp. Accent seasoning
4  to 5 green onions, chopped
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Combine first five ingredients until evenly mixed.  Shape into ball and roll in chopped pecans.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  can cherry pie filling
1  yellow cake mix
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  stick oleo
preparation: Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Pour in undrained pineapple; even out.  Dump in cherry pie filling; even out.  Sprinkle on dry cake mix.  Cut oleo in patties and place on top.  Sprinkle on nuts. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
yellow cake mix
1  can crushed pineapple (including juice)
3  or 4 bananas
3  cans vanilla pudding
2  pkg. strawberries
Cool Whip
maraschino cherries
nuts
preparation: Bake cake as directed in two 8-inch round cake pans.  Place one layer in the bottom of a punch bowl.  Add pineapple.  Layer with bananas (sliced), 1 1/2 cans vanilla pudding and 1 layer Cool Whip.  Add the other layer of cake.  Layer with strawberries, 1 1/2 cans vanilla pudding and Cool Whip.  Cover with maraschino cherries and nuts.

name: DILL SAUCED MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. Italian bread crumbs
1/2  c. dill pickle juice
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. chopped dill pickle
1/2  c. catsup
1/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix ground beef, onion, bread crumbs, dill juice, egg, salt and pepper until well blended.  Shape into loaf in shallow pan. Combine dill pickle, catsup, water, sugar and Worcestershire sauce.  Pour over loaf and bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350°, basting two or three times.  Serves 6.

name: CHEERY CHERRY CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) softened cream cheese
1  (14 oz.) sweetened condensed milk
1/3  c. ReaLemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  graham cracker crust
cherry pie filling
preparation: In a medium bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.  Add milk and blend thoroughly.  Stir in lemon juice and vanilla.  Pour cheese mixture into a prepared graham cracker crust.  Chill 3 hours or until set. Top with desired amount of pie filling before serving.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: STRAWBERRY PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. broken pretzels
1 1/2  sticks melted butter
1  c. sugar
1 large (16 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
2  c. boiling water
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
1 large (16 oz.)  box strawberries, thawed
preparation: Spread broken pretzels evenly in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour melted butter over pretzels and bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Cool.

name: RAMEN NOODLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  large celery cabbage, sliced thin
1  bunch green onions (use the whole onion for color)
2  bags Ramen noodles, crushed in bag
1  small bag blanched almonds
2  Tbsp. sesame seed
1/2  stick oleo
1/2  c. cooking oil
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Melt oleo.  Brown, watch and stir; burns easily.  Add the oil, sugar, vinegar and soy sauce.  Cool.  Mix 20 minutes before eating.

name: CANDIED APPLES
ingredients:
1  tsp. butter
3/4  c. golden King syrup
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. cold water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Boil constantly until mixture thickens. Test in cold water.  When mixture tests brittle, add red food coloring.  Turn to low heat and dip apples.

name: FROSTY STRAWBERRY SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. melted margarine
2  egg whites
2/3  c. sugar
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, partially thawed
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. heavy cream, whipped
preparation: Sift together first 4 ingredients; spread evenly in shallow baking pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle 2/3 of the crumbs in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Combine egg whites, sugar, berries and lemon juice in a large bowl; with electric beater, beat at high speed to stiff peaks, about 10 minutes.  Fold in whipped cream.  Spoon over crumbs; top with remaining crumbs.  Freeze at least 6 hours or overnight.

name: CRABMEAT DIP
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  Tbsp. unflavored gelatin softened in 3 Tbsp. water
6  oz. cream cheese
2  green onions, finely chopped
8  oz. fresh crab meat
1  c. finely chopped celery
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: In a saucepan, heat undiluted cream of mushroom soup until hot.  Remove from heat and add gelatin and water mixture.  Allow to cool slightly.  Mix softened cream cheese and mayonnaise well and add to saucepan.  Combine the remaining ingredients and pour into greased mold.  Set in refrigerator overnight.  Unmold to plate and serve with assorted crackers.

name: ORIENTAL CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. cubed cooked chicken
1  can bamboo shoots
1  can water chestnuts
2  tsp. onion
1  c. almonds
2  cans mandarin orange slices
2  c. mayonnaise
1  can Chinese noodles
preparation: Combine all ingredients except noodles.  Chill.   Just before serving, add Chinese noodles.

name: CORNED BEEF AND CABBAGE(This recipe is good any time, not just on St. Patrick's Day.)
ingredients:
1  corned beef brisket
4  to 6 potatoes
4  to 6 carrots
1  head cabbage, cut in wedges
4  to 6 small onions
preparation: Place the corned beef brisket in a large pan and cover with water.  Boil for 3 hours or until tender when jabbed with a fork. (Keep adding water to keep pan from boiling dry.)  Save brine (or broth) and place in a large kettle.  In brine, cook cabbage, potatoes, carrots and onions until tender.  Slice beef and serve with vegetables.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: CHOCOLATE MOUSSE PRONTO
ingredients:
1/2  c. hot water
1  tsp. instant coffee
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
3  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
3  eggs
1/2  c. whipping cream
chocolate curls (if desired)
