preparation: In blender, combine water, coffee and chocolate chips.  Cover and blend until smooth, about 1 minute.  Add sugar and salt.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Blend each egg in before adding the next. Pour into serving dishes.  Refrigerate until served.  Serve with whipped cream and chocolate curls, if desired.

name: FINGER PAINT
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. liquid starch
1  Tbsp. liquid paint (powdered is fine)
a few drops dishwashing liquid (helps paint mixture wash off hands easily)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and paint.

name: PIGS IN BLANKETS
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick original or reduced fat baking mix
1/2  c. cold water
8  frankfurters
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms; beat vigorously 20 strokes.  Gently smooth dough into a ball on floured cloth-covered surface.  Knead 5 times.  Roll dough into 13-inch circle.  Cut circle into 8 wedges.  Place frankfurter one each wedge; roll up, beginning at wide end.  Seal tightly by pinching point into roll.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake about 15 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve with mustard or ketchup if desired.  Makes 8 servings.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/4  c. oil
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
3  c. chopped apples
preparation: Beat together the sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla.  Add dry ingredients and mix well, fold in apples and nuts.  Bake in tube pan at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Make icing and pour over cake while warm.

name: THANKSGIVING COBBLER
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. butter, softened
1  c. nuts
1  can peach pie filling or 18 oz. peach preserves
1 (16 oz.)  can whole berry cranberry sauce
vanilla ice cream or Cool Whip
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine dry cake mix and spices in bowl.  Cut in butter until crumbly.  Stir in nuts.  Set aside.

name: BAKED POTATO DELIGHTS(Bulvines Bandukes)
ingredients:
5  medium potatoes (unpeeled)
1  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  lb. butter or margarine
1/2  pt. sweet cream
1  Tbsp. onion, chopped
preparation: Boil unpeeled potatoes until done.  Cool, peel and mash.  Add flour and salt.  Roll out on floured board about 1-inch high.  Cut into 1-inch wide strips.  Cut each strip into 2-inch pieces.  Place in greased pan and bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

name: CHEESE SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  cans cream-style corn
1  c. milk
1  c. crackers crumbs
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. green pepper
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Beat the eggs.  Add corn, milk, cracker crumbs, onion, green pepper, cheese, salt and pepper. Spoon into a 1-quart casserole dish and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1  frozen lemonade, thawed
2 small  cartons Cool Whip
1  can condensed milk
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix and pour into 2 graham cracker crusts.  Refrigerate.

name: MINT BROWNIE CUPS
ingredients:
2 1/2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1/2  c. butter
1 scant  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. mint extract
1/2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
powdered sugar for garnish
strawberries for garnish
preparation: Melt chocolate and butter in medium saucepan. Stir in sugar. Add eggs, vanilla and mint extract.  Combine flour and baking powder. Add to butter mixture.  Line a muffin pan with 12 cupcake liners. Fill each with 2 tablespoons of batter.  Bake at 350° for 13 to 15 minutes until toothpick barely comes out clean.  Remove to cool on rack.  Dust with powdered sugar when cool.  The cups will sink slightly in the middle. Garnish with strawberries.

name: OVERNIGHT PULL-APART COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  pkg. or 1 (15 oz.) pkg. frozen bread
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. granulated sugar
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
3 to 4  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. pecans (optional)
preparation: Before going to bed, place frozen dough balls into a large greased Bundt pan.  Mix sugars and cinnamon and sprinkle over rolls.  Sprinkle with finely chopped pecans.  Melt margarine; cool slightly and drizzle on top.  Cover loosely with folded tent of foil.  Place in cold oven.

name: CHOCOLATE DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. nuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
2 small  boxes instant chocolate pudding
2 1/2  c. milk
Cool Whip
preparation: Combine flour, margarine and nuts.  Spread in an oblong pan and bake 15 minutes at 350°.  Cool.  Combine cream cheese, powdered sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip.  Spread on cooled crust.  Mix pudding with milk.  Let stand, then spread on cream cheese mixture.

name: CORNED BEEF CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3 (2 1/2 oz.)  pkg. corned beef
3  bunches green onions
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. Accent brand seasoning
preparation: Soften cream cheese at room temperature.  Finely chop green onions and corned beef.  Mix all ingredients together and form into a ball.  Serve with assorted crackers.  Best if chilled before serving.

name: ENGLISH MONKEY(Mother Parkinson, March 6, 1947)
ingredients:
1  c. stale bread crumbs
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. soft mild cheese, cut in small pieces
1  egg
1/2  tsp. salt
few grains cayenne
preparation: Soak bread crumbs 15 minutes in milk.  Melt butter; add cheese and, when cheese has melted, add soaked crumbs, egg (slightly beaten) and seasonings.  Cook 3 minutes; pour over toasted or plain crackers which have been spread sparingly with butter, on a plate.

name: BLACK FOREST BROWNIES A LA MODE
ingredients:
1  (21.5 oz.) fudge brownie mix
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry or light cherry pie filling
1/4  c. oil
2  eggs
1 1/4  c. semi-sweet chocolate bits
vanilla ice cream
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  With an electric mixer, beat until blended the brownie mix, 1 cup filling, oil and eggs.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes until brownies spring back when touched.  If desired, sprinkle with chocolate chips.  Let stand until softened.

name: APPLESAUCE FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
2  eggs
3/4  c. milk
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
2  Tbsp. white sugar
1/4  c. applesauce
6  slices bread
preparation: Combine eggs, milk, cinnamon, sugar and applesauce. Soak bread slices until saturated. Cook on griddle or frying pan until lightly brown on both sides.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
2  cans cream of celery soup
2  c. Minute rice (uncooked)
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
3/4  c. celery, chopped
3/4  c. onions
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Melt margarine in baking dish. Mix all ingredients together; place in buttered dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: HONEY CORNMEAL BISCUITS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. Bisquick baking mix
1/2  c. yellow cornmeal
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. honey
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Mix all ingredients until dough forms. Beat 30 seconds. Turn dough onto surface dusted with baking mix. Gently roll in baking mix to coat.  Shape into balls.  Knead 10 times. Roll out until 1/2-inch thick.   Cut with 2-inch cutter dipped in baking mix.  Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet until golden brown (8 to 10 minutes). Serve with Honey-Butter.

name: SQUASH DRESSING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. herb stuffing mix
1  stick margarine
3  c. cooked squash
1  c. grated carrots
1/3  c. chopped onions
8  oz. sour cream
1  can cream of celery soup, undiluted
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt margarine and blend with stuffing.  Mix together remaining ingredients.  Spread 1/2 stuffing mix on bottom of oblong dish, spread squash mix on top.  Sprinkle remainder of stuffing over squash mix.  Bake at 350° until brown on top.  Cut into squares and serve.

name: APPLE SLICES
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  c. oil
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
5  apples, peeled and chopped
preparation: Mix eggs and sugar.  Add all other ingredients.  Bake in ungreased 10 x 17-inch or 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar when cool.  Cut in bars.

name: MINI CHEESE CAKES
ingredients:
3  (8 oz.) cream cheese
5  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream ingredients together.  Fill cupcake papers 3/4 full. Bake 30 minutes at 300°.  Cool 5 minutes.

name: COLA CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. vegetable shortening
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. cola drink
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1 1/2  c. small marshmallows
Cola Topping
preparation: This cake is to be mixed by hand; do not use electric mixer. Sift sugar and flour together in a large bowl.  Combine butter, shortening, cocoa and cola and heat until butter is melted; pour over flour mixture and stir well.  Add buttermilk, soda, beaten eggs, vanilla and marshmallows.  Mix well and spoon into well-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Marshmallows will tend to gather in one section.  Distribute throughout pan.  Bake at 350° about 45 minutes or until cake tests done.  Spread with Cola Topping while cake is still hot.  Yields 12 servings.

name: RICE SUPREME
ingredients:
2  cans beef bouillon
1  c. raw rice (not Minute rice)
1  stick melted butter
1  can mushrooms, drained
preparation: Mix all ingredients in 2-quart casserole.  Season well.  Bake 1 hour, covered, at 375°.  Uncover and bake 15 minutes more.

name: STRAWBERRY NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
2/3  c. shortening
2  c. flour (plain)
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs
3/4  c. pecans
1/2  tsp. lime juice
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. strawberries
1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Cream sugar, shortening; add eggs and milk.  Beat until almost liquid.  Add dry ingredients.  Stir only enough to mix.  Add strawberries and nuts.  Bake at 350° until straw comes out clean. Start with 30 minutes.

name: SUPERB CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin
1  c. hot water
1  c. sugar
1 (16 oz.)  can whole cranberries
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed and drained
3/4  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Dissolve gelatin  in  hot water.  Add sugar; cool.  Add cranberries.   Let	stand  15  minutes,  then  add	pineapple, strawberries and  nuts;  mix  well.  Spoon	into  oiled (using mayonnaise) ring  mold.  Refrigerate.  Yields  1  (6-cup) ring mold or 6 individual molds.

name: VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can white Shoe Peg corn
3/4  c. fresh green onions
1  can English peas
1  c. chopped celery
1 small  jar pimento
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  can French-style green beans
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. pepper
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. water
preparation: Bring oil, pepper, sugar, vinegar, salt and water to a boil for 1 minute.  Let cool and pour over vegetables.

name: ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can asparagus spears
4  hard-boiled eggs
1 (4 oz.)  can pimentos
1 (5 oz.)  can mushrooms
1 1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/2  c. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
dash of pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. grated sharp cheese
1  c. milk
preparation: Melt  butter in heavy saucepan.  Mix in flour, salt and pepper.  Add grated cheese and as it begins to melt; add milk. Cook  until  thick.  Place  1/2  of  bread crumbs in bottom of casserole.  Put  remaining  ingredients  in  layers, beginning with  asparagus,  sliced  eggs, pimentos, mushrooms, then pour over part  of  sauce.  Make another layer and top with crumbs. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: SHRIMP ETOUFFEE
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh medium raw shrimp
1/4  c. margarine or butter
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  medium onion, chopped (1/2 c.)
1  small green pepper, chopped (1/2 c.)
1  medium celery stalk, chopped (1/2 c.)
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
1  c. water
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. hot cooked rice
preparation: Peel shrimp and devein.  Heat margarine in 3-quart saucepan over medium heat until melted.  Stir in flour.  Cook about 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until bubbly and brown.  Stir in onion, bell pepper, celery and garlic.  Cook and stir about 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.  Stir in shrimp, water, parsley, lemon juice, salt and pepper.  Heat to boiling. Reduce heat.  Simmer, uncovered, about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are pink.  Serve over rice.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CARNE DESEBRADA(Shredded Meat)
ingredients:
4  lb. chuck roast or carne para cocer
1  chopped onion
2  chopped tomatoes
1  1/2 or 2 chopped peppers (bell, Pablano  or Anaheim)
garlic, salt and black pepper to taste
preparation: Place meat in pot and cover with water.  Boil until tender. Save liquid.  When cool, shred meat and place in pot with 1 1/2 cups of leftover liquid.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer approximately 35 minutes.  Meat may be served with side dishes or wrapped in corn or flour tortillas.

name: BUTTERMILK BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1/3  c. chilled Crisco
2/3  c. buttermilk
preparation: Make biscuits in usual manner.  Preheat oven to 450°.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

name: NO FUSS FIX AHEAD CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1  c. rice
1  pkg. dry Lipton onion soup mix
1  chicken fryer, cut up, or pieces of choice
1  can mushroom soup, mixed with 1 1/4 cans water
sliced mushrooms
preparation: Place ingredients in a 9 x 12-inch casserole in order given. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours, uncovered.  Rice serves about 6. Six chicken breasts do nicely, instead of originally called for cut up fryer.

name: FRIED RABBIT
ingredients:
1  rabbit, skinned and cut up
pepper to taste
juice of 1/4 lemon
1  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  diced onion
preparation: Roll rabbit pieces in flour, salt and pepper.  Brown the meat in skillet, using 4 to 5 tablespoons of cooking fat.  Then add onions and lemon juice.  Cook until done.

name: TASTY POTATO DISH
ingredients:
1  (2 lb.) bag hash browns
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
1  c. grated Velveeta cheese
1/2  c. onions
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Mix the ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch glass dish and bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  egg
2  sticks butter
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
12  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix together egg, butter, sugars and vanilla.  Sift together flour, soda and salt.  Mix until all blended well.   Add nuts and chips.  Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls  2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes in a 350° oven. Allow to cool before removing from sheet.  Makes about 24 to 30 cookies.

name: SEAFOOD SUPREME
ingredients:
2  cans mushroom soup
1  can thawed frozen shrimp soup
1/2  c. mushrooms
4  c. seafood (crab, shrimp or lobster)
salt and pepper to taste
paprika
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Place in casserole.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Serve with rice.

name: CHILI RICE
ingredients:
1  can (15 oz.) chili without beans
1  can (16 oz.) stewed tomatoes
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. Minute Rice
preparation: Stir chili, tomatoes, onion, garlic powder and pepper in a large skillet; bring to a boil.  Stir in rice; cover and remove from heat.  Let stand 5 minutes; fluff with fork.

name: QUICK PEAR CRUMBLE
ingredients:
2 (16 oz. each)  cans pear halves in juice
1/4  c. quick-cooking oats
2  Tbsp. chopped walnuts
2  Tbsp. golden raisins
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/8  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/8  tsp. ground ginger
preparation: Place 8 pear halves, cut-side up, in broiler-proof pan. Combine remaining ingredients.  Crumble over pears.  Broil 6-inches from heat for about 3 minutes, until browned.

name: CARAMEL DIP
ingredients:
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
8  oz. cream cheese
preparation: Use for dipping apple slices or any fresh fruit that is in season.

name: CHICKEN DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  cooked chicken, deboned
1  large green pepper, diced
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. rice (raw)
1  can tomatoes
1  pkg. spaghetti, cooked
preparation: Boil chicken, green pepper, onion and tomatoes until done. Add rice and let simmer. Add cooked spaghetti and serve.

name: MEX-ITALIAN LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can chili (no beans)
1 (16 oz.)  jar salsa
1 (4 oz.)  jar mushrooms
3/4  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
1 1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1 1/2  c. cottage cheese
1 1/2  tsp. parsley flakes
2 1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
9  lasagna noodles, cooked
preparation: Combine chili, salsa and mushrooms; set aside.  Combine cheeses and seasonings; set aside.  Boil noodles according to box directions.  Starting with chili mixture, then noodles, then cheese, layer 3 times.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: QUICK TACO SALAD
ingredients:
3/4  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  pkg. Rice-A-Roni beef flavor
1/2  c. salsa
1  tsp. chili powder
4  c. shredded lettuce
1  medium tomato, chopped
1/2  c. shredded Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. crushed tortilla chips
preparation: In large skillet, brown ground beef and onion.  Drain. Remove from skillet.  Set aside.  In same skillet, prepare Rice-A-Roni as package directs.  Stir in meat mixture, salsa and chili powder.  Continue cooking over low heat 3 to 4 minutes or until heated through.  Arrange lettuce on serving platter.  Top with rice mixture, tomatoes, cheese and tortilla chips.  Serves 5.

name: PUMPKIN TORTE
ingredients:
24  graham crackers, crushed
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1/4  c. sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
2  eggs
1/4  c. sugar
3  egg whites
1/2  c. sugar
1 (1 lb.)  can pumpkin
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  egg yolks
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  envelope Knox gelatine
1/4  c. water
8  oz. tub Cool Whip
preparation: Combine graham crackers, margarine and 1/4 cup sugar and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Combine cream cheese, 2 eggs and 1/4 cup sugar and pour over crust.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: SPINACH-CHEESE SQUARES
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter
3  eggs
1  c. flour
1  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1 (1 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach, drained
1  small onion, minced
6  medium mushrooms, chopped
preparation: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Set aside.  Mix all remaining ingredients in a bowl.  Pour over butter.  Bake for 35 minutes at 350°.  Let cool before cutting.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon *
1/4  tsp. cloves *
1  tsp. ginger *
1/4  tsp. nutmeg *
1  tsp. salt *
2  lb. (4 c.) pumpkin
preparation: *Or 2 tablespoons of pumpkin pie spices.

name: STIR AND BAKE ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. warm water
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  c. sugar
1  egg
3/4  c. oil
4  c. self-rising flour
preparation: Pour water in mixing bowl.  Add yeast and sugar.  Stir well. Add egg and oil, then stir in flour.  Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes, then cover and store in refrigerator.  When ready to bake, stir dough.  Half fill greased muffin pans.  Bake at 450° until brown.  Keeps well in refrigerator for one week.

name: PINEAPPLE - CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 large  cans chunk pineapple
1  c. sugar
5  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. shredded cheese
snack crackers, crushed (I use Ritz crackers)
preparation: Mix juice from pineapple with sugar and cornstarch.  Cook until thick.  Pour over pineapple which has been placed in 2-quart casserole.  Sprinkle cheese over pineapple and sauce.  Top with 1 1/2 cups crackers and dot with butter.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: PECAN FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sweet butter (room temperature)
4  c. sugar
4  eggs, beaten
8  sq. bitter chocolate, melted
4  c. pastry flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. milk
2  c. pecans, finely chopped
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease 3 (9-inch) layer cake pans.  In a large bowl, cream the butter.  Gradually add the sugar; beat until fluffy.  Add the beaten eggs and melted chocolate.  Sift the dry ingredients; blend in alternately with the milk.  Add the nuts and vanilla.  Pour into prepared pans.  Bake for 35 minutes, or until the center of the cake feels solid.  Cool and remove the layers from the pans.  Fill and frost.

name: RHUBARB CRUNCH
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. oleo, melted
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. brown sugar
2  c. oatmeal (not quick)
preparation: Mix all until crumbly.  Pour 1/2 into bottom of greased deep 9 x 13-inch pan.  Put 7 to 8 cups of rhubarb on top.

name: GRANDMA APEL'S CRANBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
4  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. shortening
1 1/2  c. orange juice
2  beaten eggs
2  c. fresh cranberries
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, sugar and shortening together.  Then add orange juice and eggs.  Fold in cranberries and nuts.  Pour in loaf pan and bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: BAKED CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. white wine
1  c. Italian herb seasoned croutons, crushed
1/4  c. melted butter or margarine
4  slices Swiss cheese
preparation: Remove skin from chicken breasts and wash the breasts.  Roll them in crushed croutons and arrange in greased baking dish.  Top with slices of Swiss cheese.  Combine soup and wine.  Spoon over chicken, then sprinkle remaining crushed croutons over all. Drizzle with melted butter.  Bake at 350° for about 55 minutes.

name: SWIEBACK
ingredients:
6  c. warm water
2  c. powdered milk
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. dry yeast
flour
1 1/2  c. melted oleo
2  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Mix warm water, powdered milk and sugar.  Add yeast (sprinkle on and let set until bubbly, 5 minutes.)  Beat in flour to form batter dough.  Beat hard and add oleo and salt.  Add flour to make soft roll dough, kneading gently.  Cover and let rise in warm place until double in size.  Pinch off a small ball, the size of an egg.  Place 1 inch apart on greased pan.  Put a similar ball, but a bit smaller, on top of bottom ball.  Press down with thumb. Let rise until double in size (approximately 1 hour).  Bake at 400° to 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Yields 4 dozen.

name: APPLE OR PEAR CRISP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. apples or pears, peeled, cored and thin sliced
3  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. frozen unsweetened apple juice concentrate
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
dash of ground nutmeg
3  Tbsp. corn oil margarine, softened
10  graham cracker squares, crushed (3/4 c.)
preparation: Toss apples or pears with 1 tablespoon flour in an 8-inch square baking dish.  Add concentrated apple juice.  Coat well.  In small bowl, combine the rest of the flour and the spices with the margarine and mix until well blended.  Gradually stir in the graham cracker crumbs until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle over the fruit.  Bake for 30 minutes until the topping is lightly browned and the fruit is tender.  Makes 16 (2-inch) squares (1 square = 1 fruit equivalent).

name: CRESCENT ROLLS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. melted margarine
1  c. scalded milk
1  pkg. (1 Tbsp.) active yeast culture
1/4  c. lukewarm water
1  Tbsp. granulated sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
4  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water; add 1 tablespoon granulated sugar.  Beat eggs; add 1/2 cup granulated sugar and 1/4 teaspoon salt.  Add melted margarine to yeast mixture; add in egg mixture. Stir in flour; chill for approximately 7 hours or overnight.  Roll out dough to 1/4-inch thickness as for a pie.  Slice in triangular pieces.  Roll dough starting with the larger end.  Let rise 4 hours in warm place.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes in an oven set at 350°.

name: FROSTING
ingredients:
1  sq. (1 oz.) unsweetened chocolate
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  c. sifted confectioners sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Place chocolate and butter in a small saucepan.  Stir over low heat until chocolate melts.  Remove from heat and add confectioners sugar and vanilla.  Blend in enough hot water (about 2 tablespoons) to make almost pourable consistency.

name: MARINATED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  qt. small fresh mushrooms
1  Tbsp. salt
2  pkg. Italian dressing mix
salad oil
1  qt. water
juice of 1 small lemon
white wine or champagne vinegar
preparation: Wash mushrooms quickly under running water.  Remove stems and drain.  Bring a kettle of water, enough that will cover the mushrooms, to a boil.  Add the salt and lemon juice.  After water comes to a boil, take off heat and dump in mushrooms.  Let them remain for 5 minutes.

name: PESTO
ingredients:
5 to 6  cloves garlic, minced
3  Tbsp. dried basil
1 1/2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. pine nuts, minced
1/2  c. olive oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients and mash.  Serve over pasta, pizzas, etc.

name: MOM'S CHILI
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. chopped green pepper
3/4  c. celery
3/4  c. onions
1  can sliced mushrooms
1 1/2  Tbsp. chili powder
3/4  tsp. thyme
3/4  tsp. oregano
3/4  tsp. cumin
1/2  tsp. red pepper
1 1/2 to 2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  (15 oz.) black beans, drained
1  can red chili beans
1  can pinto beans
2  cans Great Northern beans
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can ripe olives
1  can chopped chilies
2  (16 oz.) tomato paste
3 (14 oz.)  cans tomatoes
2  (14 1/2 oz.) chicken broth
preparation: Simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour.  If too thick, add some water or more chicken broth.  Can also add small pieces of ham.  Add cornstarch just before removing from heat.

name: BEEF BURGUNDY
ingredients:
4  lb. stew meat
2  cans mushroom soup
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup (dry)
8  mushrooms, sliced
1/2  c. wine (Burgundy)
preparation: Place meat in large casserole.  Slice mushrooms on top.  Mix all other ingredients and pour over top of meat.  Cover and bake 4 hours at 300°.  Serve over rice or noodles.

name: BAKED BANANA PEPPERS
ingredients:
1/2  bushel peppers
garlic salt
1  c. oil
1  qt. vinegar
water
salt
preparation: Wash peppers,  then dry and cut peppers in half lengthwise. Put in baking pan; add garlic salt.  Add 1 cup oil over them. Bake until golden brown.  Put in clean sterilized jars. Add vinegar mixture.

name: VERMICELLI CHEESE BAKE
ingredients:
1  c. (4 oz.) broken, uncooked vermicelli
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/4  c. unsifted all-purpose flour
2  c. milk
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
6  large eggs, separated
6  oz. cooked chicken, cubed
1  c. frozen broccoli, thawed
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook pasta as package label directs; set aside.  Preheat oven to 375°.  Grease 10-cup souffle dish.  Sprinkle with the Parmesan.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
4  c. oatmeal
2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
1  c. sour milk
1  box raisins
4  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. salt
1  c. nut meats
preparation: Mix butter and oatmeal until melted on stove. Set aside to cool. Add milk, eggs and raisins. Combine dry ingredients. Add to oatmeal, butter, egg and milk; mix. Fold in nuts. Drop by spoonfuls onto a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 to 12 minutes until lightly browned.

name: ONE POT CHICKEN DINNER
ingredients:
3  large chicken breasts or 4 each chicken legs and thighs
4  large potatoes, peeled and quartered
4  large carrots, peeled and quartered
1  can Campbell's cream of mushroom or cream of chicken or cream of celery soup
preparation: Brown chicken in skillet and salt.  Remove and put in a large casserole dish. Add potatoes, carrots and soup.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SOUTHERN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. corn meal (self-rising)
2/3  c. flour (self-rising)
1/4  tsp. soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1  egg
3  Tbsp. oil
2/3  c. buttermilk
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Coat 9-inch iron skillet with oil. Combine meal, flour, soda, baking powder and egg and mix well. Add buttermilk to make consistency of cake batter.

name: CHAMPAGNE PUNCH
ingredients:
1  qt. High's frozen fruit punch (either raspberry or lime)
1 1/2  qt. ginger ale
1 1/2  qt. champagne
1  qt. pineapple sherbet
orange slices
preparation: Defrost High's frozen fruit punch for at least 1 hour in punch bowl.  Add sherbet.  Pour champagne and ginger ale into mixture. Sherbet will slowly melt.  Garnish with orange slices.

name: FANNIE WILSON'S MAHOGANY CAKE
ingredients:
2/3  c. oleo
2  c. sugar
3  egg yolks
4 level  tsp. cocoa in 4 Tbsp. hot water
2/3  c. milk
2  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
4  egg whites, beaten stiff (save extra yolk for frosting)
1  box plus 1 c. confectioners sugar, sifted
2/3  c. oleo
1 egg yolk, mixed with 2 level  tsp. cocoa and 3 Tbsp. hot coffee
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix well.  Spread between layers and on top of cake.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
6  medium eggs
3  c. sugar
3  sticks butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
3  c. flour (plain or cake)
preparation: Soften and mix the cream cheese and margarine; stir in sugar. Add eggs.  Add vanilla.  Blend until smooth.  Stir in flour; blend mixture well.  Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

name: PHILADELPHIA BUTTERSCOTCH SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. dark Karo
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. evaporated milk
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix syrup, milk and sugar in double boiler until sugar is dissolved.   Cook, uncovered, for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat.  Stir in butter and vanilla.   Beat for 30 minutes or until thick.    Serve over ice cream or pound cake. Makes 2 cups.

name: QUICK CASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. sliced celery
1  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. oil
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  can evaporated milk
1  c. chopped cashews
1  c. diced chicken
1 small  can Chinese crisp noodles
preparation: Mix well.  Place in casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: LAZY PIGS IN THE BLANKET
ingredients:
1  large onion
1  green pepper
1  lb. ground beef
salt and pepper to taste
1  medium cabbage, shredded
1  can tomato sauce, undiluted
preparation: Saute onion and green pepper in saucepan in 2 tablespoons margarine.  Add ground beef and brown lightly.  Drain off fat. Season to taste.  Place half the shredded cabbage in a casserole. Add the meat mixture and cover with remaining cabbage.  Pour sauce on top and spread evenly.  Cover and bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: BUDDY'S TATER SOUP
ingredients:
4  large potatoes or more, peeled
1  lb. carrots, peeled and chopped
3 to 4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  onion, chopped
1  pkg. bacon, fried and crumbled
1  c. milk
1  c. water
preparation: Fry bacon. Drain grease. Crumble into small pieces. Sauté onions in bacon grease. In another pan, put potatoes, carrots and 1 cup water. Bring to a boil until potatoes and carrots are soft. Add bacon, onion, 1 cup milk and soup. Cook until hot, but do not boil. When all is hot, add shredded Cheddar cheese.

name: BARBECUED PUMPERNICKEL
ingredients:
1  (1 lb.) round loaf unsliced pumpernickel bread
1/2  c. margarine, softened
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
3  Tbsp. Special Blend seasoning sauce
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
preparation: Cut bread in 1/2-inch thick slices, cutting to but not through bottom crust.  Combine butter, Parmesan cheese, seasoning sauce and parsley.  Spread mixture between every other slice of bread. Make 1 lengthwise slice down center of bread, cutting to but not through bottom crust.  Wrap loaf in foil.  Heat foil-wrapped bread over slow coals until warm through, 25 to 30 minutes.  Makes 1 loaf.

name: FAMILY FAVORITE CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
Baked pie shell
1/2  c. cocoa
7  Tbsp. flour
1-1/2  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
3  egg yolks
2  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
Meringue or Whipped Cream
preparation: Mix cocoa, flour, sugar and salt. Gradually add egg yolks and milk. Cook and stir constantly over medium heat until thickened. Filling will be slightly lumpy. Add vanilla and butter and beat with an electric mixer until smooth. Cool until lukewarm and pour into a baked pie shell. If you choose, you may top with meringue and bake until brown, or you may chill the pie and top with whipped cream.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
cooked chicken, chopped
1  onion, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise or Miracle Whip
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. sugar
preparation: Mix all together.  Stuff in pita bread.

name: WACKY CAKE
ingredients:
1  1/2  cup cake flour
1  cup sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  cup cold water
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

name: COTTAGE PUDDING ONE EGG CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Cream shortening; add sugar until creamed.  Add unbeaten egg and vanilla.  Beat until smooth.  Add sifted dry ingredients; alternate with milk.  Pour into 8-inch square pan greased and floured.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  gal. pork and beans
2  medium onions, cooked in bacon grease
24  oz. ketchup
1 1/2  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. mustard
1 or 2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Bake at 350° until done.

name: REFRIGERATOR ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. milk, scalded
1  cube butter or margarine
1  pkg. dry yeast
1  tsp. sugar
1/4  c. warm water
3  eggs
1/4  c. sugar
pinch of salt
4 to 4 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Scald milk; add 1  cube  of  butter  or  margarine.  In another bowl, mix yeast,  water and 1 teaspoon sugar to proof. Beat the eggs and add  to  milk  mixture  when  it is lukewarm along with yeast mixture,  salt  and 1/4 cup sugar.  Stir well and add flour until it	is mixed well.	Should be thick, moist dough. Cover tightly and put in refrigerator overnight.

name: REUBEN LOAF
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. soft bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
1 small  clove garlic, minced
2 (12 oz.)  cans corned beef, finely chopped
1 (8 oz.)  can sauerkraut, drained and finely chopped
1/2  tsp. caraway seed
1  c. Swiss cheese, shredded
3  slices Swiss cheese, halved diagonally
preparation: Combine eggs, bread crumbs, parsley and garlic.  Stir in corned beef; mix well.  On foil or waxed paper, pat meat mixture to a 10 x 10-inch square.  Combine sauerkraut, caraway and shredded cheese; mound in center of meat mixture.  Wrap meat mixture around and over sauerkraut mixture, forming a loaf (be sure ends and seams are completely sealed).  Place loaf in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Top with cheese triangles; bake for 5 minutes more or until cheese is melted.

name: CRAB-BROCCOLI BISQUE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  onion, diced
2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. half and half
2  c. milk
fresh ground black pepper to taste
2  cans lump crab meat
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli (thawed)
lots of fresh thyme to taste
preparation: Saute butter and onion until transparent.  Add flour, half and half and milk.  Stir until thick.  May thicken with cornstarch, if preferred.  Add pepper, crab meat and broccoli and heat thoroughly.  Add grated Parmesan cheese just before serving.  Top with croutons or oyster crackers.   May serve with warm, crusty French bread.

name: CONFETTI DIP
ingredients:
2/3  c. sour cream
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chives
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1/4  Tbsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix well and refrigerate.  Serve with vegetables.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. raspberry Jell-O
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry Jell-O
3 1/2  c. boiling water
1/4  c. cold water
1  envelope Knox gelatine
1/2  c. Port wine
1 (16 oz.)  can whole cranberry sauce
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sour cream
1  large orange
preparation: boiling water together.  Mix cold water and Knox gelatine together.  Add Jell-O, Knox gelatine and Port wine together.  When slightly thickened, add pineapple, cranberry sauce and finely chopped pecans or walnuts.  Pour into 9 x 12-inch pan.

name: CANDY
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3/4  c. margarine
2/3  c. canned milk
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. peanut butter
7  oz. jar Marshmallow Creme
preparation: Combine sugar, margarine, milk and cocoa.  Bring to boil over medium heat.  Boil 5 minutes.  Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into buttered pan.  Let stand 2 to 3 hours.

name: CHERRY CREAM CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  crumb crust (9-inch) or 1 baked pastry shell
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/3  c. (15 oz.) Borden Eagle Brand condensed milk
1/3  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
1  can prepared cherry pie filling
preparation: Soften cream cheese to room temperature; whip until fluffy. Gradually add Eagle Brand, while continuing to beat until well blended.  Add lemon juice and vanilla.  Blend well.  Pour into crust.  Chill 2 hours.  Garnish top of pie with cherry pie filling.

name: LOW-FAT BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  box brownie mix
1/2  c. plain yogurt
preparation: Substitute 1/2 cup plain yogurt instead of eggs and margarine and follow directions on box.

name: BROCCOLI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
3  (10 oz.) frozen broccoli
1  stick butter
1  stack Ritz crackers, crumbled in blender
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Butter baking dish.  Cook broccoli until tender and drain. Put in baking dish.  Dot with 1/4 of butter and slice cheese to cover broccoli.  Sprinkle crumbs on top.  Add remainder of butter over top.  Bake at 350° until cheese bubbles and crumbs brown.

name: CELERY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. celery
1 (5 oz.)  c. water chestnuts
1  c. cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
1/4  c. toasted sliced almonds
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cut up celery and cook in saucepan with water until tender. Remove from stove and pour off water; add chestnuts, chicken soup and melted butter.  Stir and place in a casserole dish.  Top with bread crumbs and almonds.  Bake until brown at 350°.

name: BUTTER PECAN COOKIES
ingredients:
1  Butter Recipe cake mix
1 large  pkg. butter pecan pudding mix
1  egg
1  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Spoon drops onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes, or until lightly browned around edges.  Makes a bunch.

name: MAW MAW'S HOT CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
1  c. cocoa
2  c. sugar
2  cans evaporated milk
regular milk
preparation: Mix cocoa & sugar together, then add your two cans evaporated milk, mixing it well.  Then finish filling pot with regular milk. Cook on low or medium heat stirring regular until hot.  Drink & enjoy!

name: SORGHUM COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. butter, softened
2  Tbsp. warm water
1  c. molasses
1  egg
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.   Combine remaining ingredients.   Add sifted ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet and bake for 12 to 15 minutes in 400° oven.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. strawberry jello or 1/2 small pkg.
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. strawberries
1  pie crust
Cool Whip
preparation: Bake a pie crust and allow it to cool.  Mix dry ingredients, then add water.  Cook on the stove until it becomes a clear red (not milky).  Let cool and pour over strawberries that have been placed in the cooled pie crust.  Top with Cool Whip.  Chill.

name: RASPBERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. oleo
1/2  c. sugar
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
3/4  c. cold water
1  c. sour cream
1  (8 oz.) raspberry yogurt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. whipping cream
1  c. frozen raspberries
preparation: Combine crumbs, 1/2 cup sugar and melted oleo.  Reserve 1/4 cup of crumb mixture.  Press remaining crumb mixture into a 10 x 6 x 2-inch dish.  In saucepan mix 1/2 cup sugar and gelatin.  Add the water.  Heat and stir until gelatin and sugar dissolve.  Combine sour cream and yogurt and add to gelatin mixture.  Add vanilla. Chill until partially set.  Whip cream to soft peaks.  Fold into yogurt mixture.  Stir in raspberries.  Turn into crust.  Sprinkle reserved crumbs.  Chill until set.

name: CHOCOLATE SOUR CREAM CAKE A LA TERRI
ingredients:
1/2  c. warm water
1/2  c. oil
1/2  pt. sour cream
4  eggs
1  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
9  oz. semi-sweet chocolate bits
1  pkg. Duncan Hines chocolate cake mix
preparation: Mix water, oil, cream and eggs together.  Add pudding and mix well.  Add cake mix and then fold in chocolate bits.  Grease baking pans and bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. crushed pretzels
3/4  c. melted margarine
4  Tbsp. sugar (optional)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. sugar
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip whipped topping, thawed
1 large  pkg. strawberry jello
2  c. hot water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. sweetened strawberries
preparation: Mix together the pretzels, melted margarine and 4 tablespoons of sugar; pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 400° for 8 minutes; cool.  Mix together the cream cheese, 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip, spread over the cooled pretzel crust and refrigerate.  Mix the jello and water, stir until dissolved.  Cool and add the strawberries.  Place strawberry mixture in the refrigerator until almost set.  Pour over the cream cheese mixture and refrigerate until serving time.

name: ELEGANT SEAFOOD PASTA WITH DILL DRESSING
ingredients:
3  Florida lobster tails
1 1/2  lb. shrimp, tails on
5  to 6 Alaskan King crab legs
1  pkg. Chinese rice sticks (noodles), cooked, tossed with butter and parsley and chilled
1  bunch romaine lettuce
1  head iceberg lettuce
garnishes:  black olives, tomato wedges, hard-boiled egg halves, celery sticks and broccoli flowerets
preparation: Steam lobster, shrimp and crab.  (Add Old Bay seasoning and a slice of lemon to water, if desired.) Remove from shells and chill.

name: TANGO FRIED GREEN PLANTAINS
ingredients:
3  green plantains
oil for frying
preparation: Peel plantains and slice diagonally into 1-inch slices.  Heat oil in a nonstick pan.  Fry plantains until a fork will go through them easily or until they turn golden brown (depends on how crispy you like them).  Drain on paper towel.  Then sprinkle with salt and vinegar for the tang-ohh!!

name: MICROWAVE BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/3  c. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. fresh or unthawed frozen blueberries
3/4  c. milk
1  egg
1/3  c. melted butter or margarine
preparation: In a bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.  Add blueberries.  Add milk, melted butter and egg.  Mix until dry ingredients are just moistened.  Do not overbeat.  Spoon batter into paper-lined microwaveproof baking or cupcake pan.  Don't fill more than 2/3 up.  Microwave at Med-High power for 3 minutes.  Let rest for 3 minutes.  Microwave at High power for another 2 to 3 minutes or until muffins are done.  They will still be a little soft in the center.  Let them rest in the pan for a couple of minutes.  Serve them warm with butter or honey.

name: TOFU BQUE
ingredients:
1  lb. firm tofu
3  cloves garlic (minced)
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato puree
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  tsp. paprika
preparation: Coarsely grind tofu in food processor.  Saute garlic in olive oil.  Stir in tofu.  Add soy sauce, tomato puree and paprika. Heat on low for no more than 5 minutes.  (Tofu releases moisture if cooked too long!)  Tasty on toasted wheat bread and served with black olives!

name: ASPARAGUS AND MUSHROOM VINAIGRETTE
ingredients:
1  lb. asparagus
1  c. sliced mushrooms
1/4  c. sliced green onions
1/2  c. corn oil
1/4  c. white wine vinegar
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  tsp. dried basil
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: In a large skillet, cook asparagus in a small amount of boiling water for 3 minutes or until done; drain. Arrange asparagus and mushrooms in a pyrex dish. In a jar, shake all other ingredients. Pour over asparagus and mushrooms. Cover. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

name: DELICIOUS DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. vinegar
dash of pepper
2  tsp. chile sauce
2  tsp. chives
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all together and chill.  Best after refrigerated a day. Serve with chips, crackers or veggies.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1  whole chicken (boiled, skinned, deboned)
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
2  c. milk
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. Bisquick mix
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Tear chicken into bite size pieces and place on bottom of ungreased casserole dish.  Rinse and drain the frozen vegetables and pour over chicken.  Combine in small bowl 1 cup milk and cream of chicken soup.  Combine in small bowl, 1 cup of milk, Bisquick mix and melted margarine.  Pour slowly over top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BAKED CHEESE SANDWICHES
ingredients:
12  slices bread
natural Cheddar cheese for 6 sandwiches
4  eggs, beaten
2 2/3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
paprika (optional)
preparation: Butter a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and put 6 slices of bread in bottom.  Put cheese slices on top of bread and cover with remaining bread slices.  Beat milk, eggs and salt well.  Pour over sandwiches and let stand 45 to 60 minutes.  Sprinkle with paprika, if desired.  Bake in 325° oven for about 45 minutes or until sandwiches are browned.  Serve immediately.

name: DRIED-CHIPPED BEEF DIP
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  c. sour cream
5  oz. dried chipped beef, chopped fine
4  Tbsp. onion, chopped fine
garlic powder
pepper
4  Tbsp. butter
1  c. pecans
preparation: Melt butter.  Add pecans and bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Cut shortening in flour (like pie crust).  Mix remaining ingredients together and add to flour mixture.  Roll out on floured cutting board.  Cut out shapes.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: POTATO MUSHROOM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  or 9 boiling potatoes
2  medium onions, chopped
1/2  c. butter
2 (3 oz.)  cans mushrooms, sliced
salt and pepper
hot milk (for mashing potatoes)
1  c. sour cream
paprika
preparation: Peel  and  boil  potatoes.  Prepare  other  ingredients while potatoes  cook.  Drain  mushrooms,  save  liquid.  Heat butter  in skillet; saute onions slowly until yellow, and add drained mushrooms.  Saute about 2 minutes.  Remove onions and mushrooms with  slotted spoon.  Set aside, leaving the butter in  skillet. Drain,  whip  potatoes  when  done.  Add drained mushroom  liquid, hot milk and seasoning.  Beat in the butter left  in  skillet. Spread a thin layer of potatoes in shallow baking  pan.  Cover with  thin layer of onions and mushrooms; then  layer  of  sour cream.  Repeat.  Top  layer  should  be potatoes.  Two layers of onions and mushrooms.  Brush top with melted  butter; sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.  Leftovers may be frozen.

name: HELEN'S SPECIAL RICE RING
ingredients:
leftover chicken or turkey
2  large onions
1  green pepper
1  can tomato soup
1  can tomato puree
cooked rice
preparation: In skillet, cook onions and pepper in oil or margarine until tender.  Add soup and tomato puree.  Season with a little sugar, garlic powder, chili powder and chopped parsley.  Add 1 or 2 cups of meat; put into rice ring.  Cook amount of rice needed.  Can just serve over rice.

name: FRUIT CAKE CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling (any fruit)
1/2  box cake mix (yellow or white)
1  stick butter
preparation: Butter casserole dish.  Mix pie filling and cake mix.  Pour into dish; melt 1 stick of butter and pour over top of pie filling/cake mix.  Bake at 350° until brown around edge.

name: FETTUCCINE ALFREDO
ingredients:
8  oz. uncooked wide egg noodles
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. whipping cream
3/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  tsp. snipped parsley
preparation: Cook noodles as directed on package, drain.  Heat margarine and whipping cream over low until margarine is melted.  Stir in cheese, salt and pepper.  Pour sauce over hot noodles, stirring until noodles are well coated.  Sprinkle with parsley.

name: REFRIGERATOR SLAW
ingredients:
1  medium cabbage, chopped fine
2  medium onions, sliced
7/8  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
3/4  c. olive oil
2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. celery seed
1  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Arrange in alternate layers in covered bowl the cabbage and onions.  Add 7/8 cup sugar on top and toss.

name: MUSTGO
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. diced carrots
1  small onion
1/2  head cabbage
4  or 5 potatoes
1  c. cream of celery soup
1  c. cream of chicken soup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook ground beef until the pink is gone.  Drain very good. Layer the ground beef, carrots, onion, cabbage and potatoes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Stir the 2 soups together and pour over the casserole.  Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.

name: CREAMY DILL DIP
ingredients:
1  c. fat-free sour cream
1  c. low-fat mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. dried onion flakes
1  tsp. dried dill weed
1/2  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
preparation: Mix well.  Cover and chill until served.  Serve with fresh raw vegetables.

name: SHIRLEY'S BOSTON BROWN BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. water
1  c. raisins
1  egg
1  Tbsp. soda
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
2 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil water and raisins for 2 minutes and let cool.  When cooled, mix it with all the other ingredients.  Pour batter into a bread pan or into (2/3 full) well-greased muffin tin cans (use corn, vegetable cans).  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Very good.

name: WHITE BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
4  c. white beans
1  c. celery
1  c. carrots
1  can chicken broth
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  Tbsp. parsley
black pepper (as desired)
preparation: Cook beans, carrots and celery until done.  Add cream of chicken soup, can of broth, 2 tablespoons parsley and black pepper.  Cook in crock-pot until ready to serve.

name: ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 large  can asparagus (save drained juice)
2  c. plain cracker crumbs
1  stick butter
1/2  lb. grated cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Layer asparagus on bottom.  Mix soup and asparagus juice and pour over asparagus.  Mix grated cheese and crushed crackers together and pour on top.  Pour melted butter over all and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: QUICK BEER BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. self-rising flour
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  can lukewarm beer
preparation: Stir together and bake in greased loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Best served warm.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  sticks butter
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
3  c. sugar
3  c. cake flour (do not use plain flour)
6  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Cream butter and cream cheese.  Add sugar and continue beating until well mixed.  Alternate eggs and flour, mixing well after each addition.  Mixture will be very thick.  Add extracts and mix well.  Spoon into large tube pan and bake in 325° oven for approximately 1 hour and 45 minutes.

name: HOLIDAY GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans (1 lb. each) cut green beans, drained *
3/4  c. milk
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/8  tsp. Durkee ground black pepper
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
Pam no-stick cooking spray
preparation: Combine beans, milk, soup, pepper and 1/2 can of French fried onions.  Spray a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish with Pam.   Pour in bean mixture.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer.  Makes 6 servings.

name: HOMEMADE MANICOTTI
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oil
2  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  c. water
1/2  c. milk
6  eggs
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients; let stand 1 hour at room temperature. Using a 6-inch nonstick saute pan, heat scant teaspoon oil.  Wipe with paper towel to coat pan evenly.  Spread 1 tablespoon batter over pan; tilt to cover surface and cook until dry, not brown.  Do not turn; flip onto clean dish towel to cool.  Do not stack.  When finished making crepes, mix together the filling.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow squash
1/2  large onion
1  c. cheese chips (Cheese It snack crackers)
salt and pepper
preparation: Boil squash until tender in water; drain and mash.  Brown onion in oil; add to squash.  Cook for a few minutes.  Add cheese chips, salt and pepper to taste; mix well.  Put in casserole and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: BUTTER TARTS
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter, softened
1  c. raisins
1  c. walnuts
2  Tbsp. cream
1  recipe double crust pie
preparation: Cut rolled pie crust with 3-inch cutter.  Place in muffin or tart pan.  Mix all ingredients together by hand.  Fill each crust 1/2 full.  Bake at 350° for 18 to 22 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
1  bunch green onions, chopped (blades and all)
2  pkg. smoked ham or beef (wafer lunch meat), chopped fine
preparation: Mix thoroughly in a bowl.  Put a little cooking oil on your hands and shape it into a ball.  Serve with crackers.  Very colorful and tasty.

name: STUFFED CELERY
ingredients:
2  c. cottage cheese
3/4  c. mayonnaise
8  Spanish olives, finely chopped
1  Tbsp. juice from the Spanish olives jar
4  to 6 celery sticks, washed (of course)
preparation: Mix cottage cheese, mayonnaise and olive juice together; add finely chopped olives.  Cut celery stalks into 4-inch pieces. Using a spoon, "stuff" mixture into celery; if you choose to be more complicated, you can use a pastry bag for stuffing.  Remember to serve with napkins!  Serves 12 to 18 people, depending on length of your celery stalks.

name: WINDOW CLEANER
ingredients:
1/2  c. sudsy ammonia
1  pt. 70% isopropyl rubbing alcohol
1  tsp. liquid dish detergent
preparation: Mix and add water to make 1 gallon.

name: STUFFED ROUND STEAK
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak
tsp salt, pepper, and paprika
sliced onions, mushrooms
bread crumbs
1/2  c. melted butter
1  tbsp. boiling water
flour
preparation: Pound steak until thin, rub in salt, pepper, and paprika. Spread with mushrooms; arrange in layer. Blanket with layer of thin sliced onions, add pimentoes and cover with rolled bread crumbs.  With beater, combine butter, boiling water, and add raw egg. Dribble thin mixture over bread crumbs, arrange stuffed olives in a row on the long side of steak.  Begin the roll of meat around the olives. Tie roll with strong cord. Flour the outside and brown. Add 1-2 cups cooking wine and roast at 350° for at least 2 hrs.

name: SPICED NUTS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. cold water
1  egg white (slightly beaten)
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. pecan halves
preparation: Add water to slightly beaten egg white.  Add sugar, spices and salt to egg mixture.  Let stand until sugar is dissolved, about 15 minutes.  Dip nuts in mixture.  Spread on cookie sheet with flat side down.  Bake in 250° oven until golden brown, about 1 hour.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  stick melted margarine
1  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Press in bottom of 9 x 12-inch dish; cook at 325° for 25 minutes.  Cool.

name: VENISON ROAST
ingredients:
roast
1  bottle Worcestershire sauce
Toni seasoning
garlic powder
liquid smoke
1/2  bottle Italian salad dressing
black pepper
preparation: Rub seasoning on roast.  Mix liquids, pour over roast, cover and refrigerate for 12 hours.  Cook in oven at 200° all night long.  It's great.

name: SURPRISE CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
1 to 2 layer  pkg. yellow cake mix
1 1/4  c. mayonnaise type salad dressing
4  eggs
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. finely shredded carrots
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Combine cake mix, salad dressing, eggs and cinnamon in bowl. Mix well.  Stir in carrots and walnuts.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Yields 24 servings.

name: BAKED GARLIC, TOMATO AND ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
Extra Virgin Olive Oil
8  large or 16 medium tomatoes, cored and cut into 1/2 inch slices
6  medium zucchini, stems removed, cut on the diagonal into 1/2 inch slices
12  cloves garlic, peeled and sliced
10  sprigs fresh basil leaves, finely shredded
Coarse salt
Freshly ground black pepper
Aged goat cheese grating stick or parmesan or asiago cheese
preparation: Coat a large shallow casserole dish with a thin layer of olive oil.  Layer the zucchini slices alternately with the tomato slices, overlapping slightly.  Sprinkle the garlic slices and shredded basil on top and season to taste.  Finish with a thin layer of grated cheese.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Bake the casserole for about 30 minutes until the vegetables are tender.  Serves 20 as part of a buffet.  Can be made a day ahead without sprinkling the cheese on it-covered and refrigerated.  Top with cheese and bake when ready to serve.  Serve hot or at room temperature.

name: EASY CASSEROLE FOR A BUSY DAY
ingredients:
4  potatoes, sliced
1  can vegetable soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. ground beef
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Place in a greased casserole.  Bake at 350° until potatoes are done.

name: SWEET AND SOUR SPARERIBS
ingredients:
5 to 6  lb. spareribs or pork loin back ribs
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. ketchup
2/3  c. vinegar
1/2  c. cold water
preparation: Place  ribs  on  a rack in  large  roasting  pan.  Bake uncovered at  350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Meanwhile, combine sugars and cornstarch.  Stir  in  ketchup,  vinegar  and cold water. Cook and  stir  until  thick  and clear.  Remove ribs and rack from pan;  discard  fat.  Place  ribs  back  in  roasting pan. Pour 1 1/2  cups sauce over the ribs; bake 30 minutes longer. Ready to serve.

name: BROCCOLI AND CHEESE BAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Minute rice
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. milk
1  c. broccoli, cut in pieces
1/2  c. small cubes Velveeta cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients together. Stir well. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: FLAKY PASTRY
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. shortening
1  egg
6  Tbsp. water
preparation: Sift flour with salt. Cut shortening into flour. Beat the egg with 5 tablespoons water. Add to flour mixture.  Use remainder of water, if necessary.  Makes 3 pie shells.

name: SNOW BALL COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. oleo (1 3/4 cubes)
6  Tbsp. powdered sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix oleo, powdered sugar and vanilla.  Add flour and nuts; mix well.  Refrigerate, chill, shape into balls.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 10 minutes.  Cool.  Shake gently in paper bag with powdered sugar.  Store in closed container.

name: FEATHER LIGHT PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1  c. sifted flour
1  egg
2  Tbsp. oil
2  Tbsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Put all ingredients into a blender.  Blend until smooth and bake on a hot griddle.

name: DUTCH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
4  c. sliced apples
6  oz. cream cheese
2  c. confectioners sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla together until foamy.  Add flour, cinnamon, salt and sliced apples.  Bake for 1 hour at 350° using (9 x 13 x 2-inch) pan or two (8 x 8-inch) pans.  Remove from pans and cool.  Combine cream cheese, confectioners sugar and vanilla.  Spread on cake and serve.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  chicken (about 4 to 4 1/2 lb.)
2  cubes chicken bouillon
16  oz. vermicelli spaghetti, broken into thirds
1  lb. lite Velveeta cheese (low calorie), sliced
1  stick margarine
2  medium green peppers, chopped
2  medium onions, chopped
1 (10 oz.)  can Ro-Tel tomatoes, chopped (undrained)
1 (10 oz.)  can diced Ro-Tel tomatoes with green chilies (undrained)
15  oz. frozen petit English peas (baby)
preparation: Cook chicken with bouillon cubes in 3 quarts boiling water. Remove chicken when done; drain well.  Reserve the liquid that the chicken was cooked in to cook the spaghetti.  Skin and debone chicken when cool enough to handle.  Cut chicken into bite size pieces and place in a very large mixing bowl.  Cook broken spaghetti in the liquid that chicken was cooked in.  Drain spaghetti and add it to the chicken.  Place slices cheese over chicken and spaghetti.  Let the heat from the spaghetti soften and melt the cheese.  Stir very well.

name: FESTIVE CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
6  oz. garlic cheese log (chopped)
8  oz. Velveeta cheese (grated)
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1 - 2  tsp. garlic, minced
2 - 3  Tbsp. parsley flakes
2  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: On a sheet of wax paper, sprinkle together parsley flakes, chili powder, and half the pecans.  Set aside.  In a mixing bowl, mix cream cheese, garlic cheese log and grated Velveeta together. Add the other half of the pecans and 1-2 tsp. of minced garlic. Using clean hands or a mixer, thoroughly mix and blend the three cheeses, pecans and garlic together.  (Note:  Allowing cheese to soften at room temperature makes the blending process easier.) Shape cheese into a ball.  Roll cheese ball in parsley flakes, chili powder and pecans making sure cheese ball is completely coated.  Chill cheese ball overnight.  Serve with Sociable brand crackers.

name: BROCCOLI AND BABY CARROTS WITH PECAN-CRUMB TOPPING
ingredients:
2  bunches broccoli
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. baby carrots, peeled
1/2  c. butter
1/4  c. fresh rye crumbs
1  c. pecans, toasted and chopped
1/2  tsp. dried thyme leaves
1/4  tsp. black pepper
3/4  tsp. salt
preparation: In a 4-quart saucepan over high heat, bring 2 inches water to a boil.  Add broccoli and carrots.  Return to boil.  Cook 5 to 7 minutes until veggies are crisp-tender.  Meanwhile, in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat, melt butter (1/4 cup only).  Add bread crumbs; cook 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until golden and toasted.  Stir in pecans, 1/2 teaspoon salt, thyme and pepper; cook, stirring, about 1 minute longer.  Drain veggies; return to saucepan.  Toss with remaining butter.  Transfer to a serving dish. Sprinkle with crumb mixture.

name: VEG-ALL TREASURE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can (1 lb.) Veg-All mixed vegetables, drained
1/2  c. American cheese, cubed
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  c. dill pickle, chopped
1  tsp. pickle juice
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine Veg-All with remaining ingredients and toss lightly. Chill.  Serve on bed of crisp lettuce.  Makes 4 servings.

name: TURKEY SQUARES
ingredients:
3  oz. cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
2  c. cubed turkey meat
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1 (8 oz.)  can crescent rolls
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Blend cheese and butter until smooth.  Add turkey, pepper, salt, onion and pimento; mix well.  Separate rolls into 4 rectangles.  Firmly press perforations to seal.  Spoon 1/2 cup meat mixture into center of roll.  Pull 4 corners to center. Twist slightly; seal edges.  Brush with butter.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 20 to 25 minutes until brown.

name: CROCK POT HAM AND SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
8-10 med. potatoes, thinly sliced
6-8 slices of ham, diced (can use turkey ham)
1  onion, diced
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. grated cheddar or American cheese
10  oz. can cream of celery or mushroom soup
preparation: Put half of ham, potatoes and onions in Crock Pot.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper, then grated cheese.  Repeat with remaining half, spoon undiluted soup over top, seal edges.  Cover and cook on Low 8-10 hours or High 4 hours.  Stir well and serve.

name: STEAK WITH TOMATO SAUCE
ingredients:
approximately 2 lb. tenderized round steak, cut in serving size pieces
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. flour
1/4  c. oil
1  large onion, sliced
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
preparation: Season meat with salt and pepper to taste.  Coat meat with flour.  Heat oil in skillet; add meat and brown well on both sides. Add onion rings during last of browning.  (If you like, take steak out of pan and drain on paper towels to absorb some of grease while sauteing onion rings.)  Layer in greased casserole meat, then onions; top with mushrooms and pour tomato sauce and 1/2 can of water on top.  Cover and bake in 350° oven for two hours.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans pork and beans
1  medium onion
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  tsp. A.1. steak sauce
6  slices bacon
1/2  c. ketchup
preparation: Mix beans and ketchup together.  Combine onion, sugar, mustard and A.1. together.  Sprinkle over beans and top with bacon strips. Bake at 325° for 1  to 1 1/2 hours.

name: SANDWICH FILLING
ingredients:
1  c. grated cheese
1 small  bottle stuffed olives, chopped
1/2  c. diced bell pepper
1/2  c. chopped pecans
mayonnaise (to spread consistency)
preparation: Mix grated cheese, olives, bell pepper, pecans and mayonnaise.

name: CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
14  large marshmallows
2  c. milk
3  beaten eggs
1 1/4  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1  (9-inch) pie shell
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Heat marshmallows and milk until marshmallows are melted. Cool.  Blend in eggs, vanilla and salt.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Sprinkle nutmeg over top.  Bake about 50 minutes in 450° oven.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
2  sticks margarine
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/4  c. powdered sugar
1  (8 oz.) tub Cool Whip
2 small  pkg. instant chocolate pudding, made according to directions on box
1  (8 oz.) tub Cool Whip for topping
preparation: Mix flour, margarine and nuts; press into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 20 minutes at 350°.  Cool.

name: BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. beef boneless chuck
1  Tbsp. meat tenderizer
1  tsp. black pepper
2  pkg. soy sauce
1  c. mushrooms
1  Tbsp. parsley
preparation: Cut beef chuck in half.  Put 1 stick of butter in pot; cook for 1 hour until brown.  Put 2 1/2 cups of water.  Let cook for 1 hour.  Mix 1 cup flour with hot water very good until smooth; let simmer.  Put frozen cut broccoli in same pot; let simmer for 10 to 15 minutes until broccoli is steamed.  You can put over white rice or potatoes or pasta.

name: OLD-FASHIONED CHOCOLATE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
pinch of salt
2  c. milk
1  tsp. margarine
1/3  c. flour
2  egg yolks
1/3  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat egg yolks; add milk.  Sift dry ingredients together and place in double boiler.  Stir in 1/3 cup milk and egg yolks.  Mix and stir; add remaining milk.  Cook until thick, then add butter and vanilla.  This can also be used for a pie.  I use miniature marshmallows for my topping.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. diced apples
3  c. flour
1  c. Wesson oil
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat eggs well. Add sugar, 1/2 cup at a time, beating well. Add oil and beat.   Sift dry ingredients several times. Add apples, nuts and dry ingredients to oil mixture.  Beat well. Bake in greased tube pan 1 hour at 350°.

name: CARROTS A L'ORANGE
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots, cut into sticks and cooked
4  tsp. cornstarch
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. orange juice
4  Tbsp. butter
dash of ginger (optional)
preparation: Mix cornstarch and sugar in small saucepan.  Pour in orange juice and mix well.  Heat, stirring until thickened.   Stir in butter and ginger.  Pour over cooked carrots.

name: CHOCOLATE LUSH
ingredients:
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. flour
1  stick butter
preparation: Mix and press in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish; bake at 350° until flaky, 15 minutes.  Cool.

name: BANANA-ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine or butter
1 1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
1/2  c. sour cream
1 1/4  c. self-rising flour
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
3  large eggs
1/3  tsp. salt
1  medium banana
1  medium orange
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Cream margarine/butter and sugar together.  Add sour cream, flour, 3 eggs and salt.  Squeeze orange juice through strainer.  Add mashed banana and orange juice to batter; mix well.  Pour batter into lightly greased and floured tube or Bundt pan.  Bake 30 minutes or until browned.  Makes approximate serving for 14.

name: OCTOBERFEST RIBS
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  jars sauerkraut, drained
1  Tbsp. caraway seed
2  medium onions, halved
2  tart, green apples, peeled and cut into wedges
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
2  lb. pork spareribs
preparation: In a Dutch oven, layer all ingredients in the order listed. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, 2 to 3 hours or until the ribs are tender. Yield: 6 servings.

name: CALICO BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can each: lima beans, kidney beans and butter beans
1 (28 oz.)  can pork and beans
1/4  lb. bacon, cut up
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  large onion, chopped
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  c. cider vinegar
1/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: Drain all beans and add to pork and beans.  Put into 2-quart casserole. Saute bacon and onion.  Add other ingredients.  Pour over bean mixture.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: QUICK FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
3/4  stick margarine
3/4  c. sifted flour
1 (No. 2)  can unsweetened fruit (cherries, peaches, strawberries, etc.)
2  tsp. baking powder
dash of salt
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Melt butter in casserole dish.  Mix flour and other dry ingredients with 1 cup sugar and milk.  Stir until well blended. Pour the batter into the butter.  Add 3/4 cup sugar to fruit and heat.  Pour into batter.  Bake in 350° oven until brown.

name: LAYERED JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  (6 oz.) strawberry jello
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
1  c. boiling water
2  small bananas, sliced
1  (8 oz.) crushed pineapple
1  (8 oz.) vanilla yogurt
preparation: Mix jello, strawberries and boiling water until dissolved. Add bananas and pineapple; mix.  Pour 1/2 of this mixture into bowl and chill until set, but not firm.  Add vanilla yogurt to remaining jello mixture and pour over other layer.  Makes about 10 to 12 servings.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans green beans
1  can mushroom soup
1  can Durkee French fried onions
3/4  c. milk
preparation: In a medium bowl, combine drained green beans, soup, milk and 3/4 of the can of onions.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.  Top with remaining onions and bake uncovered for 5 minutes.

name: "HALO-HALO"
ingredients:
1  pkg. flan, cooked and set
sweetened beans or garbanzos
palm seeds (in can or bottle)
jackfruit preserves (canned or in bottle)
Jell-O, cut into cubes
cooked yam, cut up into cubes
cream
shaved or crushed ice
3  c. cream of milk
vanilla ice cream (optional)
preparation: In a tall, wide glass, put 1 tablespoon each of the first 6 ingredients.  Fill the rest of the glass with shaved or crushed ice.  Pour 1/4 cup cream or milk over the ice.  Top with a scoop of ice cream, if desired, and serve.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  medium squash
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
1  onion, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  pkg. Mexican cornbread mix
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cut up squash and boil in salted water until tender. Sauté in butter the chopped pepper, onion and celery. Combine the drained squash, sautéed vegetables, soups, cornbread mix and drained corn. Add 1 cup of grated cheese to mixture. Pour into greased 11 x 13 casserole dish and cover with remaining cheese. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes. Be sure and cover with foil and last 5 minutes take off foil and brown for 5 minutes. Serves 6 to 8 people.

name: MOCK LASAGNE
ingredients:
7  oz. elbow macaroni
1  lb. Italian sausage
1 1/2  c. Ricotta cheese
1/2  tsp. basil leaves, crushed
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic
6  oz. Mozzarella shredded cheese
preparation: Brown sausage; drain off fat. Add salt, pepper, garlic and basil. Add 1/2 cup water. Cover and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  In a 2-quart casserole dish, layer 1/2 each starting with macaroni, Ricotta cheese, shredded cheese, then meat sauce; repeat.  Cook at 375° for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.  Serve with salad and garlic bread.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  chicken breasts, cooked
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1 medium  c. sour cream
2  pkg. Ritz crackers
salt
pepper
1  stick margarine or butter
preparation: Cook chicken breasts.  Cut in small pieces.  Mix together chicken, sour cream, salt and pepper.  Crush Ritz crackers.  Mix with melted butter or margarine.

name: APPLE NUT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1 1/4  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  c. diced apples
1  c. black walnuts
preparation: Mix sugar, eggs, oil and vanilla in one bowl.  In a second bowl, mix flour, salt, soda and cinnamon.  Blend the mixtures together.  Fold in apples and black walnuts.  Bake in greased and floured angel cake pan at 320° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2  oz. chocolate (2 sq. or 1/2 c. cocoa)
1  c. sugar
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. flour
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Melt butter and chocolate in saucepan.  Blend in sugar.  Add eggs.  Blend dry ingredients together and add to batter.  Stir in vanilla.  Pour into 8 x 8 x 2-inch greased pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: SWEET PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can peas
2  hard-boiled eggs
1/4  c. chopped green onion
1/4  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. shredded carrots
1  Tbsp. diced pimento
1/3  c. to 1/2 c. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. pepper
croutons
preparation: Drain the  peas and dice the eggs.  Add all ingredients together with the mayonnaise.  Toss lightly.  Serve on lettuce and top with croutons.

name: SPINACH SALAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. red wine vinegar
2  tsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. fresh spinach (bite size pieces)
5  bacon strips, cooked and crumbled
2  hard-boiled eggs, sliced
preparation: Combine first 10 ingredients in a dressing jar; cover tightly and shake until mixed well and set aside.

name: GERMAN VERANICKS(Easy Way)
ingredients:
8  oz. lasagna noodles, boiled for 10 minutes, then drained
1  c. sour cream
1  c. cottage cheese
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. buttermilk
1 (12 oz.)  can milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix everything and place in casserole dish.  Dot with 1 cube butter.  Top with garlic and onion croutons.  Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour or until crusty brown.

name: OATMEAL LACE COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. quick oats (uncooked)
2  tsp. double acting baking powder
1  c. dark brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. melted margarine or oil
1  egg, beaten
1/2  tsp. almond flavor, if desired
preparation: Blend dry ingredients and add melted margarine or oil.  Add beaten egg and mix well.  Add flavoring, if used.  Drop from teaspoon on greased cookie sheet, leaving plenty of room to spread. Bake in moderate oven (350°) about 10 minutes.  Let stand a minute or so before removing from pan with spatula.

name: STRAWBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
3  c. sugar
3  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. salad oil
4  eggs, beaten
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1 1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine flour, sugar, soda, cinnamon and salt in a large bowl. Add salad oil and eggs.  Mix thoroughly.  Stir in strawberries and nuts.  Pour batter into two greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: CECILIA'S PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. rolled pretzels
1  stick melted oleo
1/2  c. sugar
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  pkg. Dream Whip
2 (20 oz.)  cans crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix oleo and sugar together; add pretzels and put all in a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Smooth with back of spoon to form crust.  Bake 10 minutes at 350°.  Let cool.  Mix Dream Whip following instructions on package.  Mix the Dream Whip and cream cheese until fluffy, about 2 minutes.  Pour 1/3 of mixture over the pretzel crust.  Add crushed pineapple.  Pour remaining cream cheese mixture over top. Top with reserved crushed pretzels and/or cherries.  Refrigerate.

name: WALDORF SALAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped walnuts
1/4  c. raisins
2  Tbsp. sugar
4  medium apples, cored and cubed (2 red and 2 green)
2/3  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: In large bowl, combine all ingredients.  Mix well.  Cover and refrigerate.

name: QUICHE LORRAINE
ingredients:
1  pie crust
1 1/2  c. (6 oz.) grated Swiss cheese
1  onion, minced and sauteed in margarine
8  slices crisp bacon, crumbled
3  eggs
1  c. heavy cream
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
dash of cayenne
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Sprinkle cheese and bacon into pastry lined pie pan.  Sprinkle onion on top of cheese and bacon.  Beat remaining ingredients together and pour over top.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until browned and firm.  Cool slightly.

name: MINI MEAT LOAVES
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup
2  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. fine dry breadcrumbs
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/4  c. fine chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. thyme
2 to 4  tsp. water
preparation: Mix thoroughly 1/4 cup soup, beef, breadcrumbs, egg, onion, salt, 1/8 teaspoon pepper and 1/8 teaspoon thyme.  Shape firmly into mini meat loaves.  Brown in skillet; pour off fat.  Stir in remaining soup, pepper, thyme and water.  Cover and cook over low heat 20 to 30 minutes.  Stir and baste occasionally.  I serve this with mashed potatoes, steamed broccoli and either canned peaches or pears for dessert.  Serves 4 to 6, depending on size of meat loaves.

name: DELUXE FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. evaporated milk
2  envelopes Nestle Choco Bake
1/2  tsp. salt
1  large (7 to 8 oz.) Hershey bar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, salt and milk in 2-quart saucepan. Bring to boil over moderate heat, stirring constantly. Boil for 2 minutes (rolling boil). Remove from heat; add Hershey bar, broken in pieces, Choco Bake and vanilla. Stir until chocolate melts and mix is well blended. Spread in 9-inch square pan. Chill until firm. Cut into squares. Makes 2 pounds.

name: MARZETTI
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  small green pepper, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1  can tomato soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  tsp. garlic
1  tsp. chili powder
dash of each: oregano, pepper, and salt
1 small  pkg. egg noodles
sliced cheese (you decide)
preparation: Cook ground beef, green peppers and onions until browned. Add soups and spices. Boil noodles until tender. Drain noodles and stir with beef and soup mixture. Place in baking dish and top with slices of cheese. Bake at 350 degree in oven until cheese melts.

name: CHOP SUEY
ingredients:
2  lb. cubed beef, browned
4  Tbsp. molasses
6  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  can Chinese vegetables or 1 c. cut-up celery and 1/2 c. chopped onion
1  can bean sprouts
1  can mushrooms, drained
preparation: Cover beef, molasses and  soy sauce with water and stew until tender.  Add  Chinese  vegetables and bean sprouts.  Add mushrooms.	Serve over Chinese noodles or rice.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE(Casserole)
ingredients:
1  cut up chicken or its equivalent
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can French onion soup
1  can sliced mushrooms (optional)
1 1/2  c. converted rice
