1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
preparation: In a mixing bowl, stir together mushroom soup, French onion soup, mushrooms, rice and onion soup mix, along with 2 cans of water.  (Use the empty soup cans for measuring water.)  Pour mixture into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Arrange chicken on top of mixture. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 2 hours.  Foil may be removed during the last 1/2 hour so chicken can brown.

name: MORNING GLORY MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
2  c. carrots, grated
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. walnuts or pecans, chopped
1/2  c. coconut
1  apple, peeled and chopped
3  eggs
1  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift together flour, sugar and baking powder.  Add salt and cinnamon.  Stir in carrots, raisins, nuts, coconut and apples.  In other bowl, whisk eggs, oil and vanilla.  Add to flour mixture and stir just until combined.  Spoon into well-greased and floured muffin tins, filling to top.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until done.  Let cool in tins for 5 minutes, then put on rack to cool.  Makes 30.

name: RHUBARB PIE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. flour
1  c. sugar
2  c. rhubarb, cut up
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour ingredients into unbaked pie shell.  Cover with top pie crust.  Vent top of pie crust with 5 to 6 slits.  Place on cookie sheet.  Bake 10 minutes at 425°, then 35 minutes at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped, frozen broccoli
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. oleo
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
1/2  c. rice, cooked in 1 1/2 c. water
preparation: Cook rice; set aside.  Cook broccoli by recipe on box; drain and set aside.  Saute onions in oleo.  Add soup and 1 can water. Add broccoli, Cheez Whiz and rice.  Mix together, put into casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until mixture is bubbly.  Stir gently after mixture has cooked for about 15 minutes and sprinkle top with cracker crumbs and paprika. Serves 8.

name: THREE-CHEESE MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground round
1  large onion, chopped
2/3  c. bread crumbs (optional)
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  green pepper
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. paprika
1 1/2  c. milk
2  tsp. Italian seasoning
3  c. Mozzarella cheese, cubed
3/4  c. Swiss cheese, grated
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Mix in a large bowl with hands the meat, onion, green pepper, bread crumbs, pepper, salt, paprika, Italian seasoning, eggs (beaten with milk) and cheeses.  Don't overmix.  Use pan bigger than meat loaf.  Shape into loaf.  Bake at 350°  for 1 hour.  May cook ahead.  Use microwave to warm up.  Sprinkle the top with Italian seasoning.  Serve with mustards, chutneys or hot curried fruit.

name: FROZEN APRICOT DESSERT
ingredients:
12  oz. box vanilla wafers (crushed)
1/2  stick oleo
1  tsp. almond extract
2  pkg. slivered almonds (toasted)
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
2  lb. jar apricot preserves
preparation: Melt  oleo  and add almond extract and toasted almonds. Mix this  with  crushed wafers.  Put half of mixture in bottom of large  (13  x 9-inch) oblong dish.  Slice ice cream and put half of it over wafers.  Place layer of apricot preserves (use all) over  ice  cream.  Add  another  layer of ice cream.  Add remainder of  wafers  on  top.  Freeze.  To serve, add whipped cream.  Serves 18.

name: IMPOSSIBLE COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
3/4  stick butter
1 3/4  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
1/2  c. self-rising flour
1 3/4  c. shredded coconut
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, blending mixture after each egg.  Add milk and flour (alternating) a little of each at a time, blending well.  Add lemon juice and blend.  Add coconut and blend.  Pour in a 9-inch pie pan and bake 45 minutes at 350°.  Grease your pie pan.

name: MASHED POTATO CRUST
ingredients:
1  c. water
1 1/3  c. Potato Buds
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1/4  c. green onion, chopped
preparation: Grease pie plate.  Prepare potatoes and 1 slightly beaten egg and green onion.  Spread in pie plate evenly.  Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes or until light brown.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine, softened
1/2  lb. graham cracker crumbs
1  jar (small) crunchy peanut butter
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans
1  box confectioners sugar
1  pkg. dark or light chocolate bark bars
preparation: Mix all ingredients (except chocolate bars) well.  Roll into small  balls.  Melt  chocolate  bars.  Drop  balls	into melted chocolate.	Let  cool  on  wax  paper.  Store  in cool place.

name: BRUNCH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  slices white bread
1/2  c. melted butter (unsalted)
2  c. cubed ham
2  c. fresh broccoli, cooked and chopped
2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cube bread and place in melted butter; toss well.  In buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole, layer half of the bread cubes, half Cheddar cheese, half of the broccoli, all of the cubed ham, then layer remaining broccoli, cheese and bread.  Beat eggs and milk thoroughly with seasoning.  Pour over all layers.  Refrigerate overnight or at least several hours.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour, until puffy and nicely browned.  Serves 6.

name: BUTTERMILK SALAD
ingredients:
1  large strawberry or lime jello
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  pkg. frozen coconut
1  c. chopped nuts
2  c. buttermilk
1 (9 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Heat jello and pineapple until jello dissolves.  Cool slightly.  Add buttermilk and other ingredients.  Refrigerate several hours and serve.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. grated carrots
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  c. nuts
1  c. crushed pineapple
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Add pineapple, nuts and carrots last.

name: MINTED FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. orange juice
1/3  c. ReaLemon lemon juice from concentrate
1/3  c. water
1/4  tsp. peppermint extract
8  c. cut-up assorted fresh fruits
preparation: In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients, except fruit; stir until sugar dissolves.  Place fruit in a large shallow dish; pour ReaLemon brand mixture over it.  Cover; chill 3 hours or overnight, stirring occasionally.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. corn syrup
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. flavoring (vanilla or maple)
3  qt. popped corn
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients and place over medium heat.  Bring to a boil and let boil 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and add soda and flavoring.  Pour over popped corn; stir to coat and spread on cookie sheet.  Bake for 1 hour at 250°, stirring every 15 minutes.

name: CRISPY CHOCOLATE BARS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1/2 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch morsels
1/2  c. peanut butter
5  c. corn flakes
preparation: In large saucepan, combine chocolate and butterscotch morsels and peanut butter. Stir over low heat until smooth. Remove from heat. Add corn flakes. Stir until mixed. Using buttered spatula or waxed paper, press mixture evenly into 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan that's been sprayed with cooking spray. Cut when cool.

name: APRICOT BLUSH PUNCH
ingredients:
2  c. apricot nectar
1 (12 oz.)  can lemonade concentrate
1 (12 oz.)  can orange juice concentrate
2  c. strong tea (4 tea bags in 2 c. boiling water)
1 1/2  c. sugar
6  c. water
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Serve over crushed ice.  Garnish with orange, lemon and lime slices.

name: FRUIT BOWL
ingredients:
1  can pineapple tidbits
1  can sliced peaches
2  to 3 bananas
2  to 3 red apples
3  kiwi fruit, peeled
1  c. sliced strawberries (optional)
1 1/4  c. sugar
preparation: In a large bowl, empty pineapple and peaches with their juices.  Add sliced bananas, cubed apples, sliced kiwi and cubed oranges.  Sprinkle sugar over fruit and stir.

name: CRAB CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can crab meat or  6 oz. frozen
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. milk
1  c. grated sharp cheese
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  c. seashell macaroni (uncooked)
dash of pepper
preparation: Mix everything together in a bowl; store in refrigerator about 8 hours.  Pour into a casserole dish; bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: FAVORITE BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
6 to 8  slices bread (2 c.)
3  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
3/4  c. raisins
preparation: Layer the bread in a baking bowl.  Sprinkle the raisins over the bread.  Beat eggs; add sugar, milk, vanilla and nutmeg.  Pour over bread and sprinkle with a little more nutmeg.  Set in a pan of hot water and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until set.

name: WEST TEXAS TORTILLA SOUP
ingredients:
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  tsp. cumin
2  cans chicken broth
2  cans (14 1/2 oz.) stewed tomatoes, undrained, chopped
1  c. Picante Sauce
1/2  c. chopped cilantro
8  oz. provolone or Monterey Jack cheese, cut into 1/4-inch cubes
4  corn tortillas, cut into 2x1/4-inch strips
preparation: Cook garlic in butter in large saucepan, 2 minutes.  Add cumin; cook and stir 1 minute.  Add broth, tomatoes, picante and bring to boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer 30 minutes.  Remove from heat, stir in cilantro.  Place 1/4 cup of cheese in bottom of 8 soup bowls.  Ladle 1 cup soup over cheese; top with tortilla strips.  Makes 8 servings.

name: TACO PIE DIP
ingredients:
1  small tub of softened cream cheese (onion & chive flavored)
1  jar chunky salsa
1/4  cup chopped green onions
1  can chopped black olives (pitted)
2  or 3 cups-shredded taco cheese
preparation: Spread ingredients in order as above on 10 inch pie plate or dish at least that size.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: CRANBERRY DELIGHT!
ingredients:
1  box strawberry sugar-free Jell-O
1 (12 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  prepared angel food cake
2 to 3  c. fresh strawberries or 2 cartons frozen strawberries
preparation: Prepare Jell-O as per package directions.  Stir in Cool Whip until well blended.  Tear up angel food cake into small pieces and add to mixture.  Add strawberries.  Chill until Jell-O sets.

name: GOLDEN MEATBALL CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
2  c. water (or more)
1  c. uncooked rice
2  large carrots, sliced or coarsely shredded
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  lb. cubed cheese
preparation: Mix ground  beef,  bread crumbs, egg and salt together. Make 18 meatballs; brown in oil on all sides.  Drain and add 2 cups water  or more.  Add uncooked rice, carrots, green pepper and onion.  Cover  and	simmer 25 minutes.  Add cheese and let melt.

name: WACKY CAKE
ingredients:
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. unsweetened cocoa
1  c. cold water
1/2  tsp. vanilla
6  Tbsp. Crisco oil
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: You will need a 2 x 9 x 9-inch baking pan, ungreased.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
5  or 6 eggs
3  c. plain flour
3  c. sugar
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. Crisco
1  c. sweet milk
2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: ENGLISH TOFFEE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  egg yolk
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. cake flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. finely chopped pecans
1  egg white, beaten until frothy
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Add egg yolk.  Add sifted dry ingredients and mix.  Add vanilla and 1/2 cup chopped nuts.   Mix well.  Press dough in greased tin (10 x 15-inch).  Spread egg white over dough in pan.  Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 30 minutes.  Cut cookies while warm.  Makes three dozen.

name: HAMBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (16 oz.)  can cut green beans, drained
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
3  c. mashed potatoes
1/2  c. chopped onion
dash of pepper
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can tomato soup
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Add green beans and soup.  Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.   Spoon mashed potatoes on top of meat mixture.  Sprinkle cheese over potatoes.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  fryer or 1/2 hen
2  eggs
oil
1/4  c. milk
all-purpose flour
self-rising flour
1  can cream of chicken or celery soup
1 small  can evaporated milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook chicken until tender and debone. Set aside.  Beat eggs until frothy.  Add a little oil and milk.  Add enough all-purpose flour to make stiff enough to handle (not too stiff). Roll out on self-rising flour, very thin.  Cut with round biscuit cutter.  Add to chicken broth that is simmering. Turn with fork when all dough has been used.  Add chicken or celery soup and canned milk. Simmer until done.  Add chicken along with dumplings.

name: CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
2  lb. Velveeta, cubed
2  cans Ro-Tel and peppers, drain and save juice
1  can Hormel chili
1 1/2  tsp. cumin powder
1  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Melt cheese.  Add other ingredients and mix well (use juice from Ro-Tel to thin, if needed).

name: BETTER EVERY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow pudding cake mix
20 oz  can crushed pineapple
1  c. sugar
1  pkg. instant butter pecan pudding
1  large container cool whip
nuts
preparation: Bake a yellow pudding cake. Use a 13x9 in pan. Five minutes before cake is done, beat a large can of pineapple (not drained) and 1 cup of sugar together and boil 5 minutes. Remove cake and pour hot pineapple mixture over the top. Mix 1 pkg. instant butter pecan pudding mix according to directions and spread over cake. Spread a large container of cool whip over pudding. Sprinkle with coconut and nuts, Be generous. Chill and serve.

name: Chow Mein Hot Dish
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
6  small onions, chopped
2  bunches celery, trimmed and chopped
1 (8 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms
2  cans chicken with rice soup
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
12  oz. chow mein noodles
8  oz. cashew nuts
preparation: Brown meat with onions and celery; drain fat.  Add soups.  Add a little milk if more moisture is desired.  Add mushrooms.

name: CRANBERRY RELISH
ingredients:
1  c. ground raw cranberries
1  c. sugar
1  c. chopped apples
1  c. diced celery
1/2 to 1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Mix well.  Leave set a day.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  sq. chocolate
2  Tbsp. butter
1/3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. sweet milk
3  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt chocolate and butter in double boiler.  Scald milk and add to chocolate mixture.  Mix flour, sugar and salt together. Beat egg yolk and add dry ingredients to eggs.  Add 1 cup hot mixture to egg mixture.  Mix well and add to chocolate mixture in double boiler.  Cook until thick, stirring constantly.  Let cool. Add vanilla and put in baked pie crust.  Beat egg whites and put on pie.  Bake until meringue is browned.

name: CORN BREAD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can cream-style corn
1  c. sour cream
1  box Jiffy corn bread mix
2  eggs, beaten
1  stick butter, melted
preparation: Mix all ingredients and put into casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: BLUEBERRY PIE
ingredients:
4  c. fresh blueberries (cherries or blackberries work great, too)
3/4  c. sugar (1/4 c. more if berries aren't sweet)
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. butter/margarine
2  pie crusts
1  Tbsp. milk
2  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  In a large bowl, combine blueberries, 3/4 cup sugar, flour, 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon and lemon juice.  Toss gently to mix.  Spoon into crust and dot with margarine.  Top with second crust.  Seal and flute edges.  Cut slits in top.  Brush with milk and sprinkle with 2 teaspoons sugar and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake at 425° for 45 to 55 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Cover edge of crust with strips of aluminum foil after the first 20 minutes.

name: CREAM PUFFS(Or Chocolate Eclairs)
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. boiling water
1  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
4  large eggs
preparation: Melt butter in boiling water.  Add flour and salt. Cook, stirring constantly until mixture forms a ball that does not separate, approximately 7 minutes.  Remove from heat and cool for 10 minutes. Add eggs, one at a time beating after each addition until mixture is smooth and eggs are completely incorporated.  Drop from spoon 2 inches apart onto a greased baking sheet.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.  Reduce heat to 325° and continue baking for another 25 minutes.  Cool completely before filling.

name: CRANBERRY CHUTNEY
ingredients:
4  c. (1 lb.) cranberries
1  c. seedless raisins
1 2/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
1  c. water
1  medium onion, chopped
1  medium apple, pared, cored and chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
preparation: Combine cranberries, raisins, sugar, cinnamon, ginger, cloves and water in a large saucepan.  Cook 15 minutes, until berries pop and mixture thickens.

name: GLADYS' BEANS
ingredients:
2 (14 oz.)  cans pork and beans
1/2  c. Brooks catsup
3/4  c. corn flakes
1/4  c. sugar
2  strips bacon, chopped fine
1  small onion, chopped fine
dash of cinnamon
dash of nutmeg
preparation: Combine all ingredients in casserole dish.  Cook, covered, 1 hour in a 350° oven.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
1  medium chopped onion
1 (17 oz.)  can creamed corn
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  chopped jalapeno pepper
6  slices cooked, crumbled bacon
preparation: Heat iron  skillet with bacon grease (left from cooking the bacon).  Sprinkle  a  pinch of cornmeal in pan until brown (to know when pan is hot).

name: VEGETABLE LASAGNA
ingredients:
6  lasagna noodles
1 1/2  c. part skim Ricotta cheese
1/4  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
2  c. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1  c. Mozzarella cheese, shredded (may use Cheddar or Jack)
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach
1/2  tsp. dried basil, crushed
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  c. spaghetti sauce
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook  lasagna  noodles	as  directed.  Cook  and  drain spinach.  Combine  Ricotta, basil and oregano.  Cook mushrooms and onion in  microwave in 1/4 cup water, then drain.  Add the spaghetti sauce to mushrooms and heat.

name: HOT APPETIZER PIE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. milk
1 (2 1/4 oz.)  jar dried beef, cut fine
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  c. chopped pecans
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Thin the cream cheese with milk.  Add all other ingredients except pecans and butter and place in an 8-inch Pyrex pie plate. Brown pecans in butter and pour on top.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Serve hot with crackers.

name: SPICED TEA
ingredients:
1/2  c. instant tea
2  c. Tang
4  Tbsp. lemonade mix
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ground cloves
2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and store in a jar or decanter. Use 2 rounded teaspoonfuls in a cup of boiling water.

name: PHILLY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2  sticks oleo (not soft kind)
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
4  eggs
2  c. sifted cake flour or 1 3/4 c. regular flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
confectioners sugar
preparation: Combine sugar, softened cream cheese, oleo and vanilla, mixing until well blended.  Add eggs; mix at low speed of electric mixer until blended.  Stir together flour and baking powder.  Gradually add flour mixture to cheese mixture, mixing at low speed until blended.  Pour into lightly greased and floured angel food pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.  Let cool about 5 minutes before removing from pan.  Sprinkle top with confectioners sugar.

name: HASH BROWN BAKE
ingredients:
8  hash brown potato patties
1  can either cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
1  (8 oz.) container of sour cream
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Coat a glass baking dish with butter or margarine; place potato patties, side by side.  Mix all remaining ingredients, except 1 cup of grated cheese for topping.  Spread mixture over potato patties.  Top with remaining grated Cheddar cheese.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
3/4  lb. ground beef
1/4  lb. sausage
1  garlic clove, minced
1  Tbsp. basil or Italian seasoning
2 1/2  Tbsp. salt
1  lb. fresh or canned tomatoes
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
9  to 12 lasagna noodles
3  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  lb. Mozzarella cheese, grated
preparation: Brown beef and sausage and drain.  Add garlic, basil, 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, tomatoes and tomato paste.  Simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Cook noodles in boiling water. Drain and rinse in cold water.  In a bowl, combine cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese, parsley, eggs, 1 teaspoon salt and pepper.

name: SALMON PATTIES
ingredients:
1  can pink salmon
1  egg
1/3  c. minced onion
1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  Tbsp. shortening
preparation: Drain salmon. Set aside 2 tablespoons of the juice.  In a medium bowl, mix salmon, egg and onion until sticky.  Stir in flour.  Add baking powder to salmon juice.  Stir into salmon mixture.  Form into small patties and fry until golden brown in hot shortening.

name: PEANUT SWEET POTATO BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. mashed sweet potatoes
1/2  c. crunchy peanut butter
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  egg, beaten
2  Tbsp. molasses
about 1/2 c. crushed cornflakes
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except cornflakes; blend well. Shape into balls. Roll in cornflake crumbs. Place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 375° for 15 or 20 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  beaten egg
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  tsp. baking soda
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. shredded pumpkin
1  c. sour milk
preparation: Mix dry ingredients, then add egg, oil and milk.  Spoon into a greased 12-hole muffin tin.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Check sooner.

name: ORANGE JELLO
ingredients:
1 sm.  can crushed pineapple
1  pkg. orange jello
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. cool whip
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserve juice. Add enough water to juice to make 2 cups. Heat to boiling point. Add jello, cream cheese until smooth. Fold in cool whip and pineapple.

name: PLUM GOOD CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. ground cloves
2  jars plum baby food
1  c. nuts
1  c. oil
preparation: Mix well; bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN MARINADE MARIE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  jar apricot preserves
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1  bottle Russian salad dressing
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Marinate chicken in sauce for 14 hours. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.  Turn after 1/2 hour.  Recipe makes enough for approximately 3 pound cut up chicken.

name: SOUR CREAM CUTOUT SANDIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. broken pecans
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/3  c. shortening
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1/3  c. dairy sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
Lemon Glaze
chopped pecans or pistachios
preparation: Grind the 1/2 cup pecans with a food grinder, food processor or blender.  Combine ground pecans, flour and baking powder.  In a large mixer bowl beat butter and shortening until butter is softened.  Add sugar and beat until fluffy.  Add egg, sour cream and vanilla and beat well.  Add flour mixture and beat until well mixed.  Divide dough in half.  Cover and chill at least 3 hours or until easy to handle.

name: QUICK MEAT PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
1  can tomato soup
1  can green beans, drained
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. mashed potatoes
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In frypan, brown beef and onions.  Add salt.  Drain fat.  Add soup, green beans and pepper.  Simmer 5 minutes.  Pour into a greased 1-quart casserole dish.  Drop potatoes in mounds onto hot meat mixture.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: WASSAIL
ingredients:
2  qt. apple cider
1  qt. pineapple juice
2 large  cans frozen orange juice
2 large  cans frozen lemon juice
2  Tbsp. whole cloves, tied in a bag
4  sticks cinnamon
2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix thoroughly; simmer for 30 minutes.  Serve hot.  Will keep in the refrigerator 4 weeks.

name: SLOPPY JOES
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, diced
1/2  c. ketchup
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can chicken gumbo soup
preparation: Cook beef and onion in 1/2 cup water until brown.  Add ketchup, mustard and soups and simmer for 10 minutes.

name: ROSEMARY/GARLIC CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  to 8 large pieces of chicken
2  1/2 cubes butter or margarine
1 1/2  tsp. garlic (fresh)
4  sprigs rosemary, cut in 4-inch lengths
salt and pepper to taste
1  Tbsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1/2  c. white wine
preparation: Melt 1 1/2 cubes butter or margarine in large skillet.  Add fresh garlic and 2 sprigs fresh rosemary.  Salt and pepper chicken.

name: SOUR CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
preparation: Beat eggs until light.  Add sugar and mix well, then add sour cream.  Next, combine flour, soda and cream of tartar; add to egg mixture, stirring in a little at a time.  Add vanilla last.  Bake at 350° until toothpick comes out clean.

name: VENISON STEAK AND GRAVY
ingredients:
8  slices venison steaks
1  large onion, sliced thin
4  Tbsp. cooking oil
2  cans mushroom soup (small)
2 equal  cans water
1  lb. sliced mushrooms or can of mushrooms
salt and pepper
3  lb. rabbit
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
some pepper
1  large sliced onion
1/4  c. margarine (butter or fat)
1  c. chicken or rabbit stock
2  Tbsp. paprika
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Cut rabbit in pieces and roll in flour that has been seasoned with salt and some pepper.  Let stand while you cook onion in margarine.  When onion is wilted, add rabbit and brown on all sides.  Pour chicken or rabbit stock in the pan; add paprika and cook.  Simmer until the rabbit is tender.  Remove to a dish and keep warm.  Bring sauce in the pan to a boil.  Stir in sour cream. Add salt if necessary and lemon juice.  Heat, but don't boil, and pour over the rabbit.  Serve with rice or noodles, to 6.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. water
2  eggs, well beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. raisins
1  lb. loaf day old sliced bread, torn into pieces
3/4  c. powdered milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. melted margarine
preparation: Blend together water and powdered milk.  Mix eggs, salt, vanilla and sugar together and stir into milk mixture. Add raisins and margarine.  Mix bread into liquid until lightly moistened. Bake in well-greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

name: HAM AND CHEESE ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. party rolls
1  lb. deli sliced ham
1/3  lb. Swiss cheese, thin
2  sticks margarine
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
3  Tbsp. poppy seed
3  Tbsp. mustard
2  Tbsp. minced dry onion
preparation: Soak onions in hot water until soft, drain.  Mix sauce, poppy seeds, mustard and onions together.  Melt margarine and brush on inside of split rolls.  Spread poppy seed mixture on inside of rolls.  Add ham and cheese.  Put tops on rolls and brush margarine. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 400° for 10 minutes.  Serve hot.

name: LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1  can small frozen lemonade
1  small container Cool Whip
2  pie crusts
preparation: Mix first three ingredients and pour into pie crusts. Refrigerate.

name: LELA'S PINEAPPLE CAKE ICING
ingredients:
1 large (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
2  c. sugar
1/2  stick margarine
4  cake layers made by the 1-2-3-4 Cake recipe
preparation: Mix pineapple and sugar and boil for 20 minutes.  Add margarine and boil 10 minutes more.  Remove from heat and put pan in a pan of cold water.  Cool, then beat until thickness to spread on cake.

name: CHOCO-MINT FREEZE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. finely crushed vanilla wafers (28)
4  Tbsp. melted butter
1  qt. peppermint stick ice cream, softened
1  tsp. vanilla
2  sq. (2 oz.) unsweetened chocolate
3  well beaten egg yolks
1 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1/2  c. chopped pecans
3  egg whites
preparation: Toss together crumbs and butter.  Reserve 1/4 cup crumb mixture; press the rest into a 9 x 9  x 2-inch pan.  Spread with ice cream and freeze. Melt 1/2 cup butter and chocolate over low heat; gradually stir into egg yolks with the sugar, nuts and vanilla.  Cool.  Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form.  Beat chocolate mixture until smooth; fold in egg whites.  Spread chocolate mixture over ice cream; top with reserved crumb mixture. Freeze.  Makes 8 large servings.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1  egg, beaten
1  onion, chopped fine
3/4 to 1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix dry ingredients together.  Blend in egg, onion and buttermilk.  Do not mix too long.  Drop by spoonfuls into hot grease. Fry until golden brown.  Drain on paper towels.

name: MAN'S BEST BURGER
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1/2  cup butter, soften
1  garlic clove, crushed
2  Tbsp. steak sauce
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. liquid smoke
1  tsp. hot pepper sauce
2  tsp. black pepper
1 1/2  tsp. season salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Divide into 4 parts.  Grill on medium heat until done.  Butter 4 buns and place on grill for 1 minute.  Top with lettuce, tomato, red onion and bacon.  Enjoy!

name: SUGAR FREE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1 lg.  pkg. (sugar free) vanilla pudding
1 regular size  can of crushed pineapple, drained
1  pt. sour cream, (lite)
preparation: Mix pudding and pineapple well. Fold in sour cream. You can add walnut bits. Put in a pie crust and chill. Refrigerate leftovers.

name: CHOCOLATE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. plus 3 Tbsp. reduced calorie margarine, softened
1 1/3  c. sugar
8  egg whites
1/2  c. nonfat sour cream alternative
1/3  c. evaporated skimmed milk
2  tsp. vanilla extract
1 1/3  c. all-purpose unbleached flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. unsweetened cocoa
vegetable cooking spray
Creamy Chocolate Frosting (recipe to follow)
preparation: Beat margarine at medium speed of electric mixer until fluffy. Gradually add sugar and beat well.  Add egg whites, sour cream, milk and vanilla; beat well.  Combine flour and next 3 ingredients; stir well.  Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan coated with cooking spray.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool on a wire rack.  Frost with Creamy Chocolate Frosting and cut into 24 squares.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1  c. raw rice
1  can water
1  can cream of onion soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
cut up fryer
Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Basting a turkey all night is "for the birds!"  Rub thawed turkey with melted butter.  Stuff it with onion, celery and potato; salt and pepper bird.  Place in covered container.  Add 5 to 6 cups hot water.  Cover pan with foil, then put lid on.  Preheat oven to 500°.  Place pan in oven and bake at 500° for 1 hour, then turn oven off and leave overnight (don't open oven door!).

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. Karo syrup
3  eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. pecans, chopped
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Mix eggs, sugar and Karo.  Add salt and vanilla.  Pour over pecans in unbaked pie shell and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: SEASONED SALT
ingredients:
1  c. salt
2  tsp. thyme
2  tsp. oregano, crushed
2  tsp. garlic powder
2  tsp. onion powder
2  tsp. curry powder
4  tsp. dry mustard
4  tsp. paprika
preparation: Combine all ingredients and place in shaker container.

name: COPPER PENNIES
ingredients:
2  lbs. fresh carrots
2  med. onions, thinly sliced and separated in rings
1 med. green pepper,  cup in thin strips
1  can tomato soup
3/4  cup vinegar
2/3  cup sugar
1/2  cup oil
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook carrots in boiling salted water 8-10 minutes until just tender.  Drain and slice into 1/4 inch slices.  Toss with onion and green pepper in a large bowl.  Stir together remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables.  Cover and marinate in refrigerator overnight.  Keeps several days in refrigerator.

name: CHICKEN STUFFING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. skinless and boneless chicken breasts, (1 lb.)
1  pkg. Stove Top stuffing mix for chicken
2  cans cream of chicken soup
preparation: Prepare stuffing according to package instructions.  Cut chicken into cube size pieces.  Stir-fry chicken until done.  In a separate dish, you can heat the cream of chicken soup so it will already be warm.  Once chicken is cooked, soup is cooked and stuffing is done, combine all ingredients in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.  Place in oven at 325° for about 20 minutes.

name: EASY CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  cut up chicken
1  c. ketchup
1  c. cola
preparation: Mix ketchup with cola and pour over chicken.  Bake until tender, about 45 minutes.

name: RUM BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. broken pecans or walnuts
4  c. fine Nilla wafer crumbs (you need about 1 lb. cookies)
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa (not instant)
1/3  c. corn syrup (light)
3/4  c. bourbon, rum or brandy
1/2  c. sifted powdered sugar
1  tsp. instant coffee powder (optional)
preparation: Combine nuts, cookie crumbs, 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar, cocoa, corn syrup and liquor of choice.  Shape mixture into 1-inch balls. Combine 1/2 cup powdered sugar with coffee and roll cookies in mixture.  Makes 6 dozen.

name: DATE BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. chopped dates
1  egg
2  c. Rice Krispies
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
coconut
preparation: Melt butter.  Add sugar, beaten egg and dates.  Cook slowly for 10 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Add vanilla, nuts and Rice Krispies and mix well; let cool.  Shape into balls and roll in coconut.  Place on waxed paper.

name: SWEDISH SPRITZ COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg yolk
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Cream butter; add sugar a little at a time.  Mix together all ingredients.  Put 3/4 of dough mixture in a cookie press.  Press out onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Sprinkle with colored sugar and bake 8 minutes at 350°.  Watch to make sure they don't burn!

name: GRILLE SHRIMP WITH CREAM SAUCE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. virgin olive oil
1  small onion chopped
2 garlic  cloves minced
3/4  c. heavy cream (approximately)
1  Tbsp. butter
1  Bay leaf
1 12  oz. Worcestershire sauce
1 8  oz. white wine
1  lemon, peeled and sliced
3/4  lb. shrimp peeled and deveined
1 to 2  tsp. Cajun seasoning
1 to 2  Tbsp. olive oil
1/2  small onion chopped
preparation: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil.  Add bay leaf, worcestershire sauce, wine and lemon.  Allow to cook and reduce down by half.  In a separate skillet, sauté 1/2 onion in oil until transparent.  Add shrimp and toss in skillet with oil, onion and Cajun seasoning.  Remove from heat when cooked.  After sauce has reduced, stir in butter and heavy cream.  Allow to heat and cook through a minute or two.  Add shrimp, stir together and serve.

name: TENDER CUBE STEAK
ingredients:
cube steak
flour
water
shortening
preparation: Roll cube steak in flour and salt mixture.  Brown on both sides in shortening; add water to meat and simmer on low until done.  The meat is real tender and makes its own gravy.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CUPS
ingredients:
1  c. creamy peanut butter
1/4  c. butter
2  c. confectioners sugar
12  oz. pkg. semi-sweet chocolate
preparation: Mix peanut butter, butter and confectioners sugar together. Chill for 2 hours.  Make into balls and dip in melted semi-sweet chocolate.

name: CHOW MEIN HOT DISH
ingredients:
1/2  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. mixed vegetables
1  c. chow mein noodles
1/2  lb. hamburger
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Brown hamburger; drain.  Add all ingredients.  Put in oiled casserole.  Top with crushed chips.  Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350°.

name: SIX CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. chopped oranges
1  c. pineapple chunks
1  c. chopped apples or grapes
1  c. flaked coconut
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Let stand for 2 or 3 hours before serving.  Garnish with red and green cherries for the holiday season or with unpeeled red chunks of apples for the Autumn.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked macaroni
1  can mushroom soup
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. milk
2  cans tuna
bread crumbs
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain and rinse.  Combine soup, milk, onion, salt and pepper.  Add macaroni and mix well.  Add enough extra milk to come to top of mixture in casserole dish.  Cover top with bread crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bacon
1/2  lb. ground meat
1  c. chopped onions
1  can green lima beans, drained
2  cans pork and beans, undrained
1  can kidney beans, undrained
1/2  c. ketchup
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. brown sugar
preparation: Mix well.  Bake in a 350° oven for 2 hours.

name: COMPANY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  1/2 lbs. ground beef
1 small  pkg. egg noodles
2  cans Cream of Chicken soup
2  bunches green onions, chopped
1  can tomato soup
1 small  carton sour cream
1 8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Brown ground beef and onions; drain.  Add all other ingredients, except cheese.  Cook for a few minutes until thoroughly heated.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Top with cheddar cheese.  Bake at 350 degrees until bubbly and cheese is melted.

name: EGG DROP SOUP(For when you feel under the weather.)
ingredients:
3  c. chicken stock
1  Tbsp. beef bouillon
1  Tbsp. chicken bouillon
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. cold water
2  eggs, slightly beaten
2  scallions, chopped
preparation: Bring chicken stock and bouillon to a boil.  Add cornstarch with cold water.  Thicken until clear.  Add scallions and stir. Add eggs, stirring gently with fork.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
2  ripe bananas, mashed
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. plus 1 Tbsp. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In large bowl, mix dry ingredients, then add other ingredients and mix well.  Pour into 9 x 5 x 3-inch baking pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.  Cool on wire rack.

name: HOT COCOA MIX
ingredients:
2  c. nondairy coffee cream
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. cocoa
1/2  c. instant dry milk powder
1/4  tsp. salt
marshmallows or whipped cream (optional)
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in large container and mix well. Store mix in an airtight container.

name: GUADALUPE FRIED CATFISH
ingredients:
3  lb. catfish fillets, cut thin
5  lb. potatoes, cut into thin French fries)
2  limes
4  large onions, sliced in rings
1  c. flour
1  c. corn meal
2  gal. peanut oil
Tony Chachere Cajun seasoning
preparation: Divide oil between two 12-quart pots and bring up to 350° (fish in one, potatoes and onions in the other). Slice fish. Season with lime juice and seasoning mix in 1 gallon Ziploc, combined with flour and corn meal.  Drop fish in hot oil and fry until done. Season onions and fries with Tony's seasoning and fry until done.  Serves 6 to 10 people. Serve with red sauce and tartar sauce.

name: UNBELIEVABLE LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1  c. water
1/2  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. biscuit mix
3  eggs
1/4  c. butter, softened
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients in blender except coconut.  Blend on low for 3 minutes.  Pour mixture into greased 10-inch pie plate.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Sprinkle coconut over top.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

name: SOP A(Mexican Side Dish)
ingredients:
2  cups elbow macaroni
1  tbsp oil
4  C water
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  cube beef bouillon
1/2  tsp garlic powder
1/2  tsp onion powder
1/4  tsp paprika
preparation: In medium saucepan, add cooking oil and elbow macaroni. Brown macaroni lightly. Add water and tomato sauce. Add seasonings.

name: CHRIS' SALSA
ingredients:
4  to 6 medium tomatoes, quartered
2 to 3  cloves garlic, cut
1  medium onion, cut
cilantro to taste
1/2  c. green onions, cut
1/8  c. lemon juice
salt to taste
green and yellow peppers, cut, to taste (optional)
preparation: Mix together.  Chop in a blender or use a salsa maker.  Keep refrigerated.

name: MOLASSES SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Crisco
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. molasses
2  eggs
4  tsp. baking soda
4  c. flour
1  tsp. each:  ginger and salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Melt Crisco in saucepan over low heat.  Remove from heat and cool.  Add sugar, molasses and eggs.  Beat well.  Add dry ingredients, mixing well.  Chill.  Form 1-inch balls and roll in granulated sugar.  Bake on greased cookie sheet at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: APPLE PANCAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. milk
1/2  stick butter
2  large apples
orange juice
preparation: Mix real well.  Heat oven to 425°.  In a large Pyrex pie plate, put in 1/2 stick of butter and put in oven while warming it.  Pour batter into pie plate when heat is at 425° and bake for 20 minutes.  Peel 2 large apples and slice as for pie and cook for 5 to 7 minutes (until soft) in 1/2 to 3/4 cup of orange juice. (Do this while pancake is baking.)  Spread cooked apples over pancake and put in oven for 5 minutes more.  Slice, eat and enjoy!

name: MEXICAN MEATBALL SOUP
ingredients:
1  large carrot, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1/8  c. olive oil
1 1/2  c. chicken stock
1 1/2  c. water
15  oz. consomme
1/8  c. tomato sauce
1/2  lb. lean ground beef
2  Tbsp. rice
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  egg
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
5  oz. frozen peas
1  Tbsp. fresh cilantro, chopped
preparation: Saute the carrots and onion in the olive oil.  Add the chicken stock, water, consomme and tomato sauce.  Simmer over low flame for 12 to 15 minutes.  Mix the beef, rice, egg, parsley, salt and pepper together to form small meat balls.  Bring the soup to a boil; add the meat balls, lower flame and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes.  Add the peas and cilantro and cook for an additional 5 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger meat
salt and pepper to taste
onion powder to taste
1  can cream of chicken soup
cheese slices
Tater Tots
preparation: In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, pat your hamburger in dish. Sprinkle salt, pepper and onion over meat.  Spread cream of chicken soup over that.  Cover soup with cheese slices.  Place Tater Tots over cheese.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: FAST EGGPLANT PARMESAN
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices
3  Tbsp. olive oil
salt and pepper
1  c. cottage cheese or part skim Ricotta
1  egg
2  c. part skim Mozzarella
1  tsp. dried oregano
2  Tbsp. chopped Italian parsley
1  c. prepared pasta sauce
preparation: Preheat broiler. Brush eggplant with olive oil. Sprinkle each slice with a pinch of salt and pepper. Put on baking sheet and broil until cooked through and tender, about 2 to 3 minutes on each side.

name: NEW ENGLAND CLAM SOUP
ingredients:
1  qt. quahogs, open, drain and reserve juice, straining thoroughly
1/4  lb. butter
1/4  small onion, minced
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. parsley, chopped
1  qt. whole milk
preparation: Chop clams coarsely.  Melt butter in top of double boiler over hot water.  Add rest of ingredients.  Add clam juice.  When hot, add clams and cook slowly 15 minutes.  If not to be used immediately, refrigerate or freeze.  Bring milk to a scald and add to clams.  Add seasoning to milk mixture and heat thoroughly. Serves 5.

name: YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
5  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. butter Crisco
4  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix water and yeast and let set for 10 minutes. Add flour, sugar and baking soda; mix with pastry blender until well blended, then add butter Crisco. Blend until looks like coarse crumbs. Add buttermilk. Blend well until ball forms. LET SET OVERNIGHT. DO NOT REFRIGERATE.

name: COCONUT SQUARES
ingredients:
6  eggs, well beaten
3  c. flour
salt and vanilla
3  c. sugar
3  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Pour over mixture 1 1/2 cups hot milk.  Bake at 350°.

name: 20 MINUTE SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  lb. boneless, skinless chicken, cut in cubes
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  clove garlic
1  c. green pepper strips
1  c. carrot strips
1  c. onion, quartered
1 1/4  c. chicken bouillon
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. dry sherry
3  Tbsp. vinegar
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. ginger
1 (8 oz.)  can chunk pineapple in juice
1 1/2  c. Minute rice
preparation: Brown chicken in oil and garlic.  Add vegetables and stir-fry 1 minute or until crisp-tender.  Combine bouillon, soy sauce, sherry, vinegar, brown sugar, ginger and pineapple with juice.  Bring to boil.  Stir in Minute rice.  Cover.  Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes.  Stir in chicken and vegetables and serve immediately. Serves 4.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour (all-purpose)
1/3  c. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. fresh or unthawed frozen blueberries
3/4  c. milk
1  egg
1/3  c. melted butter or margarine
preparation: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Stir in blueberries.  Add milk, egg and butter; mix just until dry ingredients are moistened.  The batter will be lumpy.  Do not overbeat.  Spoon batter into 2 1/2-inch greased muffin cups.  Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until tops spring back when lightly touched.  Serve warm.

name: AMISH CHEERIOS SQUARES
ingredients:
3  oz. pkg. jello (any flavor)
1/3  c. corn syrup
2  Tbsp. butter
4  c. Cheerios
preparation: Butter 9-inch square pan.  In a large saucepan, blend jello, syrup and butter.  Heat to boiling over medium heat, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Stir in Cheerios.  Spread mixture in pan and let set about 30 minutes.  Cut in squares.

name: GEORGIA SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
1  can crushed pineapple
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. minced celery
1 small  can pimientos
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in pineapple juice; heat to dissolve.  Mix cream cheese, pimientos, celery, salt, pineapple and pecans.  Add Jell-O.  Pour into mold.  Refrigerate.  Serves 10.

name: PARTY PINK SALAD
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple
1  box cherry jello
24  large marshmallows
1  can pecans
1  box small curd cottage cheese
1/2  pt. whipping cream
preparation: Drain juice from pineapple in pan.  Add 24 marshmallows over low heat; stir until dissolved.  Remove from heat; add jello. Stir until dissolved.  Add whipping cream, cottage cheese and nuts.  Pour into pan and let congeal.

name: CAULIFLOWER WITH A TANG
ingredients:
1  medium head cauliflower
1/2  c. fat-free mayonnaise
1.5  tsp. prepared mustard
1  green onion, sliced
1/2  c. grated reduced fat cheese
preparation: Cook cauliflower until crisp-tender. Drain well and place in serving dish. Combine mayonnaise, mustard and onion while cauliflower is cooking. Spoon over hot cauliflower. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover a few minutes until cheese is melted.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. sweet milk
5  c. flour
3  eggs
5  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening until fluffy.  Add eggs; beat well and add milk, then flour.  Beat well as you add flour and baking powder; flavor to taste with vanilla.  Drop by teaspoonfuls on well-greased cookie sheet.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
16  oz. pkg. frozen broccoli
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  tsp. basil leaves
1  c. shredded American cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  c. sour cream
8  oz. noodles, cooked and drained
preparation: Cook broccoli 6 minutes or until tender; drain in colander. In a 2-quart casserole over medium heat, cook onion and garlic until tender in margarine.  Stir in soup and seasoning.  Add cheeses, stirring until melted.  Stir in sour cream, broccoli and cooked noodles.  Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.  Makes 8 servings.

name: FROZEN CORN
ingredients:
9  c. corn
2  c. water
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Cook corn 5 minutes then cool.  Put into containers and freeze.

name: GREEN PEA AND ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can green peas (LeSueur)
1  can asparagus, chopped
3  boiled eggs, chopped
1/2  stack (20) saltine crackers, crushed
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. (grated) Cheddar cheese
milk
butter
preparation: Mix soup, cheese, milk and butter.  Pour over layered vegetables, eggs and crackers.  Bake approximately 30 to 40 minutes at 325°.

name: CHICKEN SOUP-BULGARIA(Pileshka Soopa)
ingredients:
1 1/2  pound chicken
5  Tbsp. oil
2  chopped onions
1  tsp. red pepper
2  dashes salt
1  tsp. flour
preparation: Cut chicken into pieces and saut in oil.  Take out.  Saut onions.  When soft, add red pepper, mix in salt and 1 quart water, bring to a boil.  Add chicken and simmer until soft.  Add 1/4 cup water to a boil with flour, stirring until flour is mixed thoroughly.  Add flour mixture to soup and stir well.  Serves 6.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. light Karo
1/2  c. dark Karo
3  eggs, beaten lightly
1  stick butter
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
2 1/2  c. chopped pecans
2  shallow pie shells
preparation: Cream  butter  and corn syrup (Karo).  Do this by hand, do not use mixer.	Add beaten eggs and mix.  Add vanilla, salt and pecans and  mix.	Pour into 2 pie shells and bake in 325° oven for 45 minutes.

name: APRICOT JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. apricot jello
1 (2 lb.)  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. ice water
1  pkg. Dream Whip, prepared
1/2  c. chopped pecans or English walnuts
preparation: Heat pineapple, cream cheese and sugar until cheese dissolves. Remove from heat and add jello and stir until dissolved.  Add ice water.  Mix well and place in refrigerator and let start to set. Then fold in prepared Dream Whip and nuts.  Return to refrigerator to let set.

name: STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
green peppers
tomato juice
1  lb. ground beef
3  Tbsp. chopped onions
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
1  c. rice
preparation: Wash peppers and cut  off  tops.  Set aside.  Mix beef, onions,  rice,  salt   and  pepper.  Fill  peppers  with  meat mixture.  Put 2 or 3  peppers  in quart jar, depending on size of peppers.  Fill with  tomato juice and add salt.  Process in pressure canner for 1 hour  and  30  minutes.  I  like to omit some rice and add some oatmeal.

name: PORK CHOPS IN ADOBO SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/4  c. vinegar
1  medium onion
2  cloves garlic
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  Tbsp. oil
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cumin
1/2  tsp. dried crushed oregano
6  pork chops
preparation: Place following ingredients in blender:  tomato sauce, vinegar, onion, garlic, flour, chili powder, oil, salt, oregano and cumin.   Blend well.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
4  c. peeled, cubed potatoes
1  c. sliced celery
1  c. chopped onion
2  c. water
2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1  c. whipping cream
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
1  Tbsp. dried parsley flakes
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook potatoes, celery, onion and salt in 2 cups water about 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Lightly mash potatoes and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until soup is hot and thickened.

name: SWISS VEGETABLE MEDLEY
ingredients:
1  bag (16 oz.) frozen broccoli, carrots and cauliflower combination, thawed and drained
1  can (10 3/4 oz.) condensed cream of mushroom soup
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese
1/3  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. ground black pepper
1  jar (4 oz.) chopped pimiento, drained (optional)
1  can (2.8 oz.) Durkee French Fried Onions
preparation: Combine vegetables, soup, 1/2 c. cheese, sour cream, pepper, pimiento and 1/2 can onions.  Pour into a 1 qt. casserole.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onions; bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  c. shortening
3  eggs
1  can pumpkin (2 c.)
3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. allspice
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Sift dry ingredients into mixing bowl.  Cream shortening and sugar into dry mixture.  Add eggs, pumpkin and vanilla.   Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 10 minutes at 350°, then decrease heat to 325° and bake for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: CUCUMBER SALAD
ingredients:
2  qt. sliced cucumbers (thin)
1  onion, sliced
2  Tbsp. canning salt
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
preparation: Mix and boil sugar and vinegar mixture to dissolve.

name: E-Z ONE DISH MEAL
ingredients:
1  lb. smoked sausage
1  bag frozen broccoli, carrots and cauliflower
1  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Slice smoked sausage and brown in saucepan.  Add vegetables. Cover and simmer on medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes.  Cover with cheese; heat until cheese melts.

name: MEXICAN FOOD
ingredients:
2  lbs. Hamburger
3  cans Tomato Sauce
1  can Cream of Mushroom Soup
1  pkg. Taco Seasoning
1  bag Tortilla Chips
1  pkg. Colby Cheese, shredded
preparation: Brown and drain hamburger.  Add tomato sauce, soup and taco seasoning to the hamburger and stir to a boil.  Line bottom of 9 x 13 in. baking dish with broken tortilla chips.  Sprinkle a thin layer of cheese over bottom.  Pour meat mixture over cheese. Cover with another layer of chips and remaining cheese.  Bake at 350 degrees approx. 20 min. or until cheese is melted.

name: TAMALE PIE
ingredients:
1/4  c. oil
2  onions, chopped
4  cloves garlic
1 large  can tomatoes
2  cans corn
2  c. milk
1  c. cornmeal
1  can pitted whole olives
2  eggs
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
salt to taste
preparation: Mix ingredients together well.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

name: BANANA SPLIT DESSERT
ingredients:
graham cracker crumbs
3  to 4 bananas
1/2  gal. Neapolitan ice cream
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  c. chocolate chips
1/2  c. softened margarine
2  c. powdered sugar
1 1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  tsp. vanilla
4  c. Cool Whip
preparation: Cover 11 x 15-inch pan with graham cracker crumbs.  Slice bananas over crumbs.  Slice ice cream 1/2-inch thick and place slices over bananas.  Sprinkle with nuts.  Place in freezer until firm.  Melt butter and chocolate chips over low heat.  Add sugar and milk and cook until thick, stirring constantly.  Cool and pour over crumb mixture.  Chill.  Add 1/4 cup powdered sugar and vanilla to Cool Whip.  Pour over all.  Freeze.  Serve in slices or squares. Serves approximately 25.

name: NO PEEK CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
3/4  c. uncooked rice
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of celery, chicken or mushroom soup
1  envelope onion soup mix
2 1/2  c. water
1  (2 to 2 1/2 lb.) chicken, cut into serving pieces
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a 3-quart oblong baking dish, combine uncooked rice, condensed cream soup and onion soup mix blended with water.  Arrange chicken on top.  Bake uncovered for 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until chicken is tender and rice is done.

name: PIZZA BURGERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef (lean)
1 1/2  c. shredded cheese
1  can tomato soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Fry the meat.  Stir in the cheese until it melts.  Take off heat, then add 1 can soup and mayonnaise.  Cool.  Spread on hamburger bun (open-face).  Put under broiler to heat through and serve.

name: EASY CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  small head cabbage
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Peel potatoes.  Slice like you would squash.  Roll in flour one piece at a time and fry until brown and done.  Real good.

name: CABBAGE SALAD (KAPUSTA)
ingredients:
6  small onions, chopped
2 1/2  c. green peppers, chopped
3  Tbsp. celery seed
3  Tbsp. mustard seed
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. vinegar
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  large cabbage
preparation: Shred cabbage, then heat all other ingredients together to a boil.  Pour hot mixture over cabbage and stir.  Cool.  Refrigerate in a sealed bowl.  Stir several times a day.  Make 3 to 4 days ahead for best flavor.

name: CONNIE'S FROZEN CITRUS PIE
ingredients:
1  can (6 oz.) frozen lemonade concentrate
1  pint vanilla ice cream, softened
3-1/2  c. whipped topping, thawed
1  graham cracker crust
preparation: Beat concentrate for 30 seconds.  Blend in ice cream and whipped topping.  Whip until smooth.  Pour into crust.  Freeze at least 4 hours.  top with additional whipped cream.

name: SHRIMP BOIL
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1/4  c. vinegar
1/4  c. salt
1  tsp. paprika
2  bay leaves
1 1/2  Tbsp. black pepper
1  tsp. red pepper
2 to 3  cans beer
5  lb. shrimp
preparation: Put all dry ingredients in kettle with vinegar.  Pour in beer to wash ingredients down.  Bring to boil; add shrimp.  Stir often as they boil.  Shrimp are done when they turn pink.

name: BARBARA'S BANANA MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. safflower oil
1  egg
3  bananas (verrrrry ripe), mashed by hand
preparation: Hand mix all ingredients; bake in muffin tins at 350° until golden brown.  Makes 24 muffins.

name: CANDY APPLE WALNUT PIE
ingredients:
6  c. thinly sliced apples
1/2  c. cinnamon red hot candies
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
2/3  c. chopped walnuts
1/3  c. plus 2 Tbsp. sugar, divided
2  Pet-Ritz deep dish pie crusts (frozen)
preparation: In a large bowl, toss together apples, walnuts, cinnamon candies, 1/3 cup sugar and flour.  Pour into one frozen pie crust. Break or crumble second pie crust into very small pieces.  Toss with remaining 2 tablespoons sugar; sprinkle over apples.  Bake at 375° on a cookie sheet for 55 to 60 minutes or until candies melt and bubble up through the crumbled crust.  Cool completely before serving.

name: VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  small zucchini
1/2  small purple onion
1  small red bell pepper
1  medium tomato
1  small jalapeno pepper
1  ear fresh corn
1/4  cup ranch dressing
1/4  tsp salt
1/4  tsp pepper
2  large yellow peppers
preparation: Cut zucchini in half; thinly slice zucchini, onion and red pepper.  Seed and chop tomato.  Seed jalapeno and cut into thin strips.  Cut corn from cob into a bowl; add zucchini, onion, red pepper, tomato, jalapeno, ranch dressing, salt and pepper.  Toss to coat.  Cover and chill at least 4 hours.  Cut yellow peppers in half lengthwise; discard seeds and membrane.  Stuff with vegetable mixture.  Serves 4.

name: SWEETENED CONDENSED MILK
ingredients:
1/2  c. warm water
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. powdered milk
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Dissolve dry milk in water in top of double boiler. Add sugar and stir until thick over boiling water, 17 minutes. Cool and use instantly or refrigerate. Makes 14 ounces.

name: LEMON BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sifted flour
1/4  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Mix well and press in ungreased 9 x 9-inch pan.  Bake 15 minutes at 325°.

name: MUSHROOM STEAK
ingredients:
1  pkg. Lipton mushroom soup
1  can mushroom soup
1  can mushrooms
1  c. water
3  lb. T-bone steak
preparation: Put steak in 2-quart casserole dish.  Pour your soup, water, mushrooms and soup mix over top.  Cook at 375° for 2 hours.  Turn over halfway through.  Serve over top of rice.

name: CHICKEN MAMI
ingredients:
1  lb. chicken breast, cut in strips
2  pkg. fresh linguini pasta
3  stalks green onion, chopped
12  cloves garlic, crushed and fried until brown
3  hard-boiled eggs, cut in 4 wedges
1 (13 oz.)  can chicken broth
1  tsp. salt
1  piece lemon, cut in wedges
preparation: Boil linguini pasta (Mami) until cooked.  Put pasta on a large colander and place under cold running water.  Set aside.

name: KAREN'S LASAGNA
ingredients:
6  lasagna noodles
1 1/4  lb. ground beef
1/2  chopped onion
1/2  tsp. ground oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
15 1/2  oz. Ragu spaghetti sauce
1  (16 oz.) Ricotta cheese
8  oz. grated Mozzarella cheese
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
preparation: Brown beef and onion; drain.  Add Ragu, oregano and salt. Simmer 15 minutes.  Cook noodles and drain.  Mix cheeses and parsley.  Layer in 2-quart Pyrex dish the noodles, cheese and sauce.  Repeat, ending with meat.  Bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: HUMMINGBIRD CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  c. oil
3  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  c. flour
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. mashed bananas
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Bake at 350° in 2 (9-inch) layer pans or 1 (13 x 9-inch) sheet cake pan for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

name: BERRY-MALLOW-YAM BAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. oatmeal, uncooked
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. butter
2 (17 oz.)  cans yams, drained
2  c. cranberries
15  regular Kraft marshmallows
preparation: Combine flour, sugar, oats and cinnamon.  Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Lightly toss 1 cup crumbs mixture with yams and cranberries.  Arrange in 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Sprinkle with remaining crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Top with marshmallows and broil until lightly browned. Makes 6 servings.

name: BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
4  oz. uncooked elbow macaroni
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
3/4  c. milk
2/3  c. catsup
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese (about 2 oz.)
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 to 2  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1  tsp. salt
1  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Cook and stir meat until brown; drain off fat.  Cook macaroni as directed on package; drain.  In an ungreased 2-quart casserole dish, mix all ingredients, except potato chips. Cover and bake for 40 minutes.  Uncover and sprinkle with potato chips; bake for 5 minutes longer.

name: BUFFALO CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. butter
2  c. brown sugar
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
2  c. oatmeal
2  c. crushed corn flakes
1  c. chopped pecans
6  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Melt butter.  Add brown sugar, sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Beat well and add flour, baking powder, salt and soda.  Add oatmeal, corn flakes, pecans and chocolate chips.  Make a large dropped cookies, about 9 to a sheet.  Bake at 350° about 15 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
1  box 10x sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. marshmallow cream
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil sugar and milk exactly 3 minutes (no longer).  Remove from heat and add the rest of the ingredients.  Mix well and pour into 9 x 9-inch pan.

name: SUGARLESS APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. raisins
1  c. diced dried fruit
2  c. water
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
2  eggs, beaten or egg substitute equivalent
1  c. unsweetened applesauce
2  Tbsp. liquid sweetener
3/4  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Combine raisins, fruit and water in a saucepan; cook, uncovered, until water in saucepan has evaporated and fruit is soft.  Set aside to cool.  Meanwhile, in a large mixing bowl, combine flour, baking soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon.  In another bowl combine eggs, applesauce, sweetener, oil and vanilla.  Add nuts and reserved fruit mixture.  Stir in dry ingredients and blend thoroughly.  Pour into a greased 10-inch fluted pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake is done.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1 small  can crushed pineapple
2 (16 oz.)  cans kidney beans
2  cans pork and beans
1  c. ketchup
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion.  Combine with remaining ingredients and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SCALLOPED PINEAPPLE
ingredients:
2 scant  c. sugar
1/2  c. soft butter
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  qt. bread cubes
1 large  can pineapple chunks (juice included)
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. pecans
preparation: Mix sugar and butter.  Add eggs and mix well.  Stir in pineapple with juice; add vanilla and milk.  Fold in bread cubes. Put into buttered 9 x 12-inch pan.  Sprinkle top with mixture of brown sugar and pecans.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: HOT COCOA MIX
ingredients:
14  c. powdered milk
2  lb. cocoa (Nestle Quik)
16  oz. powdered creamer
2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix in order given in a large bowl.  Store in a covered container.

name: KIT-KAT BARS
ingredients:
2  sticks butter or margarine
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/3  c. sugar
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
Waverly crackers or Club crackers
1/2  c. chocolate chips
1/2  c. butterscotch chips
2/3  c. peanut butter
preparation: Line bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan with crackers.  Mix first 5 ingredients.  Boil 5 minutes.  Pour 1/2 mixture over crackers. Layer 1 more time with crackers and pour remaining mixture over crackers.  Add 1 more layer of crackers.  Then melt last 3 ingredients.  Spread over top layer of crackers.  Refrigerate.

name: THE GREAT DEPRESSION CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. strong coffee or water
2  c. raisins
1/2  c. shortening
1  apple, peeled and grated
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: In large saucepan, simmer sugar, coffee, shortening, raisins and apples for 10 minutes.  Stir occasionally.  Cool 10 minutes. Blend the remaining ingredients and stir into mixture.  Pour batter into well-greased and floured pans.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.  Cool and dust with powdered sugar.  Water can be substituted for coffee.  Candied fruit may be added for an easy fruitcake.  Recipe dates back to 1929.

name: SEVEN-UP PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
6 (70 oz.)  bottles or cans 7-Up
orange rind curls
preparation: Chill fruits, pineapple juice and 7-Up. Combine pineapple and strawberries in punch bowl; stir in pineapple juice.  Pour in 7-Up slowly; mix gently. Add 2 trays ice cubes; garnish punch bowl with orange rind curls. Yields about 30 servings.

name: SMOTHERED QUAIL
ingredients:
6  quail
6  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. flour
2  c. chicken broth
1/2  c. sherry
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Wash and season quail.  Brown in heavy skillet or Dutch oven in butter.  When golden, remove quail and place in a deep baking dish.  Add flour to butter in skillet and stir well.  Slowly add chicken broth and sherry; blend well.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Bring to a boil and pour over quail.  Cover and bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour or until tender.  Serves 6.

name: FRIED SUMMER SQUASH
ingredients:
yellow summer squash, sliced
Jiffy corn bread mix
butter or margarine
preparation: Roll sliced squash in corn bread mix.  Fry in butter or margarine.

name: ARTICHOKE AND SHRIMP SOUP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
2  Tbsp. flour
1  minced onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  can beef broth
3  cups milk
2  cups grated American cheese (Velveeta may be used)
1/4  cup snipped fresh parsley
1  lb. shrimp
3  cans artichoke hearts (cauliflower or broccoli may be substituted)
preparation: Melt butter; sauté onion.  Add flour and blend.  Stir milk in slowly, stirring until smooth.  Add broth and seasonings.  Cook until slightly thickened on low heat.  Add cheese, parsley and artichokes along with shrimp.  Cook about 30-45 minutes.  (If fresh cauliflower or broccoli are used, parboil until almost tender before adding to soup.)

name: TOFFEE BAR CRUNCH PIE
ingredients:
1/3  c. caramel dessert topping
1 1/2  c. cold milk
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. Jell-O vanilla flavor instant pudding and pie filling
1  tub (8 oz.) Cool Whip whipped topping, thawed
6  bars (1.4 oz. each) chocolate-covered English toffee, chopped
1  Keebler Ready-Crust graham cracker pie crust (6 oz.)
preparation: Spread dessert topping on bottom of crust.  Pour milk into large bowl.  Add pudding mix.  Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes.  Stir in Cool Whip and chopped toffee bars. Spoon into crust.

name: COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  rind of orange
3  c. sifted flour
1  box sugar
1/2  c. nuts
1  egg
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients until it crumbs like meal.  Mix the next 3 ingredients with egg and buttermilk.  Beat well.   Pour the second mixture into greased and floured sheet pan.   Sprinkle topping (first mixture) over.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Cool. Cut into squares.

name: PEPPER STEAK SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. cooked roast beef
2  small tomatoes
1  large green pepper
1  c. sliced celery
1/3  c. sliced green onion
1/3  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
1/2  c. bottled teriyaki sauce
1/3  c. dry sherry (optional)
1/3  c. salad oil
3  Tbsp. white vinegar
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1  c. bean sprouts
4  c. shredded Chinese cabbage
preparation: Cut beef into thin strips; they should measure about 3 cups. Cut tomatoes into wedges and green pepper into strips.  In mixing bowl, combine beef, tomatoes, green pepper, celery, onion and mushrooms.

name: APRICOT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
4  eggs
1  c. apricot nectar
3/4  c. salad oil
preparation: Separate egg yolks from whites.  Mix cake mix, yolks, oil and apricot nectar at medium speed for 4 minutes.  Beat egg whites until  stiff; fold into batter.  Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: SAVORY PORK AND VEGETABLES
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine
4  boneless pork chops (3/4 inch thick)
1 1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  tsp. dried rosemary leaves, crushed
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  Tbsp. water
1/2  lb. fresh green beans, cut into 2-inch pieces
preparation: In skillet in 1 tablespoon of hot margarine, cook chops 10 minutes or until browned on both sides; remove.

name: JUMBO PASTA SHELLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. jumbo pasta shells
1  1/2 lbs. hamburger
1/2  pkg. Big Red Smokies, sliced thin
1  small onion
1 8oz.  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
Parmesan cheese to taste
16oz. spaghetti sauce, brand of your choice
preparation: Cook shells according to pkg. instructions.  Brown meats and onions.  Drain.  When shells are done, drain well and stuff with meat mixture.  In a 15 x 10 casserole dish, place just enough sauce to cover bottom.  Place stuffed shells side by side and pour remaining sauce over top.  Cover with the two cheeses & bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until heated through.  Good served with salad and garlic bread.

name: PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1/4  c. seasoned flour
1 1/2  lb. round steak (3/4-inch thick)
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  can condensed tomato soup
1/2  c. water
1  medium onion, sliced
1  large green pepper, cut into 8 strips
1  clove garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
4 thin  slices lemon
preparation: Pound  seasoned  flour  into  steak with meat hammer or saucer.   Brown   steak  on  both  sides  in  shortening.  Add remaining ingredients.  Cook over low heat 45 minutes or until tender.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: FOUR DAY MAKE AHEAD SOUR CREAM TORTE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Pillsbury Plus devil's food cake
3  eggs
1  c. water
1/3  c. oil
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour 2 (8-inch) round pans. In large bowl, blend all cake ingredients at low speed until moistened.  Beat 2 minutes at highest speed; pour into pans.  Cool cake in pan on cooling rack 15 minutes; remove.  Cool completely. Split each layer in half forming four layers.  Fill and frost layers with sour cream coconut filling.  If desired, garnish with pecans and maraschino cherries.  Store covered in refrigerator 12 to 14 servings.

name: LIME-LIGHT PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. Crisco
1/2  sq. melted chocolate
1 to 2  Tbsp. cold water
1  (15 oz.) Eagle Brand canned milk
1/4  c. lime juice with pinch of salt
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained well
2 to 3  drops green food color
3/4  c. cream, whipped
1  Tbsp. confectioners sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  Tbsp. grated chocolate
preparation: Crust:  Sift together flour, salt and sugar.  Cut in Crisco and drip in melted chocolate.  Sprinkle with cold water.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: NOODLES(No Fail; No Tough)
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
3  Tbsp. oleo, melted and cooled
1 1/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix well.  Roll thin.  Let lay and dry for 15 to 20 minutes. Cut desired width.

name: DELIGHTFUL FRUIT COMPOTE
ingredients:
2  medium ripe peaches, sliced
1  c. fresh or frozen blueberries
1  c. quartered fresh strawberries
2  kiwi fruit, peeled and sliced
3/4  c. seedless red or green grapes
3  Tbsp. apple jelly
4  tsp. water
preparation: Stir fruits together. In microwave, heat apple jelly and water for 45 seconds or until jelly is melted. Drizzle over fruit and stir. Refrigerate.

name: SPANISH CREAM
ingredients:
1  envelope Knox unflavored gelatine
1/3  c. sugar
2  egg yolks, slightly beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. cold milk
1/8  tsp. salt
2  egg whites, stiffly beaten
preparation: Soften gelatine in cold milk in top of double boiler.  Place over boiling water.  Add sugar and salt.  Stir until gelatine and sugar are thoroughly dissolved.  Slowly pour small amount of hot mixture over slightly beaten egg yolks.  Return to double boiler and cook over hot, not boiling, water, stirring constantly, until mixture coats spoon.  Remove from heat.  Add vanilla.  Fold gelatine mixture into stiffly beaten egg whites.  Chill until firm. (This will separate and form a jelly on the bottom and a custard on top.)  Serve with whipped cream, sliced oranges or any fruit you like.

name: JALAPENO CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  egg
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1 1/2  c. buttermilk cornmeal mix
1 (8 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1  c. (4 oz.) grated Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. chopped jalapeno peppers
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Grease a 9-inch square baking pan. Beat egg in mixing bowl.  Add remaining ingredients and stir until blended.  Pour into prepared pan.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

name: COOL HOT DOGS
ingredients:
8  hot dogs
8  slices bacon
8  slices cheese
8  hot dog buns
preparation: Will also need toothpicks.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. chopped spinach, drained
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
3  chopped green onions
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Chill and serve.

name: CHILDREN'S PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. salt
1  c. water
1  Tbsp. oil
2  tsp. cream of tartar
few drops food coloring
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in heavy saucepan.  Pour over heat, stirring constantly.  Cook until it runs loose from the sides and forms a ball.  Remove from heat and put on wax paper; work until smooth.  Put in a closed container.

name: ECLAIR CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. water
1  c. oleo
1  c. flour
4  eggs
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
2  pkg. instant French vanilla pudding
3 1/2  c. milk
Cool Whip
Hershey's syrup to taste
preparation: Boil water and oleo or heat in microwave until oleo melts. Add flour and mix together.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Spread onto a greased cookie sheet and bake at 400° for about 20 minutes. Slit bubbles in dough after baking.  Cool.

name: CHEESERONI
ingredients:
2  c. macaroni noodles
1  lb. ground beef or sausage
1  can tomato soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  green pepper, diced
1  onion, chopped
1/4  c. chopped pimento
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  can French fried onions
preparation: Cook macaroni according to package directions.  In a large skillet, brown meat with chopped onion. Add soups, green pepper, pimento and cooked macaroni; mix.  Place half of the mixture in a greased 2 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with half of the cheese and half of the French fried onions. Top with remaining macaroni mixture, then cheese.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Top with remaining French fried onions and bake 5 minutes longer. Serves 6 to 8.

name: PEPPERONI PINWHEELS
ingredients:
8  oz. can refrigerator crescent dinner rolls
1  c. pizza sauce
3 1/2  oz. pkg. sliced pepperoni
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Separate dough into four rectangles. Press to seal perforations.  Place 8 pepperoni slices on each. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cheese.  Start with short side and roll up each rectangle.  Pinch and seal.  Slice each roll into 4 equal slices.  Pinch dough on one side of each slice to seal. Place sealed side down on ungreased sheet.  Bake for 18 to 20 minutes.  Yields 16 servings.

name: CHICKEN AND BISCUIT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
2  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped baby carrots
1/2  c. all purpose flour
2  tsp. white vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dried basil
1/2  tsp. ground black pepper
4  c. chicken broth
1 (15 oz.)  can peas, drained
4  c. cubed, cooked chicken meat
2  c. buttermilk baking mix
2  tsp. dried basil
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  In a medium sized skillet, melt butter or margarine over medium high heat and sauté the garlic, onion, celery and carrots.  Add the flour, sugar, salt, 1 teaspoon dried basil, pepper and broth and bring to a boil.  Cook for 1 minute, stirring.  Reduce heat.  Add the peas and simmer for 5 minutes, still stirring.  Stir in the chicken, mix all together and pour the mixture into a greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish.

name: CREAMY STRAWBERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
13  oz. pkg. vanilla wafers, crushed
1  c. butter, divided
2  c. powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pt. whipping cream
1  qt. strawberries
1  egg
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Crust: Melt 1/2 cup butter and combine with crushed vanilla wafers. Press into 9 x 12-inch pan. Refrigerate while making filling.

name: CRACKER CAKE
ingredients:
24  to 32 crackers, crumbled
2  c. sugar
nuts, chopped
6  egg whites
2  Tbsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients.  Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff.  Fold beaten egg whites into cracker mixture. Place in cake pan.  Bake 20 minutes at 325°.

name: HEARTY RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3/4  c. diced bell pepper
3/4  c. diced celery
3/4  c. diced onion
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2 (10 1/2 oz.)  cans beef broth or chicken broth
1  c. uncooked rice
1 (2 oz.)  jar pimento strips
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Saute bell pepper, celery and onion in oil until clear and tender.  Add broth and rice; stir and simmer 5 minutes.  Stir in mushroom soup.  Pour into casserole dish that has been sprayed with Pam.  Decorate with pimento strips.  Cover and bake at 300° for 1 hour.

name: FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
3  cans Eagle Brand milk
3  c. Snow Flake coconut
1  lb. pitted dates
1  lb. candied cherries
1  lb. candied pineapple
1  lb. pecans or walnuts
preparation: Chop or cut the mixture together, leaving nuts in large pieces. Use tube pan (10 x 4-inch) with bottom and sides lined with greased paper.  Set water under the pan for baking.
