Bake 2 hours in 250° to 275° oven.  Let cool in pan overnight.  (Line with greased brown paper bag to fit pan.)

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, shredded
3  tomatoes
1  onion
1  lb. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1  bag tortilla chips
1 (8 oz.)  bottle French dressing
1 (8 oz.)  bottle hot taco sauce (optional)
1  lb. hamburger
1  can drained kidney beans
preparation: Brown hamburger and drain.  Add taco sauce and simmer.  Put lettuce, tomatoes, kidney beans, onions and cheese in a bowl.  Add meat and French dressing.  Mix.  Add chips just before serving.

name: 7-CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. chunk pineapple
1  c. fruit cocktail
1  c. coconut
1  c. cottage cheese
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

name: BEEFY MEXICAN SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  pkg. Hamburger Helper mix
5  c. water
1  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (16 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can whole corn
2  Tbsp. sliced pitted ripe black olives
preparation: Cook and stir ground beef, onion and green pepper in Dutch oven until beef is brown; drain.  Stir in sauce mix, water, chili powder, garlic, salt and tomatoes.  Break up tomatoes with fork; heat.

name: CUSTARD FILLED CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. yellow cornmeal
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
2  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. corn kernels
2  tsp. butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  In large bowl, sift together cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking soda and salt.  Make a well in center of dry ingredients and pour in buttermilk and eggs.  Stir until almost blended.  Stir in 1 cup milk and kernels until just combined.  Do not overmix.  Pour butter into a 10-inch cast-iron skillet and melt in oven.  Swirl to coat bottom and sides.  Scrape batter into skillet and sprinkle with remaining milk.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve hot with sweet butter.

name: AVOCADO PIE
ingredients:
1  c. Eagle Brand condensed milk
juice of 1 lemon
3  peeled avocados (medium-size)
preparation: Put in blender and blend until smooth.  Put mixture in a baked pie shell (use either graham or regular shell).  Let stand overnight in refrigerator.  Serve with whipped cream.

name: CHICKEN CHEESE DRIP
ingredients:
3  lb. boneless chicken breasts
2  lb. Mozzarella cheese
Italian bread crumbs
eggs
spaghetti sauce
olive oil
preparation: Roll chicken in eggs and then bread crumbs.  Fry chicken in olive oil for 20 minutes.  Pour spaghetti sauce over chicken, top with cheese.  Cover and cook for additional 30 minutes.

name: COCONUT NO CRUST PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. milk
1/4  c. melted butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. strawberry cream cheese
1  (7 oz.) marshmallow cream
1/3  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Blend together and serve as a dip for your fruit salad.

name: CHOCOLATE-N-CINNAMON CAPPUCCINO MIX
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. powdered sugar
2/3  c. instant coffee granules
2/3  c. powdered coffee creamer
1/2  c. unsweetened cocoa
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl; blend well. Place in a wide-mouth jar and put lid and ring on it.

name: CRANBERRY CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. strawberry jello
1  c. boiling water
1  c. cold water and juice of pineapple
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
1  can whole cranberry sauce
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Add boiling water to package of jello and stir well.  Add cold water and pineapple juice.  Chill until partially set, about an hour.  Add remaining ingredients and chill until firm.  Serve on lettuce leaves.

name: HOLIDAY NUT ROLL
ingredients:
2  c. nuts
1  c. coconut
1  c. raisins
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
1 small  box vanilla wafers
preparation: Crush wafers in food processor.  Mix all ingredients.  Shape into rolls.  Rolls can be rolled in coconut, also.  Chill and slice.  Let stand at room temperature a few minutes prior to serving.  Store in refrigerator.

name: HOT TAMALE PIE
ingredients:
4  c. water
1  c. cornmeal
1  tsp. salt
1  lb. hamburger
1  tsp. cumin
1  large onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, chopped
2 to 4  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: Combine water, cornmeal and 1 teaspoon salt over medium heat, stirring often, until mixture is very thick.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.  Set aside to cool.

name: VENISON SAUSAGE
ingredients:
5  lb. venison, with fat trimmed off
2  lb. fresh side pork
1  lb. beef fat
7  tsp. salt
4  tsp. black pepper
3  tsp. sage
2  tsp. thyme
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  bay leaf, crushed
preparation: Chill all meat so it will grind better. Cut venison and pork into 1-inch cubes and spread on a large cookie sheet. Grind beef fat through 3/8-inch plate and spread over the cubed venison and pork. Mix salt and other spices in a tightly covered jar, then sprinkle over meat mixture. Grind entire mixture, using 3/16-inch plate on a grinder, then mix thoroughly with your hands.

name: TRIPLE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate cake mix
1 3/4  c. milk
12  oz. chocolate chips
1  pkg. regular instant chocolate pudding
2  eggs
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients and pour in a greased,    floured Bundt or tube pan.  Bake 50 to 55 minutes. Cool cake 15 minutes before removing from pan.

name: SKILLET CORN AND CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. margarine
4  skinless boneless chicken breast halves
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's new golden corn soup
1/2  c. milk
2  c. broccoli flowerets
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: In skillet in hot margarine, cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned.  Remove; set aside.  Spoon off fat.  In skillet, combine remaining ingredients.  Heat to boiling.  Return chicken to skillet.  Cover; cook over low heat 10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink and broccoli is tender-crisp, stirring often. Garnish with tomato wedges and fresh thyme if desired.  Makes 4 servings.

name: POTATO LATKES(Israel)
ingredients:
6  large potatoes
6  eggs, well beaten
2  tsp. salt
2  medium onions
4  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Grate potatoes and onions.  Add beaten eggs.  Add flour and salt.  Mix well.  Fry in deep fat in frying pan, dropping from tablespoon.  Turn only once.  Drain on paper toweling.  Makes about 3 dozen pancakes.  Tastes great with applesauce or sour cream.

name: PECAN GOODIES
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese (room temperature)
2  sticks butter
2  c. flour
preparation: Work together with hands.  Make mealy, then chill for a while. Pinch off marble size and place in each section of mini-muffin tin.  Press down in middle with thumb.

name: BOILED DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. milk
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  stick butter or margarine, softened
3/4  c. peanut butter*
3  c. Quaker oats*
1/2  c. coconut or nuts*
preparation: Mix sugar, vanilla, milk, cocoa and butter or margarine and bring to boil in double boiler, boil 15 minutes.  Remove from stove and add peanut butter; stir until blended.  Add oats and mix well. Add coconut or nuts.  Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper and let stand at room temperature until firm.

name: KENTUCKY HOT BROWN SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  c. flour
2  c. milk
2  chicken bouillon cubes
6  slices bread, toasted
6  slices ham
6  slices turkey
6  slices Cheddar cheese
6  slices tomato
6  slices bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
preparation: Melt margarine in pan over low heat.  Add flour, stirring until smooth.  Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.  Gradually add milk and bouillon cubes.  Cover over medium heat, stirring until thickened and bubbly.  Set aside.  Place toast in buttered 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.  Top each with turkey and ham.  Spoon white sauce over meat.  Layer cheese, tomato and bacon over sauce.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  (Can use thinly sliced country ham or regular ham slices.)

name: BOB HALL'S JAMESTOWN PARMESAN MUSTARD DRESSING(Good For Cole Slaw)
ingredients:
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  c. potato flakes
2  Tbsp. Italian seasoning
6  Tbsp. mustard powder
1  c. spicy brown mustard
1/2  c. cider vinegar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  Tbsp. garlic pepper
1  Tbsp. black pepper
2  c. water
4  c. canola oil
preparation: Mix, shake and allow to sit overnight.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. mashed sweet potatoes
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs, well beaten
1  c. evaporated milk
1/4  c. melted butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. butter
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans
preparation: Mix sweet potatoes, sugar, eggs, milk, 1/4 cup of butter and vanilla together. Top with brown sugar, 3/4 cup butter, coconut and pecans.  Spread and bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

name: BARBECUE SANDWICHES(Uses leftover prepared roast.)
ingredients:
3 1/2 to 4  c. prepared roast, cut into 1-inch thinly and diagonally sliced strips
1  c. onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. catsup
1/3  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
1  Tbsp. dry mustard or 2 Tbsp. prepared mustard
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
pinch of garlic powder
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. chili powder
2 to 3  Tbsp. onion powder
1/8  tsp. cloves
2  Tbsp. lemon juice or vinegar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  drops red cake coloring (optional, for a richer appearance)
5  to 6 hamburger buns
preparation: Slice roast and set aside.  In a large skillet or saucepan, saute onion in butter until tender.  Stir in remaining ingredients in order as given.  Heat to boiling, then reduce heat.  Simmer, covered, for about 30 to 45 minutes.  Add beef and simmer an additional 15 minutes.  Serve on warm hamburger buns.  Yield:  5 to 6 servings.

name: LEE BROWN'S FAVORITE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine or butter
1  c. water
3  Tbsp. Hershey's cocoa
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Bring the first 3 ingredients to a boil over medium heat, stirring continuously.  Add the next 3 ingredients.  Stir until smooth.  Mix the vanilla, eggs, baking soda and buttermilk and add to mixture.  Mix and pour into greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: SURPRISE CAKE
ingredients:
3  oz. box Jell-O
1  can pie filling
miniature marshmallows
1  box cake mix
preparation: Mix Jell-O and pie filling together; set aside.  Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Place miniature marshmallows in bottom of pan.  Mix cake mix as per directions.  Spread the mixed cake dough over marshmallows.  Spoon Jell-O and fruit mixture over cake dough in pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. sweetened condensed milk
1 family size  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1 large  box vanilla wafers
1  (9 oz.) container frozen whipped topping
3  c. milk
1 large  bunch bananas (approximately 8)
preparation: Beat milk and pudding mix; blend in whipped topping and sweetened condensed milk.  Alternate wafers, bananas and pudding mixture in a large dish, ending with pudding mixture on top.

name: CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. veal shoulder, cut up (chop suey meat)
flour
2  medium onions, chopped fine
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1 small  can drained mushrooms
2  c. celery, chopped
2  c. water
1  c. uncooked rice (not Minute)
1/4  lb. cashews (don't add until last few minutes)
preparation: Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Stir occasionally while baking.

name: RHUBARB PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. butter
1  c. sour cream or milk
4 1/2  c. rhubarb
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1 1/4  c. hot water
preparation: Mix together white sugar, flour, soda, salt and butter.  Add sour cream or milk.  Spread over bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix rhubarb, brown sugar and hot water together.  Pour this over batter.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.  When done, the cake is on top.

name: ONION DIP
ingredients:
1  envelope onion soup mix
1  pint sour cream
preparation: Blend onion soup mix with sour cream.  Chill before serving.

name: NO BAKE BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
3  c. graham cracker crumbs
2  eggs
2  c. powdered sugar
2 additional  sticks butter
4  bananas
2 (8 oz.)  cans crushed pineapple
nuts, crushed
cherries
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Press margarine and graham cracker crumbs into a pan.  Bake at 350° for 6 minutes.

name: ENGLISH BURGERS
ingredients:
4  grilled burgers
1/4  c. each horseradish sauce and chopped tomato
2  Tbsp. crumbled crisply cooked bacon
4  English muffins, split and lightly toasted
preparation: Combine horseradish sauce, tomato and bacon.  Place a grilled burger on each muffin half. Spoon an equal amount of horseradish sauce mixture over each patty. Cover with remaining muffin half. Makes 4 servings.

name: KENTUCKY HASH(Biscuits And Gravy)
ingredients:
2  lb. pork sausage
1  small onion, chopped
1  can mushrooms, drained
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2/3  c. milk
1  doz. hard-boiled eggs, sliced
preparation: Brown pork sausage and onion.  Drain.  Add mushrooms, soup and milk.  Add eggs.  Serve over baked biscuits.

name: LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1 small  can lemonade
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
1  can condensed Eagle Brand milk
2 to 4  drops food coloring
2  (8-inch) graham cracker crusts
preparation: Whip the first 4 ingredients together in mixing bowl.  Pour into two 8-inch graham cracker crusts.  Chill 1 hour.  May garnish with lemon slices.  Very light dessert after heavy meal.

name: RAW APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
2  c. apples
1  c. dates
1/2  c. nuts
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Cream sugar with butter and eggs.  Add flour, cinnamon and cloves.  Add two cups raw apples plus diced dates (I use raisins). Add nuts, hot water and soda, dissolved in very small amount of hot water.  Beat well.  Bake at 350°.

name: HUMMINGBIRD CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. oil
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
8  oz. crushed pineapple (with juice)
1  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
2  c. chopped bananas
preparation: Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add eggs and oil, stirring until dry ingredients are moistened; do not beat. Stir in vanilla, pineapple, pecans and bananas. Spoon batter into 3 well-greased and floured cake pans or 13 x 9 pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove from pans and cool completely.

name: DATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  lb. dates
1  lb. candied cherries
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
4  eggs
4  c. pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Dates,  nuts and cherries may be left whole if desired. Sift dry ingredients together 3 times, sifting over fruit and nut mixture  the  last time.  Add beaten yolks.  Fold or work stiffly beaten  egg  whites  to which vanilla has been added. Let  stand for thirty minutes and mix again.  Use heavy waxed paper, grease and  line pan.  Cover top of cake and place pan of water  under cake.  Bake at 250° for over 2 hours.  Remove cover  from  top  of cake  during  last 15 minutes of baking. After  cake is removed from oven, cool thoroughly in the paper in which  it  was baked. Then wrap securely in a second layer of heavy paper (waxed paper is preferred) and tie with twine.

name: FOOLPROOF BEEF AND BROCCOLI
ingredients:
3/4  lb. boneless beef sirloin steak
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  clove garlic, minced
1  medium onion, cut into wedges
1  can (10 3/4 oz.) Campbell's cream of broccoli soup
1/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  c. broccoli flowerets
hot cooked noodles
preparation: Slice beef across the grain into very thin strips.  In a skillet, over medium-high heat, in hot oil, cook beef and garlic until beef is browned.  Add onion.  Cook 5 minutes, stir often. Stir in soup, water and soy sauce.  Heat to boiling.  Add broccoli, reduce heat to low.  Cover; simmer 5 hours, or until veggies are tender.  Serve over noodles.  Yields 4 servings.

name: LITTLE BUNS
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
4  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  envelopes beef mushroom soup
1  can water chestnuts, chopped
1 (10 oz.)  can bean sprouts
5  tubes crescent rolls
preparation: Combine ground beef, onion, soup mixes, water chestnuts and bean sprouts.  Mix well.  Unroll crescent rolls.  Cut each triangle in half.  Put a tablespoon of the meat mixture on each piece of crescent roll.  Bake on greased cookie sheet at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.  Makes 80 buns.

name: BUTTER MINTS
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. soft butter
1/4  c. cream
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
2  tsp. peppermint flavoring
1  lb. powdered sugar
preparation: Blend all ingredients; knead color as desired.  Form into small balls.  Press down.  Let dry for at least 1 day before packaging.

name: DORITO DIP
ingredients:
16  oz. sour cream
16  oz. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  c. shredded lettuce
1  small tomato, diced
1  bag Doritos
preparation: Combine sour cream and cream cheese.  Spread into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Top with Mozzarella cheese, lettuce and tomato. Refrigerate.  Serve cold.  Scoop up with Doritos.  (Salsa Rio are the best, but all varieties taste good.)

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
12  to 16 potatoes (medium size)
3  stalks celery, chopped
1  onion (medium), chopped
1/2  c. canola oil
4  Tbsp. white vinegar
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground black pepper
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. dill weed
2  c. Miracle Whip or mayonnaise
preparation: Fill large pan with cold water.  Bring potatoes to boil; lower heat a bit and cover pan.  Continue to boil until potatoes are tender when poked with a fork.  While potatoes are cooking, chop celery and onion.  Set aside.  In measuring cup, mix oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, paprika and dill weed.  When potatoes are done, cool, peel and cut in small pieces.  Mix potatoes, celery and onion in a large bowl.  Add oil and vinegar.  Mix together well.  Cover and put in refrigerator for at least 1 hour.  Mix in Miracle Whip.  Add some paprika and dill weed on top for garnish.

name: PICKLING PIG CAKE
ingredients:
yellow cake mix
1/2  c. Wesson oil
4  eggs, beaten real good
1  can mandarin oranges
preparation: Beat really well.  Bake at 350° or according to box.

name: SCALLOPED HASH BROWN POTATOES
ingredients:
32  oz. hash browns
8  oz. sour cream
2  c. cubed Velveeta
1  stick butter or margarine, softened
1  c. cream of chicken soup
1  Tbsp. grated onion
2  c. crushed corn flakes
1  stick melted margarine
preparation: Mix together hash browns, sour cream, Velveeta, softened butter or margarine, soup and onion; mix well.  Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix corn flakes and melted margarine.  Put on top. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.  Serves 10.

name: CHRISTMAS COOKIE MIX(Makes 7 To 8 Cups)
ingredients:
6  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. salt
1  lb. shortening (2 1/3 c.)
preparation: Mix flour and salt in large bowl; cut shortening into flour until about the size of peas.  Store in covered container.  Will keep for weeks without refrigeration.

name: QUICHE LORRAINE
ingredients:
pastry for single crust pie
3  beaten eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
8  slices bacon, cooked (save 2 Tbsp. drippings)
1  medium onion, sliced
1 1/2  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Bake pie crust at 450° for 10 minutes.  In bowl stir together eggs, milk, onion, salt, and pepper.  In skillet, fry bacon, drain, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings.  Cook onion in drippings until tender.  Add crumbled bacon and onion to egg mixture.  Toss together cheese and flour and add to egg mixture.  Pour into hot pastry shell.  Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: SPECIAL ROAST
ingredients:
1  medium roast (beef)
4  cans mushroom soup
2  beef bouillon cubes
onions, cut in half
carrots, peeled and cut
red potatoes, peeled and halved
preparation: Combine roast, mushroom soup (rinse out each soup can with 4 ounces water) and add bouillon cubes.  Bake 2 to 3 hours until almost done.  Stir occasionally.  Add onions.  Cook 15 minutes. Add carrots and potatoes.  Continue cooking for 1 hour or until carrots and potatoes are done.

name: MILLIONAIRE PIE
ingredients:
1  can condensed milk
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  c. pecans, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1 large  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients.	Pour  into  two  9-inch  graham cracker pie crusts.  Chill for several hours before serving.

name: CINNAMON CREAM CHEESE COOKIES
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  c. unsalted butter, softened
4  oz. cream cheese, softened
3/4  c. granulated sugar
1  large egg
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: In medium bowl, stir together flour, baking powder and salt. In large bowl, using wooden spoon, cream together butter, cream cheese and sugar until combined.  Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours until firm enough to shape.  To prepare topping, stir together sugar and cinnamon in a custard cup.  Shape dough into 1-inch diameter balls.  Roll each ball in topping to coat lightly. Place balls on prepared baking sheets, leaving about 2-inches between balls.  Bake 1 sheet at a time, at 350°, for 10 to 14 minutes or until bottoms of cookies are very lightly browned. Remove baking sheet to a wire rack and cool for about 3 minutes. Using metal spatula, transfer cookies to rack and cool completely. Repeat until all dough is used.  When cool, store cookies in an airtight container.  Makes about 45 cookies.

name: CHOCOLATE SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
2  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. water
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. cooking oil
preparation: Bring to a boil, water, margarine and oil.  Pour over dry ingredients and beat until creamy.  Add milk, soda and eggs; beat again.  Pour into a greased and floured cookie sheet (approximately 17 1/2 x 11 1/2-inch).  Bake at 400° for 16 to 18 minutes.  Ice with Chocolate Icing.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
2  pkg. (16 oz.) cream cheese, softened
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sour cream
1  graham cracker crust
1 (16 oz.)  can or jar cherry pie filling
preparation: Beat softened cream cheese.  Add eggs and sugar; blend.  Add vanilla and sour cream; beat.  Pour into graham cracker crust. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.  Turn off oven.  Leave pie in oven 50 minutes.  After removing pie from oven, pour 1 can or jar of prepared cherry pie filling over cheese cake pie.

name: SUSIE'S PEACH CRUMBLE
ingredients:
1  can (29 oz.) peach slices, drained
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Arrange  drained  peach  slices  in  a	greased shallow baking dish.  Blend  remaining  ingredients  until  crumbly. Sprinkle over  peaches.  Bake  at 375° for 25 minutes.  Serve warm or cold.

name: JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  small cottage cheese
3  oz. pkg. orange jello
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  small Cool Whip, thawed
preparation: Mix all together and serve.

name: RASPBERRY DESSERT SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. diet raspberry Jell-O
1 1/2  c. boiling water
10  oz. frozen raspberries or blackberries
2 (8 oz.)  cans crushed pineapple
1  banana
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; add frozen raspberries and stir until thawed.  Stir in pineapple and banana.  Pour half into 8-inch square pan and refrigerate 30 minutes; spread sour cream over gelatin, then pour remaining Jell-O over the sour cream.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. (10 oz. each) frozen chopped broccoli
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. mayonnaise
salt and pepper
1  stick oleo, melted
1  can mushroom soup
1  chopped onion
1  c. grated sharp cheese
1/2  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb seasoned stuffing
preparation: Cook broccoli and drain well.  Mix eggs, soup, mayonnaise, onion, salt and pepper.  Add to broccoli.  Pour into a greased casserole dish.  Top with cheese.  Mix oleo and stuffing mix and add to top of casserole.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, uncovered.

name: DREAM CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can cherry pie filling
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1 large  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Drain pineapple.  Mix all ingredients together.  Can use less Cool Whip.  Freeze.  It will keep for a long time.  Re-freeze after used.

name: MUSTARD POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
5  lb. potatoes, cooked and mashed
1/2  c. Italian salad dressing
1  large onion, minced
1  large green pepper, minced
1  c. light Miracle Whip
3/4  c. mustard
1/2  c. bread and butter pickle juice
1  Tbsp. Nature's Seasons (or to taste)
1  tsp. salt (or to taste)
1  tsp. pepper (or to taste)
6  eggs, boiled and chopped
paprika
preparation: After boiling potatoes and cooling, pour Italian dressing over.  Add onion and green pepper.

name: ASPARAGUS SPEARS WITH GARLIC MUSTARD
ingredients:
1  lb. (24) asparagus spears, trimmed
2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. (1/2 lb.) sliced 1/4-inch fresh mushrooms
2  Tbsp. country-style Dijon mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
pinch of salt
1/2  tsp. minced fresh garlic
preparation: In 10-inch skillet, place asparagus spears; add enough water to cover.  Bring to a full boil.  Cook over medium heat until asparagus is crisply tender (5 to 7 minutes).  Drain; return to skillet.  Add remaining ingredients, pushing asparagus to side just until butter is melted.  Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until heated through (5 to 7 minutes).  Makes 4 servings.

name: REUBEN BURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2/3  c. Quaker oats
1/2  c. Thousand Island dressing
1  egg
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Combine meat shell ingredients and press into the bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie plate.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Drain.

name: BROCCOLI PUFF
ingredients:
1  lb. cottage cheese
1/2  tsp. onion powder
1  tsp. salt
3  eggs
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
1/4  c. butter, melted
1/2 to 3/4  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Combine cottage cheese, onion powder, salt, eggs, Cheddar cheese and broccoli in large bowl.  When mixed well, pour into 9 x 12 baking dish. Make topping of melted butter and crumbs. Sprinkle on top of broccoli mix. Bake at 350° for one (1) hour or until knife inserted comes out clean. Let set 10 minutes before serving.

name: MARY LUCCI'S EASTER BREAD
ingredients:
6  eggs
6  Tbsp. oil
12  Tbsp. sugar
1 cake yeast, dissolved in 1/2  c. warm milk
anise seed
1  Tbsp. anise extract
approximately 6 c. flour
preparation: Mix to bread texture.  Knead; let raise more than double. Knead again, then shape into braid, ring, round or bread size. Let raise.  Bake in low temperature oven (325°).  Let brown on top and bottom.  Easy to burn.

name: BARBECUE STEAK MARINADE
ingredients:
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. ginger, ground
1/4  c. oil
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. honey
2  tsp. garlic salt or powder
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Place steaks in marinade and refrigerate 24 hours.  Turn meat after 12 hours.  Grill to desired doneness.

name: MINT JULEP
ingredients:
4  c. water
3  lemons
2  c. chopped mint leaves
1  c. sugar
preparation: Squeeze lemons and put all ingredients in pan and bring to a boil.  Do not boil.  Remove immediately from burner and steep overnight, if possible.  When cool, strain and refrigerate.  As drink, add 3/4 cup ginger ale to 1/4 cup mixture.

name: ENERGY CANDY
ingredients:
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. milk powder
2  Tbsp. honey
2  Tbsp. molasses
raisins or dates
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Roll out and cut into squares or roll into balls.  Refrigerate.  Kids love it and it's easy for them to make themselves, kneading ingredients together with thoroughly washed hands.

name: APPLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
1/2  c. shortening
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour, sifted
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. allspice
1  c. apples, chopped
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening until very light, then add beaten egg.  Mix and sift dry ingredients and add to creamed sugar mixture.  Stir in apples.  Drop by balls on greased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375°.

name: STRAWBERRY SPINACH SALAD WITH LEMON DRESSING
ingredients:
6  c. coarsely torn fresh spinach
1  lb. fresh strawberries, sliced
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Rinse and drain the spinach. Arrange on serving plates and top with strawberries and walnuts. Serve with lemon dressing and walnuts.

name: MOUSER'S YUM SQUASH PIE
ingredients:
1  medium butternut squash
1 (12 fluid oz.)  can condensed milk
2  eggs
3/4  c. honey
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  tsp. each:  nutmeg and allspice
1/2  tsp. salt
1  pie crust for 9-inch pan (buy one or use your favorite recipe)
preparation: Halve the squash and scoop out seeds and pulp.  Cut squash into 1-inch cubes and steam until tender (about 15 minutes).  Let cool a bit.  Use a spoon to scrape flesh off peel.  Puree squash in a food processor until smooth.  Place 1 3/4 cup pureed squash in a food processor bowl.  Add all remaining ingredients; mix well.  Pour into crust and bake in a preheated 425° oven for 15 minutes.  Turn heat down to 350° and bake another 45 minutes.  Top with whipped cream.

name: OLD TIME BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. stew meat
2  Tbsp. oil or shortening
3  c. water
1  medium onion
1  Tbsp. salt
1  clove garlic
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. pepper
dash of allspice or cloves
6  medium carrots, quartered
6  medium potatoes, quartered
1  lb. pearl small onions
1/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Brown meat, then add water and vegetables.  Cover and cook 30 to 45 minutes or until all is tender at checking.  Combine the water and flour to make paste.  Add to the stew to thicken juices. Yields 9 cups.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIR
ingredients:
2  pkg. French vanilla instant pudding
3  c. milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
graham crackers
preparation: Mix pudding and milk; fold in Cool Whip.  Layer graham crackers and 1/2 of pudding/Cool Whip mixture.  Layer again and top with graham crackers.  Top with icing.

name: CHEESE ROLL
ingredients:
1  lb. cream cheese
1  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
dash of garlic powder
dash of salt
2  c. pecans, chopped fine
chili powder
preparation: Have cream cheese at room temperature and cream well.  Add grated cheese, garlic powder, salt and pecans.  Make into 2 rolls and roll in chili powder.  Chill well and serve with crackers.

name: FUDGE PIE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. and 2 Tbsp. cocoa
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Melt butter in medium saucepan.  Remove from heat.  Add cocoa, sugar, eggs, flour, vanilla and nuts.  Beat well.  Pour into well-greased 9-inch pie pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with ice cream or Cool Whip.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
2  over-ripe bananas
2  boxes real vanilla wafers
1  can Borden condensed milk
1  can evaporated milk
2  cans water
4  egg yolks
2  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
3  sticks butter
2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Mix sugar and flour until smooth.  Separate eggs.  Beat yolks slightly.  Combine sugar and flour mixture, egg yolks, milk, water and salt.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, so mixture won't stick to pan.  Cook until mixture starts to thicken.  Add butter and vanilla.  Cook until sauce is very thick.  Layer pan with vanilla wafers and sliced bananas.  Pour cooled sauce over cookies and sliced bananas.  Layer cookies and bananas until pan is full, ending with cookies on top.  Sprinkle with crumbled vanilla wafers and sugar.

name: CHESS CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix (no pudding)
1  egg
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Mix ingredients of crust together on medium speed until crumbly.  Press into a buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.

name: SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
8  to 10 potatoes
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, minced
1  can whole kernel corn
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
Cheddar cheese
preparation: Peel, quarter, boil and mash potatoes.  Brown ground beef and drain.  Add to meat the onion, corn and taco seasoning and mix well.  Brown until onion is tender (may add water if needed).  In baking dish, place 1/2 of the mashed potatoes.   Put a layer of the corn and beef mixture on top.  Then place remaining potatoes on top of the corn and beef.  Place in a 350° oven until it starts to brown.  Take out and top with Cheddar cheese.  Place back in oven until cheese melts.

name: HAWAIIAN DREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained (save juice)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1  c. cold milk
1  (9 oz.) container Cool Whip
nuts and coconut
preparation: Prepare cake mix according to directions, using pineapple juice for liquid.  Add water to make amount required.  Bake about 15 minutes in 350° oven, using a well-greased and floured 15 x 10 1/2 x 1 pan.  Cool in pan.  Blend together with beater the cream cheese, instant pudding and milk.  Fold in drained pineapple. Spread over top of cooled cake.  Cover with Cool Whip and sprinkle with nuts and coconut.  Refrigerate for several hours.

name: GRILLED RED SNAPPER
ingredients:
2  lb. red snapper fillets
1/3  c. water
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
2  Tbsp. lime juice
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Cut fish into serving-size portions.  Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl.  Arrange fish on grill.  Brush generously with sauce.  Cook 6 to 8 minutes and turn.  Brush fish with sauce and cook for about 7 minutes or until fish flakes.  Do not overcook.

name: LENTIL SOUP
ingredients:
2  beef soup bones with meat
2  carrots, sliced
2  stalks celery, diced
2 to 3  bunches celery leaves, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1  (1 lb.) bag lentils, rinsed and picked through
salt and pepper
4  qt. water
2  Tbsp. beef bouillon
preparation: In a 4 to 6-quart soup pot, boil bones until all the foam can be skimmed from top.  Add vegetables and lentils.  Cook until lentils are soft and soup is thick.  Simmer 2 to 3 hours.  Remove meat from bones and put into soup.  Serve as is or cut sausage up and put in.

name: CRANBERRY NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. orange juice
2  eggs, beaten
3  Tbsp. butter, melted
1/2  c. pecans or walnuts
1 1/4  c. cranberries
2  tsp. grated orange rind
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease 9-inch loaf pan.  Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt into mixing bowl.  Make well in center and pour in orange juice, eggs and melted butter; mix well. Fold in chopped nuts, cranberries and orange rind.  Pour batter in prepared loaf pan and set on middle rack in oven.  Bake 45 minutes.  Cool in pan 10 minutes.  Good toasted with butter or cream cheese.

name: MICROWAVE PARTY PECANS
ingredients:
4  c. pecans
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Microwave 6 minutes.  Stir.  Sprinkle with salt.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1 large  can tomato puree with water
3 small  cans tomato paste with water each can
salt
pepper
garlic
onion
oregano
sweet basil
preparation: Sprinkle salt, pepper, garlic, onion, oregano and sweet basil heavy once around the  pot.  Pour  some oil in bottom of pot; then add ingredients.  Add sausage and steak; add chicken later. Approximately 1 hour  before  sauce  is done, then add raw meatballs.  Should cook at  least  3  hours.  Skim off oil and excess occasionally while cooking.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box strawberry cake mix
1 small  box strawberry Jell-O
3/4  c. oil
4  eggs
1  c. strawberries
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. self-rising flour
preparation: Mix well; bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: WALDORF TOSS
ingredients:
1 (8 serving size)  pkg. cherry Jell-O or any red flavor
dash of salt
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  c. cold water
ice cubes
1  c. diced, peeled apple or pear
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (unsweetened)
1/2  c. sliced celery
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Completely dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water. Combine cold water and ice cubes to make 2 1/2 cups.  Add to gelatin, stirring until slightly thickened.  If necessary, remove any unmelted ice.  Fold in fruits and celery.  Spoon into individual dishes or a bowl.  Chill until set, at least 1 hour. Make 5 cups or 10 servings.  Contains 35 calories per serving without nuts.

name: ANGEL SWEETS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
2  Tbsp. butter
1  egg
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Melt chips and butter over low heat.   Remove from heat. Blend in egg (beaten).  Stir in sugar, nuts and marshmallows, blending well.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Roll in coconut and chill.  Makes about 48.

name: OLD-FASHIONED BREAD PUDDING RECIPE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. raisins (optional)
1  qt. milk
6  slices bread
butter
nutmeg
preparation: Butter 6 slices of bread on one side.  Cut in 1-inch cubes (can use more than 6 slices of bread, depending on how thick you want your pudding).  Stir all the rest of the ingredients in the bread cubes and mix well.  Sprinkle nutmeg on top.  Bake approximately 40 minutes until set.

name: HAMBURGER CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. grated cheese
1  large onion, chopped
4  chile peppers, chopped
1  c. milk
1 small  can cream-style corn
1  c. plain corn meal
2  eggs, beaten
1/3  c. oil
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Brown meat and next 3 ingredients.   Cook a few minutes and set aside.    Mix remaining ingredients.   Grease skillet and heat.  Pour in half of corn bread mixture.  Add all of meat mixture.   Spread evenly.   Pour in remainder of corn bread mixture; spread evenly.    Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE ZUCCHINI CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
1/4  c. cocoa
1  tsp. salt
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sour milk
2  c. grated zucchini
1/2  pkg. chocolate chips (optional)*
preparation: Blend oleo, oil, sugar, eggs, vanilla and dry ingredients with milk.  Blend well; add zucchini.  Pour in greased and floured pan (9 x 13-inches or Bundt pan).  Bake in a 325° oven for 40 to 50 minutes, until done.

name: BEEF BOAT DIP
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. sour cream
1 1/3  c. mayonnaise
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. corned beef, chopped fine
2  tsp. Beau Monde
2  tsp. dill weed
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. parsley
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Serve in hollowed out loaf of pumpernickel bread, French bread, etc.

name: ITALIAN WEDDING SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. fresh bread crumbs
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
5  tsp. chicken flavor instant bouillon
8  c. water
1/2  c. uncooked pasta (bow ties)
1 1/2  c. cut up fresh spinach
preparation: Mix meat and bread crumbs with onion and 1 teaspoon of bouillon.  Shape mixture into 40 meatballs.  In a Dutch oven, bring water and remaining bouillon to boil.  Add meatballs and pasta.  Cook 10 minutes.  Add spinach; reduce heat and simmer 3 to 5 minutes.  Serve with grated cheese.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising cornmeal
1/2  c. cooking oil
3  eggs
1  bell pepper
1  c. grated cheese
small can cream-style corn
hot chili peppers to taste
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Bake at 400° until done.

name: CREAMED BRUSSELS SPROUTS
ingredients:
4  c. whole Brussels sprouts, quartered or halved if big
cream
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Place the Brussels sprouts in a baking dish.  Pour enough cream over them to cover the bottom of the dish, 1/2-inch. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Cover and bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.

name: SWEET AND SOUR PORK
ingredients:
1/2  lb. boneless pork
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/3  c. flour
10  oz. sweet and sour sauce
8  oz. bags frozen Chinese vegetables
1  can chopped pineapple, drained
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Cut pork into chunks.  Dip in soy sauce and then in flour. Cook thoroughly in pan with oil.  In a wok or clean frying pan, cook frozen vegetables according to package directions; drain excess water.  Add sweet and sour sauce.  Add drained pineapple. Add pork.  Cook on medium heat until thoroughly heated.

name: DRESSING FOR BAKED FISH
ingredients:
3  lb. fish fillets or whole fish
2  c. dry bread crumbs
1/3  c. onion
1/3  c. sour cream
1/4  c. chopped dill pickle
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/4  c. salad oil
1/2  tsp. salt
pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and put a layer of it between fish fillets or stuff whole fish. Brush with oil; wrap in foil and bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

name: RAISIN COOKIES
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. salt (may omit)
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. allspice
1  c. water
2  c. raisins
1  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nutmeats
preparation: Add 1 cup of water to 2 cups of raisins and boil 5 minutes. Cool.  Cream the shortening and sugar.  Add eggs, vanilla, nutmeats and raisins.  Add dry ingredients.  Drop on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: CHICKEN DESIRIE
ingredients:
6  or 8 chicken breasts (boneless)
6 or 8  slices Swiss cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. white wine
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Spray Pam on a 9 x 13 Pyrex dish. Place cheese on top of each chicken breast. Mix soup and white wine and pour over chicken. Sprinkle herb seasoned bread crumbs over the top and pour margarine over crumbs. Bake, uncovered, at 350° about an hour.

name: ARTICHOKE PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
large shell macaroni, cooked
1  jar marinated artichoke hearts
1  c. ripe olives, halved
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/2  tsp. dry basil leaves
celery and/or green pepper, sliced
tomatoes (if desired)
salt and pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
6  eggs
3  c. cake flour
3  c. sugar
2  c. Crisco shortening or 2 sticks butter
1/4  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. vanilla flavor
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar until creamy.  Add eggs one at a time.  Combine flour and baking soda.  Add flour and sour cream alternately to mixture.  Add flavoring last.  Bake in a tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
3  lb. ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
1 small  can tomato paste or sauce
2  eggs
4  slices bread
2  stalks celery, chopped
1  small green pepper, chopped
salt, pepper and garlic to taste
catsup
preparation: Boil onions, celery and pepper until 3/4 cup of liquid remains in pan.  Combine all ingredients including water from vegetables, except catsup.  Bake for 1 hour at 360°, then remove from pan and drain water from the meat loaf.  Spread catsup over the loaf and return to oven for 30 minutes, or until done.

name: SALMON PATTIES
ingredients:
1  can (15 1/2 oz.) Alaska salmon
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/2  c. each chopped onion, finely chopped green pepper and fresh whole wheat bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. grated lemon peel
1/2  tsp. rosemary, crushed
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Drain salmon; flake.  Combine ingredients; mix well.  Form into 4 or 5 patties.  Pan-fry in small amount of vegetable oil until lightly browned on both sides.  Makes 4 or 5 servings.

name: LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  lb. Italian sausage
1  clove garlic
1  Tbsp. whole basil
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
10  oz. lasagne noodles
3  c. Ricotta or cottage cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  lb. Mozzarella cheese, sliced very thin
preparation: Brown meat; drain fat.  Add next 5 ingredients.  Simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Cook noodles in salted water until tender; drain and rinse.  Combine remaining ingredients, except Mozzarella cheese.  Place half noodles in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; spread with half the cheese filling.  Add half Mozzarella cheese and half the meat sauce.  Repeat layers. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.  Let stand 10 minutes before cutting in squares.  Filling will set slightly.  Makes 12 servings.

name: COCONUT POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
2  c. sugar
2  c. plain flour
5  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. coconut flavoring
1 small  can coconut
preparation: Cream sugar and Crisco.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Sift dry ingredients together.  Add alternately with buttermilk.   Add flavoring.  Remove beaters and fold in coconut.  Bake in greased tube pan at 350° for 1 hour.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
1  pkg. frozen cauliflower
1  pkg. frozen peas
1/4  c. Crisco
1  c. half and half
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. chicken broth
1  Tbsp. prepared horseradish
1  tsp. prepared mustard
4  drops Tabasco
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
soft bread crumbs
preparation: Cook each vegetable according to directions on package.  Melt Crisco in saucepan, stir in flour and cook until bubbly.  Stir in half and half and broth.  Bring to a boil.  Blend in Tabasco, mustard and horseradish.  Cook 1 minute.  Drain cooked vegetables and shredded cheese.  Fold into cream sauce.  Pour into a 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle crumbs on top.  Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or cheese is melted.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. uncooked rice (not instant)
3  c. water
1  chicken, cut up
preparation: Stir soup mix, soup and rice in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Add water and stir.  Place meat on top, then cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: COCONUT BONBONS
ingredients:
3/4  c. mashed potatoes
1  lb. powdered sugar
4  c. coconut
1  tsp. almond flavoring
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Roll into balls. Chill for 1 hour, then dip in melted chocolate for an added treat.

name: DEATH BY CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
1  pkg. brownies (family size), fix per directions of package
3 (3.5 oz.)  boxes chocolate mousse mix or 1 box chocolate mousse pie filling mix, fix per directions on box
1  large Cool Whip
8  Heath candy bars, crushed
1/4 to 1/2  c. Kahlua or 3 tsp. almond extract
preparation: After brownies cool, use fork to punch holes in brownies. Pour Kahlua or extract over brownies.  Allow time to soak in.

name: ICEBOX COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. frozen coconut, thawed
7  Tbsp. powdered sugar
12  oz. can evaporated milk (not sweetened)
9  oz. carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cake mix by directions on the box.  Add frozen coconut and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: CHARLIE'S CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal*
1  c. cream-style corn
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. salad oil or bacon drippings
2  eggs
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake in a 400° to 450° oven for about 20 to 25 minutes (or until done).

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  can cream of celery or mushroom soup
3/4  c. milk
4  c. thinly sliced potatoes
1  medium thinly sliced onion
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Grease quart casserole.  Blend soup, milk, salt and pepper.  Put layer of potatoes, onion and cheese. Pour soup mixture over top.  Dot with butter.  Cover and bake 1 hour.  Remove, cover and bake until done, about 15 minutes longer.

name: COOL ORANGE DRINK
ingredients:
6  oz. frozen orange juice
1  c. water
1  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
10  ice cubes
preparation: Combine and blend for 30 seconds.

name: NORMANDY CHOCOLATE MOUSSE
ingredients:
12  ladyfingers, split
3/4  c. (1 1/2 sticks) margarine
1 3/4  c. sifted confectioners sugar
6  egg yolks
1/4  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. rum extract
4  oz. (4 sq.) chocolate, melted
6  egg whites
1 1/2  c. pecans, coarsely chopped
whipped cream
preparation: Line a 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan with waxed paper.  Arrange ladyfingers around sides and bottom of pan.  Cream margarine; gradually add sugar, creaming until light and fluffy.  Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating until smooth after each addition. Blend in milk, vanilla and rum extract.  Blend in melted chocolate until well blended.  Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry; fold in chocolate mixture.  Fold in pecans.  Pour into prepared pans.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: SWEET CRISP PICKLES
ingredients:
7  lb. medium sized cucumbers
2  qt. vinegar
4 1/2  lb. white sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. celery salt
1  tsp. whole cloves
1  tsp. mixed pickling spices
preparation: Soak pickles overnight.  Then boil 40 minutes.  Slice cucumbers 1/4-inch thick; cover slices with a solution of 2 cups slaked lime in 2 gallons of water.  Soak 24 hours.  Slaked lime is available from your lumber dealer.  Next day, rinse pickles well and cover with fresh water.  Soak 3 hours longer.  Drain and cover with this mixture.  Soak in a crock container (only).  Pack in jars and seal.

name: BEEF AND SPINACH LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (26 to 30 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can Italian-style diced tomatoes, undrained
1/4  tsp. ground red pepper
1 (15 oz.)  carton part-skim Ricotta cheese
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, defrosted and drained
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  egg, beaten
10  uncooked lasagna noodles
1 1/2  c. shredded part-skim Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  In a large nonstick skillet, brown beef over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes. Pour off drippings.  Add salt, spaghetti sauce, tomatoes and red pepper.  Set aside.

name: CARROTS VICHY
ingredients:
3  c. carrots, peeled and sliced
3/4  c. boiling water
1 1/2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. butter (not margarine!)
parsley, chopped
preparation: Place carrots in boiling water with sugar and salt.  Cover the pot with tight cover and cook until water evaporates.  Brown carrots in butter.  Sprinkle with parsley.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. broccoli
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen cauliflower
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. Bisquick
1/4  c. oleo
preparation: Cook vegetables in salted water until stems are almost tender. Drain and put in ungreased casserole.  Mix soup and milk  and pour over vegetables.  Sprinkle with cheese.

name: WILD RICE CHICKEN SUPREME
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. original long grain and wild rice
1/4  c. margarine
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  c. half and half
1  c. chicken broth
2  c. cubed, cooked chicken
1/3  c. diced pimento
1/3  c. chopped parsley
1/4  c. chopped, slivered almonds
preparation: Cook rice according to package.  Melt butter.  Add onion and cook until tender.  Stir in flour, salt and pepper.  Gradually stir in half and half and broth.  Cook; stir constantly until thickened.  Stir in chicken, pimento, parsley, almonds and cooked rice.  Pour in greased 2-quart casserole.  Bake, uncovered at 400° for 30 minutes.

name: PIZZA DOUGH
ingredients:
3 3/4  c. flour
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  (1/4 oz.) packets quick rise yeast
1  tsp. salt
8  oz. lukewarm water
1/2  tsp. sugar
preparation: Combine flour, yeast, salt and sugar in mixing bowl and stir. Add vegetable oil and water.  Mix together all ingredients.  Knead by hand 3 minutes.  Shape.  Put into bowl.  Cover and let rise until double in volume.  Punch down; divide into 2 equal pieces and shape into 2 round balls or leave in 1 piece for 16-inch pizza. Let dough rest 4 minutes.  Rol out 12 to 16-inch diameter.  Place on pizza pan; let rise 10 to 15 minutes.  Add sauce and toppings. Place on bottom rack of cold oven.  Turn oven to 500° and bake 17 to 20 minutes.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1  can artichoke hearts
1  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. chopped scallions
1  tsp. onion flakes
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
dash of paprika
preparation: Drain artichokes and mash in a bowl.  Mix all ingredients together and place in a 9-inch pie plate.  Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Enjoy with cocktail ryes, crackers or veggies.

name: MOTHER'S EASY PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
1 2/3  c. sugar
1 small  can evaporated milk
16 large marshmallows or 2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. chunky style peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, evaporated milk and marshmallows in a medium saucepan.  Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture boils. Roll and stir 5 minutes.  Add peanut butter and vanilla.  Stir until smooth.  Pour into a buttered 8-inch square pan.  Cool.  Cut into 25 pieces.

name: MICROWAVE TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans (6 1/2 oz. each) chunk style tuna
6  oz. (3 c.) uncooked egg noodles
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/3  c. sliced green onions
1/2  c. dairy sour cream
2  tsp. mustard
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. dried thyme leaves
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. salt
1  small zucchini, scrubbed and sliced
1  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1  medium tomato, chopped
preparation: Drain and flake tuna.  Set aside.  Cook noodles according to package directions.  Drain and rinse in hot water.  Combine noodles with tuna, celery and green onions.  Blend in the sour cream, mustard, mayonnaise, thyme and salt.  Spoon half the mixture into buttered 2-quart casserole.  Top with half the zucchini.  Repeat layers.  Cover.  Microwave on High 6 to 8 minutes.  Top with cheese and tomato.  Microwave on High 2 minutes longer.  Let stand for 3 minutes before serving.

name: SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
1  c. Ricotta cheese
6  oz. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
8  oz. thin spaghetti
1/2  clove garlic, minced
1/4  c. butter
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  large egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. fresh basil or 1/4 tsp. dried
1/2  lb. ground beef
3/4  lb. Italian sausage
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. dried basil and oregano
1/4  c. white wine
preparation: Make Crust:   Combine the cooked spaghetti, garlic, butter, Parmesan cheese, egg and basil.  Mix well.

name: JELLO CAKE
ingredients:
1  lemon cake mix
1  pkg. lime jello
3/4  c. boiling water
1/2  c. cold water
1  pkg. Dream Whip
1  pkg. lemon instant pudding
preparation: Bake cake mix according to box directions.  Cool cake.  When completely cooled, poke holes with a fork or small handle of a wooden spoon.  Mix lime jello, boiling water and cold water.  Pour jello mixture into the holes of the cake.  Refrigerate 30 minutes.

name: KAHLUA CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines yellow butter cake mix
4  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
3/4  c. Crisco oil
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. Kahlua
3/4  c. pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients at medium speed for 2 minutes.  Pour into a 10-inch Bundt pan.  Bake 45 minutes at 325°, then cover with foil.  Bake 25 minutes longer.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. water
1  c. Crisco
3  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Heat water and sugar together until sugar melts; let cool. Mix the flour, nutmeg, Crisco and baking powder.  Mix until texture of corn meal.  Add sugar-water mixture and mix well.  Roll very thin.  Cut into desired shapes; dip in sugar and place on a pan.  Bake at 350° until brown.

name: HOT CATSUP
ingredients:
1  gal. catsup
2  bottles Louisiana hot sauce
10  drops of garlic oil
1/2  tsp. onion salt
7  jalapeno peppers
preparation: First of all, be careful of your selection. Once selected, give your entire thought to preparation for domestic use.  Some insist on keeping them in a pickle, others are constantly getting them in hot water. This makes them sour, hard and sometimes bitter. Even poor varieties may be made sweet and tender and good by garnishing them with patience, well sweetened with love and seasoned with kisses. Keep warm with a steady fire of domestic adoration and serve with peaches and cream. Thus prepared, they will keep for years.

name: YUMMY VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can green beans
1  can corn
1/2  c. sour cream
1  can undiluted celery soup
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. butter
3/4  c. cracker crumbs
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese
preparation: Drain beans and corn.  Mix all ingredients together, except butter and crackers.  Place in a greased casserole dish.  Melt butter.  Mix with cracker crumbs.  Spread on top.  Bake at 350° until top is brown and bubbly.

name: POTATO REFRIGERATOR ROLLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. warm water (not hot)
1  pkg. active dry yeast
2/3  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. soft shortening
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. mashed potatoes
7 to 7 1/2  c. flour
preparation: In bowl, dissolve yeast in water.  Stir in sugar, salt, shortening, eggs and potatoes.  Measure flour and mix with fork. Turn onto floured surface.  Knead until smooth and elastic. Grease bowl and place in refrigerator.  About 2 hours before baking, shape dough into rolls.  Cover and let rise until double in size, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  Heat oven to 400° and bake 12 to 15 minutes.  Makes 4 dozen medium rolls.

name: CORNISH GAME HEN WITH GRAPES(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  c. seedless green grapes (about 6 oz.)
1/4  c. chicken broth (canned can be used)
1/8  tsp. kosher salt
1  (1 3/4 lb.)  Cornish hen, split (backbone removed)
preparation: Place grapes and broth in a 10 x 7 x 4-inch oval dish. Sprinkle with salt.  Place split hen, skin side up, over grapes. Cover tightly with microwave plastic wrap.  Cook at 100% for 8 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Serve piping hot.  Serves 2.

name: BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
3  cans chicken stock
2  c. chopped onion
4  c. chopped broccoli
4  c. milk
8  Tbsp. butter
8  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Simmer chicken stock, onion and broccoli 15 minutes.  Put into a bowl.  In same saucepan, combine milk, butter and flour until thick.  Combine stock, broccoli and onion mixture with milk mixture.  Heat until thickened.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: SWISS VEGETABLE MEDLEY
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) frozen broccoli, carrots and cauliflower
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  Tbsp. black pepper
1  can French fried onions
preparation: Combine vegetables, soup, 1/2 cup of cheese, sour cream, pepper and 1/2 can French fried onions.  Pour into casserole dish. Bake covered at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onions.  Bake uncovered for 5 minutes longer.  Makes 6 servings.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  C. Sugar
1  C. Salad Oil
4  Large Eggs, beaten
1 (16 oz)  can Pumpkin
3 1\2  C. Flour
2  tsp. Salt
2  tsp. Baking Soda
1\2 tsp. Ground Cloves
1  tsp. Cinnamon
1  tsp. Allspice
2\3 C. Water
1-1 1\2 C. Pecans, chopped (optional)
preparation: Using an electric mixer, combine sugar, oil and eggs. Beat until light and fluffy. Stir in pumpkin. Combine dry ingredients and stir into pumpkin mixture. Add water and nuts, mixing well. Spoon batter into 2 well greased 9 x 5 x 3 inch loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 65 to 75 min.

name: SWEET POTATO PUDDING
ingredients:
3  c. grated sweet potatoes
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  whole eggs
1  c. sweet milk
1  stick butter
pinch of salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. vanilla
1 to 2  Tbsp. whiskey
preparation: Melt butter in glass dish, 9 x 9 in oven.  Mix butter and all other ingredients together.  Pour into glass dish and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 375°.  Stir 2 times while cooking.

name: JEN'S BREW(King Ranch Chicken)
ingredients:
5  boneless chicken breasts or more
1  large onion
1  green bell pepper
1  can mushroom soup
1  can Ro-Tel
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. grated cheese
1 1/2  tsp. chili powder
1 1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  pkg. corn tortillas
preparation: Boil chicken.  In skillet, saute onion and pepper until clear, then add soups (mushroom, Ro-Tel and cream of chicken).  Chop chicken; put in soup mixture.  Dip 6 or more tortillas in chicken broth.  Spray pan with Pam, then pour 1/2 of chicken mixture in pan.  Spread some cheese.  Add the tortillas that have been dipped in chicken broth to cover.  Add rest of mixture.  Add chili and garlic powder.  Add rest of cheese.  Bake for approximately 5 to 15 minutes.

name: QUAKER OATS CHOCOLATE-CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine (2 sticks)
1 1/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
2 1/2  c. Quaker oats
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add eggs, milk and vanilla; beat well.  Add flour, baking soda and salt; mix well.  Stir in oats, chocolate morsels and nuts; mix well.

name: Pea Salad
ingredients:
1  can LeSueur peas, drained
1  hard-boiled egg
1  onion, chopped fine
3/4  c. celery, chopped fine
1 small  can water chestnuts, drained and diced
1  c. Cheddar cheese, cubed (small)
small jar pimento, drained and chopped
1/2 to 3/4  c. mayonnaise
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all together the night before.  Refrigerate.  Serves 6.

name: NEW SWING ON FIXING CHICKEN(Quick And Easy)
ingredients:
boneless chicken breasts or tenders
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Fry, using 1 tablespoon butter or margarine and 1/4 cup Worcestershire sauce and chicken until done.  Serve with seasoned long grain and wild rice and tossed salad.  Whole meal takes less than 20 minutes.

name: BELGIAN BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1/4  cup flour
2  lbs. lean beef cubed
2  tsp salt
1/2  cup salad oil
2  lbs. onions, sliced
1  clove garlic
2  cans light beer
1  Tbsp. Worchestire sauce
1  Tbsp. steak sauce
2  bay leaves
1/2  tsp. dried thyme
2  lbs. potatoes, quartered
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Combine flour, salt and pepper, coat meat.  In a large dutch oven, sautée onions and garlic in hot oil until onions are clear and tender.  Remove onions and set aside.  Add meat to oil and brown well on all sides.  Return onions to pan and add beer, Worchestire sauce, steak sauce, bay leaves and thyme.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, covered, about 2 hours.  Add potatoes, simmer until done.

name: LEMON CHESS PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. lemon juice
rind of 1 lemon
3  Tbsp. butter
dash of salt
preparation: Mix eggs and sugar. Squeeze the lemon juice and use pulp. Combine ingredients and bake in raw pie shell for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: HUMMINGBIRD CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. salad oil
2  tsp. vanilla
1  can (8 oz.) crushed pineapple, undrained
1  c. chopped nuts
2  c. chopped bananas
Cream Cheese Frosting
preparation: Combine dry ingredients in large bowl.  Add eggs and salad oil.  Stir until all ingredients are moistened.  Do not beat. Stir in vanilla, nuts, pineapple and bananas.

name: WHISTLING BAGPIPES
ingredients:
6  oz. butterscotch chips
1/2  c. peanut butter
3  oz. chow mein noodles
1  c. mini marshmallows
preparation: Melt together chips and peanut butter.  Add marshmallows and noodles.  Drop onto wax paper in tablespoon size.  Chill.  Makes about 35 pieces.

name: BUTTER BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  cans butter beans drained & rinsed
1  cup brown sugar
13  oz. ketchup
1  med. onion (diced)
1  can italian stewed tomatoes
2  green peppers cut up
1  1/2 lbs. kielbasa
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake uncovered at 350 for 1 1/2 hours.

name: GODFATHER MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. ground beef
2  eggs
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  chopped onion
1  clove garlic
1  c. Italian bread crumbs
4  slices ham
4  slices Mozzarella cheese
1  jar Ragu Italian sauce
2  slices Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Mix on wax paper; shape into rectangle.  Layer 4 slices ham and 4 slices Mozzarella cheese.  Roll up.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.  Pour 1 jar Ragu Italian sauce over meat loaf; top with 2 slices Mozzarella cheese.

name: ORNAMENTAL FROSTING
ingredients:
1  egg white
1/8  tsp. cream of tartar
1/5  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. sifted confectioners sugar
preparation: Mix up and beat ingredients until sharp enough to hold a line when cut with a knife.

name: NO BAKE CHOCOLATE OATMEAL PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. cocoa
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  1/2  c. Quick Oatmeal (uncooked)
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. evaporated milk
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine sugar, butter, cocoa, vanilla, and milk.  Boil until thick, remove from heat immediately, mix in peanut butter, oatmeal, and nuts.  Spoon onto wax paper.  Cool and enjoy!

name: SHORT CUT CHICKEN "N" RICE
ingredients:
4  chicken breast halves, skinned and boned
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1 1/3  c. dry white wine
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. long grain and wild rice mix
preparation: Coat a large skillet with cooking spray.  Place over medium heat until hot.  Brown chicken on both sides.  Remove chicken; set aside.  Combine soup and wine.  Stir in rice mix.  Pour mixture into skillet and bring to a boil.  Arrange chicken over rice. Cover and reduce heat and simmer 25 minutes or until rice is tender.  Yield: 4 servings.

name: STREUSEL
ingredients:
4  1/2 c flour
3  sticks butter
2  c sugar
1  can crushed pineapple (drained) or 1 can cherry pie filling
preparation: Mix together first three ingredients until crumbly.  Pat half of mixture onto a greased jelly roll pan.  Spread filling over crust.  Sprinkle the rest of the mixture over top of filling. Bake for 45 minutes on 350  degrees.

name: PEANUT BUTTER SQUARES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. margarine, melted and cooled
1  c. peanut butter
1  lb. box powdered sugar
12  oz. pkg. milk chocolate bits
preparation: Mix graham cracker crumbs, margarine, peanut butter and powdered sugar.  Pat into the bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan.  Put in refrigerator.  Melt chocolate bits.  Pour over top of other mixture and spread.  Cool in refrigerator 10 minutes and then cut.

name: MARTHA WASHINGTON CANDY
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  stick oleo
1 1/2  boxes powdered sugar
2  c. coconut
3  c. nuts, chopped (optional)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together milk, butter and sugar; add nuts, coconut and vanilla.  Stir well.  Drop from spoon on wax paper; pieces should be about the size of small walnuts.  Let set overnight in a cool place.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  lb. butter
4  Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
vanilla
preparation: Cream together and pour in a long pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1/4  c. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. milk
3  egg yolks, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. margarine
vanilla
preparation: Cook the ingredients until thick; pour over vanilla wafers and bananas which have been placed in a long, large glass dish.

name: SWEET TOMATO RELISH
ingredients:
1  gal. ripe tomatoes, peeled and quartered
1  pt. onions, finely chopped
1  doz. bell peppers, chopped
1/2  doz. hot peppers, chopped
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
2  c. sugar
2  c. white vinegar
6  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a large pot and boil 10 minutes. Spoon into jars and seal.  Eat with vegetables or meat.

name: TEXAS LEMON CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
1  pkg. Betty Crocker white cake mix
3/4  c. Wesson oil
4  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. lemon extract
1  c. powdered sugar
4  Tbsp. lemon juice
a little grated lemon rind
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water; let cool, stirring occasionally.  Mix together cake mix, Wesson oil, eggs and lemon extract.  Beat 2 minutes, then add jello.  Bake in sheet pan at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: BUCKEYES
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. powdered sugar
1  c. peanut butter
1  large bag chocolate chips
1  c. butter
1/4  c. cake paraffin
preparation: Melt butter and peanut butter in a pan.  Mix with powdered sugar.  Roll into balls.  Melt paraffin and chocolate chips and pour over peanut butter balls.

name: NEVER FAIL CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
2  c. milk
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix eggs, sugar and salt.  Bring milk to a boil.  Add milk to egg mixture slowly, beating as you mix.  Add vanilla.  Pour into unbaked pie shell and sprinkle with nutmeg.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: EGG DROP SOUP
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. water
1 (2.25 oz.)  envelope chicken noodle soup mix
1  egg, beaten
preparation: In medium saucepan bring water to a boil.  Stir in soup mix. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes.  With a fork, quickly stir in the egg, a little at a time, until it congeals.  Serve with chow mein noodles or crispy Chinese fried noodles.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1  c. roasted peanuts
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  tsp. butter
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: In 1 1/2-quart casserole, stir together sugar and syrup. Microwave on High for 4 minutes.  Stir in peanuts.  Microwave on High for 3 minutes until light brown.  Add butter and vanilla, blending well.  Microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes.  Peanuts will be lightly browned and syrup will be hot.  Add baking soda and stir until light and foamy.  Pour mixture into nonstick coated cookie sheet.  Spread as thin as desired.  Let cool 1/2 to 1 hour. Break into small pieces and store in airtight container.

name: OLIVE NUT SPREAD
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
2  Tbsp. olive liquid
1  Tbsp. olives, chopped
1  dash hot sauce
preparation: Put all ingredients in a small bowl and blend well.  This will stay fresh in the refrigerator for 2 weeks.  Serve with crackers or may be used as a sandwich spread.

name: CHEESE BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. shredded cheese (2 oz.)
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Mix together.  Drop by spoonful on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: ROBERT'S BREAKFAST SAUSAGE
ingredients:
5  lb. 70% lean pork (ground 1 time)
1 1/2  oz. salt
1/4  oz. sage
1/4  oz. black pepper or pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Add one cup water and mix well. You can make sausage patties or stuff in sheep casing.  Cook like you would any other sausage or freeze in serving size portions.

name: POTATO CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. (2 sticks) margarine
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. crushed potato chips
1  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix margarine, sugar and vanilla together.  Mix well.  Add potato chips and stir in flour.  Form small balls from mixture and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Press balls flat with the bottom of a glass that has been dipped in sugar.  Bake 16 to 18 minutes, or until lightly browned.

name: COCONUT CREME PIE
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. milk
3  egg yolks, slightly beaten
1  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. coconut
preparation: Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt in pan.  Gradually stir in milk.  Cook on medium heat, stirring constantly.  Boil 1 minute. Stir 1/2 of hot mixture in egg yolks.  Blend all.  Boil 1 minute longer.  Blend in butter, vanilla and coconut.  Pour in cooled pie crust.  Top with meringue or Cool Whip.

name: CHRISTMAS FRUIT COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
2  c. white sugar
1  c. butter shortening
4  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
2 1/2  c. candied fruit
1  c. pecans
3  eggs
preparation: Chop up nuts and fruit.  Mix with 1 cup flour; set aside.  Mix sugars, shortening, eggs and vanilla until smooth.  Add flour, soda and salt.  Mix.  Add fruit and nuts.  Roll into logs. Refrigerate overnight.  Slice and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: APPLE CINNAMON CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. oil
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  c. plain flour
1  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. baking soda
2  Tbsp. vanilla
3  c. chopped Granny Smith apples
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. raisins
preparation: Combine oil, sugar and eggs; add dry ingredients, then remaining ingredients.  Mixture will be a heavy dough.  Pour into a greased and floured tube pan.  Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes at 325°.  When done, leave in pan.  Pour Buttermilk Sauce over cake and let cool completely in pan.

name: ORANGE "TORCH" WHIP MOLD
ingredients:
2  cans vanilla pudding
1 (16 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Mix together all ingredients and chill.  Place mandarin oranges on top.

name: ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
8  flour tortillas
1  large onion, chopped
1  lb. ground chuck
1  can chili without beans
1/2  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
1  tsp. chili powder
red pepper (optional)
1/2  lb. grated cheese
additional chopped onion
1  can El Paso enchilada sauce (optional)
preparation: Saute  onion  and  ground  meat until meat is brown and onions are tender.  Add chili and seasonings.  On each tortilla, put a small amount  of  meat  mixture,  cheese  and onion. Roll up and place in  baking  dish.  Pour remaining meat sauce on top, more onion and top  with  cheese.  Bake	at 350° until cheese melts or if sauce seems  too dry or there is not enough to cover the tortillas, use a can of El Paso enchilada sauce.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger, fried and drained
1  head lettuce, cut up
1  bag corn chips
1 large  bottle Catalina dressing
preparation: Mix all of the ingredients together and let set for 30 to 60 minutes.  Very good!

name: BROCCOLI PERFECT
ingredients:
2  pkg. chopped broccoli
1  beaten egg
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. bread crumbs
1/4  c. butter, melted
paprika
preparation: Cook broccoli 3 minutes; drain well.  Mix beaten egg, onion, mayonnaise, cheese and soup.  Add to cooked broccoli.  Pour into buttered casserole.  Spread with bread crumbs.  Drizzle with butter and sprinkle with paprika.  Bake 35 minutes at 350°.

name: HOMEMADE TOMATO SOUP
ingredients:
24  medium size tomatoes
2  stalks celery, cut
2  bay leaves
1/4  tsp. onion juice
1/2  tsp. lemon
2  Tbsp. chopped green peppers
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. cayenne
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. parsley
1/2  c. whipped cream
preparation: Do  not  skin  tomatoes;  cut  in quarters and place in heavy pot  with  celery,  green pepper and bay leaves.  Cover tightly and  cook  on low to medium heat without adding water. Put through sieve,  add  all  the rest of the ingredients and bring to a boil.  Serves about 6.

name: ALL VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can Veg-All, drained
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. grated cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
20  Ritz crackers, crushed
1/3  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Mix the first 5 ingredients and put into a casserole dish. Top with a mixture of crumbs and margarine.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: SUGAR-FREE LEMON PIE
ingredients:
2  pkg. sugar-free vanilla Jell-O pudding
3 1/2  c. 2% sweet milk
1  tub Crystal Light lemonade mix
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
2  graham cracker crusts
preparation: Mix sugar-free pudding in milk.  Mix well; use mixer.  Add lemonade mix; mix well.  Add Cool Whip; mix well.  Put into crusts and chill.

name: FRENCH BREAKFAST PUFFS
ingredients:
1/3  cup shortening
1/2  cup sugar
1  egg
1 1/2  cup flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  cup milk
preparation: Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Grease or line with paper 30 - 36 cupcake (3 pans).  Mix thoroughly shortening, 1/2 cup sugar and the egg.  Stir in flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg alternately with milk.  Fill muffin cups 2/3 full.  Bake 10 -12 minutes.

name: CRAZY CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
1/3  c. cocoa
3/4  c. salad oil
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. cold water
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Mix well.  Pour into ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: CRISPIX MIX
ingredients:
1  box crispix cereal
1  jar of peanut butter
1  bag chocolate chips
1  box powdered sugar
preparation: Melt peanut butter and chocolate chips over med. heat.  Pour over cereal in large bowl.  Gently stir, careful not to crush cereal, until all cereal is coated.  Pour powdered sugar into an oven roasting bag (or a clean shopping bag will work).  Pour coated cereal into bag of sugar.  Making sure to hold the top closed, shake bag until all cereal is coated with sugar.  Pour cereal mix onto cookie sheet to cool.  If you have any left after snacking, store in an airtight container.  Enjoy!!

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  Tbsp. sugar
5  Tbsp. margarine, melted
preparation: Combine and press in 9-inch pie pan.  Chill.

name: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
1 (17 oz.)  can whole kernel corn
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese
milk (see directions for amount)
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter, softened
15  to 20 soda crackers
1  Tbsp. each: onion and green pepper, finely chopped (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Drain liquid from whole corn into measuring cup, noting the amount.  Discard the liquid.  Pour milk into same measuring cup until amount equals liquid that was discarded.  Put corn into medium-sized casserole dish.  Add butter, milk and cheese to the corn.  Add green pepper and onion, if desired.  Mix well.  Crumble crackers into mixture.  Stir.  Bake, uncovered, in preheated oven for 30 minutes.  Dish is done when top starts to brown and mixture appears set.  Remove from oven and let cool for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

name: COCOA MIX
ingredients:
4  c. instant milk powder
1  c. cocoa (sift if lumpy)
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. Cremora
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix all together well in a large airtight canister.   Use 1/4 cup of mix in a cup of boiling water to drink.

name: E. G. CHEESE LOG
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. (10 oz.) shredded sharp natural Cheddar cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (2 1/2 oz.)  pkg. smoked beef slices, chopped
1/4  c. green onion, chopped
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. chopped parsley
preparation: Combine Cheddar cheese and softened cream cheese, mixing on medium speed on electric mixer until well blended.  Add chopped beef, green onion and Worcestershire sauce.  Mix well.  Chill several hours or overnight.  Shape mixture into 7-inch log.  Wrap 16 x 1-inch foil strips around log.  Roll in chopped parsley. Remove foil.  Serve with crackers or party rye bread.

name: MEXICAN POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
3  bacon strips
3  to 4 large potatoes, peeled and diced
4  c. chicken broth
1  c. water
1  c. tomato sauce
1/4  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  tsp. salt
10  oz. chopped green chiles
medium Cheddar and Jack cheese, grated
preparation: Brown bacon in large pan; drain.  Add the potato cubes and mix.  Add broth, water, tomato sauce, onion and salt.  Bring to a simmer and cook until potatoes are tender.

name: PORK CHOP CACCIATRA
ingredients:
6  pork chops (about 3/4-inch thick)
1/2  tsp. salt
6  thin onion slices
1  envelope spaghetti sauce mix
1  can (2 c.) tomatoes
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
6  green pepper rings
preparation: Trim fat from chops.  Heat fat in skillet.  When you have about 1 tablespoon melted fat, remove trimmings.  Brown chops; season with salt and dash of pepper.
