Place in an 11 x 9-inch baking dish. Top each chop with onion slice.  Combine next 3 ingredients; pour over chops.  Cover with foil; bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.  Uncover.  Top chops with green pepper; bake 15 minutes.  Serve with hot cooked rice.  Makes 6 servings.

name: MIX IN THE PAN CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  c. shredded carrots
1/4  c. water
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In an 8 or 9-inch square pan, mix dry ingredients.  Add carrots, eggs, oil, water and vanilla.  Mix well with a fork until blended.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.  Cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar.  Serves 9.

name: STUFFED COCKTAIL TOMATOES
ingredients:
1  pt. cherry tomatoes
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, finely grated
1/4  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. sherry
preparation: Wash tomatoes.  Cut off tops and gently squeeze out seeds. Place on paper towels, top side down to dry.  Mix cheese with sour cream and sherry in blender.  With teaspoon, fill tomatoes with mixture.  Chill for 1 hour before serving.

name: INDOOR S'MORES
ingredients:
1/3  c. corn syrup
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. milk chocolate chips
1/2  tsp. vanilla
4  c. Golden Grahams cereal
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Butter 9 x 9 x 2-inch square pan.  Heat corn syrup and butter to boiling in 3-quart saucepan.  Remove from heat.  Add chocolate chips and vanilla; stir until chocolate is melted.  Fold in cereal, 1 cup at a time, stirring gently until completely cooked. Fold in marshmallows.  Press mixture evenly in pan with buttered back of spoon.  Let stand until firm, at least 1 hour.  Cut into bars, about 2 1/4 x 1 1/2-inches.  Makes 24 bars.

name: SIMPLE STEAK
ingredients:
3  lb. round steak, cut into bite size pieces
4  cans cream of mushroom soup or cream of chicken
1  can water
salt and pepper to taste*
preparation: *I don't use any.  I find the salt in the soup is plenty.

name: FLITTERS
ingredients:
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  tsp. Arm & Hammer soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. all-purpose flour (not self-rising)
shortening
preparation: Mix into a bowl, buttermilk, soda, salt and baking powder. Stir until batter is smooth.  Add flour and stir until batter is of a pancake batter consistency.  Melt shortening in a pan and cook as you would pancakes, at a medium temperature.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs, added to milk
preparation: I use 1/2 this recipe for my family of 4.

name: GREEN ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  doz. corn tortillas
1/2  c. onion, finely chopped
1  c. grated cheese
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  can evaporated milk
2 small  cans chopped green chilies
1 to 2  c. cooked chopped chicken
preparation: Fry tortillas in hot fat until they bubble; blot excess grease.  Place soup, milk and green chilies in saucepan and warm. Layer tortillas, cheese, onion and chicken.  Top with 1/3 soup mix, then more tortillas, etc. until all ingredients have been put in casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: SWEET POTATO SOUFFLE
ingredients:
3  c. mashed baked sweet potatoes
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. milk
1/2  stick melted margarine
1  egg, well beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. shredded or fresh coconut
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Place in baking dish and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.  Remove from oven and place marshmallows on top.  Return to oven and slightly melt and brown marshmallows.

name: BREAST OF CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts
1/2  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  can sliced mushrooms
1/4  tsp. marjoram
1/4  c. sherry
1  tsp. parsley, chopped
dash of white pepper
toast slices
Canadian bacon, sliced
preparation: Broil chicken breasts, pouring undiluted soup over them.  Add a few extra mushrooms.  Add the marjoram, sherry, parsley and white pepper.  Place piece of Canadian bacon on toast, then top with chicken and sauce.

name: BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. sour milk (milk plus enough vinegar to curdle)
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. banana flavoring (optional)
few drops lemon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. mashed bananas
2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.    Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.   Great for overripe bananas.

name: BAVARIN
ingredients:
1  pkg. jello (any kind)
1  c. boiling water
3/4  c. cold water
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix jello and hot water; add cold water and freeze until thickens.  Set aside 1/2 cup jello.  Mix ice cream with 1/2 cup jello.  Then top with other mixture and chill!

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 small  boxes cherry Jell-O
1  c. celery
1  c. walnuts
1  c. crushed pineapple
2  c. ground cranberries
preparation: Let cranberries set in 1 3/4 cup sugar for 1 hour.  Dissolve gelatin in 3 cups of hot water.  Dice celery.  Chop nuts.  Combine all ingredients and chill.

name: NOODLE PUDDING
ingredients:
6  c. noodles (1 lb. fine)
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  lb. butter
1 1/2  pt. sour cream
3/4  lb. cream cheese
4  Tbsp. vanilla
6  eggs
preparation: Cook noodles.  Soften butter and cream cheese over low heat. Put sugar in large bowl.  Throw on hot, drained noodles and mix well.  Add cream cheese mixture; mix well.  Add sour cream, eggs and vanilla; mix all together.  Put into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan; sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour. May be cut in half.

name: PENUCHE NUTS
ingredients:
1  c. light brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1/2  pt. sour cream
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. or more pecan halves
preparation: Combine sugars with sour cream, stirring well.  Stir over low heat until mixture forms a soft ball in cold water.  Remove from heat and add vanilla and nuts.  Stir until mixture coats nuts. Turn out on waxed paper.  Separate with a fork.

name: PENNSYLVANIA DUTCH MILK PIE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. flour
4  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  c. whole milk
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Put flour and sugar into unbaked pie shell.  Mix together and spread over shell with fingers.  Cover with milk and dot with butter.  Bake at 400° for 35 minutes.

name: LIGHT AND FLUFFY PIE
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. jello (any flavor)
2/3  c. boiling water
2  c. ice cubes
1  (8 or 9 oz.) Cool Whip
1  ready made graham cracker crust
preparation: Dissolve jello completely in boiling water, stirring about 3 minutes.  Add ice cubes and stir until jello is thickened, about 2 or 3 minutes.  Remove any unmelted ice.  Using fork or wire whisk, blend in Cool Whip topping.  Whip until smooth.  Chill, if necessary, until mixture will mound.  Spoon into crust.  Chill 3 hours.

name: BAKED PINEAPPLE
ingredients:
2 large  cans pineapple chunks
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1  stack Ritz crackers
1  stick butter
preparation: Drain pineapple.  Place in oblong baking dish.  Mix sugar and flour.  Spread over pineapple.   Crush Ritz crackers.  Spread over pineapple and flour mixture.  Melt butter and pour over.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: PORK CHOPS AND KRAUT
ingredients:
4  pork chops
1 small  can kraut
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. onion rings
preparation: Drain most of juice from kraut.  Brown pork chops and chopped onions in 1/2 stick butter.  Put kraut in baking dish, then pork chops and sauteed onions.  Pour mushroom soup over all and put onion rings on top.  Bake in 350° oven until chops are tender.

name: LUSH
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, at room temperature
1  c. flour
8  oz. cream cheese, at room temperature
2  pkg. instant pudding mix (vanilla or chocolate)
3  c. milk
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. powdered sugar
2  c. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix margarine, flour and chopped nuts and press into 13 x 9-inch  pan.  Bake	15 minutes at 375°.  Mix powdered sugar, cream cheese  and  Cool  Whip  and spread on crust while warm. Mix instant  pudding  mix  and milk and spread on cream cheese mixture.  Add rest of Cool Whip on top.  Refrigerate.

name: PICKLED TURNIPS
ingredients:
about 1 1/2 lb. small turnips
2  Tbsp. salt
1  c. vinegar
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. yellow food coloring
1/4  tsp. paprika
preparation: Peel turnips.  Cut crosswise in thin slices, not more than 1/4-inch thick. Mix with salt.  Let stand 1 hour. Drain  and rinse thoroughly with water.  Bring to a boil vinegar, sugar, food coloring and paprika.  Add turnips and simmer 2 minutes; cool.

name: BEE STING CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
10  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/4  c. melted butter or margarine
1/4  c. heavy cream
1  c. shredded coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together first 5 ingredients.  Bring milk and 2 tablespoons butter to slight boil.  Mix with batter.  Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.  Mix last 5 ingredients together and spread on cake while cake is still warm.  Broil until topping is bubbly and brown.  Makes 10 servings.

name: CORNED BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  oz. elbow macaroni
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can milk
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  can corned beef
2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Cook macaroni; drain.  Put in large baking dish.  Add onion, soup, milk, salt, pepper and corned beef.  (Chunk up corned beef before adding.)  Add 1 cup of grated cheese; mix well.  Sprinkle remaining cheese over top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
3  bananas, sliced
1  can pineapple tidbits (20 oz.)
1  can fruit cocktail
1  pkg. vanilla pudding (instant)
preparation: Drain juice from both  cans and save.  Pour pudding mix in a bowl and use  all  of pineapple and about 1/2 fruit cocktail juice to mix with  pudding.  Add all of fruit and toss to coat.  Chill before serving.

name: SURPRISE CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened or lite Neufchatel cheese
1/4  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
2  c. flour
1 3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  c. oil
3  eggs, beaten
3  c. shredded carrot
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients, mixing until well blended. Set aside.

name: 3 PECAN PIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. flour
6  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. Karo
1  stick butter
2  c. pecans, chopped fine
preparation: Mix sugar, melted butter, Karo, flour and vanilla.  Stir in eggs, one at a time.  Do not beat.  Add pecans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until firm.

name: MEAT AND POTATOES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
5  medium potatoes, cubed
1  large onion, chopped
2  c. diced celery
1  can tomato sauce
1/2  c. hot water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown meat and drain fat.  Place layer of meat in casserole, layer of potatoes, onion and celery.  Season, then add 1/2 can of soup.  Repeat layers.  Pour hot water over top and cover casserole.  Bake at 300° for 2 hours.

name: BOILED CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/4  c. cocoa
2  c. sugar
pinch of salt
1/2  c. milk
1  stick margarine
3  c. oats (1 minute oats)
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar and cocoa; add salt and milk.  Bring to a rolling boil.  Boil 3 minutes, then add the oats, peanut butter, margarine and vanilla.  Mix real well, then spoon onto wax paper.  Let cool. Enjoy!

name: OVEN ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton onion soup mix
2  lb. potatoes, cut in large chunks
1/3  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  In large plastic bag, add all ingredients.  Close bag and shake.  Empty into roasting pan and bake 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Bake until brown.

name: PARBOILING RIBS BEFORE BARBECUING
ingredients:
2  gal. water
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. cayenne pepper
1/2  c. Tabasco
5  onions, chopped
8  lb. beef ribs
preparation: Bring all ingredients but ribs to a boil.  Reduce to a simmer. Add ribs and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until done.  Turn off heat and let sit 10 minutes more.

name: CINNAMON BALL DOUGHNUTS(Yields 2 1/2 Dozen, 1 3/4-inch Doughnut Balls)
ingredients:
2  c. Duncan Hines buttermilk pancake mix
1/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
1  egg
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
Crisco oil for deep frying
preparation: In an electric skillet, heat to 375° enough oil to make a 1 1/2-inch depth.  Combine pancake mix and 1/4 cup sugar.  Add milk and egg.  Stir just until pancake mix is moistened.  Drop from a teaspoon into hot oil.  Brown doughnut balls on both sides, then drain on paper towels.  Measure 3/4 cup sugar and the cinnamon into a plastic or paper bag.  Add a few doughnut balls at a time; shake to coat them with cinnamon-sugar mixture.  Extra good served warm.

name: EASY BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  can chicken broth
1 large  pkg. frozen broccoli
1  pkg. Lipton dry chicken noodle soup
small pkg. Velveeta cheese
1  c. half and half cream or milk
preparation: Cook broccoli in chicken broth.  When done, add dry chicken soup mix.  Cut cheese into chunks and add.  Let cook on low heat until cheese melts.  Add the half and half to soup.

name: CHILI WITH SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (15 oz.)  can chili hot beans
2  cans water
1  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. salt
1/4 (8 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti, broken into pieces
1  onion, chopped
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet until completely browned and onions are tender.  Drain fat.  Add tomato sauce, beans and 2 cans of water.  Also add spices.  Stir well to mix all ingredients together.  Bring mixture to a simmer and cover with lid.  Simmer 30 to 45 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI BARS
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white syrup
2  eggs
1 3/4  c. flour
walnuts
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. raisins
3/4  c. coconut
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. unpeeled, grated zucchini
preparation: Mix all.  Bake in jelly roll pan at 350° for 45 minutes. Frost with powdered sugar frosting.

name: SUET PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. finely chopped suet
1  c. molasses
1  c. milk
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ginger, cloves and nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix and sift dry ingredients.  Add molasses and milk to suet. Combine mixtures.  Turn into buttered mold and cover.  Steam 3 hours.  Raisins and currants may be added.

name: SCALLOPED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  loaf white bread, cubed
1 1/2  c. cracker crumbs, crushed
3  c. chicken broth
3  eggs, lightly beaten
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. diced celery
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
3  c. cubed, cooked chicken
1 (8 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms, drained
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: In a mixing bowl, combine bread cubes and 1 cup cracker crumbs. Stir in broth, eggs, salt, celery, onion, chicken and mushrooms. Spoon into a greased 2-quart casserole.  In a saucepan, melt butter; brown remaining cracker crumbs.  Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: FRIED RICE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked brown rice
2  celery stalks
2  carrot sticks
1  small onion
1  or 2 eggs
2  Tbsp. peanut oil
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Chop celery, carrots and onion.  In large saucepan, break eggs in peanut oil.  In separate corners of pan, place celery, carrots and onion.  With spatula, chop egg up and flip as it cooks and stir other vegetables.  Add rice and soy sauce and mix all together, stirring and flipping until rice is brown.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: MOCHA TRUFFLES
ingredients:
2  pkg. (12 oz. each) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
3  Tbsp. instant coffee granules
2  tsp. water
1  lb. dark chocolate confectionery coating
white confectionery coating (optional)
preparation: In a microwave-safe bowl or double boiler, melt chocolate chips.  Add cream cheese, coffee and water; mix well.  Chill until firm enough to shape.  Shape into 1-inch balls and place on a waxed paper-lined cookie sheet.  Chill for 1 to 2 hours or until firm.

name: OREO PIE
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. Oreo cookies
1  qt. vanilla ice cream, softened
preparation: Grease lightly a pie pan or cake pan.  Crush Oreos.  Place most crumbs in pan, saving some for topping.  Press firmly in bottom.  Spread ice cream on crumbs.  You may not need entire quart.  Top with remaining crumbs.  Freeze for 2 hours.  Slice.

name: POPPY SEED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 whole or 3  c. chicken, broken up, reserve broth
1  stick margarine
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 1/2  Tbsp. poppy seed
2  c. cracker crumbs
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Take chicken off bone.  Butter pan.  Put chicken in pan.  Whip sour cream and soup together.  Pour over chicken.  Melt margarine and mix with cracker crumbs and poppy seed.  Put on top of chicken and cream sauce.  Sprinkle chicken broth over entire pan and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: HARDEE'S BISCUITS
ingredients:
4  c. self-rising flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
2  c. buttermilk
2/3  c. shortening
preparation: Mix together ingredients, but do not knead.  Roll out dough 1-inch thick.  Cut into rounds; brush tops with buttermilk.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

name: OLD FASHIONED TAFFY
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. water
preparation: Boil all ingredients until the hard ball stage.  Pour into greased pan or greased marble slab to cool.  When cool enough to handle, pull  until white.  This was used for the old fashioned taffy pull.  Especially fun for young people.   The longer it is pulled (to get air out of it), the better.

name: HASH BROWN SUPREME
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash browns
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
1  pt. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. salt and pepper
2  c. corn flake crumbs
1/2  c. butter/margarine
preparation: Combine potatoes and melted butter.  Stir in sour cream, soup, onion, shredded cheese, salt and pepper.  Mix well.  Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan well.  Combine corn flake crumbs with butter and sprinkle on top of mixture once placed in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover mixture with foil.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Uncover and bake an additional 20 minutes.

name: RASPBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry jello
2  c. hot water
2 small (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen raspberries
1 (16 oz.)  jar applesauce
preparation: Dissolve jello; cool to lukewarm.  Add raspberries and applesauce.  Let set.

name: ORANGE SLICE COOKIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. vanilla wafers, crushed
1  lb. orange slice candy, cut in small pieces
1  c. pecans, crushed
1  c. coconut
1  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Blend all ingredients in a large bowl.   Mix well. Form into 3 small rolls. Wrap in plastic wrap or wax paper.  Let chill in refrigerator. Cut into thin slices and serve. (No baking.)

name: CREAMY CORNMEAL
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
2  eggs
1  c. cream-style corn (small can)
1  c. sour cream
1/3  c. oil
preparation: Mix. Bake at 425° until done in an iron skillet.

name: GUACAMOLE WITH TORTILLA CHIPS(Makes 12 Appetizer Servings)
ingredients:
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. Jell-O brand lemon flavor sugar-free gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1  (16 oz.) container 1% low-fat cottage cheese
1  c. chopped ripe avocado
3/4  c. chopped green onions, divided
1/4  c. drained pickled jalapeno pepper slices
1/4  c. lemon juice
2  cloves garlic
1 to 2  tsp. chili powder
1/4  c. chopped tomato
4  pitted ripe olives, sliced
Chili Tortilla Chips
preparation: Completely dissolve gelatin in boiling water; pour into blender container.  Add cottage cheese, avocado, 1/2 cup green onions, jalapeno peppers, lemon juice, garlic and chili powder; cover. Blend on low speed, scraping down sides occasionally, about 2 minutes or until mixture is smooth.  Pour into shallow 5-cup serving dish; smooth top.  Chill until set, about 4 hours.

name: CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE - FUDGE ICING
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter or margarine
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
1/2  c. cocoa
1 1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. Crisco
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans (optional)
preparation: Cream the butter, shortening and sugar. Sift dry ingredients together.  Add dry ingredients and milk alternately, about 1/3 at a time, beating constantly. Add eggs, one at a time.  Add vanilla. Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 hour and 25 minutes at 300°.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour (plain)
2  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1 No. 303  can fruit cocktail with juice or crushed pineapple
2  eggs, beaten
raisins
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Add fruit cocktail and eggs. Mix well  with spoon, do not use mixer!!!.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: HOMEMADE STRAWBERRY ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1 (5 1/2 oz.)  pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
2  c. sugar
2  cans evaporated skim milk (approximately 3 c.)
3  c. 1% or skim or whole milk
2  c. fresh strawberries, mashed (about 2 pt.)
preparation: Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl; add remaining ingredients, stirring to mix.  Pour mixture into freezer can of a 1 gallon freezer.  Freeze.  Let ripen at least 1 hour.  Yields 1 gallon.

name: QUICK ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. warm water
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  pkg. yeast
milk
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Add enough milk to make 1 cup. Add remaining ingredients.  Roll out on floured board and cut out. Cook in a 400° oven until done.

name: LUNCH BOX PIZZAS
ingredients:
1  (7 1/2 oz.) tube refrigerated buttermilk biscuits (10 biscuits)
1/4  c. tomato sauce
1  tsp. Italian seasoning
10  slices pepperoni
3/4  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Flatten each biscuit into a 3-inch circle and press into a greased muffin cup.  Combine tomato sauce and Italian seasoning; spoon 1 teaspoon into each cup.  Top each with 1 pepperoni slice and 1 tablespoon cheese.  Bake at 425° for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve immediately or store in refrigerator.  Makes 10 servings.

name: BAKED HONEY MUSTARD CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless skinless breasts
1/3  c. orange juice
1  Tbsp. Dijon
1  Tbsp. honey
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Arrange the chicken breasts in a single layer in baking pan. In a small bowl, stir together the ingredients. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. softened margarine
3/4  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. white sugar
1 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
12  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix shortening and margarine together.  Then add both sugars; mix until well blended.  Add dry  pudding mix; blend.  Add eggs; mix well.  Mix dry ingredients and slowly stir into batter.  Stir in vanilla, then chocolate chips.  Drop by spoonful onto greased sheet.  Bake at 375° for 9 to 12 minutes.  Remove from sheet immediately.

name: DIABETIC PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  cup peanut butter
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. orange rind
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
artificial sweetener equivalent to 24 tsp. sugar
1/4  cup margarine
1  1/2 cups flour
1  well beaten egg
3/4  cup raisins
1/3  cup orange juice
preparation: Cream margarine, peanut butter, rind and vanilla together. Add egg and blend well. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with orange juice. Blend well. Add raisins. Roll into balls, place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet, flatten with fork. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Store in airtight container. Taste better 24 hours after baking.

name: CRACKER SPREAD
ingredients:
3  oz. dried beef
8  oz. cream cheese
1/4  c. chopped onion
1 to 2  Tbsp. horseradish
1  tsp. dried onion soup
preparation: Cut beef into small pieces.  Mix with other ingredients and refrigerate.

name: MORAVIAN CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
2 1/3  c. flour
1/2  c. shortening
1  tsp. salt and ice water
3 to 4  c. cooked chicken, chopped
1/4  tsp. black pepper
3  Tbsp. butter
1  c. chicken broth
preparation: Make crust for double crust pie with 2 cups flour.  Cut in shortening.  Add salt and ice water to make a pastry that clings together.  Divide into halves.  Roll out one half on lightly floured board.  Line a 9-inch pie pan.

name: EXOTIC CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3  lb. cooked chicken, cut in chunks
1 (8 oz.)  can sliced water chestnuts
1  lb. seedless grapes
2  c. celery, chopped
2 to 3  c. slivered almonds, toasted (save 1/2 c. for garnish)
2 to 3  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. curry powder
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
lettuce
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients.  Combine mayonnaise, curry powder, soy sauce and lemon juice; toss with chicken and chill several  hours.  Spoon  onto  bed  of  lettuce  or  individual plates.  Sprinkle with pineapple and rest of almonds.

name: THRIFTY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. soda and baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
1  c. shortening or butter, soft
4  unbeaten eggs
1  tsp. vanilla and lemon flavoring
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Sift together flour, soda, baking powder and salt.  Beat sugar, shortening or butter, eggs and vanilla and lemon flavoring. Beat 2 1/2 minutes on high speed.  Turn to low speed.  Add flour mixture and buttermilk.  Beat about 2 1/2 minutes.  Bake in tube pan for 1 hour at 350°.

name: SQUASH DRESSING
ingredients:
2  c. cooked squash
1/2  stick melted oleo
1  large onion, chopped
2  c. crumbled cornbread
1  can cream of chicken soup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook and drain squash.  Add all other ingredients.  Bake in buttered casserole dish 30 to 40 minutes at 325°.

name: APPLE RAISIN BREAD
ingredients:
4 to 4 1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/3  c. honey
1  c. lukewarm milk
1/3  c. water
1/2  c. softened butter
1/2  c. raisins
2  c. peeled, chopped apples
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Combine 2 1/2 cups flour with yeast and honey.  Beat in milk slowly, then water.  Continue  beating  2  to  3 minutes. Add butter.  Mix well.  Add  remaining  flour  to  make  dough stiff. Let rest 5 minutes.  Add raisins, apples and cinnamon. Knead for 6 to 7  minutes until fruits are evenly distributed. Place in large greased bowl  and cover with damp towel.  Place in warm place 1 to 1  1/2  hours.  Punch down dough.  Knead on floured surface 3 to 4 minutes.  Shape into large ball.  Place in greased and floured baking  pan.  Let  rise  uncovered  20 minutes in a warm place. Preheat  oven to 425°.  Place pan of hot water on lowest rack. Bake  bread for 30 minutes.  Remove water and reduce oven to 300°.  Bake  for  35  to 40 minutes. Cool on wire rack.  Breakfast bread.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/3  c. maple syrup
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges
1 (11 oz.)  can pineapple tidbits
1  c. Tokay grapes, halved and seeded
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. whipped cream
preparation: Beat  cream  cheese,  maple syrup and lemon juice until creamy.  Fold  in fruit, marshmallows and whipped cream.  Pour into a mold.  Cover with plastic wrap; freeze until firm.

name: DOMINOSAURUS POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. butter or margarine
1 2/3  c. Domino pure granulated sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
1  c. milk
preparation: Combine flour, baking powder and salt in medium bowl; set aside.  In separate bowl, cream butter and sugar; add vanilla. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each.  Alternately add flour mixture and milk.  Line outside of spring-form pan with foil.  Grease and flour pan.  Pour in batter and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool 10 minutes.  Remove cake from pan.  Makes 8 servings.

name: RITZ CRACKER PIE
ingredients:
18  Ritz crackers
1  c. nuts
4  egg whites
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
whipped cream
grated chocolate
preparation: Roll crackers fine and mix well with nuts.  Beat egg whites until foamy.  Add baking powder and beat until very stiff.  Add sugar slowly.  Fold crackers, nuts and vanilla into egg whites. Pour into well-greased pie pan.  Bake 40 minutes at 300°.  Top with whipped cream and grated chocolate shavings.

name: CHRISTMAS STRUFFLERS(Honey Balls)
ingredients:
12  eggs
4  demitasse cups sugar
1  stick butter or margarine
2  tsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. vanilla
5  lb. unbleached flour
2  qt. vegetable oil
citron/sprinklers
preparation: In large 6 to 8-quart stainless steel bowl, beat eggs.  Slowly add sugar, melted butter or margarine, baking powder and vanilla. Beat in 1 cup of flour at a time.  Dough will be sticky.  Keep adding flour until dough can be removed from bowl.  Now, knead on floured table.  Keep kneading and adding flour until dough can be rolled.  Cut into slices and roll strips like a snake.  Cut into square pieces.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  box graham crackers
3 1/2  c. cold milk
16  oz. chocolate frosting
6  oz. vanilla instant pudding
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cover bottom of pan with graham crackers (do not crush).  Combine vanilla pudding and milk as directed on box of pudding.  Fold Cool Whip into mixture.  Spread half of pudding mixture on top of crackers.  Repeat with another layer of graham crackers and pudding.  Add another layer of graham crackers.  Spread chocolate frosting over top.  Refrigerate overnight before serving.

name: FUDGE NUT BARS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1/2  c. sweetened condensed milk
1  Tbsp. oleomargarine
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. quick oats
1/4  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Melt first 4 ingredients over hot water in double boiler. Remove from heat.  Add vanilla.  Set aside to cool.  Blend margarine, brown sugar, egg and vanilla, beating until light. Sift flour, soda and salt together, then add to first mix of margarine, sugar, egg and vanilla.  Stir in oats.  Press 2/3 of mixture into a 9 x 9 or 7 x 11 pan that's been greased and floured.  Spread chocolate mixture over batter, then top with remaining batter by crumbles or bits over chocolate (use fingers and pat down a little).  Sprinkle with nuts and press into top. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cool; cut into bars.

name: JAM CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. Crisco shortening
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
3  eggs
1  c. jam
1  c. preserves
3  c. flour
pinch of salt
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1  c. raisins, floured
1  c. nuts
preparation: Cream together shortening and sugar.  Add eggs, jam and preserves.  Sift together flour, salt, soda, cinnamon, allspice, cloves and nutmeg.  Add alternately with buttermilk.  Fold in raisins and nuts.  Bake in tube pan 1 hour at 250°, then at 350° for 1 more hour.

name: QUICK BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. (10 oz.) frozen French-style green beans
1  lb. stew beef, cut in cubes
1  large onion, chopped
1  can (10 1/2 oz.) condensed tomato soup (undiluted)
2  c. cooked egg noodles
salt and pepper
preparation: Place green beans in a 1-quart casserole, icy side up.  Cook, covered for 8 to 10 minutes.  Reserve.  Combine beef cubes and onion in a 2 to 3-quart casserole.  Cook, covered with waxed paper, for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring halfway through cooking time.  Add tomato soup, 1/2 cup water, noodles, and green beans to beef cubes. Stir lightly and season with salt and pepper to taste.  Cook, covered for 8 to 9 minutes.  Stir and let stand covered 3 to 4 minutes before serving.  Yields 4 servings.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple
1  can cherry pie filling
1  box yellow cake mix
1 1/2  sticks butter or margarine
preparation: "Dump" ingredients in order listed into a 9 x 13-inch oblong pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Serve cold or warm with ice cream.

name: FACIAL CLEANSING CREAM
ingredients:
2  parts Crisco or lard
1  part water
a few drops of your favorite perfume
preparation: Fluff in a mixing bowl.  Store in opaque jars.  You can't buy a better cleansing cream, at any price.  Recommended by two nurses. 1930's recipe.

name: NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  egg, beaten
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  c. nuts, chopped
2 1/2  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix in order given.  Put in greased and floured loaf pan and bake in moderate oven at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: COCOA PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
5  tsp. flour
2  c. hot water
3  egg yolks
2  Tbsp. butter
5  tsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook all ingredients on low heat until thick.  Put in baked pie shell.  Top with meringue frosting.

name: BEST BUTTERSCOTCH COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
1  lb. butter
2  egg yolks
4  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a large bowl, combine all ingredients and mix with electric beater until well blended.  Drop dough by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets.  Press with fork tines to flatten slightly.  Bake for approximately 10 minutes or until lightly golden.

name: BAKED CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can cream-style corn
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs
3/4  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour in a 350° oven.  Sprinkle bread crumbs and butter over the top of casserole about 15 minutes before done.  Double the recipe for a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

name: BLUEBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines angel food cake mix
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (9 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  can blueberry pie filling
preparation: Mix and bake cake according to package directions.  Mix cream cheese and sugar well; add Cool Whip.  Mix well and add lemon juice.  Put around side and top edge of cake.  Fill top of cake and hole with blueberry pie filling.

name: QUICK BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/3  pkg. Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix
preparation: Cook broccoli according to directions.  Drain and put into casserole dish with the cream of mushroom soup.  Add stuffing mix. Blend well.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: "THE" DIP
ingredients:
2  cans bean dip or jalapeno or enchilada dip
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  chopped tomatoes
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
3 or 5  oz. can chopped black olives
1  bunch green onions, chopped
preparation: Mix together the cans of dip, mayonnaise, sour cream, onions and taco seasoning.  Spread mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Then layer tomatoes, then the olives and then the cheese on top.  Serve with plain tortilla chips.

name: FUNNY CAKE
ingredients:
pie crust for 10-inch pie plate
1 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. Crisco
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  unbeaten egg
3  Tbsp. chopped walnuts
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients; add shortening, milk and vanilla. Add egg and beat for 1 minute.  Pour batter into prepared pie crust and top with nuts.  Pour sauce over all.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.  Serve with whipped cream.

name: HARVARD BEETS
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. margarine
1 (No. 2)  can cut or small whole beets
preparation: Mix in a saucepan sugar, cornstarch, salt, vinegar, margarine and 1/3 cup liquid, drained from beets.  Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Add beets.  Let simmer 10 minutes.

name: ENCHILADA SAUCE
ingredients:
1  onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
butter (to saute)
flour
chili powder
ground cumin
salt and pepper
1  lb. ground beef, browned
water
preparation: Saute onion and bell pepper in liberal amount of butter.  Add cooked beef; mix well.  Add flour and seasonings to your taste. Lastly, add enough water to make gravy.

name: BEEF AND CHEESE FOLDOVER
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. barbecue sauce
6  slices cheese
2  cans crescent rolls
preparation: Brown meat and onion; drain and stir in sauce.  Set aside. Unroll dough into 4 rectangles on ungreased sheet.  Overlap edges. Spread mixture lengthwise in a 4-inch strip down center of dough to within 1-inch of edge.  Top meat with cheese.  Fold shorter sides over filling.  Bring long sides of dough over filling. Pinch to seal.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: BANANA FRITTERS
ingredients:
4  ripe bananas
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  egg
fat
1/4  lb. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
preparation: Mash bananas.  Add vanilla.  Beat egg and add to mixture.  Add nutmeg and salt to flour, then add to mixture.  Mix well.  Drop by spoonfuls in hot oil and fry.  Drain.  Sprinkle with lime juice and granulated sugar.

name: BASIL CREAM PASTA
ingredients:
1/2  c. olive oil
4 large  cloves garlic
3  c. packed basil leaves
2  c. heavy cream
1 1/4  c. finely grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  lb. pasta (fettucine)
preparation: Blend 1/4 cup        oil and garlic in blender.  Slowly add basil and additional 1/4 cup oil until it becomes a fine green paste.   In saucepan, add cream, basil paste, 3/4 cup cheese, salt and pepper.  Heat just until hot.  Cook and drain pasta.  Toss with sauce and garnish with remaining Parmesan cheese.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  (4 to 5 lb.) chicken
3/4  c. sifted flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1/3  c. milk
preparation: Cook chicken in salted water.  Remove chicken and debone.  Use chicken broth to make medium-thick gravy.

name: SOPHIA LOREN'S SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. olive oil
1 or 2  cloves crushed garlic
16  oz. can tomatoes or 1 lb. fresh, peeled and sieved
1  Tbsp. minced, fresh basil or 1 tsp. dried
1  tsp. sugar
salt to taste
4  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Heat oil in skillet; add garlic, then blend in other ingredients.  Stir until blended.  Lower heat and cook gently for 30 minutes, stirring every now and then.  Put cooked spaghetti on a large platter; cover with sauce.  Sprinkle with at least 4 tablespoons of grated Parmesan cheese.

name: GRAHAM MAC NUT TREAT
ingredients:
2  blocks butter or margarine
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. coarsely chopped Macadamia nuts
11  oz. Diamond brand graham crackers
preparation: Boil butter and sugar.  Remove from heat.  Add Macadamia nuts. Line cookie sheet with foil.  Spread nut syrup on crackers, place on foil, bake at 325° for 15 minutes or less.  Take off pan immediately.

name: SEAFOOD CHEESE ROUND
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. mayo or salad dressing
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
dash of garlic powder
1/2  c. finely chopped celery
2  Tbsp. sweet pickle relish
3/4  c. chili sauce
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  can small shrimp, drained
1 (6 oz.)  can crab meat, drained
assorted crackers
preparation: Mix cream cheese, mayo, lemon juice, garlic and Worcestershire sauce together.  Beat with mixer until smooth.  Add celery and mix with spoon.  Form mixture into a flat circle about an inch high and the size of a plate.  Mix chili sauce and pickle relish.  Put on top of cheese mixture.  Place crab meat in middle and place shrimp around the crab meat on top of the chili sauce mixture.  Serve with crackers.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. pure peanut butter
1  c. powdered milk
honey or brown sugar
sun flour seeds
coconut
raisins
granola
preparation: Mix peanut butter, powdered milk and honey or brown sugar (sweetened to your taste).  Add any one of these that you like to give crunchiness: granola, sunflower seeds, coconut or raisins. Roll into balls or logs (to slice).  Roll in sesame seed or flaked coconut.

name: BLUEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can blueberry pie filling
1 large  can crushed pineapple
2  pkg. grape jello
1  c. hot water
preparation: Mix jello with hot water and dissolve.  Add pie filling and pineapple.  Mix well and chill.

name: PINEAPPLE-ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. coarsely shredded zucchini
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, well drained
3  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. finely chopped nuts
preparation: Beat eggs lightly with rotary mixer.  Add oil, sugar and vanilla.  Continue beating until thick and foamy.  Stir in zucchini and pineapple.  In another bowl, combine flour, soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg and nuts.  Stir gently into zucchini mixture, just until blended.  Divide batter equally between 2 greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour until wood pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans for 10 minutes.  Turn out on wire racks to cool thoroughly.  Makes 2 loaves.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
3  to 4 sweet potatoes (2 1/4 lb.)
1/2  c. butter
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves (ground)
13  oz. Pet evaporated milk
2  pie shells (unbaked)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cream potatoes.  Stir in butter and sugar.  Beat in eggs.  Mix spices, salt and milk in potato mixture.  Pour into pie shells.  Bake 70 minutes.

name: MICROWAVE LASAGNE
ingredients:
1 (32 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1/2  c. water
1  pt. cottage cheese
1  egg
shredded Mozzarella
1  lb. ground beef
lasagne noodles (uncooked)
preparation: Brown hamburger; drain and rinse.  Mix with 1/2 cup water and sauce (do not heat).  Set aside.  Mix egg with cottage cheese and salt and pepper to taste.  Set aside.

name: PUDDING MIXTURE
ingredients:
1  pkg. pudding (not instant)
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Add dry ingredients to pudding mixture.  Add milk.  Cook, then add vanilla.

name: RECIPE FOR HAPPINESS
ingredients:
1  c. good thoughts
1  c. kind deeds
1  c. consideration for others
1  c. sacrifice
1  c. well beaten faults
3  c. forgiveness
preparation: Add tears of joy, sorrow and sympathy.  Flavor with love and kindly service.  Fold into daily life.  Bake well with warmth of human kindness and serve with a smile anytime.  It will satisfy the hunger of starved souls.

name: TOMATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  slices bread, cubed
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/4  tsp. butter flavoring
1  qt. canned tomatoes or 4 c. fresh
1  c. tomato juice or water
1  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
salt to taste
preparation: Cut bread into cubes.  Place in greased casserole dish.  Melt butter or margarine and combine with butter flavoring.   Pour over bread cubes.  Mix until bread is coated.  Combine remaining ingredients and simmer, stirring frequently, 6 to 8 minutes.  Pour over buttered cubes.  Bake in 375° oven for about 45 minutes.

name: POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
1/2  c. white Karo
1  tsp. white vinegar
1/3  c. water
1  Tbsp. oleo
1/2  tsp. soda
5 to 6  qt. popped corn
preparation: Take 1 large field, half a dozen children, 2 or 3 small dogs, a pinch of brook and some pebbles.  Mix the children and the dogs together well; put them on the field, stirring constantly.  Pour the brook over the pebbles; sprinkle the field with flowers. Spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in the sun.  When brown, set away to cool in the bathtub.

name: MAMA ANNIE'S PEANUT CANDY
ingredients:
2  c. granulated sugar
1  c. dark corn syrup
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1 3/4  c. peanuts
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Combine sugar, syrup and water in a 3-quart saucepan.  Heat until sugar dissolves.  When mixture boils, add butter.  Stir often after it reaches 230° on a candy thermometer.  Add nuts at 280° if raw (add nuts last if roasted).  Stir constantly until mixture reaches 300° or the hard crack stage.  Add baking soda and stir well.  Pour onto two greased cookie sheets and spread to desired thinness.  Loosen candy from cookie sheets as soon as cooled.  Break into pieces.  Yields 2 pounds.

name: CHOCOLATE CHERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box chocolate cake mix
1 large  can cherry pie filling
2  eggs
1/4  c. water (more if needed)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix by hand.  Bake in a loaf pan or 2 round pans at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: DRESSING
ingredients:
2  c. chopped onions
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
1  clove garlic
2  c. bread crumbs
4  eggs
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  c. turkey
2  c. turkey broth
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. sage
preparation: Cook 1 hour at 350° in 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased pan.

name: SNOWBALL SALAD
ingredients:
2  lb. Cool Whip
1  small sour cream
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed or chunked pineapple, drained
2  cans fruit cocktail
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

name: GRAPE-NUTS DESSERT
ingredients:
1 large  box vanilla pudding
1  c. Grape-Nuts cereal
1  (9 oz.) tub Cool Whip
preparation: Prepare pudding as directed.  Mix in Grape-Nuts and add Cool Whip.  Chill about 1 1/2 hours.  Grape-Nuts will get soft.

name: MARGARINE CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine or butter
2  c. sugar
4  whole eggs
2  c. flour
1 small  can evaporated milk (2/3 c.)
2  tsp. vanilla or lemon flavoring
preparation: Cream margarine and vanilla.   Add sugar, gradually beating all the time.  Then beat in eggs, one at a time.  Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk.  Always add flavor first and last.  Bake in a tube pan at 350° for 1 hour.

name: TERESA'S BUTTERMILK BUNS
ingredients:
3  c. buttermilk (room temperature)
1/2  c. sugar
2  pkg. yeast
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. melted butter
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
8  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water.  Mix with buttermilk and sugar.  Let stand 15 minutes.  Add butter and eggs.  Add 4 cups flour, soda and salt; beat well.  Then add remaining flour.  Knead well.  Let rise until double.  Punch down and shape into rolls. Let rise again.  Bake at 400° for about 12 to 15 minutes or until light brown.

name: CUSTARD PUDDING
ingredients:
1/4  c. melted butter
1  c. Grape-Nuts
3  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
2  c. milk
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Melt butter with Grape-Nuts.  Beat eggs; blend in sugar.  Add remaining ingredients and the Grape-Nuts mixture.  Blend well. Pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish.  Place in pan of hot water. Bake at 375°.

name: MARINATED VENISON ROAST
ingredients:
1  (3 to 4 lb.) venison roast
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  c. cola flavored beverage
1 1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. white vinegar
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. catsup
preparation: Place roast in a shallow baking dish; set aside.  Saute garlic in oil; add beverage and remaining ingredients, stirring well. Pour over roast.  Cover and marinate 8 hours in refrigerator, turning meat occasionally.  Remove roast from marinade, reserving marinade; place on a large piece of heavy-duty aluminum foil. Bring edges of foil up around roast, leaving top open.  Pour marinade over roast.  Bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours or until meat thermometer registers 170°, basting every 45 minutes.  Yield:  10 to 12 servings.

name: HAMBURGER SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. lean hamburger
1  clove garlic
1  small onion, chopped
1  can tomatoes, diced
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Fry meat, garlic and onion together; drain.  Add tomatoes and any other desired seasonings.  Simmer.

name: QUICK CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
4  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  c. shortening
2 or 3  Tbsp. soft butter
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Make dough of first 7 ingredients.  Roll dough 1/4 inch thick and spread with 2 to 3 tablespoons of soft butter.  Sprinkle with about 1/4 cup brown sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.  Roll tightly. Pinch ends.  Cut into 1 inch slices.  Place on greased pan and bake at 425° for about 15 minutes.  Add nuts if desired.

name: QUICK TACO BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (1 1/4 oz.)  envelope taco mix
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  c. Bisquick original baking mix
1  c. milk
2  eggs
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Cook ground beef and onion until beef is done.  Spoon into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.   Stir in taco seasoning mix (dry), tomato sauce and corn.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Stir remaining ingredients until blended.  Pour over beef mixture.  Bake 35 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve with sour cream, chopped tomatoes and shredded lettuce, if desired.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
24  oz. jar salsa
1  c. cornmeal
1/4  c. flour
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased 10-inch skillet.  Cook at 500° until done.

name: HOLIDAY SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1 1/2  c. finely cut Oklahoma pecans
2  lb. red grapes, seeded and peeled
1 1/2  c. whipped cream, sweetened with 2 Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix all together and you have a delicious and festive holiday salad.

name: SPRING FLING
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1/2  c. oil
4  eggs
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, undrained
1 (9 oz.)  carton whipped topping
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, undrained
preparation: Mix cake mix, oil, eggs and oranges with mixer until well blended.  There will be small chunks of oranges.  Bake at 350° in 2 greased and floured 8-inch pans for 35 minutes or until done. Let cool in pans for 10 minutes.  Remove when cold and split layers to make 4 layers.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. vermicelli, cooked
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
4  Tbsp. oil
1  Tbsp. Accent
1/2  c. chopped onions
1 1/2  c. sliced celery
1  c. chopped bell pepper
1  c. ripe olives
1  c. sliced pimentos
1  pt. mayonnaise
salt to taste
preparation: Marinate vermicelli overnight in lemon juice, oil and Accent. Add chopped onions, celery, bell pepper, olives, pimentos and mayonnaise.  Salt to taste.  Refrigerate.

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
5  lb. red potatoes
1  lb. bacon
1/2  c. sugar
2/3  c. vinegar
1  c. water
1  Tbsp. cornstarch (rounded)
2  tsp. salt
2  bunches green onions, entirely chopped
1/4  tsp. fresh ground black pepper
preparation: Cook potatoes with skins on until tender, drain and cool. Peel and slice into 1/4-inch slices or desired size.  Cut bacon into 1-inch pieces and fry until crisp but not burnt.   Remove and drain bacon, saving 1/4 cup bacon drippings.  Mix cornstarch and water together.  Heat sugar, vinegar, bacon drippings, salt and pepper.  Then add cornstarch mixture to thicken.  Stir constantly. Pour hot mixture over potatoes, bacon and green onions.  Mix and serve while hot.

name: CORN FRITTERS
ingredients:
1  pt. corn (cut off cob) or 1 can cream-style corn
1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. butter
1  egg
1/2  tsp. baking powder
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly.  Drop by 1/4 cupfuls in hot frying pan with a little bacon grease or on a hot griddle. Cook on both sides until done and lightly browned.  Can serve with syrup.

name: EASY ICE CREAM
ingredients:
3  qt. milk
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 large or 2 small  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
any fruit you prefer
preparation: Mix pudding and some milk well.  Add condensed milk.  Put in churn; add fruit.  Finish filling to the line with the milk. Churn until hard.

name: ITALIAN SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. chopped onion
2  cloves garlic, minced
1/3  c. olive oil
7  c. canned whole tomatoes
4 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
2  c. water
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. dried oregano
2  bay leaves
1/2  tsp. basil
preparation: Cook onion and garlic in hot oil until tender but not brown. Crush or blend can tomatoes.  Stir in the tomatoes and next 8 ingredients.  Mix well.  Simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally for 30 minutes.  Remove bay leaves.  Makes 4 quarts.  Serve over pasta.

name: LEMON SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cornstarch
1/8  tsp. salt
1  c. boiling water
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  egg yolk, beaten
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients; then add water.  Cook 5 minutes and let cool.  Then add butter, lemon juice and egg yolk.  Recook for 3 minutes.  Delicious!!

name: EASY MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburg
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
2/3  c. bread crumbs
2/3  c. milk
1/4  tsp. pepper or 1 green pepper, cut up
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine.   Grease pan and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes; longer if desired.  Do not cover.

name: BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  bag frozen broccoli cuts
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
garlic powder (optional)
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  cans milk
preparation: Cook broccoli in small amount of water.  Mix all other ingredients together in crock-pot.  Add broccoli and cook on low all day or until it reaches desired temperature.

name: MICROWAVE CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
4  qt. unsalted popped corn
1  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/4  c. light corn syrup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Divide popped corn between two 4-quart glass bowls.  Combine brown sugar, butter, syrup and salt in a 2-quart bowl.  Microwave on High for 3 to 3 1/2 minutes or until mixture boils, stirring once.  Microwave at 30% power for 4 minutes.  Stir in soda.  Pour half of the syrup evenly over each bowl.  Sprinkle 1 cup of peanuts over each bowl.  Stir until it lightly coats corn. Microwave at 50% power, one bowl at a time, for 6 to 7 minutes, stirring twice.

name: POTATO AND HAM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  cup ham (diced)
1  small onion (chopped)
3  cups uncooked potatoes (diced)
1  cup uncooked carrots (diced)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 soup  can of milk
preparation: Saute ham and onion.  Mix together all of the ingredients in a casserole.  Bake covered at 350° for 1 hour.  Remove cover a little while before it is done.

name: ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can asparagus
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: Layer in casserole dish.  Top with crumbled Cheez-Its.  Bake at 350° until bubbly.

name: BRUNSWICK STEW
ingredients:
1 (24 oz.)  can Castleberry brunswick stew
1 (10 oz.)  can barbecue beef
1 (10 oz.)  can barbecue chicken
1 (10 oz.)  can barbecue pork
1 (17 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1 (17 oz.)  can LeSueur garden peas
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. onion salt
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a large pot or Dutch oven.  Heat and serve.  Unusually good for such a quick and easy recipe!

name: RHUBARB DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. margarine
1  egg, beaten
2 or 3  Tbsp. milk
4  c. rhubarb, cut up
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. red jello
1/2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. melted margarine
preparation: Sift 1 1/3 cups flour, 1 tablespoon of sugar, baking powder and salt into mixing bowl.  Cut in margarine.  Add egg and milk.  Mix together and pat into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Build up sides. Cover with rhubarb.  Sprinkle jello over rhubarb.

name: MEDITERRANEAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  skinned, boned chicken breast halves
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can ready to serve chicken broth
1/4  c. sliced ripe olives
2  Tbsp. capers
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 (14 oz.)  can artichoke hearts, rinsed and halved
preparation: Dredge chicken in flour; set aside.  Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.  Add chicken and cook 3 minutes on each side or until lightly browned.  Add chicken broth and next 3 ingredients.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until bubbly.  Stir in artichoke halves and cook until mixture is thoroughly heated.  Yield:  4 servings.

name: MUFFIN BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  c. flour (self-rising)
3  Tbsp. oil
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix and put into muffin pan.  Bake at 425° until done.

name: BLACK FOREST TORTE
ingredients:
1 (18 1/4 oz.)  pkg. devil's food cake mix with pudding
1  (8 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Spread batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan; bake according to package directions. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan and cool completely on wire rack. Slice cake horizontally to make 3 layers. Place bottom layer on cake platter; spread about 1 cup whipped topping and top with 1/3 of cherry pie filling. Repeat process with second and third layers. Chill well.

name: MEATBALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. lean hamburger
1/4  c. breadcrumbs
20  oz. ketchup
2  Tbsp. butter
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1  egg
10  oz. apple jelly
few drops Tabasco sauce
preparation: Mix meat with soup mix, breadcrumbs and egg; make meatballs. Combine ketchup, apple jelly, butter and Tabasco.  Stir until jelly melts and make sure ingredients are mixed thoroughly.  Drop meatballs in crock-pot and cook on high for 1 hour, then reduce heat to low for 1 hour.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  roll sugar cookie dough
8  oz. low-fat cream cheese
8  oz. Cool Whip, thawed
1/3  c. sugar
1  can pineapple tidbits
1/2  pt. strawberries
2  or 3 kiwi
preparation: Spread cookie dough onto a pizza pan.  Bake according to directions on package; cool.  Make filling by combining cream cheese, Cool Whip and sugar.  Mix well and spread onto cooled cookie dough.  Drain fruits and place on top of filling, putting pineapple on outside, strawberries in the middle and kiwi in the center.  I enjoy these fruits, however any can be used.

name: SMITHFIELD HAM(Cooked Overnight)
ingredients:
Smithfield ham
7  c. water
preparation: Soak ham overnight; scrub.  Preheat oven to 375°.  Place ham in a large covered baking pan, skin side up.  Cover ham with 7 cups water.  Place ham in oven.  Turn oven to 500°.  Cook 10 minutes after oven reaches 500°.  Leave oven off for 3 hours.  Leave ham in oven.  Do not open oven.  Turn oven to 500°.  Cook 15 minutes after temperature is reached.  Leave ham in closed oven for 8 hours.  Do not open oven during entire cooking.

name: CHEESEBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
8  slices Cheddar cheese
1  deep dish pie shell
1/2  c. tomato sauce
1/3  each:  chopped bell peppers and onions
1  beef bouillon cube
3  eggs, well beaten
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Bake pastry shell for 8 minutes; remove from oven.  Reduce oven temperature to 350°.  Take 6 slices of cheese and cut up in pieces.  Brown meat; drain.  Add tomato sauce, peppers, onions and bouillon cube.  Cook and stir until bouillon dissolves; remove from heat.  Stir in eggs, flour and cut up cheese.  Fill pie shell.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes in a 350° oven.  When done, top with remaining cheese slices and melt.

name: PUMPKIN PIE CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. can pumpkin
3  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1 large  can evaporated milk
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. ginger
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can peach pie filling
1  can chunk pineapple
1  can Mandarin orange slices
1  pkg. strawberries
3  bananas
preparation: Drain juice from Mandarin orange slices & pineapple. Slice bananas cross-wise. Mix all together.

name: MINI WHITE CASTLES(Yield: 60)
ingredients:
3  pkg. Pepperidge Farm plain party rolls (20 count pkg.)
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix (2 envelopes more flavor)
1  egg
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/3  c. bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Mix ingredients well.  Pack into a flat cookie sheet, prick entire surface with a fork.  Preheat oven to 400° and bake for 10 minutes.  Cool and cut into 60 squares.  Fit onto buns and put on a dill pickle slice on  each one and replace top of bun.  Place back in containers.  Sprinkle with water and cover with foil. Store in refrigerator until ready, then bake at 375° for 7 to 10 minutes.  Can also be frozen.

name: FRUIT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
6  ripe bananas
4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. nuts
1/2  c. cherries
1/2  c. chocolate chips or Hershey's Kisses
preparation: Cream together the butter and sugar; add eggs and mix well. Mash the bananas, then add to the butter.  Sift together the dry ingredients; add to the butter and blend well.  Stir in the nuts, cherries and chocolate chips.  Pour into 2 large or 3 small loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: CHOCOLATE NUT PIE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, melted and cooled
2  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
2/3  c. English walnut bits
1  unbaked 9-inch pie shell
preparation: Whip eggs into cooled margarine.  Add sugar and vanilla; mix well.  Add chocolate chips and nuts.  Mix and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Pie is done when knife comes out clean.

name: WASETTI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can tomato soup
1  can mushroom soup
8  oz. Velveeta cheese
1  pkg. noodles
1/2  c. grated Cheddar
preparation: Cook noodles as directed, then drain.  Brown ground beef; add soups and Velveeta.  Mix well.  Add noodles.  Put into casserole dish.  Sprinkle Cheddar on top.  Bake at 350° until hot through, 20 to 30 minutes.

name: PEAR AND GINGER BEER
ingredients:
12  oz. can pear nectar, well chilled
12  oz. bottle ginger beer, well chilled
juice of 1 lime
ice cubes
lime slices
preparation: Pour pear nectar, ginger beer and lime juice into a pitcher half filled with ice.  Stir to blend.  Pour into tall glasses and garnish with lime slices.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1 1/4  c. salad oil
2 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
4  c. finely diced apples
1  pkg. butterscotch chips
preparation: Combine in order given.  Mix well and top with butterscotch chips.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.  Do not grease pan.

name: PRALINES
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. milk
3  c. chopped pecans
1  stick margarine
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Caramelize 1  cup sugar in a frying pan, then pour into large pot  with  remaining  2  cups of sugar, butter and milk. Cook until  mixture  forms  a soft ball in water.  Remove from heat and add  vanilla and chopped pecans.  Beat until mixture looks like fudge.  Pour out on buttered surface and cool.  Cut into desired size.

name: SHRIMP OR CRABMEAT DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 small  jar pimento, chopped
4  small green onions, chopped
1  can shrimp or crabmeat, drained and mashed
1  jar Hoffmans shrimp sauce
preparation: Mix cream cheese, pimento and green onions.  Arrange this into a ring and place shrimp or crabmeat on top of ring.  Top with shrimp sauce.  Serve with crackers.

name: SWEET POTATO NUT WHIP
ingredients:
6  medium size sweet potatoes
2  eggs
3  Tbsp. melted butter
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
salt to taste
rich milk or cream
1/2  c. pecan nuts
preparation: Pare the potatoes; cook until tender.  Mash and add the beaten egg yolks and sufficient rich milk or cream to whip.   Add the butter, sugar and salt.  Beat until light and fluffy.  Add whole pecan nuts; fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites.  Pile roughly into a buttered baking dish; sprinkle lightly with nut meats. Bake in a moderate oven at 400° for 30 minutes.

name: CREAMED CHICKEN IN PATTY SHELLS(Quick)
ingredients:
6  frozen patty shells
2  Tbsp. butter
2 1/2  c. diced cooked chicken
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  Tbsp. sherry
1 (3 oz.)  can sliced or chopped mushrooms
pecan halves
paprika
preparation: Bake patty shells as directed on package.  Heat butter in pan. Add chicken, soup, sherry and mushrooms; bring to a boil.  Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes.  Serve in shells.  Top with pecan halves; sprinkle with paprika.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. oil
3  c. grated carrots
4  eggs
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Blend all ingredients together.  Bake in 3 well-greased layer cake pans for 30 to 35 minutes or 1 tube pan for 60 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: BRAN WAFFLES
ingredients:
2/3  c. whole wheat flour
2/3  c. white flour
3/4  c. bran
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves
2  eggs, separated
1/3  c. packed brown sugar
1/3  c. butter, melted
1/2 to 1  c. chopped nuts
1 1/2 to 2  c. milk or buttermilk
preparation: Combine all dry ingredients/nuts.  With fork, beat egg yolks and brown sugar together until crumbly and yellow colored.  Beat egg whites to stiff peaks stage.

name: ITALIAN BEEF SUPPER
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. salt
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 to 2  cans water
1 small (5.5 oz.)  can V-8 juice
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. Birds Eye Italian style vegetables with seasoned sauce
rice
preparation: Brown beef in skillet; drain.  Add salt, tomato sauce, V-8 juice and water; bring to boil.  Add vegetables; cook until tender.  Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.  Serve over rice.

name: CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
1/2  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
3  c. cake flour, sifted
1/2  c. cocoa
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. milk
preparation: Cream the butter, Crisco and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Add flour, cocoa and milk.  Add vanilla.  Pour in greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes in a 325° oven.

name: CHICKEN PARMESAN
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter
1  clove garlic, minced
1  c. seasoned bread crumbs
1  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
1  tsp. sage
1/8  tsp. pepper
parsley, chopped
6  boneless chicken breasts
preparation: Melt butter.  Add garlic and simmer.  Mix crumbs, cheese and seasonings.  Dip chicken in butter mixture; roll in cheese and crumbs.  Place in pan.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour, then at 300° for another 1/2 hour.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
4  eggs
6  oz. cottage cheese
1  chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1  stick margarine
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli
2  c. cornmeal
preparation: Stir all ingredients together.  Bake in greased skillet at 400° for 15 or 20 minutes or until brown.

name: STRAWBERRY SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1/2  c. melted margarine
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
3  egg whites
1  c. granulated sugar
2  c. strawberries
1  c. whipped cream
preparation: Stir together first four ingredients and spread evenly in shallow baking pan.  Bake in 350° oven for 20 minutes, stirring every five minutes.  Sprinkle 3/4 of the crumbs in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.

name: HOT CHICKEN STROGANOFF SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. rice mix
2  c. cubed, cooked chicken
1  c. sliced celery
3/4  c. sour cream
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. cashews (optional)
preparation: In skillet cook rice mix according to package directions.  Add chicken and celery.  Blend sour cream, mayonnaise, milk and salt. Stir in chicken-rice mixture.  Cook and stir over low heat until mixture heats.

name: SWEET-SOUR SAUCE
ingredients:
2  c. water
1/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. butter
1/3  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Take your favorite potato salad recipe and substitute steamed cauliflower.  It is different and delicious.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CRESCENTS
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. peanut butter
3  c. sifted all-purpose flour (Swans Down)
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla; stir in peanut butter.  Sift dry ingredients.  Stir into creamed mixture.   Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake in moderate oven at 350° about 10 minutes.  Makes 3 dozen cookies.

name: RALPH'S OLD-FASHIONED RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. cooked rice (regular or instant)
2  c. milk
1/2  c. raisins
2  eggs
1/3  c. sugar
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Stir  together	first 3 ingredients until creamy.  Boil about 5  minutes.  Mix  together	the  eggs,  sugar,  salt and vanilla. Add  to rice.  Place in pan.  Sprinkle with cinnamon or nutmeg. Bake  in  oven  approximately  40 minutes at 350°. Serve with whipped  topping.  Can be cut and eaten like piece of cake.

name: SAUSAGE AND WILD RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. long grain wild rice mix
1  lb. pork sausage
1  can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1  c. chopped fresh mushrooms
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
1/2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. chicken broth
1/4  c. minced celery
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. fresh ground pepper
preparation: Cook box of rice according to directions and set aside.  Cook sausage and drain.  Add the rest of the ingredients including the rice.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in a 2-quart casserole dish. Serves 6 to 8.

name: PUFF PIZZA
ingredients:
3  cans buttermilk refrigerator biscuits, quartered
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. onions
1 3/4  c. Prego spaghetti sauce
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese
pepperoni (to top)
preparation: Cook meat with onions until done.  Mix sauce and meat and drop in cut up biscuits and mix well.  Add cheese.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Put pepperoni on top; sprinkle the Mozzarella cheese on top.  Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: BEEF STEW
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. oil
1  clove garlic, minced
2  lb. stew meat
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  bay leaf
4  c. hot water
2  to 3 potatoes, cubed
3  to 4 carrots, sliced
2  to 3 stalks celery, sliced
1  can kidney beans, drained
1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. cold water
preparation: Brown meat in oil slowly and deeply for top flavor.  Add garlic and cook a few minutes more.  Add Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, bay leaf and 2 cups of water.  Simmer, covered, for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.  Remove bay leaf.  Add 2 cups water, potatoes, carrots and celery.  Continue cooking until vegetables are done (30 to 45 minutes).  Add beans.  Blend the flour and 1/2 cup water until smooth.  Gradually stir into stew.  Cook a few more minutes, until thickened and bubbly.

name: COCONUT CRISPS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. butter or margarine, softened
1  c. sugar
1  large egg
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1 1/2  c. shredded sweetened coconut
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Combine flour, baking powder and salt in medium bowl.  Beat butter and sugar in mixer bowl at medium speed until light and fluffy.  Beat in egg and vanilla.  With mixer at low speed, beat in dry ingredients just until combined. Stir in coconut. Drop dough by level tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets.  With bottom of glass dipped in flour, flatten each cookie to 1/4-inch thickness, then press with back of fork to form ridges.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes, until edges are golden.  Transfer to racks to cool.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: COCONUT BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs, lightly beaten
2  tsp. coconut extract
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. shredded coconut
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt; set aside. In a large bowl, combine sugar, oil, eggs and coconut extract.  Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk; stir just until moistened. Fold in coconut and nuts. Pour into two greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch x 2 1/2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until breads test done. Cool 10 minutes in pans before removing to a wire rack to cool completely. Yield: 2 loaves.

name: ONION POTATO PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  medium onion, quartered
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. baking powder
4  medium potatoes, peeled and cubed
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
3 to 4  Tbsp. cooking oil
preparation: In a blender or food processor, place eggs, onion, flour, salt, pepper, baking powder and 1/2 cup of potatoes.  Cover and process on high until smooth.  Add parsley and remaining potatoes.  Cover and pulse 2 to 4 times until potatoes are chopped.  Pour 1 to 2 tablespoons oil onto a hot griddle or skillet.  Pour batter by 1/3 cups onto griddle.  Flatten slightly to 4 to 5-inch diameter.  Cook over medium heat until golden on both sides.  Add oil as needed until all pancakes are cooked.  Makes 6 to 8 servings (12 pancakes).  Good with applesauce.

name: DELICIOUS DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2 to 1  c. nuts
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
2 1/2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. Cool Whip
3/4  c. butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese (room temperature)
2  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
chocolate curls and nuts
preparation: In the early Spring, pick Blue Elder flowerets. These are pale yellow when first in bloom.  Place in pail of water for a few hours or wash carefully.  The flowers sometimes have tiny gnats in them.  Drain on paper towels.

name: HOG WILD PARTY MIX
ingredients:
1  lb. sliced bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces
3  qt. fresh popped popcorn (unsalted)
1 (5 oz.)  can chow mein noodles
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  c. unsalted cashews or walnuts
1/3  c. butter or margarine, melted
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook bacon in large frying pan over medium heat until crisp; drain on paper towel.  Combine popcorn, noodles, cashews and cheese.  Combine butter and seasoned salt; drizzle over popcorn mixture tossing lightly to coat.  Stir in bacon.  Spoon mixture into two 13 x 9-inch pans.  Bake in 350° oven for 5 to 8 minutes or until heated through.  Yield: about 4 1/2 quarts.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked Minute rice
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
3/4  c. chopped celery
3/4  c. chopped onion
1  stick margarine
8  oz. jar Cheez Whiz
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
preparation: Cook broccoli according to directions. Sauté onion and celery in margarine. Combine all ingredients together in large bowl. Pour into buttered baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: 24 HOUR PEA SALAD
ingredients:
lettuce
diced onions
chopped celery
chopped green peppers
1 small  pkg. frozen peas
1  pt. jar Miracle Whip
1 to 2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
grated cheese (topping)
bacon bits (topping)
preparation: Combine lettuce, onions, celery, peppers and peas.  In a small bowl, mix Miracle Whip and Worcestershire sauce.  Spread on top of salad, making sure you spread to the edges.  Sprinkle cheese and bacon on top and cover with aluminum foil.  Let sit in fridge for 24 hours.

name: SOUR CREAM CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. cream style corn
1  c. sour cream
1  c. self rising cornmeal
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  medium onion grated
preparation: Melt margarine in 8 x 8-inch pan or iron skillet in 350° oven.  Coat pan with margarine.  Mix other ingredients until blended.  Pour batter into hot pan.  Bake at 350° for 35-40 minutes.

name: JOGGERS JUG
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. grape juice
2 1/2  c. apple juice
5  Tbsp. honey
1  c. vinegar
3  c. water
preparation: Mix all together.  Chill.  Serves 1/2 cup daily.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
4  eggs
3/4  c. water
1  c. oil
3  c. sugar
1  can squash
1  c. chopped walnuts
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
2  tsp. soda
pinch of cloves
1  jar cherries, quartered
preparation: Beat the first 5 ingredients together, then add the next 6 ingredients.  Beat all together.  Add cherries.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Makes 2 loaves.  This should be cold before you remove it from the pan.

name: HOT CRAB DIP
ingredients:
3  (8 oz.) cream cheese bricks, softened
1  lb. crabmeat (canned can be used)
3  Tbsp. horseradish
1  Tbsp. Old Bay seasoning
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Blend all ingredients together. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: CRANBERRY JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cherry jello
1  c. pineapple juice
1  c. ground raw cranberries
1  c. drained crushed pineapple
1  c. finely chopped celery
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
1  c. hot water
1  c. sugar
preparation: Dissolve jello in hot water; add pineapple juice and cool. Pour sugar over cranberries and let stand while jello cools.  When jello begins to thicken, add cranberries, pineapple, celery and nut meats.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. soft margarine
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. powdered sugar
3 1/2  c. milk
2 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
12  oz. thawed whipped topping
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. Oreo cookies
preparation: In a medium bowl, combine margarine, cream cheese and powdered sugar.  Mix well.  In another bowl, combine milk and pudding mix; add whipped topping and blend well by hand.  Combine both bowls and set aside.  Process cookies in food processor until they look like potting soil.  Layer cookies and filling in a clean 8 1/2-inch flowerpot, starting and ending with cookies.  Wrap stems of artificial flowers in plastic wrap and insert.  Refrigerate until serving.

name: TAPIOCA PUDDING
ingredients:
2  qt. boiling milk
1  c. tapioca
4  whole eggs
1 1/4  c. sugar
2 level  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Add tapioca to milk.  Beat together the eggs, sugar and cornstarch; add to milk-tapioca mixture when about cooled.  Add some hot milk.  When cold, add whipped cream, bananas, nuts, pineapple or whatever you wish.

name: SQUASH CUSTARD
ingredients:
1  stick butter or margarine
5  egg yolks
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  qt. evaporated milk (1/2 evaporated milk and 1/2 water)
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder (if using plain flour)
5  squash
1  tsp. vanilla
5  stiffly beaten egg whites
5  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Boil squash until it can be mashed.  Drain the squash; melt butter in hot squash.  In a separate bowl, combine egg yolks, 1 1/2 cups sugar, flour and vanilla.  Stir well and add evaporated milk and water; add to squash and mix well.  Bake in moderate oven (350°) until firm, about 1 hour.  Remove from heat.

name: GARDEN FRESH PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  pork chops or veal, 1 inch thick
1  carrot, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
1/2  c. sliced fresh green beans*
1  potato, cut in chunks
1/4  tsp. basil
2  envelopes Lipton cream of mushroom Cup-a-Soup
2/3  c. water
preparation: In skillet, melt butter and brown chops.  Add vegetables, basil and Cup-a-Soup blended with water.  Simmer, covered, 45 minutes or until chops and vegetables are tender.  Makes about 2 servings.

name: CRUNCHY PEANUT CRACKERS
ingredients:
1  c. wheat flour
1/3  c. corn meal
1  c. peanuts
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. honey
3/4  c. soy milk
1  c. peanut butter
preparation: Blend  first 4 ingredients until finely chopped.  Whisk remaining  ingredients in a bowl.  Add dry to wet ingredients. Divide  into  2  portions.  Roll  on floured pastry cloth.  If very  crumbly,  just  press  out  flat, with fingers.  Cut and place on  cookie  sheet.  Prick  and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: CARAMEL NUT POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
1/2  c. shortening
1  box light brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
5  large eggs
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
preparation: Cream butter, shortening and brown sugar, a little at a time. Beat well.  Add granulated sugar.  Beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each; beat 3 minutes. Sift together dry ingredients.  Add alternately with milk.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Bake in tube pan for 1 hour and 30 minutes at 325°.
