name: SWEET PICKLE STICKS
ingredients:
cucumbers
3 3/4  c. vinegar
4 1/2  tsp. celery seed
4 1/2  tsp. turmeric
3  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. salt
3/4  tsp. mustard seed
preparation: Cut the cukes longways twice.  Put in pan.  Pour boiling hot water over them.  Let stand overnight.  Next morning, drain.  Pack in jars.  Boil the remaining ingredients 5 minutes.  Pour into jars over cukes.

name: OVERNIGHT COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. shortening
4  eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla
3/4  tsp. salt
6  c. flour
1  Tbsp. soda
1  Tbsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Cream together sugars and shortening; add vanilla and eggs which have been well beaten.  Sift together the flour, salt, soda and cream of tartar and add to other ingredients.  Form into roll and refrigerate overnight.  Slice and place on unbaked cookie sheet; bake at 350° until golden brown.

name: NEIMAN-MARCUS COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. butter
2  c. brown sugar
2  c. white sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
5  c. blended oatmeal (measure first, blend to fine powder)
4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
8  oz. Hershey bar, grated
3  c. chopped nuts
4  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream butter and both sugars.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Mix together with flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder and soda.   Add chips, grated Hershey bar and nuts.  Shape into balls the size of walnuts or roll into logs and wrap in wax paper as icebox cookies. Chill and slice 1/4-inch thick.  Bake 6 minutes at 375°.  Makes 112 cookies.

name: WAGON WHEEL COOKIES
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. sugar
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. salt
1  cube butter or margarine
4  cubes unsweetened chocolate
1/2  c. walnuts (optional)
preparation: Melt together butter or margarine and unsweetened chocolate. Blend sugar into eggs.  Add dry ingredients to egg, sugar and vanilla mixture.  Pour in melted butter and chocolate.  Mix all together and add chopped walnuts or pecans at this time.  May need to add more flour if mixture is too runny.  Want it somewhat stiff, but too much flour will make cookies dry.   Chill overnight, covered.  Roll in balls and roll in powdered sugar before baking.   Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.  (I usually double this recipe when I make it.)

name: MRS. LYNN'S FUDGE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter or shortening
2  eggs
1/4  c. milk
1  c. flour
3 to 4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. walnuts (optional)
preparation: Mix ingredients in order given as quickly as possible.  Do not beat.  Bake in a well-greased 9 1/2 x 13 1/2-inch pan in 400° oven for 12 minutes.  Frost while warm with powdered sugar icing or chocolate frosting.  Cut into squares and enjoy.

name: INDIAN SPOONBREAD
ingredients:
1  can cream corn
3/4  c. milk
1/3  c. melted Crisco
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. corn meal
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies
2  c. grated cheese, divided
preparation: Mix corn, milk, Crisco, eggs, corn meal, soda and salt well. Pour half the batter into a 9 x 9-inch greased pan. Spread chilies over batter. Sprinkle 1 cup grated cheese over chilies. Pour remaining batter on top. Sprinkle with additional 1 cup grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: SKILLET BURGERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. each:  chopped onion and celery
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1/2  c. water
dash of hot pepper sauce
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. monosodium glutamate
1/4  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Cook ground beef, onion and celery until meat is browned; drain off fat.  Stir in tomato sauce, water, pepper sauce, salt, monosodium glutamate and chili powder.  Simmer, uncovered, 30 minutes.  Serve on buns.

name: LOBSTER (LANGOSTINO) ROLLS
ingredients:
1  loaf white bread
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/2  lb. butter
6  oz. lobster or langostinos, cleaned
preparation: Remove crust from bread.  Flatten bread with rolling pin.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIR
ingredients:
2  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1  box graham crackers
3  c. milk
1  medium sized container Cool Whip
1  c. chocolate icing
preparation: Combine pudding and milk.  Beat until thick, then fold in Cool Whip.  In a 9 x 13-inch dish, layer bottom with whole (not crushed) graham crackers.  Put a layer of pudding mix, then another layer of crackers, then a layer of mix, ending with a layer of crackers on top.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. diced, cooked chicken breast
1 (20 oz.)  can diced pineapple
2  c. finely diced celery
1  c. pecan pieces
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix together in large bowl and serve over bed of lettuce.  To lower fat, use low-fat mayonnaise.

name: LEMON BARS(Low-Fat)
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. margarine, softened
2/3  c. liquid egg substitute
1/4  c. lemon juice
2  tsp. grated lemon peel
confectioners sugar (optional)
preparation: Blend 1 cup flour and 1/4 cup sugar; cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Press mixture on bottom of 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.  Blend egg product, lemon juice, lemon peel and remaining flour and sugar; pour over pastry crust.  Bake 15 minutes more or until set.  Cool slightly; sprinkle with confectioners sugar, if desired.  Cool completely; cut into 2 x 1-inch bars.

name: SLUSH
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. water
2 (12 oz.)  cans frozen fruit punch concentrate
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen lemonade concentrate
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen limeade concentrate
2  qt. white soda (lemon-lime)
preparation: Bring the sugar and water to a boil.  Mix in remaining ingredients and freeze.

name: ZUCCHINI SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  c. sliced squash
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of celery soup
1  c. dairy sour cream
1  c. shredded carrots
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. herb seasoned stuffing
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook squash in salted boiling water for 5 minutes.  Drain. Combine soup and sour cream.  Add shredded carrots.  Fold in drained squash and onion.

name: CHICKEN DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton Dry Onion Soup Mix
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Russian Salad Dressing
1 (8 oz.)  jar apricot jam
4  chicken quarters
preparation: Combine dry soup, Russian dressing and jam, mixing well until there are no lumps.  Wash chicken and pat dry.  Slightly overlap in flat pyrex dish.  Spoon and spread 1 Tbsp. or more of sauce on each piece of chicken.  Bake at 225 degrees for 4 to 5 hours or however long it takes to get done.  Be careful to place well below heating element if using electric oven.  This can be done in 1 hour at 375 degrees.

name: 7 LAYER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice
1  c. whole kernel corn, drained
salt and pepper
2  cans tomato sauce, divided
3/4  c. water, divided
1/2  c. each:  finely chopped onion and green peppers
1  lb. ground beef
4  strips bacon
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Place the rice and corn in layers in a 2-quart casserole with tight fitting lid.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Pour over 1 can tomato sauce, 1/2 cup water, chopped onion and green peppers and the ground beef.   Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Pour over the second can of tomato sauce and 1/4 cup water.  Cover with strips of bacon.  Cover; bake for 1 hour at 350°.  Uncover; bake 30 minutes longer, or until bacon is crisp.

name: WAYNE'S POOR MAN PUDDING
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
6  large potatoes, sliced
2  pkg. brown gravy mix
1  large onion, diced
preparation: Boil potatoes for 15 minutes.  Put sliced potatoes in bottom of casserole dish.  Mix soup and brown gravy mix together.  Pour over potatoes.  Mix ground beef and onion together.  Make balls (about 2-inches) and place on top of casserole.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: BROCCOLI DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. Jalapeno cheese - shredded
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 -10  oz. pkg. chopped broccoli - cooked
preparation: Mix all together and bake until bubbly in the oven or microwave.  Dip with crackers or corn chips.  May be done in a crock pot.

name: MARINATED VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1/2  c. oil
1  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. dill weed
1  Tbsp. Accent
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix ingredients and pour over fresh vegetables.  Chill 24 hours.  Stir often to coat well.  Drain before serving (liquid you drain may be frozen and used again).  When using hard vegetables, i.e., carrots, cauliflower or broccoli, parboil slightly.

name: PUPU CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. soy sauce
6  Tbsp. sugar
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. powdered ginger
1  chili pepper, finely diced/minced
1  stalk green onion
4  lb. chicken wings
preparation: Heat first 5 ingredients until sugar is dissolved at a low boil.  Add green onion, finely minced, and set aside.  Roll chicken wings in flour and fry until done.  Dip wings in sauce. Serve hot or cold.

name: MOCK APPLE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cream of tartar
23  Ritz crackers
unbaked pie shell
butter
brown sugar
cinnamon
preparation: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil.  Drop in Ritz crackers. Do not stir.  Boil 2 minutes, then pour in unbaked pie shell.  Dot with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon.  Put crust on top and bake 20 minutes at 450°.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1  tomato, diced
1  green pepper, diced
1  onion, diced
1  bag Doritos
1  bag shredded Cheddar cheese
1  lb. cooked hamburger (drain grease)
1 large  bottle Catalina dressing
preparation: In large bowl, tear lettuce into bite size pieces.  Mix in tomatoes, onions, pepper, cheese and crumble in cooked hamburger. Crumble in Doritos.  Pour in Catalina dressing.  Mix well.  This is a favorite of ours.

name: PICKLED EGGS
ingredients:
2  c. vinegar
1  qt. of pickled beet juice
1  qt. of pickle juice
2  c. sugar
2  c. water
eggs, hard boiled
preparation: Put any amount of eggs in a pot.  Cover with water and bring to a boil.  Let eggs boil for 15 minutes.  Take off of heat and cool under cold water.  Peel eggs while warm.  While eggs are boiling, go ahead and mix all other ingredients in a large pot on the stove. Heat mixture and taste.  For sweeter eggs use more sugar.  For sour eggs use more vinegar.  Put warm eggs into a warmed glass jar. Pour heated pickle mixture over eggs.  They'll pickle quicker when warm.  Let jar cool and place into refrigerator at least 4 to 5 days.  The longer the eggs stay in juice the more they will pickle.

name: TACOS BEL GRANDE
ingredients:
1  soft taco dinner kit (includes taco sauce, taco seasoning and soft taco shells)
1  jar mushrooms
1  pkg. ground beef
1  onion
1  pkg. grated cheese (any flavor) or cheese slices
1  jar picante sauce or salsa
preparation: Cook ground beef (chopped) until well done.  Stir in onion and drained mushrooms; mix well.  From taco kit, stir in taco sauce and taco seasoning; mix well.  It will be dry.  Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam or other nonstick spray.  Fill soft taco shells with mixture.  Lay them in the pan with one slightly on top of the other.  Top with cheese.  Any kind of cheese works well. Top with picante sauce or salsa.  Bake in the oven at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes, until cheese has melted.

name: HOMEMADE BANANA ICE CREAM
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  pt. half and half
1/2  tsp. vanilla
3  ripe bananas, mashed
preparation: Mix and heat on medium-low until thoroughly hot the eggs, sugar and milk.  Mix in separate bowl the Eagle Brand milk, half and half, vanilla and bananas. Add heated mixture and pour into canister.  Fill to line with milk.

name: GOLDEN RAISIN TRUFFLES
ingredients:
1/2  c. golden raisins, coarsely chopped
10  oz. white chocolate, chopped fine
1/3  c. cream
powdered sugar
preparation: Melt chocolate with cream.  Add raisins.  Cover and refrigerate until set, about 4 hours.  Scoop into balls and roll in powdered sugar.

name: BUSY DAY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground hamburger
1/2  onion, chopped
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
1  c. water
1  can (10) biscuits
preparation: Brown hamburger meat with onion.  Drain.  Add soup, vegetables and water.  Simmer until vegetables are tender.  Put in Pyrex dish; top with biscuits.  Bake at 400° until biscuits are brown (8 to 10 minutes).

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
2  c. sugar
2  eggs, well beaten
2  c. thick applesauce
3  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. cloves
1 (15 oz.)  box raisins
1  c. black walnut meats
1  c. English walnuts or 2 c. if you don't have black walnuts
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs.   Add next 6 items and beat about 2 minutes.  Fold in nuts.  Bake in greased and floured angel food cake pan for 2 hours at 300°.  Makes about 5 pounds.

name: HOMEMADE CURRY POWDER
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. garlic salt
2  Tbsp. cumin
2  Tbsp. cardamon
2  Tbsp. turmeric
preparation: Blend all ingredients together.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  whole eggs, beat slightly
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. Blue Label Karo syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
pecans
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Arrange pecan halves on top of pie.  Bake at 450° for 10 minutes, then at 350° for approximately 25 minutes or until set.

name: PIZZA CRUST
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  stick soft butter
1  pkg. yeast, dissolved in 1 c. water
preparation: Cut together flour, salt and butter.   Stir in yeast and knead.

name: GOLDEN CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  eggs, well beaten
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. cracker crumbs
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1  tsp. chopped pimiento
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients thoroughly.  Pour into greased 1-quart casserole.  Place casserole in baking pan.  Pour very hot water into pan to a depth of about 1-inch.  Bake until knife inserted 1-inch from edge of casserole comes out clean, 50 to 60 minutes.  Center will be soft but will set.  Makes 6 servings.

name: TARSHA SPANN'S MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1/2  c. green pepper
1/2  c. onions
1  c. ketchup
2  tsp. garlic salt
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients in a bowl.  Flatten the meat loaf out in a small pan and take more ketchup and spread evenly on top.  Bake at  375° for 30 minutes.  (The more hamburger, the more ingredients  and  the bigger the pan, the longer it takes to cook.)

name: SAUSAGE CHEESE BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour (Pioneer)
1/2  lb. bulk pork sausage
1/2  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. red pepper (optional)
1  egg
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Mix well; knead lightly.  Pinch off dough and form into balls to make a biscuit about 1 3/4-inch in width. Place on greased baking sheet.  Bake at 325° about 25 minutes or until golden brown.

name: OVEN FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3  lb. chicken, cut up
1/4  c. shortening
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. all-purpose flour*
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Wash chicken and pat dry.  In oven melt shortening and butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Mix flour, salt, paprika and pepper.  Coat chicken in egg; then roll into flour mixture.  Place chicken, skin side down in melted shortening. Cook, uncovered, for 30 minutes.  Turn chicken and cook 30 minutes longer or until thickest pieces are done.

name: CORN BREAD CAKE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. corn meal
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1  c. white sugar
4  eggs, beaten
1  c. oil
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Spray pan with Pam.  Mix all ingredients and pour in baking dish and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

name: SWEET PICKLES
ingredients:
8  lb. sliced cucumbers
2  gal. water
2  c. lime
2  qt. vinegar
2  Tbsp. salt
9  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. mixed pickle spice
1 scant  tsp. powdered alum
preparation: Slice and soak cucumbers in the 2 gallons of water and lime overnight.  Wash several times to remove all lime.  Dissolve sugar, salt and alum in vinegar and add spices and washed cucumbers.  Let set about an hour.  Bring to a boil and boil for 20 minutes.  Put into jars and seal.

name: BONELESS BARBECUE PORK LOIN
ingredients:
3 to 5  lb. boneless pork loin roast
1/2  c. vinegar
1  c. water
2  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. pepper
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
2  slices lemon
2  slices onion
1  c. catsup
4  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. margarine
preparation: Cook roast on grill on medium-slow to slow for 2 hours with a pan of water beside roast.  Internal temperature of roast should be 170° when done, or bake in oven at 325° for 2 hours.  Baste frequently with sauce.  Serve with sauce when roast is done.

name: PIZZABURGERS
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1/2  lb. bologna
1/3  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sage
1  Tbsp. oregano
2  c. spaghetti sauce
4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/8  c. parsley
hamburger buns
preparation: Brown hamburger; drain.  Grind bologna in food processor.  Add bologna and seasonings to meat.  Add spaghetti sauce, 3 cups cheese and parsley.  Heat until warm.  Spoon on bun halves and top with extra cheese. Bake at 350° for 10 to 13 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND OKRA GUMBO
ingredients:
4  lb. stewing or roasting chicken
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. shortening
1  c. chopped onions
5  c. water
5  c. peeled, chopped tomatoes
2  c. fresh corn, cut from cob
3  c. sliced okra
1 1/2  Tbsp. salt
2 1/2  c. water
preparation: Cut chicken into serving pieces.  Dredge with flour and the 1 1/2 teaspoons salt mixed and brown slowly in hot fat over moderate heat; add onions until soft.  Add 5 cups water and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours until tender.  Lift chicken out onto a plate to cool.  Add remaining ingredients to broth.  Simmer slowly for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, remove meat from bones and cut chicken into cubes. Return chicken to broth mixture.  Heat through quickly and serve at once.

name: PEAR RELISH
ingredients:
2  qt. ground pears
2  small onions
2  large green bell peppers
2  large red peppers
6  dill pickles
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. turmeric
3  tsp. dry mustard
4  tsp. flour
1  pt. vinegar
1  tsp. mustard
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix and bring to boil; boil 5 minutes.  Pour in sterilized jars and seal.  Makes 6 pints.

name: WRAPPED CHICKEN BREAST SUPREME
ingredients:
8  chicken breasts (uncooked), deboned and skinned
1  pkg. chipped beef or 4 oz. jar dried beef
8  slices bacon
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  pt. sour cream
preparation: Wrap each chicken breast with a slice of bacon and secure with toothpick.  Grease bottom of casserole and line with chipped beef. Place chicken breasts on top of beef.  Mix sour cream and mushroom soup.  Pour over chicken.  Bake uncovered in 275° oven for 3 hours.

name: CHICKEN AND NOODLES
ingredients:
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
2  c. noodles (any kind)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. diced chicken
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. green pepper
1/4  c. onion
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Set aside 1/2 of cheese.  Mix remaining ingredients.  Place in greased casserole dish.  Sprinkle remaining cheese on top.  Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
1  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
3  drops Tabasco sauce
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. dill weed
1  tsp. parsley
1  tsp. Accent
1  tsp. minced onion
1  tsp. seasoned salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients and chill 6 hours.  Serve with chips or raw veggies.

name: MICROWAVE EASY GRAVY
ingredients:
1/4  c. meat or poultry drippings (juice from meat with most of fat removed)
1/4  c. flour
2  c. warm liquid (broth, water or juice)
salt and pepper
preparation: Pour drippings into 4 cup glass measure.  Stir in flour until smooth.  Pour in liquid and stir briskly until well blended.  Cook on High (maximum power) 3 to 4 minutes or until boiling, stirring several times during cooking.  Season with salt and pepper.  Beat until smooth.  Serve hot with meat, potatoes or dressing.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 small  boxes frozen chopped broccoli
1  c. cream of mushroom or chicken soup
2  eggs, well beaten
1 medium onion, chopped, or 1 1/2  Tbsp. onion flakes
1  c. grated cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
bread or cracker crumbs
preparation: Cook broccoli as directed on box; drain.  Add soup and mayonnaise; mix well.  Add eggs, onion and cheese; mix well.  Pour into a 2 or 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Sprinkle with bread or cracker crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: MAMA'S JAM CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. jam (any variety)
2  c. sifted flour
2/3  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. brown sugar
3  eggs, separated
1/2  c. raisins
1  tsp. allspice
preparation: Cream butter and gradually add sugar.  Cream until the mixture is fluffy.  Add egg yolks and jam to this mixture and beat until well blended.  Sift flour and measure.  Take out about 1/2 cup to use to dredge raisins.  Sift remaining flour with cinnamon, nutmeg and allspice.  Add soda to buttermilk.  Add flour mixture alternately with the buttermilk and soda.  Mix in flavored raisins, and lastly, fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.  Reserve 2 tablespoons for the filling.  Divide the remaining batter into two 9-inch cake pans which have been lightly greased in the bottom and wax paper lined.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: STUFFED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
4  thick loin chops
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine or water or orange juice
1/4  c. celery
1  Tbsp. onion
1/8  c. walnuts
1/2  c. apples
1/8  c. raisins
1  c. bread crumbs
1/2  tsp. salt and pepper
1/4  tsp. sage
preparation: Cut pockets in chops.  Combine onion and celery in skillet and saute.  Add rest of stuffing and mix well.  Stuff pockets.  Place chops in foil and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

name: SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless chicken breasts
2  Tbsp. oil
1  chopped onion
3  Tbsp. ketchup
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: In large frypan saute onion in oil until soft.  In bowl combine ketchup, sugar, soy sauce, lemon juice and pepper.  Add to pan with onions.  Add chicken.  Bring to boil.  Cover and simmer 25 to 35 minutes or until chicken is done.  Remove chicken.  Dissolve cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water.  Add to pan.  Bring sauce to boil, stirring until thickened.  Pour over chicken.  Serve with rice.

name: OVEN BBQ PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
8  pork chops
1  small onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/2  c. water
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. chili sauce
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
2-3 drops hot pepper sauce (to taste)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a large skillet over medium high heat 1 teaspoonful of vegetable oil, add pork chops and brown them on both sides.  Place in a casserole dish.  In a bowl mix together chopped onion, 2 Tbsp. vegetable oil, water, vinegar, chili sauce, brown sugar, dry mustard, and hot pepper sauce; pour mixture over chops.  Cover and cook for 40 minutes.  Uncover casserole dish and cook for 20 minutes more.  Serve.

name: BRAZIL NUT AND DATE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. Brazil nuts, pecans or walnuts
1  lb. pitted dates
3/4  c. drained maraschino cherries
3/4  c. sifted flour
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put nuts, dates and cherries into a large bowl.  Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt over nut mixture.  Mix with hands until mixture is coated.   Beat eggs until foamy. Add vanilla. Stir into fruit and nuts until well mixed.  Pour into greased and waxed paper pan.  Spread evenly. Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes in a 300° oven.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2 to 3/4  c. butter
12  apples, peeled and sliced
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. lemon
1/2  c. water
preparation: Mix first 3  ingredients  and  crumble	in butter until very fine.  I use  my  hands.  Set  aside.  Place apple in 9 x 13-inch pan, mix  sugar  and  cinnamon,  then  sprinkle  over apples, stirring slightly  to cover.  Add lemon juice to water and pour over  apples.  Cover  with	flour  mixture and pat to cover firmly and smoothly.  Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

name: CAPPUCCINO MIX
ingredients:
1  c. powdered, instant non-dairy creamer
1  c. chocolate milk mix (i.e. Nestle Quik)
2/3  c. instant coffee granules
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Mix well. Store in airtight container.  To serve: place 4 level tsp. in cup.  Add boiling water.  Stir Well.  Yield: about 33 servings.  Makes great gifts by placing in small containers.

name: SPICED NUTS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 to 2  Tbsp. curry powder
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  c. blanched almonds
preparation: In oblong baking dish, heat butter at High 1 minute or until melted.  Stir in curry and Worcestershire.  Add almonds and coat thoroughly.  Heat at High 4 to 5 minutes.  Stir twice.  Yields 2 cups.

name: SUNDAY MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. bread crumbs
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  c. milk
1/3  c. dry minced onion
1  pkg. dry chicken noodle soup mix
1  carrot, grated
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
4  oz. can tomato sauce
preparation: Mix together all ingredients except the tomato sauce.  Put the meat mixture into greased loaf pan.  Top with tomato sauce, seasoned with your favorite herbs (oregano, basil, thyme, etc.) Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.  Makes 8 servings.

name: BUCKEYES
ingredients:
3  c. powdered sugar
1  c. oleo
2  c. peanut butter
2 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1/4  cake paraffin wax
preparation: Mix powdered sugar, oleo and peanut butter together.  Form into 1-inch balls and refrigerate.

name: STIR-FRIED SHRIMP CHOW MEIN
ingredients:
about 50 shrimp, peeled
1  can Campbell's chicken broth
1  bottle soy sauce
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  can fancy Chinese vegetables, drained in colander and rinsed
1  large onion, sliced into thin slices
1  large green pepper, sliced into thin slices
1 large  can chow mein noodles, toasted in oven
rice, cooked to own taste
oil for cooking
preparation: Heat frying pan with enough oil just to coat the surface.  Add thinly sliced onion and green pepper.  Cook only until onion is translucent.  Do not overcook.  Remove onion and green pepper from frying pan and drain on paper towel.  Some oil will remain in the skillet.

name: PINTO BEAN PIE
ingredients:
1  can plain pinto beans
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. pecans or walnuts, chopped
2 1/2  c. sugar
2  sticks melted butter
1 1/2  c. flaked coconut
3  unbaked 9-inch pie shells
preparation: Blend beans and juice in a food processor until smooth.  In a separate bowl, mix sugar, eggs, melted butter and vanilla.  Add blended beans, coconut and nuts.  Pour into the unbaked pie shells. Bake at 300° for 1 hour.  Yields 3 pies.

name: MILKY WAY CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. Milky Way candy
2  sticks margarine (1 softened)
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
4  eggs
1  oz. semi-sweet chocolate, melted and cooled
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt candy with 1 stick butter over low heat.  Cream softened butter and sugar.  Beat in eggs one at a time.  Blend in chocolate.  Sift together flour, salt and soda.  Beat in flour alternately with buttermilk.  Add vanilla; blend in candy and nuts.  Bake in a greased and floured tube pan about 1 1/4 hours at 350°.  Cool on rack 10 minutes before removing from pan.

name: PENNSYLVANIA DUTCH BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. warm water
3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. margarine
1  pkg. yeast
2  eggs, beaten
12  c. flour or 5 c. wheat flour and 7 c. flour
1/2  c. warm water
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water.  Melt margarine, salt and sugar in 3 1/2 cups warm water.  Stir together.  Add eggs. Stir in yeast.  Stir in flour, making a stiff dough.  Let rise until double in bulk in large greased bowl.  After several hours, punch down and shape into rolls or bread.  Place in greased pans or Pyrex bowls (casserole).  Let rise until double.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.  When baked, rub tops with butter or margarine.

name: CHOCOLATE ICING
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. milk
1/2  c. chocolate chips
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bring margarine to a boil.  Boil for 3 minutes.  Add chips and vanilla.  Remove from heat and stir until chocolate has melted. Pour over warm cake.

name: TEXAS SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
5  lb. stewing hen (highly seasoned)
1  c. chicken fat
1  can chopped mushrooms
1  lb. spaghetti
2  green peppers, chopped fine
1  lb. grated American cheese
2  cans tomatoes
4  small onions, chopped fine
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
preparation: Cook  chicken,	remove	from  bone.  Heat  fat	and add peppers,  onions, tomatoes, mushrooms and chicken.	Cook until peppers  and  onions  are tender.  Boil spaghetti; drain.  Add cheese  to	spaghetti,  saving a little for top.  Mix in other ingredients.  Put in casserole.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Bake at 325°  until  it bubbles, 25 to 30 minutes.	Serves 12 to 15 people.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. diced chicken
1/2  c. toasted almonds
2  tsp. grated onion
2  c. chopped celery
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. grated American cheese
1  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Combine first 7 ingredients and pat in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle with grated cheese and crushed potato chips.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until bubbly.

name: SLUSH
ingredients:
2  c. boiling water
4  tea bags
7 more  c. boiling water
1  c. sugar
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
2  c. rum or vodka
7-Up
preparation: Make tea with the 2 cups of boiling water and tea bags.  Make the tea strong.  Mix all ingredients except 7-Up.  Freeze.  Will be a slush.  Serve 2 or 3 tablespoons of frozen slush with a glass of 7-Up.  You can garnish with cherry and slice of orange.  Enjoy.

name: GOURMET ARK VALLEY COOKED GOOSE
ingredients:
1  Canadian or 2 Snow Geese, (Preferably shot in the Arkansas Valley)
1  stick butter or margarine
Garlic Salt
Basil
Poultry seasoning
Seasoning salt
Cut Lemon slices
preparation: Preparation, cooking and serving instructions:  Preheat oven for 20 minutes at 350°.  Place thawed goose on cedar board approximately 12 X 18 inches, 1/4 to 1 inch thick.  Rub bird down with butter or margarine to insure seasonings stick to carcass. Season bird with:  Garlic salt, basil, poultry seasoning, and seasoning salt.  Season both inside and out.  Stovetop stuffing optional inside carcass.  Place goose on Cedar board on middle rack of oven.  After one hour remove and squeeze with fresh lemon. Place back in oven and gradually increase oven temperature to 425°. Cook an additional hour and thirty minutes after squeezing with lemon juice.  Remove from oven and let cool approximately 15 minutes.  Last step, throw the bird away and eat the cedar board.

name: STUFFED ROLLS
ingredients:
30  small sourdough rolls
1  lb. Monterey Jack cheese
2  cans chopped black olives
6  green onions
2  minced garlic cloves
3  boiled eggs (optional)
1/2  can chopped green chilies
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/3  c. oil
preparation: Grind al ingredients and mix together.  Remove part of center of rolls.  Fill with mixture.  Wrap in foil and bake at 250° for 30 minutes.

name: DOUBLE-LAYER CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
4  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. milk or half and half
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  chocolate graham crust
2  c. cold milk or half and half
2  pkg. (3 1/2 oz.) chocolate instant pudding
preparation: Mix cream cheese, 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth. Gently stir in 1 1/2 cups of the whipped topping. Spread onto bottom of crust. Pour 2 cups milk into bowl. Add pudding mix. Beat with wire whisk until well mixed. (Mixture will be thick.) Immediately stir in remaining whipped topping. Spread over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set. Garnish as desired.

name: EASY THOUSAND ISLAND DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. pickle relish
2  Tbsp. chili sauce
1  hard-cooked egg
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: In small bowl combine all ingredients; blend well. Cover and chill.  Makes 3/4 cup.

name: MY SISTER'S BEST WHOLE WHEAT PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  egg
1  c. whole wheat flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. honey (optional, but I always use it!)
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. milk or soy milk
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat egg until fluffy.  Mix in remaining ingredients. Cook as usual.

name: HAM WITH PINEAPPLE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  boneless fully cooked ham (4 to 6 pounds)
3/4  cup water, divided
1  cup packed brown sugar
4 1/2  tsp. soy sauce
4 1/2  tsp. ketchup
1 1/2  tsp. ground mustard
1 1/2  c. undrained crushed pineapple
2  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. cornstarch
preparation: Place ham on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 to 2 hours or until a meat thermometer reads 140° and ham is heated through. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, combine 1/4 cup water, brown sugar, soy sauce, ketchup, mustard and pineapple. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Combine cornstarch and remaining water until smooth; stir into pineapple sauce. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Serve with the ham.

name: JOYCE'S EASY LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3 1/2  c. (32 oz. jar) thick spaghetti sauce
1 1/2  c. water
2  c. (15 oz. container) Ricotta or small curd cottage cheese
3  c. (12 oz.) shredded Mozzarella or Monterey Jack cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  eggs
8  oz. lasagne, uncooked
preparation: Brown beef in 3-quart saucepan.  Drain off excess fat.  Add sauce and water; simmer about 10 minutes.  Combine remaining ingredients except lasagne for filling.  Pour about 1 cup sauce on bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Layer 3 pieces of uncooked lasagne over sauce; cover with about 1 1/2 cups sauce.  Spread 1/2 of cheese filling over sauce.  Repeat layers of lasagne, sauce and cheese filling.   Top with layer of lasagne and remaining sauce. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes. Remove foil; bake about 10 minutes longer.  Allow to stand about 10 minutes before cutting for easier handling.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.  Lasagne will expand to fill empty spaces.

name: BEEF 'N CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, cubed
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (12 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1/4  c. chopped pimento
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1 (7.5 oz.)  can refrigerated buttermilk biscuits
preparation: Brown meat; drain.  Add onion; cook until tender.  Add cream cheese and soup, mixing well.  Stir in corn, pimento and seasonings; pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Separate dough into 10 biscuits; cut each in half, forming 20 half-circles.  Place biscuits, cut side down, around edge of casserole.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes, or until biscuits are browned.  Makes 6 servings.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
3  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
1  c. peanut butter
2  Tbsp. milk (more if needed)
preparation: Cream sugar, shortening, peanut butter, salt, vanilla and eggs.  Add sifted flour and baking soda.  Roll in balls and flatten with a fork.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

name: THUMBPRINT COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  lb. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
2  egg yolks
3  c. flour
jelly of choice
preparation: Mix sugar and butter.  Stir in egg yolks.  Gradually add 3 cups flour; mix well.  Roll into small balls and place on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Dip finger in water and make shallow depression in each ball of dough.  Put a bit of jelly (color of your choice) in each depression.  Bake at 350° until lightly browned.  (This is a good recipe to make when also making Forgotten Cookies, as the remaining egg yolks are used.)

name: APPLE BUTTER
ingredients:
7  lb. ripe tomatoes
7  lb. tart apples
1  c. vinegar
2  tsp. allspice
2  tsp. cinnamon
4  lb. sugar
1  c. crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix well.  Bake in oven 3 hours or cook on top of stove.

name: CONGRESS TARTS
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1/4  lb. butter
2  tsp. baking powder
raspberry jam
1/2  c. plus sugar (4 oz.)
2  eggs
3  tsp. almond essence
preparation: Make pie crust.  Either your own or pie crust mix.  Cut pie crust with cutter and line muffin tins.  Put teaspoon of jam on pie crust and then large tablespoon of batter mix on top.  Bake until golden brown at 300° to 350°.

name: YUMMIES
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
1  lb. white chocolate wafers
4  c. Golden Grahams cereal
2  c. salted peanuts
preparation: Put oil in pan on low heat.  Add chocolate wafers and melt, stirring often.  Pour over cereal and nuts in large bowl.  Spread mixture evenly.   Cool and break up like peanut brittle.

name: NACHO DIP(9 x 13-inch Pan)
ingredients:
2  cans Nalley's bean dip
3  to 5 fresh avocados
1  small container sour cream
1  onion
1  can chopped olives
Cheddar cheese
preparation: First layer:  Bean dip.

name: VERY VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
2  cans (14 1/2 oz.) Swanson ready to serve vegetable broth
1/2  tsp. dried basil leaves
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1 (16 oz.)  can whole, peeled tomatoes, cut up
1  c. dry corkscrew macaroni
1 (15 oz.)  can Veg-All mixed vegetables
preparation: In saucepan, mix broth, crushed basil, garlic powder and tomatoes.  Heat to a boil.  Stir in macaroni; cook over low heat 10 minutes or until macaroni is done, stirring often.  Add vegetables and heat through.  Serves 6.

name: UNREAL MAYONNAISE
ingredients:
2  c. water
3/4  c. raw cashews
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. orange juice concentrate
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. onion powder
1/8  tsp. paprika
1/8  c. olive oil
4  Tbsp. instant Clearjel
1/2  tsp. citric acid
preparation: Blend with 1 cup hot water, then add 1 cup cold water and blend well.  Slowly add oil while blender is running.  Add Clearjel 1 tablespoon at a time and blend well.  Add citric acid and let it sit overnight before using.

name: CANDY ORANGE SLICE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1/2  lb. dates, chopped
2  c. white sugar
3 1/2  c. flour
1  c. coconut
1  lb. candy orange slices, chopped
1  tsp. soda
4  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift flour and soda together 3 times.  Cream butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Add flour and buttermilk.  Stir other ingredients into batter with spoon.  Add orange slices with last ingredients.  Bake at 250° for 3 hours in greased and floured tube pan.

name: MOCK APPLE  PIE
ingredients:
36  Ritz Crackers
2  c. Sugar
2  c. Water
2  tsp. Lemon Juice
Cinnamon
Nutmeg
2  tsp. Butter
preparation: Bring to boil water, sugar. Put in 36 ritz crackers and lemon juice. Cook 2 minutes. Pour into pie crust and sprinkle with nutmeg and cinnamon. Add 2 tsp. butter. Cover with pie crust. Cut hole in middle. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 min.

name: COCOONS
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo (1 c.)
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream butter and sugar well.  Add flour, water, vanilla and nuts; chill.  Roll in individual balls.  Roll in powdered sugar. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes;  cool.

name: PAPRIKA FISH
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. melted butter
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. Dijon mustard
1  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. seasoned pepper
1  lb. fresh white fish fillets
preparation: Combine the first 5 ingredients.  Brush over both sides of fish.  Broil 5 minutes or until fish flakes easily.

name: CHALUPAS
ingredients:
3  corn tortillas
1  can refried beans
1/2  c. chopped lettuce
1  diced tomato
1/2  c. shredded cheese (Cheddar)
preparation: This recipe is for one serving.

name: PANCAKE MIX
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour, sifted
1  Tbsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg, beaten
1 3/4  c. milk (sweet)
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder, sugar and salt together.  Combine egg, milk and vegetable oil.  Add to dry ingredients, stirring just until flour is moistened.  Batter will be slightly lumpy.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
20  oz. pkg. Oreo Cookies
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1/2  stick butter
1  c. sugar
3  c. milk
2 small  boxes French Vanilla instant pudding mix
12  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Grate cookies, set aside.  Mix cream cheese, sugar and butter together.  Mix vanilla pudding with 3 cups of milk and add to mixture, fold in Cool Whip.  Layer grated cookies alternately with mixture ending up with cookies on top.

name: FUDGERY BROWNIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. Hershey's cocoa
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2/3  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. boiling water
2  eggs
1 1/3  c. unsifted flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
preparation: Measure accurately. Stir cocoa and baking soda in mixing bowl. Blend in 1/3 cup vegetable oil. Add boiling water; stir until mixture thickens. Stir in sugar, eggs and remaining 1/3 cup oil. Stir until smooth. Add flour, vanilla and salt. Blend completely. Pour into lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool. Frost, if desired.

name: SPICE TEA
ingredients:
6  tsp. tea or 8 tea bags
2  c. boiling water
1 small  can frozen lemon juice
1 small  can frozen orange juice
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  qt. water
1  stick cinnamon
preparation: Pour water over tea and let cool.  Strain and add remaining ingredients.  Simmer mixture for 20 minutes.  If too strong add water.  Add extra sugar to taste.  This recipe makes 16 to 20 cups.

name: CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
11  potatoes, diced and shredded in processor (optional)
1  lb. carrots, diced
1  large onion
3  Tbsp. bacon grease
1/2  bottle dill sauce (optional)
2 large  cans clams, drained, saving juice plus water to equal 4 c.
3  qt. half and half
1/2  c. butter
3  lb. bacon
1  c. cornstarch
salt and pepper to taste
chives to taste
paprika to taste
preparation: Cook onions in grease until brown.  Add potatoes, carrots, sauce, seasonings and juice.  Boil.  Add clams, half and half, chives and butter.  Simmer for 1 1/2 hours.  Fry bacon crisp.  Add, crumpled, into soup.  (Save some to garnish as served.)  Add cornstarch to thicken as desired.  Simmer 1/2 hour.  Garnish with chives and bacon.  Freezes for 1 to 2 months.

name: CROCK-POT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. California Blend vegetables
3  c. spiral noodles
1  can Campbell's Cheddar cheese soup
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 1/2  c. milk
dash of salt
preparation: Cook the vegetables and noodles; drain.  Mix with the remaining ingredients.  Cook in crock-pot until hot.

name: FRESH CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. fresh corn, cut
1/4  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  c. toasted bread crumbs
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  beaten eggs
1 1/2  c. fresh tomatoes, chopped
1/4  c. chopped celery
2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. oleo
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Put into a casserole dish.  Put casserole dish in a pan of water and bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  egg
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
crushed pineapple (optional)
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar.  Beat in the egg, then dry ingredients.  Line an 8 x 8-inch baking dish (greased) with dough. If the dough is hard to handle, then chill first.  Drain crushed pineapple and spread when filling is ready.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  pork chops (1-inch thick)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. water
3  large potatoes, sliced
1  medium onion, sliced
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Use a 9 or 10-inch baking dish.   Layer potatoes, onion and pork chops.  Repeat with remaining.  Mix mushroom soup and water; pour over pork chop layers.  Salt and pepper.  Bake, covered, 45 minutes.  Remove cover and bake 15 minutes more.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI ANGEL HAIR
ingredients:
2  oz. olive oil
1  tsp. fresh garlic, minced
1  c. rotisserie chicken (boneless, skinless), julienned
1  c. broccoli flowerets, blanched
4  oz. chicken stock
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground black pepper
1  Tbsp. fresh basil, stemmed, washed, rinsed and minced
2  oz. whole butter
1  Tbsp. pine nuts, toasted
8  oz. angel hair, blanched
preparation: In 12-inch saute pan, combine olive oil and garlic and begin cooking so as to sweat the garlic (approximately 1 minute).   Add chicken, broccoli, chicken stock, salt, pepper and basil and bring to a boil (approximately 3 to 4 minutes).  Add butter and swirl into liquid mix to blend.  Poach pasta and add to mix.

name: SLICED COOKIES(Over 100 Years Old)
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
3  beaten eggs
1  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. soda
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped English walnuts
preparation: Mix as other cookies, then to first 2 cups flour (plain), add soda, salt, cinnamon, vanilla and nuts.  Keep adding flour until you have a stiff enough dough to shape into a loaf.  Work on a molding board to shape into a loaf.  (Makes 3 or 4 loaves).  Wrap into wax paper and chill.  Slice thin and bake until light brown at 350°.  Keep in airtight container.

name: HAWAIIAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  bottle Russian dressing
1 (10 oz.)  jar apricot preserves
2  Tbsp. Lipton onion soup
4  whole chicken breasts
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour over chicken.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Remove foil and brown.

name: QUICKIE COBBLER
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  qt. canned peaches or other
preparation: Melt butter in oven while it's preheating to 400°.  Mix dry ingredients together.  Combine milk and vanilla with dry ingredients.  Pour into pan with butter.  Pour peaches or other fruit over the butter.  Sprinkle with brown sugar and bake at 400°.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1 (18.25 oz.)  pkg. cake mix plus ingredients to prepare the mix (you may use a store bought pound cake)
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. vanilla instant pudding and pie filling plus ingredients to prepare the mix
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained), divided
2 (21 oz.)  cans cherry pie filling, divided
1  (12 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed and divided
1/2  c. chopped nuts, divided
preparation: Prepare and bake cake according to directions on package. Cool.  Prepare pudding mix according to package.  Crumble half of cake into large bowl.  (A small punch bowl works well.)  Top with layers of half the pudding, pineapple, cherry pie filling, whipped topping and nuts.  (If desired, reserve a few cherries from second can of pie filling for garnish.)  Repeat layers, using rest of ingredients.  Top with remaining whipped topping.  Garnish with reserved cherries.

name: BAKED HAM
ingredients:
7 1/2  lb. ham
1  doz. cloves
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  bottle blue label Karo dark corn syrup
3  Tbsp. vinegar
3/4-inch  water
preparation: In a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan, put the ham in and stick cloves in the ham. Next add the water, Karo syrup, brown syrup and then your vinegar.  Bake at 350° for 2 1/2 hours.

name: HOT POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
2  lb. boiling potatoes, cooked, peeled and cubed (warm)
1/2  c. diced onion
1/2  lb. cooked bacon
2  Tbsp. bacon drippings
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
3/4  c. water
1/2  c. red wine vinegar
3/4  c. sour cream
parsley sprigs
preparation: Add onion to warm potatoes.  Stir flour into bacon drippings in a large frypan.  Add sugar, butter, salt, pepper, water and vinegar; bring to a boil, stir constantly.  Remove from heat and stir in sour cream.  Add potatoes, onion and half the bacon; toss gently.  Turn into a heated salad bowl.  Garnish with the remaining bacon and parsley sprigs.

name: CANDIED CARROTS
ingredients:
4  cups diagonally sliced carrots
1/4  cup butter
1/4  cup jellied cranberry sauce
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Cook carrots in a small amount of salted water for 10 minutes. Drain and set aside.  Combine next three ingredients in a skillet. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until cranberry sauce melts. Add carrots and stir gently.  Cook until heated.  6 servings.

name: MARSHMALLOW ICE CREAM
ingredients:
80  marshmallows*
4  c. milk
2  pt. whipping cream
4  Tbsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Put marshmallows and milk in large boiler over low heat.  Stir until marshmallows are melted. Remove from heat; add vanilla extract and cool. When chilled and beginning to thicken, fold in the cream which has been whipped until thick but not stiff. Pour into freezer canister and add ice and salt as usual. Super good and oh so rich!

name: OLD SETTLERS' BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  lb. bacon, cut in small pieces
1  small onion
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  c. catsup
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. molasses
1  can pork and beans
1  can butter beans, drained
1  can kidney beans, drained
preparation: Brown meats and onions; drain and mix.  Combine brown sugar, granulated sugar, catsup, dry mustard and molasses; add to meat mixture.  Add beans.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
12  oz. vermicelli
1  tsp. Accent
2  Tbsp. Lawry's season salt
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
4  Tbsp. salad oil
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green pepper (optional)
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. stuffed olives
4  oz. chopped pimento
1 to 1 1/2  c. mayo
preparation: Mix all together and serve.

name: HOT CHEESE TOAST
ingredients:
8  slices bacon
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar
dash of black pepper
8  slices white bread
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  small onion, grated
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Cook bacon and drain.  Combine all ingredients in a bowl, except bread and bacon.  Crumble bacon and add to mixture, then set aside.  Cut crusts from bread slices on all sides.   Spread each slice generously with cheese mixture.  Cut each slice into 3 strips.  Place on baking sheet; cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Bake at 350° for 7 to 10 minutes.  Serve hot.

name: PIE CRUST - FAILPROOF
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. shortening
1  egg yolk
milk
1  egg white
1  tsp. water
preparation: Combine flour and salt; cut in shortening.  Measure 1 egg yolk and milk to equal 2/3 cup.  Reserve egg white.  Beat with 1 teaspoon water and use as glaze on top crust of pie.   Add egg yolk-milk mixture to flour mixture and combine thoroughly.  Roll crust on flour or cloth in usual manner.  Any crust is usually easier to work with if left to set for a few minutes before rolling or put into refrigerator for a few minutes.

name: MY BUDDY'S PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  medium green pepper, chopped
1/2  lb. sliced pepperoni
1 large  can mushrooms
1 large  jar favorite spaghetti sauce
1  c. elbow macaroni
1  c. shell macaroni
1  c. spiral macaroni
2  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: In a large skillet, brown the ground beef, onion, green pepper, pepperoni and mushrooms.  Drain excess grease.  Add spaghetti sauce.  Cook noodles until soft in boiling water; drain. Combine meat sauce and noodles in a large casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI-CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  tsp. vegetable oil
1  can broccoli cheese soup
1  can chicken broth
2  c. water
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. white rice
2  c. broccoli (uncooked)
1  green pepper, sliced
1  red pepper, sliced
preparation: Combine both soups, water and pepper in bowl. Add to cooked chicken in frying pan; bring to boil. Stir in rice. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Add broccoli and peppers; simmer for 5 minutes uncovered.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
16-24 oz. bag-frozen chopped broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  roll of Townhouse crackers
2  cups shredded Velveeta cheese
preparation: Cook broccoli, according to package directions.  Mix broccoli, soup and cheese in bowl.  Spread over crushed crackers in casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

name: MYRA'S INSTANT TEA
ingredients:
2  c. Tang
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. instant tea (sweetened instant lemon)
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  pkg. lemon twist dry mix
preparation: Mix together.  Use 2 tablespoons per cup added to hot water.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
3  c. oatmeal
1 1/2  tsp. coconut flavoring (optional)
preparation: Combine flour, soda, salt and cinnamon and set aside.  Cream eggs, shortening and sugar until fluffy.  Gradually add flour mixture.  Stir in oatmeal.  Spoon dough in 1-inch balls onto greased cookie sheet.   Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes until brown.

name: THE ORIGINAL RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  oz. red food coloring (1/4 c.)
2 heaping  Tbsp. cocoa
2 1/4  c. cake flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. white vinegar
preparation: Grease and flour two 8-inch cake pans.  Heat oven to 350°. Cream butter with sugar and add eggs.  Beat until well blended. Make a paste of food coloring and cocoa.  Add to creamed mixture. Sift flour with salt.  Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour.  Add vanilla.  Place vinegar in a small measuring bowl and add soda, holding bowl over the batter bowl as vinegar mixture foams.  Then add soda and vinegar to batter, blending, instead of beating.  Pour into prepared pans.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean.  Remove from oven.  Cool in pans for 10 minutes.  Remove from pans.  Cool completely on wire racks.  When cool, split each layer into 2 layers.

name: LEMON BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. milk
grated rind of 1 lemon
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Bake in loaf pan for 1 hour at 350°.  Have ready the juice of one lemon and 1/4 cup sugar; mix well.  Pour over loaf when taken from oven and let juice soak in.

name: COCONUT ICING
ingredients:
2  egg yolks
3/4  c. evaporated milk
3/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. flaked coconut
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat egg yolks. Add milk, sugar and butter. Cook over medium heat for about 12 minutes, stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Remove from heat; add coconut, nuts and vanilla. Spread on cake.

name: BROCCOLI/RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg frozen chopped broccoli
2  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. margarine (1 stick)
2  cans cream chicken soup
1  c. Velveeta cheese, grated
1  c. milk
1/2  c. water or chicken broth
2  c. minute rice
preparation: Cook broccoli until partly tender; sauté onion in margarine. Combine all ingredients and pour into buttered 9 x 13 x 2 inch baking pan (or similar size casserole).  Bake 350 for 1 hour. Serves 10 or more.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
1  egg
1/4  c. chopped onions
1  pkg. saltine crackers
1/2  c. catsup or tomato sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Mold to desired shape and place in baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Remove from oven and glaze top of loaf with catsup.  Bake an additional 20-30 minutes.

name: OLD SOUTHERN SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. dark molasses
1  c. mustard
2  c. vinegar
2  c. water
4  Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Cook on low heat until thick.

name: RICE CUSTARD PUDDING
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
1  qt. milk, scalded
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. raisins
2  c. cooked rice
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Combine first 3 ingredients. Stir in scalded milk. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into a 2-quart baking dish. Set dish in a pan of hot water 1-inch deep. Bake 45 to 50 minutes.

name: GOOF BALLS
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
4  c. chopped nuts
2  boxes powdered sugar
1  can condensed milk
1 (7 oz.)  can coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
2  pkg. chocolate chips
1  block paraffin
preparation: Melt oleo and pour over chopped nuts.  Add 2 boxes sifted powdered sugar, condensed milk, coconut and vanilla.  Mix all together.  Roll into small balls and put in refrigerator 15 minutes.  Melt 2 packages of chocolate chips and paraffin.  Dip balls into chocolate mixture and cool.

name: MICE COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  cup butter or margarine, softened
1/2  cup smooth peanut butter
1  cup firmly packed brown sugar
1  egg
1  teaspoon vanilla extract
2  1/2 cups all-purpose flour
1/3  cup peanuts
Red shoestring licorice
Black coarse decorating sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. In a large bowl, cream butter, peanut butter, and brown sugar until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla; beat until smooth. Add flour to creamed mixture; stir until a soft dough forms. Shape dough into 1- inch balls. Pinch each ball to form a nose. Decorate each cookie using peanut halves for ears, small pieces of licorice for eyes, and a sugar crystal for nose. Use a toothpick to poke a hole in back of each cookie for tail. Transfer to an ungreased baking sheet. Bake 10 - 12 minutes or until bottoms are lightly browned. Transfer cookies to a wire rack. While cookies are warm, insert 2 inch long pieces of licorice into holes for tails. Cool completely. Store in an airtight container. Makes about 4  1/2 dozen mice.

name: CRUNCHY FUDGE SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. (1 c.) butterscotch chips
1/2  c. peanut butter
4  c. Rice Krispies
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. (1 c.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  c. sifted confectioners sugar
2  Tbsp. softened butter
1  Tbsp. water
preparation: Melt butterscotch chips and peanut butter over very low heat, stirring constantly until smooth.  Stir in cereal.  Press half the mixture into buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.  Chill.  Set remaining mixture aside.  Melt chocolate chips, sugar, butter and water in double boiler (over hot, not boiling, water).  Stir constantly until smooth.  Spread over chilled cereal mixture.  Spread remaining cereal mixture evenly over top, pressing it in gently. Chill until firm (approximately 1 hour).

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. celery
1  c. green peppers
1  oz. mushrooms
1  c. onions
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  pkg. Vermicelli
1  c. cheddar cheese
4  chicken breast boiled
preparation: Sauté celery, green peppers, mushrooms, and onions in butter. Cook chicken and save broth. Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Cook noodles in broth. Drain. Layer noodles, chicken, and other ingredients. Save 1/2 c. cheese for top. Bake 35 minutes at 350.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 large  can fruit cocktail, undrained
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
2 1/2  c. plain flour
preparation: Put eggs in bowl, beat until light.  Add flour, sugar, salt and soda, all sifted together.  Add fruit cocktail, spread 1/4 cup brown sugar and a few crushed pecans on top of batter.  Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes.  Do not grease pan.

name: YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. hot water
5  Tbsp. shortening
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg, beaten
1  pkg. yeast
2  Tbsp. warm water
3  c. plain flour
preparation: Pour boiling water over shortening, sugar and salt.  Blend and let cool.  Add egg.  Sprinkle yeast on warm water until dissolved. Add egg; mix.  Gradually add flour, blending well.  Place in a large covered container in refrigerator overnight.  Use dough as you need to.  It will keep several days in refrigerator.  When ready to use, roll out dough on a floured waxed paper, small amount at a time.  Cut with biscuit cutter; brush with melted butter.  Cover and let rise until doubled.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  boxes jello
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
1  can crushed pineapple
Dream Whip
preparation: Put jello, water and strawberries in bowl; stir until strawberries are thawed and jello begins to thicken.  Add pineapple.  Pour half in dish.  Spread Dream Whip on first mixture.  Add rest of jello mixture and chill.  Best to prepare the day before needed and chill overnight.

name: KICKLACH
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. poppy seeds (optional)
preparation: Beat eggs until light, then beat in oil, sugar, flour and salt. Beat until very smooth.  Stir in poppy seeds, if you desire.

name: BLUEBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. orange juice
1  egg
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. fresh blueberries
1/4  c. boiling water
3  tsp. grated orange rind
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: In saucepan, melt butter in boiling water.  Add orange juice and ring.  In bowl, beat egg well.  Add sugar and beat until fluffy.  Sift flour, baking powder, soda and salt together.  Add to egg and sugar alternately with juice, rind and butter combination.  Fold in blueberries.  Bake in paper lined 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Remove from pan.  While still hot, spoon glaze over top of loaf and immediately wrap in foil until cold.

name: BAKED LIMA BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. large dried lima beans, soaked overnight
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  onion
1  c. molasses
1  c. hot water
1/2  tsp. salt
6  slices bacon
preparation: Soak beans overnight and rinse.  Cover with cold water and bring to a boil.  Boil 5 to 7 minutes.  Use large casserole or bean pot.  Place 1/2 onion in bottom.  Put in beans, bacon (rolled and placed in the beans), then mix remaining ingredients to cover beans (add water if needed).  Place strips of bacon on top; cover with catsup and bake at least 2 hours at 300°.  Add water if beans become dry.  Can be baked longer.

name: TORTILLA APPETIZERS
ingredients:
2  (6-inch) soft tortilla shells
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 small  can green chilies
1 small  jar green or black pitted olives
preparation: Mix green chilies and chopped olives into cream cheese. Spread onto tortilla shells.  Roll up shells and refrigerate approximately 3 hours.  Cut into 1/2 to 1-inch slices and serve.

name: FLAVORED TEA MIX
ingredients:
1  c. unsweetened powdered tea
1 small  box flavored gelatin (peach, raspberry)
2  c. sugar
preparation: Combine all ingredients well.  Store in airtight container. To drink, mix 2 teaspoons of tea mix into 8 ounces of hot water. Serve warm or iced.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, cut up and drained
1  to 1 1/2 tomatoes, cut up
1/2  lb. sharp cheese, grated
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1  bag tortilla chips, broken up
1  bottle Catalina dressing
preparation: Mix taco seasoning with 1/4 cup water to with drained beef. While browning beef, cut up lettuce, tomatoes and grated cheese. Toss together in glass bowl. Add beef and broken chips and toss. Put desired amount in salad bowls and pour in dressing.  Enjoy.

name: CHICKEN DRESSING
ingredients:
1  whole chicken, boiled and boned (save broth)
1  pan corn bread, precooked
1  onion, diced
2  celery stalks, diced
2  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
2 to 3  Tbsp. ground sage
1  cube chicken bouillon
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Break up corn bread into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Slowly start adding chicken broth with bouillon cube dissolved in it.  Once the corn bread is moist, add onion, celery, eggs, 2 tablespoons of sage (add more, if desired) and salt and pepper to taste.  You know the corn bread is mixed just right when it is easy to fold. Too much moisture will make it soggy.  Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350° or until top is golden brown.  Add broth every 30 minutes to keep it moist.

name: ADAM'S FRUIT COCKTAIL
ingredients:
1  can mixed fruit
Cool Whip
preparation: Put fruit in a bowl.  Put 3 spoonfuls of whipped cream and stir until it is stirred enough.  After, you'll have your homemade fruit cocktail.  Makes one serving.

name: SOURDOUGH BREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. potato flakes (instant)
1/4  tsp. yeast
1  c. warm water
1 1/2  c. warm water
1/2  c. corn oil
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. sugar
6  c. bread flour (no substitute)
preparation: After you have mixed and kneaded, place in a large greased bowl and let rise most of the day, then punch down and divide into 3 parts and shape into loaves.  Place in greased pans and let rise overnight.  The next morning, preheat oven to 375° and let bake 10 minutes.  Reduce to 350°.  Bake until done (usually 25 to 30 minutes).  Turn out on racks to cool.

name: TAFFY APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1  graham cracker pie crust
1  large apple
1  pkg. nut topping
preparation: Boil unopened can of condensed milk in a large pan of water for 5 hours.  Make sure the can is always submerged.  In graham cracker crust, slice apple with skin.  Pour taffy from condensed milk over apple slices.  Sprinkle with chopped nut topping.

name: MILKY WAY CAKE
ingredients:
8  Milky Way (regular size) candy bars
2  sticks oleo
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/4  c. buttermilk
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt candy bars with 1 stick oleo.  In separate bowl, cream together sugar and 1 stick oleo.  Add alternately flour, baking soda and buttermilk to creamed mixture.  Mix well.  Stir in melted candy mixture.  Add nuts.  Pour mixture into a greased 10-inch tube pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done.

name: SOFT PRETZELS
ingredients:
2  pkg. yeast
1 1/2  c. warm water
1/2  tsp. salt
4 1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. cold water
2  tsp. soda
preparation: Dissolve  yeast in warm water.	Meanwhile dissolve soda in cold water.  Put  mixtures	together,  then  add  salt  and flour. Mix dough.  Knead.  Let  rise  15 minutes.  Shape into pretzels. Makes 10 good size	pretzels.  Bake  at 450° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: DORA'S BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  boxes (10 oz. each) frozen chopped broccoli
6  hard-boiled eggs
1  c. stuffed olives, sliced
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  can (6 oz.) water chestnuts, sliced thin
1/2 to 3/4  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Broccoli may be cooked, if desired, but will be crisper if just thawed and drained well.  Mix lightly with other ingredients.  If broccoli is raw, the flavors mix best if refrigerated several hours.

name: PRALINES
ingredients:
2  c. white sugar
3/4  c. Pet milk
2/3  c. boiling water
1/3  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  tsp. soda
2  c. pecans
preparation: Bring to a  boil  sugar,  milk, boiling water and white Karo syrup in a very large saucepan.  Add soda;	bring to boil again. Add pecans.  Stir  constantly, continuing to firm ball stage. Remove from heat  and beat until it thickens and loses shiny gloss.

name: ONNA'S TACO DIP
ingredients:
2  pkg. cream cheese
8  oz. avocado dip
8  oz. sour cream
your favorite cheese (Cheddar or Colby will do or whatever)
green onions
black olives
tomatoes
tostados
jalapeno peppers
preparation: Mix together the first 3 items with peppers.  Add peppers to taste, the more peppers, the hotter it is.  Spread mixture in the bottom of a 9-inch pie pan.  Top with grated cheese, chopped green onions, sliced black olives and chopped tomatoes.  Dip with tostados.  Eat and enjoy.

name: MARINATED SLAW
ingredients:
3 medium onions,  slice and pull rings apart
2  lb. cabbage, grated
3/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. mustard seed
1  tsp. celery seed
1  c. vinegar
2  tsp. sugar
3/4  c. oil
preparation: Place cabbage and onions in large bowl.  Pour sugar over this. Mix in saucepan the next 6 ingredients.  Bring this to a boil and pour over cabbage.  Cover and marinate overnight.  Drain marinade from cabbage before serving.  Serve cold.  Serves 12.

name: ITALIAN CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
5  egg yolks
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1 small  can Angel Flake coconut
1  c. chopped nuts
5  egg whites, stiffly beaten
bananas
cream cheese
preparation: Cream margarine and shortening.  Add sugar and beat until mixture is smooth.  Add egg yolks and beat well.  Combine flour and soda and add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla extract.  Add coconut and nuts.   Fold in egg whites.  Pour batter into three 9-inch or four 8-inch greased and floured cake pans.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until cake tests done.  Cool.  Frost with cream cheese frosting.  Place sliced bananas between layers with the frosting.

name: BUFFALO BILLS ONION
ingredients:
6  (1 lb.) Vidalia or other sweet onions, cut in 1/2 crosswise
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
lettuce leaves
preparation: Cut 12 (12-inch) squares of heavy duty aluminum foil.  Place an onion, cut side up, in center of each.  Dot each onion with margarine; sprinkle with cheese, salt and pepper.  Wrap well; place on a baking sheet.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until tender.  Serve on lettuce leaves, if desired (onions can also be grilled).

name: DILL PICKLES
ingredients:
64  oz. kosher dill pickles, drained
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1 1/2  tsp. pickling spice
preparation: Stir sugar and vinegar through cut up pickles, making sure all sugar is wet.  Add pickling spice and let sit, stirring every 15 minutes.  Let soak good in the syrup.  Add to jar.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. butter
2  c. brown sugar
6  eggs, slightly beaten
3  c. peanut butter
4 1/2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
3  c. granulated sugar
1  Tbsp. soda
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream the butter, vanilla and sugar.  Add slightly beaten eggs, then add peanut butter, flour, salt and soda.  Mix well. Shape into 2-inch cookies and place on cookie sheet.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.  Makes 100 cookies.

name: KARL'S POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. pkg. hash browns, thawed
1  cube margarine, softened
1  can cream of chicken soup
8  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
1  pt. sour cream
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. Lawry's seasoning salt
2  c. corn flakes
preparation: Mix all ingredients except 1/2 cube of margarine and corn flakes.  Pour mixture into rectangular pan.  Pour 1/2 cube margarine (melted) over the corn flakes.  Place the corn flake mixture over the potatoes.  Bake at 350° for one hour, uncovered.

name: WHOLE WHEAT CRANBERRY BRAN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. whole wheat flour
1/2  c. all-bran or crushed bran cereal with raisins
3/4  c. light brown sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. cranberries, chopped
1/4  c. granulated sugar
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. orange juice
1/2  c. melted margarine or vegetable oil
preparation: Combine flours, bran cereal, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda and nuts; mix well.  Combine cranberries and granulated sugar.  Stir sugared cranberries, egg, milk, orange juice and margarine into flour mixture all at once, but only until mixed.  Pour into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Bake in oven for 60 to 70 minutes, or until firm in center.  Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove to rack and cool on long side before slicing.  Freezes well.  Makes 1 loaf.

name: CRAB SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
1/4  c. Zesty Italian dressing
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
2  c. rainbow noodles
1 1/2  c. imitation crab meat (8 oz. pkg.)
1  c. broccoli, partially cooked
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. chopped tomato
1/4  c. table onions, cut up
preparation: Mix and let stand in refrigerator.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans fried Chinese noodles
2  cans tuna (7 oz.)
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  c. celery, chopped
2  c. onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. almond nuts
preparation: Mix tuna, soup, water, soy sauce, onion and celery.  Place 1/2 fried noodles on bottom of casserole pan; add tuna mixture.  Top with balance of noodles.  Sprinkle nuts on top.  Bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven.  Serves 4.

name: GARY'S POTATO CANDY
ingredients:
1  medium potato
powdered sugar
peanut butter (creamy)
preparation: Peel and boil potato.  When soft, remove and place in mixing bowl.  Mash potato.  After mashed, add powdered sugar to make dough.  Once you have a stiff dough, sprinkle powdered sugar onto flat surface and roll out dough to about 1/4-inch thick.  Cover top with peanut butter.  Roll up like a jelly roll.  When drier, slice roll.

name: DISGUSTINGLY RICH BROWNIES(These Are Only For People Who've Been Really Good Recently)
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
3/4  c. cocoa
1 1/4  c. flour (1 1/2 c. high altitude)
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2  cubes butter (1 c.)
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped walnuts (optional)
shortening (to grease pan)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°, then smear 9 x 13-inch baking pan with shortening.  Melt butter over low heat.  In mixing bowl, stir cocoa and sugar together.  Then stir in the melted butter.  Add the eggs and vanilla and stir again.  Now, add the flour and salt and mix just until smooth, not too much.  (Add nuts at this time if you want.)  Scrape mixture into greased pan and spread out in an even layer.  Bake in a 350° oven until the brownies just begin to pull away from the sides, about 20 to 30 minutes.  The hardest part: Let cool for a while before cutting.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts or 2 whole fryers, cooked (reserve broth)
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1 small  can evaporated milk
2 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  stick margarine
1  bag Pepperidge Farm seasoning mix
preparation: In  long, buttered casserole (13 x 9-inches), layer the following:  Place  chicken (deboned).  In saucepan, heat soups and milk.  Pour this mixture over chicken breasts.  In saucepan, heat  broth,  margarine  and  seasoning  mix.  Pour over casserole.  Heat at 325° for 15 minutes or until bubbly.

name: GREEN CHILI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. (10 to 12) flour tortillas
1  can evaporated milk
1  can cream of chicken soup
6  oz. can green chilies
1  lb. ground meat (beef or pork)
chopped onion to taste
1/2  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Saute meat and onion; drain.  Combine soup, chilies and evaporated milk.  Cut tortillas to bite size chunks.  Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Beginning with tortillas, layer tortillas, meat, soup and cheese.  Repeat 3 or 4 times.  End with cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, until hot and bubbly.  Double or triple recipe.  Great for a crowd.  Prepare ahead.

name: CHEESY POTATOES II
ingredients:
2  lb. bag frozen hash browns
1/4  lb. margarine
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
2  c. milk
4  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Thaw potatoes.  Heat Velveeta, margarine and milk until melted.  Pour over potatoes.  Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top. Bake uncovered at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PLUM SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour, sifted
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. Crisco oil
4  eggs
2 small  jars baby food (strained plums)
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Pour  into  a  tube  pan and bake for one hour at 350°.

name: PISTACHIO DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Mix together and pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Cool.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake, baked (from cake mix)
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  large vanilla instant pudding mix, prepared
3  bananas, sliced
1  (16 oz.) large Cool Whip topping
1  can cherry pie filling
1/2 to 1  c. nuts
1  c. coconut, shredded (optional)
1 small  jar maraschino cherries (optional)
1  punch bowl
preparation: Bake cake according to package.  Crumble into pieces and place in punch bowl.  Pour pineapple, with part of the juice reserved, over the cake.  Prepare vanilla pudding mix and add the bananas. Pour over the cake mixture, then on top of pudding, pour the cherry pie filling.  Top with Cool Whip.  Cover and chill.  Add nuts, coconut and cherries on top before serving.

name: NO BAKE OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  Cups Sugar
1/2  cup Powdered Cocoa
1/2  Cup Milk
1/2  Cup Margarine
1/2  Cup Peanut Butter
1/2  Cup Coconut
1/2  Tsp. Vanilla
preparation: In large saucepan, mix sugar, cocoa, milk and margarine. Bring to a boil; let boil for 1 minute.  Remove from heat and blend in remaining ingredients.  Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper and let set.

name: PEANUT SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1/4  c. chopped celery
1  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. minced onion
1  c. creamy peanut butter
4  c. beef bouillon
1/2  c. chopped peanuts
preparation: In top of double boiler, melt margarine.  Add onion and celery.  Saute until tender.  Place over boiling water.  Add creamy peanut butter and flour; blend well.  Stir in beef bouillon and lemon juice.  Cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. When serving, garnish with chopped peanuts.

name: BRISKET
ingredients:
1  (5 lb.) brisket
3  Tbsp. liquid smoke
3  tsp. garlic salt
2  tsp. onion salt
2  tsp. celery salt
pepper
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix liquid smoke, garlic, onion and celery salts into a paste. Rub on meat.  Wrap in foil and marinate in refrigerator overnight.

name: HONEY BUN CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
4  eggs
3/4  c. oil
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.  Pour 1/2 of batter into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix filling.

name: GARLIC NEW POTATOES
ingredients:
18  new potatoes
2  garlic cloves, minced
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
1  Tbsp. parsley
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook potatoes, covered, in boiling water (salted) about 15 minutes until tender; drain.  Saute garlic in butter until tender. Add parsley and pepper to skillet; pour over potatoes, toss to coat.

name: SALMON LOG
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can salmon
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. grated onion
1  tsp. horseradish
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Drain salmon.  Add remaining ingredients. Roll in nuts. Refrigerate.

name: BROCCOLI ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. young broccoli spears, frozen in butter sauce
1 (5 oz.)  pkg. refrigerated buttermilk biscuits
1 (6 3/4 oz.)  can chunked and ground ham
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. prepared mustard
3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese
1 (2 1/2 oz.)  jar sliced mushrooms, drained
preparation: Prepare broccoli according to package directions.  Snip corner of pouch and drain butter sauce into a small saucepan.  On floured surface, roll each biscuit into a 5-inch circle.  Divide broccoli into 10 spears.  Arrange 2 spears on center of each biscuit and top with ham.  Fold biscuits sides over broccoli and ham and pinch to seal.  Place biscuits, seam side up, on an ungreased cookie sheet.   Bake in preheated 375° oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.  Prepare cheese sauce.  Stir flour and mustard into butter sauce until thickened and smooth.  Stir in cheese and mushrooms and cook, stirring, until cheese is melted.  Serve roll-ups with sauce.  Makes 3 to 4 servings.

name: SAVORY CHICKEN CRESCENTS
ingredients:
3  oz. cream cheese
3  Tbsp. melted butter
2  c. cooked cubed chicken
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. onions
1 (8 oz.)  can crescent rolls
3/4  c. crushed croutons or bread crumbs (Italian)
preparation: Blend cream cheese with butter until smooth.  Mix in next 6 ingredients.  Separate crescent dough into 4 rectangles.  Spoon 1/2 cup mixture onto dough; pull up 4 corners together and twist the dough.  Brush with melted butter and sprinkle crumbs on top (crumbs also can be put into mixture).
