Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: PUMPKIN CHEESECAKE DESSERT
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. pound cake mix
3  eggs (divided)
2  Tbsp. pumpkin pie spice (divided)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
1(14 oz.) can sweetened condensed milk
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped walnuts
whipped cream (optional)
preparation: In small mixing bowl, combine cake mix, 1 egg, butter and 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice.  Beat on low until mixture is crumbly. Press into bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking pan, set aside.  In a large mixing bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy.  Add milk, 2 eggs, rest of pumpkin pie spice, cinnamon and salt.  Mix. Pour onto crust.  Sprinkle with nuts.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until set.  Cool, refrigerate until ready to serve.  Cut and top with whipped cream.  Makes 12 to 15 servings.

name: FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  whole chicken, cut up
flour
salt and pepper
1/4  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. Italian seasoning
preparation: Mix flour and seasonings together.  Roll chicken pieces in flour mixture.  Fry in Crisco oil until done.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE(Microwave for 18 minutes.)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1 (16 oz.)  can cut green beans, drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed tomato soup
4  servings instant mashed potatoes
1/2  c. (2 oz.) shredded process American cheese
1  beaten egg
preparation: In 1 1/2-quart casserole, crumble beef; add onion.  Cook at High for 5 minutes, stirring 3 times.  Drain off excess fat.  Add salt and pepper. Stir in beans and soup.  Set aside.

name: MOCK APPLE PIE
ingredients:
2  crust (9-inch) pie
36  Ritz crackers (1 stack)
2  c. water
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cream of tartar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice (fresh lemons)
zest of lemon (grated rind of 1 lemon)
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Prepare pastry for two crust pie.  Line bottom of 9-inch pie plate with pie pastry.  Coarsely crumble Ritz crackers on pastry. Combine and boil the water, sugar and cream of tartar.  Boil 15 minutes, gently.  Add lemon juice and zest.  Cool.  Pour over crackers and dot generously with butter.  Sprinkle with cinnamon.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
8  medium potatoes, peeled and cubed
1  medium onion
2  carrots
3  or 4 stalks celery, chopped
1  tsp. salt
4  chicken bouillon cubes
1  stick oleo
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
pepper to taste
preparation: Combine vegetables, salt and 6 cups water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil.  Add bouillon cubes.  Simmer until veggies are tender.  Add oleo and milk.  Bring to a boil.  Season with pepper.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
3/4  c. quick-cooking rolled oats
1  egg
1  c. milk
1  small onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/4  tsp. rubbed sage
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Spread in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan (shape into a loaf).  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked potatoes, mashed
1/2  c. oleo
1/3  c. milk
2  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. light brown sugar
1/3  c. butter
1/3  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
milk
preparation: Mix together sugar, butter, flour and nuts and use enough milk to help make it spread.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

name: OREO DELIGHT
ingredients:
2  gal. vanilla ice cream
1  large Cool Whip
26  crushed Oreo cookies
preparation: Let ice cream soften, then mix all together.  Put in freezer until ready to serve, then cut into little squares.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  box strawberry jello
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. water
1  c. sugar
2  drops lemon juice
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  qt. strawberries (if fresh, sugar them and let it soak)
1  pie crust shell (graham cracker)
preparation: Mix everything except strawberries together in a pan.  Heat over medium heat until it starts to boil.  Boil 1 minute.  Remove from stove and cool.  When cool, mix in berries and place in pie crust shell.  Put in refrigerator until jello thickens.  Before eating, cover with whip cream.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE BAKE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped frozen broccoli
1  c. uncooked Minute rice
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
1/2  can water
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  medium onion
1  stick margarine
preparation: Saute onion in margarine.   Add to all other ingredients in a large bowl.   Mix well.    Add salt and pepper to taste.   Grease 9 x 13-inch baking dish.   Put mixture in dish.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, uncovered.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: SANDY'S SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1  small container sour cream
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  small bundle green onions
1  can baby shrimp
1  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. Tabasco sauce
few chopped olives (optional)
preparation: Chop the green onions and the baby shrimp real fine.  Mix the remaining ingredients with the onions and shrimp and chill.  This dip is real good served with Fritos.

name: SALMON CROQUETTES
ingredients:
1  can pink salmon
1 1/2  Tbsp. minced onion
1 1/2  c. Progresso Italian bread crumbs
1  egg
salt and pepper to taste
vegetable oil
preparation: Combine salmon, onion, bread crumbs, egg, salt and pepper. Heat oil in a large skillet (approximately 1/4 inch deep).   Form patties and cover outside in additional bread crumbs.   Fry in oil, turning once, until golden brown.

name: TACO SAUCE
ingredients:
12  medium tomatoes, chopped
1  to 1 1/2 green peppers, chopped
1  garlic clove, mashed
1  tsp. (heaping) sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1  tsp. cumin
salt to taste
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Heat to desired thickness and can at 10 pounds pressure for 5 minutes.

name: PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
1/2  c. salt
1  c. flour
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. water
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
food coloring
preparation: Mix salt, flour and cream of tartar in a medium saucepan.  Add vegetable oil and water.  (Add several drops of food coloring to water for colored play dough.)  Cook over medium heat until thickened and play dough pulls away from the sides of the pan.

name: TONY'S EASY FROSTING
ingredients:
1  lb. powdered sugar
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
3 heaping  Tbsp. cocoa
1/3  c. milk
preparation: Melt margarine. Add sugar, vanilla and cocoa. Add milk small amounts at a time until smooth.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. shortening
2  eggs
3  Tbsp. buttermilk
1  c. mashed bananas
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix sugar.  Add shortening well.  Add eggs.  Stir in buttermilk and add bananas.  Sift together dry ingredients.   Stir into sugar mixture.  Blend in nuts.  Pour into well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Let stand 20 minutes before baking.  Bake at 350° until it is done.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  chicken, boiled
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1 1/2  sticks margarine
1  stack Ritz crackers
1 large  pkg. egg noodles
preparation: Boil and bone chicken.  Blend 3 cups chicken broth with cream of chicken soup and sour cream.  Bring to a boil.  Add egg noodles to remainder of chicken broth; cook until tender.  Drain noodles and pour into long pan.  Top with boned chicken.  Pour soup mixture over noodles and chicken.   Crumble Ritz crackers on top of soup.  Melt margarine and spoon over the cracker crumbs.  Bake 20 to 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: FROZEN STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. (10 oz.) frozen strawberries, partially thawed
1/2  c. sugar
1  unbeaten egg white
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. whipping cream
preparation: Combine in large mixing bowl the strawberries, sugar, egg white and lemon juice.  Beat with electric mixer at highest speed until soft mounds form, about 5 to 8 minutes.  In another bowl, beat the whipping cream until thick.  Fold into strawberry mixture by hand.  Spoon into baked shell.  Sprinkle with crumbs.  Freeze until firm, 4 to 6 hours.  Cover.

name: CHICKEN LIVERS
ingredients:
6  slices bacon
1  can mushroom stems and pieces, drained
1/2  c. chopped green onions
1  lb. chicken livers
1/2  c. cooking wine
1/2  c. water
1  beef flavored bouillon cube
hot cooked rice
preparation: Cook bacon in large skillet until crisp.  Remove bacon, reserve drippings in skillet.  Crumble bacon and set aside; keep warm.  Add livers to skillet and saute 12 to 15 minutes or until tender.  Add reserved bacon, mushrooms, green onions, wine, water and bouillon cube.  Cook 5 minutes or until bouillon cube is dissolved and mixture is heated, stirring occasionally.  Serve over rice.  Serves 4.

name: STRAWBERRY PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2-2/3  c. crushed pretzel nuggets
3/4  c. butter
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
9  oz. Cool Whip
1  large strawberry jello
2  c. boiling water
1  c. cold water (use juice from pineapple then fill to make 1 cup)
1 small  box frozen strawberries
1 small  can crushed pineapple (reserve juice)
2  mashed bananas
preparation: Crush pretzel nuggets; do not overly crush, keep them in small chunks.  Mix pretzels and butter together; pat in bottom of a 9x13 inch pan.  Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes; let cool.

name: TACO SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dry dressing mix
1  can pinto beans
1  can hominy
1  can kidney beans with juice
1  can green chilies
2  cans stewed tomatoes
preparation: Brown beef and onion; drain well.  Combine all ingredients together and simmer until done.  May be served with grated cheese and sour cream.  Serve with taco chips.  Will freeze well.

name: Low Cholesterol Pumpkin Pie
ingredients:
Egg Beaters equivalent to 2 eggs
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. cloves
1 2/3  c. (13 oz.) evaporated skim milk
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
preparation: Mix filling ingredients in order given.  Pour into pie shell. Bake in 425° oven for 15 minutes.  Reduce temperature to 350° and continue baking 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center of filling comes out clear.  Cool.   (If using frozen pie shells, this recipe fills 2 shells.)

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
2  c. graham crackers
1/4  c. melted butter
1/4  c. sugar
10  oz. pkg. large marshmallows
8  oz. carton whipped topping
2  pt. strawberries
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Make your graham cracker crust with the top three ingredients and put on the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Cook until melted the milk and marshmallows.  Cool, then add strawberries and whipped topping.  Fold in and pour into the graham cracker crust.

name: PATTI JACUZZI'S POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
5  lb. potatoes
10  boiled eggs
1  medium red onion
2  lb. cottage cheese
2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. mustard
3/4  c. Durkee
3  c. mayonnaise
1 1/2  Tbsp. celery seed
preparation: Cube and boil potatoes in salted water until done.  Drain. Add chopped eggs, onion, cottage cheese, salt, mustard, Durkee, mayonnaise and celery seed.  Mix well.  Refrigerate until well chilled.  Even better the next day.

name: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. Oleo (melted)
2  Tbsp. Sugar
Salt to taste
1/2  tsp. Pepper
2  Eggs (beaten)
1 1/2  c. Canned Milk
3/4  c. Graham Crackers (crushed, about 8)
1  can Creamed Corn
1/4  c. Chopped Onions
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

name: SURPRISE BROWNIE ROUNDS
ingredients:
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. confectioners' sugar
1 (11 oz.)  box pie crust mix
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs
preparation: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  In a small bowl, combine the peanut butter and confectioners' sugar. Blend well and then roll into small balls (about 1/2 inch in diameter).  Place in freezer. In a large mixing bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Drop from tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheet, spacing cookies about 2 inches apart.  Press a peanut butter ball into center of each chocolate mound.  With slightly wet fingers, pull the chocolate dough over the peanut butter ball forming a peak.  Cookies will look like little teepees.  They will flatten slightly while baking.  Some might have a little raised mound in the center and others might flatten more.  Bake for 12 to 15 minutes.  Remove from baking sheet immediately and place on rack to cool.  Makes 22 to 24 cookies

name: HERSHEY'S VANILLA CHIP FRUIT TART(Makes 10 to 12 Servings)
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
Vanilla Filling
Fruit Topping
preparation: Heat oven to 300°.  Beat butter and confectioners sugar until light and fluffy.  Blend in flour.  Press mixture onto bottom and up side of a 12-inch round pizza pan.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned.  Cool completely.  Prepare Vanilla Filling. Spread on cooled crust.  Cover.  Chill.  Prepare Fruit Topping. Cover.  Chill assembled tart.

name: CHICKEN FRICASSEE
ingredients:
3 1/2  lb. chicken cut into eight parts
1/2  lb. white onions, peeled and trimmed
1  stick (4 oz.) melted butter
3/4  c. peanut butter
mushrooms, quartered
3/4  bottle dry white wine
2  c. cream
preparation: Melt the butter in a large, fairly deep sauté pan.  Add chicken pieces, cut into 8 parts, onions and cook very gently until each one slightly colored.  Add mushrooms, pour in the wine, cover and simmer over gentle heat until chicken is done; about 35 to 40 minutes.  Remove the chicken, onions and mushrooms with a slotted spoon and transfer to a heated serving platter; cover and keep warm.  Make the sauce by reducing the cooking juices by half over moderately high heat.  Add the cream and boil hard for about 5 minutes.  Taste the sauce and season with salt and pepper if necessary.  Pour the sauce over the chicken, mushrooms, and onions. Serves 4.

name: CREAMY ROQUEFORT DRESSING
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. each: vinegar and olive oil
1/4  c. Roquefort cheese
2 1/2  Tbsp. cream cheese
1/8  tsp. salt
2/3  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Beat until smooth the vinegar and oil.  Add Roquefort cheese, cream cheese and salt.  Blend in mayonnaise.

name: BREAKFAST SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. pkg. sausage
8  oz. cream cheese
2  pkg. crescent rolls
preparation: Brown sausage; drain.  Mix with cream cheese.  In 9 x 13-inch pan, place 1 package rolls on bottom; top with "goop".  Place second package of rolls on top.  Bake at crescent roll package directions until brown.  "Great with omelets."

name: DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour, sifted
1/2  tsp. sugar
1  c. sweet milk
1/4  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Drop in greased muffin tins and cook 12 minutes at 450°.

name: EASY LOW-FAT CHILI
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped
1/4  c. green pepper, chopped
4  c. water, divided
1 (15 oz.)  can Great Northern beans, rinsed and drained
1 (6 oz.)  can salt free tomato paste
1  (14 1/2 oz.) low-salt diced tomatoes (undrained)
2 to 4  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt (optional)
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 (15 oz.)  can Navy beans, rinsed and drained
preparation: In a large saucepan, cook onion and green pepper in half cup water until tender.  Add beans, tomato paste and tomatoes. Stir in chili powder, salt (if desired), pepper and remaining water; bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.  Yields 7 servings.  Diabetic exchanges:  One 1 cup serving prepared without added salt equals 2 starch and 1 1/2 vegetables.

name: TOMATO SALSA
ingredients:
1  box tomatoes, wash, peel and chop
5  lb. chopped onions
4  large green peppers, chopped
3  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
2  cayenne peppers, chopped
6  jalapeno peppers, chopped
1/4  c. salt
2 large  cans tomato sauce
2  tsp. cilantro, chopped (optional)
preparation: Let all ingredients come to a boil; cook about 1 hour.  Stir occasionally.  Put in hot jars and seal.  Yield: About 25 pints.

name: COFFEE CAN BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/2  c. warm water
1/8  tsp. ginger
3  Tbsp. sugar
1 (12 oz.)  can skim evaporated milk
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. salt
4 to 5  c. flour
1 1/4  c. very warm milk
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. softened sweet butter or margarine
1  tsp. salt
2  envelopes active dry yeast
1  tsp. sugar
3  eggs, well beaten
5 to 6  c. unsifted all-purpose flour
uncooked eggs in shell
1  egg
1  Tbsp. water (optional:  can substitute 1/2 Tbsp. water and 1/2 Tbsp.  Marsala wine or sherry in place of 1 Tbsp.  water)
preparation: Combine 1 cup of very warm milk, 1 cup sugar, butter and salt in a large bowl.  Stir until most of butter is melted.   Sprinkle yeast and the 1 teaspoon sugar into the remaining milk in a 1 cup measure; stir to dissolve.  Let stand to proof until bubbly and raised to double in volume (about 15 minutes).  Stir beaten eggs and yeast mixture into butter mixture.  Beat in about 5 cups flour, one cup at a time, until a soft pliable dough is formed. Place dough onto a well floured surface and knead from 10 to 15 minutes or until smooth and stretchy.  (Only use enough flour necessary to keep dough from sticking.) Place dough in a large, buttered bowl, turning to bring buttered side up and cover with a clean dish towel.

name: BROCCOLI AND NOODLES PARMESAN
ingredients:
1  bunch broccoli
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove minced garlic
1  c. Ricotta cheese
6  c. cooked noodles
1  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cut broccoli into bite-sized pieces.  Cook in covered saucepan over medium heat for 6 minutes; drain.  Saute onion and garlic in butter until tender.  Stir in soup and seasoning; mix well.  Add Swiss and Parmesan cheese, stirring until melted.  Stir in Ricotta cheese, broccoli and cooked noodles.  Pour into casserole.  Cover and bake at 350° until bubbly.  Makes 8 servings.

name: CHICKEN PARMIGIANA
ingredients:
4  boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. Progresso Italian style bread crumbs
1/4  c. Progresso olive oil
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  jar Progresso meat flavor spaghetti sauce
1/2  c. Progresso grated Parmesan cheese
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Dip chicken into egg and then into bread crumbs, coating thoroughly.  In a medium skillet, heat olive oil.  Cook chicken in oil until done and well browned on both sides.  Pour spaghetti sauce into an 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Place chicken on sauce and top with Parmesan and Mozzarella cheese.  Bake for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly browned.  Makes 4 servings.

name: ROAST (PORK OR BEEF)
ingredients:
1  beef or pork roast
1  onion, chopped fine
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
Tony's
1/2 to 1  tsp. minced garlic (depends on size of roast)
1  to 2 potatoes, quartered (if wanted)
preparation: Add your seasoned roast to pot and brown. It will make water so don't add any now. Once the water cooks out and the roast browns real good on both sides, add onions and smother down (don't worry, they will brown too). Add small amounts of water (about 1 cup) at a time until tender. Cook on medium to low heat until done. Add potatoes when you see the roast is tender and cook until they are done.

name: POTATO AND SAUERKRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
6  c. cooked, diced potatoes
3 1/2  c. cooked, drained sauerkraut
2  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. paprika
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine potatoes, sauerkraut and eggs.  Toss lightly and chill.  Add remaining ingredients and toss lightly but thoroughly. Serve chilled.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: TURKEY TORTILLA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. chicken broth
1/4  c. chopped celery
3  c. chopped, cooked turkey or chicken
1  can cream of chicken soup
8  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
10  to 12 (6-inch) corn tortillas, torn into bite size pieces or equal amount of tortilla chips, broken
1 (4 oz.)  can diced green chilies, drained
1  tsp. pepper
1  c. chunky salsa
preparation: In 2-quart low baking dish (9 x 13-inches), cook onion, celery and broth in microwave for 2 to 3 minutes, until tender.  Stir in turkey, tortillas, chilies, soup, pepper and 6 ounces of the cheese.  Top casserole with reserved cheese and salsa.  Bake at 350° about 30 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

name: CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
6  c. water
2  chicken bouillon cubes
1/2  onion, grated
1/2  c. flour
1  lb. Velveeta cheese cubes
1  rib celery, grated
1/2  c. flour
1  small carrot, grated
1/4  c. oil
preparation: Put water, celery, onion, carrot and bouillon in saucepan and simmer until tender (about 10 minutes). Mix oil and flour together until smooth. Using wire whip, stir into cooked mixture. Add cheese and stir until all is melted. Salt and pepper to taste.

name: SOUR CREAM POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
5  lb. small red potatoes (with skins on)
2  c. chopped celery
1  sweet onion, chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. dill
preparation: In a pot on the stove top, add enough water to cover potatoes, then cook until potatoes are soft or about 50 minutes. Remove potatoes from water and let cool.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion
1 large  can evaporated milk
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 1/2  c. cheese, grated
Tater Tots
preparation: Brown ground beef and onions, then drain.  Place in 2-quart casserole dish.  Mix milk, mayo and soup together; pour over meat. Cover the top with cheese and place Tater Tots on top of cheese. Cook at 350° until golden brown.

name: OATMEAL CHOCOLATE CHIP CAKE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. boiling water
1  c. brown sugar
1  stick oleo
1 3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. uncooked oatmeal
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. cocoa
3/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Pour water over oatmeal; let stand 10 minutes.  Add sugars and oleo.  Stir until oleo melts.  Add slightly beaten eggs and then dry ingredients.  Add 1/2 package chocolate chips.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan (fluted pan).  Sprinkle nuts and remaining chocolate chips on top.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: THE BRIDLE PATH BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. thinly sliced potatoes
1  lb. spicy sausage, cooked, crumbled, drained
2  c. shredded Swiss cheese
2  c. cubed ham
6  eggs
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
Salt and pepper to taste
1  c. milk
preparation: Layer potatoes in buttered baking dish.  Top with sausage, 1 cup cheese, and ham.  Beat eggs with mustard, salt, pepper, and milk in bowl.  Pour over top layer.  Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup of cheese.  Bake at 350°  for 45 minutes.  Serve with toast or banana bread.   Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  medium bananas
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sour milk
3/4  c. chopped nuts (if desired)
preparation: Cream first 5 ingredients.  Add the rest and mix well.  Pour into greased and floured loaf pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.

name: CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. graham cracker crumbs
2  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. butter, melted
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
16  oz. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix cracker crumbs, 2 tablespoons sugar and butter.  Press in bottom of 9-inch spring pan.  Bake 10 minutes.  Reduce oven to 300°.  Beat remaining ingredients until smooth.  Pour over crumb mixture.  Bake for 1 hour or until center is firm.  Cool and refrigerate.

name: DATE NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  lb. pitted dates
1  c. chopped nuts
1  stick butter, cut
2  c. boiling water
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2  c. sugar
4  c. flour
preparation: Combine dates, nuts, soda, salt and butter with 2 cups boiling water.  Let set for 20 minutes.  Beat eggs.  Add sugar, vanilla, then flour.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes for little loaves or 1 hour and 15 minutes in Bundt pan.

name: STUFFED GRAPEVINE LEAVES(Dolmathes)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (15 oz.)  jar grapevine leaves (cabbage leaves may be substituted by boiling head of cabbage until tender)
1/2  c. butter, melted
1  c. canned tomatoes (pulp and juice)
1 1/2  c. hot water
2  medium onions, chopped
1/2  c. long grain rice
2  Tbsp. mint leaf or parsley
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients except leaves in water.  Salt and pepper to taste. In the center of each leaf, place a heaping teaspoonful of mixture.  Starting from stem, roll, turning in ends and roll tightly to avoid filling coming out.  Form into oblong rolls. Arrange in compact layers in large saucepan and place a dish over rolls to prevent breaking up when boiling.  Add water.  Bring to a boil over high flame.  Reduce heat and cook 25 minutes over medium heat.  Remove from stove and drain off broth into a separate bowl, to be used in avgolemono sauce.  Pour avgolemono sauce over rolls and let stand.  Serve hot.  Serves 5 to 6.  Avgolemono Sauce is also in this cookbook.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
3  mashed bananas (ripe)
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar.  Beat eggs; add to butter and sugar mixture.  Sift flour, soda and salt, then stir with fork. Add bananas (pulp).  Stir in pecans (chopped).  Bake in 2 greased loaf pans (5 x 9-inch) for 50 minutes at 350°.

name: PINEAPPLE-COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1  (12 oz.) cottage cheese
1  c. salad dressing
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple, drained; save juice
2  pkg. lemon jello
4  c. hot water
1  c. grated carrots
preparation: Prepare jello using reserved pineapple juice to which water has been added to make 4 cups.  Add cottage cheese, salad dressing, pineapple and carrots to almost set jello.  Chill and serve.

name: LEMON CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. milk
1  box lemon instant pudding mix
preparation: Stir cream cheese until very soft.  Gradually blend in 1/2 cup milk until smooth and creamy.  Add 1 1/2 cups milk and lemon instant pudding mix.  Beat slowly with mixer 1 minute.  Pour at once into a cooled, baked graham cracker crust.  Chill 1 hour or until firm.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can dark red kidney beans
1  pkg. taco seasoning
2  c. sharp cheese, shredded
1  large bag Doritos cheese chips, crushed in bag
3  or 4 scallions, chopped
1  head lettuce, chopped
2  or 3 medium size tomatoes, chopped
1 large  bottle Catalina dressing
preparation: In large skillet, brown meat.  Add seasoning and beans.  Allow this mixture to cool slightly, then add cheese.  In large bowl, combine lettuce, tomatoes and onions.  Add skillet ingredients; mix well.  Add dressing and crushed chips, again mixing well. Very good served with garlic bread.

name: OVERNIGHT LETTUCE SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, cut up
1/2  head cauliflower, cut up
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1  c. green pepper, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas (do not thaw)
2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. sugar
4  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
1/4 to 1/2  jar bacon bits
preparation: Layer first 6 ingredients in a dish. Spread mayonnaise on top. Sprinkle with sugar, then cheese and bacon bits. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Toss when ready to serve.

name: PARTY POTATOES
ingredients:
4  to 5 medium potatoes
1  lb. Velveeta
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. Polish sausage
1  small onion, diced
preparation: Butter an 8 x 8-inch baking dish.  Slice potatoes, sausage and onion thin then layer.  Cover with sliced or grated Velveeta. Cover with soup.  Then cover with foil and bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY SORBETTA (ICE)(Sherbet)
ingredients:
2  pt. extra ripe strawberries
3  c. sugar
2  c. water
2  lemons (juice)
preparation: Puree strawberries.  Make sugar syrup with water and sugar. Cook until clear.  Mix strawberry puree, syrup and lemon juice. Taste; may need more sugar due to tartness of lemon.  Freeze in home ice cream freezer until firm enough to hold shape.  Put in freezer.  Serve as soon as possible.   Nectar of the gods!

name: STUFFING
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped
1  stick butter
bread, cubed
sage
poultry seasoning
milk
preparation: Cook onion in skillet with butter until onion is transparent. Set aside.  Put cubed bread in a casserole bowl and sprinkle sage and poultry seasoning over top.  Mix.  (Don't overspice.)  Now, pour onions and butter over top and mix.  Pour milk over top to moisten and put in oven for 1/2 hour at 350°.

name: PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
pork chops, browned
1  box Uncle Ben's wild rice
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1/2  c. water
preparation: Add rice, tomato sauce and water to pork chops.  Cook at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: EGGPLANT AND ANGEL HAIR PASTA
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  tsp. minced garlic
1  c. onion, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
4  c. eggplant, peeled and diced
1/2  c. chicken broth
1  c. tasso, finely chopped
1 (10 oz.)  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
2  c. fresh mushrooms, sliced
preparation: In a large heavy pot, saute over high fire the garlic, onions and celery until slightly wilted.  Then add eggplant and reduce heat to medium.  Cover pot and allow the eggplant to smother. Stir occasionally.  When eggplant is very tender, add the chicken broth, tasso and tomatoes.  Cover pot again and simmer for 1 hour, stirring from time to time.  Add mushrooms and cook 5 minutes. Check for seasonings.  If tasso is highly seasoned, no other seasonings may be needed.  To cook angel hair pasta, I give this tip.  Bring 8 cups water seasoned with 1 teaspoon salt to boil in large pot.  Add 12 ounces pasta.  Turn off the fire.  Cover and let stand 6 minutes.  Drain.  Pour cool water over the pasta and allow to drain well.  Toss with a couple of tablespoons olive oil. Toss the pasta with the eggplant mixture and garnish with freshly grated Romano cheese.

name: CHICKEN FETTUCINE ALFREDO
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. margarine
2 small  cloves garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. flour
1 1/3  c. milk
2  Tbsp. cream cheese
1 1/4  c. freshly grated parmesan cheese, divided
4  c. cooked fettucini (cooked without salt)
1  tsp. chopped fresh parsley, optional
2  c. chicken, cooked
preparation: Sauté garlic in margarine, then stir in flour.  Gradually add milk, stirring with a wire whisk until blended.  Cook mixture 8 minutes or until thick.  Stir in cream cheese and cook 2 more minutes.  Add 1 cup parmesan cheese, stirring until melted.  Cook fettucini according to package directions; add chicken.  Pour the hot cheese sauce over the hot fettucini and chicken.  Toss well to coat.  Top mixture with the remaining 1/4 cup of parmesan cheese and sprinkle on some black pepper.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1/3  c. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. diced carrots
2  cloves garlic, diced
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  c. cream-style corn
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped red and green bell pepper
1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Sift together and mix thoroughly in a large bowl the first 6 ingredients.  Combine and stir into dry ingredients the rest of the ingredients only until the mixture is well moistened.  Pour into a greased 9-inch square pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool before cutting.  This is one of my family's favorites!  I have to double the recipe if I get any!

name: BROCCOLI CHICKEN BAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  c. chicken, cooked and cut up
2 (10 oz.)  boxes frozen broccoli
1/4  c. mushrooms (optional)
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can chicken broth
6  slices cheese
1  pkg. dressing, mixed according to directions on pkg.
preparation: Place chicken and broccoli in layers with dressing in 2-quart casserole.  Mix soup and broth together well.  Pour over top. Add cheese slices on top when half baked.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: GOOEY BARS
ingredients:
1  box cake mix (lemon or yellow)
1  stick margarine
3  eggs
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  box powdered sugar, reserving 2 Tbsp.
preparation: Mix cake mix, margarine and 1 egg with fork and pat into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and 2 eggs.  Pour over cake mixture and bake at 350° for 25 or 30 minutes.  When done, sprinkle with powdered sugar and chopped nuts, if desired.

name: SOUTHERN PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1  pie crust
3  eggs
1  c. dark corn syrup
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. creamy peanut butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. salted peanuts
preparation: Chill the pie crust.  Beat eggs.  Add corn syrup, sugar, peanut butter and vanilla; beat until smooth.  Stir in peanuts. Pour filling into chilled shell; bake for 15 minutes in a 400° preheated oven.  Turn heat down to 350° and bake for  30 or 35 minutes.  Let cool.

name: VIRGINIA SPOON BREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. corn meal
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. boiling water
2  eggs
1  c. sweet milk
2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix  meal,  salt and margarine;  scald with the boiling water. Add well-beaten eggs, milk and baking powder.  Bake in moderate oven  350°  in  greased  dish  for  approximately 40 minutes. Serve hot, and it loves butter.

name: CHEESE BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. sharp cheese, grated
2 1/2  c. Bisquick
1  egg
1  c. milk
poppy seed
preparation: Stir Bisquick, cheese and 1/2 teaspoon poppy seed.  Add milk and eggs.  Pour into greased loaf pan.  Sprinkle more poppy seed on top.  Bake at 350° until brown.

name: CRAB PUFFS
ingredients:
4  egg whites
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1 1/4  c. mayonnaise
8  oz. flaked crab meat
1  Tbsp. freeze dried chives
freshly ground pepper
ground red pepper
16  slices bread, well toasted (crusts trimmed) and halved diagonally
paprika (garnish)
preparation: Beat egg whites until foamy.  Add cream of tartar and continue beating until very stiff.  Combine mayonnaise, crabmeat, chives and peppers in another bowl.  Fold into whites, blending well.

name: TUNA CHOW MEIN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. cut up celery
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  can tuna
1/2 (5 1/2 oz.)  can chow mein noodles (reserve 1/4 c.)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. water
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In large skillet, cook and stir celery, onion and green pepper in butter until onion is tender.  Stir in tuna (with liquid) and remaining ingredients.  Pour into ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Sprinkle with reserved chow mein noodles.  Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: OLD-FASHIONED SWEET POTATO PIE *
ingredients:
2  c. mashed sweet potatoes
1/4  c. margarine
1/2  c. Karo syrup
1  c. white sugar
2  Tbsp. flour (scant)
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. allspice
preparation: Boil sweet potatoes, peel and mash, then add margarine, syrup, white sugar, flour and seasoning.  Bake in 9-inch crust.  Cook at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: NO COOK FONDANT
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter
1/3  c. Karo syrup
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
3 1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix with spoon, then knead by hand.  Makes 1 1/3 pounds. Store in cool place.  Shape as desired.

name: EASY MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
12  slices American cheese
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. chicken bouillon
1 1/2  tsp. dry mustard
2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. bread crumbs
preparation: Melt margarine in medium saucepan.  Stir in flour, bouillon and mustard.  Gradually stir in milk.  Cook and stir until bouillon dissolves and mixture thickens slightly.  Remove from heat.  Break 10 slices of cheese into pieces.  Stir into mixture until melted. Stir in macaroni.  Turn into 1 1/2-quart baking dish.  Top with remaining cheese slices (broken into bits).  Sprinkle with bread crumbs.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 375°.

name: CHICKEN CACCIATORE
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. olive or salad oil
1  c. coarsely chopped onions
4  garlic cloves, minced
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  tsp. allspice
2  (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) fryers, cut up
1  medium green pepper, chopped
2 (29 oz.)  cans tomatoes
1/2  c. Chianti (optional)
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. thyme leaves
2  bay leaves
preparation: About 1 1/2 hours before serving:  In 12-inch skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat in hot olive oil, cook chicken a few pieces at a time until browned on all sides; set aside chicken.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  whole chicken
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
8  oz. milk
salt and pepper to taste
sage to taste
preparation: Cook chicken.  Pull off bone.  Add chicken and all other ingredients in large bowl and mix well.  Pour into greased baking dish.  Bake at 350°  for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: BLUEBERRY/YOGURT MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  (8 oz.) low-fat vanilla yogurt
1  c. blueberries, thawed
Pam spray
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  c. orange juice
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine flour, 1/3 cup sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.  Make a well in center.  Combine orange juice, oil, vanilla and yogurt.  Stir just until moistened.  Gently fold in blueberries.  Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of sugar over 12 muffins and bake at 400° for 18 minutes.

name: CHEESE LOG
ingredients:
2  pkg. cream cheese (8 oz.)
1  can crushed pineapple (16 oz. drained)
2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. finely chopped pecans
1/4  c. dried apricots
preparation: Note:  About 1 cup to 1 1/2 cups chopped pecans for outside coating.

name: FRUIT SLUSH
ingredients:
1  (12 oz.) frozen orange juice
2  cans crushed pineapple
1 large  can mandarin oranges
2  (10 oz.) containers frozen strawberries
1/3  c. lemon juice
6  to 8 bananas, sliced or mashed
preparation: Mix together.  Put in 9-ounce hard plastic cups.  Freeze.

name: WHOLE ARTICHOKE PICKLES
ingredients:
1  peck Jerusalem artichokes
1  c. olive or cooking oil
1  pkg. mustard seed
1  pkg. celery seed
2  Tbsp. whole black peppercorns
2  tsp. turmeric
3  lb. sugar
1  gal. cider vinegar
1  or 2 red pepper pods
1/2  lb. powdered mustard
preparation: Scrub artichokes with a wire brush, cutting off any soft spots.  Soak in strong brine for 3 days. Rub dry with a rough cloth.  Pack in sterile jars.

name: VENISON MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground venison
1/2  lb. ground beef or pork
3/4  c. instant oats
1  onion, chopped
mushrooms, chopped
1  egg
1  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Shape into a loaf and place in roasting pan.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 1 hour.  Serves 4.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  c. real mayonnaise
1 1/2  tsp. dill weed
1 1/2  tsp. Beau Monde
1 1/2  tsp. dried onion flakes
preparation: Mix together thoroughly.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. fresh cranberries
1 3/4  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. water
1 large  pkg. cherry Jell-O
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1  c. Jonathan apples, chopped
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
preparation: Boil cranberries, sugar and water for 10 minutes.  Add the Jell-O; stir well.  Let cool until warm.  Add celery, apples and walnuts; mix well.  Pour into mold.  Chill until firm.  Remove from mold onto lettuce leaves.

name: MIMOSA FIDDLEHEAD GREENS SALAD
ingredients:
2  tsp. salt
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen or 1 1/2 c. fresh fiddleheads
1 large  clove garlic, chopped fine
6  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. wine vinegar
freshly ground black pepper
1  small head bibb or Boston lettuce, washed, trimmed and cut to bite size
1  small head romaine lettuce, trimmed and torn
3  or 4 chickory leaves or dandelion greens, washed and torn
1  bunch watercress, washed and stems removed
3  hard-cooked eggs, chopped finely
preparation: In heavy 2 to 3-quart saucepan, bring to boil 3/4 cup water and 1 teaspoon salt.  Drop in fiddleheads.  Reduce heat to simmer (low) and partially cover the pan.  Simmer for 2 minutes until they are barely tender and show only slight resistance when pierced with point of a skewer or small knife.  Drain in colander and run cold water over them to set their color and stop their cooking.  Then spread on paper towels and pat dry.  Place chopped garlic in large salad bowl and pour in salad oil and vinegar.

name: ZUCCHINI SOUFFLE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1 1/2  tsp. butter
1/2  onion, chopped
1  c. Bisquick
3  c. grated zucchini (don't peel)
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
4  oz. Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Mix in order.  Put in greased 9 x 9-inch pan.  Bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes.

name: EGGPLANT MARGARITA
ingredients:
1  tomato, diced
4  mushrooms, sliced
1  sweet red pepper, sliced
1/2  c. pitted black olives
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  pinch basil
1  c. tomato sauce
chicken broth
1  tsp. minced garlic
1  eggplant, peeled, sliced, breaded and fried
preparation: Put all ingredients except eggplant into a frying pan.  Bring to a boil and let simmer until sauce has thickened.  Place 1/2 teaspoon butter or margarine on sheet pan.  Lay out eggplant and top with ingredients from frying pan.  Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white Karo
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. pecans
4  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together and bake in unbaked pie shell in 350° oven for 45 minutes and 375° oven for 15 minutes.

name: INDY SLUSH
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. boiling water
5  bananas, sliced
1  qt. strawberries, sliced
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (10 oz.)  jar maraschino cherries, sliced
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen orange juice concentrate
12  oz. water
preparation: Make a syrup of sugar and boiling water; cool.  Mix all ingredients.  Freeze in containers the size that you can use all at one time.  Take out of freezer far enough ahead (4 hours for a gallon) to be a slush.  Goes equally well at a picnic or a formal dinner party.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. water
1/4  c. cornstarch
pinch of salt
red food coloring
1  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
fresh, unsweetened strawberries
1  baked, cooked pie shell
whipped cream (optional)
preparation: Combine sugar, water, cornstarch and salt.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until boiling.  Cook until clear. Remove from heat.  Add red food coloring (approximately 1/2 teaspoon) and Jell-O.  Stir well.  Let cool.  Mix sliced strawberries in Jell-O mixture and pour into pie shell.  Chill. Top with whipped cream before serving.

name: STRAWBERRY LEMONADE
ingredients:
1  gal. Country Time lemonade
1 (16 oz.)  carton frozen strawberries
preparation: Mix lemonade as directed on can and thaw frozen strawberries. Mix together.

name: Red Pepper Round Steak
ingredients:
1  (1 lb.) round steak
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  large sweet red pepper, chopped
1  beef-flavored bouillon cube
1  c. hot water
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can tomato wedges, drained
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. water
2  tsp. soy sauce
hot cooked noodles or rice
preparation: Partially freeze steak; slice diagonally across grain into 1/4-inch wide strips.  Cut strips into 2-inch pieces.  Sprinkle steak with salt and pepper.

name: MAKE-AHEAD MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
3  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  egg
1/4  c. milk
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients  thoroughly.  Shape  into  1-inch balls. Place in ungreased jelly roll pan, 15  1/2  x 10 1/2 x 1.  Bake about 10 minutes or until done.

name: MYSTERY FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
2  eggs, separated
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. sweet milk
2  c. flour (Swans Down preferred)
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. vanilla
4  sq. bitter chocolate
preparation: Blend butter and egg yolks together well.  Gradually add sugar, creaming well.  Sift baking powder and flour together.  Add flour and milk alternately.  Add melted chocolate and vanilla. Last fold in beaten egg whites.  Bake 30 minutes in 375° oven.

name: JALAPENO CORNBREAD
ingredients:
3  c. cornbread mix
2 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. oil
3  eggs, beaten
1  large onion, grated
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  can cream-style corn
1/2  c. jalapeno pepper, chopped
1 1/2  c. Longhorn cheese, grated
preparation: Fry approximately 8 strips of bacon.  Dry and crumble in mixture. Use grease from bacon to bake in cornbread.  Bake at 350°.

name: OVEN BARBECUED TURKEY LEGS(4 Servings)
ingredients:
4  turkey drumsticks or thighs
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. chili powder
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
6  Tbsp. cooking oil
1/2  c. orange marmalade
1/2  c. bottled chili sauce
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. celery seed
few drops smoke flavoring
preparation: Wash and dry turkey.  Blend flour, salt, pepper and chili powder.  Dredge turkey with this mixture.  Heat oil in heavy frying pan; add turkey parts.  Brown evenly on all sides over medium to high heat.  Stir together marmalade, chili sauce, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce and celery seed.  Put browned meat into shallow baking dish.  Spoon chili mixture over evenly.  Cover dish. Bake at 300° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until turkey is tender; baste once or twice with sauce that collects in bottom of pan during baking.  Good served with hot fluffy rice, green vegetable and salad.

name: CHINESE CHOP SUEY
ingredients:
1/2  lb. lean pork
1  bunch celery
1  lb. onions, cut in small pieces
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  can sprouts
1  Tbsp. brown sauce
preparation: May also use veal, lamb or chicken.

name: WATERGATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix
3  eggs
1  pkg. pistachio instant pudding
1/2  c. fine shredded coconut
3/4  c. oil
1  c. Seven-Up or club soda
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.  Cool.

name: PINEAPPLE PIE
ingredients:
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  can Eagle Brand milk
2  graham cracker crusts
preparation: Mix well Cool Whip, drained pineapple, lemon juice and Eagle Brand milk.  Pour into 2 graham cracker crusts.  Freeze.

name: WHEAT HEARTS PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  egg
1  c. buttermilk
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil or melted shortening
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. uncooked wheat hearts cereal
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat egg, then beat in remaining ingredients in order given, sifting the dry ingredients.  Grease griddle and when hot, add batter for pancakes.  Turn pancake as soon as puffed and full of bubbles and before bubbles break.  Makes 10 (4-inch) golden brown cakes.

name: YOGURT FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
2  graham cracker crusts
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
2  (8 oz.) yogurt
2  c. fruit
preparation: Select the flavored yogurt that would go best with your fruit combination. Strawberry and banana use strawberry yogurt, pineapple (crushed) and coconut use pina colada, mandarin orange slices with lemon yogurt. Mix ingredients together; pour into pie shells and refrigerate 2 hours.  Serve.

name: VEGGIE PIZZA
ingredients:
2  pkg. refrigerated crescent rolls
3/4  c. Miracle Whip
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. Ranch dressing
chopped vegetables (carrot, red peppers, mushrooms, broccoli)
3/4  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Spread crescent roll onto cookie sheet.  Bake at 350°  for 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned.  Cool.  Mix Miracle Whip, cream cheese and Ranch dressing.  Spread onto crescent dough.  Add mixture of vegetables and press into cream cheese mixture.  Top with cheese and press.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.  Cut into squares.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter or other fat oil
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cream or milk
preparation: Sift together 1 1/2 cups flour, baking powder and salt.  Cream butter until soft.  Beat in sugar, egg, vanilla and cream.  Stir in flour mixture.  Gradually add the remaining flour until the dough is just stiff enough to roll.  Chill thoroughly.  Place on lightly floured board and roll 1/8-inch thick.  Cut with a floured cutter as desired.  Place on a greased baking sheet.  Put in moderate oven (375° to 400°) for 8 to 10 minutes.  I put a cup of walnuts or pecans in my dough.

name: KID'S FAVORITE FOURTH OF JULY JELLO
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cherry Jell-O
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. berry blue Jell-O
1  bag regular size marshmallows
1  container Cool Whip
4  c. boiling water
2  trays ice cubes (28 to 32 cubes)
2  egg whites (room temperature), beat until frothy
few grains salt
1/2 scant  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. sugar (regular pure cane, do not use blends such as the U.S. brand)
12  oz. bag semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Add salt and cream of tartar to the egg whites and beat until stiff.  Slowly add the sugar, beating well as you go along. Mixture will be thick and glossy.  Add vanilla at the end of beating.  Fold in chocolate chips.  Drop by teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheets, 1 inch apart.  Put in oven and turn oven off immediately.  Leave in oven for 3 to 5 hours (or overnight).

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can chunk pineapple
1  jar cherries
4  or 5 bananas
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
3  oz. vanilla pudding
preparation: Mix together juice from pineapple and cherries with instant pudding.  Pour over fruit and refrigerate.  Stir before serving.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. water
1  qt. milk
4  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
cinnamon
3/4  c. rice
4  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Cook rice in water for 7 minutes.  Add milk and butter, then cook 1 hour on low heat.  Add eggs, sugar, vanilla and if desired, raisins.  Put in serving dish and sprinkle with cinnamon.

name: 3-CHEESE QUICHE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. half and half
2  c. any 3 cheeses (example:  Cheddar, Swiss and Mozzarella)
1/2  tsp. salt
1  (9 or 10-inch) pie crust shell
preparation: One pie crust shell baked at 375° for 10 minutes.

name: LIME SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lime jello
1  c. hot water
1  c. crushed pineapple
2  c. vanilla ice cream
preparation: Dissolve lime jello in hot water; mix well.  Add crushed pineapple and ice cream.  Stir until ice cream is melted.  Chill 10 minutes and serve.

name: GROUND TURKEY BARLEY SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey
2  Tbsp. flour
4  c. beef broth
1/4  c. barley
1 (16 oz.)  can chopped tomatoes
1  medium chopped onion
3  peeled, sliced carrots
1  sliced rib celery
salt and pepper
preparation: Brown turkey in large saucepan, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle flour over meat and stir until flour loses its white color.  Slowly add broth, then remaining ingredients.   Bring mixture to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 60 minutes.

name: SPRING CORN
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen corn
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. mustard
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook corn as directed on package.  Saute onions in butter. Add corn, sugar, mustard, parsley and salt and pepper.  Mix and serve.

name: FIERY CAJUN SHRIMP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. (2 sticks) butter, melted
1/2  lb. (2 sticks) margarine, melted
3 to 4  oz. Worcestershire sauce (3/8 to 1/2 c.)
4  Tbsp. ground black pepper
1  tsp. ground rosemary
2  tsp. Tabasco
2  tsp. salt (sea salt, if possible)
3  cloves garlic, minced
4  lemons (2 juiced and 2 sliced)
5 to 6  lb. raw shrimp (in their shells)
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  In a bowl, mix all ingredients, except lemon slices and shrimp.  Pour about 1/2 cup sauce to cover the bottom of a large baking dish and arrange layers of shrimp and lemon slices until nearly to the top of the dish.  Leave about 1-inch headroom.  Pour remaining sauce over shrimp and lemon slices.

name: LEPARIN GOOD
ingredients:
1  c. macaroni or spaghetti, cooked
1  lb. hamburger
1  can corn
1  can tomatoes
1  can or less grated cheese
1  Tbsp. butter
1  finely chopped onion
2  medium green peppers, chopped
salt and pepper
preparation: Brown onion and hamburger.  Add other ingredients.  Cube buttered bread and place over top.  Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: EASY PIZZA
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/2  c. warm water
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. soft shortening
2  c. sifted flour
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  lb. ground beef
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. thyme
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Dissolve yeast in  water;  add salt, shortening and 1/2 cup flour.  Beat until  smooth;  add remaining flour, roll out and place on a 14  x 7-inch greased baking sheet.  Spread with tomato sauce.  Brown beef  with  the onion, oregano, thyme and garlic salt.  Drain and  spread  over sauce.  Top with cheese. Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

name: CHINESE PORK AND RICE
ingredients:
2/3  c. uncooked rice
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  bouillon cube
2  tsp. soy sauce
1  medium onion, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1 1/2  c. diced, cooked pork
preparation: Cook rice in hot oil until golden brown. Add salt, water, bouillon cube and soy sauce. Cover and cook 20 minutes. Add rest of ingredients and 1/4 cup more water if necessary.  Cover tightly.  Cook 10 minutes more.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
1/2  c. scallions, chopped
1  Tbsp. water
2 1/2  c. chicken broth
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/8  tsp. salt
pinch of black pepper
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. thyme
3  c. potatoes, cubed
2  c. skim milk
20  oz. frozen corn
1/4  c. instant dry milk
preparation: Steam scallions in water, covered, until wilted.  Add stock, seasonings and potatoes.  Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally.  Gradually add skim milk, then add corn.  Heat to almost scalding and cook 1 minute.  Put 2 cups of chowder in blender or food processor with skim milk.  Puree.  Return to pot and heat.  Contains 0.7 grams of total fat per serving.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1 (8oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
3  chopped scallions
1  can water chestnuts, chopped
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
preparation: Squeeze water from spinach.  Mix remaining ingredients in large bowl.  Mix thoroughly and chill for 1 hour.  Nice when served with sliced pumpernickel!

name: CROCK-POT CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large chicken
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can peas and carrots, mixed
1  medium onion, chopped
1 small  box Minute rice
preparation: Cook chicken and onion in 2 quarts water in crock-pot until done.  Take chicken out and debone, reserving the broth in crock-pot.  Cook 15 or 20 minutes (until done).  Stir in the chicken, vegetables, cream of chicken soup, salt and pepper to taste.  Good with cranberry sauce.

name: HARVARD BEETS
ingredients:
6  medium sized beets or canned beets, drained
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix  sugar and cornstarch.  Add vinegar.  Cook over low heat for  5  minutes.  Add  butter and stir.  Pour sauce over beets. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes to absorb sweet/sour flavor of the sauce.

name: BAKED APPLES
ingredients:
6  large baking apples
1  c. sugar
3  c. water (part cider may be used)
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
preparation: Before baking, apples may be filled with raisins and nuts or mincemeat.  Honey may be substituted for part of the sugar.  Place apples, which have been peeled 2/3 way down, in long baking dish. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.  Add water.  Place in preheated 425° oven and bake for 45 minutes.  Baste several times during baking and upon removing from oven.  Serve warm or cold.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  (7 oz.) 7-Up
5  Tbsp. cornstarch (level)
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. red food coloring
preparation: Cook until thick. Cool.  Stir in 1 pint fresh strawberries. Put in baked pie shell.  Top with Cool Whip.

name: FLOUNDER CREOLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 small  can mushrooms
1  can tomatoes
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. tarragon
1  bay leaf
1/4  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1  lb. flounder
preparation: Saute onions, green pepper  and mushrooms.  Add seasonings and tomatoes.  Cook 3 minutes.	Add fish and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes, until fish flakes.  Serve over rice.

name: CHOCOLATE STRUEDEL BARS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. unsifted flour
1 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1/2  c. unsweetened cocoa
1  c. cold margarine or butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1  egg
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. In a large bowl combine flour, sugar and cocoa.  Cut in margarine until crumbly (mixture will be dry). Reserve 2 cups of crumb mixture and press remainder in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake 15 minutes.

name: CHIPPED BEEF CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  containers cream cheese (soft)
2  jars dried beef
1  tsp. Worcestershire
3  green onions, chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients; refrigerate and serve with Ritz crackers.

name: COUNTRY STYLE STEAK
ingredients:
4  medium size cubed steaks
1/4  c. Crisco
1/2  c. self-rising flour
4 to 5  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Spray 10-inch cast-iron frying pan with "Pam".  Heat pan with Crisco.  Roll steaks in flour; place in pan.  Salt and pepper. Brown on medium heat; turn over to brown 2nd side.  Remove steak from pan.  Add flour to pan.  Brown flour over over medium heat. Add 4 cups water to flour mixture.  Stir.  Add browned steaks. Cover and simmer on low heat for 60 minutes.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can (15 1/4 oz.) pineapple tidbits, drained
1 small  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 small  box vanilla pudding and pie filling (not instant)
1 small  jar maraschino cherries, drained
2  or 3 sliced bananas (optional)
preparation: Drain pineapple juice and mandarin orange juice into saucepan and heat.  When hot (do not boil) add box of vanilla pudding and pie filling.  Mix well and cook until thickened.  Set aside to cool and then stir in the pineapple tidbits and mandarin oranges. Refrigerate.

name: NO BAKE LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1  (9 oz.) container Cool Whip
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk
2  graham cracker crusts
preparation: Mix ingredients well.  Pour in pie shell.  (Refrigerate.)

name: MICHIGAN BEANS AND SAUSAGE
ingredients:
1  lb. dry navy beans
6  bacon strips, diced
3  medium onions, sliced into rings
1  lb. chicken gizzards, trimmed and halved, optional
4  cups water
2  garlic cloves, minced
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dried marjoram
1  bay leaf
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  lb. fully cooked Kielbasa or Polish sausage, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/4 inch slices
8  oz. can tomato sauce
1  cup soft bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
preparation: Place beans in a Dutch oven; add water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil; boil for 2 minutes.  Remove from heat; cover and let stand for 1 hour.  Drain and discard liquid.  Return beans to pan and set aside.  In skillet, cook bacon until crisp.  Drain, reserving 2 Tbsp. of drippings; set bacon aside.  Sauté onions, and gizzards if desired, in the drippings until onions are tender and the gizzards are browned.  Add water, garlic, salt, marjoram, bay leaf, pepper, bacon, and onion mixture to beans.  Cover and bake at 350° for 3 hours or until beans are tender.  Discard bay leaf.  Stir in sausage and tomato sauce.  Toss bread crumbs and margarine; sprinkle over top.  Bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes longer or until golden.  Yields 10-12 servings.

name: MERRY CHERRY BARS
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
1  c. granulated sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. almond extract
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. coarsely chopped cherries
1/3  c. coarsely chopped green M&M's plain chocolate candies
1  c. sifted powdered sugar
5  tsp. warm water
preparation: One 16 ounce package of M&M's yields about 1/2 cup green candies.

name: CHEESE ROLL
ingredients:
1  c. pecan chips
1  lb. Velveeta
3  oz. cream cheese
1  clove garlic or garlic powder
paprika
preparation: Let Velveeta cheese and cream cheese sit at room temperature for a while.  Cream cheese together and add rest of ingredients. Roll in paprika.

name: GRANDMOM'S CRAB BITES
ingredients:
6  English muffins
1/2  lb. crab meat or imitation crab meat
1  jar Old English Cheddar spread
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1  stick margarine
a few dashes garlic salt
paprika
preparation: Bring all ingredients to room temperature.  Mix all ingredients and spread on muffins.  Cut into quarters and sprinkle with paprika.  At this point Crab Bites may be frozen for later use.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. 7-Up soda
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  pkg. strawberries, sliced (enough to for deep crust)
jello
preparation: Mix jello and sugar together, then add 7-Up soda.  Cook over medium heat until thick.  Put strawberries in cooked pie crust (deep shell). Pour filling on strawberries.  Put Cool Whip on top.

name: APRICOT CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
1 3  oz. box apricot jello
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1 4  oz. carton Cool Whip
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. pecans optional
preparation: Heat pineapple and juice in sauce pan until bubbly.  Add jello, remove from heat.  Stir until jello is dissolved.  Let cool slightly.  Pour into 8 by 8 inch pyrex dish.  Stir in cool whip, buttermilk, and pecans.  Refrigerate until set.

name: CONFETTI BROWN RICE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. mixed dried fruit, chopped
2/3  c. mixed nuts, chopped
1/3  c. sesame seed
1/3  tsp. ground cloves
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. raw brown rice, cooked
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Preheat oven  to  350°.  Heat  the oil in a skillet and saute the  onion,  fruit, nuts and sesame seed until the onion is translucent,  about  5 minutes.  Add the cloves and salt to the onion mixture and stir.  Add the rice and mix well.  Place the rice in a buttered casserole dish and pour the butter over all. Bake  for  15  to  20  minutes  to	heat through.  Serve immediately.  Serves 4.

name: RHUBARB DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
5  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Blend together.  Press into 8 x 8-inch pan (ungreased).  Bake 15 minutes at 350°.

name: REFRIGERATOR ROLLS(4 Dozen)
ingredients:
1  qt. whole milk
1  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
1  quick-acting yeast
1/4  c. lukewarm water
1  Tbsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
8  c. enriched flour + 1 c.
preparation: Scald milk with sugar and shortening.  Cool to lukewarm.  Then add yeast thoroughly dissolved in lukewarm water.  With the new fast-action yeast, you can use it according to the instructions on the package; eliminate the 1/4 cup warm water and mix the dry yeast in with the flour.  Add 8 cups of flour.  Beat well.  Let rise until double in bulk, then add salt, soda and baking powder.  Add enough flour (about 1 cup) to make soft dough.  Place in bowl, grease surface of dough, cover and place in refrigerator.  Make rolls when wanted.  Will keep 1 week to 10 days.

name: ALLSPICE WASSAIL BOWL PUNCH
ingredients:
1  gal. apple cider
1/4  c. honey
1/2 to 3/4  c. lemon juice
6  oz. can frozen orange juice concentrate
4  (2-inch) cinnamon sticks
1  Tbsp. whole cloves
1  Tbsp. whole allspice
2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Combine.  (Tie cloves and allspice in cheesecloth.) Cover. Simmer for 20 minutes.  Serve hot with a cinnamon stick in each mug.

name: PORTUGUESE KALE SOUP
ingredients:
6  pkg. frozen kale
1  large head cabbage, chopped
2  pkg. linguisa, sliced
2  pkg. cherico, sliced
2  Tbsp. mint and black pepper
1  bag Maine potatoes, peeled and cut bite size
2 large  cans chicken broth
2  c. split peas
2  large onions, chopped
preparation: Note:  I use a 5-gallon soup pot because you can freeze this soup.  It's okay to cut this recipe in half.

name: JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  carton cottage cheese
1  can pineapple, crushed and drained
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
1  large Cool Whip
1 small  pkg. Jell-O (dry; flavor of your choice)
preparation: Mix cottage cheese, Cool Whip and Jell-O together.  Gently fold in pineapple and oranges.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
3  c. water
2  c. sugar
1 (46 oz.)  can unsweetened pineapple juice
1 1/2  c. orange juice
1/4  c. lemon juice
3  mashed bananas
1  large (32 oz.) Sprite or ginger ale
preparation: Mix water and sugar and boil, then mix all the ingredients, except Sprite or ginger ale, and freeze overnight.	Add Sprite or ginger ale just before serving.

name: UPSIDE-DOWN BERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/4  c. butter
2 1/2  c. berries, without juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. oil
1  egg, beaten
1  c. sifted flour (plain)
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. baking powder (no kiddin', 2 Tbsp.)
preparation: Mix oil, egg and milk.  Sift dry ingredients and add to the first mixture.  Add 2 tablespoons more milk.  Fry on hot griddle. Waffles, too!

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1/2  carton frozen strawberries
1  box strawberry Jell-O
1  c. Wesson oil
1/2  c. water
4  eggs
preparation: Mix cake mix, strawberries, Jell-O, Wesson oil and water thoroughly.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Bake in tube pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.  Let cool.

name: EASY LEMON CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  lb. skinless, boneless chicken breast, cut in cubes
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2 (12 oz.)  jars chicken gravy
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. dried thyme leaves, crushed
3  c. cooked, cut-up vegetables (fresh or frozen)
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen puff pastry shells, baked
preparation: In a large skillet, brown chicken in vegetable oil.  Pour off fat.  Add gravy, lemon juice, thyme and vegetables to skillet. Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes or until done.  Spoon into pastry shells.  Serve.  Serves 6.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. Lipton onion and vegetable soup
2  eggs
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN 'N' HASH BROWN BAKE
ingredients:
1 (32 oz.)  pkg. frozen Southern style hash brown potatoes
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
4  c. diced cooked chicken
1 (4 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms, drained
1  c. (8 oz.) sour cream
2  c. chicken broth or stock
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
2  tsp. instant chicken bouillon granules
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
2  Tbsp. finely chopped sweet red pepper
1  garlic clove, minced
paprika
1/4  c. sliced almonds
preparation: Thaw hash browns overnight in refrigerator.  Layer in an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Place chicken and mushrooms over the hash browns.  Stir together sour cream, broth, soup, bouillon, onion, red pepper and garlic.  Pour over all.  Sprinkle with paprika and almonds.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until heated through. Makes 8 to 10 servings.  This is a good potluck dish.

name: FUDGE NUT BROWNIES
ingredients:
4  squares Baking Chocolate
1  stick Margarine
1 1\2  C. Sugar
3  Eggs
2  tsp. Vanilla
1  C. Flour
1  C. Walnuts, chopped
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Microwave or Melt chocolate and margarine on "high" for 2 min.  Stir until chocolate is completly melted.  Stir in sugar until well blended.  Mix in eggs and vanilla.  Stir in flour and walnuts.  Mix well.  Spread in greased 8x8-inch baking pan.  Bake 35-38 min. or until toothpick inserted in center comes out with fudgy crumbs.  Cool in pan.  Cut into squares and serve.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. powdered sugar
2 small  boxes chocolate pudding (instant type)
1  stick butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. Cool Whip
3  c. milk
Cool Whip
preparation: Melt butter; mix well with flour, nuts and 1/4 cup powdered sugar.  Line a 10 x 12 x 2-inch pan with mixture.  Add 1/4 cup powdered sugar, cream cheese and 1 cup Cool Whip.  Spread over crust.  Mix pudding and milk; beat until thick.  Spread over cream cheese mixture.  Top with Cool Whip.

name: ST. PETERS VEGETABLES-RUSSIA(Luk Marinovannyi)
ingredients:
1  lb. jar of pearl onions, drained
1  cup cider
1/2  cup sugar
2  Tbsp. fresh dill, minced
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. crushed red pepper
1  tsp. caraway seeds
12  black peppercorns
preparation: Place drained onions back into the jar. Combine all other ingredients together in a saucepan. Bring to a boil  over medium heat. Pour over onions. Cap the jar tightly and allow to cool. Refrigerate for 2 weeks before serving.

name: GREEN PEPPER VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
2  c. regular rice (4 c. when cooked)
4  c. water
1  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  onion, chopped fine
2  tsp. chili powder
1 1/2  tsp. garlic salt
6  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2 (15 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1  qt. tomato juice
dice 6 or 7 large mangoes
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Spray 2 (2-quart) casserole dishes with Pam.  Pour in mixture.  Bake at 400° covered for an hour.  Remove lid and bake at 325°.

name: CREAMY CARROT SOUP
ingredients:
1  small onion
1  Tbsp. oil
salt and pepper
1/2  tsp. ground cumin
10  oz. pkg. frozen carrots
1 1/2  c. chicken stock or canned broth
1/4  c. heavy cream
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Chop onion; in a soup pot, heat oil over medium low heat.  Add onion and 1/4 teaspoon salt.  Cover and cook until tender, 5 minutes.  Stir in cumin; add the carrots, stock and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.  Bring to a simmer; cook until carrots are heated through, about 2 minutes.  In a blender or food processor, puree the carrot mixture, in batches if necessary, until smooth.  Return to pot; stir in the cream and warm over low heat until soup is heated through.  Taste for seasoning and add salt and pepper, if needed. Sprinkle with parsley before serving.  Makes 4 servings.

name: RIB-EYE POTATO BUTTER
ingredients:
1  lb. butter or margarine or half and half
1/2  c. softened bacon fat
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. finely chopped fresh green onions
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. white pepper
1  tsp. Rib Eye Seasoning
1  c. bacon bits
preparation: Blend butter and  bacon fat in a mixing bowl until soft and gently blend in the remaining ingredients.

name: SEAFOOD LINGUINE
ingredients:
1  small onion, diced
1  clove garlic, diced
1/2  bunch green scallions, chopped
3  Tbsp. chopped fresh or dried parsley
1  bottle clam juice
2  cans chopped clams
8  oz. crab meat
8  oz. scallops or shrimp (shrimp can be chopped)
3/4  lb. linguine (or spaghetti, if preferred)
preparation: Saute onion, garlic, green scallions in olive oil.  Add parsley and clam juice; simmer about 10 minutes.  Add clams, crab meat and remaining seafood and simmer 3 to 4 minutes.  In another pot, bring water to a boil.  Add pasta and cook according to directions on package.  Drain pasta; add seafood mixture and mix. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve.

name: RICE WITH PIGEON PEAS
ingredients:
1  can pigeon peas (16 oz.), drained
4  Tbsp. tomato sauce
10  green olives, sliced
1/2  tomato, diced
1/4  green pepper, finely chopped
1/2  onion, finely chopped
4  cloves garlic, finely chopped
1  Tbsp. olive oil
2  slices bacon, cut in small pieces
2  c. white rice
1  tsp. Goya Adobo all-purpose seasoning
3  c. water
1/4  tsp. cilantro or oregano
preparation: In large saucepan on medium heat, add olive oil and bacon. Brown bacon.  Add garlic, onion and green pepper.  Stir often until browned.  Add tomatoes and green olives.  Stir in tomato sauce, all-purpose seasoning and cilantro.  Add peas and 2 cups water. Cover pan and boil for 1/2 hour.  Add rice and 1 cup water.  Cook on high, uncovered, for 15 minutes.  Reduce heat, cover pan and simmer until rice is done (about 20 minutes).  Stir occasionally. Yields 6 servings.

name: OLD FASHION COUNTRY GRAVY
ingredients:
4 to 5  Tbsp. meat drippings
2 heaping  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper to taste
1 to 2  c. milk (can use 1/2 milk and 1/2 water)
preparation: Make in heavy skillet.  When drippings (grease) are hot, add flour, salt and pepper.  Stir until brown (not burned).   Add milk; boil until thick.  If too thick, add more milk.

name: BAKED FUDGE
ingredients:
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
4  eggs, beaten
1  c. melted butter
1  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Blend cocoa, flour and sugar. Add eggs and blend. Pour in 9 x 9 pan. Place pan in larger pan filled with 1 to 1 1/2-inches of hot water. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
6  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. sugar
6  c. milk
1  c. raisins
10 to 12  c. broken bread pieces, rolls or doughnuts
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Blend in bread. Pour mixture into a 13 x l9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until set.

name: ZESTY MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3  slices bread, torn into small pieces
10  oz. can diced tomatoes and green chilies
1  small onion, chopped
2  Tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/3  c. chili sauce
1/4  c. cheddar cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Combine first 7 ingredients.  Mix well.  Spread into a 8 1/2	x 4 1/2  x 2 1/2 inch loaf pan. Bake 1 hour.  Drain excess drippings.  Spoon chili sauce over cooked meat loaf; sprinkle with cheese.  Bake an additional 15 minutes. Serves 6.

name: MINI CHEESECAKES
ingredients:
12  vanilla wafers
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
miniature chocolate chips, fruit, preserves or nuts
preparation: Line muffin tins with foil liners.  Place one vanilla wafer in each liner.  Mix the cream cheese, vanilla and sugar on medium speed until well blended.  Add eggs; mix well.  Pour over wafers, filling 3/4 full.  Bake for 25 minutes at 325°.  Remove from pan when cool.  Chill.  Top with fruit, preserves, nuts or chocolate.

name: ELSIE'S BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. butter
1  c. sugar
2  egg yolks
1/2 lemon rind and juice or 1  Tbsp. brandy
1  tsp. baking powder
6  c. flour
preparation: Cream butter and sugar; add egg yolks, flavoring and flour. Use only enough flour to handle dough.  Roll thin on pastry cloth; trim with slightly beaten egg whites and decorate with colored sugar and nuts if desired.

name: SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Italian spaghetti dinner (Kraft)
1  lb. hamburger
1  small onion
1 large  can stewed tomatoes or 2 c. tomato juice
1 small  can tomato sauce
2  tsp. chili powder
herb pkg. from Kraft dinner
preparation: Boil spaghetti until soft (as directed on package).  Set aside. Brown hamburger and onion.  Drain grease.  Add stewed tomatoes or tomato juice, tomato sauce, chili powder and herb package mix to hamburger and onion.  Simmer for a few minutes.  Layer spaghetti and sauce in a 2-quart casserole dish, ending with sauce.  Sprinkle with cheese from Kraft dinner.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

name: BLUE RIBBON CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. white sugar
1  c. butter, softened
2  large eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. dark brown sugar, packed
2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Combine flour, salt and soda; mix well. Set aside.  In large bowl, blend sugars at medium speed.  Add butter and mix to form a paste.  Add eggs and extract. Mix at medium speed until blended.  Do not overmix.  Add flour mix and chips.  Blend at low speed until just mixed.  Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet, 2-inches apart.  Bake 22 minutes or until golden brown.  Transfer to cool surface with spatula immediately.  Yields 3 1/2 dozen.

name: MOMMA'S SPINACH SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1/4  c. oil
1/4  c. honey
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. catsup
salt
2  hard-boiled eggs, finely chopped
2  strips bacon, cooked crisp and broken into pieces
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour over clean, fresh spinach.

name: POTATO SUPREME
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1/2  c. melted butter
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  pt. sour cream
10  oz. grated sharp cheese
1  c. corn flakes
preparation: Mix all ingredients; pour in buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with crushed corn flakes and dot with butter.  Bake 30 minutes more.  This freezes well.  Serves 12 to 14.

name: CRANBERRY RELISH
ingredients:
1  lb. raw cranberries
1 small  can crushed pineapple
3  apples
3  oranges
2  c. sugar
preparation: Grind together and let stand for several days in refrigerator.

name: AUNT BOE'S COCONUT BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. confectioners sugar
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  stick margarine
1  can coconut
1  pinch of salt
2  c. chopped pecans
2  pkg. chocolate chips
1  block (1/4 lb.) paraffin
preparation: Melt butter slowly and add milk.  Stir in sugar and salt; add coconut and pecans.  Chill until easily handled and roll into balls.  Melt chocolate pieces and paraffin together in top of double boiler.  Remove from heat and dip each ball, removing candy quickly from chocolate mixture and placing on waxed paper.  Take a small number of balls out of refrigerator at a time to prevent them from getting soft.  Store in air tight container.

name: 1-2-3 COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. granulated sugar or 1 c. brown sugar, packed
1/4  c. soft butter or margarine
1/2  c. boiling water
2  c. Bisquick
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Mix peanut butter, butter, sugar and boiling water.  Blend with beater/mixer until smooth.  Stir in Bisquick.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a lightly greased baking sheet.  Flatten with a fork dipped in flour.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until set, but not hard.  Makes about 6 1/2 dozen.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP DATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped dates
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1 1/4  c. flour
1  pkg. chocolate chips
1/2  c. nutmeats
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and let cool.  Mix next 6 ingredients; pour in pan, 13 x 9-inch.  Top with chocolate chips, nutmeats and sugar.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: JOSEPHINAS(Ho-se-fee-nas)
ingredients:
1  loaf French bread
1  stick butter
1  can diced green chiles
1/2  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
preparation: Blend butter and chiles.  Spread on rounds of French bread. Blend cheese and Miracle Whip.  Spread on top.  Bake or broil until melted.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. unsifted flour
1  pkg. dry yeast
1  c. shortening
1  tsp. salt
5  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. soda
3  tsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. lukewarm water
preparation: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Mix dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Add yeast mixture and buttermilk. Mix well.  Roll out on floured board and cut out as biscuits. They do not need to rise before baking. Bake at 400° for approximately 20 minutes. Unused dough will keep up to a week if well covered and refrigerated. After cutting as biscuits, you may brush on a bit of melted margarine and turn over as Parker House rolls.

name: ONION SOUP
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can onion soup (not cream)
1  can water
6  Tbsp. flour
1  can Swanson chicken broth
1  can Pet milk
preparation: Blend first 4 ingredients in blender.  Pour in saucepan.  Add chicken broth.  Cook on medium heat, stirring constantly.  When thick, add 1 can Pet milk and cook until thick.  Line serving bowl with grated Swiss cheese.  Pour soup into bowl.

name: YUM-A-SETTA(Amish)
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
salt and pepper to taste
brown sugar (a little)
1/4  chopped onion
