1  can tomato soup (undiluted)
1  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. egg noodles
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. processed cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger with salt, pepper, brown sugar and onion.  Add tomato soup.  Cook egg noodles and drain.  Add chicken soup. Layer hamburger mixture and noodle mixture in casserole dish with processed cheese between layers.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

name: CHOP SUEY
ingredients:
2  lb. chop suey meat (1 lb. beef, 1 lb. pork, cubed small)
2  c. chopped celery
2  c. chopped onion
1  can bean sprouts
1  Tbsp. oil
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. La Choy brown gravy sauce
1/2  c. water
preparation: Brown meat in 1 tablespoon oil.  Add onion and saute.  Add soy sauce and gravy sauce with water and celery.  Stir and simmer until tender.  Add drained bean sprouts and cook 5 minutes.  Serve over rice or Chinese noodles.

name: CHOCOLATE OATMEAL CANDY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. milk
3  c. oatmeal
3  Tbsp. chocolate
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil sugar, margarine and milk for 3 minutes.  Mix with remaining ingredients, then spread mixture in a 9-inch buttered pan.  Let cool and cut into squares.

name: CAULIFLOWER AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE(7 Servings)
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen broccoli
1  pkg. frozen cauliflower
1  can mushroom soup
1  pkg. grated Cheddar cheese
1  c. evaporated milk
1/2  can onion rings
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except onion rings.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.  Top with onion rings and bake 20 minutes.

name: BEEF BRISKET
ingredients: 4 to 5  lb. brisket
preparation: Brush brisket with liquid smoke. Cover with foil and bake at 275° four or five hours.

name: COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  pkg. small Jell-O vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
1 1/3  c. water
4  eggs
1/4  c. oil
2  c. Baker's coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Blend cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil.   Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes.  Stir in coconut and pecans.   Pour into three greased and floured 9-inch layer pans.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Cool in pans for 15 minutes.  Remove and cool on rack.  Frost when cool.

name: ZUCCHINI NUT BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. coarsely grated zucchini
2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Beat the eggs until frothy.  Beat in sugar, vegetable oil and vanilla; mix until thick and lemon color.  Stir in zucchini.  Add flour, cinnamon, baking soda, salt and baking powder; mix well. Add chopped nuts.  Coat two loaf pans (8 x 4 x 3-inch) with nonstick cooking spray.  Bake at 350° for about 50 minutes.  Let cool in pan for 10 minutes before removing onto wire rack.

name: FETTUCCINE WITH SPINACH CHEESE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen spinach, chopped, thawed and drained
3  cloves garlic
1  Tbsp. parsley
1/4  c. walnut pieces
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. olive oil
3/4  lb. fettuccine or other broad noodles
preparation: Squeeze out water from spinach.  Mince garlic; add parsley. Add minced walnuts, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper (can use processor to do).  Add spinach and oil to form a puree.

name: MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3  slices bread, soaked in milk
1  egg
3  Tbsp. onion
3  Tbsp. parsley
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
2  c. tomato juice
1  c. water
1/2  c. celery
1/2  c. sliced carrots
dash of Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix ground beef, bread and milk; set aside.  In blender, mix egg, onion, parsley, salt and pepper.  Mix this with beef mixture. Roll into 30 balls.  Roll in flour and brown in 2 tablespoons oil. Drain, then add tomato juice, water, celery, carrots and Worcestershire sauce.  Simmer; pour over meat balls and simmer 45 minutes.

name: MUSHROOM BARLEY SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. boneless beef chuck cubes
2  c. finely chopped onion
1/2  c. sliced celery
2  garlic cloves, minced
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can beef broth
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can chicken broth
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  c. diced carrots
1  lb. sliced fresh mushrooms
1/2  tsp. dried thyme
2  c. water
1/2  c. medium pearl barley
3  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: In a large kettle, brown meat in oil.  Remove meat with a slotted spoon and set aside.  Saut onion, carrots and celery in drippings over medium heat until tender, about 5 minutes.  Add mushrooms, garlic and thyme; cook and stir for 3 minutes.  Add broths, water, barley, salt and pepper.  Return the meat to pan; bring to a boil.  Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until barley and meat are tender.  Add parsley.  Yields 11 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 18.25  oz. yellow cake mix with pudding
1 3.9  oz. box chocolate instant pudding mix
1/2  c. sifted powdered sugar
1 8  oz. carton sour cream
4  large eggs
1 6  oz. pkg. semisweet chocolate chips
3/4  c. water
3/4  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients, stirring with a wire whisk to remove large lumps.  Add oil eggs, water and sour cream.  Stirring until smooth.  Stir in chocolate chips.  Pour batter into greased and floured bundt pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.  Cool 10 minutes on wire rack.  Remove from pan and cool on wire rack.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: CHOCOLATE SWIRL CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
5  eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. Baker's German sweet chocolate, melted
preparation: Add sugar to cheese in a bowl, beating well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add vanilla.  Measure 2 cups of the cheese mixture.  Fold in cooled chocolate.  Pour remaining cheese mixture into well-buttered 10-inch pie pan or 9-inch square pan.  Add spoonfuls of the chocolate-cheese mixture and zigzag a spatula through batter to marble.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.  Cool and then chill.  Yields 12 servings.

name: WHITE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. shortening
3/4  c. milk
3  unbeaten egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Add milk, eggs, shortening and vanilla.  Mix well.  Bake in 350° oven until done.

name: DROP NOODLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. chocolate chips
2  c. butterscotch chips
1  c. cashew nuts
1  c. chow mein noodles
preparation: Melt chips. Add nuts and noodles. Drop by teaspoonful on waxed paper and let cool. Store in cool place. Makes 3 1/2 doz.

name: CORNED BEEF AND CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  small head cabbage
4  to 6 potatoes
1  small onion
1  can corned beef
1  Tbsp. butter
1 to 2  c. water
preparation: Layer potatoes (sliced), the onion (sliced thin) and then layer cabbage (wedged).  Salt and pepper as you layer.  Add 1 tablespoon meat grease, butter and water according to how much you cook.  Then put the corned beef on top of the cabbage and be sure to have the pan with airtight lid.  Let cook for 1 hour and 10 minutes on low heat.

name: VEGETARIAN CHILI
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans beans in chili sauce
1 (16 oz.)  can diced tomatoes
1 (16 oz.)  can whole kernel corn
garlic powder
preparation: Heat all ingredients to a boil.  Then let simmer.  Serves 4.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1  bag (14 oz.) caramels
3/4  c. butter
1/2  c. canned milk (evaporated)
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix cake batter as directed on package.  Put 1/2 of the batter in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  In a saucepan over low heat, melt caramels with butter and milk.  Pour over hot half-baked cake.  Top with chocolate chips and pecans. Pour rest of batter over caramels; bake at 350° for 20 minutes longer.

name: STRAWBERRY COOKIES
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oleo
1  box dates, cut up
2  c. Rice Krispies
red sugar
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cook oleo, dates, sugar and eggs together.  Add Rice Krispies and nuts.  Mix well and form into small strawberry shapes.  Roll in red sugar.

name: CRANAPPLE CRISP
ingredients:
6  to 8 apples
1  c. cranberries
1  c. sugar
1  c. oatmeal
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. flour
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together like you would a pie crust.  Sprinkle over fruit. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: VEGETABLE BEEF MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  egg, slightly beaten
3/4  c. soft bread crumbs
1  envelope Lipton vegetable beef soup
1/2  c. water
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  In large bowl combine meat, egg, bread crumbs,  soup  and water.  Shape into loaf and place in shallow baking  pan.  Bake 1 hour or until done.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. frozen hash brown potatoes
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and onions. Drain. Add hash browns and soup. Season with salt and pepper. Place in baking dish and bake at 385° for 30 minutes. Layer with cheese. Bake for another 10 to 15 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY-RAISIN BAKE(Scones)
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. raisins
1/2  c. thick strawberry jam
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Grease a round 9-inch cake pan.  Combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.  Using a fork, cut in butter until coarse crumbs are formed.  Add the milk, eggs and raisins. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened.  With floured hands, pat 1/2 of the dough into the greased cake pan.  Press dough 1/4-inch on the sides of pan.  Spread strawberry jam on top dough.  Use remainder of dough, spreading evenly.  Using a sharp knife, score dough into 8 wedges.  Brush top lightly with melted butter and sprinkle with sugar.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes.

name: DOWN EAST BLUEBERRY PIE
ingredients:
9-inch baked pie shell
1/2  c. water
1  qt. blueberries
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. water
preparation: Cook 1 cup of blueberries with sugar and 1/2 cup of water until soft.  Make paste of flour, salt and 1/2 cup of water; add to cooked berries.  Cook slowly until thickened.   Add to uncooked berries; turn into shell.  Refrigerate for 3 hours.

name: WACKY CAKE
ingredients:
2/3  c. cocoa
2  c. sugar
3  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  c. cooking oil
2  c. water
2  tsp. vinegar
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine all ingredients; beat well.  Pour into 8 1/2 x 12 1/2 x 2-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.  Yields 12 to 16 servings.

name: FRIED OKRA OR SQUASH
ingredients:
4  squash or 10 pods okra
1  c. meal
1  Tbsp. flour
salt to taste
3  Tbsp. Crisco oil
preparation: Cut squash or okra in slices.  Mix meal, flour and salt.  Pour on top of okra or squash and batter.  Heat oil in pan, then add battered squash or okra.  Fry on medium-low until brown.

name: CHOCOLATE GLOP
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. butter
2  sq. baking chocolate
dash of salt
dash of vanilla
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. sugar
2  c. boiling water
preparation: Melt butter and baking chocolate and add dash of salt and vanilla.  Combine flour, sugar, baking powder and milk.  Add melted butter and chocolate mixture to flour and sugar mixture. Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Combine cocoa, brown sugar and sugar and spread evenly over batter in pan.  Carefully pour 2 cups of boiling water over all.  Cook at 350° for 45 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

name: BRAZILIAN BLACK BEANS
ingredients:
1  pkg. black beans
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1  bay leaf
1  onion, chopped
1  slice green pepper
1  Tbsp. olive oil
preparation: Soak the beans in water overnight (or at least 2 hours).  Cook with bay leaf and green pepper until tender; discard bay leaf and pepper slice.  In another pot, saute crushed garlic and chopped onion until tender; add beans and mix thoroughly.  Cook 15 more minutes.  Serve with rice, collard greens and slices of orange for a balanced Brazilian meal!

name: BREADED TURKEY CUTLETS
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. turkey cutlets
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. dry bread crumbs
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
2  tsp. dried oregano
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place turkey cutlets in a medium bowl. Cover with water.  Add lemon juice.  In a shallow bowl, combine remaining ingredients, except oil.  Mix well.   One at a time, take cutlets from water and dip into crumbs, turning once to coat both sides.  Place cutlets in a shallow baking pan that has been sprayed with a nonstick cooking spray.  Drizzle oil over breaded cutlets.  Bake, covered, 30 minutes, or until lightly browned.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry Jell-O
1  c. boiling water
1 (1 lb.)  can whole cranberry sauce
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Chill Jell-O to syrup.  Add cranberry sauce and nuts.  Swirl in sour cream.  Pour into mold.  Serves 6.

name: MARINATED VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1  c. olive or vegetable oil
1/2  c. vinegar
1 large  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. dried oregano leaves, crushed
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  pkg. (16 oz.) fresh mushrooms
2  c. broccoli flowerets
2  c. cauliflowerets
2  c. red pepper, cut in 1 inch sq.
2  c. diagonally sliced carrots
preparation: In a large bowl, combine first 5 ingredients.  Add remaining ingredients and toss to coat well.  Cover and refrigerate until serving time, at least 4 hours, stirring occasionally.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked chicken, chopped
1  c. cream of chicken soup
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. chicken broth
1  c. rice
preparation: Cook rice and mix with other ingredients.  Place in a casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CHEERWINE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
2 large  cans Pet milk
16  oz. Cheerwine
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and finish filling your freezer with plain milk.

name: CHEESE-MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. cooked seasoned macaroni
1  c. diced celery
1  c. cooked peas
1/2  c. shredded uncooked carrots
1  green pepper, shredded
salt and pepper
mayonnaise
cheese balls or stuffed olives
preparation: Chill macaroni.  Combine with celery, peas, carrots and green pepper.  Season to taste.  Moisten with mayonnaise.  Mix lightly with two forks.  Serve on any crisp salad greens.  Garnish with cheese balls or diced stuffed olives.   Yield: 6 servings.

name: BILL'S BEST WAFFLES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
1/4  stick butter, melted
1  egg, separated
preparation: Combine dry ingredients.  Beat egg yolks, add to milk and melted butter.  Make hole in center of dry ingredients; dribble milk mixture.  Fold in, do not beat.  (Do this just before cooking.)  Fold in beaten egg whites.  Cook waffles on preheated waffle iron (Vitantanio iron preferred) just before serving.  Serve with maple syrup.  Makes 2 waffles.

name: VERY CHEESY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked soybeans
2  c. cooked brown rice
4  lightly beaten eggs
2  c. (1 lb.) Ricotta or cottage cheese
1  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
1/2  lb. chopped mushrooms
1  c. chopped onion
2 to 3  cloves garlic, crushed
1  tsp. each:  basil, thyme and marjoram
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
salt and pepper to taste
4  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. fine bread crumbs
2  medium tomatoes, thinly sliced
preparation: Saute onion, garlic, mushrooms and herbs in butter, until onion is soft.  Combine all but last 3 ingredients.  Spread mixture in large, buttered oblong pan.  Top with sliced tomatoes. Combine Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs.  Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
1  can tuna, drained
1  c. peas
1  c. cheese crackers
preparation: Put soup in casserole; add milk and mix.  Add tuna, peas and 3/4 of crackers.  Stir all together.  Sprinkle top with remaining crackers.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: SPARKLING PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade, thawed (no water)
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
3  qt. ginger ale, chilled
preparation: Combine all ingredients except ginger ale in blender at high speed until smooth.  Just before serving, stir in ginger ale. Makes 4 quarts.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN(Serves 6)
ingredients:
6  whole chicken breasts
3/4  c. mayonnaise
20  oz. broccoli
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/4  lb. butter
6  oz. stuffing (herb seasoned)
preparation: Cook chicken and cut into pieces.  Mix with mayonnaise and place in pan.  Cover with broccoli and then soup.  Mix stuffing with melted butter and sprinkle on top.  Cover with foil.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. Jell-O
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Make Jell-O with one cup of boiling water.  Put in blender. Add Jell-O, cream cheese and pineapple.  Pour into bowl and add Cool Whip.  Put in 13 x 9-inch pan.  Refrigerate.

name: LACY OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. pecans, finely chopped
1/2  c. uncooked old-fashioned oats or quick-cooking oats
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. packed light brown sugar (not dark brown)
1  stick (1/2 c.) butter (not margarine), cut in pieces
2  Tbsp. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Line cookie sheet(s) with foil.  Mix pecans, oats and flour on a sheet of waxed paper.  Stir sugar, butter and milk over low heat until butter melts.  Remove from heat.  Stir in nut mixture and vanilla; let cool 10 minutes.  Drop slightly rounded teaspoonful, 3 inches apart, on prepared cookie sheets.  Bake 8 to 9 minutes until cookies spread, look lacy and are lightly browned.  Cook on cookie sheets on wire rack 1 to 1 1/2 minutes until cookies harden slightly.  Remove from wire rack with broad metal spatula.

name: WOOD'S APPLEJACK-APPLE PIE(In Honor of Jenny Kate)
ingredients:
pastry for 2-crust,  9-inch pie (deep-dish)
3/4  c. sugar
2/3  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. grated orange rind
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. salt
5  c. peeled, cored and thinly sliced apples
9  Tbsp. granulated sugar, divided
lime juice (fresh)
12  tsp. applejack, divided
3  Tbsp. whipping cream
preparation: Make your favorite pastry for a 2-crust, 9-inch pie.  Roll out 1/2 the pastry to fit the pie plate; flute edges.

name: CONFETTI CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
2/3  c. milk
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
2  Tbsp. chopped green bell pepper
1/4  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. chopped cooked chicken
1  c. macaroni, cooked
1/4  c. margarine
preparation: Heat soups, milk, onion, pimento and green pepper in saucepan over low heat.  Stir in cheese until melted.  Add chicken, macaroni and margarine; mix well.  Spoon into buttered baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until bubbly.  Yield: 10 servings.

name: RANCH OYSTER CRACKERS
ingredients:
2 10  oz. bags oyster crackers
3/4  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Original
1  tsp. dill weed
preparation: In a large bowl, empty 2 bags oyster crackers. Mix oil, seasoned salt, Hidden Valley, dill weed and shake well. Pour evenly over crackers and stir. Coat well and evenly. Spread on two large cookie sheets and bake at 200° about 30 minutes or until golden brown, stirring every 10 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  large chicken breasts
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can mushroom soup
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  stick butter (margarine)
30  Ritz crackers, crumbled
preparation: Cut chicken in small pieces; layer.  Mix the soup and sour cream.  Pour over chicken.  Crumble crackers over pan.  Melt margarine; pour over crackers.  Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

name: NOODLES ROMANOFF
ingredients:
1  pkg. egg noodles
1  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  c. milk
1/2  pkg. dry onion soup mix
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook egg noodles and drain.  Add together cottage cheese, sour cream, milk, soup mix and Cheddar cheese.  Mix well.  Mix this into the noodles.  Put into greased casserole dish.  Sprinkle top with some Cheddar cheese.  Bake covered at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  oz. red food coloring
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2 1/4  c. flour
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Make a paste of the cocoa and food coloring.  Cream the shortening with the sugar.  Add eggs.  Combine flour with salt. Add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture.  Fold in baking soda and vinegar with spoon.  Use a round tube pan for Ding Dong Cake recipe or use three 8-inch cake pans.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: DEEP FRY FISH RECIPE
ingredients:
1/4  c. stale beer
1/4  c. cornstarch
1/4  c. flour
2  egg whites
preparation: Good for smelt or any fish filet.   Do not use for pan frying.

name: PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. finely chopped pretzels
3  Tbsp. sugar
3/4  c. butter, melted
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  large container Cool Whip
1 large  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
1  can drained, crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix pretzels, sugar and butter.  Pour in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 7 minutes and cool.  Blend cream cheese and powdered sugar; beat until smooth.  Add Cool Whip.  Spread on cooled layer of crust.

name: OREO DESSERT
ingredients:
2 small  boxes instant vanilla pudding
3  c. milk
1/2  c. soft butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  large tub Cool Whip
1  pkg. Oreo cookies, crushed
preparation: Press half  of  crushed cookies in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix  pudding  and milk until thick.  Mix butter and cream cheese, then  add  powdered sugar.  Add pudding gradually, mix until smooth.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Spread on cookies.  Sprinkle remaining cookies on top and freeze.

name: COPPER CARROTS
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots
1  small green pepper
1  medium onion
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can tomato soup
1/3  c. salad oil
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper
preparation: Scrape and slice carrots.  Boil in salted water until tender. Then cool and drain.  Alternate layers of carrots, then green pepper rings and onion rings.  Make a marinade of remaining ingredients; beat well until blended.  Pour over vegetables and refrigerate.

name: CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour (self-rising)
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. oil or shortening
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. water
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1  stick oleo
4  Tbsp. cocoa
6  Tbsp. milk
1  box powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift together in a large bowl sugar and flour.  Mix and boil rapidly for 2 to 3 minutes the 1 stick oleo, oil or shortening, 4 tablespoons cocoa and water.  Pour boiling mixture over flour and sugar.  Mix well.  Add buttermilk, soda, cinnamon, eggs and vanilla.  Bake about 25 minutes at 350°.  Five minutes before cake is done, mix 1 stick oleo, 4 tablespoons cocoa and milk.  Bring to a boil and add powdered sugar and vanilla.  Spread on cake while hot.

name: CHICKEN-WILD RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. wild rice
3 to 4  c. diced, cooked chicken (about 2 lb.)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can chicken broth
1 (4.5 oz.)  jar sliced mushrooms, drained
1  c. diced celery
1/3  c. chopped onion
1 small  pkg. slivered almonds
crushed potato chips or cornflakes
preparation: Cook wild rice in 4 cups of water for about 45 minutes; drain. Saute onion and celery in 2 tablespoons butter.  Mix all soups together.  Blend all ingredients.  Season to taste (lemon pepper, parsley flakes, garlic powder, salt and pepper are what I use). Put in buttered casserole dish.  Top with crushed potato chips or cornflakes.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: CHEWY O'S
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  box cake mix (yellow or chocolate)
3  c. miniature marshmallows
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
3  c. Cheerios
1  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Melt butter and pour in 9 x 13-inch pan or jelly roll pan.  Cover bottom.  Sprinkle cake mix over butter. Sprinkle marshmallows, chocolate chips and Cheerios.

name: BROCCOLI TERRIFIC
ingredients:
1/2  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing
1  stick melted butter or margarine
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  boxes chopped broccoli, completely thawed
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  onion, minced
preparation: Mix above ingredients.  Bake, covered, for 15 minutes and uncovered for 30 minutes at 350°.  Makes 2-quart casserole.

name: DOTS SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1  medium carrot, grated
1  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Combine jello with 1 cup boiling water.  Drain pineapple; add cold water to juice to make 1 cup and add to jello.  Chill until partially set.  Soften cheese and whip together with mayonnaise. Add to jello and stir well.  Add other ingredients and chill until firm.

name: RICH CHOCOLATE CHESS PIE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa, heaping
3  Tbsp. flour, heaping
pinch of salt
4  eggs
1  stick softened margarine
1  c. evaporated milk
2  unbaked pie shells
preparation: Mix together thoroughly the dry ingredients.  Add remaining ingredients and beat with mixture until well blended.  Pour into unbaked pie shells.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar (large coffee c.)
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. melted shortening
4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together and let stand 1/2 hour.  Push by teaspoons on greased sheet.  Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH CRUNCHIES
ingredients:
1  (12 oz.) bag butterscotch chips
1/2  c. peanuts
1 (3 oz.)  can chow mein noodles
preparation: Place butterscotch chips in a medium, microwave-safe bowl. Cover and microwave on High for 2 minutes or until chips are melted.  Stir in peanuts and chow mein noodles and mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper.  Cool until hard.  Makes about 30.

name: ELEPHANT EARS
ingredients:
2  pkg. active dry yeast
3  c. warm water
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1 1/2  tsp. salt
7 to 8  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cinnamon
vegetable oil for deep frying
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, soften yeast in warm water.  Add sugar, butter and salt.  Stir in enough flour to make a soft dough.  Turn onto floured surface.  Knead until smooth and elastic.  Place in a greased bowl, turning to grease surface. Cover; refrigerate 3 hours.  Punch down dough.

name: ORANGE SHERBET
ingredients:
6 (10 oz.)  bottles orange soft drink
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 small  can crushed pineapple with liquid
preparation: Mix together.  Pour into a gallon freezer.  Add enough milk to bring mixture to full line.  Stir well.  Freeze.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE(Newfie Style)
ingredients:
1  lb. box casserole size elbow macaroni
1/2  lb. Colby cheese
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. milk
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  slices toasted whole wheat bread
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. diced onion (optional)
1  lb. can tomatoes
preparation: Boil macaroni and drain.  Add milk, butter, salt, pepper and onion.  Add cheese, but reserve a little for the top.  Be sure to stir occasionally as cheese melts.  Add toasted bread that has been broken into bite size pieces.  Add tomatoes and stir gently. Sprinkle cheese on top.  Bake at 350° to 375° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: CHEDDAR SOUP
ingredients:
1  c. minced carrots
1  c. diced celery
1  c. diced onion
1  c. green pepper, diced
1/2  c. margarine
dry sherry
1/2  c. flour
2  qt. chicken broth
6  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
4  c. evaporated milk
1/2  tsp. salt
white pepper
preparation: Saute carrots, celery, onion and pepper for about 5 minutes in butter.  Stir in flour until pasty.  Add chicken broth while stirring constantly.  Add cheese slowly until melted.  Add evaporated milk, salt and pepper.  If you want a smooth creamy soup, puree first 4 ingredients before mixing with flour, etc. Add 1/8 cup sherry just before serving.

name: COCKTAIL CREAM PUFFS
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1  c. water
1  c. flour
4  eggs
dash of salt
preparation: Boil margarine and water in saucepan until margarine is melted.  Add flour and salt all at once.  Beat mixture until it sticks together.  Cool.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each.  Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 425° for 10 minutes, then at 350° for 1/2 hour or until golden.  Cool. Cut in half and allow center to dry out.  Fill with chicken or tuna salad.

name: MIRACLE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1 large  can fruit
preparation: Mix and pour in pan in which 1 stick butter had been melted. Pour fruit on top.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

name: LEMON SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. butter, softened
2  eggs, lightly beaten
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
rind of 1/2 lemon
preparation: Mix with a spoon flour, powdered sugar and softened butter (not melted).  Press into ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan, covering bottom and sides to 1/2-inch of edge.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Hand mix the next 5 ingredients for 3 minutes or until light and fluffy.  Pour over hot crust.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until no imprint is left when touched.  Cover and cool overnight.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar and cut into squares. Serves 16.

name: CAFE VIENNA MIX
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. almond extract
1/4  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. instant coffee
1/2  c. nondairy creamer
1/2  c. instant nonfat dry milk powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Place sugar in a small bowl.  Sprinkle with almond and vanilla extracts.  Blend until no traces of moisture remain.  Add remaining ingredients.  Sift to blend.  Store in airtight container.  Makes 1 1/2 cups of mix.  To serve:  Add 3 teaspoons mix to 1 cup boiling water.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
3 1/2  sticks butter
3  c. graham cracker crumbs
2  c. powdered sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
5  bananas
1 (1 lb. 4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  envelopes Dream Whip
cherries (small jar)
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. pecan chips
preparation: Mix 1 1/2 sticks melted butter with graham cracker crumbs. Spread over bottom of container.  Refrigerate.  Mix 2 sticks melted butter, powdered sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Beat 20 minutes at medium speed.  Spread over crust.  Place sliced bananas lengthwise on filling.  Spread drained pineapple over bananas. Prepare Dream Whip as directed as package.  Spread over pineapple. Top with cherries and pecan chips.  Place cherries as centers of cutting squares.

name: SZECHWAN BEEF STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1  lb. beef flank steak
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
4  tsp. Oriental dark roasted sesame oil, divided
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. cornstarch
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1  Tbsp. minced fresh ginger
1/4  tsp. crushed red pepper pods
1  small red bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. frozen baby corn, defrosted
1/4  lb. pea pods
preparation: Cut beef steak lengthwise into 2 strips.  Slice across the grain into 1/8-inch thick strips.  Combine soy sauce, 2 teaspoons oil, sugar and cornstarch and stir into strips.

name: JACKIE B'S SEVEN MINUTE FROSTING
ingredients:
2  egg whites
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1/8  tsp. salt
1/4  c. water
1  c. Marshmallow Fluff
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine all ingredients except vanilla in top of a double boiler.  Place over boiling water.  Beat with mixer until mixture holds soft peaks.  Remove top of boiler; beat until mixture holds stiff peaks.  Beat in vanilla.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. rice
1/2  c. onions
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  pkg. chopped broccoli
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Saute onions and celery in butter or margarine.  Add soups and Cheez Whiz.  Cook rice and broccoli separately.  Add rice and broccoli to soup mixture.

name: CHOCOLATE ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo or oil
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. applesauce
2  eggs
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. buttermilk
2 1/2  c. flour
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. soda
2  c. grated zucchini
1/2  c. chocolate chips
1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Beat first 4 ingredients together well.  Add next 6 ingredients and stir well together.  Fold in zucchini, chocolate chips and nuts.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.  Makes 2 loaves (bread pan size).

name: HAMBURGER STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger or ground deer
1  medium onion, chopped
1/4  c. butter
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. garlic salt
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can mushrooms, drained
1  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
2 to 3  c. hot noodles
preparation: Cook and stir hamburger and onion in butter in 10-inch skillet until hamburger is light brown.  Stir in flour, salt, garlic, pepper and mushrooms.  Cook, stirring constantly, 5 minutes.  Stir in soup.  Heat to boiling, stirring constantly; reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes.  Stir in sour cream and heat thoroughly.  Serve over hot noodles.

name: COUNTRY FARE TURKEY
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. hot water
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
1 (4.8 oz.)  pkg. thin noodles with Parmesan sauce
2  c. chopped turkey
1/4  c. chopped, fresh basil
2  Tbsp. sliced green onions
preparation: In a 3-quart saucepan, combine hot water, milk and butter. Bring just to a boil.  Add pasta, contents of seasoning package, turkey or chicken, basil and green onions.  Reduce heat to medium, boil uncovered and stirring often for 5 to 7 minutes.  Pasta will be saucy, but will thicken upon standing.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. rice (uncooked)
1  c. water
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/3  c. melted margarine
1  pkg. frozen broccoli, thawed
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  can sliced water chestnuts
8  oz. Cheez Whiz
preparation: Lay in order in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for one hour.

name: BRISKET IN BEER
ingredients:
1  brisket
1  onion, sliced
1/4  c. chili sauce
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  minced garlic
1 (12 oz.)  can beer
preparation: Put sliced onion over brisket.  Mix all other ingredients and pour over brisket.  Cover; bake at 350° until tender.

name: EASY BRAN REFRIGERATED MUFFINS
ingredients:
9  c. Raisin Bran cereal
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  qt. buttermilk
5  c. flour
5  tsp. baking soda
1  c. salad oil
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: In a large bowl, mix dry ingredients, including nuts, if desired.  In second bowl, beat eggs well. Add oil and buttermilk to eggs.  Add to dry ingredients.  Mix well, but only until all ingredients are thoroughly blended.  Put in refrigerator in tightly covered container.  (Will keep up to 6 weeks.)  Fill muffin tins half full of batter.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 25 minutes.  I use a 5-quart ice cream pail to mix in and store batter in.

name: MARY PELT DESSERT
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. flour
1/2  c. chopped pecans
2 small  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
3  c. milk
8  oz. cream cheese
2  c. Cool Whip, divided
1  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Crust:  Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle 1 cup flour over melted margarine.  Add 1/2 cup chopped pecans on top of flour.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 20 minutes; watch.  Set aside to cool.

name: MONGOLIAN BEEF
ingredients:
1  lb. beef sirloin steak
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. soy sauce
1  green onion (with top)
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. chopped ginger root
1  tsp. chopped garlic
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
dash of white pepper
preparation: Trim fat from beef; cut beef with grain into 1/8-inch slices. Toss beef, cornstarch, 1 tablespoon oil, the salt, sugar, 1 teaspoon soy sauce and the white pepper in a bowl.  Cover and refrigerate 1 hour.  Cut green onion into 2-inch pieces.  Heat wok until 1 or 2 drops of water bubble and skitter when sprinkled in wok.  Add 3 tablespoons vegetable oil; rotate wok to coat side. Add ginger root and garlic.  Stir-fry until brown.  Add beef; stir-fry until beef is brown, about 3 minutes.  Add 1 tablespoon soy sauce; stir to coat beef.  Add green onion.  Stir-fry 30 seconds.

name: SOUPERIOR MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets Onion Soup Mix
2  pounds ground beef
3/4  cup plain dry bread crumbs, you may substitute 1 1/2 cups fresh baked crumbs or 5 slices fresh bread, cubed
2  eggs
3/4  c. water
1/3  c. ketchup
preparation: Preheat oven to 350.  In a large bowl, combine all ingredients.  In 9 X 13- inch baking or roasting pan, shape mixture into loaf.  Bake uncovered for 1 hour or until done.  Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. chopped cooled chicken
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies, drained
3  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. cumin
3/4  tsp. garlic salt
2 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  c. sour cream
1 1/2  c. (8 oz.) Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
12  (6-inch) corn tortillas
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large saucepan cook onion and green pepper in 2 tablespoons butter until tender.  Combine with chicken and green chillies in large bowl; set aside.

name: EASY MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup (Campbell's)
1  pouch onion soup mix (Campbell's)
2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. water
preparation: Mix thoroughly 1/2 cup mushroom soup, onion soup mix, beef, bread crumbs and egg.  In 2 quart oblong baking dish, firmly shape into 8 x 4-inch loaf.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours or until done. Spoon off fat; reserve 1 to 2 tablespoons drippings.  For gravy, in 1 quart saucepan, combine remaining soup, water and reserved drippings over low heat.  Heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally.

name: SLIMEY GOOP FOR KIDS(Also Called Gak)
ingredients:
4  oz. glue (school, Elmer's, etc.)
4  oz. water
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. Borax
food coloring
preparation: Mix together the glue and water.  Mix together the water, Borax and food coloring.  Stir mixtures together and watch Gak appear!  Great for Halloween parties.  For age 5 and up.

name: VEGGIE SQUARES
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  pkg. dry Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing
1  crescent rolls
assorted vegetables, finely chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix cream cheese, mayonnaise and salad dressing; set aside. Unroll crescent rolls and flatten on cookie sheet.  Bake 7 minutes at 375°.  Cool.  When cool, spread with cream cheese mixture.  Top with vegetables (carrots, radishes, broccoli, cauliflower, green pepper and mushrooms).  Add tomatoes, then Cheddar cheese.  Press down lightly.  Refrigerate.  Cut into squares and serve as appetizer.

name: CRISPY POTATO WEDGES
ingredients:
2  medium baking potatoes
1  medium sweet potato
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. paprika
3/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. dried thyme, crushed
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cut each potato lengthwise into 8 wedges (24 wedges total). On an ungreased 15 x 10 x 2-inch baking pan, arrange wedges in a single layer, skin side down.

name: GROUND BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. sugar
2 small  cans tomato sauce
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  carton sour cream
1/2  lb. grated sharp cheese
5  spring onions, tops and all, chopped fine
1  pkg. noodles
preparation: Brown  meat  and  add  next  4	ingredients.  Simmer 15 minutes.   Cook  noodles;  drain  and  set	aside.	Mix  cream cheese,  sour  cream, sharp cheese and onions together.  Place cooked noodles  in baking dish.  Add meat mixture and top with cheese mixture.  Bake  at  350° for 20 minutes or until heated thoroughly.  Best  to  make  the  day before cooking.  It also freezes well.

name: EASY VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
2 (13 3/4 oz.)  cans chicken broth
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed Italian or Spanish vegetables
1/3  c. catsup
1/4  c. macaroni (small)
2  Tbsp. dried celery flakes
1  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1  tsp. Italian salad dressing mix
preparation: In a large saucepan, combine all ingredients.  Bring to boiling.  Reduce heat. Cover and simmer until pasta is tender, about 30 minutes.  Makes 5 to 6 servings.

name: PEPPERMINT PUNCH
ingredients:
1/2  gal. peppermint ice cream, softened
1/2  gal. egg nog
48  oz. club soda, chilled
red food coloring
canned refrigerated whipped cream
1  c. crushed peppermint candy
small peppermint sticks
preparation: Spoon ice cream into a large punch bowl.  Add egg nog and chilled club soda, mixing well.  Add a few drops of red food coloring, enough to give punch a pink color, and stir.  Serve punch topped with whipped cream.  Sprinkle whipped cream with crushed candy and place a small peppermint stick in each cup as a stirring stick.

name: POTATO CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. Pringle's potato chips, finely crushed
preparation: Combine butter, sugar and flour.  Stir in chips and vanilla. Drop by teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° until lightly browned.  While still warm, sprinkle with sugar.

name: SHRIMP SCAMPI
ingredients:
2  lb jumbo shrimp
1-1/2  sticks butter
1/4  cup chopped onion
3  Tbsp minced garlic
1  tsp salt
1/8  tsp pepper
2  Tbsp lemon juice
1/4  cup chopped parsley
preparation: Shell and clean shrimp.  Sauté shrimp in butter with onion and garlic about 5 minutes; turn shrimp once.  Transfer shrimp to hot serving dish; set aside.  Add seasonings and lemon juice to skillet and heat.  Pour over shrimp and sprinkle with chopped parsley.  I serve over rice.

name: RICH PASTRY(Great With Strawberry Pie)
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. shortening
1  egg yolk
water
preparation: Sift together flour and salt into mixing bowl.  Cut in shortening (it will look like small peas).  Combine egg yolk and water; add to dry ingredients while tossing and stirring lightly with fork.  Add liquid to driest particles, pushing lumps to side until dough is just moist enough to hold together.  Form a ball and flatten to 1/2-inch thickness.  Roll out on floured surface to 1 1/2-inches larger than inverted pie pan.  Fit into pie pan and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 425° or until golden brown.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (16 oz.)  can cherry pie filling (you can use any pie filling you wish)
1  yellow cake mix
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
2  sticks butter or margarine
preparation: Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Drain pineapple and spread over bottom of pan, corner to corner.  Spread the pie filling the same. Dump the cake mix (dry) on top of the fruits.  Spread as evenly as possible. Sprinkle on the nuts.  Melt the butter and pour all over the top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Easy.

name: HAWAIIAN FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1/4  c. pineapple juice
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. salad oil
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. paprika
preparation: Combine ingredients; chill.  Shake or beat thoroughly before serving.  This recipe is adapted for use with mixed fruit salads. Makes 7 to 8 cups.

name: CHEESEBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  tsp. oregano
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. fine bread crumbs
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
2  c. grated sharp cheese
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. milk
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. chili sauce
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain.  Stir in oregano.  Stir in salt, pepper, onion, green pepper, bread crumbs and 1/2 cup tomato sauce.  Press into pie shell.

name: NO-FAT MATZOH BALLS
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. seltzer
salt
about 3/4 c. matzoh meal
boiling, salted water
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients.  Gradually stir in matzoh meal; keep stirring until mixture is pretty thick.  Refrigerate for about 1 hour.  Make balls about the size of large walnuts.  Drop into boiling, salted water.  Let boil for about 25 minutes.  Makes 10 to 12 rather large balls.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans
German chocolate cake mix
1  stick butter
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  box confectioners sugar
preparation: Grease 13 x 9-inch pan.  Sprinkle coconut and pecans in pan. Mix German chocolate cake according to box.  Pour over pecans and coconut.  Mix butter, cream cheese and confectioners sugar.  Pour over cake mix.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. sausage
2  medium onions, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. soy sauce
1  pkg. Lipton dry noodle soup mix
2  c. hot water
1  c. raw long grain rice
preparation: Fry sausage; drain.  Mix chopped onions, celery soup mix, hot water, soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce.  Place rice in bottom of 2-quart casserole, then the sausage.  Pour the soup and vegetable mixture over the sausage.  Place finely sliced almonds on top (optional).  Bake 45 minutes in 350° oven.  Stir well. Saute some more almonds and place on top.  Return to oven for an additional 15 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6 people.

name: FRENCH SILK PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. butter
3  squares unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
chocolate or graham cracker pastry crust
whipped cream
chocolate curls or sprinkles (optional)
preparation: Cream sugar and butter for 4 minutes or until light. Add unsweetened chocolate and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating on medium speed for 2 minutes after each egg, scraping bowl constantly. Turn filling into pie shell. Top with whipped cream, then curls or sprinkles if desired.

name: EGG DROP SOUP
ingredients:
3  c. seasoned chicken broth
1  egg
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Heat the chicken broth in pan.  Combine cornstarch and cold water and stir until smooth.  Stir into hot chicken broth and cook until slightly thickened, stirring constantly.  Beat egg with whisk until frothy.  Gently stir into simmering broth and turn off heat immediately.  Egg should float like a cloud to surface. Serve immediately.  Serves 2.

name: PEAR BREAD
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
3  c. sugar
3  c. pears, peeled, grated and drained
3  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. cooking oil
1 1/2  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
6  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
4 1/2  c. flour
3  c. ground pecans
preparation: Mix eggs with next four ingredients; beat well.  Add dry ingredients and beat well.  Stir in pecans last.  Pour into three generously greased and floured loaf pans.  Bake at 320° for 1 hour and 15 minutes, until done.  Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

name: LAMB SHANKS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oil
4  lamb shanks
1  carrot, chopped
1  rib celery, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  yellow turnip, cubed
salt and pepper
1/4  tsp. thyme
1 1/2  c. chicken broth or water
3/4  c. rice
1/2  lb. green beans, cut in 1 1/2-inch pieces
2  ripe tomatoes, quartered
preparation: Heat oil in a heavy casserole.  Brown lamb on all sides. Remove from pan.  Add carrot, celery, onion and turnip; turn to glaze in fat.  Then return lamb to pan.  Add seasonings and broth; cover and cook until lamb is tender, about 1 hour.  Add rice, raising lamb so that rice is submerged in liquid.  (Add more broth if necessary, to cover rice by 1 inch.)  Add beans and tomatoes. Cover pan tightly.  Return to boil, then simmer about 20 minutes, stirring once, until rice is done and lamb is very tender.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
4  egg yolks
1  c. milk
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Combine sugar, flour, salt, cocoa, milk, butter and egg yolks and cook until thick.  Add vanilla and pour into cooked and cooled pie shell.  Beat egg whites and add 3 to 5 tablespoons sugar. Beat until stiff and mound on top of pie.  Bake until brown in 325° oven.

name: CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. cinnamon or nutmeg
2  c. hot milk
1  (8-inch) unbaked pie crust
preparation: Beat eggs, add sugar, salt, cinnamon or nutmeg and milk.  Mix well.  Pour into unbaked crust.  Place in a very hot oven at 450° for 10 minutes.  Decrease heat to 325° and cook until set, about 30 minutes.

name: LAZY PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  stick oleo
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. self-rising flour
1/2  c. milk
1  pt. fresh or canned peaches
preparation: Melt oleo in casserole dish. Make batter using sugar, milk and flour. Pour this over the oleo. Do not stir. Pour sweetened peaches over batter. Do not stir. Bake at 350° about 1 hour.

name: NO FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. Crisco shortening
1/2  c. cold water
preparation: Make a well in your bowl with flour and mix with pastry or dough tool.  Roll out on floured board ready for pie tin.

name: BROCCOLI WITH OIL AND LEMON
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. fresh broccoli, cut into spears
3  Tbsp. olive or vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat 1 inch water (salted if desired) to boiling.  Add broccoli.  Heat to boiling; reduce heat.  Cover and cook 12 to 15 minutes or just until stems are tender; drain.  Mix remaining ingredients; pour over broccoli.  Makes 6 servings.

name: BAKED HAM AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. honey
1/4  c. butter, melted
1/3  c. green pepper
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1  c. dried apricots, cooked and drained
3  c. leftover cooked ham
2  tsp. soy sauce
2  c. rice
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large bowl, combine honey, butter, green pepper, soy sauce and mustard; mix well.  Add remaining ingredients; toss lightly to mix well.  Turn into lightly greased 2-quart casserole; bake, covered, about 1 hour.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: MILLION DOLLAR PIE
ingredients:
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 small  can coconut
1  can condensed milk
1  c. pecans
1/4  c. lemon juice
9  oz. whipped topping
2  cooked pie crusts
preparation: Combine   all  ingredients  well.  Pour  into  the  pie crusts.  Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

name: SOUR CREAM 'N' DILL CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  to 10 chicken pieces, skinned (may use pork cutlets, good!)
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
1  envelope dry onion soup mix
1  c. (8 oz.) sour cream
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. fresh dill, chopped or 1 tsp. dill weed
1 (4 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms, drained
paprika
cooked wide egg noodles (optional)
preparation: Place chicken in a single layer in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Sprinkle with pepper.  Combine soup, soup mix, sour cream, lemon juice, dill and mushrooms; pour over chicken.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour or until chicken is tender.  Serve over egg noodles if desired.  Yield:  4 to 6 servings.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS SUPREME
ingredients:
3  chicken breasts, cut in half
1/2  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/4  c. margarine
preparation: Cut chicken breasts in half and pat dry with cloth or paper towels.  In a large bowl, combine sour cream, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.  Add chicken and coat each piece well.  Refrigerate overnight.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Roll chicken in bread crumbs.  Arrange in single layer in baking dish. Melt margarine and spoon half over chicken.  Bake for 45 minutes. Turn chicken and spoon on rest of margarine.  Bake another 10 to 15 minutes until brown and tender.

name: CHERRY DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1  stick butter
1  can pineapple (crushed)
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Use an oblong pan.  Place cherry pie filling and pineapple in pan.  Mix well. Dump the box of cake mix on top of the cherries (dry cake mix).  Slice butter and place in chunks on top of cake mix. Bake in oven for 1 hour.

name: VERY BERRY SURPRISE
ingredients:
2  pkg. blackberry or black cherry Jell-O
1  c. blueberries
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
1  large sour cream
1  c. sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Drain blueberries and pineapple (save juice).  Mix Jell-O with package directions (hot water only).  Add juice from berries and pineapple.  Let jell.  Add pineapple and blueberries to Jell-O. Mix remaining ingredients together.  Top chilled Jell-O mixture and chill.

name: PEAR RELISH
ingredients:
7  c. pears
1  c. green pepper
2  sweet red peppers
1 1/2  c. white onions
2 1/2  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. allspice
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1  Tbsp. turmeric
1  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
preparation: Wash and pare pears; cut in quarters.  Wash and cut open peppers; remove seeds.  Peel onions.  Run pears, peppers and onions through food chopper.  Place in large kettle.  Add sugar, salt, turmeric and spice.  Blend thoroughly.  Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer slowly for 30 minutes.  Pack hot in pints.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  c. water
3  c. raw peanuts
3  T. butter
2  t. soda
1/2  t. vanilla
preparation: Boil sugar, syrup and water until thread spins or 250 degrees on candy thermometer.  Then add peanuts and stir continuously after peanuts are added.  Cook until temperature reaches 300. Take from heat, add butter, and soda.  Pour onto buttered cookie sheet to cool.

name: PASTA IN CREAMY DILL SAUCE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. garlic, finely chopped
1  c. heavy cream
salt and pepper to taste
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. fresh dill
1/2  c. diced tomatoes
preparation: Melt butter with garlic in pan.  Add cream, salt, pepper and Parmesan cheese.  Stir until cheese is melted.  Reduce heat; add fresh dill and diced tomatoes.  Remove from heat and gently pour over pasta.  Excellent over spinach fettucini or other flavored pastas.

name: FRUITCAKE BARS
ingredients:
2  c. raisins
1/4  c. bourbon
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
3/4  c. butter
2  c. chopped, candied cherries
3/4  c. citron
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  c. brown sugar
3  eggs
2  c. pecans
preparation: Soak the raisins in the bourbon for 1 hour.  Set aside.  Cream the butter, sugar and eggs.  Sift dry ingredients and mix together. Add fruits and pecans.  Bake at 350° in jelly roll pan 25 to 30 minutes or until firm.

name: QUICK PEANUT BUTTER KISS COOKIES
ingredients:
1  roll peanut butter cookie dough
1  pkg. chocolate kisses (unwrapped)
preparation: Scoop dough into rounded tablespoonfuls and roll in sugar. Cook as package directs.  Take from oven and quickly press a kiss into center, pushing down firmly.  This is good to keep on hand for unexpected company.

name: JELLY BEAN CONFETTI CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
3/4  c. miniature jelly beans, halved
1  c. sugar
1  c. butter, softened
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
powdered sugar
preparation: Heat oven to 325°.  Grease and flour tube pan.  Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup.  Level off.

name: SUPER FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans chunk pineapple, drained
2 (11 oz.)  cans Mandarin oranges, drained
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries or 1 pt. fresh
4  bananas, sliced
1 (21 oz.)  can peach pie filling
preparation: In large bowl, mix pineapple, oranges, strawberries and bananas.  Pour pie filling over fruit and stir until just mixed. Chill.  Yields 2-quart bowl full.

name: GUMDROP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
2  c. quick oats
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  c. chopped gum drops
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
walnuts (if desired)
preparation: Cream shortening and sugars until creamy.  Add eggs and beat well.  Add all other ingredients, mixing well.  Using a teaspoon of batter, form a ball.  Place on greased cookie sheet and mash with fork.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

name: NEW YEAR'S DAY DIP
ingredients:
1  can black-eye peas
1  can jalapeno black-eye peas
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
Tostitos
preparation: Mix peas and tomatoes.  Serve with Tostitos as they have just the right amount of salt.

name: HAYSTACKS
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch morsels
2  jars peanut butter
1 small  can shoestring potatoes
preparation: Melt morsels in a double boiler.  When melted, put in a bowl. Add peanut butter and shoestring potatoes; mix.  Drop by teaspoons on wax paper.

name: PUMPKIN BARS
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten well
2  c. sugar
2  c. canned pumpkin
1  c. salad oil
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. each:  ginger, cloves and nutmeg
preparation: Sift together last 5 ingredients.  Grease and flour a jelly roll pan (10 1/2 x 15 x 1-inch).  Set oven at 325°.  Mix eggs, sugar, pumpkin and oil.  Add sifted dry ingredients and mix well. Pour into prepared pan and bake 30 minutes or until done.  Do not overbake!  Cool, frost and cut.  These freeze well frosted or not.

name: SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/4  c. pancake mix
2  tsp. ground ginger
1  lb. chicken pieces, cut into 3/4-inch sq.
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  can pineapple chunks (reserve syrup)
1/4  c. vinegar
1/4  c. soy sauce
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire
1/3  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  green pepper, cut in strips
1  can bean sprouts
1  can water chestnuts
1  Tbsp. chili sauce
3  c. cooked rice
preparation: Mix 2 tablespoons pancake flour and ginger; coat chicken pieces.  Fry in skillet until brown.  Add water to syrup to make 1 cup.  Add to it rest of pancake mix.  Cover in tightly covered container and shake.  Stir mixture with vinegar, soy sauce and Worcestershire into fat in skillet.  Heat to boil, stirring constantly.  Boil 1 minute.  Reduce heat.  Add sugar, salt, pepper and chicken.  Cover.  Simmer 45 minutes.  Add pineapple and green pepper.  Cook, uncovered, 10 minutes more.  Stir in water chestnuts, bean sprouts and chili sauce.  Serve over rice.

name: EGG ROLL(Lumpia)
ingredients:
1/2  c. lean ground pork
1/2  c. chopped tiny shrimp
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
50  pieces egg roll wrappers
oil (for deep fat frying)
preparation: Mix thoroughly all ingredients except for egg roll wrappers and oil for frying.  Take a heaping tablespoonful and roll in egg roll wrapper.  Make a long roll about 3/4-inch in diameter.  Deep fat fry.  Serve with soy sauce or sweet and sour sauce.

name: GERKEN SALAT(Cucumber Salad)
ingredients:
2  medium cucumbers
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar (I use white)
1 1/2  tsp. salt
parsley or dill weed (optional)
sliced onions (optional)
preparation: Peel and slice cucumbers. Mix other ingredients and pour over cucumbers and chill.

name: RICH AND CREAMY FUDGE
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
12  oz. semi-sweet chocolate chips
2  large eggs
4  c. powdered sugar
1 1/2  tsp. pure vanilla extract
1  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
preparation: In small saucepan, melt margarine and chocolate chips, stirring until smooth.

name: STUFFED SNAPPER
ingredients:
1  (2 lb.) snapper
1/2  lb. crabmeat
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
1/2  onion, chopped
3  slices toast
salt and pepper to taste
tomato sauce
preparation: Wet and  crumble  toast.  Mix  crabmeat,  bell	pepper, onion and toast  together.  Salt	and  pepper  to  taste.  Put snapper on baking  pan.  Cover snapper with stuffing mix.  Top with tomato sauce.  Bake at 375° until fish is done.

name: NOODLE SALAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. canola oil
1 1/2  Tbsp. white vinegar
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  pkg. chicken-flavored Ramen noodles, broken up (do not use enclosed seasoning packet)
1 to 2  c. chopped lettuce greens (any kind you desire)
2  green onions, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
1  can mandarin oranges, well drained and chilled (small or large can, depending on how much lettuce you use)
sliced almonds (as many or as few as desired)
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients together for dressing and chill.

name: DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. plain flour
1 1/2  pkg. yeast
1  stick margarine
1 1/2  c. milk
2  tsp. Crisco oil
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt margarine.  Mix all other ingredients.  Add margarine. Let dough rise for 2 hours.  Take small amount of dough, twist and tie dough in various shapes.  Let rolls set for another 2 hours. Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes or until done.  Yields about 3 dozen rolls.

name: TERIYAKI MARINADE
ingredients:
1  c. pineapple juice
1  c. soy sauce
2  cloves minced garlic
1  c. red Burgundy wine
preparation: Mix all together.  Marinate 24 hours with beef, chicken or pork.  Grill on a barbecue or gas grill.

name: SOLE FLORENTINE(For 4)
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  cans clam juice
1  lb. sole (can use other fish)
2  pkg. leaf spinach, cooked and drained
1  lb. cooked shrimp
preparation: Roll up fish filets and place in pan with clam juice and simmer about 4 minutes or until cooked. Place drained spinach in 8 x 8 casserole and place sole rolls on top. Sprinkle with shrimp. Pour Sauce over top. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 425° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: HAM AND POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup or mushroom soup
3  c. frozen hash browns
1-1/2  c. cubed ham
1-1/2  c. shredded Colby-Jack cheese
1  c. crushed croutons
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°. Combine sour cream and soup in a 9 x 9 inch pan. Add hash browns, ham and cheese. Cover and bake for 50 minutes, stirring once at 25 minutes. Remove from oven when hot and bubbly. Sprinkle with crushed croutons, let stand 10 minutes before serving.

name: Gigi's Apricot Nut Bread
ingredients:
1/2  cup Dried Apricots
1  Egg
1  cup Granulated Sugar
2  Tbsp. Melted Butter
2  cups All Purpose Flour
1/2  tsp. Salt
2  tsp. Baking Powder
1/4  tsp. Baking Soda
1/2  cup Orange Juice
1/4  cup Water
1  cup Chopped Nuts
preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.

name: OATMEAL PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. dark corn syrup
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. quick oatmeal
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. butter
3  eggs, well beaten
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
preparation: Mix all ingredients together; put in unbaked pie shell.  Bake 45 to 50 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: CHEESE WAFERS
ingredients:
2  sticks butter, softened
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  c. Rice Krispies
2  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. crushed red pepper
1  tsp. hot sauce
preparation: Mix all together; form	into  small balls.  Place balls on ungreased cookie sheet and	press  down with fork.	Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Yield: 100.

name: SPRINGTIME LAYERED DESSERT
ingredients:
1 (4 serving)  pkg. Jell-O lemon flavor gelatin
1 (4 serving)  pkg. Jell-O orange flavor gelatin
2  c. boiling water, divided
1  c. cold water, divided
3  c. marshmallows
2 1/2  c. halved strawberries
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip, thawed
preparation: Dissolve lemon and orange gelatin separately in 1 cup of the boiling water each.  Add 1/2 cup cold water to each.  Pour each into separate 9 x 5-inch loaf pan; refrigerate until firm.  Cut into 1-inch cubes.  Layer 1/2 each of the gelatin cubes, marshmallows, strawberries and whipped topping in 2-quart serving bowl; repeat layers.  Refrigerate.  Garnish with additional marshmallows.

name: BANANA SPLIT PIE
ingredients:
2  graham cracker crusts
2  c. powdered sugar
2  eggs
2  sticks margarine
1  large container Cool Whip
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
bananas
pecans (small can)
cherries
preparation: Combine sugar, eggs and margarine in mixer.  Beat at high speed for 15 minutes.  Pour over graham cracker crust.  Slice bananas over mixture.  Put pineapple over this, then Cool Whip, then nuts, then cherries.  Makes 2 pies.

name: GARLIC BUBBLE LOAF
ingredients:
1  loaf frozen white bread dough (thaw as directed on package)
1/4  c. oleo, melted
1  egg, beaten
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1/4  tsp. salt (optional)
preparation: Blend together oleo, egg, garlic powder, parsley flakes and salt (optional).  Cut off or tear off small pieces of dough, about the size of walnuts.  Dip into oleo mixture.  Place pieces of dough into greased loaf pan until all dough is used up.  Cover; let rise until doubled in size.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.  Remove from pan; cool slightly.

name: ECLAIR PIE
ingredients:
1  c. water
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
2  boxes instant vanilla pudding
1  stick margarine
4  eggs
1  c. flour
1  pt. heavy cream
1  tub chocolate frosting
preparation: Bring to a boil the water, margarine and salt.  Remove from heat.  Add the flour; mix well.  Add 4 eggs, one at a time.  Mix well each time.  Spread onto round cookie sheet.   Make sides higher than middle.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.  Turn off oven; let set in oven with door open for 15 minutes.  Mix the instant pudding, 1 cup milk and the heavy cream.  Beat for 3 minutes. Pour onto crust.  Microwave the chocolate frosting for 45 seconds; stir, then pour over top.  Chill for 2 hours.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  to 6 medium squash
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  c. canned milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. onion
1/2  tsp. pepper
5  double saltines crackers, crumbled or 1 c. Pepperidge Farm stuffing
4  slices cheese, broken in pieces
preparation: Wash and trim squash.  Cover with water; boil until done.  Add onion.  Drain well.  Mix all ingredients.  Place in 2-quart baking dish.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS DIANE
ingredients:
4  large boneless chicken breast halves or 8 small
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. black pepper
2  Tbsp. salad oil
2  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. chopped chives
juice of 1/2 lemon
3  Tbsp. chopped parsley
2  tsp. Dijon style mustard
1/4  c. chicken broth
preparation: Place chicken breast halves between sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap.  Pound slightly with mallet.  Sprinkle with salt and black pepper.  Heat 1 tablespoon each of oil and butter in large skillet.  Cook chicken over high heat for 4 minutes on each side. Do not cook longer or they will be overcooked and dry.  Transfer to warm serving platter.  Add chives, lemon juice (if used), parsley and mustard to pan.  Cook 15 seconds, whisking constantly. Whisk in broth.  Stir until sauce is smooth.  Whisk in remaining butter and oil.  Pour sauce over chicken.  Serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.

name: PINEAPPLE, STRAWBERRY AND CHERRY CONSERVE
ingredients:
1  qt. strawberries
1  qt. sour cherries or 2 c. canned pie cherries
2  c. pineapple tidbits
1  orange
sugar
preparation: Prepare berries and cherries; drain pineapple.  Slice orange very thin.  Combine fruits; weigh and add equal weight of sugar. Cook slowly until mixture thickens when a little is tested on a cold plate.  Pour into hot glasses and cover with paraffin.  This is delicious served with cream cheese and crackers.

name: CHOCOLATE MARSHMALLOW COOKIES
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. milk
about 17 marshmallows, cut in half
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add vanilla and egg; mix well. Add mixed dry ingredients and milk (dough will be thick).  Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 8 minutes, then press marshmallows (cut side down) on top.  Bake 2 minutes more.  Cool and frost with chocolate icing.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1 small  can crushed pineapple
2  c. chopped walnuts
2  tsp. finely chopped onion
1  Tbsp. Lawry's seasoned salt
preparation: Drain pineapple and soften the cheese.  Combine all of the ingredients, but use only 1 cup of the nuts.  Chill until firm enough to shape into 1 or 2 balls.  Roll balls in the remaining cup of nuts.  Best made a day ahead of serving.

name: FILLED CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1  pkg. devil's food cake mix
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. sugar
1  large egg
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
preparation: Prepare cake mix according to package directions.  Spoon batter into paper-lined muffin tins, filling 2/3 full.  Beat cream cheese and sugar until fluffy; add egg, beating well.  Stir in chocolate morsels.  Spoon 1 heaping tablespoon of this mixture into center of each cupcake.  Bake in 350° oven for 25 minutes.  Remove from pan and let cool before storing in the refrigerator.

name: ITALIAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  lb. jar Ragu spaghetti sauce
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese, grated
8  oz. carton sour cream
8  oz. can crescent dinner rolls
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: In frypan, brown ground beef and onion and drain.  Stir in spaghetti sauce and simmer 10 minutes.  Pour hot meat mixture into ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise or light mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. wine vinegar
1/3  c. sugar
4  to 6 fresh spears broccoli
1/2  c. chopped red onion
1  c. dark raisins
1  c. Spanish peanuts or party nuts
preparation: Mix the mayonnaise, wine vinegar and sugar together and set aside.  Rinse the bunch of broccoli spears and then cut into bite size, using the tops only.  Add the chopped red onion and raisins. Mix and toss with dressing mixture and serve cold.  Add the nuts right before serving.

name: COLD CARROT SALAD
ingredients:
3  lb. cleaned carrots
1  large sliced onion
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3/4  c. vinegar
1  sliced green pepper
1  can tomato soup
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. mustard
1/2  c. salad oil
preparation: Cook carrots until just tender.  Drain and set aside to cool. Mix remaining ingredients.  Stir and add carrots.  Refrigerate at least 24 hours.  Lasts up to two weeks.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, baked and deboned
1  c. seedless white grapes
1  c. seedless purple grapes
3/4  c. slivered almonds
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sour cream
seasoning salt
pepper to taste
preparation: Cut deboned chicken into small chunks and place in large bowl. Cut grapes in half and place in bowl.  Add almonds, mayonnaise and sour cream.  Mix well.  Add seasoning salt and pepper.  Mix and serve.

name: MEXICAN SURPRISE
ingredients:
1  can jalapeno bean dip
1  c. sour cream
1  c. Hellmann's salad dressing
diced green peppers
chopped tomatoes
chopped green onions
1  c. Cheddar or Monterey cheese, grated
Doritos or corn chips (to dip)
preparation: Spread jalapeno bean dip on plate, then alternate ingredients in layers as listed.  Dip with chips.

name: RAISIN CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. box raisins
2  c. water
1 1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. baking soda
3  c. flour
1  c. cold water
1/2  c. Crisco
preparation: Cook raisins in 2 cups of water for 20 minutes.  While they are cooking, mix together the sugar, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, ginger, salt, baking soda and flour; set aside.  When raisins have cooked, add to mixture.   Add cold water and Crisco.  Add the dry ingredients, stirring them until well blended.  Since the raisin mixture will still be fairly hot, no real beating is necessary and the cake takes just a matter of minutes to mix.  Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan and bake in a 350° oven for about 35 to 40 minutes or until the cake springs back when touched in the middle.

name: ALMOND BARK TREATS
ingredients:
peanut butter
Ritz crackers
1 1/2  lb. pkg. almond bark
preparation: Sandwich two Ritz crackers together with a generous amount of peanut butter.  Using tongs, dip crackers into melted almond bark. Place on wax paper to harden.  Refrigerate 1/2 hour or place briefly in freezer to harden more quickly.

name: ORANGE AND LEMON JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. orange jello
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. boiling water
13 1/2  oz. can crushed pineapple
1 small  can frozen orange juice concentrate
1  can mandarin oranges
8  oz. Cool Whip
1  pkg. instant lemon pudding
1  c. milk
preparation: Dissolve jello and sugar in boiling water.  Add crushed pineapple, orange juice and mandarin oranges.  Pour in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Make pudding with 1 cup milk.  Combine with Cool Whip. Spread over set jello and let cool in refrigerator.

name: HEARTY BEEF/POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. (1/2 of 30 oz.) frozen potato rounds
1  lb. hamburger
10  oz. thawed broccoli
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
1  medium tomato, chopped
1  can cream of celery soup
1/3  c. milk
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Spray dish with Pam.  Place potatoes on bottom and sides of 8 x 12-inch casserole dish.  Bake uncovered at 400° for 10 minutes. Brown meat in large chunks (drain grease).  Place beef, broccoli and 1/2 can of French fried onion rings and tomatoes in potato shell.  Combine soup, milk, 1/2 cup cheese and seasonings; pour over beef mixture.  Bake uncovered at 400° for 20 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onion.  Bake uncovered 2 to 3 minutes until cheese is melted.

name: BEEF ROULADEN(Contest Winner)
ingredients:
10  slices round steak, cut in 3 x 6 x 1/4-inch thick
6 large  slices bacon, chopped
1  large onion, chopped
2  beef bouillon cubes
1/4  c. bacon drippings or oil
2  c. water
1/2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. sour cream
sliced mushrooms (optional)
dill pickle spears (optional) *
preparation: Pound meat very thin until almost double in size.  Salt and pepper.  Saute bacon and onion.  Spread 1 tablespoon of bacon mixture on each slice, spreading evenly.  Roll meat slices and tie with butchers string or secure with toothpicks.  Heat oil or drippings in large skillet.  Fry rolls until brown.  Reduce heat to low and add water and bouillon until covered.  Cover and cook until tender, approximately 1 hour.  Remove rolls from pan.  Skim off any fat.  Mix 2 tablespoons flour to little water until smooth.   Add to skillet and cook until thick.  Add salt and pepper as needed.  Add sour cream and mix well.  Return rolls (without picks or string) until warm.  Do not boil.

name: MUSHROOM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  cans mushrooms (save 1 can liquid)
3  eggs
25  soda crackers, crushed
1/2  c. canned milk
4  oz. Velveeta cheese, diced
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  large onion
preparation: Beat eggs.  Combine with all ingredients.  Pour into greased casserole.  Bake, covered, thirty minutes at 350°.  Uncover and bake a few minutes longer.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP MUFFINS
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1  c. light brown sugar
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. milk
2  large eggs
1/2  c. melted butter
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  c. chocolate chips
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Combine flour, baking powder, brown sugar and salt.  Make a well in center.  In separate bowl, combine milk, eggs, vanilla and melted butter; cool slightly.  Add to flour mixture; stir with fork until just combined.  Fold in nuts and chips; stir as little as possible.  Divide batter equally into lined muffin pan. Sprinkle with sugar.  Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes, or until done.

name: BLUEBERRY DREAM WHIP
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  pkg. Dream Whip
1  c. cold milk
1/2  c. sugar
1  can blueberry pie filling
preparation: Mix graham cracker crumbs, sugar and butter.  Mix cream cheese, Dream Whip, cold milk and sugar.  Using a 9 x 13 x 2-inch Pyrex dish, layer as follows:  Graham cracker mixture, Dream Whip mixture, blueberries, Dream Whip mixture and graham cracker mixture.  Let stand in refrigerator overnight.

name: Parmesan CHIPS
ingredients: 2  c. (8 oz.) Parmesan cheese, shredded
preparation: Line a baking pan with parchment paper.  Spread grated cheese on paper, leaving 1/4-inch at edges.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Cool completely.  Break into chips.  Good for dips and soups.

name: EASY CHICKEN APPETIZERS
ingredients:
4  to 6 chicken breasts, deboned and cut into bite size pieces
Hidden Valley Ranch mix (original)
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
turmeric
salt, pepper and flour
preparation: Mix buttermilk and dressing mix.  Pour over chicken, cover and let stand overnight or several hours in refrigerator.  Mix flour, salt, pepper and turmeric.  Dip chicken in dry mixture and deep fry until golden brown.

name: CHICKEN CHINOISE(Serves 6)
ingredients:
3  skinless, boneless chicken breasts
1/2  c. diced celery
1  c. blanched green beans
1/2  c. chopped scallions
1  can chopped water chestnuts, drained
1  c. chopped mushrooms
1  c. chicken stock
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
6  Tbsp. cold water
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. fresh ginger, grated
2 to 3  Tbsp. peanut oil
preparation: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Heat the oil to very hot in a wok or large skillet.  Add the chicken and cook for 1 minute.  Add the rest of the vegetables and ginger.  Cook for 2 minutes longer.  Add the chicken stock.

name: CHERRY SQUARES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  Tbsp. lemon extract
1  c. butter
2  c. flour
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Add sugar and butter in a large bowl.  Cream until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.  Add flour and extract.  Pour batter into well-greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Mark the batter very lightly into squares.  Put 1 tablespoon filling into each square.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
3  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. chopped nuts
2  c. sugar
3  c. flour, sifted
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. grated zucchini, raw, peeled
1 1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Beat eggs until light and foamy, add sugar, oil, zucchini and vanilla and mix lightly but well.  Combine and add dry ingredients, stir until well blended.  Add nuts.  Bake in 2 loaf pans 9 x 5 x 3 inch. in a 350° oven for 1 hour.  Cool on rack.

name: FARMER'S BREAD WITH HAM, CHEESE AND WHITE SAUCE
ingredients:
8 thick  slices farmer's bread, toasted
8  slices ham
1 1/2  c. Monterey Jack cheese, grated
1  can white sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Arrange 8 slices of farmer's bread on cookie sheet.  Cover farmer's bread with 2 slices each of ham; top with 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese.  Salt and pepper all 8 slices.  Close sandwiches.  Spoon white sauce over each sandwich.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Broil for 4 minutes in oven until bubbly. Serve at once.  Makes 4 servings.

name: SWEET AND SOUR PORK
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
3/4  lb. boneless pork, cubed
1  c. green and red peppers, cubed
1/4  c. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1 1/2  c. Minute rice
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1  can pineapple chunks in juice
preparation: Heat oil in large skillet.  Add pork.  Stir-fry until well browned.  Add peppers.  Stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes.  Mix soy sauce, brown sugar, vinegar, cornstarch, garlic powder, ginger and pineapple chunks in juice.  Add to the skillet.  Bring to a boil. Cook rice.  Serve pork mixture over rice.

name: COCONUT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2/3  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. coconut
preparation: Mix and roll into round rolls.  Chill.  Slice.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  c. potato flakes
1  c. water
1  c. milk
