cream of celery soup
cream of chicken soup
cream of mushroom soup
1 1/2  cans Cheddar cheese soup
sliced cheese
salt
pepper
broccoli, cooked
preparation: Make instant potato soup from first 3 ingredients.  Add soups, salt, pepper and broccoli.  Warm to desired temperature.  Serve.

name: FRIED GREEN TOMATOES
ingredients:
6  large green tomatoes
1  c. corn meal
2  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper to taste
cooking oil
preparation: Slice tomatoes into thick slices.  Season tomatoes with salt and pepper.  Mix in tomatoes into meal and flour.  Mix well.  Take tomatoes out of mixture.  Put into oil.  Cook until golden brown. Serve warm.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE
ingredients:
1 (18 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli cuts
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
preparation: In a saucepan, cook broccoli according to package directions; drain. Add rice and soup. Cook until heated through.

name: WINTER VEGETABLE STEW
ingredients:
2  tablespoons olive oil
3  cloves garlic, smashed
1  lb mushrooms, halved
1  medium zucchini, cut into 1 inch pieces
1  medium onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
1  can chick peas, drained
1  1/2 teaspoons cumin
1- 28 oz  can of diced tomatoes
2  tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped
preparation: In a medium sauce pot over a moderate heat, sauté garlic and mushrooms in the olive oil for 2-3 minutes.  Add in zucchini and onion.  Season with salt and pepper.  Sauté for another 5 minutes. Add in chick peas, cumin, tomatoes, an rosemary.  Bring this to a stew to bubble, reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.

name: CREPES
ingredients:
1  egg
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. flour, sifted
butter (for frying)
powdered sugar
jelly
preparation: Combine egg, milk and flour.  Beat with a whisk.  Melt butter in frying pan and pour batter, using 1/4 cup for each crepe into pan.  When finished, fill crepe with jelly.   Roll it up and sprinkle with powdered sugar.  Enjoy!

name: CRANBERRY DELIGHT SALAD
ingredients:
6  oz. pkg. raspberry Jell-O
1 1/4  c. hot water
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1 (16 oz.)  can whole cranberry sauce
4  oz. Philadelphia cream cheese
8  oz. sour cream
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Melt Jell-O in hot water.  Then add crushed pineapple and cranberry sauce.  Stir until mixture is evenly distributed. Refrigerate until firm.

name: VEGETABLE AND CHEESE OMELETTE(Low-Fat)
ingredients:
1  whole egg
1  egg white
splash of low-fat milk
1/4  c. mushrooms
1/4  c. tomatoes
1/3  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1/4  c. green pepper
preparation: Heat pan to medium temperature.  Saute vegetables in oil until soft.  In a bowl, whip whole egg, egg white and milk until fluffy. Remove vegetables from pan and begin cooking egg on low heat. After about 2 minutes, add vegetables and shredded cheese.  Season to taste.  Cover and continue to cook until egg is firm and cheese melted.  Slip spatula under half of firm omelette and fold over. Slide out of pan onto plate.

name: ROCKY ROAD CANDY(This is a microwave recipe.)
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
1/2  c. butter
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  pkg. miniature marshmallows
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In a 4-quart microwave-proof mixing bowl, combine chocolate, butterscotch and butter.  Cook on 70 (Roast) for 5 minutes or until melted.  Stir.  Fold in marshmallows and nuts.  Spread in a buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.  Refrigerate until set (about 2 hours). Cut into squares.  Makes 45 servings.

name: OVEN POTATOES
ingredients:
1 (2 lb.)  pkg. frozen hash brown or cubed potatoes
1  pkg. (1 c.) grated cheese
3  cans cream of potato soup
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Mix all together and let stand for a while for flavors to mix. Use 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 300° for 2 hours.  Serves 9 to 12.

name: AWESOME ICED TEA
ingredients:
8  tea bags
1  c. sugar
1  gal. water
1 (6 oz.)  can concentrated lemonade
preparation: Place tea bags in pan. Add only enough water to cover bags and bring to a boil. Remove tea bags and add sugar. Add mix to 1 gallon of water. Stir in lemonade and chill.

name: HOT PRETZELS(Bridgette's favorite table scraps.)
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1 1/2  c. warm water
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
4  c. unsifted flour
beaten egg
salt
preparation: Pour warm water into measuring glass, sprinkle in yeast.  Pour into bowl; add sugar and salt.  Stir in flour.  Turn dough onto floured surface.  Knead until smooth, about 5 to 10 minutes. Divide into sections and shape into pretzels.  Put on greased cookie sheet.  Brush with egg and sprinkle with coarse salt.  Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.  Makes 1 dozen.

name: NO-COOK MINT PATTIES
ingredients:
1/3  c. light corn syrup
1/4  c. butter, softened
1  tsp. peppermint extract
1/2  tsp. salt
1  lb. sifted powdered sugar (4 3/4 c.)
red and green food coloring
preparation: Blend the corn syrup, butter, extract and salt.  Add sugar; mix with spoon and hands until smooth.  Divide into thirds.  Knead 1 drop red food coloring into one third and 1 drop green food coloring into another third.  Leave remaining third white.  Shape into small balls.  Flatten with fork on waxed paper lined baking sheets.  Let dry several hours.  Makes 72 patties.

name: TUNA DELIGHT
ingredients:
1/2  onion, chopped
3  tablespoons oil
2  cups cooked rice
1-16 oz. can French green beans
1- 6 1/2  oz. can flaked tuna, drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Saute onion in oil in skillet until tender.  Add rice and green beans; mix well.  Stir in tuna and mushroom soup.  Cook until heated thoroughly.

name: APPLE BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. broccoli florets
1  chopped Granny Smith apples
1  c. shredded carrots
1/2  c. chopped red onion
1/3  c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
preparation: Toss main ingredients and fruit in large bowl, add 1/3 c. salad dressing.  Stir into main ingredients and fruit.  Yield:  6 servings.

name: ESPRESSO CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. crushed almond macaroons (40 cookies)
6  Tbsp. butter, softened
4 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
6  sq. semi-sweet chocolate, melted
3  eggs
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. milk
2  tsp. instant Espresso
preparation: In 9 x 3-inch spring-form pan, mix almond macaroons and butter; press on bottom and around side of pan to within 1 inch of top. Set aside.  (You can also use 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs and 2 teaspoons almond extract in place of the macaroons.)

name: STRAWBERRY CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
10  graham crackers, crushed
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  stick butter
1 small  pkg. Dream Whip
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  box strawberry jello
1  c. boiling water
1 small  box frozen strawberries
preparation: Fix Dream Whip as directed.  Blend cream cheese with 1/2 cup of powdered sugar.  Mix cream cheese mixture with Dream Whip and spread over graham cracker crust.  Then dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add frozen strawberries.  Stir until thick.  Pour over cream cheese and Dream Whip mixture and chill.

name: CREAMED PEAS AND PEARL ONIONS
ingredients:
1  c. pearl onions
4  c. green peas, frozen- defrosted and drained
3  strips bacon
1  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. chicken broth
1  c. milk
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
salt to taste
pepper to taste
preparation: Slice bacon into 1/4 inch strips.  In a  heavy bottomed skillet, fry bacon strips until crisp.  Remove bacon and retain grease in skillet.

name: BEST EVER SLUSH PUNCH
ingredients:
46  oz. pineapple juice
46  oz. orange juice
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
30  oz. frozen Hawaiian Punch concentrate or 1 qt. liquid concentrate
2  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Mix all ingredients in an empty ice cream pail.  Mix well and freeze.  Take out of freezer 4 to 5 hours ahead to thaw a little. Chop with a knife to make slush.  Put into punch bowl and add ginger ale just before serving; will be slushy.  Makes 50 (5 ounce) servings.  (You can make this several days ahead of time and keep frozen until ready to use.  Take out a few hours ahead of time.)

name: STEAK SUPPER IN FOIL
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. chuck steak 1 inch thick
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  envelope of onion soup mix
3  medium carrots; quartered
2  stalks of celery; cut into 2 inch pieces
3  medium potatoes pared and quartered
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Place 24x18 inch piece of heavy duty foil in baking pan.  Place meat on foil.  Stir together mushroom soup and onion soup mix.  Spread on top of meat.  Top with vegetables and sprinkle water on top.  Fold foil and seal securely.  Cook 1 1/2 hours.

name: DAIRY QUEEN BLIZZARD
ingredients:
1  candy bar (your favorite), frozen
2 1/2  c. vanilla ice cream
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. fudge topping
preparation: Break the candy bar into tiny pieces with a knife handle before removing the bar from wrapper.  Combine all of the ingredients in the blender; blend for 30 seconds on medium speed. Stop the blender to stir the mixture with a spoon.  Repeat until well mixed.  Pour into a 16-ounce glass.  Makes 2 servings or 1 extra large serving.

name: SMOTHERED POTATOES
ingredients:
3  to 4 large potatoes
1/2  c. minced onions
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Dice potatoes and along with onions brown quickly in small amount of grease in skillet.  After browning, add enough water to cover, cover and simmer until tender.  Add water if they cook down and are not quite soft enough.  Serves 3 to 4 people.

name: PINK DIVINITY
ingredients:
3/4  c. water
3/4  c. light corn syrup
dash of salt
2  egg whites
1 small  pkg. red Jell-O
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, corn syrup, water and salt in saucepan. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Cover and bring to a boil.  Cook for a minute or two to wash down sugar crystals.  Remove cover. Cook, without stirring, until syrup reaches hard ball stage, 260°, or until syrup is slightly brittle when dropped in cold water. Beat egg whites until frothy.  Continue beating, adding Jell-O slowly. Beat until candy is creamy. Stir in nuts. Candy sets quickly.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.  Yields 5 dozen.

name: VEGETARIAN CHOPPED LIVER *
ingredients:
6  hard-boiled eggs
3  onions, chopped
1  lb. green beans (fresh or frozen)
dash of pepper
1  Tbsp. oil
1/2  c. wheat germ
preparation: Saute onions in oil.  Cook green beans until soft.  Place eggs, onions, beans, pepper and wheat germ in bowl of food processor and process until smooth.  Refrigerate.

name: BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can French cut green beans, drained
1  can white wax beans, drained
1  can kidney (red) beans, drained
1/2  c. onions, chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1/2  tsp. each salt and pepper
preparation: Mix above ingredients.  Pour dressing over bean mixture and chill for a few hours.

name: PINEAPPLE SQUARES
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  lb. oleo
1  egg
1  can drained crushed pineapple
2  cans pineapple pie filling
preparation: Mix flour, sugar and oleo until crumbly.  Take 1 cup of mixture and save for topping.  Into the rest of batter, add egg. Pat into pan and put up around sides of pan.  Mix crushed pineapple and pie filling; put over crumb mixture.  Sprinkle top with the rest of crumbs.  Bake at 375° for 5 minutes, then at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Wesson oil
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  c. chopped apples
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  Tbsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients.  Mix eggs, oil and vanilla with dry ingredients.  Mix in apples and stir well.  Grease and flour pan, 9 x 13-inch.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: CHEESE CHOWDER
ingredients:
2/3  c. chopped onion
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped carrots
1  c. cubed potatoes
6  c. chicken broth
1 (12 oz.)  cans whole kernel corn, drained
1/3  c. butter
1/3  c. flour
3  c. milk
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
3/4  tsp. white pepper
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. paprika
1 (2 oz.)  jar pimento, drained
3  c. (12 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large pot over medium-high heat.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender.  Stir in corn and remove from heat.  Melt butter in heavy saucepan.  Stir in flour and cook 1 minute.  Gradually add milk and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens.   Blend in remaining ingredients.  When cheese melts, add to vegetable mixture, stirring until well blended. Heat through, but do not allow to boil.

name: CHINESE-STYLE SHRIMP IN PASTRY SHELLS
ingredients:
3/4  c. chicken broth
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. teriyaki sauce
3  Tbsp. peanut oil
1 1/2  c. diagonally sliced snow peas 1 inch pieces
1/4  c. green onions
1 12  oz. pkg. frozen cooked shrimp (thawed and drained)
1  pkg. (10 oz.) Pepperidge Farm puff pastry shells baked according to directions
preparation: Mix chicken broth with teriyaki sauce and cornstarch. In a large skillet, heat oil over high heat. Add snow peas and onions; stir-fry until almost tender-crisp. Add shrimp and stir in chicken broth mixture; cook, stirring constantly until sauce thickens and just comes to a boil and shrimp are tender.

name: ALL FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  c. blueberries, raspberries or sliced peaches or strawberries
1/2  c. (1 stick) margarine
1  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  In a mixing bowl toss sugar together with fruit.  Put butter in an 8 x 10-inch ovenproof serving dish and place in oven to melt.  Sift flour, baking powder and salt together into a bowl.  Stir in milk to make a batter.  Pull hot dish of melted butter from oven and pour in bottom which will bubble around sides.  Quickly spoon fruit and juice evenly over batter.  Return to oven and bake until done and rises up around the fruit.  Bake 30 or 40 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: SIMPLE SALISBURY STEAK
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. ground beef
1/3  c. dry bread crumbs
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. finely chopped onions
1 1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
preparation: In a bowl, mix 1/4 cup of the soup, beef, bread crumbs, egg and onion.  Shape into 6 patties.  In skillet, cook patties, a few at a time, until browned on both sides.  Spoon off fat.  Stir in remaining soup and mushrooms.  Return patties to skillet.  Reduce heat to low.  Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until done, turning patties occasionally.  Makes 6 servings.

name: FOOLPROOF DARK CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
3 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
dash of salt
1/2 to 1  c. chopped nuts (to taste)
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: In a heavy saucepan or double boiler over low heat, melt chips with milk and salt.  Remove from heat; stir in nuts and vanilla. Spread evenly onto waxed paper in an 8 x 9-inch square pan.  Chill until firm.  Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel paper off.  Cut into squares.  Makes about 2 pounds.

name: SOUR CREAM PANCAKES
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. flour
3  Tbsp. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. oil
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Add wet ingredients.  Pour on hot griddle.  Cook until edges are cooked and air bubbles are forming on top.

name: TURTLE CAKE SQUARES
ingredients:
1  (14 oz.) bag caramel (about 50 squares)
1 (5 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1  stick butter, melted
1  box German Chocolate cake mix
1  c. finely chopped nuts
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Melt caramels and 1/4 cup milk in heavy saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly; or melt this mixture in a microwave for 3 minutes, stirring after every minute. Set aside.

name: HAM LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground ham
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. milk
2  eggs
1  lb. lean ground pork
2  c. crushed graham crackers
1  can tomato soup
1/3  c. vinegar
2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Mix  first 6 ingredients and form into loaves and place in small  loaf pans.  Place loaf pan on an inverted pie pan in Dutch oven.  Bake  one hour or until done.  For a sauce on top of loaves, mix tomato soup, vinegar and brown sugar.

name: QUICK CARAMEL ICING
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter
6  Tbsp. milk
3/4  c. light brown sugar
2  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Melt butter.  Add brown sugar and blend.  Add milk and boil hard for one minute.  Add confectioners sugar gradually.  Beat mixture as you add sugar until it loses its glaze.

name: LONDON BROIL
ingredients:
1  flank steak (1 1/2 lb. or so)
1  c. salad oil
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  clove garlic, minced
salt and pepper
preparation: Place steak in shallow pan.  Combine oil, vinegar and garlic. Pour over steak.  Cover and let stand in refrigerator for 3 hours or better yet overnight, turning several times.  Preheat broiler. Broil steak 3-inches from heat, about 5 minutes.  Season.  Turn; broil 3 minutes.  Add more seasoning.  Remove to cutting board. Carve very thin slices diagonally across the grain.  Serves 4 to 5.

name: EGG BRUNCH
ingredients:
9  eggs
3  c. milk
4  slices bread, cubed
1  lb. bacon, browned and drained
1 1/2  c. Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. dry mustard
chopped chives for color
preparation: Beat eggs well; add milk, bread, salt and mustard.  Stir in cheese and meat.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Refrigerate overnight.  Bake for 45 minutes or until firm in a 350° oven.

name: NO COOK STRAWBERRY FREEZER JAM
ingredients:
2  c. crushed strawberries (about 1 qt.)
4  c. sugar
3/4  c. water
1  box Sure-Jell fruit pectin
preparation: Thoroughly mix fruit and sugar in large bowl. Let stand 10 minutes. Mix water and fruit pectin in small saucepan. Boil 1 minute, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir into fruit. Continue stirring 3 minutes.  Ladle quickly into six 1 cup containers.  Cover at once with tight lids.  Let stand overnight, then store in freezer.

name: MINI PIZZAS
ingredients:
1  can biscuits
1  jar pizza sauce
1/2  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1  pkg. Cheddar cheese
preparation: Flatten biscuits.  Brown ground beef in skillet and drain. Put pizza sauce on biscuits and top with ground beef and then both cheeses.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes or until done.

name: TORTELLINI WITH SPINACH AND CLAM SAUCE
ingredients:
16  oz. cheese or meat tortellini
10  oz. fresh round leaf spinach
1 (15 oz.)  can white clam sauce
1  Tbsp. olive oil
oregano
garlic powder
1/2  tsp. salt
4  qt. water
grated cheese
preparation: Wash spinach, remove stems, dry and place in a large bowl. Boil water; add salt and tortellini.  Boil 3 to 5 minutes, until al dente.  At the same time, heat clam sauce with olive oil, oregano and garlic powder until it starts to boil.

name: RAMEN SLAW
ingredients:
3  cups chopped cabbage
2  tsp sesame seeds
4  chopped green onions
1  pkg chicken ramen noodles, crumbled dry (reserved seasoning)
1/3  cup slivered almonds (optional)
1/4  cup water
2  Tbsp. oil
1  Tbsp. Vinegar
1  pkg seasoning from ramen noodles
3  Tbsp. Sugar
preparation: Toss together cabbage, onion, sesame seeds, and dry Ramen noodles. Mix water, oil, sugar, vinegar and ramen seasoning to make dressing.  Pour dressing over cabbage mixture; toss. Sprinkle with almonds. Serves 6.

name: ZUCCHINI, PEPPERS AND TOMATOES
ingredients:
1  lb. zucchini (approximately 3 1/2 c.), sliced
salt
2  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. oil
1  c. sliced onions
1  c. sliced green peppers
1 1/2  c. peeled, seeded, chopped tomatoes
1/2  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. oregano
pepper
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese (optional)
preparation: Wash, trim and slice the zucchini.  Salt and let drain; pat dry.  Heat the butter and oil and saute the onions until wilted. Add the zucchini and peppers and cook 2 to 3 minutes.  Stir in the Parmesan cheese if you like.  Serve either hot or cold.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. sliced cooked chicken
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1/4  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. chicken broth (optional)
1  c. rice
preparation: Boil rice until done.  Add chicken, soup, lemon juice, butter, grated cheese, mayonnaise and chicken broth.  Mix together.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CHICKEN TACO RICE
ingredients:
1  lb. boned chicken breasts, cut into strips
2  Tbsp. oil
1  can (13 3/4 oz.) chicken broth
1  can (8 oz.) tomato sauce
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1  can (12 oz.) corn, drained
1  medium red or green pepper or a combination, cut into strips
1 1/2  c. Minute rice (regular or long grain)
1/2  c. (2 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese (optional)
tortilla chips (optional)
sour cream (optional)
preparation: Cook and stir chicken in hot oil until lightly browned.  Add broth, tomato sauce and seasoning mix.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer 5 minutes.  Add corn and red pepper.  Bring to a full boil.  Stir in rice.  Cover; remove from heat.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Fluff with fork.  Serve with cheese, tortilla chips and sour cream, if desired. Makes four servings.

name: BARB'S OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. soft margarine
2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  c. oats
1  c. raisins or nuts or half and half
preparation: Cream margarine, sugar, eggs and vanilla together.  Slowly add remaining ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.

name: SHOO-FLY PIE
ingredients:
2/3  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. butter
1  c. dark molasses
3/4  c. boiling water
1  tsp. soda
1  beaten egg
preparation: Mix sugar and butter into crumbs.  Set aside half of mixture. Mix molasses, water, soda, egg and 1/2 crumbs.  Put in pie shell and cover with the remaining crumbs.  Bake 11 minutes at 375° and 30 minutes at 350°.

name: APPLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
1  egg
1/4  c. milk
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. finely chopped apples
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream sugar and butter; add egg and milk.  Mix in dry ingredients.  Stir in apples and nuts.  Drop onto slightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until done.

name: KEY LIME PIE
ingredients:
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  can frozen limeade
1  medium Cool Whip
2  graham cracker crumb pie shells
preparation: Mix together and spread in pie shells. Top with Cool Whip (optional).  Keep refrigerated.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts
1/2  tsp. vanilla
4  ripe bananas, mashed
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs.  Mash ripe bananas well and add, then add dry ingredients.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. cooking oil or melted shortening
preparation: Sift flour with sugar, baking powder and salt into mixing bowl.  Combine eggs, milk and cooking oil; add to dry ingredients. Beat quickly only until large lumps disappear.  If batter thickens upon standing, thin it with 1/4 to 1/2 cup milk.  Pour batter onto hot, lightly greased griddle (for an electric griddle, set at 375°).  Bake until bubbles break and edges are cooked. Turn and bake other side.  Yields 16 (4-inch) pancakes.

name: SIX WEEK MUFFINS
ingredients:
15  oz. box Raisin Bran cereal
3  c. sugar
4 1/2  c. flour
5  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. salt
1  c. cooking oil
1  qt. buttermilk
4  eggs
preparation: Combine dry ingredients in large bowl.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Bake in muffin pans for 15 minutes at 400°.  Mixture will keep for several weeks in refrigerator.

name: NO-BAKE ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1  pkg. sliced sandwich ham (6 to 8 oz.)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese (soft)
3 to 5  Tbsp. cubed sweet pickles
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of black pepper
1/2  tsp. paprika
preparation: Drain and pat dry ham slices.  In bowl combine softened cream cheese, pickles and spices.  Stir until mixture is smooth and creamy.  Spread thin layer of mixture over slice of ham and roll up.  Place toothpick in roll about every 1/2 inch (6 to 8 per roll) and place on cookie sheet.  Continue until all of mixture is used.  Place roll-ups in refrigerator overnight or at least 2 to 4 hours.  When cream cheese mixture becomes firm, slice between toothpicks for bite-size servings.  May be garnished with olives, cheese, radishes, etc.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
2/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. mashed banana (2 to 3 medium bananas)
1/3  c. shortening, margarine or butter
2  Tbsp. milk
2  eggs
1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a large mixer bowl, combine 1 cup of flour, the sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.  Add mashed banana, shortening, margarine or butter and milk.  Beat with an electric mixer on low speed until blended, then on high speed for 2 minutes.  Add eggs and remaining flour.  Beat until blended. Stir in nuts.  Pour batter into a greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean.   Cool for 10 minutes on a wire rack. Remove from pan.  Cool thoroughly on wire rack.  Wrap and store overnight before slicing.  Makes 1 loaf (16 servings).

name: CHEESE BISCUITS
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
dash of cayenne pepper
1  lb. sharp cheese, grated
3/4  c. margarine
preparation: Sift dry ingredients.  Mix grated cheese and margarine together.  Add dry ingredients to cheese mixture.  Dough will be very stiff.  Roll about 1/4-inch thick and cut into small biscuits.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325° for 25 minutes or until done, but do not brown.  Makes about 125 small biscuits.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
4  to 6 chicken breasts
1  tsp. salt
1  can mushroom or celery soup
1 to 2  c. Minute rice
1  stick oleo, melted
1  Tbsp. onion flakes
1  can water
preparation: Mix melted oleo, rice, salt and onion flakes.  Stir in soup and water; mix.  Place in baking dish.  Arrange chicken on top. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: VEGEN FAJITAS
ingredients:
1  bell pepper
1  medium onion
2  green onions
2  tomatoes
1/2  c. cilantro
1  Tbsp. cumin
1/2  tsp. salt
pepper
3  garlic cloves
2  summer squash
flour tortillas
preparation: Dice onions, garlic and green onion.  Slice bell pepper, tomatoes and summer squash.  Saute in skillet, adding cumin, salt, pepper, tomatoes and cilantro in last.  Saute for 15 minutes. Serve in flour or corn tortillas with sour cream and hot sauce.

name: ULTIMATE BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. butter
1  c. flour
4  sq. unsweetened chocolate
4  eggs, well beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt butter and chocolate; add sugar, flour, eggs, salt and vanilla.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
2  sticks butter, softened
1  c. peanut butter
1  box powdered sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
12  oz. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/4  to 1/2 bar Parowax
6  oz. milk chocolate chips
preparation: Mix together the butter, peanut butter, powdered sugar and vanilla.  Form into small balls, then chill.  Melt both chocolates and the Parowax in a double boiler.  Dip balls into mixture and cool.  Place on waxed paper to set.

name: CARAMEL APPLE WALNUT SQUARES
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. unsifted flour
1  c. quick cooking oats
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. margarine or butter
1  c. chopped nuts
20  caramels, unwrapped
1 (14 oz.)  can condensed milk (Eagle Brand)
1 (14 oz.)  can apple filling or topping
preparation: Preheat  oven  to  375°.  In  large bowl combine flour, oats, sugar,  baking  soda  and salt.  Cut in margarine until crumbly. Reserving  1 1/2 cups crumb mixture, press remainder on the bottom  of  13  x  9-inch  pan.  Bake  15 minutes. Add walnuts to reserved crumb mixture.  In heavy saucepan over low heat,  melt caramels  with sweetened condensed milk, stirring until  smooth. Spoon  apple filling over prepared crust.  Top with  caramel mixture,  then reserved crumb mixture.  Bake 20 minutes or until set.  Cool; serve warm with ice cream.

name: CELERY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. celery (1-inch slices)
1 (5 oz.)  can water chestnuts
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  Tbsp. diced green pepper
preparation: Cook celery in boiling water for 8 minutes.  Drain.  Combine soup, water chestnuts (drained and sliced) and green pepper.  Add celery.  Mix.  Top with seasoned bread crumbs mixed with melted butter and slivered almonds if you prefer.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: SCROD PROVENCALE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. scrod fillet (or any firm fish, catfish, cod, etc.)
4  cloves garlic, sliced
4  onions, sliced
2  stalks celery, sliced
2 small  cans stewed tomatoes
1/4  tsp. oregano or herbes de provence
pepper to taste
preparation: Heat one tablespoon oil in iron skillet.  Saute onions and sliced celery until transparent.  Add sliced garlic and oregano or herbes de provence.  Simmer several minutes.  Add stewed tomatoes and simmer, uncovered until slightly thickened.  Place fish fillets on sauce; cover and simmer 15 minutes.  Serve with rice.

name: HAMBURGER SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. ground chuck
5 3/4  c. tomato juice
1  c. stewed tomatoes
1  c. minced clams
2  tsp. basil
2  tsp. oregano
2  Tbsp. dried onions
1  c. mushrooms
1  bay leaf
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
2  c. chopped celery
1  c. sliced carrots
2  c. sliced cabbage
2  c. green beans (any kind)
preparation: Brown beef and drain.  Combine all other ingredients and simmer 2 hours.

name: TOLL HOUSE PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. unsifted flour
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. butter, melted (room temperature)
16  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped walnuts
9-inch unbaked pie crust
preparation: Beat eggs until foamy.  Beat in flour, sugar and brown sugar. Blend in butter.  Stir in chips and nuts.  Pour into shell.  Bake one hour in a 325° oven.  Serve warm with Cool Whip or ice cream.

name: CHOCOLATE PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. Karo light or dark syrup
1  c. sugar
1  small bag Nestle semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. pecans
1  unbaked 9-inch pie crust
preparation: In a large bowl combine eggs, syrup, sugar, vanilla and pecans until well blended.  Stir in pecans and chocolate chips.  Pour into pie crust.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.  Allow to cool.  Serves 8.

name: ANGEL BARS
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. angel food cake mix
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Combine pie filling and dry cake mix.  Pour into 10 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan that has been sprayed with Pam.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Dust with powdered sugar.

name: STRAWBERRY PUDDING
ingredients:
1  qt. strawberries, cleaned
1/2  c. sugar
1 small  box strawberry Jell-O
3 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
3  c. cold milk
1  c. sour cream
1  large Cool Whip
1  box vanilla wafers
preparation: Heat Jell-O, sugar and berries to dissolve Jell-O, stirring constantly.  Cool, mix pudding and milk.  Add sour cream, fold in 3/4 Cool  Whip.

name: CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
4  Tbsp. Crisco
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. boiling water
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift together sugar, flour, cocoa and salt.  Make hole in center.   Add Crisco, boiling water and baking soda.  Beat egg and add to mixture, along with baking powder and vanilla.  Mix well and bake in 9-inch pan at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  Uncle Ben's wild rice
2  c. chopped, cooked chicken
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can sliced water chestnuts
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
preparation: Cook rice according to package directions.  Mix with other ingredients and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BLUEBERRY CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  can blueberry filling
2  pkg. graham crackers
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  container Cool Whip
2  Tbsp. powdered sugar
preparation: Soften cream cheese in microwave oven about 15 to 20 seconds, depending on heating variations of your microwave. Stir together Cool Whip and cream cheese, then add your powdered sugar. Mix this together until smooth. Set this aside until crust is made.

name: SEVEN LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1  small head lettuce, chopped
1/2  head cauliflower, broken into small pieces
1/2  c. chopped green onions with tops
1/2  c. diced green pepper
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas
2  c. Hellmann's mayo
6 to 8  slices bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Layer first 7 ingredients and place in refrigerator 6 hours or overnight.  Just before serving, toss and sprinkle bacon and cheese on top.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE(For Crock-Pot)
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice
1 1/2  c. water
3  whole breasts, 3 legs and 3 thighs
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  cans cream of celery soup
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
preparation: Put rice over bottom of pot.  Pour water over rice.  Place chicken pieces over rice.  Pour soups over chicken, cover and cook. Heat control to 280° and cook 4 to 5 hours.

name: CHOCOLATE GRAVY
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. all purpose flour
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. water
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in saucepan. Cook over medium heat until it boils. Mixture will slowly thicken. Cook for about 10 minutes, stirring constantly until thick. Pour over hot, buttered biscuits.

name: VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  pkg. Good Season's Italian dressing mix
1/2  c. sour cream
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. parsley flakes
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Best when made ahead, allowing flavors to gently blend.  Serve with assorted vegetable sticks.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
4  c sugar
1/4  lb butter
1  can milk
1  pt marshmallow cream
1  tsp vanilla
peanut butter (about 1 c)
preparation: Cook sugar, butter and milk to a soft ball stage (236 degrees).  Add marshmallow, vanilla and peanut butter.  Mix together well.  Pour into a buttered 9x13 pan.

name: ATHENIAN STIFATHO
ingredients:
3  lb. beef or lamb stew meat
3  Tbsp. butter
4  cloves garlic, minced
salt and pepper to taste
2  tsp. pickling spice
1  bay leaf
1  stick cinnamon
1  c. dry red wine
8  oz. can tomato sauce
1/4  c. red wine vinegar
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  lb. small onions
finely chopped parsley
preparation: Brown chunks of meat in butter.  Add garlic and season with salt and pepper.  Tie pickling spice, bay leaf and cinnamon stick in cheesecloth and add to meat.  Pour in wine, tomato sauce, vinegar and sugar.  Cover and simmer 1 hour.  Peel and cut a small cross in the root end of each onion.  Add to stew and simmer 30 minutes or until meat is tender.  Sprinkle with parsley.  Serve with rice or potatoes and a Greek salad.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
8 heaping  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. shortening or margarine
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Blend sugar, shortening and eggs.  Add dry ingredients.  Blend thoroughly.  Then add nuts and vanilla. Pour batter into greased 9 x 13-inch square pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Cool in pan and cut in squares.

name: EYE OF ROUND ROAST
ingredients:
eye of round roast
salt and pepper
rosemary
garlic cloves
preparation: Make slits in roast and place garlic in slits (scatter the slits). Rub roast with oil, salt, pepper and rosemary.  Place roast in baking pan or dish with about 1/2 cup or so of water in bottom.  Keep moist.  Bake 2 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: CHICKEN ON A BISCUIT
ingredients:
1  roll biscuits
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas
2  c. chicken
1 1/4  c. grated Cheddar
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix and heat peas, chicken, soup, milk, salt and pepper.  Pour into baking dish.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Place biscuits on top. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: FRESH TOMATO-BASIL SAUCE
ingredients:
6  large fresh tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped (or 2 1/2 lb.)
4 to 5  cloves garlic, chopped fine
4  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. olive oil
1/4 to 1/2  c. fresh basil, chopped fine
3/4 to 1  lb. angel hair pasta
preparation: Prepare the first 2 ingredients; place together in bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  lb. chicken, baked and boned
2  doz. tortillas
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. milk
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese
2  cans green chilies
preparation: Cut chicken into bite size pieces.  Cut tortillas into 1-inch squares.  Mix soups, onions, milk and chilies together.  Butter casserole dish and put 2 tablespoons juice from chicken in bottom. Place layers of tortillas, chicken and soup mixture, ending with grated cheese and let set overnight in refrigerator to blend flavors.  Bake, covered with foil, at 300° for about 90 minutes. Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.  Serves 12 people.

name: GOLDEN BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  c. cocoa
2/3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Combine all ingredients in bowl.  Beat at low speed for 2 minutes.  Spread into greased pan and bake 25 minutes.  Cool.

name: CHOCOLATE BOTTOM CUPCAKES(Jesse's Favorite!)
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  egg
1/3  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
6  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
1 1/2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. water
1/3  c. salad oil
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In large bowl, combine in order, then mix with mixer.  Fill muffin cups 1/3 full of batter; drop 1 well rounded teaspoon of cream cheese mix in middle.  Sprinkle top with sugar.  Bake at 350° for 23 to 25 minutes.  Makes approximately 18.

name: VEGETABLE SPREAD
ingredients:
3  carrots, scraped
1/2  sweet red pepper
1  stalk celery
1/2  c. walnuts, shelled
1  tsp. fresh grated ginger
1  tsp. fresh grated lemon rind
2 to 3  tsp. mayonnaise
preparation: In food processor, chop together carrots, red pepper, celery and walnuts to coarse consistency. Add ginger, lemon rind and enough mayonnaise to hold mixture together. Chill before serving. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

name: ONION RINGS
ingredients:
3/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2/3  c. cream
1 1/2  Tbsp. oil
1  egg white, unbeaten
preparation: Mix and beat lightly.  Dip onion rings in batter and fry in a deep fryer.

name: BAKED ZITI
ingredients:
8  oz. ziti
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  lb. ground beef or ground turkey
1  onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, chopped
1 (28 oz.)  can crushed tomatoes, undrained
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato sauce
salt and pepper to taste
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. marjoram
1/4  c. chopped parsley
1/4  lb. Mozzarella cheese, grated
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook ziti in boiling water following directions on box. Drain.

name: EASY TOFFEE BARS
ingredients:
15  graham crackers (2 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch)
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  c. oleo
6  oz. pkg. (1 c.) milk chocolate chips
1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Line 13 x 9-inch pan with foil; grease foil with butter.  Arrange graham crackers in prepared pan. (Some crackers may need to be broken apart in order to cover entire bottom of pan.)  In medium saucepan, combine brown sugar and butter; bring to a boil.  Remove from heat; pour over graham crackers.  Bake at 400° for 5 minutes.  Remove from oven; immediately sprinkle with chocolate chips.  When chips are soft, sprinkle with nuts.  Chill about 30 minutes until chocolate is set.  Cut into bars or break into pieces.  Makes 24 bars.

name: MEARA'S DIP
ingredients:
3  8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  jar dried beef
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
chopped green onions
Dash of seasoned salt
preparation: Soften cream cheese.  Chop dried beef.  Chop green onions. Mix all ingredients together and serve with corn chips or crackers.

name: BLUE CHEESE DRESSING
ingredients:
2 (4 oz.)  pkg. Blue cheese
1  large container sour cream
1  large lemon
salt
pepper
preparation: Crumble cheese; add sour cream and juice of one large lemon; salt and pepper to taste.  Chill before serving.

name: SPINACH BALLS
ingredients:
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  c. herb seasoned bread crumbs
1  stick melted oleo
salt to taste
dash of garlic powder
parsley flakes
6  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. Parmesan cheese
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach
preparation: Cook and drain spinach.  Add all other ingredients.  Form into walnut sized balls.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: NEVER FAIL MERINGUE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. water
6  Tbsp. sugar
3  egg whites
preparation: Combine 2 tablespoons sugar, cornstarch and water in small pan.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until soft mounds form.  Add 6 tablespoons sugar gradually to egg whites, beating well after each addition.  Add cornstarch mixture gradually. Continue beating until meringue stands in peaks.  Cover pie with meringue and brown in 375° oven.

name: BLACK WALNUT SQUARES
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
1  c. oil
1  c. hot water
2  eggs
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. black walnuts
preparation: Combine brown sugar, oil and water.  Let cool.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 350° for 25 minutes.  Cool and ice with cream cheese frosting.

name: CAKE
ingredients:
water
cake batter
flour
sugar
1  box yellow cake mix
1 (3 oz.)  box Jell-O instant pistachio pudding
4  eggs
1/2  c. plain yogurt or sour cream
1/2  c. oil
3/4  c. midouri
1/2  tsp. coconut flavoring
preparation: Beat 4 minutes.  Pour into well-greased Bundt pan.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.  Cool in pan 15 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. smooth peanut butter
3  oz. cream cheese
12  oz. whipped topping
1  graham cracker crust
preparation: Cream together powdered sugar, peanut butter and cream cheese. Fold in whipped topping.  Pour into graham cracker crust.  Chill.

name: SUMMER SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  medium yellow squash, sliced in rounds
1  medium onion, chopped
2  slices bread crumbled
salt and pepper to taste
1  egg, beaten
1/4  tsp. basil
1  c. grated American or Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook squash in covered pan in small amount of water along with the onion; squash makes its own liquids; needs only enough water to get it started.  Cook until tender but not falling apart.  Drain and combine with bread, egg, salt, pepper, basil and half the cheese.  Butter 2-quart casserole.  Place the mixture in it and dot with butter.  Top with remaining cheese.  Bake in preheated oven at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes or until firm.  Serves 6.

name: PASTA WITH SOY SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. pasta of your choice, cooked as directed
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. garlic, minced or garlic powder
preparation: Mix soy sauce and garlic.  Blend the mixture to the cooked pasta.  Serve alone or as a side dish with meat or stir-fry vegetables.

name: APPLE-TUNA SALAD
ingredients:
1  medium head lettuce, chopped
2  c. diced apple
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin orange sections (1 1/3 c.)
1 (6 1/2 or 7 oz.)  can tuna, drained and broken in large chunks
1/3  c. coarsely chopped walnuts
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: In large salad bowl, combine lettuce, apple, mandarin orange sections, tuna and walnuts; toss together.  Combine mayonnaise, soy sauce and lemon juice; mix well. To serve, add dressing to salad; toss gently.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: TEX MEX ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
2  onions, chopped
1  clove garlic
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. ground cumin
2  green onions, chopped
1 1/2  c. cooked chicken, shredded
1  c. half and half
2 (4 oz.)  cans green chilies
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  c. grated cheese
12  flour tortillas
1  c. chopped tomatoes
preparation: Chop onions and chilies, mince garlic.  Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat, add onions and saute until soft.  Stir in flour, chicken broth, chilies, garlic and salt to taste and cumin and simmer 15 minutes.  Heat oven to 350°.  Grease a rectangular baking dish.  Grate cheese, slice green onions.  Put some chicken in each tortilla along with some onion mixture and 3 tablespoons of grated cheese.  Roll up tortillas and put in baking dish seam side down.  Pour the remaining sauce over them and then the cream.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese and green onions.  Bake 20 minutes and garnish with tomatoes.

name: CHOCOLATE ICING FOR LAYER CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/3  c. cocoa
1  stick butter or margarine
3/4  c. evaporated milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients in heavy saucepan.  Bring to boil on medium heat.  Boil for 2 minutes.  Watch carefully!  Try not to stir. Remove from heat and cool.  When cool, stir thoroughly and spread on layers.  Icing is thin, may have to spoon back on cake as it runs down sides.  Lots of work but worth it!

name: COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
2  c. sugar
2  c. sour cream
2 (9 oz.)  pkg. frozen coconut
1 1/2  c. Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake as directed using two pans.  Split each layer in half.  Combine sugar, sour cream and coconut.  Chill.  Reserve 1 cup of sour cream mixture for frosting.  Spread remaining mixture between layers.  Combine reserved mixture with Cool Whip.  Blend until smooth and spread on top and side of cake.  Store in airtight container.  Refrigerate for two days before serving to allow cake to moisten.

name: PINK FLUFF SALAD
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. chopped pecans
1  large Cool Whip
8  oz. sour cream
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  can condensed milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.

name: FRESH COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sifted flour (plain)
3  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. sugar
2/3  c. Crisco
preparation: Measure into sifter flour, baking powder, salt and sugar. Measure into a cup the milk and vanilla.  Measure into large bowl the  Crisco.  Have ready 5 egg whites, beaten to a meringue with 1/2 cup sugar.

name: CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  sticks oleo
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
4 or 5  tsp. cocoa
1  c. boiling water
1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix together eggs, oleo and sugar.  Add flour and soda.  Mix cocoa in boiling water.  Add to batter.  Add sour cream and nuts. Pour into a greased and floured 15 1/2 x 11 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: ESCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1/2  c. melted oleo or butter
1  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1/2  c. onion, chopped
2  c. sour cream or 1 each: cream and yogurt
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
2  c. corn flakes, crushed and mixed with 1/2 c. melted oleo
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients, except corn flakes mixture.  Sprinkle buttered corn flakes on top.  Use a 3-quart casserole or large flat glass baking dish.  Bake for one hour.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: BAKED CORN
ingredients:
1  pt. corn
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. butter
2  eggs, well beaten
1/4  c. milk
2  tsp. sugar
preparation: Mix flour, egg and sugar together.  Add corn, butter and milk. Put into 2-quart casserole and bake 45 minutes at 400°.

name: ANGEL FLAKE YEAST BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
2  c. buttermilk
3  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
5  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. shortening
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water.  Mix yeast mixture with buttermilk, sugar and salt; set aside.  Mix flour, baking powder and soda together.  Cut in shortening.  Add liquid ingredients.  Mix lightly.  Do not knead.  Refrigerate overnight.  Pinch off amount needed.  Knead, roll, cut and bake.  Don't allow to rise.  Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.

name: GARDEN STYLE SPIRAL (COLORED) MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  Tbsp. Accent
1/3  c. salad oil
1/2  Tbsp. pepper
1/2  Tbsp. garlic  powder
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1/2  c. parsley
macaroni
1  small, finely chopped onion
1  small bell pepper, finely chopped
1 small  jar pimentos
1 (4 oz.)  can sliced black olives
preparation: Mix first 8 ingredients thoroughly.  Pour over macaroni.  Cook macaroni according to directions on package.   Drain and place into large Tupperware bowl that has a cover.  Stir in small onion, bell pepper, pimentos and black olives.  Cover tightly and store in refrigerator overnight or 24 hours, if possible.

name: 15-MINUTE CHOCOLATE-BANANA CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  "Ready-Crust" chocolate pie crust
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding and pie filling
1 (1 1/2 oz.)  envelope whipped topping mix
1 1/2  c. cold milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  medium bananas
preparation: In a mixing bowl, combine pie filling mix, whipped topping mix, milk and vanilla on low speed until blended.  Increase speed and beat until very thick, about 3 minutes.  Pour 1/3 of mixture into crust.  Layer slices of bananas on top (save 1 banana for the top).  Pour remaining filling into crust.  Chill 2 hours.  Garnish with sliced bananas and additional whipped topping, if desired.

name: PARTY COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2 1/4  c. plain flour
1  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. plain M&M's
preparation: Blend shortening and sugar; beat in vanilla and eggs.  Sift remaining dry ingredients together.  Add to the sugar and egg mixture; mix well.  Stir in 1/2 cup M&M's.  Reserve remaining candies for decorating.  Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Decorate top of cookies with remaining M&M's.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown.

name: JAMBAYALA IN MICROWAVE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. shallots
bell pepper
2  c. water
2  bouillon cubes
salt
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
dash of garlic powder
1  Tbsp. Kitchen Bouquet
pepper
1  c. rice
sausage or chicken breasts (boneless; before adding chicken, cook in microwave)
preparation: In a 3-quart dish add oil and onion.  Cook 4 minutes in microwave.  Add shallots and everything else except meat and rice. Cook for 3 minutes in microwave until water boils.  Add rice and meat and cook covered in microwave at 50% power for 12 minutes. Stir.  Put back in microwave at 50% power for 12 minutes.  Let stand for 8 to 10 minutes before serving.

name: SUGAR-FREE STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) diet Faygo "red pop"
1/2  c. water
2 1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  large sugar-free strawberry Jell-O
1  qt. fresh strawberries
preparation: Mix cornstarch with small amount of "red pop."  Mix all ingredients, except berries.  Microwave on High for 2 to 3 minutes. Stir mixture and repeat this step twice.  Add berries to cooked mixture.  Cool until set and pour into baked pie shell.

name: ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
5  large potatoes, peeled and sliced
1  c. chicken stock
1  tsp. garlic powder and pepper to taste
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Place potatoes in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Combine chicken stock, garlic powder and pepper. Pour over potatoes.  Dot with butter.  Cover and bake at 400° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Remove cover during last 15 minutes to brown.

name: WHITE CHOCOLATE HAYSTACKS
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. vanilla milk chips or chunks
1  c. whole almonds, toasted
1/2  c. candied red cherries, chopped
1/2  c. golden raisins
1/2  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Line a cookie sheet with wax paper; stir vanilla chips in a 2-quart saucepan over very lot heat until smooth.  Remove from heat and stir in almonds, cherries and raisins.  Drop by tablespoons onto prepared cookie sheet.  Sprinkle with coconut. Refrigerate until hard.  Store airtight.

name: CHEESY BAKED COD OR ORANGE ROUGHY
ingredients:
2  lb. cod fillets
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  tsp. prepared mustard
1/2  c. grated Swiss cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Rinse and dry fish well.  Salt and pepper.  Layer fish in baking dish.  Mix remaining ingredients and spread on fish.  Bake at 400° until slightly browned and fish is flaky.  Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

name: FRITTER FRIED OKRA
ingredients:
1  c. plain flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs, well beaten
1/3  c. milk
5  c. thinly sliced okra
hot oil
preparation: Combine flour, baking powder and salt in a medium mixing bowl. Add eggs and milk.  Heat until smooth.  Add okra, stirring until coated.  Spoon okra into hot oil in large skillet.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown.

name: PARTY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  c. chopped pecans
2  Tbsp. chopped green onions
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1/4  c. finely chopped bell pepper
1  Tbsp. seasoned salt
additional 1 c. finely chopped pecans
preparation: Drain pineapple well.  Squeeze to remove all liquid.  Blend softened cream cheese with pineapple.  Add other ingredients and shape into ball.  Refrigerate for 1 hour.  Reshape and roll in additional cup of finely chopped pecans.

name: BISCUITS
ingredients:
3  c. flour
4 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. soda
1/2  c. Crisco
1 1/2  c. sour milk
preparation: Combine flour, baking powder, salt and soda.  Cut in shortening until mixture is coarse.  Add milk and stir until blended.  Transfer to lightly floured surface.  Knead lightly, roll dough out and cut with biscuit cutter.  Bake at 475° until golden brown, about 15 to 18 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI QUICHE
ingredients:
4  c. sliced zucchini
1/4  c. margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. oregano
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
8  oz. tube Pillsbury crescent rolls
2  tsp. prepared mustard
1  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. basil
2  beaten eggs
preparation: Saute thin sliced zucchini and onion in margarine for 10 minutes.  Stir in parsley and seasonings.  Combine eggs and cheese and stir into zucchini mixture.  Separate dough into 8 triangles and press into 10-inch quiche pan.  Press over bottom and up sides.  Spread mustard over crust and pour in the vegetable mixture.

name: DIVINITY CANDY
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
3  egg whites, stiffly beaten
1  c. chopped nuts
3/4  c. light corn syrup
preparation: Cook sugar, water, syrup, vanilla and salt to soft ball stage. Pour 1/2 of syrup in a fine stream over stiffly beaten egg whites while beating constantly.  Cook remainder of syrup to crackle stage.  Pour over first mixture in a fine stream and continue beating until it begins to harden.   Add nuts.  Spread evenly in well buttered pan.  When hard enough, cut in 1-inch squares.  Nut halves may be placed so there will be 1 on top of each piece, if desired.

name: CORNFLAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/3  c. white syrup
1/3  c. white sugar
1  c. peanut butter
2  c. cornflakes
preparation: Bring syrup and sugar to a boil.  Add peanut butter.  Add cornflakes.  Drop by spoonfuls onto foil.

name: SPINACH STUFFED FISH ROLLS
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. grated onion
1/4  tsp. hot pepper sauce
4  fish fillets (1/4 lb. each)
2  Tbsp. butter
1  clove garlic, minced
paprika
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a small bowl, combine spinach, cheese, onion and hot sauce.  Mix well.  Divide filling into 4 portions.  Place one portion across fish; starting with short end, roll fish around filling.  Melt butter and stir in garlic.  Brush each fish roll with this and place in shallow baking pan. Sprinkle liberally with paprika.  Bake for 20 minutes.  Serve over rice, if desired.

name: BARBECUE MARINADE
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. salt
6  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. dry lemon powder
2  Tbsp. m.s.g.
2 1/2  Tbsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. paprika
preparation: Rub this  into both sides of pork chops and refrigerate a minimum of 8 hours before cooking.  Keep balance of marinade in closed  jar.  This keeps indefinitely if refrigerated.  It will do about 60 chops.

name: CUCUMBER PICKLES(Refrigerated)
ingredients:
2  qt. sliced cucumbers
4  onions, sliced
2  Tbsp. salt
2  c. vinegar
3  c. sugar
preparation: Sprinkle salt over cukes and onions and let stand for 2 hours. Rinse in colander.  Boil vinegar and sugar.  Pour over cukes and let stand several days.

name: CHEESE CHILI
ingredients:
10  inch pie plate
10  oz. sharp cheddar cheese grated
1-2 mild chopped chili peppers (small can)
3  eggs
3  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Spread grated cheese on bottom of pie plate.  Spread peppers over cheese.  Mix eggs and milk together and spread over cheese mixture.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.  Serve with crackers. (Town House brand seems best).

name: SWEET BUNS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  c. water
1  tsp. baking powder
1  large cake yeast
1/4  c. Crisco
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
flour to stiffen (about 6 c.)
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water.  Mix in all ingredients; cover and let double in size.  Punch down and let double in size again. Make in shape of buns and let rise.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: RHUBARB CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  egg
1 1/2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. diced raw rhubarb
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. walnuts
preparation: Cream butter and sugar; add egg and vanilla and beat well. Add milk with the dry ingredients and blend all together. Fold in the diced rhubarb. Pour into greased 13 x 9 pan.

name: TRADITIONAL ROLLED SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  sticks butter soften
3/4  c. sugar
1  large egg
1  tbsp grated lemon peel
1  tsp vanilla
2 1/4  c. all purpose flour
1/4  tsp salt
preparation: Cream butter in a large bowl; add sugar.  Beat until light and fluffy.  Beat in egg, lemon peel, vanilla until blended well.  Beat in water, few drops at a time, only until dough starts to come away from sides.  Shape dough into large flat disc.  Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Roll dough on lightly floured surface.  Cut with cookie cutter; place on butter cookie sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until brown.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. cooked chicken, diced
1 1/2  c. diced celery
1/2  c. sliced almonds
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  Tbsp. grated onion
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Mix chicken, celery, almonds, mayonnaise, salt, onion and lemon juice.  Put in a greased casserole.  Top with cheese and chips.  Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes or until brown.

name: PIROSHKI
ingredients:
1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. tomato paste
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. milk
1/4  lb. bacon, diced
1/2  lb. mushrooms, chopped
1  tsp. dried thyme leaves
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  egg
Flaky Butter Pastry (following)
preparation: Crumble beef and set aside.  In heavy skillet, brown bacon until crisp.  Pour off drippings.  Add onion and beef, saute for 3 to 4 minutes, until meat has lost its pinkness.   Add mushrooms and cook until liquid is absorbed.  Stir in tomato paste, thyme, salt, black pepper and sour cream.  Remove from heat and cool.

name: FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large  can frozen orange juice
1 small  can frozen lemonade
12  oz. apricot nectar
12  oz. pineapple juice
1  liter ginger ale
6 orange juice  cans water
small pkg. fresh strawberries
preparation: Mix all ingredients but the ginger ale.  Mix in ginger ale just before serving.

name: HUNGARIAN GOULASH
ingredients:
1 1/2  pkg. spaghetti
5  onions
1/2  lb. bacon
1  green pepper
1  lb. hamburger
1 small  can olives
1 (No. 2)  can tomatoes
1/4  lb. cheese
1 (No. 2)  can corn
preparation: Fry hamburger and bacon in butter.  Layer as follows: cooked spaghetti, hamburger and onions, green pepper, tomatoes without the juice, corn, remainder of the spaghetti and meat, juice of the tomatoes and olives and cheese.  Cover and bake 1 hour or more at 350° and serve with hot biscuits.

name: QUICK AND EASY BARS
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. water
1/2  c. shortening
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pkg. graham crackers
1/2  c. flour
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. nuts
preparation: Cream eggs, brown sugar, vanilla, water and shortening.  Crush 1 2/3 cups graham crackers.  Add to creamed mixture, flour, chocolate chips and nuts.  Bake in 12 x 9 x 2-inch pan in a 350° oven for 16 to 18 minutes.  Remove and sprinkle chocolate chips on hot bars; let stand and spread.   Cool and cut.  Makes 24 bars.

name: HOT DOG AND GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. frozen green beans
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
4  hot dogs, cut in slices
1  slice toast, cubed
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
paprika
preparation: Cook green beans as label directs, but only for 3 minutes; drain.  In same saucepan, blend margarine and flour; slowly stir in milk, salt, pepper and paprika.  Cook until thickened.  Add hot dogs and green beans; pour into casserole.  Top with bread cubes and cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BEEF CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. Accent
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
chopped green onions
1  pkg. wafer thin sliced corned beef
preparation: Mix half package of meat with other ingredients; form a ball. Cover ball with remaining beef.  Refrigerate several hours.  Cover with plastic wrap.

name: APRICOT-GLAZED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
3  lb. sweet potatoes, cooked, peeled and cut up
1  pkg. brown sugar
5  tsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  c. apricot nectar
1/2  c. hot water
2  tsp. butter or margarine
2  tsp. grated orange peel
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Place sweet potatoes in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish and set aside.  In a saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch, salt and cinnamon.  Stir in apricot nectar, water and orange peel.  Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Remove from heat.  Stir in butter and pecans.  Pour over sweet potatoes.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through.

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
2  lb. steak or venison
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  medium onion
1  small green pepper
1 (16 oz.)  can peeled tomatoes
2  c. beef bouillon
1  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Using mallet, pound flour into both sides of steak.  Saute steak in butter in large skillet over high heat.  Quickly brown both sides.  Place steak in large pot.  Arrange vegetables on steak.  Add skillet drippings, consomme and seasonings.  Simmer, tightly covered, for about 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Serve over rice or broad noodles.  Yields 4 servings.

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
1  c. onion
1  c. celery
1  green pepper
1  stick margarine
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. chicken broth
1  c. grated cheese
1  lb. spaghetti, cooked in chicken stock
3  c. chopped chicken
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Saute onion, celery and green pepper in margarine.  Add cream of mushroom and chicken soups, chicken broth and grated cheese. Remove  from heat and add spaghetti, chicken and salt and pepper to	taste.	Mix  and bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch dish  for  30 minutes at 370°.  Add grated cheese and sprinkle on top last 10 minutes of baking.

name: WATER WHIPPED BAKED PASTRY SHELL
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening (solid)
1  Tbsp. milk
1/4  c. boiling water
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Place first 3 ingredients in deep mixing bowl.  Beat at medium speed with electric mixer until light and fluffy.  Add flour and salt; beat on low speed until dry mixture is moistened. Divide dough in half; shape into balls.  Wrap in plastic wrap and chill 4 hours.  Remove one dough portion at a time.  Place between 12-inch long pieces of wax paper.  Roll into a 12-inch circle; peel away wax paper and place in a 9-inch pie plate and flute edges.  Prick bottom and sides with a fork.  Repeat procedure with remaining dough.  Bake at 350° for 18 minutes until lightly browned.  Cool.  Yield: two 9-inch pie shells.

name: CINNAMON ORNAMENTS
ingredients:
1 large  bottle ground cinnamon (4.12 oz.) or 1 c.
3/4  c. applesauce
preparation: Combine cinnamon and applesauce to form a stiff dough.  Add additional applesauce if necessary.  Roll out dough to 1/4-inch thickness.  Cut with cookie cutters.  Make a hole with a straw at the top.  Carefully place on wire rack or in dehydrator to dry. Let air dry several days, turning occasionally.  Makes 12 sweet smelling ornaments.  Great for kids!

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  lb. butter or oleo
9  eggs
2 2/3  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. butter flavoring
1 1/2  tsp. lemon extract
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Use two bowls to mix this cake.  In one bowl, mix together the flour and butter and work until it is creamy.  In second bowl, mix eggs and sugar, beating until light and fluffy.  Then mix the two together, beating well.  Add baking powder, salt, butter flavoring, and lemon extract and vanilla extract.  Mix thoroughly.  Pour into a very large tube pan (or use 2 pans).  Bake 1 hour in 300° oven. Increase heat to 325° and bake 15 to 20 minutes longer.

name: FRESH CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. fresh cranberries
1  large orange, peeled, deseeded and cut into squares
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  pkg. mixed fruit jello
1 1/2  c. water
1/2  c. nuts
1  large apple
1/2  c. celery
1  c. drained pineapple
preparation: Place orange squares and cranberries in blender.  Blend. Remove from blender.  Place in a bowl.  Add sugar; let set 2 hours.  Mix jello and water until dissolved.  Set aside to cool. Chop nuts, apple and celery; add pineapple.  Fold together.

name: SWEET-SOUR SMOKIES
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  jar plum jam (can substitute grape jelly)
1 (8 oz.)  jar mustard
2  (5 oz.) pkgs. Little Smokies
preparation: Combine all ingredients. Cover and simmer in slow cooker for 1 hour.

name: HOT FRUIT
ingredients:
1  can sliced pineapple
1  can pear halves
1  can peach halves
1  can apricots
1  can apple rings
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. sherry wine
preparation: Combine oleo, sugar, flour and wine and bring to boil.  Pour over drained fruit and refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: EASY CHICKEN ENCHILADA SOUP
ingredients:
1 (26 oz.)  can chicken and rice soup
1 (10 oz.)  can Ro-Tel tomatoes and chile peppers
1 (15 oz.)  can beans (black, pinto or kidney)
1 (15 oz.)  can yellow corn
1 large (12.5 oz.)  can chicken breast meat (Sweet Sue's works best)
preparation: Mix and warm to boil.

name: PIZZABURGERS
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger, cooked and drained
1  lb. American cheese
1  pkg. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
1  can Spam
1  pt. spaghetti sauce
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. sage
sprinkle of parsley
preparation: Grind or grate cheese and Spam.  Add to cooked hamburger, along with other ingredients.  Simmer (the longer, the better). Put on bun half and broil.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  lb. butter
6  eggs
1 small  carton whipping cream
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix butter and sugar together, add eggs.  Mixing well, add flavoring.  Add flour, starting with flour and alternate with cream, beat well.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 40 to 50 minutes. Start in a cold oven.

name: WATERGATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
3  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. oil
1  (3 oz.) instant pistachio pudding mix
1  c. 7-Up or Sprite
preparation: Mix until well blended.  Pour into greased and floured cake pan or two 9-inch pans.  Bake approximately 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.  Cool.

name: ESCALLOPED HAMBURG
ingredients:
1  lb. extra lean ground beef
2  or 3 large potatoes, thinly sliced
1  medium onion, chopped fine
salt and pepper
butter or margarine
milk
preparation: Put a layer of hamburg in a 2-quart casserole dish.  Season with salt and pepper.  Put a layer of thinly sliced raw potatoes and onions, chopped fine on top.  Dot with butter.  Alternate layers until dish is full.  Cover with enough milk to moisten and reach top layer.  Bake 1 1/2 hours in hot oven at 400°.

name: SAUSAGE BALL APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  box Bisquick
1 1/2  lb. hot bulk sausage
1/4  lb. coon cheese, melted
preparation: Mix Bisquick and sausage.  Add melted cheese and mix well. Form into tiny balls and freeze.  Take from freezer, as needed, and bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Yield:  150 balls or more, depending on size.

name: STUFFED PEPPERS ALA MIKE
ingredients:
6  bell peppers
1  c. cooked long grain rice
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. beef broth
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  Tbsp. light brown sugar
2  lb. ground or chopped meat
2  Tbsp. sage
2  eggs
1  medium onion
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Clean peppers.  Remove seeds and white membrane.  Blanch in salted boiling water for five minutes.  Drain and place in greased ovenware dish.  Peel and dice onion and pepper lids.

name: BLACK WALNUT CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine (1/2 lb.)
2 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1 3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
4  medium eggs
3/4  c. milk
1  c. chopped black walnuts (about 5 oz.)
preparation: Cream shortening. Add next 4 ingredients and mix together. Add milk and vanilla.  Beat.  Add eggs and mix well.  Add nuts. Pour into greased and floured tube cake pan.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour.  Cool in pan for 20 minutes.  Remove from pan and let cool.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. diced chicken, cooked
1/2  c. chicken broth
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. sliced onion
2  c. diced celery
1  pkg. slivered almonds
1  can sliced mushrooms
1  can bean sprouts
water chestnuts
2  cans chow mein noodles (save 1 can for top)
preparation: Combine all ingredients; put in casserole.  Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can cranberries or cranberry sauce
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. raspberry Jell-O
1  small Cool Whip
2  c. hot water
preparation: Dissolve in 2 cups hot water the Jell-O and add can of cranberries.  When firm, but not set, whip in Cool Whip.  Pour into bowl or mold to set.

name: CUCUMBER RELISH
ingredients:
4  qt. grated cucumbers
4  c. grated onions
4  pods hot pepper
1  pt. vinegar
4  c. sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. turmeric
1  tsp. celery seed
1/4  c. salt
preparation: Mix cucumber and salt.  Let set for 4 hours.  Drain well.  Mix cucumbers and all other ingredients in dishpan.  Cook for 20 minutes.  Pack in pint jars while hot enough to seal.  This is good with hot dogs or beans.  (Be sure to drain salty water out as good as you can.)

name: FRIENDSHIP CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow pudding-in-the-cake mix
2/3  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs
1  c. chopped nuts
2  c. brandied fruit, drained well
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Bake in a greased tube or Bundt pan at 300° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.  These cakes freeze well or will keep several days at room temperature, staying moist.

name: PICKLED RED ONIONS
ingredients:
3  large red onions, very thinly sliced
1  c. tarragon red wine vinegar
1  tsp. sugar
3  whole cloves
4  black peppercorns, crushed
preparation: Place onions in a saucepan with the vinegar and enough cold water (about 1 cup) to cover.  Add sugar, cloves and peppercorns. Simmer over medium heat for 10 minutes or until the onions are tender.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
1/2  gal. raspberry sherbet, softened
1  qt. ginger ale or 7-Up
1  can pineapple juice
preparation: Serves 35.

name: BABY BACK RIBS WITH OYSTER SAUCE
ingredients:
baby back ribs
1 (8 oz.)  bottle oyster sauce
5  garlic cloves
1  ginger root
1  c. sugar
1/2  bottle water (oyster bottle)
preparation: Peel garlic cloves and smash them.  Peel ginger root and smash them.  Put ribs in a pot on top of the stove, covered with garlic and ginger.  Turn heat on medium-high; cook for 45 minutes. Uncover and pour oyster sauce over ribs.  Mix water in oyster sauce bottle 1/2 full.  Shake well and pour over ribs.  Cover and continue to cook at medium heat for 15 minutes.  Uncover, add 1 cup sugar, mixing well.  Cover and continue to cook for 15 minutes.  Uncover and turn off heat.  Allow ribs to air cook.  Eat 'em up.

name: LOIS H'S BAKED CARROTS
ingredients:
8  c. sliced carrots
2  medium onions
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. seasoned croutons
1  stick butter or margarine
preparation: Cook carrots until just slightly done, about 8 minutes.  Saute onions in the 3 tablespoons butter.  Mix together all but the croutons and stick of butter.  Place in buttered or sprayed 9 x 13-inch pan.  Melt the stick of butter.  Toss in the croutons. Sprinkle over the carrots.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. sliced mushrooms
1  c. chopped zucchini
1/2  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. oregano
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
5  eggs, beaten
1/3  c. milk
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Saute onion and mushrooms.  Add rest of ingredients.  Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 350°.  Test until set.  Save 2 tablespoons cheese for the top.

name: CHEESY POTATO STICKS
ingredients:
2  lb. Russet potatoes
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1/2  c. dry fine bread crumbs
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Peel potatoes or wash skins thoroughly.  Cut lengthwise into quarters.  Cut each quarter into thirds.  Coat potatoes with margarine.  Combine crumbs, cheese and seasonings.  Roll potatoes in mixture.

name: ROUND STEAK SAUERBRATEN
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak (1/2-inch thick)
1  envelope brown gravy mix
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. wine vinegar
1  tsp. Worcestershire
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1  bay leaf
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cut meat into 1-inch squares.  Brown in 1 tablespoon shortening.  Remove from pan.  Add gravy mix to pan.  Mix in 2 cups water.  Bring to boil, stirring constantly.  Stir in rest of ingredients; add meat.  Place in 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Cover. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Serve over buttered noodles.

name: GRANDMA ORR'S FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can chunked pineapple
1 (11 oz.)  can Mandarin oranges
1  can light cherries, pitted
1  egg yolk
1  tsp. flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts
small marshmallows to taste
1/2  pt. freshly made whipping cream
preparation: Drain together pineapple,  Mandarin oranges and cherries and keep the juice.  Mix together the egg yolk, flour and sugar with a fork.  Add enough drained fruit juice to this to equal 1/2 cup. Stir.  Add 1/2 cup nuts and marshmallows to taste.  To this, fold in one-half pint fresh whipping cream (whipped until it forms stiff peaks with 1 tablespoon granulated sugar).  Chill.

name: MARK'S FAVORITE FETTUCINI
ingredients:
1  onion
3  cloves garlic
1/2  red bell pepper
1  c. sliced mushrooms
3/4  lb. shrimp, peeled and deveined
2  tsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. half and half
fettucini
preparation: In a large skillet, saute onion, garlic, bell pepper and mushrooms in olive oil and wine.  Add seasonings to taste, i.e., basil, red pepper, garlic powder and salt.  Add shrimp.  Cook over medium-low heat until shrimp are done (10 minutes).  Mix cornstarch in cold half and half.  Pour into hot vegetables.  Turn up heat to thicken.  Add the rest of the half and half.  Turn heat to low and let simmer for 5 to 10 minutes, while noodles cook. Stir often.  Serve over fettucini.  Serves 4.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
4  pkg. Pillsbury rolls
1  c. brown sugar
1  stick butter
preparation: Grease Bundt pan; cut rolls in fours and roll the pieces in a mixture of white sugar and cinnamon.  Drop the pieces in a Bundt pan (even) until all pieces are used.  Melt the butter or oleo with the brown sugar and pour over rolls.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown on top.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1/2  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. parsley
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onions
1  lb. browned ground beef, drained
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain.  Add all ingredients; simmer 30 minutes.  Serve over egg noodles or rice.

name: SURE SHOOT ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. hot water
1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. Crisco
1/2  tsp. salt
1  beaten egg
1  pkg. quick rise yeast
2  Tbsp. warm water
3  c. flour
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients, stir until Crisco melts.  Add one beaten egg and 1 package quick rise yeast dissolved in 2 tablespoons warm water.  Add 3 cups flour.  Beat until dough is smooth.  Cover and let rise until double in bulk, about 1 1/2 hours.  Turn out on floured surface and knead until smooth and no longer sticky.  Roll out to about 3/8-inches thick.  Cut with large cutter.  Brush with melted oleo and fold over.  Place in greased pan.  Let rise until doubled again.  Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Makes about 18 large rolls.

name: GRAPEFRUIT JELLY
ingredients:
5  c. sugar
4  c. grapefruit juice
Sure-Jell
preparation: Measure sugar; set aside.  Measure grapefruit juice into large pan.  Stir in Sure-Jell and mix.  Bring to a rolling boil, stirring constantly.  Add sugar; bring to a rolling boil for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat and pour into jars.  Top with paraffin.

name: EASY MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
3  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  tsp. salt
1  small onion, chopped
1  can condensed tomato soup
1 1/2  tsp. chili powder
8  crackers, crumbled up
1  egg
dash of pepper
1/2  bell pepper
1  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. catsup
preparation: Combine all ingredients; pack lightly in a large, greased loaf pan.  Bake in the oven at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: QUICHE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped ham
1  c. broccoli
1  onion
4  oz. grated Mozzarella cheese
4  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
3  eggs
2 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. flour
salt and pepper
2  (9-inch) pie shells
preparation: Beat eggs and milk.  Add flour, salt and pepper; mix until no lumps remain.  Divide remaining ingredients in half; place in each of the pie shells.  Pour milk and egg mixture equally into each pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes, or until knife comes out clean, or until top is golden brown.  Let stand 15 minutes.

name: SESAME CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
2  pkg. chicken wing drummettes
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. dry sherry
1  tsp. ginger
2  tsp. Oriental sesame oil
maple syrup
1  Tbsp. sesame seed
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Coat 9 x 13-inch pan with nonstick cooking spray.  In pan, mix soy sauce, sherry, ginger, sesame oil and 2 tablespoons syrup.  Add wings; turn to coat.  Bake 45 minutes, basting often.  Add water if gets too dry.  Brush wings with 2 tablespoons syrup; sprinkle with seed.  Bake 15 minutes longer.

name: COCA-COLA CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Coca-Cola
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  sticks butter
2  c. plain flour
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
2  eggs, unbeaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. marshmallows
preparation: Boil first 3 ingredients; add flour and sugar, then add buttermilk, soda, eggs, vanilla and marshmallows.  Mix all together in bowl.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: SWEET AND SOUR PORK
ingredients:
1/2 to 1  lb. boneless pork
2  Tbsp. oil
1 (16 oz.)  can pineapple chunks (undrained)
1/2  to 1 green pepper
1/2  c. corn syrup
1/4  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. ketchup
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  clove minced garlic
cornstarch
