preparation: Heat oil in skillet with pork (lightly seasoned with garlic salt), cut into bite size pieces.  Add pineapple and green pepper. Turn heat down to low.  When pineapple juice starts to thicken and brown, add cornstarch (into which vinegar, ketchup, soy sauce and garlic have been stirred).  When pork and pepper are fork-tender, add thickening made of 2 tablespoons cornstarch and 2 tablespoons water and stir until clear.  Serve over cooked rice.

name: DOUBLE FUDGE BROWNIE BAR
ingredients:
1  pkg Double Fudge Brownie Mix
2  eggs
1/3  C water
1/4  C vegetable oil
1  C Peanut butter chips
1/2  C pecans, chopped
1  C flaked coconut
1  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Grease bottom only of 3 x 9 inch pan.

name: ANN'S POTATO SOUPStilwell, Kansas
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1  large onion, chopped
4  c. diced, raw potatoes
1  large carrot, sliced
4  c. chicken broth
Salt and pepper to taste
1  c. light cream
2  Tbsp. fresh dill
preparation: Melt butter in a large pan.  Add onion, potatoes and carrot. Cover and cook over low heat for 5 to 10 minutes.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. onions, chopped
1 1/2  cloves garlic, minced
3  Tbsp. (give or take) all-purpose flour
1/2  c. green peppers, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
16  oz. can tomatoes, cut up
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. water
2  bay leaves
1  tsp. dried oregano
1  Tbsp. dried thyme
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. hot pepper sauce
1 1/2  tsp. white pepper
1  tsp. ground red pepper
3/4  tsp. black pepper
1 1/2  tsp. dried basil leaves
2  tsp. sugar
10  oz. frozen or canned, chopped okra
3  lb. or 3 1/2 lb. fresh jumbo shrimp
1  can or 1 lb. flaked crab meat
2  Tbsp. low-sodium soy sauce
4  (6 oz.) skinned chicken breast halves
3  Tbsp. sesame seed
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
garlic powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
vegetable cooking spray
1  Tbsp. margarine, melted
preparation: Place soy sauce in a shallow dish; add chicken, turning to coat.  Remove chicken from soy sauce; discard soy sauce.  Combine sesame seed and next 3 ingredients in a large zip-top heavy-duty plastic bag.  Add chicken; seal bag and shake to coat chicken with sesame seed mixture.

name: HEAVENLY ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/8  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
1/4  c. warm water
1  pkg. dry yeast
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water; set aside.  Mix dry ingredients in order given, cutting in shortening.  Stir in buttermilk and water with yeast in it.  Blend thoroughly and the dough is ready to be refrigerated in a large, covered bowl, or made into biscuits.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
olives, chopped
2  (8 oz.) softened cream cheese
1  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, finely grated
1  lb. Velveeta cheese (at room temperature)
1  tsp. hot sauce
3  Tbsp. minced onion (if desired)
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  c. nuts, finely chopped
preparation: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  This is best done using your hands to mix.  Shape into a ball and roll in nuts or chopped olives, if desired.  Wrap in waxed paper and then in airtight container.

name: FANCY FRENCH BEANS
ingredients:
4  c. frozen French-style green beans
1  c. bean sprouts
1  can (8 oz.) sliced water chestnuts, drained
2  Tbsp. butter/margarine
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of cayenne pepper
1 1/2  c. half & half cream
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. sliced almonds
1/4  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook beans according to package directions.  Add bean sprouts and water chestnuts; heat through.	Drain well and set aside.  In a saucepan melt better.  Stir in flour, salt, pepper and cayenne until smooth.  Gradually add cream.  Bring to a boil;  cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.  Add Worcestershire sauce and bean mixture; toss to coat.  Pour into a greased 2-qt. baking dish.  Combine almonds and cheese; sprinkle over the top.  Broil 4-6 inches from the heat for 5 minutes or until almonds are golden brown and cheese is bubbly.

name: SYRUP CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  c. milk
2  c. pure cane syrup
4  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
preparation: Cream  butter  until  soft.  Add  sugar and blend well. Add eggs  and  mix.  Add  milk, syrup, flour, soda and spices; mix until well blended.  Pour into 9 x 13 x 2-inch greased pan which has been lined with greased waxed paper.

name: ORANGE EGGNOG
ingredients:
2  eggs, separated
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. chilled orange juice
1 1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. milk
pinch of salt
nutmeg
preparation: Beat  egg  yolks  until  thick.  Beat  in sugar, stir in orange and lemon juices.  Add milk.  Cover and chill.  Beat egg whites  with  salt  until  soft  peaks form.  Beat in remaining sugar until  eggs are stiff.  Beat egg whites into orange juice mixture.  Pour in glasses.  Sprinkle nutmeg and serve chilled.

name: CRAB STUFFED CHERRY TOMATOES
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. frozen crab meat, thawed and flaked
1  pt. cherry tomatoes
1/4  c. real mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. minced fresh parsley
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
pinch of salt
fresh parsley or watercress sprigs
preparation: Drain crab meat on several layers of paper towels.  Thinly slice tops and bottoms from tomatoes.  With a small melon ball cutter, remove pulp and drain upside-down on paper towels.

name: WONDERFUL STUFFED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  baking potatoes
3/4  c. 1% low-fat cottage cheese
1/4  c. 1% low-fat milk
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  tsp. dill weed
3/4  tsp. herb seasoning
4 to 6  drops hot pepper sauce
2  tsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Prick potatoes with fork.  Bake at 425° for 60 minutes, or until fork is easily inserted.  Cut potatoes in half lengthwise. Carefully scoop out potatoes, leaving about 1/2 inch of pulp inside shell.  Mash pulp in large bowl.  Mix in by hand the remaining ingredients, except Parmesan cheese.  Spoon mixture into potato shells.  Sprinkle top with 1/4 teaspoon Parmesan cheese. Place on baking sheet and return to oven.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until tops are golden brown.

name: GOURMET DRESSING
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  envelope French salad dressing mix
2  Tbsp. salad oil
2/3  c. tomato juice
preparation: Pour vinegar into cruet; add salad dressing mix and shake well.  Add salad oil and tomato juice.  Shake.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. oil
3  eggs
2  c. flour
3/4  tsp.salt
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1 medium  can crushed pineapple
1  c. coconut
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. grated carrots
2  c. walnuts
preparation: Cream together oil, sugar and eggs; add dry ingredients.  Add carrots and nuts; add vanilla and mix well with mixer.  Pour into greased funnel cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. baking soda
2  c. shredded, unpeeled zucchini
1  c. raisins
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
3  eggs
1  c. oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except eggs and oil, in a large mixing bowl.  In a small bowl beat the eggs and oil.  Pour the egg mixture over the flour mixture and stir until moistened.  Turn into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch bread pan.  Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool in pan 10 minutes (at least).  Invert on rack; turn top side up.

name: ICE CREAM DESSERT
ingredients:
1  stick softened oleo
2  boxes instant vanilla pudding
1  qt. soft butter brickle ice cream
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. Lorna Doone cookies
1 1/2  c. milk
4  Heath candy bars, frozen
preparation: Mix together oleo  and	cookies  and press into 8 1/2 x 11-inch cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes and cool.

name: CABBAGE AND RICE JAMBALAYA IN RICE COOKER
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage, chopped
1/2  lb. lean ground beef, browned and drained
1/2  lb. sausage, browned and drained
1  can diced Ro-Tel tomatoes
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  tsp. garlic powder
salt and pepper to taste
1 1/2  c. raw rice
1 1/2  c. water
preparation: Mix all ingredients and cook in large rice cooker.  Let stand about 15 minutes after bell rings.

name: PORK CHOP BAKE
ingredients:
5  medium pork chops
6  medium potatoes, thinly sliced
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. shredded cheese
1/2  c. milk
4  Tbsp. margarine
1  medium onion
preparation: Salt and pepper chops.  Place potatoes in shallow baking dish, and layer with onion and cheese.  Add milk and margarine.  Arrange pork chops across top and cover with foil.  Bake at 425° for 1 hour.

name: RED LOBSTER'S CHEESE-GARLIC BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. prepared baking mix (Bisquick)
2/3  c. milk
1/2  c. (2 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Mix baking mix, milk and cheese until a soft dough forms; beat vigorously 30 seconds.  Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes, until golden brown.  Mix butter and garlic powder; brush over warm biscuits before removing from cookie sheet.   Serve warm.  Makes 12 biscuits.

name: SOUTHERN PECAN PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. melted butter
1 1/4  c. light corn syrup
1 1/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Beat eggs with whisk.  Add salt, butter, syrup, sugar and vanilla; mix well.  Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell; sprinkle with pecans.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: WHOLE-WHEAT SODA BREAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. white flour, divided
2  c. whole-wheat flour
1 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter, cut into bits
1  c. golden raisins
2  Tbsp. caraway seed
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
2  large eggs, lightly beaten
melted butter for brushing loaf after baking
preparation: Mix 2 cups white flour and 2 cups wheat flour and add raisins and caraway seed. Cut in butter. Combine milk and eggs; stir into dry ingredients. Turn dough onto board and knead in remaining 1/2 cup flour. Shape into 8-inch pancake. Place on greased cookie sheet. Mark an X on top. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. bacon, diced
2  c. bread crumbs
1/4  c. minced onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
2  cans (16.5 oz. each) cream-style corn
preparation: In a skillet, fry bacon until lightly browned.  Remove and set aside.  Pour 1/8 to 1/4 cup of bacon drippings over bread crumbs; set aside.  Discard all but 2 tablespoons of remaining drippings. Saute onion and green pepper until tender.  Stir in corn and bacon.  Spoon into a 1-quart baking dish and sprinkle with crumbs. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly and heated through.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  c. Crisco
1  pkg. yeast, softened in 2 Tbsp. warm water
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Sift all dry ingredients together and cut in Crisco.  Add buttermilk and yeast.  Mix and knead well.  Roll out and cut biscuits.  Bake at 450° until done.

name: BANANA SLUSH PUNCH
ingredients:
6  c. water
3  qt. ginger ale, Sprite or 7-Up
5  bananas, mashed
4  c. sugar
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade or 1/4 c. lemon juice
preparation: Boil sugar and water until dissolved; cool.  Add fruit juices and bananas.  Blend well and freeze.  Let thaw about 2 hours before serving.  Just before serving, add the ginger ale in punch bowl and stir until slushy.

name: TUNA POT PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. diced carrots
1 1/2  c. diced potatoes
3  tsp. chopped onions
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. flour
1  can tuna (6 oz) in oil
1  c. English peas
1  pie crust
preparation: Cook carrots, potatoes and onions until tender in liquid from peas.  Drain off liquid and add oil from tuna and enough milk to make 2 cups of liquid.  Melt butter, blend in flour, and add liquid stirring constantly until thickened.  Pour over cooked vegetables.  Add tuna and peas.  Season to taste.  Turn into greased casserole dish and cover with pie crust.  Bake at 425° until crust is brown.  Makes 4 large servings.

name: Mint Chocolate Chip Shake(Yield: Two 8 oz. Drinks)
ingredients:
Mint Chocolate Chip Ice Cream
Milk
preparation: 1. Put 2 large scoops of Mint Chocolate Chip Ice Cream into a blender.

name: VEGGIE DIP
ingredients:
2/3  c. mayonnaise (not Miracle Whip)
1/3  c. sour cream
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. dill weed
1 BIG  tsp. minced onion or 1 tsp. dehydrated onion, slightly crushed
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
preparation: Mix thoroughly and refrigerate overnight for best flavor. Great with all raw vegetables and chips.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  to 6 pork chops
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
1  can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Brown pork chops.  Using oil from the chops, liberally grease a casserole dish.  Line dish with rice; cover with undiluted soup and add milk.  Place chops on top.  Cover.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

name: HONEY BUN CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
4  eggs
1  c. brown sugar
2  c. powdered sugar
3/4  c. oil
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
3  tsp. cinnamon
4  tsp. milk
preparation: Grease and flour 9 x 13 pan. Mix cake mix, oil, eggs and sour cream. Pour half of batter into prepared pan.

name: HONEY BUNCH MUNCHIES
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. rolled oats
1  c. coconut
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/2  c. margarine or butter
3/4  c. packed brown sugar
3  Tbsp. honey
1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
pecan halves (optional)
whole dried apricots (optional)
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, stir together oats, coconut, flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt and nutmeg.  In a small saucepan, cook and stir margarine or butter, sugar and honey over medium heat until sugar dissolves. Remove from heat.  Pour over oat mixture.  Mix well.

name: TEXAS HASH
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. oil
3  large onions
1  green pepper, minced
1  lb. ground beef
1  can tomatoes
1/2  c. uncooked Minute rice
1  tsp. chili powder
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Saute the onions and green pepper in the salad oil until they are tender.  Add the ground beef.  Cook until the beef is brown. Stir in the tomatoes, uncooked rice, chili powder, salt and pepper.  Pour into a 2-quart baking dish.  Bake 1 hour in a 350° oven.

name: BEEF RICE SOUP(Beef Barley Soup)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
5  c. water
1 (16 oz.)  can peeled tomatoes
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. sliced carrots
1  c. chopped celery
1/3  c. pearl barley or 1/4 c. rice
1/4  c. ketchup
1  tsp. beef bouillon
2  tsp. seasoned salt
1  tsp. dried basil
1  bay leaf
salt and pepper
preparation: Brown and drain meat.   Add all ingredients and simmer for 1 hour.

name: HAM LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ham
1  lb. pork
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. pineapple juice
1  c. milk
1  tsp. mustard
1  can crushed cracker crumbs
preparation: Grind ham and pork together.  Mix all ingredients together. Spread 1 cup brown sugar in bottom of pan.  Place loaf in pan. Combine 1 tablespoon vinegar and 1 cup crushed pineapple; pour over top.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  Let cool and invert on a plate.

name: BROCCOLI RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  onion
1/2  stick margarine
1  can nacho cheese soup
1  to 2 heads broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. prepared brown rice
preparation: Saute onion in margarine.  Add broccoli, mushroom soup, nacho soup and rice.  Put into casserole and bake 30 minutes at 325°.

name: Mexican Hot Chili
ingredients:
3  lb. hamburger
2  medium onions
4  sticks celery (optional)
3 to 4  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  tsp. paprika
2  Tbsp. cumin powder
1/2  tsp. black pepper
4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1 (46 oz.)  can tomato juice
2  cans chili beans or red kidney beans
preparation: Peel and finely dice onions and celery.  Brown in heavy pot with ground beef (drain).  Add seasonings.  Cook together a few minutes.  Add tomato juice and simmer about 1 hour.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. salad oil
2  c. sugar
2  c. grated, peeled zucchini
2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts (optional)
1  tsp. grated lemon rind
preparation: Beat eggs until light; add sugar, salt, oil and vanilla, mixing well until thick.  Add zucchini; stir thoroughly.  Sift flour, cinnamon, baking powder and soda.  Add, stirring until smooth.  Add chopped nuts and lemon rind.  Bake in 2 greased and floured loan pans, about 1 hour in a 350° oven.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
5  bananas
1 small  jar cherries
1 small  pkg. nuts
2  c. crushed graham crackers
1  large tub Cool Whip
2  c. powdered sugar
2  eggs
1 large  can crushed pineapple
3  sticks margarine
preparation: Mix 1 stick margarine and 2 cups cracker crumbs and pat into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

name: SIMPLE CHILI
ingredients:
4  cans tomato soup
2  cans kidney beans
2  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onions
2  Tbsp. chili powder
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown and drain ground beef.  Mix together soup, beans, onions, chili powder, salt and pepper.  Add ground beef.  Cook over low heat until ready to serve.  Can simmer all day.

name: MOIST AND CRISPY CHICKEN
ingredients:
3  c. Rice Krispies, finely crushed
1  tsp. paprika
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  broiler fryer chicken, cut up
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Place crushed Rice Krispies in plastic bag with salt, pepper and paprika.  Shake to blend.  Brush chicken parts with mayonnaise.  Place, 1 piece at a time, in bag.  Shake bag to coat well.  Place on rack in broiler pan.  Bake at 425° for 40 to 45 minutes, or until golden brown.

name: CREAM CHEESE AND TACO SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. Tostitos or taco chips
1  jar taco sauce or picante sauce (mild)
preparation: Place cream cheese block on serving platter and pour sauce over.  Place chips around sides and dip off cream cheese with chips.

name: EASY SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
2  c. Minute rice
1  c. water
2  c. spaghetti sauce
preparation: Combine all three ingredients in vented microwave-safe dish. Cook on full power for 8 minutes.  Let set two minutes; fluff with fork and serve.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. box spaghetti
1  cucumber
2  tomatoes
1  bottle McCormick Salad Supreme
1/2  green pepper
1 (4 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms
8  oz. bottle Italian dressing
preparation: Cook spaghetti; rinse and drain well.  Mix all ingredients together and let set at least 4 hours.  Stir occasionally.

name: CHOCOLATE TRUFFLE
ingredients:
1  devil's food cake (prepared, baked, cooled)
2  pkg. chocolate pudding (made and set)
1  container Cool Whip or heavy cream, whipped
5  small Heath bars, crushed in blender
1/2  c. Kahlua
preparation: Divide all ingredients by 3 to make enough for 3 layers. Start with:  cake (crumbled up), Kahlua, pudding, Cool Whip or whipped cream, Heath bars.  Repeat 2 more times.

name: FRESH FRUIT TRIFLE
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1 1/4  c. skim milk
1/2  c. plain low-fat yogurt
1  tsp. grated orange peel
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. vanilla sugar-free instant pudding
4  c. assorted sliced fruit (strawberries, nectarines, grapes, orange and/or pineapple)
preparation: In medium bowl, combine milk, yogurt and orange peel; blend well.  Beat until well blended.  Let stand 5 minutes.  In large trifle bowl, layer half the cake pieces, 1/3 of the fruit and 1/2 the pudding.  Repeat layers.  Arrange remaining fruit on top. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 6 hours before serving.  Calories 130, fat 1 g.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. oil
4  eggs
1 (2 c.)  can pumpkin
3 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4 - 1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. allspice
2/3  c. cold water
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, oil, eggs, pumpkin and vanilla together.  Set aside.  Combine all dry ingredients and add to mix alternately with water.  Add nuts.  Grease and flour 3 loaf pans.  Makes 3 loaves. Bake in electric oven at 325° for 1 to 1-1/2 hours or gas oven at 375°, test for doneness.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
2  c. canned whole corn
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. sour cream
3  strips bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
preparation: Saute onion and pepper in butter until transparent and then place in casserole dish.  Add corn, salt and sour cream; mix thoroughly.  Cook in moderate oven for 20 minutes.  (Cream must not boil.)  Sprinkle very crisp bacon over top of casserole when ready to serve.

name: SAUSAGE CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  large onion, chopped
2  eggs
1-1/2  cups self-rising corn meal
1  can (17 oz.) cream style corn
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. vegetable oil
2  c. (8 oz.) grated cheddar cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°. Grease 10-1/2 inch iron skillet or 2 qt. baking dish. Brown sausage and onion. Drain well. Combine eggs, cornmeal, corn, milk, and oil. Pour half of cornmeal mix in prepared dish. Sprinkle with sausage mixture and cheese. Pour remaining batter on top. Bake 30-40 minutes.

name: FRESH BLUEBERRY PIE  - NO BAKE
ingredients:
1  pie shell, baked (9-inch)
4  c. fresh blueberries
1/4  c. cold water
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
dash of salt
1/2  c. water
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. blueberries
preparation: Dissolve cold water, cornstarch and salt until it makes  a paste.  In a medium saucepan, bring to boil the water, sugar and 1 cup blueberries.  Add cornstarch paste to mixture, stirring and cooking until mixture thickens.  Cool to room temperature.  Fold in remaining blueberries and turn into cooked pie shell. Refrigerate until serving; top with whipped cream.

name: MICROWAVE CARAMEL POPCORN
ingredients:
15 to 20  c. popped popcorn
1  c. brown sugar
1  stick margarine
1/4  c. white corn syrup
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Spray the inside of a large brown paper bag with Pam.  Put popcorn in bag.

name: SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. ground beef
3  cans vegetarian vegetable soup
8  to 10 potatoes
1  onion, chopped
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion in pan. Set aside.  Peel potatoes, cook and mash.  In Dutch oven layer ground beef on bottom, soup and mashed potatoes on top.  Bake at 350° until slightly brown.

name: BLONDE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/8  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/3  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: To sifted flour, add baking powder, soda and salt.  Add nuts. Melt butter in saucepan; remove from heat and mix in sugar.  Cool. Stir in egg and vanilla.  Add flour mixture gradually, mixing well. Spread in greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Sprinkle chocolate chips over top.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Do not overbake. Cool in pan; cut in bars.

name: HANKY PANKYS
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese (regular or Mexican)
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. pork sausage
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
salt and pepper to taste
1  loaf cocktail rye bread
preparation: Cube Velveeta into small pieces.  Fry beef and sausage.  Drain well and reheat.  Mix cheese cubes and spices with heated meats. Mix well until meat, cheese and spices are well-blended.

name: MADRESS COOLER
ingredients:
3  parts orange juice
1  part cranberry juice
preparation: Fill tall glass with juice; top with a splash of lemon-lime soda.  Serve over ice with an orange slice.

name: SPECIAL BARS
ingredients:
1  pkg. German chocolate cake mix
1/2  c. melted margarine
1/3  c. evaporated milk
50  Kraft caramels
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix first 3 items and put "half" in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan.  Bake 6 minutes at 350°.  Melt about 50 Kraft caramels in the evaporated milk.  After cake is baked, sprinkle chocolate chips over cake and dribble the caramel mix over the chocolate chips.  Then crumble the remaining half of the cake mixture on the very top of the cake.  Bake again for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: EASY COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. melted oleo
1  egg
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Beat together sugar, oleo, egg and milk.  Sift flour, baking powder and salt.  Add to mix and beat until well mixed (will be thin).  Prepare two 8-inch cake pans (grease and wax paper). Spread mixture evenly into pans.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.  Cool 5 minutes.  Remove from pans.  Brush with melted oleo.  Shake powdered sugar and cinnamon on top.

name: RANCH CRISPY CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/4  c. unseasoned bread crumbs
1  oz. packet Hidden Valley Ranch milk recipe original Ranch dry salad dressing mix
6  to 8 pieces chicken (bone-in)
preparation: Combine bread crumbs and dressing mix in a plastic bag.  Add chicken; shake to coat.  Bake chicken on ungreased baking sheet for 50 minutes at 375°.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: VERMICELLI SALAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. vermicelli spaghetti
1  green pepper, chopped
1 1/2  c. sliced celery
1 1/2  c. chopped green onions
1 (4 oz.)  jar pimientos, chopped and drained
1 (16 oz.)  can pitted black olives, drained
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, thawed
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Cheddar cheese, diced
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. salad oil
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Cook spaghetti according to package; drain and rinse in cold water.  Drain again.  In a large bowl, combine green bell pepper, celery, green onions, pimientos, black olives, peas and cheese. Mix well.  Add drained spaghetti and combine.  In small bowl, combine juice (lemon or lime), salad oil and mayonnaise.  Add to vegetable-spaghetti mixture.  May be served right away or covered and chilled before serving.  (Can use Kraft cheese or Casino Monterey Jack).

name: SPOON BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. whole milk
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. plain corn meal
6  egg yolks
1/2  tsp. baking powder
6  egg whites
preparation: Mix the milk and sugar.  Put the salt in milk and bring to a boil.  Add the corn meal. Stir until cooked, almost 2 minutes. Stir in the egg yolks and baking powder.  Beat the egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture.  Place in buttered baking dish. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: RAISIN DATE PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  c. water
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. raisins or dates
1/2  c. nuts
1  c. milk or apple juice
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Boil the first two ingredients together.  Let cool; pour in bottom of pan.  Mix the remaining ingredients together.  Bake in a 325° oven for 45 minutes.

name: ROCKY ROAD BARS
ingredients:
1  pkg. (6 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter
2  c. Bisquick baking mix
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease bottom of rectangular pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inch.  Heat 1/2 cup of the chocolate chips and the margarine in heavy 1-quart saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally, until melted.  Mix baking mix, sugar, vanilla and eggs.  Stir in chocolate mixture.  Spread in pan.  Bake 15 minutes.  Sprinkle with marshmallows, nuts and remaining chocolate chips.  Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until marshmallows are light brown.  Cool completely.  Cut into about 2-inch squares.  Makes 30 bars.

name: JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  box jello (size depends on how much you want to make)
1 tall, thin  can crushed pineapple
1  small container Cool Whip
1 small  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Drain pineapple.  Mix jello  according to directions so it is just starting to set.  Mix softened cream cheese and pineapple so cheese will not be lumpy.  Mix all ingredients together and chill.

name: FRUIT DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  small pistachio instant pudding
1  can crushed pineapple (with juice)
1 large  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  small Cool Whip
nuts (optional)
other fruit can be added
preparation: Mix pudding and pineapple.  Add fruit cocktail.  Fold in Cool Whip and chill.

name: COCKTAIL MEATBALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef (raw)
1  c. corn flakes
1/2  c. dried parsley
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/3  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  lb. can cranberry sauce
1 (12 oz.)  bottle chili sauce
preparation: Combine ground beef, corn flakes, parsley, eggs, soy sauce, pepper, garlic powder, catsup and onion.  Mix well.  Form small balls and put in pan larger than 9 x 13-inch.

name: BAKED EGGPLANT PARMIGIANA
ingredients:
1  large eggplant, peeled and sliced thin
3  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. oil
2  c. seasoned bread crumbs
2  c. Mozzarella, shredded
Romano or Parmesan cheese, grated
1 large  can tomatoes, crushed
salt and pepper
oregano
garlic powder
basil
preparation: Dip sliced eggplant in eggs, then bread crumbs and fry until golden.  Layer the slices with marinara sauce, then cheeses in rectangular baking dish.

name: HOMEMADE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
6  eggs
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
fresh fruit, mashed
preparation: Beat eggs several minutes.  Beat in sugar one cup at a time. Add vanilla and evaporated milk and pour in 4-quart freezer container.  Either add fresh milk to full line in freezer container or add sweetened fresh fruit, reducing sugar in ice cream mixture by 1/2 to 1 cup depending on taste desired.  Yields 8 to 10 servings.

name: HONEY CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sifted cake flour
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/4  c. honey
2  eggs
3  sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted
2/3  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift flour and measure; add soda and salt and sift together 3 times.  Cream shortening, gradually add honey, beating well after each addition to keep mixture thick.  Add 1/4 of flour mixture and beat until smooth and well blended.  Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each.  Stir in chocolate and blend.  Add remaining flour alternately with water, beating very well after each addition.  Add vanilla.  Bake in 2 greased 9-inch layer pans at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.  Frost and fill with Quick Creamed Frosting.

name: CHICKEN ESCABECHE
ingredients:
1  broiler chicken, cut up
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
8  oz. onion slices
6  Tbsp. lime juice
1/4  c. chicken bouillon
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. chili powder
1 (4 oz.)  jar pimentos, drained
preparation: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper.  Place half the onions in baking dish.  Place chicken on onions and top with remaining onions.  Combine lime juice, bouillon, paprika and chili powder; pour over chicken and onions.  Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking.  Place pimentos over onions and chicken.  Bake, covered, at 325° for 30 minutes. Remove cover.  Bake 30 minutes longer or until chicken is tender. Serves 4.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP OR M&M COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening, butter or margarine
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. milk
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. chocolate chips or M&M's
preparation: In a large bowl, blend shortening and both sugars until well blended. Add eggs and milk; stir until well blended.  Stir in flour and baking soda until well mixed.  Stir in chocolate chips or M&M's (or both, if desired).  Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 7 to 8 minutes until lightly browned.  (Longer if a crisp cookie is desired.)

name: ALPINE CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  chicken breasts, boned
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Swiss cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk or water
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix
3/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Arrange chicken in greased pan.  Layer Swiss cheese over chicken.  Combine soups with milk or water and pour over chicken. Toss stuffing with butter and spoon over all.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 hour and bake uncovered 1 hour.

name: HASH BROWN DISH
ingredients:
2  lb. bag hash browns
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  c. grated cheese
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  stick melted butter
1  tsp. salt
black pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Cook at 350° for 1 hour.

name: QUICK AND EASY PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
1  bag peanut butter chips
1  can condensed milk
preparation: Melt together slowly in a saucepan over low heat, continuously stirring, until all melted.  Pour into a square buttered dish and refrigerate.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. chicken
1/2  c. celery
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. almonds
1  tsp. lemon
3  hard cooked eggs
1  tsp. onion flakes
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Put in buttered casserole with crumbs. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: PINA COLADA
ingredients:
3  oz. rum
6  oz. pineapple juice
2  oz. creme de cacao
3  oz. vanilla ice cream
2  c. crushed ice
maraschino cherries*
pineapple chunks*
preparation: Blend ingredients until smooth.

name: MEXICAN BEEF DIP
ingredients:
4-5 lb. hamburger meat (you can substitute 1/2 and 1/2 with ground turkey - no one will know the difference)
2  blocks Velveeta Mexican Cheese (mild or hot)
3-4 large jars of salsa (mild or hot)
preparation: Brown the ground hamburger and drain well. Set the cooking temperature to low. Cut the Velveeta cheese into 1/2 inch blocks (that is just to help melt the cheese faster than if you drop the whole block into the pot).  Add the cheese and continue to stir so the ground meat does not burn. Once the cheese has started to melt, add the salsa. Once the cheese is completely melted, the dip is done! Allow the dip to cool and put in the fridge. (It is better if made the night before!) Put the crock-pot on the day to serve and put on low heat. Watch out because if it simmers in the crock-pot too long it will get very soupy! Serve with tortilla chips.

name: BIBBER'S CORN LIGHT BREAD
ingredients:
1  egg
1/2  c. sugar
2  c. plain corn meal
1  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  scant tsp soda
2  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. melted butter
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and pour into a greased and floured tube or bundt pan and bake in a slow oven 55 - 60 minutes until browned.

name: BAWATSA(Appetizer)
ingredients:
1  frozen bread dough/pizza dough
1  large green pepper, diced
1  large onion, diced
2  lb. mild sausage (or 1 lb. mild and 1 lb. hot can be used)
2  c. pepperoni, sliced
1  large knob Mozzarella cheese, shredded
Mushrooms (optional)
preparation: Brown sausage in large skillet.  Drain well.  Spread dough on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Spread meat mixture on dough. Layer pepperoni, onions and green pepper on meat.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Roll from short end, making sure ends of dough are secure. Bake at 350° for approximately 20 minutes.  Slice and serve hot.

name: CHEESE STRAWS
ingredients:
1  lb. grated cheese (sharp Cheddar)
1/4  lb. margarine, melted
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. paprika
preparation: Pour melted margarine over grated cheese while margarine is still hot and stir in.  Combine other ingredients and mix into cheese.  Push through pastry tube or cookie press (star tip is suggested).  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until barely brown.  There is no need to grease baking sheet.

name: CHICKEN CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  small onion, chopped
1  tsp. lemon juice
3  drops Tabasco sauce
6  drops Worcestershire sauce
2 (5 oz.)  cans white chicken
1/2  tsp. salt
seasoned salt to taste
preparation: Blend all ingredients; chill for several hours before serving.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CRISPY TREATS
ingredients:
1  c. Karo syrup (light or dark)
1  c. sugar
1  c. peanut butter
6  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  In a large saucepan over low heat, stir together the first 3 ingredients.  Stirring constantly, bring to a boil and boil for 3 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Add cereal; toss to coat well.   Press into pan.  Cool. Cut into 2-inch squares.  Makes 32.

name: HEALTHY SNACK
ingredients:
1/2  stalk celery
1  pkg. baby carrots
1  c. Ranch dressing
1  c. cheese cubes
preparation: Place celery, carrots and cheese on a plate and dressing in a bowl.

name: SPINACH SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh spinach
1/4  lb. bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
1  hard-cooked egg, diced
1  small red onion, separated into rings
1/2  c. Crisco oil
1/4  c. red wine vinegar
1  tsp. salt
freshly ground black pepper
1/8  tsp. oregano
preparation: Wash and pat dry spinach.  Add bacon, diced egg and onion. Combine Crisco oil and remaining ingredients in a screw-top jar. Cover tightly; shake vigorously to blend well.  Pour dressing over spinach mixture; toss lightly to coat evenly.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: VEG-ALL CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans Veg-All mixed veggies, drained
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1  c. grated Cheddar
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. cream of chicken soup
1  c. cracker crumbs
3/4  stick oleo, melted
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients.  Place in casserole dish.  Crush 1 cup cracker crumbs.  Sprinkle on top of casserole.  Pour melted oleo on top.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 20 minutes or until light brown.

name: SEVEN MINUTE FROSTING
ingredients:
2  egg whites
1/4  c. water
1 1/3  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. white syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients in top boiler.  Place over boiling water. Beat at medium speed until frosting stands in peaks.

name: PARTY POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans cream of celery soup
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream or unflavored yogurt
1  medium chopped onion
1  green bell pepper, chopped
3  Tbsp. diced pimento
2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  (32 oz.) bag frozen hash brown potatoes
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except potatoes and cheese.  Stir in potatoes.  Spread in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish or 3-quart casserole bowl.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Uncover and cook until potatoes are tender, about 30 minutes.  Sprinkle with paprika, if desired.  (Eight cups of cubed potatoes can be substituted for the frozen potatoes, if desired.)

name: LEMON LUSH
ingredients:
2  strips oleo
2  c. flour
a few nuts
1  c. powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  (8 or 9 oz.) Cool Whip
2  boxes instant pudding (any flavor)
3 1/2  c. milk
cherries and nuts
preparation: Mix oleo, flour and nuts.  Spread into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Cool.  Mix powdered sugar, cream cheese and  part  of  Cool Whip.  Spread on cooled crust.	Mix instant pudding  with  milk.  Spread  on  cheese mixture.  Top with remaining  Cool Whip, cherries and nuts.  Cut in half for 8-inch square pan.

name: POOR MAN'S CAKE
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  box raisins
1  c. applesauce
1  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
2  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. water
2  c. flour
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: In medium saucepan, combine first 6 ingredients.  Bring to boil.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Cool.  Add eggs.  Mix well.  Sift flour and baking powder.  Add to raisin mixture.  Add nuts.  Place in 2 medium loaf pans or 1 regular size.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: PEAR SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  box lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
1  c. pear juice
1  c. crushed pears
6  oz. cream cheese
1  c. whipping cream, whipped
1 (3 oz.)  box lime jello
preparation: Mix lemon jello, boiling  water  and  pear juice.  Let set until almost firm.  Then add  pears,  cream  cheese  and whipped cream.  When firm, add prepared lime jello on top.

name: ITALIAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
3  lb. potatoes, cooked and cooled
1/3  c. Italian salad dressing
4  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
3/4  c. celery, chopped
1/3  c. onion, chopped
1/4  c. cucumber, chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. sour cream
1  tsp. prepared horseradish
fresh tomatoes, chopped
preparation: Peel and chop cooked potatoes.  Place in a large bowl.  Add dressing and toss to coat.  Cover and chill for 2 hours.  Add eggs, celery, onion, cucumbers and green peppers.  Mix well.  In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, sour cream and horseradish; mix well.  Pour over potato mixture and toss.  Chill at least 1 hour. Top with chopped tomatoes.

name: MOLDAVIAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
6  medium red potatoes, with skins
1/3  c. olive oil
2  to 3 large garlic cloves, pressed
1  c. Feta cheese, crumbled
1/4  c. scallions, finely chopped
3  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
3  Tbsp. fresh or 2 tsp. dried chopped dill
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Boil potatoes for 18 to 20 minutes.  Cool until manageable and cut in 3/4-inch cubes.  Pour garlic and olive oil on potatoes. Toss and let come to room temperature.  Add Feta and scallions and toss.  Sprinkle on vinegar (more to taste, if desired), dill, salt and pepper.  Let sit at least 1 hour on counter to let flavors settle.  Serves 4.

name: CURRIED CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, cooked and deboned
2  cans whole green beans
2  cans cream of chicken soup
3/4  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. curry
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Place beans in bottom of casserole.  Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry.  Spread mixture over beans.  Push in chicken breasts and sprinkle with cheese.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: BUTTERMILK ROAST
ingredients:
1  c. buttermilk
4  lb. chuck, round or rump of beef
1 to 2  cloves garlic
1/4  c. flour
salt and pepper
preparation: Cut garlic and rub meat well, pressing some of the garlic into the meat.  Add salt and pepper and dredge with flour.  Brown on all sides in a small amount of fat.  Add buttermilk and cook slowly until tender, about 3 to 4 hours.  The liquid is a delicious gravy.

name: MOCK CHOP SUEY
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can chop suey vegetables with liquid
1  c. rice
1  medium onion
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion in skillet.  Drain.  Add all other ingredients.  Cook over medium heat for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE(Light and Zesty)
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, halved
1/3  c. Italian salad dressing
2/3  c. uncooked rice (not Minute)
1  (16 oz.) bag frozen Oriental vegetables
1  can French fried onions (can be omitted)
1  can cream of chicken soup
2/3  c. water and 4 chicken bouillon cubes, dissolved
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
preparation: Place chicken in baking dish.  Pour salad dressing over and bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Place rice and vegetables, (onions, if using) around and under chicken.  Combine soup mix and Italian seasoning.  Pour over the chicken and vegetables.  Bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

name: ORANGE JULIUS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. milk
1/3  c. frozen orange juice
1  tsp. nondairy cream powder
1  orange sherbet or vanilla ice cream
preparation: Blend in blender; serve over crushed ice.  Serves 4.

name: SOCK IT TO ME CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines golden butter cake
1/2  c. granulated sugar
4  eggs (beat in one at a time)
3/4  c. butter flavor Wesson oil
1  c. (8 oz.) sour cream
3  tsp. each cinnamon and brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients together.  Pour 1/2 the mixture into tube pan.  Mix cinnamon, brown sugar and pecans and sprinkle 1/2 over mixture of batter in pan.  Add rest of cake mixture.  Now add rest of cinnamon mixture.  Take a knife and circle through entire mixture except very bottom.   Cook 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.

name: COCA-COLA SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. water packed cherries, drained
2  pkg. cherry gelatin
1  c. sugar
1  (2 oz.) Coca-Cola
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. pecans, broken
preparation: Mix cherry juice, gelatin and sugar in saucepan.  Heat, but do not boil.  Remove from heat; cool until mixture begins to thicken. Add Coca-Cola, cherries, pineapple and pecans.  Chill until firm. Makes 12 servings.

name: CORNBREAD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans Lucks pinto beans
2  cans tomato sauce
1  medium onion, chopped
1  lb. browned hamburger
3  c. self-rising cornmeal
preparation: Mix well, except for cornmeal.  Pour into 9 x 12-inch baking pan.  Mix self-rising cornmeal (about 3 cups) and pour on top. Bake at 450° for 45 minutes or until cornbread is done.

name: POTATO SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. oil
2  tsp. prepared mustard
1  Tbsp. sugar
salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients and whip until all are blended.  Pour over potato salad.

name: EVERYDAY BROCCOLI CHEESE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. margarine
4  skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
1  can Campbell's new broccoli cheese soup
1/3  c. water or milk
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  c. broccoli flowerets
preparation: In skillet, over medium heat, in hot margarine, cook chicken 10 minutes or until chicken is brown on both sides.  Spoon off fat.  Stir in soup, water and pepper.  Heat to boiling.  Add broccoli.  Reduce heat to low; cover.  Simmer 10 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender and broccoli is done, stirring occasionally.  Serves 4.

name: CARROTS AND BRUSSELS SPROUTS WITH LEMON BUTTER(Serves 6)
ingredients:
1  lb. carrots, cut in julienne strips
1  lb. Brussels sprouts, trimmed and cut in halves
boiling, salted water
1/3  c. butter or margarine
grated peel and juice of 1/2 lemon
1  tsp. caraway seed
1 small  clove garlic, minced
preparation: Cook carrots and Brussels sprouts together in boiling, salted water until tender, about 10 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  Melt butter in saucepan with lemon peel and juice, caraway seed and garlic.  Add cooked vegetables and heat.  Contains 140 calories per serving.

name: COMPANY CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  breasts
1  can cream of mushroom soup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Remove skin and bones from chicken breasts.  Place in buttered baking pan and cover with cream of mushroom soup.  Cover and bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

name: ICEBOX FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. pecans
1  lb. walnuts
1  lb. raisins
1  lb. marshmallows (the small ones are best)
1  bottle red maraschino cherries
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  lb. vanilla wafers
preparation: Put  all  these in large bowl, grind pecans, walnuts and raisins.  Roll vanilla wafers into fine meal.  Mix the ingredients.

name: BAKED NORTHERN PIKE
ingredients:
2 northern pike, cut in crosswise  slices about 2-inch thick
salt and pepper
1  large sweet onion, cut in thick slices
1 (1 lb.)  can ready-seasoned stewed tomatoes
1  tsp. dried basil leaves
preparation: Place slices of pike in greased baking dish.  Season with salt and pepper.  Place slices of onion on fish.  Spoon tomatoes over onion.  Crumble basil over tomatoes.  Bake in moderate oven at 350° for about 1 hour or until fish flakes easily.  Good served with baked potatoes, carrot casserole and celery, apricot pie for dessert.

name: FROSTED GRAPES
ingredients:
red or purple grapes
1  egg white
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Wash the grapes and dry well.  Beat egg white until slightly frothy.  Sprinkle it over the grapes.  Dust with sugar and let dry.

name: CALICO BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6 to 8  slices bacon
1  lb. hamburg
1  c. chopped onions
3/4  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. wine vinegar
1/4  c. white sugar
1  (16 oz.) pork and beans
1  (16 oz.) kidney beans, drained
1  (16 oz.) lima beans, drained
preparation: Fry bacon and drain.   Add hamburg and onions and brown. Combine catsup, salt, sugars, dry mustard and vinegar.  Add to preceding ingredients.  Add beans.  Place in casserole.   Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Freezes well.

name: POOR BOY'S STRAWBERRY SHORTCAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
3  c. packaged buttermilk pancake mix
1  egg, beaten
2 (8 oz.)  cartons strawberry yogurt
1/3  c. packed brown sugar
1/3  c. milk
1  (4 oz.) container frozen whipped dessert topping, thawed
preparation: Grease lightly and flour 2 (8 x 1 1/2-inch) round baking pans. Set aside.  In large mixing bowl, cut shortening into pancake mix until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Combine eggs, 1 carton of yogurt, brown sugar and milk.  Add to dry ingredients, stirring until moistened.  Turn mixture into prepared pans.  Bake in 375° oven for 25 minutes or until done.  Cool 10 minutes on wire racks.

name: SPAGHETTI A LA ZIKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. thin spaghetti
1 large  can tomatoes
1/2  medium bell pepper
1/2  medium onion, chopped
2  lb. ground meat
salt
pepper
garlic powder
seasoned salt
Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook spaghetti 12 minutes.  Drain.  Cut up tomatoes (or run through blender).  Add to spaghetti.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Add chopped onion and bell pepper to ground beef and cook until beef is browned.  Add mixture to spaghetti.  Mix well.  Pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Cover with slices of cheese.  Let stand several hours before baking for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

name: PEANUT PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. dark corn syrup
1/4  c. butter, melted
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1 1/2  c. chopped roasted Wakefield Peanut Company peanuts
9-inch unbaked deep dish pastry shell
preparation: Beat eggs until foamy.  Add sugar, syrup, butter, salt and vanilla; continue to beat until thoroughly blended.  Stir in peanuts.  Pour into unbaked pastry shell.  Bake in a 375° oven for 50 to 55 minutes.  Serve warm or cold.  Yields 6 servings.

name: QUICK STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pt. sour cream
2  beef bouillon cubes
1  pkg. egg noodles
2  c. water
preparation: Brown and drain ground beef.  In same pan, add to ground beef the soup, bouillon cubes and water.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Add sour cream and simmer 10 minutes longer.  Serve over noodles.

name: CHICKEN N BISCUIT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
10 1/2  oz. can mushroom soup
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1/2  c. milk
1  c. shredded American cheese
10  oz. pkg. frozen peas
2  c. diced cooked chicken
salt and pepper
1  can refrigerated biscuits
preparation: In saucepan combine soup, flour, onion and milk.  Cook until mixture thickens.  Remove from heat.  Blend cheese until melted, stir in peas, chicken and salt and pepper.  Heat through.  Place in 8 or 9-inch baking pan.  Place biscuits around edge of dish. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes, until biscuits are done.

name: APPLE BUTTER
ingredients:
3  c. sweet apple cider
2  lb. apples (about 6 large)
1/4  c. honey
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
1/4  tsp. allspice
preparation: Cook the cider over medium heat until it boils.  Boil 15 minutes.  Peel and core the apples.  Cut into small pieces.   Add apples to boiling cider.  Cover.  Cook apples over low heat until tender, about 1 hour. Stir often.  When apples are tender, remove pot from heat.  Mash apples with a potato masher.  Stir in the honey, cinnamon, cloves and allspice.  Cook the apple mixture, uncovered, over low heat for 30 minutes or until thick.  Cool for at least 15 minutes, then spoon into jars.

name: APPLE RELISH
ingredients:
12  tart apples
6  red bell peppers
6  green bell peppers
2  hot peppers
3  large onions
1   Tbsp. salt
1 1/2   lb. brown sugar
1  pint vinegar
preparation: Chop first 5 ingredients. Put in a large saucepan, add other ingredients and let come to a boil. Boil for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Put mixture into hot sterilized pint jars and seal.

name: BEST EVER CUBED STEAK
ingredients:
4  large pieces cubed steak
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  can water
2  Tbsp. butter
1  small onion
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt to taste
pepper to taste
garlic powder to taste
4 heaping  Tbsp. sour cream (optional)
preparation: Dredge	meat  in  flour.  Set  aside.  Slice  onion and saute in	butter.  Remove  onion.  Add steak and brown on both sides over  medium  heat.  Place	meat in Pyrex dish in single layers. Put  onions  on top.  Mix soup, Worcestershire sauce, water, sour cream and seasonings.  Pour over meat.  Cover with foil.

name: DREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1/2  c. oil
4  eggs
1 small  can mandarin oranges (with juice)
preparation: Mix cake mix, oil, eggs and mandarin oranges.  Bake in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: GRANDMA'S GUMDROP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. soft butter
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. oatmeal
1  c. chopped gumdrops
preparation: Cream the first 3 ingredients.  Add egg and vanilla; mix well. Mix flour, baking powder and salt.  Add to egg mixture.  Add oatmeal and mix well.  Add gumdrops last.  Bake at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes.  Check with toothpick.  Cut when cool and roll in powdered sugar.

name: SHONEY'S STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. water
1  c. sugar
6  tsp. cornstarch
4  tsp. strawberry Jell-O
red food coloring
2  c. whole strawberries
whipped cream (for top)
preparation: Bring to boil the water, sugar and cornstarch and cook until clear.   Add Jell-O and a few drops of red food coloring.   Place 2 cups of fresh whole strawberries in a baked pie shell.   Pour cooled mixture over and let set for about 5 hours.  Top with whipped cream.

name: CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
5  slices bacon
1 (16 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained (reserving liquid)
1  medium onion, thinly sliced
1  c. diced, raw, pared potatoes
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of celery soup
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Cook bacon; drain, reserving drippings.  Crumble.  Add corn liquid, onion, potatoes and salt to bacon drippings.  Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender.  Add celery soup, milk and corn.  Heat on low heat.   Spoon into serving dish and sprinkle bacon over chowder.  Yield: 6 large servings or 8 smaller servings.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground hamburg
1  small onion
2  eggs
salt and pepper
1  tsp. mustard
1  piece bread, broken in small pieces
1 1/2  c. catsup
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and make into loaf.  Butter bottom of pan lightly.  Add catsup to top of loaf.  Bake at 350° to 375° for 1 hour or done.

name: CORNBREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
2  recipes baked cornbread
2  cans biscuits, cooked
3  tsp. baking powder
4  tsp. poultry seasoning
6  celery ribs, chopped
1  onion, chopped
2  cans chicken broth
1 small  pkg. Owens hot sausage, cooked and crumbled
salt and pepper to taste
turkey broth, canned or from baking turkey
water
preparation: In large baking pan, break biscuits and cornbread into small bits.  Add baking powder and poultry seasoning.  Simmer celery and onion in chicken broth for 30 minutes.  Add to dry ingredients. Add cooked sausage to mixture.  Using mixture of 1/2 turkey broth and 1/2 water, add to mixture until moist consistency.  Add salt and pepper.  Taste and add seasonings, as needed.  Bake at 425° for 1 hour.

name: DIVINITY
ingredients:
2  c. or more pecans
3  egg whites (room temperature)
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. white Karo
3  c. sugar
preparation: Lightly toast two or more cups pecans and chop.  Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff.  Cook water, Karo syrup and sugar until it spins a thread.  Pour half of mixture over stiffly beaten eggs.  Continue cooking until it spins a long thread.  Pour the rest in and beat.  Stir in pecans and vanilla. Drop by spoonful onto buttered cookie sheet.

name: SIMPLE SALISBURY STEAK
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup, divided
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. onion, chopped fine
1 1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
preparation: In a bowl, mix thoroughly 1/4 cup of the soup, beef, bread crumbs, egg and onion; shape firmly into 6 patties.  In skillet over medium-high heat, cook patties until brown on both sides. Spoon off fat.  Stir in remaining soup and mushrooms.  Return patties to skillet.  Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 20 minutes or until done, turning patties occasionally.  Serves 6.

name: BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. instant chicken bouillon granules
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. dried thyme, crushed
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. milk
2  c. water
2  c. broccoli flowerets or frozen cut broccoli
preparation: In a 3-quart saucepan, cook the chopped onion in butter or margarine until tender, but not brown. Stir in flour, chicken bouillon granules, mustard, thyme and pepper.  Add milk and water all at once.  Cook and stir over medium-high heat until thickened and bubbly.

name: CHICKEN BUNDLES
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. dill weed
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
4  c. cubed, cooked chicken
1/2  c. finely chopped celery
4  green onions (with tops), thinly sliced
3  (8 oz.) tubes crescent rolls
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
1/4  c. seasoned bread crumbs
preparation: In a small bowl, beat cream cheese, milk, dill weed, salt and pepper until smooth.  Stir in chicken, celery and onions.  Unroll crescent roll dough and separate into 12 rectangles, 4 from each tube.  Press perforations together.   Spoon 1/3 cup of the chicken mixture into the center of each rectangle.  Bring edges up to the center and pinch to seal. Brush with butter and sprinkle with bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.  Yields 6 servings.

name: CASSEROLE FOR TEN
ingredients:
2  large onions, cut up
2  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1  lb. ground beef (lean)
1  can drained mushrooms
1  pkg. (8 oz.) noodles, cooked
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  lb. American cheese, cut in chunks
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 soup  can milk
1/2  lb. cashew nuts
1  c. chow mein noodles
preparation: Saute  onions  in  butter  until brown.  Add  meat  and brown. Drain grease.  Add all ingredients  except noodles and nuts; place  in casserole.  Heat soup and  milk;	pour  over. Place in 375° oven about 25 minutes.  Sprinkle  nuts  and chow mein noodles  over  top; bake about 10  minutes	more.  Watch closely as they may burn.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. flour tortillas
1  whole chicken
2  cans Ro-Tel, drain juice
2 big  cartons sour cream
preparation: Boil chicken, then tear in small pieces.  Keep chicken broth. Mix Ro-Tel and sour cream.  In baking dish, dip tortilla in chicken broth and lay in pan; add some chicken, then sour cream mixture, then some cheese.  Repeat 2 more times.  When ready to eat, may want to put some salsa on yours.

name: SOMBRERO DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can chili beans (pureed in blender)
1  tsp. Tabasco sauce (more, if desired)
1/2  c. ketchup
dash of salt
preparation: Brown beef and onions.  Add rest of ingredients.  Heat well. Garnish with grated Cheddar cheese, raw onion and green olives.

name: CHICKEN-ETTE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. spaghetti, cooked and drained
3 to 4  c. chicken, cooked and chopped
1/4  c. minced green pepper (optional)
1/2  c. minced celery
1  onion, chopped
1  c. Minute rice
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1 or more  c. chicken broth
1  qt. fresh or frozen corn
preparation: Cook pepper, celery and onion with spaghetti.  Mix all the ingredients together and bake about 30 to 40 minutes in moderate oven or slow cook in a crock-pot a few hours.

name: AUNT MARY'S TAMALES
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger (ground beef)
1  lb. sausage (hot Swaggerty)
1  oz. Mexene chili powder
1  tsp. cayenne pepper
salt to taste
tamale papers and string
approximately 8  c. self-rising cornmeal
1  c. Crisco shortening
2 1/2 to 3  c. hot water
preparation: Mix together hamburger, sausage, chili powder, cayenne and salt.  Make into small 1/2 x 2-inch servings.   Combine cornmeal and water to form a mixture that does not stick to hands.  Scoop up enough mixture to cover meat serving.  Roll in tamale papers, which have been softened in water.  Tie with string in middle. Drop into boiling water and cook for 35 minutes.  Serve with chili or alone with mustard.  Yield:  25 tamales.

name: RIVIERA GARDEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Kraft macaroni and cheese
1  c. diced cucumber
1  c. sliced cherry tomatoes
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Prepare dinner as directed.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix lightly.  Chill.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: SWEET RELISH
ingredients:
2  qt. chopped cucumbers
2  c. chopped red peppers
2  c. chopped green peppers
2  c. chopped onions
1  Tbsp. turmeric
2  sticks cinnamon
1  Tbsp. mustard seed
2  tsp. whole allspice
2  tsp. whole cloves
1/2  c. salt
1  qt. vinegar
4  c. brown sugar
preparation: Combine cucumbers, peppers and onions.  Sprinkle with turmeric.  Dissolve salt in 2 quarts cold water.  Pour over vegetables and let stand for 3 to 4 hours.  Drain; cover vegetables with cold water and let stand for 1 hour.  Drain.  Tie the spices in a bag; add to the brown sugar and vinegar.  Heat to boiling and pour over the vegetables.  Cover and let stand for 12 to 18 hours in a cool place.  Simmer until vegetables are hot. Bring to a boil; pour into jars and seal.

name: HAM PIE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. oil
6  Tbsp. flour
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 1/3  c. milk
2  c. diced ham
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. grated cheese
1  pkg. refrigerator biscuits
preparation: Saute onion and pepper in oil.  Stir in flour; add soup and milk and heat until thickened.  Add ham and lemon juice; mix well and pour into baking dish.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Roll out 4 to 5 biscuits flat and cut out centers with a small cutter.  Arrange large pieces on top of ham mixture; fill in between large biscuits with small center pieces of biscuit.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Reduce to 350° and cook until biscuits are done.

name: RAISIN CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2 1/2  c. sugar
3  sticks margarine and 1/2 c. Crisco*
2  boxes raisins
6  large eggs
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: *May substitute 1/2 pound butter and 1 cup Crisco.

name: BAKED SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef or turkey
12  oz. box spaghetti
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper (optional)
1 large (29 to 32 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
Parmesan cheese
1  can Durkee French onions
milk
butter
preparation: Brown beef and drain. Add jar of sauce and set aside. Cook and drain spaghetti. Mix 1/2 of sauce mixture with spaghetti and put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sauté green pepper and onion in butter. Add cream cheese and enough milk to make it smooth. Then spread over spaghetti. Pour remaining sauce over cheese and sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes and top with fried onions. Bake 5 minutes longer.

name: OATMEAL MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. oatmeal
1  egg
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/4  c. oil
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Soak oatmeal in buttermilk 20 minutes.  Put in bowl and mix with all other ingredients.  You can add nuts, raisins, chocolate chips or chopped fine zucchini, any one of these.   Bake in muffin tins at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Will spring back at finger touch when done.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
2  slightly beaten eggs
2 1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. 1-inch, day-old bread cubes
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Combine eggs, milk, vanilla, cinnamon and salt.  Stir in bread cubes.  Stir in brown sugar and raisins.  Pour mixture into an 8 x 1 3/4-inch round ovenware cake dish.  Place pan in larger shallow pan on oven rack.  Pour hot water into larger pan 1 inch deep. Bake at 350° about 45 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.  Makes 6 servings.

name: PEACH JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  box peach jello
1  c. sugar
1 medium  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. water
1 regular size  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix jello, sugar and pineapple; bring to a boil, then add cream cheese and water.  Jell slightly.  Add Cool Whip and put back in refrigerator to jell hard.

name: BROWN RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. rice, uncooked
2  cans French onion soup
1  can water
1  stick butter, melted
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake 15 minutes at 400°.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: WEIGHT WATCHER'S DRESSING
ingredients:
1/4  c. wine vinegar
2  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
1  clove garlic (if desired)
preparation: Mix all ingredients in blender.

name: PEPPERMINT CHOCOLATE BONBONS
ingredients:
1  c. (6 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/3  c. butter or margarine
1/4  c. whipping cream
1  c. unsifted powdered sugar
1/4  tsp. peppermint extract
preparation: Mix chocolate chips, butter and cream in a heavy saucepan. Place over very low heat and stir until chips and butter are melted and mixture is smooth and thick.  Remove from heat.  Beat in the powdered sugar until mixture is smooth again.  Stir in the peppermint extract.  Cover and chill about 1 or 2 hours, until mixture is thick enough to shape or drop into small candy cups. Divide the mixture into 24 portions.  Drop into paper bonbon cups or first roll into small balls before placing into cups.  (To shape, use a No. 70 or smaller ice cream scoop.  For an extra nice look, roll the shaped, chilled candies in cocoa before serving.)

name: CHOW CHOW
ingredients:
Green tomatoes
1  medium cabbage
9  green bell peppers
3  red bell peppers
4  onions
4  pods hot peppers
4  c. sugar
3   c. vinegar
preparation: Press out the juice in tomatoes. Cook 30 minutes and put in jars.

name: CHINESE STIR-FRY
ingredients:
sliced mushrooms (desired amount)
broccoli spears (desired amount)
baby carrots (desired amount)
snow peas (desired amount)
1  red pepper
1  yellow pepper
1  fresh chopped garlic clove
2  Tbsp. sesame or peanut oil
ginger
soy sauce
preparation: Use large pan or wok for best results.  Heat oil on high until hot (not boiling).  Turn heat down to medium-high.  First, add chopped ginger to oil and let it saut for 1 minute.  Then add garlic and saut for an additional minute.  Turn heat back up to high and add the rest of the ingredients.  Stir constantly to ensure the mixture gets cooked by rotating the vegetables.  Do this 4 to 5 minutes or until desired texture and taste.  Turn heat down to medium and add soy sauce to taste and continue to stir for another minute.

name: COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. flour
1  egg
1/2  c. buttermilk
1/4  tsp. cinnamon or nutmeg
nuts, raisins (optional)
preparation: Cream sugar and margarine.  Combine soda, flour and spice. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk (add nuts or raisins).

name: BAKED CHEESE GRITS
ingredients:
4  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. quick cooking grits
2  c. (8 oz.) sharp shredded cheese
1/2  c. oleo
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Bring water  and  salt to a boil.  Stir in grits.  Cook grits according to package directions.  Remove from heat.  Add cheese and oleo, stirring until melted.  Stir in milk.

name: OVEN STROGANOFF(Smells So Good!)
ingredients:
3  lb. boneless chuck, fillet or any nice lean piece beef
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. Burgundy wine
1  pkg. dry Lipton onion soup mix
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  can mushroom pieces (I prefer fresh mushrooms)
1  pt. sour cream (to be stirred in before serving)
preparation: Cut meat into bite-sized pieces.  Do not brown.  Just mix all ingredients, except the sour cream, in a large casserole or roast pan (for double quantity).  Bake at 300°, uncovered, for three hours.  Just before serving, stir in sour cream.  Serve over buttered wide noodles.  Serves 8.

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
1/2  c. lemonade concentrate
1  c. pineapple juice
2  cans orange juice concentrate (6 oz. cans)
2  qt. cold ginger ale
preparation: Mix well.  Garnish with orange slices, strawberries or maraschino cherries.  Makes 25 cups.

name: FROZEN BUTTERMILK SALAD
ingredients:
1  box sugar-free instant vanilla pudding
2  cups buttermilk
1  can fruit cocktail (drained)
1  can pineapple tidbits (drained)
8  oz. lite cool whip
preparation: Mix all ingredients and freeze.  Take out 10 minutes before serving.

name: CHINESE FRIED RICE
ingredients:
4  slices bacon
2  medium onions, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. soy sauce
2  c. cooked rice
1 1/2  c. cooked shrimp, hen or chicken
salt and pepper
1  egg (unbeaten)
preparation: Fry bacon. Remove from fat. Add onions and green pepper. Fry until slightly browned. Pour in soy sauce. Stir. Combine rice and meat. Add to onion mixture. Salt and pepper to taste. Heat. Add unbeaten egg and stir until blended well with rice. Crumble bacon over top.

name: ORANGE CANDY CAKE
ingredients:
8  oz. chopped dates
2  c. chopped pecans
2  c. coconut
16  oz. orange candy, cut up
1  c. flour
1/2  c. Crisco
1/2  c. oleo
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix the dates, pecans, coconut and candy (coated with flour before cutting up).  Cream together the Crisco, oleo, sugar, eggs, salt and soda.  Add the 2 1/2 cups flour, alternating with buttermilk to the creamed mixture, then add the first mixture to all and mix well.  Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

name: HAY AND STRAW NOODLE TOSS
ingredients:
2  c. yellow summer squash, cut in narrow, lengthwise strips
2  c. spinach noodles, cooked
1  large tomato, diced
1  Tbsp. oil
freshly ground black pepper
1  tsp. basil
1/2  c. low-fat cottage cheese
preparation: Steam squash until tender.  Combine remaining ingredients; toss gently.  Serve hot or cold.

name: BUBBLE PIZZA
ingredients:
2 tubes or 1  can Big Country biscuits
16  oz. can pizza sauce
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese
1 1/2  c. Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain.  Cut the biscuits in quarters and mix with the ground beef and sauce.  Put into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake in a 400° oven for 20 minutes.  Remove and top with cheese.  Return to oven and bake 10 minutes.  Yield:  6 to 8 servings.

name: DAD'S VANILLA ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  can evaporated milk
1/2  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1  tsp. vanilla
sprinkle of salt
preparation: Mix, freeze and enjoy.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CANDY
ingredients:
3  sticks melted margarine or very soft margarine
2  lb. powdered sugar
3  Tbsp. vanilla
2  c. peanut butter
about 1/2 box crushed graham crackers
preparation: Mix together in mixer the margarine, sugar, vanilla and peanut butter.  Line an oblong pan with half the graham crackers.  Spread with mix over all and pat down with remaining crumbs. Refrigerate, then cut into squares.

name: PUMPERNICKEL RYE DIP
ingredients:
1  round loaf pumpernickel bread
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. Beau Monde spice
1  (16 oz.) mayo
2  Tbsp. dill weed (not seed)
preparation: Place bread on a large serving tray or platter.  Cut off top of the bread and pick out center.  Place bread pieces around the bread on the platter.  Mix all ingredients, place inside hollow bread.  Cut up the top of bread and place with the rest of bread pieces.  Use these pieces to eat dip with your fingers.

name: POTATO ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast (RapidRise)
1/2  c. hot mashed potatoes
1/4  c. shortening
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  c. scalded milk
1  egg
4 to 4 1/2  c. sifted flour
preparation: Combine potatoes, shortening, sugar, salt and hot milk.  Cool until lukewarm.  Add egg and yeast.  Stir in flour.  Beat well. Knead on slightly floured surface until smooth and elastic.  Place in lightly greased bowl, turning once to grease surface.  Cover and let rise until double (about 1 hour).  Punch down and let rise 10 minutes.  Roll and cut into shape.  Place on greased baking sheet. Cover and let rise until almost double (about 1 hour). Bake in hot oven at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes. Brush tops with butter.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box macaroni and cheese dinner or 1 box shells and cheese dinner
1  can tuna in water
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  can baby English peas (optional)
creole seasoning to taste
preparation: Cook macaroni and cheese dinner according to box instructions. Combine all ingredients and mix well in casserole dish or baking pan.  Cover and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup
1 soup  can oil
a little chopped onion
1  tsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Place all ingredients in blender; blend well. Store in refrigerator.

name: SPECIAL FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1  clove garlic, grated fine
1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c vinegar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  small onion, grated fine
2/3  c. ketchup (I add 1 c.)
2  c. salad oil
preparation: Mix in order given and beat thoroughly.  Pour in a jar and store in fridge.  Can be mixed in shaker instead of beating.  Shake until mixed and thick.  Shake everytime you use.

name: LIVER AND ONIONS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. sliced liver
1/2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. fat
1  large onion
1 1/2  tsp. salt or to taste
1/4  tsp. pepper or to taste
1/4  c. water
preparation: Dip liver in flour and brown on one side in fat in frypan. Slice onion.  Turn liver.  Add salt and pepper.  Cover with onions. Add water; cover pan tightly and cook over low heat, 20 to 30 minutes or until liver is tender.

name: HOT MULLED CIDER
ingredients:
1  gal. apple cider
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. whole cloves
2  tsp. allspice
6-inch cinnamon stick
preparation: Mix all ingredients in large saucepan.  Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.  Strain and serve.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. margarine, softened
6  eggs
1/2  tsp. lemon extract
1  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. baking soda
3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Heat oven to 325°.  Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan.  Stir flour and soda together. Set aside.  Cream the margarine and sugar together until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Mix in vanilla, lemon extract and almond extract. Add flour mixture alternately with sour cream, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Blend thoroughly after each addition.  Pour into prepared pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool 20 minutes before removing from pan to completely cool.

name: PARTY EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  doz. eggs, beaten
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  can Ro-Tel
1  lb. chopped ham (optional)
1/2  stick margarine, melted
1  lb. Velveeta, chopped
8  oz. sour cream
preparation: Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.  Pour into pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Bake, uncovered, until brown around the sides.  Can be frozen.  (Defrost 15 minutes.)

name: PORTUGUESE BREAKFAST MEAT
ingredients:
10  lb. pork roast
1 1/4  pkg. New Mexico red chilies (mild)
2  pkg. New Mexico red chilies (hot)
1/3  pkg. pasilla chilies
2  Tbsp. garlic powder
1/4  c. oregano, crushed
1/4  c. minced garlic
2  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. salt or to taste
1/4  c. wine vinegar
preparation: Cut meat into 2 x 2-inch pieces; add all ingredients.  Mix well in large covered airtight bowl.  Stir and refrigerate couple of days.  After it's been in refrigerator 1 day, mix with hand in plastic glove.  Next day, mix again; let set in fridge for couple hours more, then fry a few pieces and taste.  Add more salt, if needed.  Freeze in small Baggies according to family size.  Most delicious with eggs for breakfast or with fried potatoes.  Enjoy.

name: JEN'S CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. butter, softened
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2  eggs
2  c. semi-sweet morsels
preparation: Combine flour, baking soda and salt in small bowl.  Beat butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla in large mixing bowl.  Add eggs, one at a time; beat well.  Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in morsels.  Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheets.  Bake at 375° for 9 to 11 minutes.  Makes about 5 dozen.

name: CORNMEAL ROLLS
ingredients:
1/3  c. cornmeal
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. margarine
2  c. milk
2  beaten eggs
1  cake yeast
1/4  c. warm water
2  tsp. sugar
4  c. flour
preparation: Cook first 5 ingredients until thick.  Cool until lukewarm. Combine eggs and yeast in warm water with sugar.  Mix well and add to other mixture.  Then add flour to make a soft dough.  Knead and place in greased bowl.  Cover and let rise one hour.  Punch down and roll out.  Cut with biscuit cutter.  Brush with butter and fold over as Parker House rolls.  Place on a greased cookie sheet.  Let rise until doubled.  Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.  Makes about 30 rolls.

name: CRAB BISQUE
ingredients:
2  c. fumet
1  can clam juice
3 to 4  qt. chicken stock
2  c. chopped celery
approximately 1 Tbsp. saffron
1 to 1 1/2  c. cognac
pepper
lobster shells
1  bottle (750 ml) white wine
2  c. chopped onion
1  c. butter
2 to 4  c. heavy cream
salt
3  c. Arborio rice
2  c. chopped carrots
preparation: Saute onions, celery and carrots in 1/2 cup butter until soft. Add lobster shells and white wine.  Cook until shells are red.  Add fumet, clam juice and chicken stock.  Simmer one hour.  Add rice and simmer thirty minutes longer.  Food mill rice and put through small tamis.  Bring to boil, add heavy cream and cognac.  Add saffron and season to taste with salt and pepper.

name: PAT'S DILL PICKLES
ingredients:
14  lb. cucumbers
5  tsp. mustard seed
5  tsp. celery seed
5  tsp. pickling spices
10  whole bay leaves
10  cloves garlic
10  small sprigs fresh dill
2  c. vinegar
5  qt. water
1  c. salt
preparation: Wash cucumbers thoroughly.  Then slice 1/3-inch thick.  Pack into sterilized quart jars.  Place 1/2 teaspoon each of mustard seed, celery seed and pickling spices in each jar.  Place 1 whole bay leaf, 1 clove of garlic and 1 sprig of fresh dill in each jar.

name: DATE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  c. and 2 Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten well
1/4  c. melted butter
1  Tbsp. grated orange rind
2  c. finely cut dates
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix flour with baking powder and salt.  Combine other ingredients.  Gradually add flour mixture, beating well.  Spread batter evenly in baking dish.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. fresh cranberries, ground
1  large orange, unpeeled, seeded and ground
1  c. sugar
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon flavored gelatin
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1 (15 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, undrained
1  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. diced celery
lettuce leaves
preparation: Combine ground cranberries, ground orange and sugar.  Cover and chill one hour.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cream of tartar
4  c. plain flour
1  c. oil
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. lemon flavoring
preparation: Cream oleo, oil and sugar.  Add eggs; beat well.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Chill overnight.  Roll into balls the size of a nickle and place on cookie sheet.
