Press down with a glass.  Dip glass in water for first cookie only, then dip in white granulated sugar for each cookie.  Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown at edges.  Batter may be kept in refrigerator for 2 weeks or more.  May be frozen to use later.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. corn meal (self-rising)
1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  Tbsp. red pepper
1 small  can cream-style corn
1  c. Wesson oil
1  c. chopped onion
1  egg
preparation: Mix together and bake in greased pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE AND CREAM CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  c. Crisco
6 to 8  Tbsp. orange juice (1 fresh orange)
dash of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. Swans Down cake flour
Frosting (recipe follows)
preparation: Mix and bake cake at 325°  in 3 layers.

name: BANANA HAWAIIAN DELIGHT
ingredients:
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. confectioners sugar
6  firm bananas, cut into 2-inch long pieces
1 (8 oz.)  can flaked coconut
preparation: Whip the cream until stiff. Add sour cream and sugar. Whip at low speed until just blended. Dip bananas into cream mixture; coat well. Roll in coconut. Serve on tray with chilled fruit. May be prepared several hours ahead.

name: POTATO VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
2  qt. potatoes, raw, peeled and diced
3  c. mixed vegetables, frozen
5  c. water
2  tsp. salt
8  slices bacon
1 1/2  c. celery, chopped
1  c. onions, chopped
3 (13 oz.)  cans canned milk, undiluted
preparation: Combine potatoes, mixed vegetables, water and salt in large kettle.  Cover and cook over medium heat until potatoes are tender.  Do not drain.  Cut bacon in small pieces; fry until partially cooked.  Add celery and onions and continue frying until celery and onions are transparent and bacon is crisp.  Add milk, bacon, onion and celery mixture to potatoes  Mix well.  Heat until hot.  Do not boil.  Stir in cracker crumbs before serving.

name: MAGIC COOKIE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine or butter
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1  c. (6 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can flaked coconut (1 1/3 c.)
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Preheat the oven to 350° (325° for glass dish).  In 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt margarine in oven.  Sprinkle crumbs over margarine; pour Eagle Brand evenly over crumbs.  Top with remaining ingredients.  Press down firmly.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.  Cool.  Chill, if desired.  Cut into bars.  Store loosely covered at room temperature.  Makes 24 to 36 bars.

name: APPLE DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  to 3 apples (Granny Smith or Winesap)
1  can flaky biscuits (10 count)
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
1  stick margarine
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Slice apples.  Cut each biscuit in half horizontally, making 20 biscuits.  Melt margarine in baking dish.  Wrap apple slices in biscuits and put in the margarine.  Heat sugar, cinnamon and water until dissolved.  Pour over biscuits and bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: TURTLE BARS
ingredients:
14  oz. bag caramels
1/2  c. evaporated milk
3/4  c. softened butter
3  eggs
1  pkg. German chocolate cake mix
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped walnuts
1 1/3  c. water
preparation: Melt caramels and milk in microwave.  Combine cake mix with water, butter and eggs.  Pour 1/2 of batter into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes until gooey cake puffs up.  Pour melted caramels evenly over cake.  Sprinkle on chips and nuts. Pour remaining batter on top and bake 30 minutes.  Cool and cut into squares.

name: SPINACH TARTS(Makes 8 Servings)
ingredients:
8  pastry tart shells, baked and cooled
1  Tbsp. powdered salad dressing mix
1  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. oleo
preparation: Cook the spinach and drain as dry as possible.  Put drained spinach over low heat and add cheese and oleo.  Stir and melt these ingredients.  Add Hidden Valley powder and sour cream.  Stir until completely mixed.  Spoon the spinach mixture into the tart shells, mounding it up.  Garnish with pimiento strips, mushroom caps or grated Parmesan.

name: COCONUT KISSES
ingredients:
3  egg whites
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. granulated sugar
2  c. cornflakes
1 1/3  c. flaked coconut
1/2  c. chopped nuts
2  (1 oz.) squares semi-sweet chocolate
2  tsp. shortening
preparation: Beat egg whites with dash of salt and vanilla to soft peaks; gradually add sugar and beat until stiff.  Stir in cereal, coconut and nuts.  Drop from teaspoon onto well-greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes.  Remove cookies immediately.

name: CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. bacon, cut up
1  large onion
1/2  c. catsup
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. mustard
4  tsp. vinegar
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  can pork and beans
1  can garbanzo beans
1  can kidney beans
1  can butter beans
preparation: Drain garbanzo beans, kidney beans and butter beans.  Brown ground beef, bacon and onion in large pan and drain.  Mix in catsup, salt, mustard and vinegar.  Combine mixture with remaining ingredients in casserole.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or slow cook in crock-pot 2 hours.

name: EASY CREAMY PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2/3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. peanut butter
preparation: Boil sugar and milk until soft ball stage.  Remove from heat. Add vanilla and peanut butter; mix until creamy.

name: CHOCOLATE SYRUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
dash of salt
1  c. water
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. water
3  Tbsp. strawberry Jell-O
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. sugar
1  pt. strawberries, sliced
1  cooked 9-inch pie shell
1 small  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix water,  jello,  cornstarch  and  sugar;  cook  until clear.  Cool; pour  over berries and pour into cooked pie shell and top with Cool Whip.  Chill before serving.

name: ORANGE SHERBET SALAD
ingredients:
2  (3 oz.) orange jello
2  c. boiling water
1  pt. orange sherbet
1  can crushed pineapple (small can), drained
1  can Mandarin oranges, drained
1  or 2 sliced bananas
preparation: Mix first 2 ingredients and cool slightly until thick, but not solid. Add rest of ingredients. Refrigerate several hours before serving.

name: TURKEY AND HAM A LA KING
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  chopped green pepper
6  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. black pepper
2  c. defatted chicken broth
1  c. skim milk
1 1/2  c. cooked turkey or chicken
1 1/2  c. low-fat ham
1  (12 oz.) pimiento, drained
preparation: Sauté in 1/4 cup water the onion and green pepper until tender. Stir in flour and black pepper. Cook until smooth. Add broth and milk into mixture. Cook until thickened. Stir constantly. Stir  in turkey, ham and pimientos. Cook until thoroughly heated. Serve on plate with rice.

name: WHITE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. sour milk
1  tsp. soda
1  c. shortening
2  tsp. baking powder
4 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix soft; do not handle much.  Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet, then press down with glass dipped in sugar.

name: BREAKFAST PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. sliced bacon
1/2  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1/2  c. shredded cheddar cheese
1/3  c. chopped onion
2  c. milk
1  c. Bisquick
4  eggs
salt and pepper
preparation: Lightly grease 10 inch pie plate. Fry bacon and crumble. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth. Pour in pie plate. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

name: 24-Hour Salad
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
4  Tbsp. vinegar
6  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. whipped cream
2  c. cherries (maraschino)
2  c. pineapple
2  c. oranges
2  c. marshmallows
coconut to taste
preparation: Cook eggs, vinegar and sugar, stirring until thick.  Add butter.  Cool.  Fold in cream.  Fold in fruits.  Let stand covered in refrigerator 2 hours, stirring several times.

name: YUMMY ICE CREAM
ingredients:
4  Milky Way candy bars
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. large marshmallows
1 large  can sweetened condensed milk
milk
preparation: Melt candy bars and marshmallows until thick and sticky.  Add condensed milk gradually, stirring until liquid.  Finish filling with milk to make 1 gallon.  Freeze.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1  can artichoke hearts
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. grated cheese
fresh vegetables (raw), cut up
preparation: Drain artichoke hearts; place them in bottom of baking dish. Shred into small pieces.  Mix mayonnaise and cheese and spread on top of artichokes.  Place in  oven at 350° until cheese is bubbly.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs, beaten
3  bananas
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
preparation: Cream butter and add sugar.  Blend well.  Add eggs and beat. Blend in bananas.  Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture.  Bake in greased loaf pan at 350° for 60 minutes.

name: FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
4  large onions, sliced thin
10  beef bouillon cubes
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
8  c. water
grated cheese (Parmesan or Romano)
preparation: Saute onions until golden in margarine.  Add water; bring to boil.  Add bouillon cubes and Worcestershire sauce.  Simmer 1/2 hour, or until ready to eat.  Add grated cheese just before putting in bowls.  In individual bowls, add croutons.  Put Mozzarella cheese over top in each bowl.  Melt cheese in microwave or oven.

name: EXPRESS SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  can Campbell's Italian tomato soup
2 (16 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
3  Tbsp. Italian seasoning
1 to 2  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. oregano
2  lb. lean ground beef
1  to 2 onions, chopped
1  to 2 green peppers, chopped
3  Knorr beef bouillon cubes
1/4  c. olive oil
4  to 5 bay leaves
preparation: Cooking Meat:  Place the ground beef in a large pan with the olive oil preheated and start cooking until it starts to turn brown, then add the onions, green peppers and Italian seasoning. Lower the temperature and cook slowly until the meat is thoroughly cooked.

name: POL'S APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/4  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. self-rising flour
2  medium apples, peeled, cored and chopped
1  c. shredded coconut
1  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
preparation: Blend eggs, oil and sugar until creamy.  Add flour a little at a time.  Blend well.  Batter will be stiff.  Fold in apples, coconut and nuts.  Pour into well greased tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.  Cool and turn out on plate and spread glaze over.

name: MOCK CHICKEN-NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. noodles, cooked
1  small to medium tub French onion dip
1  can mushroom soup
1  can soy chicken, diced
preparation: Mix and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: POPCORN BARS
ingredients:
3  qt. popped corn
4  c. miniature marshmallows
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. oleo
4  oz. semi-sweet chocolate
preparation: Pop corn in popper.  Melt oleo and marshmallows.  Stir in vanilla.  Pour mixture over popcorn in bowl, stirring the popcorn to mix well.  Press into a buttered 13 x 9-inch cake pan.  Melt chocolate and spread over top.  Chill and cut into squares.

name: MUSTARD POTATOES
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
1  medium onion
6  Tbsp. margarine
3  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. stock or 2 bouillon cubes, dissolved in 1 1/2 c.  hot water
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. mustard
preparation: Cook and dice potatoes.  Dice the onion.  Melt the margarine and cook onion until limp.  Stir in the flour and add the stock. Cook over low heat and add the salt, pepper and the mustard.  Cook slowly, about ten minutes or until slightly thickened.  Pour over the potatoes and bake about 15 minutes in 350° oven.  Especially good with ham, ham loaf or chicken.

name: CANDIED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
1 large (29 oz.)  can Sugary Sam sweet potatoes
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  stick oleo
1/4  c. orange juice
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Drain juice from sweet potatoes.  To juice, add sugar, oleo, orange juice and cinnamon.  Cook until slightly thickened.  Add sweet potatoes.  Continue to cook until slightly candied.

name: PECAN DELIGHT PIE
ingredients:
4  egg whites at room temperature
1  c. sugar
1 3/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. vanilla
2  c. coarsely broken soda crackers
3/4  c. chopped pecans
1 1/2  to 2  c. whipped cream
1/4  c. chopped pecans
1  9-inch unbaked pie shell
preparation: Whip egg whites on medium speed until soft peaks form. Continue whipping on medium speed while gradually adding sugar and baking powder. Continue to whip until very stiff peaks form and all sugar is dissolved.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1  c. crunchy peanut butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  large container Cool Whip
1 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
2  graham cracker crusts
preparation: Mix peanut butter and cream cheese with electric mixer until fluffy.  Add confectioners sugar and Cool Whip.  Pour into 2 (8-inch) prepared graham cracker crusts.  Drizzle chocolate syrup or chocolate curls on top.  Freeze for 8 hours before serving.  I keep some made in freezer for a quick dessert!

name: HOT HAM AND CHEESE SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo, softened
2  Tbsp. poppy seed
3  tsp. horseradish mustard
1  tsp. onion, grated
12  buns
baked ham slices
12  slices Swiss or Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Mix oleo, poppy seed, mustard and onion.  Spread on buns.  Add cheese and ham to buns.  Wrap in foil tightly.  Heat and cook 30 minutes at 350°.  Freeze if desired.

name: BEEF AND BEAN STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can tomato soup
1/2  can water
1 large  can green beans, drained
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper
preparation: Fry beef and onion.  Drain fat away.  Add soup, water and beans.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.

name: FRUIT JUICE FIZZ
ingredients:
1  orange or lemon
orange juice
pineapple juice
cranberry juice
seltzer or club soda
preparation: Cut orange or lemon into slices.  Put one or two cups of juice into the pitcher.  Add 3 more cups of juice for every cup of seltzer or club soda.  Chill juice.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1  (3 lb.) fryer
2  c. broth
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  tsp. each:  salt and pepper
1  c. buttermilk
1  stick margarine, melted
1  c. self-rising flour
preparation: Cook chicken; take off bone.  Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine broth and soup; bring to a boil and pour over chicken. Combine flour, buttermilk and margarine; spoon over chicken.  Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

name: APPLESAUCE BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
1  egg
1  c. applesauce
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
nuts, if desired
preparation: Cream sugar and oil.  Add egg and beat well.  Add applesauce and beat.  Add vanilla.  Stir in sifted dry ingredients.  Bake in 2 small or 1 large greased loaf pan at 325° about 1 hour.  Do not overcook.

name: GINGER CREAMS
ingredients:
1/4  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1  small egg
1/2  c. molasses
1  tsp. soda, dissolved in 1/2 c. hot water
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix first four ingredients together thoroughly.  Stir in soda dissolved in hot water.  Mix together flour, salt, ginger, nutmeg, cloves and cinnamon.  Add to first mixture, mixing thoroughly. Chill dough.  Drop by teaspoon 2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet.  Bake in 400° oven 7 to 8 minutes.  Ice while still warm.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
3  Tbsp. water
4  c. milk, scalded
marshmallows or whipped cream
preparation: Scrape chocolate squares fine; mix with water, milk and sugar. Stir until dissolved.  Whip with eggbeater until light and fluffy.  Serve with marshmallows or cream.

name: LEMON-MUSHROOM SALAD
ingredients:
1/2 (8 oz.)  carton plain low-fat yogurt
1  Tbsp. reduced-calorie mayonnaise or salad dressing
1  tsp. honey
1/8  tsp. finely shredded lemon peel
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1/8  tsp. dry mustard
1/8  tsp. pepper
3  c. sliced fresh mushrooms (8 oz.)
2  Tbsp. frozen chopped onion
1  medium tomato
lettuce leaves
coarsely ground pepper (optional)
preparation: Stir  together  yogurt,  mayonnaise  or salad dressing, honey, lemon peel, lemon juice, mustard and pepper in a large mixing bowl.  Add  mushrooms  and  onion.  Toss lightly until coated.

name: TEXAS CHILI
ingredients:
2  lb. ground chuck
1  lb. sausage
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. bell pepper, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
1  c. cooked rice
3  cans Ranch Style beans
1  pkg. chili mix
1/2  bottle chili powder or to taste
preparation: Brown first 5 ingredients in skillet; drain off grease.  In a large pan, put 1 cup cooked rice; add meat mixture, beans, chili mix, chili powder and salt to taste.  Stir and simmer about 30 minutes.  You may need to add some water while simmering.  Mixture will be real thick.  Serves 8 to 10 people.

name: NUTTY DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
6 to 8  slices pineapple with syrup
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/4  c. brown sugar
2  c. biscuit mix
3/4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Arrange pineapple slices in 10-inch skillet with cover.  Pour in syrup from fruit and heat.  Combine biscuit mix, milk, nuts and 1 tablespoon of sugar.  Mix well with a fork.  Spoon on pineapple slices and cook on low heat about 10 minutes.  Sprinkle brown sugar over the top and cook another 10 minutes.

name: RICE AND PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
4  to 6 center cut pork chops
1  c. milk
1  can cream of celery soup
1  c. quick cooking rice
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. sage
preparation: Melt butter in skillet.  Brown pork chops in butter.  Transfer chops to casserole and combine remaining ingredients.  Spoon mixture over and around chops.  Cover.  Bake for 1 hour at 325°.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  eggs
1/2  c. ketchup
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1  onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
salt
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour, or until brown.

name: CRAB CAKES
ingredients:
1  lb. crabmeat
1/4  c. breadcrumbs
1  egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  tsp. Dijon mustard
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire
1/2  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients and form 6 patties.  Fry in small amount of oil until golden brown.

name: CHICKEN DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1  can whole berry cranberry sauce
1 (8 oz.)  jar French dressing
1  (4 to 5 lb.) chicken, cut into 8 to 10 pieces
preparation: Mix first three ingredients in a bowl.   Arrange chicken in pan. Pour mixture over entire chicken pieces and bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered. Serve with rice, if desired.

name: RAINBOW SALAD
ingredients:
5  pkg. flavored gelatin (5 different)
2  pkg. unflavored gelatin
8  oz. cream cheese
2 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix flavored gelatin separately using 1 1/4 cups hot water for each package. Soften 2 packages unflavored gelatin in 1/2 cup water. Set aside. Beat together cream cheese and 1/2 cup milk. Heat the remaining 2 cups milk to almost boiling, then add 1/2 cup sugar.  Stir in the softened unflavored gelatin. Add cream cheese mixture and vanilla.  Stir until smooth. Cool.

name: BOILED CAULIFLOWER(Kokt Blomkaal)
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower
2  qt. water (or to cover)
1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. melted butter
finely chopped parsley
preparation: Remove cauliflower's large outer leaves.  Cut the stalk off to about 1-inch and cut a deep cross on the end to make it cook quicker.  Bring water and salt to boil.  Put cauliflower in, head up, and boil for 3 minutes.  Remove cauliflower from boiling water and pour cold water over it to cool it.  (This keeps the cauliflower white.)  Place cauliflower back into the boiling water, head down this time, and boil for about 20 minutes, being careful not to overcook.  Serve cauliflower on a platter with melted butter poured over it and sprinkled with parsley.  Save water and any leftovers for cauliflower soup.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  boxes Kraft macaroni and cheese
1  stick butter
1/2  c. milk
crackers
preparation: Boil chicken until done and debone.  In a large pan cook macaroni and cheese, then drain.  Add butter and milk; mix well. Add cream of mushroom soup.  Add chicken and mix well.  Top with smashed crackers.  Put in a glass pan.  Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.

name: GRANDMA KLOSE'S STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
2  green peppers
1/2  c. rice (uncooked)
salt and pepper to taste
2  cans tomato paste
ketchup
preparation: Mix meat, rice, salt and pepper and stuff into peppers.  Make meat balls out of the remaining mixture to drop into sauce.  Put tomato paste and 2 cans of water into a large kettle.  Add salt and pepper.  (Add 1 teaspoon sugar; optional.)  Put in some ketchup.  Cover kettle and cook slowly at a low temperature for about 2 hours.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. instant pudding
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  bananas, sliced
1  can cherry pie filling
2  containers nondairy whipped topping
preparation: Crumble cooled, baked cake.  Layer half of cake crumbs in punch bowl.  Top with half each of pie filling, pineapple pudding (made by directions on box) and bananas.  Repeat with remaining ingredients.

name: FRIED GREEN TOMATOES WITH ROCK SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. rock shrimp, peeled
salt and freshly ground black pepper
4  c. water
1  tsp. Zatarain's liquid shrimp and crab boil
1  lemon, halved
2  bay leaves
1  large egg
3  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
1/4  c. chopped onions
1/4  c. chopped green onions
1/4  c. chopped celery
1  Tbsp. prepared horseradish
3  Tbsp. Creole or whole-grain mustard
3  Tbsp. ketchup
3  Tbsp. chopped parsley
cayenne pepper
1  c. olive oil
12 green tomato  slices (each about 1/4-inch thick)
1  c. all-purpose flour
2 large eggs, beaten with 2  Tbsp. whole milk
2  c. fine dried bread crumbs
Emeril's Original Essence
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  c. fresh maiche (optional)
preparation: Season the shrimp with salt and black pepper.  Combine the water, liquid crab boil, lemon and bay leaves in a large, heavy pot. Season the mixture with more salt and black pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil; add the shrimp and cook for 1 minute. Remove from the heat and let sit for 1 minute. Drain and discard the liquid. Let the shrimp cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for about 2 hours.

name: AUNT EFFIE'S SALAD AND DRESSING
ingredients:
1  head iceberg lettuce
1  bag fresh spinach
2 (6 oz.)  cans water chestnuts, sliced
4  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1 (6 oz.)  can bean sprouts
1/2  c. fried crisp bacon, chopped
preparation: Tear lettuce and place in a large serving bowl.  Tear spinach in small pieces.  Place spinach in bowl and add all other ingredients; toss well.  Pour salad dressing over all and toss thoroughly.  This salad is better if made a couple of hours before serving and placed in refrigerator until time to serve.

name: BUTTERMILK BREAD
ingredients:
1  - 1/4 cups Highpoint Dairy Buttermilk
1  tsp. salt
1/3  cup sugar
1  Tbsp. butter
3  cups bread flour
2  tsp. yeast
preparation: Place ingredients in bread machine. Bake according to instructions with your machine.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked squash
1  large onion, diced
1  c. medium sharp cheese
2  eggs, well beaten
1  c. bread crumbs
1/2  c. milk
1/8  tsp. garlic salt
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook onions in 2 tablespoons butter.  Combine all ingredients and pour into well-greased baking dish.  Top with enough additional bread crumbs to cover ingredients and dot with butter. Bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven.  Serve hot.

name: SOFT SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3 1/2  c. flour (plain)
1  tsp. soda
2  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Cream butter, shortening and sugar.  Add eggs, then the dry ingredients.  Chill  dough for 1 hour.  Roll out; cut cookies and bake at 325° for 10 minutes.

name: SANDRA'S TACO MEAT
ingredients:
8  lb. hamburger
1/2  bottle hot sauce
3  large chopped onions
1/2  gal. canned tomatoes
3  tsp. ground oregano
3  tsp. chili powder
6  tsp. cumin
3  tsp. pepper
4  tsp. salt
3  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Brown hamburger in a large pot.  Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 3 hours.  Makes 6 quarts.  May freeze in separate containers for future use.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. dark Karo syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. white sugar
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. pecan pieces
1  unbaked pie crust
preparation: Stir first 5 ingredients well. Stir in pecan pieces. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes depending on oven or until knife inserted in middle comes out clean.

name: BUTTERMILK PRALINES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
2  Tbsp. light corn syrup
1/2  stick of butter
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2  c. pecans
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a 3 quart saucepan.  Cook to a soft ball stage (240 degrees on a candy thermometer) stirring constantly.  Cool slightly.  Add vanilla and pecans.  Beat until mixture loses its gloss.  Drop by teaspoonful onto waxed paper. Yield 3 dozen.

name: SOUR CREAM AND CHIVE POTATOES
ingredients:
5  lb. potatoes, peeled and cut up
2  tsp. salt
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  c. chives
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Place potatoes in pan. Cover with water. Add salt. Cook for 25 minutes. Drain. Mash the potatoes after draining. Add sour cream, milk and margarine. Add chives and pepper. Mix well. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

name: BAKED FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
1  (8 to 9 oz.) day old loaf French bread
3  eggs
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. flour
6  Tbsp. dark brown sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. butter
1  c. fresh or frozen blueberries
1  c. sliced strawberries
preparation: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cut bread diagonally into 1-inch slices and place in pan.  Slightly beat eggs, sugar and vanilla. Stir in milk until well blended.  Pour over bread, turning slices to coat well.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.

name: KILLER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
2  eggs
1  c. smooth peanut butter
1/2  c. melted margarine
1  c. chocolate chips
1 3/4  c. Eagle Brand condensed milk
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  container coconut-pecan frosting
1  c. coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
1  pkg. chocolate frosting
preparation: Blend well by hand the cake mix, eggs, peanut butter and margarine in a bowl.  Place 2/3 of dough onto bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Press firmly to cover bottom of pan.  In a saucepan at low heat, bring to a simmer the chocolate chips, milk and margarine until melted.  Remove from heat and add the frosting, coconut, pecans and chocolate frosting.  Spread mixture over dough. Crumble remaining dough on top of filling mixture.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Cool completely; cut into bars.

name: ONE MEAL DISH
ingredients:
1  lb. macaroni
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  stick butter
8  oz. Cheddar cheese
3/4  c. milk
1/2  head lettuce
dash of salt
dash of pepper
1/4  c. (1/2 water and 1/2 vinegar)
preparation: Use one ramekin and grease with butter.  Layer macaroni, salt, pepper and pieces of butter and then Cheddar cheese.  Make another layer of the same.  Pour milk over mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: APPLE-PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. self-rising flour
1/2  stick margarine
4  small apples, chopped fine
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Cook first 4 ingredients until thickened.  Cool, then add apples and nuts.  Spread mixture into a 13 x 9-inch dish.  Spread Cool Whip on top.  Top with cherries, if desired.

name: OIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/3  c. oil
3  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Mix; put in pie pan.  Spread out.  Bake at 350° until brown.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  onion, chopped
3  to 5 dashes Tabasco sauce
1  can chili beans, drained
1 (12 to 15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. ketchup
1  c. water
1/4  c. sugar
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion; drain.  Add ingredients; simmer for 30 minutes.

name: LEMON CREAM SQUARES
ingredients:
2  pkg. crescent dinner rolls
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
approximately 1 Tbsp. lemon juice or to taste
1/4  c. chopped nuts (optional)
confectioner sugar
preparation: Line baking dish (approximately 9 x 12-inch) with 1 package of rolls.  Mix the next 5 ingredients; spread on crescent rolls.  Top with 1 package of rolls.  Beat egg white and spread over top. Sprinkle on nuts.  Bake at 350° for approximately 35 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle top with confectioners sugar.  Cool and slice into squares.

name: FRIED CAWSWAY(Burmese Spaghetti)
ingredients:
1/2  onion, sliced thin
stew beef or chicken, cut in pieces
1/2  Tbsp. fresh garlic, chopped
1/2  Tbsp. fresh ginger, chopped
1  tsp. salt
red pepper as desired
dash of turmeric
2  tomatoes or stewed tomatoes
chopped cabbage and green onions as garnish
cooked spaghetti
preparation: Brown the onion; add meat and spices.  When fully cooked, cut tomatoes in small pieces and add.  Cover with water and simmer until it's well cooked.  Add to spaghetti and stir.  Garnish with cabbage and green onions.

name: KILLER CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
4  oz. ???, fried crisp and drained
3 (6 oz.)  cans clams (save liquid from clams and add enough water to make 2 c.)
4  medium potatoes, peeled and diced
1/2  c. onion, diced
1 1/2  c. canned milk
1  c. light cream
1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. flour
1/2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. butter
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Take liquid from clams and add water to make 2 cups.  Cook potatoes and onion in pan, covered, for 15 minutes or until tender.  Stir in clams and cream.  Add rest of ingredients, heat and serve.

name: PICKLED BEETS
ingredients:
beets
1  c. vinegar
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. whole cloves
1  stick cinnamon
1  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Cook beets until tender with 2-inches of tops left on.  To pickle beets, use a granite pan large enough to make 8-quarts. Heat all ingredients to a boiling point, then all the cut up beets and bring to a boil.  Reduce the heat to medium.   Have jars and lids hot.  Fill jars and seal.  Wait 2 weeks before opening for better flavor.

name: CRANBERRY SAUCE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. water
cloves
1  lb. cranberries
salt
preparation: Combine sugar and water into saucepan.  Stir to dissolve the sugar.  Add a dash of cloves and bring to a boil.  Add cranberries and a dash of salt.  Cook cranberries in boiling water until the skin pops.  This will take about 10 minutes.  Very good with roast turkey or meat pie.

name: EASY MEAT AND POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
4  medium potatoes, thinly sliced
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (26 1/4 oz.)  can family sized condensed vegetable soup
4  oz. (1 c.) shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Brown ground beef in large skillet; drain.  In ungreased 12 x 8-inch (2-quart) baking dish evenly layer potato slices.  In small bowl combine flour, salt and pepper; sprinkle over potato slices.  Spoon ground beef over potatoes and spoon vegetable soup evenly over top.  Cover with foil.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender. Uncover and sprinkle evenly with cheese.  Bake an additional 5 minutes.  Makes four 1 1/2-cup servings.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. Tabasco sauce
1  c. water
1/4  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Heat to boiling.  Simmer 30 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
4  sq. unsweetened chocolate
13  oz. evaporated milk
1  stick margarine
7  oz. Marshmallow Creme
1 small  jar peanut butter
nuts (if desired)
preparation: Heat sugar, chocolate and evaporated milk until chocolate melts and ingredients come to a boil.  Cook on high for 15 minutes.  Stir constantly.  Remove from heat and add margarine, Marshmallow Creme, peanut butter and nuts.  Beat with wooden spoon until smooth.  Pour into buttered greased pan.  Cut when warm for best results.

name: CREAM OF PEANUT SOUP
ingredients:
4  stalks celery
1  onion
1/4  lb. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1  gal. chicken stock
1  lb. peanut butter
1  qt. cream
preparation: Chop 4 stalks celery and 1 onion.  Braise in 1/4 pound butter.  Add flour and cook until well blended.  Add 1 gallon chicken stock and bring to boil.  Add 1 pound peanut butter and stir until well blended.  Add 1 quart cream and serve.

name: EASY STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) baked pie crust
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  qt. fresh strawberries, cleaned and hulled
1  (14 oz.) container Marie's strawberry pie glaze
1  container Cool Whip
preparation: Soften cream cheese and spread on bottom of cooled pie crust. Place strawberries point up in cream cheese tightly together so that the pie shell is full.  Spread Marie's pie glaze over strawberries to fill in spaces.  Refrigerate before serving and top with Cool Whip.

name: Banana-Pineapple Salad
ingredients:
1 large  can pineapple chunks
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
2  eggs
3  to 4 bananas
1/2  pt. whipping cream or 8 oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Drain juice from pineapple chunks into saucepan.  Bring juice to a boil.  Add 1/2 cup sugar and 1/4 cup flour.  Cook until thick, then set off heat.  Add 2 egg yolks and cook again slightly.  Beat egg whites with 2 tablespoons sugar until stiff. Add to cooked mixture.  Cool.  Add pineapple chunks and sliced bananas and fold in whipped cream or Cool Whip.  Refrigerate until ready to eat.

name: FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice concentrate
2 (6 oz.)  cans frozen limeade concentrate
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade concentrate
1 (1 lb. 14 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1  pt. cranberry juice cocktail
4  c. cold water
2  qt. ginger ale, chilled
1  pt. club soda, chilled
Fruit Ring and fruits and mint for garnish
preparation: Empty frozen concentrates, pineapple and cranberry juices and water into a large container.  Let stand until frozen juice is thawed; stir well.  Pour mixture into punch bowl; add ice cubes.

name: AEBLESKIVER
ingredients:
2  c. buttermilk
2  c. flour
3  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2  Tbsp. sugar
applesauce
preparation: Beat egg yolks.  Add sugar, salt and milk; then add flour, soda and baking powder which have been sifted together.  Last, fold in stiffly  beaten egg whites.

name: PORK ROAST WITH BEANS
ingredients:
2  lb. lean pork roast
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. black pepper
1  clove garlic
3  qt. water
2  lb. dry pinto beans
2  cans chili blend or 2 pkg. dry chili blend
preparation: Cook pork roast and garlic in 3 quarts water until meat is tender  and falls apart.  While meat is cooking, soak beans in enough  water  to  cover  beans.  When meat is done, remove from liquid.  Add  beans  and  chili  blend to liquid and cook until beans  are done.  Add chopped pork last hour of cooking.

name: CREME DE MENTHE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix (follow for high altitude)
1  c. water
1/3  c. green creme de menthe
1  can chocolate frosting
1  pkg. Cool Whip, mix as directed
1/4  c. green creme de menthe
preparation: Add water and 1/3 cup of creme de menthe to cake mix.  Blend and beat for 2 minutes.  Bake with directions on box.  Cool.

name: BLOW AWAY SPONGE CAKE(Low Calorie)
ingredients:
1/2  c. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
3  eggs
1/3  c. sugar
4  pkg. Sweet 'N Low
2  c. Whipped Topping (low calorie)
12  medium strawberries
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Spray two 8-inch round layer pans with Pam.  Sift together cornstarch, flour and baking powder.  In separate deep bowl, beat eggs with electric mixer until foamy. Beat in sugar and Sweet 'N Low gradually.  Continue beating 5 minutes or until mix is thick and lemon colored.  Gently fold in dry ingredients a few tablespoons at a time, mixing carefully and thoroughly.  Turn into prepared pans.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  (8 oz.) tub of sour cream
1  (16 oz.) bag of hash browns (plain or o'brien)
2  (16 oz.) bags of shredded cheese
1  stick margarine, melted
2  shakes hot sauce, if desired
preparation: Stir together soup, sour cream, hash browns, 1 bag of cheese, melted margarine and hot sauce (if desired).  Put in a 9 x 13-inch (or equal quantity) pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until lightly browned on bottom and sides.  Add more cheese on top for the last few minutes of baking time and bake till bubbly.

name: CRUMB CAKE
ingredients:
1  Duncan Hines Butter Recipe cake mix
2/3  c. oil
2/3  c. milk
4  eggs
2  sticks margarine
1  stick butter
4  c. flour
2/3  c. brown sugar
2/3  c. white sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat together cake mix, oil, milk and eggs.  Mix well.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes in a 12 x 18 x 1-inch greased pan (size of pan is important).  While cake is baking, prepare crumb mixture. Melt margarine and butter; cool slightly.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. chopped onion
1  clove minced garlic
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. water
preparation: Brown beef, onion and garlic.  Drain off fat.  Stir remaining ingredients.  Mix and simmer.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can French-style beans with diced red peppers, drain
1 (No. 2)  can whole kernel corn, drain
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped bell pepper
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  carton sour cream
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  tube Ritz crackers
1  stick margarine
1  pkg. almonds
preparation: Mix all ingredients in bowl and put in casserole.  Crush 1 tube of Ritz crackers; melt margarine.  Pour margarine into Ritz crackers.  Spread on top of casserole.  Sprinkle almonds on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1 medium-to-large  can (in water, not oil!) artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
2 (4 oz.)  jars chilies, drained and chopped (may be omitted, but they provide just the right amount of "bite")
5  to 6 green onions or shallots, chopped/minced
preparation: Mix together in casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve warm as a dip with Tostitos or other corn chips.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  large onion ,chopped
1/2  stalk celery, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  can tomatoes
1  pkg. spaghetti sauce mix
3  bay leaves
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  tsp. Mrs. Dash
1  tsp. Season-All
preparation: Brown beef.  Add onion, garlic, celery and bell peppers.  Add rest of ingredients and cook for 2 hours.  Add spaghetti sauce mix.

name: MY BIG BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
1  1/2 loaves bread, torn in pieces
2  cans evaporated milk
about 2 cans water
2  lb. raisins
1  doz. eggs
about 2 tsp. vanilla
1/2 to 1  c. sugar
pinch of salt
cinnamon
nutmeg
butter or margarine
preparation: Reconstitute milk with water.  Pour milk over bread. Mix in raisins.  Beat eggs and add to bread mixture.  Add 1/2 cup sugar and pinch of salt.  Add cinnamon and nutmeg according to taste. Extra sugar may be needed depending on how sweet raisins are. Mix well.

name: MEXICAN LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  box taco shells, broken in half
1  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. taco seasoning
2  c. Cheddar cheese
1  c. sour cream
1  jar mild salsa (large jar)
1  can refried beans
preparation: Brown ground beef with taco seasoning.  Layer the following in a 9 x 13-inch pan:  salsa, taco shells to cover pan, hamburger, salsa, refried beans, sour cream and Cheddar cheese.  Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: SWEDISH NUT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
2  eggs
2  tsp. baking soda
1  (20 oz.) crushed pineapple (undrained)
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix by hand.  Pour in greased 9 x 12-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.  Have icing ready when the cake is done.

name: TEA CAKES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. buttermilk
sugar
preparation: Beat margarine in a large bowl for 30 seconds.  Add 1 1/4 cups sugar and vanilla.  Beat until fluffy.  Add eggs; beat well.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
frozen broccoli spears, thawed
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
diced onion
grated cheese
1  c. cracker crumbs
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients and pour into casserole dish.  Top with grated cheese and cracker crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: DATE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. dates
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. Rice Krispies
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix dates, sugar, egg and margarine in saucepan.  Bring to a boil over medium heat.  Boil 3 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Add vanilla, Rice Krispies and nuts.  Pour into buttered pie pan. Refrigerate.

name: BLUEBERRY DREAM
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
2/3  c. butter or margarine, melted
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sifted powdered sugar
1 (2.8 oz.)  pkg. whipped topping mix
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (21 oz.)  can blueberry pie filling
preparation: Combine cracker crumbs and butter; stir well.  Set aside 2 tablespoons crumb mixture.  Press remaining crumb mixture into an ungreased 15 x 8 x 2-inch dish.  Bake at 350° for 8 minutes.  Cool. Place cream cheese in large bowl; beat on high speed until fluffy. Add powdered sugar; mix well.  Set aside.  Combine whipped topping mix, milk and vanilla in large bowl.  Beat on high, 4 minutes or until fluffy.  Fold into creamed mixture.  Spread 1/2 of topping mix over crust.  Spoon on pie filling.  Spread remaining topping. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top.  Chill 8 hours.  Serves 12.

name: HOTTT! SOUP
ingredients:
3 (6 oz.)  cans mixed vegetables
1 large  can tomato sauce
2 (6 oz.)  cans diced tomatoes
3  lb. ground chuck
1  can Ro-Tel diced tomatoes or 3 jalapeno peppers, diced
2  tsp. Cajun spice
preparation: Brown ground chuck and drain excess grease off. Combine mixed vegetables, tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, diced Ro-Tel tomatoes or diced peppers and Cajun spice. Bring all ingredients to a boil for 10 minutes, then stir and reduce heat for 15 minutes. Get ready for a Hot Spicy Soup-MMM Good!

name: CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. cream cheese (16 oz.)
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
16  oz. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients with beater until smooth.  Pour in 8-inch round pan, greased.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  After, turn off oven and let pan sit in oven for 1 hour.  Remove and cool.  Then refrigerate.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. cubed zucchini, peeled
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. cubed sharp cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. oregano
3  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. Bisquick
preparation: Put first 6 ingredients into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. In small bowl, mix eggs, oil and Bisquick.  Pour over zucchini and bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: BRENDA HOLLAR'S BREAKFAST CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen dinner roll balls (2 doz.)
2  sticks butter, melted
mixture of cinnamon, brown sugar and sugar (same consistency of mixture for cinnamon toast)
preparation: Dip frozen rolls that have been separated in melted butter, then roll in sugar mixture.  Layer in greased Bundt pan.  Pour remaining butter over rolls, then top with sugar mixture.  Cover with a towel and leave out overnight to rise.  Bake next day at 350° for 30 minutes.  Remove carefully by inverting Bundt pan onto cookie sheet.  Watch for splashing butter!

name: FAJITA STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1  lb. lean boneless beef steak
2  Tbsp. oil
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  large onion, sliced and separated
3  large jalapeno chilies, minced
1  large bell pepper, sliced
2  tsp. ground cumin
3  Tbsp. lime juice
1  tsp. cornstarch
2  medium Roma-type tomatoes, diced
salt and pepper
lime wedges (optional)
sour cream (optional)
1  large ripe avocado, peeled and diced
8  warm flour tortillas (8-inch diameter) *
homemade or purchased salsa
preparation: *Flour tortillas may be replaced with large iceberg lettuce leaves, chilled.

name: NACHO PLATTER
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef (optional)
1 1/2  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. cumin
1 (16 oz.)  can refried beans (double if not using beef)
1  can chopped green chilies
1 1/2  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1 1/2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  c. taco sauce
1/2  c. chopped green onions
1 (4 oz.)  can black olive pieces
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen guacamole
1  c. sour cream
1  large bag tortilla chips
preparation: If using, brown beef and drain.  Season with chili powder and cumin (if not using beef, season the refried beans with the chili powder and cumin).  Spread the beans in a shallow 10-inch greased dish.  Sprinkle on the beef followed by the green chilies, Monterey Jack and Cheddar.  Pour taco sauce over cheese.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.  Garnish immediately with layers of green onions, black olives, guacamole and sour cream.  Place dish on platter and surround with tortilla chips.  Serve warm.  Serves 8.

name: FUDGE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
1/4  c. cocoa
1 tall  can evaporated milk
3  egg yolks, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, flour and cocoa; gradually stir in milk.  Stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil and thickens.  Add small amount of mixture to egg yolks.  Return all to pan.  Cook and stir until very thick.  Remove from heat, stir in butter and vanilla. Cool 5 minutes.  Pour into cooked pie shell.   Cover with meringue and brown in 350° oven.

name: HOLIDAY JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
2 small  boxes raspberry jello
2 small  boxes strawberry jello
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. fruit cocktail
1  c. seedless grapes, cut up
2  sliced bananas
1  c. pecan pieces
1  box cottage cheese
preparation: Prepare jello as directed.  Set in refrigerator.  Mix all fruit and pecan pieces together.  When jello starts to thicken, stir in fruit mixture.  Spoon in cottage cheese.  Just below surface of jello, place in refrigerator overnight.

name: CREAMY DILLED CARROTS
ingredients:
4  c. thinly sliced carrots
3/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. sugar
pinch of white pepper
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. half and half
2  tsp. dried dill or 2 Tbsp. fresh dill
preparation: In saucepan, combine carrots, margarine, salt, sugar and pepper.  Cover and simmer until carrots are crisp-tender, about 10 minutes.  Drain liquid into a small saucepan; set the carrots aside and keep warm.  Bring liquid to a boil.  In small bowl, combine flour and cream until smooth; slowly add to liquid, stirring constantly.  Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Pour over carrots; stir in dill.  Cover and let stand for 15 minutes before serving.  Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

name: CORN-SAUSAGE CHOWDER
ingredients:
1  lb. Jimmy Dean mild pork sausage
1  c. diced onion
1  c. potato cubes
1  tsp. salt
crushed pepper to taste
2  c. water
1  can cream-style corn
1  can whole kernel corn (undrained)
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1/2  tsp. dried marjoram
preparation: Cook sausage and onion in large kettle; brown and drain.  Add potato, salt, marjoram and water.  Simmer until potatoes are cooked, about 15 minutes.  Add corn and milk.  Heat through and serve.  Add pepper to taste.

name: STEAK SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  c. margarine, melted
1  c. flour
1  qt. water
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped carrots
1  c. diced celery
1  qt. water
2  c. frozen mixed vegetables
1  c. tomatoes
1  Tbsp. Accent
4  beef bouillon cubes
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Lightly brown ground beef.  Set aside.  Combine melted margarine, flour and first 1 quart of water.  Set aside.  In large Dutch oven or pot, combine onions, carrots and celery.  Add second 1 quart of water and boil 5 minutes.  Add browned ground beef and margarine, flour and water mixture to vegetable pot.  Next, add frozen mixed vegetables, tomatoes, Accent, beef bouillon cubes, pepper, salt and sugar.  Bring all to boil, then simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.   May sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese on surface after soup is ladled into bowls.

name: CARROT SALAD
ingredients:
2  lb. shredded carrots
2  green peppers, cut into rings
2  Spanish onions, cut into rings
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. oil
1  can tomato soup
1/2  c. vinegar
preparation: Mix sugar, oil, tomato soup and vinegar. Pour over carrot mixture and mix. Refrigerate 24 hours.

name: EASY BROWN BREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  c. boiling water
2  c. cold water
2  Tbsp. yeast
3/4  c. cooking oil
7 to 8  c. flour (2 c. of it brown)
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients.  Add 1 cup boiling water and 2 cups cold water.  Add yeast and let rise a little.  Now add oil and flour.  Knead 20 minutes.  Let rise 30 minutes.  Knead.  Let rise 1 1/2 hours.  Make into loaves (makes 4 loaves).  Bake 30 to 35 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: PINK FLUFF
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  can mandarin oranges
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. crushed pecans
1  (8 oz.) pineapple, crushed
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Allow Cool Whip to soften.  Blend the Cool Whip and Eagle Brand milk with mixer on medium speed.  Fold in pineapple, mandarin oranges, cherry pie filling, marshmallows and pecans. Garnish the top of "Pink Fluff" with crushed pecans.  The result is a pretty, easy to make and delicious salad.  (Remember to drain the oranges and pineapple.) Refrigerate.

name: MRS. HUEY'S JELLO
ingredients:
1  box lemon jello
1  box orange jello
2  c. boiling water
1 1/2  c. cold water
2  sliced bananas
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple, drained
40  miniature marshmallows
approximately 1/4 to 1/2 c. grated sharp Colby cheese
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  egg
1  c. pineapple juice
1  pt. whipping cream (Dream Whip)
1 small (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Dissolve both boxes of jello in boiling water.  Add cold water.  Add bananas, pineapple and marshmallows.  Pour in 9 x 13-inch rectangle dish and chill until solid.

name: TERIYAKI ROAST TENDERLOIN
ingredients:
1/2  c. dry sherry
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. dry onion soup
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2 to 3  lb. beef tenderloin
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except tenderloin.  Add terderloin and marinate 2 hours or more.  Bake at 425° for 45 to 50 minutes. Serves 6.

name: PEACH PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen peaches
2/3  c. sugar
2  c. orange juice
1  container frozen lemonade
1  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Defrost peaches, then mash peaches in a bowl.  Add sugar and all ingredients except ginger ale.  Add ginger ale prior to serving.

name: 7 LAYER DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. sour cream
1  jar salsa (hot or mild)
1  small onion, diced
1  small bell pepper, diced
Mozzarella cheese, grated
1  medium tomato, sliced
preparation: Line 9-inch pie pan with sour cream.  Pour in salsa.  Scatter pepper, onion and tomato.  Scatter Mozzarella, then Cheddar cheese.  Chill for 1 hour.  Good with tortilla chips.

name: VEAL MARSALA
ingredients:
1  lb. veal (1/4-inch thick)
1/2  tsp. crushed, dried rosemary
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. minced garlic
2  c. sliced mushrooms (fresh)
1/3  c. chicken broth
1/3  c. Marsala wine
1  tsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. oil
preparation: Over medium heat, brown veal (3 minutes per side) after you have coated it with spices.  Remove veal from skillet.  Add mushrooms; saute for 3 minutes.  Mix cornstarch and broth in bowl; stir with wire whisk.  Add this to mushrooms.  Add wine and cook 2 to 3 minutes until thickened and bubbling.  Pour over veal that you have kept warm.  Serves 4.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
3  c. sugar
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. salad oil
4  eggs
2  c. canned pumpkin
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped (optional)
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix all dry ingredients.  Add all remaining ingredients and mix well.  Bake in 2 well-greased loaf pans for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: PORCUPINE MEATBALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  c. uncooked rice
1  small onion (diced)
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  Tbsp. pepper
1  can tomato soup
1 1/2  cans water
preparation: Mix rice, ground beef, onion, salt and pepper together.  Form round balls.  Put in baking kettle.  Mix tomato soup with 1 1/2 cans water and pour over meatballs.  Cook in oven, uncovered, at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: TAR TOTS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger, drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can green beans
1/2  onion packet
preparation: Put all ingredients in pan.  Mix. Put Tar Tots layer on top. Add salt and pepper.  Cook until Tar Tots are brown.

name: D. A.'S BEST SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
5  qt. fresh peeled or canned tomatoes
1  large onion, chopped
4  cloves garlic, minced
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1  Tbsp. oregano
1  Tbsp. sweet basil
1  Tbsp. thyme
1 (12 oz.)  can tomato paste
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
2  to 3 bay leaves
preparation: Brown ground beef and garlic in a large stockpot in a tablespoon of olive oil.  When meat is almost cooked, add mushrooms and onions; continue browning until vegetables are slightly tender. Drain meat mixture.  Add oregano, basil, thyme, bay leaves and tomatoes.  Bring almost to a boil, lower heat and simmer for 2 to 3 hours.  Add tomato paste, sugar and Parmesan cheese.  Continue simmering for 1 more hour.  Serve over your favorite pasta.  Recipe makes approximately 1 gallon of sauce.  Freezes in Ziploc bags well for another day.

name: REFRIGERATOR ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. water
2/3  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. sugar
6  c. all-purpose flour, divided
2  tsp. salt
2  pkg. dry yeast
2  eggs
preparation: Combine water, butter and sugar in a saucepan; heat until butter melts, stirring occasionally.  Cool to 120° to 130°. Combine 2 cups flour, salt and yeast in a large mixing bowl; stir well.  Gradually add liquid mixture to flour mixture, beating well at high speed of an electric mixer.  Add eggs and beat an additional 2 minutes at medium speed.  Gradually stir in remaining flour, making a soft dough.  Cover and refrigerate up to 3 days; punch dough down and cover if it begins rising out of bowl.

name: YEAST BREAD
ingredients:
5 1/2  c. Dixie Lily plain flour
2  pkg. dry yeast
1  c. milk
1  c. water
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. oil
1  Tbsp. salt
oil
preparation: Stir together 2 cups flour and yeast.  Heat milk, water, sugar, 2 tablespoons oil and salt over low heat only until warm, stirring to blend. Add liquid ingredients to flour-yeast mixture and beat until smooth, about 2 minutes on medium speed with electric mixer or 300 strokes by hand.  Add 1 cup flour and beat 1 minute on medium speed or 150 strokes by hand. Stir in more flour to make a moderately stiff dough.  Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and satiny, about 8 to 10 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap.  Let rest 20 minutes.

name: GRATED POTATO DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
3  raw potatoes, grated fine
1  Tbsp. salt
4  eggs, beaten
2 to 3  c. flour
2  onions, diced
1/4  lb. butter
preparation: Grate potatoes.  Add salt and beaten eggs.  Add enough flour to make a soft dough.  Drop by spoonfuls into boiling water; cook for 8 to 10 minutes.  Drain and rinse in hot water.  Cook onion until golden brown in butter.  Pour onions and butter over dumplings.  Serve hot.

name: BANANA SPLIT PIE
ingredients:
8  oz. softened cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
5  Tbsp. milk
1  graham cracker crust
2  bananas
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 small  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and milk.  Spoon into pie shell.  Slice bananas over cream cheese mixture.  Add pineapple over bananas.  Top with Cool Whip.  Add cherries or nuts, if desired.

name: CHEESY HAM SANDWICHES
ingredients:
2  c. finely chopped ham
3/4  lb. Velveeta cheese, cubed
1/4  c. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. green onion slices
8  Kaiser rolls
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix  ham, cheese, mayonnaise and onion. Place 1/3 cup of  mixture on each bun.  Wrap individually in foil.  Bake 15 to  20  minutes or until hot and cheese begins to melt.  Serves 8.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  medium onion
4  Tbsp. margarine
4  Tbsp. flour
2 1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  egg yolk
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
2/3  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
preparation: Cut onion in small pieces.  Fry in margarine until soft.  Add flour, salt, milk and pepper to make a cream sauce.  Add egg yolk and cheese.  Add cooked and drained broccoli.  Put in casserole and sprinkle with bread crumbs.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. shredded cheese (medium or sharp)
1  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Have cheese at room temperature.  Mix together all ingredients. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper and salt.  Let chill.  Roll into balls and roll in chopped pecans or parsley until well coated.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
5  to 6 large potatoes
4  to 5 carrots or 1 small bag frozen (raw)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4 to 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Brown hamburger.  Drain well.  Peel and slice potatoes and carrots.  Mix in a 2-quart casserole dish: meat, vegetables, soup and milk.  Season to taste.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PARTY ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. sifted cake flour or 1 c. all-purpose flour
3/4  c. sugar
1 2/3  c. egg whites (about 12 at room temperature)
1 1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Note:  Mom always adds sprinkles.

name: QUICK COMPANY PIE
ingredients:
1 small  can pink lemonade
1  can Eagle Brand
1 small  carton Cool Whip
1  graham cracker crust, homemade or not
preparation: Can use a big can of lemonade and big carton of Cool Whip and make two pies.

name: BLUEBERRY YUM-YUMS
ingredients:
2  frozen pie crusts
16  oz. Cool Whip
1/2  c. sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. pecans
1 (16 oz.)  can cherry, blueberry or strawberry pie filling
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Take frozen pie crust and press a few pecans into crust.  Mix with spoon 1/2 of Cool Whip, 1/2 cup sugar and cream cheese in bowl until smooth (will be slightly lumpy). Pour into pie crusts.  Cover with layer of pie filling (your favorite), then top with the remaining Cool Whip.  Chill.

name: BLUEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. black cherry jello
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
1  can blueberries
2  c. boiling water
1 small  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan mix gelatin and boiling water until dissolved.  Add pineapple and blueberries.  Stir and let set. Separately mix sour cream, cream cheese, sugar and vanilla. Spread on top of gelatin mixture when set and sprinkle with nuts, if desired.

name: CHINESE CHEWIES
ingredients:
1  box brown sugar
1/2  c. self-rising flour
1/4  c. Crisco
3  eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour in greased glass dish.  Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: SAUCEPAN BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  stick oleo or butter
2  sq. chocolate
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. nutmeats
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt the butter and chocolate in a large saucepan.   Then add the sugar, flour, baking powder, nuts and vanilla to the butter and chocolate.   Beat the 2 eggs in, one at a time.  Bake in a 9 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  lb. grated cheese
2  c. bisquick
preparation: Mix together; make into balls and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until brown.

name: FUDGE
ingredients:
1  c. nuts
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1/4  lb. butter
6  oz. can evaporated milk
2  c. sugar
10  large marshmallows
preparation: Mix in a bowl the nuts, chocolate chips and butter.  Set aside.   In a pan mix evaporated milk, sugar and marshmallows. Bring to a boil for 6 minutes, stirring constantly.  Pour into chocolate mix until chocolate melts or dissolves.  Put into shallow buttered and greased pan.  Let set in refrigerator until cool.

name: CALICO COLESLAW
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. coleslaw blend (without dressing)
1 (11 oz.)  can corn with red and green peppers, drained
1 (2 1/4 oz.)  can sliced ripe olives, drained
1/2  c. sliced green onions
1  c. salad dressing or mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. cider vinegar
4  tsp. mustard
1/2  tsp. celery seed
preparation: In a large bowl, combine coleslaw blend, corn, olives and onions; mix well.  In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients; blend well.  Add to coleslaw mixture; toss to coat.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

name: CHEESY CHOWDER
ingredients:
1  c. chopped potatoes
1  c. chopped carrots
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
4  Tbsp. oleo or butter
3  c. chicken stock
dash of white pepper
2  c. milk
1/2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
3  c. (12 oz.) shredded processed sharp American cheese
preparation: Cook vegetables (except parsley) in butter and chicken stock for 30 minutes.  Blend together milk and flour.  Add to cooked vegetables and cook until thickened.  Add cheese, pepper and parsley.  Stir until cheese melts.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: DIP FOR STRAWBERRIES, FRUIT, ETC.
ingredients:
13  oz. jar marshmallow creme
8  oz. cream cheese
1  tsp. lemon juice
sprinkle of ginger
preparation: Stir all ingredients together.  Chill.

name: TOFFEE BARS
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sifted flour
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nutmeats
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and vanilla.  Add flour.  Mix well.  Stir in chocolate chips and nutmeats.  Press mixture into ungreased jelly roll pan.   Bake 25 minutes at 350°.  Cut into bars while still warm.  Cool before removing from pan.  Makes 5 dozen.

name: BEAN AND BEEF BARBECUE BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/8  c. diced green pepper
1/4  c. minced onion
1/4  c. diced celery
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  c. water
1 (No. 2)  can pork and beans
2  Tbsp. wine vinegar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/4  tsp. parsley
1/4  tsp. cumin
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
salt and pepper
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Cook ground beef and vegetables until meat is brown and vegetables are tender.  Add tomato sauce, water, garlic, vinegar, mustard, thyme, parsley, cumin, brown sugar and seasoning.  Blend well and simmer 5 minutes.  Pour beans into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Pour meat mixture over them.  Do not stir.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

name: DATE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. snipped pitted dates (8 oz.)
1  c. boiling water
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
3/4  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and lightly flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Combine dates and boiling water; cool to room temperature.  Stir together the flour, baking soda and 1/4 teaspoon salt.  In a large mixer bowl, beat shortening about 30 seconds. Add sugar and vanilla and beat until fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating 1 minute after each.  Add dry ingredients and cooled undrained date mixture alternately to beaten mixture, beating after each addition.  Stir in nuts.  Spread in pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.  If desired, serve each piece with a dollop of whipped cream.  Serves 12.

name: SUPPER IN A DISH
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
sliced potatoes
sliced carrots
chopped green peppers
chopped celery
chopped onion
peas
1  can cream of chicken or mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
2/3  c. grated cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown hamburger.  Layer with vegetables according to your taste.  Pour soup over the top.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Sprinkle cheese on top and return to oven until melted.

name: OLD-FASHIONED SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. brown sugar, packed
1 1/2  c. sour cream
3/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. ginger
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  Tbsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs
preparation: Place all ingredients in bowl and blend on low speed.  Then beat 3 minutes on high.  Bake 55 to 60 minutes at 350°.  Cool on rack for 10 minutes.

name: GROUND BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. onion
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. pimento
salt and pepper
3  c. cooked noodles (6 oz.)
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
3  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Cook noodles; brown ground beef and onion until tender.  Add salt and pepper.  Add noodles, corn, soup, sour cream and pimentos; mix well.  Pour into baking dish.  Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and grated cheese.  Dot with margarine.   Bake at 350° until cheese melts.

name: STIR FRY SHRIMP
ingredients:
1  lb. Jumbo shrimp
1  large onion
12  oz. mushrooms
1  head of broccoli
3  Green Bell Peppers
1/4  lb. snow peas
Olive oil
Salt and Pepper
Soy Sauce
preparation: Wash the shrimp, remove the shell and devein. Chop the broccoli and discard the large stem. Chop the peppers, mushrooms, and onion. In a large pan, or wok, pour 1 tbsp. of olive oil, and add shrimp. Sauté shrimp for 2 minutes, then add broccoli, and mix well. Add green peppers, 1/2 tsp. salt, and pepper to your liking.

name: CARROT RELISH
ingredients:
6  c. carrots, cooked and sliced (should be cool, not cold)
1  large onion
1  chopped green pepper
3/4  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
1  can tomato soup
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Boil vinegar, sugar, tomato soup, vegetable oil, salt and pepper together.  When slightly cool, pour over carrots, onion and green pepper.  Refrigerate 2 to 3 days.

name: EGGLESS HILLBILLY CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
1  stick margarine or butter (1/2 c.)
2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. soda
1  c. raisins
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients  except soda and flour.  Boil for one minute,  then  add  flour and soda.  Place in loaf pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  8  oz. cream cheese
2  pkgs. beef (lunch meat)
1  Tbsp. worcestershire sauce
5  green onions (chopped)
1  Tbsp. Accent
preparation: Mix onions, 1 pkg. beef, worcestershire sauce, Accent and cream cheese.  Mix with hands and shape into ball.  Dice 1 pkg. beef into small pieces.  Cover ball with diced beef.  Set in fridge overnight.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1 medium  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
pinch of salt
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Beat eggs; add fruit cocktail, sugar, flour, soda and salt. Mix well.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Sprinkle brown sugar and nut mixture over batter.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.  Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

name: CALZONES
ingredients:
15  oz. Ricotta cheese
8  oz. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. parsley
3/4  c. ham, cubed or 24 meatballs (if desired)
2  loaves frozen bread dough, defrosted
preparation: Mix all cheeses, parsley and ham, if desired, together. Separate defrosted bread dough into 8 pieces and roll out into a circle about 8 inches across.  Place 1/4 to 1/2 cup of cheese mixture on one side of dough circle.  Fold other half over to make a semi-circle.  Pinch edges to seal.  Bake in a 375° oven for 15 to 20 minutes until dough is golden brown.

name: KOOL-AID PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. Kool-Aid (any flavor)
2  c. sugar
2  qt. water
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
4  c. 7-Up
preparation: Mix ingredients well.

name: TACO SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion
2  cans tomato soup
2  cans whole kernel corn
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can pinto beans
1  can black beans
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  can diced tomatoes
preparation: Brown ground beef and when almost done, chop onions and cook with beef. Drain beef when done. Heat thoroughly until all vegetables are warm.

name: OYSTER CRACKER SNACK
ingredients:
2  pkg. oyster crackers (12 or 18 oz.)
1 (18 oz.)  bottle Orville oil topping
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch envelope
preparation: Mix all oil and all dressing together.  Put all crackers and oil mix in bowl.  Slop around (2 to 4 ounces of oil mix left over in bowl).  Don't soak crackers.  Bake on cookie sheet 1 hour and 15 minutes at 225°.  Dump on paper towels to absorb excess oil.

name: CHOCOLATE OAT CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. (2 sticks) oleo
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/3  c. flour
2 1/2  c. quick cooking oats
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips (semi-sweet)
1  c. chopped nuts
1 1/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Beat softened oleo and sugars until creamy.  Add eggs, milk and vanilla.  Beat well.  Stir in oats, chocolate chips, flour and nuts.  Mix well; drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 9 to 10 minutes.

name: HOPPING JOHN
ingredients:
1  c. dried black-eyed peas
water to cover peas
1/2  lb. smoked bacon or salt pork, diced
1  red pepper pod, diced
3  c. cooked rice
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Soak peas overnight.  Cook with the bacon and pepper pod until the peas are very tender.  Add rice and salt and pepper to taste. Pour into casserole.  Cover.  Bake in moderate oven (350°) until liquid is absorbed and dish is thoroughly heated.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans Mandarin oranges
1  large Cool Whip
1  large cottage cheese
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1 small  box orange Jell-O
1  Tbsp. sugar
crushed pecans
preparation: Combine Mandarin oranges (well drained), cottage cheese, pineapple, Jell-O, sugar and Cool Whip.  Mix well.  Sprinkle with crushed nuts.  Put in fridge.  Keep cold.  Quick, easy and very good.

name: SUPER FAST FRANKS AND BEANS
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can red kidney beans, drained
1 (17 oz.)  can lima beans, drained
1/2  c. spaghetti sauce
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. Cheddar cheese
6  to 8 frankfurters
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Mix beans in spaghetti sauce, onion and cheese in an ungreased 2-quart casserole dish.  Place franks on top of mixture.  Bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes or until beans are bubbling and franks have a touch of brown.  Sprinkle with cheese and cook 5 minutes more, until cheese melts.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  pt. pumpkin
6  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
2  qt. milk
8  eggs
preparation: Makes 3 pies.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP PUDDING COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. packed brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1 small  pkg. instant pudding (vanilla or chocolate)
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Combine butter and sugar.  Add vanilla and eggs, mixing well. Stir in pudding powder.  Combine flour and soda.  Add to butter and sugar mix.  Add chocolate chips.  Bake at 375° for about 8 to 10 minutes on ungreased cookie sheets.  Makes 5 dozen.

name: BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1  ham bone or 3 ham hocks
8  c. water or less
1  lb. small soup beans (navy), soaked overnight
1/4  tsp. margarine
1/4  tsp. thyme (more for taste)
1/2  can medium tomatoes
1  can tomato soup
3  stalks celery, cut up
1  small onion, diced
1/4  green pepper, diced
1  small turnip
3  carrots
3  small potatoes
1  c. noodle products
preparation: Put all this in a large pot at once and simmer until beans are soft.  Add:

name: CHEESE MUFFIN
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  c. grated medium sharp Cheddar, divided
1  egg
3  Tbsp. liquid/melted margarine
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Grease 12 muffin tins.  Do not use liners.  Mix dry ingredients and 3/4 cup cheese.  Stir in liquid with fork; mix gently.  Fill muffin tins and sprinkle with remaining grated cheese.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes.  These are excellent served with soup and salad.  Yield:  12.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  lb. sweet potatoes, boiled, peeled and mashed
3  eggs, separated
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
1/3  c. brown sugar
preparation: In mixing bowl, blend potatoes, egg yolks, salt, butter and milk. Add 1/3 cup brown sugar and walnuts. Fold in beaten egg whites (stiff but not dry). Arrange walnuts and some brown sugar on bottom of large casserole pan that has been well buttered. Spoon the potato mixture over this.  Sprinkle some nuts and brown sugar on top of this mixture and bake in preheated oven at 350° for about 45 minutes.  Serve hot.

name: LIVER WITH ONIONS
ingredients:
2  c. sliced onions
1  stick butter
1/4  tsp. sage
1  lb. calves liver, cut into strips
seasoned flour
preparation: Saute onions in butter and sage in a large skillet for about 10 minutes. Shake liver in bag of seasoned flour. Add liver to onions and cook until done, stirring frequently.

name: FIVE CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. canned oranges
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. coconut
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Chill until time to serve.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  cans mandarin oranges
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
3/4  c. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add flour, sugar, oranges, salt and soda; mix thoroughly.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

name: WHITE HOUSE QUICK AND EASY GELATIN SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. diet orange gelatin dessert
1  c. boiling water
1  c. White House unsweetened apple sauce
1/2  c. finely grated carrots
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained and packed in natural juice
1  tsp. White House distilled vinegar for a firmer gelatin salad
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup boiling water.  Add applesauce and mix well.  Add carrots, pineapple and vinegar.  Pour mixture into your favorite mold.  Yield: 4 servings

name: EGGPLANT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant
1  green pepper
1  onion, grated
1  egg
small amount bacon fat or margarine
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. stale bread crumbs
preparation: Boil eggplant.  Mash eggplant, pepper, onion and egg.  Add stale bread crumbs.  Add bacon fat or margarine.  Add mushroom soup.  Save few crumbs for top.  Mix and bake in buttered dish at 450° until done.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. oil
2  eggs
1  c. pumpkin
1 3/4  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/3  c. water
1/4  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. each: cinnamon, ground cloves and allspice
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN TORTILLA SOUP
ingredients:
2  skinless chicken breasts
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. Mexican salsa
8  corn tortillas, torn into pieces
1  Tbsp. chicken bouillon
preparation: Put chicken in large pot with 1 1/2 quarts water.  Simmer until meat is cooked.  Remove chicken from broth.  Chop meat into small pieces.  Skim fat from broth.  Add remaining ingredients to broth.  Bring to a slow boil.  Cook until thickened by tortillas (they will partially dissolve).  Add chicken meat.  Makes 6 servings.

name: REAL CHILE VERDE
ingredients:
2  lb. pork chops (lean)
6  to 7 large green chilies (Anaheim are okay)
3  large tomatoes
1  large onion (any color)
3 large  cloves garlic
vegetable oil
flour
salt
preparation: Cover bottom of large pot with oil and warm.  Cube pork; mince garlic and chop onion.  Put pork, garlic, 1/4 of onion and desired salt in pot and brown; sprinkle 2 tablespoons of flour while stirring and browning meat.  When brown, turn down heat.  Chop tomatoes and chilies and add with the rest of the onion to the meat; add 1 quart of water and boil.  Boil water out 3 times or until all ingredients are very soft.  Lower heat when thick or add cornstarch.  Great on burritos, eggs, fried potatoes, rice.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
2/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1/3  c. margarine, melted
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. fresh or frozen blueberries
preparation: In mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. In another bowl, beat eggs.  Blend in milk, butter, nutmeg and vanilla.  Pour into dry ingredients and mix just until moistened. Fold in blueberries.

name: HOMEMADE CHILI
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  pkg. Chili-O powder mix
32  oz. tomato juice
2 (16 oz.)  cans chili beans
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain.  Add tomato juice and chili beans in a large pot; simmer for 20 minutes.  Add chili powder; bring to a boil.  Serve hot.

name: ANGEL DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  prepared angel food cake
1  large instant lemon or vanilla pudding mix
8  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. Cool whip
1  can pie filling (cherry or lemon)
preparation: Tear angel  food  cake	into  chunks.  Place  in  a 9 x 13-inch  pan.  Mix	pudding  according  to directions and pour over cake.	Beat  cream cheese and Cool Whip together and pour over pudding.  Chill one hour.  Top with filling.

name: MARINATED GARBANZOS
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can garbanzos, drained
1/2  c. oil
3  Tbsp. vinegar or juice of 1 lemon
1/2  c. chopped parsley
1/4  c. chopped scallions
garlic powder or 2 cloves fresh garlic, minced
1/4  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients and allow to marinate in refrigerator at least 2 hours.  Drain.  Serve with toast rounds, or as part of an antipasto tray.  Yields 2 1/2 cups.  Approximately 135 calories per 1/2 cup serving, 20 calories per tablespoon.

name: TURKEY SCALOPPINE GOURMET
ingredients:
1  pound turkey breasts 3/4 inch thick
8  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  cup unsalted butter
1/4  pound sliced mushrooms
3  Tbsp. chopped onions
3/4  cup white wine
pepper to taste
1  chicken bouillon cube
parsley
preparation: Flatten turkey breasts, press into mixture of flour, cheese and seasonings.  Melt 1/4 cup butter in skillet over medium heat, sauté.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1 (2 lb.)  pkg. hash browns (frozen potatoes)
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
potato chips
preparation: Mix all ingredients together except potato chips.  Bake in casserole dish at 375° for 1 hour. Crumble potato chips over baked casserole. Return to oven for 15 minutes or until brown on top.

name: PUDDIN COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. Bisquick mix
3  oz. pkg. chocolate instant pudding mix
1/4  c. salad oil
1  egg
preparation: Mix.  Form into small balls.  Flatten with hand on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake 8 minutes at 350°.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Crisco shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  oz. red food coloring
1  oz. water
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. buttermilk
2 1/4  c. plain flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vinegar
