preparation: Cream Crisco and sugar with a spoon; add eggs, then food coloring and water, then cocoa. Blend in buttermilk; add flour and salt gradually. Add vanilla and beat well with spoon. Mix vinegar and soda together and fold into mixture. Do not beat. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes in 350° oven. Makes 2 (9-inch) layers or 9 x 13-inch sheet cake. Frost with Fluff Frosting.

name: GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
4  strips bacon, cooked
4  Tbsp. butter
4  Tbsp. Kikkoman soy sauce
2  cans green beans, drained
1 1/2  c. water
preparation: Bring to boil all ingredients.  Simmer for 30 minutes.

name: K CEREAL BARS
ingredients:
6  c. K cereal (Special K)
1  c. sugar
1  c. white Karo syrup
1 1/2  c. peanut butter
small pkg. chocolate chips
small pkg. butterscotch chips
preparation: Butter a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.   Add cereal.  Bring sugar and syrup to a light boil.  Stir in peanut butter.  Pour over cereal.  Mix well and pat down.  Melt small package of chocolate morsels and a small package of butterscotch morsels.   Spread over cereal mixture and let cool.  Cut in squares.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1  large fryer, cooked and boned
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. chicken broth
2  cans mixed vegetables, drained
preparation: Grease baking dish.  Put chicken in bottom of dish.  Mix soups, broth and vegetables.  Pour over chicken.  Top with crust.

name: CHOCOLATE ANGEL CAKE
ingredients:
12  oz. pkg. semi-sweet chips
4  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. light corn syrup
2/3  c. powdered sugar
1  lb. angel food cake
preparation: In medium glass bowl, combine chips, butter, corn syrup and 2 tablespoons of water.  Microwave on High for 1 3/4 minutes or until chips are melted.

name: FRESH VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise (do not use substitute)
1  tsp. dill weed
1 1/2  tsp. Beau Monde seasoning
1  tsp. dried onion
preparation: Mix all together well and chill overnight before serving with an assortment of small pieces of fresh vegetables.

name: BENEDICTINE SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  cucumber, seeded and grated
4  Tbsp. juice from 1 onion
pinch of salt
few drops green food coloring
preparation: Blend grated cucumber and onion juice into cream cheese.  Beat until consistency desired.  Add food coloring to create a pale green tint and blend.  This is a light and tasty spread for sandwiches or use as a dip with crackers and chips.

name: SOY SAUCE CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  c. mushroom soy sauce
3  c. water
1  c. dry white wine
1/2  c. sugar
5 thin  slices fresh gingerroot
4  star anise
3  lb. whole broiler-fryer chicken
green onion or parsley
preparation: Heat soy sauce, water, wine, sugar, gingerroot and star anise to boiling in Dutch oven.  Add chicken; heat to boiling.  Reduce heat to medium-low; cover and simmer 30 minutes or until done, turning chicken and stirring mixture 2-3 times.

name: PINEAPPLE SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
1/3  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
2  eggs
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour into a greased sheet cake pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes in a 350° oven I bake mine 45 minutes).

name: MICHIGAN ROCKS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. butter
4  eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  lb. dates, cut up
1  c. nutmeats
preparation: Cream together sugar and butter.  Add eggs and beat.  Mix together flour, cinnamon, salt, vanilla and baking soda in a little hot water.  Add dates and nutmeats.  Bake at 350° to 375°.

name: BAKED BANANA CUSTARD
ingredients:
1/2  c. bread crumbs
juice of 1 lime
3  eggs
nutmeg to taste
2  c. milk
4  ripe bananas
5  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Peel and crush bananas.  Add 2 tablespoons of sugar, nutmeg and lime juice and mix.  Place in buttered baking dish and cover with bread crumbs.  Beat eggs and remaining sugar until smooth. Heat milk and add to egg mixture.  Pour over banana mixture and bake in 325° oven until custard is set.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI QUICHE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. diced chicken
1 (10 oz.)  box frozen broccoli, thawed and well drained
1  c. (lite) Ricotta cheese
1  whole egg
1  egg white
1/2  c. low-fat plain yogurt
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
preparation: Lightly spray 9-inch pie plate.  Combine 1/2 of chicken and 1/2 of  broccoli  in  pie  plate.  Puree  Ricotta  cheese, yogurt, eggs, flour,  baking powder, salt, Parmesan cheese and melted margarine  in  blender.  Pour  over  the  chicken  and broccoli. Take the remaining chicken and broccoli and scatter over the top. Bake 30  to  45  minutes at 350°.  Let stand 10 minutes.

name: GLAZED CARROTS
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots, peeled and cut into 3 to 4-inch pieces
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. brown sugar
4  Tbsp. cold water
3  tsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. nuts, coarsely chopped
preparation: Cook carrots until almost done; drain.  Put carrots into frying pan and add margarine and brown sugar.  In separate small bowl, mix water and cornstarch until smooth and add to carrot mixture.  Let it simmer uncovered on stove for 30 minutes; add nuts.  Put carrots into a casserole dish and keep warm in oven (very low temperature) indefinitely.

name: PINEAPPLE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  can pineapple pie filling
3  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 1/2  sticks margarine
1/4  c. sugar
4  c. Cool Ship
1  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
8  oz. cream cheese
preparation: Mix graham cracker crumbs, margarine and sugar together for the bottom of crust; spread evenly in a large pan.  Whip Cool Whip and powdered sugar, then add cream cheese with vanilla.  Spread half of mixture on crust.  Spread pie filling over Cool Whip mixture.  Add remaining Cool Whip over pie filling; chill.

name: PARTY JEWEL CAKE
ingredients:
1  egg, well beaten
1  c. Pet milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. fresh coconut
1  c. cut candied cherries
1  pkg. white or yellow cake mix
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Bake cake mix according to directions on package in two or three 9-inch round cake pans.  Cool cake.  Mix well beaten egg, sugar, Pet milk, vanilla, salt and butter in a 2-quart saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture thickens, about 8 or 10 minutes.  Do not boil.  Take off of heat.  Stir in coconut, nuts and cherries.  Cool.  Spread cherry mixture between and on top of layers.  Decorate with nuts and cherries.  Chill 6 to 8 hours to let flavor blend.

name: PEANUT BUTTER OATMEAL BARS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar (packed)
1/2  c. peanut butter
6  Tbsp. butter
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. quick cooking oats
preparation: Stir together flour, sugar and peanut butter; mix in eggs, milk and vanilla.  Add oats and mix well.  Spread in lightly greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 375°  for 12 to 15 minutes. Cool; spread with peanut butter frosting.  Cut into bars.

name: AUNT INEZ'S SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. butter
3  c. sugar
4  eggs
5 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all.  Drop by rounded teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° until barely brown.

name: SOFT HONEY SUGAR COOKIES(Makes 3 Dozen)
ingredients:
1/2  c. Baker's Deluxe margarine, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. honey
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla extract
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: In large bowl with electric mixer at medium speed, beat Baker's Deluxe margarine, sugar, honey, egg and vanilla extract until thoroughly blended.  Blend in flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.  Cover; chill dough at least 2 hours.  On a lightly floured surface, roll dough out to 1/4-inch thickness.  Cut dough with cookie cutters into desired shapes.  Place on ungreased baking sheets.  Bake at 350° for 6 to 8 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove from baking sheets; cool on wire racks.  Decorate as desired.

name: CHESS SQUARES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  egg
1  yellow cake mix
8  oz. cream cheese
3  eggs
1  box powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix margarine,	1  egg	and  cake mix by hand or with a spoon. Press  into  an  ungreased  13  x 9-inch pan.  Combine cream cheese,  eggs,  vanilla and sugar.	Pour over cake mixture.  Bake 45	minutes  at  350°.  Let  cool  and  cut  into squares.	Time of preparation: 45 minutes.

name: EGGPLANT, ONION AND TOMATO BAKE
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1  large onion, coarsely chopped
2  large tomatoes, cut into 3/4-inch chunks
2  cloves garlic, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. basil leaves
2  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
chopped fresh tomatoes (for garnish)
preparation: Lightly oil a heavy 3-quart casserole.  Layer the eggplant, onion and tomatoes in the casserole.  Sprinkle with garlic, salt, basil and olive oil.  Cover.  Bake at 350° for 2 hours. Mix gently.  Sprinkle with parsley.  Garnish with chopped fresh tomatoes before serving.

name: ITALIAN SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. bacon drippings
1/2  c. celery
1/2  c. onion
2  cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2  lb. hamburger meat
4  c. tomato juice
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. chili powder
1  bay leaf
1  tsp. oregano
2  c. mushrooms
preparation: Saute celery, onion and garlic in bacon drippings.  Brown hamburger meat.  Drain and add to sauteed mixture.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1 hour.

name: ZIPPY POTATOES(Microwave)
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes, cut in chunks
2  Tbsp. oil
1  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Blend all ingredients in microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on High for 6 minutes; stir well. Microwave on High for 6 more minutes. (May need to adjust time more or less depending on microwave wattages.) Let stand 3 minutes.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2 medium  cans chunk pineapple (unsweetened), drain and save juice
1  can Mandarin oranges, drain (do not save juice)
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. fresh fruit
5  large bananas
3  Tbsp. Tang
1 small  box instant vanilla pudding
preparation: Mix Tang with pineapple juice and pour over fruit.  Mix and sprinkle instant pudding mix; then mix well.

name: QUICK AND EASY LEMON PIES
ingredients:
1 small  can frozen lemonade (pink lemonade or limeade can be used)
1  can condensed milk
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
2  graham cracker crusts
preparation: Mix all ingredients well in a large bowl. Pour into 2 crusts and refrigerate.

name: SWISS AND FRANK ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
2  pkg. (20 each) appetizer frankfurters
40  sticks Swiss cheese (1/4 x 1/4 x 2 inches)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. refrigerator biscuits
butter, melted
sesame seed
preparation: Note:  Use a buttered baking sheet.

name: BARBIE'S CASSEROLE
ingredients:
16  oz. Shoe Peg corn, drained
8  oz. French-style green beans, drained
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  Tbsp. oil
1  c. cream of celery soup
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Saute the onion and celery in oil.  Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.  Transfer to a large casserole dish.  Top with 1 stack crushed Ritz crackers.  Drizzle 1 stick margarine over all.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: QUICK AND EASY CAMP STEW
ingredients:
1  can Castleberry's barbecue pork
1  can Castleberry's barbecue beef
1  can barbecue chicken
1  can Swanson chicken or use 4 to 6 chicken pieces, cooked and cut up
2  cans tomatoes
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can cream-style corn
1  large onion, chopped fine
1/4  tsp. lemon juice
4  potatoes, diced
1  can English peas
1  box or 1 bag butter beans
3  carrots, sliced thin
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients; cook over low heat for about 2 hours, or until potatoes are done.  May be eaten then or refrigerated overnight.  Heat and serve.

name: PORK TENDERLOIN WITH FIG PRESERVES
ingredients:
5  lb. pork tenderloin
salt to taste
ground cayenne pepper to taste and/or Louisiana hot sauce
1/2  c. chopped onion or smaller amount dried onion
1/2  tsp. minced garlic or to taste
1  c. chopped mushrooms (canned is fine)
1  c. fig preserves
1/2  c. dry white wine (red works fine also)
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°. Sprinkle salt and pepper over pork loin, then place in middle of flat baking dish. Sprinkle the onions, garlic and mushrooms around the meat. Spread the fig preserves over the meat until it is completely covered. Pour the wine around the meat; cover with foil and bake until done, 2 to 3 hours. Adjust baking time for less meat.

name: GREAT STRAWBERRY SHORTCAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  qt. strawberries
3/4  c. sugar
2  containers Cool Whip
preparation: Make cake per directions in 2 layers.  When layers are cool, punch holes in both layers with a 2-prong fork.  Leave 4 strawberries whole; cut remaining berries into 4ths or 8ths; add sugar and a little water to mix well.  Spread 1/2 strawberries over bottom layer; add top layer cake and spread the remaining cut up strawberries over top layer.  Beat thawed Cool Whip with mixer until it can be spread over entire cake.  Garnish top with 4 whole strawberries that have been cut into halves.  Refrigerate cake.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. Mexican cornbread mix
2  cans cream-style corn
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
1 1/2  lb. ground meat
1/2  to 1 onion, chopped
1  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix cornbread mix, eggs and milk.  Lightly brown ground beef with onion.  Put half of the cornbread mixture in a lightly greased pan; spread meat mixture on top and cover with half of cheese. Spread the other half of cornbread mix and cover with the rest of cheese.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: DARK FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
3  oz. pkg. lemon peel
3  oz. pkg. orange peel
1/2  lb. candied cherries
1/4  lb. walnuts
1/4  lb. pecans
1/2  lb. pitted dates
1/4  lb. candied pineapple
1/4  lb. preserved citron
1/2  lb. seeded raisins
1/4  c. flour
1  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. honey
5  well beaten eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/4  c. orange or grape juice
preparation: Shred fruit peels; halve cherries, nuts and dates.  Cut pineapple and citron the size of almonds.  Dredge fruits in 1/4 cup flour.  Cream shortening and sugar; add honey, then eggs and beat well.  Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with fruit juice. Beat thoroughly.  Pour batter over floured fruits and mix well. Line greased 3 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch loaf pan with waxed paper, allowing 1/2-inch to extend above all sides of pan.  Do not flatten.  Bake in slow oven at 250° for 3 to 4 hours.  Place pan containing 2 cups water on bottom shelf of oven while baking for greater volume, moist texture and a smooth, shiny glaze.  If desired, pour brandy over as cakes are removed from oven.  Cool.  Brush with hot corn syrup.  Decorate with blanched almonds and cherries.  Makes 5 pounds.

name: LOW-FAT CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1  can stewed tomatoes
1 small  can kidney beans
1  c. water
1  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. cumin
1/8  tsp. red pepper
preparation: In a large pot, brown turkey. Drain any excess fat. Add onion, pepper and garlic. Stir until onion changes color.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1 1/2 hours.  (One cup with 5 crackers equals 8 grams total fat.)

name: SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  boxes chopped spinach
1  (8 oz.) block cream cheese, softened
1  egg
onion powder
preparation: Cook and drain spinach; mix in beaten egg, cream cheese and onion powder to taste.  Pour in a casserole dish and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: MAYONNAISE
ingredients:
2  egg yolks
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
2  c. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. lemon juice or vinegar
preparation: Beat egg yolks, salt and mustard until light and lemon colored.  Add oil, a small amount at a time.  Beat until mixture is emulsified.  Stir in lemon juice or vinegar.  Refrigerate until needed.  Makes 1 pint.

name: MEXICANA CREMA (SOUR CREAM)
ingredients:
1  c. heavy cream
1/2  c. sour cream
juice of 1 squeezed lime
1/2  tsp. Cilantro spice
preparation: Whisk heavy cream with sour cream in a small saucepan.  Heat to 90° over low heat.  (Do not allow mixture to become hotter or the culture will be inhibited and the cream will not thicken.) Pour into a warm sterilized glass jar; cover lightly.  Store in a dark place 8-12 hours or until cream ripens and becomes thick. Refrigerate 24 hours.  Cream will continue to thicken.  This is a luxurious, thick, rich cream which resists curdling.  Use for special Mexican dishes in place of regular sour cream.   Yields: 1-1/2 cup.

name: CRUSTLESS EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  c. evaporated milk
5  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
3/4  c. sweet milk
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix well.  Bake at 325° until done, approximately 30 minutes.

name: HOLIDAY PUNCH
ingredients:
3  c. pineapple juice
3  c. cranberry juice
1 1/2  c. water
1/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: Pour juice in coffeepot and add 1 cinnamon stick and 1 1/2 teaspoons whole cloves in basket of coffeepot.  Perk.

name: GREEN PUNCH
ingredients:
3  c. white sugar
3  c. water
1  pkg. lime jello
12  oz. lemon juice
1 small  bottle almond extract
1  bottle ginger ale
1 large  can pineapple juice
preparation: Add sugar and water.  Cook until it becomes syrup.  Combine jello and 2 cups hot water; dissolve as making jello.  Add to syrup.  Add lemon juice, almond extract, ginger ale and pineapple.

name: CORN SALAD
ingredients:
6  ears yellow corn
1/2  long Burpless cucumber
1/2  to 1 chopped red pepper
1/4  c. oil
1/4  c. lemon juice
little hot sauce
salt to taste
preparation: Cook corn and cut off the cob or may use frozen or canned; fresh is better.  Do not peel cucumber.  Cut in half and slice. Add chopped red pepper and toss.  When ready to serve, add dressing.  May use store bought if preferred.  Very colorful and tasty.

name: BARBECUE BEANS
ingredients:
1  large onion
1  medium green pepper
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1/2  c. ketchup
6  slices bacon, cut up
1 (32 oz.)  can pork and beans
preparation: Chop onion and green pepper.  Combine with brown sugar, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire and bacon in a 2-quart casserole dish.  Drain beans, then stir beans into mixture.   Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 2 hours.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sliced and diced apples
2 1/2  c. sugar
3  c. flour
3  eggs
1 1/4  c. oil
1 1/4  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. coconut
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. allspice
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a mixing bowl well.  After well blended, pour into an ungreased tube pan.  Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: COATED PECANS
ingredients:
2  c. pecan halves
1  egg white
2/3  c. light brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat egg whites until very stiff.  Add sugar and vanilla; mix well.  Add pecans and stir to coat.  Drop one at a time onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake in 250° oven for 30 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. flour
1 medium  jar green olives, drained
1  stick butter or margarine, softened
preparation: Mix cheese, margarine and flour.  Take a small amount of this mixture and form into 1-inch balls.  Flatten slightly and place olive in center.  Roll back into ball.  Continue until either olives or mixture runs out.  Bake in a 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.  These can be stored in freezer before baking.

name: SAUSAGE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. pork sausage
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1  large egg, lightly beaten
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
vegetable spray
preparation: Brown sausage in skillet.  Stir until it crumbles; drain and set aside.  Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Make well in center.  Combine milk, egg and butter.  Add to dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened.  Stir in sausage and cheese.  Place baking cups in muffin pan and spray cups.  Spoon batter into cups, filling 2/3's full.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes until golden brown.  Remove from pans.  Yield: 12 muffins.

name: 3 COCONUT PIES
ingredients:
6 to 8  Tbsp. flour
2  c. sugar
1/2  stick margarine
6  eggs, separated
3 1/2  c. milk
2 to 3  c. coconut (fresh is better)
preparation: Cook all except egg whites until thick; beat egg whites until stiff.  Fold 1/2 into cooled mixture.  Add 6 tablespoons sugar to remaining egg whites and top pies.  Brown under broiler.

name: FRIED PIES(Berniece Harbaugh's Recipe)
ingredients:
5  c. flour
4  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. salt
8  Tbsp. sugar
2/3  c. shortening
2  eggs
1 large  can evaporated milk
fruit or pudding
shortening (for deep frying, add 2 Tbsp. vinegar; this keeps shortening from soaking into pie crust)
preparation: Sift together flour, baking soda, salt and sugar in a large bowl.  Add the shortening and cut into flour mixture.  Add milk and slightly beaten eggs.  Chill overnight.  Roll dough out thin to avoid being tough.  Don't handle dough too much or it will shrink. Cut a circle the size of a pie plate.  Be sure to lift dough before cutting.  Fill with fruit or pudding.  (Dried fruit makes easy to handle while eating.)  Place fruit on 1/2 side of the circle.  Wet edges with a little water.  Fold over and seal edges.  Fry in deep fat at 325° until golden brown on both sides.  Makes about 40 pies.

name: INDIVIDUAL CHERRY CHEESECAKES
ingredients:
1  box vanilla wafers
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3  large eggs
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
canned cherry pie filling
preparation: Mix cream cheese, eggs, sugar and vanilla.  Beat well with a beater.  Put 1 vanilla wafer in bottom of cupcake papers.   Fill 2/3 full with cream cheese mixture.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Cool.  Place 1 tablespoon cherry pie filling on top of cheesecake.  Refrigerate.

name: CAFE SUISSE MOCHA
ingredients:
1/4  c. powdered nondairy coffee creamer
2  Tbsp. powdered baking cocoa
1/3  c. sugar
1/4  c. instant coffee
preparation: Put all  ingredients  in blender.  Cover and process at liquefy until  well  blended.  Use one level tablespoon of mix with 6 ounces  of boiling water for each cup.  Stir.  Makes 16 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE CARAMEL BARS
ingredients:
2  eggs
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. Kraft caramels
1/4  c. milk
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Beat eggs, sugar, Miracle Whip and vanilla; add flour and baking soda.  Set aside 1 cup of the batter.  Spread remaining batter into lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes (at 350°) or until lightly browned.  Cool 10 minutes. Melt caramels with milk over low heat, stirring frequently, until smooth.  Top crust with caramel mixture.  Sprinkle with chocolate chips and pecans.  Spoon reserved 1 cup batter by teaspoonfuls over pecans.  Continue baking 12 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned.  Cool and cut into squares.

name: ICEBOX FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. candied cherries, sliced (red)
1  lb. candied pineapple, sliced (green or yellow)
1  lb. coconut
1  lb. pecans, chopped
1  lb. graham crackers, crushed
1  lb. marshmallows, melted
1  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: In a large bowl or dishpan, mix the cracker crumbs, fruit, coconut and pecans.  In a separate bowl, melt marshmallows and milk together.  Pour over the dry mixture.  Mix together and form into a cake.  This will make a large 7 pound cake or several small ones. This cake will seem dry while mixing, but no additional moisture is needed.  Store covered in the refrigerator.  Will keep well.

name: TANGY TOMATO SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  small onion, diced
1/4  c. cider vinegar
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dried whole oregano
preparation: Combine all ingredients in container of electric blender. Process until smooth.  Cover and chill.  Serve over salad greens. Yield:  1 1/2 cups (18 calories per tablespoon).

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  whole chicken breasts
1  lb. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  pkg. large tortillas, quartered
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  jar salsa sauce
preparation: Cook chicken breasts and cut into bite size pieces.  Mix together soup and salsa.  Set aside.

name: OVEN STEW
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. stew meat
3  carrots, diced
4  stalks celery (1-inch pieces)
1  can green beans
2  large potatoes, cut up
1  can tomato soup
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. water
preparation: Mix together, cover and cook for 5 to 6 hours at 275° in oven.

name: MY FAVORITE PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
3 1/2 to 4  c. pumpkin
1  tsp. ginger
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  can skim condensed milk
3  egg whites
2  Tbsp. flour mixed with sugar
preparation: Mix ginger, cinnamon, flour and sugar.  Beat egg whites lightly.  Add dry ingredients, then pumpkin.  Mix well.  Add milk; mix well.  Pour into two 10-inch pastry shells or 3 smaller shells. Bake for 10 minutes at 450°, then at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: GARDEN SPREAD
ingredients:
chopped red, yellow or green peppers
scallions
seeded tomatoes
cucumber
celery
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese, whipped
herbs
salt
pepper
preparation: Proportions are your own, but start with 2 or 3 tablespoons of any or all the vegetables.  Add to the whipped cream cheese. Flavor with herbs, salt and pepper.  May be made ahead and refrigerated.

name: BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. strips fresh ginger
salt and pepper to taste
1  tsp. cooking wine
4  scallions (1/2-inch)
1  Tbsp. honey
1/2  tsp. minced garlic
preparation: Place chicken in baking dish.  Combine all ingredients except scallions and pour over chicken.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 hours.  Bake at 300°.  When almost done, add scallions.

name: BLUEBERRY AND CREAM CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box cake mix
1  can blueberry pie filling
preparation: Bake cake mix according to directions.  Split layers.  Use blueberry pie filling to stack cake.  Save a little to top cake.

name: ZIPPY'S FAT-FREE SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1/2  tsp. chopped green peppers
1/4  c. chopped carrots
1  tsp. minced parsley
1/3  tsp. suc. solution
1  c. tomato juice
1/4  c. vinegar
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients in jar with tight fitting top.  Cover; shake until blended.  Store, covered, in refrigerator.  Shake well before using.

name: SAUCY HAM AND POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
2  Tbls. chopped onion
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
dash of pepper
1 1/2  c. milk
2  c. shredded mild cheddar cheese
1/2  lb. ham, cut into 1/8-inch slices
6  c. cooked potatoes sliced
preparation: Sauté onion in butter, blend in flour and seasonings. Gradually add milk, cook, stirring constantly until thickened. Add 1 1/2 c. cheese; stir until melted. Toss potatoes in cheese sauce. Reserving 1 cup of potatoes. Pour into 2 qt. casserole dish. Arrange ham and reserved potatoes on top of casserole, top with remaining cheese. Bake 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CRISP ONION-ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton onion recipe soup mix
1/2  c. olive or vegetable oil
1/4  c. margarine, melted
1  tsp. thyme leaves (optional)
1  tsp. marjoram leaves (optional)
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  lb. all-purpose potatoes, cut into quarters
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  In shallow baking or roasting pan, thoroughly blend all ingredients, except potatoes.  Add potatoes and turn to coat thoroughly.  Bake, stirring occasionally, for 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown.  Garnish, if desired, with chopped parsley.  Makes about 8 servings.  Also terrific with Lipton onion recipe soup mix.

name: MILLION DOLLAR PIE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. flour
4  Tbsp. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  medium size whipped topping
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt margarine in pie pan; mix in flour, 4 tablespoons sugar and half of nuts.  Spread with fingers to fit pan.  Bake at 350° until golden brown; cool crust.

name: CHUCK ROAST
ingredients:
4  lb. chuck roast
crushed garlic
salt
black pepper
red pepper
soy sauce
oil
flour
preparation: Stuff roast with crushed garlic, salt and black and red pepper. Plenty of salt on outside (this makes it brown nicely). Marinate overnight in a baking plastic bag with soy sauce.  Take out of plastic bag.  Brown on all sides in an iron pot (no flour). Cover and cook on low heat 3 to 4 hours.  Take out roast and thicken gravy with a little flour.  Soy sauce mixture can be frozen and used over in the plastic bag.

name: YUM YUM CAKE
ingredients:
1 blue  box Sun-Maid Muscat raisins
2  c. water
1/2  c. Crisco
1  c. water
4  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. cloves
1  Tbsp. baking soda in 2 Tbsp. warm water
preparation: Boil raisins in 2 cups water for 15 minutes.  Add Crisco; cool.  Add 1 cup water.  Mix with dry ingredients.  Add baking soda.  Flour and grease pans.  Makes 2 square or loaf pans or 1 Bundt and loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CRUNCHY FUDGE CRISPIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
45  large marshmallows
1 6  oz. pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla extract
4  c. oven toasted rice cereal
preparation: In a large saucepan over low heat, melt butter and marshmallows.  Remove from heat; add chips and vanilla, stirring until melted.  Stir in cereal.  Turn into lightly buttered 8 inch pan.  Chill.  Cut into bars.  Store covered at room temperature.

name: FARMER'S PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
4  pork chops
1  clove garlic, chopped
4  potatoes, sliced
2  large onions, sliced
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. sour cream
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  c. flour
preparation: Trim fat from chops and roll in flour. Brown chops in garlic in hot fat over medium heat. Season with salt and pepper. Place sliced potatoes in baking pan; top with pork chops. Separate onion slices into rings and lay over chops. Blend in sour cream and mustard. Pour over top. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Makes 4 servings.

name: LAKE EUFAULA PUNCH
ingredients:
juice from 1 dozen lemons
1  c. honey
1/5  gin
preparation: Dissolve lemon juice and honey.  Add gin. Put in crock and let stand overnight.   (Leave lemon rinds in mixture.) Next morning squeeze rinds and strain.  Makes about 1/5 and a half.  Serve in old fashion glasses over shaved ice.

name: HOT MILK SPONGE CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1 3/4  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. hot milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Beat eggs 1 minute.  Add sugar; beat  15  minutes.  Add flour and milk alternately.  Add vanilla.  Mix  baking  powder with tablespoon flour and add last.  Makes 2 layers.

name: SAUSAGE AND CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
Jesse Jones hot sausage
Cheddar cheese or nacho cheese soup
tortilla chips (Tostitos)
crushed red pepper (optional)
preparation: Fry sausage. Drain grease. Add soup. Add 1 can water (less water to make thicker). Simmer.

name: EASY CHICKEN THIGHS
ingredients:
6  chicken thighs
3  Tbsp. butter
3  chicken bouillon cubes
garlic powder to taste
preparation: Brown chicken thighs in melted butter.  Add water, bouillon cubes and garlic powder.  Simmer for 45 minutes on low heat.

name: COLD CORN SALAD
ingredients:
2  doz. ears corn, cut from cob
2  large heads cabbage, shredded
8  peppers, chopped
4  onions, chopped
4  lb. sugar (9 c.)
1  tsp. black pepper
2  tsp. celery seed
2  tsp. turmeric
4  tsp. salt
4  tsp. mustard
4  tsp. ground mustard
1  pt. water
2  qt. vinegar
preparation: Boil 30 minutes.  Put in pint jars and seal.

name: PAN FRIED BARBECUED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  frying chicken, cut up
1  can tomato soup, undiluted
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped celery
3  tsp. garlic salt
3  Tbsp. prepared mustard
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
few drops Tabasco sauce
preparation: Brown unfloured chicken in frying pan.  An electric frying pan is nice to use with this recipe.  Add barbecue sauce which has previously been mixed in a bowl.  Cook slowly until chicken and celery are well done.

name: CRUNCHY FUDGE SANDWICHES
ingredients:
6  oz. butterscotch morsels
1/2  c. peanut butter
4  c. kelloggs rice krispies cereal
6  oz. semi sweet chocolate morsels
1/2  c. sifted confectionary sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. water
1-8 oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  1/2 loaves bread
melted butter
preparation: Cut crusts off about1 1/2 loaves bread.  Roll slices of bread flat with rolling pin.  Spread each piece with about 1 teaspoon cream cheese mixture; roll up.  Dip in melted butter, then sugar and cinnamon mixture.  Bake 400° for 10 minutes.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. granulated sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
3  cans biscuits, cut in quarters
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Put granulated sugar and cinnamon in bag.  Shake biscuits (quartered) in bag.  Layer biscuits in tube pan.  Pour extra sugar/cinnamon mixture over biscuits in pan.  In a saucepan, mix brown sugar and butter for 1 minute.  Pour mixture over biscuits as you layer them in tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  To serve, dump out of pan onto plate.

name: ARTICHOKE NIBBLES
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  jar marinated artichoke hearts
1  small onion, finely chopped
2  cloves garlic, finely chopped
4  eggs (extra large)
1/2  c. fine, dry bread crumbs
1/4  tsp. each:  white pepper, oregano and Tabasco sauce
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese (2 c.)
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
preparation: Drain marinade from 1 jar artichokes into a small frypan. Drain the other jar.  Chop artichokes fine, discarding any hard pieces; set aside.  Add onion and garlic to marinade and saute until limp.  Drain off excess marinade.

name: GOLDEN STUFFED POTATOES
ingredients:
6  large potatoes
4  Tbsp. butter
2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. chopped green onions
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Bake potatoes at 400° for 1 hour, or until done.

name: SWEET SOUR CHICKEN(Gets Raves Everytime)
ingredients:
4  to 6 skinless, boneless chicken breasts
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Russian dressing
1 (8 oz.)  jar apricot preserves
1  envelope onion soup mix
1 large  can pineapple chunks, drained
2  green peppers, cut into large pieces
preparation: Lightly brown chicken breasts and place into casserole dish. Mix dressing, preserves and onion soup mix together and pour over chicken.  Cover and bake 45 to 50 minutes at 370°.  Add pineapple chunks and green pepper.  Cover and bake at 375° for 30 minutes longer.  Serve over pasta.  Enjoy!

name: WATER CHESTNUT SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. chicken stock
2  Tbsp. low sodium soy sauce
1/4  c. additional chicken broth
2  cans (5 oz.) water chestnuts, drained and sliced
1  Tbsp. dried minced onion
2  Tbsp. pimento, chopped
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Combine stock, soy sauce, water chestnuts, onion and pimento in saucepan; set aside.  Combine cornstarch and cold water to make a paste; add to liquid.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickened.  Makes 3 cups.

name: QUICK UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/8  tsp. ground cinnamon
1 (8 oz.)  can pineapple slices, drained
2  Tbsp. chopped pecans
7  maraschino cherries
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. yellow cake mix
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Grease sides of an an 8-inch cast-iron skillet.  Melt butter in skillet; sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon.  Cut 3 pineapple slices in half; arrange whole slices in center of brown sugar mixture and place half slices around it.  Arrange pecans and cherries over the top.  Set skillet aside.  Prepare cake mix according to package directions and stir in vanilla.  Spoon batter into skillet over pineapple slices.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until done.  Immediately invert cake onto serving plate.

name: CHERRY DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  can crushed pineapple with juice
1/2  stick melted margarine
1  yellow cake mix
1  stick margarine
chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix melted margarine, pie filling and undrained pineapple in large baking dish.  Sprinkle cake mix evenly over top (do not mix).  Thinly slice 1 stick of margarine and place over cake mix (close together).  Cover with nuts, if desired.  Bake for 1 hour in a 400° oven.

name: GRATED PUMPKIN BREAD(Yield: 1 Loaf)
ingredients:
1  c. raisins
1/4  c. water
3  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. oil
2 1/2  c. grated raw pumpkin
1  tsp. vanilla
2 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. mace
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Cover raisins with water to plump.  Beat eggs thoroughly and mix in sugar, oil, pumpkin and vanilla.  Sift together remaining ingredients.  Mix into pumpkin mixture, beating well.  Drain raisins and stir into the batter; pour into greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until toothpick comes out clean.  Cool on rack for 15 minutes before turning out of pan.

name: PERFECT POT ROAST
ingredients:
4 to 5  lb. beef rump roast
2  Tbsp. salad oil
2  Tbsp. butter or regular margarine
1  small onion, sliced
1  clove garlic, crushed
1  tsp. dried thyme leaves
1  tsp. dried marjoram leaves
1  bay leaf
8  whole black peppers
1  tsp. salt
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed beef broth, undiluted (1 1/2 c.)
8  halved, pared carrots (1 lb.)
12  small onions, peeled
1  sprig parsley
3  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Wipe pot roast with damp paper towels.  In hot oil and butter in 5-quart Dutch oven or heavy kettle, over medium heat, brown roast along with sliced onion (onion browns and gives a good dark color and rich flavor to pan drippings), turning roast with two wooden spoons, until well browned on all sides, 25 minutes in all. Slow browning gives the meat and gravy a better flavor and color.

name: THE BEST "NO BAKE" COOKIE RECIPE YOU'LL EVER HAVE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. milk
3  c. oatmeal
1  c. coconut or peanuts
preparation: Bring sugar, cocoa, shortening and milk to boil; boil for 2 minutes.  In a bowl, mix oatmeal and coconut or pecans.  Mix all ingredients and drop on wax paper.

name: SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
12  to 14 wings
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. cornstarch
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  beaten egg
1/4  c. chicken broth
1/4  c. water
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1  tsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. Accent (optional)
preparation: Beat egg.  Mix cornstarch and garlic.  Heat the oil; dip wings into egg, then put in the cornstarch and garlic mixture.  Fry in oil.

name: PEANUT BUTTER KISSES
ingredients:
1  jar creamy peanut butter
1 1/4  c. granulated sugar
2  large eggs
48  Hershey Kisses
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Have cookie sheets ready.  With a wooden spoon, combine peanut butter, sugar and eggs.  With floured hands, roll into 1 1/4-inch balls.  Place 1 1/2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 12 to 14 minutes until appear dry and cracked. Remove and immediately place a Kiss in each.  Cool on sheet 1 to 2 minutes.

name: DIABETIC MILKSHAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. fresh or frozen unsweetened fruit
1/2  c. skim milk
3  pkg. Equal
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Combine  all ingredients in blender.  Process at medium speed until smooth.  Serve immediately.  Contains 80 calories per shake. Frozen fruit makes thicker shakes.

name: PEAS AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  lb. peas
2  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. shortening
1 1/3  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
4  eggs
2  tsp. butter
preparation: Heat peas in frypan with 2 cups water.  In heavy pan, heat together 1 cup water, salt and shortening.  When boiling, dump in flour and baking powder, mixed.  Beat over fire until stiff enough to come loose from sides of pan and all stick together.  Remove from fire; add eggs one at a time, beating in each egg well.  Drop by teaspoonful into boiling peas.  When all are in, dot with butter.  Cover and cook 12 minutes.  Serve at once.

name: SPINACH FANTASTIC
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. long grain and wild rice mix
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, thawed
2  c. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
1/4  c. butter, melted
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
3/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook rice according to package directions.  Press spinach between paper towels to remove excess moisture.  Combine rice, spinach and remaining ingredients.  Spoon into a lightly greased 2-quart shallow casserole dish.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: The Best Brownies
ingredients:
1/2  cup vegetable oil or melted butter
1  cup Sugar
1  teaspoon vanilla
2  eggs
1/2  cup unsifted all-purpose flour
1/3  cup cocoa powder
1/4  teaspoon baking powder
1/4  teaspoon salt
1/2  cup nuts (optional)
preparation: Blend oil, sugar and vanilla in a mixing bowl. Add eggs; beat well. Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt; gradually add to egg mixture until well blended. Stir in nuts. Spread in greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until brownie begins to pull away from edges of pan. Cool in pan. Frost if desired cut into squares. 16 brownies.

name: OLD-FASHIONED BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
4  c. soft bread crumbs
2  c. milk
1/4  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Place bread crumbs in buttered baking dish.  Set aside.  Scald milk and butter.  In large bowl, beat together eggs, sugar, cinnamon, raisins and salt.  Combine with milk and butter.  Stir well and pour over crumbs in baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out without any mixture on it.

name: BROCCOLI QUICH
ingredients:
1  c. Bisquick
1 1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
1/2  stick oleo or butter, melted
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  lb. pkg. thawed broccoli
preparation: Beat Bisquick, milk, eggs and oleo until blended together. Fold in cheeses and broccoli. Coat sides and bottom of 9 x 13 pan with a little oleo. Add mixture and bake at 350° about 1/2 hour or until side gets light brown and center is cooked. This is good warm or cold.

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
5  lb. potatoes
1  lb. bacon
1  large onion, diced
2  c. white vinegar
2  Tbsp. sugar or equivalent artificial sweetener
salt to taste
pepper to taste
preparation: Boil, peel and slice potatoes.  Add the diced onion; set aside.  Cut bacon into 1/2-inch squares and cook until crisp. When done, pour bacon and grease over top of potatoes and onion. Add salt and pepper to taste.  Mix about 2 tablespoons sugar with vinegar.  Add this sweet-sour mixture to potatoes and bacon and mix thoroughly.  After mixing, add more salt and pepper to taste, if desired.  Do not refrigerate!

name: BECHAMEL SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Rich Butter Sauce
1/2  c. cream
4  Tbsp. grated cheese
preparation: See recipe for Rich Butter Sauce.  Add cream and grated cheese with Rich Butter Sauce and let cook briefly together to blend thoroughly.

name: POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
5  medium potatoes
1  c. cream of chicken soup
1/2 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1  c. hard-cooked eggs, chopped
1  Tbsp. parsley
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook potatoes until almost done; dice.  Mix all other ingredients.  Put in a 2 or 3-quart casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SANGRIA
ingredients:
1  gal. red wine
1  qt. orange juice
2  oranges, sliced
1  qt. club soda
1/2  c. brandy
1  c. lemon juice
2  limes, sliced
preparation: Combine wine, brandy, orange juice and lemon juice in a punch bowl; mix well.  Add half of the fruit slices.  Chill for 1 hour. Add remaining fruit slices and club soda.

name: CHEESY HAM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
1  1/2 c . (6 oz.) Cheddar cheese, divided
1 1/2  c. ham, cubed
1 1/2  c. rotini noodles, cooked and drained
2  c. frozen broccoli flowerets, thawed
1/2  c. green bell pepper
1/2  c. red bell pepper
1/4  c. milk
3/4  c. seasoned croutons
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients, except 1/2 cup cheese and croutons.  Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese and croutons.  Bake 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BROWN SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs, well beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. Mapleine
2 3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
nuts (if desired)
preparation: Note:  Use ungreased cookie sheets.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
32  oz. spaghetti
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  cans cream of celery soup
2  cans nacho cheese or cheddar cheese soup
1 to 2  c. chicken or 2 (10 oz.) cans chicken
1  pkg. cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Cook spaghetti. Mix together soups, chicken and cooked spaghetti. Top with cheddar cheese and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: EGG ROLLS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  can water chestnuts, chopped
1  large onion
1/2  lb. bean sprouts
1  large egg
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1 to 2  pkg. egg roll wrappers
preparation: Let ingredients sit for half hour.

name: STUFFED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
3  pork chops, (1 1/4 to 1 1/2-inch thick) with pockets cut
3/4  c. toasted bread cubes (herb stuffing)
1/4  c. chopped apple, raw
1/4  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. raisins
1  Tbsp. melted butter
1  Tbsp. orange juice
1/8  tsp. salt
1/16  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Salt  and  pepper  pockets.  Toss  together bread cubes, apple,  cheese  and  raisins.  Combine  melted  butter,  orange juice,  salt  and  cinnamon.  Pour over bread fruit mixture and mix  gently.  Stuff  chops  and  close pockets with toothpicks. Place in  shallow  baking  pan.  Bake  at 350° for 1 1/4 hours. Cover lightly with foil and bake 15 minutes more.

name: EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 1/2  c. hot water
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs, beaten
preparation: Mix well.  In mixing bowl, beat eggs, then pour in hot water (hot water will cook eggs if not beaten well).  Pour into pie shell and bake at 300° for 30 to 40 minutes.  It will shake; it's usually done.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  egg, beaten
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1/2  c. chopped onion
Ritz crackers, crumbled
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into a casserole dish. Sprinkle crumbled crackers over top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. This can be frozen.

name: REBECCA SALAD
ingredients:
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip
12  oz. cottage cheese
1  box orange jello
1 small  can mandarin oranges
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1/2  pkg. mini marshmallows
preparation: Mix Cool Whip, jello and cottage cheese.  Mix well, then stir in all other ingredients.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. fresh corn
2  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. melted shortening
1 1/3  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of white pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients; pour into greased casserole.  Place casserole in pan of hot water in oven.  Bake in preheated 350° oven about 50 minutes.  Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

name: MARINATED TORTELLINI
ingredients:
1  pkg. tortellini (with meat fillings)
1  pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
parsley flakes
preparation: Cook tortellini; drain and cool.  Mix as directed the Italian dressing.  Pour dressing, Parmesan cheese and parsley flakes in with tortellini.  Add salt and pepper.  Stir and chill.

name: PIMENTO CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
8  oz. extra sharp cheese
1 small  jar pimentos
2 to 3  Tbsp. Dukes mayonnaise
2  tsp. granulated sugar
salt
pepper
preparation: Grate cheese and put aside. Mash pimentos with fork into very small pieces. Drain juice. Mix cheese and pimentos, then add mayonnaise and sugar. Salt and pepper to taste.

name: BUTTER PECAN COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
2/3  c. brown sugar
1  egg
2  c. all-purpose flour
pecan halves
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Blend in egg. Stir together flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt.  Stir into creamed mixture. Chill 1 hour.  Form into 1-inch balls. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten in one direction with fork tines. Top each with a pecan half.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Makes 4 dozen cookies.

name: GINGER KRINKLES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. molasses
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cloves
pinch of salt
preparation: Cream together shortening and sugar.  Mix in egg, then molasses.  Add flour mixture with spices, soda and salt.  Form ball of dough the size of a walnut, roll in sugar.  Place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Cookies will look too soft but they cool to be just right.  Cool on pan for 1 to 2 minutes, then move to a rack.

name: LOW-FAT SEAFOOD SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. "Sea Legs" or cooked shrimp
4  oz. plain nonfat yogurt
2  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. dry dill
1  tsp. extra virgin olive oil
1/2  peeled, seeded and grated cucumber, dried on paper towels
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  Tbsp. small capers
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl.  Serve salad in tomato cups or on a bed of romaine lettuce.  Serves 4.

name: MELTING MOMENTS
ingredients:
1  c. soft butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. powdered sugar
2 1/4  c. flour
3/4  c. nuts, chopped fine
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.

name: CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP
ingredients:
chicken pieces
2  qt. water
2  to 3 carrots, diced
2  to 3 potatoes, diced
2  to 3 ribs celery, diced
1  small onion, diced
parsley
salt and pepper to taste
cayenne pepper
1  pkg. no-yolk noodles
preparation: Cook chicken in water until tender.  Remove meat from bones. Add vegetables, seasonings and noodles.  Simmer until done.  Add water as needed.

name: BEEF AND CABBAGE DINNER
ingredients:
1  tsp. oleo
4 to 5  c. cabbage, coarsely shredded
1  medium onion, chopped
at least 3 c. thinly sliced potatoes
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. caraway seed
1  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Melt oleo in large skillet.  Add cabbage and onion, mixing well.  Arrange potatoes over cabbage; sprinkle with caraway seed. Crumble beef over potatoes; sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Pour tomato sauce over all and cover skillet.  Cook over low heat until meat and potatoes are done, about 30 minutes.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1 small  can mandarin oranges, drained well
1 small  pkg. orange jello
1  small container cottage cheese (small curd)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together; mix well.

name: 5 BEAN SOUP(Very Hearty)
ingredients:
1/2  c. dried black beans
1/2  c. dried red kidney beans
1/2  c. dried white navy beans
1/2  c. dried black-eyed peas
1/2  c. dried baby lima beans
3/4  lb. andouille (spicy New Orleans sausage)
1  medium smoked ham hock (10 oz.)
4  c. water
1  large carrot, broken in several pieces
3  large celery ribs, broken in large pieces
3  parsley sprigs
1  very large onion, chopped coarsely
1/2  c. olive oil
2  finely chopped garlic cloves
1  bay leaf
2 1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. paprika
2  tsp. cumin
2  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. black pepper
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. chopped canned tomatoes (in paste)
2  c. beef stock
1  tsp. red wine vinegar
preparation: Place all beans (except limas) in bowl and cover with water. Soak overnight.  Soak limas separately.  Cover ham hock and sausage with water and boil.  Add carrot, celery and parsley. Simmer 1 hour, but remove sausage after 15 minutes. Set aside. Saute onion in olive oil. Add garlic and set aside. Drain and remove grease for hock water.  Discard veggies.  Remove meat from hock and chop coarsely.  Dispose of skin and bone.  Drain mixed beans and put in a large pot.  Measure degreased water and add water to make 4 cups.  Pour over beans.  Boil.  Add onion-garlic mixture.  Simmer; add spices.  Simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  Add tomatoes, beef stock and lima beans.  Simmer another 30 minutes. Cut sausage into 1/4-inch rings.   Add to soup with ham and vinegar. Simmer 10 minutes more. Serve!  Very good.  Hot.  Good Tex-Mex!

name: FIESTA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
8  oz. bow tie noodles
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach, thawed
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. picante sauce
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
1 (8 oz.)  can corn, drained
preparation: Cook and drain noodles.  Squeeze dry and chop spinach.  Brown ground beef and drain.  Add picante sauce, onion, tomato sauce, salt and oregano; mix well.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 1 minute.  Remove from heat and mix in noodles.  Place 1/2 mixture into 13 x 9 baking dish.  Cover with spinach.  Top with remaining mixture.  Sprinkle with corn.  Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.  Cover with cheese and bake until cheese is melted. Garnish with sour cream.  Makes 8 servings.

name: QUAKER'S BEST OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. (2 1/2 sticks) margarine, softened
3/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
3  c. Quaker Oats (quick or old-fashioned, uncooked)
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Beat in egg and vanilla.  Add combined flour, baking soda, salt and spices; mix well.  Stir in oats.  Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 8 to 9 minutes for a chewy cookie, 10 to 11 minutes for a crisp cookie.  Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet.   Remove to wire rack.  Makes about 4 1/2 dozen.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter (2 sticks)
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
3  c. plain flour
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. soda
preparation: Cream butter and 2 cups of the sugar.  Add egg yolks.  Mix soda to sour cream, then add to butter, sugar and egg yolks.  Mix thoroughly, then add flour.  Beat egg whites umtil they hold a peak.  Beat in the additional cup of sugar, then fold into mixture.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.  Use a large tube pan.

name: Lentil And Brown Rice Soup
ingredients:
8  c. chicken broth
1 1/2  c. lentils
1  c. brown rice
2  lb. can tomatoes, drained, chopped, reserving juice
3  carrots, chopped
1  onion, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped
3  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. dried basil
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1/4  tsp. dried thyme
1  bay leaf
2  Tbsp. cider vinegar or to taste
salt and pepper
preparation: In large kettle, combine the broth, lentils, rice, tomatoes, reserved juice, carrots, onion, celery, garlic, basil, oregano, thyme and bay leaf; bring to boil and simmer the mixture, covered, stirring occasionally for 45 to 50 minutes or until rice and lentils are tender.  Discard bay leaf and season with vinegar, salt and pepper to taste.  Good with cut up smoked sausage added last 10 minutes.  Makes about 1 pound.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  chopped onion
1  c. ketchup
1  lb. hamburger meat
1 to 1 1/2  cans spaghetti with cheese
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Saute  green  pepper  and onion.  Brown hamburger meat; drain off  fat.  Add  peppers  and onions to ground beef.  Add ketchup and  spaghetti;  mix well.  Spoon into casserole dish and top with cheese.  Cook  30  to 40 minutes on 350° or until cheese begins to bubble.

name: SPINACH PATTIES
ingredients:
2  lb. spinach, cooked, chopped and well drained
2  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. horseradish
2  Tbsp. bacon bits
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. nutmeg, ground
16  crackers, crumbled
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Make into patties and brown in butter 2 minutes on each side.  Yields 12 patties.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1/3  c. melted butter
1/2  c. Bisquick
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or longer.

name: CARROT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. carrots, sliced and cooked until tender, drain
1/4  lb. butter or oleo
1/4  lb. Velveeta cheese
20  Ritz crackers
preparation: Melt butter and cheese together. Pour over the carrots. Sprinkle with Ritz crackers, crumbled.  Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can chunk pineapple
1  can fruit cocktail
1  can mandarin oranges
2  bananas
1/2 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
preparation: Drain fruit; save pineapple juice.  Mix pudding with pineapple juice to make a thin dressing.  Add fruit and chill.

name: PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE (FOR HAM)
ingredients:
2  c. crushed pineapple
1/2  c. sugar
3 large  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. grated cheese (Cheddar, Colby, Longhorn)
preparation: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes. Serve hot. Let set to firm up.

name: APPLE JELLY
ingredients:
4  c. apple juice
2  Tbsp. strained lemon juice (if desired)
3  c. Domino granulated sugar
preparation: Add apple juice and sugar and stir well.  Boil over high heat above the boiling point of water or until jelly mixture sheets from a spoon.  Remove from heat.  Skim off foam quickly.  Pour jelly immediately into hot, sterilized glasses and seal with paraffin.  Makes 4 or 5 glasses.

name: BAKED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach souffle
24  medium mushroom caps
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Thaw spinach and spoon into mushroom caps.  Arrange on baking sheet.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.  Serve hot.  "Simple but so good."

name: SAVORY BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  cup instant potatoes
1/3  cup Parmesan cheese
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. butter
2  to 3 lbs. chicken breasts cut up or 4 boneless halved breasts.
preparation: Heat oven to 400° and place a 13x9 baking pan in oven with the butter.  In a bag, mix the potatoes and cheese together.  Dip the chicken pieces in beaten eggs then place in bag and shake until coated.  Bake at 400° for 45 to 60 minutes.

name: CRUSTY POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  large baking potatoes (approximately)
water
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1  c. milk
2  large onions, chopped
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
4  eggs, lightly beaten
paprika
preparation: Peel the  potatoes  and shred (you should have 8 cups). Add enough  water to cover potatoes, preventing discoloration until all  are  shredded.  Drain potatoes, saving 1 cup of the water. Heat  the  water, 2 tablespoons of the butter and milk to just under  boiling.  Pour  over  potatoes and stir in the onion, salt, pepper and eggs.

name: FROZEN PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. cherry Kool-Aid
1  pkg. orange Kool-Aid
3  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. real lemon juice
3 (10 oz.)  bottles 7-Up
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
3  bananas, pulverized in blender
2  qt. water
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Stir every hour after putting in freezer.  Set out at room temperature.  Allow 5 hours thaw time.

name: ROASTED RED POTATOES
ingredients:
potatoes
2 to 3  Tbsp. oil
2  cloves garlic
salt and pepper
butter
preparation: Quarter potatoes (do not peel), one or two per person.  In a 9 x 13-inch roasting pan, add the oil and garlic and toss to coat potatoes. Add salt and pepper to taste. Bake, uncovered, for about 40 to 50 minutes, turning potatoes once or twice to brown. When done, dot with butter.

name: RACCOON
ingredients:
1  raccoon
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
2  cloves garlic
1  Tbsp. red pepper
preparation: Clean raccoon.  Parboil in clear water and red pepper.  Cook until tender.  Remove from water; season with salt, pepper and garlic (diced).  Bake in oven at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CUSTARD RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. scalded milk (let cool and remove scum)
8  Tbsp. cooked rice
1/3  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
cinnamon and sugar mix
preparation: Beat eggs well.  Add sugar, milk, vanilla and rice.  Pour mixture into a 2-quart Pyrex dish; sprinkle top with cinnamon and sugar mix.  Place Pyrex dish in a pan with hot water.  Bake in a 350° oven for about 25 to 30 minutes.  Try inserting knife at 25 minutes; when it comes out clean, it's done.  Don't overbake.

name: FETTUCINI
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter or margarine
4  eggs
1/4  c. whipping cream
8  oz. bacon, cooked and cut up
1  lb. fettucini or linguine
1  c. Parmesan cheese
pepper
1/4  c. parsley
preparation: Let butter or margarine, eggs and cream stand at room temperature for 2 to 3 hours.  Cook bacon in skillet until browned.  Remove and drain on paper toweling.  Beat together eggs and cream just until blended.  Cook pasta until al dente (tender), about 15 minutes.  Drain thoroughly; do not rinse.  Toss pasta with butter.  Pour egg mixture over and toss until pasta is well coated.  Add bacon, cheese, pepper and parsley; toss to mix. Serves 6.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  can cherry pie filling
1  box lemon or yellow cake mix
1  stick margarine plus 2 Tbsp.
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan; spread pineapple evenly.  Cover with cherries.  Sprinkle cake mix over fruit.  Sprinkle melted butter over cake mix.  Add nuts if wanted.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: DUTCH SPINACH SALAD
ingredients:
3 to 4  slices bacon, diced
1  egg, slightly beaten
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
water
4  c. torn spinach greens
1/2  small onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
hard-cooked eggs, sliced
preparation: In a small frying pan, cook bacon until crisp; do not drain. In a 1 cup measure, place egg, sugar, vinegar and enough water to make 3/4 cup.  Pour over bacon and grease.  Cook, stirring constantly, until dressing thickens.  Season to taste.  Pour hot dressing over greens and onion.  Toss; garnish with egg slices. Serve immediately.  Yields 4 servings.

name: NEIMAN-MARCUS CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
2  eggs
1  stick melted oleo
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  box powdered sugar
2  eggs
preparation: Mix together cake mix, 2 eggs and oleo.  Put in 9 x 13-inch buttered dish.  Mix together cream cheese, sugar and 2 eggs.  Pour over cake mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: SWEET-SOUR ITALIAN DRESSING
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. red wine vinegar
1  c. olive oil
2  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Blend in electric blender.  Serve at room temperature.

name: CHURCH PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  can mandarin oranges (don't drain)
1 large  can drained crushed pineapple
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1/4  c. lemon juice
coconut
preparation: Mix altogether, except coconut.  Pour into two graham cracker crusts.  Put coconut on top and chill.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
3  c. sifted flour
1/2  pt. sour cream
1/4  tsp. soda
2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. almond
preparation: Eggs, sour cream and butter should be at room temperature.

name: CORN AND ONION CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3 1/2  oz. French-fried onions
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  tsp. margarine
1  lb. can cream-style corn
2  tsp. chopped pimento
1  egg, slightly beaten
preparation: Crush half the onions.  Saute green pepper in margarine until soft.  Add corn, pimento, egg and crushed onions.  Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until firm. Sprinkle remaining onions on top.  Bake 5 minutes longer.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER BARS
ingredients:
graham crackers
1  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  c. coconut
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. graham crackers, crushed
preparation: Place a layer of graham crackers on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Leave crackers whole.  Melt butter and add sugar, milk and egg. Cook until it comes to a full boil, stirring constantly.  Pour over crackers.  Add coconut, nuts and crushed graham crackers.

name: FRENCH FRIED BATTER
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  egg
1  tsp. baking powder
3  Tbsp. oil
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. ice water
preparation: Beat together all ingredients.  Chill 1 hour.  Dip shrimp, fish or meat in batter and deep fry in oil.  Drain and serve at once.

name: SWEETENED CONDENSED MILK
ingredients:
1/3  c. plus 2 Tbsp. evaporated milk
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. butter
preparation: Mix together in heavy saucepan. Heat until butter and sugar have melted. Cool and use. Makes 15 ounces.

name: NO KNEAD "FRENCH" BREAD
ingredients:
1 cake or  pkg. yeast
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. shortening, melted
1 1/2  c. very warm water
1 1/2  tsp. salt
4  c. sifted flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water in a very large bowl. Dissolve sugar and salt in 1 cup warm water.  Add to yeast mixture and mix well.  Add shortening.  Add flour and mix well.  Stir 5 times, 10 minutes apart.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
32  oz. pkg. frozen hash browns
1  small sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
12  oz. grated cheese
1/2  onion, chopped
1/2  stick melted butter
preparation: Thaw hash browns, then mix all ingredients together in a large bowl and stir until potatoes are well coated.  Pour into 3-quart casserole dish sprayed with Pam.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered.

name: CANDIED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  stick margarine
1  c. cold water
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix white sugar and flour, then mix all other ingredients. Bring to a boil and cook until thick.  Pour over cooked sliced sweet potatoes and bake 30 minutes at 350°, until candied.

name: NO BAKE BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1 medium  pkg. chopped nuts
1 small  bottle candied cherries
2  sticks margarine
2  eggs
4  to 5 large bananas
2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Melt 1 stick margarine.  Mix nuts and graham cracker crumbs. Place in 8 x 12-inch pan.  Mix eggs, sugar and 1 stick butter. Place on top of graham cracker mixture.  Place crushed pineapple (drained) on top of egg mixture.  Layer bananas on top of that. Cover with Cool Whip.  Garnish with nuts and cherries.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix
1 large  pkg. frozen strawberries (save 1/3 c. for frosting)
2/3  c. Wesson oil
4  eggs
1  pkg. strawberry Jello, 4 oz.
preparation: Beat eggs, add oil, then cake mix and Jello.  Beat well, then add strawberries and beat well.  Bake at 325 degrees until done. Bake in 3 layers.

name: APRICOT MOUSSE
ingredients:
1 (17 oz.)  can unpeeled apricot halves, drained and mashed
1/2  c. sifted powdered sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. almond extract
1  c. whipping cream
preparation: Advance preparation:  Combine apricots, sugar, vanilla, extract and dash of salt.  Whip cream until custardlike; fold into apricot mixture.  Turn into a 3-cup refrigerator tray; freeze until firm, about 4 hours.  Makes about 3 cups.

name: GRANDMA'S SALMON AND RICE
ingredients:
1  can salmon, deboned
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. bacon drippings
1  medium onion, chopped
salt and pepper
2  cups cooked rice
preparation: Heat skillet on med-high heat until hot. Add bacon drippings and eggs. Mix well. Add salmon. Mix and separate salmon well. Add onion. Salt and pepper to taste. Turn heat down to med-low and simmer for about 15 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent scorching. Serve with, or over rice.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. cooked macaroni
4  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
2  stalks celery, chopped fine
1/2  medium onion, chopped fine
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and chill.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: DOG BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. whole wheat or all-purpose flour
2  c. cornmeal
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese or substitute 3/4 c. peanut butter
3/4  c. vegetable oil or bacon grease
1/2  c. water or beef bouillon
1  egg
preparation: Combine flour, cornmeal and cheese in medium bowl, then stir in oil until mixture is crumbly.  Stir in water until well mixed. On floured surface use your hands, form with your hands and then use cookie cutter, transfer to ungreased baking sheet.  Bake at 300° for 40 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  pkg. frozen broccoli
1  small tube garlic cheese
1 small  stick Velveeta cheese
1/2  c. bread crumbs or cracker crumbs
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. evaporated milk
preparation: Cook broccoli as directed on package, then drain.  Melt 3/4 stick of garlic cheese, 3/4 stick of Velveeta cheese, mushroom soup and milk in saucepan or double boiler; stir until mixed well. Add this to the broccoli and top with crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.  This serves 12.

name: SHRIMP OR CHICKEN CURRY(Microwave)
ingredients:
4  c. cooked, cleaned shrimp or chicken, cut up
4  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1/2  c. minced onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  Tbsp. curry powder
6  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  c. chicken broth or 1 chicken bouillon cube dissolved in 1 c. water
1  c. milk
1  apple, peeled and chopped
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Arrange chicken in pan.  Cover and microwave at 100% power for 20 to 25 minutes.  Melt butter at 100% power for 1 minute.  Saute onion, celery and curry powder in melted butter 2 to 3 minutes at 100% power.  Blend in flour and seasonings.  Cook at 70% power for 1 minute or until mixture is smooth and bubbly.  Stir in chicken broth and milk.  Microwave at 70% power for 3 to 5 minutes, until boiling.  Stir every 2 minutes.  Add chopped apple.  Add chicken and lemon juice.  Microwave at 70% power for 2 to 4 minutes. Serve over rice with condiments such as chopped tomatoes, raisins, coconut, pineapple chunks, chopped hard cooked eggs and French fried onion rings.  Serves 8.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
5 to 6  c. broccoli
1/2  c. sunflower seeds
1/4  c. red onion, diced
1  c. golden raisins
1/4 to 1/2  c. Bac*Os
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
4  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  This recipe is best served the same day.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
2  c. cooked chicken, diced
8  oz. spaghetti, cooked
1 small  can pimento, diced
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. grated American cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix  all ingredients and bake at 250° for approximately 1 hour.  Stir  occasionally.  Milk  or  cream may be added if dish seems too dry.

name: BROCCOLI AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
large pkg. frozen broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
Ritz crackers
Velveeta cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Prepare broccoli as directed. Put broccoli into 9 x 12 baking dish. Mix in cream of mushroom soup (undiluted). Cube 1 cup of Velveeta cheese and mix in. Crumble about 12 crackers into casserole and stir slightly. Crumble and top casserole with 20 crackers or until casserole is covered with crackers. Bake for 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

name: LEMON ROUNDS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. vegetable shortening
1  c. sugar
1  egg
2  Tbsp. grated lemon rind
1/2  c. finely chopped pecans
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Sift flour, baking soda and salt onto waxed paper.  Cream shortening with sugar until fluffy in a medium sized bowl; beat in egg, lemon juice and rind and pecans.  Add dry ingredients, blending to make a soft dough.  Shape into 2 long rolls; wrap in waxed paper.  Chill overnight.  To bake, slice dough 1/4-inch thick; place on cookie sheet.  Bake in moderate oven at 375° for 8 minutes or until golden around edges.  Remove from cookie sheet; cool completely on wire racks.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: HOT TACO DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
1 large  can Hormel no bean chili
2  cans mild chili peppers, chopped
1  can black olives, finely chopped
12  oz. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
10  oz. bag tortilla chips
preparation: A lasagna pan is good to use.  Preheat oven to 350°.

name: TURKEY BREAST(The Low-Fat Way)
ingredients:
turkey breast
sliced fresh pears (1 or 2)
1 small  bottle apple juice
preparation: Skin turkey breast.  Place in roaster.  Add pears.  Pour apple juice over all.  Cover.  Bake at 325° until done.  The broth makes delicious gravy.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. spaghetti
1  green pepper, chopped (not fine)
2  cucumbers, chopped (not fine)
1  1/2 tomatoes, chopped (not fine)
1  small red onion, chopped (not fine)
1/2  can McCormick salad toppings
12  oz. bottle Zesty Italian dressing
preparation: Break spaghetti into 3 pieces.  Drop into boiling water.  Cool and drain.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Refrigerate overnight before serving.

name: SURPRISE CHILI
ingredients:
1  tsp. oil
1  lb. lean ground beef
1 1/2  c. chopped onions
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (15 oz.)  can sauerkraut, drained
1 (15 oz.)  can pinto beans
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can low sodium beef broth
3 to 4  Tbsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat oil in 3-quart saucepan.  Brown meat, onions and garlic. Drain off fat.  Stir in remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low.  Simmer partially covered for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: SAN FRANCISCO FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
3  slices sour dough bread
2  eggs beaten
1/2  teaspoon vanilla extract
1  teaspoon sugar
1  tablespoon orange juice
2  tablespoons oil
2  ounces apple butter
powdered sugar
preparation: Combine eggs vanilla extract, sugar and  orange juice   Mix well.  Heat oil in skillet.  Dip bread slices into egg mixture. Fry in oil until lightly browned on each side.  Serve with syrup, powdered sugar and apple butter.

name: CHOCOLATE SODAS
ingredients:
2 to 3  Tbsp. chocolate syrup for each one
club soda, ginger ale or carbonated lemon-lime beverage
preparation: Place 2 to 3 tablespoons chocolate syrup in each tall glass. Fill each glass 1/2 full with chilled club soda or ginger ale or carbonated lemon-lime beverage.  Serve immediately with a straw.

name: FLOUR TORTILLAS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. cooking oil
2/3  c. boiling water
preparation: Combine dry ingredients.  Add oil and mix thoroughly.  Add hot water to form a dough.  Knead dough until smooth and elastic.  Form 12 balls from dough.  Roll balls into 6-inch round tortillas.  Cook tortillas on hot griddle (medium heat) until blisters form.  Turn tortilla over and cook opposite side for five seconds.

name: CHICKEN-FRIED ROUND STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. round steak (1/2 inch thick)
2  beaten eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
1  c. fine low-sodium bread crumbs or flour
1/4  c. unsalted fat
pepper
preparation: Pound steak thoroughly. Dip into egg mixed with milk, then into crumbs or flour. Brown on both sides in hot fat.  Season. Cover and cook over very low heat 45 minutes to 60 minutes. Serves 6.

name: FRESH PEACH PIE
ingredients:
4  c. fresh peaches
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  cooked pie crust or graham cracker crust
preparation: Mash half of peaches.  Add sugar, cornstarch and lemon juice. Cook until thick and clear.  Set aside to cool.  Slice remaining peaches and fold into cooled mixture.  Spoon into pie crust.  Top with Cool Whip.  Chill.

name: BANANA PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Mother S Marias cookies (butter cookies)
1/3  melted butter
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Grind cookies to powder.  Add melted butter and sugar.  Mix well and cover pie pan with cookies.  With spoon spread mixture until firm.  Freeze for 1 to 2 hours.

name: SHRIMP AND PASTA SALAD(4 Servings)
ingredients:
1/4  c. olive oil
3  Tbsp. distilled white vinegar
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh thyme  or 1 tsp. dried
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
3/4  lb. shelled cooked medium sized shrimp
1/2  lb. bow tie pasta, cooked
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen green peas, cooked
1  c. cherry tomatoes, halved
romaine lettuce leaves
preparation: Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, thyme, salt and pepper in large bowl.  Add shrimp, pasta, green peas and tomatoes to dressing.  Cover and let stand 1 hour, tossing occasionally. Serve on lettuce leaves.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BAKED HAM STRATA(Makes 8 Servings)
ingredients:
12  slices firm white bread
3  Tbsp. butter or oleo, softened
2 1/2  c. milk
5  large eggs
4  tsp. Dijon-style mustard
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground black pepper
3/4  lb. Swiss or Jarlsberg cheese, shredded
1/4  lb. baked or broiled ham, diced
3  green onions, trimmed, sliced and chopped
green onion curls (optional)
preparation: Toast bread and spread on one side of each with butter.  Cut toast into 3/4-inch pieces.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can LeSueur peas
1  can white Shoepeg corn
1  can French-style green beans
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
1/4  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped onion
Ritz cracker crumbs
grated cheese to cover
1  stick margarine
preparation: Drain vegetables.  Add soup, sour cream, 1/2 cup grated cheese, celery and onion; mix.  Sprinkle top with Ritz crackers and grated cheese.  Pour one stick of melted margarine on top. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 30 minutes.

name: PASTA IN A POT
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  garlic clove, chopped
8  oz. macaroni shells
1 1/2  lb. sliced Mozzarella
1 (14 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1 (30 oz.)  can mushrooms
salt, sugar and oregano to taste
1/2  pt. sour cream
preparation: Brown beef; drain off fat.  Add onion, garlic, spaghetti sauce, stewed tomatoes and undrained mushrooms.  Add spices.  Mix well.  Simmer 20 minutes.

name: MIXED VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (10 oz.) frozen mixed vegetables
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. grated cheese (Velveeta best)
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1  stick margarine, melted
1  stack butter crackers (Waverly or Escort, etc.)
preparation: Cook vegetables until tender.  Drain.  Pour into greased casserole dish.  Mix together mayo, cheese and onion.  Spread over vegetables.  Mix crushed cracker crumbs with margarine and sprinkle over top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. chopped chicken, cooked
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped apple
1  c. green grape halves
Kraft real mayonnaise
preparation: Combine chicken, celery, fruit and enough mayonnaise to mix well.

name: BUTTER BROWNED POTATOES
ingredients:
3  large potatoes
1/4  c. butter, melted
salt and pepper
preparation: Peel potatoes; cut each into 6 slices; dry.  Coat in butter on cookie sheet.  Add salt and pepper.  Bake covered at 350° in single layer 20 minutes.  Uncover, baste and bake 30 minutes more.

name: YOGURT SIP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peach slices
1  c. plain yogurt (8 oz.)
1/4  c. peach brandy or other brandy
1/4  c. light rum
1  Tbsp. honey
ground nutmeg
preparation: Let peaches stand at room temperature 10 minutes.  In a blender container, combine yogurt, brandy, rum and honey.  Add undrained peaches.  Cover; blend until smooth.  Pour into glasses; top with nutmeg.  Makes 5 (4-ounce) servings.

name: CAESAR SALAD WITH SOURDOUGH CROUTONS
ingredients:
1/2  c. fresh lemon juice
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
4  garlic cloves, coarsely chopped
1/2  tsp. hot pepper sauce (such as Tabasco sauce)
1  c. olive oil
