2  large heads romaine lettuce, torn into bite size pieces
1  red onion, thinly sliced
Sourdough Croutons
1  c. freshly grated Parmesan cheese (about 3 oz.)
preparation: Blend first 4 ingredients in processor or blender. With machine running, gradually add oil in thin steady stream.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Prepare 1 day ahead.  Cover and chill. Bring to room temperature before serving.  Combine lettuce, onion and croutons in a large bowl. Toss with enough dressing to season to taste.  Sprinkle with cheese and serve.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CHEESY BARS
ingredients:
1  egg
1  box cake mix (2-layer)
1  stick margarine
2  eggs
8  oz. cream cheese
1  lb. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix egg, cake mix and margarine until crumbly.  Press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Set aside.  Beat 2 eggs, cream cheese and powdered sugar.  Pour over crumbs in cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. powdered sugar
4  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. crunchy peanut butter
12  oz. Cool Whip
graham cracker or pie crust shell
preparation: Mix cream cheese, sugar and peanut butter.  Fold in Cool Whip. Pour in graham cracker or pie crust shell.  Refrigerate.

name: SAUSAGE GRAVY
ingredients:
1  (1 lb.) roll sausage
3  Tbsp. flour
milk
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. sage
preparation: Brown sausage in skillet.  Chop sausage into small chunks. After browning sausage, drain fat, reserving 3 tablespoons of fat. Add the flour; brown flour and fat.  Add drained sausage.  After mixture has been browned, gradually add milk; simmer until thickened.  Add pepper and sage while gravy is simmering.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. margarine or butter, softened
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. mashed ripe bananas (3 or 4 medium)
1/3  c. water
1 2/3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2 to 1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease bottom only of loaf pan, 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2 or 9 x 5 x 3-inches.  Mix sugar and margarine in a 2 1/2-quart bowl.  Stir in eggs until blended.  Add bananas and water; beat 30 seconds.  Stir in remaining ingredients except nuts just until moistened; stir in nuts.  Pour into pan.  Bake until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean (8-inch loaf 1 1/4 hours or 9-inch loaf 55 to 60 minutes).  Cool 5 minutes.  Loosen sides of loaf from pan; remove from pan.  Cool completely before slicing.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix (no pudding in the mix)
2 heaping  tsp. sour cream
1 small  box vanilla pudding
3/4  c. water
1/2  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs
1  small container chocolate jimmies (1/2 c.)
1 small  pkg. chocolate chips (1 c.)
preparation: Mix the first 6 ingredients for 2 minutes on medium speed. Add jimmies and chips by hand.  Pour into a 12-cup greased Bundt pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.  Cool on rack 15 to 20 minutes, then remove from pan.

name: TEXAS CORNBREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. cornbread stuffing mix (1 recipe made according to box)
16  oz. whole hog sausage (medium)
2  c. shallots
1 1/2  c. celery
1  c. onion
1  c. bell pepper
4  cans chicken broth
1  stick butter
1  Tbsp. poultry seasoning
1 1/2  Tbsp. cayenne pepper
1 1/2  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. parsley
preparation: In a frypan, add the butter, then add seasonings.  Saute until tender.  In the same frypan, fry and chop sausage until brown.  You can fix cornbread ahead of time.  In a large bowl, add all ingredients together.  Add the chicken broth.  Mix well and make sure it's good and moist.  Put in a large pan.  Bake at 350° for approximately 1 to 1 1/2 hours until firm and golden brown.  Serves 12.

name: IRISH STEW
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. bacon drippings
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  lb. lamb
1  lb. beef
2  c. water
3  carrots, sliced
2  or 3 potatoes, diced
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  medium onion, diced
3  Tbsp. parsley, chopped or 1 Tbsp. dried
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. each: dried marjoram, thyme and celery seed
1  bay leaf
preparation: Place flour and salt in a plastic bag.  Shake.  Cut meat in 2-inch pieces.  Add to mixture in the bag and shake well.  Brown flour coated meat in bacon drippings and oil in a large pot.  Add more oil if necessary.  Add the water, vegetables and seasonings to the browned meat.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer about an hour.

name: CRAB MEAT APPETIZER
ingredients:
2 to 3  pkg. imitation crab meat
1  to 2 onions, chopped
3  to 4 celery sticks, finely chopped
mayonnaise
salt and pepper to taste
crackers of choice
preparation: Chop crabmeat into pieces and place in bowl.  Add chopped onions and chopped celery.  Add enough mayonnaise to make moist. Add salt and pepper to taste.  Chill 30 minutes to 1 hour.  Serve with crackers/saltines.

name: ULTIMATE CHOCOLATE BROWNIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. baking cocoa
1/2  c. boiling water
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. coarsely chopped pecans
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2/3  c. margarine, melted, divided
2  c. sugar
1 1/3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chunks
preparation: Grease 13 x 9-inch pan.  Combine baking cocoa and baking soda. Blend in 1/3 cup melted margarine.  Add boiling water and stir until well blended.  Stir in sugar, eggs and remaining melted margarine.  Add flour, vanilla and salt.  Stir in pecans and chocolate chunks.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. boned chicken
3  hard-boiled eggs
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. celery, chopped
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1 large  pkg. potato chips
preparation: Crush chips in package and mix half of chips with other ingredients.  Sprinkle last half on top of casserole.  Bake for 15 minutes at 450°.

name: BLACK BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. beans
6  glasses water
4  cubes beef bouillon
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. onion powder
1  whole onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. olive oil
salt to taste
preparation: Wash beans, then place in pan to boil with plenty of water. Add onion powder, garlic powder and beef flavor bouillon cubes when beans are fully cooked.  Cut up onions into small pieces and fry in olive oil until lightly brown.   Pour over beans and boil again.  Add salt to taste.

name: LEMON CHIFFON PIE
ingredients:
1 large  Tbsp. cornstarch
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
3  eggs
1  tsp. lemon extract
1  pie shell
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. sugar or to taste
preparation: Bake pie shell and coat with margarine; set aside.  Separate yolks and whites of eggs.  Put whites in freezer part of refrigerator immediately and they will be cold enough to beat after other ingredients are mixed.  Beat other ingredients together.  Boil, stirring constantly; when thick, pour into pie shell.

name: ANGIE'S CHICKEN OR TUNA STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1/2 to 1  c. cooked rice
2  (4 oz.) tuna or chicken (or more)
1/2  c. chopped cooked broccoli, chopped celery, carrots, onions, cabbage or mushrooms
1  tsp. vegetable oil
1/4  c. each or more of whatever raw vegetable you like best
bouillon bits or beef cubes
soy sauce, seasoned salt or onion powder to taste (or whatever seasonings liked best)
preparation: Heat oil in wok  or  nonstick skillet.	Add meat, fresh vegetables.  Saute altogether  with  seasonings and serve over rice.  This is low calorie.

name: 7 LAYER BARS
ingredients:
1/2  stick sweet butter
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. coconut
1/2  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate pieces (6 oz.)
1/2  pkg. butterscotch pieces (6 oz.)
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Melt butter in oblong pan.  Place ingredients in order on top of each other.  Last, press walnuts down on other ingredients. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Cool in pan over metal rack.  Cut into bars.

name: ORANGE-CHAMPAGNE SWIZZLE
ingredients:
2  c. champagne or ginger ale
6  oz. frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
preparation: Mix champagne and orange juice and serve immediately.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. cornmeal
1  small onion, finely chopped (optional)
3/4  c. milk
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Mix dry ingredients; add onion, milk and egg.  Fry teaspoonfuls of batter in hot fat until golden brown.  Drain; serve hot.

name: CREAMY BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. broccoli
1  tsp. salt
1  can condensed mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. Bisquick mix
1/4  c. margarine
preparation: Cook broccoli with salt.  Heat oven to 400°.  Put cooked broccoli in ungreased casserole.  Spread the Cheddar cheese on top.  Mix the Bisquick mix with margarine until crumbly and sprinkle on top of broccoli.  Beat the soup with milk and pour over the top of it all.  Bake for 20 minutes uncovered or until golden brown.

name: CRISPY DRUMSTICKS(Low-Fat)
ingredients:
1/4  c. fine, dry breadcrumbs
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. onion powder
1/8  tsp. dried whole marjoram
1/8  tsp. dried whole thyme
1  egg white, lightly beaten
1  Tbsp. skim milk
8  chicken drumsticks, skinned (about 1 1/2 lb.)
vegetable cooking spray
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a small dish, stir well. Combine egg white and milk in a small bowl.  Dip each drumstick in milk mixture; dredge in breadcrumb mixture.  Place drumsticks in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until done.  Yield:  4 servings (196 calories per serving).  Fat:  5.8 grams per serving.

name: MOUSE SNACK
ingredients:
1  (2-inch) banana
crushed vanilla wafers
2  almond slices
peanut butter
2  raisins
1  chocolate chip
4  pretzel sticks
preparation: Completely cover the piece of banana with wafer crumbs.  Push the 2 almond slices into top of banana for the mouse's ears.  Use the peanut butter to "glue" on raisin eyes and a chocolate chip for the nose.  Stick pretzel sticks into each side of face for whiskers.

name: ZUCCHINI PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. buttermilk or country refrigerator rolls
2  zucchini
1  onion
3  oz. yellow or white cheese
2  Tbsp. margarine for saute
preparation: Separate rolls and press them out into a glass pie pan. Thinly slice the zucchini and onion.  Saute zucchini and onion ringlets in butter until about half done.  Put half the veggies into the pie pan crust.  Add half of the cheese; repeat.  Bake according to roll recipe (400° for 12 to 15 minutes).

name: ITALIAN NOODLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  cucumber, diced
1  green onion, diced
1  tomato, diced
1  lb. curly noodles
Italian salad dressing
preparation: Cook noodles; drain. Add cucumber, onion and tomato. Pour salad dressing over and stir all together.

name: CREAM CHEESE MINTS
ingredients:
3  oz. cream cheese
2 1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. flavoring (2 to 3 drops)
food coloring (2 to 3 drops)
preparation: Knead dough with powdered sugar; press in molds.  Dip in granulated sugar.

name: CHIPPED BEEF CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
3 or 4  oz. envelope dried beef (jar is too salty)
2 heaping  tsp. horseradish (less if desired)
preparation: Use a mixer to combine all ingredients.  Let it set a day or two.  Optional:  Roll in chopped pecans.

name: EASY DESSERT
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1 large  can cherry pie filling
1  box yellow cake mix
2  sticks margarine
nuts (optional)
preparation: In a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan, pour entire cans of pineapple and cherry pie filling.  Distribute over bottom of pan.  Sprinkle cake mix evenly on top of mixture.  Sprinkle nuts over this.  Cut up margarine in pats over entire mixture and bake for 50 minutes at 350°.

name: DINER MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. ground pork
3/4  c. instant oatmeal
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. tomato juice
1  onion, minced
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix beef, pork, oatmeal and eggs.  Blend in rest of ingredients.  Pack in 9 x 5-inch loaf pan, shaping into a rounded top.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Let stand 10 minutes before slicing.  Drain off any excess juice.  Serves 8.

name: FRENCH FRIED ONION RINGS
ingredients:
2  large onions, sliced
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
pinch of salt
1  beaten egg
1  c. beer
1  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Separate onion  slices  into  rings.  Combine all other ingredients.  Blend well.  Dip  onion slices into batter.  Fry in oil until brown.

name: RUSSIAN TEACAKES
ingredients:
1  c. soft butter
1/2  c. confectioners sugar, sifted
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. finely chopped walnuts
preparation: Mix butter, vanilla and sugar well.  Sift flour and salt; stir in sugar mixture, mix in nuts.  Chill dough.  Heat oven to 400°. Roll dough into 1 inch balls.  Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.  While still warm, roll in powdered sugar. Cool.  Roll in sugar again.  Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

name: CLEANING SOLUTION
ingredients:
1  c. sudsy ammonia
1  pt. rubbing alcohol
1  Tbsp. Joy dishwashing detergent
preparation: Put all in gallon jug.  Fill with water.  Pour into spray bottle and use as you would 409.

name: TABOULI SALAD
ingredients:
3 large  bunches parsley
1/3  c. cracked wheat
2  c. water, warm
1 1/2  bunches green onions
2  large tomatoes
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/3  c. lemon juice
1/4  c. olive or corn oil
preparation: Wash parsley; drain and shake out excess moisture.  Soak cracked wheat in warm water in large bowl until it appears dry. Set aside.  Remove stems from parsley; chop fine.  Chop onions fine.  Chop 1 celery stick fine.  Dice tomatoes and 1 cucumber. Squeeze out excess water from cracked wheat and place in large bowl.  Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well.  Chill and serve.

name: DRUNKIN WIENIES
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. hot dogs
3/4  c. bourbon
1 1/2  c. ketchup
1  tsp. minced onion
1/2  tsp. rosemary
1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Mix all together in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish.  Bake uncovered 1 hour at 350°.

name: COCKTAIL QUICHE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. Flour
2  Beaten Eggs
1/2  c. Milk
2/3  c. Crabmeat
8  oz. Swiss Cheese, cubed
1/3  c. Green Onions
Dash, Cayenne Pepper
Parsley
9-inch Pie Shell
As many fish fillets as you and your guests will eat.
Butter or ?
Cajun seasoning or ?
Lemon, Parsley, Fresh Dill and/or ?
preparation: Broil fish fillet about five minutes 2 to 3 inches from the flame.  Pierce with a fork at 1-inch intervals.  Spread with butter or ?  Season with Cajun seasoning or ?  Return to broiler for five minutes or until done.  Garnish with lemon, parsley, dill and/or ? Serve.

name: DIABETIC PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1/4  c. peanut butter
2  Tbsp. skim milk
2  Tbsp. nonfat dry milk powder
1/4  c. raisins
4  graham crackers (2-inch squares), broken into pieces
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of cinnamon
preparation: Cream peanut butter with the 2 tablespoons of milk and 2 tablespoons of dry milk until well blended.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Drop on foil or waxed paper in 1-inch balls.  Place in freezer until ready to serve.  Yields 10 cookies.

name: TUNA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. salad noodles
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch style dressing
1  can tuna, drained
pimento (if desired)
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. chopped celery
4  boiled eggs, chopped
preparation: Cook noodles according to directions.  Mix tuna, celery, eggs and pimento with noodles.  Mix salad dressing mix with mayonnaise and buttermilk according to directions on package.  Mix salad dressing with other mixture.  Salt and pepper to taste.

name: SPAGHETTI DINNER
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  boxes spaghetti
2  jars (1 lb 14 oz.) spaghetti sauce
8  oz. block of sharp cheddar cheese, cut in small cubes
1  lb. bacon
preparation: Boil spaghetti according to directions on box.  drain liquid and rinse with cold water.  Add sauce and cheese.  (I spray my 10 x 13 inch pyrex dish with vegetable spray to avoid hard crust build up.)  Lay strips of bacon on top of spaghetti.  Bake at 350 to 375° 40 minutes.  Yield: 8 servings.

name: BREAKFAST COFFEE RING
ingredients:
1  egg
3/4  c. milk
1/3  c. melted butter or oleo
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. sifted enriched flour
2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. grated orange rind
confectioners sugar icing
chopped nuts (if desired)
preparation: Beat eggs slightly.  Stir in milk and butter or oleo.  Sift sugar, flour, baking powder and salt together.  Add dry ingredients and orange rind to milk mixture, stirring only until well blended.  Pour into a well-greased 9-inch ring mold.  Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cool on rack for 5 minutes; remove from pan.  When cool, drizzle confectioners sugar icing over top. Sprinkle with chopped nuts.  Makes one 9-inch ring.

name: LEMON GINGER CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. light sour cream
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. grated lemon peel
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. cubed, cooked chicken
1  c. seedless green grapes
1  c. sliced celery
preparation: Combine mayonnaise, sour cream, sugar, lemon peel, lemon juice, ginger and salt; stir well.  Add chicken, grapes and celery.  Toss to coat well.  Cover and chill at least 2 hours before serving.  Can be served in melon halves with toasted almond slivers sprinkled on top.

name: FRIED FROZEN CORN
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  bag frozen corn
preparation: Place both in frying pan and cover. Fry on medium setting. Watch carefully and stir often.

name: RHUBARB CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, slightly beaten
2  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
2  crust pastry dough
2 2/3  Tbsp. milk
4  Tbsp. flour
4  c. rhubarb, cut up
preparation: Mix eggs and milk together.  Stir in sugar, flour and nutmeg. Mix in rhubarb.  Put in pastry-lined pan.  Dot with butter (optional).  Cover with top crust, if desired.  Bake at 400° for about 50 to 55 minutes.

name: RUM WALNUT BALLS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. vanilla wafers, crushed
1 3/4  c. sifted confectioners sugar
1 1/2  c. ground walnuts
1/4  c. unsweetened cocoa powder
3  Tbsp. honey
1/2  c. light or dark rum
preparation: In bowl, stir together the wafer crumbs, sugar, walnuts and cocoa until well blended.  Stir honey into rum and gradually add to dry ingredients, mixing first with spoon, then your hands.  Add just enough rum mixture to make dough hold together.  Roll bits of the dough into small balls about 1-inch in diameter.  Roll in confectioners sugar.  Balls will seem soft, but will firm up.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2 whole chicken breasts or 2  c. chicken cooked with 1 bouillon cube
1  c. undiluted cream of mushroom soup
1  c. celery, diced
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1/2  c. slivered almonds
3/4  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1/2  c. crushed corn flakes (for topping)
preparation: Cube cooked chicken and mix with other ingredients and cover with buttered corn flakes.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.  Serves 6.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
2  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. peanut butter
12  oz. Cool Whip
1  large graham cracker crust
preparation: In mixing bowl, blend sugar and cream cheese.  Then blend in peanut butter.  Next, fold in Cool Whip.  Pour into graham cracker crust.  Chill at least 3 hours.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BONBONS
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  box 10x powdered sugar
paraffin wax
2  sticks butter
1  can coconut
1  (16 oz.) bag chocolate chips
preparation: Melt butter and peanut butter in double boiler.  Pour over graham cracker crumbs, powdered sugar and coconut.  Mix well. Roll into small balls.  Melt chocolate chips and wax, then dip balls and place on waxed paper.

name: PICADILLO
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. cumin (optional)
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
1/2  tsp. salt
1  or 2 jalapeno peppers, diced (optional)
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. slivered almonds
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet.  Add tomatoes, vinegar, cinnamon, chili powder, salt, raisins and optional ingredients. Simmer with cover for 45 to 60 minutes.  Stir in slivered almonds. Serve with tortilla chips or wrap in flour tortillas.  Can also serve with shredded cheese and lettuce.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, cut in pieces
4  green onions and tops, chopped
3  medium tomatoes, diced
1  can pinto beans, washed and drained
1  c. grated cheese
1  bag tortilla chips
Catalina salad dressing
preparation: Toss together and add 1 bag of crushed tortilla chips before serving.  Top with Catalina salad dressing.

name: HONEY PECAN BARBECUE SAUCE(From Dakota's Restaurant, Dallas: Yields 1 Quart)
ingredients:
1/4  c. onions
1  tsp. oil
2  Tbsp. pablano peppers
2  tsp. garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. dark chili powder
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. rosemary, chopped
1/3  c. pecans, toasted and chopped
2  Tbsp. honey
1/2  c. red wine vinegar
1  c. chicken stock
3  c. catsup
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Saute onion in	oil.  Add peppers and garlic and saute. Add remaining ingredients and cook 40 minutes and strain.

name: DING DONG CAKE
ingredients:
1  Duncan Hines devil's food cake mix
2/3  c. Crisco
1/3  c. Pet milk
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
1/2  c. powdered sugar
Duncan Hines ready to spread chocolate frosting
preparation: Bake as directed for 2 layer cake.  Substitute milk instead of water.  Cool.  Mix Crisco, milk, sugar, vanilla and salt with mixer on high speed for 5 minutes.  Add powdered sugar.  Beat 4 minutes and spread between layer, then ice with Duncan Hines frosting.

name: WHITE BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. white beans (camellia) or new crop (fresh)
1  medium onion, chopped fine
2  or 3 onion tops, chopped fine
3  Tbsp. cooking oil
parsley flakes
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Sort and wash white beans. After they are clean, fill pot with water and boil beans until they start to split open (about 1 hour). While this is cooking, fry onions and onion tops down until they are clear (on medium heat). Once beans are split, drain and fill pot again with more water. Put beans back to boil and cook on high heat. Add onion  mixture to pot. Sprinkle parsley flakes. Let cook until thick, but remember to smash beans on side of pot for creamy ones and to lower the heat as they become thick. Watch not to scorch the bottom (that's why you lower the heat as you go).

name: CHOPANDIANGAS
ingredients:
1  doz. corn tortillas
1  c. hot fat
1  chicken, cooked and boned
4  green chili peppers, chopped (canned style)
1  clove garlic, chopped
2  tsp. chopped onion
1  large tomato, chopped
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1 large  can evaporated milk
1  lb. Monterey Jack cheese, grated
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Dip tortillas in hot fat to soften; blot excess fat from tortillas with paper towels.  Arrange 6 tortillas in a 13 x 2-inch baking dish.

name: MAJESTIC PIE
ingredients:
1  large Cool Whip
1  can mandarin oranges, drain
1 medium  can pineapple, drain
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1/2  c. nuts
1/4  c. lemon juice
2  pie shells, baked
preparation: Mix  all ingredients thoroughly.  Add lemon juice last. Pour in cooled shells.  Chill and serve.

name: CREAM CHEESE FROSTING
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  stick margarine
1  box confectioners sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
Angel Flake coconut
chopped pecans
preparation: Beat cream cheese and margarine together until smooth. Add powdered sugar and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Spread on any two or three layer cake. Sprinkle with coconut flakes and pecans.

name: FAGE(Irish Bread)
ingredients:
6  c. flour
7  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. margarine
2  Tbsp. caraway seed
2  c. raisins
2  eggs
3 1/2 to 4  c. milk
preparation: Sift together the dry ingredients.  Cut in margarine with pastry blender.  Stir in caraway seed and raisins.  Add eggs and milk, stirring until well moistened.  The mixture will be quite thin.  Pour into two greased 9 x 5-inch loaf tins.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.  Turn out loaves on cooling rack.  Butter tops and sprinkle with sugar while warm.  It is best served warm. Freezes well.

name: CHRISTMAS EGGNOG
ingredients:
1  qt. eggnog
1  qt. French vanilla ice cream
nutmeg
brandy (optional)
preparation: Mix together and serve.  Garnish with a sprinkle of nutmeg. Add 1/2 shot of brandy, if desired.  Enjoy.

name: EASY CHEESE BREAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. biscuit mix
1  c. (4 oz.) sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
2  tsp. poppy seed
1  egg, beaten
1  c. milk
preparation: Combine biscuit mix, cheese and poppy seed in large bowl. Combine egg and milk.  Add to biscuit mixture, mixing vigorously for 1 minute.  Spoon into a lightly greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 1 loaf.  Tastes great "toasted."

name: PICKLED GREEN TOMATOES(Kosher Style)
ingredients:
green tomatoes
stalk celery
sweet green peppers
garlic
2  qt. water
1  qt. vinegar
1  c. canning or pickling salt
fresh dill to taste
preparation: Use small, firm, freshly-gathered green tomatoes.  Wash, dry and pack in sterilized jars.  Add a bud of garlic, 1 stalk celery and 1 green pepper (cut in fourths) to each quart jar.  Combine water, vinegar, salt and dill.  Boil together for 5 minutes.  Pour hot vinegar mixture over tomatoes to within 1/2-inch of the top of the jar.  Adjust screw band firmly tight.  *Process in boiling water bath 15 minutes.  Liquid enough to fill 6 quarts.  Tomatoes will be ready for use in 4 to 6 weeks.

name: CAROLINA CHEWS
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1 (1 lb.)  box light brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream together butter and sugar.  Add rest of ingredients. Mix well.  Bake in a 300° oven for 45 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Cut into bars and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: COCONUT SOUR CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1 (18 1/2 oz.)  pkg. butter flavored cake mix
1  (8 oz.) container whipped topping
2  c. sugar
1 (16 oz.)  carton sour cream
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. frozen coconut, thawed
preparation: Prepare cake mix according to directions, making 2 (9-inch) layers.  Cool and slice each layer to make 4 layers.

name: HONEY BARS
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. honey
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. cooking oil
2  c. chopped nuts
4  c. plain flour
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
2 1/2  c. powdered sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
8  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Mix sugar, eggs, oil, nuts, cinnamon, salt, honey, flour and soda; you may have to mix with your hands.  Press thinly onto a cookie sheet.  Bake at 300°.  Mix remaining ingredients and spread on while hot.  Let cool and cut into squares.

name: SALAD D'AMOUR
ingredients:
2  c. rice, cooked
1/2  pkg. fresh spinach, chopped
3  celery stalks, diced
1/3  c. yellow raisins
1  green pepper, diced
3  Tbsp. parsley
3  scallions
1 1/2  c. cashews
1 1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  pkg. chow mein noodles
preparation: Pat dry everything with paper towel, except chow mein noodles. Make the sauce.

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. Kool-Aid of choice
2  c. sugar
2  qt. water
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1  qt. ginger ale, chilled
preparation: Mix Kool-Aid, sugar and water.  Then add pineapple juice. Chill.  Pour over ice in punch bowl and add ginger ale.  Serve at once.  Yields 50 servings.

name: MAMA'S APPLE FRITTERS(Mrs. Ada Brooks)
ingredients:
1  c. sifted all-purpose flour (sift before measuring)
2  Tbsp. granulated sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
2  medium size tart apples, pared and coarsely chopped (1 1/2 c.)
Crisco oil
confectioners sugar
preparation: Sift together flour, granulated sugar, baking powder and salt. In medium bowl, with rotary beater, beat eggs, milk and vanilla until well combined.  Gradually add flour mixture, beating until smooth.  Stir in apples.  In an electric skillet or heavy saucepan, slowly heat oil (1 1/2 to 2-inches deep).  Drop fritters by rounded tablespoonfuls into hot oil.  As they rise to surface, turn over with slotted utensil.  Fry until golden brown on both sides (4 to 5 minutes in all).  Drain on paper towel.  Serve hot, sprinkled with confectioners sugar.  Makes about 12 fritters.

name: ESCAROLE AND BEANS
ingredients:
1  c. chicken broth
1  large head escarole, well washed, coarsely cut
2  Tbsp. olive oil
2  cloves garlic, minced
1 (15 oz.)  can cannellini beans
4  fresh basil leaves, cut up
preparation: In a large saucepan place chicken broth and escarole, bring to a boil and simmer 1 hour.  Brown garlic in olive oil gently and add cannellini beans with liquid.  Combine with escarole and let simmer 10 to 20 minutes.  Stir carefully with wooden spoon.  This should have a soupy consistency.  If needed, add more broth.  Sprinkle with grated cheese and serve with hot Italian bread.

name: HOMEMADE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. honey
7  c. milk
3  c. whipping cream
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Utensils Needed:  Large mixing bowl, egg beater, mixing spoon, measuring cup, measuring spoons, ice cream freezer, rock salt and ice (one part rock salt to eight parts ice)

name: SOLD AT AUCTION AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1  c. mandarin oranges
1  c. coconut
1  c. pineapple chunks
1  c. chopped pecans
1  jar cherries, drained
1  c. mini marshmallows
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix all together. Chill. Serve!

name: SNACK PIZZA
ingredients:
1  can biscuits (flaky)
1/3  c. tomato sauce
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  small onion, chopped
1/2  c. cheese, shredded
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Pat each biscuit on greased cookie sheet. Mix tomato sauce and oregano.  Spoon sauce on each biscuit. Sprinkle onions and cheese over tomato sauce. Bake 15 minutes or until crust is lightly brown.

name: PREACHER'S CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple (do not drain)
2  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together about 2 minutes with electric mixer at medium speed.  Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: SPAGHETTI ALIA OIL(Garlic And Oil)
ingredients:
1  lb. spaghetti (or pasta of your choice)
1/2  c. olive oil
4 to 5  cloves of garlic, cut up
1/2  c. parsley
1  can flat anchovies
1 small  can sliced black olives
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
preparation: Boil water for spaghetti, keep boiling.  Lightly brown garlic in oil, add anchovies, break with fork.  Add all other ingredients and simmer for about 20 minutes.  Cook and drain spaghetti and mix with oil and garlic sauce.

name: RYE BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. unsifted rye flour
3 1/2  c. white flour
1  pkg. yeast
1  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. margarine
3  Tbsp. molasses
1  c. milk
1  c. water
approximately 1 c. white flour, for kneading
sesame seed (optional)
1  egg white
preparation: Combine rye flour, yeast and 3 1/2 cups white flour in large bowl.  Stir to mix.  Combine salt, margarine, molasses, milk and water in saucepan and heat to very warm (approximately 130°).  Add heated liquid to the flour-yeast mixture.  Stir to moisten.  Use as much of the cup of white flour to knead dough until smooth and elastic.  Cover and let rest for 10 minutes.  Knead and divide into 2 balls.  Shape into long loaves.  Place on a greased baking sheet and cover with dry towel.  Let rise until doubled.  Brush with egg white diluted with 1 tablespoon water.  With a sharp knife lightly cut diagonally across top of each loaf 3 times.  Sprinkle with sesame seed, if desired.  Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

name: PEPPERONI BALLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. hot roll mix
1/4  lb. Mozzarella cheese, cubed
1/4 to 1/2  lb. pepperoni, thinly sliced
oil for deep frying
preparation: Prepare roll mix according to package directions, omitting egg and using 1 cup water.  Place 1 cheese cube with 1 pepperoni slice.  Wrap each with a small piece of dough shaping into a ball. Fry in deep oil for 5 minutes or until brown.

name: APPLE TAFFY SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  beaten egg
2  Tbsp. brown vinegar
8  oz. can crushed pineapple, drained (reserve juice)
4  c. Delicious apples (both red and green) in small bite-size chunks with skins on
1  c. Spanish peanuts
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
preparation: Combine sugar, flour, egg, vinegar and drained pineapple juice from the crushed pineapple.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thick (doesn't take long).  Cool in refrigerator. When cool, add fruits, nuts and Cool Whip.  Cover and refrigerate.

name: WONTON APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1  pkg. wonton wrappers
1  lb. sausage
chopped onion (as much or as little as liked)
3  c. cheese (Mexican and Cheddar)
1/2  pkg. Ranch dip mix
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. milk
green peppers (optional)
preparation: Brown sausage and onion and drain. In paper towel, remove as much grease as you can from meat.

name: LEMON CHESS PIE
ingredients:
2  whole eggs plus 4 yolks
1  c. white sugar
4  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  c. heavy cream
1  Tbsp. yellow cornmeal
1  Tbsp. flour
4  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. grated lemon rind
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie crust
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Beat eggs, yolks and sugar at high speed for 2 minutes.  Add cornmeal, flour, lemon juice and rind. Mix well.  Pour into pie crust and bake 30 minutes.  Allow to cool to room temperature.

name: CORNBREAD FOR A CHILI SUPPER
ingredients:
3/4  c. unbleached white flour
1 1/4  c. corn meal
4  Tbsp. sugar
5  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1 1/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Sift the dry ingredients together.  Set aside.  Beat the eggs; add the milk and melted butter.  Add the dry ingredients and stir well.  Spread the batter in a buttered 9-inch pie pan.  Cook in a preheated 375° oven for about 30 minutes or until lightly browned around the edges.

name: MILLIONAIRE PINEAPPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1/4  c. lemon juice
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
3/4  c. chopped nuts
1  (9 oz.) tub Cool Whip
2  graham cracker crusts
preparation: Drain pineapple.  Mix milk and juice together.  Add rest of ingredients and pour into pie crust.

name: SPEAGGATI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. speaggati, cooked
2  Tbsp. pimentos
2  Tbsp. minced garlic
1  c. frozen peas
1  c. mayonnaise
2  lb. choice of meat, cooked and chopped
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix together.

name: BEAN AND PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. French cut green beans
2 small  cans small peas
1  medium onion, chopped
4  stalks celery, chopped
1 (2 oz.)  jar diced pimientos
1  medium green pepper, chopped
preparation: Mix and set aside.

name: OREO SURPRISE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. Oreo cookies, crumbled
3/4  c. cookie crumbs, reserved
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 large  pkg. chocolate pudding
1 (12 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
2 1/2  c. milk
1  stick butter or margarine
preparation: Crush cookies.  Melt butter and mix with cookies.  Press into pan.  Mix cream cheese and Cool Whip together.  Put 1 cup of this over cookies.  Beat milk with pudding and pour over other two layers.  Top with remaining Cool Whip mixture.  Sprinkle with reserved crumbs.

name: TAILGATE PARTY SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. rotini
1  lb. smoked sausage, cut into 1/2-inch slices
3  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
1  medium tomato
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans, drained
1/2  medium green pepper, chopped
1/2  medium red onion, chopped
1  c. sliced olives
1 1/2  c. (6 oz.) cubed Mozzarella cheese
2  Tbsp. parsley
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. wine vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. oregano leaves
preparation: Prepare rotini according to package directions. Drain. Combine all ingredients. Toss well to mix. Cover and chill thoroughly.  Toss gently before serving.  Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. molasses
1  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. water
1/8  tsp. soda
2  Tbsp. butter
1/4  tsp. vanilla
4  qt. lightly salted popcorn
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients in a pan.  Cook over medium heat until a little of the mixture forms a ball when dropped in cold water (265°) on candy thermometer.  Remove from heat.  Stir in soda, butter and vanilla.  Pour over popcorn.  Mix well.  Wet hands and shape mixture into balls.  Makes about 1 1/2 dozen 3-inch balls.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter, softened
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
3  bananas, mashed
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. walnuts (optional)
1/2 to 1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Grease and flour one large or two small loaf pans.   In large bowl, cream together the butter and sugar; add the eggs.  Blend well.   Add the bananas, flour, baking soda, vanilla and nuts; mix well.   Pour the batter into the prepared pan/pans.   Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until brown.  Yield:  Makes 1 large or 2 small loaves.

name: TURKEY LOAF
ingredients:
2 (1 lb.)  pkg. ground turkey
2  c. herb stuffing mix
1/4  c. finely chopped parsley
2  stalks celery, chopped
1  large carrot, pared and grated
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Put in loaf pan and bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
3  to 4 pieces chicken breasts, cubed
1  onion (medium to large), chopped
1  apple (Granny Smith or Red Delicious), chopped
1  can small pineapple chunks
1/2  c. chopped walnuts or nut of choice
1 1/2  c. pasta (of choice)
1/2  c. raisins (dark or golden)
3 1/2  tsp. curry powder (to taste)
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1/4  c. sour cream
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook and cool pasta.  Cook cubed chicken and 1/2 onion in large frying pan halfway through and add curry powder and 1/2 to 3/4 cup water.

name: ANCHOVY AND COTTAGE CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. cottage cheese
1/4  c. melted butter
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. caraway seed
3  anchovies, chopped fine
1  Tbsp. capers, chopped fine
1  Tbsp. chives, chopped fine
preparation: Put cottage cheese through a sieve.  Add other ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Chill for 1 hour before serving.

name: QUICHE LORRAINE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) prepared pie crust
12  slices bacon (about 1/2 lb.), crisply fried and crumbled
1  c. shredded natural Swiss cheese (4 oz.)
1/3  c. minced onion
4  eggs
2  c. light cream or whipping cream
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. sugar
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in pastry-lined pie pan. With rotary beater, blend remaining ingredients; pour into pie pan. Bake 15 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jiffy cornbread mix
3  eggs
1  onion
1 small  carton cottage cheese
1  pkg. chopped broccoli, drained
1  stick margarine
preparation: Mix all together and cook until golden brown at 450°.

name: CABBAGE PATCH STEW
ingredients:
2  lbs. hamburger (or more, if desired)
1  medium onion, chopped
1  cup celery, chopped
1/2  cup bell pepper, chopped
Salt and pepper to taste
1 or 2  cans of tomatoes (mashed)
2  cans kidney beans
2  cans chili beans
1/2  small head of cabbage, shredded (no more than 2 or 3 cups)
preparation: Use liquid with all canned items.

name: FONDANT
ingredients:
6  c. powdered sugar
2  sticks butter, melted
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  lb. chopped pecans
1  can coconut
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1  cake paraffin
preparation: Combine powdered sugar, butter, milk, pecans and coconut.  Roll into small balls and chill.  Melt chocolate and paraffin in double boiler.  Dip balls into mixture.  Yields about 100 servings.

name: COCONUT POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo
3  c. sugar
1/2  c. plus 1 Tbsp. Crisco
5  eggs
3  c. flour
1  c. milk
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. coconut flavor
1  can Angel Flake coconut
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and Crisco.  Add eggs, 1 at a time. Combine flour and baking powder and add alternately with milk. Add flavoring and coconut last.  Mix; bake in a tube pan at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
8  Tbsp. soft butter
2 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped nuts
3  c. flour
1/2  c. water
2  c. cooked pumpkin
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Blend butter and sugar together.  Add eggs, then add raisins, nuts, water and pumpkin.  Blend well.  Sift dry ingredients and add, beating well.  Pour into two large bread pans (greased). Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.  Use toothpick to check for doneness.  Delicious with cream cheese frosting.

name: DELIGHT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can fruit cocktail
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  pkg. jello
1  small cream cheese (3 oz.)
preparation: Heat fruit cocktail.  Add jello and dissolve.  Chill until almost set.  Mix cream cheese with a little milk.  Beat whipping cream and add to cream cheese.  Mix with fruit and jello.

name: CHINESE RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  can Chinese vegetables, undrained
1 large  can mushrooms, undrained
1  can French-style green beans, drained
1  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
1  can onion soup
1  can chicken soup
1 1/4  c. raw rice
preparation: Cook beef with onion and pepper.  Mix all other ingredients in large casserole dish.  Bake for 1 hour at 325°.

name: BERRY AND PINEAPPLE CRUMBLE
ingredients:
1 (1 lb. 2.25 oz.)  box yellow cake mix
14  Tbsp. (1 3/4 sticks) chilled unsalted butter, cut into pieces
3/4  c. packed dark brown sugar
1/2  c. old-fashioned oats
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
2  (1 lb.) bags frozen unsweetened blueberries
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple in heavy syrup
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Butter 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass baking dish.  Combine cake mix, butter, 1/4 cup sugar, oats and cinnamon in large bowl.  Rub together in fingertips until mixture resembles coarse meal and holds together in large moist clumps.  Mix in pecans.  Mix frozen  blueberries, pineapple with syrup and remaining 1/2 cup sugar in prepared dish.  Cover fruit with cake mix topping.  Bake crumble until fruit is bubbling thickly and topping is brown and crisp, about 1 hour.  Let stand 15 minutes.

name: COCKTAIL MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. crushed cracker crumbs
2  Tbsp. instant minced onion
9  drops Tabasco sauce
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
dash of salt
3/4  c. catsup
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. vinegar
1/3  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1 1/4  tsp. salt
4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
6  drops Tabasco sauce
preparation: Combine the ground beef, eggs, cracker crumbs, onion, Tabasco sauce, garlic salt and salt.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 325° for 30 minutes.  Combine the catsup, water, vinegar, brown sugar, onion, mustard, salt and sauces; pour over the meatballs.  Bake 1 hour at 325°.

name: BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
2  c. honey
2  c. All-Bran cereal
4  c. 100% bran cereal
1  c. boiling water
4  eggs
5  c. flour
5  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. salt
1  qt. (4 c.) ???
preparation: Cream together the Crisco and honey. Add the All-Bran, 100% bran cereal and boiling water. Blend in the eggs.  Sift together the flour, baking soda and salt. Add the ???.   Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Makes a large batch.  Store batter in refrigerator in jars until ready to bake.

name: ORANGE ROUGHY IN ORANGE-MINT-YOGURT SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. orange roughy fillets
1  tsp. olive oil
1/2  tsp. minced ginger root
1/2  tsp. minced garlic
1 (8 oz.)  carton plain nonfat yogurt
1  tsp. grated orange peel
1  tsp. minced fresh mint leaves
white pepper
preparation: Brush fish with oil and sprinkle lightly with ginger and garlic.  Broil 3 to 4 inches from heat source for about 5 minutes or until fish flakes when tested with fork.  Stir together yogurt, orange peel and mint leaves.  Season to taste with white pepper. To serve, spoon yogurt sauce over fish or serve separately. Serves 6.

name: BEEF AND NEW PEA PODS-CHINESE STYLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked rice
1  lb. top beef round
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. dry sherry (optional)
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. fresh snow pea pods or 1 pkg. frozen
3  Tbsp. cooking oil
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
1  c. water
2  Tbsp. chopped green onions with tops
2  Tbsp. pimento strips
preparation: Prepare rice.  Chill meat in freezer until slightly firm.  Cut meat diagonally across the grain into very thin slices.   Mix 1 tablespoon cornstarch, soy sauce, sherry, sugar and salt; pour over meat and mix well.  Snap off tips of fresh snow pea pods; remove strings from pea pods.  Blanch one minute in boiling water. Rinse in cold water and drain well.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots, sliced thinly
1  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1  can tomato soup
3/4  c. vinegar
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. Worcestershire
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook carrots in small amount of boiling, salted water until tender.  Drain.  Combine with onion and green pepper in a bowl. Stir together remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables. Cover and marinate in refrigerator several hours or overnight.

name: OVEN BARBECUE RIBS
ingredients:
3/4  c. no salt catsup
2/3  c. salt free steak sauce
2  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  Tbsp. ginger
1  Tbsp. salt free herb and spice blend
3  cloves garlic, minced
1/4  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
4  lb. spareribs, halved
preparation: Cover spareribs with the sauce.  Let stand 2 hours.  In 375° oven on large rack, set ribs right side up.  Keep brushing with sauce until done.  (Put 1/2-inch water into roasting pan holding rack of ribs.)  Bake 45 minutes.

name: SPINACH AND MASHED POTATOES
ingredients:
3  cups mashed potatoes (hot)
3  tablespoons butter
2  teaspoons salt
1  teaspoon black pepper
1  cup chopped spinach
preparation: Blanch spinach and squeeze out liquid.  Mix mashed potatoes, butter, salt, black pepper and spinach.  Serve hot as a side dish.

name: GRANDMA K'S SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. Hellmann's salad dressing
2  Tbsp. x sugar
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. celery salt
2  Tbsp. vinegar or lemon juice
6  Tbsp. salad oil
preparation: Mix together the confectioners sugar, dry mustard, paprika and celery salt.  Add this mixture to the mayonnaise and stir well. Now add vinegar and salad oil.  Mix together well.  Serve on tossed salad.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1 large  can pork and beans
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
4  strips bacon (across top)
preparation: Mix ingredients together in order.  Bake in 3-quart casserole dish in 350° oven for 2 hours.

name: HOT BUFFALO WINGS
ingredients:
25  drummettes, fried in vegetable oil
1  c. Texas Pete
1  stick butter
preparation: Drain oil from fried wings.  Heat Texas Pete.  Melt butter in Texas Pete.  Stir thoroughly.  Dip each drummette in mixture. Serve.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. diced chicken or turkey
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2 soup  can milk
3  c. prepared Stove Top stuffing or 1/2 pkg. Pepperidge Farm dressing
preparation: Mix together soup, sour cream, and milk for sauce. Put chicken into 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.  Pour sauce over chicken and top with stuffing.  Bake for 45 minutes in 350° oven.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2/3  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. shortening, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  c. boiling water
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.  Mix in 3 tablespoons cocoa.  Add milk, shortening and vanilla.  Mix all ingredients only until smooth.  Stir in pecans.  Pour into a greased 1-quart baking dish.  Mix brown sugar and remaining 3 tablespoons cocoa; sprinkle over mixture in the baking dish.  Pour 1 1/2 cups boiling water over the top.  (When baked, this pudding cake has a sauce on the bottom and cake on top!)  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Serve warm or cold.

name: CREAMY COCONUT ICING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  egg whites
1/3  c. white Karo
2  Tbsp. water
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Mix in a double boiler.  Boil and stir until stiff (8 to 10 minutes).  Spread over cake and top with coconut.

name: FRUIT FIZZ
ingredients:
juice of 4 oranges
juice of 2 lemons
1/2  c. pineapple juice
1/2  c. maraschino cherries, with juice
4  pt. sparkling white grape juice
preparation: Combine the juice of the oranges and lemons; add the pineapple juice (preferably unsweetened, canned) and the cherries with their juice. Just before serving, add the white grape juice.  Turn over ice cubes and garnish each glass with a mint sprig.  Serves 8.

name: RICE AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen broccoli
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  stick margarine
3  c. cooked rice
1/4  c. grated onion
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook broccoli. Drain and combine with rest of ingredients. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: SHRIMP MASKA
ingredients:
2  lb. shrimp (unpeeled, headless)
2  oz. olive oil
1  tsp. oregano
6  buds garlic
2  bay leaves
1  tsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. rosemary, crushed
1  Tbsp. salt
1  oz. cooking sherry or wine
preparation: Heat olive oil in pan.  Add shrimp and spices.  Saute for 20 to 30 minutes.  Add wine and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.  Serve hot with French bread.

name: PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. crushed pretzels
3/4  c. butter, melted
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. Cool Whip
1 large  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
2  c. boiling water
2  (6 oz.) sliced frozen strawberries
preparation: Mix pretzels, butter and 3 tablespoons sugar; mix and press into 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake crust for 10 minutes at 375°; cool. Cream 1 cup sugar and cream cheese.  Add Cool Whip; spread over pretzel layer.  Mix Jell-O and boiling water; add frozen strawberries (practically thawed).  Pour over second layer. Refrigerate.  Best to make night before.

name: SWEET POTATO PUDDING
ingredients:
4  C boiled sweet potatoes
2  C sugar
1  stick butter or fat
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. allspice
1  C milk
1  C flour
preparation: Combine together first five ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Mix in milk and flour. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Let cool remove from pan.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  to 5 zucchini, sliced
1  large onion, sliced
1/4  stick margarine or butter
1  can stewed tomatoes
1  pkg. spaghetti sauce mix
1  can mushrooms
grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Place sliced zucchini, onion and butter or margarine in skillet and brown.  Stir stewed tomatoes, spaghetti sauce mix and mushrooms together.  Gently stir into the zucchini mixture.  Pour into casserole dish and top with Mozzarella cheese.  Bake at 325° until cheese melts.

name: COCONUT CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs, well beaten
2  c. milk
1/2  stick margarine, softened
1  (7 oz.) bag coconut
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. baking powder
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients in order; mix well.  Pour into greased 10-inch glass pie pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes until golden brown.  This pie makes its own crust.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
4  or 5 chicken breasts
2  cans drained Veg-All
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  cans chicken broth
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. flour
1  c. milk (for soft dumpling-like topping) or 1/3 c. milk (for thinner, more crisp topping)
1/2  stick oleo
pinch of salt
preparation: Cook chicken breasts until tender.  Pull meat from bone; chop and put in large casserole dish.  Add Veg-All.  Add soup, mixed with broth.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Mix remaining ingredients.  Spread over top.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes, may be longer.

name: HAMBURGER POT PIE
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. hamburger
1 large  can tomato soup
1  can green beans, drained
1  can biscuits
onions, celery, green peppers, seasoning to taste
cheese
preparation: Fry hamburger with onions, celery and all of your favorite seasonings until done (drain).  Put back on stove, add tomato soup and green beans.  Do not add water to soup.  Stir in beans and top with biscuits of your choice.  Bake in oven until biscuits and cheese are melted and biscuits are brown.

name: BLONDE BROWNIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. margarine
2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
2  c. plain flour
1/4  tsp. soda
2  tsp. vanilla
3/4  tsp. salt
1  (6 oz.) bag chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt margarine.  Add brown sugar to melted margarine; mix well.  Add slightly beaten eggs, vanilla and dry ingredients.  Add nuts and chips.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: COCONUT CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix (not pudding type)
1 1/3  c. milk
1  Tbsp. oil
2  eggs
1  can (8 1/2 oz.) cream of coconut
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
1  pkg. frozen coconut
preparation: Mix together cake mix, oil and eggs.  Bake in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes.  Cool in pan for 10 minutes.  Punch holes in cake with toothpick and pour cream of coconut over cake while warm.  Let cool and spread Cool Whip over cake.  Sprinkle frozen coconut on top and chill four hours.

name: ITALIAN SPAGHETTI FRITTATA
ingredients:
1/2  c. green pepper
1/2  c. yellow onion
1/2  c. zucchini
1  clove garlic
6  oz. cooked shrimp, chopped
1/2  lb. dry spaghetti, cooked
1/2  c. tomatoes
5  or 6 eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Julienne the green pepper and zucchini.  Slice onion thin. Finely chop the garlic.  Peel the tomatoes; seed and drain.  Beat eggs and Parmesan together.  In a 12-inch nonstick omelet pan, saute green pepper and onion until onion begins to brown.  Add tomatoes and garlic; saute 5 to 10 minutes.  Add shrimp, zucchini and drained spaghetti.  Toss until well mixed.  Pour egg and Parmesan mixture over the contents in pan.  Cook until eggs begin to set and mixture browns.  Slide Frittata onto an oiled plate. Invert pan over the Frittata; flip over and fry on the other side until brown.

name: FIVE-CUP SALAD
ingredients:
8 1/4  oz. can pineapple chunks
11  oz. can Mandarin orange sections, drained
1  c. coconut
1  c. tiny marshmallows
8  oz. carton dairy sour cream
2  Tbsp. chopped pecans
preparation: Drain pineapple chunks, reserving 1 tablespoon syrup. Combine pineapple chunks, reserving syrup, Mandarin orange sections, coconut, marshmallows and sour cream.  Cover and chill for 2 to 24 hours.  Before serving, sprinkle with pecans.

name: REGINA'S IRISH SODA BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1  egg, beaten
1 1/4  c. milk
1  c. raisins
preparation: Mix all together.  If using a mixer, fold in raisins.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour.  Check at 50 minutes.  Use a well-greased loaf pan.  Great for St.  Patrick's Day.

name: MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
1/2  c. crushed cornflakes
1/2  c. applesauce
1  small grated onion
salt and pepper to taste
3/4  c. catsup
3/4  c. water
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix ground chuck, cornflakes, applesauce, onion, salt and pepper.  Make into balls.  Place in baking dish (lined in foil). Mix together catsup, water and Worcestershire sauce.  Pour over meatballs.  Bake, covered, about 1 hour.  Remove cover and brown a little.

name: FAT-FREE COCOA
ingredients:
2  c. water
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. sugar
1  can skim milk concentrate
1  can water
1/8  tsp. cinnamon (just a shake)
1/8  tsp. salt (just a shake)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil cocoa, water and sugar 3 minutes.  Add milk, additional water, salt and cinnamon.  Heat, but do not let boil.  Add vanilla just before serving.  Serves approximately 4 to 6 servings.

name: 24 HOUR SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. pineapple tidbits, drained
3  egg yolks
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. oleo
2 1/2  c. light sweet cherries, drained
2  c. orange pieces
2  c. mini marshmallows
1  c. whipping cream, whipped
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving 2 tablespoons syrup.  In a double boiler, beat egg yolks slightly.  Add reserved syrup, sugar, vinegar and oleo.  Stir until thick.  Cool.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1/2  c butter
1/2  c Crisco
1  1/2 c sugar
2  eggs
2  3/4 c flour
2  tsp cream of tartar
1  tsp baking soda
1/4  tsp salt
2  tsp cinnamon and 2 Tbsp sugar, for rolling*
preparation: Mix butter, shortening, sugar, and eggs thoroughly. Blend flour, cream of tartar, soda, and salt. Stir into butter mixture. Shape into 1 inch balls. Roll into mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Place on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: PARKER HOUSE ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. melted shortening
6  Tbsp. sugar
1 3/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. lukewarm water
3/4  c. milk, scalded and cooled
5 to 5 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Soften yeast in water 15 minutes.  Add shortening, sugar, salt and milk.  Add flour, a little at a time, beating thoroughly after each addition.  Knead until smooth.  (Do not add too much flour.)  Cover with a damp, warm cloth.  Let rise until double in bulk.  Roll to 1/2-inch thickness.  Cut in 2-inch rounds.  Butter, fold over and butter again.  Place in rows on well-oiled baking sheet.  Cover and let rise until triple in bulk. Bake in a hot oven (450°) for 15 to 18 minutes.  Makes 24 to 30 rolls.

name: PEA SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans peas, drained
celery, diced
2  hard-boiled eggs
parsley
onion (optional)
mayonnaise to moisten
preparation: Drain peas.  Dice celery.  Slice hard-boiled eggs.  Mix all ingredients together.

name: INSTANT DATE NUT ROLL
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. vanilla wafers, crushed
1  pkg. dates, chopped
1  c. pecans, chopped
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  c. mini marshmallows (optional)
1  Tbsp. lemon juice (optional)
preparation: Mix all together until thoroughly moistened.  Divide in half. Place on a sheet of plastic wrap and roll to form 2 (1 1/2-inch thick) rolls.  Makes 2 rolls about 8-inches long.  Seal ends of plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.   Slice and serve.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. shortening
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Mix peanut butter and shortening well.  Add rest of ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: PRAWNS - SPICED AND BREWED
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. prawns (large, fresh or frozen, shell on)
1  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. pickling spice or a shrimp and crab boil
4 (12 oz.)  cans Budweiser light beer
preparation: Pour all ingredients into a slow cooker and cook covered for 5 hours.  Cut prawns along their back from end to just before the tail, leaving the shell and tail on.  Remove the vein; rinse and refrigerate until ready to use.  After 5 hours of cooking ingredients, turn slow cooker to high and add enough water to fill the slow cooker to above half full.  Cook an additional 1/2 hour. Add prawns and cook until they turn pink, about 10 to 15 minutes. Remove shells and eat hot or cold.  Enjoy!

name: NEIMAN-MARCUS BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  box Swiss chocolate cake mix
2  c. nuts
1  egg
1  stick melted butter
preparation: Mix together and press into 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: BREAKFAST SOUFFLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. bulk pork sausage
9  eggs
3  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
3  slices bread
1 1/2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Cook and  crumble  sausage over medium heat until done. Drain on	paper  towels.	Cut  bread  into  1/4-inch cubes and place in bottom  of	greased  13  x 9-inch baking dish.  Beat eggs.	Add milk to beaten eggs until mixed.  Combine sausage, mustard, salt and  cheese and stir in egg mixture.  Pour over bread cubes and refrigerate, covered, overnight.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.	Serves 8 to 10.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. Hidden Valley party dip
1  pt. sour cream
1/4  c. minced onion, diced
1/2  c. cucumber, diced
1/2  bottle Heinz chili sauce
1  tsp. horseradish
1 small  pkg. salad shrimp, thawed and all water squeezed out
black pepper or white pepper
cayenne pepper
Tony Chachere seasoning sauce to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Season with black or white pepper and cayenne pepper.  Add Tony Chachere seasoning sauce to taste.

name: MANDARIN AND PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  box orange jello (just powder, no water)
1 small  box cottage cheese (small curd)
1 medium  Carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix well.

name: PARTY SLUSH PUNCH
ingredients:
1  large (6 oz.) strawberry jello
2  c. hot water
4  c. sugar
1  pt. ReaLemon juice
2  Tbsp. almond extract
9  c. water
1 large (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 large  can frozen orange juice
4 to 6  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Mix jello, hot water and sugar together until jello is dissolved.  Add all other ingredients except ginger ale.  Put in containers and freeze.  I use butter tubs or freezer bags.  Take out of freezer 3 hours before serving.  Place in punch bowl and pour ginger ale over.  Mix together.  This will be slushy.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  pork chops
6  potatoes, sliced
2  onions, sliced
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can of water (mix with soup)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown pork chops. Trim the fat. Put pork chops on bottom of pan. Place a layer of sliced potatoes, layer of onions, layer of potatoes and layer of onions. Pour mushroom soup and water (already mixed) over casserole. Cover and bake in oven at 400° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: SCALLOPED OYSTERS
ingredients:
2 large  cans cream-style corn
10  to 12 broken crackers
1 (8 oz.)  can cove oysters
pepper to taste
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. half and half
butter
preparation: Alternate corn, crackers and oysters in layers; add salt and pepper to taste.  Beat eggs; add milk and half and half together. Pour over each layer.  Dot with butter.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Serves 10.

name: CHEESE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick butter (no substitute)
1  c. sharp yellow cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. red cayenne pepper
1  c. flour
pecan halves
preparation: Cream  butter;  add cheese, then salt, pepper and flour. Roll into  tiny  balls.  Press half pecan on each ball to flatten. Place on cookie sheet and bake 15 minutes in a 350° oven. Makes 40 to 45 cookies; 50 calories for 4 cookies.

name: BERRY OR PEACH BAKED DUMPLING
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1  c. uncooked fruit
1  c. sugar (for tart fruit) or 1/2 c. sugar (for sweet fruit)
1  c. boiling water
butter
preparation: Cream together the first 6 ingredients and pour into an ungreased 11 x 8-inch pan.  Add uncooked fruit and sugar for fruit.  Pour boiling water over top of the fruit.  Dot with butter.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: GLORIFIED GRAHAMS
ingredients:
24  graham crackers
1/2  c. melted margarine
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Place the graham crackers in a single layer on a cookie sheet. Mix the margarine and sugar together and pour over the graham crackers.  Sprinkle the pecans on top.  Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

name: BEEF BURGUNDY
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. cubed beef or stew meat
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. dry red wine
preparation: Mix all ingredients in large covered casserole.  Bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours or until done.  Stir in 1/2 to 1 cup sour cream before serving.

name: STRAWBERRY NUT BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. Gold Medal flour
1  Tbsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. vegetable oil
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed and drained
1  c. chopped nuts (pecans or walnuts)
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients; set aside.  Combine oil, eggs and sugar in a large bowl; mix well.  Gradually add "dry" ingredients to creamed mixture, stirring just until all ingredients are moistened.  Stir in strawberries and chopped nuts.  Spoon mixture into two greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool in pans 10 minutes.  Remove to wire rack and cool completely.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. cooked chicken, cut up in small pieces
3  tsp. grated onion
1  c. Stove Top stuffing
2  c. finely chopped celery
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Put in buttered dish; add 2 tablespoons butter cut in pieces. Sprinkle Stove-Top on top.  Bake in 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: POOR MAN'S RAISIN CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. raisins
2  c. water
1  tsp. soda
2 rounded  Tbsp. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
pinch of each: salt, allspice, nutmeg, cinnamon and ginger
preparation: Cook raisins and water down to 1 cup juice; add soda and shortening to liquid while warm.   Add sugar and flour (enough to make a light batter, not a stiff one), baking powder and spices. Mix well and bake at 350° until done.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. cooked, diced chicken
2  c. cream of mushroom soup
1  c. mayonnaise
3  c. crushed potato chips
2  c. finely chopped celery
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  c. slivered almonds
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  box long grain wild rice mix
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except 1 cup crushed potato chips. Put in a baking dish. Sprinkle the 1 cup potato chips on top. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.

name: STUFFED BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  large potatoes (baking)
1  c. sour cream
2  green onions, diced
1  large tomato, peeled and diced
1/2  tsp. salt
pepper
parsley, chopped
grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Bake potatoes at 400° for 1 hour or until done.  Cut in half lengthwise.  Scoop out into a bowl, reserving shell.  Beat potato, sour cream, onion, salt, pepper and parsley until well blended. Stir in tomato.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. water
3/4  c. sugar
2 to 3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. dry strawberry jello
1  qt. sliced strawberries
preparation: Cook the first 4 ingredients until thick.  Put the dry strawberry jello into this mixture and stir well.  Add the strawberries and let set for 5 minutes.  Put in baked pie shell and chill.  Use favorite topping.

name: SUPER BEAN SALAD BOWL
ingredients:
1  lb. dry black-eyed beans (peas)
water
salt
3  c. cooked rice
1  c. French dressing
3/4  c. diced green onion
3/4  c. thinly sliced celery
3/4  c. diced carrot
1/2  c. diced green pepper
1/3  c. diced pimiento
1  c. cooked ham, cut into cubes or thin strips
pepper
preparation: Soak beans overnight in 6 cups water to which 2 teaspoons salt has been added.

name: FAJITA PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. rice (white or brown)
3/4  lb. flank steak, cut into thin strips
1  medium onion
1  green pepper, sliced
1  red pepper, sliced
1 1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. oil
1/4  c. lime juice
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. hot pepper sauce
1/4  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Prepare rice as directed on package.  Cook and stir meat, vegetables and garlic powder in hot oil in large skillet until browned.  Add remaining ingredients; bring to boil.  Reduce heat; simmer for 5 minutes.  Serve over rice.  Makes 4 servings.

name: QUICK PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. white sugar
3/4  c. milk
1  stick margarine
3 to 4  c. fresh or canned peaches (or can use other fruit, like berries)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Melt margarine in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Mix flour, sugar and milk together well with a fork.  Pour mixture over bubbling margarine.  Do not stir.  Add hot fruit over top of mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Batter will rise to the top, forming a delicious crust.

name: 7 VEGETABLE MUSHROOM RICE
ingredients:
2 (15 oz.)  cans Veg-All, drained
2  c. cooked wild or regular rice
1  can canned, sliced mushrooms
1  medium onion, finely chopped
preparation: In a saucepan mix vegetables, rice, mushrooms and onions. Over medium heat, heat through, stirring occasionally.  Serves 8.

name: ORANGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, softened
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. vanilla wafers, crushed
1  box powdered sugar
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
coconut
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except coconut. Form into balls and roll in coconut.

name: APPLE PANCAKES LITHUANIAN(Blynal Su Obuoliais)
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. milk
3  eggs
6  tsp. butter or margarine, melted
3  c. flour, sifted
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  apples, sliced thin or diced
preparation: Combine milk, eggs and melted butter.  Sift together dry ingredients.  Add liquid ingredients.  Stir to blend.  Add apples. Use 1/3 cup batter for each pancake.  Brown on each side.  Serve with honey.

name: RAW PEACH PIE
ingredients:
peeled peach halves
1/3  c. butter
1/3  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  egg
preparation: Put peeled peach halves (fresh) open side down in an unbaked pie shell. Mix butter, flour and sugar; add egg. Beat together and pour over peaches. Bake 1 hour at 300°. Serve with whipped or ice cream.

name: BARBECUE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can corned beef
14  oz. catsup
3  Tbsp. vinegar (may want to use less)
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: Brown and drain hamburger and other ingredients.  Simmer 90 minutes.

name: CHURCH SUPPER DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter, melted
2  c. boiling water
1  c. milk
1 3/4  c. Cool Whip
2  to 3 bananas
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. jello (any flavor)
1  pkg. marshmallows
preparation: Combine crumbs, sugar and butter.  Press firmly in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.  Chill for 15 minutes.  Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add cold water; chill until thickened.  Combine marshmallows and milk in small saucepan.  Heat over low heat until marshmallows are melted; cool.

name: JADE PUNCH
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. lemon-lime flavored instant drink mix
1/2  c. sugar
3  c. water
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen concentrated lemonade
1  c. pineapple juice
1 (11 oz.)  bottle ginger ale, chilled
few drops of green food coloring
preparation: Dissolve soft drink powder and sugar in water.  Add lemonade and pineapple juice; chill.  Before serving, add ginger ale and food coloring.  Serve over ice cubes with thin slices of lemon or lime for garnish.

name: ARTICHOKE BITES
ingredients:
1  loaf party rye bread
1/2  stick melted butter
1  can artichokes (not in oil)
2  c. shredded mild Cheddar cheese
1 to 1 1/2  c. real mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. lemon pepper
preparation: Place the party rye bread onto cookie sheet.  Brush each little bread with the melted butter.  Open artichoke can; drain and cut each artichoke into sixths.

name: HOT CORN
ingredients:
4  c. fresh corn
1  hot pepper
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. tomatoes
preparation: Mix  ingredients  and  cook  until  done to your taste. Season to taste.

name: CATSUP RELISH
ingredients:
7  lb. ripe tomatoes
1  lb. peeled, quartered onions
2  peeled green peppers, cored, cut in strips
2  ribs chunked celery
1/2  tsp. cayenne
1  c. cider vinegar
2  tsp. dry mustard
1 1/2  tsp. whole cloves
1  stick broken cinnamon
1  tsp. whole allspice
1  tsp. celery seed
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. molasses
4  tsp. pure coarse salt
preparation: Core tomatoes.  Strip off skin and quarter.  If necessary, rotate each tomato on a fork over heat until skin pops.  Chop finely the first 5 ingredients and add to 6 to 8-quart enamelled or stainless steel kettle.

name: LOW-FAT, LOW CALORIE FETTUCCINE PRIMAVERA
ingredients:
2  c. broccoli flowerets
1  c. thinly sliced carrots
1/2  c. sliced green onions
2  cloves garlic, minced
1/4  c. reduced calorie margarine, melted
2  c. sliced mushrooms
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. broth (beef or chicken)
3 1/2  c. cooked fettuccine
3  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Saute first 5 ingredients in margarine in large skillet for 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.  Stir often.  Add mushrooms, salt, pepper and broth.  Cook 2 minutes or until mushrooms are tender.  Gently toss fettuccine and cheese.  Top with vegetables.  Serve.  Yields 7 cups or servings (179 calories per serving and 5.8 grams fat).

name: SOUR CREAM BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
2  c. self-rising flour
1  stick butter, melted
preparation: Combine  all  ingredients.  Mix  well.	Put  in greased miniature muffin tin.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 18 minutes.

name: CALORIE WISE STEAK
ingredients:
1  chuck steak, cut 1-inch thick (1 1/2 to 2 lb.)
1  envelope au jus gravy mix
1 1/4  c. hot water
1  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen green beans
preparation: Trim fat from the steak.  Combine contents of envelope of gravy mix, hot water, onion and Worcestershire sauce.  Pour over steak in a shallow baking pan.  Cover tightly (use foil if pan has no cover) and bake in 400° oven about 1 hour or until tender.  Add green beans; cover and cook 15 minutes longer.  Serve.

name: BLACK WALNUT COOKIE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. packed brown sugar
2  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. black walnuts (no more)
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream butter, vanilla and brown sugar.  Gradually add beaten eggs and cream until fluffy.  Add walnuts.  Combine flour, soda and salt; add 1/4 at a time.  Roll and wrap dough; chill several hours or overnight.  Slice and bake at 350° for 8 minutes.

name: LOW CALORIE SPINACH LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. basil
1 1/2  c. tomato puree
salt and pepper
6  (6 oz.) lasagna noodles
2  (10 oz.) frozen chopped spinach, thawed
1 1/2  c. low-fat cottage cheese
1  egg, slightly beaten
3  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Spray pan with nonstick vegetable spray.  Brown ground meat. Remove, reserving 1 teaspoon drippings.  Add onions; saute.  Add garlic.  Cook 1 minute, then add beef; blend in oregano, tomato puree, basil, salt and pepper.  Heat to boiling.  Simmer 5 minutes. Cook noodles; drain.  Mix spinach (water removed), cottage cheese, egg, Parmesan cheese, nutmeg, salt and pepper.  In 9-inch square pan, place 1/3 spinach mix on bottom.  Use 2 noodles to make a layer; spread meat sauce, continue layering.  Cover with foil. Bake 40 to 45 minutes until hot and bubbly.

name: FRIED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  medium head shredded cabbage (about 6 c.)
1/4  c. melted margarine
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. paprika
1/2  c. light cream
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Melt margarine in large skillet.  Add shredded cabbage.  Cook over low heat for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add salt and paprika and simmer until cabbage is just tender.  Combine cream and vinegar and add to cabbage and stir gently.  Serve hot.

name: EASY PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
3  pkg. Kool-Aid (cherry flavor)
12  c. water
3  c. sugar
1 large  can pineapple juice
1  carton 7-Up
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except 7-Up.  Add 7-Up just before serving.

name: FOOTBALL CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. boiling water
1  tsp. soda
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
pinch of salt
1/2  c. cocoa (regular)
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. shortening
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve soda in boiling water in large bowl; add sugar, shortening, eggs, salt, cocoa, buttermilk, vanilla and flour. Mix with electric mixer at slow speed until all ingredients are moistened. Increase mixer speed until medium and beat for 2 minutes. Bake as a sheet cake in oiled, paper-lined pan at 350° for 45 minutes or until batter springs back when touched lightly in the center. Take out of oven and let cool for 5 to 10 minutes, then turn out on rack to finish cooling.

name: RAISIN SAUCE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  c. apple cider
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. white raisins
preparation: Heat cornstarch in butter.  Thicken.  Add apple cider.  Stir until thickened.  Add raisins when slightly cooled.  Great with ham.

name: EASY CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1  c. regular rice (uncooked)
1  (10 3/4 oz.) cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
2 3/4  c. water
1  (2 to 3 lb.) broiler-fryer, cut up
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. oleo, cut into 1/8-inch slices
preparation: Sprinkle rice in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Combine soup and water; pour over rice.  Place chicken pieces, skin side up, in baking dish.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Place a piece of butter on each piece of chicken.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Yield: 6 servings.

name: BEEF AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
2  Tbsp. fat
1/2  c. rice
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  can tomatoes
preparation: Lightly brown beef, onion and pepper in fat.  Wash rice. Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole.  Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350°.  Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. flour
1  large egg, beaten
4  oz. American cheese, cubed
2  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. buttered crumbs
salt
preparation: Saute butter and onion; stir in flour and salt.  Add water and cook until thick.  Add cheese; stir until blended.  Combine with broccoli; blend in beaten egg and pour in greased baking dish. Top with crumbs.  Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

name: APPLE PAN PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. oil
3  c. flour
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. apples, peeled
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix all together. Put in ungreased 9 x 13 pan. Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

name: BANANA-GINGER MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  medium ripe bananas, mashed
1/3  c. maple syrup
2/3  c. orange juice
1/3  c. applesauce
2  tsp. finely grated ginger root
1  medium lemon
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Put muffin cups in muffin pan.  In a bowl, mix bananas, syrup, orange juice, applesauce, ginger and lemon. In another bowl, mix flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt together.  Add banana mixture to dry mix and stir; don't overstir. Spoon batter until cups are 3/4 full.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 12 muffins, 137 calories each, fat .4 gm.

name: CRISP SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. lemon extract
1/4  c. canned milk (or regular milk)
4  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Chill dough.  Roll 1/8-inch thick and cut into desired shapes. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.  These crispy cookies are delicious.

name: TOM'S DEEP FAT FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  cut up frying chicken
2  eggs
1  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. fine bread crumbs
vegetable oil for deep fat frying
preparation: With mixer, beat eggs, flour, salt, pepper and milk until smooth.  Dip each piece of chicken in batter and roll in bread crumbs.  Lightly brown in deep fat.  Arrange in shallow pan and bake in a 325° oven for about 40 to 45 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. salad oil
4  eggs, well beaten
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. red food coloring
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. cinnamon
2 (10 oz. each)  boxes frozen strawberries
3/4  c. pecans
preparation: Cream together oil, eggs and sugar.  Add food coloring and mix well.  Sift together dry ingredients and blend with egg mixture. Add strawberries all at once and mix well.  Stir in nuts.

name: LOU'S CHUCK WAGON CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  green pepper, chopped
