2  onions, chopped
4  Tbsp. shortening
1  lb. ground beef
3 1/2  c. tomatoes (two 16 oz. cans)
1  tsp. salt
1  c. mushrooms (optional)
1/4  lb. American cheese, shredded
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. noodles, uncooked
preparation: Lightly saute pepper and onion in shortening.  Push aside. Saute meat, then combine all.  Sprinkle uncooked noodles over top. Add tomatoes and mushrooms, including juice.  Bring liquid to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 45 minutes, stirring several times.  Sprinkle cheese over top and continue simmering 15 minutes longer.

name: MAMAW'S FRUIT CAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/4  stick margarine
1 1/2  c. plain flour
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. all spice
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. wine
1/2  lb. cherries
1/2  lb. pineapple
3  c. pecans
preparation: Soak fruit in wine while sifting flour and spices together. Add fruit to flour mixture.  Add pecans.  Refrigerate overnight. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet (1 tsp. for each cookie).  Bake at 250 degrees for about 20 minutes.

name: DOUBLE DECKER DINNER
ingredients:
1  beaten egg
1/2  c. tomato juice
1 1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  lb. ground beef, pork, lamb, veal or turkey, or 2 c. fully-cooked ground ham
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli or frozen mixed vegetables
1 1/4  c. boiling water
1  c. quick cooking rice
1 1/2  tsp. minced dry onion or 1 small fresh chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1  c. shredded American cheese or Cheddar
2  beaten eggs
preparation: In mixing bowl, combine the first beaten egg, tomato juice, bread crumbs, 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper.  Add meat and mix well.  Pat meat evenly in 8 x 8-inch ungreased pan.  Bake in 350° for 20 minutes; spoon off any excess juices.

name: WASSAIL
ingredients:
3  qt. boiling water
1  tea bag (to color)
1 small  can frozen orange juice
1 small  can frozen lemonade
1  c. sugar
12  whole cloves
3  cinnamon sticks
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and simmer for 1/2 hour.  Serve hot.  A crock-pot is nice for serving since it keeps it warm.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. corn meal
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. butter
milk
1/2  c. regular milk
1  green bell pepper
3  hot peppers
1  c. grated cheese
1  can cream-style corn
3  eggs
1  large onion, diced
1  c. oil
1  c. flour
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 small  box instant vanilla pudding
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. pecans or walnuts, chopped
1  c. raisins
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Stir in one ingredient at a time to avoid lumping.  Mix by hand.  Put into a greased Bundt pan or two bread pans, three if the small size.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.  Keep loosely covered at room temperature.

name: LOW-FAT CHOCOLATE SNACK CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/4  c. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  Egg Beaters or 4 egg whites
1  c. water
1/2  c. light corn syrup
preparation: Spray 9-inch square baking dish with a nonfat cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine dry ingredients.  In separate bowl, beat together wet ingredients.  Add to flour mixture; stir until smooth.  Pour into prepared pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 35 minutes.  Serves 16; .09 g fat per serving.

name: RICE KRISPIE TREAT
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. white Karo
1 3/4  c. peanut butter
4  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Put first 3 ingredients in skillet and bring to a boil. Remove and add Rice Krispies.  Spoon on wax paper.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. lean hamburger
1 (24 oz.)  pkg. hash browns, thawed
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
2  c. shredded cheese (save 1/2 c. for top)
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Saute hamburger and salt.  A little chopped onion may be added. Mix the potatoes, soup and sour cream with 1 1/2 cups of cheese all together with the meat.  Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Sprinkle with reserved 1/2 cup cheese.  Bake a few minutes more.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. baking soda
2  sticks butter
3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla or lemon extract
6  eggs
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Sift and measure flour; resift flour with soda.  Cream soft butter; add sugar and cream well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.  Stir in sour cream.  Add dry ingredients, 1/2 cup at a time, beating constantly.  Stir in flavoring.  Pour into well-greased and floured tube pan.  Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.  Place pan on rack to cool 5 minutes. Serve plain.  This cake freezes well.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. white sugar
2  Tbsp. corn syrup
1/3  c. water
1  c. peanut butter
preparation: Mix sugar, syrup and water together.  Bring to a rolling boil. Remove from heat.  Beat in the peanut butter until creamy.  Pour into an 8-inch square pan, lightly buttered.  Do not overcook.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. water
3 1/2  tsp. instant bouillon (chicken)
1 1/4  tsp. instant minced onion
1/2  tsp. celery seed
pepper to taste
1  c. instant potato flakes
preparation: Mix everything and simmer for 10 minutes, but do not boil. Garnish with parsley.

name: DOUBLE CHOCOLATE BARS
ingredients:
2  rolls refrigerated chocolate chip cookie dough
1 (15 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped walnuts
2/3  c. margarine/butter
2  c. brown sugar, packed
2  eggs, slightly beaten
2  tsp. vanilla
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Mix together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.  Add nuts and mix well.  Melt the margarine in a large bowl in the microwave (or on top of stove); add sugar.  Cool slightly and add beaten eggs and vanilla.  To the margarine and sugar mixture, add flour mix a small amount at a time, stirring well after each addition.  Turn dough out into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Sprinkle chocolate pieces over top and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  (Do not overbake.)  Cool in pan and cut into bars. Makes approximately 4 dozen.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. boiling water
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  c. sliced strawberries (fresh)
1  baked pie shell
3  Tbsp. strawberry jello
preparation: Mix together first 3 ingredients and cool (15 minutes) then add jello.  Cool and add strawberries.  Pour into baked pie shell and chill 2 to 3 hours.  Top with whipped cream.

name: CHEESE-STUFFED CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped green onions
1  tsp. dried parsley flakes
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
4  whole boneless chicken breasts, pounded to 1/8-inch thickness
4  slices (1 oz. each) Swiss cheese
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. seasoned fine dry bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  In small mixing bowl, combine green onions, parsley flakes, salt, pepper and garlic powder.  Set aside.  Place 1 piece of cheese in center of each chicken breast. Top with 1/4 of onion mixture.  Starting at narrow edge, roll each breast tightly, tucking in sides to enclose cheese and onion mixture.  Dredge with flour.  In small bowl, combine bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.  Dip each rolled breast in beaten egg, then in crumb mixture to coat.

name: CORN BREAD PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
1  tsp. chili powder
1  can tomato soup
3/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1  c. whole kernel corn, drained
1  tsp. salt
2  c. water
preparation: Brown beef and onion in large skillet.  Add soup, water, seasonings, corn and green pepper.  Mix and simmer 15 minutes. Fill greased baking dish 3/4 full with mixture, leaving room for corn bread topping.

name: LEMON POPPY SEED POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. poppy seed
1  c. butter, softened
1  c. buttermilk *
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. each:  baking soda, baking powder, salt and vanilla
4  tsp. lemon peel, grated
preparation: In large mixing bowl, combine all cake ingredients.  Beat at low speed until all ingredients are moistened.  Beat at high speed until smooth (2 minutes).  Pour into greased and floured 12-cup Bundt pan.  Bake at 325° for 55 to 65 minutes or until wooden pick comes out clean.  Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan.  Cool completely.  Drizzle glaze over cake.

name: SIMPLE POTATO DISH
ingredients:
3  Potatoes, peeled
1  envelope dry Onion Soup Mix
Salt
Pepper
Butter
preparation: Cut potatoes into chunks.  Place on heavy-duty foil. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and soup mix.  Dot with butter. Seal foil well. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

name: ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box orange cake mix
4  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1 small  can mandarin oranges, do not drain
1  stick oleo
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  box confectioners sugar
preparation: Mix the first  4 ingredients. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes in 3 round cake pans. Let cool and spread frosting.

name: COCKTAIL CHEESE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine, softened
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. red pepper
8  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
2  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Blend together first 5 ingredients.  Add Rice Krispies.  Use your hands and mix well.  Takes a lot of elbow grease.  Roll small balls and press flat on cookie sheet; mash with fork.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
1/2  c. each:  diced onion and green pepper
2  tsp. olive or vegetable oil
1  small garlic clove, minced
1  c. canned Italian tomatoes with liquid, drained and chopped (reserve liquid)
2  oz. uncooked instant rice
dash of each:  crushed red pepper, salt and pepper
preparation: In a 1-quart casserole, mix onion, bell pepper, oil and garlic. Microwave on High for 3 minutes, stirring once.  Add tomatoes, reserved liquid and rice.  Stir; cover and vent. Microwave on High 10 minutes or until rice is tender.  Remove from oven.  Stir in seasonings.  Let stand 1 minute.  Serves 2. Contains 192 calories, 5 gm fat and 264 mg sodium.

name: CRANBERRY APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1 3/4 to 2  c. sugar
1/3  c. flour
3  c. sliced, pared apples
2  c. fresh or frozen cranberries
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.   Mix sugar and flour in pastry lined 9-inch pie plate.  Alternately layer apples, cranberries and sugar mixture.    Cover with crust and bake 40 to 50 minutes.

name: BAKED APPLES
ingredients:
9  apples, cored
cinnamon
8  oz. diet soda (any flavor)
nutmeg
preparation: Place apples close together in an 8-inch square pan and pour soda over them.  Sprinkle cinnamon and nutmeg over them and bake until soft.  Try strawberry or raspberry cream soda.  Serve with a peak of whipped topping.  Apples are good hot or cold.

name: SAVORY POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  round bone chuck roast (about 3 1/2 lb.)
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
2  large onions, diced
2  minced garlic cloves
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes and liquid
1  c. water, divided
2  Tbsp. prepared horseradish
1  tsp. browning sauce
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Brown roast in oil in a Dutch oven.  Remove meat and set aside.  Saute onions and garlic in drippings until tender.  Return roast to Dutch oven and add cut up tomatoes and remaining ingredients using 1/2 water.  Cover and cook until meat is tender about 2 or 3 hours.  Remove roast to serving platter, keeping it warm.  Add flour and remaining water to pan juices.  Cook for about 5 minutes until thick and bubbly.  Slice roast and serve with gravy.

name: APPLE BUTTER
ingredients:
4  lb. apples
1 1/2  c. cider vinegar or apple juice
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Wash and cook apples until tender, then run in blender until smooth.  Put in saucepan; cook with cider vinegar, sugar and spices on low heat about 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.  Pour at once into jars and seal.  Process 10 minutes in boiling water bath at simmering temperature.

name: RHUBARB CRUNCH
ingredients:
4  c. rhubarb, cut up
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. flour
1  c. oatmeal
1 1/2  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. oleo
1/2  c. shortening
preparation: Sprinkle over first mixture.  Bake until bubbly and light brown in 350° oven.

name: HOT MEXICAN BEEF SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans, drained
1/2  c. Catalina French dressing
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  qt. shredded lettuce
1/2  c. sliced green onion
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown meat; drain.  Add onion; cook until tender.  Stir in beans, dressing, water and chili powder.  Simmer 15 minutes. Combine lettuce and green onion.  Add meat mixture and 1 1/2 cups cheese; mix lightly.  Top with remaining cheese.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: CRISP PICKLE SLICES
ingredients:
2  c. lime (in crock or stainless steel container)
2  gal. water
cucumbers (enough that water will cover)
2  qt. pure cider vinegar
9  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. celery salt
1  Tbsp. pickling spices
preparation: Soak cucumbers in lime solution for 24 hours.  Rinse and cover with fresh water.  Soak 3 hours.   Drain well.  Cover with vinegar and sugar mix.  Soak overnight, then boil gently 40 minutes or until clear.  Place in jar and seal.

name: TURKEY ALMOND CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetable in onion sauce
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Betty Crocker Noodles Almondine
2 1/3  c. boiling water
1 1/2  c. cubed, cooked turkey
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Prepare vegetables according to package directions, using milk.  Combine vegetables with the uncooked noodles from the mix, the packet of noodle sauce from the mix, boiling water, turkey and butter.  Mix very thoroughly.  Pour into a casserole; cover and bake at 375° for 25 minutes.  Uncover.  Sprinkle with potato chips; bake 5 or 10 minutes longer.  Let stand 5 minutes for serving.

name: CHICKEN AND VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1  lb. boneless chicken breast, cubed in small pieces
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  c. plus 1 Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. butter, melted
1/2  c. chopped celery
3/4  c. green pepper, chopped
3/4  c. onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  c. ketchup or tomato sauce
preparation: Mix flour, salt and pepper together.  Roll chicken in flour mixture and fry in oil until brown.  Add all wet ingredients, vegetables and brown sugar to chicken in pan.  Mix together and simmer 20 to 30 minutes until vegetables are tender.  Stir occasionally.  Serve over rice.

name: TOSSED TUNA SALAD
ingredients:
2 (6 1/2 oz. or 7 oz.)  cans tuna
1  clove garlic
2  c. chopped raw spinach
1  c. thinly sliced celery
1  c. bean sprouts, drained
1/2  c. chopped cucumber
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. French dressing
tomato wedges
preparation: Drain tuna.  Break into large pieces.  Rub the inside of a salad bowl with the cut surface of a clove of garlic.  Combine all ingredients except tomatoes.  Toss lightly.  Garnish with tomato wedges.  Yields 6 servings.

name: HOT SPICED CIDER
ingredients:
1/2  gal. fresh apple cider
4  cinnamon sticks
8  whole allspice
10  whole cloves
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Bring all ingredients to a boil; simmer for 1/2 hour and be sure to refrigerate leftover cider.

name: CHICKEN TORTILLA PIE
ingredients:
1  medium green pepper, halved and seeded
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. 6-inch corn tortillas
3  boneless, skinned chicken breasts, cooked and shredded (12 oz.)
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. Cheddar cheese soup
1/2  c. mild Mexican salsa
1  c. milk
2  eggs
1  tomato, diced
preparation: Slice 1/2 green pepper into thin strips; set aside for garnish. Coarsely chop for the other half.  Overlap 6 tortillas in circular pattern on bottom of 10-inch quiche dish.  Top with chicken strips, 1/2 cup of the shredded cheese, chopped green peppers and half of the diced tomato.  Beat together soup and salsa in medium-sized bowl until blended.  Slowly stir in milk until smooth.  Lightly beat in eggs.  Measure 1 1/2 cups of egg-milk mixture; reserve. Pour remaining egg-milk mixture over top of chicken.  Arrange remaining tortillas over top.  Pour reserved 1 1/2 cups egg-milk mixture over all.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Cover tightly with foil.  Bake in preheated moderate oven (375°) for 40 minutes. Lower oven temperature to 350°.  Uncover, bake for 20 minutes or until bubbly hot.  Garnish with remaining tomato and green pepper strips.

name: CHOCOLATE CASHEW CLUSTER
ingredients:
1  lb. semi-sweet chocolate
1  c. cashews
preparation: Place chocolate in 2-quart glass microwave dish.  Cook on High 2 1/2 minutes.  Add cashews; stir until blended.  Drop mixture by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.  Let stand until firm.  (If mixture in bowl becomes too firm, cook on 30 power for 1 to 2 minutes.)

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
1  liter 7-Up
1  can chunk pineapple
1/2  gal. apple juice
1/2  gal. grape juice
1/2  gal. cranberry juice
1  qt. rainbow sherbet
preparation: Put soda, pineapple and juice in punch bowl.  Add sherbet. Stir.

name: SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
1 (2 lb.)  can sweet potatoes (with juice)
1  egg
1/3  c. brown sugar
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
dash of salt
3  Tbsp. butter
marshmallows
preparation: Whip all ingredients, except marshmallows, until smooth.  Cook at 375° about 30 minutes.  Top with marshmallows and brown them.

name: SEVEN MINUTE ICING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  egg whites
5  Tbsp. water
1/8  tsp. cream of tartar
6  large marshmallows, cut in small pieces
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put all ingredients, except vanilla, in top of boiler.  Stir until well mixed.  Place over simmering, but not boiling, water. Cook, beating constantly with electric mixer at high speed, for about 7 minutes, or until icing becomes stiff and glossy.  Remove from heat and add vanilla.  Stir until blended.

name: EASY PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. milk
1  qt. peaches
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
preparation: Melt  margarine in dish.  Put  in  peaches.  Mix  other ingredients together.  Pour over  peaches,	then  cook at 350° until golden brown.

name: CHEESE CRACKERS
ingredients:
2  c. Monterey Jack cheese
1  c. butter
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cayenne or chili powder
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: In food processor, combine cheese and butter.  In a separate bowl, mix remaining ingredients.  Add to processor; process until just combined.  Remove and form into 2 long, skinny rolls.  Chill (up to several days).  Cut into 1/4-inch slices; bake for 15 minutes.  Sprinkle with chili powder.  Makes 60.

name: PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking soda
2  c. sugar
1  can crushed pineapple (take out 3 Tbsp. juice)
preparation: Mix well. Bake in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: CHEESE, PEPPER AND HERB-STUFFED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
4  pork loin chops, cut 3/4 to 1-inch thick, trimmed
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1/4  c. chopped red bell pepper
2  tsp. minced fresh rosemary or 1/2 to 3/4 tsp. dried rosemary, crushed
1 1/2  tsp. minced fresh thyme or 1/2 tsp. dried thyme, crushed
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: To cut pockets in chops, place on cutting board and with a sharp knife, cut horizontally through each chop nearly to the bone.  Stir together cheese, red bell pepper, rosemary and thyme. Divide mixture into 4 portions, stuffing 1 portion in each pocket.  Close pockets with small skewers or wooden picks.  Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat source for 14 to 18 minutes, turning once. (Grill by placing on grid over medium coals.  Grill 16 to 18 minutes, turning once, until pork is cooked through, but still slightly pink.) Season with salt and pepper, if desired.

name: PEAR CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. salad oil
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. thinly sliced pears
preparation: Combine sugar, eggs and oil.  Beat well after each addition. Stir in vanilla and pears.  Bake in tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Remove from pan and allow to cool.  Glaze with 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar mixed with 2 to 4 tablespoons milk.

name: LASAGNE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef, browned
1 1/2  qt. sauce
1  pkg. lasagne noodles, cooked
2  lb. Ricotta cheese
1  pkg. Scamorze cheese, sliced
4  eggs
preparation: Combine Ricotta cheese, eggs, 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper. In a lightly oiled 9 x 13-inch baking dish, pour sauce (1/2 cup) on bottom and spread evenly.  Place first layer of noodles on top. Spread a heavy layer of sauce and meat.   On top of this, spread evenly part of the Ricotta cheese mixture.  Place a layer of Scamorze cheese.  Now, repeat these layers until the top.

name: ELAINE'S CAKE MIX COOKIES
ingredients:
1  box cake mix (any flavor)
2  eggs, beaten
1  stick margarine
1  Tbsp. water
preparation: Cut margarine into cake mix until it resembles pie dough (crumbly).  Add beaten eggs and water.  If mixture is too thick, add another tablespoon of water.  Drop on greased cookie sheet and flatten with the bottom of a glass that has been dipped in water and then sugar.  Bake at 350° for about 10 minutes.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can chunk pineapple
1  pkg. frozen peach slices
1  pkg. frozen whole strawberries
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
2  to 3 fresh bananas
preparation: Drain pineapple and reserve juice to mix with pudding mix. Combine frozen fruits, pineapple and bananas.  Mix thoroughly with the pudding mixture.

name: SWISS HAM RING
ingredients:
1  c. fresh or frozen broccoli
1/4  c. chopped parsley or 2 Tbsp. parsley flakes
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  tsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. (3 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese
1  can Hormel chunk ham, drained and separated
1 (8 oz.)  can crescent dinner rolls
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Cook and drain broccoli.  In bowl, mix parsley, onion, mustard, margarine and lemon juice.  Add cheese, ham and broccoli.  Set aside.

name: ROTEL CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. Boil in Bag rice
1 large  can tomato juice
1  can pinto beans
1  pkg. chili seasoning mix
1  can chopped and diced Ro-Tel
shredded cheese
preparation: Brown and drain ground beef.  Prepare rice according to package directions.  Add meat and rice to the other ingredients. Heat on stove top or slowly in crock-pot.  Serve hot with cheese sprinkled on top of individual servings.

name: COOKIE JAR COOKIES
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  c. butter, softened
1  egg
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. quick cooking oats
1  c. crisp rice cereal
1  c. flaked coconut
1/2  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In a large mixer bowl combine all ingredients, except oats, rice cereal, coconut and nuts.  Beat at low speed, scraping bowl often until well mixed (2 to 3 minutes). By hand, stir in all remaining ingredients.   Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls 2-inches apart onto cookie sheets.   Bake for 13 to 16 minutes or until browned.  Yields 4 dozen cookies.

name: SWEET-N-SOUR SAUCE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. water
dash of garlic powder or minced fresh garlic
drop of hot sauce (if desired)
1  Tbsp. ketchup
1 1/2 to 2  tsp. cornstarch (extra if ketchup is increased)
preparation: Bring all ingredients to a boil, stirring until thickened. Flavor to suit your taste with horseradish, spicy mustard, soy sauce, more ketchup, etc.  Make several flavors or increase recipe depending on number of people to be served.   Makes 1/2 cup.

name: CHICKEN ROTEL
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. vermicelli noodles, cooked
4  chicken breasts, cooked and cut in bite-size pieces
preparation: Combine mushroom and chicken soups, tomatoes and cheese in microwave-safe bowl. Microwave the mixture until the cheese has melted. In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer cooked noodles, chicken and cheese mixture. Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

name: DOUBLE BOILER BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
4  slices bread, buttered and cubed
2  eggs
2  c. milk
dash of salt
vanilla
preparation: Put sugar and cubed bread into double boiler.  Mix eggs, milk, salt and vanilla and pour over bread.  Cook for 1 1/2 hours.  Do not mix ingredients.

name: OH SO GOOD OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  beaten eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
3  c. rolled oats (uncooked)
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Cream together shortening, brown sugar and white sugar.  Then add eggs and vanilla.  Then sift together and add flour, soda and salt.  Add oats, nuts and raisins and mix well.  Refrigerate. Take spoonfuls and shape into balls.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.  Makes 5 dozen.

name: BEEF, PORK AND KIDNEY BEAN STEW
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. dried kidney beans
2  lb. beef chuck, cut in pieces
1  tsp. vegetable oil
2  tsp. butter (unsalted is best)
2  lb. boned pork, cut in pieces
2  onions, chopped
2  bell peppers, chopped
1  tsp. marjoram
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. rosemary
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  clove garlic, minced
3 1/2  c. beef broth
1/4  c. tomato paste
1/4  c. molasses
preparation: Combine beans with 3  cups  water  and bring to a boil. Soak for 1 hour and drain.  Add 3 more cups water;  bring to a boil and simmer 1  1/2  hours  or  until tender.  Drain beans. Brown  beef in oil  and  butter.  Remove  and  brown  pork  in drippings. Cook onions,  garlic,  peppers  and spices in some oil, after removing pork.  Add  more  butter  if  needed.  Add flour, then broth.  Bring  to  a boil and simmer until mixture thickens.  Add beef,  pork, tomato sauce and molasses.  Simmer 3 hours or more. Add  beans  and simmer 1/2 hour.  Serve over rice.  Add salt if desired.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. Tater Tots
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: Brown hamburger; drain.  Spread in cake pan and pour mushroom soup on hamburger.  Top with Tater Tots.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

name: BAKED RACCOON
ingredients:
1  raccoon
1  tsp. red pepper
1  tsp. black pepper
2  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. garlic powder
onion, sliced
carrots, quartered
potatoes, quartered
preparation: Parboil coon for 30 minutes in salt water; drain and place in shallow baking dish.  Blend spices and liberally cover coon. Surround with sliced onions.  Cover and bake at 300° for 45 minutes.  Place carrots and potatoes in juice and continue to bake until vegetables are tender.  Uncover and broil to brown.

name: CHICKEN SUPREME
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
1  can creamed mushroom soup
1  can condensed milk
1  c. mushrooms
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  pkg. chicken stuffing (Stove Top)
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook  chicken until done.  Debone.  Layer in casserole. Mix soup  and milk with garlic powder.	Add mushrooms.	Put on top of chicken.  Add stuffing and cheese.	Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: RED-EYE POT ROAST
ingredients:
4 to 5  lb. boneless pot roast (rump or chuck)
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. dry red wine
2  pieces orange peel (1 x 2-inch, orange part only)
4  whole cloves
2  cinnamon sticks
1  clove garlic, minced or mashed
12  small boiling onions, peeled
preparation: Place meat in Dutch oven.  Combine tomato sauce and 1/2 cup wine and add to meat along with orange peel, spices and garlic. Cover and cook at 300° for 3 hours.  Add remaining wine and onions.  Cover and cook for 1 hour longer or until meat and vegetables are tender.  Remove meat and let stand a few minutes before slicing.  Skim excess fat off juices.

name: ENCHILADA'S
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
2  c. chopped olives
2  c. chopped onions
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  cans Las Palmas enchilada sauce
24  corn tortillas
preparation: Fry hamburger, drain and set aside.  Put olives, onions and cheese in separate bowls.  Have two large, heavy frypans on stove. In one have hot oil and in the other hot enchilada sauce.  Fry tortillas 1 or 2 seconds in oil; then into hot sauce.  Remove to board and stuff with meat, olives, cheese and onions.  Roll and place in oblong pan, close together.  Sprinkle with any remaining cheese over top.  Pour remaining sauce over all.  Garnish with whole olives.  Bake at 350° until good and hot.  May be frozen for future use.

name: EGGPLANT PARMESAN
ingredients:
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  medium to large onion, chopped fine
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. thyme
2  whole bay leaves
2  tsp. basil
preparation: Make ahead, either early in the day or a day before and refrigerate until used.

name: TOFU CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
2  lb. tofu
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. dried pineapple
2  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. water
1 1/2  c. granola, crumbled
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Prepare crust by crushing granola in blender to make 1 1/4 cups of crumbs.  Press into a 9-inch pie plate.

name: BAKED CORN
ingredients:
1  can cream-style corn (yellow or white)
3  eggs
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. butter, melted
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine ingredients in a greased casserole dish.  Bake in a 350° oven approximately 1 hour.  Top will be puffed and nicely browned.

name: SPAGGETTI(Kids Kitchen)
ingredients:
noodles
tomato stuff in can
lettus
tomatoes
salad dressing
preparation: Get noodles and tomato stuff in a can.  Get some lettus and get you some tomatoes and get some salad dressing on it.  Then you wind the winder up what goes ding.  When it goes ding, tick, tick, tick when it goes ding it's ready.

name: DELICIOUS BRAT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. celery, chopped
4  medium potatoes
3  large bratwurst
1 (16 oz.)  can green beans, drained
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  can milk
preparation: Saute celery until partially done.  In a well-buttered 2-quart casserole dish, place potatoes, thinly sliced.  Cut brats into 1-inch pieces.  Cook thoroughly.  Drain grease off and place on top of sliced potatoes.  Place green beans and celery over brats. Mix soup and milk.  Stir well and pour over ingredients in casserole dish.  Bake at 375° for 1 1/2 hours.  Can use Italian sausage.  Serves 4.

name: POPSICLES
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jell-O (any flavor)
1  pkg. Kool-Aid (same flavor as jello)
1  c. sugar
2  c. hot water
preparation: Mix all together until Jell-O and Kool-Aid are completely dissolved, then add 2 cups of cold water and stir.  Pour into mold and freeze.  Makes 18 popsicles.

name: VIRGINIA CRAB CAKES
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh crabmeat
2/3  c. soft bread crumbs
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/2  tsp. salt
little dry mustard
oil for frying
preparation: Combine  crabmeat,  bread  crumbs,  eggs, onion, mayonnaise, parsley,  salt  and mustard.  Mix well.  For each cake, spoon approximately  1/3	cup  of  mix  into 1/2-inch hot oil. Shape into  patties, pressing lightly with turner.  Fry 3 to 5 minutes, turning once.

name: "ONO"LICIOUS CORNBREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. soft margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  c. Bisquick
6  Tbsp. cornmeal
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add eggs and mix well.  Add Bisquick, cornmeal and milk.  Mix very well.  Grease and flour pan (9 x 13-inch).  Bake at 350° (preheated oven) for approximately 35 minutes, or until golden color on top.

name: BARBARA'S BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1  (10 oz.) frozen chopped broccoli
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. stuffing bread crumbs, fried in 2 Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook broccoli in salt water 8 minutes until tender.  Drain. Blend soup and flour.  Add sour cream, onion, salt and pepper. Top with stuffing.  Bake at 350° uncovered 30 to 35 minutes.

name: SOUR CREAM CHICKEN NACHOS
ingredients:
1/2  c. sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz process cheese spread
1/4  c. picante sauce (mild or hot)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. tortilla chips
2  c. shredded lettuce
1  c. chopped tomato
1/2  c. pitted ripe olive slices
1  c. chopped cooked chicken
preparation: Combine sour cream, cheese spread and picante sauce in saucepan; stir over low heat until cheese spread is melted.   Stir in chicken.  On serving platter, layer half of chips, cheese spread mixture, lettuce, tomato and olives; repeat layers.  Top with additional sour cream, if desired.

name: NO FAIL PIE CRUST(5 Crusts)
ingredients:
5  c. flour
1  c. water
1  egg
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. shortening
preparation: Cut flour, shortening and salt together.  Add cold water, egg and vinegar.  Mix together.  Roll out and bake as directed.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. cream cheese
1  small onion, grated finely
1/4  tsp. horseradish
dash of Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. cocktail sauce
1/2  lb. boiled shrimp, chopped into small pieces
preparation: Cream the softened cheese.  Add next 4 ingredients and mix well.  Fold in shrimp.  Chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

name: THE IMPOSSIBLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. milk
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. biscuit mix
4  eggs
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 (4 oz.)  can flake coconut
1/3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In blender container, combine milk, sugar, biscuit mix, butter, eggs and vanilla.  Cover; blend on low speed for 3 minutes.  Pour into greased 9-inch round or square pan.  Let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.  Sprinkle with coconut and pecans.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Cool on wire rack.  Yields 1 cake.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large head cabbage
2  to 3 medium sized onions
1  large block medium sharp cheese
1/2  stick margarine
dash of Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. evaporated milk
3  eggs
preparation: In a large pot, boil cabbage and onions (cut up both as if frying) in lightly salted water until cabbage is tender.  In casserole dish, cut up cheese and margarine (just as if fixing macaroni and cheese).  When cabbage is tender, drain off water and put hot cabbage in dish with cheese and margarine until cheese is good and stringy.  Then add pepper, milk, eggs and the Worcestershire sauce.  Stir well and bake in preheated oven at 350° until a golden brown on top.  Cool slightly before serving.

name: CROWD SIZE - DIET RED APPLESAUCE SALAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugarless red Jell-O
6  c. water
4  c. applesauce
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. red hots
preparation: Heat applesauce.  Dissolve Jell-O and cinnamon in applesauce. Let cool.  Add cold water and stir.  Set in refrigerator.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. self-rising flour
3  c. carrots, shredded
1  c. nuts
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pkg. 10xx sugar
1 1/4  c. vegetable oil
10  oz. cream cheese
preparation: Mix sugar, flour and cinnamon together. Add carrots. Add eggs, one at a time. Add vanilla and oil. Mix until combined. Add 1/2 cup of nuts and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until well done. Let cool until frosting is ready.

name: FRIED CABBAGE
ingredients:
6  c. shredded cabbage (long shreds)
1  c. thinly-sliced bell pepper strips
1  c. onion, cut into thin strips
3 to 4  Tbsp. oil
2 to 3  Tbsp. lite soy sauce
3/4  tsp. Cavender's Green seasoning
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Combine the cabbage, bell pepper, and onion.  Rinse and drain.  Pour the oil into a large skillet and add cabbage mixture. Stir to mix.  Cover.  Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is wilted and peppers/onions are tender.  Sprinkle soy sauce over top and mix.  Taste and add Cavender's (or you can use salt & black pepper). Stir in butter. 4 to 6 servings.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1/2  c. water
4  eggs
1  Tbsp. plain flour
3/4  c. salad oil
1/2  c. frozen strawberries
preparation: Sprinkle flour over white cake mix.  Add Jell-O, salad oil, water and frozen strawberries, thawed to mushy stage.  Mix thoroughly with electric beater.  Add 1 egg at a time until all 4 eggs have been added.  Divide batter into 2 (9-inch) cake pans. Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes.

name: "IN A JIFFY" JIFFY SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour an 8-inch brownie pan. Mix by hand all 3 ingredients together.  Pour mixture into prepared pan and bake for 30 minutes.  Let cool completely and cut into squares.  Yields 9 squares.

name: SEAFOOD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. light cream
1  c. Pepperidge Farm herb crumbs
2  hard-cooked eggs
1  c. crabmeat, tuna, shrimp, lobster or Sea Legs
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
bread crumbs
preparation: Mix mayonnaise and cream.  Add herb crumbs and other ingredients.  Put in buttered casserole.  Cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serves 6.  (Double for 12 but use only 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise.)

name: TROPICAL (AND DELICIOUS) CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. finely chopped bell pepper
1  Tbsp. finely minced onion
1 small  can crushed pineapple (drain, then squeeze juice out)
seasoned salt to taste
preparation: Thoroughly mix with hands, not mixer.  Form into ball.  Roll in chopped nuts or coconut.  Serve with fancy crackers.  (Easier to form, if chilled first.)

name: 5 MINUTE REESE'S PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  tub Cool Whip
1  small tub cream cheese
1  pie crust (cooked)
1 small  box Reese's peanut butter cups, crushed
preparation: Mix in a bowl Cool Whip, sugar and cream cheese.  Beat 2 minutes.  Add Reese's peanut butter cups, crushed.  Fold in, pour in pie crust.  Refrigerate and serve.

name: CHEESE AND VEGETABLE CHOWDER
ingredients:
4  c. water
3  c. shredded cabbage
1  c. finely chopped Canadian-style bacon
2  large carrots, sliced
1 (5.5 oz.)  pkg. au gratin potato mix
1  c. milk
1  tsp. cornstarch
1  c. frozen cut green beans
preparation: In a 4-quart Dutch oven, combine the water, cabbage, bacon, carrots and dry potato mix with sauce.  Bring to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.  Combine the milk and cornstarch.  Add to soup along with frozen beans.  Simmer, covered, for 10 to 15 minutes more until beans are tender.  Makes 4 to 6 main dish servings.

name: PINEAPPLE DESSERT
ingredients:
1  yellow Jiffy cake mix
1  (3 3/4 oz.) vanilla instant pudding
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
2  c. milk
1 (20 oz.)  can sweetened crushed pineapple, drained
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cake as directed and bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix together pudding, cream cheese and milk; beat until smooth.  Spread on cooled cake.  Top with pineapple and Cool Whip.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: GUACAMOLE DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
1  large ripe avocado, peeled and mashed
1  tomato, seeded and chopped
2  Tbsp. each:  chopped onion and chopped green chilies
1  tsp. lemon or lime juice
preparation: Mix ingredients until well blended.  Refrigerate.  Serve with tortilla chips.  Makes 2 cups.  Prep time:  15 minutes, plus refrigerating.

name: TAMALE PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1/2  c. bell pepper, finely chopped
1/3  c. celery, chopped
1  can tomatoes
1  can drained hot chili beans
1  can black olives, drained
chili powder to taste
salt and pepper to taste
1  box Jiffy corn bread
preparation: Brown beef, celery, onion and green pepper and drain.  Add tomatoes, beans and seasonings and cook until thickens a little.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. peanut butter
1  c. powdered sugar
1/3  c. flour
2/3  c. granulated sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
3  slightly beaten egg yolks
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Blend peanut butter and powdered sugar together; spread 2/3 of this in baked pie shell.

name: DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. lukewarm water
1 1/2  c. milk
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. shortening, melted
5 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Warm the water to lukewarm; add yeast to soften.  Heat the milk and pour into mixing bowl with sugar, salt and shortening; mix well.  When mixture has cooled to lukewarm, add 2 cups flour and beat well.  Add softened yeast and beaten egg; mix carefully. Add remaining flour and mix until a soft dough forms.  Turn out on a floured board and knead until satiny in appearance.  Put dough in a large, oiled bowl (cover with plate) and let rise at room temperature for about 3 to 4 hours or overnight in refrigerator. Turn out on floured board and knead again.  Roll flat, cut rolls, fold in half with a pat of margarine in middle and on top.  Bake. Recipe can be halved.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. hash browns
16  oz. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick butter
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Place potatoes in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Season with salt and pepper.  In a bowl, add minced onions and mix together sour cream and cream of chicken soup; mix these items together. Pour soup mixture over potatoes; sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and butter that you have cut into cubes.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until all is completely warm and cheese is melted.

name: FRIED PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1  qt. all-purpose flour
1  can evaporated milk
2  eggs
2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. Crisco
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix together.  Refrigerate until chilled.  Roll out to be filled with fruit pie filling of your choice.  Makes approximately 30 pies.  Fry pies in Puritan or Crisco oil for best pies.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2/3  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. almond extract
3  eggs
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Let cream cheese stand at room temperature until soft.  Gradually add sugar and mix thoroughly. Break eggs into cream cheese, one at a time, stirring after each. Add almond extract and mix thoroughly.  Pour into graham cracker crust and bake for 50 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: BROCCOLI-CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
1 (8 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
dash or two pepper
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
3  Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. salt
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large bowl, beat eggs slightly; beat in both cheeses, flour, salt and pepper.  Drain broccoli well, patting dry with paper towels.  Stir into egg mixture.  Pour into greased  9 x 9-inch baking dish, spreading evenly with spoon. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until mixture is firm and pulls away from sides of pan.  Loosen edges with spatula, slice and serve.

name: CHEESE FRITTERS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. Gruyere cheese, cut in finger size sticks
freshly ground black pepper
1 1/2  c. dry white wine
enough oil for deep frying
1 1/4  c. flour
1/2  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  egg white, beaten stiff
preparation: Place cheese in bowl and sprinkle with pepper.  Add 1/2 cup of white wine and set aside to marinate for 1 hour.

name: TORTILLA ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
8  oz. sour cream
8  oz. cream cheese
4  oz. diced green chilies, drained
4  oz. chopped black olives, drained
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. chopped green onions
1  jar diced pimentos
garlic salt to taste
flour tortillas
salsa
preparation: Mix ingredients, except salsa; spread on tortillas.  Roll up and chill.  Cut tortillas in 3/4-inch slices and serve with salsa for dipping.

name: SUNSHINE CAKE
ingredients:
6  large eggs, separated
1 1/4  c. sugar
1 heaping  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2 to 1  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
1  c. flour, sifted 3 times
preparation: Beat egg whites and salt until creamy.  Add cream of tartar; beat until stiff.  Add sugar gradually and mix after each addition.  Set aside.  Beat egg yolks with vanilla until yellow. Add yolks to egg white mixture and mix.  Fold in the flour.  Bake in an ungreased tube pan in a moderate oven at 375° for 15 minutes, then at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: SLICED BAKED POTATOES(Quick and Easy)
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. melted butter
2  Tbsp. herbs (fresh parsley, chives and thyme) or 2 tsp.  dried herbs
4  Tbsp. grated Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Peel potatoes if tough skin, otherwise scrub and rinse.  Cut into thin slices but not all the way through (use spoon handle to prevent cutting through).  Put potatoes in baking dish, fan them slightly.  Drizzle with butter, sprinkle herbs and salt.  Bake at 425° for 50 to 60 minutes.  Remove from oven, sprinkle with cheese.  Bake another 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned and cheese is melted.

name: SALMON CROQUETTES
ingredients:
1 large  can salmon
2  eggs
1  small onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix salmon, eggs, salt and pepper to taste and onion together. Add enough cornmeal to make mixture stiff enough to shape into croquettes.  Fry in hot skillet with deep Crisco oil.

name: BETTER THAN ROBERT REDFORD
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1/2  large tub Cool Whip
1 large  pkg. chocolate instant pudding
1 large  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
3  c. milk
1/2  large tub Cool Whip
preparation: Mix and press the first 3 ingredients into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook 15 minutes at 350°.  Cool.

name: CHOCOLATE MARSHMALLOW PEANUT BUTTER CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
3/4  c. crushed peanuts
preparation: Mix and pat into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: REFRIGERATOR FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. vanilla wafers, crushed
16  oz. candied pineapple, chopped
8  oz. candied dates, chopped
1  qt. chopped pecans
1  c. sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Mix well all ingredients.  Press into 2 loaf pans lined with foil.  Stor in refrigerator tightly covered.  Slice thinly.

name: CABBAGE ROLLS(Holupky)
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage
3  lb. meat (ground beef or pork)
3  whole eggs
1  c. raw rice
3  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/4  lb. bacon, fried and chopped
2  qt. tomato soup
preparation: Core and wash head of cabbage, place in a large kettle and cover with water.  Put a lid on and boil until cabbage is wilted. Cook rice until tender and absorbed all water.  Drain and cool head of cabbage.  Combine meat and cooked rice.  Cut stiff vein from cabbage leaf and place a small amount of meat mixture in center.  Fold over and roll leaf up.  Place in roaster and cover with tomato soup and cover with lid.  Bake at 350° for 2 hours. May serve with mashed  potatoes.

name: CHOCOLATE-PEANUT BUTTER SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. white Karo syrup
1  c. white sugar
1  c. peanut butter
6  c. Rice Krispies
milk chocolate for topping
preparation: Bring Karo syrup and sugar to a boil, then add peanut butter. Stir to mix well and add Rice Krispies.  Press into cake pan. Melt milk chocolate in microwave for 2 minutes.  Spread over mixture.

name: CARAMEL OATMEAL CHEWIES
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. Quaker oats (quick or old fashioned, uncooked)
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt (optional)
3/4  c. (1 1/2 sticks) margarine, melted
1  c. chopped peanuts
1  c. (6 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1 (12.5 oz.)  jar (1 c.) caramel ice cream topping
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Combine oats, flour, brown sugar, soda and salt; mix well.  Stir in margarine, mixing until well blended.  Reserve 1 cup; press remaining onto bottom of prepared pan.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown; cool 10 minutes.  Top with nuts and chocolate pieces.  Mix caramel topping and 1/4 cup flour until smooth; drizzle over chocolate pieces to within 1/4-inch of pan edges. Sprinkle with reserved oat mixture.  Bake an additional 18 to 22 minutes or until golden brown. Cool; chill until set.

name: CHOW CHOW
ingredients:
4  c. lima beans
4  c. green beans
4  c. chopped cabbage
4  c. cauliflower florets
4  c. sliced carrots
4  c. celery chunks
4  c. sliced red and green peppers
1  Tbsp. mustard seed
4  c. small white onions
4  c. cucumber chunks
4  c. corn
4  c. sugar
2  c. yellow wax beans
3  c. vinegar
1  c. water
1  Tbsp. pickling spices
1  Tbsp. celery seed
preparation: Cook each vegetable separately until tender, but not mushy. Drain; rinse with cold water to stop its cooking and preserve color.  Drain; layer into a large dishpan.  Combine sugar, vinegar, water and spices into stock pot.  Bring to a boil.  After sugar dissolves, spoon in vegetables and boil for 5 minutes.  Stir gently so you don't break up the vegetables, but mix them well. Spoon into hot sterilized jars and seal.

name: SUGAR-FREE JELLO SALAD OR DESSERT
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  boxes sugar-free raspberry jello
sugar-free frozen raspberries (approximately 12 oz. pkg.)
2  bananas, mashed
1 large  can pineapple, crushed
1  (16 oz.) large tub sour cream (nonfat is available)
1  packet Equal
2  c. boiling water
preparation: Mix raspberry jello with 2 cups boiling water, stir until completely dissolved.  Add frozen raspberries and stir until thawed.  Add mashed banana and pineapple.  Put half the mixture in large clear dish and place in refrigerator.  Leave rest of mixture on counter (it will not set up too quick).  When first half of mixture is set, put Equal into sour cream, spread over set jello, then very carefully pour remaining jello over sour cream.  Return to refrigerator to set.

name: PASTA IN WIENER RAFTS
ingredients:
16  oz. pkg. Green Giant frozen Pasta Accents Cream Cheddar
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. prepared mustard
10  wieners
1  tsp. margarine or butter
preparation: Prepare Pasta Accents as directed on package until vegetables are crisp-tender.  Stir in mustard.  Keep warm.  Meanwhile, make 4 slashes, 1 inch apart, on 1 side of each wiener, cutting to 1/4-inch of opposite side.

name: MINIATURE REUBENS
ingredients:
8  oz. loaf party rye bread slices
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. chili sauce
1/2  tsp. horseradish
1/2  small green pepper, minced
1/4  lb. thinly sliced corned beef
8  oz. can sauerkraut, drained
8  oz. pkg. sliced Swiss cheese
preparation: Arrange bread slices on large cookie sheet.  Bake 5 minutes at 350°.  Remove from cookie sheet.  Spread each with mixture of mayonnaise, chili sauce, horseradish and green pepper.  Top each slice with some corned beef, sauerkraut, then cheese, cutting corned beef and cheese slices to fit.  Bake about 10 minutes more or until cheese is melted.  Serve immediately.  Makes about 3 dozen.

name: PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak, cut in thin strips
2 to 3  Tbsp. oil
1  clove garlic, minced
4 to 5  Tbsp. Kikkoman soy sauce
1  tsp. salt
2  c. water
1  c. green pepper, cut in 1-inch pieces
1  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Brown beef in hot oil; add garlic and cook a few minutes.  Add soy sauce, salt, onion and 1 1/2 cups water.  Cook until meat is tender, approximately 30 to 35 minutes.  Add green pepper and cook ten minutes longer.  Blend cornstarch with 1/2 cup water.  Stir into meat and allow to thicken.  Serve over hot rice.

name: POTATO CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. (not oleo) butter, softened
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
3 1/2  c. flour
1  pkg. crushed potato chips
1 3/4  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Cream butter, sugar, flour and vanilla.  Add potato chips. Make small balls and press out on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° about 12 to 15 minutes.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar while warm but not hot.  Makes 1 dozen.

name: SUE'S MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
4  lb. ground chuck
2  Tbsp. paprika
4  eggs
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs or crackers
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. black pepper
2  large onions, finely chopped
1 small  can evaporated milk
1/2  c. bell pepper, finely chopped
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. ground red pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Roll into small balls. Roll balls in flour and fry them until they are lightly browned.  (I use a medium boiler and deep fry them, it's easier.)  Add them to the sauce.  These are the best meat balls and sauce.  Put over spaghetti or fix meat ball hoagies and top with Mozzarella cheese. Fix ahead and freeze.  (I freeze them in quart containers.)

name: BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. unprocessed bran
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. honey
1  egg, beaten
1  c. whole wheat flour
1  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. milk or plain yogurt
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Stir together the bran, flour, raisins, soda, baking powder and baking soda; set aside.  Blend milk, honey, oil and egg. Add these to dry ingredients. Stir just until moistened. Spoon into greased muffin pan. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until muffins pull away from sides of pan.

name: CLASSIC GLORIFIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3  lb. broiler-fryer chicken, cut up
1  Tbsp. magarine or butter, melted
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's condensed cream of chicken, cream of celery, cream of mushroom, golden mushroom or cream of broccoli soup
chopped parsley for garnish
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Meanwhile, in 12 x 8-inch baking dish, arrange chicken, skin side up.  Drizzle with margarine.  A dash of Italian seasoning in the margarine is very tasty, too.  Bake 40 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY ICE CREAM
ingredients:
3  c. fresh strawberries
2  eggs
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  c. half and half
1/4  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. whipping cream
preparation: Wash strawberries.  Remove and discard caps.  Puree berries in blender or food processor.  Set aside.  In a large bowl, beat eggs until thick and lemon colored.  Beat in sugar, half and half, vanilla and whipping cream.  Stir in blended strawberries.  Pour into ice cream canister.  Freeze in ice cream maker according to manufacturer's directions.  Makes about 2 quarts.

name: HEATH TORTE
ingredients:
1  box devil's food cake mix
10  original Heath bars, crushed
1  carton whipping cream
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Bake a devil's food cake according to the package directions. Cool, then split the layers, using thread.

name: HOMINY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. onion powder
2  c. milk, heated
1  c. grated cheese
1 (29 oz.)  can hominy, drained
1  c. Ritz crackers crumbs
preparation: Melt butter.  Slowly blend in flour over low heat.  Add hominy. Pour in greased casserole dish.  Put cracker crumbs on top.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
8  boiled potatoes
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
1  c. parsley
1  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped onion
preparation: Mix all ingredients and chill for 24 hours.

name: BREAD SOUP
ingredients:
2  tbsp. butter
1/2  cup of each onion, carrots and celery chopped
4  cups bread cubed and roasted in oven (I use leftover white bread)
2  Qt. chicken stock (water can be used)
Salt and Pepper to taste
preparation: Put butter in large pot; add onions, carrots and celery.  Stir till hot.  Add bread.  Stir add water or stock. cook for about 45 minutes.  Stir occasionally.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
4  bunches broccoli
1  medium red onion, chopped
1/2 to 1  lb. bacon, fried and chopped
1  c. yellow cheese, shredded
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Wash and cut off tops of broccoli.  Discard stems.  Cut into bite size pieces and put into large bowl.  Add onion and bacon. Add 1 cup cheese.  Mix mayonnaise and sugar in a small bowl until well blended.  Add to broccoli mixture and stir to coat.  Serve at once or chill.

name: CEVICHE
ingredients:
8  oz. Scallops (Finely Diced)
8  oz. Firm Flesh White Fish (Snapper, Dorado, Grouper)
8  oz. Small Shrimp
1/2  c. Fresh Lime Juice
1/4  c. Fresh Lemon Juice
2  Ripe Tomatoes (Diced)
1  Serrano Chili (Minced)
1  Anaheim Chili (Minced)
1  Tbsp Minced Fresh Cilantro
1/2  c. Finely Chopped Onions
2  Spring Onions
2  Tbsp. Olive Oil
1/2  tsp. Oregano
1/2  tsp. Salt
preparation: 1. Dip fish and other seafoods in boiling water and remove any bones/shells.   2. Put fish in non-aluminum bowl and cover with lime/lemon     juices and allow to stand (refrigerated) for an hour.   3. Drain fish/seafood and rinse in cold water.   4. Stir together remaining ingredients in a non aluminum     bowl and add fish/seafood and refrigerate (covered) for     an hour or so. 5. Serve chilled with Tortilla chips or bread.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. yellow meal
2  eggs, well beaten
1  c. sweet milk
1/2  tsp. soda
3/4  tsp. salt
1 (No. 303)  can cream-style corn
1/2  c. bacon drippings
1  lb. ground meat
1  large onion, chopped fine
1/2  lb. grated cheese
4  jalapeno peppers, chopped
preparation: Mix meal, beaten eggs, sweet milk, soda, salt, corn and bacon drippings; set aside.  Saute ground meat; put on towel and dry. Grease large iron skillet; set aside.  Pour 1/2 of batter in skillet.  Sprinkle cheese, meat, onion and peppers evenly on batter.  Pour remaining batter on top.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: PASTA STIR-FRY
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  lb. sliced mushrooms
2  c. chopped broccoli
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1  lb. Hillshire Farm sausage, bite-size pieces
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1  can water chestnuts
preparation: Stir-fry vegetables in margarine.  Add seasoning.  Cook until crispy-tender.  Add sausage.  Heat through.  Stir in cheese.  Stir over buttered pasta.

name: NEW ENGLAND CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
3  potatoes
1  large onion
2  c. water
1  bay leaf
1/2  tsp. celery powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  qt. skim milk
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  packets Butter Buds
2 (6 1/2 oz.)  cans minced clams (undrained)
chopped chives
preparation: Dice potatoes and onion.  Put in saucepan with water, bay leaf, celery powder and pepper.  Cook until potatoes are tender.  Reduce heat to simmer.  Combine milk, cornstarch and Butter Buds.  Add slowly to potato mixture, stirring constantly.  Add clams and juice.  Stir over medium heat until it begins to boil and thickens slightly.  Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.  Remove bay leaf and garnish with chopped chives before serving.

name: EASY FRUIT WHIP
ingredients:
1  c. orange juice
1  c. strawberries (frozen will work if fresh are unavailable)
1  egg
2/3  c. nonfat dry milk powder
1/4  c. water
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a blender and mix until smooth. Serve cold with a fresh fruit garnish.  Makes 3+ cups.

name: FUDGE-FUDGE PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
1 (17 1/2 oz.)  pkg. chocolate cake mix
1 1/3  c. hot water
1  pkg. chocolate frosting mix (12 1/2 oz.)
2 1/2  c. boiling water
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Melt margarine in 13 x 9-inch pan in oven.  Add dry cake mix and 1 1/3 cups hot water.  Stir with a fork until smooth.  Spread evenly in the pan.  Sprinkle dry frosting mix over all.  Gently pour 2 1/2 cups boiling water over frosting mix.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes until crust is shiny and cake starts to pull away from sides of the pan.  Serve warm, saucy side up, with whipped topping or ice cream.

name: HAYSTACKS
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
1/4  block paraffin
1 large and 1 small  can chow mein noodles
peanuts (if desired)
preparation: Melt the chips and paraffin and mix together.  Drop onto wax paper and allow to harden.

name: TORTILLA SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can Ranch Style beans
1  can cream-style corn
1  can whole kernel corn
preparation: Brown ground meat and drain.  Add all other ingredients.  Do not drain.  Bring to a boil, then simmer a few minutes.  Easy and ready to eat.

name: MARK'S VEGETARIAN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
1  medium zucchini, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1  jalapeno
1 (15 oz.)  can light red kidney beans, drained
1  c. peanuts
5  to 6 flour tortillas
1  to 2 tomatoes, chopped
1  c. Cheddar cheese
plain yogurt
preparation: Saute onion, zucchini and pepper in oil until soft.  Place in a bowl with drained kidney beans and peanuts.  Mix. Wrap filling and a little Cheddar cheese in tortilla.  Place in baking dish.  Repeat with the rest of tortillas.  Top with Cheddar cheese and chopped tomato.  Bake at 350° until cheese is melted and tortillas are heated through.  Serve with plain yogurt.

name: ROCKY ROAD SQUARES
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  pkg. miniature marshmallows
2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. dry roasted peanuts
preparation: In top of double boiler, over hot water, melt chips, butter and condensed milk. Remove from heat. Combine peanuts and marshmallows. Add chocolate mixture. Spread in greased wax paper-lined 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill 2 hours.  Makes 20 to 24 servings.

name: HAM 'N CHEESE ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1/4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. Blue Bonnet margarine, softened
4 (1/8-inch)  slices boiled ham
Ritz crackers
preparation: In small bowl, combine Cheddar cheese, cream cheese and Blue Bonnet margarine until well blended.  Spread 1/4 of mixture on 1 ham slice.  Repeat with remaining cheese mixture and ham slices. Roll up from short sides.  Chill for several hours or wrap and freeze, if desired.

name: CREAM CHEESE FROSTING
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  stick margarine
1  lb. powdered sugar
preparation: Beat softened cream cheese and margarine together until mixed well.  Add powdered sugar in small amounts and beat until smooth. Spread on cooled cake.

name: CANDY CHOCOLATE PIZZA
ingredients:
1  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  lb. white almond bark
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. crisp rice cereal
1  c. peanuts
1 (6 oz.)  jar red maraschino cherries, drained and cut in half
3  Tbsp. green cherries (if desired)
1/3  c. coconut
1  tsp. oil
preparation: Microwave chips and 14 ounces almond bark in 2-quart bowl on High 2 minutes; stir.  Continue 1 or 2 minutes until smooth, stirring every 30 seconds.  Stir in marshmallows, cereal and peanuts.  Pour onto greased 12-inch pizza pan.  Top with cherries; sprinkle with coconut.  Microwave remaining 2 ounces bark with oil.  Drizzle over coconut.  Refrigerate until firm.  Store at room temperature.

name: JOE FROGGERS YANKEE MAGAZINE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  c. molasses
1/4  c. rum
4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening; stir in molasses and rum.  Add all dry ingredients and chill over night.  Roll in balls the size of a walnut.  (Roll in sugar.)  Heat oven to 350°.  Use a greased cookie sheet; bake time will depend on thickness, (10 minutes).  Yield about 5 dozen.  Good.

name: CROCK-POT SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1  large 1/2-inch thick round steak, cut into serving pieces
2  large carrots, sliced thin
1  medium onion, sliced
1 (1 lb.)  can stewed tomatoes, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. sugar
Adolph's seasoning or salt and pepper to qaste
flour
1  bay leaf
1/2  beef bouillon cube
preparation: Rinse meat; pat dry.  Trim off fat; season lightly with Adolph's seasoning or salt and pepper.  Dredge in flour.  Place carrots and onion in crock-pot; lay meat on top.  Pour stewed tomatoes on top of meat.  Mix in 1 tablespoon sugar with tomato sauce.  Pour over meat mixture; cover.  Cook for 10 to 11 hours on slow or 5 to 6 hours on high until tender.  Add a little bit of cornstarch with water to thicken sauce if not thick enough.  Serve over mashed potatoes or noodles.  Add bouillon cube to sauce in crock-pot.

name: CHEDDAR ZUCCHINI BAKE
ingredients:
6  c. zucchini, sliced thin (don't peel)
salt and pepper
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. sour cream
2  egg whites, stiffly beaten
1 1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
8  slices bacon, crumbled
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  c. fine dry bread crumbs
preparation: Simmer squash to tender; drain.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Combine egg yolks and sour cream.  Whip egg whites. Place 1/2 of egg mixture, 1/2 of cheese and all of bacon in pan. Repeat layers.  Melt butter; stir in crumbs.  Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: RANCH BEANS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  onion
1  green pepper
1  can pinto beans
1  can kidney beans
1  can pork and beans
1  can hot Mexican chili with beans
chili powder
1  c. brown sugar
1/2 large  bottle ketchup
preparation: Brown meat, chopped onion and pepper in pan.  Salt and pepper. Sprinkle chili powder over all.  Add 4 cans of beans and stir.  Add brown sugar and ketchup.  Stir, cover and bake about 1 hour at 350°.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  large boneless chicken breasts
2/3  c. celery, chopped
2  Tbsp. almonds, crushed
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Boil chicken and cool.  Chop chicken and add remaining ingredients.  Mix and chill.  Use on croissants or just plain bread.

name: CRESCENT SANDWICHES(Appetizer)
ingredients:
1  can crescent rolls
Virginia baked ham, sliced real thin
smoked turkey breast, sliced real thin
Gruyere cheese, sliced thin
preparation: Separate crescent rolls into triangles.  Layer 1 slice ham, cheese and turkey.  Roll the crescent rolls as normal.   Bake at 350° until light brown.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS AND VEGETABLES
ingredients:
6  whole chicken breasts
4  Tbsp. oleo
16  small red potatoes
8  small carrots
2 (10 1/2 oz.)  cans chicken broth
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Peel potatoes.  Place carrots and potatoes in bowl.  Wash chicken; drain well.  Place 2 tablespoons oleo in skillet.  Brown chicken, a few pieces at a time. When all is browned, set aside. Take the other 2 tablespoons oleo and place in saucepan. Saute potatoes and carrots 2 minutes. Stir in chicken broth and salt. Arrange chicken on top of vegetables.  Reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes.

name: CINNAMON TWISTS
ingredients:
3  pkg. yeast
1/3  c. warm water
2  c. sour cream
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
3  eggs
flour
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
3  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Scald cream. Add sugar, salt and oil. Cool to lukewarm.  Add beaten eggs and yeast dissolved in warm water.  Beat and add flour gradually until of kneading consistency. Knead on floured board for 5 minutes.  Let rise in warm place. Divide dough. Roll out as a rectangle and spread half with 1/4 of the butter and cinnamon mixture. Fold other half over and repeat process.  Roll to 1-inch thick and cut in strips, 1 x 5 x 6-inch.  Twist and place on cookie sheet. Let rise.  Bake at 400° for 12 or 15 minutes. When cool, frost with powdered sugar icing.  Makes 4 dozen rolls.

name: RUTH'S ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  Hidden Valley Ranch dressing (dry)
1  lb. boiled ham, chopped fine
4  or 5 green onions, chopped fine
1/2  c. olives, chopped fine
1/3  c. pimentos, chopped fine
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. sour cream
12  oz. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
8  tortilla shells, soft
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Spread on tortilla shells (8 shells).  Roll up and refrigerate overnight.  Slice to serve.

name: SAUSAGE-SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. squash, diced, boiled and well drained
1  lb. sausage, fried and well drained
12  oz. sour cream
1  onion, diced
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1  c. cheese, grated
preparation: Mix squash and sausage.  Add sour cream and onion, bread crumbs and grated cheese.  Top with Durkee onions.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: FRIED TOMATOES
ingredients:
1  medium tomato for each person
cornmeal
bacon drippings
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Slice tomatoes 1/4-inch thick and roll in cornmeal.  Fry in bacon drippings and sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Cook quickly and serve piping hot.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  stick Parkay margarine
1/2  c. white Karo
preparation: Put ingredients in iron skillet and start heating.   Have oven hot and partial parch 2 cups peanuts (about 1/2 done).   Take out of oven and dump in skillet of mixture above.  Turn stove eye on high.  Cook 2 or 3 minutes until syrup is caramel light.  Set off stove and add 1 teaspoon soda.  Stir for a minute.  Pour in 2 greased cookie pans.  Smooth down.  When cold, break into pieces. Keep in tight covered container.

name: MEXICAN FRITTERS
ingredients:
1  c. water
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/3  c. plus 1 tsp. sugar, divided
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  c. all-purpose flour
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
vegetable oil
preparation: Combine water, butter, 1 teaspoon sugar, salt and nutmeg in 2-quart saucepan.  Heat over medium-high heat until butter is melted, stirring occasionally.  Increase heat to high.  Bring to a full rolling boil.  Add flour all at once to saucepan; remove from heat.  Beat with wooden spoon until mixture forms smooth, thick paste.  Cook and stir over medium-high heat 1 to 2 minutes until mixture pulls away from side of pan and forms a ball and a film forms on bottom of pan.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating vigorously after each addition until dough is smooth and shiny. Stir in vanilla.  Let dough stand at room temperature 15 minutes.

name: DAD'S CLAM PIE
ingredients:
2  cans minced or chopped clams
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  stick margarine
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. crushed red pepper
1  c. bread crumbs
paprika
preparation: Put everything except the bread crumbs into saucepan (include juice from clams).  Simmer until peppers and onions are soft (about 20 to 25 minutes).

name: MISSISSIPPI YEAST BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  c. warm water
2  pkg. dry yeast
3  Tbsp. sugar
3/4  c. oil
2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
5  c. self-rising flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water.  Add oil, buttermilk and soda; mix.  Then add flour.  Put mixture in large container. Chill.  Make into rolls as needed.  (Can be used for cinnamon rolls.)

name: COOL 'N EASY PIE
ingredients:
2/3  c. boiling water
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. Jell-O brand watermelon flavor gelatin or any flavor
1/2  c. cold water
ice cubes
1  (8 oz.) tub Cool Whip nondairy whipped topping, thawed
1  (6 oz.) prepared graham cracker crumb crust
additional whipped topping (for garnish)
preparation: Stir boiling water into gelatin in bowl 2 minutes or until dissolved.  Mix water and ice to make 1 1/4 cups.  Stir into gelatin until slightly thickened.  Remove any remaining ice.

name: Strawberry Bread
ingredients:
1  c. butter or oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
4  eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  tsp. strawberry jam
1/2  c. sour cream
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. lemon extract
1  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream butter, sugar, vanilla and lemon extract.  Mix together in a bowl.  Add eggs, one at a time. In a second bowl, mix dry ingredients.  In a third bowl, mix jam and sour cream together. Mix all together and put into 9 x 5-inch pans.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.  Makes 2 large loaves.

name: ROTINI PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
2  envelopes Four Seasons Italian dressing mix
1  green pepper, diced
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1  can extra large sliced pitted olives
1  box tri-color rotini pasta
preparation: Cook pasta until tender; drain and rinse in cold water.  Mix both envelopes of dressing as directed on package.  Combine all ingredients in bowl.  Stir well and chill overnight in fridge. You can add pepperoni or salami.

name: WASSAIL DRINK
ingredients:
4  c. water
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. orange juice
1/3  c. real lemon
cloves
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Bring water and sugar to a boil. Add orange juice, real lemon, shake of cloves, ginger and cinnamon. Serve hot.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can tuna in water, drained
1  (7 oz.) pack potato chips
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Crush chips and mix all together. Bake in casserole dish at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

name: WHITE BREAD PLUS
ingredients:
1  cake yeast
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  beaten egg
1/2  c. melted shortening
2  c. lukewarm water
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
8  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup water; add sugar and blend.  Let stand in a warm place for 40 minutes.  Beat in egg, shortening, salt, sugar and 2 cups of the water.  Stir in some of the flour to form a thick batter, then pour onto floured board and knead in remaining flour, about 10 minutes.  Place in a well-greased bowl and let stand until double in size.  Knead in edges.  Turn dough and let stand in warm place until double in size.  Cut into three equal portions and shape into loaves.  Place in well-greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pans and let rise until double in bulk.  Place in cold oven, turn heat to 400° for 15 minutes, then reduce to 375° for 25 minutes.  Remove from oven, brush with melted shortening and turn onto wire rack to cool.

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE(Low-fat)
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. applesauce
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. canola oil
1/2  c. Egg Beaters
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. raisins
1/4  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Pour in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: SNICKER SURPRISE SALAD
ingredients:
4  crisp red Delicious apples
4  Snickers candy bars
1  container La Creme frozen topping
preparation: Core and dice apples; leave skin on.   Cut bars 3 or 4 times lengthwise and then across to fairly small chunks.  Fold in La Creme.

name: FRUIT MEDLEY
ingredients:
1 (21 oz.)  can peach or apricot pie filling
2 (15 oz.)  cans fruit cocktail, drained
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, drained
1 (15 oz.)  can Mandarin oranges, drained
2  medium firm bananas, sliced
preparation: In large bowl, combine pie filling and canned fruits. Cover and refrigerate. Stir in bananas just before serving. Yield: 12 to 14 servings.

name: BROCCOLI RICE BAKE
ingredients:
onion, diced
8  oz. Cheez Whiz
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can water
1 small  jar mushrooms, sliced (and juice)
20  oz. pkg. broccoli, thawed and drained
1  stick oleo
2  c. Minute rice
preparation: In skillet, saute diced onion in melted oleo.  Stir in Cheez Whiz.  Stir until smooth.  In a large mixing bowl, mix rice, soups, water and mushrooms.  Add thawed broccoli.   Stir in melted cheese mixture.  Bake in casserole dish for 35 minutes at 350°.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/4  c. margarine
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
preparation: Combine sugar, syrup and margarine in saucepan; cook on high until margarine melts and mixture is hot. Mix slowly with beaten eggs, stirring constantly. Add pecans and vanilla. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes (until it doesn't shake in middle).

name: "THE BEST" OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
3  eggs, well beaten
1  c. raisins
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. soda
2  c. oatmeal
3/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine eggs, raisins and vanilla and let stand for 1 hour, covered with plastic.  Cream together butter and sugars.   Add flour, salt, cinnamon and soda to sugar mixture.  Mix well.  Blend in egg and raisin mixture, oatmeal and nuts.  Dough will be stiff. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or light brown.   Delicious.  Secret is soaking the raisins.

name: CHICKEN SPOONBREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. cornmeal
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
4  c. chicken broth
1/4  c. butter
4  egg yolks, beaten
3  c. cooked, chopped chicken
4  egg whites, beaten
preparation: Combine cornmeal, flour and salt in heavy saucepan; add broth and cook until thickened.  Stir in butter and cool.  Blend in beaten egg yolks and fold in chopped chicken.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.  Bake in a 6 x 10-inch greased baking dish at 375° for 40 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  c. rice (instant)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
preparation: Boil broccoli in 1 cup water for 5 minutes. Add instant rice, then add Cheez Whiz and cream of mushroom soup.  Mix well.  Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY BANANA TRIFLE
ingredients:
1  cup sugar
1/4  cup cornstarch
3  Tbsp. strawberry gelatin powder
1  cup cold water
1  pint fresh strawberries, sliced
1  3/4 cups cold milk
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
3  medium firm bananas, sliced
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
6  cups angel food cake, cubed
2  cups whipping cream, whipped
Additional strawberries and bananas, optional
preparation: In saucepan stir sugar, cornstarch and gelatin, stir in water until smooth.  Bring to a boil, cook and stir for two minutes, or until thickened.  Remove from heat.  Stir in strawberries and set aside.  In a mixing bowl combine milk and pudding mix.  Beat on low speed for two minutes, set aside.  Toss bananas with lemon juice, drain and set aside.  Place half of cake cubes in a trifle bowl.  Layer with half of the pudding, bananas, strawberry sauce and whipped cream.  Repeat layers.  Cover and refrigerate for at least two hours.  Garnish with the additional fruit, if desired.

name: TOFFEE BARS
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg yolk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream butter  and  brown  sugar  together. Add yolk and vanilla and  blend.  Sift  flour  and  salt and mix thoroughly with creamed  mixture.  Spread  in	10  x 13-inch cookie sheet with sides.  Bake  at  350° for 20 minutes.  While still warm, frost with	1  pound  Hershey bar.	Sprinkle with chopped nuts and cut in small squares.

name: CHOLESTEROL-FREE BANANA RAISIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
3/4  c. packed brown sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. light corn oil spread
1 2/3  c. mashed bananas (4 medium)
1  c. dark seedless raisins
1  c. quick-cooking oats (uncooked)
1/2  c. frozen, thawed, no-cholesterol egg substitute
1/2  c. unsweetened apple(s)
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  In a large bowl, mix flour, brown sugar, baking powder and baking soda. Cut in corn oil spread until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Stir in bananas, raisins, oats, egg substitute, applesauce and vanilla extract just until flour is moistened.  Spoon batter into pan. Bake 1 1/4 hours until done.  To prevent overbrowning, cover bread loosely with a tent of foil after 1 hour.  Cool bread in pan for 10 minutes.  Remove from pan.

name: BUCK EYES
ingredients:
2  c. (18 oz.) crunchy peanut butter
3  c. Rice Krispies
1/2  c. butter
3  c. powdered sugar
6  squares chocolate, melted
preparation: Mix Rice Krispies and peanut butter, add melted butter. Gradually add powdered sugar, mixing well each time. Roll in melted chocolate and place on waxed paper until cool.

name: AVOCADO DIP
ingredients:
1  ripe avocado
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  tsp. grated onion
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Blend ingredients at room temperature.  Serve with chips or crackers.

name: BANANA COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. ripe bananas, mashed (2 to 3 bananas)
optional:  cinnamon, sugar, coconut and chopped nuts
preparation: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.  Cream shortening until soft, gradually beat in sugar until light and fluffy.  Beat in eggs and vanilla.
