Add flour mixture alternately with mashed bananas.  Blend well after each addition.  Drop by tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Sprinkle tops with cinnamon, sugar, chopped nuts or coconut.  Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.  Cool on rack.  Makes approximately 3 dozen.

name: JANE'S CHICKEN FLAUTAS
ingredients:
1  can white chicken meat
1/2  tsp. cumin
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. shredded lettuce
1  c. chopped tomatoes
1/2  c. chopped green onions (for garnishing)
6  green onions, chopped
2  Tbsp. Pancho's salad dressing
10  small flour tortillas, cut in half
preparation: Use any of the following as a dip:  sour cream (I like sour cream the best!), Pancho's hot dip, cheese dip or salad dressing.

name: FLAVORFUL MANDARIN COOLER
ingredients:
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. orange juice
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges (undrained)
1 (6 oz.)  carton orange creme yogurt
1 (1 oz.)  pkg. sugar-free instant vanilla pudding mix
12  to 14 ice cubes
preparation: In a blender, combine milk, orange juice, orange yogurt, pudding mix and ice cubes.  Cover and process for 20 seconds until smooth.  Stir before pouring into chilled glasses.

name: HOT MILK SPONGE CAKE
ingredients:
4  large eggs
1  c. sugar
1  c. self-rising flour
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Whip together until very light, eggs and sugar.  Measure into cup the flour.  Add vanilla to egg mixture. Heat milk with butter until butter melts.  Dump hot milk and flour into egg.  Fold thoroughly, using wire whip.  Pour into greased and floured 2 layer cake pan or 9 x 13-inch sheet cake pan.  Bake for 30 minutes.

name: COCONUT PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. sugar
6  oz. box vanilla instant pudding
9  oz. container Cool Whip
coconut
preparation: Bake cake in a 13 x 9-inch pan according to directions.  Make pudding.  Heat pineapple and sugar  (do not cook).  When cake is cool, punch holes with a wooden spoon handle.  Spread pineapple over cake, then pudding, then Cool Whip.  Sprinkle coconut on top. Refrigerate.

name: FIESTA GRILLED AVOCADOS
ingredients:
1  pkg. Fresher Lasting Jumbo Avocado Halves
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  tsp. fajita seasoning
2  Seasoned Cilantro Lime Chicken Breasts
1  pkg. Fresher Lasting Roasted Salsa
1  c. shredded jalapeno jack or cheddar cheese
preparation: Place olive oil in a small bowl.  Dip Avocado halves in olive oil.  Sprinkle avocados with fajita seasoning and place on a sheet pan.  Heat coals or grill to medium heat, 375 degrees.  Brush hot grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.  Grill chicken breasts according to package directions and thin slice.  Grill avocados on cut side for 5 minutes.  Turn avocados over and grill for 3 minutes.  Place grilled avocados on a small foil lined baking pan and top with sliced chicken, salsa and shredded cheese.  Place pan on grill and loosely cover with foil.  Heat avocados for 3 more minutes until cheese melts.  Serve warm.

name: PEANUT BUTTER AND JELLY DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) container sour cream
2  Tbsp. peanut butter
2  Tbsp. strawberry preserves
preparation: In small bowl combine ingredients; mix well.  Serve with sliced apples, celery, carrots, etc.  Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 1 cup.

name: CHOCOLATE SALAD DRESSING CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. salad dressing
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 c. warm water
2  c. all-purpose flour
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix in order listed.  Grease and flour pan.  Bake very slowly (350°) about 20 minutes.

name: BEEF PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. prepared, mashed potatoes
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. condensed tomato soup
2  c. green beans, drained
preparation: Brown meat with onion and salt and pepper.  Drain fat and stir in soup and beans.  Cook slowly for 5 minutes.  Pour into casserole dish.  Top with mashed potatoes.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. Ritz crackers
1/2  c. melted butter
1  c. milk
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  can cream of celery
4  c. shredded cabbage
1/2  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Mix crackers and butter.  Set aside.  Mix milk, mayonnaise and soup.  Pour over shredded cabbage.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Then add crackers on top of cheese.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until done.  Crackers will be brown on top.

name: CHEESEBURGER RICE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
2  c. water
2/3  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  c. rice, uncooked
4  oz. Cheddar cheese, sliced
preparation: Brown meat and onions in large skillet on medium-high heat; drain.  Stir in water, catsup, mustard, salt and pepper.  Bring to a boil.  Stir in rice; cover.  Remove from heat.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Fluff with fork.  Top with cheese; cover.  Let stand 3 minutes or until cheese melts.  Makes 4 servings.

name: YOGURT FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. light cream cheese
1  c. plain nonfat yogurt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  tsp. grated lemon rind
20  packets Equal
preparation: Mix all ingredients and chill.  Serve with slices of fresh fruit.  Makes about 2 1/2 cups dip.

name: CHICKEN "CRESCENT" CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  or 3 chicken breasts
1  can Pillsbury crescent rolls
1  can creamy chicken mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
1/3  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Cook chicken breasts in water and salt and pepper until done. Take chicken off bones.  Put a large piece of chicken on large end of roll and roll it up.  Line in casserole dish.

name: POPPY SEED BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  pkg. coconut instant pudding
1/4  c. poppy seed
4  eggs
1  c. hot water
1/2  c. oil
preparation: Mix ingredients well.  Pour into 2 well-greased loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: ENGLISH PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1  can French-style beans
1  jar pimentos
1  can white Shoe Peg corn
1  can English peas
1  onion
1 1/2  c. oil
1 1/2  c. vinegar
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Drain first 4 ingredients.   Heat oil, vinegar and sugar until sugar is dissolved.   Pour second mixture into first mixture.   Add chopped onion.   Refrigerate.

name: NATURAL MUNCH'N
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  c. honey
1  Tbsp. grated lemon peel
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
2  qt. popped popcorn
1  c. raisins
1  c. sunflower seeds
1  c. whole cashews
preparation: Melt margarine in small saucepan; stir in honey, lemon peel and cinnamon.  Drizzle over popcorn in a large bowl; toss gently. Add raisins, sunflower seeds and cashews.  Toss gently until well blended.  Makes 2 1/2 quarts.

name: MILK NOODLES
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
5  c. milk
2  c. flour
salt
2  Tbsp. butter
cinnamon and sugar mixture to taste
preparation: Combine eggs and 1 cup of milk in a bowl; mix well.  Add sifted flour and salt; mix well.  Stir in just enough milk until stiff dough forms; knead well.   Roll into a thin rectangle on a lightly floured surface; dust with additional flour and cut into thin strips.

name: CHOCOLATE CARAMEL BARS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. butter
2  c. oatmeal
2  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
64  caramels
6  Tbsp. butter
6  tsp. milk
12  oz. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix butter, oatmeal, soda, flour, brown sugar and salt and put 3/4 of mixture into jelly roll pan.  Melt caramels, butter and milk; pour over mixture.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Remove and place chocolate chips and nuts on top.   Top with remaining crumb mix.  Bake another 15 minutes at 350°.

name: TAFFY APPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
juice from 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple
1  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. apple cider vinegar
4  c. apples, peeled and chopped
crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. peanuts, crushed
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients in saucepan.  Cook until thickened. Cool 1 hour.  Combine apples, pineapple, 1/2 cup nuts and Cool Whip.  Mix together with cooked, cooled sauce.  Sprinkle top with remaining nuts.  Chill and serve.

name: TEX-MEX DIP
ingredients:
3  medium ripe avocados
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
3  medium tomatoes, chopped
1  pkg. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
2 (10 1/2 oz.)  cans bean dip
1 large  bunch green onions, chopped
sliced black olives
tortilla chips
preparation: Mash avocados and mix well with lemon juice, salt and pepper. Mix sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning mix together.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. frozen, cooked shrimp
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
8  Tbsp. margarine, melted
1  small onion, finely chopped
1 1/4  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  loaf King's Hawaiian bread
preparation: Chop shrimp coarsely.  Add all remaining ingredients, except bread, and mix well.  Pinch out the center of bread in chunks. Reserve chunks until ready to serve.

name: QUICK ESCALLOPED HAM
ingredients:
1  pkg. (box) prepared scalloped potatoes
1 to 2  c. cooked ham, chopped into small pieces
2  Tbsp. minced onion or dehydrated onion
preparation: Simple dish.  Great for using up leftovers or fixing an inexpensive dish for a crowd.

name: HUMMUS DIP
ingredients:
1  can garbanzo beans, drained
2 to 3  Tbsp. tahini (crushed sesame seed)
1/4 to 1/2  c. lemon juice
1  clove garlic
1/2  tsp. cumin
1/2  tsp. salt
water
preparation: Place drained beans in blender.  Add all other ingredients, then add enough water to almost cover beans.  Blend until smooth. Pour into serving dish.  Pour very thin layer of olive oil on top; sprinkle with parsley.  Serve with pita bread.

name: RHUBARB CAKE DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. butter (cold)
2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Crumble together and press into 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: HAM, BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) Cheez Whiz
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. onions
4  Tbsp. butter
2  (10 oz.) broccoli, chopped (frozen)
2  c. Minute rice
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
4  c. cooked, diced ham
preparation: In large bowl, blend cheese, soup and milk.  Cook broccoli according to package directions.  Drain; cook onions in butter until tender.  Add onions, broccoli, ham, uncooked rice and Worcestershire sauce.  Mix all together.  Turn into 2 (1 1/2-quart) casseroles.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: CHINESE PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. round steak
2  Tbsp. fat
1  medium size onion, cubed
1  clove garlic or 1/8 tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. salt
2  beef bouillon cubes
1  c. hot water
3  medium size tomatoes, cut up
2  large green peppers, chopped
4  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. cold water
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Brown meat in  fat  after  cutting  meat into bite-size pieces.   Add onion  and  garlic  last  minutes  of  browning. Season.  Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot water and add to meat. Cover and simmer 20  minutes.  Add  tomatoes and green pepper. Cook 10 minutes  longer.  Combine  remaining  ingredients  and stir into meat.  Bring  to boil.  Cook, stirring constantly, 5 minutes longer.  Serve over rice.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  onion, chopped
1  tsp. chili powder
2  cans tomato soup
2  cans kidney beans
green peppers (optional)
garlic powder (optional)
preparation: Brown hamburger with onions.  Add other ingredients.  Simmer 30 minutes.

name: NO BAKE PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES(Child Snack Recipe)
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
2  c. cornflakes, toasted oat or crisp rice cereal
1  c. peanut butter
preparation: In a medium glass bowl, blend sugar and syrup.  Microwave sugar and syrup on High for 2 1/2 minutes or until mixture comes to a full boil.  Stir in cereal and peanut butter.  Drop by teaspoonful on wax paper.

name: CREAMY POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
4  slices bacon, cut up
3  medium potatoes, peeled and chopped up (3 c.)
1  large onion, chopped (1 c.)
1  medium carrot, chopped (1/2 c.)
1  stalk celery, chopped (1/2 c.)
4  c. milk
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. paprika
preparation: In large saucepan, cook bacon until crisp; drain bacon, reserving 3 tablespoons drippings in pan.  Set bacon aside.  Add chopped potatoes, onion, carrot and celery to bacon drippings. Cover and cook over low heat about 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally.  Stir in the milk, salt and pepper. Bring mixture to boil.  Stir together sour cream, flour and paprika; gradually stir about 1 cup of hot mixture into sour cream mixture.  Return to remaining hot mixture in saucepan.  Cook and stir just until mixture bubbles.  Top with bacon pieces.  Serve immediately.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: CALIFORNIA HOT BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
broccoli
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Cook broccoli until still crisp.  Heap upon a platter.  Cover with sauce consisting of mayonnaise, prepared mustard and vinegar.

name: POTATO PEEL SOUP
ingredients:
6  well scrubbed potatoes
2  whole potatoes, diced
1  carrot, grated
1  tsp. marjoram or thyme
1  tsp. salt
8  c. cold water
1  onion, diced
1  celery stick, diced
2  chicken bouillon cubes
1  tsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Generously peel the potatoes. Put the peelings in a pot along with remaining ingredients. Simmer mixture for 1 1/2 hours. Put through a blender and add 1 cup milk and 1 cup grated cheese. Heat until cheese is melted. Serve.

name: UPSIDE-DOWN STRAWBERRY MERINGUE PIE
ingredients:
3  egg whites
1/2  tsp. vinegar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  (9-inch) baked pie shell
3  c. fresh strawberries
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. water
red food coloring
1  c. whipping cream
preparation: Beat egg whites with vinegar and salt to form soft peaks. Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla, beating to stiff peaks. Spread on bottom and sides of baked pastry shell.  Bake in 325° oven for 12 minutes.  Cool.

name: OAT BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  box bran flakes
1  c. oat bran
3  c. sugar
5  c. all-purpose flour
5  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. salt
1  c. vegetable oil
1  qt. buttermilk
4  egg whites, beaten
preparation: Mix well dry ingredients, except oat bran.  Add 1 cup vegetable oil, then 4 egg whites; well beaten.  Mix in 1 quart buttermilk and let set a few minutes (10 minutes).  Then add extra cup of oat bran.  Bake in muffin tins with liners for 15 to 20 minutes at 400°.  Makes about 4 dozen.

name: SALT AND PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. sirloin steak
1/2  c. oil
1  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  c. water
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
cooked rice
preparation: Cut the steak into very thin slices.  In a skillet with a lid, heat the oil and add steak slices.  Cook, uncovered, until browned. Pour out some of the oil and add the remaining ingredients except the rice.  Cover and cook for 30 to 35 minutes until the juice has thickened.  Serve over rice.

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
2/3  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. water
3  c. flour
1 3/4  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  c. raisins
1 1/4  c. sugar
3  eggs
1 3/4  c. applesauce
1/3  tsp. baking powder
1 3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. each: cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar and eggs.  Add applesauce; mix well. Add water alternately with dry ingredients.  Add raisins; pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SPECIAL K ROAST
ingredients:
1  large onion
1  stick margarine, melted
2  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. chopped nuts (pecans are best)
3  eggs
3  Tbsp. beef seasoning
4  c. Special K type cereal
preparation: Blend together first six ingredients.  Add cereal and mix well.  Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 1 hour at 350°. May be topped with cream of mushroom soup diluted 1/2 strength.

name: WESTERN BEEF AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. pitted ripe olives
1  lb. ground lean beef
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. uncooked rice
2 1/2  c. canned tomatoes
1  c. water
2  tsp. salt
2 or 3  tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Cut olives into large pieces.  Brown the ground beef in the oil; remove the meat from the pan.  Add onion, celery, green pepper and rice.  Cook, stirring, until browned.  Add the tomatoes, water, seasonings, meat and olives; bring to a boil. Pour into a 2-quart casserole and cover.  Bake for 45 minutes to an hour.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: MOLDED SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
2 small  pkg. lemon lime Jell-O
2  c. hot water
1 large  can pineapple
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Pour hot water over cheese and Jell-O; mix well with egg beater.  Add pineapple (drained).  Cool until slightly thickened. Add Cool Whip; fold in Jell-O.  Add cherries and nuts, if desired.

name: CHINESE PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
1  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
8  pork chops
preparation: Combine all ingredients except pork chops.  Marinate pork chops in sauce every 3 hours in refrigerator.  Place pork chops evenly in a baking dish, pour sauce on top.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: HOMEMADE PIZZA DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. warm water
1  pkg. yeast
1  tsp. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. oil
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. additional flour
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients in large bowl allowing yeast to soften.  Stir in oil and 2 cups flour.  Add more flour until dough holds together.  Grease your hands lightly and knead dough on floured board until smooth.  Cover and let rise 45 minutes.  Shape it to pans you are using or into individual disks all on greased pans.  Brush with sauce and cover with ingredients.  Let rise about 5 to 10 more minutes then bake in 425° oven for 15 minutes. This recipe also makes a nice French bread loaf.  My family makes individualized pizzas.

name: FRUIT FLUFF
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. instant French vanilla pudding
1 (16 oz.)  can fruit cocktail, drained
1 (8 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1  envelope Dream Whip, prepared
preparation: Cream together the pineapple and pudding.  Stir in fruit cocktail and mandarin oranges.  Blend in Dream Whip.  Chill.

name: VEGETABLE BATTER
ingredients:
1/4  c. flour
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2 to 3/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. cold water
pinch of ginger
vegetables, thoroughly dried
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Add water.  Stir in ginger.  Dip vegetables in batter; drain and fry in deep oil.  Use chunks of broccoli, cauliflower, zucchini, celery and mushrooms.  Drain on paper towels.

name: CHIPPED BEEF DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
16  oz. sour cream
4  oz. dried beef
1  round loaf unsliced bread (pumpernickel, rye or sourdough)
preparation: Mix ingredients together and put into a hollowed out loaf of bread.  Put pieces of bread that were removed around the loaf and cover with foil.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: EASY BANANA PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) graham cracker crust
2  bananas
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. milk
1 3/4  oz. pkg. vanilla pudding
preparation: Slice bananas onto crust.  Gradually add 1/2 cup milk to softened cream cheese.  Mix well.  Add pudding; mix and add remaining milk.  Beat slowly one minute.  Pour into crust.

name: MOCK OYSTER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. peeled, cubed eggplant
1  onion, finely chopped
4  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. water
1  c. milk
3  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
4  slices soft white bread, broken in pieces
preparation: Cook eggplant and onion in unsalted water until tender.  Drain thoroughly.  Combine all ingredients; mix well.  Pour into buttered casserole and bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
8  oz. sour cream
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together until smooth and creamy.  Very good on any fruit.

name: CINNAMON ORNAMENTS(Makes 18 to 25 Small To Medium Ornaments)
ingredients:
3/4  c. ground cinnamon
1  Tbsp. ground allspice
2  Tbsp. cloves
1  Tbsp. nutmeg
1  c. applesauce
preparation: Combine spices blending well.  Stir in applesauce and mix well.  Mixture will be stiff.  Roll out to 1/4-inch thickness. Using small to medium cutters, cut dough into desired shapes.  Let ornaments dry 4 to 5 days.

name: BROCCOLI CORN MUFFIN BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jiffy corn bread mix
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. sharp cheese, grated
1  c. fresh green onions, chopped
1  stick butter
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk or sour cream
preparation: Chop  onions.  Cook broccoli; drain well. Combine onions, broccoli, eggs, margarine, salt, corn muffin mix and milk. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake for 35 minutes at 350°. Sprinkle cheese over top and return to oven until cheese is melted.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
1  small onion, chopped
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
3  Tbsp. butter
3  c. hot boiled rice
salt and pepper to taste
1 1/4  c. canned tomatoes
preparation: Saute onion and green pepper for 5 minutes in the butter.  Add tomatoes and rice, heat to boiling.  Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes more.  Season to taste.  Makes 5 servings.

name: BREAD STICKS
ingredients:
1  c. warm water
1  Tbsp. honey
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. onion powder
1  tsp. sage
1  Tbsp. yeast
1/4  c. oil
3  c. flour
preparation: Mix together  first  5  ingredients.  Stir in yeast and oil. Mix  in flour with spoon.  Beat without kneading.  Cover and refrigerate  2  hours  or  overnight.  Divide into 3 dozen small pieces.  Roll  into  8-inch strips.  Place 1 inch apart. Let rise. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 400°.

name: PORK CHOP SPANISH RICE(One Skillet Meal)
ingredients:
5  center cut boneless pork chops (1/2-inch thick)
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. chili powder
3/4  c. uncooked long grain rice
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 (1 lb. 12 oz.)  can tomatoes
5  green pepper rings
2  oz. sharp cheese, shredded
preparation: Trim fat from chops.  Brown in oil 15 to 20 minutes.  Mix salt and chili powder.  Sprinkle over chops.  Add rice, onion and chopped green pepper.  Pour tomatoes over.  Cover and cook over low heat 35 to 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add green pepper rings and cook 5 minutes longer or until rice and meat are tender.  Sprinkle with cheese and serve.

name: CRAB DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. milk
dash of pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1 1/2  tsp. horseradish
1  can crabmeat or imitation crab
preparation: Add milk to softened cream cheese.  Add the remaining ingredients.  Put mixture into baking dish.  Sprinkle with toasted almonds.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: FREEZER CABBAGE SLAW
ingredients:
1  medium cabbage
1  carrot
1  mango
1  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. vinegar
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. mustard seed
preparation: Shred cabbage, carrot and mango as for slaw.  Add salt; mix well.  Let set 1 hour.  Squeeze out juice.  Mix remaining ingredients and boil 1 minute.  Cool, then add to cabbage.  Pack in plastic containers and freeze.  When ready to serve, let thaw completely.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia brand cream cheese, softened
1 (7 oz.)  jar Kraft Marshmallow Creme
preparation: Mix ingredients well until blended well.  Serve with any fruit.

name: HEALTHY CHOICE CRAB DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. nonfat plain yogurt or sour cream
2  Tbsp. fat-free mayonnaise
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. fat-free cream cheese, softened
1  tsp. prepared horseradish
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. hot pepper sauce
1  c. (4 oz.) fat-free shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  lb. imitation crab, flaked
paprika
preparation: Combine yogurt, mayonnaise, softened cream cheese and seasonings; mix well.  Stir in Cheddar cheese and crab.  Cover and chill 2 hours.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Serve with crackers, breadsticks or vegetables.

name: BARBECUED HAMBURGER
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  Tbsp. oil
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  c. catsup
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. diced celery
1/4  c. diced onion
preparation: Brown meat in fat.  Add remaining ingredients.  Blend thoroughly.  Cook over low heat 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve on hamburger buns.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
2  boxes vanilla instant pudding, mixed
2  cans strawberry pie filling
2 large  cans crushed pineapple
4  bananas
2  boxes Cool Whip
2  pkg. chopped pecans
preparation: Cook cake mix in long pan.  Cut in half; put half of cooked cake in punch bowl.  Add 1/2 pie filling on top of cake, then add 1 can pineapple, 1 can strawberry pie filling, 2 bananas, 1 box Cool Whip and 1/2 of nuts.  Repeat with the rest of the remaining ingredients; top with Cool Whip, nuts and maraschino cherries.

name: KATHY'S MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1 large  can refried beans
1  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  jar taco sauce (mild)
1  can ripe sliced olives
1  carton sour cream
1 (7 oz.)  can chopped green chilies
1 1/2  c. shredded cheese
1  c. chopped tomatoes
1  c. chopped green onion
preparation: Brown hamburger and taco seasoning.  Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Spread refried beans over meat.  Layer on cheese, chilies and taco sauce.  Bake at 350° until cheese is bubbly.  Remove; cool slightly.  Spread sour cream on top.  Garnish with green onions, olives and tomatoes.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: OATMEAL PIE
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
2/3  c. white Karo syrup
2/3  c. oatmeal
1  stick butter, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
pinch of salt
unbaked pie crust
preparation: Combine all ingredients and pour into crust.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes to an hour.

name: ENERGY BARS
ingredients:
1  bag marshmallows
1  cube butter
1/2  c. peanut butter
2 1/2  c. oatmeal
2 1/2  c. Rice Krispies
1  c. raisins
1  c. nuts
1  c. dried fruit
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients on low heat, then add the remaining ingredients.  Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Set 1 hour. That's it!  Let's eat!

name: MEXITALIAN LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can Hormel chili (no beans)
1 (4 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms, drained
1 1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1 1/2  tsp. dried parsley
2 1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1 (16 oz.)  jar Mexican salsa, drained
3/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1 1/2  c. cottage cheese
9  lasagna noodles, cooked
vegetable cooking spray
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In large bowl, combine chili, drained salsa, mushrooms, Parmesan cheese and Italian seasoning.  In small bowl, stir cottage cheese and parsley flakes.  Layer noodles, cottage cheese, chili mixture and Mozzarella cheese in a 9 x 9-inch baking dish coated with vegetable cooking spray; repeat to make three layers.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until lasagna is thoroughly heated.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

name: QUICHE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. melted margarine
1 1/2  c. milk
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1/2  c. chopped ham
dash of pepper
preparation: Place all ingredients, except ham and cheese, in blender. Blend well.  Pour into 9-inch or 10-inch greased pie pan. Sprinkle ham and cheese evenly over top, pushing gently below surface.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

name: PORK AND BEANS SANDWICH
ingredients:
1  slice bread, toasted
1/3  c. drained pork and beans
1  slice cheese
2  slices bacon
1  tsp. diced onion
preparation: Spread pork and beans over top of bread slice.  Top with slice of cheese.  Sprinkle with diced onion.  Place 2 slices of bacon on top and place under broiler until bacon is done. Great with glass of milk.  This could be done in a microwave if the bacon was precooked.

name: QUICK-N-EASY SOUTHERN BISCUITS
ingredients:
3  c. self-rising flour
1 1/4  c. milk
3  Tbsp. shortening
1/4  stick butter (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Grease baking sheet.  Put flour in a bowl and "hollow out" by pushing it to sides of bowl.  Add milk and shortening and pull flour down from edges.  Mix together, forming a ball  of dough.  Shape quickly; less kneading will form fluffier biscuits.  Sprinkle flour on hands and pinch off desired amount.  Roll and pat into shape with least amount of patting for fluffy, tasty biscuits.  Bake approximately 12 to 15 minutes. Remove from oven and butter biscuit tops generously.  Biscuits may be returned to oven if not fully cooked; watch for golden brown color.  Yields approximately 16 biscuits.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow squash
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. mayonnaise
3  eggs, lightly beaten
1/2  c. crushed saltines
1  pkg. buttermilk Ranch dressing
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Cook squash with onion about 10 minutes (squash should be firm).  Drain well.  Combine squash with next 5 ingredients. Place in a 2-quart lightly greased casserole.   Combine bread crumbs and margarine, sprinkle over top.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Yields 8 servings.

name: CRANBERRY TOP SWEETS
ingredients:
1  lb. sweet potatoes
1  can whole cranberry sauce
1/4  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Parboil potatoes until tender.  Cut in half and put in baking dish.  Pour cranberry sauce over top.  Sprinkle with sugar and dot with butter.  Bake in 350° oven for 25 minutes or until heated through.

name: SPECIAL LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1  (8 or 9-inch) graham cracker crumb crust
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1/3  c. ReaLemon reconstituted lemon juice
few drops yellow food coloring
3  egg whites *
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
whipped cream or topping and lemon slices (optional)
preparation: In medium bowl, combine Eagle Brand, ReaLemon and food coloring; mix well.  In small bowl, beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff but not dry; gently fold into Eagle Brand mixture.  Turn into crust.  Chill 3 hours or until set.  Garnish with whipped cream and lemon slices, if desired.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: MRS. MCKAY'S COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. walnuts, chopped
1  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cream butter; add sugar and mix well.  Stir in eggs; add alternately the milk and flour which has been sifted with baking powder and salt.

name: TEA TIME
ingredients:
1/2  c. instant tea
2  c. sugar
1  c. lemon juice
1 1/2  c. white grape juice
1  gal. water
preparation: Mix ingredients together and chill.  Refreshing.

name: FRESH COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
4  egg yolks
2  whole eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine, cut up
1  c. hot milk
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped black walnuts or pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spray three 9-inch round cake pans with Pam.  In a large mixing bowl, beat egg yolks, whole eggs and sugar with an electric mixer for at least 5 minutes or until light and fluffy.  Stir margarine pieces into hot milk until it is melted. Combine flour with baking powder.  Add 1/2 cup flour mixture into egg mixture, beating slowly.  Add half the hot milk mixture, 1 cup flour mixture, then the remaining hot milk; beating after each addition.  Add remaining flour mixture and vanilla.  Beat well. Fold in nuts.  Pour batter into prepared pans.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted into center comes out clean.  Cool 5 minutes, remove from pans and cool completely.

name: SCALLOPED TOMATOES, CORN AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  can tomatoes (undrained)
1/2  tsp. salt
pinch of pepper
1  c. cottage cheese
1/4  c. dry bread crumbs
3  Tbsp. melted margarine
preparation: Spread corn in bottom of greased baking dish.  Combine tomatoes with salt and pepper.  Spread over corn.  Spread cottage cheese over tomatoes.  Mix crumbs and melted butter.  Spread evenly over cheese layer.  Bake in a 400° oven for about 25 minutes or until bubbling hot and top is browned.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
3  lb. lean ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
3  sliced toast, crumbled
1  cup ketchup
1  egg
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine beef, onion, toast, ketchup and egg. Form into a loaf and place in pan.

name: MALE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. light brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. chopped nuts
1/4  lb. oleo
2  eggs
preparation: Use 11	1/2  x	7  1/2-inch pan.  Pour melted oleo over sugar and mix all together, adding eggs last.  Bake slowly for about 30 to	40  minutes in a 325° oven.  Cool in pan, cut and dust	with powdered  sugar.  Important:  Dust	and grease pan with flour.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots
1  medium onion, sliced thin
1  medium green pepper, halved and sliced thin
1  can tomato soup (undiluted)
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. salad oil
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Slice and cook carrots; drain and cool.  Heat soup, vinegar, oil, sugar and dry mustard until sugar melts.  Mix all together well and refrigerate overnight.

name: HARDTACK CANDY
ingredients:
1  c. corn syrup
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
whatever flavoring
food coloring
preparation: Boil syrup, sugar and water to hard crack stage (300°). Remove from heat.  Add flavor of choice and food coloring.  Stir well to mix.  (Hint:  Don't use metal or plastic spoon.)  Pour onto greased cookie sheet.  Allow to cool.  (Mixture will set quickly.  You will need to work fast.) Crack candy to desired slice and toss with powdered sugar.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten until foamy
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
3  c. scalded milk
1  tsp. vanilla
5  slices bread, cubed
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients together, then add milk and vanilla.  Add bread and raisins.  Put into a buttered casserole. Add the milk mixture.  Sprinkle with nutmeg.  Put casserole in pan of water.  Bake 10 minutes in a 450° oven, then 40 minutes in a 325° oven.

name: GRANDMA'S SAUSAGE AND POTATO STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. turkey sausage
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. bell pepper, chopped
4  medium potatoes, cut in wedges
4  Tbsp. cooking oil
6  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Make a roux.  Add onion and bell pepper; saute.  Add water, potatoes and sausage; season to taste.  Cook until potatoes are done (approximately 25 minutes).

name: HOT MILK CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk, heated with 1 stick oleo
1 1/2  c. flour
1/8  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together eggs and sugar until real creamy.  Sift all dry ingredients together.  Heat milk with oleo or butter until melted. Add dry ingredients gradually to egg and sugar alternately with hot milk and oleo (butter).  Bake in rectangular cake pan at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into cake.

name: OLIVE NUT SPREAD
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  c. sliced olives
2  Tbsp. olive juice
dash of pepper
preparation: Mix all together. Keep in sealed container. Will keep in fridge a week. It's nice for finger sandwiches on party rye or wheat bread.

name: CRESCENT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. dry bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. mustard
3  lb. lean ground beef
2  Tbsp. onion
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. catsup
1  can crescent rolls
preparation: Combine all ingredients except dough and press mixture into a loaf pan.  Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours.  Cool in pan for 5 minutes.  Drain off fat and invert meat loaf onto a cookie sheet.  Separate roll of dough into 4 rectangles.  Overlap slightly on a pastry cloth or floured board to form a large rectangle.  Roll out to 10 x 5 inches.  Drape over meat.  Trim excess.  Bake in 325° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.  Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: RANCH STYLE BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
1  envelope Lipton onion soup mix
2 (1 lb.)  cans pork and beans
1 (1 lb.)  can kidney beans
1  c. catsup
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. mustard
2  tsp. vinegar
1/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: Brown meat in a large iron skillet.  Stir in soup mix, beans, catsup, mustard, vinegar and sugar.  Simmer 30 to 45 minutes. Pour into 2 1/2-quart bean pot to serve.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: GINGERBREAD WITH LEMON SAUCE
ingredients:
1/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
dash of ground nutmeg
3/4  c. water
1/2  tsp. finely shredded lemon peel
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. margarine
1  drop yellow food coloring (if desired)
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. cooking oil
1  egg
2  egg whites
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. apple juice
2  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  c. whole wheat flour
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/2  tsp. baking soda
3  c. peeled, cored and sliced cooking apples (such as Golden Delicious or McIntosh)
1/2  c. finely chopped walnuts, toasted
powdered sugar (optional)
vanilla yogurt (optional)
ground nutmeg (optional)
1  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
2  Tbsp. corn syrup
1 (8 oz.)  can pineapple slices (juice pack), drained and halved
4  maraschino cherries, halved
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
2  egg whites
1  egg
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. skim milk
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: You will also need nonstick spray coating.

name: "SLOPPY JOE" CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. shell macaroni
1 (1 5/16 oz.)  envelope Sloppy Joe seasoning mix
1  lb. ground chuck
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  lb. creamed cottage cheese
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook macaroni as package label directs; drain. Meanwhile, prepare seasoning mix with ground chuck, tomato paste, tomato sauce and 1 1/4 cups water, as package label directs. Preheat oven to 350°. In 2 1/2-quart casserole, layer half the macaroni, half the cottage cheese and half the meat sauce; repeat. Top with Cheddar cheese. Bake, uncovered, 40 to 50 minutes or until bubbling. Makes 6 servings.

name: LENTIL SALAD
ingredients:
2 to 3  c. cooked lentils
1  large tomato, diced
1  small onion, chopped
fresh parsley, chopped
salad oil
vinegar
salt
pepper
other seasonings to taste (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients in bowl.  Mix well.  Serve cool.

name: LEMON LUSH
ingredients:
1  stick oleo and 1 c. flour or 1 c. graham cracker crumbs and oleo
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
Cool Whip
2  c. instant lemon pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix oleo and flour or graham cracker crumbs.  Press in 9 x 13-inch or 8 x 12-inch pan.  If using flour, bake 15 minutes at 350°.  Let cool.  (Don't bake if using graham cracker crumbs.)

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2 1/2  lb. fryer, cut up
1 stack  pkg. saltine crackers
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  container sour cream
1 soup  can chicken broth
salt and pepper to taste
paprika (optional)
preparation: Boil chicken pieces until tender.  Remove from bone and cut into bite size pieces.  Cover bottom of oblong dish with chicken. Crumble crackers over chicken.

name: ED'S BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
4 squeeze  bottles Heinz catsup
1 (5 oz.)  bottle liquid smoke
1 (5 oz.)  bottle Worcestershire sauce
1  lb. brown sugar
1/4  c. black pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients in large bowl.  Use a wire whisk to mix well.  Use funnel to pour back into catsup bottles.  Keeps well. Yummy!

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
4  egg yolks
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. sugar
2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix dry ingredients; add milk and butter.  Cook until begins to thicken.  Separate eggs; beat yolks well and add a small amount of the hot mixture to the egg yolks and slowly stir into the hot mixture.  Cook until thick; add vanilla.  Pour into baked pie crust and top with meringue.

name: OREO ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
1/2  pkg. double cream Oreo cookies
1  (9 oz.) container Cool Whip
preparation: Remove ice cream from box and put in plastic container in a sink of hot water until very soft.  Crush cookies in a bowl; add Cool Whip.  Then mix in the soft ice cream and stir until blended. Put in freezer until hard.

name: SUGARED PECANS
ingredients:
4  C. pecan halves
1  C. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg white, beaten until foamy
preparation: In a large bowl, toss pecans in beaten egg white, coating evenly. Add dry ingredients and toss well. Spread nuts on greased baking sheet, (I cover the sheet with foil and spray the foil with vegetable spray) and bake at 300 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

name: MEXICAN LUNCHEON
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  lb. sausage
1  c. onion, diced
1  c. green pepper, diced
2  c. canned tomatoes, pureed
2  c. noodles, cooked
1  c. buttermilk
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Brown  meats, onions and green pepper;	pour  off  fat. Add remaining  ingredients.   Cover and cook  10  minutes  on medium heat and 20 minutes on low heat.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SIDE DISH CARROTS FOR BARBECUE
ingredients:
1  lb. carrots
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/4  c. oil
1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. vinegar
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Peel carrots and slice in rounds.  Cook until tender, but still crunchy; set aside.  Simmer remaining ingredients until sugar dissolves.  Mix carrots with 1 small, chopped onion and 1 small, chopped green pepper.  Add sauce; mix all and refrigerate for 2 to 3 days.  Will keep for 1 to 2 weeks, covered.

name: SOUR CREAM BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising or all purpose
1  1/2 t. baking powder
1/2  t. baking soda
1/2  t. salt
1/4  c. cold butter
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.

name: PORTUGUESE BREAD
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. sugar
3  tsp. salt
1  c. boiling water
1  pkg. dry yeast or 1 yeast cake
1  c. warm water
6  Tbsp. vegetable shortening
6  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Put the sugar, salt and shortening into a bowl and add the boiling water.  Cool to lukewarm.  Dissolve the yeast in the 1 cup warm water.  Add to the sugar-shortening mixture.   Add 3 cups flour and beat smooth.  Add most of the remaining flour gradually. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, adding any remaining flour.  Grease a bowl with olive oil and place the dough in it.  Cover with a towel and place it in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Punch the dough down and divide into halves.  Shape each half into a round loaf and place each into an oiled 8-inch round pan.  Cover again and let rise in a warm, draft-free place until doubled in bulk, about another hour.  Bake in a 400° oven until nicely browned.

name: TUTTI-FRUTTI
ingredients:
10  oz. pkg. frozen sliced strawberries
6  oz. frozen orange juice
6  oz. frozen pink lemonade
10  oz. jar maraschino cherries, drained (save juice)
6  oz. crushed pineapple, not drained
2 1/2  c. water
2/3  c. sugar
4  to 5 bananas
preparation: Mix water, sugar and cherry juice.  Dissolve sugar.  Add to juice.  Mix well.  Add sliced bananas, strawberries, cherries and pineapple.  Mix all together and freeze.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
6  tops of green onions, diced
2  pkg. pastrami, diced (except 4 slices)
2  tsp. Accent flavoring
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Knead ingredients together and mold into ball.  Put the 4 slices of pastrami across top in strips.

name: CHEESE SAUCE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
4  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Melt butter in a heavy saucepan.  Blend in flour until smooth. Add milk gradually; stir until thick.  Add other ingredients, stirring constantly.

name: STRAWBERRY JAM
ingredients:
5  c. crushed berries
3  c. sugar
1 large  pkg. wild strawberry jello
preparation: Let berries and sugar come to boil or simmer a few minutes, about 10.  Then add 1 large package wildberry strawberry jello; stir well.  Then put into jars.

name: CREAMY DOUBLE DECKER FUDGE
ingredients:
1  c. Reese's peanut butter chips
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk), divided
1  tsp. vanilla extract, divided
1  c. Hershey's semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Line an 8-inch square pan with foil.  In small microwave-safe bowl, place peanut butter chips and 2/3 cup of sweetened condensed milk.  Microwave at High (100%) for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, stirring after 1 minute until chips are melted and mixture is smooth when stirred.  Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla.  Spread evenly into prepared pan.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
2  medium zucchini
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
3  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
3  c. flour
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. seedless raisins
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Finely shred zucchini to measure 2 cups; set aside.  Cream sugar and oil.  Add eggs, zucchini and vanilla; mix well.  Combine flour, cinnamon, salt, baking soda and baking powder; mix well. Add raisins and nuts to dry ingredients.  Combine with zucchini mixture; mix well.  Pour into two greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tests done.  Let stand 10 minutes; turn out on wire rack to cool.

name: COWBOY COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. shortening
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
2  eggs
2  c. rolled oats
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate bits
preparation: Sift together and set aside flour, soda, salt and baking powder.  Blend together shortening and sugars.  Add eggs; beat until light and fluffy.  Add flour mixture; mix well.  Add rolled oats, vanilla and chocolate bits.  Dough is crumbly.  Roll into small balls (1-inch).  Bake on greased cookie sheets, about 15 minutes, at 350°.  Makes about 7 dozen.

name: KARROT KAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1-1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. cooking oil
2  c. carrots, shredded
1 medium sized  can of crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients together. Drain off 1/4 of the juice from pineapple. Add juice and remaining ingredients to dry ingredients; mix well. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: SOFT PIZZELLES
ingredients:
8  eggs
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. pure anise oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. salad oil
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Beat eggs well. Add sugar gradually. Add oil, anise oil and vanilla and mix. Add flour, soda and powder; mix until smooth. If dough is too runny, add a little more flour. Bake in pizzelle iron 30 to 35 seconds.

name: MEAT CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  small cabbage, shredded
2  Tbsp. butter
1/4  tsp. marjoram
1  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. salt
2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. dark corn syrup
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. bread crumbs
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook cabbage in enough boiling water with 2 teaspoons salt; cover and cook for about 5 minutes or until tender-crisp and drain.  Add butter, syrup, marjoram and pinch of salt.  In another bowl, mix the beef, bread crumbs, milk, eggs, salt and pepper. Butter 2-quart casserole and layer the cabbage and meat, beginning with cabbage.  Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour or until meat is done.

name: MARY BALL FUDGE
ingredients:
1 large  can Pet milk
5  c. sugar
3  pkg. chocolate bits
1/2  lb. butter
2  c. nuts
1  jar marshmallow cream
vanilla to taste
preparation: Mix sugar and milk together.  Bring to a boil and boil exactly 9 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Stir in chocolate bits, butter and marshmallow cream. Stir until melted and mix well. Add vanilla and nuts. Yields about 5 pounds.

name: ONE BOWL BROWNIES
ingredients:
4  sq. Baker's unsweetened chocolate
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. chopped walnuts
3/4  c. margarine (1 1/2 sticks)
3  eggs
1  c. flour
preparation: Heat oven to 350° (325° in glass dish).  Microwave chocolate and margarine in a large bowl on High for 2 minutes until completely melted.  Stir in sugar; blend well.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Stir in flour and walnuts until blended.  Spread on greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out with fudgy crumbs.  Do not overbake.

name: SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  boxes chopped spinach or 1 large bag
1  pt. sour cream
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook spinach and drain well. Mix spinach, sour cream and onion soup mix.  Place in baking dish. Top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast (2 if in hurry)
1/4  c. lukewarm water
1 1/4  pt. warm water
1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. lard
1/2  tsp. salt
3 or 4  drops yellow food coloring
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup lukewarm water.  Combine ingredients.                        Put enough flour to make a stiff sponge.  Then let rise until double in size.  Then work in more flour until you think enough.  Let it stand 15 minutes more. Cut and drop into deep pan of hot grease.

name: ORANGE ALMOND SALAD
ingredients:
1  small head lettuce
2  long green onions, diced
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. diced celery
1  pkg. sliced almonds
preparation: Brown almonds and sugar in a skillet; sugar will melt and coat almonds.  Tear lettuce.  Toss lettuce with celery and onions.

name: SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. hamburger per person
1  small Irish potato
1  small onion
salt and pepper (as desired)
cheese (optional)
catsup (optional)
preparation: Flatten hamburger out to make a patty the size of a small plate.  Dice potato and onion; add salt, pepper, cheese and catsup.  Wrap in aluminum foil.  Bake 45 minutes at 425°.  Clip hole in end of foil and drain.  Serve with a side salad, if desired.  No cleaning up, just throw away foil and dishes are done.

name: CREAMY STUFFED BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
10  to 12 Idaho baking potatoes
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1 1/2  sticks butter
chives to taste
parslied garlic salt to taste
paprika
1 1/2  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Wrap potatoes in foil and bake at 400° for 1 hour.  Cut potatoes in half, lengthwise, and scoop out potato.  Combine scooped potato with butter, sour cream, chives and parslied garlic salt. Mash mixture with a fork until thoroughly mixed but still lumpy. Fill potato jackets with mixture.   Top with paprika and cheese. Place potatoes on a cookie sheet and bake 15 minutes in a 350° oven. Serves 20 people.

name: HOMEMADE SYRUP
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. water
preparation: Use saucepan. Brown sugar until light brown. Add water and cook over low fire until thickened. Serve with pancakes or hot biscuits. Easy and delicious.

name: CRANBERRY RASPBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen raspberries
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry jello
1  c. hot water
1  c. cold water (including raspberry juice)
1  can cranberry sauce
preparation: Thaw raspberries; reserve juice.  Dissolve jello in hot water.  Add cold water and juice.  Chill until it begins to thicken.  Fold in cranberry sauce and raspberries.  Pour into mold.  Refrigerate until firm.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
16  c. skinned and chopped tomatoes
4  c. chopped onions
4  large green peppers, chopped
10  jalapeno peppers (leave seeds in two of them)
1  clove garlic (more, if desired)
1  Tbsp. cumin
4  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. salt
2  c. cider vinegar
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
preparation: Bring all ingredients to a boil and simmer 2 hours.  Put into hot jars and seal.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  medium zucchini, diced (do not peel)
3/4  c. shredded carrots
1/2  c. onion
7  Tbsp. margarine
3  c. herb stuffing
1  can cream of mushroom soup or cream of chicken
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Cook squash in a little bit of salted water until tender and drain well.  In saucepan, cook onion, carrots and 4 tablespoons margarine until tender.  Stir in 1 1/2 cups stuffing, soup and sour cream.  Stir in squash gently.  Pour mixture into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Melt remaining margarine and toss remaining stuffing in it. Use as topping prior to baking.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
4 1/2  oz. can shrimp, rinsed and drained
chili sauce
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. horseradish
dash of Tabasco sauce
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Blend chili sauce, lemon juice, salt, pepper, horseradish and Tabasco sauce.  Fold in sour cream.  Add shrimp (broken in pieces).  Cover and chill.  Use as a dip or spread.

name: BROCCOLI-CHEESE BAKE
ingredients:
1 large  bunch fresh broccoli
1/2  c. milk
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1  c. grated cheese
2  c. bread crumbs
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
preparation: Cook broccoli until tender; drain and put into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Combine soup with milk, stirring until smooth.  Pour half of soup mixture over broccoli.  Sprinkle grated cheese over soup layer; add remaining soup.   Top with buttered bread cubes; bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Yield:  6 servings.

name: QUICK FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1  c. buttermilk
1  Tbsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Melt 1/2 cup butter in baking dish.  Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into baking dish and swirl in melted butter. Spoon in favorite fruit.  (Be sure fruit is fixed and seasoned the way you desire before spooning into mixture.)  Bake at 350° until golden brown.

name: FLUFFY POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. hot or cold mashed potatoes (leftovers may be used)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  small onion, finely chopped
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Put potatoes in a large bowl.  Add cream cheese, onion, eggs and flour.  Beat at medium speed until blended.  Put on high speed and beat until light and fluffy.  Add salt and pepper.  Spoon into a greased 9-inch casserole dish.  Sprinkle potato chips atop potatoes.  With a knife, poke crumbs into potato mixture.  Bake, uncovered, for 35 minutes in a 300° oven.

name: CHEDDAR CHEESE POTATOES
ingredients:
instant potatoes (Hungry Jack, 10 to 12 servings)
1  c. sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. onion salt (optional)
1  tsp. garlic salt (optional)
preparation: Use only milk for portion for water and milk on instructions on box of instant potatoes.  Add sour cream and softened cream cheese. Mix in Cheddar cheese and seasonings.  This can be mixed in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish sprayed with Pam.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: SWEET AND SOUR SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. salad oil
1  c. vinegar
1/4  c. water
preparation: Mix together and serve.  Celery seed or seasoned pepper may be added, if desired.

name: LOW'S SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. condensed milk
1  box Cool Whip
1  c. chopped pecans
1 small  can pineapple, drained
1  can pie filling (any kind)
preparation: Mix and store in refrigerator.

name: CORN BREAD (PLAIN)
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. cooking oil
2  eggs
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix well all ingredients.  Pour into a well-oiled 8-inch pan. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until well done.

name: CRUNCHY CHEESE CRACKERS
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. grated cheese
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. Rice Krispies
1/4  tsp. red pepper
preparation: Cream the margarine and cheese.  Add flour and pepper and mix well.  Fold in Rice Krispies.  Pinch up small amounts and place on cookie sheet.  Dip a fork in cold water and press down for design. Bake in 325° oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: CRANBERRY CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked oats
1/2  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter or oleo
1  can cranberry sauce (jellied or whole)
preparation: Mix oats, flour and brown sugar.  Cut in butter until crumbly. Place half of this mixture in an 8 x 8-inch greased baking dish. Cover with cranberry sauce.  Top with balance of mixture.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.  Serve hot in squares, topped with ice cream.

name: CHICKEN-BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box broccoli spears
3  chicken breasts, cooked and boned
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. curry powder
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
1/2  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Layer the broccoli spears and chicken in baking dish.  Mix the soup, mayonnaise, mayonnaise, curry powder and lemon juice.  Spoon over the chicken.  Sprinkle the cheese on top.  Cover with the bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: TEXAS PANHANDLE COLESLAW
ingredients:
1  head napa cabbage, chopped
2  green onions, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/3  c. rice wine vinegar
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sunflower seeds
1  pkg. Ramen noodles, crushed
preparation: Combine vegetable oil, vinegar, sugar, pepper and salt as a dressing.  Combine vegetables.  Just prior to serving, add sunflower seeds and crushed noodles.  Pour dressing over all.

name: OVEN BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. beef, cut into 1-inch cubes
1/3  c. flour
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/3  c. oil
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, thawed
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
10  small whole onions
3  c. hot mashed potatoes
1/2  lb. Velveeta pasteurized process cheese spread, cubed
preparation: Coat meat with combined flour and seasonings.  Brown in oil; drain.  Combine meat, tomatoes, peas, mushrooms and onions; mix well.  Pour into 2-quart casserole.  Cover; bake at 325° for 1 hour and 45 minutes or until meat and onions are tender.  Combine potatoes and process cheese spread; spoon around edge of casserole.  Broil until process cheese spread begins to melt. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  stick margarine
1  egg
1  (8 oz.) bar cream cheese, softened
2  eggs
1  box confectioners sugar
preparation: Mix cake mix, margarine and 1 egg.  Press into bottom of oblong (9 x 13-inch) pan.  Mix cream cheese, 2 eggs and confectioners sugar.  Spread on top.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: BETTER THAN SEX CAKE
ingredients:
1 (18 1/2 oz.)  pkg. yellow cake mix, baked as directed
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (in natural juices), undrained
1/2  c. sugar
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1  c. coconut
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
1  c. pecans, toasted and chopped
preparation: In saucepan over medium heat, combine pineapple, sugar, pudding and coconut.  Simmer 5 minutes.  Using a wooden spoon handle, poke holes in warm cake.  Slowly pour pineapple mixture over cake, spreading evenly. Cool.  Spread topping evenly over cake and sprinkle with pecans.  Chill at least 2 hours before serving.

name: TUNA NOODLE BAKE
ingredients:
5  oz. wide noodles (2 c. broken up)
1 (7 oz.)  can tuna, flaked
pepper
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. milk
1  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Cook noodles as label directs.  Mix tuna, soup, milk, pepper and noodles.  Pour into buttered baking dish.  Top with potato chips.  Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: HOMESTYLE SAUSAGE SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. kielbasa or smoked sausage, sliced 1/2-inch thick each slice quartered
1  medium onion, coarsely chopped
2  c. water
1 (5.2 oz.)  pkg. Uncle Ben's homestyle chicken and vegetable rice dish
2  c. milk
1  tsp. flour
1/3  c. chopped parsley
preparation: Cook sausage in large saucepan until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.  Add onion; continue to cook 2 minutes.  Stir in water and contents of rice and seasoning packets.  Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 8 minutes.

name: SWEET POTATO SALAD(Low-Fat!)
ingredients:
1 1/2  Tbsp. olive oil
4  Tbsp. raspberry vinegar
3/4  tsp. cumin
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
2  large, cooked sweet potatoes, cut into bite size cubes
2  stalks celery, finely sliced
3/4  c. chopped, fresh parsley
sprigs of parsley for garnish
preparation: Combine oil, vinegar, cumin and salt in a medium size bowl. Add remaining ingredients except for the whole parsley.  Toss very carefully so that the sweet potatoes stay intact.  Chill for 1 to 2 hours or overnight.  Garnish with parsley just before serving. Serves 4.  Tastes great and great for you, too!

name: CREAMY FROSTING
ingredients:
2 to 4  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
1  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook flour and milk, stirring until thick.  Cool.  Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add vanilla.  Gradually add cooled milk mixture, beating well after each addition.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES AND PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
5  c. thinly sliced peeled (optional) potatoes
1  c. chopped onion
salt and pepper to taste
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. sage
1/2  c. sour cream
6  pork chop loins, cut 1-inch thick
preparation: In a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish, layer half of the potatoes and onion.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Repeat layers.  Combine the soup, sage and sour cream.  Pour over potato mixture. Cover and bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: OATMEAL CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. boiling water
1  c. quick oats
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. oleo
1 1/3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Pour boiling water over oats.  Let stand for 20 minutes. Cream sugars, eggs and oleo.  Add flour, salt, soda and vanilla. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: FETTUCINE AU GRATIN
ingredients:
fettucine noodles (2 lb.)
1  c. fresh milk or cream or mocha mix can be used for richer flavor
1  stick butter
fresh Parmesan cheese (to taste, approximately 3 to 4 oz.)
pepper to taste
preparation: You can tell if fish is fresh if the gills are pink with fresh red blood.  Fish should not smell fishy and the eyes should be clear and firm, not cloudy.  The inside should be clean and the meat should be firm.

name: BEEF BURGUNDY
ingredients:
2  lb. cubed sirloin steak
3  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. butter
1/3  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. parsley
1  medium crushed garlic
1  medium bay leaf
3/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
6  oz. can drained mushrooms
3/4  c. Burgundy wine
3/4  c. water
preparation: Cut steak  into  cubes.  Use  all  flour on meat.  Melt butter in  skillet  and  brown  meat.  Remove  from heat.  Add onion, parsley,  garlic,  bay leaf, salt and pepper, then stir in mushrooms,  wine  and  water.  Heat until boiling.  Reduce heat until  simmering, then cover until meat is tender.  Cook for 2 to 3 hours, slowly stirring every half hour.  Remove bay leaf and serve over rice or noodles.  Serves 6.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  bunch fresh broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  c. rice
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cut up and cook broccoli and rice.  Add soup, Cheez Whiz, rice, milk and butter.  Bake in a 350° oven for 1/2 hour.

name: ICEBOX ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. mashed potatoes
1 1/2  c. potato water
2/3  c. vegetable oil
2/3  c. raw sugar
2 1/2  tsp. salt
1  yeast cake
6 to 8  c. whole wheat flour
preparation: Mix potatoes, liquid, sugar, yeast, salt and 1/2 the flour. Beat well.  Add rest of the flour to make a soft dough.  Let rise once.  Shape and bake.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar, packed
3  eggs
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream together shortening, peanut butter and sugars.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Sift together the flour, baking soda and salt.  Add to creamed mixture.  Roll in balls; flatten with fork.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or longer to light brown.

name: OATMEAL RAISIN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. rolled oats
1 1/4  c. buttermilk
2  large eggs, beaten
3/4  c. packed brown sugar
1  stick (1/2 c.) unsalted butter, melted
1  c. flour, sifted with 1 1/4 tsp. baking powder, 1/2 tsp.  salt and 1/2 tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Combine oats and buttermilk.  Let the mixture stand for 1 hour.  Stir in the eggs, sugar and butter.  Add the flour mixture and stir until it is just combined (will be lumpy).   Fold in the raisins.  Spoon batter into greased and floured muffin tins.  Bake in preheated hot (400°) oven for 15 to 20 minutes.  Makes 18 medium or 12 large muffins.

name: FOIL WRAPPED DINNER
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. beef round steak (1/2-inch thick)
1  pkg. (10 oz.) frozen green peas
4  medium carrots
4  medium potatoes, pared
1  can (10 1/2 oz.) condensed cream of mushroom soup
1  envelope (about 1 1/2 oz.) onion soup mix
8  cherry tomatoes
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Cut meat into 1-inch pieces.  Place frozen peas in colander or sieve.  Run cold water over peas, just until broken apart.  Drain.

name: UPSIDE-DOWN CHILI PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef (chuck)
1 medium  clove garlic, minced
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. frozen corn (optional)
1  c. cheese
1  small onion, chopped
2  tsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  pkg. cornbread muffin mix
prepared salsa (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°. In 10-inch ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat, cook beef, garlic and onion for 5 minutes or until beef is well browned and liquid evaporates, stirring frequently. Add chili powder. Cook for 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Stir in tomato sauce and salt. Heat through. Remove from heat. Sprinkle corn evenly over chili mixture. Prepare cornbread batter according to package directions. Spoon batter over corn, spreading to edges of skillet. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until cornbread is golden brown. Let cool in skillet on wire rack for a few minutes. Using knife, loosen cornbread from edge of skillet. Invert pie onto platter. Sprinkle with lots of cheese. Serve with salsa if you like.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. flour
pinch of salt
2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. milk
1  can sliced peaches
preparation: Melt butter in deep baking dish (8-inch square).  Combine sugar, flour, baking powder, salt and milk.  Pour over butter.  Do not stir.  Put peaches on top of batter; do not stir.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: MARY'S CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
1 (15 oz.)  can green chili peppers, drained, seeded and chopped
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. ground cumin
1  tsp. salt
2  c. chopped, cooked chicken
1 1/2  c. shredded sharp American cheese (6 oz.)
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped pitted ripe olives
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  corn tortillas
cooking oil
1/4  c. sliced pitted ripe olives
preparation: Cook the 1 cup chopped onion and garlic in the 2 tablespoons oil until onion is tender but not brown; stir in flour.  Add undrained tomatoes, tomato sauce, chili peppers, sugar, cumin and the 1/4 teaspoon salt.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly; set aside.  Combine chicken, half the cheese, the 1/4 cup onion, the chopped olive and the 3/4 teaspoon salt.  Set aside.

name: DUTCH APPLE DESSERT
ingredients:
5  medium apples, pared, cored and sliced
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. cold margarine or butter
1 1/2  c. biscuit baking mix, divided
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a medium bowl, combine apples, milk and cinnamon.  In a large bowl, cut 1/2 cup margarine into 1 cup biscuit mix until crumbly.  Stir in apple mixture.  Pour into greased 9-inch square baking pan.

name: HAWAIIAN CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. scalded milk
3  beaten egg yolks
2  Tbsp. oleo
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  c. crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. Baker's coconut
preparation: Combine flour, sugar and salt; add scalded milk gradually. Cook on low heat until thickened.  Pour small amount over 3 beaten egg yolks, then add to the remainder.  Cook 3 to 4 minutes.  Add oleo, lemon juice, pineapple (drained) and add Baker's coconut. Pour into 10-inch baked pie shell.  Top with meringue. Brown at 350° until golden brown.

name: CHEESE SOUP PRIMAVERA
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  Tbsp. finely minced onion
1/3  c. finely minced celery
1/3  c. finely minced carrots
1  c. chicken broth
1  c. half and half
2  Tbsp. flour
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of potato soup
1/2  c. chopped broccoli (fresh or frozen)
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Melt the butter in a soup pot.  Sauté the onions, celery, and carrots.  Combine the chicken broth with half and half.  Stir the flour into the vegetables, mixing well.  Add the liquid and stir. Add the potato soup and broccoli.  Mix until smooth.  Gradually add small chunks of cheese, stirring continuously until cheese melts.  Keep warm until ready to serve.

name: JEAN MUNDY'S POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
5  large eggs (one at a time)
3  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  tsp. almond flavoring
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat Crisco and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Sift flour and baking powder.  Add everything else.  Bake at 275° for 2 hours.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI #2
ingredients:
1  large chicken (4 to 5 lb.)
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. onion
1  medium bell pepper
1  pkg. spaghetti (12 to 16 oz.)
1 small  jar pimento
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Boil chicken in 6 cups salted water.  Remove chicken and add celery, onion and bell pepper to chicken broth.  Simmer until tender (30 minutes).  Remove vegetables from broth.  Broth should be 3 to 4 cups.  If not, add water.  Add to broth, the spaghetti and cook according to package directions.  Add deboned chicken, vegetables, drained pimento and cheese (cut in pieces) to spaghetti.  Stir gently until cheese is melted.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Mixture thickens as it cools.  If allowed to cool, place in casserole dish.  Bake at 300° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: PERSIMMON PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
2  c. persimmon pulp
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/8  tsp. salt
2  large eggs
1/8  lb. butter
1/4  c. cream
2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix together pulp and sugar; add eggs and beat well.  Add soda to buttermilk; stir until foaming stops and add to mixture and stir.  Sift flour; add salt and baking powder.  Sift into persimmon and buttermilk mixture and beat well.  Add cream.  Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pour into batter, leaving enough to grease pan well.  Beat mixture well.  Pour into baking pan.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until done.

name: APPLE BROWNIES
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/4  c. oil
3  large eggs
2  c. granulated sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. Granny Smith apples, chopped
1  c. nuts, chopped
3/4  c. raisins
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jelly roll pan.  Mix flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon in a large bowl. Whisk oil and eggs in another bowl until blended and smooth. Stir in sugar and vanilla. Stir in flour mixture until blended.  Stir in apples, nuts and raisins. Spread evenly in pan. Bake 40 to 50 minutes until top is golden.  Let cool on wire rack. Dust with powdered sugar.

name: ALMOND CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. noodles
2  Tbsp. butter or substitute
1  c. thinly sliced celery
2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/8  tsp. pepper
2 1/2  c. milk
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. grated American cheese
2  c. diced, cooked chicken or turkey
1/4  c. diced pimiento
1/4  c. diced green bell pepper
1/2  c. buttered soft bread crumbs
1  c. roasted almonds, diced or sliced
preparation: Cook noodles in salted water until tender.  Meanwhile, melt butter.  Add celery; cover and cook slowly for 10 minutes.  Blend in flour, mustard, salt and pepper.  Add milk and Worcestershire sauce.  Cook and stir until thick.  Add cheese, chicken, pimiento, green pepper, drained noodles and half of almonds.  Put into shallow baking dish; sprinkle with crumbs and remaining almonds. Decorate with additional almonds, if desired.  Bake in hot oven for 15 to 20 minutes until heated through.

name: FRANKS 'N RICE
ingredients:
8  frankfurters
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1 1/3  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/3  c. Minute rice
1/3  c. catsup
1/2  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Brown franks in butter in skillet, adding onion the last few minutes.  Saute until onion is tender; add water.  Bring to a boil; stir in salt and rice.  Cover; remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes.  Stir in catsup and vinegar.  Makes 4 servings.

name: MAYONNAISE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. cocoa
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. cold water
preparation: Combine dry ingredients; mix. Add mayonnaise, water, and vanilla; mix until smooth. Bake in 2 (9 inch) pans that have been greased and floured. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 375°.

name: WACKY CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. soda
6  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. white vinegar
12  Tbsp. oil
2  c. water
preparation: Mix all together in bowl.  Pour in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.  Moist chocolate cake, is better the day after.

name: PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large onion, chopped
1 large  can mushrooms, drained
1  lb. ground meat
1  can crescent rolls
1  jar Ragu
1  large container sour cream
1  pkg. cheese, grated
preparation: Sauté onions, then set aside.  Brown ground meat; drain grease. Mix the sautéed onions into the browned ground meat; add mushrooms and 1/2 to 3/4 of the jar of Ragu and place in rectangular baking dish.  Spread a layer of sour cream over the ground meat mixture. Sprinkle grated cheese over sour cream layer.  Roll out the crescent rolls over the cheese layer.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes (until rolls brown).

name: CANDIED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
1  c. dark corn Karo syrup
1/2  c. firmly packed dark brown sugar
2  Tbsp. margarine
12  medium sweet potatoes, cooked
preparation: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil.  Reduce heat; simmer 5 minutes.  Pour half into a large shallow baking dish.  Add potatoes.  Top with remaining syrup.  Bake at 350°, basting often, for 20 minutes.  Do not cover.

name: SOUTHWESTERN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
12  oz. uncooked spaghetti
1  1/2 lbs. ground beef
1  sm. onion, chopped
1  envelope taco seasoning
1- 26  oz. jar spaghetti sauce
1- 4 1/2  oz. jar sliced mushrooms, drained
1- 2 1/4  oz. can sliced ripe olives, drained
8  oz. shredded cheese
Sour cream
Salsa
preparation: Cook spaghetti according to pkg. directions. In large skillet cook beef and onions until done and drain. Stir in taco seasoning, spaghetti sauce, mushrooms and olives. Drain spaghetti and stir into beef mixture.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
white cake mix
1  pkg. cherry jello
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. strawberries
4  eggs
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. pecans (optional)
1/2  c. coconut (optional)
preparation: Mix and bake.

name: CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
Bacon
1  C chopped onion
4  potatoes, diced
1 large  can creamed corn
1  can canned milk
butter the size of an egg
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Chop and fry bacon until you have about a cup. Dip out bacon pieces and put aside. Sauté onions until clear, add diced potatoes. Cover with water and cook until just tender. Add onion, corn, milk and butter. Salt and pepper to taste.

name: MAGIC LEMON MERINGUE PIE
ingredients:
1  (8-inch) baked pie shell
2  eggs, separated
1 (14 oz.)  can condensed milk
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. grated lemon rind
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: In a medium bowl beat egg yolks; stir in condensed milk, lemon juice and rind.  Put in pie shell.

name: QUICK DESSERT
ingredients:
about 3 c. sweetened fruit
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  stick oleo
1  slightly beaten egg
preparation: Put fruit in a 9 x 9-inch baking dish.  Mix flour and sugar. Add 1 stick oleo; cut into flour as for pie crust.  Add egg.  Dough will not be smooth.  Scatter dough mixture over fruit.  Bake about 40 minutes or until crust is brown at 375° to 400°.  Serve with topping or plain.  Use any kind of fruit, berries or rhubarb.

name: FIVE STAR DIP FOR VEGGIES
ingredients:
2  c. sour cream
1  tsp. onion salt
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  Tbsp. dill weed
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
dash of Tabasco
preparation: Combine all ingredients and chill.  Makes 2 cups.

name: HEAVENLY BISCUITS
ingredients:
2/3  c. warm milk (115~)
1  pkg. RapidRise yeast
1  Tbsp. sugar
2 1/4  c. Bisquick
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients.  Let set until completely dissolved, stirring occasionally.  Add to Bisquick.  Stir vigorously 2 minutes.  Pour onto a floured sheet of wax or plastic wrap.  Knead until smooth.  Cover with mixing bowl and let rest 10 to 15 minutes.  Press down and cut out biscuits with a 2-inch biscuit cutter.  Place in a greased baking dish and let rise for at least 30 minutes.  If using a glass baking dish, bake for 18 minutes at 425°.  Yields 15 biscuits.  Brush with butter after baked.

name: SUPER EASY CONGO BARS
ingredients:
1  c. vegetable oil
1 (1 lb.)  box dark brown sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. almond extract
2 1/2  c. unsifted flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat  oven  to  350°.  Combine  vegetable oil, brown sugar, unbeaten  eggs  and  almond  extract;  set  aside.  In separate bowl,  combine  flour,  baking  powder and salt with wooden spoon.  Stir  in  chocolate  chips,  pecans  and sugar mixture. Turn  into  greased  9  1/2 x 15 x 2-inch pan.  Bake bars  30 to 35 minutes or until done.  Cool and cut into small squares. Freezes well.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1 (3 oz.)  box strawberry Jell-O
3/4  c. Wesson oil
1/2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
1/4  c. water
4  eggs
preparation: Mix cake mix, Jell-O, oil, strawberries and water, then add eggs, one at a time.  Beat well.  Bake in 2 layers at 350° until toothpick comes out clean.

name: BLUEBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. plain flour
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. nuts
butter
preparation: Melt butter; add flour and sugar.  Add nuts and press over pie plate.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes; let cool.

name: CUCUMBER-CHILE GRANITE
ingredients:
2  (14 oz.) cucumbers, peeled, seeled and cut into 1-inch chunks (3 c.)
1  fresh jalapeno chile pepper, seeded and cut up*
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. lemon
1/4  small cucumber, cut into matchstick-size pieces (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients except matchstick cucumber pieces, in a food processor or blender. Cover and process or blend until nearly smooth. Press mixture through a fine mesh strainer, 1/3 at a time, holding strainer over bowl to catch juices (you should have about 1 2/3 cups strained juices). Discard solids. Transfer strained juices to a 2-quart square baking dish. Cover and freeze for 3 to 4 hours or until firmly frozen. Break up frozen mixture. Transfer mixture to a chilled large bowl. Beat with an electric mixer until slushy, but not melted. Return to baking dish. Cover and freeze for 2 to 3 hours or until firm.

name: PEANUT CANDY(Childrens Recipe)
ingredients:
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. honey
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. powdered milk
