preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Roll into small balls, then roll in finely chopped nuts.  This is a no cook delicious candy. Children love it.

name: MILLERS GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  large onion
1  green bell pepper
2  cans green beans
2  cans tomato soup
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
instant potatoes for 6 servings
garlic salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cut up onion and bell pepper; cook with ground beef.  Season to your liking.  Drain oil.  Put beef mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Make instant mash potatoes (serving 6 people) as directed. Add sour cream and garlic salt; lay over ground beef.  Open cans of green beans; drain water and lay over mashed potatoes.  Open the tomato soup and lay over beans.  Cook at 325° for 30 minutes. Enjoy it!  It's delicious!

name: STEVE'S GRILLED POTATOES
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. potatoes, diced
3  Tbsp. Italian dressing
3  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. season salt
1/2  c. onion, diced
1/2  c. green pepper, diced
1/2  c. ham, bacon or hamburger (optional)
preparation: Wrap potatoes, onion, peppers and spices in aluminum foil twice.  Place on grill on low heat.  Turn every 15 minutes for 30 to 45 minutes.  Serves 2.

name: HEAVENLY HASH CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo or margarine
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1 1/2  c. flour
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix ingredients together well.   Pour into greased and floured oblong loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  When done, cover with miniature marshmallows and let melt.  Ice in pan.

name: CHEESE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  egg
1  stick margarine
1  box powdered sugar
2  eggs
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Blend together the first 3 ingredients; pour in an 8 1/2 x 11-inch greased pan.  Mix together sugar, eggs, cream cheese and vanilla.  Pour over mixture in pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until brown.

name: BROWNED BUTTER GLAZE
ingredients:
3/4  c. margarine
3  c. powdered sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2 to 4  Tbsp. hot water
preparation: Heat margarine; remove and add powdered sugar and vanilla. Stir in water until smooth.  Dip cookies.  Place on wax paper to cool.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chopped frozen broccoli (20 oz.)
2  c. cooked rice
1/2  stick margarine
8  oz. jar Cheez Whiz
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 small  clove garlic, chopped
preparation: Cook the broccoli as usual.  Cook the rice according to the package directions.  Saute the garlic in the margarine.   Dilute the soup with water from the broccoli (about 1/4 cup of water). Put everything into a casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SACRAMENTO FRUIT BOWL
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. anise seed
1/2  tsp. salt
1  small pineapple
1  small honeydew melon
1  small cantaloupe
2  oranges
2  nectarines (or 4 apricots)
2  purple plums
1  c. seedless green grapes
1  lime, sliced
preparation: Early in day:  In a medium saucepan over medium heat, cook 2 cups water with sugar, lemon juice, anise seed and salt 15 minutes or until mixture becomes a light syrup; chill.

name: OATMEAL BREAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. active dry yeast
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. very warm water
1  tsp. sugar
1 3/4  c. warm milk
3  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. molasses
2  tsp. salt
5 to 6  c. flour
1  c. quick oats
preparation: Mix the night before.  Bake early next morning.  Together in bowl, combine warm water, yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar.  Let stand about 10 minutes.  In a large bowl, mix milk, sugar, margarine, molasses, salt and 2 cups flour.  Mix until smooth.  Add 1 cup flour and the oats.  Mix.  Add flour to make soft dough.  Knead 10 minutes until smooth.  Add flour as needed.  Cover with plastic, then towel.  Let set 20 minutes.  Grease 2 (8 x 4 x 3-inch) loaf pans; divide dough.  Place in pan.  Brush top with oil.  Cover loosely with plastic.  Refrigerate 2 to 24 hours.  Remove; let stand 10 to 15 minutes before baking.  Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Makes 2 loaves.

name: VIOLET JAM
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. wild violet blossoms
1 1/2  c. water, divided
juice of 1 medium lime
2 1/3  c. sugar
1 (1 3/4 oz.)  pkg. powdered pectin
preparation: Rinse violet blossoms well; place in a blender.  Add 3/4 cup water and lime juice; blend well.  Gradually add sugar, blending until a smooth paste is formed.  In saucepan, combine pectin and remaining water; bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute.  Add to blender; blend for 1 minute.  Quickly pour into prepared jars or glasses and seal.  Be sure to use wild violets (common, not hot house African violets).

name: SWEET POTATO AND JALAPENO PEPPER SOUP
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. unsalted butter
1  c. chopped onions
3  medium size sweet potatoes, pared and chopped
1  frozen corn kernel (1 1/2 c.)
1  jalapeno pepper, thinly sliced
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. heavy cream
1 1/2  tsp. lime juice
1/2  tsp. grated lime rind
fresh parsley leaves, 2 to 3 Tbsp.
fresh pepper and salt to taste
3  c. chicken broth (about 2 cans)
preparation: Melt butter in large casserole dish.  Add onion.  Cook (stirring until brown) approximately 5 minutes.  Reduce heat to moderate-low and cover.  Cook until soft, then stir in sweet potatoes and chicken broth.  Bring to boil.  Lower heat and simmer, partially covered, approximately 25 minutes.  Next strain soup.  Reserve solid and liquid separately.  Put solid in blender and puree.  Whisk puree into a liquid and return to casserole. Stir in jalapeno pepper and corn.  Cook 5 minutes until pepper is crisp and tender.  Whisk in cream, juice and grated rind.  Season with salt and pepper.  Gently heat.  Serve with individual dollops of sour cream and parsley; enjoy.

name: CHOCOLATE CHEWS
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter/margarine
1/2  c. dark corn syrup
6  Tbsp. baking cocoa
1/2  tsp. vanilla
3 1/4  c. confectioners sugar, divided
3/4  c. nonfat dry milk powder
preparation: In saucepan, melt butter; stir in corn syrup and cocoa and bring to boil.  Remove from heat; stir in vanilla, two cups of confectioners sugar and milk powder.  Mixture will be stiff.  Turn out onto surface lightly dusted with confectioners sugar and knead remaining sugar; knead 3 to 4 minutes longer until stiff.  Divide into four pieces and roll each into an 18-inch rope; cut into 3/4-inch pieces and wrap each candy in cellophane or waxed paper. Yields 8 dozen candies.

name: TWO-TONE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
3/4  c. packed light brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  large eggs
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. white chocolate chips
3/4  c. milk chocolate chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Cream butter with sugars until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well.  Add flour, but do not stir in yet.  Sprinkle soda and salt over flour and fold in, so these are well distributed.  Mix thoroughly, then add chips.  Bake about 8 minutes, or until light golden.

name: MUD PIE
ingredients:
1/2  pkg. chocolate Oreo cookies
1/2  c. butter, melted
toffee ice cream
caramel fudge topping
Cool Whip
sliced almonds
preparation: Take filling out of Oreo cookies.  Crush cookies and stir with melted butter.  Press into bottom and sides of pie pan.  Chill in refrigerator about 1/2 hour.  Fill crust with toffee ice cream and freeze.  Pour layer of caramel fudge topping on ice cream and return to freezer for another 15 minutes.  Before serving, top with Cool Whip and sprinkle with plenty of sliced almonds.

name: CHILI IN A WOK
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can tomato sauce
2  cans tomato paste
2  cans kidney beans
3/4  c. onion
1/2  c. green pepper
2/3  c. water
1  tsp. garlic salt
2 1/2  tsp. chili powder
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown ground beef, onion and green pepper in wok.  Add tomato sauce, tomato paste, kidney beans and water.  Season with garlic, chili powder, salt and pepper.  Makes 4 servings.

name: WALDORF SLAW SALAD
ingredients:
6  c. coarsely shredded green cabbage
bite size chunks large apple with peel on
1/2  c. raisins
Marzetti slaw salad dressing
preparation: Toss gently to coat everything.  Chill to let flavor blend. Before serving, garnish with more apple slices.  Dip the apple in lemon juice to prevent browning.  Add 1/4 cup chopped walnuts.

name: CARAMEL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
1  c. butter
2  eggs
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. sweet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream together sugar and butter.  Add eggs and mix thoroughly. Combine dry ingredients and add to first mixture followed by nuts, vanilla and milk.  Form into two 2-inch rolls and wrap in waxed paper.  Refrigerate until firm.  Slice thin and bake on ungreased cookie sheets in 350° oven until brown.  Remove directly from sheets.  Cool completely before storing in airtight containers.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1 1/2 or 2  c. cooked macaroni
2  cans evaporated milk (one large and one small)
1/2  stick butter
1  stick sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1  egg
preparation: In a bowl, toss cooked macaroni and butter.  In a 2-quart casserole dish, alternate a layer of macaroni and a layer of cheese, ending with cheese on top. Whip together milk and egg. Pour over top layer of macaroni and cheese.  Cook in a 400° oven for 30 minutes.

name: MANDA'S HELPER
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. rice (instant)
1  c. water
1  can beef consomme
1/4 to 1/2  c. onion
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion.  Drain.  Add rice, water and beef consomme to ground beef and onion.  Cook on low for 10 to 15 minutes or until desired consistency.

name: COBBLER DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  stick oleo or butter
1  c. flour
2/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  can pie filling (cherry, blueberry, etc.)
preparation: Melt 1 stick oleo or butter in baking pan.  Mix flour, sugar and baking powder together.  Add 1 cup milk.  Pour into pan, then add pie filling.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY-RHUBARB DEEP DISH PIE(People who don't like rhubarb may even like this!)
ingredients:
4  c. sliced rhubarb
2  c. sliced strawberries
1/4  c. plain flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
2  Tbsp. butter
pastry for 1-crust pie
sugar
preparation: Combine sugar, flour and nutmeg; mix with fruit.  Pour mixture into 1 1/2-quart casserole; dot with butter and top with crust. Cut steam vents and sprinkle with additional sugar.  Bake at 425° until crust is brown and filling is bubbly, about 30 minutes.

name: EASY OVEN BROWNED POTATOES
ingredients:
1/4  lb. butter or margarine
1  envelope Lipton onion soup mix
4  or 5 quartered potatoes
preparation: Melt butter and stir in onion soup mix.  Roll potatoes in mixture.  Place in baking dish.  Pour remaining mixture over potatoes.  Cover with lid or foil.  Bake 1 hour at 400° until potatoes are easily pierced with fork.  Stir occasionally.

name: BREADED ORANGE ROUGHY
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. seasoned breadcrumbs
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. onion powder
1  lb. orange roughy fillets
preparation: Pour lemon juice in shallow bowl.  Combine breadcrumbs, cheese, garlic and onion powder in another shallow bowl.  Dip fish in lemon juice; roll in breadcrumbs.  Place fish in baking dish coated with cooking spray.   Sprinkle with remaining breadcrumb mixture.  Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily.

name: AMBROSIA FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 (13 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, drained
1  c. flaked coconut
1  c. sour cream or 1/2 c. whipping cream, whipped
1  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Mix together and chill overnight.

name: GREEN PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. round steak
1/4  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. diced onion
1  clove minced garlic
4  diced green peppers
1  c. thinly sliced celery
1  c. beef bouillon
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  c. rice
preparation: Cut steak in 1/8-inch diagonal slivers.  Place oil, salt and pepper; add slivers of steak and brown.  Then add onion, garlic, green peppers, celery and bouillon.  Cover skillet with tight fitting lid.  Cook over low heat 10 minutes.  Blend cornstarch, water and soy sauce; add to mixture and cook until juice thickens. Serve with hot cooked rice.

name: STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. ham, chopped
2 (12 oz.)  pkg. fresh mushrooms (remove and chop stems)
1  slice dry bread, crumbled
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
garlic powder, seasoned salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown all ingredients together until tender.  Place mixture into mushroom caps.  Place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, or until mushrooms are tender.  Serve warm.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick butter, softened
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
2  c. confectioners sugar
1  egg
1  stick butter, softened
5  bananas
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
crushed pecans
Cool Whip
maraschino cherries
preparation: Mix 1 stick butter and graham cracker crumbs together and press in bowl or dish for crust.

name: MAKE-UP(For Halloween)
ingredients:
2  tsp. white shortening
5  tsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. flour
3 to 4  drops glycerin food coloring
preparation: Mix ingredients together like paste.  Add colorings.

name: HAMBURGER SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
5  c. water
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
1  c. onions, chopped
1  c. carrots, sliced
1  c. celery, chopped
1/3  c. pearl barley
1/4  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. instant beef bouillon
2  tsp. seasoned salt
1  bay leaf
preparation: Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer for 1 hour. Add salt and pepper to taste.  Freezes well.

name: PEPPY POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  (3 to 4 lb.) pot roast
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
3/4  c. water
2 to 3  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Brown meat in large heavy pan; pour off fat.  Add soup mix and 1/2 cup water.  Cover; cook over low heat for 3 hours or until tender.  Stir occasionally.  Remove meat from pan.  Gradually blend remaining water into flour; slowly stir into gravy.  Cook, stirring until thickened.  Yield:  4 to 6 servings.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  lb. yellow squash
1/2  stick butter
1  large yellow onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Cooking Time: 1 hour.

name: GROUND BEEF SHEPHERDS PIE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  onion, chopped
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  tsp. dried basil
1  clove garlic, minced
1  c. green beans
1  c. tomatoes, diced
2  potatoes, cooked and mashed
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese, optional
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Coat a 2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray.  Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Cook onion in oil for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.  Stir in the ground beef and basil, and cook and stir for 5 more minutes.  Mix in the garlic, green beans, and tomatoes, and simmer for 5 minutes. Transfer beef mixture to prepared dish.  In a mixing bowl, mix together the mashed potatoes, egg and water.  Spread evenly over meat mixture.  Bake in a preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until potatoes start to brown on top.  Sprinkle with cheese, and continue cooking for 5 minutes.

name: MARINARA SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  onion, chopped
1 to 2  cloves minced garlic
20  oz. cans crushed tomatoes
20  oz. cans tomato puree
6  oz. tomato paste
water
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  Tbsp. basil
1/2  Tbsp. parsley
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. red wine
preparation: Brown onion and garlic in olive oil. Add tomatoes, tomato puree and tomato paste. Add water to thin sauce, if desired. Add spices and baking soda. Simmer for a few hours. Serve over pasta or chicken Parmesan. Add meat or meatballs to sauce.

name: 24-HOUR FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
4  egg yolks
juice of 1 lemon or 2 Tbsp. juice
1/4  c. cream
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. whipping cream, whipped
1  lb. green seedless grapes or 1 (16 oz.) can fruit cocktail, drained
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/4  lb. nutmeats (pecans, walnuts)
1  c. miniature marshmallows or 10 regular size, cut into quarters
preparation: Boil the first 4 ingredients together until thick; cool.  Add whipped cream, fruit, nuts and marshmallows.  Mix together; let stand overnight.

name: PARTY PUNCH ON ICE
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
6  c. water
2  c. concentrated orange juice, frozen
1  qt. unsweetened pineapple juice
1  c. tangerine juice (optional)
2  lemons
6  bananas
preparation: Boil together sugar and water  3 minutes; set aside to cool. Pour juice of lemons over mashed bananas.  Combine all ingredients; stir well and freeze.  Serve in parfait glasses with ginger ale.  Can be garnished with fresh peach slices, mandarin orange sections or cherries.  Makes 20 or more servings.  Keeps for days in freezer.

name: DELICIOUS SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter or margarine
3  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
6  eggs, separated
3  c. plain flour
1/4  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream sugar and butter.  Add egg yolks, one at a time.  Add sour cream.  Mix in 1 cup flour mixture, which has been sifted with dry ingredients.  Fold in egg whites that have been stiffly beaten.  Add remaining flour and vanilla.  Bake for approximately 1 1/2 hours at 300°.

name: SHRIMP BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese (room temperature)
2  can shrimp, almost drained
1 to 1 1/2  tsp. Old Bay
2  Tbsp. horseradish
1  bottle Crosse & Blackwell cocktail sauce
preparation: Soften cream cheese with fork.  Add horseradish and Old Bay. Combine and add shrimp with a little of juice from each can.  Form into a ball in plastic wrap.  Put in refrigerator for a couple of hours.  Before serving, pour some cocktail sauce over ball and add as necessary.  Serves 10 to 15 people.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. ground pork
1  egg
1 1/2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. cracker crumbs
1  tsp. mustard
1  medium size onion
black pepper
1 small  can tomato sauce
preparation: Put ingredients into a bowl and mix.  Bake about 45 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Hines regular cake mix
2  lb. strawberries
Cool Whip
preparation: Cook cake by regular cake directions.  Punch holes.  Pour strawberries, then Cool Whip.

name: STRAWBERRY MOUSSE
ingredients:
1  qt. strawberries
2  c. heavy cream
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped, toasted almonds
preparation: Wash, hull and crush strawberries.  Whip the cream until thickened.  Gradually add sugar, beating constantly.  Add salt and beat until cream is stiff.  Fold in strawberries and almonds.  Turn into 2-quart mold.  Freeze until firm.  Unmold onto serving plate. Garnish with whole strawberries and mint sprigs, if desired. Serves 6 to 8.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sieved, cooked pumpkin
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
2  c. milk
2  eggs
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Pour into unbaked pie crust.  Bake at 400° for 1 hour.

name: HEAVENLY JAM
ingredients:
5  c. rhubarb
5  c. sugar
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
juice of 1 lemon
2  pkg. strawberry jello
preparation: Boil together  first  4  ingredients  about 20 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in jello until dissolved.  Pour into jars. Either freeze or seal.

name: MOM GRAY'S MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1  lb. long macaroni
1  stick margarine
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, cut in slices
3  c. milk
preparation: Rub chicken halves with a little butter and herbs de Provence. Bake in 350° oven until tender, 45 to 50 minutes.  Serve with potatoes and vegetable or rice cooked with spices.

name: LAYERED SPINACH SALAD
ingredients:
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. refrigerated, uncooked cheese tortellini
2  c. shredded lettuce
6  c. torn spinach leaves
1  c. cherry tomatoes, halved
1/2  c. sliced green onions
1  bottle Ranch dressing
5  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
preparation: Cook tortellini to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain and rinse.  In 13 x 9-inch dish, layer lettuce, spinach, tortellini, tomatoes and green onions.  Pour dressing evenly over top; sprinkle bacon evenly over top.  Cover and refrigerate until serving time.

name: SAUSAGE DRESSING
ingredients:
1  pan cornbread
5  slices bread (toasted and cut into cubes)
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  c. chopped onion
3  or 4 chopped green onions
1  pound sausage
4  eggs
salt, pepper, crushed red pepper to taste
1 1/2 to 2  Tbsp. sage (more if needed)
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. cooked rice
chicken broth
preparation: Bake cornbread, let cool and crumble into a large bowl. Crumble sausage into frying pan.  Cook sausage with chopped celery and onions until pink color leaves sausage and celery and onions are tender.  Let cool.  Add remaining ingredients, mix well, using enough broth so dressing will not be dry.  Let set for at least 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, add more broth if needed.  Pour into buttered baking dish.  Bake at 375° until brown, about 1 hour.

name: CHINESE MUSHROOM STEAK
ingredients:
2  lb. sirloin or round steak, cut in 1-inch strips
3  Tbsp. oil
3  Tbsp. flour
2  c. water
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1/4  c. catsup
4  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  c. onion, sliced
1  green pepper, sliced into thin rings
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
preparation: Brown meat in oil; push steak to one side.  Blend flour into remaining fat.  Gradually stir in remaining ingredients, except green pepper and mushrooms. Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat. Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.  Add green pepper and mushrooms; cook 10 to 15 minutes.  Serve over rice.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: "NO COOK" FUDGE (PEANUT BUTTER)
ingredients:
2  lb. confectioners sugar
8  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1  or 1 1/2 (8 oz.) tub oleo or margarine
12  oz. jar peanut butter
preparation: Mix sugar and cocoa.  Add vanilla and oleo or margarine. Beat with electric mixer, then add peanut butter.  It is very stiff.  Spread in large pan and refrigerate for a few hours or more.

name: HAM AND EGG SALAD
ingredients:
6  hard-cooked eggs
1 1/2  c. diced ham
2  c. cooked macaroni
diced celery to taste
mayonnaise
chopped olives to taste
chopped pickles to taste
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Dice eggs and mix all ingredients.  Moisten with mayonnaise and chill.

name: CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
6  slices bacon
1/2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can pork and beans
1 (16 oz.)  can butter beans
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
2  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp, then drain and crumble.  Brown the ground beef with the onion added.  Saute until the onion is tender.  Drain.  Mix the catsup, salt, brown sugar, mustard and vinegar.  Combine beans, meats and catsup mixture in a greased 2-quart baking dish and bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: CHRISTMAS JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  box lime Jello
1 small  box lemon Jello
1/2  c. sugar
1  pt. whipping cream or Cool Whip, 8oz.
1  large Philadelphia Cream Cheese
1  can of crushed pineapple, drained
1 large  box red Jello
30  marshmallows
preparation: Mix lime jello according to pkg. instructions.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Dissolve 1 cup of hot water and lemon Jello.  Add 30 marshmallows and let dissolve.  Mix 1/2 c. of sugar, whipped cream, cream cheese and pineapple.  Add this mixture to lemon Jello. After lime Jello has set, add lemon Jello mixture on top and let set.  Then dissolve red Jello as directed on pkg. and put on top of lemon mixture.

name: LEBANESE SALAD(Tabboule)
ingredients:
2  bunches chopped parsley
1/2  bunch chopped mint leaves
1  finely chopped onion
2  finely chopped large tomatoes (red and firm)
1  to 2 lemons
3  Tbsp. bulgur wheat
olive oil
preparation: Marinate the bulgur wheat in the lemon juice.  While it is marinating, wash vegetables thoroughly and chop.  Combine vegetables and bulgur wheat.  Add lemon juice, olive oil (1 tablespoon oil for 1 tablespoon lemon) and salt and pepper to taste.  Mix thoroughly.  Decorate with romaine lettuce (leaves can be used as spoon to serve oneself).

name: DILLED SHRIMP MOUSSE PATE
ingredients:
3/4  c. canned tomato juice
1  envelope unflavored gleatin
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. dill weed
6  oz. small cooked shrimp
watercress or parsley
pitted ripe olives
lemon wedges
preparation: Pour tomato juice into 2-quart pan.  Sprinkle in gelatin and let stand about 5 minutes.  Place over medium heat and stir until gelatin is completely dissolved.  Remove from heat and let cool slightly.  To gelatin add lemon juice, salt, Worcestershire, sour cream, dill and all but 10 to 15 shrimp.  Place half the mixture in a blender and whirl until smooth.  Pour into a 2 1/2 cup mold. Repeat with remaining mix.  Cover and chill until 4 hours or until set.   Unmold onto serving plate and garnish with reserved shrimp, greens, olives and lemon wedges.  Serve with crackers.

name: IRENE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lime jello
1  c. boiling water
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1 small  can Pet milk
1 small  can crushed pineapple
pecans (optional)
preparation: Mix and jell lightly the first 4 ingredients.  Take out of refrigerator and add remaining ingredients. Chill.

name: OLD FASHIONED SUGAR CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
scant 1/2 c. sifted flour
1  tsp. salt
1  pt. whipping cream
1  tsp. vanilla
unbaked 9-inch pie shell
cinnamon
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Sift together sugar, flour and salt.  Stir in 1 cup cream to make a paste.  Stir paste until very smooth, then add the remaining cup cream.  Beat lightly.  Stir in vanilla.  Pour into unbaked pie shell; sprinkle with cinnamon and dot with 1 tablespoon butter. Bake in 400° oven for 15 or 20 minutes.  Reduce temperature to 325° or 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: QUICK LASAGNA
ingredients:
4  c. spaghetti sauce (Ragu or Prego)
2  c. low-fat Ricotta cheese
1  Tbsp. dried parsley
4  oz. grated Mozzarella cheese
1/4  lb. uncooked lasagna noodles
3/4  lb. hamburger
1  c. low-fat cottage cheese
1  tsp. chopped garlic (kind in a jar)
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: This can be put together the night before and refrigerated without baking.  Increase baking time by 15 minutes.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can pie filling
1  yellow or white dry cake mix
1 1/2  sticks margarine
1  c. pecans (optional)
preparation: Spread pie filling in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pour dry cake mix on top, spreading evenly.  Add pecans.  Pour margarine on top and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: RICE JUMBLE
ingredients:
1  lb. beef or pork
1  onion
1  green pepper
1  c. water
1  tomato
2  stalks celery
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. uncooked rice
preparation: Cut meat in cubes and fry until brown in butter.  Cut finely the onion, green pepper and celery; add to meat.  Fry until onion is soft.  Add to this the water and the rice.  Cover and cook until rice is done.  Add more water, if necessary.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. hot water
2  pkg. raspberry jello
1 medium  can pineapple chunks (13 1/2 oz.)
1  can whole cranberry sauce
1  can mandarin orange segments, drained
preparation: Pour hot water over jello.  Drain pineapple and use juice and add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups.  Chill until syrupy.  Beat cranberry sauce lightly with fork.  Fold in with rest of ingredients.

name: SQUASH DRESSING
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  c. cornbread, crumbled
2  c. yellow squash, cooked
2  eggs, beaten
1  can cream of chicken soup
poultry seasoning or sage to taste
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Saute onion in butter.  In large bowl, combine all ingredients and mix.  Pour into casserole dish and bake for 25 minutes.

name: BARBECUE RIBS
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. spareribs
2  c. catsup
2  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. liquid smoke
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. onion powder
preparation: Mix catsup, brown sugar, liquid smoke, garlic powder and onion powder.  Cut ribs into single pieces.  Broil each side 15 minutes. Place in crock-pot.  Cover with sauce.  Cook on low 8 to 10 hours.  (High temperature is too hot.  It burns the sauce and ribs.)

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (2 lb.)  pkg. hash brown potatoes
1  stick margarine, melted
1  lb. sour cream
1/2  lb. grated cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. chopped onions
preparation: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix ingredients and bake at 350°, uncovered for 1 hour.

name: GRANDMA'S CARROT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. melted margarine
2  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. grated carrots
1  c. pecans
preparation: Mix sugar, margarine and eggs.  Sift together flour, cinnamon, soda, baking powder and salt.  Add flour mixture.   Add carrots and nuts.  Put in bread pan and bake 1 hour at 325°.

name: SHRIMP OR CRAB SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
2  c. hot water
1  pkg. Knox gelatine, dissolved in 4 Tbsp. hot water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  cans tomato sauce
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
3/4  c. shrimp or crab
2  c. celery, finely cut
grapes (optional)
preparation: Combine Jell-O, hot water and Knox gelatine.  Stir until dissolved.  Blend softened cream cheese with vinegar and tomato sauce.  Add this to Jell-O mixture and mix until smooth.  Chill until mixture is slightly thickened.  Add shrimp or crab and celery.  May also add grapes.  Turn into individual molds or a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.  Chill until firmly set.  May garnish with crab legs.  Serve with crackers.

name: GLORIFIED BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
3/4  c. plain flour
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  c. chopped pecans
2  eggs
preparation: Mix ingredients one at a time.  Pour in greased baking dish. Bake 20 minutes in 350° oven.

name: TOMATO PIE
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. milk
3  or 4 tomatoes, sliced
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  tsp. basil
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. chives
1  c. sharp cheese, grated
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Combine Bisquick and milk; press into a 9-inch pie pan to make crust.  Add enough tomatoes to fill crust.  Sprinkle with salt, pepper and spices.  Combine mayonnaise and cheese; spread over top of tomatoes.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cut up cooked chicken
3 1/2  c. herb seasoned croutons
1/2  c. diced celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
1/2  c. water
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. water
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Place meat in ungreased 9 x 9 x 2-inch square or 2-quart casserole dish.  For stuffing, combine croutons, celery and onion in bowl.  Add butter and 1/2 cup water; toss until croutons are moistened.  Reserve about 1 1/2 cups stuffing; spread remainder over meat.  Blend soup and 1/4 cup water.  Pour over stuffing.  Top with reserved stuffing.  Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes or until heated through.

name: CHERRY CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) graham cracker crumb crust
1 (8-inch)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1/3  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling, chilled
preparation: In large bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.  Gradually beat in condensed milk until smooth.  Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into prepared crust.  Chill 3 hours or until set.  Top with cherry pie filling before serving.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: OATMEAL CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
3/4  c. brown  sugar (dark)
3/4  c. white sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2  pkg. chocolate chips
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. oatmeal
1 1/4  c. flour (all-purpose)
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. raisins
1  c. coconut
preparation: Cream the shortening. Add sugar and cream well.  Add vanilla. Add eggs; beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients.  Add oatmeal. Add chips, nuts, raisins and coconut.  Drop by teaspoonful onto a slightly greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 375°.

name: POTATOES SUPREME
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
1/2  c. melted margarine
2  c. Cheddar cheese
1/3  c. green onions or red onions
1  pt. sour cream
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook potatoes in small amount of salted water; drain and refrigerate until cool. Chop potatoes coarsely. Mix well with remaining ingredients. Bake in 1 1/2-quart dish at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BEETS WITH PINEAPPLE
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can tiny whole beets, drained (reserve liquid)
1 (1 lb.)  can pineapple chunks, drained (reserve liquid)
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Cook juice drained from beets and pineapple in small saucepan with cornstarch, sugar and vinegar, stirring constantly until thickened.  Add salt and pepper to taste, drained beets and pineapple and butter.  Cook slowly for 20 minutes and serve hot or cold.  Yields 8 servings.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. oats (uncooked)
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. tomato juice
1/2  c. onion, chopped
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. green pepper, diced
preparation: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Pack firmly into loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: MARTHA WASHINGTON
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
2  boxes powdered sugar, sifted
1/2  lb. oleo, melted
2  cans Angel Flake coconut
1/2  lb. chopped pecans
small box paraffin
2  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix together the first 3 ingredients and add coconut and pecans. Roll in little balls and chill.

name: SOUR CREAM SPICE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. sour cream
3  c. flour, sifted
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves
1  c. dates (optional)
1  c. raisins
1  c. nuts (optional) or citron, orange, lemon
preparation: Cream together shortening, brown sugar, white sugar, egg and sour cream. Sift together flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves. Combine with dates, raisins, nuts or citron. Drop by spoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: SPOON BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. melted shortening
3  well beaten egg yolks
2  c. milk
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
3  stiffly beaten egg whites
preparation: Cook cornmeal and 2 cups milk until consistency of mush. Remove from heat.  Add salt, baking powder, shortening and 1 cup milk.  Add egg yolks and fold in egg whites.  Bake in greased 2 quart baking dish at 325° for one hour.

name: CHEW BREAD
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  box brown sugar
3  eggs
2 1/2  c. creamy peanut butter
2  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Cream butter.  Add sugar.  Beat eggs well and add to creamy mixture, then add sifted flour.  Pour into long rectangular pan. Bake at 300° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Let sit awhile.  Real chewy.

name: BANANA POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
3  c. plain flour
1  stick magarine
5  eggs
pinch of salt
1  tsp. baking powder
3  ripe bananas, mashed
3  Tbsp. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream Crisco, margarine and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time. Beat well after each addition.  Add dry ingredients alternately with bananas and milk.  Add vanilla.  Pour into tube pan.  Bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes in 325° oven.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. oil
3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
4  eggs
2/3  c. nuts
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients.  Add flour, baking powder, salt and eggs.  Stir in carrots and nuts.  Pour into angel food cake pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: MUSTARD GLAZE FRUIT
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
3  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1 (16 oz.)  can sliced drained peaches
1 (13 1/2 oz.)  can drained pineapple chunks
1 (11 oz.)  can drained mandarin oranges
2  medium bananas, peeled and sliced
nutmeg
preparation: Heat oven at 375°.  Melt butter; stir in brown sugar and mustard.  Heat and stir until boils, remove from heat and stir in fruit.  Pour in baking dish and sprinkle with nutmeg.  Bake for 20 minutes.

name: DUMPLINGS FOR SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. butter
2  eggs
1/2  c. original pancake mix
1/2  tsp. parsley
1/5  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Combine water and butter in small saucepan.  Bring to a boil; add pancake mix, parsley and garlic, stirring vigorously until mixture leaves side of pan and forms a ball.  Remove from heat. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.  Drop tablespoon on soup. Cook about 2 minutes or until they come to the top.

name: CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
1  qt. water
4  chicken bouillon cubes
1  large onion (chopped)
1  cup celery (chopped)
1  cup carrots (chopped)
2  cups diced potatoes
1  bag frozen mixed vegetables
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  lb. American or velvetta cheese
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients in a 4 qt. pan.  Cover and simmer 20 minutes.  Add carrots, potatoes, and mixed vegetables, simmer until crispy tender.  Add soup.  Continue to simmer until vegetables are done.  Add cheese, stirring occasionaly until cheese melts.

name: LINGUINE NOODLES
ingredients:
1  lb. linguine
1  medium tomato, diced
1  medium onion
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Kraft Zesty Italian
1/2  bottle McCormick Salad Supreme
preparation: Cook linguine 9 minutes. Drain and mix with other ingredients. Mix together with hands.

name: BUFFET POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen French fries
1 tall  can evaporated milk
1  stick margarine
garlic salt to taste or other salt
2  c. (1/2 lb.) sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Place unthawed potatoes in a 9 x 13-inch casserole.  Add salt. Pour milk over potatoes; sprinkle cheese over top.  Dot with margarine.  Cover with foil and bake in a 400° oven for 45 minutes.  Serves 8.

name: AU GRATIN POTATOES
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
1 to 2  c. grated cheese
1/4  c. butter
1  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1  tsp. garlic salt
2  Tbsp. chopped green onion
preparation: Boil potatoes with skin.  Cool, peel and shred.  Add grated cheese and mix together.  Combine butter, soup, salt and green onion in a saucepan and heat through.  Add sour cream to soup mixture and stir.  Pour over potatoes and cheese and mix thoroughly.  Bake, uncovered, in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. rice (uncooked)
1  can consomme soup (beef)
1/3  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
garlic powder to taste
1/4  tsp. oregano
1  can mushrooms and juice
preparation: Saute onion in margarine.  Place in casserole dish with remaining ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: ICE CREAM PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. cooked pumpkin
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. ginger
1  graham cracker crust
1  qt. vanilla ice cream, softened
preparation: Mix pumpkin, sugar, salt & spices. Add ice cream & mix well. Put into crust & freeze.

name: FRUIT AND CEREAL BRUNCH CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Total cereal
1  c. orange juice
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  egg
2  small bananas, thinly sliced
1 1/2  c. Gold Medal all-purpose flour
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. raisins (if desired)
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
Streusel Topping (recipe follows)
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease square pan, 8 x 8 x 2-inches.  Mix cereal and orange juice in a large bowl; let stand about 2 minutes or until soft.  Mix in oil, egg and bananas.  Stir in remaining ingredients except Streusel Topping.  Pour into pan.

name: STRAWBERRY SHORTCAKE
ingredients:
2  pt. strawberries, sliced
2/3  c. sugar
2 1/3  c. Bisquick original mix
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. margarine, melted
1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. heavy whipping cream
preparation: Sprinkle strawberries with 2/3 cup sugar; let stand 1 hour. Heat oven to 400°.  Mix baking mix, 3 tablespoons sugar, margarine and milk until soft dough forms.  Drop dough in 6 mounds onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 11 or 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Beat whipping cream in chilled bowl until stiff.  Split shortcake; fill and top with strawberries.  Top with whipped cream.

name: SALTED PECANS
ingredients:
1  qt. jar pecans
1/4  c. salt
preparation: Fill a quart jar with pecan halves.  Put 1/4 cup salt in jar. Fill with tap water.  Let stand 30 minutes.  Drain well.  Pat nuts on layers of paper towels, patting with dry towels until all water is absorbed. Place on dry towels and let stand in warm room two hours.  When thoroughly dry, toast in 225° oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. boiling water
1  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. pineapple juice
1  c. ground unpared apple
1  c. ground cranberries
1/2  ground orange
crushed pineapple
grapes
1/2  c. nuts
1  c. sugar
preparation: Mix boiling water with lemon jello and pineapple juice; allow to set.  Mix remaining ingredients.  Let set.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger meat (extra lean is best)
4  oz. mild or hot salsa
8  oz. medium picante sauce
1  pkg. taco seasoning
14  oz. diced tomatoes (Del Monte Recipe Ready)
16  oz. Velveeta cheese, cubed
preparation: Brown and drain hamburger meat.  Add salsa, picante sauce, seasoning and tomatoes.  Simmer for 30 minutes on low.  Then add 16 ounces Velveeta cheese (cubed).  Stir to make sure cheese does not stick or burn.  Put in crock-pot.

name: MICROWAVE MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1  egg, beaten
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. catsup
preparation: Mix ground beef lightly with bread crumbs, egg, milk, onion, garlic, salt and pepper.  Pack mixture into a 2-quart glass baking dish.  Cover with wax paper.  Cook in microwave oven for 5 minutes at Medium-high setting.  Top with catsup; return to oven and rotate dish 1/2 turn.  Cook, covered, for 15 minutes at High setting, or until done.  Remove from oven.  Cover with aluminum foil; let stand 5 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN PIE(Yields One 9-Inch Pie)
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. pumpkin
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pumpkin spice
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. mace or nutmeg
1  can canned milk
1/2  c. molasses or Karo
preparation: Whisk all ingredients together.  Pour into deep 9-inch pie shell.  Bake at 400° for about 1 hour or until set in center.

name: AUNT SADIE'S JAM BARS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter (2 sticks)
3/4  c. sugar
3  egg yolks
3  c. cake flour (you can use regular flour if you subtract 2 Tbsp. per c.)
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. or more either strawberry or raspberry preserves
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
3  stiffly beaten egg whites
preparation: Bottom Layer:  Cream the butter with the sugar.  Blend in the egg yolks, flour, baking powder and vanilla.  Using heel of hand, fit dough into bottom of a 10 x 12-inch baking pan.

name: RHONDA'S CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless chicken breasts
1  small tube Mahatma yellow rice, uncooked
2  cans water
1  can cream of chicken and mushroom soup (may substitute creamy chicken soup)
preparation: Preheat  oven to 375°.	Put rice in casserole; add soup and water.  Season  the  chicken with salt, pepper and garlic salt. Put  chicken  on  top of rice.  Place casserole in oven for  1 hour.  Turn chicken 30 minutes in the cooking process. Check to make sure rice is not drying out, if so, add water.

name: AMAZIN' RAISIN CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. unsifted flour
2  c. sugar
1  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. milk
2  eggs
2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cloves
3  c. chopped, peeled apples
1  c. seedless raisins
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Mix the first 10 ingredients at low speed.  Stir in rest of ingredients.  Pour into three 9-inch cake pans.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes, until done.  Fill and frost with whipped topping.

name: SESAME SALAD
ingredients:
1  head red cabbage, shredded
8  Tbsp. slivered almonds, toasted
8  Tbsp. sesame seed, toasted
6  green onions, chopped
2  pkg. Ramen noodles
preparation: Mix cabbage and onions in large bowl.  Add dressing.  Break up noodles in small pieces.  Add almonds, sesame seed and noodles just before serving.

name: CINNAMON REFRIGERATOR COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  c. butter
1  egg yolk
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix flour and granulated sugar.  Cut in butter with a fork. Add egg yolk.  Mix.  Form into 2 rolls.  Beat egg white slightly. Brush it on the roll and then roll the roll in a mixture of brown sugar and cinnamon.  Chill 1 hour.  Cut into slices about 1/8-inch in thickness.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until very lightly browned (golden in color).  Makes 40 to 60 cookies.  Bake on rack higher than the middle of the oven.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. corn or burtortillas
1  can enchilada sauce
1  can taco sauce
2  cans green chilies
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  chopped onion
Monterey Jack and Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Brown meat and add onion.  Add all cans; simmer.  Layer as follows in a 9 x 13-inch dish:  6 tortillas, meat sauce and cheese.  Repeat layers; top with cheese.  Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: CHICKEN-ANDOUILLE GUMBO
ingredients:
2  large fryers (about 3 lb. each)
1  lb. andouille sausage, sliced or diced
6  large onions, chopped fine
1  large bell pepper, chopped fine
1  bunch shallots, chopped
1  Tbsp. minced garlic
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley or parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. black pepper (use 1/4 tsp. cayenne if you like it hot)
1 1/2  c. oil, preferably bacon drippings
1 1/2  c. flour
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can golden mushroom soup
8  oz. mushrooms (bits and pieces will do)
salt to taste
preparation: Boil chicken to reduce grease.  Remove the skin and debone if you desire.  I do this.

name: HEATH CANDY BAR
ingredients:
Heath brickle chips
milk chocolate
preparation: Line mold with milk chocolate.  Sprinkle Heath brickle chips into mold and cap with chocolate.

name: FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
3  pkg. each: orange and raspberry Kool-Aid
6  c. sugar
7  qt. water
1  bottle maraschino cherries
1  qt. ginger ale
3  oranges, peeled and cut up
2  lemons, peeled and cut up
1  (42 oz.) pineapple juice
1 or 2  pkg. frozen strawberries
preparation: Blenderize oranges, lemons and slightly thawed strawberries. Pour blenderized fruit into Kool-Aid mixture.  Stir well.  Then pour punch through strainer to remove small particles.  Chill. Mix ginger ale with punch before serving.

name: YUMMY POTATOES
ingredients:
8  Medium Potatoes
1  Can Cream of Chicken Soup
1  1/2 Cups Sour Cream
1/4  Cup Margarine
1  1/2 Cups Grated Cheese
Bacon, fried and crumbled
Onion
Salt & Pepper
preparation: Boil potatoes in salt water with a couple bay leaves until tender.  Drain and cool in refrigerator.  Shred potatoes and place in baking dish.  Mix soup, sour cream, margarine, onion, salt, pepper and stir into potatoes.  Top with grated cheese.

name: CLASSIC RED KIDNEY BEANS AND RICE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1/2  c. ham, chopped
1/2  c. onion chopped
1/4  c. green pepper chopped
2  cloves garlic minced
1/4  cup tomato sauce
1/4  tsp. oregano
3/4  c. water
1 15.5  oz. can red kidney beans undrained
1  pkg. Sazon goya with coriander and annatto
preparation: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat.  Add ham, onion, pepper and garlic.  Cook 10 minutes.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Serve over hot white rice.

name: LUSCIOUS LEMON CREME FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. ReaLemon juice
1  c. whipped cream
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In a bowl beat eggs and add 1/2 cup sugar and lemon juice. Beat together.  In a saucepan put 1/2 cup sugar and cornstarch. Stir in water.  Cook until thick.  Remove from heat.  Beat in egg mixture.  Cook on low heat.  Stir until slightly thickened.  Add vanilla and cool completely.  Fold in whipped cream.  Serve with fresh fruit.  Refrigerate.

name: TWO-FLAVOR FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  jar marshmallow cream (5 to 10 oz.)
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch morsels
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet morsels
1  c. walnuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine first four ingredients in saucepan and bring to a full boil over moderate heat, stirring frequently.  Boil for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat.  Add marshmallow cream, butterscotch and semi-sweet morsels.   Stir until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth.  Blend in nuts and vanilla.  Pour into greased 9-inch square pan.  Chill until firm. Yield:  About 2 1/2 pounds.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER TORTE
ingredients:
3  large ripe bananas, sliced thinly
1  pt. heavy whipping cream
1  tsp. rum, flavoring
54  graham crackers (2 sections = 1 cracker)
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. walnuts, chopped
1/2  c. cherries, chopped
preparation: Whip cream, sugar and rum together.  Arrange 9 crackers in a square.  Spread with a thin layer of cream and top with slices of banana.  Repeat layering 4 times.  Top with another layer of graham crackers.  Frost with remaining cream and decorate with nuts and cherries.

name: EARTHQUAKE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. coconut
1  c. chopped nuts (I use pecans)
1  box chocolate cake mix (Swiss, German chocolate or double Dutch)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  box powdered sugar
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Mix together coconut and chopped nuts; press into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.   Mix the cake mix as directed and pour over coconut and nut mixture.  In a separate bowl, mix together remaining ingredients and drop on top of cake using a teaspoon. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Cake should look like an earthquake goes right through the middle when done.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. oleo
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream the oleo, egg and sugar. Add flour, baking powder and salt.  Press in bottom of pizza pan.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE MIX
ingredients:
1 large  box Nestle Quik
1 (8 oz.)  box nonfat dry milk
3  oz. jar Coffee-mate creamer
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
dash of salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  May be kept on shelf and used as needed.  Combine with boiling water for a great cup of hot chocolate!

name: Hush Puppies
ingredients:
corn bread
chopped green onion
about 3/4 c. corn (fresh or canned), well drained
dash of hot sauce
hot oil
preparation: Make corn bread (not too thick).  Add chopped green onion.  Add corn.  Add hot sauce.  Drop in hot oil, very hot, 1 teaspoon at a time.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
10  lb. potatoes
1  lb. cheese
4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  large sour cream
1  lb. bacon
preparation: Dice and boil potatoes. Thicken with flour mixture. Add cheeses and sour cream. Add bacon bits or have on sides. You can halve this recipe.

name: OATMEAL SHEATH CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. boiling water (in oven)
1  c. quick cooking oats
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. butter or margarine
2  whole eggs
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1 1/3  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. Pet milk
1  c. coconut
preparation: Spread on cake.  Put under broiler until brown.

name: CHEESE ROUNDS
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
3  oz. cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. grated onion
1  loaf party rye bread
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and spread on bread.  Sprinkle with paprika and bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until bubbly.

name: BOILED COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/4  lb. margarine or butter
4  Tbsp. cocoa
2 1/2  c. oatmeal (quick)
1/4  c. chopped nuts (optional)
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. peanut butter
preparation: Cook sugar, milk, butter and cocoa for 2 minutes.  Start counting when mixture comes to a full rolling boil.  Remove from heat and add oats, nuts (optional), peanut butter and vanilla. Beat well until blended.  Spoon onto waxed paper.

name: LOU'S OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
2  c. brown sugar
1  c. margarine
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. quick cooking oats
powdered sugar
whole pecans
preparation: Sift flour, salt, baking powder and soda together 3 times. Cream brown sugar and shortening.  Add beaten eggs and vanilla; beat well.  Stir in sifted dry ingredients and rolled oats.  Form balls the size of walnuts; roll in powdered sugar until heavily coated.  Put whole pecan in center of each ball; press balls down on cookie sheet with a glass.  Bake in moderate oven, 375°, for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.  Should still be soft when removed from oven.

name: BAKED CELERY CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  frying chicken, cut up
1  can cream of celery soup
1 small  jar chopped pimentos
herb salt
pepper
salt
preparation: Arrange chicken in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle lightly with salt (not very much) and pepper.  Mix celery soup (undiluted) and pimentos.  Pour over chicken. Sprinkle herb salt on top. Bake 1 hour at 350° (moderate oven).

name: SUPER EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  doz. eggs
1  c. cottage cheese
1  c. grated cheese
salt and pepper
1  can diced green chilies (optional)
preparation: Beat eggs well.  Add cottage cheese, grated cheese, salt, pepper and drained green chilies.  Pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Place this pan inside another slightly larger pan. Add water to the larger pan so as to create a water bath.  Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

name: AUNT DAVIES CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
4 large  pkg. cherry gelatin
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. cranberries
2  c. sugar
3  apples, peeled and chopped
3  oranges, peeled and chopped
4  stalks celery, thinly sliced and chopped
1 1/2  c. finely chopped pecans
1  c. crushed pineapple, undrained
preparation: Grind the cranberries in blender. Add 2 cups sugar and set aside.  Mix the gelatin as directed on package. Refrigerate until thickened.  Mix all ingredients together with thickened gelatin and cranberries.  Refrigerate.  Makes about 1 gallon.

name: FLOUR FROSTING
ingredients:
3  tbsp Flour
1/2  cup milk
1/2  cup shortening
1/2  cup granulated sugar
1  tsp flavoring
preparation: Mix Flour and milk, cook until it is a smooth thick paste, cool well.  Add remaining ingredients and beat together until fluffy, the longer the better.

name: CHEESY CHILI RELLENOS
ingredients:
6  canned whole mild green chiles
6  (3 x 1/2 x 1/2-inch) strips Monterey Jack cheese
3  eggs, separated
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. water
1/4  tsp. salt
all-purpose flour
canola oil
preparation: Rinse chiles; remove seeds and pat dry.  Stuff chiles with strips of cheese.  (If chiles tear, overlap torn sides; batter will hold them together.)  Beat the egg yolks with an electric mixer until fluffy and pale yellow (about 3 to 5 minutes).  Add 3 tablespoons flour, water and salt; mix well.  Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into yolk mixture.   Dredge stuffed chiles in flour, coating well.  Dip chiles in egg mixture.  Brown chiles on both sides in 1/2 inch of oil at 370° for 3 to 5 minutes.  Drain on paper towels.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  qt. softened squash, seasoned
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  stick butter
1/2  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. cracker crumbs
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Save some cheese and crumbs for top.

name: MAPLE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  c. maple sugar
1  c. pineapple chunks
3  eggs, separated
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. lemon extract
1  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Melt butter in bottom of 8-inch round cake pan.  Mix in maple sugar.  Arrange pineapple chunks to cover bottom of pan.  Mix beaten egg yolks with sugar; add milk and extract, then dry ingredients, sifted together.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour batter over pineapple.  Bake in moderate oven at 350° about 45 minutes.  Invert and serve out in wedges, garnished with whipped cream.  Makes 6 servings.

name: ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
1  box cottage cheese
1 small  box orange jello
1 small  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 (9 oz.)  box Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cottage cheese with jello.  Add oranges and Cool Whip. Mix well.  Let set 1 hour.  Keep refrigerated.

name: HOMEMADE DEEP DISH PIZZA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. onions, chopped
1/4  c. green peppers
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato sauce (with bits)
1  pkg. Jeno's pizza mix
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese slices
preparation: Brown meat; drain off grease. Add onions and peppers. Add tomato sauce, pizza mix sauces and spices. Simmer 15 minutes. Heat oven to 425°.  Prepare dough. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan up both sides. Fill dough in bottom and up sides as far as you can. Cover bottom with half the cheese, then half meat sauce, then the other half of the cheese, then the remaining meat sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes.  Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

name: HAM LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground pork
1  lb. ground ham
3/4  c. bread crumbs
1 1/2  c. milk
1  egg
1  medium onion
pinch of salt
preparation: Soak bread crumbs in  milk  and  salt.  Add to meat and form a loaf. In a  saucepan  warm  1/2  cup tomato juice and 3 tablespoons brown sugar.  Pour  over loaf.  Bake at 275° until heated through, then 300° until done.

name: LINZERTORTE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour*
1/4  tsp. salt (omit if using salted butter)
1  c. sugar
1  c. butter
grated rind of 1 lemon
3  egg yolks
1 1/3  c. unblanched almonds, ground finely*
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1 (10 to 12 oz.)  jar raspberry jam (preferably seedless), divided
preparation: Sift flour with salt.  Cream sugar with butter until the mixture is light and fluffy.  Add the grated rind of 1 lemon and the egg yolks, one at a time, beating well after each addition.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
12  oz. V-8 juice
1  c. chili sauce
1  c. catsup
1/2  c. lemon juice
1/4  c. prepared mustard
1/4  c. vegetable oil
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients in saucepan.  Cook uncovered.  Boil for 5 to 6 minutes.  Serve.  Refrigerate any unused portions.

name: STUFFIN' MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. low-fat Ricotta cheese
1/2  c. unsweetened applesauce
1/2  c. Fruit Sweet
2  Tbsp. oil
1  egg
2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. wheat germ
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. allspice
1  c. shredded zucchini or carrots or combination of both
1/4  c. chopped apple
1/4  c. raisins
1/4  c. sunflower seeds (optional)
preparation: In large bowl cream Ricotta, applesauce, fruit sweetener and oil.  Stir in egg and vanilla.  In separate bowl combine flour, wheat germ, soda, baking powder, nutmeg and allspice.  Add to batter; blend well.  Add zucchini, apples, raisins and sunflower seeds.  Spoon into 15 muffin cups which have been sprayed with nonstick coating.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes (or until firm and golden brown) at 350°.  Makes 15 muffins.

name: PEANUT BUTTER KISSES
ingredients:
2  c. creamy peanut butter
1 1/4  c. granulated sugar
2  large eggs
48  Hershey's Kisses (9 oz. bag)
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Have cookie sheets ready.  Stir peanut butter, sugar and eggs in a bowl until blended (it will be sticky).  With floured hands, roll level measuring tablespoonfuls into 1 1/4-inch balls.  Place 1 1/2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets.  Bake for 12 to 14 minutes until cookies look dry and tops crackled.  Remove from oven and immediately press a kiss in center of each.  Cool on cookie sheet 1 to 2 minutes, then remove to wire racks to cool.  Store airtight in one layer up to 3 weeks.

name: BOILED EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
1  qt. milk
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. flour (plain)
2  eggs
preparation: Mix  sugar,  flour and eggs together.  Beat well.  Heat milk to	scalding.  Gradually  pour egg mixture into milk and cook until it coats a spoon.  Add 1 teaspoon vanilla.

name: KAHLUA
ingredients:
1/2  gal. bottled water
2/3  c. instant coffee
6  c. sugar
6  tsp. vanilla
4  c. vodka
preparation: Simmer water, coffee and sugar for 2 hours.  Cool and add vanilla and vodka.  Let stand 3 to 4 weeks.

name: MICROWAVE LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (15 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. red wine (optional)
8  uncooked lasagna noodles
2  c. cottage cheese
3  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook ground beef on stove or in microwave; drain.  Combine beef, spaghetti sauce, water and wine.  Spread one-third of mixture into microwavable 12 x 8-inch dish (lightly greased).  Arrange 4 noodles on sauce.  Layer 1 cup cottage cheese and 1 cup Mozzarella cheese.  Repeat layers, ending with meat sauce.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Cover with plastic wrap and fold back one corner. Microwave at 50% power for 32 to 35 minutes (turn dish after 15 minutes).  Uncover; sprinkle with 1 cup Mozzarella cheese and cook 2 minutes more.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE MIX
ingredients:
8  qt. pkg. dry milk
6  oz. jar Coffee-mate creamer
1  lb. instant cocoa mix
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Combine all ingredients. Store in airtight container. Add 2 heaping tablespoonfuls to 1 cup hot water.

name: ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. cooked hamburger
2-10 oz. cans enchilada sauce
1  can Rotel
1-16 oz. can chopped black olives
1  c. diced onions
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
12  corn tortillas (quartered)
preparation: Mix hamburger, sauce, onions 3/4 of Rotel and olives.  Set aside.

name: LOW SUGAR STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  box sugar free jello (strawberry)
fresh strawberries
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  low fat graham cracker crust
preparation: Add cornstarch to 2 c. boiling water.  Then add jello to the water.  Cut and slice strawberries.  Then arrange them in the bottom of the crust.  Pour mixture into the crust.  Chill 2 hours.

name: SPLIT PEA SOUP
ingredients:
1  ham bone or 1 1/2 cups ham
16  oz. pkg. split peas
2  carrots, thinly sliced
1  medium onion, chopped
1/4  tsp. whole allspice
1/4  tsp. peppercorns
1  bay leaf
salt
7  c. water
preparation: In Dutch oven or large kettle over medium heat, heat ham bone, split peas, carrots, onion and 7 cups of water to boiling. Meanwhile, tie allspice, peppercorns and bay leaf in a cheesecloth bag.  Add to ham bone mixture.  Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 1 hour.  Discard spice bag.  Add salt to taste. Remove meat from bone and return meat to soup.  Discard bone. Makes about 7 cups or 6 servings.

name: CHICKEN NOODLE SOUPGroves, Texas
ingredients:
1  can Chicken Noodle soup
crackers
preparation: Get soup out of cabinet and open with can opener.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. diced onion
2  Tbsp. fat
1  c. green pepper, diced
1  c. chopped tomato
1  c. celery, diced
1/2  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  c. meat stock
1  c. catsup
salt
red pepper
paprika
preparation: Heat fat.  Stir and fry onions lightly.  Add remaining ingredients and cook over low heat about 50 minutes.  Serve with any cooked meat except fowl.

name: CHOCOLATE BUNDT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1 (3.4 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1  c. sour cream
3  eggs
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. water
4  ozs. grated german sweet chocolate
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. chocolate frosting
pecan halves
preparation: In a mixing bowl combine cake and pudding mixes, sour cream, eggs, oil and water.  Beat on low speed for 2 minutes.  Fold in grated chocolate, chocolate chips and chopped pecans.  Transfer to a greased and floured 10 inch fluted tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan.  Drizzle with frosting and garnish with pecan halves.

name: COLD SPINACH SOUP
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
1  c. chopped scallions or green onions
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
12 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans cream of potato soup
2 (13 1/2 oz.)  cans chicken broth
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. pepper
salt to taste
1/2  c. half and half cream
1  c. sour cream
preparation: In large frying pan, melt butter and saute scallions. Transfer to large bowl and add spinach, potato soup, chicken broth, lemon juice, salt and pepper.  Puree in blender or food processor.  Put back into bowl and stir in cream and sour cream. Chill at least 8 hours.  Garnish with chopped parsley and/or lemon rind.  Serves 8.

name: Chicken Soup
ingredients:
6  c. chicken broth
1  c. carrots, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
1  c. frozen corn
1  c. frozen peas
2  c. shredded chicken
1  c. drain, cooked macaroni
black pepper to taste
2  tbsp. Parsley
preparation: Mix all ingredients in stockpot and heat over medium heat.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (No. 303)  cans green beans (French style)
1  c. grated cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can onion rings
preparation: Mix beans, soup and cheese.  Pour in pan and top with onion rings.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CREAM CHEESE MINTS
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
7 to 9  drops oil of peppermint
2  Tbsp. milk
1  box powdered sugar
preparation: Add additional milk by the teaspoon until right to mold.  Use rubber type molds.  Dry on wax paper and freeze. Great for weddings and showers.

name: CREAM OF BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. broccoli, chopped
1/4  c. onion, chopped
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3  Tbsp. flour
5  c. milk
2  c. whipping cream
4  c. grated or minced sharp Cheddar cheese
salt to taste
freshly ground white pepper to taste
preparation: Steam the broccoli until tender. Chop coarsely and set aside. Saute the onion in butter or margarine until soft, but not brown. Add flour and stir until paste-like.  Blend in milk and cream. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened and smooth.  Add cheese by the handful, stirring until smooth. Add broccoli and salt and pepper.  Serves 12.

name: FLANK STEAK TERIYAKI
ingredients:
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. salad oil
2  Tbsp. honey
1  Tbsp. wine vinegar
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1  large flank steak
preparation: Combine all marinade ingredients. Marinate 1 large flank steak in refrigerator for about 4 to 6 hours. Refrigerate until about 1/2 hour before grilling. Broil meat about 4 minutes per side for rare or longer for desired degree of doneness. Slice thinly on the diagonal.

name: FEATHER ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. scalded milk
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
3/4  tsp. salt
1  yeast cake
4  c. flour
2  well beaten eggs
preparation: In a bowl, add oil, sugar and salt to milk.  When lukewarm, add yeast.  Stir well and add eggs and enough flour to make a stiff dough.  Cover and let rise until double.  Punch down and put in muffin pans.  Let rise.  Bake 30 minutes at 375°.  Makes approximately 24 to 30 rolls.

name: DIVINITY CANDY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  c. water
2  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla
nuts
preparation: Cook sugar,  Karo and water until syrup forms hard ball in cold  water.  Beat egg whites until they will cling to bowl when upside down.  Syrup and egg whites should be ready at the same time.  Add  syrup  to  egg whites slowly, beating all the time until  it  will  stand  when  dipped  with a spoon onto a plate. Add nuts.

name: FRENCH TOAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  slices bread, cubed (no crusts)
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, cubed
12  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. maple syrup
2  c. milk, cream or canned milk
cinnamon (lots)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Use an oblong dish; butter or spray bottom.  Beat the eggs with the vanilla and some cinnamon and the milk.  Blend the syrup and the cream cheese.

name: GREEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  doz. flour tortillas
1  (8 oz.) Monterey Jack cheese
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. chicken broth
1  c. sour cream
3/4  c. chopped onion
1  (4 oz.) green chilies, chopped
1  chopped chicken, deboned
preparation: Add soup and broth; warm.  Roll tortillas with chicken and cheese.  Pour soup mixture over them.  Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.

name: IMPOSSIBLE CHICKEN PARMIGIANA PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. creamed cottage cheese (small curd)
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1 1/2  c. cooked chicken
1 1/4  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese (5 oz.)
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1/2  tsp. dried basil
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
2  eggs
2/3  c. Bisquick
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Grease a 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate.  Layer cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in pie plate.  Mix chicken, 1/2 cup of Mozzarella cheese, the garlic powder, oregano, basil and tomato paste.  Spoon over Parmesan cheese.  Beat remaining ingredients in blender on high for 15 seconds or 1 minute with hand beater or until smooth.  Pour into pie plate.  Bake 30 minutes.  Top with remaining Mozzarella cheese.  Bake 5 to 8 minutes longer or until knife comes out clean.  Cool 5 minutes.

name: FOR GOODNESS SAKES SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon flavored gelatin
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime flavored gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1  c. evaporated milk
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, undrained
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. cottage cheese
1  c. chopped nuts
1  Tbsp. horseradish sauce
preparation: In a large bowl, dissolve gelatins in boiling water.  Cool slightly.  Stir in milk, pineapple with juice, mayonnaise, cottage cheese, nuts and sauce.  Mix well.  Chill until partially set. Pour into oiled mold and chill 6 or 8 hours.  Unmold.

name: CHEESE LUNCHEON DISH
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  c. milk
1  c. fresh bread crumbs
1  c. grated cheese
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. baking powder
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Beat eggs;  add milk and remaining ingredients.  Pour in pie baking dish and cook in moderate 350° oven for approximately 45 minutes or until brown and set.

name: HONEY-GLAZED POTATOES
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. new potatoes, cut into quarters
1/2  c. butter
1/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. honey
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
preparation: In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, cover potatoes with salted water.  Bring water to a boil and cook until potatoes are tender. Drain.  In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.  Stir in water, honey, salt and pepper, stirring occasionally.  Cook one layer of potatoes for 10 to 12 minutes or until brown.  Transfer to a serving dish and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. Repeat for remaining potatoes.  Serve warm.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: SHRIMP-CHILI DIP
ingredients:
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  can shrimp, drained
3/4  c. chili sauce
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
preparation: Combine all ingredients in small mixing bowl and mix at medium speed of mixer until well blended.  Makes 2 cups.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  carton cottage cheese (16 oz.)
1  (3 oz.) jello (any flavor)
1  small Cool Whip
1 small  can pineapple chunks
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix cottage cheese and dry jello. Add fruit and Cool Whip. Chill until firm.

name: FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
3  oz. gelatin, any flavor
1  c. hot water
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  qt. cold water
2 1/2  c. pineapple juice
1/2  c. lemon juice
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in hot water.  Add sugar and stir till dissolved.  Add lemon juice, cold water and pineapple juice.  Stir well.

name: LUMPIA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground pork
1  lb. shrimp, chopped finely
1/2  lb. onions, chopped finely
1/4  c. soy sauce
bok choy, chopped finely
bean sprouts, chopped finely
celery, chopped finely
carrots, chopped finely
won ton wrappers (found in produce department)
preparation: Brown pork and drain. Mix all ingredients, except wrappers. Take a heaping tablespoon and roll in won ton wrapper according to package directions. Deep-fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

name: PINK CLOUD
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  can pineapple, drained (16 oz. chunks or tidbits)
1  Extra Creamy Cool Whip (12 oz.)
1  can cherry pie filling
Chopped nuts
preparation: Mix together and chill.

name: HOT DEVILED CLAM SNACK
ingredients:
2  tsp. chopped onion
1 1/2  Tbsp. butter
3/4  c. buttered bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  can minced clams
1  c. clam liquid and milk to equal 1 c.
2  hard-boiled eggs
1  tsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Saute onion in butter until tender.  Add flour, salt and pepper; blend.  Drain clams and add quantity of milk to juice to make one cup.  Add liquid to flour mixture gradually, until thick. Add remaining ingredients except for bread crumbs.  Place in shallow glass pie plate.  Top with buttered bread crumbs. Sprinkle top with paprika.  Bake until brown at 350° or about 20 minutes.

name: ENCHILADA PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. corn tortillas
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1 1/2  c. Cheddar cheese
1 (16 oz.)  can pinto beans
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies
1  can chopped tomatoes and green chilies
1  can cream of chicken soup
garlic salt
preparation: Line a 10 x 12-inch baking dish with tortillas.  Place cooked beef on top of tortillas.  Sprinkle with garlic salt.  Add beans, then cheese.  Break up remaining tortillas and place on top.  Mix tomatoes and green chilies and cream of chicken soup and pour over the casserole.  Sprinkle top with chopped chilies.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Reduce heat to 250° and bake for another 30 minutes.

name: ARMENIAN RICE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1  medium onion, chopped
5  slices bacon, diced
2  c. Uncle Ben's long grain rice
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
3  cans consomme soup
3  cans bouillon soup
1  pkg. slivered almonds
1  can mushrooms or 1 c. fresh
1  can water chestnuts
preparation: Saute onion and bacon.  Add butter and rice.  Fry 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and cook over medium-low heat until rice is tender.  Serves 12.

name: HEARTY HOMESTYLE BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  bunch broccoli, chopped
2  c. boiling water
1  medium onion, chopped
2  stalks celery
2  carrots, peeled and chopped
2  potatoes, peeled and chopped
1  stick margarine
1/2 to 3/4  c. flour
2  c. milk
3  c. hot chicken broth
1  tsp. celery salt
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. parsley, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Steam chopped  broccoli  over  boiling	water  (reserve water).

name: 7 LAYER PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1  carton sour cream
1 small  jar mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  pkg. Cheddar cheese
fried bacon
1  head lettuce
bell pepper
green onion
cauliflower
English peas (frozen)
radishes
celery
preparation: Combine the sour cream, mayonnaise and sugar, then set aside. Layer in salad bowl the lettuce, bell pepper, green onion, cauliflower, English peas, radishes and celery, then pour dressing over top.  Then crumble bacon over the dressing.  Then sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.

name: QUICHE ZUCCHINI
ingredients:
3  c. thin sliced unpared zucchini
1  c. Bisquick
1/4  c. Italian cheese
2  Tbsp. parsley
1/2  tsp. Lawry's seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  c. vegetable oil
4  beaten eggs
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Mix all ingredients with beaten eggs. Spread in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Bake until golden brown. Cut in pieces.  Easy and delicious.  Bon appetit!

name: EASY APPLE BAKE
ingredients:
2  tubes crescent rolls
2  med. Granny Smith apples, peeled and cored
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. butter or margarine, melted
3/4  c. Mountain Dew
Ground cinnamon
Vanilla ice cream, optional
preparation: Unroll crescents and separate dough into 16 triangles. Cut each apple into eight wedges. Wrap a crescent dough triangle around each apple wedge. Place on greased 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish.

name: PORCUPINES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/4  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/2  c. raw rice
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. oil
2  cans tomato sauce
1  c. water
preparation: Mix ground beef, chopped onion, poultry seasoning, raw rice, pepper and salt; form mixture into small balls (about the size of walnuts).  Brown lightly in uncovered pan in oil; drain off excess fat.  Add tomato sauce and water.  Cover tightly; simmer for 45 to 50 minutes, or until rice is tender.

name: RAISIN SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. raisins
2  c. water
1  tsp. cloves
1 small  can frozen orange juice
1/4  c. vinegar
2  c. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Wash raisins, cover with water.  Add cloves and simmer 10 minutes.  Add orange juice and vinegar.  Bring to a boil.  Add brown sugar, cornstarch and butter.  Cook until slightly thickened.  Serve as hot sauce with ham.  Any left over may be frozen.

name: PASTRY MADE WITH OIL
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. oil
1/4  c. cold milk
preparation: Mix flour and salt.  Measure  oil and milk into measuring cup. Add to flour and  stir with fork until mixture forms a ball. Divide in half and  roll  between two sheets of waxed paper. Makes two crusts.  Bake  at  450° for ten minutes when recipe calls for use of baked pie shell.

name: BAKED BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. lean beef stew meat in 1-inch cubes
1  c. canned tomatoes, cut up
6  carrots, cut into strips
1/2  c. thick sliced celery
3  medium potatoes, peeled and quartered
1  medium onion, sliced and separated into rings
3  Tbsp. quick cook tapioca
1  slice bread, crumbled
1  c. water
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Place in 3-quart casserole.  Cover and bake at 325° for 3 1/2 hours.  (Other spices and herbs may be added to taste: basil, thyme, marjoram, bay leaves, etc.)

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  c. cornmeal (plain)
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. whole kernel corn
1  c. chopped onions
3  Tbsp. chopped hot pepper
1  c. shredded Velveeta cheese
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: In a mixing bowl, combine first 6 ingredients.  Combine remaining ingredients; add to dry ingredients and stir only until moistened.  (Add water if necessary.)  Pour into a greased 9-inch square baking pan or 10-inch heavy skillet.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until bread is golden brown and tests done. Yield:  8 to 10 servings.

name: CABBAGE AU GRATIN
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. cabbage
2  Tbsp. butter
6  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
1/4  lb. mild Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Cut and cook cabbage in water until tender.  Drain.  Make white sauce using butter, flour and milk.  When white sauce is thickened, layer cabbage with white sauce alternately in greased baking dish.  Top with grated cheese and bake for 20 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chopped broccoli
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1/2  c. butter
1  medium onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  c. rice, cooked (1 c. not cooked = 2 c.)
preparation: Chop onion and sauté in butter. Cook rice and broccoli. Mix all together. Preheat oven to 350° and cook for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE FONDUE DIP
ingredients:
16  oz chocolate (milk, dark or semisweet), broken in pieces
1/2  pint whipping cream
1/2  c caramel topping
3  Tbsp Torani hazelnut syrup or favorite liqueur
preparation: Place all ingredients in a ceramic fondue pot over low heat. Stir constantly until the mixture is melted and smooth. Do not allow to bubble. Arrange an assortment of bite-sized dipping foods on a tray. Some suggestions are strawberries, bananas, apples, grapes, cherries, pound cake, marshmallows, raisins and shelled nuts. Spear with fondue forks or wooden skewers, dip swirl and enjoy!

name: CHEESE DREAM SANDWICHES
ingredients:
2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
