1 1/2  c. chopped pecans (optional)
1  medium onion, chopped
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
4  stalks celery, chopped
preparation: Grate cheese and all ingredients.  Mix well and refrigerate. To prepare rolled sandwiches, flatten one slice of trimmed bread with rolling pin.  Spread with filling.  Roll from one corner of bread to the other.  Fasten with a toothpick.  Chill rolls.  Brush with melted margarine and toast just before serving.  Makes 70 sandwiches.  Freezes well.  Delicious.

name: BAKED SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. zucchini or yellow summer squash
3  Tbsp. onion, chopped
3  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. Tabasco sauce
2  tsp. parsley flakes
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. oleo, melted
2  c. cracker crumbs
preparation: Slice squash in 1/2-inch pieces.  Boil 3 minutes or until tender.  Drain.  Add onion, eggs and seasonings.  Mix until well blended.  Pour into 1-quart buttered casserole.  Mix butter and crumbs.  Sprinkle over squash.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes until browned.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. Karo white syrup
1  tsp. soda
1/2  stick butter
2  c. peanuts
preparation: Cook sugar and syrup in heavy pan until syrup bubbles, then add nuts and cook until candy turns light brown.  Add butter and soda.  Remove from heat.  Stir until butter is melted.  Pour in buttered cookie sheet.  When hard, break into pieces and store in airtight tin.

name: SHRIMP SCAMPI
ingredients:
2  lb. shrimp, peeled
3 or 4  cloves garlic
1/2 to 3/4  stick margarine
1/2 to 1  tsp. Paul Prudhomme seafood seasoning
3/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. cayenne pepper
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. parsley
vermicelli or spaghetti
preparation: Peel shrimp and devein.  Place shrimp and butter in a covered dish.  Cook on High in the microwave for 5 minutes.   Combine seasoning, water, cornstarch, pepper, lemon juice and parsley. Mix well.  Pour over shrimp and stir.  Cook, covered, 5 minutes. Uncover and cook 5 more minutes.  Serve on vermicelli or spaghetti.

name: CRACKLIN' BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. meal
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. flour
1  egg
1/4  c. buttermilk
1  c. cracklings
preparation: Mix the ingredients and bake in medium tins, corn stick pan or baking pan.  This is a Georgia Agrirama recipe.

name: CORN BREAD SALAD
ingredients:
1  cup cornmeal
1/2  teaspoon salt
1/2  teaspoon baking soda
1  cup milk
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  cup melted shortening
8  oz. bacon fried crisp, crumbled
1  onion, chopped
1  tomato, chopped
1/2  cup mayonnaise
preparation: Mix cornbread, salt and baking soda in bowl.  Stir in milk, eggs and shortening.  Pour into greased 9 X 12 in baking pan.  Bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until golden brown.  Let stand until cool. Crumble into bowl.  Stir in bacon, onion and tomato.  Fold in just enough mayonnaise to coat.

name: CHAMPAGNE PUNCH
ingredients:
1  bottle champagne
1/2  gal. pineapple sherbet
1  (6 oz.) frozen orange juice
1  (6 oz.) frozen lemonade
1 (2 liter)  bottle 7-Up
1 (64 oz.)  can unsweetened pineapple juice
ice
preparation: Put sherbet in punch bowl, then add the following: frozen orange juice, frozen lemonade, unsweetened lemonade, 7-Up and champagne.  Stir, then add ice and serve.

name: GWEN'S VEGETARIAN SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  c. pinto beans (dry)
1/4  c. black-eyed peas
1/4  c. lentils
1/4  c. lima beans
1/2  c. navy beans
1/4  c. split peas (yellow or green)
1  c. chopped celery
2  medium onions, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can green beans (with juice)
2  large potatoes or turnips or both (optional)
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. rosemary
1/2  c. chopped fresh parsley or 3 Tbsp. dried parsley
3  large carrots, cut up
1  c. frozen corn
1 large  can tomatoes  (32 oz.) or combination of puree and tomato
1  tsp. salt or to taste
1  tsp. chili powder
1 1/2  tsp. dried basil
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. garlic powder or 2 fresh garlic cloves, minced
preparation: Soak all dried beans except lentils and split peas overnight. Cook beans in about 4 cups water for about 1 hour.  (Not the lentils and split peas.)  If beans seem hard, cook awhile longer. Add lentils and split peas.  Simmer for 20 minutes. Add canned tomatoes, celery, carrots and onions and all spices and herbs. Simmer for 30 minutes. Add more water if too thick. Add potatoes and turnips (if adding). Simmer for 15 minutes. Add frozen corn and green beans. Simmer for about 10 minutes.

name: MOCK LOBSTER SALAD
ingredients:
6  lb. haddock fillets
1  can whole tomatoes
1  medium onion
celery
salt and pepper
mayonnaise or salad dressing
preparation: Cook fish, tomatoes and whole onion until fish is ready.  Pour into colander.  Take out onion and let cool.  Flake fish and cut in celery.  Add flaked fish, tomatoes, celery and salad dressing.

name: BREAKFAST BURRITOS
ingredients:
12  bacon strips, diced
12  eggs, slightly beaten
Salt and pepper to taste
10  flour tortillas (7 inch)
1 1/2  c. shredded cheddar cheese
1/2  c. thinly sliced green onions
preparation: Cook bacon in skillet until crisp; drain on paper towel. Reserve 1-2 Tbsp. drippings. Add eggs, salt and pepper to drippings; cook and stir over medium heat until eggs are completely set. Spoon 1/4 cup of egg mixture down the center of each tortilla; sprinkle with cheese, onions and bacon. Fold bottom and sides of tortilla over filling.

name: NO WORK CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless chicken breasts
1/2  c. honey
1/2  c. Dijon style mustard
1  Tbsp. curry powder
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Place chicken, skin side down, in flat baking dish in one layer.  Mix all other ingredients together.  Pour over chicken and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight.  When ready to cook, turn chicken, cover dish with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Remove foil; baste well.  Continue baking, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Serves 4.

name: SANTA'S WHISKERS
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
3/4  c. chopped cherries
1/2  c. chopped nuts
3/4  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Cream butter and sugar with mixer.  Blend in milk and vanilla. Stir in flour, cherries, nuts and coconut.  Form into 2 rolls (each 2 inches in diameter and 8 inches long).   Slice 1/4 inch thick.  Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

name: FANCY RABBIT(This is good, but takes a while to prepare.)
ingredients:
1  cut up rabbit
1  small onion, sliced
1/2  c. cider vinegar
1/2  c. flour
1  c. sour cream
1  c. wine
1/2  c. water
salt and pepper
3  whole cloves
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Place rabbit in baking dish; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with mixture of onions, wine, water and vinegar.  Place in refrigerator for 2 days.  Pat rabbit dry.  Flour and fry in butter until brown.  Add 1/2 cup of marinade liquid and bring to boil. Cover and simmer until rabbit is tender.  Remove the meat; add flour to liquid.  After liquid is thickened to a gravy, stir in sour cream and pour over rabbit.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH TAPIOCA CREAM
ingredients:
2  eggs, separated
1/4  c. brown sugar plus 2/3 c. brown sugar
1/4  c. butter
4  c. milk
1/3  c. quick tapioca
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat egg whites until foamy.  Add 1/4 cup packed brown sugar, 2 tablespoons at a time until soft peaks form.  Set aside.  Melt butter; add 2/3 cup brown sugar and cook until dissolved.  In another pan, mix yolks, milk, tapioca and salt.  Cook until mix comes to a full boil.  Add butterscotch mixture and mix well. Pour a little in meringue, blending well.  Quickly stir in remaining mixture.  Add vanilla and let stand for 15 to 20 minutes.  Stir.  Serve warm or cold.

name: SMOKED SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. smoked sausage, cut into 4-inch lengths
1  tsp. butter or margarine
1  medium onion, cut into wedges
2 (16 oz.)  cans sauerkraut
1  c. apple juice
2  medium apples, cut into wedges
4  medium potatoes, cut in half
dash of salt and pepper
preparation: Brown sausage in butter in a 1 1/2-quart Dutch oven or large casserole; arrange onion, sauerkraut, apples and potatoes around sausage.  Top with apple juice and pepper to taste.  Cover tightly and simmer over low heat for 30 to 40 minutes or until potatoes are done.  Stir once during cooking.

name: SHRIMP GUMBO
ingredients:
1  medium onion
1  medium bell pepper
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. basil
1  tsp. black pepper
3  cans chicken broth
3  cans water
1  bag okra (frozen), cut
1  tsp. gumbo file
1  stalk celery, cut
1  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
2  tsp. salt
1  only bay leaf (optional)
1  c. tomatoes
1  lb. hot smoked sausage
3  c. shrimp
preparation: Saute onion, celery, bell pepper, sausage, thyme, oregano, cayenne pepper and basil.  Add chicken broth and water.  Cook. Add tomatoes, okra, salt and black pepper.  Cook.  Add shrimp. Cook, adding file.

name: SOUR CREAM LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3 1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. lemon rind, grated
1/2  fresh lemon juice
3  egg yolks, slightly beaten
1/4  c. butter
1  c. sour cream
1  baked 9-inch pie shell
1  c. heavy whipping cream, whipped
1  c. milk
preparation: Combine sugar, cornstarch, lemon rind, juice, egg yolks and milk in heavy saucepan.  Cook over medium heat until thick.  Stir in butter and cook mixture to room temperature.  Stir in sour cream and pour filling into pie shell.  Cover with whipped cream and garnish with lemon twists.  Store in refrigerator.

name: EASY MEXICAN SOUP
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1 (10 oz.)  can tomatoes with green chiles
1 (15 oz.)  can whole kernel white corn
1 (10 oz.)  can tomato soup
1 (10 oz.)  can vegetable beef soup
1 (15 oz.)  can chili with beans
shredded Cheddar cheese, sour cream and corn chips
preparation: Combine tomatoes, tomatoes with green chiles, corn, tomato soup, vegetable soup and chili  in large pot and mix well. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring frequently. Layer cheese, sour cream and chips in individual bowls. Ladle hot soup over top. Makes 12 servings.

name: PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
1/2  c. salt
2 1/2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. powdered alum
2  c. water
3  Tbsp. oil
preparation: In a saucepan, heat water to boiling.  Stir in all at once the oil, salt, alum and flour.  Stir until it forms a ball.   Cool a bit and knead until it's smooth.  Add food coloring and/or flavoring, if desired.  Keeps for weeks when stored in a tightly covered container.

name: ITALIAN CHICKEN CUTLETS
ingredients:
6  chicken breast halves, skinned and deboned
1  c. Italian seasoned bread crumbs
1/2  c. grated Romano or Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1 (0.8 oz.)  envelope light Italian salad dressing mix
2  tsp. dried whole oregano
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
2  eggs, beaten
1/3  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Place each piece of chicken between 2 sheets of wax paper. Flatten to 1/4-inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin. Combine bread crumbs and next 5 ingredients.  Dip chicken in eggs and dredge in bread crumb mixture.  Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Add chicken and cook 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until golden brown, adding extra oil if necessary. Drain on paper towels.  Yields 6 servings.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
1 1/4  lb. diced onions
1  c. flour
1  qt. half and half
4  lb. diced potatoes, peeled and cooked, do not overcook
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. Tabasco
1/2  gal. chicken stock
preparation: Melt butter.  Prepare chicken stock.  Saute onions in butter until translucent.  Add flour; mix thoroughly.  Cook over low heat for 5 minutes.  Slowly add hot chicken stock, stirring until smooth.  Add half and half and remaining spices.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Add potatoes; stir.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Garnish with Cheddar cheese, bacon bits and chives.

name: ARTICHOKE APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1 (13 oz)  can artichoke hearts
1 (4 oz)  can chopped green chilies
1  c. parmesan cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. dijon mustard
6  English muffins
preparation: Chop artichoke hearts and green chilies. In a mixing bowl, combine artichokes, chilies, cheese, mayo and mustard. When ready to serve preheat oven to 350°. Split English muffins and spread mixture on each half. Bake for 30 minutes until browned. Cut each half into quarters to serve as bite-sized pieces. May be baked in a shallow round baking dish as a hot dip served with crisp bread or tortilla chips.

name: ENGLISH DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening (half butter and Crisco)
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. coffee
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. each nutmeg, cloves and allspice
2  c. raisins
1  c. nuts
preparation: Set oven to 325°.  Cream sugar and shortening.  Add beaten eggs, cold coffee and vanilla.  Sift dry ingredients together and add.  Mix in raisins and nuts.  Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet 3 inches apart.

name: BOURBON PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped pecans
3  Tbsp. bourbon
3  eggs, well beaten
3/4  c. light Karo
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. melted butter
1  c. sugar
1 small  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Soak pecans in bourbon overnight.  Combine eggs, sugar, Karo, salt,  chocolate chips, vanilla and pecans.  Pour  into 9-inch deep pie shell.  Bake at 375° for 55 to 60 minutes.

name: HOT MILK CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. whole milk
4  Tbsp. margarine
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Heat milk and margarine.  While milk and margarine are heating, add vanilla and dry ingredients; mix well.  Then add hot milk.  Mix slowly.  Bake in greased and floured pan or use Pam. Cool in pan 15 to 20 minutes before removing from pan. `Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes for layers.  For tube pan, bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Cake can be cut in half for a smaller cake.  Reduce each item exactly in half.

name: FASHION SHOW PUNCH
ingredients:
1  pkg. Kool-Aid (cherry)
1  can ginger ale
1  can pineapple juice
1/2  gal. sherbet (lemon, lime or orange)
preparation: Mix all ingredients except sherbet; cool with ice cubes.  Put sherbet in punch while serving several scoops at a time.

name: VEGETABLE SANDWICHES
ingredients:
2  cucumbers
2  carrots
1  small onion
1/2  bell pepper
1  c. celery
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. salt
1  c. mayonnaise
1  envelope plain Knox gelatine
1/4  c. cold water
preparation: Grate and  squeeze  cucumbers, carrots and onion.  Chop bell pepper and	celery.  Add  lemon  juice and salt.  Mix all together.  Add mayonnaise.	Mix Knox gelatine with cold water. Dissolve over  hot	water.	Add  to vegetables and mayonnaise. Let set in  refrigerator at least 12 hours.  Great on Ritz and cubes of bread (open face sandwiches).

name: CHICKEN AND SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. raw spaghetti (10 to 12 oz.)
1 1/2  c. cooked chicken (save broth)
1/4  c. diced pimento
1/2  c. diced onion
1/2  c. chicken broth
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1 3/4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
preparation: Cook the spaghetti in the broth that is left over from cooking the chicken (reserve 1/2 cup broth for casserole).  Drain spaghetti.  Mix all ingredients and put in a casserole dish; sprinkle the cheese on top.  Heat oven to 350° and bake casserole for 45 minutes.

name: EASY STICKY BUNS
ingredients:
1  pkg. Riches frozen rolls
2 small  pkg. nuts (pecans and walnuts)
1  stick melted margarine
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Royal butterscotch pudding (not instant)
preparation: Grease a Bundt or tube pan.  Put nuts in bottom of pan.  Place rolls over nuts.  Mix all dry ingredients and pour over rolls. Pour melted margarine over rolls.  Cover with tea towel and let rise overnight.  Do not refrigerate.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Turn immediately onto serving plate.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. catsup
1 small  can shrimp
6  Tbsp. horseradish
preparation: Mix all together in mixer until blended.  The amount of horseradish can be adjusted according to taste.  Serve with crackers or bagel chips.

name: MEXICAN CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  lb. Cheddar cheese
1 (16 oz.)  jar picante sauce
preparation: Brown ground beef in skillet and drain.  Cube both cheeses and melt in crock-pot.  Add hamburger and picante sauce.  Mix thoroughly, then serve with tortilla chips.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter/margarine, softened
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Mix butter, shortening, 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs.  Blend in flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt.  Shape dough by rounded teaspoonfuls into balls.  Mix 2 tablespoons sugar and the cinnamon; roll ball into mixture.  Place 2 inches apart on greased baking sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until set. Immediately remove from baking sheet.  Makes about 6 dozen.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  c. white Karo syrup
1/4  c. melted butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. pecans
2  pie shells
preparation: Beat well.  Add ingredients in given order into uncooked pie shells, dividing evenly.  Add 1 cup pecans.  Pour mixture over pecans and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes, until crust is brown.

name: CHICKEN CACCIATORA
ingredients:
1  cut up fryer
3  Tbsp. oil
3  or 4 medium garlic
1 1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
1 large  can stewed tomatoes
oregano
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown chicken in oil.  Sprinkle with salt, pepper and oregano. Remove from pan and sear garlic, then mushrooms.  After this is done, put chicken back in pan (Dutch oven preferably).  Pour tomatoes over.   Stir thoroughly.  Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Uncover and cook, until chicken is done.

name: AUNT MILLWEE'S PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. plus 1 Tbsp. water
1/2  c. white Karo syrup
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
2  c. peanuts
preparation: Cook until honey color. Do not stir.  Pour into long pan.  Let cool. Break into pieces.

name: FRUIT SHAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. plain nonfat yogurt
3/4  c. buttermilk
1  whole banana, peeled, cut into about 8 pieces and freeze the night before
2 packets sweetener or 4  tsp. sugar
cinnamon or nutmeg to taste
preparation: Put all ingredients in blender and mix until fully blended. This refreshing breakfast shake can be made with bananas, strawberries, peaches, cantaloupe or just about any fruit that you enjoy.  Be sure to freeze fruit the night before.

name: PERKY CHEESE CAULIFLOWER
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
1/2  c. sharp Cheddar, grated
3 to 4  drops Tabasco
1 small  jar pimentos, chopped
preparation: Cook cauliflower until tender.  Saute green pepper in butter until tender.  Add flour and milk to make cream sauce.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix and pour over cauliflower head.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. Wesson oil
1  c. chopped pecans
3  eggs, beaten well
3  c. chopped apples
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put together in a large bowl the flour, sugar, soda, salt and cinnamon.  Make a hole or well in the center.   Add Wesson oil, pecans, eggs, apples and vanilla.  Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes.

name: A MIX TO PUT OVER CREAM CHEESE
ingredients:
9  oz. jar apple jelly
9  oz. jar pineapple preserves
2 1/2  oz. horseradish
1 heaping  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix together and store in jars.  Keeps for weeks in refrigerator.  When serving, spoon over cream cheese.

name: MARINATED TOMATOES
ingredients:
3  large tomatoes, sliced
1/3  c. olive oil
1/4  c. red wine vinegar
1/4  c. chopped onions
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
1 large  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dried basil
1/4  tsp. pepper
green peppers and cucumbers, sliced (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Refrigerate for 3 hours.

name: EASY FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  bag frozen fruit
1  c. self-rising flour or plain flour with 1 tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
preparation: Melt butter in 2-quart glass baking dish in microwave.  Stir together flour and 1 cup sugar.  Add milk and mix well.  Pour mixture into baking dish.  Stir gently to mix with the butter. Add fruit that has been tossed with remaining sugar.  Don't stir. Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.   Serve warm with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.  Serves 6.

name: PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  (1 lb. 4 oz.) crushed pineapple, well drained
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder and salt.  Beat eggs until fluffy. Gradually beat in sugar until mixture is thick and ivory colored. Fold in pineapple and nuts.  Gradually fold in flour mixture.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: POTATO PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. sweet potatoes, boiled and mashed
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. coconut
1/2  c. raisins (if desired)
1/8  lb. butter
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine ingredients in casserole.

name: SPOON BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1 1/4  c. water
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  tsp. baking powder
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed Cheddar cheese, cream of chicken or mushroom soup
3  eggs, separated
preparation: In saucepan, combine  corn  meal  and water, bring to a boil and cook  until  very thick, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat and  stir  in	butter.  Add  soup, baking powder and slightly beaten  egg  yolks.  Mix  well.  Fold  mixture  into stiffly beaten egg whites, pour into greased 2 quart casserole dish.  Bake at 350°  for  1  hour,  serve  hot with butter and maple syrup if desired.  Makes 6 servings.

name: BROCCOLI BREAD
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
12  oz. cottage cheese
1  stick butter, melted
1  large onion, chopped
10  oz. pkg. frozen broccoli
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  pkg. Mexican corn meal
preparation: Mix all the ingredients.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
1  large Cool Whip
1  c. (8 oz.) cottage cheese
1 small  pkg. orange jello
1 large  can mandarin oranges
1 small  can pineapple, crushed
1  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix Cool Whip with orange jello then add other ingredients.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. butter
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. cocoa
2 1/2  c. cake flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. soda
2  oz. red food coloring
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together butter and sugar, add eggs and beat until fluffy.  Make a paste of lemon juice and cocoa, add to flour.  Add flour mixture alternately with milk.  Add vanilla and coloring. Mix well.  Bake at 350°.

name: SLUSH DRINK
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
2  c. tea (made with 4 tea bags)
3/4  c. sugar
7  c. water
4  c. whiskey
preparation: Mix together and put into freezer.  When frozen, add 1 ice cream scoop of slush to glass and fill with Sprite, 7-Up or ginger ale.

name: CHINESE-STYLE PORK
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. oil
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  c. roast pork, cut into thin, small strips
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1/2  c. thinly sliced celery
1/2  c. sliced, raw mushrooms
1  can bean sprouts, drained
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
black pepper to taste
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. water
Chinese noodles
preparation: In a skillet, heat the oil.  Add the onion and cook until transparent.  Add the pork, chicken broth, celery, mushrooms and bean sprouts; simmer five minutes.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
20  Ritz crackers, crushed (but not fine)
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. pecans, chopped
1  tsp. vanilla
3  egg whites
preparation: Mix crackers with 1/2 cup sugar and pecans.   Beat egg whites until stiff.  Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla; mix with cracker mixture.  Put into a 9-inch greased pie pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with whipped cream and shaved chocolate or chocolate bits.

name: CRISP WAFFLES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. Bisquick
1 1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. oil
2  egg whites
1  pkg. dry yeast
warm water (to make 4 c. batter)
preparation: Mix all together until smooth. Let set 5 minutes before cooking.  Good for freezing.  Just pop in toaster.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. shortening or butter
1/2  c. peanut butter (crunchy or creamy)
1  egg
1  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Mix shortening and peanut butter in with flour.  Add sugar, egg and vanilla. Add tablespoon of milk.  Mix all together until blended.  Make in to 1-inch balls.  Place on cookie sheet. Flatten with a fork.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or until brown.

name: SWEDISH TEA RING(1/2 Recipe)
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1/4  c. lukewarm water
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1/2  c. shortening or butter or margarine, melted
2 1/4  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Stir in milk, sugar, salt, eggs, shortening and 1 1/4 cups flour.  Beat until smooth, then add 1 cup flour to make dough.  Cover, raise 1 1/2 hours, then punch down dough.  Roll dough into a rectangle.   Spread 2 tablespoons butter or margarine, sprinkle with 1/2 cup brown sugar and 2 tablespoons cinnamon.  Roll up beginning at wide side. Pinch edge of dough to seal well.  With sealed edge down, shape into ring on lightly greased baking sheet.  Pinch ends together. With scissors make cuts 2/3 of the way through ring 1-inch apart. Turn each section on its side.  Let rise until double for 30 minutes.   Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 375°.

name: MEX RICE
ingredients:
1  c. rice
1/2  onion
2  c. water
1/8  tsp. cumin
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. tomato sauce
few green peppers
2  Tbsp. canola oil
preparation: Brown onion and rice in canola oil until light brown.  Add water, cumin and garlic powder.  Cook rice mix for about 10 minutes.  Add tomato sauce and green peppers and cook about 5 minutes.  Check rice to see if it is done.  Turn off.  Rice will soak up water.  Cover; let stand.

name: GRANNY'S MEATBALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  medium onions
1  egg
cooking oil
flour
salt
pepper
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
milk
preparation: Mix ground beef, onion and egg.  Shape into patties and fry in a little oil until brown.  Drain on paper towel.

name: ITALIAN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  chopped onion
2  Tbsp. oil
2  Tbsp. sugar
salt and pepper to taste
2  c. cooked tomatoes
2  c. uncooked spaghetti, broken into pieces
shredded cheese
preparation: Cook onion, oil and sugar in a large pan until light brown. Add ground beef; crumble up and brown, stirring frequently.  Drain off grease.  Add tomatoes, cooked spaghetti and salt and pepper to taste.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat, cover with lid and simmer 20 minutes.  Stir often.  Pour out in dish and put cheese on top, if desired.

name: SUPER BOWL COOKIE BARS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. Hershey's cocoa
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. margarine or butter, melted
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
2  c. Hershey's semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  c. Hershey's butterscotch chips or Reese's peanut butter chips
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can flaked coconut (1 1/3 c.)
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass dish).  Combine crumbs, cocoa, sugar and margarine.  Press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan; pour Eagle Brand milk evenly over crust.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
3  eggs
2  c. milk
1  c. sugar
3  c. day old bread, crumbled
2  apples, cut into cubes
1  c. raisins
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Butter a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Melt remaining margarine and add to beaten eggs, milk, bread, sugar and other ingredients.  Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

name: GRILLED CORNISH HENS(Serving Size: 2)
ingredients:
2  Cornish game hens, split and well-washed
Kikkoman lite teriyaki sauce
preparation: Brush meat side of each hen liberally with the teriyaki sauce 30 minutes before grilling.  Grill on low to medium coals, turning every 5 to 10 minutes and basting each time.  Cook 45 minutes to 1 hour, until meat is tender and juices run clear.

name: IMPOSSIBLE BROCCOLI AND CHICKEN
ingredients:
10  oz. frozen, chopped broccoli
3  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. cooked chicken
2/3  c. chopped onion
1 1/3  c. milk
3  eggs
3/4  c. Bisquick mix
salt and pepper
preparation: Run broccoli under cold water to thaw and drain thoroughly. Mix broccoli and 2 cups of cheese, chicken and onion.  Beat milk, eggs and Bisquick mix until smooth.  Add to chicken and broccoli mixture.  Salt and pepper to taste.   Pour into a greased 10-inch pie pan.  Bake 30 minutes at 400°.  Remove from oven and top with remaining cheese and bake until cheese melts.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2  c. white beans, soaked overnight
1/2  lb. bacon, well done
salt and pepper to taste
white sugar to desired sweetness
preparation: Add crumbled bacon to beans along with other ingredients. Bake at 375° until desired thickness.

name: AMMONIA COOKIES(German Christmas Cookies)
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
3  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. lard or shortening
3  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. peppermint extract
10  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
3  tsp. powdered ammonia (you get this from a pharmacy)
preparation: Mix the first 6 ingredients together until well blended. Combine flour, baking powder, soda and powdered ammonia; mix in the egg mixture.  Chill at least 2 hours or overnight.  Roll out and cut with cookie cutter.  Place on cookie sheets and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes until light brown.  Makes 7 to 8 dozen.

name: CHOCOLATE MINT DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. (16 oz. can) Hershey's syrup
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  In large bowl, beat flour, sugar, butter, eggs and syrup until smooth. Pour into prepared pan.  Bake 30 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched.  Cool completely.

name: ATRE JOHNSON'S STEAK
ingredients:
2  lb. top round steak (3/4-inch thick)
1  c. tomato juice or small can sauce
1  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. chopped parsley
1/4  c. butter
1  pkg. wild rice
salt and pepper to taste
flour to coat steak
preparation: Flatten steak thin; add flour, salt and pepper.   Cook rice according to package directions.    Saute onions and parsley in butter; add tomato juice.   Add sauce to rice.  Spoon rice mixture on meat; roll and tie.    Brown roll on top of stove in casserole dish.  Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: BEAN STEW
ingredients:
1  can black beans
1  can pinto beans
1  can chickpeas
1  can red kidney beans
1  onion, chopped fine
1  can tomato sauce
1  can chopped tomatoes
1  green pepper
1  tsp. garlic
1  tsp. ginger
2  tsp. cumin powder
salt to taste
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Fry onions and pepper.  Add spices, tomato sauce and chopped tomatoes.  Add beans.  Cook for 20 minutes.  Serve over brown rice.

name: GINGERSNAPS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. molasses
1  c. margarine
1  egg
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. ginger
2  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
flour to make stiff dough
preparation: Combine first 7 ingredients.  Mix well.  Add vinegar, vanilla and enough flour to make a stiff dough.  Roll very thin.  Cut with cookie cutter.  Bake at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Makes about 48.

name: AUNT PEE WEE'S SWEET POTATO PONES
ingredients:
sweet potatoes, enough raw potatoes to make 1 gal. and 1 qt.
4 1/2  c. sugar
2  c. brown sugar
3/4 to 1  lb. (3 to 4 sticks) butter
3  Tbsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. allspice
2  tsp. cloves
3 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1/2  can (6 oz.) Pet milk
preparation: Cut up enough sweet potatoes to measure 1 gallon and 1 quart. Shake potatoes down a little when measuring.  Cook potatoes until tender.  Drain.  Add butter to cooked potatoes while hot so butter will melt.  Beat well with mixer.  Combine sugars, spices and flour in another bowl.  Let potatoes cool, then gradually add flour mixture to potatoes, alternating with Pet milk.  Mix well. Pour into 4 to 5 greased iron skillets.  Melt some margarine and pour on top; then sprinkle with sugar.  Bake about 45 minutes at 350° to 400°.

name: EASY STEW(Low-fat Recipe)
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef or turkey
4  medium potatoes, peeled and sliced
1  green pepper, diced
1  small onion
1/2  tsp. Mrs. Dash
1/4  tsp. black pepper
3/4  c. water
preparation: Brown ground beef in a skillet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Add potatoes, pepper, onion and seasoning.  Add water and let simmer, covered, until potatoes are tender.  Makes 4 servings.

name: SALT DOUGH
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1  c. salt
1  c. water
preparation: Mix with your hands, adding more flour if dough is sticky and more water if crumbly.  Wet the surface to add bits of decorative dough to cut-outs.  After shaping, bake at 200° until thoroughly dry (about 1 hour).  You may glaze with egg yolk/water for brown color.  Varnish cooled ornament.

name: SHRIMP DIP FOR CRACKERS
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1 small  can tiny shrimp
1/4  c. minced onion
1/2  tsp. horseradish
splash of Worcestershire sauce
cocktail sauce
preparation: Soften cream cheese.  Rinse and drain shrimp.  Break up with a fork.  Mix with onion, horseradish and Worcestershire sauce.  Make into a ball.  Chill.

name: HEARTY LENTIL SOUP
ingredients:
16  oz. pkg lentils
2  large onions, chopped
2  cups celery, chopped
3 large  cloves garlic, minced
1  handful chopped fresh parsley
1  large bay leaf
1  cup carrots, chopped
1 32  oz. can Italian plum tomatoes (whole, in tomato puree)
1/4  cup olive oil
2  tsp dried oregano
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Wash lentils and let soak overnight; drain. Sauté onions, celery and garlic in olive oil. Put soaked lentils in large pot and fill with 2 quarts water. Add sautéed vegetables, carrots, tomatoes (chopped very coarsely) along with all the puree, oregano, salt, pepper, parsley and bay leaf.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  egg, beaten
1 big  can fruit cocktail, drained
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Sift dry ingredients; beat egg until light.  Add fruit cocktail.  Mix and pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Before baking, mix nuts and brown sugar and sprinkle over top of cake mixture. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.  Cool.  Cut into squares.

name: SOUTH-OF-THE-BORDER LAYERED DIP
ingredients:
2  medium size avocados
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  can refried beans
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1/2  c. chopped green onion
2  medium tomatoes, chopped
1 large  can black olives, pitted and sliced
3  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Layer on large platter.

name: CRABMEAT PIECES
ingredients:
1  stick soft butter
1 (5 oz.)  jar Old English cheese spread
1 1/2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. seasoning salt
1  can crabmeat
English muffins
preparation: Blend first 6 ingredients.  Spread on muffin halves.  Cut each half in 8 pie shaped pieces.  Place under broiler until edges are brown and cheese bubbles, approximately 2 to 3 minutes.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1 large and 1 small  can Great Northern beans
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white Karo
1  tsp. mustard
ketchup to taste
bacon
preparation: Mix all together and bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered.

name: RICE ELENA
ingredients:
3 to 4  c. cooked rice
2  c. sour cream
2 (4 oz.)  cans chopped green chilies
1  lb. Monterey Jack cheese, grated
salt to taste
1/4  c. grated Cheddar
preparation: Butter a 2-quart casserole dish.  Mix all except Cheddar. Pour into casserole.  Sprinkle Cheddar on top.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.  Serves 12.

name: CHERRY CHEESE BARS
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter, softened
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. plus 2 to 4 Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. cherry preserves
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Cream butter and sugar with electric mixer in large mixing bowl until light and fluffy.  Add one egg; beat well.  Stir in 1 1/2 cups flour and salt until well blended.  Reserve 1 cup of mixture by spooning lightly into measuring cup; set aside.  Press remaining crust mixture into prepared pan.  Bake 15 minutes. Blend remaining 2 to 4 tablespoons flour into reserved crust mixture until crumbly; set aside.

name: FESTIVE SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  can pineapple chunks
1  medium green pepper, cut in 1 inch squares
1  medium onion, cut in 1 inch squares
2  T. vegetable oil
1  lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cubed
2  jars (10 oz. each) sweet and sour sauce
preparation: Drain pineapple; reserve 2 T. juice.  Cook chicken in hot oil until no longer pink inside.  Add peppers, onions, and pineapple chunks to pan.  Stir in sweet and sour sauce, and reserved juice and cook until vegetables are crisp-tender.  Serve over rice.

name: BARBECUED CHICKEN IN A BAG
ingredients:
3  lb. cut up chicken
3  Tbsp. catsup
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
4  Tbsp. water
2  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry or prepared mustard
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
preparation: Heat ingredients to blend.  Grease the inside of a large brown bag and place in a roasting pan.  Set oven at 500°.  Salt and pepper chicken.  Dip each piece in sauce and place in bag.  Pour remaining sauce over all the chicken.  Fold sack opening in double and fasten with 6 or 7 paper clips.  Cover roaster.  Place in oven and cook for 15 minutes.  Reduce temperature to 350° and cook 1 hour and 15 minutes.   Do not open bag until cooking time is reached.  Good eating.  Enjoy.

name: ONION ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton onion soup mix
2  lb. potatoes (new ones are best)
1/3  c. olive or vegetable oil
preparation: Cut potatoes in bite-size chunks.  Preheat oven to 450°.  In a large plastic bag add all ingredients.  Close bag tightly.  Shake until potatoes are evenly coated.  Empty into shallow baking dish. Bake, stir occasionally for about 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown.  Yields 8 servings.

name: GRADYS CHEESE TOAST
ingredients:
whole wheat hoagie buns
Monterey Jack cheese
sharp Cheddar cheese
Parmesan cheese
butter
preparation: Shred and mix cheeses.  Slice bun lengthwise and butter. Sprinkle on cheese.  Broil until melted.

name: RUM BALLS
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. vanilla wafers, crushed
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts, crushed
1/4  c. melted butter
1/4  c. rum
powdered sugar (to roll balls in)
preparation: Mix together the vanilla wafers, granulated sugar and chopped nuts.  Add melted butter and rum.  Roll into balls and then roll in powdered sugar.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. water
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  qt. strawberries
1  box strawberry jello
preparation: Mix together sugar and cornstarch and add to water.  Cook until clear.  Add jello and cool.  Add strawberries.  Put filling in a baked pie crust.  Chill.  May be topped with whipped cream.

name: CINNAMON ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1  loaf bread, decrusted
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  stick margarine, melted
1  c. sugar, mixed with 1 Tbsp. cinnamon
preparation: Use rolling pin and flatten each slice of decrusted bread. Spread each slice with cream cheese.  Roll up and take each roll and roll in melted margarine.  Then roll in cinnamon-sugar mixture. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  These can be made ahead and frozen.

name: LEMON/DILL MARINATED FLANK STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. flank steak
1/4  c. sliced green onion
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. dill
2  cloves garlic
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. red wine
1  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Score meat by making shallow cuts at 1-inch intervals diagonally across steak in diamond pattern.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Marinate steak 6 to 24 hours. Grill over medium coals 12 to 14 minutes or broil.  Turn and brush with marinate often to prevent drying. Slice thinly across grain to serve.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
3 (14.5 oz.)  cans chicken broth
1  chicken bouillon cube
1/2  c. long grain rice
8  raw chicken tenders
1 (10 oz.)  can Ro-Tel diced tomatoes (with cilantro, chiles and lime juice)
preparation: In a 3-quart heavy pot, bring two cans of broth to a boil. Add chicken tenders; reduce heat, cover and simmer 8 to 10 minutes. Remove chicken; cut into bite-size pieces and return to pot. Add bouillon cube and tomatoes. Bring to a rolling boil; add rice and cook for 15 minutes. Add final can of chicken broth and heat through. Stir well and serve. Top each bowl of soup with shredded cheese and tortilla chips.

name: BANANA NUT LOAF
ingredients:
1/2  cup butter or margarine
1  cup sugar
1  cup mashed bananas (2 or 3 bananas)
2  cups sifted flour
1  teaspoon soda
1/2  teaspoon salt
1/2  cup nuts
preparation: Cream butter until soft.  Add sugar.  Cream until fluffy. Add eggs and bananas.  Mix well.  Sift flour with soda and salt. Stir in nuts.  Bake in loaf pan one hour at 350°.

name: RANGER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. flour
1  c. oatmeal
1  c. coconut
2  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Mix shortening, brown sugar and white sugar.  Beat eggs; mix into sugar.  Mix dry ingredients with sugar, shortening and eggs, then add oatmeal, Rice Krispies and coconut.  Bake at 325° to 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: FORTY-NINERS
ingredients:
1  box light brown sugar
2  c. biscuit mix
4  eggs, well beaten
2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine all ingredients and blend well.  Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes. Remove from oven and cool thoroughly before cutting into squares or bars.  Dust with powdered sugar, if desired.  (Chewy if eaten while warm.)

name: CRAB CAKES
ingredients:
1  lb. white crabmeat, picked and flaked
1  egg, beaten
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. Tabasco
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
juice of 1/2 lemon
preparation: Combine all ingredients; form into 8 patties 2 inches in diameter.  Better if chilled a few hours.  Fry in deep fat (low cholesterol shortening) until golden brown.

name: ITALIAN HERB POTATOES
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. Russet potatoes
1  tsp. olive oil
1/2  tsp. each: basil and crushed oregano
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cut potatoes in 1 1/2-inch pieces.  Place in microwave-safe dish.  Drizzle with olive oil and mix well.  Sprinkle with seasoning.  Cover with waxed paper and microwave on High 7 to 9 minutes or until tender.  Mix halfway through cooking time. Sprinkle with cheese and microwave on High 1 minute longer.  Makes 4 servings.

name: LEMON ICEBOX PIE
ingredients:
1  crumb or pastry pie shell, cooked and cooled
1/2  c. lemon juice (fresh 3 to 4 lemons)
1  can sweetened condensed milk
2  eggs, separated
4  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Combine lemon juice and milk.  Add egg yolks; beat well until blended.  Pour into chilled crust.  Add sugar to egg whites.  Beat with mixer until stiff.  Pile lightly onto pie filling.  Bake at 325° until meringue is slightly browned.

name: PECAN CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
6  eggs
1  lb. butter
2  c. chopped pecans
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  lb. candied cherries
1/2  lb. candied pineapple
1 1/2  oz. bottle lemon extract
preparation: Mix flour and baking powder with the candied fruits.  Cream the butter and sugars together.  Separate the eggs.  Add the egg yolks and the flour mixture alternately with the lemon extract and pecans.  Fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites.  Pour into a greased and floured tube pan.  Let stand overnight.  Next day, bake at 250° for 3 hours.

name: FANCY FONDUE
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can jellied cranberry sauce
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
1/4  c. water
1 to 2  lb. franks
preparation: Beat cranberry sauce in saucepan.  Add cornstarch, cinnamon and ground cloves; blend well.  Add water.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture boils and thickens.  Add franks (cut into bite size pieces); cook until franks are done.

name: SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1  onion
1 small  can tomato paste
1 (14 oz.)  jar Ragu tomato sauce with mushrooms
1  can consomme
1/2  can water
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1 small (7 oz.)  pkg. thin spaghetti
preparation: Brown beef with chopped onion.  Add tomato paste and chili powder and stir in well.  Add tomato sauce, consomme and water. Simmer all of this for 15 minutes.  Add cooked and drained spaghetti.  Put in casserole.  When ready to serve, heat in 350° oven until bubbly hot.  Serve with Parmesan cheese on top. Freezes well.

name: PINA COLADA FRUIT DIP(Makes 2 1/2 Cups)
ingredients:
8  oz. can crushed pineapple in own juice, undrained
3 1/2  oz. pkg. instant coconut pudding and pie filling mix
3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: In bowl, combine all ingredients.  Mix with mixer for 1 minute until blended.  Refrigerate several hours or overnight to blend flavors.

name: SPINACH SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh spinach
4  to 6 hard-boiled eggs
1/2  lb. bacon
preparation: Clean and tear up spinach.  Brown and crumble bacon.  Chop eggs.

name: CHOP SUEY("A Favorite From The '76 Cookbook.")
ingredients:
1  lb. meat (pork or beef), diced
3  Tbsp. cooking oil
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
3  c. celery, sliced
2  c. onions, sliced
1 1/2  c. soup stock, gravy or bouillon
1  can bean sprouts, drained
1  Tbsp. molasses
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2/3  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1 small  can peas (optional)
preparation: Brown meat in oil.  Add 1 tablespoon of soy sauce.   Cook 20 minutes.  Add celery, onions and soup stock.  Cook until nearly done.  Add bean sprouts.  Cook 3 minutes.   Mix together molasses, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, cornstarch, salt and water.  Add to vegetable mixture.  Cook 5 minutes.    Add small can of peas. Serve piping hot over rice.

name: SOUR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. dairy sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together shortening, sugar and eggs.  Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with sour cream.  Add vanilla.  Mix well.  Refrigerate for several hours.  Roll dough 1/2 to 1/4-inch thick on floured cloth.  Cut with large biscuit cutter.  Place on greased cookie sheet and sprinkle with granulated sugar.  Bake in a 410° oven for 8 to 10 minutes.  Place cookie sheet on top rack of oven for 8 to 10 minutes.  Bake smaller cookies 7 to 8 minutes.  Place cookie sheet on top rack of oven to prevent the cookies from becoming too brown.  They are best rather pale and soft.  Check frequently to prevent overcooking.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
4  oz. Baker's German's brand sweet chocolate
1/2  c. boiling water
2  c. sugar
1  c. margarine
4  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
2 1/4  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
4  egg whites, stiffly beaten
preparation: Melt chocolate in boiling water.  Cool.  Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.  Add yolks one at a time, beating well after each.  Blend in vanilla flavoring and chocolate.  Sift flour with soda and salt; add alternately with buttermilk to chocolate mixture, beating after each addition until smooth.  Fold in beaten egg whites.  Pour into 3 (9-inch) layer pans lined with wax paper. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Cool.  Frost tops only.

name: BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. baking powder
6  c. flour
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  can cream
1/2  c. water
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Make 9-inch pie crust.

name: FRIED APPLE RINGS
ingredients:
2  small apples
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice (if desired)
preparation: Core apples and cut each in 4 circles.  Melt fat in a frypan. Add sugar and lemon juice (if used).  Add apple slices and cook slowly about 10 to 15 minutes until tender.   Turn as needed to brown.  Makes 4 servings.  Another light and healthy dessert.

name: PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2 2/3  c. slightly crushed pretzels
3  Tbsp. sugar
3/4  c. melted oleo
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
8  oz. Cool Whip
1  c. sugar
6  oz. pkg. strawberry jello
2  c. boiling water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen sliced strawberries
preparation: Combine pretzels, sugar and oleo.  Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 10 minutes at 350°.  Cool.  Beat together cream cheese and sugar.  Fold in Cool Whip and spread evenly over cooled crust. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Add frozen strawberries and stir until thawed and gelatin is slightly thickened.  Pour over cheese layer and refrigerate until set.  Makes 10 to 12 servings.

name: SOUR CREAM ICEBOX COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. flour, sifted
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix and sift flour, baking powder, soda and salt.  Cream shortening and sugar.  Stir in flour mixture alternately with sour cream.  Add vanilla.  Make into 2 rolls and wrap in oiled paper. Place in refrigerator to chill.  Cut in 1/8-inch slices and bake on ungreased pan at 400°.

name: VEGETABLE GRATIN
ingredients:
3  garlic cloves, minced
1/3  c. extra virgin olive oil
2  large baking potatoes, sliced thinly
3  medium zucchini, sliced 1/8 inch thick
9  Italian plum tomatoes, sliced 1/4 inch thick
6 to 8  oz. Gruyere cheese
1  tsp. each dill weed and parsley flakes
1  Tbsp. basil
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Heat garlic gently in olive oil for about 5 minutes.  In shallow 9 x 12-inch baking dish, arrange vegetables in alternating layers as follows: Layer half potatoes, zucchini, tomatoes and cheese and sprinkle with herbs and salt and pepper.  Repeat.  Sprinkle with garlic and oil mixture and bake 45 minutes, uncovered.  Serve hot or at room temperature.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1-1/2  tsp. baking soda
3  c. plain flour
1  c. vegetable oil
3  c. diced, peeled apples
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. raisins
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Sift sugar, soda, flour, spices and salt together in a bowl. Add eggs, oil and vanilla, mixing well. Add apples and nuts. Pour into greased tube pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Remove cake from oven, place in heavy brown bag immediately, close tightly and let stand until cool. This is delicious.

name: GINGERBREAD COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  c. molasses
1  egg, beaten
4 1/2  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  Tbsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Beat in molasses and egg. Sift together dry ingredients. Stir in molasses mixture and blend. Roll out  1/8-inch thick and cut desired shapes. Bake cookies at 350° for 8 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE REFRIGERATOR CAKE
ingredients:
1  box chocolate cake mix
1  box chocolate pudding
1 (8 oz.)  carton plain yogurt
1  c. milk
almond slices
Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake mix in 3 layers according to directions on box.  Mix chocolate pudding, yogurt and 1/3 cup of the milk.  Stir and add remaining 2/3 cup milk and beat two minutes.  Spread between layers and  top with Cool Whip and almond slices.

name: VEG-ALL CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  cans Veg-All vegetables, drained
1  c. celery, finely chopped
1  c. onions, finely chopped
1  c. medium sharp cheese, grated
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can water chestnuts, drained
preparation: Mix together and place in a buttered baking dish. Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

name: FRUITED CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. cooked chicken, diced
1  c. celery, diced
1/3  c. pecans, chopped
2  Tbsp. green onions, chopped
1/2  c. seedless green grapes
1 1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. white pepper
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. lemon juice
5/8  c. cream, whipped
lettuce
cantaloupe rings
seasonal fruit
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Fold in whipped cream.  Chill, covered, for at least 3 hours.  When ready to serve, line plate with lettuce.  Place cantaloupe ring on top.  Fill center with large scoop of chicken salad.  Decorate with seasonal fruit.  Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: OVEN STEW
ingredients:
2 1/2  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  c. minced celery
1/4  c. thinly sliced green pepper
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  c. sliced onion
2  lb. beef stew meat or round steak
2 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  fresh tomato, peeled and diced (canned tomato, well drained may be substituted)
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
2  c. beef broth or water
1/2  c. dry red wine (cooking red sherry substitute)
1/2  c. pimento-stuffed, sliced olives
preparation: Melt the margarine in a skillet.  Add the celery, green peppers, garlic and onions.  Saute until softened and slightly browned.  Cut meat into 1-inch cubes.  Dust with the flour and seasonings.  Add to the skillet; saute until browned.  Stir in the sugar, salt, tomato, mushrooms, broth and wine.  Transfer to a buttered 3-quart casserole.  Cover.  Let stand several hours. Bake at 350° for 2 hours (uncovered).  Stir in olives 5 minutes before done.  Note:  Start early afternoon.

name: TEXAS CAVIAR
ingredients:
2 (14 oz.)  cans black-eyed peas, drained
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  can hominy, drained
2  medium tomatoes, chopped
4  green onions, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  medium bell pepper, chopped
1  jalapeno pepper, chopped
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. chopped parsley
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Italian salad dressing
preparation: Combine all ingredients except salad dressing; mix well.  Pour salad dressing over mixture; cover and refrigerate to marinate for at least 2 hours.  Drain and serve with tortilla chips.

name: FAST DOUBLE BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. banana cake mix
1/4  c. oil
2  eggs
1  c. water
1/3  c. sugar
2  ripe bananas, mashed
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Pour oil into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan; tilt to cover bottom.  Put remaining ingredients into pan; stir with a fork or spoon until blended (about 2 minutes).  Scrape sides and spread batter evenly in pan.  Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until tooth pick inserted into center comes clean.  Cool; sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired.  Serve directly from pan.  Store loosely covered.

name: MICHELLE'S WATERGATE DELIGHT DESSERT
ingredients:
3  (16 oz. or 24 oz.) Cool Whip
3  boxes pistachio instant pudding
2 large  cans crushed pineapple
1  large bag small marshmallows
2  c. broken pecans
1 small  pkg. coconut (optional)
preparation: In large bowl add Cool Whip, dry pistachio instant pudding and pineapple.  Mix ingredients together.  Add pecans and coconut (optional).  Keep in refrigerator.  About 2 or 3 hours before serving, add marshmallows.  Mix.  Put back in refrigerator. Enjoy.

name: SPICED CRANBERRY RING
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. jello
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
dash of cloves
2  c. boiling water
2 (8 oz.)  cans whole cranberry sauce
2  Tbsp. grated orange rind
1  c. diced orange sections
1  c. chopped apple
preparation: Dissolve jello and all seasonings in water.  Add sauce and rind.  Chill until thickened.  Fold in orange and apple.  Chill until firm, about 4 hours.  Unmold and garnish.

name: SOUTHERN SAUSAGE STEW
ingredients:
2 (14 1/2 oz.)  cans Cajun-style stewed tomatoes
20  oz. frozen chopped turnips or collard greens or kale
1 (7 oz.)  can corn kernels, drained
8  oz. light kielbasa, cut in rounds
preparation: Put tomatoes and frozen greens in skillet. Stir over medium heat until thawed. Stir in remaining ingredients.  Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: VANILLA WAFER CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
5  eggs (add one at a time)
crushed walnuts
coconut
1/2  c. milk
dash of salt
12  oz. box vanilla wafers
preparation: Soften margarine.  Crush vanilla  wafers,  mix with milk and blend into a creamy  mixture.  Add  coconut,  walnuts  and salt. Blend together well.  Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325° in a tube pan.

name: AMARETTI COOKIES
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can Pure Almond Paste (i.e. Almond Solo Brand)
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/4  c. flour
pinch of salt
2  egg whites (slightly beaten) *
1/8  lb. pignoli nuts
Maraschino cherries (drained and chopped)- optional
preparation: Pre-heat oven to 325°.  Line cookie sheet with parchment paper or fitted brown bag.  Blend ingredients by hand or use food processor.  Break almond paste in pieces.  Gradually blend in sugars, flour, salt and egg white.  Using two teaspoons, drop heaping teaspoonful on paper; swirl into oval shape, peaking upwards. Decorate with 4 to 8 nuts (place firmly into dough) and/or press cherry into center of cookie and press pignoli nuts (pine nuts) around cherry.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CHOCOLATE CHIP ICE CREAM
ingredients:
6  eggs
2  c. peanut butter
2  pt. half and half
1  c. milk chocolate chips
1  c. Sugar Twin
1  c. white Karo syrup
4  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs until frothy.  Stir in Sugar Twin until dissolved. Add peanut butter and syrup; blend well.  Add cream and vanilla; blend well.  Stir in chocolate chips.  Pour into freezer can and freeze until firm.  Makes one gallon.

name: PERFECT WHITE BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. warm water
2  pkg. active dry yeast
1 3/4  c. milk, scalded
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
3  Tbsp. soft shortening
7  c. flour, may use part wheat (do not use self-rising)
preparation: Pour warm water in large bowl and sprinkle with yeast.  Stir until dissolved.  Add sugar, salt, shortening and lukewarm milk to the yeast mixture and beat in about 3 cups flour.  Beat until smooth and falls from spoon in sheets.  With a spoon and 1 hand, mix in enough flour to make dough that pulls away from sides, leaving only small amount sticking to sides.

name: CRANBERRY MEATBALLS(Makes 4 Dozen)
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. hot water
1 (16 oz.)  can whole berry cranberry sauce
1/3  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  Tbsp. lime juice
preparation: Combine cornstarch and water in small bowl; stir until smooth. In large skillet, combine the rest of ingredients.   Cook over medium heat until sugar dissolves.  Add cornstarch mixture and cook, stirring until it thickens.  Stir in meatballs,  transfer to a 2-quart casserole.  Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight to allow flavors to blend.

name: PEANUT BUTTER LOGS
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1 1/2  c. sifted 10x sugar
1/4  c. softened margarine
3  c. crisp rice cereal
1  c. chopped peanuts
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Beat together peanut butter and 1/4 cup margarine.  Stir in 10x sugar.  Stir in cereal.  Using one tablespoon of dough, shape into logs.  Roll in nuts; set aside.

name: NO ICING CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo
1/2  c. shortening
3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
5  eggs
1  c. milk
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together.  Put in Bundt or tube pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Put a cookie sheet under and flip out of pan while still warm.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts, skinned, boned and split in 2
1  pkg. dried beef
1  pt. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Tear dried beef and place in bottom of roaster or cake pan. Place chicken breasts on top of dried beef.  Mix soup and sour cream together and pour over chicken breasts.   Cover and bake at 300° for 3 hours.  Remove cover and bake another 1/2 hour.  Serve hot with wild rice, regular rice or noodles.

name: OREO CRUNCH PIE
ingredients:
ready made Oreo pie crust
vanilla ice cream or vanilla yogurt
Hershey's chocolate syrup
bite size Oreo cookies
Cool Whip
preparation: Soften ice cream enough to spread smoothly.  Place ice cream into pie crust until level with top of crust.  Place bite size Oreo cookies side by side around the edge of the crust, then place approximately 3 to 4 cookies in the middle in a circle.  Pour Hershey's chocolate syrup all around.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. potatoes, sliced
1  c. cream of chicken soup
2/3  c. milk
butter and margarine
salt and pepper
cheese
preparation: Boil  potatoes  until  done (to prevent breaking do not stir while cooking);  drain.  Mix milk  and soup.  In a baking dish, layer potatoes, butter, salt  and  pepper as desired and soup mixture.  Continue alternating  layers.  Place  cheese on top; bake at 300° for 20 minutes.

name: CANNOLI(Dessert)
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. flour
1  Tbsp. shortening
pinch of salt
1/2  tsp. sugar
wine (sweet or dry) or water
preparation: Mix flour, shortening, salt and sugar.  Add enough wine (can use water if desired) to make a stiff, but workable, dough.  Roll into a ball and let stand 1 hour.  Roll out dough 1/8-inch thick. Cut into 5-inch squares and wrap the dough around a short cannoli tube so that the opposite corners meet.  Fry in deep fat one at a time until golden brown.

name: THREE BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. can cut green beans
1  lb. can cut yellow beans
1  lb. can red kidney beans
1  c. lima beans (optional) or use 1 can garbanzos
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  medium onion, sliced
1/2  c. cider vinegar
1/3  c. cooking oil
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Drain beans and rinse well.  Add green pepper and onion to beans.  Mix other ingredients and add to bean mixture.  Mix well. Let set overnight in refrigerator.

name: SALMON STEW
ingredients:
5  medium potatoes, diced
5  medium onions, diced
1 tall  can salmon, deboned, dark skin removed and flaked
1/2  stick margarine
salt and pepper to taste
2 tall  cans evaporated milk
preparation: Place diced potatoes and onions in large pot; cover with water.  Add salt, pepper and margarine.  Bring to boil.  Turn heat down; simmer an hour or so.  Add salmon; cook about 15 minutes. Add milk; heat until very hot.  Do not boil.  Serve with saltines.

name: PEACH SALAD
ingredients:
1  can peach pie filling
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  c. small marshmallows
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained well
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix and chill.

name: IMPOSSIBLE CHEESEBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. shredded cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. biscuit mix
3  eggs
preparation: Grease a 10 pie plate.  Brown beef & onion, add salt & pepper. Spread in pie plate.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Beat rest of ingredients in blender on high speed for 15 seconds.  Pour over meat & cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 min. or until knife in center comes out clean.  Let stand 5 min. before cutting.

name: FRIED APPLE PIES
ingredients:
2  c. dried apples
2  c. flour (self-rising)
3/4  c. Crisco
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. buttermilk
sugar to taste
preparation: Cook dried apples with enough water to cover.  Add sugar to taste; set aside.  Mix flour and Crisco together like biscuit dough until mealy.  Add water and buttermilk (May add more or less butter until dough is like biscuit dough.)  Knead dough; roll out thin. Use a saucer to lay on dough; cut a circle.  Put cooked apples on half the circle; fold other half on top of apple half.  Pinch together edges; prick middle with a fork.  Fry in Crisco oil that has covered the bottom of a pan.  Cook in electric skillet or iron skillet until brown.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE DISH
ingredients:
1/2  c. raw rice
1/2  pkg. onion soup mix
boned chicken pieces
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 1/2 soup  cans water
1 small  can sliced mushrooms
preparation: Put rice in bottom of greased casserole.  Sprinkle onion soup mix over rice.  Place boned chicken pieces over rice mixture.  Mix soup and water; pour over top.  Add sliced mushrooms over top. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

name: REESE CUP SQUARES
ingredients:
1  box powdered sugar
1 1/2  sticks margarine, melted
1 1/2  c. peanut butter
1 1/2  c. crushed graham crackers
12  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Combine first four ingredients and press into a large 9 x 13-inch pan.  Melt chocolate chips over low heat and pour over mixture.

name: RICH BROWNIES(With a Wonderful Cream Frosting)
ingredients:
1/3  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2 (1 oz.)  sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted
2/3  c. enriched flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2/3  c. walnuts
preparation: Thoroughly cream shortening and sugar.  Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well.  Add cooled melted chocolate and blend.  Add sifted dry ingredients.  Stir in walnuts.  Bake in greased 8-inch square pan in moderate oven at 350° for 35 minutes.  Frost with Creamy Chocolate Frosting.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
cooked chicken, boned
1  can English peas
1  can sliced carrots
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can reserved chicken broth
1/2  stick margarine
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Layer chicken, peas and carrots.  Add flour to margarine. Gradually add milk and mix well. Pour over layered ingredients. Use an oblong Pyrex dish.  Do not grease dish.  Cook at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: B.B.Q. SPARE RIBS
ingredients:
1 1/2  jars bbq sauce
1/2  jar apricot jam
2  tsp. hickory smoked salt (optional)
2  tsp. soy sauce
2-3 lbs. country-style boneless spare ribs, cut into bite size pieces
cooked rice
preparation: Mix bbq sauce with soy sauce, ham and hickory smoked salt. Put ribs in a slow cooker and add this mixture to it and stir. cook on low 9-10 hours.  Serve over rice.

name: BANANA COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. whole wheat flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. honey
1/2  c. oil
1  egg
1  c. bananas, mashed
1 3/4  c. oatmeal
1/2  c. chocolate chips
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Sift together the flour, soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon.  In a large bowl, blend honey, oil, egg and bananas with an electric mixer.  Slowly add dry ingredients until well mixed.  Add remaining ingredients.  If dough gets stiff, add last of ingredients by hand; mix well.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet; bake at 375° for 9 to 11 minutes.

name: PIZZAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small green bell pepper, chopped
1 (30 oz.)  jar chunky garden style pasta sauce (chunky mushrooms and onions)
1 (8 oz.)  box spaghetti
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. sliced pepperoni
1  pkg. shredded Mozzarella cheese (3 c.)
preparation: Brown ground beef in skillet, crumbling meat as it cooks; drain.  Add green pepper to meat.  Stir in pasta sauce; simmer for 5 minutes.  Cook spaghetti as directed on box; drain.  Spread half of cooked spaghetti in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Spread half of sauce mixture over it.  Place layer of sliced pepperoni on top of sauce.  Cover pepperoni with half of cheese.  Repeat to make second layer.  Place in hot oven (375°) until cheese melts or becomes lightly browned.  Cool slightly.  Makes 10 to 12 servings.

name: DILLY BEANS
ingredients:
2  lb. fresh green beans
dill heads
medium garlic cloves, sliced
2 1/2  c. vinegar
2 1/2  c. water
1/4  c. salt
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
preparation: Snap off stem ends of beans.  Pack into 4 sterilized pint jars to which you have added 1 large dill head and a sliced medium garlic clove.  Bring vinegar, water, salt and cayenne pepper to a boil.  Pour over beans.  Seal; process 10 minutes in hot water bath.  Do not use quart jars.

name: PINEAPPLE-CHEESE-MARSHMALLOW SALAD
ingredients:
2 (15 oz.)  cans pineapple tidbits
1 1/2  c. American cheese
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. cornstarch
1 1/2  c. drained pineapple juice
yellow food coloring
preparation: Drain and save juice from pineapple tidbits.  Cube cheese; mix with marshmallows.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
10  chicken wings (about 2 lb.)
3/4  c. Bisquick baking mix
2  Tbsp. cornmeal
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. buttermilk
1/4  c. margarine or butter, melted
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Separate chicken wings at joints; discard tips.  Mix baking mix, cornmeal, chili powder, salt and pepper. Dip chicken into buttermilk; coat with cornmeal mixture.  Arrange close together in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch rectangular pan. Drizzle with margarine.  Bake, uncovered, for 35 to 40 minutes or until light brown and crisp.  Makes 20 chicken wings.

name: BRAISED CELERY
ingredients:
2  c. chopped celery
4  sprigs parsley
4  slices onion
1/2  c. bouillon (beef or chicken)
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  strips bacon, chopped
buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Put the celery, parsley, onion and bouillon in a casserole; toss lightly.  Sprinkle with the salt, pepper and bacon.  Bake, covered, at 375° for 30 minutes.  Take out and sprinkle with the bread crumbs.  Bake, uncovered, for about 10 more minutes.  The bread crumbs will be brown.

name: MAPLE PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
pinch of salt
3/4  c. maple syrup
1  c. undiluted evaporated milk
2  c. canned pumpkin
pastry for 9-inch bottom crust
preparation: Beat eggs well, then beat in sugar, spices and salt.  Add maple syrup, evaporated milk and pumpkin, beating with rotary beater.  Pour into pastry-lined pan and bake in 450° oven for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to 350° and bake 40 minutes longer or until a knife blade comes out cleanly when inserted near center.  Serve cold or slightly warm.

name: RUSSIAN INSTANT TEA
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Tang
2  pkg. lemonade mix
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1  c. lemon flavored instant tea
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. allspice
preparation: Combine all ingredients, mixing well.  Store in tightly covered containers.  Use 1 to 2 heaping teaspoonfuls per cup of hot water; stir until dissolved.  (May be used as ice tea.)

name: THUMBPRINTS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  egg, separated
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add beaten egg yolk.  Beat until light.  Add flour and vanilla.  Roll into balls.  Beat egg whites until foamy.  Dip the balls into egg whites and roll in ground nuts.  Press with thumb.  Bake at 350° for 5 minutes, then push center down again and bake 15 minutes longer.  Remove and put on wire rack.  Fill center with jam or icing.

name: PERSONAL PIZZAS
ingredients:
4  English muffins
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/4  lb. Mozzarella cheese
16  slices salami or pepperoni
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Split open muffins and put on cookie sheet.  Mix tomato sauce, basil and oregano.  Grate Mozzarella cheese.  Spread 1 to 2 tablespoons of tomato sauce on muffin halves.  Put 2 slices salami or pepperoni on each.  Sprinkle each with cheese.  Bake until cheese melts at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: CROCK-POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  chuck roast (boneless)
1  onion, sliced
1  carrot, sliced
1  stalk celery, sliced
3  medium potatoes, sliced
1  c. ketchup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1  tsp. each:  salt and pepper
preparation: Put chuck roast into crock-pot.  Add all ingredients to this. Add enough water to cover just over the ingredients.   Cook on high for 3 to 4 hours.  May be best to add your cut up potatoes last so it won't be mushy.  You can add the last hour.

name: RELYENONG TA LONG(Eggplant Omelette, Filipino Style)
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground pork
2  large eggplant
2  eggs (fresh), scrambled
1  small onion
2  pieces garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
dash of soy sauce and pepper
preparation: Broil eggplant, skin it and put aside.  Heat pan with cooking oil with slow heat; brown garlic.  Stir onion until translucent and mix meat until brown.  Season with soy sauce and dash of pepper. Cover and simmer about 5 minutes.  Take eggplant and part in the middle; stuff with the cooked ingredients and pour with the scrambled eggplant.  Fry in a large pan.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. chopped broccoli
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. sharp grated cheese
2  eggs, well beaten
preparation: Cook the broccoli in salted water until tender.  Drain. Combine the mayonnaise, soup, cheese and eggs and blend.  Pour over broccoli and top with crushed cheese crackers.  Bake 20 minutes at 400°.  This freezes well.  Bake about 10 minute before you freeze.

name: CRUSTY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. cake flour
1  c. Crisco at room temperature
pinch of salt
4 or 5  Tbsp. orange or lemon vanilla
2  c. sugar
5  eggs at room temperature
2  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream shortening and 1 cup sugar.  Add other cup of sugar and cream, then add eggs one at a time.  Add flour that has been sifted 5 times.  Add vanillas and salt.  Bake at 325° to 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen broccoli spears
1  pkg. frozen broccoli pieces
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  Tbsp. grated onion
2  eggs, well beaten
buttered crumbs
preparation: Cook and drain broccoli.  Cut spears in large pieces.  Mix other ingredients together; add broccoli.  Place in lightly buttered casserole.  Top with crumbs and bake 40 minutes in 350° oven.  Serves 6.

name: HOT CURRIED FRUIT
ingredients:
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, undrained
1 (16 oz.)  can pear halves, undrained
1 (16 oz.)  can apricot halves, undrained
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2 to 3/4  tsp. curry powder (curry is real strong, watch)
1/2  c. red maraschino cherries, drained
2  large bananas, cut into thick slices
preparation: Drain first 3 ingredients, reserving juice; set aside. Combine next 3 ingredients in a medium saucepan; stir well.   Add reserved fruit juice and bring mixture to a boil, stirring constantly.  Boil 1 minute; remove from heat.

name: CARROT SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. shredded carrots
1  c. raisins
1  c. crushed pineapple
2  Tbsp. sugar
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. plain yogurt
preparation: Combine carrots, pineapple and raisins.  Combine sugar, mayonnaise and yogurt, blending well.  Pour over carrot mixture and toss.  Cover and refrigerate.

name: LORI'S CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 1/4  sticks butter
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  envelope Dream Whip
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix the graham cracker crumbs, melted butter and sugar.  Press in bottom of buttered pan (9 x 13-inches).  Mix Dream Whip as package says; set aside.

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
6  boneless chicken breasts
8  oz. box thin spaghetti
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1  small onion
1  stick margarine
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Boil chicken until tender.  Remove from water and cut into bite-sized pieces.  Cook spaghetti noodles in same water, drain and rinse with cold water.  Saute onion in butter.  Place all ingredients in a glass 9 x 13-inch baking dish and mix well.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: EGG IN A FRAME
ingredients:
1  slice bread
2  pats butter or margarine
spatula
1  egg
small frying pan
preparation: Cut a hole in the center of the bread with an upside down drinking glass.  Then melt one pat of butter in a small frying pan over low heat.  Toss in the bread and break the egg into the hole. Don't worry if you break the yolk.  Cook until the bread is golden brown on the bottom.  (You can peek with a spatula.)  Turn the bread over.  Put the remaining butter in the pan and use your spatula to make sure it gets under the toast.  Continue frying until the egg looks done.  No more than a couple of minutes.

name: SUNSHINE CAKE
ingredients:
10  eggs
1 1/2  c. white sugar
1  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
pinch of salt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: First beat egg whites stiffly, then beat in cream of tartar. Next, put in sugar and flour; just mix with a big spoon.  Last, add egg yolks.

name: EGGPLANT PARMESAN
ingredients:
1  large eggplant, sliced into medium pieces
4  c. tomato-vegetable spaghetti sauce
2  oz. reduced fat Mozzarella cheese
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
nonstick cooking spray
preparation: Coat a pan with nonstick cooking spray.  Spread unpeeled eggplant in pan.  Lightly spray top of eggplant.  Broil until brown.  Preheat oven to 350°. In baking dish, layer tomato-vegetable sauce, eggplant, Mozzarella, sauce, eggplant, Mozzarella and sauce.  Sprinkle with grated Parmesan.  Bake covered for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: BREAD CUSTARD
ingredients:
1/2  c. brown sugar
4  slices bread
1/8  tsp. salt
2  eggs
2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
nutmeg
preparation: Put brown sugar in top of double boiler.  Place well buttered bread slices on top of sugar.  In a separate bowl, beat eggs.  Add milk, salt and vanilla.  Pour this custard over the bread, but do not stir.  Steam for 1 1/2 hours and serve hot or cold.

name: QUICK METHOD ROLLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. warm water
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs, well beaten
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  pkg. yeast
5  Tbsp. shortening
5  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water and let stand 5 minutes. Add remaining water, salt and sugar; beat.  Add shortening and beat.  Add eggs and beat.  Add flour and mix until elastic.  Put in refrigerator and let double in size.   Take out and knead amount desired.  Return rest to refrigerator.  Let rise.  Bake at 450° until brown.

name: CHINESE FRIED RICE(6 Servings)
ingredients:
3  c. leftover rice
4  minced scallions
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. diced cooked chicken (optional)
3  eggs
1 1/2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/4  c. minced cilantro leaves
1/4  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Heat oil in heavy skillet; toss in rice and heat until hot and golden.  Add scallions, salt and chicken; mix well.  Push rice to sides of pan and break 3 eggs into hollow.  Stir until lightly scrambled, then stir together with rice mixture.  Add soy sauce and cilantro; stir.  Serve.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
1/2 small  pkg. chocolate chips
1  box gingerbread mix
preparation: Follow directions on package.  Pour in pan.  Sprinkle chocolate chips on top.  Gently swirl a little mix to cover chips; do not stir them in.  Bake as directed.  Serve like brownies or as cake with warm applesauce or ice cream.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  large chicken breasts
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1 (10 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1 small  can diced chili peppers
1/2  c. chicken bouillon
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. tortilla chips
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cut chicken into bite size pieces and cook.  Mix soups, tomatoes, onions and broth to make sauce.  Layer in 9 x 13-inch greased pan:  chips, chicken, sauce and cheese, ending with chips and cheese for topping.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to an hour.

name: CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  can chunk pineapple, drained
1  c. chopped pecans
1  large whipped topping
1  tsp. almond flavoring
preparation: Mix ingredients in large bowl and chill overnight.  Makes a big salad.

name: BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1/2 to 1  lb. dry beans
2  strips bacon
1  small onion, chopped fine
1  stalk celery, chopped fine
1  small potato
1  carrot
2  cans chicken broth
