1  tsp. chicken bouillon
pepper
preparation: Soak beans overnight, then drain and rinse.  In your soup pot, fry bacon, then discard.  Saute onions and celery.  Then add chicken broth.  Grate potato and carrot into the broth.  Add bouillon and pepper.  Add beans and water to fill up your pot to where you want it.  Bring to a boil.  Let it boil for at least 15 minutes, then turn heat down.  Cover, then simmer until done (2 to 3 hours).  Navy, Northern or pinto beans will do; can be mixed, also.

name: UPSIDE-DOWN PIZZA
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1/2  pkg. dry spaghetti mix
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/4  c. butter, melted
1/2  c. chopped onion
16  oz. can tomato sauce
1  can crescent rolls
preparation: Brown beef; drain.  Add onion, then add spaghetti mix and tomato sauce.  Simmer a few minutes, then put into a 9 x 13-inch pan or 2 square pans.  Add mushrooms and peppers (optional). Cover with cheese.  Unroll rolls and put over cheese.  Spread over dough.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Freezes well.

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
4  slices bacon
1/4  c. butter (1/2 stick)
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 2/3  c. Pet milk (1 tall can)
1/3  c. cider vinegar
4  c. cooked, sliced, hot potatoes
1  Tbsp. mustard (dry)
paprika to garnish
preparation: Fry bacon; set aside. Melt butter; add onions and pepper. Cook. Blend flour, sugar and salt; add milk. Cook over low heat; stir in vinegar and mustard. Pour over potatoes and toss lightly. Put paprika on top.

name: APRICOT GLAZED CARROTS
ingredients:
1  pkg. whole baby carrots (frozen)
1/4  c. apricot preserves
1 1/2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. grated orange rind
1/8  tsp. ground nutmeg
preparation: Cook whole baby carrots, using microwave or stove top directions.  Drain.  Combine remaining ingredients in a saucepan. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until preserves melt. Stir in carrots and cook until thoroughly heated.  Garnish with apricot halves.

name: CREAMY POTATO PUFFS
ingredients:
1  pkg. cream cheese
4  c. hot mashed potatoes
1  egg, beaten
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped pimiento
dash of salt and pepper
preparation: Combine softened cheese and potatoes, mixing well. Add remaining ingredients.  Place in 1-quart casserole and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: COCOA OATMEAL TREATS
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/3  c. Hershey's cocoa
1/2  c. skim milk
1/2  c. margarine
1/3  c. creamy peanut butter
2 1/2  c. quick-cooking rolled oats
1/2  c. chopped unsalted peanuts (optional)
preparation: In a medium saucepan, stir together the sugar and cocoa.  Stir in the milk and butter.  Cook over medium heat until boiling. Stir constantly.  Boil for one minute.  Remove from heat.  Stir in peanut butter.  Add oats and peanuts.  Stir to mix well.  Quickly drop mixture by rounded teaspoonfuls onto wax paper or foil.  Cool completely.  Store in a cool, dry place.

name: Chocolate Eclair Dessert
ingredients:
1  box graham crackers
2  pkg. instant French vanilla pudding
milk to make pudding
8  oz. frozen whipped topping, thawed
2  oz. liquid chocolate
2  tsp. light corn syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
3  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Butter 13 x 9-inch pan.  Line bottom with whole graham crackers.  Mix pudding and milk according to label.  Mix in thawed whipped topping.  Prepare frosting from remaining ingredients; set aside.  Pour half the pudding mix over graham crackers.  Top with remaining pudding mix.  Put third layer of whole crackers to cover pudding.  Spread frosting over top layer of crackers. Refrigerate.  Try to leave it in the refrigerator at least 24 hours.

name: MILKY WAY CAKE
ingredients:
5  Milky Way candy bars
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
4  eggs, separated
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/4  c. buttermilk
2 1/2  c. flour
1  c. pecans, chopped
2  c. semi-sweet chocolate morsels, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Grease and flour angel food cake pan. In a small pot over low heat, melt candy bars with 1/2 cup butter. Cream sugar with remaining 1/2 cup butter until light.  Add candy mixture and blend well.  Add egg yolks, one at a time, mixing well after each.  Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk and add alternately with flour to candy mixture, ending with flour.  Beat egg whites to stiff peaks and fold into candy mixture with chopped pecans.  Bake 1 hour 10 minutes.  Cool and frost with melted semi-sweet chocolate.  Very Rich!

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken breasts
flour
3  oz. can mushrooms
1  tsp. paprika
1  c. sour cream
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1  c. water
preparation: Cube the meat from raw chicken breasts.  Roll in flour.  Heat 2 tablespoons shortening in skillet and brown meat well on all sides.  Add mushrooms (drained).  Remove from heat.  Add paprika and blend.  Combine onion soup, sour cream and water.  Pour over meat.  Pour into casserole; cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.  Serve over cooked rice or noodles.  Serves 6.

name: CHILI-RONI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. green bell pepper, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 3/4  c. water
1  pkg. chili seasoning mix
1 1/2  c. uncooked elbow macaroni
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown beef, onion and green pepper in large skillet.  Drain fat.  Stir in tomatoes, water, chili mix and macaroni.  Cover; simmer 25 to 30 minutes or until macaroni is done.  Top with cheese.

name: 5 MINUTE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
3  c. flour
3/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Put eggs in a cup and finish filling with milk.  Add this to the butter and sugar; beat well.  Sift flour with baking powder alternately with milk.   Bake in tube pan in a slow oven.

name: ANN LANDER'S MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground round
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. bread crumbs
3/4  c. ketchup
1  tsp. Accent
1/2  c. warm water
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
preparation: Mix thoroughly.  Pat into loaf pan.  Cover with 2 strips of bacon.  Pour over top 1 (8 ounce) can tomato sauce.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.  Serves 6.

name: CROCK POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  English beef roast (or other)
1  can stewed tomatoes
1  can Cream of Celery soup
1  Tbsp. worcestershire
1  small-medium onion chopped
Lawry's seasoning salt
preparation: Pour enough oil in the bottom of a skillet to brown your roast on medium to high heat.  Sprinkle entire roast with Lawry's and brown well in skillet.  Set aside.  Mix tomatoes, soup, Worcestershire sauce and onion in crock pot.  Place roast in the crock pot and cook all day on low.  What a great gravy to serve with your roast and mashed potatoes!

name: DRESSING MIX
ingredients:
2 or 3  c. turkey or chicken broth
corn bread crumbs
wheat bread crumbs
2  c. chopped celery
1  chopped onion
poultry seasoning to taste
sage to taste
preparation: Mix together well and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: ITALIAN SLOPPY SUBS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground Italian sausage
1/2  c. coarsely chopped onion
1/2  c. coarsely chopped green pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can whole tomatoes, drained and cut up
1/4  c. catsup
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
4  French rolls (6 to 8-inch), split
1  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: In 1-quart casserole, combine sausage, onion and green pepper. Cover.  Microwave at High for 4 to 5 minutes, or until meat is no longer pink, stirring several times to break apart.  Drain.  Add tomatoes, catsup and Italian seasoning.  Microwave at High for 2 to 4 minutes, or until mixture is hot and flavors are blended, stirring once.  Set aside.

name: TEXAS TATERS
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash brown potatoes
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. melted margarine
2  cartons (8 oz. each) sour cream
1  tsp. salt or to taste
1  can (10 1/2 oz.) cream of chicken soup
10  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into a well-greased baking pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: FUDGE OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. Pet milk
1  stick butter
2 1/2  c. oats
flavoring
preparation: Cook sugar, cocoa, Pet milk and butter for 5 minutes.  Add oats and cook 3 minutes.  Add flavoring and beat unti creamy. Drop on wax paper.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  pkg. shredded cheese
lettuce
tomato
onion
nacho chips
preparation: Mix the first three ingredients together and spread on cookie sheet.  Top that with chopped lettuce, onion, cheese and tomato. Eat with nacho chips.

name: SESAME CHICKEN(Excellent And Easy!)
ingredients:
6  to 8 chicken breasts
3/4 to 1  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/2  stick margarine
1/4  c. oil
3  Tbsp. sesame seed
1/3  c. chopped scallions
10  to 12 fresh sliced mushrooms
1  c. white wine
preparation: Dredge chicken in flour, salt, pepper and paprika.  Melt margarine and oil in 9 x 13-inch glass dish in the oven.  Put chicken in pan and sprinkle with 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame seed and bake at 375° for 20 minutes.  Turn chicken and add scallions, remaining sesame seed, mushrooms and white wine.  Lower oven to 350° and cook for another 20 minutes.

name: PRETZEL SALAD OR DESSERT
ingredients:
2  c. pretzels, crushed
3/4  c. margarine, melted
4  Tbsp. sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1  large Cool Whip
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry or red raspberry jello
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. strawberries or red raspberries
2  c. boiling water
preparation: To make crust, mix pretzels, margarine and sugar.  Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 400° for 6 minutes.  Cool.

name: STUFFED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
6  small sweet potatoes, baked
1/2  c. sweetened condensed milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Slice top off baked potatoes; scoop insides into mixing bowl. Mash potatoes and beat with butter, milk, salt and pecans.  Refill shell.  Bake in 450° oven for about 5 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. nuts
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
3  c. plus 2 Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix ingredients in order.  Bake on greased cookie sheet at 375° for 10 minutes.  If cookies seemed too thin, add a little more flour.

name: CUCUMBER SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing
2  cucumbers, peeled and sliced
1  loaf cocktail rye
preparation: Combine cream cheese and 1 package Italian dressing mix. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours minimum.  Slice cucumbers 1/8-inch.  To serve, spread cheese mix on bread slice and top with cucumber.

name: IRISH BREAD
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. caraway seed (optional)
3  c. flour
3  Tbsp. baking powder
1/4  Tbsp. baking soda
1/4  Tbsp. salt
3/4  box raisins
preparation: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add the egg. Add measured 3 cups firmly packed flour, plus dry ingredients, alternately with milk. Add caraway seed and raisins.  Pour into tube pan. Sprinkle sugar over top and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 5 or 10 minutes. Rub butter over the top of bread as soon as you remove from the oven.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  zucchini
2  onions
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  c. grated cheese
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Use 2-quart baking dish.  Layer zucchini, alternated with sugar and salt.  Layer onions, alternated with sugar and salt. Repeat layers.  Pour tomato sauce over zucchini and onions.  Top with cheese.  Bake 1 hour at 400°.  Serves 4.

name: BASIC SOUFFLE RECIPE
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. milk
7  Tbsp. flour
6  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. salt
4  egg yolks
4  egg whites
preparation: Make a white sauce of melted butter, flour and milk.  Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored.  Add to the white sauce. Beat the egg whites until stiff, but not dry.  Fold into the white sauce-yolk mixture.  Bake in an ungreased casserole at 325°, starting with a cold oven, for 1 hour.  Remove immediately for eating or it will collapse.  Serves 4.

name: COMPANY CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  to 8 boneless chicken breast halves
1  large block cream cheese, sliced
1  bag baby spinach
1  can cream of celery soup (undiluted)
1  pt. sour cream
1/4  c. white wine
1 1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Place spinach on bottom of baking dish. Wrap chicken breast around a piece of cream cheese. Place seam side down on spinach. Mix soup, sour cream and wine together. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Cover and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until chicken is done.

name: BASIC CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  egg
1 1/3  c. milk
1/4  c. oil
2  c. self-rising meal
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake in 400° oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

name: ENGLISH MUFFINS WITH SEAFOOD AND CHEESE
ingredients:
4  English muffins
1/2  c. butter
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1 (7 oz.)  can crabmeat or cocktail shrimp
garlic salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Soften the butter in a small bowl with an electric mixer or wooden spoon.  Mix in the cheese, seafood and seasonings.  Spread the mixture on halved muffins.  Place them on a cookie sheet; broil until bubbly.

name: BISCUITS
ingredients:
1/3  c. shortening
2  c. plain flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Combine flour, baking powder and salt.  Cut shortening into mixture until it is fine crumbs.  Stir in just enough milk so dough leaves side of bowl; round up into ball.  Turn dough onto lightly floured surface.  Knead lightly 10 times.  Roll or pat dough 1/2-inch thick.  Cut with floured 2-inch biscuit cutter.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet about 1-inch apart for crusty sides.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes about 16 biscuits.

name: AUNT JUDY'S PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
2  tsp. flour
1  pie shell
1  c. white Karo
1  tsp. vanilla
1 or 2  c. pecans
preparation: Melt butter and mix in flour.  Add remaining ingredients except vanilla and pecans and mix well.  When all mixed, add vanilla and pecans.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour.  Makes one 8-inch pie.

name: CATHY'S MOM'S CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. margarine
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
3  egg yolks
3  Tbsp. cocoa
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. milk
preparation: Melt butter over low heat.  Mix together all dry ingredients. Add milk to butter.  Add dry ingredients.  Add yolks and vanilla last.  Cook over medium heat until thick.  Pour into cooked pastry crust and chill.  You can also put crushed Snickers bars in bottom of crust.

name: PUMPKIN ROLL
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. pumpkin pie filling (canned)
1  tsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat on high speed for 5 minutes the eggs.  Gradually add sugar.  Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice.  Add remaining ingredients.  Spread in greased and floured cookie pan.  Top with 1 cup crushed walnuts.  Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.  Turn out on towel sprinkled with powdered sugar and roll towel and cake together (lengthwise).  Cool.  Unroll.  Spread filling on top.

name: SOUR CREAM BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
6  c. milk
2  large instant vanilla pudding
1  pt. sour cream
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip
1 large  box vanilla wafers
5  or 6 bananas
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients until thick.  Layer vanilla wafers and bananas (sliced), alternating between wafers and bananas.  Pour thickened mixture over layered wafers and bananas.  Make night before.

name: VIETNAM POPCORN
ingredients:
6  qt. popped corn
2  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  c. white corn syrup
2  sticks oleo
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Mix ingredients together and bring to a boil.  Add 1/2 teaspoon baking soda.  Pour over popcorn.  Spread on cookie sheet. Put in a 200° oven about 1 hour to dry.  Will keep in plastic bags a long time.

name: OVERNIGHT SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1/2  c. celery, chopped fine
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped fine
3  small onions, cut small
1  pt. Hellmann's mayonnaise
2  tsp. sugar, sprinkled over mayonnaise
10  to 12 strips crisp bacon
8  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Layer each ingredient; do not mix.

name: HASH BROWN POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
24  oz. pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
8  oz. Cheddar or Velveeta cheese
8  oz. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
3/4  stick margarine
salt and pepper to taste
chopped onions
1 1/2  c. crushed corn flakes
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BISQUICK ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
2 1/4  c. Bisquick
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Mix together all  ingredients.  Grease muffin pan.  Bake at 400° approximately 20 minutes.  Makes 12 rolls.

name: CHOCOLATE SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
2  sticks margarine
3 to 4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. soda
1  c. water
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix flour, salt and sugar.  Place oleo, cocoa and water in saucepan and bring to boil.  Pour sugar and flour mixture into pan.  Add eggs, vanilla, buttermilk, soda and cinnamon.  Beat until smooth.  Pour into greased 11 1/2 x 16-inch pan.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: CRACKER SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. crushed saltines
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. sweet relish
3  boiled eggs, chopped
pinch of sugar
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Blend well.  Store, covered, overnight in refrigerator.

name: BAKED SWISS HAMBURGER
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
3/4  c. breadcrumbs
salt and pepper
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
flour
1  can mushroom soup
1  pkg. dry onion soup
preparation: Mix hamburger, breadcrumbs, eggs and milk.  Pat out on cookie sheet or jelly roll pan.  Cover with waxed paper overnight.

name: LIBBY'S RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2 3/4  c. cake flour
2  c. cooking oil
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vinegar
red food coloring
preparation: Cream together oil, sugar and vanilla.  Add eggs one at a time, beating after each addition.  Add red food coloring and vinegar. In a separate bowl, mix together flour, baking soda, salt, and cocoa.  Sift flour mixture and add to batter alternately with buttermilk.  Pour batter into three 8 inch round cake pans and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.  Remove from oven and let cool before icing.

name: CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  green pepper
1  small onion
1  stick butter
4  or 5 medium potatoes
1  can chicken broth
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. Velveeta cheese
milk
preparation: Dice green pepper and onion.  Put in a soup kettle with the butter.  Saute until soft.  Peel and chop potatoes into small bite size pieces.  Add to the pepper and onion mixture.  Pour in one can of chicken broth and enough water to just cover the potatoes.  Cook until the potatoes are completely done.  After potatoes are cooked, cut up the cheese and stir in the potatoes.  After cheese is melted, stir in milk until desired thickness.

name: EGG/SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage, cooked and crumbled
8  eggs, beaten slightly
6  slices bread, cubed
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded or grated
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients; spray 9 x 13-inch pan or Pyrex dish with Pam.  Pour ingredients into pan.  Cover and put in refrigerator overnight.  Next morning, heat oven to 350°.  Put in oven and bake 35 minutes.

name: BATTER BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
2  c. lukewarm water
1/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. melted butter, cooled
1  egg
4  c. self-rising flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water and sugar in large bowl.  Stir in butter and egg.  Add flour a little at a time.  Store covered in refrigerator and use as needed.

name: NO-KNEAD TUPPERWARE BREAD
ingredients:
3  pkg. yeast
3 3/4  c. warm water (105~ to 115~)
10  c. all-purpose flour
6  Tbsp. sugar
6  Tbsp. stick margarine, melted
1  Tbsp. salt
2  eggs, lightly beaten
vegetable cooking spray
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a 7-quart Tupperware container; let stand 5 minutes.  Add flour and next 4 ingredients, stirring well to blend.  Cover container with lid and seal.  Let stand at room temperature 1 hour or until lid pops off.  Spoon dough evenly into 3 (9 x 5-inch) loaf pans.  Coat with cooking spray.  Cover to rise in warm place 30 minutes.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until sounds hollow.

name: BLUEBERRY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. butter
2 1/4  c. sugar, divided
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. fresh blueberries
preparation: Grease a 10-inch tube pan with the 2 tablespoons butter. Sprinkle pan with 1/4 cup sugar.  Cream butter; gradually add balance of sugar.  Beat after each addition, add eggs, one at a time.  Beat after each.  Add vanilla and mix well.  Combine 2 3/4 cups flour, baking powder, soda and salt.  Gradually add to creamed mixture, beating until well blended.  Dredge blueberries with remaining 1/4 cup flour.  Fold berries into batter.  Pour into prepared pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.  Remove from pan.  Cool.

name: BOW TIE CABBAGE SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. evaporated milk (Carnation)
1/3  c. sour cream
1/2  c. cider vinegar
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. uncooked bow tie pasta
5  c. shredded cabbage
3/4  c. chopped green onions
1/2  c. finely chopped green pepper
8  oz. Cheddar cheese, cut into small cubes
preparation: In a jar with tight fitting lid, combine the first 7 ingredients.  Shake well.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours.

name: LOW-SODIUM DUCHESSE POTATOES(Serves 6)
ingredients:
4  c. unsalted mashed potatoes
2  Tbsp. sweet butter or unsalted margarine
2  egg yolks
1 1/2  tsp. Angostura Aromatic Bitters
1/3  c. salt-free cottage cheese
preparation: Combine all ingredients; beat until smooth and well blended. Heat over low heat until piping hot.  Contains about 195 calories per serving with 9 milligrams sodium per serving.

name: FREEZER JAM
ingredients:
2  c. strawberries
4  c. sugar
1/4  c. pectin
3/4  c. water
preparation: Mash berries; add sugar and mix.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Add 1/4 cup pectin and water.  Bring to boil.  Stir constantly.  Boil 1 minute; add to berries.  Stir constantly for 3 minutes.  Ladle into jar or container.  Let sit for 24 hours prior to freezing.

name: EASY CHICKEN AND BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1  tsp. margarine
4  broccoli spears, blanched, cut into 1-inch pieces
3/4  c. chicken broth
2  tsp. cornstarch
dash of pepper
2  Tbsp. oyster sauce
10  oz. chicken breasts, boned, cut in 1 x 3-inch strips
1  clove minced garlic
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: In a 10-inch skillet, heat margarine until hot; add chicken, cook until lightly browned on all sides.  Remove from skillet and set aside.  To same skillet, add broccoli, garlic and saute for 1 minute.  In mixing bowl, combine chicken broth, oyster sauce and cornstarch.  Add to broccoli mixture and cook for 15 minutes, until tender.

name: "MY FAVORITE" CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  sticks margarine
8  oz. cream cheese
3  c. sugar
dash of salt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
6  large eggs
3  c. sifted flour (plain)
preparation: Cream the margarine, cream cheese and sugar until fluffy.  Add salt and vanilla; beat well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Stir in flour.  Spoon into greased 10-inch tube pan.  Bake 1 hour at 325°.

name: S'MORES(Microwave)
ingredients:
graham crackers
marshmallows
large chocolate bars
preparation: Break graham cracker into square shapes.  Put a square of chocolate on graham cracker.  Top with marshmallow and graham cracker square.  Cook on High in microwave for 10 seconds.

name: CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  Ready-Crust (graham cracker "Keebler")
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  (8 oz.) container frozen whipped topping
fresh strawberries
Maria Calendars' glaze
preparation: Beat cheese until smooth; gradually beat in sugar.  Blend in vanilla.  Fold in whipped topping, blending well.  Spoon into crust.  Chill until set, 4 hours.  Clean; slice strawberries and mix with glaze.  Serve on top of cheesecake.

name: LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces
1  pkg. frozen peas, partially thawed
1  large green pepper, chopped
1  large onion, chopped or sliced
mayonnaise
sugar
grated Cheddar cheese
bacon bits
preparation: Put  lettuce  in  salad  bowl.  Sprinkle  green peppers evenly,  then  onions  and  peas.  Cover  salad generously and completely with mayonnaise.  Sprinkle generous amount of sugar over  mayonnaise.  Grate  enough cheese to cover entire salad. Refrigerate for  6  to  8  hours.  Prior  to serving, sprinkle entire salad with bacon bits.

name: SEAFOOD SCAMPI
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
1  onion, cut in wedges
1  green pepper, cut in strips
1  clove garlic, chopped
1  pkg. crabmeat, flaked
4  oz. mushrooms, sliced
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  tsp. parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. lemon pepper
6  oz. fettucini noodles, cooked
preparation: Melt margarine in skillet.  Saute on medium-high the onion, green pepper and garlic for 3 minutes.  Add crab, mushrooms, lemon juice, parsley and lemon pepper.  Add noodles and toss.

name: BLUEBERRY FLIP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. whipping cream
1  egg
3/4  c. canned or cooked fresh blueberries (with juice)
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. milk
1/2  pt. vanilla ice cream
preparation: In chilled bowl, whip cream until it will hold peaks; set aside.  Put egg, blueberries, sugar and milk in blender; run on high speed until very smooth.  Pour carefully over whipped cream and fold in gently.  Pour into 6 tall glasses; top each with a scoop of ice cream.  Yields 6 servings.

name: AVOCADO DIP
ingredients:
1  medium ripe avocado
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. chopped green onions
preparation: In blender, blend avocado, sour cream, green onions and lemon juice until smooth. Chill until time to serve.  Serve with fresh vegetables.  Makes 2 cups dip.

name: BAKING POWDER BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
water
preparation: Combine dry ingredients and shortening.  Blend with a fork until it resembles small dry grains.  Add enough water to make soft, smooth dough, not sticky.  Roll out 1/2-inch thick; cut into round shapes.  Gather scraps and reroll.  If you want drop biscuits, add more water until sticky and drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Makes approximately 7 to 9 biscuits.

name: BROILED CRAB CAKES
ingredients:
1  lb. lump crabmeat
1  tsp. seafood seasoning or 1 tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. finely chopped fresh parsley
2  eggs, well beaten
preparation: Pick over crabmeat gently and carefully to remove shells and cartilage; do not break up lump meat.  Add seasoning, lemon juice, parsley and eggs; combine gently.  Form into medium-size cakes; place in lightly buttered flat pan.  Place under broiler; cook until golden brown, turning once.  Serve with salted crackers. Makes 4 servings.

name: ZUCCHINI PARMESAN
ingredients:
4  or 5 small zucchini, thinly sliced (about 3 c.)
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Put zucchini, butter and seasonings in skillet.  Cover; cook slowly 5 minutes.  Uncover; cook, turning slices until barely tender, about 5 minutes more.  Sprinkle with cheese; toss.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CHICKEN BISCUIT PIE
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. water or juice from peas
1 1/2  c. cooked chicken, cubed
1/2  c. cooked peas
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
biscuit dough for 12 biscuits
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Stir soup; add water.  Slowly blend in chicken, peas and pimento.  Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Top with biscuits.  Bake at 450° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: TORTILLA BITS
ingredients:
8  to 10 flour tortillas
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  tsp. lemon juice
4  green onions, chopped
1  can green chilies
garlic salt to taste
preparation: Combine last 6 ingredients and spread over tortillas.  Roll up and wrap.  Chill for at least 2 hours.  Cut into bite-size pieces. Can be served with picante sauce.

name: RUM CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
1 (18 1/2 oz.)  pkg. yellow cake mix
1 (3 3/4 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding and pie filling
4  eggs
1/2  c. cold water
1/2  c. Wesson oil
1/2  c. dark rum
preparation: Grease and flour tube or Bundt pan.  Sprinkle nuts over bottom of pan.  Mix all cake ingredients together. Pour batter over nuts. Bake 1 hour at 325°.  Cool.  Invert on serving plate.  Prick top. Spoon and brush glaze evenly over top and sides.  Allow cake to absorb glaze.  Repeat until glaze is used up.

name: COCOA FROSTING
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  Tbsp. unsweetened cocoa
1/4  c. milk
3 1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine  butter,  cocoa  and  milk  in  large saucepan. Bring to  a boil over medium heat.  Remove from heat.  Stir in powdered sugar and vanilla; beat until smooth.

name: HARDEE'S BISCUITS
ingredients:
4  c. self-rising flour
2/3  c. shortening
2  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. sugar
2  c. buttermilk
1  stick butter or margarine
preparation: Mix biscuits as usual.  Place butter in bread pan, place in oven to melt.  Remove pan from oven and leave 1/2 of butter in pan.  Use remaining butter to spoon on top of biscuit.  Bake at 375° until golden brown on top and bottom.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CANDY
ingredients:
4  c. white sugar
1  can Milnot
4  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. white syrup
1 (18 oz.)  jar peanut butter
1  jar marshmallow cream
preparation: Stir first 4 ingredients and boil over low heat until it forms a medium-hard ball in water.  Add peanut butter and marshmallow cream.  Beat until thick and pour in buttered pan.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1/3  c. chopped onion
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3 or 4  oz. chipped beef, chopped
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix together; roll in shredded Cheddar cheese.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. melted shortening
1  egg
3  large bananas, mashed
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  c. sour milk
2  c. flour
1/2  c. nutmeats
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening. Add egg, salt and mashed bananas. Beat for 2 minutes. Add soda to sour milk. Add to first mixture and beat. Add flour and nuts. Pour into a greased loaf pan and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1 (18.25 oz.)  box Butter Recipe yellow cake mix
1/2  c. oil
1  c. chopped pecans
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. peanut butter chips
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine cake mix, eggs and oil. Add other ingredients. Spray cookie sheets with a nonstick spray. Roll cookie dough into balls about the size of a large marble. Arrange on cookie sheet, allowing space for dough to spread. Bake in a 350° oven 10 to 12 minutes until lightly browned. Yield: 3 1/2 to 4 dozen crisp cookies.

name: FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
5  eggs, well beaten
1/4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. honey
bread slices
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except bread, well.  Heat nonstick skillet on stove.  Melt about 1 tablespoon of butter in skillet on medium heat.  Quickly "dunk" bread slices into egg mixture, then put in skillet.  Cook until lightly browned, turn, cook until lightly brown.  Remove from skillet; spread with butter and top with syrup.  For an added treat, top with your favorite jelly.

name: MICROWAVE HOT POTATO SALAD(German)
ingredients:
4  slices bacon, diced
1  small onion, finely chopped
2  tsp. flour
1/3  c. cider vinegar
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. celery seed
4  medium potatoes, baked, peeled and sliced
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine  bacon and onion in 8-inch round dish.	Cook at High 3  to  5  minutes;	stir  occasionally.  Stir  in flour, vinegar, sugar,  celery seed, salt and pepper.  Add potatoes. Cook at High 4 to 5 minutes; stir.  Serve warm.

name: PLUM CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. ground cloves
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
3/4  c. cooking oil
3  eggs
2 small  jars plum baby food (strained)
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix together the first 4 ingredients.  Add the oil, eggs and baby food.  Mix well, but do not use a mixer.  Add the chopped nuts.  Bake in a greased and floured tube or Bundt pan at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: SOUR CREAM NOODLE-BAKE
ingredients:
8  oz. pkg. narrow noodles
1  lb. ground beef
1  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
8  oz. can tomato sauce
1  c. cream-style cottage cheese
8  oz. sour cream
1  c. chopped green onions
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook noodles according to package directions; drain.  Saute beef in butter.  Add salt, pepper, garlic salt and tomato sauce to meat.  Simmer over low heat 5 minutes.

name: EGGNOG CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 1/4 oz.)  pkg. regular vanilla pudding mix
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon jello
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry jello
1 (16 oz.)  can whole cranberry sauce
1/2  c. finely chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped pecans
1  envelope dessert topping mix
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
preparation: In saucepan, combine pudding mix, lemon jello and 2 cups water. Cook and stir until mixture boils.  Stir in lemon juice; chill until partially set.  Dissolve raspberry jello in 1 cup boiling water.  Cook and stir until dissolved.  Beat in cranberry sauce. Fold in celery and nuts.  Chill until partially set.  Prepare dessert topping according to package directions, adding nutmeg; fold into pudding mixture.

name: MUSHROOM DIP(Hot)
ingredients:
1  lb. mushrooms
1  Tbsp. fresh chives or onion
3  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. sour cream
1/2  lb. sharp cheese, grated
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Slice mushrooms and fry in margarine 10 minutes with onion. Add flour and sour cream (thicken).  Add cheese and seasoning. Put in casserole dish.

name: MOTHER GOOSE POPCORN
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. vanilla
12  c. popped corn
preparation: Bring ingredients (except popcorn) to a full boil.  Add several drops of food coloring of your choice and vanilla.  Pour over popped corn.  Serves 12.

name: REUBEN FONDUE
ingredients:
3  oz. cream cheese
16  oz. sauerkraut
1/4  c. bread crumbs
oil
1  small onion, minced
12  oz. corned beef
flour, heavy cream and bread crumbs
preparation: Drain sauerkraut thoroughly and chop.  Mix cream cheese, onion, corned beef, sauerkraut and 1/4 cup bread crumbs.  Roll into one-inch balls.  Dip each ball into flour, then cream; roll in bread crumbs.  Heat oil (about 2-inches deep) in fondue pot and cook balls until golden brown.

name: LEMON CUSTARD CAKE
ingredients:
1  prepared angel food cake (10-inches)
1  pkg. (3.4 oz.) instant lemon pudding mix
1 1/2  c. cold milk
1  c. (8 oz.) sour cream
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry or strawberry pie filling
preparation: Tear the angel food cake into bite-size pieces.  Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  In a mixing bowl, combine the pudding mix, milk and sour cream.  Beat until thickened, about 2 minutes.  Spread over cake.  Spoon pie filling on top.  Chill until serving time. Yields 12 servings.

name: FUDGE
ingredients:
1  lb. Domino confectioners sugar
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3  Tbsp. unsweetened cocoa
1/4  c. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. chopped pecans (optional)
preparation: Mix sugar and cocoa in a bowl.  In a boiler, melt butter over low heat.  Add sugar/cocoa mixture to melted butter.  Stir good. Add milk and vanilla.  Stir until smooth.  Add pecans.  Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper or pour into a 9 x 5 buttered Pyrex dish. Cool and cut into squares.  Makes 24 pieces.

name: RENEE'S HOMEMADE TARTAR SAUCE
ingredients:
3  large sweet pickles, diced
2  Tbsp. pickle juice
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  small onion, diced
preparation: Dice pickles and onion as fine as possible.  Add juice and mayonnaise.  Serve.

name: PEACH COOLER
ingredients:
2  ripe peaches
2  c. pineapple sherbet
1/4  c. lime juice
powdered sugar to taste
7-Up or ginger ale
preparation: Blend all ingredients, except 7-Up, until smooth.  Fill glasses 1/2 full with blended mixture.  Fill glasses with 7-Up and stir gently.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines butter golden cake mix
4  eggs
8  oz. sour cream
1/3  c. cooking oil
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla/butter nut flavoring
preparation: Mix all  ingredients  on  high	speed  for two minutes. Pour into tube  or  Bundt  pan.	Bake  at 375° for 45 minutes. Check with toothpick.  If  needed,  cook	for  5 to 10 minutes longer.

name: CRAB APPETIZER
ingredients:
1  jar Old English spread (cheese)
1  can crab meat
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
dill or other seasoning
12  English muffins
preparation: Mix in small mixer bowl.  Spread on 12 English muffin halves. Quarter.  Broil about 5 minutes until browned.  If not wanting to use right away, freeze on flat pan.  Store in freezer bags.

name: SHOE PEG SALAD
ingredients:
1  can French-style beans, drained
1  can Le Sueur peas, drained
1  can Shoe Peg corn, drained
1 small  jar pimentos
1  green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. celery, diced
2  or 3 green onions, diced
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.

name: JARED'S DIP
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
8  oz. taco sauce
2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  can Hormel chili (no beans)
preparation: Heat together in crock-pot.  Serve with chips.

name: SOUR CREAM MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  stick butter
2  c. Bisquick
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix together well.  Cook in well-buttered muffin tins half full.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  whole fryer chicken, cooked and deboned (save broth)
1  c. chopped onions
1  c. bell peppers, chopped
1/4  c. margarine
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. chicken broth
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  jalapeno pepper, chopped (optional)
preparation: Melt margarine in saucepan and saute onions and peppers until tender.  Add soups and broth and  jalapeno	pepper,  if desired. Add chopped chicken.  In a 9 x  13-inch  pan, spread 1/2 bag Doritos.  Spread half chicken and soup  mixture on top of chips. Top with 1 cup of cheese.  Repeat  layers.	Bake at 425° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH PIE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
3  Tbsp. flour
2  egg yolks
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. evaporated milk
1  c. water
preparation: Beat brown sugar, butter, flour and egg yolks.  Add liquid; cook in double boiler until proper consistency.

name: PINWHEEL COOKIES
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. ground dates
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
1  c. ground walnuts
1  c. butter
2  c. brown sugar
3  eggs
4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Cook dates, sugar and water for 10 minutes.  Add walnuts; set aside.  Mix remaining ingredients.  Chill.  Divide into 4 parts. Roll; spread filling and roll up.  Freeze for easier cutting. Bake at 325° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: EASY PECAN "STICKY" BUNS
ingredients:
1/2  c. maple or maple flavored syrup
1/4  c. margarine
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/3 to 1/2  c. chopped pecans
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. refrigerated crescent rolls
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In small pan, combine syrup, margarine and cinnamon.  Bring to a boil and simmer for two minutes.  Pour into a 9-inch round or square pan.  Sprinkle with nuts.  Open crescent roll packages; do not unroll dough.  Cut each package into 8 pieces.  Place in rows in pan (flat like regular cinnamon rolls). Sprinkle lightly with cinnamon.  Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown.  Let stand 5 minutes; invert on serving plate.  Serve warm.

name: NO FAIL FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
dash of salt
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. peanut butter
preparation: Boil sugar, milk and salt in saucepan for 10 minutes.  Add butter.  Continue to boil until  mixture forms soft ball in cold water.  Remove from heat.  Add vanilla.   Beat until mixture starts to set.  Pour quickly into buttered pan.

name: SUGAR CREAM PIE #1
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
2  c. whipping cream
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
ground nutmeg
1  (9-inch) pie crust
preparation: Mix all ingredients (except nutmeg) thoroughly until smooth. Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Sprinkle top generously with nutmeg. Bake for 15 minutes at 450°, then reduce to 350° for 30 more minutes.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 small  bottle cocktail sauce
1 small  can tiny shrimp
1/4  c. milk
3  Tbsp. Miracle Whip
preparation: Cream the cream cheese, Miracle Whip and milk.  Spread on dinner size plate about 1/4 inch thick.  Spread 2/3 bottle cocktail sauce on top.  Sprinkle shrimp on top of that.  Dip into with your favorite kind of crackers.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  Stick Butter or Margarine - Melted
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm Dressing
1  Can Cream of Celery Soup
1  Can Cream of Chicken Soup
2  Cups of Cooked Chicken - Cut in Cubes
1/2 to 2/3  Cup Milk
preparation: Add butter to dressing.  Mix well.  Place 1/2 of dressing mixture in 10 inch casserole dish.  Press down.  Combine soup & milk.  Heat thoroughly in a sauce pan.

name: FROZEN FRUIT POPS
ingredients:
3  large ripe bananas, peeled and cut up
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen tangerine juice or orange juice concentrate, thawed
1  c. water
preparation: In a blender container combine the bananas, juice concentrate and water.  Cover and blend until smooth.  Pour mixture into 10 (3 ounce) paper cups or frozen pop molds.  Cover with aluminum foil and freeze one hour; insert stick into each cup through foil. Return to freezer for 3 to 5 hours, until firm, or overnight.  To serve, tear off paper or remove from mold.  Makes 10 pops.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
5 or 6  qt. popcorn
2  c. brown sugar
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Boil sugar, margarine and syrup slowly for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and add vanilla, salt and baking soda.  Pour over popcorn and stir well.  Put in very large pan and bake for 40 minutes at 250°.  Stir every 10 or 15 minutes.  Let cool and store in airtight container.

name: MOCK ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  can hominy
1  can chili
1  onion, chopped
2  c. grated Co-Jack cheese
preparation: Layer ingredients in 2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake in a 350° oven until bubbly. Serves 4.  (May also be microwaved.)

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  c. 7-Up
1 small  box strawberry jello
2  pie shells
3  c. strawberries
preparation: Mix sugar and cornstarch together.  Add 7-Up.  Cook until it comes to a boil.  Cook on low until clear.  Keep stirring; add jello.  Pour over strawberries that have been placed in the pie shells.  Top with Cool Whip and chill.  Makes two pies.

name: MARVELOUS MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef
3/4  c. tomato juice
3/4  c. uncooked oatmeal
1  egg, beaten
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  medium size shredded carrot
3  chopped mushrooms (optional)
1/2  bell pepper, chopped (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients; add ground beef last.     Mix well. Press into 10 x 10-inch casserole dish.   Cover; bake 1 hour at 350°; uncover last 10 minutes.

name: OVEN CARAMEL POPCORN
ingredients:
15  c. popped popcorn
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. oleo
1/4  c. light corn syrup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Heat oven to 200°.  Divide popcorn between 2 ungreased 13 x 9-inch pans.  Heat sugar, corn syrup, oleo and salt to simmering over medium-high heat.  Stir constantly, then cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat.  Stir in soda.  Pour over popcorn; coat it well.  Bake at 200° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

name: GRATED POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. milk
3  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. cubed Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  seeded green pepper, cut up
1  small onion, quartered
4  medium potatoes, pared and quartered
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease a 2-quart casserole.  Put all ingredients in blender container in order listed.  Cover and run on high speed just until all potatoes go through the blades.  (Do not overblend.)  Pour into casserole and bake for 1 hour.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburg
2  c. onion
1 large  can red kidney beans
1 small  can pinto beans
1 large  can tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. oregano
3  c. celery
1  large green pepper
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Brown hamburg, onion, celery and green pepper for 10 minutes in a large kettle.  Add the rest of ingredients and simmer for 2 hours.

name: PEACH PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. butter
12  peach halves
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  egg yolks
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Combine the first 4 ingredients.  Cut the butter in with pastry blender until crumbs form.  Press into a 10-inch pie plate. Arrange peach halves over crumb crust.  Combine 3/4 cup sugar with the cinnamon; sprinkle over peaches.  Bake for 15 minutes at 400°. Beat egg yolks and sour cream; pour over peaches.  Bake 30 minutes longer.

name: GRANNY'S FROZEN DESSERT
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. water
juice of 3 lemons
juice of 3 oranges
3  bananas, mashed (good)
1 small  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Dissolve sugar and water over heat.  Pour water and sugar over fruit mixture.  Add crushed pineapple.  Put in deep refrigerator tray and freeze.

name: WHOLE WHEAT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  c. warm water
2  packets (1/4 oz. each) active dry yeast
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. salt
1  c. whole wheat flour
2  c. white flour
preparation: In 2-quart bowl, combine water, yeast, oil and salt.  Stir. Add flour (whole wheat first), one cup at a time, until it forms a ball that can be kneaded.  Knead for 2 minutes.  Return dough to bowl and coat with small amount of oil.  Cover with cloth and let stand to rise in a warm place until doubled in size (20 to 30 minutes).  Spread into 12 x 18-inch oiled cookie sheet.  Top with tomato sauce and favorite toppings.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: KRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can chopped kraut
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
1 small  jar pimentos
1  grated carrot
1/4  c. oil
1/4  c. vinegar
3/4  c. sugar or less (try 1/2 c. sugar first, add more if not sweet enough)
1  medium onion
preparation: Wash and drain kraut in colander.  Mix other ingredients, then add oil and sugar.  Marinate overnight before eating.  Will keep a month in refrigerator.

name: CREAMY DOUBLE DECKER FUDGE
ingredients:
1  c. Reese's peanut butter chips
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. (6 oz.) Hershey's semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: In 2-cup glass measure, with handle, combine peanut butter chips and 2/3 cup sweetened condensed milk; cook on 100% power (High) for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, stirring after 1 minute, until chips are melted and mixture is smooth.  Stir in 1/2 teaspoon vanilla.  Spread evenly into foil-lined 8-inch square pan.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can lima beans
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can English peas
1  can green beans
1  can mushroom soup
1  pkg. grated cheese
1  can Durkee onions
preparation: Mix all together in casserole dish.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 15 minutes, then covered for 30 minutes.

name: ONE STEP LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. water
1  (15 oz.) container Ricotta cheese
2  (15 1/2 oz.) spaghetti sauce
1 (16 oz.)  box lasagna noodles
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese, thinly sliced
preparation: Combine water with sauce.  Cover bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish with 1 1/2 cups sauce.  Arrange layer of uncooked noodles on top of sauce.  Spread half Ricotta and half of Mozzarella cheese over noodles.  Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese.  Add another layer of sauce.  Repeat with a layer of noodles remaining Ricotta and Mozzarella and 2 tablespoons Parmesan.  Top with a layer of noodles.  Pour remaining sauce over, spread evenly to cover edges of noodles.  Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of Parmesan.  Cover tightly with heavy-duty foil.  Bake in a preheated oven for 1 hour until knife passes easily through pasta.  Let it stand covered on rack for 10 minutes.

name: JEWISH COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
2 small  pkg. instant pudding (French vanilla)
5  eggs
1  c. water
3/4  c. Crisco oil
2  Tbsp. vanilla
3/4  c. sugar
2 to 3  Tbsp. cinnamon
crushed pecans
preparation: Mix sugar, cinnamon and pecans together.  Grease and flour a tube pan.  Mix first 6 ingredients and pour 1/3 of batter in pan. Sprinkle sugar mixture (1/3) over batter.  Repeat 2 more times. Bake 60 to 65 minutes in a 300° to 325° oven.  Cool.  Remove from pan.

name: BIG HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  bag egg noodles, cooked
1  onion, chopped
1  can cream of tomato soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Put in 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour or more.

name: TURNIP RELISH
ingredients:
5  c. shredded turnips
2  c. chopped onion
4  tsp. salt
4  c. sugar
3  c. white vinegar
3/4  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. yellow food coloring
preparation: Combine turnips, onion and salt; let stand 1 hour, then drain. Combine sugar, vinegar, paprika and food coloring; bring to boil. Add turnip mixture; simmer for 1 minute.  Fill jars to 1/2-inch from top.  Seal and cook 5 minutes in open cooker.

name: PORK CHOPS 'N KRAUT
ingredients:
1 large  jar sauerkraut, drained
2  lb. pork chops, trimmed
1  c. chopped onions
1/4  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: In 13 x 9-inch pan, place drained sauerkraut.  Layer onion and brown sugar on top.  Place chops on top and sprinkle soy sauce over.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 3 to 4 hours.

name: BREAKFAST SCHNITZEL
ingredients:
breakfast pork chops
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. milk
1  egg, well beaten
1  c. crushed crackers
1/2  tsp. salt
shortening for frying
preparation: Coat pork chops with flour.  Dip in milk, then egg.  Coat with cracker crumbs.  Sprinkle with salt.  Fry in 1/2-inch deep shortening in skillet for 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until tender.

name: BROILED PEAR SALAD
ingredients:
2  pears, halved and cored
3  tsp. honey
1/2  c. part-skim Ricotta
2  doz. strawberries, cleaned and sliced
mint leaves (optional)
preparation: Heat broiler.  Brush each half pear with 1/2 teaspoon honey. Broil 2 minutes or until slightly soft.  Combine butter with remaining honey.  Spoon onto pear halves.  Arrange strawberry slices on top.  Garnish with mint leaves, if desired.  Makes 4 servings.

name: VEGETABLE BURGER SOUP
ingredients:
3/4  lb. ground beef
1  (1 lb. can, 2 c.) tomatoes, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  c. water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
1/2  pkg. Lipton dry onion soup mix
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  c. celery, diced
preparation: Stir soup mix in package before measuring.  Lightly brown ground beef, drain off excess fat.  Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, frozen vegetables, celery, onion soup mix and sugar. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: MAGIC FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
2/3  c. candied red cherries
1  c. nuts
1  lb. dates
1/2  lb. shredded coconut
preparation: Save a few nuts and cherries to decorate cake.

name: PEACHES AND CREAM COBBLER
ingredients:
3/4  c. self-rising flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (3 1/8 oz.)  pkg. vanilla pudding (not instant)
1  egg
3/4  c. milk
vegetable spray
1 (29 oz.)  can sliced peaches, drained (save juice)
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
6  Tbsp. peach juice
1  c. sugar
preparation: Combine the first 5 ingredients and mix.  Pour batter into 9-inch square baking pan coated with vegetable spray.  Put peaches over batter.  In another bowl, add cream cheese, peach juice and sugar; mix well.  Spoon mixture over peaches; cover peaches completely.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: BAKED CHILI RELLENOS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
8  oz. seeded green chillies, canned, split lengthwise, peeled
1-1/2  c. grated cheddar cheese
1-1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
4  beaten eggs
preparation: Brown meat and onion; drain well.  Add salt and pepper.  Put half chilies in a 6x10 baking dish.  Sprinkle with cheese, add meat mixture.  Add remainder of chilies and cheese.  Combine milk, flour, salt and eggs.  Pour batter on chili meat mixture.  Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until inserted knife comes out clean.  Cut into squares.

name: NOT-SO-SINFUL BROWNIES
ingredients:
nonstick cooking spray
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
3  sq. (3 oz.) unsweetened chocolate
1 1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. unsweetened applesauce
4  egg whites or 2 eggs, lightly beaten
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. quick or old fashioned oats (uncooked)
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt (optional)
1/4  c. confectioners sugar (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. With nonstick cooking spray, coat bottom only of a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Set aside. In large saucepan over low heat, combine oil and chocolate. Heat, stirring frequently about 2 minutes until chocolate is melted. Remove from heat; cool slightly. Add sugar and applesauce to chocolate mixture; mix well. Stir in egg whites and vanilla; blend well. In medium bowl, combine oats, flour, baking powder and salt; add to chocolate mixture, stirring until just combined. Scrape batter into prepared pan. Bake 22 to 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out almost clean (do not overbake). Cool completely in pan on wire rack. Remove from pan and cut into bars. Store in tightly covered container for up to 1 week. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar just before serving.

name: MYSTERY SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. lemon-lime gelatin
1 large  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese, softened
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 small  jar maraschino cherries
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. cream
1/2  c. broken pecans
preparation: Mix gelatin according to directions and let set until thickened a little.  Mix mayonnaise, cream and cream cheese.  Add to gelatin with pineapple, cherries and pecans.  Pour into mold or serving dish.  Chill.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER PRALINES
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1  stick butter
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  pkg. sliced almonds
honey graham crackers
preparation: Slightly grease cookie sheet.  Melt butter and oleo.  Add sugar; boil 2 minutes.  Pour immediately over graham crackers. Top with almonds; bake for 12 minutes at 350°.  Remove from pan at once.

name: SPANAKOPITA
ingredients:
1lb. pastry sheets (filo)
8  to 9 eggs
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. salt and pepper
1  medium onion
spinach (optional)
2  c. feta or 1 1/2 c. cottage cheese and 1 1/2 c. feta
preparation: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan with butter.  Line pan with 4 to 5 filo including sides.  Brush melted butter lightly over layer. Beat eggs until slightly fluffy.  Dice cheese into very small pieces and mix into eggs.  Also, mix in salt and oil.  Brown finely chopped onion and mix into cheese, eggs and spinach.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
4  pkg. refrigerator biscuits, cut into 4 pieces for each biscuit
1  c. sugar
cinnamon to taste
1  stick butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Mix cut-up biscuits with sugar and cinnamon to coat biscuit pieces.  Grease a Bundt pan and layer the biscuit pieces randomly. Melt butter and add brown sugar.  Pour over biscuits in Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Remove from oven and remove bread from pan as soon as possible.

name: EGGPLANT PARMESAN
ingredients:
1  or 2 small eggplant
1/2  lb. hamburger
1/2  lb. sausage
2  medium onions
1  rib of celery
1  can stewed tomatoes
Cheddar, Mozzarella or Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Peel, cube, steam eggplant until tender.  Saute hamburger, sausage, onion (chopped) and celery sliced thinly.  Mix together in casserole with stewed tomatoes.  Top with lots of Cheddar, Mozzarella or Monterey Jack cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. ketchup
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine ingredients in a 1 pint screw-top jar and shake until blended.  Refrigerate unused portion.

name: PRIDE OF INDIANA COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. butter or Crisco
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1  c. coconut
3  c. oats
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together sugars and butter.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Mix in flour, baking powder, soda and salt.  Next mix in coconut and oats.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: ORANGE TAPIOCA PUDDING
ingredients:
1 large  can pineapple chunks or tidbits, drained well
1 small  can mandarin oranges, drained well
1  small tapioca pudding (not instant)
1  small vanilla pudding (not instant)
1  small orange Jell-O
1/2  c. orange juice
2 1/2  c. water
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix puddings, Jell-O, orange juice and water.  Cook, stirring constantly, until thick.  Cool completely.  Then add Cool Whip and fruit.

name: FIVE HOUR STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. stew meat (do not brown)
3  or 4 cut-up potatoes
carrots, cut up (about 6)
1  raw onion, sliced
1  pkg. onion soup mix
4  c. water
3  Tbsp. tapioca
preparation: Mix all together in Dutch oven and bake 5 hours at 300°.  Stir occasionally.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
3  lb. ground meat
1  head of lettuce, chopped or sliced
1  tomato
1  (17 oz.) bag tortilla chips
1  (16 oz.) cheese (any type), shredded
sour cream
1  taco seasoning pkg.
taco sauce (mild, medium or hot)
preparation: Brown meat; mix in large bowl or do separately on plates. Makes 10 medium plates.

name: CHEESY HASH BROWNS 'N HAM
ingredients:
12  tsp. oleo, softened
6  (3 oz.) frozen hash brown patties
6  oz. thinly sliced cooked ham
3/4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley (optional)
preparation: Spread 1 teaspoon oleo on each side of hash browns.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Broil 4 to 6 inches from heat for 11 to 13 minutes or until golden brown.  Turn patties over; broil 4 to 6 minutes more.  Place ham slice on each patty.  Broil 1 to 2 minutes or until hot.  Sprinkle with cheese and parsley.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SOUTHERN PRALINES
ingredients:
2  c. granulated sugar
3/4  tsp. soda
1  c. light cream
1 1/2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. pecan halves
preparation: Combine sugar and soda in 3-quart saucepan; mix well. Stir in cream. Bring to boiling over medium heat, stirring constantly. Cook and stir to soft-ball stage (234°). (Mixture caramelizes slightly as it cooks.) Remove from heat; add butter. Stir in pecans; beat until thick enough to drop from spoon (takes only 2 or 3 minutes). Drop from tablespoon on waxed paper. If candy becomes too stiff to drop, add a tablespoon of hot water. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

name: JIFFY STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. confectioners sugar
1  large Cool Whip
1  qt. fresh strawberries
1  pkg. strawberry glaze
preparation: Take 1/2 of cake and tear into small pieces.  Put into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix cream cheese, confectioners sugar and Cool Whip together until smooth.  Spread over cake.  Tear other 1/2 of cake into small pieces and put over cream cheese mixture.  Slice strawberries and mix with glaze.  Spread over cake.

name: 8 MINUTE CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
8  oz. Cool Whip
1/2  c. sugar
8  oz. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
crust of choice
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients with mixer on medium until very fluffy.  Stir in vanilla.  Spoon into crust.  Chill for 30 minutes.  Serve.

name: NACHO DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
green chilies to taste
1 to 2  Tbsp. diced jalapeno peppers
preparation: Melt cheese and cream  cheese  over  low heat.	Stir in remaining ingredients.  Heat thoroughly.

name: CHEESEBURGER 'N' FRIES CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lbs. lean ground beef
1  can (10  3/4 oz.) condensed golden mushroom soup undiluted
1  can (10  3/4 oz.) condensed cheddar cheese soup, undiluted
1  pkg. (20 oz.) frozen crinkle cut French fries
preparation: In a skillet, brown the beef; drain.  Stir in soups.  Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish.  Arrange French fries on top.  Bake, uncovered, at 350 degrees for 50-55 minutes or until the fries are golden brown.

name: VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower
1/2  c. chopped onions (sweet)
1  cucumber, chopped in chunks
1  small squash, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
1  bunch broccoli
1/2  c. bacon bits
1  large tomato, chunked
1  c. low-fat dressing (Ranch)
1  large carrot, chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Chill well before serving.

name: LEMON RICE AND BROCCOLI
ingredients:
2  c. chicken broth
1  c. rice
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. melted butter
1  pkg. frozen broccoli (10 oz.)
preparation: In a 2-quart baking dish, mix all but broccoli.  Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes, until tender.  Cook broccoli; drain well. Put rice in a bowl.  Make a well and put broccoli in center, then serve.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
4  c. pared, cored and sliced apples
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. flour
1/3  c. softened butter
preparation: Place apples in buttered 10 x 6 x 2-inch pan.  Add water, salt and cinnamon; set aside.  Mix together sugar, flour and butter until crumbly.  Spread mixture over apples.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Serve warm or cold.  Makes 6 servings.

name: BROCCOLI BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jiffy corn bread mix
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  c. grated mild Cheddar cheese
1  c. cottage cheese
1  chopped onion
1  stick margarine
4  eggs
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°. Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix all together and pour half of butter into mix.  Mix together well and pour into pan.  Bake 30 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. margarine
3  drops onion juice
2  dashes garlic powder
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Beat first 5 ingredients;  form into a ball and roll in nuts. Chill.

name: MEXICAN RICE
ingredients:
2/3  c. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. bacon fat
1  c. raw converted white rice
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  tsp. chili powder
1 (8 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
2  tsp. salt
chopped fresh tomato (optional)
chopped green pepper (optional)
2  c. water
preparation: In medium size heavy skillet with tight fitting cover, saute onion in hot bacon fat.  Stir in rice, 1 cup green pepper, chili powder, canned tomatoes and salt.  Add 2 cups water; bring to boiling, then reduce heat.  Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed and rice is cooked.  Garnish with chopped tomato and green pepper.  Makes 6 servings.

name: TOMATO JUICE COCKTAIL
ingredients:
1 (46 oz.)  can tomato juice
6  oz. can orange juice
juice of 2 lemons
juice of 1 lime
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Blend and refrigerate.  Serve in frosted glasses.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
5  c. carrots
1  small bell pepper, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can tomato soup
3/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Cook carrots until barely tender; drain and cool. (I sometimes use canned carrots.)  Mix seasonings, soup, onion and bell pepper. Pour over carrots.  Place in covered bowl and refrigerate 12 hours before serving.  Keeps well for at least a week.

name: ESCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
8  medium potatoes, boiled with skin on
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  c. coffee cream
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Peel and shred potatoes in buttered dish.  Grate Cheddar cheese and combine with mustard, coffee cream, salt, milk and nutmeg. Heat.  Pour over potatoes and stir lightly; chill overnight.  Bake, uncovered at 325° for 1 hour.

name: ORANGE JUICE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow butter cake mix
1 small  pkg. vanilla pudding
1  c. orange juice
1/2  c. oil
4  eggs
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Grease and flour Bundt pan.  Pour nuts evenly in bottom.  Mix remaining ingredients and pour over nuts in pan.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: MELTING MOMENTS COOKIES(This Recipe is 51 Years Old)
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened (2 sticks)
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
2/3  c. cornstarch
1  c. flour
1/4  c. butter (1/2 stick)
1  lb. confectioners sugar (I find this too much)
juice and rind of 1/2 lemon
preparation: Cream 1 cup butter and 1/2 cup confectioners sugar.  Add cornstarch and flour.  Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased baking sheets.  Bake at 325° for 10 minutes.  Do not brown.   Combine rest of ingredients and frost when cool.

name: BREAKFAST PIZZA
ingredients:
2  pkg. crescent rolls
1  pkg. breakfast sausage, cooked
1/2  pkg. frozen hash browns
5 eggs, beaten with 1/4  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
grated cheese
preparation: Spread crescent rolls in pizza pan.  Spread cooked sausage on crust.  Spread hash browns on crust.  Pour eggs-milk over crust. Salt and pepper to taste.  Cover full pizza with grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Sprinkle 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese on top after baking.

name: HOMEMADE VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  chicken bouillon cube
1  beef bouillon cube
1  medium onion
1  qt. tomatoes
1/4  head cabbage
1/2  pt. can corn
1/2  pt. English peas
1  bell pepper
1  c. okra
1  lb. stew beef, cooked
4  medium carrots
4  medium diced potatoes
2  stalks celery
preparation: In a large Dutch oven add the bouillon cubes, carrots, onions, tomatoes, cabbage, corn, peas, bell pepper, okra, potatoes, celery and cooked stew beef. Add 2 cups water.  Bring to a boil.  If more water is desired, add.  Reduce heat to simmer and add 1 teaspoon black pepper, pinch of oregano, salt, garlic to taste, 1 bay leaf and a teaspoon of chili powder.  Cook until carrots and potatoes are done.   Serves 8.

name: MEATBALLS AND RICESocorro, New Mexico
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, diced
1  c. cooked rice
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. oil
1  can Cream of Mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
preparation: Combine meat, onion, rice and salt.  Form into 2-inch balls. Brown in hot oil.  Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.  Pour mushroom soup diluted with milk over meatballs.  Simmer for 5 minutes. Serve with potatoes or over cooked rice.

name: HOLY BIBLE CAKE
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. 1 Kings 4:22 (fine flour)
1  c. Judges 5:25 (butter)
2  c. chopped 1 Samuel 30:12 (raisins)
2  c. Jeremiah 6:20 (sugar)
2  c. chopped Nahum 3:12 (figs)
2  c. Numbers 17:8 (almonds)
2  Tbsp. 1 Samuel 14:25 (honey)
1 level  tsp. Leviticus 2:13 (salt)
6  Jeremiah 17:11 (eggs)
1/2  c. Judges 4:19 (sweet milk)
2  tsp. 2 Chronicles 9:9 (spices)
2  tsp. Amos 4:5 (leaven baking powder)
preparation: Bake slowly and this cake will keep indefinitely in a covered jar.

name: BLUEBERRY BUCKLE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  stick butter
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. blueberries
preparation: Mix sugar, butter, egg and milk with beater.  Stir in flour, baking soda and salt.  Fold in blueberries.  Pour into greased and floured 9-inch square pan.

name: LEAVENWORTH LEMON BUNDT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon cake mix
1  pkg. instant lemon pudding mix
1  c. water
1/3  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs
1  lemon
powdered sugar
preparation: Grease and flour Bundt pan.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Beat cake mix, pudding mix, 1 cup water, eggs and grated rind of lemon for 3 minutes.  Pour into pan and bake 45 to 55 minutes.

name: FRUIT BARS
ingredients:
2  c. nuts
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs
1  c. flour (self-rising)
1  c. candied cherries
1  c. candied pineapple
preparation: Spread nuts on greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream sugar and butter; add eggs and flour. Mix well and spread over nuts. Cover with candied pineapple and cherries, cut in pieces. Bake for 1 hour at 275°. Cut in bars.

name: RASPBERRY PIE OR STRAWBERRY
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 small  pkg. raspberry jello
1  qt. raspberries (strawberries)
preparation: Boil sugar, cornstarch and water until thickened and clear; add jello and few drops food coloring.  Let cool; add berries and pour into baked crust.

name: BLUEBERRY YUM-YUM
ingredients:
2  c. blueberries
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. water
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. margarine, softened
1  c. finely chopped nuts
1  pkg. softened cream cheese (8 oz. pkg.)
1  pkg. whipped topping (9 oz. pkg.)
preparation: Combine blueberries, 1 cup of sugar and 1/4 cup water in saucepan and simmer on low heat until berries soften.   In a separate bowl, mix cornstarch and 3 tablespoons water.  Add cornstarch to blueberry mixture.  Mix together flour, margarine and pecans.  Press evenly in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Bake crust at 350°  for 20 minutes.  Allow to cool.

name: CONDENSED MILK
ingredients:
1  c. dry milk
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. boiling water
3  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Mix in blender or mixer at high speed until thick.  Let stand 24 hours in refrigerator.

name: POPPY SEED BREAD
ingredients:
4  eggs
3  c. sugar
1  c. oil
1 big  can evaporated milk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  Tbsp. poppy seed (use more if needed)
preparation: Beat eggs with mixer.  Add sugar, oil, milk and vanilla to eggs; mix well.  Mix flour, soda and poppy seed; add to prepared mixture.  Pour into floured and greased pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 60 minutes, or until done.  Use 2 loaf pans or 1 Bundt pan.

name: PIZZA MUFFINS
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. olive oil
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. diced Mozzarella cheese
1  tsp. oregano
2 3/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. diced pepperoni
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  c. tomato juice
1  egg, beaten
3/4  tsp. salt (optional)
preparation: In oil saute onion and garlic until soft.  In a bowl, mix sauteed mixture with egg and tomato juice.  In another bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt, oregano, Mozzarella cheese and pepperoni.  Quickly stir moist ingredients into dry ingredients until just moistened.  Spoon into oiled muffin cups.  Sprinkle tops with grated Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until done.  Serve hot from oven or reheat.

name: ORANGE TAFFY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. light corn syrup
1  6  oz. can frozen orange juice concentrate, undiluted
pinch salt
1  c. half and half cream
1/2  c. butter or margarine
preparation: In a saucepan, combine first four ingredients.  Cook and stir over medium heat until sugar is dissolved.  Bring to a rapid boil and cook until candy thermometer reads 245°.  Add cream and butter.  Stir until mixture reaches 245° again.  Pour into a greased pan and cool.  When cool enough to handle, roll into 1 1/2 inch logs or 1 inch balls.  Wrap individually in foil.  Twist ends.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
3  c. Bisquick
1  lb. mild sausage
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Mix with hands until crumbly.  Form into small balls.  Place on baking sheet.  Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.  Can be frozen before ready to bake.  Serves 5 to 6 dozen.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. blueberries
preparation: Combine flour and baking powder.  Add vanilla to milk.  Cream margarine and sugar; add eggs, then milk alternately with dry ingredients.  Fold in blueberries.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

name: EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
1  stick butter, melted
1  c. sugar
3 level  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour into unbaked pie shell (deep dish).  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until brown.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  whole chicken, cooked and shredded
vermicelli spaghetti (1/2 box)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  medium onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
Velveeta cheese (half loaf)
1 to 2  c. chicken broth
preparation: Cook chicken, chop or shred.  Cook spaghetti.  Heat rest of ingredients (soup, cheese, broth, onion and pepper).  Mix all together with chicken and spaghetti after cheese melts.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.

name: DIXIE'S APPLE DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  large apple
8  Pillsbury crescent rolls
1  c. orange juice
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  stick margarine
1  (5 to 6 lb.) beef brisket, trimmed (flat cut)
2  Tbsp. liquid smoke
1  tsp. celery salt
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. onion salt
lemon pepper seasoning
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
6  oz. barbecue sauce (Masterpiece hickory flavored or Shady Nook)
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. water
preparation: Place brisket on large piece of heavy-duty aluminum foil. Sprinkle with liquid smoke and salts.  Wrap in foil and refrigerate overnight or at least 5 hours.  When ready to bake, sprinkle with lemon pepper and Worcestershire sauce.  Reseal in foil.  Bake at 275° for 4 to 5 hours.  Uncover and pour barbecue sauce over meat. Cook with foil open for another 1/2 hour.  Remove to platter and let cool before slicing.  Remove fat and discard from remaining juice in dish.  Place in saucepan; add flour, water and additional barbecue sauce (to taste and to thicken).  Serve sauce with sliced meat.  I serve sliced brisket with sauce, mayonnaise and rolls (Kroger Country Oven) to be eaten as a sandwich.  Serve with large green salad, baked beans and dessert.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
8  c. sliced fresh peaches
2  c. sugar
2 to 4  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  tsp. almond or vanilla extract
pastry for double crust pie
1/3  c. butter
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients in Dutch oven.  Set aside until syrup forms.  Bring peach mixture to a boil; reduce heat to low, and cook 10 minutes or until tender.  Remove from heat; add extract and butter, stirring until butter melts.

name: CHERRY PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. cherry juice
1/2  c. water
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
pinch of salt
red food coloring
1  can cherries, drained
1  baked pie shell
3/4  c. grated American cheese whipped cream
preparation: Mix cherry juice, water, sugar and  cornstarch. salt and food coloring. Cook until thickened, stirring continually. Add cherries and heat through.

name: JEZEBEL
ingredients:
1  jar pineapple preserves
1  jar crabapple jelly
2  tsp. dry mustard
6  tsp. horseradish
preparation: Mix. Spoon over cream cheese and spread on crackers.

name: HOT REUBEN DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1 1/2  c. shredded Swiss cheese (6 oz.)
1/2  c. Thousand Island dressing
4  oz. deli sliced corned beef, chopped
1/2  c. drained sauerkraut
Pretzel crackers, if desired
Cocktail rye bread slices, if desired
preparation: Heat oven to 400°. Mix cream cheese, 1 c. of the Swiss cheese, the dressing and corned beef. Spread in pie plate, 9 x 1 1/4 inches, or quiche dish, 9 x 1 1/2 inches. Top with sauerkraut and remaining 1/2 c. Swiss cheese. Bake about 15 minutes or until bubbly around the edge. Serve hot with pretzel crackers or cocktail rye bread. This has 2 gm carbohydrates.

name: APRICOT GLAZED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken parts
1  pkg. chicken legs
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
1 medium size  jar apricot preserves
1  bottle creamy French dressing
preparation: Season chicken with Accent and let stand.  Empty apricot preserves in large mixing bowl; refill preserve jar with French dressing and add to preserves.  Empty 3/4 of the onion soup mix and mix thoroughly.  Dip the chicken parts in glaze mixture; arrange on baking dish.  Pour the remaining glaze mixture over the chicken.  Sprinkle the remaining onion soup mix over the chicken. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: PECAN BARS
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1  box light brown sugar
2  eggs
2  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. pecans
preparation: Melt margarine and add sugar and eggs.  Stir in flour and add nuts and vanilla.  Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: SHOE PEG CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can Shoe Peg corn
1  can green beans, drained
1  can celery soup
1  stick Ritz crackers
1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  small onion, diced
1  stick butter
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients  together.  Pour  into  a  9-inch square pan.  Top  with 1 stack crushed Ritz crackers.  Melt 1 stick butter and pour over top.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: DATE NUT PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. dates, chopped
1  c. flour
1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. white sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1 1/3  c. boiling water
preparation: Mix dates, flour, milk, 1 cup brown sugar and baking powder and place in 8-inch pan.  Mix white sugar and 1/4 cup packed brown sugar and sprinkle mixture evenly over top of dough. Dot with 2 tablespoons butter and nuts.  Over this pour the boiling water.  Bake at 375° until thick (30 minutes.)

name: BAKED CHICKEN AND PINEAPPLE
ingredients:
2  broiler-fryers, cut up (3 lb.)
2  tsp. dried rosemary leaves
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
10  green onions, chopped
2  c. unsweetened pineapple juice, drain canned pineapple and serve fruit with meat
1  tsp. ginger
paprika
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Wash and skin chicken.  Drain well on paper towels.  Combine rosemary, salt and pepper.  Rub into chicken pieces.  Arrange chicken, meaty side up, in a baking dish. Sprinkle with onion pieces.  Combine pineapple juice and ginger; pour over chicken.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake uncovered 55 to 60 minutes or until tender.

name: KIELBASA WITH SKILLET STEAMED CABBAGE
ingredients:
2  oz. bacon, diced
5  c. coarsely shredded cabbage
1 1/2  c. coarsely chopped apples
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. caraway seed
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. beer
6  c. water
1  lb. kielbasa sausage
preparation: Cook bacon about 5 minutes until crisp.  Pour off fat and add cabbage, apples, onion, caraway, salt and pepper to pot.  Pour beer over all and toss to mix.  Cover, reduce heat to low and cook 30 minutes, stirring once or twice.  Cabbage will be wilted but will still have color.

name: CHINESE CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. cooked chicken breasts, skinned and boned
1/2  c. water chestnuts, drained
1/2  c. bean sprouts
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped green onion
1  c. cooked brown or white rice
2  Tbsp. fat-free Italian dressing (Weight Watchers or Kraft)
1  tsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. fat-free Ranch dressing (Weight Watchers or Kraft)
1  Tbsp. Mock Sour Cream
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: In a large bowl, mix together the chicken, cut in cubes, water chestnuts, sprouts, celery and onion.

name: OLD FASHION POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
7  medium potatoes
4  eggs, boiled
1  c. onions, sliced
salt and pepper
vinegar
preparation: Peel and boil potatoes.  Cut potatoes in small pieces.  Saute onions in microwave for about 2 minutes.  Add to potatoes.  Cut eggs in small pieces over potatoes.  Add salt and pepper and sprinkle vinegar.  Mix well.

name: GOULASH
ingredients:
