1  c. small shell macaroni
boiling water
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onions
1 (2 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms (undrained)
1  c. sliced celery
1/2  c. ketchup
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can Hunt's stewed tomatoes
preparation: Place macaroni in a bowl and cover with boiling water.  Set aside while macaroni blanches.  Saute ground beef and onions together in a large saucepan until beef loses redness and onions are transparent.  Drain fat.  Drain macaroni and add to meat along with remaining ingredients and 1/2 cup water.  Mix thoroughly. Cover and simmer 40 to 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Makes 6 servings.

name: KRAUT
ingredients:
shredded cabbage
pickling or coarse salt
vinegar
sugar
preparation: To each quart of shredded cabbage, add 1 tablespoon pickling or coarse salt, 2 tablespoons vinegar and 1 tablespoon sugar. Fill jars with shredded cabbage.  Fill with hot water.  Put on cap loosely.  This will ferment in about 1 week.  When fermentation ceases, clean sealing edge of jar.  Screw band tight and process in boiling bath for 25 minutes.

name: SPICE FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. orange juice
1  c. pineapple juice
2  c. water
1/2  c. sugar
grated rind of 1 lemon
1  Tbsp. strained honey
6  whole cloves
1/2  tsp. grated nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3  pt. ginger ale
preparation: Combine orange juice, pineapple juice, water and sugar.  Add grated rind of lemon, honey, cloves, nutmeg and cinnamon.  Mix and let stand 3 hours.  Strain through cheesecloth and add the ginger ale.  Stir briskly and serve in glasses containing ice cubes.

name: TURKEY 'N STUFFING PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. water
1/4  c. butter or margarine
3 1/2  c. seasoned stuffing crumbs
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of celery soup
3/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. (7 oz.) cubed, cooked turkey
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, thawed and drained
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a medium saucepan, heat water and butter.  Stir until butter melts. Remove from heat.  Stir in seasoned stuffing crumbs and 1/2 can French fried onions. Spoon stuffing mixture into a 9-inch round or fluted baking dish.  Press stuffing evenly across bottom and up sides of dish to form a shell.  In a medium bowl, combine soup, milk, turkey and peas. Pour into stuffing shell. Bake, covered, for 30 minutes or until heated through. Top with remaining onions and bake, uncovered, 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: EASY RUM CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped walnuts
1 (18 1/2 oz.)  pkg. yellow cake mix
1 (3 3/4 oz.)  pkg. Jell-O vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
1/2  c. cold water
1/2  c. Wesson oil
1/2  c. dark rum (I prefer Meyers and Bacardi rums over others)
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Grease (Pam spray) and flour a 10-inch tube or 12-cup Bundt pan.  Sprinkle nuts over bottom of pan.  Mix all cake ingredients together.  Pour batter over nuts.  Bake for 1 hour.  Cool.  Invert on a serving plate.  Prick top.  Drizzle and smooth with Rum Glaze (follows) evenly over top and sides.  Allow cake to absorb glaze.  Repeat until the glaze is used up.

name: HAM AND BROCCOLI IN SAVORY SAUCE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli (chopped)
1/3  c. flour
1/4  c. butter, melted
1 1/2  c. milk
4  oz. (1 c.) sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
2  c. cooked ham, cubed
1/2  c. sour cream
3  c. hot cooked rice
preparation: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Drain. Separately blend flour and butter. Add milk and cheese.  Cook, stirring, until thickened. Add broccoli and ham.  Heat.  Blend in sour cream, but do not boil. Serve over rice.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1 1/4  c. flour
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix shortening, peanut butter, butter, sugar, brown sugar and egg.  Blend in flour, soda, baking powder and salt.  Cover and chill.

name: GRANDPAP'S FAVORITE GINGER COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. ginger
1/2  c. shortening (lard)
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. molasses
1/2  c. plus 1 Tbsp. warm water
preparation: Cream the shortening, sugar and molasses. Add dry ingredients and water. Drop and flatten with glass.  Bake about 8 minutes at 400°.

name: DROP SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
2  tsp. soda
1  c. sour milk
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
4  c. flour
preparation: Beat sugar and shortening together.  Add eggs.  Dissolve the soda in the milk (soda makes the milk sour), add vanilla.  Slowly stir in flour and baking powder.  Drop on greased cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: SUSIE'S SUPPER SALAD
ingredients:
1  stalk broccoli
4  to 8 florets cauliflower
3  to 4 green onions (tops and all)
1  stalk celery, sliced thin
6 to 8  oz. frozen peas
10  to 15 green olives
2  c. cooked shell macaroni
1  c. cubed meat (ham, roast, pastrami or chicken)
1/4  c. sour cream
1/4  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Salt and pepper to taste. Serve chilled.

name: FROZEN APPLE YOGURT
ingredients:
1  c. plain yogurt
1  c. unsweetened applesauce
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1 to 2  Tbsp. maple syrup or honey
preparation: Mix yogurt, cinnamon and honey in blender.  Stir in applesauce.  Pour into individual containers.  Freeze at least 3 to 4 hours.  Let soften 5 to 10 minutes before serving.  Serves 4.

name: PLUCKETS(Amish Rolls)
ingredients:
1 cake yeast, dissolved in 1/4  c. lukewarm water
1  c. scalded milk
1/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. melted butter
3  eggs, well beaten
4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. nuts
3  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Add 1/3 cup sugar, butter and salt to scalded milk when lukewarm. Add dissolved yeast, eggs and flour.  Beat thoroughly. Cover and let rise until double. Stir down and let rise again until double.  Take 1 teaspoon of dough and dip in butter (melted).  Roll in mixture of the 1 cup sugar, nuts and cinnamon. Pile balls loosely in ungreased angel food pan.  Let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes and then at 350° for 30 minutes.   When baked, turn the pan upside down immediately. Serve warm.  The rolls will be stuck together and that's the way you serve them.  Everyone plucks his roll from the central supply. These can be reheated in the oven if wrapped in foil. They are also good when served cold. These are very good and different.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  stick oleo or butter
3  eggs
1/8  tsp. salt
1  c. white Karo syrup
1 1/2  c. pecans
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: In a mixing bowl, cream sugar and butter; then add eggs, one at a time, mixing well.  Add 1/8 teaspoon salt.  Add syrup, pecans and vanilla.  Mix all and pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake 1 hour at 325°.

name: CREAM OF BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  onion, chopped
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2 1/2  c. chicken broth
2 (10 oz.)  package frozen, chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
2  c. milk
preparation: In a large saucepan, melt butter and sauté onion about 10 minutes or until golden.  Blend in flour, salt and pepper. Gradually add the chicken broth, milk, and then the broccoli. Bring mixture to a boil, stirring frequently.  Cover and simmer until broccoli is tender, about 15-20 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. croutons (any flavor)
1  bunch fresh broccoli
1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. fresh, diced carrots
1  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1  medium onion, diced
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Cut broccoli in small pieces.  Cook in microwave until half tender, approximately 6 minutes on High.  Cook onion and carrots in microwave until "half" tender, approximately 6 minutes on High.  Mix all vegetables, 1/2 cup croutons, cream of mushroom soup, 3/4 cup cheese and 1/2 cup water in a large bowl. Place remaining croutons on top and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake approximately 20 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.  Let cool at least 20 minutes.

name: FOOLPROOF CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of celery soup
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1 soup  can white wine
1  c. rice
3  chicken breasts
preparation: Mix soup, wine and rice and let stand several hours.  Put in casserole dish.  Arrange chicken on top.  Cover.  Bake 1 hour at 350°, then uncover and bake another hour.

name: HOT DOG CHEESIES(Kid's Recipe)
ingredients:
8  hot dogs
8  slices bread
butter
8  slices American cheese
preparation: Drop hot dogs into saucepan of boiling water.  Lower heat. Cover and simmer 5 to 8 minutes. Drain.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. mashed sweet potatoes
1/2  c. honey
1/2  c. white sugar
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  deep dish pie crust
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. pecans
preparation: Cook potatoes; mash.  Add sugar, honey, eggs, salt (spices), cinnamon and vanilla.  Add chopped nuts.  Bake at 350° in a deep dish pie crust 50 minutes or until firm.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. chicken
1/2  c. celery
3/4  c. slivered almonds
1  (6 oz.) water chestnuts
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. grated onion
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
11  oz. cream of chicken
3/4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except for cheese and potato chips.  Put in a casserole dish.  Put cheese and potato chips on top and bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: UGLY COOKIES
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  box brown sugar
2  c. Bisquick
2  cans coconut
1  c. chopped nuts
1 large  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Beat the 4 eggs.  Add brown sugar.  Slowly add the Bisquick, coconut, chopped nuts and the chocolate chips.  Mix well.  Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pour batter in and bake for 30 minutes in 400° oven.

name: CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. flour
1/3  c. Hershey's cocoa
1  tsp. baking soda
6  Tbsp. butter
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk (can use low-fat)
1  Tbsp. white vinegar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix flour, cocoa and soda; set aside.  Melt butter in saucepan; stir in sugar.  Remove from heat.  Add milk, vinegar and vanilla; stir.  Add dry ingredients; whisk until well blended. Pour into 2 (8-inch) round pans or 1 (10-inch) square pan.  Bake about 20 minutes.  Cool; frost with Coconut Pecan Icing.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. buttermilk
1  stick margarine (soft)
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans, chopped
2  unbaked pie shells
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
6  eggs
preparation: Place sugar in bowl.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Blend in margarine and buttermilk.  Add vanilla and flour.  Add coconut and pecans.  Put in pie shells.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes until golden brown.

name: BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3  large bananas, mashed
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening.  Add buttermilk, eggs and bananas. Add flour and remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Bake at 350°. Test with a toothpick until done.

name: AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1  jar maraschino cherries
1  can pineapple tidbits
3  oranges, peeled and sliced
coconut
sugar
preparation: Drain cherries and set aside. Drain pineapple and save juice. In a medium size bowl, place a layer of oranges, then coconut. Sprinkle some sugar, then a layer of pineapple. Sprinkle with cherry halves. Layer of coconut, then oranges and so forth until bowl is full. Pour saved juice on top and chill. Serve.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
1  c. meal
3/4  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1  c. grated onion
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  If too thick, add buttermilk to moisten.  Let stand half a day before cooking.

name: ROASTED FRESH VEGGIES
ingredients:
New potatoes cut into 1/2 or 1/2 pieces
Carrots halved then quartered
Onions quartered
Garlic, as many as you like
Summer squash, cut in 1 inch chunks
Basil
Oregano
Parsley
Sage
Rosemary
Olive oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Cut up veggies; sprinkle with herbs and salt and pepper.  Drizzle with olive oil and mix well.  Roast about 30 minutes, stirring half-way through.  Serve hot.

name: TUNA NOODLE CRISP
ingredients:
8  oz. uncooked noodles
1/4  c. shortening
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
2 (10 1/2 oz.)  cans Cheddar cheese soup
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2 (6 1/2 to 7 oz.)  cans tuna
1  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Cook noodles; drain.  Melt shortening in large skillet; add onion and  green  pepper  and  cook until tender.  Stir in soup, milk, pimento,  salt  and pepper.  Bring to a boil.  Add cooked noodles and flaked	tuna.  Mix well and put in 1 1/2 or 2 quart casserole.	Sprinkle  with	bread  crumbs  and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Serves 12.

name: PEACHY FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2  peaches, peeled and pitted
1/2  c. plain nonfat yogurt
2  Tbsp. packed brown sugar
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  cantaloupe, cubed
3  peaches, peeled, pitted and sliced
2  c. strawberries, cut into halves
2  c. cubed apples
2  c. white seedless grapes
2  c. sliced bananas
preparation: Puree first 4 ingredients until smooth.  Refrigerate 1 hour. Place remaining ingredients in large bowl. Pour peach sauce over fruit; toss until covered.  Chill before serving.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: SUGAR-FREE TINY APPLESAUCE CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  egg
2  tsp. Sweet 'N Low
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. ginger
1  c. applesauce (unsweetened)
2  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. raisins
1/3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream margarine until fluffy.  Beat egg and sweetener until thick and lemon colored; add to margarine and mix well.  Sift all dry ingredients together; add to margarine mixture alternately with applesauce; blend well.  Add vanilla, raisins and nuts.  Pour into tiny tart tins, filling 2/3 full.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Makes 30.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. unsifted flour
2  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  Tbsp. baking soda
1/2  Tbsp. cinnamon
1/2  Tbsp. nutmeg
1/2  Tbsp. salt
1  c. ripe mashed bananas (2 or 3 medium)
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. melted butter
1/4  c. milk
1 1/3  c. chopped walnuts
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. or 1 c. Nestle butterscotch morsels
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a small bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt.  In a large bowl, combine bananas, sugar, egg and butter. Beat until creamy. Gradually add flour mixture alternately with milk.  Mix until well blended. Stir in 1 cup nuts and butterscotch bits. Pour into well-greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Sprinkle remaining 1/3 cup nuts on top.  Bake at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes. Cool for 15 minutes.

name: SEASONED SQUID RINGS
ingredients:
squid
eggs and milk
bread crumbs
garlic powder
Italian seasonings
onion powder
shortening
preparation: Clean and cut squid; put aside.  Mix Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, and bread crumbs together and set aside. Beat egg and mix in milk.  Heat shortening in a deep fry pan.  Dip rings in egg and cover with crumbs.  Fry until golden brown. Garnish and serve.

name: OREO COOKIES
ingredients:
1  Pillsbury Plus cake mix (chocolate) with pudding (I have used cake mix with no pudding)
2/3  c. Crisco shortening
2  beaten eggs
1  stick butter
1  lb. powdered sugar
canned milk
preparation: Mix well and bake 7 to 8 minutes for small cookies, longer for large, at 350°, on an ungreased cookie sheet.  Fill with:

name: ARTICHOKE NIBBLES
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  jars marinated artichoke hearts
1  small onion, finely chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
4  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. oregano
1/8  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
preparation: Drain marinade from 1 jar of hearts into frying pan.  Drain other jar.  Chop all hearts and set aside.  Add onion and garlic to frying pan and saute until onion is limp, about 5 minutes.

name: GRANDMA'S HOT RICE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
1  pt. sour cream
1 small  can green chili peppers, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/3  lb. Cheddar cheese (prefer sharp)
preparation: Mix rice together with sour cream, chili peppers, salt and pepper.  Grate cheese and sprinkle over top of rice mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.  Serve hot.

name: STEAK MARINADE ITALIANO
ingredients:
1/4  c. A. 1. steak sauce
1/4  c. prepared Italian salad dressing
1  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Combine all ingredients; use to marinate any steak for about an hour.  Use marinade to baste beef while cooking.  Makes 1/2 cup.

name: CHRISTY'S BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
6  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped pecans (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Blend butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, and blend.  Sift flour and cocoa and add to mixture.  Add vanilla and pecans.  Pour into greased pan and bake about 30 minutes.  This is a light cake-type brownie.

name: OATMEAL PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. white sugar
1 1/4  c. molasses
1 1/4  c. oatmeal (uncooked)
3  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. margarine, melted
2/3  c. coconut
preparation: Pour into 2 (8-inch) unbaked pie shells and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: PUPPY CHOW FOR PEOPLE
ingredients:
1  c. chocolate chips
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  stick butter
9  c. Crispix
2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Melt together the chocolate chips, peanut butter and butter. Pour over Crispix in a bowl with a lid.  Add powdered sugar.  Put on lid and shake.  Eat and enjoy!

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (9 oz.)  pkg. frozen cut green beans
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
dash of pepper
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
preparation: Microwave:  Place beans in medium bowl.  Cover and cook on High 9 minutes, stirring twice. Drain.  In a 1 1/2-quart bowl, stir soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper until smooth.  Stir in beans and 1/2 can onions. Cover and heat on High 7 minutes or until hot and bubbling, stirring once during cooking.  Sprinkle with remaining onions.  Cook, uncovered, 1 minute.

name: CHICKEN AND DRESSING FOR SIX
ingredients:
3  c. self-rising meal
3  eggs
3  Tbsp. melted shortening
2  Tbsp. sugar
milk
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
3  eggs, beaten
chicken broth
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients and mix with enough milk to make soft mixture.  Bake at 450° until light brown.  Cool and crumble bread, then add celery, onions, soup, eggs, salt and pepper and enough broth to make a soupy mixture.  Cook in 350° oven until light brown, but not hard.  It should be soft when ready to eat, but not runny.

name: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
dash of salt
2  c. orange sections
1  (8 oz.) maraschino cherries
2  c. whipping cream
1/4  c. whipping cream
1/4  c. lemon juice
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
1 (17 oz.)  jar sweet cherries
1  c. pecans
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Drain pineapple chunks.  Drain cherries and chop.  Chop pecans. Combine cream cheese, 1/4 cup whipping cream, mayonnaise, lemon juice and salt in mixing bowl.  Beat until smooth.  Stir in fruit and pecans.  Combine 2 cups whipping cream and sugar and beat until light and fluffy.  Fold into fruit mixture.  Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Freeze.  Cut into squares to serve.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: TOMATO MEDLEY
ingredients:
4  to 5 carrots
6  stems celery
2  medium onions
1  can green beans
1 large  can tomatoes
4  Tbsp. margarine
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Cut into pieces (as for soup) the first 3 ingredients.  Add a little salt.  Simmer in the juice of the tomatoes.  Add water sparingly to cover until tender.  Add cut up tomatoes and green beans.  Add 3 to 4 tablespoons margarine.  Simmer, adding one tablespoon cornstarch, dissolved in water to thicken.

name: LEE ANN'S CHEESE RING
ingredients:
1  lb. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1  c. chopped pecans
1  small onion, grated fine
dash of cayenne pepper
1  c. mayonnaise
black pepper to taste
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Place  in  round salad mold. Chill overnight.  Empty onto  a  large  platter.  Fill  center with Smucker's strawberry  preserves.  Place Town House crackers around ring.  Serve  by  placing  cheese  mixture and then preserves on cracker.  Great for a party dish, shower, etc.

name: CHICKEN AND SOUR CREAM
ingredients:
5  chicken breasts
2  cans creamy chicken mushroom soup
2 (8 oz.)  cartons sour cream
2  sticks melted oleo
2  stacks crushed Ritz crackers
1  c. chicken broth
preparation: Boil chicken and cut in small pieces.  Melt oleo and stir in crushed crackers.  Put half of crumbs in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Put chicken pieces on top of crumbs.  Mix soup, sour cream and broth together.  Pour over chicken.  Top with remaining crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: SEVEN CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. fruit cocktail, drained
1  c. pecans
1  c. coconut
1  c. sour cream
1  c. cottage cheese
1  c. mini marshmallows
preparation: Mix all ingredients in large bowl and chill.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. crescent rolls
approximately 2 c. fruit (several different kinds)
preparation: Unroll crescent dough.  Lay flat on cookie sheet or pizza pan. Seal all edges.  Bake as directed on package.  In medium bowl, blend cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until fluffy on low with electric mixer.  After crust is cool, spread mixture on crust evenly.  Slice canned, frozen or fresh fruit of your choice. Arrange in pretty pattern on top of cheese mixture.

name: SHRIMP-RICE SOUP
ingredients:
2  c. water
1  tsp. instant chicken bouillon
2 to 3  Tbsp. rice
1/2 to 1  c. diced celery
1  can chicken and rice soup
1  c. milk
1  (4 1/2 oz.) canned shrimp, drained
1/2 to 1  c. sour cream
preparation: In  medium  saucepan, combine water, bouillon, rice and celery.  Simmer  12  to  15  minutes.  Stir in soups and milk. Add drained shrimp.  Heat through.  Add sour cream.  Heat, but do not boil.  Serve with crusty French bread.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. corn bread mix
3  eggs, beaten
2 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. oil
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1/2  c. pimiento
2  pods crushed garlic
1/4 to 1/2  c. chopped jalapenos
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. creamed corn
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Mix all together.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: JELLO CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1 large  can evaporated milk
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1  c. hot water
2  tsp. vanilla
32  graham crackers
1  sq. butter, melted
preparation: Remove cream cheese from fridge.  Put evaporated milk in freezer.  Add 1 cup hot water to Jell-O.  Place in fridge until syrupy.  Whip.  Add sugar and vanilla to cheese and beat.  Whip evaporated milk until it peaks.  Mix with cheese mixture.  Add crushed pineapple, if desired.  Press 1/2 of cracker mixture into a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish and let stand while preparing other ingredients.  Sprinkle balance of crackers over top.

name: BREAKFAST PIZZA
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage
1  can crescent dinner rolls
1  lb. cheese, grated (1/2 lb. Mozzarella and 1/2 lb. sharp Cheddar)
6  eggs
1/2  c. sweet milk
1  tsp. oregano
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Crumble sausage in a skillet and fry until done, but not hard. Stir occasionally while frying to keep crumbled fine.   Put sausage into a colander and let drain. Cool.  Spray a baking pan, 13 1/2 x 9 1/2 x 2-inch, with Pam and unroll the crescent rolls in the pan in 2 strips. Pinch together the middle seam and perforated places. Spread with fingers to cover bottom of pan.  Crumble sausage over the roll crust evenly. Sprinkle cheese over sausage. Beat eggs, milk, salt and oregano together and pour this egg mixture as evenly as possible over the cheese. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.  Let pizza set for 5 to 10 minutes.  Cut into squares and serve hot.

name: EASY CARROT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. sliced carrots
1  Tbsp. minced onions
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  lb. Longhorn cheese, grated
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1/2  c. cornflakes
preparation: Parboil carrots until tender.  Drain well.  Mix carrots with onion seasoning.  Place in alternate layer with grated cheese in a well-buttered 2-quart casserole.  Pour melted butter over all. Top with cornflakes.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: MOM'S RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2  whole eggs
2 heaping  Tbsp. cocoa
2 1/2  c. cake flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. white vinegar
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  oz. red food coloring
1  c. buttermilk
1  tablespoon vanilla
1  Tbsp. soda
preparation: Cream butter with sugar and eggs.  Make a paste of food coloring and cocoa.  Add to the creamed mixture.  Add alternately buttermilk with sifted flour and salt.  Add vanilla.  Add soda to vinegar.  (Hold over bowl it will foam.)  Add the soda and vinegar, blending instead of beating.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes in greased and floured pan.  Cool.  Split each layer into 2 layers and frost and add each layer back on top of each other after frosted.

name: KAY'S BUNDT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Butter Recipe golden cake mix
1  pkg. instant lemon pudding
3/4  c. Wesson oil
3/4  c. water
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. vanilla, butter and nut flavoring
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix cake mix and pudding together.  Add oil and water.  Add eggs, beating well after each.  Add both flavorings.  Beat 6 to 7 minutes.  Grease Bundt pan well and sprinkle half of nut and sugar mixture in pan (coat all over as if it were flour).  Pour half of batter into pan.  Sprinkle rest of mixture  over batter.  Pour in remaining batter.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.  Check to see if done; it may take 55 minutes.

name: HAMBURGER CORN PONE PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/3  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. oil
2  tsp. chili powder
3/4  tsp. salt (optional)
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. canned tomatoes
1  c. drained kidney beans
preparation: Cook together ground beef, onion and oil until done.  Add chili powder, salt, Worcestershire sauce, tomatoes, kidney beans and corn bread batter on top.  Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
1/2  c. celery
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of chicken or celery soup
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
Tater Tots
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Brown ground beef and onion.  Add celery and soups.  Place in 2-quart buttered casserole and cover with as many Tater Tots as possible.  Bake for 30 minutes!

name: Banana Cake
ingredients:
1  Duncan Hines butter cake mix (baked in 3 layers)
bananas
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  stick oleo
dash of salt
1/4  c. white Karo syrup
1 small  can Carnation milk
preparation: Bake cake in 3 layers.  Cook icing in saucepan medium to high. When it bubbles up, remove from heat.  Put between layers of cakes, punching holes in cake so icing will go in.  Put sliced bananas between layers also.  Stack while hot.

name: RUTH'S CHOCOLATE OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  stick margarine
4  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. oatmeal
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. nuts
1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Boil sugar, milk, margarine and cocoa for 3 to 5 minutes. Start counting when mixture has reached a full boiling (rolling boil).  Remove from heat.  Add vanilla, oatmeal, peanut butter, coconut and pecans.  Mix well.  Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper.

name: YELLOW SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. sliced yellow squash (about 8 small)
1  c. water
1/2  c. evaporated skim milk
1/4  c. (2 oz.) shredded reduced-fat Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  tsp. diet margarine, melted
3/4  c. fine dry breadcrumbs
1  packet low-sodium chicken-flavored bouillon
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. paprika
preparation: Combine squash and water in a 1-quart saucepan.  Cover and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until tender.  Drain well and mash squash.  Add milk, cheese, 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, onion, margarine, bouillon and pepper, stirring until well combined.  Pour into a 1-quart casserole; top with remaining breadcrumbs and paprika.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Makes 6 (1/2 cup size) servings.

name: APPLE BARN FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. oil
3  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
3  apples, chopped
preparation: Mix flour, soda, salt and sugar.  Mix in oil, eggs, vanilla and apples.  Bake at 325° in tube pan for 1 hour and 20 to 30 minutes.

name: MEXICAN RICE
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked white rice
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  medium onion, finely chopped
2  tsp. chili powder
2  tsp. salt
1  c. canned tomatoes
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Heat shortening in heavy skillet over medium heat.  Add onion and rice and cook until onion is tender.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer until done.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1/4  c. sour cream
1/4  c. mayonnaise
4  oz. cream cheese
1/4  small onion, cubed (omit or use less if preferred)
dash of Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except shrimp, in blender.  While blending, slowly add shrimp and blend.  Serve with chips or raw vegetables.  Yields 1 to 1 1/2 cups.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS AND HEARTS OF PALM
ingredients:
6  boneless chicken breasts, skinned
6  hearts of palm
seasoned salt to taste
pepper to taste
butter
Hollandaise Sauce
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Wrap each chicken breast around a heart of palm.  Sprinkle with seasoned salt and pepper.  Fasten with toothpicks.  Place seam side down in buttered Pyrex dish.  Dot with butter.  Bake for 25 minutes.  Serve with Hollandaise Sauce in packets.

name: EASY COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
3/4  stick butter, melted
1 1/3  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
3  eggs
1  can evaporated milk (13 oz.)
1  can coconut (3 1/2 oz.)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine flour and sugar; add to butter.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Add milk; fold in coconut and vanilla.  Pour into heavily greased and floured 9-inch pan (no crust).  Cook 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

name: POOR MAN CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
5  slices bread
sugar
cinnamon
butter or margarine
preparation: Butter sliced bread and cut in half.  Sprinkle halves with sugar and cinnamon.  Roll pieces up and place in a muffin pan. Coat tops with butter, cinnamon and sugar.  Bake at 350° until brown.  Makes 10 Cinnamon Rolls.

name: AMISH HOT POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
4  slices bacon
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1  qt. hot, cooked, cubed potatoes
1/4  c. grated raw carrots
3  hard-cooked eggs
preparation: In large skillet, dice bacon and pan fry.  Add onion and pepper and cook 3 minutes.  Add vinegar, salt, pepper, sugar and beaten egg.  Cook 1 minute.  Add potatoes, carrots and diced hard-cooked eggs.  Blend and serve hot.

name: DAGO SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
2  lb. ground meat
1  egg
1  c. bread crumbs
salt and pepper to taste
1  tsp. garlic powder
4  Tbsp. minced onion
Parmesan cheese (amount you desire)
cooking oil
1  lb. pork chops
salt to taste
3  lb. thin spaghetti, cooked
preparation: Mix first 7 ingredients and make into meatballs.  Put cooking oil in a skillet and brown the meatballs.  Take them up and set aside.

name: MOCK SWEET BREADS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground pork
1/2  lb. ground veal or hamburger
2  c. crushed saltine crackers
1/2  c. cold water
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
pepper
preparation: Mix and let stand overnight (in refrigerator).  Make into patties; roll in flour and brown.  Place in baking pan.  Pour cream of mushroom soup over patties.  Cover with foil and bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: OYSTER CRACKERS
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  boxes oyster crackers, unsalted
2  Tbsp. dill weed
1/2  Tbsp. lemon pepper
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dip mix
2  Tbsp. garlic salt
1  c. salad oil
preparation: Mix all except crackers.  Pour over crackers.

name: "DAY OUT" POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  beef roast
16  oz. jar Ragu or Prego spaghetti sauce
16  oz. can cranberry sauce
carrots, potatoes, green beans and onions
noodles (optional)
preparation: Combine spaghetti sauce and cranberry sauce.   Pour over roast in roasting pan.   (A slow cooker or crock-pot may be used.)   Put vegetables on top of roast.   Cover and cook in 200° to 250° oven all day.   Beef may be frozen when started.  No browning or seasoning is necessary.   If desired, at end of cooking time, meat and vegetables can be removed, sauce heated to bubbling and noodles cooked right in the gravy.   The longer this cooks, the more tender the meat.  Just turn it on and spend the day out.

name: HAMBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. tomato paste
1  medium onion, diced
1  bell pepper, diced
3  large mushrooms, sliced
2  c. cooked string beans
mashed potatoes
Cheddar cheese
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Brown beef, onion, pepper and mushrooms.  Add tomato paste and seasonings, then combine with string beans.  Place in casserole. Cover with mashed potatoes and grated cheese to taste.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: BROCCOLI CHEESE RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  boxes long grain and wild rice
2  pkg. frozen broccoli, prepared as directed
1  can chicken broth (14 oz.)
2  cans chopped mushrooms
2  cans water chestnuts (optional)
2  c. nonfat cheese, grated
1  c. low-fat croutons
1 to 1 1/2  tsp. Mrs. Dash spicy seasoning
preparation: Prepare the rice as directed, using liquid Butter Buds.  Add the cooked broccoli, water chestnuts and chicken broth.   Add seasoning and cheese.  Spoon into a large casserole dish that has been sprayed with nonfat cooking spray.  Top with the croutons; cover and bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.  Remove cover the last 10 minutes.

name: FOURTEEN DAY SWEET PICKLES
ingredients:
2  c. canning salt
cucumbers
2  Tbsp. alum
7  c. sugar
2  c. apple cider vinegar
2  Tbsp. pickling spice
preparation: Mix 2 cups of canning salt to 1 gallon water.  Mix well. Slice cucumbers, pack in jars, and pour salt water on cucumbers. Soak 7 days.  Pour off salt water, take pickles out of jars, and rinse twice.  Eighth day return to jars.  Pour boiling water to cover pickles.  Soak 24 hours, pour off water.  Mix alum to one gallon of water.  Mix well.  Pour over pickles.  Next day pour off water.  Take out of jars and rinse well.  Return to jars, and make syrup on 10th day.  To make syrup, mix 7 c. sugar, 2 c. apple cider vinegar, and 2 Tbsp. pickling spice, put in cheese cloth, and boil.  Pour over pickles in jars.  Then reboil syrup, and pour over pickles in jars.  The 11th, 12th, 13th, and 14th day.

name: SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE(Spaghetti For A Crowd!)
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti
water, lightly salted
1  Tbsp. sugar
3  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  pt. Ready Hamburger Mix, thawed
1 (2 1/4 oz.)  can mushrooms
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can tomato soup
1/2  c. milk
1 (15 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°F (170°C).  Butter a 2 1/2 to 3-quart casserole.  Cook spaghetti in lightly salted water according to package directions.  Put half of cooked spaghetti in bottom of prepared casserole.  Sprinkle with half the sugar.  Sprinkle half the grated cheese on top, then half the Ready Hamburger Mix, then half the mushrooms.   Repeat layers.  In a small bowl, combine tomato soup, milk and spaghetti sauce.  Pour over entire casserole.  If necessary, add more milk during baking to keep casserole moist.  Bake 1 hour, until bubbly.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: SAUERKRAUT
ingredients:
5  lb. shredded cabbage
3 1/2  Tbsp. coarse ground salt
water
preparation: Wash cabbage.  Remove bad spots.  Shred with kraut cutter or knife (not too finely).  Layer cabbage in crock.  Sprinkle on salt.  Do in layers until a ratio of 5 pounds of cabbage to 3 1/2 tablespoons salt is used.   Add enough water just to cover cabbage.  Place plain plate or glass pie plate on cabbage.  Place a stone on plate heavy enough to keep cabbage down in liquid. Cover with cheesecloth.

name: GOLDEN CREAM OF POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
6  c. peeled, cubed red potatoes
2  c. water
1  c. sliced celery or 1/2 tsp. celery seed
1  c. sliced carrots
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  tsp. dried parsley flakes
2  cubes chicken bouillon
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. flour
2 1/4  c. milk
3/4  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Combine ingredients (except last 3)                      in a heavy saucepan or Dutch oven.  Cook together until tender (approximately 20 minutes).

name: STUFFED FAJITAS
ingredients:
prepared butterflied fajitas
1  or more containers fresh mushrooms
1  onion, sliced
1/2  bell pepper, sliced
1/2  lb. butter, melted
1  slice bacon for each fajita
1/2  green hot pepper
preparation: If butterflied fajitas are not available, cut fajitas into very thin, 5 to 6-inch slices.  Cook mushrooms; set aside.  Saute bell pepper, onion and 1/2 hot pepper in butter until tender. Spoon onion mixture on fajita slice.  Roll up fajita and wrap 1 slice of bacon around it, securing with toothpick.  When coals are ready, place on grill; cook well done.  Turn very slowly and in small turns.  Fajitas have to cook all the way through from one side.  Top with mushrooms and butter.

name: ESTELLE'S MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground chick
1/2  c. Progresso bread crumbs
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. chopped parsley
2  eggs, beaten
2  cloves garlic, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.   Form a loaf on a large sheet of heavy-duty foil, bringing sides of foil up to make a fold.  Seal edges and put in a pan or on a cookie sheet.  Bake at 400° for 1 hour.  Last 10 minutes, open foil to brown meat loaf.  Serves 8 to 10 persons.

name: BAKED CARROTS
ingredients:
2 to 4  c. cooked carrots
1  can cream of celery soup, undiluted
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese, grated
buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Combine carrots, soup and cheese.  Pour into greased casserole and sprinkle on buttered bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  stick butter
preparation: Melt butter, mix with crumbs and press into a glass baking dish.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. shortening
3/4  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
4  tsp. milk (1%)
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Thoroughly cream shortening and sugar. Add egg; beat until light and fluffy.  Stir in milk and vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients and blend into creamed mixture. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet.  To make a design (roll the mixture), add extra 1/2 cup flour.  Chill 1 hour before using. Use 1/2 at a time, keeping 2nd half chilled.

name: YELLOW PARTY CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. butter, softened
2  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
preparation: In a mixer bowl cream sugar and butter until light and fluffy, scraping bowl frequently.  Add eggs and vanilla; beat at medium speed (about 2 minutes) until light and fluffy.  Scrape bowl frequently.  Stir together flour, baking powder and 1 teaspoon salt.  Add to creamed mixture alternately with the milk, beating at low speed after each addition.  Beat 1 minute at end.  Turn batter into 2 greased and lightly floured 9 x 1 1/2-inch round baking pans.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tests done.  Cool 10 minutes.  Remove from pans and cool thoroughly on wire racks.

name: APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  pie crust (any kind)
1  box crushed pie crust topping
1  c. butter
1  c. milk
5  lb. apples, sliced
2 1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Cook apples with brown sugar and cinnamon to taste for about 1 hour.  Add apples into pie crust and pour in milk.  Add butter. Cover with crumb topping.  Bake in oven for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: COCONUT PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1/4  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients and add flour, soda, salt and pineapple.  Bake in large pan at 350° about 40 minutes.  Leave in pan.

name: CANADIAN CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
2  medium carrots
2  stalks celery
1  small onion, chopped
2  c. water
2  chicken bouillon cubes
2  c. milk
1/4  c. flour
2 1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, cubed
preparation: Put carrots, celery, onion, water and bouillon cubes in saucepan and cook until tender.  Cook milk, flour and cheese over low heat until smooth; pour into vegetables and simmer until thoroughly blended.

name: SALMON LOAF
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans salmon
2  eggs
salmon liquid and enough milk to make 1 1/2 c.
3  c. cracker crumbs
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. chopped onions
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Flake and remove bones and skin from salmon.  Blend in eggs and salmon-milk mixture.  Add remaining ingredients.  Spoon into greased loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: HELEN'S CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. chopped chicken
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can evaporated milk
2  c. Chinese or any kind of noodles
1 1/2  c. herbed croutons
1  c. frozen peas
1  c. chopped celery
1  small onion
1 small  can water chestnuts
chicken broth (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Add chicken broth.  Put in casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN WINGS WITH SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken wings
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. raw rice
1/4  tsp. fresh ground pepper
1  c. canned tomatoes with liquid
1 1/4  c. chicken stock
2  pimentos, diced
1/4  c. olive oil
1  garlic clove, crushed
2  tsp. salt
1  c. cooked green peas
1/4  tsp. powdered saffron
preparation: Drain wings.  Pat dry.  Heat the oil over moderate heat until hot, but not smoking.  Add onion and garlic; cook until soft and slightly browned, stirring constantly.  Remove onion from skillet and set aside.  Brown wings lightly, remove from pan and set aside. Add rice, salt, pepper, tomatoes and chicken stock.  Dissolve saffron in 1 tablespoon hot water; add to chicken.  Cover and simmer until rice and chicken are tender.  Add peas and pimentos, stir gently into rice.  Reheat and serve.  Enjoy.

name: ALL-BRAN PULL APART BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. All-Bran cereal
1  c. warm water
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1  pkg. yeast
3 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water.  Mix all ingredients, except flour. Stir well and let rise until double, 1 hour.  Punch down and shape in oblong rolls.  Dip in melted butter.  Stack in greased tube pan and let rise again.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: NO-NOTHINGS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. shortening
preparation: Add water or milk to make a soft dough.  Roll 1-inch thick. Cut with doughnut cutters and fry as doughnuts.

name: SPICY HERB MARINADE
ingredients:
1/2  c. ReaLemon lemon juice from concentrate
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1  clove garlic, finely minced
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. hot pepper sauce
2  tsp. Wyler's or Steero chicken or beef flavor instant bouillon
1  tsp. thyme leaves
1/4  tsp. oregano leaves
preparation: Combine ingredients and mix well.  In shallow dish or plastic bag, pour over chicken, beef or pork.  Cover and marinate in refrigerator 4 hours or overnight, turning occasionally.  Remove meat from marinade; heat marinade.  Grill or broil as desired, basting frequently with marinade.  Refrigerate leftover meat. Makes about 3/4 cup.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
3  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Boil chicken breasts until done.  Remove skin and bone from chicken and cut into bite size pieces.  Place in casserole dish; set aside.

name: PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. crushed pretzels
3  tsp. sugar
3/4  c. melted margarine
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip
1  c. sugar
2 small  pkg. strawberry jello
2  c. boiling water
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
preparation: Mix pretzels, 3 teaspoons sugar and margarine.  Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 10 minutes at 350°.  Mix cream cheese, 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip.  Spread over cooled crust.  Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add strawberries.   Pour over all.  Chill.

name: CHICKEN RAVIOLI
ingredients:
1  hen
2  pkg. noodles (large)
2  cans mushroom soup
1  large onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped pimento
salt and pepper to taste
grated cheese
preparation: Simmer hen until tender; remove and add noodles to broth. Cook until tender.  Saute onion, pepper and celery in butter until tender.  Mix together with noodles, soup and chicken which has been taken from bone and cut up.  Add pimento and enough chicken broth to make it very moist.  Put into baking dish and cover with grated cheese.  Bake until cheese melts and is lightly brown on top.  Good to fix ahead of time and freeze.

name: CHOCOLATE CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick margarine
1  c. nuts
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
2  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix flour, margarine and nuts; spread in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan (will be very thin).  Cook 20 minutes at 325°.  Cool.

name: SLOP OVER CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1 3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1/4  c. butter, melted
1  egg
milk
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Put melted butter in a cup, add egg and add milk until it slops over the top of the cup.  Add to dry ingredients and beat well.  Turn into 2 greased 8-inch pans and bake at 375° to 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: 5 POUND CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
1 12 oz  pkg. semisweet chips
1  pint marshmallow cream
1/2  lb. butter or margarine
2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
2  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
4 1/2  c. sugar
1  can evaporated milk
preparation: Put first five ingredients in a very large bowl.

name: CHERRY NUT SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. Cool Whip
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  c. nuts
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Pour all into large mixing bowl except nuts.  Mix well.  Add nuts.

name: PORCUPINE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/4  tsp. salt and pepper
1/4  c. cooked rice (not too soft)
3  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
2 small  cans Hunt's tomato sauce
1  can water
preparation: Mix ingredients and form into balls (about 16 to 20).  Brown and drain well.  Put in casserole.  Cover with tomato sauce and water.  Put on lid and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: CRAZY CRUST APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  egg
2/3  c. Crisco shortening
3/4  c. water
1 (5 oz.)  can apple pie filling
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. nutmeg or spice
preparation: In small mixer bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, egg, Crisco and water; blend well.  Beat 2 minutes at medium speed.  Pour batter into a 9-inch pie pan.  Combine pie filling, lemon juice and spice.  Pour into center of batter.  Do not stir.  Bake at 425° for 45 to 50 minutes, until crust is golden brown.

name: COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or oleo
1 1/4  c. sugar
2 1/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  egg (unbeaten) plus enough milk to make 1 1/4 c.
preparation: Mix butter, flour, sugar and baking powder like pie crust. Add the egg mixture.  Stir until smooth.  Spread in a greased jelly roll pan (12 x 15-inch).

name: CHRISTMAS JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  (3 oz.) cherry Jell-O
1  (3 oz.) lime Jell-O
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  can pineapple (crushed)
preparation: Mix cherry Jell-O; put in bottom of serving bowl.  Let chill. Mix cream cheese with a little milk and put over cherry Jell-O when chilled.  Mix lime Jell-O with pineapple and pour over salad.

name: CHINESE RICE
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  box instant rice
1/2  lb. chopped ham
1  can sliced water chestnuts
1  can bean sprouts
1  bunch green onions
2  stalks celery
1  doz. eggs
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
soy sauce
French onion dip
preparation: Cook rice and set aside.  Chop vegetables and ham, then stir-fry in skillet or wok.  Scramble eggs and add to vegetables and stir.  Mix vegetables and eggs with rice.  Serve in bowl with soy sauce and desired amount of French onion dip.

name: LINCOLN LOG
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
5  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Sift together 1/2 cup sugar, flour, cocoa and salt.  Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff, but not dry.  Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar, beating constantly.  Set aside.  Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored.  Add vanilla and fold in dry ingredients.  Then fold in egg whites.  Spread evenly in a greased and floured pan (15 1/2 x 10 x 1-inch).  Bake in preheated oven at 325° for about 25 minutes.  Roll up in towel sprinkled with powdered sugar.  When cool, unroll and spread with filling (whipped cream or ice cream).  Roll and spread with chocolate icing or dust with powdered sugar.  Refrigerate.

name: CHEESY POTATOES
ingredients:
1  bag hash browns
1  small onion, chopped fine
1  can cream of chicken soup
3/4  c. sour cream
1 8  oz. pkg. shredded cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix together all ingredients. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

name: MEDIEVAL TIMES HERB-BASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
6  Russet potatoes, cut in half lengthwise
1  c. butter, melted
2  Tbsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. Italian seasoning
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. barbecue spice
white pepper
lemon pepper
preparation: Parboil potatoes just until tender.  Melt butter in saucepan. Add the next 5 ingredients; mix well.  Place potatoes on baking sheet.  Generously brush butter mixture over all sides of potato halves.  Season to taste with white and/or lemon pepper.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
6  eggs
1  can Eagle Brand
1  can Carnation milk
1  tsp. vanilla
homogenized milk to fill freezer
preparation: In large bowl, mix Eagle Brand and Carnation.  Add eggs; beat until blended well.  Add sugar and beat until foamy.  Add vanilla and pour into freezer.  Add milk to fill freezer.  Start freezer. Should be ready in about 30 minutes.

name: APPLE DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  can Butter-Me-Not biscuits
3  chopped apples
1  stick butter or margarine
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
12  oz. 7-Up
preparation: Roll out biscuits; fill with apples.  Pinch together.  Bring to a boil the butter, sugar, cinnamon and 7-Up.  Pour over Apple Dumplings.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: GOLDEN PEACH PIE
ingredients:
4  c. sliced cling peaches (two 1 lb. cans)
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
dash of salt
2  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. orange peel, shredded
1/8  tsp. almond extract
1  unbaked 9-inch pie shell
preparation: Drain peaches, reserving 1/3 cup syrup.  Combine sugar, flour, nutmeg and salt.  Add reserved syrup.  Cook and stir until mixture thickens.  Add butter, lemon juice, orange peel, almond extract and peaches.  Pour into prepared pie shell and arrange a lattice top.   Bake at 400° for 40 to 45 minutes.    Serve warm.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. softened butter
2 1/4  c. brown sugar
3  eggs (room temperature)
1/2  tsp. salt
2 1/4  Tbsp. baking powder
2 1/2  tsp. baking soda
6  Tbsp. plain yogurt
1 1/2  c. mashed bananas (about 3)
3  c. flour*
4  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: *Can use 1/2 whole wheat flour and 1/2 enriched, but not all whole wheat, too heavy.

name: OATMEAL GEMS
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3  c. old-fashioned or quick oats, uncooked
strawberry preserves
preparation: Beat butter/margarine and sugars until light and fluffy.  Blend in eggs and vanilla.  Add combined flour, baking soda and cinnamon. Mix well.  Stir in oats.  Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Indent center.  Fill each with 1/4 teaspoon preserves.  Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.  Let stand 2 minutes before removing from cookie sheet.  Makes about 4 1/2 dozen cookies.

name: BRIDE AND GROOM PUNCH(Makes 100 Three Ounce Servings)
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  cans frozen orange juice concentrate
2 (6 oz.)  cans frozen lemonade concentrate
1  gal. Sauterne or Riesling wine, chilled
6  bottles champagne
preparation: Combine juices in large bowl.  Gradually add chilled wine and stir until dissolved.  Chill until serving time.  Just before serving time, add ice block and champagne.  Garnish with orange and lime slices.  For 12 servings, use 1/3 cup frozen juices, 1 (28 ounce) bottled wine and 1 bottle champagne.

name: APPLE PIE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  can apple pie filling
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients together by hand. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes in a loaf or Bundt pan.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter + 2 Tbsp.
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
nuts, if desired
preparation: Bake at 350° for 29 minutes or longer if needed.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  pkg. frozen hash browns
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  cans potato soup
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Bake at 325° for 4 hours.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1  can mixed vegetables
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can chicken
2  9 inch pie shells
preparation: Mix all ingredients together. Put in pie shell. Cover with other pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: WATERGATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1  box pistachio pudding
3  eggs
1  c. oil
1  c. club soda
1  c. nuts
1  pkg. Cool Whip
1 1/3  c. cold milk
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except nuts and Cool Whip, in mixer and mix 2 minutes on medium.  Add nuts and bake in pan for 50 minutes at 350°.  Cool before frosting with Cool Whip.

name: REFRIGERATOR POTATOES
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
5  lb. potatoes
1  c. sour cream
2  tsp. onion salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Peel and cook potatoes in boiling salt water.  Drain and mash. Add other ingredients.  Refrigerate.

name: LUCILLE'S JELLO
ingredients:
2  pkg. sugar-free raspberry jello
1 1/2  c. hot water
1 large  can pineapple with juice
1  can lite cherry pie filling
preparation: Mix about ingredients and chill until set.  Top with lite Cool Whip.

name: DATE AND NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. dates (1 c. full)
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. boiling water
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. flour
1 small  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together dates, baking soda and boiling water; let cool. Cream together sugar, butter and egg.  Add vanilla, flour and nuts.  Mix all together.  Makes 1 loaf.  Line pan with wax paper on bottom.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SAN DIEGO CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil, divided
1  onion, julienned
1  red pepper, seeded and julienned
1/2  lb. small mushrooms, thinly sliced
1  c. red wine
3  garlic cloves, chopped
1/4  c. tomato paste
all-purpose flour for dredging chicken
salt and pepper to taste
1 to 1 1/2  lb. boneless chicken, cut into small pieces
2  c. fresh basil
4  c. chicken broth
3  plum tomatoes, diced
preparation: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.  Add onion and red pepper; cook 3 to 4 minutes until soft.  Add mushrooms, 1/2 cup of wine, garlic and tomato paste.  Cook 5 minutes.  Season about 1 1/2 cups of flour to lightly coat both sides of chicken.  In a large, heavy saucepan or Dutch oven, heat remaining 1 tablespoon of oil.  Cook chicken for 5 to 7 minutes on each side.  Add the cooked veggies to saucepot of chicken; stir in basil, chicken broth and remaining 1/2 cup red wine.  Cover and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add tomatoes; cover and simmer 15 minutes.  Serve over pasta.

name: VEAL CUTLET SUPREME
ingredients:
veal cutlet or steak
garlic powder
paprika
1  large onion, chopped
salt
Italian bread crumbs
Parmesan cheese
water (approximately 1 1/2 c.)
cheese slices (American or Mozzarella)
butter
1  egg
preparation: Season veal with salt and garlic powder.  Dip in egg; then dip in bread crumbs.  Fry in butter until browned on both sides. Remove and place in baking pan.  Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Saute onions until tender (soft) slowly, seasoning with salt and paprika.  Add water during latter stages of cooking and simmer about 10 to 15 minutes.  Place slice of cheese on top of veal pieces, then pour onion gravy on top.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Serve with rice or noodles.

name: AUNT ESTELLE'S HOMEMADE SYRUP
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. maple flavoring
1  c. white syrup
preparation: Add 1/2 cup water or more to dissolve sugars; add maple flavoring.  Boil to thin syrup.  Remove from heat.  Stir in white syrup.  This will not crystallize and will keep a long time.

name: APPLE TORTE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
8  Tbsp. butter
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. flour
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. baking powder
4  c. chopped raw apples
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs and beat.  Sift together dry ingredients and add to butter, eggs and sugar.  Add raw apples and mix well.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serve plain or top with ice cream.

name: PIZZA CRUST
ingredients:
1  c. warm water
1  pkg. yeast (dry)
3  c. flour (reserve 1 c. flour to work into dough)
preparation: Preheat oven.  Mix water and yeast.  Add flour; stir.  Roll and knead until not sticky.  Spread out on pizza pan.  Add topping.  Bake 15 minutes at 450°.

name: MY IRISH MOTHER'S CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
10  lb. chicken necks and backs
4  carrots
1  onion
1  bay leaf
1  bunch parsley
1/2  bunch celery
any left over produce
preparation: Rinse chicken parts thoroughly in cold running water. Place in large soup pot and add cold water to cover chicken. Add vegetables and spices. Bring to a boil and simmer for 3 hours. Remove foam from top while cooking. After cooking, strain soup and discard all chicken parts. Cool overnight in refrigerator. Remove and discard fat. Soup can now be reheated and served or frozen in ice cube trays to add to gravy or other recipes, or freeze in portions for instant chicken soup. Add cooked noodles, if desired.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
1  c. buttermilk
1  stick margarine, melted
1 2/3  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. plain flour
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. lemon flavoring
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add flour and eggs; mix well.  Add buttermilk.  Mix. Add lemon flavoring.  (For best results, beat with electric mixer.)  Pour in shell.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CORNBREAD SALAD
ingredients:
cornbread, baked and crumbled
1  large bell pepper
2  green onions
1  can dark red kidney beans, drained
2  medium tomatoes
1  lb. bacon, dried and crumbled
1/2  c. sweet pickle cubes
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sweet pickle juice
preparation: Mix cornbread, vegetables and bacon.  Add mayonnaise and pickle juice.  Mix well.  Let stand in refrigerator overnight.

name: CHEESE OLIVE BALLS (3 DAY)
ingredients:
1  lb. sharp cheese, grated
1  c. flour
red pepper sauce to taste (go easy)
2  drops Worcestershire sauce
1 large  jar medium size stuffed olives
preparation: Let cheese set until soft.  Mix in flour and seasoning.  Press bits of mixture around olives.  Bake on greased cookie sheet 10 minutes at 400°.  Serve hot with toothpicks.  Freezes well so can be made ahead.

name: COCONUT COFFEECAKE(In Honor of Lottie Direct)
ingredients:
1  pkg. (18.5 oz.; 2 layer size) yellow cake mix
1 (11 oz.)  can condensed Cheddar cheese soup
1/2  c. water
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. grated lemon rind
1 1/2  c. flaked coconut or shredded (if prefer)
1/2  c. crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine, softened
1/2  c. unsifted all-purpose flour
1/4  c. packed light brown sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  In a large electric-mixer bowl, combine cake mix, soup, water, eggs and lemon rind.  Beat until blended, following package directions.  Stir in 1 cup of the coconut, the pineapple and the walnuts.  Spread batter evenly in pan.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
6  eggs (at room temperature)
3  c. sugar, separated
3  c. cake flour, sifted and separated
3  sticks real butter (at room temperature)
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese (at room temperature)
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Mix butter and cream cheese together until smooth.  Add 1 egg and 1 cup of sugar.  Mix until smooth.  Add 1 egg and 1 cup of flour.  Mix until smooth.  Add 1 egg and 1 cup of sugar.  Mix until smooth.  Add 1 egg and 1 cup of flour.  Mix until smooth. Add 1 egg and 1 cup of sugar.  Mix until smooth.  Add 1 egg and 1 cup of flour.  Mix until smooth.  Add vanilla.

name: SNACK TIME TACO DIP(A Favorite Of Mary Sue And Bruce Lambert)
ingredients:
1  can refried beans
1 to 2  tsp. lemon juice
approximately 1 c. mayo
approximately 1 1/2 c. sour cream
1  pkg. taco seasoning
taco chips
2  to 3 avocados
2  large tomatoes
6  to 8 green onions
1  can pitted black olives
16  oz. shredded cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In a 9 x 13-inch square glass dish, spread 1 can of refried beans on the bottom evenly.  Pit and mash the avocados; mix with the lemon juice with a dash of salt and pepper.  Spread on top of the refried beans.  Mix the mayo, sour cream and the taco seasoning well; spread on top of the avocado mixture.  Chop the tomatoes, onions and  olives and sprinkle alternately with the cheese on top of the sour cream mixture.  Serve with taco chips. (Note:  Long periods of refrigeration may cause sogginess.)  Eat with the taco chips or just a spoon.

name: CHICKEN AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 10  ounce packages frozen chopped broccoli
4  chicken breasts, cooked and chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
2/3  cup mayonnaise
1/2  cup evaporated milk
3/4  cup shredded Cheddar cheese
1  tablespoon lemon juice
1  1/2 teaspoons curry powder
1  cup buttered breadcrumbs
preparation: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Drain well.  Place in a lightly greased 1 1/2 quart casserole; top with chicken.  Combine remaining ingredients except breadcrumbs, stirring well.  Spoon mixture over chicken, top with breadcrumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: GOLDEN SQUASH CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
2  tsp. fresh squeezed orange juice
2  Tbsp. whipped cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. grated yellow squash
8  pitted dates, chopped
1/4  c. confectioners sugar
1/2  c. sour cream
2  eggs
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Onto sheet of wax paper, sift flour, baking powder, soda, salt and cinnamon; set aside.  Beat eggs and sugar until combined.  Add sour cream, orange peel and vanilla. Add dry ingredients.  Mix well.  Stir in squash and dates.  Spray Bundt pan before adding batter.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes.  Invert cake onto wire rack.  Let cool 15 to 20 minutes.  In small mixing bowl, combine confectioners sugar and cream cheese.  Add juice. Mix well.  Pour over cooled cake.

name: BEER CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. shredded Cheddar
3  oz. cream cheese
1/3  c. beer
1  Tbsp. green onions, minced
1  Tbsp. horseradish
assorted crackers
preparation: Place all ingredients except crackers into a bowl of the food processor and process until pureed and fully combined.   Spoon into the crock and chill.  Serve on platter surrounded by assorted crackers.

name: BISCUIT DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
1  can biscuits
cinnamon
sugar
preparation: Open biscuit can and separate biscuits.  Take one and form into a doughnut gently, then in sugar and sprinkle cinnamon on top, then place on cookie sheet.  Continue to do this to other biscuits and when all placed on cookie sheet, put in oven to bake for 5 to 8 minutes until golden brown; cool and eat.

name: DOUBLE DEVILED EGGS
ingredients:
6  hard-cooked eggs
1  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. sour cream
1 small (2 1/4 oz.)  can deviled ham
1/2  tsp. prepared mustard
1  Tbsp. finely chopped sweet pickle
dash of white pepper
preparation: Halve eggs. Remove yolks and in a small bowl, combine yolks, sour cream, deviled ham, mustard, pickle and pepper.   Fill whites.  Chill before serving.

name: OPEN-FACE PITA SANDWICH
ingredients:
8  oz. sun-dried tomatoes in oil, drained (1 Tbsp. oil reserved)
1  lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, cut into about 1/2-inch pieces
1/4  tsp. Italian seasoning
1  small onion, thinly sliced
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  whole wheat pita pockets
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Cut tomatoes into 1/4-inch strips.  Heat reserved 1 tablespoon oil in 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat until hot.  Cook chicken, Italian seasoning and onion in oil about 4 minutes, stirring frequently, until chicken is no longer pink in center.  Stir in tomatoes and Parmesan cheese.

name: CHILI HOT DIP
ingredients:
1  can Hormel chili without beans
1 small  jar plain Cheez Whiz
1 small  jar Mexican style Cheez Whiz
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
preparation: In microwave, heat chili and Cheez Whiz.  Stir well.  Add cream cheese.  Heat and mix well.  Add 1/2 jar salsa, if desired. Serve with tortilla chips.

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1 small  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
1/2  c. celery
1/2  c. onions
1/2  c. carrots
1/2  c. cauliflower
1/2  c. green peppers
1/2  c. radishes
1/2  c. broccoli
12  oz. pkg. Cheddar or Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Mix cream cheese, mayonnaise and Ranch dressing together and spread on pizza crust.  Mix vegetables together and spread evenly on top of cream cheese mixture.  Press lightly.  Top with grated Cheddar cheese or Mozzarella cheese.  Bake at 350° until cheese is melted.

name: LEMONADE PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker pie crust
1 small  can frozen lemonade
1  large size Cool Whip
1  can Eagle Brand milk
2  drops green cake coloring
juice of 1 lemon
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and put in pie crust. Chill 1 hour.

name: SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
7  oz. spaghetti
32  oz. chunky sauce
8  oz. cream cheese
16  oz. sour cream
2  lb. ground beef
1 to 2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook noodles and brown ground beef. Pour noodles in pan, mix sour cream and cream cheese and pour over noodles, then mix ground beef with sauce and pour over noodles.  Cover top of casserole with shredded cheese.  Cook at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked regular rice
1  can (undiluted) Campbell's consomme
1  can (undiluted) Campbell's beef broth
1/2  stick margarine
1  small onion
4  oz. can mushrooms
preparation: Mix  in  1  1/2 quart casserole dish with lid.  Bake in oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until liquid is absorbed at 350°.

name: MEXICAN WEDDING CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1 large  can crushed pineapple
2  c. sugar
1  c. chopped walnuts
2  tsp. baking soda
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  stick margarine
3/4  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Spread on top of cake.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: STRAWBERRY BAKED ALASKA
ingredients:
1  prebaked 9-inch pie shell
1 1/2  qt. (about 6 c.) strawberry ice cream
1  c. strawberry jam or sundae topping
3  egg whites
dash of cream of tartar
fresh strawberries for garnish (optional)
strawberry jam (optional)
preparation: Chill baked pie shell well. Spread bottom with strawberry jam or topping. Reserve a little to drizzle over top.  Soften ice cream at room temperature. Beat with electric mixer until smooth and creamy. Spread ice cream evenly over bottom of pie shell, mounding it in the center.  Place in freezer immediately while preparing the meringue topping.

name: CHICKEN BONNE FEMME
ingredients:
4  boneless breasts
2  egg yolks
2  Tbsp. dry white wine
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. tarragon
2  Tbsp. oil
10  oz. bag spinach (baby)
1/2  lb. mushrooms, thinly sliced
1  carrot (2 x 1/8-inch strips)
1/8  tsp. red pepper
butter
preparation: Pound chicken to 1/4-inch; set aside. In double boiler over hot (not boiling) water, beat egg yolks, wine and lemon with whisk until thickened. Add 1/4 cup butter, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating constantly until it thickens. Add tarragon, red pepper and 1/4 teaspoon salt; cover and keep warm.

name: COMPANY POTATOES
ingredients:
8  large potatoes
1 1/2  c. shredded sharp cheese
1  pt. sour cream
4  green onions
preparation: Boil, cool and shred potatoes (medium shredder).  Stir in sour cream, onions and 1 cup of the cheese. Pour into greased casserole dish and top with remaining cheese.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  can pork and beans
1/3  c. maple pancake syrup
1  Tbsp. Heinz 57 sauce
1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Mix in oven-safe pan.  Bake for 30 minutes.

name: FREEZER COLESLAW
ingredients:
1  head cabbage, shredded
1  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. celery seed
4  stalks celery, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1  carrot, cut lengthwise into fourths and sliced
1  onion, chopped
preparation: Mix cabbage and salt; let stand one hour.  Heat sugar, vinegar, water and celery seed to boiling.  Boil and stir one minute; cool to lukewarm.

name: SALMON SOUFFLE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. milk
2  slices bread, crumbled
2  c. pink salmon (1 lb. can), drained, deboned and flaked
1  egg yolk
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. minced onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  egg white, beaten stiff
preparation: Melt butter  in  saucepan.  Remove  from heat; add milk and crumbs.  Mix  well.  Stir  in  salmon,  egg  yolks,  lemon juice, onion, salt and pepper.  Fold in stiff egg white.  Pour into greased  1 quart casserole.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: DREAM PUNCH
ingredients:
1  pt. pineapple sherbet
1  pt. orange sherbet
3 large  bottles 7-Up
preparation: Whip sherbets and 7-Up until consistency of thick cream.  Serve in punch bowl.  Yield:  12 servings.

name: VEG-ALL CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans Veg-All
8  oz. jar Cheez Whiz
3/4  c. butter
Ritz crackers
preparation: Drain Veg-All and put in casserole.  Melt cheese and butter together and pour over Veg-All. Crumble crackers on top.  Melt 1/2 stick butter and pour over top. Cook at 350° until cheese bubbles and the top is brown.

name: SPICED CRANBERRY RING
ingredients:
2 (3 oz. each)  pkg. or 1 (6 oz.) pkg. Jell-O brand raspberry flavor gelatin
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
dash of cloves
2  c. boiling water
2 (8 oz. each)  cans whole berry cranberry sauce
2  Tbsp. grated orange rind (optional)
1  c. diced orange sections
1  c. chopped apple
preparation: Dissolve gelatin, salt, cinnamon and cloves in boiling water. Add cranberry sauce and orange rind.  Chill until thickened.  Fold in orange and apple.  Pour into 6-cup mold.   Chill until firm, about 4 hours.  Unmold.  Garnish as desired.  Makes 12 servings.

name: CRISPY ONION CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. ground mustard
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
4  boneless skinless chicken breast halves
1 (6 oz.)  can Cheddar or original French fried onions, crushed
preparation: In a shallow bowl, combine the butter, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, garlic salt and pepper. Dip chicken in the butter mixture, then coat with onions. Place in a greased 9-inch square baking pan. Top with any remaining onions; drizzle with any remaining butter mixture. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until chicken juices run clear. Yield: 4 servings.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick butter or margarine
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
2 to 3  c. sharp cheese
16  oz. container sour cream
2  lb. bag frozen hash browns
1 small  box cornflake cereal
preparation: Combine all ingredients except for the cornflakes.  Melt the margarine before mixing with other ingredients (soup doesn't need to be heated).  Put into a 13 x 9 1/2-inch pan.  Crumble cornflakes by hand and spread across top of casserole, approximately 1/2-inch thick.  Bake covered at 350° for 1 hour. Take foil off of casserole and continue baking for approximately 15 to 20 minutes or until cornflakes are a golden brown.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: BROWNIE PIE
ingredients:
9-inch pie shell
4  sq. semi-sweet chocolate
1/2  c. margarine
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. water
2  eggs, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven and cookie sheet to 350°.  In medium saucepan, melt chocolate and margarine.  Cool slightly.  Mix together water, egg yolks, vanilla and brown sugar.  Stir into chocolate.  Fold in flour and salt.  Beat egg whites until stiff, then fold into chocolate.  Add pecans.  Spread into pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Cool before cutting.

name: COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1/2  grated cabbage head
1/2  small onion
1 1/2  Tbsp. vinegar
3  Tbsp. water
2  tsp. sugar
3 heaping  tsp. salad dressing (mayonnaise)
preparation: Mix all together well.

name: SEAFOOD CHOWDER
ingredients:
1/2  c. finely minced onion
1/4  c. butter, melted
2  c. chicken or fish stock
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. finely chopped carrots
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  bay leaf
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/2  lb. fish fillets, cut into bite size pieces
3  c. milk
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. light cream
1  c. cooked crabmeat
2 (6 1/2 oz.)  cans minced clams with liquid
preparation: Saute onion in butter for 3 minutes; add stock, celery, carrots,  salt,  pepper, bay leaf and thyme.  Simmer gently 10 to 15 minutes.  Add fish;  simmer 5 minutes.  Remove bay leaf. Make smooth  thin  paste  of 1 cup milk and flour.  Add to hot mixture and  cook,	stirring, until thick.	Stir in remaining milk, cream, crab meat and clams.  Serves 6.

name: WEIGHT WATCHERS FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. crushed pineapple
1 small  can orange juice (frozen)
1  c. water
3  apples, diced
2  pkg. Sweet 'N Low
4  drops banana, coconut and vanilla flavorings
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

name: HOT MEXICAN SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (28 oz.)  can whole tomatoes, mashed and chopped
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies, drained and chopped
1/2  to 1 medium onion, diced
1  clove garlic, minced
1 1/2 to 2  tsp. chili red pepper
preparation: Combine  ingredients.  Refrigerate and freeze for longer storage.

name: JOSIE'S VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can cut beans
1 (16 oz.)  can kernel corn
1 (16 oz.)  can sweet peas
2 (16 oz.)  cans whole tomatoes, undrained
2  lb. stew beef or ground beef
1  large onion, diced
4  sticks celery, diced
2  white potatoes, diced
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
4  c. water
2  beef bouillon cubes
red pepper (optional)
preparation: In a large  stock  pot	or  Dutch  oven,  brown meat in vegetable oil; add oil  and  celery.  Pour	in 4 cups of water and bouillon cubes.  Drain  cut  beans,  corn  and sweet peas. Then add to  water  along  with	the  rest of the ingredients. Bring to a boil, then  cook	on  medium  heat for 1 hour and a half.  Add salt and black pepper to taste.

name: MAMA'S DATE LOAF
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  stick oleo
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
2  c. chopped dates, packed firmly
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pure vanilla
2  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Note:  For best results, use heavy saucepan.  Mix sugar, margarine and milk together.  Place over medium heat until dissolved, stirring constantly.  Bring to boil; add chopped dates. Continue to cook until soft ball is formed when small amount is dropped in cold water.  Remove from heat and beat until it begins to pile.  Add salt, vanilla and pecans.  Shape by hand into a roll 2 1/2 to 3-inches in diameter.  Wrap in wet towel which has been wrung out well.  Allow to stand until cool.  Cut in 1/4-inch slices.  Do not refrigerate.  Cut as needed.  Wrap to store. Yields about 3 dozen.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. rice
1  cut up fryer
1 1/4  c. water
1  envelope onion soup mix
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: Pour rice in casserole dish.  Place cut up chicken pieces on rice.  Add water to canned soups; stir well.  Pour over chicken and rice.  Sprinkle onion soup on top.  Cover with foil; bake for 1 hour, or until chicken is done, at 400°.

name: VEAL AND PEPPERS ITALIANO
ingredients:
1  lb. boneless lean veal
nonstick spray coating
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. sliced leek or green onion
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  tsp. dried basil, crushed
1/2  tsp. instant chicken bouillon granules
1/2  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. green pepper, cut into bite size strips
2  Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  c. hot noodles
preparation: Trim separable fat from veal.  Cut into 1-inch cubes.  Spray a cold large skillet with nonstick coating.  Preheat skillet over medium heat.  Brown veal in the hot skillet.  Stir in undrained tomatoes, water, sliced leek or green onion, garlic, basil, chicken bouillon granules, oregano, salt and pepper.  Bring to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.  Add green peppers.  Cook, covered, for 5 to 10 minutes or until peppers are tender.  Stir together 2 tablespoons water and cornstarch.  Stir into meat mixture.  Cook and stir until mixture is thickened and bubbly.  Cook and stir 2 minutes more.  Serve with hot, cooked noodles.  Yield:  4 (1 1/2 cup) servings.

name: CREAM CHEESE SANDWICH COOKIES
ingredients:
2  pkg. Pillsbury chocolate chip cookie dough
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Slice one package dough thin and place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pat to form crust.  Mix cream cheese and sugar together.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Add vanilla.  Pour over crust.  Slice second package of cookie dough thin and place on top of cream cheese mixture.  Fill in spaces as best you can.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Allow to cool completely before cutting into squares.

name: CREAMED CUCUMBERS AND ONIONS
ingredients:
4  medium cucumbers, peeled and sliced
1  large onion, sliced
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
pinch of salt
pinch of pepper
1  tsp. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Put cucumbers and onions in a bowl.  Combine the mayonnaise, sugar, salt, pepper and vinegar.  Mix well and add to cucumbers and onions.  Can be served immediately or refrigerated.

name: CREAM CHEESE SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. shortening
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1 1/3  c. sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
