preparation: Combine flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg; set aside. Cream together butter and shortening.  Add cream cheese and sugar, beating until fluffy.  Add egg and vanilla.  Beat well.  Gradually beat in flour mixture.  Cover and chill 1 to 2 hours or overnight.

name: TACO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1/2  envelope dry taco seasoning
1/2  onion, chopped
1/4  c. water
1  chopped tomato
1/2  can Cheddar cheese soup
1/4  c. milk
1/2  pkg. taco flavored Doritos, crushed
1/4  head lettuce, shredded
shredded cheese
Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger and drain.  Add dry taco seasoning, onion and water.  Stir to mix.  Crush taco flavored Doritos and put in bottom of 8 x 8-inch pan.  Spread hamburger mixture over Doritos. Spread tomato over hamburger.  Spread shredded lettuce over tomato.  Mix cheese soup with milk and pour over lettuce.  Top with shredded Cheddar and Mozzarella cheese.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: MEXICANA ANTIPASTO
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
dash of garlic salt
1/2  c. sour cream
1  large avocado, mashed
1/4  tsp. lemon juice
3  to 4 green onions, chopped
1/4  c. stuffed green olives, sliced
1  tomato, finely chopped
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies
1  c. grated cheese
5  slices bacon, cooked and diced
1/4  c. ripe olives, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Old El Paso taco sauce (hot)
preparation: Combine cream cheese, sour cream and garlic salt.  Place in a 9-inch pie plate.  Combine avocado, lemon juice, tomato and green chilies.  Use this as the second layer.  Sprinkle on the bacon, green onion and olives.  Spread taco sauce over all.  Sprinkle with grated cheese.  Serve cold with corn chips, taco chips or crackers.

name: BANANA CAKE ICING
ingredients:
2  c. sugar (white)
1  c. milk
3  to 5 bananas
preparation: Place milk and sugar in heavy saucepan.  Cook on high, continually stirring until it begins to boil.  Lower to medium or low heat and continue to cook for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

name: BANANA PUDDING 2
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. vanilla pudding (you can use sugar free)
1  c. milk
1  c. sour cream
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
vanilla wafers
bananas
preparation: Mix pudding and milk until blended.  Add sour cream and Cool Whip.  In a dish put sliced bananas and vanilla wafers.  Pour the pudding over the cookies and bananas.  Chill until read to eat.

name: VEGETABLE-CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium onion
small amount butter
12  oz. Velveeta cheese
1  can cream of celery soup
1  pkg. broccoli-cauliflower-carrot mixture, parboiled
approximately 2 c. regular rice
2 to 3  c. chopped cooked chicken (optional)
preparation: Saute onion in butter.  Melt cheese and soup in onion.  Add vegetables, rice and chicken, if desired.  Bake in a 2 to 2 1/2-quart casserole or 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for about 30 minutes.

name: POACHED CHICKEN BREASTS IN WINE
ingredients:
4  (4 oz.) skinned boneless chicken breasts
3/4  c. Chablis or dry white wine
2 1/2  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
1/2  tsp. dried whole tarragon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  tsp. water
preparation: Place chicken between 2 sheets heavy-duty plastic wrap and flatten to 1/4-inch thick; set aside.  Combine wine and next 5 ingredients in large skillet; bring to boil over high heat. Arrange chicken in a single layer in skillet; cover and reduce heat.  Simmer for 15 minutes or until chicken is tender.  Remove chicken to serving dish; keep warm.  Combine cornstarch and water; stir into skillet and bring mixture to a boil.  Boil one minute, stirring constantly.  Pour over chicken.  Yields 4 servings.

name: BACON-ALMOND DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. bacon, chopped
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese with chives (room temperature)
1  c. sour cream
3  Tbsp. chili sauce
1/4  tsp. hot pepper sauce
freshly ground pepper
1/4  c. finely chopped green onions
1/2  c. slivered almonds, toasted
preparation: In large skillet, cook bacon over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until crisp.  Drain on paper towels.  In mixing bowl, mix cream cheese, sour cream, chili sauce, hot pepper sauce and pepper to taste.  Add green onions, bacon and almonds and mix until blended, but still chunky.  This can be kept refrigerated for two days or frozen.  If frozen, defrost in refrigerator; if dip is too thick, add additional sour cream.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (20 oz.)  can pie filling (cherry, etc.)
1  yellow or white cake mix
3/4 to 1  c. melted margarine
1/2  c. coconut (flaked)
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Dump pineapple and pie filling in bottom of oblong pan.  Mix and spread evenly over bottom.  Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over those.  Pour melted margarine over cake mix.  Sprinkle evenly with coconut and then pecans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PUPPY CHOW
ingredients:
9  c. Chex cereal or Crispix
1  c. chocolate chips
1/2  stick margarine
1 1/2  c. 10x sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt margarine, chocolate chips and peanut butter.  Add vanilla; stir cereal until evenly coated.  Put in bag or bowl with tight lid.  Add 10x sugar.  Shake until well coated.  Sweet and crunchy!

name: GRANDMOTHER'S TEA CAKES
ingredients:
2  eggs
2/3  c. oil
2/3  c. sugar
2  c. self-rising flour
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Beat eggs and add other ingredients, one at a time.  Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 400° for 6 to 8 minutes.

name: WOK BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1  head fresh broccoli
3  scallions
1/2  lb. mushrooms
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
drop of oil
drop of water
possible additions: boneless chicken or pepper steak *
preparation: Cut up broccoli, scallions and mushrooms into small pieces. Put a drop of oil in bottom of wok.  Heat.  Add broccoli pieces. Cover and mix.  Cook 1 minute.  Add water.  Cover for one minute. Add mushrooms, scallions, sugar, salt and nutmeg.  Mix.  Cover and cook 1 more minute.

name: THREE MEAT GOULASH
ingredients:
1  lb. veal for stew (no bone)
1  lb. pork for stew (no bone)
1  lb. lamb for stew (no bone)
3  medium size onions, peeled, halved and sliced
3  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. sweet paprika
1  c. beef or chicken stock or broth (low salt) (this can be either self-made or canned)
1  c. water
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Heat butter in a deep pot that has a well fitting cover available that is oven proof.  Saute onions in pot and butter until transparent.  Add a third of the meat and stir on almost high heat for about 2 minutes.  You are not trying to brown the meat, just change its surface from red to white.  Add half the remaining meat to the meat in the pot and repeat process until all the meat is cooking in the pan and then stir and cook about 4 more minutes.

name: EASY RUM BALLS
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. vanilla wafers
2  c. nuts
4  Tbsp. cocoa
4  Tbsp. light syrup
1/2  c. rum
preparation: Crush nuts and wafers together.  Add cocoa, syrup and rum. Make small balls the size of walnuts and roll in powdered sugar. Let stand, then roll in powdered sugar again.

name: NEW ORLEANS JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
1/4  c. oil
1  chicken, boned and cut up (about 2 1/2 to 3 c.)
1 1/2  lb. smoked sausage or kielbasa
4  c. chopped onions
2  c. chopped celery
2  c. chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. garlic
4  c. uncooked rice
5  c. stock or water
2  tsp. salt
Kitchen Bouquet or other browning sauce
cayenne pepper or red hot sauce to taste
2  c. chopped green onions
preparation: Put pork chops in frying pan or skillet.  Put on high heat. Go away and do not tend for at least 30 minutes.  When you return, fan smoke detector as it should be blaring by now.  Scrape or chisel pork chops from pan and either throw away or use as hockey pucks.  Send out for pizza!

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
3  sticks margarine
3  c. sugar
6  eggs (room temperature)
3  c. flour, sifted
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Blend  cream  cheese and margarine together; add sugar, beating slowly.  Add  eggs,  one at a time, beating after each addition.  Add  flour,  a small amount at a time.  Add vanilla and beat  well.  Pour into well-greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 300° for one hour and thirty minutes (1 1/2 hours).

name: BLUEBERRY BUCKLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. soft shortening
2  eggs
1  c. milk
4  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  c. blueberries
preparation: Put all but blueberries in mixing bowl and beat with electric mixer until a smooth batter.  Add and stir in berries.  Then measure together 1 cup sugar, 1 teaspoon cinnamon and 1/2 cup flour and crumble in 1/2 cup soft butter to sprinkle on top.  Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or three smaller pans.  Bake in 375° oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1 large or 2 small  pkg. pistachio pudding mix
1/4  c. milk (or less)
1  (8 or 9 oz.) Dream Whip
1/2  c. chopped nuts of your choice (if not in pistachio)
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, do not drain
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Add all together and keep in refrigerator.

name: MEXICAN WEDDING RINGS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
4  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. nuts
1/2  lb. oleo
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream sugar and oleo.  Add flour, vanilla and nuts.  Roll into 1-inch balls.  Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.  Roll in powdered sugar while hot, then again when cool.

name: OVEN-FRIED FRENCH FRIES
ingredients:
white potatoes, cut in strips
flour
pepper and salt
Parmesan cheese (about 1/2 c.)
1  stick margarine
preparation: Wet potato strips and coat with mixture of flour, salt, pepper and Parmesan cheese.  Melt the margarine in large cookie sheet. Place potatoes in margarine and bake about 30 minutes.  Turn and bake 30 more minutes.

name: CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs, separated
2  c. sugar
1  c. cold water
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Beat egg yolks; add sugar, water and then beaten stiff egg whites, then vanilla, flour and baking powder.  Grease and flour 3 (9-inch) round cake pans and divide cake batter equally.  Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. boiling water
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. shortening
1/4  c. lukewarm water
2  eggs
8  c. flour
2  pkg. yeast
preparation: Dissolve yeast in the lukewarm water.  Set aside.  Mix boiled water, sugar, salt and shortening.  Cool until lukewarm; add eggs and 4 cups of the flour and mix well.  Add dissolved yeast, then add the other 4 cups of flour.  Let rise 2 to 3 times.  Punch down with a fork each time.  After the last rising, turn onto a floured board.  Roll out until about an inch thickness.  Cut into biscuits. Let rise again.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: GUACAMOLE
ingredients:
2  ripe avocados
1  tomato, peeled, seeded and chopped
1  Tbsp. onion, minced
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. chili powder
mayonnaise
preparation: Pit and peel avocados.  Mash pulp in bowl and stir in remaining ingredients, except mayonnaise.  Cover top with a thin layer of mayonnaise to keep mixture from darkening; refrigerate. Stir well before serving with tostados for dipping.  Makes about 2 cups.

name: SNACK DINNER
ingredients:
crackers
cheeses
sandwich meats
sliced fruit (apples, pears, whatever)
rolls or other bread
cut  up vegetables (if in fridge)
veggie dip
preparation: Assemble.  Everyone compiles their own dinner from what's available in the middle of the table.  One or two cutting boards help.  Eat and eat until you're full!  (It's fast food!)

name: TOMATO JUICE COCKTAIL
ingredients:
1  qt. tomato juice
3/4  tsp. Worcestershire
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vinegar
1/2  tsp. horseradish (prepared)
1/4  tsp. celery salt
preparation: Thoroughly mix tomato juice and seasonings.  Chill before serving.

name: LASAGNE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. lasagne
1  lb. ground beef
2  tsp. seasoned salt
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can tomatoes (3 1/2 c.)
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  pkg. spaghetti sauce mix
1/2  lb. Mozzarella cheese
1/2  lb. Ricotta cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Brown meat in heavy skillet.  Add salt, garlic and pepper. Cook slowly, uncovered, 10 minutes.  Stir in tomatoes, tomato sauce and spaghetti sauce mix.  Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Meanwhile, cook lasagne as directed.  Drain and rinse.

name: SOUR CREAM APPLE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  c. Pillsbury Best all-purpose flour
2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. margarine or butter, softened
1  c. chopped nuts
1 to 2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. dairy sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
2  c. finely chopped, peeled apples
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off.  In large bowl, combine flour, brown sugar and margarine.  Beat at low speed with electric mixer until crumbly. Stir in nuts; press 2/3 cup of crumb mixture in bottom of ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.  To remaining mixture, add cinnamon, baking soda, salt, sour cream, vanilla and egg.  Mix well.  Stir in apples.  Spoon evenly over base.  Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cut into squares.  Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.  Yields 12 servings.

name: CONFETTI RICE
ingredients:
2  c. defatted chicken stock
1  c. long grain rice
1  bell pepper, diced
1/4  c. sliced black olives
2  ribs celery, diced
1/4  c. sliced green olives
1/2  sweet onion, diced
6  plum tomatoes, diced
1  clove garlic, minced
1  c. fat-free Ranch dressing
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook rice in stock for 20 minutes until liquid is absorbed. Place in a large serving bowl.  Let cool. Add diced vegetables to rice.  Add dressing. Stir well. Chill.

name: OATMEAL CARAMEL BARS
ingredients:
1  c. oats
1  c. unsifted flour
3/4  c. firmly packed light brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. cold butter
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. caramels, unwrapped
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large bowl, combine oats, flour, sugar, cinnamon and egg; mix well.  Cut in margarine/butter until crumbly.  Stir in nuts.  Reserving 2 cups crumb mixture, press remainder firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Bake 15 minutes.

name: 24 HOUR SALAD
ingredients:
1  medium cabbage, shredded
1  small onion, chopped
1  medium bell pepper, chopped
1  small carrot, shredded
1  tsp. salt
2/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. mustard seed
2/3  c. vinegar
1/2  c. oil
1 small  jar pimentos, chopped
preparation: Mix cabbage,  onion,  bell pepper and carrot well.  Add salt, sugar,  celery  seed,  mustard  seed,  vinegar,  oil and pimentos. Mix  well and store in refrigerator 24 hours before serving. Will keep 2 weeks.

name: FESTIVE HOLIDAY MEATBALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground round beef
2  c. fine bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  clove minced garlic
4  Tbsp. chopped parsley
2  eggs
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  green peppers, sliced thin
1  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
dash of hot pepper sauce
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  medium onion, sliced thin
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple chunks with juice
preparation: Combine beef, bread crumbs, onion, garlic, parsley, eggs, salt and pepper in large bowl until well mixed.  Shape into 1-inch balls and brown in butter or margarine over medium heat.  Remove from skillet and set aside.

name: HAMBURGER TATER TOTS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. hamburger
2  c. cream of mushroom, cream of chicken soup or 1 c. soup and 1 c. milk
1 bag mixed vegetables (frozen) or 2  cans your favorite vegetables
pinch of celery salt
pinch of salt and pepper
garlic (if desired)
2  boxes or 1 large bag Tater Tots
preparation: Brown hamburger and drain, then season. Lay in the bottom of an 8 1/2 x 11-inch dish. Next, layer vegetables or you can mix with hamburger. Pour 1/2 of soup in bottom if you mix vegetables and hamburger; mix soup also. Layer your Tater Tots on top of mixture and pop in the oven for 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

name: QUICK SCONES
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. Bisquick
1/3  c. milk plus 1 tsp.
1  Tbsp. sugar plus 1/2 tsp.
1/3  c. dried cranberries or raisins
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Mix baking mix, 1/3 cup milk and 1 tablespoon sugar until mixture leaves side of bowl.  Stir in cranberries.

name: POPPY SEED CHICKEN
ingredients:
3  to 4 chicken breasts
1/4  lb. cheese, melted
small sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
3  Tbsp. poppy seed
1  stick margarine
1  pkg. Hi Ho crackers
preparation: Boil the chicken breasts.  Cut cooked chicken into small pieces.  Mix together the cheese, sour cream, chicken soup and poppy seed.  Add cut up chicken pieces and mix well.  Put in casserole dish.  Melt the margarine.  Mash up the crackers and mix with the melted margarine.  Spread over chicken mixture.  Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
1  chicken- cooked, deboned, cut into chunks
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  c. grated sharp cheese
buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Spread broccoli in bottom of greased 9 x 12 pan. Put chicken on top of broccoli.  Next combine mayonnaise and chicken soup together and pour over chicken. Top with cheese and cover with bread crumbs.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  boxes frozen broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  eggs
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. shredded cheddar cheese
17  ritz crackers
6 - 7  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 350.  Cook broccoli and drain.  Crack eggs into large bowl and whisk together.  Add soup, mayonnaise and cheese.  Stir well.  Add broccoli.  Stir well.  Place mixture into ungreased 8 x 8 x 2 casserole dish.  Coarsely crush the Ritz crackers.  Melt butter and pour over the crackers.  Stir gently. Cover the top of the broccoli mixture with the crackers and butter topping.  Bake for about 40 minutes or until set.

name: SWEET POTATO PUDDING *
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. milk
3  c. grated sweet potatoes
4  Tbsp. melted butter
2  c. light brown sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat eggs lightly.  Add remaining ingredients and pour into buttered dish.  Bake in slow oven at 300° for about 30 minutes or until well browned.  May be served with whip cream.

name: GREEN BEAN STIR FRY
ingredients:
1/2  lb. chicken, cut into thin strips
1  Tbsp. oil
1  pkg. green bean stir fry
2  Tbsp. water
1/2  c. prepared stir fry sauce
or Homemade Mustard Sauce:
1  tsp. chicken bouillon granules
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. corn starch
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
2  tsp. dijon mustard
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: In a wok, stir fry chicken in the oil until fully cooked.  Add green bean stir fry and water, cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes.  Stir occasionally.  Add prepared stir fry sauce or the homemade mustard sauce:  Dissolve bouillon in water and blend in remaining ingredients.  After adding either sauce heat through.  Makes 3 to 4 servings.

name: NO BAKE PEANUT COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. milk
1  stick margarine
3  c. quick cooking oats
3/4  c. peanut butter
preparation: Cook hard the sugar, milk and margarine for 1 1/2 minutes. Add the oats and peanut butter.  Stir thoroughly and drop by teaspoons onto wax paper.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
4  eggs
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Dump  all  ingredients	into large bowl and beat for 20 minutes, until smooth.  Dust a greased 10-inch tube pan with a mixture  of  2  tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon nutmeg.  Dump batter into pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: LITTLE ITALY IN A POT
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. Italian sausage (remove from casing)
2  large onions, chopped
1  garlic clove, crushed
1 (14 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1 (1 lb.)  jar stewed tomatoes
1 (3 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms
1/4  c. red wine (optional)
8  oz. shell macaroni
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  lb. sliced Provolone cheese
1/2  lb. sliced Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown meats in hot salad oil.  Drain off excess fat.  Add onions, garlic, spaghetti sauce, tomatoes and undrained mushrooms. Blend.  Simmer 20 minutes.  Add wine.  Cook macaroni according to directions on package.  Drain and rinse with cold water.

name: CHIPMUNK PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
1  egg, beaten
1  c. chopped apples
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix dry ingredients together and add egg and apples.  Fold in vanilla and chopped nuts.  Pour mixture into lightly greased pie plate and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until apples are tender.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen broccoli
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  c. cooked rice
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped celery
preparation: Mix together.  Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes in 350° oven.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Baker's German sweet chocolate
1/2  c. boiling water
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
4  egg whites
2 1/2  c. sifted Swans Down cake flour
1  c. butter or margarine
4  egg yolks, unbeaten
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Melt chocolate in 1/2 cup boiling water.  Cool.  Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add egg yolks, one at a time, and beat well after each.  Add melted chocolate and vanilla.  Mix well.  Sift salt, soda and flour.  Add alternately with buttermilk to chocolate mixture, beating well.  Beat until batter is smooth.

name: FRESH BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. oil
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. blueberries
preparation: Beat eggs.  Stir in milk and oil.  Mix in everything else, until lumpy.  Grease 12 muffin cups; fill these 2/3 full.  Bake muffins for 20 minutes at 400°.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
1  box (8 qt.) dry powdered milk
1  box (32 oz.) Nestle Quik
1  (6 oz.) nondairy creamer
1/4 to 1  c. powdered sugar
1  to 2 bags mini marshmallows
preparation: Mix all ingredients together. Use 1 to 3 tablespoons to taste, mixed with warm milk.

name: BAKED CHEESE
ingredients:
1  can crescent rolls
any size piece Gouda cheese
preparation: Pinch together  all seams on the crescent rolls to make one piece  of  dough.  Remove  red plastic from around cheese, place in  center of dough.  Wrap the crescent dough around the cheese, sealing  any  holes.  Bake at 350° to 375° until crescent rolls are brown.  Serve with sliced apples.

name: HERBED SHAD WITH EDIBLE BONES
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. dressed shad
lemon and pepper seasoning
3 to 4  c. water or 1/2 water and white wine
2  stalks celery, broken in 2-inch pieces
1  Tbsp. instant minced onion or 1 small onion, chopped
2  bay leaves
preparation: Wash and dry shad.  Sprinkle inside with lemon and pepper. Place fish on rack in baking pan.  Add liquid to a level just below fish.  Add rest of ingredients.  Cover tightly.  Let steam in a 350° oven for 5 hours.  Baste frequently.  Serves 6.

name: SCHOOL ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. warm milk
3  pkg. yeast
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. melted shortening
5 1/2  c. plain flour
preparation: Put warm milk in large bowl.  Add sugar, salt and yeast.  Stir until dissolved.  Add melted shortening and stir.  Add flour. Knead until dough is smooth and soft.  Put dough in well-greased bowl. Set in a warm place and let rise double in size.  Punch dough down.  Shape into loaves or rolls.  Put into a greased pan. Let rise again.  Bake at 400° until golden brown.   Brush with butter and serve.

name: GOLDEN ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cake flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
5  eggs, separated
1/2  c. cold water
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift together flour, salt and baking powder. Set aside. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon coloring. Add water and beat until light and fluffy. Gradually beat in sugar. Fold in dry ingredients a little at a time. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff, but not dry. Fold into egg yolk batter. Add vanilla. Bake in 10-inch ungreased tube pan in slow oven at 325° for 1 hour.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. sweet potatoes, mashed
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1/3  c. milk
1/2  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. light brown sugar
1/3  c. butter, melted
1/2  c. flour
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Combine potatoes, sugar, eggs, milk, butter (1/2 cup) and vanilla.  Mix well and pour into casserole dish.  Mix sugar, butter, flour and nuts; put on top of casserole.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

name: TIM GUMP MURPHY PIE
ingredients:
50  lb. apples (with or without worms)
25  lb. sugar
45  lb. pie crust
55  lb. cinnamon sticks
preparation: You will need 55 gallon metal drum (wash toxic chemicals out), cord of firewood, outside fire pit or campfire, matches (10 packs), gasoline (2 gallons) and one garden shovel.

name: CHICKEN WITH MUSHROOM-DIJON SAUCE
ingredients:
3/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. water
3/4  c. Chablis or other dry wine
1  small onion, sliced
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
3/4  tsp. chicken bouillon granules
8  sprigs fresh thyme
12  whole peppercorns
4  (4 oz.) boned, skinned chicken breast halves
1  Tbsp. honey
2  tsp. Dijon mustard
1 1/2  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
2  tsp. flour
fresh thyme sprigs (optional)
lemon slices (optional)
preparation: Combine  water,  wine,	onion,	lemon  juice,  bouillon granules, thyme and  peppercorns  in  skillet.  Bring to boil. Cover; reduce heat and  simmer  5 minutes.	Add chicken; cover and simmer 15 minutes or until done.  Remove chicken;  reserve liquid. Strain liquid.  Discard onion, peppercorns and thyme. Add honey, mustard and  mushrooms to cooking liquid.  Bring to boil; cook 10 minutes.

name: OKRA N RICE
ingredients:
1  pound okra
1  large onion
1  large breen bell pepper
3  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
1  cup rice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cut okra in rings. Steam in very little water until done. Add to bacon drippings and cook until light brown. Cut onion and pepper medium fine. Add crumbled bacon.  Add the rice and 2 cups water, season with salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat for about 45 minutes or until done.

name: BLACK BEAN TORTILLA PINWHEELS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sour cream
1  c. Monterey Jack cheese
1/4  c. chopped, drained pimento green olives or black olives
1/4  c. chopped red onion
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1 (15 oz.)  can black beans, drained
5  (10-inch) flour tortillas
salsa
preparation: Beat cream cheese and sour cream in bowl until blended.  Stir in Monterey Jack cheese, olives, onion, salt and garlic powder. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours.  Place beans in food processor or blender; process until smooth.  Spread each tortilla with a thin layer of beans.  Spread thin layer of cream cheese mixture over beans.  Roll up tortillas lightly.  Wrap in plastic wrap. Refrigerate until chilled.  Cut 3/4-inch slices and serve with salsa.

name: SPANISH RICE PRONTO
ingredients:
1/4  c. bacon drippings or oleo
1  medium onion, thinly sliced (about 1/2 c.)
1/2  medium green pepper, diced (about 1/3 c.)
2  c. Minute rice
2  c. hot water
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1/2  tsp. prepared mustard (optional)
preparation: Melt fat in skillet. Add onion, green pepper and rice right from the box. Cook and stir over high heat until lightly browned. Add remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes, all the time the rice needs to take all the flavor in.

name: PERFECT POACHED FISH
ingredients:
4 to 5  oz. orange roughy
1/4  tsp. basil
herb pepper, to taste
1/2  c. skim milk
preparation: Place in individual baking dish and sprinkle with seasonings. Pour around fish.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.  When milk starts to boil, the fish is done perfectly.

name: CRESCENT ITALIANO BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  c. mushrooms
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt and pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (8 oz.)  can crescent rolls
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. rosemary or basil
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion; drain fat.  Add salt, pepper, mushrooms and tomato sauce.  Put in 8-inch ungreased pan. Sprinkle with shredded cheese.  Separate dough into triangles.

name: CRESCENT/CHEESE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  pkg. crescent rolls
2  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg, separated
1/4  c. sugar
chopped nuts
preparation: Spread	1  package  crescent  rolls  on  bottom  of 9 x 13-inch  pan.  Mix	cream  cheese, 1 cup of sugar, vanilla and egg yolk;  spread  on	crescent  layer.  Lay  2nd  package of crescents  on top of cheese mix.  Beat egg white and spread on top.  Sprinkle  with 1/4 cup sugar and chopped nuts.  Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.  Let cool before slicing.

name: CHILI-MAC
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, broken up
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato juice
2/3  c. tomato juice
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans, drained
1 to 2  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cumin
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. elbow macaroni
sour cream
sliced green onion
preparation: In a large kettle, cook ground beef, onion and celery. Add tomatoes, tomato paste, tomato juice, kidney beans and seasonings. Simmer on low heat 30 minutes. Prepare macaroni according to package directions. Drain. Stir macaroni into chili mixture. Heat through. Serve in warm bowls. Garnish with spoonful of sour cream and green onions. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
4  small tomatoes
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  bunch green onions, chopped
1 small  can chopped chili peppers
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. vinegar
8  oz. can tomato sauce
preparation: Mix together the first 4 ingredients.  Combine remaining ingredients and add to tomato mixture.  Refrigerate for several hours before serving.

name: CHEESY PIZZA POTATOES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. Betty Crocker au gratin potatoes
1  c. hot water
2/3  c. milk
1/4  c. sliced ripe olives
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can whole tomatoes (undrained)
1  can mushrooms
1  c. shredded Mozzarella
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Cook and stir beef over medium high heat until brown; drain.  Mix beef and remaining ingredients, except cheese, in ungreased 2-quart casserole.   Break up tomatoes. Bake, uncovered, until potatoes are tender, 45 to 50 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix
4  eggs
3/4  c. Crisco
1  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1/2  c. water
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water and let cool. Add 1/2 cup juice from frozen strawberries. Combine other ingredients. Blend together for 4 minutes. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 2 layers.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
1 small  can mushrooms
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, sliced
1  pkg. spaghetti
1  c. Ro-Tel tomatoes, chopped
preparation: Boil chicken until tender; debone and cut into bite size pieces.  Boil spaghetti in leftover chicken broth and drain.  Mix all ingredients in a deep dish casserole dish.  Cover; bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: "FABULOUS" SALAD
ingredients:
1  can sliced beets, cut in julienne strips
1 (18 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
3  or 4 red apples, chopped (skin on)
3  or 4 dill pickles, chopped
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Drain beets.  Mix all ingredients together in order given. (You can use all sour cream and no mayonnaise, if preferred.) Salad is better if made day before so all flavors can blend. Yield: 8 to 12 servings.

name: CRAFT RECIPE
ingredients:
5  oz. cinnamon
5  oz. applesauce
preparation: Mix to form dough.  Roll out in additional cinnamon.  Cut with cookie cutters.  Let dry two days.  Paint if you wish.  Put wires through for ornaments or magnets for refrigerator.

name: LEMON SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
dash of salt
dash of ground nutmeg
2  c. water
1/4  c. butter
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Combine sugar, cornstarch, salt and nutmeg in a saucepan. Gradually stir in water.  Cook over moderately low heat (225°), stirring constantly, until thickened and clear.  Remove from heat. Add butter and lemon juice.  Stir until butter is melted.  Keep warm until serving time.

name: APRICOT JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  box apricot Jell-O or 2 small
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (12 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges
1  Cool Whip
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.  Add cream cheese.  Mix with electric mixer.  Cut up mandarin oranges.  Add oranges and pineapple to Jell-O mixture.  Add Cool Whip to mixture.  Chill and serve.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
3/4  c. powdered sugar
8  oz. peanut butter (creamy)
2  Tbsp. plain gelatin (1/2 oz.)
1/4  c. boiling water
3/4  c. milk
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
2  graham cracker crusts or Oreo cookie crusts
chopped peanuts, mini chocolate chips or chocolate curls and whipped cream (garnish)
preparation: Beat cream cheese, sugar and peanut butter until combined. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; combine with cream cheese mixture.  Add milk and stir until smooth.  Gently stir in Cool Whip until thoroughly mixed.  Pour into 2 pie crusts.  Freeze until shortly before serving time.

name: "CORN" BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
2  packets Splenda
5  eggs (room temperature)
1 1/2  c. almond flour
1/2  c. hazelnut flour
1  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. butter flavoring
1/4  c. corn bran or coarse grain corn meal
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: You can use almond flour but hazelnut flour gives more of a corn taste.

name: CROCK-POT POTATOES
ingredients:
1  carton sour cream
2  cans Cheddar cheese soup
1  stick margarine
6  to 8 potatoes, boiled
1  small onion, chopped and cooked
preparation: Melt margarine in saucepan and add sour cream and soup. Combine with cooked potatoes in crock-pot on low.  Heat for one hour.  Delicious!

name: SPUDS ELEGANT
ingredients:
4  c. hot mashed potatoes or 1 pkg. instant
8  oz. cream cheese
1  egg, beaten
1/3  c. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped pimiento
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
paprika
preparation: Blend cheese and egg into potatoes.  Add remaining ingredients, except paprika.  Bake for 45 minutes in 350° oven. Serves 6.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  eggs (beaten)
1  c. buttermilk
1 - 16  oz. can whole kernel corn (drained)
1 - 16  oz. can cream-style corn
1 - 8 1/2  oz. box Jiffy corn muffin mix
1  stick margarine (melted)
preparation: Combine all ingredients and pour into 9x13 inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 30-35 minutes.

name: OYSTERETTE SNACKS
ingredients:
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing mix
3/4  c. oil
1  Tbsp. dill weed
1 (15 oz.)  pkg. oyster crackers
preparation: Mix salad dressing mix,  oil  and  dill  weed  in bowl. Pour over crackers in  large  bowl.  Stir  gently  at  several minute intervals until  oil  is  absorbed.  Spread  on several layers  of paper towels.  Let	stand  for  1  hour.  Store  in airtight container.	Makes 10 cups.

name: LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
1 small  jar Ragu sauce
1  large bag Mozzarella cheese
1 small  can Parmesan cheese
1  box lasagne noodles
preparation: Brown and drain hamburger meat.  Add Ragu sauce and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes.  Cook noodles until tender and drain. Place noodles on foil to dry.  Place one layer of noodles in a large casserole dish.  Then add layer of hamburger meat.  Add layer of Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese; then repeat these steps again.  Place in oven for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

name: PUPPY CHOW(Good and Easy!)
ingredients:
12  oz. chocolate chips
1  c. peanut butter
1  stick butter or margarine
1  box powdered sugar
preparation: Melt together.  Pour mixture over 1 medium box of Crispix. Place mixture in a paper bag with the powdered sugar and shake. Then eat.

name: BEST EVER YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. dry yeast
1  c. warm water
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. boiling water
2/3  c. sugar, divided
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
6 to 7  c. all-purpose flour, divided
preparation: Dissolve yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar in 1 cup warm water; let stand about 5 minutes.  Combine remaining sugar, salt, butter and shortening in a large bowl.  Add boiling water, stirring until butter and shortening dissolve.  Cool slightly.  Add dissolved yeast, stirring well.  Add beaten eggs and 3 cups flour, beating until smooth.  Gradually stir in enough flour to make a soft dough.

name: CHEESE BLINTZES
ingredients:
2  loaves Wonder bread, cut off crusts
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  egg yolks
1/3  c. sugar
cinnamon and sugar
melted butter
preparation: Roll each slice of bread flat with rolling pin.  Spread cream cheese, egg and sugar mixture.  Roll in melted butter.  Roll in cinnamon and sugar mixture.  Freeze overnight.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1/2  box elbow macaroni, salted
1 large  can evaporated milk
3  eggs, beaten
1/2  stick margarine
2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Boil macaroni until tender.  Add other ingredients.  Sprinkle extra cheese on top.  Bake at 400° until bubbly and slightly brown.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  large chicken
2  qt. chicken broth
1  lb. spaghetti, broken small
1  large green pepper
1  large onion
2  garlic buttons
2  Tbsp. oleo
1 medium  bunch celery
1 small  can mushrooms
2 (No. 3)  cans tomatoes
1  lb. grated mild Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook chicken until tender.  Remove from bones; set aside. Cook spaghetti in 2 quarts chicken broth until done.  Dice green pepper, onion and garlic and saute in oleo.  Add diced celery, mushrooms and tomatoes.  Cook slowly for 2 hours.  Add to chicken and spaghetti.  Put in baking dish so it will be about 2 1/2 inches deep.  Cover with grated cheese and bake for 30 minutes.

name: CREAMED POTATOES
ingredients:
6  large potatoes
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Boil potatoes until well done and breaking apart.  Drain and add other ingredients.  Mix until smooth, adding more mayonnaise or butter, if needed.

name: GLAZED MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. bread crumbs
1  c. milk
1/2  c. minced onion
1  small green pepper, chopped
3  Tbsp. tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. horseradish
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1/8  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, bread crumbs, milk, egg, onion, 2 tablespoons tomato sauce, horseradish, salt and pepper. Mix well. Put in loaf pan. Combine remaining ingredients and spread over meat loaf. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: CHERRY WINKS COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. milk
1  c. pecans
1  c. chopped dates
1/2  c. maraschino cherries
preparation: Shape into balls and roll each ball in 2 1/2 cups crushed corn flakes.  Top each cookie with 1/2 cherry. Bake in oven at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes. Do not stack or store until cold.  Makes 5 dozen.

name: CREAM CHEESE CRESCENT
ingredients:
1  c. softened butter
8  oz. cream cheese
2  c. plain flour
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. chopped nuts
1/3  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Combine butter and cheese until well blended.  Add flour and salt and shape into eight balls.  Wrap in plastic and chill 2 hours.  Roll each ball of dough into 8-inch circle.  Cut into 8 wedges.  Combine nuts, sugar and cinnamon.  Sprinkle over each wedge.  Roll wedges into crescents.  Bake at 350° for 12 minutes. Dust warm cookies with powdered sugar.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1  jar Marshmallow Creme
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Use for fruit such as strawberries, grapes, cantaloupe, etc.

name: MAGIC LEMON MERINGUE PIE
ingredients:
1  baked (8-inch) pastry shell or graham cracker crust shell
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1  tsp. grated lemon rind
2  or 3 egg yolks
preparation: Mix in  medium  size  bowl.  Combine  Eagle Brand milk, lemon juice, rind and egg yolks.  Turn into pie shell.

name: SHRIMP IN WHITE WINE AND CREAM
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. shrimp, shelled and deveined
shallots
herbs (parsley, bay leaf, thyme, chervil, tarragon)
brandy
white wine
cream
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  egg yolks
preparation: Saute 1 finely chopped shallot in 3 tablespoons butter.  Add shrimp, pinch of thyme, bay leaf, salt and pepper.  Simmer for 7 minutes.  Warm 2 tablespoons brandy; light it and pour it flaming over the shrimp.  When flame has died, add 3/4 cup white wine. Simmer further 5 minutes, then transfer to heated serving dish. Reduce pan juices by half; add mixture of cream, egg yolks, 1 teaspoon lemon juice and 1 teaspoon each of parsley, chervil and tarragon.   Stir well and pour sauce over shrimp.  Do not let boil.  Serves 4.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. white Karo syrup
1  c. water
2  c. white sugar
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3  tsp. vanilla
3  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Stir until well blended.  Pour into greased cookie sheet.  Let cool, then break into pieces.

name: WATER CHESTNUT HORS D'OEUVRES
ingredients:
2  cans water chestnuts, cut to thumb size
1 to 1 1/2  lb. bacon
1  bottle catsup
8 big  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Wrap chestnuts with 1/2 slice of bacon; fasten with a toothpick.  Place in rows in 9 x 6 x 12-inch pan.  Bake at 350° until bacon is almost done but not crisp.  Remove from oven; pour off grease.  Combine catsup and sugar.  Pour around but not over chestnuts.  Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350°.  Serve immediately. Yield:  15 to 18 servings.

name: PECAN ROLL
ingredients:
1  c. light brown sugar
2  c. granulated sugar
1  c. evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. white corn syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix sugar, milk and syrup and cook slowly until mixture forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water.  Remove from heat and let cool to lukewarm.  Add vanilla and beat until mixture will hold its shape.  Turn out on board which has been dusted with confectioners sugar.  Shape into a long roll about 2 inches in diameter.  Roll in chopped pecans; wrap in waxed paper and place in refrigerator to harden.  Slice with sharp knife.  Makes 1 pound.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. shredded Cheddar
8  oz. French onoin dip
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. taco seasoning
shredded lettuce
cut up tomatoes
8  oz. shredded Cheddar
1  jar hot or mild taco sauce or salsa
preparation: Mix cream cheese and 8 ounces Cheddar together with French onion dip.  Spread in 9 or 10-inch pie plate and refrigerate. Brown ground beef and add taco seasoning; spread on cream cheese layer.  Next, sprinkle shredded lettuce and cut-up tomatoes on meat layer and sprinkle with 8 ounces Cheddar cheese.  Pour taco sauce or salsa over lettuce and tomato layer.  Use tortilla chips for dipping.

name: BROWN RICE
ingredients:
1  c. white rice
1  can beef broth (bouillon)
1  can consomme (beef)
1  stick margarine
salt
pepper
preparation: Place white rice in casserole dish.  Put in the can of beef broth and consomme.  Add salt, pepper and pats of margarine.  Mix together.  Put in oven at 350° for 1 hour.

name: HERSHEY BAR CAKE
ingredients: chocolate cake mix (pudding recipe)
preparation: Cook cake mix in 3 layers.

name: CHICKEN BARLEY SOUP
ingredients:
1  (2 to 3 lb.) broiler-fryer chicken, cut up
2  qt. water
1 1/2  c. diced carrots
1  c. diced celery
1/2  c. barley
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  chicken bouillon cube (optional)
1  bay leaf
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. dried sage
preparation: In a large kettle, cook chicken in water until tender.  Remove chicken, let cool enough to handle, then remove bones and skin and cut into bite-size pieces.  Cool broth and skim off fat.  Return chicken to kettle and add remaining ingredients.  Cover and simmer for at least 1 hour or until vegetables and barley are tender. Remove bay leaf.  Yield: 5 servings.

name: RUM BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. vanilla wafer crumbs
1/2  c. rum
1/2  c. honey
1  lb. ground walnuts
powdered sugar
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients.  Shape into balls and roll in powdered sugar.  Store in cool place in airtight container.

name: MAC-N-CHEESE
ingredients:
1  lb. macaroni, cooked
16  oz. Cheddar cheese
16  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese
16  oz. Swiss cheese
milk (enough to cover halfway up baking dish)
salt and pepper to taste
butter or oleo to taste
preparation: Cook macaroni; drain. In a large bowl, shred cheeses on macaroni and stir gently. Salt and pepper to taste. Mix in pats of butter. Pour into baking dish of gallon size. Pour over milk. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or more if needed.

name: P. B. GRAHAM SNACKERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter flavor Crisco
2  c. powdered sugar
3/4  c. creamy peanut butter
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs, crushed peanuts or chocolate sprinkles
preparation: Combine Crisco, powdered sugar and peanut butter in a large bowl.  Beat at low speed with electric mixer until well blended. Stir in 1 cup of crumbs and chocolate chips.   Cover.  Refrigerate 1 hour.  Form dough into 1-inch balls.   roll in 1/2 cup of crumbs for a fancier cookie.  Cover.  Refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes 3 dozen.

name: LYRICAL LIME PIE
ingredients:
1  (9 oz.) container Cool Whip
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed
1 (15 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
2  (9-inch) graham cracker pie crusts
preparation: Combine Cool Whip, limeade, milk and lemon juice.  Spoon into crusts.  Chill until cold.  May add green food coloring, if desired.  Will keep in refrigerator for 1 week.

name: GERMAN POTATO PANCAKES
ingredients:
4  to 5 medium raw potatoes
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Grate potatoes, add salt and egg and mix well.  Drop by tablespoons in well-greased frying pan, spreading real thin.  Fry slowly until browned on each side.

name: DIRT DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. Oreos
1/4  c. margarine
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
2  (3 oz.) instant vanilla pudding
3 1/2  c. milk
12  oz. Cool Whip
gummy worms (if desired)
preparation: Blend Oreos (a few at a time) in a blender.  Set aside.

name: ORANGE FLUFF
ingredients:
12  oz. Light 'n Lively low-fat cottage cheese
1 small  pkg. sugar-free orange jello
1  c. fruit cocktail, drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients together.  Cover and refrigerate. Sprinkle  with crushed pecans or walnuts before refrigeration. (Good summertime dessert.)

name: GLAZED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
4  pork chops
4  Tbsp. brown sugar
4  Tbsp. margarine
salt and pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place pork chops in shallow Pyrex baking dish.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Place 1 tablespoon margarine on each pork chop.  Spread 1 tablespoon sugar over each chop.  Bake 40 to 45 minutes.

name: CRAB SOUP
ingredients:
2  cans beef bouillon
2  cans water
1  can tomato soup
1  can water
1  can white corn
1 large  can crushed tomatoes
1  can vegetarian vegetable soup
1  can water
1  large bag frozen mixed vegetables
1  onion, diced
2  stalks celery, diced
1/4  c. barley or handful of lentils
1  lb. crab claw meat
Old Bay seasoning to taste
1  c. cooked macaroni noodles (optional)
preparation: Add all ingredients to large pot, except crabmeat.  Simmer for one hour.  Add crabmeat.  Simmer 10 more minutes.  Serve.

name: CRAB SUPREME(Make One Day Ahead)
ingredients:
8  slices soft bread, diced
1  lb. crab meat, remove any shell
1  chopped onion
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  tsp. Accent
1/2  tsp. salt
4  beaten eggs
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
2  c. cold milk
paprika
1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Cook celery, green pepper and onion slowly in small amount of water for 10 minutes.  Place 1/2 of diced bread into 9 x 12-inch cake pan or equivalent casserole dish.  Mix together crab meat, cooked celery, onion and green pepper, mayonnaise, Accent and salt.  Spread over diced bread and top with remaining 1/2 of bread.  Mix together eggs and milk and pour over ingredients in dish.  Cover and place in refrigerator for at least 4 hours. Remove from refrigerator, spoon mushroom soup over top and sprinkle with paprika and cheese.  Bake for 10 to 15 minutes at 325°.

name: OREO ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1 (19 oz.)  pkg. Oreos
1  stick butter
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
1 (11 oz.)  jar fudge topping
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Crush Oreos and place in bottom of pan.  Pour melted butter over top.  Put a layer each of vanilla ice cream and fudge topping. Top off with layer of Cool Whip.

name: JAM CAKE
ingredients:
5  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. butter
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. cloves
1 1/2  tsp. allspice
1  c. raisins or chopped dates
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. blackberry jam
preparation: Cream butter and gradually add sugar. Cream together until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time. Sift flour before measuring and add spices and salt. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Add it and the flour mixture alternately to the egg, sugar and butter mixture; beat after each addition.  Lightly dredge fruit and nuts with extra flour and add. Add the jam. Stir well. Cook about 25 minutes at 375°.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
2  c. macaroni
3  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Cook macaroni and drain.  Melt butter.  Blend in flour.  Slowly add milk and cook until smooth and thickened.  Add salt, pepper and 1 1/2 cups cheese.  Pour over macaroni and sprinkle with bread crumbs and remaining cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: PARTY PIZZA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lean hamburger
1  lb. sausage
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1 (16 oz.)  jar pizza sauce
preparation: Brown meat; drain.  Add other ingredients and simmer until cheese melts.  Spread on English muffin halves and heat until muffins are hot.

name: HOLIDAY SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1  can cream of shrimp soup (Campbell's is all I have ever seen and that is scarce)
1  can chopped or minced clams (whichever you prefer), reserve juice
1  block cream cheese (the big one, I think 8 oz?) softened
1  tbsp (or so) dry parsley
1  tsp (or so) horseradish
preparation: In a bowl, beat cream cheese with a little clam juice, just enough to make it creamy, maybe a tsp or so.  Add Cream of Shrimp soup, continue beating.  Drain remainder of clams, add clams to soup mixture, add Parsley.  Add enough parsley to make it look pretty, it just gives it a little color.  Add Horseradish, now this is where personal taste comes into play, just don't overdue it too much can ruin it.  I, personally, like to have a little zing in mine, but not to much so my eyes water.  Chill before serving.  It can last a few days in the fridge, but when more green shows up then just the parsley, it is time to ditch it.

name: MARINATED AND GRILLED SHRIMP
ingredients:
1/3  c. sherry
1/3  c. sesame seed oil
1/3  c. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
2  lb. large fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except shrimp in a shallow dish and mix well.  Add shrimp, tossing gently to coat.  Cover and chill for 2 to 3 hours, stirring occasionally.  Drain shrimp, reserving marinade.  Place shrimp on 6 (14-inch) skewers.  Grill over medium-hot coals 3 to 4 minutes on each side, basting frequently with marinade.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: TEXAS RICE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. water
1 1/4  c. quick cooking rice
1  envelope instant creamy chicken soup
1  tsp. dried minced onion
parsley (optional)
preparation: In 3-quart casserole, combine water, uncooked rice, soup mix and onion.  Put in microwave for 4 to 5 minutes or until boiling. Let stand, covered, 5 minutes.  Stir before serving.

name: BUTTER NUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco shortening
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2 1/2  c. sifted self-rising flour
1  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. butternut flavoring
preparation: Cream sugar, Crisco and eggs together for 10 minutes at high speed in mixing bowl.  Add 1 cup flour.  Beat on high for 1 minute.  Add remaining flour and milk.  Beat 1 minute on high. Add butternut flavoring.  Beat well.  Pour in greased tube pan. Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: OATMEAL BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. mashed bananas
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. oats
3/4  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar well.  Add eggs, one at a time, mixing thoroughly after each addition.  Add bananas and mix well. Sift flour, soda and salt.  Add with oats to creamed mixture. Stir in nuts and vanilla.  Pour batter into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan and bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until an inserted toothpick comes out clean.

name: STRAWBERRY FILLED ANGEL CAKE
ingredients:
1  baked 10-inch angel food cake
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin
1  c. boiling water
2/3  c. cold water or juice from strawberries
1  c. sliced strawberries (fresh or frozen; 1 lb. pkg.  frozen)
2  envelopes Dream Whip or 1 (12 oz.) Cool Whip (I use Dream Whip)
preparation: Cut a 1/2-inch horizontal slice from top of cake.  Then carefully hollow out remainder of cake, leaving 1/2-inch shell on bottom and sides including around the hole.  Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Add cold water if using fresh strawberries or juice from thawed berries (if using frozen).  If not enough juice, add water to make 2/3 cup.  Add berries and chill until slightly thickened.  Prepare Dream Whip as directed after gelatin is slightly thickened.   Blend 2 cups of Dream Whip or Cool Whip with the gelatin mixture.  Spoon part of the gelatin mixture into the hollow cake.

name: TOOT'S BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
3  mashed bananas
2  eggs
chopped walnuts
1/2  c. shortening
3  Tbsp. hot water
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix sugar, shortening and well beaten eggs.  Dissolve soda in hot water.  Add 1 cup flour.  Add bananas and rest of flour.  Bake for 1 hour or more at 350°.

name: KOREAN GARLIC STEAK
ingredients:
1  flank steak (2 to 3 lb.), fat cut off
2  Tbsp. sesame oil
1  Tbsp. minced ginger
4  Tbsp. minced scallions
2  Tbsp. minced garlic
1  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients except soy sauce.  Marinate overnight in refrigerator or 4 hours room temperature.  Add soy sauce a few minutes before broiling.  Broil for 3 minutes on each side, basting with remaining liquid.  Slice diagonally.

name: DEPRESSION CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large onion, chopped
1 to 2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1/2  c. ketchup
1/2  c. vinegar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  pkg. frankfurters, cut into 1-inch chunks
toast points or cooked rice (optional)
preparation: In a saucepan, saute onion in oil until tender.  Stir in ketchup, water, vinegar, mustard and pepper.  Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.  Place franks in a 1-quart baking dish. Pour sauce over.  Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 30 minutes.  Serve over toast points or rice.  Yields 5 servings.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. oil
1 1/4  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. nutmeg
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. soda
3 1/3  c. flour
2/3  c. water
2  c. pumpkin
4  eggs
preparation: Mix sugar, oil and eggs.  Add salt, nutmeg, cinnamon, soda and flour.  Stir in water and pumpkin.  Bake in three 9 x 5 x 3-inch bread pans at 350° for 60 minutes.

name: PEANUT PATTIE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. white syrup
1  c. water
3  c. raw peanuts
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter
15 to 20  drops red food coloring
preparation: Combine 3 cups sugar, 1 cup syrup and 1 cup water in large saucepan.  Bring to boil; add peanuts and food coloring.  Boil to soft ball stage.  Remove from heat; add vanilla, salt and butter. Stir until thick; spread out onto buttered tin foil.

name: APRICOT CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
8  oz. Catalina salad dressing
1 small  jar apricot preserves
10  to 12 boneless chicken breasts
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients together.  Pour over chicken breasts in 9 x 13-inch pan and marinate for 24 hours.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Cover for first hour, then uncover last half hour.

name: STACKED ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  pkg. flour tortillas
1 lrg.  can whole green chilies
3/4  lb. Monterrey Jack cheese, shredded
2  lb. mexican meat (receipe below)
1 (14 oz.)  can black refried beans
1  can mild enchilada sauce
12  oz. picante sauce
preparation: Mix enchilada sauce and picante sauce.  Tile bottom of 9x13 greased pan with tortillas so completely covered.  Split open green chilies and layer on tortillas.  Mix meat and beans together and spread half over chilies.  Pour half the sauce over and top with 1/3 of the cheese.  Repeat layers and top with a layer of tortillas and the rest of the cheese.  Bake at 350 for 30-45 minutes or until cheese on top is melted and brown.  Let stand 15-20 minutes out of oven, then cut into squares.

name: CHILIES AND SAUSAGE QUICHE
ingredients:
2  uncooked 8-inch pie shells
1 (7 oz.)  can whole green chilies
1  lb. hot, bulk sausage, cooked and crumbled
4  eggs, lightly beaten
2  c. half and half
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. grated Swiss cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Line bottom of pie shells with split and seeded whole green chilies. Sprinkle sausage over chilies. Combine eggs, cheeses and seasonings.  Pour over sausage. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until top is golden brown. Remove from oven and allow to set 5 minutes before serving. Serves 8.

name: MOM'S YORKSHIRE PUDDING(Serves 6)
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  large egg
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. water
2 to 3  Tbsp. beef drippings or vegetable oil
preparation: Sift the flour and salt into a large bowl.  Lightly beat the egg in another bowl and stir in the milk and water with a fork. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture and gradually pour in the liquid, whisking just until the batter is smooth.  Let the batter rest for 1 hour.  Heat the oven to 425°.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. plain flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. buttermilk
1 1/2  c. Wesson oil
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vinegar
1  oz. red food coloring
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Add buttermilk, oil, eggs, vanilla and vinegar.  Mix thoroughly.  Add food coloring and mix well.  Spread batter in greased and floured cake pans.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until done.  Remove from pan; let cool.

name: CRUSTLESS SWEET POTATO PINEAPPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. mashed sweet potatoes
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. milk
3/4  c. sugar (brown or white)
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. salt (optional)
1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
preparation: Combine sweet potatoes, eggs, sugar and milk.  Beat until blended and smooth.  Add other ingredients and mix well.  Stir in crumbs.  Grease a deep 9-inch pie pan; pour filling in pan.  Bake in a preheated oven for 45 to 55 minutes at 325° or until a knife inserted comes out clean.  Cool and refrigerate; top with whipped cream or topping.  Cut in wedges and serve.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  to 5 medium pork chops
5  to 6 potatoes
1  can cream of chicken or mushroom soup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Grease a 1/2-quart casserole dish with butter.  Cut potatoes in thin slices and put in the bottom of dish.  Salt and pepper. Brown pork chops and put on top.  Pour soup over chops.  Cover; bake at 350° for 1 hour until potatoes are tender.

name: CORN RELISH
ingredients:
12  ears corn
1  small head cabbage
4  medium onions, peeled
3  sweet red peppers, seeded
2  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. turmeric powder
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  qt. vinegar
preparation: Cook corn on cob just enough to set milk, about 3 minutes. Cut from cob.  Put cabbage, onions and peppers through food chopper, using coarse blade.  Combine all vegetables.  Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes.  Seal at once in hot sterilized jars.  Makes about 8 pints.

name: CAESAR SALAD
ingredients:
1  clove garlic, crushed
2/3  c. olive oil
4  qt. romaine lettuce, chilled, torn (about 3 medium heads)
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. fresh ground pepper
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1  egg
3 to 4  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
6  to 8 anchovy fillets, chopped
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  c. croutons
preparation: Add garlic to oil; let stand overnight.  Discard garlic.  Place romaine in large salad bowl.  Sprinkle with salt, pepper and Worcestershire.  Coddle egg for 1 1/2 minutes; break into middle of salad.  Pour lemon juice and wine vinegar over egg.  Toss lightly to mix well.  Add remaining ingredients, tossing after each addition.  Adjust servings if necessary.  Serve immediately.  Makes 8 servings.

name: PANCAKES WITH ORANGE SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sifted all-purpose flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. orange juice
3  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
1 or 2  c. cottage cheese
preparation: Sift together dry ingredients.  Combine eggs, milk, orange juice and margarine.  Stir into dry ingredients.  Bake 4 large pancakes on hot griddle, one at a time, using 2/3 cup batter for each.  Stack pancakes, spreading cottage cheese between each.  To serve, cut into wedges and spoon Orange Sauce over top.

name: CHICKPEA, PASTA AND SPINACH SOUP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. marjoram
1/4  tsp. rosemary
10  oz. frozen chopped spinach, unthawed
1 (16 oz.)  can chickpeas, drained
2  c. beef broth plus 4 c. water
1  c. tube-shaped pasta
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Heat oil in saucepan 1 minute.  Saute onion.  Stir in garlic, marjoram and rosemary and saute 2 minutes longer.  Add spinach; cover.  Cook over moderate heat until tender, about 5 minutes.  Add chickpeas and stock and bring to a simmer over moderate heat.  Add pasta and cook uncovered 10 minutes until pasta is tender.  Stir in salt and pepper.  Serve with Parmesan cheese.

name: PHYLLO CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine, melted and divided
12  sheets phyllo
3  c. diced chicken
1/2  lb. bacon, cooked and crumbled
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
2  c. shredded Cheddar or Swiss
6  eggs
1  c. light cream or evaporated milk
1/2  c. milk
salt and pepper
preparation: Brush sides and bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan with melted butter. Place 1 sheet phyllo on bottom.  Brush with butter.  Repeat 5 more sheets (keep remaining phyllo covered with wax paper to prevent drying out.)  In bowl, combine chicken, bacon, broccoli and cheese. Spread over phyllo.  In another bowl, whisk eggs, cream, milk, salt and pepper.  Pour over chicken.  Cover with 1 phyllo and brush with butter.  Repeat remaining phyllo, top and butter.  Bake uncovered at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: ROQUEFORT DRESSING
ingredients:
1  qt. buttermilk
1  qt. mayonnaise
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
2  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. onion powder
2  tsp. garlic powder
2  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
preparation: Mix well and let it set for a few hours.  Makes 2 1/2 quarts.

name: HARVEST CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. diced apples
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. cooking oil
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. soda
3  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix apples and sugar together.  Add eggs.  Beat in cooking oil, vanilla, baking soda and flour.  Add chopped nuts.  Bake in greased tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

name: CRUNCH
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. berries
1  c. sugar
3  tsp. cornstarch
preparation: Cook until thickened.

name: CHEESY ZUCCHINI BAKE
ingredients:
2  medium tomatoes, peeled and cut into wedges
2  small zucchini, sliced
1/8  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. dried basil
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
2  small yellow squash, sliced
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/3  c. dry bread crumbs
1  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Combine tomatoes, zucchini, yellow squash, seasonings and Cheddar cheese.  Place in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Top with Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until vegetables are tender.  Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and let stand 5 minutes before serving.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: CHOCOLATE SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  c. water
3/4  c. cooking oil
1  stick butter or margarine
1/2 to 1  c. nuts (if desired)
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Grease and flour a 9 x 4 x 13-inch sheet pan.  In mixing bowl, mix flour and sugar;  set aside.   In saucepan, bring to a boil the water, cooking oil, butter and cocoa.   Boil 1 minute; pour over flour and sugar.  Mix.   Mix buttermilk with soda.  Pour into mixture.  Add unbeaten eggs, one at a time.  Add salt and stir.   Pour mixture into pan and bake at 325° for 30 minutes. Prepare icing while cake bakes.  Ice Cake hot out of oven.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. Karo syrup
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. pecans
1  (9-inch) pie shell (frozen)
preparation: Preheat oven and cookie sheet to 350°.  In a large bowl, stir the first 5 ingredients until well blended.  Stir in pecans.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake on cookie sheet 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool.  Serves 8.

name: EGG ROLLS
ingredients:
vermicelli (bean thread)
egg roll skins
fresh bean sprouts
boneless chicken cutlets (skinless)
cabbage
Cajun seasoning
garlic
cooking oil
preparation: Cut chicken into smaller pieces; using a food processor, chop the chicken to the consistency of ground beef.  Chop the cabbage (approximately 2 pounds) to the consistency of cole slaw.  Take 2 nests of the bean threads from package; soak them in hot water to soften the threads, then cut into 2-inch strips.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  c. celery, chopped
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1 small  jar chopped pimento
2  cans boned chicken
2  hard-boiled eggs
grated sharp Cheddar cheese
crushed potato chips
preparation: Toss together ingredients except cheese and potato chips. Place mixture in sprayed loaf pan.  Top with cheese and chips. Bake at 350° until bubbles.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
1/4  c. flour
2  c. sugar less 2 Tbsp.
1  stick butter/margarine
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. buttermilk
3  beaten eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix flour and sugar; add melted butter, then buttermilk, beaten eggs, salt and vanilla.  Bake in uncooked pie shell until firm in 325° oven for 1 hour.

name: VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  box frozen mixed vegetables, cooked and drained
1  can red kidney beans, rinsed
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. plain flour
preparation: Cook until clear.  Cool and pour over vegetables.  Refrigerate 24 hours before serving.

name: BRAISED VENISON
ingredients:
2  lb. venison stew meat
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  onion, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
6  oz. wine
preparation: Sauté onion and celery.  Add stew meat and brown.  Add garlic powder and black pepper.  Bring to a boil.  Add wine.  Turn to simmer.  Cook 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

name: KOOKIE KAT SUNDAE
ingredients:
your favorite ice cream
M&M's
small round cookies (chocolate or vanilla wafers)
small plastic dishes
preparation: Using instant chocolate icing, "glue" 3/4 of a round chocolate waver onto a chocolate covered marshmallow cookie.  This makes the fan tail.  Next, glue a candy corn to the opposite side, making the head.  Easy to make and kids have fun with them!

name: OVEN STEW
ingredients:
4  to 6 carrots, cut in 1 1/2-inch lengths
3  celery stems, cut in 1 1/2-inch lengths
2  to 4 potatoes (large chunks)
1 (No. 2)  can tomatoes
1  slice bread, crumbled
3  Tbsp. tapioca
1  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
2  onions, cut small
small can mushrooms
1 1/2 to 2  lb. stew meat
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and put in roasting pan with a tight lid.  Bake at 225° to 250° for 5 hours.  Serve as is or in bread bowls.

name: FRUIT-NUT-WHITE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1 2/3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. Land O Lakes butter, softened
1  c. packed brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
2  c. Nestle Toll House white chips
1  c. chopped nuts
3/4  c. chopped Sun-Maid fruit bits
preparation: Combine flour, soda and salt in small bowl.  Beat butter, brown sugar and vanilla in large bowl until creamy.  Beat in egg. Gradually beat in flour mixture.  Stir in chips, nuts and fruit bits.

name: SLICED BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes
1  tsp. salt
2 to 3  Tbsp. melted butter
2 to 3  Tbsp. dried herbs of your choice (parsley, chives, thyme or sage)
4  Tbsp. grated Cheddar cheese (low-fat)
1 1/2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Peel potatoes if skin is tough, otherwise just scrub and rinse them.  Cut potatoes into thin slices, but not all the way through. Use a handle of a spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way through.  Put potatoes in a baking dish, fan them slightly. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter.  Sprinkle with herbs. Bake potatoes at 425° for 50 minutes.  Remove from oven, sprinkle with cheeses and bake potatoes another 10 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned, cheeses are melted and potatoes are soft inside.

name: PULL APART ROLLS
ingredients:
1  1/2 recipe biscuit dough (Bisquick)
6  Tbsp. butter, melted
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1/2  Tbsp. nutmeg
preparation: Form biscuit dough into 2 rolls about 12 inches long.  Cut each roll into 6 pieces and form into balls.  Dip balls into melted butter.  Dip each ball into mixed nuts, sugar and spices. Place rolls in double row in greased loaf pan.   Bake in hot oven (400°) for 30 minutes or until done.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
pork chops
1  can French onion soup
1  can beef broth
1  c. rice
1 1/2  c. plain yogurt or sour cream
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. Hungarian sweet paprika
1  garlic clove, minced
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
1/4  tsp. pepper
8  boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
2  c. fine dry bread crumbs
preparation: In a large bowl, combine first 8 ingredients.  Place chicken in mixture and turn to coat.  Cover and marinate overnight in the refrigerator.  Remove chicken from marinade; coat each piece with crumbs.  Arrange on a shallow baking pan.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes or until juices run clear.  Yield: 8 servings.

name: SWEET CHERRY MOLD(A Christmas Special)
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. cherry jello
1  c. hot water
1  c. cold water
1 (No. 2 1/2 )  can sweet cherries
1 (14 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. whipping cream
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Put jello in bowl; add hot water and stir until jello is dissolved.  Add cold water.  Drain cherries and pineapple and add juice of both to jello.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  c. Hellmann's
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  small onion, minced
dash of garlic salt
2  cans tiny cocktail shrimp, drained
preparation: Beat all ingredients, except shrimp, until smooth.  Add shrimp and beat slightly.  Serve cold.  Very good.

name: KANSAS HASH
ingredients:
1  large onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1  lb. ground meat
1  can tomatoes
chili powder
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and pepper
1/2  c. raw rice
preparation: Cook  onion,   pepper  and  meat  together.  Add  other ingredients.  Cook one hour covered at 325°.

name: GERMAN APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs (3 if small)
2  c. flour
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
1  c. nuts
4  c. thinly sliced apples
6  oz. cream cheese
3  Tbsp. soft oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix and spread on cake.

name: FRUIT-GLAZED EASTER HAM
ingredients:
5 to 7  lb. smoked ham
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/3  c. orange marmalade
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
dash of allspice
1/3  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Place ham, fat side up, on rack in open roasting pan.  Insert meat thermometer so bulb is centered in thickest part.  Be careful bulb does not rest in fat or on bone.  Do not add water.  Do not cover.  Roast at 325° until meat thermometer registers 130° to 140° for "fully cooked" half ham (18 to 24 minutes per pound) or 160° for a "cook before eating" half ham (22 to 25 minutes per pound).

name: GRANOLA (CEREAL)
ingredients:
1  c. raw sugar
1  c. raw (or toasted) wheat germ
1/2  c. toasted coconut
1  c. almonds, ground up
1  c. filberts, ground up
2  qt. oatmeal (dry)
3/4  c. honey
1  c. peanut oil
preparation: Mix with hands and place on two cookie sheets.  Bake in a 325° oven for 10 minutes; stir.  Bake 10 minutes longer or until light brown.  Store in airtight container.

name: CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
1  can pork and beans
1  can kidney beans
1  can lima beans
1/4 to 1/2  lb. bacon
1  lb. hamburger
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. ketchup
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Drain beans and save liquid.  Brown bacon and hamburger. Saute onions.  Combine beans, hamburger, bacon and onions. Combine remaining ingredients and mix.  Pour into pan.  If it looks too dry, add some of bean liquid.  Bake at 350° for at least 1 hour.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  c. thinly sliced potatoes
1  onion, peeled and sliced thin
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
3  Tbsp. flour
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. margarine
1 1/2  c. skim milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a lightly oiled casserole dish, place a layer of potatoes.  Sprinkle with flour, then place a layer of onion.  Sprinkle each layer with flour.  Alternate onion and potatoes until all are used.  Salt and pepper each layer. Heat the milk and margarine; pour over potatoes.  Cover casserole; bake for 1 hour.  Remove cover and bake another 1/2 hour to brown. Yields 6 servings.

name: WHOLE WHEAT BREAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. yeast dissolved in 1/2 c. warm water and 2 tsp. sugar
6  c. whole wheat flour
2 1/4  c. lukewarm water
2 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. salt
1  stick margarine
preparation: Combine  5  cups  of  flour, sugar and salt.  Mix well. Add dissolved  yeast  and  water.  Knead for 20 minutes.  Add small amounts of flour to prevent sticking.  You may need more flour. Cut  margarine  into  small  bits.  Knead  into dough. Toward  end of kneading, dough will become supple and elastic. Form into ball.  Put  into  a large bowl to rise.  Cover with wet  towel placed on some sticks across the bowl.  Let rise in warm place until double in size (a heating pad is good), about 1  to  1 1/2 hours depending on warmth.  Punch down.  Let rise again,  about 1/2 time of first time.  Turn dough onto floured table  top.  Cut in  1/2 and shape into 2 loaves.  Place in 2 greased  8  x  4-inch bread pans.  Let rise once more about 20 minutes.  Loaves  should arch over tops of pans.  Preheat oven to 425°.  Bake for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to 325°.  Bake for 35 minutes more.

name: BRAISED PORK CHOPS WITH SAUERKRAUT(Makes 6 Servings)
ingredients:
6  slices diced, sauteed bacon
2  lb. drained sauerkraut
2  c. applesauce
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/4  c. water
1/2  Tbsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. freshly ground pepper
6  loin pork chops (1-inch thick)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.   Have ready the bacon.  Mix it in a casserole with drained sauerkraut, applesauce, brown sugar, water, dry mustard and ground pepper.    Saute gently on both sides the pork chops.  Place them on top of the mixture.  Cover and bake 1 hour.

name: RED SAUCE
ingredients:
1/3  c. water
14  oz. bottle Heinz catsup
12  oz. bottle Heinz chili sauce
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
preparation: Mix together mustard, sugar and water, leaving no lumps.  Add remaining ingredients and bring to slight boil.  After chops are tender, remove from oven and dip in red sauce.  After dipping, bake 30 minutes more at 350° or until slightly glazed.

name: PLAY CLAY
ingredients:
1/2  c. salt
1  c. flour
1/3  c. water
1  Tbsp. liquid cooking oil
few drops food coloring
preparation: Combine the water and colored cooking oil.  Add this water mixture to flour and salt.  The clay should be the consistency of biscuits or pie dough.  When not being used, store in plastic bag or sealed container in refrigerator.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. Lipton vegetable soup mix
16  oz. sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  box frozen spinach, drain and squeeze
1  can water chestnuts, drain and chop
preparation: Mix well.

name: DATE BALLS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  box dates, cut up
3/4  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
1/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. Rice Krispies cereal
1  c. chopped nuts
about 1 c. coconut
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients and cook over medium heat until thick.  Stir constantly.  Add vanilla and mix.  Then add Rice Krispies cereal and chopped nuts.  Mix well.  When cool enough to handle, form into small balls and roll in coconut.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 2/3  c. sugar
3/4  c. oil
1/4  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. shredded zucchini
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In a large bowl beat eggs, sugar, oil, milk and vanilla.  In separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon.  Add dry ingredients to egg mixture and beat 2 minutes. Then add zucchini and nuts.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Makes 2 regular size loaf pans.  Grease and flour baking pans well.  Keep refrigerated.  Also freezes well.

name: SUNSHINE CARROTS
ingredients:
7  or 8 medium carrots
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  c. orange juice
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Bias-slice carrots crosswise about 1/2-inch thick.  Cook, covered, in boiling, salted water, until just tender, 15 to 20 minutes; drain.  Meanwhile, combine sugar, cornstarch, salt and ginger in small saucepan.  Add orange juice, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and bubbles.  Boil 1 minute.  Stir in butter or margarine.  Pour over hot carrots, tossing to coat evenly. Garnish with parsley, if desired.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CREAMY POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
8  slices bacon
1  large stalk celery, chopped
1  onion, chopped
4  small carrots, thinly sliced
8  small potatoes, peeled and cubed
6  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Fry bacon in soup pot until crisp; drain, reserving 2 tablespoons of pan drippings.  Saute celery, onion and carrots in reserved pan drippings over medium heat until tender.
