Add potatoes.  Cook until slightly browned, stirring frequently.  Add milk.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat.  Add salt and pepper.  Cook over low heat for 30 to 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Mix sour cream and flour in small bowl.  Stir into soup.  Cook over low heat for 5 to 10 minutes or until of desired consistency. Ladle into serving bowls; sprinkle with crumbled bacon.  Yields 8 servings.

name: BREAKFAST HASH
ingredients:
2  eggs (no shell)
1/2  c. diced, cooked potato
1  broken strip of bacon or 1 diced sausage link
1  cheese slice, cut in strips
1  splash milk
pepper to taste
salt (if you insist; not in mine!)
preparation: In small microwave bowl, combine all ingredients, stirring completely, until foamy.   Cook on High for 1 minute in microwave; remove and stir again.   Cook for approximately 1 more minute or until done to your likeness.   Serve with toast and orange juice and enjoy!!

name: GARLIC POT ROAST
ingredients:
1  fresh garlic head
1  medium pot roast
1/2  c. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. soy sauce
salt and pepper
water
preparation: Stuff pea sized pieces of garlic into one inch cuts in roast by using a sharp knife. Do this all over roast, then brown roast in a large skillet with just enough grease to lightly cover bottom of pan. After roast is browned on both sides, put into a crock pot, add salt and pepper and the sauces. Finish filling crock pot 3/4 full with water. Cook for 8 to 10 hours on high or until tender. (You may add onions, carrots and potatoes if desired, then fill with water.)

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
8 or 9  qt. popped corn
2  c. brown sugar
1  c. butter
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. Karo syrup
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put popped corn in a large roaster pan.  Boil all ingredients, except popped corn and baking soda, for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Add soda; stir quickly and pour over popped corn while foamy.  Mix well.  Place in a 250° oven for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes while baking.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
2 1/2  c. fine sliced apples
1  tsp. soda
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well. Bake in 9 x 13 pan at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: BUTTERMILK CAKE
ingredients:
2 3/4  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
4  large eggs
1  c. buttermilk
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking ???
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together sugar and shortening; cream.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Combine dry ingredients.  Add flour and milk alternately. Add vanilla and mix well.  Bake in a greased and floured tube pan for 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 325°.  Bake until real brown.  Let cool and invert pan.

name: STUFFED ACORN SQUASH
ingredients:
2  small or 1 medium size acorn squash
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. fine bread crumbs
salt and pepper to taste
butter
preparation: Boil whole squash in salted water until almost tender.  Remove tops to make cavities for stuffing.  Scoop out stringy insides and discard.  Drain water that collects.  Beat eggs until frothy.  Add grated onion, cheese, bread crumbs, salt and pepper.

name: AUSTRIAN/HUNGARIAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
6  strips bacon
3 to 4  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. white vinegar
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. water
preparation: Cut bacon in small pieces and fry until quite crisp and most fat is out.  Pour off fat, leaving about 3 or 4 tablespoons.  Stir in flour and let the mixture come to a bubble.

name: CLAM BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. clams
1  c. mushroom soup
1  stick oleo
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. Old Bay
1  1/2 bags cubes
celery seed
1  small onion
preparation: Bake 1/2 hour at 350°.

name: CHICKEN AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
3  cooked chicken breasts
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sharp grated cheese
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Chop chicken, then layer the broccoli in a casserole dish. Blend cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice.  Pour over chicken and broccoli.  Sprinkle the cheese and bread crumbs on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies(Yield: 2 Dozen Cookies)
ingredients:
1/2  cup Butter, softened
1/4  cup Granulated Sugar
1/2  cup Firmly Packed Dark Brown Sugar
1  Egg
1/2  tsp. Vanilla Extract
1  1/8 cups All-Purpose Flour
1/2  tsp. Baking Soda
pinch Salt
1  cup Chocolate Chips
1/2  cup walnuts, chopped
preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease two baking sheets.

name: CHOCOLATE-SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
2  c. sugar
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
6  large eggs
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. cocoa
8  oz. sour cream
2  tsp. vanilla extract
powdered sugar (optional)
preparation: Beat butter at medium speed with an electric mixer about 2 minutes or until soft and creamy.  Gradually add sugars, beating at medium speed 5 to 7 minutes.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating just until yellow disappears.   Combine flour, baking soda and cocoa.  Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream, beginning and ending with flour mixture.  Mix at lowest speed just until blended after each addition.  Stir in vanilla.  Spoon batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool completely and sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired.

name: APPLE CINNAMON SALAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. red hots
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. cold water
1/2  c. chopped celery (optional)
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  box cherry jello
1  c. chopped apple
1  c. water
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. powdered sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together.  Spread on salad.  Let set before serving.

name: CHICKEN STEW
ingredients:
1  whole hen
1  can of whole kernel corn
1  quart of can tomatoes, garden
1  large onion
1/2  gallon sweet milk
2  cans of evaporated milk
preparation: Cook chicken and let cool, chop chicken up in blender real fine. Blend tomatoes, corn, and onions. Add milk to the broth. Add chicken. Cook on low heat 1 to 2 hours.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. all-purpose flour (if using self-rising flour, omit salt and baking soda)
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  c. raisins
1  c. chopped nuts
3  c. quick cooking oats
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix thoroughly shortening, sugars, egg, water and vanilla.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 1-inch apart onto greased baking sheet.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until almost no imprint remains when touched with finger.  Store in tightly covered container.  Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

name: CHOCOLATE EGG CREAM
ingredients:
milk
seltzer
chocolate syrup
preparation: Mix half glass milk with chocolate syrup.  Add seltzer!

name: Heavenly Hash
ingredients:
1  pkg. jello (raspberry or strawberry)
2  c. miniature marshmallows
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. crushed pineapple
1/2  pt. cream, whipped firm
1 small  bottle maraschino cherries
preparation: Dissolve gelatin as usual.  Put in shallow pan.  When set, cut in 1/2-inch squares.  Fold into whipped cream.  Add pineapple, cherries and marshmallows.  Should set 12 hours.

name: GEORGIA HUGHES' SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
12  Tbsp. sugar
12  Tbsp. soft butter
4  Tbsp. whole beaten egg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Lightly grease cookie sheet.  Mix butter and  sugar.  Stir  in  egg and vanilla.  Add flour.  The dough will  be  hard  to stir.  Make rounded balls of dough and place  on  cookie  sheet.  Press cookie dough down with floured bottom of drinking glass.  Sprinkle cookies with sugar.  Bake 5 to 7 minutes.

name: OVEN FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
chicken breast or cut up fryer
seasoned salt and pepper to taste
melted margarine (enough to coat chicken)
flour (to coat chicken)
preparation: Salt and pepper chicken.  Dip in melted margarine; coat chicken with flour.  Put in baking pan lined with foil.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour, or until done.

name: HILDEGARDE SALAD
ingredients:
1  doz. Jonathan apples, sliced
1  c. English walnuts or pecans
1  lemon (juice)
juice from 1 can pineapple
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1  can sliced pineapple, drained
1  doz. chipped marshmallows
seeded grapes
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  pt. whipped cream
preparation: Boil the pineapple juice; beat the eggs lightly and add sugar and flour mixed.  Add butter.  Cook until thick.  When cooled, add to fruits.  Just before serving, stir in the whipped cream.

name: SAVORY PORK STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1  lb. lean boneless pork or chicken
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. sesame oil
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. dry ginger
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  carrot, cut in thin strips
1/2  green pepper, cut into strips
1  onion, chopped coarsely
1  stalk broccoli, cut into 1-inch pieces
1  Tbsp. chicken broth
1  Tbsp. toasted sesame seed, if desired
2  c. cooked rice
preparation: Slice pork or chicken across grain in 1/8-inch strips. Marinate in soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger for 10 minutes.  Heat vegetable oil in electric skillet or wok to 400°.  Stir-fry pork for 3 to 5 minutes, until pork is no longer pink.  Add vegetables, chicken broth and marinade.  Stir mixture until tender-crisp.  Serve over hot cooked rice.  Sprinkle with toasted sesame seed.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE ZUCCHINI CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. soft margarine
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1 3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sour milk
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
2  c. grated zucchini
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate bits
preparation: Cream together margarine, oil and sugar.  Add eggs, vanilla and milk.  Beat well.  Mix in flour, cocoa, baking powder, soda, cinnamon and cloves.  Stir in zucchini.  Pour batter in 9 x 12-inch pan.  Sprinkle top with chocolate bits.  Bake in 325° oven for 45 minutes.

name: 8-MINUTE STRAWBERRY CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sour cream
1  (8 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
1  Keebler Ready-Crust graham cracker pie crust
fresh strawberries (for garnish)
preparation: Beat cheese until smooth and then gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla.  Fold in whipped topping and blend well.  Spoon into crust.  Chill until set, at least 4 hours. Garnish with lots of sliced, fresh strawberries to cover top. Add dollops of whipped topping on top, if desired.

name: DESSERT PIZZA
ingredients:
Pillsbury sugar cookie mix
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. Cool Whip
1/2  c. sugar
fruit of choice
preparation: Take Pillsbury sugar cookie mix and bake as directed on pizza pan.  Cool.  Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and sugar together. Spread over cookies.  Then decorate with choice of fruits, sliced strawberries, kiwi or blueberries.  Looks and tastes great!

name: Ham and Cheese Roll-Ups
ingredients:
Oscar Mayer sliced ham
Kraft sliced American cheese
Dijon mustard
preparation: Spread mustard on slice of ham.  Lay slice of cheese on top of mustard.  Roll jelly roll style.  Cut into 3rds.  Put toothpick in each one to hold it together.  Serve on pretty party tray.

name: SUN CITY APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1  lb. lean hamburger
1  hot and 1 sweet sausage
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  Tbsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. garlic
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Crumble and brown hamburger and sausage.  Drain fat.  Add cheese, oregano, garlic and Worcestershire sauce.  Mix well.  Let cool.  Spread on party rye bread.  Place on cookie sheet and put in freezer.  Once frozen, place in freezer bags.  Broil 3 to 4 minutes to serve.

name: ICEBOX ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. mashed potatoes
1/2  c. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
1  pkg. dry yeast
5  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Place milk, sugar, potatoes, butter and salt in a large saucepan.  Heat slowly to boiling point.  Let stand until lukewarm. Add yeast, dissolved in a little of this lukewarm mixture, then add to first mixture.  Mix soda and baking powder with flour.  Stir in to make a stiff dough.  Let rise 15 minutes.  Knead to a stiff dough, adding more flour, if necessary.

name: HASH BROWN POTATOES
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. baking potatoes, peeled (about 4 medium)
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
3/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. butter flavor Crisco or 1/2 stick margarine
preparation: Shred potatoes into cold water; drain well.  Combine with onion, salt and pepper in medium mixing bowl.  Melt Crisco or margarine in large skillet.  Add potatoes; spread evenly in pan. Cook over medium-high heat 13 to 15 minutes or until golden brown and tender, turning potatoes with spatula after half the time.

name: SHELLEY'S MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb ground beef
1  can tomato sauce
1/4  c worcestershire sauce
1/2  onion, chopped
2  tsp garlic, minced
1  egg
preparation: Mix all ingredients together except tomato sauce. Shape the meat in a loaf pan. Pour the tomato sauce on top of the meat. Bake at 375 degrees until done.

name: WILD RICE CHICKEN SUPREME
ingredients:
1  pkg. long grain and wild rice
1/4  c. butter
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  c. half and half
1  c. chicken broth
2  c. cooked chicken (bite size pieces)
1/3  c. parsley
1/4  c. slivered almonds
preparation: Cook rice according to directions.  Saute onion in butter; remove from stove.  Add chicken broth, half and half, salt, pepper and 1/3 cup flour; stir until smooth.  Add chicken and rice.  Pour into greased casserole and top with parsley and slivered almonds. Bake in a 375° oven for 45 minutes.

name: PICKLED EGGS
ingredients:
1  doz. eggs
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. cold water
1/2  tsp. salt
stick cinnamon
3  cloves
1/2  tsp. sugar
preparation: Hard-boil eggs and peel.  Boil all ingredients, except eggs, in a saucepan.  Simmer for several minutes.  Cool until just warm and add shelled, boiled eggs.  Keep refrigerated a day or so to blend spices.

name: LEMONADE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon cake mix
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. lemon flavor instant pudding and pie filling
4  eggs
1  c. water
1/4  c. oil
preparation: Combine cake mix, pudding mix, eggs, water and oil in large mixer bowl.  Blend well, then beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 4 minutes. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.  Cool in pan about 5 minutes.  Thoroughly prick warm cake with utility fork completely through to bottom of cake.

name: STRACCIATELA(Roman Egg Soup)
ingredients:
3  c. chicken broth
1/4  c. fresh breadcrumbs
salt and freshly ground pepper
chopped parsley
3  eggs
1/4  c. fresh Parmesan cheese
preparation: Bring the broth to a boil in a saucepan.  In a bowl, beat together the eggs, breadcrumbs and cheese.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Remove broth from heat and pour in the egg mixture, blending well with a whisk.  Return the broth to a bowl, stirring constantly, with a whisk.

name: RYE BREAD MIX
ingredients:
1  qt. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1  qt. sour cream
3  Tbsp. parsley flakes
3  Tbsp. onion flakes
3  tsp. m.s.g.
3  tsp. dill seed
preparation: Mix with mixer and serve with round rye.

name: SPICY APPLE WEDGES
ingredients:
2  large apples
4  Tbsp. margarine, melted
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cut each apple into sections, lengthwise.  Remove core. Combine remaining ingredients and brush on apple.  Cover with foil.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: POPPY SEED DRESSING
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. cider vinegar
1  Tbsp. onion juice
1  c. oil
1 1/2  Tbsp. poppy seed
preparation: In medium bowl, combine sugar, mustard, salt, vinegar, and juice.  Gradually beat in oil until mixture is thick and smooth. Stir in poppy seed.  Store covered in refrigerator.

name: CURRY AND DILL SHRIMP SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. fresh medium shrimp
1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms
2  artichokes
1  onion
5  Tbsp. fresh chopped dill
2  cloves garlic
2  Tbsp. fresh parsley
1  lemon
1  pkg. Knorr curry sauce mix
1  stalk celery
1  pkg. medium noodles
preparation: Peel and devein shrimp.  Combine 6 quarts water, 1/2 cup salt, dill and cut up lemon.  Boil 5 minutes, then add shrimp.  Boil 4 minutes, turn off heat and let soak 20 minutes.  Drain and remove lemon.  Cut bottom off of artichokes; boil for 20 minutes. Remove, drain and let cool.  Mince onion, garlic, celery and parsley to make a paste (a mini chopper works well for this). Slice the mushrooms and saute them with the paste in 2 tablespoons olive oil for 3 to 4 minutes.  Set aside.

name: YUM-A-SETTA
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
salt and pepper to taste
a little brown sugar
1  can tomato soup (undiluted)
1  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. egg noodles
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. processed cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger with salt, pepper, brown sugar and onions. Add tomato soup.  Cook egg noodles; drain.  Add cream of chicken soup with noodles.  Layer hamburger mixture and noodle mixture in casserole dish with processed cheese between each layer.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

name: MOTHER'S 3-BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can green beans
1  can wax (yellow) beans
1  can kidney beans
1  carrot, sliced
1 small  can corn
1  stalk celery
1/2  c. onion slices
1  c. liquid oil
1  c. vinegar
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. sugar substitute *
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Marinate 24 hours.

name: HAM AND CHEESE SUB
ingredients:
chipped ham
Swiss cheese
American cheese
lettuce
tomato
onion
pickles
jalapeno peppers
Salad Supreme seasoning
sub buns
salt and pepper
olive oil
vinegar
mustard
preparation: Place ample helping of ham, cheeses, lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles and peppers on bun.  Add Salad Supreme, salt, pepper, olive oil, vinegar and mustard to taste.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
4  sq. chocolate, grated
2  Tbsp. butter
4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
pie shell
whipped cream
preparation: Mix cornstarch with 1/2 cup milk.  Combine chocolate, butter, remaining milk, sugar, salt and vanilla in a double boiler.  Heat to the boiling point.  Add cornstarch mixture and cook 8 minutes. Let cool and pour into a baked pie shell.  To serve, top with whipped cream.

name: PEANUT-OATMEAL-CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine, softened
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. soda
2  c. chunky peanut butter (18 oz.)
18  oz. box quick oatmeal
12  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Spoon onto cookie sheet (ungreased).  Bake at 325° for about 20 minutes (estimate). Makes 8 dozen medium size cookies.

name: LACHO
ingredients:
2  cans S&W stewed tomatoes (Italian pear)
2  cans S&W whole tomatoes (with oregano and basil)
1  yellow onion
6  to 12 Hungarian hot wax peppers
1  dinner ring Polish sausage
preparation: Chop the onion.  Slice the meat.  Slice the peppers.  Dump in the cans.  Cook the stuff in a crock-pot on low for 5 to 7 hours or high 4 to 5 hours.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
1  c. Kraft mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. Accent
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. onion flakes
1  tsp. dill seed
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients and chill.  Serve in hollowed rye bread.

name: MAMA'S SUGAR SYRUP
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
4  c. water
preparation: Caramelize 1/2 cup sugar in large iron skillet, stirring so it won't burn.  Pour in 4 cups boiling water and rest of sugar; boil for 12 minutes.  Can be poured into clean hot jars and sealed. May be kept to use as needed.  While hot, pour over buttered biscuits!  It's great.

name: FINNAN HADDIE
ingredients:
2  lb. smoked haddock
1/4  c. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1 3/4  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
3  Tbsp. butter, melted
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. fresh parsley
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  For thin white sauce, melt butter in saucepan, add flour and stir to form paste.  Remove from heat and slowly add 1/2 the milk.  Return to  heat and stir until thickened; beat until smooth.  Gradually stir in remaining milk and heat to simmering.  Place fish in greased casserole dish and pour white sauce over it.  Cover and bake at 400° for 10 to 20 minutes, until fish flakes easily.  Sprinkle with bread crumbs which have been mixed with melted butter.  Return to oven and bake 5 to 10 minutes, until golden.   Sprinkle with parsley and garnish with lemon wedges.

name: MOCK T-BONE
ingredients:
3  slices white bread, crumbled
3/4  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
1/8  tsp. garlic salt
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  lb. ground beef
Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients and blend with hamburger.  Shape into small t-bone 1 to 1 1/4-inch thick.  Douse with Worcestershire sauce on broiler pan.  Broil 5 minutes on each side.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. oil
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
3  c. flour
1  c. pumpkin
2/3  c. water
3  c. sugar
preparation: Mix together nutmeg, cinnamon, oil and eggs.  Add rest of ingredients together.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: EASY AS PIE CRUST
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
2/3  c. plus 4 Tbsp. shortening
7 to 8  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: Mix together flour and salt.  Use pastry blender to cut in shortening until pastry looks like coarse meal.  Sprinkle 2 tablespoons at a time of cold water over mixture.  Stir with a fork until the dough follows the fork around the bowl.  Divide in half and chill.  Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: TING-A-LING(Haystacks)
ingredients:
1 (6 to 8 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 (6 to 8 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
1 (4 to 5 oz.)  can chow mein noodles
1  c. Spanish peanuts, salted
preparation: In large saucepan, melt chips over low heat, stirring constantly.*  Remove from heat and quickly stir in noodles and peanuts, making sure all ingredients are coated evenly. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper. Chill until firm. Yield: 3 1/2 dozen.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
2  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
3  bananas, crushed
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Cream together shortening and sugar.  Add eggs and bananas. Add dry ingredients.  Pour into bread pan (makes one loaf).  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: DEVILED EGGS
ingredients:
6  hard-boiled eggs
1  tsp. mustard
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
3  Tbsp. Miracle Whip
1/2  Tbsp. vinegar
paprika
preparation: Shell cooled eggs.  Cut in half lengthwise.  Take out yolks and put in bowl.  Break up yolks with fork.  Add all ingredients except paprika.  Mix until fluffy.  Fill egg whites with yolk mixture.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Makes 12 deviled eggs.

name: BETH'S BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can kidney beans, drained
2  stalks celery, chopped
2  dill pickles, chopped
1/2  c. onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
Hellmann's mayonnaise
preparation: Mix ingredients and chill.  I usually triple this recipe.

name: DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
1  egg
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. shortening, melted
3  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Beat together egg, sugar, milk and shortening.  Set aside. Mix flour, baking powder, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Add to first mixture.  If batter is too soft to handle, add more flour.  Chill dough thoroughly.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  small whole chicken, cooked
1  bag wide noodles, cooked and drained
1  can chicken broth
1  can cream of celery soup
2  cans cream of chicken soup
dried onions
preparation: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Put the chicken broth, celery soup and cream of chicken soup in.  Sprinkle on dried onions.  Add chicken pieces and cooked noodles.  Put bread crumbs on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: SQUASH PIE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked unsalted squash, drained
3  Tbsp. flour
4  egg yolks
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  tsp. lemon extract
preparation: Blend all ingredients in blender.  Pour in uncooked pie crust. Cook at  350° for 30 minutes or until knife stuck into center comes out clean.

name: CHOCOLATE ALMOND COCONUT BARS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. margarine, softened
1 1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. almonds
14  oz. condensed sweet milk
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix together flour, brown sugar and margarine until crumbly.  Press in a 9-inch greased pan.  Combine coconut and 3/4 cup condensed milk and spread over crust. Sprinkle with almonds evenly.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.  While baking, mix 1/2 cup of condensed milk and chocolate chips together and heat over low heat until melted.  Stir in vanilla; spread over warm bars and refrigerate until firm.  Cut into bars.

name: GREEN BEAN & SHOEPEG CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can French style green beans, drained
1  (11 oz.)	can shoepeg corn, drained
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. shredded cheddar cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
salt and pepper to taste
1  tube round buttery-flavored crackers, crushed
1  stick margarine, melted
1/4  c. slivered almonds, optional
preparation: Combine green beans, corn, soup, cheese, sour cream and salt and pepper. Place in a greased shallow 2 qt casserole dish. Combine crushed crackers, margarine and  almonds. Sprinkle over top. Bake at 400° uncovered for 25 minutes.

name: SUNSHINE SHAKES(For Kids)
ingredients:
1  c. orange juice
2  tsp. honey
3  Tbsp. nonfat dry milk powder
2  Tbsp. vanilla yogurt
1  Tbsp. wheat germ
1/4  tsp. vanilla extract
4  ice cubes
preparation: Blend in blender and serve.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. squash, raw
1  tsp. soda
3  c. flour
3  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Blend squash in blender.  If large, remove seeds and pulp. Mix eggs, oil, sugar, vanilla and squash.  Add rest of ingredients.  Pour in 2 loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: POTATO-CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
4  c. sliced potatoes
2  c. water
2  tsp. salt
1  onion, sliced
1  Tbsp. oil
5  sprigs parsley (fresh)
3  c. milk
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  tsp. pepper
pinch of garlic powder
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Cook potatoes and salt in water; reserve water.  In skillet, saute onion in oil until soft.  In blender, blend potatoes, potato water, onion, milk and parsley until smooth.  Only fill blender halfway to avoid sticking.  Return mixture to stove and, stirring continuously, add margarine, pepper, garlic powder and grated cheese.

name: DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
1  egg, plus enough water to equal 1 1/3 c.
1  tsp. lemon juice
4  c. bread flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. oil
2  tsp. active dry yeast
preparation: Place ingredients in bread pan in order listed.  Use dough setting; press start.  When setting is complete, remove dough from bread pan.  Place on lightly floured surface.  Divide dough into 24 pieces.  Shape into balls.  Place on greased baking sheet(s) about 1/2-inch apart.  Let stand, covered, in a warm draft-free place 30 minutes or until doubled in size.  Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes 24 rolls.

name: CRUSTLESS PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can solid pack pumpkin
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated skim milk (undiluted)
2  whole eggs
2  egg whites
3/4  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. graham cracker or vanilla wafer crumbs
1  c. whipped cream
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground allspice
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: In large bowl, combine pumpkin, evaporated milk, eggs and egg whites.  Beat until blended and smooth.  Mix in sugar, cinnamon, allspice, ginger and salt, blending well.  Stir in crumbs.  Spray high sided 9-inch pie plate with nonstick cooking spray.  Pour pie filling into pie plate.  Bake in preheated 325° oven for 45 to 55 minutes, until a knife inserted near center comes out clean.  Cool pie on wire rack; refrigerate overnight.  Cut in wedges; serve with small dollop of whipped cream.  Makes 10 servings.

name: NO-BAKE OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  C sugar
1/4  C cocoa
1/2  C milk
1  stick butter
2  C oatmeal
1/2  C nuts or coconuts
1/2  tsp vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, cocoa, and milk. Heat on medium until boils then add butter. Let boil for 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients.

name: SNACK CRACKERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. onion
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Mix all together.  Spread on cocktail rye bread.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Broil; serve warm.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  sticks oleo
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
cinnamon-sugar mixture
3  cans buttermilk biscuits
nuts, chopped (optional)
preparation: Cut biscuits into quarters.  Roll biscuits in a cinnamon and sugar mixture.  In a saucepan, cook oleo and brown sugar until melted and combined.  In a Bundt pan, put a layer of cooked mixture, then a layer of cinnamon-sugar covered biscuits, then nuts (optional).  Continue to fill the pan, alternating cooked mixture, nuts and biscuits.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: ESCALLOPED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  small head cabbage
salt to taste
1  pkg. rolled crackers
1  stick oleo
1  Tbsp. sugar
milk
cheese
pepper to taste
preparation: Shred cabbage coarser than for kraut.  Put in a saucepan; add salt and pepper to taste.  Cook cabbage until tender.  Add rolled crackers and oleo to drained cabbage.  Add 1 tablespoon sugar. Pour mixture into baking dish; add milk to cabbage mixture.  Dot with cheese on top.  Bake in a 400° oven for about 20 to 30 minutes, until golden brown.

name: SAUSAGE QUICHE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. roll sausage
1  unbaked (9-inch) pie crust
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. grated Swiss cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. butter
4  eggs
1  c. milk
1  c. cream
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Crumble sausage and cook until brown.  Remove sausage and add butter and onions to drippings and cook for 5 minutes.  Cover bottom of pie crust with sausage, onions and 1/4 cup of cheese.

name: GREAT BARBECUE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger (ground chuck)
1  can corned beef (12 oz.)
1  medium chopped onion
14  oz. bottle catsup (not Del Monte)
1  Tbsp. chili powder
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
water (rinse out catsup bottle)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown hamburger with onion.  Add corned beef (crushed).  Add chili powder and brown sugar.  Simmer at least 1 hour.  (This freezes great!)  Serves 10 to 12.

name: KRINGLA
ingredients:
1/2  c. plus 1 Tbsp. oleo
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
3 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
preparation: In a mixing bowl, beat together the oleo, sugar and egg.  Then add the buttermilk, sour cream, vanilla and spice.  Beat well.  Add flour, baking powder and soda and mix by hand.  Chill dough overnight.  Roll small bits of dough on floured board into strips the size of a pencil and shape into a figure 8. Bake in preheated hot oven, probably 435°, until slightly brown; don't overbake.

name: COCOA KISSES
ingredients:
2  egg whites
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1/8  tsp. salt
2/3  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
3/4  tsp. almond extract
1/3  c. finely chopped almonds
preparation: Preheat oven to 200°.  Line 2 large cookie sheets with foil. In small bowl beat at high speed egg whites, cream of tartar and salt until soft peaks form.  Gradually beat in sugar, 2 tablespoons at a time, beating well after each addition.  At low speed, beat in cocoa and almond extract until blended.  Fold in almonds, reserving 1 tablespoon.  Drop mixture by slightly rounded tablespoonfuls onto cookie sheets, sprinkle tops with reserved almonds.  Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until set.  Cool on cookie sheets 10 minutes.

name: LEMON-CATFISH PARMESAN
ingredients:
2  catfish fillets
1  c. stuffing mix
3/8  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/8  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. lemon pepper
1/8  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. salt
3/8  c. vegetable oil
lemon slices (optional)
preparation: Combine all dry ingredients.  Dip catfish in oil.  Roll in stuffing/spice mixture.  Arrange on greased baking dish.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 375°.  Garnish with lemon slices, if desired. Recipe can be doubled.

name: HAMBURGER SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
onion
salt
pepper
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
1  c. water (plus, if needed)
1  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
preparation: Brown hamburger, onion, salt and pepper.  Add rest and simmer. (I find more water is needed so I use some beef bouillon.)

name: CHERRY FRAPPE
ingredients:
2 (4 oz.)  jars red maraschino cherries, undrained
1  pt. vanilla ice cream, softened
2  pt. orange sherbet
crushed ice
preparation: Combine cherries, ice cream and half the sherbet in electric blender.  Blend until smooth.  Pour into glasses half filled with crushed ice. Top with scoop of remaining sherbet. Garnish with mint. Serve with straws.  Blend half the ingredients at a time for easier handling.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SPICY BLACK-EYED PEA SOUP
ingredients:
5  slices bacon
1  c. onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. jalapeno, finely chopped
2  c. chopped canned tomatoes
1  clove garlic, minced
3  c. hot water
3  beef bouillon cubes
4 (15.8 oz.)  cans black-eyed peas
1  c. grated Cheddar or Swiss cheese
preparation: Cut bacon into small pieces; sauté until brown. Drain. Pour out grease in pan. Add onion, bacon, jalapeno, garlic and tomato to pan. Sauté. Dissolve bouillon in hot water. Drain peas; add to bouillon, then add to onion and bacon mixture. Simmer together. Serve hot with cheese sprinkled on each serving.

name: MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, mashed
1/2  tsp. salt
1 8  oz. tomato sauce
1/4  c. catsup
1/2  tsp. oregano, crushed
1  tsp. sugar
1 8  oz. cream cheese
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1  green chili pepper or 1 small jalapeno
preparation: Brown ground beef, onion, garlic and salt; drain and add remaining ingredients.  Heat in crock-pot.  Dip with chips, crackers or bread.

name: DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. milk
3  Tbsp. shortening
preparation: Mix well;    roll out on floured board and cut in squares.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE MOLD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lime jello
1  c. boiling water
1 small  can drained crushed pineapple
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. chopped celery
1  c. cottage cheese or 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Stir in other ingredients. Put in 1-quart mold.  Chill.

name: CHOCOLATE LAYER PIE
ingredients:
1  stick melted margarine
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. flour
2  Tbsp. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix together melted margarine, nuts, flour and powdered sugar. Press into large pie dish or 9 x 13-inch dish.  Bake 20 minutes at 325°.  Let cool.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sour milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
preparation: Melt together margarine, water and peanut butter.  Mix flour, soda, sugar, salt, sour milk, vanilla and eggs into mixture.  Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done.

name: ALMOND-APRICOT BREAD
ingredients:
1  egg
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. milk
3  c. biscuit mix
3/4  c. finely chopped, unbleached almonds
3/4  c. finely chopped, uncooked apricots
1/2  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  In large bowl with wooden spoon or mixer, beat egg and sugar well. Add milk and biscuit mix.  Beat well.  Stir in almonds, apricots and extract, mixing well.  Turn batter into pan.  Bake 55 to 60 minutes until tester comes out clean from center.  Cool 10 minutes.  Loosen sides with spatula.  Cool completely on wire rack.

name: HORSERADISH MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. regular oats (uncooked)
1  large onion, chopped
1/2  c. catsup
1/4  c. milk
2  large eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. horseradish
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. catsup
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. horseradish
2  tsp. spicy brown mustard
preparation: Combine first 9 ingredients in a large bowl; stir well.  Form beef mixture into a loaf and place in a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Combine catsup, brown sugar, horseradish and mustard in a small bowl.  Spoon half of catsup mixture over top of meat loaf.  Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 45 minutes.  Spoon remaining catsup mixture over top of meat loaf and bake an additional 10 minutes.

name: ICEBOX FRUITCAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. graham cracker crumbs
1  lb. marshmallows
1  c. orange juice
1  lb. box raisins
3  lb. nuts (pecans and walnuts)
1  lb. candied mixed fruit
1/2  lb. dates
1/2  lb. candied green cherries
1/2  lb. candied red cherries
1  can coconut
1  Tbsp. brandy flavoring
1/2  lb. figs or fig preserves
preparation: Heat juice and marshmallows until well blended.  Mix all ingredients (except crumbs) in very large pan; stir in graham cracker crumbs and mix well.  Pour juice mixture over fruit and stir until well blended.  Pack into 10-inch tube pan.  Better if prepared about 1 month before eating.  Store in refrigerator.

name: HEAVENLY HASH
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  can coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
1 or 2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Blend sour cream and cream cheese with mixer until smooth. Add other ingredients, mixing well with large spoon.  Chill thoroughly.

name: AUNT LILA'S WHEAT GERM BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine (1 stick)
2  sq. (2 oz.) unsweetened chocolate
2  eggs
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. unsifted flour
1/2  c. wheat germ
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt margarine and chocolate; cool slightly.  Then add to eggs and sugar and mix well.  Add rest of dry ingredients; then add vanilla and nuts.  Mix until just moistened.  Bake until just done to assure chewiness and moistness (350° for 25 to 30 minutes).

name: BUBBLING BISCUITS BITS
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. chopped walnuts
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Place butter or margarine in oven at 350° to melt, about 5 minutes. Mix together rest of ingredients. Open 1 package (8 ounce) refrigerated buttermilk biscuits. Cut each biscuit into 4 equal pieces. When butter or margarine is melted, remove pan from oven.

name: TUNA PATE
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  Tbsp. chili sauce
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
1  tsp. instant minced onion
1/2  tsp. bottled hot pepper sauce
2 (6 1/2 oz.)  cans tuna, drained
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Refrigerate.  Great on crackers.

name: PICKLED PEACHES
ingredients:
8  lb. peaches
2  Tbsp. whole cloves
4  sticks cinnamon
2  lb. sugar
1  qt. vinegar
1  pt. water
preparation: Wash and peel peaches. Leave whole. Put cloves and cinnamon loosely in a clean, thin white cloth and tie top tightly. Simmer spices, sugar, vinegar and water for 10 minutes or until sugar dissolves and mixture becomes spicy. Add peaches and cook slowly until tender but not broken. Let sit overnight.

name: EGG NOG
ingredients:
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
6  c. milk
2  eggs, separated
1  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Beat egg whites until stiff.  Mix pudding, sugar, egg yolks, vanilla, nutmeg and milk in a large bowl and beat at low speed for about 1 minute.  Fold in egg whites.  Chill.

name: SOUR CREAM RAISIN PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
2  egg yolks
pinch of salt
1  c. raisins
1  baked pie shell
preparation: Boil first 5 ingredients until thick and pour into baked pie shell.  Top with Cool Whip. Can be cooked in microwave.

name: THELMA'S ROLLS
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. scalded milk
2  pkg. yeast, dissolved in 1/2 c. lukewarm water
2  eggs
2/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. salt
1  c. cold water
6  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Add  shortening to scalded milk and let cool.  Dissolve yeast in  lukewarm  water.  In  large  bowl,  beat eggs until light. Add  egg  mixture to the milk and yeast mixtures.  Add flour, one cup  at  a time; mix well.  Let stand until doubled in bulk.

name: ALMOST RASPBERRY JAM
ingredients:
5 1/2  c. chopped green tomatoes
5 1/2  c. sugar
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. raspberry jello
preparation: In large kettle, combine tomatoes and sugar; simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Remove from the heat.  Stir in gelatin until dissolved, about 1 minute, stirring occasionally to prevent floating fruit.  Pour into jars or plastic containers. Cool; top with lids.  Refrigerate up to 3 weeks.  Yields 7 cups.

name: TURKEY AND CARROTS IN ORANGE SAUCE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oleo
6  to 8 medium carrots, cut diagonally in 1/2-inch slices
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2/3  c. orange juice
1/8  tsp. basil leaves
1/3  c. sliced onions
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  pkg. turkey breast tenderloins
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
pepper
preparation: Heat oleo in medium skillet over medium-high heat until melted. Cook turkey in oleo mixture until brown.  Place turkey and carrots in a shallow 2-quart casserole.  Mix brown sugar and cornstarch in a small bowl.  Stir in orange juice, garlic salt, basil and pepper. Pour over turkey and carrots.  Add onion over top.  Cover and bake at 350° about 1 1/4 hours or until carrots are done.  Salt and pepper to taste.

name: TROPICAL CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can white chicken
1  stalk celery
1  can pineapple tidbits
1  apple, chopped
2  Tbsp. sesame seed, toasted
Miracle Whip, as desired
preparation: Mix ingredients together and chill. Serve on a plate of lettuce.

name: HOMEMADE DIVINITY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1/2  c. water
2  egg whites
1  c. chopped nut meats
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil sugar, syrup and water until mixture dropped in cold water turns brittle (no longer, watch close, test often).  Pour slowly over stiffly beaten whites of egg; add nuts and flavoring. Beat until mixture is creamy.  Pour on buttered platter.

name: HAMBURGER/CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground hamburger
chopped onions
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
8  oz. sour cream
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
3  c. cooked noodles
salt and pepper
1/2  c. melted butter
4  slices bread, diced
preparation: Brown hamburger with onions.  In a bowl mix soups, sour cream and corn.  Add  hamburger and noodles.  Put in casserole dish. Top with butter and diced bread; mix this together and sprinkle on top of casserole.  Then  bake  at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: FAKE RASPBERRY JAM
ingredients:
5  c. ground tomatoes
4  c. sugar
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. raspberry gelatin
preparation: Cook ground tomatoes and sugar together for 15 minutes.  Add the package of gelatin.  Stir until gelatin is dissolved.  Put in jars and seal.  Invert jars after 1 hour to distribute the fruit.

name: SPICED TEA
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
4 or 5  sticks cinnamon
2  tsp. cloves
1  gal. water
4  or 5 small tea bags
3/4  c. lemon concentrate
1 1/2  pt. Tang, made from powdered concentrate
1  gal. cider
preparation: Boil sugar, cinnamon, cloves and water for several minutes. Add tea bags and simmer.  Remove tea bags; add remaining ingredients.  Heat to boiling point.  Serve hot.

name: PIZZA BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen pizza dough
1  pkg. sliced pepperoni
1  pkg. Provolone cheese
1  can sliced mushrooms
preparation: Thaw dough; roll out into a rectangle.  Add pepperoni, cut up pieces of cheese, then mushrooms.  Roll up like a jelly roll. Pinch ends in good.  Put, seam side down, on a cookie sheet.  Make 3 slits on top of roll.  Bake at 375° until golden brown.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium sized cabbage, shredded
1  lb. ground beef, browned
1/2  medium onion
1/2  c. uncooked rice
1  can tomato soup with water
preparation: Place shredded cabbage in large buttered casserole dish.  Add remaining ingredients, pouring soup over the top of all.  Bake for 1 hour or until cabbage is tender in 350° oven.

name: SPOON ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
4  c. self-rising flour
3/4  c. melted shortening or oil
2  c. lukewarm water
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Mix other ingredients with yeast.  Store in refrigerator until ready to use.  Cook at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Keeps in refrigerator for weeks.

name: BLANCHE'S CORN SOUFFLE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  can evaporated milk
2  cans creamed corn
1  can whole corn, drained
2  tsp. baking powder
1  stick margarine
1  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat eggs; add sugar and milk and beat well.  Add flour, baking powder and salt; beat.  Add cans of corn and stir with a spoon; do not beat.  Melt butter and add to mixture; stir.  Pour into a buttered casserole dish.  Bake at 350° until brown (about 1 hour).

name: EASY TACO DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. sour cream
1  jar salsa (approximately 12 oz.)
1  large tomato, finely chopped
8  oz. Cheddar cheese, finely shredded
tortilla chips (preferably Tostitos brand)
8  oz. cream cheese
1  green pepper, finely chopped
1/4  head iceberg lettuce, finely chopped
8  oz. Monterey Jack cheese, finely shredded
preparation: Using a hand mixer, thoroughly mix sour cream and cream cheese.  Spread mixture evenly over large, round, flat serving platter.  Evenly layer the rest of the ingredients in the following order:  salsa, green pepper, tomato, lettuce and Cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese.  Chill until ready to serve.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: RED'S PERFECT CAKE
ingredients:
1  dash to car
1/8  gal. of gas
Simmer in traffic
preparation: Gently beat way to cake aisle in favorite supermarket. Stand in line 10 minutes. Repeat first 3 steps. Yields 1 or more perfect cake every time.

name: MEDIUM WHITE SAUCE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
4  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. low-fat milk
preparation: Melt butter or margarine over low heat.  Add flour and pepper. Stir until well blended.  Remove from heat.  Gradually stir in milk and return to heat.  Cook, stirring constantly, until thick and smooth.

name: DATE PECAN BLONDIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. plain flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. chopped dates
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat brown sugar and butter or margarine until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well.  Add flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg; mix well.  Add dates and stir well.  Spread into greased pan.  Sprinkle chopped pecans on top.  Bake for approximately 20 minutes or until light golden brown.

name: BROCCOLI AND RICE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chopped broccoli
1  stick butter
1  large onion
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
salt to taste
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. Minute rice
preparation: Cook broccoli and rice following directions on the boxes. Melt butter and cook onion in butter for 5 minutes.  Mix together in a casserole dish rice, broccoli, butter, onion, cream of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup and cheese, cut in chunks. Place in oven at 400° and cook until bubbly.

name: VEGETABLE MEDLEY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. frozen cauliflower
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. Brussels sprouts
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. flour
1 (10 oz.)  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1/2  lb. soft cheese (Velveeta)
preparation: Cook all vegetables according to package instructions.  Drain well and place in a 9 x 12-inch pan.  In a saucepan, blend soup and flour.  Add tomatoes and stir until mixture boils.  Add cheese and stir until cheese melts.  Pour sauce over vegetables and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 10.

name: PECAN GLAZED PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1 (16 oz.)  can solid pumpkin
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1  c. brown sugar, divided usage
2  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
1  deep dish pie crust (frozen)
1  c. pecan pieces
1/4  c. butter, melted
preparation: Preheat oven and baking sheet to 375°.  In large bowl, whisk together eggs, pumpkin, evaporated milk, 3/4 cup sugar and pumpkin spice.   Place frozen pie crust on preheated baking sheet; pour filling into crust.  Bake for 40 minutes.

name: TURKEY PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  lb. breast of turkey
1/2  pkg. (5 oz.) bow-shaped pasta, cooked and drained
1 small  bunch (1 lb.) fresh spinach, torn in bite size pieces
1/2  c. (4 oz.) creamy herb salad dressing
leaf lettuce
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
coarsely ground black pepper
2  medium tomatoes, diced
5  ripe olives, sliced
preparation: Cut turkey into 1/2-inch cubes; set aside.  Combine pasta, spinach and dressing.  Place mixture in large, lettuce-lined salad bowl.  Sprinkle with cheese and pepper to taste.

name: APPLE CRUMB PIE
ingredients:
6  to 7 tart apples
1 1/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
dash of nutmeg
dash of salt
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Slice apples; mix with 3/4 cup sugar, 2 tablespoons flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt.  Put mixture in pie plate.  Mix crumbs by mixing 1/2 cup sugar and 3/4 cup flour together.  Cut butter into flour and sugar.  Sprinkle over top of apples.  Bake at 400° for 40 minutes or until done.  A bottom crust may be used, if desired.

name: SHRIMP DIP(Blazer's; Greenwood, SC)
ingredients:
1  lb. small salad shrimp
1 1/2  lb. grated cheese
1  small onion, chopped fine
1  clove garlic (garlic press or chopped fine)
1/3  c. buttermilk
1  qt. mayonnaise
Tabasco sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients in bowl and let set a few hours before serving.  Serve with Club crackers.

name: SWEDISH PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple with juice
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix and pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

name: CHINESE BARBECUE PORK
ingredients:
1  clove garlic
1/2  tsp. ginger
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. dry sherry
4  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. Chinese 5-spice
1/2  tsp. red food coloring
2  green onions, chopped fine
1/4  c. chicken stock
2  lb. pork
preparation: Bring all ingredients, except pork, to a simmer.  Pour over pork, sliced in 2-inch cubes.  Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

name: TUNA NOODLE CRISP
ingredients:
4  oz. uncooked noodles (3 c.)
1/4  c. Crisco
1/3  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cheese soup
1/2  c. milk
1  can tuna
salt and pepper
bread crumbs or regular potato chips
preparation: Cook noodles according to directions on package, drain.  Melt Crisco in large skillet, add onion and green pepper and cook until tender.  Stir in soup, milk, salt and pepper.  Bring to boil.  Add cooked noodles and tuna.  Place mixture in a 1 1/2 or 2 quart casserole.  Sprinkle bread crumbs or crumbled regular potato chips on top.  Bake in 350° oven 25 to 30 minutes.

name: KATY MCCONNEL'S BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  onion, chopped (optional)
1/2  stick oleo
1/4  c. water
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, cooked as directed and drained
1  c. cooked Minute rice
1/2  c. milk
1  c. cream of mushroom, cream of celery or cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1/4  c. Cheez Whiz
preparation: Bake in greased casserole dish at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: JAZZ UP BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
3  eggs, well beaten
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. grated onion
preparation: Cook broccoli and drain.  Melt butter in saucepan.  Add flour, salt and pepper.  Cook until bubbly.  Stir in milk.  Cook until thick and smooth.  Remove from heat and stir in onion, mayonnaise and eggs.  Carefully mix in broccoli.  Turn into a 2-quart greased casserole and place uncovered into a pan of hot water.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.  Top will be nicely browned.

name: SPRING DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime jello
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon jello
3  c. boiling water
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
24  large marshmallows
1 large  can crushed pineapple
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add marshmallows and cream cheese and stir with wire whisk until dissolved.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Chill until congealed.

name: BROCCOLI BREAD
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
1  stick margarine, melted
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. cottage cheese
1  tsp. salt
1  pkg. chopped broccoli
1  box Jiffy cornbread mix
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

name: EASY RED BEANS
ingredients:
2 small  cans Blue Runner red beans
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. sausage
preparation: Brown sausage, add red beans, cream of mushroom soup and 1 can water. Cook until thoroughly heated, about 20 minutes.

name: PICKLES FOR FREEZER
ingredients:
6  cucumbers, unpeeled
1  onion (medium size), sliced into rings
salt to taste (small handful)
1/2  c. white vinegar
1 1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Slice cucumbers thin and let stand in salted water for 2 hours.  Drain well.  Mix 1/2 cup white vinegar and 1 1/2 cups sugar.  Stir well to dissolve sugar and heat to boiling, then cool.  Mix with pickles and onion rings.  Put in containers and freeze.  I pack the slices in 1-quart freezer bags, then pour in brine to cover.  Thaw when ready to use.

name: CRABMEAT PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. salad dressing or mayonnaise
1/4  c. Italian dressing
1/4  c. shredded cheese
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1 1/2  c. imitation crabmeat, cut into chunks
2  c. corkscrew noodles, cooked and drained
1/4  c. chopped green onions
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1 1/2  c. frozen peas
1/2  c. chopped tomato
2  boiled eggs
preparation: Mix dressing and cheese well.  Add other ingredients; mix lightly.  Chill.  Garnish with boiled eggs and serve with freshly ground black pepper if desired.

name: LIME COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon jello
1  pkg. lime jello
2  c. boiling water
1  can condensed milk
1  tub cottage cheese
1  can crushed pineapple, drained slightly
1  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. horseradish
preparation: Mix well and chill for several hours.  This has a tendency to become a little watery after a few days, so eat up and enjoy.

name: BUTTER PECAN ICE CREAM(Makes 1 Gallon)
ingredients:
1  c. chopped pecans
1  Tbsp. margarine
5  eggs, separated
1  c. sugar
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1  can condensed milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2/3  tsp. butter flavoring
1/4  tsp. maple flavoring
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
dash of salt
1  box instant vanilla pudding (3 oz.)
preparation: Toast pecans in margarine for 10 minutes in 350° oven.  Beat egg whites in large mixer bowl until stiff.  Gradually add sugar; set aside.  In another bowl, beat evaporated milk until foamy. Add slightly beaten egg yolks.  Add balance of ingredients and pecans.  Fold in egg whites.  Pour into freezer.  Finish filling freezer can with whole milk.  Freeze.

name: BOUILLABAISSE
ingredients:
1  onion, finely chopped
1  leek (white part only), sliced thin
3  cloves garlic, finely chopped
2  tomatoes, peeled, seeded and diced
2  Tbsp. finely chopped parsley
1  celery rib, finely chopped
1  bay leaf
1/2  tsp. dried thyme
1/2  tsp. dried fennel
1/2  tsp. freshly ground black pepper
2  c. chicken stock
1  c. dry white wine
1/2  lb. firm white fish, cubed
1/2  lb. shellfish, cleaned
fresh thyme or fennel (for garnish)
preparation: Combine onion, leeks and garlic and cook, covered, over very low heat until soft, about 10 minutes, adding a little stock if necessary.  Add all the other ingredients except fish, shellfish and garnish.  Mix well and bring to a boil.   Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.  Add fish and shellfish and cook until it turns opaque, 2 to 5 minutes.  Serve garnished with fresh French bread.

name: IRISH POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. diced bacon
3  c. cubed potatoes
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/4  c. fresh marjoram
3  c. beef stock
3/4  c. cubed carrots
3/4  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped leeks
1  c. heavy cream
salt and pepper
preparation: Saute bacon.  Add potatoes, onion, marjoram and beef stock. Cook 25 minutes.  Add leeks, carrots and celery.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Add cream.  Cook 5 minutes.  Season.  Garnish with parsley.

name: GARLIC CHEESE TOAST
ingredients:
Texas toast
garlic powder
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Mix soft butter and Parmesan cheese together.  Stir in garlic powder to taste and spread on Texas toast.  Fry on both sides on solid grill or iron skillet.

name: HOT ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1 large  can artichoke hearts (not marinated)
1/2  c. sour cream
garlic powder to taste
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
preparation: Chop artichokes.  Mix all ingredients together in a bowl by hand.  Pour into a greased baking dish (quiche size does well). Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes.

name: PORK ROAST
ingredients:
10 to 12  lb. pork roast
2  onions, chopped
2  cloves garlic, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Make slits in roast with knife to a depth of approximately 3 inches deep every 5 to 6 inches.  In a small bowl, mix garlic, onion, salt and pepper.  Dampen mixture with water.   Rub seasoning over roast.  Heat small amount of oil in deep heavy iron pot.  Brown roast well on all sides.  After browning, add water and cover.  Let cook on high heat for 5 minutes.  Reduce heat and let simmer, turn occasionally.  Bake 4 hours or until well done. For additional flavor, stuff roast and keep in freezer for 3 to 4 days before baking.

name: PEDRO'S SPECIAL
ingredients:
1  lb. ground round
1  onion, chopped
1  can tomato sauce plus 1/3 can water
1  can kidney beans
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  bag corn chips
lettuce
onions
preparation: Brown ground round and chopped onion together.  Stir in tomato sauce, water and chili powder.

name: OLD FASHIONED POOR MAN'S CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. raisins
1 1/2  c. water
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking soda
2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Boil all ingredients together except flour and baking soda. When cool, then add flour and baking soda.  Mix well.  Grease and flour any size pan, preferably loaf pan.  Pour contents in pans and bake in slow (350°) oven for approximately 45 minutes; let cool before cutting.  Cake can also be frozen for future use.

name: GLAZED CARROTS
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can whole baby carrots, drained
2  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. firmly packed dark brown sugar
1 1/2  tsp. prepared spicy mustard
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Place carrots in a 9-inch pie pan.  In a small saucepan over moderate heat, melt butter; add onion and cook until lightly browned.  Remove from heat.  Stir in sugar and mustard; blend and spoon over carrots.  Bake, uncovered, 15 minutes or until lightly glazed.

name: REFRIGERATOR PICKLES
ingredients:
7  c. sliced cucumbers
2  onions, sliced
1  c. vinegar
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. celery seed
2  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Mix together cold.  Pour over cukes.  Let stand for 2 days. They keep for 3 months in refrigerator.

name: FRESH PEACH TOPPING
ingredients:
5  medium fresh peaches
fresh lemon
3  Tbsp. granulated sugar
1/4  cherry 7-Up
1/2  c. carbonated peach flavored soft drink
preparation: Peel and thinly slice peaches.  Squeeze fresh lemon sparingly over prepared peaches, then evenly sprinkle the sugar over this. Stir in the cherry 7-Up and peach soft drink.  Refrigerate.

name: INSTANT RUSSIAN TEA MIX
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  lb. 2 oz. jar Tang
1/2  c. instant Lipton tea (no lemon or sugar)
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in a jar.  Add 1 to 2 teaspoons per cup of boiling water.

name: APPLE FRITTERS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
2  large or 3 medium apples
preparation: In a bowl, stir first 5 ingredients until smooth. Pare, core and slice apples thinly.  Dip apple slices into the batter so each one is well-coated.

name: CARROTS A LA ORANGE
ingredients:
1  lb. (5 to 6) carrots, pared
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  c. orange juice
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter
fresh snipped parsley
preparation: Slice carrots crosswise on the bias, about 1 inch thick.  Cook, covered in boiling salted water, until just tender, about 15 minutes.  Drain.  Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch, salt, ginger and add orange juice.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.  Cook 1 minute or more.  Stir in butter until melted.  Pour over hot carrots, tossing to coat evenly.  Turn into serving dish.  Sprinkle with snipped parsley.  Yields 4 servings.

name: THREE BEAN BAKE
ingredients:
1/3  lb. diced bacon
1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1  lb. pork and beans
1  lb. kidney beans, drained
1/3  c. chopped onions
2 1/2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2/3  c. ketchup
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  lb. American cheese, grated
preparation: Cook bacon on sheet pan in oven.  Drain.  Dice or crumble. Cook ground beef and drain off fat.  Add remaining ingredients, except cheese, to beef and bacon.  Mix carefully.   Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake in a 350° oven for approximately 1 hour or until hot and bubbling.

name: VENISON ROAST
ingredients:
1  venison neck roast
1 medium  can tomatoes
1  large onion
carrots and potatoes
1/4  lb. sliced bacon
2  c. Burgundy wine
salt and pepper to taste
garlic powder
preparation: Soak roast in salt water overnight.  Rinse well.  Place venison neck in roasting pan, sprinkle roast with salt, pepper and garlic powder.  I use a lot of pepper and garlic.  Place tomato pieces and onions over roast and secure with toothpicks.  Pour tomato juice and wine over roast, lay bacon across the top, cover and bake at 325° for approximately 3 to 4 hours or until meat falls off the bone.  About 1 1/2 hours before roast is done, add potatoes and carrots.  Don't forget to baste periodically.

name: APPLESAUCE HONEY CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. allspice
1/2  c. soft butter
1 1/4  c. applesauce
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. honey
3  eggs
1  c. raisins
1  c. chopped walnuts
3  oz. softened cream cheese
3  Tbsp. honey
preparation: Combine first 13 ingredients in large mixer bowl.  Beat together on low speed of mixer until combined, then on medium speed, scraping sides and bottom of bowl with rubber spatula.  Pour hot water over 1 cup raisins; let set about 15 minutes.  Drain and lay on paper towels to absorb excess water.  Stir raisins and 1 cup chopped walnuts into batter.  Spread in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured baking pan.  Bake for 45 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1 large  can peaches
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  stick melted butter
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix together peaches and 1/2 cup of sugar and pour into cake pan.  Mix together flour, 1 cup sugar, milk, butter and baking powder.   Pour over peaches and sugar.  Do not stir!!  Bake at 375° until golden brown. It is delicious!!!

name: LYNN'S PUMPKIN PIE CAKE
ingredients:
1  can pumpkin (pie size)
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  yellow cake mix
2  sticks butter
1  c. pecans
preparation: Beat together.  Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Sprinkle (dry) cake mix on top.  Melt butter and pour over this. Add chopped pecans to top and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  can corn
1  can green beans
2  cans red kidney beans
2  cans tomatoes
1  can tomato sauce
2  c. potatoes, cooked
preparation: Put all ingredients in crock-pot and let simmer all day.  Add salt and pepper.

name: SMOKEY BRISKET (SUNDAY FAVORITE)
ingredients:
1  bottle hickory liquid smoke
1 to 2  lb. brisket
1/2  tsp. celery salt
water to cover
preparation: Turn crock-pot to high.  Pour in one bottle of liquid smoke. Place brisket in crock-pot.  Add celery salt and enough water to cover.  Cook overnight or all day.

name: CHICKEN-RICE BAKE
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (3 oz.)  can chopped mushrooms
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas and carrots, thawed
paprika
1  c. milk
1  envelope onion soup mix
1  c. regular rice
1  (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) ready to broiler-fryer chicken, cut up
preparation: In bowl, stir together mushroom soup, milk, dry onion soup mix and undrained mushrooms.  Reserve 1/2 cup of the soup mixture and set aside.  Stir uncooked rice and thawed vegetables into remaining soup mixture.

name: BROWN SUGAR CHESS PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. corn meal
1/4  c. melted margarine
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix well and flour in one 9-inch pie shell.  Bake at 320° for 45 minutes.

name: VEGETABLE FRITTATA
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil or margarine
1/2  lb. sliced fresh mushrooms
1  c. diced zucchini
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. chopped green onion
1  medium tomato, diced
3  eggs, lightly beaten
1/4  c. water
1/3  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. shredded Cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese
paprika
preparation: Heat skillet; add oil or margarine.  Add mushrooms, zucchini, green pepper and green onion; cook and stir over medium heat, about 5 minutes.  Sprinkle diced tomatoes over the top.  Mix together the eggs, water, mustard, salt and pepper; pour over veggies in skillet.  Cover; cook for 5 to 10 minutes, or until eggs are set.  Sprinkle cheese and paprika over the top; cover until cheese is melted.  Cut into wedges to serve.

name: EASY BAKED RATATOUILLE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. olive oil
3  cloves garlic, crushed or minced
1  bay leaf
1/2  tsp. basil leaves
1/4  lb. sliced mushrooms
salt and pepper to taste
2  onions, sliced thinly
2  to 3 eggplants
4  tomatoes, cut in half and sliced
1/2  tsp. rosemary leaves
preparation: Lightly grease a shallow 1 1/2-quart ovenproof dish with 1 teaspoon oil.  Cover bottom with half the onions and garlic.  Set aside.  Slice off ends of eggplants and cut in half lengthwise. Place each half on a cutting board, skin side up.  Slice each half lengthwise into thirds, leaving slices attached at stem ends. Spread sliced section apart to make a fan.  Insert a tomato slice between each section of eggplant fans.  Layer fans in dish along with remaining tomato, onion, garlic, mushrooms, basil, rosemary, bay leaf, salt and pepper.  Press down to pack.  Drizzle with remaining oil.  Cover with foil.  Bake in 375° oven for 45 minutes or until eggplant is tender.  Remove bay leaf before serving. Makes 6 servings.

name: QUICK PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  box rigatoni
2  green peppers
3  tomatoes
1/2  red onion
2  cucumbers
1 large  bottle Italian dressing
1/2  bottle McCormick Salad Supreme
preparation: Mix dressing and Salad Supreme.  Add pasta and remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Cover and refrigerate.

name: MACARONI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  1/2 cups elbow macaroni
3  Tbsp. margarine
3  Tbsp. all purpose flour
2  cups Carnation milk
salt and pepper to taste
2  cups shredded cheese
1/4  cup minced onion, optional
preparation: Melt butter, blend in flour. Add milk. Cook over medium heat until it begins to thicken. Remove from heat. Add salt and pepper, onion, if desired, and cheese. Stir until cheese is melted. Put already cooked macaroni in casserole dish and pour in all ingredients, already mixed. Stir thoroughly. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3/4  c. margarine, softened
1 1/3  c. frozen egg substitute, thawed
1 1/2  c. low-fat sour cream
1  tsp. baking soda
4 1/2  c. sifted cake flour (measure, then sift)
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Cream sugar and margarine at medium speed of an electric mixer until combined.  Gradually add egg substitute, beating well. Combine sour cream and baking soda; stir well and set aside. Combine flour and salt; with mixer running at low speed, add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream mixture, beginning and ending with flour mixture.  Stir in vanilla.  Spoon batter into a 10-inch tube pan coated with cooking spray.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 35 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove from pan.  Cool on a wire rack.  Yields 24 servings (serving size:  one 1-inch slice).

name: COUNTRY HAM BUTTER
ingredients:
8  Tbsp. or 1 stick unsalted butter
1  c. minced baked country ham, firmly packed and free of fat
preparation: Combine this and process in food processor until perfectly smooth.  Chill. Serve on biscuits, buttered toast or crackers.

name: EASY ONE-DISH CHICKEN BAKE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli cuts, rinsed and drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed Cheddar cheese soup
1  c. milk
3  c. cut up cooked chicken
1/2  tsp. onion powder
2  c. Bisquick reduced fat baking mix
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Mix broccoli, soups, 1 cup milk, chicken and onion powder in ungreased rectangular baking dish, 13 x 9 x 2-inch.  Mix baking mix and milk. Pour evenly over soup mixture. Sprinkle with parsley, if desired.  Bake 27 to 30 minutes or until light golden brown. Let stand at least 5 minutes.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
2/3  c. shortening plus 2 Tbsp.
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. salt
4 to 5  Tbsp. water
preparation: Mix and roll out dough.

name: MARSHMALLOW CREAM FUDGE
ingredients:
1  jar marshmallow cream (5% to 10%)
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter or oleo
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1/2  c. nuts (if desired)
2/3  c. evaporated milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In medium saucepan, combine marshmallow cream, sugar, evaporated milk, butter (or oleo) and salt.  Bring to a full boil, stirring constantly over moderate heat.  Boil 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Add vanilla.  Remove from heat.  Add chocolate chips and nuts; stir well until chips are melted.  Pour into a greased 8-inch square pan (with oleo).  Chill in refrigerator until firm, about 2 hours.  Yield:  2 1/4 pounds.

name: SPINACH IN RYE ROUNDS
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1  pkg. Knorr dry vegetable soup mix
1  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
1  small onion
1 small  can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
1  loaf round rye bread
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except bread, until smooth.  Scoop out center of rye bread, forming a bowl.  Put dip in center of bread and serve with bread cubes and crackers.

name: OPEN-FACE CUCUMBER SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  envelope Italian salad dressing
rye bread rounds
cucumber slices
dill weed
preparation: Mix cream cheese and Italian salad dressing together.  Spread on rye bread rounds.  Top with a slice of peeled cucumber. Sprinkle with dill weed.

name: CREAMED PEAS
ingredients:
1  can English baby peas
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  chicken bouillon cube
1  Tbsp. butter
1 small  jar pimentos
preparation: Gently fold all ingredients and heat thoroughly, but do not overcook.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  cans French-style green beans
1  c. grated cheese
1  medium chopped onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1/3  c. water
1 (No. 2)  can French fried onion rings
preparation: Mix together soup, sour cream and water.  In a saucepan, cook green beans and onions for 15 minutes.  Grease the bottom of casserole dish with butter.  Place green beans in first, then alternate layers with soup mixture, grated cheese and dot with butter.  Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes, then place onion rings on top and bake for 5 minutes more.

name: FUN FILLO
ingredients:
1  pkg. mini fillo shells or 1 pkg. pie dough, mixed
1  pkg. vanilla pudding (French vanilla is best)
any kind of fruit for tops *
preparation: *Suggestions:  Can use strawberries, bananas, blueberries, melon, apples, kiwi, papaya, grapes and tangerines.

name: NEW ENGLAND CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
2  cans clams (7 1/2 oz.)
4  oz. salt pork, minced
4  c. potatoes, diced
1 1/2  c. water
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1 3/4  c. milk
1  c. cream
1/4  c. milk
3  Tbsp. flour
preparation: In saucepan, cook salt pork until crisp.  Remove any lean pieces of pork; save.  Add the potatoes, 1 1/2 cups of water, onion and clam liquor to drippings.  Cook, covered, until potatoes are tender, 15 to 20 minutes.  Add clams, 1 3/4 cups milk and the cream.  Blend together 1/4 cup milk and flour; stir into chowder. Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally.  Add salt, pepper and salt pork.  Serves 6.

name: COUNTRY HERB ROASTED CHICKEN
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3  lb. chicken, cut into serving pieces
1  envelope Lipton savory herb and garlic soup mix
2  Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. olive or vegetable oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan, arrange chicken.  In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients; brush over chicken.  Bake 45 minutes or until chicken is done.

name: JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
1  lb. polish sausage or kielbasa
2  c. ham
2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. chicken
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  c. celery
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  c. onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. red pepper
1  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. salt
2  bay leaves
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. sage
2  c. tomatoes
2  cloves garlic, minced
2 1/2  c. chicken stock
1 1/2  c. rice
preparation: Saute sausage and ham in butter for 5 minutes.	Add chicken and brown sugar; cook 5 more minutes.  Add celery, bell pepper, onion; cook 5 minutes more.  Add all spices and sauté 1 minute. Mix in tomatoes and garlic.  Cook for an additional minute or two. Combine everything with chicken stock and rice in a Dutch oven. Cook at 350° for 1 hour or until all liquid has been absorbed.

name: SENSIBLE DOUBLE CHOCOLATE CHIP BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  c. chocolate chips, divided
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. unsweetened applesauce
2  Tbsp. margarine
3  egg whites
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Over low heat, melt 1 cup chips, sugar, applesauce and margarine; stir until smooth.  Remove from heat.  Add egg whites; stir well.  Stir in flour, baking soda and vanilla.   Stir in rest of chips and nuts.  Spread into greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake in preheated 350° oven for 16 to 20 minutes, or just until set.  Cool completely.  Cut into 2-inch squares.

name: BREAKFAST PIZZA
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk pack sausage
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. crescent rolls
1  c. frozen loosely packed hash brown potatoes, thawed
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
5  beaten eggs
1/4  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook sausage in medium skillet until browned; drain.  Set aside.  Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles; place triangles with elongated points toward center in a greased 12-inch pizza pan. Press bottom and sides to form a crust; seal perforations.  Spoon sausage over dough; sprinkle with hash browns and Cheddar cheese. Combine eggs, milk, salt and pepper; pour over sausage mixture. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.  Sprinkle with additional cheese.

name: BAKED POTATO TOPPER
ingredients:
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2 soup  can milk
diced onions to taste
1  dash Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Heat until onions are cooked (transparent).  Spoon over potatoes.

name: CRUNCHY JUMBLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. Rice Krispies cereal
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate morsels
preparation: Preheat  oven  to  350°.  Sift together flour, soda and salt. Set  aside.  Measure butter and sugar into large mixing bowl. Beat  until  well  blended  and  smooth.  Add  egg  and vanilla. Beat  well.  Add  sifted dry ingredients.  Mix until combined. Stir  in Rice Krispies cereal, semi-sweet chocolate morsels  and 1 cup raisins, if desired.  Drop by level measuring  tablespoon onto lightly greased cookie sheets.  Bake for 12  minutes  or until lightly browned.  Remove immediately and cool on wire racks.

name: LAYERED TACO DIP
ingredients:
2  cans refried beans (with peppers added)
1  container avocado dip
2  large containers sour cream
2  envelopes taco seasoning
2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. chopped green onions
1  large chopped and drained tomato
taco sauce or salsa
preparation: In large Pyrex dish, layer beans first, then avocado dip.  Mix sour cream with taco seasoning, then layer it and remaining ingredients, ending by spooning salsa over top.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: MANICOTTI GENOVESE
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped onion
1 large  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. basil leaves, crushed
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  can golden mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  c. water
1 (5 oz.)  can chunk chicken
2  c. (16 oz.) cottage cheese
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
8  manicotti macaroni, cooked and drained
3  slices Provolone cheese, cut in halves
preparation: Cook onion with garlic and basil in butter until tender.  Add soup, tomato sauce and water.  Bring to a boil.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Add chicken.

name: STRAWBERRY TRIFLE
ingredients:
2  c. cold water
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  large instant vanilla pudding
1  large Cool Whip
Vienna finger cookies
strawberries, sliced
preparation: Mix water and Eagle Brand milk with mixer.  Add instant pudding mix.  Chill about 5 minutes.  Add Cool Whip.  Layer with cookies and sliced strawberries.  Repeat pudding, cookies and strawberries. End with pudding.  (Good with peaches or other fresh fruit.)

name: OVEN-SHY COOKIES(Kids Corner)
ingredients:
1  pkg. marshmallows
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1 (12 oz.)  can salted peanuts
2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
3  c. crisp rice cereal
preparation: In a saucepan over low heat, cook and stir marshmallows, chips and butter until marshmallows are melted  and mixture is smooth. Remove from heat and stir in peanuts and cereal; mix well. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto wax paper; cool.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE SQUARES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
1 (8 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
2  c. flour
favorite preserves
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients.  Refrigerate for 3 hours.  Roll out dough and cut in squares.  Put favorite preserves in center. Pinch sides of dough to make hats.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, until bottom turns slightly brown.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  can cherry pie filling
1  box yellow cake mix
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
1 1/2  sticks oleo
preparation: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.  Spread pineapple over bottom of pan. Spread cherry filling over pineapple.  Sprinkle cake mix over fruits.  Top with nuts.  Cut oleo in small pieces and put on top. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour.  Serve with Dream Whip, etc.

name: SNOW-CAPPED BROCCOLI SPEARS
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli spears or fresh
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
grated Parmesan cheese
2  egg whites
1/4  tsp. salt
1/3  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
preparation: Cook broccoli spears according to package directions; drain well.  Arrange broccoli with stem ends toward the center on an ovenproof platter or in a 9-inch pie plate.
