Brush broccoli with the melted butter or margarine.  In a small bowl, beat egg whites and salt with rotary beater until stiff peaks form (tips stand straight).  Gently fold in mayonnaise or salad dressing.  Spoon mixture in center of broccoli; sprinkle with Parmesan.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CAMP STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  Tbsp. butter
1  can vegetable soup
1/2  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown ground beef in butter; add soup and water.  Season with salt and pepper.  Cover; cook slowly for 15 minutes.  Serve with thick slices of garlic toast.  Yield:  4 servings.

name: CRAYFISH QUICHE
ingredients:
1  unbaked pie crust
1  lb. crawfish tails, seasoned and salted
Mozzarella cheese
ham slices
mushrooms
6  eggs
1  pt. half and half cream
preparation: Begin with a layer of crawfish, layer of Mozzarella cheese, layer of small slices of ham.  Repeat 3 layers.  Top with mushrooms and cheese.  Beat the eggs well and add the half and half.  Pour over pie and let sit 10 minutes.  Cook at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Sprinkle a little nutmeg on each layer.

name: FRIED MUSKRAT
ingredients:
1  muskrat, dressed
salt and pepper
2  tsp. garlic powder
1  onion, sliced
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  c. ketchup
preparation: Cut the muskrat into serving size pieces and soak in salted water overnight.  Place the meat in a pot, add 1 quart of water, salt, pepper, garlic powder and onion.  Cook about 1 hour.  Brown meat in vegetable oil.  Pour ketchup seasoned with 1 teaspoon garlic powder over the meat.  Add some water and simmer about 30 minutes.

name: HOT FUDGE SAUCE IN THE MICROWAVE
ingredients:
1  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips (6 oz.)
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/4  c. half and half
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In mixing bowl, combine chocolate chips and corn syrup. Microwave at power level 5 for 1 1/2 to 2 1/2  minutes.  Mixture should be smooth when stirred.  Add remaining ingredients.  Stir until the butter melts and the mixture is blended.  Will make approximately 1 1/2 cups.  Serve over cake or ice cream.

name: FRESH BLENDER APPLESAUCE
ingredients:
4  large apples, peeled, cored and quartered
1/2  c. water
3  Tbsp. honey
1/8 to 1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Place all ingredients in container of electric blender.  Blend at medium speed until smooth, about one minute.  Serve at room temperature or chill.  Makes 3 cups.

name: TWO-CHEESE SHRIMP TARTS
ingredients:
1/3  c. semi-soft cheese (with garlic and herbs) or 1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese (with chives)
1/3  c. margarine
1  c. flour
1  egg yolk
1  c. Ricotta cheese
1  Tbsp. milk
2  tsp. finely snipped fresh dill or 1/2 tsp. dried dill weed
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. frozen, peeled and cooked shrimp, thawed and drained
preparation: For Pastry:  In a small mixing bowl, let semi-soft cheese or cream cheese and margarine or butter soften at room temperature. Stir together.  Stir in flour. Divide into 12 pieces.  Place one piece in the center of a seasoned 2 1/2-inch sandbakkelser mold. Press pastry evenly and thinly over bottom and up sides of mold. Repeat with remaining pastry.  Place molds on jelly roll pan or cookie sheet.  Bake in a 375° oven for 15 minutes or until lightly brown around edges.  Cool.   Using a toothpick, carefully put in an airtight container.  (Or return pastry shells to jelly roll pan and cover with foil.)  Seal, label and freeze for up to 2 months.

name: DILL WEED DIP
ingredients:
1 small  carton sour cream
equal amount Hellmann's mayonnaise
1  tsp. dill weed
1  tsp. Lawry's seasoned salt
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1  Tbsp. minced onion
preparation: Mix ingredients in small mixing bowl.  Refrigerate for 24 hours before serving.

name: MAMMA'S CHICKEN CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  chickens, cut up in serving pieces
1  c. lemon juice
2  c. seasoned bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. grated cheese (Parmesan)
1  sliced onion
olive oil
preparation: Dip chicken in lemon juice, then roll in seasoned bread crumbs and cheese mixture.  In a baking dish, place onion in and around chicken.  Sprinkle with olive oil and bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour, uncovered.

name: FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  c. (1 stick) butter
6  c. sliced onions (about 3 large or 6 medium)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
6  bouillon cubes (beef)
5 to 6  c. water
1/2  tsp. garlic salt or 2 cloves garlic
1/2  to 1 bay leaf
French bread or rye bread
Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Melt butter; stir in sliced onions and cook, covered, over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes.  Add salt and sugar, stir and cook another 15 minutes until onions are golden brown. Sprinkle flour over onions and stir.  Add bouillon which has been dissolved in 1 cup boiling water.  Add garlic, bay leaf and a little pepper.  Add 4 (or more) cups water and cook (simmer) for 20 minutes.  Put into bowls, place a slice of bread (which has been dried in the oven) on top and put a slice of cheese on top. Heat in oven at 350° for 5 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. Crisco
1 1/4  c. firmly packed brown sugar
2  Tbsp. sweet milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring
1  egg
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Cream Crisco, brown sugar, milk and vanilla in large bowl.  Blend until creamy.  Blend in egg. Combine flour, salt and baking soda.  Add to creamed mixture, gradually.  Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.  Drop by rounded spoonful 3-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Cook 8 to 10 minutes for chewy cookies or cook 11 to 13 minutes for crisp cookies.  Let cool on sheet 2 minutes.  Remove to cooling rack. Makes 3 dozen 3-inch cookies.

name: MAC-NUGGETS
ingredients:
2  beaten eggs
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1 minced  clove garlic
4  to 6 chicken breasts, skinned and cut into pieces
1/8 to 1/4  tsp. ginger
1/8  c. milk
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Marinate the chicken pieces in mixture of the other ingredients for at least 2 hours.

name: CHUCK WAGON BEANS
ingredients:
1 medium size  can pork and beans
1  green pepper
2  small onions
3  Tbsp. barbecue sauce
1  lb. sausage
1  lb. bacon
touch of brown sugar
preparation: Fry sausage and bacon.  Mix all other ingredients together. Crumble sausage and bacon with the other ingredients.  Add barbecue sauce.  Mixture will be a little dry at first.  Put in dish and place in a 350° oven for 30 minutes or until juice is thickened.  If you like baked beans, you'll love this.

name: BAKED HALIBUT, ITALIAN STYLE
ingredients:
4  halibut steaks
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/2  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
1/4  c. sliced olives
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of white pepper
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Place fish in greased baking dish.  Saute onion and garlic in butter until onion is tender.  Add tomato sauce, mushrooms, olives, oregano, sugar, salt and pepper.  Heat through.  Pour over halibut and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: SCOTCHIES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. quick cooking oats
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. shredded coconut
preparation: Sift together the flour, soda and salt.  Cream shortening; beat in sugar slowly.  Add egg and vanilla; beat until light and fluffy.  Stir in flour mixture, then the oats, pecans and coconut. Drop from a teaspoon onto greased cookie sheets.  Flatten to 1/8-inch thick with bottom of a glass dipped in flour.  Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes.  Remove from pan immediately.  (I always used to bake 2 or 3 batches at once.  My family could really make them disappear!)

name: TOMATO VEGETABLE SOUP(Diabetic)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
46  oz. V-8 juice
1  tsp. bouillon
1  c. water
1 1/2  c. cauliflower
1  large carrot, sliced
3/4  c. celery
3/4  c. onion
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. dried elbow macaroni
preparation: Brown meat; drain off fat.  Add remaining ingredients except macaroni.  Simmer until vegetables are tender.  Add macaroni and cook until macaroni is done.

name: PINEAPPLE BUTTERMILK SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  (3 oz.) orange jello
1  (3 oz.) apricot jello
2  c. buttermilk
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine pineapple and sugar in saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat; stir in jello until dissolved.  Cool to lukewarm.  Add buttermilk and stir.  Fold in Cool Whip and pecans.  Put in 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish.  Chill until firm.  Delicious.

name: MOO GOO GAI PAN
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. sherry
2  tsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. sugar
1  lb. mushrooms, sliced
4  green onions, sliced
2  large chicken breasts
1  c. peas
1  c. rice, cooked
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Cut chicken into bite size pieces and marinate with soy sauce, sherry, ginger, cornstarch, sugar and garlic powder.   In skillet, add oil.  Cook mushrooms and green onions until tender.  Remove. Add chicken and marinade and cook.  Return mushrooms and onions to pan.  Now add peas and heat thoroughly.  Serve over rice.

name: SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
6  oz. spaghetti
2  Tbsp. butter
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  eggs, well beaten
1  c. cottage cheese
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green bell pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions; drain. Stir butter into hot spaghetti.  Stir in Parmesan cheese and eggs. Form spaghetti mixture into a crust in buttered 10-inch pie plate.  Spread cottage cheese over bottom of spaghetti crust.

name: CURRY-CHICKEN BROCCOLI
ingredients:
4  whole chicken breasts, cooked and deboned
2  pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1  can cream of chicken soup
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1  stick butter
1  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Press cooked broccoli firmly in bottom of dish.  Top with chicken slices.  Combine everything else in large bowl (except butter and bread crumbs).  Pour over chicken slices.  Melt butter and add to bread crumbs.  Sprinkle on top.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: FROZEN PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  cup peanut butter
1  cup powdered sugar
1/2  cup milk
8  oz. whipped topping
1  prepared graham cracker crust
preparation: Whip cream cheese until fluffy.  Beat in peanut butter and sugar; add milk while beating.  Fold in whipped topping and beat. Pour into crust and freeze overnight.  Thaw at room temperature 15 minutes before serving.

name: CUCUMBER MAYONNAISE FOR FISH
ingredients:
1  large cucumber, grated fine
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. minced onion
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix and chill thoroughly.  Makes a wonderful tartar sauce.

name: NEVER FAIL FUDGE
ingredients:
1  box confectioners sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1  stick margarine
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix sugar and cocoa with milk in double boiler.  Dot margarine in there.  Simmer until mixture starts bubbling.  Remove from heat.  Add vanilla and pecans.  Mix well.  Pour out on waxed paper.  Refrigerate for about 30 minutes.  Cut in squares.

name: CAVATINI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef or turkey
1  lb. Italian sausage
2  tsp. dried onion
pepperoni
1 (4 oz.)  jar mushrooms
1  jar pizza sauce
10 to 12  oz. pasta shells or Skroodles
1 large  jar spaghetti sauce
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cook pasta; drain.  Brown meat; drain.  Add onion, pepperoni, mushrooms, sauces and spices.  Mix with pasta; pour into casserole (makes two 8-inch square pans).  Top with Mozzarella cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Freezes well.

name: STRAWBERRY GLAZE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. cornstarch
dash of salt
3  oz. pkg. strawberry jello
1 1/2  qt. fresh strawberries
2  baked pie shells
preparation: Boil water, sugar, cornstarch, and salt until thickened.  Add strawberry jello.  Stir in 1 1/2 quarts of fresh strawberries. Pour into 2 baked pie shells.

name: B L T'S TO GO
ingredients:
bread
lettuce
mayonnaise
sliced tomato
crispy bacon
preparation: Cover 1 slice of bread with lettuce leaves.  Cover lettuce with mayonnaise.  Place tomato slices under running water to wash out seeds and place on top of mayonnaise.  Crumble bacon over tomato slices.  Cover bacon with more lettuce leaves and top with another slice of bread.  Do not cut.  By washing out seeds and putting the mayonnaise between lettuce leaves, bread will not become soggy.  Crumbled bacon will assure bacon flavor in every bite.

name: RASPBERRY CREAM
ingredients:
1  c. boiling water
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry gelatin
1/2  pt. vanilla ice cream
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen raspberries
preparation: Pour boiling water over gelatin in bowl, stirring until gelatin is dissolved.  Stir in ice cream and raspberries, breaking up berries with fork.  Chill until set, about 20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND DRIED BEEF
ingredients:
4  to 6 chicken breasts
1  jar dried beef
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  tsp. butter
preparation: Grease bottom of baking dish with butter.  Clean chicken good. Cover bottom of dish with dried beef.  Next, lay chicken breasts over dried beef.  Pour the uncooked soup over chicken.  You may need to spread it out.  Cover dish with foil.  Bake for 2 hours at 325°.

name: SWEET POTATO PIES
ingredients:
4  large sweet potatoes, peeled
1  stick butter
3  c. sugar or sweeten to taste
2  tsp. cinnamon or to taste
1  tsp. nutmeg or to taste
1  can Carnation milk (evaporated)
preparation: Boil sweet potatoes until done, about 45 minutes.  Blend together for 15 minutes until strings from potatoes are gone. Pour into ready pie crust and bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes 4 to 5 pies.

name: HONEY MUSTARD DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. honey
1/2  c. mustard
2  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  tsp. onion salt
1/2  tsp. ground red pepper
3  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
preparation: Whisk until completely smooth.  Cover and refrigerate 6 to 8 hours.  Keeps up to a week.

name: VEGETABLE RICE
ingredients:
2  c. hot cooked rice
10 3/4  oz. can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/3  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. butter, softened
3  green onions with tops, finely chopped (1/4 c.)
1  c. shredded American cheese
1  c. frozen peas, thawed
1  medium green pepper, chopped (2/3 c.)
preparation: In 10-inch frypan, combine ingredients.  Cook, uncovered, over medium heat, stirring occasionally, about 15 minutes or until tender.

name: NUT BALLS
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1/4  c. oleo
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix in that order.  Roll into small balls.  Bake in oven at 375° for about 10 minutes, until lightly browned.  Cool real well. Shake a few at a time in bag with confectioners sugar.  Makes 65.

name: HERB ROASTED CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  lb. chicken fryer
1  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  c. melted butter
1/2  c. dry white wine
1  tsp. crushed rosemary
1  tsp. sweet basil, crushed
1  tsp. chopped parsley
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 375°. Sprinkle chicken cavities with the garlic salt and crushed rosemary. Truss chicken and place in an open roasting pan. Combine butter, wine, rosemary, basil, parsley, salt and pepper in a small saucepan. Cook over low heat a few minutes until thoroughly blended.  Baste chicken with wine sauce. Roast 20 minutes per pound until tender. Baste frequently. The last 20 minutes, turn to brown underside.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE FILLING
ingredients:
2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. cocoa
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together in saucepan over medium heat until it boils. Stir constantly. Let cool and pour into a baked 8-inch pie crust. Refrigerate overnight, then top with whipping cream.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs, lightly beaten
1  c. salad oil
1  c. sugar
2  c. zucchini, grated and drained
2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
3  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
2/3  c. raisins
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: You will need 2 greased and floured loaf pans.

name: MILLION CHEESECAKE-CALORIES THAT IS!!!!!
ingredients:
4 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. granulated sugar
pinch of salt
3  Tbsp. flour
6  eggs
juice of 1/2 lemon or 1 Tbsp. bottled concentrate
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Beat cream cheese.  Add sugar, salt and flour.  Mix well.  Add 1 egg at a time, beating after each addition.  Add sour cream, lemon juice and vanilla.  Blend well.  Pour into ungreased 10-inch spring-form pan.  Bake at 400° for 45 minutes on center shelf of oven.  Turn off oven.  Open and let stand for 1 hour.  Cool completely.

name: COWBOY CASSEROLE(Former Dallas Cowboy, Don Meredith)
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti
1  onion, diced
butter
1 1/2  lb. ground round
salt and pepper to taste
garlic powder, chili powder or Lawry's salt or all 3
1  can mushroom soup
1  can tomato soup
dash of Worcestershire
grated cheese
preparation: Cook spaghetti until just tender.  Brown onion in butter; add ground beef and cook until browned.  Add salt, pepper and seasonings.  Add soups and Worcestershire; mix spaghetti and meat sauce.  Cover and simmer 15 minutes.  Put into casserole dish. Top with cheese and heat in oven until cheese melts.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hash brown potatoes
1  pt. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. margarine or butter, melted
1/3  c. margarine or butter, melted
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  tsp. salt
2  c. cornflake crumbs
preparation: Combine potatoes and butter in large bowl.  Stir in sour cream, soup, onion, cheese, salt and pepper.  Place in greased 13 x 9-inch dish.  Combine crumbs and butter.  Sprinkle over top. Cover.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 40 minutes.

name: OLIVE-CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. shredded sharp natural Cheddar cheese
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
about 36 pimiento-stuffed small olives, drained
preparation: Mix cheese and flour.  Add butter and mix thoroughly.  (If dough seems dry, work with hands.)  Mold 1 teaspoon of dough around each olive; shape into ball.  Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet.  Cover; chill at least 1 hour.  Heat oven to 400°.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes.  Makes 3 to 4 dozen appetizers.

name: OLD FASHION OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c sugar
2  eggs
1  c crisco oil
3  1/2 c coconut
1  c brown sugar
1  c self rising flour
1  tsp vanilla
1/2  c pecans
preparation: Mix sugar and eggs together.  Add flour, crisco and vanilla, mixing well.  Add oatmeal, pecans and coconut.  Spoon out onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350 degrees for approx. 15 minutes.

name: SAUERKRAUT
ingredients:
1  head cabbage (firm and mature), chopped
1 scant  Tbsp. pickling salt per qt. warm water*
preparation: *For large container, use 1/2 pound (1 cup) pickling salt to 20 pounds chopped cabbage.  After cured, put in jars and process.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1  can Veg-All
1  can cooked chicken
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  frozen pie shells
preparation: Drain can of Veg-All and combine with chicken and cream of chicken soup. Pour mixture into one of the pie shells, cover with the other pie shell.  Make slits in top pie shell.  Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRIES
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1  c. finely ground nuts
1  c. flaked coconut
3/4  c. sweetened condensed milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  jar red sugar
almond slivers for stems
preparation: Mix the  first  5  ingredients.  Let  chill.  Make into balls 1-inch  in  diameter.  Roll in red sugar.  Pinch one end to form the  point  of  a strawberry.  Soak almond slivers in green cake coloring.  Let dry on paper towel.  Stick into end of strawberry for  a  stem.  Will  keep  in  refrigerator for several days. Good for party plates, teas, receptions, etc.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
3  ripe bananas, mashed
1/2  c. water
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix together.  Bake for 1 hour at 275°.

name: CHOCOLATE SOMBRERO CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate cake mix
1  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
1/2  c. cooking oil
1/4  c. coffee brandy
1/4  c. vodka
3/4  c. milk
4  eggs
preparation: Mix all ingredients and beat for 4 minutes.  Pour into well-greased and lightly floured Bundt pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until done.  Dust with confectioners sugar or frost with glaze.

name: HOMEMADE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. vanilla (1 Tbsp. if fruit is to be added)
1/2  pt. whipping cream
2  cans Eagle Brand condensed milk
1 1/2  qt. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
4  c. presweetened fruit (optional)
preparation: Combine eggs, cream, sugar, salt and vanilla in bowl and mix thoroughly with mixer.  Pour into ice cream freezer, add condensed milk and stir well.  Add dairy milk to fill line on freezer and stir.  If fruit is used, add before dairy milk.  Makes 4 quarts.

name: BARBECUES
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  small onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1  c. catsup
preparation: Brown hamburger with onion.  Drain fat off.  Add remaining ingredients.  Warm 10 to 15 minutes.

name: FRANKE'S TAMALE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
1  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. chili powder
1  c. cold water
2  c. boiling water
1  Tbsp. oil
1/3  c. chopped green pepper
1  lb. ground steak or hamburger
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sliced ripe olives
2 1/2  c. cooked tomatoes, chopped
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients.  Add slowly to boiling water and cook slowly, covered, for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Line bottom and sides of a 2-quart casserole with cooked cornmeal.  Set aside.  Cook next 4 ingredients until meat browns, stirring often. Add next 4 ingredients and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring often. Put this mixture in cornmeal lined casserole.  Top with grated cheese.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: GRANDMA'S GRAPE-NUT PUDDING(Easy)
ingredients:
1 scant  c. Grape-Nuts
1/2  c. sugar
salt
nutmeg (a lot)
cinnamon (a lot)
2  eggs
3  c. milk (whole)
preparation: Butter glass dish.  Add ingredients.  Just stir well.  Let set at least 1/2 hour.  Bake about 1 hour in 350° oven.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: VALENTINE PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. cherry Kool-Aid
2  pkg. strawberry Kool-Aid
2 large  cans Hi-C orange drink
2 large  cans pineapple juice
1 small  bottle lemon juice
preparation: Mix water and sugar with Kool-Aid according to package directions.  Then add orange drink, pineapple juice and lemon juice.  Mix together well.  Chill overnight in refrigerator, if possible.  Serve in punch bowl with fresh strawberries for garnish.

name: REUBEN POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can corned beef, minced
4  c. diced cooked potatoes
1 (No. 2)  can sauerkraut, drained
1  c. diced celery
2  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1  c. milk
2  c. mayonnaise
4  Tbsp. mustard
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
dash of pepper
preparation: Mix together first 5 ingredients.  Use milk to thin mayonnaise.  Add remaining ingredients to mayonnaise mixture; mix well.  Toss this mixture with the first mixture.  Serve immediately or warm up in oven or slow cooker.

name: MOLASSES BEANS
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans pork and beans
1 (15 3/4 oz.)  can barbecue beans
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  c. molasses
1/4  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. lemon pepper
4 to 5  slices bacon
preparation: Combine all ingredients together in baking dish and bake at 350° for 2 hours.  Makes 8 servings.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. oil
4  eggs, beaten
2/3  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
16  oz. pumpkin (fresh is best)
1 1/2  c. walnuts or pecans (optional)
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Pour into 4 (1 pound) coffee cans sprayed with Pam.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Makes 4 loaves.

name: RUM CUSTARD CAKE
ingredients:
5  large egg yolks
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. milk, scalded
preparation: Combine yolks and sugar in medium saucepan.  Gradually add cornstarch and vanilla.  Add hot milk, whisking constantly.   Cook over very low heat or in double boiler, stirring constantly, until thickened, about 5 minutes.  Cool.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
3  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  bunch green onions (tops and all)
3  ribs celery
1 (8 oz.)  can mushrooms
1  can mushroom soup
1  roll garlic cheese or 1 small Cheez Whiz and 1 tsp.  garlic powder
preparation: Cook and drain broccoli; saute onions, celery and mushrooms in butter.  Melt garlic cheese on soup.  Combine all ingredients in a casserole and bake at 350° until hot through (about 30 minutes). Top with Ritz cracker crumbs.

name: SPRING SALAD
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple (juice and all)
1  box mixed fruit jello (no water)
1  small (8 oz.) container cottage cheese
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
preparation: Mix together the pineapple and jello.  Boil for 2 minutes and then cool.  Mix cottage cheese and Cool Whip into pineapple and jello mixture.  Congeal overnight.

name: QUAIL HUNTER'S BOUNTY
ingredients:
4  to 6 quail breasts
1/2  c. water
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  diced apple
preparation: Place quail breast in pan of water and boil for 10 minutes. Drain and arrange breasts in baking dish.  Make gravy from one can of cream of mushroom soup, 1/2 cup water and diced apple.  In a small saucepan, cook over medium heat, stirring constantly. Remove from heat when it begins to boil.  Pour over quail breasts. Salt and pepper to taste.  Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: SUGAR FREE WHIPPED TOPPING
ingredients:
1/4  c. ice water
1/4  c. instant non-fat dry milk powder
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
sugar substitute to equal 1/3 c. sugar (6 tsp. Equal is equal to 1/3 c. sugar)
preparation: Place ice water in a small bowl; gradually add milk powder, beating at high speed of an electric mixer until soft peaks form.

name: LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. hot water
2  eggs, separated
1  lemon and grated rind
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix  sugar and cornstarch.  Add water and cook until it boils; remove  from  heat.  Add  lemon  juice  and beaten egg yolks. Cook  until  thick.  Remove from heat.  Add margarine, salt and grated  rind.  Cool  and  pour in a baked 9-inch pie shell.

name: ONE DISH MEAL
ingredients:
1  medium onion, diced
1  c. celery, diced
1  c. brown rice (uncooked)
1  can diced Soyameat
1  c. grated carrots
1  c. sliced mushrooms
1/3  c. oil
2  c. water
3  pkg. George Washington broth
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: Mix diced vegetables, Soyameat, rice and mushrooms in a 2-quart casserole; set aside.

name: VANILLA WAFER CAKE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  box vanilla wafers, crushed
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans, chopped
2  c. sugar
2  c. milk
9  eggs
2  sticks or 1 c. margarine
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients.  Put in greased and floured Bundt or angel food cake pan.  Cook for 1 hour or until golden brown and toothpick inserted into cake comes out clean.  Makes a great substitute for fruit cake.

name: REFRIGERATOR MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. crushed Shredded Wheat
2  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. melted shortening
2  eggs
2  c. Bran Buds or All-Bran
1  c. boiling water
2  Tbsp. honey
1 1/2  c. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking soda
2 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Combine Shredded Wheat and boiling water.  Add following in the order given and mix well while adding: 1/2 cup buttermilk, honey, shortening, sugar, eggs, baking soda, remaining buttermilk, Bran Buds and flour.  Store in refrigerator up to 5 weeks.  Or place in muffin tins and bake at 375° for 25 minutes.  Makes 24 muffins.

name: ANNA'S SWEET AND SOUR MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. milk
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2/3  c. Heinz chili sauce
2/3  c. red currant jelly
preparation: Combine ground beef, bread crumbs, egg, onion, milk, garlic, salt and pepper. Form into 40 meatballs, using a rounded teaspoonful for each one.  Brown meatballs lightly in oil.  Cover and cook over low heat for 5 minutes.  Drain excess fat.  Combine chili sauce and jelly.  Pour over meatballs and heat, stirring until jelly is melted. Simmer 10 to 12 minutes until sauce thickens.  Baste occasionally.

name: CHEESE SNAPS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter (do not substitute)
2  c. flour
2  c. grated sharp cheese
red pepper (use sparingly)
salt to taste
1/2  c. finely chopped pecans (optional)
preparation: Cream butter and cheese well.  Add flour, red pepper, salt and pecans.  Mix well.  Form into small logs and wrap in foil.  Leave in refrigerator until hard enough to slice.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Watch closely.  For cheese sticks, use pastry bag to form stick.  Chill, then bake same as before.

name: TEA PUNCH
ingredients:
2  family size tea bags
1 1/2  c. sugar
12  oz. can frozen orange juice
12  oz. can frozen lemonade
water (enough to make 1 gal.)
preparation: Brew tea.  Add sugar and stir to dissolve.  Add all other ingredients and chill.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. + 2 Tbsp. butter
4  eggs
2/3  c. milk
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2 + 2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. nuts, chopped up
preparation: Bake in jelly roll pan for 28 to 30 minutes at 375°.

name: EGGLESS, MILKLESS, BUTTERLESS CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. water
1  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
2  c. raisins
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/3  c. shortening
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Put water, brown sugar, raisins, shortening, salt and spices in a saucepan.  Mix.  Bring to a boil.  Cook for 3 minutes.  Cool. Sift together flour, soda and baking powder.  Stir into cooled mixture, mixing well.  Pour into a greased loaf pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.  Frost, if desired, or serve plain.

name: CRAB DELISH
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. green onions, chopped
1  Tbsp. milk
1 (6 oz.)  can crabmeat
thin rounds French bread
preparation: Mix together cream cheese, Worcestershire sauce, green onions and milk.  Add crabmeat.  Bake in shallow pan at 350° until bubbly. Can be spread on thin rounds of French bread.  Serve hot.

name: ELLEN HONNOLD'S PERFECT CHOCOLATE PIE FILLING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
5  Tbsp. cornstarch
dash of salt
4  c. milk
3  sq. chocolate, melted, or 5 Tbsp. cocoa
3  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  baked pie shell
preparation: Cocoa Recipe:  In a saucepan, mix sugar, cornstarch, salt and cocoa.  Gradually stir in milk and eggs; cook slowly until thick. Remove from heat.  Stir in vanilla and butter.

name: GREEN RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick melted margarine
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
4  c. cooked rice
1  lb. frozen chopped broccoli
preparation: Mix together the soup, margarine, celery, onion and salt.  Add the Cheez Whiz, rice and broccoli.  Bake 1 hour at 350° or until onions are tender.  Buttered bread crumbs or crushed potato chips may be sprinkled over top before baking if desired.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
12  medium yellow squash
1  stack Ritz crackers
2  beef bouillon cubes
1  medium, chopped onion
1  stick butter
12  oz. grated cheese
preparation: Any type squash or combination will do; cook squash and onion in bouillon water until tender.  Use just enough water to cover squash well.  When tender, add butter, crackers and cheese.  Stir together well and season to taste.

name: MAKE-AHEAD BREAKFAST
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
4  slices bread, toasted and crumbled
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
6  eggs
2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Crumble sausage in a medium skillet; cook over medium heat until browned, stirring occasionally.  Drain well.  Spread bread crumbs in a buttered 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish; top with sausage and cheese.  Combine eggs, milk and seasonings; beat well and pour over cheese.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until set.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: PINEAPPLE FRITTERS
ingredients:
1  egg
1  cup milk (scant)
3  Tbsp. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  cup crushed and drained pineapple
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
2  1/2 cups flour to make stiff batter
preparation: Combine in order given. Add pineapple to batter last. Drop a tablespoon at a time in hot, deep fat. Cook until golden brown. Serve with pineapple fritter sauce.

name: BEEF BURGERS PROVENCALE
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef or ground turkey
1/4  c. shredded zucchini
1/4  c. seasoned bread crumbs
2 1/2  c. sliced zucchini
14 1/2  oz. can tomatoes
16  oz. can small white potatoes
preparation: Mix ground beef, shredded zucchini and bread crumbs into 8 (1/2-inch) thick patties.  Brown on both sides in a large nonstick skillet for 3 to 4 minutes.  Stir in sliced zucchini and tomatoes. Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat.  Cover and simmer 7 to 9 minutes. Turn patties and stir 2 to 3 times or until zucchini is crisp-tender.  Add potatoes and simmer 3 minutes longer or until patties are no longer pink in center.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
2  cans cream of broccoli soup
1  c. milk
1/4  tsp. dried thyme leaves
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can Hungry Jack refrigerated flaky biscuits
4  c. cut up vegetables (cauliflower, broccoli, carrots and potatoes) *
2  c. cubed cooked chicken or turkey
preparation: *Or use 1 (16 ounce) bag frozen vegetable combination (broccoli, cauliflower and carrots), cooked and drained, and 1 cup cubed, cooked, peeled potato.

name: TROUT WITH DILL BUTTER
ingredients:
4  trout
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. allspice
1 1/4  tsp. white pepper
juice of 2 lemons
1/4  c. chopped dill
1/4  c. butter
6  Tbsp. oil
1  lb. tomatoes
1  onion, finely chopped
preparation: Trout is available all the year round, fresh or frozen.  Allow frozen trout to thaw before using.  Rub the insides of the trout with salt,  allspice, 1/4 teaspoon of the pepper and half the lemon juice.  Mix the dill with the butter and spread inside the trout.  Lay the fish on the broiler pan or barbecue rack; brush with oil and broil or barbecue for about 5 minutes on each side.

name: RASPBERRY PIE
ingredients:
2  pie shells
2 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
5  c. raspberries
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt.  Gently toss raspberries with mixture (don't break berries).  Pour into bottom crust; dot with butter.  Moisten edge of crust and top with remaining crust. Seal.  Bake at 375° for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. cooked chicken
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. cooked white rice
3/4  c. small green grapes
3/4  c. pineapple tidbits
1/2  c. mandarin oranges, drained
1/2  c. slivered almonds, toasted
1/2  c. mayo
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Ranch salad dressing
preparation: Add ingredients in order.  Mix mayonnaise and salad dressing, then toss to coat.

name: DANDY SHANDY
ingredients:
4  oz. (1.2 c.) good quality dark stout or porter beer or nonalcoholic beer
4  oz. (1/2 c.) chilled ginger ale or ginger beer
preparation: Place dark stout beer in a serving glass.  Pour ginger ale atop. Makes 1 (8-ounce) serving.

name: CRABMEAT AU GRATIN
ingredients:
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1  c. onions, chopped
1/4  tsp. red pepper
1/2  c. flour
2  egg yolks
1  tsp. salt
1  lb. lump crabmeat
1  stick butter
1 (14 oz.)  can evaporated milk
8  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Saute onions and celery in butter until soft.  Add flour to mixture. Add milk, stirring constantly. Add egg yolks, salt and pepper.  Cook for 10 minutes.  Put crabmeat in a bowl and pour sauce over it.  Blend well and place in a lightly greased casserole and sprinkle with grated cheese.  Bake at 375° until browned.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans Swanson chicken or 1 boiled chicken
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  c. milk
2  sticks margarine
2  c. canned chicken broth or 2 c. broth from boiled chicken
2  small bags Pepperidge Farm herb dressing
preparation: Mix together in a 9 x 15-inch pan  the first 3 ingredients. In saucepan, combine margarine and chicken broth with dressing. Mix together well.  Spoon on top of creamy chicken mixture.  Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: PECAN MACAROONS
ingredients:
4  c. pecans
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients; add pecans.  Bake at 275° for 20 minutes (preheat oven).  Spread on greased cookie sheet to bake.

name: CHICKEN JUBILEE
ingredients:
2  frying chickens
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. drained peaches
1 1/2  c. drained dark cherries
1/2  c. chili sauce
1  tsp. salt
1 (8 oz.)  bottle sweet and sour sauce
1  medium onion
preparation: Place chicken in pan.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Drizzle with butter.  Broil until brown.  Combine sauce, drained peaches and cherries, sliced onion and chili sauce.  Spoon over chicken. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: RED POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. red potatoes, boiled, cooled and cut in half
6  hard-boiled eggs, peeled and cut in half
2  to 3 stalks celery, chopped
2  to 3 green onions, chopped
3  Tbsp. fresh dill
2  Tbsp. fresh parsley
salt and pepper
3/4  c. sour cream
3/4  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and chill before serving.

name: MAGIC MEATBALLS
ingredients:
12  oz. bottle chili sauce
3/4  c. grape juice
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine chili sauce, jelly and lemon juice in 2 quart saucepan.  Shape beef and salt into 1-inch balls.  Place in sauce and cook, simmering 30 minutes.  Serve hot with toothpicks.

name: THELMA'S APPLE BUTTER
ingredients:
apples*
9 to 10  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. cloves
pinch of salt
preparation: *Cut and core apples; cut into small pieces.  Cook and put through food mill.  Measure out 10 cups cooked apples (like applesauce).

name: HOT FUDGE PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sugar, divided
1  c. flour
7  Tbsp. cocoa, divided
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1 1/4  c. hot water
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In medium mixing bowl, combine 3/4 cup sugar, flour, 3 tablespoons cocoa, baking powder and salt.  Blend in milk, melted butter and vanilla.  Beat until smooth.  Pour batter into square 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

name: LOW-FAT CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. 95% lean ground beef
1  lb. lean ground turkey (1% fat)
1  can Hunt's traditional spaghetti sauce
1 large  can crushed tomatoes
2 medium to large  cans B&M red kidney beans
2  cans water
1  pkg. any chili mix seasoning
preparation: Stir in large saucepan and simmer; add Tabasco and crushed red pepper to your taste.  Serve with Italian breadsticks with low-fat Mozzarella cheese or saltine crackers.

name: CLAM CASINO
ingredients:
2  cans clams, minced or chopped (with juice)
1  c. crushed Ritz crackers
1  stick butter, melted
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh garlic (you can use garlic powder as a substitute)
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. oregano
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
juice from 1 fresh lemon
preparation: Combine all ingredients together and mix well.  Bake in covered dish at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Serve with small rye bread rounds or Ritz crackers.  Also may be used to stuff quahaugs.

name: ANYTIME SMOOTHIE
ingredients:
1  banana
1 to 1 1/2  c. strawberries or peach slices or blueberries
3  Tbsp. Dannon nonfat plain yogurt
orange juice
ice
1  Tbsp. honey or sugar
1/4  tsp. cinnamon or nutmeg
1 to 2  Tbsp. protein powder (optional)
preparation: In a blender, put berries or peaches (fresh is preferred, but frozen with no juices is okay), then break 1 banana on top.  Next, add yogurt, honey (or sugar), cinnamon and/or nutmeg.  Add protein powder, if desired, at this time.  Add enough ice to fill just under top of blender.  Put enough orange juice in to fill to near top.  Put lid securely over blender and blend at low and then high speed.  Pour into tall glass or frosted mug.  Makes 24 ounces.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH TEA COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter, softened
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  egg
1  Tbsp. instant tea concentrate
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. rolled oats
2/3  c. shredded coconut
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. unsifted all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
blanched almonds (optional)
preparation: Cream butter and sugar together.  Beat in egg, tea and vanilla.  Add oats, coconut and chopped nuts.  Mix together flour, baking soda and salt; add to batter.  Chill for an hour or more. With lightly floured hands, shape into 1-inch balls and place on baking sheet, 2-inches apart.  Flatten with floured fork and place almond in center.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.  Remove from baking sheet while warm.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
1/2  c. light corn syrup
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. melted butter
1  c. pecan halves
preparation: Mix sugar, corn syrup, eggs and butter in blender.  Mix in pecan halves by hand.  Fill unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 375° for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: CRAB SWISS BITES
ingredients:
1  can crab meat
1  Tbsp. green onion, diced
4  oz. (1 c.) grated Swiss cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. curry powder
1  pkg. flaky style refrigerator rolls (12 in pkg.)
preparation: Drain and flake crab.  Combine all except rolls and mix well. Separate rolls into 3 layers each.  Spoon on crab mixture.  Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet in a 400° oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes 36.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1  pkg. vanilla pudding (instant)
1  (6 oz.) frozen orange juice, thawed
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Mix together and serve with fresh fruit.

name: STUFFED TORTILLAS
ingredients:
1  (4 oz.) chopped green chilies
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  can chopped olives
2  pkg. flour tortillas
preparation: Let cheese soften.  Mix olives and green chilies with cheese. Spread on flour tortillas.  Roll up and chill several hours.  Cut in desired size slices.  Serve with picante sauce.

name: BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. beef, cubed and trimmed well
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. beef broth
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  garlic cloves, crushed
1  small bay leaf
3/4  tsp. paprika
4  carrots, sliced
3  potatoes, diced
2  large chopped onions
2  stalks celery, sliced
1  tsp. Kitchen Bouquet
pinch of cumin
pinch of oregano
preparation: Mix flour, salt and pepper.  Coat meat.  Add and mix the remaining ingredients.  Toss all into crock-pot.  Cook on low approximately 8 hours.

name: DONNA BELL'S POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
5  lb. red California potatoes
1  medium onion, diced small
1  lb. bacon plus 3 Tbsp. bacon fat
1  qt. Hellmann's mayonnaise
4  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. parsley
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Boil potatoes in skins until tender, but firm.  Cool, peel and slice into bowl.  Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble into potatoes.  Cook diced onion in bacon fat until light brown and tender.  Add onions and 3 tablespoons bacon fat to potatoes.

name: CROWD PLEASER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. lean ground meat
1  large onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  c. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
1 large  pkg. egg noodles, cooked
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
grated cheese
preparation: Brown meat, onion and bell pepper.  Add following ingredients: sour cream, soups, corn, egg noodles, salt and pepper.  Turn into 2-quart Pyrex dishes; top with grated cheese.  Bake for about 30 minutes at 350°, until cheese is melted.  Can be frozen to use at a later date.

name: SWEET 'N SOUR STIR-FRY
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oil
1  c. thinly sliced carrots
1  c. snow peas (about 4 oz.)
1  small green pepper, cut into chunks
1  c. sliced water chestnuts
1  medium tomato, cut into wedges
1/2  c. sliced cucumber, halved
3/4  c. Wish-Bone Sweet 'n Spicy French dressing
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  tsp. soy sauce
preparation: In medium skillet, heat oil and cook carrots, snow peas and green pepper over medium heat, stirring frequently, 5 minutes or until crisp-tender.  Add water chestnuts, tomato, cucumber and Sweet 'n Spicy French dressing blended with brown sugar and soy sauce.  Simmer, covered, 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Top, if desired, with sesame seed.  Makes about 6 servings.

name: COCONUT PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  c. packed light brown sugar
1  c. cream of coconut
1  c. pecan pieces or halves
2  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
1/2  c. coconut
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  unbaked pie shell (9-inch)
whipped cream
chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Beat eggs in medium bowl.  Add brown sugar; stir until brown sugar dissolves.  Add next 6 ingredients; mix well.  Spoon into pie shell.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until center is puffed.  Cool.  Chill until serving time.  Serve with whipped cream and chopped pecans.

name: CHEESY CARAPPLE DESSERT
ingredients:
2  cans biscuits
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
1 (12 oz.)  jar caramel ice cream topping
2  apples, chopped
preparation: Roll out biscuits to fit long cookie sheet.   Mix cream cheese, vanilla and sugar.  Spread over dough.  Spread apples over top.   Sprinkle over top of dough the chopped nuts.   Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.  This dessert is not real sweet, but it is delicious.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  c. chopped zucchini
1/2  c. diced onion
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 1/2  c. Herd croutons
3/4  c. grated carrot
3/4  c. sour cream
2 1/2  c. cheddar cheese
6  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook zucchini until tender.  Drain. Set aside.  Sauté carrots, onions, pepper in butter until done.  Mix together with zucchini in greased 9 x 13 dish.  In small bowl mix sour cream, soup and cheese, combine with zucchini mixture.  Stir in croutons. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: BLUEBERRY CRUNCH
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  sticks margarine
1  c. pecans, chopped
1  box confectioners sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1  can blueberry pie filling
preparation: Mix melted margarine, flour and pecans.  Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° until brown.  Mix cream cheese, confectioners sugar and 1 1/2 cups Cool Whip.  Spread on crust. Top with pie filling, then top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

name: CALIFORNIA BLEND CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  bag California blend
1  can deboned chicken
1  can cream of chicken
1  c. Miracle Whip
1  bag shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix together cream of chicken and Miracle Whip, then put in layers in a 9 x 13 pan.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: PARTY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  Tbsp. pimentos
1  Tbsp. green pepper, grated
1  Tbsp. onion, grated
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. lemon juice
dash of salt
1 to 2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine softened cream cheese and Cheddar cheese until well blended.  Add other ingredients (except pecans) and mix well. Chill. After chilled, shape in a ball and roll in pecans.

name: MEATBALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  eggs
1  c. bread crumbs
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1  can whole cranberry sauce
1  can sauerkraut, drained
1  bottle chili sauce
1  c. brown sugar
preparation: Mix together the beef, eggs, bread crumbs and onion soup mix. Put into a 9 x 13-inch pan or baking dish (do not brown).  Mix cranberry sauce, sauerkraut, chili sauce and brown sugar; pour over meatballs.  Cover with foil.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 hours.

name: SOFT MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. allspice
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cloves
2  tsp. ginger
2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. hot coffee or hot water
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. shortening
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. molasses
preparation: Sift flour once.  Add salt and spices, then sift together. Beat eggs; add sugar.  Blend well, then add molasses and shortening.  Dissolve baking soda in coffee and add to other ingredients.  Combine with flour mixture, mixing thoroughly. Chill at least 1 hour.  Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Makes 48 medium cookies.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. mashed bananas
3/4  c. oil
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1/2  c. nuts
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, bananas, oil and eggs in large bowl with wooden spoon.  Mix in remaining ingredients and bake in greased loaf pan for 60 to 70 minutes at 350°.  Cool 10 minutes.  Take out of pan. Can also add 1 cup raisins if you like.

name: PIG LICKIN CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  can mandarin oranges (juice and all)
1  large container Cool Whip
1 large  box instant pudding mix (mix as directed on box)
1  c. powdered sugar
1 small  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix the cake mix, oil, sugar, eggs and mandarin oranges together.  Pour into 3 round cake pans.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. diced zucchini
1  medium onion, chopped
3  large eggs
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
1  c. Bisquick
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. oregano (can be omitted)
preparation: Mix zucchini, onion, cheese, Bisquick and seasonings well in a large bowl.  Pour into a well-greased casserole.  Beat eggs and oil together; pour over zucchini mixture, blending well.  Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 50 minutes.  Freezes and reheats well.

name: CHICKEN HAWAIIAN
ingredients:
2  (3 to 3 1/2 lb.) chickens, cut in eighths
1  jar apricot jelly
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1  jar Wish-Bone Russian dressing
1 medium  can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Mix all ingredients (except chicken) together in bowl.  Dip chicken in mixture and place in baking pan.  Pour remainder of mixture on top of chicken parts.  Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour, covering with foil for first half hour.  Serve with rice. (Do not salt chicken.)

name: BARBECUE BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2 (14 oz.)  cans pork and beans
1  small onion, chopped
1  small bell pepper, chopped
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/4  c. ketchup
2  Tbsp. barbecue sauce
6  slices bacon
preparation: Mix all ingredients except bacon and put in baking dish. Place bacon strips on top of the beans and cook in the oven, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until onion and bell pepper are done.

name: OH-SO-EASY BARS
ingredients:
1  c. mini sized M&M's
2  c. Bisquick
1 1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
3 eggs or 1  pkg. egg substitute
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Mix all ingredients except 1/4 cup of the M&M's candies.  Spread the mixture in the pan and sprinkle the reserved candies on top.  Bake about 30 minutes or until light golden brown.  Cool.  Cut into bars and serve.

name: PATRICIA'S PEANUT BUTTER OATMEAL FUDGE
ingredients:
1  stick Butter
2  c. Sugar
1/2  c. Milk
1/2  tsp. Vanilla
1  c. Peanut Butter
1  c. uncooked Oatmeal
1  c. Walnuts
preparation: Stir while melting on low, Butter, Sugar and Milk.  Bring to a full boil for 1 minute, no stirring.  Remove from heat.  Add Vanilla, Peanut Butter, Oatmeal and Walnuts.  Mix well, place in pan sprayed with Pam.  Refrigerate.

name: COLD OVEN POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
1/4  c. Crisco
3  c. plain flour
3  c. sugar
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
5  eggs
preparation: Cream butter and Crisco well.  Add other ingredients; add milk last!  Add eggs, one at a time.  Beat well after each egg.  Blend well after milk, pouring mixture into floured tube pan.  Bake in cold oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.  Cool about 10 minutes, then wrap in foil.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1  stick butter
2  cans creamed corn
5  eggs
2/3  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Melt butter and mix with corn.  Beat eggs and fold into corn. Add milk.  Mix sugar and flour.  Add to other ingredients.  Mix well and bake at 350° for 35 minutes (longer if needed).

name: GARLIC BREAD AND BUTTER PICKLES
ingredients:
2  green bell peppers, chopped
4  qt. cucumbers, sliced (about 6 lb.)
1 1/2  c. onions, sliced (about 1 lb. or 12 to 15 small white)
3  large garlic cloves
1/2  c. salt
cool water to cover
5  c. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. turmeric
1 1/2  tsp. celery seed
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
3  c. white cider vinegar
preparation: Wash cucumbers thoroughly, using a vegetable brush; drain on rack.  Slice unpeeled cucumbers into 1/8-inch or 1/4-inch slices; discard ends.  Add onions and garlic.  Add salt and mix thoroughly. Cover with crushed ice or ice cubes; let stand 3 hours.  Drain thoroughly; remove garlic cloves.  Combine sugar, spices and vinegar; heat just to boiling.  Add drained cucumbers and onion slices and heat 5 minutes.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1 (9 oz.)  carton whipped topping
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  box vanilla wafers
4  bananas
preparation: Make pudding as directed on package; chill until set.  Stir in marshmallows and whipped topping, just until blended.  In a large bowl, layer the wafers, then the mixture, then layer of bananas, until all is used.

name: SAUERKRAUT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. Mild Italian Sausage Links-Cut into 1-inch Slices
1  lg Onion Chopped
2  Apples Macintosh or Granny Smith Peeled & Quartered
27  oz. Can Sauerkraut-Undrained
1  Cup Water
1/2  Cup Browned Sugar Packed
2  tsp. Caraway Seeds
preparation: Preheat oven to 350.  In large skillet or Dutch oven.  Cook Italian Sausage and onion until sausage is brown and onion is tender.  Drain fat.  Stir in apples, sauerkraut, water, sugar and caraway seed.  Transfer to a 2-1/2 qt. baking dish.  Cover and bake for 1 hour.  Serves 4.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  chicken, boiled, deboned and chopped
1/3 large  jar Miracle Whip
1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  large onion, chopped
1  small bag almonds
preparation: Mix all and chill.  Serve with crackers, chips or on bread as a sandwich.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix (butter recipe)
2  boxes instant vanilla pudding mix, mix as directed on box
2 large  cans crushed pineapple, well drained
1  can cherry pie filling
1  large container Cool Whip
nuts
preparation: Make 2 layers of cake.  In punch bowl, crumble one layer of cake.  Pour half of pudding mix over cake.  Crumble other layer of cake and add rest of pudding mix; spread evenly.  Add pineapple. Pour over pudding mix.  Pour cherry pie filling evenly.  Top with Cool Whip.  Sprinkle with nuts on top.  Keep refrigerated.

name: FROZEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can (12 oz.) frozen OJ (thawed)
1  cup water
1  cup sugar
6  bananas (sliced)
1  can (16 oz.) of crushed pineapple
1  can (16 oz.) of apricot halves (drained)
1  can (16 oz.) of sliced peaches (drained)
maraschino cherries (drained)
1 large  pkg. of frozen strawberries
seedless grapes (washed and sliced if large)
2  cans (12 oz.) of 7-Up
preparation: In a large bowl combine OJ, water and sugar.  Slice bananas into OJ mixture to prevent darkening.  Add pineapple.  Chop apricot halves, slice peaches and cherries into bite size pieces.  Add to mixture.  Add strawberries and grapes.  Mix well.  Cover and freeze.  Remove from freezer about 45 - 60 minutes prior to serving.  When ready to serve pour 1 - 1.5 cans of 7-Up over frozen fruit mixture.  Serve partially frozen.

name: CRANBERRY NUT PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
2  c. fresh cranberries
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/4  stick (1/4 c.) butter, melted
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
2  eggs
preparation: Mix 1/2 cup sugar, cranberries and chopped walnuts together and pat down in ungreased pie pan. In mixing bowl, add melted butter, 1 cup sugar, flour and eggs, mixing together thoroughly. Pour this mixture on top of berries. Melt 4 tablespoons butter and drizzle over top of berries and topping. Bake in preheated 325° oven for 1 hour. When cooled, sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired.

name: OYSTERETTES
ingredients:
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing (dry)
1 1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1/2  tsp. lemon pepper seasoning salt
16  oz. box oyster crackers
1/2 to 3/4  c. Wesson oil
preparation: Mix in big bowl.  Put in cake pan.  Place in 250° oven for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.  Take out of oven and put in brown bag and shake to take off excessive oil.  Store in Tupperware.

name: OLIVE CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
4  Tbsp. butter, room temperature
1  c. flour
dash of cayenne pepper
50  green stuffed olives
preparation: Cream the cream cheese and butter together.  Blend in flour and cayenne.  Drain olives and dry on paper towels.  Wrap each olive with 1 teaspoon of the dough.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake 15 minutes in a 400° oven.  Very tasty warm or cold; best warm.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  qt. size can Campbell's pork and beans
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
2  Tbsp. corn syrup
1  tsp. mustard
1  medium onion, chopped
2  or 3 blobs ketchup
8  strips bacon, cooked and crumbled
preparation: Combine all ingredients and stir together in casserole dish. Bake covered at 350° for 45 minutes to an hour.

name: SNUGGLED HOT DOGS
ingredients:
1  c. Bisquick mix
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. parsley
1  egg
6  hot dogs
Cheddar or American cheese or 2 Tbsp. relish or catsup
preparation: Mix the first 4 ingredients together; beat well.  Spread into a 9 x 5-inch greased baking pan.  Partially split hot dogs.  Fill split with 6 strips of cheese or 2 tablespoons relish or catsup. Arrange hot dogs crosswise on dough in pan.  Press lightly.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes, until brown.

name: SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  lb. spaghetti
water (to boil spaghetti)
1  small onion
1/2  jar Ranch dressing
1  jar spaghetti sauce
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Boil water. Put in spaghetti. Dice onion in boiling water and add butter. When spaghetti is soft, drain. Put cold spaghetti sauce and Ranch dressing on hot spaghetti.

name: PETER PAN CRUNCH CLUSTERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  c. milk chocolate chips
2  c. chopped roasted peanuts
preparation: Melt chocolate chips and add peanut butter.  Stir in peanuts. Drop by spoonful into paper candy cups and chill.   Store in refrigerator.  Makes 6 dozen.

name: FUDGY PECAN PIE
ingredients:
9-inch unbaked pastry shell
1/3  c. butter or margarine
1/3  c. cocoa
2/3  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
3  eggs, slightly beaten
3/4  c. light corn syrup
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. pecan halves
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In medium saucepan, melt butter.  Add cocoa; stir until smooth.  Remove from heat; cool slightly.   Add sugar, salt, eggs and corn syrup; blend thoroughly.  Add chopped nuts.  Pour into unbaked shell, placing pecan halves on top.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Cool; cover and let stand 8 hours before serving.  Garnish with sweetened whipped cream.

name: MARY'S APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. raisins
1  c. Comstock apples
1/2  c. walnuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients together by hand.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: APPLESAUCE-HONEY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. whole wheat flour
2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ginger
1  egg
3/4  c. applesauce
1/2  c. honey
1/3  c. oil
1/4  c. apple juice
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Stir together flour, baking powder, cinnamon and ginger. Combine egg, applesauce, honey, oil and juice.  Add to flour mixture.  Stir just until moistened.  Batter should be lumpy. Fold in pecans and raisins.  Fill 12 muffin cups 2/3 full.  Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  can mushroom soup
2  onions, sliced and separated into rings
8  potatoes, peeled and sliced
1 soup  can milk
preparation: Brown ground beef in skillet and drain.  Place layers in casserole in following order:  potatoes, onion, beef, onion, potatoes.  Mix soup and milk.  Pour over entire casserole; cover and cook in microwave for 20 to 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender.  Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

name: SPINACH DIP BREAD RING
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. frozen spinach, drained and chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
1 small  can water chestnuts, chopped
1  round sourdough bread
preparation: Mix mayonnaise, sour cream and water chestnuts together.  Add spinach when you are ready to serve.  Hollow out a round sourdough bread.  Serve with spinach dip in the middle and wedges of bread around.

name: HUNGARY MANS DIP
ingredients:
4  pounds Velveeta cheese
1/4  pound sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1  pound hamburger, browned and drained
1  jar Salsa
preparation: On low heat of crock pot, melt Velveeta cheese, add hamburger, salsa and Cheddar cheese. When cheese is completely melted, serve with corn chips, or your favorite chip.

name: APRICOT BARS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour, sifted
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. quick cooking rolled oats
1  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. butter or margarine
3/4  c. apricot preserves or jam
preparation: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt; stir in rolled oats and sugar.  Cut in butter until crumbly.  Pat 2/3 of the crumb mixture into an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch pan.  Spread with preserves. Cover the preserves with the remaining crumb mixture.  Bake in a moderate oven (375°) about 35 minutes or until browned.  Cool.  Cut into bars or squares.

name: GUMDROP BARS
ingredients:
1  c. gumdrops
1/2  c. chopped nuts
4  eggs
2  c. light brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix gumdrops and nuts; set aside.  Beat eggs until light; add sugar, flour, salt and flavoring.  Gradually add gumdrops and nuts. Spread into 11 x 16-inch pan.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

name: BAKED LIMA BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  clove garlic, minced
2  tsp. oil
3  cans beans, drained
2  c. tomatoes, drained
1/2  c. sharp cheese, grated
1  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook meat, onions and garlic until tender.  Add remaining ingredients and pour into a casserole dish.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
spaghetti
1  lb. hamburger
green pepper, chopped
onion, chopped (optional)
1  can tomatoes
1  can cream of celery or cream of mushroom soup
10  biscuits
American cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger with green pepper and onion.  Add tomatoes and soup.  Cook spaghetti; drain well and add to hamburger mixture. Place in a greased casserole dish and cover with cheese.  Bake one can (10) biscuits for 5 minutes on a cookie sheet.  Place biscuits on top of casserole and bake at 350° for 5 minutes or until brown.

name: SUGAR-FREE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1  egg
1 1/2  c. milk
6  pkg. Equal
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat all ingredients together.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
2 (15 1/2 oz.)  cans dark kidney beans, drained
2  cans chili beans, drained
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
1/2  c. diced mushrooms (optional)
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. water
1  tsp. chili powder or more to your taste
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
salt to taste
preparation: Use a 4-quart pot.

name: 3 LAYER DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick softened butter
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix.  Make crust and pat into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan (lightly greased with margarine).  Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Let cool.

name: STUFFED SQUASH
ingredients:
2  lb. crookneck squash
1  lb. ground round
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
salt and pepper
1/4 to 1/2  c. raw rice
1 (4 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. chopped onion (if desired)
1/2  stick oleo
preparation: With an apple corer or small spoon, scoop out inside of squash, reserving neck to slice into bottom of pot.  Mix raw beef, tomatoes, salt, pepper, rice and onion together.  Stuff this mixture into the squash cavity.  Stand squash upright in pot with slices of squash in bottom.  (If you have meat mixture leftover, form into balls and place between the squash.)  Add tomato sauce and water to the top of squash.  Slice oleo over the top and cook on top of stove 1 hour or longer, if desired.

name: COUNTRY STYLE STEAK
ingredients:
4  medium size cubed steaks
2 heaping  Tbsp. shortening
enough flour to coat the steaks
2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Salt and pepper steaks.  Coat with flour.  Fry in hot shortening until medium brown.  Remove steaks from pan.  Add 2 heaping tablespoonfuls flour to hot grease. Let it start turning brown.  Return steaks to this and add water, a little at a time, to cover steaks.  Turn burner down to simmer or slow boil for 20 minutes.  If gravy gets too low, add a little extra water carefully though, it may become too thin.

name: PICKLED BEET SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. cherry Jell-O
1  can crushed pineapple
1  can pickled beets, chopped
1/2  c. pecans or almonds, chopped
container of sour cream
preparation: Use juice from pineapple and beets to make 1 cup of liquid. To make Jell-O, use 1 cup boiling water and the cup of juice.  Add beets, pineapple and nuts after Jell-O begins to thicken.  Serve with sour cream.

name: MAGIC COOKIE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can flaked coconut
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350° (use 325° if using a glass dish).  In a 9 x 13-inch baking pan, melt butter.  Sprinkle crumbs over butter. Pour milk evenly over crumbs.  Top evenly with chips, coconut and nuts; press down gently.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly brown.  Cool thoroughly before cutting.  Loosely cover any leftovers.

name: SOUR CREAM POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash browns, thawed
8  oz. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 large  carton sour cream
1  tsp. salt
1  onion, diced
garlic salt to taste
pepper
2  c. cornflakes, crushed
1  stick margarine
preparation: Mix altogether, except cornflakes and butter.  Place in large casserole and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Top with cornflakes and butter.  Bake 15 minutes longer.

name: PORK CHOPS WITH PEARS
ingredients:
pork chops (number desired)
1  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. garlic
1  tsp. poultry seasoning
pear halves (canned)
mayonnaise (1/2 tsp. per pear half)
preparation: Mix flour, salt, paprika, pepper, garlic and poultry seasoning.  Shake each pork chop in this mixture until there are no moist spots on the meat.  Place chops in greased shallow baking pan.  Add as many pear halves as pork chops, placing the pears between the chops.  Add 1/2 teaspoon mayonnaise to each pear center.  Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes.  Ovens may vary. Bake until chops are thoroughly cooked and brown.

name: SMOKED EGGS
ingredients:
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. peanut or sesame oil
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. liquid smoke
4  hard-cooked eggs, shelled
preparation: Combine water, soy sauce, sugar, oil, salt and liquid smoke in small bowl.  Add eggs.  Marinate at room temperature 2 to 3 hours, turning eggs often to keep them evenly coated.  Drain.  Cut into wedges.  Serves 8.  Can leave in sauce in refrigerator for up to 3 days.

name: HOPSCOTCH CRUNCHIES
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch morsels
1/2  c. creamy peanut butter
1  can chow mein noodles
1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Melt butterscotch morsels in a double boiler over hot (not boiling) water along with peanut butter.  Stir to hasten melting. Remove from heat and stir in chow mein noodles and marshmallows. Drop by spoonfuls on a cookie sheet covered with wax paper.  Makes about 30 crunchies.

name: MILD CHICKEN CURRY
ingredients:
whole chicken
3  Tbsp. curry powder
2  cans chicken broth
1  large onion
2  tomatoes
3  cloves garlic
salt
pepper
preparation: In large pot, combine chicken, 1/2 of curry, salt, pepper and garlic; add water.  Boil completely.  Remove bones and skin, but keep broth.  Put chicken back in 1/2 of natural broth and add canned broth and chopped tomatoes and add rest of curry and more if desired.  Simmer until thick.  Serve over rice.

name: PEPPERONI PIZZA SNACKS
ingredients:
1 (10.6 oz)  pkg. refrigerated garlic breadsticks
20  slices pepperoni
20  (1/2 in.) cubes mozzarella cheese
1  c. heated pizza sauce
preparation: Heat oven to 375 degrees.  Spray 8 in. square pan with non-stick cooking spray.  Remove dough from can.  Unroll dough, separate into strips.  Cut each strip in half crosswise to make 20 pieces.  Press each piece to form 2 1/2 in. squares.  Top each square with 1 slice pepperoni and 1 cheese cube.  Wrap dough around filling to completely cover; firmly press edges to seal. Place butter mixture from breadstick package into small microwave safe bowl.  Microwave on high for 10-20 seconds or until melted. Dip each filled dough bite into melted butter.  Place seam side down with sides touching in sprayed pan.  Bake qt 400 degrees 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.  Cool 5 minutes.  Remove from pan.  Serve warm sticks with warm pizza sauce.  You may use marinara sauce to replace pizza sauce.

name: LEMON FLUFF
ingredients:
1  c. quick rolled oats
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. flour
1/3  c. melted butter
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
4  egg yolks (beaten)
1  tsp. grated lemon rind
1/2  c. sugar
4  egg whites
preparation: For crust, combine oats, flour, brown sugar and salt in a shallow pan.  Add melted butter and mix thoroughly.  Bake 10 minutes at 350°.  Soften gelatin in cold water.  Combine egg yolks, sugar, lemon rind and lemon juice in saucepan.  Cook over low heat until mixture boils.  Remove from heat, add softened gelatin and stir until dissolved.  Cool thoroughly.  Beat egg whites until foamy.  Gradually add sugar, then beat until mixture stands in peaks.  Fold cooled gelatin mixture into beaten egg whites.  Put half of crumbs in pan, add filling and top with rest of filling.  Chill until set.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
1  c. buttermilk
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. flour
dash of nutmeg
1 1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Pour into pie crust.  Bake at 350° for approximately 45 minutes.

name: JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. orange-pineapple Jell-O
1  c. hot water
3/4  c. cold water
1 small  can crushed pineapple, undrained
part of 1 can fruit cocktail, drained
few chopped pecans
Cool Whip
preparation: Dissolve  Jell-O  in 1 cup hot water.  Add 3/4 cup cold water, crushed  pineapple,  fruit  cocktail and pecans.  Pour into square pan.  Let set until jelled.	Cover with Cool Whip.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes, cooked in jackets
1  medium onion
1  c. sour cream
3/4  c. chicken broth
3/4  c. half and half cream
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. margarine
preparation: Cool potatoes.  Peel and cube.  Place in a 12 x 12-inch casserole.  Grate onion and spread over potatoes.  Mix sour cream, chicken broth, half and half cream, salt, pepper and margarine in a saucepan.  Heat and mix well.  Pour over potatoes and onion in casserole.  Spread one 8 ounce package Cheddar cheese over casserole.  Mix 1/4 cup margarine and 3/4 cup crushed cornflakes. Spread on top of casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY ALMOND CREPES
ingredients:
1  pt strawberries sliced, sugared to sweeten
2  Tbsp butter
1/4  c toasted almond slivers
whipped cream flavored with almond extract, (1/4 tsp per 12 oz container)*
preparation: Use the basic crepes recipe. Prepare crepes ahead of time. Fill crepes with lightly sweetened strawberries, lay them side by side in a chafing dish, in which you melted the butter in. Sprinkle with almonds and warm thoroughly. Top with whip cream.

name: PLUM CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs, beat well
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. cloves
2 small  jars plum baby food
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Beat together. Pour in a greased Bundt pan or 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: OATMEAL CHOCOLATE CHIP WHEAT GERM COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. milk
1  c. flour
1  c. wheat germ
2  c. oatmeal
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
chocolate chips
nuts
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add milk, vanilla and eggs.  Beat. Add flour, wheat germ, baking soda and powder.  Beat.  Add oatmeal, chocolate chips and nuts.  Bake at 350° until set.

name: PUMPKIN CAKE IN A JAR
ingredients:
2/3  c. shortening
4  eggs
2/3  c. water
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. ground cloves
2  tsp. baking soda
2 2/3  c. sugar
2  c. canned pureed pumpkin
3 1/3  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped nuts
8 pint- size, wide mouth  jars with lids and rings
8  wax paper circles to fit jars
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar together, adding sugar slowly. Beat in eggs, pumpkin and water.  Set aside.  Sift together flour, baking powder salt, ground cloves, allspice, cinnamon and baking soda.  Add to pumpkin mixture and stir well.  Stir in nuts.  Pour batter into greased canning jars, filling half full.  Place jars on cookie sheet.  Beat upright in preheated 325 degrees for about 45 minutes.  When done, remove one jar at a time from oven.  While still warm, place wax paper circle on the top end of the cake. Wipe sealing edge of jar.  Place lid on jar and close tightly with ring.  Turn jar upside down.  To serve:  Open jar, slide a knife around inside of the jar to loosen cake, and remove cake from jar. Warm cake in oven if desired.  Slice and serve with whipped cream.

name: AS GOOD AS FUDGE(Diabetic Recipe)
ingredients:
1/2  c. honey
1/2  c. cocoa powder
1/4  c. unsweetened shredded coconut
1/2  c. chopped unsweetened dates
1/3  c. chopped walnuts
1/4  c. sesame seed
1/2  c. peanut butter
3/4  c. sunflower seeds
preparation: In small pan over low heat, stir together honey and peanut butter until smooth.  Remove from heat; add cocoa powder and blend well.  Add remaining ingredients.  Press into oiled 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cut into 36 squares.  Chill until firm. Yields 36. Serving size:  1.

name: SLOPPY JOES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can Italian tomato soup
1/4  c. water
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook beef.  Add soup, water, Worcestershire and pepper.  Heat through, stirring often.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
2  c. zucchini, grated and peeled
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4 to 3/4  c. nuts
preparation: Mix eggs, vanilla, sugar, vegetable oil and zucchini all together in a bowl.  Add remaining ingredients and stir well.  Put in 2 loaf pans and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: ROBERT REDFORD DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick butter
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
12  oz. whipped cream
1 large  box instant vanilla pudding
1 large  box instant chocolate pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: Combine flour, butter and nuts and press into bottom of ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Let cool.  Combine cream cheese, sugar and half of the whipped topping; blend until smooth.  Spread over baked crust.  Beat together the two puddings and milk.  Whip until well blended. Pour into crust.  Spread remainder of whipped topping on top. Refrigerate.

name: PAM'S CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  pkg. ( 8 oz.) cream cheese
1  bunch green onion tops, chopped
1 (2 oz.)  pkg. chipped beef
1/4  tsp. seasoning salt
1/4  tsp. Accent (optional)
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix softened cream cheese with rest of ingredients (except pecans).  Shape into a ball and roll in chopped pecans.

name: HOT BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  lb. cheese, grated
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  can milk
salt
pepper
1 (8 to 10 oz.)  pkg. noodles, cooked
Chinese noodles
preparation: Brown beef and onion in butter.  Mix in cheese, soup, milk and seasonings.  Mix with noodles.  Put in casserole dish.  Cover with Chinese noodles, place in oven and heat well.

name: PETIT POIS FRAIS A LA FRANCAISE(Julia Child's Green Peas, French-Style)
ingredients:
2  c. fresh shelled or 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas
8  scallions, sliced thin
4  Tbsp. butter, cut up
1  tsp. granulated sugar
1/4  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. fresh ground black pepper
1  medium size head Boston lettuce, shredded
preparation: Put all ingredients except lettuce into a 3-quart saucepan; top with lettuce.  Cover pan tightly and bring to a boil over moderately high heat.  Reduce heat and simmer 10 to 15 minutes, until peas are tender, stirring once or twice.  Add extra water if pan is dry.  If too liquidy, transfer peas to dish and boil liquid until about 1/3 cup remains.  Pour over peas and serve.

name: JERKY
ingredients:
3  lb. lean meat
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. onion powder
1  tsp. garlic
1 to 2  tsp. pepper
1/3  c. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Cut meat into 1/2-inch strips.  Mix all ingredients together and pour over meat.  Marinate overnight.  Remove from dish and dry with paper towels.  Put on rack and dry in slow 200° oven, about 2 1/2 hours or until very dry.

name: COCONUT RUM BALLS
ingredients:
4  c. vanilla wafer crumbs
1 1/3  c. coconut
1  c. firmly chopped nuts
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1/2  c. rum or use 1/2 c. water and 1 tsp. rum extract
10x sugar
preparation: Combine crumbs, coconut and nuts in bowl.  Stir in milk and rum.  Mix well. Chill 4 hours or overnight.  Drop from tablespoon into bowl of 10x sugar to coat.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Cover and store in refrigerator.  Roll again in sugar just before serving.

name: MARINATED CUCUMBERS
ingredients:
1  large cucumber (unpeeled), very thinly sliced
1  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/3  c. vinegar
preparation: Sprinkle cucumber slices with sugar and salt; add vinegar. Press slices with back of spoon to release juices.  Cover tightly or chill about 4 hours.  Makes 4 servings.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
3 to 4  c. potatoes, boiled (canned or frozen)
2/3  c. all-purpose flour
