6  c. 2% reduced fat milk
1  c. (4 oz.) Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  c. reduced fat sour cream
1  tsp. salt
6  bacon slices, cooked and crumbled (optional)
preparation: Lightly spoon flour into a dry measuring cup; level with a knife.  Place flour in large pot, gradually add milk, stirring with a whisk until blended.  Cook over medium heat until thick and bubbly.  Add potatoes, cheese, salt and pepper and bacon.  Stir until cheese melts.  Remove from heat.  Stir in sour cream.  Cook over low heat for 10 minutes or until thoroughly heated (do not boil).

name: POTATO-CUCUMBER SOUP
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes, diced
1  tsp. salt
2  c. water
1  medium cucumber, peeled, seeded and diced
1/4  tsp. white pepper
1  c. heavy cream
1/2  c. milk
1  green onion, sliced
1  tsp. dried dill weed
preparation: Cook potatoes in salted water until tender; drain.  Stir in cucumber, pepper, cream, milk and onion.  Simmer until cucumber is tender.  Add dill.  Salt and pepper to taste.

name: ANGEL COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. Crisco (do not use butter)
1  well-beaten egg
2  c. flour (add last)
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  bag chocolate chips
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Beat sugars with Crisco; add egg.  Add soda, cream of tartar, salt and vanilla, then add flour.  Beating with the mixer is what makes these cookies light and tender.  Mix chips and walnuts in by hand.  Roll in balls (size of walnuts).  Bake at 350° about 10 minutes.

name: CHICKEN SALAD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. chicken, chopped
1  c. cracker crumbs
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  c. celery, chopped
4  Tbsp. onion, chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
6  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
Chinese noodles or potato chips
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and top with Chinese noodles or potato chips and bake at 350° until bubbly hot, and celery and onions are done.  A bouillon cube will help the flavor.

name: DREAM BARS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. margarine
3  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Mix together flour, 1/2 cup of the brown sugar and margarine to fine particles.  Press into bottom of pan.  Bake for 15 minutes.  Beat remaining ingredients (except coconut) until just blended.  Add coconut and pour over bottom layer.  Return to oven and bake until golden brown.  Cool in pan and cut into bars.

name: DELICIOUS CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
1/2  c. syrup (white or dark)
2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. soda
8  qt. popped corn
preparation: Melt butter in a  large pan.  Add syrup and sugar. Boil 5 minutes.  Remove from heat. Add salt, vanilla and soda.  Pour over popcorn and stir well.  Bake 1 hour in a 250° oven, stirring every 15 minutes.

name: BAKED CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
whole chicken, cut up into pieces
1  chopped onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. rice
salt and pepper
thyme
tarragon
preparation: Place chicken pieces in a greased baking dish.  Add chopped onion and dry rice.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Add a pinch of thyme and tarragon leaves.

name: CHICKEN DELIGHT
ingredients:
2  pkg. chicken thighs or wings
1  bottle Wish-Bone red Russian dressing
8  oz. jar apricot preserves
1  pkg. dry Lipton onion soup
preparation: Mix together sauce ingredients.  Spread chicken pieces in baking pan.  Spoon sauce over chicken.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: CHEESY GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
10  slices bacon
2  pkg. (16 oz.) frozen cut green beans
1  lb. mushrooms, sliced
3/4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. pepper
1 (16 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
preparation: Cook bacon in skillet until crisp; drain.  Reserve 1/4 cup drippings.  Crumble bacon; reserve 2 tablespoons.  Cook beans as directed on package; drain well.  Add mushrooms and onion to reserved 1/4 cup drippings in skillet.  Cook and stir on medium-high heat 10 minutes; drain.  Add bacon, hot cooked green beans and pepper; mix lightly.  Spoon into 2-quart serving dish. Heat cheese as directed on label.  Pour over green bean mixture. Sprinkle with remaining bacon.  Makes 10 servings.

name: CHERRY CRUMB CAKE
ingredients:
1 (2 layer size)  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  envelope dry yeast
1  c. flour
2/3  c. warm water
2  eggs
1 (1 lb. 5 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/3  c. butter or margarine
preparation: Measure 2 1/2 cups dry cake mix for topping.  Combine remaining dry mix, flour, yeast, water and eggs.  Beat 100 strokes by hand. Spread evenly in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Top with cherry filling evenly.  Mix reserved cake mix, 1/4 cup sugar, cinnamon and butter with fork until finely grained.  Spread over filling.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tests done.

name: APPLE CHEESE CRISP
ingredients:
4  apples
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. shortening
3/4  c. cheese
preparation: Peel and slice apples (Granny Smith apples are best). Place apples in a shallow baking pan. Pour water and lemon juice over the apples. Mix sugar, cinnamon, flour, shortening, salt and cheese. Sprinkle over apples. Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: TOM AND JERRY GOOD COLD WEATHER DRINK
ingredients:
6  eggs
1  lb. powdered sugar
1  pinch salt
4 or 5  drops rum extract
preparation: Separate eggs; beat stiff with the pinch of salt.  Beat egg yolks until thick.  Mix egg white and yolk together; add rum extract.  Beat powdered sugar into mixture and beat a lot, then dip into cups 2 tablespoons of the mixture.  Add a shot of brandy to each cup.  Mix into this boiling water.  Top with cinnamon or nutmeg and drink while hot.

name: VANILLA WAFER CAKE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. vanilla wafers, crushed
2  c. sugar
2  sticks margarine
6  eggs
1/2  c. crushed pineapple
7  oz. coconut
1  c. pecans
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients and add vanilla wafers.  Bake in well-greased tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: PEANUT BUTTER DELIGHT
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1/2  lb. margarine
1/2  c. cocoa
5  c. oatmeal
4  tsp. vanilla
1  c. peanut butter
preparation: Cook sugar, milk, margarine and cocoa for 2 minutes or bring to boil.  Remove from heat; add oatmeal, vanilla and peanut butter.  Beat until well blended.  Spoon on wax paper, using #40 scoop.  Makes 18 servings (54 cookies).

name: THELMA'S BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  large head iceberg lettuce
2  tomatoes
2  cucumbers
1  medium Vidalia onion
1  medium green pepper
2 (15 oz.)  cans red kidney beans, drained
1/2  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing*
preparation: Tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces into large bowl.  Chop tomatoes, cucumbers, onion and green pepper; add to lettuce.  Pour in the drained beans.  Stir in mayonnaise.  Chill several hours or overnight.

name: COUNTRY STYLE APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. grated or diced apples
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. melted shortening or oil
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. chopped nuts (walnuts)
1  c. raisins
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs, oil, sugar and vanilla together.  Add dry ingredients.  Fold in apples, nuts and raisins.  Bake for 1 hour in a 325° oven in a greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan.  After cake is done, pierce top with fork and glaze.

name: SALSA(Makes 1 Quart)
ingredients:
1 (28 oz.)  can whole or chopped tomatoes
2 to 4  cloves dried olives
1  onion, diced
2 small  cans diced chilies (mild)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Run tomatoes through chop cycle on blender just until everything has passed through blade.  Add all ingredients.  Mix and let set at least 1 hour before serving with tortilla chips.

name: CARROT GARLIC SPREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Mozzarella Cheese, grated
1  c. mayonnaise
2  hard boiled eggs, sliced
3  medium carrots, grated
2  cloves garlic, minced
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a medium bowl and serve spread on freshly made toast.  Store in refrigerator.

name: PARTY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  oz. pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
2  c. (10 oz.) shredded extra sharp Cheddar
2  c. (10 oz.) shredded mild sharp Cheddar
1/4  Tbsp. cayenne pepper
1/4  c. beer
1/4  c. garlic salt
preparation: All cheeses should be at room temperature.  Blend well and shape into ball.

name: RED CABBAGE WITH APPLES
ingredients:
2  lb. head red cabbage
2  Tbsp. butter or chicken fat
2  c. water
1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  cloves
salt
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1  tart apple
1  medium-sized onion, sliced
1/2  c. red wine vinegar
juice of 1/2 lemon
1  bay leaf
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Wash cabbage; cut as for coleslaw. Peel and chop apples. Heat fat in large saucepan and cook apple and onion gently 3 to 4 minutes. Add water, vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper, cloves, bay leaf and lemon juice. Stir; bring to boil. Add cabbage; mix well. Cover; simmer 45 minutes or until tender. Sprinkle flour over top. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Mix well and cook 5 minutes longer.

name: SPINACH SQUARES
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. milk
1  stick butter
1  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
1  c. chopped onion
2  pkg. chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Combine eggs, milk and butter; add rest of ingredients and mix well.  Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 minutes at 350°.  Cool.

name: LOUISIANA  SPECIAL POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  box pound cake mix (Betty Crocker)
1  box confectioners' sugar (reserve 1/2 c.)
8  oz. cream cheese
1  stick melted butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
4  whole eggs
1  c. chopped nuts (pecans)
preparation: Combine cake mix, butter and two eggs.	Blend well.  Spread in a well greased 13x9 aluminum pan.  Then beat cream cheese (room temperature) until fluffy.	Add 2 eggs, vanilla and confectioners' sugar.  Blend well.  Pour over cake and sprinkle nuts.  Bake at 350° for 30-40 minutes.  Take out and sprinkle reserve, 1/2 c. confectioners' sugar while the cake is still hot.  Cool before cutting or cake will crumble.  Overnight is best before cutting.

name: ICICLE PICKLES
ingredients:
2  gal. cucumbers, cut lengthwise
1  gal. water
1  pt. salt
1  gal. boiling water
2  Tbsp. powdered alum
2  gal. vinegar
8  pt. sugar
spices to taste
preparation: Let first 3 ingredients stand 7 days.  Drain and pour off liquid.  Add boiling water and alum.  Let stand 24 hours.  Drain; pour off liquid.  Make syrup of vinegar and sugar.  Boil and pour over cucumbers.  Continue this for 4 days.  Add spices to taste. Can and seal.

name: MOM'S MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
1  c. sorghum molasses
1/4  c. buttermilk (may use 1/4 c. sweet milk and 1/2 tsp.  vinegar)
1  egg
flour (about 5 c.)
2  tsp. soda, in 1 Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cream sugar, shortening and sorghum.  Add egg and buttermilk. Mix well.  Add vinegar and soda mix.  Mix very well.  Add enough of mixture of all dry ingredients to make a soft dough.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Press each cookie in a crisscross pattern with a fork dipped in cold water.  Bake 10 minutes in 350° oven.  Extras freeze well.

name: NOODLES CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
1  medium red bell pepper, chopped
3  scallions, chopped
4  c. chopped fresh broccoli
1  (14 1/2 oz.) chicken broth
1  c. light cream or half and half
3  c. (6 oz.) medium noodles
1 1/2  c. chopped cooked chicken
preparation: In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.  Add red pepper, scallions and broccoli.  Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.  Stir in chicken broth, cream, noodles and chicken. Heat to boiling.  Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer over low heat 25 to 30 minutes or until noodles are tender.

name: SEVEN SEAS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
1 1/3  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  onion, chopped
1 1/3  c. Minute rice
1 1/2  c. cooked peas
1 (7 oz.)  can tuna, drained and flaked
1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: In saucepan, combine soup, water, salt, pepper and onion. Bring to a boil.  Pour half of mixture into casserole.  Make layers of rice (from box), peas and tuna.  Add other soup mixture. Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes, cutting through with knife after baking 10 minutes.

name: SPINACH SOUFFLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, cooked and drained
1  can undiluted cream of mushroom soup
4  to 6 eggs, well beaten
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
salt, if desired
2/3  c. Romano or Parmesan cheese
preparation: Beat eggs, soup, nutmeg and salt until frothy; add cheese. Mix well and start adding well drained spinach until all is mixed. Butter deep baking dish and fill.  Cover top with sharp cheese of your choice.  Bake at 350° until knife inserted comes out clean. Use cover when baking.

name: BEEFY MUSHROOM CUBE STEAK
ingredients:
2  cube steaks
1  pkg. Lipton beefy mushroom soup mix
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Sprinkle both sides of beef with soup mix.  Wrap in foil, sealing edges airtight with double fold. Place in oven for 45 minutes.

name: SPICY BEEF RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small green pepper, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2 to 3/4  tsp. chili powder
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato wedges
1 1/2 to 2  c. cooked rice
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese
preparation: Place beef and green pepper in a 2-quart casserole.  Microwave on high for 4 to 5 minutes.  Stir once or twice during cooking to break beef into small bits.  Add remaining ingredients and heat to taste.

name: DAIRY SWEET SLOPPY JOES
ingredients:
5  lb. hamburger
2  tsp. salt
1/3  tsp. pepper
3/4  Tbsp. chili powder
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
2  c. tomato juice
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/2  c. dehydrated onions
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. liquid smoke
sprinkle of garlic
preparation: Cook hamburger	with  dehydrated  onions  until redness disappears and cook until  all  is	flavored  through about 20 minutes.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. Crisco shortening
6  whole eggs
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
2  c. sifted flour (all-purpose)
2  c. white sugar
1  tsp. almond flavoring
preparation: Put all ingredients into a mixer bowl and mix slowly for 1 minute.  Turn mixer to medium speed and beat for 10 full minutes. Put into a well-greased and floured tube pan.

name: CARROT BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  c. salad oil
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. finely shredded carrots
2  c. packaged grated coconut
1  c. raisins
1  c. chopped walnuts
2  c. unsifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. sugar
preparation: In a large bowl, beat eggs until light. Stir in vanilla and salad oil.  Add carrots, coconut, raisins and nuts.  Mix well until blended.  Combine the flour, salt, soda, baking powder, cinnamon and sugar. Sift into the first mixture.  Stir just until well blended. Spoon into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan that has been well buttered and dusted with flour. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour or until it tests done.  Remove from pan and cool completely.  Its flavor and texture improve if wrapped and refrigerated for several days.  Yields 1 loaf.

name: DOLLY PARTON CRUMB CAKE
ingredients: 1  box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
preparation: Follow directions on the box except add one extra egg.  Bake in a cookie sheet at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: WALDORF CROWN SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
2  c. boiling water
1 1/2  c. cold water
1  c. cubed apples
1/2  c. celery
1/4  c. walnuts
1  c. sour cream
1 1/2  c. marshmallows
1/2  c. mayonnaise type salad dressing
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add cold water; chill until partially set.  Add apples, celery and walnuts.  Pour into lightly greased (with mayonnaise) ring mold; chill until set.  Mix the sour cream, marshmallows and salad dressing.  Unmold the salad and place salad dressing mixture in the center.

name: JAN'S STRAWBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. strawberry Kool-Aid
2  c. sugar
1  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1  pt. frozen strawberries, packed in sugar
preparation: Combine sugar and Kool-Aid with 1/2 gallon water.  Stir until both are dissolved.  Pour in thawed strawberries.  Mix Jell-O according to package directions and add to mixture.  Add enough water to make 1 gallon.  Put in plastic gallon jug and freeze. Shake frequently until slushy.

name: SWEET TRASH
ingredients:
1  pkg. almond/vanilla bark
1  box Honey Graham cereal
1 large  can mixed nuts
1/2  small bag pretzels
preparation: Melt bark according to package directions.  Mix cereal, nuts and pretzels together.  Pour melted almond/vanilla bark over mixture.  Then pour onto wax paper to harden.  Once hardened, break into pieces.

name: VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger meat
2  cans Veg-All mix
2 large  cans whole tomatoes
5  or 6 medium size potatoes
1 large  can water
preparation: Fry out hamburger meat in a deep pot and drain off fat.  Add the Veg-All, tomatoes, peeled and diced potatoes and the water. Let cook for about 3 hours.

name: EASY PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  (29 oz.) sliced peaches
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1 small  can evaporated milk
2  tsp. baking powder
2/3  stick margarine, melted
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: Place peaches in a 9 x 9-inch glass baking dish (do not grease).  Mix remaining ingredients and pour over peaches.  Bake at 400°  for 30 minutes.

name: IMPOSSIBLE QUICHE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  c. biscuit mix
1/2  c. melted butter
1 1/2  c. milk
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1/2  c. cooked bacon
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire
1  tsp. onion
preparation: Place all except cheese in blender.  Pour in greased 9-inch pie plate.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: OVEN FRIED FISH
ingredients:
1  lb. fish fillets
1/3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
bread crumbs
1/4  c. melted margarine
preparation: Preheat oven to 500°.  Stir salt into milk; dip in fish fillets.  Roll  in	bread  crumbs and place in lightly greased baking  dish  (13  x  9 x 2-inches).  Drizzle melted margarine over fish.	Bake in 500° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: EGG AND SAUSAGE BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk sausage, cooked and drained
2  c. herb croutons
4  eggs, lightly beaten
3  c. milk
1  tsp. dry mustard
8  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: Cook crumbled sausage well done and drain.  Combine eggs, 2 1/2 cups milk and mustard  in bowl.  Set aside.  Place croutons in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cover with sausage.   Pour egg mixture over sausage and croutons.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Combine soup and 1/2 cup milk.  Pour over cheese.  Cover and let sit overnight in refrigerator.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour until firm in center and brown on top.

name: LUCRETIA'S LEGACY
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. butter
1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix  and  press into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

name: SWEET POTATO SURPRISE
ingredients:
2 (1 lb.)  can sweet potatoes
2/3  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Drain sweet potatoes.  Place in 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Drop bits of margarine over sweet potatoes.  Sprinkle with brown sugar. Place in Radarange oven; cook 1 minute.  Stir.  Spread marshmallows over top.  Cook 3 additional minutes.  Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: RASPBERRY JAM COOKIES
ingredients:
1  bottle raspberry jam
1/2  lb. butter or margarine
1/2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
preparation: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.  Add flour.  Shape dough into little balls (about the size of marbles).  Poke a dent into each ball (with your thumb) and fill with jam.

name: THYMED TUNA-BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1/3  c. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. olive oil
1/2  tsp. dried thyme
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. cracked black pepper
1  can garbanzo beans, drained
1  can black beans, drained
2  ribs celery, sliced
2  carrots, sliced diagonally
1  small red onion, chopped
1/4  c. loosely celery leaves
1/2  small escarole lettuce
1 (6 oz.)  can white tuna, drained
preparation: In a large bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, oil, thyme, sugar and black pepper.  Let stand 15 minutes.  Whisk dressing. Toss in beans, celery, carrots, onion and celery leaves.

name: COOKIE PIZZA
ingredients:
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1 1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1  pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. whipped cream
M&M's
candy bars
chocolate chips
preparation: Mix the margarine, sugars, vanilla and egg.  Stir in flour and soda.  Stir in chocolate chips.  Spread on an ungreased 12-inch pizza pan or cookie sheet.  Bake for about 15 minutes, or until golden brown.  Cool.  Just before serving, put whipping cream on cookie.  Sprinkle with walnuts, M&M's, chocolate chips, candy bars, etc.  Refrigerate.

name: BEEF AND BROCCOLI CORN BREAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. Jiffy corn muffin mix
1  stick margarine, melted
4  eggs
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli, thawed
1  c. shredded cheese
1/2  c. milk
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. ground beef, cooked and drained well
1  c. cream-style or whole grain corn
1 (8 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
preparation: Mix together all ingredients.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 375° for 30 minutes or until tests done.  Serve with a salad for a complete meal.

name: MILLION DOLLAR PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  container Cool Whip
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  can cherry pie filling
1  graham cracker pie crust
preparation: Combine milk and lemon juice; stir until thickened, then add Cool Whip.  Stir until blended.  Put mixture into graham cracker crust.  Put pie filling on top.  Keep refrigerated.

name: MARVELOUS MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. Prego sauce
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1/4  c. finely chopped onions
1  egg, beaten
preparation: In a large bowl, mix thoroughly 1/2 cup of Prego sauce, beef, bread crumbs, onions and egg.  In a 12 x 8-inch baking pan, firmly shape meat into 8 x 4-inch loaf.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done.  In a 1-quart saucepan, over medium heat, heat remaining Prego sauce to boiling, stirring occasionally. Serve sauce with meat loaf.  Makes 6 servings.

name: PEACH JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  c. buttermilk
2 (3 oz.) or 1 (6 oz.)  pkg. peach jello
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Heat pineapple and juice.  Add	dry  jello (remove from heat). Add buttermilk and mix  well.  Blend  in Cool Whip and put in refrigerator.  Can be cut in squares.

name: FROSTED ALMOND TWISTS
ingredients:
18  oz. pkg. refrigerated crescent dough
1  egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
2 1/2  tsp. milk
2  tsp. butter or margarine
1/8  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Grease cookie sheet.  Unroll crescent dough onto cutting board and cut each piece in half along straight perforations.  With fingers, pinch diagonal perforations together on all pieces.   Cut each rectangle lengthwise into 6 strips. Twist two strips together like a rope; cut each rope in half. Place ropes about 1 inch apart on cookie sheet.  Brush strips with egg and sprinkle with sugar.  Bake 8 to 12 minutes until golden.

name: FISH WITH CAJUN SAUCE
ingredients:
2  lb. white fish fillet, cut in portions
1  c. sliced onions
1  c. sliced tomatoes
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
4  Tbsp. oil
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. sugar
1  jalapeno pepper, chopped (optional)
preparation: Wash and dry fish fillet.  Dredge with lemon juice, salt and pepper on both sides.  In a frying pan heat oil.  Quick fry fish, high heat, 2 minutes each side.  Remove and set aside.  Add butter and saute tomatoes for 1 minute.  Add onions.  Saute for 1 minute. Add broth.  Stir in sugar.  Simmer (optional:  add jalapeno peppers).  Add fish.  Cook for 15 minutes or until fish flakes off easily.  Serve over noodles or rice.

name: CRAB QUICHE
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
3  eggs
1/2  lb. crab meat
1  can French fried onion rings, mashed
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix together and put in pie crust.    Bake at 350° until set.

name: PUMPKIN PIE DESSERT
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1/2  c. melted butter
1  egg
preparation: Blend cake mix with melted butter. Reserve 1 c. for topping. Add egg to remainder of mix. Blend well. Press in 9x13 pan.

name: CHICKEN CACCIATORE
ingredients:
3  lb. chicken pieces
seasoned salt
3  Tbsp. oil
1/2  medium bell pepper, sliced
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes or 1 (15 oz.) can Hunt's tomato sauce (special)
1 (1.5 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti sauce mix
1/2  c. water
1/4 to 1/2  c. raisins
1/2  lb. spaghetti noodles, cooked
1/4  c. slivered almonds
preparation: Sprinkle chicken with salt; saute in oil.  Remove chicken; add pepper strips and saute 2 minutes.  Remove from skillet.  Drain fat.  Mix tomato sauce, spaghetti sauce mix and water in skillet; add chicken.  Cover; simmer 35 minutes.  Add raisins; simmer 10 minutes.  Put cooked spaghetti on platter and arrange chicken on top.  Pour sauce over all.  Top with almonds.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: DATE NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  c. chopped dates
1 1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  egg, beaten
2 1/4  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  Tbsp. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Pour boiling water over dates and let stand 10 minutes. Add sugar to beaten egg in bowl.  Add flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda.  Mix alternately with date mixture.  Stir in oil or melted shortening, vanilla and nuts.  Pour into large loaf pan (10 x 5 x 3-inch) and bake 1 hour.  Test with toothpick in middle. Freezes well.

name: RICE CRESPYS TREATS
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  c. milk
9  c. Rice Crespys
1  c. oil
preparation: You pout it all in a bowl and stir.  Then put the bowl in the refregarater for 2 hours.  Take it out and eat it.

name: CITRUS SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. fresh pineapple chunks or 1 (8 oz.) can pineapple chunks, drained
1  c. fresh orange pieces
1  c. fresh tangerine pieces or 1 (11 oz.) can mandarin oranges, drained
1  c. (8 oz.) sour cream
1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. flaked coconut
lettuce leaves (optional)
preparation: In a large bowl, combine the fruit, sour cream, marshmallows and coconut. Cover and refrigerate for several hours.  If desired, serve on lettuce lined plates.  Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: GOULASH SOUP
ingredients:
1  medium onion
4  Tbsp. margarine
3 to 4  Tbsp. Hungarian paprika
4  Tbsp. margarine
3/4 to 1  lb. cubed beef
2  cans beef broth
1  can water
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  can water
2  medium potatoes, diced fine
preparation: Saute onion diced fine in 4 tablespoons margarine until tender.  Add paprika. Cook until bubbly.  Put in bowl and set aside. In same pan, melt 4 tablespoons margarine and cubed beef, which has been floured.  Cook until browned.  Add onion, paprika mixture, beef broth and 1 can water.  Heat to boiling, stirring. Add tomato sauce and 1 can water.  Once again, heat to boiling, add potatoes which have been diced.  Reduce heat to simmer.  Simmer at least 2 to 4 hours.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: MOLDED CHEESE AND PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon flavored gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1  c. heavy cream, whipped
1 1/2  c. cottage cheese
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime flavored gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1  c. pineapple juice
1  c. crushed pineapple
preparation: Dissolve lemon gelatin in 1 cup boiling water. Chill until slightly thickened. Beat until light and fluffy. Fold in whipped cream. Add cottage cheese. Pour into 10 individual molds to partly fill them. Dissolve lime flavored gelatin in boiling  water. Add pineapple juice. Chill until slightly thickened. Add pineapple. Pour onto lemon layer, filling molds. Chill until firm. Makes 8-10 servings.

name: SWEDISH APPLE PIE
ingredients:
5  to 6 large apples, peeled, cored and sliced
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  stick butter or margarine
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Place apples in a pie plate. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.  In a saucepan, melt the stick of butter. Remove from heat. Stir in the flour and sugar. Add egg last and mix well.  Put chopped nuts over apples, if desired.  Pour cooked mixture over apples. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: MAKE AHEAD ECLAIR CAKE
ingredients:
1  box graham crackers
2  pkg. instant French vanilla pudding
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip
3 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix pudding with milk.  Beat 2 minutes.  Blend in Cool Whip. Line a buttered 10 x 12-inch pan with graham crackers.  Pour 1/2 of pudding mixture over crackers.  Add another layer of crackers. Pour remaining pudding mix over crackers.  Refrigerate 2 hours.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. bread, broken up
1  qt. scalded milk
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. melted butter or margarine
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all the ingredients together (except for the nutmeg) and put it into a casserole dish.  Sprinkle a little nutmeg on top. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: HUNGARIAN CHICKEN PAPRIKOSH
ingredients:
2  large onions, finely diced
2  qt. sour cream
1  Tbsp. paprika
3  lb. chicken
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. garlic or 4 cloves fresh garlic
2  c. flour
4  egg yolks
1/4  c. milk
3  qt. water
preparation: Saute onions, garlic and chicken until onions are translucent and chicken is lightly browned.  Boil water in a large pot.  After boiled, put the onions, garlic and chicken into pot.  Reduce heat; simmer for 2 hours.

name: KID'S MUNCHIES
ingredients:
1  bag "light" microwave popped popcorn (3 oz. unpopped)
1  (14 oz.) bag short pretzel sticks
1 (10 oz.)  box mini chocolate flavored teddy bear-shaped cookies
1  (10 oz.) bag miniature marshmallows
1  large (14 oz.) bag plain M&M's
preparation: Pop the popcorn according to package directions and cool.  In a 6-quart or larger bowl, mix together all the ingredients.  Serve immediately.  To store, divide into the desired portions and store up to five days at room temperature in sealed containers or resealable, zipper-top bags.  Makes 24 cups.

name: LENTIL SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. lentils
6  c. water
1  small onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
1 (20 oz.)  can tomatoes
3  slices turkey
bacon, crumbled
1/4  lb. diced kielbasa
2  carrots, diced
1 (15 oz.)  can chicken broth
salt and pepper
parsley flakes
preparation: Rinse lentils.  Boil in 6 cups of water until tender.  Drain. Rinse.

name: APPLE PEAR SALAD
ingredients:
2  medium apples, sliced
2  medium pears, sliced
1  medium stalk celery, sliced
2  Tbsp. fresh orange juice
1  tsp. grated orange rind
1  Tbsp. honey
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
salad greens
preparation: Mix apples, pears and celery slices; shake orange juice, honey, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg in tightly covered container and pour over apple mixture.  Toss until evenly coated.  Cover and refrigerate at least one hour.  Arrange apple mixture on salad greens.  Yields 8 servings.

name: FUDGE BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/4  c. margarine or butter
2  c. biscuit mix
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large saucepan, over low heat, melt 1 cup chips with margarine; remove from heat.  Add biscuit mix, sweetened condensed milk, egg and vanilla.  Stir in remaining 1 cup chips.  Turn into well-greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until brownies begin to pull away from the sides of the pan.  Cool.  Garnish as desired.  Cut into squares or bars.  Store tightly covered at room temperature.

name: PEANUT BUTTER POTATO CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. potato chips, crushed
1  c. walnuts
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips (optional)
preparation: Cream together sugar, shortening and eggs.  Add peanut butter. Mix. Add flour, soda and vanilla.  Mix well.  Dough will be somewhat stiff.  Blend in potato chips and walnuts.  Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Remove from cookie sheet and allow to cool on rack before storing.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: HAWAIIAN BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sour cream
1 3/4  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. onion flakes
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
2  tsp. dill weed
2  tsp. Beau Monde seasoning
1  loaf King's Hawaiian bread
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except bread, and mix well.  Scoop out center of bread and save pieces.  Put dip in center of bread.  Use bread pieces to dip.  Continue pulling pieces from bread as needed.  Can serve with radishes and cauliflower around bread to serve more.

name: Swiss Chicken
ingredients:
2  T. flour
1  t. paprika
1  t. salt
6  skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
2  T. butter
1  t. oil
1/4  c. sherry
1  t. cornstarch
3/4  c. light cream
1/3  c. white wine
1  T. lemon juice
3/4  c. shredded Swiss cheese
preparation: Combine flour, paprika and salt in a plastic bag. Add chicken and shake until well coated. Brown chicken on both sides in butter and oil. Add Sherry; cover and simmer about 25 minutes; or until tender. Combine cornstarch and cream, stir into pan. Cook, stirring until sauce thickens. Add lemon juice and wine. Sprinkle cheese over top of breasts, cover and let stand for 5 minutes to melt cheese.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
16  oz. sour cream
garlic salt
1  jar taco sauce
lettuce
onions
tomatoes
12  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix cream cheese and sour cream; cream together.  Spread over pizza dish.  Sprinkle with a little garlic salt.  Spread taco sauce.  Layer with lettuce, onions, tomatoes and cheese.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: CRUNCHY FUDGE SANDWICHES
ingredients:
12  oz. pkg. butterscotch chips
1  c. creamy peanut butter
8  c. Rice Krispies
12  oz. chocolate chips
1  c. powdered sugar
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine (not soft or lite margarine)
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Melt 6 ounces butterscotch chips with 1/2 cup peanut butter in heavy saucepan over low heat, stirring until blended.  Stir in 4 cups Rice Krispies.  Press into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.  Chill. Stir over hot water chocolate chips, powdered sugar, butter and water until melted and blended.  Spread over chilled mixture.  (Do not chill after adding chocolate layer.)  Melt the rest of the butterscotch chips and peanut butter; stir rest of Rice Krispies and spread over chocolate layer (do this as quickly as possible after spreading chocolate).  Press lightly.  Chill.  Cut into squares.

name: RASPBERRY COOLER(Yields 6 to 8 Servings)
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. mint leaves
1  c. water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen raspberries
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen limeade or lemonade concentrate
2  c. club soda
preparation: Combine sugar, mint leaves and water in a 2-quart casserole. Cook on High for 2 1/2 to 4 minutes or until mixture boils.  Stir halfway through cooking time.   Let stand 5 minutes.  Add frozen raspberries and limeade.  Stir until raspberries are thawed. Gradually stir in club soda, just before serving.  Serve on ice.

name: BEEF AND CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
3  pkg. dried smoked beef, chopped fine
1  small onion, chopped fine
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese (room temperature)
1  tsp. Accent
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine 2 packages of beef, onion, cream cheese, Accent and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl.  Mix well and form into a ball. Roll ball in the remaining package of beef that has been chopped. Serve at room temperature.  Makes 1 very large cheese ball or 2 small cheese balls.  Two-thirds of this recipe makes a good size ball for a tray of crackers.

name: KEY LIME PIE
ingredients:
3  egg whites
1  egg white
4  egg yolks
1 (14 oz.)  can condensed milk
1/2  c. lime juice
3  tsp. grated lime peel
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Beat egg yolks, blend with milk.  Add lime juice and peel. Beat 1 egg white until stiff, fold into milk mixture.  Pour into baked pastry shell.  Beat 3 egg whites with cream of tartar until frothy.  Gradually beat in sugar, a little at a time.  Continue beating until mixture is thick and glossy.  Fold in 1 teaspoon vanilla flavoring.  Pile meringue on pie filling and swirl it over top bringing it out to pastry rim to seal and prevent shrinkage. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.  Chill before serving.

name: AUNT JEANNE'S SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
5  Tbsp. oil
1  clove garlic, minced
1  large onion, chopped fine
1  lb. ground beef
1 (4 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. hot water
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. seasoned salt
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. chili powder
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. chili sauce
preparation: Saute the garlic and onion in oil for about 15 minutes.  Do not burn.  Add ground beef and saute until the meat is all brown. Add tomato paste, tomato sauce and water.  Simmer for one hour. Any grease may be skimmed off at this time, then for the last 15 minutes, add all the spices.  This makes enough sauce for a one pound box of spaghetti.

name: CHICKEN OR VEAL PARMESAN
ingredients:
chicken or veal breast
bread crumbs, seasoned with oregano and garlic salt
beaten egg with 2 Tbsp. water
15  oz. can tomato sauce plus 1/2 can water
Mozzarella cheese, grated
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. garlic
preparation: Dip meat in egg and then in bread crumbs (adheres better if coated a few hours prior to frying).  Fry in 1/2-inch grease. Drain.  Place in casserole.  Cover with foil.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Pour off grease from pan.  To drippings, add tomato sauce and water.  Add seasonings.  Pour sauce over meat in casserole.  Cover and bake an additional 30 minutes.  Uncover; top with cheese.  Bake 5 minutes.  Serve with rice or noodles.

name: RITZ CRACKER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  box Ritz crackers
1  jar creamy peanut butter
2  lb. chocolate almond bark
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Butter cracker with peanut butter.  Top with second cracker (making like sandwich).  Melt chocolate almond bark and oil in top of double boiler or microwave (keep warm while working with it). Dip cracker sandwich into melted chocolate almond bark.  Place on waxed paper and allow to harden.  Makes about 60.

name: CORN AND PEPPER CHOWDER
ingredients:
1  large onion, chopped
1  medium sweet red pepper, chopped
1  tsp. canola oil
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. ground cumin
2  c. water
1 1/3  c. cubed potatoes
1  tsp. chicken bouillon granules
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. white pepper
2  c. frozen corn
1 (12 oz.)  can fat-free evaporated milk
1/4  c. minced fresh cilantro or parsley
preparation: In a saucepan, sauté onion and red pepper in oil until tender. Stir in flour and cumin until blended. Gradually stir in water. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Reduce heat. Add the potatoes, bouillon, salt and pepper. Cover and cook for 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Add corn and milk. Cook, uncovered, 5 minutes longer or until heated through. Garnish with cilantro. Yield: 6 servings.

name: JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon flavored Jell-O
1 (17 oz.)  can fruit cocktail
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (8 3/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. cream (whipping)
preparation: Place gelatin in bowl.  Drain fruit.  Heat 2/3 cup juice and pour over gelatin, stirring until dissolved.  Add lemon juice and cheese, stirring until well blended.  Add fruits and undrained pineapple.  Chill until partially set.  Fold in cream which has been whipped stiff.  Chill.

name: COUNTRY STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak (3/4 inch thick)
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. water
preparation: Pound steak; cut into serving size pieces.  In skillet, brown steak in oil; pour off fat.  Stir in soup and water.  Cover; simmer 1 1/2 hours or until done.  Stir often.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/4  c. milk
1  can crescent dinner rolls
salt to taste
1  lb. tube sausage, browned and drained
1  c. grated sharp cheese
preparation: Line 9 x 13 dish with rolls.  Combine milk, eggs and salt; mix well and pour over rolls.  Add drained sausage.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes then add the grated cheese.  Let it melt on the top.  If you like more cheese, put some in the mix of milk and eggs.

name: TORTILLA ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
4  large flour tortillas (dairy case)
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. dry Hidden Valley mix or salsa or dry taco mix
chopped green chiles
chopped black olives
green onions
green peppers
red peppers
Cheddar cheese
chopped green olives
chopped pepperoni, ham, bacon, etc.
preparation: Spread cream cheese on tortillas.  Sprinkle on any or all of the ingredients listed.  Roll and chill 2 hours.  Slice 1/2-inch slices.  Put toothpick through to hold in place.

name: CRISPY CHICKEN WITH ASPARAGUS SAUCE
ingredients:
4  skinless, boneless chicken breast halves or 8 boneless chicken thighs
1  egg or 2 egg whites, beaten
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's new cream of asparagus soup
1/3  c. each:  milk and water
hot cooked rice with chopped parsley
preparation: In a pie plate, dip chicken into egg; coat with bread crumbs. In a skillet over medium-low heat, in hot oil, cook chicken 15 minutes or until browned on both sides and no longer pink. Remove; keep warm.

name: BROCCOLI OR ZUCCHINI QUICHE
ingredients:
2  c. broccoli or zucchini, chopped
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. Bisquick
3  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix together all ingredients at once.  Pour into greased 9-inch pie plate.  Bake 30 minutes at 400°.

name: STRAWBERRY SURPRISE
ingredients:
1 medium size  carton cottage cheese
1  medium bowl Cool Whip
1  box strawberry jello
1  bag mini marshmallows
1/2  c. coconut flakes
1  can drained, crushed pineapple
preparation: In a large bowl, mix jello and pineapple.  Add cottage cheese, Cool Whip, coconut and marshmallows.  Stir well and refrigerate before serving.

name: FRUIT LIZZIES
ingredients:
1  lb. dates, chopped
1/2  lb. candied pineapple, chopped
1  lb. pecans, chopped
1/2  lb. seedless raisins
1/2  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar
1  stick butter
4  eggs
2 1/2  c. plain flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground allspice
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/3  c. grape juice or apple juice
preparation: Chop all fruits and nuts.  Then combine with 1/2 cup flour to coat well.

name: ITALIAN CREAM CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1/2  c. vegetable shortening
2  c. sugar
5  egg yolks
2  c. flour
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  stick butter
1  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1 small  can shredded coconut
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
chopped pecans
preparation: Cream butter and shortening; add sugar and beat until smooth. Add egg yolks and beat until smooth.  Combine flour and soda; add to creamed mixture, alternating with buttermilk.  Stir in vanilla. Add nuts and coconut.  Fold in egg whites.  Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 8-inch cake pans.  Bake for 25 minutes at 350° or until tests done.

name: BARBECUED CHICKEN IN THE OVEN(Wings, Legs or Breasts)
ingredients:
12  chicken wings
salt and pepper to taste
1  Tbsp. ground garlic
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
preparation: Season the wings with the ingredients, and in a greased baking pan, place  the  wings.  Let  cook for 30 minutes, covered,  at 325°.  After  30  minutes,  uncover,  empty  excess grease, and cover with  Hunt's barbecue sauce.  Cook for 20 to 30 more minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: OATMEAL MUFFINS
ingredients:
3 1/4  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. white sugar
a little salt
3/4  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  c. walnuts (optional)
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  c. hot water
2  c. flour
2  c. quick oats
1  c. raisins
preparation: Dissolve the soda in hot water; pour over shortening, sugar and eggs, mixed together.   Mix all ingredients together and bake in a moderate oven at 350° until golden brown.

name: CHOCOLATE TRIFLE
ingredients:
2 small or 1 large  pkg. brownie mix, prepared
1  container Cool Whip (regular or chocolate)
1 large  pkg. instant chocolate pudding, prepared
1/2  pkg. Bits O' Brickle (Heath Bar bits) or 6 crumbled Heath bars
preparation: Crumble half the cooled brownies into clear bowl.  Spoon half the chilled pudding over the brownies.  Let set for 5 minutes. Next spread half the Cool Whip over the pudding.  Spread Heath Bar bits evenly over Cool Whip.  Repeat.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 scant (almost)  c. oil
3  c. dried, peeled apples
1  c. chopped nuts
2 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  pkg. butterscotch chips
preparation: Mix sugar, oil and eggs.  Beat well.  Add dry ingredients, mixing thoroughly.   Add apples and nuts.  Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.  Sprinkle butterscotch chips on top of batter.  Bake an hour or until brown in 325° oven.

name: OLD FASHIONED RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. cooked rice
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
whipped cream (optional)
1 1/3  c. milk
1  Tbsp. soft butter
3  eggs, beaten
preparation: Combine cooked rice, milk, brown sugar, butter, vanilla and eggs in 2 1/2-quart casserole.  Microwave at Medium for 13 to 15 minutes.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Serve warm or cold topped with whipped cream, if desired.  Makes about 6 servings.

name: CHEEZY CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  boneless chicken breasts
6  slices Swiss cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix
1/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Place chicken in baking dish.  Put cheese slices on top of chicken.  Add  undiluted  soup  and  spread  over  chicken. Sprinkle top  with	dressing  mix.	Pour  melted  butter  over dressing.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: REESE'S PEANUT BUTTER BARS
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1  c. peanut butter
1 3/4  c. graham cracker crumbs
2 1/4  c. powdered sugar
12  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Melt margarine.  Add peanut butter and graham cracker crumbs. Gradually add powdered sugar.  Pat into 13 x 9-inch pan.  Melt chocolate chips and spread over peanut mixture.  Let cool completely.  Cut into bars.  Can be made in microwave.

name: VEGETABLE - BEEF SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. boneless beef chuck, tip or round, cut in 1/2-inch cubes
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  c. beef broth
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. fresh, chopped or 1/2 tsp. dried marjoram leaves
1 1/2  tsp. fresh, chopped or 1/2 tsp. dried thyme leaves
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  bay leaf
3  c. water
1  c. whole kernel corn, frozen or canned
1  c. carrots, sliced (about 3 medium carrots)
1/2  c. celery, sliced (about 1 large stalk)
1/2  c. onion, chopped (about 1 medium onion)
1 (16 oz.)  can whole tomatoes, undrained
preparation: Cook and stir beef in oil in Dutch oven over medium heat until brown.  Stir in beef broth, salt, marjoram, thyme, pepper and bay leaf; reduce heat.  Cover and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until beef is tender.

name: SPICY CRANBERRY CHEESE
ingredients:
1/2  c. whole-berry cranberry sauce
1/2  c. jalapeno pepper jelly
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
assorted crackers, shortbread cookies
preparation: Combine cranberry sauce and pepper jelly. Stir well. Spoon mixture over cream cheese. Serve with crackers or shortbread cookies. Makes 10 servings.

name: GRANOLA
ingredients:
6  c. uncooked oats (not quick kind)
1  c. raw wheat germ
1  c. honey
1/2  c. corn oil
1  c. cold water
1  c. sunflower seeds
1  c. sesame seed
1  c. pecans or almonds, blanched
1  c. raisins
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients; add blended liquid.  Mix well; pour in large pan (heavy) and spread evenly.  Bake in 250° oven for 2 hours.  Stir every 15 minutes.  Turn off oven; add nuts and raisins and allow mixture to cool in oven.  When cooled, put in a tightly covered container.  Store in a cool, dry place.  Serve with meat or fresh fruit.  One-half or one-third of recipe may be made.

name: FRYING PAN COOKIES
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
2 1/2  lb. boxed dates, cut in pieces
1  c. sugar
2  beaten eggs
2  c. Rice Krispies
1/2  c. cut walnuts
1  pkg. shredded coconut
preparation: Mix butter, dates, sugar and eggs.  Put in frying pan and cook over low heat for 10 minutes.  Put Rice Krispies and walnuts in bowl.  Pour mixture over and stir.  When cool, shape into walnut size balls.  Roll in coconut.

name: MERRY CAROTENE
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots, sliced, cooked and drained (do not overcook)
1  green pepper, sliced
1  large onion, sliced
1  can tomato soup
1 1/2  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1/4  c. oil
1/2  c. honey
3/4  c. cider vinegar
1  tsp. mustard
preparation: Mix   all  ingredients  together  except  for  carrots, peppers  and  onion.  Beat  well.  Add  carrots,  peppers  and onions.  Refrigerate  8 to 12 hours before serving.  Will keep up to 3 weeks.

name: ZUCCHINI BITES
ingredients:
4  c. shredded zucchini
1  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. oregano leaves
2 to 3  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  c. salad oil
4  eggs, slightly beaten
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease a jelly roll pan or spray with Pam.  Mix all ingredients well.  Pour into pan; bake for 35 minutes, or until golden and set.  Let cool for 15 minutes.  Cut into bite size squares.

name: ONION POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
1 (2 lb.)  pkg. frozen hash browns
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
1  can Durkee onions
1  stick oleo
1 (5 oz.)  can evaporated milk
preparation: Mix potatoes, soup, milk and 1/2 can of onions in a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Melt oleo and pour over the potatoes.  Top with salt and pepper and 1/2 can of onions.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. diced cooked chicken
2  c. celery, sautéed in butter
1  onion
1  c. mayonnaise
1 small  jar pimentos
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  can diced water chestnuts
salt and pepper
1 small  can peas
4  hard-diced boiled eggs
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Mix chicken, celery, onion, mayonnaise, pimentos, lemon juice, water chestnuts, salt and pepper.  Add peas and eggs and spread into a pan.  Add layer of cheese.  Add crushed potato chips.  Cook 25 minutes at 400° in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: MARINATED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms
1/2  c. oil
1/4  c. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. chopped chives
1/2  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Select bite size mushrooms. Wash and dry completely.  Combine remaining ingredients and pour over mushrooms.  Marinate 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Drain and serve on toothpicks.

name: EASY SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed celery or cream of mushroom soup
1/2 to 3/4  c. milk
dash of pepper
4  c. thinly sliced potatoes
1  small onion, thinly sliced or diced
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
dash of paprika (optional)
preparation: Blend soup, milk and pepper together.  Arrange alternate layers of potatoes, onions and sauce in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Dot top with butter.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour.  Uncover, bake 15 minutes more.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: CORDELIA KNOTT'S RECIPE - BUTTERMILK BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. shortening
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. buttermilk
1/8  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Into a mixing bowl, sift flour, baking powder and salt.  Add shortening and blend well.  Add baking soda to buttermilk, then pour into flour mixture.  Blend thoroughly.

name: FRUITED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
4  double thick pork chops
4  slices apple
4  slices onion
salt and pepper
4  slices pineapple
preparation: Brown pork chops on both sides; place in casserole.  Top with apple, onion and seasonings.  Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.  Remove from oven and top with pineapple slice.  Return to oven and bake 15 minutes or until pineapple is tipped with brown.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans
1  German chocolate cake mix
1  stick butter
8  oz. cream cheese
1  box powdered sugar
preparation: Mix coconut and pecans and pour into 9 x 13 greased pan. Mix cake mix according to directions and pour over coconut and pecans. Heat butter and cream cheese until warm enough to stir in sugar. Once sugar is dissolved, spoon over cake mixture. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes. Don't cut cake until cool.

name: LOBSTER STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
16  large mushroom caps
1 1/2  c. bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. finely chopped garlic
1  medium lobster, steamed
1/4  tsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. finely chopped parsley
1/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Wipe  mushroom  caps with damp cloth.  In a large bowl, combine  crumbs,  garlic,  parsley, paprika and melted butter. Add coarsely  chopped  lobster meat.  Stuff caps and place in buttered baking dish.  Bake at 425° until heated through for 8 to 10  minutes.  Serve  with lemon wedges and a sprinkling of chopped parsley.

name: LIME FIZZ
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed
1/2  c. chilled bottled green maraschino cherry syrup or green passion fruit juice mix
2 1/2  c. chilled quinine water
green food coloring
preparation: Just before serving, combine the limeade concentrate, syrup and quinine water in a pitcher.  Add food coloring to tint desired shade of green; mix lightly.  Garnish with a float of fresh cranberries.  Serve over crushed ice.

name: ORANGE RAISIN CARROTS
ingredients:
1  lb. carrots, scraped and sliced
3/4  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. orange juice
1/2  c. raisins
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Combine carrots, water and salt in saucepan.  Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce the heat.  Simmer for 5 to 8 minutes, until carrots are crisp-tender; drain.  Combine orange juice and cornstarch and stir into carrots.  Stir in raisins and sugar. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and thickened.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: TAMALE PIE
ingredients:
1  onion, finely chopped
1  green pepper, chopped fine
1  clove garlic
1/2  c. chopped olives
1 small  can vegeburger
chili powder
2  c. cooked tomatoes
1/2  c. cornmeal
preparation: Saute onion, green pepper and clove of garlic.  Saute vegeburger in separate pan until light brown.  Mix all together and add chili powder as desired.  Add tomatoes and cornmeal, still cooking over low heat.  Add olives. Put into buttered casserole and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Uncover for the last 15 minutes.

name: 12-INCH COOKIE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
2/3  c. oil
2  eggs
2  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Pour into greased 12 to 14-inch pizza pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: BANANA ORANGE NUTMEG BREAD
ingredients:
2  bananas, mashed
1/4  c. orange juice
1/4  c. margarine
2/3  c. sugar
1  egg
2  c. flour
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix juice and bananas.  Cream margarine and sugar; add egg and banana mix.  Stir in flour, nutmeg, baking powder and soda.  Stir in nuts.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes in well-greased loaf pan.

name: HAM LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground smoked ham
2  lb. ground fresh ham
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1  c. cracker crumbs
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. vinegar and water
1  Tbsp. Colman's mustard
preparation: Mix smoked and fresh ham with eggs, milk and cracker crumbs and form into loaf.  Mix brown sugar, vinegar, water and mustard. Pour over loaf in baking pan.  Bake at 325° for 2 hours.  Baste often, like every 15 minutes.

name: JELLO CAKE
ingredients:
1  white cake mix
1 small  box strawberry Jell-O
1  c. strawberry soda pop
1  bowl Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake mix and cool.  Leave in pan; poke holes in cake. Mix Jell-O and pour over cake.  Ice cake with Cool Whip and put in refrigerator until ready to serve.

name: BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
3  c. bran cereal (All-Bran or any 100% bran)
1  c. boiling water
1/2  c. cooking oil
2 1/2  c. flour
2  c. buttermilk
2 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt (optional)
2  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. sugar (more if you like a sweeter taste)
preparation: Combine 1 cup All-Bran with boiling water.  Cool.  Add oil. Sift dry ingredients together.  Combine eggs and buttermilk.  Add to dry ingredients together.  Stir in 2 remaining cups of bran and the first bran mixture.  Pour into greased muffin tins.  Bake 18 minutes at 400°.  Makes 24.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE MIX
ingredients:
8  qt. dry milk
1  lb. Nestle Quik
6  oz. Coffee-mate
1  lb. box powdered sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients together. Put 1 or 2 tablespoons in a cup of hot water.

name: PORK CHOPS AND WILD RICE
ingredients:
1  box Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice mix
1  can mushroom soup
1 1/4  c. water
1  can water chestnuts, drained and sliced (optional)
6  lean pork chops
preparation: Combine contents of box, soup, water and water chestnuts in 13 x 9-inch pan.  Trim any fat off pork chops and arrange on top of rice mixture.  Bake, uncovered, 1 hour and 20 minutes at 350°.

name: SOUR CREAM COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick butter or oleo (1/2 c.)
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  c. sour crem
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and eggs.  Sift flour, soda, baking powder and  salt.  Add  sour  cream to creamed butter mixture. Turn to low speed and add flour mixture.  Mix until smooth.

name: LOBSTER NEWBURG
ingredients:
1 large  can lobster (fresh or frozen)
1/4  lb. butter (no substitutes)
1/4  c. flour
1  c. milk
1/2  c. sherry
add salt or seasoning to taste
preparation: Melt butter; add flour.  Add milk gradually, stirring until thickened.  Add lobster and sherry.  Serves 4.

name: DATE NUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. Karo syrup in 1 stick melted butter
1  lb. dates, halved
1  lb. walnuts
1  c. brown sugar
4  egg yolks
4  egg whites, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift flour and baking powder twice. Sift over dates and nuts. Add sugar, butter, yolks and vanilla. Mix with hands. Fold in beaten egg whites. Pour in greased angel food pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: CHOCOLATE COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
7  Tbsp. cocoa
1 large  can evaporated milk
pinch of salt
1  stick margarine
1  can coconut
4  eggs, whisked
2  tsp. vanilla
3  (9-inch) pie shells (frozen pie shells should be browned beforehand)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into 9-inch pie shells and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Makes 3 pies.

name: POTATO-BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. ground nutmeg
2  c. milk
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, cubed
1/2  c. (2 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese
4  c. (16 oz.) frozen loose-pack hash brown potatoes, thawed
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1/4  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Melt the 2 tablespoons butter or margarine.  Blend in flour and seasonings.  Add milk; cook and stir until bubbly.  Add cheeses, stirring until melted.  Stir in potatoes.  Turn half the mixture into a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish; top with broccoli. Spoon remaining mixture over top.  Cover; bake in a 350° oven for 35 minutes.  Mix crumbs and remaining butter; sprinkle around edges.  Bake, uncovered, 10 to 15 minutes.  Makes 8 servings.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
catsup (to make pink)
2  splashes Worcestershire sauce
3  drops Tabasco
2  green onions, finely chopped
1  c. shrimp, drained
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cream together cream cheese, mayonnaise, catsup, Worcestershire and Tabasco.  Add onion and shrimp, then salt and pepper.  This is better, if refrigerated overnight.  It keeps a long time in the refrigerator.

name: EASY EGG NOODLES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
3  egg yolks
1  egg
2  tsp. salt
1/4 to 1/2  c. water
preparation: Measure flour and salt in bowl.  Add egg and extra yolks; mix thoroughly.  Add water 1 to 2 tablespoons at a time mixing well. Form dough into a ball.  Knead until elastic and smooth.  Cover and let set 10 minutes.  Divide dough into 4 parts.  Roll one at a time on well floured pastry sheet about 1/8-inch thick.  Cut into thin or thick (whichever you prefer) strips with a pizza cutter.  Shake off extra flour and place on towel or sheet pan to dry for several hours or overnight.  Cook in 3 quarts water or use chicken broth 12 to 15 minutes until tender.  Makes 6 cups.

name: RICH CHOCOLATE BEET BREAD
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.) beets, drained (reserve 1/2  c. juice)
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vegetable oil
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
3/4  c. cocoa
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chocolate chips
1/2  c. pecans (optional)
preparation: Puree beets with juice and transfer to large bowl.  Stir in next 4 ingredients.  Combine dry ingredients and add to beet mixture and mix well.  Stir in chips and nuts.  Bake in three 8 x 4 x 2 bread pans about 3/4 full.  Bake 30 to 40 minutes.

name: MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. molasses
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and molasses and mix well.  Stir in dry ingredients.  Make into balls.  Roll in sugar; place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 370° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: GLAZED CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. honey
1/4  c. prepared mustard
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. curry powder
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
6  chicken breasts, split and boned
preparation: In a shallow baking dish melt butter.  Stir in remaining ingredients except chicken.  Roll chicken in mixture, coating both sides.  Arrange chicken in dish, skin side up.   Bake at 375° for 1 hour, basting occasionally.

name: TORTILLA BITES
ingredients:
2  pkg. cream cheese
3  to 4 jalapenos, chopped
2  green onions, chopped
1  c. sour cream
1 small  can chopped black olives
salsa (optional)
1  pkg. flour tortillas
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and spread on the tortilla.  Roll up tortilla.  Place in a Ziploc bag and refrigerate, at least 2 days.  Slice in 1/2-inch slices and serve with salsa.

name: LEMON JELLO CAKE
ingredients:
1  box lemon cake mix
5  eggs, well beaten
3/4  c. cooking oil
1  box lemon jello
1  c. hot water
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients, then next 2 ingredients.  Mix well together.  Pour in greased Bundt pan and bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. stuffing mix
1  stick oleo, melted
4  c. cooked chicken
8  oz. sour cream
1  can mushroom soup
2  jars mushrooms, drained
preparation: Melt butter and mix with crumbs; pat half in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Reserve some crumbs for top.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. mashed sweet potatoes
1  c. sugar (or less)
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
preparation: Mix all and pour in a 2-quart baking dish.

name: SOUPER RICE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 soup  can Minute rice
1 soup  can milk
preparation: Use any type cream soup.  In a 2-quart covered microwave dish, empty 1 can cream soup, 1 can Minute rice and 1 can milk.  Stir, cover and cook on High in microwave for 4 minutes.  Turn dish 1/4 turn and continue to cook 3 more minutes.  Stir, cover and let stand 5 minutes or until all of the milk is absorbed.

name: MONKEY CAKE
ingredients:
4  cans biscuits (10 to a can)
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Take biscuits and cut into quarters.  Put sugar and cinnamon in a bag.  Put biscuits in the bag and shake.  Place biscuits in a greased tube pan (layered).

name: HOBO BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. currants
2  tsp. soda
1  c. boiling water
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. butter
2  c. flour
preparation: Combine currants and soda.  Pour 1 cup boiling water over. Let cool.  Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into cans that have been sprayed with Pam.  Bake at 350°.  When dough rises to top of the can, test with toothpick for doneness.

name: LEMON-POPPY SEED BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon cake mix
4  eggs
1  c. water
1/2  c. oil
1  pkg. lemon instant pudding
1/4  c. poppy seed
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and beat by hand for 4 minutes. Grease and flour five small or two regular size loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CHOW MEIN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. chopped chicken
2 small  cans evaporated milk
2  cans chicken and rice soup
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  cans sliced water chestnuts
2  cans chow mein noodles
preparation: Mix all together. Place in 2-quart buttered casserole, adding noodles last. Bake at 350° for 35 or 40 minutes.

name: AUNT MARY'S PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large  can unsweetened pineapple juice
1 large  can frozen orange juice
1 large  bottle club soda
1 large  bottle ginger ale
1 small  pkg. lemon sherbet
1 small  pkg. orange sherbet
preparation: Add all the ingredients in a large punch bowl.  You can float ice cubes in the punch with raspberries or strawberries frozen into them.  Lemon or lime slices also look nice as does daisies for a decorative note.

name: WILD RICE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. raw wild rice
3 1/2  c. low salt chicken broth or water
1  c. pecan pieces
1  c. yellow raisins
1/4  c. chopped fresh mint leaves
4  green onions, sliced
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, halved and drained
grated rind of 1 orange
1/3  c. orange juice
1/4  c. oil
1 1/2  tsp. salt
pepper
preparation: Cook wild rice in broth or water until liquid is absorbed, about 1/2 to 2 hours.  Cool; add pecans, raisins, mint, onions and orange sections.  Set aside.  Combine orange rind, orange juice, oil, salt and pepper and mix well.  Pour over rice mix and toss. Let stand at room temperature 2 hours.  Serve at room temperature or chilled.

name: CHICKEN SUPREME
ingredients:
8  boneless chicken breasts
Swiss cheese
baked ham
1/2  c. milk
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  c. Pepperidge Farm herb dressing mix
preparation: Salt and pepper each chicken breast.  Lay in greased casserole pan.

name: BLACKBERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
4  c. blackberries
3/4 to 1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. melted butter
3  Tbsp. flour
1  pie crust (uncooked)
preparation: Wash berries and place in a 2-quart casserole dish.  Combine sugar and flour; add water, small amounts at a time.  Stir in lemon juice.  Mix well and pour over berries.  Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.  Remove from oven and place crust on top, slitting in 3 to 4 places.

name: HOT FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (25 oz.)  jar chunky applesauce
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple chunks (undrained)
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can sliced peaches (undrained)
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can apricot halves (undrained)
1 (15 oz.)  can mandarin oranges (undrained)
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Place the first six ingredients in a slow cooker and stir gently.  Combine brown sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over fruit mixture.  Cover and cook on low for 3 to 4 hours.  Yield: 16 servings.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
8  Tbsp. flour
2  c. sharp Cheddar, grated
2  c. crushed pineapple, drained
1  roll Ritz crackers, crushed
1  stick butter, melted
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients.  Crush crackers on top.  Pour butter over crackers.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. bisquick
1/2  c. cold water
1  lb. sausage, cooked and drained
1/2  c. shredded cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients and roll into small balls.  Bake on a cookie sheet at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes, peeled
2  Tbsp. melted margarine or oil
1/4  c. corn flakes, crushed
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Roll potatoes in butter, then crumbs.  Bake in covered dish at 425° for 45 minutes.

name: GREEN NOODLES
ingredients:
1/4  lb. spinach
3  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs
6  qt. water
1  Tbsp. salt
3/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Wash spinach.  Place into a heavy saucepan. Do not add water. Cook only in the moisture remaining on the leaves from washing. Partially cover and cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally with a fork. Drain spinach, pressing out water and chop finely.   Mix flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a bowl,  making a well in center. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing slightly after each addition. Add the chopped spinach and mix well.  Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth, adding flour if needed to make a stiff dough.  Divide dough in half.  Lightly roll each half into a rectangle, about 1/8-inch thick. Cover and let stand for 1 hour.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
2  boxes instant vanilla pudding
2 1/2  c. cold sweet milk
4  oz. sour cream
1  (9 oz.) bowl Cool Whip
bananas
vanilla wafers
preparation: Beat pudding and milk until thick.  Add sour cream and Cool Whip.  Alternate layers of bananas and wafers.  Spread pudding on each layer.  Put Cool Whip and sour cream on top.  Sprinkle with graham crackers or vanilla wafers.

name: FREEZER SLAW
ingredients:
1  head cabbage, chopped fine
1  c. vinegar
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. mustard seed
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. green pepper, chopped fine
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except cabbage and green peppers.  Bring to a boil.  Cool.  Pour over slaw and freeze.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD(Makes 2 Loaves)
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. light vegetable oil
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
3/4  tsp. baking powder
2  c. grated raw zucchini
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  c. raisins
preparation: Beat and add gradually eggs, sugar, vegetable oil and vanilla. Add and mix flour, baking soda, baking powder and cinnamon.  Fold in zucchini, walnuts and raisins.  Bake for 55 minutes in oven at 350°.  Makes 2 loaves, 3 x 9-inches.

name: SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti, cooked
1 (32 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1  lb. ground beef
1 large  carton cottage cheese
Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown and drain ground beef. Season and stir in spaghetti sauce.  In an oblong dish, place the cooked spaghetti.  Hold back some noodles for top layer. Add ground beef and cottage cheese. Add remaining noodles.  Top with Mozzarella cheese.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour, sifted
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  c. pumpkin
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. nuts, chopped
3/4  c. raisins
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder, soda, cinnamon and salt together. Set aside.  Cream shortening; add sugar, pumpkin and egg.  Mix well.  Add dry ingredients, nuts, raisins and vanilla.  Mix until well blended.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1/2  c. onion, diced
2  c. red beans, drained
1/2  c. French dressing
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. chili powder
4  c. lettuce, shredded
1/2  c. onion
2  c. Cheddar cheese
Tostitos
preparation: Brown hamburger and onions.  Stir in beans, dressing, water and chili powder.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Add lettuce, onion and cheese.  Toss together.  Break up Tostitos and toss before serving.

name: NEW YORK CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
3  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  c. sour cream
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  graham cracker crust
preparation: Let cream cheese set at room temperature to soften. Beat cream cheese with mixer until fluffy. Add sugar and vanilla; blend well. Add eggs one at a time and blend. Add sour cream; blend. Spread in graham cracker crust. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHEESE ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped onion (1 small)
1  c. chopped green pepper (1 medium)
1  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. water
1  tsp. instant beef broth
1  pkg. frozen tortillas
1  lb. cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Sauté onion, green pepper and garlic in vegetable oil until soft.  Add 2 Tbsp. flour, chili powder and salt.  Cook until bubbly.  Add water and instant beef broth and cook, stirring, until thickened.  Add in cheddar cheese.

name: TUNA SOUFFLE
ingredients:
1  c. scalded milk
1  c. fresh bread bits
1/2  c. grated American cheese
1  can flaked tuna
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  eggs
preparation: Remove crusts from fresh slices of bread; break into small bits.  Scald milk and add to bits.  Add chopped cheese, tuna, lemon juice, salt and well beaten egg yolks.  Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry.  Fold into mixture.  Turn into buttered casserole.  Set into a pan of water and bake for 35 minutes at 325°.

name: SHRIMP SCAMPI
ingredients:
3/4  lb. medium raw shrimp, shelled and deveined
6  Tbsp. margarine
1  Tbsp. minced green onion
1  Tbsp. salad oil
4 to 5  cloves garlic, minced or pressed
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
1/4  tsp. grated lemon peel
dash of liquid hot pepper seasoning
preparation: Pat shrimp dry with paper towels; set aside.  Melt butter in a wide frying pan over medium heat.  Stir in green onion, oil, garlic, lemon juice and salt; cook until bubbly.  Add shrimp to pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp turn pink (4 to 5 minutes).  Stir in parsley, lemon peel and hot pepper seasoning. Makes 2 servings.

name: MRS. FIELDS COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
2 1/2  c. oatmeal
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  (12 oz.) bag chocolate chips
1  (8 oz.) Hershey bar, grated
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts (any kind)
preparation: Cream together butter, sugar and brown sugar.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Mix together flour and oatmeal (put small amount into blender until it turns to powder; measure first, then blend).  Mix together these ingredients.  Add chocolate chips, grated Hershey bar and nuts.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheets.  Make golf ball sized cookies, 2-inches apart, and bake at 375° for 6 minutes. Makes 112 cookies.

name: CORN PUDDING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can cream-style corn
1  box Jiffy corn muffin mix
3  eggs
1/3  c. milk
1  small chopped onion
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Pour into casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  Tbsp. fat (may use 3 to 4 Tbsp. olive oil)
4  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. chopped celery, cooked
1  c. green peas or beans
1/2  c. onion, chopped
2  c. chicken stock
2 to 3  c. cooked chicken, chopped
1  c. sliced carrots, cooked
preparation: Heat fat.  Add onion and cook until soft and golden, approximately 10 minutes.  Add flour; stir until blended.  Add stock slowly and stir over low heat until thick and smooth. Season to taste.  May wish to use celery and/or onion salt.

name: WHITE ALMOND FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. sour cream
1/3  c. light corn syrup
2  tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. whole natural almonds, chopped, divided
1/4  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Butter an 8 in square baking pan.

name: REED WALDEN'S CRANBERRY JELLO MOLD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. orange jello
1  pt. sour cream
1  can cranberry sauce with whole cranberries or 1 1/2 c.  cooked cranberries
1  c. boiling water
1  tin mandarin oranges
preparation: Mix jello and boiling water.  Add cranberry sauce; mix well. Add sour cream.  Put in mold; chill and let set overnight. Unmold; garnish with oranges.

name: EASY SNACK MIX
ingredients:
1  jar dry roasted peanuts
1  jar Wheat-nuts
1  pkg. chocolate chips
1  pkg. butterscotch chips
1 to 2  c. raisins
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.  Store in an airtight container.

name: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
3  cans water
1  c. sugar
1 medium  bottle maraschino cherries and juice
1 (20 oz.)  can chunk pineapple and juice
20  oz. frozen strawberries
3  bananas, sliced
preparation: Mix together, adding bananas last.  Freeze.  May be used as a salad or dessert.

name: ORANGE DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1/4  c. butter
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1/4  c. orange juice
1  Tbsp. grated orange peel
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sour milk
3 1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs, orange juice, peel, vanilla and milk; mix well. Add dry ingredients. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Frost, if desired.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1  c. soft butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  medium eggs
2 3/4  c. sifted flour (plain)
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. soda
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cream the butter, sugar and eggs thoroughly.  Sift together the flour, cream of tartar and soda.  Stir into butter mixture. Chill mixture.  Form dough into balls about the size of a walnut. Roll in a mixture containing 2 tablespoons of sugar and 2 teaspoons of cinnamon.  Place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 400° for 8 minutes.  Yields 5 dozen.

name: BASIC CRUSTLESS QUICHE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter/margarine
10  eggs
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  lb. large curd cottage cheese
1  lb. Jack cheese, shredded
preparation: Melt the  butter.  Whip  the  eggs until fluffy and add the flour,  baking powder, salt, cottage cheese, melted butter and half  the  Jack  cheese.  At  this	point,	add  any other special ingredients  you wish.  Place the mixture in a greased 9 x 13-inch  baking  dish.  Top  with  remaining Jack cheese. Bake at 400°  for 15 minutes; then reduce temperature to 350° and continue to	bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until the top is lightly browned. Cool and cut into squares for serving.

name: ONE HOUR ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1 1/2  c. warm buttermilk
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. melted shortening
4 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water.  Add buttermilk, sugar and shortening.  Sift dry ingredients and add to mixture.  Beat until smooth.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Roll out dough; cut or shape as desired.  Place on greased pan.  Let rise in warm place for 30 minutes.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Makes approximately 2 dozen rolls.

name: CHICKEN VERMICELLI SALAD
ingredients:
6 to 8  c. cooked chicken, diced
1 small  box vermicelli
1 large  bottle Marzetti slaw dressing
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. celery, chopped fine
1  c. bell pepper, chopped fine
juice of 1 lemon
4  to 6 dashes of red pepper
preparation: Boil chicken and remove from bones. Dice for salad. Break pasta in fourths and cook until done. Chop celery and bell pepper. Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: TUPPERWARE PIE CRUST
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
pinch of salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. Crisco shortening
1/2  c. cold water
preparation: Place the first 4 ingredients in large Tupperware mixing bowl; seal and burp.  Shake approximately 3 or 4 minutes, or until ingredients look like large peas.  Add the cold water; seal and burp again.  Shake until ball forms.  Roll out.  Never fails!! Makes 3 single 9-inch crusts.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie crust
2  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/8  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Beat eggs slightly with hand beater or wire whisk in medium bowl.  Beat in remaining ingredients.  Place pie plate on cookie sheet to prevent spills.
