Pour filling into pie plate.  Bake for 15 minutes.  Reduce oven temperature to 350°. Bake for about 45 minutes longer or until done.  Cool. Refrigerate for about 4 hours or until chilled.  Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

name: PIZZETTE(Small Fried Pizza With Sauce)
ingredients:
1  c. bread flour
1/4  tsp. dry yeast
5  Tbsp. lukewarm water
1  lb. ripe tomatoes, peeled and coarsely chopped
salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
4  garlic cloves
1  red chili pepper
3  Tbsp. extra virgin olive oil
3  c. oil for deep frying
6  fresh basil leaves
preparation: Place flour in large bowl.  Dissolve yeast in one tablespoon lukewarm water.  Add flour.  Gradually add remaining water to flour, mixing until firm, elastic dough forms.  Knead for a few minutes.  Form into ball.  Let rise for about 2 hours.  Place tomatoes in a saucepan with a little salt and the sugar.  Cook over medium heat until softened and the liquid has evaporated. Chop garlic with chili pepper.  Saute in olive oil until garlic is lightly colored.  Stir into tomato sauce and keep hot.  Roll dough into log.  Cut into 1-inch pieces.  Roll out each piece on floured work surface.  Heat oil in cast-iron skillet, fry pizzas, turning over until each is puffy and light brown.  Drain pizzas onto paper towels.  Transfer to serving platter.  Add the basil to the tomato sauce.  Serve sauce with pizzas. Garnish with basil sprigs.

name: HOT CIDER PUNCH
ingredients:
4  c. water
4  c. apple juice
1  c. Kool-Aid (presweetened)
1/4  tsp. cinnamon, ground
1/8  tsp. nutmeg, ground
1/8  tsp. cloves, ground
preparation: Combine 4 cups each water and apple juice in a saucepan.  Add 1 cup Kool-Aid brand presweetened soft drink mix (any red flavor), cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves.  Mix well and bring to a boil.  Serve hot.  Garnish as desired.  Makes 16 servings.  Can keep refrigerated and just heat up a cup as needed.

name: BROCCOLI AND CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  small cauliflower, chopped
1  bunch fresh broccoli, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
1/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. vinegar
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine cauliflower, broccoli, onion and water chestnuts; toss well.  Combine remaining ingredients, mixing well.  Pour over vegetables and let stand in refrigerator overnight.

name: RICE CASSEROLE(Serves 8)
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow rice
1  can Mexican corn
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick oleo
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook rice per package directions.  When done, add oleo, corn with liquid and soup.  Pour into buttered casserole dish.  Bake at 350° about 20 to 25 minutes, uncovered.  Spread cheese over top, return to oven and melt.

name: NEVER FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. shortening
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. vinegar
5 to 6  Tbsp. water
preparation: Cut shortening in flour and salt.  Mix together egg, vinegar and water.  Sprinkle over flour mixture.  Makes 2 small double crust pies or 1 big pie.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
6  to 8 lasagna noodles
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. Italian sausage
1  onion, diced
1 large  jar extra thick Ragu spaghetti sauce
1 small  can sliced mushrooms
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. oregano
1  tsp. basil leaves
1 large  can whole tomatoes, drained and crushed
1  (16 oz.) cottage cheese
1  egg
1  large bag Mozzarella cheese
3/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Boil lasagna noodles in water according to directions on the box and drain.  Cook ground beef, sausage and onion in a large skillet over medium heat until done and drain.  In a large pan, combine Ragu spaghetti sauce, mushrooms, garlic powder, oregano, basil, whole tomatoes, ground beef and sausage.  Heat over low heat.

name: CREAM CHEESE GLAZE
ingredients:
3  tsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. soft butter or margarine
3  oz. cream cheese, cut into 4 sections
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: In food processor (with blade in) combine lemon juice and soft butter or margarine.  Drop through chute the cream cheese, with motor running.  Add powdered sugar and process until smooth. Makes 1 cup.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH CHEESE BARS
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
1/2  c. margarine or butter
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
preparation: Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass dish).  Melt chips and butter; stir in crumbs and nuts.  Press 1/2 crumbs on bottom of pan (13 x 9-inch).  In mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese until thick.  Add milk, vanilla and egg; mix well.  Pour on top of crumbs in pan.  Top with remaining crumbs.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until toothpick comes out clean.

name: ANNA'S FAVORITE KIT KAT BARS
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs, crushed
1  c. margarine
1/3  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. milk
1  box club crackers (i.e. Waverly)
1/2  c. chocolate chips
1/2  c. butterscotch chips
2/3  c. peanut butter
preparation: Place 1 layer of Club crackers in 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Mix first 5 ingredients together and bring to boil and boil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Pour 1/2 of mixture over crackers, cover with another layer of crackers.  Pour the rest of mixture over second layer and cover with another layer club crackers. Melt chips and peanut butter and pour over all.  Cool and cut. Yield depends on sizes cut.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. sirloin steak or fillet of beef
1/4  c. flour
2  Tbsp. salt
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  c. finely chopped onion
1/2  lb. mushrooms, sliced
1 small  clove garlic, minced
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Slice meat in 1/2-inch strips.  Dredge strips in flour, seasoned with salt, then set aside.  Saute onion and mushrooms in 2 tablespoons butter for 5 minutes.  Remove vegetables.  Add 2 tablespoons more butter to skillet and add meat strips.  Brown evenly on all sides.  Return onion and mushrooms.  Add garlic and blend in sour cream.  Mix thoroughly and heat through on moderate heat.  Serve with rice or noodles.  Serves 4.

name: WATERMELON RIND PICKLES
ingredients:
7  lb. watermelon rind
7  c. sugar
2  c. vinegar
1/4  tsp. oil of cloves
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Trim off dark green and pink parts of watermelon rind.  Cut 1-inch or any shape desired.  Soak in lime water (1 tablespoon slacked lime to each quart of water) for 4 hours.  Drain and rinse. Cover with cold water and cook until tender but not soft. Drain. Combine sugar, vinegar, cinnamon and cloves.  Bring to boiling point.  Pour over rind and let stand overnight.

name: FILLED STAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
3  egg yolks
1/3  c. orange juice
4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
preserves or jam for filling
confectioners sugar
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar and vanilla extract.  Beat in egg yolks and orange juice.  Combine flour and salt; mix in 2 cups at a time until dough is soft.  Add flour if needed.  Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate overnight.  Roll out chilled dough to 1/4-inch thickness.  Use a star cutter to cut out shapes.  Use thimble to cut out 5/8-inch centers (these are the top cookies). Gather dough scraps and roll out to 1/4-inch thickness.  Cut out stars and put onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Cool and fill with jam.  Sift confectioners sugar on top.

name: TEXAS BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. oleo
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. strong brewed coffee
1/4  c. cocoa
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Note:	If buttermilk is  not  on  hand,  substitute  2 teaspoons vinegar and 1/2 cup milk.

name: REFRIGERATOR PICKLES
ingredients:
3  qt. sliced cucumbers (do not peel)
2  lb. onions (more or less), sliced in rings
1  green bell pepper, chopped
1  jar pimentos
1/3  c. salt
3  c. sugar
2  c. white vinegar
preparation: Stir together salt, sugar and vinegar until all is dissolved. Combine vinegar mixture with cucumbers, onions, pepper and pimentos.  Put into clean jars and let sit for 24 hours.  Store in refrigerator.

name: RED BEAN CALIENTE
ingredients:
2  lb. pinto beans
2  large onions, diced
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies
1  lb. can tomatoes
1/2  tsp. comino seed
2  tsp. salt
4  cloves garlic or garlic powder
1 (8 oz.)  can taco sauce
preparation: Soak beans overnight in cold water.  Drain and add fresh water to beans.  Bring water level 2 inches above beans; add salt and cook over moderate heat for 1 hour.  Add water as needed.  Combine all other ingredients and add to beans.   Cook over low heat until beans are done.  You can cook all day in a crock-pot.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2  stick butter
8  oz. cream cheese
1  large vanilla instant pudding mix
3 1/2  c. milk
1 1/4  lb. Oreo cookies
12  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Cream together in mixing bowl, powdered sugar, butter and cream cheese.  Add pudding mix, Cool Whip and milk.  Crush cookies in 8 or 8 1/2-inch flower pot.  Layer mixture, cookies, mixture, cookies, etc., ending with cookies on top.  Add flower, plant, gummy worms, etc.  Serve with spade, line pot with colored Saran Wrap.

name: IRENE'S CORN BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. water
2  c. milk
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. salt
2  c. yellow corn meal
preparation: Put water and margarine in a large pot; bring to boil.  Beat eggs and sugar; stir in salt, milk and corn meal.  Add to boiling water; stir and cook until thick.  Pour into 9 x 9-inch baking dish or pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. candied fruit
1  c. each light and dark raisins
1/2  c. dates
1  c. nuts
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/4  c. soft margarine
3  eggs
1/4  c. wine
1/4  c. applesauce
1/2  tsp. almond extract
1/4  tsp. each allspice and cinnamon
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1  c. flour
preparation: Sprinkle 1/2 cup flour over nuts and fruit and set aside.  Mix sugars, margarine and cream.  Add eggs and mix.  Add wine and applesauce and mix.  Add flour and spices.  Mix and then add nuts and fruit.  Bake at 275° for about 1 hour or so.  Grease and flour bread pan.

name: STRAWBERRY JELLO MOLD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
1  c. boiling water
1/2  c. cranberry juice
1/4  c. cold water
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. strawberries, cut up
preparation: Pour boiling water over gelatin; stir until dissolved.  Stir in cranberry juice and cold water.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Shape cream cheese into 18 balls.  Sprinkle sugar on strawberries; stir.  Pour 1/3 cup thickened jello into mold; arrange cheese balls on top.  Spoon strawberries over cream cheese balls.  Pour remaining jello over strawberries.  Chill until firm.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. cubed, cooked chicken or turkey
2  stalks celery, chopped
1/3  c. pecans, chopped
2 to 3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
pepper to taste
preparation: Mix ingredients and chill.  Great served over bed of lettuce or just with crackers.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
12  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix and dip in walnuts.

name: CARAMEL AND CHOCOLATE COOKIE BAR
ingredients:
60  caramels
1  pkg. German chocolate cake mix
1/2  c. evaporated milk
3/4  c. margarine, melted
1  c. chopped nuts
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1  c. chocolate bits
preparation: In a heavy pan combine caramels and 1/2 cup evaporated milk. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until caramels are melted.  Set aside.

name: RICE PILAF
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter, melted
1  can beef consomme
3/4  c. long grain rice
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms or 1/2 lb. fresh
1  tsp. each:  garlic powder, celery salt and onion powder
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
preparation: Melt butter in medium casserole dish.  Mix with remaining ingredients and bake, covered, in a 350° oven for 30 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed.

name: HEARTY OATMEAL
ingredients:
4  c. skim milk
2  c. rolled oats (regular or quick; not instant)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. raisins
2  apples, peeled and chopped
1/4  c. sunflower seeds (optional)
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: In a heavy saucepan, combine the milk, oats, salt, raisins and apples.  Bring the oatmeal to a boil, reduce the heat, cover the pan and simmer the cereal, stirring it often, for about 5 minutes. Add the sunflower seeds and cook the oatmeal for another 5 minutes or until it reaches the desired consistency.  Serve the oatmeal sprinkled with cinnamon-sugar, if desired.  Serves 4.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CRISPY TREATS
ingredients:
1  c. light Karo
1  c. sugar
1  c. peanut butter
6  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Grease a long pan.  On low heat, stir together first 3 ingredients.  Bring to a boil and cook 3 minutes, stirring constantly.  Add cereal and press into pan.  Cut into 2 x 2-inch squares.  Makes 32.

name: CRUNCH BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
6  Tbsp. baking cocoa
1  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (7 oz.)  jar Marshmallow Creme
1  c. creamy or crunchy peanut butter
2  c. (12 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
3  c. rice crispy cereal
preparation: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs.  Stir in cocoa, flour, vanilla and salt.  Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until brownies test done.  Cool.  Spread Marshmallow Creme over cooled brownies.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen or 1 bunch fresh broccoli
4  chicken breasts, cooked and boned
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/2  tsp. paprika
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook and drain broccoli.  Place in bottom of greased, glass baking dish (13 x 9-inch).  Arrange cooked chicken on top.  Mix together soup, mayonnaise, curry powder and lemon juice.   Pour mixture over chicken and broccoli. Top with shredded cheese, bread crumbs and paprika.  Bake 30 minutes or until bubbly.

name: WILLIAMSBURG ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. soda
3/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. butter *
1/4  c. shortening *
3  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  fine chopped nuts
1  Tbsp. grated orange peel
preparation: *Or all softened butter.

name: CHARLIE'S CAESAR SALAD
ingredients:
2  cloves garlic
1  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  glass dry red wine
1  egg
1/2  tsp. anchovy paste
1/3  c. olive oil
1/2  c. boxed seasoned croutons
1  medium size head romaine lettuce
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
preparation: Break garlic into large wooden salad bowl.  Add vinegar and lemon juice; soak for 2 hours.  Drink wine.  Remove garlic from liquid and rub sides of bowl.  Dice half of 1 clove and leave in liquid.  Add egg, olive oil and anchovy paste.  Tear romaine into 1-inch squares.  Toss with croutons; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Yields 4 servings.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CUPS
ingredients:
1 roll  slice and bake peanut butter cookies (15 oz.)
1  bag Reese's miniature peanut butter cups (9 oz.)
preparation: Freeze Reese's peanut butter miniatures for several hours before using.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Slice the cookie dough. Roll into nine 1-inch slices and then quarter each slice for 36 pieces in all.  Spray 3 mini muffin pans with Pam.  Drop one piece into each muffin cup.  Do not pat or mold dough.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

name: BABYSITTER SLOP
ingredients:
1  box macaroni and cheese
1  pkg. hot dogs
1/2  c. melted Velveeta cheese (optional)
preparation: In a large saucepan, prepare macaroni and cheese as directions indicate.  While pasta is boiling, cut up hot dogs and boil along with pasta.  Drain water and put ingredients back into saucepan. Add cheese(s).  Stir well.  Serve hot.  Makes about 5 to 6 (1 cup) servings.  Yum Yum!

name: JAMAICAN JUNGLE BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. flaked coconut
1/2  c. chopped toasted nuts
1  c. quick oats
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. mashed bananas (about 3 medium)
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
2  eggs
preparation: In large bowl, stir together the first 9 ingredients.  In medium bowl, mix bananas, pineapple, oil and eggs.  Add all at once to oat mixture.  Stir just until liquid is absorbed and mixture is thoroughly moistened.  Do not overmix.  Pour into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake in 350°  oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan for 5 minutes.  Loosen edges with a knife, turn out on cooling rack.  Cool completely.   Glaze if desired.  Makes 1 loaf or 2 small  loaves.

name: CORN CHIP PIE
ingredients:
1  large onion, chopped and browned in oil
1 1/2  lb. ground meat, browned
1  pkg. chili seasoning mix
1  can tomatoes
1  can yellow hominy
1  can pinto beans
1  c. crushed corn chips
1  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients and simmer 30 to 45 minutes.  Top with crushed corn chips and grated cheese.  Cook at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until cheese melts.  To make it more spicy, salsa or Mexican cheese may be added.

name: WORRY FREE VEGETABLE
ingredients:
1  onion, peeled and chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  c. tomato juice
3  c. chicken broth
1  c. mushrooms in liquid (canned)
1  medium cabbage, chopped
1  c. chopped mixed vegetables*
1  Tbsp. horseradish
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: *(Celery, carrots, parsnips, green beans, turnip, squash, cauliflower, broccoli.)

name: CRISP CRUSTED BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  (3 to 3 1/4 lb.) frying chicken, cut up
1  egg
1  Tbsp. milk
1  c. instant potatoes
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  c. grated cheese
1/4  c. butter or margarine
celery leaves and thinly sliced celery for garnish
preparation: Wash chicken pieces and pat dry.  Beat eggs and milk in bowl. In another bowl mix potatoes, garlic powder and grated cheese. Roll chicken first in egg mix, then in potato mixture.  Melt butter in shallow baking pan.  Roll coated chicken pieces in butter and place them skin side up in pan.  Bake at 400° for 45 to 50 minutes, or until juices from thighs run clear when pierced with fork. Serve with celery for garnish.

name: CHICKEN SUPREME
ingredients:
1 small  jar chipped beef
6  to 8 chicken breasts (fillets or tenders)
2  cans mushroom soup
8  oz. cream cheese
Worcestershire sauce
pepper
salt
bacon
preparation: Line baking dish with chipped beef.  Roll boneless chicken breasts with slice of bacon.  Mix 2 cans of mushroom soup,  8 ounces cream cheese, 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce, pepper and salt to taste.  Bake at 300° for 3 hours or 325° for 2 1/2 hours.

name: PLANTATION SUPPER
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. milk
1  can cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. corn, drained
8  oz. noodles, cooked
1 1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Brown meat, add onion and cook until tender.  Stir in milk, soup and cream cheese until well blended.  Add remaining ingredients and pour into casserole dish.  Bake at 350 degrees for 30 - 45 minutes.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. whipping cream
5  tsp. unsalted butter
1  lb. or 4 bars German chocolate, melted
white chocolate bark
preparation: Mix together and refrigerate overnight.  Roll in balls.  Dip in bark white chocolate (melted).  Drop onto waxed paper.

name: MARINATED EYE OF ROUND
ingredients:
1/4  c. salad oil
2  Tbsp. lemon pepper seasoning
1/2  c. wine vinegar
1/2  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. Worcestershire sauce
1  (5 lb.) eye of round roast
preparation: Mix together salad oil, lemon pepper, wine vinegar, lemon juice, soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce.  Marinate roast in mixture for 1 to 2 days, turning at least once a day.  Cook, uncovered, with marinade in a Dutch oven at 250° for 3 hours. Refrigerate overnight.  Slice thin and serve with heated marinade. Also good served hot.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  large Cool Whip
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
1  box powdered sugar
1  can evaporated milk
3  boxes strawberries (milk carton)
strawberry glaze (topping)
2  (8 oz.) angel food cakes
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients together.  Tear cake into small pieces and fold in with other ingredients lightly.

name: DIABETIC STRAWBERRY TRIFLE
ingredients:
1  qt. strawberries
1  angel food cake
1 large  box sugar-free vanilla instant pudding
1  carton Cool Whip (light)
preparation: Clean and mash berries.  Tear cake into 1-inch cubes.  Prepare pudding as directed on box.  Line bowl with a layer of cake, berries and pudding.  Continue layering.  Top with Cool Whip.

name: SWISS CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts, halved, skinned and boned
6  slices Swiss cheese
1 (10 1/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. margarine, melted
stuffing mix (chicken flavor)
preparation: Arrange chicken breasts in a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.  Top with cheese slices.  Combine soup and milk. Stir well.  Spoon sauce over chicken.  Sprinkle with stuffing mix. Drizzle butter over crumbs.  Cover and bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: SPECIAL K CANDY
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1/2  c. dark corn syrup
2  c. peanut butter
5  c. Special K cereal
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Bring to boil the first three ingredients.  Then add last three ingredients.  Mix cereal, peanut butter and nuts with sugar and corn syrup.  Roll in balls and place on waxed paper.

name: SQUASH PATTIES
ingredients:
1  beaten egg
4  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. grated raw zucchini squash
preparation: Add enough milk to hold it together. Drop by spoonful into well-greased frying pan.

name: TERRIFIC CHEESE BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1  stick butter
1  medium onion, chopped (1/2 to 3/4 c.)
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz (mild Mexican or plain)
1/2  c. Minute rice
1/2  tsp. salt
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Melt butter with broccoli, onion and salt (no water); let this cook until broccoli has thawed.  Add undiluted soup, rice and Cheez Whiz; mix well.  Spray baking dish with Pam or rub with butter.  Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: FRIED OKRA
ingredients:
4  cups sliced okra
1/2  cup milk
1/4  tsp salt
1/4  tsp pepper
3/4  cup cornmeal
vegetable oil
preparation: Combine okra, milk, and seasonings in a shallow dish; let stand 1 hour or until most of milk is absorbed.  Dredge in cornmeal.  Fry okra in deep hot oil (375 degrees) until golden brown.  Drain.  Serve immediately.  Serves 4.

name: NEVER-FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. unsifted flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. Crisco shortening (solid)
1  egg
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. water
preparation: Mix salt into unsifted flour.  Cut Crisco in flour with a flour blender  or  two  table  knives.  Put egg, vinegar and water in a small	jar  with  a lid and shake well to mix.  Add liquid mixture to	flour,	forming a ball.  Divide into 3 to 4 portions. Shape  each into a round slightly flattened "cake". Dough can be stored in individual bags indefinitely or frozen.

name: INSTANT RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. instant rice
2 1/2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. raisins
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  tsp. vanilla
nutmeg
preparation: Combine all ingredients except eggs, and vanilla.  Bring to boil, stirring constantly.  Reduce heat; boil 15 minutes.  Slowly pour hot mixture into eggs, a little at a time, beating vigorously.  Add vanilla, sprinkle with nutmeg.  Let cool.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
3  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  pt. sour cream
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
6  eggs
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add soda, sour cream and vanilla. Add eggs, 2 at a time with 1 cup flour, beating well after each addition until all the flour and eggs are added.  Bake at 325° for one hour to 1 1/4 hours or until done.

name: GRANDMA'S SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. white sugar
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  c. shortening (Crisco)
1  Tbsp. soda in 1 c. boiling water
7  c. sifted flour
3  eggs
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream sugar and  shortening.  Beat in eggs.  Add alternately dry ingredients,  hot  water  and  soda.  Add  vanilla. Chill in refrigerator  overnight  if possible.  Roll out about 1/4-inch thick and sprinkle with sugar.  Bake at 425° for 5 to 7 minutes (watch that  bottoms  do  not burn).  Store in tight container. Makes 5 to 7 dozen average cookies.

name: HAMBURGER PICNIC BUNDLES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, seasoned with your favorite spices
steak or chili sauce
potatoes, thinly sliced
carrots, thinly sliced
onions, thinly sliced
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Place a well seasoned beef patty in the center of a 10-inch square of aluminum foil.  Top with a teaspoon of steak sauce or chili sauce.  Cover meat with thinly sliced potatoes, carrots and onions.  Season with salt and pepper.  Add 1 tablespoon water. Fold foil loosely around food.  Seal tightly.  Bake at 450° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CRAB CAKES
ingredients:
1  lb. or 2 (6 1/2 oz.) cans crabmeat
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. fine dry bread crumbs
3  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
few sprigs parsley, finely chopped
2  Tbsp. cream
all-purpose flour
preparation: Flake crabmeat if necessary.  Cook chopped onion in 1/4 cup butter until limp.  Add bread crumbs and mix well.  Beat eggs thoroughly and add to crabmeat along with crumb mixture, salt, mustard, chopped parsley and cream.  Shape into 8 flat patties; coat with flour and saute in remaining butter until delicately browned on both sides.  Yields 4 servings.

name: LEMON SUPREME POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines lemon supreme cake mix
1  pkg. (4 serving size) lemon instant pudding
1/2  c. Crisco oil
1  c. water
4  eggs
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Blend all ingredients in a large bowl; beat at medium speed for 2 minutes.  Bake in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan for 45 to 55 minutes.  Cool right side up for about 25 minutes.  Remove from pan.

name: RANCH RICE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  can onion soup
1  can beef consomme
1 (4 to 5 oz.)  can mushrooms
1  c. white rice
preparation: Place all ingredients in a large pan with cover.  Stir, cover and place in a 350° oven for 1 hour.  All ingredients, except margarine, can be increased to create larger recipe.

name: SEAFOOD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. small seashell macaroni
1  medium onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  lb. crabmeat
1/2  lb. shrimp, cleaned and deveined
1/2  pt. oysters
1/2  lb. pork sausage
3/4  c. Cheddar cheese (mild), shredded and divided
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
2 to 3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
seasoned bread crumbs
preparation: Cook  macaroni   according   to  package  instructions. Season with salt, pepper  and  1/4  cup  shredded  cheese; set aside. Saute onion and  pepper  in margarine; add the seafood and cook for 2 to  3 minutes.  Set aside.  Crumble sausage and fry until done; set aside.  Mix Worcestershire sauce, mushroom soup, milk, mayonnaise  and  remaining  cheese.  Combine  this mixture with macaroni  mixture,  seafood  mixture and sausage. Mix well.  Turn into a  greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Sprinkle with the seasoned bread crumbs.  Bake  in a 350° oven about 25 to 30 minutes, until bubbly hot.

name: ANTIPASTO SALAD
ingredients:
6  oz. Mueller's Twist trio (colored pasta twists)
1/8  tsp. crushed dried red pepper
1  tsp. salt
dash of garlic salt
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. grated Parmesan
2  c. broccoli, cooked tender-crisp
4  oz. pepperoni slices, cut in 1/4
10  cherry tomatoes, quartered
1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
preparation: Cook and drain Mueller's Twist trio.  Combine all ingredients with Wish-Bone Robusto Italian dressing.  Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours before serving.

name: CORN FRITTERS(Pancake Style)
ingredients:
1  c. flour, sifted
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
2  c. canned creamed corn (one 16 oz. can)
2  eggs, separated
preparation: In 1676, fifty homes and warehouses were destroyed by fire. Clearly, something better was needed than the Jynk's "engines" and it was voted to buy the very best London had to offer.  America's first practical fire engine, a device for pumping water, operated manually and was put into service on January 27, 1678.  It consisted of a wooden box, about three feet long, eighteen inches wide, standing on four legs with protruding front and rear handles that enabled it to be carried to the fire.  Mounted inside was a pump that fed a flexible, snake-like nozzle.  Water was supplied to the box by the bucket brigade.  Thomas Atkins, Captain of this rig, was appointed America's first paid firefighting officer.  He appointed twelve assistants and together they formed our first paid fire department in America.

name: CHOCOLATE MINT PIE
ingredients:
26  Oreo cookies, crushed
1/3  c. melted margarine
1/2  gal. chocolate mint ice cream, soft
1  (8 oz.) container whipped topping
preparation: Stir crushed cookies and melted margarine together until well blended.  Press into a spring-form pan or a 13 x 9-inch pan; for one hour, freeze.  Spread frozen crust with softened ice cream and freeze for one hour.  Top with layer of whipped topping.  Freeze 24 hours before serving.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. dark corn syrup
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  c. pecans
preparation: Mix together all ingredients  and  pour into 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 400° for 15  minutes;  reduce oven to 350° and bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: BOHEMIAN COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2 1/2  c. flour
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. oil
2  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix  flour,  salt  and	spices.  Cream	sugars, oil and eggs. Add  milk	and  soda.  Add  to  dry  ingredients.	Add vanilla, coconut  and pecans.  Bake in tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: CHILI BURGERS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1 1/4  c. diced celery
1 (14 oz.)  bottle catsup
2  Tbsp. dry mustard
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  medium onion, diced
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1  can tomato paste
1/2  c. water
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. chili powder
8  hamburger buns
preparation: In glass casserole, saute ground beef, onion and celery 6 to 8 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes.  Drain off drippings.  Add vinegar, catsup, tomato sauce, mustard, water, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper and chili powder; stir to blend.  Cook, covered, 8 to 10 minutes.  Heat buns wrapped in terry towel 1 minute.  Spoon mixture on heated buns.

name: GRACIOUS MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  egg
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
2  tsp. pepper
1  c. tomato juice
1  small chopped onion
1 1/2  c. Quaker oats
preparation: Mix all together.  Put in a loaf pan.  Heat oven to 375°. Cook 1 1/2 hours.  Let stand 10 minutes and serve.  Yummy!

name: VANILLA LEMON NUTMEG SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  c. boiling water
4  Tbsp. oleo
2  tsp. vanilla or 2 tsp. lemon juice or 2 tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix first 2 ingredients in saucepan.  Add boiling water; boil 1 minute.  Add rest of ingredients as wanted.  Good on plain cake or gingerbread.

name: PINEAPPLE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
sliced, canned pineapple
maraschino cherry (in each slice of pineapple)
preparation: Arrange fruit on a mixture of melted butter and brown sugar. Make a cake batter of your choice or yellow packaged cake mix and pour over the fruit mixture.  Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.

name: COLD GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
3  cans or 3 lb. potatoes, cooked and sliced
2/3  c. mayonnaise
6  Tbsp. vinegar or to taste
2/3  c. diced celery
6  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. pimiento
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. sugar
8  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
parsley
preparation: Slice potatoes thinly.  Combine mayonnaise, vinegar, salt, dry mustard, sugar and pepper into dressing.  Pour over potatoes, celery, onion and pimiento; mix.  Top with crumbled bacon and parsley; chill well.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. pasta
broccoli
1  cucumber
1  tomato
1  carrot
Italian dressing
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook pasta in salted water, but do not overcook.  Drain and cool.  Add chopped vegetables and dressing.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Refrigerate and serve.

name: WHITE BUTTERMILK CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
2  c. white sugar
3  c. plain flour
5  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. soda
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar and sift flour with dry ingredients, then add (beat in) egg whites.  Add buttermilk and beat well.  Bake in tube pan at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: MUSTARD RELISH
ingredients:
6  c. sugar
13  hot peppers, chopped
2  green peppers, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  qt. yellow mustard
1  qt. white vinegar
1  Tbsp. salt
1 1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Boil the first 7 ingredients.  Mix the water and flour and make a paste (no lumps).  Pour paste mixture into first mixture and bring to a boil, then pour into warm jars and seal.  Makes 6 to 7 pints.

name: BOILED EGG
ingredients:
paper drinking cups
eggs
water
preparation: Place  an  unbroken  egg in a paper drinking cup.  Fill the cup with  water and set it on a bed of coals.  Allow it to boil to your taste.  The cup won't burn.

name: OATMEAL MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. oatmeal
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. berries
1  c. milk
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  egg, beaten
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix dry ingredients in large bowl.  Mix wet ingredients, except berries, in a small bowl.  Add wet to dry ingredients. Stir until moistened.  Lumps should remain.  Fold in berries.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chocolate chips
1/4  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
preparation: In a bowl, mix sugar, flour, baking powder, salt and chocolate chips.  In a 1-cup measuring cup, place oil, eggs and vanilla. Add enough milk to finish filling up the cup.   Add this to dry ingredients.  Pour into muffin pans.  (Sometimes I make them in mini muffin pans and I use mini chips.)  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: DURGIN PORK BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. California pea or navy beans
1/4  lb. bacon/salt pork
4  Tbsp. white sugar
1  c. dark molasses
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  small onion
preparation: Soak beans overnight.  Parboil in the morning with 1/2 teaspoon baking soda 5 minutes.  Run a cup of water through beans in strainer.  Dice bacon or salt pork.  Cut in half.  Place 1/2 in bottom of beanpot with onion.  Add beans and place 1/2 bacon/salt pork on top.  Mix remaining ingredients and pour over beans just until liquid shows.  Do not stir.  Cook at 300° for 6 hours, adding liquid ingredients as needed.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can mixed vegetables
1  can cream of mushroom soup
Tater Tots
preparation: Brown meat and drain well.  In baking dish mix vegetables, soup and meat.  Cook 30 minutes at 350°.  Cover with Tater Tots and brown.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked squash
6  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. grated cheese
2  c. cracker crumbs (saltine crackers)
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped onions
1  c. evaporated milk
preparation: Mix together; sprinkle cracker crumbs on top.  Bake 40 minutes at 375°.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs, beat well
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. oil
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
3  tsp. cinnamon
3  tsp. vanilla
2  c. grated zucchini
1  c. sunflower seeds
preparation: Mix together first 9 ingredients well.  Add zucchini and sunflower seeds.  Mix well again.  Pour mixture into well-greased and floured pans.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.  Makes 2.

name: SUGAR-FREE COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
2  c. crushed pretzels
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  sticks margarine
preparation: Mix together and spread in Pyrex dish and cook until brown; let cool.

name: HARVEST HOME CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion
1  green pepper
2  cans Campbell's baked beans
1  can Del Monte creamed corn
1  stick butter
preparation: Brown beef, onion and pepper in frying pan until cooked through.  In saucepan combine beans, corn and butter.  When beef mixture is done, drain and add to beans and corn.  Cook everything on low heat about 1 hour for full flavor.

name: NO COOK FONDANT
ingredients:
1/3  c. soft butter or margarine
1/3  c. Karo syrup (red label)
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  lb. confectioners sugar
preparation: Blend butter, syrup, salt and vanilla in large mixing bowl. Add sugar, all at once.  Mix together.  Knead with hands.  Turn onto board and continue kneading until well blended and smooth. Store in dry place.

name: CORNBREAD SAUSAGE STUFFING
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced (about 4 c.)
1  c. chopped celery
3/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. margarine or butter
4  tsp. Wyler's chicken flavor instant bouillon or 4 chicken flavor bouillon cubes
1 2/3  c. water
1  lb. bulk sausage, browned and drained
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. cornbread stuffing mix
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
preparation: In a large skillet, cook mushrooms, celery and onion in margarine until tender.  Add water and bouillon; cook until bouillon dissolves.  In a large bowl, combine mushroom mixture and remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Loosely stuff turkey just before roasting, if desired.  Place remaining stuffing in a greased baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until hot.  Refrigerate leftovers.  Makes about 3 quarts.

name: CARAMEL-PECAN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  cups flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  stick butter, softened
3/4  cup sugar
1/2  cup brown sugar
1  egg
1/4  cup half-and-half
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  cup chopped, toasted pecans
8  oz. Rolo candies
preparation: Combine four and baking soda;  set aside.  Beat together butter, sugar and brown sugar;  mix in egg, half & half and vanilla.  Beat in flour mixture, then stir in pecans and Rolo candies, cut in half.  Drop dough by tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart onto baking sheets and bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes.  Cool on racks.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: APPLE DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. almond brickle chips
preparation: Combine cream cheese and brown sugar, mixing well.  Let stand 15 minutes.  Stir in sugar, vanilla and almond brickle chips. Cover and chill up to 8 hours.  Serve with apple or pear wedges. Yields 2 1/2 cups of dip.

name: ULTIMATE CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. Crisco
1 1/4  c. packed brown sugar
2  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  egg
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream the Crisco, brown sugar, milk and vanilla. Blend in egg. Combine flour, salt and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture gradually. Stir in chips. Bake at 375°.

name: CAJUN SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. olive oil
3  stalks celery, chopped
3  cloves garlic, minced
1  large onion, diced
1  large bell pepper, diced
1 (14 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. dried basil leaves
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
3/4  tsp. salt
1  lb. medium shrimp, shelled and deveined
cooked rice
preparation: In large, deep	fry  pan  over medium heat, melt butter and oil.  Add  celery, garlic, onion and bell pepper.  Saute 4 minutes, until  vegetables	begin to soften.  Add stewed tomatoes and tomato	sauce.	Mix well.  Add basil, pepper, cayenne pepper and salt.  Mix  well.  Over medium-high heat, simmer 10 minutes. Add shrimp.  Simmer  5  to	8 minutes, stirring frequently, until shrimp  are pink and cooked thoroughly.  Serve over white or brown rice.

name: PEANUT BUTTER SQUARES
ingredients:
1  egg, well beaten
1  lb. box powdered sugar (a little less)
1 1/4  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt peanut butter and butter together.  Beat egg well and add sugar and mix until smooth.  Add vanilla.  Add egg mixture to peanut butter and beat well.  Stir in nuts.  Press in buttered 8 x 8-inch pan or dish.

name: CREAMY TUNA AND NOODLES
ingredients:
8  oz. noodles
6  Tbsp. margarine
3/4  c. chopped onion
6  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
3  c. milk
2  c. shredded American cheese (8 oz.)
1  c. cooked peas
1  c. (7 oz.) tuna or salmon, drained and flaked
1/2  c. chopped pimiento
preparation: Cook noodles according to package.  In a large saucepan, melt butter and cook onion until tender. Stir in flour and salt blended with milk.  Bring to the boiling point, then simmer, stirring constantly, until sauce is thickened, about 5 minutes.  Stir in cheese, peas, tuna, pimiento and noodles.  Heat through, but do not boil.  Makes about 4 servings.

name: CHEDDAR CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1  c. milk, divided
1/2  c. chopped onions
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. shredded carrots
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
3  c. cubed, cooked chicken
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  c. buttermilk complete pancake mix
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. sliced almonds
preparation: In a large saucepan, combine undiluted soup, 1/2 cup milk, onion, softened cream cheese, celery, carrots, Parmesan cheese and salt.  Cook and stir until mixture is hot and cream cheese is melted.  Stir in precooked chicken and broccoli that has been cooked and drained.  Heat through.  Pour into an ungreased 2-quart baking dish.

name: CHICKEN CURRY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. cooked chicken, chopped fine
3/4  c. toasted chopped almonds
1/3  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. chutney
1  Tbsp. curry powder
preparation: Combine all ingredients; cover with Saran Wrap and chill at least 2 hours.  Shape into ball and coat with parsley.  Serve with crackers.

name: MARINATED GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
2  cans whole green beans
1  bottle (small) Zesty Italian dressing
bacon
preparation: Drain green beans (whole). Pour Zesty Italian dressing over beans. Marinate overnight. Next day, drain and put 4 or 5 beans in a bundle. Wrap with bacon and bake in oven at 425° until bacon is done.

name: MAPLE COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, well beaten
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. maple syrup
1  Tbsp. butter, melted
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. coconut
preparation: Beat eggs slightly with sugar.  Add vanilla and salt.  Mix well.  Pour in syrup and melted butter.  Blend thoroughly.  Spread coconut in 9-inch pie shell (unbaked).  Bake at 425° for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to 350°.  Bake until pie puffs in the middle and a silver knife inserted in the center comes out clean.  Yields 8 servings.

name: FROSTY CHOCOLATE-CHERRY YOGURT
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cartons (3 1/2 c.) vanilla yogurt
2 1/2  c. fresh dark sweet cherries, pitted or frozen unsweetened pitted dark sweet cherries (13 oz.)
1/3  c. milk
1/3  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. miniature semi-sweet chocolate pieces
preparation: In a blender container or food processor bowl, combine yogurt, 1 cup cherries, milk and corn syrup.  Cover and blend or process until almost smooth.  Freeze mixture in a 2 quart ice cream maker or put in a bowl and freeze in your freezer until almost firm. Add remaining cherries and chocolate pieces; continue to freeze until firm.  Yields 6 cups.

name: CHEWY FUDGE SQUARES
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines Butter Recipe Fudge cake mix
2  eggs
1/2  c. (1 stick) melted butter
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. coarsely chopped walnuts
preparation: Grease  9  x  13-inch pan.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Stir together  cake mix, eggs and butter in bowl until well blended (mixture  will  be  stiff).  Stir in marshmallows and walnuts. Spread mixture  in pan.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until set in center.  Cool and cut in squares.  Makes 2 dozen.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH RUM FUDGE
ingredients:
1  c. golden raisins
1/4  c. light rum
2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. evaporated milk
1 (7 oz.)  jar marshmallow cream
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch morsels
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1  tsp. rum extract
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Combine raisins and rum in a small bowl; cover and let stand 8 hours.  Combine brown sugar and next 3 ingredients in a 3-quart saucepan.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, to soft ball stage (238°).  Remove from heat; stir in marshmallow cream and butterscotch morsels.  Add reserved raisin mixture and remaining ingredients; stir well.  Spread mixture into a buttered 8-inch square pan.  Cool and cut into squares.  Store candy in airtight container.  Yields 3 1/2 pounds.

name: BLACK WALNUT POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
4  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. Crisco oil
8  oz. sour cream
1  c. chopped black walnuts
1  tsp. black walnut flavoring
preparation: Mix ingredients; put in tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Do not overcook.

name: CRABMEAT STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  c. breadcrumbs
1 1/2  sticks butter
1  can crabmeat
lemon juice
garlic powder
sauteed minced onions and pepper
1 large  pkg. large sized mushrooms
preparation: Saute finely minced onions and pepper in a little butter.  Mix remaining ingredients together, except mushrooms.  Mix well. Remove stems from mushrooms and wash mushroom caps.  Stuff the mushrooms with the mixture.  Place in a baking dish with 2 tablespoons of water.  Bake in a 350° oven for about 20 minutes. Sprinkle with ___, if desired.  Serve hot.

name: COOKIE JAR GINGERSNAPS
ingredients:
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. ginger
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. molasses
granulated sugar (to roll balls in)
preparation: Measure sifted flour, ginger, soda, cinnamon and salt into sifter.  Sift 2 or 3 times.  Cream shortening in medium size bowl. Add sugar gradually, creaming well.  Beat in eggs and molasses. Add dry ingredients, mixing well.  Form teaspoons of dough into balls.  Roll balls in sugar, covering entire surface.  Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until tops are lightly browned.  Remove from pans. Cool completely.  Store in airtight container.

name: HAMBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  can golden mushroom soup
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  egg, slightly beaten
bacon bits
1/4  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  c. mashed potatoes
1/2  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Mix 1/2 cup soup, raw hamburger, onion, egg, bread crumbs, salt and pepper.  Press into pie plate.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Cream potatoes and place on top of meat.  Top with remaining soup and cheese.  Sprinkle top with real bacon bits. Bake 10 minutes.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can creamed corn
1  stick butter
1  pkg. Jiffy cornbread mix
1  egg
8  oz. sour cream
preparation: Combine all ingredients in 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake at 350° for one hour.

name: HAMBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  chopped green pepper
1  chopped onion
1  can green beans, drained
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. garlic salt
2  tubes crescent rolls
1  chunk Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  chunk Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
preparation: Brown hamburger and drain. Add chopped onion and green pepper. Simmer 15 minutes and drain again.  Add tomato sauce and garlic salt. Simmer 15 minutes.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash browns or 2 lb. potatoes, sliced thin
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/2  pt. sour cream (8 oz. carton)
1  can mushroom soup
1  stick margarine
1/4  c. chopped onion
preparation: Melt margarine, then saute onion until clear.  Grate cheese and mix everything together except potatoes.  When ready to bake, add potatoes and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serve while warm.

name: HERBED TOAST
ingredients:
16 thin  slices white bread (Pepperidge Farm)
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. savory
1/2  tsp. fennel seed, crushed
preparation: About 20 minutes before serving or early in day:  With knife, cut off crusts from bread slices.  (Reserve crusts for making bread crumbs for another day.)  Arrange bread slices on cookie sheets.  Preheat oven to 400°.  In small saucepan over medium heat, heat butter or margarine, savory and fennel seed until butter melts.  Brush bread slices with butter mixture; bake 15 minutes or until golden on both sides, turning bread slices once. Makes 8 servings.

name: EASY, EASY, EASY COOKIES
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix (use devil's food mix for chocolate cookies)
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Remove to rack to cool. I divide the batter and put pecans and pecan flavoring, coconut and coconut flavoring, orange or lemon flavoring, chocolate chips, peanut butter and butterscotch chips.  I use a teaspoonful of dough and flatten with a fork.  These are so easy to make.

name: ALLISON'S GOULASH
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion
1 small  jar mushrooms
5  oz. macaroni
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  can pinto beans
2  cans diced tomatoes
preparation: Brown the ground beef; cut up the onion and add to ground beef.  Add the 2 cans of tomatoes; add the jar of mushrooms.  Add the macaroni and cook this mixture until macaroni is done.  Add garlic salt, corn and beans.  Simmer for about 15 minutes.

name: APPLESAUCE MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2/3  c. applesauce
3/4  c. crumbled cornflakes
1  egg
1  small onion, chopped
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix and shape into balls.  Mix 1/2 cup catsup and 1/2 cup water together; pour over meatballs.  Bake at 325° for 30 minutes and then turn oven temperature to 350°.  Bake 30 minutes longer.

name: SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
cooked hamburger or canned meat or chicken
1  pkg. frozen carrots and peas
2  cans Campbell's soup (cream of mushroom, celery or chicken, etc., undiluted)
mashed potatoes or hash browns
preparation: Put meat into bottom of pan.  Put vegetables on top of meat. Add soup over top.  Top with mashed potatoes or hash browns. Place in a 400° oven until it bubbles.

name: QUICK BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  cut up fryer
1/2  stick margarine
1  envelope onion and mushroom mix
3  Tbsp. A.1. sauce
preparation: Place fryer in baking dish.  Brush with margarine and A.1. sauce.  Sprinkle soup mix over chicken.  Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.  Uncover the last few minutes of baking time.

name: SUMMER PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. milk
1 1/2  c. cubed ham
1  c. shell macaroni, cooked and drained
1  c. chopped tomato
1  c. green pepper chunks
1/4  c. chopped onions
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine mayonnaise, cheese and milk; mix well.  Add all remaining ingredients and mix lightly.  Chill several hours or overnight.  Serves 4.

name: SPINACH BALLS
ingredients:
2  boxes frozen leaf spinach, cooked, drained and squeezed dry
2  c. Pepperidge Farm seasoned crumbs
6  eggs
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. oleo, melted
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Shape into balls. Place on cookie sheet and freeze.  Put in plastic bag after frozen.  When ready to serve, heat in a 350° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.  May cover with aluminum foil in oven to prevent drying out.

name: COCONUT-PECAN FROSTING
ingredients:
1  c. evaporated milk
1  c. sugar
3  egg yolks, slightly beaten
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/3  c. Baker's Angel Flake coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine milk, sugar, egg yolks, butter and vanilla in saucepan.  Cook on medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened (about 12 minutes).  Add coconut and pecans.  Cook until thick enough to spread, stirring occasionally.  Makes 2 1/2 cups.

name: BROCCOLI, CHICKEN AND CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 bag or  bunch broccoli
1  lb. deboned chicken
1  bunch green onions
1  c. milk
1  large white onion, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1  stick butter
1  c. shredded Cheddar
1  c. shredded Mozzarella
1  small bell pepper, chopped
1  c. chopped celery
preparation: Cook broccoli until done.  Saute pepper, onions and celery in butter; simmer until tender.  Mix broccoli, cooked, deboned chicken, vegetables, salt and milk.  Mix well.

name: DON'S PEANUT BUTTER CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
3  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix and cream the butter, sugar and eggs.  Add flour, baking powder, salt and milk.  Mix well.  Pour into 3 greased and floured cake pans.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
1  c. milk
2  eggs
1  c. cream-style corn
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. bacon drippings
1/2  lb. ground meat
1  large onion, chopped
1/2  lb. grated cheese
3  jalapeno peppers, chopped
preparation: Brown meat; drain, then cool.  Combine all ingredients except meat and mix well.  Have a large (10 to 12-inch) cast-iron skillet hot in a 350° oven with a small amount of grease in bottom of skillet so the cornbread won't stick.  Pour 1/4 batter mixture into skillet, then add 1/2 meat.  Repeat so batter mix is on top. Cook 1 hour at 350°.

name: EGG NOODLES
ingredients:
2  egg yolks, beaten
1  tsp. softened lard
2  Tbsp. cream
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
flour
preparation: Add lard, cream, salt and baking powder to egg yolks and mix well.  Add enough sifted flour to make a soft, non-sticky dough that will roll thin, about the consistency of pie dough.  These can be cooked immediately.  Can also be made ahead of time.  Be sure they have plenty of flour on them to keep them from sticking together.

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. crushed pretzels
3  Tbsp. sugar
3/4  c. margarine, melted
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  c. sugar
2  c. Cool Whip
1  pkg. strawberry Jell-O (6 oz.)
1  carton frozen strawberries (small)
2  c. boiling water
preparation: Mix together first 3 ingredients and press into 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Bake at 400° for 6 minutes.  Don't burn.  Cool.

name: CINNAMON ACORN SQUASH RINGS
ingredients:
2  medium acorn squash, seeded and sliced in 1/2-inch rings
dash of pepper
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  c. brown sugar
4  Tbsp. melted margarine
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Place squash in an ungreased jelly roll pan.  Sprinkle remaining ingredients on top.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until tender and well browned.  Serves 6 at 124 calories each serving.

name: DREAMSICLE CAKE
ingredients:
orange cake mix
1  tsp. orange flavoring
1  small container Cool Whip
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Bake the orange cake as directed on box, adding the orange flavoring.  Bake in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.  Cool. Mix together the Cool Whip, cream cheese and powdered sugar.  Mix well.  Split cake and spread filling between the layers.  Keep refrigerated.

name: CHEESE 'N SAUSAGE PIE
ingredients:
2  (9-inch) pie shells
1  lb. bulk sausage
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/3  c. chopped bell pepper
4  eggs
2  tsp. parsley
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Bake pie shells until lightly brown, about 7 minutes.  Remove and set aside.  Reduce oven temperature to 350°.  In a skillet, brown sausage until done.  Remove and drain on paper towel.  Reserve 2 tablespoons fat.  Saute onions and bell pepper until crisp-tender, about 2 minutes.  Stir sausage into mixture.  Divide sausage mixture between the pie shells. Sprinkle cheese on top.  In bowl, beat eggs until blended; add remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Pour over cheese.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.  Cool 5 minutes.  Slice and serve with tossed salad.

name: JOYCE'S BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  qt. Open Pit barbecue sauce (hickory smoked)
1  c. packed light brown sugar
1  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. red pepper sauce (Tabasco sauce)
1/4  c. prepared mustard (hot or mild)
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. white or black pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan over low heat.  Heat to boil.  Remove from heat and let stand at room temperature until cool.  Store, covered, in refrigerator.  Use over ribs, pork chops or chicken.  Makes 7 cups.

name: STRAWBERRY SQUARES
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. oatmeal
3  c. flour
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
3  sticks margarine
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. strawberry jam
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients (except jam).  Set 1/2 of mixture aside to be used as topping.  Press remaining mix into the bottom of an 11 3/4 x 7-inch pan.  Bake for 15 minutes. Remove pan and spread jam into pan.  Take remaining mixture and crumble over jam.  Put in oven for another 15 to 20 minutes (bar should be brown and jam will be bubbly) or until it looks done.

name: CHRISTMAS RIBBON SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cherry jello
2 (3oz.)  pkg. lime jello
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon jello
1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. pineapple juice
1 large  pkg. cream cheese (room temperature)
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. whipped cream
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: This 3 layer salad looks pretty in a glass dish.  Prepare the 2 packages of lime jello according to directions on box.  Cool until almost set.  Dissolve the lemon jello in 1 cup boiling water.  Add cut up marshmallows.  Stir until melted.  Add 1 cup pineapple juice and 1 package cream cheese.  Beat until well blended.  Stir in 1 cup pineapple.  Cool slightly.  Fold in whipped cream and 1 cup mayonnaise.  Chill until thickened.  Pour over lime jello.  Make cherry jello according to package directions.  Chill until syrupy and pour over pineapple layer.  Chill until firm.  Takes a 9 x 15 x 1 1/2-inch pan.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1 small  jar taco sauce
1  can chili hot kidney beans
1 medium  bottle Catalina dressing
large bag Doritos
8  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  head lettuce, broken up
preparation: Brown and drain hamburger.  Add taco seasoning and taco sauce to hamburger.  Simmer.  Then add beans and simmer until juice evaporates.  Fill large bowl with lettuce and Doritos (slightly crushed).  Pour on dressing.  Put meat mixture on and top with cheese.  Serve immediately.

name: BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2 large  Tbsp. flour
1 heaping  Tbsp. real butter
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream the sugar, flour and butter until it is in small lumps. Add milk and vanilla.  Pour into an unbaked pie shell and bake until it gets crusty on top and kind of brown.

name: LEMON CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker crust (9-inch)
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant lemon pudding
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. milk
preparation: Beat milk, pudding mix and cream cheese together until well blended.  Pour into pie shell.  Sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs.

name: RED BEANS AND RICE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. dry kidney beans, rinsed
1/2  lb. dry pinto beans, rinsed
4  c. water
4  c. chicken broth
2  garlic cloves, minced
2  bay leaves
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can tomatoes with liquid, chopped
1 (4 oz.)  jar chopped pimento, drained
1  large green pepper, chopped
1  large sweet red pepper, chopped
1  c. celery, chopped
1  large onion, chopped
1 (4 oz.)  can diced green chilies
1/4  c. snipped, fresh parsley
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. hot pepper flakes
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. ground cumin
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. hot pepper sauce
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. vinegar
hot, cooked rice
preparation: Place beans in a Dutch oven with water.  Bring to a boil; simmer 2 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Cover and let stand 1 hour. Drain and rinse beans.  Return to Dutch oven with broth, garlic and bay leaves.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 1/4 hours.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Cover and simmer 1 hour or until beans and vegetables are tender and gravy is thick.  Remove bay leaves.  Serve over rice.  Makes 12 servings.

name: CHICKEN CURRY
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped green onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. oil
1/3  c. flour
2  c. chicken broth
1/2  tsp. thyme
1  Tbsp. parsley
1  c. tomato juice
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. curry powder
salt and pepper to taste
1  clove garlic
4  c. diced, cooked chicken
preparation: Brown onions and celery in oil.  Blend in flour and broth. Cook, stirring until thickened.  Add juice and all seasonings. Add chicken and heat through.  Serve over rice.  Serves 6.

name: JANET'S CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. sifted flour
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. oil
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. water
1/2  c. sour milk
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt margarine and shortening.  Stir in cocoa and water; bring to a boil.  Stir flour and sugar together.  Add rest of ingredients; mix well.  Pour into greased 15 1/2 x 10-inch jelly roll pan.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 18 minutes.

name: INDIANA FARM BREAKFAST SAUSAGE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground pork
1/2  c. chopped onions (white)
2  tsp. parsley flakes
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. rubbed sage
1  tsp. dried basil (optional)
1  tsp. dried marjoram (optional)
1  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. red pepper
1/4  tsp. dried thyme (optional)
preparation: If possible have pork at room temperature before starting.  Mix all spices together.  Mix spices with onions and pork.  Knead all ingredients into pork thoroughly.  Make patties and store in refrigerator overnight.  Next morning, heat skillet and cook until done.

name: CRANBERRY CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  bottle Russian salad dressing
1  envelope dry onion soup mix
1  can whole cranberry sauce
6  to 8 chicken breasts (boneless)
preparation: Mix dressing, onion soup mix and cranberry sauce together. Place chicken in ovenproof pan and pour mixture over chicken. Bake for 30 minutes or until chicken is tender.

name: SOUPER TUNA CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  can Chinese noodles
1  can Campbell's cream of mushroom soup
3/4  c. water
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can Chicken of the Sea tuna, drained and broken in chunks
1  c. cashews or peanuts
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1/2  c. cooked peas
soy sauce
preparation: Reserve 1/2 cup Chinese noodles.  In 1 1/2-quart casserole, combine remaining noodles, soup, water, tuna, cashews, celery, onion and peas.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until hot.  Stir; sprinkle reserved noodles around edge.  Bake 5 minutes more. Serve with soy sauce.  Makes about 4 1/2 cups.

name: SALSA VERDE
ingredients:
2  lb. jalapeno peppers
1/2  lb. Serrano peppers
2  large onions
5  lb. green tomatoes
2  lb. tomatillos
1  clove garlic
2  bunches green onions
8  oz. vinegar
3  oz. vegetable oil
preparation: Grind all ingredients, except oil and vinegar, in a meat grinder; mix well.  Add oil and vinegar; mix well.  Pour into gallon jugs.  Refrigerate for 3 days before serving.  Very hot.

name: ICE CREAM
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  can condensed milk
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  qt. half and half
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
milk
preparation: Mix everything but milk together and pour into ice cream freezer and fill to fill line with milk and freeze.

name: PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. light corn syrup
1  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. raw peanuts
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: In heavy saucepan, combine sugar, corn syrup and water.  Cook until sugar dissolves; stir constantly.  Add salt and peanuts; cook until hard crack stage, stirring occasionally.  Add butter, vanilla and soda; mix well.  Pour onto 2 buttered baking sheets. While warm, pull out to desired thickness.  When cool, crack into pieces.  Makes about 2 pounds.

name: SWEET AND SOUR MEATBALL SAUCE
ingredients:
1 large  can tomatoes
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  medium onion
10  gingersnaps
preparation: Blend all the ingredients in blender. Make your favorite meatballs.  Brown in skillet.  Pour sauce over them.  Bake in oven at 350°  for 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN(Sweet and Sour)
ingredients:
1  chicken, cut up
1 small  jar apricot or peach preserves
1  bottle French dressing
1  envelope dry onion soup mix
preparation: Mix preserves, dressing and soup mix together.  Arrange chicken in baking pan and top with mixture.  Cook in 350° oven for one hour and fifteen minutes.  Serve with rice.

name: QUICK PEANUT BUTTER BARS
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1/4  c. butter
1  c. peanut butter
2  eggs
1/3  c. water
1  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Spread on greased and floured cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° until golden.

name: CHERRY CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. flour
1  c. oats, raw
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
pinch of salt
2  cans cherry pie filling
preparation: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  In bowl, mix dry ingredients with wooden spoon and add melted margarine.   The mixture will be a little lumpy.  Put 1/2 mixture in pan.  Add cherry pie filling, then rest of mixture; spread evenly.  Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
2 small  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1  tsp. onion, minced
preparation: Grate cheese and mix together.  Add just enough mayo to stick together.  Add Tabasco sauce and onion.  Put in refrigerator until it hardens slightly.  Remove and shape into ball and roll in parsley or chives.

name: SCRULL
ingredients:
1  c. melted butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
6  beaten eggs
1/2  c. water
1/2  tsp. vanilla
speck of salt
1 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Add sugar to melted butter.  Add remaining ingredients and mix all together.  Put 1 teaspoon on Scrull iron.  Take off and roll in cone shape.

name: TOASTY PEACH CRISP
ingredients:
2 (No. 2 1/2)  cans peaches
1  c. oats
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. melted oleo
1/3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Put peaches with juice in 9 x 9-inch baking pan.  Mix remaining ingredients until crumbly; sprinkle over peaches.   Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.  Serve with whipped topping.

name: DAD'S BARBECUE MARINADE(Good on chicken, pork, steak and beef.)
ingredients:
1/2  c. peanut oil
1/4  c. Hoisin sauce
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. rice vinegar or distilled white vinegar
1/4  c. dry sherry
1/2  tsp. hot chili oil (optional)
dash of dark sesame oil (optional)
2  whole scallions, minced
2  garlic cloves, minced
2  Tbsp. ginger
preparation: Combine all ingredients and marinate with either chicken, pork, steak or beef overnight.

name: BROCCOLI HOT DISH
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. frozen Tater Tots
1  pkg. frozen broccoli or any frozen vegetables
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  cans milk
1 large  pkg. Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
preparation: Brown hamburger; put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Add Tater Tots, followed by frozen vegetables.  Mix soup, milk and garlic powder.  Pour over vegetables.  Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over soup. May top with a can of French fried onions, if desired.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or more until vegetables are soft.

name: GOULASH
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
1  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
2  c. uncooked macaroni
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. sugar
salt and pepper to taste
1  (20 oz.) canned tomatoes
preparation: Brown hamburger meat, onion and green pepper until well done. Add tomatoes and seasonings and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.  Cook macaroni as directed on package and add to meat mixture.

name: EVERYDAY DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  cake compressed yeast
1  Tbsp. lukewarm water
3 1/2  c. sifted flour
preparation: Scald milk.  Add the shortening, salt and sugar; allow to cool to lukewarm.  Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water; add to mixture. Add the flour to the liquid gradually, mixing well after each addition until a soft dough is formed.  Cover the bowl tightly, set in warm place, and allow to rise until double in bulk.  Turn onto a floured board; knead until the dough can be easily handled and mold into rolls.  Place in a well-greased pan; let rise again until double in bulk.  Bake in a hot oven (375°) for about 20 minutes or until golden brown.

name: EASY CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine, melted
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 small  can Pet milk
2 1/2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt margarine; mix all other ingredients together with margarine. Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake for 40 minutes at 325°.

name: LAYERED LETTUCE SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1/2  c. chopped green peppers
2  c. chopped celery
1/4 to 1/2  c. sliced onions
1  c. frozen peas, uncooked
2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. sugar
4  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
6 to 8  slices bacon, fried and crumbled
preparation: Layer lettuce, green peppers, celery, onions and peas.  Spread with mayonnaise and sprinkle with sugar.  Top with the Cheddar cheese and then crumble the bacon on top.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.

name: STUFF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef (lean)
potatoes, small chunks
carrots, sliced
onion, chopped
green pepper, diced
peas (optional)
cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
Velveeta cheese slices
preparation: In large skillet, layer the ingredients in order given.  Cover and simmer on low for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Do not stir.

name: CRAN-RASPBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry jello
1 3/4  c. boiling water
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (16 oz.)  can whole cranberry sauce
1  c. sour cream
preparation: In bowl dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add undrained pineapple and cranberry sauce, stirring until cranberry sauce melts.  Chill until partially set by placing bowl into a larger bowl of ice water or chill in refrigerator.  Pour half of mixture into a 6 1/2-cup ring mold.  Chill until firm.  Let the remaining gelatin mixture stand at room temperature.

name: NACHO CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
2  cans Armour chili
1  lb. Velveeta Mexican cheese
preparation: Put all ingredients in crock-pot long enough for cheese to melt and to get hot.

name: CHOPPED APPLE PIE(Makes 2)
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  stick melted butter
2  eggs
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
4  c. chopped apples
preparation: Cream first 7 ingredients.  Stir in apples.  Pour into 2 (9-inch) pie shells.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.  Reduce heat to 350° for 30 minutes.

name: PEOPLE CHOW
ingredients:
1  box Golden Graham cereal
2  c. broken pretzel sticks
1  c. Spanish peanuts
2 (12 oz.)  pkg. white chocolate chips
preparation: Combine cereal, pretzels and peanuts.  Melt chocolate chips; pour over cereal mixture.  Toss to coat.  Spread in a greased cookie sheet.  Let cool.  Break into pieces.

name: CHICKEN MANICOTTI (HEALTHMARK)
ingredients:
6  oz. can tomato juice
1  clove garlic, minced
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. marjoram
1/4  tsp. sweet basil
2  whole large chicken breasts (skinless and boneless)
4  oz. low-fat cottage cheese
2  oz. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
ground pepper
preparation: In 1-quart saucepan over medium heat, bring tomato juice, garlic, 3/4 of the combined seasonings and pepper to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer mixture 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  On cutting board, pound chicken pieces to about 1/4-inch thickness; set aside.

name: CHEESE SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  lb. can tomatoes
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/2  stick butter
1  lb. box spaghetti
preparation: Put tomatoes (cut up) in pot.  Bring to boil, turn down, let simmer 5 minutes.  At same time put water on for spaghetti.  When you add spaghetti to water, add cheese (cut up in chunks) to tomatoes.  Keep stirring cheese until all melted.   Drain spaghetti when done, add tomatoe/cheese sauce (put in bowl to combine).  Brown butter and pour over spaghetti.  Mix together. Let sit for 5 minutes.  Enjoy!

name: Lemon Cake Pie
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
juice and grated rind of 1 lemon
2  egg yolks
3  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
2  egg whites, stiffly beaten
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Cream sugar and butter; add lemon juice and rind.  Beat in egg yolks and flour; mix well.  Add milk gradually; beat until well blended.  Fold in beaten egg whites.  Pour into pie shell and bake at 350° until center of pie is firm, about 30 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

name: FORGOTTEN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  egg whites
1/8  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
2/3  c. sugar
chopped nuts (optional) or mini chocolate chips (optional)
preparation: Heat oven to 350° while preparing cookie dough.  Beat egg whites until very, very stiff.  Gradually add salt, cream of tartar and sugar.  When egg whites are like satin, fold in nuts or chips. Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheets.  Put cookies in oven and immediately turn oven off; leave cookies in oven overnight.  Do not open oven.

name: STUFFED ITALIAN BREAD
ingredients:
1  loaf Italian bread, cut lengthwise
1  onion, chopped
1  can mushrooms
1  stick butter, melted
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cover  bread  with  onion  and mushrooms.  Melt butter. Pour over  onion  and  mushrooms.  Cover  with  cheese.	Wrap tightly in foil.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges
1 1/2  c. seedless grapes
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. flaked coconut
3/4  c. dairy sour cream or vanilla yogurt
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Stir all ingredients together.  Chill.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising corn meal
3/4  c. Crisco oil
2  eggs
8  oz. sour cream
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. cream-style corn
preparation: Mix and pour in preheated oiled skillet.  Bak at 350° for 35 minutes.  Let cool 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

name: ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3 (10 oz.)  cans asparagus pieces
1 1/2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  c. cracker crumbs
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
3/4  c. pecan pieces
preparation: Butter bottom of casserole.  Make a layer of crumbs, asparagus, nuts, soup and cheese.  Repeat.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: MRS. EDITH'S FESTIVE CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  chicken
3  celery stems
4  large sweet pickles
2  or 3 boiled eggs
1 small  jar diced pimento, drained
1/3  to 1/2 stuffed olives
1 medium  can pineapple tidbits, drained
2  or 3 dashes garlic powder
2  or 3 dashes Accent
Miracle Whip salad dressing
salt
preparation: Boil chicken until tender.  Cool in broth.  Remove chicken from bones and cut into small chunks.  Cut celery, pickles and eggs into very small pieces.  Slice stuffed olives.  Mash pimento into smaller pieces, using a fork.  Combine all ingredients.  Add garlic powder and Accent.  Use enough Miracle Whip to moisten, usually 2 or 3 heaping tablespoonfuls.  Salt to taste.

name: MOIST PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
2/3  c. chopped pecans
2/3  c. shortening
2 3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
4  large eggs
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ground cloves
2/3  c. raisins
preparation: Beat shortening and sugar together.  Add eggs, beating well. Add pumpkin and rest of the ingredients.  Spoon into loaf pan that has been greased and floured.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.  Cool 10 minutes and remove from pan.

name: MOLDED CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
1  lb. cottage cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  small onion, diced
little diced celery
preparation: Pour boiling water over jello.  Let cool and add remaining ingredients.  Chill until firm.

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
3 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
3  c. hot water
1 1/2  c. cold liquid, pineapple juice and water
1/16  tsp. salt
3  tsp. real lemon
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. and 1 (10 oz.) pkg. halved frozen strawberries minus 1/2 c. of the juice (mix together)
1 1/2  pkg. Dream Whip or Cool Whip
preparation: Mix all ingredients except Dream Whip.  Top with Dream Whip or Cool Whip.

name: SWEET BUNS(Boller)
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
2  tsp. cardamom
4 1/2 to 5  c. flour
1 3/4  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1  pkg. yeast
1  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Melt butter in small pan.  Add milk, sugar and salt, then egg. Keep at right temperature for the yeast, a little hot to the touch.  Add powdered yeast; stir well and let sit for 4 minutes. Beat in flour to a very stiff dough.  Beat and beat some more. Add raisins.  Let rise until double in volume.  Knead and shape into 30 medium balls (or smaller, if you prefer) and let rise again.  Brush with egg mixed with 1 tablespoon milk and bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Serve fresh, as is, or with jam or cut in half, buttered with jam or cheese.

name: CABBAGE BEEF SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium size head cabbage
1  medium onion
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes
1 (1 lb.)  can tomato sauce
2 (1 lb.)  cans kidney beans
1  can beef consomme soup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain, shred cabbage.  Chop onion and other ingredients; cook over medium heat.  Add about 2 cups water to begin and then as needed.  Cooking time:  2 hours.

name: BEEF AND RIGATONI STEW
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. Charolais chuck beef, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
1  c. dried prunes
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. salad oil (canola)
1  medium onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. oregano
4  drops Tabasco sauce
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
hot water
1/2  lb. rigatoni or other large macaroni
preparation: Stew prunes for 5 minutes and pit.  Shake beef cubes in a bag with flour and 1 teaspoon salt, a few at a time, until all are coated.  Brown beef in hot oil in deep 4-quart Dutch oven.  Add onion, garlic, salt, pepper, oregano and Tabasco.  Add tomato sauce and enough hot water to keep liquid 1 inch above meat.  Stir well, cover tightly and bake in slow oven (300°) for 2 hours. Add rigatoni, prunes and more water.  Cover; bake 1 hour longer. Serve with green salad, rolls and light dessert.  Enjoy.

name: SPARKLING STRAWBERRY BEVERAGE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen sweetened strawberries, slightly thawed
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade concentrate, slightly thawed
2 (28 oz.)  bottles cold ginger ale
1 (28 oz.)  bottle club soda (cold)
2  trays ice cubes
1/4  c. sugar
orange slices for garnish
preparation: In covered blender, blend strawberries and undiluted lemonade concentrate until mixed well.  Pour mixture into chilled punch bowl.  Add sugar, ginger ale, club soda and ice cubes.  Stir until sugar is dissolved.  Add orange slice before serving.

name: OLD-FASHIONED LOAF CANDY
ingredients:
6  c. white sugar
1  pt. white corn syrup
1  pt. cream or half and half
1  lb. unsalted butter
1  lb. chopped nuts
2  tsp. vanilla
