preparation: Mix all ingredients in a large heavy pan.  Place over medium heat.  Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Cook to a medium firm soft-ball stage.  This will take 40 minutes to 1 hour.  You must constantly stir or candy will burn.  (I try about 1 teaspoon in a cup of cold water.  When it can be picked up with no effort, then candy is cooked.)  Remove from heat.  Continue to stir and beat. When candy begins to stiffen, add the nuts and continue to stir. Candy will get very stiff and hard to stir.  When it will hold its shape, mold into loaf.  Wrap and chill.  Can be frozen.

name: SPICED RHUBARB
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh rhubarb, cut into 1/2 in. pieces
1  c. sugar
1 2 in.  stick cinnamon
4  whole cloves
2  whole allspice
1  4 in. strip orange rind (orange part only) or 1 tsp.  grated orange rind
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.

name: 24 HOUR FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans crushed pineapple
2  cans Royal cherries (light ones)
2  cans mandarin oranges
2  c. small marshmallows
1 small  bottle maraschino cherries, cut up
preparation: Drain all fruit.

name: ZUCCHINI SQUASH SOUP
ingredients:
4  or 5 zucchini squash
1  onion
water
1  can (large) milk
1/2  stick butter
garlic powder to taste
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Wash,  peel and cook squash and onion in water.  Drain; put in blender or mash with masher.  Add milk, butter, garlic powder, salt and pepper.  Simmer 5 to 8 minutes.

name: GRAPE PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large  can frozen grape juice
1 large  can frozen lemonade
3  bottles club soda
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Chill slightly and serve.  Delicious.

name: MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1 large  can tamales
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes, chopped
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, chipped
1  can Ranch Style beans
preparation: Brown ground meat.  Mash tamales with a fork.  Mix browned meat and tamales with other ingredients in a slow cooker.  Cook until thoroughly heated, stirring occasionally.

name: CRAB-CHEESE FONDUE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. Swiss cheese
1  can crab meat
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. dry white wine
1  tsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Over low heat, melt cream cheese with wine, stirring constantly.  Toss Swiss cheese with cornstarch to coat.  Stir crab, cheese, milk and Worcestershire sauce into wine mixture. Heat thoroughly.  Transfer to fondue pot (keep warm).  Makes 3 cups.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. butter
3 1/2  Tbsp. powdered sugar
1  qt. strawberries
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
Cool Whip
preparation: Blend flour, butter and powdered sugar.  Press in pan with fingers. Bake at 350° until slightly brown, about 20 minutes. Place half of the berries in baked crust.  Add sugar and cornstarch. Boil until clear and thick.  Cool slightly and pour over berries in crust. Cool. Cover with Cool Whip.

name: TUNA-PECAN SALAD WITH WATER CHESTNUTS
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
3  c. canned white albacore tuna, drained and flaked
1/4  c. lightly toasted pecans, chopped
1/4  c. chopped celery
salt and white pepper to taste
1/4  c. water chestnuts, coarsely chopped
preparation: Combine all ingredients, mixing well to evenly distribute and coat well with mayonnaise.  Adjust seasoning to taste.  If salad is dry, add a bit more mayonnaise.

name: RAW SUMMER SQUASH SALAD
ingredients:
1  small zucchini
1  tomato
juice of 1/2 lemon
2  Tbsp. salad oil
2 to 3 leaves minced basil or 1/2 to 1  tsp. dried basil
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Slice or chop vegetables.  Mix other ingredients and drizzle over vegetables.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1 1/4  Tbsp. cinnamon
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. oil
1  c. nuts
2  c. shredded zucchini (use either blender or food processor)
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients together.  Set aside.  Combine sugar, eggs, vanilla and oil together.  Add zucchini and nuts.  Gradually add the dry ingredients.  Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes.  Cool before slicing.

name: HARVEST LOAVES
ingredients:
4  c. diced, peeled apples
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  c. self-rising flour
1  c. oil
2  eggs
1/4  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Stir apples and sugar together.  Let stand 1 hour.  Stir flour and spices together.  Beat eggs; add oil, vanilla and apples.  Add flour mixture.  Stir in nuts.  Divide between 2 sprayed loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

name: BEAU MONDE DIP(Excellent With Pumpernickel Bread)
ingredients:
1  pt. sour cream
1  pt. mayonnaise
2  tsp. Beau Monde
2  tsp. dill seed
2  Tbsp. parsley
2  Tbsp. onion flakes
1  round pumpernickel bread broken in pieces
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients  together with spoon.  Arrange so bread can be dipped in mixture by guests.

name: HONEY DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
4 1/4  c. bread flour
1  pkg. dry yeast
1 1/4  c. milk
1/3  c. honey
1/4  c. margarine
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
preparation: Combine all dry ingredients in large bowl.  Heat margarine, milk and honey until warm and margarine is melted.  Add liquid to dry mixture and add eggs.  Knead and add flour to make dough smooth and elastic.  Put in well-greased bowl and allow to double, covered.  Make rolls and put in oiled muffin pans.  Let rise until double.  Bake in 375° oven for 12 minutes.  Use paper muffin cups to cut down on cleanup. Makes 36 rolls.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising corn meal
1  c. buttermilk
2  eggs
1 small  can creamed corn
1/2  c. oil
1  chopped bell pepper
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
1/4  chopped red pepper
2  tsp. chopped onion
preparation: Grease pan.  Mix and bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: SWEET POTATO DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  can sweet potatoes
1/2  pt. heavy whipping cream
2  eggs
honey (optional)
1/4  c. butter
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2/3  c. brown sugar
1  c. pecan chips
preparation: Drain most of the juice from the sweet potatoes.  Whip so it is the consistency of mashed potatoes.  Mix in cream, eggs, butter and cinnamon.  Pour in baking dish.  Sprinkle top with brown sugar (fairly heavy) and pecans.  Drizzle with butter and honey.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Let set for 10 minutes to firm up.

name: SIMPLE CHOCOLATE CHEESECAKES
ingredients:
24  vanilla wafer cookies
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. Hershey's cocoa
2  Tbsp. flour
3  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
canned cherry pie filling, chilled
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Line muffin pans with foil paper cups (2 1/2 inches in diameter).  Place 1 vanilla wafer in bottom of each cup.  In large mixer bowl, beat softened cream cheese and sugar. Blend in cocoa and flour.  Add eggs; beat well.  Blend in sour cream and vanilla.  Fill each prepared cup almost full with cheese mixture.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or just until set.  Remove from oven.   Cool 5 to 10 minutes.  Spread heaping teaspoonfuls of topping (below) on each cup.  Cool completely.  Chill.  Garnish with cherry pie filling just before serving.

name: MARRA'S SALSA
ingredients:
3  medium hot peppers
3  sweet bell peppers
3  medium onions
8  tomatoes
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2  c. vinegar
4  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. tomato paste
preparation: Dice onions, peppers and tomatoes and place in a pan to heat. Add garlic powder, chili powder, vinegar, sugar and salt.  Cook slowly until the vegetables are soft.  Add the tomato paste, bring to a boil again.  Remove from heat and cool.  Eat with chips of your choice.

name: FRUIT FILLED CRUMB CAKE
ingredients:
6  c. flour
1 1/2  c. granulated sugar
3  tsp. baking powder
3  eggs
1/2  lb. oleo
1/2  lb. butter
canned pie filling
preparation: Mix all ingredients together except pie filling.  Spread 3/4 dough on a cookie sheet.  Cover dough with choice of canned pie filling (2 cans).  Grate remaining 1/4 dough over the fruit.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then reduce to 325° for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.  Sift powdered sugar over the top when cool.

name: JOLLY OLD ST. NICK CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Pillsbury Plus cake mix (any flavor)
water
oil
eggs
frosting and decorations
1  can Pillsbury frosting
1  drop red food color
miniature marshmallows
1/4  tsp. red food color
gumdrops
string licorice
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Angel food cake mix and 2 2/3 cups water.  Add "A" mix and mix in large stainless steel bowl (Kitchen Aid).  Mix for 2 minutes on slow.  Whip until peaks don't fall. Put into large bowl.  Sprinkle 1/4 flour ("B" package) onto whipped eggs at a time, then fold.  Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan.  Spread evenly.  Cook for 30 to 40 minutes.  Let cool 35 to 45 minutes. Marshmallows should be spread like a beard; gumdrops as eyes.  Ice cake with icing evenly, then chow.

name: PIN MONEY PICKLES
ingredients:
3  qt. cucumbers, chopped
1  qt. green tomatoes
1  pt. sweet green peppers
1 1/2  qt. sweet red peppers
3  lb. sugar (half brown)
1  qt. onions
2  hot peppers
2  oz. white mustard seed
1  oz. celery seed
1/2  gal. vinegar
preparation: Soak cucumbers in fresh water for 2 days or until fresh enough. Soak other things in water with handful of salt overnight. Cook in vinegar, sugar and spices for 1 hour, slowly.

name: WEDDING SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. acini de pepe, cooked 8 minutes and drained
1  can pineapple tidbits, drained (save juice)
1  can mandarin oranges, drained (save juice)
1  large Cool Whip (12 oz.)
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
juices from fruit
1  Tbsp. flour
1  beaten egg
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Cook the sugar, salt, juices from fruit, flour, egg and lemon juice and bring to a boil. Add to drained acini. Refrigerate overnight. In the morning, add fruits and Cool Whip. Mix well and chill.

name: PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  onion, chopped
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
15  oz. can spaghetti sauce
8  oz. can tomato sauce
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
8  oz. wide noodles
12  oz. Mozzarella cheese, cubed
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion together. Cook noodles.  Combine hamburger, onion, noodles and remaining ingredients. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: TRIPLE FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  (4 oz.) chocolate pudding mix (not instant)
1  pkg. devil's food cake mix
1/2  c. nutmeats
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Make pudding according to directions in saucepan.  Blend dry cake mix into hot pudding with electric mixer for 2 minutes.  Pour into oiled 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle top with chocolate chips and nutmeats.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  May use different combination of cake mix, pudding and topping.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  envelope Lipton onion soup mix
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. bread crumbs
3/4  c. water
1/3  c. catsup
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  In a  large bowl, combine meat, soup mix, eggs, catsup, bread crumbs and water. Shape into a greased loaf pan.  Bake about 45 minutes or until done.  Makes about 6 servings.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
3/4  c. melted butter or margarine
1/2  c. Carnation evaporated milk
1  pkg. Kraft caramels
1/3  c. Carnation evaporated milk
1  c. pecan pieces
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients.   Spread half of the batter into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 5 minutes at 350°.

name: AVOCADO SALSA
ingredients:
1/3  c. white wine vinegar
1  Tbsp. honey
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground cumin
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  small onion, chopped
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chiles, undrained
1  clove garlic (large), minced
2  avocados, peeled and diced
preparation: Combine all ingredients except avocados, stirring well.  Cover and chill.   Just before serving, add avocados and toss gently. Serve with tortilla chips.  Yields 1 1/2 cups.

name: MOCK STEAK
ingredients:
3  lb. hamburger
1  c. cracker crumbs
1  c. evaporated milk
2  cans mushroom soup
1  can water
preparation: Mix hamburger, cracker crumbs and milk together.  Spread on cookie sheet.  Let set overnight in refrigerator.  Cut into squares.  Roll squares in flour and brown.  Cover with 2 cans soup and water.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: CREAMED CABBAGE AND STUFFED FRANKFURTERS
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage
1  lb. hot dogs
bread dressing
1  c. cabbage juice
milk
dash of salt
1  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. oil
1/3  c. flour
preparation: Cut cabbage small; cook in pan covered with salted water. Cook until tender; drain (save 1 cup of the liquid).  In frypan, saute onion in oil.  Remove onion from pan.

name: MEXICAN PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. Hungry Jack biscuits
1  pkg. dry chili mix
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1 (8 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain off grease.  Add tomato sauce, chili mix and corn.  Cook for approximately 5 minutes on medium heat.  In a pie plate press together the biscuits to form the piecrust.  Take half of the package of Mozzarella cheese and spread over the bottom layer of piecrust.  Add meat mixture and top with remaining Mozzarella cheese.  Bake at 350° for 25 - 30 minutes until golden brown.  Remove from oven and let stand for 5 minutes before cutting.  Serves:  4 - 6.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1  c. creamy peanut butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
12  oz. Cool Whip
1  (8 or 9 oz.) graham cracker pie crust
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a bowl at room temperature for 10 minutes.  Place mixture into graham cracker crust and freeze for 2 hours.  Then refrigerate before serving.

name: CHILI DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese, at room temperature
2  cans (15 oz. each) chunky chili with beans
1/2  cup salsa
1/4  cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1/4  cup shredded Colby cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease a 10 inch deep dish pie pan or shallow 1 1/2 qt. baking dish.  Spread cream cheese in bottom of baking dish.  Mix chili and salsa until blended, then pour over cream cheese.  Sprinkle with Jack and Colby cheeses.  (Wrap and refrigerate at this point if making ahead.)  Bake 25 to 35 minutes, until bubbling and cheese melts.  Serve hot or at room temperature. Serves 12.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. flour
1/4  c. oil
2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped onion tops
2  buds garlic, minced
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. chopped celery and leaves
2  bay leaves
3  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
6  oz. tomato paste
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1  c. water
5  lb. raw shrimp, peeled and deveined
dash of Tabasco
1/2  c. chopped celery
juice of 1/2 lemon
preparation: In Dutch oven or large, heavy pot, make a roux of flour and oil.  Add onion, green pepper, celery, bay leaves, salt and pepper.  Saute, uncovered, over medium heat until onion is transparent and soft.  Add tomato paste and saute 3 minutes.  Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and water.  Simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
17  oz. pkg. slice-n-bake sugar cookie dough
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1 large  can pineapple chunks
1  can Mandarin oranges
fresh fruit (I use 1 qt. strawberries, plus banana)
preparation: Cut cookie dough into 1/8-inch slices and arrange on cookie sheet, overlapping slightly.  Bake at 375° until light brown.  Let cool.  Pour liquid from oranges and pineapple into saucepan.  Add 2 tablespoons cornstarch and cook until thick.  Set aside and let cool.  Spread mixture of cream cheese, 1/2 cup sugar and teaspoon vanilla onto cooled cookies.  Arrange fruit in layers, pineapple, oranges, bananas, strawberries, etc.  Pour cooled sauce on top to cover all fruit.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: POTATO PUDDING OR "KUGELIS"
ingredients:
10  large potatoes
1  medium onion
5  slices bacon
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. hot milk or evaporated milk
3  eggs
preparation: Peel and grate fine  the potatoes and onion.  Cut bacon crosswise into narrow strips  and fry until crisp.	Pour bacon and fat over potatoes.	Add hot milk.  Add beaten eggs, one at a time. Add salt and  pepper;  mix  well.	Pour  into greased pan.  Bake at 400° for  15 minutes.  Reduce heat to 375°, bake 45 minutes longer.  Cut into  squares	and serve hot with sour cream.

name: MUFFALETTAS
ingredients:
1/2 (16 oz.)  jar Italian olive salad, drained and chopped
1/4  c. pitted black olives, chopped
1  large stalk celery, chopped
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  (8-inch) round loaf crusty French bread or sourdough bread
1/4  lb. thinly sliced Genoa salami
1/4  lb. thinly sliced baked ham
1/4  lb. thinly sliced Provolone cheese
1/4  lb. thinly sliced Mortadella
1/4  lb. thinly sliced Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Combine olive salad, black olives and celery in a bowl and mix well.  Cut bread in half to form 2 rounds and remove some of the soft inside from each half so that sandwich won't be too thick. Brush inside each half with olive oil mixture.  Spread olive salad mixture over bottom half of bread.  Top with salami, ham, Mortadella and cheeses.  Replace top half of bread and cut sandwich into quarters.  Makes 4 servings.

name: *MARY E'S FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. salad oil
1/3  c. ketchup
1/4  c. vinegar
juice of a lemon
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Blend all ingredients well.  Shake well before using.

name: WHITE COCONUT CHRISTMAS PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
1/2  c. whipping cream
1  c. coconut
3/4  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. almond flavoring
3  egg whites
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Make a pie crust, baked, with high fluted edge.  Blend thoroughly in a saucepan flour, sugar, gelatin and salt.  Stir in gradually 1 3/4 cups milk.  Cook over medium heat until mixture boils, stirring constantly.  Boil for 1 minute.  Place pan in cold water.  Cool until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from spoon.  Blend in the flavorings.  Beat egg whites to stiff peaks. Carefully fold in stiffly whipped cream and coconut.  Pile into pie crust; sprinkle with coconut.  Chill several hours.

name: PICKLED CARROTS
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. oil
1  c. tomato soup
preparation: Cook carrots, not too soft.  Cool.  Combine all ingredients. Marinate at least 24 hours in refrigerator.

name: PLAY DOUGH(For Children)
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. water
1/2  c. salt
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
2  tsp. cream of tartar
few drops red food coloring
preparation: In a heavy aluminum saucepan, mix dry ingredients.  Add oil, water and food coloring.  Cook 3 minutes or until mixture pulls away from side of pan.  Knead slightly.  Store in airtight container.

name: SPINACH PIE *
ingredients:
1  pkg. (8) crescent roll dough
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. grated Mozzarella cheese
1  egg
1  Tbsp. chopped garlic
preparation: Line an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan with 1/2 of the dough (4 rolls). Thaw and drain spinach.  Mix egg, garlic and spinach and layer on top of dough in pan.  Cover mixture with a layer of the cheese and another layer of the remaining dough.  Bake at 350° for about 1/2 hour, until cheese is melted and dough is golden brown.  Let cool for about 5 to 10 minutes before cutting into small squares.  Can be frozen.

name: BARBECUED GROUND BEEF
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can tomato soup
1  Tbsp. barbecue sauce
preparation: In oil, saute onion, celery and green pepper.  Add ground beef and cook until beef is gray color.  Add salt, pepper, tomato soup and barbecue sauce.  Mix well.  Simmer about 1 hour.  Serve on buns or rolls.

name: ONION CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  sweet onions, sliced thickly
3/4  stick butter
8  oz. shredded Swiss cheese
1  loaf French bread, sliced 1-inch thick
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  can milk
preparation: Saute onions in butter.  Put in 8 x 11-inch casserole.  Put Swiss cheese on top of onions.  Butter both sides of slices of French bread, then cube 1-inch.  Put on top of cheese.  Mix chicken soup and milk together and pour over bread.  Sit overnight in refrigerator, then bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: CROCK IT MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
1 (16 oz.)  jar grape jelly
1 (12 oz.)  bottle chili sauce
preparation: Combine grape jelly and chili sauce in crock-pot.  From ground meat into balls and drop in.  Stir well to coat the meatballs. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

name: EASY BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick
1  stick margarine
1  (8 oz.) container sour cream
preparation: Melt butter.  Have sour cream at room temperature.  Mix all ingredients together.  Spray muffin pan.  Will make 12  muffin biscuits.  Bake at 425° for 10 to 14 minutes.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. oil
1  large onion, copped
2  pods garlic, crushed
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  c. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. ketchup
1/2  c. white vinegar
2  lemons, squeezed (save the rinds)
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. black pepper
preparation: In a heavy pot, heat the oil.  Add onions, garlic and dry mustard.  Cook until soft, but not brown.  Add remaining ingredients, including lemon rinds.  Simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Discard rinds.  Pour in a jar and store in refrigerator.

name: HONEY PORK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. pork, cut into thin bite pieces
2  Tbsp. oil
1  envelope brown gravy mix
1  c. water
1/4  c. honey
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
4  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  green pepper in small sq.
3  carrots, sliced thin
1  large onion, cut in 6 wedges
cooked rice
preparation: Brown pork in oil in large skillet, stirring frequently, approximately 15 minutes.  Combine gravy mix, water, honey, soy sauce, vinegar, ginger and garlic salt.  Add to skillet.  Cover and cook 20 minutes.  Add carrots, cook 10 minutes.  Add onion and peppers, cook 5 to 10 minutes.  Serve with rice.

name: TOURTIERES CANADIENNE(Canadian Meat Pie)
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  tsp. salt
3  c. flour
2/3  c. water (cold)
preparation: Cut 1/2 cup shortening into salted flour, then add remaining shortening.  Mix well and stir in water.  Roll out 1/2 of dough to line 10-inch pie plate.  Save other 1/2 to top the pie.

name: PICKLED EGGS
ingredients:
6  or more boiled eggs (peeled)
2 1/2  c. leftover sweet and sour beet juice
some beets
preparation: Pour cool syrup over cooked and peeled eggs.  Make sure there is enough syrup to cover the eggs.  Place in refrigerator overnight.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH CRESCENTS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butterscotch chips
2  Tbsp. chopped nuts
1  can refrigerated crescent rolls
1/4  c. coconut
powdered sugar
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Stir butterscotch chips, coconut, and nuts together.  Unroll crescent dough.  Sprinkle 1 Tbsp. butterscotch mixture on each.  Gently press into dough.  Roll dough up into crescents short end first.  Place in pan edge down. Bake 10-12 minutes or until brown.  Sprinkle top with powdered sugar.

name: CHOCOLATE SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
4  c. sifted powdered sugar
2  sticks oleo
2  tsp. vanilla
2 2/3  c. Pet milk (1 large)
preparation: Melt chips and oleo.  Gradually add sugar and milk.  Cook 8 minutes after full boil, stirring constantly.  Remove and add vanilla.  Serve warm over ice cream or cake.  Keeps a long time in refrigerator.  Real good.

name: KRISTIE'S ROUND STEAK IN THE CROCK-POT
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. round steak
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
1  can Ro-Tel diced tomatoes and green chilies
1  can Ranch Style beans (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients in crock-pot.  Cook on low 5 1/2 to 6 hours or on high 3 1/2 to 4 hours.  If Ranch Style beans are added, wait until the last hour to do so.  Serve over rice.

name: TANGY VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. horseradish
1  tsp. curry powder
1  tsp. minced onion
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.  Good with all vegetables.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 large  pkg. sharp Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. green pepper, finely chopped
1  tsp. onion, finely chopped
1 small  jar pimentos
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Allow cheese to soften.  Grate Cheddar cheese.  Mix all ingredients, except nuts.  Form cheese ball and roll it in chopped nuts.  Serve with crackers.

name: CARAMEL CRUNCH
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
4  c. Rice Chex cereal
1  Tbsp. white corn syrup
1  c. light brown sugar
preparation: Melt butter and syrup in skillet.  Blend in brown sugar and cook 2 minutes.  Add cereal and stir until coated.  Spread on aluminum foil to cool.  Separate to eat.

name: GRAN'S STOVE TOP BEANS
ingredients:
1 large  can pork and beans
1  large onion
1  can Vienna sausage (drain water)
approximately 1/4 c. tomato catsup
1/2  stick butter or margarine
1  beef bouillon cube
4  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Chip  Vienna's  and  onion; add finely chopped bouillon cube. Then  add the rest of the ingredients and mix together. Put on high  to  start and then on low cook for 3 to 4 hours, stirring occasionally.

name: FRIED CABBAGE AND HAM
ingredients:
1  head cabbage
4  carrots
1  stick butter
1  Tbsp. pepper
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. ham, cooked and diced
preparation: Melt butter in large skillet.  Add chopped cabbage, carrots, salt and pepper.  Cook on medium heat; stir frequently to keep from burning.  Let cabbage begin to brown.  Add 1 cup water and ham.  Cover and simmer for about 20 minutes.

name: BUTTERMILK FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. pecans, chopped
1/2  stick butter
pinch of soda
preparation: Cook sugar, soda and milk to fairly hard boil.  Add butter before removing from heat.  Beat until it begins to cream.  Add nuts and pour into buttered Pyrex dish.  Cut into squares when cool.

name: BRISKET
ingredients:
brisket
salt and pepper
celery salt
1  bottle liquid smoke
5 to 6  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2 to 3  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Rub salt, pepper and celery salt into brisket.  Lay brisket on heavy-duty foil, fat side up.  Pour liquid smoke, Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice over brisket.  Seal in foil and let marinate overnight.  Bake for 10 hours at 225°.

name: ONE BOWL CHERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  eggs
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and blend well with a wooden spoon.  Put into a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.  When cooled, sprinkle with powdered sugar.  Cut slices right from pan.

name: EASY CHICKEN-N-DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
approximately 1 qt. boiled, deboned chicken (retain broth)
2  cans Hungry Jack biscuits (10 count cans)
1  can cream of chicken soup
6  chopped, boiled eggs
preparation: You'll need approximately 2 quarts broth; add soup (no extra water).  Pinch each biscuit in about 4 pieces.  Drop one by one into hot, boiling broth and soup mixture; the dumplings will be bite-sized and fluffy.  Let boil on medium-high for approximately 5 to 8 minutes.  Add cooked eggs and chicken.  Makes a large pot.

name: KART WHEELS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. margarine or butter, softened
1/4  c. powdered sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. milk
about 1 c. jam (any flavor)
preparation: Heat the oven to 375°.  Mix flour, margarine, sugar, baking powder and just enough milk until dough forms.  (If dough seems dry, mix in more milk, 1 teaspoon at a time.) Divide dough into 6 equal parts.  Shape each part into a ball.  Place on an ungreased cookie sheet; flatten slightly.  Make an indentation, 1 3/4-inches in diameter and about 3/4-inch deep in center of each flattened ball.  Fill each indention with about 2 tablespoons jam.  Bake until the edges begin to brown, about 20 to 25 minutes.  Makes 6 Kart Wheels.

name: BAKED CHEESE STUFFED TOMATOES
ingredients:
4  large tomatoes
2  c. grated Swiss cheese
1/2  c. light cream
2  egg yolks, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. chopped chives
3  Tbsp. grated onion
1/2  tsp. marjoram leaves
1  tsp. dry mustard
1 1/2  tsp. salt
dry bread crumbs
melted margarine
preparation: Grease  flat  baking  dish.  Halve  tomatoes crosswise. Scoop out  pulp,  leaving shells intact.  Chop pulp coarsely. Combine pulp  with  cheese,  cream, egg yolks, chives, onion, marjoram, mustard  and  salt.  Mix  well.  Spoon mixture into shells. Toss bread crumbs with melted margarine. Sprinkle over cheese  mixture. Arrange  tomatoes in prepared dish.  Bake 25 minutes at 350°. Serves 8.

name: BAKED ACORN SQUASH
ingredients:
acorn squash
1  Tbsp. butter
honey or brown sugar
preparation: Wash and cut in half.  Remove seeds.  Bake, cut side down, at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Turn cut side up.  Fill cavity with butter and honey or brown sugar.  Continue baking for 20 minutes more or until done.

name: CHOCOLATE SYRUP FOR ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1  c. white syrup
2  c. cream (whipping)
preparation: Combine  all;  stir  well.  Bring to  boil.  Boil  five minutes.  Makes 1 quart.

name: OLD FASHIONED OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines spice deluxe cake mix
2  c. uncooked rolled oats
2  eggs
3/4  c. cooking oil
1/2  c. milk
2  c. raisins
1  c. chopped nuts
1/4  c. dark brown sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients; mix well. Drop from a teaspoon onto an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for about 12 minutes, until cookies test done with a toothpick. Cool on cookie sheet about 1 minute, then remove from rack to finish cooling.

name: MANGO ICE CREAM
ingredients:
4  ripe mangoes, peeled and sliced
1/4  c. lemon juice
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  egg yolks, beaten
6  c. half and half
1/4  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Start with a good portion of love, stir in a few smiles and one or two good belly laughs.  Add a pinch of each: understanding, cheerfulness, compassion, a prayer or two or three and honesty.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
32  oz. bag frozen hash browns
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  stick margarine, melted
2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
1  onion, chopped
16  oz. sour cream
preparation: Mix together and top with 1 stick melted margarine and corn flake crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CRACKER PUDDING
ingredients:
1  qt. milk
1  c. cracker crumbs
1/2  c. coconut
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. 10x sugar
preparation: Baking Temperature: 350°.  Baking Time: 15 minutes.

name: OVERNIGHT VEGGIE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can small green peas, drained
1 (16 oz.)  can French-cut green beans, drained
1  (11 oz.) Shoe Peg white corn, drained
1  medium onion, finely chopped
3/4  c. celery, finely chopped
2  Tbsp. chopped pimentos
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. white wine vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat dressing until sugar is dissolved.  Pour over veggies. Cover.  Refrigerate overnight.  Good keeper.

name: ZUCCHINI BOATS
ingredients:
small to medium zucchini squash
Parmesan cheese
bacon slices
preparation: Slice squash lengthwise.  Sprinkle with Parmesan.  Twist and lay 1/2 slice bacon on each squash.  Place on a cookie sheet.  Bake at 300° until desired doneness.

name: DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. melted shortening
2  eggs
4  c. flour
4  Tbsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. milk
preparation: Beat eggs until light.  Add sugar, beating well.  Blend in shortening.  Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and sugar mixture.  Roll 1/4-inch thick on floured board.  Cut with doughnut cutter and fry a few at a time in 4-inches hot (360°) oil or shortening, turning once.  Drain on paper towel.  Dip in sugar or frosting.  Makes 24.

name: CHEESY SCALLOP SOUP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1  large onion, chopped
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
3 1/2  c. milk
1  lb. scallops
1 (4 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. dry white wine
2/3  c. shredded Swiss cheese
2  Tbsp. parsley, snipped
preparation: Melt butter and cook onion until tender, covered.  Stir in flour and add milk, cooking until it bubbles.  Add scallops, mushrooms, salt and pepper, simmering, 15 to 20 minutes.  Add wine and cheese; stir until cheese melts.  Top with parsley and serve. Very easy and tasty on a cold day.

name: CHICKEN OR TURKEY ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts or other pieces of equivalent weight
1  pt. sour cream
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  can chopped green chilies (optional)
taco sauce
milk
cheese
12  flour tortillas
preparation: Boil chicken; remove skin and bones and shred.  Mix the sour cream, soup, chilies and enough milk to create pourable consistency.  Flavor with taco sauce to taste.  Pour small amount of sauce into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Spread to cover.  Form enchiladas by placing chicken and grated cheese in a tortilla roll.  Place seam side down in dish.  Continue with enchiladas until chicken and cheese are gone.  Cover with remaining sauce; sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: VENUS DE MILO SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. lean hamburg or turkeyburger
2  qt. water
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup (2 envelopes)
1  lb. pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
1  can tomatoes (28 oz.)
1/2  tsp. salt, pepper and celery salt
1/2  c. orzo
preparation: Break up burger into water.  Cook until done (5 to 10 minutes).  Add seasonings and soup mix.  Cook 15 minutes.  Add tomatoes (blended), vegetables and orzo.  Simmer for 1/2 hour.

name: WHITE FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
5  eggs, beaten
1/2  lb. butter
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. lemon extract
1  lb. candied pineapple
1/2  lb. red candied cherries
1/2  lb. green candied cherries
4  c. pecans or walnuts
preparation: Cut cherries and pineapple in half.  Mix fruit and flour. Cream butter and sugar; add beaten eggs and flavorings.  Combine with fruit and nuts.   Line greased 9-inch tube pan with brown paper.  Grease paper also.   Pour mixture in pan.  Bake at 300° until done (2 to 2 1/2 hours).  Cool on rack for 1/2 hour.  Remove paper.  Cool completely and store.

name: TACO PIE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef, browned
1  large pie crust
2  pkg. taco mix
2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Brown pie crust.  Put in hamburger meat mixed with taco seasoning.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
German chocolate cake mix
1/2  c. butter
1  pkg. caramels
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix cake mix, add butter instead of oil.  Put 1/2 batter in pan.  Bake 15 minutes at 350°.  Melt caramels and milk.  Pour over cake, add chocolate chips and pecans.  Pour rest of cake batter. Bake 30 more minutes at 350°.

name: LEFTOVER SPECIAL
ingredients:
1/4 to 1/2  lb. leftover roast or chicken
1  lb. can mixed vegetables or leftover vegetable
thickened vegetable liquid or 1/2 can mushroom soup
1  can refrigerator biscuits
preparation: Mix roast, vegetables and liquid in a casserole.  Top with biscuits.  Bake at 350° until biscuits are golden brown.

name: ORANGE-PINEAPPLE CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. orange-pineapple gelatin
1  can frozen orange juice (small)
1  can crushed pineapple (large)
1  can mandarin oranges
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups of hot water.  Add orange juice, pineapple, drained oranges and nuts, if desired.  Chill until firm. Serve on lettuce.

name: PINEAPPLE SURPRISE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. orange Jell-O
2  c. canned pineapple juice
1  c. shredded pineapple
1  c. finely cut or grated carrots
1  head lettuce
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in warm pineapple juice drained from a can of shredded pineapple.  When mixture has hardened somewhat, add the pineapple and carrots.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans corn
3/4  stick oleo
2  Tbsp. flour
1  carton whipping cream
preparation: Drain the corn.  Melt the oleo in casserole dish. Add the flour and stir.  Add drained corn and whipping cream. Cook at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: RECIPE FOR A HAPPY FAMILY
ingredients:
1  Husband
1  Wife
Children
1  Bible for each
1  Home
generous portions of Prayer
3  c. Love, firmly packed
1  pkg. Work
1  pkg. Play (together)
1  portion Patience
1  portion Understanding
1  portion Forgiveness
1  small Paddle
1  cup Kisses
preparation: Mix thoroughly, sprinkle with awareness.  Bake in moderate oven of everyday life, using as fuel all the grudges and past unpleasantness.  Cool.  Turn out onto a platter of cheerfulness. Garnish with tears and laughter in large helpings.  Serve God, country and community.

name: STRAWBERRY FROZEN DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
1 (20 oz.)  can unsweetened crushed pineapple, drained
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Cream together cream cheese and sugar. Blend strawberries and pineapple into creamed mixture.  Fold Cool Whip into mixture. Pour into pan or cupcake paper or anything pretty and freeze.

name: FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
2/3  c sugar
1/3  c catsup
1  Tbsp Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp salt
1  c salad oil
1/4  c cider vinegar
preparation: Combine ingredients, toss with salad.

name: CORNBREAD SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jiffy cornbread muffin mix
1  tomato, chopped
1  bunch green onions, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
1/2  c. pickle relish
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Prepare muffin mix by directions on box.  Bake and crumble in bowl when cool.  Mix remaining ingredients in bowls. Pour over crumbled bread.  Chill.  Best if prepared the day before you serve.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
4 large  cans unsweetened pineapple juice
2 large  cans hot water
2  qt. ginger ale
6  pkg. unsweetened Kool-Aid tropical punch
6  c. sugar
preparation: Mix Kool-Aid and sugar in hot water until completely dissolved.  Add pineapple juice and freeze in large molds.  At serving time, remove from freezer and place in punch bowl.  Pour ginger ale over frozen mixture and mix.  Serves 50.

name: PAN-FRIED POTATOES
ingredients:
Wesson oil
3/4  c. water
cabbage
sliced potatoes
onion
preparation: Take frypan, add oil.  Slice onion, potatoes and cabbage.  Add water.  Cook 45 minutes, covered, on medium.  When almost done, add wieners, Polish sausage or any link meat.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Good main dish.

name: CORN BREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  large pan corn bread (about 4 c.)
1  whole onion, sauteed
1  c. celery, sauteed
1  stick margarine
4  c. or more broth
1  Tbsp. sage
1  can cream of chicken soup
3  eggs
nuts (if desired)
preparation: Mix together in order listed.  Needs to be soupy.   Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

name: FRESH VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. vinegar
4  tsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. powdered ginger
2  Tbsp. milk
2  Tbsp. fresh green onion, chopped very fine
preparation: Mix ingredients together and let stand in jar in refrigerator several hours or overnight before using.

name: ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  pkg. corn tortillas (20 or so)
large can Hormel chili
grated cheese
oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Heat oil in skillet (1/4 inch deep).  Put tortilla in oil until it starts to puff and immediately turn tortilla over.  Take out and drain on paper towel.  Repeat with all tortillas.  Put grated cheese on each tortilla and roll up.  Place in 9 x 13 inch baking dish.  Cover with chili and top with more grated cheese.  Bake for 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.  Tortillas can be filled with additional toppings such as onions, seasoned ground beef, chicken, etc.

name: JUMPING BEAN DIP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  can Frito Lay Bean Dip
1 (4 oz.)  jar chopped green chilies
1  finely chopped onion
1  envelope taco mix
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  (3 oz.) cream cheese
grated Cheddar cheese
dried or fresh parsley
preparation: Blend first 6 ingredients thoroughly.  Pour mixture in deep dish pie plate.  Sprinkle with cheese and parsley.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  If doubled, bake 30 minutes.  Serve with taco chips.

name: TURTLE PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) baked pastry shell
12  caramels, unwrapped
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
2 (1 oz.)  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1/4  c. margarine
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. vanilla extract
dash of salt
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: In small heavy saucepan, over low heat, melt caramels with 1/3 cup sweetened condensed milk.  Spread evenly on bottom of prepared pastry shell.  In medium saucepan, over low heat, melt chocolate with margarine.  In large mixer bowl, beat eggs with remaining sweetened condensed milk, water, vanilla and salt.  Add chocolate mixture; mix well.  Pour into prepared pastry shell.  Top with pecans.  Bake at 325° for 35 minutes or until center is set. Cool.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
1  cube oleo
1  large onion, cut fine
6  to 8 medium potatoes, diced
2  carrots, grated
2 to 3  Tbsp. cornstarch
6  c. water (just to cover)
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  tsp. white pepper (optional)
2  c. milk
preparation: Melt butter, saute onions and add potatoes, carrots, water and salt.  Cook until tender.  Add 2 or 3 tablespoons cornstarch or flour to 2 cups milk.  Mash potatoes and add milk.  Cook until thickened.

name: LILLIE MAE WHITTAKER'S SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
dash of salt
1  Tbsp. butter (rounded)
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
2  to 3 eggs
1/4  c. vinegar
1/4  c. water
preparation: Cream sugar, salt and butter together. Beat in mustard and eggs.  Add vinegar and water.  Cook, stirring constantly, to a good rolling boil.  Pour hot over potatoes or coleslaw.

name: INSTANT RUSSIAN SPICED TEA
ingredients:
1/2  c. instant tea
2  c. sugar
2  c. Tang
1  pkg. lemonade mix (large)
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ground cloves
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix thoroughly.  Use 2 to 3 rounded teaspoonfuls to a cup of boiling water.

name: VEGETABLE LASAGNA
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  onion
1  clove garlic
1/2  c. plain flour
3  c. milk
3/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
16  oz. uncooked lasagna
16  oz. cottage cheese
1  egg
4  oz. Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
2  carrots, shredded
2  zucchini, shredded
10  oz. frozen chopped broccoli
1/2  lb. spinach, chopped
preparation: Microwave margarine; add onion and garlic.  Microwave 3 minutes until onion is soft.  Stir in flour.  Cook 1 minute more. Gradually stir in milk 1/4 teaspoon pepper and salt.   Microwave 10 minutes until sauce is thickened and smooth.  Combine cheese, egg and 1/2 Mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese and 1/2 teaspoon pepper.  Stir in carrots, zucchini, broccoli and spinach.  Layer pan, 1/4 onion sauce, 1/3 noodles, 1/2 vegetable mixture.  Repeat. Top with onion sauce and cheese.  Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes if browning too fast; cover with foil.

name: ORANGE WAFER BALLS
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  box vanilla wafers
1 (16 oz.)  box powdered sugar
1  c. finely chopped nuts
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed and undiluted
1 (12 oz.)  can flaked coconut
preparation: Crush vanilla wafers into fine crumbs; add sugar, nuts, margarine and orange juice.  Mix well and shape into bite-sized balls.  Roll lightly in coconut.  Chill and place in an airtight container.  Store in refrigerator.  Yields 5 or 6 dozen.

name: DIABETIC GREEN BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh green beans
1  small onion, sliced
1  c. cherry tomatoes, halved
3/4  c. nonfat yogurt
1  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. Dijon style mustard
1/2  tsp. dried dill
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. white pepper
preparation: Wash and trim beans.  Boil in small amounts of water until crisp and tender; drain.  Combine beans, tomato halves and onion; set aside.  Combine ingredients and mix well.  Toss beans with yogurt dressing.  Chill several hours before serving.  Yields about 4 cups.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
3/4  c. milk
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  stick butter
2  c. peaches, drained
preparation: Stir together first 4 ingredients.  Melt butter in cake pan. Pour milk, sugar, flour and baking powder in pan (do not stir). Pour peaches over.  Do not stir peaches in batter.  Bake at 350° until it turns brown.  Serves 6.

name: THE P.B.J.  SANDWICH
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. peanut butter
jelly
2  slices bread
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix in small bowl peanut butter and cinnamon.  Put the peanut butter and cinnamon on a slice of bread.  Then put jelly on the other slice of bread.  Put it together and eat.  Serves one.

name: CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
1  fryer
2  c. broth
1  can peas and carrots, drained
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. milk
1/2  stick oleo
1  c. Bisquick
preparation: Cook chicken and debone.  Cut up and place in 9 x 12-inch baking dish.  Add peas and carrots to the chicken.  Add broth, chicken soup and top with mixture of milk, Bisquick and melted oleo.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: LEMON CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/4  c. melted butter
1/4  c. sweet milk
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. white cornmeal
grated rind of 1 lemon
4  eggs
preparation: Mix sugar, flour and meal.  Add butter, lemon juice, sweet milk and grated rind of lemon.  Add the eggs and beat really well with mixer.  Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 325° about 45 minutes or until done.

name: CORN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can of white shoe peg corn
1/2  c. of chopped bell pepper
1/2  medium onion, chopped fine
1/2  medium tomato, chopped
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients and chill before serving.

name: CONGO SQUARES
ingredients:
2 3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. shortening, melted
1  lb. brown sugar
3  eggs
1  pkg. chocolate bits
1  c. chopped nut meats
powdered sugar
preparation: Sift together flour, salt and baking powder.  Melt shortening. Add brown sugar and mix well.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Beat well.  Add dry ingredients, chocolate bits and nut meats.  Pour into greased pan and bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (2 lb.) bag frozen hash brown potatoes
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. oleo (save 1/2 for top)
10  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. sour cream
bread crumbs
preparation: Mix all except bread crumbs and 1/2 oleo.  Put in greased pan. Add crumbs and butter to top.  Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350°.

name: PINEAPPLE-GINGER DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. plus 1 Tbsp. pineapple juice
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. grated orange rind
1 1/2 to 2  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  c. flaked coconut, toasted
2  Tbsp. powdered sugar (optional)
preparation: Beat cream cheese until light and fluffy.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Serve with fresh fruit.  Yields 2 cups.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
2/3  c. oil
2  c. plain flour
2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix ingredients together and drop with teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° until light brown.

name: PINEAPPLE COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. evaporated milk
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  c. coconut
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Mix flour with sugar and drain a small amount of pineapple juice.  Mix ingredients together and turn into pie shell.  Bake at 350° until rises to the top and turns golden brown.

name: ZUCCHINI PINEAPPLE BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. coarsely shredded zucchini
1 (8 1/4 oz.)  can drained crushed pineapple
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
3/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  c. finely chopped walnuts
1  c. currants
preparation: Beat eggs and blend in oil, sugar and vanilla.  Beat until thick and foamy.  With a spoon, stir in zucchini and pineapple. Combine flour, soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, walnuts and currants.  Stir into the zucchini mixture until well blended.  Divide batter into 2 greased and floured 5 x 9-inch loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Cool in pan 10 minutes then turn out onto wire racks to cool.

name: SAUSAGE BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. cornbread
1  lb. sausage, browned
1  can cream-style corn
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. Cheddar cheese
1  c. milk
1  small onion, chopped
preparation: Brown sausage and onion.  Do not drain.  Combine all other ingredients in large bowl.  Add sausage and onion.  Mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cook in 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: SUMMER SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow summer squash
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1  c. dairy sour cream
1  c. shredded carrots
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb seasoned stuffing mix
1/2  c. melted butter
preparation: In saucepan, cook sliced squash and chopped onion in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain.  Combine cream of chicken soup and sour cream.  Stir in uncooked shredded carrots.  Fold in drained squash and onion.  Separately combine stuffing mix and butter. Spread 1/2 of stuffing mixture in bottom of 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish.  Spoon vegetable mixture on top.  Sprinkle remaining stuffing over vegetables.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.

name: YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. hot water
2/3  c. Crisco oil
2/3  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/4  c. lukewarm water
1  pkg. yeast
6  c. plain flour
1  c. melted butter
preparation: Mix hot water, oil and sugar.  Let cool. Add eggs, warm water and yeast. Mix well. Add flour and mix well. Let rise 1 hour.

name: GAY'S SHRIMP AND CRAB CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
3/4  c. celery, chopped
butter
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of celery soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
2  c. cream
1  lb. crabmeat
1  lb. shrimp, cooked
2  c. wild rice, cooked
2  c. rice, cooked
2  c. cheddar cheese
1/4  lb. almonds, chopped
preparation: Sauté onion, pepper and celery in butter.  Combine all ingredients in large casserole.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: SCRAMBLED EGGS IN PUFF PASTRY* * * * *
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen puff pastry, thawed
an egg wash made by beating 2 large egg yolks with 2 tsp.  water
1  lb. mushrooms, sliced thin
1/2  c. unsalted butter
20  large eggs
white pepper to taste
1  c. Creme Fraiche (recipe to follow)
4  Tbsp. snipped chives
4  Tbsp. minced parsley leaves
cooked asparagus tips (for garnish  if desired)
preparation: Roll out the puff pastry 1/8-inch thick on a floured surface. Cut out 8 rounds with a 3 1/2 to 4-inch fluted cutter and invert them onto a buttered baking sheet.  Score the rounds lightly in a cross hatch pattern with a sharp knife; brush them with some of the egg wash and bake in the middle of a preheated 400° oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until they are golden and puffed.  Let the rounds cool on a rack while preparing the eggs.  In a large skillet, saute the mushrooms in 4 tablespoons of the butter over moderately high heat, stirring occasionally, until the liquid they give off is evaporated, then keep them warm, covered.  In a bowl, beat together the eggs, white pepper and salt to taste.  In a large heavy skillet, heat remaining butter over moderate heat until the foam starts to subside; add all but 1/2 cup of the eggs and cook the mixture, stirring constantly with a whisk, for 8 minutes or until it is very thick and creamy.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. sugar
1  c. oleo
1  c. corn oil
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Cream sugars, oleo and oil together; add remaining ingredients.  Roll into small balls; place about 1 1/2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Press with glass dipped in sugar.  Sprinkle sugar on top.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN CHIP MUFFINS
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1 1/4  c. vegetable oil
3  c. all purpose flour
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  (12 oz.) bag semisweet chocolate or butterscotch chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  In a large bowl combine eggs, sugar, pumpkin and vegetable oil.  Beat until smooth, set aside.  In a large bowl sift together flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon and salt.  Slowly add flour mixture to pumpkin mixture, stirring well.  Fold in chocolate or butterscotch chips.  Fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups with batter until three-fourths full.  Bake 16 to 20 minutes or until centers of muffins bounce back when touched.  Makes approximately 36 muffins.  Can also be made as mini-muffins.

name: ALABAMA CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  c. cream corn
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. self-rising cornmeal
1/2  c. cooking oil
pinch of salt
preparation: Beat eggs well and add to all ingredients. Preheat medium size iron skillet with oil.  Bake at 450° until done, about 30 minutes.

name: TEA BISCUITS
ingredients:
3/4  Tbsp. salt
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. warm water
1/4  c. butter or Crisco
1 1/4  c. milk
4 1/2 to 5  c. plain flour
2  cakes yeast
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water.  Put Crisco, milk, sugar and salt on stove.  Get lukewarm.  Add flour.  Mix and knead.  Let set 15 minutes.  Knead and roll.  Let stand 15 minutes, then bake at 425° for 15 minutes.

name: MEXICAN MEAL
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. frozen corn
1  can tomato sauce (6 oz.)
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. cooked macaroni
1/4  onion
3  drops red hot sauce
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Brown meat. Drain. Cook macaroni; drain. Add all ingredients to ground beef; simmer for 15 minutes.

name: SCALLOPS NICOISE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. or pts. bay scallops
3  tomatoes (about 1 lb.)
12  pitted green olives
6  pitted black olives
3  Tbsp. capers, drained
pepper
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. parsley, finely chopped
juice of 1/2 lemon
1  Tbsp. minced garlic
1  Tbsp. olive oil
preparation: Core and peel tomatoes and cut into 1/2-inch cubes.  There should be about 3 1/2 cups. Chop the olives. There should be about 3 tablespoons of the green and 1 1/2 tablespoons of the black. Saute the garlic in oil.  Add tomatoes and bring to a boil.  Add olives and capers, salt and pepper.  Cook 2 minutes.

name: HONOLULU RICE
ingredients:
4  strips bacon
1/2  lb. ground beef (if not using shrimp, use 1 lb.)
1  c. finely chopped onions
3  c. cooked rice
2  c. cleaned and cooked shrimp or canned shrimp
1/3  c. minced celery leaves
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp; remove bacon from skillet. Add ground beef and onion, cook, stirring until onion is tender. Stir remaining ingredients and heat through.

name: 4 LAYER DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick butter
1  c. powdered sugar
1  pkg. cream cheese (8 oz.)
1  c. Cool Whip (use remainder for topping)
1 big  pkg. pudding
3  c. milk
chopped nuts
preparation: Combine flour and butter.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Let cool.  Mix powdered sugar, cream cheese and 1 cup Cool Whip. Spread over cooled crust.  Mix pudding and milk.  Put over cream cheese layer and refrigerate.  Top with rest of the Cool Whip and chopped nuts.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  bunch broccoli
1 small  jar mushrooms
1/2  c. olives (black)
2  boiled eggs
2  tsp. lemon juice
1  c. mayonnaise
1  envelope original Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
preparation: Wash and drain broccoli; cut off tops and use in salad.  Mix 1 cup mayonnaise and the Ranch dressing together.  Add the rest of ingredients and mix well.

name: CHICKEN BREAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  large chicken breasts, skinless and boneless
8  slices of bacon (or less)
1 - 4  ounce jar chipped beef (or package of loose)
1  can mushroom soup (or chicken or celery)
1/2  pint sour cream
preparation: Cut chicken breasts in half, wrap in bacon.  Line bottom of pan with chipped beef, lay chicken on top and pour over it a mixture of soup and sour cream.  Refrigerate overnight.  Bake for three hours at 275 degrees, uncovered.  Serve with rice.  The chicken breasts can be cut into quarters for smaller servings.  The sauce can be doubled and the chipped beef can be doubled.

name: TEX-MEX MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. all-purpose flour
4 1/2  oz. uncooked yellow cornmeal
2  Tbsp. each granulated sugar and double-acting baking powder
5  oz. cooked turkey sausage
3  oz. reduced-fat Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  c. low-fat buttermilk
1/2  c. drained salsa
1/3  c. less 1 tsp. vegetable oil
3  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. light sour cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Spray 12 (2 1/2-inch) muffin pans with nonstick spray.  In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, cornmeal, sugar and baking powder. Stir to combine.  Add scrambled sausage and cheese.  Stir thoroughly.

name: YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1/4  c. warm water
1  pkg. dry yeast
2  Tbsp. sugar
buttermilk
1/2  c. Crisco
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Mix sugar and Crisco like you were making biscuits.  Add flour.  Add yeast water and buttermilk. Mix well and roll.  Let sit for 30 minutes.  Bake at 450° until brown.

name: DEEP DISH PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1  c. milk
1  stick butter
dash of cinnamon or allspice
4  c. cooked fruit
preparation: Melt butter in baking dish.  Blend flour, sugar and milk and pour over butter.  Add fruit on top of mixture.  Crust will form on top.  Bake in 300° oven until brown.

name: NACHO AND SAUSAGE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  lb. sausage
1  small onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. hot Mexican Velveeta
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Brown sausage, hamburger and onion together.  Drain; cube cheese and mix cheese and mushroom soup together.  Cook in microwave until melted.  Stir in meat and onion.

name: FROZEN DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
5 1/2 to 6 1/2  c. unsifted flour
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  pkg. dry yeast
1 1/4  c. water
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. margarine
2  eggs (at room temperature)
preparation: In a large bowl thoroughly  mix 2 cups flour, sugar, salt and undissolved dry yeast.   Combine water, milk and margarine over low heat until liquids are very warm (120° to 130°); margarine does not need to melt.  Gradually add to dry ingredients and beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer, scraping bowl occasionally.  Stir in enough additional flour to make a soft dough.  Turn out onto lightly floured board; knead until smooth and elastic, about 8 to 10 minutes.  Cover with plastic wrap, then a towel and let rest 20 minutes.

name: GINGERSNAPS
ingredients:
2/3  c. Crisco
1  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. molasses
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Beat Crisco, sugar, molasses and eggs until fluffy.  Combine dry ingredients together and add to molasses mixture.  Roll into 1 inch balls and then roll in granulated sugar.  Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: VENISON CHILI
ingredients:
1/2  c. beef suet
2  lb. ground venison
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  tsp. paprika
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. white pepper
2  tsp. diced chili pods
preparation: Fry suet in heavy kettle.  Add venison.  Cook, stirring, until browned.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Add enough water to cover.  Cook slowly for 4 to 5 hours, stirring occasionally, adding water as needed for desired consistency.  Serve with pinto beans.  Freezes well.

name: CHILI STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
4  large bell peppers
1/2  lb. extra lean beef or ground turkey
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
2  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. cumin
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans, drained
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato puree
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies (undrained)
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Cut bell peppers lengthwise in half. Remove seeds and membranes.  Place peppers, cut side up, in rectangular 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Cook ground beef or turkey and onion in 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until meat is brown.  Drain.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Heat to boiling; reduce heat.  Cover and simmer 10 minutes, stirring frequently.  Divide meat mixture evenly among peppers.  Cover and bake 40 to 45 minutes or until peppers are tender.

name: PORK CHOPS A LA JODI
ingredients:
10  to 12 boneless, center cut chops (1/4 inch thick)
salt and pepper
flour
1/2  c. butter
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
paprika
preparation: Season chops with salt and pepper.  Coat chops with flour, shaking excess.  In large skillet, brown both sides in butter.  In shallow casserole dish, place chops in overlapping rows.  Spoon pan drippings over chops.  Spread soup over chops.  Sprinkle with cheese and paprika.  Preheat oven at 350° and bake, covered, for 10 minutes.  Remove cover and bake another 15 to 20 minutes. Excellent over cooked rice and peas.

name: TAPPER DOUGH
ingredients:
9  c. flour
1 1/2  c. scalded milk
1 1/2  c. cool water
2  tsp. salt
4  eggs, beaten
2  pkg. yeast
preparation: Put flour in a very large bowl (that has a sealed cover). Make a well in the center.  Add milk, water, sugar, salt and eggs. Then sprinkle with yeast.  Do not mix.  Seal lid; let set one hour.  Remove seal; add 1 cup melted margarine.  Mix together and knead dough.  (May need more flour.)  Reseal.  When the lid pops off, the dough is ready to shape into rolls, etc.

name: PORK AND BEAN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. raisins
1  c. boiling water
3  eggs
1  c. vegetable oil
2  c. sugar
1 (16 oz.)  can pork and beans, undrained and mashed
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. flour
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Place raisins in boiling water; set aside.  (Drain off water before adding raisins to batter.)  Blend eggs, oil and sugar together.  Add mashed pork and beans.  Add vanilla and dry ingredients.  Fold in raisins.  Add nuts if desired.  Grease and flour 2 standard loaf pans.  Bake in 325° oven for 60 to 70 minutes.  Makes 2 loaves.

name: Spinach Casserole
ingredients:
1  pkg. spinach, thawed
12  oz. cottage cheese
salt and lemon pepper
1  c. grated Cheddar
3  eggs, beaten
preparation: Blend ingredients.  Place in greased 9 x 9-inch casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. elbow macaroni, cooked
2  c. cooked, peeled and deveined shrimp
1  Tbsp. seasoned salt
5  green onions, chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
2  hard-boiled eggs, diced
lettuce
preparation: Combine  macaroni,  shrimp,  salt,  onions, mayonnaise, parsley flakes and eggs, mixing well.  Chill 1 hour.  Serve on crisp lettuce.  Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: BROWNIE PUDDING DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. shortening or margarine
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Sift dry ingredients; add milk, vanilla and shortening.  Pour into 8 x 8-inch pan.  Mix 3/4 cup brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa; sprinkle over batter on top.  Pour 1 3/4 cup hot water over and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.  Pudding will form on bottom.

name: BEET RELISH
ingredients:
1qt. cabbage, chopped
1  qt. boiled beets, finely chopped
2  c. sugar
1  c. horseradish - drained
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  c. cider vinegar
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

name: TUNA NOODLE CASSEROLE(Serves 4)
ingredients:
8  oz. fine egg noodles, cooked
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can tuna (solid white meat)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  onion, minced
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. milk (may need less)
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese + 2 Tbsp.
preparation: Saute onion in butter in small, flat (stove top-proof) casserole dish.  Add tuna, breaking up meat and mixing with onions.  Add cooked noodles.  Mix.  Add soup and mix well.  Add milk to moisten.  (You don't want to see liquid in bottom of dish.)  Mix well.  Add 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese; mix well. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese over top of mixture.  Dot with butter.  Bake in 350° oven 30 to 40 minutes until bubbly. Recipe may be doubled.

name: NO COOK FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
4  Tbsp. butter
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
2  c. small marshmallows
1/2 to 1  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Line an 8 or 9-inch pan with foil.  Melt chocolate chips, 2 tablespoons butter, vanilla and milk.  Stir in salt.  Remove from heat.  Add nuts.  Spread in pan.  Melt marshmallows with 2 tablespoons butter.  Spoon over fudge.  Swirl with knife. Refrigerate 2 hours.  Store at room temperature.

name: DRESSING
ingredients:
1  large skillet of cornbread
6 to 8  slices bread
2  cans cream of chicken soup
2  cans chicken broth
1  Tbsp. poultry seasoning
1  Tbsp. ground sage
salt and pepper to taste
1 1/2 to 2  c. sauteed onion and celery
preparation: Mix all ingredients together. Put in an oiled pan and bake for approximately 30 to 45 minutes at 400°.

name: CLASSIC TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans tuna (6 1/8 oz.)
1 small  can sliced mushrooms
1  small bag egg noodles
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  c. Italian style bread crumbs
6  Tbsp. Heritage butter
6  Tbsp. flour
3  c. Heritage milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: First you make a white sauce.  In a medium saucepan, melt butter on low heat.  When butter is completely melted, add flour and a dash of salt and pepper.  Whisk together; when mixture begins to sizzle slightly in the pan, add milk and stir.  Raise heat slightly and continue to stir until mixture thickens.  When sauce has reached thickness of gravy, lower heat and set aside until needed.  Cook egg noodles as directed on package.  Drain thoroughly.  In a large casserole dish, empty both cans of tuna and mushrooms, well-drained.  Mix these ingredients in casserole. Put in drained cooked egg noodles, grated Cheddar cheese and white sauce.  Mix together until completely creamed.  Top with Italian bread crumbs.  Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: WINTER FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. Pillsbury refrigerator sugar cookies
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
fresh or canned pineapple slices, drained
maraschino cherries, cut in half
Mandarin oranges, drained
kiwi fruit, peeled and sliced
1/4  c. orange marmalade
1  Tbsp. water
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Slice cookie dough as directed on package. Arrange slices in bottom of 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.  Using floured fingers, press dough evenly into pan.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.  Cool.

name: RAVIOLI PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
Marzetti or Candicci's creamy Italian dressing
7  oz. pkg. mini cheese ravioli (found in dried pasta aisle)
1  red bell pepper, diced
1  bunch broccoli flowerets
2  carrots, chopped
black olives, sliced
preparation: Boil mini ravioli for 20 minutes.  Towel dry.  Add vegetables and toss with Italian dressing.  (If taking to a pot luck, toss with only half the jar of dressing at home and add the remaining dressing when you arrive)

name: MY MOTHER'S MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
2  c. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
1  can (28 oz.) tomatoes with liquid, cut up
1/2  tsp. onion salt (optional)
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese, divided
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Combine macaroni, tomatoes, onion salt, pepper and 1 1/2 cups Cheddar cheese. Pour into greased 2-quart baking dish.   Dot with butter.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.   Sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Bake 15 minutes longer.  Yields 4 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE TRUFFLE CAKE
ingredients:
16  oz. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1  stick unsalted butter
1 1/2  tsp. flour
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. hot water
4  eggs, separated
1  c. heavy cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Grease bottom of spring-form pan.  Melt chocolate and butter in top of double boiler.  Add flour, sugar and water; blend well.  Beat egg whites until stiff, not dry, and set aside.

name: CUCUMBER HOR D'OEUVRES
ingredients:
3  oz. cream cheese
1 1/2  tsp. Good Seasons Italian dressing mix
1  or 2 cucumbers, sliced
dill weed
1  loaf party rye
preparation: Mix cream cheese and dressing mix.  Spread on rye bread.  Top with cucumber slice and sprinkle on dill weed.

name: APLETS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. grated apples
4  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. unflavored gelatin
1  c. applesauce
2  c. chopped nuts
2  tsp. vanilla
powdered sugar
preparation: Combine grated apples with sugar in heavy pan.  Slowly bring to boil.  Soften gelatin in applesauce.  Add to cooked apple mix. Bring to full boil for 15 minutes.  Stir constantly.  Remove from heat.  Add nuts and vanilla.

name: CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. cornmeal
1/4  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together. Add milk and egg to dry ingredients; mix. Pour into a greased skillet or pan. Bake at 400° to 450° until brown.

name: QUICK BLACK FOREST CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  box chocolate cake mix
dash of almond extract
1  can (21 oz.) cherry pie filling
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. milk
5  Tbsp. butter
6  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Beat eggs with almond extract.  Add pie filling and cake mix. Mix until blended, batter will be lumpy.  Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes until it tests done in the center.  While cake is cooling, boil together sugar, milk and butter.  Add chocolate chips and stir until blended. Spread on warm cake.  Store cake in refrigerator.

name: TWO'S COMPANY CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
1  large chicken breast, split
salt and pepper to taste
1 1/4  lb. sliced mushrooms
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1  can prepared spaghetti sauce
1  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Place chicken breasts, skin side up, into a small shallow baking dish.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Top with mushrooms and green pepper.  Pour sauce over chicken.  Cover dish with foil; bake 35 minutes at 350°.  Remove foil; top chicken with cheese. Return to oven uncovered and bake 10 more minutes.

name: PARTY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
4 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 small  jar pimento, chopped fine and drained
2  pkg. beef-flavored instant broth
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. lemon juice
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. grated Cheddar cheese
1  can crab meat, drained and chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl.  This recipe will make 1 large or 2 medium balls.  Form ball with your hands and roll onto a plate that has finely chopped walnuts or pecans. Cover with foil and refrigerate.  Serve with your favorite crackers.

name: GUACAMOLE DIP
ingredients:
1  ripe avocado
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. chili powder (or to taste)
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. grated onion
1  tsp. lime juice
preparation: Peel avocado, remove pit and mash.  Blend in other ingredients and beat until light and creamy.

name: LOW-FAT BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  c. 100% bran cereal
1/3  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. applesauce
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1 1/4  c. skim milk
1  single Egg Beater
1  c. raisins
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda and cinnamon in large bowl.  Mix cereal, milk and sugar in another bowl.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Stir in Egg Beater and applesauce. Add to flour mixture.  Stir just until moistened.  (Batter will be lumpy.)

name: SAVORY PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak (1/2-inch thick)
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. cooking oil
1 (8 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 3/4  c. water
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 small  clove garlic
1  Tbsp. gravy  base
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  large bell peppers
preparation: Cut steak into strips and coat with mixture of flour, salt and pepper. Brown strips in oil in large skillet.   Drain tomatoes, reserving liquid.

name: LAYERED GARDEN PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (7 to 8 oz.)  pkg. macaroni shells
1/2  c. sliced green onions
1/2  c. bacon bits
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. lemon juice
3  tsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
4  c. bite size salad greens
1  medium zucchini, sliced
1  c. sliced cauliflowerets
1  c. broccoli flowerets
2  medium tomatoes, cut into wedges
preparation: Cook macaroni as per package directions and drain.  Rinse with cold water; drain again.  Stir together macaroni, onions and bacon bits in medium bowl.  Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice, cheese, sugar and garlic powder.  In 3 1/2-quart salad bowl, layer salad greens, macaroni mixture, zucchini and cauliflowerets.  On top of this, layer broccoli and tomatoes.  Pour dressing evenly over top.  Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours.  Sprinkle with bacon bits just before serving.  Refrigerate only remaining salad.  Makes 10 servings.

name: SPINACH DIP IN FRENCH BREAD BOWL
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
3  to 4 green onions, chopped
1  can chopped water chestnuts
1  box Knorr leek soup mix
1  round loaf Cottage Bakery sourdough bread (unsliced)
preparation: Cook spinach; cool and drain.  Mix with all other ingredients. Cut off top of French bread and hollow out the inside to use as a bowl.  Cut the top and bread removed from the inside into pieces that are the right size for dipping.  Stuff the hollow bread bowl with dip.

name: BUTTERMILK SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can undrained crushed pineapple
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange jello
2  c. buttermilk
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Bring pineapple to a boil.  Stir in jello until dissolved. Remove from heat and stir in buttermilk.  Cool to room temperature.  Fold in cool whip.  Pour into 2 quart mold or bowl and chill.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, cooked
1  c. broth
1  can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. dry stuffing mix
preparation: Pinch chicken off of bone.  Mix with other ingredients and put in dish.  Pour dry stuffing mix into bowl.  Melt 1 stick of butter; pour over stuffing and mix well.  Pour this over other mixture. Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

name: SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. hot cooked rice
1/4  c. French dressing
3/4  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. white pepper
3  drops of hot sauce
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  c. diced celery
1 1/2  c. cooked peas
2  cans shrimp
lettuce
preparation: Combine rice and French dressing; cool to room temperature. Mix mayonnaise, onion and seasonings.  Place celery and peas in large mixing bowl; pour in mayonnaise mixture.  Add rice mixture, toss lightly with fork.  Chill salad well.  Drain and chill shrimp. Add shrimp to salad just before serving.  Turn salad into lettuce lined bowl.  Garnish with tomato wedges.  Makes 8 servings.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick butter
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. sugar
1  pkg. cream cheese (8 oz.)
9  oz. Cool Whip
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Mix flour, butter and chopped nuts together.  Press in bottom of pan and bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until brown.  Mix sugar, cream cheese and Cool Whip together.  Spread over cooled crust. Spread cherry pie filling on top and chill.

name: MACARONI-PINEAPPLE TOSS
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. elbow macaroni
2 (20 oz. each)  cans crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  large stalk celery, chopped
3/4  c. mayo or salad dressing
1/3  c. maraschino cherry halves
preparation: Cook macaroni as directed on package.  Rinse with cold water. Toss with remaining ingredients.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.

name: TACO PIE(Microwave)
ingredients:
3  c. taco chips, crushed
1  can (16 oz.) refried beans
1  lb. ground chuck
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1  c. shredded lettuce
1  large tomato, chopped
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
taco sauce
preparation: Crush taco chips in paper bag, using rolling pin to lightly go over chips 2 or 3 times.  Place in pie plate.  Press refried beans against taco chips, using a wooden spoon, to form a shell.  Set aside.  Brown meat in a mixing bowl.  Microwave 8 to 10 minutes on High, stirring occasionally.  Add taco seasoning mix and recommended amount of water according to package directions. Microwave 5 minutes on High until mixture is at a boil.  Reduce setting to Medium for 3 to 5 minutes or thick.  Fill crust with filling.  Micro for 3 to 5 minutes on High.  Top with lettuce, tomato, cheese and sauce.

name: MINT TULIP
ingredients:
1  c. slightly crushed mint leaves
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
3/4  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. orange juice
1 1/2  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Mix  all ingredients, except ginger ale.  Let stand for at least  an  hour.  Strain.  Add  ginger  ale.  Pour over ice cubes.

name: LEMON PUDDING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. milk
1  pkg. Jell-O instant lemon pudding
1  (8-inch) graham cracker crust
preparation: Soften cream cheese; blend with 1/2 cup milk.  Add 1 1/2 cups milk and the pudding mix; beat slowly with egg beater just until well mixed, about 1 minute (do not overbeat).  Pour at once into graham cracker crust; sprinkle graham cracker crumbs lightly over top.  Chill about 1 hour.  Serves 8.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE DESSERT
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake, broken in pieces
1  (16 oz.) Cool Whip, thawed
2 small  pkg. jello chocolate instant pudding, prepared according to box directions
6  Skor candy bars, broken into small chips
preparation: Layer in a large glass bowl in the following order: cake pieces, pudding, Cool Whip and candy pieces.  Repeat until there are 2 or 3 layers of each.

name: MARINATED SLAW
ingredients:
1  large cabbage
1  medium green pepper
1  medium onion
2  or 3 carrots, hand grated
1  Tbsp. salt
1/4  c. Mazola oil
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
preparation: Chop cabbage, pepper, onion and mix with grated carrots.  Mix 1 cup sugar and salt.  Pour over vegetables.  Heat vinegar, oil and 2 tablespoons sugar until sugar dissolves, about 5 minutes.  Cool slightly.  Pour over all other ingredients and stir well.  Put in glass or stoneware jar only.  Cover and let set for 24 hours.

name: SIX LAYER DINNER
ingredients:
2  c. sliced raw potatoes
2  c. chopped celery
1  c. sliced onion
1  lb. ground beef or turkey
1  c. sliced green pepper
2  c. tomatoes (1 tall can)
preparation: Place ingredients in layers in greased casserole dish.  Season each layer using 2 teaspoons salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Garnish with green pepper slices.  Bake at 350° for 2 hours. Serves 6.

name: EASY SUPPER(Kids' Recipe)
ingredients:
1  box scalloped potato mix
1/2  c. frozen peas (optional)
1  can shredded ham
preparation: Prepare potatoes according to directions.  Add ham and peas. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: BEEF AND RICE FIESTA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1 1/2  c. water
1  can "golden" cream of mushroom soup
1  can whole corn or Mexican corn, drained
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1 1/2  c. Minute rice (uncooked)
1  can tomatoes
1  green pepper, cut into strips
preparation: Brown beef in skillet, leaving meat in large chunks. Add onion and cook over medium heat until tender. Add water, soup, corn, salt and chili powder. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice. Add tomatoes and green peppers; cover and simmer 5 minutes.

name: SHISH KABOB
ingredients:
2  lb. sirloin tip steak (2 inches thick)
1  bell pepper
1  onion
4  mushrooms
1  medium squash (yellow or zucchini)
1  c. Italian dressing
