1  c. teriyaki marinade
preparation: You will need 4 skewers for this recipe.

name: BUTTERFINGER CAKE
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake mix
1  can Eagle Brand
1  jar caramel ice cream topping
1  (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
2  Butterfinger candy bars
preparation: Bake cake  as  instructed.  Cool and punch holes in it. Pour Eagle  Brand  over	cake.  Top  with  1/2  jar of caramel topping. Add  Cool  Whip over that. Crush candy bars over top. Refrigerate.

name: CARAMEL CRACKERS
ingredients:
2 (9 oz.)  boxes Ritz Bits crackers
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. dry roasted peanuts
1  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Preheat oven to 250°.  Combine crackers and nuts in a greased, large shallow baking pan.    In a saucepan, bring butter, sugar and corn syrup to a boil.  Cook for 5 minutes on low heat.  Remove from heat.   Add vanilla and soda.  Pour caramel mixture over crackers and nuts.  Stir well.  Bake 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.  Pour onto waxed paper and break apart.  Allow to cool. Store in airtight container.

name: CHILE RELLENOS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  can whole green chiles
1  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1/2  lb. Jack cheese, grated
4  eggs
2  Tbsp. flour
1 tall  can evaporated milk
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Rinse chiles and remove seeds.  Place half of the chiles in a layer in a greased casserole dish.  Sprinkle with half of both cheeses.  Add remaining chiles.  Top with remaining cheese.  Beat eggs, flour, milk and salt together until smooth.  Pour over casserole and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. crushed pretzels
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. melted butter
1 (6 oz.)  box strawberry jello
2  c. boiling water
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Crush pretzels.  Mix together pretzels, 1/2 cup sugar and butter.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Beat together Cool Whip, cream cheese and 1 cup sugar.  Spread on cooled crust.  Add boiling water to jello.  When jello is thoroughly mixed, add strawberries.  Place jello in refrigerator until partially set.  Place on top of salad.  Refrigerate, covered.

name: CHICKEN DELICIOUS
ingredients:
4  whole chicken breasts, boned and halved
lemon juice, salt, pepper, celery salt and paprika to taste
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1  can condensed cream of celery soup
1/2  c. dry sherry or white wine
grated Parmesan cheese
fluffy rice
preparation: Rinse chicken breasts and pat dry.  Season with lemon juice, salt, pepper, celery salt and paprika.  Place in crock-pot.  In a medium bowl or pan, mix mushroom and celery soups with sherry. Pour over chicken breasts.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Cover and cook on low setting for 8 to 10 hours.  Serve chicken and sauce over hot fluffy rice.  Makes 8 to 12 servings (about 3 quarts).

name: JOG IN A JUG
ingredients:
2  (64 oz.) apple juice
2  (64 oz.) grape juice
1  pt. apple cider vinegar
16  oz. grape juice
32  oz. apple juice
4  oz. apple cider vinegar
preparation: About 6 ounces at bed time.

name: SQUASH AND SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  medium onion
2  lb. yellow squash
1  carrot, grated
1  c. sour cream
4  oz. seasoned bread crumbs
1  stick butter, melted
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Cook sausage and drain.  Cook squash and drain.  Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into baking dish.  Bake at 375° until bubbly.

name: BANANA SPLIT
ingredients:
1  whole banana
3  scoops ice cream
optional ingredients
preparation: Take a whole banana, then take 3 scoops ice cream and place them on the banana, then add the ingredients that you would like on top of the banana and the ice cream.  Then eat and enjoy.

name: TUNA NOODLE BAKE
ingredients:
8  oz. uncooked wide egg noodles
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
2/3  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. dairy sour cream
1 (6 1/8 oz.)  can tuna, drained and flaked
1  c. canned sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. frozen peas, thawed and drained
1/4  c. onion, finely chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  Tbsp. olive oil
2  lb. lean ground beef
1  c. finely chopped onion
1 large  clove garlic, crushed and chopped
1  tsp. dried basil
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cumin
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes, chopped
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (14 oz.)  can Bush's pinto beans, drained
2  c. corn chips
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a 10 to 12-inch skillet over medium heat, place olive oil. Crumble ground beef into skillet and cook until all pink is gone. Add onion, garlic, basil, chili powder, salt, cumin and cayenne pepper. Stir and cook until onion is tender. Add stewed tomatoes, tomato sauce and pinto beans. Bring to a boil; lower heat and simmer 10 to 12 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. finely chopped nuts
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
2  tsp. vanilla extract
2  c. shredded zucchini
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, well drained
preparation: Combine flour, soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon and nuts (set aside).  Beat eggs lightly in a large mixing bowl.  Add sugar, oil and vanilla.  Beat until creamy.  Mix in zucchini and pineapple.  Add dry ingredients, stirring only until dry ingredients are moistened.  Spoon batter into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for about 50 minutes and test.  Cool 10 minutes before removing from pans. Turn onto rack and cool.

name: DRESSING
ingredients:
2  qt. cornbread, crumbed
2  qt. biscuits, crumbled
1  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. sage
2  Tbsp. poultry seasoning
turkey or chicken broth or mixture made of 1 c. hot water, 1/4 c. margarine and 1 bouillon cube
may also use pecans, chopped apples or raisins
preparation: Mix all ingredients well in large pan, then add enough broth to moisten the mixture well.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbling hot.  Serve with baked turkey, chicken, duck, goose, bear, venison, antelope or your choice of meat and giblet gravy.

name: SWEET CHOPS
ingredients:
pork chops (preferably boneless loin chops)
1 large  can cream of mushroom soup
large white onion
brown sugar
Havarti cheese (optional)
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Spray nonstick spray in casserole dish. Place half of soup mix on bottom of dish with 2 tablespoons of water and mix.  Place chops in dish.  Sprinkle brown sugar on chops (enough sugar to cover each chop).  Pour the rest of mushroom soup over chops.  Slice onion over chops.

name: CHICKEN-TACO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  chicken, cut up
1  can mushroom soup
1  chopped onion
1 large  pkg. corn chips
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
pepper
1  can enchilada sauce
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Boil chicken and remove from bone.  Reserve 1 cup broth.  Cut chicken into bite size pieces.  Combine chicken, sauce, soup, onion, garlic, salt and pepper. Line a greased baking dish with part of corn chips.  Add chicken mixture, sprinkle with grated cheese.  Cover with remaining corn chips.  Add broth.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SHRIMP IN GARLIC BUTTER
ingredients:
12  oz. shrimp, peeled and deveined *
3  cloves garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. dry sherry
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
preparation: Thaw shrimp, if frozen.  In a large skillet, heat margarine over medium high heat.  Add shrimp and garlic.  Cook, stirring frequently for 1 to 3 minutes or until shrimp turn pink.  Stir in parsley and sherry.

name: SWEDISH YAMZETTE(Casserole)
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
3  medium onions, chopped
1  green pepper
2  sticks celery, diced
2  carrots, diced
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. noodles (wide)
1  can tomato soup
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  lb. medium sharp Cheddar cheese, cubed
salt and pepper
preparation: Brown meat; drain.  Brown onions, celery, carrots and green pepper.  Cook noodles in salt water; drain.  Rinse and drain again.  Mix all together, adding cheese last.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Bake 1 hour at 300°.

name: HAM AND POTATO PIE(Main Dish)
ingredients:
6  large potatoes
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. pie crust mix
3  Tbsp. flour
1  c. Cheddar cheese
1  large onion, sliced
2  c. ham, cubed
1  Tbsp. margarine
2  garlic, minced
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. milk
1  egg yolk
1/2  c. light cream
preparation: Peel potatoes, sliced very thin, covered with cold water. Make pie crust mix.  Follow directions on package.  Preheat oven to 350°.

name: A FAVORITE RICE DISH
ingredients:
3  c. prepared Minute rice
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. milk
1 small  can diced green chiles
1  c. grated cheese
1  tsp. paprika
preparation: Mix sour cream and milk.  Layer rice, cheese, sour cream and chiles in casserole.  Top with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: SOUTHERN BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1/3  c. butter
2/3  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Mix softened butter with flour mixture. Add buttermilk. Knead dough on floured surface 4 or 5 times.  Roll dough out and cut biscuits.  Put on buttered tray and cook in oven, preheated at 450°, until brown.

name: SALMON CHOWDER
ingredients:
1  large onion, sliced thin
2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. thin sliced potatoes
4  c. hot water
1  lb. salmon
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
2  c. hot milk
8  to 12 crackers
2  hard-boiled eggs
preparation: Fry onion in butter until golden brown.  Add remaining ingredients, except milk, crackers and eggs.  Boil gently for 30 minutes.  Add hot milk.  Let it boil up once.

name: HONEY MILK BALLS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. peanut butter
1/4  c. honey syrup, molasses or jelly
1/2  c. nonfat dry milk
1/2  c. crushed cereal flakes
preparation: Mix peanut butter with your choice of honey syrup, molasses or jelly.  Add dry milk a little at a time.  Mix well after each addition.  Form into small balls, about 3/4 across, using your hands.  Roll the balls in crushed flakes.  Chill until firm. Makes small balls.

name: ORANGE BLOSSOMS
ingredients:
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. sour cream
2  c. sugar
2  sticks butter
2 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream together sugar and butter.  Mix in sour cream and eggs. In a separate bowl, mix dry ingredients together.  Add flour mixture to batter and mix well.  Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.  Remove from oven to wire racks to cool slightly.

name: PERFECTION SALAD
ingredients:
2  envelopes (2 Tbsp.) unflavored gelatin
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  c. finely shredded cabbage
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. chopped canned pimento
preparation: Mix gelatin, sugar and 1 teaspoon salt.  Add 1 1/2 cup boiling water and stir until gelatin dissolves.  Add 1 1/2 cup cold water, vinegar and lemon juice.  Chill until partially set.  Add vegetables.  Pour into 6 1/2 cup ring mold.  Chill until firm. Unmold on crisp greens.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: BREAKFAST SOUFFLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. bulk pork sausage
9  slightly beaten eggs
2  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. salt
3  slices white bread, cut in 1/2-inch cubes
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown crumbled meat; drain.  Mix eggs, milk, mustard and salt. Stir in bread cubes, sausage and cheese.  Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Refrigerate, covered, overnight.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/3  c. cocoa
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. uncooked rolled oats
1/2  c. nut meats
preparation: Mix sugar, cocoa, butter and milk.  Boil 1 minute in saucepan. Add peanut butter.  Add oats.  Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper and chill until firm in refrigerator.

name: SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box raisins
4  c. water
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. or 4 Tbsp. shortening
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
4  c. flour
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Cook 1 box raisins in 4 cups water until well blended.  Mix 2 cups of the warm raisin juice, 2 cups sugar, shortening, spices and vanilla until well blended.  Add dry ingredients and beat well after each addition.  Add raisins and chopped nuts.

name: OLD FASHIONED STEW
ingredients:
1/3  recipe Basic Stew Mixture (1 qt.)
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. paprika
dash of pepper
1  bay leaf
6  carrots, quartered
4  potatoes, quartered
1/4  c. flour
preparation: In Dutch oven, combine stew, 1 1/2 cups water, salt, Worcestershire sauce, paprika, pepper and bay leaf. Cover and cook on low heat about 20 minutes. Add carrots and potatoes until tender. Remove bay leaf. Blend flour with 1/2 cup water. Stir slowly into hot liquid. Cook and stir until thickened. Makes 6 servings.

name: PORCUPINE MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. rice
1  Tbsp. onion
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can tomato soup
3/4  c. water
preparation: Mix ground beef, rice, onion, salt and pepper.  Shape into balls.  Place in pressure cooker.  Mix tomato soup with water. Pour over meatballs.  Jiggle for 10 minutes at 10 pounds pressure.

name: VEGETABLE PANCAKES
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
dash of red pepper
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/8  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. diced onion
1/4  c. diced sweet red pepper
1/2  c. shredded carrot
1  c. shredded yellow squash
1  c. shredded potato
1/2  c. commercial sour cream
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
preparation: Combine  flour,  salt,  poultry  seasoning, red pepper, eggs and  Worcestershire  sauce.  Stir  in  onion,  diced red pepper, carrot, squash and potato.

name: MOM'S RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
3 or 4  c. rice
3 or 3 1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook rice in 3 or 3 1/2 cups of milk.  Mix in a bowl eggs, sugar, cinnamon and vanilla.  After rice is done, add bowl mixture into rice; then cook until thickened.

name: CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. lukewarm water
2  pkg. yeast (quick rise is best)
1  box yellow cake mix
1  c. all-purpose flour
3  eggs
1/3  c. oil
1   tsp. salt
5 1/4  c. flour
soft margarine
sugar
cinnamon
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water for about 3 minutes.  Add cake mix, 1 cup flour, eggs, oil and salt.  Beat with beater until bubbles appear.  Slowly add 5 1/4 cups flour.  Stir with spoon, making a soft dough.  Knead on board for about 5 minutes.

name: AUNT ESTHER'S CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  c. cocoa
1  egg
1/2  c. sour milk
1/2  c. peanut oil
1/2  c. boiling water
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Sift together flour, sugar, salt and cocoa.  Make hole in middle of dry ingredients.  Drop egg in hole.  Add milk, oil, water and soda.  Mix gently.  Pour into glass loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: PANCAKE SEA PRISE
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  cans tuna
1  grated onion
1/2  c. cracker crumbs
1  tsp. chopped parsley flakes
preparation: Mix all the ingredients together. Shape into 6 thick pancakes and fry until brown on each side. Can top with a white sauce or creamed peas.

name: MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cloves
2  tsp. cinnamon
4  Tbsp. molasses
3/4  c. shortening
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. ginger
1  egg
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients together.  Roll in ball size of a walnut and  dip  in  sugar,  flatten  in palm of hand, put on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350°.

name: VELVEETA CHEESE FUDGE
ingredients:
2  lb. confectioners sugar
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
1  stick butter
preparation: Melt cheese and butter; add remaining ingredients.  Spread in 13 x 8 x 2-inch buttered pan.  Cut into pieces.

name: ICEBOX FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  box Ritz or Town House crackers, crushed
1 large  pkg. miniature marshmallows
1  can Pet evaporated milk
1  large (1 lb.) container mixed candied fruit
1 1/2  c. light seedless raisins
1  c. coconut
1  1/2 chopped nuts
preparation: Heat evaporated milk and marshmallows over low heat in a heavy saucepan.  Stir constantly until all the marshmallows have dissolved.  Remove from heat; add crushed crackers.  Mix well and let cool enough so you could mix with hands.  Add all remaining ingredients and mix well.  Pack in pound cake pan that has been lightly greased with butter.  Refrigerate.  To remove from pan, place bottom of pan in warm water for a few minutes.

name: SPINACH SOUFFLE
ingredients:
3  pkg. frozen spinach
1  pkg. Lipton beefy-onion soup mix
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Combine ingredients (spinach should be cooked already and drained).  Place in greased casserole and top with 1/2 cup grated cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: RAISIN PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  cup sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. vinegar
1/2  cup raisins
1/2  cup pecans broken in pieces
1  tsp. cinnamon
lump of butter
preparation: Mix sugar, egg yolks, vinegar, cinnamon and butter.  Stir in raisins and pecans.  Beat egg whites until stiff.  Fold into mixture.  Pour filling into a 9 inch unbaked pie crust and bake at 300 degrees for 35 minutes.  Serve with cool whip.  Serves 4-6.

name: PECAN DREAMS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
1/4  c. confectioners sugar
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Mix butter, sugar and flour.  Spread in 11 x 15-inch pan. Beat eggs until light and add brown sugar.  Add flour and baking powder, which has been sifted together.  Mix well, until smooth and stir in pecans.  Spread over top of first mixture and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Remove from oven and cut into 1 1/2-inch squares.  Makes 60 squares.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  (14 oz.) Eagle Brand milk
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  (16 oz.) cranberry sauce
1  (20 oz.) crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  c. chopped walnuts (optional)
1  (9 oz.) whipped topping
preparation: Combine all ingredients, folding in whipped topping last.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage
1  can cream of chicken
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
10  or 12 Ritz crackers
preparation: Cook medium head of cabbage in salt water until tender. Drain after done.  Pour into buttered casserole.  Pour undiluted cream of chicken soup over cabbage.  Add 1 1/2 cups of grated cheese.  Add Ritz cracker crumbs on top.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

name: KENTUCKY HOT BROWNS
ingredients:
thinly sliced ham and turkey
toast
tomato slices
partially cooked bacon strips
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  c. flour
2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Make toast and trim.  Make cheese sauce by melting margarine and stirring in flour.  Slowly add milk, grated cheese, Parmesan cheese, salt and Worcestershire.  Cook, stirring constantly, until thick.  Arrange thinly sliced turkey and ham slices on toast. Cover with hot cheese sauce.  Top with tomato slices and partially cooked bacon strips.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Broil in oven until brown.

name: PICKLES
ingredients:
6  c. sliced cucumbers
1  c. diced green peppers
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1  c. diced onion
1  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Put pickles, peppers and onion in a bowl.  Mix sugar, salt, celery seed and vinegar. Stir until sugar dissolves.  Pour over pickles and put in refrigerator.  Leave for 24 hours.  Will last a long time.

name: BLACK FOREST BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  box devil's food cake mix
1  can cherry pie filling
2  eggs
1  tsp. almond flavoring (optional)
preparation: Combine ingredients, mixing these by hand. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan.  Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 25 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY LIMON PUNCH
ingredients:
2 (10 oz. each)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed
2  Tbsp. grenadine
2 (1 liter each)  bottles ginger ale, chilled
1 (1 liter)  bottle seltzer, chilled
ice cubes
lemon and lime slices for garnish
preparation: Puree strawberries in  blender	or food processor until smooth.  Pour into	large pitcher.	Stir in juice concentrates and grenadine.   Refrigerate.	 Just	before	serving,  pour strawberry mixture into large  punch bowl.	Pour in ginger ale and seltzer.  Add ice  cubes.  Garnish	with  lemon  and  lime slices. Makes 36 (1/2-cup) servings.

name: PARMESAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
1  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix last 5 ingredients together.  Heat oven to 400°.  Spray a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with Pam.  Dip chicken in melted butter and roll in dry mixture.  Place on prepared pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until tender and brown.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  stick butter (real)
1/2  c. sugar
chopped nuts (walnuts)
6  oz. chocolate chips (mini)
graham crackers
preparation: Boil margarine, butter and sugar at full boil for 3 minutes. Line cookie sheet with foil.  Place graham crackers which have been broken on the foil.  Pour boiled mixture over crackers.  Bake 10 minutes at 325°.  While hot, sprinkle mini-chocolate chips over the top.  Spread as melts, sprinkle with chopped walnuts.

name: STUFFED ZUCCHINI SQUASH
ingredients:
6  medium-sized zucchini
3  c. soft bread cubes
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  small onion, minced
3  Tbsp. minced parsley
garlic powder
salt and pepper to taste
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Wash squash; cut off ends, don't pare.  Cool in boiling salted water 5 minutes.  Halve lengthwise; remove pulp with spoon. Combine pulp, bread crumbs, cheese, onion, parsley, salt, pepper, garlic powder and eggs.  Fill shells, dot with butter, sprinkle additional cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: PIZZA POCKETS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1  c. chopped pepperoni
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  tsp. oregano leaves
1/4  tsp. basil leaves
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
4  pkg. refrigerated biscuits
milk
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In bowl combine tomato sauce, oregano, basil and garlic; stir. Add Mozzarella cheese and pepperoni.  Add peppers, if desired.  Set aside.

name: PEANUT SLAW
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. milk
6  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. white vinegar
salt and pepper to taste
3/4  c. mayonnaise
3  c. shredded cabbage
1/2  c. or more if desired Spanish peanuts
preparation: Mix milk, sugar, vinegar, salt, pepper and mayonnaise until well blended.  Toss with cabbage.  Garnish with peanuts.

name: SWEET AND SOUR BEANS
ingredients:
8  slices bacon, fried
4  lg. onions, sliced thin
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. mustard, dry
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. vinegar
2 (15 oz.)  cans dried butter beans
1 (15 oz.)  can green lima beans
1 (15 oz.)  can dark red kidney beans
1 (16 oz.)  can pork and beans
preparation: Fry bacon until crisp, remove from skillet, add following to drippings:  4 large onions (sliced thin), 1 1/2 cups brown sugar, 1 tablespoon dry mustard, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 cup vinegar.  Cook 20 minutes.  Drain dried butter beans, green lima beans, and dark red kidney beans.  Add pork and beans (do not drain).  Mix all beans together, add bacon and onion sauce.  Bake 1 hour at 350° or crockpot 6 - 7 hours on low.

name: QUICK CORNED BEEF MACARONI
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. macaroni
1  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. water
1  small onion, chopped
2  c. corned beef, cooked and cubed
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  can French fried onion rings (3 oz.)
preparation: Place macaroni, soup, milk, water and chopped onion in a 2-quart ovenware casserole dish, covered.  Cook for 15 minutes or until macaroni is tender.  Add corned beef and cheese.  Cover with onion rings.  Cook 3 to 5 minutes or until mixture bubbles along edges.  Let stand 5 minutes.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (32 oz.)  pkg. Ore-Ida hash browns
1  can cream of chicken soup
16  oz. sour cream
2  c. shredded sharp cheese
1  medium onion, chopped
1  stick margarine
2  c. crushed Ritz crackers
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients except margarine and crackers.  Put in 13 x 9-inch dish.  Melt margarine and add to crackers.  Sprinkle on top.  Bake at 425° for 45 minutes.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes
1  envelope spaghetti sauce
garlic salt to taste
8  oz. lasagna noodles
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1  c. cottage cheese
3  oz. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Brown meat in skillet and remove excess fat.  Add next 4 ingredients.  Cover and simmer for 40 minutes.  Cook noodles according to package directions.  Drain.  Place 1/2 noodles in baking dish, 1/3 of meat sauce, 1/2 of cottage cheese and 1/2 Mozzarella cheese.  Repeat.  Add last 1/3 meat sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 350° oven in 12 x 12 x 2-inch baking dish.

name: 3 BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
2 (16 oz. each)  cans Great Northern beans
2 (16 oz. each)  cans pintos with jalapenos
2 (11 1/2 oz. each)  cans bean with bacon soup
2 soup  cans water
1  large onion, chopped
1  large bell pepper, chopped
4  cloves garlic, minced
1  bay leaf
smoked ham hock
1  chopped carrot
skinless chicken breast or ham pieces or both
preparation: Combine beans with remaining ingredients (except chicken) in a large pot.  Bring to a boil.  Simmer 30 minutes.  Add chicken or ham pieces or both and simmer 30 to 40 minutes until meat is cooked and tender.  Makes 3 to 3 1/2 quarts.

name: CHRISTMAS PLUM PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  c. self-rising flour
3  whole eggs
1  c. canned plums
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. oil
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. pecans, chopped
1 1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Mix sugar, self-rising flour, soda, nutmeg, allspice and cinnamon; set aside.  Beat eggs.  Add plums (without seeds), oil, buttermilk and vanilla.  Mix with flour mixture until well blended.  Stir in pecans.  Bake in a lightly oiled 9 x 13-inch sheath pan in 375° oven for 45 minutes.

name: DIET (Nood-Less) LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1/4  c. minced onion
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. basil
1  tsp. chopped parsley
dash of garlic salt
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained or 1/2 c. fresh mushrooms,  sliced thin
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. low-fat cottage cheese
4  oz. skim milk Mozzarella cheese, grated
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  In medium size nonstick skillet, saute ground meat and onion until onion is tender and meat is browned. Do not add fat or oil to skillet!  Add tomato sauce, basil, parsley, oregano, garlic salt, pepper and mushrooms to ground beef mixture.  Combine well drained spinach with cottage cheese.

name: CHOCOLATE MARSHMALLOW COOKIE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. Kraft miniature marshmallows
2  Tbsp. milk
2 1/2  c. thawed Cool Whip
2  c. cold milk
2  pkg. instant Jell-O chocolate pudding and pie filling
1  (6 oz.) Keebler chocolate Ready-Crust
14  vanilla wafer cookies
preparation: Microwave marshmallows and 2 tablespoons milk in medium bowl on High for 45 seconds.  Stir (marshmallows will be partially melted).  Refrigerate 15 minutes to cool.  Stir in 1 cup of the Cool Whip.  Pour 2 cups milk into large bowl.  Add pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk for 2 minutes (let stand 1 minute or until thickened).  Stir in remaining 1 1/2 cups Cool Whip. Spoon into crust and arrange cookies over pudding mixture. Spread marshmallow mixture over cookies.  Refrigerate 4 hours or until set.

name: BEST YET BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. stew beef
2 to 3  Tbsp. beef bouillon
2 to 3  Tbsp. basil
1 large  can chopped tomatoes
4  medium cooked potatoes
2  small onions, cut up
1  pkg. Sweet 'N Low
salt and pepper to taste
2  c. cooked carrots
preparation: Cook stew beef and onions with water in crock-pot on low all day.  Add tomatoes, carrots, potatoes, bouillon, basil, Sweet 'N Low, salt and pepper.  You may thicken with cornstarch or flour, if desired.

name: CHICKEN DELUXE
ingredients:
4  c. stuffing mix
3/4  c. melted oleo
2  cans cream of celery soup
1  can milk
1  pkg. frozen peas, cooked
3  c. cooked chicken breast, cut in pieces
2  Tbsp. diced onion
1 small  jar diced pimento
dash of salt and pepper
preparation: Mix stuffing and oleo and press half of this mixture in bottom of a 3 quart baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and put over stuffing. Top with remaining dressing mixture. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. May be made the night before and refrigerated until baking time.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
salt and pepper to taste
garlic powder to taste
1  can tomato soup, undiluted
1  can green beans, drained
whipped potatoes
grated cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef with onion, salt, pepper and garlic powder. Add tomato soup and green beans.  Pour into casserole and top with whipped potatoes and grated cheese.  Bake at 325° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: FAST FIXIN' FUDGE
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  pkg. confectioners sugar
1  c. unsweetened cocoa
1/2  c. milk
1  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
2  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Power level:  High.  Approximate cooking time:  6 minutes. Yields about 3 pounds.

name: BROWNIE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. Crisco
4  tsp. cocoa
1  c. water
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Sift together sugar and flour in large bowl.  In saucepan, put oleo, Crisco, cocoa and water.  Bring mixture to a rapid boil. Mix with dry ingredients; then add eggs, vanilla, soda and cinnamon.  Bake at 300° for 25 minutes.

name: APPLE BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. Crisco oil
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. sugar
2  c. pared, chopped apples
2/3  c. nuts
1  egg
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Cream together oil and sugar; add egg and beat well.  Sift together flour, soda, cloves, cinnamon and salt.  Add to shortening mixture.  Then stir in apples and nuts.  Pour into a greased loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Let stand until cool. Remove from pan and sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

name: LEMON CREME BARS
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. pecans
4  large eggs
2  c. white sugar
1/3  c. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. baking powder
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Cream together butter and confectioners sugar; gradually stir in 1 cup pecans.  Using floured hands, put dough into ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Press down.  Bake 15 minutes.

name: THREE-MINUTE YOGURT PIE(Slightly Sweet, Slightly Tart-Cool-Creamy-Delicious)
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) containers favorite strawberry yogurt
1  (8 or 9 oz.) container Birds Eye Cool Whip nondairy whipped topping
Johnston's graham cracker ready crust
fresh strawberries (for garnish)
preparation: Just fold the tangy taste of your favorite strawberry yogurt into the creamy, fresh taste of Cool Whip.  Spoon into a delicious Johnston's graham cracker crust.  That's it.  Now, your freezer does the rest.  Freeze until firm (about 4 hours).  Remove from freezer 30 minutes before serving and place in refrigerator. Garnish with fresh strawberries.  In the unlikely event that any pie is left over, just store in your freezer.

name: OVEN PORK CHOPS WITH RICE
ingredients:
4  pork chops
2  Tbsp. shortening
salt to season
pepper to season
3/4  c. uncooked rice
1/2  c. tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  can condensed tomato soup
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Brown pork chops in hot fat.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Place in bottom of 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Combine other ingredients and pour evenly over pork chops.  Cover and bake in slow oven for 1 hour or until meat is tender.  Add additional water if necessary.  Makes 4 servings.

name: RHUBARB CRISP
ingredients:
4  c. cut up rhubarb
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/3 to 2  c. sugar
3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/3  c. butter
preparation: Place rhubarb in ungreased 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with salt.  Put sugar, flour and cinnamon into bowl. Add butter and mix until crumbly. Sprinkle over rhubarb.  Bake 40 minutes in a 350° oven.  Serve warm with whipped cream.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER SLEDS
ingredients:
graham crackers
mini candy canes
white frosting (cake)
mini candies
frosting glue (to put mini candy canes on graham crackers to look like runners)
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  lb. powdered sugar
3  egg whites
preparation: This makes a lot so this can be cut in half for smaller portion and can be stored in covered container for some time in the refrigerator.  Take half of a graham cracker and put some frosting glue on the bottom sides; attach two mini candy canes (one on each side) so it looks like sled runners; turn sled over on something so frosting glue will dry.  When dry, you can use white frosting to decorate your sled anyway you choose with mini candies.  Enjoy this fun treat!  Great Christmas snack!

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. sharp cheese, grated
1  c. cooked macaroni
1  can Carnation milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown beef and onion and drain off fat.  Add milk, cheese and macaroni as well as other ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI WITH STUFFING
ingredients:
2  pkgs. frozen broccoli
2  eggs, beaten
1  onion, finely chopped
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. grated cheddar cheese
1  pkg. herbed stuffing mix
1/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Cook broccoli according to package directions.In a medium bowl, combine eggs, onion, soup and mayonnaise. Place layer of broccoli in 2-quart casserole dish. Add a layer of cheese. Pour sauce on top. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used. Top with stuffing mix. Sprinkle butter on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: GOOEY, CHEWY POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
approximately 1/2 grocery sack of popped popcorn
1  stick margarine
1  (14 oz.) bag caramels (unwrapped)
1  (16 oz.) bag marshmallows
preparation: Remove all unpopped kernels from popcorn.  Melt margarine, caramels and marshmallows in a large pan.  Put popped corn in a large bowl or plastic container.  Pour melted caramel mixture over popcorn and mix.  Butter hands and shape popcorn into balls. Place on waxed paper to cool.  Wrap in plastic wrap.

name: ELK OR VENISON STEAK & GRAVY
ingredients:
2  1/2 to 3 lbs.  Steak
1  bell pepper, sliced thin
1  med. onion, sliced thin
1  c. flour
2  tsp. Salt
1  tsp. Pepper
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. oil
preparation: Slice onions and peppers in rings.  Brown lightly in oil. Remove from heat and remove them from oil.  Remove all fat from steaks.  Pound steaks to tenderize.  Mix flour, salt and pepper. Cover steaks in flour, shake off excess and brown both sides in oil used for peppers and onions.  Pour off oil.  Place onion and pepper rings on top of steak, then spread soup over all.  Add water to almost cover meat.  Simmer for 2 hours adding water as needed to keep meat nearly submerged.  (Can be done in slow cooker.)

name: SLUMGULLION
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
2  c. stewed tomatoes
1  small green sweet pepper, chopped
1  Tbsp. chili powder
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. macaroni (uncooked)
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion.  Add tomatoes, green pepper, chili powder, salt and pepper.  Cover and simmer 20 to 30 minutes.

name: BARBECUE WIENERS
ingredients:
1  pkg. wieners
2  stalks celery
1  small onion
1/2  medium green pepper
1 garlic  clove or 1 tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. celery salt
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 (8 oz.)  can water
salt to taste
preparation: Chop vegetables medium fine.  Chop or crush garlic.  Saute all in small amount of olive oil.  Chop wieners in 1/2-inch pieces. Add to vegetables and saute on medium heat until vegetables are tender and wieners are partially cooked.  Add tomato sauce, water and seasonings.  Continue to cook on low heat to marry the flavor and the sauce has thickened.  Serve with or over mashed potatoes. Children love this.

name: MY MOTHER'S SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3  cans tomato sauce plus 1 can water
1  can tomato paste
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  tsp. salt
pepper
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. oregano (best left out for young children)
dash of parsley flakes
1  lb. thin spaghetti, cooked according to directions
preparation: Brown ground beef, draining off excess fat.  Add remaining ingredients (except for spaghetti) and simmer slowly, stirring often, for about 30 minutes to an hour (more if you have time, but don't let it cook more than 1 1/2 hours).  Serve spooned over the cooked spaghetti on a platter.

name: CHEESE BEEF BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
chopped green onions
4  pkg. thin sliced beef
Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Soften cream cheese to room temperature.  Chip in blender the beef.  Mix together.  Add chopped green onions and Worcestershire sauce to taste.  Combine and shape into ball and chill.  Serve with crackers.

name: CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
3/4  c. packed brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  Tbsp. chopped pecans
1  pkg. refrigerated biscuits
brown sugar
margarine
preparation: Melt 1/4 cup margarine in aluminum pie pan or similar metal pan over heat.  Add 3/4 cup brown sugar, cinnamon and chopped pecans.  Mix these well.  Remove from heat.

name: PIMENTO CHEESE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese (room temperature)
1  jar pimento, drained
salad dressing
sugar
salt
preparation: Mix together pimento and cheese with a fork. If cheese is not soft enough, put in microwave for a few seconds. Add salad dressing for desired consistency. Add dash of salt and sugar to taste.

name: BIRD'S NEST
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. cake flour
preparation: Mix ingredients; chill thoroughly.  Roll in small balls.  Dip first in slightly beaten egg white, then in finely chopped nuts. Place dipped side up on baking sheet.  Press down in the center of each ball with a spoon to make a hollow place or make a thumbprint.  Bake for 8 minutes at 350°.

name: CHOCOLATE MAYONNAISE CAKE
ingredients:
2  tsp. soda
1  c. cold water
1  c. sugar
4 to 7  Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. salad dressing or mayonnaise
preparation: Mix soda, water and sugar.  Add cocoa and stir well.  Add flour and vanilla.  Mix well and add mayonnaise.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.

name: 1-2-3-3-4 MAYONNAISE BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Mix milk and mayonnaise.  Mix both together until just blended.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly floured cookie sheet.  Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Don't overbake!  Can be made larger, but the smaller the better, I think.

name: LAYERED MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can chili with or without beans
1 small  can refried beans
1  tomato, diced
1  onion, diced
1  can black olives, sliced
sour cream
shredded cheese
nacho chips
ground beef (optional)
salsa (optional)
jalapeno peppers (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spread cream cheese on bottom of small, deep pan.  Spread chili over cream cheese.  Spread refried beans over chili.  Top with ground beef (browned and drained before putting on top).  Place in oven for approximately 15 minutes (possibly 25).  Remove from oven.  Top with tomato, onion, black olives and sour cream.  Serve hot with nacho chips.

name: COOKIES FOR A CROWD
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. sugar
2 1/4  c. brown sugar
2 1/4  c. shortening or butter
5  eggs
2 1/4  tsp. vanilla
4 1/2  c. flour
2 1/4  tsp. baking soda
1 1/8  tsp. baking powder
1 1/8  tsp. salt
4 1/2  c. oatmeal
1 large  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix sugars, shortening, eggs and vanilla in an extra large bowl until smooth.  Mix flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt.  Stir both mixtures together until smooth and then add oatmeal and chocolate chips.  Use ice cream scoop to measure mixture and place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for approximately 14 minutes.

name: TURKEY MEAT LOAF(Serves 4)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey
1  egg
1/2  c. seasoned bread crumbs
1/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. dried onion
1  Tbsp. chopped green onions
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. catsup
1  Tbsp. horseradish
1/2  tsp. ground mustard
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients.  Place in lightly greased 4 x 8 1/2 x 2 5/8-inch loaf pan or shape in loaf form and place in lightly greased baking dish.  Bake for 45 to 60 minutes or until meat is no longer pink in center.  Special from "Heart Beat".

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
16  oz. Velveeta cheese
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Soften cheese.  Beat cheeses together until well mixed and smooth.  Add pecans, chili powder and garlic powder.  Mix and roll into balls.  Sprinkle with extra chili powder if desired. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: KANSAS COWHAND COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. margarine
1 1/4  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. granulated sugar
3  beaten eggs
1 1/2  c. chunky peanut butter
5  c. old-fashioned oats (not quick)
1  c. whole wheat flour
2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. chopped dates
1  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Melt butter; blend in sugars, eggs and peanut butter.  Add oats, flour, soda, dates and chocolate chips.  Mixture will be sticky.  Drop on greased cookie sheet with ice cream scoop or a large spoon.  Flatten slightly; each cookie should be about 3-inches in diameter.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Remove to cooling rack.  Makes 2 dozen big cookies.

name: MERINGUE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. cold water
1/2  c. boiling water
3  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Blend cornstarch and cold water. Add boiling water and cook until clear and thick. Chill. Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry. Turn to low speed. Add sugar, one tablespoon at a time, until dissolved. Add salt and vanilla. Beat in cold cornstarch mixture, then at high speed, beat well. Spread on pie. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

name: TEX-MEX TORTILLA APPETIZERS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies, drained
1 (4 oz.)  can black olives, chopped
2  green onions, minced
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
12  (6-inch) flour tortillas
picante sauce
preparation: Combine cream cheese, green chilies, green onions, black olives and garlic salt in a small bowl.  Spread 1 heaping tablespoonful of cream cheese mixture on each tortilla.  Roll up jellyroll fashion.  Place seam side down on baking sheet; cover and chill 2 hours.  Slice each tortilla roll into 4 pieces.  Serve with picante sauce.  Yield:  4 dozen.

name: BOW TIES (A FINGER FOOD)
ingredients:
1  loaf sandwich bread (white or wheat as desired)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. bacon, strips cut in halves
preparation: Remove crusts from bread as you like.  Spread with cream of mushroom soup.  Roll corners opposite and secure with 1/2 strip of bacon, overlapping it.  Bake in a slow 300° oven for 1 hour.  You can spread bread with margarine, if desired.  It is best if they set overnight before baking.

name: ABIGAIL ADAMS' CHAMPAGNE PUNCH
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. strong black tea
1 1/2  c. orange juice
rind of 2 lemons, thinly sliced
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  c. light or dark rum
1  fifth champagne, chilled (26 oz.)
fresh orange slices and mint sprigs (optional)
preparation: Tea is an unusual addition to this refreshing punch popular for gatherings in the 1700's.

name: MILLION DOLLAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
3/4  c. oil
1  c. margarine
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. salt
3  c. Rice Krispies
1  c. uncooked oats
1/2  c. Grape-Nuts
1  pkg. butterscotch chips
preparation: Mix sugars, oil and margarine; add beaten egg and vanilla. Sift flour, baking soda, cream of tartar and salt.  Add to first mixture.  Fold in cereals and chips.  Roll dough into balls; place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Slightly flatten each with sugared glass.  Bake 10 to 15 minutes in 350° oven.

name: BETTER THAN SEX CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1 small  box instant vanilla pudding
4  eggs
1 small (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1/2  c. Crisco oil
1/2  c. water
1  bar German chocolate, shredded
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate bits
1  c. pecans
preparation: Mix the first 6 ingredients together; beat with electric mixer until smooth.  Add the next 3 ingredients.  Pour batter into greased and floured Bundt pan.  Bake at 325° for 55 minutes.  Let cool; remove from pan.

name: GOURMET POTATOES
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
2  c. shredded Cheddar
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1/3  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. paprika (if desired, for top)
preparation: Boil potatoes in skins until cooked, but not too soft.  Peel and shred.  In saucepan, melt cheese and butter.  Remove from heat and add sour cream, onion, salt and pepper.  Fold in potatoes. Put into greased 2 quart casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated.

name: DINNER ROLL
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  c. milk
3/4  tsp. sugar
preparation: Mix well.  Put in large greased muffin tin.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.  Makes 6.

name: CORN FRITTERS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  can cream-style corn
preparation: Form into balls and fry in deep fryer until golden brown.

name: MINI MEATBALL AND  BELL PEPPER SOUP
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1  c. coarsely chopped onion
3  bell peppers (preferably 1 red, 1 green and 1 yellow), cut in sixths lengthwise, then crosswise in 1/2-in. strips
1  Tbsp. minced garlic
2  tsp. each dried oregano and basil
64  oz. canned or bottled tomato juice
4  c. water
2  c. medium pasta shells
24-oz. pkg. refrigerated fully cooked appetizer-size turkey meatballs
1  can (14.5 oz.) diced tomatoes with garlic and onions
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.  Add onions and peppers and cook, stirring often, 10 minutes or until vegetables are soft.  Add garlic, oregano, and basil.  Stir until garlic is fragrant.  Stir in tomato juice and water, and stirring occasionally, bring to boil.  Stir in pasta; cook 12 to 15 minutes or until pasta is firm-tender.  Stir in meatballs and canned tomatoes, salt and pepper, simmer 5 minutes or until meatballs are hot.

name: WINE COOLERS
ingredients:
wine
seltzer
fruit juice
preparation: Mix one part wine with two parts seltzer and add a splash of fruit juice (such as orange or pineapple).  Has 8 calories per ounce.

name: AMISH DRESSING
ingredients:
1  loaf toasted bread crumbs
1  whole cooked cut up chicken (approximately 3 c.)
4  c. chicken broth
1/2  stick melted butter
2  eggs
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. milk
1  c. diced carrots
1  c. diced celery
4  c. diced potatoes
1/2  c. chopped onion
preparation: Bake at 300°, stirring often until vegetables are cooked and bread is not soggy.

name: RASPBERRY JELLO
ingredients:
3  oz. pkg. raspberry jello
1 (12 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 (15 oz.)  can julienne beets
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Bring juice from pineapple and beets to a boil. Add jello and sugar. Stir until dissolved. Add other ingredients.  Chill to set.

name: SNAPPY BARBECUE BEEF SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1  roast (4 lb.)
1  c. ketchup
1  c. barbecue sauce
4  c. chopped celery
2  c. water
1  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Place beef in a Dutch oven.  Combine all ingredients; pour over beef.  Cover and bake at 350° for 5 hours, turning occasionally.  Shred beef with a fork.  Serve on rolls or buns. Makes 24 servings.

name: FRUIT COOKIES
ingredients:
1  cube margarine, cut in pieces
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. dates, cut up
1/2  c. prunes or dried apricots, cut up
1/2  c. raisins
1  c. walnuts
2  c. Rice Krispies
coconut
preparation: Press fruit down in cup to make full cup.  Combine first 6 ingredients in skillet and cook 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add nuts and Rice Krispies and mix well.  Form into balls the size of large walnuts and press down in coconut. Turn over and press other side in coconut.  Press to thickness desired.  Makes about 50 cookies.

name: YABBA-DABBA-DOO SQUARES
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
6  c. Fruity Pebbles
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. mini marshmallows
preparation: Melt margarine in saucepan over low heat.  Add marshmallows. Stir until  melted.  Remove from heat.  Add cereal.  Cool well. Press firmly into greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Chill 1 hour.  Cut into squares.  Store in cool place.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1  jar Cheez Whiz
2  c. cooked rice
1  can cream of mushroom soup
bread crumbs
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Boil broccoli in small amount of water until tender, but still bright green.  Mix with rice and undiluted soup.  Pour into greased casserole dish.  Sprinkle thin layer of bread crumbs on top.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
2  cans shrimp, crush
1/2 to 3/4  jar horseradish
3 to 4  Tbsp. lemon juice
3 to 4  drops Worcestershire
preparation: Add all ingredients and store in refrigerator overnight. Serve with crackers.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  sticks butter or margarine, softened
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
3  c. sugar
dash of salt
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  tsp. almond extract (optional)
6  large eggs
3  c. flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour Bundt pan.  Cream together butter, cream cheese and sugar.  Mix well.  Add dash of salt.  Add vanilla and almond.  Mix well.  Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well.  Add flour and mix well.  Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until done.  Cover with glaze (confectioners sugar and lemon juice).

name: CHEESY CHICKEN ENCHILADA BAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. cooked chicken, cubed
1  can refried beans
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  (16 oz.) tub sour cream
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. shredded cheese
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1  pkg. flour tortillas
1/4  c. each: green pepper, onion and shredded lettuce
preparation: Mix all ingredients (except cheese, lettuce and sour cream). Bring to a boil in saucepan.  When bubbly, transfer to a casserole dish and top with shredded cheese.  Bake at 350° for approximately 10 minutes.  Serve in tortillas (see package for heating instructions) and add lettuce.  Fold tortillas, sprinkle with shredded cheese, then melt it.  Add sour cream.

name: JUNE CLEAVER'S COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
2  eggs, beaten
2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream shortening with sugars.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Blend in flour, salt and baking soda; mix well.  Mix in chocolate chips.

name: HEAVENLY SALAD
ingredients:
3/4  medium size head cabbage, shredded
1 medium size  can chunk pineapple, drained
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
1  c. diced celery
2  diced apples
1  c. salted nuts
2  sliced bananas
1 1/2  c. mini marshmallows
3/4  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
preparation: Toss and serve.  No need to let set.  You can put bananas in Fruit Fresh or lemon juice to keep them from turning brown. Yields 4 quarts.

name: GREEN TOMATO PICKLES
ingredients:
4  lb. green tomatoes
4  onions, sliced
1  c. green pepper, chopped
8  c. white vinegar
5  c. sugar
1/4  c. mustard seed
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1  tsp. ground turmeric
preparation: Core and slice tomatoes.  Combine with onions and green pepper.  Set aside.  In a saucepan, combine remaining ingredients and  bring	to  a boil.  Pack vegetables into clean, hot pint jars  leaving  1/2	inch  of  room at the top.  Pour hot liquid over vegetables.  Prepare lids according to manufacturers directions.  Wipe jar rims; adjust lid.  Process jars in a boiling water bath for 15 minutes.	Makes 8 pints.

name: HOLIDAY PEPPERMINT FUDGE
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can condensed milk
2  Tbsp. butter
16  oz. Hershey's vanilla (white) chips
3  oz. white Baker's chocolate
1/2  tsp. peppermint extract
red and/or green food coloring
preparation: Line an 8 x 8-inch pan with foil.  Over low heat in saucepan, melt condensed milk with butter.  Remove from heat.  Add vanilla chips and white chocolate squares (broken up).  Add peppermint; stir until all chocolate is melted.  Pour into pan.  Dot the top with red and green coloring.  Drag knife through it to give marbled effect.  Refrigerate 8 hours.  Cut into squares after turning out onto cutting board.

name: ROAST IN THE COALS(It Won't Be Salty - It Won't Be Dry!)
ingredients:
3 1/2 to 4  lb. sirloin tip roast
6  oz. jar prepared mustard
1  c. salt
preparation: Prepare fire so you have a good bed of hot embers.  You should have a large, wide fire so that coals can be raked up as needed.

name: WILD APPLE PRUNE STUFFING
ingredients:
3  c. fresh bread crumbs
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1  c. wild apples, diced
3/4  c. cooked prunes, chopped
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Combine all ingredients and mix lightly.  Will stuff two grouse, four chukar or two pheasants.

name: KENTUCKY CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  can cherry pie filling
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
20  to 30 miniature marshmallows
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
1/2  c. chopped pecans (optional)
preparation: Mix Eagle Brand milk and pie filling.  Fold into mixture pineapple, marshmallows, Cool Whip and pecans.

name: ORANGE CRUSH CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco shortening
1/2  c. butter or 1 stick margarine
2 3/4  c. sugar
3  c. plain flour
5  eggs
1  c. Orange Crush
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. orange flavoring
preparation: Cream shortening, margarine and sugar.  Add eggs, 1 at a time. Add Orange Crush alternately with sifted flour.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour 10 minutes.  Let cool.

name: BANANA LOAF CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/3  c. brown sugar
2  well beaten eggs
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1/4  c. sour milk
1  c. banana pulp (2)
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Mix together flour, salt and soda.  Stir in flour mixture alternately with sour milk and mashed bananas to shortening mixture until smooth.  Add nuts and bake in 5 x 9-inch loaf pan for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean from center of loaf.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
6  slices bacon, fried crisp
3  Tbsp. bacon drippings
1  c. white or brown rice
2  c. tomatoes (1 lb.  can)
1  medium onion, chopped
2  c. water
1/4  c. green pepper, chopped
1/4  c. catsup
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: In  bacon  drippings  cook rice, onion and green pepper until onion  is  tender.  Add  bacon  and  other ingredients. Cover and simmer over low heat about 30 minutes, or until rice is tender and liquid absorbed.  Makes 5-6 servings.

name: APPLE PIE
ingredients:
3  c. canned apples
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
dash of cloves and allspice
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2 or 3  Tbsp. butter
1  pie shell
preparation: You can use jelly roll pan or use tart pans.  Line pan with pastry.  I usually buy the Pillsbury pie crust in the box. You can make your own if you want.  Make sure you roll it out very thin. Spread red jam in thin layer over pastry.  I use strawberry. Spread cake dough over jam.  Bake until cake is done. Frost with powdered sugar and water icing with almond flavoring.

name: CHICKEN KISSES
ingredients:
1  bag quick frozen chicken breasts
1  c. celery, chopped
1  c. green onions, chopped
2 (8 oz.)  boxes cream cheese
bread crumbs
1  egg
2 lg.  cans crescent rolls
preparation: Boil chicken until done.  Drain, set aside to cool.  Combine celery, onions, and cream cheese.  Mix until completely blended. Chop chicken breast into 1/2 inch pieces.  Add chicken to cream cheese mixture.  Blend well.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large head cabbage, shredded (about 12 c.)
1  onion, chopped
6  Tbsp. margarine, divided
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. process American cheese, cubed
salt and pepper to taste
1/4  c. dry bread crumbs
preparation: Cook cabbage in boiling salted water until tender; drain thoroughly.  In a large skillet, saute onion in 5 tablespoons of margarine until tender.  Add soup and mix well.  Add cheese.  Heat and stir until melted.  Remove from heat.  Stir in cabbage, salt and pepper.

name: COWBOY CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. dried pinto beans
3/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. chili powder
8  cloves garlic, minced
1/4  c. vegetable oil
3  lb. boneless chuck, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
1 1/2  c. chopped onion
1  large green pepper, chopped
8  cloves garlic, minced
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. chili powder
2 (14 1/2 oz.)  cans tamales (undrained, optional)
additional chopped onion
shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Sort  and  wash  beans.  Place  in a Dutch oven.  Cover with water  2-inches  above  beans.  Cover and let beans soak overnight.   Drain   beans.  Cover  with  water.  Add  chopped onion,  chili  powder  and garlic.  Cover and simmer 1 hour or until beans are tender, adding more water, if necessary.

name: DUMP FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can fruit cocktail
1  box instant strawberry pudding
preparation: Mix together, stirring well.  Strawberry instant pudding is found at Krogers.

name: HAM ROLLS
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. mustard
pinch of garlic salt
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  small onion, grated
2  pkg. thinly sliced ham
preparation: Mix together and spread over ham.  Roll ham up.  Cut off ends. Cut into four rolls.  Refrigerate until use.  You can freeze whole rolls until you need them.  They will be easier to cut when slightly frozen.

name: HEARTY HUNGARIAN GOULASH
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. beef cubes
1  envelope Lipton onion-mushroom or onion Recipe soup mix
1 1/2  Tbsp. paprika (optional)
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
salt and black pepper to taste
1  c. water
preparation: In Dutch oven or large saucepan, heat oil and brown beef. Drain oil.  Add Lipton soup mix and paprika, blended with tomatoes.  Simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, for 1 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender.  Stir in flour blended with water (I make paste out of cornstarch instead of flour).  Bring to a boil, then simmer, stirring constantly, until sauce is thickened, about 5 minutes.

name: FRESH VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. broccoli florets
1 1/2  c. sliced carrots
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. sliced zucchini
1  c. celery, sliced
1/2  c. diced green pepper
1/2  c. diced onion
1  Tbsp. parsley
1  Tbsp. basil
3  Tbsp. margarine
12  saltines, crushed
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Steam broccoli, carrots and zucchini until crisp-tender; drain and set aside.  Mix together mayonnaise, Cheddar cheese and pepper. Add broccoli, carrots, zucchini, remaining vegetables, parsley and basil.  Stir gently to mix.  Spoon into greased 2-quart casserole dish.  Melt butter.  Add crushed saltines; stir until browned. Remove from heat; stir in Parmesan cheese.  Sprinkle over top. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: MOIST AND CRISPY CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  envelope onion soup mix
3/4  c. bread crumbs
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2 to 3  lb. chicken, cut up
preparation: Place soup mix and crumbs into bag; shake to blend.  Dry chicken; brush with mayonnaise.  Place chicken in bag; shake until coated.  Bake on rack in roasting pan at 400° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  pt. whipping cream
4  Tbsp. powdered sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
16  oz. cream cheese
1  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
1  can pineapple chunks, drained
2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Whip cream, sugar and vanilla.  Whip cream cheese in separate bowl, then add to cream.  Fold in fruit and marshmallows.  Chill.

name: SWEET FRUITCAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  c water
2  pkg Pillsbury Date Bread mix
2  c pecan (halves or chopped)
2  c raisins
2  c candied cherries
1  c candied pineapple
preparation: Heat oven to 350 degrees, grease and flour (or spray with Pam) a tube pan.  In large bowl, combine eggs and water. Add remaining ingredients, stir by hand until combined.  Pour into prepared pan. Bake for 75 to 85 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool in pan for 30 minutes, loosen edges and remove from pan.  Cool completely, wrap in foil or plastic wrap and store in refrigerator.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  medium onion, finely chopped
1/2  green pepper, finely chopped
1 (12 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  envelope Italian spaghetti sauce mix with mushrooms
1 1/2  c. water
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. garlic powder or 1/2 garlic clove, crushed
preparation: Brown ground beef, onion, green pepper and mushrooms.  Add the other ingredients in the order given.  Simmer 4 to 5 hours.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: GINGER-APPLESAUCE BARS
ingredients:
1  pkg. Betty Crocker gingerbread cake mix
1  c. applesauce
1  egg
1/4  c. water
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes.  Frost with powdered sugar frosting.

name: TURKEY REUBEN CANAPES
ingredients:
8  slices thin party-style pumpernickel bread (3/4 oz. per 2 slices), lightly toasted
2  Tbsp. Russian dressing
2  oz. thin sliced roast turkey breast (eight 1/4 oz.  slices)
1/4  c. rinsed and drained sauerkraut
2  oz. thin sliced Swiss cheese (eight 1/4 ounce slices)
preparation: On nonstick baking sheet, arrange bread.  Spread 3/4 teaspoon Russian dressing on each slice.  Top with 1 slice turkey, 1 1/2 teaspoons sauerkraut and 1 slice cheese.  Broil until heated through and cheese is melted, 1 to 2 minutes.  Serves 4.  Contains 167 calories, 8 gm fat and 268 mg sodium.

name: GRANDMA'S APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. soda, dissolved in hot applesauce
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. hot applesauce (unsweetened)
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Cream butter.  Add sugar, eggs and applesauce.  Rub raisins with flour.  Add with all remaining ingredients to creamed mixture. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan or two loaf pans about 1 hour at 325°.

name: SANTA ROSA PIE
ingredients:
16  oz. can refried beans
1 (6 oz.)  carton avocado dip
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  can chopped black olives, drained
4  to 6 green onions, chopped
4  oz. can chopped green chilies, drained
1  large tomato, diced
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. sour cream
4  Tbsp. picante sauce or jalapeno sauce
preparation: On serving plate, spread beans into pie shape 8 to 9-inches in diameter.  Cover with avocado dip.  Combine olives and green onions.  Spread over pie.  Mix chilies and tomato.  Spread on top. Cover with cheese; frost with sour cream and spread sauce over top.  Serve with home-fried flour or corn tortilla chips.

name: FUDGE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. chocolate chips
1/2  c. butter
2  c. powdered sugar
1 1/3  c. evaporated milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt chips and butter.  Add sugar and milk; blend well. Stirring constantly, bring to boil and cook 8 minutes.  Add vanilla.  Serve warm.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1/4  stick margarine
2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. raisins
1  c. milk
1  banana, mashed
preparation: Cream the sugar and margarine. Add egg. Add flour alternately with milk. Add banana. Fold in raisins which have been coated with a little flour.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: REUBEN DIP
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, at room temperature
1/4  c. sour cream
1/2  c. grated Swiss cheese
4  oz. sliced corned beef, finely diced
1/4  c. drained sauerkraut
2 to 3  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Heat all ingredients in a small saucepan over low heat.  Thin with milk if necessary.  Serve with rye snack sticks.  Yield:  1 1/2 cups.

name: Tuna Quiche
ingredients:
9  eggs
1 1/2  c. half and half
1  tsp. horseradish
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. basil
2 (12 oz.)  cans tuna, drained
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, thawed
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
1/3  c. sliced green onion
1 1/2  c. shredded Jack and Cheddar cheese
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add half and half.  Mix in horseradish, lemon juice, salt and basil.  Stir in tuna, peas, water chestnuts, green onion, Jack cheese and 1 cup Cheddar.  Pour mixture into greased 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan.  Top with remaining Cheddar.  Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife comes clean.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Serve.  Serves 12 to 18 or 60 hors d'oeuvres.

name: TURKEY A LA KING
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. mushrooms
1/4  c. green onion
6  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. turkey or chicken broth
2  c. cubed turkey or chicken
pastry shells
preparation: In pan, melt margarine; add mushrooms and green onion and saute.  Blend in flour.  Gradually stir in milk and broth.  Cook until mixture boils and thickens.  Add cubed turkey.  Serve on Pepperidge Farm pastry shells.

name: POWERHOUSE STEW
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. ground beef
1  can tomato soup
1  envelope Lipton beefy-onion soup
2  or 3 onions
4  to 6 medium or large potatoes
1  lb. frozen mixed vegetables of your choice (or less)
preparation: Use a heavy saucepan large enough to hold all ingredients. Brown beef in the pan.  Drain.  Add package of beefy-onion soup to one cup of hot water in a small saucepan, then add this to the beef.  Add the tomato soup.  Peel and dice potatoes and onions to suit.  Add all vegetables, salt and pepper to suit.  Cook until done.

name: LIT'L SMOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. grape jelly
3/4  c. mustard
1  pkg. Lit'l smokies
preparation: Mix jelly and mustard in heated crock pot until well blended. Add smokies.  Serve when heated through.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  whole chicken breasts (boneless and halved)
1/2  c. margarine, melted
garlic powder
1  c. plain dry bread crumbs
1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Add garlic powder to melted margarine.  Set aside.  In bowl, mix bread crumbs, Cheddar cheese and Parmesan cheese.   Dip chicken pieces in melted margarine, then in bread crumb mixture. Place in shallow baking dish.  Drizzle remaining margarine over chicken.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.  Serves 4.

name: HOT GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. flour
1 to 2  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. celery seed
pepper to taste
6  medium potatoes
6  slices bacon
3/4  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. water
1/3  c. vinegar
preparation: Boil potatoes in jackets, then peel and slice thinly.  Fry bacon in skillet and drain. Saute onion in bacon fat until brown. Add dry ingredients, stirring until smooth and bubbly.  Add water and vinegar.  Bring to boil, stirring.  Boil for 1 minute.  Stir in potatoes and bacon (crumbled in small bits).  Remove from heat. Cover and let stand until ready to serve.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: MAPLE WALNUT MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1  c. milk
1/3  c. melted butter
1/2  c. maple syrup
1  tsp. maple extract
3/4  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Preheat oven 450°.  Sift flour with baking powder, salt and sugar.  Add everything else except nuts; stir until moistened.  Fold in walnuts.  Pour in paper lined muffin tins until full.  Bake about 20 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY JELLO
ingredients:
1  box strawberry jello
2  mashed bananas
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  pt. strawberries
1 small  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  pkg. Dream Whip
preparation: Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water.  Gel.  Add mashed bananas and strawberries, spread a layer on bottom of dish.   Beat Dream Whip.  Add cream cheese and pineapple.  Spread on top of jello.  Cover with another layer of strawberry mixture.  Put in refrigerator until firm.

name: SPICED HOLIDAY TEA
ingredients:
5  qts. water
1  tsp. whole cloves
2  cinnamon sticks
1  c. sugar
1 small  can orange juice
1 small  can lime juice
1 lg.  can unsweetened pineapple juice
preparation: Boil water, cloves, cinnamon sticks and sugar for 10 minutes. Take out cloves.  Add orange juice, lime juice and pineapple juice.

name: CHEESY VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. American cheese
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. (about 30) crushed butter crackers
1  (16 oz.) bag frozen vegetable blend (containing broccoli, cauliflower and carrots), thawed and drained
preparation: Cut cheese into cubes.  Place in a saucepan with 1/4 cup butter.  Heat over medium until melted and smooth, stirring often. Place vegetables in a 1-quart casserole dish.  Pour cheese mixture over and mix well.

name: AUNT BARBARA'S SOUR MILK CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
1/4  lb. oleo
1/4  c. cocoa
3  c. flour
3  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. hot water
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: Cream together brown sugar and oleo.  Sift cocoa together with flour.  Alternately stir into the creamed mixture the dry (cocoa) ingredients and one pint sour milk.  Mix 1/2 cup hot water and 3 teaspoons baking soda.  Add to other ingredients.  Add 1/2 cup raisins.  Bake in large 9 x 13-inch loaf pan.  Enjoy!

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  bunches broccoli or 1 bunch broccoli and 1 head cauliflower
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  lb. bacon, cooked crisp, then crumbled
1/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. white vinegar
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Combine vegetables, cheese and bacon in large bowl.  Mix sugar, vinegar and mayonnaise.  Add dressing shortly before serving.

name: Chocolate Tarts
ingredients:
1/2  c. cocoa
1  c. white sugar
preparation: Make dough and roll out as for apple turnovers.  Mix cocoa and sugar.  Put in desired amount, 1/4 to 1/2-inch turnover shells. Bake instead of frying.  Butter tops before frying.  Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350° or fry as desired.

name: ZUCCHINI PIZZA
ingredients:
3  c. shredded zucchini
1/2  c. shredded onion
1/2  c. shredded sharp cheese
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. oregano
4  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. oil
1  c. plus 2 tsp. Bisquick
preparation: Mix all of the ingredients together.  Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Top with grated Italian cheese.  Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.  (If you would like a thicker pizza, use a 9 x 9-inch pan.)

name: OATMEAL PIE(Mock Pecan)
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. oatmeal
3  eggs, lightly beaten
1/8  tsp. salt
1  c. light Karo syrup
1/4  lb. margarine or 1/2 c. butter
2  tsp. vanilla
1  large pie crust
preparation: Mix all ingredients. Add oats last. Bake until done.

name: CHEESE-GARLIC BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick
2/3  c. milk
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. margarine, melted
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix Bisquick, milk and cheese until soft dough forms.  Drop dough by spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 450°.  Mix butter and garlic powder.  Brush over warm biscuits.

name: BREAKFAST PIZZA
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk sausage
1  pkg. (8) crescent rolls
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. frozen, loose pack hash brown potatoes, thawed
5  eggs
1/4  c. milk
salt and pepper
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Brown sausage and drain.  Separate crescent rolls into triangles.  Place on ungreased pizza pan.  Press to make crust. Seal perforations.  Spoon on sausage.  Sprinkle on potatoes and top with cheese.

name: HORNET NEST CAKE
ingredients:
1  box cook and serve vanilla pudding
1  box yellow cake mix
12  oz. pkg. butterscotch chips
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Prepare pudding and cool slightly.  Add cake mix.  Stir well. Pour into 9 x 13 pan.  Cover with butterscotch chips and nuts. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: SPICED APPLESAUCE RAISIN BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1  c. fiber cereal
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. applesauce
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. allspice
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
1  egg
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Beat all ingredients, except raisins, in large bowl on medium speed for  1 minute, scraping bowl constantly.  Stir in raisins.  Pour into pan.  Bake  until wooden pick comes out clean, 55 to 60 minutes.  Remove  from  pan; cool before slicing.	Makes one 9-inch loaf.

name: SUNSHINE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  c. whole wheat flour
1 2/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
3  eggs, beaten
2/3  c. fresh orange juice
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  tsp. orange extract
1  Tbsp. orange marmalade
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Combine flours, sugar, baking powder and salt.  Add remaining ingredients.  Stir until moistened (batter may be lumpy).  Fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups 2/3 full.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Makes 15 to 18 muffins.

name: GARBAGE CHOP SUEY
ingredients:
4  oz. olives
4  sticks celery
2  medium onions
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
2  lb. macaroni
1 (48 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1  medium green pepper
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. shredded Mozzarella cheese
2  Tbsp. oregano
1  clove garlic
2  lb. ground beef (lean)
1  (5 oz.) mushrooms (S&P)
preparation: Brown hamburg; drain off fat.  Saute onions, garlic, pepper, celery and mushrooms (chopped) in a frying pan.  Drain; then mix with browned beef with tomato paste, spaghetti sauce and oregano.

name: TURKEY-CARCASS SOUP
ingredients:
1  turkey carcass
4  qt. water
6  small potatoes, diced
4  large carrots, diced
2  stalks celery, diced
1  large onion, chopped
2  c. shredded cabbage
1  can tomatoes, chopped
1/2  c. uncooked barley
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1  bay leaf
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. poultry seasoning
preparation: Remove turkey from carcass and place in large Dutch oven; add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for about 2 hours or until all vegetables are tender. Remove bay leaf. Very good!!

name: UGLY-DUCKLING CAKE
ingredients:
1 (2 layer size)  pkg. yellow cake mix
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. Jell-O lemon instant pudding
1 (16 oz.)  can fruit cocktail, including syrup
1  c. Baker's angel flake coconut
4  eggs
1/4  c. oil
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Blend all ingredients except brown sugar and nuts in large bowl.  Beat 4 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer.  Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.  Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.  Cool in pan 15 minutes.  Spoon hot Butter Glaze over warm cake.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  boxes frozen chopped broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  eggs, well beaten
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. grated cheese
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  stick oleo
1/2  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix
preparation: Drain cooked broccoli.  Combine soup, mayonnaise, eggs and onion.  Add to broccoli and stir.  Pour in casserole.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Add salt and pepper.  Melt 1/2 stick oleo in pan. Add 1/2 package Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix.  Sprinkle on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  onion, chopped fine
1/2 to 1  jar Armour dried beef, chopped
pecans, chopped
preparation: Mold together with hands into ball and roll in pecans.  Serve on crackers.

name: CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1/2  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. flour and 4 Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. boiling water
1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Cream oil, butter and sugar.  Add eggs.  Mix flour, salt and soda together.  Add to egg mixture.  Alternate with buttermilk. Add boiling water last.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

name: ARLIE'S CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1  can pinto beans
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2 to 3/4  c. ketchup
1  c. onion
1 1/2 to 2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Brown meat and drain grease, then add onion and beans.  In a bowl, make paste with chili powder, salt, flour and enough water to make a thin paste.  Put paste and ketchup in meat and add 1/2 cup water.  Simmer for 1/2 hour.

name: SQUASH BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. cooked, mashed acorn or butternut squash
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. milk
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. melted margarine
preparation: Combine flour, soda, salt, nutmeg, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon and milk; stir lightly and set aside.  Combine squash, eggs and margarine; mix well.  Add to flour mixture, stirring until blended.  Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until bread tests done.  Yield: 1 loaf.

name: POT ROAST
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. chuck roast
4  large potatoes
8  large carrots
1  large onion
1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms
1/2  tsp. garlic
1  tsp. black pepper
2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. red cooking wine
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Wash roast.   Place in roast pan.  Add wine, salt, pepper, garlic and Worcestershire sauce.  Brush liquid mixture over roast.  Cover and let set in refrigerator overnight. Remove from refrigerator.  Peel and slice potatoes and carrots. Wash and slice mushrooms.   Add to roast pan.  Dice onion and add to roast.  Cover and bake in a 325°  oven from 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat and vegetables are tender.

name: BAKED CHICKEN(Low Cholesterol)
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
1  stick margarine, melted
1  c. fine cracker crumbs (no cholesterol)
preparation: Remove skin from chicken.  Dip into margarine, then roll in cracker crumbs. Place in a pan at 350° for an hour or until done. Serves 4.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  c. mashed banana
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Cream together butter and sugar.  Add eggs and beat well. Sift together dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture and alternate with banana.  Blend well after each addition.  Add walnuts.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: RADISH AND CREAM CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. cream cheese (8 oz.), softened
1/2  c. margarine or butter, softened
1/2  tsp. celery salt
dash of paprika
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. finely chopped or grated radishes
1/4  c. chopped green onions
preparation: Mix cheese, butter, celery salt, paprika and Worcestershire sauce together until smooth.  Stir in radishes and onions.  Chill several hours to blend flavors.   Spread on rye crisp.  Makes 1 1/2 cups.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE UPSIDE DOWN CAKE
