ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake
1/2  cup margarine
1  can coconut
1  1/2 pkgs. pecans
1  box powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Grease baking pan.  Place coconut and pecans in the pan.

name: SQUASH ROLLS
ingredients:
1/4  c. shortening
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. scalded milk
1  yeast cake
1/2  c. warm water
1/2  c. summer squash, liquefied
3  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
mace or cinnamon
preparation: Mix ingredients as for any rolls.  Knead until smooth.  Let rise once.  Punch down.  Shape into rolls.  Let rise until double in bulk.  Bake at 400° about 20 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  tub pimento cheese
1  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. red pepper
1  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients and shape into ball.  Sprinkle with paprika.

name: HOMINY AND SOUR CREAM
ingredients:
2  cans hominy
1/2  stick margarine
1  c. sour cream
1 small  can green chilies
1  c. grated cheese
garlic salt
preparation: Drain hominy.  Place in pan on burner with margarine. Sprinkle generously with garlic salt, simmer.  Remove from heat and add sour cream and green chilies.  Pour into casserole.  Top with grated cheese.  Cook in oven at 350° until bubbly.  Great as a side dish with Mexican food.

name: ITALIAN LOVE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate cake mix
3/4  c. sugar
4  oz. instant chocolate pudding
1  c. milk
2  lb. Ricotta cheese
1  (8 oz.) whipped topping mix
4  eggs, at room temperature
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Grease and flour 11 x 13-inch pan.  Make cake according to box directions; pour into pan.  Mix vanilla, sugar, eggs and cheese. Pour gently over cake mix.  Do not blend.

name: SANDWICH DELUXE
ingredients:
1  slice boiled ham
a little mustard
1  slice cheese
oleo
2  beaten eggs
1  c. milk
preparation: Make sandwich with boiled ham, mustard and cheese.  Use a thin spread of oleo on bread next to cheese.  Dip the sandwich very quickly on each side into a mixture of beaten eggs and milk. Grill or fry, using as little grease as possible.

name: PAGOGE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground London Broil (bite size)
2  bunches green onions
2  cloves garlic, diced small
1  tsp. sesame seed
1/2  tsp. red pepper
2  Tbsp. oil or cooking sherry
1/4 to 1/3  c. soy sauce
1/8  c. water
preparation: Mix together and simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour in a wok. Serve this with rice and soy sauce.

name: HAWAIIAN MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground round
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ginger
1  egg
1  tsp. water
1/4  c. flour
3  Tbsp. oil
20  oz. can pineapple
1/4  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  green peppers, cut in strips
buttered hot noodles
preparation: Season meat with salt and ginger; form into 16 small balls. Dip in egg, slightly beaten with 1 teaspoon water.  Dip in flour. Brown all over in hot oil; remove from pan.  Make sauce in same pan.  Drain syrup from pineapple; add water to make 1 cup liquid. Stir into drippings in pan.  Stir in brown sugar, cornstarch, vinegar and soy sauce.  Cook, stirring constantly until sauce thickens.  Arrange meatballs, peppers and pineapple in separate piles in pan.  Stir each gently to coat with sauce.  Cover and simmer 10 minutes.  Serve with buttered noodles.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked broccoli
2  c. cubed, cooked chicken
2  c. soft bread cubes
2  c. grated processed sharp or American cheese
1 (12 oz.)  jar Homestyle chicken gravy
1/2  c. evaporated milk
dash of pepper
preparation: In buttered 9 x 9-inch baking dish, layer broccoli, chicken, bread cubes and cheese.  Combine gravy, milk and pepper.  Pour over mixture.  Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.  Let stand for 5 minutes.

name: CHOP SUEY
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  box Rice-A-Roni (beef flavor)
1 big  can bean sprouts
1 small  can meatless chow mein
1  can chow mein noodles
1  bottle soy sauce (for taste)
preparation: Brown hamburger.  Make rice to box directions, but do not evaporate water.  Add hamburger to rice. Add bean sprouts and chow mein in large pan. Simmer for 20 minutes.  Preparation time:  30 minutes.

name: CHRISTMAS CRUNCHES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. corn flakes
1/2  c. shredded coconut
1/2  c. coarsely chopped pecans
1  c. regular oats, uncooked
preparation: Cream butter; add sugar and beat until light and fluffy.  Add eggs and vanilla, mixing well.  Combine flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt; gradually add to creamed mixture, beating well after each addition.  Stir in oats, corn flakes, coconut and pecans.  Shape dough in 1-inch balls and place 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool on wire racks.  Yields 3 1/2 dozen.

name: KING RANCH CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  whole chicken
1  qt. broth
1  c. chopped celery
1  medium chopped onion
1/2  lb. cheese, shredded
tortilla shells
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. garlic
preparation: Boil chicken; debone.  Tear up 10 tortilla shells.  Place in bottom of 8 x 11-inch baking dish.  Pour 1 cup chicken broth over the tortilla shells.  Mix together chicken soup, mushroom soup, Ro-Tel tomatoes, chili pepper and garlic.  Place in baking dish in the following order: chicken, onion, tortilla shells and cheese. Pour mixture over layers.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: BACON AND SWISS SPREAD
ingredients:
4  oz. Swiss cheese, grated
8  oz. softened cream cheese
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped
1/2  c. mayonnaise
crumbled bacon (about 5 slices)
crushed butter crackers
preparation: Mix first four ingredients and put in shallow dish. Microwave 4 1/2 minutes, rotating dish after two minutes.  Sprinkle cracker crumbs and bacon on top.  Serve with crackers.

name: VENISON STEW
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oil
3  large onions, coarsely chopped
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. pepper
7  potatoes, peeled and quartered
1  lb. carrots, cut into 1-inch pieces
bottled browning sauce (optional)
1  lb. venison stew meat
2  garlic cloves, crushed
1  bay leaf
1  Tbsp. salt
3  c. water
1/4  c. flour
1/4  c. cold water
preparation: Heat oil in a Dutch oven.  Brown meat.  Add onions, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, bay leaf, oregano, salt and pepper.  Simmer, covered, 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat is tender.   Add potatoes and carrots.  Continue to cook until vegetables are tender, about 30 to 45 minutes.  Mix flour and water.  Stir into stew.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.  Add browning sauce, if desired. Remove bay leaf.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: WALNUT CAKE(Dios Torta)
ingredients:
1/4  lb. semi-sweet chocolate
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs
preparation: Butter 2 large 9-inch layer cake pans; place a circle of waxed paper or brown paper in the bottom and butter that as well.  Set the pan aside.  Preheat the oven to 375°.  Beat the egg whites with a pinch of salt until foamy; continue beating until very stiff. Set aside.  With an electric mixer, beat the egg yolks with sugar until light yellow and very creamy.  Blend the walnuts and bread crumbs together; fold them into the egg yolk mixture.  Mix a heaping tablespoonful of the beaten egg whites into the batter to lighten it.  Lightly fold in the remainder of the whites.  The batter should be evenly mixed but not overworked.  Pour into the cake pans; bake for 20 minutes or until the cake springs back when touched.  Remove from oven; cool for 10 minutes in the pans. Invert onto a cake rack; quickly remove all the paper from the bottoms of the layers.  Cool completely before filling and frosting cake.

name: CHICKEN AND DRESSING
ingredients:
1  pan thick cornbread and just a handful of crackers
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  qt. chicken broth
8  eggs (hard-boiled)
1  large onion
celery (just a little celery to suit taste)
butter *
preparation: *If fryer is used instead of hen, add butter as required.

name: IMPOSSIBLE CHEESEBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1/2  c. Bisquick
2  eggs
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook ground beef and onion; drain. Stir in salt. Spread in greased 9-inch pie plate. Sprinkle with cheese. Mix milk, eggs and Bisquick with fork until blended. Pour over cheese. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

name: GROUND BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  lb. ground beef
1  small onion
1  clove garlic
1  c. bell pepper
1/2  c. celery
1  small tomato paste
1  small tomato sauce
1 small  can mushrooms (stems and pieces)
1 small  can creamed corn
1 small  jar sliced olives
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. egg noodles
1  stick sharp cheese
preparation: Brown beef.  Cook pepper, celery and onion in a small amount of fat, then add to ground beef and cook about 20 minutes.  Cook noodles according to package directions.  Combine noodles with meat mixture.  Layer meat and noodle mixture with grated cheese and bake about 30 minutes at 350°.

name: LO-CAL TOMATO JUICE DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. canned tomato juice
2  Tbsp. lemon juice or vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2 to 4  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. minced onion
3  Tbsp. sugar substitute
preparation: Combine all ingredients and beat until well blended.  Makes  1 cup.  Contains 25 calories per tablespoon.

name: MAN ON THE MOON CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  c. cooking oil
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla extract
4  c. chopped pared apples
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Beat eggs and oil until foamy.  Combine flour, salt, soda, cinnamon and sugar; add to egg mixture.  Add remaining ingredients, except Topping and mix well.  Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake tests done.  Remove from oven and spread with Lunar Landing Topping. Cool before cutting.  Yields 1 (13 x 9 x 2-inch) cake.

name: EASY PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
3/4  c. peanut butter
2  c. biscuit mix
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Beat milk and peanut butter until smooth.  Add biscuit mix and vanilla; mix well.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Place 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheet.  Flatten with fork.  Bake 6 to 8 minutes at 375°.

name: CHIPS OF CHOCOLATE PEANUT BUTTER CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
2  c. brown sugar
1  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. chocolate chips
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
preparation: Combine and blend the first 4 ingredients.  Save 1 cup to sprinkle over top with the 1 cup of chocolate chips.  Then add remaining ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

name: SPINACH BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
2  c. sour cream
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese or Cheddar and Mozzarella mixed
3  Tbsp. bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
preparation: Cook  spinach and broccoli until just tender-crisp;  do not overcook.  Drain  well  by  squeezing out water.  Combine sour cream  and  soup  mix and stir into spinach and broccoli. Place in casserole dish.  Bake, covered, in preheated oven at 350° for  30 minutes  or  until  bubbly.  Top with cheese and bread  crumbs; drizzle  butter over top.  Place under broiler until bubbly and browned.  Can be made a day ahead and kept in refrigerator.

name: KRAUT AND BEER FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
2/3  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. unsweetened cocoa powder
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. beer
2/3  c. rinsed, drained and chopped sauerkraut
preparation: Cream  butter  with  sugar.  Beat  in eggs and vanilla. Sift dry  ingredients;  add  alternately with beer to egg mixture. Stir  in kraut.  Turn into 2 greased and floured 8-inch pans. Bake  in  350°  oven for 40 minutes or cake tests done. Cool on racks, then frost with chocolate or vanilla icing.  If preferred, bake in tube pan for 60 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY BREAD WITH STRAWBERRY CREAM CHEESE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. thawed frozen strawberries (reserve 2 Tbsp. juice)
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  large egg white, lightly beaten
1  oz. chopped pecans
1/2  c. light cream cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spray a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  Combine flour, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.  Make a well in center of flour mixture.  Pour strawberries, oil, egg white and pecans into well. Mix well.  Spoon batter into prepared pan.  Bake 45 to 50 minutes.  Cool completely on rack.  Combine cream cheese and reserved strawberry juice.  Cover and refrigerate.

name: TAMALE DRESSING
ingredients:
2  c. bread crumbs, toasted
2  c. corn bread crumbs
3/4  c. onion, chopped
3/4  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. green bell pepper, chopped
2  Tbsp. fresh parsley, chopped
4  eggs, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. poultry seasoning
8  fresh or frozen tamales, crumbled
6  c. chicken or turkey broth
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. black pepper, freshly ground
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients, mixing well. Pour mixture into a greased 3 qt. pan or casserole dish.

name: NO-BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  tsp. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. peanut butter
3  c. oatmeal
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, cocoa, milk and margarine in pan; boil for 1 minute.  Take off stove. Add remaining ingredients quickly.  Drop on wax paper.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE PIE(Makes 2 Pies)
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
4  eggs, beaten
7  Tbsp. cocoa
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1 large  can Pet milk
1  stick oleo, melted
2  c. flaked coconut
1  c. nuts
preparation: Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: CONGEALED CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. cooked, diced chicken
2  hard-boiled eggs
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
1 3/4  c. cranberry juice
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. salted nuts
1  pkg. raspberry gelatin
preparation: Heat cranberry juice and pour over gelatin and cool.  Press other ingredients into the bottom of the mold and pour gelatin mixture over it.  Chill until firm.

name: AMISH HAT
ingredients:
4  Ritz crackers
2  large or 12 mini marshmallows
peanut butter
preparation: Spread peanut butter on each cracker.  If you are using large marshmallows, cut each one in half with scissors and put 1/2 on each cracker.  If using small, place 3 on each cracker.  Place in microwave or under broiler and cook until marshmallow is soft.

name: RAISIN NUT PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
3/4  c. Karo syrup
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  c. butter, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
unbaked pie shell
preparation: In bowl, beat eggs slightly.  Stir in corn syrup, brown sugar, butter, vanilla and salt.  Stir in raisins and nuts.

name: RHUBARB CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. buttermilk
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
3  c. rhubarb, cut fine
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix together.  Put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle top with 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.  Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: PENNY'S VEGGIE BARS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. refrigerated crescent rolls
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. mayonnaise
1 (0.4 oz.)  envelope buttermilk recipe or Ranch dressing mix (Hidden Valley)
preparation: Press dough from 1 package rolls on ungreased cookie sheet into a 9 x 12-inch rectangle.  Bake in 350° oven 10 to 15 minutes. Repeat with other package of rolls.  Cool completely.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
5  c. milk
1/2  c. rice
1/2  c. sugar
1  beaten egg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook milk and rice until rice is done, the more you stir it the creamier it will be.  Take it off the stove and add the sugar, egg and vanilla.  Cook about 5 more minutes and pour into dish to cool.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. Tater Tots
1  onion (optional)
1  pkg. Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Brown hamburger; drain off fat.  Layer in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Add soup on top of meat.  Put cheese on top of soup.  Put Tater Tots on top of cheese.  Bake in a 350° oven until Tater Tots are brown.

name: SHISH KABOB MARINADE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Burgundy (relax, the alcohol cooks out!)
1  tsp. Worcestershire
1/2  tsp. m.s.g. (Accent)
1  clove garlic
1/2  c. salad oil
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. ketchup
1  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  tsp. marjoram
1/2  tsp. rosemary
preparation: Marinate meat, cut in cubes for skewers, and fresh mushrooms several hours, turning occasionally.  Suggestions for Shish Kabobs:  canned pearl onions, canned new potatoes, pineapple chunks, bell pepper and cherry tomatoes.  Put meat on skewer first, then desired ingredients alternately.  Cook on grill until meat is done.

name: JAPANESE SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
2  oz. fresh ginger root (approximately 1/2 c.)
1  medium onion, quartered
3  c. oil
1  c. vinegar
1 3/4  c. soy sauce
1 1/2  Tbsp. tomato paste
1/4  lemon, juiced
1  clove garlic
1 3/4  c. water
preparation: Put in blender, then chill.  Serve on salad.

name: TIGER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. (6 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
3  c. Kellogg's sugar Frosted Flakes
2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Melt chocolate chips in double boiler over hot water.  Measure sugar Frosted Flakes and crush.  Sift flour, soda and salt. Beat margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients.  Mix thoroughly. Fold in crushed sugar Frosted Flakes. Swirl warm melted chocolate lightly through batter, leaving streaks of chocolate.  Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 12 minutes in a 375° oven.

name: MUSSELS NORMANDY
ingredients:
3  lb. cleaned mussels
2  shallots, minced
2  garlic, minced
1/2  c. hard apple cider
1/2  c. heavy cream
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. chervil, minced
preparation: Put all in pot and steam until opened.  Top with 2 tablespoons minced chervil.

name: STRAWBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. plain flour
1  stick margarine, melted
1/2  c. pecans, chopped finely
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix together the first 3 ingredients and press in bottom of a 9 1/2 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325° for 30 to 40 minutes or until lightly browned.  Mix the cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip.  Pour this over cooled crust.  Pour 1 package of thawed strawberries (you may use fresh, if possible) over the cream cheese mixture. Cover the strawberries with a jar of strawberry glaze. Chill and serve.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. fine graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. finely chopped nuts (walnuts or pecans)
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Reserve 3 tablespoons of mixture.  Press remainder on bottom and up 2 1/2-inches on sides of a 9-inch spring-form pan.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
4  Tbsp. flour
4  c. milk
2  tsp. salt
6  c. sliced raw potatoes
Velveeta cheese (optional)
preparation: Melt 4 tablespoons butter, add flour and salt.  Add milk slowly and cook until sauce thickens.  Melt cheese in sauce if used.  Add sliced potatoes; bring to a boil.  Put into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish and dot with remaining butter.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Yields 15 servings.

name: LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
2  egg yolks
juice from 1 1/2 lemons
5  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  c. boiling water
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt.  Add boiling water and lemon juice.  Cook until thick.  Stir in egg yolks, cook 1 minute longer.  Add butter. Cool.  Pour in baked pie shell and top with meringue or Cool Whip.

name: CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
2  lb. Velveeta chunk cheese
1  lb. ground chuck
1  large onion
1 small  can jalapeno relish
preparation: Melt cheese in crock-pot on high.  Cook ground beef and onion together; drain grease.  Mix with melted cheese.  Pour in jalapeno relish and mix well.  Reduce crock-pot to low heat.  If sauce seems to get too thick, add water.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CANDYCAKES
ingredients:
4  large eggs (room temperature)
2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
1  c. creamy peanut butter
1  (8 oz.) milk chocolate Hershey bar, melted
preparation: Beat eggs with electric mixer until thick and lemon colored. Gradually add sugar, milk and vanilla.  Stir together the flour, baking powder and salt.  Blend these ingredients into egg mixture. Pour batter into a jelly roll pan (10 x 15-inch) sprayed with Pam or Baker's Joy.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, or until cake tester comes out clean.  While cake is still hot, spread peanut butter evenly over top of cake.  Let cool thoroughly, then spread melted Hershey bar over peanut butter.  Refrigerate until firm.

name: PUMPKIN SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/3  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. canned pumpkin
2/3  c. buttermilk or sour milk
1 3/4  c. sifted all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. allspice
1/4  tsp. ginger
preparation: Cream the shortening and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each. Combine the pumpkin and buttermilk or sour milk. Sift together the remaining ingredients. Add to the creamed mixture alternately with pumpkin mixture, beating well after each addition.  Bake in greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool and frost.

name: CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. butter (3 sticks)
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
1  c. milk
3  c. flour
5  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, and beat well.  Sift dry ingredients 3 times.  Add, alternating with milk. Bake 80 minutes at 325° in greased and floured, large tube pan. Serve sprinkled with powdered sugar.

name: CHICKEN FLORENTINE
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts, halved
1  c. seasoned bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. marinara sauce, homemade or canned
1/2  c. dry red wine
1 1/2  c. chicken stock, heated to boiling
1  c. uncooked long grain rice
2 1/2  oz. can sliced black olives, drained
2  pkg. (10 oz.) frozen spinach
1  c. Ricotta cheese
2  beaten eggs
1/2  tsp. crushed marjoram
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Coat chicken with bread crumbs.  Heat oil and butter in 12-inch skillet.  Saute breasts until brown. Remove and set aside.  Combine marinara sauce and wine.  Put 1 cup wine sauce mixture in skillet.  Add stocks, rice and olives and stir, scraping bottom of pan.  Pour into lightly oiled 3-quart casserole dish.  Put chicken, skin side down, on rice.  Cover tightly with foil and cook 20 minutes.  Turn chicken, re-cover and cook another 25 minutes.  While chicken bakes, combine spinach, Ricotta cheese, eggs marjoram and nutmeg.  Spoon mixture around edges of casserole dish.  Pour remaining wine sauce over chicken. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake, uncovered, 10 to 15 minutes or more.

name: EARTHQUAKE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped nuts
1  pkg. German chocolate cake mix
8  oz. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
1  box powdered sugar
1  stick margarine
preparation: Grease	9  x  13-inch  pan  (or  slightly  larger).  On bottom, spread chopped nuts and coconut.  Mix German chocolate cake as directed on box.  Pour over nuts and coconut.

name: BURGER BUNDLER
ingredients:
2  lb. lean ground beef
1 (1 1/4 oz.)  pkg. onion soup mix
1  egg
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. water
1/3  c. dry bread crumbs
3/4  lb. Velveeta, cut into 1/4-inch slices
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. dinner rolls (12 rolls per pkg.), split
dill pickle slices
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Mix meat, soup mix, egg, pepper, water and bread crumbs.  Press onto bottom of 15 x 10-inch pan.  Prick meat mixture with fork.  Bake 10 to 15 minutes or to desired doneness. Drain.  Place Velveeta slices over meat.  Bake 1 minute or until Velveeta begins to melt.  Cut into 24 squares.

name: WEDDING PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. strawberry jello
2  c. boiling water
2  c. cold water
1 large  can frozen orange juice
1 3/4  c. sugar
1 large  can frozen lemonade
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add sugar, stir until dissolved.  Add cold water.  Prepare orange juice and lemonade according to package directions.  Add pineapple juice.  Add jello mixture.  Pour into jars, cover and chill for 24 hours.  Part of jello mixture may be poured into jello mold.  Freeze for 24 hours. Place ice ring in punch bowl, add rest of punch.

name: SAUCY SKILLET SUPPER
ingredients:
2  c. jumbo macaroni
1  c. celery, sliced
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1  tsp. salt
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. onion, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Prepare macaroni according to package directions.  Drain.  In large skillet, cook ground beef, celery and onion.  Drain fat. Add tomatoes (breaking up with spoon), tomato sauce, salt and pepper.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Mix cooked macaroni with meat sauce; heat on low for 5 minutes.  Just before serving, stir in grated cheese.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese (American)
1  lb. Old English cheese
1  lb. cream cheese
4  oz. Bleu cheese
10  oz. very sharp Cheddar cheese
1  medium onion, grated
preparation: Grate.  Mix  all  together.  Roll in parsley flakes and nuts. Works better at room temperature.

name: MEXICAN RICE
ingredients:
1/2  c. uncooked rice
1  lb. hamburger meat
2  Tbsp. bacon fat
1  large onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1/2  Tbsp. hot pepper
1  medium green sweet pepper
1  tsp. salt
1  c. tomato sauce
1/2  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: Cook rice until light brown.  Fry hamburger in fat in separate skillet.  Add onion, garlic, hot and sweet pepper, salt, tomatoes and chili powder.  Allow mixture to cook about 3 minutes.  Blend in browned rice.  Simmer slowly in skillet on top of range until done.

name: MISSISSIPPI MUD PIE
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. pecans, chopped
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
12  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  c. sifted powdered sugar
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip, thawed and divided
1  tsp. vanilla
2  (3.9 oz.) instant chocolate pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients.  Press into bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Cool completely. Combine cream cheese, sugar, 2 cups Cool Whip and vanilla.  Beat at medium speed with mixer until smooth.   Spread on crust. Combine pudding mix and milk.  Beat with mixer 2 minutes.  Spread over cream cheese layer.  Top with remaining Cool Whip.  Chill 8 hours and serve.  Makes approximately 15 servings.

name: MILLION DOLLAR PIE
ingredients:
1  can condensed milk
1/3  c. lemon juice
1/3  c. crushed pineapple
1/3  c. chopped cherries
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Pour in graham cracker crust.  Cook for 8 minutes in 375° oven.  Let cool.  Top with Cool Whip or whipped cream.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
2  carrots, sliced
1  medium green pepper, sliced
1  medium onion, sliced thin
1  can tomato soup
1/2  c. cooking oil
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Cook carrots until tender and crisp, drain and rinse in ice water.  Layer carrots, peppers and onions.  Blend other ingredients until sugar is dissolved.  Pour over veggies and refrigerate, overnight is good.  Use leftover dressing for salads. Good! Keeps well in refrigerator.

name: CARAMEL NUT POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
1/2  c. shortening
1  box light brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
5  large eggs or 6 medium ones
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sweet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts or chopped walnuts
preparation: Cream butter, shortening and brown sugar.  Beat well.  Now, add granulated sugar and mix until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well each 3 minutes.  Add milk and vanilla and mix.  Mix nuts.  Save 1/2 cup.  Add flour before adding nuts. Bake in pan for 1 hour and 30 minutes at 325°.  Line pan in wax paper.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  to 2 onions, chopped
2  cans cream of chicken or creamed chicken and mushroom soup
1  c. Cheez Whiz or processed cheese, cubed
2  c. rice or elbow macaroni, cooked
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. water
1  c. milk
2  c. or 20 oz. frozen broccoli
water chestnuts
preparation: Saute onion in margarine;  mix with liquid, soups and cheese to make sauce.  Cook broccoli by package directions.    Mix broccoli and rice/macaroni with sauce.  Bake in a greased casserole for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: SUPER EASY PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. beef round or chuck, trim  fat
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  clove garlic
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  c. onion, sliced thin
1  c. green pepper, cut in 1-inch pieces
2  stalks celery, cut up
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. water
4  Roma tomatoes, cut in wedges
preparation: Cut beef in thin strips 1/8-inch thick.  Combine soy sauce, garlic and ginger.  Add beef.  Toss and set aside.  While you prepare vegetables, heat oil in large frying pan; add beef and toss over high heat until brown.  Cover; simmer 30 to 40 minutes, until tender, over low heat.   Turn heat up and add vegetables (not tomatoes).  Toss until tender (10 minutes).  Mix cornstarch with cold water; add to meat and vegetable mixture.  Stir and cook until thickened.  Add tomatoes until they are hot clear through. Serve over white rice.

name: CHOCOLATE PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1/2  c. honey
1/2  c. peanut butter
3/4  c. uncooked quick rolled oats
1/4  c. crispy rice cereal
1  envelope (individual serving) instant cocoa mix
preparation: In a medium-size bowl, mix honey and peanut butter.  Add cocoa mix until well blended.  Stir in oats and rice cereal until well coated.  Shape into balls the size of golf balls.  Refrigerate 30 minutes before serving.

name: TORTELLINI SALAD
ingredients:
2  bunches broccoli
1  red onion
2  bags cheese tortellini
2  red peppers
1  carrot
1 large  bottle Italian dressing
2  green peppers
1  bunch radishes
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook tortellini as directed.  Use only tops of broccoli (cut small).  Julienne peppers and onions and slice radishes and carrot thin.  Mix together with tortellini and Parmesan and add dressing.

name: GARLIC BREAD
ingredients:
1  loaf French bread
1  clove garlic, finely minced
5  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Blend garlic into butter thoroughly.  Slice bread into thick slices and spread with garlic butter.  Place in oven under the broiler for 5 minutes, watching closely.

name: LEMON CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  to 8 pieces boned and skinned chicken breasts, legs or thighs
1  whole lemon
1/3  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/4  c. salad oil
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  lemon, thinly sliced
1  c. chicken broth
2  sprigs fresh mint (optional)
preparation: Wash chicken and drain on paper towels.  Grate the peel from the whole lemon and set aside.  Cut lemon in half and squeeze the juice over the chicken, rubbing the juice into the chicken.  Coat chicken with the flour, salt and paprika and brown slowly in the heated oil.  Arrange in casserole or baking pan.  Sprinkle grated lemon peel and brown sugar over the chicken, and then cover with the lemon slices.  Pour broth over all and place the mint (if used) over the top of the chicken.  Cover and bake in 375° oven until chicken is tender, 45 to 60 minutes.  Remove mint before serving.  Serves 6 to 8 if chicken pieces are large.

name: SAUSAGE GREEN CHILI STRATA(Breakfast)
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
5  slices white bread
3  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
4  eggs, slightly beaten
2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1 small  can chopped green chillies
preparation: Crumble sausage, cook and drain.  Set aside.  Lightly butter the bread and cut into cubes.  Place half the bread cubes into bottom of greased 8-inch square pan or double recipe and use 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle half the cheese.  Cover with sausage.  Add remaining bread cubes and remaining cheese.  Combine eggs, milk and seasoning.  Pour over bread, cheese and sausage.  Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.  Before baking, drain chillies and sprinkle over.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour until golden brown.

name: DELICIOUS PUNCH
ingredients:
1  pkg. orange Kool-Aid (presweetened)
1 large  can pineapple juice
1/2  large ginger ale or 1 small (12 oz.)
pineapple sherbet
preparation: Mix Kool-Aid and pineapple juice.  Add ginger ale and spoon in sherbet.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. cherry Jell-O
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 large  can whole berry cranberry sauce
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/4  c. minced celery
1/4  c. chopped raisins
1  c. liquid, pineapple juice plus water
preparation: Boil  liquid.  Add Jell-O  and  dissolve.  Now  add  the other ingredients and mix well.  Pour  into  a  ring  mold  and chill until set.

name: PUMPKIN STREUSEL MUFFINS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. pumpkin pie spice
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs, lightly beaten
1  c. pumpkin
1/2  c. vegetable oil
preparation: In a large bowl, combine the first 5 ingredients; set aside. In a medium bowl, combine the eggs, pumpkin and oil.  Add liquid ingredients to dry ingredients.  Stir just until moistened.  Spoon batter into greased muffin cups, filling 3/4 full.  Sprinkle streusel topping over batter.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Makes 18 muffins.

name: BREAKFAST OF CHAMPIONS
ingredients:
10  slices sourdough bread, buttered and cut into 1-inch cubes
2  lb. sausage, drained
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
6  eggs
3  c. milk
1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Butter a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Fry sausage and drain.  Put on top of bread.  Sprinkle 1 1/2 cups of grated cheese on top of sausage. Beat eggs and milk together. Pour over top.  Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.   Top with 1/2 cup grated cheese.   Bake at 350° uncovered for 35 to 45 minutes.  Let stand 15 minutes.   Cut into serving pieces.

name: TUNA PATTIES
ingredients:
2 (6 oz. each)  cans tuna
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
32  cracker squares, crumbled
preparation: Mix all together and form into patties.  Spray skillet with Pam.  Fry patties until brown on each side.  Makes 18 patties about 3-inches in diameter.  Low calorie when using tuna packed in water.

name: PIG PICKING CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. butter cake mix with pudding
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges and juice
1/2  c. oil
4  eggs
1/2  c. walnuts
preparation: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Prepare cake mix following directions on package using the oil, eggs and juice drained from oranges.  Mix well.  Fold in oranges and nuts.  Spread evenly in pan.  Bake for 25 minutes at 325°.  Cool for 10 minutes then frost.

name: REFRIGERATOR PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. nuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  large Cool Whip
2 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
3 1/2  c. milk
2 small  pkg. butter pecan pudding
1  Hershey bar
preparation: Mix flour and oleo, then add nuts.  Press into 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

name: COMPANY CHICKEN
ingredients:
any 6 good size pieces chicken
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1  c. heavy cream (don't cheat and use milk; the cream makes the difference)
salt and garlic salt
paprika
chopped parsley
preparation: Salt and garlic salt the chicken pieces a bit, then paprika it thoroughly.  Spread chicken out in one layer in a shallow baking pan.  Dilute the soup with the cream; pour it over the chicken. Sprinkle the chopped parsley (generously) on the top.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: CABBAGE NOODLES
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage
8  Tbsp. bacon grease
4  oz. egg noodles
salt (as desired)
preparation: Cook all ingredients until well done in 1 1/2 quarts water. Use more water, if needed.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
cooked chicken breasts (2 to 3)
cream of chicken soup or celery soup
homemade dressing
1  can chicken broth
preparation: Make your favorite dressing, using canned broth to moisten (leave very moist).  Put dressing in baking dish.  Place boned chicken breast on top of dressing.  Pour soup over chicken and dressing and bake until golden brown.  This dish may be enlarged for groups.  You may substitute turkey for chicken.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. seasoned croutons
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  lb. pork sausage
4  eggs
3/4  tsp. dried mustard
2 1/2  c. milk
1  c. condensed mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Place croutons in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish that has been greased.  Place cheese on top of croutons.  Fry sausage and drain. Place on top of cheese.  Beat eggs, mustard and 2 1/2 cups milk together.  Pour over meat mixture.  Cover.  Refrigerate overnight. In morning, pour 1/2 cup milk mixed with soup on top.  Bake in slow oven at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: PEACH CRUNCH CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  unbeaten egg
1 large  can sliced peaches, drained
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Stir in egg.  Put peaches in baking dish.  Spread cake mixture on top.  Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE ZUCCHINI CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. oil
1 3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sour cream
2 1/2  c. flour
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
2  c. shredded zucchini
1/4  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add oil, eggs, vanilla and sour cream.  Mix together.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bake at 325° for 40 minutes in a 9 x 12-inch pan (greased and floured) or 60 minutes in greased and floured tube cake pan.

name: VERNA HOFFMAN'S EASY GERMAN CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients: 1  German chocolate cake mix
preparation: Prepare cake mix according to directions.  Cool.  Ice with the icing recipe.

name: TACO SURPRISE
ingredients:
1  box Stove Top cornbread stuffing
1  lb. ground beef, browned
1 (8 oz.)  jar picante or salsa sauce, medium or hot
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Prepare the stuffing as directed on box.  Set aside.  Brown meat and add sauce.  Cook for 15 to 20 minutes.  Layer half of stuffing in casserole.  Top with ground beef, then spread cheese over meat.  Cover with remaining stuffing.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Double recipe for a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  You can sprinkle cheese on top also.

name: COCONUT CHERRY BARS
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. chopped maraschino cherries
2/3  c. flaked coconut
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Cream butter and sugar.  Blend in egg and vanilla.  Sift together flour, baking powder and salt and stir into creamed mixture.  Add nuts, cherries, coconut and chocolate. Spread into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 25 minutes.  Cool slightly.  Cut in 40 bars.

name: GORGONZOLA-SAUCED PASTA
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. Blue cheese (2 oz.)
1/2 to 3/4  c. light cream
dash of white pepper
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1  lb. any cooked pasta
preparation: Melt butter; add Blue cheese.  Stir in light cream, pepper and Parmesan cheese.  Toss cheese with pasta until coated.  Serve immediately.

name: DOUBLE CHOCOLATE BROWNIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/3  c. margarine
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. water
12  oz. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  In medium bowl, combine margarine, sugar and water; put in microwave until margarine melts.  Add 1/2 of chocolate morsels and stir until melted; add vanilla.  Add eggs 1 at a time and beat well.  In small bowl, combine flour, soda and salt.  Gradually add this to ingredients in medium bowl.  Stir in remaining morsels and nuts; mix well.  Spread in greased 9-inch square pan.  Bake 30 minutes; cool and cut into squares.  Doubles easily.  If using 9 x 13-inch pan, add 5 to 8 minutes cooking time.  Freezes well.

name: STRAWBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. sugar
3  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1 1/4  c. salad oil
4  eggs, beaten
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1 1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine flour, sugar, cinnamon, soda and salt in large bowl. Add salad oil and eggs. Mix thoroughly; stir in strawberries and nuts. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3 pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: PAPAS GISADAS
ingredients:
2  to 3 potatoes, sliced or cubed
2 1/2  c. water
3  Tbsp. Crisco oil
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  onion
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  to 2 garlic cloves, mashed
1/2  tsp. cumin seed, mashed
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. parsley
preparation: Heat oil in frying pan and saute potatoes.  Add onion to potatoes.  Add water, tomato sauce and all remaining ingredients. Simmer, adding more water if needed.

name: PENNSYLVANIA APPLE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  large apples, peeled, cored and diced
1/2  c. finely chopped pecans
1  egg, beaten
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Lightly spread in shallow greased pan. Bake in preheated (350°) oven for 25 minutes or until macaroon-like crust forms on top.  Serve warm or cold with whipped cream.  Serves 6.

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
3  lb. small white potatoes
1  c. beef bouillon (2 cubes)
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. oil
1  medium chopped onion
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Boil potatoes in skin.  When done, cool, peel and slice thin. Combine bouillon, oil, vinegar, onion, salt and pepper.  Stir into potatoes gently.  Liquid will be absorbed.

name: LO-CAL DESSERT LIME FLUFF
ingredients:
1  pt. cottage cheese
1  large Cool Whip
1  pkg. lime jello (sugar free)
1  can mandarin oranges
1  can pineapple tidbits
1  c. colored marshmallows
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Sprinkle dry jello over cottage cheese and Cool Whip.  Drain oranges and pineapple.  Add to cottage cheese mixture, then add marshmallows and nuts.  Refrigerate.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. hot sausage (room temperature)
1/2  lb. sharp cheese (room temperature)
4  c. Bisquick
dash of hot sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Shape into marble-size balls.  Bake on cookie sheet at 325° for 20 minutes.

name: ANGEL SAUCE WITH ANGEL CAKE
ingredients:
1  can mandarin oranges, drain and reserve juice
1 small  can frozen orange juice, undiluted
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour or cornstarch
1  lump oleo
preparation: Mix flour and sugar. Add juices.  Cook until thick. Add oranges and oleo. Serve over angel food cake. Use whipped cream on cake and then use sauce. Refrigerate.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  bunch broccoli florets
1  head cauliflower florets
8  bacon strips, fried and crumbled
1/3  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped tomatoes, seeded
2  hard-cooked eggs, sliced or chopped
1  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1/3  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: In large salad bowl, combine broccoli florets and cauliflower florets, bacon, onion, tomatoes and eggs; set aside.  In another bowl, combine mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar.  Mix until smooth. Just before serving, pour dressing over salad and toss.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: LEMON CUSTARD PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs, separated
grated peel of 1 lemon
confectioners sugar
6  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: In a large mixing bowl combine flour, butter and 1 1/2 cups sugar.  Beat egg yolks and add to mixing bowl along with milk and lemon peel.  Mix well.  Add lemon juice.

name: BEANS AND SAUSAGE
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. smoked sausage, sliced to bite-sized pieces
1 (15 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2 (1 1/2 lb.)  cans Ranch Style pinto beans
1  c. chopped celery
1 medium onion, chopped or 1  tsp. onion salt substituted
1  c. green pepper, chopped
red pepper to taste
preparation: Saute celery, onion and pepper in small amount of cooking oil or butter.  Add to remaining ingredients.  Stir until well blended.  Simmer until consistency to serve over cooked rice.

name: UNBELIEVABLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  c. creamy peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat sugar and peanut butter until creamy.  Add beaten egg. Mix well and add vanilla.  Shape dough into a large ball.  Pinch off pieces.  Shape into 1-inch balls (marble size) and place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Place 2 inches apart.  Press with a fork, making cross marks and flattening.  Bake at 325° for 10 minutes until brown.  Let cool before removing from cookie sheet. Results: Crispy cookies.

name: MAGIC LEMON MERINGUE PIE
ingredients:
1  (8-inch) baked pastry pie shell, cooled, or crumb crust
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. lemon rind, grated
2  eggs, separated
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: In medium size bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice and rind.  Blend in egg yolks.  Turn into cooled crust.  In a small size bowl, beat egg whites with cream of tartar until soft peaks form.  Gradually beat in sugar until stiff peaks form when beater is raised.  Spread over filling.  Seal to edge of crust. Bake in slow oven (275° to 325°) for 12 to 15 minutes or until meringue is golden brown.

name: BRICKLE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. margarine or butter
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  (6 oz.) bag (1 c.) Bits 'O Brickle
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Cream butter with sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Beat until fluffy. Blend in dry ingredients.  Stir in Bits 'O Brickle.  Spread evenly in a well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake for 30 minutes.  When cool, cut into bars.  Makes about 3 dozen.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 large  pkg. sour cream
2  cans Mandarin oranges
1/2  pkg. miniature marshmallows
1  c. shredded coconut
preparation: Let cream cheese soften.  Mix cream cheese and sour cream well.  Drain Mandarin oranges and add to mixture.  Add marshmallows and shredded coconut and mix well.  Place in refrigerator and chill until ready to serve.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF(Easy, But Delicious!)
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak, cut in thin strips
1  envelope onion soup mix
1  carton (pt.) sour cream
1  can mushrooms, drained
flour
preparation: Flour and brown steak in as little shortening as possible. Completely cover with water; add soup mix and cook slowly, covered about 2 hours or until tender.  Add mushrooms when meat is almost done. Stir in sour cream and just barely simmer for 10 minutes. Serve over buttered noodles.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: CHOCOLATE CHERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
mini marshmallows
1  pkg. devil's food cake mix
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cherry Jell-O
1 (20 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
1  container Cool Whip
preparation: Grease a 9 x 13-inch glass pan.  Cover the bottom of the pan with the mini marshmallows.  Prepare devil's food cake mix as directed on the package.  Spoon carefully over the marshmallows. Mix in a bowl the cherry jello (dry) with the cherry pie filling. Spoon carefully over the cake batter (do not pour, spoon it over). Bake for 50 minutes at 350°.  Cool and cut into squares.  Serve with Cool Whip.

name: ICE CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
6  c. Rice Krispies
2/3  c. peanut butter
1  gal. ice cream
preparation: Melt chips and peanut butter in large pan; add cereal.  Spread on cookie sheet and cool in fridge.  Break mixture into small pieces after dried.  Soften ice cream; fold in all but 1 cup of cereal mixture.  Spread in a 10-inch spring-form pan.  Use remaining 1 cup cereal mixture to decorate top.  Garnish with whipped cream and strawberries, if desired.

name: BREAD PUFF
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  c. milk
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
brown sugar
cinnamon
margarine
preparation: Use either an 8 x 10-inch pan or 1 round layer cake pan. Grease pan and sprinkle generously with brown sugar.  Mix in medium bowl: sugar, shortening, milk, flour and baking powder. Spread batter in pan over the brown sugar.  Dot the batter with margarine and sprinkle generously with brown sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until done.

name: ITALIAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken, cut up
1 large  bottle of Wishbone Italian Dressing
flour
Parmesan cheese
garlic salt
preparation: Marinate the chicken in Italian dressing over night.  Keep Refrigerate.  Mix equal parts of flour and parmesan cheese.  Add garlic and salt to taste.  Roll chicken in flour mixture and put in shallow baking pan.  Pour remaining dressing around chicken, but not on top.  Bake uncovered at 350 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
1  c. meal
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1  medium onion, chopped
1  egg
preparation: Mix all ingredients with enough liquid to make a soft dough. Drop from teaspoon in deep fat.   Fry until golden brown.

name: GREEN PEA DIP
ingredients:
1  can green pea or split pea with ham soup (Campbell's brand)
1  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. grated onion or chopped green onion
soy sauce to taste
tortilla chips
preparation: Cream the soup and mayonnaise together.  Add onion and soy sauce.  Mix and refrigerate.

name: CARROT SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. carrots, sliced, cooked and cooled
1  green pepper, sliced
1  large onion, sliced
1  can tomato soup
1/2  c. oil (scant)
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Marinate carrots, green pepper and onion in tomato soup.  Mix other ingredients and pour over marinated vegetables.  Let stand for 12 hours.

name: CRUSTLESS SPINACH QUICHE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
5  eggs
1  large chopped onion
3/4  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach
preparation: Thaw spinach and squeeze to remove moisture.  Saute onion in oil.  Add spinach and cook until excess moisture is evaporated. Let cool.  Beat eggs in bowl and add cheese.  Stir into spinach mixture.  Pour into greased quiche pan or 9-inch pie plate.  Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

name: RUM COFFEE STRIPS(Easy Refrigerator Cookies)
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. instant coffee
1/8  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. shortening
3 1/3  c. butter
1/3  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. rum extract
preparation: Sift dry ingredients.  Cream the butter and shortening until fluffy.  Add eggs and flavoring; beat well.  Stir in dry ingredients; blend.  Shape into 2 flat rectangles and chill overnight after wrapping in wax paper.

name: ICEBOX COOKIES
ingredients:
1  box graham crackers
2  sticks margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1  c. nuts
1  c. coconut
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
preparation: Place whole graham crackers in bottom of 9 x 15-inch pan.  Melt in saucepan the margarine.  Mix sugar, egg and milk; bring to boil. Cook 1 minute; remove from heat.  Add nuts, coconut and graham cracker crumbs.  Pour over whole crackers, then top with layer of whole graham crackers.  Chill.

name: RICE KRISPIES TREATS
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. caramels
1  stick margarine
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  pkg. large marshmallows
1  box Rice Krispies cereal
preparation: Melt together caramels, margarine and milk until smooth.  Dip marshmallows in caramel sauce and roll in Rice Krispies.

name: PARTY SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. grated cheese
1  lb. sausage
1 1/3  c. Bisquick
preparation: Mix all together in bowl.  Then make round balls, size of walnuts.  Place on cookie sheets.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Then turn them over and bake 10 minutes more.  Drain on paper towels.

name: PINEAPPLE CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts (frozen)
3  cloves garlic
1 small  can crushed pineapple with juice
1  can pineapple rings with juice
1  sm/med bell  pepper, chopped
1/2  cup low fat or fat free French dressing
preparation: Put above ingredients in crock pot and cook on low for 8 hrs.

name: TAFFY APPLE SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. drained, crushed pineapple
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. apple cider vinegar
1  beaten egg
5  or 6 tart apples, chopped or cubed
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
chopped pecans
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients in saucepan until thick.  Cool.  Chop or cube apples.  Put cooled mixture and Cool Whip on apples. Add chopped pecans to own liking.  Mix thoroughly.

name: BUTTER PECAN COOKIES
ingredients:
1  cup butter or margarine
3/4  cup brown sugar
3/4  cup granulated sugar
2  eggs
1  teaspoon vanilla
2  1/4 cups flour
1  teaspoon soda
1/2  teaspoon salt
1  cup finely chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Cream butter and	sugars, beat in eggs and vanilla.  Combine flour, soda, and salt, add to creamed mixture and mix well.  Stir in pecans.  Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.  Yield approximately 4 dozen.

name: TABOULI
ingredients:
1  c. dry bulgur wheat
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. fresh lemon or lime juice
1 heaping  tsp. fresh garlic, crushed
1/2  c. chopped scallions, including green
1/2  tsp. dried mint
2  medium tomatoes, diced
1/4  c. olive oil
1  c. fresh chopped parsley
preparation: Combine bulgur, water and salt in a bowl.  Cover; let stand 15 to 20 minutes, until bulgur is chewable.  Add lemon juice, garlic, oil and mint.  Mix thoroughly.  Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.

name: BARLEY (TABBOULEH) SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. cooked barley
1/4  c. extra virgin olive oil
3  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
2  cloves garlic, finely minced
1  c. fresh mint leaves, coarsely chopped
1/2  c. fresh dill, chopped
2  c. plum tomatoes, seeded and diced
1/2  c. scallions, thinly sliced
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Toss cooked barley in a large bowl with the olive oil, lemon juice and garlic.  Add the chopped mint and dill.  Toss in tomatoes, cucumbers and scallions.  Season with salt and pepper. Toss gently, but thoroughly.  Let rest for 1 hour so the flavors can blend.  Garnish with sprigs of mint or dill before serving. Serving Size:  12.  Preparation Time:  0:30.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked (not quite done)
1  can mushroom soup
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. grated sharp cheese
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1  stack Ritz crackers
1  stick melted oleo
preparation: Mix together mushroom soup, eggs, mayonnaise, cheese and onion and put in bowl with broccoli.  Mix together crackers and oleo and sprinkle on top of casserole.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CRUNCHY PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas
1 1/2  c. chopped cauliflower
1/2 to 1  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. Ranch salad dressing
1  c. diced celery
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. light sour cream
crisp crumbled bacon
preparation: Combine all ingredients except bacon.  Chill.  Garnish with bacon and additional nuts just before serving.

name: CHEESY CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. butter
1 1/2  c. chicken broth*
1 1/2  c. diced cooked chicken*
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. celery salt
2  cans creamed corn
1/4  tsp. white pepper
1  c. shredded carrots
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
4  c. hash browns
3  c. milk
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  c. green peppers (optional)
preparation: *Can substitute 2 cans cream-style chicken for broth and diced chicken.  Add water to make 3 cups.

name: REFRIGERATOR PICKLES
ingredients:
7  c. cucumbers, sliced
2  c. sugar
1  c. cider vinegar
1  c. green pepper
1  c. onion
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. celery seed
1 to 2  tsp. mustard seed
preparation: Stir together sugar, vinegar, celery seed and mustard seed. Add remaining ingredients.   Store in tightly covered container in refrigerator.

name: CHEWIES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  lb. box brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. nuts or coconut or half and half
preparation: Melt margarine with the box of sugar and then let it cool.  Add eggs, vanilla, flour and nuts or coconut.  Pour into a greased and floured 3 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Bake in a 325° oven for about 35 minutes.  Cool.  Cut into squares.  Makes 36 small squares.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple (drain well)
1  (9 oz.) container Cool Whip
3/4  c. chopped pecans
maraschino cherry halves
3  sticks butter
2  c. powdered sugar
3  to 4 bananas, sliced
preparation: Mix graham cracker crumbs with 1 stick melted butter.  Put in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cream together eggs, 2 sticks butter, powdered sugar and vanilla.  Beat mixture for 15 minutes with electric mixer.  Spread mixture over crumbs.  Spread sliced bananas over mixture.  Spread drained pineapple over bananas. Spread Cool Whip over bananas.  Sprinkle with pecans.  Top with maraschino cherries.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP/OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2  c. oats
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Grease baking sheets.  Combine flour, salt and baking soda. In separate bowl, beat together the shortening, sugars and vanilla until creamy.  Add eggs, beating until light and fluffy. Gradually beat in flour mixture and rolled oats.  Stir in chocolate chips.  Drop batter by well rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased baking sheets.  Bake in preheated 350° oven for 10 to 13 minutes, or until golden.

name: MEAT LOAF PIE
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes, creamed
1/2  lb. ground beef
seasoning to taste
preparation: Line a casserole dish with half of potatoes.  Season meat. Place on top of potatoes.  Cover with remaining potatoes.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: MEXICAN PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. pasta
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  can red kidney beans, drained
1/2  c. pitted ripe olives, sliced
1  can chickpeas, drained
1  c. thinly sliced escarole (lettuce)
1 (12 oz.)  jar prepared salsa
preparation: Prepare pasta according to package.  Drain.  In large bowl, combine pasta and oil; toss gently to coat well.  Add kidney beans, chickpeas, olives, escarole and salsa.  Toss, chill and serve.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1  large onion
1  lb. hamburger
1  qt. tomato juice
1  tsp. salt (rounded)
1  can kidney beans
1/2  lb. spaghetti
1/4  tsp. chili powder (or more if you wish)
2  tsp. butter
preparation: Cut up onion and  brown in butter.  Add hamburger; stir and cook until no longer red.  Add tomato juice and salt.  Cook slowly, about 1/2 hour.  Add kidney beans.  Break up and add spaghetti.  Cook slowly until soft.  Add water, if necessary.  Add chili powder last.  Allow about 1 hour or longer to make, stirring occasionally.  Can be reheated or can be frozen for later use.

name: CHEESEBURGER PIE
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. hamburger meat
1  large onion, chopped
4  pkg. of crescent rolls, uncooked
1 large  box of Velveeta cheese
preparation: Fry hamburger meat until done.  Drain off excess fat.  Add onions to the meat and cook until onions turn clear.  Set meat mixture aside.  When you open the crescent rolls, do not separate into crescent shapes but leave as rectangles.  Line the bottom of a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan with a layer of crescent rolls.  Add the hamburger and onion mix.  Top with a layer of the Velveeta cheese and finish with another layer of crescent rolls until all the top is covered.  Put in 375° oven and bake until crescent rolls turn golden brown. Cut into cubes to suit your plate.  Great served with salad and baked beans.

name: UNCOOKED BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
bananas
vanilla wafers
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1  pkg. French vanilla instant pudding mix
3 1/2  c. milk
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
Cool Whip
preparation: Layer bananas and vanilla wafers, pouring mixture of vanilla pudding mix, vanilla instant pudding mix, milk and sour cream over each layer.  Top with Cool Whip.  Better if it sits over at least 24 hours before serving.

name: GRANDMA'S NO BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. cocoa
1  stick butter
2  c. sugar
3  c. quick oatmeal
3/4  c. peanut butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cook milk, butter, sugar and cocoa.  Boil until it bubbles all over the top.  Then add to mixture the oats, peanut butter and vanilla.  Mix thoroughly, then spoon on waxed paper and let cool. Serves 36.

name: GROUND BEEF IN GRAVY
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1/4 to 1/2  c. flour
2  c. water
1/2  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Patty ground beef into about 2-inch patties.  Brown on both sides in a large skillet.  Remove from skillet.  Brown flour in fat; add water slowly, stirring to keep from lumping.  Add milk, salt and pepper, stirring constantly to keep milk from curdling. Add hamburger patties and simmer for about 15 minutes.

name: SPAGHETTI MEAT SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. olive oil
2  onions, chopped fine
3  cloves, minced
2  lb. ground beef
3  c. tomato juice
1 1/2  c. tomato puree
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. parsley, chopped
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. red pepper
1  Tbsp. black pepper
1  tsp. dried basil
1  medium bay leaf
12  stuffed olives
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
preparation: Heat oil in deep frying pan.  Add onions, garlic and brown; add meat and brown slowly. Heat tomato juice, puree, and paste in deep kettle (3 qt. size). Add meat mixture, celery, green pepper, parsley, and other seasonings. Simmer slowly for 1 1/2 hours. Remove bay leaf. Add sliced olives; simmer 10 minutes longer. Serve over hot spaghetti. Top with Parmesan cheese. Makes 2 quarts spaghetti sauce. Freezes well.

name: CORNED BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. macaroni
1 (12 oz.)  can corned beef
1/4  lb. light Cheddar cheese, grated
1  can creamy chicken soup
1  c. milk
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Cook macaroni in boiling water and salt; drain.  Add corned beef, cheese, soup, milk and onions.  Put in casserole.  Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: LO-CAL CRAB COCKTAIL CAKES
ingredients:
1  lb. cooked crab meat or 2 (6 oz.) cans crab meat, rinsed and drained
2  egg whites, lightly beaten
1 1/4  c. reduced calorie sour cream
1  c. chopped green onions
1  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
1  c. fresh whole wheat bread crumbs
2  tsp. minced fresh dill or 1 tsp. dried dill
1  lemon, cut in wedges for garnish
preparation: In large bowl blend crab meat, 1/4 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup green onions and lemon juice.  Form mixture into 1 inch diameter patties.  Combine bread crumbs and dill.  Roll cakes in crumb mixture.  Place on large nonstick baking sheet and bake in preheated 375° oven 10 to 15 minutes.  In small bowl combine remaining sour cream and green onions.  Serve cakes garnished with lemon wedges; pass sour cream, green onion mixture.  Makes 16 to 20 (1-inch) crab cakes.  Nutrients per crab cake:  calories 46, protein 6 g, carbohydrates 2 g, total fat 1 g, cholesterol 25 mg, sodium 86 mg.

name: FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large  can pineapple juice
1 small  can frozen orange juice, diluted
1 small  can frozen lemonade, diluted
2  qt. ginger ale
1  qt. pineapple sherbet
preparation: Add sherbet just before serving.  Serves 25.

name: WINDMILL COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter
1  egg, separated
1  Tbsp. baking powder
2/3  c. colored sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  c. all-purpose flour
30  candy coated chocolate pieces
preparation: You will need 30 popsicle sticks.

name: GAZPACHO
ingredients:
6  ripe tomatoes, peeled and seeded
2  cucumbers, peeled, seeded and divided
4 1/2  c. ice water
2  medium bell peppers, seeded and chopped
2  cloves garlic, peeled
3  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1/2  ground red pepper
salt and pepper
croutons
preparation: Dice 2 tomatoes and 1/2 of a cucumber.	Cover and refrigerate until serving time.  In a blender or food processor, place 2 1/2 cups of ice water, 4 tomatoes, 1 1/2 cucumbers, green peppers, onion and garlic.  Run until finely chopped.  Add olive oil and mix well.  Pour into large bowl.  Add remaining 2 cups ice water.

name: SORBET A LA FRAISE(Strawberry Ice)
ingredients:
3  c. strawberries
3/4  c. confectioners sugar
3 to 4  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 to 2  Tbsp. Superfine sugar
preparation: Set aside 4 perfect strawberries with stems.  Wash and cap remaining strawberries.  Puree strawberries in blender, food processor (with a steel blade) or food mill.  Combine puree with confectioners sugar and lemon juice.  Pour mixture into a 1-quart metal pan or ice cube tray.  Freeze until mushy and frozen 1/2 inch around sides.

name: JELLO CAKE
ingredients:
1  white cake mix
2 small  boxes jello (may use same flavor or 2 different flavors)
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cake as directed on box and bake.  Cool as directed using 2 pans sprayed with Pam.  Mix each box of jello with 1/2 cup hot water.  Add 1/2 cup cold water and mix.  With cakes still in pans, poke holes throughout with meat fork.  Pour jello over cake - slowly.  Refrigerate overnight.  Loosen cake from pans and use the Cool whip for frosting.

name: BAKED BRIE
ingredients:
1  small wheel of Brie or Camembert
1  sheet Pepperidge Farm pastry sheets
honey mustard, brown sugar or apricot preserves
preparation: Spread thawed pastry sheet on baking sheet.  Place Brie (or Camembert) in center of sheet.  (Optional:  Remove rind from cheese prior to placing on pastry sheet.)  Spread honey mustard or apricot preserves on top of cheese.  (If honey mustard is used, sprinkle a small amount of brown sugar on top.)  Wrap cheese in pastry; bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until done.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
9  inch pie shell, baked
1/3  c peanut butter
3/4  c 10X sugar
preparation: Mix peanut butter and 10X sugar together until crumbly. Put in bottom of pie shell (save a little to put on top of pie).

name: MOUNTAIN DEW SALAD
ingredients:
1  (6 oz.) lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
1  can Mountain Dew
1  (15 oz.) pineapple chunks or tidbits, drain and save juice
1  pkg. cooked lemon pudding
1  c. Cool Whip
1  c. marshmallows
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Add Mountain Dew and juice from pineapple.  Chill until it thickens.  Cook pudding as directed; cool.  Mix gelatin, lemon pudding and Cool Whip.  Beat together.  Add pineapple and marshmallows.

name: MAYONNAISE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. cocoa
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift first 5 ingredients together; set aside.

name: SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
6  oz. spaghetti
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  eggs, well beaten
1  c. cottage cheese (8 oz.)
1  lb. ground beef or bulk pork sausage
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up (undrained)
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese (2 oz.)
preparation: Cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain.  Should have about 3 cups.  Stir butter or margarine into hot spaghetti. Stir in Parmesan cheese and eggs.  Form mixture into a crust in a buttered 10-inch pie plate.  Spread cottage cheese over bottom of crust.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (5 oz.)  jar sharp Cheddar spread
1 (5 oz.)  jar smoky cheese spread
1 (2 oz.)  pkg. Roquefort cheese
1/2  tsp. grated onion
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/3  c. evaporated milk
chopped parsley
preparation: Put cheeses in bowl; let stand at room temperature until soft. Blend.  Add onion and Worcestershire.  Gradually add milk.  Chill for 4 hours.

name: PIGS IN A BLANKET
ingredients:
2 small  cans crescent dinner rolls
1  pkg. Little Smokies wieners
toothpicks
preparation: Pull apart layers of dinner roll.  Wrap little wieners inside pastry.  Secure with toothpick.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

name: WINDOW CLEANER
ingredients:
1/2  tsp. cornstarch
4  c. warm water
preparation: Mix water and cornstarch into a spray bottle; use as you would any window cleaner.  Discard after several weeks and mix new batch.

name: BROWN DERBIES(Low-fat)
ingredients:
2  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. Egg Beaters
2  c. chicken broth
1/2  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. liquid smoke
3  Tbsp. Lea & Perrins steak sauce
preparation: Mix as a meat loaf, adding broth last.  Make patties (1/2 cup size).  Brown patties in dry skillet and drain.

name: ORANGE PINEAPPLE SHERBET
ingredients:
1  (2-liter) Nehi orange drink
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour in ice cream freezer and freeze.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
10  qt. air popped popcorn
toasted almonds or other nuts
preparation: Place popped popcorn in 2 large roasting pans.  Sprinkle almonds or nuts over popcorn.  Melt butter.  Stir in brown sugar, corn syrup and salt.  Bring to boil and continue to boil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.   Stir in baking soda and vanilla.  Gradually pour over popcorn and mix well. Bake for 1 hour at 250°, stirring every 15 minutes.  Put into Tupperware immediately so it won't stick to pans.

name: CREAM GRAVY
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. shortening or sausage or bacon grease
2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. water *
1 1/2  c. milk *
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of black pepper
preparation: *May use all milk.

name: HOT CRAB DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  jar Kraft Old English cheese
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
dash of salt
dash of pepper
8  oz. crabmeat
1/4  c. slivered almonds
preparation: Soften cheeses and mix together with onion, salt and pepper. Add chopped crab.  Spread in glass pie plate; top with almonds. Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.  Serve with crackers.

name: FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. 6 oz. thinly sliced onions
3  oz. butter
1  tsp. green pepper
1  tsp. paprika
2  bay leaves
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  qt. beef bouillon (can or cubes)
preparation: Melt butter; add onion.  Saute 20 minutes.  Add paprika, pepper, bay leaves and flour.  Stir; mix well over low heat.  Add small amount of bouillon and cook for 5 minutes.  Gradually add rest of bouillon; simmer for 30 minutes or place all ingredients in crock-pot for several hours.  Place slice of French bread in bowl and shredded Provolone or Gruyere cheese.  Brown under broiler.

name: GOLDEN PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large  can apricot nectar
1 large  can pineapple juice
1  large frozen lemonade
1  large orange juice
1  large ginger ale
preparation: Mix all ingredients and add a large can of water.  May use a juice can.  Stir.  Add ginger ale before serving.

name: CHEESE STRUEDEL
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) crescent rolls
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  egg, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Mix together cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and egg yolk. Spread 1 package crescent rolls in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Pinch at perforations to keep from separating.  Pour cream cheese mixture evenly to cover dough. Spread second stretched crescent dough over top. Brush with egg white over top.  Bake in glass pan at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes. Bake in metal pan at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: POPPY SEED DELIGHT LOAF
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2 1/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. milk
1 1/4  c. oil
3  eggs
1 1/2  Tbsp. poppy seed
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  tsp. almond extract
1 1/2  tsp. butter flavoring
preparation: Combine all of the ingredients; mix for 1 to 2 minutes with electric mixer.  Pour into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Let cool in pan about 5 minutes, then glaze.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans French-style green beans
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
1 (28 oz.)  can dried onions
preparation: Drain juices off green beans.  Mix beans, milk and soup in a large bowl.  Add 1/2 can of dried onions.  Pour into a greased pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Pour rest of onions on top and bake for 10 more minutes.

name: SHRIMP AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli (thaw just to separate)
1  lb. raw shrimp (canned may be used)
salt and pepper to taste
1  can cream of celery soup
1  c. salad dressing or mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Arrange broccoli in buttered 7 x 4-inch pan.  Cover with raw shrimp.  Sprinkle with seasonings.  Combine celery soup, salad dressing, lemon juice and cheese.  Spread mixture all over shrimp. Top with buttered bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes or until nice and bubbly.

name: GARDEN VEGETABLE PASTA
ingredients:
1  lb. pasta (any shape)
1  lb. bag frozen vegetables, mixed
1  c. low-fat sour cream
1  packet garden vegetable party dip mix
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water about 5 minutes. Before the pasta is done, stir in frozen vegetables.  While this cooks, in a large bowl, mix low-fat sour cream with packet of garden vegetable party dip mix.  Drain pasta and vegetables well, then add to the sour cream mixture and toss well to mix.  Serve with grated Parmesan cheese.  Serves 4.

name: SUGAR DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  lb. butter, room temperature
2  eggs, beaten lightly
1  c. sour milk or buttermilk
4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, mixing well.  Stir in milk. Combine dry ingredients and mix in.  Drop mixture from spoon onto cookie sheets; spread with spatula.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until nicely brown.  Remove from sheet immediately and cool on wax paper.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: FRUIT SLUSH
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1  can water
6  bananas, diced
1 large  can crushed pineapple with juice
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  c. water
1 small  bottle cherries, diced
preparation: Combine sugar and 3 cups water; bring to a boil.  Let cool. Add the rest of the ingredients and freeze.  Take out 2 hours before serving.

name: COMPANY CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  chicken, cut up (or pieces of your choice)
1  c. raw rice
1  envelope dry onion soup mix
2 to 2 1/2  c. water
1  stick margarine, melted
salt, pepper and paprika to taste
preparation: Wash chicken pieces and pat dry.  Spread rice and onion mix in bottom of Pyrex dish.  Place chicken pieces on top of rice and soup mix.  Pour water over this.  Pour melted margarine over all. Add salt, pepper and paprika.  Cover and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: MEXICAN SQUASH
ingredients:
6  to 8 medium yellow squash
1  sliced onion
1  can whole kernel corn
1 small  can chopped green chilies
Cheez Whiz or Velveeta
preparation: Boil squash with onion and salt until slightly crunchy. Drain well. Put in bottom of greased casserole. Mix in corn. Add green chilies. Cover with Cheez Whiz or cubed Velveeta cheese. Top with bread crumbs or a can of fried onion rings. Bake at 350° about 30 minutes.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
6  graham crackers (4 section per cracker)
1  small instant sugar-free vanilla pudding
1/2  c. pineapple juice
banana
strawberries
1 1/2  c. crushed pineapple, drained
6  Tbsp. Cool Whip
preparation: Line bottom of dish with graham crackers.  I prefer to crush and line bottom with crumbs.  In medium bowl, mix 1 small pudding as directed on box, but substitute pineapple juice for 1/2 cup milk.  Spread 1/2 pudding over crackers, then layer 1 banana sliced, then pudding, 1 cup strawberries, then 1 1/2 cups crushed pineapple, drained.  Dot with 6 tablespoons Cool Whip.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
3 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. oil
2  c. grated zucchini
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped nuts
2  c. raisins
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, combine sugar and oil.  Mix in eggs and zucchini.  Add salt, flour, soda, spices and vanilla.  Mix well.  Stir in raisins and nuts.  Bake in 2 greased and floured loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 75 minutes.

name: PHEASANT PIE(Favorite Recipe of Cecil D. Andrus, Governor of Idaho)
ingredients:
1  (3 to 4 lb.) pheasant (dressed weight)
6  peppercorns
1  Tbsp. salt
1  c. light cream
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 (1 lb.)  can pearl onions (optional)
1 (14 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms
1  box pastry mix
1  bay leaf
1  stalk celery
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  pkg. frozen peas
2  cans pimientos, sliced
preparation: Place pheasant in large kettle and cover with water.  Add bay leaf, celery, peppercorns and 1 tablespoon salt.  Bring to a boil. Cover and cook over low heat 2 to 3 hours, or until pheasant is tender.  (Can be done the day before.)  Remove meat from bones; strain broth.  Melt butter in saucepan; add flour and stir until blended.  Gradually add 2 cups of the broth, stirring constantly. Add light cream, pepper and salt.  Cook, stirring until thickened. Arrange pheasant pieces, onions, mushrooms, peas and pimientos in a 2-quart casserole.  Add sauce, leaving at least 1-inch space at top.

name: GLAZED WALNUTS
ingredients:
2  egg whites
1  c. white sugar
pinch of salt
1  lb. walnuts
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Beat egg whites; add sugar and salt.  Add nuts and stir until covered with mixture.  Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Spread nuts over butter and bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 325°.  Stir every 10 minutes.

name: CHICKEN LICKEN GOOD PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  to 8 lean pork chops
1/2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
2  Tbsp. oil
1 (10 oz.)  can chicken and rice soup
preparation: Coat pork chops in mixture of flour, salt, dry mustard and garlic powder.  Brown in oil in large skillet.  Place browned pork chops in crock-pot.  Add can of soup.  Cover and cook on low, 6 to 8 hours (high, 3 1/2 hours).

name: GLORIFIED RICE
ingredients:
1  c. rice
1  c. milk
1  c sugar
1 big  can crushed pineapple
1/4  pound marshmallows
1/2  pint cream
maraschino cherries
red cake coloring
preparation: 1 c. rice, cooked well done.  Let stand until cool, then add 1 c milk and let cool until dry.  Then add 1 c. sugar, 1 big can crushed pineapple, drained, 1/4 pound marshmallows, 1/2 pint cream, whipped stiff, maraschino cherries and red cake coloring.  Let stand over night.

name: CHEESY SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
1  (6 oz.)can frozen orange juice
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese (room temp)
1  c. fresh or frozen coconut
1  c. grated carrots
1 med.  can crushed pineapple
