preparation: Dissolve jello in water combine orange juice and cream cheese thoroughly. Add slowly to the jello mixture. Add coconuts carrots and pineapple and beat until smooth. Pour into mold and chill until firm.

name: PEANUT BLOSSOM COOKIES
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  egg
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
48  chocolate Kisses
preparation: Combine all ingredients except Kisses in large mixing bowl. Mix on lowest speed of mixer until dough forms.  Shape dough into balls, using a rounded teaspoon for each.  Roll balls in sugar. Bake at 375° on ungreased cookie sheet.  Top each cookie immediately with candy Kiss; press down firmly so cookie cracks around edge.

name: HOLIDAY COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening (margarine or Mazola)
1  c. light brown sugar
2  eggs
3 1/2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
2  c. cherries, chopped (red and green)
2  c. chopped dates or raisins
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/4  c. buttermilk
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar and eggs together.  Sift together flour, salt and baking powder.  Mix sifted ingredients alternately with milk to sugar and shortening mixture.  Stir in dates, cherries and nuts.  Refrigerate at least 1 hour, preferably overnight.  Drop on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. sugar
2  c. milk
1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  stick butter, melted
7 or 8  oz. grated coconut
preparation: Beat eggs and add sugar, flour, milk, vanilla, coconut and melted butter.  Pour into two greased 9-inch pie pans.  Bake at 350° for 30 or 40 minutes.  This will make 2 pies without crust.

name: FAT-FREE PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1 large  can crushed pineapple
Egg Beaters for 2 eggs
preparation: Mix all together and pour into ungreased 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish.  Bake at 350° until toothpick put in center comes out clean.

name: CHEESE MUNCHIES
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1 1/2  c. corn flakes
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grate room temperature cheese and cream with butter/margarine.  Mix together in small bowl the flour, salt and paprika.  Add to first mixture and add Tabasco.  Mix well. Last, mix in carefully with a fork, the corn flakes, trying not to crush them too much.  Break off small pieces of the dough (about a tablespoon) and roll like a marble.  Press down lightly onto an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 12 minutes.  Easy and good.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  yellow squash
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. milk
1  can mushroom soup
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1  c. grated cheese
8  saltine crackers
4  Tbsp. oleo
preparation: Boil squash until tender; drain.  Mix all ingredients except a small amount of cheese and cracker crumbs.  Pour into casserole dish.  Sprinkle top with cheese and cracker crumbs.  Bake for about 30 minutes at 350°.

name: GINNY'S TORTILLA CHEESE RINGS
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
8 to 10  oz. Cheddar cheese, grated
1/2  c. picante (mild)
2 to 3  Tbsp. onion, chopped fine
garlic salt
1/2  to 1 jalapeno
preparation: Have cream cheese, Cheddar cheese and picante at room temperature.  Mix very well.  Add onion, garlic salt and jalapeno; mix well.  Spread on tortilla and roll lightly.  Put back in refrigerator.  Chill and then cut with electric knife.  Can freeze.

name: SALT SUBSTITUTE
ingredients:
1  tsp. chili powder
2  tsp. ground oregano
2  tsp. black pepper
2  Tbsp. dry mustard
3  Tbsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. garlic powder (not garlic salt)
3  Tbsp. poultry seasoning
6  Tbsp. onion powder (not onion salt)
preparation: Blend well.  Makes about 1 cup seasoning.

name: SWEDISH MEATBALLS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. ground pork
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
1/4  c. milk
1  egg, well beaten
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Melt margarine in a skillet; saute onions over low heat, stirring constantly until golden color.  Remove from heat.  In a bowl, mix together onions, ground beef, ground pork, bread crumbs, milk, egg, salt and pepper.  Make into meatballs the size of large walnuts.  Return to skillet; brown meatballs on all sides.  Cover and cook over low heat about 10 minutes or until done.  Makes about 20 meatballs.

name: PEACH KUCHEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
7/8  c. sugar
2  egg yolks
1  c. sour cream
3  large peaches
preparation: Mix butter, flour, baking powder, salt and 2 tablespoons sugar with pastry cutter until like corn meal. Save 1 cup of this for topping.  Pat the rest into the bottom of an 8-inch square pan. Place peaches, cut into slices, over crust. Sprinkle with 7/8 cup sugar mixed with 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake 20 minutes at 400°. Mix egg yolks and sour cream.  Pour over kuchen and bake 30 minutes more.  Cool.  Good warm or cold.

name: TORN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can chicken and rice soup
1  can Old El Paso enchilada sauce (can should be slightly larger than the soup cans)
1  pkg. Old El Paso taco seasoning mix
1  lb. grated Colby-Jack cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and add the taco seasoning.  At this point, do not add any water.  Mix in the cans of soup and the enchilada sauce.  You will now need to add enough water to make it soupy. Spoon sauce onto bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole dish (just enough to cover the bottom).

name: IOWA CITY CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
16  marshmallows
1/2  c. milk
4  regular size almond Hershey bars
1  c. whipping cream
1  graham cracker pie crust
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients in a double boiler; stir until blended.  Set aside and let cool.  Whip 1 cup of whipping cream and fold cooled chocolate mixture into it.  Pour into crust.  Keep refrigerated.  Takes a while to set.  Top with whipped cream and grated chocolate.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage (hot)
10  oz. extra sharp cheese, grated
2 or 3  c. biscuit
preparation: Mix ingredients together in mixing bowl with hands.  Make into balls.  Cook 20 to 30 minutes in oven at 350°.

name: DRESSING FOR FRUIT
ingredients:
1  container strawberry yogurt
4  oz. whipped cream cheese
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Whip together.  Serve on fresh fruit or fruit salad.

name: GROUND PORK AND SHRIMP STIR-FRY
ingredients:
3/4  lb. uncooked spaghetti
1/4  c. soy sauce
4  tsp. cornstarch
1  lb. ground pork
1  Tbsp. ginger
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
2  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. crushed red pepper
3/4  c. chopped green onion
1/2  lb. cooked baby shrimp, drained
preparation: Cook  spaghetti  according to package directions, omitting the salt.  Combine soy sauce, cornstarch and 1 cup water; set aside. Heat  cooking  oil  in  wok or electric skillet on medium  high heat.  Thoroughly  cook pork with ginger, garlic and red  pepper. Add  green onion and stir-fry 1 minute.  Add soy sauce mixture; cook until mixture boils and thickens.  Add shrimp and heat through.  Pour over noodles.  Toss to combine.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  onion, chopped
2  stalks celery
4  oz. can sliced mushrooms
1  stick margarine
2  pkg. chopped broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. sharp cheese, shredded
1/2  c. croutons
preparation: Saute onion and celery in margarine.  Add mushrooms.  Add broccoli, soup, cheese and croutons.  Mix all together.  Pour into casserole dish. Top with more croutons.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: CREAMY TACOS
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  onion
1  lb. velveeta cheese
1  can chili (no Bean)
8  oz. sour cream
1  pkg. tortilla chips
tomatoes
lettuce
salsa
preparation: Brown meat and onion.  Drain.  Add cheese to meat and melt. Add chili and sour cream.  Serve in layers.  Crumble chips; put hamburger mixture, then tomatoes, lettuce and salsa.

name: CHERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
1  pkg. graham crackers, crushed
1/2  stick butter or margarine
1  box Dream Whip
3/4  c. milk
1  c. powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  can cherry pie filling (may substitute other flavors)
preparation: Melt margarine and mix with crackers.  Spread in large casserole dish (9 x 12-inch).  Combine Dream Whip and milk.   Whip until thick.  Add powdered sugar and cream cheese.  Whip together until smooth.  Pour over cracker crust.  Pour canned filling over top.  Refrigerate for several hours or overnight.

name: EGGPLANT SOUP
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant, peeled and diced
1  c. water
dash of salt
1  qt. milk
2  Tbsp. flour
pepper to taste
preparation: Cook eggplant in water with salt until tender, about 10 minutes.  Add milk.  Add flour paste to thicken.  Add butter and pepper.  Tastes like oyster stew!

name: TORA'S BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. granulated sugar
3 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  egg
1  c. mashed banana
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
3/4  c. milk
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix together dry ingredients.  Combine remaining ingredients and stir into dry mixture.  Add nuts.  Grease and flour one large or two medium-size loaf pans.  Fill with dough.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  May cover with foil to prevent overbrowning.  Remove foil and continue baking until done.  (May be an additional 30 minutes for a large loaf.)

name: HOT TUNA SANDWICH
ingredients:
1  can tuna, chopped
3/4  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  Tbsp. chopped green peppers
3  hard-cooked eggs
1 1/2  Tbsp. minced onion
mayonnaise (enough to mix ingredients)
preparation: Place mixture in hamburger rolls and wrap in foil. Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.

name: CHEESY BROCCOLI POCKETS
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
2  tsp. olive oil
1  clove garlic, minced
1  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  jars roasted red peppers, chopped
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen bread dough, thawed
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°. Grease 2 baking sheets. Cook broccoli according to directions. Drain well. In a medium skillet, heat oil over low heat. Add garlic. Sauté for 2 minutes. Add broccoli. Cook, stirring, until moisture has evaporated, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Cool slightly. In a medium bowl, combine broccoli mix, Mozzarella, Parmesan, roasted peppers, oregano, salt and pepper. Mix well. On a lightly floured surface, divide dough into 8 pieces. Roll out each piece to form a 6-inch circle. Spoon an equal amount of broccoli mix in the center of each circle. Fold dough over filling to form a half circle. Press edges with a fork to seal; prick a few holes in pocket top. Place pockets on prepared baking sheet. Bake 25 minutes.

name: SWEDISH HEIRLOOM COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. butter, softened
5  oz. diced toasted almonds or chopped walnuts
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: In a large mixer bowl, combine all ingredients.  Blend well at low speed. Shape into balls or crescents, using a rounded teaspoonful for each.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 325° for 15 to 18 minutes.  Do not brown.  Roll warm cookies in additional confectioners sugar.

name: LINDA'S ROAST
ingredients:
roast (rump or chuck)
liquid smoke
garlic (minced or garlic salt)
celery salt
preparation: Place roast on a large sheet of heavy-duty foil.  Cup it around the roast.  Then season with celery salt and garlic and pour the entire bottle of liquid smoke over the meat.  Put an additional piece of foil on top and seal the 2 pieces together on all sides.

name: GRANOLA
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. rolled oats
1/2  c. slivered almonds
1/2  c. toasted wheat germ
1/4  c. honey
1/3  c. frozen apple juice concentrate
vegetable cooking spray
1/4  c. raisins
1/2  c. dried fruit, chopped (apples, apricots or any other dried fruits)
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°. In a large mixing bowl, combine the oats, almonds and wheat germ; set aside. Stir together honey and apple juice concentrate. Pour over oat mixture, stirring until coated. Spread mixture evenly in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan sprayed with vegetable cooking spray. Bake, uncovered, for 45 to 50 minutes or until brown. Stir every 15 minutes and several times during the last 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Stir in raisins and dried fruit. Transfer to another pan and cool. Store in airtight container. Makes 10 (1/2 cup) servings.

name: PORK TENDERLOIN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  strips tenderloin or 6 boneless pork chops (cheaper)
2  cans mushroom soup
10  oz. can mushrooms
1  pkg. onion soup
1 1/2  cans water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown meat in butter; add mushrooms.  Put in casserole.  Add soups.  Cover and bake 4 to 5 hours at 275°.  Serve with rice.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box noodles
1  tsp. salt
2  cans tuna
1  (8 oz.) mild cheese
preparation: Prepare noodles by box directions.  Drain noodles.  Mix noodles, tuna and cheese; put it in the bowls.  It's my favorite.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4 to 6  c. diced cooked chicken
1/2  c. almonds
2  c. chopped celery
1  c. cracker crumbs
6  hard cooked eggs, chopped
3  cans cream of chicken soup
A.1. sauce (optional)
4  Tbsp. grated onion
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. mayonnaise
1 small  can mushrooms
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Cover with cracker crumbs.  Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
1  medium onion, chopped
8  oz. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can water chestnuts, chopped
1  large round loaf bread
preparation: Thaw spinach and drain thoroughly, squeezing all water out of spinach. Mix spinach, soup mix, onion, sour cream, mayonnaise and water chestnuts. Blend well and set aside.

name: ORANGE CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1 1/2  c. orange juice
1 1/4  Tbsp. Soy Sauce
1  Tbsp. molasses
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/2  c. green pepper, coarsely chopped
1  orange, peeled and sliced
2  tsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Place chicken pieces in a single layer in a large skillet. Combine orange juice, soy sauce, molasses, dry mustard, garlic powder, cinnamon and ginder. Pour over chicken. Bring to boil, lower heat. Cover and let simmer for 30 minutes, or until chicken is tender. Add green pepper, cook 5 minutes longer.

name: CHEESE AND PASTRY APPETIZER
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. Muenster cheese, grated
1  beaten egg
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. melted butter
3/4  c. chopped parsley
1  pkg. refrigerated crescent rolls
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Combine Muenster, egg, pepper, garlic salt, salt and butter/margarine.  Set aside.  Roll out 1/4 package of the crescent rolls into a rectangle.  Be sure to seal pieces together.  Place half the cheese mixture in the center of the pastry and spread evenly, leaving about a 1/2 inch border all the way around the rectangle.  Roll out another 1/4 of the package into a rectangle; again being sure to seam pieces together and place on top of cheese mixture.  Pinch the pastry layers together, fluting decoratively as for pie crust if you wish.  Cut a few slits in the top for steam to escape and bake for about 20 minutes.  Cut in squares to serve.  This is good warm or at room temperature. Repeat process with remaining crescent rolls and filling to make an additional borka.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. beef sirloin
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter
3  oz. can sliced mushrooms, drained
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove crushed garlic
2  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. tomato paste
1 1/4  c. beef stock or 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can beef broth
1  c. dairy sour cream
2  Tbsp. dry white wine (optional)
preparation: Cut beef sirloin in 1/4-inch strips.  Coat meat with mixture of 1 tablespoon flour and salt.  Heat cooking utensil over direct heat.  Then add 2 tablespoons butter.  When melted, cook sirloin strips quickly until brown on all sides.  Add sliced mushrooms, onion and garlic.  Cook 3 or 4 minutes until onion is crisp-tender.  Remove from pan.

name: COCONUT CREAM PIE (MAKES 2 PIES)
ingredients:
4  c. milk
2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. flour
4  eggs, separate whites from yolks
1/2  stick butter or margarine
preparation: Mix all ingredients and cook in double boiler until thick. Beat egg whites well and pour into batter after it is done.  Beat with mixer.   Put coconut in batter; add vanilla and a little salt.  Toast a little coconut in oven.  Let cool.  Put Cool Whip on top of pies and sprinkle toasted coconut on top of Cool Whip.

name: SICILIAN SUPPER
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
3/4  c. milk
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
2  c. cooked egg noodles
preparation: Brown meat; add onion and cook until tender.  Add tomato paste and 1 cup water; salt and pepper and simmer 20 to 30 minutes. Heat milk and cream cheese in saucepan over medium heat.  Blend well.  Stir in 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, garlic salt and green pepper and noodles.  In 9 x 13-inch casserole, alternate layers of noodles and meat sauce.  Bake at 350°  for 20 minutes.  Sprinkle remaining Parmesan cheese on top before serving.

name: FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  1/2 lbs. chicken parts
1  can cream
1  egg
2  cups flour
2  cups vegetable oil
salt
pepper
preparation: Soak chicken overnight in salt water.  Combine cream and eggs in shallow dish.  In a plastic bag, combine flour, salt, and pepper.  Dip chicken in egg mixture; place in bag.  Shake bag to coat chicken with flour.  Cook in hot oil until browned, turning to brown both sides.  Cover and cook 25 minutes.  Uncover and cook an additional 5 minutes.  Drain on paper towels.

name: BEEF AND POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. cold, mashed potatoes
1/2  c. milk
1  egg
8  uncooked potatoes, sliced
2  large sliced onions
2  c. beef bouillon
preparation: Mix beef, salt, pepper, mashed potatoes, milk and egg.  Shape into patties.  Brown on both sides.

name: BAKED SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
spaghetti
1  bag potato chips
preparation: Spread spaghetti in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Top with 1 bag crushed potato chips. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Slice and serve.

name: PARTY PUNCH(Serves 50)
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
8  c. water
2 (12 oz.)  cans frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
4  c. cranberry juice
2 (34 oz.)  cans unsweetened pineapple juice
2 (3 liter)  bottles lemon-lime soda, chilled
preparation: Boil sugar and water in saucepan for 5 minutes.  Cool to room temperature.  Stir in orange juice concentrate, cranberry juice and pineapple juice.  Chill until serving time. Combine with lemon-lime soda in punch bowl at serving time.

name: CHOCOLATE, STOUT AND BOURBON PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. dark brown sugar, lightly packed
1/4  c. flour
1/3  c. cornmeal
6  extra large eggs
1 1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. stout
3/4  c. fine bourbon
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  unbaked sweet pie crust (10-inch)
whipped cream
preparation: Stir together the brown sugar, flour and cornmeal.  Beat eggs with granulated sugar until thick and light in color.  Add vanilla, stout and bourbon to the brown sugar mixture, stirring to eliminate lumps.  Fold in the beaten egg mixture and chocolate chips.  Pour into crust and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until the center is set.  Cool just until warm and serve with just a dollop of whipped cream.

name: SUMMER SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow summer squash (6 c.)
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. shredded carrots
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. herb seasoned stuffing mix
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
1  c. sour cream
preparation: In saucepan, cook sliced squash and onion in salted water for 5 minutes; drain.  Combine soup and sour cream; stir in shredded carrots.  Mix with squash and onion mixture.  Combine stuffing mix and butter.  Spread 1/2 of stuffing mixture in bottom of large baking dish.  Spoon vegetable mixture on top.  Sprinkle remaining stuffing mixture on top.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: BANANA BRAZIL NUT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. soft butter
2  eggs
1/4  c. buttermilk
3/4  c. chopped Brazil nuts or almonds
slightly sweetened whipped cream
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/4  c. mashed bananas (2)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In a bowl, combine flour, salt, baking soda and baking powder. In a larger bowl, cream together butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating thoroughly after each addition. Beat in bananas.  Add flour mixture, buttermilk and vanilla.  Beat until blended.  Stir in nuts.   Turn batter into 2 greased and lightly floured 9-inch layer cake pans.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until tester inserted near the center comes out clean. Let stand in pans on wire rack for 5 minutes.  Turn out.  Turn top side up.  Cool.  Spread whipped cream on top and sides with remaining cream.  Slice.  Serve.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can French onion soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Golden mushroom soup
salt and pepper
1/2  pt. sour cream
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  jar sliced mushrooms
preparation: Cube steak and brown in hot oil. Mix soups (undiluted). Season as desired with salt and pepper. Pour over beef and simmer, covered, in electric skillet or large skillet on the stove for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Add sour cream and mushrooms. Serve warm over noodles or rice.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
4  c. sliced apples
1  c. water
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. plain flour
1/2  c. margarine
preparation: Place apples in a buttered 9-inch baking dish.  Combine water and cinnamon;  pour  over  apples.  Mix sugar, flour and margarine until crumbly.  Spread  over  apples.  Bake  at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Serve topped with ice cream if desired. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: GREEN BEANS IN SAUCE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  clove garlic, chopped
2 1/2  c. canned tomatoes, sieved
1  c. boiling water
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. oregano
2  tsp. chopped parsley
1  lb. green beans
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat olive oil and garlic in a skillet until garlic is lightly browned.  Add tomatoes  and water slowly.  Stir in 1/2 teaspoon salt, pepper, oregano and parsley. Bring to boiling. Cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  oz. lean boiled chicken (1 meat)
1  Tbsp. Weight Watchers light mayonnaise (1 fat)
1/2  c. unsweetened pineapple (1 fruit)
1  small apple (1 fruit)
2  Tbsp. raisins (1 fruit)
slivered almonds
preparation: Place cleaned fryer hen in Dutch oven with water and poultry seasoning (generous amount); salt and pepper if your diet allows. Cook until meat falls away from bone.  Let cool and then remove meat from bone.  Add remaining ingredients to chicken, sprinkling slivered almonds on top of salad.

name: CRANBERRY SAUCE
ingredients:
1  large raspberry jello
1  can (small) crushed pineapple
1  can whole cranberry sauce
1/2  c. chopped celery
nuts to taste, chopped
preparation: Drain pineapple.  Save juice and use with water. Boil 1 1/2 cups water, add jello and bring to a boil.  Take off immediately and add 1 cup water and the 1/2 cup juice and the rest of the ingredients.  Stir around until cranberries are spread around and jelly is dissolved.  Put in refrigerator and let set.

name: CREAMY FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (7 oz.)  jar Kraft Marshmallow Creme
preparation: Combine softened cream cheese and Marshmallow Creme.  Mix until well blended.  Serve with fresh fruit, assorted cheeses or cookies as dippers.

name: MEXICAN-STYLE CHEESE STRATA
ingredients:
4  c. flavored tortilla chips, broken
2  c. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
6  eggs, beaten
2 1/2  c. milk
1 (4 oz.)  can green chillies, drained, seeded and chopped into slices
1/4  c. onion, finely chopped
3  tsp. catsup
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. bottled hot pepper sauce
whole tortilla chips
halved tomatoes
preparation: Sprinkle the broken tortilla chips evenly over the bottom of 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle cheese in a medium bowl; combine with rotary beater the eggs, milk, green chillies, onion, catsup, salt and hot pepper sauce.  Pour over cheese in dish. Cover.  Refrigerate several hours or overnight.  Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven 50 to 55 minutes or until set and lightly browned. Garnish with whole tortilla chips and halved tomato slices.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CHICKEN ZAMBOANGA(Serves 4)
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken thighs
1  can regular cream of mushroom soup
2  oz. whipped cream cheese
2  Tbsp. ripe olives
1  tsp. grated ginger root (not ground ginger)
1/16  tsp. curry powder (I like curry, so I sprinkle it on)
preparation: In large shallow baking pan, place chicken skin side up in single layer.  In bowl, mix undiluted soup, cream cheese, olives and ginger.  Spread mixture evenly over chicken.  Sprinkle curry on chicken.  Bake, uncovered, 1 hour or until fork-tender.  To serve, place chicken on rice and pour soup mixture over all.

name: LUMPIA SHANGHAI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. onion powder
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. Accent
1/2  tsp. pepper (fine)
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soy sauce
1  medium carrot, shredded
2  medium green onions
3  tsp. flour
2  eggs
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain.

name: SWEDISH RYE BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. rye flour
1 1/2  c. hot water
1/2  c. soft shortening
1  c. molasses (Grandma's)
2  pkg. dry yeast
1  c. warm water
2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. brown sugar
6 to 8  c. white flour
preparation: Mix rye flour with hot water and molasses.  Add yeast to warm water.  Mix rye flour, water and molasses mixture with yeast and shortening.  Add flour.  Knead well.  Place in greased bowl and let rise until double.  Shape into 3 loaves.  Let rise again. Bake 1 hour at 325°.

name: SAUSAGE AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk sausage
1 1/2  c. uncooked rice
1  can beef consomme plus enough water to make 3 c.
1  small onion, chopped fine
1  chopped bell pepper
salt and pepper
preparation: Brown sausage and drain.  Mix all other ingredients with sausage and bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Cover to bake.

name: STRAWBERRY JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
2  c. boiling water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
1  c. sour cream
1 (13 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  large ripe bananas
preparation: Mix all ingredients except sour cream.  Pour 1/2 of mixture into container and chill until set.  Spread on sour cream.  Add the rest of the mixture and chill again.  Chopped nuts may be added in the second pouring.

name: HOBO DINNER
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
4  medium potatoes, sliced
4  carrots, sliced
1  large onion, sliced
1  bell pepper, sliced
salt (to taste)
pepper (to taste)
other spices as desired
preparation: Cover baking sheet with aluminum foil as if you were fixing to wrap a present.  Smash ground beef in the bottom of the pan.  Top with potatoes, carrots, onions, bell pepper, salt, pepper and other spices (if desired) to taste.  Seal the foil so it will be airtight.

name: ASPARAGUS WITH LIME HOLLANDAISE
ingredients:
12  asparagus spears
4  tsp. salt
8  paper thin Prosciutto slices
2  egg yolks
1  lime
4 to 5  oz. butter, melted
dash of salt
dash of white pepper
1  hard-boiled egg
preparation: Trim woody stems from asparagus.  Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil.  Add salt.  Add asparagus and boil 6 to 8 minutes until firm-tender.  Arrange ham on 4 plates.  Drain and divide asparagus on plates.  Put yolks in top of double boiler and beat with juice from lime and cook over medium heat until double in volume. Drizzle in butter.  Add salt and pepper.  Pour in "strips" over asparagus.  Garnish with grated egg.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked squash
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
2  eggs beaten
1/2  pkg. crushed soda crackers
1/2  c. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. butter
1  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Layer ingredients in order in a 8 inch dish. Squash, onion, cheese then crackers make two layers. Beat eggs and mix with milk pour over crackers. Pour melted butter over top. bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until brown.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE MIX
ingredients:
8  qt. dry milk
1  (1 lb.) Nestle Quik
6  oz. Coffee-mate
1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix and store.  Use 2 scoops per cup of hot water (about 2 tablespoons per cup).

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  chicken (fryer)
1  stick butter
1  medium onion, chopped
1  stick celery, chopped
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
spaghetti, boiled in water chicken was cooked in
Cheddar cheese
preparation: Boil and debone chicken. Using large pot, melt butter and sauté onions; add celery and bell pepper, stirring until soft. Stir in both cans of soup, tomatoes and Ro-Tel tomatoes. Add deboned chicken and cooked spaghetti. Let simmer about 15 minutes. In large casserole dish, put a layer of this mixture and then a layer of cheese; repeat. Cover with foil so cheese will melt. Ready in 5 minutes.

name: BLACK WALNUT FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. black walnuts
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Boil to soft ball stage the sugar, salt and sour cream.  Add butter and black walnuts.  Cool at room temperature, without stirring, until lukewarm (110°).  Beat until loses its gloss.  Add nuts.  Spread in buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.  Cut into pieces.

name: BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  fryer (3 lb.), cut up and skin removed
5  to 6 large red potatoes, peeled
1  pkg. carrots, peeled and sliced
French's seasoned salt
1 1/2  sticks margarine
preparation: Cut up fryer and remove skin.  Peel red potatoes and cut into large bite-size chunks.  Peel carrots and slice in thin slices. Layer carrots in large iron skillet; add chopped potatoes over carrots, covering bottom of skillet.  Cover both sides of each piece of chicken well with French's seasoned salt.  Place chicken on top of carrots and potatoes.  Add pats of butter on top of each chicken piece, covering larger pieces with 2 to 3 pats.  Place cover on skillet and place in 450° oven.  Cook 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Check once during baking to add margarine, so chicken and vegetables stay moist.  Serve with English peas.

name: BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. mashed bananas
1  tsp. vanilla or lemon extract or 1/2 tsp. each
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk or cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Butter and flour a 9-inch square pan. Cream until light and fluffy the butter.  Beat in gradually the sugar.  Add eggs; beat thoroughly.  Add bananas and vanilla or lemon extract.  Sift together flour, baking soda (1 teaspoon sour milk or cream is used) and salt.  Add flour mixture to butter mixture alternately with milk or cream.  Spoon into pan.  Bake about 35 to 40 minutes.  Cut into squares and serve with whipped cream on top.

name: LITE LEMON ANGEL
ingredients:
1  angel cake
1  pkg. sugar-free instant lemon flavor pudding mix (4 serving size)
1 3/4  c. skim milk
lite Cool Whip (optional)
preparation: Mix pudding mix and milk; chill until firm.  Slice cake into 3 layers.  Divide pudding between layers.  May be frosted with lite Cool Whip just before serving.

name: GRANDMOTHER'S OLD-FASHIONED TEA CAKES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla
3  c. plain flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
preparation: Cream butter gradually; add sugar.  Then add eggs and vanilla. Combine flour, baking powder and salt; add to creamy mixture. Place 1 tablespoonful of mixture per a cookie sheet.  Bake at 325° for about 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly brown.  Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

name: PRUNE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Wesson oil
3  eggs, beaten
2 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. prunes
1  c. nuts
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Blend oil, sugar and eggs.  Beat well.  Sift flour, soda, nutmeg and cinnamon together.  Add alternately the buttermilk to first mixture.  Add prunes, nuts and vanilla.   Mix well.  Pour into pan, well-buttered.  Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350°.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can French-style green beans, drained
1  can white Shoe Peg corn, drained
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped onions
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
1  can cream of celery soup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix together and place in casserole dish.  Then add the topping.

name: CARROTS AND GRAPES
ingredients:
2  (16 oz.) bags carrots
1/2  c. orange juice
1/3  c. olive oil
1/2  tsp. sugar
dash of ginger
1  c. seedless green grapes, cut in half
preparation: Cut carrots into 1-inch thick diagonal slices.  In saucepan over medium heat, cook carrots, orange juice, olive oil, salt, sugar and ginger to boiling.  Cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes.  Add cut grapes to mixture and cook 5 minutes more until carrots are fork tender.  Drain and serve.

name: REUBEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  large onion, chopped
1 large  can sauerkraut, drained
1  can or pkg. corned beef
Swiss cheese slices (8 oz.)
10  slices rye bread, crumbled in blender
1 or 2  sticks melted butter
preparation: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix the sour cream, onion and sauerkraut together and place in the casserole.  Layer the crumbled corned beef over the sauerkraut mixture, then lay the Swiss cheese slices over the corned beef.  Mix the melted butter with the rye bread crumbs and layer the bread crumb mixture over the cheese.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: ALL-PURPOSE SEASONING
ingredients:
box salt
1 1/2  oz. ground black pepper
2  oz. bottled ground red pepper
1  oz. garlic powder
1  oz. chili powder
1  oz. Accent
preparation: Use red pepper to personal taste.  Use less for mild and more for hot.  Use mixture like salt.

name: PURI (NON)(A Bread)
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. butter
water
oil for deep frying
preparation: Sift the flour and salt; knead it with water to a smooth and slightly stiff dough.  Cover it and keep it for an hour.  Knead again and make small round balls about the size of a lemon.  Roll out each ball into a round 1/2-inch thick and put it in the hot oil.  Press it until it puffs up and then turn it on the other side.  Fry until it turns light brown.  Serve hot with any curry. Serves 7.

name: TEXAS BRAG CAKE
ingredients:
1  can sour pitted cherries
1  c. sugar
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  yellow cake mix
1/2  lb. (2 sticks) oleo
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans
preparation: Pour cherries into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle sugar over cherries.  Pour or spoon pineapple over cherries and sugar.   Add the cake mix over all.  Cut oleo and spread over cake mix, then spread or sprinkle coconut over oleo.  Sprinkle pecans over all. Cover with foil lightly; bake at 325° until done.

name: VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
2  cans French-cut string beans
1  can whole kernel corn
1  c. petite limas
2  c. okra and tomatoes
preparation: Brown meat in large pot; drain well.  Add cans of vegetables, undrained.  Bring to boil, stirring to avoid sticking.  Reduce heat to simmer.  Cook at least 30 minutes.  Serve with cornbread for delicious lunch.  Put leftover soup in Ziploc bags (when cool) and freeze.

name: CHOCOLATE OATMEAL DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. creamy peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
4  c. oatmeal
preparation: In a large saucepan, melt first 4 ingredients over medium-high; bring to a boil.  Boil 1 minute.  Remove from heat. Stir in next 3 ingredients.  When well blended, add oatmeal.  Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.  Let cool.  Eat and enjoy.  Yields 3 to 4 dozen, depending on size.

name: CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. cake flour
1/2  c. cocoa
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
5  eggs
1/2  c. soft oleo
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. milk
3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar with oleo.  Add eggs, one at a time,   beating  after  each.  Sift  dry  ingredients.  Add alternately with  milk  and vanilla.  Bake in 10-inch tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

name: BROWN CHEWY BARS
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  c. white sugar
3 to 4  c. biscuit mix (Pioneer or Bisquick)
1  c. coconut
2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. or more vanilla
1  c. walnuts
preparation: Mix sugars and eggs. Add vanilla. Add biscuit mix, coconut and nuts. Bake in a 9 x 13 pan for 40 minutes at 325°. Cool and cut into bars.

name: ZUCCHINI CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. vegetable oil
2  c. sugar
2  c. zucchini, unpeeled, grated
2  c. flour
dash of salt
1  tsp. soda
3  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Beat eggs until fluffy; add oil, sugar and zucchini.  Mix well; add remaining.  Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour in 2 greased loaf pans.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  c. flour
preparation: Cream margarine, sugar and egg.  Add 1 cup of flour, vanilla, soda and cream of tartar.  Add 1/2 cup flour.  Cover and chill for 1 hour.

name: BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
15  oz. can pork and beans
1  can butter or lima beans
1  can Northern white beans
1  can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1  lb. ground beef, browned and fat drained
1/2  lb. bacon, diced and fried
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. In a large bowl, combine all ingredients.  Pour into casserole; bake 1 hour or place in crock-pot for 3 hours on medium-high.

name: CRAB DIP APPETIZER
ingredients:
1  lb. lump crab meat
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. garlic powder
1/4  c. chopped spinach
1/4  tsp. lemon juice
dash of onion salt
dash of crushed red pepper
1  tsp. Texas Pete
preparation: Mix all ingredients; heat and serve with herb toast.

name: COUSIN MILLIE'S PICKLES
ingredients:
1  gal. cucumbers, cut into chunks
10  c. boiling water in a gal. crock or glass jug
1  c. salt (canning salt; "pickles and canning salt" Mrs.  Wages)
preparation: Takes 39 days.

name: OVEN STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. stew beef, cut in cubes
potatoes, cubed large
celery and carrots, chunks
onions
1 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  Tbsp. Minute tapioca
salt and pepper
preparation: Pour 1 package Lipton onion soup mix over all.  Cover casserole with heavy foil, then lid, to seal.  Bake at 250° for 5 hours or bake at 350° for 3 hours (I found 5 hours is best).  Do not open to look in while baking!

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
3  c. diced apples
1 3/4  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. oil
3  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients together.  Add oil and eggs.  Beat at low speed until well mixed.  Add apples and nuts; mix again.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: JAMAICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1  c. corn meal
2/3 to 1  tsp. salt
2  sticks butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
6  tsp. baking powder
2  c. milk
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Beat egg, melt margarine and mix both with milk.  Add to dry ingredients.  Beat mix until well blended. Pour into greased tin.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can golden corn, drained
16  oz. pkg. egg noodles
2  lb. ground meat
10.5  oz. can cream of mushroom soup
1  (10.2 oz.) cream of celery soup
1  (10.2 oz.) cream of onion soup
1 (16 oz.)  carton sour cream
2  c. grated cheese
8 to 10  slices bread, cut into 4 squares (each slice making about 32 to 40 squares)
1  c. melted butter
preparation: Cook ground meat in skillet until done.  Drain; set aside. Boil noodles until desired fluffyness; drain.  Set aside. Combine cream of mushroom soup, cream of celery soup, cream of onion soup (optional), sour cream and grated cheese in a large pot; heat to boiling.  Add drained ground meat and noodles; stir to keep from sticking.  Pour into large square baking pan.  Arrange bread pieces on top of mixture in baking pan; pour melted butter over top of bread. Bake until bread is toasted.  Let cool and serve. Yield: 10 to 12 servings.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  egg yolks
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. rich milk
1/3  c. peanut butter
powdered sugar
3  egg whites
6  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  stick butter
preparation: Combine 1 cup sugar and flour; add a little milk to make a paste.  Add rest of milk, egg yolks and salt.  Stir while cooking until thick.  Remove from heat; add butter and vanilla.  Mix peanut butter with enough powdered sugar to make a crumbly mixture.  Put in bottom of baked pie shell.  (Save a little to sprinkle on meringue.)  Pour filling in crust; top with meringue, made by beating egg whites and gradually adding 6 tablespoons sugar, beating until stiff.  Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top and brown in a 400° oven for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: TEXAS DIP
ingredients:
4  to 6 tomatoes, chopped
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies
1  bunch green onions (use tops too)
1 small  can chopped black olives
1 small  can chopped mushrooms
2  Tbsp. jalapeno hot sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients and season to taste with salt, pepper and garlic powder.  You can use the amount of hot sauce to your taste. I use 2 tablespoons of Jimenez jalapeno green sauce. Serve with Doritos chips. This is a favorite of everyone.

name: PORK CHOPS AND VEGETABLES
ingredients:
4  pork chops
2  Tbsp. oil
1  c. chopped green onions
1/2  c. milk (optional)
1 1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. seasoned pepper
1/2  head cabbage, shredded
4  chopped potatoes
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of asparagus soup
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In large skillet over medium heat; add oil, brown both sides of chops.  Grease 13 x 9-inch dish.  Toss in all ingredients.  Arrange chops on top.  Cover dish with foil and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until meat is tender.

name: KING RANCH CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  large fryers, boiled
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. tortillas, cut in triangles
1  green pepper, chopped fine
1  large onion, chopped fine
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
chili powder
garlic powder
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix chicken broth and both soups.  Divide all ingredients in half.  In greased casserole dish, put in chicken, sprinkle lightly with chili powder, garlic powder, salt and pepper.  Follow with soup-broth mix.  Then onion and green pepper on top. Make layer of tortillas and sprinkle with cheese. Repeat second layer as first. Top with crushed tortilla chips.  Bake, covered, 1 hour at 350°. Serves 8 to 12.

name: PUMPKIN ROLL
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
2/3  canned pumpkin
1  tsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  c. chopped pecans
1 or 2  Tbsp. powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. butter or margarine, softened
1  c. sifted powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
garnishes (sweetened whipped cream, chopped pecans)
preparation: Line a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jellyroll pan with wax paper.  Grease and flour.  Set aside.  Beat eggs in a large bowl at high speed until thick.  Gradually add sugar and beat 5 additional minutes. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice.  Combine flour and next 5 ingredients.  Gradually stir into pumpkin mixture.  Spread batter evenly in prepared pan.  Sprinkle with 1 cup pecans, gently pressing into batter.  Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: SOUP BURGER SKILLET MEAL
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
6  oz. can alphabet soup
6  oz. can pork and beans
1  pkg. hamburger buns
preparation: In a large skillet, brown chopped hamburger and drain. Add soup and beans and simmer until hot. Spoon onto buns as a sandwich or open face as a meal. Serves 4.

name: CHEDDAR CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lg. onion, thinly sliced
1  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  c. flour
3/4  tsp. dry mustard
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  c. chicken broth
3  c. chopped potatoes
1  c. chopped carrots
3  c. milk
3.  c. shredded cheddar cheese
1/4  tsp. pepper
salt to taste
1/2  lb. Kielbasa sausage, sliced thin (optional)
preparation: Sauté onion and celery in margarine for 3 minutes. Stir in flour, mustard, and Worcestershire sauce. Cook until vegetables are coated and mixture is bubbly. Stir in broth, carrots and potatoes. Bring to boil, then simmer stirring occasionally until vegetables are tender. Add milk; heat but do not boil. Stir in cheese until melted. Add pepper and salt.

name: BACON DIP
ingredients:
16  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
10  slices bacon, crumbled
preparation: Mix all together.  Mound into dish and garnish with parsley flakes.

name: EASY SPINACH ARTICHOKE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped spinach
1  can chopped artichokes
1  pt. sour cream
1  onion
1  stick butter or margarine
1  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Chop onion; saute in 1 stick butter or margarine.  Drain spinach very well.   Drain artichokes; mix all ingredients and pour into medium size casserole.  Bake, covered, for 35 to 45 minutes at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI SOUFFLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. mayonnaise
2  eggs, well beaten
1  c. sharp cheese
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. crushed Ritz crackers
1/4  c. melted butter or margarine
preparation: Cook broccoli 5 minutes.  Drain well.  Combine soup, mayonnaise, eggs, cheese and chopped onion.  Mix well.  Add cooked broccoli.  Pour into greased baking dish.  Top with crushed Ritz crackers and drizzle butter over top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. soft shortening
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1 1/4  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix together the first 5 ingredients thoroughly.  Sift together and stir in the next 4 ingredients.  Chill dough; roll into balls size of large walnuts.  Place 3 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet.  Flatten with fork dipped in flour, crisscross.  Bake until set, but not hard, at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

name: EASY LASAGNA
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. spaghetti sauce
8  oz. (9 pieces) lasagna noodles (uncooked)
3  c. (12 oz.) shredded Mozzarella cheese, divided
2  Tbsp. chopped, fresh parsley
1  c. water
1 3/4  c. (15 oz.) part skim Ricotta cheese
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  In saucepan, heat spaghetti sauce and water.  Combine Ricotta, 2 cups of Mozzarella, Parmesan cheese and parsley.  Pour 3/4 cup sauce in 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Arrange 3 pieces of uncooked pasta lengthwise over sauce.  Pour half of sauce over pasta.  Spread with half of cheese mixture.  Cover with 1/2 cup of sauce.  Repeat layers.  Top with pasta and remaining sauce.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Cover with foil; bake 60 minutes.  Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup of Mozzarella cheese.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Yields 8 servings.

name: LIGHT AS A CLOUD DESSERT
ingredients:
1 (21 oz.)  can pie filling (any flavor you like)
1  large angel food cake or 2 small
1  pkg. vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
1 1/2  c. skim milk
1 (8 oz.)  carton low-fat yogurt (any flavor you want)
1/3  c. sliced almonds, toasted
preparation: Tear cake into bite-size pieces.  Beat vanilla pudding mix and mix until smooth and thickened; stir in yogurt.  Layer 1/4 of the cake pieces, 1/2 can pie filling, 1/4 of the cake pieces and 1/2 of the vanilla pudding mixture in 3-quart glass serving bowl; repeat.  Sprinkle with almonds.   Refrigerate until chilled. Makes 12 servings, 280 calories, 350 mg. sodium, 1 mg. cholesterol, 1 g. saturated fat and 1 g. polyunsaturated fat. Calories can be reduced by using diet pudding.

name: SOFT CUTOUT VANILLA COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1/4  tsp. salt
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. buttermilk or 1/2 c. milk and 1 1/2 tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients and chill for several hours.  Roll out to about 1/8-inch thickness.  Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.  Cookies will look light in color.  Cool on a rack and decorate with frosting or sprinkle sugar on cookies while warm.

name: "SHROOMS"
ingredients:
1  lb. large mushrooms
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. lite cream cheese
1 small  can Ortega chilies, chopped
1/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Wash and stem mushrooms.  Place upside down on cookie sheet. Place 1 teaspoon of cream cheese in each cap.  Place 1/4 teaspoon Ortega chilies on each (on top of cream cheese). Pour melted butter over all.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 350° oven.

name: M&M'S COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2 1/4  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. M&M's
preparation: You get some cupcake mix.  Then you make the cupcakes.  Put sprinkles in and eggs in.  Stir with the mixer.  Put them in a pan and bake them for 14 minutes on warm.  Then you take them out of the oven and put them on a towel to cool.  When they are cooled, put any color of icing on them.  If you have a little girl, she can lick the spatula and the beaters so they will look all shiny and clean.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  cold fried chicken
1  large head lettuce
1 small  pkg. fine frozen peas, thawed
1  red pepper or fresh cucumber
8  small bouquets of raw cauliflower
8  slices crispy fried bacon
preparation: Cut chicken into small pieces, removing bones.  Mix with lettuce, cauliflower, thin rings of red pepper and/or cucumber and peas.  Pour on French or Italian salad dressing and garnish with bacon slices on top.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: APPLE CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. butter
7  medium apples, sliced
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine flour, sugar and salt and mix well.  Cut in butter until it resembles coarse meal.  Toss apples with water and lemon juice.  Spoon into lightly greased casserole.  Sprinkle flour mixture over apples.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35 minutes. Top with cheese.  Bake an additional 5 minutes.  Serves 8 to 12.

name: APPLE TORTE
ingredients:
3  c. apples, peeled and diced
1/2  c. nuts
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  egg
3  Tbsp. melted butter
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Stir together in large bowl, apples and nuts.  Mix flour, sugar, soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon.  Sift over apples and nuts and stir well until all coated.  Beat egg.  Add butter and vanilla.  Stir into apple-nut mixture.  Pour into 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: KNOX DIET SQUARES(Fat-Free)
ingredients:
4  envelopes Knox unflavored gelatine
3  pkg. (3 oz. each) D-Zerta gelatin
3 7/8  c. water
1/8  c. lemon juice
preparation: In large bowl, combine Knox gelatine and flavored gelatin; add boiling water and stir until gelatin dissolves.  Pour into pan (13 x 9-inch) and chill until firm.  Makes about 100 (1-inch) squares.

name: BLACK BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
12  oz. black turtle beans
6 to 8  c. chicken broth
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. shredded carrots
1  c. shredded potatoes
1  bay leaf
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  tsp. dried oregano
1/2  tsp. black pepper
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
lemon slices
preparation: Soak beans for 20 hours; drain.  Add chicken broth and heat to boiling.  Simmer 3 to 4 hours.  Melt butter in skillet and saute onion, celery and carrots 3 to 5 minutes.  Add to beans along with potatoes, bay leaf, oregano and black pepper; simmer for another 45 minutes.  Stir in lemon juice.  Serve and garnish with lemon slices.

name: TACO SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  onion, chopped
1 small  can green chilies
salt and pepper
garlic powder
chili powder to taste
1  can tomato sauce
1  can water
1  can stewed tomatoes
1  can Ranch Style beans
1  can whole corn
1  can Minute rice
preparation: Brown meat and onion; drain.  Add next 4 seasonings.  Add next 6 cans of ingredients.  Simmer.

name: BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. bran flakes
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1/4  c. light molasses
1 1/3  c. milk
1 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. dark brown sugar, packed
1/4  c. salad oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Grease 12 muffin cups.  Toast bran flakes in oven for 5 minutes; cool.  Combine flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon; mix well.  Stir in bran flakes.  Beat eggs at low speed; add brown sugar, then molasses.  Beat in milk and salad oil.  Add to dry ingredients.  Spoon into cups.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes.  Remove immediately to wire rack.  Contain 150 calories each.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pounds frozen hash brown potatoes
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  Tbsp. pepper
1/2  c. onion, finely chopped
1-  can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
2  c. grated Colby cheese
preparation: Thaw potatoes.  Combine all other ingredients and gently mix with potatoes.  Pour into a greased 9 x 13 baking pan.  Bake uncovered in preheated 350 degree oven for 35 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  stewing chicken
3 to 4  c. broth
6  Tbsp. chicken fat
3/4  c. sifted flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
3 to 6  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1/3  c. milk
preparation: Remove pieces of chicken from broth and keep hot.  Skim fat from broth.  Blend fat and flour.  Stir in several spoonfuls of the broth and pour the mixture into the rest of the broth, stirring constantly. Cook this gravy until slightly thickened and season.

name: CHEDDAR SESAME GARDEN VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1/2  c. undiluted Carnation evaporated skimmed milk
1  Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. country Dijon style mustard
1/2  c. (2 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
3 to 4  c. fresh vegetables, drained
1  Tbsp. toasted sesame seeds
preparation: In small saucepan, whisk small amount of milk into flour. Stir in mustard.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil and thickens.  Add cheese; stir until melted.  Serve over vegetables.  Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Makes 2 servings.

name: BROWN SUGAR SQUARES
ingredients:
1  egg (unbeaten)
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Mix and spread in greased 8 x 8-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Cool in pan and cut into squares.

name: AUNT FAY'S CHERRY CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  c. flour (self-rising)
1  stick margarine
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt margarine and brown sugar.  Add flour, nuts and vanilla. Mix and spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until golden.  Let cool.

name: MONKEY BREAD(Mom)
ingredients:
3 (10 oz.)  cans Hungry Jack buttermilk biscuits
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  stick margarine
1  c. brown sugar
preparation: Cut each biscuit into 4 quarters. Make balls. Mix cinnamon and sugar. Roll balls. Grease tube or Bundt pan with margarine; use a lot. Put balls in pan. Add nuts. Put 1 stick margarine and brown sugar in pan. Boil 1 minute. Pour over top. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes.

name: COUNTRY BUTTERCREAM RIBBON CHOCOLATE FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  egg
1/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. milk
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine, softened
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
4 (1 oz.)  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1 1/3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla extract
Fudge Frosting
preparation: Combine cream cheese, 1 egg and 1/4 cup sugar in a medium mixing bowl.  Beat at high speed of an electric mixer until smooth. Gradually add 3 tablespoons milk and next 3 ingredients, beating well.  Set aside.

name: MIXED VEGETABLE MEDLEY
ingredients:
1  lb. Brussels sprouts, cooked
1  small head cauliflower, cooked
1  lb. carrots, sliced and cooked
4  oz. Cheez Whiz
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  can milk
pepper and salt (as desired)
1/2  c. buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Cook your fresh vegetables, done but firm. Combine soup, Cheez Whiz, milk and seasonings.  Pour over vegetables which were placed in a greased casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Add browned bread crumbs and bake, uncovered, another 15 minutes.

name: BEEF AND LENTIL STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef or turkey
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
1 (4 oz.)  can mushroom stems and pieces (with juice)
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1  stalk celery, sliced
1  large carrot, sliced
1  c. uncooked lentils
3  c. water
1  bay leaf
2  Tbsp. parsley
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. beef bouillon
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook and stir meat, onion and garlic in Dutch oven until meat is brown.  Drain off fat.  Stir in mushrooms and remaining ingredients.  Heat to boiling.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender, about 40 minutes. Remove bay leaf.  Makes 6 (1 1/2 cups each) servings.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. ketchup
1/4  c. A.1. sauce
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. mustard
2  tsp. hot sauce
a little black pepper
preparation: Bring to a boil and cook 1 minute.

name: ORANGE DREAM CHEESECAKE(Low Carb)
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1 small  box sugar-free jello (orange)
2/3  c. boiling water
preparation: Bring water to boil; remove from stove. Add jello and mix well. Set aside to cool for 10 minutes.

name: CUCUMBER-TOMATO SALAD(Number of Servings: 6)
ingredients:
1/2  c. distilled white vinegar
3  c. unpeeled, 1/4-inch sliced and quartered cucumbers
2  c. chopped tomato (about 1 large)
1/2  c. chopped red onion
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Mix well. Refrigerate, covered, at least 30 minutes before serving.

name: CHERRY PIE DELUXE
ingredients:
crushed graham crackers
1  pkg. Dream Whip
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. mini marshmallows
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Sprinkle crushed graham crackers in bottom of pie pan.  In bowl whip Dream Whip with cream cheese.  Add marshmallows.  Spread over graham crackers and chill.  When firm, spread cherry pie filling mix over top.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
4  large chicken breasts
1/2  c. onion
2  tsp. butter
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies, chopped
1/2  c. sour cream
flour tortilla shells
1  c. sour cream
1  can cream of celery soup
Cheddar cheese
preparation: Boil chicken breasts, then cut into medium pieces.  Cook onion (chopped) with butter for a few minutes.  Add these to cream of chicken soup, green chilies and 1/2 cup sour cream.  Mix well. Put on shells and roll.  Top with 1 cup sour cream and cream of celery soup (mixed well), then top with cheese.  Cook at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: CLAM-FILLED LASAGNA ROLLS
ingredients:
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can chopped clams, drained (reserving liquid)
1  (26 oz.) spaghetti sauce
1  (15 or 16 oz.)  Ricotta cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
8  strips lasagna, cooked and drained
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine reserved clam liquid and spaghetti sauce.  Reserving 1 cup sauce, spoon remainder equally into individual ramekins or 12 x 7-inch baking dish.  In medium bowl, combine clams, Ricotta cheese, Parmesan cheese, egg and parsley; mix well.  Spread equal portions on lasagna strips; roll up jellyroll fashion.  Place seam side down in ramekins.  Top with remaining sauce; cover.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until hot.  Serve with Parmesan cheese, if desired.  Garnish as desired.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: 14 LAYER CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
6  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
3  c. sifted self-rising flour
2  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Put about 4 tablespoons of batter per greased cake pan.  Continue until all 14 layers are made.

name: SAUTEED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
18  large mushrooms
1/4  c. butter
1  tsp. marjoram leaves
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Wash mushrooms. Trim ends of stems.  Melt butter in large skillet.  Add mushrooms; sprinkle with marjoram and salt.  Saute mushrooms, turning frequently, 15 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: COWBOY STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can corn
1  can whole tomatoes, cut up
1  can hominy
1  can Ranch Style beans
chili powder to taste
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown ground beef.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer for about 10 minutes or until heated.

name: SOUTHERN PRALINES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. firmly packed light brown sugar
2/3  c. half and half
1/8  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. pecans halves
preparation: Combine sugar, half and half and salt in deep 3-quart casserole.  Mix well.  Stir in butter; microwave at High for 7 to 9 1/2 minutes or until mixture reaches soft ball stage (235°), stirring once.  Stir in pecans; cool about 1 minute.  Beat by hand until mixture is creamy and begins to thicken (about 3 minutes). Drop by tablespoon onto waxed paper.  Let stand until firm.

name: EGGPLANT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  eggplant, peeled and chopped
4  slices white bread, torn
1 (5 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1  medium onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
2  large eggs, separated
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook eggplant in boiling water to cover for 10 minutes or until tender; drain well.  Mash eggplant; set aside.  Combine bread and milk; let stand for 10 minutes.  Cook onion and garlic in butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat, stirring constantly until tender.  Add eggplant, egg yolks, salt and pepper.  Set aside.

name: CARROT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots, sliced
1  lb. Velveeta, cubed
1  stick margarine, cubed
1  tube Ritz crackers
preparation: Slice and boil carrots until tender; drain carrots. In a 2-quart casserole, layer carrots, then Velveeta. Dot with margarine. Top with crushed crackers. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box macaroni or rice
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  can tomato soup
1/2  tsp. sugar
1  onion
1  green pepper
croutons
cheese
preparation: Prepare macaroni or rice as usual.  Brown ground beef, onion and green pepper.  Drain.  Mix ground beef mixture with tomato soup and sugar.  Mix mixture with macaroni or rice.  Place croutons on top.  Then sprinkle cheese on top.   Bake at 325° to 350° for 15 minutes.

name: STIR-FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oil
1  lb. chicken strips
1  Tbsp. oil
4  c. cut-up vegetables (broccoli, green onion, celery, carrots, mushrooms, yellow squash, green peas, etc.)
1  clove minced garlic
1  c. chicken broth
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. ginger
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: In skillet or wok, in 2 tablespoons oil, stir-fry chicken strips until opaque.  Remove and set aside.

name: RIBS AND SAUERKRAUT
ingredients:
1  pack ribs (to fit family size for meal you're cooking)
1 or 2  cans sauerkraut (to your flavor)
season to your flavor
preparation: Boil ribs.  About halfway through cooking, add sauerkraut and any seasonings or spices to your taste. Finish cooking.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
macaroni
onion, chopped
sweet pepper, chopped
carrot, chopped
bacon bits
1/2  mayonnaise
1/2  Ranch dressing
salt
pepper
preparation: Cook macaroni; drain.  Mix macaroni, onion, sweet pepper, carrot and bacon bits.  Mix mayonnaise and Ranch dressing together, then put all together.  Make a large amount or a small amount, whatever.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CUPS
ingredients:
1/3  lb. graham cracker crumbs
1/2  lb. melted butter
1  c. peanut butter
1  lb. confectioners sugar
2  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix crumbs, butter, peanut butter and sugar in bowl.  Mix until smooth.  Put into buttered 9 x 9-inch pan.  Melt chocolate chips in pan over low heat. Spread over mixture.  Cool and cut into squares.

name: ONION CALASTE(Casserole)
ingredients:
2  large Vidalia onions, sliced and separated into rings
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  lb. Swiss cheese, grated (2 c.)
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. milk
1  c. cream of chicken soup
6  slices dry French bread, buttered
preparation: Melt margarine	in  skillet;  add  onions and cook low, stirring often,  covered,  20  to  30  minutes  or until soft. Spoon into	casserole  dish;  spread  cheese over and sprinkle with pepper.  Heat	soup  and  milk  in same skillet, stirring constantly until  smooth.  Pour  over onion and cheese layers. Stir slightly with tip of knife to let sauce flow to bottom of dish.  Overlap  bread  slices  into ring on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until bread is toasted and sauce bubbly.

name: SOUTHERN YAM/PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can whole sweet potatoes
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
miniature marshmallows
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  egg, beaten
3  Tbsp. melted butter
1  c. crushed pineapple
preparation: Beat all together, except marshmallows.  Butter a baking dish. Place 1/2 of the mixture in dish.  Dot with marshmallows, then add remaining mixture.

name: FANNY FARMER FUDGE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. evaporated milk
1/2  lb. butter
1 1/2  c. Nestle's semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. walnuts, chopped (less if preferred)
preparation: Mix sugar and evaporated milk in saucepan; bring to boil; boil 6 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Beat in butter, chocolate chips and vanilla; beat 10 minutes.  Stir in walnuts.  Place in greased 9 x 9-inch pan.  Cool and store in refrigerator.

name: NON-HARDENING NO-COOK PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  Tbsp. alum
2  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. boiling water
preparation: Mix and knead.

name: SALMON PATTIES
ingredients:
1 (15 to 16 oz.)  can pink salmon
1  egg
1/3  c. minced onion
1 1/2  c. Crisco
1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Drain salmon; set aside 2 tablespoons of the juice.  In medium mixing bowl, mix salmon, egg and onion until sticky.   Stir in flour.  Add baking powder to salmon juice.  Stir into salmon mixture.  Form into salmon patties and fry until golden brown (about 5 minutes) in hot Crisco.  Serve with tartar sauce or Caesar salad dressing.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: CHICKEN SALAD CRESCENT RING
ingredients:
1  c. Miracle Whip
2  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
2  Tbsp. fresh or dry parsley
1  Tbsp. finely chopped onion (I use dried, chopped)
1 (10 oz.)  can chicken, drained and flaked
4  Tbsp. Hormel real bacon bits
1  c. Mozzarella cheese, shredded and divided
1  can crescent rolls
preparation: Preheat the oven to 375°. Mix all ingredients, except rolls and half the cheese. Place the rolls on a round pan with the wide ends together and extending the tops outwards.

name: SULLY'S STEAK SANDWICHES
ingredients:
flank steak
hot dog buns
butter
barbecue seasonings
preparation: Barbecue flank steak to taste; recommend medium-rare.  Slice steak lengthwise in strips very thinly. They come out conveniently in hot dog bun size.  Heat butter and stir in steak strips. Serve in hot dog buns for delicious change of pace from hot dogs.  A Sullivan Family favorite for 2 generations.

name: BROCCOLI AND CAULIFLOWER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen broccoli buds
2  pkg. frozen cauliflower flowerets
1/2  lb. (approximately) Velveeta cheese
2  sticks or less butter or margarine
1  roll Ritz crackers, crumbled
preparation: Cook veggies as indicated on package.  Drain.  Mix vegetables together into a 9 x 13-inch pan or casserole.  Melt Velveeta and 1 stick of butter together.  Pour over vegetables.  Melt rest of butter and mix with crumbled crackers.  Spread/sprinkle over cheese and bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  bunch broccoli (small flowerets only)
1  head cauliflower, broken into small flowerets
1 (6 oz.)  can drained pitted ripe olives
1 (6 oz.)  jar stuffed green olives, drained
8  oz. Feta cheese, crumbled
1  pt. tiny cherry tomatoes (whole)
1  c. Italian salad dressing
preparation: Place all ingredients in large bowl, preferably one with seal on lid.  Toss to coat.  Marinate in refrigerator at least 8 hours, tossing occasionally to distribute marinade over vegetables.

name: FRESH PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
8  c. sliced fresh peaches
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/4  f. flour
1  tsp. grated lemon rind
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1/3  c. butter or oleo, melted
preparation: Combine ingredients in a large dutch oven; set aside until mixture forms a syrup.  Bring peach mixture to a boil; reduce heat to low and cook uncovered 5 to 10 minutes or until peaches are tender.  Remove from heat and stir in butter.

name: CUTOUT COOKIES
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
3  oz. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. almond extract
1  egg yolk
2 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Soften butter and cream cheese. Add sugar, almond extract, egg yolk and flour. Chill. Roll out. Bake at 325° about 10 minutes. Adjust temperature and time as needed. Frost with Betty Crocker cream cheese frosting.

name: HOMEMADE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1 1/2  qt. milk
5  eggs, separated
1 large  can cream
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Mix egg yolks, sugar and cream and add milk and vanilla.  Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture.  Use ice cream freezer according to directions.

name: CLEVELAND CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground sirloin
1  green pepper
1  onion
1  stalk celery
2  garlic cloves
salt to taste
pepper to taste
chili powder to taste
2  Tbsp. butter
2  cans chili beans
1 large  can stewed tomatoes
instant potatoes (optional)
preparation: Saute onion, garlic, green pepper, celery, salt and pepper in butter.  When cooked, remove from pan into bowl.  Brown meat. Drain fat.  Add bowl of sauteed items to browned meat.  Add tomatoes, chili beans and spices.  Simmer on low for 1 hour. Serve over mashed potatoes (optional).

name: COUNTRY EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
3  large brown eggs
1 1/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. self-rising flour
2  c. milk (sweet)
1  stick butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, flour and milk.  Add egg yolks, one at a time.  Mix real well.  Add vanilla.  Place in pie crust and bake until done. Beat egg whites.  Place on custard.  Bake until brown.

name: FISH CAKES
ingredients:
2  c. cooked fish, finely flaked
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. medium cooked potatoes, mashed
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  egg, whisked
1  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper.  Add the potatoes, parsley, butter and egg. Shape into flat round cakes. Roll in fine bread crumbs, then the egg mixed with 1 tablespoon milk, then again in bread crumbs. Fry both sides in deep oil until brown. Serve hot with lemon slices.

name: PEPPERONI BREAD
ingredients:
1  lb. bread dough
1/2  lb. slicing pepperoni
1/2  lb. Muenster cheese, sliced
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Roll dough out  thin.  Cover entire area with slices of pepperoni and  cheese.  Sprinkle  with  Parmesan cheese.  Roll up. Put seam  on bottom.  Turn flaps under.  Place on greased cookie sheet.  Spread  oil  on  roll.  Sprinkle  with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350°  for  20  to  25 minutes or until golden brown.

name: CHOCOLATE MAYONNAISE CAKE
ingredients:
1  cup sugar
1  cup mayonnaise
4 heaping  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
1  cup cold water
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
2  cups flour
preparation: Mix mayonnaise, sugar, salt and cocoa together and then flour, soda and baking powder alternately with water then add vanilla. Bake at 350° for 35-40 minutes.

name: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (11 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  (9 oz.) tub Cool Whip
1  c. cherry pie filling
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and freeze.  Let thaw about 15 minutes before serving.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked macaroni
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt and pepper
bread crumbs (buttered)
preparation: Cook macaroni.  Add cheese, milk, salt and pepper.  Pour into greased dish and top with bread or cracker crumbs.  Dot with butter and cheese.  Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 1/2 hour.

name: STRAWBERRY DAIQUIRI PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) graham cracker crumb crust
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
2  Tbsp. light rum
red food coloring (optional)
2/3  c. frozen strawberry daiquiri mix, thawed
1  c. (1/2 pt.) Borden whipping cream, whipped
preparation: In large mixing bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.  Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.  Stir in daiquiri mix, rum and food coloring, if desired.  Fold in whipped cream. Pour into prepared crust.  Chill or freeze 4 hours or until firm. Garnish as desired.  Refrigerate or freeze leftovers.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1 (16 oz.)  can chili beans
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  head lettuce, torn
4  tomatoes, diced
1/2  c. grated cheese
2  c. crushed Fritos
preparation: Cook ground beef; drain.  Add taco seasoning and cook according to package directions.  Layer meat and remaining ingredients.  Serve with Catalina salad dressing.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice
1  envelope Lipton onion soup
cut up chicken
1  can cream of mushroom soup
paprika
preparation: Pour rice in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan.  Sprinkle with 1 envelope Lipton onion soup.  Add chicken pieces.  Mix cream of mushroom soup with two cans of water.  Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: CHILI DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can chili (with or without beans)
1  block Monterey Jack cheese
1  or 2 bags white corn tortilla chips
preparation: Spread cream cheese on bottom of a 2-quart casserole dish. Use the back side of a spoon to make spreading easier.  Spread chili over cream cheese.  Shred Monterey Jack cheese over chili. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on High for 5 minutes. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

name: INFALLIBLE RICE
ingredients:
1  medium onion, minced
2  tbsp. butter
1  cup long-grain, raw white rice
2  cups chicken broth (hot)
preparation: Sauté onion in butter until transparent.  Combine onion, rice and hot broth.  Bring to a boil on top of range.  Cover and place in 325° oven for 20 minutes.  Serves 4 - people.

name: BEER BATTER ONION RINGS
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. dried parsley flakes
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
dash of pepper
1 1/4  c. beer
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  eggs, separated
3  medium Spanish onions
preparation: Peel onions; cut into 1/4-inch slices and separate into rings. Combine  next  8 ingredients and egg yolks; beat well. Beat egg whites (at room temperature) until stiff peaks form; fold into batter.  Dip  onion  rings  into batter; fry in deep hot (375°) oil until  golden  brown.  Drain  on  paper towels. Yields 8 servings.

name: PURPLE COWS
ingredients:
1  can grape juice
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
preparation: Put 1 scoop of ice cream in a cup.  Pour grape juice over ice cream.  Ice cream will foam up to a very delicious drink!  Yum!

name: HUNGARIAN SWEET BREAD(Kolach)
ingredients:
3  c. flour
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/4  lb. sweet butter
1/2  c. sour cream
1  egg
1  cake yeast
1/2  glass water
preparation: Crumble yeast into water; stir until dissolved, then put aside.  Mix together the flour, sugar and salt.  Add egg, sour cream and yeast; mix thoroughly.  When smooth, work soft butter into mixture.  Let rise to double in bulk.  Put on a floured board and knead, then divide in 3.  Braid dough and put in a greased loaf pan.  Let rise, then bake in a 375°oven for 45 minutes, or until done.

name: BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  pieces chicken
Pam spray
2  tsp. garlic
2  tsp. sage
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Spray chicken with Pam spray.  Put ingredients together.  With your fingertips, sprinkle mixture over chicken.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours, until well done.

name: INDIAN TACOS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. dry milk
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. shortening
3/4  c. milk
preparation: With your hands, mix flour, dry milk, baking powder, salt and shortening.  Add milk.  Roll out on floured board.  Fry in 1-inch hot oil until brown.  Top with favorite taco filling or fruit or etc.

name: BROCCOLI-CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
2 (6 3/4 oz.)  cans chicken (chunk style) or fresh, cut up
3  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dried thyme
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 3/4  c. milk
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can chicken broth
1/2 of a (20 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli, cauliflower and carrots (2 c.) or use fresh
preparation: Drain chicken; reserve liquid.  Chop chicken; set aside.  In a 3-quart pan, melt butter.  Add onion and cook until tender.  Stir in flour, mustard, salt, thyme and pepper.  Stir in milk and chicken broth all at once.  Cook and stir over medium heat until slightly thickened and bubbly.  Stir in vegetables, chicken and chicken liquid.  Cook and stir for 4 to 6 minutes or until vegetables are tender and soup is heated through.  Makes 6 servings.

name: DONNA MOON'S CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
pinch of salt
2  sticks oleo
4 really heaping  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. water
2  eggs
1  c. buttermilk, mixed with 1 tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. cinnamon (optional)
preparation: Sift together the sugar, flour and salt.  Mix together and heat until boiling the oleo, cocoa and water.  Pour the chocolate mixture over the flour and sugar and mix together. Add the eggs, buttermilk mixture, vanilla and cinnamon (optional).  Pour into greased sheet pan.  Bake 18 minutes at 400°.

name: LINGUINE SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. linguine
cucumbers, tomatoes, green peppers, green onions, radishes and any other raw vegetables you may wish
1  bottle Viva Italian dressing
3/4  jar McCormick Salad Supreme (dry spice mix)
preparation: Cook linguine according to directions on box.  Drain and rinse in cold water.  Pour into large bowl.  Add vegetables as desired. Mix in dressing and spice.  Let stand in refrigerator for several hours (overnight is better).

name: SPLIT DESSERT
ingredients:
2  to 3 bananas
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
1  c. walnuts
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  c. butter
2  c. powdered sugar
1 1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  qt. Cool Whip
1  box vanilla wafers
