preparation: Cover bottom of two 9 x 13-inch pans with crushed wafers. Slice bananas over wafers. Slice ice cream in 1/2-inch slices over bananas. Sprinkle nuts on top. Freeze until firm.  Melt chocolate chips and butter together. Add powdered sugar and milk.  Cook until smooth and thick, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add vanilla.  Cool.  Pour over ice cream when cool and then freeze again.   Cover with Cool Whip and freeze. Before serving, sprinkle with nuts and top with cherries.

name: CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
3  c. fresh corn, cut from cob
1 1/2  c. peeled, cubed potatoes
1 1/2  c. water
2  chicken flavored bouillon cubes
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. dried whole thyme
2  c. milk
1  c. half and half
preparation: Saute onion and celery in butter in a large saucepan until tender.  Stir in corn, potatoes, water, bouillon cubes, salt, pepper and thyme.   Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Add milk and half and half.  Cook, stirring constantly, until thoroughly heated. Yields 8 cups.

name: CHRISTMAS WASSAIL
ingredients:
1  gal. apple cider
4  sticks cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  orange, sliced
1  lemon, sliced
4  c. orange juice
1  c. lemon juice
1 1/2  c. sugar (or more to taste)
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a large kettle.  Steep just below boiling point for 2 hours.  Remove cinnamon sticks.  Serve hot.

name: PINEAPPLE SOUFFLE
ingredients:
1  (20 oz.) crushed pineapple (undrained)
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
3  eggs
6  slices white bread, cubed
1  stick butter or oleo
preparation: Melt butter in 1 1/2-quart straight sided dish.  Beat in eggs, flour and sugar.  Stir in pineapple and bread.  Let stand in refrigerator severals hours or overnight.  Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.  A wonderful side dish for ham.

name: STROMBOLI
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. sausage
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/3  c. chopped green pepper
3  oz. tomato sauce
1/2  tsp. oregano
4  oz. Mozzarella cheese
4  oz. Parmesan cheese
2 to 3  slices hot pepper cheese (optional)
French bread or hard rolls
preparation: Brown meat and drain.  Add onion, green pepper, tomato sauce and oregano.  Simmer 10 minutes.

name: MEATBALL STEW
ingredients:
10  oz. ground beef
1  egg white
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1  medium bell pepper, chunked
1  (2 oz.) onion, sliced
2  c. canned whole tomatoes
1/2  tsp. salt
12  oz. cooked red kidney beans
4  oz. uncooked elbow macaroni
preparation: Broil ground beef until rare and crumbled.  Combine with egg white and dill weed.  Shape into 24 equal sized meatballs.  In a large nonstick skillet saute meatballs until browned on all sides. Add green pepper and onion to skillet.  Cover and steam 1 minute. Stir in tomatoes and salt.  Then stir in beans and macaroni.  Cover and cook over medium heat about 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender.  Serves 4.

name: ICE RING PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen limeade
1 ( 6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1 ( 6 oz.)  can frozen Bright & Early juice
1  jar maraschino cherries
Water
preparation: Mix all frozen juices and cherries with water to bring to 64 ounces. Freeze in a ring mold.

name: CHEESE KUYPERS
ingredients:
2  pkg. cream cheese
2  pkg. crescent rolls
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  egg yolk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cover cookie sheet with crescent rolls.  Leave 2 triangles together.  Seal edges together.  Rolls will be wider than sheet. Mix cream cheese, sugar, lemon juice, yolk and vanilla.  Spread mixture over rolls.  Flip extra roll dough over mixture.  Can be eaten as is or blueberry or strawberry pie filling can be placed on top.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: CORN RELISH
ingredients:
10  cups whole kernel corn
1  cup chopped green pepper
1  cup chopped sweet red pepper
1  cup chopped onion
1  cup chopped celery
1  Tbsp. salt
1  1/2 cups sugar
2 1/2  Tbsp. mustard seed
1  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. turmeric
2  1/2 cups white vinegar
2  cups water
preparation: Combine all ingredients and boil for 15 minutes.  Place in pint jars with lids and process in boiling water for 15 minutes. Makes 5 to 6 pints.

name: BLUE CHEESE MOUSSE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  carton sour cream with chives
1  pkg. Good Seasons cheese garlic dressing mix
1  Tbsp. unflavored gelatin
1 large (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
4  oz. Blue cheese, crumbled
1  c. cottage cheese
1/4  c. water
preparation: Soften gelatin in water over low heat.  Combine sour cream and cream cheese.  Add cottage cheese and salad dressing mix; stir in Blue cheese.  Add gelatin; mix well.  Pour in mold and refrigerate overnight.  Next day, convert mold on a fancy platter.

name: NATIVE AMERICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cubes chicken bouillon
1  c. water
1  pkg. smoky link sausages
2-4 skinless chicken breasts (diced)
1  1/2 c cooked rice
1  medium tomato, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1  medium green pepper, chopped
1/2  t. thyme
1/2  jalapeno
1  pkg. frozen peas
2  cubes chicken bouillon
1  c. water
preparation: Dissolve chicken bouillon in 1 cup water. In a large skillet, brown sausages for 5 minutes. Add chicken breasts and brown 5 minutes. Add all other ingredients, including bouillon, and simmer 5 minutes. Turn off heat and let set 5 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
4  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. allspice
1 (1 lb.)  can pumpkin
3 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
2/3  c. water
preparation: Combine sugar, shortening and eggs.  Add pumpkin and mix well. Sift together dry ingredients and add to pumpkin mixture.  Add water and mix thoroughly.  Pour into 2 greased loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
lasagna (no boil sheets)
1  lb. shredded Mozzarella
2  tsp. dried parsley
2  qt. your favorite tomato sauce
2  lb. Ricotta
1  egg
1/2  c. grated cheese
1  lb. meatballs, chopped
preparation: Mix Ricotta, Mozzarella, egg, parsley and grated cheese.  In a 9 x 13 pan, spoon about 2 tablespoons sauce in bottom of pan. Layer uncooked lasagna sheets in pan.  Spoon the Ricotta mix on top, then sprinkle some chopped meatballs on top.  Spoon some sauce on top.  Then start again with the lasagna sheets, Ricotta mix, chopped meat and sauce.  Do a third layer of lasagna sheets, Ricotta mix, chopped meat and sauce.  Now place lasagna sheets on top and top with sauce.  Sprinkle with shredded Mozzarella and grated cheese.  Bake in a 350° oven for about 30 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven and let rest about 10 minutes before serving.

name: LAYERED VEGETABLE AND SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients:
5  c. torn lettuce
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
8  oz. fresh or frozen cooked medium shrimp, thawed and drained or imitation crab meat
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. sour cream
1/4  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. frozen peas, thawed and drained
4  slices bacon, crisply cooked and crumbled
preparation: In an 8-inch square pan, layer lettuce and onions.  In small bowl, combine mayo, sour cream and sugar; blend well.  Spoon half of mixture evenly over onion.  Layer celery, pepper, peas and shrimp over mayonnaise mixture.  Spread remaining mayonnaise mixture over top; sprinkle with cheese and bacon.  Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours.  Makes 6 servings.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
2  eggs
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  qt. Cool Whip
2  pt. strawberries, halved (reserve some for each center of each slice)
2  cans pineapple spears
2  bananas, sliced
2  kiwis
preparation: Line bottom of two 12-inch round pizza pans with foil. Combine 1/2 cake mix with water, eggs, margarine and brown sugar; mix thoroughly.  Add remaining 1/2 mix.  Fold in nuts.  Divide batter between pans.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Remove from pans after cooling slightly and peel foil from cake.  Top with the Cool Whip.  Arrange fruit in circular pattern: strawberry halves, pineapple spears, kiwi slices and sliced bananas.  Refrigerate.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/3  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
3  c. sugar
1  c. oil
4  eggs
2/3  c. water
1  c. pumpkin
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Sift first 6 ingredients together; add remaining ingredients.  Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Cool and remove from pans.

name: BLACK MAGIC CHOCOLATE CAKE AND FROSTING
ingredients:
1/2  c. cocoa
1 1/2  c. hot strong coffee
2 1/4  c. flour
1 1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. shortening
1 3/4  c. brown sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  tsp. maple extract
preparation: Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl; add shortening and hot coffee.  Blend; add eggs, one at a time.  Beat well after each addition; add flavorings.  Pour into two 9-inch round pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.  Let cool and frost.

name: SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburg
1 (15 oz.)  can cream-style corn
3 or 4  c. mashed potatoes
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Brown hamburg and season with salt and pepper; drain and place in 8 x 8-inch square pan.  Cover hamburg with corn.  Be sure hamburg is covered.  Cover corn with potatoes.  Dot potatoes with butter.  Bake in 350° oven for 1/2 hour or until potatoes brown a little on top.

name: SOFT LEMON COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
yellow food coloring
1  egg
1  c. sour milk or buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
2  tsp. lemon extract
3 to 4  c. flour
preparation: Combine sugar, shortening, salt and food coloring; blend thoroughly.  Add remaining ingredients; mix well.  Roll out small portions of dough at a time; cut with a biscuit cutter.  Place on cookie sheet; if desired, sprinkle with sugar over top of cookies. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.  Yields 24 servings.

name: CUCUMBERS WITH DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
1/4  tsp. salt
4  c. sliced cucumbers
preparation: In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar and salt. Add cucumbers; stir to coat. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: APPLE DATE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. allspice
2  eggs, lightly beaten
1  can apple pie filling
1/2  tsp. almond extract
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped dates
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Combine dry ingredients.  Stir gently.  Combine eggs, pie filling, almond extract, oil and vanilla.  Stir in dates and walnuts.  Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: ESKIMO PIE
ingredients:
1 (19 oz.)  pkg. Oreo cookies, crushed fine
1/2  gal. ice cream (not ice milk)
1  (12 oz.) bowl Cool Whip
preparation: Mix ice cream and Cool Whip (has to be a little soft).  Layer 1/2 of the crushed Oreos in a 9 x 13-inch pan, then ice cream. Spread rest of the Oreos on top.  Sprinkle 1 cup chopped pecans on top with hot fudge topping.  Freeze 2 to 3 hours.

name: CREAM OF CAULIFLOWER OR BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  medium head cauliflower
2  c. water
1  large stalk celery, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter
2  Tbsp. flour
2 1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. instant chicken bouillon
3/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
dash of ground nutmeg
1/2  c. whipping cream
preparation: Prepare cauliflower (whole 20 to 25 minutes, flowerets 10 to 12 minutes); drain.  Heat 2 cups water to boiling in 3-quart saucepan. Add cauliflower, celery, onion and lemon juice.  Cover and heat to boiling.  Cook until tender, about 10 minutes; do not drain.  Press cauliflower mixture through food mill or place in blender until uniform consistency.  Heat margarine in 3 quart saucepan (low) until melted.  Stir in flour.  Cook, stirring constantly until mixture is smooth and bubbly.  Remove from heat.  Stir in 2 1/2 cups water.  Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.  Boil and stir for 1 minute.  Stir in cauliflower mixture, instant bouillon, salt, pepper and nutmeg.  Heat just to boiling.  Stir in cream.  Heat but do not boil.  Serve with grated cheese if desired.

name: CHEESE LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. cream cheese
1 small  jar olives
1 small  can pimientos
1  c. nuts
preparation: Put all ingredients in a chopper or cut fine with knife.  Mix well.  Roll into ball and chill.  Serve with crackers.

name: PA. DUTCH GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
3  strips bacon
1  small onion, sliced
2  tsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1 (No. 303)  can green beans
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  hard-cooked egg, sliced
preparation: In a skillet, fry bacon until crisp.  Crumble.  Drain off all but 1 tablespoon drippings.  Add onion and brown lightly.  Stir in cornstarch, salt and dry mustard.  Drain beans, reserving 1/2 cup liquid.  Add this to skillet.  Cook, stirring until mixture boils. Blend in brown sugar and vinegar.  Add green beans and beat thoroughly.  Turn into serving dish and garnish with egg and crumbled bacon.  Serves 4.

name: MUSHROOM PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
6  to 8 pork chops
flour
vegetable oil
1 soup  can milk
preparation: Roll chops in flour.  Heat oil in skillet.  Fry chops until golden brown.  Mix milk and soup in a deep baking pan.  Place chops in pan in soup and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
4  mashed bananas
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. flour
2  eggs
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together well and pour into greased loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: PAELLA
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. oil (olive preferred)
1  large onion, chopped
1/2  Tbsp. chopped garlic
3  c. tomato broth (liquid from canned tomatoes or diluted tomato juice)
2  large artichokes or 1 (14 oz.) can
1  c. green peas
1  pimiento, cut in strips
1  medium green pepper, chopped
1 1/2  c. uncooked long grain brown rice
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. saffron (optional)
2  c. cooked kidney beans or chickpeas
preparation: Heat oil and saute onion, garlic, pepper and rice for about 5 minutes.  Add broth, salt and saffron.  Bring to a boil.  Cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. butter or oleo
2  c. plain flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. mashed bananas (3 ripe ones)
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream butter  and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, then add bananas.  Mix thoroughly.  Sift together dry ingredients. Stir into  banana  mixture.  Add  nuts.	Bake  in  greased and floured loaf pan one hour at 350°.

name: CORN SOUFFLE
ingredients:
1  can creamed corn
1  can whole kernel corn
1  box Jiffy cornbread
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
2  beaten eggs
1  stick butter
preparation: Melt enough of the butter to grease a 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Drain corn.  Mix all ingredients, including remaining butter. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

name: FERN'S BATTER BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/2  c. warm water
1/4  tsp. ginger
3  Tbsp. sugar
1 large  can evaporated milk
2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. oil
4  c. flour
preparation: In large bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water.  Blend in ginger and 1 tablespoon sugar; let stand in warm place until mixture begins to bubble.  Using an electric mixer, stir in remaining 2 tablespoons sugar, milk, salt, oil and 3 cups flour.  Blend in remaining cup of flour with spoon; knead on floured surface. Place dough in 2 well-greased one-pound coffee cans.  Place plastic lids on cans; let dough rise until lids are pushed off. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes.  Delicious frozen and reheated.

name: ORIENTAL OMELET(From Joslin Diabetic Clinic)
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped-cooked chicken
1/4  c. bean sprouts
3  water chestnuts, thinly sliced
1  tsp. soy sauce
4  eggs
1/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1/2  tsp. minced onion
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Combine chicken, bean sprouts, water chestnuts and soy sauce and mix well.  Set aside.  Mix eggs, water, green pepper, onion, salt and pepper with a fork.  Heat butter or margarine in a 10-inch skillet.  Pour in egg mixture.  With spatula, draw cooked portions of egg toward center so that uncooked portions flow to bottom. Cook until bottom is set and lightly browned and top is creamy. Arrange chicken mixture on half of omelet.  With spatula, fold other half over and turn out on serving platter.  Yields 2 servings.  Each serving equals 3 ounces of meat and 1 vegetable.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
4 egg yolks, plus 1  c. sugar (mix together well)
3  Tbsp. cocoa (very full)
4  Tbsp. flour (very full)
1/4  tsp. salt
2 1/2  c. ice cold milk
3  Tbsp. oleo
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix as listed.  Cook, stirring continually, until thick.  Add oleo and vanilla.  Pour into a cooked pie shell.  Top with egg white meringue and brown.  This is a very old recipe.

name: DINNER-IN-A-DISH
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef or ground chuck
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can corn, drained
1  can tomatoes, crushed
saltines, crushed
salt and pepper to taste
dab of butter or margarine
preparation: Brown ground beef, bell pepper and onion; drain and put in bottom of casserole dish.  Pour corn and tomatoes on top of ground beef mixture.  Cover with crushed saltines, adding a dab of butter. Cook at 350° for approximately 30 minutes or until saltines are brown.

name: NO FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1 1/4  c. Crisco
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1  egg, beaten
5 to 6  Tbsp. ice water
preparation: Blend salt into flour.  Cut in shortening well.  Combine beaten egg, vinegar and water.  Pour into flour mixture all at once.  Blend by hand or spoon until all dry ingredients are moistened.  Roll out.  Makes 3 singles or 1 double and 1 single crust.  Bake at 425° for 10 minutes.

name: CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick butter, melted in electric skillet
sliced potatoes
shred cabbage like slaw
salt & pepper to taste
onion, chopped
polish sausage or hot dogs
garlic powder
American cheese
1  cup water
preparation: Melt butter in electric skillet.  Add sliced potatoes, shredded cabbage, salt & pepper and chopped onion.  Slice polish sausage or hot dogs on top of mixture.  Add garlic powder.  Cover top with American cheese.  Add 1 cup of water.  Cook until all is tender.

name: DOUBLE DELICIOUS BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1  (12 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  c. peanut butter chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 350° (325° glass).  In a 13 x 9-inch pan, melt margarine.  Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over margarine.  Pour milk over crumbs.  Top with both kinds of chips.  Press firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly brown.  Cool and cut.

name: AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1  can pineapple chunks in juice
1  can mandarin orange sections
1  banana, peeled and sliced
1 1/2  c. seedless grapes
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. flaked coconut
1  (8 oz.) container vanilla yogurt
preparation: Mix the first 6 ingredients together.  Fold in yogurt. Refrigerate.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: MOIST CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  c. Hershey's cocoa
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1/2  c. Crisco oil
1  c. strong black coffee
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients together.  Mix remaining ingredients into dry mixture.  Pour into a 13 x 9-inch cake pan, greased. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: VEGETABLE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower
1 large  bunch broccoli
1  red onion
5  Tbsp. apple cider vinegar
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. Miracle Whip
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Chop broccoli and cauliflower into bite size pieces.  Chop onion.  Heat vinegar and sugar just until sugar melts.  Stir in Miracle Whip and pour over vegetables.  Mix in grated cheese.

name: PEANUT BUTTER POWER SNACK
ingredients:
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/4  c. Ricotta cheese
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
1  Tbsp. honey
preparation: Mix all ingredients into bowl until well blended.  Place on crackers, bread or muffins.  If placed on bread or crackers, it could be microwaved.

name: TEXAS SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1  c. water
4  Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. sugar
2  c. self-rising flour
1/2  c. sour cream
2  eggs
preparation: Bring margarine, water and cocoa to a boil.  Remove from heat and add sugar, flour, sour cream and eggs.  Thoroughly mix ingredients in saucepan and pour into greased cookie sheet (11 x 17 x 3/4-inch) with sides.  Bake at 375° for 22 minutes.

name: FRUIT CRISP
ingredients:
1/2  c. quick cooking rolled oats
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  c. butter or margarine
2  lb. apples or 2 1/2 lb. peaches
2  Tbsp. granulated sugar
preparation: Combine oats, brown sugar, flour, cinnamon and dash of salt. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.   Set aside. Peel, core and slice fruit to make 5 to 6 cups.  Place fruit in a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle with granulated sugar. Sprinkle crumb mixture over all.  Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.  Serve with ice cream.  Serves 6.

name: CORN FLAKE CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  c. light Karo syrup
1  c. sugar
1  c. peanut butter
6  c. corn flakes
preparation: Bring Karo syrup and sugar to a boil.  Remove from heat.  Add peanut butter.  Stir until peanut butter has melted and is creamy. Pour mixture over corn flakes.  Spoon onto waxed paper.

name: JAPANESE MOCK SUKIYAKI
ingredients:
1  lb. beef, pork or chicken
1  can broth or bouillon cube
1 1/2  c. sliced celery
1  medium green pepper, sliced
1  large onion, sliced
1  can mushrooms
1/2  c. green onion tops
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Brown meat in 2 tablespoons oil.  Add broth, vegetables and sauce.  Cover  and	simmer	10  minutes.  Combine  1/4 cup water and cornstarch.  Stir in sauce and serve over rice.

name: CHOCOLATE TORTE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate cake mix
6  oz. chocolate chips
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. almonds, chopped
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip, thawed
preparation: Mix cake as directed.  Bake in two 9-inch layer pans.  Cool. Split layers horizontally.  Melt the chips in saucepan over very low heat. Cool, then beat in margarine.  Add almonds. Spread one cake layer with 1/2 chocolate mixture. Top with second layer of cake and spread with 1/2 Cool Whip. Repeat layers. Garnish with shaved chocolate curls and almonds.  Chill 1 hour.

name: PORCUPINE MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup
1/4  c. uncooked rice
1/4  c. minced onion
1  tsp. salt
1  lb. ground beef
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
preparation: Mix 1/4 cup of the tomato soup with the rest of the ingredients.  Shape into balls (1 1/2-inch).  Brown in 2 tablespoons of shortening with 1 small garlic clove (minced) in skillet.  Blend in rest of can of soup and 1 cup of water.  Cover. Simmer about 40 minutes.

name: CRUNCHY PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. baby peas, thawed
1  c. diced celery
1  c. chopped cauliflower
1/4  c. diced green onions
1  c. chopped cashews
1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. prepared Hidden Valley Ranch Original dressing
some crisp bacon
preparation: Combine all ingredients together and chill.

name: NANCY'S SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
1  can whole kernel corn (include liquid)
1  can cream-style corn
1/2  c. melted margarine
1  c. sour cream
2  eggs
1  pkg. Jiffy corn muffin mix (dry)
preparation: Combine ingredients and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: TACO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger meat
1  pkg. taco seasoning
2  cans pinto beans
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  can diced Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  bag tortilla chips, crushed
1  pkg. shredded Colby cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger meat and drain.  Add taco seasoning and stir well.  Layer 1/2 of the chips in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Then layer next ingredients in order:  hamburger meat, beans, soup, tomatoes, chips and cheese.  Bake for 20 minutes in 400° oven.

name: HUNDRED DOLLAR CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. salad dressing
1  c. cold water
1 1/2  tsp. soda, dissolved in water
2  c. flour (do not sift flour)
2  Tbsp. cocoa
pinch of salt
vanilla
preparation: No milk, no shortening, no eggs.

name: ORIENTAL CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. oil
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. rice vinegar
1  clove garlic, minced
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  lb. skinless, boneless chicken breast
1  Tbsp. oil
2/3  c. fresh bean sprouts
1  red pepper, cut into desired size
4  green onions, cut into desired size
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen snow peas, thawed
2  c. torn salad greens
2 (5 oz.)  cans chow mein noodles
preparation: Combine first 8 ingredients in a shaker jar; shake well until combined.  Pour half of this mixture into a dish; set remainder aside.

name: LIP SMACKING GRILLED CHICKEN
ingredients:
chicken with or without skin
sesame oil
seasoned salt
preparation: Brush chicken with oil and sprinkle with seasoned salt.  Grill until done.

name: APPLE CHOPS
ingredients:
4  pork chops
4  baking apples
1/2  c. raisins
1 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  Tbsp. cinnamon
butter
preparation: Brown chops in pan.  Peel and slice apples.  Mix sugar, cinnamon and raisins with apples.  Grease a baking pan with butter.   Layer apple mixture in baking pan.  Top with chops. Cover with remainder of apple mix.  Dot with butter.  Bake at 350° until apples are tender.    Serves 4.

name: PLATE OF PASTA
ingredients:
1/4  c. olive oil
1  onion, chopped
2  tsp. minced garlic
1  box (10 oz.) frozen broccoli, chopped and thawed
1  can (10 1/2 oz.) chicken broth
1/2  c. chopped parsley
1  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. basil
dash of salt and pepper
1  tsp. crushed red pepper
1  lb. linguini, chunky pasta or spaghetti
preparation: Saute onion and garlic in oil.  Add broccoli and can of chicken broth.  Then add parsley, oregano, basil, salt and peppers.  Bring to simmer for 10 minutes or until broccoli is done. Pour over cooked pasta, toss and serve.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
10  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. Wesson oil
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
4  eggs (unbeaten)
1  c. nuts (may be omitted)
preparation: Place all ingredients in a large bowl. Beat about 3 minutes with mixer and bake in preheated oven at 350° for 30 minutes. Bake in greased sheet cake pan.

name: HEAVENLY ONION CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3  medium sweet onions, sliced
8  oz. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1 (5 oz.)  can evaporated milk
2  tsp. soy sauce
6 to 8  slices French bread (1/2 inch thick)
6 to 8  slices Swiss cheese (about 4 oz.)
preparation: In large skillet melt butter.  Saute onions and mushrooms until tender.  Place in 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish or 2-quart casserole.  Sprinkle shredded cheese on top.  Combine soup, milk and soy sauce.  Pour over cheese.  Top with bread, place cheese slice on top of bread.  Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.

name: SAUSAGE PUFFS
ingredients:
1  lb. hot bulk sausage
1  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
3  c. Bisquick mix
1/2  tsp. red pepper
3/4  c. water
preparation: Cook sausage until done, breaking up meat with a fork.  Drain off fat; place sausage in a large bowl.  Cool; add cheese, Bisquick mix, pepper and water.  Mix with fork until blended. Roll in 1/2 to 1-inch balls.  Place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from baking sheets and cool completely.  Makes about 8 dozen.

name: VANILLA CHIP ORANGE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/2  c. cocoa
1  tsp. grated orange rind
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)
3  Tbsp. water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. vanilla milk chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In medium bowl, mix crumbs, cocoa and rind.  Stir in sweetened condensed milk, water and chips until well blended; spread evenly into greased 9-inch square baking pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched.  Cool completely; cut into bars.  Store tightly covered. Makes 20 to 24 brownies.

name: AUNT MARY DEBERRY'S KRAUT RECIPE
ingredients:
1  gal. chopped cabbage
2  Tbsp. plain salt
preparation: Mix real good.	Pack  in  glass  or stone jug.	Be sure cabbage is under broth.  Let  stand for 4 or 5 days.  Check to see if sour enough.  If  it  is,  put  in clean jars and seal. Put in boiling water  bath  and  heat long enough to seal.  If cabbage is not sour  as  you  would like, let it stand another day.

name: OATMEAL BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. rolled oats
2  c. boiling water
2  pkg. yeast
1/3  c. warm water
2  Tbsp. butter, softened
1/2  c. molasses or honey
2  tsp. salt
6  c. (approximately) unbleached flour (Heckers)
preparation: Pour boiling water over oats; let stand and partially cool. Melt yeast in warm water and add liquified yeast to above.  Add butter, molasses or honey and salt to oats and yeast.  Add 2 cups flour and stir well.  Add 2 more cups of flour which may be difficult but will gradually blend in.  Add last 2 cups of flour, a little at a time, while kneading well until dough is smooth and elastic (takes about 15 minutes).

name: DO AHEAD SAUSAGE SOUFFLE
ingredients:
8  slices white bread
2  c. shredded cheddar cheese
3/4  tsp. dry mustard
1-1/2  lb. sausage links, cooked and cut in thirds
4  eggs
2-3/4  c. milk, divided
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Lay bread in well greased 8-1/2 x 11 inch pan. Sprinkle cheese evenly over top. Arrange sausage pieces on top of cheese. Beat eggs with 2-1/4 cups milk and mustard. Add soup and the remaining milk. Mix well. Spoon over bread, cheese and sausage layers. Cover tightly. Refrigerate overnight. Put in cold oven, turn the oven to 300° and bake for 1-1/2 hours.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. soft butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
5  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and eggs together. Add sifted dry ingredients. Cover and chill at least 1 hour. Roll out 1/8-inch thick on lightly floured cloth or board. Cut into desired shapes. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 400° for 6 minutes.

name: RICE COOKER SHRIMP PILAF (OR CRAWFISH)
ingredients:
1  lb. shrimp, cleaned and deveined
1 1/2  c. raw, long grain rice, washed
1/2  medium bell pepper
3/4  medium onion
4  oz. jar sliced mushrooms with juice
10  oz. can beef broth
1  stick butter
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Saute bell pepper and onion in butter.  Add mushrooms, beef broth, salt, pepper and rice.  Put in rice cooker and stir in shrimp.  Turn cooker on and push button to cook.  It will be done when rice cooker goes off.  Delicious meal.   Serve with salad. Serves 6 to 8 persons.

name: QUICK PIZZA
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  eggs
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Blend together and spread in pan.  Top with topping.  Bake at 425° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: BEEF STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. stew beef
2  Tbsp. oil
2  tsp. salt
6  each:  carrots, onions and potatoes, all chopped
1  c. celery
1/4  c. flour
16  oz. tomato sauce
2  c. hot water
1/4  tsp. basil
preparation: Coat beef with flour and salt.  In large heavy sauce pan or skillet, brown beef in oil.  Stir in water, sauce and seasoning. Simmer 1 1/2 hours.  Add vegetables and simmer until tender, about 45 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: TEXAS CHILI
ingredients:
3  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. oil
1 1/2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. each cumin and paprika
1  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. ground oregano
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
1/2  c. water
1  beef bouillon cube
preparation: In a large skillet, brown meat and onion in oil.  Add remaining ingredients; stir until well mixed.  Simmer, covered, 1 hour; stir occasionally.

name: OKRA AND TOMATOES
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh okra, cut up or 1 box frozen okra
onion slices
1  can stewed tomatoes
2  strips bacon, cut in pieces
3  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Cut okra into slices or leave whole if small.  Fry bacon pieces in a skillet, along with the onion.  Add okra and fry until it gets gooey.  Add the tomatoes, undrained, and vinegar.  Season with salt and pepper and continue cooking until okra is tender.

name: SMORE PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker crust (9 oz.)
12  oz. chocolate bar, broken in pieces
6  oz. hot fudge (warm)
30  regular marshmallows
3/4  c. milk
2 1/2  c. whipped cream (reserve 1 c. for topping)
preparation: In saucepan, place chocolate bar, milk and marshmallows.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until melted.  Cool.  Fold 1 1/2 cups whipped cream into chocolate mix.  Spread thin layer of warm hot fudge in bottom of pie crust.   Gently spoon cooked mixture into crust.  Top with reserved whipped cream and garnish with chocolate syrup topping.  Refrigerate for 3 hours.

name: VEGETABLE BAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. California Blend
1  c. mushrooms
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Cook California Blend until tender.  In a saucepan, mix cornstarch and salt.  Gradually stir in milk until smooth.  Add margarine.  Stirring constantly, bring to a boil over medium heat and boil 1 minute.  Put vegetables in baking dish and pour sauce over vegetables.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
1 tall  can pineapple juice
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. almond flavor
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
preparation: You can put this in plastic jugs and freeze. Take out 2 to 3 hours before and you will have a slush.

name: SCALLOPED CREAMED POTATOES
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. warm milk
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt the butter. Add the flour and mix until smooth. Add the milk slowly, stirring constantly.  Cook until thick and smooth, about 5 minutes after it comes to a boil. Add the salt toward end of cooking time.  Add more milk if it becomes too thick.

name: SOUTHERN SPOON BREAD
ingredients:
4  c. milk
1  c. cornmeal (I use yellow)
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
4  eggs, well beaten
preparation: Mix 1 cup milk with cornmeal.  Scald 3 cups milk in top of double boiler.  Add hot milk to cornmeal mixture, then cook in top of double boiler about 10 minutes or until mixture is consistency of thin mush.  Add baking powder, salt and butter.

name: PORK TENDERLOIN WITH POMMERY-MUSTARD MARINADE
ingredients:
1  trimmed pork tenderloin
4  Tbsp. honey
1/2  tsp. fresh ground pepper
1/2  c. red wine vinegar
1/2  c. Clos Du Bois Merlot
3  tsp. Pommery mustard
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except pork tenderloin, together.  Let sit for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Next, place pork tenderloin in the marinade and let sit in fridge for 6 to 8 hours. Turn tenderloin and cover with the marinade every hour or so.

name: CANDIED PECANS
ingredients:
1  tsp. cold water
1  egg white
1  lb. pecan halves
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Beat water and egg white, then mix well with pecans.  Mix sugar and cinnamon, them mix with pecans.  Spread on cookie sheet. Bake at 225° for 1 hour.  Stir occasionally.

name: HIS MAJESTY'S SPECIAL
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken breasts
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. chopped green peppers
1/4  c. chopped celery
1  small onion
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. butter
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Sprinkle salt and pepper on chicken.  Place skin side up in baking dish. Combine all other ingredients.  Pour over chicken. Bake 1 hour at 325°.  Serve over potatoes, noodles or rice.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
3  whole chicken breasts, cooked, skinned and deboned
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
2  pkg. frozen broccoli spears, partially cooked or 2 bunches fresh broccoli
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. melted butter
1/2 to 1  tsp. curry powder
1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
1/2  c. buttered cracker crumbs
preparation: Beginning with broccoli, layer with sliced chicken and mixture of soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice, curry powder and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch greased casserole dish (2 layers of each).  Cover with cracker crumbs. Drizzle 1/4 cup butter over top. Bake, covered for 30 minutes in 350°.  Uncover last 5 minutes to brown top.

name: CHOCOLATE WALNUT CLUSTERS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet pieces
1 1/2  c. walnuts, broken into large pieces
preparation: Melt chocolate over warm water, stirring constantly.  Add walnuts and stir until coated.  Drop in clusters on waxed paper. Cool until set.  Makes 12 large clusters.

name: HAM AND CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cooked ham, diced
1  c. Swiss or Cheddar cheese, grated
8  oz. chopped frozen broccoli, thawed or 1 1/2 c. cooked broccoli
1/3  c. chopped onion
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1  c. biscuit mix
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.   Grease 9 x 9-inch square or 10-inch round pan.  Layer ham, broccoli, cheese and onion in pan.  Beat together remaining ingredients.  Pour over ham layers.  Bake for 40 minutes.

name: HUMMINGBIRD CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. vegetable oil
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (unsweetened)
1  c. chopped pecans
2  c. chopped bananas
1/2  c. pecans (for the frosting)
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl.  Add eggs and oil, stirring until dry ingredients are moistened.  Do not beat. Stir in vanilla, pineapple, 1 cup pecans and bananas.  Do not beat.  Spoon batter into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes.  Remove from pans and cool completely. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

name: OVERNIGHT SALAD
ingredients:
spinach
bacon
hard-boiled egg
lettuce
sweet peas
onion, chopped
cheese
1  c. sour cream
1  c. mayo
salt, pepper and sugar
preparation: Best if you use a glass bowl.  Clean and tear spinach.  Layer with bacon and egg.  Sprinkle salt, pepper and sugar on egg. Clean and tear lettuce.  Layer on egg.  Layer peas and onion on lettuce.  Sprinkle salt, pepper and sugar on onion.  Mix sour cream and mayo; spread on the onion layer.   Sprinkle with your favorite cheese.  Refrigerate overnight.  Mix well before serving. Enjoy!

name: CHOCOLATE SUNDAE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour, sifted
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. chopped nuts
2  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift  all  dry ingredients into mixing bowl.  Add milk, nuts, butter  and  vanilla;  blend  well.  Pour  into greased 8-inch dish.

name: ORANGE ROUGHY WITH RED PEPPERS
ingredients:
1  lb. orange roughy or lean fish fillets
1  tsp. olive or vegetable oil
1  small onion, cut into thin slices
2  red or green bell peppers, cut into julienne strips
1  Tbsp. snipped fresh thyme or 1 tsp. dried thyme leaves
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: For extra-crisp peppers when cooking this dish in the microwave, omit the step of cooking the peppers before adding the fish.  If fish fillets are large, cut into 4 serving pieces.  Heat oil in 10-inch skillet.  Layer onion and bell peppers in skillet; sprinkle with half of the thyme and half of the pepper.  Place fish over bell peppers and sprinkle with remaining thyme and pepper.  Cover and cook over low heat 15 minutes.  Uncover and cook until fish flakes easily with fork, 10 to 15 minutes longer.

name: HOT CINNAMON CRANBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
3  qt. water
5  whole cloves
1  small frozen orange juice
48  oz. cranberry juice
2  c. sugar
1/2  pkg. red hots
1  small frozen lemonade
preparation: Bring water to a boil.  Add sugar and red hots.  Stir until dissolved.  Remove from heat.  Add cloves and frozen juices. Stir; then cover and let stand until cool.  Add cranberry juice. Serve hot or cold.  Makes 1 gallon.

name: CHERRY O CHEESE REFRIGERATOR PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker pie crust
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1/3  c. concentrated lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Whip cream cheese until softened and then add milk, lemon juice and vanilla.  Whip or mix until smooth.  Pour into graham cracker pie crust and refrigerate until mixture is firm, then add your cherry pie filling to the top.  Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

name: LOW-FAT PINEAPPLE ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines angel food cake mix
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (in own juice)
preparation: Mix together and put into Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Turn oven down to 325° for 20 minutes. Turn upside down and let cool.

name: CREAMY CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. elbow macaroni, cooked
3/4  c. milk
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  c. chopped cooked chicken
1  c. shredded sharp American cheese
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
1/4  c. chopped pimientos
preparation: Mix macaroni and remaining ingredients in a bowl.  Spoon in a casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
4  c. boiling water
3  chicken bouillon cubes
2  c. diced potatoes
1  c. diced onions
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen, mixed vegetables
2  cans cream of celery soup
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Cook first 5 ingredients until tender.  Add soup and chopped Velveeta.  Stir constantly until the cheese is melted.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1/2  c. water
1/3  c. ketchup
1/3  c. vinegar
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. paprika
2  tsp. mustard
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well.  Brush over chicken, pork chops, etc.

name: SANDWICHES
ingredients:
cheese
meat
mustard
ketchup
pickles
two buns
preparation: Cook the meat.  Put it on the buns.  Put cheese on it, then mustard, then ketchup, then pickles, then you're finished and you eat.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked drained sweet potatoes
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  stick margarine
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
dash of cinnamon
preparation: Mix ingredients. Pour in casserole dish. Spoon topping over potatoes. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: EASY SALAD
ingredients:
1  large Cool Whip, thawed
1  small cottage cheese
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. orange jello
1  (20 oz.) crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Mix all together. Put in refrigerator.

name: 7-UP SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon jello
1  can cold 7-Up
1 (20 oz.)  can chunk pineapple, drained
1  c. mini marshmallows
2  bananas, sliced
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  (8 oz.) whipped topping
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  c. hot water
preparation: Dissolve jello in hot water.  Add 7-Up.  Chill until thickens. Drain pineapple juice (save).  Fold pineapple, marshmallows and bananas in jello.  Put in pan.  Chill until firm.

name: MACKERAL LOAF
ingredients:
1  can mackeral
3/4  c. bread crumbs
3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. pickle relish
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. chopped onion
4  slices bacon
preparation: Drain the mackeral, flake and place in a bowl.  Add the bread crumbs, milk, pickle relish, eggs, salt, margarine and onion and mix well.  Pack in a well-greased loaf pan and place bacon on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, then slice.

name: HAM LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground ham
1  lb. ground fresh pork
2/3  c. medium cracker crumbs
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1  egg, beaten
pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients together; make into loaf.  Put into shallow pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  During the last 30 minutes, spoon on tangy mustard glaze.  Save some for serving the Ham Loaf.

name: APPLE CINNAMON CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. spice or yellow cake mix
1 (21 oz.)  can Thank You apple pie filling
3  eggs
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Blend together cake mix, pie filling and eggs in large mixer bowl.  Beat at medium speed 2 minutes. Combine sugar and cinnamon.

name: HUNGARIAN COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. flour
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cocoa
1 1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
2  c. ground almonds
preparation: Cream butter with sugar and lemon juice.  Stir in the almonds. Mix in the cinnamon and cocoa and half the flour.  Mix in remaining flour.  Chill dough for 30 minutes.  Roll out on floured surface, one half at a time, to 1/4 inch thickness.  Cut with a 2 inch round cookie cutter.  Bake on greased cookie sheet at 325 degrees for 12 minutes then let it cool.  Put pairs together sandwich fashion with raspberry jam.

name: CANDIED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
6  medium sweet potatoes
1/2  c. orange juice
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. dark or light raisins
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Boil potatoes until tender. Remove the jackets and slice (if small, leave whole). Place them in a baking dish and cover with a syrup made of other ingredients. Bake in a 375° oven for 1 hour. Serve while hot.

name: SUGARLESS CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. raisins
2  c. water
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. rolled oats
1 1/2  tsp. sugar substitute
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Combine raisins in water and simmer for 15 minutes.  Let cool. Add beaten egg.  Add shortening, rolled oats, sugar substitute and vanilla.  Add sifted flour, salt, soda and cinnamon.  Mix all together well.  Pour into greased 1-layer cake pan and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

name: REFRIGERATOR ROLLS
ingredients:
1/3  c. Crisco or butter
1/2  c. boiling water
1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. cold water
1  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. lukewarm water
1  egg, beaten
3 1/4  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Place Crisco in large bowl.  Add boiling water and stir until melted.  Add sugar, cold water and yeast which has been dissolved in warm water, egg, flour and salt.  Mix thoroughly.  Cover with waxed paper and wet towel.  Place in refrigerator overnight.  Take out 2 or 3 hours before using.  Shape and allow to rise until almost doubled in size.  Bake in a hot oven at 450° for 7 minutes.

name: CHICKEN TAPAE
ingredients:
1  (3 to 4 lb.) disjointed chicken
1  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. butter, melted
1  lb. cooking apples, peeled, cored and thinly sliced
1  tsp. sugar
1  c. Macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped
2/3  c. apple cider
1  c. rice, cooked
preparation: Sprinkle chicken with salt.  Brown in butter in skillet. Remove chicken and butter into large baking dish.  Mix apples with chicken.  Sprinkle with sugar and nuts.  Add cider; cover.  Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes.  Serve with mound of steamed rice.

name: SLOW COOKER HOT DOGS
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. butter
14  oz. catsup
2  Tbsp. pickle relish
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce (optional)
1  lb. hot dogs
preparation: Cook onion in butter until tender.  Slice hot dog skin thinly. Combine all ingredients in slow cooker; stir and heat on low for 4 hours.  Hot dogs can be cut through and used as appetizers or served as is in buns.

name: BAKED TOMATOES
ingredients:
4  medium tomatoes
6  green onions, chopped
10  soda crackers, crushed
salt and pepper to taste
4  Tbsp. celery, chopped
2  Tbsp. green peppers, chopped
preparation: Scoop out tomatoes and save. Turn tomatoes upside down to drain. Saute the onions, celery and peppers in butter until soft, not brown. Chop tomato pulp. Combine with onions, celery, peppers, crackers and salt and pepper.  Stuff tomatoes and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and paprika.  Drizzle with melted butter and bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: SEAFOOD CHOWDER
ingredients:
1/4  c. sliced celery
1 medium  clove garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  can vegetarian vegetable soup
1 soup  can water
1  can (4 to 7 oz.) drained minced clams, shrimp or tuna
preparation: In saucepan cook celery and garlic in butter until celery is tender.  Add soup, water and seafood.  Heat and stir.  Serves 2 to 3 people.

name: NO BAKE BANANA CREAM PIE
ingredients:
vanilla wafers
4  to 6 large bananas (not overripe)
1  pkg. vanilla pudding
1  small tub lite Cool Whip
preparation: Line a 10-inch pie plate with vanilla wafers.  Fill plate with alternating layers of bananas and vanilla pudding.  Top with desired amount of Cool Whip.  Sprinkle crushed cookie crumbs on top.

name: STEAK AND GRAVY
ingredients:
1  lb. round steak, tenderized
1/2  c. canola or olive oil
1  c. flour
1/2  onion, chopped
2  c. water (more or less for gravy)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cut steak into serving pieces.  Add salt and pepper to flour; mix well.  Dredge steak in flour.  Heat oil and brown meat on both sides.  Add remaining flour mixture to oil in pan, stirring well to form paste.  Brown, then add hot water and chopped onion. Bring to boil.  Add browned steak and simmer for 1/2 hour or until steak is tender.  Serve over mashed potatoes or cooked rice.

name: SPINACH LASAGNE
ingredients:
6  uncooked lasagne noodles
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
1  jar spaghetti sauce
1  can (8 oz.) mushrooms (undrained)
2  c. Ricotta cheese
1  pkg. (10 oz.) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  garlic cloves, crushed
4  oz. Mozzarella cheese slices
preparation: Cook noodles as directed on package; drain.  Cook beef and onion until well done; drain.  Stir in spaghetti sauce and mushrooms; heat to boil.  Reduce heat to simmer.  Mix remaining ingredients except Mozzarella slices.  Pour small amount of sauce on bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Place 3 lasagne noodles on top of sauce.  Spread cheese mixture on lasagne.  Top with a layer of Mozzarella cheese.  Repeat this step with remaining ingredients.  Bake at 350° uncovered for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

name: HOLLY'S DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. nuts
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
6 to 8  oz. Cool Whip
2 small  pkg. coconut pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, oleo and nuts and press into a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.  Cream together cream cheese and powdered sugar.  Fold in 1/2 of a large container of Cool Whip.  Spread on first layer.  Cook 2 small packages of coconut pudding with milk.  Cook until thick, then cool.  Spread over other layers.  Spread remaining Cool Whip on top.  Sprinkle with toasted coconut.

name: SCOOBY SNACKS
ingredients:
1/4  oz. vodka
3/4  oz. midori liqueur
3/4  oz. malibu rum
1  oz. pineapple juice
1/2  oz. cream
preparation: Combine all ingredients. Shake well with ice and serve in a highball glass.

name: BUTTERMILK COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  stick margarine, melted
3  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  c. coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
1  deep unbaked pie crust
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°. Mix all ingredients well. Pour in unbaked pie crust until brown. It may take an hour or longer.

name: HONEY BUN CAKE
ingredients:
1  butter cake mix
3/4  c. oil
4  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1  c. brown sugar
3  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix cake mix, oil, eggs and sour cream all together.  Pour 1/2 of the mixture into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix brown sugar and cinnamon together.  Sprinkle 1/2 of this on top of the batter in your pan.  Pour remaining batter over this.  Then add remaining sugar and cinnamon over this batter.  Swirl through mixture with a knife.  Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.

name: MUSHROOMS BAKED IN FOIL
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh mushrooms
1/4  c. chopped parsley
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  Tbsp. dry sherry
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. ground white pepper
preparation: Rinse, pat dry, trim and place mushrooms in center of sheet of heavy-duty foil.  Sprinkle with remaining ingredients.  Bring edges of foil up over mushroom mixture and crimp to seal.  Set in baking pan and bake in unpreheated 350° oven for 45 minutes or until mushrooms are cooked.  Makes 6 servings, about 24 calories each.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
2  c. sour cream
2  c. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. dried onion
3  Tbsp. dill
preparation: Mix together and serve on any kind of bagel or bread.

name: HOMEMADE KAHLUA
ingredients:
2  oz. instant coffee
4  c. sugar
2  c. boiling water
1  pt. brandy
2  vanilla beans, split in half lengthwise
preparation: Mix coffee and sugar in a bowl. Stir until dissolved. Cool completely. Add brandy to sugar/coffee mixture. Divide mixture evenly between 2 fifth bottles. Add a vanilla bean to each bottle. Cap after the liquid is completely cooled. Must be stored at least 30 days to steep before consuming to get full flavor.

name: COKE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. Coke
3  Tbsp. cocoa
2  sticks butter or margarine
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
2  eggs, unbeaten
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Sift sugar and flour together.  Bring to boil the Coke, cocoa and butter.   Pour into flour mixture and stir well.  Dissolve soda in buttermilk and add to other mixture.  Add eggs; stir in marshmallows.  Pour into well-greased 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Cool.

name: SKILLET PIZZA
ingredients:
1/2  lb. sausage or ground beef
1/2  small onion, chopped
2  c. uncooked egg noodles
2  c. water
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Brown meat and onion in skillet.  Add uncooked noodles to meat and onions.  Mix water, tomato paste and spices together.  Pour over noodles and meat.  Cover and cook 20 to 30 minutes, until noodles are done.  Top with cheese, melt and serve.

name: ITALIAN STEAK
ingredients:
1  boneless sirloin steak
1  can Italian stewed tomatoes
1/8  tsp. basil
1/8  tsp. oregano
beef broth or water with beef bouillon
preparation: Brown steak, cut into 2 or 3-inch squares. Add can of stewed tomatoes, basil and oregano, adding broth or water last. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.  Thicken slightly before serving.

name: CREME DE MENTHE TORTE
ingredients:
24  chocolate Oreos, crushed
1/4  c. melted butter
2  (7 oz.) marshmallow cream or 24 marshmallows, melted with 1/4 cup milk and cooled
2  c. cream, whipped or 2 envelopes Dream Whip
1/4  c. creme de menthe
preparation: Mix chocolate Oreos and melted butter and reserve 1/3 cup for topping.  Press in 9 x 13-inch pan and chill.  Combine marshmallow cream and creme de menthe.  Fold in cream and freeze until served.

name: GOURMET BAKED ACORN SQUASH
ingredients:
3  halved acorn squash, seeded
2/3  c. diced celery
1 1/2  c. diced, unpeeled apples
1/4  c. oleo
1 1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
1  c. grated cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Place squash halves, cut side down, in baking pan in small amount of water.  Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes or until almost tender.  Saute celery and apples in butter in skillet for 5 minutes; stir in crumbs, cheese, salt and pepper.  Turn squash halves, fill with apple mixture.  Bake 10 to 15 minutes longer or until squash halves are tender.

name: QUICK SHRIMP CURRY
ingredients:
1  small onion, diced
1 small  clove garlic, minced
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. curry powder
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
1  lb. shrimp, cooked
1 small  can peas
3  c. cooked rice
preparation: Cook onion, garlic and curry powder in butter until onion is tender.  Stir in soup, milk, shrimp and peas.    Cook over low heat for 5 minutes; stir frequently.  Serve over rice.  Serve with fruit salad.

name: NEVER FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
2  c. flour
3/4  c. butter flavor shortening
1/2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  Tbsp. sugar
1  small egg, beaten
1/4  c. water
3/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Sift together flour, sugar and salt, then cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Beat together vinegar, water and egg.  Mix with flour mixture until dough is moist enough to form a ball.  Wrap in plastic and chill for 30 minutes.  Makes 1 large double crust pie.

name: ROSY RHUBARB PRESERVES
ingredients:
5  c. rhubarb
1  can drained crushed pineapple
4  c. sugar
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
preparation: Combine rhubarb, pineapple and sugar.  Cook over low heat to dissolve sugar, then cook 10 minutes over medium heat.  Continue to cook slowly until mixture thickens and is clear.  Add jello.  Pour into jars and seal.  Keeps well in refrigerator or freezer.

name: FRIED RICE
ingredients:
1  pkg. bacon
6  boneless pork chops
5  green onions, chopped
4  c. Minute rice
6  eggs
salt
pepper
oregano
1  tsp. lemon juice
soy sauce
preparation: In skillet fry bacon that has been cut into 1 inch strips. When bacon is almost done, add chops (that have been cut into 1 inch cubes).  Season with salt, pepper, oregano and 1 teaspoon lemon juice.  When chops are almost done (about 25 minutes), add chopped green onions.  While meat mixture is simmering with a lid on, cook rice as directed on box.  When meat mixture is done, add it to rice.  Then in skillet meat was in scramble eggs.  Add these to rice and meat.  Serve and let each person add as much soy sauce as wanted.

name: SCOTCH EGGS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. sausage meat
6  hard-boiled eggs
bread crumbs
1  egg, slightly beaten
frying oil
preparation: Divide the sausage meat into 6 (4 ounce) portions.  Shell the eggs; dip in flour.  Coat each egg with egg and bread crumbs.  Fry in hot (but not smoking) oil, turning carefully (roll over) every minute or two to cook evenly until browned all over, about 25 minutes cooking time in all.  Cut each egg in half. Serve hot with tomato sauce or cold with salad greens.

name: PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (15 oz.)  cans pineapple chunks
1  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. flour
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. melted margarine
1  c. cornflakes
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving 6 tablespoons juice. Combine sugar and flour in a bowl. Stir in reserved juice. Add cheese and pineapple chunks. Mix well. Spoon into greased 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Mix melted margarine and cornflakes. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  egg, beaten
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. shortening
2  (1 oz.) squares unsweetened chocolate, melted
1 2/3  c. cake flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. sweet or sour milk
1/2  c. broken walnuts
preparation: Beat egg and sugar until light; add vanilla, shortening and melted chocolate; blend well.  Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk; add nuts.  Drop small portions 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet.  Bake in 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.  Makes 2 1/2 dozen.  Cool.  Then frost with Mocha Chocolate Frosting.

name: LEMON SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. margarine or butter, softened
1/4  c. powdered sugar
2  eggs
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. grated lemon peel (optional)
preparation: Heat oven to  350°.  Mix flour, margarine and powdered sugar. Press in an ungreased square pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch or 9 x 9 x 2-inch), building up 1/2-inch edges.  Bake for 20 minutes.  Beat remaining ingredients until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Pour over hot crust and bake until no indentation remains when touched lightly in center, about 25 minutes.  Cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar.  Cut into about 1 1/2-inch squares.  Makes 25 cookies.

name: YOGURT DIP FOR FRUIT
ingredients:
1  pt. size container vanilla yogurt
2 to 3  Tbsp. honey
grated orange rind from 1/2 orange
preparation: Combine the ingredients.  Chill and serve with fresh fruit.

name: ONE PAN DINNER
ingredients:
1  qt. green beans
2  c. chopped potatoes
1  small onion, chopped fine
1/2  Polish sausage, cubed
water to steam
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix ingredients and cook until tender.  Serve with applesauce or fruit of choice.

name: SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
3  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
salt and pepper
mashed potatoes
1  lb. cheese
preparation: Cook ground beef and onion in skillet and drain.  Put in a casserole dish.  Make enough mashed potatoes to cover ground beef. Sprinkle cheese on top and put in oven long enough to melt cheese; serve hot.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
skinless chicken
cream of chicken soup
Veg-All vegetables
mushrooms
Bisquick
preparation: Boil chicken until tender.  Add broth to cream of chicken soup.  Mix Veg-All vegetables and mushrooms in casserole dish. Mix Bisquick with milk.  Pour Bisquick batter over mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger, browned and drained
6  pieces bacon, fried and crumbled
1  can kidney beans
1  can lima or pinto beans
1/2  c. ketchup
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. mustard
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can pork and beans
preparation: Combine all ingredients together and pour into a casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: PINK DESSERT
ingredients:
1  large cottage cheese
1 1/2  pkg. strawberry jello (dry)
1 large  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  carton Cool Whip
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  c. small marshmallows (optional)
preparation: Mix all together with cottage cheese and jello. Add Cool Whip. Mix well. Let stand overnight in refrigerator.

name: QUICK AND EASY COOKIES
ingredients: 1  pkg. any cookie dough
preparation: Go to closest market in your neighborhood.  Find the section with cookie dough in it.  Take 1 package and rush home with it. Slice and place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at temperature designated on package.  Cool and munch away.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (32 oz.) bag hash browns, thawed
1  stick butter, melted
1  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
cornflakes
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix together hash browns, soup, cheese, butter, salt and pepper.  (Save a little of the butter.)  Crumble cornflakes on top. Drizzle butter over the cornflakes.  Bake at 350° for one hour.

name: FUDGE SUNDAE PIE
ingredients:
1/4  c. corn syrup
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2 1/2  c. Rice Krispies
1/4  c. peanut butter
1/4  c. chocolate fudge sauce
3  Tbsp. corn syrup
1  qt. ice cream
preparation: Cook first three ingredients over low heat, while stirring, until mixture begins to boil.  Remove from heat.  Add Rice Krispies and stir.  Press into 9-inch pie pan, bottom and sides.

name: HAMBURGER RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1/2  c. diced onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can water
1  c. diced celery
1  can chicken rice soup
1/2  c. raw rice
preparation: Brown hamburger, celery and onion until meat is done.  Turn into casserole or roaster.  Add other ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  More water may be added if the casserole seems too dry.

name: CHERRY CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
14  oz. can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1/3  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
1  graham cracker pie crust
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Beat cream cheese until light and fluffy.  Add milk and blend thoroughly.  Stir in lemon juice and vanilla.  Pour into pie crust and  chill until firm.  Top with pie filling before serving.

name: SIMPLE CARROT SALAD
ingredients:
3  to 4 grated carrots
1  can crushed pineapple
1/3  c. chopped walnuts or pecans
1/4 to 1/3  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Combine all ingredients and chill thoroughly.

name: EASY LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip
1  (6 oz.) frozen lemon juice
1  Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Mix together.  Put into graham cracker crust.

name: MRS. B'S HOT FUDGE SAUCE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
4  sq. unsweetened chocolate
2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
preparation: Melt chocolate and butter together in top of double boiler over boiling water.  Slowly add sugar, 1 cup milk and salt.  Cook over medium heat until slightly thickened (5 to 10 minutes). Slowly add condensed milk and stir well.  Cook 2 minutes.  Remove from heat and add vanilla.  Pour into glass jars for Christmas gift giving.  Keeps in the fridge for 1 month.

name: CARIBBEAN SHRIMP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. instant minced onion
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. chopped green bell pepper
1 (14.5 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
1  bay leaf
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. ground allspice
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. ground red pepper
1  lb. medium shrimp, shelled and deveined
1  Tbsp. fresh lime or lemon juice
preparation: Combine the onion with two tablespoons of water; set aside to soften, about 10 minutes.  In a large skillet, heat the butter until hot.  Add the green pepper and onion; cook, stirring, until almost crisp and tender (about 3 minutes).  Add tomatoes, bay leaf, sugar, allspice, salt and ground red pepper, breaking up the tomatoes with a spoon.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until slightly thickened, about 20 minutes.  Add shrimp; cook and stir until pink, 3 to 5 minutes.  Stir in the lime juice. Remove the bay leaf before serving.  Serve on steamed rice, if desired.  Serves four.

name: SHRIMP SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  stick oleo
3 to 4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  can broken shrimp
salt, pepper and garlic salt to taste
4  green onions and stalks
dash of Tabasco sauce
preparation: Drain shrimp well.  Mince green onions.  Blend together the softened cream cheese and oleo.  Mix in mayonnaise, shrimp and onions.  Season to taste with salt, pepper, garlic salt and Tabasco sauce; mix well.  Let set in refrigerator overnight. Serve with crackers.

name: PISTACHIO SALAD
ingredients:
3.4  oz. box (small) pistachio pudding
20  oz. crushed pineapple (undrained)
8  oz. Cool Whip
bag marshmallows
preparation: Stir together pudding and undrained pineapple until completely blended.  Fold in Cool Whip and marshmallows.  Chill.

name: RAINBOW SALAD
ingredients: 1  (3 oz. pkg. each) Jell-O: black cherry, lime, lemon, orange, orange pineapple and wild strawberry
preparation: 1st Layer:  Black cherry dissolved with 1 1/2 cups hot water; set.

name: STEAMED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  whole chicken
butter
salt and pepper
preparation: Prepare chicken for roasting.  Rub inside and outside with salt and pepper.  Rub outside with melted butter.  Place in steamer. Steam until tender.  If desired, steamed chicken may be brushed with melted butter and browned in oven.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
3  c. cornmeal
1  c. flour
salt
1/2  c. diced onion
1/2  c. diced celery
2  eggs
1  c. cream or milk
preparation: Mix and drop in grease.

name: FRENCH VANILLA DELIGHT
ingredients:
graham crackers
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. French vanilla instant pudding
3  c. milk
1  can milk chocolate frosting
preparation: Place enough graham crackers to line bottom of a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.  Mix milk and pudding, beating until thick.  Spread enough (or half) of the pudding mixture over the graham crackers. Place another layer of graham crackers and another layer (the rest) of the vanilla pudding. Chill. Top with milk chocolate frosting before serving.

name: BUTTER PECAN CAKE
ingredients:
1  Butter Pecan cake mix, baked
caramel syrup
1  pt. Cool Whip
1 1/4  c. light brown sugar
chopped nuts
preparation: Bake cake in a 9 x 13 inch greased pan, according to directions on box.  Let cool.  Meanwhile, beat Cool Whip with brown sugar.  Cut the cake in half horizontally to make two 9 x 13 layers.  On the first layer, spread a layer of caramel syrup, chopped nuts, and Cool Whip.  Place the other half of cake on top and spread Cool Whip on the cake.  Finish with a few chopped nuts.

name: CORN IN THE HUSK(Microwave)
ingredients:
4  ears corn in husks
butter or margarine
salt
pepper
preparation: Discard soiled outer portion of husks.  Soak corn in cold water 10 minutes; drain, but do not dry.  Arrange corn in spoke fashion on micro-proof plate.  Use Cook cycle and cook 11 to 12 minutes, re-arranging halfway through cooking time.  Let stand 3 minutes.  Peel and discard husks and silk.  Serve with butter, salt and pepper.

name: PEPPERONI CABBAGE SOUP
ingredients:
1  stick pepperoni, sliced thin
oil
1  can Northern beans
1  head cabbage, shredded
garlic
elbow macaroni
preparation: Heat oil in large pan; saut garlic.  Add pepperoni and cabbage.  Cover with water.  Cover pan and cook on low heat until cabbage is done.  Add Northern beans directly from the can.  While this is cooking, cook macaroni separately as directed on the package.  Add as much as you want to soup.  Add water if needed. Serve with Italian bread.  Delicious.

name: FRUIT FILLING FOR PIE(Diabetic)
ingredients:
4  c. fruit (any)
nonnutritive sweetener (equivalent to 3/4 c. sugar)
1  Tbsp. arrowroot
1/4  tsp. lemon peel, grated fine
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
pastry (for 9-inch pie crust), unbaked
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Mix all ingredients together and place in pie crust.  Bake until fruit is tender, about 45 minutes.  If a two-crust pie is desired, cover unbaked pie with second crust. Cut air vents in top and flute edges.  Cover fluted edges with foil to prevent excessive browning (remove foil after 30 minutes). Bake as before.

name: FETTUCINE
ingredients:
3  c. whipping cream
2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
4  egg yolks
parsley flakes for color
cooked fettucine noodles
preparation: In small saucepan, combine cream and cheese.  Whisk until thick.  To thicken quicker, add more cheese.  Whisk until cheese melts, about 30 minutes.  Add egg yolks and blend until smooth. (Add meat now if using as a main dish.)  Add cooked noodles.

name: PISTACHIO FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  pkg. instant pistachio pudding (8 oz.)
1  can crushed pineapple (20 oz.)
1 large  can fruit cocktail (16 oz.)
2  c. whipped cream (Dream Whip)
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Whip the cream to directions on package.  Make pudding, using drained liquid from fruit cocktail and pineapple, using 1 1/2 cups of liquid.  Combine all ingredients and pour in mold or bowl.

name: HEARTY BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (16 oz.)  can baked beans
1 (15.5 oz.)  can light red kidney beans
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. ketchup
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. prepared mustard
4  slices bacon, cut in pieces
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In a large skillet, brown ground beef, bacon and onion; drain.  Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour in ungreased 2-quart casserole dish; cover.  Bake 30 minutes or until bubbly.  Makes 8 (1/2 cup) servings.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  chicken
1  egg
2  c. broth
2  c. plain flour
1  can cream of chicken soup (optional)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Stew chicken until done, drain off broth in pan that you will be cooking dumplings in. Debone chicken and set aside. Mix 1 egg into 2 c. broth, mix in plain flour until a stiff dough. Roll out on dough board very thin, cut in strips, drop in very hot broth, cook until done. Add the deboned chicken. The secret is stiff dough.

name: CHOCOLATE CRUNCH PIE
ingredients:
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. Jell-O chocolate flavor instant pudding and pie filling
1  c. cold milk
3 1/2  c. (8 oz.) Cool Whip nondairy whipped topping, thawed
20  chocolate sandwich cookies, ground
1 1/2  c. "rocks" (use any combination of chocolate chips, peanut butter chips, chopped peanuts, granola bar chunks or 1 Skor candy bar)
1  (6 oz.) chocolate crumb crust
preparation: Prepare pudding mix with 1 cup milk as directed on package. Fold in whipped topping.  Stir 1 cup cookies and the "rocks" into pudding mixture.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
4  tsp. butter
1  c. onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1/4  c. celery, diced
2  c. stewed tomatoes
2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. black pepper
3  c. hot cooked rice or 1 1/2 c. Minute rice
chopped parsley
preparation: Brown beef in butter.  Add onion, green pepper and celery. Simmer on range top until tender.  Pour into 4-quart baking dish. Add tomatoes, salt, pepper and rice.  Blend well.  Garnish top with chopped parsley.  Bake 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: BARBECUE RIBS
ingredients:
4  lb. country style ribs
salt and pepper
2  medium onions, sliced
1  clove garlic
2  Tbsp. fat
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  c. green pepper, diced
2  lemons, sliced
1  c. celery, diced
1  c. catsup
preparation: Season ribs with salt and pepper.  Put in roaster with rack for 1 hour, covered.  Drain grease; add sliced onions and remaining ingredients.  Bake in covered roaster at 350° for 1 hour, then uncovered for 1/2 hour more.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) pie shell
3/4 to 1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. water
1/8  tsp. salt
1  qt. strawberries
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin
whipped topping
preparation: Cook sugar (amount depends on sweetness of berries), cornstarch and water over medium heat until thick, stirring constantly.  Add gelatin.  Cool slightly.  Add salt.  Arrange berries in baked pie shell.   Pour glaze over berries or spoon it over berries.  Chill several hours. Top with whipped topping to serve.

name: SWEET POTATO SAUSAGE CAKES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. fresh sausage
1  tsp. salt
2  c. raw sweet potatoes, shredded
preparation: Shred raw sweet potatoes and mix with sausage and salt.  Shape into 10 flat cakes.  Place in cold skillet and place over low heat.  Fry slowly until brown and crisp on both sides.  Serves 5 to 6.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2  c. loosely packed, coarsely grated zucchini
2  c. flour, sifted
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. nuts
preparation: In a large bowl beat eggs until they are frothy; beat in sugar, vegetable oil and vanilla until thick and lemon colored. Stir in zucchini, flour, cinnamon, baking soda, salt and baking powder.  Fold in nuts.  Pour mixture into 2 oiled and floured loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour until toothpick comes out clean.

name: SHRIMP SPREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. tomato soup
1  tsp. salt
1  envelope Knox gelatine
3/4  c. Miracle Whip
1  small (4 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  c. celery, chopped fine
1/2  c. onion, chopped fine (optional)
2  cans shredded shrimp
preparation: Heat soup slowly; do not boil.  Add gelatine and salt, then set aside.  Mix with Miracle Whip and cream cheese.  Add celery, onion and soup.  Then add shrimp.  Pour into quart mold and let stand in refrigerator at least 8 to 12 hours.  Very good on Triscuit crackers.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs
1 small  box strawberry jello mix, dissolved in 1/2 c. boiling water
1/2  c. frozen strawberries, thawed
preparation: Mix the first four ingredients together.  Add the strawberries.  Bake in 3 round cake pans at 350° for 25 minutes or until done.  Cool before frosting.

name: EASY PINEAPPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple in its own juice (8 oz.)
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 small  carton sour cream
1  graham cracker crust
Cool Whip
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients together and put in a graham cracker crust.  Put in refrigerator to set.  Top with Cool Whip to serve.

name: ALMOND BISCOTTI
ingredients:
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. light brown sugar
2  eggs
1/3  c. oil
2  Tbsp. water
2  tsp. each:  cinnamon and baking powder
1/2  tsp. powdered cloves
2 1/2  c. flour
2  c. blanched almonds (whole or slightly crushed)
1  extra egg yolk, mixed with a little water
preparation: Mix the first 8 ingredients in large mixing bowl, then add flour and almonds until well blended.  Separate dough into 3 parts; roll each into a "rope."  Place on greased cookie sheet and flatten slightly.  Brush with egg and water mixture.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes, until center is slightly firm.  Cool slightly. Slice diagonally with sharp knife.  Recipe can be doubled.

name: CAVATINI
ingredients:
1  pkg. wheel macaroni
2  jars Ragu Traditional pizza sauce
1/2  c. diced bell pepper
1/2  c. diced onion
1 small  can mushrooms (optional)
2  pkg. sliced pepperoni
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cook macaroni as directed and drain.  Sauté pepper, onions and mushrooms.  In a very large bowl, combine all ingredients.  Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes.  Can be cooked in the microwave.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk or sour milk
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
3  c. quick cooking oats
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar and eggs together until light and fluffy.  Stir in buttermilk.  Sift together dry ingredients; stir into creamed mixture.  Stir in oats, raisins and nuts.  Drop from tablespoon, 2-inches apart, on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake in 400° oven about 8 minutes.  Cool slightly; remove from pan. Makes about 5 dozen cookies.  You can use sweet milk; reduce soda to 1/4 teaspoon and use 2 teaspoons baking powder.

name: CHICKEN DISH
ingredients:
2  fryers
sweet basil
bay leaf
1  stick margarine
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  cans cream of chicken soup
5  oz. diced tomatoes and green chilies
2  onions
1  lb. Cheddar cheese
1  can sliced water chestnuts
onion
oregano
salt
1 1/2  pkg. flour tortillas
preparation: Stew fryers for 1 hour, seasoned to taste with chopped onion, oregano, salt, pepper, sweet basil and bay leaf.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
8  oz. cream cheese, room temperature
16  oz. carton cottage cheese
1  tsp. onion salt
1  tsp. paprika
1  c. chopped pecans (optional)
1  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
preparation: Put everything in a bowl.  Mix well.  Mold into a ball.  Roll in chopped pecans.

name: CHOP SUEY
ingredients:
1  lb. raw bean sprouts
6  large stalks celery
2  large onions
1 small  can mushroom pieces
1  can water chestnuts
1  lb. raw shrimp (any meat)
2  Tbsp. crushed garlic
2  Tbsp. crushed ginger
2  Tbsp. oil
2  c. water
4  Tbsp. cornstarch in 1/4 c. water
preparation: In a Dutch oven, bring water to a boil.  After rinsing off sprouts, simmer for ten minutes.  Bias cut celery and onions into semi-large pieces.  Add to sprouts and simmer another five minutes.   While you are cooking the vegetables, cut meat into whatever size pieces you desire.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  c. bread crumbs
1  egg
1  tsp. sage
1  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. grape jelly
3/4  c. grape jelly
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1  Tbsp. horseradish
preparation: Mix together in skillet and heat, then pour over sausage balls.

name: STRAWBERRY JELLO CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix
1  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
3  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. Wesson oil
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. strawberries
4  eggs
1  lb. powdered sugar
1  cube margarine
1/2  c. strawberries
preparation: Mix ingredients in rotation.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.  Put a large pan of water under cake while baking.   It burns easily.

name: BROWN CARAMEL
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. Crisco
5  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. white Karo
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sweet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix 2 1/2 cups sugar, Crisco, margarine, Karo, salt and milk in	large  saucepan.  Stir until dissolved over low heat. Place 1/2 cup  sugar  in heavy pan and stir it until it browns and turns to	syrup.	Add 3/4 cup water to syrup and stir.  It will lump, but keep  on  low heat until it all dissolves.  Add to first mixture and  cook  until it forms a soft ball in cold water.  Add vanilla, cool and beat well.

name: ITALIAN VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
1 (0.6 oz.)  pkg. Italian dressing mix
1/4  c. chopped red pepper
