1/4  c. chopped green pepper
preparation: Mix and refrigerate.

name: AMAZIN RAISIN CAKE WITH OLD FASHION ICING
ingredients:
3  cups unsifted flour
2  cups sugar
1  cup mayonnaise
1/3  cup milk
2  eggs
2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cloves
3  cups peeled/chopped apples
1  cup raisins
1/2  cup walnuts or pecans
preparation: Grease and flour 2 (9 in.) round cake pans.  In large bowl with mixer at low speed; beat first 10 ingredients for 2 minutes; scraping bowl frequently.  Stir in apples, raisins & nuts.  Pour into pans and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.  Cool 10 minutes.

name: MISSISSIPPI MUD CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1  c. butter or margarine, melted
4  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. mini marshmallows
preparation: Stir together flour, salt, sugar and cocoa in large bowl. Add butter, eggs and vanilla, stirring until smooth.  Spread batter into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.  Sprinkle hot cake with marshmallows.

name: BAKED MUSHROOM RICE
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice
1/2  c. sliced green onions, with tops
1  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1 (2-1/2 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms with liquid
1/4  c. chopped pimentos
1-1/2  c. chicken broth
1/4  c. dry sherry
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. seasoned pepper
preparation: Sprinkle rice in a buttered baking dish.  In skillet, sauté onions in butter until soft.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bring to boil.  Pour this mixture over rice in baking dish; stir.  Cover with a tight fitting lid or foil.  Bake at 375 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.  Fluff lightly with fork.  Yield:  6 servings.

name: SPICED APPLES
ingredients:
6  to 8 apples
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
cinnamon
red food coloring
red hots (optional)
preparation: Peel apples and cut into chunks or thick slices. (To keep from darkening, apples can be placed in a bowl of saltwater after they are sliced.) Place sugar, water and several red hots in heavy saucepan; stir well and simmer. Add generous sprinkle of cinnamon and enough food coloring to make the solution bright red. Add part of the apples (drained, if they have been soaked) and cook until tender. Remove and continue with the remainder. Then cook the syrup until thickened and pour over apples in casserole or dish and chill. They keep well in the refrigerator.

name: DILL CHICKEN AND ARTICHOKES
ingredients:
8  oz. bottled Italian salad dressing (can use less)
8  boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt (optional)
1  tsp. dill weed
1  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
2 (6 oz. each)  jars marinated artichoke hearts, drained and sliced
8  oz. sour cream
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Pour salad dressing into a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Add chicken breasts to pan. Sprinkle salt, pepper and dill weed over chicken. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Top chicken with mushrooms and artichokes.

name: MEAT SAUCE
ingredients:
1  medium onion
1  Tbsp. oil
2 1/2  c. canned pork, chopped or diced
1 1/2  c. water
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. sugar
salt (optional)
preparation: Chop onion and cook in oil until tender.  Mix rest of ingredients and cook over low heat 1 hour until thick.  Makes 3 cups.  Serve over cooked noodles, rice or spaghetti.  Beef, Spam or hamburger may be substituted for the pork.

name: DIRT PUDDING
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. Oreo cookies
2 small  pkg. instant French vanilla pudding
3  c. milk
1/4  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
16  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Crust 1/2 package Oreos.  Spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Mix pudding with milk and set aside.  In large glass bowl put margarine, sugar and cream cheese.  Microwave until melted; stir.  Add Cool Whip; stir again.  Add pudding; mix well. Pour mixture over Oreos in pan.  Crush remaining cookies and sprinkle on top.  Chill well.

name: CREAM PIE SQUARES
ingredients:
1  regular size yellow cake mix
1  egg
1  stick margarine
1  box powdered sugar
2  eggs
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: PECAN PIE BARS
ingredients:
Cookie Crust (follows)
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. Karo corn syrup
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. butter, melted
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. pecan halves, chopped
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Prepare and bake Cookie Crust. Meanwhile, in a large bowl beat eggs, corn syrup, sugar, butter and vanilla until well blended.  Stir in pecans.  Immediately pour over hot crust; spread evenly.  Bake 25 minutes until firm around edges.

name: NACHOS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (15 oz.)  can pinto beans
1 (10 oz.)  can Campbell's nacho cheese soup
1  c. chopped green onions
1  c. chopped lettuce
1  diced tomato
1 (8 oz.)  c. sour cream
1  bag Tortilla chips
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain.  Combine beef with beans and heat on low 5-10 minutes.  Heat cheese soup. Layer chips, beef and bean mixture, cheese sauce, lettuce, tomato, green onions, and sour cream for individual servings.

name: EGG DISH FOR A LARGE GROUP
ingredients:
15 to 18  slices white bread, cubed
3/4  lb. butter
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  doz. eggs
4  c. milk
preparation: Grease 13 x 9-inch pan.  Put bread cubes in pan.  Melt butter and cheese in double boiler.   Pour over bread cubes.  Add extra ingredients at this point.  Beat eggs and milk.  Pour over bread. Let stand in refrigerator at least 20 to 24 hours.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour, uncovered.  May be served hot or cold and can also be reheated.

name: OATMEAL CHEWIES
ingredients:
2  c. oats
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. cooking oil
1  egg, beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Combine oats and sugar with the oil.  Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour.  Add egg, salt, vanilla and coconut and combine well.  The dough will have a crumbled appearance.  Place level tablespoons of the dough on greased cookie sheet and bake in a moderate oven (325°) for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: RICE BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. rice
1  lb. chopped meat
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic
salt and pepper
parsley
cooking oil
4 1/2  c. water
1  lb. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
4  eggs, separated
garlic powder
grated Romano cheese
bread crumbs
preparation: Sauté chopped meat, garlic and onion until meat is no longer pink; drain fat. Add tomato sauce, salt, pepper (or garlic powder). Cook 10 to 15 minutes; set aside. Cook rice (use a long grain rice of any "starchie" rice). Add salt and cook until not quite done. Remove from heat and let stand. Add 4 egg yolks, salt, pepper and grated cheese.

name: MAYONNAISE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/3  c. cocoa
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. white sugar
1  c. cold water
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into greased and floured cake pan(s) of your choice.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
6  large green peppers
1  lb. ground turkey or beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  c. tomato sauce
3  oz. uncooked rice
6  oz. shredded cheese
pepper to taste
preparation: Wash peppers and cut off tops.  Remove seeds. Boil (steam) in 1-inch of water for 5 minutes. Brown meat and onion.  Drain.  Add tomato sauce, rice and pepper.  Cover and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes. Stand peppers upright in baking dish.  Place 1/2 ounce of cheese in bottom of each, then fill with meat mixture.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25 minutes.  Place 1/2 ounce of cheese on top of each pepper before serving.

name: INDIVIDUAL APPLE AND WALNUT TARTS
ingredients:
2/3  c. unsalted butter, softened
2/3  c. granulated sugar
3  eggs
1 1/4  c. flour
2/3  c. coarsely chopped walnuts
3  tart apples, such as Granny Smith
1/3  c. powdered sugar
6  individual tart molds or 1 large tart mold
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a mixing bowl, combine butter and sugar and blend thoroughly.  Add eggs, one at a time, blending well.  Stir in flour and walnuts and blend well.  Divide batter among 6 buttered molds, patting each evenly over the bottom.  Peel and core apples; thinly slice.  Divide apple slices among tarts on top of batter. Place in preheated oven and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until batter puffs slightly and the edges are golden. Sprinkle tarts with powdered sugar and return them to oven to brown slightly, about five minutes.

name: VENISON STEW
ingredients:
4  medium carrots, quartered
3  medium potatoes, quartered
4  stalks celery, quartered
2  lb. venison (1-inch cubes)
1  c. water
salt and pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients and cook in crock-pot on low setting overnight or 8 to 10 hours.

name: RIGATONI
ingredients:
1  qt. tomato juice
parsley, salt, pepper, onion, oregano and garlic salt or powder
1/4  tsp. ground red pepper
preparation: Boil above ingredients.  Brown ground hamburg; add to sauce. Cook.  Cook rigatoni noodles; drain.  Alternate layers with sauce in baking dish.  Put Mozzarella cheese throughout.  Put white American cheese on top.  Bake at 350°.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium cabbage, chopped
1 1/2  lb. ground meat
3  c. rice
2  large bell peppers, chopped
1  medium onion
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
3  c. water
preparation: Put cabbage, meat, peppers, onion, salt and pepper in pot. Cover.  Cook over medium heat for 1 1/2 hours or until cabbage is tender.  Stir in rice; mix well.  Pour in large casserole dish. Bake 30 minutes at 300°.

name: ORANGE BANANA BAKE
ingredients:
6  large bananas, peeled and halved
1  c. orange juice
2  Tbsp. lime juice
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. allspice
4  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Lay bananas in a single layer in a baking dish, sliced side down.  Put remaining ingredients on bananas in order given.  Dot with butter.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: BUTTERMILK HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
2  c. corn meal
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
3  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients, then add onions, milk and beaten egg. Drop by spoonfuls into hot fat and fry to golden brown.  Drain and serve hot.

name: MUSCADINE OR GRAPE COBBLER
ingredients:
4  c. muscadine or grape hulls
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1/8  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Press the seeds out of enough hulls to make 4 cups.  Cover hulls with water and cook until tender.  Pour into deep dish pie shell and cover with top crust or lattice strips.  Dot with butter and bake at 350° until brown.

name: OATMEAL CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
3/4  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. all purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. oatmeal uncooked
1 12  oz. pkg. semi-sweet chocolate bits
preparation: Preheat oven to 350.  In large bowl cream shortening, brown sugar and granulated sugar.  Add eggs and mix thoroughly.  Combine the baking soda, salt and flour and add to creamed mixture until thoroughly combined.  Add oatmeal and chocolate bits until well mixed.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.

name: SAVORY GRILLED POTATOES
ingredients:
1/2  c. salad dressing
3  minced garlic cloves
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. each salt and pepper
3  bakers, cut into 1/4-inch slices
1  large onion, sliced
preparation: Combine and mix all ingredients. Divide equally and place on 6 (12-inch) squares of foil.  Seal, forming a packet.  Grill over medium coals 25 to 30 minutes. This is also good fried in skillet.

name: SUMMER TUNA LUNCH
ingredients:
1  can white tuna in oil
1  can cannellini beans, drained
1  small onion, minced
1  Tbsp. fresh Italian parsley, chopped
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1  Tbsp. olive oil
salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
preparation: Break tuna into coarse pieces with fork.  Mix all ingredients and tuna together.  Serve at room temperature.  Serves 4.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. long grain and wild rice mix
2  c. hot water
6  pork chops
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Combine rice, seasoned package rice mix and hot water.  Place in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Set aside.  Sprinkle pork chops with pepper.  Place over rice mix.  Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Uncover casserole.  Combine celery soup and milk.  Pour over casserole.  Bake another 15 minutes uncovered.

name: GREEN BEANS WITH SUNFLOWER SEEDS
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh green beans
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  tsp. minced garlic
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
shake of red pepper, crushed (optional)
1/3  c. water
3  Tbsp. sunflower seeds
1/4  tsp. oregano
preparation: Snap ends off beans and break into 1/2-inch lengths.  If very young, leave whole.  Wash and place in pan.  Sprinkle onion, garlic, salt and pepper over beans.  Add water.  Cover tightly and cook on high until steaming; reduce heat and cook about 20 minutes until beans are crisp-tender.  Pour off excess liquid.  Sprinkle sunflower seeds and oregano over beans.  Mix lightly.

name: Baked Chicken and Vegetables
ingredients:
vegetable cooking spray
2  medium onions, sliced
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. Dijon mustard
4  c. sliced yellow squash
1  dried whole basil
4  (about 1/4 lb.) boneless and skinless chicken breast
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
8  cherry tomatoes, halved
1  clove garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. corn oil margarine
preparation: Cut four (18 x 12-inch) sheets heavy-duty aluminum foil and coat each sheet with cooking spray.  Arrange 1/4 of sliced onion evenly in center of each sheet of foil.  Top each with a chicken breast half.  Spread 1 teaspoon mustard over each breast half and sprinkle evenly with salt and pepper.  Top each with 1/4 of squash, mushrooms and tomatoes.  Sprinkle evenly with basil and garlic.  Dot each with 1 teaspoon margarine.  Fold edges of foil over and wrap securely.  Place packets on an ungreased baking sheet.   Bake at 400°  for 25 to 30 minutes.  Serve in foil packets.  Yields 4 servings.

name: LOW CARB PIZZA CRUST
ingredients:
4  oz. cream cheese
3  eggs
1/3  c. cream
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. oregano (optional)
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
2  c. mixed Italian cheese
1/2  c. pizza sauce
1  c. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Beat together cream cheese and eggs until smooth. Add cream cheese, Parmesan cheese and spices and mix together again. Spray a 9 x 13 pan with Pam. Sprinkle 2 cups of Italian cheese onto pan and pour the egg mixture over the cheese. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand for 5 minutes; add pizza sauce and favorite pizza toppings.

name: ZINGY BEAN DIP
ingredients:
2  c. cooked pinto beans, rinsed and drained
2  Tbsp. lime juice
1  medium tomato, peeled
3  cloves garlic, minced
handful of fresh parsley
handful of fresh cilantro
3/4  tsp. cumin
1  scallion, minced
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Whip all ingredients in food processor.  Serve with tortilla chips or pita crisps or vegetable dippers such as pepper strips and celery sticks.

name: MRS. WENZEL'S IKES CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
2/3  c. cocoa, dissolved in 1/2 c. boiled water
3  eggs, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. sour milk or buttermilk
preparation: Cream butter and sugar well.  Cool cocoa and water mix.  Add egg yolks and vanilla to creamed mixture.  Beat well.  Add cooled cocoa.  Sift together flour, soda, baking powder and salt.  Add alternating with sour milk or buttermilk in 1/3's.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.  Turn batter into 2 greased and floured pans. Bake approximately 30 minutes in 375° oven.  Frost with my favorite buttercream frosting.

name: TENDERLOIN DELUXE
ingredients:
2  lb. beef tenderloin or eye of round
2  Tbsp. softened butter
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. Dijon mustard
dash of fresh ground pepper
3/4  c. sherry
preparation: Remove surface fat and connective tissue from meat; spread with 2 tablespoons butter.  Place on rack in shallow roasting pan. Cook 15 minutes, then baste in sauce.  Insert meat thermometer. Roast at 425° until 140° (rare).  For 2 to 3 pounds about 45 to 50 minutes.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. chicken or use chicken or turkey breasts
1  lb. shredded cheese (Colby or Cheddar)
1  can chopped chiles (green)
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  small bag tortilla chips, crushed (not individual bag)
preparation: Boil chicken and dice.  Set aside in bowl.  Mix soups and chiles together; add small amount of broth to soup mixture.  Grease bottom and sides of baking dish.  Begin to layer ingredients: crushed chips, spoon on soup mixture, chicken and cheese.  Repeat layers until chicken is gone.  It doesn't usually take all of the soup, depending on how much chicken is used.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: ENGLISH ORANGE ROUNDS
ingredients:
1  can frozen orange juice concentrate
1  box honey graham crackers, crushed finely
spices of your choice
preparation: Mix and shape into balls about 1/2-inch in diameter.  May be served fresh, chilled or frozen and served later.

name: Chocolate Fondue
ingredients:
6 (1 oz.)  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. light cream
1/2  c. butter
1/8  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. creme de cacao
angel food cake, cut into bite-size chunks
marshmallows
fruits (bananas, strawberries, pineapple, maraschino cherries)
preparation: Melt chocolate in slow-cooking pot.  Cover and heat on high until chocolate melts.  Stir in cream, sugar, butter and salt; cook on high for 10 minutes until blended.  Add creme de cacao and turn heat to low.  Serve with fondue forks.

name: BROCCOLI AND CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
6  oz. jar chopped pimentos
8  oz. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  head broccoli
1  head cauliflower
1 large  jar stuffed olives
1  stem celery
Kraft mayonnaise
preparation: Cut celery, cauliflower and broccoli ends into small pieces. Add drained pimentos, olives and cheese.  Mix together with mayonnaise.

name: POTATOES, GREEN BEANS AND HAM
ingredients:
6  large red potatoes
2  cans green beans
1  onion
2  lb. seasoned ham
preparation: In a large stock pot add 2 quarts of cool water.  Peel and cut potatoes in cubes; add to water.  Drain 2 cans of green beans; add to water.  Dice ham and add to water.  Cover pot. Cook over medium low heat until potatoes are done, about 45 minutes.

name: ALMOND CHEESE FILLED COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  c. lukewarm water
1  tsp. sugar
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. butter
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. granulated sugar
1  tsp. almond extract or vanilla
preparation: Mix yeast, water and 1 teaspoon sugar.  Let stand for 10 minutes.  Add eggs.  Cut butter into flour and salt; mix well.  Add yeast mixture.  Divide into 2 balls and roll each into an 8 x 10-inch rectangle.  Make filling by combining cream cheese, almond and 1 cup sugar.  Spread half of the cream cheese filling on each rectangle and fold, by taking each long side toward the middle, making sure the sides overlay a little.  Fold ends up about 1 1/2-inches.  Lay on a lightly greased cookie sheet and bake immediately for 25 minutes at 400° to 425°.  When cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar or drizzle a thin glaze over this.

name: BAKED ARTICHOKE SPREAD
ingredients:
8  oz. artichoke hearts, cooked
1  c. Parmesan, grated
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. mayonnaise
8  oz. cream cheese
2  garlic cloves, minced
2  jalapeno peppers, stemmed, seeded and diced
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Place all ingredients in the food processor and puree until smooth.  Pour into shallow baking dish and bake 30 to 45 minutes or until light brown on top.   Serve with tortilla chips, French bread or crackers.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  bunches broccoli
1/2  c. diced onion
1/2  c. raisins
1 1/2  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. fried bacon (6 slices)
preparation: Mix all together.

name: BANANA DELIGHT PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
2 1/4  c. milk
1  1/2 bananas, sliced
1/2  c. Cool Whip, thawed
9-inch pie shell, baked
preparation: Prepare pudding with milk.  Set aside 1 cup filling.  Pour thin layer of remaining filling into cooled pie shell.  Arrange sliced bananas on filling.  Top with rest of filling.  Blend Cool Whip into reserved filling.  Spread over filling.  Chill 3 hours. Garnish as desired.

name: APPLE-GLAZED CHICK 'N' GRITS GORGONZOLA
ingredients:
4  skinned, boned chicken breast halves
cooking spray
1/4  c. apple butter
14  c. spicy brown mustard
1/4  tsp. salt, optional
1/4  tsp. red pepper
1/8  tsp. black pepper
2  Tbsp. green onion tops, chopped
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Flatten chicken breast between waxed paper.  Place chicken in baking pan coated with cooking spray. Combine next 5 ingredients (apple butter to blk. pepper).  Brush over chicken.  Bake for 20 minutes.  Cut chicken into 1/2 inch slices.  Spoon Gorgonzola grits into 4 shallow serving bowls.  Top with chicken.  Sprinkle with green onion tops.

name: RHUBARB CRUMB TART
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
3  Tbsp. powdered sugar
1/3  c. oleo
1  egg, beaten
4  tsp. milk
3  c. raw diced rhubarb
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1/2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. oleo
preparation: For crust, mix flour, baking powder and powdered sugar in a medium bowl.  Cut in oleo until it forms coarse crumbs.  Add egg and milk; stir until a ball forms.  Pat into a greased 11 x 7-inch baking pan.  Place rhubarb in crust; sprinkle with Jell-O.  In small bowl, mix the 1/2 cup flour, 1 cup sugar and 1/3 cup oleo together until crumbly.   Sprinkle over rhubarb mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.  Allow to cool until firm.

name: CHEDDAR CHEESE PUMPKIN(Autumn Appetizer)
ingredients:
2  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded (8 oz.)
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. chopped salted peanuts
1/4  c. shredded carrots
2  Tbsp. minced red onion
1/8  tsp. dill weed
strip of green pepper (for "stem")
preparation: Mix in medium bowl the Cheddar cheese and cream cheese, until well blended.  Stir in peanuts, carrots, onion and dill. Refrigerate, covered, at least 1 hour. Shape into pumpkin or ball shape.  Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours to blend flavors.

name: HAPPINESS BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. good thoughts
1  c. kind deeds
1  c. consideration for others
2  c. sacrifice
2  c. well beaten faults
3  c. forgiveness
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Turn down television.  Remove toys from countertop.  Measure 2 cups of flour.  Put flour, baking powder and salt into sifter.  Vacuum mixture from flour, which Benjamin spilled.  Get an egg.  Answer phone.  Grease pan.  Answer door. Take 1/2-inch of salt from greased pan and look for Benjamin.  Put mess in wastebasket.  Wash dishes.  Call the bakery and take an aspirin.

name: INDONESIAN CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. curry powder
6  oz. chutney
preparation: Mix.  Place peanuts or pecans all over surface of cheese ball.

name: STRAWBERRY SHORTCAKE
ingredients:
1  qt. strawberries, sliced
1/2  c. sugar
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  large eggs
1  c. whipping cream
1/4  c. sifted powdered sugar
garnishes: whole strawberry and fresh mint sprigs
preparation: Combine strawberries and 1/2 cup sugar; set aside.  Combine flour and next 3 ingredients.  Cut in butter with a pastry blender until mixture is crumbly.  Add eggs, stirring until moistened. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface.  Knead lightly several times to form a ball.  (Dough will be grainy.)  Press into a wax paper-lined 8-inch round cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until golden.  Cool in pan on a wire rack and peel off wax paper.  Cool on a wire rack.

name: ORANGE SWEET POTATO SOUFFLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked, mashed sweet potatoes
1/3  c. fresh squeezed orange juice
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs, slightly beaten
2  tsp. grated orange peel
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Mix and pour into buttered casserole dish.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising cornmeal
2  eggs
1  c. corn
1/2  c. oil
3  tsp. baking powder
3  or 4 pods hot pepper
1  c. sour cream
1  c. grated cheese
1  small onion, grated
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake in a greased pan at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: HONEY PECAN SHORTBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1/3  c. honey
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
3/4  c. finely chopped pecans
preparation: Heat oven to 300°.  Allow butter to reach room temperature and then cream together with honey and vanilla.  Gradually add the flour and nut mixture.  Do not overbeat.  Pat dough into an 11 to 12-inch pancake on an ungreased cookie sheet.   Score halfway through into pie piece wedge shapes.  Bake 40 minutes until lightly browned.  Cool 10 minutes before cutting wedges all the way through.

name: HAM AND EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
6  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper
3  c. milk (more if needed)
1  medium onion, minced
1  medium green pepper, minced
1/8  tsp. dry mustard
1  can sliced mushrooms, broiled in butter
2  c. cooked ham, ground or finely chopped
3  hard-boiled eggs, chopped or sliced
preparation: In a double boiler, melt the butter or margarine.  Add the flour and the seasoning and blend.  Add the milk and the minced onion and green pepper. These will cook as the sauce does.  Add the mushrooms and the dry mustard.

name: APPLE-BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. raw broccoli
2  c. raw apple
1  c. golden raisins
1  c. walnuts, chopped
1  small red onion
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. white vinegar
preparation: Wash and cut broccoli and unpeeled, cored apple into bite-sizes.  Add raisins, nuts and sliced onion.  Toss.  Mix together mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar.  Pour this over first ingredients and mix.  Chill before serving.

name: HOMINY
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
2  garlic cloves, minced
2  cans (15 1/2 oz.) yellow hominy, drained
2  c. chopped tomatoes
1 small  can chopped green chilies
1  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. ground cumin
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a large skillet coated with nonstick cooking spray, sauté onion and garlic until tender. Add the drained hominy, tomatoes, chilies, chili powder, cumin and pepper; mix gently. Transfer to a greased 2-quart baking dish. Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and return to oven for an additional 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

name: LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1/3  c. lemon juice
1  can Eagle Brand (lite)
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix well with a spoon or whisk.  Pour into a graham cracker pie crust.

name: HOT SAUCE
ingredients:
5  qt. chopped and peeled tomatoes
2 to 2 1/2  c. chopped bell pepper (1/2 c. hot peppers)
3  medium chopped onions
1  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
3  tsp. salt
garlic to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Cook 45 to 60 minutes over medium heat. Pour into jars and seal.

name: FESTIVE LASAGNA
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. cooked lasagna noodles
2  lb. bulk Italian sausage *
2 (15 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
2 (12 oz.)  cans tomato paste
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans tomato puree
2  tsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt (may omit salt)
1 1/2  tsp. basil leaves
1  tsp. crushed red pepper
1/4  tsp. black pepper
2  (15 oz.) containers Ricotta cheese
1  egg, beaten
1/3  c. chopped parsley (fresh or parsley flakes may be used)
4  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: *Season meat with garlic powder and onion salt.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. frozen Shoepeg corn
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. melted margarine
2  eggs, well beaten
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
preparation: To corn, add salt, pepper, sugar, melted margarine, and flour. Add beaten eggs and milk, stirring well.  Pour into greased 9-inch square baking dish and bake at 350° approximately 35 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: MOM'S FRIED BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. pistolettes bread
3  c. oil
preparation: Heat oil until hot.  Drop pistolettes in, one at a time.  Turn each one until brown on both sides.  Drain on paper towels.

name: QUICK BARBECUE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1/2  bottle catsup
1 large  can tomato sauce
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  c. vinegar
preparation: Brown hamburger and onions in skillet.  Drain off fat.  Add catsup, tomato sauce and vinegar.  Mix together.  Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.

name: CREAM CHEESE BLUEBERRY PIE
ingredients:
2  graham cracker crusts
18  oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened
3  c. powdered sugar
1 large  box Dream Whip
1 large  can blueberry pie filling
preparation: Cream together.  Soften cream cheese with sugar until fluffy. Mix Dream Whip by directions on box.  Fold in cream cheese.  Fill cracker crust.  Top with blueberries and chill overnight.  (Any kind of fruit may be used.)

name: SUGARLESS COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. twin brown sugar
1  egg
1  c. unsweetened applesauce
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. nuts
1  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  c. quick cooking oatmeal
preparation: Cream together margarine, brown sugar twin, egg, applesauce and vanilla.  Mix dry ingredients with creamed mixture.  Stir until well blended.  Add nuts and raisins.  Drop by teaspoonful onto greased baking sheet.  Bake at 375° to 400° for 8 to 10 minutes or until slightly browned.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 large  bunch broccoli
1  pkg. Stove Top stuffing
1 1/2  c. chicken pieces, cooked (boneless breasts)
1/2  c. chopped walnuts (optional)
2  c. milk
1  1/2 chicken bouillon cubes
1/2  c. margarine (Parkay)
4  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Cook broccoli in hard boiling water until almost done. Drain and layer in well-buttered casserole dish. Add chicken pieces and the prepared stuffing (recipe on box). Layer broccoli, chicken and stuffing until stuffing is on top.

name: TACO SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  (14 oz.) kidney beans
1  (14 oz.) corn
2  cans Ranch Style beans
1  can black beans
1  envelope taco seasoning
shredded taco flavored cheese
1  bag Fritos chips
preparation: Brown meat; drain. Combine all ingredients (don't drain juices off of cans) except cheese and chips into crock-pot. Cook until warmed through. Serve with chips and cheese.

name: WILD RICE AND SAUSAGE(Yields 12 Servings)
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  c. chopped celery
1  large onion, chopped
1  medium green pepper, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
3  c. chicken broth
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1 (8 oz.)  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
2 (4 oz.)  cans sliced mushrooms, drained
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. long grain and wild rice mix
1 (2 oz.)  pkg. sliced almonds
dash of thyme
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large skillet; cook over medium heat until sausage is browned and vegetables are tender, stirring to crumble meat.  Drain.  Stir in remaining ingredients except almonds; mix well.  Spoon into a lightly greased 3-quart casserole and sprinkle with almonds.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Garnish with parsley, if desired.

name: STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1/4  lb. pork sausage
1  c. chopped onion
1  lb. or 12 large mushrooms
3/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. parsley
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. Minute rice
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Brown sausage and onions.  Remove stems from mushrooms; chop fine  and  add  to	meat mixture.  Cook until brown.  Add water, parsley,  salt and pepper;	bring to a boil.  Add rice, cover and remove  from  heat.  Let  stand for 5 minutes.  Mix mayonnaise and cheese,  stir  1/2 cup mayonnaise mixture into rice mixture. Spoon  into  mushrooms, place in shallow baking dish.  Top	each mushroom  with remaining mayonnaise mixture. Bake at 400° for about 15 minutes or until brown and puffy.

name: NANA'S NO FAIL FUDGE
ingredients:
2/3  c. evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. butter
1 1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. marshmallows
1  c. walnuts
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients in saucepan, stirring constantly. Cook to a rolling boil.  Boil for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat, add chocolate morsels and marshmallows.  Stir until all are melted.   Add vanilla and nuts.  Spread into buttered 8-inch pan. No beating required.

name: EGG AND CHEESE BAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Bisquick
1  c. cottage cheese (small curd)
1/2  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. dried or fresh onion
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1/4  tsp. salt
6  eggs, lightly beaten
1  c. milk
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Mix ingredients in order given except butter.  Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Pour in cheese/egg mixture, spreading evenly.  Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.  (Chopped up ham or cooked bacon pieces can be added to this dish also.)

name: GERMAN SOUR CREAM POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes, cooked
6  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
small bunch green onions or medium sweet dry onion, chopped
1/2  lb. lean bacon, finely diced
1/2  pt. sour cream
1  Tbsp. salt
pepper
6  Tbsp. vinegar
3  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Chop warm potatoes in large bowl.  Add eggs and onion.  Fry bacon until crisp.  Retain the bacon grease.  Put bacon over the potatoes.  Add to the grease the salt, pepper, vinegar, sugar and sour cream; bring to boil, stirring to combine ingredients.  Pour over potatoes.  Serve warm or cold.  Makes 8 servings.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1 - 8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. milk
1 - 8  oz. Cool Whip
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Combine first three ingredients and then add milk.  Fold in the Cool Whip and nuts.  Pour into a prepared graham cracker crust and freeze overnight.  Just before serving, remove from the freezer and let stand at room temperature for about 30 minutes.

name: DEVILED EGGS
ingredients:
6  hard boiled eggs, cut in half lengthwise
1/3  cup cottage cheese
2  Tbsp. skim milk
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1/4  tsp. salt
Dash of pepper
Dash of onion powder
preparation: Remove yolks from whites and place in blender with remaining ingredients.  Blend at medium speed until mixture is smooth.  Stop blender and scrap sides occasionally.  Spoon yolk mixture into egg whites.  Garnish with snipped parsley or paprika.  12 servings.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1  can cream of shrimp soup
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: Heat soup in a bowl for 3 to 4 minutes.  Stir often.  Cut cream cheese into cubes and stir cheese into the hot soup.  Heat 2 minutes, stirring often.  Mix with electric mixer until smooth. Place in plastic container with a tight fitting lid.  Place in refrigerator to cool.  Serve with potato chips.

name: DIRTY PUDDING
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. Oreo cookies
1  large Cool Whip
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. French vanilla instant pudding mix
3  c. milk
preparation: Crush cookies and place half of them in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix together Cool Whip, cream cheese and powdered sugar.  Mix pudding and milk in separate bowl. Combine both mixtures and pour over crumbs. Spread remaining crumbs over top. Refrigerate before serving.

name: WYOMING WHOPPER COOKIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. butter
1 1/4  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. granulated sugar
3  beaten eggs
1 1/2  c. chunky style peanut butter
6  c. old fashioned oatmeal (not quick cooking)
2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  c. raisins
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Melt butter over low heat.  Blend in sugars, eggs and peanut butter.  Mix until smooth.  Add oats, soda, raisins and chocolate chips. (Mixture will be sticky.)  Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes.

name: BREAKFAST EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
10  slices bread, crust removed
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/4  lb. butter
8  eggs
2  c. milk
preparation: Remove crust and place in 10 x 13-inch Pyrex pan.  Melt butter and cheese and pour over bread.  Beat eggs and milk.  Pour over cheese mixture and bread.  Let stand, covered with foil, overnight. Bake at 300° in hot oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Done when puffy and slightly brown.  Optional to add ham, mushrooms, onions and green pepper over entire mixture before baking.

name: SAUSAGE SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  head shredded cabbage
1  c. Northern beans
1  can whole tomatoes
1/2  lb. hot or smoked sausage or turkey sausage, sliced
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  medium onion, chopped
1/4  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/2  bay leaf
preparation: Brown sausage; drain fat.  Place with other ingredients in pan; cook for 1 1/2 hours.

name: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
1  can corn
2  eggs
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 to 2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. butter
pinch of salt
preparation: Beat eggs. Add other ingredients and bake in a 325° oven for about 45 minutes.

name: AU GRATIN POTATOES
ingredients:
3  lb. potatoes
1  onion, chopped
1/4  c. margarine
1  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. milk
2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar
1/4  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Wash, peel and remove eyes from potatoes.  Thinly slice.  Cook onion in butter; stir in flour, salt and pepper.  Cook over low heat until bubbly.  Remove from heat.  Stir in milk and cheese. Heat to boil, 1 minute.  Put potatoes in ungreased pan.  Pour on cheese sauce.  Cook, uncovered, at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Sprinkle on bread crumbs.   Bake 15 minutes more.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
1  chicken
1  box (2 envelopes) Lipton chicken noodle soup
1  medium to large onion, chopped
2  pods garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. cumin powder
2  to 4 6-inch zucchini, sliced
2  carrots, thinly sliced
1  to 2 celery sticks, diced
preparation: In a large pot or Dutch oven, cook chicken.  Remove chicken when done and chop up.  Take 4 cups of chicken broth (add water, if necessary to make 4 cups).  Add:  onion, garlic, chili powder, cumin, zucchini, carrots, celery, chicken and chicken noodle soup. Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer about 30 to 45 minutes.

name: DATE BALLS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. sugar
1  c. dates, chopped
1  c. nuts, chopped
2  c. Rice Krispies
coconut
preparation: Cook all in pan until bubbly.  Add Rice Krispies.  Mix.  Cool. Make into balls.  Roll in coconut.

name: APPLESAUCE CHRISTMAS CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1 1/2  c. applesauce
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. ground cloves
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. raisins
1  tsp. soda
2 1/2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. ground nutmeg
2  tsp. molasses
1/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar; beat in egg.  Combine applesauce and soda; beat in.  Combine rest of dry ingredients and add.  Stir in molasses, vanilla, raisins and pecans.

name: GRANDMA BARB'S DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. melted shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
preparation: In a bowl, sift together flour, salt and baking powder.  Add 1/2 cup milk. Mix until forms a soft dough.  Blend in melted shortening. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto boiling soup.  Cover tightly and steam without lifting cover for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: TUNA NOODLE SUPREME
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. (6 oz.) Light n Fluffy wide noodles, uncooked
1 (6 oz.)  can tuna, drained and flaked
1  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. Dijon mustard
2  c. small fresh broccoli florets, parboiled 2 minutes and drained
1/4  c. green onion slices
1  pkg. Sea Sticks, cut bite size
1/3  c. red pepper, chopped (Optional)
preparation: Set oven to 350°.  Cook pasta according to package directions; drain.  In large bowl, combine sour cream, mayonnaise, Parmesan cheese, milk and mustard.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Add hot pasta, tuna, Sea Sticks, broccoli, green onion and red peppers. Stir until blended.

name: CREAMY RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. milk
1/2  c. sugar
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. rice
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. lemon extract
1  c. heavy cream
preparation: Heat milk, sugar and gelatin in top of double boiler over very low heat, stirring occasionally, until small bubbles form around edge of milk.  Stir in salt and rice.  Place over boiling water; cover and cook 1 hour or until rice is soft.  Stir in extract and cool to room temperature.  Whip cream and fold into rice mixture; chill several hours.  Serves 6.

name: OPEN FACED TUNA SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1  can (6 oz.) light tuna in water, drained & flaked
1  c. chopped unpeeled apple
3  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/8  tsp. pepper
4  slices bread, toasted
4 thin  slices (2 oz.) Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: In a bowl, combine tuna, apple, onion, mayonnaise, lemon juice and pepper.  Spread on bread.  Top with a cheese slice.  Broil about 4 inches from the heat for 4 minutes or until cheese is melted.  Yield:  4 sandwiches.

name: ITALIAN DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
2  medium onions, chopped
1  c. macaroni, cooked
1  pt. corn
1  qt. tomatoes or juice
1  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: Fry hamburger and onions.  Add cooked macaroni and corn, then tomatoes.  Add chili powder.  Simmer about 1/2 hour.

name: CHEESE BALL OR DIP
ingredients:
3  pkg. cream cheese
1  medium onion
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. Accent
2  pkg. dried beef
preparation: Grind up beef and onion, then mix in remaining ingredients. Shape into a ball or process it and pour it in a bowl.

name: NO BAKE LO-FAT CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. light Philadelphia Brand Neufchatel cheese, softened*
4  (3 1/2 oz.) instant vanilla pudding mix
3  c. skim milk
1  tsp. vanilla flavor
1/4  c. lemon juice (optional)
2  ready to use graham cracker crusts
topping of your choice
preparation: Cream Neufchatel cheese until smooth using a blender or fork. Add instant vanilla pudding mix and milk.  Blend to a smooth consistency.  Add flavor and juice (if desired).  Stir well.  Pour into crusts and add toppings before serving.  Cherry pie filling is good topping.  May chill or serve instantly.

name: QUICK AND EASY COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. milk
1  can crushed pineapple or 1 can sliced peaches
preparation: Melt stick of butter in a 13 x 9-inch pan at 350°.  While butter is melting, mix flour, sugar and milk by hand.  When butter is melted, pour flour mixture on top of butter, then your fruit. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes, or until it is golden brown.

name: HOT MONTEREY RICE SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
2  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. mayonnaise
3  c. cooked rice
2  c. sliced celery
1  c. each: chopped green pepper and onion
3  medium tomatoes, cut into eighths
1  c. crushed corn chips
preparation: Cook meat in lightly greased skillet until done (drain well). Add garlic salt, pepper sauce and lemon juice to mayonnaise.  Stir into meat mixture with remaining ingredients, except corn chips. Turn into a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Top with corn chips. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: MARINATED FLANK STEAK
ingredients:
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. sherry
2  tsp. Worcestershire
1/2  tsp. ginger
1 minced  clove garlic
1  flank steak
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except the flank steak.  Pour over the flank steak in a freezer bag and freeze with the flank steak in the marinade.

name: PORK CHOPS ON RICE
ingredients:
6  pork chops (3/4-inch thick)
1 1/3  c. uncooked packaged precooked rice
1  c. orange juice
1  can chicken with rice soup
preparation: In skillet, brown pork chops on both sides; season with salt and pepper.  Place rice in 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish; pour orange juice over rice.  Arrange pork chops on rice.  Pour chicken soup over all.  Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Uncover; bake 10 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI PIE
ingredients:
4  c. zucchini, peeled and sliced
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/3  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. flour
2  eggs
1/4  c. lemon juice
pastry for 1 (2 crust) pie (unbaked)
preparation: Slice zucchini thin.   Mix first five ingredients.  Beat eggs lightly with lemon juice.  Mix with the first five ingredients. Fill unbaked pie shell.  Cover with top crust.  Bake as apple pie.

name: SAFFRON RICE SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. cooked rice, cooked in chicken broth and 1/8 tsp. saffron* and cooled to room temperature
1/2  c. diced red pepper
1/2  c. diced green pepper
1/4  c. sliced green onions
1/4  c. sliced ripe olives
2  Tbsp. white wine vinegar
1  tsp. olive oil
2 to 3  drops hot pepper sauce (optional)
1  clove garlic, minced
1/4  tsp. ground white pepper
lettuce leaves
preparation: *May substitute ground turmeric for the saffron, if desired.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin Jell-O
1 2/3  c. boiling water
2  c. or 4 1/2 oz. container thawed Cool Whip
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  c. strawberry halves
1  baked 9-inch pie crust, chilled
preparation: Dissolve  gelatin  in  boiling	water; add sugar. Chill until slightly thickened.  Spread Cool Whip over bottom and up sides  of pie crust.	Stir strawberries into thickened gelatin and  gently spoon on top of Cool Whip mixture.	Chill at least 3 hours.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. shortening, margarine or butter
4  beaten egg yolks
1/2  tsp. salt
1  pkg. Baker's German sweet chocolate
1/2  c. boiling water
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk
2 1/2  c. sifted cake flour
1  tsp. baking soda
4  egg whites, beaten until stiff
preparation: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add egg yolks, beating thoroughly after each addition. Add buttermilk alternately with flour, salt and baking soda. Melt over low heat the German chocolate in 1/2 cup boiling water. Add vanilla and cool. Add chocolate mixture to batter. Mix well. Fold in 4 stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into greased and floured pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 2 (10-inch) layers or 3 (8-inch) layers. When cake is cool, ice with frosting.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. Taco Bell picante sauce
2  peeled and pitted avocados
4  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1/2  tsp. coarse ground pepper
juice of 1 lime
1  sliced cucumber
2  sliced carrots
1  thinly sliced red onion
2  oz. can sliced black olives, drained
1  box Taco Bell tortilla chips
preparation: Slice chicken breasts into bite size strips and brown in large skillet with oil.  Add Taco Bell taco seasoning mix and water; simmer until reduced.  Clean and slice all remaining vegetables for the salad.  Combine all dressing ingredients and blend well.  Pour into serving dish.  Place the salad into serving bowl and top with warm chicken.  Serve with Taco Bell tortilla chips and Avocado Picante Dressing.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.  Takes 20 minutes.

name: BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
dried beef
boneless chicken breasts
1  c. sour cream
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: In a large buttered pan, add a layer of dried beef (may be freshened if you wish) and boneless chicken breasts.  Combine sour cream and mushroom soup.  Pour over the chicken.  Cover and bake at 275° for 3 hours.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
10  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. chopped ham
1/2 small  jar pimentos (optional)
preparation: Mix cheeses and mayonnaise well together.  Then add ham, then pimentos (optional).  Shape into ball and roll in pecans.

name: VELVETY COCOA CREAM PIE
ingredients:
3  c. milk
1/2  c. minus 1 Tbsp. cocoa
1 1/4  c. sugar
4 1/2  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  (9-inch) pie shell, baked
1  c. whipped cream
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Boil until thick.  Pour into pie shell. Top with whipped cream.

name: POTATOES AU GRATIN
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. grated cheese
1 1/2  lb. potatoes, sliced and boiled
1/2 to 1  tsp. (to your liking) salt
1/4  c. fine dry bread crumbs
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Rub a 1 1/2-quart baking dish with butter.  Melt 2 tablespoons margarine; blend in flour and milk gradually.  Simmer, stirring, over low heat for 3 minutes.  Add salt and grated cheese and continue to heat until cheese is melted. Arrange potatoes in baking dish; pour cheese sauce over them and top with crumbs, which are mixed with remaining 1 tablespoon of margarine.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until crumbs brown.

name: EASY BARBECUE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  cut up fryer
tomato catsup
brown sugar
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
1/2  c. orange juice
2  tsp. orange peel (McCormick spice)
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Put favorite pieces of chicken in baking dish. Drizzle good with tomato catsup, brown sugar and soup mix. Add orange juice and orange peel, then soy sauce. Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 30 minutes. Reduce heat to 375° and cook approximately another 50 minutes. Ovens vary, so cook until browned and tender.

name: CHOCOLATE ZUCCHINI CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. soft margarine
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1 3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sour milk *
2 1/2  c. flour
6  Tbsp. cocoa (1/4 c. plus 2 Tbsp.)
1  tsp. baking soda
pinch of salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  c. grated zucchini
preparation: Beat margarine, oil, sugar eggs, vanilla and sour milk with mixer.  Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture; beat well. Stir in zucchini.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. water
1  Tbsp. dried onions
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  c. Minute rice
1  can cream of celery soup
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
preparation: Cook together for 3 minutes the margarine, water, dried onions and broccoli.  Remove from heat and add Minute rice, cream of celery soup and Cheez Whiz.  Mix well and put into a large casserole.  Top with bread crumbs and bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.  (If you are in a hurry like I am, just cook it all on the stove.)

name: CABBAGE PATCH STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  large chopped onion
1  large chopped bell pepper
3  large chopped celery stalks
3  Tbsp. oil
1/2  large head cabbage, chopped
1  can Ranch Style beans
1  can stewed tomatoes
1  can beef broth
2 small  cans tomato sauce
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1/2  tsp. each cumin and garlic powder
preparation: Brown  hamburger  and put into stew pot.  In oil, saute onion, pepper  and  celery.  Add	vegetables to pot.  Add all other ingredients  to  the pot with the cabbage on top.  Bring to a boil and simmer for 1 hour.

name: OATMEAL RAISIN SPICE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1/3  c. milk
1  c. raisins
3  c. oats, uncooked
preparation: Sift flour,  baking powder, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg into a bowl.  Add shortening, brown sugar, eggs and half of the milk. Beat until smooth.   Add rest of milk, raisins and oats.  Drop by spoon onto cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

name: 7-MINUTE FROSTING
ingredients:
2  egg whites, room temperature
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. water
1  tsp. almond flavoring
dash of salt
2  tsp. corn syrup
preparation: Combine egg whites, sugar, salt, water and corn syrup in double boiler.  Beat one minute until thoroughly mixed.  Place over boiling water.  Beat at high speed for 7 minutes until stiff peaks form.  Pour into bowl.  Add almond extract and beat one minute until thick.  Fill and frost cake.  Sprinkle coconut over top and sides.

name: PEPPERONI PIZZAZZ
ingredients:
8  oz. medium tube pasta
28  oz. spaghetti sauce divided
4 1/2  oz. jar sliced mushrooms, drained
8  oz. sliced pepperoni
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
8  oz. can tomato sauce
2  c. shredded mozzarella cheese
1 small  can sliced black olives
preparation: Cook pasta according to the directions.  Combine 2 1/3 cups of spaghetti sauce, mushrooms, Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, black olives and pepperoni. Drain pasta and add to sauce mixture, mix well.  Transfer to 3 quart baking dish.  Combine tomato sauce and remaining spaghetti sauce and pour on top.  Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 40 to 45 minutes or until bubbly.  Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese and bake uncovered for 5 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.  Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

name: MOCK APPLE PIE
ingredients:
36  Ritz crackers
2  c. water
2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. cream of tartar
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil spread
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
pastry for 2 (9-inch) pies
preparation: Line pie plate with one pie pastry.  Crumble up crackers and place in pastry.

name: MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1/2  c. ketchup
8  to 12 saltine crackers
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  stick margarine
2  c. water
preparation: Melt margarine in skillet.  Mix beef, onion, ketchup, cracker crumbs, salt and pepper together.  Shape into balls.  Place in hot skillet; turn until brown.  Cover meatballs with ketchup.  Add water.  Cover skillet; simmer for about 1 hour.

name: RELL'S CHRISTMAS CANDY
ingredients:
2  boxes 4x sugar
1  stick oleo
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
1  can coconut
4  c. or less pecans
preparation: Mix well the sugar, oleo and milk and add the coconut and pecans.  Mix well and roll into balls.  Put into refrigerator until hard.

name: ORIENTAL CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
4  boneless skinless chicken breasts, cooked and broken into small pieces
8  oz. water chestnuts, drained and sliced
3  green onions and tops, chopped
1/4  c. sesame seeds, toasted
1/3  c. sliced almonds, toasted
1  Tbsp. poppy seed
Dressing (recipe follows)
3  oz. chow mein noodles
1  medium head iceberg lettuce, broken into small pieces
4  Tbsp. sugar
4  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Mix together sugar, cider vinegar, salt and pepper. Add vegetable oil and shake to mix well.

name: PRESERVING NEWS ARTICLES(Takes Acid Out)
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. Milk of Magnesia
1  qt. water
preparation: Mix and let set for 24 hours.  Pour into 9 x 12-inch pan, then put article in mixture for 2 hours.  Put on paper towel after taking it out of mixture.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
2  c. sliced carrots
1/2  bell pepper, diced
1/2  c. salad oil
1/2  c. vinegar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. salt
1  onion, diced
1/2  c. tomato soup
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook carrots until nearly tender. Drain.  Mix remaining ingredients and let set for 12 hours. Will keep 3 to 4 weeks in refrigerator.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIR DESSERT
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
3  c. milk
6  oz. Cool Whip
graham crackers
2  sq. Baker's chocolate
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
3  Tbsp. oleo
2  tsp. white Karo
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2 to 3  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Layer  graham  crackers  in  large  dish.  Mix  vanilla pudding in 3 cups  milk.  Beat until thick.  Add Cool Whip and pour over crackers.  Add layer of graham crackers on top.

name: HELEN'S CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
chicken breasts, deboned and skinned (2 per person)
1/2  tsp. salt
pinch of garlic salt or 1/8 tsp. onion juice
Old London bread crumbs
2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2  tsp. paprika
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Put chicken in Ziploc bags.  Cover with mixture and marinate in refrigerator overnight.  One and one-half hours before baking, remove from refrigerator.  Roll up chicken into rolls, then roll in bread crumbs.  Let sit for 1 hour.  Spray baking pan with Pam.  Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.  Good hot or cold!

name: MOON ROCKS
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. margarine
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  tsp. salt
4  c. quick cooking oatmeal
1  c. nonfat dry milk
1  c. seedless raisins
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, water, margarine, cocoa, peanut butter and salt together in a pot.  Bring this to a full rolling boil over medium heat.  Boil the mixture for one minute.  Then, take off the heat. Mix the oatmeal, dry milk and raisins together.  Add this to the hot mixture.  Stir until mixed.  Add the vanilla and mix it in well.  Drop teaspoons of cookie batter onto waxed paper or a clean tabletop.  Let the cookies cool until they are set.

name: RANCH POTATOES
ingredients:
5  or 6 scrubbed, unpeeled potatoes
1  stick oleo
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. paprika
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.   Cut each unpeeled potato into 8 pieces.  Combine melted oleo with the rest of the ingredients in a large bowl.  Add potatoes and toss until potatoes are covered with mixture.  Place potatoes on ungreased cookie sheet and bake for 40 minutes.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE(This Recipe Doubles Well.)
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  clove garlic, minced
3  Tbsp. salad oil
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1/2 to 1  tsp. chili powder
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
dash of bottled hot pepper sauce
2  tsp. cornstarch
12  oz. cleaned raw shrimp
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
preparation: Cook onion, celery and garlic until tender but not brown.  Add tomatoes and next 6 ingredients.  Mix cornstarch with 1 tablespoon cold water and stir into sauce.  (Simmer sauce, uncovered, 45 minutes.)  Cook and stir until mixture thickens and bubbles.  Add shrimp and green pepper.  Cover and simmer until done (5 minutes). Serve over rice.  Serves 6.

name: EGGPLANT PATTIES
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant, peeled and cubed
1 1/4  c. cracker crumbs
1 1/4  c. (5 oz.) shredded sharp cheese
2  slightly beaten eggs
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
2  Tbsp. chopped onions
1  clove garlic, minced, or garlic salt
1/8  tsp. black pepper
3  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Cook eggplant until tender; drain and mash.  Stir in crumbs, cheese, eggs, parsley, onion, garlic, salt and pepper.  Shape into 8 patties.  Cook in hot oil about 3 to 5 minutes each side, until brown.

name: HAM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked chopped ham
2  c. cooked diced potatoes
1  c. chopped onions
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  c. chopped celery
1  can French green beans
2  cans mushroom soup
1  tsp. salt (more if needed)
preparation: Mix well and pour into large casserole bowl. Bake for about 40 minutes at 350°. Top with a can of French onion rings. (Cover to cook.)

name: PASTA E FAGIOLI
ingredients:
1/3  lb. short pasta (ditalini)
1 1/2  c. beans (1/2 pureed, 1/2 whole)*
3 to 4  slices bacon, cut into matchsticks
2 to 3  cloves garlic, chopped fine
parsley and basil
1/2  can whole tomatoes, crushed
salt and pepper
grated Parmesan cheese
3  Tbsp. olive oil
1/2  medium onion, chopped
2  c. water or chicken broth
preparation: *Use beans such as cannellini or pinto.

name: JACKLYN ZEMAN'S PINEAPPLE SOUR CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple in juice
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  pkg. (2 layer) yellow cake mix
1  pkg. (4 servings) vanilla, pineapple cream or pistachio instant pudding mix
4  eggs
1/2  pt. sour cream
1/4  c. oil
preparation: Combine pineapple with juice and soda.  Mix well.  In a large bowl, combine cake mix and remaining ingredients.  Add pineapple mixture.  Blend.  Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes.  Pour into greased and floured 10-inch fluted tube or tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.  Do not underbake.  Cool in pan for 15 minutes.  Remove from pan.  Finish cooling on rack.

name: CALIFORNIA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  medium green pepper, chopped
3/4  c. chopped onion
1 (16 1/2 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed tomato soup, undiluted
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms, undrained
1 (10 oz.)  can tomatoes with green chilies, undrained (can use only 1/2 can for less spicy)
1 (2 1/4 oz.)  can sliced ripe olives, drained
1 (4 oz.)  jar diced pimiento, drained
1 1/2  tsp. celery salt
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
8  oz. medium egg noodles, cooked and drained
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a large skillet, cook ground beef with green pepper and onion until meat is browned and the vegetables are tender; drain. Add next 11 ingredients and mix thoroughly. Add noodles; mix well.  Pour into a large baking dish.  Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese.  Return to oven for 10 minutes or until cheese melts.  Makes 12 to 16 servings.

name: POPPY CHEESE BREAD
ingredients:
3 3/4  c. biscuit mix
1 1/4  c. shredded sharp cheese
1  Tbsp. poppy seed
1  beaten egg
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine biscuit mix, cheese and poppy seed.  Add egg and milk and mix just to blend.  Beat for 1 minute. Turn into greased 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Sprinkle with additional poppy seed.  Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until done.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. powdered sugar
4  Tbsp. fresh orange juice
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. orange rind
4  Tbsp. softened margarine
preparation: Blend all together in food processor.  You can use orange, lime or lemon juice and rind.

name: EASY LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
3 1/2  c. spaghetti sauce
1 1/2  c. water
2  c. (15 oz.) Ricotta cheese
3  c. (12 oz.) shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  eggs
1/4  c. chopped parsley
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
8  oz. lasagne (uncooked)
preparation: Brown beef in 3-quart saucepan; drain off excess fat.  Add sauce and water; simmer about 10 minutes.  Combine remaining ingredients, except lasagne, for filling.  Pour about 1 cup sauce on bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Layer 3 pieces of uncooked lasagne over sauce; cover with about 1 1/2 cups sauce. Spread 1/2 of cheese filling over sauce.  Repeat layers of lasagne, sauce and cheese filling.   Top with layer of lasagne and remaining sauce.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° about 55 minutes.  Remove foil and bake 10 minutes longer.  Yields 8 to 10 servings.

name: FESTIVE FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1  egg, slightly beaten
2 (11 oz.)  cans mandarin oranges, drained
1 (20 oz.)  can pears, drained and chopped
3  kiwi fruit, peeled and sliced
2  large unpeeled apples, chopped
1  c. pecan halves
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving juice.  Set pineapple aside.  Pour juice into a small saucepan; add sugar and flour.  Bring to a boil.  Quickly stir in egg; cook until thickened.   Remove from heat; cool.  Refrigerate.  In a large bowl, combine pineapple, oranges, pears, kiwi, apples and pecans.   Pour dressing over and blend well.  Cover and chill for 1 hour.

name: Hollandaise Dressing
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. warm water
3  egg yolks
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
1/2  lb. melted butter
preparation: In top of double boiler, place warm water and egg yolks.  Beat until creamy (3 minutes).  Remove from heat.  Add lemon juice, salt and pepper.  Beat in butter, a little at a time, until smooth.

name: HOCKENBERRY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large potato
1  lb. ground meat
1  small onion
1/4  c. uncooked rice
1 large  can tomatoes
salt, vary to taste
pepper, vary to taste
American cheese slices
bread crumbs
preparation: Dice onion and cook with ground meat until all meat is brown. Remove grease.  Into casserole dish, slice very thinly the potato. Add meat and onion mixture.  Sprinkle with uncooked rice.  Add tomatoes (partially chopped).  Sprinkle with bread crumbs.

name: SAUSAGE CRESCENT ROLLS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
1  lb. pork sausage, cooked and well drained
1  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  egg, beaten
3/4  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan, sprayed generously with vegetable cooking spray, spread crescent rolls to cover the bottom of the pan. Keep the rolls touching. Sprinkle sausage and cheese evenly over the rolls. Combine eggs and milk, beating well. Pour mixture over sausage and cheese. Cover with aluminum foil so that rolls will cook thoroughly in the middle. Bake for 25 to 35 minutes or until set. Remove from oven and allow to stand for 5 minutes. Cut into squares and serve immediately. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: CUCUMBER AND DILL SALAD
ingredients:
1  to 3 cucumbers
1  Tbsp. sugar
salt
1/4  c. white vinegar
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh dill
freshly ground pepper (preferably white pepper)
preparation: Peel the cucumbers and split them in half.  Scoop out the seeds with a mellon ball cutter.  Slice the cucumbers crosswise. There should be about 4 cups.  Put the slices in a mixing bowl. Add the remaining ingredients and toss to blend.  Add more seasonings, such as vinegar, sugar and so on to taste, if desired. Yield:  4 servings.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
8  oz. Cheddar cheese
1  lb. American cheese
1  lb. hot sausage
2  c. Bisquick
preparation: Mix.  Roll into marble size balls.  Freeze in a bowl.  Bake in single layer while frozen at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
hamburger meat
1  can kidney beans
1  can sliced black olives
crushed Doritos
3 or 4  Tbsp. picante sauce
1  Tbsp. fajita seasoning
3  or 4 green onions
lettuce
tomatoes
grated cheese
preparation: Boil meat in water; drain.  Return to saucepan and add fajita seasoning, kidney beans and picante sauce.  Mix well and let simmer as you prepare lettuce, tomatoes, cheese and green onions. Mix together with black olives and meat mixture.  Add crushed Doritos to mixture when ready to eat, or each person add his own.

name: STRAWBERRY SHORTCAKE
ingredients:
3  pt. box fresh strawberries
1/4  c. sugar or honey
2  tsp. orange juice
2  c. sifted flour
4  Tbsp. sugar
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. solid shortening
1/2  c. sour cream
2  c. whipping cream
4  Tbsp. sugar
grated rind from 1 orange
preparation: Combine sliced berries, sugar or honey and orange juice. Let stand  at room temperature for 1 hour.  Sift all dry ingredients together  into  a  medium  bowl.  Add orange rind.  Add butter and  shortening  and work them into flour mixture thoroughly. Lightly  mix  in  sour  cream with fork to form a soft dough. Roll  dough  out  onto  lightly floured board, 3/4-inch thick. Cut  into  4-inches,  4  circles.  Place  on  ungreased baking sheet,  bake  at  400° about 20 minutes or until golden. While still  warm, use fork and split cakes in half, place each on dessert  plate,  top with drained berries and second half of cake. Top  with  additional berries.  Pour juice on top, decorate with whipped cream and berries.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2/3  c. flour
4  c. milk
6  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
3  or 4 bananas
graham crackers
preparation: Combine sugar, flour, milk and beaten egg yolks in sauce pan. Cook until thick, stirring often. Add vanilla. Layer graham crackers bananas and mixture in dish. Let cool and serve.

name: BAKED SWEET POTATOES WITH EQUAL
ingredients:
5  sweet potatoes
1/2  stick butter or oleo
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
12  pkg. Equal
1/2  c. water
preparation: Peel and slice potatoes in casserole dish.  Add Equal, butter, nutmeg and water.  Bake until potatoes are done.  Baste regular.

name: PUPPY CHOW
ingredients:
12  oz. bag chocolate chips
12  oz. peanut butter (creamy or chunky)
1  stick margarine
2 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1  box crispy cereal (Wheat Chex or Crispix)
preparation: Over low heat, melt chocolate, peanut butter and margarine in saucepan.  Put cereal in large bowl.  Pour melted mixture over cereal in large bowl.  Put confectioners sugar in large brown paper bag.  Add cereal mixture.  Shake until coated.  Put in airtight container and refrigerate.

name: ONION CASSEROLE(Club Member: Lee Ann McRaney)
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1/2  c. cheese
5  onions
1  can cream of mushroom soup
12  crackers
preparation: Slice onions; place in bottom of casserole dish. Cook sausage; drain and sprinkle on top of onion slices. Crush crackers on top of this. Spoon mushroom soup on top. Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes or until onions are clear.

name: 7 LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. celery
1  c. onions
1  c. green peppers
1  head lettuce
1  can LeSueur green peas
1  c. onion
3  or 4 chopped eggs
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Putting lettuce on bottom, layer ingredients.

name: SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1 3/4  c. cooked sweet potato
1/2  tsp. lemon extract
1/2  tsp. salt
3  large eggs
6  oz. evaporated milk
preparation: Beat sweet potatoes with electric mixer until smooth (works best if potatoes are warm).  Add beaten eggs, sugar, salt and cinnamon and mix well.  Add milk and lemon extract.  Beat until smooth.  Pour into prepared pie shell.  Use a 9-inch deep-dish pie shell.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.  Reduce temperature to 350° and bake for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: SWISS CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  boneless chicken breasts
1  can cream of chicken soup
Pepperidge Farm bread crumbs
margarine to taste (1/4 to 1/2 c.)
1/4 to 1/2  c. milk
Swiss cheese
preparation: Lay chicken breasts in baking dish; cover with Swiss cheese. Mix soup, margarine and milk together and cover over chicken. Sprinkle with the bread crumbs.  Bake at 325° for an hour or until chicken is tender.

name: CORNBREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  box Jiffy corn bread mix
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
2  eggs, beaten
1 (15 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (15 oz.)  can cream style corn
8  Tbsp. (1 stick) margarine
preparation: Melt margarine over low heat and let cool.  Combine cornbread mix, sour cream eggs and stir well.  Add both cans of corn and the cooled melted margarine and stir well.  Pour all into a greased casserole dish.  Bake at 350 degrees until top is golden brown and toothpick comes out moist but clean (approx. 30 minutes in a 3 - 4 inch casserole).  This recipe is best in a deep dish, but can use a 9 x 13 pan (approx. 20 minutes).  This should be more moist than corn bread...do not overcook.

name: CARAMEL ICING
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
1/2  stick butter or margarine
1/2  c. evaporated milk
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients in saucepan, bring to hard boil and stir constantly. Boil one minute. Cool. Add vanilla and beat until creamy.

name: CHEESEBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) unbaked pastry shell
8  slices American cheese
1  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. tomato sauce
1/3  c. chopped green bell pepper
1/3  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. beef-flavored instant bouillon
3  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. flour
chopped tomato and shredded lettuce (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Bake pastry shell for 8 minutes. Remove from oven.  Reduce oven temperature to 350°.

name: POOR MAN'S SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onion
2  cans mixed vegetables
1  can kidney beans, drained
1  can green beans
5  beef bouillon cubes
3 1/2  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
dash of cayenne pepper (or more if you like it hot)
2  cans stewed tomatoes
preparation: All cans should be 10 to 14 ounces.

name: BLUE CHEESE DRESSING
ingredients:
4  c. mayonnaise (1 qt.)
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. small curd cottage cheese
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. salt
4  oz. Blue cheese, crumbled
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a bowl except Blue cheese.  Mix with mixer.  Stir in Blue cheese with fork.  Refrigerate.  Makes 1 1/2 quarts.

name: HERBED-CHEESE OMELET
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2  tsp. sour cream
1/4  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. parsley
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. white pepper
1/8  tsp. dill weed
8  large eggs
2  Tbsp. water
1/2  tsp. white pepper
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. chopped green onion
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients; add next 5 ingredients.  Mix well.  Combine eggs, water and 1/2 teaspoon white pepper; stir with a whisk until blended.  Heat a 10-inch heavy skillet over medium heat until hot.  Add olive oil and butter.  Pour egg mixture into skillet.  As mixture starts to cook, gently lift edges of omelet with a spatula and tilt pan so uncooked egg flows underneath.  Spoon cheese mixture in center and fold sides over filling.  Sprinkle with green onion.

name: PARTY CHEESE RING
ingredients:
16  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. mayo
2  Tbsp. chopped onions
1  jar strawberry jam
more onions (optional)
Louisiana hot sauce (optional)
preparation: Mix  chopped pecans, mayo, cheese, onions and hot sauce together  and  form  a  ring  on plate.  Put strawberry jam in center of ring prior to serving.  Serve Party Cheese Ring with crackers.

name: TUNA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can tuna in water
1  hard-boiled egg, chopped fine
1  small onion, chopped fine
3  Tbsp. bread and butter pickles, chopped fine
1  Tbsp. celery, chopped fine
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise or to taste
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Drain tuna well and flake with a fork.  Place all ingredients in a small bowl and mix well.  Serve on lettuce with salad crackers.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. cooked rice
3  eggs
3/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla pudding
1  c. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Bake at 350° until it is thick and starts to brown.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
1  c. yellow cornmeal
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg, beaten
3/4  c. milk
1  small onion, finely chopped
oil (for deep fat frying)
preparation: Combine meal, flour, baking powder and salt.  Mix well.  Add egg, milk and onion.  Stir just until mixed.  In deep fat fryer or electric skillet, heat oil to 365°.  Fry 2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until golden brown.  Drain on paper towel.   Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: SMALL DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. soft shortening
1  pkg. yeast
1  c. warm water
1  egg
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
preparation: In large mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in water.   Stir in sugar, salt and half the flour.   Beat until smooth.  Add egg and shortening.   Beat in remaining flour until smooth.    Scrape down the sides of bowl with paddle scraper.   Seal and let rise in warm place until double in size.   Punch down and turn out on pastry sheet.   Make into rolls and let rise again.   Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes until brown.

name: BAKED POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
2/3  c. margarine
2/3  c. flour
7  c. milk
4  large potatoes, baked, peeled and cubed
4  green onions, sliced
12  strips bacon, cooked and crumbled
1 1/4  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  c. sour cream
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Melt margarine in large pot; stir in flour, stirring until smooth.  Add milk slowly, stir constantly until thickened.  Add potatoes and onion.  Bring to a boil, stirring.  Reduce heat; simmer 10 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients; stir until cheese is melted.  Serve immediately.  Yields 2 1/2 quarts, 8 to 10 servings.

name: SWEET TATER PIE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked mashed potatoes
1/4  c. oleo
3  eggs
1  c. milk
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. orange juice
preparation: Combine all ingredients and place in unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and cook additional 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: LOUISIANA CHICKEN-FILLED BISCUIT DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
3 (5 oz.)  cans boned chicken
1/4  c. chopped celery
4  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  tsp. parsley flakes
1/8 to 1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (10 count)  pkg. buttermilk biscuits
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
preparation: Chop chicken; place in mixing bowl.  Add celery, 2 tablespoons onion, parsley flakes and pepper; mix well.  Separate biscuits; pat or roll out each biscuit to a 4-inch circle.  Place a small amount of chicken mixture on each biscuit.  Wrap dough around mixture; press edges together firmly.  Combine soups, 1 1/4 cups water, green pepper and remaining onion in a 3-quart saucepan; heat until bubbly, stirring occasionally.  Place dumplings, sealed edges down, in soup mixture; spoon soup mixture over dumplings.  Cover tightly. Cook over medium heat for 15 to 20 minutes, or until dumplings are cooked through.  Serve hot, using soup mixture as sauce.  Yields 10 dumplings.

name: RED TURNER'S RIG CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
3/4  c. water
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  sticks oleo
2  eggs
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: In a large bowl, mix sugar, flour, soda and cinnamon and set aside.  In saucepan, mix oleo, water and cocoa and bring to boil. Pour over sugar and flour mixture.  Beat 2 eggs.  Add buttermilk and vanilla.  Stir into cake mixture.  Pour into greased pan.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: RICE KRISPIES TREATS
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
1 (10 oz., about 40)  pkg. regular marshmallows or 4 c.  miniature marshmallows
6  c. Rice Krispies cereal
vegetable cooking spray
preparation: Melt margarine in large saucepan over low heat.  Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted.  Remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies cereal.  Stir until well coated.  Using buttered spatula or waxed paper, press mixture evenly into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan coated with cooking spray.  Cut into squares when cool. Yield:  24 treats, 2 x 2-inch squares.

name: AMAZING COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
2  c. milk
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. biscuit mix
4  eggs
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
preparation: Blend milk, sugar, biscuit mix, eggs, butter and vanilla in electric blender on low speed for 3 minutes.  Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan.  Let stand about 5 minutes; then sprinkle with coconut.  Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.  (Great way to have pie without having to make a pastry.)

name: SKILLET STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium sized onion
6  to 7 medium potatoes
2  cans carrots
1  can cream of celery soup
1  pkg. Cheddar cheese (optional)
preparation: Brown ground beef, drain.  Then top with onion, potatoes, carrots and celery soup (undiluted).  Simmer 40 to 50 minutes, covered, until  potatoes are done.  Top with soft cheese.

name: PARTY POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash brown potatoes
2  onions, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
4  oz. melted butter
6  oz. grated sharp cheese
10  oz. sour cream
crushed potato chips for topping
preparation: Let hash browns thaw completely.  Mix in order given.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered, in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

name: SAUCY MICROWAVE CAULIFLOWER
ingredients:
1  lb. head cauliflower
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. shredded cheese
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Remove leaves and woody stem from cauliflower.  Rinse clean. Wrap in wax paper.  Puncture paper.  Microwave on High for 10 minutes.  Unwrap.  Place in glass casserole.  Mix together remaining ingredients.  Pour over cauliflower.   Microwave, uncovered, for 1 minute.

name: CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. (12 to 15) chicken wings
3/4  c. Texas Pete hot sauce
1  stick margarine
preparation: Cut wings at all joints.  Throw away wing tips.  Place wings on paper towels until all water is absorbed.  Spread wings on sheet pan.  Bake at 450° for 45 minutes.

name: HOME PASTRY MIX
ingredients:
6  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  lb. shortening
preparation: This will keep in airtight can on shelf.  Put flour and salt into large bowl.  Cut in shortening until like peas.

name: CRANBERRY-PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
