1  c. cranberry juice cocktail
3  c. sliced peeled fresh or frozen peaches (6 medium)
1/4  c. fresh or frozen cranberries
preparation: In saucepan, combine sugar and cornstarch.  Stir in juice. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.  Stir in peaches and cranberries.  Cook, uncovered, until cranberry skins pop, about 5 minutes.

name: CARAMEL SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1 (1 lb.)  box brown sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour (all-purpose)
2  tsp. baking powder
dash of salt
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. chopped pecans
powdered sugar
preparation: Melt  margarine  and  sugar  in double boiler or on low heat. Add  eggs  and beat well. Add flour, baking powder, salt and vanilla.  Beat  until  smooth.  Stir in pecans. Pour into greased and  floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.  Let cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cut in small squares.

name: ICE CREAM COCOA ROLL
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. sifted flour
1/3  c. dry unsweetened cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  qt. ice cream (cherry or strawberry or your choice)
preparation: Grease 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan; line with wax paper; grease again.  Beat eggs with vanilla until thick and lemon colored.  Beat in sugar until mixture is thick and fluffy.  Sift remaining ingredients over egg mixture and fold in carefully.  Spread batter in pan.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.  Invert immediately on towel which has been dusted with powdered sugar.  Remove wax paper and roll end to end, towel and all.  Cool, unroll, remove from towel and spread with softened ice cream (your choice).  Re-roll, wrap in foil or plastic wrap and freeze.

name: CHEESY CORN BREAD *
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter, room temperature
1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  lb. can creamed corn
1/2  c. grated Monterey Jack cheese with jalapeno peppers
1/2  c. grated mild Cheddar cheese
1  c. sifted flour
1  c. yellow cornmeal
4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan.  Cream 1/2 cup butter with sugar in bowl until light and fluffy.  Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Mix in corn and cheeses. Sift together dry ingredients and add to corn mixture; blend well. Pour batter in pan; put in oven and reduce oven temperature to 300°.  Bake bread until golden brown and begins to pull away from sides of pan, about 55 minutes.

name: STUFFED CHEESE BREAD
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
2/3  c. ham, cubed small
2  Tbsp. green pepper, finely chopped
2  Tbsp. onion, finely chopped
3  Tbsp. milk
touch of garlic
4  Tbsp. softened butter
1  loaf French bread
4  oz. yellow cheese, cubed small
2  Tbsp. pimento, chopped
salt to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except French bread, well by hand.  Slice bread in half lengthwise.  Remove some bread from middle and spread with butter.  Put filling in middle of both halves of bread.  Put together.  Wrap tightly with Saran Wrap and foil. Refrigerate overnight.  Slice to serve.

name: MEXICAN STUFFED SHELLS
ingredients:
12  pasta stuffing shells, cooked and drained*
1  lb. ground beef
1  jar (16 oz.) medium or mild picante sauce
1/2  c. water
1  can (8 oz.) tomato sauce
1  can (4 oz.) chopped green chilies, drained
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1  can (2.8 oz.) Durkee French fried onions
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain.  Combine picante sauce, water and tomato sauce; stir 1/2 cup into ground beef along with chilies, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can French fried onions; mix well.  Pour half of remaining sauce mixture on bottom of 10-inch round or 8 x 12-inch baking dish.  Stuff cooked shells with ground beef mixture. Arrange shells in baking dish; pour remaining sauce over shells. Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onions.  Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.  (I have to double this recipe, because Doug can eat it all.)

name: HEART-SMART PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. oil
2  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Mix in pie pan.  Press around bottom and sides.  Bake at 350° until golden.

name: ENGLISH MONKEY(Mom's 1930)
ingredients:
1  c. bread crumbs
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. cheese, grated
1  egg
salt and pepper
preparation: Soak crumbs in milk; melt butter.  Add cheese and when cheese has melted, add soaked crumbs, egg (slightly beaten) and seasoning; cook 3 minutes.  Pour over cooked vegetables.  Reheats good.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
16  oz. sour cream
2  Tbsp. minced onion
2  tsp. parsley flakes
6  Tbsp. chili sauce
4  tsp. lemon juice
salt, to taste
pepper, to taste
shrimp, boiled and chopped
preparation: Add all together in bowl.  Chill and serve with chips or crackers.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  c. green apples, diced
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
3  eggs
1 1/4  c. cooking oil
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together and mix. Add apples and nuts. Mix well. Combine all other ingredients and add to dry mixture. Mix well. Grease and flour 9 x 12 cake pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: OATMEAL RAISIN COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  large egg
1 1/2  c. old-fashioned rolled oats
1  Tbsp. grated orange or lemon zest
1  c. raisins
preparation: Preheat oven to 400° and grease 2 cookie sheets.  In a medium bowl, mix together the flour, baking powder and salt.  In a large bowl using an electric beater set on medium speed, beat together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.  Beat in egg.  Reduce mixer to low and gradually beat in the flour mixture, oats and zest.  Drop dough by rounded tablespoonful onto the prepared cookie sheets spaced 2 inches apart.  Bake until golden brown, about 10 minutes.  Transfer to a wire rack to cool.  Repeat with remaining dough.  Let the sheets cool before adding the next batch.  This will stop the cookies from spreading during baking.

name: FAVORITE MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. breadcrumbs
1  egg
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/8  c. ketchup
1/8  c. milk
1/4  c. minced onions (optional)
1/8  c. green pepper (optional)
preparation: Mix together and put in greased loaf pan.  Spread more ketchup over top of meat loaf.  Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.

name: ROYAL DRUG STORE CHILE
ingredients:
5  lb. ground chuck
2  Tbsp. salt
3  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. black pepper
1  qt. tomato juice
preparation: Combine all ingredients and cook on low heat for 3 hours. Very good to freeze.

name: SEVEN LAYER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  stick melted margarine
6  oz. chocolate chips
6  oz. butterscotch chips (optional)
1  c. nuts
1  c. coconut
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Mix graham cracker crumbs and melted margarine to form a crust in a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Spread the remaining ingredients, except milk, in layers on top of crust.  Pour the Eagle Brand milk over layers.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: EASY FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick butter or margarine
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  can pie filling
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Melt butter in a 9 x 9-inch pan.  Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and milk together and pour into melted butter.  Do not stir.  Spoon pie filling into middle of dough mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until brown.

name: BAKED CORN
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1  can creamed corn
2  c. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Bake 1 hour in 375° oven or will be done when knife blade comes clean when tested in center.

name: SILVER WHITE CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. self-rising flour
1 2/3  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. milk
2/3  c. shortening
1  tsp. vanilla
5  egg whites
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Beat flour, sugar, milk, shortening and vanilla on low speed for 30 seconds, then on high speed for 2 minutes.  Beat in egg whites on high for 2 minutes.  Pour into pan (2 round or 1 sheet pan).  Bake layers for 30 to 35 minutes or sheet cake for 40 to 45 minutes.  Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan.

name: POPPY SEED CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts
1  can cream of chicken soup
8  oz. sour cream
1  sleeve Ritz crackers
1/2  stick melted margarine
1  Tbsp. poppy seed
preparation: Boil chicken and cut into chunks.  Mix with soup and sour cream.  Crush Ritz crackers; mix with margarine and poppy seed; spread on top of chicken mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes; you can prepare beforehand and refrigerate, then bake about 45 minutes.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
1  gallon water
5  lbs. potatoes, peeled and diced
1   lb. butter or margarine
2  Tbsp. chicken boulion powder
1  pint of half and half
2  cans cheddar cheese soup
1/2  cup flour
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Pour water in very large pot.  Add diced potatoes.  Cook until tender.  Do Not Drain - leave water with potatoes.  Add the soup and stir well.  In a separate pan, melt butter and add chicken boulion and flour.  When it becomes a paste consistency, pour this into pot with potatoes.  Add the half and half stirring well.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Serves 8 - 12 people.

name: CHICKEN 'N RICE
ingredients:
4  large pieces chicken breast
4  onion slices
8  Tbsp. Minute rice
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/3  c. sweet milk
preparation: You will need 4 (12-inch) squares aluminum foil.

name: BAKED PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
20  oz. can pineapple chunks, drain and reserve liquid
1  c. shredded cheese
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
3  Tbsp. pineapple juice
1/4  c. melted margarine
saltine crackers
preparation: Mix together sugar, flour and juice; pour over pineapple and cheese (9-inch glass dish).  Mix together margarine and cracker crumbs (enough crackers to make a thick oatmeal base) and spread on top of pineapple and cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve hot!

name: FISH SUPREME
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. halibut or white fish
1/2  c. mushrooms
1  c. bread crumbs
4  eggs
red pepper
1  pt. cream
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. Watkins pepper
onion seasoning
celery salt
preparation: Remove bones and skin of fish; pound.  Rub through a strainer. Cook bread crumbs and cream in a double boiler for 10 minutes. Add butter and seasoning.  When cold, add fish and beat thoroughly.  Add well-beaten eggs and place in buttered ring mold. Set mold in a deep pan with hot water to 1 inch of top.  Cover mold with wax paper.  Bake in a moderate oven for 45 minutes.

name: DREAM PIE
ingredients:
2  c. frozen strawberries
1  c. water
1  c. sugar
1  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
preparation: Bring strawberries and water to a boil.  Add sugar and stir. Add Jell-O and mix well.  Turn into pie pan or dish and chill until almost jelled.

name: EASY COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. carton cottage cheese (small curd)
1 (3 oz.)  box Jell-O (any flavor)
fruit, well drained
Cool Whip (small size)
fruit cocktail
Mandarin oranges
pineapple tidbits
miniature marshmallows
chopped nuts
coconut
preparation: If you use a lot of fruit, etc., use 6 ounce box of Jell-O.

name: JIM'S MICRO MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey or lean beef
1  egg white
1/3 to 1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/2  envelope instant onion soup mix
1 to 2  Tbsp. milk or water
salt and pepper
1/3  c. catsup
preparation: Spray loaf microwave dish with nonfat cooking spray.  In medium bowl, combine all ingredients, except catsup; mix well. Bread crumbs and liquid may be adjusted as liquid in meats vary. Shape into loaf and place in sprayed dish.  Cover completely with plastic wrap.  Cook at Medium-high for 14 to 16 minutes. (Note: This recipe is for a microwave that is 700 watts on High. You may have to adjust your oven.)

name: JELLY ROLL
ingredients:
3  large eggs
1  c. sugar
5  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
soft jelly or lemon or chocolate pie mix
preparation: Grease and flour a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jelly roll pan.  Line with greased waxed paper.  Turn up edges to make proper size in pan.  Beat eggs and sugar together.  Add water and beat all at once.  Add vanilla.  Sift dry ingredients and add to mixture, beating just until smooth (don't overbeat).  Pour into prepared pan and bake in a preheated oven at 375° for approximately 20 minutes or just until done (don't overbake).  When done, loosen edges and immediately turn upside down on a towel sprinkled with powdered sugar.  Remove paper quickly by pulling off.  Spread with jelly and roll up.  Wrap in the towel and cool approximately 1/2 hour.

name: CHEESY BEEF PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  tsp. cornstarch
1 (10 oz.)  can Old El Paso mild enchilada sauce
1/4  c. snipped parsley
1 (3 oz.)  can chopped mushrooms, drained
2  pkg. refrigerated crescent rolls
3  eggs
6  slices sharp American cheese
preparation: In skillet, brown beef and onion; drain.  Sprinkle meat with cornstarch; blend in.  Stir in parsley, mushrooms and enchilada sauce.  Unroll 1 package of rolls and place the 4 sections of dough together, forming a 12 x 6-inch rectangle.  Seal edges together.  Roll into a 12-inch square.  Fit into a 9-inch pie plate; trim edge even with plate.  Separate one of the eggs; set yolk aside.  Beat egg white with remaining 2 eggs; spread half over dough.

name: CHOCOLATE ZUCCHINI CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. shredded, unpeeled zucchini
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk (sour)
1/4  c. unsweetened cocoa
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
1/2  c. chocolate bits
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream margarine, oil and sugar.  Add eggs, vanilla and sour milk; blend thoroughly.  Combine dry ingredients and blend into creamed mixture.  Stir in zucchini.  Spoon into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan; sprinkle chocolate bits and nuts over top.  Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes or until done.

name: OATMEAL CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. hot water
1  c. uncooked quick oats
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Add hot water to oats and let stand while mixing other ingredients.  Cream together the margarine, brown sugar and white sugar.  Add eggs.  Combine flour, soda and cinnamon and add to sugar mixture; add oatmeal mixture and blend.  Pour batter into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes. Add topping. Serves 12 to 15.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/3  c. Hershey's cocoa
1/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. margarine, melted
3  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  can sweetened condensed milk
3  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. mini semi-sweet chips
1  tsp. flour
preparation: Heat oven to 300°.  In bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs, cocoa, sugar and butter.  Press evenly onto bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan.  In a large mixer bowl, beat the cream cheese until fluffy.  Gradually add sweetened condensed milk, beating until smooth.  Add eggs and vanilla; mix well.  In a small bowl, toss 1/2 cup mini chips with flour to coat; stir into cheese mixture.  Pour into prepared pan.  Sprinkle remaining chips over top.  Bake for 1 hour.  Turn off oven; allow to cool in oven 1 hour.  Remove from oven; cool to room temperature.  Refrigerate before serving.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  large onion, chopped
1  large green pepper, chopped (if desired)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can golden mushroom soup
1  can cream of onion soup
1  bag egg noodles
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown hamburger, onions and green peppers (drain fat).  In large bowl, mix together all soups well.  Pour into skillet.  Let simmer until hot.  Cook noodles by directions on package.  Drain noodles.  Serve hamburger mixture over noodles.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1  c. (2 sticks) unsalted butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  large whole eggs
2  egg yolks
3 1/3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  c. broken pecans
ground nutmeg and sugar (for sprinkling)
preparation: Cream butter with sugar until light and fluffy in medium-sized bowl.  Beat in whole eggs and yolks.  Sift flour with baking soda and nutmeg.  Add to batter.  Fold in nuts.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour but not longer than overnight.  Roll into teaspoon-sized balls and place on buttered cookie sheet.  Gently flatten with bottom of glass dipped in sprinkling mixture, then lightly sift additional mixture over each cookie with spoon.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until bottoms are lightly done, not brown.  Remove from cookie sheet while still warm and cool on wax paper-covered rack.  Store in airtight container with a couple pieces of bread in the bottom.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed
1  c. mayonnaise
1  red bell pepper, chopped
1 (1 2/5 oz.)  pkg. vegetable soup mix
2 (6 oz.)  cans water chestnuts, drained
1/4  c. chopped onion
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
chopped fresh dill weed or crumbled dry dill weed to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients and chill.  Nice in hollowed out head of red cabbage.

name: SALLY O'BRIEN'S PEACH DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
5  to 6 fresh peaches
1  c. flour
1/2  c. Crisco
1/4  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
3  c. sugar
3  c. water
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  stick butter
couple drops red food coloring
preparation: Mix flour, Crisco, milk and salt.  Roll dough thin.  Put sliced peaches in center and fold like rectangle.  Bring remaining ingredients to a boil and cook 10 minutes, possibly 15.  Bake in a pan at 350° or 375° for 30 to 45 minutes or until golden brown.

name: ORANGE-PINEAPPLE SHERBET(Club Member: Clint Hudson)
ingredients:
24  oz. Nehi orange drink
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1 small  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix all ingredients and freeze in ice tray.

name: HAM AND CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  c. ham, chopped
1  c. grated cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  (9-inch) pie shells (unbaked)
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add milk, ham, salt and pepper.  Pour into 2 unbaked 9-inch pie shells.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Other ingredients may be added, such as peppers, mushrooms, bacon, etc.  Makes 2 pies.

name: ITALIAN VEGETABLES PACKET
ingredients:
1  small onion, thinly sliced
4  medium zucchini or yellow squash, sliced
1  medium tomato, cut in wedges
1/2  c. Kraft Zesty Italian dressing
preparation: You will also need 1 sheet (18 x 24-inch) Reynolds wrap heavy duty aluminum foil.

name: FLOUR TORTILLAS
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. coconut milk or other milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Add milk gradually and blend until smooth.  Knead dough for 2 minutes.  Divide dough into 4 pieces. Take one section and roll out to a round shape about 8 1/2 inches in diameter.  If thin tortillas are desired, divide into 5 pieces.

name: E-Z PANCAKES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
6  Tbsp. oil
1  egg
1/4  c. water plus 1/4 c. cream
preparation: Mix this all together and if batter needs to be thinner, add more cream and water.  Cook at 375° on electric griddle.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE(Delicious)
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. cooking oil
2  eggs
4  c. diced apples
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. raisins
3  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. allspice
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Blend together the sugar, oil and eggs.  Add the apples, nuts and raisins.  Add the remaining ingredients.  Bake in oblong 13 x 9-inch pan for 1 hour at 325° to 350°.  Can be baked in 6 small pans at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: PIGS IN BLANKET(Quick)
ingredients:
1  small head cabbage, chopped
1  lb. ground beef, browned
1/2  c. chopped onion, browned
1/2  c. rice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  can tomato soup
1 1/2  c. water
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. In saucepan, mix soup and water; bring to a boil.   Spread cabbage, meat and rice in dish; mix.   Pour soup mixture over mixture.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Top with cheese.   Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.   Cover tightly with foil.

name: PICNIC DELIGHT
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter or shortening
1  egg
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.  Cream 1/2 cup butter.  Add 1 cup sugar; mix well.  Add egg; beat 1 minute. Combine buttermilk and vanilla; add alternately with dry ingredients to the cream mixture, beginning and ending with dry ingredients.  Mix thoroughly after each addition.  Add marshmallows and chocolate chips.  Spread in greased, floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Combine brown sugar, 2 tablespoons butter and nuts. Sprinkle over the batter.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. milk
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2 or 3  slices bread
sprinkle of cinnamon
preparation: Beat together milk, eggs, sugar and vanilla.  Pour into small baking dish.  Place bread slices on top; sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350° about 45 minutes, until knife comes out clean when placed in center.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can crescent rolls
1  pkg sausage
1  pkg hashbrowns
6  eggs
Salt & pepper to taste
1/2  c milk
1  cup grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Lay out on bottom of pan the rolls.  Pour over rolls the sausage that has been cooked and drained.  Sprinkle the hash browns over sausage.  Beat 6 eggs, salt and pepper and 1/2 c milk and pour over hash browns.  Top with grated Cheddar cheese.  Bake at 400° until brown.

name: HAMBURGER-VEGGIE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  tsp. each:  marjoram, rosemary, savory and thyme
1/2  tsp. fennel seed
1/2  tsp. pepper
garlic to taste
1  medium onion
2  medium potatoes, cubed
2  carrots, diced
1  can corn, drained
1  can green beans
1  bouillon beef cube
preparation: In Dutch oven pan, fry hamburger in two tablespoons butter and all seasonings, garlic, bouillon cube and onion.  Don't drain.  In same pan, add 8 cups water, potatoes and carrots.  Put lid on and boil until veggies are tender.  Add corn and beans; cook until warm.  Serve.  The fennel seed add a sweetness to the flavor of the soup.

name: CHOCOLATE PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
3/4  c. Toll House semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. white corn syrup
4  eggs, lightly beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. pecan halves
1  unbaked 9-inch pie shell
preparation: Melt butter with chocolate.  Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Pour filling into 9-inch unbaked pastry shell.  Bake in 350° oven for 50 minutes.  Cool completely before cutting.

name: BROCCOLI MUSHROOM CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. Kraft jalapeno cheese
1  small container frozen chopped broccoli
8  oz. Green Giant sliced mushrooms
1  small onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
3  Tbsp. butter
tortilla chips
preparation: In large skillet saute onions in butter.  After onions are thoroughly cooked, add mushrooms, cream of mushroom soup, broccoli and cheese.  Stir and simmer until cheese melts and broccoli is no longer frozen.  Serve warm with chips.

name: SNOWBALL CAKE
ingredients:
2  envelopes unflavored gelatin
4  Tbsp. cold water
1/2  c. sugar
1 large  can crushed pineapple and juice
1  c. boiling water
3 small  pkg. dessert topping mix or use Cool Whip
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  large angel food cake, torn into 1-inch pieces
1  can shredded coconut
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in cold water.  Add hot water.  Add to sugar, lemon juice and pineapple.  Chill until thickened.  Prepare 2 packages dessert topping mix according to directions on package (or use Cool Whip).  Fold into pineapple gelatin mixture.

name: QUICK GARLIC BEAN DIP
ingredients:
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1 (16 oz.)  can garbanzo beans, drained
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1 1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  clove garlic, crushed
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: In food processor, combine all ingredients.  Process 1 minute or until smooth, scraping bowl twice.  Makes 1 1/2 cups.

name: APPLE SALAD
ingredients:
10  to 12 apples, cut in chunks (leave peel on a few to give color)
1  can pineapple, (chunks or tidbits), drained
1/2  lb. mild cheese in bite-size pieces
1/2  box raisins
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients together and make sauce.  Mix sugar and flour with juice from pineapple.  Boil until thick.  Let cool and mix with fruit.

name: COWBOY BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  c. ketchup
1  tsp. mustard
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. sugar
1  onion, chopped
1  lb. ground chuck
1  can pork and beans
1  can navy beans
2  cans pinto beans
preparation: Brown and drain ground chuck.  In large pot, combine all ingredients; bring to a boil and simmer.

name: SYLVIA'S OLD FASHIONED POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3  c. plain flour, unsifted
4  eggs
1  c. milk
2  sticks butter
1/2  c. Crisco
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. flavoring (vanilla, lemon or almond)
preparation: Mix dry ingredients together in separate bowl. Cream the butter and Crisco. Add eggs, then add milk. Alternate milk mixture with dry mixture. Add flavoring.  Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Place in cold oven. Bake at 325° to 350° (ovens vary) for 1 hour and 15 minutes to 1 hour and 30 minutes until straw inserted in middle comes out clean.

name: SOUTH OF THE BORDER CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  boneless chicken breasts, cooked and diced
2  ripe tomatoes, diced
1  small red onion, diced
1  large jicama, diced (Mexican potato)
1  bunch fresh cilantro, chopped
1  lime, juiced
1  avocado, peeled, seeded, and sliced
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In large bowl, combine chicken, tomatoes, red onion, jicama, cilantro and lime juice. Toss together well.  Garnish with slices of avocado, season with salt and pepper and serve immediately.

name: YORKSHIRE TRIFLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jell-O (any flavor)
1  can fruit
2  fruit swirls, cut in half
1  pt. vanilla pudding
1  pt. heavy cream
sprinkles
preparation: Dissolve the Jell-O, place fruit in deep dish and cover with fruit swirls.  Then pour the Jell-O over fruit and fruit swirls (when set).  Pour vanilla pudding on top.  Whip heavy cream and place on top, then cover with sprinkles and keep refrigerated. Serves 6 to 8.

name: FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. onions, cut into thin slices
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. oil
2  Tbsp. flour
4  c. beef stock
1  c. water
1/2  loaf French bread
1/2  lb. cheese (your choice), grated
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: In Dutch oven, heat margarine and oil over medium heat.  Add onions, salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft, about 10 minutes. Reduce to low, stirring occasionally, until onions are caramelized.  This should take about 1 hour and 15 minutes. Stir flour into onions.  Bring to a bubble. Cook about 3 minutes.  Slowly stir in beef stock and water. Simmer, partially covered, for 15 minutes.  Heat oven to 325°. Cut French bread into 4 slices.  Bake until dry, about 6 minutes each side.  Heat broiler.  Pour soup into heatproof serving bowl.  Put 1 slice of bread into each bowl and top with cheese.  Broil until golden brown, about 2 to 3 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1/2  c. raisins
1  c. granola
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. powdered milk
preparation: Mix them all together and then add 2 cups peanut butter.  Mix all that together and then roll little meatball size balls into sesame seed or coconut.  Then put them into the refrigerator.

name: JESSE STUART'S CHEESE STEW
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter
3  stalks celery, chopped, including leaves
3 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans chicken broth
3  grated onions
3  grated carrots
1  oz. (3 slices) American cheese
8  oz. sour cream
preparation: Mix all ingredients except cheese.  Stir in chopped parsley, coarse pepper and bottled hot sauce to taste.  Simmer 30 minutes. Drop in cheese and stir until it melts.    Serves 10 to 12 people.

name: 5 CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. miniature marshmallows
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  carton sour cream
1  can mandarin oranges
1  can thin flaked coconut
preparation: Drain all fruits  and  mix  with  remaining ingredients. Chill.

name: ELEPHANT STEW
ingredients:
1  medium size elephant
salt and pepper to taste
2  rabbits (optional)
brown gravy (lots)
preparation: Cut elephant into bite-size pieces (this will take about 2 months).  Add enough gravy to cover.  Cook over kerosene fire at 450° for 4 weeks.  This will serve 3800 people.  If more are expected, add the 2 rabbits, but do this only if necessary for most people don't like to find hare in their stew!

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
1/4  c. chopped onions
1/4  c. chopped bell peppers
2  c. chopped nuts (roll in 1 c.)
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can crushed drained pineapple
1/4  tsp. seasoned salt
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients  except  1 cup nuts.  Make into a ball and roll in rest of nuts.  Chill and serve with crackers.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. peanut butter
4  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. milk
8  oz. whipped topping
1  pie crust (graham cracker)
preparation: Cream the cream cheese, sugar and peanut butter.  Stir in milk and whole container Cool Whip.  Put in pie crust.  Freeze 4 to 6 hours.  Top with crushed peanuts or grated chocolate.

name: OUR YUM YUM SALAD
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1 large  can crushed pineapple (do not drain)
1  can cherry pie filling
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. pecans, chopped
1  c. frozen blueberries
preparation: Note:  If canned blueberries are used drain well.

name: BLACK-EYED PEA JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
1  large onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
2  pods garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. bacon grease
2  cans black-eyed peas with jalapeno
4  c. cooked rice
1  lb. cooked ham or cooked sausage, cubed
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Saute onions, pepper and garlic in bacon grease.  After 10 minutes, add black-eyed peas and simmer 1/2 hour.  Mix rice, peas and meat together.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
1  c. corn oil
2  eggs
3 1/2  c. canned pumpkin
2  tsp. vanilla
5  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
4  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. raisins
1  c. pecans
preparation: Beat sugar, eggs, oil, pumpkin and vanilla.  Add dry ingredients.  Add raisins and pecans; mix well.  Pour into greased loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Reduce heat to 250° and bake 20 minutes.  Chill overnight before slicing.  Makes 3 loaves.

name: CHEESY-BACON-BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  large baking potatoes
4  slices bacon
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/3  c. diced green pepper
2  c. sliced mushrooms
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese, divided
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Scrub potatoes.  Pat dry.  Pierce with a fork.  Bake at 425° for 55 to 65 minutes or until soft.  Meanwhile, saute bacon in a skillet until brown.  Cool and crumble.  In 2 tablespoons of bacon drippings, cook onions and green pepper until still tender-crisp. Add mushrooms.  Continue sauteing until mushrooms are cooked.  Set aside.

name: DUTCH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter or vegetable shortening
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3  apples, pared and sliced
cinnamon
preparation: Cream butter with 7/8 cup of sugar.  Add well beaten egg, then the milk and vanilla.  Mix the dry ingredients together and add alternately to the milk mixture, beating thoroughly.

name: HOT SPICED PERCOLATOR PUNCH
ingredients:
3  c. unsweetened pineapple juice
3  c. cranberry juice cocktail
1 1/2  c. water
1/3  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  tsp. whole cloves
1  stick cinnamon, broken
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine all ingredients except cloves, cinnamon and salt in percolator.  Place cloves, cinnamon and salt in basket.  Allow to go through perk cycle.  Serve piping hot.  Yields 10 cups.

name: EGG SALAD SANDWICH
ingredients:
2  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
2  Tbsp. sweet pickle relish
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
salt to taste
preparation: Flaked tuna or salmon, sweet pickle, chopped celery and mayonnaise.

name: MEATBALL STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1  egg
1  slice white bread coarsely crumbed
1/2  tsp. salt with dash pepper
1  can Campbell's Cream of Mushroom Soup
1/2  c. sour cream
1/3  c. water
3  c. cooked noodles
preparation: Mix ground beef, onion, egg, bread, salt, and pepper.  Makes about 16 meatballs.  Brown in skillet, pour off fat.  Blend in soup, sour cream, water.  Cover, simmer 10 minutes.  Stir now and then.  Serve over noodles.  (3 to 4 servings.)

name: SHRIMP CURRY
ingredients:
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream (evaporated milk)
1  can water (use cream can)
2  Tbsp. curry powder
1  lb. shrimp (raw)
6  to 8 hard-boiled eggs, cooled and chopped
preparation: Boil shrimp in water until pink; drain and set aside to cool. In large pot, mix cream of mushroom  soup, cream, water and curry. Peel shells off shrimp; cut into bite size pieces. Add  to  pot. Bring to slow boil for 1/2 hour.  Add  eggs  to pot.  Turn off heat; let sit until ready to eat.  Serve hot.

name: CHICKEN AND SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  chicken, cooked, skinned and chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
4  celery ribs, chopped
1  can tomatoes
salt
pepper
Italian seasoning
bay leaf
1/2  pkg. spaghetti (1 lb. size)
preparation: Cook chicken and save broth.  Remove chicken to cool in order to remove skin and chop.  Add the rest of ingredients to broth. Simmer until done.  Add chicken and uncooked spaghetti.  Cook until spaghetti is done.

name: OKRA PATTIES
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh okra or 1 (8 oz.) frozen cut okra
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  egg
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. corn meal
oil
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Combine cut okra, onion, salt, pepper, water and egg. Mix well. Combine flour, baking powder, meal and garlic powder. Add to okra mixture. Stir well. Make into patties, then fry in 1/2-inch hot oil over medium heat until brown on both sides. Drain on paper towels.

name: CHOCOLATE ZUCCHINI CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. butter or Crisco oil
2  eggs
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. buttermilk or sour milk
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2 1/2  c. flour
5  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. chocolate chips
2  c. grated zucchini
preparation: Cream all shortening.  Add spices, soda, baking powder and eggs.  Gradually add flour, buttermilk and remaining ingredients. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan and bake at 400° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: SKILLET TURKEY CHILI
ingredients:
2  slices bacon, cut in 1/2-inch pieces
1  large onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic, crushed
2  c. bite size cooked turkey
1 to 2  tsp. chili powder
1 (14 oz.)  can Mexican-style stewed tomatoes
1 (15 oz.)  can kidney or black beans
preparation: In a large skillet, cook bacon until crisp.  Remove and drain skillet.  Put onion and garlic in skillet and cook until tender. Add turkey and chili powder. Cook 5 minutes.   Stir occasionally. Add tomatoes and bring to a boil. Stir in bacon and beans. Reduce heat and simmer 5 or more minutes.

name: BEEF AND ONION CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
3  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 small  jar dried beef, chopped
1  bundle green onions, chopped
4  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. Accent
dash of hot sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Put in refrigerator to firm up. Make into a ball and roll in pecans.

name: PULL APARTS
ingredients:
1/2  c. nuts
1  pkg. frozen dinner rolls (24)
1  pkg. butterscotch pudding (small box, not instant)
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  stick melted butter
1/4  c. white sugar
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Place in bottom of Bundt pan the nuts and frozen dinner rolls. Mix brown sugar and butterscotch pudding together (do not cook). Sprinkle over rolls.  Pour over melted butter and then sprinkle the white sugar and cinnamon over butter.  Cover with cloth and let stand 8 hours to rise.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes in pan.  Serve.

name: BEEF AND BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
16  oz. can pork and beans, drained
1/2  c. ketchup
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. Tabasco
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Brown beef with onion and bell pepper.  Drain well.  In a bowl, combine the remaining ingredients with the cooked beef. Pour into a casserole dish and bake at 350 for 30 minutes.  Let sit 10 to 15 minutes after taking out of the oven before serving.

name: HOT DOG STEW
ingredients:
frankfurters, kielbasa, bratwurst, andouille or other sausage
2  onions, chopped finely
paprika
garlic
green pepper
tomato
pepper
potatoes, peeled and quartered
preparation: This is sort of a poor man's goulash, something quick and dirty that doesn't take much time but is pretty good and a lot of fun as well.

name: COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box butter flavor cake mix
1 1/2  c. granulated sugar (add to icing)
1  c. sour cream
2  pkg. frozen coconut
1 1/2  c. Cool Whip
preparation: Cook 2 layers and cut to make 4 layers.

name: JELLO LEMON CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow or white cake mix
1  pkg. lemon jello
3/4  c. Wesson oil
3/4  c. apricot nectar
4  eggs
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
preparation: (No water.)

name: CHOCOLATE OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. butter
2  c. sugar
2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking soda
1  (8 oz.) Hershey bar, grated
4  c. flour
5  c. oatmeal (put in blender until it turns to powder)
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
24  oz. chocolate chips
3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and brown sugar.  Add eggs and vanilla.  In separate container, mix together flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder and baking soda.  Mix together all ingredients, then add to first mixture.  Add chocolate chips, Hershey bar and chopped nuts. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet.  Make golf ball sized cookies. Bake at 275° until light brown.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  lb. shredded hash brown potatoes
8  oz. diced onion
8  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
8  oz. shredded American cheese
1 (20 oz.)  can Campbell's cream of chicken soup
16  oz. sour cream
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine all ingredients in large bowl; stir well. Spoon into a greased 9 x 13 baking dish; spread out evenly. Bake for 40 minutes or until top is golden brown and bubbly.

name: IMPOSSIBLE ZUCCHINI QUICHE
ingredients:
2  c. chopped zucchini
1  c. tomatoes
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
a sprinkle of oregano, basil and parsley (optional)
pepper to taste
1 1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. Bisquick mix
3  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Lightly grease a 10-inch pie plate.  Mix the veggies, cheese and spices together and put in the plate.  In blender, mix the milk, Bisquick mix and eggs and blend until well mixed.  Pour over the veggies and stir gently.  Bake for 30 minutes or until a silver knife comes out pretty clean when inserted 1-inch from the edge.  Cool slightly and serve.  Good with a tossed salad and a crispy homemade bread.

name: DARN GOOD CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  package plain devil's food or dark chocolate fudge cake mix
1  package (3.9 oz) chocolate instant pudding mix
4  large eggs
1  cup sour cream
1/2  cup warm water
1/2  cup vegetable oil, such as canola, safflower, soybean, or sunflower
1  1/2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
preparation: Place a rack in the center of the oven and preheat the oven to 350°, mist a 12 cup bundt pan with vegetable oil spray and then dust with flour, shake out the excess flour.  Set pan aside.  Place the cake mix, pudding mix, sour cream, warm water and oil in a mixing bowl. Blend with an electric mixer at slow speed for 1 minute.  Stop the mixer and scrape down the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula. Increase the speed to medium and beat 2 to 3 more minutes. Add the 4 eggs and then mix an additional 2 minutes, scraping the sides of the bowl as needed.  Then fold in your chocolate chips.  Make sure they are dispersed throughout the batter.  Pour the batter into the bundt pan and place into the oven.  Bake cake until it springs back when pressed with your finger and it pulls away from the sides (usually 45 to 50 minutes). Cool cake for approximately 20 minutes. Run a long knife around the edge of the cake, invert it onto a cooling rack and allow it to continue to cool for approx. 20 minutes.  It is good when served warm.

name: EUROPEAN CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
7  oz. bittersweet chocolate (European chocolate)
5  oz. unsalted butter
5  egg whites and 5 egg yolks
2/3  c. granulated sugar
1/4  c. almonds, ground very fine (use toasted blanched almonds)
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Grate or shave the chocolate so that it will melt uniformly. Melt butter until fully melted and very hot, then stir in the chocolate and continue to stir until the chocolate is melted. Whisk sugar and egg yolks together until light and then whisk into the chocolate/butter mixture until smooth.  Then whisk in flours and continue to whisk until batter is smooth.  Beat egg whites until they hold a stiff peak.  Briskly stir 2 heaping tablespoonfuls of beaten egg white into your chocolate mixture, then fold in remaining.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes in a 9-inch Bundt pan.

name: ODDS AND ENDS CEREAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. shortening (oleo)
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
4  tsp. baking powder
2 3/4  c. flour
2  c. cereal (flakes)
2  c. quick oats
preparation: Mix in order of ingredients.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

name: CHICKEN DEVON
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked
2  c. cooked chicken, sliced
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. curry powder (optional)
1/2  c. grated yellow cheese
1/2  c. soft buttered bread crumbs or croutons
preparation: Put broccoli in shallow rectangle baking dish.  Cover with chicken.  Combine soups, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder and pour over chicken.  Sprinkle with cheese and top with bread crumbs or croutons.  Bake in oven at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through.  (If prepared earlier and frozen, bake 1 hour or more.)

name: BEEF OR CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
12  corn tortillas
1  onion, chopped
1/2  lb. grated cheese or cooked (ground or shredded) beef
hot salad oil (or chicken broth for fewer calories)
preparation: Dip tortillas in and out of oil (or broth) to soften; drain on paper towel.  Dip tortillas in Enchilada Sauce.  Place cheese and onion in center.  Roll up and place in baking dish.  Top with remaining sauce and grated cheese.  Heat at 350° for about 15 minutes or until cheese melts.

name: REFRIGERATED BLUEBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
9  oz. Cool Whip
4  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  pt. blueberries
2  pie shells (graham cracker crusts)
preparation: Mix and pour in pie shells.  Refrigerate.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
3  large bananas, mashed
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. margarine
2  c. whole wheat flour
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
3/4  c. raisins
1/4  c. chopped dates
preparation: Put bananas in large mixing bowl.  Add eggs, vanilla and margarine.  Sift together flour, salt, sugar, soda, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Add to banana mixture and mix well.  Stir in raisins and dates.  Pour entire mixture into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch bread pan.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.  Cool and serve.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. zucchini, sliced thin
1 1/2  c. Bisquick
3/4  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. Parmesan cheese
3  Tbsp. chopped parsley
3/4  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. seasoned salt
pepper to taste
garlic salt to taste
3/4  c. vegetable oil
6  eggs, beaten slightly
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

name: GINGER CRINKLES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. molasses
2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
2/3  c. oil
1  egg
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ginger
1/4  c. sugar (to roll cookies in)
preparation: Combine ingredients in order listed.  Roll dough into balls, then in sugar.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: APPLE PIZZA PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. powdered dairy creamer
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
1/3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  c. oleo
6  c. peeled apples, sliced 1/2-inch thick
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Combine creamer, sugars, flour, salt and spices in bowl.  Mix well.  Sprinkle 1/2 mixture over pastry.  Cut butter into remaining mixture until crumbly.  Set aside.  Arrange apples in rings, overlapping.  Sprinkle with lemon juice.  Top with crumbly mixture.  Bake at 450° for 30 minutes.

name: COUNTRY CLUB PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1 (2 1/2 lb.)  can pumpkin
1 1/2  c. light brown sugar
2  Tbsp. dark molasses
3/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. salt
4  eggs, well beaten
3  Tbsp. melted butter
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  c. Pet milk
preparation: Combine ingredients; pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake in hot oven (450°) for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to 325° to 350° for 30 minutes, or until knife inserted comes out clean.

name: CARROT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. oil
4  eggs
3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  c. grated carrots
1/2  c. finely chopped walnuts
preparation: Combine sugar and oil; blend thoroughly.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Mix flour, baking powder, soda and salt together; add to egg mixture.  Stir in carrots and nuts.  Spread batter in 2 greased 8 x 4 x 3-inch loaf pans.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

name: "TSOUREKIA" - EASTER BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. butter
1  Tbsp. salt
3  small cubes frozen yeast
8  eggs, well beaten
approximately 3 lb. flour
sesame seed
1  tsp. grated orange peel
1  tsp. grated lemon peel
preparation: In large saucepan, warm milk.  When milk is warm, add salt, yeast and 1 1/2 cups flour.  Stir until yeast is melted.  Put aside and let rise for 1 hour.  When 1 hour is up, add the eggs, sugar, melted butter, lemon and orange peels.  Stir in well with hand, not mixer.  When everything is mixed in, begin adding flour slowly until it makes a soft nonsticky dough.  Knead well.  Put aside to rise 3 to 4 hours.  When well risen, knead again.  Shape into braids or loaves.

name: DISHPAN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
2  c. white sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. corn oil
4  eggs
4  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. quick oats
4  c. corn flakes
preparation: Cream together sugars, vanilla, oil and eggs.  Add flour, soda and salt into first mixture.  Fold in oats and then corn flakes. Drop onto cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 7 to 8 minutes or until light brown.  Makes a dishpan full.  Good to freeze and serve later.

name: HEATH BAR CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
1/2  jar caramel ice cream topping
8  oz. container Cool Whip
1  Heath bar
preparation: Bake cake according to directions on box. Remove from oven. While hot, punch holes in cake with straw. Pour onto hot cake the Eagle Brand milk and ice cream topping. Let cool. Cover with Cool Whip and garnish with crushed Heath bar.

name: SPANISH OLIVE SALAD
ingredients:
1  jar Spanish olives
6  sticks celery
oregano to taste
1  medium onion, diced
oil
preparation: Rinse olives and slice in half.  Chop celery and add to olives.  Sprinkle with oregano.  Add onion and oil.

name: FRIED RICE
ingredients:
2 to 3  c. rice
2  to 4 pieces chopped bacon
1/2  c. chopped beef, pork or chicken
2  eggs
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1 1/2  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: Fry bacon until brown.  Add chopped ingredients and fry 2 to 3 minutes.  Add rice.  Cook 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally. Mix eggs and soy sauce in bowl.  Pour over rice and stir until cooked.

name: FRIED GREEN TOMATOES
ingredients:
3  green tomatoes, sliced
2  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. oil
1 1/2  c. cracker crumbs
preparation: Dip green tomato slices in egg, then coat with cracker crumbs. Fry in hot oil until golden brown.  Turning so both sides are crispy.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
1  pkg. taco seasoning
4  tomatoes, chopped
2  green peppers, chopped
1  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  large bag Doritos (nacho cheese)
1  large Catalina French dressing
preparation: Brown meat.  Drain grease and add taco seasoning and water according to seasoning package.  Let cool.  Add chopped tomatoes, peppers and cheese.  Refrigerate.  Before serving, add crushed Doritos and Catalina dressing and mix it all together.

name: BURNT SUGAR PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
2  egg yolks
1/2  c. white sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
preparation: Brown 1/2 cup white sugar.  Add 1/2 cup hot water.  Let stand on warm covered until all the sugar and water is dissolved.  Cook until thick.  Remove from stove.  Add 2 tablespoons butter.  Pour into baked crust.  Cover with meringue made from 2 egg whites and 2 tablespoons sugar.

name: OLD SETTLERS BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. hamburger
1/2  lb. ham
1  onion
1  can kidney beans, pork and beans, butter beans
1/3  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. barbecue sauce
1/4  c. ketchup
1  tsp. chili powder
1  Tbsp. ground mustard
2  Tbsp. molasses
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and let simmer at least 1 hour.

name: SEAFOOD NEWBURG
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. half and half (substitute nondairy creamer for low-fat)
2  eggs
3/4 to 1  lb. imitation crab meat or combination of cooked shrimp, scallops and canned clams to equal 3/4 to 1 lb.
3  Tbsp. white wine (alcohol cooks off)
2  tsp. lemon juice
sprinkle of paprika for color (garnish)
preparation: Melt margarine in nonstick skillet.  Mix half and half or creamer with flour.  Pour into skillet and stir constantly over medium heat until thickened.  Beat eggs and small amount of white sauce from skillet with eggs to temper.  Then add eggs to skillet and stir until blended and smooth.  Add seafood and heat through. Add wine and lemon juice and sprinkle with paprika.  Serve over rice or toast.

name: EVELYN HARLOW'S BRUNCH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk pork sausage
8  oz. can refrigerated crescent rolls
2  c. Mozzarella cheese, grated
4  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. milk
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Crumble sausage in skillet; cook and stir over medium heat until brown.  Drain well.  Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish with rolls, firming, pressing perforations to seal.  Sprinkle with sausage, then cheese.  Combine and beat remaining ingredients; pour over sausage and cheese.  Bake 15 minutes at 425°.  Let stand 15 minutes.  Cut into squares and serve immediately.  Good served with fruit salad and blueberry muffins.

name: FRESH PEACH GLACE PIE
ingredients:
3  lb. peaches, peeled and sliced
3/4  c. water
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  (8 or 9-inch) baked crust
preparation: Simmer 1 cup peaches with the water for 4 to 5 minutes. Combine sugar and cornstarch and add to cooked fruit.  Cook until thick and clear, stirring constantly.  Add lemon juice.  Cool slightly.  Put remaining fresh peaches in the baked pie shell. Pour glace over the fruit and cool.  Serve with whipped cream. Serves 6.

name: NUT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. granulated sugar
1  pt. cream
1/2  pt. light Karo syrup
1  lb. chopped pecans
2  c. brown sugar
1  c. shortening
2  beaten eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. quick Quaker oats
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. raisins or more to taste
1  c. walnuts, chopped coarse or more to taste
1  unbaked pie crust
1  c. chopped pecans
4  oz. cream cheese
2  c. powdered sugar
6  oz. Cool Whip
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1 (16 oz.)  can blueberry pie filling or 1/2 following recipe
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place pecans in the bottom of pie crust; bake until crust is golden brown.  Cool completely.  Beat cream cheese with sugar until smooth.  Fold in Cool Whip and vanilla extract.  (You may substitute 3/4 cup heavy cream, whipped with 1 cup powdered sugar, then mix in 6 ounces cream cheese until smooth.)  Pour mixture over cooled crust and level.  Top cream layer with blueberry pie filling.  Chill and serve.

name: BUSY DAY CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  c. Mahatma long grain rice
1  fryer, cut into serving pieces
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 1/2  c. water
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
preparation: Scatter uncooked rice on bottom of a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Lay chicken, skin side up, on top of rice. Combine mushroom soup and onion soup mix. Pour over chicken. Bake at 325° for about 2 hours. Makes about 6 servings.

name: JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
2 small  boxes strawberry Jell-O (sugar-free)
1 large  can unsweetened, crushed pineapple, drained
1 large  carton low-fat cottage cheese
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix well in order given.  Chill overnight or for several hours, covered, in refrigerator.

name: EASY BROCCOLI CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cheddar cheese soup
2 soup  cans whole milk
2  c. broccoli, cooked, drained and chopped
1  stick butter
Pepper to taste
preparation: Mix ingredients together. Heat and serve.

name: Grape Syrup
ingredients:
6  oz. frozen unsweetened grape juice concentrate
12  oz. frozen unsweetened apple juice concentrate
2  Tbsp. unbleached flour
3  Tbsp. distilled water
preparation: Put grape and apple juice concentrate into a pan and bring to a boil.  Mix unbleached flour and water in a small bowl.   Add this to boiling mixture, stirring consistently for 2 minutes. Makes about 16 ounces.

name: BAKED BROCCOLI AND BEANS
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked instant rice
2 (16 oz.)  cans chili beans (undrained)
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen cut broccoli
6  slices bacon, crisply cooked and crumbled
8  oz. Mexican style process cheese spread loaf, cut into cubes
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients, except cheese, in ungreased 3-quart casserole.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Cover and bake for 1 hour, or until rice and broccoli are tender.

name: SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
6  oz. spaghetti
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. sour cream
1/2  lb. sausage
1/2  lb. ground beef
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  c. water
4  oz. Mozzarella cheese, sliced or grated
preparation: Break spaghetti in half; cook in boiling water until done. Drain while warm.  Combine eggs and Parmesan with spaghetti.  Pour into greased pie plate and pat mixture up and around sides with a spoon.  Melt butter.  Add onion; saute until limp.  Stir in sour cream with onion and spoon over spaghetti "shell."  Brown sausage and beef in skillet; drain off fat.  Add tomato paste and water; simmer for 10 minutes.  Spoon meat over sour cream mixture.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: THREE CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
2  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. flour
8  eggs
2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
4  medium tomatoes, sliced
preparation: Mix cheeses, onion and flour.  Spread half in each of two (10-inch) greased quiche dishes.  Beat eggs slightly; beat in milk, salt, mustard and Worcestershire sauce.  Pour half over each cheese mixture.  Bake at 350° until set, about 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes; arrange tomato slices around the edge of pie, overlapping slightly.

name: TRUFFLES
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. real milk chocolate
1/3  c. heavy cream
1/3  c. half and half
1  tsp. vanilla
dipping chocolate
preparation: Melt chocolate over hot water.  Combine cream and half and half.  Heat to scalding; cool cream mixture to 130°.  Add to melted chocolate all at once, beating until smooth and well blended.  Add vanilla and blend into mixture.  Chill in refrigerator until candy is firm but pliable.  Beat with mixer until candy is light and fluffy, then return to refrigerator until firm.  Form into 3/4 inch balls and immediately dip into dipping chocolate; set on wax paper to set up.

name: MAC'S MASHER BISCUITS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1/2  pt. heavy whipping cream
preparation: Mix together with spoon.  Roll into 1/4 to 1/2 inch thickness. Cut out biscuits.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: SPICED ORANGE MOLD
ingredients:
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
1  stick cinnamon
6  whole cloves
1  (3 oz.) lemon-flavored jello
1/2  c. orange juice
juice of 1 lemon, strained
preparation: Drain liquid from oranges into small pan.  Add sugar, water and spices.  Boil and simmer for 5 minutes.  Place jello into bowl and pour hot liquid through strainer into jello.  Stir until dissolved.  Add fruit, orange juice and lemon juice.  Spoon into molds.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hot sausage or kielbasa
2 1/2  c. thinly sliced potatoes
1  can cream of celery soup
1/3  c. water
1/3  c. Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. green pepper
1/4  c. pimento
preparation: Grease dish; line dish with potatoes.  In separate pan, heat soup and water.  Add cheese and melt, then add sausage, pepper and pimento.  Pour over potatoes.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: GERMAN PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  egg
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
a dash of salt
1  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Beat egg.  Mix flour and sugar with egg.  Add salt and milk and mix well.  Pour mixture in hot skillet with small amount of melted butter or margarine.  Flip pancake when top appears dry. Remove from skillet when browned.  Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar mixture and enjoy.

name: ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk
2  c. light cream or 1 pt. nondairy creamer
1  c. cold water
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix ingredients well and freeze in 1/2 gallon ice cream freezer.  Makes 1/2 gallon.

name: ZESTY POTATOES
ingredients:
8  red potatoes
1/2  stick margarine
Good Seasons Italian dressing mix
1  tsp. salt
1  large onion (optional)
preparation: Wash and slice potatoes (do not peel).  Place in casserole dish 3 to 4 potatoes deep.  Add enough water to cover bottom of dish. Salt potatoes lightly.  Melt butter and drizzle over potatoes. Sprinkle Italian dressing mix over and through potatoes.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes (until potatoes are tender).  Use a whole packet of dressing mix for large casserole, or about 1/2 packet for a smaller one.

name: CABBAGE SALAD
ingredients:
1  large head Nappa cabbage
5  green onions, chopped
1  pkg. Ramen noodles, crunched up
1 small  pkg. slivered almonds
1/2  c. sesame seed
1/4  c. margarine
preparation: Mix chopped cabbage and onions together and refrigerate. Melt margarine in skillet.  Add noodles and almonds and brown over low heat to golden color.  Add sesame seed when almost brown, set aside.

name: BUTTER BISCUITS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. sugar
1/2  c. butter flavored shortening
2/3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Sift all ingredients together.  Cut shortening into dry ingredients, then add milk.  Stir with fork until dough forms into a ball.  Knead gently 6 times.

name: POPPY SEED BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. butter pecan cake mix
1  pkg. toasted coconut pudding mix (instant)
4  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1  c. hot water
1/4  c. poppy seed
preparation: Mix all together for 2 minutes.  Pour into two loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: APPLE COTTAGE PUDDING
ingredients:
4  to 6 medium apples, peeled and sliced
cinnamon
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Peel and slice 4 to 6 medium apples and cook for 10 minutes. Sprinkle with cinnamon and 1/3 cup sugar.  Pour over this batter made with: 1/2 cup sugar, 2 teaspoons sugar, milk, salt, flour and baking powder.  Bake in 375° oven, about 35 minutes.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz. each)  pkg. cream cheese
8  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1  Tbsp. chopped green chilies
1  tsp. finely chopped onion
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
dash of salt
pecans, finely chopped
preparation: Mix cream cheese and grated Cheddar.  Add all other ingredients, except pecans; mix well.  Shape into ball or roll. Roll in pecans.  Wrap in foil and chill 24 hours before serving.

name: DOWN SOUTH POTATO PIE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. cooked mashed sweet potatoes
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
2  eggs, beaten
2 small  cans Milnot
2/3  c. milk
2  (9-inch) unbaked pastry shells
preparation: Combine sweet potatoes and butter, mixing until blended.  Add sugar, flour, salt, nutmeg, ginger, cinnamon and cloves.  Blend in eggs and milk.  Pour into crusts and bake in a 350° oven 1 hour.

name: PUPPY CHOW
ingredients:
12  oz. chocolate chips
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. margarine
2  c. powdered sugar
1  box Rice or Corn Chex
preparation: In large bowl, melt chips, peanut butter and margarine together in microwave.  Add Chex; thoroughly mix together.  In large grocery sack, add Chex and powdered sugar.  Shake until it is all covered.  You may need to add more powdered sugar.  Enjoy!

name: CHEESE, SAUSAGE AND GROUND BEEF DISH
ingredients:
1  lb. roll quality sausage (Jimmy Dean, hot)
1  lb. ground beef (chuck)
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Mash sausage in frying pan.  Put lid on and simmer for 5 minutes or until done.  Pour off excess fat.  Add ground beef and stir until done.  Cut up cheese into mixture and stir until melted.  Do not cook any longer.  Serve on rice, potatoes or toast.

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
1  can Campbell's condensed cream of mushroom soup
3/4  c. water
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
4  c. cooked spaghetti (about 8 oz. dry)
2 (5 oz. each)  cans Swanson premium chunk white chicken, undrained
1/4  c. chopped sweet red pepper or pimento
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley or 2 tsp. dried parsley flakes
preparation: In a 2-quart saucepan, combine soup, water and cheese.  Over low heat, heat until cheese is melted, stirring occasionally.  Add spaghetti, chicken, pepper and parsley.  Heat through, stirring occasionally, about 10 or 15 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: CHILI CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  lb. Cheddar cheese
1  c. walnuts
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. instant minced onions
1  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: Grind  cheese  and  walnuts  together;  blend  in cream cheese,  garlic powder, Worcestershire sauce and onion.  Shape into ball  about  4-inches  in  diameter.  Roll  ball in chili powder and refrigerate until well chilled.

name: BEST EVER PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1  c. lard
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  Tbsp. vinegar
5  Tbsp. water
2  c. flour
preparation: Add lard to salt and flour.  Put egg and vinegar in a bowl and work flour, salt and lard mixture together.  Bake crusts at 375°.

name: CHOCOLATE ROLL
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  egg, beaten
1  c. chopped nuts
10 1/2  oz. pkg. miniature marshmallows
13 1/2  oz. flake coconut
preparation: Melt butter and chocolate over low heat, stirring.  Cool slightly; stir in powdered sugar and egg.  Beat to creamy and glossy.  Put in marshmallows and nuts to coat.  Put coconut on wax paper and roll mixture in it.  Shape into roll.  Make into two rolls.  Slice.  No bake.

name: CHICKEN WITH 40 CLOVES OF GARLIC
ingredients:
2  plump fryers, quartered or 8 chicken legs
4  ribs celery, thinly sliced
2/3  c. olive oil
6  sprigs parsley
1  tsp. tarragon
2 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. freshly ground pepper
dash of nutmeg
40 whole  cloves garlic, peeled *
flour and water
preparation: Rinse chicken in cold water and pat dry.  Put the oil into a heavy casserole with celery, parsley and tarragon.  Add chicken pieces and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt, pepper and nutmeg.  Turn chicken several times so all surfaces are coated with oil.  Toss in the 40 peeled garlic cloves; sprinkle with remaining salt and put lid on casserole.  Make a heavy, thick flour and water paste and with your hands, press it all around the rim where the lid and casserole meet, making an even, tight seal.  Cover the lid and the circle of paste with a layer of foil.  Bake in preheated 375° oven for 1 1/2 hours.  Do not remove lid or foil during baking period. At serving time, remove foil and flour seal.  Serve the chicken with hot toast or thin slices of pumpernickel and spread the soft, buttery garlic cloves on top.

name: GOLDEN FRUIT NECTAR PUNCH
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. boiling water
3/4  c. lemon juice
1 (12 oz.)  can apricot nectar, chilled
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen limeade concentrate
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice concentrate
2 (1 pt. 12 oz.)  bottles ginger ale, chilled
1  qt. lemon sherbet
preparation: Dissolve sugar in boiling water.  Refrigerate until well chilled.  Pour chilled mixture into chilled punch bowl.  Add lemon juice, apricot nectar and frozen juice concentrates.  Stir until well combined.  Add ginger ale.  Top with scoops of sherbet; garnish with fresh mint leaves, if desired.

name: GREEN GODDESS SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lime Jell-O
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
16  large marshmallows
1  c. milk
1 small  can crushed pineapple (juice and all)
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1  c. whipping cream, whipped
1  c. nuts
preparation: Melt marshmallows in milk.  Beat Jell-O and cream cheese together.  Add milk mixture. Beat until smooth. Add pineapple, including juice. Fold in whipping cream and mayonnaise. Add nuts. Pour into bowl and chill.

name: SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
6  oz. spaghetti
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  well beaten eggs
8  oz. cottage cheese
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/4  c. chopped green peppers
1 (8 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions; drain. Stir butter or margarine into hot spaghetti.  Stir in Parmesan cheese and eggs.  Form spaghetti mixture into a "crust" in a buttered 10-inch pie plate.  Spread cottage cheese over bottom of crust.

name: SPINACH PIE
ingredients:
1  pie crust (Pillsbury refrigerated or your best effort)
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped frozen spinach
4  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  c. low-fat cottage cheese
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook spinach, squeeze all water out and let stand.  Mix eggs, milk, cottage cheese and Cheddar cheese.  Add spinach and mix. Pour into pie crust.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top and serve.

name: APPLE-NUT TORTE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. oil
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
4  or 5 peeled, cored and diced apples
3/4  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix all together by hand, batter will be thick.  Also, by hand, blend in apples.  Grease and flour 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: BROWN SUGAR DIP FOR FRUIT
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Serve with apple or pear slices.  Great with bananas also.

name: HAM DISH
ingredients:
2  c. cooked ham
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. noodles
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. bell pepper, chopped
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  c. sweet milk
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Cut ham into bite size pieces and set aside.  Cook noodles and set aside.  Saute onions and bell peppers in margarine until brown.  Add ham, milk and cream of chicken soup.  Let mixture come to a boil.  Pour mixture over cooked noodles.

name: EGG CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
5  eggs
1  can condensed milk
1  can water
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. blueberries
sugar for sprinkling of muffins
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  can canned milk
4  eggs
12  oz. vegetable oil
1/2  tsp. salt
poppy seed filling
3  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix flour, sugar and baking soda.  Add milk, eggs and vegetable oil.  Add salt, poppy seed filling and vanilla.  Spoon into muffin cups about 1/4 full.  Then add one-third teaspoon of lemon filling,  then cover and add to about two-thirds full with more batter.  Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes, being careful not to overbake.  Remove from oven.  Need not be iced.

name: ZESTY PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  box rotini-cooked and drained
1  large green pepper- cut into small pieces
1  large red onion- cut into small pieces
1  bag frozen broccoli- cooked and cooled
2  pkgs. imitation crab meat
1 large  bottle of zesty Italian dressing
preparation: Mix together first 5 ingredients in large bowl. Pour 1/2-3/4 bottle of dressing over mixture. Stir well and refrigerate. Make this the day before for more flavor. Before serving you may need to add a little more dressing. Serves about 20 people.

name: FUNNEL CAKES
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. cooking oil
1  tsp. baking flour
milk (enough to make batter runny)
preparation: Mix well and drop through funnel into hot oil.  Crisscross to keep cake together.  Serve with powdered sugar or plain.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  jar Old English cheese
1  jar Roka Blue cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 small  pkg. pecans, crushed
1  small onion, chopped finely
preparation: Cream together cheeses, add onion and some pecans.  Chill, form into ball and press remaining pecan pieces onto ball.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
fruit cocktail (2 c. juice)
2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix sugar and eggs well. Sift together flour, soda, and salt and add to mixture with 2 cups of cocktail juice. Then fold in fruit. Bake in oblong pan at 300 for 45 - 60 minutes.

name: BAKED BRIE IN PHYLLO
ingredients:
12  sheets phyllo pastry, handle according to directions on box
1/2  c. melted butter
1/2  c. toasted sesame seeds
1  whole (2 2/2 lb.) round Brie
1  c. apricot preserves
1  c. slivered almonds
preparation: Place first sheet of phyllo on buttered baking tray and paint with butter.  Sprinkle with sesame seeds and so on until 6 sheets are used.  Place Brie in center of phyllo.  Spread preserves over top of Brie and sprinkle with almonds. Lay out another sheet of phyllo, paint with melted butter and sprinkle with sesame.  Repeat for a total of six sheets and place on top of Brie.  Gather pastry and decoratively enclose the Brie, pressing together to seal. Paint entire bundle with butter and bake in a preheated 350° oven until pastry is brown and flaky, about 35 minutes.  Serves 8 to 12.

name: CARROT BEEF LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
6  grated carrots
1  c. tomato juice
2  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  c. crackers, crushed
preparation: Mix the ingredients in the order given.  Grease a shallow pan. Place mixture in pan and bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: COCONUT CREAM PIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  c. milk
1/2  c. flour
4  egg yolks
2  tsp. vanilla
14 to 16  oz. coconut
2  baked deep-dish pie crust
preparation: Mix sugar and flour.  Beat egg yolks and add milk.  Mix with dry ingredients.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thick.  Add vanilla and coconut, mixing well.  Pour into baked pie crusts.  Beat egg whites until stiff, adding 2 tablespoons sugar gradually.  Add to top of pies and brown.

name: HEATH BAR COOKIES
ingredients:
40  crackers
1  c. brown sugar
12  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Place  crackers  on  cookie  sheet  lined with aluminum foil. Mix  brown sugar and margarine in saucepan and bring to boiling point.  Pour over crackers.  Sprinkle pecans on top of crackers, bake  for 5 minutes  at  350°.  Sprinkle  chocolate chips over crackers and spread when melted.  Put in refrigerator until cooled and break into pieces.

name: ALMOND SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. water
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  mandarin juice
1/4  lemon
1  oz. blanched almonds, chopped
6  ginger snaps
1/4  c. white vinegar
1  mandarin
1  oz. white raisins
preparation: Crumble cookies in water, stir until smooth; boil.  Add sugar, vinegar and mandarin juice, simmer for 10 minutes.  Finely chop mandarin and lemon, peel and fruit.  Add citrus fruit, peel, raisins, and almonds, simmer for 20 minutes.  Best with ham or pork.  Sauce freezes well.  Makes 2 cups.

name: CRANBERRY CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1/2  c. cold water
1 1/2  c. ground fresh cranberries
1  unpeeled orange, seeded and ground
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, undrained
3/4  c. chopped pecans
1 1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Combine the gelatin and the boiling water.  Stir until gelatin is dissolved.  Stir in cold water.  Set aside. Combine the cranberries, orange, pineapple, pecans and sugar.  Mix well.  Stir into gelatin mixture.  Mix well.  Chill until firm.  Serve with creamy fruit sauce.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: HERB VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  tsp. minced savory
1/2  tsp. dill seed
1/4  tsp. minced marjoram
2 1/2  c. stewed tomatoes
1  tsp. sugar
1  crushed garlic clove
2  qt. water
4  c. chopped assorted vegetables
2/3  c. uncooked long grain rice
pepper
salt
preparation: Mix herbs and add to tomatoes with sugar and garlic.  Mix well and cover; let stand in refrigerator overnight.  The next day, add water and vegetables.  Bring all to a boil.  Reduce heat and cover; simmer over very low heat for 3 hours.  Add rice and cook for 20 more minutes.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.  Makes 8 to 10 cups.

name: ANGEL ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. warm water
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
2  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. melted Crisco
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add sugar and stir well. Combine flour, baking powder, salt and soda. Add buttermilk and Crisco to dry ingredients. Add yeast mixture. Mix all together, adding a little flour until dough isn't too sticky. Cover tightly. Let stand in refrigerator 2 hours before baking. Flour hands and shape into desired balls.  Bake at 425° for about 10 minutes.

name: STUFFED GREEN PEPPERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion
1  can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/4  c. uncooked rice
1/2  c. water
1/8  tsp. thyme
1/4  tsp. sweet basil
1/4  tsp. dill weed
1/4  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Brown and drain ground beef.  Saute onion in oleo.  Add brown sugar to tomato sauce.  Pour tomato sauce over ground beef and simmer together.  Add spices and simmer all together until rice is done.  Parboil pepper halves in boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes. Drain; fill with meat and rice mixture and top with bread crumbs or cheese.  Bake for 30 minutes at 325°.  This recipe will serve 12 people.

name: MEXICAN ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can chopped green chillies (mild)
3  green onions, chopped
black olives, chopped (approximately 2/3 c.)
grated Cheddar cheese (1 c.)
garlic powder (1/2 tsp.)
large flour tortilla shells
preparation: Mix all ingredients and spread thinly on flour shells and roll up.  Cover with plastic wrap and chill overnight.  Slice and serve with salsa dip.  Will make 5 to 6 rolls.

name: CHICKEN SOUP WITHOUT THE CHICKEN
ingredients:
2 extra large  cans chicken broth
1  bag frozen, sliced or diced carrots
3  medium potatoes, diced
2  to 3 celery stalks, diced
1  onion
1/2  box baby pastina
preparation: In large soup pan, add together chicken broth, carrots, potatoes, onion and celery.  Cook until celery and potatoes are cooked.  Add pastina and cook another 20 minutes.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (No. 303)  can green beans
1 (No. 303)  can whole new potatoes, drained and sliced
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  can French fried onions (Durkee)
paprika
preparation: Slice the potatoes into a buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish and cover with green beans.  Cover beans with the entire can of mushroom soup and top with the onions (dilute soup a little bit). Sprinkle with paprika and microwave for 7 minutes.

name: PORK BARBECUE
ingredients:
6 to 8  lb. fresh pork picnic
1 or 1 1/2  bottles Kraft hot barbecue sauce
preparation: Cook pork picnic in crock-pot.  I cook mine about 17 hours on low.  Take out, clean off fat and bone.  Shred up meat.  Pour on sauce.  Put back in crock-pot for about 2 hours to simmer.

name: BEEFY MEXICAN LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (16 oz.)  can whole tomatoes, cut up
1 (1 1/8 oz.)  pkg. Durkee taco seasoning
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
1 (12 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
1 1/2  c. (6 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
2  eggs, slightly beaten
12  (6-inch) flour or corn tortillas*
1  tomato, chopped
shredded lettuce
preparation: In large skillet, brown beef; drain.  Add canned tomatoes and taco seasoning; simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes.  Stir in 1/2 can French fried onions.  In bowl, combine cottage cheese, 1 cup Cheddar cheese and eggs.  Place 3 tortillas on the bottom of a greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish.  Overlap 6 tortillas around sides of baking dish.  Spoon meat mixture evenly in dish.  Top with 3 tortillas, then with cheese mixture.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Place remaining onions in center of casserole; bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer. Before serving, arrange tomato and lettuce around edge of casserole.  Makes 6 servings.

name: PECAN CHEWS
ingredients:
2  egg whites
2  c. light brown sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. finely chopped pecans
preparation: Beat egg whites until stiff.  Add brown sugar, vanilla and salt.  Fold in pecans.  Spray cookie sheet with Pam.  Bake in 350° oven for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: HOT CRAB MEAT DIP
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can crab meat
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. minced onion
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Beat cream cheese until smooth.  Stir in remaining ingredients until well mixed.  Put into ovenproof dish.  Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.  Makes 1 cup.

name: MARINATED BOTTOM ROUND ROAST
ingredients:
3 to 5  lb. beef bottom round roast
Worcestershire sauce
garlic powder
onion salt
lemon pepper
paprika
Italian seasoning
seasoned salt (optional)
preparation: Take a plastic bag and pour into it approximately 8 to 12 ounces of Worcestershire sauce.  Add garlic powder, onion salt, lemon pepper, paprika, Italian seasoning and seasoned salt (if desired).  Amounts are not important and depend upon personal preference.  Place roast in bag and marinate a minimum of 24 hours in refrigerator.  Bake uncovered at 375° for 1 hour and 20 minutes for medium to well done.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
2  or 3 (10 count) biscuit tubes
3/4  stick oleo, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
