preparation: Use Bundt pan or loaf pan (or 13 x 9-inch pan).  Cut biscuits in halves.  Mix cinnamon and sugar.  Coat biscuits with cinnamon and sugar mixture; place in pan.  Mix melted oleo, vanilla and rest of sugar mixture; pour over biscuits.  Nuts can be placed in pan first, in the middle or at the end.  Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.  Watch carefully.

name: MAGIC COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
2  c. milk
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. Bisquick
2  eggs
1/4  c. melted butter
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients  in  mixing  bowl.  Blend  for  3 minutes.  Pour  into  a  9-inch pie plate.  Let set for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with 1 cup coconut.  Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

name: LEMON CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  to 6 chicken breasts
2  boxes white rice, cooked ahead
1 1/2  c. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. garlic salt
3/4  stick butter
preparation: Place breasts  in a brown cooking bag; add lemon juice. Sprinkle garlic  salt over breasts.  Place slices of butter on top.  Close  bag and cook at 350° for about 30 minutes.  Serve chicken over  wild	rice.  Pour  some  of garlic butter liquid over chicken and rice.

name: HUMMINGBIRD CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
3  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. vegetable oil
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, undrained
1  c. chopped pecans
1 3/4  c. mashed bananas
1/2  c. chopped pecans
Cream Cheese Frosting
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl; add eggs and oil, stirring until dry ingredients are moistened.  Do not beat.  Stir in vanilla, pineapple, 1 cup pecans and bananas.

name: ESCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. hash brown potatoes (partly thawed)
1 1/2  sticks margarine, melted
2 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  pt. sour cream
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix and put in greased 9 x 12-inch baking dish.  Top with 1 cup crushed corn flakes and dot with oleo.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CREAMY CABBAGE-AND-APPLE SLAW
ingredients:
6  c. finely shredded green cabbage
1/2  c. finely shredded onion
1  green or red pepper, seeded and cut into thin strips
1  large red apple, cored and diced
1/4  c. dark or light raisins
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. honey
2  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
green pepper rings for garnish (optional)
preparation: In large salad bowl, combine cabbage, onion and pepper strips. Toss apple and raisins with lemon juice; add to cabbage.  In small bowl combine mayonnaise, sour cream, honey, mustard, salt and pepper.  Pour over cabbage.  Toss until evenly coated.  Cover slaw with plastic film and refrigerate until serving time.  Stir with fork just before serving.  Garnish with pepper rings, if desired. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE(Serves 8)
ingredients:
1  can sweetened condensed milk
2  graham cracker crusts
2  pkg. frozen strawberries
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: In a mixing bowl, add milk and strawberries; blend 15 seconds. Fold in Cool Whip, then pour into pie crusts.  Use the plastic top from the crust to make lid for pies; crimp down the sides. Place in freezer for about 2 hours.

name: CHOCOLATE ALMOND BARS
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple
3/4  c. oleo, softened
3/4  c. dark brown sugar, packed
2  c. flour
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  Tbsp. freshly grated orange rind
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. sliced almonds
preparation: Drain pineapple well.  Reserve juice.  Cream oleo until light and fluffy.  Beat in 1 tablespoon juice and brown sugar.  Add flour and beat well.  Press into 9 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Combine chocolate chips with 3 tablespoons pineapple juice, orange peel, vanilla and cinnamon in small pan.  Melt over low heat.  Spread over baked mixture.  Top evenly with drained pineapple.  Sprinkle with almonds.  Allow to cool.  Cut into bars. Makes 16 bars.

name: STRAWBERRY FIGS
ingredients:
6  c. mashed figs
6  c. sugar
4  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil 15 minutes.  Put in sterilized jars.  Quick and easy, tastes like strawberry preserves.

name: NORWEGIAN PANCAKES
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add milk and sugar.  Beat until smooth and mix in melted butter. Fry on hot griddle.

name: MINI PECAN PIES
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. plain flour
1/4  c. sugar
1  large egg
1/2  c. milk
1/4  stick oleo, melted
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Spray muffin pans with a vegetable spray.  Mix all ingredients together except pecans; mix well.  Add pecans and bake for 45 minutes or until the pies are brown. Yields 6 pies.

name: CROCK-POT MASHED POTATOES
ingredients:
5  lb. potatoes
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. butter
6  oz. cream cheese
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Cook and mash potatoes with just enough milk to mash easy. Add salt, pepper, butter, cream cheese and sour cream.  Cool (even overnight).  Put in crock-pot (greased) and cook on low for 4 hours.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1  can cream of shrimp soup
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. chopped green onion
1/4  tsp. curry powder
garlic powder to taste
hot sauce to taste
preparation: Combine soup, cream cheese, lemon juice, green onion, curry powder, garlic powder and hot sauce in mixer bowl.  Beat at low speed until of serving consistency.  Chill, covered, for several hours.  Serve with fresh vegetables.  Yield:  32 servings.

name: CARBONEAR
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter
2  c. cooked ham
1  c. whipping cream
2  large egg yolks
salt and pepper
1/2  lb. cooked spaghetti
preparation: Melt butter, add ham and 3 quarters of cream.  Cook over low heat until cream has thickened or cooked down some.  Blend rest of cream with egg yolks.  Add that to hot mixture (mix a little hot cream with cold before pouring it all together).  Stir 1/2 minute over low heat.  Add a little salt and pepper.  Mix in with spaghetti and toss it!

name: PECAN TASSIES
ingredients:
1/4  lb. butter or margarine
1  (3 oz.) Philadelphia cream cheese
1  c. flour
preparation: Mix well and press into 36 tiny muffin or tassie cups

name: DIETER'S DELIGHT SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. orange jello
1 (8 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 (8 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 (8 oz.)  carton whipped topping
preparation: Sprinkle jello over cottage cheese in bowl.  Stir to mix well. Add pineapple, oranges and pecans.  Fold in whipped topping. Spoon into serving bowl.  Chill until serving time.  Yields 4 servings.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE DINNER
ingredients:
6  boneless chicken breasts
1  (8 oz.) container sour cream (optional)
1  can cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. water
1  jar dried beef (optional)
preparation: Wrap chicken with dried beef.  Hold together with toothpicks. Mix with rest of ingredients and cook in a slow cooker on low all day or 3 hours on high.  Chicken can be wrapped and left in refrigerator overnight before cooking.  Serve with rice.  Can be made low-fat by skinning chicken, using low-fat sour cream, low-fat soup and omitting dried beef.

name: RED ONION SALAD
ingredients:
2  medium red Italian onions
2  large oranges
1  head romaine lettuce
1 (1 lb.)  can tiny beets
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. orange juice
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. rosemary
fresh ground pepper
preparation: Peel and slice onions.  Peel and section oranges.  Break romaine into serving pieces.  Arrange romaine in bowl.  Add orange sections and tiny beets.  Top with onion rings.  Combine oil, vinegar, orange juice, salt and seasonings; blend well.  Pour over salad; toss at moment of serving.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  small (10 oz.) frozen broccoli
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
1 small  jar pimento, chopped
2  c. cooked rice
preparation: Heat onion, celery and pepper in microwave until tender.  Add Cheez Whiz and pimento.  Break up frozen broccoli; add to cheese mixture.  Add cooked rice.  Cook at 350° until bubbly.  Serve hot.

name: BEEF HASH
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
3  c. frozen hash brown potatoes
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. prepared salsa
green onions and olives, sliced (optional)
preparation: Brown beef and onion in large skillet over medium heat (8 to 10 minutes).  Pour off drippings.  Stir in potatoes, salt and pepper.  Increase heat to medium-high and cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Stir in salsa.  Continue cooking 8 to 10 minutes or until potatoes are lightly browned.  Stir occasionally.  Garnish with green onions and olive slices.  Serves 4.

name: CROWN OF GOLD MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
4  egg yolks
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. mustard
2  Tbsp. minced onions
1/3  c. ketchup
1 1/2  tsp. prepared horseradish (optional)
4  egg whites
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
4  Tbsp. mustard
preparation: Mix ground beef, bread crumbs, egg yolks, salt, mustard, onions, ketchup and horseradish (optional) well; place in a 9-inch casserole or wide tube pan.  Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.  Beat egg whites, cream of tartar and mustard.  Spread over meat loaf; return to oven and bake 20 to 25 minutes.

name: OLD SOUTHERN CRACKLIN BREAD
ingredients:
2  cups cornmeal
1  teaspoon baking powder
1/2  teaspoon salt
2/3  cup cracklings
preparation: Sift into a bowl cornmeal, baking powder, and salt, pour into this enough boiling water to make a stiff batter, Add cracklings and 1 whole cup bacon drippings.  Bake in oven 400 degrees or until light brown.

name: BLUEBERRY DELIGHT #1
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1 1/2  sticks margarine
1  can blueberry pie filling
1  c. sour cream
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Soften margarine and cut into dry cake mix until thoroughly blended.  Pat into 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish.  Bake for 10 minutes.  Spread pie filling over cake mix.

name: DREAM BARS
ingredients:
2  sticks butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1  c. nuts
1  c. coconut
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  pkg. whole graham crackers
preparation: Make layer of whole graham crackers in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt  butter over low heat. Add sugar, milk and egg.  Stir. Bring to a rolling boil.  Remove from heat and add coconut, nuts and graham cracker crumbs.  Pour over crackers in pan and cover with another layer of crackers.  Top with thin layer of vanilla icing.

name: STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  pkg. mushrooms
1  lb. bacon, cooked and crunched
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. pepper
preparation: Combine cream cheese, bacon and pepper.  Cut stems off the mushrooms and fill with cream cheese mixture.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

name: BREAKFAST BEANS(Why Not)
ingredients:
1  lb. dry baking beans (your choice)
1  lb. mixed dried fruits (at least half prunes, apricots, apples and peaches are good too), finely chopped
1/4 to 1/2  c. pure maple syrup
1  small peeled onion, studded with 2 cloves
generous pinch of each ground ginger and cinnamon
1 heaping  Tbsp. spicy brown mustard (prepared)
2  Tbsp. balsamic or other aromatic vinegar
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Rinse and pick over beans. Soak beans in water to cover for 4 hours. Drain. Add water to cover and simmer about 1 hour.  Mix beans with other ingredients in a large casserole with tight fitting cover. Add enough water to cover beans well. Bake, covered, in a 350° oven for 4 to 5 hours until beans are soft and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Stir mixture every hour during cooking. Add boiling water as necessary if beans become dry.

name: SICILIAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  large boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut up
6  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
3  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  onion, finely chopped
1/2  tsp. rosemary, crushed
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can Italian Style stewed tomatoes
preparation: Coat chicken with 4 tablespoons cheese, then flour, salt and pepper to taste.  In skillet, cook chicken in oil over medium heat until done.  Remove chicken to dish.

name: GAME SANDWICH
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. instant onions
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  tsp. poppy seed
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix in cereal bowl.  Spread mixture on bun tops.  Layer baked ham or chipped, chopped ham.  Fold Swiss cheese over meat. Wrap in foil and heat in 350° oven for 15 minutes.

name: CROCK-POT STEAK
ingredients:
2 to 2 1/2  lb. cubed steak
1/4  c. water
1  pkg. onion gravy mix
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Brown  meat.  Put in crock-pot.  Add mixture.  Simmer 6 to 8 hours.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 lg  can fruit cocktail with juice
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
nuts (optional)
1/2  tsp salt
preparation: Stir all ingredients and bake at 350 degrees for 55 minutes.

name: COLE SLAW DRESSING
ingredients:
1/3  c. vinegar
2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sugar
1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/3  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. garlic and pepper (use fresh garlic or powder)
1  tsp. celery seed
1/4  c. chopped onion
1 small  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Put in blender; blend well.  Keep chilled.  Makes a little over 3 cups.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  Duncan Hines butter in mix cake
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1/2  c. milk
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 large  can cherry pie filling
1  large tub Cool Whip
nuts
preparation: Bake cake as directed.  Crumble half cake in bottom of large bowl.  Prepare pudding mix adding 1/2 cup extra milk.  Layer with 1/2 cup of pineapple and 1/2 can pie filling.  Cover with layer of Cool Whip and nuts.  Repeat with remaining cake, pineapple and pie filling.

name: TORTILLA SOUP
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic, chopped
2  Tbsp. olive oil
2  cans beef bouillon
2  cans chicken broth or homemade stock
1/2  c. tomato juice
1/2  c. tomato sauce
shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1  tsp. ground cumin
1  jalapeno, chopped
1  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. Worcestershire
1  c. diced, cooked chicken
1  large tomato
1 small (10)  pkg. corn tortillas
1  sliced avocado
preparation: Saute onion  and garlic in oil.  Add beef bouillon or 3 beef bouillon cubes dissolved in 3 cups water, chicken broth, tomato juice, sauce, cumin, jalapeno, salt and Worcestershire. Bring to a  boil.  Cover  and simmer 30 minutes.  Add chicken and  diced tomato.  Cook 5 minutes.  Cut tortillas in strips; drop  into soup.  Serve  with  slices of avocado and shredded cheese sprinkled on individual bowls of soup.

name: IMPOSSIBLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1 scant  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together and bake at 350° until done.

name: SEAFOOD SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen crab meat (sea legs), thawed
1  lb. clean deveined shrimp, cut in 1/2
3/4  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green onion
dash of cayenne pepper
1/8  c. lemon juice
mayonnaise (enough to hold together)
preparation: Thaw crab meat and cut into bite size pieces; cut shrimp into bite size pieces.  Add all the ingredients together and chill. This recipe can be cut down to serve two people.

name: PRONTO PUP MIX
ingredients:
1/2  c. meal
1-1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients together.  Add egg and milk and beat until smooth.  Dip frankfurters in batter and fry in deep oil until brown.

name: DILL PICKLES
ingredients:
cucumbers
dill
clove of garlic
pod of pepper (if desired)
2  c. water
1/3  c. salt (pickling)
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Wash and dry cucumbers.  Pack in jar in which you have already put dill, clove of garlic and pod of pepper, if desired.  Boil water, salt, vinegar and sugar.  Pour immediately over cucumbers and seal jar.  Hot water bath 5 to 10 minutes or until cucumbers turn slightly yellow.  Ready in 2 weeks.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE, TEXAS STYLE
ingredients:
8  oz. almond Hershey bar, melted
8  oz. Cool Whip, out of refrigerator 1/2 hour
preparation: Mix the ingredients and pour into cookie crumb crust.  Chill for at least 1 hour.

name: EASY HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 or 1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  medium onion
1  Tbsp. oregano
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. shredded Cheddar or Velveeta cheese
1 small  can tomato sauce
1 (8 to 10 oz.)  pkg. egg noodles
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown hamburger with onion.  Drain grease if necessary.  Add oregano, salt, pepper, soup and tomato sauce.  Turn down low to simmer.  Cook noodles as directed.  Drain and add to meat mixture or layer in casserole.  Top with cheese and bake at 350° until cheese melts but not browned.  Should be bubbly.  This freezes well, also.

name: OKTOBERFEST PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4 to 5  slices bacon
1 (16 oz.)  can sauerkraut
4  to 6 pork chops
1  large onion, sliced thin
2  to 3 large potatoes, peeled and sliced thin
1 (16 oz.)  can chopped or stewed tomatoes
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. caraway seed
preparation: Cover bottom of casserole with slices of bacon.  Top bacon with the sauerkraut.  Lay pork chops on top, followed by onion.  Next, layer potato slices.  Cover with tomatoes, pepper and caraway seed. Cover and bake at 350° until done, approximately 2 hours.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. low-fat vanilla yogurt
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  c. mashed ripe bananas
nuts (if desired)
preparation: Combine dry ingredients with wet ingredients.  Beat well. Pour into a greased loaf pan.  Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°. Makes one loaf.

name: FANTASY FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3/4  c. Parkay margarine
2/3  c. (5 1/3 oz.) evaporated milk
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1 (7 oz.)  jar Kraft Marshmallow Creme
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, margarine and milk; bring to rolling boil, stirring constantly.  Boil 5 minutes over medium heat or until candy thermometer reaches 238°, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Stir in chocolate pieces until melted.  Add Marshmallow Creme, nuts and vanilla.  Beat until well blended.  Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Cool; cut into squares.  Makes 3 pounds.

name: DATE, NUT & CHOCOLATE CHIP LOAF CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. chopped dates
2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. cold water
1  c. hot water
1/2  c. margarine
2  c. sugar
2  large eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
2  tsp. vanilla
1  pkg. (12 oz.) chocolate chips
preparation: Soak first four ingredients together in a small bowl (preferably over night). Then mix together margarine, sugar, & eggs in a large bowl. Blend into margarine mixture: 3 c. flour - alternate with date mixture, salt, nuts, vanilla, and chocolate chips. Place mixture into greased & floured loaf pans. Makes 2 large or 3 small loaves. Bake at 350° for about 60-70 minutes.

name: SAUTEED CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  sticks butter (saute chicken in one stick)
1  can cream of chicken
3/4  c. water
3/4  c. sherry
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Then pour over chicken in casserole dish. Cook 1 hour at 350°. Cook rice and use sauce over rice.

name: WALNUT RAISIN COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. softened margarine
1 1/3  c. firmly packed light brown sugar
1/2  c. seedless raisins
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1 1/3  c. Planters walnut pieces, chopped
1  c. chopped dried apples
preparation: In small bowl, combine flour and baking soda; set aside.  In medium mixing bowl, using an electric mixer, cream margarine, brown sugar and vanilla.  Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Stir in flour mixture.  Stir in walnuts, raisins and apples.  Drop by tablespoonful onto greased baking sheet.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.  Cool on wire rack.

name: EASY HOT FUDGE
ingredients:
2  squares of baker's unsweetened chocolate
1  can eagle brand sweet condensed milk
vanilla ice cream
chopped nuts
preparation: Melt Chocolate in Microwave until soft. Stir. Then add milk and heat.  Stir again.  Pour over vanilla ice cream and add chopped nuts.

name: ONE PAN COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
2/3  c. milk
1 1/2  c. Bisquick
1  c. sugar
1  can Comstock strawberry pie filling
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Melt margarine in 11 x 7-inch pan.  Add milk, Bisquick and sugar; stir until smooth.  Drop spoonfuls of filling over batter.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown.

name: MEXICAN PINWHEELS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing salad dressing
2  green onions, minced
4  (12-inch) flour tortillas
1 (4 oz.)  jar diced pimento
1 (4 oz.)  can diced green chilies
1 (2.2 oz.)  can sliced black olives
preparation: Mix first three ingredients.  Spread on tortillas.  Drain remaining ingredients and blot on paper towels.  Spread equal amounts on cream cheese.  Roll tightly.  Chill 2 hours.  Cut into 1-inch pieces.  Discard ends.  Serve facing up on dish or plate.

name: CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
1  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  c. skim milk
2  Tbsp. applesauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well.  Pour into greased 7 x 11-inch pan.  Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.

name: BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs
3  mashed bananas
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
4  Tbsp. buttermilk
1/2  c. pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix  and sift together flour and soda.	Add alternately with first  4  ingredients, then add pecans and vanilla.  Bake at 325° to 350° for 45 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: CHICKEN STUFFING BAKE
ingredients:
12  oz. milk
3  Tbsp. margarine
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. herb seasoned cubed stuffing
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  c. cut up, cooked chicken
2  c. shredded cheese
1  c. cooked broccoli flowerets
preparation: In a 1-quart saucepan over high heat, heat 3/4 cup of the milk and margarine to scalding.  In large bowl, pour hot milk mixture over stuffing.  Toss to mix well.  Pat half of the stuffing mixture into a buttered 12 x 8-inch baking dish.

name: COCOA APPLE CAKE(Tender And Keeps Well)
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. allspice
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. chocolate bits
2  apples, minced (without core)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Using a 10-inch cake pan, grease and flour the pan bottom. Preheat oven to 325°.  Beat together eggs, butter (or margarine), sugar and water.  Sift together the flour, baking soda, allspice, cocoa and cinnamon; after mixed, sift dry ingredients into egg mixture while stirring.  Mix well.  Fold in nuts, chocolate, apples and vanilla.  Pour into cake pan.  Bake at 325° for 60 to 70 minutes, until top springs back if touched lightly.

name: PONCHE DE PINA
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. water
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 1/2  c. orange juice
1/2  c. lemon juice
1 1/2  c. water
4  sticks cinnamon
12  cloves
preparation: Simmer sugar, water, cinnamon and cloves for about 30 minutes. Strain; removing cinnamon and cloves.  Add pineapple, orange and lemon juice.  Pour over ice or frozen pineapple juice cubes.  One gallon ginger ale may be added to serve additional guests or to give sparkly taste.

name: CREAMY LEMON CHEESECAKE BARS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. powdered sugar
3/4  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. (12 oz.) evaporated milk
2  eggs
2 (8 oz. each)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
5  Tbsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. granulated sugar
2  Tbsp. grated lemon zest
1 to 2  drops yellow food coloring
1  c. (8 oz.) carton sour cream
preparation: Crust:  In medium bowl, combine flour and powdered sugar.  Cut in butter until small crumbs form.  Press lightly into bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes or until lightly browned.  Cool.

name: CRUSTY COBBLER
ingredients:
1/4  lb. oleo (1/2 c.)
1  c. flour
3/4  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  can fruit
1  c. sugar
preparation: Melt oleo in deep dish.  Mix together flour, baking powder, sugar and milk.  Pour over melted oleo; do not stir.  Pour 1 can of fruit with juice over mixture.  Bake 50 minutes at 350°.

name: CHEESE STRAWS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. plain flour
1  stick margarine
1/2  lb. sharp cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake on greased pan 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown at 350°.

name: OVEN-SMOKED TURKEY
ingredients:
1  turkey, thawed, washed and patted dry
liquid smoke
1/2  c. oil and 1/4 c. salt
2  stalks celery, cut in half
1  onion, peeled and cut in 1/4's
1/2  green pepper, cut
3  cloves garlic, cut in 1/4's
3/4  c. vinegar
1  c. Coca-Cola
1/4  c. oil
1/2  c. Sauterne wine
1/4  c. liquid smoke
2  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. parsley, chopped
preparation: Rub turkey with liquid smoke.  Mix salt and oil and rub turkey.  Place vegetables in cavity.  In deep  roaster  bake 1 hour at 375°, uncovered.  Mix remaining and  pour over turkey. Lower  heat to 325°.  Cover and bake until  done.  Serve  with sauce.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  jar Kraft Roka Blue cheese (4 oz.)
8  oz. Wispride Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. chopped nuts
8  oz. cream cheese
1/4 to 1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1  cherry
preparation: Let stand until soft, then mix well.  Shape into a ball.  Roll in chopped nuts.  Top with a cherry.  Refrigerate.  May be frozen.

name: PECAN TARTS
ingredients:
1  stick butter, softened
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. flour
preparation: Mix and shape into 24 balls and press with thumb into tart pans.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
3  medium eggs
1 1/3  c. carrots, grated
2/3  c. crushed pineapple, drained
2/3  c. pecans, chopped fine
1 1/3  c. salad oil
preparation: Mix together flour, baking soda, cinnamon, salt and sugar. Mix until cinnamon is well blended.  Add eggs, salad oil, carrots, pineapple and pecans.  Mix on medium speed until batter is smooth and silky.   Pour batter into two 9-inch layer pans that have been lined with wax paper.  Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes.  Cool, then ice.

name: Chocolate Cheesecake
ingredients:
1  c. crushed chocolate graham crackers
1/2  c. melted margarine
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1  c. low-fat cottage cheese
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. cocoa
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/4  tsp. salt
3  eggs
2  Tbsp. semi-sweet chocolate mini morsels
preparation: Mix margarine with crumbs and press into bottom of a 7-inch spring-form pan.  Set aside.  Into blender, add cream cheese and next 8 ingredients, blending until smooth.   Fold in chocolate morsels.  Slowly pour mixture over crumbs in pan.  Bake at 300° for 65 to 70 minutes or until set.  Let cool in pan.  Cover and chill 8 hours.  Garnish with chocolate curls, if desired.  Serves 12.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. sharp Cheddar cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  tsp. chopped pimento
2  tsp. chopped green pepper
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Combine cheeses and mix until well blended.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Roll into round ball.  Refrigerate. Garnish with chopped nuts.

name: CRANBERRY MOLD
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can whole cranberry sauce
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. red flavored gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  apple or orange, peeled and diced
1/4  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Heat cranberry juice and strain.  Set berries aside.  Dissolve gelatin in hot juice and water.   Add salt and lemon juice.  Chill until thickened enough to mound when dropped from spoon.  With rotary beater, beat in mayonnaise until light and fluffy.  Fold in the cranberries, fruit and nuts.  Pour into mold.  Chill until set.  Unmold at serving time.

name: CHEESY GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
10  slices bacon
2 (16 oz.)  pkg. green beans
1  lb. mushrooms, sliced
3/4  c. chopped onion
3/4  tsp. pepper
1  (16 oz.) Cheez Whiz
preparation: Cook bacon until done; drain and reserve 1/4 cup drippings. Crumble bacon; reserve 2 tablespoons.  Cook beans as directed; drain well.  Add mushrooms and onion to reserved 1/4 cup drippings.  In skillet, cook and stir on medium-high heat 10 minutes; drain.  Add bacon, hot, cooked green beans and pepper. Mix lightly.  Microwave process cheese spread as directed, then pour over green beans.  Sprinkle with reserved 2 tablespoons crumbled bacon.

name: ALL PURPOSE BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2 to 3  drops hot pepper sauce
1  c. water
1/4  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  tsp. celery seed
1  Tbsp. minced onion
preparation: Combine ingredients in slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low for 2 to 3 hours.  Makes 2 cups of sauce.  Good on spareribs, chicken, pork chops and roast beef.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
5  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  pkg. strawberry jello
1  tsp. red food coloring
1  qt. fresh or frozen strawberries
preparation: Cook water, sugar and cornstarch until thickened.  Add jello and food coloring. Let mixture set until cold. Fold in sliced strawberries.  If berries are frozen, drain and use instead of water. If there isn't 2 1/2 cups of juice, use what juice you have and add the rest water.  Pour into baked pie shells.  Top with whipped cream.  Makes 2 pies.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. oil
1  Tbsp. water
2  eggs
preparation: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Press a crisscross on each cookie with a fork.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: DEBBIE'S CRAB DIP
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
sprinkle of garlic
1  can white crab meat
3/4  jar chili sauce
sprinkle of parsley flakes (optional)
preparation: Let the cream cheese soften. Add Worcestershire sauce, onions and garlic. Mix together until creamy. Spread on platter and cover with chili sauce. Rinse crab meat and squeeze out all water (watch out for shells) and spread on top of cheese and sauce mixture. Sprinkle with parsley flakes.

name: CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  can Ro-Tel *
12  oz. Velveeta cheese
preparation: *Ro-Tel is a can of tomatoes and green chilies, found in the can vegetable section of grocery store.

name: FIESTA CORN SALAD
ingredients:
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  c. chopped fresh tomatoes
1  c. chopped peeled cucumber
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. diced green pepper
2  green onions, sliced
1/2  c. bottled Italian salad dressing
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Chill several hours before serving. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: PEACHES AND CREAM SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. peach or apricot flavored jello
1  c. boiling water
3/4  c. cold water
3  c. sliced peaches
1  small banana, sliced
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
3  Tbsp. cold water
1/2  c. half and half
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. whipping cream
1/2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. sugar
1  c. pureed peaches
preparation: Dissolve peach gelatin in 1 cup boiling water; stir until dissolved.  Add cold water and mix well.  Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg white.  Stir in sliced peaches and banana.  Pour into lightly oiled 8-cup mold.  Chill until set.

name: BARBECUED TROUT
ingredients:
6  pan-dressed trout
2/3  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. ketchup
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. crushed rosemary
lemon wedges (optional)
preparation: Place trout in a single layer in a plastic bag or glass baking dish.  Combine the soy sauce, ketchup, lemon juice, oil and rosemary; pour into bag or dish.  Cover (or close bag); let stand for 1 hour, turning once.  Remove fish, reserving marinade.  Place fish in a single layer in a well-greased, hinged wire grill basket.  Grill, covered, over medium coals for 8 to 10 minutes, or until fish is browned on the bottom.  Turn and baste with marinade; grill 5 to 7 minutes longer, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.  Serve with lemon, if desired.

name: PICKLED ZUCCHINI
ingredients:
1  lb. zucchini
1/4  lb. or 3 small onions, sliced
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  tsp. turmeric (optional)
2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Scrub zucchini well; cut off both ends and slice thinly.  Do not pare off outer green.  Cover with cold water and salt.  Soak for 1 hour.  Mix all other ingredients; bring to a boil.  Add drained zucchini.  Turn off flame/burner; let stand 1 hour longer. Bring to a boil; cook for 3 minutes.  Refrigerate in covered container.  Serve as you would pickles.

name: CHOCOLATE-CHOCOLATE-CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. oil
1  box chocolate cake mix
3  beaten eggs
1  box instant chocolate pudding
1  c. water
6  oz. chocolate chips (semi-sweet)
preparation: Mix well.  Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: CHERRY DEVILICIOUS CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Crisco
1  c. sugar
3  egg yolks
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. sifted cake flour
1/2  c. cocoa powder
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1 1/3  c. water
3  egg whites
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Cream Crisco and 1 cup sugar until fluffy.  Add egg yolks 1 at a time, beating after each.  Stir in vanilla.  Sift together flour, cocoa, soda and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with water; beat well after each addition.  Beat egg whites until soft peaks form; gradually add 3/4 cup sugar; beat to stiff peaks.  Fold into batter.  Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Cool.  Cut into squares.  Top each serving with dollop of Cream Cheese Topper and warm Cherry Sauce.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
2  lb. ground meat or ground turkey
salt
pepper
garlic to taste (salt or powder)
1/2  pkg. taco seasoning
1/2  can Ro-Tel tomatoes and diced chilies
1  (2 lb.) Velveeta cheese
chopped lettuce, tomatoes and green onions
1  bag corn chips (tortillas)
milk
preparation: Brown ground meat.  Add salt, pepper and garlic to taste. Drain.  Cut Velveeta cheese into small squares.  Add to meat.  Add Ro-Tel.  Add taco seasoning.  Cook until melted.   Use milk to thin mixture, if necessary.  In individual servings, crunch chips into small pieces.  Add cheese and meat mixture to top.  Add salad toppings as desired.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  qt. vinegar
1  pt. tomato juice
1/2  lb. margarine
1  Tbsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. crushed red pepper
2  oz. salt
preparation: Mix all  ingredients  and bring to a boil.  Will cook 3 chickens on the grill.  Keep sauce hot while cooking chicken.

name: SUGAR-FREE APPLE PIE
ingredients:
4  c. sliced, peeled apples (sweet varieties are best)
1/2  c. frozen apple juice concentrate, undiluted
2  tsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Roll pastry  very  thin  to  fit  an 8-inch plate.  Set aside. Mix  apples,  apple  juice concentrate, cornstarch and spice and stir until apples are well coated.	Add lemon juice, if desired, to	keep  apples  lighter colored.	Pour into the pastry lined pie pan  and top with the second crust or pastry strips.  Seal the edges  and	cut  slits  in the top crust to allow steam to escape.  Bake  at  425°  for  40 to 45 minutes until golden brown. Makes 8 servings.	One serving (including the crust) equals 220 calories, 1 1/2 fruit exchanges, 1 bread exchange, 2 fat exchanges.

name: SMOTHERED VENISON CUBE STEAK
ingredients:
1  pkg. cubed venison (about 4 pieces)
flour
black pepper
olive oil
Worcestershire sauce
onion
soy sauce
preparation: Heat olive oil in large frying pan.  Use just enough oil to cover bottom of pan.  Mix flour and black pepper to taste.  Dredge meat in flour-pepper mix and brown on both sides in hot oil. After browning, reduce heat and put sliced onion, soy and Worcestershire sauces on top of meat and add enough water to cover meat.  Turn heat to low; cover pan and allow to simmer for about 1 hour.

name: SHRIMP MOUSSE
ingredients:
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened
4 to 6  drops Tabasco sauce
1  can tomato soup (undiluted)
1  c. mayonnaise
1 1/2  pkg. Knox gelatine
1/2  c. very hot water
1  c. celery, finely chopped
1  c. onion, finely chopped
2  c. shrimp, cooked, peeled and chopped
Pam
preparation: Mix cream cheese, Tabasco, soup and mayonnaise.  Soften Knox gelatine in very hot water.  Add to cheese mixture.  Blend celery, onion and shrimp into mixture.  Spray a mold with Pam.  Pour in mixture and chill overnight.  Unmold on a lettuce bed.  Serve with crackers.  Makes 48 servings (1 tablespoon each).

name: HOME STYLE RIBS
ingredients:
4 to 5  lb. boneless spareribs, cut up
1  medium onion, sliced
1  c. ketchup
1/4 to 1/2  c. water
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. cider vinegar
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. ground mustard (I just use yellow mustard)
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. paprika
preparation: Place half the ribs in a slow cooker. Top with half of the onion. Repeat layers. Combine the remaining ingredients; pour over all. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours or until ribs are tender. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: RATATOUILLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. oil
4  onions, sliced thin
3  green peppers, cut in strips or red, green, yellow
1  eggplant
4  zucchini, cubed
5 tomatoes or 1 large  can tomatoes
1 to 2  Tbsp. fennel seed
pepper and salt to taste
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. dill
1/4  c. lemon juice
preparation: Saute onions; add peppers, eggplant and zucchini and cook for 5 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients except lemon juice.  Cover and cook 15 minutes, then sprinkle with lemon juice.

name: APPLE BUTTER AND PEAR CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. brown sugar
2 (9 oz.)  pkg. Pillsbury Plus (yellow)
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. water
1/2  c. apple butter
1/3  c. oil
3  eggs
preparation: Heat oven to 350°. Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch pan.  In a small saucepan, melt margarine.   Stir in brown sugar and heat until sugar is dissolved.  Spread brown sugar mixture into bottom of prepared pan. Cut pear halves into 6 slices.   Arrange on top of brown sugar mixture.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pt. cooked boned chicken
1  pt. milk or chicken broth
1 medium  pkg. Creamette macaroni, uncooked
3  boiled eggs, cut up
2  cans cream of mushroom soup or cream of chicken
1/2  lb. cubed Velveeta cheese
preparation: After mixing ingredients together, pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish and refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour. (A good do-ahead meal and can be frozen for up to 4 weeks.)

name: CHUTNEY EGGS
ingredients:
12  hard-cooked eggs
6  slices crisp cooked bacon, crumbled fine
1/4  c. finely chopped chutney
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise or cooked salad dressing
preparation: Cut eggs in 1/2; remove yolks.  Mash yolks.  Add bacon, chutney and mayonnaise.  With pastry tube, fill white with yolk mixture.

name: CHICKEN DELICIOUS
ingredients:
2  whole boned chicken breasts
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
dry bread crumbs
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2 (3 oz.)  cans sliced mushrooms
4 to 5  slices Muenster cheese
1/2  c. chicken stock
preparation: Cut chicken into pieces.  Soak in salt and beaten eggs for 2 to 3 hours.  Drain; roll in bread crumbs and brown in butter.  Put into baking dish.  Cover with mushrooms and top with cheese. Baste with chicken broth.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
3  chicken breasts
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
2  c. chicken broth
3  Tbsp. sherry (optional)
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. half and half
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook broccoli in salt water.   Drain.  Melt margarine, blend in flour, add broth, cook and stir until thick.  Stir in half and half, salt and dash of pepper.  Place broccoli in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pour 1/2 of the sauce over broccoli, top with chicken.  Add Parmesan cheese to remaining sauce and pour over chicken.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Then broil for 8 minutes.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  taco seasoning mixes
corn tortillas
2  cans Ranch Style beans
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1 to 2  cans Ro-Tel tomatoes
shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook ground beef.  Mix seasoning mix while cooking meat and then drain.  On bottom of pan, spread ground beef, then layer overlapping tortillas.  Pour 1 can Ranch beans and 1 can cream of chicken soup (dab it on the beans).  Add Ro-Tel tomatoes; add cheese on top and repeat all ingredients again; cook at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: EASY PUMPKIN PIE WITHOUT A CRUST
ingredients:
2  c. pumpkin
1/2  c. Bisquick
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. melted margarine
2  Tbsp. pumpkin pie spice
preparation: Mix all ingredients in blender and pour into pie plate that has been sprayed with Pam.  Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes or until set.  Cool.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
1  large onion
3  stalks celery
2  Tbsp. butter
4  c. chicken broth
1  pt. half and half
2  medium potatoes (baking)
milk
preparation: Chop onion and celery.  Saute in butter until soft.  (Do not brown.)  Add broth and simmer 30 minutes.  Dice potatoes and cook. Add to mixture.  Just before serving, add half and half along with milk.  Do not boil after adding milk.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked and drained
3  to 4 servings sliced, cooked chicken or turkey
1  can Campbell's cream of chicken soup
1/3  c. milk
1/3  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Arrange broccoli in bottom of a 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish (10 x 6 1/2-inch).  Top with chicken.  Combine soup and milk; pour over all.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 450° for 15 minutes, or until hot.  Makes 3 to 4 servings.

name: STICKY BUNS
ingredients:
pecans
frozen bread dough
1/2  c. brown sugar
cinnamon
1/2  stick butter, cut up
1  pkg. butterscotch pudding
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease Bundt pan.  Spread pecans on bottom of pan.  Sprinkle with cinnamon.  Spread 1/2 cup brown sugar, butter (cut up) and butterscotch pudding on the bottom of pan.  Place slightly thawed frozen bread dough (cut up) around pan.  Cover with paper towel.  Let sit for 5 hours.  Bake for 30 minutes and turn upside down on plate immediately.

name: GOLDEN WEDDING RINGS
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. salad dressing
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. drained, crushed pineapple
preparation: Blend cream cheese and salad dressing.  Add chopped nuts and pineapple.  Makes about 1 1/2 cups of sandwich filling.

name: BLEU CHEESE DRESSING
ingredients:
1  pt. sour cream
1  tsp. vinegar
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. celery salt
1/2  tsp. onion salt
1  tsp. lemon juice
2 (16 oz.)  pkg. Bleu cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.  Chill before serving.

name: HAMBURGER GOULASH
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  cans tomato soup (condensed)
2  c. cooked macaroni
1  small onion, chopped
1  small green pepper, chopped
1  Tbsp. garlic salt
preparation: In large frying pan, brown beef; drain.  Add in macaroni, onions, peppers and garlic salt.  Mix well.  Stir in tomato soup; cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.  Quick meal!

name: SOUR CREAM CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
chicken filets (1 per person)
green peppers, chopped
onions, chopped
2  cans cream of chicken soup
16  oz. sour cream
corn or flour tortillas
Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Saute peppers and onions.  Add soup and sour cream and bring to a boil.  Cook chicken and cut up.  Cut up tortillas and layer tortillas, chicken and sauce in casserole (2 layers each).  Top with cheeses.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: ITALIAN ASPARAGUS
ingredients:
1  lb. asparagus
1  medium chopped tomato
2  Tbsp. chopped green onion
1/8  tsp. oregano
1/8  tsp. thyme
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook and cover asparagus in a small amount of boiling water for about 4 minutes.  Drain and arrange in a serving platter.  Combine tomato and next 4 ingredients in a small bowl; stir well.  Spoon mixture over asparagus.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Makes 4 servings. Each serving contains 31 calories and 0.5 fat.

name: SALISBURY STEAK
ingredients:
1  can golden mushroom soup
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  c. bread crumbs
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Combine 1/4 cup of the soup with beef, egg, crumbs, onion and seasonings.  Shape into 6 patties that are flat and quite thick. Brown patties in a small amount of oil in skillet.  Drain off excess fat.  Mix remaining soup, water and parsley.  Pour over meat.  Cover and cook over low heat for about 20 minutes.  Stir occasionally.

name: BAKED SOLE WITH MUSHROOM SAUCE
ingredients:
vegetable cooking spray
2  tsp. reduced calorie margarine
3/4  c. minced onion
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  lb. sliced fresh mushrooms
2  Tbsp. water
3  Tbsp. Chablis or other dry white wine, divided
1/4  c. thinly sliced green onions
6  (4 oz.) sole fillets
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray; add margarine.  Place over medium-high heat until margarine melts. Add onion; saute until tender.  Add flour; cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.  Add mushrooms, water and 1 tablespoon wine.  Cook over medium heat 5 to 7 minutes or until mushrooms are tender, stirring constantly and adding 1 tablespoon water, if necessary, to prevent sticking.  Stir in green onions.  Remove from heat; cover and set aside.

name: NO PEEK STEW
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. stew meat
2  medium onions, sliced
2  Tbsp. tapioca
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
4  to 5 medium potatoes, diced
2  c. carrots
1  c. celery
2  c. V-8 juice
preparation: Layer in roaster in order; cover and bake at 250° for 5 hours. Don't peek during cooking time.

name: GREEN ONION DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. dry mustard
7  green onions
preparation: Beat real good in blender.  Gradually add 1 cup oil and beat real good.  Very good taste!

name: QUICK GRANOLA
ingredients:
3  c. quick oats
1/2  c. plain wheat germ
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped almonds
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. sunflower seeds
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. honey
preparation: In large bowl, mix first 7 ingredients.  Add oil and honey and blend until moistened.  Spread on 2 ungreased 15 x 10-inch pans. Bake in 300° oven for 20 minutes, stirring once.  Cool.  Put in airtight container or freeze.  To make Granola Squares, beat 1/2 c. oleo, 1/2 c. brown sugar and 1/2 c. honey.  Add to above granola mix.  Spread in a greased 13x9x2 pan, press down firmly.  Bake 350° for 30 minutes.  Mixture will be soft in center, but will firm when cooled.  Cut into squares.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
devil's food cake mix
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  jar Hershey's chocolate ice cream topping
3  Heath candy bars
Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake per package instructions.  When it is taken out of oven, poke holes in top and pour condensed milk over it.   Top this with Hershey's topping, then top with 3 crushed Heath candy bars and cover with Cool Whip.  Refrigerate until serving.  You can also use German chocolate cake mix, caramel ice cream topping and crushed Butterfingers.

name: MEAT AND VEGETABLE MARINADE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. teriyaki sauce
2  Tbsp. dark brown sugar
juice from 1/2 lime
1  tsp. red pepper flakes
1  Tbsp. fresh ginger, grated
3  garlic cloves, crushed
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  Tbsp. onion flakes
preparation: Mix all in Ziploc bag.  Can place meat and vegetables (squash, broccoli, halved new potatoes, onions, etc.) in a large Ziploc bag. Marinate for 1 hour or more.  Save the marinade for gravy. Add 1/2 cup peanut butter to leftover marinade and cook over medium heat until the gravy is medium thick.  Use over chicken, pork, beef or seafood.

name: BRIE/LINGUINE
ingredients:
4  ripe tomatoes
1  lb. Brie cheese
1/2  c. olive oil
1/2  c. basil, sliced thin
1  tsp. salt
black pepper to taste
4  cloves garlic, minced
1  lb. linguine
preparation: Slice, then cube tomatoes.  Remove rind from Brie and break in small pieces.  Mix all other ingredients, except linguine, and let marinate for a few hours.  Cook linguine eight minutes after second boil.  Pour marinated ingredients over cooked linguine. Toss and enjoy!

name: PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1 (15 oz.)  can spaghetti sauce
1 (15 oz.)  can pizza sauce
small pepperoni
16  oz. rotini noodles
Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Optional: Green peppers, onion, black olives, green olives, sausage, mushrooms, crushed garlic or whatever you like on pizza.

name: WHITE MICE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
6 heaping  tbsp. 10x sugar
2 1/2  c. pastry flour
1  tbsp. vanilla
2  tsp. cold water
1  c. ground pecans
preparation: Mix in order given until creamy.  Shape into crescents or ovals and bake at 350° for 8 minutes.  Do not brown.  Roll in 10x sugar when cool.

name: DEER CHILI
ingredients:
2  lb. ground deer meat
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  medium onions, chopped
4  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. ground cumin
3  cloves garlic
2  Tbsp. flour
red pepper to taste (optional)
2  c. water
preparation: Mix meat and chopped onion and place in open Dutch oven or large skillet.  Place over high heat and stir constantly until meat is thoroughly browned and onions are tender.  Reduce heat and stir in flour thoroughly.  Stir in all remaining ingredients and turn heat very low.  Cover and simmer for 1 hour, stirring only occasionally.  When serving, you may add grated Cheddar cheese to hot chili.  You may need to add additional water while chili is simmering.

name: OATMEAL PICNIC BARS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  c. quick oatmeal
1  stick oleo
2  eggs
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Pour boiling water over oatmeal; stir.  Add oleo and eggs; blend.  Add remaining ingredients.  Spread in a 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan and bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN ROLL
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. pumpkin
3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. 10x sugar
6  oz. cream cheese
4  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Whip together.  Spread over cake evenly and roll the cake up like a jelly roll as tight as you can.  Wrap in tin foil and refrigerate.  Makes one roll.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. sugar
pinch of salt
2  Tbsp. butter
1 tall  can evaporated milk
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips*
1  pt. jar Marshmallow Creme
nuts (optional)
preparation: *Substitute peanut butter chips for peanut butter fudge.

name: MOM'S POTATO PANCAKES
ingredients:
10  large potatoes, grated
3  large onions, grated
1 heaping  Tbsp. flour
3  eggs, separated
salt (optional)
pepper to taste
vegetable oil
preparation: Grate potatoes and onions alternately (onions keep potatoes white).  Add egg yolks and flour to potatoes.  In a separate dish, beat egg whites until fluffy.  Fold into potato batter.  Fry in vegetable oil until golden brown on both sides.  You may top with sour cream, jelly, cream cheese or applesauce.

name: ENGLISH CRABMEAT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. light cream
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1/3  c. dry sherry
dash of salt and pepper
1  lb. flaked crabmeat
bread crumbs (for topping)
preparation: Combine the first seven ingredients in blender and mix until smooth.  Place flaked crabmeat (canned, fresh or frozen) in buttered casserole dish.  Add the mixture to casserole and stir in thoroughly.  Top with bread crumbs and bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

name: PIE CRUST
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. oil
1  egg
1  tsp. vinegar
1/3  c. ice water
preparation: Sift together flour, salt, baking powder and sugar.  Cut oil into dry mixture until consistency of corn meal.  Beat 1 egg well. Add vinegar and ice water.  Stir this mixture into dry ingredients.  Makes 3 large shells.  Dough can be frozen.

name: CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
1 cake yeast or 1  pkg. dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. shortening
2  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. warm milk
3  c. flour
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Mix yeast and warm water.  Add sugar, salt, shortening and warm milk.  Stir well.  Add eggs and stir.  Add flour 1 cup at a time.  Place in greased bowl and cover with towel and let rise in warm place 30 minutes.  Roll out about 1/2 to 1 inch thick.  Spread soft oleo on dough, thick.  Sprinkle with mixture of 3/4 cup sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon.  Roll from long side like jelly roll.  Slice and place on cookie sheet and let rise (covered) for 30 minutes.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.  Ice with a thin powdered sugar icing.

name: CAROL'S CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2 (8.5 oz.)  pkg. corn muffin mix (Jiffy)
8  oz. can creamed corn
2  eggs
1/2  c. plain nonfat yogurt
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4 to 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Combine all in bowl.  Stir until moistened.  Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan (or 14 muffin tin).  Bake at 400° for 17 to 20 minutes.

name: PILGRIM'S PROGRESS PUNCH
ingredients:
32  oz. cranberry juice cocktail
2 (6 oz.)  cans frozen lemonade concentrate
4  c. cold water
1  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Combine all ingredients and serve in punch bowl.  This is a beary tasty punch, not too tart, not too sweet.

name: FUDGE BALLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt (1/4 tsp. for low sodium diet)
3/4  c. butter, softened
2  oz. unsweetened baking chocolate, melted
1/4  c. cold coffee
1 1/2  c. rolled oats (quick-cooking)
1 1/2  c. finely chopped walnuts (more if desired)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Into a large bowl, sift together the flour, sugar and salt.  Add the butter, chocolate and coffee, beating well until smooth, about 2 minutes.  Fold in the rolled oats.

name: KEEBLER 15-MINUTES CHOCOLATE-BANANA CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  Keebler ready-crust chocolate pie crust
1  pkg. (4 serving size) instant vanilla pudding and pie filling
1  envelope (1 1/2 oz.) whipped topping mix
1 1/2  c. cold milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  medium bananas
preparation: In mixing bowl, combine pie filling mix, whipped topping mix, milk and vanilla on low speed of electric mixer until blended. Increase speed and beat until very thick, about 3 minutes.  Pour 1/3 of mixture into crust.  Layer slices of banana on top, reserve 1/2 banana for garnish.  Pour remaining filling into crust.  Chill 2 hours.  Garnish with sliced banana and additional whipped topping, if desired.

name: ZITI WITH BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1  lb. ziti shaped pasta
2  Tbsp. olive oil
2  cloves garlic, crushed
2 (10 oz. each)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and well drained
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
4  c. heavy cream
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook ziti in boiling water until al dente (still a little firm). Drain pasta and place in a large bowl; set aside.  Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and saute garlic until lightly brown, about 1 minute.  Combine garlic, broccoli, Parmesan cheese and heavy cream with ziti.  Spoon mixture into large baking dish.  Top with Mozzarella cheese and bake, covered, for 20 to 30 minutes.  Yield:  8 servings.

name: MAGGIE'S WINTER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
3  hard-boiled eggs
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. mustard
preparation: Mix all ingredients with salt and pepper to taste.

name: EASY ROAST BEEF
ingredients:
1  (2 to 6 lb.) roast
seasoned salt
garlic salt
potatoes
carrots
1  can cream of mushroom or celery soup
preparation: Prepare roast by rinsing and seasoning to taste.  Place roast in crock-pot or roast pan.  Add soup and/or vegetables on top of roast.  If you plan to prepare roast in crock-pot, prepare in the morning and roast will be ready at meal time in the evening.  If the conventional method is used, bake in roast pan for 3 hours at 250°.  The longer the time, the lower the heat, the more tender the meat.  The same method may be used on pork roast and for chicken, minus the vegetables.

name: TEA CAKES
ingredients:
2  c. butter Crisco
4  eggs
10  c. self-rising flour
4  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. almond and vanilla flavoring
preparation: Mix Crisco and sugar until fluffy.  Add eggs and beat again; add baking soda, flour and vanilla.  Mix (will probably need to use hands).  Put in refrigerator overnight.  Take out a little while to soften, then roll into balls (size of quarter).  Put on greased cookie sheet, press flat with a potato masher and cook at 325° until light brown.  Makes a lot of cookies.

name: MOIST BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. each: baking powder, baking soda and salt
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. buttermilk
1 1/4  c. mashed ripe bananas
2  eggs
preparation: Mix dry ingredients (except sugar) in bowl.  Add oil, buttermilk and bananas.  Beat eggs until foamy and thick. Gradually add sugar.  Add egg mixture to dry ingredients.  Pour into greased and floured 8-inch cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Frost with Caramel or Cream Cheese Icing.

name: BROCCOLI SUPREME
ingredients:
3  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1 1/2  c. cream of mushroom soup
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
3  eggs, well beaten
1  1/2 medium onions, chopped
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
2 1/4  c. herb seasoned stuffing bread crumbs
1/4  c. margarine, melted
preparation: Cook broccoli as directed.  Drain well.  Combine soup, mayo, eggs and onion.  Blend in cooked broccoli.  Pour into buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Melt margarine.  Add crumbs and mix well.  Sprinkle over top of cheese.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: TUNA NOODLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. macaroni and cheese mix
1  can peas, drained
2  cans tuna, drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4 to 1/2 soup  can milk
preparation: Cook macaroni according to package.  Put the tuna, peas, milk and soup in a bowl and mix together well.  When the macaroni is done, make it according to the package, then add to the soup mixture.  Heat until bubbly.

name: APPLESAUCE COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. soft shortening
1  c. light brown sugar, packed
1  egg
1/2  c. applesauce
2 1/4  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix thoroughly shortening, sugar and egg.  Stir in applesauce. Sift dry ingredients and stir in.  Mix in raisins and nuts.  Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.  Yields 4 dozen.

name: CRAB CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. cottage cheese
9  eggs
1  stick margarine
8  oz. mock crab
10  oz. chopped spinach, thawed
8  oz. sharp Cheddar
6  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Sprinkle flour over cottage cheese; let set.  Beat 3 egg whites until stiff.  Fold in rest of eggs beaten lightly.  Cube margarine and Cheddar in small pieces.  Cut up crab and spinach. Add all ingredients to egg mixture.  Pour into 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: TWICE BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  potatoes
2  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. cheese
2  Tbsp. sour cream
milk
salt
pepper
fried bacon
preparation: Microwave potatoes for 10 to 15 minutes or bake in oven at 450° for 45 minutes.  Then cut potatoes in half and scoop out the potato into a bowl.  Now add butter, cheese, sour cream, milk, salt, pepper and fried bacon (broken up).  Mix together and put back into potato shells.  Bake in oven at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: CHIP BEEF BREAD DIP
ingredients:
1  loaf round sourdough bread
2  c. mayonnaise
2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. dried parsley
2  tsp. Beau Monde
2  pkg. chipped beef (chopped)
1/2  tsp. minced onion
preparation: Mix ingredients in saucepan and heat (low heat).  Cut middle out of bread making a bowl.  Pour mixture into bread bowl.  Cut remaining bread up into cubes for dippings.

name: BANANA-APPLE MOLD SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry gelatin
1  c. hot water
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1  c. evaporated milk
1  c. diced apple
1  c. diced banana
1/4  c. chopped pecans
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Dissolve  gelatin  in  hot  water.  Let  cool  to  room temperature.  Add  mayonnaise  and milk; mix well.	Add apple, banana, pecans and	lemon juice.  Chill until set.	Unmold and garnish with lettuce leaves.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. steak, cut up in small pieces
1  chopped onion
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  can tomato soup
3 to 4  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce (or to your liking)
1  c. sour cream
1  c. mushrooms (optional)
2  c. Minute rice
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
preparation: Cut steak up; flour and cook in cooking oil until tender.  Add Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper and onion; saute until tender, then add tomato soup and sour cream.  Cook another 10 to 15 minutes.  Add water as needed.  Serve over hot rice.

name: OATMEAL BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. boiling water
2  c. quick rolled oats
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. molasses
1  pkg. dry yeast, dissolved in 1/2 c. warm water
2  eggs
6  c. unbleached flour (more, if needed)
preparation: Pour  boiling  water  over  oats;  cool until lukewarm. Add butter,  salt, molasses and yeast.	Mix in eggs and gradually blend  in  flour,  adding  more,  if necessary.  Knead 10 minutes on	 floured  board.  Cover;  rise	until  double  in greased bowl.  Shape  into	2  loaves.  Spread  with  bit  of butter; sprinkle  with  oats.  Place  in  greased  loaf  pans. Cover.  Let rise  until  double.  Bake	at  350°  for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI PUFF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 10  OZ. pkg frozen chopped broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. shredded sharp processed American cheese (I use Cheddar)
1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  egg beaten
1  Tbsp. melted margarine
1/4  c. fine dry bread crumbs (I use cracker crumbs)
preparation: Cook broccoli according to package directions, omitting the salt; drain thoroughly.  Place broccoli in 10x6x1 1/2 inch baking dish.  Combine soup and cheese, add milk, mayonnaise and egg gradually, stirring until well blended.  Pour over broccoli, combine margarine and bread crumbs; sprinkle evenly over soup mixture.  Bake in preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes or until bubbly and crumbs are lightly browned.  Garnish with parsley.

name: APPLE BARS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. margarine
2  beaten egg yolks
4  medium apples, shredded
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  slightly beaten egg white
preparation: Combine the 2 cups flour, the 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder and salt; cut in butter until crumbs are the size of peas.  Stir in egg yolks; divide mixture in half.  Press 1/2 over bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Combine apples, remaining sugar, flour and cinnamon and arrange over dough.  Crumble remaining dough over apples; brush egg whites over all.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Cool; drizzle thin powdered sugar icing over top; cut in bars.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: TURKEY-STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
4  large sweet red peppers
4  large green peppers
2  Tbsp. olive oil
2  large onions, chopped
2  cloves garlic, finely chopped
1 1/2  tsp. thyme
1 1/2  tsp. rubbed sage
2  lb. ground turkey
1/2  c. fresh parsley, chopped
1  c. dry bread crumbs
2  c. barbecue sauce
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Halve peppers lengthwise; remove seeds. Blanch 5 minutes in a large pot of boiling water.  Drain, cut side down, on paper towels.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
1  grated onion
1  stalk celery, diced
1/4  head shredded cabbage
1  grated carrot
2  Tbsp. butter
3 1/2  c. (1 lb.) hash browns
3  cans chicken broth
2  cans water
1  pkg. browned sausage links
1/3  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. flour
1/4  c. milk
preparation: Cook onion, celery, cabbage and carrot in butter for 10 minutes.  Add the hash browns, broth, water and sausage (cut up); cook until vegetables are done.

name: SALAD SLAW
ingredients:
1  large green lettuce
2  Tbsp. Miracle Whip
3  to 4 medium red tomatoes
preparation: Chop up lettuce.  Dice tomatoes and add to lettuce.  Add Miracle Whip.  Mix well and enjoy.

name: BUTTERMILK POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. Crisco
6  eggs
1/4  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. plain flour
1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix together buttermilk and soda.  Blend sugar and Crisco together.  Add eggs one at a time.  Add milk and flour alternately.  Add vanilla.  Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 25 to 30 minutes.

name: RICH CHOCOLATE CHIP TOFFEE BARS
ingredients:
2 1/3  c. flour
2/3  c. packed light brown sugar
3/4  c. butter or margarine
1  egg, slightly beaten
1 3/4  c. Skor English toffee bits
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1  (12 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  In large bowl, stir flour and brown sugar together.  Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Add egg; mix well.  Stir in 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips and nuts.  Reserved 1 1/2 cups mixture.  Press remaining crumb mixture onto bottom of prepared pan.  Bake 10 minutes.  Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over hot crust; top with 1 1/2 cups toffee bits.  Sprinkle reserved crumb mixture and remaining 1/2 cup chips over top.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.  Sprinkle with remaining toffee bits.  Cool completely in pan on wire rack.  Cut into bars.

name: MUNCHIES
ingredients:
3  c. Rice Chex
3  c. Fruit Loops
1  c. pretzel sticks, broken
3  c. Honey Comb
1  c. nuts (peanuts)
1  c. M&M's
1 1/2  lb. white confectioners coating
preparation: Melt coating.  Mix slightly with cereal mixture.  Pour on wax paper.  Cool and break into pieces.

name: ROLLED TURKEY BREAST WITH RED PEPPER STUFFING
ingredients:
1  onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
7  oz. jar roasted red peppers or fresh peppers, roasted in broiler
3 1/2  Tbsp. butter
3/4  tsp. basil
salt to taste
pepper to taste
1  c. dry bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
4  boneless turkey breasts
3/4  c. water
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Heat butter in frying pan.  Add onion, garlic and basil.  Remove from heat and stir in salt, pepper, bread crumbs and parsley.

name: ZIPPY STUFFED FRANKS
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. butter
3  c. herb stuffing mix, coarsely crushed (measure before crushing)
1/4  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. pickle relish
3/4  c. water
1  lb. large frankfurters (4)
3  slices American cheese, cut into strips
preparation: Cook onion in butter until tender.  In medium mixing bowl, combine crushed herb stuffing mix, onion, catsup, pickle relish and water.  Cut franks lengthwise almost to opposite side.  Mound stuffing mixture in franks.  Place on baking sheet.  Bake in a 400° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.  Place cheese strips atop.  Return to oven; bake 3 minutes or until cheese melts.

name: EASY OPERA FUDGE
ingredients:
1/2  c. maraschino cherries, chopped
1/2  c. oleo
2 (3 1/4 or 3 5/8 oz.)  pkg. coconut cream pudding mix
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  lb. XXX sugar
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Drain cherries on paper towel.  In saucepan, melt butter. Stir in dry mix and milk.  Stir and let come to a boil for one minute.  Stir constantly and remove from heat.  Stir in vanilla. Beat in XXX sugar until smooth.   Stir in cherries and nuts.  Pour in 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish.  Garnish with walnuts.   Chill. Yields 32 pieces.

name: CINNAMON PECANS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. pecans
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Stir and boil until all the water cooks out. Pour onto a cookie sheet and separate until cool.

name: POPPY SEED BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. butter pecan cake mix
1  pkg. instant coconut pudding mix
1/2  c. Wesson oil
4  eggs
1  c. hot water
1/4  c. poppy seed
preparation: Mix cake mix, pudding mix, oil and eggs with electric mixer. Then add poppy seed and hot water.  Bake in 2 greased and floured loaf pans at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: SOUR CREAM COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. chopped nuts
1  yellow cake mix
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
3/4  c. oil
1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients together; set aside.  Mix the remaining 5 ingredients together in the order given.  Pour 1/2 of the cake batter into well-greased Bundt pan.  Pour brown sugar mixture over cake batter.  Pour rest of cake batter into Bundt pan.  Take a knife and mix once through cake.  Bake for 1 hour in a 350° oven.

name: DEEP FRIED CAULIFLOWER
ingredients:
2  lb. cauliflower flowerets
2  eggs, beaten
vegetable oil
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. bread crumbs
1/2  tsp. paprika
preparation: Cook cauliflower in 2-inches water approximately 10 to 12 minutes or until tender.  Drain and pat dry.  Heat oil to 360°, about 1 or 2-inches.  Mix bread crumbs and paprika.  Dip cauliflower in egg, salt and pepper mixture. Coat with bread crumb mixture.  Fry 8 to 10 flowerets at a time in hot oil. Turn occasionally.  Cooking time is 2 minutes.  Drain.  Keep warm in a 200° oven 10 to 15 minutes.  Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
1 large  can refried beans
1  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  or 2 diced tomatoes (as many as desired)
1  can sliced black olives
preparation: Spread refried beans on bottom and sides of an 8-inch pie plate.  Combine sour cream, mayonnaise and taco mix and spread on top of refried beans.  Put Cheddar cheese, tomatoes and black olives on top of sour cream mixture in this order.  Place in refrigerator until ready to serve.  Eat with nachos.

name: PORK CHOP AND LONG GRAIN WILD RICE
ingredients:
6  to 8 pork chops
1  box Uncle Ben's long grain wild rice
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 1/2  cans water
1  can mushrooms, drained
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Salt pork chops; put on top of rice mixture. Cover with foil.  Cook 1 hour and 20 minutes at 350°.  I substitute chicken instead of pork chops.  This is real good reheated.

name: OLD-FASHIONED MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  lb. sausage
1  large onion
1  small green pepper
1  c. ketchup
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, mix ground beef and sausage.  Grate onion and bell pepper.  Mix meat, onion and green pepper.  Put mixture into a loaf pan and spread ketchup over the top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until brown.

name: FETTUCINE WITH MUSHROOMS AND SALAMI
ingredients:
1  lb. thinly sliced mushrooms
1 1/2  sticks butter
1 1/2  c. chopped mild Italian salami
1/3  c. minced scallions
freshly ground pepper to taste
1  c. heavy cream
4  egg yolks
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  lb. fettucine
preparation: Cook mushrooms in butter over moderate heat for 10 minutes, or until liquid has evaporated and butter is golden.  Stir in salami, scallions and pepper; cook for 3 minutes.  Beat cream with egg yolks and Parmesan cheese.  Cook fettucine "al dente."  Drain. Toss with cream mixture.  Transfer to serving dish; spoon mushroom sauce over pasta.

name: Hungarian Goulash
ingredients:
2  lb. lean round steak, cut into 1-inch cubes
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. paprika
4  Tbsp. butter
2  large onions, sliced
1 small  clove garlic, minced
1  green pepper, chopped
1  bay leaf
3  beef bouillon cubes
3  c. boiling water
1/2  can (8 oz.) tomato puree
5  potatoes, cut up
4  carrots, sliced
4  celery stalks, sliced
5  beef bouillon cubes
5  c. boiling water
preparation: In brown paper bag, combine flour, salt, pepper, paprika and beef cubes.  Shake well to coat.  Brown meat in butter; add onions, garlic, pepper and simmer until well coated.  Empty all into large Dutch oven.  Dissolve bouillon cubes (3) in 3 cups boiling water.  Add to Dutch oven.  Bring to boiling point, then lower to simmer; cover and cook slowly for 2 hours.  Add rest of vegetables and additional 5 cups boiling water with the dissolved 5 bouillon cubes and tomato puree.  Bring to a second boil, lower heat and cook until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes. Additional bouillon stock may be added if too thick.

name: CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
1  slice bacon, cut in half
2  Tbsp. diced onion
1  small potato, peeled and diced
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can minced clams (undrained)
1  c. milk
1  stick butter
1  pt. half and half
1/2  pt. whipping cream
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp; drain on paper towels and reserve drippings.  Saute onion in reserved bacon drippings until tender; set aside.  Combine potatoes, water, salt and pepper in a saucepan; cook over medium heat just until potato is tender.  Stir in clams, milk, butter and onion; simmer 3 minutes or until well heated.  Crumble bacon over each serving.  Yields 2 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE-PEANUT BUTTER ICE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
2  pt. chocolate ice cream (slightly soft)
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. ready-to-use chocolate pie crust
22  (1-inch) chocolate peanut butter cups, chopped
1  c. whipped topping
preparation: Spread 1 pint of ice cream on bottom of pie crust.  Arrange 2/3 of chopped candies over ice cream, cover and freeze 1 hour. Spread remaining pint of ice cream over candies.  Cover and freeze 1 hour.  Decorate top of pie with whipped topping and remaining candy.  Freeze uncovered about 2 hours or until firm.  Let stand at room temperature about 10 minutes before cutting.  Cover and freeze remaining pie.

name: CHOCOLATE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
2  c. milk, scalded
2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
4  egg yolks
1/2  c. cold milk
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
5  Tbsp. flour
1/2  stick butter
2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. nuts, chopped
whipped cream
1  (9-inch) pie shell, baked
preparation: Mix milk  with	chocolate and scald.  Mix eggs and cold milk. Beat  into hot mixture.  With whip, add flour, salt and sugar to hot  mixture.  Cook  until	thick.	Add  butter  and vanilla. Pour  into pie shell.  When cold, cover with whipped cream	and sprinkle generously with chopped pecans or walnuts. If you prefer, you may substitute grated chocolate for nuts.

name: APPLE CHUTNEY
ingredients:
3  lb. green cooking apples, peeled, cored and coarsely diced
1  lb. coarsely chopped onions
2  c. white seedless raisins
2  c. dark brown sugar
1 1/2  c. malt vinegar
1  Tbsp. crushed mustard seed
1 1/2  tsp. mixed pickling
spice tied in cheesecloth
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
preparation: In heavy 4 to 5-quart pot, combine apples, onions, raisins, brown sugar, vinegar, mustard seed, pickling spice, ginger and cayenne pepper.  Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, then reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for about 2 hours, or until most of the liquid has cooked away and the mixture is thick enough to hold its shape in a spoon.  Stir often to prevent the chutney from sticking.  Remove from heat and ladle into hot sterilized jars.  Makes 3 pints.

name: GOOD PUFFY FRITTERS(Serves 4)
ingredients:
any fruit or vegetables (such as 1 can corn, peaches, apples or mushrooms), drained
1  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs, well beaten
1/3  c. milk
preparation: Sift  together flour, baking powder and salt. Beat eggs with milk.  Stir remaining ingredients into egg mixture. Beat until smooth  and well blended. Fold in desired vegetables or fruit. Drop by tablespoonfuls into deep oil at 375°. Fry until golden brown.  Remove  with  a  slotted spoon. Drain on paper towel.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple with syrup
1 large  can cherry pie filling
1  box white or yellow cake mix
1/2  c. chopped pecans
2  sticks butter or margarine (into 4 pats)
1/2  c. brown sugar, tightly packed
preparation: Dump in pineapple and cherry pie filling and spread over bottom of buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish or pan.  Sift cake mix evenly over fruit.  Sprinkle with pecans over cake and mix.  Cover with butter pats.  Sprinkle with brown sugar.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: ZUCCHINI APPETIZERS
ingredients:
3  c. grated unpared zucchini (about 4 small)
1  c. Bisquick baking mix
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. dried marjoram or oregano leaves
dash of pepper
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
1/2  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs, slightly beaten
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease oblong pan (use two pans, 13 x 9-inches).  Mix all ingredients; spread in pans.  Bake until golden brown, about 25 to 35 minutes.  Cut into 2 x 1-inch pieces; serve hot or cold.

name: FRESH COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow butter cake mix
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. frozen fresh coconut
2  c. sugar
1  large Cool Whip
16  oz. sour cream
preparation: Prepare cake mix as directed and cut each layer in half, making four layers.  Mix sugar, sour cream and coconut.  Save 1 cup and mix with Cool Whip to ice top and sides.  Put first mixture between layers.  Keep in airtight container in refrigerator for 3 days before serving.

name: CHOC-OAT-CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. (2 sticks) butter, softened
1 1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2 1/2  c. Quaker oats (quick or old-fashioned)
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Beat butter and sugars until creamy.  Add eggs, milk and vanilla; beat well.  Add flour, baking soda and salt; mix well.  Stir in oats, chocolate chips and nuts; mix well. Drop by rounded measuring tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 9 to 10 minutes for chewy cookies or 12 to 13 minutes for crisp cookies.

name: RAVIOLI WITH BROCCOLI RABE(Quincy Pub II)
ingredients:
2  bunches cooked Broccoli Rabe, chopped
2  cloves chopped garlic
2  doz. cheese ravioli, cooked to desired tenderness
4  oz. dry white wine
4  oz. chicken stock
black pepper and Romano cheese to taste
2  oz. blended oil
preparation: Saute minced garlic in a skillet with 2 ounces oil and add Broccoli Rabe for 1 minute.  Deglaze pan with white wine; simmer for 4 minutes.  Add chicken stock, salt and pepper.  Add cooked ravioli and simmer another 4 minutes.  Add Romano cheese to taste.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CHOCOLATE BONBONS
ingredients:
2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. graham cracker crumbs (honey flavored)
3/4  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. flaked coconut
2/3  c. margarine
1/2  c. peanut butter
1 1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
2  Tbsp. Crisco
preparation: In a large bowl, combine the powdered sugar, graham cracker crumbs, pecans and coconut.  In a small saucepan, melt margarine and peanut butter; pour over coconut mixture.  Blend until mixture is moistened.  Shape mixture into 1-inch balls.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can unsweetened pineapple (14 oz.)
1  can fruit cocktail (No. 1 can)
1  can mandarin oranges (11 oz.)
1  box instant lemon pudding
preparation: Drain juice from the oranges and fruit cocktail; don't use.

name: EGG ROLLS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground pork
1  whole onion, chopped
2  eggs
4 to 5  tsp. soy sauce
1  oz. dried mushroom (optional)
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  pkg. clear dried noodles (called nuen)
1 to 2  pkg. egg roll wrappers
shredded carrots and cabbage (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients, excluding wrappers, together.  Next, separate the wrappers and place them diamond-shaped in front of you.
