Place one spoonful of the meat onto one side of one of the corners.  Beginning at that corner, fold the wrapper over the meat and roll until you get to the other corner.  Heat vegetable oil in a skillet.  Place a couple of rolls in the skillet.  Put on medium-high heat.  Fry until golden brown.  Serve with traditional Vietnamese sauce.

name: THREE BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  can kidney beans
1  can green beans
1  can yellow wax beans
1  small green pepper, diced
1  pimento, sliced thin
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. vinegar
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Drain all beans.  Mix sugar, oil, vinegar, salt and pepper. Add beans, green pepper and pimento to oil mixture.  Chill.  Make at least the night before.

name: IMPOSSIBLE HAM 'N SWISS PIE
ingredients:
2  c. cut-up fully cooked smoked ham
1  c. shredded natural Swiss cheese (about 4 oz.)
1/3  c. chopped green onions or chopped onion
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1  c. Bisquick baking mix
1/4  tsp. salt (if desired)
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: The pie that does the impossible by making its own crust. Makes 6 servings.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  yellow cake mix (dry)
1  stick butter, melted
preparation: Layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan in the order given.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BARBECUE PIZZA
ingredients:
bread dough (use homemade or thaw frozen bread dough)
cheese
pizza sauce
toppings
preparation: Roll out bread dough into pizza-size circle.  Put oil and foil on one side.  Cook on barbecue grill over medium heat, oil side down until golden brown.  Put toppings on cooked side (sauce, toppings and cheese).  Place on grill again and cook until golden brown.

name: BUTTER BRICKLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  butter pecan cake mix
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1  bag butter brickle bits (Bits 'O Brickle)
1  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix and bake cake according to directions on box. When cake is done, remove from oven and while cake is hot, punch holes in top with fork.  Pour Eagle Brand milk on top and cool completely. When cake is completely cool, frost with Cool Whip.  Sprinkle butter brickle bits over top.  If unable to find butter brickle bits, crush 2 or 3 Heath bars.  Refrigerate.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. shredded zucchini
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained
3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. nuts
1  c. raisins or dates
preparation: Cream together eggs, sugar, oil, salt and vanilla.  Mix zucchini with pineapple and add with mixture.  In separate bowl, combine flour, soda, powder, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Add to mixture. Then add nuts and raisins or dates.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. hot water
1/2  c. cold water
3  Tbsp. clear jell
2/3  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. white Karo syrup
1/2  tsp. red coloring
1/2  box or 1 1/2 oz. (3 1/2 Tbsp.) strawberry jello
3/4  qt. strawberries or more
1  baked (9-inch) pie crust
preparation: Put in saucepan the clear jell, sugar, salt, Karo syrup and coloring; stir together and add the cold water.  Then add hot water and place on stove to boiling point for 1 minute.  Remove from stove and add the jello.  Stir until dissolved and let cool until just cold, then add washed, drained and cut strawberries. Fill the pie crust and refrigerate until it thickens.  Top with whipped cream or Rich's topping.  Delicious!

name: DUTCH APPLE PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
3  c. sliced, peeled apples
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. flour
1/2  stick butter
1/4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
6  Tbsp. sugar
1  crust pie shell
preparation: Combine 3/4 cup sugar, apples and cinnamon.  Place in saucepan over low heat.  When juice forms, increase heat to medium.  Stir carefully occasionally until apples are done.   Pour into pie shell.  Combine flour, butter, grated cheese and sugar.  Crumble mixture over apples.   Bake at 375° for approximately 45 minutes.

name: BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
Italian bread crumbs
mayonnaise
chicken pieces
preparation: Spread mayonnaise on chicken and dip in bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can crushed pineapple
1  pkg. instant pistachio pudding
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Mix all ingredients well and place in refrigerator.  Will keep for several days.

name: LEMON BARS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. margarine or butter (melt after measured)
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. lemon juice
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients together like pie crust.  Press into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Meanwhile, combine ingredients following and beat well.  Pour over baked crust.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes more.  Sprinkle powdered sugar upon removing from oven.  This is better if it is allowed to sit a day before cutting into squares.

name: COWBOY CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. oleo
1/2  c. nuts, chopped fine
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
2  c. oats
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream together butter and sugars.  Add eggs and vanilla and mix well.  Sift together flour, soda, salt and baking powder.  Add to butter mixture and mix well.  Add oats and nuts and mix.  Fold in chocolate chips.  Drop by rounded spoonful on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

name: SURPRISE HASH BROWNS
ingredients:
12  oz. sour cream
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  can cream of celery soup, undiluted
1  c. milk
1  can Cheddar cheese soup, undiluted
1  large onion, chopped
2  lb. frozen hash brown potatoes, slightly thawed
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix together sour cream, salt, pepper, cream of celery soup, Cheddar soup and milk.  Stir in onions and potatoes.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish and sprinkle cheese on top. Bake, uncovered, 1 1/2 hours at 325°.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: SAUCE FOR CUCUMBERS
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. thyme
1/4  tsp. poultry seasoning
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Put in a jar with enough milk to make it thin and creamy. Shake until all lumps are gone.  Pour over 2 or 3 thinly sliced cucumbers.

name: CRAB DIP
ingredients:
2  lb. crab meat
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  pt. sour cream
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
3  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. dry mustard
3  shakes garlic salt
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients,	except	crab  meat  and Cheddar cheese.  Fold  in  crab meat.  Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top. Bake, uncovered, for 1/2 hour at 350° or until done.  Enjoy!

name: COKIE'S CHICKEN AND FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  large chicken (4 to 5 lb.)
1  c. mandarin oranges, drained
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt/pepper
1/2  c. toasted, slivered almonds
3/4  c. diced celery
1  c. seedless white grapes
1/2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley or 2/3 Tbsp. dried parsley
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. herb seasoning (optional)
preparation: Cook chicken, cool and pick meat.  Discard bones.  Mix mayonnaise, sour cream and onions.  Add this mixture to chicken with the rest of ingredients, gently adding oranges last.

name: DATE-NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. chopped dates
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. boiling water
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. oil
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix dates, nuts and soda.  Add boiling water; cool.  Add remaining ingredients.  Pour into a 4 x 8-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° in oven for 1 hour.  Excellent!

name: ROAST CHICKEN STUFFING
ingredients:
1/2  loaf white bread, cubed (about 8 to 10 pieces)
5  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. parsley
1  c. raisins
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients together until bread has absorbed all the egg.  Lightly salt and pepper chicken cavity and add stuffing.

name: VIELE GOOD QUICHE
ingredients:
2/3  c. milk or cream
12  eggs
8  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, cubed
2  c. ham, cubed
1  c. crumbled cooked bacon
1  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1  can mushrooms
2/3  c. broccoli
2  deep dish pie crusts
preparation: Place cheese, ham, bacon and vegetables in bottom of 2 deep dish pie crusts.  Whip eggs.  Add milk to eggs, then pour 1/2 of mixture over each pie crust.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes to 1 hour, until quiche is formed.  Frozen pie shells work well.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1 3/4  c. sugar
2/3  c. cocoa
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. oil
7  eggs, separated
3/4  c. cold water
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Combine flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder and salt.  Make a well in mixture and add oil, egg yolks, water and vanilla.  Beat with wooden spoon.  Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until frothy, add 1/4 cup sugar and beat to stiff peaks . Pour batter over egg whites and blend.  Pour into ungreased tube pan.   Bake at 325°  for 1 1/2 hours.  Cool and frost with Peanut Butter Frosting.

name: QUICK POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
4  chicken bouillon cubes
4  c. water
2  cans chopped potatoes
1  can chopped carrots
chopped onion
2  cans cream of chicken soup
Velveeta cheese
preparation: Melt Velveeta cheese in the mixture. Serve hot.

name: MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/2  lb. Mexican Velveeta cheese
1  lb. sausage
8  oz. picante sauce
1/2  can evaporated milk
preparation: Brown meat and drain.  Mix all ingredients in crock-pot and heat until cheese melts.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. bread
2  Tbsp. butter
1  egg
1/4  c. sugar
2  c. milk, scalded
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. raisins
preparation: Combine sugar, salt, butter, egg and cinnamon. Add milk slowly, stirring constantly, then bread, raisins and vanilla. Place bowl of ingredients in pan of warm water and bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. white sugar
3/4  can cream
1  stick butter
1  jar marshmallow cream
3/4  c. peanut butter
preparation: Mix up sugar, cream and butter and cook over medium heat on stove.  Stir constantly until it boils.  Let it boil 6 minutes. Take off.  Stir in a jar of marshmallow cream and 3/4 cup of peanut butter.  Pour out.  Let cool, then cut into squares.

name: SOUR CREAM COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
1  c. sour cream
3  c. plain flour
1 small  pkg. frozen coconut
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring
1/2  tsp. yellow cake coloring
dash of salt
preparation: Cream Crisco and sugar until fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time; add sour cream and flour and all other ingredients.  Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: COUNTRY BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. bacon
64  oz. (4 cans) pork and  beans (drained)
12  oz. (1 bottle) chili sauce
1  large onion, chopped
2  c. brown sugar, packed
preparation: Cook bacon and crumble into a large bowl.  Add rest of ingredients, stirring until well blended.  Pour into an ungreased 9x13-inch baking dish.

name: SOUR CREAM ENCHILADAS(Serving Size:  15; Mexican)
ingredients:
5  lb. lean ground beef
1 1/4  c. chopped onion
1 1/4  tsp. salt
30  corn tortillas
1 1/4  c. cooking oil
1 1/4  c. bottled Ortega taco sauce
2 1/2  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
2/3  c. butter
15  Tbsp. flour
5  tsp. instant chicken bouillon
5  c. water
2 1/2  c. sour cream
2/3  c. chopped green chilies
preparation: Cook meat and onion until meat is brown; drain off any excess fat.  Add salt and taco sauce; stir until blended.  Dip tortillas in hot oil; fry quickly until limp.  Drain on paper towels.  Spoon equal portions of the meat mixture onto tortillas.  Top each with 1 tablespoon of Monterey Jack cheese.  Roll up; place seam-side down in a lightly greased 10 x 6-inch baking dish.  In a medium saucepan, melt butter; add flour and bouillon granules, stirring until smooth.  Gradually add water.  Cook, stirring often, until thick.  Remove from heat and stir in sour cream and chilies.  Pour mixture over rolled tortillas.  Top with remaining cheese.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

name: RANCH OYSTER CRACKERS
ingredients:
3/4  c. salad oil
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1/4  tsp. lemon pepper
12 to 16  oz. plain oyster crackers
1  envelope Ranch milk recipe salad dressing mix
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Whisk together salad oil, dill weed, lemon pepper, garlic powder and Ranch dressing mix.  Pour over crackers, stirring to coat.  Place on baking sheets and bake at 275° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Makes 11 to 12 cups.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  stick butter, melted
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
preparation: Mix flour, sugar and cocoa. Add butter, egg and vanilla; mix well. Add nuts. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. You can use a 9 x 9 for thick brownies or 13 x 9 for thinner brownies.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
15  roma or plum tomatoes
1  large red (purple) onion
1 small to medium garlic, minced or 2  oz. minced garlic in jar
1  large green pepper
4  large jalapeno peppers
1 large  bunch cilantro
1/2  c. lime juice
1 1/2  tsp. hot sauce or 1 tsp. crushed red peppers
1  tsp. black pepper
2  tsp. salt
1  can Ro-Tel (mild, medium or extra hot) tomatoes
preparation: Wash all vegetables well. Dice tomatoes, green pepper, onion and  jalapeno in small cubes. Cut and dice cilantro (discard stems). Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl, except lime juice. Mix well and then add lime juice.

name: CRISP ZUCCHINI PANCAKES
ingredients:
3  medium shredded zucchini (about 1 lb.)
3/4  tsp. salt
1  medium onion, finely chopped (1/2 c.)
1  Tbsp. butter
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/4  c. flour
1/8  tsp. pepper
canola oil for frying
preparation: Put shredded zucchini in colander.  Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt; set aside for 30 minutes.  Squeeze as much liquid as possible from zucchini with your hands; reserve.  Saute onions in hot butter in a skillet over medium-high heat until soft. Transfer reserved zucchini and onion to large bowl.  Stir in eggs, flour and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper.

name: STRAWBERRY PUDDING
ingredients:
1  qt. strawberries, sliced
1/2  c. sugar
1 small  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
3  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1  c. sour cream
3  c. cold milk (to be used for pudding instead of amount on box)
1  large Cool Whip
1  box vanilla wafers
preparation: Heat strawberries,  sugar  and  Jell-O  just  enough  to dissolve Jell-O,  stirring  constantly.  Cool.  Mix pudding and milk by directions on box.  Add sour cream.  Fold in 3/4 ounces Cool Whip.  In  large  13  x  9  x  1/3-inch dish layer wafers, pudding mix  and strawberries.  Repeat until all are used.  Top with remaining  Cool  Whip.  Garnish  with sliced strawberries. Refrigerate.

name: CHICKEN RISOTTO
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. oil
3  c. sliced mushrooms
1  medium onion, chopped
2  slices bacon, cut up
1  c. uncooked regular long grain rice
2 1/3  c. water
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  chicken bouillon cubes, crumbled
2  c. cut up, cooked chicken
1/2  c. thinly sliced dried apricots
1/2  c. chopped dates
1/4  c. chopped, unsalted cashews
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
2  green onions, sliced
preparation: Heat oil in skillet over medium heat.  Cook mushrooms, onion and bacon in oil over medium heat for 10 minutes until vegetables are tender.  Stir in rice; cook for 5 minutes.  Stir in water, soy sauce and bouillon.  Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat.  Cover and simmer for about 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Cover and let stand 15 minutes before serving.

name: MOLASSES CRINKLES COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. molasses
2 1/4  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
preparation: Mix together the first four ingredients.  Stir in the rest. Chill at least an hour.  Roll into balls; dip in sugar.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: MISSISSIPPI CORNBREAD SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cornbread muffin mix
1 (1 oz.)  envelope Ranch Style dressing mix
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
3  large tomatoes, chopped
1/2  c. chopped red bell pepper
1/2  c. chopped green onions
2  (16 oz.) black beans or pinto beans, drained
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
10  bacon slices, cooked and crumbled
2 (15 1/4 oz.)  cans whole kernel corn
preparation: Prepare cornbread mix according to package directions; cool. Stir together salad dressing mix, sour cream and mayonnaise until blended; set aside.  Combine tomatoes and next 3 ingredients; gently toss.  Crumble half the cornbread into a 3-quart trifle bowl or large salad bowl.  Top with half each of beans, tomato mixture, cheese, bacon, corn and dressing mixture; repeat layers.  Cover and chill 3 hours.  Yields 8 to 10 servings.

name: BLUEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. grape jello
1 1/2  c. hot water
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple and juice
1 (21 oz.)  can blueberry pie filling (I use lite)
preparation: Mix the ingredients and chill until set.

name: BEAN DIP
ingredients:
1  oz. cream cheese
1/2  can Hormel chili with beans
1/2  can Hormel chili without beans
shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
tortilla chips
preparation: Layer all the ingredients in order listed.  Bake in 300° oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until the cheese is melted.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: HOT FRUIT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can Mandarin oranges
1  can pineapple chunks
4  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
5  slices white bread, cubed
preparation: Cream the margarine with sugar. Add eggs.  Mix well with drained fruit and bread.  Pour into 2-quart greased casserole and bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: TERIYAKI CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  fryer, cut up
1/8  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. ginger, freshly grated
1/2  c. soy sauce
1  clove garlic, crushed
3  Tbsp. sake
preparation: Mix all in bowl.  Add to skillet with a little oil; cook about 30 minutes on medium heat, turning chicken a couple of times. Serve on cooked rice bed.

name: MRS. WAFFSIE'S SOUR CREAM COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  cubes butter
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
3 1/2  oz. pkg. chopped pecans
4  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and vanilla.  Mix in eggs and sour cream. Sift together flour, baking soda and baking powder and add to cream mixture.  Set aside.  Mix chopped nuts and sugar in another bowl.  Pour half of batter in an ungreased 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish, spreading evenly.  Sprinkle half of nut-sugar topping.  Add top layer of batter.  Sprinkle on remaining topping. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serves 12.  A New Year's morning tradition in the Worth family.

name: MARINARA SAUCE
ingredients:
1  onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. garlic
3 large  cans crushed tomato
oregano
basil
2  bay leaves
1/2  tsp. sugar
pinch of salt
1  Tbsp. olive oil
pepper
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil. Add crushed tomato. Bring to a simmer and add sugar. Then add salt, bay leaves and as much oregano, basil and pepper as you like. Heat all together and remove bay leaves before serving.

name: HOT APPLE SPICED TEA
ingredients:
2  qt. apple juice
4  orange spice herbal tea bags
1  or 2 cinnamon sticks
1  tsp. whole cloves
2  strips orange zest (optional)
preparation: Combine apple juice, tea bags, cinnamon sticks and cloves in saucepan and heat slowly until simmering.  Let steep 5 minutes, then remove tea bags.  Add orange zest; cover and simmer 5 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND VEGETABLES(Microwave)
ingredients:
1/2  c. thinly sliced celery
1/2  c. thinly sliced green pepper rings
1  (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) chicken, cut up
salt and pepper
1/2  c. thinly sliced carrots
1/2  c. thinly sliced zucchini
3  Tbsp. Dijon-style mustard
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Combine celery, carrots, green pepper and zucchini.  Spread evenly over bottom of greased shallow microwave-safe baking dish. Arrange chicken pieces toward outside of dish.

name: TOMATO AND APPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (no. 2)  can quartered apples
2 1/2  c. tomatoes (not whole; do not use all the juice; these can be home canned)
1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. oleo or butter
3  slices toasted bread
nutmeg
salt
preparation: Make alternating layers of apples and tomatoes.  Season with a little salt and nutmeg. Sprinkle sugar on top, then top with bread crumbs.  Dot  with  oleo  and  bake  at 350° for 45 minutes.  Use 1 quart casserole. Serves 4 to 6.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
20  oz. frozen broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
2  eggs, well beaten
1/2  c. onion, chopped fine
1  stick butter, melted
2/3  c. hot water
2  c. Earth Grain stuffing mix
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.   Cook and drain broccoli.  Add all other ingredients.  Mix well (you may need to use your hands). Bake in 9 x 13-inch baking dish or large casserole dish, uncovered.   Bake about an hour, until brown.

name: SPINACH-ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. fresh spinach
1/2  head Boston lettuce
2  small oranges, peeled and sectioned
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. orange juice
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: In large bowl, tear spinach and lettuce into bite-size pieces. Add oranges.  In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients.  Pour over salad and toss gently to coat.  Cover and refrigerate about 1 hour.

name: CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  large cauliflower, chopped
1  small onion
1  green pepper, chopped
1  lb. bacon, fried and crumbled
1  c. grated cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all vegetables together.  Blend cheese and mayonnaise together and mix with vegetables.  Keep refrigerated.

name: ROLLED SUGAR COOKIE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
4  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. milk
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add eggs; add flour, milk and vanilla and mix thoroughly.  Roll out; cut and bake 10 minutes at 375°.

name: LACY PECAN COOKIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. ground pecans
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
1  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a 10-inch skillet.  Cook over medium heat, stirring, until blended.  Keep warm.  Drop batter by teaspoonfuls, about 3 inches apart, onto greased baking sheets (place 4 cookies on each).  Bake in a 350° oven for 5 minutes, or until golden brown.  Cool on baking sheet 1 minute.  Loosen cookies with pancake turner.  Turn over and roll around the handle of a wooden spoon.  Slide off and cool on rack.  Work quickly.  If cookies become too hard to shape, return to oven for 1 minute to soften.  When cooled, store in airtight container.  Makes 32.

name: CHRISTMAS FRUIT COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. whiskey
1  lb. white seeded raisins
1/2  lb. candied pineapple
1/2  lb. candied cherries
1/4  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. nutmeg and cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. buttermilk
1  lb. pecans
preparation: Pour whiskey over raisins, pineapple and cherries.  Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time.  Mix spices with flour. Dissolve soda in buttermilk.  Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture.  Add fruit mixture and pecans. Drop from teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake 20 minutes at 300°.  Cookies not only keep well but improve after 2 or 3 days. Yield:  6 dozen cookies.

name: *DEVIL'S FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. cocoa
1  tsp. soda
1/2  c. boiling water
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. vinegar
1 7/8  c. flour, sifted
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine cocoa, soda and boiling water in small bowl; set aside.  Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and vanilla and beat. Add cocoa mixture and beat.  Combine milk and vinegar.  Sift salt with flour.  Add alternately to batter.   Bake 30 minutes in 350° oven.  Makes 2 (8-inch) layers or 9 x 15-inch loaf.

name: FRANK'S DURN GOOD CHICKEN SOUP STARTER(With zero added salt and near zero fat.)
ingredients:
3  c. diced tomatoes
1  c. 1/4-inch cubed potatoes
1  c. slivered carrots
10  oz. frozen peas
10  oz. frozen green beans
1  Tbsp. chopped chives (dry)
1  Tbsp. cilantro (Spanish parsley)
1  Tbsp. regular dry parsley
1  c. finely diced celery
1/2  tsp. ground black pepper
1  tsp. ground cumin
1  tsp. ground coriander
1/3  c. regular long grain rice
1/4  c. lentils
1/4  c. pearled barley
1/2  c. couscous (fine grained semolina)
preparation: As the chicken is timing out on the boil, get out your trusty 8 to 10-quart soup pot.  Put about 3 quarts of water in it and put the heat on full (you are going to be adding so many ingredients that it won't boil right away).  Add ingredients to soup pot.

name: SPAGHETTI-GRATIN
ingredients:
1  lb. spaghetti
3  Tbsp. parsley
4  to 5 tomatoes, boiled and peeled
7  oz. Gruyere cheese
8  oz. bacon
2  onions
1  c. cream
1  tsp. butter
salt
pepper
paprika
oregano
basil
preparation: Butter a baking dish.  Put in al dente cooked spaghetti with parsley and oregano.  Slice tomatoes over spaghetti.  Sprinkle basil on top.  Grate cheese; sprinkle on top, then sprinkle crumbled bacon and chopped onions.  Pour heavy cream over entire mixture.  Add salt, pepper and paprika.  Put in preheated 350° oven.  Bake 20 minutes until heated through and cheese is melted. Serves 4 to 6.

name: "DOWN THE BAY" SALAD
ingredients:
1  can English peas
1/4  c. chopped sweet pickle
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
1/4  c. diced Cheddar cheese
mayonnaise
chopped celery (optional)
preparation: Mix vegetables and cheese.  Add chopped eggs.  Toss with enough mayonnaise to coat all ingredients.  (Adjust amount of ingredients to suit individual taste.)

name: CALIFORNIA SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, in pieces
1  head cauliflower, in pieces
1  red onion, thinly sliced
1  lb. bacon, fried and crumbled
2  c. Miracle Whip
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Layer first four ingredients in a bowl.  Cover with Miracle Whip, sprinkle with sugar and top with Parmesan cheese.  Cover and chill.

name: HIDDEN VALLEY RANCH QUICHE LORRAINE
ingredients:
1  (8-inch) pie shell, baked and cooled
1  c. grated Swiss cheese
3  large eggs
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing mix
2  Tbsp. bacon bits
1 1/4  c. heavy whipping cream
preparation: Preheat  oven  to  400°.  Sprinkle cheese in pie crust. Whisk eggs until frothy.  Add other ingredients and mix.  Pour over cheese.  Bake  15 minutes; reduce heat to 350°.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes, until center is set.  Cool.  Serves 8.

name: QUICK FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
3/4  stick margarine
3/4  c. sifted flour
1 large  can unsweetened fruit
2  tsp. baking powder
dash of salt
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Melt butter in casserole dish.  Mix flour and other dry ingredients with 1 c. sugar and milk.  Stir until well blended. Pour batter into casserole with butter.  Add 3/4 c. sugar to fruit and heat.  Pour into batter.  Bake in 350° oven until browned.

name: STRAWBERRY DREAM
ingredients:
2  c. unsalted pretzels
2  Tbsp. sugar
3/4  c. melted butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
2  c. miniature marshmallows
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
2 (12 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, partly thawed
1  c. boiling water
1  c. cold water
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Crush pretzels.  Mix pretzels, sugar and butter (melted).  Press into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 15 minutes.  Cool completely.  Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar in large bowl.  Fold in Cool Whip and marshmallows.  Spread on top of cooled crust.  Mix Jell-O with boiling water; mix well.  Add cold water and partly thawed strawberries.  Put on top.  Chill for 2 hours.

name: BLUEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. jello (blackberry or blueberry)
1  can blueberries
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  c. chopped pecans
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water; drain blueberries and pineapple (save the juice).  Measure out 1 cup of the juice and add to jello mixture.  Take pineapple and berries and add to mixture.  Place in refrigerator until congealed.

name: PUMPKIN PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. cooked pumpkin
1/2  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
1  pkg. instant pudding
1/2  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Cook the pumpkin, then mix all ingredients together.  Serve either warm or chilled.

name: OLD FASHIONED BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. cornstarch-flour
dash of salt
4  eggs
3  c. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
vanilla wafers
6  bananas
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients and cook on medium-low heat, stirring often, for 30 to 45 minutes.  Remove from heat and let cool.  Layer cookies, bananas and pudding.  Garnish with sliced bananas and cookies.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
3/4  c. butter
1  c. evaporated milk
14  oz. pkg. caramels
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Prepare cake mix as directed.  Pour 1/4 to 1/2 batter into a 9 x 12-inch or a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 15 minutes at 350°.

name: GRILLED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. oil
1  c. vinegar
5  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
5  chicken halves
preparation: Mix oil, vinegar, salt, pepper and poultry seasoning.  Brush chicken halves with sauce.  Cook slow, turning every 15 minutes to prevent burning.  Serves 5.

name: BONBON CANDY
ingredients:
2  lb. powdered sugar
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. coconut
3  c. chopped nuts
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  stick butter
1  (12 oz.) chocolate chips
1/2  stick paraffin
preparation: Mix nuts, butter and coconut.  Mix well. Add Eagle Brand milk, vanilla and powdered sugar.  Mix well.  Roll into small balls. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin in double boiler.  Dip balls into chocolate.  Place on wax paper until set.

name: HAWAIIAN PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
1 small  can crushed drained pineapple
1  can Angel Flake coconut
3  bananas
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  small container Cool Whip
1  c. chopped pecans
1/4  c. lemon juice (concentrated)
maraschino cherries
preparation: Mix milk, sugar and lemon juice together.  Spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish.  Slice bananas in circle on top of first layer.  Spread drained pineapple next.  Spread coconut over pineapple.  Spread Cool Whip next.  Spread nuts next.  Add maraschino cherries on top.  Let stand overnight in refrigerator.

name: TACO SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (16 oz.)  jar mild taco sauce
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed tomatoes
1  can each: black beans, kidney beans, pinto beans and corn (whole kernel)
1  medium onion, diced
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes with chilies
preparation: Brown beef and onions. Drain and put in crock-pot. Add remaining ingredients. Cook for 1 hour on high or until heated thoroughly. When ready to serve, serve with the following toppings: sour cream, grated cheese, green onions, corn chips and diced tomatoes.

name: JANE'S DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (10 oz.)  jar Smucker's sweet orange marmalade
1  c. chopped nuts
cream cheese (at room temperature)
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Serve with assorted crackers.

name: PUMPKIN CARE RING WITH LEMON GLAZE
ingredients:
1 (18 1/2 oz.)  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
2  eggs
water
1  c. Libby's solid pack pumpkin
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine cake mix and spices in bowl; add eggs and water as directed on cake mix package, substituting pumpkin for 1/3 cup of the water.  Mix as directed.  Stir in nuts.  Pour batter into greased 10-inch tube pan.  Bake in 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until done.  Cool for 10 minutes; remove from pan and glaze with 1 cup powdered sugar, 1 tablespoon lemon juice and 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon rind.  Add just enough cream to make glaze slightly runny.

name: EASY SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1  tenderized round steak
3  cans stewed tomatoes (Italian or Mexican style tomatoes add best flavor)
preparation: Trim steak and cut into serving size pieces.  Place in crock-pot and cover with tomatoes.  Cook on low for 3 to 4 hours. May be served over rice or potatoes.  The leftovers make excellent starter stock for stew.

name: SPINACH SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh spinach
1  pt. fresh strawberries, sliced
1/2 to 1  c. toasted pecans
preparation: Clean spinach.  Tear into bite size pieces.  Place in bowl. Top with strawberries.  Pecans can be toasted in saucepan with melted butter.  Stir constantly.

name: CHILI CON CARNE
ingredients:
2 to 3  Tbsp. butter, melted
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1 to 2  lb. ground beef
1 3/4  c. canned tomatoes
2  c. canned kidney beans
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  bay leaf
1  tsp. sugar
chili powder to taste
preparation: Saute the onion in the butter.  Add ground beef and cook until well done.  Add 1 3/4 cups canned tomatoes and some water.  Add the beans, salt, bay leaf, sugar and chili powder.  Cover and cook slowly for about 1 hour.  Serve with tortillas or crackers.

name: CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower
1  large carrot
1  small onion
1  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2 small  jar mayonnaise (do not use salad dressing)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cut cauliflower to florets, bite size chunks.  Grate the carrot and chop onion fine.  Let cream cheese soften to room temperature to mix well.  Add enough mayonnaise to mix well.  Add salt and pepper to taste.

name: CATSUP
ingredients:
2  c. tomato paste
1/4  c. honey
2  tsp. onion powder
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/4  c. oil (optional)
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Stir together.  Chill.  If too thick, thin with water.

name: HOMEMADE SOUTHERN BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
1 heaping  Tbsp. Crisco shortening
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Knead flour, shortening and milk together until tacky.  Roll out; cut with a small cup.  Place in a cast-iron skillet; bake until lightly brown.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1 2/3  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
2  eggs
1/2  c. salad oil
1  c. canned pumpkin
1  c. dates or nuts
preparation: Sift flour.  Add sugar, soda, baking powder, salt and spices into large bowl.  Beat eggs, oil and pumpkin.  Add to sifted dry ingredients, stirring until just moistened.  Fold in nuts.  Turn into greased 8 x 4-inch or 9 x 5-inch pans.  Bake at 375°.  Serves 4.

name: CABBAGE ROLLSRoswell, New Mexico
ingredients:
2  large heads of cabbage
2  lbs. hamburger meat
1 1/2  c. instant rice (uncooked)
Chopped onion - salt and pepper to taste
3/4  c. of catsup - more if desired
2  eggs
preparation: Roast and peel 10-12 green chilies and stuff with strips of colby or cheddar cheese, leaving stems on.  Dip and fry in batter.

name: SNACK CRACKERS
ingredients:
1  bag oyster crackers
1  pkg. powdered Ranch or party dip
1  Tbsp. dill powder
pinch of garlic powder
1/2  c. oil
preparation: In a grocery bag, place all ingredients, adding oil last. Roll bag top closed and shake.  Air dry on cookie sheet for 1 hour.

name: CALIFORNIA CREAM SOUP
ingredients:
1  can (10 1/2 oz.) cream of celery soup
1  can (10 1/2 oz.) cream of chicken soup
2  c. milk
2/3  c. light cream
3/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  medium avocado, peeled and chopped
1/4  c. sliced pitted ripe olives
1/4  c. chopped pimiento
preparation: Combine all soups, milk, cream, salt and pepper.  Simmer over low heat, stirring.  Add avocado, olives and pimiento; heat thoroughly.  Serves 6.

name: METHODIST WOMEN'S SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Mix.  Makes about 3 cups.

name: BOJANGLE'S BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. Crisco
3/4 to 1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix all ingredients gently.  Roll out on wax paper, keeping dough about 1/2 to 1 inch thick.  Cut out with biscuit cutter. Place on greased cookie sheet.  Baste with butter before and after baking.  Makes 10 to 12 biscuits.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: WONDERFUL VEGETABLE BARS
ingredients:
2  pkg. crescent rolls (8 each)
3/4  c. Miracle Whip or mayonnaise
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  envelope Hidden Valley Ranch mix
3/4  c. green pepper, finely chopped
3/4  c. green onion, finely chopped
3/4  c. tomato, finely chopped
3/4  c. broccoli, finely chopped
3/4  c. cauliflower, finely chopped
3/4  c. mushrooms, finely chopped
3/4  c. carrots, finely chopped
3/4  c. Cheddar cheese, finely chopped
preparation: Cover bottom of 11 x 17-inch ungreased pan, with rolls. Bake at 350° for 7 to 8 minutes.  Rolls should start to brown, but not quite done.  Cool.	Mix cream cheese, Miracle Whip or mayonnaise and  dressing  mix.  Spread on rolls.  Sprinkle on vegetables. Cover  with  wax  paper  or  Handi-Wrap and press down.  Chill 3 to 4 hours and then cut into bars and serve.

name: GINGER AND PEACH CHICKEN(Serves 4)
ingredients:
4  medium (12 oz. total) boned, skinless chicken breast halves
1 (8 oz.)  can peach slices in light syrup
1  tsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. grated ginger root or 1/8 tsp. ground ginger
1/4  tsp. salt
1  can sliced water chestnuts, drained
2  c. hot cooked rice
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. frozen pea pods, cooked and drained (optional)
preparation: Spray a large skillet with nonstick spray coating.  Preheat skillet over medium heat.  Add chicken.  Cook over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender and no longer pink; turn to brown evenly.  Remove from skillet; keep warm.

name: ORANGE SLICED BARS
ingredients:
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. light brown sugar
2  c. flour
14 to 20 orange  slices (candy)
1  c. walnuts
preparation: Mix together.  Spread out on a well greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 15-20 minutes.

name: COUNTRY CLUB GOULASH
ingredients:
2  pkg. gizzards
1  pkg. chicken livers
2  onions (medium size)
2  bell peppers
preparation: Cook livers by themselves until tender.  Let juice boil down to about 2 cups of juice.  Pressure cook gizzards about 1 hour on low.  Add 2 tablespoons corn oil; stir in onions and peppers and put lid on for a while and stir down.   Mix together cooked livers and gizzards; pour in onions and peppers.  Use the oil from onions, add 1/2 cup flour and brown like gravy (thick).  Take juice from livers and gizzards; pour all together.  Bring to boil. Serve over rice.

name: MARINATED DUCK
ingredients:
2  ducks
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  small onion, chopped
2  garlic cloves, minced
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. dry red wine
1  tsp. ground ginger
2  bay leaves, crumbled
preparation: Cut ducks in half lengthwise.  Place in plastic bag in shallow pan.   Combine remaining ingredients and pour over duck.  Cover and marinate overnight in refrigerator, turning occasionally.

name: DESSERT BROWNIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. cocoa
3/4  c. oleo
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. nuts
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt cocoa and oleo in 1 1/2-quart saucepan.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CRANBERRY CHEESE BARS
ingredients:
2  c. unsifted flour
1 1/2  c. oats
3/4  c. plus 1 Tbsp. packed brown sugar
1  c. oleo (softened)
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  (8 oz.) softened cream cheese
1  (14 oz.) condensed milk
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  (16 oz.) whole berry cranberry sauce
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large bowl combine flour, oats, 3/4 cup sugar and oleo.  Mix until crumbly.  Reserving 1 1/2 cups crumb mixture, press remainder on bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake 15 minutes.  In small bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk; stir in lemon juice. Spread evenly over prepared crust.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3  sticks butter
3  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
6  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift flour, soda and salt together, then add eggs, sour cream and vanilla.  Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each one.  Add flour mixture and sour cream alternately. Add vanilla.  Pour in greased and floured tube pan and bake 1 1/2 hours at 325° or until cake stays in place when touched lightly with finger.  Cake will pull away from pan slightly.

name: MRS. VINSON'S OLD-FASHIONED TEA CAKES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1/4  c. shortening
1  tsp. vanilla
flour (self-rising)
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Mix sugar, eggs, shortening and vanilla in medium sized bowl.  Add flour to make dough.  Roll out thin. Cut with biscuit cutter and bake 8 minutes (be sure to time). When bottoms get brown, put oven on broil.  Watch closely to brown tops (only takes a minute).

name: MEATBALLS WITH MUSHROOM SAUCE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. bread crumbs
1 (5 1/3 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. butter
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 1/4  c. water
preparation: Combine thoroughly beef, bread crumbs, milk, onion, garlic salt and pepper.  Shape into 35 meatballs.  Chill 1 hour.  Melt butter in electric skillet.  Brown meatballs.  Spoon out extra grease.  Combine soup and water.  Add to meatballs and bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer 30 minutes.

name: BRUNCH DISH
ingredients:
8  slices bread
1  pkg. sausage links or ham, cut up
2  c. Cheddar cheese
2 1/4  c. milk
5  eggs
2  tsp. dry mustard
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix well together the 2 1/4 cups milk, eggs and dry mustard. Layer half of the first 3 ingredients with half of the egg mixture. Repeat.  Refrigerate overnight.  Before baking, mix the soup with the 1/2 cup milk.  Mix well and pour over top.  Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: FRANK-BEAN BAKE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can red kidney beans, drained
1 (17 oz.)  can lima beans, drained
1/4  c. spaghetti sauce
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
4  to 6 frankfurters
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Mix beans, sauce, onion and cheese in ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Arrange frankfurters on top. Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes or until bubbly.

name: DEATH BY CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1/2  pkg. Nabisco chocolate wafers
softened butter
1  gal. softened high-quality ice cream
fudge sauce
whipped cream
slivered almonds
preparation: Crust:  Crush 1/2 package Nabisco chocolate wafers in a blender.  Add enough softened butter to make the crumbs hold together, press into a 9-inch pie pan and chill.

name: PINK PUNCH
ingredients:
2  c. boiling water
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
6  c. cold water
1/2  c. sugar
1  can frozen orange juice
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1  can frozen lime or lemonade
1  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Add boiling water to jello.  Stir until dissolved.  Add cold water, juice and sugar.  Chill.  When ready to serve, add ginger ale.  Makes 1 1/2 gallons.

name: PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1/2  c. sugar
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  c. nuts
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1/4  lb. cheese, grated
1  c. hot water
preparation: Mix Jell-O.  Let cool. Cook sugar and pineapple 3 minutes. Put into Jell-O and let cool; start to gel.  Grate cheese, then mix in Jell-O and add nuts.   Fold in whipped cream.  Chill until firm.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. peeled sliced apples
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
3/4  c. vegetable oil
2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. chopped pecans
Apple Dessert Sauce (recipe follows)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. In large bowl, stir together apples and sugar. Add dry ingredients. Stir well. In separate bowl, beat eggs, oil and vanilla. Stir egg mixture into apple mixture, blending until thoroughly moistened. Stir in pecans. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 50 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed. Serve with warm Apple Dessert Sauce. Yields 12 to 15 servings.

name: MOTHER'S CHOCOLATE CARAMELS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  Tbsp. white corn syrup
3/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts (pecans)
preparation: Mix all ingredients except walnuts and cook until it will form a ball in cold water.  Pour in buttered pan and sprinkle with pecans or nuts.  When cool, cut in 1/2-inch squares and roll in wax paper.

name: BANANA SNACK CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine or butter, softened
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk*
1  c. (2 medium) bananas, mashed
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. Pillsbury's Best
all-purpose or unbleached flour**
1  c. quick cooking rolled oats
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
6  oz. pkg. (1 c.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease 13 x 9-inch pan.  In large bowl, combine margarine, sugar and eggs; mix well.  Stir in buttermilk, bananas and vanilla; blend thoroughly.  Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off.  Stir in flour, oats, soda and salt; mix well.  Stir in chips.  Spread batter in prepared pan.  Sprinkle nuts evenly over top.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Makes 20 to 24 servings.

name: GERMAN BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1 (1 lb. 13 oz.)  can baked beans
1  lb. hamburg
2  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  small onion, chopped
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. ketchup
3/4  c. applesauce
salt to taste
bacon (optional)
preparation: Brown hamburg and onion in butter.  Combine with the remaining ingredients in large casserole.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.  May be topped with strips of bacon before baking.

name: CLASSIC CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. cooked chicken, diced (2 to 3 breasts)
1  c. finely chopped celery
1  c. small seedless grapes
1  c. toasted slivered almonds
1  tsp. minced onion or more (to taste)
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. Cool Whip
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Combine all ingredients and cover.  Chill for several hours before serving.

name: HOLIDAY BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  large eggs, lightly beaten
1  c. ripe banana, mashed
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
1-1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1/4  c. flaked coconut
1/4  c. raisins
preparation: Combine first four ingredients, then combine the next 3 ingredients and add to banana mixture, stirring until well blended.  Add last 3 ingredients and spoon batter into greased and floured 8-1/2 x 4-1/2 x 3 inch loaf pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour 10 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cover with aluminum foil last 15 minutes if needed to keep from getting too brown.  Yield one loaf.

name: MEXICAN ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. sour cream
2  jalapeno peppers, chopped
10  green onions, chopped
1  pkg. grated Cheddar cheese
10  flour tortillas
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients and spread on tortillas (spread thickly and to edges).  Roll up tortillas.  Refrigerate overnight in airtight container or wrap individually in plastic wrap.  They will keep for days.

name: PINK SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. raspberry jello
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  box Dream Whip, whipped
1  c. cottage cheese
3/4  c. nuts
preparation: Bring pineapple and the juice to a boil, stir in jello.  Let cool.  Add cottage cheese, nuts and Dream Whip whipped.  Pour into mold.  Chill overnight.

name: PECAN CRISPIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
2  eggs, beaten
1/8  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. packed brown sugar
2 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs.  Sift together dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture.  Add pecans and vanilla.

name: E-Z SERVE PUNCH
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sugar
6  c. water
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
3  cans water
1 (46 oz.)  can unsweetened pineapple juice
juice of 2 lemon
5  ripe mashed bananas
preparation: Combine sugar and water; stir until dissolved.  Heat to boiling and cool.  Add and mix remaining ingredients; freeze.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. bag frozen hash browns
1  stick butter
1  c. (8 oz.) sour cream
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
3  c. corn flakes cereal
1  stick butter, melted
preparation: Combine first 7 ingredients.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Mix melted butter and corn flakes.  Sprinkle over hash brown mixture.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: ORANGE BALLS
ingredients:
6  oz. can frozen orange juice
1  box vanilla wafers, blended in blender
1  stick margarine, melted
1  lb. powdered sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. coconut
preparation: Combine wafers, sugar, pecans and coconut.  Add juice and margarine.  Mix well and form into balls.

name: MARINATED PORK TENDERLOIN
ingredients:
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. chili sauce
2  Tbsp. honey
1  Tbsp. salad oil
minced green onion
1  tsp. curry powder
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and marinate pork tenderloin for at least 5 hours.  Cook on grill.

name: EASY ICE CREAM (NO EGGS)
ingredients:
9  c. sweet milk (1/2 gal. plus 1 c.)
1  box instant Jell-O vanilla pudding and pie filling
1  c. sugar
1  can sweetened condensed milk
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar and pudding mix; add milk (both kinds) and then vanilla.  Freeze in hand or electric freezer.  Fresh fruits may be used by leaving out part of the milk and adding that amount of fruit.  Makes 1 gallon.

name: CHOCOLATE BUNDT CAKE
ingredients:
1  chocolate devil's food cake mix
4  eggs
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. oil
8  oz. sour cream
1  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix  together.  Fold in chocolate chips.  Bake in Bundt cake pan  that was sprayed with Pam in a 350° oven.  Test with toothpick.  Poke  in  cake.  If  it  comes  out clean, cake is done.

name: PINEAPPLE-BUTTERMILK CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple with juice
2  Tbsp. sugar
6  oz. orange jello
2  c. buttermilk
8  oz. Cool Whip
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine pineapple and sugar in saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring.  Remove from heat.  Add jello, stirring well.  Cool. Add buttermilk; stir well.  Fold in cream and pecans.  Stir well. Pour into 13 x 9-inch dish and chill.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
2  c. flour
2  tsp. salt
2 1/2  c. blueberries or 2 apples, diced small plus cinnamon
preparation: Cream butter and sugar together until fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Mix well.  Add dry ingredients, alternating with milk. Fold in fruit.

name: GREEN BEAN WRAPS
ingredients:
1  lb. bacon
1/4  c. brown sugar
2  cans green beans
1  stick margarine
preparation: You also need toothpicks.

name: ORANGE SQUARES
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon gelatin
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange gelatin
3/4  c. sugar
juice of 1 orange
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
preparation: Chill milk until icy.  Dissolve gelatins in 1 cup boiling water; chill until thickened.  Whip milk until stiff, adding sugar and orange juice.  Add gelatin; beat until light and fluffy. Spread cracker crumbs in waxed paper lined 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan; pour in filling.  Chill until firm.  Cut in squares to serve.

name: QUICK SUPPER
ingredients:
2  pkg. Rice-A-Roni beef flavor
1  can sliced mushroom (optional)
1  chopped green pepper (optional)
Round steak or other type of beef
preparation: Slice meat into thin one inch pieces and brown.  Cook Rice-A-Roni according to package directions with meat added.  Just before time is up, add mushrooms and green peppers and cover for 2 to 3 minutes.

name: SALTED PECANS
ingredients:
1  lb. pecan halves
1/2  stick margarine
Lawry's seasoned salt
preparation: Spread pecans in a baking pan.  Dot margarine slices over pecans.  Sprinkle with Lawry's seasoned salt.  Place in a 350° oven and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.  Watch carefully to prevent burning.  Stir several times to mix.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
2  pkg. graham crackers, crushed
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  stick margarine, melted
1  pkg. chocolate cream cookies
1  large Cool Whip
1 large  box instant pudding (chocolate or vanilla)
preparation: Mix graham cracker crumbs, sugar and melted margarine.  Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake for 5 minutes.  Mix pudding as directed.  Pour 1/2 of pudding on crust.  Put 1/2 of Cool Whip on top of pudding.  Put layer of crushed cookies on top of Cool Whip. Repeat.  Refrigerate.

name: BLACKBERRY FRITTERS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten lightly
1  c. milk
2  c. fresh blackberries
cooking oil for deep-frying
powdered sugar
preparation: Fill deep fryer with oil to at least 6-inches.  Heat oil to 375°.  Combine flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.  Stir in eggs and milk.  Blend and fold in berries.  Drop by spoonful into hot oil and cook, turning once, 2 or 3 minutes or until golden.  Drain on paper towel and sprinkle with powdered sugar.  Serve warm.

name: FRUIT SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. plain low-fat yogurt
2  Tbsp. orange juice
1 or 2  Tbsp. honey to taste
1  Tbsp. poppy seed and/or 1/2 tsp. celery seed
salt (if desired) to taste
freshly ground black pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl or jar and whisk or shake well.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
3  pkg. Kool-Aid (any flavor)
2  bottles ginger ale
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
2 (6 oz.)  cans frozen orange juice
preparation: Make up Kool-Aid as usual.  Add other ingredients.  Serves 50 to 75.

name: GINGER ALE PUNCH
ingredients:
1  pt. cranberry juice
1  c. lemon
1  can pineapple juice
2  qt. ginger ale
1  c. sugar
preparation: Mix together; add slices of fruit.

name: BANANA PUNCH
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
6  c. water
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen lemonade (no water)
6  bananas, mashed
7 (32 oz.)  bottles lemon-lime soda
preparation: Dissolve sugar in water.  Bring to boiling stage, but do not boil.  Let cool.  Mash bananas in blender with pineapple juice. Mix banana mixture, orange juice, lemonade and sugar water mixture.  Pour in containers and freeze.  Remove from freezer for 6 hours before serving.  Serves about 50 people.

name: HOMEMADE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1  qt. milk
3  egg yolks
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 4/5  c. sugar
1  qt. cream
1  pkg. Knox gelatine
preparation: Cook until it coats spoon.  Cool and add 1 package Knox gelatine, 1 quart cream and 1 quart milk.  Beat egg whites until stiff; add to mixture in can.  Add teaspoon vanilla.  Freeze in ice cream freezer.

name: PARTY SQUASH CASSEROLE(Serving Size: 6)
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. yellow squash, sliced
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  large egg, lightly beaten
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1/4  c. onions, finely chopped
1/4  c. green pepper, finely chopped
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/3  c. breads crumbs, fine and dry
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine, cut into pieces
preparation: Cook squash in 1/2 cup boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes; drain.  Place squash in large bowl and mash.  Stir in mayonnaise and next ingredients.

name: BUTTERMILK SALAD
ingredients:
1  large apricot Jell-O
1  c. buttermilk
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Heat pineapple and add Jell-O (dissolved).  Fold in buttermilk and then Cool Whip.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: BEEF AND NOODLES
ingredients:
2  lb. beef roast
1  pkg. beef stew seasoning mix
1  pkg. noodles
preparation: Cut beef into cubes, brown in Dutch oven in a small amount of oil; drain.  Add the seasoning mix then cover with enough water to cover the beef.  Simmer until tender.  Add enough water to cook the noodles, bring to a boil.  Add the noodles.  Cook until noodles are just done.  Mix beef mixture with noodles or serve over the noodles.  Can be increased for a large crowd.  Large pasta shells can be substituted for noodles.

name: EASY CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  fryer or pieces of chicken of your choice
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  stick melted butter or margarine
Ritz crackers
preparation: Place chicken in dish.  Cover with soup (do not dilute).  Pour melted butter over top.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until lightly brown and tender.

name: COCA-COLA CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. mini marshmallows
2  sticks butter
1  tsp. soda
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. Coca-Cola
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine flour, sugar and marshmallows in a mixing bowl.  Heat butter, cocoa and Coca-Cola to boiling and combine with the first mixture.  Add buttermilk, eggs, soda and vanilla which have been beaten together first and mix well.   This will be a thin batter with some marshmallows floating on top.  Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.  Ice while hot.

name: MOUNTAIN PIE
ingredients:
3/4  stick of oleo
1  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
1 to 2  c. fruit
preparation: Melt oleo in a loaf pan.  Mix flour, baking powder, salt and sugar well before adding the milk.  Pour on top of that melted oleo.  Add fruit sweetened to taste.  My favorite is strawberries, rhubarb and raspberries.  Peaches can be used.  Bake 15 minutes in a 400° oven.  Reduce heat to 325° and bake 35 minutes.

name: HOLIDAY PUNCH
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  cans frozen orange juice
2 (6 oz.)  cans frozen lemonade
1  c. sugar
6  c. water
46  oz. pineapple juice
24  oz. ginger ale
preparation: Mix all ingredients and serve over ice.   Makes 1 1/2 gallons.

name: STUFFED PORK TENDERLOIN
ingredients:
2  tenderloin rolls, cut down center and flattened out
dressing or Stove Top stuffing
preparation: Stuff with dressing or Stove Top stuffing.  Roll up and tie each end and down the middle.  Brown lightly in frying pan.  Place in  a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with chicken broth. Cover with foil. Bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour.  Remove the stuffed tenderloin. Thicken the juices in the pan.  Cut the tenderloin in 1 1/2-inch slices. Serve with rice or mashed potatoes, vegetables or salad. Serves 6 to 8.

name: HACIENDA DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. salsa
dash of onion salt
corn chips or vegetable dippers
preparation: Mix cheese, salsa and salt until well blended, spread cheese mixture in microwavable pie plate or bowl.  Microwave on High 3 to 4 minutes or until thoroughly heated, stirring every 2 minutes. Makes 2 cups.

name: YUM YUM SALAD(Holiday Salad)
ingredients:
1  can evaporated milk
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. sugar
1  pkg. raspberry or strawberry jello (2 small or 1 large)
preparation: Evaporated milk must be refrigerated overnight.  Whip until thick.  Beat the milk; add cream cheese; beat.  Set aside.  Cook pineapple, sugar and jello.  Let cool for 10 minutes or so.  Mix two together and let stand in refrigerator overnight.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Wesson oil
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. chopped apples
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Combine oil, sugar and eggs together.  Add flour, salt, soda, baking soda, cinnamon and nuts, a little at a time.  Add vanilla and apples to batter.  Mix and pour into a floured and greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake  at  350° for 50 to 60 minutes. Sprinkle powdered sugar on top  of  cake  as  soon  as cake is taken out of oven (optional).

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large bag hash browns
1  c. cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
1  c. shredded cheese (Cheddar)
1  c. chopped onion
1  stick butter
1 1/2  c. corn flakes, crunched
preparation: Mix potatoes, soup, sour cream, cheese and onion.  Heat oven to 350°.  Melt stick of butter in pan.  Pour butter over crunched corn flakes and set aside.  Pour mixture into buttered pan and cook for 50 minutes.  Then add corn flake mixture on top and cook 10 more minutes.  Salt and pepper in mixture to taste.

name: BUTTER SHORTBREAD
ingredients:
1  lb. butter
1  c. sugar
3  c. sifted flour
1  c. cornstarch
preparation: Cream butter and shortening thoroughly; gradually add sifted flour and cornstarch.  Mix until flour is moistened.   Spread on cookie sheet; refrigerate overnight.  Bake starting at 300° for 1 hour.  Optional:  Chop up 2 large Cadbury milk chocolate bars and sprinkle over hot cookies.  Spread when melted.  Cut while warm.

name: MOTHER'S JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  large all fruit Jell-O
1 small  can diced beets
1 small  can crushed pineapple (do not drain)
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Drain beet juice into cup and fill with hot water.  Put Jell-O into bowl; mix with boiling water.  Add beet juice water to Jell-O.  Add beets and pineapple.  Stir in vinegar.  Pour into mold or flat pan.  If pan is used, cut into squares and serve on lettuce.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: CHERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. coconut
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. soda cracker crumbs
1/2  lb. butter
2  cans cherry pie filling
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients.  Melt butter; pour over mixture and mix well.  Reserve some crumbs for topping.  Press into bottom and sides of jelly roll pan.  Cover with cherry pie filling.  Sprinkle with crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour, then at 300° for 15 minutes.  Serves about 20.

name: TEXAS SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1  c. water
1/4  c. cocoa
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine butter, water and cocoa in saucepan.   Bring to a boil.  Remove from heat and beat in flour, sugar, salt, eggs, sour cream, soda and vanilla. Pour into large cookie sheet with sides. Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: ASHLEY'S MEXICAN BEAN DIP
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  can bean dip
8  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine taco seasoning mix with sour cream.  Mix well.  Stir in softened cream cheese and can of bean dip.  Stir until smooth.

name: EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
16  slices white bread, cubed
2  c. ham, cubed
1  lb. Swiss, cubed
1  lb. sharp Cheddar, cubed
3  c. milk
6  eggs
1  tsp. onion salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2 to 1  stick butter
2  c. cornflakes
preparation: You will need a 9 x 13-inch dish.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. self-rising flour
1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  c. vegetable shortening
2  c. buttermilk
2  pkg. yeast (red label)
1/4  c. lukewarm water
preparation: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water.  Mix all dry ingredients together and put in shortening.  Add to milk and yeast; stir until well blended.  Grease light sided bowl and place all or part in a bowl.  Sit in refrigerator.  Keeps 2 weeks.

name: PEPPERONI PIE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. Muenster cheese
1  egg
1/2  stick pepperoni, cut up
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix all together and put in pie dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: HEAVENLY FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1 (12 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  (15 oz.) crushed pineapple, drained
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1/3  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. chopped nuts
2  (9-inch) graham crusts
preparation: Combine milk, topping, pineapple, oranges, lemon juice and pecans.  Stir well.  Pour into pie crusts.  Chill for several hours before serving.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
3  bananas, mashed
1  c. sugar
1  egg
2  c. flour
1/4  c. shortening
1  tsp. baking soda
pinch of salt
preparation: Mash bananas; add sugar, egg and shortening.  Sift flour with baking soda and salt; add to banana mixture.  Grease loaf pan. Bake in slow oven, 300°, for an hour or until toothpick comes out clean from center of bread.

name: AMELIA'S FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. celery salt
1  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  c. vinegar
2  c. oil
1/4  c. onion, grated
preparation: Mix dry ingredients; add  1  cup vinegar and stir well. Add  2 cups oil and stir.	Add  1/4  cup  grated  onion.  Beat until thick.  Put in  jar  and  refrigerate.  Makes  almost  a quart.

name: DEVILISH DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  devil's food cake mix
1  jar caramel or butterscotch ice cream topping
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1 (8 oz.)  carton whipped topping
1  c. crushed Heath bar
preparation: Prepare cake mix as directed.  While cake is still warm, poke holes in it with a fork.  Pour the jar of ice cream topping over the cake.  Pour the can of sweetened condensed milk on the cake. Refrigerate the cake or cool completely.   Before serving, spread whipped topping on the cake and sprinkle the Heath bar bits on top.

name: ITALIAN BEEF
ingredients:
4  lb. lean, boneless beef roast
garlic cloves
sweet basil
oregano
oil
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
1  beef bouillon cube
1  c. water
1  can beef broth
preparation: Cut X in top of roast.  Put a clove of garlic in each 4 sections.  Sprinkle with sweet basil and oregano.  Brown in a little oil in a big heavy pan on both sides.  When brown, add onion soup mix, beef bouillon cube, water and beef broth.  Can add a little more water or broth, if needed.  Simmer for 4 hours. Remove, cool and slice thin.  Put back in broth and simmer 1 more hour.  Cool, put in containers and freeze.  Serve on hoagie buns. Can do 2 roasts at one time.

name: HOT MOCHA MIX
ingredients:
1  c. unsweetened cocoa (1/2 c. Hershey and 1/2 c. Girardhelli)
2  c. sugar
2  c. nonfat dry milk
2  c. dry coffee creamer
1/2  c. instant coffee
6  tsp. powdered vanilla
preparation: Sift all together until well mixed.  Store in airtight container.  Use 3 tablespoons for 6 ounce cup of hot water. Yields 6 1/2 cups.

name: DESSERT
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  fresh lemon
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1/2  c. walnuts
1  c. sour pitted cherries, drained
preparation: Squeeze lemon juice and mix with Eagle Brand milk. Add Cool Whip, walnuts and cherries. Mix all together and put in refrigerator until set.

name: BROWNIES (COOMBS)
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. butter
2  eggs
2  sq. semi-sweet chocolate
1/3  tsp. salt
1/2  c. flour (unbleached)
1  c. walnuts
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. boiling water
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add well beaten eggs.  Dissolve chocolate in boiling water.  Add salt, flour, vanilla and nuts. Spread thin in two pans.  Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: EDWINA'S HUSHPUPPIES
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1  c. complete pancake mix
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  egg
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. buttermilk (more or less)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and add just enough buttermilk to form a stiff batter.  Drop by small spoonfuls into hot oil until golden brown.

name: GRANNY GAY'S BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  gal. bread crumbs, soften with milk
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. evaporated milk
4  eggs
1  stick butter (no substitutes)
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. raisins, cook to boil for 10 minutes and drain
2  tsp. vanilla or lemon extract or suit your taste
preparation: Mix all together.  Cook at 375° until brown.  Leave in pan to cool.

name: STRAWBERRY SHORTCAKES
ingredients:
2 1/3  c. Bisquick mix
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. margarine, melted
1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. chilled whipping cream
sliced strawberries, sweetened
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Mix Bisquick, sugar, margarine and milk until soft dough forms.  Gently smooth dough into ball on cloth covered board, dusted with Bisquick.  Knead.  Roll dough 1/2-inch thick, cut with 3-inch cutter dipped in Bisquick.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet until golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes.  Beat whipping cream in chilled bowl until stiff.  Split shortcakes. Spoon strawberries between halves and on tops.  Top with cream.

name: HONEYMOON PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
3/4-inch  to 1-inch fresh pork chops (same size)
onion salt
flour
hot milk
a little pepper and parsley (if desired)
preparation: Have freshly cut 3/4-inch to 1-inch pork chops.  Use onion salt on both sides, then flour.  Place in Pyrex baking dish to fit chops close together.  Cover with hot milk to slightly cover chops.  If desired, use a little pepper and parsley.  Bake at 325° about 1 hour.  (More chops may take longer.)  They are done when milk is gone and tops are lightly brown.  Keeps well in low oven for 1/2 hour.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground round
6  oz. V-8 juice
16  oz. jar Prego spaghetti sauce
2  cans (10 oz.) Campbell's chili-beef soup
1  lb. can kidney beans, undrained
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. cumin powder
1  envelope onion soup mix
preparation: Brown ground round; add remaining ingredients.  Cook on low to medium heat 30 minutes or so.  Serves 8.  Can be frozen.

name: ITALIAN SAUCE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1/2  c. oil
1  onion
1  bulb garlic
1  green pepper
5  cans tomato paste
1  can tomatoes
12  shakes Tabasco sauce
6  shakes Worcestershire sauce
oregano
garlic salt
preparation: Combine together hamburger, oil, onion and garlic and fry in skillet.  Drain grease.  Put in slow cooker along with remaining ingredients.  Cook slow all day on low heat.

name: CHOCOLATE SYRUP POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter (2 sticks)
1/2  c. Crisco (8 Tbsp.)
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
3  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1 (1 lb.)  can chocolate syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter and Crisco.  Add chocolate syrup and sugar; beat until smooth.  Add eggs, one at a time; continue to beat.  Combine sifted flour and baking powder alternately with milk.  Stir in vanilla.  Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Start in cold oven.  Do not open door for 1 hour.  Bake for 1 hour and 30 minutes at 325° or for 2 hours at 300°.

name: DRESSING FOR BANANA CROQUETS
ingredients:
1  egg, well beaten
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. butter or evaporated milk
preparation: Stir all ingredients together. Bring to a slight boil until thickens. Be sure to continue stirring. Allow dressing to cool.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  sticks margarine or butter
1/2  tsp. salt
6  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. almond flavoring
1/2  tsp. lemon flavoring
preparation: Let butter or margarine reach room temperature.  Cream with sugar until fluffy.  Add eggs, 1 at a time (critical!!) and blend each egg in well.  Add flour, 1/3 of amount at a time, blend well with each addition.  Add salt with flour.  Mix in flavorings.  Bake in a tube pan at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
1 1/4  lb. sweet potatoes, peeled, cooked and mashed
1/4 to 1/2  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. milk
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. chopped walnuts
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Add butter to hot mashed potatoes and stir until melted.  Stir in milk, sugar, eggs, salt and cinnamon.  When blended, pour in 9-inch pie plate or shallow casserole.  Sprinkle with walnuts.  Bake about 35 minutes or until inserted knife comes out clean.  Makes 8 servings.

name: HOT CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cornmeal
3  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. Wesson oil
1 6  oz. whole grain corn, drained
6  to 8 jalapeno peppers, chopped and small amount juice
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and put in greased baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until browned.

name: CORN PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. fine saltine cracker crumbs
1 1/4  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. instant minced onions
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. butter
2  c. fresh or frozen cut corn
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Mix crumbs and 1/2 cup melted butter.  Set aside 1/2 cup and press remainder into 9-inch pie pan to form shell.

name: INSTANT SPICED TEA
ingredients:
1/2  c. instant tea
2  c. Tang dry orange drink mix
1  pkg. lemonade mix
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix ingredients well.  Store in tightly sealed container.  Use 2 teaspoons to make a delicious cup of hot tea.

name: CHILDREN'S PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. water
1/2  c. salt
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. cream of tartar
food coloring
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan.  Cook over medium heat, about 5 minutes, until it forms a ball.  Cool slightly and knead until smooth.  Store, wrapped tightly in plastic, in refrigerator. The dough hardens on standing.  Great for sculptures.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. curly or shell macaroni
1  onion
1  green pepper
2  grated carrots
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  c. vinegar
2  c. mayonnaise
sugar to taste
preparation: Cook macaroni. Drain. Chill.  Combine vegetables.  Mix rest of ingredients and toss with vegetables until coated.  Will keep a week in refrigerator.

name: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2/3  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
1 (9 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/4  c. sliced red cherries
1/4  c. chopped pecans
1  banana, sliced
preparation: Mix all together.  Line muffin pan with paper baking cups. Place approximately 1/2-inch of mixture in each cup.  Freeze.

name: MANY LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1  qt. spinach, chopped stems too
3  hard-cooked eggs
1  large onion, chopped fine
1/4  lb. bacon, cubed fine and cooked crisp
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can LeSueur peas
1  qt. lettuce (Boston head), chopped fine
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  can water chestnuts, sliced thin
3/4  c. mayonnaise, mixed with 2 Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Layer in order given, spreading ingredients evenly.  Cover closely with Saran Wrap and refrigerate for 12 to 24 hours.  Mix before serving.

name: SOUPER MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
7  lb. ground beef
4  c. small bread cubes
4 (10 1/2 oz. each)  cans condensed tomato soup
1 1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped parsley
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
5  eggs
2  Tbsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2 to 4  Tbsp. drippings
2  Tbsp. horseradish (prepared; optional)
preparation: Combine meat and bread.  Blend 1 1/2 cans of soup, onion, parsley, Worcestershire sauce, egg, salt and pepper.  Add to meat; mix thoroughly.  Shape firmly into 2 loaves.  Place in shallow baking pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours.  In saucepan, combine remaining soup, drippings and horseradish.  Heat, stirring now and then.  Serve over meat loaf.  Makes about 25 servings of 4 1/2 ounces.

name: BAKED COD FILLETS
ingredients:
1  lb. cod fillets
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. tarragon leaves
4  whole cloves
1/2  c. skim milk
1/2  tsp. butter or imitation butter flavoring
1  bay leaf
preparation: Sprinkle fish fillets with salt and pepper.  Combine remaining ingredients and slowly pour over fish.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until fish flakes.   Serves 2.

name: LEFTOVER CORN-OFF-THE-COB
ingredients:
4 to 5  ears cooked corn-on-the-cob
1  medium onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cut corn from cob and scrape cob; set aside.  Melt butter in large skillet.  Add chopped onion and cover. Stir once or twice until onion is translucent.  Add corn and milk if corn is dry. Cover and heat through.  Season to taste.  Sprinkle with cheese if desired.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. sugar
2  eggs (reserve whites)
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  stick butter
preparation: Blend flour, cocoa and sugar in top of double boiler; add eggs and milk and heat over medium heat, stirring constantly until thick.  Add a little vanilla (1/2 teaspoon) and butter or margarine to thickened mixture.  Pour into baked pie shell.  Cover with meringue made from reserved egg whites and brown in oven.

name: CARROT SALAD
ingredients:
2  (1 lb.) bags petite carrots
1  can tomato soup
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  bunch green onions
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. oil
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. dried mustard
preparation: Cook carrots; cool and slice.  In a large bowl, add vinegar to tomato soup, also oil.  Add rest of ingredients.   Add carrots; cover and marinate overnight.  Can be stored in quart jars kept in refrigerator for weeks.

name: HODIE PODIE
ingredients:
3  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
3  cans minestrone soup
2  cans Ranch Style beans
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
preparation: Brown meat and onion.  Add remaining ingredients.  Cook on low heat in crock-pot for 6 to 8 hours.  Serve with cornbread and salad.

name: CARAMEL PECAN BARS
ingredients:
18  oz. pkg. Pillsbury refrigerator chocolate chip cookies
11.5  oz. pkg. milk chocolate chips
16  oz. caramel apple dip
3  c. rice crispies
1 1/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Heat oven to 375 degrees.  Cut each section in half lengthwise.  press dough in bottom of ungreased 13x9 in. pan. Bake at 375 for 10-18 minutes or until light golden brown.  Cool 15 minutes.  In large sauce pan, combine 1 c. chocolate chips, and 1 c. of dip.  Cook over medium heat until melted and smooth, stirring constantly. Remove from heat.  Stir in cereal and pecans. Spread over crust.  In a small sauce pan, combine remaining 1 cup chips and 1/2 cup dip.  Cook over medium heat until melted and smooth, stirring constantly.  Spread over cereal mixture. Refrigerate 30 minutes or until set.  Cut into 36 bars.

name: CHICKEN SALAD PIE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked diced chicken
3/4  c. shredded American cheese
1/2  c. diced celery
1/2  c. drained crushed pineapple
1/3  c. slivered almonds
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. paprika and salt
preparation: Turn into baked crust.  Whip 1/2 cup cream very stiff.  Fold in 1/4 cup mayonnaise.  Spread over salad in pie shell, leaving 1-inch of salad around edge, uncovered.  Place in 450° oven for 8 to 10 minutes.  Serve immediately.   Serves 6.

name: Toffy Squares(Yield: 2 Dozen or More)
ingredients:
1  Package Saltine Crackers
2  Sticks Butter
1  cup Brown Sugar
12  oz. Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips
1  cup Chopped Nuts (optional)
preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
10  c. tomatoes
3  c. sweet peppers
2  c. hot peppers (hot salsa)*
2  c. onions
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. canning salt
1 1/2  c. cider vinegar
preparation: *For mild salsa use 1 cup banana peppers and 1 cup hot peppers.

name: STIR-FRY GROUND MEAT WITH CELERY AND BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground turkey or beef
4  stalks celery, cut in 1/4-inch slanted slices
2  c. broccoli, cut up
1/2  tsp. fresh ginger, minced
3  pieces garlic, minced
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. cooking wine (red)
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  c. cold water
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: In heavy large skillet or wok at high heat stir-fry meat until done, then add vegetables and stir-fry until broccoli turns color, about 2 or 3 minutes.  Add spices and remaining ingredients, except cornstarch and water.  Stir to blend.  Add the cornstarch mixture and reduce heat to simmer.  Cook until sauce thickens. Remove from heat and serve over rice or noodles.

name: CHILI RELLENOS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  cans Ortega whole chilies
1  lb. Cheddar cheese
1  lb. Jack cheese
4  eggs
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1 (8 oz.)  can enchilada sauce
preparation: Wash chilies and remove strings and seeds.  Drain.  Grate cheeses separately.  In a 13 x 9-inch pan, place a layer of chilies, then Cheddar, then Jack.  Repeat 2 more times.
