Separate eggs.  Beat yolks and add milk, flour and salt.  Beat whites, then fold into yolk mixture.  Pour over chilies and cheese.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Add enchilada sauce and bake 1/2 hour more.  Put oven rack as far away from heat source as possible.  This stuff burns easily!  Serves 10 to 15.

name: DATE AND NUT ROLL
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. dates
1/2  c. canned milk
1/2  c. nuts
2  tsp. butter or oleo
preparation: Cook sugar, dates  and  canned  milk  until  soft  ball stage. Let cool for a  while.  Then add butter and nuts.  Let cool until just warm  then  powder  your  pie board heavy with powdered sugar.  Take  mixture  and  knead  like  bread.  Work enough sugar in until  you can roll out.  Cool in refrigerator before you slice down.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  sticks butter, melted
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. nuts
2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
7  Tbsp. cocoa
preparation: Mix butter, sugar and eggs; beat well.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Bake at 300° for 45 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: TACOS IN PASTA SHELLS(Makes 4 to 6 Servings)
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. ground beef
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese with chives, cubed and softened
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. chili powder
18  uncooked jumbo pasta shells, cooked, rinsed and drained
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1  c. prepared taco sauce
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1 1/2  c. crushed tortilla chips
1  c. dairy sour cream
3  green onions, chopped
leaf lettuce (optional)
small pitted ripe olives (optional)
cherry tomatoes (optional)
preparation: Cook beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat until brown, stirring to separate meat.  Drain fat. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add cream cheese, salt and chili powder.  Simmer 5 minutes.

name: HELLO DOLLYS
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. coconut
1  c. chocolate chips
nuts, if desired
1  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Melt margarine in 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan.  Make a layer of each in order listed.  Drizzle Eagle Brand milk over this and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.  Let set awhile before cutting. The longer it sets the better.

name: SOUTHERN BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
4  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1/4  c. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. butter
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.  Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring frequently.  Yields 16 servings.  Approximately Per Serving:  Calories: 77.  Fat: 1 gram.

name: CREAM FILLED DEVIL COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. sour milk
1  c. boiling water
4  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cocoa, sifted
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs.  Add dry ingredients with milk and boiling water.  Drop by tablespoon on greased baking sheet.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND BROCCOLI SAUTE
ingredients:
1  lb. rigatoni
2  pkgs. broccoli spears
2  lbs. boneless chicken
1  red pepper
1/3  c. olive oil
1/4  c. margarine
Italian seasoning
garlic powder
1 small  can sliced mushrooms
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. Romano grated cheese
1/4  c. Parmesan grated cheese
preparation: Thaw broccoli and cut in half.  Cut chicken into pieces.  Chop red pepper.  Saute chicken, red pepper and mushrooms in 1/3 cup of olive oil and 1/4 cup of margarine.  Sprinkle with garlic powder and Italian seasoning.  Add soup; stir and heat through.  Boil 4 quarts of water; salt.  Add rigatoni; cook 15 minutes, then add thawed broccoli and cook for 3 to 5 minutes longer.  Drain in colander.  Pour chicken mixture over rigatoni and broccoli.  Add Romano and Parmesan cheese.  Toss and serve.

name: ROCKY ROAD BROWNIE SQUARES
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine, softened
3/4  c. sugar
2  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2/3  c. flour (all-purpose)
1/3  c. unsweetened cocoa
1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
vegetable cooking spray
2  Tbsp. semi-sweet chocolate mini morsels
4  caramels (unwrapped)
1/2  tsp. water
preparation: Beat margarine at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy.  Gradually add sugar, beating well.  Add egg whites, beating until blended.  Stir in vanilla.  Combine flour and cocoa. Add to margarine mixture, stirring until blended.  Stir in marshmallows.  Spoon batter into an 8-inch square pan coated with cooking spray.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  (Do not overbake.)  Sprinkle with chocolate morsels and cool completely on a wire rack.  Cut into 9 squares.  Combine caramels and water in a small, heavy-duty zip top plastic bag.  Seal bag.  Microwave at Medium-high 45 seconds or until caramels melt.  Knead bag to blend caramels and water.  Snip a tiny hole in corner of bag.  Drizzle mixture over brownies.  Yield:  9 brownies; 197 calories/brownie, 6.8 g of fat/brownie, 0 mg cholesterol and 82 mg sodium.

name: WHITE SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter (oleo)
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. powdered sugar
4  c. flour
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter, shortening and sugars.  Add eggs and beat well. Add flour sifted with cream of tartar and soda.  Add vanilla. Roll into balls.  Sprinkle with sugar and place on greased cookie sheet.  Flatten with a glass dipped in sugar.  Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until they turn a light tan.  You can frost for Christmas.

name: SOUR CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. cake flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. walnuts
4  Tbsp. brown sugar
3  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix butter, sugar and eggs well.  Fold in sour cream and vanilla.  Fold in flour, baking powder and salt.  Spoon 1/2 of mixture into a greased and floured tube pan.

name: EASY PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
8  center cut or butter filled pork chops
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. oil
1  c. sour cream
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1  envelope onion soup mix
1  c. white wine
preparation: Rinse pork chops and pat dry.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Coat with flour.  Brown on both sides in oil in skillet; drain well.  Arrange in single layer in rectangular baking dish. Combine sour cream, soup, soup mix and wine in bowl.  Mix well. Spoon over pork chops.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.  Serve with wild rice and julienned carrots.  Yields 8 servings.

name: DIP DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese bar
10  oz. chunky salsa
6  oz. Cheddar and Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Spread the cream cheese in a pie plate.  Cover with salsa. Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Serve with corn tortilla chips.

name: POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
3/4  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1/3  c. honey
preparation: Combine and cook to bubble; then pour over 10 to 12 cups of popped popcorn.  Stir until all is coated, then form into balls.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  large chicken breast halves, boiled and cut into bite-size pieces
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can Ro-Tel diced tomatoes with green chilies
1 small  can sliced mushrooms, drained
1  c. chicken broth
1  lb. Velveeta, grated
preparation: Cook in crock-pot on high for 1 hour.  Stir in 1/2 pound bag of Doritos, coarsely crushed.  Continue cooking 20 to 30 minutes.

name: AFTER DINNER MINTS
ingredients:
1  unbeaten egg white
1  Tbsp. cream
1  tsp. vanilla
3  drops oil flavoring
food coloring
1  box powdered sugar
1  tsp. (heaping) soft butter or shortening
preparation: Combine egg white, cream, vanilla, oil flavoring and coloring. Stir well.  Add sugar, all at once, mixing thoroughly.  Add more cream, if needed.  Add butter and more sugar if necessary to make mixture the consistency needed to roll into firm small balls. Arrange balls on waxed paper.  Press each ball with tines of fork dipped into additional powdered sugar.  Let stand overnight to form crust.  Put mints into tins with waxed paper between each layer. Mints may be frozen and kept for several months.

name: EASY CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
3  c. diced, cooked chicken
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of celery soup, undiluted
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. chicken broth
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. milk
1/2  c. butter or oleo, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Grease a shallow 2-quart baking dish. Place chicken and vegetables in baking dish.  Stir together soup, chicken broth and pepper.  Pour over chicken mixture and mix. Combine flour, milk and butter and stir until smooth.  Pour over mixture in baking dish.  Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until lightly browned and vegetables are done.  Let cool 10 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can fruit cocktail
1  can pineapple tidbits
1  jar maraschino cherries
1  can mandarin oranges
1  bag small marshmallows
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Drain off the juice from all the fruits.  Mix all the ingredients in a large bowl.  Refrigerate.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1/4  cup butter
1/4  cup light brown sugar
1  cup white Karo syrup
1/4  tsp salt
3  eggs
1  tsp vanilla
1  cup pecans, halved or chopped
unbaked 9 inch pie shell
preparation: Mix butter, sugar, Karo, salt, eggs, and vanilla together until well blended.  Stir in pecans.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake at 350° until tests done.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  lb. boneless skinless chicken breasts
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.)  can mushroom pieces, drained
2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. slivered almonds
2  c. (16 oz.) sour cream
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
4  c. diced celery
2  c. shredded cheese
2  c. (16 oz.) water chestnuts
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2 (2.8 oz.)  cans French fried onions
preparation: Boil chicken and cut into cubes. Place in a large bowl and add all but cheese and French fried onions. Mix well and transfer to 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and French fried onions. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 16 servings.

name: PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. crushed pretzels
1/2  c. sugar
1  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  c. sugar
3/4  c . (1 1/2 sticks) margarine, melted
1  carton (9 oz.) whipped topping
1 large  pkg. strawberry flavored gelatin
2  c. pineapple juice, heated or 2 c. boiling water
2  pkg. (10 oz.) frozen strawberries with juice
preparation: Mix pretzels, 1/2 cup sugar and melted margarine.  Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Mix cream cheese, 1 cup sugar and whipped topping and spread over pretzel layer. Dissolve gelatin in hot juice and add strawberries and juice to gelatin.  Let set partially, then spread on top of cream layer and chill thoroughly.  `

name: CABBAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
1  can tomato paste
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. chili powder
1  lb. hamburger
3/4  c. cooked rice, well drained
1  egg
1/2  c. canned milk
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix the first 7 ingredients in bowl; let stand.  Put head of cabbage in boiling water to loosen leaves.  Peel off.  Mix remaining ingredients together.  Fill leaves and fasten with toothpick.  Pack in roaster pan.  Pour sauce over.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.  Check and bake 1 hour longer.  Add water if needed.

name: NO CRUST CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. Philadelphia cream cheese
1  lb. Ricotta cheese
1  pt. Breakstone sour cream
1/4  lb. butter
4  eggs
1  tsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1 1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Combine cream cheese and Ricotta cheese.  Add sugar and lightly beaten eggs.  Beat well.  Stir in lemon juice, butter (melt in pan), vanilla extract, flour and cornstarch.  Blend well. Last, add sour cream.  Beat all ingredients with mixer until smooth.  Preheat oven to 375°.   Butter sides and bottom of spring-form pan.  Bake for 1 hour or until top is golden brown. Let sit in turned off oven for 2 hours.  Remove and cool for 1 hour.  Refrigerate.  Serve plain or topped with cherry or blueberry filling.

name: PARADISE CRAN-APPLESAUCE
ingredients:
4  c. fresh or frozen cranberries
1/4  c. water
8  c. sliced peeled cooking apples
2  c. sugar
preparation: In a covered saucepan, simmer cranberries and water for 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.  Press through a sieve or food mill; return to saucepan.  Add apples; cover and simmer for 35 to 40 minutes or until apples are tender, but retain their shape.  Add sugar, simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Yields 8 to 10 servings.

name: MEATBALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
3  c. corn flakes
1  egg, beaten
2  tsp. sweet relish
2  tsp. mustard
1  medium onion, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato soup
preparation: Mix together the ground beef, corn flakes, egg, sweet relish, mustard and onion.  Roll into balls and place in baking dish. Bake at 350° until half way done; cover with tomato soup and continue cooking until done.  Serve with cooked spaghetti.

name: SHEPHERDS PIE
ingredients:
2  lb ground beef
2  cans cream of chicken soup
7 to 8  slices of American cheese
1  bag of tater tots
preparation: Pat beef in greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Layer soup, cheese and tater tots.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  DO NOT SALT!

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD, HER VERSION
ingredients:
5  lb. potatoes
10  oz. Vlasic sweet butter chips
3  Tbsp. Dijon country style mustard
4  Tbsp. Hellmann's natural mayonnaise or use recipe in our Sauce section
1  onion (large)
1  to 2 apples
2  Tbsp. vinegar (from the sweet butter chips jar)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Bring water to a boil in a large pot.  Add the potatoes. While the potatoes are cooking, make the sauce.

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2 level  tsp. soda
1 level  tsp. cinnamon
1/2 level  tsp. cloves
1/2 level  tsp. nutmeg
1/2 level  tsp. allspice
2  eggs
2  c. unsweetened applesauce
3/4  c. cooking oil
1  c. seedless raisins
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Reserve 1/4 cup flour to dredge walnuts and raisins.  Sift all dry ingredients into large bowl.  Make a well in sifted dry ingredients.  Add applesauce, oil and eggs; mix.  Dredge raisins and walnuts with 1/4 cup flour.  Add to cake mixture.  Bake in well-greased and floured angel food cake pan at 325° for first 20 minutes and at 350° the last 40 minutes.  Let cool in pan before removing.

name: DRIED PEACH CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. dried peaches
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. cooked peaches
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs, well beaten
1  c. oil
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Add others.  This will be thin.  Pour into 3 prepared pans and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: CARAMEL PIE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. flour
1  c. brown sugar, packed
2  Tbsp. butter
3  eggs, separated
3/4  c. water
3/4  c. Pet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  9-inch pie shell, baked
preparation: Mix flour, brown sugar and butter.  Add beaten egg yolks with Pet milk diluted with 3/4 cup water.  Cook until thick; add vanilla.  Put into baked pie shell.  Top with meringue.

name: GRANDMA TRAVIS'S HOMEMADE MACARONI
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Uncooked Macaroni
1/4  c. Margarine
1 1/2  c. American Cheese, grated or cubed
1 1/2  Tbsp. Onion (Finely Chopped)
1 1/2  Tbsp. Parsley
1  tsp. Salt
1/2  tsp. Pepper
1/2  tsp. Paprika
2  Eggs (Beaten)
2  c. Heated Milk
preparation: 1. Cook macaroni. Place in casserole dish, add seasoning, cheese, beaten eggs, and hot milk together.   2. Pour over noodles & stir. Cook at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: GREEK PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
12  oz. bowtie pasta
2 3/4  c. diced tomatoes
1  c. diced cucumber
3/4  c. sliced red onion
1/3  c. sliced black olives
1  c. diced green pepper
3 1/2  oz. crumbled feta cheese
1/2  c. chopped fresh oregano or 1 Tbsp. dried oregano
3  oz. sliced pepperoni
preparation: Cook pasta, rinse in cold water, drain and place in serving bowl.  Add vegetables, feta cheese, pepperoni and oregano.

name: CHICKEN CREOLE STYLE
ingredients:
1  chicken, cut up
3  Tbsp. shortening
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  can tomato soup
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3 onion  slices or rings, separated
1/2  green pepper, cut in rings
preparation: Prepare chicken for frying with flour, salt and pepper.  Brown in shortening and butter.  Add remaining ingredients.  Simmer for 45 minutes.

name: VEGETABLE PIZZA
ingredients:
2  cans crescent rolls
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. vegetable seasoning
chopped vegetables (celery, carrots, broccoli, cauliflower and green and red peppers)
cheese (Romano, Parmesan or Cheddar)
preparation: Spread the rolls in a 10 x 15-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Cool.  Mix the cream cheese, mayonnaise, basil and vegetable seasoning; spread over crust.  Spread the chopped vegetables on top of cream cheese mixture.  Sprinkle with cheese on top, if desired.

name: BOURBON BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. vanilla wafer crumbs
2  c. chopped pecans
2  c. powdered sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. bourbon
3  Tbsp. light corn syrup
powdered sugar
preparation: Mix together vanilla wafer crumbs, pecans, sugar and cocoa. Blend in bourbon and corn syrup. Combine into mixture.  Roll into ball and then powdered sugar.  Keep in airtight container.

name: STUFFIN MUFFINS(These Savory Bread Puddings Are Absolutely Scrumptious!)
ingredients:
10  oz. Italian bread (preferably day-old), cut into 1/2-inch cubes
2  c. milk
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
2  scallions, chopped
1/4  tsp. dried thyme
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Butter 12-cup muffin pan.  Divide bread cubes among muffin cups.  In a large bowl, combine milk, eggs, scallions, thyme, salt and pepper.  Pour milk mixture over bread cubes.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Bake until golden brown, about 45 minutes.  Run knife around puddings and carefully lift out.  Cool 10 minutes.  Serve warm.

name: CINNAMON RAISIN BARS
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1  c. light brown sugar
1  egg
1/2  cup hot coffee
1 1/2  c. all purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  cup of chopped nuts
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Cream first 4 ingredients, then add all other ingredients. Pour into 9 inch x 13 inch greased  and floured pan.  Bake at 350° for 15-20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (12 oz.) bag noodles
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
4  or 5 chicken bouillon cubes
3/4 to 1  lb. diced, cooked chicken
1  c. water
1  c. milk
1  can carrots
1  can peas
preparation: Cook noodles according to package directions.  Mix the soups, bouillon cubes, water and milk together.  Mix all ingredients together and pour in casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: OVEN FRIED PECAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. biscuit mix
1/2  c. ground pecans
1  tsp. paprika
salt and pepper to taste
3  Tbsp. oleo
1  (3 lb.) fryer
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients.  Melt oleo in 13 x 9-inch dish. Dredge chicken in pecan mixture.  Place chicken in oleo.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Turn chicken, cover and bake 30 minutes more.

name: ELAINE'S EASY DEEP DISH PIZZA
ingredients:
3  c. Bisquick mix
3/4  c. water
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. Italian seasoning
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  jar sliced mushrooms, drained
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese (about 8 oz.)
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Lightly grease jelly roll pan, 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch or a cookie sheet.  Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms.  Gently smooth dough into ball on floured surface.  Knead 20 times.  Pat dough on bottom and up sides of pan with floured hands or roll into rectangle and place on cookie sheet.  Pinch edges of rectangle, forming 3/4-inch rim.  Cook and stir ground beef, onion, salt and garlic until beef is brown. Drain.  Mix tomato sauce and Italian seasoning.  Spread evenly over dough.  Spoon beef mixture evenly over sauce.  Top with mushrooms, green pepper and cheese.  Bake until crust is golden brown, about 20 minutes.

name: STEAK AND PEPPER STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1  medium red onion, sliced
6  cloves garlic, minced
1  tsp. ground ginger
3  small bell peppers (1/4-inch slices)
1  bunch broccoli
3/4  lb. London Broil, cooked and sliced
1/3  c. low-sodium soy sauce
1 1/2  Tbsp. honey
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Heat oil in hot skillet.  Add onions and garlic; cook 3 minutes.  Add ginger, peppers and broccoli; cook 5 minutes, adding meat after 2 minutes.  In bowl, combine remaining ingredients; add to pan.  Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes.  Makes 4 servings.

name: Apple Cake
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. oil
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
2  eggs
4  c. chopped apples
preparation: Mix together.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BAKED SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  chopped green pepper
2  c. chopped celery
1 large  jar sliced mushrooms
3  cans tomato soup
1 large  jar prepared spaghetti sauce
1  lb. spaghetti, cooked
2  pkg. Cracker Barrel cheese, sliced (mellow Cheddar)
preparation: Cook spaghetti and drain.  Brown ground beef and drain grease. Brown green pepper, celery, mushrooms and season with salt and pepper.  Mix in large pot, tomato soup and spaghetti sauce.  Add drained, browned beef and vegetable mixture.  Heat until hot and well mixed.

name: CREAM CHEESE PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  lb. cream cheese
1/2  pt. cream, whipped
1  c. cold water
1  c. hot water
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 1/2  c. nuts
1/2  c. sugar
1  envelope Knox gelatine
salt to taste
preparation: Soak gelatine 5 minutes in cold water, then add hot water and beat in cream cheese.  Add sugar, whipped cream and pineapple. Add nuts and salt last.  Pour into molds and let congeal.  This will make 2 small molds or one large.

name: DATE LOAF
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  c. evaporated milk
2  c. chopped pecans
1 1/2  c. chopped dates
preparation: Cook sugar and milk over medium heat (stirring constantly) to soft ball stage (235°).  Add dates and pecans.  Let cool.  Turn into a buttered pan.  Knead until creamy and stiff.  Shape into a roll.  Wrap in damp dish towel or waxed paper.  Chill and then slice.  Makes approximately 1 1/2 pounds.

name: POT PIE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of mushroom, broccoli, onion or celery
1 (5 oz.)  can evaporated milk
parsley
3/4  c. cooked chicken, turkey or beef
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. mixed vegetables
3/4  c. instant potatoes
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/3  c. butter
milk
preparation: Filling:  Mix soup, seasoning, evaporated milk, meat and vegetables.  Spoon into casserole dish.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1/3  c. margarine/butter
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 3/4  c. chicken or turkey broth
2/3  c. milk
2  c. cooked chicken or turkey
1  (10 oz.) frozen mixed vegetables
garlic powder to taste
preparation: Heat margarine over low heat until melted.  Blend in flour, onion, salt and pepper.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is smooth and bubbly; remove from heat.  Stir in broth and milk.  Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.  Boil and stir 1 minute.  Stir in chicken and frozen vegetables.  Pour filling into pie crust.  Cook in 350° oven until crust is done (approximately 1 hour).

name: NONFAT BLUEBERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. Promise fat free mayonnaise
2  c. blueberries
1  c. skim (nonfat) milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring
Pam spray
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Mix flour, sugar and fat free margarine together by hand.  Dough will be sticky.  Put half of dough in bottom of a glass square dish that has been lightly sprayed with Pam.  Put blueberries on top of dough.  Drop remainder of dough by spoonfuls on top of blueberries.  Mix the vanilla flavoring with the skim milk and then pour over the cobbler.  Bake at 375° for about 45 minutes or until top crust is brown.

name: MOLASSES PECAN COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. butter
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1/3  c. molasses
3/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together; set aside.  In a separate bowl, cream the butter, sugar and eggs until smooth.  Add molasses; mix well.  Combine creamed mixture and dry ingredients.  Add nuts; blend well.  Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake in a 350° oven for about 10 minutes.  Makes about 3 dozen.

name: ITALIAN SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. Heinz ketchup
1  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. warm water
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. oregano
1  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Pour in a bowl Heinz ketchup and warm water.  Add salt and pepper.  Mix.  Add oregano and Parmesan cheese.  Cook over a low heat for 3 minutes, then sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
3/4  c. long grain rice
1 1/4  c. water
1  small onion, chopped
1  (3 lb.) chicken, cut up
salt and pepper to taste
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1/3  c. milk
preparation: Spread rice in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Add water. Sprinkle onion over mixture.  Season chicken to taste; place, skin side up, on rice mixture.  Slightly dilute soup with milk; spread over top of chicken.  Cover with foil; bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. fresh, peeled and diced apples
1  c. chopped pecans
3  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. nutmeg or cinnamon
1  c. vegetable oil
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs, well beaten
preparation: Mix the apples, sugar and nuts in a large mixing bowl and let stand for an hour.  Stir often so that the mixture makes its own juice.  Combine dry ingredients and add to apples.  Add oil, vanilla and eggs.  Do not use a mixer.  Stir ingredients together by hand.  Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.

name: BROWNIE MOUND COOKIES
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
2/3  c. light Karo syrup
2  eggs
6 (1 oz.)  sq. melted unsweetened chocolate
2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. coarsely chopped walnuts
preparation: Sift flour with baking powder and salt.  Set aside.  Mix margarine with sugar.  Stir in syrup and eggs.  Stir in flour, chocolate, vanilla and walnuts.  Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls onto greased baking sheet.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.  These cookies get soft and chewy when stored overnight in an airtight Tupperware type container.  They also freeze well.

name: ST. PATRICK'S DAY DINNER
ingredients:
4 to 5  lb. corned beef
1  clove garlic
1  bay leaf
1 (15 oz.)  can beef broth
2  potatoes, quartered
3  carrots, cut into 2-inch chunks
2  onions, quartered
1  cabbage, cut into wedges
preparation: Combine beef, garlic, bay leaf and broth.  Cover and cook in a 300° oven for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.  Remove cover and add vegetables. Cover again and continue cooking, approximately 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.

name: TWO PECAN PIES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
1  tsp. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  stick butter
1/2  c. milk
1  c. pecan
preparation: Cook at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: SALMON PATTIES
ingredients:
1 (15 to 16 oz.)  can pink salmon
1  egg
1/3  c. minced onion
1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Drain salmon; set aside 2 tablespoons juice.   In medium bowl, mix salmon, egg and onion; stir in flour.  Add baking powder to salmon juice.  Stir into salmon mixture.  Form into patties and fry until golden brown.  Serve with tartar sauce.  Quick, easy and nutritious.  Very good.

name: HELLO DOLLIES
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1 1/4  c. graham crackers
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. coconut
1  c. nuts
1  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Melt oleo in 13 x 9-inch pan.  Spread graham cracker crumbs over oleo and press.  Layer chocolate chips, coconut and nuts. Drizzle all over top can Eagle Brand milk.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until top browns.

name: HAM B.B.Q.'S
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
3  Tbsp. worcestershire sauce
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Cup ketchup
1  Cup water
sweet pickle relish
1 to 1 1/2  lb. chipped ham
preparation: Melt butter, worcestershire sauce and brown sugar in pot. Add ketchup, water and relish to suit.  Add chipped ham that has been pulled apart.  Heat thoroughly.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. shortening
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
4  tsp. milk
2  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar and vanilla.  Add egg and milk; beat until light and fluffy.  Sift dry ingredients together and blend into creamed mixture.  Divide dough in half.  Cover and chill at least one hour.  On lightly floured surface, roll to 1/8-inch thickness.  Chill other half of dough until ready to use.  Cut in desired shapes with cutters.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Cool slightly and remove.  Makes 3 dozen.

name: SHRIMP SPREAD
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  (8 oz.) shrimp and cocktail sauce
1  (6 or 8 oz.) frozen baby shrimp
preparation: Put softened cream cheese on a flat plate.  Spread cocktail sauce over cream cheese.  Sprinkle shrimp over the cream cheese and cocktail sauce.  Refrigerate.  Spread on crackers.

name: CHICKEN ELEGANCE
ingredients:
6  boneless chicken breasts
mayonnaise
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Place boneless chicken breasts in baking dish, spread with mayonnaise and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: CRACKER JACKS
ingredients:
5  qt. popped corn
1  c. peanuts
1  c. margarine
1  box light brown sugar
1/2  c. dark Karo syrup
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine popcorn and peanuts.  Melt butter.  Stir in sugar and syrup. Bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes. Stir often.

name: LEMON CRUMB SQUARES
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can condensed milk
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. grated lemon rind
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. butter or oleo
1  c. dark brown sugar, firmly packed
1  c. uncooked oatmeal
preparation: Blend together milk, juice and lemon rind and set aside.  Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.  Cream shortening; blend sugar.  Add oatmeal and flour mixture and mix until crumbly. Spread half the mixture in an 8 x 12 x 2-inch buttered baking pan and pat down; spread condensed milk mixture over top and cover with remaining crumb mixture.  Bake at 350° until brown around edges (about 25 minutes).  Cool in pan at room temperature for 15 minutes; cut into 1 3/4-inch squares and chill in pan until firm.

name: ICEBOX PICKLES
ingredients:
4  qt. thin sliced cucumbers
2  qt. sliced onions
1  c. salt
4  c. vinegar
8  c. sugar
5  tsp. red pepper
preparation: Pour salt over cukes; cover with water.  Soak 2 hours.  Drain, but do not rinse.  Boil remaining ingredients.  Cool.  Pour over cukes.  Must keep in refrigerator!

name: BAKED AUTUMN HAM
ingredients:
1  sm. canned ham (2 1/2lbs.)
4  slices orange
4  slices pineapple
4  cooked sweet potatoes
1/2  c. corn syrup
1/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: Bake ham in shallow baking dish for 40 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven, set oven to 400°.  Place orange slices, pineapple slices, and sweet potatoes around ham.  Pour corn syrup and brown sugar over ham, orange, pineapple, and sweet potatoes. Bake in 400° oven for 25 minutes or until browned and glazed. Makes 4 servings.

name: LIME JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1  (8 oz.) cottage cheese
1  (3 oz.) lime jello
1  (8 oz.) crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix Cool Whip and jello.  Cream mixture until well blended. Blend in other ingredients by hand.  Refrigerate for 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN AND DRESSING CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  chicken, cut up and boiled tender
1  can golden mushroom soup
1  stick butter, melted
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm dressing mix
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can sweet milk
1  c. chicken broth
preparation: Debone chicken.  Place chicken in casserole dish.  Mix soups and milk.  Pour over chicken.  Mix dressing, butter and broth. Pour over top.  Brown in oven at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. oatmeal (quick), uncooked
2/3  c. margarine
2  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. artificial sweetener
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. raisins
2  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  c. skim milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Stir oatmeal and melted margarine together.  Blend in eggs and sweetener.  Add sifted dry ingredients.  Mix in raisins alternately with milk and vanilla.  Drop on baking sheet and bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes or until brown.

name: FRUIT BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
6  slices bread, crumbled
8  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  can fruit cocktail
4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bake in greased cake pan, 11 x 14-inch, at 350° for 30 minutes or until inserted knife comes out clean.

name: BAKED CUSTARD
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. hot milk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. melted butter
pinch of salt
preparation: Beat eggs real good. Add sugar and beat well. Add hot milk, melted butter, salt and vanilla. Put into a buttered casserole. Set in a pan of hot water; bake in 350° oven until firm or until knife inserted comes out clean.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  to 6 medium zucchini
1  onion, finely chopped
2 small  cans sliced mushrooms
4  stalks celery, chopped
1  green pepper, finely chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  lb. bacon
1/4  c. bread crumbs
1/4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. butter
1  lightly beaten egg
preparation: Slice zucchini and cook until done.  Saute green pepper, garlic, onion, mushrooms and celery in butter.  Fry bacon, drain and crumble.  Drain zucchini in strainer.  While in strainer, lightly mash and then let drain again to eliminate excess liquid. Pour into casserole.  Add bacon crumbs, sauteed vegetables, lightly beaten egg and bread crumbs.  Blend.  (The consistency should be rather mushy.)  Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake in 350° oven 30 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: UNFRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
1 1/2  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. onion powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
4  chicken breast halves, skinned (2 1/2 lb.)
4  whole chicken legs, skinned (2 1/2 lb.)
1/4  c. evaporated milk
preparation: In shallow dish, mix together first 5 ingredients.  Dip chicken pieces in evaporated milk and coat with crumb mixture. Place in single layer in shallow roasting pan.  Bake in 400° oven for 45 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve hot or cold.  Makes 8 servings.  Per Serving:  235 calories, 39 g protein, 6 g carbohydrate, 5 g fat, 121 mg cholesterol and 317 mg sodium.

name: BEST EVER MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  lb. hamburger
1/2  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/2  c. chopped fine onion
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. water
preparation: Mix thoroughly 1/2 cup soup, beef, bread crumbs, egg, onion and salt.  Shape firmly into loaf, 8 x 4-inch.  Place in shallow baking pan.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
8  potatoes, sliced
1  medium sliced onion
1  can cream of mushroom, chicken or celery soup
slices of cheese
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Boil sliced potatoes with sliced onion.  Butter casserole dish.  Place 1/2 the drained potatoes in pan.  Add soup, evaporated milk, salt, pepper and celery seed.  Layer with slices of cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN ALA PREGO
ingredients:
1  egg
2  lb. boneless skinless chicken breast
1  c. Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  jar Prego sauce
preparation: Beat egg. Mix bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese together.  Dip chicken in egg, then in the crumbs. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan; put some sauce on bottom of pan. Place chicken on top of sauce. Put remaining sauce on top of chicken. Bake covered 1 hour at 400°. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and melt in oven.

name: PUMPKIN NUT COFFEECAKE
ingredients:
16  oz. can pumpkin
1/4  tsp. pumpkin spice
3  eggs
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  box yellow cake mix
1/2  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Mix at low speed for 1 minute.  Mix 2 minutes on medium speed.  Pour in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan.

name: PETER PAN COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. brown sugar, sifted
1/2  c. white sugar
1/4  lb. butter (1 stick)
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. nut meats
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt  butter.	Add  sugar,  well  beaten  egg,  flour, vanilla and nuts.  Drop by teaspoonfuls on baking sheet.  Bake 5 minutes at 400°.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. boiling water
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. dry strawberry jello
few drops red food coloring
1  qt. sliced strawberries
1  baked pie shell
Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cornstarch and sugar.  Pour into boiling water.  Stir until full rolling boil.  Add jello and food coloring.  Stir until dissolved.  Keep in refrigerator until consistency of egg whites. Pour sliced strawberries into baked pie shell.  Pour glaze over berries.  Chill.  Top each slice with Cool Whip just before serving.

name: JEROME BARS
ingredients:
2 1/4  sticks margarine
1  egg
1  c. sugar
1 small  can evaporated milk
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
2  c. powdered sugar
3  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
whole graham crackers
preparation: Line a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with whole graham crackers. Mix 1 1/2 sticks margarine, egg, sugar and evaporated milk and cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil.  Add graham cracker crumbs, coconut and pecans.  Mix well.  Pour over layer. Place another layer of graham crackers on top.  Mix remaining margarine (softened), powdered sugar, milk and vanilla. Spread on top layer.  Refrigerate.

name: CREAMY LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
3/4  c. finely chopped walnuts
1  stick butter or margarine
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
2 (4 oz.)  pkg. instant lemon pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Blend first 3 ingredients for crust and press into bottom and up sides of a 9-inch pie plate (use a fork). Bake 10 minutes and cool.

name: MIKE'S FAVORITE BAKED SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (15 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce with mushrooms
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. thin spaghetti
salt and pepper to taste
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can tomatoes
1  Tbsp. dried, diced onions
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  or 3 medium tomatoes, cut up or 1 pt.
4 to 6  slices American cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef, drain and season with salt and pepper.  Add next 7 ingredients and simmer 1 hour.  Cook spaghetti, drain and add meat mixture.  Put in casserole dish.  Cover with cheese slices and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated thoroughly and cheese is melted.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  cube margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
3  ripe bananas (medium)
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. walnut meats
preparation: Cream together first four ingredients until bananas are pulverized.  Sift together flour, salt and baking soda.  Mix in the banana mix and add walnuts.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes for small loaves or 1 hour for large loaves.   Cool in the pan.

name: SEAFOOD PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. Miracle Whip or mayonnaise
1/4  c. Zesty Italian dressing
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  c. (8 oz.) corkscrew noodles, cooked and drained
1 1/2  c. (8 oz.) imitation crabmeat, cut into chunks
1  c. broccoli flowerets, partially cooked
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped tomato
1/4  c. chopped green onion slices
preparation: Combine dressing and cheese.  Mix well.  Add remaining ingredients; mix lightly and chill.  Makes 4 servings.

name: OREO PIE
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. Oreo cookies
1  stick margarine
2 large  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
3 1/2  c. milk
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Mix Oreo cookies (crushed) with margarine and press in bottom of large dish.  Mix pudding, cream cheese, milk and softened Cool Whip.  Mix all ingredients together and pour into pie shell. Sprinkle reserved crumbs over pie (about 1 cup).

name: MANDARIN ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. orange jello
1  carton cottage cheese
1  c. pecans, chopped
2  cans mandarin oranges, drained
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Sprinkle  dry jello over cottage cheese and blend well. Add remaining ingredients and refrigerate.

name: HEARTY BREAKFAST CHOWDER
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed chicken noodle soup
1  can water
1 (8 3/4 oz.)  can whole kernel corn
1/2  c. nonfat dry milk powder
preparation: Heat together all ingredients.  Serve.

name: PINA COLADA CAKE
ingredients:
1  (2-layer) white cake mix
1  (4-serving size) Jell-O coconut cream or vanilla instant pudding mix
4  eggs
1  c. flaked coconut
1/2  c. water (with vanilla, increase water to 3/4 c., add 1 c. coconut to batter)
1/3  c. Bacardi dark rum (80 proof)
1/4  c. cooking oil
preparation: Blend all ingredients except coconut in large  mixer bowl. Beat 4 minutes at medium speed. Pour into 2 prepared layer cake pans (9-inch).  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Do not underbake.  Cool well.

name: SESAME PORK ROAST
ingredients:
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  sliced garlic cloves
2-inch ginger root, peeled and sliced
3 to 5  lb. pork tenderloin
3/4  c. honey
3/4  c. sesame seed
preparation: Combine soy sauce, garlic cloves and ginger root.  Marinate pork 1 hour in soy sauce mixture in refrigerator.  Dry pork with a paper towel.  Coat with honey and roll in sesame seed.  Bake on a lightly greased broiler pan rack at 375° until thickest portion reaches 160° (approximately 1 hour).

name: MAKE AHEAD FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can chunky fruit mix
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple tidbits
1 (5 or 6 oz.)  can mandarin oranges
1/4  c. orange juice
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. Cook 'N Serve vanilla pudding
2  or 3 bananas, sliced
preparation: Drain all the fruit and save 1 1/4 cups.  Combine saved fruit juice, orange juice and pudding in saucepan.  Cook until thick. Set aside and let cool.  Combine fruits and bananas.  Stir in cooled pudding.  Chill and serve.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. cooked squash
1/2  c. onions
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Dot with butter and crushed crackers.  I use bread crumbs.  Bake at 350° in casserole dish until top is golden brown.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/4  c. (1/2 stick) butter or margarine
1  c. dark brown sugar, firmly packed
1  egg, unbeaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. pecans or walnuts, coarsely chopped
preparation: Combine butter, sugar, egg and vanilla in mixing bowl; beat well until light and fluffy.  Sift together flour, baking powder and salt; stir into first mixture.  Mix in chopped nuts.  Spread in greased 8-inch square baking pan.  Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.  Let cool in pan and cut into squares while slightly warm.  Roll or toss in powdered sugar.  Makes 16 (2-inch) chewy squares.

name: CHEDDAR TURKEY BAKE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked turkey, diced
1  c. sharp Cheddar, diced
1/4  c. slivered almonds
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. cornflake crumbs
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1 1/2  c. celery, diced
3/4  c. salad dressing
1/4  c. onions, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1  medium tomato, sliced
preparation: Combine first 8 ingredients.  Mix lightly and spoon into 10 x 16-inch baking dish.  Toss cornflakes with butter.  Sprinkle over casserole.  Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.  Top with tomato slices. Bake again 5 minutes.  Top with additional cheese if desired. Serves 6.

name: RAISIN BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
5  c. flour
5  tsp. baking soda
7 1/2  c. Raisin Bran cereal
1  qt. buttermilk
4  eggs, beaten
3  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. oil
preparation: Blend flour, sugar, salt and soda.  Stir in cereal.  Add milk, oil and eggs.  Blend until moistened.  Do not stir again.  Can be stored 6 weeks in refrigerator.  Use as needed.  Fill lightly greased tins 2/3 full.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
12  oz. pkg. pasta noodles
chopped onion
2  c. chopped cucumbers
2  c. green peppers
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
preparation: Fix noodles according to package, let cool.  Mix together onion, cucumbers and green pepper.  Add mayonnaise.  Enjoy!

name: CRANBERRY-ORANGE COOLER
ingredients:
1  pkg. orange Jell-O
1  c. boiling water
2 1/2  c. cranberry juice, chilled
ice cubes
orange slices
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O into boiling water.  Add cranberry juice. Pour over ice cubes in tall glasses and garnish with orange slices.  Makes 3 1/2 cups or 4 servings.

name: PACKAGED CAKE(Microwave)
ingredients: 1  (17 to 18 1/2 oz.) cake mix
preparation: Grease and flour 2 (8-inch) round glass cake dishes.  Prepare cake mix as to package directions.  Heat one layer at a time uncovered on roast for 8 to 9 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.  Cool for 5 minutes.

name: GRANOLA BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo or butter
1/4  c. honey
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. quick cooking oats
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1  egg
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Melt butter in saucepan over low heat.  Remove from heat. Stir in remaining ingredients (sugar, honey, egg, flour, soda, cinnamon, salt, oats, coconut and nuts).  This mixture will be thick.  Press in prepared pan.  Bake 20 minutes.  Cool in pan. Cut into 32 bars.

name: SWEET POTATO DELIGHT
ingredients:
3  c. cooked or canned sweet potatoes
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. melted margarine
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. coconut
1  c. broken pecans
1/3  c. flour
1/3  c. melted margarine
preparation: Whip together sweet potatoes, vanilla and 1/3 cup margarine. Put in buttered casserole.  Mix together brown sugar, coconut, pecans, flour and 1/3 cup margarine.  Spread over top of sweet potatoes.  Cover 25 minutes, then uncover 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.

name: BISQUICK BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/3  c. oil
1-1/2  c. mashed bananas (3 lg.)
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2-1/3  c. Bisquick
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in one bow and beat for one minute.  Pour into a 9 x 5 x 3 inch loaf pan, which has been greased or sprayed with Pam.  Bake at 350° for 55-60 minutes, or longer.  Take a toothpick test to see if the bread is done.  Note: Reduced Fat Bisquick may be used in this recipe.

name: LOW CALORIE FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can pineapple (packed in own juice)
3  apples, peeled and cubed
3  bananas, sliced
1  can sliced peaches (packed in light syrup)
1  c. raisins
preparation: Mix all together and chill.

name: EASY RICE CASSEROLE(Good For Covered Dish Dinners)
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice
1  stick margarine, melted
1  can Campbell's onion soup
1  can Campbell's beef broth soup
1 small  can mushrooms
dash of Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Bake in casserole dish at 350° for 1 hour.

name: ITALIAN SAUSAGE SOUP
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. sweet Italian sausage
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  medium onions, chopped
1 (28 oz.)  can whole tomatoes, mashed
2 (14 oz. each)  cans beef broth
1  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. oregano
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  medium green pepper, chopped
1 to 2  c. water
preparation: In skillet, brown sausage; drain well.  Add all ingredients to a crock-pot and stir well.  Cover and cook on low setting for 12 hours.  Taste for seasoning.  Serve sprinkled with Parmesan cheese.  Makes 6 servings.

name: STEAK SOUP(For Crock-Pot)
ingredients:
2  c. water
4  small onions, chopped
6  stalks celery, chopped
4  carrots, sliced
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes
1  tsp. pepper
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
2  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
4 to 6  Tbsp. beef granules or dried au jus mix
1/2  c. butter, melted
1/2  c. flour
preparation: Put all ingredients except butter and flour in cooker.  Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours.  One hour before serving, turn to high.  Make a thickening of the butter and flour.  Stir until smooth.  Stir thickener into soup and cook on high until thickened.

name: PEANUT BUTTER REESE CUP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  roll Pillsbury peanut butter cookie mix
1  bag miniature Reese cups, unwrapped
1  miniature muffin pan
preparation: Spoon out cookies from roll and form into a ball.  Place a ball into each cup of the pan.  Bake as directed on the package of the cookies.  Remove from the oven and push slightly, 1 miniature cup into each cookie.  Allow to cool before removing from the pan.

name: CHICKEN DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  whole broiler-fryer chickens
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
8  c. water
preparation: Place chickens in a large pot or Dutch oven.  Sprinkle chickens, inside and out, with salt and pepper.  Add water.  Bring to boiling.  Cover and cook for 50 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender.  Remove chickens to serving platter.  Cut into serving portions.  Keep chicken warm while dumplings cook.

name: CHRISTMAS LIME SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime Jell-O
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/4  c. sugar
1  c. whipping cream, whipped
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained
1  (6 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients with 1 cup boiling water.  Stir until marshmallows melt.  Refrigerate until partially congealed. Blend in whipped cream, pineapple cream cheese and pecans.  Chill until set.

name: APPLE DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. strawberry jam
1 (8 oz.)  carton whipped topping
preparation: Whip softened cream cheese with jam.  Gently fold in topping until evenly blended.  A great fruit dip especially for apples.

name: CORN DOG BITES
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
2/3  c. cornmeal
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  egg, beaten
1  c. buttermilk
1  pkg. hot dogs
hot vegetable oil
preparation: Combine flour, meal and sugar.  Combine 2 tablespoons oil, egg and milk.  Stir into flour mixture.  Cut hot dogs into pieces. Dip in batter and fry in hot oil until brown.  Serve with mustard or ketchup.

name: OVEN POTATOES
ingredients:
6  to 8 medium potatoes
2 to 3  Tbsp. oil
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
preparation: Wash potatoes and cut into bite-size pieces.  Place potatoes and oil in mixing bowl and mix until potatoes are well coated. Add onion soup mix.  Mix well.  Place potatoes in shallow baking pan.  Bake at 375° or 400° for 35 to 45 minutes or until brown and tender.

name: SLICED FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can fruit cocktail
4  lettuce leaves
whipped cream or salad dressing
preparation: Freeze can of fruit cocktail.  Open both ends of can; push fruit cocktail out.  Cut into 4 slices.  Serve on lettuce; garnish with whipped cream.  Serve immediately.

name: HAWAIIAN PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1  box yellow cake mix
3  c. cold milk
8  oz. cream cheese
20  oz. can crushed pineapple
1  large container Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake according to directions in greased sheet cake pan. Cool cake.

name: CAMPER'S COCOA
ingredients:
1  (2 lb.) container Hershey's Quik
1 large  jar Coffee-mate
1 (1 lb.)  box powdered sugar
1  (14 qt.) container instant milk
1/2  c. cocoa
1  c. sugar
preparation: Mix together and keep in airtight container.  Use 1/3 cup mix to 1 cup boiling water.

name: AUNT ANN'S APPLESAUCE FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. applesauce
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
2  tsp. baking soda
1  lb. raisins, cooked about 10 minutes and drained well
2  c. white sugar
1  c. butter
1/2  c. oleo
1  egg
1/2  lb. English walnuts
4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. dates, cut in pieces
1  lb. mixed fruit
preparation: Mix together applesauce, cinnamon, nutmeg and baking soda. Cream together sugar, butter and oleo.  Add egg.  Add to applesauce mixture.  Blend remaining ingredients together and add raisins. Bake in tube pans at 300° for 1/2 hour and at 275° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: CROCK-POT VENISON
ingredients:
1/2  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. salt
2  cloves garlic
cold water
2  cloves garlic, chopped
1  large onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
salt and pepper to taste
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. mustard
1/2  c. vinegar
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes
preparation: Marinate venison overnight in vinegar, salt and 2 cloves of garlic; cover with cold water.  Place venison in crock-pot after draining liquid.  Add chopped garlic, onion, brown sugar, salt and pepper to taste, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, vinegar and tomatoes.  Cook on high until tender.  Serve over noodles or rice.

name: SIMPLE BASIC YEAST DOUGH - "NO KNEADING"
ingredients:
2  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. warm water
3/4  c. milk
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine
3  eggs
1  tsp. salt
5 to 5 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Add yeast to water; let stand a few minutes.  Stir to dissolve.  Combine milk, margarine and sugar; heat to about 120°. Cool; add eggs, salt and 2 cups of flour.  Beat thoroughly.  Stir into yeast mixture.  Blend in remaining flour; beat 5 minutes.  Do not knead.  Brush with shortening.  Cover and let rise 1 hour. Turn out on lightly floured surface.  Knead 1 minute.  Shape into rolls.  Bake at 350° until brown.

name: OUTSTANDING BREAKFAST
ingredients:
1  lb. bacon
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
4  slices white bread
1  doz. eggs
3  c. milk
pepper
paprika
preparation: Fry and crumble bacon.  Cube bread.  Layer bacon, cheese and bread into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix eggs, milk and spices. Pour over layered ingredients.  Refrigerate overnight (at least 4 hours).  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: QUICK CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  roasted whole chicken or 6 skinned and boned, cooked chicken breast halves, chopped
4  c. water
3  c. chopped cooked chicken
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
2  tsp. chicken bouillon granules
1  tsp. seasoned pepper
1 (7.5 oz.)  can refrigerated buttermilk biscuits
preparation: Bring first 5 ingredients to a boil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat, stirring often.  Separate biscuits in half, forming 2 rounds; cut each round in half.  Drop biscuit pieces, 1 at a time, into boiling mixture; stir gently.  Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer, stirring occasionally, 15 to 20 minutes.

name: JALAPENO APPETIZER
ingredients:
jalapeno hot peppers
2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1  doz. eggs
preparation: Pam a 13 x 9-inch Pyrex dish and line the bottom with drained, sliced jalapeno hot peppers.  Grate Cheddar cheese and put on top of the peppers.  Beat eggs and pour over top of cheese.  Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.  Cool and cut in 1-inch squares.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  egg whites
1 1/2  c. skim milk
2  drops yellow food coloring
1/2  c. sugar substitute
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. raisins
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
preparation: Combine egg whites, milk, coloring, sugar, salt, vanilla, raisins and cinnamon.  Mix and blend well.  Add rice and pour into shallow quart casserole.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until a knife comes out clean when tested in the middle.  Serve warm.

name: ECLAIR CAKE
ingredients:
2 small  boxes instant French vanilla pudding
2 1/2  c. skim milk
16  oz. tub Cool Whip
1 (1 lb.)  box reduced fat graham crackers
1  tub Betty Crocker sour cream chocolate icing
preparation: First, spray 9 x 13 pan with nonstick spray. Put layer of graham crackers. Next, mix pudding and milk. When starts to thicken, fold in Cool Whip. Spread 1/2 of mixture onto the crackers, then add another layer of crackers. Put rest of mixture onto crackers. Top with remaining crackers. Frost crackers with icing. Refrigerate overnight or at least 4 hours.

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
2  cans Swanson chicken
1  can Veg-All
1  can cream of chicken
1  can cream of celery
preparation: Mix all pie ingredients in a baking dish.

name: TUNA BALL
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  can tuna, drained
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
1  small onion, chopped fine
1  tsp. Tabasco sauce
preparation: Mix and form into ball and roll in parsley flakes. Refrigerate.

name: DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1/2  Tbsp. salt
1  egg
2  Tbsp. shortening
1/4  c. sugar
1/4 cake yeast or 1  pkg. dry yeast
1 1/4  c. warm water
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Mix with rest of ingredients. Let rise until about doubled.  Punch dough down.  In muffin pan, place dough in each cup or 3 small balls in each for cloverleaf rolls.  This can also be baked in a loaf pan for bread.  Bake at 325° until tops are golden.

name: JUMP CREW CRAB DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. crab meat
2  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  shakes garlic powder
3  shakes Season-All salt
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix together everything except grated Cheddar cheese.  Place crab mixture into a baking dish.  Sprinkle grated Cheddar on top. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

name: BANANA PECAN COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. chopped pecans
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. mashed, ripe bananas
1/3  c. oil
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Lightly grease a 9-inch square pan. Mix pecans, brown sugar and cinnamon; set aside.  Stir flour and sugar until well mixed.  Combine bananas, eggs, oil and vanilla until blended.  Add blended liquid ingredients to flour mixture and stir.  Spread half of batter into pan.  Sprinkle half of nuts, brown sugar and cinnamon.  Spread rest of batter.  Sprinkle with remaining nut mixture.

name: CRACKER CANDY
ingredients:
saltine crackers
1  c. butter (not margarine)
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1  bag Nestle milk chocolate morsels
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Line a 9 x 13-inch cookie sheet with aluminum foil.  Cover with saltine crackers.  In a saucepan, mix next 2 ingredients and boil 3 minutes.  Pour over saltines.  Cook in oven for 5 minutes.  Take out and straighten crackers.  Quickly pour over this the bag of morsels.  Let stand for 5 minutes. Spread with a knife.  Refrigerate until chocolate set.  Peel off aluminum and break into pieces.  Keep in refrigerator.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1 (29 oz.)  can pumpkin
1 1/2  c. sugar *
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
2 (12 oz.)  cans evaporated milk or substitute 3 c. skim milk
preparation: * Four tablespoons Equal may be substituted for sugar.

name: BAKING POWDER BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
6  Tbsp. shortening
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Bake at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. corn syrup
1  c. brown sugar
4  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. pecans
1/4  c. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. pecan halves on top
preparation: Cook corn syrup and brown sugar.  Beat eggs and add to mixture.  Add pecans, butter and vanilla and pour into unbaked pie shells.  Place pecan halves on top.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
8  oz. pkg. spaghetti
1/4  c. butter
3  Tbsp. flour
2  c. chicken broth
3/4  c. half and half
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
dash of pepper
3  c. cubed, cooked chicken
4  oz. mushrooms, sliced
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook spaghetti and drain; set aside. Melt butter.  Stir in flour; add chicken broth.  Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens.  Remove from heat.  Stir in half and half, parsley, salt, nutmeg and pepper.  Toss chicken, mushrooms and spaghetti with sauce.  Turn mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake for 30 to 40 minutes until thoroughly heated.  Makes 8 servings.

name: MAPLE WALNUT SCONES
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
1/4  c. brown sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. ginger
7  Tbsp. butter
1  large egg, beaten
1/2  c. buttermilk
1/3  c. maple syrup
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Mix flour with brown sugar, baking powder, salt, soda and ginger.  Cut butter into flour mixture in small particles.  Add egg, buttermilk and maple syrup.  Stir just until mixed.  Stir in walnuts and raisins.  Drop batter by heaping tablespoons onto lightly greased baking sheet 2 inches apart, making 10 mounds. Bake at 425° for 12 to 13 minutes.  Serve warm.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  can cream-style corn
1  can whole kernel corn
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  box Jiffy corn muffin mix
preparation: Melt the margarine in a casserole.  Mix together all ingredients.  Pour into casserole. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until it begins to brown.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs, well beaten
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. milk
1/2  stick margarine, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Grease pie pan with butter (this will make 2 pies).  Mix all ingredients.  Pour into greased pie pans.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes (until firm).

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. oleo
2 1/2  lb. confectioners sugar
2  bags (12 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  slat paraffin wax
preparation: Combine oleo and sugar; roll into balls.  Melt chocolate chips and paraffin.  Cover balls with chocolate mixture.  Let harden on wax paper.  Makes a large amount.

name: ORANGE-DATE BARS(For Diabetics)
ingredients:
1  c. chopped dates
1/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. orange juice
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  egg
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. grated orange rind
preparation: Combine dates, sugar, oil and juice in a saucepan.   Cook for 5 minutes to soften dates.  Cool.  Add remaining ingredients. Spread into an oiled 8 x 8-inch baking pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.   Cool before cutting.  Makes 36 bars.

name: HERB-SEASONED POPCORN
ingredients:
4 (3.5 oz.)  pkg. butter flavored microwave popcorn
2  tsp. dried basil
2  tsp. dried chervil
2  tsp. dried thyme
2 (12 oz.)  cans mixed salted nuts
preparation: Prepare popcorn, one package at a time, according to directions.  Carefully open each bag and add 1/2 teaspoon of each herb.  Close bag and shake.  Pour into containers.  Add nuts and toss gently.  Yields 9 quarts.

name: ASIAN CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. dark Asian sesame oil
1 small  clove garlic, chopped
1/2  tsp. minced fresh ginger
1  sweet red pepper
1  (3 oz.) boneless, skinned chicken breast
1  c. cooked cellophane noodles (1 1/2 oz. dry)
preparation: Preheat broiler.  Combine soy sauce, lemon juice, sesame oil, garlic and ginger in a small bowl.  Place red pepper and chicken on broiler pan 3 inches from heat.  Broil chicken, 3 minutes per side, until opaque.  Broil pepper until skin is black, turning, about 10 minutes.  Place pepper in brown paper bag until cool; peel, core, seed and slice into strips.  Slice chicken into strips.  Toss with pepper, noodles and sauce.  Serve warm or chilled.

name: SAUCY SMOKIES
ingredients:
2  lb. cocktail Smokies
1  bottle chili sauce
8  oz. grape jelly
preparation: Place Smokies in medium saucepan; combine with jelly and 1/2 bottle chili sauce.  Simmer over low heat until jelly melts, stirring occasionally.  When sauce is thickened, remove from heat and place in serving bowl.

name: PARTY MIX
ingredients:
1 large  box (lb.) oysterettes
1  c. Wesson oil
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1 large  can mixed nuts
1  pkg. Ranch style dressing
1  tsp. lemon pepper
preparation: Mix together and stir into oysterettes and nuts until oil mixture is absorbed by oysterettes.

name: CAVIAR-CREAM CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. onion flakes
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  Tbsp. lemon juice
dash of hot sauce
2  hard-boiled eggs, finely mashed
1/2  c. chopped fresh parsley
1 small  jar black caviar
preparation: Soften cream cheese in microwave, then beat with fork until smooth. Stir in mayonnaise, onion, lemon juice and hot sauce. Blend well. Spoon onto serving tray and shape into low, flat mound.  Mix mashed eggs and parsley. Cover cream cheese mound with mixture, pressing it gently in the mound.  Top with layer of caviar and serve with crackers.

name: FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
4  onions, sliced
1/4  c. oleo
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
4  c. water
6  beef bouillon cubes
1  can beef broth
6  slices toast
oleo
garlic salt
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Saute onions in the oleo. Add flour, Worcestershire sauce, water and broth. Simmer for 1 hour or until onions are tender. Serve with toasted bread with butter, Parmesan cheese and garlic salt. Cut toast up into small pieces. Top soup and croutons with Mozzarella cheese.

name: ZUCCHINI QUICHE
ingredients:
1/2  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt and pepper
1  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. mixed Swiss and Cheddar cheese, shredded or grated
2  Tbsp. parsley
3  c. zucchini, grated
preparation: Grease square pan.  Mix eggs, oil, salt, pepper and parsley. In separate bowl, mix zucchini, onion, Bisquick and cheese.  Add to mixture and fold in.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
1 large  bunch broccoli, cut into spears, or 2 pkg. (10 oz.  each) frozen broccoli spears
4  Tbsp. butter
salt and pepper to taste
1/4  c. flour
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
2  c. milk, heated
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/2  lb. mushrooms (optional)
8  skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, poached
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Steam broccoli spears until barely tender, 3 to 5 minutes.  Arrange in the bottom of a buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.

name: DILL PICKLES
ingredients:
3  c. white vinegar
3  c. water
1  tsp. salt to a pt. or 1 Tbsp. to a qt.
garlic pieces (4 small cloves to each qt.)
cucumbers
2  Tbsp. dill seed (each jar)
3  peppercorns (each jar)
preparation: Peel garlic pieces.  Pack clean jars with clean cucumbers. Add dill seed and peppercorns to each jar.  Cold pack for 10 minutes.  Delicious.

name: CHOCOLATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
3  c. milk
1  box graham crackers
1  large Cool Whip
2  pkg. instant vanilla pudding (large)
Milk Chocolate frosting
preparation: Line a 9 x 13-inch cake pan with whole graham crackers.  Mix pudding and mix together until real thick; add Cool Whip and mix well.  Spread mixture over graham crackers.  Top with another layer of crackers, then spread on chocolate frosting and refrigerate. Serve cool.

name: BROCCOLI DIP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  lb. Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Cook broccoli and drain.  Mix broccoli, soup and cheese. Microwave until cheese is melted.  Stir and mix well. Serve with Triscuits or any snack cracker.

name: CHEDDAR CHEESE PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon gelatin
1  c. water
1/2  c. sour cream
1 (13 1/2 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, undrained
1/2  c. (2 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
preparation: In  medium  saucepan  combine gelatin and water.  Heat. Stir until  gelatin  is  dissolved.  Beat mayonnaise and sour cream together with spoon.  Mix gelatin in mayonnaise mixture a little at  a  time.  Add pineapple.  About 20 to 30 minutes later, add Cheddar cheese.  Chill until firm.

name: SPICY SPINACH AND ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. (1 stick) margarine or butter
1  med. onion, chopped (1 c.)
2 - 10  oz. pkgs. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
1- 14  oz. can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1- 8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1- 8  oz. pkg. sour cream
1  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. tabasco or hot sauce
Salt to taste
Corn chips, crackers or firm bread
preparation: Melt butter in large saucepan or skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Stir in spinach, artichokes, cream cheese, sour cream 3/4 cup of Monterey Jack cheese, 3/4 cup of Parmesan cheese, tabasco sauce and salt. Stir until well blended and heated through. Pour mixture into casserole dish and top with remaining cheeses. Bake at 350 degrees until cheese starts to brown, about 10 to 15 minutes.

name: GERMAN POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
3  lb. potatoes
soup greens
1  bay leaf
1  small onion, quartered
2  bouillon cubes
bacon
1  diced onion
preparation: Peel, quarter and slice potatoes. Combine with water and all seasonings. Cook for 30 to 40 minutes. Dice bacon; fry. Add diced onion and fry until brown. Put in with potatoes. Add wieners or smoked sausage until heated. Eat with soup.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1  stick melted butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  mashed ripe bananas
preparation: Cream together sugar, eggs, margarine, flour and bananas. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: CHEESE KRISPIES
ingredients:
1  lb. grated sharp cheese
1/2  lb. melted butter
1/2 to 1  tsp. red pepper
2  c. flour
dash of salt
2  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Sprinkle flour on cheese.  Pour on butter.  Add salt and red pepper.  Add Rice Krispies.  Knead by hand.  Roll into marble sized balls and bake on ungreased sheet.  Flatten with fork and bake at 300° for 30 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI TUNA ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. milk
1  can tuna fish
1  pkg. frozen broccoli spears
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  can French fried onions
1  tomato, chopped
6  small flour tortillas
preparation: Cut broccoli spears in 1-inch pieces.  Combine soup and milk. Set aside.  Combine tuna fish, broccoli, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can French fried onions.  Stir in 3/4 cup soup.  Divide tuna mixture evenly between the tortillas and roll up.  Place seam side down in a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Stir tomato into remaining soup and pour over top of tortillas.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 35 minutes.  Top center of tortillas with remaining cheese and onions.  Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.

name: LOUISIANA GUMBO
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. chicken wings
1  pkg. frozen okra
1  pkg. smoke sausage (if desired)
1  lb. medium/large shrimp, peeled (if desired)
large white onion
shallots (green onion)
1  bell pepper
parsley flakes
2  bay leaves
preparation: In a large 1 1/2-quart or 8-quart pot, half fill with water; place on back burner.  In a large skillet, brown chicken wings and smoke sausage in some shortening.  When good and brown (just before), add onion, shallots, parsley, bell pepper and bay leaves. Turn over several times, then pour in large pot of water.  Add shortening to cover bottom of skillet and thaw the frozen okra until almost all of the juice is out.  May add shrimp and white onion, if desired.  Put this all in the large pot with the rest of the ingredients.

name: MOM'S SIX LAYER DINNER
ingredients:
2  c. sliced raw potatoes
1  c. sliced onion
1 small  can tomatoes
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. uncooked rice
2  c. ground beef
1  c. sliced green pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients and place in a greased casserole or slow cooker.  If baking, cover with lid and bake at 300° for 2 1/2 hours.  Slow cooker should take about the same time.

name: BRUNCH BITES
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
2/3  c. milk
1/4  c. sour cream
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
2  cloves garlic, crushed
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix first 3 ingredients.  Add egg, milk and sour cream.  Mix well.  Add cheese, ham, garlic and parsley. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish for 40 minutes or bake in miniature muffin tins for 15 minutes.  Yield: 4 dozen muffins.

name: HAMBURG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburg or ground turkey
2  c. green beans
2  cans tomato soup
mashed potatoes
1  onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
2  slices bacon, cooked crisp
butter or margarine (optional)
2  eggs
salt
pepper
pinch of chives
1  tsp. fine dry bread crumbs
1  tsp. milk
preparation: Crumble bacon.  Brush individual gratin dish or casserole dish with bacon grease or butter.  Crack eggs into dish.  Sprinkle with salt, pepper and chives.  Sprinkle crumbled bacon over eggs and then sprinkle with bread crumbs.  Pour milk over eggs.  Bake at 350° for 13 to 15 minutes or until eggs are set.

name: EASY SALAD
ingredients:
1  can French green beans
1  can white Shoe Peg corn
1  can LeSueur English peas
1  can water chestnuts, chopped
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  c. chopped Vidalia onion (add in summertime)
preparation: Drain the first 4 ingredients. After veggies have drained, place in large bowl. Add enough mayonnaise only to coat. Add small amount of Ranch dressing, just enough to cut taste of mayonnaise, at least 1 tablespoon. Best to add grated cheese an hour or so before serving salad, but can be added at any time. Refrigerate.

name: CANDIED YAMS
ingredients:
2  medium size yams, baked
1  c. crushed pineapple
1/2  c. pineapple juice
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  tsp. grated orange peel
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Remove skin from baked potatoes.  Slice as desired.  Pour crushed pineapple with juice over potatoes.  Sprinkle sugar over. Place sliced butter over or on top.  Add vanilla.  Add grated orange peel, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Place in 350° oven 1 or 1 1/2 hours, until candied and brown.  Yields 4 servings.

name: HAM LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground pork
2  lb. ground ham
4  eggs
1/2  c. milk
2  c. bread crumbs
2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. dry mustard
preparation: Mix pork, ham, eggs, milk and bread crumbs together.  Shape into loaf.  Mix brown sugar, vinegar, water and mustard together. Pour over loaf.  Bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours.  Cover with foil and continually baste.

name: APPLE DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
vanilla to taste
preparation: Blend well.  Serve with apple slices.

name: STRAWBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin
2 1/2  c. boiling water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1  pt. whipping cream, whipped
1  large angel food cake
preparation: Dissolve gelatin with boiling water.  Let partially set.  Fold in the whipped cream and the strawberries.  Tear 1/2 the cake into pieces and lay loosely in bottom of pan.  Pour half of gelatin mixture over cake pieces.  Repeat.  Chill at least 4 hours.  Keep in refrigerator.

name: MEATBALL SOUP WITH SPAGHETTI RINGS
ingredients:
4  carrots, peeled and sliced
2  stalks celery, sliced
1  small onion, peeled and diced
3  bouillon cubes (beef flavored)
1/2  tsp. pepper
3  qt. water
preparation: Combine ingredients in a large pot; bring to a boil.  Simmer 20 minutes.

name: SWEDISH POTATIS KORB(Potato Sausage)
ingredients:
5  lb. all-purpose potatoes, peeled
1  lb. hamburger
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. pepper
3  oz. casing (skins), soak in water 1/2 hour
1  medium onion
preparation: Coarse grind potatoes and onion.  Mix all together the potatoes, onion, hamburger, salt and pepper in a bowl.  Using a hand sausage stuffing tube with casing attached, force in mixture into 2 feet of casing.  Flatten casing to half its thickness and leave ends 1-inch empty.  Place 2 to 3 lengths into 8 quarts of salted boiling water.  Cook 30 minutes.  Remove from water and serve hot with salad and French bread.  Serves 1 to 1 1/2 persons. Is good cold also.

name: ROLLED COOKIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines spice cake mix
1  egg
2  Tbsp. undiluted frozen orange juice concentrate
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Combine egg, orange juice and butter.  Slowly add cake mix.  If too stiff, add more orange juice concentrate.  Cover with plastic wrap and chill.  Roll about 1/8-inch thick and bake on greased cookie sheets for 5 to 8 minutes at 325°.  (Can also use chocolate mix and Kahlua.)

name: RAISIN-BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar or honey
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
3  c. Raisin Bran or 1 1/2 c. All-Bran and 3/4 c. raisins
1 1/4  c. milk
1  egg
1/3  c. shortening or vegetable oil
preparation: Measure Raisin Bran and milk into mixing bowl.  Stir to combine.  Let stand 2 minutes until softened.  Add egg and shortening.  Beat well.  Stir together flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Add dry ingredients to cereal mix. Stir until well combined.  Spoon into 12 greased muffin tins.  Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

name: CARAMEL BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1  (14 oz.) sweetened condensed milk, caramelized
1 1/2  c. cold water
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
2  c. (1 pt.) whipping cream, whipped
36  vanilla wafers
3  medium bananas, sliced and dipped in bottled lemon juice and drained
preparation: Caramelize the sweetened condensed milk by preferred method. In a large mixer bowl, combine caramelized milk and water.  Add pudding mix; beat well. Chill 5 minutes.  Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 1 cup pudding mixture into 2 1/2-quart glass serving bowl. Top with 1/3 each of the wafers, bananas and pudding. Repeat layering twice, ending with pudding.  Cover and chill.  Garnish as desired.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: DILL BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1  c. cottage cheese
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. dill seed
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  egg
2 1/4 to 2 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Measure out half a bag of self-rising flour into large mixing bowl. Add warm water, a cup at a time, until you get where your mixture does not stick to your fingers. Pinch off dinner roll size dough, then flatten on a flour covered surface. You may use a rolling pin if so desired. Fry in 1 inch of hot shortening, preferably in an iron skillet. Fry until golden brown, flipping over, so both sides are even.  Set aside on a paper towel to drain. Top with honey or powdered sugar if desired.

name: CITRUS SODA CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
2  sticks oleo
1/2  c. shortening
5  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
7  oz. bottle 7-Up
3  c. flour
pinch of salt
1  tsp. lemon extract
preparation: Cream together sugar, oleo and shortening.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.  Add flour and salt alternately with 7-Up. Beat well.  Add flavoring. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: BISCUIT PUDDING
ingredients:
2  large eggs, lightly beaten
2  c. milk
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
3  c. crumbled biscuits
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
1  stick butter
1  c. Bisquick
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
4  Tbsp. juice from canned peaches
1 large  can sliced peaches (Freestone are best)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large black skillet, melt butter in oven until completely melted.  Remove skillet and swirl around butter so that bottom and sides are covered.  In separate mixing bowl, put all remaining ingredients and mix gently.  Pour mixture into skillet with butter.  Do not stir!  Bake for 30 to 45 minutes until crust is golden.  Serve plain or with vanilla ice cream. Transfer leftovers to airtight container.  Reheat in microwave. Better the next day!

name: PORK CHOPS FOR MICROWAVE
