ingredients:
4  medium chops
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. water or milk
preparation: Mix soup, milk or water together.  Place in a baking dish over chops.  Bake at 50% power for 15 minutes per pound.

name: POTAGE PEA SOUP
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen green peas
1  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
sprinkling of fresh ground pepper
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can chicken broth, undiluted
1  Tbsp. butter
4 to 6  Tbsp. half and half
preparation: Defrost peas to room temperature.  Reserve 1/2 cup of peas for garnish.  In small saucepan, combine remaining peas with water, salt, sugar and pepper.  Bring to vigorous boil over high heat. Cover, lower heat to medium and cook 5 minutes.  Remove from heat. Strain liquid and reserve.  Cool peas and place in blender with chicken broth.  Cover and blend on high speed for 1 minute.  Add to saucepan with cooking liquid and bring to a boil.  Stir in butter with wire whisk.  Taste and correct seasonings.  Before serving, add 2 or 3 tablespoons of soup to cream.  Garnish with uncooked peas.

name: MICROWAVE FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can (20 oz.) pineapple chunks
2 small  cans mandarin oranges
4  bananas
2  c. juice from drained fruit
2 small  boxes vanilla pudding (not instant)
preparation: Mix juice from fruit with vanilla pudding and cook until thick in microwave according to directions on box, stirring occasionally.  Cool, then add fruit; add bananas before serving.

name: CHICKEN KUN KOKI
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. minced onion flakes
1/4  c. soy sauce
3/4  c. water
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  (10 oz.) chicken breasts or pieces, skinned
preparation: Combine onion flakes, soy sauce, pepper and water.  Bring to boil.  Put in chicken pieces and cook (simmer) until chicken is done.

name: CHEESE RING WITH PRESERVES
ingredients:
1  lb. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  chopped (finely) onion
3/4  c. chopped pecans
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix and form into ring; fill middle with strawberry preserves. Serve with Waverly crackers.

name: SUGAR-FREE APPLE PIE
ingredients:
pastry for double crust pie
6  oz. frozen apple juice (sugar-free)
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground nutmeg
6  c. apples, freshly peeled
preparation: Combine apple juice and cornstarch in saucepan; bring to boil stirring frequently.  Add butter and spices; mix well.  Stir in apples.  Spoon into pastry shell.  Cover with top crust.  Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.  Reduce heat to 375° and bake for an additional 30 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI STICKS
ingredients:
1  medium to large zucchini
4  eggs
16  oz. cornmeal or flour
preparation: Cut zucchini into 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch strips.  Dip into beaten eggs and then into the cornmeal.  Place battered strips into a pot of hot oil.  Cook until brown.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Serve with Ranch dressing.

name: HAWAIIAN CHICKEN BREAST
ingredients:
1  (3 oz.) chicken breast
1/4  c. soy sauce (Kikkoman lite)
1/2  c. crushed pineapple
1/2  bell pepper
2  Tbsp. brown sugar substitute
Mrs. Dash lemon pepper
preparation: Overnight, marinate chicken in soy sauce and sprinkle on Mrs. Dash lemon pepper.  Place chicken in baking dish.  Sprinkle with brown sugar substitute.  Pour remaining soy sauce over chicken. Bake covered for 1/2 hour at 350°.  Uncover; add bell pepper and pineapple.  Bake 1/2 hour longer.  Each serving:  1 portion. Exchanges:  3 meat, 1/2 vegetable and 1 fruit.  Calories:  284.

name: BREAD DIP
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, drained
1  pkg. Knorr dry vegetable soup mix
1  can water chestnuts, chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Cut top off of a large round loaf of bread,  unsliced.  Take	out  the insides of the bread and cut into  wedge  shaped  pieces.  Put  spinach	mixture in hollowed-out bread.  Place	wedged	pieces around the loaf and replace the top.

name: SQUASH PATTIES
ingredients:
2  c. grated uncooked yellow squash
2  tsp. grated onions
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. sugar
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. all-purpose flour
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Combine first five ingredients.  Cover and let stand 30 minutes.  Drain thoroughly.  Add flour and eggs.  Stir well.  Melt margarine in a large skillet over medium heat.  Drop squash mixture by tablespoons in hot margarine.  Cook until golden brown, turning once.

name: PUMPKIN SPICE DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. Bisquick baking mix
1/2  c. quick-cooking oats
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  c. firm margarine or butter
1  can (16 oz.) pumpkin
1  can (13 oz.) evaporated milk
2  eggs
3/4  c. granulated sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
2  Tbsp. firm margarine or butter
Spiced Whipped Cream
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix baking mix, oats, 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/4 cup margarine until crumbly.  Press into rectangular pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inches.  Bake 10 minutes; cool slightly.

name: BLACK-EYED PEA SALSA
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can black-eyed peas, drained
2  tomatoes, chopped
1  bunch green onions, sliced
1  Tbsp. cilantro
3  Tbsp. lime juice
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1 to 2  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. cumin
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Place peas in colander.  Rinse with cold water; drain. Combine tomatoes and next seven ingredients in medium bowl; stir in peas.  Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours.  Serve with tortilla chips.

name: ICEBOX CHERRY CAKE
ingredients:
graham crackers (whole)
1 large  box vanilla sugar-free Jell-O instant pudding
1 1/2  c. Cool Whip Lite
2  cans cherry pie filling (light version)
2  c. skim milk
preparation: Mix pudding and milk, then add Cool Whip.  Place graham crackers in bottom of an 8 x 13-inch cake pan.  Pour half the pudding mixture over crackers.  Top that with more graham crackers and pour rest of mixture over second layer of crackers.  Top with cherry pie filling.  Refrigerate for at least one hour before serving.

name: POINSETTIA COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
60  large marshmallows
1  tsp. vanilla
green food coloring to desired tint
6  c. corn flakes
preparation: Melt butter, marshmallows and vanilla on low.  Add food coloring.  Mix in corn flakes.  Shape into wreaths on wax paper. Add red cinnamon candies around wreath; let set overnight.

name: COOKED PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1 1/2  c. salt
6  tsp. cream of tartar
3  Tbsp. salad oil
3  c. water with food coloring added
preparation: Combine all the ingredients and mix well in a large pan.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until dough clings together in a ball.  Cool and knead.  Store in an airtight container.

name: STUFFED CABBAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
12  medium-size cabbage leaves
1 1/2  c. cooked ground beef
1  onion, grated
1  c. cooked rice
1  tsp. salt
dash of cayenne pepper
1  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  c. tomato juice
preparation: Cook cabbage leaves for 3 minutes in boiling, salted water. Drain; dry.  Combine ground beef, onion, rice and seasonings.  Put about 1/4 cup on each cabbage leaf.  Roll and fasten with wooden toothpick.  Place rolls close together in greased baking dish. Brush rolls with butter and pour tomato juice over them.  Bake in moderate oven at 375° until cabbage leaves are tender, about 15 minutes.  Remove wooden picks before serving.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. melted butter
3  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  tsp. lemon extract
1/2  c. coconut
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat eggs; add milk, sugar, flour, butter, salt, both extracts and coconut.  Mix well.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Cook 10 minutes at 375° and then 40 minutes at 350°.  Remove from heat, cool on rack until set then refrigerate until serving.

name: CHICKEN WITH DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. salad oil
chicken gravy from stock
preparation: Prepare stewed chicken. When almost tender, sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Combine milk and oil. Add to dry ingredients. Stir just to moisten. Drop from tablespoon directly onto chicken in boiling broth. (Do not let batter drop into the liquid.) Cover tightly and return to boiling. Reduce heat (do not lift cover). Simmer 12 to 15 minutes until dumplings are done. Remove chicken and dumplings to hot platter. Keep hot while preparing gravy. Pour gravy over chicken and dumplings. Garnish with parsley. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: SALMON PARTY LOG
ingredients:
1 large  can red salmon
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  small onion
2  tsp. horseradish
1  small bag walnuts
parsley
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
crackers of choice
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix salmon and cream cheese in a bowl by hand.  Dice 1 small onion and mix.  Add salt, horseradish and lemon juice.  Mix until all is blended.

name: CHICKEN TERIYAKI
ingredients:
1  medium size fryer
3  Tbsp. sherry
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. shoyu
2  Tbsp. Karo syrup
preparation: Cut chicken into serving pieces.  Make sauce of remaining ingredients.  Soak	chicken  in bowl overnight or several hours. Place  chicken  in	roasting pan and bake until golden brown. Turn over  the	chicken  and brown.  It takes about 30 minutes in 350° oven.

name: PEAR CAKE(Club Member: Lee Higginbotham)
ingredients:
4  c. cooked pears, mashed
2  c. sugar (1 c. if pears are sweet)
3  c. flour
1  c. nuts, chopped
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. vegetable oil
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well. Pour into greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes (check at 1 hour).

name: CRANBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
4  c. cranberry juice
4  c. pineapple juice
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. almond extract
1  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Mix all but ginger ale.  Chill and add cold ginger ale when ready to serve.

name: CASSEROLE HASH
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  chopped onion
2  lb. bag frozen hash brown potatoes
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  can milk (soup can)
preparation: Layer ingredients in a 9 x 12 x 2-inch baking pan.  Put the meat first, then the onion, then the hash browns.  Pour soup on top of hash browns.  Spread evenly and bake at 350° for 2 hours. Can also add peas or corn if desired.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon or lime jello
1  lb. cottage cheese
1 small  bottle maraschino cherries, cut
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1 small  can crushed pineapple
3/4  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Drain the juice from the can of pineapple and dissolve the jello with the juice.  Bring to a boil.  Mix pineapple with cottage cheese.  Pour jello mixture into cottage cheese mixture. Set to chill.  Add cherries and pecans to chilled mixture.  Whip cream rather stiff.  Fold into cottage cheese mixture.  Set to firm.

name: SPAGHETTI-PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. spaghetti pasta, cooked
2  c. Mozzarella shredded cheese
1  pkg. pepperoni, sliced
1 large  jar spaghetti sauce
1  jar sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. Parmesan grated cheese
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Mix Parmesan cheese, margarine and pasta together and place in bottom of 13 x 9-inch glass dish.  Pour 1/2 jar spaghetti sauce over pasta.  Layer pepperoni and mushrooms over sauce.  Cover with remaining sauce.  Top with Mozzarella cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: BAKED CHICKEN/PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
pork chops or chicken breasts
2  Tbsp. butter
salt and pepper
3/4  c. nondairy creamer
3/4  c. white wine or water
1  Tbsp. flour
paprika
Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Place meat on baking dish sprayed with Pam.  Brush with melted butter,  sprinkle  with  salt and pepper.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.  Combine creamer, flour, wine (water), paprika and Worcestershire sauce.  Spoon over meat and bake 15 minutes (or until done).

name: BANANA FRENCH TOAST WITH BLUEBERRY SAUCE
ingredients:
2  small very ripe bananas
1  c. skim milk
dash of cinnamon
8  slices French bread
oil (for brushing)
preparation: In a blender or food processor, mix bananas, milk and cinnamon until very smooth. Pour mixture into a shallow bowl. Heat a nonstick griddle over medium-high heat and brush lightly with oil. Dip bread into banana mixture and cook until lightly browned on both sides.

name: CHEESE ONION BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. onion, chopped
4  Tbsp. butter, melted
2  eggs, slightly beaten
2 1/2  c. Bisquick
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  Tbsp. poppy seed
preparation: Sauté onion in 2 tablespoons butter until tender. Combine eggs, milk, Bisquick and 2/3 cup cheese in bowl, mixing well. Add onion, stirring to blend. Pour into greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pan. Mix remaining 2 tablespoons butter, 1/3 cup cheese and poppy seed. Sprinkle topping over batter. Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes or until loaf tests done.

name: TOMATO HOT SAUCE
ingredients:
16  c. tomatoes, chopped
1/4  c. salt
4  c. onion, chopped
2  c. hot pepper, chopped
3  Tbsp. garlic powder
2  tsp. cumin
2  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. alum
2  c. white vinegar
1 small  can tomato paste
preparation: Cook and simmer 1 1/2 hours.   Pour in hot jars and seal.

name: MAKE AHEAD BREAKFAST
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
2  slices bread, cut in 1/2-inch cubes
1  c. shredded cheese
6  eggs
2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Crumble sausage in skillet.  Cook over medium heat until brown, stirring occasionally.  Drain fat well.  Spread bread cubes in buttered 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan.  Top with sausage and cheese; combine eggs, milk and seasoning.  Beat well.  Pour over cheese and sausage.  Cover; refrigerate overnight.   Remove and bake for 30 or 40 minutes in 350° oven.

name: SUPER SLO-COOKER SUPPER
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3  lb. frying chicken, cut up
2  c. basic tomato sauce
1 (1 lb.)  can stewed tomatoes
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. diced green pepper
1/2  c. diced celery
1/2  c. diced onion
1  c. long cooking rice
preparation: Combine all but the rice in a slo-cooker.  Bring to a boil on high heat, then reduce heat and slo-cook for 4 hours.  Remove the chicken and discard the skin and bones.  Measure the remaining liquid and, if necessary, add enough more bouillon to make 2 1/2 cups.  Return chicken, liquid and rice to slo-cooker; slo-cook an additional 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: HOT CHILI BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  small onion, chopped
1  small pepper, chopped
2 large  cans whole tomatoes, crushed
2 (16 oz.)  cans kidney beans
2  Tbsp. chili powder
2  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Brown meat, onion, pepper, chili powder, salt and garlic salt. Then add crushed tomatoes.  Simmer for 2 hours.  Stir occasionally.  Serve with milk and corn bread.

name: MA'S SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
3  lb. hamburger
1 1/2  c. onions
2 large  cans tomatoes
2 large  cans tomato paste
1  c. water
5 to 6  cloves garlic
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. oregano
preparation: Simmer all ingredients together for a couple hours, stirring occasionally.  Skim fat off top.

name: SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
4  boiled sweet potatoes
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. melted margarine
1/4  c. water
preparation: Peel potatoes, cut in half.  Put into baking dish.  Spread with sugar and margarine mixed together.  Add 1/4 cup water and bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

name: CROSTATA ITALIANA
ingredients:
1  c. oleo or butter
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1/2  c. milk
3  tsp. baking powder
4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
fruit (apples, pears, peaches, pineapple, raisins)
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Mix ingredients for dough; reserve part for top crust.  Roll out dough and line a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Put sliced apples, peaches, pears, pineapple and raisins over crust.  Sprinkle nuts over fruit.  Roll out remaining dough and cut into strips.  Crisscross strips over fruit filling.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: ROSEMARY POTATOES
ingredients:
8  to 12 small red potatoes (sliced in quarters)
1 to 2  Tbsp. Rosemary
2 to 4  Tbsp. Virgin Olive Oil
1/2  stick butter (optional)
1  large red onion sliced
preparation: Mix together.  Coat sauce pan with baking spray.  Cook over medium heat 25 - 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: VERNON'S RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1  Pillsbury Plus butter flavor cake mix
1 (1 oz.)  bottle red food dye
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Prepare  cake mix per box directions.  Add food dye and paste made  from the cocoa and vinegar.  Mix well and bake as directed on cake box.  Frost with favorite frosting.

name: SWEDISH BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1/2  stick margarine
pinch of salt
1  c. flour
1  tsp. almond extract
1/2  c. walnuts
preparation: Beat eggs, sugar, butter and almond extract together until smooth.  Add flour and salt.  Beat or blend together.

name: BROCCOLI CORN BREAD
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. corn bread mix
12  oz. small curd cottage cheese
4  eggs
1 1/2  sticks softened oleo
16  oz. chopped broccoli, frozen and slightly thawed
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. grated cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients (reserve 1/4 cup grated cheese) and pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan or 22 muffin pans.  Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until firm and lightly golden brown.  In last 5 minutes of baking, you may put grated cheese on top.

name: RELISH
ingredients:
25  medium cucumbers
15  bell peppers
12  onions
3  Tbsp. salt
water
6  c. sugar
1  qt. vinegar
preparation: Cut up cucumbers, peppers and onions; soak in salt water for 1 hour, then rinse and drain.  Mix sugar and vinegar; drop first 3 ingredients in and bring to a boil.  Pack in jars and seal.

name: CRUNCHY APPLE SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. chopped apples
1  c. celery slices
1/2  c. peanuts
1/3  c. raisins
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Combine the ingredients.  Mix lightly.  Yield:  8 servings.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. corn
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. butter
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: To the corn, add sugar, flour, salt, pepper and eggs.  Mix well.  Melt butter in baking dish (1 quart size).  Pour mixture into the hot buttered dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: DATE DELIGHT
ingredients:
15  cream filled chocolate cookies
1/2  c. melted butter
1/2  lb. dates
3/4  c. water
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. miniature marshmallows or 16 large ones
1/4  c. chopped nuts
1/2  pt. cream
1/4  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Crush cookies and mix with butter.  Put in bottom of 8 x 8-inch dish. Chop dates and cook in water with salt until soft. While hot, add marshmallows and nuts.  Spread this over cookie crust and chill.  Whip cream with vanilla.  Spread over date mixture.  Sprinkle crushed crumbs over top for garnish.  Chill overnight.  Freezes and keeps well.

name: CHEESY-CHILI DIP
ingredients:
2  cans chili (no beans)
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
dipping Fritos
preparation: In a fondue pot, mix chili and cream cheese.  Melt together and serve on warm setting, stirring occasionally.  Serve with Fritos.

name: JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. sausage
1  lb. bulk chicken, cooked
3  Tbsp. oil
1  medium onion, chopped
3  Tbsp. flour
1  clove garlic, chopped
1/3  c. green pepper
2  c. water
2  c. raw rice
2  c. stewing tomatoes
2  tsp. parsley
1/3  c. onion tops
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Brown sausage.  Cube chicken; set aside.  Fry onion in oil. Add flour; cook until flour is brown.  Add water and all ingredients; bring to a boil.  Lower heat; cover.  Raise lid occasionally to stir, but not too often.  Cook until rice is tender, about 45 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
1 to 2  c. coarsely crushed pretzel sticks
1  stick margarine
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  medium Cool Whip
1  c. sugar
3 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
preparation: Melt margarine, mix with pretzels and sugar.  Spread evenly in large Pyrex dish.  Bake at 350° for 6 minutes.  Cool.  Have cream cheese at room temperature.  Mix well with Cool Whip and sugar. Spread over cooled crust.  Pour 2 cups boiling water over jello and stir until dissolved.  Chill until it begins to thicken.  Add strawberries, stir well into jello and pour over the cream cheese. Chill several hours before serving.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese, soft
3  c. sifted cake flour
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine butter and cream cheese until fluffy.  Gradually add sugar and continue beating until light.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each one.  Pour batter into well greased and floured 10-inch tube or Bundt pan.  Place in cold oven and set temperature at 325°  and bake an hour and 20 minutes, or until cake tests done.  Cool 15 or 20 minutes before removing from pan.

name: MANA PUA
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast, dry
1 1/2  c. warm water
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. salt
4  c. flour
1  Tbsp. salad oil (to coat hands when making balls)
preparation: Mix yeast in warm water.  Mix salt and sugar together; add to yeast.  Add flour.  Mix with hands; knead and put into bowl. Cover with cloth and leave 2 hours.  Punch down; cover and let rise again, 30 minutes.  Oil hands and make 2 inch balls.  Flatten in palms of hands and fill with about 1 Tbsp. filling.  Pull dough over filling and close by pinching and twisting edges together. Place on 3 X 3 inch piece wax paper; pinched edge down.  Grease rack of steamer.  Pull small cloth on top cover of steamer to collect water.  Steam for 40 minutes or longer.

name: BAKERS AID
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
1  c. flour
1  c. Crisco oil
preparation: Pour granulated sugar slowly into the blender at its highest speed.  The longer you blend the finer the sugar.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines butter cake mix
4  eggs
3/4  c. oil
1  can oranges with juice
preparation: Mix together; beat 2 minutes. Place in 2 round cake pans (floured or sprayed). Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: MONTEREY CHICKEN FOR THE GRILL
ingredients:
5  lb. deboned, skinned chicken breasts
K. C. Masterpiece original barbecue sauce
1  bunch scallions
2  or 3 tomatoes
6  c. Monterey Jack cheese or a mixture of Monterey Jack with Cheddar
1  lb. bacon, fried and drained
preparation: Grill chicken breasts with thin layer of barbecue sauce.  Fry bacon.  Chop scallions and tomatoes into very small bits.  When chicken is done, place it in a flat pan (like a cookie sheet with sides).  Pour a little more barbecue sauce on each breast.  Place bacon strips on chicken.  Cover with cheese.  Place in hot oven and allow cheese to melt.  Does not take long!  Bring it out and serve on each plate with scallions and tomatoes on top. Delicious!

name: CATCH OF THE DAY
ingredients:
fresh fish (Grouper, Hogfish, Wahoo)
fresh or frozen veggies (carrots, broccoli, cauliflower, peppers, tomatoes, etc)
dill (about 1 Tbsp.)
olive oil (about 1/4 cup)
salt and pepper to taste
foil - 4 pieces
preparation: Heat oven or grill to 350°.  Place piece of fish on foil (make into "boat").  Sprinkle with dill, salt and pepper and olive oil.  Place selection of  fresh or frozen veggies on top of fish. Close up foil and place on cookie sheet (if using oven) and cook 20-30 minutes depending on thickness of fish.  Serve with rice.

name: ALWAYS-MOIST CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1/3  c. cocoa
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda (scant)
3/4  c. oil
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. cold water
1  c. brown sugar, packed firm
3  Tbsp. milk
5  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Sift flour, sugar, cocoa, salt and soda in a bowl.  Mix together and make a well.  In another bowl mix the oil, lemon juice, vanilla and water.  Gradually add to the first mixture. Pour into an ungreased 9 x 12-inch pan and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: DIRT PUDDING
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  large instant vanilla pudding
1 1/2  c. milk
1  small Cool Whip
1  c. powdered sugar
15  to 20 double stuffed Oreo cookies
preparation: Mix together cream cheese and confectioners sugar.  In separate bowl, mix pudding and milk.  Combine these ingredients with Cool Whip and cream together.  Pour into flower pot and refrigerate overnight.  Next day (to prevent soggy dirt), crunch cookies in plastic bag with rolling pin and sprinkle over top of pudding.  Add flower bunch and place in center of table.

name: NUT ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. shortening
6  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
6  egg yolks
2  c. cold milk
1  large household yeast
preparation: Sift flour and salt.  Cut in shortening with pastry blender. Beat the egg yolks with milk and crumble yeast into it.  Stir until dissolved, then add to the flour/shortening mixture.  Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight.  Sprinkle sugar on pastry cloth and roll thin.  Cut into squares; spread filling on it.  Roll up and place on greased cookie sheets.  Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: SANDIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
1/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. chopped pecans
1/4  c. powdered sugar
2  tsp. water
preparation: Beat butter for 30 seconds; add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add vanilla and 2 teaspoons of water; beat well.  Stir in flour and pecans.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Place on an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake in a 325° oven about 20 minutes.  Cool completely.  Gently shake on powdered sugar.   Makes 36 cookies.

name: SLOPPY JOES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, lean
1  large onion
1  clove garlic
1/2  green pepper, diced
2  Tbsp. olive oil
2/3  c. catsup
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. salt (optional)
1/8  tsp. pepper
6  hamburger buns
preparation: Brown meat, onion, garlic and green pepper in olive oil. When thoroughly browned, add remaining ingredients. Simmer 20 to 30 minutes.

name: CORN DOGS
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising cornmeal mix
2  Tbsp. oil
pepper
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. milk
8  franks
preparation: You will need 8 popsicle sticks.

name: FRUIT CAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
3  c. cake flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
3  Tbsp. sour milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  lb. white raisins
2  lb. fruit cake mix
1 1/2  lb. chopped pecans
1/2  c. flour to dredge nuts and fruit in
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each one.  Sift flour, soda and nutmeg.  Add to mixture, alternating with milk.  Add vanilla; mix well.  Dredge nuts and fruit in 1/2 cup flour.  Add to batter; mix well.  Drop by teaspoon on greased baking sheet.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Yield: 7 dozen.

name: TURKEY CHILI(Serves 8)
ingredients:
2  lb. ground turkey
1  Tbsp. salad oil
1  c. finely chopped onion
2 (15 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1 (28 oz.)  can whole tomatoes (undrained), cut up
1 or 2 (15 oz.)  cans kidney beans, drained
1 to 2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. garlic salt
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
1/2  tsp. ground pepper
preparation: In a 4-quart Dutch oven, brown ground turkey in oil.  Add onion and cook until crisp-tender.  Add tomato sauce, cut up tomatoes, kidney beans, chili powder, garlic salt, cayenne pepper and ground pepper.  Mix well.  Cover and simmer for 2 to 3 hours or bake in preheated 325° oven for 1 to 2 hours, until mixture is hot and bubbly.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can French-style green beans, drained
1  can Shoe Peg corn, drained
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. onion, chipped fine
1/2  c. sour cream
1  can cream of celery soup
1  c. grated sharp cheese
1  stick margarine, melted
1  roll Ritz crackers, crumbled
preparation: Mix all ingredients except the margarine and crackers.  Put into a 2-quart casserole dish.  Mix crackers and melted margarine together and spread on top of casserole.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: FIVE MINUTE FUDGE
ingredients:
2/3  c. undiluted Carnation milk
1 2/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate bits
1 1/2  c. diced marshmallows
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine milk with sugar and salt in saucepan.  Heat to boiling.  Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat, add marshmallows, nuts, chocolate bits and vanilla.  Stir until marshmallows are melted.  Pour into buttered 8 or 9-inch square pan.  Cool.  Cut in squares.  Makes 2 pounds.

name: CHICKEN CACCIATORE
ingredients:
3 to 3 1/2  lb. frying chicken
2  Tbsp. olive oil
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  medium onion, sliced
2  stalks celery (1/2-inch slices)
1  medium green pepper (1/2-inch strips)
1/2  c. sliced black olives
1 (4 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms, drained
1  whole bay leaf
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. mixed Italian herbs
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes with juice
1 (32 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cut chicken into serving-size pieces; pat dry and set aside. Over medium heat, saute garlic, onion and celery in oil, 2 to 3 minutes, stirring frequently.  Add green pepper; cook another 2 minutes.  Remove from pan.  Increase heat to medium-high; brown chicken all sides, about 6 to 7 minutes.

name: COUNTRY POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
3  c. diced and pared potatoes
1/2  c. diced celery
1/2  c. diced onion
1 1/2  c. water
2  chicken bouillon cubes
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. chopped chives
preparation: In large saucepan combine potatoes, celery, onions, water, bouillon and salt.  Cover and cook until vegetables are tender (about 20 min.)  Don't over cook potatoes; they should be just tender, not mushy.  Add 1 cup milk and heat.

name: MINCED BARBECUE
ingredients:
2  lb. pork (lean)
1  can tomatoes
1  large onion, chopped
1/3 small  bottle Worcestershire
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. water or broth from pork
1  tsp. each of salt, black pepper, sugar and red pepper
preparation: Cook lean pork (remove all fat or bones), chopped in small pieces.  Mix all ingredients above.  Cook on high heat until hot, then cook on low for about 3 hours or until thick.  Stir frequently.  Serve on hamburger bun.  This is low calorie if you use lean pork.

name: MATCHLESS MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. light molasses
3  Tbsp. prepared mustard
3  Tbsp. vinegar
4  Tbsp. ketchup
1  c. milk
2  eggs (unbeaten)
1  envelope or can dehydrated onion soup mix
3  c. soft bread crumbs
1/2  tsp. bottled hot pepper sauce
1  tsp. MSG
1/2  tsp. leaf oregano
1/4  c. finely chopped parsley
3  lb. ground beef
preparation: Blend molasses and mustard in large bowl. Stir in vinegar, ketchup, milk, eggs, onion soup mix and bread crumbs. Stir to mash crumbs. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pack into greased loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inches). Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Slice to serve.

name: GRACE MURDOCH'S HAM LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ham
1 1/2  lb. pork
2  eggs, beaten with milk
1  c. milk
1  c. soft bread crumbs
pepper
preparation: Grind together ham and pork.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
1  large green pepper, chopped
1  large tomato, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. cooked rice
1/3  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: In a 1-quart microwave-safe casserole dish, combine green pepper, tomato, onion and butter.  Cook, covered, on High for 5 to 6 minutes or until vegetables are tender, stirring once.  Stir in cooked rice, water, salt and pepper.  Cook, covered, on High for 3 to 4 minutes or until mixture is heated through, stirring once. Makes 6 side-dish servings.

name: SPICY CRAB SPREAD
ingredients:
2  cans (6 oz. each) crabmeat, drained
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. minced green pepper
2  green onions, finely chopped
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. ground red pepper
preparation: In a large bowl combine all ingredients; stir until well blended.  Cover and refrigerate 2 hours.  Serve chilled with French bread or crackers.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans, divided
1 1/2  c. butter/margarine, softened
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
3  c. sifted cake flour
dash of salt
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Sprinkle 1/2 cup pecans in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Set aside.  Cream butter and cream cheese in a large bowl. Gradually add sugar; beat well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add flour and salt, stirring until combined.  Stir in vanilla and remaining cup of pecans.

name: PUMPKIN BARS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
4  beaten eggs
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. cooking oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Stir together flour, baking powder, cinnamon, soda and salt.  Combine eggs, pumpkin, sugar and oil. Beat until combined.  Add dry ingredients.  Beat until well combined.  Spread batter in an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cool.  Frost with cream cheese frosting.  Cut into bars.  Makes 25 (2 x 3-inch) servings.

name: TRIPLE ORANGE AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jell-O (orange flavor)
2  c. boiling water
1  pt. orange sherbet
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin orange sections, drained
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, drained
1/2  c. Kraft miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. Baker's Angel Flake coconut
1  c. thawed Cool Whip topping
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Stir in sherbet until melted.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Mix in half the oranges and pineapple chunks.  Pour into ring mold sprayed with no-stick cooking spray.  Chill until firm.  Unmold.  Stir marshmallows, coconut and remaining fruit into whipped topping.  Scoop mixture into center of ring mold.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
1  lb. chicken, smoked sausage, diced pork, crawfish or shrimp
2  onions, diced
1  stick margarine
1  can beef broth
3  c. raw white rice
1/2  bell pepper, diced
1  can mushroom steak sauce
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes, drained
3  Tbsp. Creole seasoning
preparation: Brown meat and remove excess fat.  Put everything in large stockpot.  Cover and cook on medium to low heat.  Stir contents 3 times in first 15 minutes.  Cook 35 minutes or until rice is done.

name: MACARONI TOSS
ingredients:
7  oz. pkg. uncooked macaroni
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen green peas
1  c. cubed Cheddar cheese (about 4 oz.)
1  c. sweet relish (or pickles, cut up)
1  medium onion (1/2 c.)
salt and pepper to taste
3/4  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
preparation: Cook macaroni; drain.  Cook peas as directed on package; drain (canned peas may be used).  Mix macaroni, peas, cheese, relish, mayonnaise and chopped onion.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: 2 COCONUT PIES
ingredients:
6  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  stick margarine
1  can Angel Flake coconut
preparation: Combine all ingredients together and pour into pie shells. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: FRIED BISCUITS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. powdered milk (instant nonfat dry milk)
2  Tbsp. yeast
3/4  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. water, heated to 110~
3  Tbsp. oil
8 1/2  c. self-rising flour
shortening (for frying)
preparation: In a large bowl, combine the powdered milk, yeast and the sugar.  In another bowl, mix the water and oil.  Add the liquids to the dry ingredients and mix well until no yeast lumps remain. Add flour, 1 cup at a time, stirring slowly.   After 5 cups are added, begin kneading in remaining flour, slowly, on a generously floured surface.  After all flour is added, continue kneading 5 minutes more.  Roll out dough in sections if necessary to 1/2-inch thick.  Keep surface floured.  Cut with a 2-inch biscuit cutter. Form scraps into a ball and re-roll and cut.  Place biscuits on a floured cookie sheet.  Let rise in a warm area for 1 hour.  Heat deep shortening to 350°.  Add biscuits without crowding.  When edges turn brown, turn once.  Biscuits cook quickly.  Remove with tongs.  Drain on paper towels.  Serve hot with apple butter. Makes 48.

name: POTLUCK BEAN BAKE
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can pork and beans, undrained
1 (15 oz.)  can chili beans, drained
1 (15 oz.)  can pinto beans, drained
1/2  lb. frankfurters, diagonally sliced
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce with onions
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a 7 1/2 x 12 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish.  Mix thoroughly.  Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: CHEESEBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. milk
3/4  c. Bisquick
3  eggs
1  c. shredded sharp cheese
preparation: Brown beef and onion; drain.  Stir in salt and pepper.  Spread into a greased pie plate.  Beat milk, Bisquick and eggs until smooth.  Pour into pie plate.  Bake at 400° for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake for 5 to 8 minutes longer.

name: PICCALILLI
ingredients:
1  peck green tomatoes
12  sweet peppers (red)
12  sweet peppers (green)
12  onions
3  stalks celery
3/4  c. salt
2  qt. cider vinegar
3  lb. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. mustard seed
1  Tbsp. whole cloves
1  Tbsp. stick cinnamon
preparation: Core tomatoes.  Grind tomatoes, peppers, onion and celery. Mix in salt; let stand overnight.  Drain well.  Combine sugar and vinegar.  Heat, stirring, until sugar melts.  Add mustard seed. Tie cloves and cinnamon in small bag and add to mixture.  Bring to simmer.  Cook 35 minutes after it starts to boil.  Seal in pints.

name: STUFFED BELL PEPPERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
1/2  chopped onion
oil to brown
salt, pepper and chili powder
3 small  cans tomato sauce
2  c. cooked rice
grated Cheddar cheese
4  bell peppers, cooked
preparation: In small amount of oil, brown the ground beef, chopped bell pepper and chopped onion.  Add salt, pepper and chili powder to taste.  Add tomato sauce and cooked rice.  Cut bell peppers in half if large or use whole small bell peppers with tops removed.  Scrape insides of peppers and precook slightly.  Fill with ingredients and place in casserole dish.  Bake in a 350° oven until hot and bubbly. Sprinkle with grated Cheddar cheese and allow cheese to melt.

name: HOMEMADE MAYONNAISE
ingredients:
1  egg
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. prepared mustard
2  c. Wesson oil (do not substitute another brand)
preparation: Beat egg with mixer.  Add next 4 ingredients, one at a time, beating after each addition.  Gradually add oil, beating constantly.

name: PEPPERONI ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. zucchini, peeled, chopped and seeded
1/2  c. onion, chopped
2  c. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese, grated
1  c. pepperoni, small chunks
1/4  c. oil
4  eggs
1  c. Bisquick
salt, pepper, oregano and basil to taste
preparation: Spray a 13 x 9-inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Preheat oven to 350°.  In a large bowl, combine zucchini, onion, cheeses, pepperoni and spices.  Mix thoroughly.  In another bowl combine oil, eggs and Bisquick.  Mix well.  Add to the zucchini mixture and blend thoroughly.  Spread mixture in a baking dish.  Bake 35 to 45 minutes or until cheese starts browning.

name: STRAWBERRY BANANA DESSERT
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1  c. cold water
1 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
2  c. (1 pt.) whipping cream, stiffly whipped
1  pt. fresh strawberries, cleaned and sliced
2  bananas, sliced and dipped in lemon juice
1 prepared loaf  pound cake, cut into 12 slices
preparation: In large bowl, combine first two ingredients.  Add pudding mix and beat well.  Chill 5 minutes.  Fold in whipped cream, then fold in strawberries and bananas.

name: CHICKEN EL PASO
ingredients:
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1  lb. skinless, boneless chicken breast
1/4  c. refrigerated Ranch dressing and dip
salsa
preparation: On waxed paper, combine crumbs and chili powder.  In shallow dish, dip chicken into dressing.  Coat with crumb mixture.  On baking sheet, arrange chicken.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink, turning once during baking. Serve with salsa.

name: SPINACH BALLS
ingredients:
2  boxes frozen, chopped spinach
1  stick margarine, melted
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm croutons (Cheddar and Romano or herb and garlic)
1  c. Parmesan cheese
6  eggs
preparation: Cook and drain spinach.  Ring in paper towels to get all moisture out.  While still warm, mix all other ingredients well and form into balls (they're a little slimy).  Put on cookie sheet close together and put into freezer for 1 hour.  Then you can put into plastic bags and keep frozen until you need them.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes, frozen, in 350° oven.

name: CARAMEL BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  box chocolate cake mix
1  stick margarine, softened
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  c. finely chopped nuts (optional)
1  (14 oz.) bag caramels (35 caramels)
1/3  c. evaporated milk
6  oz. chocolate chips
3/4  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Put cake mix into a bowl and cut in margarine.  Add 1/2 cup evaporated milk and 1 cup chopped nuts.  Spread half the mixture into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 6 to 10 minutes. Melt caramels and 1/2 cup evaporated milk over low heat, stirring constantly.  Cover baked layer with chocolate chips and 3/4 cup chopped nuts.  Spread caramel mixture over chips and nuts.  Cover with remaining batter.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Cool.  Cut.

name: FLYING QUAIL CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
chicken breasts
honey
mustard
preparation: Mix honey and mustard.  Baste chicken with sauce.  Bake in preheated oven at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes.  Turn when top surface begins to brown; baste.  Turn over at least once more and baste.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  c. thinly sliced zucchini
3  strips bacon, cut in small pieces
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. sliced fresh or canned tomatoes
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Fry bacon; add zucchini.  Cover and simmer 5 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients and pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 375°.

name: LAHVOSH ROLL
ingredients:
1  10 inch tortillas
1 4  oz. tub cream cheese with chives and onion
1/4  cup chopped, drained marinated artichoke hearts
2  Tbsp. diced pimentos
1  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
6  oz. thinly sliced Black Forest Ham
4  oz. sliced provolone cheese
1  large romaine leaf, rib removed.
preparation: Stir together cream cheese, artichoke hears, pimento, and oregano in a bowl.  Spread tortilla with cream cheese mixture. Arrange ham over cream cheese.  Place cheese slices in the center and lettuce leaf next to cheese.  Roll up tortilla.

name: POLISH COOKIES(Chrusciki)
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
4  egg yolks
2  c. flour
10x sugar
vegetable shortening
preparation: Combine sour cream and egg yolks.  Blend in flour to make a soft dough; knead until combined.  Roll out, using flour to prevent sticking, until thin.  Cut into strips about 1 inch wide. About every 2 inches, cut on a diagonal to make diamond shapes. Make slit in center of each; push one end through to make a bow tie.  Fry in hot fat until brown.  Drain and cool; sprinkle with 10x sugar.

name: SEAFOOD QUICHE
ingredients:
1  deep-dish unbaked pie shell
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. half and half
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. chives
1  small chopped onion
8  oz. Monterey Jack cheese, grated
6 1/2  oz. can crab meat, drained
6 1/2  oz. can shrimp, drained
preparation: Note:  May use egg substitute and whole or skim milk.  May use low-fat cheese.

name: CROWN OF GOLD TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans solid white tuna
2 small  jars pimiento (optional)
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. cooked rice
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
3  pkg. shredded Cheddar
sliced water chestnuts (optional)
3  to 5 egg whites
preparation: Mix the first 5 ingredients with 2 packages of cheese.  Put in greased pan.  Beat egg whites and fold in 1 package of cheese. Spoon on top and spread.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.  Serve about 8.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
7  pieces white bread
1  c. sugar (can be reduced to 1/2 c.)
1  c. milk
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla (add 2 tsp. if sugar is reduced)
preparation: Tear bread into small pieces in a big bowl.  Mix the rest of the ingredients with bread.  Pour into greased 9-inch cake pan and bake 30 minutes.  Dot with butter before putting into oven.  (You can add cinnamon to mixture.)

name: ALMOND CRESCENT COOKIES
ingredients:
10  oz. pkg. almonds
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. flour
1  c. butter
1  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Whirl almonds in blender.  Mix flour, sugar and ground almonds.  With fingers, work in butter and vanilla until mixture cleans bowl.  Chill dough at least 1 hour.  Roll dough into balls (approximately 1 1/4-inch), then into rolls (3 1/2-inch).  Form into crescent shapes.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes until lightly brown.  Cool on pan about 10 minutes.  While still warm, roll in confectioners sugar.  Makes 25 to 30.

name: FRUIT BARS
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
4  eggs
2  tsp. rum flavoring
1  lb. cherries
1  lb. pineapple
1  box brown sugar
2  c. cake flour
preparation: Grease pan.  Cover bottom with chopped nuts.  Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs one at a time.  Add flour and flavoring; mix well and put over nuts.  Sprinkle top with mixed fruit and top with coconut.  Bake at 300° for 35 minutes or well browned.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  whole cut-up chicken
1  can cream of mushroom soup
3  Tbsp. flour
1  box Bisquick
preparation: Boil chicken until chicken starts to fall off bone.  Pull all chicken out of water (now broth).  Let cool until you can pull all skin and bone from meat.

name: GRANDMA BARBARA'S CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, skin removed
6  to 8 whole carrots
6  to 8 stalks celery, chopped
4  whole parsnips
1  garlic bud
6  to 8 scallions, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
2  medium onions
preparation: Wash chicken; prepare vegetables.  Fill 4-quart pot with cold water; bring to boil (add all ingredients just before water come to full boil).  Skim any fat which rises to top.  Turn heat to medium; stir briefly.  Cook at medium to medium-low heat for about 1 1/2 hours.  Add water to maintain original level.  Remove all bones from chicken.  Strain, cool and refrigerate.  Heat and enjoy!!

name: JOLOPES
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
8  oz. Jack cheese
8  oz. Cheddar cheese
2  cans diced chilies
1  oz. flour tortilla
1  pt. sour cream
3  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  carrot
1  onion
parsley
preparation: Cook chicken with onion, carrot and parsley.  Grease casserole.  Layer:  3 tortillas, shredded chicken, 1 can soup, chillies, sour cream and layer each of cheese.  Repeat 2 or 3 times.  Bake for 45 minutes at 375°.

name: KETTLE SOUP
ingredients:
1 (48 oz.)  can V-8 juice
1  can beef broth
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
dash of Tabasco
preparation: Combine all ingredients together and simmer for 30 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI/CAULIFLOWER SAUTE
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower, cut up
1  bunch broccoli, cut up
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1 1/2 to 2  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  chicken bouillon cubes
1  tsp. soy sauce
pepper
preparation: Cook cauliflower approximately 6 1/2 minutes in microwave in a large, covered container.  Cook broccoli the same way, about 5 minutes.  Saute garlic in butter until golden.  Add mushrooms. Saute until tender.  Stir in crushed bouillon cubes.  Add remaining veggies and soy sauce.  Stir-fry 5 minutes to heat.  Add pepper to taste.  Serves 8 to 12.

name: PEANUT BLOSSOM COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/4  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2 (5 3/4 oz.)  pkg. Hershey's Kisses
preparation: Cream together shortening, peanut butter, sugar and brown sugar until blended.  Add egg and vanilla.  Beat well.  Blend in dry ingredients.  Shape scant teaspoon of dough into balls.  Roll in sugar and place on greased cookie sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.  Remove from oven.  Top each cookie with Kiss, pressing down until cookie cracks.  Makes about 6 dozen.

name: NO BAKE FRUIT CAKE ROLL
ingredients:
1  lb. marshmallows, cut fine
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  box graham crackers, crushed (save 3/4 c.)
1  box raisins
2  c. nuts
1  lb. candied fruit
preparation: Pour the milk over marshmallows and let stand.  Mix other ingredients and add to marshmallows.  Mix well.  Place some crumbs on a square of wax paper and form a roll about 2-inches in diameter and place in crumbs.  Roll up in crumbs and wax paper. Refrigerate overnight.  Slice and serve.  Makes 4 large rolls.

name: SIMMERED CHINESE CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  whole chicken legs and thighs
1  Tbsp. oil
1/3  c. soy sauce
1/3  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. catsup
1/4  c. dry sherry
dash of two of Tabasco sauce
1  garlic clove, minced
4  green onions, sliced
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. water
2  tsp. toasted sesame seed (toast seed in shallow pan at 350~ for 8 minutes, watch closely)
preparation: Heat oil in Dutch oven and brown chicken on all sides.  Mix together soy sauce, brown sugar, water, catsup, sherry, Tabasco sauce, garlic and green onion.  Pour mixture over chicken.  Cover, simmer 35 to 45 minutes.  Remove chicken to platter.  Thicken pan juices with the cornstarch mixture.  Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.  Spoon some sauce over chicken, sprinkle with sesame seed.  Serve chicken with remaining sauce.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CHICKEN QUICHE
ingredients:
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  c. milk (approximately)
1  c. chicken, chopped and cooked
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/4  c. bacon, chopped
2  Tbsp. margarine
1 1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
2  Tbsp. flour
1  (9 inch) pie crust
5  eggs, slightly beaten
salt
pepper
preparation: Saute onion and bacon in butter until tender and brown.  Set aside.  Mix cheese and flour until covered and set aside.  Mix cream, milk, eggs, salt and pepper.  Add onion and bacon mix, cheese mix and chicken.  Pour into pie crust and bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then at 350° for approximately 30 to 45 minutes.  Cover edges of crust with foil.  Done when knife comes clean from middle.

name: GLAZED CARROTS
ingredients:
1  lb. bag carrots, sliced
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. honey
1/4  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  c. raisins
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook carrots until just tender; drain.  Add all other ingredients.

name: VEG-ALL CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans Veg-All, drained
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
2  c. cheese, grated
1 to 2  c. cracker crumbs
preparation: Combine all ingredients except cracker crumbs.  Place in a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish.  Top with cracker crumbs and dot with butter.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

name: POWDERED SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
pinch of salt
2 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Cream butter, powdered sugar and egg.  Blend in vanilla, baking soda and salt.  Add flour and mix well.  Chill about one hour.  Roll out and cut into desired shapes.  Sprinkle with colored sugar.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE CANDY
ingredients:
3 small  pkg. Nestle semi-sweet chocolate
2  sq. bitter chocolate
4 1/2  c. sugar
1 large  can Carnation milk
2  sticks margarine or butter
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts
preparation: Put margarine, bitter chocolate (cut in small pieces) and semi-sweet chocolate in large pan.  Put milk and sugar in heavy saucepan and turn on low until sugar dissolves, then turn higher until it starts to boil.  Cook for 7 minutes while boiling, stirring all the time.  Pour this over margarine and chocolates and beat until all melts and begins to get stiff.  Add nuts and vanilla.  Pour in buttered pans and refrigerate until cold.  Cut in squares.  Store in refrigerator.

name: APRICOT BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. dry apricots
1  small bag coconut
1  lb. powdered sugar
1  can sweetened condensed milk
powdered sugar
preparation: Put all ingredients through food processor or food grater. Shape into balls.  Roll in powdered sugar.

name: EMERALD PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (46 oz.)  can unsweetened pineapple juice, chilled
3/4  c. lime juice, chilled
3/4  c. sugar
green food coloring
1  tray ice cubes, crushed
6 (16 oz.)  bottles 7-Up beverage, chilled
lemon slices
maraschino cherries
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients in a punch bowl.  Stir to dissolve sugar.  Add a few drops of green food coloring.  Add ice and 7-Up. Garnish with lemon slices and cherries.

name: NECK BONES AND NOODLES
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. pork neck bones
1  pkg. wide egg noodles, cooked
1  onion, chopped
1  rib celery, sliced
pepper to taste
1  can cream of mushroom soup, prepared according to directions on can
preparation: Boil neck bones for 1 to 2 hours, until meat falls off the bone, in water that contains onion, celery and pepper.  Drain and mix with the noodles and soup.  Good with slaw.

name: CREAMED TUNA
ingredients:
1/2  c. sliced celery
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. oleo
1  can cheese soup
1/2  c. milk
1  can tuna, drained
preparation: In saucepan, cook celery and onion in oleo until tender. Blend soup slowly.  Add milk; add tuna.  Serve over rice or macaroni.

name: PINEAPPLE BARS
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. salad oil
4  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. flour
1  c. chopped nuts
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  can crushed pineapple, well drained
preparation: Mix sugar, oil and eggs in a large bowl.  Mix dry ingredients together and then add to egg mixture.  Add pineapple and nuts; mix well.  Bake in a 10 x 15-inch pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and cut into squares after cool.

name: WHITE PIZZA
ingredients:
1  batch pizza dough
1/2  lb. Provolone cheese, sliced thin (deli)
1 1/2  lb. Mozzarella cheese, grated
1/2  c. black olives, sliced thin
3  tomatoes, sliced thin
garlic powder to taste
preparation: Spread pizza dough in a pan.  Place slices of Provolone cheese on pizza to cover entire pizza, then add grated Mozzarella cheese to cover pizza.  Sprinkle on black olives and garlic powder to taste.

name: OLD SETTLERS BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
4  slices bacon
1  small onion
1  can pork and beans
1  can butter beans
1  can kidney beans
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white sugar
1  c. ketchup
1/2  tsp. mustard
preparation: Brown beef, bacon and onion in skillet.  Drain off grease, then place in crock-pot on low setting.  Add the rest of the ingredients; stir, then cook for 2 to 3 hours.

name: HOT MEXICAN SALSA
ingredients:
3  large tomatoes, chopped
3  tsp. green onions
1  tsp. chopped green parsley
1  clove garlic, crushed
1/4  tsp. cumin
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. sugar
3  canned or fresh jalapeno peppers
preparation: Use blender or food processor; add all ingredients.  Blend until chunky.  Cover and chill.

name: CHILI CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  lb. Velveeta or American cheese, cut into small pieces
1  can green chilies and tomatoes
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1  can canned chili
preparation: Brown ground beef well and drain.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer until cheese is melted.  Keep on warming tray until serving time or make dip immediately before serving.  Serve warm with tortilla chips or corn chips.

name: 7 LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head of lettuce
1/4 to 1/2  c. each:  chopped onions, green pepper and celery
1  box frozen peas
1  pt. Hellmann's mayonnaise
2  tsp. sugar
4  (6 or 8 oz.) grated Cheddar cheese
8  strips bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled
preparation: In an 8 x 10-inch pan, pick a head of lettuce in pieces to make one layer.  Then add chopped onions, green pepper and celery. Sprinkle cooked peas.  Spread Hellmann's mayonnaise over layers. Sprinkle with sugar.  Put grated Cheddar cheese and crumbled bacon on top.  Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate.

name: COCONUT COOKIES
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. coconut extract
1  egg
1  pkg. Martha White biscuit mix
1  pkg. Martha White spud flakes
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and coconut extract together.  Add egg and beat well.  Stir in biscuit mix and spud flakes.  Cover bowl. Chill for 1 hour.  Form into marble-size balls.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 12 to 14 minutes at 375°.

name: CALICO SALAD
ingredients:
1  can chopped kraut
1  medium onion, chopped
1  small green pepper, chopped
2  canned pimentos, chopped
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar or slightly less artificial sweetener
1/4  c. salad oil
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Combine kraut, onion, green pepper and pimentos.  Mix vinegar, sugar, salad oil, salt, celery seed and garlic salt.  Stir into kraut mixture.  Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours before serving.

name: EYE OF ROUND WITH DILL
ingredients:
1  envelope Good Seasons herb and garlic
1  tsp. crushed garlic, fresh
3/4  bottle lite teriyaki sauce
1  Tbsp. pickapeppa sauce
1/2  c. red wine
1/2  tsp. dill seed
3 to 4  lb. eye of round roast
preparation: Prepare dressing as directed, shake well and pour into marinade dish.  Add rest of ingredients except meat.  Mix well. Place trimmed roast in dish and roll in marinade.  Leave meat in marinade 6 to 7 hours, basting occasionally.  Remove meat and place on rack in roasting pan.  Use meat thermometer.  Cook at 400° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.  Slice thin to serve.  Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: TOFU VEG ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  bunch chives, chopped
2  c. fresh corn
1  red bell pepper, sliced
1  jalapeno, minced
1  tsp. cumin seed
1  lb. tofu, crumbled
10  (8-inch) corn tortillas
preparation: Saute all ingredients (except tortillas) until tender, then wrap in corn tortillas.  Pour peanut butter sauce over enchiladas and top with cheese if desired.

name: SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. chopped spinach
1  c. milk
2  eggs, beaten separately
1/4  c. bread crumbs
salt and pepper to taste
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook spinach and drain.  Melt butter.  Mix with other ingredients except egg whites.  Mix all ingredients together, then fold in egg whites.  Pour into souffle dish.   Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: Banana Pudding
ingredients:
6  to 8 bananas
2  boxes vanilla pudding (instant)
1  can sweetened condensed milk
16  oz. Cool Whip
2  boxes vanilla wafers
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix vanilla pudding with 3 cups milk according to directions. Add condensed milk and mix well.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Layer vanilla wafers and bananas.  Spread pudding mixture over wafers and bananas.  Repeat until all is used, ending with pudding mixture.  Refrigerate.

name: CHICKEN AND CHEESE LASAGNA
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
1  Tbsp. water
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. chopped pimientos
1/3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. dried basil
8  oz. lasagna noodles
2  c. ricotta cheese
3  c. chopped cooked chicken
1-1/2  c. grated cheddar cheese, divided
1  c. grated parmesan cheese, divided
preparation: Sauté onion and bell pepper in water over medium-high heat. Add soup, pimientos, milk and basil and mix well.  Arrange half the noodles on the bottom of an 11x7 inch baking dish.  Spread half the soup mixture and half ricotta cheese over noodles. Arrange half the chicken on top of ricotta.  Sprinkle with half cheddar and half parmesan cheese.  Repeat layers of the remaining noodles, soup mixture, ricotta, and chicken.  Bake covered at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.  Sprinkle with remaining cheddar and parmesan cheese.  Bake uncovered for 4 minutes.

name: TOFFEE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. white Karo
1  c. toasted slivered almonds
6  Hershey bars
preparation: Combine margarine, sugar, water and Karo in 2-quart saucepan. Cook on medium heat until it reaches hard crack (290°) on candy thermometer.  Pour in 3/4 cup of almonds and mix.  Pour on large cookie sheet.  Spread on cookie sheet.  Lay Hershey bars on top. Spread Hershey bars as they melt.  Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup almonds on top of Hershey bars.  Refrigerate for 1 1/2 hours. Break into pieces.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
32  oz. bag hash browns or 4 c. cubed potatoes
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. chopped onion
8  oz. sour cream
2  sticks butter, melted
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  c. corn flakes, crushed
preparation: Mix everything (except corn flake crumbs and butter) together and put in baking dish.  Mix corn flake crumbs and butter together.  Put over top of potatoes.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BLOCK PARTY BEANS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1  can cream of tomato soup (undiluted)
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1/2  c. ketchup
1 (16 oz.)  can green beans, drained
1 (17 oz.)  can lima beans, drained
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  can wax beans, drained
1 (15 to 16 oz.)  can chili beans (undrained)
1 (16 oz.)  can pork and beans (undrained)
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
preparation: In a large Dutch oven, brown beef over medium-high heat. Drain fat.  Add onion and celery; cook until tender.  Stir in soup, tomato paste and ketchup; simmer 15 to 20 minutes.   Spoon into a large kettle or roaster.  Add all remaining ingredients; stir well.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.  Yields about 25 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE-COVERED MINTS
ingredients:
1 (l lb.)  box confectioners sugar
1/4  c. melted butter
2 1/2  Tbsp. warm water
15  drops oil of peppermint (buy at drugstore)
4 (1 oz.)  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1/4  oz. paraffin wax
preparation: Mix  confectioners sugar, butter, warm water and oil of peppermint;  form into flat patties.  If soft, refrigerate for about  1  hour.  Melt  unsweetened chocolate and paraffin wax. Keep   chocolate-paraffin   mixture  over  warm  water.  Place peppermint patties on fork, dip and place on wax paper.  Allow chocolate to set at room temperature.  Makes 5 dozen mints.

name: CHOCOLATE CRUNCH BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
6  Tbsp. baking cocoa
1  c. flour
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (7 oz.)  jar Marshmallow Creme
1  c. creamy peanut butter
2  c. (12 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
3  c. crisp rice cereal
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs.  Stir in cocoa, flour, vanilla and salt.  Spread into a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Let cool.

name: MEXICAN WEDDING CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter, softened
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter very well.  Gradually add 1/2 cup confectioners sugar and cream until fluffy.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE RECIPE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. mushrooms
1  c. tomato sauce
1  c. water
1/2  c. green pepper
1/2  c. onions
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. black pepper
dash Italian seasoning
preparation: Cook ground beef  10  or  15  minutes in saucepan, then drain. Combine  ground  beef, mushrooms, tomato sauce, water, green pepper,  onions,  salt,  pepper  and  Italian seasoning. Simmer for 30 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: PARTY POTATOES
ingredients:
5  lb. potatoes, cooked and mashed
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. sour cream
1/2  stick butter
1  Tbsp. onion salt
preparation: Mix together and bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes or so.  Can be made ahead.  Serves 12.

name: BEEF BARBECUES
ingredients:
2  small onions
1 1/2  lb. beef cubes
4 1/2  Tbsp. vinegar
3 1/2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 small  can tomato sauce
3/4  c. ketchup
1  tsp. mustard
1  Tbsp. liquid smoke
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. onion salt (optional)
preparation: Cook onions and beef  together  until  brown; add water and cook until beef  falls  apart.  Add  other ingredients and simmer.

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
3  cups  boiled chicken or turkey, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can chicken soup
1/2 to 3/4  cup diced celery and leaves
3  cups shredded cheese
Celery salt
1  onion, chopped
1 1/2  cup English peas
1/4  cup chopped pimento
1  cup broth (can use more)
1  pkg. egg noodles
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Sauté celery and onion in margarine until tender. Cook noodles 6 to 8 minutes and peas until tender.  Mix all ingredients together, reserving 1 cup of cheese for top.  Use a lot of celery salt.  Bake 1/2 hour at 350°.  May be frozen for later use.  Do not cook before freezing. Do not cover while baking.

name: APPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. diced apples
1  c. diced celery
1/2  c. nuts (walnuts or pecans)
1/2  c. bacon, crumbled
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/3  c. mayonnaise
lettuce leaves
preparation: Mix apples, celery, nuts, bacon, cheese and mayonnaise.  Place on lettuce leaves and sprinkle with salt and pepper or paprika.

name: STRAWBERRY DAIQUIRI
ingredients:
6  oz. Bacardi rum
5  c. ice
10  oz. Bacardi tropical fruit mix
preparation: Mix together in blender.  Makes 5 (8 ounce) drinks.

name: ROTEL CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  to 6 chicken breasts, boiled and deboned
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
1  can diced Ro-Tel tomatoes
Doritos chips
1  small onion, chopped (optional)
grated cheese
butter
preparation: Boil chicken until tender; let cool.  Saute onion and bell pepper in butter until tender.  Mix soups and tomatoes together; add bell pepper and onion.  In large casserole dish, break chips to cover bottom.  Add chicken in bite size pieces; cover with soup mixture.  Microwave 20 minutes on High; break up more chips in casserole dish and cover chips with cheese.  Microwave 2 or 3 minutes until cheese is melted.

name: SHONEY'S STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  box strawberry Jell-O
1 1/2  c. water
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  qt. strawberries
1  pt. Cool Whip
preparation: Cook water, sugar and cornstarch until thick.  Add one box of strawberry Jell-O while hot.  Cool and add 1 quart strawberries; put in baked pie shell.  Add Cool Whip.

name: COUNTRY CHICKEN 'N BISCUITS
ingredients:
8  slices bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
2 1/2  c. (13 oz.) cubed, cooked chicken
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, cooked and drained
1  c. chopped tomatoes (about 2 medium)
1 1/2  c. (6 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
3/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. biscuit mix
2/3  c. milk
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
preparation: In greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish, combine first four ingredients and 1 cup cheese.  Blend soup and 3/4 cup milk; pour over casserole.  Bake, covered, at 400° for 15 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER/CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. margarine (1 1/2 sticks)
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  pkg. milk chocolate chips
peanuts
preparation: Cream margarine with granulated sugar and brown sugar.  Add peanut butter, eggs and vanilla.  Mix in 2 1/2 cups flour, baking soda and salt.  Then add chocolate chips (and I use a handful of peanuts, too).

name: BAKED CHEESE PUFFS(Makes 60 Puffs)
ingredients:
1  loaf Texas toast
1  (3 oz.) cream cheese, soft
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
cayenne pepper to taste
1/2  c. margarine, softened
1/4  lb. sharp cheese, grated
salt to taste
2  egg whites, stiffly beaten
preparation: Note:  Can be frozen and baked later.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. yellow squash
1  small onion, chopped
1  1/2 to 2 carrots, grated
1  stick butter
8  oz. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
8  oz. Pepperidge Farm seasoned dressing crumbs
preparation: Slice squash and cook until tender.  Mash in colander with a fork and let set to drain.  Combine squash, onion, carrots, sour cream, soup and 1/4 cup melted butter.  Pour 1/2 cup of melted butter over crumbs and toss.

name: CHOCOLATE ZUCCHINI CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. oleo
2  c. grated zucchini
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
3  eggs
1/2  c. buttermilk
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. soda
1/2 to 1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream first 4 ingredients together.  Add zucchini, eggs, vanilla and buttermilk.  Combine next 5 ingredients in a small bowl, blending well.  Mix with rest of mixture.  Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Sprinkle with chocolate chips.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.  Contains 221 calories and 11.9 fat.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple and juice
1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
2  c. broken pecans
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip
1  box pistachio instant pudding mix
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Let stand a while before serving.

name: GRANDMA LIEBRAND'S PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. buttermilk
3/4  c. sweet milk
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 heaping  tsp. baking powder
2  c. flour
preparation: Mix together and fry on hot griddle.

name: CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. yellow corn meal
1/4  c. sugar
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1/4  c. melted margarine
1  egg
preparation: Combine flour, corn meal, sugar, baking powder and salt.  Add milk, egg and melted margarine.  Beat until smooth.  Bake in 8-inch square pan for 20 to 25 minutes in 425° oven.

name: POTATO AND SPINACH SOUP
ingredients:
3  c. canned vegetable broth or fat-free chicken broth
3  c. water
3  bunches scallions, ends trimmed, washed and cut in 1-inch pieces (1 lb., about 18 scallions)
1  lb. potatoes, peeled and cut in 1-inch pieces
1  large rib celery, cut in 1-inch pieces
1  c. fresh spinach leaves, washed
1  c. buttermilk
1 1/4  tsp. salt
freshly ground pepper, scallion greens or chives (garnish)
preparation: Bring broth, water, scallions, potatoes and celery to a boil. In a 4-quart pot, reduce heat to low.  Cover and simmer 30 minutes until vegetables are tender.  Puree in batches in blender or food processor until puree is smooth and bright green, adding some of the spinach to each batch.  Pour into a 3-quart container.  Stir in buttermilk and salt; cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to 2 days.  Serves 6.

name: CHEESY CHILI DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, cut up
1 (15 oz.)  can chili
preparation: Microwave Velveeta and chili in 2-quart microwavable bowl on High 5 minutes or until Velveeta is melted, stirring after 3 minutes. Serve hot with tortilla chips, French bread chunks or corn bread sticks. Makes 3 3/4 cups.

name: CHRISTMAS PUNCH
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1 small  box cherry Jell-O
1  qt. ginger ale
1  qt. cranberry juice
1  qt. pineapple juice
1  c. boiling water
3  c. cold water
preparation: Mix Jell-O with 1 cup boiling water and add cold water. Add ginger ale	cranberry  and pineapple juice.  Stir well and add ice.

name: SCALLOP CORN
ingredients:
1/2  c. Crisco shortening
1/2  c. chopped carrots, finely chopped
2  tsp. chopped celery
2  tsp. chopped onion
2 (17 oz.)  cans cream-style corn
4  eggs, beaten
1  c. crushed soda crackers
1/2  c. undiluted evaporated milk
1/8  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1  tsp. sugar
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. paprika
1 1/2  c. chopped parsley
1  medium green pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Melt Crisco in a large heavy skillet. Stir in carrots, green pepper, celery and onion.  Cook over medium heat until vegetables are barely tender.  Stir in corn, eggs, cracker crumbs, evaporated milk, Tabasco sauce, sugar and salt. Top with cheese and sprinkle with paprika.  Turn into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until center is set and top is golden.  Remove from oven.  Garnish with parsley and olives.

name: DELICIOUS TACO PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (1 1/4 oz.)  envelope taco mix
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies, drained
1 1/4  c. milk
3/4  c. Bisquick baking mix
3  eggs
2  large tomatoes, sliced
1  c. shredded Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese
preparation: Heat  oven  to	400°.  Grease  10  1/2 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate (or  pan).	Cook  and stir beef and onion until meat is brown; stir  in  seasoning  mix.  Spread  the meat mixture in plate.  Top with  chilies.  Beat  milk,  baking  mix and eggs until  smooth (1	minute with hand beater).  Pour into plate. Bake  25  minutes. Top  with tomatoes and cheese.  Bake until knife  inserted  in center  comes  out clean (8 to 10 minutes longer).	Cool  5 minutes.  Can  be  served  with sour cream, shredded lettuce, tomatoes and cheese if desired.

name: SWISS 'N CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  c. chopped, cooked chicken
2  c. sliced celery
2  c. croutons
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Kraft natural Swiss cheese
1  c. Miracle Whip
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. chopped walnuts, toasted
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients except walnuts.  Spoon into 2-quart casserole; sprinkle walnuts.  Bake 40 minutes or until thoroughly heated.  Makes 6 servings.

name: MUSTARD GLAZE
ingredients:
1/2  c. mustard
1/2  c. orange marmalade
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
preparation: Combine ingredients.   Brush mixture on ham frequently during the last hour of baking.   Makes 1 cup (enough for 10 to 15 pound ham).

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 (1.4 oz.)  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
3  green onions, chopped
preparation: Stir all ingredients until well mixed.  Cover and chill. Makes 3 cups.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. biscuit mix
1/3  c. milk
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1  lb. sausage
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  egg, beaten
2  c. (8 oz.) grated sharp Cheddar cheese
2 (4 oz.)  cans chopped green chilies, divided
preparation: Combine biscuit mix, milk and 2 tablespoons mayonnaise.  Stir well.  Spread mixture in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Set aside.  Cook sausage and onion until browned.  Drain.   Layer sausage mixture over biscuit mixture.  Combine egg, cheese, chilies and rest of mayonnaise.  Spread over sausage mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

name: BELGIAN STEWED LEEKS
ingredients:
2  to 3 large stalks leeks
1  c. water
1/4  lb. butter
preparation: Wash leeks thoroughly and cut into chunks.  Cook in water. Add butter. Season with salt and pepper to taste.  Simmer, until tender, adding a little water if necessary. The broth can be thickened by adding a little cornstarch, if desired.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick butter or margarine
2  eggs, beaten
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  can cream-style corn
8  oz. sour cream
1  box Jiffy corn bread muffin mix
preparation: Melt butter or margarine.  Mix all other ingredients in the butter or margarine.  Pour into a baking dish.  Bake at 350° approximately 45 to 60 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.  Enjoy!!

name: LOUISIANA GUMBO
ingredients:
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped green pepper
3  cloves garlic, chopped
4  c. chicken broth
2 1/2 to 3  lb. chicken, cut up
1 (16 oz.)  can whole tomatoes (undrained)
1  bay leaf
1  tsp. pepper sauce
3/4  lb. shelled, deveined shrimp (medium size)
1  pkg. frozen whole okra, cut into 2 inch pieces
3  c. cooked rice
preparation: In large saucepot, heat oil.  Add flour and cook over low heat, stirring often, until roux turns dark brown and develops a nut-like aroma.  Add onions, celery, green pepper and garlic and cook until vegetables are tender.  Slowly add chicken broth, a little at a time, stirring after each addition; bring to a boil.  In separate skillet, brown chicken pieces until golden in color and add to pot with tomatoes, bay leaf and pepper sauce.  Simmer, uncovered, 45 minutes.  Add shrimp and okra; cook 10 minutes longer.  Serve with rice.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
1  beaten egg
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. Aunt Jemima pancake mix
2  slices bread
2  tsp. oleo to put on skillet
preparation: In a medium, shallow bowl, mix eggs, milk and pancake mix. Blend well with a fork.  Heat skillet with 2 teaspoons of oleo until hot.  Dip 1 bread slice into the batter and cook in hot skillet 2 minutes on each side, until lightly browned on both sides.  Add more oleo to skillet.  Repeat until you have cooked all bread.

name: POPPY SEED MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. poppy seed
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter, softened
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon peel, grated
1  c. plain yogurt
preparation: Mix flour, poppy seed, baking soda and salt together.  Set aside.  Beat sugar and butter until fluffy.  Beat in eggs, vanilla and lemon peel.  Add flour mixture and 1 cup yogurt.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.  Makes 18 muffins.

name: CREAMY TOMATO SOUP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. reduced calorie margarine
1  large onion, peeled and thinly sliced
1  carrot, chopped
2  garlic cloves, coarsely chopped
1 (28 oz.)  can peeled Italian plum tomatoes
3  c. chicken broth
1  small boiling potato, peeled and thinly sliced
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh basil leaves or 2 tsp. dried basil
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
salt to taste
1  c. milk
preparation: Melt margarine in a soup pot over low heat.  Add onion, carrot and garlic. Cook, covered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender and wilted. Crush tomatoes in their liquid and add to the pot along with the chicken broth, potato, basil, nutmeg and salt. Cook, covered, over low heat for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally. Let cool to room temperature. Puree in a blender, in small batches, adding a bit of milk to each batch. Return to soup pot and adjust seasonings. Before serving, warm through over very low heat. Do not boil. Serves 6.

name: RITZ FRIED SHRIMP
ingredients:
2  c. pancake mix
1  lb. shrimp
1  egg
milk
Ritz crackers
preparation: Combine egg, milk and pancake mix as you would prepare for pancakes.  Crush about 3 or 4 cups of Ritz crackers in food processor and place in a separate bowl.  One at a time, dip shrimp into pancake mix, then roll shrimp into cracker crumbs.  Place on tray.  Deep fry until golden brown.

name: SOPHISTICATED SQUASH
ingredients:
zucchini squash, sliced
tomatoes, sliced
onions, sliced
sausage patties, fried and crumbled
Mozzarella cheese, shredded
salt and pepper to taste
Italian seasoning
preparation: In casserole dish, layer as follows:  squash, tomatoes, onion, sausage and cheese.  Season with salt, pepper and desired amount of Italian seasoning.  Repeat layers.  Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  (Is even better the second day!)

name: ICEBOX (REFRIGERATOR) FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. graham crackers
2 (5 cent)  boxes vanilla wafers! (I use 1/2 lb.)
1  c. cream (I use milk, even skim milk)
1  lb. box raisins
1  pkg. chopped dates
1  pkg. cherries (I use large jar maraschino, drained)
1  pkg. figs, chopped
1  lb. chopped nuts
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. marshmallows, melted*
preparation: * I use 1 small jar marshmallow cream.

name: COFFEE CAKE WITH BEER
ingredients:
2  c. packed brown sugar
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
2  eggs, beaten
3  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. chopped dates
1 (12 oz.)  can beer
preparation: Cream well the brown sugar and butter.  Add eggs.  Mix together and sift 3 cups flour, baking soda, salt and spices. Dust the nuts and dates lightly with flour.  Add flour mixture alternately with beer to the sugar, butter and eggs, beginning and ending with dry ingredients.  Fold in nuts and dates.  Butter and flour Bundt pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours or until done. When cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar.
