name: LITA'S GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
32  oz. canned yellow whole corn, drained
16  oz. canned French-cut green beans, drained
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. chopped green peppers
1  c. sour cream
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix the drained corn and green beans with the remaining ingredients.  Pour mixture into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

name: DREAM PIE
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
1  c. flour
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
preparation: 1st Step:  Blend flour and margarine.  Press down in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cook 15 minutes or until slightly brown for crust.

name: COFFEE POT PUNCH
ingredients:
48  oz. cranberry juice
46  oz. unsweetened pineapple juice
water (add enough to make 32 c.)
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. brown sugar
4  cinnamon sticks
preparation: Pour in pot the cranberry juice, pineapple juice and water. In basket, put sugars and cinnamon. Perk as usual.

name: BROCCOLI-CAULIFLOWER SOUP
ingredients:
8  oz. frozen cauliflower
10 3/4  oz. canned condensed chicken broth
10  oz. frozen, chopped broccoli
1/2  tsp. mustard seed
1/2  tsp. dried dill weed
1/2  tsp. ground mace (optional)
1/3  c. onion, chopped
1/4  c. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3 1/2  c. milk
1  c. Cheddar or Swiss cheese, shredded
dash of pepper
preparation: Cook cauliflower in half the chicken broth for 5 to 8 minutes in a medium saucepan.  In a very large pan, add the remaining broth, broccoli, mustard seed and dill weed.  Cook 5 to 8 minutes. Blend cooked cauliflower, broth and mace in blender until smooth. Cook onion in butter until tender; stir in flour, salt and pepper.  Stir cauliflower mixture and onion mixture together with the broccoli mixture in the large saucepan.  Add milk and cook until thick and bubbly.  Add cheese and cook until melted.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: PARTY CHILI
ingredients:
1  large onion, sliced
1  green pepper, chopped
1  lb. ground beef
vegetable oil
1 1/2  c. kidney beans
2  c. tomatoes
1  c. tomato sauce
1 1/2  Tbsp. chili powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  bay leaf
dash of paprika
dash of cayenne pepper
preparation: Brown onion, green pepper and beef in a little hot oil.  Add beans, tomatoes, tomato sauce, chili powder, salt, bay leaf, paprika and cayenne.  Cover.  Simmer 1 1/2 hours.  Add extra bean liquid or water, if needed.  Yields 6 servings.

name: DIET PEANUT BUTTER CAKE
ingredients:
2/3  c. unsweetened applesauce
2  c. sifted cake flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. reduced-fat or natural peanut butter
1  c. packed brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
2  large eggs
1  large egg white
3/4  c. fat-free milk
preparation: Place a strainer over a deep bowl. Spoon applesauce into strainer and set aside to drain 15 minutes. (Will have about 1/3 cup drained applesauce.) Discard liquid.

name: "GET-TOGETHER" CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. bulk hot sausage
1  c. chopped onion
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese, divided
1  green pepper, chopped
1 (12 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed tomato soup (undiluted)
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/3  c. sliced olives
1  garlic clove, minced
1/2  tsp. salt
8  oz. wide noodles, cooked and drained
preparation: In a large Dutch oven, brown the beef, sausage and onion. Drain off fat.  Stir in 1 cup of cheese, green pepper, corn, soup, tomato sauce, olives, garlic, salt and noodles.   Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Cover and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer.

name: COUNTRY GRANOLA
ingredients:
5 1/2  c. quick-cooking oats
2  c. flaked coconut
2  c. chopped nuts (if desired)
1/2  c. margarine or butter
1/2  c. brown sugar (light brown)
1/2  c. honey
1  Tbsp. vanilla
2/3  c. vacuum packed wheat germ
1 1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Combine oats, coconut and nuts in large pan (11 x 15). Bake 20 minutes at 300°, stirring occasionally. Melt butter in medium-size saucepan. Add brown sugar and honey. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Add wheat germ to oats. Drizzle with butter mixture. Toss. Bake at 350° for 5 minutes. Add raisins. Toss again. Press mixture into pan. Bake additional 5 to 7 minutes. Cool. Store in airtight container.

name: PISTACHIO PUDDING
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1 (3 3/4 oz.)  pkg. pistachio pudding
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1 (10 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Place pineapple in a large bowl.  Sprinkle pudding mix over pineapple and mix.  Add remaining ingredients and mix.   Place into container and refrigerate.

name: DAD'S SATURDAY OR SUNDAY SPECIAL(German Pancakes)
ingredients:
1  egg
2 rounded  Tbsp. flour
dash of salt
drop or two vanilla
preparation: As a treat, my father and his father before him, frequently made the traditional German family pancakes when we were small children.  A tradition I have kept alive in my family.

name: ANNA'S GREEN PEAS
ingredients:
16  oz. frozen English peas or can use 2 cans (15 oz.)
1/4  lb. Velveeta cheese
1 (8 oz.)  can sliced water chestnuts
1 (4 oz.)  jar sliced pimientos
2  Tbsp. butter or Parkay
preparation: Heat peas in microwave 10 minutes. Add cheese, water chestnuts, pimientos and butter. Cook until cheese is melted.

name: PEANUT CLUSTERS
ingredients:
1  lb. almond bark
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1  lb. Spanish peanuts
preparation: Melt the first 3 ingredients in a double boiler.  When smooth, add the peanuts.  Drop by teaspoonfuls on aluminum foil.  Cool.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine or butter
1 2/3  c. sugar
5  eggs
2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar together.  Add eggs, one at a time. Add flour gradually, then add milk, vanilla and salt.  Bake in a tube pan at 325° for 70 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY PRETZEL SQUARES
ingredients:
2  c. finely crushed pretzels
1/3  c. sugar
2/3  c. margarine or butter, melted
12  oz. cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. milk
1 (8 serving) or 2 (4 serving)  pkg. Jell-O strawberry flavor gelatin
1  c. thawed Cool Whip
2  c. boiling water
1 1/2  c. cold water
2  pt. strawberries, sliced
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix crushed pretzels, 1/3 cup sugar and margarine.  Press firmly into bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 10 minutes.  Cool.  Beat cream cheese, 1/4 cup sugar and milk until smooth.  Stir in Cool Whip.  Spread over crust. Refrigerate.

name: SHRIMP PIZZA
ingredients:
3 (4 1/2 or 5 oz.)  cans shrimp
1/3  c. chopped onion
3  finely chopped garlic cloves
3 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
1/3  c. chopped parsley
1 1/2  tsp. oregano
3  unbaked 9-inch pizza crusts
3/4  lb. thinly sliced Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Drain shrimp; rinse in cold water.  Cook onion and garlic in butter until tender.  Add tomato paste and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat.  Add parsley and oregano.  Place pizza crusts on well greased baking pans.  Cover each crust with 1/3 of the sauce, 1/3 shrimp and 1/3 cheese.  Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.

name: OUR SURPRISE DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. sugar (scant)
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. fruit cocktail
1/4 to 1/2  c. juice
1  c. flour
1  egg
pinch of salt
1/2  c. brown sugar
nuts (optional)
preparation: Put all ingredients in a  bowl and mix until wet.  Pour into a buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup brown sugar and nuts, if you wish. Bake at  350°	for  55  minutes  in 9 x 13-inch pan. Serve warm with cream or ice cream.

name: CORN-ON-THE-COB
ingredients:
6  ears corn, trimmed
butter
salt and pepper
preparation: In a large pan, bring to the boil, 4 cups water.  Add corn and reduce heat.  Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until corn is tender-crisp.  Drain.  Season with butter, salt and pepper.

name: ZUCCHINI SALAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. oil
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  onion, chopped fine
1/2  c. celery
1/2  green pepper
preparation: Mix ingredients and pour over thinly sliced zucchini.  Let set at least 1 hour before serving.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  bunch broccoli, washed and chopped
1  large purple onion, chopped
3  eggs, boiled and chopped
bacon, cooked and crumbled
mayonnaise
preparation: Stir in just enough mayonnaise to hold other ingredients together.  Use the woody stems of broccoli; peel and chop.  They have a nutty flavor and rich in nutrients.

name: CHRISTMAS CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
3  (8 oz.) cream cheese
5  whole green onions
1 (2 1/2 oz.)  pkg. dried beef
1  tsp. Accent (optional)
preparation: Chop green onions (green parts too) and dried beef very fine. Mix altogether.  Shape into a ball.  Serve on crackers.

name: CARAMEL BARS
ingredients:
32  caramels
5  Tbsp. cream
1  c. flour
1  c. oatmeal
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. soda
3/4  c. soft butter
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Melt caramels in a double boiler with cream.  Mix flour, oatmeal, brown sugar, soda, butter and salt until crumbly.  Put half of crumbly mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 10 minutes at 350°.  Put on chocolate chips, nuts (optional) and caramel mixture.  Spread rest of dry mixture over the top.  Bake 15 minutes more at 350°.

name: CHRISTMAS RICE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. dry rice
2  cans chicken and rice soup
1 small  jar chopped pimento
1 1/4  c. water
1 small  jar mushrooms
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. green pepper, chopped
1  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Mix all  ingredients.  Bake  for  45  minutes  at 350°. Stir 2 or 3 times while baking.

name: CREAMY BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. broccoli or 1 medium head cauliflower, separated
1  can mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. Bisquick
1/4  c. margarine or butter
preparation: Heat salted water (1/2 teaspoon to 1 cup water) to boiling. Add broccoli (cover and heat to boiling and cook until tender, 10 to 12 minutes).  Drain and place in ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Heat oven to 400°.  Beat soup and milk with hand beater until smooth; pour over broccoli.  Sprinkle with cheese. Mix Bisquick and margarine until crumbly and sprinkle over cheese. Bake until light brown, about 20 minutes.

name: DR. CARTER'S PRUNE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. oil
2  jars prunes (baby food)
3  eggs
1  c. nuts
preparation: Sift  together	flour,	sugar,	cinnamon,  allspice and nutmeg.  Blend  in	oil,  prunes, eggs and nuts.  Mix well and bake  in a tube pan 1 hour at 350°.  May be eaten warm.

name: CHICKEN CACCIATORE
ingredients:
1  tsp. olive oil
1  lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
1  large green bell pepper
15  oz. marinara sauce
1/2  c. water
2  c. cooked rice
preparation: Heat oil in skillet over medium high heat.  Cook chicken and bell pepper for 5 minutes or until chicken is lightly browned. Add sauce and water, bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low; cover. Cook 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.  Stir in cooked rice.

name: EASY COOKIES
ingredients:
1  sleeve unsalted crackers
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. sugar
chocolate chips, nuts, sprinkles or colored sugars (optional)
preparation: Melt sugar in margarine.  Place crackers on a baking sheet (single layer).  Pour margarine and sugar over crackers and bake at 350° for 12 minutes.  While still hot, top with 1 cup chocolate chips and nuts or sprinkles or colored sugar.

name: SPICED TEA MIX
ingredients:
1 large  jar Tang
1  pkg. lemonade mix
1  c. sugar (or more if needed)
1  tsp. ground cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. instant tea
preparation: Mix well.  Use 2 teaspoons of mix to one cup of hot water.

name: SAUSAGE PEPPER QUICHE
ingredients:
1/2  c. each:  sharp Cheddar and Swiss cheese
2  c. Monterey Jack cheese
1  lb. breakfast sausage
1/4  lb. Polish sausage, sliced
3  Tbsp. butter
6  chiles (2 green, 2 yellow, 2 red), sliced, seeds removed and chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. chopped broccoli
1  c. sliced mushrooms
10  oz. half and half
10  oz. evaporated milk
6  jumbo eggs
2  tsp. Old Bay seasoning
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
2  tsp. parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. cayenne
3  deep dish frozen pie crusts
6  Tbsp. Parmesan (2 Tbsp. per pie)
1 1/2  tsp. paprika (1/2 tsp. per pie)
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Grate cheeses; set aside.  Cook sausages and drain.  In a skillet, saute vegetables in the butter until soft.  In a large bowl, combine and whisk half and half, milk, eggs and seasonings.  In pie crusts, layer sausages, vegetable mixture and cheeses, two layers per pie.  Pour milk over layers.  Sprinkle with Parmesan and paprika.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until brown; let sit 15 minutes before slicing to eat.

name: PEPPERONI SALAD
ingredients:
1  bunch broccoli, cut in flowerets
1/2  c. chopped red onions
1 small  jar mushrooms, chopped
1  pkg. sliced pepperoni
1 small  bottle Italian dressing
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1  head lettuce, torn in small pieces
preparation: Mix broccoli, onions, mushrooms and pepperoni together with dressing.  Let stand for 2 hours.  Toss lettuce and top with cheese.

name: MARINATED CUCUMBERS
ingredients:
3  cukes, sliced thin
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. vinegar
2  drops hot sauce
2  Tbsp. chives
dash of pepper
1  tsp. dill seed
preparation: Put sliced cukes in bowl.  Add salt and let stand for 35 minutes.  Combine remaining ingredients and pour over cukes. Refrigerate until time to serve.

name: BEST BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
16  oz. cut green beans
16  oz. cannellini beans
16  oz. red kidney beans
8  oz. cider vinegar
4  oz. olive oil
1  medium onion
salt and pepper to taste
oregano to taste
garlic powder to taste
preparation: Drain 3 cans of beans.  Pour contents into salad bowl.  Chop up onion and add.  Pour in vinegar and oil.  Add spices to taste. Stir and allow to marinate for 12 plus hours.  Serve chilled.

name: HALIBUT WITH HAZELNUT CRUST
ingredients:
1  red apple
3  Tbsp. olive oil
2  tsp. minced shallots
2  tsp. sugar
1/4  c. lemon juice
2  tsp. Dijon mustard
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. lemon zest
1/2  tsp. thyme
pinch of cayenne pepper
1  Tbsp. water
1 1/2  c. hazelnuts, almonds, walnuts or pecans
pinch of dry mustard
1 1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  Tbsp. grated lemon zest
1  tsp. thyme
1 1/4  lb. halibut fillet
1/4  c. oleo, melted
3 to 4  Tbsp. vegetable oil
preparation: Cut apple in half and core.  Chop 1/2; reserve other 1/2 for garnish.  In small skillet over medium-low heat, heat olive oil and add chopped apple.  Cook 1 minute, then add shallots and sugar. Continue cooking until apple is tender, 1 minute.  Add lemon juice and remove from heat.  Cool, then puree in blender until smooth. Pour pureed mixture into bowl.  Add the Dijon then slowly whisk in the oil.  Add the 1 teaspoon lemon zest, 1/2 teaspoon thyme and season with 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and pinch of cayenne pepper.  Stir in the water.  Cut the remaining 1/2 apple into 1/4-inch dices. Toss with dressing; refrigerate.

name: RICE CHEDDAR
ingredients:
3/4  c. sliced green onions (and tops)
2  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. diced pimento
1  c. diced Cheddar
3  c. cooked rice
preparation: Saute onions in butter until soft.  Add rice and pimentos. Cook over low heat until rice is thoroughly heated.  Stir in cheese. Add salt and pepper.

name: SQUASH PICKLE RELISH
ingredients:
8  c. squash, sliced
2  c. onions, diced
2  c. bell pepper, diced
1 large  jar pimento, chopped
3  qt. water
2/3  c. salt
preparation: Soak squash in 3 quarts of water with salt for 1 hour.  Drain, but do not wash.

name: CRAWFISH ETOUFFEE
ingredients:
3  cans golden mushroom soup
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can mushrooms
onions, bell pepper, garlic, etc. (to individual taste)
1  lb. crawfish
preparation: Saute seasonings; add other ingredients (except crawfish). Cook a few minutes.  Add crawfish, salt and pepper.  Cook about 15 to 20 minutes.  Serve over rice.

name: VEGETARIAN SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. olive oil
1  onion
1  green pepper
1/2  c. diced celery
16  oz. tomatoes with juice
18  oz. chopped water chestnuts
4  oz. mushrooms, sliced
1/4  c. chopped parsley
2  tsp. honey
8  oz. tomato sauce
1/8  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
2  tsp. wine vinegar
3  small bay leaves
2  tsp. hot sauce (optional)
preparation: In large iron skillet, on low heat, add oil, onion, pepper and celery.  Fry gently until onion turns.  Add tomatoes and blend in other ingredients.  Cover and simmer 50 to 60 minutes.  Continue to simmer to thicken or use 1 teaspoon flour and water.

name: NO-BAKE PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  baked pie shell
1  box instant vanilla pudding
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Add 1 cup pumpkin.  Add whipped topping (Dream Whip).  Pour into pie shell.  Chill.  Top with whipped topping.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans French-style green beans
1  medium onion, cut in rings
8  strips bacon
1/2  c. slivered almonds
1 (11 oz.)  can celery soup
6  Tbsp. sugar
6  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Drain beans; put into casserole dish.  Place onion rings over beans.  Fry bacon and place over beans and onion.  Sprinkle almonds over bacon.  Pour celery soup over this.  Heat vinegar, sugar and bacon drippings and put on top of all ingredients.  Let set a while, then bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: STEP COOKIES(Unbaked)
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/4  c. sugar
5  Tbsp. cocoa or 2 sq., melted
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. coconut, chopped fine
1/4  c. instant French vanilla instant pudding
1  Tbsp. milk
1/2  c. margarine or butter
2  c. sugar
preparation: Combine  butter,  sugar,  cocoa,  egg,	vanilla,  graham cracker crumbs and coconut well.  Press  into  9  x 9-inch pan. Chill.  Mix instant pudding,  milk,  margarine  and sugar; whip and spread over the first layer,  tipping  pan  so it is spread smoothly.  Melt 2 squares  baking  chocolate  and 2 tablespoons margarine together and smooth over	the  second layer until all is covered.  Store in refrigerator.  Cut  after  it is chilled. Delicious and loaded with calories.

name: EASY PEANUT BUTTER CANDY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  c. peanut butter
preparation: Combine sugar and milk.  Bring to a rolling boil.  Take off stove and add peanut butter.   Beat until the gloss is gone.  Then pour into a buttered pan and let cool.

name: ENVY SALAD
ingredients:
1  (6 oz.) lemon Jell-O
1 1/3  c. hot water
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  tsp. chopped pecans
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (10 oz.)  bottle lemon-lime carbonated beverage
1 small  can crushed pineapple
2  drops green food coloring
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in hot water in mixer bowl.  Add cream cheese. Beat at medium speed until blended.  Stir in remaining ingredients by hand.  Pour into mold.  Chill until firm.

name: CHOCOLATE CARAMELS
ingredients:
1  c. light cream
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. light corn syrup
1/2  tsp. salt
3  oz. (3 sq.) unsweetened chocolate
1/8  tsp. cream of tartar
2  tsp. vanilla
almonds, pecans or walnuts (if desired)
preparation: Combine first 7 ingredients in heavy saucepan.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves.  Cook until candy forms a firm ball in cold water (245° on candy thermometer). Remove from heat.  Stir in vanilla.  Pour in a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Do not scrape pan.  Nuts can be pressed into top, if desired.  Let cool.  Cut into 3/4-inch squares.  Let dry.  Wrap.  Makes 144 caramels.

name: FRESNO FRITTERS
ingredients:
1  egg
1/4  c. milk
1  c. pancake mix
1 1/2  c. whole kernel corn, drained
3/4  c. raisins
cooking oil 1 inch deep in skillet
preparation: Blend egg and milk.  Add pancake mix, stirring just enough to blend.  Fold in corn and raisins.  Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil. Cook until golden brown, about 4 minutes.  Drain on paper towels. Serve warm with butter and syrup for breakfast or as a side dish. Makes 24-30.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  egg
2  c. flour
1/3  c. sugar
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  c. blueberries
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Put cupcake liners in muffin pans.  Beat milk, oil and egg.  Stir in flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, all at once, just until flour is moistened (batter will be lumpy). Fold in blueberries.

name: POTATOES AU GRATIN
ingredients:
7  medium potatoes, cooked and grated
1  pkg. frozen hash browns
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/3  c. minced onion
1  pt. sour cream
salt and pepper to taste
corn flakes or potato chips
preparation: Heat potatoes and hash browns together.  Mix all ingredients except corn flakes or potato chips.  Crush corn flakes or chips and sprinkle on the top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, uncovered.

name: TORTILLA SOUP
ingredients:
4  c. chicken broth
1  large onion
1  jalapeno pepper
1  green pepper
1  clove garlic, chopped fine
1 large  can Mexican stewed tomatoes
1  small tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. cumin
1  Tbsp. chili powder
4  chicken breasts, boned, skinned and chopped
preparation: Sauté onions, peppers and garlic. Add and simmer chicken breasts. Add remaining ingredients and simmer. Serve with Fritos or Doritos.

name: LAYERED MANJU
ingredients:
5  c. flour, unsifted
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt (optional)
1  lb. butter
3/4  c. Borden's condensed milk
1  egg
2  cans Koshian
preparation: Beat  egg;   set  aside.  Mix  dry  ingredients.  Cream butter.  Add  dry  ingredients and milk alternately to butter. Divide dough into  2  parts.  Spread  dough;  press into a 9 x 13-inch  pan.  Spread  Koshian.  Spread  remaining	dough  and press.  Coat with  beaten  egg.  Bake  at  375°  for  40 to 45 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  lb. (1 stick) butter, softened
1  c. sugar
2  eggs (unbeaten)
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. unbleached flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  pt. sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Cream together butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Set aside. Sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.  Combine all ingredients.  Add sour cream.  Stir in drained pineapple by hand.

name: PINEAPPLE COCKTAIL BARBECUE
ingredients:
1 (1 lb. 4 oz.)  can pineapple chunks
1  c. (10 oz. jar) red cherry jelly or preserves
1/4  c. ketchup
3  whole cloves
1  stick cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. soy sauce (optional)
1/2 to 1  lb. ground beef
1/2 to 1  lb. Vienna sausages
preparation: Drain pineapple and save syrup.  Combine the syrup with the jelly or preserves, ketchup, cloves, cinnamon and salt.  Heat to boiling.

name: WHOLE WHEAT BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1  c. unsifted whole wheat flour
1/2  c. unsifted unbleached white flour
1  tsp. baking soda
3/4  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. mashed, ripe bananas (2 large or 3 small)
1/4  c. yogurt
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cream butter and sugar together until very light and creamy.  Beat in the egg.  Sift together the whole wheat flour, white flour, baking soda and salt.  Combine the bananas and yogurt, stirring just enough to mix.  Add dry ingredients alternately with banana mixture to butter mixture, stirring just enough to combine well.  Turn into an oiled 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until done.  Cool in the pan 10 minutes.  Remove from pan and finish cooling on a rack. Yield:  One loaf.

name: DATE LOAF CANDY
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. milk
8  oz. dates, cut fine
2  Tbsp. oleo
1  c. nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Let sugar and milk boil for a few minutes.  Add dates.  Stir and mash dates while cooking.  Cook to the soft ball stage; add oleo, nuts and vanilla.  Knead with spoon well.  Roll in damp cloth and allow to harden.  Unroll and cut into 1/2-inch slices.

name: RICE-FRANK-CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. diced green pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  c. instant rice or almost precooked regular rice
2  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1  can condensed Cheddar cheese soup
3/4  lb. frankfurters (bite size)
2  tsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Melt butter in skillet; saute onion and green pepper.  Stir in rice.  Add water and salt; boil and cook 5 minutes.  Stir in soup. Add frankfurters and mustard.  Heat through, stirring often.

name: MEAT AND POTATOES
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
potatoes, diced
onions, chopped
salt
pepper
parsley
preparation: Fry diced potatoes, then fry hamburger meat.  Combine the two and serve.

name: PUMPKIN RAISIN CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  c. oil
4  eggs
15  oz. pumpkin
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. raisins
1/3  c. soft butter
3  oz. soft cream cheese
2  c. powdered sugar
1  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Heat oven to 350 degrees and grease 13X9 pan.  Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and cloves.  Mix oil, eggs and pumpkin; add to dry ingredients.  Add nuts and raisins.  Bake 40-50 minutes.  While cake is cooling, mix butter, cream cheese, powdered sugar, milk and vanilla.  Beat until smooth and creamy.  Frost cake.

name: SAUSAGE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
2  lb. Velveeta
1  can cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. jar picante sauce
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. milk
preparation: Cook and drain 1 pound sausage.  Mix other ingredients together in a saucepan and melt over low heat.  Add sausage. Serve warm with crackers or chips.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
3  lb. apples
1/2  c. water
cinnamon and nutmeg to taste
1  stick butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
nuts (optional)
preparation: Peel and slice apples into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle with water, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Crumble butter, sugar and flour. Sprinkle over apples.  Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour. Nuts may be added before crust if desired.

name: M&M COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. oil
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2 1/4  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2 to 2  c. M&M's candy
preparation: In large bowl, blend shortening, brown sugar and white sugar. Beat in vanilla and eggs.  Add rest of ingredients.   Blend well. Stir in M&M's candy, saving 1/2 cup to put 3 on each cookie.  Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet.

name: UGLY CAKE
ingredients:
1  egg
1  stick oleo
1  box yellow cake mix
1  box powdered sugar
2  eggs
8  oz. cream cheese
preparation: Mix  well  1 well beaten egg, oleo and cake mix.  Press into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/3  c. flour
3  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. oil
4  eggs
2  c. canned pumpkin
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Grease and flour 1 large loaf pan or 4 mini loaf pans.  Mix all ingredients well; pour in pan and bake 1 hour.  Great when sliced and spread with soft cream cheese!

name: MAPLE FUDGE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. white sugar
2  c. maple syrup
2/3  c. half and half
1/2  c. chopped nutmeats
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan.  Add next 3 ingredients and cook until a soft ball may be formed.  Add nutmeats.  Beat until smooth, then pour into buttered dish.  Let cool, then cut.

name: CREAM PUFFS
ingredients:
1  C. boiling water
1/2  C. butter
1  C. sifted flour
4  eggs
preparation: Cook the water, butter and flour until thick and smooth. Cool.

name: ORANGE SHORTBREAD SQUARES
ingredients:
2 1/3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. margarine, softened
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1/3  c. orange juice
2  tbsp. grated orange peel
10x sugar
preparation: In small bowl, combine 2 c. flour, baking powder and salt. In large bowl beat margarine and 1/2 c. sugar until light and fluffy.  At low speed, gradually stir in flour mixture until well blended.  Chill 2 hours.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
6  eggs
3  c. sugar
3  sticks butter
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
preparation: Have all ingredients at room temperature.  Mix butter, sugar and cream cheese for 5 to 7 minutes.  Add eggs one at a time. Beat well.  Add flour and salt, 1 cup at a time.  Pour batter in a greased and floured tube pan or 2 loaf pans.  Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350° or until done.

name: BURIED TREASURE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jell-O pudding and pie filling (any flavor)
1  whipped topping (frozen)
preparation: Prepare pudding mix as directed.  Using a spoon, scoop out 4 balls of frozen whipped topping and place in each of 4 dessert glasses.  Spoon pudding over whipped topping in glasses.  Chill. Makes 2 2/3 cups.

name: DROP DOUGHNUTS(Breakfast or Dessert)
ingredients:
3  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  c. milk (sweet or sour)
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
4  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Stir all ingredients together, except butter, then stir in the melted butter.  Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot fat.

name: 7-UP APPLESAUCE JELLO(No Fat, Low Sugar)
ingredients:
16  oz. unsweetened applesauce
1 small  pkg. lemon jello
1 small  pkg. lime jello
16  oz. 7-Up (sugar-free)
preparation: Heat applesauce.  Dissolve jellos in applesauce.  Let cool. Add 7-Up and refrigerate.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Minute rice, cooked
2  boxes frozen chopped broccoli
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. celery
1/4  c. onion
preparation: Add all ingredients together.  Place in a 13 x 9-inch cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

name: SPECIAL K BARS
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
1  c. white syrup
1 1/2  c. peanut butter
6  c. Special K cereal
1 small  pkg. chocolate chips
1 small  pkg. butterscotch chips
preparation: Bring to boil the white sugar and white syrup; add peanut butter and Special K cereal.  Spread on buttered 11 x 16-inch cookie sheet.  Melt the chocolate chips and butterscotch chips. Spread on top of mixture on sheet.

name: CHICKEN THIGHS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  - 12 chicken thighs
1  stick butter
1  can chicken noodle soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  cup rice, cooked
Heinz 57 sauce
Velveeta Cheese, sliced
preparation: Cook chicken thighs in butter until brown.  Set aside.  Cook rice. Combine soups and bring to a boil.  Grease 9 x 12 pan.  Put in rice and chicken.  Cover with soup mix.  Sprinkle with Heinz 57 sauce. Cover with sliced Velveeta.  Bake at 350° until cheese turns light brown, about 30 minutes.

name: CANNED TOMATO SOUP
ingredients:
1  pk. tomatoes
1  bunch celery
6  onions
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. salt
1  bunch parsley or 1/4 c. dried
2  green peppers
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. flour
preparation: Cook tomatoes, onions, celery, parsley and peppers until tender. Put through a sieve. Add sugar and salt. Make a paste of melted butter and flour. Blend with juice. Heat and add to jars. Process in hot water bath 2 hours or in a pressure cooker (pints 15 minutes or quarts 20 minutes).

name: BONBONS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter, softened
1  box powdered sugar
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1/2  sq. paraffin
preparation: Cream butter.  Gradually  add sugar, beating well. Stir in milk and vanilla.  Chill  until  firm.  Shape  into walnut-size balls.

name: COOL WHIP PIE
ingredients:
1  large container Cool Whip
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1/3  c. lemon juice
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  c. chopped nuts
2  baked pie crusts
preparation: Beat Cool Whip, condensed milk, lemon juice and pineapple. Fold in nuts and pour into baked pie crusts.  Chill about 1 hour.

name: A HAPPY HOME RECIPE
ingredients:
4  c. love
2  c. loyalty
3  c. forgiveness
1  c. friendship
5  spoons of hope
2  spoons of tenderness
4  qt. faith
1  barrel of laughter
preparation: A variety  of  meals can be prepared as noted below and found to be very palatable.

name: MINTS
ingredients:
3  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  lb. confectioners sugar
few drops oil of peppermint
desired food coloring
preparation: Mix together all ingredients thoroughly.  Be sure it is of right consistency.  Press in mint molds.  Turn out onto waxed paper to dry.  Store in airtight container in refrigerator or freezer.

name: SUMMER SANDWICH
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. grated cucumber, drained
3/4  c. carrots, grated
1/4  c. green pepper, finely chopped
1/4  c. celery, finely chopped
1/4  c. onion, finely chopped
1/4  c. salad dressing
dash of salt
dash each: garlic salt, onion salt and celery  salt (optional)
preparation: Combine all ingredients which have either been grated or finely chopped. Cucumbers should be grated on a paper towel to absorb moisture.

name: Caramel Pie
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. boiling water
2  c. milk
4  egg yolks (use egg whites for meringue)
1/2  c. flour (plain)
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put one cup sugar in large iron skillet and let melt to a dark golden brown syrup, stirring constantly.  Add boiling water and cook until lumps are gone.  Mix rest of ingredients together and stir into syrup.  Cook until thick.  Cool before putting into baked pie crusts.  Makes 2 pies.

name: INTERNATIONAL STINGER
ingredients:
1  oz. Metaxa
1/2  oz. Galliano
preparation: Build in rock glass with cubed ice.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. white sugar
1  c. oil
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1 small  can crushed pineapple
2  c. grated carrots
2  c. sifted flour
1  c. walnuts
preparation: Cream  sugar,  oil  and  eggs  together.  Add  vanilla, baking powder,  baking  soda,  salt, cinnamon and nutmeg; beat into creamed  mixture.  Add grated carrots and crushed pineapple (drained);	beat into other mixture.  Add flour; mix in by hand, then add chopped walnuts.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour a  9 x 13-inch glass baking dish.  Bake for about 40 minutes, or until  done.  Can  make a layer cake.  Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

name: SIMPLE STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1  c. thinly sliced chicken
2  tsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. La Choy soy sauce
1 1/2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2 1/2  c. chopped vegetables (bean sprouts, water chestnuts and frozen pea pods
1  tsp. each: garlic and fresh ginger
preparation: Put 1 cup La Choy sauce in a bowl.  Combine chicken and cornstarch.  Mix well.  In large nonstick skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil; stir-fry chicken until brown.  Set aside.  Heat remaining oil in pan; add vegetables, garlic and ginger.  Add to chicken; toss to coat.  Heat through.  Serve with chow mein noodles.

name: SIDE RICE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
1  c. raw rice
1 (8 oz.)  jar mushrooms, drain and reserve liquid
1  pkg. Lawry cheese Italian dressing mix
salt and pepper to taste or 1 tsp. seasoned salt
hot water
preparation: Melt butter in skillet; add rice and stir until golden brown. Remove from heat and add mushrooms, salt and pepper and dressing mix to the rice; stir well. Add enough hot water to reserved liquid to make 2 cups of liquid and pour over rice mix; bring to a boil. Pour into a buttered dish and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: NAN'S TURKEY DRESSING
ingredients:
4  c. raw rice
1  (13 x 9 x 2-inch) pan crumbled corn bread
2  lb. ground beef
1  chopped onion
2  bunches green onions, chopped
1  bunch celery tops, chopped
3  stalks celery, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
1  red bell pepper, chopped
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. Season All
2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. Cajun seasoning or black pepper
preparation: Mix all together; stuff both ends of the bird.  Bake as directed by manufacturer.  Remove stock from the pan as the turkey bakes.  Set aside.  Will be used for giblet gravy and to moisten uncooked dressing.  When the turkey is almost done, pack the rest of the dressing around the bird.  Moisten with 2 to 3 cups of the stock.  Bake until all is cooked.  When everything is cooked, remove all of the dressing from around and inside the turkey.

name: WALDORF SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. diced apples
1  c. cut celery
1/2  c. broken walnuts
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
dash of salt
preparation: Combine apples, celery and walnuts.  Blend together mayonnaise, sugar, lemon juice and salt.  Fold into apple mixture. Chill.

name: SMOKED SALMON SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  can red salmon, drained and flaked
1 (8 oz.)  carton nonfat cream cheese
1  Tbsp. prepared horseradish
1  Tbsp. onion
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/8  tsp. liquid smoke
1  Tbsp. fresh parsley, chopped
48  whole wheat Melba rounds
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients; stir well.  Put in serving bowl. Cover and chill.  Sprinkle with chopped parsley.  Serve on Melba rounds.

name: SOUTHERN BURGERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
2  Tbsp. mustard
2  Tbsp. catsup
1  can Campbell's chicken gumbo soup
preparation: Combine in skillet and simmer on low for about 1/2 hour.

name: CRUMB COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. brown sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. walnuts or pecans, chopped
1  c. milk
1  egg
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix the first 4 ingredients together until crumbly.  Save 1 cup for crumb topping.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bake in a 9 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large head cabbage, shredded (about 12 c.)
1  onion, chopped
6  Tbsp. butter  or margarine, divided
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
8  oz. process American cheese, cubed
salt and pepper to taste
1/4  c. dry bread crumbs
preparation: Cook cabbage in boiling salted water until tender; drain thoroughly.  In a large skillet, saute onion in 5 tablespoons butter until tender.  Add soup and mix well.  Add cheese; heat and stir until melted.  Remove from the heat.  Stir in cabbage, salt and pepper.  Transfer to an ungreased 2-quart baking dish.  In a small skillet, melt remaining butter.  Cook and stir crumbs in butter until lightly browned; sprinkle over casserole.  Bake, uncovered, at 350°  for 20 to 30 minutes or until heated through. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: BETTY'S CHEESE STRAWS
ingredients:
8  oz. medium sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  lb. softened margarine
3  c. plain flour
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. red pepper
preparation: Grate cheese and mix with margarine with hands until creamy. Mix until dough clings to bowl.  Grease cookie sheet and use cookie press.  Place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes.  Yields about 4 dozen.

name: MOM BARDO'S CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
3  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
2  eggs
1  c. sweet milk
preparation: Cream sugar, shortening and eggs.  Sift together cornmeal, flour, baking powder and salt.  Then add alternately with milk. Bake in a loaf pan at 350°, about 40 minutes.  (I used cornmeal from Alderfers Pantry from Troy.)

name: ORANGE CANDY SLICE CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
4  eggs
1  tsp. soda
4  c. flour
1  lb. orange jelly candy slices, halved
2  c. mixed nuts, chopped
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1/4  tsp. salt
1  lb. dates, chopped
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.  Add 1 cup buttermilk.  Beat well.  Add soda to the other half cup buttermilk.  Add to mixture.  Combine dry ingredients. Add orange slices, halved.  Add dates and nuts.  Blend well.  Line tube pan with well-greased brown paper.  Bake slowly at 275° for 2 1/2 hours.

name: CHILI GUMBO
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. elbow macaroni
1  onion, chopped
1 1/3  c. cubed cheese
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1 large  can plain chili
1  dash garlic salt
preparation: Boil 1-quart water with salt and pepper to taste. Add the chopped onion.  Cook onion 5 minutes.  Add macaroni and tomatoes. Cook 15 minutes, then add chili with chili powder and garlic salt. Cut cheese in cubes and add to mixture.  Cook slowly until dissolved.

name: CRAB PASTA
ingredients:
6  oz. thin spaghetti
16  oz. crab meat (can be flaked)
2  scallions
3/4  c. mayonnaise (can be lite)
preparation: Break spaghetti into thirds.  Cook and drain.  Chop scallions finely.  Mix everything together.  Serve on lettuce, if desired.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. Oreo cookies
1  large size Cool Whip
1/2  c. butter or oleo
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
preparation: Crush Oreos and line a 9 x 13-inch pan with 3/4 of crushed cookies.  Mix together Cool Whip, butter, cream cheese and powdered sugar.  Mix together milk, vanilla and pudding.  Pour over cookies and top with remaining cookies.  Freeze or chill (either way, it's good).

name: SPICY OVEN "FRIED" POTATO WEDGES
ingredients:
3/4  lb. baking potatoes, cut into thin wedges
2  tsp. vegetable oil
1/4  tsp. each:  onion powder, garlic powder, ground red pepper and black pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Spray nonstick baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.  Arrange potatoes on sheet; drizzle with oil.  Turn potatoes, coating well with oil.  Bake for 10 minutes. Turn potatoes over; bake until edges are lightly browned, about 10 minutes longer.  Transfer potatoes to mixing bowl; sprinkle with spices.  Mix well.

name: BUDGET CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburg
1  large onion, chopped fine
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. egg noodles
3/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. milk
1  can cream of mushroom soup, not diluted (any brand will do)
preparation: Brown hamburg and onion in a skillet slightly.  Add tomato sauce and simmer a few minutes.  Cook noodles as per package instruction. Mix cheese, milk and soup.  Place noodles in a baking dish.  Top this with meat mixture.  Top this with cheese mixture. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: GRAMMA'S SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
1  c. hot baked sweet potatoes, mashed
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. evaporated milk
1/2  tsp. nutmeg (or to taste)
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix brown sugar with flour, then mix all ingredients together well and pour into unbaked crust.  Dot butter on top before baking.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: FUN TO MAKE POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
5  qt. popped corn
1/2  c. Karo
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. water
1  tsp. vinegar
food coloring of your choice to tint
preparation: Keep popped corn warm in a slow oven (300°).  Combine sugar, Karo, water, salt and vinegar.  Cook to 250°; add the vanilla. Pour syrup slowly over warm corn.  Stir slowly and gently.  Butter hands and make into balls.  Wrap in wax paper.

name: OVEN CHOW MEIN
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburg
1  c. onion, diced
1  can chicken rice soup
1  can water
1  c. celery, diced
1  c. uncooked rice (not instant)
1/2  bottle soy sauce
1  bag chow mein noodles
preparation: Mix all ingredients together except noodles.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.  Sprinkle noodles on top.

name: TEA TIME TASSIES
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1  c. flour
preparation: Mix all ingredients and separate into approximately 1-inch balls.  Spread balls around bottom and edge of small muffin tins.

name: PINEAPPLE BAKE(Very Popular!)
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter, softened
4  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
5  slices bread, cubed
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar. Beat in eggs. Stir in pineapple. Fold in bread cubes.  Put mixture in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.  Good served with ham.

name: CRAB BALLS
ingredients:
1/2  c. cooked crab (1 can)
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. celery seed or celery salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Drain, squeeze and pick crab.  Mix everything else and then add crab.  Chill thoroughly. Form into balls.  Keep well chilled until party or serving.  Add a pretzel stick to each ball and pick up by pretzel stick.

name: HAMBURGER CHILI DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger, cooked and drained
1  can chili, no beans
1  box Mexican Velveeta (hot or mild)
preparation: Mix into crock-pot, set on low.  Cook about 1 hour until hot. Serve with chips.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: SOUTHERN PIE CRUST(Easy Recipe)
ingredients:
3  c. flour, blend with 1 tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. shortening
1  egg
1  tsp. vinegar
3  Tbsp. water
preparation: Beat egg.  Add vinegar and water.  Cut flour into shortening. Add egg mixture to flour and shortening.  Mix just until flour is moistened.  Use additional flour when rolling dough.  Makes one double crust and one shell.

name: OATMEAL CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. shortening
3/4  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. white sugar
2  eggs
2  c. oatmeal
1  tsp. hot water
1  pkg. chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream  shortening; add sugars gradually.  Add eggs, one at a time,  beating after each addition.  Add hot water, then add  dry ingredients.  Add  oatmeal,  chocolate chips and mix thoroughly. Add vanilla and blend well.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

name: PASTA PRIMAVERA WITH A TWIST
ingredients:
1  can Campbell's condensed cream of chicken and broccoli soup
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  c. broccoli flowerets
2  medium carrots, sliced
2 1/2  c. cooked corkscrew macaroni
2  cans Swanson premium chunk white chicken, drained
preparation: In saucepan, mix soup, milk, cheese, garlic powder, pepper, broccoli and carrots.  Heat to boil.  Cover and cook over low heat for 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender-crisp, stirring occasionally.  Add macaroni and chicken and heat through.  Serves 4.

name: CHERRY ICE CREAM(Makes 1 1/2 gallons.)
ingredients:
8  eggs
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
3 (13 oz.)  cans evaporated milk, chilled
2 (21 oz.)  cans cherry pie filling
3 3/4  c. milk
preparation: Beat eggs for 3 minutes in a large mixing bowl at high speed of an electric mixer.  Gradually add sugar and salt continuing to beat.  Add evaporated milk and pie filling until blended.  Stir in milk.  Freeze in 1 1/2 gallon freezer or divide mixture and freeze half at a time in a 1 gallon freezer making sure the other half is stored in refrigerator.  Let ripen for 1 1/2 hours.

name: BUTTER PECAN BARS
ingredients:
1  butter pecan cake mix
1  egg
1  stick butter
8  oz. cream cheese
3  eggs
1  box powdered sugar
preparation: Mix cake mix, egg and butter, this makes crust.  Place in 9 x 12-inch baking dish.  Cream remaining 3 ingredients.  Spread on crust.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Cook and cut into bars.

name: SPICY CHEESEBURGER SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. water
2  c. potatoes, cubed
2  small carrots, sliced
1  small onion
1/4  c. green pepper, chopped
1  garlic clove
1  Tbsp. beef bouillon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  lb. ground beef, cooked and drained
2 1/2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. flour
8  oz. American cheese, cubed
1/2  lb. bacon, cooked and crumbled
preparation: In a large saucepan, combine the first 8 ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Stir in beef and 2 cups milk; heat through. Combine flour and remaining milk until smooth. Gradually stir into soup. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened and bubbly. Reduce heat. Stir in cheese until melted. Top with cooked bacon just before serving. Makes about 2 quarts.

name: SOURDOUGH PANCAKES FOR 4 TO 5
ingredients:
1/2  c. Starter
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. oil
1  c. evaporated milk (undiluted)
1 1/4  c. warm water
2  large eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Combine water, milk, Starter and flour.  Blend together and take out new Starter.  Let stand at room temperature overnight. Next morning, add eggs, sugar, salt, soda and oil.  Mix well.  Cook on griddle at moderate heat (375°).

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. whole hog sausage (pork)
1  c. uncooked regular rice
2  c. grated carrots, coarsely grated or chopped
1  c. chopped onions
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. water
1  can chicken broth (14 1/4 oz.)
preparation: Spread rice evenly in a slightly greased 3-quart casserole dish.  Add chopped vegetables, spreading evenly over rice.  Pour chicken broth and water over rice and vegetables.  Cook sausage until slightly brown; drain.  Spread over vegetables.

name: CORN AND BEAN VEGGIE DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 small  can sliced black olives
1 16  oz. can whole kernel corn
1 16  oz. can black eyed peas
1 16  oz. can black beans
1/2  c. chopped red or green pepper
1  clove minced garlic
1  bottle Zesty Italian salad dressing
1  lb. bag tortilla chips
8  oz. pkg. grated cheddar cheese, optional
preparation: Mince garlic, chop onion and pepper. Drain all canned vegetables.  Combine all ingredients with Italian salad dressing. Cover and let flavors blend from 2 to 24 hours.  Spoon vegetables into a serving bowl with a slotted spoon to drain liquids.  Serve with wide tortilla chips to scoop up dip.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck
1/2  lb. pork sausage
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  c. oats
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. (rounded) sage
1  c. tomato juice
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Combine ground chuck, sausage, onion, green pepper, celery, oats, salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce and sage in bowl; mix well.  Add tomato juice and egg; mix well.  Shape into loaf and place in 5 x 9-inch loaf pan.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 hour. Bake, uncovered, for 15 minutes longer or until brown.  May make gravy from meat loaf broth.  May substitute bread crumbs for oats and V-8 juice for tomato juice.  Yield: 8 servings.

name: OLD FASHIONED APPLE FLOAT
ingredients:
2  egg whites
boiling water
1  qt. applesauce
sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Beat 2 egg whites until stiff.	Pour boiling water over the egg whites and let stand for 5 minutes.

name: COCONUT DESSERT
ingredients:
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
60  Ritz crackers
1/4  lb. margarine
1/2  c. milk
2  pkg. instant coconut cream pudding
preparation: Crumb the crackers and mix with the melted margarine.  Set aside 1 cup. Soften ice cream until creamy and add milk and pudding mix.  Line bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan with crackers.  Mix and pour mixture over the crackers.  Refrigerate 1 hour.  Top with Cool Whip and the 1 cup crackers. Keep refrigerated.

name: BANANA-NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. shortening
2  eggs
1  c. mashed bananas
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Mix dry ingredients. Cream the shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Beat good. Add dry ingredients alternately with bananas.  Mix walnuts and 1 tablespoon flour.  Mix with batter.  Pour in greased loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: VEGETABLE RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. green onion including tops, sliced
1  Tbsp. margarine
1 (3 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms
1/4  c. chopped pimento
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. uncooked rice
preparation: Place onion and margarine in skillet.  Cook over medium heat until onion is soft.  Add remaining ingredients, except rice. Bring to a boil.  Place ribs in a greased casserole dish.  Pour liquid mixture over rice.  Stir well.   Cover and bake in preheated oven at 370° for 30 minutes.

name: FRIED PECANS
ingredients:
cooking oil
pecans
preparation: Heat cooking oil in a deep fryer to 375°.  Place pecans in fry basket and put in hot oil.  Remove pecans when they just begin to turn brown.  (This will take 3 to 5 minutes.)  The pecans will continue to cook once they are removed from oil.  Salt while hot. These are delicious!

name: QUICK CHOCOLATE BUTTERMILK CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  stick butter or margarine
1/2  c. shortening
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. water
2  beaten eggs
1  tsp. soda
1/2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Sift first 3 ingredients together.  In a saucepan, bring butter/margarine, water, shortening, buttermilk and cocoa to a boil.  Remove from heat.  When mixture is cool, pour over sifted dry ingredients and mix well.  Add beaten eggs and soda.  Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes for layer cakes; 28 to 32 minutes for 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: LUCY OWEN'S FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. salad oil
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
2  c. chopped nuts
3  c. chopped, raw, cooking apples
preparation: Put in	mixer,	oil,  sugar,  eggs and flavoring.  Beat until creamy.  Sift  dry	ingredients  together.	Add  to  oil mixture, a little at a time.  Fold in chopped apples and nuts. Put into greased  and floured Bundt pan.  Cook about 1 hour at 350°.

name: CROCK-POT VEGETABLE-BEEF SOUP
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. soup bones
1  pt. tomato juice
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  bay leaves
1  can tomatoes (14 oz.)
1  pkg. frozen soup vegetables
preparation: Combine meat, tomato juice, onion, seasonings and about 6 cups water in crock-pot.   Simmer on low for about 6 hours, according to pot directions.    Cut meat from  bone in cubes.  Strain broth; let cool until fat congeals.   Skim off.   Add meat, tomatoes and soup vegetables to broth and return to crock-pot.   Simmer on low until vegetables are tender.

name: REESIE BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 1/4  c. peanut butter
1  lb. powdered sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  c. wax
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Combine graham cracker crumbs, peanut butter and sugar.  Melt butter; add vanilla and combine with the graham cracker mixture. Stir thoroughly and mix with hands.  Form small balls and chill until firm.  In double boiler, melt the wax and chocolate chips. Dip candy balls in the chocolate mixture and let set one hour before serving.

name: VAMPIRE PUNCH
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
20  oz. can crushed pineapple in juice (undrained)
1  qt. hulled strawberries
1  qt. cranberry juice
juice of 2 oranges
juice of 2 lemons
1  qt. club soda, chilled
2  c. crushed ice
preparation: In saucepan, bring sugar and water to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves.  Cool.  In a large bowl, combine pineapple, strawberries and juices.  Chill.  Add cooled sugar syrup to fruit mixture.  Refrigerate.  Just before serving, add club soda and ice.

name: STICKY BUNS
ingredients:
2  loaves frozen bread dough, thawed
2  c. brown sugar
1 large  pkg. vanilla pudding
1  stick butter, softened
1  tsp. cinnamon
nuts (optional)
preparation: Tear 1 loaf thawed bread dough into irregular pieces and place in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle the mixture of brown sugar, pudding, butter and cinnamon over the bread pieces.  Tear up the second loaf of thawed bread dough and layer on top.  Cover with a wet towel and let rise about 4 hours.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Turn upside down immediately.  Nuts and raisins may be added with the brown sugar layer.

name: FANTASTIC SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
1 small  pkg. orange jello
1  can mandarin oranges
1 flat  can crushed pineapple
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix dry jello and cottage cheese.  Stir in drained fruit and fold in Cool Whip.  Refrigerate.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS IN CURRIED CREAM SAUCE
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. skinless boneless chicken breasts
2  Tbsp. butter
1/4  c. finely chopped shallots
1  Tbsp. curry powder
1/2  c. dry white wine
1 1/4  c. heavy cream
salt and pepper
preparation: Cut the chicken strips about 1/2-inch wide. Melt the butter in a skillet and when it is hot, add the chicken pieces. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Stir until chicken strips lose their raw look. Add shallots and curry powder. Stir to blend and cook about 1 minute. Transfer chicken to a bowl. Add the wine to the skillet and cook over high heat about 3 minutes or until reduced to about 1/4 cup. Add any juices that have accumulated in the bowl containing the chicken. Add the cream to the skillet and cook over high heat about 4 minutes. Add the chicken and stir to blend well. Serve over rice. Makes 4 servings.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. ketchup
1/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. oil
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Mix all together well and baste meat.

name: CARRY-OUT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. wide noodles, cooked and drained
2  lb. ground beef
2  c. cottage cheese
1/4  c. diced green pepper
1/4  c. chopped ripe olives
2  c. tomato sauce
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Saute onion and green pepper; set aside.  Brown beef; add flour.  Combine beef, vegetables and tomato sauce; simmer for 10 minutes.  Season with salt and pepper.  Add remaining ingredients and divide into two 9 x 13-inch pans or large casserole dishes. (This freezes well, so one casserole can be saved for a future time.)  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Makes 16 servings.  This is an excellent casserole for potlucks and large groups.

name: CLAMS PARMESANO
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Noodle Roni Parmesano
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. margarine or butter
1 (6 oz.)  can minced clams (undrained)
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. finely chopped parsley (optional)
preparation: Cook noodles as package directs; drain.  In same pan, saute onion in margarine.  Add clams, milk and contents of seasoning packet; heat through.  Toss noodles with clam sauce and parsley. Makes 3 (1 cup) servings.

name: MARINATED CUCUMBERS
ingredients:
3  large cucumbers
2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. tarragon vinegar
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cut cucumbers into  very  thin  slices.  Toss  them  in salt. Combine vinegar,  sugar  and pepper.  Mix in cucumbers. Cover tightly;  refrigerate at least 3 hours.

name: OMELET SANDWICH
ingredients:
16  slices white bread
8 (1 oz.)  slices processed American cheese
8 (1 oz.)  slices ham
6  eggs, beaten
3  c. milk
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  c. cornflakes, crushed
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with cooking spray.  Line bottom with 8 bread slices, cutting them to fit.  Arrange cheese, ham and remaining bread slices over top

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. hamburger
1/2  lb. bacon
1  medium onion, chopped
2 (16 oz.)  cans pork and beans
1 (11 oz.)  can red kidney beans
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
1  c. catsup
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Saute onion.  Add meat and brown.  Drain grease off the meat. Mix other ingredients together in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Add meat and mix well.  Bake uncovered at 375° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: PISTACHIO SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. pistachio instant pudding mix
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1 large  pkg. Cool Whip
2  c. colored miniature marshmallows
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Combine pudding mix with crushed pineapple.  Add Cool Whip, marshmallows and nuts.  Mix well and refrigerate.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: SWISS CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  boned chicken breasts
2  cans cream of chicken soup
Swiss cheese slices
Pepperidge Farm stuffing
1 1/2  sticks melted butter
preparation: Cut up breasts; put in a 4 x 13-inch or larger deep dish pan. Pour soup over chicken and mix.  Place slices of Swiss cheese on top to cover.  Then top with stuffing.  Drizzle the melted butter on top of that.  Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
1  can potato soup
1  can celery soup
1  can Carnation milk
1 small  can minced clams
preparation: Mix together and cook about 10 minutes, stirring often.

name: MEAT LOAF TOPPING
ingredients:
1/4  c. catsup
3  Tbsp. brown sugar (rounded)
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix all ingredients and spread over prepared meat loaf.

name: CHEDDAR BATTER BREAD
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. cornmeal
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  pkg. quick rising active dry yeast
1/4  tsp. onion powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  tsp. salt
1  egg
3/4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese or Monterey Jack cheese
1/2  c. cornmeal
preparation: Bake in a greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan sprinkled with the 1 tablespoon cornmeal.

name: CHICKEN CACCIATORE
ingredients:
3  lb. broiler-fryer chicken, cut up
1/4  c. shortening
1/2  c. Gold Medal flour
2  c. thinly sliced onion rings
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, drained
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (3 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms, drained
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. oregano
preparation: Wash chicken and pat dry.  In a large skillet, melt shortening over medium heat.  Coat chicken with flour.  Cook chicken in hot shortening over medium heat 15 to 20 minutes or until brown. Remove chicken and set aside.  Add onion rings, green pepper and garlic to skillet. Cook and stir over medium heat until onion and pepper are tender.  Stir in remaining ingredients. Add chicken. Cover and simmer 30 to 40 minutes or until thickest pieces are tender.  Makes 4 servings.

name: PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. cream of tartar
1 1/2  c. water
1/2  c. salt
1  Tbsp. oil
food coloring (if desired)
preparation: In a bowl, mix flour and cream of tartar.  Set aside.  In a large pan, heat water, salt, oil and food coloring to boiling. Mix with dry ingredients.  Knead well.  Store in an airtight container or Ziploc bag.

name: CREAMY CRUNCHY POTATOES(Great Barbecue Side Dish)
ingredients:
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
2  Tbsp. butter
3 (12 oz.)  pkg. frozen shredded hash brown potatoes, thawed
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup (or another cream soup will do)
3/4  c. chopped jalapeno peppers (optional)
1  c. cornflakes
1/4  c. melted butter
preparation: In a saucepan cook onion in 2 tablespoons butter until tender. In a bowl, combine thawed hash browns, sour cream, cream soup, onion mixture and jalapenos, if you like.  Transfer to a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Sprinkle with cornflakes and drizzle with melted butter.  Bake in a 350° oven for about 45 minutes or until golden.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Makes 10 to 12 servings.

name: LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1  cauliflower
1  pkg. frozen peas (uncooked)
1  pkg. Italian seasoning mix
1  c. mayonnaise
Parmesan cheese
bacon crumbs (optional)
preparation: Layer in Tupperware bowl the lettuce, cauliflower and peas. Sprinkle Italian seasoning mix on top.  Cover with mayonnaise and seal around edges.  Sprinkle cheese and bacon crumbs on top. Cover and refrigerate.

name: LEMON WHIPPED CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  baked pie shell
1  can almonds, toasted (crumble nuts and line pie shell)
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  carton whipping cream, whipped
preparation: Fold whipped cream into lemon mixture.  Pour into pie shell and add some of the crumbled nuts on top for garnish.

name: CINNAMON STREUSEL COFFEECAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/3  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. Parkay margarine
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. Parkay margarine
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. milk
preparation: Combine nuts, brown sugar, 1/4 cup flour and cinnamon; cut in 1/4 cup margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.

name: HANKY PANKY
ingredients:
1  lb. hot sausage
1  lb. hamburger
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, chunked
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
2  loaves party rye bread
preparation: Brown meats and drain off fat.  Add  cheese and spices and stir until melted.  Toast bread with a little margarine on each piece.  Spread a small amount of meat mixture on each piece of toasted  bread and place in warm oven until ready to serve.  This is a great little appetizer and recipe freezes well.

name: OLD SOUTHERN CORN BREAD OR MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising corn meal
1  c. self-rising flour
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. bacon drippings
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Combine flour, corn meal and sugar.  Add one tablespoon bacon drippings, buttermilk and eggs.  Leave 2 tablespoons in pan.  Pour batter in pan and bake at 400° for about 35 to 40 minutes or until done.

name: ORIENTAL FRIED SQUIRREL
ingredients:
4  squirrels, dressed
1  c. soy sauce
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. powdered ginger
1/2  tsp. salt
flour
3  Tbsp. margarine
8  slices canned pineapple
preparation: Cut the squirrels into serving size pieces.  Marinate for 2 hours in soy sauce, garlic powder, paprika, ginger and salt. Drain and roll in flour.  Heat margarine in a skillet and fry the pieces until meat is brown.  Remove the meat and fry pineapple in the skillet.  Serve with the meat.

name: CHILI DIP
ingredients:
2  lb. block Star chili
2  lb. ground beef
2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  pt. whipping cream
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1/2  tsp. red cayenne pepper
preparation: Brown and drain ground beef.  Add Ro-Tel and heat on medium heat.  Mix in chili; heat.  Add cheese until melted.   Mix in cayenne pepper.  When heated and mixed thoroughly, add whipping cream and heat until blended.  Serve warm in a crock-pot.

name: DOG LIVER BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  lb. liver (any kind)
1/2  c. cornmeal
1  c. flour
1  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Cut liver into small pieces; grind in food processor.  Put into mixing bowl.  Add cornmeal, flour and garlic powder; mix well.  Grease a cookie sheet.  Spread the liver mixture on the sheet.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes, or until done.  Let cool; break into small pieces and put in container in the refrigerator.  Your dog will love you forever for making this treat!

name: SAUERKRAUT
ingredients:
1  1/2 lbs. bulk sausage
1 large  can sauerkraut
1 1/2  c. celery, cut in small pieces
1  1/2 cups onion, cut in small pieces
add water as needed
preparation: Boil together until well done. Next; add one stick of margarine and 1 bag of croutons. Add salt, pepper and poultry seasoning to taste. You need enough croutons to make it hold together. Roll into balls and bake until done.

name: AUNT C'S CLUSTERS
ingredients:
1  c. Karo syrup
1  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. creamy peanut butter
6  c. cornflakes
preparation: Bring syrup and sugar to a boil, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter, blend well.  Pour over cornflakes and mix to make sure all cornflakes are covered.  Drop by teaspoonfuls  onto waxed paper.  Leave until set.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
3  ripe bananas, mashed
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
4  Tbsp. buttermilk
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Dissolve soda in buttermilk.  Cream sugar and butter.  Add mashed bananas, eggs, buttermilk and sifted dry ingredients.  Add nuts.  Bake in greased loaf pan at 350° for 1 hour or until loaf tests done.  Yield:  1 loaf.

name: OREO COOKIE DESSERT
ingredients:
2  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
8  oz. Cool Whip
8  oz. Philadelphia cream cheese
1  lb. Oreo cookies, crushed
preparation: Prepare pudding as directed on package.  Add Cool Whip and cream cheese.  Fold in cookies.  Pour into 8 x 8-inch dish.   This can be frozen.

name: LILLIE'S BUTTERSCOTCH BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1/2  stick oleo
2  c. light brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Put butter and oleo on low heat to melt and then add remaining ingredients. Bake in 9 x 13 pan at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool brownies and spread with icing.

name: ICE CREAM CONE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box ice cream cones
1  cake mix (I used yellow)
1  can icing (I used chocolate)
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
preparation: Put dry cake mix in a bowl and add dry pudding.  Mix cake according to directions on box.  Put cones on a cookie sheet and fill 1/2 full of cake batter.  Bake at 350° until toothpick comes out clean when inserted into middle.  Frost and decorate as you like.

name: PEPPERY POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
2  cans (14.5 oz each) chicken broth
4  small baking potatoes, halved and sliced
1  large onion, quartered and sliced
1  rib celery with leaves, sliced
1/4  c. all purpose flour
3/4  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. half and half
1  Tbsp. butter
Celery leaves or fresh Parsley
preparation: Combine broth, potatoes, onion, celery, flour, pepper and salt in slow cooker; mix well.  Cook on low for 6 to 7 1/2 hours.  Stir in half and half; cover and continue to cook 1 hour.  Remove slow cooker lid.  Slightly crush potato mixture with potato masher. Continue to cook, uncovered, an additional 30 minutes until slightly thickened.  Just before serving, stir in butter.  Garnish with celery leaves, if desired.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  c. finely grated medium Cheddar cheese
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
dash of onion salt
dash of celery salt
dash of garlic salt
1/4  c. chopped ripe olives
chopped pecans
preparation: Combine all ingredients and then add olives.  Then chill until firm.  Scrape out of bowl.  Then roll in chopped pecans.  Serve with crackers of your choice.

name: SCRIPTURE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Psalms 55:21
3  c. Jeremiah 6:20
6  each Isaiah 10:14
3 1/2  c. 1 Kings 4:22
1  Tbsp. 1 Corinthians 5:6
1  little Leviticus 2:13
1  c. Genesis 24:17
1  Tbsp. 1 Samuel 14:25
2  c. 1 Samuel 30:12
1  c. Numbers 17:8
2  c. 1 Samuel 30:12
season to taste with 1 Kings 10:10
preparation: Mix and follow advice in Proverbs 23:14 for making a good boy. Put all in one pan.  Bake 3 hours in moderate oven.

name: CREAMED CABBAGE SOUP
ingredients:
2 (14 1/2 oz. each)  cans chicken broth
2  celery ribs, chopped
1  medium head cabbage, shredded (3 lb.)
1  medium onion, chopped
1  carrot, chopped
1/4  c. butter or margarine
3  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. light cream
1  c. milk
2  c. cubed fully cooked ham
1/2  tsp. dried thyme
chopped fresh parsley
preparation: In a large soup kettle or Dutch oven, combine broth, celery, cabbage, onion and carrot; bring to a boil.  Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

name: BOILED OATMEAL COCOA COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
1/2  stick butter
3  c. quick oats
2/3  c. cocoa
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. peanut butter
preparation: Stir sugar and cocoa together.  Add milk, vanilla and butter. Heat at medium until it reaches full boil.  Boil for 1 minute. Add oats and peanut butter.  Stir until thoroughly mixed.  Drop quickly by spoon on waxed paper or pan.  Let stand until cool.

name: SLOPPY JOES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  medium onions
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  c. water
4  Tbsp. vinegar
4  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. Worcestershire
dash of Tabasco
preparation: Cook hamburger, breaking it up as it cooks.  Drain off fat. Add other ingredients. Cook slowly, uncovered, to desired wetness. Serve on hamburger buns.  One pound makes 6 to 8 sandwiches on hamburger buns.

name: POTATOES ANNA
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
4  c. peeled and sliced potatoes
preparation: Melt butter and salt.  In a greased 9-inch pie plate, arrange potato slices, overlapping them.  Drizzle butter mixture on top. Cover plate tightly with foil.  Bake 25 minutes, covered; then bake 55 minutes, uncovered, or until potatoes are tender and crispy. Let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes before serving.

name: SOUR CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
6  eggs (add separately)
3  c. plain flour
1/4  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
1/2  tsp. almond flavoring
1  tsp. vanilla
1  (8 oz.) container sour cream
preparation: Mix all ingredients together, folding in sour cream.  Bake at 325° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

name: GRANDVIEW FRUIT COCKTAIL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  egg
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1 (17 oz.)  can fruit cocktail
1/2  c. chopped nuts (I prefer pecan chips)
3 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar; add egg.  Beat well.  Add cinnamon and the fruit cocktail (mixed together).  Mix in the nuts.  Add flour and other dry ingredients.  Put dough in the refrigerator and let set for 1 hour.  Grease a cookie sheet lightly and drop cookie dough by teaspoonful onto cookie sheet.  Bake at 400° about 12 minutes (or less) until lightly browned on bottom.

name: TOLL HOUSE PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  c. melted butter, cooled to room temperature
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Toll House semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell *
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Beat eggs.  Add flour, sugar and brown sugar;  beat  until  blended.  Blend in butter.  Mix in chocolate chips  and	walnuts.  Pour	into pie shell.  Bake 1 hour at 325°. Serve warm.

name: STRAWBERRY-RHUBARB PIE
ingredients:
2  (9-inch) unbaked pie crusts
1/3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sliced fresh strawberries
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
3  c. diced rhubarb
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Combine and mix well the sugar, flour, salt and vanilla.  Add rhubarb and strawberries; mix well and put into pie shell.  Dot with butter.  Add top crust and cut slits in crust.  Bake at 450° for 15 minutes, then reduce oven to 350° and bake for 30 to 40 minutes.  Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

name: ORIENTAL HOT DISH
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  stalk celery, chopped
2  onions, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 1/2  c. water
1/2  c. rice, uncooked
1/4  c. soy sauce
preparation: In 2 tablespoons oil, lightly brown hamburger, celery and onions.  Add rest of ingredients.  Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Remove cover and bake another 30 minutes longer.  Cover with chow mein noodles and serve.

name: WILD RICE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked wild rice
seasoned salt (optional)
2  c. diced cooked chicken
1 1/2  c. halved green grapes
1  c. water chestnuts or celery
3/4  c. light mayonnaise
1  c. cashews (optional)
lettuce
preparation: Cook rice according to package directions, omitting any salt if desired.  Drain well.  Cool to room temperature.  Put in large bowl.  Add chicken, grapes, chestnuts or celery and mayonnaise. Toss gently.  Cover and chill.  Just before serving, add nuts and serve on lettuce.  Yields 6 servings.

name: SPEEDY TACO BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  envelope taco seasoning mix
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can whole kernel corn, drained
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  c. Bisquick original or reduced fat baking mix
1  c. milk
2  eggs
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Cook beef and onions until brown.  Drain. Stir in taco seasoning mix (dry), tomato sauce and corn.  Spoon into ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle with cheese. Mix remaining ingredients until blended.  Pour over beef mixture. Bake 35 minutes or until light golden brown.  Serve with sour cream, chopped lettuce and tomato if desired.  Makes 8 to 10 servings.

name: HAMBURGER PIE
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
cooking fat or oil
1  onion, chopped
1 1/2  c. green beans
2  medium potatoes, diced
1 1/2  c. corn
salt and pepper to taste
1 (11 oz.)  can tomato soup
canned biscuits or mashed potatoes
preparation: Saute onion in oil.  Add beef and seasonings and brown.  Add beans, corn, potatoes and soup.  Mix well and spoon into casserole.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Top with canned biscuits or mashed potatoes last 15 minutes of baking.

name: ULTIMATE CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
parsley
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  Tbsp. seasoned salt
1  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  c. diced green pepper
1/4  c. diced green onion
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix softened cheese with ingredients.  Roll into a ball. Garnish with parsley or roll in chopped parsley.

name: TOPSY TURVEY APPLE PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1/4  c. softened butter or margarine
1/2  c. pecan halves
2/3  c. firmly packed brown sugar
6  c. sliced apples (about 2 1/2 lb.)
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. salt
pastry for 2-crust pie
preparation: Spread softened butter evenly on bottom and sides of 9-inch pie pan.  Press pecan halves, round sides down, in butter.  Pat brown sugar evenly over pecans.  Roll out enough pastry for 1 crust.  Place in pie pan over sugar.  Trim, leaving 1/2 inch overhang.

name: PORK TENDERLOINS
ingredients:
1  boneless pork roast, sliced thin
1 large  can whole tomatoes
3  cloves garlic
rosemary
thyme
1  red pepper, sliced
2  to 3 onions, sliced
olive oil
preparation: Saute thinly sliced pork in 3 tablespoons olive oil.  Remove. Saute onions and pepper.  Add spices.  Mix tomatoes in with the spices, onions and pepper.  Put pork in this sauce and simmer about 20 or so minutes.  Pour over fresh angel hair pasta. Delicious!!!!

name: CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1 1/2  c. white sugar
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
4  Tbsp. flour
4  Tbsp. meal
2  Tbsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix together and pour into unbaked pie crust.  Bake at 350°. Makes 2 deep dish pies.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. red food coloring
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. Crisco
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. sifted cake flour
1  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. baking soda
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix food coloring with cocoa; let set. Cream the Crisco, sugar and vanilla. Add eggs, one at a time. Beat hard. Add cocoa mixture and mix well. Alternate adding flour and salt with buttermilk. Add soda and beat. Add vinegar and beat hard. Bake in 2 (9-inch) layer pans at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.

name: PINEAPPLE SHEATH CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  large eggs
3/4  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. crushed pineapple and juice
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.   Combine by spoon all ingredients. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Bake for 25 to 40 minutes. Use cream cheese icing for topping.

name: CHOCOLATE PEANUT BUTTER BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. melted margarine
2  eggs
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 (15 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped pecans
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Stir until it holds together the cake mix, peanut butter, margarine and eggs.  Press 2/3 of batter into the bottom of an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: CALIFORNIA CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box Rice-A-Roni (chicken)
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. broccoli cuts
1  large chicken, cooked
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
3/4  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
3/4  c. milk
8  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese
seasoned bread crumbs
preparation: Prepare Rice-A-Roni as directed on box.  Thaw broccoli in boiling water.  Drain well.  Place rice in a 9 x 13-inch pan and layer broccoli over rice.   Cut chicken in cubes  and layer over the broccoli.  Mix together soup, mayonnaise, milk and cheese. Spread over casserole and sprinkle with seasoned bread crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.  You may substitute chicken broth in place of milk if you wish.  Do not salt the chicken when cooking.

name: SPIKE STEAK
ingredients:
