about 3 lb. sirloin steak (2-inches thick)
1  Tbsp. black peppercorns
2  cloves garlic, minced
4  c. coarse salt
3/4  c. water
preparation: Trim excess fat from steak.  Crack peppercorns coarsely and mince garlic.  Press peppercorns and garlic into both sides of steak and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour.  Make a thick paste of salt and water.  Cover top side of peppered steak with half mixture.  If cooking steak over coals, cover salt side with a wet cloth or paper towel and place salt side down on grill (cloth or paper holds the salt in place; will char as the steak cooks, but this does not affect the taste).  Cover top side with remaining salt mixture and another piece of wet cloth or paper towel.  If broiling, put salt side up, 3-inches from heat.  Put salt on other side of steak when it is turned.  Cook 15 minutes on each side for rare, 25 minutes for medium-rare.  Remove salt before eating.

name: EGGPLANT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large eggplant
1/2  onion, sliced
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. bread crumbs
2  slices bacon
1 1/2  c. tomatoes
dash of red pepper
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Pare eggplant and cut into small pieces. Cook in boiling water with salt until tender. Drain and mash.  Place bacon in skillet and cook until brown. Add onion; cook gently 15 minutes.  Add tomatoes and seasonings; cook another 15 minutes. Combine eggplant to tomato mixture. Add 1 cup bread crumbs and 1/2 the cheese. Place in greased casserole dish and sprinkle with remaining crumbs and cheese.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: ARIZONA CHILI CON CARNE Y FRIJOLES
ingredients:
1  lb. pinto beans
1  lb. stew beef
1  large onion
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes or 3 to 4 fresh tomatoes
3 to 4  cloves garlic
3  green chilies for a mild taste, 3 jalapenos for a medium taste and 3 Serranos or yellow chilies for a hot taste
1/4  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. salt (add to taste)
1/8  tsp. cilantro
1/4  tsp. cumin
just enough oil to brown beef
1/2  c. dry sherry
preparation: Sort the beans, looking carefully for any stones or dirt clods and removing them.  Soak the beans!  This is the first and most important rule for good beans.

name: FRESH APPLE PIE
ingredients:
2  sticks or 1 packet pie crust mix
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. Gold Medal flour
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
dash of salt
6  c. thinly sliced, pared tart apples (about 5 medium)
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Prepare pastry for 9-inch 2-crust pie as directed on package.  Stir together sugar, flour, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt.  Mix lightly with apples.  Pour into pastry lined pie pan.  Dot with butter.  Cover with top crust which has slits cut in it; seal and flute.  Cover edge with 2 to 3-inch strip of aluminum foil to prevent excessive browning; remove foil last 15 minutes of baking.  Bake 40 to 50 minutes, or until crust is brown and juice begins to bubble through slits in crust.  Serve warm.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  can baked beans
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. bacon
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. ketchup
1  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Cut bacon in bite size pieces; fry and drain.  Fry beef and drain.  Saute onion.  Add ketchup, mustard and sugar and stir together.  Add beans and heat.

name: MUSHROOM SPREAD
ingredients:
8  oz. fresh mushrooms
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. butter
3  oz. cream cheese
1/4  tsp. salt
2  sprigs parsley
1/2  tsp. basil
preparation: Saute mushrooms, chopped onion and butter in pan until liquid evaporates.  In food processor, finely chop the following: mushroom mixture, cream cheese, salt, parsley and basil. Refrigerate for 3 hours.

name: PINEAPPLE PARTY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can crushed pineapple
1  pkg. lemon gelatin
1  pkg. lime gelatin
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. nuts
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Drain syrup from pineapple; add enough water to syrup to make 2 cups.  Heat to boiling point; dissolve lemon and lime gelatin in boiling liquid.  Add salt.  Cool until slightly thickened.  When beginning to congeal, fold in cottage cheese, mayonnaise, crushed pineapple and nuts.  Pour into mold or Pyrex dish.  Place in refrigerator to chill and set.  Serve on lettuce leaf.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: CHAMPAGNE PUNCH
ingredients:
2  qt. champagne
23  oz. pineapple juice
1  qt. ginger ale
6  oz. frozen lemonade
preparation: Combine.  Float pineapple sherbet scoops to decorate.  Makes approximately 20 servings.

name: SAUSAGE CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  lb. grated cheese
2  c. Bisquick
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Shape into balls and bake on am ungreased baking sheet at 400 degrees for 10-12 minutes.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked squash
1  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1  small onion, chopped
1 (2 oz.)  jar pimiento, chopped
1  c. sour cream
salt and pepper to taste
bread crumbs
butter or margarine
preparation: In an 8 x 8-inch casserole dish, cover bottom with bread crumbs and butter.  Mix together soup, onion, pimiento, sour cream, salt and pepper and pour over top of bread crumbs.  Top with additional bread crumbs and butter.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: HUSBAND'S DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. garlic salt
pepper to taste
1  tsp. sugar
3 (15 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1/2  c. chopped onion
3  oz. pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sour cream
8  oz. wide egg noodles
1  can whole tomatoes, chopped
preparation: Brown beef and onion together.  Pour off fat and add all seasonings and tomato sauce.  Add chopped tomatoes.  Cook noodles according to the package.  Soften cream cheese and mix with the sour cream.  Then mix everything together.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch casserole.  Sprinkle grated cheese on top.  Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

name: POTATO PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  c. grated raw potatoes
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. grated onion
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Fry until browned in shortening.

name: RICE AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. rice
1  stick oleo
onions
Cheez Whiz (small jar)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  pkg. broccoli
preparation: Boil broccoli; cook rice and put in casserole.  Saute onions in oleo and pour on rice; put Cheez Whiz on top.  Pour cream of mushroom soup on top and bake in medium oven, 350°.

name: BAKED CORN
ingredients:
1  can corn
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
butter
preparation: Mix cornbread crumbs, salt and sugar.  Beat eggs until very light.  Stir in milk and add to corn mixture.  Turn into well-buttered baking dish.  Dot with bits of butter and bake 40 minutes at 350°.

name: ARMADILLO EGGS
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  c. Bisquick
25  jalapeno peppers
1/2  lb. Monterey Jack cheese
2  eggs, beaten
1  pkg. Shake 'n Bake (pork), mixed with bread crumbs
preparation: Clean jalapeno peppers; remove seeds and drain.  Mix sausage, Cheddar cheese and Bisquick.  Stuff peppers with small sliver of Monterey Jack cheese; wrap with sausage mix.  Dip in beaten eggs; roll in Shake 'n Bake mixture.  Bake at 300° for 30 to 35 minutes. Can be frozen and used later, also.  Yields 25 peppers. Delicious.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. spaghetti
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Italian dressing
2  boiled eggs, mashed
1  bunch green onions
1  cucumber
1  bell pepper
pepper to taste
1  bottle Salad Supreme
preparation: Cook spaghetti and drain. Chop green onions, cucumber and bell pepper. Mix all ingredients together. Let set overnight in the refrigerator.

name: LARRUPIN POTATOES
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  pkg. frozen hash browns
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  c. shredded cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/4  c. melted butter
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Place in a 9 x 10-inch pan. Sprinkle with extra cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CRAB CHANTILLY
ingredients:
1  lb. imitation crab
4  chopped green onions
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
2  c. milk
1/4  c. Ranch dressing
1  lb. fresh asparagus or canned
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. catsup
preparation: Cook green onions in butter until tender.  Stir in flour and cayenne pepper.  Add milk.  Stir until thickened.  Remove from heat.  Stir in Ranch dressing, catsup and crab.   Heat, but do not cook.  Spoon warm crab over cooked asparagus.  Sprinkle with Parmesan.  Broil 3 to 4 minutes (until lightly browned).  Serve over toast.  (An attractive and easy dish for company.)

name: FUDGE MARSHMALLOW CANDY
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. peanut butter
4  c. mini marshmallows
preparation: Microwave chocolate chips with peanut butter on Medium for 2 to 3 minutes.  Stir after every minute.  Add marshmallows.  Chill until firm.

name: CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, boiled and chopped
1  can Veg-All, drained
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  cans chicken broth
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. milk
1/2  stick melted oleo
preparation: Arrange a layer of chicken and a layer Veg-All.  Pour broth over this.  Mix flour, milk and oleo together.  Pour this mixture over top of chicken and Veg-All.  Bake in oven at 400° for about 30 minutes or until brown.

name: SUNKEN TREASURE(Mexican Nacho Chip Dip)
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  can Frito bean dip
1/2  c. chopped onion
10 to 20  drops Tabasco sauce
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1/2  lb. Cheddar
1/2  lb. Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Pour into dish (large 8 x 8-inch glass).  Grate and sprinkle cheeses on top of mixture.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.  Use as a dip with nacho chips.

name: PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
2  c. macaroni, cooked
3  green peppers, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  jar mushrooms
1  bag sliced pepperoni
1  lb. Mozzarella cheese
1 large  jar spaghetti sauce or homemade sauce
preparation: Brown the hamburger.  Pour some sauce in bottom of baking dish.  Add a layer of macaroni (about 1/2), green peppers, pepperoni, mushrooms, cheese and more sauce.  Continue layers until all ingredients are used.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CORN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. whole kernel corn, drained
2  medium tomatoes, cubed
bunch green onions (tops only), chopped small
salt and pepper
1/4  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix vegetables together.  Add about 1/4 cup mayonnaise.  Too much will make salad soupy.  Season to taste with salt and pepper. Refrigerate overnight.

name: BUTTERFINGER ICE CREAM DESSERT
ingredients:
1  box ice cream sandwiches
1  jar chocolate fudge ice cream topping
12  oz. Cool Whip
4  Butterfinger candy bars, crushed
preparation: In a square or rectangular pan, place a layer of  ice cream sandwiches until they cover entire bottom of pan (you may have to cut a few to make them fit).  Cover sandwiches with chocolate fudge, then layer in Cool Whip.  Finally, sprinkle Butterfinger crumbs over top.  Freeze until ready to serve.

name: CRAB AND SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1  (6 1/2 oz.) crab meat
1/2  lb. frozen shrimp
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
1/2  tsp. grated onion
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
dash of Tabasco sauce
almonds (optional)
preparation: Drain crab meat.  Mix all ingredients and heat in chafing dish.  Serve on crackers.  Yields 4 cups.

name: APPLE DESSERT
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. flour
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
lump of shortening
sugar
cinnamon
apples
preparation: Place sliced apples in an 8 x 8-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon to taste.  Mix first 5 ingredients together and place on top of apples.  Bake at 350° until browned, about 20 to 30 minutes.

name: LOW CALORIE APPLE CIDER SALAD
ingredients:
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
2  c. unsweetened apple cider, divided
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. lemon juice
2  medium apples, finely chopped (unpeeled)
1/2  c. finely chopped celery
vegetable cooking spray
lettuce leaves
preparation: Combine gelatin and 1/2 cup apple cider in a small, heavy saucepan; cook over low heat, stirring constantly until gelatin dissolves.  Stir in remaining apple cider and lemon juice.  Chill until the consistency of unbeaten egg white.  Fold in apple and celery.

name: OREO ICE CREAM DESSERT
ingredients:
1/2  gal. ice cream or ice milk
3/4 small  pkg. Oreos, crushed
1  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Soften ice cream.  Stir in Cool Whip and crushed Oreo cookies. Pour into bowl and freeze.

name: CREAMY CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/3  c. flour
3  c. chicken broth
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. light cream
1  c. finely chopped cooked chicken
dash of pepper
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan; blend in flour.  Stir in broth, milk and cream.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened and boiling.  Add chicken and pepper; return to a boil. Serve immediately.  Yield:  4 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE FILLED CUPCAKES
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1/3  c. sugar
1  egg
dash of salt
12  oz. chocolate chips
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
2  tsp. baking soda
2/3  c. oil
3  c. flour
2  Tbsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  c. water
preparation: Cream the first 5 ingredients and add chocolate chips. Mix remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Batter will be thin.  Fill cupcakes 1/2 full.  Fill with a teaspoon of cream cheese mixture. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

name: PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
5 1/2  c. pineapple juice
2  boxes lemon pie filling (not instant)
preparation: Mix white cake mix according to package directions.  Blend together the lemon pie filling and pineapple juice.  Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans.  Pour the cake batter in and then pour the pie filling and juice mixture over the batter.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Cut into squares and serve with whipped cream.

name: FIVE CUP SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. mandarin orange, drained
1  c. crushed pineapple
1  c. flaked coconut
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix all together and refrigerate.

name: RUMAKI (POLYNESIAN APPETIZER)
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  can (8 oz.) water chestnuts, halved
1/3  lb. chicken livers, halved
8  bacon slices, halved
preparation: Cook chicken livers in butter and soy sauce.  Wrap chestnut half and piece of chicken liver with 1/2 slice of bacon.  Secure with food pick.  Marinate 1 hour in soy sauce.  Broil until bacon is crisp (about 15 minutes).  Turn once.

name: MAPLE PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. Karo pancake and waffle syrup
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. salt
1  c. pecan halves
1  (9-inch) unbaked pastry shell
preparation: In medium bowl, beat eggs slightly.  Beat in next 5 ingredients.  Stir in pecans.  Pour into pastry shell.  Bake in a 350° oven for 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.  Cool.  Serves 8.

name: FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/3  c. milk
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
8  slices white bread
preparation: Beat eggs, milk, sugar, salt and cinnamon well.  Dip 8 slices of bread, one at a time, into mixture and cook in hot skillet with butter.  Brown lightly on both sides.  Serve with syrup.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CRACKLE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  sleeve saltine crackers
1  bag chocolate chips
preparation: Put butter in a nonstick saucepan to liquefy on low/medium heat.  Add brown sugar and constantly stir until it thickens and caramelizes.  Bring to a boil, then let it sit for 5 minutes NOT stirring.  Line cookie sheet with aluminum foil.  Next, line with saltine crackers.  Pour mixture over crackers and bake at 400° until mixture bubbles.  Spread mixture evenly over crackers. Sprinkle chocolate chips on top.  Put cookie sheet back in the oven until chocolate melts, then remove and smooth chips out.  Put in the refrigerator until mixture hardens and cools.  Break it out of the pan and store in container that is NOT airtight.

name: GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
1 1/4  c. dark brown sugar
2  eggs
1  c. sour milk
preparation: Stir flour, soda, spices and salt together.  Cream shortening and sugar thoroughly.  Add eggs, beating until light.  Alternately add flour mixture and sour milk.  Beat well after each addition. Pour batter into greased 8-inch square pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
2  tsp. lemon juice
1 or 2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
8  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
1  or 2 dashes garlic powder
preparation: Mix all together.  Roll into a ball, then roll in chopped pecans.  Serve with any kind of cracker.

name: MULLIGATAWNY SOUP
ingredients:
3  c. chicken broth
1 small  can crushed tomatoes
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped apple
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. diced carrots
1  Tbsp. parsley
1  tsp. curry
1  tsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  c. cooked chicken pieces
1  c. cooked rice
salt and pepper
fresh basil
mushrooms (optional)
preparation: Simmer all ingredients but the chicken and rice which are added when the vegetables are done.

name: ICEBOX PIE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
1/2  c. 10x sugar
2  eggs
1 large  can pineapple, drained
1  c. nuts
2  pkg. vanilla wafers
preparation: Mix together all ingredients, except vanilla wafers.  Line pan bottom and sides with vanilla wafers.  Place mixture in pan and top with more vanilla wafers.  Add Cool Whip and set in refrigerator about 2 hours.

name: FROZEN BANANA POPS
ingredients:
3  large bananas
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. ground walnuts
1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1/4  c. creamy peanut butter
preparation: Peel bananas; cut in half crosswise.  Insert a wooden stick into each banana half; place on waxed paper.  Cover; freeze 2 hours.  Combine chocolate morsels, evaporated milk and peanut butter in a small saucepan.  Cook, stirring occasionally until chocolate morsels are melted and sauce is smooth.  Dip frozen bananas into sauce; roll in nuts.  Serve immediately or freeze for later.

name: DATE AND NUT TIFFIN LOAF
ingredients:
3/4  c. sifted flour
1/8  tsp. salt
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  lb. pitted dates, cut in thirds (1 1/3 c.)
1/2  lb. English walnuts or pecans, coarsely chopped (2 c.)
2  eggs, separated
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift dry ingredients.  Add dates and nuts.  Mix with fingers until well coated.  Add beaten egg yolks and vanilla and blend with fingers.  Mix in stiffly beaten egg whites.  Brush loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch) with butter; flour lightly and add batter, smoothing it with your hands.  Cover top of pan with foil, folding around the edge of pan.   Bake at 275° for 1 3/4 hours.  Remove foil and increase heat to 325°.  Let remain in oven 10 to 15 minutes longer or until top becomes faintly brown.  Remove from oven and let set 5 minutes.  Loosen with dull knife.  Turn upside down on cake rack.  When cool, wrap and store or freeze.  Slice thinly.

name: ICE CREAM SUNDAE
ingredients:
3  to 4 scoops ice cream
2  Tbsp. caramel or chocolate syrup
1  tsp. chopped nuts
1  cherry
whipped cream
preparation: Place ice cream in a small bowl.  Drizzle caramel or chocolate syrup over ice cream and add whipped cream and nuts.  Top off with the cherry.

name: OVEN BARBECUE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. packed brown sugar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. Louisiana style hot sauce (optional)
2  lb. chicken parts (skinned, if desired)
preparation: Combine soup, oil, vinegar, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder and hot sauce.  In a 3-quart oblong baking dish or pan, arrange chicken; cover with foil.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.  Pour or spoon off fat.  Pour soup mixture over chicken; return to oven for 30 more minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.  Stir sauce, then serve.  Makes 4 servings.

name: STRAWBERRY MERINGUE ROLL
ingredients:
3/4  c cake flour
salt
1  tsp baking powder
4  eggs, separated, plus 1 egg white (may substitute Cool Whip for remaining egg white)
1  1/4 c plus 2 Tbsp sugar
1/2  tsp vanilla
1  c whipping cream
1  qt strawberries
preparation: Sift flour, 1/4 tsp salt and baking powder together.  Beat 4 egg whites stiff in large mixing bowl.  Add 1/2 c sugar, gradually. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored in small bowl.  Add 1/4 c sugar and vanilla gradually.  Fold egg yolk mixture into egg whites; fold in sifted ingredients.  Place on waxed paper lined 15x10-inch pan.  Bake 12 minutes at 375 degrees.  Turn onto towel dusted with confectioners sugar.  Roll quickly as for jelly roll. Cool on rack.  Whip cream; fold in 2 Tbsp sugar and 1 c sliced strawberries.  Unroll meringue; frost with whipped cream mixture. Roll and chill.  Beat remaining egg white until stiff (or use Cool whip); add remaining sugar, 1/8 tsp salt and 3/4 c sliced strawberries.  Beat until stiff, at least 5 minutes.  Frost roll; decorate with whole strawberries immediately after frosting.

name: ZUCCHINI CRABMEAT QUICHE
ingredients:
1  pkg. crescent dinner rolls
3  medium zucchini, sliced
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 medium  jar sliced mushrooms
1  c. cubed Monterey Jack cheese
3  Tbsp. butter
1/2  clove garlic, crushed
1/4  tsp. dill weed
2  eggs
1  can crabmeat
fresh parsley (garnish)
preparation: Form rolls into crust.  Saute zucchini and mushrooms in butter.  Add crabmeat, drained and washed.  Beat eggs adding garlic, salt, dill weed and pepper.  Pour over zucchini mixture in pie shell.  Top with cheese.  Bake at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes. Garnish with parsley.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: MAPLE NUT PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1  c. maple syrup (Log Cabin)
1  envelope Knox gelatine
1  c. chopped pecans
1 1/2  c. whipping cream
1/2  lb. vanilla wafers, crushed
preparation: Scald milk.  Dissolve gelatine in 1/2 cup hot water.  Add to scalded milk, then add syrup and mix well.  Place in refrigerator to cool.  When cooled so that it is thick enough to roll from a spoon, add whip cream and pecans.  In the meantime crush vanilla wafers.  Place half the crumbs in an oblong dish.  Put the pudding over this.  Add the rest of crumbs over the pudding.  Refrigerate until firm set, better if left overnight.

name: ORIENTAL CARROT SOUFFLE
ingredients:
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas
pinch of marjoram
salt
butter
1 1/2  c. carrots (about 2 lb.), cooked and pureed
1  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. flour
6  egg yolks
mushroom caps for garnish
lemon juice
1  handful Mung bean sprouts
parsley flakes
pepper
soy sauce to taste
pinch of cloves
2  Tbsp. honey
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. cream
8  egg whites, stiffly beaten
butter
preparation: Saute  peas  and bean sprouts slightly, just to soften. Season with marjoram, parsley flakes, salt, pepper, butter and soy sauce. Set  aside.  Season carrots with cloves, honey and salt.  Butter a  souffle  dish  or Bundt pan.  Melt remaining butter, add  flour and  cook  1  minutes.  Add cream and cook until  thick, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Add egg yolks and  carrots.  Cool. Fold  in egg whites.  Bake at 350° for 35  minutes.  Unmold  on platter.  Place  peas  and  bean sprout mixture  in  center and surround with a row of mushroom caps that have been lightly sauteed in butter and lemon juice. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

name: CHUCK CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. fine noodles
2  c. onions, chopped
2  lb. ground chuck
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
1  can water chestnuts, sliced
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. soy sauce
salt and pepper to taste
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  lb. grated cheese
1  can Chinese noodles
preparation: Cook and drain noodles.  Brown chuck and onions in pan. Combine mushrooms, soup, milk and sauces.  Add to meat, add chestnuts and mix.  Butter 3-quart casserole dish.  Spread noodles and cover with meat mixture.  Top with cheese.  Cook at 350° until cheese bubbles.  Remove from oven and top with Chinese noodles. Return to oven for 10 minutes.

name: CRACKER JACKS
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
2  sticks butter
1  c. Karo
1  c. raw peanuts, shelled
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
2  gal. popped corn
preparation: Boil first 4 ingredients for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat. Add soda and vanilla.  Stir.  Place corn onto cookie sheet.  Pour mixture over corn.  Bake at 250° for 1 hour.  Cool on wax paper. Break into pieces.  Will keep 2 weeks in airtight container.

name: TWO FLAVOR BAR COOKIES
ingredients:
3 2/3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
3  eggs
3/4  c. all fruit apricot jam
3  oz. unsweetened chocolate
1 2/3  c. sugar
3/4  lb. butter
1/2  tsp. almond extract
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1/3  c. coconut, flaked
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Line two 9-inch square pans with aluminum foil.  Combine 3 cups flour, 2/3 cup of the sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of the salt in a food processor and whir until well mixed.  Cut 1/2 pound of the butter into small pieces and add to the flour mixture. Pulse until mixture resembles coarse meal.  With a fork, beat 1 of the eggs with 1 tablespoon water and the almond extract.  With the motor running, pour egg mixture into food processor and whir just until large crumbs start to form.  Remove 1 cup of the crumbs and set aside.  Pulse remaining mixture until it forms a ball.  Divide dough in half and press half into the bottom of each prepared pan. Bake 1 pan until top starts to look dry, about 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and cool.  Spread jam over dough in the other pan, leaving a 1/8-inch edge.  Sprinkle reserved crumbs on top.  Bake until golden brown, 40 to 50 minutes.

name: NANCY'S BEANS
ingredients:
2 or 3  cans French green beans, drained
1  stick margarine
1  large onion
1/2  lb. hoop cheese
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: Chop onion fine and saute in butter.  Cook beans.  Add onion to beans, cheese and undiluted mushroom soup.  Top with Ritz crackers that have been crushed in melted butter.   Bake at 350° until heated throughout.

name: CORN BREAD
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. bacon drippings
1 1/2  c. yellow cornmeal
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  c. fresh buttermilk
1  egg
preparation: Melt bacon drippings in a 9-inch iron skillet until very hot. During this time, sift dry ingredients into bowl.  Add buttermilk and egg; beat until batter is smooth.  Add 1/2 of drippings to batter and stir well.  Pour batter into skillet and bake at 450° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. Bisquick
10  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
1  lb. sausage (hot or mild)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix ingredients and roll into small balls.  Place on a cookie sheet sprayed with Pam.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Ingredients mix together better if they are at room temperature.

name: PECAN CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. butter (1/2 margarine, 1/2 butter)
1  lb. brown sugar
1/2  lb. cherries
1  lb. shelled pecans
1/2  lb. pineapple
4  c. plain flour, sifted
6  eggs, separated
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/4  oz. or 2 1/2 Tbsp. pure lemon extract
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add egg yolks, one at a time.  Beat well after each.  Add 2 cups of flour with baking powder.  Add all extract.  Use 2 cups of flour to dredge fruit and nuts.  Fold into creamed mixture.  Beat egg whites stiff and fold into batter.  Let stand overnight.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  chicken
8  oz. can mushrooms
1/3  lb. spaghetti
1/2  onion
1/2  Tbsp. butter
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/3  lb. Cheddar cheese
1  c. milk
1  clove garlic
preparation: Cook chicken. Cook spaghetti.  Saute onion, garlic and mushrooms in butter 5 minutes.  Mix everything except the spaghetti and 1/4 of the cheese. Add spaghetti and top with remaining cheese.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: SWEET-SOUR TURKEY
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can pineapple chunks
1/3  c. vinegar
1/4  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
2 1/2  c. diced cooked turkey
3/4  c. green pepper strips
1/4  c. sliced onion
preparation: Drain pineapple, saving 1 cup juice.  Combine juice, vinegar, brown sugar, cornstarch, soy sauce and salt.  Cook over low heat until thickened and clear stirring constantly.  Remove from heat; add turkey.  Let stand for 10 minutes.  Place green peppers in enough boiling water to cover; let stand for 5 minutes.  Drain well.  Add green peppers, onion and pineapple to turkey mixture; heat through.  Serve over rice.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES NO. 1
ingredients:
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. honey
1/4  c. granulated sugar
3/4  c. peanut butter
2  c. Cocoa Puffs
preparation: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil.  Add peanut butter; mix. Add Cocoa Puffs.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.  Cool and store in airtight container.

name: SPINACH DIP IN A FLASH
ingredients:
1 10  oz. box chopped spinach defrost and squeeze dry
1 8  oz. pkg. muenster cheese grated
1/4  c. grated parmesan cheese
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1 8  oz. pkg. cream cheese softened
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl; transfer to a greased pie plate and bake at 305° for 20 minutes.	Serve hot with fresh bread.

name: PEPPERONI TWIST
ingredients:
1  box sliced pepperoni (1/2 pkg.)
1  lb. hamburger
1 (8 oz.)  box twist macaroni
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  jar pizza sauce
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger and pepperoni.  Mix hamburger, pepperoni and both sauces together.  Simmer 30 minutes.  In meantime, cook macaroni as directed on package.  Pour macaroni in baking dish and pour sauce mixture over it and mix (do not stir, just pull macaroni to the sides and let the sauce fall down).  Put Mozzarella cheese on top and bake at 350° or until cheese melts.

name: TURKEY BAKE
ingredients:
1  layer turkey stuffing
1  layer cubed, cooked turkey
1  layer turkey gravy
1  layer precooked frozen peas and carrots
1  layer mashed potatoes
preparation: Layer in 11 x 13-inch buttered pan in the order given.  Dot with butter.  Bake in preheated 350° oven for about 1 hour. Serves 12.

name: OREO COOKIE DESSERT
ingredients:
1  lb pkg Oreo cookies
1/3  c margarine
8  oz Cool Whip
1  c powdered sugar
8  oz cream cheese, softened
4  oz pkg instant chocolate pudding
1  3/4 c milk
preparation: Crush Oreo cookies, reserve 1/2 c for topping.  Mix remaining crumbs with melted margarine and press into the bottom of a 9 x 13 pan.  Refrigerate for 1 hour.  Mix powdered sugar and cream cheese, then fold in half of cool whip.  Spread over cookie crust.  Make pudding with 1 3/4 cups milk and pour over cream cheese layer.  Top with remaining cool whip and sprinkle with reserved cookie crumbs, and refrigerate 1 more hour before serving.  Serves 24.

name: FRIED RICE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. chopped peppers
1 1/4  c. chopped onions
1  c. chopped carrots
1  stick chopped celery
2  c. uncooked rice
preparation: Rinse rice once.  Bring the rice and 2 cups water to boil. Stir and cover with lid.  Turn off heat; let set.  Brown ground beef.  Add onion; stir until tender.  Add carrots, celery and peppers.  Stir-fry until vegetables begin to be tender.  Do not overcook.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Add rice.  Sprinkle with soy sauce and Accent; stir until well blended.  Serve hot.

name: TEXAS PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. (1 stick) margarine
1  c. flour
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. powdered sugar
1  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese
4  c. whipped topping, divided
1  pkg. (3 oz.) instant chocolate pudding
1  pkg. (3 oz.) instant vanilla pudding
3 1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
Hershey bar
preparation: Melt margarine and combine with flour and pecans.  Press into 9 x 13 pan; bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes.  Cool completely.  Combine powdered sugar and cream cheese; fold in 2 cups whipped topping. Spread over cooled crust.  Let cool in refrigerator for 10 minutes. Mix chocolate and vanilla puddings with milk; add vanilla.  Pour over cooled cream layer; let cool in refrigerator for 10 minutes. Spread 2 cups whipped topping over all.  Top with 1/2 shaved Hershey bar.  Let cool at least 30 minutes in refrigerator before serving.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD 2
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten slightly
3  Tbsp. sour milk *
1  tsp. baking soda
3  large bananas, mashed with fork
2  c. flour
1/2  c. walnuts
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Add sour milk and baking soda.  Add bananas.  Add flour, one cup at a time. Add nuts.  Grease loaf pans.  This may all be hand-mixed in one bowl.  Bake in one large loaf pan or two small ones at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until done.  May be frozen.  Keeps well. Delicious sliced thin and spread with butter.

name: MACARONI AND TOMATO JUICE
ingredients:
macaroni
tomato juice
salt and pepper
preparation: Heat water to boiling.  Add macaroni and cook until tender; drain.  Add tomato juice to macaroni; heat.  Add salt and pepper to taste.

name: RENEE'S PASTRY WRAPPED GOUDA
ingredients:
1  (7 oz.) round Gouda cheese
1 (8 oz.)  can Pillsbury crescent dinner rolls
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard (optional)
1  egg (optional)
preparation: Cut cheese in half to form two circles.  Divide can of rolls in half.  Set one half aside.  Lay the 2 rectangles next to each other on a baking sheet.  Pinch perforations to seal.  Place 1/2 cheese in center.  Spread with 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard.  Fold in corners and pinch edges shut.  Brush with beaten egg.  Repeat with other half of dough.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Serves 8.

name: MUSHROOM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box elbow macaroni
2 large  jars mushrooms
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
1  c. chopped onion
1 large  jar pimento
preparation: Cook macaroni as directed.  Drain.  Add next 6 ingredients. Mix well.  Cover with cracker crumbs and drizzle with butter. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: MEATBALLS SUPREME
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  c. bread crumbs
3  eggs
1  pkg. onion soup mix
1  bottle chili sauce
1  can whole cranberry sauce
1  can sauerkraut, drained
1  c. brown sugar
preparation: Meatballs:  Mix ground beef, bread crumbs, slightly beaten eggs and onion mix; stir completely together, then form meatballs.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH DELIGHTS
ingredients:
12  oz. butterscotch pieces
1/2  c. peanut butter
2  c. corn flakes
1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Combine butterscotch pieces and peanut butter in double boiler.  Cook and stir over hot water until mixture is smooth and melted.  Remove from heat and stir in corn flakes and coconut. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper.  Chill until set.

name: HOT DOG SAUCE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. thyme
1  Tbsp. cumin
2  Tbsp. chili powder
garlic salt
red pepper
preparation: Brown hamburger.  Add salt, thyme, cumin and chili powder and sprinkle with garlic salt.  Add red pepper to taste.  Cover with water and simmer for one hour.  Add red food coloring to add color if desired.

name: SPINACH BALL
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen (10 oz.) spinach, cooked and drained very well
2  c. Pepperidge Farm stuffing
2  medium onions, chopped
6  beaten eggs
3/4  c. melted butter
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. crumbled Feta cheese
1  Tbsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. thyme (optional)
preparation: Empty carton  of  plain  yogurt  into  cheesecloth  and suspend over  a large bowl in the refrigerator overnight.  The next day, you can  use  plain  or  added soup mix for a dip or lemon juice and honey for a salad dressing or only honey for a spread on toast.

name: CARROT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. herb flavored stuffing mix
3  Tbsp. margarine
3  c. cooked carrots, sliced
1  onion
1  can cream of celery soup
4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/3  c. melted butter
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Prepare stuffing as directed on package. Set aside.

name: MELTED BRIE
ingredients:
1  round/oval loaf French bread
1/3  c. olive oil or melted butter
2  cloves garlic, minced or pressed
1 to 1 1/2  lb. Brie cheese
preparation: With serrated knife, cut hollow into bread 1/2-inch away from sides and bottom; remove from loaf.  Cut piece which has been removed from loaf into strips, 1 to 1 1/2-inch wide strips.  Mix oil and garlic.  Brush inside of shell and bread slices.  Place cut up cheese in bread shell.  Place filled shell and slices in a single layer on a 10 x 15-inch pan.  Bake for 10 minutes at 350°. Remove bread slices.  Cook filled shell 10 minutes more and serve with grapes.  Serves 10 to 12 people.

name: POOR MAN'S COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. Bisquick
1  c. sugar
1  stick butter, melted
3/4  c. milk
1  can fruit (your choice)
preparation: Pour butter in 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.  Mix together Bisquick, sugar and milk.  Pour batter over melted butter.  Pour fruit over batter and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: GOOD PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. plain flour or half plain and half whole wheat
2/3  tsp. salt
1 1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  egg
2/3  c. milk
2  Tbsp. oil
fruit (if desired)
preparation: Mix  dry  ingredients.  Add  egg,  milk  and  oil.  Add blueberries, chopped peaches, strawberries, etc.  Pour on very lightly  oiled  griddle  set  at 375°.  Turn once when pocking begins to occur.  Serve hot with butter and favorite syrup.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli or 2 bunches fresh broccoli
3  whole cooked, skinned and boned chicken breasts
1  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1/2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. soft bread crumbs, buttered
preparation: Cook broccoli until tender; drain.  Arrange stalks in greased baking dish.  Place chicken on top.  Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder.  Pour this mixture over chicken and broccoli.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Then sprinkle bread crumbs over this.  Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: PEACH PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  small (not instant) vanilla pudding
1  egg
3  Tbsp. milk
1 large  can peaches
1/2  c. sugar
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
cinnamon
preparation: Beat first 5 ingredients for 2 minutes.  Pour into 9-inch greased pie pan.  Drain peaches and arrange over mixed ingredients in pie pan.  Mix sugar, cream cheese and 3 tablespoons peach juice (or more - make it so it can pour over peaches - not too thin). Pour over peaches.  Mix 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon.  Sprinkle on cream cheese.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: CAMPING CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  head cabbage
1  Tbsp. oil
preparation: You will need tinfoil.

name: MARTHA WASHINGTON BALLS
ingredients:
3  lb. confectioners sugar
1  lb. butter
10 to 12  oz. peanut butter
3  Tbsp. vanilla
1  lb. semi-sweet chocolate
1/2  cake paraffin wax
preparation: Melt chocolate and wax in double boiler. Dip balls in chocolate, using toothpicks and let dry. Freezes well.

name: QUICHE MUFFINS
ingredients:
16  oz. cottage cheese
3  egg whites, beaten until foamy
5  eggs
1/4  c. buttermilk
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
2  green onions
10  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Fill large, greased muffin tins 2/3 full.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.  This recipe makes about 10 of the large muffins or 15 cupcake size.  On the large size muffins, cooking time was about 25 minutes.

name: ANISE COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
dash of salt
1 1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
2  egg yolks
2  tsp. anise extract
preparation: Sift flour, baking powder and salt together.  Cream butter. Add sugar gradually and blend well.  Stir in unbeaten egg yolks and anise extract until batter is smooth.  Add flour mixture.  Nip off little pieces of dough and roll into balls size of a cherry. Place on an ungreased baking sheet.  Bake at 425° for 7 to 8 minutes.  Cool before removing from cookie sheet.

name: JIFFY JERKY
ingredients:
flank steak or top round steak
6  oz. teriyaki sauce and marinade (cover meat)
1 1/2  tsp. red pepper flakes
1  tsp. cayenne pepper
preparation: You will also need a Brinkmann meat smoker.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2  lb. navy pea beans
1/4  lb. salt pork, cut up small
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  c. sugar (brown or granulated)
1/2  c. molasses
1  large onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Rinse and sort beans.  Soak overnight.  Drain and put in large pot with water to cover.  Add chopped onion and salt pork.  Boil until tender, adding water as needed.   When cooked, but not mushy, place in greased casserole.  Add remaining ingredients and bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

name: CHOWNING'S TAVERN BRUNSWICK STEW
ingredients:
1 (6 lb.) stewing hen or 2 (3  lb. each) fryers
2  large onions, sliced
2  c. cut okra
4  c. fresh or 2 (1 lb. each) cans tomatoes
3  medium potatoes, diced
4  c. or 2 (1 lb. each) cans corn
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Cut chicken in pieces and simmer in 2 or 3 quarts water for 2 1/4 hours.  Remove chicken; add vegetables to broth and simmer, uncovered, until beans and potatoes are tender.   Stir to prevent scorching.  Add chicken (boned and diced) and seasonings. Brunswick Stew is better if made a day ahead and allowed to stand in refrigerator overnight in order for flavors to blend.  Serve with a salad and chunks of bread and butter.

name: CHOCOLATE FROSTEE
ingredients:
2  qt. Mayfield chocolate milk
1  (8 oz.) bowl whipped topping
1  can condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour in ice cream can and freeze until hard.  (Yummy good.)

name: CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1  chicken, cooked and removed from bone (discard skin)
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
2  boiled eggs
2  c. chicken broth (use broth from cooked chicken)
1/4  tsp. poultry seasoning
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. buttermilk
1  stick butter
preparation: Cover 11 x 14 casserole dish with cooked chicken. Cut up egg and cover chicken. Combine in bowl, cream of celery soup, cream of chicken soup, chicken broth and poultry seasoning. Mix well and pour over egg and chicken. Melt butter and combine with flour and buttermilk. Stir well and pour on top of casserole. Bake 1 hour at 400°.

name: QUICK CHICKEN CATCH-A-TORY
ingredients:
1  fryer, cut up (or whole)
1  box spaghetti
1  jar spaghetti sauce
Parmesan cheese
salt to taste
preparation: Lightly salt chicken and bake in 350° oven until done, 45 minutes to an hour.  Cool enough to remove meat from the bones.

name: COCONUT PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
2  Tbsp. unsweetened grated coconuts
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
1 to 2  Tbsp. cold water
vegetable cooking spray
preparation: Combine first three ingredients in a medium bowl.  Stir well. Sprinkle cold water, one tablespoon at a time, evenly over surface of mixture.  Stir with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened.

name: CHICKEN AND SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
3  chicken breasts
1/2  onion, chopped
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
8 to 12  oz. spaghetti
1/2  stick oleo
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
salt and pepper
preparation: Boil chicken and all ingredients, except Velveeta and spaghetti, until chicken is done.  Remove chicken, cool and debone.  Add spaghetti to broth; cook until tender.  Add Velveeta and deboned chicken.

name: EASY PIGS
ingredients:
4  c. shredded cabbage
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. rice
1  can tomato soup
1  c. water
1 large  can tomato sauce
preparation: Brown beef with onion, then add rice to tomato soup and tomato sauce.  Mix well and add to beef.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Pour over raw cabbage in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix well to cover cabbage.  Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: GREEN BEAN AND MUSHROOM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. French-cut green beans (frozen)
1  pkg. frozen spinach
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  can Durkee French fried onions
preparation: Cook green beans and spinach according to package directions. Mix in casserole dish with other ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: JOLLY RICE(African Dish)
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  lb. chicken, cut into serving portions
1  large onion, chopped
4  tomatoes, chopped
3 1/2  c. water
1/2  tsp. crushed red pepper
1  Tbsp. curry, nutmeg or thyme
1 1/2  tsp. salt
6  oz. can tomato paste
2  c. uncooked rice
preparation: In Dutch oven, heat oil.  Fry chicken.  Add onion and tomatoes to chicken.  (If desired, other vegetables such as green peppers, cabbage or mushrooms may be added.)  Cook vegetables until soft. Add 2 cups of water and the spices.   Cover and cook over low heat, about 25 minutes or until the chicken is soft.  Add 1 1/2 cups or more water and tomato paste; bring to a boil.  Add rice; cover and continue cooking about 15 minutes longer or until rice is done.  Stir often to prevent sticking.  If rice mixture becomes too dry, add more water.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: LAYERED PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  head lettuce, shredded
1/2  red onion, quartered and thinly sliced
4  or 5 radishes, sliced
1/4  head broccoli, broken or cut into small heads
1 to 1 1/2  c. shredded cheese
1  stalk celery, thinly sliced
1/2  green pepper, quartered and thinly sliced
1  c. sliced cauliflower
1  can green peas
1 to 1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Layer raw vegetables, beginning with lettuce, in a deep glass bowl.  Drain peas and pour over top of vegetables.  Cover peas with mayonnaise.  Sprinkle cheese over all.  Seal with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight.

name: BEEF BURGUNDY
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. beef cubes
1  can Swanson beef broth
1  c. Burgundy or other dry wine
1/2  tsp. crushed thyme leaves
8  whole small white onions (1/2 lb.)
4  oz. can sliced mushrooms, drained
preparation: In large heavy pan, brown beef in 1 tablespoon shortening. Pour off fat.  Stir in broth, wine and thyme.  Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours.  Add onions and mushrooms.  Simmer 1 hour more. Gradually blend 1/3 cup water into 1/4 cup flour until smooth. Slowly stir into stew.  Cook, stirring until thickened.  Serve over cooked noodles.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BUFFALO WINGS
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. chicken wings
1 1/2  bottles Durkee, Frank's original red hot cayenne pepper sauce
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Split wings at joint; discard tips and pat dry.  Deep fry at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes or bake in a roasting pan at 425° for 1 hour.  Turn halfway through cooking time.  Combine sauce and butter.  Dip wings in sauce to coat completely.  Do not allow chicken to soak in sauce (chicken may become soggy).  (My personal favorite is:  Grill outdoors instead of deep frying.  Gives a great smoky flavor.)

name: MISSISSIPPI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/4  c. cooking oil
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. cream-style corn
1  c. sour cream
1  c. self-rising corn meal
preparation: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 425°.

name: SKILLET SUPPER(Easy One Dish Meal!)
ingredients:
1  lb. Prosage, crumbled
1  chopped onion
1  chopped green pepper
1 large  can tomatoes
1/2  c. tomato juice or V-8 juice
2  c. raw macaroni
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. chili powder
2  c. sour cream (optional)
preparation: Saute first 3 ingredients in a little oil.  Add rest of ingredients except sour cream.  Cover and simmer until macaroni is tender.  Add sour cream, if desired, at end, but do not let boil again or it might separate.

name: MOTHER'S POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 (1 lb. or 907 g)  box confectioners sugar (10x)
1/4  lb. (340 g) butter
8  large eggs
1  box (the 10x sugar box or 745 ml) flour
1  tsp. (5 ml) vanilla
1  tsp. (5 ml) lemon flavoring
preparation: Beat sugar and butter until creamy.  Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Sift flour and add gradually.  Add flavorings.  Bake in greased and floured 10-inch (25-cm) tube pan at 275° (135°C) for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: MOUNTAIN CAKE
ingredients:
6  egg yolks
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1  c. nutmeats
3/4  c. Cream of Wheat
1/2  tsp. baking powder
6  egg whites
cherry
Cool Whip
preparation: Mix all ingredients together; add the 6 egg whites, beaten stiffly, very last.  Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.  Use extra creamy Cool Whip and shape into a mountain form with layers of each until top.  Place cherry on top and enjoy.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  small onion, chopped
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1  tsp. pepper
1  c. bread crumbs or crackers
1  egg
2/3  c. tomato juice
2  Tbsp. butter
dash of salt
preparation: Saute onion in butter for 5 minutes.  Add to ground beef in large bowl.  Sprinkle in salt and pepper; mix well.  Stir in crumbs, eggs and juice.  Shape into a loaf.  Place in a greased pan.  Bake at 300° for 60 to 90 minutes or until browned.  Remove loaf and place on platter.  Serve with brown gravy.

name: BAKED TURNIPS
ingredients:
4  medium turnips
1/4  c. milk
1  Tbsp. margarine
1/8  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
bread crumbs, toasted
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Peel and slice turnips thin.  Cook in a little salted water, barely covering.  As soon as they are barely tender (do not overcook), drain and mash.  Add milk, margarine, salt and sugar. Put in greased casserole.  Add bread crumbs and cheese.  Put into 375° oven, about 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

name: MICROWAVE CHICKEN AND DRESSING
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. herb seasoned stuffing mix
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. minced onion
1 (2 oz.)  jar sliced pimento (optional)
1  egg
2  c. chicken broth
1  (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) chicken, cut up or pieces of boneless breasts
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
salt to taste
paprika
preparation: In a 2-quart oblong glass baking dish, toss together stuffing mix, celery, onion, pimento, egg and broth.  Brush chicken pieces with melted butter.  Place on top of dressing with meaty pieces to the outside edges of dish.  Sprinkle with salt and paprika.  Cover with wax paper.  Microwave at High (10) for 19 to 22 minutes.  Let stand about 5 minutes before serving.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: HONEY BUN CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix with pudding
4  eggs
2/3  c. vegetable oil
1/3  c. water
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
2/3  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients.  Combine sugar, cinnamon and pecans.  Pour 1/2 batter into greased and floured pan.  Top with 1/2 sugar mixture.  Repeat.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: BAKED PINEAPPLE
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can chunk pineapple, drained
1/2  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. flour
1  stick butter
2  c. medium sharp cheese, grated
Ritz crackers
preparation: Line bottom of dish with pineapple.  Mix sugar, flour and grated cheese.  Put on top of pineapple.  Some of reserved pineapple juice may be drizzled over this mixture.  Crumble enough crackers to spread over top.  Drizzle melted butter over top of this.  Bake 20 minutes in 375° oven, until lightly browned. Serves 6.

name: LEMON CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  lb. skinned, boned chicken breasts, cut into strips
1  medium onion, chopped
2  garlic cloves, crushed
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 (13 3/4 oz.)  can chicken broth
1  large carrot, sliced
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. grated lemon rind
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. snow pea pods
3  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1 1/2  c. dry Minute rice
preparation: Saute chicken, onions and garlic in butter until chicken is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.  Stir in cornstarch and cook 1 minute.  Add broth, carrot, lemon juice, rind and salt.  Bring to a full boil.  Stir in pea pods, parsley and rice.  Cover; remove from heat.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Fluff with a fork.  Makes 4 servings.

name: DIRT PIE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. Oreo cookies
2  small pkgs. chocolate instant pudding
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  stick margarine
3/4  cup confectioners sugar
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Cream together cream cheese, sugar and margarine.  Mix pudding as directed on package.  Add to the cream cheese mixture. Fold in cool whip.  Crush oreo cookies in blender. Alternate layers of cream cheese mixture and crushed Oreos in a new flower pot.  Top layer should be Oreos.  Decorate with artificial flowers and gummy worms if desired.

name: PEPPERONI BREAD
ingredients:
1  frozen loaf bread dough
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. Lawry's season salt
1/2  tsp. parsley flakes
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
3  Tbsp. melted butter
1  pkg. thin sliced pepperoni
2  c. grated Provolone or Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Roll dough to a 9 x 12-inch pan (jelly roll pan).  Combine oregano, salt, parsley flakes and garlic powder with melted butter. Brush lightly on dough.  Save a little for top.  Arrange pepperoni on top of dough and cover with cheese.  Roll like a jelly roll, tightly (to look like a French loaf of bread).  Brush with remaining butter.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes on cookie sheet. Cool for 15 minutes before cutting.  Great with spaghetti or served alone with a salad.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1  pt. cream-style corn
1/2  c. milk
1  egg, beaten
2  Tbsp. flour
3  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into small greased baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: ROUNDUP CHOW
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  can baked beans
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. mustard
1  Tbsp. barbecue sauce
preparation: In a large skillet, brown hamburger.  Add beans and heat, mixing in brown sugar, mustard and barbecue sauce (adjust amounts of these 3 ingredients to suit your individual taste).  Serve hot with or over biscuits or cornbread.  This dish is simple and filling; should feed 2 people, depending upon how much you eat!

name: FRIED RICE
ingredients:
4  c. cooked white rice
1/2  lb. bacon, cut up
3  eggs, scrambled
1  bunch green onions (use all parts)
1  c. frozen peas
Kikkoman soy sauce
preparation: In a large skillet or wok, fry up bacon.  Set aside.  Remove all but 1 tablespoon oil.  Scramble eggs.  Chop up onions (green tops included).  Place all ingredients in wok.  Stir-fry for 5 minutes.  Season with Kikkoman soy sauce.

name: CUMIN VINAIGRETTE
ingredients:
1/4  c. cider vinegar
2  tsp. Dijon mustard
3/4  tsp. ground cumin
1  tsp. minced garlic
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/4  tsp. salt (optional)
3/4  c. extra virgin olive oil
preparation: Combine the vinegar, mustard, cumin, garlic, pepper and salt in a small bowl.  Whisk well. Slowly drizzle in the olive oil, whisking constantly, until smooth.  Makes 1 cup.

name: CHOCOLATE BISCUITS
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
dash of salt
3  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Place sugar, salt, flour and cocoa in saucepan, slowly adding milk.  Cook until thick.  Add vanilla and pour over baked biscuits.

name: HOT PEPPERS
ingredients:
1  peck hot peppers
1/4  c. oregano
1/2  bulb garlic
vinegar
oil
preparation: Cut peppers.  Cover with vinegar.  Add oregano and garlic. Let soak overnight.  Drain.  Put in jars.   Cover with oil and put lids on.  You do not heat.

name: CARAMEL COCONUT BARS
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs and sugar.  Add flour and baking powder.  Heat milk and butter until butter melts.  Add to egg mixture.  Add vanilla. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

name: DEEP FRIED ICE CREAM
ingredients:
vanilla ice cream
cooking oil
corn flakes
cinnamon sugar*
honey
whipped cream
preparation: Roll ice cream into balls and refreeze.  Heat oil until hot. Crush corn flakes and roll ice cream balls in corn flakes until well covered.  One at a time, place balls on slotted spoon and dip into oil.  (Do not drop off spoon.) Leave in oil until corn flakes are browned, about 2 to 3 seconds.  Roll in cinnamon sugar and place in serving dish.   Drizzle with honey, top with whipped cream and serve.  One ball per serving.

name: NUT ROLL CAKE
ingredients:
1  box graham crackers
1  bag miniature marshmallows
juice of 2 oranges
1  can condensed milk
1  box raisins
1/2  c. pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pack in a tube pan lined with wax paper.  Wet hands with water before attempting to pack mixture in pan.  Refrigerate 1 1/2 days before removing from pan and cutting.

name: CINNAMON CHEESE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  pkg. refrigerated crescent rolls
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. granulated sugar
1  egg, separated
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. granulated sugar
preparation: Spread package of crescent rolls on bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan, pinching seams together.  Don't put up sides of pan. Mix cream cheese, 1 cup sugar, egg yolk and vanilla until smooth. Beat real good.  Spread over dough in pan.

name: GRANDMA'S SKILLET COOKIES
ingredients:
1  beaten egg
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
1  c. chopped dates
1/4  c. peanuts
1/4  c. gumdrops
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. rice cereal
preparation: In heavy skillet, at low temperature, cook beaten egg, sugar, butter and dates until dates pull away from the side of skillet. Add nuts, gumdrops and vanilla.  Pour over cereal; stir and cool. Roll in 1-inch balls in powdered sugar.  Store in refrigerator.

name: ROSE BUD PUNCH
ingredients:
1/2  gal. orange juice
1 big  can pineapple juice
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  jigger lemon juice
1/3  fifth of gin
grenadine for color
preparation: Mix all ingredients together, adding the powdered sugar and grenadine last.

name: WHOLE WHEAT ROLLS
ingredients:
3/4  c. bran cereal
1/3  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. boiling water
1/2  c. warm water
2  pkg. yeast
1  egg, beaten
3 1/4 to 4  c. unbleached flour
melted butter
preparation: Combine cereal, sugar, salt, margarine and boiling water, then cool.  Dissolve yeast in warm water; let sit until it foams. Combine yeast mixture with cereal mixture, egg and flour.  Mix until stiff dough has formed.  Knead 8 to 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.  Grease bowl.  Put dough in bowl; set in warm place. Let rise until double, about 1 1/2 hours.  Punch down; form small balls.  Place on greased cookie sheet close together.  Brush with butter.  Let rise 1 hour, covered.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 375°.

name: SPEEDY BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1 large  can pork and beans
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. ketchup
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. salt
2  slices bacon
1/4  onion, chopped
1/4  bell pepper, chopped
preparation: Mix and bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

name: TACO COMPUESTO
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped canned green chili peppers
1  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. chili powder
1 1/2  c. chopped tomato
3  Tbsp. low calorie Italian salad dressing
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
8  taco shells
1  c. shredded lettuce
1/2  c. shredded low calorie process cheese product (2 oz.)
1/2  c. taco sauce
preparation: Cook beef, onion, chili peppers and garlic until beef is browned; drain.  Stir in chili powder and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Combine tomato, salad dressing and seasoned salt.  Spoon beef mixture into taco shells; top with tomato mixture, lettuce and cheese.  Pass taco sauce.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BROWN SUGAR POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. margarine
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
5  eggs, separated
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1  c. chopped pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour 10-inch tube pan.  Cream margarine and sugars.  Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating well after each one.  Beat until light and fluffy.  Combine flour, baking powder and salt.  Add to sugar mixture alternately with milk.  Begin and end with flour mixture.  Stir in pecans and vanilla.  Beat egg whites to soft peaks.  Fold into batter.  Pour into pan.  Bake 90 minutes or until done.  Let cake rest in pan 30 minutes before removing.

name: VEGETARIAN PIZZA
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. croissants (dough)
8  oz. pkg. lite cream cheese
1  c. plain yogurt
1  c. mayonnaise (lite)
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
assorted, cut small vegetables (carrots, peppers, broccoli, cauliflower; about 2 c. in all)
preparation: Spread croissant dough on greased sheet cake pan (12 x 18-inch) or cookie sheet.  Bake 10 minutes at 350°.  Cool.  Combine cream cheese, yogurt and mayonnaise with Hidden Valley Ranch mix.  Spread on cooled crust.  Sprinkle with vegetables.  Cut into squares.

name: DATE BALLS
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
3/4  c. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. chopped dates
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
2  c. Rice Krispies
1  c. chopped nuts
confectioners sugar
preparation: Cook margarine, sugar and dates over low heat, stirring constantly until melted.  Remove from heat.  Stir in 1 teaspoon vanilla flavoring.  Add 2 cups Rice Krispies and 1 cup chopped nuts.  Let cool.  Roll into small balls in confectioners sugar. Makes approximately 3 dozen.

name: CABBAGE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey or beef
1  large onion
4  c. chopped cabbage
2  ribs celery, chopped
1  can pinto beans
2 small  cans tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1  can tomatoes, chopped
1  Tbsp. chili powder
4 to 6  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Place turkey and chopped onion in a large pot and brown. You may drain if you like but there will be very little grease from the turkey. Mix in remaining ingredients and cook slowly until cabbage is tender. The amounts of cabbage, onion and celery are not critical. Also, you may increase the amount of chili powder if you like. The amount of water may be varied to your taste. A few chopped jalapenos will add a nice touch if you like hot peppers.

name: TOFU SPINACH LASAGNA
ingredients:
1/2  lb. lasagna noodles
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed
1  lb. soft tofu
1  lb. firm tofu
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. soy milk
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  tsp. minced fresh basil
2  tsp. salt
4  c. tomato sauce
preparation: Cook the noodles according to package directions.  Drain and set aside on towel.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Squeeze the spinach as dry as possible and set aside.  Place the tofu, sugar, soy milk, garlic powder, lemon juice, basil and salt in a food processor or blender and blend until smooth.  Cover the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with a thin layer of tomato sauce, then a layer of noodles (use about one-third).  Follow with a layer of half of the tofu filling and half of the spinach.  Continue in the same order, using half of the remaining tomato sauce and noodles and all of the remaining tofu filling and spinach.  End with the remaining noodles, covered by the remaining tomato sauce.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: RUM BALLS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. crumbled vanilla wafers
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
1/4  c. rum *
2  tsp. cocoa
1/3  c. light corn syrup
preparation: Mix all ingredients and roll into balls about the size of hickory nuts.  Let stand for a while, then roll in powdered sugar. Store in airtight container.

name: CAKE PAN POTATOES
ingredients:
4  large potatoes
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. shredded sharp cheese
3  Tbsp. butter, melted
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1/3  c. light cream
parsley for garnish
preparation: Peel and slice potatoes like for French fries.  Put in greased cake pan.  Pour other ingredients over potatoes.  Bake at 425° for 50 minutes.  Sprinkle cheese on a little before done.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. dark brown sugar
5  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
3  c. milk
2  eggs, separated
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  baked pastry shell
2  egg whites
1/2  c. finely chopped pecans
preparation: Combine  sugar,  flour and salt and stir in milk slowly. Cook over  boiling water until thickened, stirring constantly. Cover and  cook  10  minutes longer, stirring constantly.  Add mixture to  egg  yolks,  stirring  vigorously;  cook  1 minute longer. Add  butter, vanilla and pecans.  Cool.  Place filling into a 9 inch baked pastry shell.  Top with meringue.

name: BASIC BASIL TOMATO SAUCE
ingredients:
1  small onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic, chopped fine
3  Tbsp. olive oil
1 (28 oz.)  can crushed tomatoes (Hunt's Angelomia)
1 (15 oz.)  can Hunt's ready tomato sauce (chunky Italian)
1/2  can water (large can)
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. red pepper
3  Tbsp. fresh basil or 1 Tbsp. dried basil
preparation: In large saucepan, saute onion and garlic in hot oil over medium heat until tender.  Add undrained tomatoes, sugar, crushed red pepper, water and 1/4 teaspoon salt.  Bring to boil, reduce heat and cook 45 minutes, stirring often until thick.  Add basil and cook 1 more minute.  Serve over pasta.

name: STEWED CHICKEN AND GRAVY
ingredients:
large pkg. cut up fryer pieces
oil
3  c. self-rising flour
salt, to taste
pepper, to toast
garlic salt, to taste
1  onion, chopped
preparation: In large Dutch oven, heat small amount of cooking oil. Mix flour, salt, pepper, and garlic salt; roll chicken in flour. Place chicken in hot oil; fry on both sides. Add water to cover chicken; add onions. Boil over medium heat until chicken is done; chicken will make it's own gravy.

name: GRANDMA SMITH'S BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
2  eggs, beaten lightly
3  ripe mashed bananas
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour loaf pan.  Mix flour, salt, nutmeg and baking powder; set aside.  Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Mix well.  Add flour mixture alternately with mashed bananas.  Add nuts.  Pour in prepared pan. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

name: OKRA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen, sliced and breaded okra
1  bunch green onions, chopped
2  medium tomatoes, chopped
5  slices bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1/8  c. sugar
1/8  c. vinegar
preparation: Fry okra according to package directions; drain and allow to cool completely. In a large bowl, combine okra with onions, tomatoes and crumbled bacon; mix gently. Add mixture of oil, sugar and vinegar; toss to coat. Chill until ready to serve.

name: SOUTH OF BORDER FLIP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. tomato sauce
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  c. red kidney beans
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  pkg. frozen corn, thawed
1  head shredded lettuce
1  onion, diced or green onion
2  c. sour cream
3  tomatoes, diced
1/2  c. green olives, sliced
Mexican hot sauce
2  pkg. cornbread
preparation: Brown beef and drain off fat.  Add tomato sauce and taco seasoning.  Simmer a few minutes.  Spread meat sauce in pan, then layer drained beans, cheese and corn.  Prepare corn bread and spread on top.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until done.  Top each serving with lettuce, tomato, onion, sour cream and hot sauce.

name: MINI MEAT LOAF SUPPER
ingredients:
1  small onion, quartered
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. undiluted evaporated milk
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1  Tbsp. oil
4  medium potatoes, in 1/2-inch slices
1  large onion, in 1/2-inch slices
4  large carrots, in sticks
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas (optional)
1  c. red wine
preparation: Combine onion, ground beef, evaporated milk, bread crumbs, egg, garlic salt, salt and mustard.  Mix lightly but thoroughly. Shape mixture into 4 to 6 loaves. Brown meat loaves in oil, top and bottom. Add potatoes, onion and carrots. Add wine. Season with salt and pepper.  Cover and simmer about 1 hour. Add peas, if desired. Cover and simmer 10 minutes.

name: PUFFED-UP PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
several dashes bottled hot pepper sauce
1  c milk
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  c. flour
1/2  c. (2 oz.) grated Parmesan cheese
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. chopped green pepper
1 (1 1/2 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti sauce mix
1  clove garlic, minced
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
2  eggs
8  oz. (2 c.) shredded Mozzarella
preparation: In a 12-inch skillet, cook the ground beef until brown.  From the meat, drain off the fat and discard it.  Stir in the tomato sauce, chopped onion, chopped green pepper, water, spaghetti sauce mix, oregano, minced garlic and bottled hot pepper sauce.  Bring to boiling.  Reduce heat and simmer the mixture, covered, for 10 minutes.

name: CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
1  cooked chicken
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  c. chicken broth
1  can mixed vegetables
preparation: Take chicken off bone and cut into small pieces. Mix soup, broth and vegetables together. Pour over chicken in deep baking dish.

name: CONEY ISLAND HOT DOGS
ingredients:
8  hot dogs and buns
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. finely chopped onions
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  can tomato sauce
1/8  tsp. garlic powder or salt
1/2  tsp. chili powder
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Saute meat until brown.  Drain fat off.  Add onions and cook until transparent.  Add garlic, chili powder, dry mustard, brown sugar, lemon juice and tomato sauce.  Cook and stir until well blended.

name: CHRISTMAS TOFFEE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. white sugar
1 1/2  c. chopped walnuts
3  Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. white corn syrup
1  (6 oz.) chocolate chips, melted
preparation: Butter 9-inch square pan.  Melt butter in 2-quart pan.  Stir in sugar gradually.  Add syrup and water.  Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, to 290°.  Add 1 cup walnuts; cook 3 minutes more, stirring constantly.  Pour into pan.  Melt chocolate over hot water.  Coat one side of toffee, sprinkle with chopped walnuts.  Allow to set for a minute or so.  Flip over on waxed paper and repeat.  Break into bite size pieces.  Makes about 1 3/4 pounds.

name: BACON WRAPPED CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless skinless chicken breasts
1  (4 oz.) cream cheese
4  slices bacon
4  tsp. fresh chives, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. pepper
pinch of salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Pound chicken breasts until flat.  Put a slice of cream cheese and 1 teaspoon chives in middle of each breast; roll up.  Wrap each rolled breast with 1 slice of bacon and secure with toothpick.  Combine soup, mayonnaise, milk, lemon juice, pepper and salt.  Mix until smooth.  Place wrapped chicken pieces in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Cover chicken with sauce mixture.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1 1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
9  oz. pkg. tortillas
oil
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown meat; drain.  Add tomatoes, tomato paste, water, onion and seasonings.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Dip each tortilla in hot oil. Place a rounded tablespoonful of meat sauce and cheese on each tortilla.  Roll up tightly.  Place, seam side down, in baking dish.  Top with remaining sauce and cheese.  Cover with aluminum foil.  Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: SUNSHINE CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1  can mandarin oranges
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 large  box vanilla instant pudding
1  Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cake mix as directed on back of box.  Pinch up mandarin oranges and put in batter.  Pour a little of juice in batter. Bake as directed and cool.

name: RITZ CRACKERS SNACKS
ingredients:
1  stick real butter
1  stick margarine
1/2  c. sugar
40  Ritz crackers
1 1/2  c. pecan pieces
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients in saucepan.  Boil 3 minutes.  Lay Ritz crackers side by side on jelly roll pan.  Sprinkle with pecans.  Pour butter/sugar mixture over crackers.  Bake 10 minutes at 350°.  Remove from oven.  Let cool approximately 5 to 10 minutes.  Remove from pan and place on serving tray.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  cartons Cool Whip
4  large apples
2  (10 1/2 oz.) bags miniature marshmallows
2 (17 oz.)  cans fruit cocktail
2  c. pecans
preparation: Drain fruit cocktail; put in a large bowl.  Dice apples and add all remaining ingredients.  Makes 12 servings.

name: APPLE FRITTERS
ingredients:
1  c. milk
2  eggs, beaten separately
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  c. sliced apples
preparation: Heat milk until more than lukewarm.  Add slowly to beaten egg yolks and sugar.  Sift flour, baking powder and salt.  Stir flour mixture into egg and milk.  Slowly add beaten egg whites.  Stir together, then add slices of apples.  Drop into hot grease by large spoonfuls, and fry until light and brown.  Serve with maple syrup.

name: MUSHROOM ROLLS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. mushrooms, chopped finely
1/4  c. butter
3  Tbsp. flour
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. m.s.g.
1  c. light cream
2  tsp. minced chives
1  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Saute mushrooms in butter until soft.  Blend in flour, salt and m.s.g.  Stir in cream.  Cook until thick.  Add chives and lemon juice.  Cool.

name: CHRISTMAS SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. water
1  can (1 lb.) whole cranberry sauce, mashed
2  pkg. (3 oz.) raspberry Jello
1  c. orange sections, well drained
2  c. creamed cottage cheese
preparation: Bring 1 c. water to a boil.  Add cranberry sauce and heat until it melts.  Add jello and stir.  Add 1 c. cold water.  Chill until mixture is syrupy.  Add orange sections to jello.  Pour into ring mold.  Chill until firm.  Unmold on lettuce leaves and fill center with creamed cottage cheese.  One c. canned mandarin oranges can be used.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. corn meal
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  chopped onion
2  beaten eggs
3/4  c. milk
6  jalapeno peppers
preparation: Blend eggs, milk, onion and peppers in a blender. Add to dry ingredients. Fry in deep fat.  They will turn over by themselves when 1 side is done.

name: FUDGE BROWNIE RING CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. family size fudge brownie mix
2  pkg. coconut almond or coconut pecan frosting mix
1  c. sour cream
2/3  c. milk
2  eggs
preparation: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients.  Stir well.  Pour batter into generously greased and lightly floured 10-inch tube or Bundt pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 50 to 70 minutes or until pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool 15 minutes.  Remove from pan and drizzle with glaze.

name: ITALIAN CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs, separated
1  c. sugar
1  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
4  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Resift flour with baking powder and salt.  Beat egg yolks until thick and light.  Blend in sugar gradually; add lemon juice. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry.  Mix into yolks alternately with dry ingredients.  Use 9-inch round cake pan, 3 inches deep; do not grease.  Spread batter.  Bake at 325° for 40 to 60 minutes.  Invert pan on rack at least 1 hour.  Split in half just before adding cream filling.  Cake should be cold.

name: ALMOND BARK COOKY
ingredients:
1  box Ritz crackers
peanut butter
Almond Bark
preparation: Put peanut butter between 2 Ritz crackers.  Use all crackers. Heat on low, 1 pkg. of Chocolate almond bark.  Do not add anything to bark.  Remove from heat.  Dip crackers in bark till coated evenly.  Place on foil to cool, about 1 hour.  You can use white almond bark for colors add several drops of food color.

name: OLD FIELD'S LAYERED BLUEBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  qt. blueberries
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/8  tsp. salt
1  c. water
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: This pie adapts itself to being made with or without an orange liquor and the taste is wonderful either way.

name: EARTHQUAKE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. pecans, chopped
1  c. coconut
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. oleo, softened
2  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix pecans and coconut and put in bottom of lightly greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix cake as directed on box, then pour over coconut and pecan mixture.  Mix cream cheese, oleo, powdered sugar and vanilla and spread over cake batter.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN
ingredients:
chicken pieces
8  oz. Russian dressing
8  oz. apricot preserves
1  onion soup
1/4  c. water
pineapple to garnish
preparation: Put all chicken pieces in baking dish.  Mix all ingredients and pour over and cover chicken pieces.  Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. flour
3  c. water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. broccoli flowerets
4  chicken bouillon cubes
1  tsp. worcestershire sauce
3  c. shredded cheddar cheese
2  c. (1 pint) half & half
preparation: In a large pot, cook onion in butter until tender.  Stir in flour until smooth.  Gradually add water then broccoli, bouillon and worcestershire sauce.  Over medium heat, cook and stir until thickened and broccoli is tender.  Add cheese and half & half. Cook and stir until cheese melts and soup is hot.  (Do not boil.)

name: FUDGE ICING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
1/4  c. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. white corn syrup
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil; boil at medium for 3 minutes.  Add 1 box powdered sugar and beat until smooth.  Add 1 teaspoon vanilla.  Ice cake that is still warm.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
4  c. sliced apples
2/3 to 3/4  c. packed brown sugar
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. rolled oats
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/3  c. soft butter
preparation: Heat oven to 375 degrees.  Place sliced apple in greased square pan 8 x 8 x 2 or a baking dish.  Blend remaining ingredients until mixture is crumbly.  Spread over apples.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until apples are tender and the topping is golden brown.

name: CUCUMBER RELISH
ingredients:
11  cucumbers
9  green tomatoes
3  ripe tomatoes
7  green peppers
4  large onions
6  c. sugar
4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. turmeric
preparation: Chop all vegetables fine and mix sugar, vinegar and turmeric together with vegetables.  Boil for 1 hour.  Put in jars and seal. Makes 10 pints.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. grated zucchini
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  c. oil
3  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1 (scant)  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. raisins
nuts (optional)
cherries (optional)
pineapples (optional)
preparation: Steam raisins and let set 1 hour; drain.  Beat sugar, eggs and oil until fluffy.  Add flour, vanilla, baking soda, baking powder, salt and cinnamon.  Stir in zucchini and raisins.  Fill half 2 or 3 loaf pans.  Bake at 325° for 3/4 to 1 hour.

name: CREAMY FRUIT SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. pineapple or orange juice
1/4  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. chopped nuts
preparation: Blend fruit juice and sour cream into mayonnaise in a small bowl.  Mix in nuts.  Chill until serving time.  Serve over fruit salad.  Vary amount of fruit juice for desired consistency.

name: FUDGE CAKE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. oleo, softened
1  c. flour
4  eggs
1  c. nuts
pinch of salt
1  can Hershey's chocolate syrup
preparation: Cream together the sugar and oleo.  Add Hershey's syrup and flour.  Add the eggs one at a time, beating about 1 minute after each egg.  Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.  Frost with cream cheese frosting.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. pumpkin
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
2/3  c. water
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. salad oil
3  tsp. baking soda
