preparation: Mix everything, except flour and soda, together well.  Then mix the baking soda in together with 1 cup of the flour.  When mixed, add to rest of the flour.  Mix all ingredients together thoroughly.  Bake at 350° until toothpick comes out clean!

name: GREEN TOMATO SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. green tomato pulp
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. scalded raisins
1/2  c. walnuts
1/2  c. margarine
1  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp.ground cloves
preparation: Grind the tomatoes to make like applesauce.  Heat tomato pulp, margarine, sugar and raisins together.   Cool.  Add flour, spices, soda and salt sifted together. Add nutmeats.    Mix well. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: WALDORF PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. rotini or corkscrew macaroni, uncooked
1-1/4  tsp. salt, divided
2  Tbsp. oil
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. sugar
3/4  tsp. poppy seeds
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  c. chopped black walnuts
1  large red delicious apple, peeled or unpeeled and chopped
1 stalk celery, thinly sliced, or 1/4  tsp. celery seed
1/2  (10-oz.) block cheddar cheese, cut into bite size     pieces
3  Tbsp. seedless raisins
1  c. chopped cooked chicken (optional)
preparation: Cook macaroni  according to package directions, using 1 teaspoon salt in water; drain and set aside.  In a large bowl, combine oil, lemon juice, sugar, poppy seeds, mustard and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt.  Add drained macaroni, walnuts, apples, celery, cheese, raisins, and chicken, if desired.  Toss to blend well.  Serve with crackers.

name: CHEESY OVEN POTATOES
ingredients:
1 (32 oz.)  pkg. frozen hash browns
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. oleo, melted
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. mild Cheddar, shredded
preparation: Mix together all ingredients and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Top with 1/4 cup melted oleo and 1 cup corn flakes, mixed together.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: MARSHMALLOW CARAMEL BALLS
ingredients:
1  bag Kraft caramels, remove wrappers
1/2  c. sweetened condensed milk
Rice Krispies cereal
1/2  c. butter
1  bag large marshmallows
chopped nuts (optional)
coconut (optional)
preparation: In heavy saucepan, melt together the caramels, butter and condensed milk until smooth.  May need to add up to 1/4 cup more evaporated milk to make smooth.  With metal fork, dip large marshmallows into sauce, then roll in Rice Krispies.  (May add nuts and coconut to Rice Krispies.)

name: 10 MINUTE MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. uncooked rice
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Shape combined mixture well into small patties.  Drop patties into hot condensed tomato soup to which 1/2 cup of water has been added.

name: CAVATINI
ingredients:
1  lb ground chuck
Garlic salt or powder, to taste
1  small onion, chopped (can use flakes)
1  small green pepper chopped
1/2  lb pepperoni
1 small  can mushrooms (optional)
3  cans Hunt's spaghetti sauce
1/2  lb grated cheese (1/2 provolone, 1/2 mozzarella)
1/2  lb noodles
preparation: Brown chuck, onion, green pepper in frying pan and drain. Add pepperoni, mushrooms, spaghetti sauce, cheese.  Cook noodles, drain.  Mix all ingredients with noodles. Put in two 9 x 13 inch pans that have been sprayed with Pam. Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese.  Bake in 400 degree oven for 30 minutes.  Recipe can be halved for a small family or doubled for a large crowd.

name: AMAZING COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
2  c. milk
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. Bisquick
4  eggs
1/4  c. oleo
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. Angel Flake coconut
preparation: Combine milk, sugar, Bisquick, eggs, butter and vanilla in blender.  Cover blender and blend on low for 3 minutes.  Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan.  Let stand about 5 minutes, then sprinkle with coconut.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: IMPOSSIBLE CHEESEBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  tomatoes, sliced
3/4  c. Bisquick baking mix
2  c. Cheddar cheese
3  eggs
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Grease a 10-inch pie plate and set aside.

name: EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
4  eggs
3  c. milk
nutmeg
6  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs, add sugar, milk and vanilla.  Sprinkle with nutmeg. Place in an unbaked pie shell.  Bake 10 minutes at 450°.  After 10 minutes cut to 350° for 25 minutes.

name: GRANDPA'S GOULASH
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1 (28 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
2  medium chopped onions
3/4  c. chopped green peppers
1/2  c. water
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. chili powder
7  oz. pkg. shell macaroni
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook hamburger and onions until brown; drain.  Stir in tomatoes and juice, green peppers, water, mushrooms, salt, sugar, chili powder and macaroni.  Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer about 30 minutes.  If needed, add more water.

name: GRANNY GOO CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  stick butter
1  egg
1/2 to 1  c. chopped pecans
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  box powdered sugar
2  eggs
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients until crumbly; pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle nuts over crust.  Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over crust.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: FROZEN MUD PIE SANDWICHES
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  Tbsp. unsweetened cocoa
1  tsp. stick margarine
1 1/4  c. chocolate frozen low-fat yogurt, softened
2  Tbsp. light colored corn syrup
1  Tbsp. 1% low-fat milk
1/4  tsp. vanilla extract
16  large or 48 small chocolate wafer cookies
preparation: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a small heavy saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, stirring frequently with a whisk. Turn down to a simmer and cook on low heat for about 2 minutes or until thick. Stir  the mixture frequently while it cooks. When finished, remove the mixture from the heat and stir in the margarine and vanilla. Cover and chill thoroughly.

name: STUFFED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  large head green cabbage
1  Tbsp. salt, divided
1  c. chopped onions
1  clove garlic, crushed
1  lb. lean ground beef
2  c. cooked rice
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  tsp. green bell pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (14 1/2 to 16 oz.)  can tomatoes, chopped
juice of one lemon
2  Tbsp. brown sugar (optional)
preparation: Remove	12  large  outer leaves from cabbage.  Trim off thick part  of  each  leaf.  Add leaves and 1 teaspoon salt to boiling water.  Allow  to stand five  minutes, so they become pliable. Drain.  Combine  onions,  garlic, ground meat, rice, eggs, pepper and 1 teaspoon salt.  Place mound of meat mixture (1/2 cup) in hollow of each leaf.  Fold the sides of leaf over stuffing.  Roll up	from  the thick end of leaf to make roll. Arrange  cabbage rolls  seam  side  down  in lightly buttered shallow  3  quart baking pan.  Combine tomato sauce, tomatoes, lemon juice, 1 teaspoon salt and pepper in saucepan.  Bring to boil.  Pour  over cabbage  rolls.  Sprinkle with brown sugar. Cover.	Bake  at  375° for  50  minutes.	Uncover and cook 10 minutes  longer.  Remove to	a  warm  serving platter;  spoon sauce over all.  Serves 8.

name: BUTTERHORNS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. milk, scalded
1  c. butter
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1 cake yeast, dissolved in 2  tsp. sugar
3  eggs
5 to 5 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Scald milk; add butter, sugar and salt.  Cool.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Add yeast and flour; beat well by hand.  Let rise until double in bulk.  Punch down and place in refrigerator for a couple of hours.

name: SOUTHWEST STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. diced onion
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes
1  can pinto beans
1  can mixed vegetables
1  c. picante sauce
1  tsp. ground cumin
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. pepper
salt to taste
preparation: In skillet brown ground beef; drain excess fat.  Place beef and remaining ingredients in a large pot.  Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

name: CHOCO MINT SNAPPERS
ingredients:
6  oz. pkg. chocolate mint chips
2/3  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. Karo syrup
1 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt chocolate chips in the microwave.  Combine shortening, sugar and egg.  Blend in chocolate and Karo syrup.  Sift together flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.  Stir in gradually.  You may have to chill for a little while to make it easy to shape into balls.  Shape into balls and roll in sugar.  Bake at 350° or until the cookie looks cracked on top.  Bake with oven rack in the middle or at the top level in oven.  If you bake them too close to the burner, the bottoms of the cookies will burn.

name: HEART HEALTHY PIZZA
ingredients:
1  can Pillsbury pizza crust from the dairy case
1/2  c. Kraft Healthy Favorites shredded mild Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. Kraft Healthy Favorites shredded mild Mozzarella cheese
Hunt's pizza sauce
8  oz. Perdue ground turkey (not all white meat), cooked in microwave and drained
preparation: Grease well a jelly roll pan.  Spread pizza crust in pan. Spread a thin layer of pizza sauce over the crust.  Crumble the ground turkey over the sauce.  Add the shredded cheese.   Bake in 425° oven for 15 to 18 minutes.  If you like, you can add onions, green peppers and mushrooms before sprinkling the cheese on top.

name: SURPRISE! SURPRISE! CAKE
ingredients:
1  box coconut pecan frosting
1  box chocolate cake mix
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Mix cake according to directions.  Pour cherry pie filling into mixture.  Beat at 325° until center is done.  Spoon icing onto hot cake.  Broil until bubbly!

name: FRESH BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
raw broccoli, chopped in bite-size pieces
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. green onion, chopped
1/2  c. olives, sliced
4  hard-boiled eggs, sliced thin
salt and pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients and serve.

name: COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
5  eggs
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  stick margarine, melted
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. cornmeal
1  c. coconut
preparation: Mix the flour, cornmeal and coconut with sugar.  Mix all ingredients and pour into 2 uncooked pie crusts.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: GLAZED SALTED NUTS
ingredients:
1/4  c. salad oil
2  Tbsp. corn syrup
1  qt. pecans
preparation: Mix oil and syrup in saucepan.  Heat gently, then stir in nuts.  Put in iron skillet and place in a 250° oven for 1 hour. Stir 4 times.  Remove and cool.  Transfer to jars or canisters with lids.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  lb. yellow squash
1  chopped onion
1/4  c. butter
3  eggs, beaten
1  can mushroom soup
1  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook squash and onion until tender.  Drain well.  Add butter and mix well.  Fold in remaining ingredients.  Place in buttered casserole dish and top with a thin layer of cracker crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: CARROT AND PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon jello
1  c. pineapple juice
1  c. crushed pineapple
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. boiling water
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. grated carrot
1/3  c. pecans (optional)
preparation: Pour boiling water over jello and dissolve.  Add pineapple juice, vinegar and salt.  Mix well and add pineapple, carrots and pecans.  Mix well and place in refrigerator to congeal.  Serve in squares on lettuce leaves. Top with a little mayonnaise.

name: FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. onions, sliced thin
1/4  c. butter or margarine
3  cans condensed beef broth
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. salt and pepper
preparation: In large Dutch oven, cook onions, covered in butter, about 20 to 25 minutes, until tender.  Add beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper; bring to a rolling boil.  Cover, reduce heat and cook 20 to 30 minutes longer.   Serve with large toasted French bread cubes, topped with Swiss or Jack cheese, and enjoy!!!

name: TRI-PORK CHITTERLINGS
ingredients:
20  lb. fresh or frozen chitterlings
2  celery stalks
1  medium sized green pepper (red; optional)
2  medium sized onions (white or yellow)
1 1/2 to 2  tsp. table salt and black pepper
1  Tbsp. crushed red pepper
2  c. ham seasoning meat or 3 medium cut slices fat back
2  lb. pork maws
1 1/2 to 2  tsp. table salt
1  medium sized green pepper (red; optional)
1  medium sized onion (white or yellow)
1  tsp. crushed red pepper and black pepper
preparation: Boil 45 minutes to 1 hour in medium sized pot.  Cook meat and vegetables until tender.  Add water throughout the cooking process (meat should never stick).  Drain meat and vegetables, removing all liquid, except 1 1/2 cups.  Chop every ingredient finely in a wafer pan or iron skillet.  Place in the oven to bake.  Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: HERSHEY'S CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  can Hershey's syrup
1  lb. Hershey's chocolate candy (16 oz.)
1  c. buttermilk
2 1/2  c. plain flour (or self-rising flour, but omit soda)
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. baking soda
4  eggs
2  sticks butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
chopped black walnuts (optional)
preparation: Melt  chocolates  over low heat.  Cool and add vanilla. Cream sugar and butter.  Add eggs, 1 at a time.  Add chocolate mixture to  butter.  Add  flour  and soda mixture alternately with buttermilk.  Add nuts.  Grease and flour 3 loaf pans or 1 Bundt pan and  1  loaf pan or 1 large sheet pan.  Bake at 300° to  350° for  approximately  1 hour.  Check with toothpick or finger press after 45 minutes.  Cool before taking from pans.

name: SEVEN-UP CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3  c. sugar
5  eggs
2  Tbsp. lemon flavoring
1/2  lb. margarine
3  c. flour
8  oz. Seven-Up
powdered sugar
lemon juice
preparation: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Pour into a 10-inch Bundt pan that has been greased and floured. Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until cake tests done. Mix powdered sugar and lemon juice until of spreading consistency and ice cake.

name: CRAN-PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  large raspberry jello
1 (14 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1  can whole-berry cranberry sauce
3/4  c. Port wine
preparation: Dissolve jello in 1 1/4 cups hot water.  Add other ingredients.  After it is set add topping.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL CAKE
ingredients:
1  egg
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
pinch of salt
1  can (No. 2) fruit cocktail
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. nuts
1  c. coconut
preparation: Mix first 6 ingredients and pour into 9 x 12-inch cake pan. Top with brown sugar and nuts.  Bake at 350° until done, 30 to 40 minutes.

name: DEVILED SALMON
ingredients:
2  c. tomato juice, cooked down to 1 c. tomato sauce
3  tsp. dehydrated onion flakes
1/4  green pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. prepared mustard
1  lb. canned and drained salmon
6 thin  slices lemon, including peels
1/4  c. fine crumbs
preparation: Blend first 5 ingredients for about 15 seconds.  Flake salmon. Combine with sauce from blender; turn into casserole dish.  Top with crumbs and then with lemon slices.  Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: TATER TOT HOT DISH
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, browned
sliced onions
1  can peas, drained *
1 small  pkg. Tater Tots
1  can cream of mushroom soup *
1  can milk
preparation: *Can use green beans instead of peas or cream of chicken soup.

name: FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines butter flavor fudge cake mix
1  pkg. chocolate or chocolate fudge instant pudding mix (4 serving size)
1/2  c. oil
1 1/4  c. water
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1/2  tsp. vanilla, butternut flavoring or butter flavoring
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour pan.  Blend ingredients in a large bowl.  Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Bake at 350° until toothpick comes out clean.  Bake 50 to 60 minutes for a 10-inch tube pan, 45 to 50 minutes for two 8-inch round pans, 40 to 45 minutes for two 9-inch round pans and 50 to 55 minutes for a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cool tube cake 25 minutes. Cool others 15 to 20 minutes before removing from pan.

name: ARKANSAS GRAVY
ingredients:
1  lb. deer sausage
1 1/2  c. milk
dash of Louisiana hot sauce
3 heaping  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper
1/4  c. coffee
preparation: Brown meat in skillet; don't let it get hard.  Add flour and stir.  Add a little oil, if needed.  Stir and cook 2 or 3 minutes. Add milk, salt and pepper.  Cook and stir until thick.  Add hot sauce and coffee.  Add more milk, if needed.

name: BLACK-EYED PEAS ON NEW YEAR'S DAY FOR GOOD LUCK
ingredients:
4  strips bacon
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  c. peas
1/2  c. uncooked long-grained white rice
2  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Use unhusked ears of corn.  Lay back husks enough to remove silk.  Return husk to original position.  Be sure kernels aren't exposed.  Roast on grill, turning 3 or 4 times so all sides are exposed to heat.  Allow at least 30 minutes for roasting, depending on age-size of corn and proximity of heat.  When done, serve plain or season with butter.

name: HERBIE'S 3 STAGE CHILI(From Solid to Liquid to Gas)
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. hamburger
1  medium onion
1  large green pepper
2  tomatoes
1  can pork and beans
1  can kidney beans, drained
1  can chili beans
1  stick butter (optional)
1  pkg. Cajun spice mix
1  c. sugar
preparation: Brown hamburger and 1/2 of onion in skillet; drain.  Chop up green pepper, tomatoes and rest of onion; put in slow cooker.  Add all the beans; drain juice from kidney beans.  Put all in slow cooker and cook on low about 3 to 6 hours.

name: IN THE BAG TURKEY BREAST
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. lemon-pepper seasoning
3  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. dried thyme
1  tsp. crushed dried rosemary
1  (4 to 6 lb.) turkey breast
vegetable cooking spray
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
preparation: You will need 1 large (14 x 20-inch) oven cooking bag.

name: CAULIFLOWER SOUP
ingredients:
1/4 to 1/2  c. onions, diced
2  Tbsp. margarine
1 large  can chicken broth
1/2  bag thin noodles
6  c. milk
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Saute onions in margarine.  Cook 1 head of cauliflower that has been cut into flowerets.  Cook the cauliflower separately and add to the above, onions and margarine that has been sauteed and the noodles and chicken broth that have been cooked.  I add some flour to the milk to thicken and then add the Velveeta cheese that has been cubed.  Simmer until cheese is melted.  Makes about 4 quarts. Can be frozen.

name: CUCUMBER AND POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
2  cucumbers
1  potato, boiled
caraway seed
oil and vinegar
garlic
salt
pepper
preparation: Peel cucumbers completely.  Slice fine with slicer.  Drain off juice.  Sprinkle with salt, pepper and caraway seed.  Peel and dice soft-boiled potato.  Mix with cucumbers.  Pour oil and vinegar over mixture.  Sprinkle with a touch of garlic.  Chill.

name: SAND CUPS
ingredients:
2  c. cold milk
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. Jell-O vanilla flavor pudding
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. vanilla wafers, crushed
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: You also need 8 to 10 (7 ounce) clear plastic cups.

name: Baptist Pound Cake
ingredients:
1/2  c. Crisco
1  stick margarine
3  c. white sugar
5  eggs
3  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream shortening and margarine.  Add sugar and cream.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Sift flour; add baking powder.  Add flour and milk to mixture.  Add vanilla.  Pour into a greased Bundt pan. Do not preheat oven.  Put in cold oven and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

name: ROLLS *
ingredients:
6  c. flour
2  tsp. salt
1  c. Crisco
1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. boiling water
1  c. lukewarm water
2  pkg. yeast
preparation: Mix salt, Crisco and sugar with boiling water.  Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water; add to first mixture.  Add beaten eggs and enough flour to make a stiff dough.  Cover and refrigerate for several hours or until needed (will keep for a week).

name: TANGY BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise or Miracle Whip
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1 medium  bunch broccoli, cut into flowerets
4  c. loosely packed fresh spinach leaves, chopped
1/2  lb. thin sliced bacon, cooked crisply and crumbled
1/2  c. red onion slivers
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Mix dressing, sugar and vinegar in large bowl.  Add remaining ingredients; mix lightly.  Refrigerate.  Serves 8.

name: BAKED SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
4  lb. hamburger meat
1  clove garlic, minced
1  bell pepper
1  whole onion (Vidalia or oss)
1  Tbsp. oregano
1  can tomato sauce
1  can stewed tomatoes
1  jar Ragu
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Prepare the hamburger by boiling rapidly in enough water to cover meat. Break the meat up so as not to have lumps in the meat. Pour off water and repeat cleaning process. Add all ingredients. Simmer for 1 hour. Cook spaghetti until tender, enough to pinch in two. Add spaghetti to cold water to terminate cooking; drain. Layer mix in large casserole the sauce, spaghetti and sharp Cheddar cheese, ending with sauce. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top. Bake at 350° until sides are bubbling and top is browned.

name: PRUNE NUT CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
1  c. drained, chopped, cooked prunes
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. walnuts
preparation: Combine ingredients as you do in cake.  Bake in small cupcake pan at 350° for 25 minutes or until done.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP 2
ingredients:
2  cans artichoke hearts (16 oz. cans)
1  c. mayonnaise
2  c. fresh Parmesan
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
dash of Tabasco (optional)
2  garlic cloves, crushed
pepper
paprika
preparation: Cut artichoke hearts in fourths.  Mix all ingredients together except paprika.  Put in 2-quart baking dish.  Sprinkle paprika on top.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.  Serve hot with crackers.

name: CHOCOLATE SYRUP CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
4  eggs
1 large  can chocolate syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine all ingredients well.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

name: CAESAR SALAD
ingredients:
croutons
1  to 2 garlic cloves, crushed
1  can anchovies, chopped
1/3 or 1/4  c. olive oil
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
fresh ground pepper
1 large  bunch romaine lettuce
1  squeezed lemon
1/3  or more grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Rub wooden bowl with 1 cut garlic clove; crush the rest. Allow some garlic in the bowl.  Mix in 1 cup anchovies, oil, salt, dry mustard and pepper.  Chop lettuce.  Add mixture to lettuce; squeeze lemon over salad and toss.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and croutons.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  (20 oz.) roll sugar cookies
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
Several varieties fruit (canned or fresh - see below)
preparation: Mix Cool Whip, sugar, and cheese and set aside.  Lightly grease pizza pan.  Slice cookie dough 1/4 inch thick; lay in pan and smooth together to make crust.  Cook per directions.  Cool. Spread cheese mixture over crust.  Arrange fruit and top with glaze. Suggested fruits:  peaches, strawberries, pineapple, grapes, pears, mandarin oranges, strawberries, bananas, kiwi fruit.

name: CHICKEN RICE SOUP
ingredients:
1  large soup bone
3 or 4  qt. water
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
3 chicken bouillon cubes or 1 1/2  c. chicken stock
1 1/2  c. uncooked rice
2  Tbsp. parsley
preparation: Cook soup bone in water for 3 hours.  Remove bone.  Add salt, pepper, bouillon or chicken stock, rice and parsley.  Cook 25 minutes or until rice is done. Serve hot.

name: PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can chunk pineapple
1  c. sugar
1  stick butter
1  sleeve Ritz crackers
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. self-rising flour
preparation: Drain can of pineapple. Set juice aside. Melt butter and mix with sugar. Stir in pineapple with sugar and butter. Mix. Sprinkle flour in as you stir in these ingredients. Crush Ritz crackers. Stir in crackers and cup of shredded cheese to the mixture. Add 1 tablespoon of pineapple juice to mixture. Put in casserole dish and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Can be served warm or cooled.

name: CHICKEN CORDON BLEU BASKET(Microwave Recipe)
ingredients:
4  boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
4 thin ham  slices (regular or turkey ham)
4 thin  slices Swiss cheese
seasoned bread crumbs
egg white (optional)
preparation: Pound chicken breasts thin.  Lay a strip of ham and slice of cheese on each breast half.  Roll up and secure with toothpicks. Dip in slightly beaten egg white (or water, if preferred) and roll in bread crumbs to coat.  Place in microwavable casserole dish. Microwave approximately 10 to 12 minutes, turning once halfway through.  Serve over a bed of rice.

name: MAMA'S FRIED PORK SPARERIBS AND GRAVY
ingredients:
1  slab pork spareribs
3  c. all purpose flour (for coating)
Salt and Pepper to taste
Cooking oil
1/2  onion, diced
2  tsp. flour
preparation: Slice into portions of 2 or three rib sections.  Season with salt and pepper to your desire.  Put three cups of all purpose flour into a bag.  Add ribs and shake to coat.

name: STRAWBERRY JELLO SALADLubbock, Texas
ingredients:
Strawberry jello - thickened
1  can pie cherries, juice and all
1 8  oz. can crushed pineapples
Nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix fruit into thickened jello.

name: NO BAKE CHOCOLATE PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. chocolate wafer crumbs
1/4  c. Pet instant dry milk
1/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Mix ingredients and press on bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie pan and chill until ready to fill.

name: MARINARA (LOW CALORIE)
ingredients:
2  tsp. each: olive oil and butter or margarine
1  clove garlic, minced
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. sliced mushrooms
1 1/2  c. canned ready cut tomatoes
1/4  c. chopped parsley
1/2  tsp. dried basil
salt and pepper to taste
3/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In a large nonstick skillet, heat olive oil and butter.  Saute garlic and onion until onion is clear, about 5 minutes.  Add mushrooms and saute 2 minutes longer.  Stir in tomatoes, parsley and seasonings.  Cover and simmer gently for 15 minutes.  Stir in half of the Parmesan cheese.  Sprinkle remaining cheese on top as serving.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. packed brown sugar
1  c. butter, melted and cooled
1  (6 oz.) bag chocolate chips
1  c. walnuts (optional)
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
preparation: Beat eggs until foamy.  Mix in flour, sugar and brown sugar; beat.  Blend in butter.  Add chocolate chips.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SALMON CROQUETTES
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can salmon
1  egg
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. potato flakes
1  small onion, grated
freshly ground black pepper
oil for frying
fresh dill and lemon wedges for garnish
preparation: Drain salmon, reserving 1/4 cup of the liquid.   Remove skin and bones.  Place salmon in mixing bowl, breaking up into smaller pieces.  Add egg, mixing thoroughly.  Stir in flour.  Blend in potato flakes, onion and black pepper.  Combine baking powder and reserved 1/4 cup of liquid.  Stir into salmon mixture until well combined.  Form mixture into 24 croquettes.  Drop into deep, hot oil (375°) and fry, without crowding, for 3 to 5 minutes or until golden brown on all sides.  Drain on paper toweling.  Garnish with dill and lemon wedges.

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cloves
3  c. applesauce
2  c. white sugar
1  c. margarine
4  c. plain flour
1  lb. seedless raisins
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
1/2  lb. walnuts
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  c. strong coffee
preparation: Dissolve soda in coffee.  Mix applesauce with beaten margarine and sugar.  Sift flour, spices, salt, chopped raisins and nuts. Add soda with coffee and beaten eggs.  Mix well.  Bake 2 hours at 325°, maybe longer.

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
1 small  can crushed pineapple
3  bananas, diced
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.  Add undrained strawberries and pineapple.  When cooled to room temperature, add bananas. Turn a third of mixture into a mold.  Chill until firm.  Spread Cool Whip over congealed layer.  Add remaining mixture and chill until firm.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) softened cream cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
chopped lettuce
onion
1  green pepper
tomatoes
taco sauce
shredded Cheddar cheese
taco chips
preparation: Mix cream cheese and sour cream; spread on plate.  Add remaining ingredients.  Top with sauce and shredded cheese. Amounts for each ingredient can vary depending upon how much you want to make.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1  c. coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
2  c. marshmallows
1  c. sour cream
1  c. pineapple chunks, drained
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Chill for 1 hour.

name: CHOCOLATE OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
1  c. peanut butter
3  c. quick oatmeal
preparation: Mix together on medium heat the sugar, cocoa, milk, margarine and salt.  Bring to a boil.  Boil for 1 minute.  Remove from heat. Add vanilla and peanut butter.  Stir quickly to dissolve peanut butter.  Add oatmeal.  Stir until evenly coated.  Drop on waxed paper or cookie sheet and cool.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  egg, slightly beaten
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
2 1/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together egg, sugar and shortening.  Add rest of ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: ANGEL FLAKE BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. self-rising flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
3/4  c. liquid shortening
2  pkg. yeast, dissolved in 1/4 c. lukewarm water
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Combine buttermilk, shortening and yeast mixture.  Add flour and sugar.  Stir until flour is moist.  Roll, cut and bake at 400° about 12 minutes.  Or place batter in greased bowl, cover and store in refrigerator.  Take out amount as needed.

name: WALDORF SALAD
ingredients:
4  to 5 medium apples
4  oz. sour cream
1/4  c. mayo
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Chop apples.  Mix all ingredients.  Chill and serve.

name: BETTER THAN POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. cooked long grain rice
8  radishes, sliced
4  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
1  medium cucumber, chopped and seeded
2  c. thinly sliced celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise (Miracle Whip can be used)
3  Tbsp. prepared mustard
3/4  tsp. salt
preparation: In a large bowl, combine rice, radishes, eggs, cucumber, celery and onion. Combine mayonnaise or Miracle Whip, mustard and salt. Mix well. Pour over rice mixture and toss. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Serves 12 to 14.

name: CHILI DIP
ingredients:
1  c. Hormel chili with beans
1 small  pkg. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Melt cheese with chili.  Serve with corn chips.

name: LEMON COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sweet butter
1  egg, beaten
3/4  c. almonds, ground
3 1/4  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
2  c. sugar
2  egg whites, beaten
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  egg white
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Cream butter with sugar until light and fluffy.  Blend in beaten egg and whites.  Add almonds and vanilla; stir well. Gradually add flour, stirring well between each addition.  Drop cookie dough in balls onto greased cookie sheet.  Brush cookies with mixture of 1 egg white, 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar and 2 tablespoons lemon juice.  Bake in preheated oven at 325 ° for 20 to 25 minutes, or until light, golden brown.  Makes 3 dozen cookies.

name: PEPPER RELISH
ingredients:
12  medium chopped green peppers
12  medium chopped red peppers
3  large chopped onions
1 1/2  pt. cider vinegar
2  c. granulated sugar
2  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Mix peppers and onions together.  Cover with boiling water and let stand for 10 minutes; drain.  Cover again with boiling water and bring all ingredients back to a boil.  Remove from heat and let stand 10 minutes.  Drain.  Mix remaining ingredients with pepper/onion mixture and cook over medium heat about 15 minutes. Ladle into pint jars and seal while hot.  Makes 6 pints.

name: RYETA'S CHICKEN RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 or 3  lb. chicken
1  can celery soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can condensed milk
1  pkg. dry onion soup
1 small  box instant rice
1  can water
preparation: Lightly grease a 9 1/2 x 11-inch cake pan with lid.  Sprinkle box of rice in bottom of pan.

name: VEGETABLE QUICHE
ingredients:
1  can crescent rolls
1  bag frozen broccoli
1  bag frozen carrots
1  bag frozen cauliflower
onion flakes to taste
1/3  c. butter
black pepper to taste
garlic salt to taste
2  eggs, beaten
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese
1 1/2  Tbsp. parsley
1/8  tsp. basil
1/8  tsp. oregano
preparation: Crust: Remove crescent rolls from can and put all points together in a 10-inch pie plate.

name: TACO BEAN DIP
ingredients:
1  can refried beans
1/2  pt. sour cream
4  oz. cream cheese
1/2  pkg. taco seasoning
1/2  c. cheese
preparation: In a small bowl mix all ingredients except cheese.  Put mixture in a pan and sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 350° until hot and cheese melts.

name: TACOS VERDE, BLANCO, Y ROJO(Green, White and Red Tacos)
ingredients:
1  small onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  pickled serrano or jalapeno peppers, rinsed, seeded and chopped or 1/2 tsp. crushed red pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. chopped, cooked chicken breasts or pork
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
12  (6-inch) tortillas
2  c. guacamole
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Cook onion in the 1 tablespoon oil until tender; stir in tomato sauce, peppers and salt.  Simmer, covered, for 5 minutes.  Stir in chicken or pork; heat thoroughly.  Keep warm.  In small skillet, heat the 2 tablespoons oil.  Holding tortillas with tongs, dip each tortilla in the hot oil for about 10 seconds or just until limp. Drain on paper toweling.

name: CHILI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. hamburger
1  pkg. chili mix
1 large  can tomato sauce
2  cans kidney beans
3/4  box rotini (squiggly noodles)
1  pkg. Monterey Jack or Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cook noodles and set aside. Shred cheese and set aside.  Brown hamburger and drain. Then add chili mix, tomato sauce and beans. Layer with half of chili mixture, cheese and noodles.  Repeat. Bake at 350° until bubbly.

name: EASY PORK AND RICE
ingredients:
1  stick butter or margarine
4  pork chops
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
1  c. uncooked rice
preparation: Melt butter in casserole; place pork chops in melted butter. Sprinkle soup mix over pork chops; add rice.  Pour enough water into casserole to cover pork chops.  Cover; bake at 350° for 1 hour.  A little more water may be added if needed.

name: REFRIGERATOR BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. boiling water
2  c. seedless raisins
5  tsp. baking soda
1  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. salt
4  c. All Bran cereal
2  c. 40% Bran Flakes
1  qt. buttermilk
5  c. sifted plain flour
1  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Pour boiling water over raisins and All Bran cereal.  Add soda to this and set aside to cool.  Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs, one at a time, beating well.  Add buttermilk to sugar mixture.  Sift flour into bowl, saving 1/2 cup to flour nuts.  Add salt and 40% Bran Flakes to flour.

name: WILD RICE AND LEEK PILAF
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. wild rice
2  lb. leeks, coarsely chopped (white part only)
3 1/2  c. or more chicken stock
1/2  tsp. dried thyme, crumbled
6  Tbsp. unsalted butter
1  c. diced, peeled carrots
2/3  c. converted white rice
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. freshly ground pepper
preparation: Cook wild rice in a large amount of boiling water 10 minutes. Drain well.   Melt butter in heavy large saucepan over medium heat. Add leeks and carrots and cook until beginning to soften, about 5 minutes.  Mix in wild and converted rice. Add 3 1/2 cups stock, salt and thyme and bring to simmer.  Reduce heat to low, cover and cook until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender, adding more stock if necessary, 30 to 35 minutes. Mix in pepper. Adjust seasoning. (Can be prepared 20 minutes ahead, covered and kept warm.)  Makes 6 servings.

name: HEAVENLY PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  medium container Cool Whip
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  pkg. pecan pieces
2  graham cracker crusts
preparation: Stir in Eagle Brand milk and 2 tablespoons lemon juice.  Drain crushed pineapple.  Add to mixture.  Add the Cool Whip and blend all together.  Add pecan pieces and mix.  Pour mixture into graham cracker crusts and chill.

name: LEMON BREAD
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
grated rind of lemon
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and eggs together.  Add milk and grated rind of lemon.  Mix in flour, baking powder and salt.  Pour into greased loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 55 to 65 minutes.  Cool.  While warm, drizzle glaze over top.

name: RABBIT BARBECUE
ingredients:
1  large rabbit or 2 small
4  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. vinegar
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. dry mustard
4  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. salt
1  dash pepper
preparation: Cook rabbit until well done.  Take off bone and chop up. Combine all other ingredients.  Bring to boil and add rabbit meat. Simmer until about dry.

name: CRUMB TOPPING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  drops vanilla
1  stick butter, softened
1  c. flour
preparation: With a fork, mix first 3 items.  Add flour and use hand to crumble.  Put on coffee cake (13 x 9-inch) pan and bake for 35 minutes at 350°.  This recipe is over 100 years old.

name: GRANDMA LANCASTER'S RAISIN CAKE(No Eggs or Milk Products)
ingredients:
2  c. sugar, white or brown
2  c. boiling water
1  c. Crisco
1  lb. raisins
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts or dried fruit (optional)
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
4  c. flour
preparation: Mix sugar, water, spices and Crisco; bring to boil and boil 3 minutes.  Cool.  Mix soda and baking powder in small amount of water; pour into cooked mixture.  Add flour and nuts.  Pour into Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  "Old family recipe."

name: HOBO DINNER
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  small onion, diced
2  medium potatoes, sliced
1  can Campbell's golden mushroom soup
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
3/4  c. water
preparation: Brown ground beef and diced onions. Drain. Spray 9 x 13-inch baking dish with Pam cooking spray. Transfer drained ground beef and onions into baking dish and spread evenly over bottom of dish. Layer sliced potatoes over ground beef and onions. Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese over potatoes. In separate bowl, mix golden mushroom soup and water. Blend thoroughly. Pour soup mixture over cheese layer. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PIE
ingredients:
4  tsp. soft butter or margarine
3/4  c. sugar
1  container Egg Beaters (4 eggs)
2  c. milk (regular or skim)
1/2  c. fat-free ???
1  c. coconut
preparation: Put above ingredients, one at a time, into a blender on low speed.  Mix.  Then pour into a 9-inch pie plate.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple
2  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
bread crumbs
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients.  Top with bread crumbs.  Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.  Serve with ham.

name: DROP COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs, separated
4  tsp. baking powder
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Cream shortening, vanilla and sugar together until light and fluffy.  Continue creaming while adding well beaten eggs slowly. Sift flour, baking powder and salt together and add alternately with milk to creamed mixture.  Drop small portions of mixture on greased baking sheet; in 400° oven, bake for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 72 cookies.

name: STRAWBERRY BUTTER SPREAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  carton frozen strawberries
1  c. unsalted butter
1/2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.  Mix well until blended and smooth. Store in refrigerator.  Delicious on toast or hot rolls.

name: CURRIED HAM
ingredients:
1  can consomme
1/2  c. chopped celery
little oleo
little cornstarch
small amount coconut
chopped ham
small onion
1  tsp. curry powder
preparation: Note:  You may use chopped chicken or shrimp instead of ham.

name: CHERRY CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) graham cracker or baked pastry shell crust
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1/3  c. lemon juice from concentrate
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.  Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into prepared crust.  Chill 3 hours.  Top with pie filling before serving.

name: MRS. GRIFFIN'S PERSIMMON PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. persimmon
1  c. milk
1  egg
1  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
preparation: Press persimmons through a colander. Add sugar to persimmons. Then add milk, egg and dry ingredients. Bake in shallow pan for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: LUSCIOUS GRAPE PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Concord grapes
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1  egg
3  Tbsp. butter
9-inch pie shell
preparation: Place grapes in uncooked pie crust.  Mix sugar, flour and egg well; spread over the grapes.  Add the top crust.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.  Reduce temperature to 350° and bake approximately 25 minutes longer.

name: MY FAMILY'S CHRISTMAS EGGS
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage (regular or hot), browned, drained and set aside
2 1/4  c. milk
10  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
3  slices (about 2 c.) cubed bread
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Brown and drain sausage and set aside.  Add eggs, mustard, milk and salt.  Beat one minute on medium.  Stir in cheese, bread and sausage.  Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan, ungreased. Bake 30 to 40 minutes.  Can be doubled, tripled or quadrupled.

name: CHICKEN FINGERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. sesame seed
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1  lb. chicken breasts, skinned, boned and sliced into 2 x 1-inch strips
2  tsp. olive oil
1  red leaf lettuce
strips of orange rind
preparation: In a small bowl, combine sesame seed and Parmesan cheese. Roll chicken pieces in sesame mixture.  Heat oil in ovenproof heavy-bottomed nonstick skillet or saute pan, until just below smoking point.  Add chicken strips and brown on both sides over medium-high heat; do not scorch.  Place chicken strips on cookie sheet and bake in preheated 425° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until cooked through.  To serve, arrange chicken strips on plates with lettuce leaves and garnish with orange rind.  Serve with honey-mustard sauce.

name: ZUCCHINI PIE
ingredients:
4  c. sliced zucchini
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. oleo
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
2  eggs
1  c. shredded Swiss
2  tsp. mustard
1  can crescent rolls
preparation: Arrange rolls in pie plate.  Sprinkle with mustard; set aside. Cook zucchini and onion in oleo 10 minutes.  Add spices.  Beat eggs well.  Add cheese.  Mix all together.  Pour in pie pan.  Bake at 375° for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: LOW-FAT FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
6  egg whites
1/2  c. nonfat milk
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. orange extract (optional)
4 to 6  slices whole wheat bread or oat bran
preparation: You will also need Pam spray.

name: KOOL-AID PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. lime kool-aid  (any other flavor may be used)
2  cups sugar
2  quarts water
1 46  oz. can pineapple juice
1  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except ginger ale, and chill.  Add chilled ginger ale at serving time and float pineapple or lime sherbet on top.  Serves 24.

name: MAMA MARY'S RASPBERRY SLUSH
ingredients:
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
2 1/2  c. fresh raspberries or 2 pkg. frozen
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1 (6 oz.)  can pure lemon juice
4  c. sugar
2 or 3  pkg. instant raspberry flavored unsweetened punch mix
lemon-lime beverage, chilled
preparation: Combine pineapple juice, raspberries, lemonade, lemon juice, sugar and punch mix.  Add water to make 2 gallons; blend thoroughly.  Freeze 24 hours or longer.  Remove from freezer 2 hours before serving. Chop through mixture; spoon into serving glasses, 2/3 full.  Add lemon-lime carbonated beverage to fill. Garnish with whole berries and mint sprigs.

name: EASY COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. milk
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  stick butter
2  c. berries
1/2  c. sugar
3 to 4  tsp. cornstarch
preparation: Melt butter in 9 x 9-inch pan.  Mix flour, milk, sugar and baking powder and pour in pan.  Mix berries, sugar and cornstarch and pour on top of flour mix.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Double recipe for 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: HOPE PIES
ingredients:
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can sliced peaches
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. grated orange rind
1  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. margarine or shortening
1  egg
1/3  c. peach syrup
2  Tbsp. sugar
brown sugar cinnamon
preparation: Drain peaches and save 1/3 cup syrup.  Place peaches in buttered baking dish.  Sprinkle with 4 tablespoons sugar and orange rind.  Heat in oven while preparing batter.  Sift flour once; measure.  Add salt and baking powder and sift again.  Work in margarine.  Add beaten egg and peach syrup.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
2 -44  oz. Heinz ketchup
1 medium size  jar of mustard
2 1/2  C. white vinegar
1 1/2  C. lemon juice
1 1/2  C. brown sugar
Little salt
1/2 small  box of red & black pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Makes 1 gallon.

name: HOT CHIPPED BEEF DIP
ingredients:
2 (2 1/2 oz.)  jars dried beef, cut in small pieces
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
4  Tbsp. milk
1  c. sour cream
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
salt and pepper to taste
dash of parsley
dash of Tabasco
preparation: Mix well.  Place in ovenproof dish.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.  Best for dipping with any kind of chips.

name: ZUCCHINI APPLE PIE
ingredients:
4  c. zucchini, peeled and diced or sliced thin
1/2  c. apple juice
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/8  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  (9-inch) pie shell, unbaked
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Bring  zucchini,  apple  juice, lemon juice, spices and margarine to  a  boil; boil for 3 minutes.	Add cornstarch and water, stirring  constantly.  Cook	1 minute more; remove from heat.  Place  in  uncooked	pie shell; add top crust.  Bake at 450° for 25 minutes.

name: CHEESE POTATOES
ingredients:
5  large potatoes
4  Tbsp. green peppers, chopped
1 1/2  tsp. pimiento, chopped
6  Tbsp. onion, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. grated cheese
1  stick oleo, sliced
1  Tbsp. parsley
1/4  c. milk
preparation: Cut potatoes into slices.  Mix all ingredients and put in casserole sprayed with Pam.  Pour 1/4 cup milk over top.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until done.  Stir once while baking.

name: NEW ORLEANS BUTTER PRALINES
ingredients:
2  c. granulated sugar
1  c. light brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. unsalted butter
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. light corn syrup
3  c. pecan halves
2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Place 2 large parchment paper sheets on baking sheets (butter parchment sheets).  Set aside.  Combine all ingredients, except vanilla, in a heavy, 2-quart saucepan over medium heat.  Bring to a boil, stirring often.  Cook to soft ball stage (234°).  Remove from heat; stir in vanilla.  Stir briskly, until mixture loses its glossy sheen.  Working quickly, drop by teaspoons onto buttered paper.  Let cool completely.  Remove and store in airtight container.  Makes 2 dozen.

name: BOILED CUSTARD
ingredients:
1  qt. milk (lukewarm)
2  Tbsp. flour
4  egg yolks
1/5  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Add milk slowly to other ingredients.  Cook in double boiler until thick.  Stir constantly.   Remove from heat.  Add vanilla. Chill at once.

name: CHEESY POTATOES
ingredients:
6  to 8 medium potatoes
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. butter
1  tsp. salt
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. pepper
8  oz. sour cream
2  c. grated cheese
bacon bits
preparation: Boil potatoes with skins.  Cool; grate.  In a saucepan, heat milk,  butter,  salt,  pepper and sour cream.  Put grated potatoes in  a  greased  dish.  Pour  saucepan  mixture  over potatoes. Bake  45  minutes at 350°.	Spread cheese over top, then bacon bits.

name: CHICKEN BITS
ingredients:
4  whole, boneless, skinless chicken breasts
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. herb-seasoned croutons, crushed
oil for frying
preparation: Cut chicken in bite-size  pieces.  Dip	in  beaten eggs then in crumbs.	Fry in	hot oil until lightly browned.	Serve hot with dips.  Can be  made  ahead	and  re-heated	in  oven. Makes about 4 dozen.

name: BRACIOLA
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak, without fat removed (surrounds outer part of meat, 1 inch thick)
1  piece short rib with bone left in
2  large garlic cloves, chopped
2  fresh broccoli leaves, chopped
4  sprigs fresh parsley, chopped
1/4  c. oil
1/4  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Spread meat with garlic, basil and parsley.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Roll up like a jelly roll and tie with butcher's string. Brown in a little oil and water on top of the stove along with the short rib.  Lower the heat and continue cooking until done.  Slice and serve or can be put whole in your meat sauce along with the meats for extra flavor.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. brown sugar
6  Tbsp. granulated sugar
1/2  c. margarine
1  egg
3/4  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. quick oats
1  c. chips
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream sugars and margarine.  Add egg and vanilla.  Mix in flour, soda and salt.  Then add oats, chips and pecans.

name: BROWN AND SERVE ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. scalded milk
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. butter (oleo)
1  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. lukewarm water
5 to 6  c. all-purpose flour
preparation: Scald milk; add sugar, salt and butter.  Cool to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in water.  Add to milk.  Add enough flour to make soft dough. Knead lightly.  Place in greased bowl.  Brush top with melted butter.   Cover; let rise until double in bulk.  Shape into rolls.  Brush top with melted butter.  Cover and let rise until double in bulk.  Bake in 250° oven for 20 minutes.  Remove from pan; butter top.

name: BUBBLE AND SQUEAK
ingredients:
2  c. leftover mashed potatoes
1  c. leftover chopped cabbage, cooked
salt and pepper to taste
bacon (approximately 4 strips)
preparation: Cook bacon in skillet; remove bacon.  Mix together potatoes, cabbage and seasoning.  Flatten mixture in skillet.  When browned on one side, turn and brown on the other.  May add crumbled bacon to mixture.

name: HOME MADE BUNS
ingredients:
1  cake yeast, softened in 1/4 c water
4  c lukewarm water
3/4  c crisco
2  tsp salt
1  c sugar
3  lrg eggs
12  c flour
preparation: Measure flour, put 6 cups in pan to mix with remaining ingredients.  Mix the other 6 cups of flour 1/2 cup at a time until all flour is mixed in.  The dough will be soft.  Do not use any more flour than what is called for.  Grease sides and bottom of pan and knead the dough for about 5 minutes.  Let rise to double it's size.  Mix down and let rise again.  Make into buns, let rise to double their size and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350 degrees.

name: CHOCOLATE COVERED CHERRIES
ingredients:
2  lb. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  can Eagle Brand milk
12  oz. pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  cake paraffin wax
1/2  stick margarine, melted
2 (10 oz.)  bottles maraschino cherries
preparation: Freeze	cherries  overnight  on  a  flat  surface.  Mix sugar, vanilla, milk and margarine.  Seal frozen cherries in a small piece  of dough.  Roll into a ball.  Place in refrigerator for at least 20 minutes.

name: MILLION DOLLAR PIE
ingredients:
1  can condensed milk
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. coconut
1  pkg. dry whipped topping mix
1/4  c. lemon juice
preparation: Mix the condensed milk with the pineapple, nuts and coconut. Fold in the whipped topping mix, whipped according to instructions on the package.  Add the lemon juice.  Can be used in either a graham cracker crust or plain baked pastry.  Top with the same whipped topping mix (whipped).   Garnish with crushed nuts and pineapple, then refrigerate.

name: RASPBERRY SALAD JELLO MOLD
ingredients:
1 large or 2 small  pkg. raspberry jello
1  (15 oz.) applesauce
1 small  pkg. frozen raspberries
preparation: Prepare jello as directed on package.  Add applesauce and raspberries.  Mold and refrigerate.

name: CREAMED MEAT(No. K-75)
ingredients:
25  lb. meat carcass or 17 lb. ground meat
1  lb. (1 qt.) onions, chopped or 1 1/2 oz. (12 Tbsp.) dehydrated onions (optional)
1  lb. (1 pt.) bacon or meat fat
1 1/2  lb. (1 1/2 qt.) flour, sifted
16 (14 1/2 oz.)  cans evaporated milk
2  gal. (8 qt.) beef stock or water (for milk)
salt to taste
1/4  oz. (1 Tbsp.) pepper
100  slices bread, toasted
preparation: Cut meat into 1-inch pieces; grind.  Cook meat in its own fat until brown, stirring frequently.  Cook onions in bacon fat; add flour and mix thoroughly.  Mix milk and beef stock or water; heat. Add hot milk to fat and flour mixture gradually.  Heat to boiling point; boil 1 minute, stirring constantly.  Add salt and pepper. Pour sauce over meat; simmer until meat is well done, but not overcooked.  Serve on toast.  Yields 100 servings.

name: BRAN APPLE MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. bran flakes
1  egg
1  c. chopped unpeeled apple
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. corn oil
1 1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/4  tsp. soda
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. apple juice or milk
preparation: Combine flakes and juice or milk.  Let set 5 minutes.  Sift dry ingredients together.  Add oil and egg to flakes mixture, then dry ingredients and chopped apple.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. rice
2  c. water
2  qt. milk
1 1/2  c. sugar to taste
cinnamon to taste
1  blanched whole almond (Swedish custom)
preparation: Makes a large bowl of rice pudding.  Enough to feed a large group, but the recipe can be cut in half.

name: CROCK-POT APPLE BUTTER
ingredients:
8  c. applesauce or cooked apples
1  c. or 1/2 c. cider vinegar
5  c. sugar
cinnamon
preparation: Stir all together.  Turn pot on high.  Cook 4 hours with lid on.  Remove lid and stir occasionally the first 4 hours.  Cook another 4 hours without the lid on.  Makes 6 to 7 pints.

name: CRESCENT ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. milk, scalded
1/2  c. shortening
1/4  c. sugar
4 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  pkg. yeast
3  beaten eggs
preparation: Combine milk, shortening, sugar and salt.  Cool to lukewarm. Add yeast and stir well.  Add eggs, then flour.  Mix to a smooth, soft dough.  Knead lightly on a floured surface.  Place dough in a greased bowl; cover with a wet cloth and let rise until at least doubled in bulk.  Divide dough in thirds.  Roll each third on lightly floured surface to a 10-inch circle.  Brush with melted butter.  Cut each circle into 8 to 12 wedge-shaped pieces.  Roll each wedge, starting with the wide end and rolling to the point. Arrange on a greased baking sheet and brush with melted butter. Cover and let rise until light.  Bake at 400° to 425° for 15 minutes or less.  If desired, brush with a brown sugar and water glaze.

name: PISTACHIO SALAD
ingredients:
1  small bag marshmallow
1  can fruit cocktail
1  can mandarin oranges
1  can crushed pineapple
1  box pistachio pudding
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Mix all together.  Refrigerate.

name: BAKED TOMATOES
ingredients:
1  qt. cooked tomatoes
3  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. flour
3  Tbsp. margarine
1  tsp. vanilla or little nutmeg
preparation: Mix together all ingredients.  Place into greased casserole dish.  Bake 40 minutes at 350° to 375°.

name: FROZEN LEMONADE PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 small  carton Cool Whip
1 small  can frozen lemonade
1  graham cracker pie shell
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie shell.  Freeze.

name: PEANUT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. chicken, cooked and diced
1  c. celery, finely diced
2  Tbsp. onion, grated
2  Tbsp. pimiento, chopped
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. roasted peanuts, chopped
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/4  c. salad dressing
dill weed to taste
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Mix well.  Serve as a sandwich filling, stuffed in a tomato or on lettuce.

name: TRIPLE GOOD BARS
ingredients:
2  c. raisins
1  Tbsp. grated lemon peel
1  c. margarine or butter, softened
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/3  c. firmly packed brown sugar
2 1/2  c. oatmeal
1 1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
1/4  tsp. salt (optional)
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  In medium saucepan, combine raisins, condensed milk, lemon peel and lemon juice.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, just until mixture starts to bubble.  Remove from heat; cool slightly and set aside.  Beat margarine, sugar and vanilla until fluffy.  Add remaining ingredients; blend until evenly mixed and crumbly. Reserve 2 cups.  Press remaining mixture onto bottom of prepared pan.  Spread raisin mixture to within 1/2-inch of edge of pan. Sprinkle with remaining oat mixture; pat lightly.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.  Cool and cut into bars.

name: BACON WRAPPED CHICKEN BREAST
ingredients:
4  to 6 boneless chicken breasts
4 to 6  slices ham
4 to 6  slices cheese
8 to 12  slices bacon
preparation: Pound boneless chicken breast until 1/4-inch thick.  Sprinkle halves with salt and pepper.  Top each piece of chicken with 1 slice ham and 1 slice of cheese.  Fold chicken over ham and cheese.  Wrap each bundle in 2 strips of bacon and place in shallow baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until chicken is cooked and bacon is browned.

name: GRANDMA'S RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  qt. milk
4  Tbsp. rice
4  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together the milk, rice, sugar, salt and vanilla.  Bake for 2 to 3 hours at 350°.  Stir once in a while.

name: SAUSAGE/EGG BRUNCH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. herbed seasoned croutons
2 1/2  c. grated cheese
1 1/2  lb. sausage
2 1/2  c. milk
6  eggs
3/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  can milk
preparation: Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan croutons, cheese and sausage (cooked and drained) in pieces.  Beat together milk, eggs and dry mustard and pour over first mixture.  Cover and refrigerate overnight. Before baking mix together 1/2 can of cream of mushroom soup with 1/2 can milk. Pour over mixture in pan.  Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours, uncovered, or until firm.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1 large  can cream
3/4 (18 oz.)  jar peanut butter
preparation: Mix sugar and cream; bring to boil on stove until mixture forms soft ball stage in cold water.  Take off stove and stir in peanut butter.  Stir until candy is hard.  Pour out into platter and cut into squares.

name: ULTIMATE CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter flavor Crisco
1 1/4  c. firmly packed light brown sugar
2  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  egg
1 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  c. coarsely chopped pecans
preparation: If nuts are omitted, add an additional 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips.

name: RAINBOW JELLO
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange jello
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime jello
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon jello
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello (do not use cherry)
2 (12 oz.)  cans Carnation evaporated milk (can use fat-free)
preparation: First Layer:  In bowl, mix 1 package jello with 1 1/2 cups boiling water until jello is dissolved.  Cool until lukewarm. Pour into 9 x 13 pan.  Refrigerate for 30 to 40 minutes until jello sets.

name: APPLE SLICES
ingredients:
4  c. flour
2  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/3  c. oil
6  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Mix with fork.  Put 2/3 in jelly roll pan.  Press into pan. Save 1/3 to crumble on top.  Add a little more flour and sugar to this, about 2 tablespoons flour and 1 teaspoon sugar.

name: SPINACH DIP FOR HOLLOWED OUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed, drained and squeezed
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
1 small  can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
preparation: Cut top of bread off; cut out inside of bread to form bowl. Use top and inside to make wedges to spread dip on. You will probably need to double recipe for most loaves.

name: BATTER DIPPED SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1/2  tsp. dried basil
1  c. beer
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. Swiss cheese
2 (4 oz.)  pkg. sliced cooked ham
4  oz. sliced cooked turkey breast
1/4  c. mustard
8  slices white bread
vegetable oil
preparation: In bowl with fork, beat together flour, baking soda, salt, oregano, basil and beer until well blended to make batter.  Cut cheese, ham and turkey slices in half crosswise.  Spread mustard evenly on one side of each bread slice.  Top mustard side of 4 bread slices with cheese, ham and turkey slices, dividing evenly and trimming to fit.  Place remaining bread slices on top, mustard side down to make 4 sandwiches; press each sandwich gently to seal.

name: STIR-FRIED BEEF AND BROCCOLI
ingredients:
12  oz. boneless round steak
4  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. dry sherry
2  tsp. sugar
4  oz. fresh broccoli
1 small  can baby corn-on-the-cob
3  Tbsp. cooking oil
2  green onions, sliced
1/2  c. beef broth (in can)
1  c. rice
preparation: For the Rice: Put 2 cups of water and 1 cup of long cooking rice in pan.   Turn burner on medium heat.  Bring to boil; cover and reduce heat to low.  Cook for about 12 minutes, or until water has evaporated and rice is sticky.  Remove from heat and leave covered until serving.

name: BROCCOLI AND MUSHROOM SAUTE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1  medium onion, thinly sliced
4  c. broccoli flowerets
8  oz. fresh mushrooms, quartered
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: In large  skillet,  melt  butter  and saute onion until tender.  Stir in broccoli, mushrooms, garlic, salt and pepper. Saute for one  or  two  minutes.  Cover  and  cook over medium heat, stirring  frequently	five  to  seven  minutes  or until broccoli is crispy.

name: LEMON STRAWBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large  box frozen strawberries in syrup, thawed
1/2  c. sugar
3 (6 oz.)  cans lemonade
1  liter ginger ale
1  bottle champagne
preparation: Stir first three ingredients together in punch bowl.  Pour in liquids.  Add ice.

name: HONEY-FRUIT SYRUP
ingredients:
3/4  c. unsweetened pineapple juice or orange juice
2  Tbsp. honey
2  tsp. cornstarch
1/8  tsp. ground ginger
1  c. sliced strawberries, raspberries, and/or blueberries
preparation: In a small saucepan, stir together pineapple juice, honey, cornstarch, and ground ginger.  Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly, cook and stir for 2 minutes more.  Stir in fruit.  Serve over pancakes, waffles or French toast.

name: SWEET POTATO BALLS
ingredients:
6  sweet potatoes
24  marshmallows
1  c. honey
1/2  c. black walnuts or 1/2 c. pecans
preparation: Peel and cook potatoes in water until soft.  Mash and let cool.  Form mashed sweet potatoes around marshmallows.  Dip in honey and roll in crushed nuts.  Place on cookie sheet and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 400°.

name: BREAKFAST COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine, melted
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. granulated sugar
2  beaten eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. oatmeal
1  c. cornflakes
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix melted margarine, brown sugar, granulated sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Blend in oatmeal and cornflakes.  Sift flour, baking soda, baking powder and add to first mixture.  (I add 1/2 cup raisins or chocolate chips.)  Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 11 to 14 minutes.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1 (16 oz.)  jar salsa (mild)
1  bag Mexican blend grated cheese
1  (8 oz.) bag tortilla chips
preparation: Blend cream cheese and sour cream.  Spread on 12-inch round tray.  Put salsa on top, then cheese.

name: CHEESE KRISPIES
ingredients:
8  oz. grated sharp cheddar cheese
2  c. flour
1  c. melted butter or margarine
2  c. fresh crisp rice cereal
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
Dash Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix all ingredients well with hands.  Roll into balls the size of a walnut.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet and press with the tines of a fork in a criss-cross pattern.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.  Cool on a cake rack. Serve at room temperature.  They freeze very well.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. hot water
1  stick butter
1/2  c. Crisco
1/2  c. cocoa
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
1/2  pt. sour cream
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In saucepan, put water, Crisco and butter.  Melt over heat until melted.  Remove from heat.  Add other ingredients except sour cream and nuts.  Fold in last.  Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes in large cookie sheet.

name: RASPBERRY CRISP
ingredients:
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. oatmeal
1/3  c. margarine
3  c. fresh or frozen and thawed raspberries
preparation: Use topping with peaches, cherries, blueberries, apples, etc.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar, divided
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. regular oats
1/2  c. butter, softened
3  c. peeled, sliced apples
preparation: Combine 1 cup sugar, flour and oats.  Cut butter into flour mixture until crumbly.

name: BROCCOLI CORN BREAD
ingredients:
2  boxes Jiffy cornbread mix
10  oz. broccoli, chopped
2  eggs
10  oz. cottage cheese
1  medium onion, chopped
1  stick butter
preparation: Mix together.  Melt 1 stick of butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CHERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1  stick melted margarine
1/2  c. chopped pecans
8  oz. cream cheese
8  oz. sour cream
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
large Cool Whip
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Mix flour, margarine and pecans.  Press into an oblong pan. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 325°.  Remove and cool in pan.  Mix cream cheese, sour cream, sugar and vanilla.  Fold in Cool Whip and spread mixture on crust.  Top with pie filling and chill.

name: PINEAPPLE UPSIDE-DOWN CAKE
ingredients:
1  box butter recipe cake mix (yellow)
2  cans sliced pineapple
1  stick butter
1  jar cherries
1/2  c. chopped pecans
3/4  c. light brown sugar
preparation: Melt 1 stick butter in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Mix brown sugar into melted butter.  Sprinkle nuts into butter and sugar mixture.  Arrange pineapple slices in mixture to cover bottom of dish.  Place cherries in center of pineapple rings.  Mix cake mix as directed and pour over mixture.  Bake at 350° in preheated oven 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Turn cake onto long cake plate or pan immediately past removing from oven.

name: CHEESE PANCAKES
ingredients:
3  c. flour
5  eggs
milk
sugar to taste
cottage cheese
preparation: Combine flour and eggs.  Add enough milk to make a thin batter (about half as thick as regular pancake mix).  Add sugar (as much as you want to make the batter sweet).  Fry pancakes on both sides.  Remove from pan; add cottage cheese in middle of pancake. Roll the pancake up.

name: COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine or butter
1  c. milk
1  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sugar
4  c. sliced and sweetened fruit or berries
preparation: Melt butter in an 8 x 12-inch dish.  Mix in milk, flour and sugar.  Arrange fruit on top.  Do not stir.  Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

name: BEER-BATTER FRIED WALLEYE
ingredients:
2  eggs, separated
2/3  c. beer
1  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. margarine, melted
1 1/2 to 2  lb. walleye
hot peanut oil
preparation: Beat egg yolks and beer together.  Gently stir flour and salt until blended.  Mix in margarine and allow to stand at room temperature 30 minutes.

name: EASY STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  lb. ground beef
1  bag egg noodles
salt and pepper to taste
sour cream
preparation: Cook noodles, drain almost but not all, liquid off and add browned ground beef, soup, salt and pepper.  Cook until desired thickness.  Let individuals spoon amount of sour cream desired on their serving.

name: PEANUT BUTTER SNOWBALLS
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. powdered milk
2 to 3  Tbsp. honey
shredded coconut
preparation: Mix all the ingredients until they form a ball.  If too crumbly, add honey.  Chill 1 1/2 hours.  Roll balls and cover with coconut.

name: DREAM BARS
ingredients:
1/4  c. shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs, well beaten
vanilla
2  tsp. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. coconut
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix together the first 4 ingredients.  Spread onto a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes; remove and set aside. Mix together the remaining 7 ingredients; spread over above mixture.  Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

name: JIFFY COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
3/4  c. milk
1/4  lb. oleo
1 large  can peaches
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and milk.  Melt 1/4 pound oleo in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Pour batter into pan on top of oleo. Top batter with one large can of sliced peaches and bake in 325° oven until batter rises to top.  After batter has risen to top, but before it is brown, sprinkle sugar-cinnamon mixture on top. Total baking time is 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: HONEY MUSTARD GRAVY
ingredients:
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can chicken gravy
2  tsp. Dijon-style mustard
1  tsp. honey
preparation: In saucepan combine ingredients.  Heat through, stirring constantly.  Serve over chicken or cooked vegetables.  Makes 1 cup.

name: OATMEAL COOKIE BARS
ingredients:
3  c. uncooked oats
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. margarine
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
fruit preserves or apple butter
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Press all but 1 cup mix into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.  Spread 1 1/2 to 2 cups fruit preserves or apple butter over mix.  Sprinkle remaining crumbs of mix over preserves. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes (until golden brown).  Cool and cut into bars.

name: CHERRY CHIFFON DESSERT
ingredients:
1 12  oz. can cherry or light cherry pie filing
1 14  oz. can sweetened condensed milk, or 1 c. plain yogurt
1 8  oz. container frozen whipped topping, thawed
1 15  oz. can crushed or chunk pineapple, drained
1  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Combine ingredients in large bowl, folding together until blended.  Spoon into serving bowl.  Chill.

name: CHICKEN STUFFED SHELLS
ingredients:
3  whole chicken breasts, chopped up
1  pkg. Stove Top stuffing mix
a little celery, onion and parsley
1/2  c. Miracle Whip dressing
1  box jumbo shell macaroni, cooked al dente
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1 soup  can water
preparation: Cook the whole chicken breasts; chop up.  Mix the stuffing mix with a little celery, onion and parsley.  Mix both chicken and stuffing mixture with the Miracle Whip.  Cook the macaroni al dente.  Stuff shells and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix the soup with the water; pour over stuffed shells.  Let stand 24 hours in refrigerator.  Cover with foil.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.  Makes about 36 shells.

name: HONEY ICING
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
3  Tbsp. honey
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Add all ingredients.  Blend with fork until smooth.  Makes 1 cup icing.

name: ITALIAN CORN CRUSTED BAKED FISH
ingredients:
2  c. chopped tomato
1/2  c. sliced ripe olives
2  Tbsp. minced garlic
1/4  c. olive oil
1  Tbsp. thyme or oregano, crushed
1  lb. any whitefish (cod, etc.), thawed, or fresh
1/2  c. yellow cornmeal
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Mix tomato, olives, garlic and olive oil in bottom of a 1 1/2-quart baking dish.  Separate fish fillets and cut smaller, if they are large.  Dip each in cornmeal seasoned with the salt, pepper and Parmesan cheese.  Put in casserole dish.  Bake at 450° for 20 to 25 minutes or until baked crusty.  Serve Parmesan cheese on top.  Makes 4 servings.

name: FRUIT COCKTAIL BARS
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/3  c. coconut
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
1 medium  can fruit cocktail with juice
preparation: Mix together and put in cookie sheet with edge on it.  Sprinkle top with coconut and walnuts.  Bake at 350° until done.  Put glaze on last.

name: SLAW FOR DEEP FREEZER
ingredients:
1  medium size head shredded cabbage
1  mango
1  carrot
2  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. mustard seed
1  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Place cabbage in salt water (1 teaspoon salt) and soak for 1 hour.

name: CARAMEL NUTS
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. light cream
2  Tbsp. light corn syrup
1  Tbsp. butter/margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. whole pecan halves
preparation: Combine sugars, cream and corn syrup in 1 1/2-quart saucepan. Cook to softball stage (236°).  Add butter and vanilla.  Remove from heat and cool to lukewarm (110°) without stirring.  Beat just until mixture begins to lose its gloss.  Add nuts and stir until well coated.  Turn out onto waxed paper.  Separate nuts with two forks and let cool completely.  Makes 4 cups of confection.  Store in airtight container.

name: APRICOT-GLAZED PEARS
ingredients:
1  can pear halves
1/3  c. apricot preserves
1/3  c. orange juice
preparation: Use an 8 x 8 x 2-inch or 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Place pears, cut side down.  Pour mixture of preserves (or jam) and juice over. Cover.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Garnish with ground nutmeg.  Great warm or cold.

name: FRENCH MEAT PIES
ingredients:
1  onion
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. mashed potatoes
2  tsp. cooking oil
salt and pepper to taste
1  egg, beaten (to brush pie crust)
2  pie crusts
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except egg, together.  Brush pie crust with egg.  Pour mixture into 1 pie crust.  Fold second pie crust over mixture.  Bake for 30 minutes at 375°.

name: JUST FOR KIDS: TINY TURTLE SALAD
ingredients:
canned pear halves (save the syrup)
4  pecan halves (per salad)
green food coloring
1  green olive (per salad)
2  cloves (per salad)
preparation: Empty syrup from canned pears into a small bowl.  Add a few drops of food coloring to syrup.  Soak pear halves in syrup until tinted green.

name: PIZZA PASTA
ingredients:
8  oz. Creamettes rigatoni, cooked as per pkg. directions
1 (26 oz.)  jar Classico Pecorino Romano and herb pasta sauce
1 (2 1/2 oz.)  pkg. sliced pepperoni
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. In large bowl, combine pasta, pasta sauce and pepperoni (reserve some pepperoni slices for topping). Coat 2-quart baking dish with vegetable cooking spray. Spoon mixture into dish. Top with cheese and reserved pepperoni. Cover. Bake 30 minutes or until hot.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1/4  c. butter
2  eggs
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. peanut butter
2 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
6  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream butter, shortening and sugars.  Add eggs and beat well. Sift dry ingredients and mix in by hand.  Stir in chocolate chips. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes on an ungreased cookie sheet. Makes about 7 dozen.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  medium potatoes
2  c. sour cream
10  oz. medium Cheddar cheese, grated
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
3/4  c. Brownberry's herb seasoned stuffing (green bag)
preparation: Cook, cool and grate potatoes.  Combine potatoes with sour cream, cheese, milk, salt and pepper.  Place in a greased 9 x 12-inch baking pan.  Top with herb seasoned stuffing.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: STACY'S SNICKER POPS
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  bag bite size Snickers
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Mix sugars, butter, peanut butter, vanilla and egg.  Add dry ingredients and mix well.  Take Snickers bar and form dough around to make a ball (covering completely).  Place on ungreased cookie sheet 3 inches apart.  Bake for 13 to 16 minutes. Cool and remove.  Enjoy!

name: GREATEST CASSEROLE EVER
ingredients:
Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice
2  c. cooked, diced chicken
16  oz. can drained whole kernel corn
16  oz. can diced tomatoes
1 1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Prepare rice according to package directions for 2 cups cooked rice.  Layer all ingredients                     in greased casserole in order given.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until cheese bubbles.

name: CHILI-CHEESE POTATOES
ingredients:
3  medium baking potatoes, unpeeled and cut into 1/2-inch slices
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. minced fresh parsley
1  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  small green onion, chopped
preparation: Combine potatoes and oil in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish; toss well.  Sprinkle potatoes with parsley, chili powder, salt and pepper.  Cover tightly with heavy-duty plastic wrap; fold back a small corner to wrap to allow steam to escape.  Microwave at High 9 to 10 minutes or until tender, stirring gently, every 3 minutes. Sprinkle potatoes with cheese and onion.  Let stand, covered, 5 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  bunch fresh broccoli
2/3  c. chopped green olives
1  small chopped onion
4  boiled eggs, chopped
1/2  c. mushrooms
preparation: If broccoli is not tender, cook 3 to 4 minutes.  Drain; cut up. Combine all salad ingredients.

name: ARTICHOKE APPETIZER
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. diced artichoke hearts
1  c. Parmesan cheese
dash of Tabasco
preparation: Cut up artichoke hearts and drain.  Mix in a cup of mayo and a cup of Parmesan cheese.  Sprinkle a dash of Tabasco and mix.  Put into dish and bake at 350° until brown and bubbly, approximately 20 to 25 minutes.

name: TUNA BROCCOLI CUPS
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  c. Bisquick baking mix
1/2  c. cold water
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can tuna, drained
preparation: Grease 12 muffin pan cups.  Cook broccoli as directed on package and drain.  Pat dry with paper towels.  Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms.  Beat vigorously 20 strokes.  Drop dough by spoonful into muffin cups.

name: CARIBBEAN DIET DRINK
ingredients:
1/2  papaya, sliced
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
approximately 10 to 12 ice cubes
preparation: Put all ingredients in a blender until ice is completely liquified.

name: EGGNOG
ingredients:
1  egg, well beaten
1 1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
few grains of salt
1/2  tsp. flavoring
preparation: Mix all together.

name: FROZEN PINK LEMONADE SUNDAE PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) baked pastry shell or graham cracker crumb crust
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1/2  c. ReaLemon juice
6 to 8  drops red food coloring
2  c. (1 pt.) whipping cream, whipped
