preparation: In a large mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.  Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.  Stir in bottled lemon juice and food coloring.  Fold in whipped cream.  Pour into prepared pastry shell.  Freeze or chill 6 hours or until firm.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.  Garnish as desired.  Freeze leftovers.  Makes one 9-inch pie.

name: WATERGATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  (19 oz.) yellow cake mix
1  c. oil
3  eggs
1  c. Seven-Up
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant pistachio pudding mix
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Beat 5 minutes at medium speed. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes.  Cool before cutting.

name: BANANA SPLIT SUPREME
ingredients:
1  stick melted margarine (crust)
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
2  sticks melted margarine (filling)
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  box 10x sugar
4  large bananas, sliced
1 large  can well drained, crushed pineapple
1/2  c. chocolate syrup
1 large  pkg. strawberries
1 large  carton Cool Whip
finely chopped pecans
preparation: Crust:  Mix the first stick of margarine and the graham crackers and pack in a 9 x 13-inch dish; chill.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can peaches
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. margarine, softened
1  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. flour
preparation: Place peaches including syrup in bottom of a greased 8 x 8-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle cinnamon on top.

name: HOT CIDER
ingredients:
1  c. instant tea (without lemon)
1 1/2  c. Tang
3/4  c. sugar
9  Tbsp. dry lemonade mix
3/4  tsp. ground cloves
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix all together. Store in jar with lid.  Use 2 to 3 teaspoons per cup of hot water or can be put in a large electric coffeepot for self serve. Add water to taste.

name: GRATINEED ZITI
ingredients:
1  medium onion, coarsely chopped
3  medium garlic cloves, finely chopped
2  Tbsp. extra virgin olive oil
1 (35 oz.)  can Italian peeled tomatoes
1/4  tsp. crushed red pepper
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
10  oz. dried ziti (about 3 c.)
1  lb. fresh spinach, stems discarded, thoroughly washed and coarsely chopped
6  oz. part skim Mozzarella cheese, cut in 1/2-inch diced pieces
1  c. freshly grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In a large skillet, cook onion and garlic in oil until onion is soft.  Break up tomatoes and add with juice to skillet.  Stir in crushed red pepper.  Increase heat and boil sauce.  Stir until liquid has evaporated (about 18 minutes).  Season with salt and pepper.  Keep warm.

name: BAKED SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes with liquid, cut up
1 (4 oz.)  can mushroom stems and pieces, drained
1 (2 1/4 oz.)  can sliced ripe olives, drained
2  tsp. dried oregano
1  lb. ground beef, browned and drained (optional)
12  oz. spaghetti, cooked and drained
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In a large skillet, saute onion and green pepper in butter until tender.  Add tomatoes, mushrooms, olives and oregano.   Add ground beef, if desired.  Simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Place half of the spaghetti in a greased 10 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Top with half of the vegetable mixture.  Sprinkle with 1 cup of Cheddar cheese.  Repeat layers.  Mix the soup and water until smooth; pour over casserole.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until heated through.  Yield:  12 servings.

name: JAMAICAN RUM COOKIES
ingredients:
2  tsp. dark rum
1/2  c. unsalted butter, softened
1  c. packed brown sugar
2  eggs
2  c. sifted cake flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
1/4  tsp. freshly grated nutmeg
2  c. seedless raisins, chopped
1/2  c. unsalted peanuts or cashews, chopped
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Lightly grease baking sheet and set aside.  In large bowl, cream together the rum, butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy.  Add the eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.  Sift together the flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg; then add to the rum-butter mixture.  Blend in the raisins and nuts.  Drop 1 teaspoon of the mixture at a time onto the prepared baking sheet. Allow for considerable spreading.  Bake until brown, about 10 minutes.  Be careful not to overbake.  Let cool on a wire rack before serving or store in an airtight container to improve the flavor.  Yield: 4 dozen cookies.

name: PEEL OFF POUNDS SOUP
ingredients:
6  large onions
2  green peppers
2  whole tomatoes
1  large head cabbage
1 large  bunch celery
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
preparation: Cut vegetables in medium size pieces.  Cover with water and boil for 10 minutes.  Lower heat.  Add soup mix and simmer until vegetables are soft.

name: SPICY BAKED BEANS(For A Group)
ingredients:
2 large  cans pork and beans
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. catsup
1/4  c. hickory barbecue sauce
1/4  c. Pace mild picante sauce (maybe more, depending on desired taste)
dash of Tabasco sauce
dash of wet mustard
preparation: Drain beans.  Mix all ingredients together.  Spray dish with Pam.  Top with bacon.  Bake at 350° about 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN-BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
bread crumbs, crushed
2  bunches broccoli, cooked 2 minutes
4  chicken breasts, boiled in salt water until done
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. milk
12  oz. sharp cheese, grated
2  cans cream of chicken soup
preparation: Line pan in this order:  Broccoli, cheese, chicken and bread crumbs.

name: OVEN-FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
3/4  c. dry bread crumbs
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. parsley
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. garlic powder or 1 clove of garlic, crushed
1/4  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. butter
2 1/2 to 3  lb. frying chicken, cut up
preparation: In a pie pan, combine crumbs, cheese, parsley, salt, thyme and pepper.  In an ungreased baking dish (3-quart), melt butter with garlic powder.  Dip chicken pieces in garlic-butter, then in crumb mixture.  Place in baking dish, skin side up.   Bake, uncovered, at 375°  for 55 to 65 minutes.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  cooked chicken
1  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can chicken broth
preparation: Pull chicken off bones and place in bottom of casserole.  Mix flour, baking powder and milk well.  Pour over chicken.   Then mix soup and broth and pour over mixture.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until brown around edge.

name: LEMON SAUCE
ingredients:
1/3  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
1  tsp. grated lemon peel
1  egg yolk *
2/3  c. water
1  Tbsp. butter or oleo
pinch of salt
preparation: Stir sugar and cornstarch together, then combine all ingredients in saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick and clear.

name: HOT SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  box powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 large  can cream
3/4  stick butter
preparation: Boil for 5 minutes.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
1  qt. sherbet (any flavor)
2  liters 7-Up, chilled
preparation: Put sherbet in punch bowl.  Pour chilled 7-Up over.  Stir. Ready to serve.

name: CHOCOLATE CRINKLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. oil
4  sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix oil, chocolate and sugar.  Blend in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla, flour and baking powder to chocolate mixture.  Chill well, 3 to 4 hours.  Roll into teaspoon size balls.  Roll in powdered sugar.  Place on greased baking sheet 2 inches apart. Bake 10 minutes at 350°.  Do not overbake.

name: BREAD AND BUTTER PICKLES
ingredients:
4  quarts sliced cucumbers
1/3  cup salt
2  red bell peppers
2  green bell peppers
8  small onions
1 1/2  tsp. turmeric
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
1/2  tsp. celery seed
5  cups granulated sugar
3  cups white vinegar
preparation: Slice cucumbers very thin.   Pour salt over sliced cucumbers and stir.  Cover with ice.  Let stand 3 hours.  Drain and rinse slightly.  mix cucumbers and spices in enamel kettle, bring to a boil.  Pack in sterilized jars while hot.  Seal immediately.

name: VANILLA, BUTTER AND NUT CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
2  sticks margarine
3  c. sugar
3  c. plain flour
1  c. sweet milk
1/4  tsp. salt
6  eggs
3  Tbsp. vanilla, butter and nut flavoring
preparation: Heat oven to 325°.  Grease a 10-inch tube pan and dust with flour.  Cream all shortenings together.  Add sugar and salt gradually.  Add eggs 1 at a time, beating after each addition. Add flavor to milk; then add alternately with flour to mixture. Put into prepared pan and bake at 325° about 1 1/2 hours or until done.  Cool 10 minutes in pan; then turn out on a rack to cool completely.

name: VELVEETA FUDGE
ingredients:
2  lb. sifted powdered sugar
1/2  c. Hershey's cocoa
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese, melted
1/2  lb. butter
1/2  Tbsp. vanilla
nuts, optional
preparation: Mix Velveeta cheese and butter.  Gradually add dry ingredients.  Add vanilla  and nuts, if desired.  Pour into buttered pan (cookie sheet) and refrigerate for an hour.  Cut in squares.  Keep refrigerated and can be frozen.

name: KNORR SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup  mix
1  pkg. chopped spinach, frozen
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
3  green onions
preparation: Squeeze all liquid from the spinach; chop onions and water chestnuts.  Mix mayonnaise, sour cream and soup mix.  Fold in spinach, onions and chestnuts.  Cover and chill for 2 hours.  Stir before serving.  Makes 4 cups.

name: HAM ROLLS
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 1/2  tsp. grated onion
2  tsp. horseradish
dash of Worcestershire sauce
1/2  lb. thinly sliced boiled ham
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients.  Then spread on ham slices and roll. Chill.  Cut in thin slices about 1/4 inch thick.  Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

name: MARINATED SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans white corn or hominy
1  can French-style green beans
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  jar pimento, chopped
1/2  c. salad oil
1/2  c. vinegar
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix vegetables in large bowl.  Mix dressing ingredients and pour over vegetables.  Refrigerate overnight.  Serve chilled.

name: SPICY OYSTER CRACKERS
ingredients:
1  box or bag oyster crackers
1  pkg. original Ranch dressing mix
1/4  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Mix dressing mix and vegetable oil.  Put crackers into a large bowl; pour mixture over crackers.  Mix well.  Place on baking sheet in a 350° oven; bake until crackers are golden brown. When cool, place in Ziploc storage bags.

name: MEXICAN SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can Ranch Style beans, drained
3  c. shredded lettuce
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  large tomato, diced
1/4  c. chopped onion (optional)
1/2  c. Catalina dressing
preparation: Toss all ingredients together and top with Fritos.

name: PEACH COBBLER 2
ingredients:
2  cans (16 oz. each) Del Monte yellow cling sliced peaches, drained
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan; place peaches in bottom of pan and sprinkle with nutmeg.  Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt; set aside.  Combine butter, egg and milk; stir in sifted dry ingredients; mix well.  Spoon batter evenly over peaches; bake at 400° for 30 minutes.  Serve warm or cold with ice cream or whipped cream, if desired.

name: SZECHWAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
5  Tbsp. soy sauce
1 1/2  Tbsp. white wine vinegar
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
4  chicken breast halves, skinned and cut in 1/2-inch, diced
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
3  garlic cloves, minced
3  green onions, cut diagonally
freshly cooked rice
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients in small bowl.  Dredge chicken in cornstarch.  Heat oil in wok or heavy large skillet over medium-high heat.  Add chicken and garlic and stir-fry until chicken is opaque, about 5 minutes.  Add soy mixture and stir-fry for 30 seconds.  Mix in green onions.  Serve immediately with rice.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. green pepper
1/4  c. onion
2  c. mashed potatoes
1/4  c. celery
1 (12 oz.)  can whole kernel corn
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In a large skillet, saute beef, pepper, onion and celery about 10 minutes. Pour into large, greased casserole.  Drain corn and spoon over top.  Last spoon mashed potatoes evenly over all.  Bake in a 325° oven about 30 minutes or until brown.  Yields 6 servings.

name: APRICOT AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
7  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  (46 oz.) apricot nectar
1  (28 oz.) apricot halves
1  c. pecan pieces
1  angel food cake
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip (extra creamy)
preparation: Combine sugar and cornstarch in a 2-quart saucepan.   Stir in apricot nectar gradually.  Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.  Cook until mixture is thickened and clear, stirring constantly. Remove from heat.  Drain apricots, reserve 12 halves for decoration and chop remaining apricots.  Stir chopped apricots into cooked mixture. Add pecans.  Tear cake into bite-sized pieces.  Add to cooked mixture.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch dish.  Refrigerate overnight.  Top each serving with Cool Whip.  Place reserved apricot half, cut side down, on each. Yields 12 servings.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BLOSSOMS
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. shortening
1  egg
48  Hershey Kisses
preparation: Combine all ingredients except Hershey Kisses in large bowl. Mix on lowest speed until dough forms.  Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Top each with kiss, press firmly so cookie cracks around edge.

name: FRIED YAM STICKS
ingredients:
1  medium yam
1  tsp. each margarine and vegetable oil
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: On baking sheet, bake yam at 400° until just tender, 35 to 40 minutes (do not overbake); let yam cool, then peel and discard skin.  Cut potato into 2 x 1/4-inch sticks.

name: QUICK CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cherry gelatin
1  can cherry pie filling
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Stir in pie filling.  Pour into mold, if desired, and chill.  Whipped topping is good on the top.  Serves about 6.

name: OLD FASHIONED BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
10  c. bread cubes (soft)
4  c. milk, scalded with 1 stick butter
1 1/4  c. sugar
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
2 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. seedless raisins or mini chocolate chips
preparation: Heat oven  to  350°.  Place  bread cubes in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients;  mix.  If there is too much liquid, add more  bread  cubes.  Pour  into  a 9 x 13-inch pan and pat down evenly.  Place  pan  into  another,  larger  pan with hot water, 1-inch deep.  Bake for about 50 minutes, or until knife inserted 1 inch  from  edge  comes out clean.  Cool; cut into squares. Delicious warm or cold!

name: GUACAMOLE
ingredients:
2  or 3 ripe avocados
2  green onions and tops
salt, pepper, Tabasco sauce or Louisiana hot sauce as desired
1  chopped tomato
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
lemon juice
preparation: Pit, peel or scoop and mash avocados. Chop green onions and tops; add to avocados. Add tomato, 3 or 4 dashes of Tabasco sauce, lemon juice, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Mix well. Flavor improves with time. Put seed in mixture to avoid discoloration, but remove seed before serving.

name: FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. unsifted flour
1 large  can Hershey's chocolate syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. baking powder (omit if using self-rising flour)
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: APRICOT BARS
ingredients:
3/4  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
1  egg
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1 1/3  c. coconut
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 (12 oz.)  jar apricot preserves
preparation: In large bowl, cream margarine and sugar; add egg.  Mix well. Combine flour and baking powder.  Gradually add to butter mixture. Add coconut, walnuts and vanilla; mix well.  Press 2 thirds of dough in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Spread with preserves. Crumble rest of dough on top.   Bake until brown at 350°, for 30 minutes.

name: FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
1-  9 inch Graham crust
3  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
19  oz. drained fruit salad
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix drained fruit, sour cream, vanilla and sugar.  Spoon/pour into pie crust.  Bake for 35 minutes at 325 degrees.  Cool and refrigerate.  Serve cold.

name: DILL CHEESE BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. active dry yeast or 1 cake compressed yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1  c. cream-style cottage cheese
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. instant minced onions
2  tsp. dill weed
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  egg
2 1/3  c. flour
butter
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl.  Heat cheese to warm.  Stir into yeast mixture.  Stir in rest of ingredients except flour and butter.  Mix well.  Beat in flour gradually until completely blended.  Beat vigorously about 20 strokes.  (Dough will be sticky and heavy.) Cover; let rise until doubled in bulk. Stir down dough.  Spoon into 6-cup baking bowl.  Cover and let rise 45 minutes.  Bake in moderate oven (350°) for about 50 minutes.

name: MOM'S FUDGE
ingredients:
2/3  c. Hershey's cocoa
3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. milk
4 1/2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine cocoa with sugar and salt.  Add milk; bring to a boil, stirring frequently.  Cook until a small amount of mixture forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water.  Remove from heat, drop in butter, then cool to lukewarm.  Add vanilla and beat until mixture thickens.  Pour into buttered pan and cut in squares.

name: STOVE TOP APPLEBUTTER
ingredients:
12  C. applesauce
7  C. sugar
1  Tbsp. ground cloves
2  Tbsp. ground cinnamon
1  pkg. strawberry Koolaid
preparation: In large kettle put all ingredients.  Bring to boil.  Stir for 20 minutes.  Put in jars.  Yield:  6 - 6 1/2 pints.

name: CHICKEN AND STRING BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans French-style green beans, drained
1  pkg. Lipton chicken flavored rice
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. mayonnaise
2  c. shredded cheese
4  c. cooked chicken
1/2  c. chicken broth
preparation: Mix rice that has been cooked by directions. Sauté in a little oleo before mixing. Add mayonnaise with soup. Add 1 cup cheese to mixture and mix all ingredients. Put in buttered dish. Top with cheese. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°. This recipe freezes well.

name: SENSATIONAL DOUBLE LAYER PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
4  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. milk or half and half
1  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  c. thawed Cool Whip topping
1  graham cracker Ready-Crust
1  c. cold milk or half and half
2 (4 serving size)  pkg. vanilla flavor instant pudding
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Mix cream cheese, 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth.  Gently stir in whipped topping. Spread on bottom of crust.

name: CREAM PUFFS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. bread flour
1  c. boiling water
4  eggs, unbeaten
preparation: Add butter to water and heat until butter melts.  Add flour all at once and stir vigorously until ball forms in center of pan. Cool slightly.  Add eggs one at a time, beating after each egg. Mixture should be very stiff.  Shape on buttered cookie sheet by dropping from spoon or using pastry bag and tube.  Bake until free from beads of moisture for 40 to 45 minutes in 375° oven.  Fill with cream filling, whipped cream or Cool Whip.

name: LIME SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lime jello
16  large marshmallows
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. chopped maraschino cherries
1/2  pt. whipping cream
preparation: Dissolve jello in 2 cups hot water.   Add marshmallows and cream cheese.  Stir until melted.   Place in refrigerator until it begins to set.  Add crushed pineapple (drained), chopped nuts and cherries.  Fold in whipping cream.  Return to refrigerator until congealed.

name: PIEROGIES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
2/3  c. cool water
1  large onion, chopped
1/2  c. vegetable oil
4  large potatoes, cooked
pepper to taste
sour cream
melted butter
preparation: Mix flour with salt.  Add egg and water.  Knead lightly. Cover dough with towel and set aside.  Saute onion in vegetable oil; mash potatoes.  Add onion to potatoes and mix well.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.  Cool.  Roll dough thin.  Cut into rounds with water glass.  Hold round in palm of hand; place spoonful of filling in center.   Fold in half.  Press edges to seal; place on dry towel and cover.

name: SPAGHETTI AND BACON
ingredients:
1/2  lb. bacon, diced
1  medium onion, diced
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can tomatoes with liquid, cut up
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
8  oz. spaghetti, cooked and drained
preparation: In a skillet, brown bacon and onion until bacon is crisp; drain.  Add tomatoes and tomato sauce; bring to a boil.  Place cooked spaghetti in a 2-quart baking dish.  Pour sauce over; cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: CUCUMBERS IN SOUR CREAM
ingredients:
cucumbers
salt
ice
2/3  c. sour cream
dash of Tabasco
1 to 1 1/2  tsp. prepared mustard
1  Tbsp. sugar
flavored vinegar (wine, garlic or tarragon, etc.)
1  Tbsp. chopped chives or parsley or horseradish
preparation: Slice cucumbers thin.  Cover with salt.  Let stand in plenty of ice in bowl for about an hour.  Drain thoroughly; add to Sour Cream Dressing as follows:

name: CORNBREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1  chicken
1/2  lb. sausage
2  c. onion, chopped
2  c. celery, chopped
1  Tbsp. margarine
3  eggs
2  tsp. sage
2 1/2 to 3  c. chicken stock, hot
6 1/2  c. cornbread
4  c. bread, toasted OR biscuits
preparation: Put chicken in a 4-quart pan and add just enough water to cover chicken.  Boil until chicken is tender.  Reserve stock and 1 cup of chopped chicken for later use.

name: ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1/2  c. sugar
4 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. Crisco
3  eggs
preparation: Melt Crisco, then add milk; set aside.  Add all other ingredients together, except flour.  Pour in milk and Crisco, then add flour.  Knead well.  Let rise 1 1/2 hours.   Divide dough into 4 equal parts.  Roll 1/4-inch thick, spread with oleo and cut pie shaped.  Roll each piece up, starting at large end.  Place on cookie sheet.  May be frozen.  Take out what you want to cook. Let rolls rise before baking.

name: ORANGE CHIFFON CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. sifted flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. Wesson oil
5  unbeaten egg yolks
3/4  c. orange juice
2  tsp. vanilla
grated rind of 1 orange (2 tsp.)
preparation: Measure the first 4 ingredients together into mixing bowl. Make a well and add remaining ingredients in order.  Beat until smooth with electric mixer.

name: SIX LAYER SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. raw potatoes, sliced
1  c. raw onions, sliced
1  c. raw carrots, sliced
1/2  c. rice (uncooked)
1 1/2  c. canned tomatoes, including juice
1  lb. pork sausage (loose)
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Brown sausage in heavy skillet.  Drain off excess fat.  Place sausage in bottom of a 2-quart casserole.  Cover with layers of potatoes, onions, carrots and rice.  Add tomatoes with juice. Combine salt, pepper and sugar.  Sprinkle over top.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Makes 6 servings.

name: LIGHT ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1/2  c. warm water
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
approximately 6 1/2 c. all-purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
approximately 2 c. lukewarm water
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water; set aside.  Cream shortening and sugar; add egg and beat well.  Stir in 2 cups flour to which salt has been added.  Add 2 cups lukewarm water and 4 1/2 cups flour to make a soft dough.  Flour board and knead thoroughly.  Set aside to rise or put in refrigerator until needed.  Remove from refrigerator and knead again.  Roll and cut like biscuits.  Let rise for 4 to 5 hours.  Bake in a preheated 375° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
2  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
2  pkg. thin sliced lunch meat (ham, turkey or chicken)
1  bunch green onions
2  Tbsp. Accent
1  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Cream cheese until smooth.  Chop meat and onions fine; form into ball.  Chill overnight.  Roll in chopped pecans.

name: RASPBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
raspberry Crystal Light (1 serving container)
1/2 liter  Slice orange drink (diet)
1/2  liter ginger ale (diet)
preparation: Mix all together and serve.

name: EASY LASAGNE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1 (32 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. cottage cheese
1  egg
1/2  tsp. pepper
8  lasagne noodles (uncooked)
1/2  lb. Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Microwave ground beef 2 to 3 minutes until brown; drain.  Stir in spaghetti sauce and water.  Combine cottage cheese, egg and pepper.  In baking dish, spoon 1/2 cup sauce, alternating layers of noodles, egg mixture, cheese and sauce, forming 2 layers. Heat, covered, for 8 minutes on High, then on Medium-low, covered, for 30 to 32 minutes, or until noodles are tender.  Top with Parmesan cheese.  Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

name: OKRA/TOMATO STEW
ingredients:
2  c. okra, cut in small pieces
2  c. tomatoes
1  Tbsp. butter
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook okra until tender in water.  Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.  Add butter, salt and pepper.

name: SPEEDY AFTER SCHOOL PIZZA
ingredients:
tortillas (as many as desired)
pepperoni
2  tsp. spaghetti sauce
shredded cheese
preparation: Place one tortilla on a microwave-safe plate.  Spread spaghetti sauce evenly over tortilla.  Add pepperoni.  Cover with cheese.  Put the pizza in the microwave.  Cook until cheese is melted, approximately 1 minute on medium heat.  Remove and cut into fourths. Serves one.

name: CHOCOLATE GRAVY
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
3 heaping  Tbsp. flour
2 heaping  Tbsp. cocoa
approximately 2 c. hot water
1  can Milnot
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: In skillet, stir sugar, flour and cocoa until lumps are out. Add hot water to dissolve dry ingredients.  Then add Milnot. Bring to a boil.  Stir in vanilla.  Boil until gravy becomes thick.  Serve over hot buttered biscuits.

name: BETTER THAN SEX CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  box instant pudding mix
1  can crushed pineapple (medium)
1  c. sugar
1  pkg. frozen coconut
1  carton Cool Whip (8 oz.)
preparation: Bake cake as directed in sheet pan.  Place holes in cake while still warm.  When cooled, bring to a boil the pineapple and sugar and pour over cake when cooled.  Mix pudding mix as directed and spread over cake.  Finish by spreading Cool Whip and coconut.

name: ONION ROLLS
ingredients:
6  c. all-purpose flour
2  pkg. active dry yeast
2 1/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. sugar
4  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1/4  c. water
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  egg
preparation: In a large mixer bowl, combine 2 1/2 cups flour and the yeast. In saucepan, heat together the milk, sugar, 2 tablespoons instant minced onion, cooking oil, mustard, salt and pepper, just until warm, stirring occasionally.  Add to dry mixture in mixer bowl. Add egg.  Beat at low speed for 1/2 minute, scraping sides of bowl constantly.  Beat 3 minutes at high speed.  By hand, stir in enough of the remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough.

name: COLD ASPARAGUS
ingredients:
1  bunch fresh asparagus
red or green leaf lettuce
1  jar sliced pimientos
alfalfa sprouts
balsamic vinegar
ground pepper
preparation: Cut off hard ends of asparagus; boil spears for 5 minutes. Place lettuce leaves on a dish.  Place pimientos over the lettuce (drain oil).  Place 5 asparagus spears on top of lettuce and pimiento.  Top asparagus with a clump of sprouts.  Chill in refrigerator for 1/2 hour.  Pour balsamic vinegar to taste over asparagus.  Sprinkle ground pepper to taste.

name: REFRIGERATOR BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  box wheat bran flakes cereal with raisins
5  c. all-purpose flour
3  tsp. cinnamon
3  c. sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
5  tsp. soda
1  qt. buttermilk
2  tsp. salt
1  c. shortening or oil
4  eggs, beaten
preparation: Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl; make a well in center of mixture.  Add eggs, buttermilk and shortening; stir just enough to moisten dry ingredients.  Cover and store in refrigerator until ready to bake.  Will keep as long as 5 to 6 weeks.  When ready to bake, spoon batter into greased muffin tins, filling 2/3 full.  Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.  Yield: about 5 1/2 dozen.

name: PECAN SANDIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. water
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1  c. chopped pecans
confectioners sugar
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar. Add water and vanilla.  Mix well. Blend in flour and nuts. Shape into balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325° about 20 minutes.  Roll in confectioners sugar.

name: SWEET POTATO YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  c. cooked mashed potatoes
1  c. milk
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  pkg. yeast
2  beaten eggs
1 1/2  qt. flour (more if needed)
preparation: Heat just warm the milk, sugar, shortening and salt.  Add cooled sweet potatoes.  Sprinkle yeast over slowly and combine. Stir in beaten eggs.  Add flour.  Place in greased bowl and let rise in warm place (about 1 1/2 hours).  Punch down.  Knead lightly and form balls.  Let rise on greased cookie sheet.  Brush with butter.  Cover with wax paper until double in size.  Bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Brush top with a mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and 1/2 cup warm water.

name: HAMBURGER-BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  small onion, chopped
1  c. Minute rice
1  pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Brown meat and onion.  Mix together the other ingredients. Place in oiled baking dish.  Top with grated cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: SOUR CREAM POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
7  medium potatoes, peeled, cooked and sliced
1/3  c. Italian or French dressing
3/4  c. sliced celery
1/3  c. sliced or diced onion
4  hard-boiled eggs
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. dairy sour cream
1 1/2  tsp. horseradish or mustard
salt to taste
1/3  c. sweet cubed pickles
preparation: While potatoes are warm, pour dressing over them.  Chill for 2 hours.  Add celery and onion.  Chop egg whites.  Add mashed yolks (reserve some for garnish).  Combine rest of yolk with mayonnaise, sour cream and horseradish.  Fold into salad.   Add salt to taste. Celery seed can be added.

name: CRYSTAL STICKS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. chopped dates
powdered sugar
preparation: Beat sugar lightly into eggs.  Do not overmix.  Stir in vanilla.  Add flour and baking powder; blend.  Fold in nuts and dates.  Spread evenly into a greased 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.  Cool.  Cut into bars or sticks; roll in powdered sugar.  Keeps well; improves with aging.

name: ROASTED CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  (5 lb. each) roasting chickens, plus additional breasts if desired
2  cloves garlic
salt
freshly ground pepper
juice of 2 lemons
2  Tbsp. rosemary
vermouth (a few drops)
1 to 2  c. mayonnaise
1  bunch celery, coarsely chopped
1  head radicchio
1 small  bunch leaf lettuce
preparation: Preheat oven to 550°.  Clean and dry chickens inside and out. Rub each chicken outside with cross-cut garlic clove; repeat inside, leaving garlic clove in cavity.  Season inside and out with salt.  Squeeze juice of one lemon inside and out.  Sprinkle liberally with rosemary.  Season, again inside and out with salt and pepper.  Put chickens on rack in pan in oven and reduce heat to 400°.  Roast 1 hour and 10 minutes without opening door.  Drain juices from cavities into pan.  Set chickens aside to cool, then refrigerate.  Remove rack from pan and stir in a few drops of vermouth.  Place over high heat and cook a few minutes, scraping bits from bottom and sides of pan.  Refrigerate pan juices several hours or overnight.

name: APPLE CINNAMON CAKE
ingredients:
1 (18.25 oz.)  pkg. spice or yellow cake mix
1 (21 oz.)  can apple or peach pie filling
3  eggs
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Blend together cake mix, pie filling and eggs in a large mixer bowl.  Beat at medium speed 2 minutes. Combine sugar and cinnamon.  Spread half the batter in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan; sprinkle with half the cinnamon-sugar.  Repeat with remaining batter and cinnamon-sugar.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes until toothpick inserted in center of cake comes out clean.  Cool. Yield:  12 servings.

name: MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2 (1 small)  box mild or hot Mexican Velveeta
1  can hot chile beans
preparation: Brown beef and drain.  Add cheese and chile beans gradually. Mix occasionally until completely melted.  Serve with chips or flour tortillas.

name: SALMON CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can salmon
1  can cream of celery soup
3/4  c. regular rice
1/2  c. dry sherry
1  medium onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. water
preparation: Flake salmon in 2 1/2-quart casserole.  Add soup, rice, sherry, onion, lemon juice and water.  Mix well.  Bake 45 minutes at 375°.

name: CAKE WITHOUT FROSTING
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1  bag chocolate chips
preparation: Mix cake according to directions.  After mixing cake, add chocolate chips and fold in.  Pour in cake pan.  Bake according to directions on box.  Cool about 10 minutes.  Invert cake onto plate.

name: MOM Z'S MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ginger
2/3  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
1/2  c. molasses
1/2  c. sour milk
1  c. raisins
preparation: Mix together in bowl the flour, cinnamon, soda, salt and ginger.  Cream shortening, sugar, eggs and molasses in separate bowl.  Add sour milk and raisins.  Stir until mixed well.  Add dry ingredients.  Drop by tablespoon onto greased baking sheets.  Bake in a 350° oven for 12 minutes.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. Crisco
2 1/2  c. sugar
5  eggs
1  c. sweet milk
3  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift together the plain flour, salt and baking powder.  In a large bowl, mix Crisco, sugar and eggs, one at a time; beat well after each egg.  Add dry ingredients with sweet milk (alternating).  Add vanilla.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: HOLIDAY HAM SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. salt
3  eggs
1  c. milk
1/2  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix together sugar, dry mustard and salt over double boiler. Gradually add the rest of the ingredients. Cook for 1/2 hour or until thick.

name: QUICK AND EASY BASIC DRESSING
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. dry Pepperidge Farm herb seasoned stuffing mix
2  c. chicken broth
1/2 to 1  c. onion, chopped
1  c. celery, diced
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  sticks butter, melted
preparation: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.  Stuffs 12 to 14 pound turkey or bake in a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: ITALIAN CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. oleo or butter
5  eggs, separated
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
2  c. coconut
2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cream sugar and butter. Add egg yolks one at a time and cream well. Add buttermilk, alternating with soda and flour mixture. Fold in beaten egg whites, coconut and pecans. Bake in 9 x 13 pan for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: SEVEN LAYER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick butter or oleo
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. chopped nuts
1 small  pkg. chocolate chips
1 small  pkg. butterscotch chips
1  c. coconut
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
preparation: Melt butter or oleo in jelly roll pan.  Sprinkle on graham cracker crumbs, nuts, chocolate chips, butterscotch chips and coconut.  Pour evenly over top, Eagle Brand milk.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, or until coconut is brown.

name: PECAN PIE BARS
ingredients:
1  large yellow cake mix
1/2  c. margarine
1  egg
1 1/2  c. dark corn syrup
4  eggs
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Reserve 2/3 cup cake mix.  Mix the rest of the cake mix with the margarine and 1 egg.  Crumble and pat in 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Mix 2/3 cup cake mix with corn syrup, 4 eggs, brown sugar and vanilla.  Beat 2 minutes with electric beater.  Pour over cake mix.  Sprinkle with chopped pecans.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  chicken breasts, cooked and diced
1  c. slivered almonds
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  c. onion, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  can mushrooms
1  c. celery, diced
2 1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Put in greased casserole. Sprinkle lightly with crushed potato chips.  Bake in 325° oven until hot.

name: CROCK POT VENISON
ingredients:
1-1/2  lb. venison
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. flour
1  large onion, sliced
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  green pepper, sliced
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
preparation: Cut venison into strips and put in crock pot with pepper and salt. Stir well to coat meat. Add remaining ingredients, cover and cook on low setting 8 hours or high setting for 4 hours. Serve over rice.

name: TEX-MEX BEAN DIP
ingredients:
1  can (16 oz.) refried beans
1  c. sour cream
1  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  can (4 oz.) chopped green chiles
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  c. grated Jack cheese
1  bunch green onions, chopped
preparation: Peel, core, and quarter apples.  Cook with enough water to keep apples from sticking to pan.  Drain off excess juice.  Put through colander or ricer and measure 9 cups pulp.  To the pulp add 1/2 cup vinegar, 5 cups sugar, 1/4 cup cinnamon.  Cook in 300° oven for 2 to 3 hours until mixture becomes quite thick.  Stir occasionally. Put into hot sterilized jars and seal.

name: FREEZER MOUSSE PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
3/4  c. sugar
2 (1 oz.)  sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
2  eggs
1 (4 oz.)  carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
1  baked (9-inch) pastry shell
whipped cream (optional)
shaved chocolate (optional)
preparation: Cream butter  or  margarine  and  sugar until light and fluffy; stir  in  chocolate.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating at low speed of electric  mixer 5 minutes after each addition. Fold in whipped topping.  Spoon  filling  into  pastry  shell. Freeze until firm.  Garnish  with  whipped  cream  and  shaved chocolate, if desired.

name: SPINACH BREAD
ingredients:
1  bag fresh spinach, washed and chopped
1 small  can black olives, chopped
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
pinch of salt
1  clove garlic, chopped
1/4  lb. salami, ham or pepperoni (any combination), chopped
bread dough
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/2  tsp. pepper
4  Tbsp. oil
1/4  tsp. parsley flakes
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except bread dough in a large bowl.  Roll dough flat, about 1/4-inch thick.  Spread spinach mixture on the dough and roll in a jellyroll style.  Pinch edges together and make several fork pierces in the top.  Place on oiled baking sheet.  Bake at 350° to 375° for about 45 minutes.

name: CLASSIC WALNUT PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, lightly beaten
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  c. corn syrup (light or dark)
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. walnut pieces
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Combine eggs, sugar, flour, corn syrup, butter and vanilla; blend well.  Pour into unbaked pie shell; arrange walnuts on top.  Bake in lower third of oven at 400° for 15 minutes.  Reduce to 350°.  Bake an additional 35 to 45 minutes until center appears set.  Cool.

name: AUNT EVELYN KEAR'S SUGAR CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
3 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  stick melted butter
2  egg yolks
1  whole egg
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients.  Add egg yolks and egg.  Mix , then add milk and vanilla.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Sprinkle with nutmeg.  Bake at 400° for 15 or 20 minutes.  Reduce oven to 350° and bake until set.

name: CHICKEN CACCIATORE
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. frying chicken, cut up
1  can condensed tomato soup
1 soup  can quick cooking rice (about 1 c.)
1  can Mexican-style or whole kernel corn, drained
1/2  medium green pepper, chopped
preparation: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Coat with flour.  Brown on all sides in oil. Add remaining ingredients.  Cover and simmer 20 to 30 minutes until rice is done and chicken is tender.

name: SPINACH SOUFFLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen spinach
3  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. flour
1  c. half and half
3  eggs, separated
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Drain cooked spinach and chop or put in food processor. Melt butter in skillet and saut onions. Blend in flour and slowly half and half. Cook until smooth and thickened. Beat egg yolks, stirring a small portion of cream mix into them, then return to hot mixture. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add spinach and season to taste with salt-chicken bouillon concentrate (1 to 1 tablespoon) and pepper. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture.  Turn into greased 7-inch mold and set mold in pan of hot water. Bake at 250° for 30 minutes or until set.

name: TAILGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, shredded
1  c. green pepper, diced
1/2  c. red pepper, diced
1  c. onion, diced
1  c. celery, diced
1 (17 oz.)  can English peas, drained
1  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
1  c. bacon, fried crisp and broken in pieces
preparation: Place in layers in order written.  Spread mayonnaise on each layer. Sprinkle each layer with sugar.  If you like the bacon crisp when served, wait until you serve before putting bacon in or on dish.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: BAKED BEANS WITH HAMBURGER
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. mustard
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  medium onion
2 small  cans pork and beans
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion in frying pan; drain. Mix the catsup, mustard, brown sugar, onion and pork and beans with the ground beef. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: POTATO SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  to 8 large potatoes, peeled
1  c. sour cream (8 oz.)
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. chives or green onion tops, chopped
1/4  c. butter
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese (4 oz.)
preparation: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except cheese.  Spoon into a greased 2-quart casserole.  Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 15 minutes.  Top with cheese and bake 15 minutes longer.

name: RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. (10 oz.) frozen broccoli
1  stick margarine
1  large onion, chopped
1 1/2 to 2  c. uncooked rice
1  c. milk
1  can (10 oz.) cream of mushroom soup
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
jalapeno peppers to taste
preparation: Cook  rice  and  broccoli  according  to  directions on package.  Saute  chopped  onion  and chopped peppers in margarine. Add  cheese,  mushroom  soup  and milk to onion and mix until smooth.  Pour  cheese mixture in with rice and broccoli in  large glass baking dish, blending well.  Bake in 375° oven for 20 minutes.  Serves 8.

name: CHOCOLATE DIPPED ALMOND HORNS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  c. butter, softened
2  egg yolks
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1/2  c. ground almonds
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. melted chocolate chips
powdered sugar
preparation: In large bowl, combine powdered sugar and butter. Beat until creamy. Add egg yolks and vanilla, beating until well blended. Add flour, almonds, cream of tartar and baking soda. Beat on low speed until well blended.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Roll balls into 2-inch ropes; shape into crescents. Place 2-inches apart on baking sheet. Flatten slightly with bottom of glass covered with waxed paper. Bake at 325° for 8 to 10 minutes. Do not brown. Cool completely. Dip half of each cookie in melted chocolate. Sprinkle remaining half with powdered sugar. Makes 3 dozen.

name: LASAGNE D'ITALIA
ingredients:
1/2  lb. lasagna noodles
2  Tbsp. oil
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  medium onion, chopped
1  lb. ground beef
2 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. rosemary or basil
1  Tbsp. minced parsley
2 (6 oz.)  cans tomato paste
1 1/2  c. hot water
2  eggs, beaten
1  pt. small curd cottage cheese
1/2  lb. Mozzarella cheese, sliced
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook noodles. Heat oil in skillet. Cook garlic and onion until soft. Add beef and seasonings and cook until crumbly. Add tomato paste and hot water. Simmer 5 minutes. Set aside. Blend eggs with cottage cheese in bowl. Put thin layer of the meat sauce, half the noodles, all of the cottage cheese and eggs and half of the Mozzarella cheese. Repeat with half of the remaining meat sauce, the rest of noodles, sauce and Mozzarella cheese. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes before serving.

name: COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
5  eggs, separated
2 1/4  c. cake flour
1  tsp. baking soda
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter, softened
1/2  c. oil
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. coconut extract
1/2  tsp. vanilla
4 2/3  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Beat whites of eggs in medium bowl on high speed until stiff peaks form; set aside.  Beat flour, baking soda, sugar, butter, oil, buttermilk, coconut extract, vanilla and 2 2/3 cups flaked coconut in large bowl on low speed 30 seconds, scraping bowl constantly.  Beat on high speed 3 minutes, scraping bowl occasionally.  Fold egg whites into batter.  Pour into round cake pans (greased and floured).  Bake at 325° for 40 minutes or until done.  Cool 10 minutes in pans, then remove and cool completely. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
6 to 8  slices bread
cinnamon and sugar
butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. seedless raisins
4  lightly beaten eggs
2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cut crust off bread and toast bread.  Butter toast; sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.  Close up like sandwiches.  Cut into finger slices.  Put into well-buttered casserole.  Sprinkle raisins and brown sugar on top.  Beat eggs and add to milk with 2 tablespoons white sugar and vanilla.  Pour over bread.  Place casserole in pan with 1/2-inch water.  Bake at 375° approximately 45 minutes.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. fresh cranberries
1  c. water
1  c. sugar
1 small  box cherry Jell-O
15  large marshmallows
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. chopped celery
preparation: Boil until  cranberries  pop.  Add Jell-O and marshmallows. Stir until  marshmallows melt.  Remove from flame.  Add nuts and celery.  Pour into mold.  Refrigerate until firm.

name: CHINESE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can Chinese vegetables
1  can seasoned green beans
1  can peas
1  can water chestnuts, sliced
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  medium onion
preparation: Drain vegetables and put in bowl.  Mix 3/4 cup vinegar and 1 cups sugar.  Combine and bring to a boil.  Let cool.  Mix all together and let set for several hours or overnight in refrigerator.

name: SNICKER BROWNIES
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. caramels
2/3  c. evaporated milk
1  pkg. German chocolate cake mix
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
1  c. peanuts
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Melt caramels and 1/3 cup of evaporated milk; set aside.  Mix together the cake mix, 1/3 cup of milk and butter.  Press half of the mixture into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Bake 6 minutes at 350°.

name: CRANBERRY LEMONADE PUNCH
ingredients:
4 (6 oz.)  cans frozen lemonade concentrate
2  pt. cranberry juice or cocktail
1  qt. ginger ale
1  pt. lemon, pineapple or cranberry sherbet
preparation: Make up lemonade concentrate as directed on can.  Pour into punch bowl and stir in cranberry juice.  Add ginger ale and ice cubes.  Mix well.  Float scoops of sherbet on top.  Makes 48 (4 ounce) servings.

name: BAKED SLICED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  large potatoes
1/4  c. margarine, melted
1/4  c. oil
2  cloves minced garlic
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dried thyme leaves
preparation: Cut potatoes into 1/4-inch slices.  Place overlapping in buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Mix all other ingredients. Brush slices with mixture.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until potatoes are done.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. real mayonnaise
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. curry powder
1 large  pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm stuffing
1 1/2  sticks butter or margarine
preparation: First Layer:  In a 9 x 13-inch cake pan, layer chicken (cooked and cubed).

name: CURRIED CHICKEN DIVINE
ingredients:
3  whole chicken breasts
1 large  bunch fresh broccoli
1 to 2  cans cream of chicken soup
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1  c. buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Cook chicken in salted water.  Remove from bone and cut into bite-size pieces.  Cook broccoli in broth from chicken.   Place broccoli in buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.  Top with chicken.  Mix soup, mayonnaise, evaporated milk, cheese, lemon juice and curry powder.  Pour over chicken.  Top with buttered, toasted bread crumbs.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: BEEF MARINADE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. soy sauce
2  oz. gin
1  tsp. garlic powder
1 1/2  Tbsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pierce meat and marinate overnight.  Great for outdoor grilling.

name: CARAMEL BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
3/4  c. melted butter
2/3  c. canned milk, divided
14  oz. caramels
12  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Combine the cake mix, melted butter and 1/3 cup canned milk. Press 1/2 of the mixture into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 6 minutes.

name: DOUBLE LAYER PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker crust
4  oz. softened cream cheese
1  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  (8 oz.) tub Cool Whip
1  c. cold milk
2 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1 3/4  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
preparation: Mix cream cheese, 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in large bowl until smooth. Gently stir in 1/2 of the Cool Whip. Spread on bottom of crust.

name: SWISS STEAK(Crock-Pot)
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak
2  Tbsp. flour
salt and pepper to taste
1  c. onion, sliced
2  carrots, chopped
1  stalk celery, chopped
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
preparation: Cut round steak into serving pieces. Season flour with salt and pepper. Dredge meat in seasoned flour. Place onion in bottom of crock-pot. Add meat. Top with carrot and celery and cover with tomato sauce. Cover. Cook on low 8 to 10 hours or on high 3 to 5 hours.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. Beau Monde seasoning
1  tsp. parsley
1  tsp. onion flakes
1  tsp. dill weed
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix together and store overnight in refrigerator.  Use as a dip for raw fresh vegetables.

name: CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
pastry for 2 crust pie
5  lb. whole stewing chicken
1 1/2  qt. water
1  tsp. salt
1  small onion, diced
1  carrot, diced
1  stalk celery, diced
1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. onion salt
1/2  tsp. celery salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Cook chicken in 1 1/2-quarts water with salt, onion, carrot and celery.  Cook until tender, 3 to 3 1/2 hours.  Strip meat from chicken in large strips.  Cool chicken and broth, then refrigerate. Combine remaining ingredients with 1/2 cup broth, mixing until smooth.  Heat 3 cups broth in skillet.  Add flour mixture.  Cook until thick, stirring continually.  Add chicken and blend well. Line a 9-inch deep dish pan with crust.  Fill; add top crust.  Vent top and flute edges.  Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE-RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  box Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice
1  lb. sausage
1 1/2  c. chopped onions and pepper (not each)
preparation: Brown sausage with onions and peppers.  Add broth envelope in package of Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice.  Add 2 cups of water.  (Do not drain grease from sausage before adding rice package.)  Add rice.  Cook at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: RUSSIAN TEA
ingredients:
1  jar Nestea lemon flavored instant sweetened tea
1 small  jar Tang
2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Put in jar or coffee can and stir until well blended.  To make 1 cup or mug, put 2 teaspoons in cup; add hot water.

name: HERSHEY'S KISS PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. milk
1  tsp. baking soda
1  egg
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter (use butter)
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all together and shape into balls.  Roll in sugar.  Bake 7 to 10 minutes.  Top each cookie immediately after taking out of oven with chocolate kiss or chocolate star.  Place on greased cookie sheet.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  c. mayo
1  pt. size pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix for salad
2  tsp. parsley
2  tsp. dill weed
1/2  tsp. Beau Monde
preparation: Mix all together and chill.  Serve with raw veggies.

name: CHOCOLATE CRINKLE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. Mazola corn oil
4  qt. unsweetened chocolate, melted
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. baking powder
4  eggs
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  tsp. black walnut flavoring or a few black walnuts (optional)
preparation: Mix oil, chocolate and sugar.  Blend in one egg at a time until well mixed.  Add vanilla.  Stir in salt, flour and baking powder that has been sifted together.  Chill several hours or overnight.  Drop by teaspoonful into confectioners sugar.  Roll around and shape into a ball.  Place 2 inches apart on greased baking sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.  Do not overbake. Makes about 50 cookies.

name: MEXICAN PINWHEELS
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
4  oz. chopped black olives
4  green onions, chopped
1  pkg. flour tortilla shells
preparation: Mix the first 5 ingredients together.  Spread on flat tortilla shells.  Roll up and then slice into 1/2-inch.  You may add 1 can green chilies (crushed) if you want.

name: CHOCOLATE SYRUP CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine or butter
1  cup self rising flour
1  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  can (1 lb.) chocolate syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt margarine or butter.  Mix dry ingredients and add eggs, syrup and melted margarine.  Beat well.  Pour into a greased 9 x 13 inch pan.  Bake at 350°  for 40 to 45 minutes or until done. Pour hot frosting on hot cake.

name: CHEWY FRUITCAKE BARS
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick baking mix
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. firm margarine or butter
1  c. flaked coconut
2  c. cut-up mixed candied fruit
1  c. snipped dates (if desired)
1  c. chopped nuts
14  oz. sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Mix baking mix and sugar; cut in margarine thoroughly.  Press mixture with floured hands in ungreased jelly roll pan.  Bake 10 minutes.  Sprinkle coconut over baked layer. Layer candied fruit and dates over coconut.  Sprinkle chopped nuts over fruit.  Drizzle milk over top.  Bake until light golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes; cool completely.  Cut into bars.

name: WONTONS
ingredients:
2  pkg. of fresh Wonton wrappers
1/2  lb. finely chopped pork
1/2  lb. salad shrimp (chopped)
1 small  can water chestnuts, finely chopped
1  tsp. soy sauce
7  green onions (just mince and use white portion of onion)
2  raw eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. cornstarch
preparation: Mix all the above ingredients (except wrapper) together in a bowl. Place approximately 1 tsp. in the center of the square wonton wrapper. Fold diagonally and wet the two sides of the wrapper so you will have a triangle. Now wet the two sides of the triangle and connect, forming a crown. Deep fry wontons in oil at approximately 350° until golden brown. ZUCCHINI QUICHE

name: CREAM TORTE
ingredients:
24  graham crackers
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
preparation: Put in deep pie pan.

name: CRAWFISH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. crawfish tails
1  can mushroom soup
1  can nacho cheese soup
2 1/2 to 3  c. cooked rice
1 small  jar chopped pimentos
1  each:  chopped onion and bell pepper
preparation: Saute onion and bell pepper in 1 stick oleo.  Add seasoned crawfish, soups, rice and pimentos.  Mix well and pour into a 3-quart casserole dish.  Cover and bake in a 350° oven for about 30 minutes (until hot and bubbly).  Increase baking time if double recipe.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: QUICK ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salad dressing
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix and spoon into ungreased muffin pan.  Bake at 400°.  Makes 6 rolls.  For more rolls, double recipe.

name: COUNTRY-STYLE PANCAKES
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. sugar
1  egg
1 1/4  c. whole milk
2  Tbsp. soft shortening
preparation: Mix flour and sugar together.  Beat egg; add milk and shortening and blend into flour mixture.  Drop batter on hot griddle.  Turn pancakes when bubbles appear.  Makes 16 (4-inch) pancakes.

name: EASY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  jar cold pack cheese
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. minced onion
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Let cream cheese come to room temperature.  Mix with cold pack cheese, onion and sauce.  Shape into a ball.  Roll in chopped nuts.

name: BREAD DUMPLINGS(Good To The Last Crumb)
ingredients:
1/4  c. (1/2 stick) butter or margarine
1  c. milk
1  to 2 loaves day-old French bread or 1 bag bread ends or similar
2  large or 3 medium eggs
preparation: Warm butter or margarine and milk in microwave. Crumble bread in large bowl. Pour the butter/milk mixture over the bread (if bread is very moist, use less or more if it's dry). Let stand for 1 hour. Add eggs, kneading into bread mixture. Form into small, firm balls about the size of golf balls or slightly larger. Place in boiling water for 20 minutes. Serve with your favorite cut of meat and gravy. Enjoy!

name: DOT'S SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
16  oz. pkg. vermicelli
2 1/2  lb. ground beef
2  medium onions
salt and pepper to taste
2  cans mushroom soup
3  cans tomato soup
1  medium green pepper
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 medium  jar stuffed green olives
1  lb. grated sharp cheese
preparation: Brown meat and onions.  In another pan place tomato soup and 2 cans of water.  Add chopped green pepper and olive juice.  Boil for a few minutes.  Add Worcestershire sauce.  Cook and drain spaghetti or vermicelli.  Put in large container.  Add meat, sauce and cheese to spaghetti.  Mix well.  Put in 2 casseroles (13 x 9-inch). Spread can of undiluted mushroom soup on top of each.  Decorate with sliced olives.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: SWEDISH BIRTHDAY CAKE
ingredients:
1  plain cake or angel food cake
Jello vanilla pudding, mixed per pkg. directions
Strawberries, Raspberries, or Blueberries
1/2  cup whip cream, whipped
Fruit or candy to put on top of cake
1/4  cup sugar
preparation: Cut the cake into 3 thin layers;  it's okay if they break a little, the filling will glue it together.  Put one layer of cake on a plate.  Add 1 to 2 Tbsp. of the whipped cream to the vanilla pudding.  Spread one half of this on the cake.  Add the second layer of cake and spread the rest of the mixture on it.  Mix the fruit with the sugar, mashing the fruit.  Pour over second layer of cake.  Add third layer of cake.  Spread the top layer lightly with whipped cream.  Put sliced fruits or candy on top of cake. Happy Birthday!

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2  cans cream or whole kernel corn
4  eggs, beaten
4  Tbsp. flour
1  c. canned milk
2  Tbsp. sugar (or more to taste)
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix ingredients together; pour in pan.  Dot top with butter. Bake for 30 minutes or longer at 325°.

name: EGGS PORTUGAL
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
3/4  lb. shredded Cheddar cheese
3/4  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  lb. sausage, browned
6  slices white bread, cubed
2 1/2  c. milk
6  eggs
preparation: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Mix the cheese, mustard, sausage and bread; pour in dish.  Add the milk and eggs just before baking.  (May be assembled the night before, except for milk and eggs.)

name: LEMON-BUTTER SPRITZ COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter (no substitutes)
1/2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. sugar
1  egg
grated peel of 1/2 lemon
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. flour
1/8  tsp. salt
colored sugar
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.  Add the eggs, lemon peel, lemon juice and vanilla; mix well.  Stir together flour and salt; gradually add to creamed mixture.  Using a cookie press, shape into designs on ungreased cookie sheets.  Sprinkle with colored sugar.  Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly brown around the edges.  Yield: 6 dozen.

name: GOLDEN SUNBEAM CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sifted cake flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
10  to 12 egg yolks
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. lemon extract
1  c. cold water
preparation: Sift first 4 ingredients together 3 times; set aside.  Beat egg yolks until very thick and fluffy.  Gradually beat in the sugar.  Add the next 3 ingredients, then fold in flour.  Mix gradually.  Pour into 10-inch tube pan, ungreased.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Invert pan to cool.

name: LEFTOVER CEREAL (OATMEAL) PUDDING
ingredients:
3/4  c. leftover cereal
1  egg, separated
1 1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. melted butter
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. powdered sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped dates or raisins
preparation: Beat milk into cereal until smooth.  Add egg yolk, well beaten.  Add cinnamon, butter, sugar and raisins.  Pour into baking dish.  Bake in moderate oven for 45 minutes.  Beat egg white until stiff; beat in powdered sugar and vanilla.  Cover pudding with meringue and return to oven for 8 minutes to puff and color.

name: TWISTED LEMONADE
ingredients:
1 1/4  oz. smirnoff citrus twisted vodka
1/2  oz. triple sec
1/3  cup sweet& sour mix
preparation: Fill a 14 oz. glass with ice. Add vodka and triple sec. Top off with sweet and sour mix. Serve with a straw.

name: TOMATO-MUSHROOM BISQUE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. olive oil
2  celery stalks, trimmed and chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1  leek (white and light green parts only), chopped
1  large shallot, chopped
1  garlic clove, chopped
3/4  lb. fresh mushrooms, stemmed and thinly sliced
2 1/2  lb. tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
2  c. chicken broth
3/4  c. white wine
1/2  c. whipping cream
1  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
1  tsp. thyme
1  small bay leaf
pinch of saffron threads
preparation: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in heavy, large saucepan over medium-high heat.  Add celery, onion, leek, shallot and garlic. Cook 7 minutes.  Add 1/2 pound mushrooms and saute 5 minutes.  Add tomatoes, chicken stock, wine, cream, lemon, thyme, bay leaf and saffron.  Bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes.

name: PICKLED ONION APPETIZERS
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
24  pickled onions
finely chopped watercress, parsley, dried beef, pecans or seasoned pepper
preparation: Cut  each  cake  of cream cheese into 12 squares with a piece of	string.  Let  stand at room temperature until soft. Roll squares of cheese into ball.  Press a hole in the center and stuff  with  well drained pickled onions.  Reshape cheese into ball and roll in any of last ingredients.  Chill at least 1 hour. Makes 24 appetizers.

name: LEMON RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. cooked rice
2  egg yolks, beaten
butter (size of egg)
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. milk
few grains salt
grated rind of lemon or 1 tsp. vanilla
2  egg whites, beaten stiff
juice of 1 lemon or 1 tsp. vanilla
about 4 Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Spread over pudding and return to hot oven to brown, 4 to 6 minutes.

name: FRESH APPLE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  egg
1  c. milk
1/4  c. margarine, melted
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1  c. apples (unpeeled), chopped
preparation: Beat egg.  Stir in milk, melted margarine, sugar, salt, lemon juice and vanilla.  Sift together cinnamon, flour and baking powder.  Stir into milk mixture just until blended.  Do not overmix.  Fold in apples.  Fill well-greased muffin tins about 2/3 full.  Bake at 450° for about 20 minutes, or until brown.

name: SALMON CROQUETTES
ingredients:
1 large  can pink or red salmon
1/4  c. flour
1  egg
preparation: Put salmon in large bowl; remove bones. Stir in already mixed up egg. Then pour in flour and roll into balls; put them in hot frying oil in deep fryer. Remove when brown.

name: POL'S APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/4  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. self-rising flour
2  medium apples, chopped
1  c. shredded coconut
1  c. walnuts or pecans
1/2  stick oleo
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. milk
preparation: Mix in saucepan for 3 minutes;  pour over warm cake.

name: ZUCCHINI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  lb. Italian style chicken sausage
3  diced green peppers
2  large chopped onions
12  oz. sliced mushrooms
2  medium diced zucchini
2  Tbsp. tomato paste
2  Tbsp. fresh oregano
salt and pepper
preparation: In a skillet, poach chicken sausage in 1/4-inch of water for 15 minutes.  Cut each sausage into 4 pieces and place in a large saucepan.

name: CHOCOLATE 4 LAYER DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/2  stick butter
1 1/2  c. flour
3/4  c. ground nuts (pecan or walnut)
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. xxx sugar
1  c. cool whip
1  pkg. vanilla pudding
1  pkg. chocolate pudding
3  c. milk
cool whip
preparation: Mix together first 3 ingredients; press into a 13x9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising cornmeal
1  c. sweet milk
1  c. cream-style corn
1  c. grated cheese
1/2  c. Wesson oil
1  bell pepper, chopped
3  jalapeno peppers, chopped
3  eggs, beaten
1  onion, chopped
preparation: Mix meal, milk, oil and eggs.   Add other ingredients and mix well.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch roasting pan.  Bake in preheated oven at 400° until golden brown.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
2 (4 oz.)  jars Old English cheese spread
2  (4 oz.) pimento cheese spread
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper or ground red pepper
1/2  tsp. Tabasco sauce
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
chopped nuts
preparation: Mix well.  Shape into a ball and roll in chopped nuts.  May be frozen.  Makes 1 large or 2 small balls.

name: FAMOUS CHOCOLATE REFRIGERATOR ROLL
ingredients:
1  c. heavy cream
2  Tbsp. granulated sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
20  "Famous Chocolate Wafers" (made by Nabisco)
Red candied cherries or chocolate curls (optional)
preparation: Whip cream with vanilla and sugar, or use Cool Whip

name: SNOWBALLS
ingredients:
1  can coconut
1  c. crushed pecans
1  box vanilla wafers
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  stick butter, mashed
whipped cream
preparation: Mix pecans, pineapple and butter together.  Stack vanilla wafers in 4's with pineapple mixture between.  Place in freezer. When cold or frozen, cover with whipped cream and roll in coconut.

name: JEFF'S BABY BACK RIBS
ingredients:
5  lb. pork baby back ribs
1 1/2  c. Open Pit barbecue sauce
2  Tbsp. honey
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
10  drops hot pepper sauce
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
preparation: Remove back membrane.  Bake ribs in covered cake pan with 1/2 cup water for 1 1/4 hours at 325°.  (If ribs are fatty, boil first for 20 minutes, then bake, covered, for 45 minutes.)  Drain and chill.  Make sauce with rest of the ingredients.  Place ribs on covered outdoor grill on low fire.  Heat both sides 5 minutes, then add sauce.  Cook 10 minutes on each side, until slightly browned and crispy.

name: LOW-FAT MARINATED VEG-BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1 (17 oz.)  can white whole kernel corn, drained
1 (15 oz.)  can light kidney beans, drained
1 (15 oz.)  can green beans, drained
1  medium sweet onion, chopped
1  medium green pepper, cut in small pieces
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. water
6  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. vinegar
preparation: In a medium bowl, combine corn, kidney beans, green beans, onion and green pepper.  For dressing, combine vinegar, sugar, water, olive oil, celery seed, salt, pepper and garlic powder.  Mix well and pour over vegetables.  Stir lightly; cover and chill for 4 to 24 hours.  Serve with a slotted spoon.  Makes 12 servings. Total fat 3 g (saturated fat less than 5 g and 0 mg cholesterol).

name: PEANUT BUTTER AND JELLY JEWELS
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  c. firmly packed light brown sugar
1/4  c. sugar
1  c. smooth peanut butter
1/2  c. (1 stick) butter, softened
1  large egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
cherry preserves or glace cherries
preparation: Sift together flour, soda and salt; set aside.  Combine sugars in large mixer bowl.  Add peanut butter and butter; beat until smooth and creamy.  Add egg and extract; mix well.  Gradually beat in flour mixture just until blended.  Refrigerate covered at least 1 hour.  Preheat oven to 375°.  Shape dough into 1 inch balls. Place on unbuttered cookie sheets 1 1/2 inches apart.  Use handle of wooden spoon to make deep indentions in center of each ball. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned and set.  Cool on cookie sheets until firm enough to lift.  Transfer to wire racks to cool completely.  Fill centers with cherry preserves or glace cherries.  Yields about 5 dozen cookies.

name: SELF-SAUCING APPLE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. oil
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. brown sugar
2 1/4  c. boiling water
preparation: Combine dry ingredients.  Add milk, egg, oil and vanilla, blending only until smooth.  Layer an 8 1/2 x 12-inch baking pan with cut up apples.  Sprinkle a little sugar, flour and cinnamon over them.  Add the cake mixture.  Combine brown sugar and hot water, pour over butter.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.  Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: HAM AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. cooked rice
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. cooked broccoli
6  Tbsp. melted butter
2  c. fresh bread crumbs
1 1/2  c. chopped onions
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt and black pepper
2  c. milk
1  lb. cubed ham, cooked
6  slices American cheese
preparation: Spoon rice into greased casserole.  Cover rice with broccoli. Mix in a bowl 2 tablespoons of butter and bread crumbs.  In frying pan, cook onions in remaining butter until soft.  Stir in flour, salt, pepper and milk.  Cook until thickened.  Add ham.  Heat one minute.  Pour over broccoli casserole.  Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: LAYERED BANANA PINEAPPLE DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/3  c. melted butter or oleo
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1  tub Cool Whip, thawed
1/4  c. sugar
3  bananas, sliced
3 1/2  c. cold milk
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix graham cracker crumbs, sugar and oleo in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Press evenly into bottom of pan.  Arrange banana slices on crust.  Beat cream cheese in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth.  Gradually beat in milk.  Add pudding mixes.  Beat until well blended.  Spread evenly over banana slices.  Spoon pineapple over.  Spread Cool Whip on top.  Refrigerate for 3 hours.

name: CHOCOLATE LOVERS DREAM
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. margarine, softened
1  c. chopped pecans
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. whipped topping
1  c. powdered sugar
2 (3 oz. each)  boxes instant chocolate pudding
3  c. milk
additional whipped topping
preparation: Combine flour, nuts and margarine; press into bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Cool.

name: ORANGE BALLS
ingredients:
12  oz. box crushed vanilla wafers
1/2  c. powdered sugar
3/4  c. chopped nuts (pecans)
1/4  c. melted butter or margarine
1/2  c. flaked coconut
6  oz. can frozen orange juice (do not add water!)
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Roll in 1/2-inch balls, then roll each ball in 1/2 cup powdered sugar.  Store in airtight container in refrigerator until ready to serve.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. chicken, cooked and cubed
1/2  pineapple, cubed and steamed or 20 oz. pineapple chunks, drained
1  onion, diced
1 (7 oz.)  can green olives, sliced
1  Tbsp. basil
1  lb. asparagus, steamed
2  tomatoes, sliced
1  green pepper, sliced
1  Tbsp. parsley, chopped
1  head iceberg lettuce, washed and torn
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Toss with dressing of your choice. Serves 6.

name: FUDGE BROWNIE PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/3  c. cocoa
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
ice cream
hot fudge sauce
preparation: Beat eggs in a small mixing bowl; blend in sugar and melted butter or margarine.  Combine flour, cocoa and salt; add to butter mixture.  Stir in vanilla and nuts.  Pour into lightly greased 8-inch pie plate.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until almost set (pie will not test done).   Cool.  Cut into wedges. Serve topped with ice cream and hot fudge sauce.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: DUTCH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. shortening
1  egg
1  c. milk
fresh apples with skins sliced thin
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Sift the dry ingredients 3 times (with the exception of the cinnamon); cut in the shortening and add the egg and milk, which have been mixed together.  Mix thoroughly.  Pour into a well-greased oblong pan and cover with apples which are sliced. Sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon and bake in a moderate oven (350°) for 35 minutes.

name: SHUT THE GATE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple and juice
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  pkg. instant pistachio pudding
1 (9 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Pour all ingredients into a bowl and with a spoon, stir until well blended.  Ready to serve.

name: PATTY DORSEY SALSA
ingredients:
5  medium zucchini
15  sweet banana peppers
6  hot peppers
6  to 8 green peppers
1  stalk celery (large)
1  clove garlic
5  large onions
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. Worcestershire sauce
5  Tbsp. salt
1  qt. white vinegar
2  Tbsp. seasoning salt
5 small  cans tomato sauce
1  gal. diced tomatoes (about)
preparation: Grind the first seven ingredients together, then add the rest of the ingredients.  Cook about 2 hours and seal in pint jars. Makes 25 pints.

name: CRISP OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
3  c. oatmeal
1  c. nuts
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Cream the shortening and sugars. Add eggs, oatmeal and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture.  Add nuts.  Mix thoroughly.  Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Makes approximately 120 cookies.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. Wesson oil
3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. grated raw carrots
1  can crushed pineapple (8 oz.)
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Beat together eggs, oil and sugar.  Add flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and vanilla.  Fold in carrots, pineapple (drained) and nuts.  Beat well.  Pour into cookie sheet, large one. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Frost hot cake with 1 small package of cream cheese, 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla.  Beat well.  Sprinkle with nuts.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
1/2  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, undrained
preparation: Mix ingredients together and beat until combined using medium speed of electric mixer.  Pour into two 8-inch pans and bake at 350° for 25 or 30 minutes.

name: MY GRANDMOTHER'S SCONES
ingredients:
8  oz. (2 C.) self-rising flour or plain flour
2 heaped  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar (optional)
1  egg
1/2  pint milk
preparation: Grease 12 bun tins.  Sift flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.  Beat egg and milk together.  Pour into flour.  Mix until creamy.  Fill bun tins about 2/3 full.

name: PEAR MUFFINS
ingredients:
4  c. diced pears
2  c. sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
3  c. flour
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
1  c. cooking oil
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs, beaten well
preparation: Mix   pears  and  sugar.  Let  stand  1  hour.  Combine remaining  ingredients  with pear mixture and pour into muffin pans.  Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Makes 34 muffins.

name: TANGY FLANK STEAK
ingredients:
1  (1 to 1 1/2 lb.) flank steak
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  Tbsp. plus 1 1/2 tsp. chopped fresh parsley
3  Tbsp. vinegar
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. freshly ground pepper (I use regular black pepper)
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Place steak in a large, shallow container.  Combine remaining ingredients, stirring well; pour over steak.  Cover and refrigerate 2 hours, turning steak frequently.  Can marinate longer.

name: BEER BREAD
ingredients:
1  can beer
2  Tbsp. sugar
3  c. self-rising flour (unsifted)
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Pour into well-greased loaf pan.  Bake 1 hour at 375°.  Let stand 15 minutes before slicing.

name: OYSTER STEW
ingredients:
1  pt. oysters
2 to 2 1/2  c. milk
1/2  stick butter
salt and pepper to taste
celery salt
preparation: Empty oysters and juice into saucepan; bring to medium boil. Add milk and simmer slowly until oysters float on top.

name: CHEESE SHRIMPBALL
ingredients:
2  c. deveined shrimp
2  (8 oz.) pkgs. Philadelphia cream cheese
2  Tbsp. French mustard
1/2  tsp. Dijon mustard
salt, to taste
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  or 4 shakes red pepper bits (to taste)
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
chopped pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients except pecans until well blended.  Form into a ball and roll in pecans.  Serve with crackers or rye bread.

name: BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of potato soup
1  can (at least) milk
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms (optional)
1 (10 oz.)  box broccoli, chopped
shredded Colby cheese (as much as you like)
preparation: Mix the 3 soups and milk together in a large saucepan.  Add the mushrooms, if desired, undrained.  Heat until well blended. Do not burn!  The broccoli does better if precooked to crisp, either on the stove or microwave.  Add to the hot soup mixture. The cheese is added last.  Stir until melted into the soup.  You can use other vegetables (cauliflower, asparagus or a combination).  Other cheeses can be used also (Swiss, Cheddar). You really can't ruin this.  I have even added leftover cooked ham to it.

name: LEMON VEAL WITH SPINACH
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lean veal shoulder, well trimmed and cut into cubes
3  Tbsp. oil
