1  large onion, chopped
1/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. crushed fennel seed
3  green onions, chopped
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen spinach leaves
1  lemon, cut into 6 wedges
preparation: Brown veal in oil in a large heavy skillet.  Add chopped onion, cooking until onion is tender.  Pour off the fat.  Add water, lemon juice, pepper and crushed fennel seed.  Cover and simmer over low heat 1 hour or until veal is tender, stirring occasionally.  More water may be added if needed. Add green onions and spinach. Cover and continue simmering until spinach is tender, about 5 to 10 minutes.  Arrange veal on warm serving platter surrounded with a border of spinach. Garnish with lemon wedges.

name: BLUEBERRY ORANGE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines blueberry muffin mix
1  egg
1/2  c. Citrus Hill orange juice
1  tsp. grated orange peel
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Grease muffin pans or use paper cups. Rinse blueberries with cold water.  Drain.  Empty muffin mix into bowl.  Add egg, orange juice and orange peel.  Fold in berries. Fill muffin cups.  Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Cool 5 to 10 minutes.

name: HASH BROWN POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash brown potatoes
1  Tbsp. salt
1/4  c. melted butter
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1 soup  can of milk
1  pt. sour cream
1 1/2 to 2  lb. browned hamburger
preparation: Mix all ingredients; put into a buttered 9 x 13-inch dish. Bake 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN WITH ASPARAGUS SAUCE
ingredients:
4  skinless, boneless chicken breasts
1  egg or 2 whites, beaten
1/2  c. dry bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  can cream of asparagus soup
1/3  c. each:  milk and water
hot cooked rice
preparation: In pie plate dip chicken into egg; coat with bread crumbs. In skillet over medium-low heat in hot oil, cook chicken 15 minutes or until browned on both sides and no longer pink.  Remove and keep warm.

name: LAZY DAY APPLE DESSERT
ingredients:
6  to 8 large apples
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4 to 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  egg
1/4  c. oleo
preparation: Cut up apples.  Lay in 6 x 10-inch Pyrex dish and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.  Mix together next 5 ingredients.  Add egg to this mixture.  Beat with fork and then fingers.  Pat over apples.  Melt oleo and drizzle over dry mixture.  Bake 30 minutes in 350° oven.  Enjoy.

name: KALE ANN
ingredients:
1  onion, diced
2  Tbsp. butter
2  lb. ground lamb
1 (12 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (12 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  pkg. chopped spinach, defrosted and squeezed dry
1  (16 oz.) small curd cottage cheese
1  (16 oz.) Mozzarella cheese
2  Tbsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. each: oregano, basil and parsley
preparation: In a large frypan, add butter and onions.  Cook until translucent.  Add lamb and fry until done.  Add tomato paste and sauce, oregano, basil, parsley and the cinnamon.  Stir together and simmer.  Mix the spinach and cottage cheese together.  In a good size casserole, put the tomato-lamb mixture on the bottom; put half of the Mozzarella on top.  Layer spinach-cheese mixture on top, then the rest of the Mozzarella.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes until bubbly and the cheese is melted.  Serve with spinach noodles and garlic bread.

name: APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  unbaked pie shell
2  tsp. lemon juice
10  to 12 apples, peeled and sliced
2  Tbsp. granulated sugar substitute
1  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Sprinkle lemon juice over sliced apples.  Coat well and pour into pie shell.  Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle over apples.  Bake at 425° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Yield:  8 servings. Calories per serving 103.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (1 1/2 oz.)  cans chunk-style tuna
6  oz. (3 c.) uncooked egg noodles
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/3  c. sliced green onions
1/2 to 1/3  c. dairy sour cream
2  tsp. mustard
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. salt
1  small zucchini, scrubbed and sliced
1  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1  medium tomato, chopped
preparation: Drain and flake the tuna; set aside.  Cook noodles accordingly to directions.  Drain and rinse in hot water.  Combine noodles with the tuna, celery and green onions.  Blend in the sour cream, mustard, mayonnaise, thyme and salt.  Spoon half the mixture into a buttered 2-quart casserole. Top with half zucchini.  Repeat layers.  Top with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.  Sprinkle with the chopped tomato.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  tsp. lemon juice
dash of Worcestershire sauce
paprika
1/3  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. onion juice
1  c. cooked shrimp, chopped
preparation: Soften cheese and blend in cream cheese and seasonings.  Stir in shrimp and add paprika as desired for color.  Serve with potato chips or other dippers.  Yields 1 cup.

name: OLD FASHIONED BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. bag of beans
1  tsp. soda
salt
3/4  c. brown sugar
bacon slices
preparation: Soak beans overnight; drain.  Add water to cover and soda. Bring to boil; drain.  Rinse with warm water; cover with more water.  Add salt and cook 45 minutes or until done.  Do not drain; add brown sugar and place bacon on top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  slices bread
1  lb. sausage, browned, drained and crumbled
2  c. grated sharp cheese
6  eggs
2  c. half and half
1  tsp. salt
pepper
preparation: Put bread in bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch dish; add sausage and cheese.  Mix eggs, milk, salt and pepper; pour over.  Cover with foil and chill overnight.  Bake, uncovered, 30 to 40 minutes at 325°.

name: COOKIE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1  lb. pkg. fudge striped cookies
1  container Cool Whip
1 (16 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, drained
preparation: Mix buttermilk with instant pudding. Add oranges and pineapple and mix by hand.	Cut cookies into little pieces. Add cookies and whipped topping. Refrigerate.

name: GAUTEAUX FRANCAIS(French Cake)
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
pinch of salt
1/2  c. milk
2  tsp. baking powder
4  Tbsp. butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. water
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, salt, milk and baking powder in a baking dish.  Spread batter evenly in a 9 x 9-inch pan.  Melt butter in a bowl and add brown sugar and water.  Pour over batter mixture in cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.  Serve warm with whipped cream.

name: BLUE BANDANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  ripe bananas
1 1/2  c. blueberries
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In a large bowl, cream the butter and sugar.  Mix in eggs and vanilla.  Add dry ingredients.  Mix well.  Mash bananas.  Stir in. Drain blueberries and fold in.  Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: ORANGE DRINK
ingredients:
2  pkg. orange Kool-Aid
2 1/2  c. sugar
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen Bright and Early concentrated breakfast beverage
preparation: This makes one gallon.

name: KING RANCH CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  chicken, boiled and deboned
1  onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
a little oil
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
grated cheese
99  cent bag Doritos
bread crumbs
preparation: In large skillet, saute onion and bell pepper in oil.  Add soups and tomatoes.  Simmer until hot and mixed well.  In a casserole dish, place crumbled chips.  Add chicken to soup mixture; stir well and pour over chips.  Top with grated cheese and bread crumbs.  Cook at 350° until hot and cheese is melted.

name: SNICKERS COOKIES
ingredients:
1  (18 oz.) tube refrigerated chocolate chip cookie dough
24  to 30 bite size Snickers candy bars
preparation: Cut dough into 1/4-inch thick slices. Place a candy bar on each slice and wrap dough around it. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool on wire racks. Yield: 2 to 2 1/2 dozen.

name: VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
2  c. (16 oz.) sour cream
1  c. (8 oz.) mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. green onions, chopped finely
4  tsp. parsley flakes
2  tsp. dill weed
1  envelope Lipton onion soup
preparation: Mix together well.  Chill overnight.

name: BANANA CREAM SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter, softened
1  c. shredded coconut
1  c. nuts
1  pkg. instant pudding (made)
1  pkg. Dream Whip
2  bananas, sliced
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, butter, coconut and nuts in a 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350° for 18 to 22 minutes. Stir occasionally. Reserve 1 cup of this mixture; pat the rest into the bottom of the pan. Place banana slices on top of the cooled crust; cover with pudding. Top with Dream Whip and sprinkle remaining coconut mix on top.

name: SALT AND PEPPER PORK ROAST
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. honey
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
3  lb. boned and tied pork roast
1  Tbsp. coarse salt
1  Tbsp. crushed peppercorns
preparation: Mix honey and prepared mustard, brush on roast.  Mix salt and peppercorns and roll roast in mixture until well coated.  Roast at 325° for 2 1/2 hours or until meat thermometer reads 170°.  Yields six to eight servings.

name: ORANGE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. butter
2  eggs
4 1/2  c. flour
1  c. sour milk
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. orange juice
1  tsp. salt
confectioners sugar
milk
orange juice
preparation: Cream butter with sugar.  Add eggs and continue to cream until thoroughly mixed.  Add dry ingredients  alternately with sour milk and 1/2 cup orange juice to the creamed mixture.  Drop on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) Italian dressing
1  c. broccoli flowerets
3/4  c. pitted ripe olives
3/4  c. cherry tomatoes
4  oz. fettucini noodles, cooked, drained and chilled
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. Bac*Os (bacon bits)
preparation: Pour dressing over broccoli, olives and tomatoes.  Cover. Marinate in refrigerator 3 hours; drain.  Add noodles, cheese and Bac*Os.  Toss lightly and serve.

name: AUNT GRACE'S BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
4  mashed bananas
2  c. milk
1  c. sugar
3  egg yolks
flour
vanilla wafers
preparation: Place vanilla wafers in pan.  Mix mashed bananas, milk, and flour to thicken.  Boil till thick.  Pour over wafers.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
6  potatoes, peeled and cubed
2  onions, chopped
4  chicken bouillon cubes
1  tsp. parsley flakes
5  c. water
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. Cheddar cheese soup
preparation: Mix all ingredients in crock-pot.  Cook on low for 12 hours. Mash potatoes before serving.  Top with chives for added flavor and color.

name: RICE AND BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken Rice-A-Roni
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1  can cream of celery soup
1/4  c. milk
1 small  pkg. frozen broccoli
preparation: Cook Rice-A-Roni according to directions.  Add Cheez Whiz. Stir in soup and milk.  Add frozen broccoli.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: IRISH POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  to 10 medium potatoes, peeled
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened
8  oz. carton sour cream
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/4  c. chopped chives
1  garlic clove, minced
2  tsp. salt
paprika
preparation: Cook potatoes in boiling water about 30 minutes. Less time if potatoes are  quartered. Drain well and mash. Beat cream cheese with an electric mixer until smooth. Add potatoes and remaining ingredients except paprika. Spoon mixture into lightly buttered 2 qt. casserole dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from fridge 15 minutes before baking. Bake uncovered at 350° until thoroughly heated. Serves 8 to 10.

name: MAKE-DAY-AHEAD-SALAD
ingredients:
16  oz. can French-style green beans
16  oz. can LeSueur peas
16  oz. can LaChoy chop suey vegetables
8  oz. can sliced mushrooms
1  onion, sliced thin
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2/3  c. wine vinegar
1/3  c. oil
preparation: Drain all of the ingredients well and marinate in the refrigerator overnight in the following mixture:

name: PECAN PUFFS
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. powdered sugar, sifted
2  c. plain flour
1  c. chopped nuts
powdered sugar
preparation: Blend shortening with salt and 2 teaspoons vanilla with 1/2 cup sifted powdered sugar.  Cream well; add plain flour and nuts. Shape in small balls and bake on greased cookie sheet.  Bake 15 minutes at 350°.  (It is better to bake 20 minutes at 325°.)  Let cool a little while, then roll in powdered sugar; store in tight container.  If you have plenty of nuts, you could add an extra cup.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE(Baked)
ingredients:
10  oz. macaroni
3  Tbsp. margarine
3/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper (white)
14  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese
3  eggs
2 3/4  c. bottle milk (or instead, use 1 1/2 c. evaporated milk and 1 3/4 c. water)
about 2 or 3 saltine crackers
preparation: Beat  eggs, salt, pepper and milk together.  Put a layer of cooked macaroni in greased 10 x 10 x 2-inch casserole.  Add layer of  grated  cheese, margarine and crushed cracker.  Pour half  of milk over top.  Put another layer of macaroni, margarine,  cheese and crushed cracker.  Add rest of milk.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until brown.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: PRIZE WINNING MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. tomato juice
3/4  c. uncooked oats
1  beaten egg
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Press firmly into ungreased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: JACK'S PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 (15 oz.)  can corn
1  lb. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
3  c. mashed potatoes
preparation: Brown ground beef with garlic salt and pepper to taste.  Just before done, add onion and pepper.  Drain well.  Pour into casserole dish and spread evenly in bottom.  Drain corn well, cover with meat mixture.  Add mashed potatoes, spreading evenly over meat mixture.  Cover with the cheese.   Bake at 350° until heated and cheese has melted.  Serves 4.

name: SALAMI
ingredients:
2  lb. lean ground meat
2  Tbsp. Tender Quick (Morton)
1  Tbsp. Accent
1 1/2  Tbsp. liquid smoke
1/4  tsp. onion powder
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. coarse grind black pepper
preparation: Mix ingredients well together.  Divide in half and roll into logs.  Wrap in wax paper or Saran Wrap.  Refrigerate 24 hours. Cook on a rack over a pan of water for 3 hours at 250°.  Cool, slice thinly and serve as sandwich meat, appetizer, etc.

name: ULTIMATE CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. unsifted flour
2/3  c. Hershey's cocoa
1 1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1 2/3  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. real mayonnaise
1 1/3  c. water
preparation: Grease and flour 9 x 13 x 2-inch  pan.  Mix first 4 ingredients; set aside.  In bowl with mixer at high speed, beat next 3 ingredients 3 minutes or until light and fluffy.  At low speed, beat in real mayonnaise.  Add flour mixture in 4 additions alternately with water, beginning and ending with flour.  Pour into pan.  Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool in pan 10 minutes.  Remove; cool on wire racks.  Frost as desired.

name: BUTTER PECAN BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  box Betty Crocker butter pecan cake mix
1  stick melted butter
1  egg, beaten
8 oz  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  stick melted butter
1  box powdered sugar
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. pecans or walnuts
preparation: Mix cream cheese, melted butter, powdered sugar and 2 eggs and pour over first mixture.

name: FORGOTTEN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  egg whites
2/3  c. sugar
6  oz. chocolate chips
walnuts (as desired)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat egg whites until foamy.  Add the sugar; beat until stiff. Add chocolate chips and nuts, plus vanilla.  Drop by teaspoon onto foil covered cookie sheet.  Preheat oven to 350° for 15 minutes.  Place cookie sheet in oven; turn off oven and forget. They're scrumptious!

name: BLUEBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 8  oz. cream cheese, softened
3  Tbsp. milk
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
2  c. heavy cream
1  can blueberry pie filling
preparation: For the first layer, melt margarine and mix with graham cracker crumbs.  Spread evenly in dish and chill for an hour in the refrigerator.  Mix cream cheese, milk, and confectioners sugar.  Spread evenly over first layer.  Sprinkle chopped nuts evenly over cream cheese layer.  Allow 1 hour to chill in refrigerator.  Spread blueberry filling over nuts and chill for approximately 1 hour.

name: BLACK SKILLET APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. salad oil
1  beaten egg
1/2  c. pecans
2  large apples, peeled and chopped
preparation: Into a black skillet, sift the flour, baking powder, salt, nutmeg, cinnamon, cloves and sugar.  Combine the oil, egg, pecans and apples.  Stir together and bake in oven at 375° for 35 minutes.

name: COLLETTE'S EGGS
ingredients:
6  to 7 eggs
2  Tbsp. butter
Parmesan cheese
4  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Melt butter in nonstick frying pan.  Add eggs.  Cook eggs slowly until you start to see the yolk change.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, at least 1/8-inch thick.  Slowly add vinegar, one teaspoon at a time,  to the outer edge of the pan.  This will flash cook the eggs.  Serve with bread and preserves.

name: MEXICAN BEEF'ARONI(A Microwave Recipe)
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. uncooked macaroni
1  c. water
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. cumin
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. grated low-fat cheese
1/4  c. crushed corn chips
preparation: Microwave:  Brown  beef  in plastic colander for 5 to 6 minutes on	Full  Power  (or  brown in 2 quart casserole dish, then drain).  Mash	beef  to remove chunks; add other ingredients except  cheese  and chips.	Stir well.  Cover and cook 11 to 12 minutes  on  Full  power.  Stir 3 times during cooking. Let stand 5 minutes, add cheese and chips, then serve.

name: ORANGE BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. golden raisins
1/2  c. chopped dried apple slices
1  c. fresh orange juice
1  c. unbleached flour
1  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
pinch of salt
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. bran flake cereal
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1/3  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Combine raisins, apples and orange juice; let soak 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 350°.  Line 2 (8 cup) muffin pans with paper liners.  In large bowl, sift flour, baking powder, soda, salt, sugar and cinnamon.  Add cereal and mix thoroughly.  In another bowl, beat egg, milk and oil.  Make well in center of dry ingredients and pour egg mixture in.  Add raisin mixture and stir. Do not overbeat.  Fill cups 3/4 full and bake 18 to 20 minutes. Test with toothpick.  Transfer muffins to rack to cool.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash brown potatoes
1/2  c. melted butter
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
2  c. crushed potato chips
1  can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
10  oz. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. melted butter
preparation: Defrost  hash  brown  potatoes  and  combine in a large mixing bowl with 1/2 cup butter.  Season with salt and pepper. Add onion, sour cream, chicken soup and grated cheese.  Blend ingredients  well.  Pour into 3-quart buttered casserole dish. When  ready  to  bake,  mix  crushed potato chips with 1/4 cup melted  butter and spread on top of casserole.  Cover and bake for 45  minutes  at 350°.  Remove cover and allow to brown for about 15 minutes.  Yield:  16 servings.

name: MEXICAN "CORN" BREAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. self-rising meal
1 1/4  c. self-rising flour
4  eggs
1  big spoon mayonnaise or salad dressing
3  chopped green onions (all of it)
1/2  diced red or green pepper
2  hot red peppers, diced
1 (15 oz.)  can creamed corn
1  c. frozen kernel corn
4  oz. grated hot pepper cheese
4  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
about 2 to 2 1/2 c. milk or buttermilk
preparation: Stir all together and pour in large hot iron skillet that has melted bacon grease or shortening.   Bake in preheated 450°  oven for about 1 1/2 hours.

name: COPPER PENNY CARROTS
ingredients:
2  cans sliced carrots
1  small bell pepper
1  c. condensed tomato soup
1/2  c. salad oil
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. prepared mustard
salt and pepper
1  onion, thinly sliced
preparation: Drain carrots; arrange carrots, bell pepper and onions in layers in container. Make marinade of other ingredients and beat well.  Pour over and refrigerate.  Will keep for weeks.

name: DIP
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise (no other brand)
2  tsp. dill seed
2  tsp. parsley flakes
2  tsp. onion flakes
1  tsp. seasoned salt
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Chill at least one day before serving.

name: BATTER FRIED SHRIMP
ingredients:
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  egg
1  c. flour
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. water
3/4  c. seasoned salt
dash of salt
1 1/2  lb. shrimp, peeled, deveined and split
vegetable oil
preparation: Combine 1/2 cup vegetable oil and egg, beating well.  Add the next 5 ingredients, stirring well.  Dip shrimp into batter; fry in 1 inch vegetable oil, medium hot.  Cook about 30 seconds on each side, or until lightly browned.  Do not overcook.  Makes about 6 servings.

name: CHEESE-AND-OLIVE TEA SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1/4  lb. Jarlsberg or Swiss cheese, finely shredded (1 c.)
1/2 (6 oz.)  can (drained weight) pitted ripe olives, drained and finely chopped
1 (2 oz.)  jar chopped pimentos, drained
1/4  c. mayonnaise
16 very thin  slices white bread
butter or margarine, softened
preparation: About 1 hour before serving or early in the day, in a medium bowl, mix the first 4 ingredients.  Trim crusts from bread slices. (Save crusts to use for bread crumbs another day.)  Lightly spread 1 side of each bread slice with butter or margarine. Spread filling on 8 buttered bread slices; top with remaining bread slices, butter side down.  Cut each sandwich diagonally into quarters.  Line a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jelly roll pan with damp paper towels.  Place tea sandwiches in jelly roll pan. Cover with damp paper towels to keep bread from drying out.  Cover pan with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve.  Makes 32 tea sandwiches.  Contains about 60 calories each.

name: BANANA CHERRY CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  (3 oz.) size lemon jello
1  c. boiling water
1/2  c. cold water
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2  c. sliced bananas
1/2  c. chopped maraschino cherries
1  graham cracker crust
preparation: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add cold water and lemon juice. Gradually add sugar and jello mixture to softened cream cheese. Mix until well blended.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Whip until fluffy.  Fold in bananas and cherries.  Pour into graham cracker crust.  Chill until firm.

name: CHICKEN WING DINGS
ingredients:
1  c. oil
1/2  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. soy sauce
garlic salt
5  lb. chicken wings
preparation: Mix ingredients and pour over wings in shallow Pyrex. (Mixture should cover wings.)  Cover and refrigerate overnight. Cook in same container with foil covering at 350° for 1 hour. Uncover and turn wings.  Leave uncovered and bake 1/2 hour more.

name: EGGPLANT PATTIE
ingredients:
1  eggplant
1 1/4  c. Ritz cracker crumbs
1 1/4  c. grated cheese
2  eggs, beaten
salt and pepper to taste
1  clove garlic, minced
2  tsp. dried parsley
preparation: Peel and dice eggplant and cook in a little water until very tender.  Drain well in a strainer, add other ingredients and mix well.  Put 2 tablespoons oil in hot skillet and drop by spoonfuls. Brown one side, turn to brown other side.

name: PECAN BREAD
ingredients:
1  box instant coconut pudding
1  c. oil
4  eggs
1  c. hot water
1  c. pecans
1  box butter pecan cake mix
preparation: Mix cake mix, eggs, oil, pudding mix, water and nuts.  Pour into 2 greased loaf pans.  Bake 45 minutes at 325°.

name: WATERMELON PIE
ingredients:
2/3  c. boiling water
1  pkg. (4 oz.) watermelon jello
1/2  c. cold water
1  tray ice cubes
1  tub (8 oz.) Cool Whip topping, thawed
1  graham cracker crust
additional whipped topping for garnish
preparation: Prepare jello according to directions on box.  Cool 15 minutes in refrigerator.  Stir in whipped topping until smooth. Refrigerate for 10 minutes.  Spoon into crust and refrigerate for 4 hours or until firm.

name: BAKED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  pork chops
1  c. uncooked rice
3  c. hot water
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  large onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  large green pepper, sliced
preparation: Trim off chops and brown on both sides.  In shallow baking dish, mix rice, water, salt and pepper, onion and undiluted soup. Add green pepper.  Arrange chops in dish.  Cover with foil and bake at 375° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: ETHEL'S MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
pepper
salt
garlic, if desired
1  egg
1  c. milk
2  c. bread crumbs
1  c. celery, cup up
3  Tbsp. green pepper, cut up
1  medium onion, cut up
3  Tbsp. ketchup
1  Tbsp. mustard
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Mix all ingredients, shape into loaf, wrap in foil.  Put 3 tablespoons ketchup on top.  Add a little water.  Bake until done (approximately 2 hours).

name: ALMOND ROCA
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  lb. butter (not margarine)
5  oz. almonds
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Grate chocolate and set aside.  Chop almonds.  Line cookie sheet (10 x 13-inch) with foil.  Spread layer of almonds on bottom.  Put layer of chocolate over (1/2 of each).  Combine sugar and butter; cook and stir until it reaches 300°.  Remove from heat and pour over pan.  Sprinkle remaining chocolate and almonds over. Let cool, then break.

name: REUBEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans sauerkraut
8  oz. uncooked noodles
2  cans cream of chicken soup or mushroom
3  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1 1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  can corned beef
8  oz. Swiss cheese, shredded
3/4  c. toasted rye bread crumbs
preparation: Layer sauerkraut and noodles in bottom of 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish.  Crumble corned beef on top, then cheese.  Mix crumbs with butter.  Sprinkle on top.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CREOLE CHICKEN JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
1/4  c. vegetable oil
2  medium onions, chopped
6  green onions, chopped
2  medium green peppers, chopped
1  (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) broiler-fryer chicken, cut into 8 pieces
1/2  lb. cooked ham, cubed
1/2  lb. smoked or Polish sausage, cut into 1/2-inch slices
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut into pieces (undrained)
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. salt
1 3/4  c. uncooked rice
1/2  c. water
3/4  tsp. Tabasco pepper sauce
preparation: In a large saucepot or Dutch oven, heat oil.  Add onions, green onions and pepper; cook 10 minutes or until tender.  Add chicken and brown on all sides about 10 minutes.  Add ham, sausage, tomatoes, tomato paste and salt.  Cover; simmer 10 minutes.  Stir in rice.  Add water.  Cover.  Simmer 1 hour or until chicken is done.  Stir frequently.  Add additional water if rice begins to stick to bottom of pan.  Before serving, stir in Tabasco sauce. Makes 8 servings.

name: STRAWBERRY-RHUBARB PIE
ingredients:
1  c. granulated sugar
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. strawberries, sliced
2  c. rhubarb, sliced
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Prepare pastry and set aside.  Put 1/2 of the strawberries and rhubarb into pastry lined pie plate.  Sprinkle with 1/2 of the sugar mixture.  Repeat with remaining strawberries and rhubarb.  Add sugar mixture.  Dot with margarine.  Cover edge of pastry with aluminum foil to prevent excessive browning.  Remove foil during last 15 minutes of baking.  Bake 40 to 50 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
2  bunches fresh broccoli
10  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
2/3  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Wash and cut broccoli to bite size pieces.  Combine broccoli, bacon, raisins and onion. In another bowl, combine mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar.  Mix well.  Pour dressing over broccoli mixture.  Refrigerate 2 hours before serving.  Toss occasionally. Serves 8.

name: QUICK SALAD
ingredients:
24  oz. nonfat cottage cheese
large sugar-free orange jello
1  (15 oz.) mandarin oranges
1  (11 oz.) mandarin oranges
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cottage cheese and jello.  Drain oranges and add.  Stir in Cool Whip.  Chill.

name: CHICKEN DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. whole milk
1/4  stick margarine
2  egg yolks
1  pinch salt
2 or 3  drops yellow food coloring
preparation: Mix  as if you were making biscuit dough;  knead  on  a floured  surface and roll out real thin with  a  rolling  pin. Cut into 1 inch squares.  Drop into  thickened,  boiling  hot chicken broth and boil until dumplings are done.

name: BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
2  c. water
1  c. white rice
2  c. milk
1  stick margarine
onion to taste
16 to 20  oz. chopped broccoli (fresh or frozen)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
about 10 oz. Cheez Whiz
crushed crackers
preparation: Bring water to boil; add white rice.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer 15 minutes.  In large saucepan, bring to boil milk, margarine and onion.  Add broccoli; boil for 5 minutes.

name: CHEESY BROILED HAM SLICE
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen baby lima beans
1 fully cooked smoked ham  slice (1 inch thick)
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese (about 4 oz.)
preparation: Cook frozen baby lima beans as directed; drain.  Diagonally slice outer edge of fat on ham slice at 1 inch intervals to prevent curling.  Place ham on rack in broiler pan.

name: ARTICHOKE VEGGIE DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can unmarinated artichoke hearts
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Drain and chop artichoke hearts.  Mix everything together and put in small baking pan.  Bake at 350° until browned.  Serve as a dip for raw veggies or crackers.

name: AUNT MARY STARR STUFF
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburg
1  small onion (optional)
1 small  jar Ragu
2  c. uncooked rice
preparation: Cook rice according to directions.  In large frying pan, saute onion and hamburg until cooked.  Throw in tomato sauce.  When rice is cooked, toss into hamburg mixture.  Mix well.  Season to taste with salt, pepper, Parmesan cheese, basil, parsley, whatever you have.  Serve warm.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  (8 oz.) whipped cream cheese
16  oz. salsa
1  lb. ground beef, browned
taco seasoning mix
12  oz. pkg. shredded sharp cheese
onion, diced
tomato, diced
green pepper, diced
preparation: Brown ground beef and mix with taco seasoning.  Set aside to cool.  Mix together mayonnaise and whipped cream cheese.   Spread on bottom of glass pie dish.  Layer salsa, then ground beef and package of sharp cheese.  Top with onion, tomato and green pepper. Sprinkle on top.

name: DURANGO COTTAGE CHEESE AND VEGETABLE DIP(Makes 2 Cups; Under 100 Calories)
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. low-salt, low-fat cottage cheese
1/2  c. minced green pepper
1  tsp. onion powder
1  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. ground cumin
3  Tbsp. water
1/2  tsp. cider vinegar
preparation: Place cottage cheese in electric blender container; whirl until smooth.  Spoon into bowl; add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Spoon into serving bowl; cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.  Use as a dip with raw vegetables.

name: VEGETABLE QUICHE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cooked brown rice
3/4  c. egg substitute, divided
3/4  c. shredded low-fat Mozzarella cheese, divided
1 1/2  c. chopped, fresh broccoli
3/4  c. sliced mushrooms
1/4  c. skim milk
1  Tbsp. margarine, melted
preparation: In bowl, combine rice, 1/4 cup egg substitute and half of the cheese.  Mix well.  Pat into the bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch pie plate coated with nonstick cooking spray; set aside.

name: SLENDER FRIES
ingredients:
2  medium potatoes
2  tsp. paprika
1/8  tsp. salt
cooking oil
preparation: Cut potatoes into 1/2 inch wide sticks.  Wash and place in ice water 30 minutes. Drain, pat dry.  Put oil, paprika, salt in freezer bag.  Add potatoes and shake.  Place in pan.  Bake at 425° for 30 - 35 minutes.  Turn over once while baking.

name: SUGAR CURED MEAT
ingredients:
1  pt. salt
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. red pepper
2  Tbsp. black pepper
1  joint meat (ham or shoulder)
preparation: Mix spices well and spread on meat.  Sew in a square cloth and hang joint with bone end down to drain.  If joint weighs over 20 pounds double recipe.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
4  cups peeled, sliced apples
2  cups sugar
2  cups flour (plain)
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda (omit if using self rising flour)
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt (omit if using self-rising flour)
2  eggs
3/4  cup vegetable oil
2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  cup chopped pecans
preparation: In large bowl stir together apples and sugar, Add dry ingredients and stir well. In separate bowl, beat eggs, oil and vanilla. Stir egg mixture into apple mixture.  Blend until thoroughly moistened.  Stir in pecans.  Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch dish. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 50 minutes or until cake springs back. Serve with apple dessert sauce.

name: SALAD DRESSING CAKE(Chocolate)
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
5  tsp. cocoa
1  c. sugar
1  c. salad dressing
1  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together and sift first 3 ingredients.  Add sugar, then salad dressing, water and vanilla.  Mix and beat well.   Pour into two layer pans, greased and floured.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

name: SWEET AND SOUR STIR-FRY CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. vegetable or olive oil
4  chicken breast filets, thawed and cut in thin 1/2-inch strips
3  c. frozen stir-fry vegetables
1  c. pineapple chunks
1  c. sweet and sour sauce
cooked rice (if desired)
preparation: Assemble all ingredients. Preheat large skillet or wok over high heat for 10 seconds.  Add oil to skillet and heat for 15 to 20 seconds.  Carefully add chicken strips and stir-fry until chicken is cooked, about 5 or 6 minutes.  Add vegetables and pineapple, stir-frying 3 to 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.  Stir in sweet and sour sauce.  Continue stirring until sauce covers all ingredients and is thoroughly heated. Serve over rice.  Makes 4 to 6.

name: CHRISTMAS DIVINITY
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. water
1/2  c. light corn syrup
2  egg whites
1/2  pkg. fruit flavored gelatin
3/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine sugar, water and corn syrup in heavy saucepan.  Cook, stirring, to hard ball stage.  Beat egg whites until soft peaks form; beat in gelatin.  Pour syrup over egg whites in thin stream, beating constantly.  Beat until candy is stiff and glossy; stir in nuts.  Drop from spoon onto waxed paper.  Cool.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) pie crust
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1  c. dark corn syrup
1  Tbsp. soft butter
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans
preparation: Blend sugar, flour and syrup.  Add butter.  Mix well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.  Stir in vanilla and pecans.  Mix well.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 375°.

name: TROPICAL TURKEY SALAD
ingredients:
6  oz. turkey, cooked and diced
1  c. diet pineapple tidbits
1/2  c. carrot, shredded
1/4  c. celery, chopped
2  Tbsp. plain yogurt
2  tsp. mayonnaise
1/4  tsp. curry powder
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Combine first four ingredients in a bowl.  Mix remaining ingredients to use as a dressing for the turkey.  Toss gently. Serves 2.

name: ITALIAN CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
5  large eggs
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can flaked coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
Cream Cheese Frosting
preparation: Grease 3 (9-inch) round cake pans.  Line bottoms of pans with wax paper; grease wax paper.  Flour wax paper and sides of pans. Set aside.  Beat butter and shortening at medium speed of an electric mixer until soft and creamy; gradually add sugar, beating well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition. Combine flour and soda; add to butter mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture.  Mix after each addition.  Stir in vanilla, coconut and pecans.  Pour batter into prepared pans.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool in pans on wire racks 10 minutes.  Remove from pans; peel off wax paper.  Cool on wire racks.  Spread Cream Cheese Frosting between layers and on top and sides of cake.  Store in refrigerator in an airtight container.  Yield:  One 3-layer cake.

name: OLD FASHION POT PIE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
4  Tbsp. shortening or vegetable oil
1  tsp. salt
chicken or beef broth
preparation: Put all in the bowl; add cold water a little at a time.  Stir until you have a soft dough, like pie dough.  Roll out thin.  Cut in strips.

name: LAYERED TACO DIP
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can refried beans
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
sour cream
jarred salsa
1  pkg. taco seasoning
chopped onions
chopped green pepper
lettuce, shredded
tomatoes, chopped
shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In bottom of 8-inch square serving dish, mix refried beans with 1/2 package taco seasoning and onions as desired.  Spread evenly.

name: SWEET AND SAVORY RICE PILAF
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. water
2  chicken or vegetable bouillon cubes
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  c. instant rice
1/2  c. dried cranberries or diced dried apricots
1/2  c. whole almonds, toasted and coarsely chopped
1/4  c. honey
preparation: In medium saucepan, combine water, bouillon cubes and soy sauce. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice and dried fruit. Cover immediately and remove from heat; let stand for 5 minutes. Uncover rice and fluff with fork. Stir in almonds and honey. Makes 4 servings.

name: SAUTEED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1/2  small head cabbage
1/4  c. butter
2  whole cloves
salt and pepper
preparation: Cut away the core of the cabbage. Cut the cabbage half into quarters. Cut each quarter crosswise into very thin slices. There should be about 6 cups of shredded cabbage. Melt the butter in a saucepan and add the cabbage. Add the cloves and salt and pepper to taste. Cook, stirring often, about 15 minutes. Do not allow to brown.

name: VALS MOCK SOUR CREAM
ingredients:
1  cup low fat cottage cheese
1/4  cup plain non fat yogurt
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. onions
preparation: Process in blender until smooth and creamy.

name: CHOW YUKE
ingredients:
1  lb. or more round steak
1/2  c. water
1/3  c. soy sauce
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. ginger
2  medium green peppers
2  onions
1/4  c. salad oil
1  clove garlic
preparation: Slice steak into thin slices.  Soak in water, soy sauce, sugar and ginger for 15 minutes.  Heat oil and clove garlic.  Add steak; saute for 3 to 4 minutes until tender.  Add meat liquid and cornstarch to make a thin gravy.  Serve with rice.  (Add tomatoes if wanted.)

name: PRETZEL ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. warm water
1  pkg. dry active yeast
3 1/2  Tbsp. granulated sugar
1  tsp. salt
2 1/2  Tbsp. butter (at room temperature)
1/2  beaten egg (at room temperature)
3 1/2 to 4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. water
coarse or kosher salt
preparation: Place water in electric mixer bowl.  Sprinkle in yeast; stir until dissolved.  Add sugar, salt, butter, 1/2 beaten egg and 1 1/2 cups flour.  Beat at medium speed until smooth.  Work in as much of the remaining flour as is necessary to make a stiff dough. Cover bowl with aluminum foil; refrigerate for 4 hours.

name: BLACK BEAN SOUP GUATEMALA
ingredients:
1  can condensed back bean soup
meat extract
Kitchen Bouquet
onion juice
sherry or wine
avocado
lemon or lime
hard-cooked egg
pepper or Tabasco sauce
preparation: To a cup of condensed black bean soup, add 1 can water, 1 teaspoon meat extract, 1 teaspoon Kitchen Bouquet and 1 teaspoon onion juice.  Simmer for a few minutes and just before taking off fire, add 2 to 4 tablespoons sherry or wine.  Do not boil after adding wine.  Serve with sliced egg, lemon or lime slices, and pass the Tabasco or hot sauce around the table.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
6  c. pumpkin, cooked
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
1/3  c. canned milk
6  eggs
1  Tbsp. lemon flavoring
1  stick melted margarine
3  unbaked pie shells
preparation: Cook pumpkin and drain well.  Mash pumpkin through strainer. Add all ingredients, except flavoring and mix well.  Add flavoring.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until set.  Makes 3 pies.

name: SAUSAGE DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. celery, chopped
1  lb. pork sausage
4  medium onions, chopped
2  tsp. poultry seasoning and sage to taste
salt to taste
1 1/2  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. parsley
1 1/2  qt. stale bread crumbs
preparation: Brown sausage with all ingredients except bread crumbs.  Add to bread crumbs.  Moisten with warm water until "sticky" mixture. Stuff a 15 to 19-pound turkey.  Extra dressing may be cooked in covered buttered casserole for about 1 1/2 hours.

name: JAMAICAN BROWN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  chicken, cut up
3  cloves garlic
1/2  c. water
2  onions, sliced
fresh tomatoes (optional)
chicken seasoning to taste
black pepper to taste
salt to taste
cooking oil
browning (as desired)
preparation: Brown chicken in oil (do not flour chicken). Add all ingredients and simmer, stirring occasionally. Serve with rice.

name: RIDDLE CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion
4  cans chili beans
1  pkg. spaghetti
1 small  can tomato puree
1  can whole tomatoes
chili peppers
pepper
garlic salt
chili powder
preparation: Cook hamburger to well done.  Drain grease until all is gone. Next, add chopped onion; after onion is done in ground beef, cook spaghetti in large pan of boiling water until done.  Add beans, tomato puree and whole tomatoes to meat.  Add chili powder, garlic salt and pepper as ingredients cook.  Add spaghetti.  If you like hot chili, add three chopped jalapeno peppers.  Cook ingredients together for 10 minutes.  Serves 8.

name: SUCCESS CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
1/2  c. butter
whites of 5 eggs
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. flavoring extract
1/2  c. water
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar and add the water.  Never mind its looks.  Then add the flour and baking powder, after sifting together.  Stir this thoroughly and then add the stiffly beaten whites of the eggs.  After that, beat it for 5 minutes.  Finally, add the flavoring extract, whichever one you prefer, and bake immediately.

name: GRANDMA ANNIE'S CREAM PIE
ingredients:
6 heaping  Tbsp. sugar
3 heaping  Tbsp. flour
2  tsp. vanilla
1  pt. heavy cream
preparation: Mix sugar and flour together, then add cream slowly until smooth.  Add vanilla.  Pour into unbaked pie crust.  Sprinkle with cinnamon.  Bake at 375° until bottom of crust begins to brown, then lower heat to 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: GRANOLA
ingredients:
7  c. oatmeal
1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1  c. wheat germ
1 1/2  c. coconut, finely ground
2  tsp. salt
1  c. slivered almonds or chopped pecans
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. warm water
1 1/2  Tbsp. vanilla
3/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: Mix dry ingredients (except brown sugar) together in large pan. Whiz other ingredients in blender.  Add liquid to dry ingredients. Mix thoroughly.  Put in large shallow pans and bake at 250°.  Stir every 15 to 20 minutes to prevent burning.  Bake until golden brown and crisp, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  Serve with milk.  Add fruit, if desired:  fresh peaches, strawberries or fruit puree.

name: UNBELIEVABLE PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Roll into balls; press down and bake 10 minutes.

name: CINNAMON BREAD
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
8  slices bread
8  tsp. butter
preparation: Mix the sugar and cinnamon.  Make buttered toast.  Sprinkle mixture over buttered toast.  Return toast to broiler.  Serve hot.

name: NEIMAN-MARCUS COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. butter
2  c. sugar
2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
4  c. flour (plain)
5  c. blended oatmeal
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. soda
24  oz. chocolate chips
1  (8 oz.) Hershey bar, grated
3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream butter and both sugars.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Mix together with flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder and soda.   Add chocolate chips, Hershey bar and nuts.  Roll into balls and place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet.  Bake for 10 minutes at 375°. Makes 112 cookies.

name: SUNNY ITALY DRESSING
ingredients:
16  oz. creamy Italian dressing
3  Tbsp. Salad Delight
3  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
preparation: Mix all together and chill.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
3 3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Grease cookie sheet.  Stir together flour, soda, cream of tartar and 1/2 teaspoon salt.  In separate bowl, beat butter for 30 seconds.  Add 2 cups sugar, milk and vanilla.  Beat well.  Add dry ingredients to beaten mixture, beating until well blended.  Form dough into 1-inch balls.  Roll in a mixture of 3 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.  Place balls 2-inches apart on a cookie sheet.  Flatten lightly with bottom of a drinking glass.  Bake 8 minutes or until golden.  Makes 66.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Spoon into lightly greased 1-quart baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until bubbly.  Serve immediately with chips or crackers.

name: FRIED FRUIT PIES
ingredients:
1  (8 oz) pkg dried peaches or apples
2  c water
1  Tbsp honey
1/2  c sugar
1  can (10) biscuits
shortening for frying
preparation: In a medium size saucepan.  Mix fruit, honey, sugar and water. Cook on medium-low heat for about 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Cook until fruit is tender and liquid is thickened. More water may be needed.  On a floured surface, roll each biscuit round and as flat as possible.  Place about 2 Tbsp. of fruit mixture on pastry; fold and seal edges with a fork.  Fry in shortening until brown on each side.  Drain on paper towels.  Makes 10 pies.

name: DEATH BY CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake or brownie mix
5  c. chocolate mousse (your recipe or Jell-O)
1  large container Cool Whip
4  Hershey chocolate candy bars
preparation: Prepare cake per box instructions.  Crumble cake into bottom of large glass bowl (punch bowl will work), then layer mousse, Cool Whip and crumbled candy bars.  Repeat layers and chill.

name: DOROTHY'S CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. butter flavor Crisco
2  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
5  eggs
1/2  c. cocoa
3  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream margarine, Crisco and sugar together, beating until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.  Sift dry ingredients together; add alternately with milk. Add vanilla.  Bake in a tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

name: PINK SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  box strawberry jello
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  qt. size cottage cheese
1  large Cool Whip
2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix jello and pineapple in pan and heat until jello dissolves; let cool. Mix cottage cheese, Cool Whip and pecans. When jello has cooled, add cottage cheese mixture to it; mix together well and put in refrigerator until congealed.

name: BAKED CORN
ingredients:
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can cream-style corn
1/2  c. cornbread mix
1/2  c. milk
1/3  c. melted margarine
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1/4  c. sugar
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In mixing bowl, combine all ingredients listed.  Grease baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Turn oven up to 400° and brown.  Should be golden brown when done.  Ovens may vary, so check often.

name: CURRY DIP
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Dukes mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. mustard powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. curry powder
2  tsp. chopped onion
dash of Tabasco
preparation: Mix all ingredients and serve with raw vegetables.

name: ROSEMARY BREAD
ingredients:
1  lb. pizza bread dough
garlic powder
freshly ground black pepper
fresh rosemary
olive oil
preparation: Shape dough into round flat pieces.  Brush tops with olive oil.  Sprinkle first with fresh rosemary, then black pepper and last with garlic powder.  Let rise and then bake at 350° until done.

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed and drained
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. strawberry glaze
1 (15 1/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  medium container Cool Whip
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix strawberries with glaze.  Add other ingredients and mix together thoroughly.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. crushed banana
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. nuts (optional)
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix all together. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BLUEBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
2  c. sugar
2  beaten eggs
3 1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. milk
1  qt. blueberries (floured)
sprinkle of sugar and cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cream sugar with margarine.  Add eggs. Begin adding dry ingredients and alternate with milk until completely mixed.  Add floured blueberries.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

name: BACON WATER CHESTNUTS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. bacon, cut in half crosswise
1 (8 oz.)  can whole water chestnuts, drained
1/2  c. salad dressing
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/4  c. chili sauce
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Cook bacon in a large skillet on medium heat until almost crisp; drain.  Wrap bacon around water chestnuts.  Secure with toothpicks.  Place in baking dish.  Mix remaining ingredients; pour over water chestnuts.  Bake 45 minutes.  Makes 24.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. flour
1 to 2  Tbsp. margarine
1  tsp. minced onion
salt and pepper to taste
1  tsp. dry mustard (optional)
2  c. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Measure milk into pan and blend in flour until no lumps remain.  Add margarine, onion and other seasonings and cook until sauce thickens.  Stir in macaroni and cheese.  Bake in greased 1-quart casserole, uncovered at 400° for 15 minutes or until slightly browned and bubbly.  May be frozen before baking.  Serves 4.

name: VINEGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. vinegar
4 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Cream butter, shortening and sugars thoroughly.  Add eggs and mix well.  Add vinegar and blend.  Sift flour and baking soda 4 times.  (It is important to sift 4 times; it makes them lighter.) Sift into the creamed mixture, a little at a time.  Add extracts and make into little balls.   Press flat with a fork.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: FRIED RICE
ingredients:
3  slices bacon, cut in half
1/4  c. diced onion
1  c. cooked rice (cold)
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/4  c. water
2  slightly beaten eggs
preparation: Lay bacon slices over heating base of wok.  Turn heat control to 350°.  Fry bacon until crisp, about 6 minutes.  Remove bacon. Drain on paper towel and crumble.  Stir-fry onion 2 minutes in bacon drippings.  Add cold rice and stir-fry for 7 to 8 minutes. Add soy sauce, water and bacon.  Reduce heat to 250°.  Clear wok base by moving rice up along sides.  Pour eggs on base of wok. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes or until eggs are cooked.  Break in pieces; mix in rice.  Reduce heat to warm 200° for serving.  Makes 4 servings.

name: ENGLISH TOFFEE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. packed brown sugar
1  c. butter
4  Hershey chocolate bars
preparation: Sprinkle 1/2 cup pecans in greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Melt butter in saucepan. Add sugar and mix well.

name: SHRIMP CANTONESE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. shrimp, peeled and deveined
2  Tbsp. oil
1  c. sliced onion
1  pkg. frozen snow peas
1 (16 oz.)  can fancy mixed Chinese vegetables
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. soy sauce
1 1/4  c. chicken broth
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Saute shrimp in oil for 1 minute or until shrimp turn pink, using a large skillet.  Add onion and snow peas; cook, stirring 2 minutes.  Add Chinese vegetables which have been rinsed and drained.  Cover and cook 1 minute.  Blend pepper, soy sauce, chicken broth and cornstarch.  Stir into shrimp/vegetable mixture. Cook, stirring until sauce is clear and thickened.

name: CARROT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked carrots, mashed
1  stick margarine, melted
3  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
3  eggs, well beaten
preparation: Mix carrots and margarine.  Mix flour, baking powder, cinnamon and sugar.  Add to carrot mixture.  Add eggs and mix well. Butter or grease baking dish.  Pour in mixture and bake at 375° for 15 minutes.  Reduce heat to 325° and bake 45 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE CHESS PIE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
7  Tbsp. cocoa
3  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
4  eggs
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Mix sugar, cocoa and flour.  Add milk and eggs, blend well. Add melted margarine and vanilla.  Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

name: CONFETTI SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1 soup  can milk
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1  small green pepper, cut into strips
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
dash of pepper
1  c. cheese cracker crumbs, divided
preparation: In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat.  Saute onion until tender.  Stir in potatoes, soup and milk.  Add cheese, green pepper, pimiento, pepper and 1/2 cup of the crumbs.  Pour into a shallow casserole.  Top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.   Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: SPRING POTATO TART
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. potatoes
salt
basil leaves
1  medium onion, sliced thin
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen asparagus, cooked
3  medium tomatoes, sliced
1  Tbsp. bread crumbs
preparation: Peel potatoes and slice 1/8-inch thick.  Place half the potato slices in greased 9-inch square baking dish.  Sprinkle with salt and basil.  Top with layers of sliced onion, asparagus and tomato slices, sprinkling each layer with salt and basil.  Top with remaining potato slices; sprinkle with bread crumbs.  Cover with foil.  Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.  Remove cover and continue to bake 10 to 15 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender.  Makes 6 servings.

name: CHUNKY APPLESAUCE
ingredients:
3  lb. cooking apples (such as Cortland), quartered and cored
2  Tbsp. sugar
3  packets Sweet One
1  Tbsp. water
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Cut each apple into half crosswise.  In large saucepan, combine quartered apples, sugar, Sweet One, water, cinnamon and cloves.  Over low heat, cook, covered, stirring frequently, for 10 to 15 minutes or until apples are soft, but still chunky.  Serve warm or cold.  Makes 8 (1/2 cup) servings.  Calories:  115 per 1/2 cup.

name: CRACKER CAKE
ingredients:
6  egg whites, beaten until frothy
3/4  tsp. cream of tartar
2  c. sugar
2  c. crushed soda crackers
1  c. nuts
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tub Cool Whip
pie cherries or strawberries or any fruit filling
preparation: Add to beaten egg whites the cream of tartar and sugar.  Beat until glossy, not stiff.  Fold in crackers, nuts and vanilla. Place in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Cool.  Add as much Cool Whip on top as you want. Carefully add cherries or fruit filling on top.

name: HASH BROWN POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash browns
1  pt. sour cream
1/4  c. chopped onions
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: In a 9 x 13-inch greased pan, place potatoes.  Add cheese mixture.  Stir lightly.  Top with crushed corn flakes.  Bake at 325°, uncovered, for 1 hour.

name: JELLO BLUEBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. grape Jell-O plus 2 c. boiling water
1 (No. 2)  can undrained crushed pineapple
1 (No. 2)  can blueberry pie filling
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  pt. sour cream
1/2  c. sugar plus 1 tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix Jell-O and boiling water well; add pineapple and pie filling.  Mix well and refrigerate until firm.  Combine together cream cheese, sour cream, sugar and vanilla and mix well.  Spread over Jell-O mixture.

name: TUNA AND SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. herb and butter rice, cooked
1  pkg. frozen spinach, thawed
1  c. sour cream
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can tuna, drained
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Grease a small casserole dish with fairly high sides.  In bottom, layer thawed and drained frozen spinach.  Mix 3/4 cup sour cream with the cooked rice and layer over spinach.  Flake tuna over rice.  Spread remaining sour cream over tuna and sprinkle with grated cheese.  Warm completely covered in a 350° oven for about 1 hour.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. yeast
1  c. warm water
1  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
2  tsp. salt
1  c. cold water
2  eggs
6  c. flour
1  stick butter
preparation: Mix yeast and warm water; set aside.  Cream sugar, shortening, salt and eggs; mix long.  Add cold water and yeast mixture.  Add flour (mixture is not stiff).  Cover with towel and let rise 2 to 3 hours.  Punch down and divide dough in half.  Cut in strips (big dumplings).

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising meal
3  eggs
2  Tbsp. chopped bell pepper
1  c. cream-style corn
1  c. buttermilk
3/4  c. Wesson oil
1  tsp. cayenne pepper
2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients except cheese.  Pour half of the batter into black iron skillet.  Top with 1 cup Cheddar cheese.  Pour rest of batter and top with remainder of the cheese.  Bake 45 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: BEAR CLAWS
ingredients:
2  bags caramel candy
1  stick margarine
2  Tbsp. milk
5  c. chopped pecans
Pam spray
1 1/2  pkg. almond bark
preparation: You will also need waxed paper.

name: CHICKEN CACCIATORE
ingredients:
4  skinless, boneless chicken breasts
flour or Baking Magic seasoned coating mix
1/4  c. oil
1 minced  clove of garlic
1/4  c. tomato paste
1/4  c. dry white wine
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. chicken stock
1/2  bay leaf
1/8  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. basil
1/8  tsp. marjoram
1/2 to 1  c. sliced mushrooms
preparation: Dredge chicken with flour or Baking Magic seasoning mix.  Saute until golden brown in oil.  Add all other ingredients.  Simmer the chicken, covered, for 1 hour or until tender.  Serve with pasta or rice.  Makes 4 servings.

name: HOT CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
1  lb. sharp cheddar cheese
2  medium onions
1  (4 oz.) jalapeno peppers
1/8  tsp. tabasco sauce
3/4  c. mayonnaise
Dash of salt
preparation: Using medium blade, put cheese, onions, and jalapeno peppers through a food chopper.  Add mayonnaise, tabasco sauce and salt. Refrigerate for 24 hours.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
1/2  c. butter
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
3  c. sugar
dash of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. almond
6  eggs
3  c. flour (cake)
preparation: Combine oleo, butter, cream cheese and sugar.  Beat well.  Add salt, vanilla and almonds.  Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add flour and mix well.

name: ORANGE SHERBET
ingredients:
1  (2 liter) Orange Crush drink
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk
preparation: Mix together and churn freeze.  Makes approximately 3 quarts.

name: SHRIMP SPREAD
ingredients:
1  can whole shrimp
1  Tbsp. horseradish
2  tsp. lemon juice
mayonnaise or Miracle Whip
preparation: Rinse and drain shrimp.  In a bowl, mash shrimp and add horseradish and lemon juice.  Add enough mayonnaise or Miracle Whip to make a spread.  Serve with assorted crackers.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  tsp. flour
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
3  eggs, well beaten
about 10 crackers, crumbs
6  Tbsp. butter
1/2  c. water
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and as much water squeezed out as possible
preparation: Fry onion in 4 tablespoons butter.  Add flour and water.  When thick add Cheez Whiz.  Combine sauce with broccoli.  Add eggs. Pour into greased casserole.  Top with buttered cracker crumbs using the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter.   Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.

name: TRUFFLE
ingredients:
1  pound cake or angel food cake, cut in squares
1  pkg. instant pudding
1  can pie filling (any flavor)
1  small Dream Whip (on top)
preparation: Arrange the ingredients in order given, with Dream Whip on top.  Refrigerate to set.

name: DENVER BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  qt. milk
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. baking powder
1  c. melted Crisco
1  tsp. salt
3  pkg. dry yeast
preparation: Heat milk in small saucepan to lukewarm.  Add yeast.  In large bowl, mix Crisco, sugar, milk mixture and enough flour (about 5 cups) to make consistency of cake batter.  Put in large bowl, cover and let rise.

name: NINTH STREET HOUSE TEA
ingredients:
16  tsp. plain instant tea
1  c. lemon juice
3  c. sugar
3/4  c. white grape juice
water
preparation: Mix tea, sugar, grape juice and lemon juice together in a 1 gallon jug.  Finish filling jug with water.  Makes 1 gallon tea.

name: POUND CAKE CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
2  c. sugar
2  c. plain flour
6  eggs
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. almond flavoring
2  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Grease and flour pan, loaf pan or tube pan.  Sift flour before measuring.  Put back in sifter with salt and sugar and sift together.  Break eggs one at a time.  Put eggs and flavoring together and beat.  Beat Crisco and dry mixture.  Add egg mixture; add eggs and beat well.  Put in pan and cut through with spatula. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 hours.  Test for doneness.  Cool.

name: DEVILISH DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sour cream
2 (2 1/4 oz.)  cans deviled ham
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine ingredients; mix until well blended.  Serve with vegetable dippers or potato chips.

name: RISOTTO
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. olive oil
6  Tbsp. butter
1  large onion, finely chopped
1 large  clove garlic, minced
2  c. short grain rice
1/8  tsp. saffron (optional)
4 (14 1/2 oz.)  cans chicken broth
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Place olive oil and 4 tablespoons of the butter in a heavy 3- quart pan over medium heat.  When butter is melted, add onion and cook, stirring, until soft and golden.  Add garlic and rice and stir until rice looks milky and opaque, about 3 minutes.  Stir in saffron and mix in broth.  Cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until mixture comes to a boil.  Adjust heat so rice boils gently, then cook uncovered until rice is al dente and most of the liquid is absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes.  Toward end of cooking time, stir occasionally to prevent sticking.  Turn off heat and stir in cheese and the remaining 2 tablespoons butter.

name: COQ AU VIN
ingredients:
chicken for 4
1/4  c. butter or margarine
4  onions, sliced
1  can cream of mushroom soup or cream of celery or cream of chicken
1/2  c. white wine
1/2  c. water
1/4  tsp. thyme
1  c. plus sliced mushrooms
salt and pepper to taste
parsley
rice
preparation: Brown chicken in butter.  Remove chicken from pan.  Brown sliced onions and mushrooms.  Add soup and stir.  Add wine and water.  Stir thoroughly.  Add thyme, salt and pepper.  Replace chicken in mixture.  Cover.  Cook over low heat for 30 minutes to an hour.  Serve over rice.   Serves 4.

name: STUFFING AND TURKEY BAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. (1 stick) butter or margarine
1 1/4  c. boiling water
3 1/2  c. seasoned stuffing crumbs
1 (2.8 oz.)  can French fried onions
1  can cream of celery soup
3/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. cubed, cooked turkey
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, thawed, rinsed in cold water and drained
preparation: Combine butter and boiling water.  Stir until butter melts, then pour over stuffing crumbs and toss lightly.  Stir in 1/2 can French fried onions.  Spoon mixture into 9-inch shallow buttered baking dish (1 1/2-quart).  Press stuffing in bottom and up sides of dish to form a shell.  Combine soup, milk, turkey and peas. Pour into stuffing shell.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes. Uncover and top with remaining onions.  Bake 5 to 8 minutes longer. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
2/3  c. evaporated milk
1  stick melted oleo
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. Kraft caramels, melted
nuts and chocolate chips
preparation: Mix cake as directed on box.  Add 1/3 cup evaporated milk and oleo.  Put half mixture in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.  Melt caramels with 1/3 cup milk.  Spread on hot cake.  Spread nuts and chocolate chips on top of this.  Pour rest of batter on top of this.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes longer.  Needs no icing.

name: SANGRIA
ingredients:
1 (1 pt. 7 oz.)  bottle red Spanish wine
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  lemon, thinly sliced
1/2  orange, thinly sliced
2  oz. Cointreau
2  oz. brandy
1 (12 oz.)  bottle chilled club soda
24  ice cubes
preparation: Combine and let stand 15 to 20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked chicken, cut up
1  c. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  pkg. Stove Top stuffing mix
preparation: Place chicken in casserole.  Mix sour cream and soup together; spread over chicken.  Top with prepared stuffing.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: MASHED POTATO PIE
ingredients:
1  (10-inch) unbaked pie shell
1  lb. small curd cottage cheese
2  c. unseasoned mashed potatoes
1/2  c. sour cream
2  eggs, beaten
2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. scallion, thinly sliced
3  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Mash cottage cheese with back of large spoon to make smooth. Beat mashed potatoes into cottage cheese.  Beat in sour cream, eggs, salt and pepper.  Stir in scallions.  Spoon into unbaked pie shell.  Sprinkle top with grated cheese.  Bake at 425° for 50 minutes until brown on top.  Let stand for 5 minutes.

name: LISBON'S GARLIC GRITS
ingredients:
1  c. grits
4  c. boiling water
1  tsp. salt
1  stick margarine
1/2  or 1 roll garlic cheese
2  eggs, well beaten
milk added to eggs to total 1 c.
preparation: Cook grits according to directions on box.  Add butter and cheese and stir until melted.  Add eggs, beaten with the milk. Stir until well blended.  Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole.  Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
4  c. fresh peach slices
1  stick butter
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
6  Tbsp. butter
2  cans Pillsbury crescent rolls
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix peaches with half the sugar and cinnamon.  Add vanilla and let it sit.  Put butter in pan and place in the oven on low to melt.  Unroll 1 can of Pillsbury crescent rolls.  Roll crescents until completely flat.  Lay over in the pan.   Pour the mixture in.  Take the second can of crescents out and flatten.  Cut into strips and place over the mixture.  Take stick of butter and cut fine slices over the strips.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until brown and bubbly.  Serve with ice cream.

name: COCONUT CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
1  c. flaked coconut, divided
1  unbaked 9-inch pie shell
3  eggs
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1 1/4  c. hot water
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. ground nutmeg
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Spread 1/2 cup coconut on cookie sheet. Toast in oven 5 to 8 minutes or until golden; set aside.  Bake pie shell 8 minutes; cool slightly.  Meanwhile, in medium sized bowl with wire whisk, beat eggs.   Add sweetened condensed milk, water, vanilla, salt and nutmeg.  Mix well.  Stir in remaining 1/2 cup untoasted coconut.  Pour mixture into pie shell; sprinkle edge with toasted coconut.  Bake 10 minutes.  Reduce oven temperature to 350°; bake 25 to 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted near center comes out clean.  Let pie cool thoroughly before refrigerating.  Refrigerate several hours or until chilled if desired.

name: CHICKEN 'N BISCUIT BAKE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. margarine
2  c. chopped, cooked chicken
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped celery
1  Tbsp. chopped pimento (optional)
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. dry bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. Kraft grated Parmesan cheese
1  can Pillsbury refrigerated biscuits
preparation: In large skillet, combine 2 tablespoons margarine, chicken, onion, celery and pimento.  Stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes.  Add sour cream and heat thoroughly, then separate biscuits into 10 biscuits.  Press biscuits over sides and bottom of pie pan.  Spoon chicken mixture over biscuits.  Bake 8 to 13 minutes.

name: BILLYGOAT COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. light brown sugar
1  c. butter
2 1/2  c. flour
2  c. pecan meats
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
1  lb. dates
1  tsp. soda
3  eggs
preparation: Add eggs one at a time, while mixing.  Cream sugar and butter. Add cinnamon and vanilla.  Cut dates fine.  Dredge with flour; add to mixture with nut meats.  Dissolve soda in a little warm water. Add to mixture as you add flour alternately; mix well.  Drop by small spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350°.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1  c. deveined shrimp
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1 to 2  tsp. lemon juice
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Let cream cheese stand at room temperature until soft.  Put shrimp in a bowl and mash with a fork; add sour cream, cream cheese, lemon juice, salt and pepper.

name: LIMA BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. lima beans
1/2  c. Best Foods mayonnaise
1/2  c. chopped green onions
1/2  c. chopped celery
4  hard-boiled eggs
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Boil lima beans until tender.  Rinse in cold water.  Mix in mayonnaise, green onions, celery and 3 diced eggs.  Add salt and pepper to taste. Garnish with parsley and sliced egg and paprika. Better flavor if made the day before.

name: CHILI BEANS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
2  Tbsp. oil
1  tsp. green hot pepper, chopped
1  c. pork and beans
1  bouillon cube
2  tsp. chili powder
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  c. catsup
preparation: Saute ground beef and green hot pepper in oil until tender. Now, add pork and beans, bouillon cube, chili powder, brown sugar and catsup.  Simmer all this together for about 5 minutes.

name: LUSCIOUS LEMON CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken parts
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. tarragon leaves, crushed
dash of pepper
lemon slices
preparation: In skillet, brown chicken in shortening.  Pour off fat. Add remaining  ingredients  except lemon slices.  Cover; cook over low heat 45 minutes or until tender.  Stir occasionally. Chill overnight.	Reheat	in  covered skillet about 15 minutes or until hot.  Stir and garnish with lemon.

name: CINNAMON NUTS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/3  c. canned cream
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix cinnamon into sugar; add cream and mix well.  Cook on medium-low heat, stirring constantly; cook to 240°.  Remove from heat.  Add vanilla and nuts.  Stir until syrup coats nuts.  Spread on wax paper to cool.  Break into pieces.

name: DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. soft shortening
1  pkg. active dry yeast
1  c. warm (not hot) water
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  egg
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in water.  Stir in sugar, salt and half the flour.  Beat until smooth.  Add egg and shortening.  Beat in remaining flour until smooth.  Cover; let rise in warm place until double in size.  Grease muffin pans.  Punch down dough, turn on pastry sheet and press dough flat.  Cut with cutter or shape into clover leaves.  Place in muffin tins.  Let rise again, then brush with melted butter.  Bake in preheated 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.  Makes 12 to 18 rolls.

name: TACO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked pinto beans
1  c. cooked kidney beans
1  medium onion, chopped
1  clove minced garlic
1/2  Tbsp. salt
1/2  Tbsp. cumin
1/8  Tbsp. CHILI POWDER
SPICY CASHEW CHEESE
tomato sauce
tortilla chips
preparation: Season beans  with onion, garlic, salt, cumin and chili powder.  Blend  beans.  Spread  half of mixture into casserole dish, then  tomato  sauce,  SPICY  CASHEW  CHEESE and tortilla chips.  Repeat,  ending  with cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.  Serves 8.

name: APRICOT BRANDY SLUSH
ingredients:
2  tea bags
1  c. hot water
3 1/2  c. cold water
1  c. sugar
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
3  oz. lemon juice
1  c. apricot brandy
preparation: Put tea bags in 1 cup hot water for 3 minutes.  Squeeze excess from tea bags into water.  Add remaining ingredients to the tea. Mix well and freeze.  Add 7-Up, Wink or 4% when ready to serve.

name: BREAKFAST QUICHE
ingredients:
12  slices bacon (cooked and crumbled)
1  c. shredded cheese
1  medium onion (chopped)
2  c. milk
1/2  c. biscuit mix
4  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Sprinkle  bacon,  cheese  and onion in a greased 9-inch pie pan.  Blend remaining ingredients in blender on high for 1 minute. Pour into pie pan.  Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

name: PIZZA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  lb. sausage
1  large onion, chopped
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
12  oz. pkg. Canadian bacon or round ham slices, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. wide noodles, cooked and drained
2  jars Ragu pizza sauce
1  pkg. sliced pepperoni
1 (8 oz.)  can mushrooms
4  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown and drain first 5 ingredients.  Cook noodles and drain. Mix all ingredients together except cheese and pour into casserole pans (8 1/2 x 11-inch or about).  Makes 2 or 3 pans.  Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until cheese melts.

name: FAST HOMEMADE CORN OAT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. oil
1  pkg. dry yeast
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
3  ice cubes
3  c. flour
1/2  c. cornmeal
2  pkg. instant oatmeal
preparation: Heat milk, oil, brown sugar and salt in saucepan.  Remove from heat.  Add ice cubes, then stir in yeast.  Add flour, cornmeal and oatmeal.  Cover and let rise 30 minutes.  Put into loaf pan and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: SALMON BALL
ingredients:
1 large  can salmon, drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  tsp. liquid smoke
2 to 3  tsp. onion flakes
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Form into ball.  Roll in chopped fresh parsley and pecans.  Serve with crackers.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. rice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  qt. milk
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Put 1 cup rice in large Dutch oven (4 quart stainless steel kettle with lid).  Cover with 1/2-inch water.  Start on high.  Add 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.  Bring to a boil and add milk.  Turn to medium.  When boils, turn to low and add raisins (optional).  Simmer 30 minutes, covered.  Remove and let sit off the burner 20 minutes, covered.  Mix together the eggs, 1/2 cup water, 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla.  Add to mixture and bring to a boil.  Put into serving dish.  Sprinkle with cinnamon, if desired, before serving.

name: CHICKEN-MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1 (4 oz.)  can diced Ortega chiles (green)
1  large pinch instant minced onion
1/2 soup  can water
2  large firm, ripe tomatoes, sliced thinly
1 (6 to 8 oz.)  pkg. corn chips or tortilla chips
2 (5 oz. each)  cans boned chicken, chunked or 2 c. cooked and cubed chicken
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a mixing bowl, place soup, chiles, onion and water.  Stir to blend well.  Lay 1/2 corn chips in 2-quart casserole.  Top with 1 can or 1 cup chunked chicken, then half of the tomato slices. Pour half of the soup mixture over chicken mixture. Sprinkle with half of the cheese.  Repeat layers in same order, ending with cheese.  Bake, uncovered, on High in microwave or reheat 8 to 10 minutes with cover on.  Serves 6.

name: STICKY BUNS
ingredients:
3/4  c. margarine (divided)
1/3  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 (25 oz.)  pkg. frozen round dinner rolls
1  c. white sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Melt 1/4 cup margarine and pour into a 9 or 10-inch Bundt pan. Sprinkle in the brown sugar and pecans.  Melt remaining 1/2 cup margarine and place in bowl.  Combine sugar and cinnamon.  Roll each unbaked roll in the margarine and then in cinnamon and sugar. Arrange the balls in pan. Drizzle remaining sugar-cinnamon over rolls.  Leave out overnight, covered with a cloth.

name: QUICK TATER TOT BAKE
ingredients:
3/4 to 1  lb. ground turkey
1  small onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen Tater Tot potatoes
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can reduced fat cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1/2 soup  can water
1  c. fat-free shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a skillet, brown meat and onion.  Drain any fat.  Season with salt and pepper.  Place in a greased 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole.  Top with potatoes.  Combine soup and water, pour over potatoes.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE-AMARETTO CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
6  chocolate wafers, finely crushed
1 1/2  c. light process cream cheese product
1  c. sugar
1  c. 1% low-fat cottage cheese
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. unsweetened cocoa
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. Amaretto
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
2  Tbsp. semi-sweet chocolate mini morsels
chocolate curls (optional)
preparation: You can substitute an 8-inch pan for this cheesecake recipe, if desired.  The large cheesecake will require only 45 to 50 minutes baking time.

name: EASY POT ROAST
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. chuck roast
seasoned flour
1 small  can beef broth
5  potatoes, cubed
6  to 7 carrots, cubed
4  medium-sized white onions
2  jars whole button mushrooms (drain water off)
approximately 1 tsp. salt
approximately 1/2 tsp. pepper
1  bay leaf
preparation: Turn chuck roast in seasoned flour and brown on all sides in small amount of hot oil.  Put the browned roast and vegetables into large roasting pan.  Add the salt, pepper and bay leaf.  Pour the can of beef broth over all and cover tightly.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour, then reduce heat to 350° for 2 hours, or until meat is tender.

name: CRUMB CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  lb. margarine, softened
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cinnamon
4  c. flour
powdered sugar
preparation: Prepare cake mix as directed.  Pour into 11 x 16-inch greased and floured pan.  Bake 15 minutes at 350°.  While baking, mix sugar and margarine.  Add cinnamon and flour.  Mix into crumbs and cover top of cake.  Continue to bake crumbs and cake for 20 minutes.  When cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. margarine or butter
1/2  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
1 1/4  c. milk
3  c. plain flour
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. cocoa
