preparation: Cream butter, sugar and Crisco. Add one egg at a time.  Sift flour, baking powder and cocoa together. Add alternately with milk.  Add flavoring. Put in a cold oven at 325° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  c. cornstarch
1  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
3  c. milk, scalded
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3  large ripe bananas, sliced
3  egg yolks, well beaten
preparation: Mix cornstarch with sugar and salt in double boiler.  Pour scalded milk over this mixture.  Cover and cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add hot mixture very slowly to beaten egg yolks, stirring constantly.  Return to double boiler.  Cook 2 minutes.  Let cool.  Add vanilla.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can Veg-All, drained
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can cream of chicken soup or 1 can cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. (tube roll) Ritz cracker crumbs
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can water chestnuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except crumbs.  Use 13 x 9-inch casserole dish.  Top mixture with crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter or margarine
2  tsp. chopped chives
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1 3/4  c. milk
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
4  medium potatoes, sliced
preparation: Microwave butter in 2-quart casserole on High until melted. Stir in flour, chives, salt, dry mustard and pepper.  Blend in milk.  Microwave on High 5 to 7 minutes or until thickened, stirring every other minute.  Mix in potatoes. Cover.  Microwave on High 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender, stirring 2 or 3 times.

name: HONEY FRUIT DRESSING FOR FRUIT
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1/3  c. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. ginger
2  Tbsp. honey
preparation: Combine ingredients in small bowl; beat until smooth.  Serve over fresh fruit.  Keep refrigerated.  Makes 1 1/2 cups.

name: YAMS AND CHERRIES
ingredients:
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can sweet potatoes
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
2  Tbsp. butter
1 (No. 303)  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Slice sweet potatoes 1/2-inch thick.  Arrange layer in buttered casserole dish.  Mix all dry ingredients; sprinkle over potatoes.  Dot with 1 tablespoon butter.  Add 1/2 of the cherries. Repeat until all ingredients are used.  Pour potato liquid over layers until visible.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: PIZZA TWISTS
ingredients:
1  pkg. refrigerated breadsticks
garlic powder
Italian seasonings
pizza sauce
shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Separate the breadsticks.  Stick the ends together so each one forms a circle and then twist it into a figure 8.  Sprinkle with garlic powder and Italian seasoning.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. plain flour
8  oz. cream cheese, at room temperature
3  c. sugar
7  eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring
3  sticks margarine
1  Tbsp. lemon flavoring
preparation: Cream margarine and cream cheese.  Add sugar and beat 3 minutes.  Add eggs and both flavorings.  Beat well.  Gradually add flour until well blended.  Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.

name: BUTTERMILK SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can pineapple tidbits, undrained
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange flavored gelatin
2  c. buttermilk
1  (12 oz.) container non-dairy whipped topping
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Heat pineapple and juice in a saucepan.  Remove from heat. Add gelatin, stirring to dissolve.  Cool.  Fold in buttermilk, whipped topping and pecans.  Pour into square or oblong dish. Chill until firm.

name: DIETETIC AMBROSIA
ingredients:
2  c. crushed pineapple (canned in its own juice), drained
1/2  c. raisins
3  chopped or grated apples (with or without peel)
1 large  can dietetic fruit cocktail, drained (optional)
1/2 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice concentrate
1  pkg. unflavored gelatin
3/4  can diet 7-Up
1  tsp. coconut extract
preparation: Heat part of the 7-Up to boiling point.  Stir in gelatin until well blended.  Add rest of 7-Up and then the coconut extract. Pour this over the fruits, which have been stirred together. Chill.  Store in covered container.

name: CARROT AND RAISIN SUNSHINE SALAD
ingredients:
5  to 6 carrots, peeled and shredded
1/2  c. raisins
1  carton (8 oz.) low-fat vanilla yogurt
4  to 6 iceberg lettuce leaves
preparation: Mix all ingredients together, except lettuce leaves, in a mixing bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 15 minutes; toss again before serving.  Serve on lettuce leaves.

name: LOW-FAT CHILI(Quick)
ingredients:
1  bell pepper (red or green)
1  onion
2  cloves garlic
1  can Italian stewed tomatoes
1  lb. ground turkey
2  tsp. ground cumin
2  tsp. oregano
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1/4  tsp. hot red pepper sauce
2  tsp. cider vinegar
pepper to taste
preparation: Chop pepper, onion and garlic very fine.  Put tomatoes, chopped pepper, onion and garlic in a microwave covered dish. Microwave at 100° for 9 minutes.  In a large frying pan, cook turkey, adding cumin, oregano, chili powder, pepper sauce and cider vinegar as you stir.  Break up meat chunks as they cook. Add cooked vegetables to frying pan, mixing with meat mixture. Cover and simmer 5 to 10 minutes.  Serve over cooked rice.

name: HOT POTATO(Microwave)
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes
1/4  c. water, mixed with 1/2 tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. flour
1 3/4  c. milk
2  c. mild Cheddar cheese, grated
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Peel potatoes and slice thinly into a 2-quart baking dish. Add salt water.   Cover.   Cook on High for 18 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.  Drain.

name: SOFT PRETZELS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. warm water
1  pkg. active dry yeast
4  c. flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Put warm water in bowl with yeast and let dissolve. Add sugar and salt. Stir in enough flour to make a smooth dough. Turn out the dough on lightly floured surface and use excess flour to knead into dough. Knead until smooth.  Divide into 18 to 24 pieces; roll into balls. Roll each ball into a long strip (snake). Curve each strip into a horse shoe shape. Lift up the ends and twist them once around each other. Fold over the ends and rest them on top of the curve, forming a pretzel shape. Brush pretzels with a mixture of egg beaten with a little water. Sprinkle pretzel with coarse salt. Bake on greased pan at 425° for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

name: MOSTACCIOLI(Serves 6)
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. mostaccioli
1  lb. ground beef
3  Tbsp. oil
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
1/3  c. chopped onion
4  c. tomatoes
6  oz. can tomato paste
3/4  c. water
1  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef, onion and garlic in oil.  Break up tomatoes well and add with tomato paste, water, oregano, salt and pepper to the ground beef.  Cover and cook over low heat 1 1/2 hours.  Spoon off excess fat.  Cook mostaccioli as directed.  Drain and place on serving platter.  Top with sauce and sprinkle with cheese.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans green beans, cooked
1  can mushroom soup, heated
preparation: Mix together.  Pour into a greased casserole.  Top with 1 can French fried onions.  Bake in oven 15 or 20 minutes.

name: Mozzarella Cheese Quiche
ingredients:
1  (9 or 10-inch) unbaked pastry shell
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
4  eggs
1/2  pt. cream or half and half
1  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook broccoli as directed.  Mix eggs, cream and half the cheese together.  Stir in broccoli.  Pour into unbaked shell.  Sprinkle remaining cheese on top and bake 45 minutes or until crust is brown and cheese is raised.  The cheese will flatten, if not served promptly.

name: MY FAVORITE SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
5  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. prepared mustard
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. salt
1  clove garlic
1  tsp. grated onion
1/2  c. salad oil
1/4  c. vinegar
preparation: Mix together in a jar and shake well.  Let stand out of refrigerator overnight.  Shake vigorously often.

name: CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
1  whole fryer
2 1/4  c. broth
1  can celery soup
2  hard-boiled eggs
preparation: Cook whole fryer and debone.  Put chicken in bottom of long casserole dish.  Mix broth and celery soup; cook until boiling. Pour over chicken.  Cut up eggs over this.

name: RASPBERRY-TOPPED LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1  (10 oz.) packaged frozen red raspberries in syrup, thawed
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  egg yolks
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1/2  c. lemon juice from concentrate
yellow food coloring (optional)
1  (6 oz.) packaged graham cracker crumb pie crust
whipping cream, whipped, or whipped topping
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  In small saucepan, combine raspberries and cornstarch; cook and stir until thickened and clear.  In medium bowl, beat egg yolks with sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice and food coloring if desired.  Pour into crust; bake 30 minutes.  Spoon raspberry mixture evenly over top.  Chill 4 hours or until set. Spread with whipped cream.  Garnish as desired.  Refrigerate leftovers.  Makes 1 pie.

name: PEPPERONI BITES
ingredients:
1  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. chopped pepperoni
1/2  c. pizza sauce
2  pkg. canned biscuits
1  Tbsp. milk
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: For filling:  In a bowl, combine Mozzarella cheese, pepperoni and pizza sauce.  Set aside.

name: LEMON SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
1/2  c. powdered sugar
2  c. flour
dash of salt
2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. flour
4  eggs
juice of 1 lemon or I use 1 1/2 lemons
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Pour this over baked crust and return to oven for 25 minutes at 350°.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar while still warm.  Cut into squares while warm.

name: BRENDA CARNES' KENTUCKY BUTTER CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. plain flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. butter, softened
2  tsp. rum extract
4  eggs
preparation: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and extract.  Mix dry ingredients; add alternately with buttermilk.  Beat 3 minutes. Pour into greased and floured 12-cup tube pan.  Bake for 55 to 70 minutes in preheated 325° oven.  Top with Butter Sauce as soon as cake is done.

name: MICROWAVE PEANUT BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. white corn syrup
1/2  c. water
2  c. sugar
2  c. peanuts
2  tsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Mix and cook corn syrup, water and sugar for 6 minutes in microwave on High in uncovered dish.  Meanwhile butter cookie sheets.  Remove from oven and stir.  Add peanuts.  Return to microwave on High for 8 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes.  Add butter.  Cook another 8 to 10 minutes on High, stirring every 2 minutes.  Add baking soda and vanilla to mixture, it will bubble up.  Spread into cookie sheet.  When cold break into pieces.

name: LEMON ICE BOX PIE
ingredients:
2  graham cracker crust
3  cans Eagle brand milk
juice from 5 lemons
6  egg yolks
dash salt
preparation: Makes 2 pies.

name: WINKLER'S MORAVIAN SUGAR CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. warm water (110~)
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. dry milk
1/4  c. instant mashed potatoes, dry
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. melted and cooled butter
2  eggs
1  c. flour
yeast mixture
salt
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: In  a  half  cup  of warm water (110°) add 1/2 teaspoon sugar and sprinkle 2 packages of active dry yeast.  Set aside until yeast  bubbles.  Beat 2 minutes on medium speed or with wooden spoon.  Add  an  additional 1 3/4 cup flour.  Place in greased bowl,  grease top of dough;  cover and let rise until double, about an hour.  Punch dough down in greased pan (17 x 12 x 1-inch deep).  Let rise 30 minutes.  Spread evenly in pan and  sprinkle evenly  with  brown  sugar	and cinnamon.  Make shallow indentations  with	fingers.  Dribble  with  1  stick melted and cooled butter.  Let rise 30 minutes.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375°.

name: CHRISTMAS NUTCAKE
ingredients:
2  lb. chopped dates
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
4  eggs
2  lb. nuts
1  c. flour
pinch of salt
preparation: Separate eggs; beat until foamy, but not stiff.  Chop nuts. Place all ingredients in bowl and mix well.  Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: CRANBERRY-PECAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sour cream
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. cranberries, halved
1/2  c. chopped pecans
2  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Cream margarine; add sugar.  Beat until fluffy.  Beat in eggs, one at a time, and add vanilla.  Fold in sour cream.  Combine flour, baking powder, soda, nutmeg and salt.  Gradually blend into creamed mixture.  Fold in cranberries and nuts.  Fill paper-lined muffin cups half full.  Combine sugar and nutmeg.  Sprinkle small amount on each muffin.  Bake in 400° oven for 20 to 25 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.  Yields 2 dozen.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
3  whole eggs
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
1  c. buttermilk
3  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. lemon juice (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients.   Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake for 45 minutes in 350° oven.

name: SCALLOPED CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  large chicken, cook, remove from bones and cut into small pieces
1/2  c. onion
1/2  c. celery
2  cans mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
2  beaten eggs
1/2  Tbsp. sage
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
2  c. chicken broth
1  loaf bread, cubed
preparation: Cook onion and celery until tender.  Mix in remaining ingredients.  Bake in a casserole dish at 350°.

name: MIRACLE LASAGNE
ingredients:
1 (28 oz.)  jar traditional Prego sauce
1  lb. ground beef (optional)
6  dry lasagne noodles
1  (15 oz.) container Ricotta cheese
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Spray 11 x 7-inch dish with cooking spray.  If using ground beef, brown, drain and mix with sauce.  In baking dish spread 1 cup sauce (if using ground beef use a little more sauce mixture).  Top with 3 dry noodles, half of the Ricotta cheese, half of the Mozzarella and half of the Parmesan.  Top that with 1 cup sauce. Repeat with noodles and cheese.  Top with remaining sauce.  Slowly pour 1/4 cup (or less) water around inside edge of dish.  Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour.  Let stand 5 minutes and serve.

name: CHEESE AND BROCCOLI POTATO TOPPER
ingredients:
1  can (10 3/4 oz.) Campbell's new Cheddar cheese soup
2  Tbsp. sour cream or yogurt
1/2  tsp. Dijon-style mustard
1  c. cooked broccoli flowerets
4  hot baked potatoes, split
preparation: Scrub medium baking potatoes.  Brush with salad oil.  Wrap each in piece of foil, overlapping ends.  Bake 45 to 60 minutes on grill or right on top of coals.  Turn occasionally.  Pinch to tell when done.  Cut crisscross with fork in top of package and push on ends to fluff.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
2  cans biscuits
1/2  c. sugar
1  stick butter
1  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. water
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
preparation: Quarter biscuits; roll in sugar and cinnamon mixed together. Put in a greased 9 x 12-inch pan.  Melt butter, brown sugar and water together.  Boil 2 minutes.  Pour over biscuits, now nuts if used. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: BUSTER BAR DESSERT
ingredients:
42  Oreo cookies
1/4  c. melted oleo
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
1/2  jar chocolate fudge topping
1  c. Spanish peanuts
1  container Cool Whip
1/2  jar caramel topping
preparation: Crush cookies and mix with melted oleo.  Spread evenly in 9 x 13-inch pan, reserving 1/2 cup crumbs.  Soften ice cream and spread over crumbs.  Place in freezer until firm.  Spread fudge topping on top of ice cream.  Sprinkle peanuts over topping.  Spread Cool Whip on top and sprinkle remaining cookie crumbs over Cool Whip.  Cover with foil and keep in freezer until serving time.  Makes 12 to 15 servings.

name: CARAMEL POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
4-1/2  c. brown sugar
3  sticks butter
1  can peanuts
1-1/2  c. Karo syrup
1  Tbsp. vanilla
3  bags microwave popcorn, popped
preparation: Combine sugar, syrup, and butter; bring to a boil.  Cook for three minutes.  Add vanilla, nuts and popcorn.  Shape into balls when slightly cooled.

name: PECAN CRACKERS
ingredients:
1  pkg. Club crackers
2  sticks butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Line cookie sheet with foil and spray with Pam cooking spray.  Place crackers on pan.  Combine sugar and butter in a saucepan; simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add pecans.  Pour mixture over crackers. Spread with brush for even coat.  Bake 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and cool.  Separate and place on platter.

name: BEEF AND CHEESE CRESCENT PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. ground beef
1/3  c. chopped onion or 4 tsp. minced onions
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
8  oz. can tomato sauce
8  oz. can mushrooms
1  can green beans, drained (French-style can be sued)
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (8 oz.)  can Pillsbury crescent rolls
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese
paprika
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  In large frypan, brown beef, onion and green pepper.  Drain fat. Stir in tomato sauce, mushrooms, beans, garlic salt and salt.  Simmer while preparing crust.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  cupful butter
2  cupfuls sugar
4  eggs
2  cupfuls flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. mace
preparation: Cream together butter and sugar until very light, then add egg yolks, beaten until thick and lemon-colored.  Beat again.  Mix and sift together the flour, salt, cream of tartar and soda.  Add to the first mixture along with the milk.  Beat well.  Add vanilla and mace, then fold in egg whites (which have been stiffly beaten).  Bake in greased and floured pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: POPPY SEED CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. deluxe yellow cake mix
1 large  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1/2  c. oil
4  eggs
2 large  Tbsp. cake flour
1  c. warm water
1  Tbsp. almond extract
1 large  Tbsp. poppy seed
preparation: Mix ingredients together in large mixer bowl.  Spray Bundt pan with Pam before filling with batter.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Do not overbake.

name: QUICK BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. self-rising flour
12  oz. flat beer
3  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix ingredients well.  Pour into a greased loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. yellow corn meal
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1/2  c. bacon drippings
1  large onion, chopped
4  jalapeno peppers, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  lb. ground beef (optional)
preparation: Mix corn meal, salt and soda.  Add milk and stir.  Then add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.  Pour in bacon drippings and beat.  Add remaining ingredients.  Stir and bake in an iron skillet for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: TOMATO SOUP
ingredients:
2  qt. water
4  chicken bouillon cubes
1/3  c. olive oil
3/4  c. chopped onions
1/2  stick margarine
1  tsp. sugar
4  cloves garlic, thinly sliced
1/4  ??? bacon bits
2/3  c. chopped carrots
1  c. white wine
4  Tbsp. tomato paste
3  Tbsp. flour
10  medium tomatoes (1 1/3 lb.), chopped
thyme
tarragon
salt and pepper
preparation: Boil water and bouillon cubes.  In another pan, heat oil.  Add onions, butter and sugar.  Cook until onions are transparent.  Add garlic, bacon bits and carrot.  Cook a few seconds.  Add wine, stirring until thick.  Add tomato paste, flour and tomatoes.  Place in 2 1/2-quart casserole.  Add water and bouillon mixture.  Mix well.  Season with tarragon and thyme to taste.  Cover and put it in oven at 450° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, stirring from time to time. Add water to maintain consistency.  Before serving, salt and pepper to taste.

name: CILANTRO PESTO-CURRY SHRIMP WITH GARLIC BEURRE BLANC
ingredients:
1  bunch cilantro
1  bunch Italian parsley
1/2  c. pine nuts
1/2  c. olive oil
salt and pepper
preparation: Combine dry ingredients and process in processor gradually adding olive oil.

name: DIET SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans mandarin oranges, drained
1  can crushed pineapple (No. 2), drained
2  cartons cottage cheese (small)
1 (4 1/2 oz.)  carton Cool Whip or 1/2 of 9 oz. size
1  pkg. orange jello (dry)
preparation: Mix fruit, cottage cheese and Cool Whip.  Mix well.  Sprinkle jello a little at a time.  Mix well, then refrigerate.

name: PISTACHIO PUDDING
ingredients:
1  pkg. pistachio pudding mix
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  (9 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Mix pudding and pineapple.  Add remaining ingredients.  Pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish.  Chill.

name: BLUEBERRY STACK CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick margarine, softened
3/4 to 1  c. chopped nuts (fine)
1  Tbsp. sugar
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  c. powdered sugar
1 large  carton Cool Whip
2  to 3 bananas
1 1/2  cans blueberry pie filling
preparation: Slice bananas on top.  Top with blueberry pie filling.  Chill and serve.

name: BROCCOLI AND CAULIFLOWER MELT
ingredients:
1  small to medium head broccoli
1  small to medium head cauliflower
1 (8 oz.)  carton cottage cheese (plain or with chives)
preparation: Steam broccoli and cauliflower until done (slightly firm). Drain and place in a single layer in a baking dish.  Top with cottage cheese.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until melted and bubbly.

name: GERMAN SKILLET BEANS
ingredients:
6  slices bacon
3/4  c. chopped onion
1 (31 oz.)  can pork and beans
1/4  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. firmly packed brown sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1 1/2  tsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Fry bacon until crisp; reserve 2 tablespoons drippings in pan. Crumble bacon; set aside.  Saute onion in drippings until tender. Add bacon and remaining ingredients.  Simmer 5 to 10 minutes or until thickened and heated through, stirring occasionally.

name: BLUEBERRY COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. butter
3/4  c. sugar
1  egg, lightly beaten
3/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. milk
1  c. blueberries
preparation: Sift together the flour, baking powder and salt.  Blend 3 tablespoons of butter and stir in sugar.  In measuring cup, lightly beat 1 egg with fork and add enough milk to measure 3/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons and beat this mixture into the flour mixture.  Stir in blueberries and transfer the batter to a buttered 8-inch square baking pan.  Spread the batter evenly.

name: HONEY ORANGE ROLLS
ingredients:
10  oz. refrigerated flaky biscuits
1  Tbsp. finely chopped nuts
1  Tbsp. grated orange peel
1  Tbsp. honey
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. orange juice
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine the mixture and mix well all the ingredients except the biscuits.  Separate  the biscuits and put in a Bundt pan. Layer the mixture and biscuits.  Be sure to grease the Bundt pan. Bake in oven at 400° for 16 to 22 minutes.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak
1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. chopped onions
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. water
1  can cream of mushroom soup
4  oz. sliced mushrooms, undrained
1  c. sour cream
meat tenderizer
preparation: Cut steak into bite size cubes.  Sprinkle with meat tenderizer.  Shake in plastic bag with flour.  Brown with onions in butter.   Add seasonings and water.  Cover and simmer about 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add soup and mushrooms, stir in mix.  Cook until meat is tender, about 30 minutes.  Heat mixture piping hot.  Turn off heat and stir in sour cream.  Serve over rice or wide noodles.

name: OLD MANSION HOLIDAY CAKE
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. sifted Swans Down cake flour
3 1/4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1 1/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening (lard or Crisco)
1  c. milk
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. almond extract
4 egg whites, beaten to meringue with 1/3  c. sugar
preparation: Have shortening at room temperature and stir just to soften. Sift in dry ingredients.    Add 3/4 cup milk and mix until all flour is dampened.  Beat 2 minutes with mixer at low speed, or 300 strokes by hand.  Add two flavorings and mix.  Add meringue and the remaining milk and beat 150 strokes by hand or 1 minute by mixer at a low speed.  Turn batter into 2 round 9-inch layer cake pans that are 1 1/2 inches deep and have had the bottoms lined with waxed paper and have been greased.  Bake 30 minutes or until done. Cool.  Frost.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1/4  c. flour
1/4  c. cornstarch
3/4  c. sugar
2 1/2  Tbsp. cocoa
pinch of salt
3  c. milk
3  egg yolks, beaten
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1  (9-inch) pie crust
preparation: Mix flour, cornstarch, sugar, cocoa and salt in saucepan.  Add milk and egg yolks.  Cook until thick.  Add butter and vanilla and stir until mixed good.  Pour in pie crust.  Top with meringue and brown.

name: ZERO DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. tomato juice
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. onion powder
1  tsp. brewer's yeast
1  tsp. dry parsley flakes
preparation: Mix all ingredients.

name: CHUTNEY-CREAM CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. chopped chutney
1/2  c. toasted almonds
2  tsp. curry powder
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Let cream cheese soften at room temperature.  Mix all ingredients and cream cheese until creamy.  Spoon into bowl and refrigerate for several hours.  Makes 2 cups spread.

name: MAMAW'S CHERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter
graham cracker crumbs
2  pkg. Dream Whip
1  c. milk
2  c. powdered sugar
2  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
cherry pie filling or favorite topping
preparation: Combine the butter and graham cracker crumbs.  This makes pie shell for cake pan.

name: MICROWAVE CARAMEL SAUCE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/3  c. milk or cream
2  Tbsp. light corn syrup
1  tsp. vanilla extract
dash of salt
preparation: In a 4-cup glass measure, blend butter, brown sugar, milk and corn syrup.  Cook 3 to 4 minutes, stirring every minute.  Add vanilla extract and salt; stir to blend.  Serve warm or cold. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

name: POTATO PANCAKES
ingredients:
2  c. raw grated potatoes
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
grated onion (as much or as little as you like)
preparation: Peel and grate potatoes into ice water.  Drain and dry in paper towels until you have 2 cups.  Beat eggs; mix in onion, flour, salt and pepper.  Combine with very dry potatoes.  Drop by large spoonfuls onto sizzling, hot griddle.  Brown to degree you like, then turn and brown other side.  Keep warm until all are fried.

name: AMARETTI ORESTANO(Italian Macaroons)
ingredients:
1/2  lb. almonds
1  c. sugar
2  egg whites
1/2  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Blanch almonds and place in warm oven 5 minutes to dry completely.  Chop almonds very fine until a powder.  Add sugar and mix well.  Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry and add to almonds and sugar.  Add almond extract and blend all together gently, but thoroughly.  Butter and flour a baking sheet and drop batter by spoonfuls.  Leave 1 inch between cookies.  Shape spoonfuls of batter into ovals.  Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.  Let stand 2 hours and bake at 375° for 5 minutes or until delicately brown in color.  Makes 14 cookies.

name: VENISON ROAST
ingredients:
1  (2 to 3 lb.) venison backstrap
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup
4  medium potatoes, cut into chunks
2  medium carrots, sliced
1  medium onion, sliced
1/4  tsp. salt
4  c. water (enough to cover roast)
preparation: Place all vegetables in bottom of crock-pot.  Add roast, then soup and salt and then water.  Cook overnight or all day in crock-pot on low.

name: TURKEY AND STUFFING BAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo
1 1/4  c. boiling water
3 1/2  c. seasoned bread crumbs
1  can Durkee French fried onions
1  can cream of celery soup
3/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. cubed cooked turkey
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, thawed
preparation: Combine oleo and water; stir until oleo melts.  Put over seasoned bread crumbs; toss lightly.  Stir in 1/2 can onions. Spoon stuffing mixture into a 9-inch shallow baking dish (1 1/2-quart).  Press stuffing across bottom and up sides of dish, forming a shell.  Combine soup, milk, turkey and peas; pour into stuffing shell.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 35 minutes.  Top with remaining onions and bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.

name: MOUNDS CAKE
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake mix (Butter Recipe)
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1 (15 oz.)  can creme of coconut (not frozen)
1  (8 oz.) whipped topping
1  pkg. frozen coconut
preparation: Blend milk with creme of coconut.  While cake is hot from the oven, poke holes with a toothpick over whole cake.  Slowly pour mixture over cake.  Let cool completely, then spread Cool Whip on cake top and sides.

name: REESE'S PIECES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine, softened
2  c. peanut butter
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  box powdered sugar
16  oz. semi-sweet chocolate
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients with hands.  Pat into shallow pan. Melt and pour chocolate over mixture.  Score while warm. Refrigerate at least 2 hours to set.  Set out for a while before eating.

name: APRICOT GLOW
ingredients:
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
1 (5 1/2 oz.)  can apricot nectar
1 (17 oz.)  can apricot halves, drained and chopped
1  c. cold water
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened (or use carton of soft cream cheese)
preparation: Sprinkle gelatin in cold water in 1-quart saucepan to soften. Heat over low heat, stirring constantly, until gelatin is dissolved.  Remove from heat and stir in apricot nectar.

name: DIET SANDWICHES
ingredients:
3  oz. salmon
6  oz. cottage cheese
1  tsp. horseradish
4  slices bread
preparation: Drain salmon.  Mix cottage cheese, salmon and horseradish. Pack on bread.

name: CHICKEN LIVERS & GRAVY
ingredients:
1  lb. chicken livers
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. butter
1  c. milk
1/4  tsp. pepper
Salt to taste
English muffins
preparation: Cook the livers by boiling.  While the livers are cooking, melt the butter in a frying pan.  Stir in the flour and slowly add the milk and seasonings.  When the livers are cooked, cut pieces in half and add to the cream sauce.  Cook on low heat for 5 to 10 minutes until well blended.  Serve over English muffins or toast points.

name: CHEESE WAFERS
ingredients:
2 to 2 1/2  lb. sharp cheese
3  sticks butter
1  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. Tabasco sauce
3  c. all-purpose flour
4  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Grate cheese.  Mix all ingredients, except the Rice Krispies. Next blend in Rice Krispies.   Use hands to roll into small balls and press onto greased baking sheet (press flat).  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until brown on the bottom.

name: HEARTY BEEF SOUP
ingredients:
1  pound ground beef
1  envelope Lipton onion soup mix
7  dashes tabasco sauce
4  cups water
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  bay leaf
1  - 1 1/2  pounds frozen vegetables (I use corn, green beans & cut carrots)
pepper to taste (the more the better!)
preparation: Brown ground beef in stockpot with a little oil or cooking spray.  Add soup mix and tabasco, stirring to evenly distribute. Add water, tomato sauce, bay leaf and vegetables. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover & simmer until vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.  Stir in pepper & serve piping hot!

name: DEEP DISH MEAT PIE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped potato
1  c. chopped onions
3  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. dried thyme, savory or sage, crushed
1 1/4  c. beef broth
1 1/2  c. loose-pack frozen peas and carrots
2  c. cubed, cooked beef, pork, lamb or veal
pastry for single-crust pie
preparation: Prepare pastry.  Roll pastry into a 12-inch circle.  Cover and set aside.  In a medium saucepan, cook potato and onion in margarine over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 5 to 6 minutes or until onion is tender, but not brown.  Stir in flour, herb and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.  Add broth all at once.  Stir in peas and carrots.  Cook and stir until bubbly.  Stir in meat.

name: COCA-COLA CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. butter
1  c. Coke
2  eggs
2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. mini marshmallows
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix flour and sugar.  Heat to a boil the butter, cocoa and Coke.  Pour over flour mixture, mixing thoroughly.  Add buttermilk, eggs, soda, vanilla and marshmallows.  Mix well. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Ice while hot.

name: SOUR CREAM DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. minced chives
3  Tbsp. minced onion
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Blend together all ingredients thoroughly.  Chill.  Makes 1 1/4 cups.

name: EGGPLANT FRITTERS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cooked and mashed eggplant
1  egg
1/4  c. milk
1  c. pancake mix
preparation: Combine all ingredients, mixing well, and drop by teaspoons into hot oil.  Brown and drain.

name: PIQUEY CHEESE
ingredients:
1  lb. sharp cheese, grated
1  small onion, finely chopped
sprinkle of Worcestershire sauce
1/3  c. mild catsup
1/3  c. hot catsup
2  tsp. celery seed
1  c. Miracle Whip
1  small green pepper, chopped
sprinkle of Tabasco sauce
3  tsp. Italian seasoning
preparation: Blend together until well mixed.  Great for crackers.  Also makes delicious sandwiches.

name: HOW TO BOIL WATER
ingredients:
1  appropriate size pan
1  qt. water
preparation: Fill pan with water; place on burner and leave until water bubbles; turn burner off.

name: HOLIDAY CREAM PIE
ingredients:
4  c. eggnog
1/4  c. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. butter, softened
baked pie shell
preparation: Blend eggnog and cornstarch in saucepan.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils.   Boil and stir for 1 minute.  Remove from heat, blend in butter. Immediately pour into baked pie shell.  Cover with plastic wrap and chill for at least 2 hours.  Serve with whipped cream and sprinkle with shaved chocolate.

name: FRENCH VEAL STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. veal (stew)
8  small white onions
5  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. flour
2 1/2  c. chicken broth
4  oz. mushroom caps
3  carrots, cut in 1 1/2-inch pieces
1/2  c. light cream
2  tsp. lemon juice
salt and pepper
1  bay leaf, crumbled
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. parsley
6  peppercorns
preparation: Heat 3 tablespoons butter and fry meat (do not brown).  Remove meat.  Fry onions 5 minutes.  Remove.  Melt remaining butter with meat juices.  Add flour and cook gently 3 minutes.  Stir constantly.  Add broth.  Bring to boil, stirring.  Simmer 20 minutes.  Add veal, carrots and onions.  Cook and cover on low heat for 45 minutes.  Add mushrooms and cook 15 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Stir in cream, lemon juice, salt and pepper.  Reheat without boiling.

name: FRUITED CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  cans canned chicken
1  c. diced celery
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 (8 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, drained
1/2  c. slivered almonds, toasted
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
2  Tbsp. orange juice
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
dash of marjoram
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Combine the first 5 ingredients.  Blend oil, orange juice, vinegar and seasonings; add to chicken mixture.  Chill 1 hour. Drain.  Add mayonnaise; mix well.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked, mashed sweet potatoes
1  c. white sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs, beaten
1/3  stick butter, melted
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients well and pour into greased baking dish.

name: BAKED HAM WITH GLAZE SAUCE
ingredients:
5  lb. boneless ham
whole cloves
1  can pineapple slices, drained (but save juice)
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. 7-Up
maraschino cherries
1/4  stick butter
2  c. diced onions
1/2  c. sliced green onions
2  c. sliced mushrooms
4  lb. sirloin tip roast, cut in 1-inch cubes
1/3  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. hearty Burgundy
3  c. beef stock
6  cloves minced garlic
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. ground cumin
4  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt and black pepper to taste
1/4  c. minced parsley
preparation: In a 5-quart cast-iron Dutch oven, melt the butter until it sizzles, but don't let it burn!  Then toss in the onions, green onions and mushrooms and quickly stir-fry them over high heat until the onions turn a rich caramel color (which should take about 10 minutes or so).  When they're done, remove the vegetables from the pot and set them aside in a baking pan.

name: MEXICAN TRASH BASKET SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  onion, chopped
1  can Rotel
1/2  can small chopped green chilies
2  cans pinto beans
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can lima beans
1  pkg. beefy onion soup mix
1  c. celery, chopped
1  or more large chop zucchini
1 or 2  pkg. pre-cooked link sausage, sliced
1  can black olives, drained
Monterey Jack cheese, cubed
preparation: Do not drain any of the vegetables. Place onion, Rotel tomatoes, green chilies, pinto beans, corn, lima beans, onion soup mix, and celery in large pot and simmer. Cook for 2 hours. During the last 30 minutes add zucchini, sausage, and olives. Serve over cubed Monterrey Jack cheese.

name: THOUSAND ISLAND DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. nonfat sour cream
1  c. chili sauce
1/4  c. sweet pickle relish, well drained
1  Tbsp. Crisco oil
1/2  c. sliced green onions
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  hard-cooked egg, finely chopped
preparation: Combine sour cream, chili sauce, pickle relish, oil, green onions, celery and hard-cooked egg.  Stir with fork to blend. Cover.  Refrigerate until ready to use.  Stir again just before serving.  Makes 3 cups, 1 tablespoon has 15 calories and 1 gram fat.

name: GERMAN POTATO SALAD(Microwave)
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. small red-skinned potatoes
3  slices bacon
1  medium-sized onion, chopped (1/2 c.)
1  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. celery seed
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. cider vinegar
preparation: Prick potatoes	all  over  with  a fork; cut in halves. Arrange cut side  down  in	a  circle  on paper towel in oven. Microwave on  High	7 to 9 minutes, rearranging potatoes once, until almost  tender.  Remove from oven; let stand directly on flat heatproof  surface 5 minutes, until tender.  Put bacon in 2-quart bowl.  Cover  with a paper towel and microwave on High 4 to 4  1/2  minutes,  until bacon is crisp, rotating bowl 1/4 turn once.  Drain  bacon  on  paper towel.  Add onion to bacon fat; cover with	waxed  paper and microwave on High 2 1/2 to 3 minutes, stirring  once,  until  onion  is	tender.  Stir  in remaining ingredients except potatoes.  Microwave uncovered 5 to 6  minutes, stirring  every  2  minutes,  until  thick and bubbly.  Cut potatoes  in  half again.  Add and stir to coat. Microwave on High  1  to  2  minutes, until potatoes are hot. Crumble bacon into  bowl.  Stir  to mix.	Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings; 99 calories per serving.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
2  c. Minute rice
1  green pepper
2  onions
1 (4 oz.)  can tomato paste
6  slices bacon
preparation: Chop green pepper and onions.  Cook bacon; drain drippings.  In skillet, saute pepper, onions and tomato paste.  Cook Minute rice; add to other ingredients.  Serves 4.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  stick butter or margarine
3  to 4 chopped green onions
1  pkg. diced, fresh mushrooms
cubed round steak
water
1  bouillon cube
cornstarch
4  oz. sour cream
cooked Kluski noodles
preparation: Melt butter or margarine in electric skillet.  Saute green onions and fresh mushrooms.  Remove onion and mushrooms.  Brown cubed round steak in the skillet used for onion and mushrooms. Cover with water and add 1 bouillon cube.  Simmer one hour on very low heat.  Remove meat, thicken remaining liquid with cornstarch.

name: EGG PASTRY
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. shortening
1  egg
1  tsp. vinegar
1/2  c. ice water
preparation: Sift flour and salt.  Cut in shortening until it looks like cornmeal.  Beat egg slightly.  Add vinegar and water.  Gradually add egg mix to dry ingredients.  Mix enough to hold dough together. Work on wax paper.  Keeps for a week in refrigerator.  Can be frozen indefinitely.  Makes 3 to 4 single shells.

name: QUICK CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless chicken breasts
1  small onion, sliced and separated into rings
1/2  bottle Italian salad dressing
preparation: Slice chicken breasts in small pieces.  Place in casserole dish.  Place onion rings on top of chicken.  Pour salad dressing over onions and chicken.  Cover.  Microwave on High for 20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN PINWHEELS
ingredients:
1  whole chicken
3  to 4 large carrots, sliced
1  stick celery, sliced
1  small diced onion
1  recipe Bisquick dough (from recipe on back of box)
preparation: Cook chicken with carrots, celery and onion.  Remove bones from chicken and mince the meat.  Mash with a fork the cooked carrots, celery and onion.  Save the chicken broth for gravy.

name: MEXICAN WEDDING CAKES
ingredients:
1  c. butter (do not use margarine)
1/2  c. powdered sugar
2  c. sifted plain flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Cream butter.  Add sugar gradually until smooth.  Add flour, salt, vanilla and pecans.  Blend until stiff.  Pinch off small pieces of dough and roll into balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Pat down balls.  Bake at 400° about 12 minutes or until very lightly browned.  Roll cookies in powdered sugar while warm. Yields about 4 dozen.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. squash, sliced (3 1/2 c.)
1  egg, beaten
1  medium onion, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. oleo, melted
1/2  c. bread crumbs or Pepperidge Farm mix
1  c. grated cheese
1 (8 oz.)  can sliced water chestnuts (optional)
preparation: Cook squash, onion and salt in water until well done; drain. Add egg and butter.  Add water chestnuts.  Put in greased casserole in layers; make layer of squash mixture, layer of bread crumbs or stuffing and layer of cheese.  Bake at 350° until hot throughout and bubbly.  Makes 4 servings.

name: CINNAMON LOGS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
3  tsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. almond extract
2  c. flour
confectioners sugar
preparation: Cream butter, sugar, cinnamon and almond extract in a mixing bowl.  Beat until light and fluffy.  Add flour; beat well.  Cover and chill until firm.  Shape into 1 1/2-inch logs.  Place on a greased baking sheet.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Cool.  Dip in confectioners sugar.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: BAKED BEANS BY PATRICK
ingredients:
1 large  can pork and beans
1 medium  can corned beef hash
1  c. barbecue sauce (your own sauce is better)
1  c. finely chopped onions, celery and bell pepper
1  Tbsp. minced garlic
10  slices bacon
preparation: Saute the cup of onions, celery and pepper slightly, then add to pork and beans and corned beef hash; add garlic and barbecue sauce.  Place mixture in baking dish and stripe with bacon slices. Bake in 325° oven for approximately 1 hour or until bacon is cooked.  May cover with foil for first 30 minutes, then uncover so bacon may brown.

name: HOT DOGS
ingredients:
marshmallows
2  candy bars
preparation: Put it in a pan and mix it.

name: MONTEREY JACK BREAD
ingredients:
1  loaf French bread
1  stick margarine
seasoned salt or garlic salt
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. grated Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: Slice French bread.  Melt 1 stick of margarine and pour over bread.  Sprinkle lightly with seasoned salt.  Mix mayonnaise and Jack cheese.  Spread mixture over bread.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix, prepared as directed
1  (14 oz.) bag caramels
3/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped pecans
Cool Whip
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.  Pour half the cake batter into pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: CHEX MIX
ingredients:
7  c. assorted Chex cereals
1  c. mixed nuts
1  c. pretzels
3  Tbsp. margarine, melted
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. onion salt
2  tsp. lemon juice
4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine cereals, nuts and pretzels in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Set aside.  Stir together margarine, garlic salt, onion salt, lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce; gently stir mixture over cereal, nuts and pretzels until well coated.  Bake at 250° for about 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes.  Spread on paper towels to cool. Store in airtight container.  Yields 9 cups.

name: CAJUN STROGANOFF
ingredients:
2  onions, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1  stick margarine
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  lb. shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. chives, chopped
preparation: Saute onions in margarine until clear.  Add shrimp; cover and cook until shrimp are pink.  Add salt, pepper, garlic, mushrooms and soup.  Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.  Add sour cream just before serving.  Serve over rice or pasta.  Garnish with chives. Serves 4 to 6.

name: STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  pkg. fresh whole mushrooms
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1 small  bottle real bacon bits
dash of minced onions to taste
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. Jack cheese
preparation: Wash mushrooms and remove stems.  Mix mayonnaise, bacon bits and minced onion together.  Spoon into mushrooms, then sprinkle cheese mixture on top and bake at 425° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground round
1/2  lb. ground pork
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. bread crumbs
3/4  c. catsup
1/2  c. warm water
1  pkg. onion soup mix
2  strips bacon
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
preparation: Mix meat, eggs, bread crumbs, catsup, water and soup.  Mix thoroughly.  Put into meat loaf pan.  Cover with the strips of bacon (if you like).  Pour the tomato sauce over all.  Bake 1 hour.

name: AMISH SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. butter or margarine
1  c. corn oil
2  eggs
4 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine the first 4 ingredients.  Add eggs; beat well.  Add remaining ingredients; mix well.  Chill in refrigerator overnight. Roll into balls; press down and sprinkle with sugar or cookies can be iced after baking.  Put on ungreased cookie sheets.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: BREAD STICKS
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  c. biscuit mix
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix and stir with fork until soft dough is formed.  Beat until stiff; turn out on board lightly dusted with flour.  Knead gently; roll to 12 x 8-inch rectangle.  Cut dough in half lengthwise, then cut each half crosswise into 16 strips.  Melt butter in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan in oven.  Dip each strip in the melted butter, turning to coat both sides.  Bake at 400° until golden brown, about 12 minutes.  Serve warm.  Makes 32 bread sticks.

name: STRAWBERRY PUNCH(Timmy's Favorite Punch)
ingredients:
1 large  can pineapple juice
2  pkg. strawberry Kool-Aid (unsweetened)
2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix ingredients in gallon jug. Fill the rest of gallon jug with water.  Shake well.

name: DISH PAN COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
2  c. white sugar
2  c. vegetable oil
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
4  c. flour
1 1/2  c. oatmeal
4  c. corn flakes
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. coconut
preparation: Cream well the first 5 ingredients.  Mix remaining ingredients. If dough is very stiff, add a small amount of milk.  Should be dry, but hold together.  Roll in small balls.  Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Makes 10 to 12 dozen.

name: FIG PRESERVE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  c. Wesson oil
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. salt
3  eggs
1  c. fig preserves
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
3/4  tsp. cloves
preparation: Sift flour, sugar, salt, soda and spices.  Gradually add oil and beat well.  Add figs, nuts and vanilla.  Pour into greased loaf pan and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.  Pour sauce over cake while still warm.

name: CLAM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can minced clams with juice
30  saltine crackers, crushed
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. milk
1/4  c. oleo, melted
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Mix all well and place in greased 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Bake  at  350°  for  about	45  minutes  or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  to 7 potatoes, sliced
1  onion, sliced
2  to 3 carrots (optional)
1 to 1 1/2  lb. ground meat
1  can cream mushroom soup
1  can vegetable beef soup
preparation: Place potatoes and carrots (if desired) in casserole dish. Crumble meat and add soups. Add onion. Cover and bake 1 1/4 hours.

name: TOLL HOUSE PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  c. oleo, melted and cooled to room temperature
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped walnuts
9-inch pie shell, unbaked
ice cream (optional)
strawberries (optional)
preparation: In large bowl, beat eggs until foamy.  Add flour and sugars; beat until well blended.  Blend in melted butter.  Stir in chips and nuts.  Pour into pie shell.

name: CARAMEL CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow butter Duncan Hines cake mix
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. Crisco
2/3  c. evaporated milk
pinch of salt
preparation: Bake layers according to directions on box.

name: NUTS AND BOLTS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Cheerios
1 1/2  c. bite size Rice Chex
1 1/2  c. shredded wheat squares
2  c. slim pretzels sticks
1  c. salted pecans or peanuts
3/4  c. margarine
4  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. onion salt
1  tsp. celery salt
preparation: Mix cereals, pretzel sticks and peanuts in a large roaster. Heat margarine to melt but not brown.  Add Worcestershire sauce and seasonings to margarine.  Pour over cereal combo; mix well. Toast in a 300 oven for about 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Stir every 10 minutes to get seasoned margarine evenly distributed through the mix.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. all-purpose flour, sifted
3  c. sugar
1  c. Crisco
1/2  c. Crisco oil
4  large eggs
1  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1/4  c. orange juice
preparation: Cream sugar, shortening and oil well.  Add 1/2 cup of flour to the cream mixture and mix well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each.  Add salt.  Add alternately flour and milk, beginning and ending with flour.  Add flavoring and orange juice last.  Put into large greased and floured tube pan.  Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes in 350° oven.  Yields 24 servings.  Freezes well.

name: SHAHI TUKRAY(Bread Pudding)
ingredients:
1  loaf sandwich style bread
4  cups shortening
4  cups whole milk
1/2  cup almonds
1  can condensed milk
2-1/4  cups sugar
1/2  tsp. saffron
15 cardamom pods or 3/4  tsp. seeds
preparation: Toast bread slices until golden brown.  Next, heat shortening on medium-high heat.  Place bread slices in oil one at a time until reddish brown (about 10 seconds each side).  After you fry the bread pieces, lay them down in a pan in a single layer or layer the slices.

name: PORK CHOPS AND CABBAGE
ingredients:
6  to 8 pork chops
1  head cabbage
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
4  cloves garlic, minced
1/4  c. olive oil
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. water
preparation: Broil pork chops. In saucepan, place quartered cabbage (remove center). Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer, stirring occasionally for 45 minutes. Turn in pork chops and cook for 15 minutes more.

name: HUMMINGBIRD CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1  c. pecans, chopped
2  c. bananas, chopped
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. oil
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl.  Add eggs and oil. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened.  Do not beat.  Stir in vanilla, pineapple, pecans and bananas.  Grease and flour three 9-inch pans.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: STUFFED GREEN PEPPERS
ingredients:
4  large green bell peppers
3/4  lb. ground beef
1/3  c. rice, cooked
1  tsp. salt
dash pepper
1  egg
1/3  c. onion, chopped
1- 10 3/4  oz. can tomato soup
1 1/2  c. water
preparation: Remove seeds and wash peppers. Mix beef, rice, salt, pepper, egg, onion and 1/2 c. soup. Stuff peppers lightly and place in shallow pan. Top each pepper with 1 tbsp. soup. Mix remaining soup and water, pour over peppers. Bake at 350° for about 35  to 45 minutes. Serves 4.

name: NUTTED WILD RICE(Serves 8 to 10)
ingredients:
1  c. golden raisins
1  c. wild rice
4 2/3  c. chicken broth
6  Tbsp. (3/4 stick) sweet butter
1  c. brown rice
1  c. slivered almonds
1/2  c. chopped parsley
salt and pepper to taste
2 small  cans mandarin oranges
preparation: Heat the raisins in 1/2 cup water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.  Set aside.

name: CHEWY SQUARES
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  c. peanut butter (creamy)
1  stick butter, melted
1  egg
1  c. chocolate bits
1  can sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Step 1:  Mix cake mix, 1 cup of peanut butter, 1 stick of butter and 1 egg.  Form into a dough.

name: STUFFED ROLLS
ingredients:
1  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
7  oz. can chopped pitted olives
4  hard-boiled eggs, finely chopped
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
3  Tbsp. oil
1  medium onion, finely chopped
preparation: Mix well and put inside small French rolls.  Wrap in aluminum foil.  Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.

name: LOW SUGAR IMPOSSIBLE PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. Bisquick
1  Tbsp. margarine
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated skim milk
2  eggs
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
2 1/2  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease pie plate.  Beat all ingredients 2 minutes, until smooth.  Pour into pie plate.  Bake 50 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.  Serve with whipped cream, if desired.

name: SUNRISE COOLER
ingredients:
1  scoop vanilla ice cream
1  bottle cranberry juice
preparation: Mix ingredients together and chill.

name: ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
large pkg. orange jello
1  can pineapple tidbits
1  carton cottage cheese
1  c. marshmallows
small Cool Whip
1/4  c. coconut
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Do not drain pineapple tidbits. Chill and serve.

name: CAPPUCCINO(Lo-cal)
ingredients:
3/4  c. 1% low-fat milk
3/4  c. hot brewed espresso or double-strength coffee (regular or decaffeinated)
ground cinnamon
preparation: In small saucepan over low heat, heat milk until tiny bubbles form around edge and mixture is hot (do not boil).  Carefully pour hot milk into blender or food processor, and blend at high speed until frothy.

name: CINNAMON APPLE TORTILLA CUPS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. sugar
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
4  to 6-inch medium tortillas
4  small apples, pared and grated
3/4  c. plain nonfat yogurt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  c. whipped topping
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a small cup combine 2 teaspoons of sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon.  Lightly spray tortillas on both sides with nonstick cooking spray.  Sprinkle both sides with cinnamon and sugar mixture.  Press each tortilla into a muffin or custard cup, forming a cup.  Bake tortilla cups 5 to 7 minutes just until edges begin to brown.   Cool completely on rack.  Press to open while tortillas are still warm, if necessary to maintain cup shape.  Squeeze excess moisture from grated apple.  Place in medium bowl.  Stir in yogurt, nutmeg, the remaining 2 teaspoons of sugar and remaining 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

name: APRICOT LEMON VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1  box lemon cake mix
1 (3 oz.)  box instant cheesecake pudding and pie filling
1/2  c. oil
4  eggs
1 (12 oz.)  can Sprite cola
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine all ingredients in large bowl and beat until well mixed. Pour into a 9x13x2 inch baking pan that has been greased and lightly floured on bottom only. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into center of cake.  Remove from oven and allow to cool completely before adding the icing.

name: BAMBINOS
ingredients:
1/4  c. tomato paste
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. oregano
18  round snack crackers
18  pepperoni slices
1/3  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix tomato paste, garlic salt and oregano in bowl with fork. Arrange crackers on ungreased cookie sheet.  Spread about 1 teaspoon tomato paste mixture on each cracker with spatula.  Top each cracker with 1 pepperoni slice.  Sprinkle the pepperoni with shredded cheese.  Place in oven at 350° until melted.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. mashed potatoes
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

name: CRAIG CLAIBORNE'S SAUTEED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
12  or more mushrooms, about 1/2 lb.
3  Tbsp. butter
salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
juice of 1/2 lemon
preparation: Trim off the stems from the mushroom caps.  Reserve both stems and caps.  Rinse the caps and stems in cold water and drain immediately.  Pat dry.  Heat the butter in a skillet large enough to hold the mushroom  pieces in one layer.  Add the mushroom pieces and cook, stirring and shaking the skillet, turning pieces so that they cook evenly.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Cook until nicely browned all over.  They will give up liquid.  Cook until this liquid evaporates.  Sprinkle with Worcestershire sauce, stirring and shaking the skillet.  Sprinkle with lemon juice. Toss quickly and serve hot.  Yields 2 to 4 servings.

name: TUNA MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
2  c. (7 oz.) elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
1  can (6 1/2 oz.) tuna, drained and flaked
1  c. sliced celery
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. sliced green onions
2  Tbsp. chopped pimiento
salt and pepper
lettuce
preparation: Mix  dressing,  macaroni,  tuna,  celery, green pepper, onions and  pimiento.  Season  to taste with salt and pepper. Refrigerate.  Serve  on  lettuce  lined  plates.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: CHINESE TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
14  oz. can Chinese vegetables, drained
9 1/4  oz. can tuna fish, drained and flaked
10 3/4  oz. can cream of mushroom soup
3/4  c. celery, thinly sliced
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  oz. can Chinese noodles
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix all ingredients except noodles in ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Sprinkle with noodles.   Bake, uncovered, until contents are bubbly and noodles are golden brown, about 40 to 45 minutes.  Serve with hot rolls and salad.

name: STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
3  green peppers
1  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
1  tsp. ketchup
1  c. hamburger meat, cooked (cold)
1 small  can whole corn
3  Tbsp. breadcrumbs
1  c. beef stock
preparation: Wash peppers. Remove stalk ends and seeds. Parboil gently in boiling salted water for 10 minutes. Drain. Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour and mix well; cook 1 minute. Add milk and stir until boiling. Combine this sauce with salt, pepper, ketchup, meat and well drained corn. Fill the peppers and sprinkle with breadcrumbs. Place into a greased ovenproof dish with stock or water. Bake in moderate oven until tender.

name: LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
3  egg yolks
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. butter
preparation: Stir and let cool for 10 minutes and add pure lemon juice or rind of lemon.  Stir and put in one 9-inch pie shell.

name: KENTUCKY CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. flour
3  eggs
2  c. whole kernel corn
1 3/4  c. milk
preparation: Blend butter, sugar, salt and flour with electric mixer.  Add eggs, beating well.  Stir in corn and milk.  Pour into buttered casserole dish and bake at 325°.  Stir halfway through cooking. When done, pudding will be a golden brown.  The mixture can be assembled ahead of time and kept refrigerated.  In this case, shake well before pouring into baking dish.

name: POTATOES AU GRATIN
ingredients:
3  qt. cubed potatoes
1  c. diced onion
5 to 6  Tbsp. oleo
4 to 5  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
cheese
preparation: Cook potatoes and onion until tender.  Make a medium to thick white sauce.  Melt oleo; add flour.  Blend.  Add milk, salt and pepper to taste.  Cook until thick.  Combine with drained, cooked potatoes and onions; stir, then place in large casserole.  Top generously (1/4-inch thick) with good melting cheese (such as Longhorn).  Bake in 375° oven until cheese melts and potatoes are bubbly.

name: GRACIOUS HOT SALSA
ingredients:
1  gal. tomatoes, fresh or stewed
6  large onions, diced
2 1/2  c. vinegar
2 1/4  c. sugar
6  bell peppers, diced
12  hot peppers or more
preparation: Combine all ingredients and cook on medium heat for 2 1/2 hours, stirring often, to keep from sticking.  (Cook longer if you want it thicker.)  Put in canning jars while hot.  Use sealing lids.

name: CROCK-POT SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
2  lb. round or Swiss steak (cut 3/4-inch thick)
salt and pepper to taste
1  large onion, sliced thin
1  can tomatoes
preparation: Cut round steak into serving pieces. Season with salt and pepper.  Coat with flour and brown in small amount of oil.  Place in crock-pot with sliced onion.  Pour tomatoes over all. Cover and set to high temperature for 1 hour, then to low for 8 to 10 hours.

name: CLASSIC BANANA CREAM PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
3  c. milk
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
4  bananas
1  (9-inch) pastry shell or crumb crust
preparation: In a large saucepan, mix together the sugar, flour, cornstarch and salt.  Gradually stir in milk.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil.  Simmer 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly until thickened.  Gradually stir hot mixture into eggs.  Return egg mixture to saucepan.  Cook over very low heat 2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Stir in vanilla.  Cool.  Peel and slice 2 bananas.  Place in pie shell. Cover with filling.  Chill several hours.  Just before serving, peel remaining 2 bananas, cut in slices and place on top of pie.

name: MINTS
ingredients:
1  lb. confectioners sugar
3  oz. cream cheese
food coloring
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  tsp. peppermint flavoring
preparation: Mix all ingredients together until smooth and creamy.  Roll into 1/2-inch balls.  Place on waxed paper.  Flatten with palm of your hands.  Let dry 10 to 15 minutes, then use tines of fork to flatten (making a crisscross pattern).  When tops feel dry, turn mints over to dry.  Store in airtight container between layers of waxed paper in refrigerator.

name: ASPARAGUS AND HAM
ingredients:
2  pkg. sliced ham
8  oz. cream cheese
1  can asparagus spears
preparation: Drain asparagus.  Spread ham with cream cheese.  Roll around asparagus.  Chill and slice in small pieces.

name: DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick
2/3  c. milk
stew
preparation: Mix 2 cups Bisquick baking mix and 2/3 cup milk until soft dough forms.  Drop by spoonfuls onto boiling stew.  Cook uncovered over low heat 10 minutes.  Cover and cook 10 minutes.  Makes 10 to 12 dumplings.

name: FRUIT SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
juice of 1 lemon
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg
preparation: Beat egg. Add lemon and sugar. Cook into thick sauce, like pudding. Cool and add Cool Whip.

name: LAYERED DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  sticks butter
nuts
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
Cool Whip
2  pkg. instant pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: Mix flour and butter; add nuts and press into bottom of cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Let cool.

name: MANDARIN ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
60  Ritz crackers, crushed fine
1  stick oleo, melted
1/4  c. sugar
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice, thawed
1  can Eagle Brand milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
2 small  cans mandarin oranges, drained
preparation: Mix the cracker crumbs, sugar and oleo.  Press most of this mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Reserve some crumbs for top.  Blend together the orange juice and Eagle Brand milk.  Stir in the Cool Whip and oranges.  Pour over the crumb crust.  Chill, or you may freeze, being sure to cover with foil or plastic wrap.

name: OMAHA POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hashbrowns
1  c. melted butter
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  pt. sour cream
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
2  c. crushed cornflakes mixed with 1/4 c. melted butter
preparation: Defrost potatoes.  Combine all ingredients except cornflakes. Put them on top.  Bake at 275° for 60 minutes, uncovered in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

name: BUCKHALL'S MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
40  lb. uncooked macaroni
24  lb. dehydrated onions, reconstituted
1  (20 lb.) bucket hard-boiled eggs
12  bunches celery
1 (No. 10)  can red bell peppers
2  gal. mayonnaise
2  gal. Ranch dressing
1/2  gal. mustard
1/2  c. black pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Keep refrigerated.  Serves large crowd.

name: EGGPLANT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant
4  slices toasted bread cubes
1  lb. sausage, cooked and drained
1  c. onion, finely chopped
1  can stewed tomatoes, drained
1/2  c. diced bell pepper
1  tsp. minced garlic
1  c. sharp shredded cheese
preparation: Peel and cube eggplant.  Cook in water until tender.  Drain. Mix in rest of ingredients.  Bake in greased casserole dish until cheese melts in a 350° oven.

name: ARMADILLO EGGS
ingredients:
3 to 4  c. biscuit mix or more
1  lb. sausage
8  oz. Cheddar cheese or more
8  oz. cream cheese
Progresso bread crumbs
jalapeno peppers (20 medium, more or less)
batter (egg and milk)
preparation: Mix biscuit mix, raw sausage and cheese to form batter.  Fill pepper with cream cheese.  Cover with biscuit, sausage and cheese mixture.  Dip in batter; roll in bread crumbs and bake for 20 minutes in 325° to 350° oven.  Cook and freeze.  Heat and eat.

name: BROWNIE CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. butter/margarine
2  sq. semi-sweet chocolate
2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
4  large eggs
preparation: Melt butter and chocolate.  Combine the rest of the ingredients and blend until smooth.  Fill small baking cups a little over half full and bake for 25 minutes at 325°.  Cool and dust with powdered sugar.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1 (28 oz.)  can Campbell's pork and beans
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
2 to 3  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. molasses
1/8  c. brown sugar
preparation: Combine in baking pan.  Top with 3 or 4 strips bacon.  Bake at 350° about 1 hour.

name: MICROWAVE CRANBERRY JELLY
ingredients:
4  c. cranberry juice
1  pkg. Sure-Jell
4  c. sugar
preparation: Combine juice and Sure-Jell in a 3-quart casserole.  Cook, covered, on High for 11 to 13 minutes or until mixture boils. Stir once during cooking.  Stir in sugar.  Cook, uncovered, on High for 10 to 12 minutes or until mixture boils hard for 1 minute.  Skim off foam.  Pour into jars.  Makes 6 cups.

name: BANANA NUT PIE
ingredients:
3  medium bananas
1  can pecan pieces
maraschino cherries (optional)
graham cracker shell
1  can Eagle Brand milk
Dream Whip topping
preparation: Boil milk (unopened) for 3 hours.  Pour half of cooked milk into pie shell.  Add layer of pecans, then sliced bananas.  Pour other half of milk over bananas.  Top with Dream Whip and decorate with cherries and pecans.

name: CINNAMON TWISTS
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. shortening
3  Tbsp. sugar
1/8  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  oz. yeast
3  c. flour
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1/3  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Bring sour cream to  a	boil;  remove  from  heat.  Add shortening, sugar, soda and  salt.	Cool  to  lukewarm.  Add 1 large unbeaten egg and  1  ounce  yeast.  Stir.  Mix in flour. Knead  well.   Let rise  10  minutes.  Roll  out  to  1/4-inch thickness  in  a  rectangular  shape  6  x	24-inches.  Spread one-half of dough  with  melted  butter.  Sprinkle	with brown sugar  and cinnamon.  Bring  dough	together.  Press  to  seal edges.  Cut into 1-inch strips.  Twist.  Place on cookie sheet 2 inches apart.  Let rise  about  1 1/4 hours at 85°.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350°.  Spread top with frosting.

name: OYSTER SUPREME
ingredients:
1  pt. small oysters
1  egg, beaten
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  stick melted butter
2  c. crushed crackers
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. celery seed
2 to 4  tsp. parsley
2  Tbsp. minced pimento
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients together.  Mix remaining ingredients together.  Layer the two mixtures starting with the cracker mixture and ending with it.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes. Butter the pan.

name: PIE CRUST
ingredients:
2 heaping  Tbsp. shortening
1  c. flour
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4 to 1/3  c. ice water
preparation: After mixing shortening, flour and salt, add ice water to make a ball. Poke holes in the bottom and sides after rolling the dough and place in a pie dish.  Bake at 375° until brown.

name: POTATO PUFF
ingredients:
2  lb. russet potatoes, peeled and cut in eighths
1/4  c. soft butter
2  large eggs
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
4  scallions, thinly sliced (about 1/2 c.)
paprika
preparation: In a 3-quart saucepan bring 2 cups water to boil; add potatoes; return to boil.  Cover and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.  Drain well.  Using food mill or ricer, force potatoes into the clean dry 3-quart saucepan.  Stir in butter until melted. In small bowl, beat together eggs, sour cream, milk, salt and pepper until blended.  Gradually stir into potatoes; add scallions.

name: CHEESY ONION ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream (8 oz.)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. finely shredded Cheddar cheese
3/4  c. sliced green onions
1  Tbsp. lime juice
1  Tbsp. minced seeded jalapeno pepper
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. flour tortillas (6 inches)
picante sauce
preparation: Combine first 6 ingredients in a bowl; mix well.  Spread on one side of tortillas and roll up tightly.  Wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  Slice into 1 inch pieces.  Serve with picante sauce. Makes 5 dozen.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen hash browns
1/2  c. oleo, melted
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  tsp. onion, minced
2  c. grated cheese
2  c. crushed corn flakes
1 1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. oleo, melted
preparation: In a bowl, mix together hash browns, 1/2 cup oleo, pepper, onion and soup.  Pour into well-greased baking dish.  Mix corn flakes and 1/4 cup oleo.  Pour on top of potato mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

name: MEAT LOAF PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/4  lb. mushrooms, chopped
1  onion, chopped (1 c.)
1  medium carrot, shredded (1/2 c.)
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/2  c. seasoned bread crumbs
2  eggs, lightly beaten
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a large bowl, gently mix ingredients.  Pat into 9-inch pie plate.  Bake in preheated oven for 35 minutes.  Let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.  Cut in wedges and serve.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
2  envelopes dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1  egg
1 3/4  c. buttermilk
4 heaping  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. soda
1/2  c. oil
5  c. self-rising flour
preparation: Dissolve the yeast in warm water.  In medium size bowl, break the egg and beat well.  Add buttermilk, sugar, soda and oil; add yeast and mix well.  Add this mixture to the flour and blend thoroughly.  If not stiff enough (like biscuit dough) add flour sparingly.  If too stiff, add small amount of buttermilk.  Let stand until double in size.  Refrigerate until ready to use.  When dough has risen, take 1/3 of dough and roll out in rectangular shape, about 6 to 8 inches wide, 12 inches long.  Pour melted oleo over dough and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.  Roll up narrow side.  Cut circular roll in 1-inch slices.  Place slices side by side in pie pans (makes 6 pans).  Let rise double in size; bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Ice while rolls are warm.

name: CHARLIE CHAPLIN CANDY
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) candy bar with almonds
20  large marshmallows, cut in half or use miniatures
2  sq. bitter chocolate or semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Cut marshmallows in half.  Melt chocolate in large glass mixing bowl in microwave for about 2 minutes.  When chocolate is melted, fold in marshmallows.  Mix.  Put on aluminum foil in refrigerator to cool.  Cut or break into pieces.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. macaroni, cooked, strained, drained and cooled
1  green pepper, diced
1  tomato, diced
1  cucumber, diced
1  small onion, diced
2  eggs, boiled and diced
2  Tbsp. sweet pickle relish
mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  You be the judge on mayonnaise. I sometimes add cut up cheese.

name: BAKED ROAST
ingredients:
1  roast
1 family size  can cream of mushroom soup
2  pkg. Lipton Onion soup mix
carrots, peeled and sliced
potatoes, peeled and sliced
1  onion
preparation: Place roast in 9 x 13 or larger pan. Pour dry soup mix over roast. Pour can of soup over dry mix. Pour 1 can of water around roast. Place onion in pan. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 2 hours. Remove and add vegetables. Cover and bake 1 more hour.

name: BOOTLEG BEANS
ingredients:
3  strips bacon
1  small onion, chopped
1  can pork and beans
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. ketchup
preparation: Fry bacon until half done, then add onion.  Brown.  Pour off most of grease.  Add pork and beans, brown sugar, vinegar and ketchup.  Simmer, covered, for 30 to 40 minutes at 325°.

name: JACOB'S POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
4  c. plain flour
1  lb. oleo
6  eggs
dash of salt
1  tsp. vanilla or almond flavoring
preparation: Beat sugar and butter and a little more milk and flour gradually. Add vanilla. Bake in cold oven at 300° for 1 hour and 45 minutes to 2 hours.

name: RANCH DIP
ingredients:
1 (24 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
preparation: Blend together.  Great dip for vegetables.

name: QUIK KASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1 1/3  cans whole kernel corn
1 1/3  cans sliced potatoes
2/3  can Manwich
1/3  c. chopped onions
1/3  c. chopped green peppers
Mrs. Dash seasoning
preparation: Drain the corn and potatoes.  Layer the corn, potatoes, peppers and onions in a baking dish.  Add 1/2 can Manwich. Sprinkle on Mrs. Dash to taste.  Crumble the hamburger over the top.  Spread the rest of the Manwich over the top.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHOCOLATE DIP FOR FRUIT
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  c. heavy cream
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Melt ingredients together in microwave or in small crock-pot. Serve warm with fresh bananas, apples, strawberries, pineapple, marshmallows and/or chocolate chip cookies.

name: MAYONNAISE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. plain flour
1  c. sugar
3 heaping  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° until done.  (Good with white or chocolate icing.)

name: CORN SALAD
ingredients:
3  cans whole kernel corn
3  or 4 green onions, include some tops
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. chopped celery
1 small  jar pimento
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. oil
1  c. vinegar
1/4  c. water
preparation: Boil last six ingredients together.  Pour over corn.  Put in refrigerator.  Very good with vegetables.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1  box instant pistachio pudding
1 (9 oz. size)  carton Cool Whip
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1 1/2  c. white or colored small marshmallows
1/2 to 3/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Sprinkle pudding over crushed pineapple.  Then add marshmallows, nuts and Cool Whip.  Mix and let set for a few hours.  Green coloring may be added to make salad more colorful.

name: MONSTER COOKIES
ingredients:
6  eggs
2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. brown sugar
2 1/2  c. peanut butter
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. Karo syrup
1  c. margarine
4  tsp. baking soda
9  c. oats (quick)
1  bag M&M's
preparation: Cream margarine, sugars, peanut butter and eggs.  Add vanilla, syrup and soda.  Gradually add oats and finally fold in M&M's. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 11 minutes. Makes 12 dozen.

name: TURKEY TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
6  oz. spaghetti
1  can celery soup
3/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
1 1/2  lb. sliced turkey (leftover)
1/3  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. chopped onion
salt and pepper to taste
1/3  c. plus 1 Tbsp. chopped pimento
1/3  c. plus 1 Tbsp. sliced black olives
preparation: Break spaghetti into 2-inch pieces.   Cook according to package directions. Rinse with hot water.  Combine soup and milk in a large bowl.  Mix well.  Add spaghetti, all but 2/3 cup cheese, turkey, mushrooms, onion, salt, pepper, pimento and black olives.  Toss gently.  Pour mixture into lightly greased baking pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Sprinkle remaining cheese on top.  Bake until cheese melts.

name: BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. sour milk
2  c. flour
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
2  mashed bananas
preparation: Mix all together and bake at 375° for 30 minutes.  Makes 9 x 13-inch or 2 (8-inch) cakes.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. butter, melted
1  c. light or dark corn syrup
1  c. pecan halves
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Beat eggs, sugar, salt, butter and corn syrup together with rotary beater.  Mix in pecan halves.  Pour into pastry-lined pie pan.  Bake 40 to 50 minutes until set.

name: STUFFED GREEN PEPPERS(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/3  c. finely chopped onion
2  cans (8 oz. each) tomato sauce, divided
1/4  c. water
3  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese, divided
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. instant rice
4  medium green peppers (about 1 lb.)
preparation: In medium glass bowl, crumble ground beef.  Stir in onions. Heat at High 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 minutes, or until beef loses pink color.  Stir once; drain.  Stir in 1 can tomato sauce, water, 1 tablespoon cheese, salt and pepper.  Heat, covered with plastic wrap, at High 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 minutes.  Stir in rice; let stand, covered, 5 minutes.  Cut peppers in half lengthwise; remove seeds and rinse.  Spoon beef and rice filling into each half; place in oblong baking dish.  Top with remaining sauce and cheese.  Cover with plastic wrap.  Heat at High 10 to 12 minutes, or until peppers are tender.  Let stand, covered, for 5 minutes before serving.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
3  cans biscuits
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  stick oleo
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. pecans
preparation: Put white sugar and cinnamon in a small plastic bag.  Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces and shake in bag until coated with sugar mixture.  Melt oleo; add brown sugar and pecans in a saucepan and bring to a boil.  Place 1/2 of biscuit pieces into a greased Bundt pan.  Pour 1/2 of the boiled mixture on top.  Then put the remaining biscuit pieces on top and pour the remaining boiled mixture on top.  Bake at 350°; do not overcook!

name: SUMMER SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. cucumbers
2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  lb. tomatoes
2  Tbsp. chopped mint
1  lb. zucchini
1/4  c. wine vinegar
3/4  c. red onion, chopped
1/4  c. chopped parsley
