preparation: Peel, seed and chop cucumbers.  Chop zucchini.  Mix salt and vinegar; toss with zucchini and cucumbers.  Let sit for 30 minutes.  Mix remaining ingredients and add.  Add vinegar, oil and salt and pepper to taste.

name: RUTH'S SQUASH CHEESE SOUFFLE
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1  c. bread crumbs
3  eggs, beaten
3/4  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
1  Tbsp. grated onion
4  or 5 medium yellow squash, sliced and cooked
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Heat milk and pour over bread crumbs. Add eggs, pepper, butter and onions, mixing well. Stir in squash and cheese. Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until firm. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: FRIED GREEN TOMATOES
ingredients:
firm, mature green tomatoes
flour
salt, pepper and parsley flakes
preparation: Cut firm, mature green tomatoes into 1/4-inch slices.  Coat each side with flour seasoned with salt, pepper and parsley flakes.  Place in skillet containing hot oil to which you have added 1 pat of butter.  Fry until coating is crisp, several minutes on each side.

name: BROILED FLANK STEAK A L'ORANGE
ingredients:
1/2  c. low calorie Italian dressing
Grated peel of 1/2 orange
3  Tbsp. freshly squeezed orange juice
1/4  tsp. dried dill weed
1-1/2  lbs. flank steak
1  sm. onion, thinly sliced
3/4  lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced
preparation: In a bowl, combine Italian dressing, orange peel, orange juice and dill weed.  Score the flank steak slightly on both sides.  Pour the dressing mixture over the steak and marinate at least two hours.  Reserve the marinade and place the steak on a broiler pan sprayed with a non-stick oil.  Broil the steak 4 inches from the heat for 5 minutes.  Turn and broil 4 minutes longer for rare, or longer for desired doneness.  Remove from the broiler to rest.  Simmer the reserved marinade and vegetables for 5 minutes.  Slice the steak diagonally and serve topped with the reserved marinade and the vegetables.

name: MOM'S EAT YOUR VEGGIES MINESTRONE SOUP
ingredients:
1  c. dry baby lima beans
1/4  lb. ground beef, cooked
1  medium chopped onion
1  clove fresh minced garlic
6  c. boiling water
2  cubes beef bouillon
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  large carrot, diced
2  c. turnips, cut in 1/2-inch
2  stalks celery, sliced
1 (19 oz.)  can tomatoes
small piece of bay leaf
1/4  tsp. dried leaf basil
2  c. finely shredded cabbage
1  c. torn up spinach, packed
preparation: Cook ground beef; add onion and cook for approximately 3 minutes, stirring.  Add water, bouillon cubes, salt, pepper and lima beans.  Bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer for about 1 hour (until lima beans are tender).  Then add carrots, turnips, celery, tomatoes, bay leaf and basil.  Simmer until veggies are tender (about 30 minutes).  Add cabbage and cook 5 minutes.  Add spinach and cook 5 more minutes.  Taste; season to taste, if needed. Serve hot.  Great anytime!!

name: Smoked Salmon Dip
ingredients:
6  oz. can salmon
6  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/4  c. milk
2  tsp. lemon juice
several drops liquid smoke to taste
assorted crackers or fresh vegetables
dill weed to taste
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Finely chop salmon.  Stir together with salmon, cream cheese, milk, lemon juice and pepper.  Add dill and serve.  Makes 1 1/2 cups.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. cooked or canned pumpkin
1/2  c. salad oil
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. each: nutmeg, salt and cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  c. water
1  c. raisins and 1/2 c. nuts (optional)
preparation: Combine sugars, pumpkin, oil and eggs.  Add flour and spices gradually to sugar mixture.  Stir in water and add raisins and nuts.  Pour into well-greased and floured loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 65 to 75 minutes.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
2  c. corn meal
1  tsp. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
3  Tbsp. onion
1  egg
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Add onion, egg and milk; mix well.  Drop by spoonful into deep fry; fry until golden brown.  Drain on paper towels.

name: CHEESE OLIVE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. sharp cheese, grated
1  c. flour
red pepper to taste
garlic to taste
Worcestershire sauce to taste
large jar medium sized stuffed olives
preparation: Grate cheese on coarse end of grater.  Let grated cheese soften at room temperature until consistency of butter.  Add flour and seasoning, working into a dough.  Press mixture around olives and bake on greased baking sheet for 10 minutes at 400°.  Serve hot.

name: GRANDMA'S GINGERSNAPS
ingredients:
3/4  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. molasses
1  egg
2  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt margarine in saucepan.  Let cool.  Add other ingredients and stir thoroughly.  Chill for several hours.  Roll into balls, then roll in sugar.  Do not press down! Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: CORN FLAKE SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. Karo syrup
1  c. peanut butter
7  c. corn flakes
preparation: Put sugar and syrup in large pan and bring to a boil.  Let it boil for 1 minute.  Turn off heat and stir in peanut butter, then mix in corn flakes and spread out on cookie sheet.  Cut into squares when cooled.  Put in a cup of raisins and/or chopped nuts, if desired.

name: CORNBREAD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1  pkg. cornbread mix with ingredients for mix
1  can cream corn
1/2  c. chopped onions
1/3  c. bell pepper
2  tsp. butter
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown ground meat and drain.  Set aside.  Mix up cornbread mix.  Pour 1/3 of cornbread mix into casserole dish.  Mix meat and other ingredients with 1/3 of remaining mix and add to casserole dish.  Cover with last 1/3 of mix.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

name: CINNAMON SPICED WALNUTS
ingredients:
2  c. walnuts
1  Tbsp. egg white
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Mix walnuts with egg white until well coated and sticky to the touch.  Mix together sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over walnuts, tossing until sugar mixture completely coats walnuts.  Spread on ungreased baking sheet for 20 minutes, stirring once.  Cool.  Store in tightly covered container.  Makes 2 cups.

name: QUICK OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. oatmeal
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. cocoa
1  stick butter
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, milk, butter, cocoa and vanilla in pan.  Bring to a boil for 1 minute.  Add oatmeal and coconut.  Using a tablespoon, drop mixture about an inch apart on wax paper.  Let stand until the cookies have hardened.

name: CABBAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
8  large cabbage leaves
1/2  lb. hamburger
1/2  c. rice
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1 1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. oil
1/2  c. cooked tomatoes
preparation: Mix together and roll in cabbage leaves.  Bake at 250° for 1 hour.

name: BUSTER BAR DESSERT
ingredients:
1  lb. Oreo cookies
1/2  c. melted margarine
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
1  bag peanuts
preparation: Crush cookies and add margarine.  Spread in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Soften ice cream.  Spoon over Oreo mixture and freeze.  Add peanuts over ice cream.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli spears
3 to 4  c. cooked chicken breasts, cut up
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  stick margarine
1  roll crackers
sliced almonds
preparation: Cook chicken in salted water with a few carrots, celery and onion.  Cool  chicken  and  cut  into  bite  size  pieces. Discard the rest.  Cook  broccoli  until  just  tender; drain. Line bottom of greased 2 quart baking dish with broccoli, then chicken.

name: PEACHES AND CREAM PIE
ingredients:
4  to 5 fresh or frozen sliced peaches
2/3  c. sugar or sugar substitute
4  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  pastry shell
1  c. cream
preparation: Place peaches in pastry shell.  Mix together the sugar, flour, salt and cinnamon.  Gradually add the cream.  Pour over peaches.  Bake at 400° for 35 to 45 minutes.  You may also use blackberries or strawberries for this recipe.

name: TURTLE PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) baked pie shell
12  caramels, unwrapped
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
2 (1 oz.)  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1/4  c. margarine or butter
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  In small heavy saucepan, slowly melt caramels with 1/3 cup sweetened condensed milk.  Spread evenly on bottom of pie shell.  In medium saucepan, slowly melt chocolate with margarine.  In large bowl, beat eggs with remaining condensed milk, water, vanilla and salt.  Add chocolate mixture; mix well. Pour into pastry shell.  Top with chopped pecans.  Bake 35 minutes or until center is set.  Cool.  Chill.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: CRISPY CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  egg
2  Tbsp. milk
3/4  c. cornflake crumbs
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. Watkins chicken seasoning
1/2  tsp. Watkins paprika
1/2  tsp. Watkins garlic salt
3 to 3 1/2  lb. frying chicken, cut up
preparation: In small bowl, beat together the egg and milk; set aside. Combine cornflake crumbs and next four ingredients.  Dip chicken into egg mixture; roll in crumb mixture.

name: SICILIAN POTATO BAKE
ingredients:
1 (24 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped hash browns with butter sauce
2  tomatoes, sliced
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. sliced Mozzarella cheese
1 1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
1  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. milk or cream
1  large onion, sliced
preparation: For a main dish add ham slices.

name: GREEN CHILI RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. rice, cooked with salt
1/4  c. butter
1  pt. sour cream
1/8  c. milk
1  lb. Monterey Jack cheese, grated
1 small  can green chiles
preparation: Mix rice and sour cream.  Remove seeds and veins from chiles and chop (chile peppers in small can).  In casserole put a layer of rice mixture, then a layer of chiles and next a layer of cheese. Alternate layers, ending up with cheese on top.  Bake at 350° approximately 30 minutes.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/2  lb. sausage
1  chopped onion
1 (4 oz.)  jar chopped green chili
2  cans refried beans
2  to 3 mild Cheddar or Jack cheese
1 (7 oz.)  bottle taco sauce
1  c. sour cream
1 1/2  c. guacamole (optional)
preparation: Brown meats and onions;  drain.  Layer ingredients in 9 x 13-inch pan in  the  following  order:  refried  beans, meat mix, chilies, cheese and taco  sauce.  Bake  at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.  When  hot, put sour cream and guacamole on top of it. Dip in chips.

name: GOOEY BUTTER CAKE
ingredients:
1  box pound cake mix
1/2  c. butter, melted
4  eggs
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  box 10x sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine cake mix, butter and 2 eggs; blend and beat 1 minute. Spread batter in greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Beat cream cheese until fluffy.  Beat in 2 eggs and vanilla.  Set aside 1/2 cup of 10x sugar.  Beat in remaining.  Pour over batter in pan.  Top with nuts.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.  Sprinkle with 10x sugar you set aside (after you bake).

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
10  c. water
5  c. sugar
1  large pineapple juice
1 large  can frozen orange juice
6  bananas
1 small  bottle lemon juice
preparation: Boil first 2 ingredients and cool.  This can be put in plastic bags.  Place in freezer for days or until you are ready to use.

name: RITZ CRACKER SALAD
ingredients:
60  Ritz crackers, crushed
1  stick margarine, melted
2  pkg. instant coconut cream pudding
1 3/4  c. milk
1  qt. butter pecan ice cream
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Pour melted margarine over crushed crackers; mix and set aside.  Mix pudding and milk together and beat for 2 minutes.  Add ice cream to pudding and blend.

name: DEVILED EGGS
ingredients:
6  hard-boiled eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  Tbsp. salad dressing (mayo)
2  slices bacon, crisply fried and crumbled
1/2  c. finely shredded American cheese
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
preparation: Cut eggs lengthwise in half.  Slip out yolks and mash with fork.  Mix in seasonings and salad dressing.  Fill whites with egg yolk mixture, heaping it up slightly.

name: CRAB CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. flour
2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1  egg yolk, beaten
2  Tbsp. sherry
1  c. bread crumbs
1  lb. crab
1  tsp. parsley
1  tsp. buttered crumbs
paprika
1/4  c. onion, chopped
preparation: Melt  butter,  add flour and blend.  Gradually add milk and seasonings.  Cook over low heat until thickened.  Pour hot mixture into egg  yolk  and  beat.	Cook  mixture  2  minutes, remove from heat.  Add sherry, bread crumbs, crab, parsley and onion; mix gently.  Pour  into  1 1/2-quart casserole and bake for 20 to 25 minutes in 350° oven.

name: SUPER QUICK CINNAMON TWISTS
ingredients:
1  can tube biscuits
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix cinnamon and sugar.  Roll each biscuit into a long rope. Roll in melted butter, then cinnamon-sugar.  Tie in a knot.  Bake according to package directions for biscuits.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIR CAKE
ingredients:
graham crackers
2 small (3 oz.)  boxes French vanilla pudding
3  c. milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan.  Line with whole graham crackers.  Mix pudding with milk and add Cool Whip.  Put 1/2 the pudding on top of the graham crackers.  Put another layer of graham crackers on top of the pudding.  Top those crackers with remaining pudding.  Top with third layer of graham crackers.

name: HERBED PARMESAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
3  lb. chicken breast, skinned and boned
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. dried thyme
1/4  c. freshly grated Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. minced fresh parsley
1/3  c. fine bread crumbs
1/4  tsp. paprika
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. Marsala wine
preparation: Cut chicken breast into pieces 1 1/2 to 2 inches wide.  Combine next 6 ingredients in a paper bag.  Coat chicken with mixture a few pieces at a time by shaking bag.  Place chicken in a baking dish and press any remaining seasoning into chicken.  Sprinkle chicken with oil and melted butter.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Pour wine over chicken and cover with foil.  Reduce heat to 325°.  Bake 15 minutes.  Remove foil.  Raise heat to 350° and bake 10 minutes.

name: BISCUITS (MAYONNAISE)
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  c. milk
preparation: Stir all ingredients well. Put into greased muffin tin.  Bake at 400°.  Brown as desired.

name: RANCH OYSTER CRACKERS
ingredients:
1 (1 oz.)  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
1/4  c. oil
12  oz. pkg. oyster crackers
preparation: Mix Hidden Valley with oil, pour over crackers, stirring well to coat evenly. Bake 15-20 minutes at 250°. Stir halfway through baking. Use for snacks, with soups or party appetizers.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  cartons frozen whipped topping
1  c. confectioners sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  graham cracker crusts
1/2  c. crushed nuts
preparation: Add sugar to softened cream cheese.  Stir in milk and peanut butter.  Fold in whipped topping and pour into shells.  Top with the other carton of whipped topping.  Sprinkle with crushed peanuts.

name: TOASTED PECAN PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
1 1/2  c. flaked coconut
1  c. flour
1  c. chopped pecans
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
2 (3.4 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
3  c. cold milk
1  (8 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
preparation: In a medium bowl, combine butter, coconut, flour, pecans and sugar. Spread into an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until lightly browned, stirring occasionally.  Cool.

name: BUTTERMILK BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1/3  c. shortening
2/3  c. buttermilk
preparation: Cut shortening into flour with fork.  Add milk.  Mix with big spoon.  Put on floured surface.  Sprinkle flour on top and press down to 3/4 inch thickness.  Cut out biscuits with medium size cutter or glass.  Cook in preheated 500° oven until golden brown.

name: CHOCOLATE OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. margarine
3  Tbsp. baking cocoa
1/2  c. milk
2 1/2  c. oats
2  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  c. coconut
preparation: Combine sugar, margarine, baking cocoa and milk in saucepan. Bring to a boil for 1 1/2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Stir in oats, vanilla, walnuts and coconut.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper-lined trays.  Cool until firm. Yield:  32 servings.

name: TRUFFLES
ingredients:
1  lb. chocolate
1/2  c. whipping cream
2  Tbsp. unsalted butter, melted
preparation: Melt chocolate over low heat.  Scald whipping cream and let cool until same temperature as melted chocolate.  Melt butter and let cool to same temperature.

name: BEEF ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1  c. chopped onion
16  oz. tomatoes, cut up
3/4  c. water
1  envelope American Beauty spaghetti sauce mix
1  tsp. salt
1  c. pkg. precooked rice
4  c. zucchini, cut in 1-inch strips
preparation: In  large  skillet,  cook  beef and onion until meat is browned  and  onion  tender.  Add  undrained  tomatoes, water, sauce mix  and  salt.  Bring  to  boiling;  stir  in  rice and zucchini.  Cover  tightly and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.  Stir occasionally.

name: JERICA'S FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
1  egg
2  slices bread
2  tsp. butter
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Beat egg, cinnamon and sugar in medium to small mixing bowl. Dip 1 slice of bread into bowl.  Put 1 teaspoon butter into heated pan along with 1 slice of bread.  Fry until lightly browned. Repeat the process for the second slice.  Serves 2 people.

name: ICE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1  qt. ice cream
1  graham cracker crust
1 1/2  c. fudge topping
1/4  c. pecans or almonds
preparation: Firmly press slightly softened ice cream into graham cracker crust.  Top ice cream with fudge topping and pecans or almonds. Freeze pies for 3 hours or until firm.

name: POT ROAST IN FOIL
ingredients:
4  lb. beef chuck pot roast
1  envelope dry onion soup mix (about 1 1/2 oz.)
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Place a 30 x 18-inch piece of heavy-duty aluminum foil in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Place meat on foil.  Sprinkle soup mix over top of meat and spread with cream of mushroom soup.  Fold foil over meat and seal securely.  Cook in a 300° oven for 4 hours.

name: EASY PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  medium zucchini, sliced
8  oz. fresh mushrooms, sliced
1  can pitted olives, sliced
1  large carrot, cut in 1/2-inch slices
1/2  chopped red sweet pepper
1/2  bottle chopped artichoke hearts
1 small  bunch green onions, chopped
1/2  c. or more shrimp or crab
heavy sprinkle of Parmesan cheese
10  oz. rainbow rotini
1  bottle Italian dressing
chopped fresh basil
preparation: Cook rotini until tender.  Add carrots last minute or so of cooking.  Cool; toss rest of ingredients in and pour dressing over.  Toss again.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Let chill for at least 1 hour before serving.  Add chopped basil as garnish.

name: CHICKEN ADOBO
ingredients:
1  lb. regular sliced chicken breast
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. vinegar
4 pieces chopped  clove garlic
1  tsp. black pepper balls
laurel leaves (optional)
2  medium size potatoes, cut in 4 slices
1/4  sliced fresh red pepper (medium cut)
1  spoon sugar
preparation: Precook chicken in 4 cups of water with 1 spoon of salt for 20 minutes or until the meat is tender.  Mix vinegar, soy sauce, garlic and pepper balls.  Add on meat and bring to boil on medium fire for 15 minutes.  Occasionally stir and make sure liquid won't dry up.  In case, add additional water.  When the natural juice of the meat comes out, add potatoes, red pepper and laurel.  Cook on low fire for 10 minutes.  Sprinkle 1 spoon of sugar before serving.

name: DATE NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. dates, cut up
2  c. boiling water
2  tsp. baking soda
2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. butter
3  eggs, well beaten
4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Pour boiling water and baking soda over dates; cool.  Cream butter, sugar and eggs and add to date mixture.  Sift and measure dry ingredients.  Mix with other ingredients.  Add vanilla and stir in walnuts.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Makes 2 loaves.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
20  oz. Oreo cookies
2 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
3  c. milk
12  oz. Cool Whip
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
4  tsp. margarine, softened
1  c. 10x sugar
preparation: Crumble Oreos; set aside.  Fold together the remaining ingredients.  Layer as follows: pudding, Oreos, pudding, Oreos, etc., for a total of 4 or 5 layers.  End with one inch of Oreos on top.  (These may be ground fine in a blender so as to resemble dirt.)  Optional: Add gummy worms to layers.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1/4  c. onion
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  egg, beaten
3/4  c. oatmeal
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. tomato juice
preparation: Mix together ingredients. Pour into ungreased loaf pan. Top with ketchup if desired. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
1  can apples
1  c. water
1/2  c. flour
6  Tbsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Fill in low casserole with apples, water and cinnamon (can use juice from canned apples instead of water; add with juices to make 1 cup).  Blend rest of ingredients until crumbly with fork. Spread this mixture on top of apples and bake, uncovered, for 1 hour in a 400° oven.

name: SWEET POTATO CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cooking oil
2  c. sugar
4  eggs, separated
4  Tbsp. hot water
2 1/2  c. flour (plain)
3  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  c. grated raw sweet potato
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine  oil  and  sugar, beat until smooth.  Add one of the egg  yolks.  Beat  well.  Add hot water.  Add flour, baking powder,  salt,  cinnamon and nutmeg (sifted together).  Stir in potatoes, nuts and vanilla.  Beat egg whites until stiff.  Fold into mixture.  Bake  in 3 greased 8-inch layer pans at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cool.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. yellow crookneck squash, sliced
3  Tbsp. carrots, finely grated
3  Tbsp. onion, finely chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. stuffing mix
1  stick margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Cook squash, carrot and onion in small amount of salted water until tender.  Drain and mash.  Add sour cream and soup and mix well.  Melt margarine; combine with dressing mix.  Place a layer of dressing mix in bottom of baking dish.  Add squash mixture; top with remaining dressing mix.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: INDIVIDUAL PIZZA PIES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
2  Tbsp. chopped onions
1  c. barbecue sauce
1 1/2  tsp. oregano
2 (10 count)  cans biscuits
Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and onions and then add the barbecue sauce and the oregano and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes.  Roll the ready-to-bake biscuits into 3-inch circles.  Grease cookie sheet and place biscuits on it and spread with meat mixture.  Bake for 10 minutes at 450°.  Top with Mozzarella cheese and place into oven again until cheese has melted.

name: PURPLE LADY
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. raspberry Jell-O
1  can blueberry pie filling
1  can crushed pineapple (same size as pie filling)
3  sliced bananas
8  oz. or 1 pt. whipping cream
preparation: Whip cream.  Then dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup of boiling water. Stir in blueberry pie filling and pineapple with juice.  Chill about 1/2 hour until it begins to thicken.  Add bananas and whipped cream by folding.

name: HOT SLAW
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage, grated
1/4  lb. bacon, cut into tiny pieces
1  medium onion, diced
1  c. white vinegar
1  c. sugar
salt and pepper
preparation: Grate cabbage.  Dice onion and mix with cabbage.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Fry bacon; drain and reserve bacon grease.  Add 1 cup of sugar and vinegar to bacon grease and heat to boiling. Taste to see if sweet enough.  Pour over cabbage while hot and mix.  Sprinkle with fried bacon.

name: CHERRY WINKS
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  c. flour or 2 1/4 c.
2  c. oats
2  c. coconut
1  c. nuts
2  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Mix altogether and drop by spoon.  Put 1/2 cherry on top or can use a pecan, too.  Bake at 325°.

name: DON'T LAST CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. Wesson oil
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple and juice
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
2  c. diced bananas
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In a large bowl, stir dry ingredients together.  In another bowl, mix remaining ingredients thoroughly with a spoon.  Combine both of the mixtures (do not beat).  Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 350° in a greased tube pan.  Remove from pan and allow to cool for 20 to 30 minutes before serving.

name: DREAMY APRICOT SALAD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz. each)  pkg. apricot gelatin
2/3  c. sugar
2/3  c. water
2  jars apricot baby food
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk, chilled
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine apricot gelatin, sugar and water in small saucepan and bring to a boil, stirring to dissolve sugar and gelatin.  Remove from heat and stir in apricots and undrained pineapple.  Set aside to cool.  Combine milk and cream cheese and beat until smooth. Stir in gelatin mixture and fold in nuts.  Pour into a large or two medium Pyrex dishes.  Chill overnight.  Top with Cool Whip or Dream Whip and additional chopped nuts.  Serves 20 to 24.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  can cream-style corn
8  oz. sour cream
2  eggs
1  box Jiffy corn muffin mix
1/2  c. oil
1/3  c. sugar
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix ingredients as listed.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: CALICO BEANS
ingredients:
1  can pork and beans
1  can red kidney beans, drained
1  can lima beans, drained
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. ketchup
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1 to 2  lb. cooked ground beef
1  lb. cooked, chopped bacon
1  onion, chopped
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker.  Cook 4 to 6 hours.

name: THOUSAND ISLAND DRESSING
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. grated onion
2/3  c. ketchup
1/2  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. salad dressing
1  c. vegetable oil
2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Combine all ingredients and blend.

name: MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1  c. molasses
2  tsp. soda
1  c. sugar
4 1/2  c. plain flour
4  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Sift soda and flour together.  Add dry ingredients and milk to creamed mixture.  Make dough.  Roll out and cut, the thinner the better.  Bake at 325° on a greased pan until brown.

name: JOANNE'S RED PUNCH
ingredients:
1  qt. cranapple juice
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
2  c. water
3  Tbsp. powdered orange Tang
3  c. ginger ale
preparation: Mix everything but the ginger ale and let chill.  Just before serving, add ginger ale and mix.

name: CHICKEN PIE
ingredients:
1  cooked chicken, deboned
1  can celery soup
1 1/2  c. chicken broth
1  stick margarine, cut in small pieces
1 1/2  c. Bisquick
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Place chicken in a Pyrex dish.  Mix together celery soup, chicken broth and margarine.  Pour over chicken.

name: SWEET PARTY MIX
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. butter
3  c. Crispix cereal
3  c. Rice or Corn Chex
1  c. pecans
Pam spray
preparation: Melt butter and brown sugar in saucepan.  Add pecans and stir. Add cereal and stir.  Place in baking dish sprayed with Pam and bake at 325° for 7 minutes.  Stir and bake another 7 minutes. Cool completely and store in airtight container.

name: COOL RISE - RAPID MIX ROLLS
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3 1/2  c. flour
1 cake or  pkg. dry
2/3  c. hot tap water
5  Tbsp. soft margarine
1/2  c. dry yeast
1/5  tsp. salt
1  egg (room temperature)
preparation: With a mixer, mix 1 cup flour, sugar, salt and yeast.  Add margarine and hot water and mix for 2 minutes at medium speed. Add egg and 1/2 cup flour.  Beat at high speed for 2 minutes. Using spoon, add enough flour to make a soft dough.  Knead until smooth.   Cover for 20 minutes.  Shape into rolls or place in loaf pan.  Let stand for 10 minutes.   Bake at 375° for 30 minutes. Dough may be refrigerated for up to 48 hours.

name: WHITE STAR COOKIES
ingredients:
8  oz. white stars
2 1/2  Tbsp. peanut butter
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. salted peanuts
1 1/2  c. rice crispies
preparation: Melt stars and peanut butter.  Mix all ingredients together and drop on wax paper.

name: SPECKLED COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1 1/4  c. water
2  whole eggs
1/3  c. oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease and lightly flour three 9-inch cake pans.  Combine all ingredients and beat until smooth. Spoon into prepared pans and bake for 25 to 28 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean. Remove from pans immediately and cool on rack.

name: GERMAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1  c. diced onion
1  can drained peas
1  c. finely chopped cauliflower
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. salad dressing
1  c. Parmesan cheese
6  tsp. cooked, crumbled bacon or croutons
preparation: Shred	lettuce;   add	 remaining  ingredients.  Chill several hours.

name: OPOSSUM
ingredients:
1  opossum
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. red pepper
1  small onion
2  cloves garlic
preparation: Clean opossum.  Dice garlic and onion.  Parboil until tender. Season with salt, pepper and red pepper.  Sprinkle garlic and onion over top and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.   Meat is greasy; eat only small amounts.

name: YANTACAW BROCCOLI PUFFS
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1  c. Bisquick
1  c. milk
2  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Butter a 5 1/2-cup souffle dish or 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Cook broccoli as directed on package and drain.  Beat baking mix, milk, eggs and salt with hand beater until smooth.  Stir in broccoli and cheese and pour into souffle dish.  Bake until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean (about 1 hour).  Serve immediately.  Serves 6.

name: SAUSAGE GRAVY
ingredients:
1  lb. sage flavored bulk pork sausage
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
6  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  qt. milk
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of Worcestershire sauce
dash of hot pepper sauce
preparation: Crumble sausage into a large saucepan; cook over medium-low heat.  Add onion.  Cook and stir until transparent.  Drain, discarding all but 2 tablespoons of drippings.  Stir in flour; cook over medium-low heat about 6 minutes or until mixture bubbles and turns golden.  Stir in milk.  Add seasonings; cook, stirring until thickened.  To serve, slice biscuits and spoon gravy over halves.  Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

name: CANNED APPLE PIE FILLING
ingredients:
10  c. water
5  c. sugar
1  c. cornstarch
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Peel and slice the apples. Pack into quart jars. Mix together the sugar, water, cornstarch, salt, cinnamon and lemon juice. Cook until just begins to slightly thicken. Pour over apples in jars. Cook in water bath for 20 minutes. Yield: 7 to 8 quarts.

name: BANANA BLUEBERRY BRAN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. mashed ripe banana
3/4  c. buttermilk
1/4  c. light brown sugar
1  large egg
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1 1/2  c. unsifted all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. blueberries
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place liners in 12 (1/2-cup) muffin cups or lightly grease.

name: STONE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. dry Great Northern Beans or 5 cans Great Northern beans (reduce water to 3 c.)
6  c. water
1  ham bone
1  lb. smoked sausage (cut into bite size pieces)
1  c. carrots (chopped)
1  c. celery (chopped)
1  bay leaf
1/4  c. cilantro
1/4  c. parsley
1  Tbsp. basil
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. red pepper flakes (optional)
1  stone (cleaned and washed)
preparation: For dry beans only:  rinse beans of any dirt or debris.  Add beans and bay leaf to a good-sized pot, fill with water about 3 inches over beans.  Boil for 2 minutes, remove from heat, cover, and let stand 2 hours.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
3 1/4  c. pumpkin
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1 large  can milk
4  eggs
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. ginger
pinch of salt
1/2  stick melted margarine
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Pour into 9-inch pie crust.  Makes two pies.  Bake at 450° for 10 minutes, then at 350° until done.

name: PUMPKIN YEAST BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
2  pkg. yeast
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. cloves
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cooked pumpkin
preparation: Combine 1 1/2 cups flour, yeast and spices.  In saucepan, heat milk, butter, brown sugar and salt until warm; stir constantly. Add to dry mixture.  Stir in pumpkin and beat well.  Add remaining flour.  Dough will be moderately stiff.  Turn onto floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic (5 to 8 minutes).  Shape into ball and place into lightly greased bowl, turning once.  Cover; set in warm place and let rise until double in size (about 1 hour). Punch down; shape into loaf.

name: GRAM'S MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. molasses
1  c. sugar
1  c. melted shortening
1  egg
2/3  c. boiling water
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cloves
4 level  tsp. soda
1 heaping  tsp. cream of tartar
flour
preparation: Combine molasses, sugar and shortening.  Add egg.  Add boiling water.  Add all spices, soda and cream of tartar.  Add just enough flour to make a stiff dough (4 to 5 cups), 1 cup at a time (or less).  Chill, covered, for 2 or 3 hours or overnight.

name: 7-UP CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  box vanilla instant pudding
3/4  c. Wesson oil
4  eggs
1 (10 oz.)  bottle 7-Up
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except 7-Up.  After well mixed, add 7-Up and beat well.  Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes, or until done.

name: CARAMEL PIE
ingredients:
2  cans Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1  graham cracker crust
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Boil Eagle Brand milk in cans in pot of water for 3 hours. Set out of water for about 15 minutes to cool.  Open cans of milk, put in bowl and cream with mixer.  Pour into graham cracker crust. Place in refrigerator to cool.  When cool, top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

name: BROCCOLI AND HAM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
2  c. cubed, cooked ham
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. buttermilk baking mix
3  c. milk
4  eggs
preparation: Cook broccoli only enough to thaw; drain well.  Arrange in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Layer ham and cheese over broccoli.  Beat baking mix with milk and eggs until smooth.   Slowly pour over cheese.  Bake, uncovered, 1 hour.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: TUNA CHOW MEIN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. cut-up celery
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. chopped green pepper
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can tuna
1/2 (5 1/2 oz. size)  can chow mein noodles
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. water
1/8  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. salted peanuts
preparation: Reserve 1/4 cup of the chow mein noodles.  Heat oven to 350°. onion and green pepper in butter until onion is tender.  Stir in tuna (with liquid) and remaining ingredients.

name: STRAWBERRY JELLO CREAM SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. strawberry jello
1  pkg. small marshmallows
1 large  can fruit cocktail
1/2  jar sliced maraschino cherries (optional)
1 small  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Make jello according to package directions.  (Don't use speed-set method).  Make jello in a large casserole dish.  When jello has slightly thickened, fold in rest of ingredients.  May either use the cherries in the mixture or sprinkle as a garnish on top.  Will have to chill for several hours before jello has set.

name: PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Betty Crocker's yellow cake mix (prepared according to directions on pkg.)
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple, undrained
1  cube butter
1  lb. light brown sugar
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. butter
5  eggs
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  Tbsp. flour
2  c. sugar
1  c. butter or regular margarine
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. sweet cooking chocolate, melted
3  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Cream together sugar and butter.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add vanilla and melted chocolate.  Blend in thoroughly.  Sift together flour, soda and salt.  Add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture.  Pour batter into lightly greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Bake in slow oven (300°) 1 1/2 hours.  When done, let stand 10 minutes in pan, then remove cake from pan to rack and cover loosely until cool.  Makes 16 servings.

name: CHEESY CHICKEN
ingredients:
10  boneless, skinless chicken breasts
2  cans cream of chicken soup
8  oz. sour cream
salt and pepper
shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix soups and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Bake 15 minutes at 350°.  Top with Cheddar cheese. Bake 30 more minutes at 350°. Serve with noodles or rice.

name: HAM SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1/4  c. Miracle Whip (may be low calorie)
2  Tbsp. regular mustard
1  stick (1/2 c.) oleo or butter
1 full  Tbsp. onion flakes
1  Tbsp. poppy seed
preparation: Melt oleo and add other ingredients, mixing well.  Chill to spreading consistency.  Split hamburg rolls and spread each side fairly generously with the sauce.  Top with baked, thinly sliced ham and thinly sliced Swiss cheese.  Wrap in foil.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: SWEET CRISP PICKLES
ingredients:
1  gal. whole dill pickles
5  lb. sugar
1 large  can pimentos, minced
garlic pods
hot pepper to taste
preparation: Drain juice from jar of dill pickles and drain pickles on paper towels.  Slice pickles (quartered) longwise.  Place layer of pickles, then layer of sugar alternating pimentos, garlic and hot pepper (if desired).  Keep alternating until you use up all pickles, sugar, garlic and pimentos.  Turn jar end to end occasionally (with lid on) until all sugar is dissolved.  Must use all sugar.  Shake jar occasionally to help dissolve.  Refrigerate to keep indefinitely.

name: EASY STEW CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  lb. stew meat, cut up
1  pkg. dehydrated onion soup
2  cans mushroom soup, undiluted
1/4  c. red wine
preparation: Mix all ingredients in oiled casserole.  Cover and bake at 325° for 3 hours.  Can add vegetables last hour.  Easy!

name: CUCUMBER BREAD SNACK
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  pkg. original Hidden Valley dressing
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  loaf small rye bread slices
preparation: Mix cheese, dressing and mayonnaise.  Spread on slices of rye bread.  Put a slice of cucumber on each and sprinkle with dill weed.

name: TANGY MUSTARD TOPPING
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1/4  tsp. instant minced onion
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine mayonnaise, onion and mustard.  Mix well and pour over cooked vegetables.  Sprinkle with cheese. Cook in microwave, uncovered, one minute to heat topping and melt cheese. Use as a topping on cooked vegetables such as cauliflower, broccoli or squash.  Yield: 1 cup.

name: CHICKEN A LA KING
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  c. green pepper strips
1/4  c. sliced green onions
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1/3  c. milk
1 1/2  c. cooked chicken, cubed
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento
2  Tbsp. dry sherry
4  baked patty shells, sliced English muffins or toast
preparation: In 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, melt butter.  Cook mushrooms, green pepper and onions until tender, stirring occasionally.  Stir in soup and milk.  Add chicken and pimento. Heat just to boiling, stirring occasionally.  Stir in sherry. Spoon chicken mixture into patty shells or over toasted muffins or toast.  Yields 4 cups.

name: FRESH GREEN PEAS WITH OR WITHOUT SNAPS
ingredients:
2  qt. shelled fresh peas
2  slices bacon
preparation: Fry 2 slices of bacon in a heavy, 4-quart pot.  Add the fresh peas.  Cook, covered, on medium heat, stirring often.  They will "steam fry" for about 20 minutes.  Stir frequently, do not let them burn.  Add salt (to taste) and enough water to cover the peas (or to make the amount of pea "juice" that you want).  When they begin to look cooked, turn the heat down more and cook until tender.

name: WEDDING COOKIES
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo
2  c. flour
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. chopped nuts
powdered sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix in a large bowl the oleo, flour and sugar. Mix well. Shape in small balls or half moon shapes. Bake for 10 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet. Roll in powdered sugar.

name: HAMBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
1  c. green beans
1  c. chopped onions
1  can (small) tomato sauce
1  egg
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
8  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
1  can crescent dinner rolls
preparation: Spread crescent rolls in 9 or 10-inch pie dish. Beat egg and add 1/4 cup cheese. Place in bottom of pie shell. Brown meat; drain. Add other ingredients; simmer 10 minutes and put in pie pan. Bake at 325° for 25 minutes. Put remainder of cheese on top and bake until cheese melts.

name: HOLIDAY DEVILED EGGS
ingredients:
12  boiled eggs
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. mustard (to moisten)
1/4  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Cut eggs in two.  Take out yolks.  Mix yolks, salt, pepper, mayonnaise and mustard.  Add cheese; mix well and stuff whites. Sprinkle with paprika to give that holiday look!

name: ORANGE PUDDING
ingredients:
oranges, peeled and sectioned (enough to cover bottom of a baking dish)
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 (5 oz.)  can evaporated milk (not skim) plus water to make 2 c.
2 to 3  slices white bread, broken up
2  egg yolks
egg whites (enough for meringue to cover dish)
2  Tbsp. sugar (per egg)
preparation: Soak bread in milk/water mixture. Beat egg yolks well. Blend sugar and cornstarch in top of double boiler and cook 15 minutes, stirring often. Add egg yolks and cook 5 more minutes, stirring. Let custard cook and pour over orange sections. Prepare meringue and place on pudding. Put in a 300° oven 12 to 15 minutes. Turn oven off and leave in oven another 15 minutes. Serve chilled.

name: TACOS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
4  oz. pkg. taco shells or 12 tortillas
2  c. shredded lettuce
taco sauce
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
8  oz. can tomato sauce
1  c. shredded American or Cheddar cheese
2  tomatoes, chopped
1/2  c. dairy sour cream
preparation: Heat oven to 250°.  In medium skillet, brown ground beef and onion; drain excess fat.  Stir in chili powder, salt, garlic powder and tomato sauce.  Simmer, covered, 10 minutes.  Heat taco shells in oven at 250° for 5 minutes.  Assemble tacos by layering meat, cheese, lettuce and tomatoes in each shell.  Serve with taco sauce; top with sour cream.  Makes 10 tacos.

name: NACHO DIP
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can refried beans
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. taco seasoning
4  oz. jar chopped green chilies
3/4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
3/4  c. salsa or taco sauce
preparation: *BLKLIN

name: ITALIAN DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. oil
3/4  c. vinegar
1 1/4  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
3/4  Tbsp. dry mustard
1/4  c. onion
1/2  tsp. celery seed
preparation: Mix salt, mustard, onion and half of vinegar.  Add other ingredients alternately.  Add celery seed last.  Chill.

name: CHERRY SWIM
ingredients:
1  gal. good ripe cherries
4  c. sugar
1 3/4  gal. any kind whiskey or bourbon
preparation: Pick good ripe cherries.  Clean and crush seeds and all.  Mix in this sugar.  Put into a large jar.  Add whiskey or bourbon. Seal and set aside.  Shake every day once for 4 weeks.  When cherries sink, it's ready to use or let set for a month.  Strain liquid into bottle.  Gets better with age.

name: RHUBARB CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. shortening
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk
1  egg
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
2  c. cut-up rhubarb
preparation: Mix all ingredients and fold in rhubarb.  Sprinkle brown sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon over top.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

name: WORKING GIRL SALAD
ingredients:
1  large tub Cool Whip
1  medium tub cottage cheese
1  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Mix Cool Whip and cottage cheese thoroughly.  Blend in Jell-O and pineapple.  Refrigerate.  Easy for a working girl to get together.

name: APPLESAUCE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. unsweetened applesauce
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. each:  soda, cinnamon and salt
2  tsp. baking cocoa
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. chopped nuts
6  oz. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix all together until well blended.  Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350°  for 25 minutes.  Additional nuts and chips may be sprinkled on top before baking.  When cool, cut in bars.

name: STRUFLERS
ingredients:
2  lb. flour
10  eggs
3 1/2  c. Crisco (good and hot)
6  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Fry in deep oil.  When finished, melt honey and pour over cookies.  Add colored beads.

name: PHEASANT
ingredients:
1  pheasant (can substitute broiler)
1 1/2  c. sweet white wine
1/2  c. orange marmalade
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  stick butter
1/2  c. almonds
1/2  c. currants
1/4  c. chopped pecans
1  can small button mushrooms
preparation: Wash pheasant well. Salt and pepper. Line Dutch oven with tin foil and place bird in center. In a bowl, mix wine, marmalade, cinnamon and nutmeg. Pour over bird. Cut butter in squares and put on and around bird. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Baste every 20 minutes. Tighten foil after each basting.

name: Cinnamon Bubble Bread
ingredients:
1 1/2  tsp. dry yeast
2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. bread flour
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. powdered skim milk
1  Tbsp. sweet butter
1  c. less 1 Tbsp. warm water
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Set aside and let rise.  Punch down.  Roll little balls in cinnamon and sugar mixture.  Place in loaf pan 3 deep.  Pour 2 tablespoons sweet butter or margarine over little dough balls.  Set aside and let rise until double in size.  Bake in 350° oven until done.  Top with glaze if desired.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. spaghetti, broken and cooked
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Wish-Bone Italian dressing
1/2  bottle Schilling McCormick Salad Supreme
4  stalks celery, diced
2  medium tomatoes, diced
1  cucumber, diced
1  diced small purple onion
1  green bell pepper
2 small  cans black olives, sliced
preparation: Mix cooked spaghetti, Wish-Bone dressing and McCormick Salad Supreme and refrigerate overnight.  Add remaining ingredients. The next day, mix well.  Refrigerate.

name: JEWEL SALAD
ingredients:
3  boxes grape Jell-O (3 oz.)
1  can blueberry pie filling
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  c. boiling water
nuts (optional)
1  container sour cream
1  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
preparation: Combine the first 5 ingredients. Place in a 9 x 13 dish and let jell. Mix the sour cream, cream cheese and sugar. Combine and spread on the jelled salad. Let set. Spread Cool Whip on top and sprinkle with nuts.

name: CHERRY SWISH
ingredients:
16  oz. (1 large tub) Cool Whip
8  oz. (1 large pkg.) cream cheese
1  lb. (1 box) powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  pie shells
21  oz. (1 can) pie filling, cherry
preparation: Mix together Cool Whip, cream cheese, powdered sugar and vanilla.  Pour 1/2 of mixture into each pie shell.  Pour 1/2 pie filling on top of each mixture and swish around until white shows through, making swirls.  Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

name: GOSH THAT'S GOOD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. diced celery
1  c. onion
1/2  c. Velveeta cheese
1  can tomato sauce
1  pkg. macaroni
1  lb. can tomatoes
salt and pepper
preparation: Brown beef; add celery and onion and brown slightly.  Add tomato sauce and cheese.  Cook on low heat about 20 minutes.  Cook macaroni in salted water; drain.  Add to meat mixture; add tomatoes.  Bake at 250° for 1 hour.  Add tomato juice if mixture dries a bit while baking.

name: NO BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
3  Tbsp. cocoa
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. oatmeal
preparation: Mix margarine, cocoa, sugar and milk in saucepan.  Cook over medium-high heat until boiling; boil for 1 minute.  Remove from heat.  Add peanut butter and vanilla.  Stir until melted.  Add oatmeal; stir.  Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.  Cool.

name: APRICOT SALAD
ingredients:
1  box apricot jello
2  c. hot water
1/3  c. sugar
2  c. marshmallows
1  can pineapple (large)
1/2  c. pineapple juice
1/2  c. sugar
1  box Cool Whip
1  egg
3  oz. cream cheese
preparation: Mix jello and 1/3 cup sugar in hot water, then add marshmallows.  Sit in refrigerator.  When it starts to sit, stir in the drained pineapple and 3 bananas.  Put in long, flat dish to jell.

name: TOMATO MARMALADE
ingredients:
2  doz. large tomatoes
vinegar (white)
sugar
1  lemon
1  sliced seedless orange
preparation: Pour boiling water on tomatoes.  To remove skins, cut up and cover with vinegar.  Let stand overnight, then pour off vinegar. Rinse 2 or 3 times.  Add to pulp an equal amount of sugar.  Add thinly sliced lemon, rind included.  Add 1 sliced orange.  Boil until thick like marmalade, 220° on thermometer at least 1 hour. Use spoon sheeting test.  Pour in hot jars and seal with wax.

name: WHIPPED STRAWBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 -9  oz. can crushed pineapple
1 -3  oz. pkg. strawberry gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1 1/2  c. Cool-Whip
2/3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving juice.  Add enough water to juice to make 1 cup of liquid.  Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Stir in juice and water.  Chill until thick and syrupy.  Whip gelatin until fluffy.  Fold in Cool-Whip, add pineapple and nuts.  Pour into lightly oiled 5 cup mold or 9 x 13 pan.  Chill until set.

name: DUFFIE'S DEER STEW
ingredients:
3  lb. deer stew meat, cut up into 1/4-inch cubes
little cooking oil
2  Tbsp. bacon drippings
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  large onion, sliced
2  bay leaves
salt and pepper to taste
1  Tbsp. paprika
1  tsp. sugar
6  carrots, sliced crosswise
4  medium size potatoes
preparation: We own a  permanent deer camp with log cabin consisting of sleeping quarters,	fireplace,  cooking  facilities  (both inside and outside of cabin).  Each year we invite 200 friends and neighbors to our camp for a  cookout  the night before the deer season opens.  We have a  very  large  outdoor  charcoal grill with covered shed for barbecuing.  We  cook 80 pounds of boneless pork butts in an old  time	cast-iron wash pot heated by a LP gas burner.

name: ZESTY CARROTS
ingredients:
6  to 8 carrots, cut in lengthwise strips
1/4  c. liquid from cooked carrots
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. horseradish
25  to 30 Ritz crackers, crushed
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped
1/2  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Cook carrots.  Spread in a 1-quart casserole dish.  Mix remaining ingredients.  Pour over carrots. Top with cracker crumbs.  Dot with butter.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (2 lb.)  pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
1  c. chopped onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  c. sour cream
1  stick butter, melted
salt and pepper to taste
1  can Durkee onion rings
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Lightly grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.

name: CRAB DIP
ingredients:
2-6 oz. cans of crab meat
2-8 oz. packages of creamcheese
1  stick of oleo
1  Tbsp. minced onion
Tabasco to taste
preparation: Soften cream cheese and oleo. Mix with other ingredients. Chill. Serve with chips or crackers.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. flour
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  c. milk
3  Tbsp. butter
1  can whole kernel corn
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Stir flour and sugar together.  Add the eggs, milk, butter, corn, salt and pepper.  Stir ingredients thoroughly and cook in oven at 350° until done.

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. vanilla pudding (not instant)
1  pkg. tapioca pudding
1  pkg. jello (any kind)
3  c. boiling water
8  oz. whipped cream
1 large  can fruit, drained (or fresh fruit)
preparation: Add boiling water to puddings and jello and bring to a boil. Cook until thick.  Set aside to cool.  Add whipped cream and fruit.

name: CHEESE RING
ingredients:
1  lb. medium Cheddar cheese, grated
mayonnaise
1 (8 oz.)  jar strawberry preserves
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Soften grated cheese.  Mix cheese, onions and mayonnaise, 1 tablespoon at a time.  Add pecans.  Shape into a ring on a plate. Chill.  Pour preserves into center of the ring.  Serve both preserves and cheese together on a cracker.

name: BROCCOLI BAKE FROM LUBA
ingredients:
3 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1/2  c. mayonnaise (not salad dressing)
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of mushroom, chicken or celery soup
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. crushed Cheez-It crackers
preparation: Cook broccoli in boiling, salted water briefly to make it crisp and tender; drain well.  Combine remaining ingredients except for crackers.  Put into a 2-quart casserole dish; top with crackers.  Bake in a preheated 325° oven for approximately 45 minutes or until bubbly.

name: SOUR CREAM COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
dash of salt
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 1/2  Tbsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine first eight ingredients, adding sour cream alternately with dry.  Pour 1/2 mixture into a prepared Bundt pan.  Sprinkle combined brown sugar, cinnamon and nuts over cake filling.  Pour remaining filling over the brown sugar mixture.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: CRAYFISH ETOUFFEE
ingredients:
butter
green onions
green pepper
almost 1 Tbsp. paprika
1  lb. crawfish
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  can water
preparation: Saute the first 4 ingredients until veggies are soft, then add crawfish and saute a little.  Add soup and water.  Simmer awhile.

name: EGGNOG
ingredients:
1 (3 3/4 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
6  c. milk
2  egg yolks
2  stiffly beaten egg whites
nutmeg
preparation: Peel back one peel; slit down the center.  Fill cutout with chocolate chips and mini marshmallows or butter, cinnamon and brown sugar.  Place peel back.  Wrap in foil and warm.  Eat with a spoon.

name: ZUCCHINI CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  small onion, finely sliced
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1/2  c. yellow cornmeal
1 medium (No. 303)  can cream-style corn
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
3/4  c. cooked zucchini, thin sliced
3  slices bacon, cooked until crisp
1/4  tsp. Mexican style pepper seasoning
preparation: Saute onion in melted butter until golden brown.  Beat eggs thoroughly and stir in milk, cornmeal, cream-style corn and salt. Mix in sauteed onion, green pepper and cooked zucchini.  Turn into a greased 2-quart casserole.  Bake in a moderately slow 325° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Crumble crisp bacon over the top and sprinkle with Mexican pepper seasoning.  Serves 6.

name: EASY LEMON CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. milk
2  pkg. lemon cream instant pudding mix
1  (9-inch) graham cracker crust
preparation: Stir cream cheese until very soft.  Gradually blend in 1/2 cup milk until smooth and creamy.  Add remaining milk and the pudding mix.  Beat slowly with eggbeater for 1 minute.  (Do not overbeat.) Pour into cool graham cracker crust.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI RICE
ingredients:
1  bunch broccoli, steamed
4  c. cooked rice
3  c. cooked chicken
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. lemon juice
3  c. shredded cheese
1/2  c. bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Combine soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice in a saucepan.  Cook until blended.  Place rice in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Arrange chicken and broccoli on top.  Pour on soup mixture.   Sprinkle cheese on top.  Add bread crumbs and butter.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger, browned
1  can cream of chicken soup
Velveeta cheese
1  small bag Tater Tots
preparation: Mix hamburger and soup (do not add water to soup) and place in a 9 x 9-inch pan.  Cover with slices of Velveeta cheese.  Cover all with Tater Tots.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: DATE SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. (16) pitted dates, cut fine
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped fine
3  large eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Stir together flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.  Toss dates with mixture to separate them; add walnuts.  Beat eggs slightly.  Gradually beat in sugar until thickened and pale lemon color.  Add sour cream and beat to blend.  Gradually and gently beat in flour mixture until batter is smooth. Turn into a greased 9 x 9 x 1 3/4-inch cake pan.  Bake in preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: ORANGE MILK PUNCH
ingredients:
2  c water
2  c milk
1/2  c sugar
1  - 12 oz frozen orange juice
1  - 2 tsp vanilla
vanilla ice cream (optional)
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Shake or stir before serving.

name: ANGEL PIE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
3/4 to 1  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  tsp. almond extract
1/2  pt. heavy whipping cream
1  (9-inch) graham cracker crumb crust
preparation: With electric mixer, beat the cream cheese. Add powdered sugar, extracts and heavy cream.  Beat until smooth. Pour in pie shell and refrigerate until firm, about 8 to 10 hours. Garnish with strawberries.

name: SCOTCH SHORTBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
5/8  c. sugar (1/2 c. plus 2 Tbsp.)
preparation: Mix butter and sugar, stir in flour.  Mix thoroughly with hands.  Chill dough.  Roll out 1/3 to 1/2 inch thick.  Cut into fancy shapes.  Flute edges by pinching between fingers.  Place on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake at 300° about 20 minutes.  Do not let brown.  Yields about 2 dozen cookies.

name: SOUR CREAM SUBSTITUTE
ingredients:
1  c. low-fat cottage cheese
1  Tbsp. skim milk
2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix in blender until smooth and creamy.  Scrape sides occasionally.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. yeast
1  c. lukewarm water
1  c. Crisco
2  tsp. salt
1/2  stick margarine
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. boiling water
2  eggs, beaten
6  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup lukewarm water.  In large bowl, add 1 cup Crisco, sugar, salt and boiling water.  Dissolve, then add yeast mixture and beaten eggs.  Add flour, 1 cup at a time, mixing well.  Scrape sides of bowl and smooth top.  Let rise in a warm place until doubled in size.  Punch down and knead.  Pull off small pieces.  Dip in melted margarine and place in greased Bundt pan until about half full.  Let rise again.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. cooked sweet potatoes
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1/2  stick softened margarine
1  c. raisins
preparation: Blend ingredients and pour into greased baking dish.

name: MACARONI SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked macaroni
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  c. lime juice
1  c. oil
1/4  c. mustard
2  c. cooked ham, cubed
1  medium green pepper, chopped
1  Tbsp. onion salt
1  Tbsp. celery seed
preparation: Cook macaroni as directed; drain and set aside.  Mix milk, lime juice, oil, mustard, salt and celery seed.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Chill 3 hours.

name: RED CAKE WALDORF ASTORIA
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. red food coloring
2 heaping  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. buttermilk
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. vinegar
2  eggs
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Add eggs and beat.  Make a paste of food coloring and cocoa and add to creamed mixture.  Add buttermilk alternately with sifted flour and salt.  Add vanilla. Mix soda and vinegar, then add to mixture, blending only.  Bake around 30 minutes at 350° in 2 (8 or 9-inch) pans greased and floured.  Cool on rack.  Split layers in two to make 4 layers.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS IN LEMON CREAM SAUCE
ingredients:
6  chicken breast halves, boned and skinned
salt and pepper
1  cube butter (not margarine)
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. heavy cream (whipping cream)
2  tsp. cornstarch
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Lightly salt and pepper chicken breasts.  Melt butter in skillet and saute chicken for 5 to 8 minutes, turning once to cook on all sides.  Place chicken in ovenproof serving dish.  Add lemon juice to butter in skillet.  Stir cornstarch into cream and slowly add it into skillet mixture, stirring constantly, on low heat. Pour over chicken.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and broil until golden brown. Good with rice.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: "FAT 'N UP" DOG FOOD(Recipe Given To Us By Fred Fulton of Ful-Ton Bulldogs)
ingredients:
5  lb. hamburger meat
5  lb. puppy chow
1 large  box Total cereal
16  oz. jar wheat germ
20  envelopes Knox gelatine
20  egg yolks
3  c. corn oil
2  c. Black Burn cane syrup
2  c. oatmeal
1 to 2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all together.  Make into hamburger patties.  Freeze.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. salad oil
2 1/2  c. sugar
2  c. grated raw zucchini
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
3  c. unsifted flour
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: In bowl, beat eggs until foamy; gradually beat in oil and sugar.  Add grated zucchini, cinnamon, salt, baking soda and baking powder, mixing well.  Gradually blend in flour, mixing well after each addition.  Fold in chopped walnuts.  Pour into greased Bundt pan (3-quart) and bake at 350° for one hour, or until cake tests done and starts to leave sides of pan.  Cool in pan for ten minutes.  Loosen edge.  Shake loose and turn cake out on rack to cool.  Store in covered tin or wrapped in foil.

name: BAKED FISH IN THE MICROWAVE
ingredients:
2  fish fillets
2  medium potatoes, thinly sliced
2  medium sliced tomatoes
3  Tbsp. oil
1  medium onion, thinly sliced
salt, pepper, garlic powder and oregano
preparation: In a square microwave pan, layer onions and potatoes (season each layer).  Lay fish on top, seasoned on both sides.  Put sliced tomatoes on fish and pour oil over all.  Cover with Saran Wrap and cook for 10 minutes on High in the microwave.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
3  c. sugar
2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. oil
1  c. pumpkin *
4  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. chopped nuts
2/3  c. water
preparation: Combine dry ingredients, including the nuts.  Mix well in bowl, add liquids that have been mixed together.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Makes 3 one-pound loaves or 6 small loaves (if baked in tin cans, 1 pound coffee cans, fill only 2/3 full).

name: FISH WITH TOMATO SAUCE
ingredients:
2  lb. fish (firm white)
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  clove garlic, minced
4  c. fresh tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Preheat oven to 450°.  Oil a baking dish large enough to hold the fish and place them in a single layer in the dish.   Brush the fish lightly with the olive oil and sprinkle with the garlic. Spoon the tomato sauce over the fish, then sprinkle with the chopped parsley and salt and pepper.   Cover the dish with foil and bake for 20 minutes or until the fish flakes easily.  Serve immediately.

name: CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1/2  c. chocolate chips
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  pie shell
preparation: Melt butter and chocolate chips.  Add sugar and beaten eggs. Add pecans.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Cook 1 hour at 300°.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2  Tbsp. Knox unflavored gelatine in 1/2 c. water
1  c. mayonnaise
3/4  c. chopped celery
3/4  c. chopped red onion
1  can shrimp, well drained
preparation: Bring undiluted soup to a boil; add cream cheese until smooth and melted.  Add gelatine.  Put into the refrigerator until chilled.  Add celery, onion, mayonnaise and shrimp.  Pour into a mold and chill.  Take out of refrigerator 15 minutes before unmolding.  Serve with crackers.

name: CHESS PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  stick butter
1 heaping  tsp. meal
1  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix ingredients well.  Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. freshly boiled potatoes
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
few drops lemon juice
1  Tbsp. finely minced parsley
3  Tbsp. olive oil
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Cut potatoes in 3/4-inch cubes.  Add seasonings, then olive oil, only what the potatoes will absorb, then add vinegar and mix carefully until it is absorbed.  Mound on a bed of lettuce in a shallow dish.

name: PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
2  lb. top round steak
2  large green peppers
2  onions, sliced
2  cloves garlic, minced
3  fresh tomatoes
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1/2  tsp. cumin, ground
salt and pepper
preparation: Cut round steak into long strips.  Cut green peppers into strips.  Cut tomatoes into quarters.  Lightly brown the meat in oil; add peppers, onion, garlic, tomatoes and cumin, then salt and pepper to taste.  Cover and cook for 20 minutes.  Serve with rice.

name: CHILI SAUCE FOR ONE
ingredients:
1 1/2  Tbsp. chopped green chilies
1  small tomato, chopped
2  oz. American process cheese, diced
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: Bring chilies and tomato to a boil in top of double boiler. Add cheese and salt.  Heat, stirring, until cheese is melted. Serve as dip or sauce over vegetables or macaroni.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. yellow squash
1  small yellow grated onion
1  1/2 medium chopped carrots
1 small  jar chopped pimiento
1  can cream of chicken soup
salt to taste
1  pt. sour cream
1/2  stick butter
3/4 (8 oz.)  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix or croutons (Italian seasoned)
preparation: Boil carrots, onions and squash until tender.  Put in blender or processor.  Add other ingredients.  Bake in casserole dish 45 minutes at 350°.

name: MEAT AND POTATO DISH
ingredients:
4  large potatoes
1  lb. ground meat
1  onion, chopped
2  cans of diced tomatoes (flavor of choice)
preparation: Brown meat and onions; drain.  Slice potatoes thin in a casserole dish.  Add meat mixture over potatoes; then add the tomatoes.  Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

name: COOKIES QUICK
ingredients:
1  box cake mix
1/2  c. oil
2  eggs
preparation: Any additional ingredients you wish such as chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, peanut butter chips, etc., depending on your choice of cake mix.  (Yellow cake mix is excellent for adding other flavors to.)

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  bag frozen broccoli
1  sleeve Ritz crackers
1  stick butter or margarine
9  oz. Velveeta cheese
milk
preparation: Chop cheese into pieces.  Crush crackers. Melt butter.  Add together all ingredients.  Cover with milk.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Stir casserole once while baking.

name: MOUNDS CAKE
ingredients:
30  big marshmallows
14  oz. coconut
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. milk
1  can cream of coconut
preparation: Make chocolate cake in long cake pan.  Cut into two layers with a string when cool.

name: FIVE FLAVOR POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
1/2  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
5  eggs, well beaten
3  c. sifted cake flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  tsp. coconut extract
1  tsp. rum extract
1  tsp. butter extract
1  tsp. lemon extract
1  tsp. vanilla extract or just use 1 tsp. mace and 1 tsp.  vanilla
preparation: Note:  If large eggs are used, only use 3/4 cup milk.

name: BILLIE'S HOMEMADE HOTDOG "CONEY" SAUCE
ingredients:
1  can tomato soup
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
2  bay leaves
1 1/2- 2  lb. ground chuck
2  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
1  small minced onion
1/2  tsp sugar
1  tsp. chili powder
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Place all ingredients into sauce pan together and simmer slowly.  To thicken, stir frequently.

name: YELLOW BEAN DRESSING
ingredients:
1/4  c. vinegar
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. granulated sugar
1  or 2 eggs (depending on size)
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
parsley, chopped (dry)
preparation: Dissolve dry ingredients.  Boil (medium heat) until thick, stirring all the time.  Pour over cooked beans and add parsley.

name: HAMBURGER STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/4  c. butter or margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (4 oz.)  can mushroom pieces, drained
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
preparation: In large skillet, cook and stir meat and onion in butter until meat is brown and onion is tender.  Stir in flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms.  Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Stir in soup and heat to boiling, stirring constantly.  Reduce heat, simmer uncovered, 10 minutes.  Stir in sour cream, heat through.  Serve over rice or poppy seed noodles.  Serves 4 or 5.

name: OLD FASHIONED GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. molasses
2/3  tsp. soda
2/3  tsp. cinnamon
2/3  c. butter
2 1/4  c. flour
1 2/3  tsp. ginger
2/3  c. sour milk
nuts or raisins (if desired)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 1 hour.

name: SCRIPTURE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Judges 5:25 (last clause)
1 1/2  Tbsp. Ezekiel 36:25
2  c. 1 Kings 4:22 (first clause)
1/2  tsp. Leviticus 2:13
1  tsp. Amos 4:5 (modern powder)
1  tsp. 2 Chronicles 9:9
1/2  c. Judges 4:19 (second part)
1  c. Samuel 30:12 (second item)
1  c. Nahum 3:12 (dried and chopped)
1  c. Numbers 17:8 (chopped)
4  of Isaiah 10:14 (separated and beaten)
preparation: Cream first 2 ingredients well; sift next 4 ingredients together and add alternately with next ingredient.  Follow Solomon's advice for making a good boy - Proverbs 23:14.  Add next 3 ingredients. Fold in beaten yolks and stiffly beaten whites. Bake in lined 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. A fun cake to make.

name: CHICKEN KIEV
ingredients:
2  boneless chicken breasts (whole)
1 1/2  sticks soft butter
2  tsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
1/2  tsp. tarragon
1  Tbsp. minced onion or shallots
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: After depositing lobster into boiling water, return water to boiling.  Cook 6 to 7 minutes per pound.  Make certain not to overcook so fat does not escape into the water.

name: MARSHMALLOW FUGUE BARS
ingredients:
1  cup margarine
4  eggs
1  1/2 cups all-purpose flour
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1  cup nutmeats, chopped
2  cups granulated sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. vanilla
3-4 cups miniature marshmallows
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar, Add eggs and vanilla.  Add shifted dry ingredients and nuts.  Spread on greased jelly roll pan.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350.  Remove-cover with small marshmallows. Return to oven until marshmallows are soft- about 5 minutes.  Cool and cut into 16 bars.

name: CHILI DIP
ingredients:
1  onion
1  stick butter
1 large  can Wolf Brand chili (without beans)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a large sauce pan, saut onion in butter.  Add chili and soup.  Transfer to a slow cooker to keep warm during serving. Just before you are ready to serve the dip, add cubes of sharp Cheddar cheese.  Stir just enough to mix in but not thoroughly melt.  This is great to dip with chips, use for Frito chili pie or serve on hot dogs.

name: UNMEXICAN HAYSTACK
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) pkgs. cream cheese, softened
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  bunches green onions
1  Tbsp. worchestershire sauce
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  lb. ham
12  to 15 large flour tortillas
1/2  c. pecans
preparation: With an electric mixer, blend the first 5 ingredients till smooth.  Chop ham and green onions very fine with a food chopper or food processor, then mix into the cream cheese mixture till blended well.  Place tortilla on plate, with a rubber spatula spread a thin layer of cream cheese/ham mixture on the tortilla. Keep layering tortillas and mix; end with the cream cheese on top, sprinkle with pecans.  Refrigerate a couple hours before serving. Best if prepared the night before-flavors blend together.  I cut into squares with party toothpicks inserted into each square.

name: HOME MADE BOURSIN CHEESE
ingredients:
1  8 oz pkg cream cheese
1 small  clove garlic crushed
2  tsp finely chopped parsley
1/2  tsp snipped chives
1  Tbsp dry vermouth
pinch of lemon pepper
pinch of pepper and salt
preparation: Blend all ingredients and chill for 24 hours before serving.

name: MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. dry bread crumbs
1  egg
1/2  can water
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1  can cream of celery soup
preparation: Mix all but soup and water.  Make into meat balls and brown in skillet.  Drain.  Stir soup in meat drippings until brown.  Add water.  Mix well.  Add meat balls.  Cover and simmer about 25 minutes.  Serve over rice.

name: SQUARE BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
3 heaping  tsp. baking powder
1 heaping  Tbsp. shortening
1  pt. lukewarm water
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients together.  Cut in shortening.  Add water (consistency of biscuit dough).  Roll out dough about 1/2-inch squares.  Cut hole in center.  Fry in deep fat.

name: IMPOSSIBLE PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. oleo, soft
1 large  can condensed milk
1 (6 oz.)  can pumpkin
2 1/2  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
1/2  c. Bisquick
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Blend all together in blender (mixer may be used) until smooth.  Pour into 9-inch greased pie pan.  Bake 50 to 55 minutes at 350° or until knife comes out clean.

name: GRETA'S CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  to 10 chicken breast halves
1  can chicken-mushroom soup
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  c. sherry wine (optional)
8  oz. sliced button mushrooms
ground peppercorns
paprika
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spray bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chicken breasts in pan and pepper. Top with sliced mushrooms.  Mix soup, sour cream and wine.  Pour evenly over chicken and mushrooms.   Sprinkle generously with paprika.  Bake about 45 minutes or until done. Serve over choice of rice.  Makes 6 to 10 servings.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  whole chicken, cooked
1  stick butter
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of onion soup
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Dice chicken.  Mix ingredients together.  Sprinkle Ritz crackers on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes (depending on how fast oven cooks).

name: MEAT BALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground sirloin
2  c. white bread crumbs
2  eggs, beaten
4  Tbsp. milk
4  Tbsp. onion, minced
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Mix together ingredients.  Roll into meat balls; place in baking pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.

name: SQUASH PUFFS
ingredients:
1  c. cooked squash
1/3  c. flour
1/3  c. cornmeal
1  egg, beaten
1  small grated onion
preparation: Mix ingredients and spoon into hot grease for cooking.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. mayonnaise
grated Parmesan cheese
grated Cheddar cheese
1  minced onion
1 (2 oz.)  jar pimentos
paprika
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts, sliced
2  (2 1/2 lb.) fryers, cooked and boned
1 (6 oz.)  box long grain wild rice
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of celery soup
2 (16 oz.)  cans French-style green beans, drained
preparation: Cook rice as directed on box.  Add all ingredients except paprika and cheese.  Mix thoroughly; pour into greased, shallow 3-quart baking dish.  Sprinkle cheese and paprika over mixture. Bake at 350° until bubbly or around 30 to 40 minutes.  It can be frozen; remove from freezer at least 4 hours before heating. Yields 12 servings.

name: STRAWBERRY PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. coarsely broken pretzels
1  stick melted butter
3  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix well.  Spread in a 9 x 13-inch dish.  Bake 8 minutes at 400°.  Let cool.

name: JALAPENO HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. white cornmeal
1/2  c. flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/3  c. chopped onion
1  c. milk
1  egg
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/4  c. finely chopped jalapeno peppers
preparation: Combine dry ingredients; add rest of ingredients and stir until blended.  Drop by spoon (whichever size you prefer) into hot deep fat (350°).  Fry each one at least 3 minutes or until brown.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
3 large  pkg. cream cheese
1 large  pkg. chipped beef
6  to 8 spring onions or 1 medium onion
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. milk
chives
paprika
1  pkg. light party rye bread
1  pkg. dark party rye bread
preparation: Put the 3 bars of cream cheese in a large bowl.  Chop chipped beef and spring onions.  Add to mix.  Add 2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce and 1 tablespoon mix.  Mix together and form into ball.  Sprinkle paprika and chives onto ball.  Let set overnight for best flavor.  Serve with rye bread.

name: ASPARAGUS ROLLS
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
3  oz. crumbled Blue cheese
1  egg
slice bread
asparagus
Parmesan and Romano cheese, grated
margarine, melted
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients in a blender until smooth.  Slice crust off of bread and flatten with a rolling pin.  Spread with cheese mixture.  Sprinkle with grated cheese.  Place asparagus on bread and roll up.  Dip in melted margarine and place on cookie sheet. Sprinkle with more cheese and bake until crisp at 350°.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
6  qt. popcorn
2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white Karo syrup
2  sticks butter
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. butter flavoring
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients; boil for 5 minutes.  Add baking soda and butter flavoring.  Stir and pour over popcorn.  Put on greased sheet and bake at 200° for 1 hour.  Stir at 15 minute intervals. Store in tight containers.

name: FRUIT MOLD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  box lemon Jell-O
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple and juice
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries and juice
3/4  c. boiling water
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in water.  Add balance.  Double recipe fills 2 1/2-quart ring mold.

name: BIG MAMA'S WEDDING PUNCH
ingredients:
1 small  bottle almond extract
1 1/2  gal. hot water
4 (32 oz.)  cans pineapple juice
3 (6 oz.)  pkg. lemon jello
6  c. sugar
1 1/2  gal. cold water
preparation: Boil hot water; add to lemon jello and sugar.  Stir until dissolved.  Add cold water, pineapple juice and almond extract. Stir until well blended and place in freezer for 2 days.  Take out about 4 hours before ready to serve.  Punch will be slushy.

name: SPANISH CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  whole chicken breasts
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  medium onion, chopped
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1  clove garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. ground cumin
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
1  c. water
3/4  c. long grain rice
2  chicken bouillon cubes
1/2  c. picante sauce
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
