preparation: Cook chicken in hot oil until brown.  Remove from skillet. Add onion, green pepper, garlic, chili powder, cinnamon, cumin and 1/8 teaspoon black pepper.  Cook until vegetables are tender. Drain excess fat from the skillet.

name: CALIFORNIA COBB SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  head Boston bibb lettuce
1/2  bunch watercress (optional)
1/2  head romaine
2  medium tomatoes, diced
2  half breasts cooked chicken, diced
6  strips crisply cooked bacon, crumbled
1  ripe avocado, diced
2  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1/3  c. Blue cheese, crumbled (optional)
oil and vinegar dressing
salt and pepper
preparation: Shred lettuce, watercress and romaine fine; place in a large salad bowl.  Arrange diced tomatoes, chicken, crumbled bacon, diced avocado, diced eggs and crumbled Blue cheese in strips across salad greens.  Just before serving, toss with enough vinagrette dressing to moisten salad and salt and pepper.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
4  c. water
2  c. sugar
1 large  can pineapple juice (48 oz.)
1 (12 oz.)  can orange juice concentrate
1 (12 oz.)  can lemonade concentrate
3  mashed bananas
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. lime juice
2 (2 liter)  bottles 7-Up or Sprite
preparation: Dissolve and boil the first 2 ingredients and then let cool. Mix in the next 4 ingredients.  Freeze this mixture.  Let the mixture thaw a couple of hours before serving to allow it to get slushy, then add last 3 ingredients.  This makes 1 large punch bowl.

name: KOREAN BEEF MARINADE
ingredients:
1 1/2  tsp. sesame seed oil
1/2  tsp. ginger
2  buds garlic or garlic salt
1  tsp. minced onion
2  tsp. sugar
1/3  c. soy sauce
2  lb. steak
1/4  tsp. m.s.g. (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except beef, and pour over beef. Refrigerate for 12 to 48 hours.  Grill as preferred.

name: GINGER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. shortening
1  beaten egg
4  Tbsp. molasses
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. flour
2 1/2  tsp. soda
preparation: Cream together sugar and shortening.  Add beaten egg and molasses.  Sift together dry ingredients and add to mixture.  Mix well and chill for 3 hours or overnight.  Form into balls the size of a walnut.  Roll in powdered sugar and bake in 350° oven for 8 to 10 minutes.  Cool on racks.

name: BUFFALO CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
1  family pack chicken wings
cooking oil
1  stick melted butter or margarine
1  Tbsp. white vinegar
3 to 5  Tbsp. Louisiana hot sauce or Tabasco sauce
preparation: Serve with French fries and celery sticks with Blue cheese dressing.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. onion flakes
1 (18 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  Tbsp. (heaping) oregano
1  Tbsp. (heaping) parsley flakes
1  Tbsp. basil
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  lb. lasagna noodles, cooked
2  lb. Mozzarella cheese
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef, stirring until crumbly.  Pour off drippings.  Add onion flakes, tomato paste and two tomato paste cans of water, mixing well. Add seasonings and spices.  Simmer for 45 minutes.  Layer noodles, sauce and Mozzarella cheese in two 9 x 13-inch pans. Top with Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: SHOE PEG CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can French-style green beans, drained
1  can Green Giant Shoe Peg corn, drained
1  can cream of celery soup
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1/4  c. grated sharp cheese
salt and pepper to taste
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  stack Ritz crackers, crushed
1  stick oleo, melted
preparation: Mix beans, corn, soup, sour cream, cheese, salt and pepper. Saute the onion, green pepper and celery.  Mix together with other ingredients and put in a 9 x 13-inch baking casserole dish.  Top with the Ritz crackers and pour the melted oleo over the entire dish.  Bake until bubbly and top is brown at 375° or until firm.

name: HAM AND ASPARAGUS DEVINE
ingredients:
1  lb. ham, sliced
16 fresh asparagus spears, cooked or 9  oz. frozen
1/8  c. butter
1/8  c. flour
1/4 to 1/2  c. milk (use less for thicker sauce)
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. Muenster cheese
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish, line bottom with sliced ham. Place asparagus on top of ham.

name: EASY PINA COLADA CAKE
ingredients:
1 (18 1/4 to 18 1/2 oz.)  pkg. yellow cake mix*
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. instant vanilla flavor pudding and pie filling mix
1 (15 oz)  can Coco Lopez cream of coconut
1/2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. rum
4  eggs
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, well drained
whipped cream, pineapple chunks, maraschino cherries and toasted coconut for garnish
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a large bowl, combine cake mix, pudding mix, 1/2 cup cream of coconut, 1/2 cup rum, oil and eggs. Beat on medium speed 2 minutes.  Stir in crushed pineapple.  Pour in well-greased and floured 10-inch Bundt or tube pan.  Bake 50 to 55 minutes.  Cool 10 minutes.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. oleo or butter
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. almond flavoring
1  tsp. butter flavoring
preparation: Cream the butter. Add sugar gradually and cream well. Add eggs, one at a time, and beat well after each addition. Add flour alternately with milk (to which flavorings have been added).  Bake in Bundt pan (greased and floured) at 325° for 1 hour.

name: WALDORF SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. diced, unpared red apples
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. thinly sliced celery
1/2  c. broken walnuts
1/2  c. seedless raisins
1/2  c. mayonnaise
lettuce leaves
preparation: Sprinkle apples with lemon juice.  Add celery, walnuts, raisins and mayonnaise; mix well.  Chill and serve on lettuce. Makes 6 servings.

name: PIZZA(From Amber's Kindergarten recipe)
ingredients:
1  lb. dough
3  c. sauce
15  c. cheese
10  mushrooms
81  sausages
5  perfectly ripe avocados
1  red onion
1  bunch scallions
1/2  green pepper
1/2  red pepper
5-8 assorted peppers (anaheim, serrano's, fresno's,etc.)    with at least 3 jalpenos
2  Tbsp. lime juice
1  tsp. minced garlic
1/2  c. salsa of choice
preparation: Chop all veggies and put into a large bowl.  Halve the avocados, remove the pit and scoop out flesh and put in bowl with the veggies.  Add the salsa, lime juice and garlic.  Use a potato masher and a spatula to mix the contents of the bowl.  Mix until the guacamole is a consistent texure.

name: CRAB CHEESE TOAST
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter
2  jars Old English cheese spread
1 or 2  pkg. frozen Wakefield Alaskan crab or 2 cans white crabmeat, drained very well
1  box English muffins, separated in halves
preparation: Melt butter and add cheese.  Stir until smooth.  Add crabmeat and stir until blended and heated throughout.  Heap on English muffin halves and place under broiler for 2 to 3 minutes.

name: BEEF ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  can refried beans
1/3  c. taco sauce
sour cream
flour tortillas (small size)
1  can enchilada sauce
grated cheese
preparation: Brown the hamburger. Add refried beans and taco sauce.  Cook until bubbly. Fill tortillas with 1/3 to 1/2 cup mixture.  Roll and place in baking dish.  Pour enchilada sauce over. Top with grated cheese. Bake for 20 minutes at 350°. Top with sour cream. Makes 10.

name: Cream Cheese Bars
ingredients:
2  pkg. refrigerated crescent rolls
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  c. sugar, divided
1  tsp. vanilla
1  egg, separated
preparation: Press 1 package rolls into bottom of ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix together cream cheese, 1 1/2 cups sugar, vanilla and egg yolk.  Spread over rolls in pan.  Top with remaining package crescent rolls, pressed together and flattened to fit.

name: NUTS AND BOLTS
ingredients:
4  c. Corn Chex
4  c. Rice Chex
4  c. Wheat Chex
6  c. Cheerios
5  c. pretzel sticks
3  c. mixed nuts
1  lb. butter or margarine
4  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. celery salt
2  tsp. seasoned salt
1/2  tsp. onion salt
preparation: Melt butter and add seasonings.  Mix cereal, nuts, etc.  Pour butter mixture in shallow pan and bake at 250° for 1 hour.  Stir up once.  Store in covered container when cool.

name: REFRIGERATOR ROLLS
ingredients:
2  cakes yeast
1  c. cold water
1  c. Crisco
2/3  c. sugar
1  c. boiling water
2  beaten eggs
6 3/4  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in cold water.  Mix Crisco, sugar, salt and boiling water.  Add beaten eggs.  Add yeast mixture to Crisco mixture.  Cover and store in refrigerator 24 hours or overnight.

name: TURKEY-WALNUT SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. chopped cooked turkey
1/2  c. dried cranberries
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. chopped walnuts, toasted
3  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
2  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
2  celery ribs, sliced
1  small red onion, chopped (about 1/2 c.)
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
Mixed salad greens
preparation: Stir together turkey and next 9 ingredients in a bowl.  Cover and chill at least 30 minutes.  Serve over salad greens.  Serves 6.

name: NO CRUST APPLE PIE
ingredients:
3  c. sliced apples
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. melted oleo
1/2  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. flour
pinch of salt
preparation: Put  apples  in  a  greased 9-inch pie plate.  Sprinkle with 1  tablespoon  sugar  and  cinnamon.  Mix  oleo, 1/2 cup sugar, egg, baking powder, flour and salt.  Pour over apples. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350° until golden brown.

name: CHILES RELLENOS
ingredients:
6  long green chiles
6  oz. favorite cheese
2  eggs
1/3  c. flour
1/2  c. oil (vegetable)
preparation: Roast chiles and peel.  Stuff chiles with cheese.  Cut in long strips.  Cover the stuffed chiles with flour.  Mix the egg white until fluffy and add the yolk.  Beat for 5 minutes.  When mixture is ready, dip chiles in mixture and put in hot oil until brown. Turn to other side until brown.

name: TAFFY APPLE DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. cream cheese, softened (8 oz.)
3/4  c. packed brown sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla extract
1/2  c. chopped peanuts
6  apples, cut into wedges
preparation: In a small bowl, beat cream cheese, brown sugar and vanilla until smooth.  Spread mixture on a small serving plate.  Top with nuts.  Serve with apple wedges.

name: RICE AND BEEF PORCUPINES
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. rice, washed
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. shortening
2  c. tomato sauce
1  c. water
preparation: Mix beef, rice, onion and seasoning.  Form into small balls. Fry in hot fat, turning frequently, until light brown, but not crusty on all sides.  Add sauce and water.  Mix well.  Cover and simmer about 45 minutes.

name: GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
1  egg
1  c. molasses
2 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. salt
1  c. hot water
preparation: Cream the sugar and butter. Add egg and stir well. Add molasses, stirring until well mixed.  Sift together flour, soda, cinnamon, ginger, cloves and salt. Beat until smooth.  The batter is soft but makes a fine cake.  Bake in shallow  greased pan. Bake for 35 minutes in a 325° to 350° oven.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  box cranberry jello
1/2  c. sugar
dash of salt
1  c. hot water
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. chopped fresh cranberries
1 (9 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  oranges, diced
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix jello, sugar and juice in hot water.  Chill until thickened.  Add cranberries, oranges, celery and nuts.  Chill overnight.

name: PINEAPPLE ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  c. grated zucchini
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. nuts
1  c. raisins
preparation: Beat until foamy the eggs, oil, sugar and vanilla.  Sift together the flour, soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, baking powder and salt.  Add to foamy mixture the zucchini and pineapple.   Add to flour mixture the nuts and raisins.  Mix well and pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.  Cool in pan 10 minutes.  Turn onto rack to cool.

name: HEAVENLY ONIONS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
2  large white onions, cut in rings and halved
1/2  lb. mushrooms, sliced
1/2  lb. Swiss cheese, shredded
10  slices French bread, both sides buttered (slice 1/4-inch thick and use more if needed)
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
2  tsp. soy sauce
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Butter bread on both sides. Saut onions in 2 tablespoons butter. Butter 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Layer mushrooms, onions, cheese and bread. Mix soup, milk and soy sauce and pour over top. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: SUPER SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
10  oz. grated sharp cheese
1  lb. hot pork sausage
3 1/2  c. Bisquick
preparation: Mix together and roll into walnut size balls.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: FRUIT CAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
6  c. chopped pecans
1  lb. white raisins
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. dates, chopped
1  lb. candied cherries
1  lb. candied pineapple
3/4  c. flour (to mix with fruit)
1  stick margarine
1 1/2  c. light brown sugar
4  eggs
2 1/4  c. flour
3 scant  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. salt
5  Tbsp. milk
1/2  c. wine
preparation: Chop nuts and fruit well.  Flour all fruit with the 3/4 cup flour; set aside.  Cream butter and brown sugar well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.  Sift the dry ingredients together and add to sugar and butter mixture.  Fold the nuts, fruit, milk and wine into mixture; mix well.  Drop by tablespoon onto lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: CANNED APPLE PIE FILLING
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. water
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  qt. peeled and sliced apples
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Combine sugar, water and cornstarch in a saucepan.  Cook and stir until smooth.  Add apples and cinnamon and cook until tender. Pack in sterilized jars and process at 5 pounds pressure in pressure cooker for 10 minutes or in a water bath for 20 minutes.

name: RAISIN NUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. boiling water
1  c. raisins
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
3  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
2  tsp. rum extract
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Pour boiling water over raisins.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Stir in baking soda.  Sift flour with salt.  Beat eggs with sugar, then beat in oil and rum extract.  Stir in flour mixture, alternately with raisin mixture.  Fold in nuts.  Pour into greased and floured 8-inch Bundt pan or 10-inch tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Cool in pan 15 minutes, then remove from pan and cool on cake rack.  Serve warm, topped with ice cream.  Makes 20 servings.

name: INDIAN CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  eggs, well beaten
1/4  c. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
2  cans whole kernel corn, drained
10  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
preparation: Combine eggs, flour and sugar; beat well.  Add cheese and corn.  Stir in 3/4 of the bacon.  Pour mixture into ungreased 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle remaining bacon over top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.  Yields 8 servings.

name: SUGAR-FREE TOMATO SOUP COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. melted margarine (cooled)
2  egg whites, beaten
1 (10 oz.)  can tomato soup
1 1/2  c. flour
2  c. quick-cooking oats
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: In bowl, soak raisins in hot water to cover for 5 minutes; drain.  Combine margarine, egg whites and soup in bowl.  Mix well. Stir in flour, oats, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, raisins and nuts.  Drop onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork, dipped in water.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.  Cool on cookie sheet for 2 minutes.  Remove to wire rack.  Cool completely.  Yields 4 dozen.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
3  cans buttermilk biscuits
1  c. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. brown sugar
1  stick oleo
preparation: Cut each biscuit into fourths with scissors.  Shake biscuits in a bag with white sugar and cinnamon.  Layer biscuits into greased tube pan.  Sprinkle chopped nuts between layers.  Melt the brown sugar and oleo and boil for 1 minute.  Pour over biscuits. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.  Let stand for 10 minutes before removing from pan.  To serve, just pinch off a piece and eat with fingers.  Monkey see! Monkey do!

name: NO FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  c. Crisco
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/3  c. cold water
preparation: Combine flour, Crisco and salt.  Add to egg, vinegar and water which have been mixed together.  Roll onto floured surface. Yield:  2 pie shells.

name: BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  chicken, cut up
1 1/2  Tbsp. butter
onion salt
garlic salt
pepper
preparation: Lay chicken in a pan.  Melt butter and pour over chicken. Then add a dash of pepper, onion and garlic salt.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

name: RASPBERRY JELL
ingredients:
4  c. peeled green tomatoes, chopped fine
4 1/2  c. sugar
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. raspberry jello
preparation: Combine tomatoes and sugar in saucepan.  Boil for 15 minutes. Pour over jello and stir.  Pour into jars and refrigerate.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. salad oil
4  eggs, beaten
2/3  c. water
2  c. pumpkin (16 oz. can)
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. raisins
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
3 1/3  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. soda
1/2  c. slivered almonds
preparation: Mix the first 5 ingredients together; combine remaining ingredients and add to the first 5 ingredients.  Grease and flour 2 loaf pans.  Pour mixture into pans and bake 50 minutes at 350°. Bread is nice and moist.

name: CHICKEN WITH RICE
ingredients:
1  c. chicken
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  envelope onion soup mix
3  c. water
1  c. raw rice
preparation: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.  Wash rice.  Pour over bottom of pan. Put chicken pieces over rice, then sprinkle over the soup mix. Mix soup and water together.  Pour over.  Bake in 325° oven for 2 hours.  (First hour, cover pan.)

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. milk
3  lb. summer squash
2  eggs
1/2  c. cheese, grated
preparation: In casserole place layer of cooked squash; add 1/2 cup grated Cheddar cheese; pour over milk mixture.  Top with crumbled crackers.  Repeat layers.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can fruit cocktail
1 medium  can crushed pineapple
2  apples, peeled and chopped
1/2  c. shredded coconut
1  c. pecans (optional)
2 small  cans mandarin oranges
3  bananas, sliced
2  c. miniature marshmallows
4  oz. sour cream
preparation: Drain all canned fruits well.  Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight.

name: FRUIT COOKIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. butter or margarine
3  eggs
1  tsp. baking soda, dissolved in a little warm water
pinch of salt
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  lb. raisins
1  lb. chopped dates
1  lb. English walnuts, chopped
preparation: In large mixing bowl, combine sugar, butter and eggs, then blend in next 6 ingredients. Add raisins, dates and chopped nuts last. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350° oven 12 minutes or until done.

name: QUICK CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
1  pkg. broccoli
1  c. cooked chicken
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. grated cheese
preparation: Cook broccoli; arrange in ovenproof dish.  Layer chicken over broccoli.  Combine soup, 1/2 cup cheese and Worcestershire sauce. Pour over broccoli and  chicken.  Sprinkle with 1/4 cup cheese. Bake until bubbly.

name: BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. butter
2  c. sifted flour
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
yolk of 1 egg
preparation: Cream butter and sugar. Add salt, yolk of one egg, then flour. Add vanilla.  Chill and work into balls. Press with thumb and fill with tart jelly (plum or apricot).  Bake at 250° for 30 minutes on ungreased pan.

name: CARROT/PINEAPPLE MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  c. sugar (a little less)
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. oil
2  eggs
1  c. finely grated raw carrot
1/2  c. crushed pineapple with juice
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and soda, cinnamon and salt.  Add vanilla.  Blend on low speed until all is moistened, then for 2 minutes at medium speed. Half fill greased muffin tin (or use paper liners).  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until done.  Makes 24.

name: PEANUTTY CHICKEN AND VEGETABLES
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1 - 1 1/2  lb. boneless chicken breasts, cut up
1  tsp. paprika
2  medium onions, chopped
4  carrots, peeled and cut into pieces
1  zucchini, cut into pieces
1  red bell pepper, cut into pieces
1/3  c. peanut butter
1  c. chicken broth
salt & pepper
preparation: In deep skillet, heat oil over medium - high heat.  Add chicken, sprinkle with paprika and cook till well browned.  Remove chicken and drain most of the drippings from skillet.  Add vegetables to skillet and cook, stirring, till somewhat tender. Stir in peanut butter, chicken broth, salt and pepper to taste. Heat to boiling, stirring until smooth.  Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.  Return chicken to pan and simmer a few minutes more until heated through.  Serve over hot, cooked rice and garnish with chopped peanuts, if desired.  Serves 4-5.

name: HOMEMADE CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. ground turkey
4  cans tomatoes (chili seasoned tomatoes, optional)
1 small  can mushrooms
2  cans pinto beans
2  cans red kidney beans
1  medium green bell pepper
2  packs chili seasonings with onion
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook in a large pot, all ingredients except meat.  On medium heat, brown meat; stir in meat with ingredients in pot.  Turn down heat to low; cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally until done.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
6  c. sugar
3  c. mustard
3 3/4  c. tomato ketchup
2 1/2  Tbsp. black pepper
1 1/2  tsp. red pepper
9  c. red vinegar
1 1/2  c. water
1 1/2  sticks margarine
3  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. cornstarch
3/4  c. sugar
preparation: Mix first 7 ingredients with mixer and add margarine (melted), salt and cornstarch.  Cook slowly 1 hour and add 3/4 cup sugar. Simmer for 2 hours.  Recipe makes about 1 gallon.

name: RAW APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. cubed apples
1  egg
1 1/4  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  c. chopped nuts
1/4  c. oil
1  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
confectioners sugar or whipped cream
preparation: Combine apples, egg, flour, cinnamon, chopped nuts, oil, sugar, salt and vanilla in one bowl.  Mix well.  Bake 45 minutes in a 325° oven in a 7 1/2 x 11 1/2-inch pan.  Top with confectioners or whipped cream to serve.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  chopped onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1 small  pkg. Tater Tots
1/2  can water
preparation: Line pan with meat, uncooked.  Sprinkle onions on top.  Add chicken soup.  Layer Tater Tots and celery soup mixed with water. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. cranberries
3  apples (unpeeled)
2  oranges
1  c. sugar
1  large raspberry Jell-O
1  c. water
preparation: Grind up all fruit.  Add sugar to fruit mixture and stir well; set aside.  Dissolve Jell-O in cup of water.  Add to fruit.  Add chopped nuts if desired.  Pour in mold and chill.

name: BRAISED DUCK WITH BLACK CHERRIES
ingredients:
2  (5 lb.) ducks, quartered
2 1/2  c. canned black cherries
4  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. minced onion
3/4  c. dry Marsala wine
1 1/2  c. chicken bouillon
1  bay leaf, crumbled
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. salt
black pepper (freshly ground)
preparation: Brown the duck quarters in butter.  Place the duck in a shallow pan and roast in a slow (325°) oven for 1 hour.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. butter
1/2  c. syrup
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
6  qt. popped popcorn
preparation: Melt sugar, butter, salt and syrup.  Boil syrup mixture to hard boil stage.  Stir in soda and vanilla.  Pour over popped corn.

name: ORIENTAL SALAD
ingredients:
head of lettuce
1  bunch sliced green onions
1  pkg. slivered almonds
1  Tbsp. sesame seed
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. Ramen Pride oriental noodle soup (discard flavor packet)
preparation: Mix lettuce and onions.  In a skillet, brown in butter, almonds, sesame seed and broken up noodles over low heat.  Add to lettuce and onions.

name: RICE KRISPIE BARS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. corn syrup
1  c. peanut butter
6  c. Rice Krispies
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Heat sugar  and  syrup	in saucepan until sugar is dissolved. Add peanut butter; mix in Rice Krispies.  Pack in 9 x 13-inch greased  pan.  Melt butterscotch and chocolate chips. Spread over top.  Refrigerate.	Cut  when top is set.  Yields 20 bars.

name: CHICKEN SUPREME
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. orange juice
1/2  c. water
1  c. rice (uncooked)
6  pieces chicken
1/4  envelope onion soup mix
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients and pour into greased 2-quart casserole.  Lay chicken on top.  Sprinkle with dry onion soup mix. Cover casserole airtight with heavy aluminum foil.  Bake 2 hours without opening the foil at 350°.  Can be frozen after baking. Serves 6.

name: CRIPPLE CREEK CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. minced onion
2  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  c. margarine
2  tsp. paprika
1  fryer, cut up
salt and pepper to taste
2  c. sour cream
1/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
4  c. cooked, buttered noodles
preparation: Saute onion and garlic in margarine in small skillet; add paprika.  Season chicken with salt and pepper.  Roll in onion mixture.  Arrange in 11 x 15-inch casserole.  Spoon remaining onion mixture over chicken.  Bake, covered, at 375° for 40 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
strawberries
Cool Whip
cooked pie shell
3  Tbsp. strawberry jello
preparation: Cook the sugar, water and cornstarch until thick, then add 3 tablespoons strawberry jello.  Pour over fresh strawberries in a cooked pie shell.  Top with Cool Whip.  Let set 2 hours.

name: Fruit Dip
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese (room temperature)
7  oz. jar marshmallow cream
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients together with electric mixer.  This is good to serve with bananas, pineapple chunks, white grapes, strawberries and apple slices on a serving tray.

name: SMILES
ingredients:
4  red apples (Braeburn works well)
2  c. mini marshmallows
peanut butter (creamy)
preparation: Wash apples and cut into quarters. Remove cores and seeds. Cut each quarter section into 4 slices. Spread peanut butter on one side of every slice. Place 3 to 4 marshmallows on one apple slice on peanut butter side. Place another slice on top of Marcello's with peanut butter next to marshmallows. Should look like a mouth with teeth showing.

name: PEANUT BUTTER SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. Karo (white)
1  c. peanut butter
4  c. cornflakes or Rice Krispies
preparation: Heat sugar and Karo until it barely boils.  Remove from heat and add peanut butter.  Add cornflakes.  Stir to coat.   Pour into greased pan.  Cut when cool.

name: COCONUT-PECAN ICING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. margarine
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/3  c. coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Heat over medium heat the milk, margarine and sugar.  Heat for 12 minutes until thick.  Add vanilla, coconut and pecans.  Spread on a 3 layered German chocolate cake.  Frost tops only.  Double recipe to frost sides and tops.

name: VEGGIE PIZZA
ingredients:
2  pkg. Pillsbury crescent rolls
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. dill weed
1  c. mayo
any 5 chopped vegetables *
preparation: Spread rolls on large cookie sheet and bake as directed.  Mix cream cheese, garlic powder, dill weed and mayo.  Mix until creamy and spread over cooled dough; add vegetables and sprinkle over all of the dough.  Cover with wax paper and set in refrigerator 2 to 3 hours.  Press wax paper down lightly to hold down vegetables.  Cut in 2-inch squares and serve.

name: QUICK AND EASY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (24 oz.)  pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1  can mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1  medium onion, chopped
2  cans (2.8 oz. each) French fried onions
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In heavy skillet, cook beef with salt until browned, stirring to break into small pieces.  With slotted spoon, transfer beef to large bowl.  Add potatoes, soup, sour cream, cheese and chopped onion; mix well.

name: LAZY DAY CHILI
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans Bush's chili hot beans
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1  lb. hamburger
preparation: Brown hamburger really well and pour off grease.  Add tomato sauce and 1 can of water to rinse cans.  Add beans and 1/2 can of water to rinse.  Stir frequently.  More water may be added, if desired.  Any seasoning may be added but we love it plain.

name: CHICKEN BARBECUE SAUCE(Indiana State Grand Champion)
ingredients:
1  pt. water (1/2 c.)
1  qt. vinegar (4 c.)
1  lb. butter (1 stick)
2  oz. salt
sugar to taste
preparation: Combine ingredients together in saucepan.

name: CREAM CHEESE NUT DROPS
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  sticks margarine, softened
2  c. self-rising flour
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
walnut or pecan halves
preparation: Cream margarine and cream cheese; add sugar and flour, blending well.  Form into small balls and flatten on greased cookie sheet by placing nut half in center.  Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.  Makes 4 1/2 to 10 dozen, depending on size formed.  Let cookies cool before removing from cookie sheet or they will crumble.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADA BAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  garlic clove, minced
1/2 (4 oz.)  can green chilies, chopped
1/2  c. salsa
1/2  c. sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. cooked chicken
1/2  lb. Monterey Jack cheese
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese
9  corn tortillas
black olives (optional)
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Melt margarine and saute onion and garlic in it.  Add sour cream, soup and milk.  Mix well.  Shred chicken. Mix with salsa and chilies.  Shred cheeses together.  In 9 x 13-inch pan, layer 1/3 cheese, 3 tortillas, 1/3 chicken mixture and 1/3 cheese.  Repeat until used up, using cheese last.  Bake 30 minutes until bubbly and browned.  Top with olives.  Yields 8 servings.

name: GLORIFIED PEANUTS
ingredients:
4  c. raw peanuts
2  c. sugar
red food coloring
preparation: Mix peanuts and sugar with 1 cup water in large skillet with 3 drops food coloring.  Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture crystallizes.  Spread on large greased cookie sheet, separating peanuts.  Bake at 300° for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Cool in pan.  Break into pieces.  Store in covered container.

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion
1  c. cream of chicken soup
1 small  pkg. frozen Tater Tots
preparation: Put meat in dish.  Sprinkle with onion.  Pour chicken soup over all.  Layer with Tater Tots.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick
1  lb. mild sausage
1  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: With hands, combine sausage and cheese and then add Bisquick. Shape into balls and bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

name: TURKEY PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. cooked turkey
2  c. macaroni, cooked
1  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine turkey, macaroni, celery and onions.  Mix well. Combine mayonnaise, mustard and salt.  Mix all together.  Chill before serving.

name: CAVATINI
ingredients:
1 large  can tomato sauce
1 small  can tomato sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
8  oz. noodles
mushrooms
pepperoni
3/4  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. oregano
1  onion
1  small bell pepper
1/2  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Cook tomato sauce and spices on low for 20 minutes.  Brown meat with onion and bell pepper; drain.  Cook noodles and drain.  Mix all together, along with mushrooms and pepperoni.  Put in baking dish and top with 8 ounces shredded Mozzarella cheese and 8 ounces shredded Cheddar cheese.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CHIP OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1/4  c. shortening
2  c. packed brown sugar
1  T. milk
2  t. vanilla
1  egg
2  c. flour
10  oz. pkg. peanut butter chips
1 1/2  c. quick oats
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  t. baking soda
1/2  t. salt
preparation: Heat oven to 375°. In a large bowl, beat butter, shortening, brown sugar, milk, vanilla and egg until light and fluffy. Add remaining ingredients until well blended. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet by teaspoonfuls. Bake 10-12 minutes for soft cookies and 12-14 minutes for crisp cookies.

name: AUNT RUTH'S BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  qt. milk
3  c. bread crumbs
butter
nutmeg
raisins and/or coconut (optional)
preparation: Mix sugar, eggs and milk.  Add crumbs.  Dot with butter. Sprinkle with nutmeg.  Bake in greased casserole in 375° oven until knife slid in middle comes out clean.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. salad oil
1  egg, slightly beaten
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar or 3/4 c.
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. well drained blueberries
preparation: Stir milk and salad oil into egg.  Sift together and add dry ingredients.  Stir just until flour is moistened.  Fold in blueberries.  Batter should be lumpy.  Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400°.

name: OVEN ROUND STEAK DINNER
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak, 1-inch thick, cut into serving pieces
6  medium onions, sliced
1/4  c. fat
3  large potatoes, halved
1  bay leaf
1  can condensed tomato soup
1  lb. can (2 c.) French cut green beans
preparation: Season meat with 2 teaspoons salt and dash pepper.  Roll in flour.  Cook onions in hot fat until tender but not brown; remove onions and brown meat slowly on both sides.  Place meat in 3-quart casserole, add onions, potatoes and bay leaf; pour soup over. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 45 minutes or until meat is tender.  Add beans; cook 10 to 15 minutes more.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
2  eggs, well beaten
1  stick melted margarine
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate bits
3/4  c. pecans
1/2  c. coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
1  unbaked deep-dish pie shell
preparation: Blend sugar, flour, eggs, margarine and vanilla well.  Stir in chocolate bits, pecans and coconut.  Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes, or until firm.

name: HOT FUDGE SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. evaporated milk
2  c. sugar
4  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Heat sugar and milk to a rolling boil.  Boil one minute, stirring constantly.  Add chocolate and salt.  Stir until melted. Beat until smooth with hand rotary beater.  Add butter and extract.  Makes about 2 cups.  Keep refrigerated.

name: CRANBERRY JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. cranberries
2  oranges (3/4 c.)
grated rind of 1/2 orange
2  c. sugar
1 large  box red jello
2 1/2  c. boiling water
1  can crushed pineapple with juice
2  grated apples (no skin)
preparation: Grind cranberries.  Squeeze juice from oranges.  Grate rind of 1/2 orange.  Mix together with sugar and let set while making jello.  Mix red jello and boiling water; mix with cranberry mixture.  Mix in crushed pineapple with juice and grated apples. Place in refrigerator to set.

name: DELICIOUS PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1 regular size  can pumpkin
1  can condensed milk
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
pinch of ginger
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Into large mixing bowl, place pumpkin, milk, eggs, vanilla and spices.  Blend well with mixer.  Pour into partially baked pie crust and bake at 375° until pie is firm in middle or inserted knife comes out clean.  Cool and serve with whipping cream.

name: ANISE BISCOTTE
ingredients:
6  eggs
1  c. sugar
6  tsp. baking powder
1/2  lb. butter
1 1/2  lb. flour
1  bottle anise extract
preparation: Beat eggs and sugar.  Sift flour and add baking powder; work in butter.  Combine egg and sugar mixture to flour and knead 5 to 10 minutes until smooth.  Roll into loaves.  Brush with egg glaze. Bake for 15 minutes in moderate oven at 375° to 400°.  Cool very slightly; slice, rebake until golden brown.  Cookie is hard.

name: TEXAS HASH
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, diced
1  green pepper, diced
1 (16 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
3/4  c. uncooked long grain rice
2  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: Brown meat, onion and pepper in skillet.  Add rice, chili powder and tomatoes.  Simmer for 5 minutes.  Put in a 2-quart casserole dish.  Bake, covered, for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: CRAB STUFFED MANICOTTI
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. imitation King crabmeat
18  manicotti shells
1 1/2  c. fat-free Ricotta cheese
1 (8 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
1/4  c. chopped green onions
1/4  c. cooking wine (optional)
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
nonfat cooking vegetable spray
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. thyme
1/2  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese, grated
preparation: Cook manicotti shells according to package directions.  Drain the shells and set aside.  Combine crabmeat, Ricotta cheese, mushrooms, onions, wine and lemon juice in a bowl, stirring until blended.  Stuff the shells with the crabmeat mixture.  Place the shells in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish that has been sprayed with nonfat spray.

name: CHEESY POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
6  potatoes, peeled and diced
milk
1  stick butter
salt and pepper
Cheez Whiz
preparation: Cook potatoes until tender.  Drain and add milk and rest of the ingredients.  Boil in saucepan.

name: TEXAS CAVIAR
ingredients:
2  tomatoes
15  oz. (1 can) black eyed peas
1  red bell pepper, chopped
1  bunch green onions, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
3  Tbsp. lime juice
1/2  tsp. salt
8  oz. (1 jar) picante sauce
1/2  c. cilantro (fresh) OR 1 Tbsp. dried
preparation: Remove seeds and chop tomatoes.  Drain and rinse black eyed peas.  Stir together all ingredients in a large bowl.  Cover and chill for 8 hours, stirring occasionally.

name: NO CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients:
4 to 5  slices bacon
1  medium onion, sliced and separated into rings
2  medium potatoes, diced (1 1/2 c.)
1/2  c. water
1 (17 oz.)  can cream-style corn
2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
preparation: In a large saucepan, cook bacon until crisp.  Remove from pan; crumble.  Set aside.  Add onion rings and cook until lightly browned.  Add potatoes and water.  Cook over medium heat until tender (10 to 15 minutes).  Add corn, milk, salt and pepper.  Cook until heated through.  Do not boil.  Serve in bowls; top with bacon.  Serves 4 to 5.

name: WHIPPING CREAM POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
3  c. flour
1/2  lb. butter
1/2  pt. whipping cream
1  tsp. vanilla flavor
preparation: Cream sugar and butter.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.  Add whipping cream and flour alternately.  Add flavor. Cook in preheated 300° oven for 1 hour and 20 minutes.  Use a tube pan.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
4  Tbsp. butter
3 1/2  c. milk
2 small  pkg. vanilla pudding (instant)
12  oz. Cool Whip
20  oz. pkg. Oreo cookies, crumbled
preparation: Mix cream cheese, sugar and butter.  Mix milk and pudding together.  Then add Cool Whip to the pudding mixture.  Blend the two mixtures together.  Crumble cookies.  Layer the ingredients in a flower pot starting with the cookies, then pudding, then cookies, etc., ending up with the cookies on top.  Happy Gardening!

name: CHEESE STRATA
ingredients:
6  slices bread, halved diagonally
5 (1 oz.)  slices American or Swiss cheese
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1/3  c. sliced green onion
2  tsp. prepared mustard or Dijon-style mustard
paprika
preparation: In a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish layer 8 bread slice halves, the cheese slices, then the remaining bread slice halves. Beat eggs.  Stir in milk, onion, mustard, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.  Pour over bread and cheese layers.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 2 to 24 hours.  Bake uncovered in a 325° oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until set and lightly browned.  Let stand 10 minutes.   Serves 6.

name: STRAWBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. plain flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
2  c. sugar
3  eggs, well beaten
1 1/4  c. oil or 2 sticks butter, softened
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine flour, salt, soda, cinnamon and sugar.  Make a well in center of dry ingredients.  Add eggs and oil or butter; stir only until dry ingredients are moist.  Stir in strawberries and nuts.

name: MINTED NUTS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. white Karo syrup
1 heaping  Tbsp. marshmallow cream
1  tsp. essence of peppermint
1 1/2 to 2  c. pecans or walnuts
preparation: Cook sugar, water and syrup together until rolling boil; then boil exactly one minute.  Take off stove, add marshmallow cream, peppermint and nuts.  Stir in a circular motion until all nuts are coated and mixture hardens.  Cool on wax paper.

name: KEY LIME PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) pie shell (graham)
4  eggs, separated (reserve 1 white for filling, 3 for meringue)
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)
1/2  ReaLime reconstituted lime juice
few drops green food coloring (optional)
1/3  c. sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a medium bowl, beat egg yolks.  Stir in sweetened condensed milk, ReaLime and food coloring.  In a small bowl, stiffly beat 1 egg white.  Fold into sweetened condensed milk mixture.  Turn into shell.

name: COWBOY BEANS
ingredients:
1  can pork and beans
1  can lima beans
1  can pinto beans
1  can kidney beans
1  large onion
1  jar hot Kraft barbecue sauce
2  lb. hamburger
preparation: On top of stove, cut onion in pot on top of beans.  In a separate pan, brown hamburger and drain.  Put in beans.  Pour sauce over beans and meat.  Cook until done.  Cook in crock-pot 4 to 5 hours on low.

name: POPPY SEED DRESSING
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. onion powder
3/4  tsp. ground mustard
3/4  c. vinegar
1  c. vegetable oil
3/4  tsp. poppy seed
preparation: In a mixing bowl, combine first 4 ingredients. Add the vinegar and beat for 4 minutes. Add the oil. Beat 10 minutes. Add poppy seed. Whisk in. Yields 2 3/4 cups. Good on most salads and fresh fruit.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2 to 2  lb. ground chuck
1/2  pkg. saltines (about 20)
2  or 3 eggs (depending on amount of meat you use)
1/2  c. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. black pepper, according to taste
dash of salt
1  Tbsp. minced, fresh garlic or 1/8 tsp. garlic powder
1/2  onion, chopped fine
1/2  bell pepper, chopped fine
1  whole tomato, chopped
1 (29 oz.)  can tomato sauce or Hunt's Italian style tomatoes
preparation: With rolling pin, crush saltines to make fine crumbs.  Combine meat, saltine crumbs, eggs, 1/4 cup Worcestershire sauce, black pepper and garlic.  Add chopped onion, bell pepper and tomato (save some for topping later).  Mix thoroughly.  Form into loaf shape and place in a 9 x 13-inch casserole.  Pour remaining Worcestershire sauce over meat loaf and pepper lightly.  Bake, uncovered, in a 400° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.  Turn oven down to about 325° and bake for one to one hour and 15 minutes.  Thirty minutes before meat loaf is done, top with reserved onion, pepper and tomato.  Fifteen minutes before meat loaf is done, pour a can of tomato sauce (or Italian style tomatoes) over meat loaf.  Cook, uncovered, the last 15 minutes.  Then enjoy!

name: MILDRED GREGORY'S CRUMB CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  stick margarine
pinch of salt
1  egg
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients listed until crumbly.  Take out 1/2 cup of crumbs for topping.  Beat egg, buttermilk and soda separately in a bowl.  Combine the beaten mixture and crumb mixture together.  (Do not add topping to this mixture!)  Put in a greased pan and put the 1/2 cup of crumb mixture on top.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 375°.

name: CABBAGE BOIL
ingredients:
1  large head cabbage, cut into pieces
1 (8 oz.)  can whole mushrooms
3  large carrots, cut into pieces
4  ribs celery, cut into pieces
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Place cabbage, mushrooms, carrots and celery in a 4-quart saucepan.  Add water to cover.  Add salt and pepper.  Cook until all vegetables are done.  Drain liquid and serve.

name: CABBAGE PATCH STEW
ingredients:
1/2  head cabbage
2  stalks celery
1  qt. tomatoes or tomato juice
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. thyme
1  lb. lean hamburger
1  large onion
1 (16 oz.)  can kidney beans
preparation: Brown hamburger and drain.  Combine rest of ingredients and cook until celery is done.  This freezes well.

name: RHUBARB NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. oil
1  egg
1  c. sour milk or buttermilk
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. diced rhubarb
1/2  c. chopped nuts
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar (white)
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix all but white sugar and butter together.  Pour into a greased loaf pan.  Top with mixture of white sugar and butter mixed together.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until done.

name: MARINATED CALICO VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can (16 oz.) French-style green beans
1  can (16 oz.) small green peas
1  can (16 oz.) white Shoepeg corn
1  jar (2 oz.) chopped pimento
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1  large green pepper, chopped
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. vinegar
1/2  c. oil
preparation: Drain beans, corn, peas and pimentos.  Combine all vegetables in large bowl and set aside.

name: VEGGIE DIP
ingredients:
1  c. Caines mayonnaise
1  tsp. ginger
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. minced onion
preparation: Combine ingredients; serve with veggies.  Especially good with raw cauliflower.

name: OVEN BAKED FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
16  slices white sandwich bread, (cut into one inch cubes)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese softened
12  large eggs
2  cups whipping cream
1/2  c. Griffin's Waffle Syrup
preparation: Place bread in lightly greased 9x13 dish.

name: CHERRY SUPREME CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  tsp. cherry juice
2/3  c. cooking oil
2/3  c. apricot nectar
4  eggs
1  tsp. red food coloring
4  or 5 chopped cherries
preparation: For cake, mix ingredients in order given.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes in tube pan.

name: JIMMY'S CHIX DISH - EL RANCHO CHIX
ingredients:
3  c cooked, and cut up chicken (4 breasts)
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can (mild) Rotel
1  Tbsp chili powder
1  pkg of corn tortillas, sliced thin, bite size
8  oz shredded cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix together Rotel, and both cans of soup and chili powder. In a 13 x 9 baking dish, layer tortillas, chicken, sauce, and cheese. Start over same order. with the last layer being tortillas and cheese. Bake covered at 350 degrees for 40 minutes. Uncover the last 5 or 10 minutes of cooking time.

name: EVERLASTING SLAW
ingredients:
1/2  large cabbage, thinly sliced or chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
1  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. celery seed
1  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Combine the cabbage, pepper and sugar and mix well.  Bring remaining ingredients to boil.  Pour boiling mixture over cabbage mixture.  Store in refrigerator in covered container.  Keeps at least 4 weeks.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. self-rising meal
1  c. creamed corn
1  c. buttermilk
3  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1/2  large green pepper, chopped
1  chopped onion
1  c. grated cheese
1  small chopped red pepper (hot, I use ground red pepper about 1/2 or 3/4 tsp.)
preparation: Mix  all  ingredients,  except  cheese.  Pour  half  of mixture  in  greased pan.  Spread cheese over mixture.  Spread remaining mixture over cheese.  Bake at 400° until done, about 35 to 40 minutes.

name: HAPPY BARS
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
2  c. self-rising flour
1  lb. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. chocolate chips (12 oz.)
preparation: Melt margarine.  Beat eggs.  Add sugar, vanilla, flour, nuts and chips.   Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan and spread batter in pan. (Batter will be thick.)  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.  (Do not overbake!)  Coconut may be added to batter.

name: LEMON CRUNCH POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. lemon flavor
5  large eggs
2  c. cake flour
1  c. oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Beat until smooth and creamy.  Pour into a large greased and floured Bundt pan.  Bake at 325° until center springs back when touched.

name: PUMPKIN PIE CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  c. pumpkin
1  c. evaporated milk
2  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. ginger
preparation: Combine all ingredients and beat.  Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: NANCY LEE'S BROCCOLI, CHEESE AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked rice
2 (1 lb.)  pkg. broccoli
margarine
2 (10 1/2 oz.)  cans cream of mushroom soup
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans Cheddar cheese soup
milk
Cheddar cheese
preparation: Grease 4-quart casserole, 15 x 10 x 2-inch.  Put a layer of rice.  Mix soup with some milk and pour over rice.  Next layer the cooked broccoli.  Put remaining rice over the broccoli, then pour the remaining soup mixture.  Top it all off with slices of Cheddar cheese.  If necessary, add milk so it will not bake dry. Bake in moderate oven until mixture bubbles and cheese melts.

name: SPECIAL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
5  c. flour
2  tsp. salt
2  c. lard (1 lb.)
1  egg
2  tsp. vinegar
cold milk
preparation: Blend together flour, salt and lard until particles are the size of small peas.  Beat egg in an 8 ounce measuring cup.  Add vinegar and mix well, then fill remainder of cup with cold milk. Mix with flour mixture.

name: NUT GOODIE BARS
ingredients:
16  oz. almond bark
12  oz. semi-sweet chocolate chips
6  oz. chunky peanut butter
1 1/2  lb. peanuts, salted
preparation: Melt almond bark and chocolate chips together.  Add peanut butter and peanuts.  Drop onto wax paper-lined cookie sheets. Refrigerate 10 minutes.  Remove and store in refrigerator until ready to use.  "My kids love these."

name: QUICK AND EASY CHICKEN PIE(For The Working Wife)
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  cans Swanson mixed chicken
1  pkg. pie shells (9-inch)
preparation: Mix chicken and soup together in bowl.  Pour into pie shell. Cover with remaining pie shell as package directs, pricking to allow steam to escape.  Cook as directed on pie crust package.

name: EGG NOG(12 Servings)
ingredients:
6  eggs, separated
sugar (separated 1/2 c. and 1/4 c.)
1  c. Jack Daniels
1/8  c. rum
2  c. heavy cream
2 to 3  c. milk
nutmeg (as a sprinkling)
preparation: Beat egg yolks until stiff and light yellow. Slowly add 1/2 cup sugar, beating well.  Add alcohol.  Mix well and pour into punch bowl.

name: BREAD AND BUTTER PICKLES
ingredients:
25  to 30 medium cucumbers
3  large white onions
2  large sweet peppers
1/2  c. salt
5  c. cider vinegar
5  c. sugar (2 1/2 lb.)
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
1  tsp. turmeric
preparation: Wash cucumbers and slice as thin as possible.  Chop onions and sweet peppers.  Combine with cucumbers and salt; let stand 3 hours in ice and drain.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  bunches fresh broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
butter
4  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
3  eggs, well beaten
1  small bag Pepperidge Farm stuffing (seasoned brand)
preparation: Cook broccoli just until tender; drain and cut into bite-size pieces.  Spray large Corning Ware dish with Pam.  Place cut up broccoli on bottom of dish.  Mix onion, soup, mayonnaise and beaten eggs together.  Blend well.  Pour 3/4 of mixture over broccoli; sprinkle cheese over top of that, then pour on remaining soup mixture and top with stuffing mix.  Add dots of butter on top of crust and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CUMBERLAND SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  jar currant jelly
1  egg yolk
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. raisins
3/4  tsp. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. vinegar
salt and pepper
preparation: Melt the jelly in the top of a double boiler.  Beat in all the other ingredients except the raisins and stir until the sauce is thickened.  Do not despair if this is slow work; it may take as much as 15 minutes.  I find I can read a book while I am stirring. When the sauce has thickened, stir in the raisins.

name: VEGGIE BARS
ingredients:
2  tubes crescent rolls
1  beaten egg
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. cauliflower, cut small
1/2  c. broccoli, cut small
1/2  c. cauliflower
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped fine
1/2  c. tomato, diced
3/4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: On a cookie sheet, press both cans of crescent rolls flat so all the seams are closed. Brush with beaten egg. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.  If dough puffs up while baking, flatten with spoon. Let crust cool.

name: PERFECT PIE CRUST
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
1 3/4  c. solid Crisco
1  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  egg
preparation: Combine flour, sugar and salt in a mixing bowl.  Cut in shortening with 2 knives.  Combine water and vinegar with egg; add to flour mixture and stir until moistened and dough is formed. Divide dough into 4 or 5 equal parts; shape each into a round flat patty ready for rolling.  Wrap in waxed paper; chill at least 30 minutes.  Place on lightly floured board; roll 1/8-inch thick and 2 inches larger than inverted pie pan.

name: BOHEMIAN NUT SLICES
ingredients:
1  envelope dry yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1  tsp. sugar
1/2 to 2  Tbsp. oil (cold)
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. oleomargarine
2  eggs, separated
preparation: Sprinkle yeast and sugar in warm water.  Let stand  10 minutes.  Sift together flour and salt.  Cut oleo in until it resembles coarse meal.  Blend in egg yolks and yeast.  Mix until a small ball is formed.  Beat egg whites until stiff, not dry.  Beat in sugar (1/2 cup) until peaked.  Fold in flavoring.  Divide dough in half.  Roll into 9 x 13-inch rectangle.  Spread with egg white mixture.  Sprinkle with nuts.  Roll as for a jelly roll.  Place on greased cookie sheet.  Make a 1/2-inch deep cut down the center (lengthwise) of each roll.    Bake at once at 375° for 22 minutes. Sprinkle flavored powdered sugar frosting and nuts on top.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. diced apples
1/2  c. butter
2  c. white sugar
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. flour
3  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix the butter and sugar together, then add the beaten eggs and mix well.  Then add the flour to which the soda, salt and spices have been added.  Mix well.  Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan (greased) and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until it tests done.  Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

name: POLISH SAUSAGE
ingredients:
1  lb. Polish sausage, sliced
2  medium green peppers, chopped
2  medium onions, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  clove garlic
1  Tbsp. sugar
dash of salt, pepper and oregano
preparation: Brown  sausage, green pepper and onions.  Add tomatoes, sauce, garlic,  sugar,  salt and pepper.  Simmer 1/2 hour. Add oregano. Simmer another 1/2 hour. Serve over rice or noodles.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2/3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  Tbsp. light corn syrup
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. peanut butter
preparation: Combine sugar, syrup, milk and salt.  Cook to soft ball stage. Add vanilla and peanut butter; cool 5 minutes.  Stir until creamy.  Pour into buttered pan.  You can use nuts or crunchy peanut butter.

name: PINEAPPLE ZUCCHINI JAM
ingredients:
6  c. seeded, peeled and shredded zucchini
6  c. sugar
1/2  c. lemon juice
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1 large (6 oz.)  box strawberry Jell-O
preparation: Cook zucchini and sugar for 6 minutes.  Add pineapple and juice; cook 8 minutes.  Remove; add Jell-O.  Stir for 1 minute. Skim and put in jars.  Cool before covering.  Will be thin, but will thicken in refrigerator.  Freezes very well.  You can substitute any flavor of jello; orange works very well.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
3/4  lb. sirloin or flank steak, cut in strips
2  c. sliced mushrooms
1  medium onion
2  Tbsp. oil
1  can beef broth or cubes
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/3  c. tomato paste or catsup
1 1/2  c. Minute rice
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Brown meat (quickly) in  oil,  then  add  mushrooms and onion. Cook until onion is  tender, about 3 minutes.  Add the broth, Worcestershire, paprika and  tomato  paste and bring to boil. Stir in rice.  Cover and remove from heat.  Let stand 5 minutes and stir in sour cream.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. pecan pieces
2  regular ready made pie shells (not deep dish)
3  eggs
2  Tbsp. melted butter
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. Karo waffle syrup (green label)
preparation: Cover bottom of pie shells generously with pecan pieces. Measure all ingredients into large bowl.  Beat thoroughly and pour over nuts in pie shells.  Bake at 425° for 10 minutes and at 350° an additional 25 minutes.  Do not overbake!

name: DELICIOUS CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
6  whole chicken breasts, boned and skinned
12  slices American cheese
1  c. white wine (cooking wine)
margarine
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. Pepperidge Farm seasoned crumbs
preparation: Cut chicken breasts in two and place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Place a slice of cheese over each 1/2 breast.  Mix soup with wine and pour over chicken.  Smother chicken with crumbs.  Melt butter and drizzle over the top of the crumbs.  Bake, uncovered, for 2 hours at 325°.  Serves 12.

name: HEAVENLY CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/3  c. margarine
1 1/4  c. sugar
4 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  tsp. vanilla
4  eggs
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. plain flour
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling (optional)
preparation: In a bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs, margarine and 1/4 cup of the sugar.  Press on bottom and 2 1/2 inches up sides of 9-inch spring-form pan; set aside.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. bag frozen hash browns
1  small onion, chopped
2  cans potato soup
1  c. sour cream
1  c. Cheddar cheese
1  stick butter, melted in saucepan
preparation: Mix together soup and sour cream.  Layer hash browns, layer soup and sour cream until it runs out.  Top with cheese.

name: EASY REFRIGERATOR ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. active dry yeast
2  c. warm water
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. shortening
1  egg
2  tsp. salt
6 1/2 to 7  c. flour
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Add sugar, shortening, egg, salt and half the flour.  Beat until smooth.  Mix in remaining flour with a spoon.

name: TURKEY CRUNCH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. diced, cooked turkey
2  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1 (4 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms
3/4  c. diced celery
1/2  c. slivered, toasted almonds
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
1  can cream of chicken soup
3/4  c. mayonnaise
chow mein noodles
preparation: Mix together the first 6 ingredients.  Stir soup into mayonnaise; toss with turkey mixture.  Turn into 2-quart casserole.  Bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes, then sprinkle with noodles and bake another 15 minutes or until mixture is bubbling. Serves 6.

name: FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1  qt. boiling water
3  beef bouillon cubes and 3 chicken bouillon cubes or 3 cans beef broth and 2 cans chicken broth
1  c. white wine (Sauterne; may substitute other preferred wine)
6  slices French bread, toasted
6  slices Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
6  medium size onions, thinly sliced
preparation: Melt butter in a large soup pot; add onions and cook about 10 minutes.  Add boiling water in which cubes have been dissolved; cover and cook over low heat until onions are tender, 15 minutes to 1/2 hour.  Add dry white wine.  Pour soup into 6 earthenware soup dishes; place toast on top.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover with Mozzarella cheese slices.  Bake in moderately hot oven (425°) until cheese melts.

name: MIDWEST CHOWDER
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  c. flour
2  c. milk
10  oz. sharp cheddar cheese
2  c. water
2  c. diced potatoes
1/2  c. sliced carrots
1/2  c. diced celery
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
2  cans cream style corn
preparation: Melt margarine. Add flour and milk. Thicken to make sauce. Add cheese to create cheese sauce.

name: BROCCOLI GRAPE SALAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. broccoli florets
3/4  c. red seedless grapes, halved
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green onions
1/2  c. chopped water chestnuts
1/4  c. raisins
1/4  c. almonds, thinly sliced
1/2  c. plain nonfat yogurt
2  Tbsp. low-fat mayonnaise
1  tsp. honey
preparation: In a large bowl, combine broccoli, grapes, celery, onion, water chestnuts, raisins and almonds. Mix yogurt, mayonnaise and honey. Pour dressing over broccoli mixture and gently stir. Cover and refrigerate before serving. Yields 4 servings.

name: BROCCOLI, BACON CHEDDAR TOSS
ingredients:
3  c. broccoli flowerets
2  oz. shredded Cheddar (1/2 c.)
1/3  c. raisins
1/4  c. chopped red or Vidalia onion
1/2  c. Miracle Whip
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. lemon juice
8  slices cooked bacon (crispy), crumbled
preparation: Combine first four ingredients and next 3 ingredients in separate bowls.  Mix first bowl with second.  Toss.  Add bacon, crumbled, just a few minutes before serving.

name: PINEAPPLE DELIGHT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. 2-layer-size yellow cake mix
1 (3-3/4 or 3-5/8- oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (13-1/2 oz.)  can (1-2/3 cups) crushed pineapple, undrained
1 (2-oz).  pkg. dessert topping mix
preparation: Prepare and bake 2- or 9-inch layers from cake mix according to package directions; cool.  Stir pudding mix into crushed pineapple.  Prepare dessert topping according to package directions; fold in pineapple mixture.  Spread about 1-1/2 c. frosting on bottom cake layer; top with second layer.  Frost sides of cake lightly;  top cake with remaining frosting.  Garnish with halved pineapple slices and maraschino cherries.

name: FROZEN CHOCOLATE CHIP PIE
ingredients:
2  or 3 egg whites
1/2  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Sift sugar, salt and cream of tartar together.  Beat whites stiff, adding dry ingredients gradually while beating.  Fold in vanilla and chopped pecans and place in greased pie plate.  Bake at 300° for 1 hour.  Let cool.

name: BLUEBERRY BREAD
ingredients:
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
1  c. milk
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  large egg
1 1/2  c. blueberries
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Use a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  Grease with cooking spray.  Mix baking powder, salt, flour and sugar.  Reserve 1 tablespoon margarine for crumb topping.

name: CREAM OF POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
2  c. water
6 to 8  c. cubed potatoes
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
6  c. milk
4  chicken flavored bouillon cubes
1  tsp. white pepper
preparation: Cook potatoes  in  boiling  water until tender.  Remove from heat and set  aside.  Saute  onion	in  butter in a Dutch oven over low heat about  10  minutes  or  until  tender.  Add flour, stirring until smooth;  cook  1  minute,  stirring constantly. Gradually add milk	and  bouillon  cubes;  cook over medium heat, stirring  constantly, until mixture is thickened. Add  potatoes, cooking water  and	pepper.  Simmer  20  to  30 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Yield:  9 cups.

name: MARINATED VIDALIAS
ingredients:
2  medium Vidalia onions
1  c. water
1/4  c. white vinegar
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. mayonnaise
1  tsp. celery seed (optional)
lettuce leaves (optional)
preparation: Slice onions and separate into rings.  Combine water, sugar and vinegar until sugar dissolves.  Pour over rings.  Cover and chill at least 3 hours.  Drain well.  Stir in mayonnaise and celery seed.  Serve on lettuce leaves (or omit celery seed and lettuce and serve as a salad).

name: GUACAMOLE
ingredients:
1  large avocado
1  medium tomato, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
salt or garlic salt
1  Tbsp. red crushed pepper or 1 hot pepper
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Peel and chop the avocado. Add the tomato, onion and pepper. Mix well and add the lemon juice and salt to taste. Serve with Mexican food or eat with tortilla chips.

name: CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  qt. cranberries
2  c. sugar
1  lb. grapes, halved
24  marshmallows
1  c. nuts
1/2  pt. whipping cream
preparation: Grind cranberries, mix with sugar and let stand one hour. Drain and mix with grapes that have been halved, seeded and drained.  Cut marshmallows and nuts rather fine and blend all ingredients with whipped cream and chill.  Makes 15 or 16 servings.

name: CREAMY HORSERADISH SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. heavy cream
3  Tbsp. prepared horseradish
1  tsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Beat cream in a small bowl with mixer until soft peaks form. Fold in horseradish, sugar, salt and pepper.  Makes 1 1/2 cups. Refrigerate.

name: BROWN RICE
ingredients:
1  c. long grain rice (uncooked)
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/2  stick butter
1  can sliced mushrooms
2  cans consomme soup
preparation: Brown onion and rice in butter.  Add consomme and mushrooms. Cook in covered casserole in 400° oven for 1 hour.

name: PAYDAY BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. softened margarine
1  egg
1  box yellow cake mix
3  c. mini marshmallows
1/4  c. margarine
12  oz. peanut butter chips
2/3  c. white syrup
3  c. Rice Krispies
2  c. salted peanuts
preparation: Mix together and bake in 350° oven 15 to 20 minutes 1/2 cup margarine, egg and cake mix.  Remove from oven and spread marshmallows over cake.  Set aside.  In large saucepan, cook margarine, peanut butter chips and white syrup until chips are melted.  Remove from burner and add Rice Krispies and salted peanuts.  Stir mixture together and spread over marshmallows. Press down lightly.  Cool and cut.

name: SAUCY ASPARAGUS
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's new cream of asparagus soup
2  Tbsp. milk
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen asparagus cuts or 1 1/2 lb. fresh asparagus spears, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces (about 24 to 30)
preparation: In a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, combine soup and milk. Heat to boiling, stirring often.  Add asparagus.  Cover; cook over low heat 10 minutes or until asparagus is tender, stirring occasionally.  Serve with grated Parmesan cheese, if desired. Makes 8 servings.  Preparation time: 10 minutes.  Cook time:  15 minutes.

name: WILTED SPINACH
ingredients:
3  slices bacon
3  Tbsp. chopped onion
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. vinegar
3/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
dash of pepper
3/4  lb. shredded raw spinach (3 c. tightly packed)
1/2  c. chopped celery
preparation: Cut bacon in half-inch lengths with scissors and saute with the onion for 10 minutes.  Lift out bacon to crisp; blend flour into fat remaining in pan.  Add liquids gradually and cook over low heat until thickened.  Add seasonings, then the spinach and celery.  Toss lightly until vegetables are coated with the dressing and stand over low heat until just warm.  Sprinkle crumbled crisp bacon over the top.  Serve immediately.  Makes 4 servings.

name: ADELE'S FRUIT SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. dried prunes
1/4  lb. dried apricots
1  c. seedless raisins
1  c. tapioca (1/4 c. dry)
1  stick cinnamon
1  c. sugar
3  apples, sliced
1  lemon, thinly sliced
1  orange, thinly sliced
1/2  c. red sour pitted cherries
preparation: Soak fruit and tapioca overnight.  The next day cook all ingredients, except cherries, in 1/2 gallon of water for about 1/4 hour.  (Wine may be substituted for some of the water.)  Add cherries and cool.  Very good for breakfast or an evening snack.

name: CHRISTMAS PUNCH
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. red or green Jell-O
3 1/2  c. sugar
10  c. hot water
4 small  cans frozen lemonade
3  c. canned orange juice
2 (No. 2)  cans pineapple juice
1  qt. ginger ale, chilled
preparation: Dissolve gelatin  and sugar in hot water and cool.   Add juices.  Chill and add ginger ale just before serving.

name: BAKED GAME HENS WITH VEGETABLES
ingredients:
2  Cornish game hens (about 1 1/2 lb. each), thawed and split lengthwise
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. olive oil or salad oil
2  tsp. dry rosemary
1  clove garlic, minced or pressed
lemon wedges
4  shallots (small onions)
16  to 20 baby carrots, unpeeled
6  to 8 small red thin skinned potatoes, scrubbed and cut in 1/4-inch  thick slices
Italian parsley sprigs
preparation: Rinse hen halves and pat dry.  Place skin side up, down center of a shallow 10 x 15-inch baking dish.  Mix lemon juice, oil, rosemary and garlic and pour over hens.  Cut unpeeled shallots in half lengthwise.  Arrange shallots, cut side down, carrots and potatoes evenly around hens.  Bake in a 450° oven until vegetables are tender when pierced and meat near thigh bone is not pink, about 35 minutes.  Transfer hens and vegetables to a warm platter. Garnish with lemon wedges and parsley sprigs.

name: ITALIAN SPAGHETTI AND MEAT BALLS(This Recipe Came From An Italian Chef)
ingredients:
1  can tomatoes, sieved
1  can Italian tomato paste
1/4  tsp. soda
1  tsp. sugar
1/3  tsp. nutmeg
1/3  tsp. thyme
1/8  c. parsley
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. celery, chopped
1  clove garlic, chopped
preparation: Cook celery and garlic in a little shortening in skillet for 2 or 3 minutes.  Add to rest and cook 1 hour.

name: PICKLED BEETS
ingredients:
beets
2  c. vinegar
3  c. water
2 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. celery seed
3  whole mustard seed
3  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook beets; peel and slice.  Add to mixture, then boil for 10 minutes.

name: POPPY SEED DRESSING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. dry mustard
2  tsp. salt
2/3  c. apple cider vinegar
3  Tbsp. onion juice or 1 1/2 Tbsp. onion, chopped fine
2  c. salad oil
1  Tbsp. poppy seed
1  Tbsp. red food coloring (to suit)
preparation: Put the first 6 ingredients in blender. Add the salad oil slowly while blending. Beat until thick. Add poppy seed and food coloring. Beat until very thick. Store in refrigerator. Will keep in refrigerator a week or longer.

name: MARGARITAS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen limeade (do not dilute)
6  oz. tequila
6  oz. can beer
preparation: Put all in blender, add ice, blend and serve.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
8  oz. sour cream
3 medium  cans French cut green beans
2  Tbsp. flour
8  oz. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Melt butter in saucepan.  Blend in flour.  Add sour cream and cheese to butter and flour, blend until melted.  Mix with green beans and bake in a casserole dish for 30 to 45 minutes at 350°.

name: BANNOCK BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. shortening or oil
1/3 to 1/2  c. milk or water
small amount hot oil (for frying)
preparation: Mix ingredients to form a dough.  Pinch or spoon an egg-size portion of the dough.  Flatten to a 1-inch patty on a flour-dusted plate.  Fry to a golden brown, turning once or twice.  Great with beef stew cooked over an open fire.

name: DREAM WHIP DESSERT
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. 4x sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  envelopes Dream Whip
graham cracker crust
2  cans cherry pie filling
preparation: Cream sugar, cream cheese and vanilla; set aside.  Mix Dream Whip according to directions minus vanilla.  Combine cream cheese ingredients and Dream Whip.  Pour into a 9 x 12 x 2-inch graham cracker crust.  Top with pie filling.  Refrigerate.  Very rich dessert.

name: ITALIAN VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
2  c. water
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. sliced celery
2  cloves garlic, minced
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
5  tsp. beef bouillon granules
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. sweet basil
2  c. shredded cabbage
1/2  c. small elbow macaroni
Parmesan cheese
1  c. diced onion
1  c. sliced carrots
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (15 oz.)  can red kidney beans, undrained
1  ??? dried parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  c. green beans (fresh or frozen; 1-inch pieces)
preparation: Brown beef in large heavy kettle; drain.  Add all the ingredients except cabbage, green beans and macaroni.  Bring to boil.  Lower heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.  Add cabbage, green beans and macaroni.  Bring to boil and simmer until vegetables are tender.  If you prefer a thinner soup, add additional water or broth.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese before serving.

name: SPICED PEACH HALVES
ingredients:
2 large  cans peach halves (about 16)
1/2  tsp. whole cloves
3  sticks cinnamon
1/4  tsp. whole allspice
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Drain syrup and add spices and lemon juice.  Heat and add peach halves.  Allow to cool several hours.  Strain syrup and use peaches with meat or salad.  The unused syrup can be used with peach jello for dessert or salad.

name: CHINESE BARBECUE SAUCE/MARINADE
ingredients:
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. hoisin sauce (available in Big Shop 'N Save or Giant Eagle)
3  Tbsp. dry sherry
1/4  Tbsp. Accent
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Combine.  Will marinate approximately 3 to 4 pounds meat, chicken or tofu.  Great for shish kabobs.  Marinate several hours.

name: PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (1 lb.)  cans pineapple chunks, drained
2/3  c. sugar
5  tsp. flour
1 1/3  c. grated sharp cheese
1  pack Ritz crackers, crumbled
1/2  c. butter, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In lightly greased casserole dish, place drained pineapple chunks.  In small bowl, mix together sugar and flour and sprinkle over pineapple.  Layer grated cheese over, then cracker crumbs.  Pour melted butter over all.  Bake for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: BABE RUTH BARS
ingredients:
1  c. white Karo syrup
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. Spanish peanuts
6  c. corn flakes
5  or 6 regular-size Hershey bars
preparation: Bring syrup and sugars just to a boil.  Add peanut butter and mix.  Stir in peanuts and cereal.

name: CRUNCHY PEA SALAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, thawed
1  c. cauliflower flowerets
1  c. celery, finely chopped
1/4  c. green onions, sliced
1/2  c. salad dressing or mayonnaise
1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. pecans, coarsely chopped
3  slices bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
preparation: In mixing bowl, combine peas, cauliflower, celery and onions. In small mixing bowl, blend salad dressing (or mayonnaise) with sour cream.  Pour over vegetable mixture; toss to coat.  Stir in pecans; sprinkle bacon on top.  Refrigerate.

name: FREEZER ICE CREAM (UNCOOKED)
ingredients:
3  eggs
2 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2 tall  cans evaporated milk
1/2  gal. homogenized milk
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs until light; beat in sugar and salt.	Stir in evaporated	milk,  homogenized  milk  and  vanilla.  Pour into gallon-size  ice  cream  freezer  canister.  Pack freezer with crushed ice  and  1/8  part ice cream salt.  Turn hand freezer until hard	or  use electric freezer.  Recipe may be varied by adding  crushed fruit before freezing or toppings may be used. If I  use  sweetened  fruit, I just use 2 cups of sugar and do not use the vanilla.

name: 1-2-3-4 CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. crisco
2  c. sugar
3  c. flour
4  eggs
1  c. milk
1  tsp. each of vanilla and lemon flavoring
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Put all ingredients in mixing bowl and beat thoroughly.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN IN HERB SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. celery
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. snipped chives
3/4  tsp. dried rosemary, crushed
1/4  tsp. dried chervil, crushed
1/4  tsp. dried tarragon, crushed
1  c. milk
1  c. chicken broth
2  c. cubed, cooked chicken
preparation: Cook celery in butter until tender, about 10 minutes.  Stir in flour, chives, rosemary, chervil and tarragon.  Add milk and chicken broth.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.  Stir in chicken.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Heat through. Serve on toast.  Serves 4.

name: PINK SALAD
ingredients:
16  oz. cottage cheese
8  oz. Cool Whip, softened
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
16  oz. can fruit cocktail
preparation: Drain  fruit  cocktail and put in bowl.  Discard juice. Dissolve dry jello in fruit cocktail.  Stir in cottage cheese. Stir in Cool Whip and refrigerate around 30 minutes.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1  can creamed corn
1  c. milk
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. melted butter
preparation: Mix all ingredients and cook at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: HOT CRANBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
2  c. cranberry juice
1  c. water
2  c. unsweetened pineapple juice
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. whole cloves
2  tsp. whole allspice
2  sticks cinnamon
preparation: Mix all juices together with sugar and water. Pour over spices in percolator basket and brew at medium temperature.

name: BEEF AND BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1  lb. beef top round steak
1 1/2  c. broccoli, cut up
3  medium carrots
1  tsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. dry sherry
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  medium onion, cut in thin wedges
1/2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas
1/2  c. water chestnuts
1/2  c. bamboo shoots
hot cooked rice
preparation: Slice beef into bite-sized strips.  Cook broccoli and carrots in boiling salted water, covered, for 2 minutes.  Mix cornstarch, salt, sugar, soy sauce and sherry.  Set aside.  Stir-fry broccoli, carrots and onions in hot oil for 2 minutes.  Remove from wok. Add 1/2 the beef to wok; fry for 2 minutes.  Remove beef; stir-fry remaining beef.  Return all beef to wok.  Add peas, water chestnuts and bamboo shoots.  Add soy mixture to wok.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.  Return broccoli, carrots and onion to wok; cover and cook 1 minute.  Serve over hot cooked rice.

name: ROASTED CORN BLACK BEAN AND MANGO SALAD
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  garlic cloves, minced
3  c. fresh corn kernel (about 6 ears)
2  c. diced, peeled ripe mango (about 2 lb.)
1  c. chopped red onion
1  c. chopped red bell pepper
1/3  c. fresh lime juice
3  Tbsp. chopped fresh cilantro
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground cumin
1  drained canned chipotle chile (in adobe sauce), chopped
8  c. gourmet salad greens
preparation: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic; cook 30 seconds.  Stir in corn; cook 8 minutes or until browned, stirring occasionally.  Place corn mixture in a large bowl.  Add mango and remaining ingredients except greens; stir well.  Arrange 1 cup greens on each of 8 plates.  Spoon 1 cup corn mixture over greens.

name: POTATO WEDGES
ingredients:
8  large unpeeled potatoes
1/2  c. oil
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cut potatoes into wedges and arrange, peel side down, in baking dish.  Mix ingredients and brush over potatoes.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until tender.  Brush occasionally with oil mixture.

name: SWISS VEGETABLE MEDLEY
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) bag frozen broccoli, carrots and cauliflower combo, thawed and drained
