1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese
1/3  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  can Durkee French fried onions
preparation: Combine  veggies,  soup,  1/2  cup  cheese, sour cream, pepper and  1/2 can French fried onions.  Pour into a 1 quart casserole. Bake,  covered,  at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese  and  onions;  bake,  uncovered,  5  minutes longer.  Makes 6 servings.

name: Date Bars
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. oatmeal
1 1/4  c. flour
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. soda
1  c. butter
1/2  c. water
1  pkg. dates
1  c. white sugar (could use less)
preparation: Add 1/2 cup nuts and spread on crumb mixture; spread the rest of crumbs on top.  Bake at 350° for about 1/2 hour.

name: TUNA CRAB SALAD MOLD
ingredients:
1  can white meat tuna
1  can crab meat
1/4  c. cold water
1  pkg. unflavored gelatin
2  chopped, hard-boiled eggs
1/4  c. stuffed olives, chopped
1  Tbsp. chopped chives or green onion
1 1/4  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Mix gelatin in cold water.  Heat over hot water and mix with mayonnaise.  Mix with other ingredients and put in mold.  Chill.

name: SAUSAGE BALLS(Club Member: Brigitte Magee)
ingredients:
3  c. Bisquick
1  lb. (hot or mild) sausage
10  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix all with fingers and roll into small balls. Put about 1 inch apart. Bake on cookie sheet at 375° for 10 minutes.

name: SPINACH VEGETABLE DIP
ingredients:
3  c. scallions
24  oz. sour cream
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped spinach
Knorr vegetable soup mix
preparation: Cook spinach as directed on package. Drain spinach well and squeeze out excess water.  Mix with sour cream and soup mix by hand. Add the scallions, cut small.  Mix.  Refrigerate overnight. Serve as a dip for raw vegetables (cucumbers, celery, carrots, broccoli).

name: BROCCOLI BAKE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. broccoli spears
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
6  slices tomato
2  Tbsp. margarine
1 (11 oz.)  can condensed cheese soup
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Cook broccoli until almost tender; drain and arrange in a 10 x 6-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Place tomatoes along outside edge.  Dot with butter.  Blend soup and lemon juice in a bowl until smooth.  Pour along center of casserole.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until hot and bubbly.

name: BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. flour
dash of salt
1  medium egg
3  egg yolks
3  egg whites
1/4  c. sugar
vanilla wafers
5  to 6 bananas
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Stir in all ingredients except milk until moist and smooth, then add milk.  On medium heat, cook until thick and boiling.  In large bowl, put in alternating layers of vanilla wafers and bananas and pudding.

name: CHRISTMAS GLOW PUNCH
ingredients:
2 (46 oz.)  cans low sugar Hawaiian Punch, chilled
2  c. unsweetened pineapple juice, chilled
2  c. low calorie cranberry juice cocktail, chilled
2/3  c. lemon juice
1 (32 oz.)  bottle club soda, chilled
lemon or lime slices (optional)
preparation: In large punch bowl, combine punch, pineapple juice and cranberry juice cocktail.  Slowly stir club soda.  Add ice cubes. Garnish with lemon or lime slices, if desired.  Makes 5 quarts or 38 (4 ounce) servings.

name: HOMEMADE DOG BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. whole-wheat flour
1  c. cornmeal
2/3  c. Brewer's yeast
2  tsp. garlic powder
2  egg yolks
3 bouillon cubes, dissolved in 1 1/2  c. boiling chicken broth or water
preparation: Mix all ingredients in large bowl.  Roll out half of dough at a time into 3/8-inch thickness.  Using a pizza cutter, cut in desired shapes and sizes.  Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet for 20 minutes at 375°.  Turn off oven and leave biscuits in oven until cool.  Place in airtight container.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage, browned, drained, cooled and crumbled
6  eggs
2  c. milk
6  slices bread, crusts cut off and cubed
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. mustard
1  c. Cheddar cheese, cubed
preparation: Mix all ingredients. Pour in 9 x 9-inch dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes. May be made the night before and kept in refrigerator before baking and serving. Makes a complete breakfast.

name: ONE-BOWL CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
3/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. sugar
3/4  c. vegetable oil
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda, sifted
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  lb. carrots, peeled and coarsely grated
1  c. walnut pieces
preparation: In a mixing bowl with a sturdy whisk, beat the eggs with the sugar until thick.  Slowly add the oil in a steady stream, mixing constantly.  Mix in the vanilla.  Measure the flour in a 2-cup measuring cup and mix in the salt, baking soda and cinnamon.  With a mixing whisk, mix into the liquid ingredients until smooth. Stir in the carrots and walnuts until thoroughly combined.  Pour into a greased and floured 9-inch layer or square pan and bake in a preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes or until a tester inserted in center comes out with a crumb clinging to it.  Cool pan on rack 10 minutes; then remove from pan.  Cool completely.

name: FABULOUS POTATOES
ingredients:
1  bag frozen hash browns (not shredded), thawed
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. melted margarine
8  oz. sour cream
8  oz. Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. chopped onion
salt and pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: ARROZ CON POLLO (YELLOW RICE AND CHICKEN)
ingredients:
1  fryer chicken, cut up
1  onion
2  garlic cloves
1  bay leaf
1  envelope Virgo flavoring and coloring
1 (4 oz.)  jar pimientos
6  oz. olive oil
1 small  can peas
2  Tbsp. salt
1  diced fresh tomato
1/2  green pepper, diced
1  lb. long grain rice
1  qt. water
preparation: Fry chicken in 3 ounces olive oil, until brown.  Set aside.  In a large saucepan, saute onion, garlic and green pepper in 3 ounces olive oil.  Add tomato and simmer until soft.  Add water, flavoring packet, bay leaf and salt; stir well.  Add chicken and bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 10 minutes.  Bring to a boil again, add rice and return to a boil.  Stir once, cover tightly and simmer on low heat, 25 to 30 minutes.  Do not remove cover.  When done, garnish with peas and pimientos.

name: VICTORY GARDEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can lima beans
1  lb. potatoes, sliced
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. thyme
3  c. shredded Cheddar
1/2  lb. carrots, peeled and sliced
1/2  lb. green beans, sliced, or canned
10  oz. fresh or frozen peas
2  c. milk
1/4  c. unsifted flour
3/4  c. unseasoned bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Lightly grease a 3 or 4-quart casserole.  Drain all canned vegetables or, if using fresh, pre-cook until almost tender.

name: UNCOOKED COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. milk
1/4  stick oleo
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
1/2 to 1  c. peanut butter
3  c. oats
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients and bring to rolling boil. Let boil for 1 minute, then add remaining ingredients and mix. Spoon onto waxed paper.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/3  c. melted oleo
1 small  jar Cheese Whiz
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, cooked
1  c. rice, cooked
1/2  c. celery
1  small onion, diced and sauteed
preparation: Mix all ingredients together, place in casserole dish.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
2 small  boxes or 1 large lemon Jell-O
3  c. boiling water
8  oz. Philadelphia cream cheese
1  can pineapple
1  c. diced celery
1  c. Cool Whip, thawed
preparation: Mix Jell-O and water.  Beat cream cheese; add a little of the hot mixture and beat well.  Add Cool Whip and beat.  Add to Jell-O.  Add celery and pineapple.  Chill until set.   Chopped nuts may be added or sprinkled on top.

name: SPICY CHICKEN PIZZA
ingredients:
12  oz. boneless chicken breast *
1/2  c. sliced green onion
2  cloves minced garlic
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
1/2  tsp. crushed red pepper
1/4  tsp. ground red pepper
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
16  oz. Boboli crust
1/2  c. Monterey Jack cheese
1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese
2  Tbsp. pine nuts (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Rinse chicken and pat dry.  Cut chicken into 1/2-inch pieces.

name: ORANGE JULIUS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice, thawed
1  c. milk
1  c. water
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
10  to 12 ice cubes
preparation: Blend all ingredients in blender until smooth.  Drink.

name: PERFECT PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1/2  best pie pastry
4  eggs
6  Tbsp. butter
3/4  c. dark corn syrup
3/4  c. dark brown sugar
1  Tbsp. molasses
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  tsp. fresh ground nutmeg
3/4  c. halved pecans (whole pieces)
preparation: Make the best pie pastry recipe. Halve recipe to make one pie pastry. Heat oven to 375°. On a lightly floured work surface, roll out the dough and fit pastry into 9-inch pie pan and flute or crimp the edges.

name: SQUASHED TATERS
ingredients:
yellow squash, sliced
potatoes, sliced
onions, sliced
oil and bacon drippings
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In a large skillet, put oil and bacon drippings.  Place a layer of squash, a layer of potatoes and a layer of onions. Repeat as often as needed until you have the amount you want. Season between layers and fry on low heat until done.

name: SAUSAGE ROUNDS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey
1  lb. ground turkey sausage
8  oz. low-fat Cheddar cheese
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 (8 oz.)  can mushrooms
1  party loaf pumpernickel bread
preparation: Brown meats.  Add cheese and cook until it melts.  Add seasonings and mushrooms; mix thoroughly.  Spread on slices of party bread.  Place on a baking sheet and broil until bubbly and browned.  May be frozen after they are broiled.  Makes 15 slices; 289 calories per slice.

name: SPECIAL PUNCH
ingredients:
6  eggs
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  qt. orange juice, chilled
1  qt. pineapple juice, chilled
1  qt. ginger ale, chilled
orange sherbet
preparation: Combine eggs, sugar and cinnamon in a blender container and process at a high speed for 1 minute.  Pour chilled juices and ginger ale into a 4-quart punch bowl.  Add egg spice mixture, stirring slowly. If desired, place scoops of sherbet on top of punch. Makes 12 (1 cup) servings.

name: TOMATO JACK
ingredients:
14  oz. diced green chile
4  tomatoes, chopped
24  oz. ripe olives, diced
1 1/2  c. green onions, diced
2  tsp. olive oil
garlic salt to taste
preparation: Mix together well.  Let flavors blend for one hour.  Serve chilled with crackers or chips.

name: RAISED DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
1  c. mashed potatoes
2  pkg. dry yeast
1 1/2  c. warm water
1 1/2  tsp. salt
hot oil for frying
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, well beaten
2/3  c. soft shortening
5 1/2 to 7  c. sifted flour
preparation: Mix well mashed potatoes, yeast, warm water, salt and sugar. Let stand for 20 minutes.  Add well beaten eggs and shortening to first mixture and beat well.  Add flour enough to handle easily. Knead.  Let rise double in bulk.  Roll out on floured board.  Cut out doughnuts.  Let rise double again.  Fry in hot oil.  Drain on rack or paper towels.  Sugar or glaze while still warm.

name: SAND COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  lb margarine
1  1/3 c sugar
3  c flour
1/2  c wheat germ
1  tsp baking soda
1  tsp vanilla
nutmeats
preparation: Cream sugar and margarine, beat in remaining ingredients. Make into 3 rolls and place into refrigerator overnight. (May be kept in freezer.)  Slice 1/4 inch thick and bake at 350 degrees approximately 10 minutes.

name: GREEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
4  average tomatoes, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  small bag Doritos, crumbled (or taco shells)
1 (8 oz.)  jar Thousand Island dressing
1  lb. ground beef
1  can drained kidney beans
preparation: Simmer meat and beans 10 minutes until meat is a gray color. Cool mixture and add tomatoes, onion and cheese.  Tear lettuce in bite size pieces.  Toss with meat mixture and chill for 1 hour. When ready to serve, toss with salad dressing and crumble Doritos on top.

name: GARLIC PECANS
ingredients:
1  lb. pecans (use fresh pecans)
1/4  stick melted butter or margarine
preparation: Roast in shallow pan at 300° for approximately 15 to 20 minutes.  Stir until coated with butter.  Salt to taste.

name: GINNY'S POPOVERS
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. flour
1  c. milk
dash of salt
preparation: Beat all together.  Put into well-greased muffin tins in cold oven.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  box strawberry gelatin
2  c. boiling water
1  c. sugar
4  c. cold water
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1  (46 oz.) pineapple juice
2  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Add sugar; stir until sugar dissolves.  Add cold water and lemonade.  Mix well.  Pour in pineapple juice.  Freeze punch mixture in a gallon container until slushy.  Add ginger ale when ready to serve.

name: HASH BROWN BAKE
ingredients:
1  tsp. butter or margarine
3  large potatoes (about 1 1/2 lbs.)
2  green onions, thinly sliced
1  c. (4 oz.) grated Swiss cheese
1  tsp. dried, minced garlic
1  large egg, slightly beaten
1  c. sour cream
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease sides and bottom of a 9 inch round or square casserole dish with 1 tsp. butter.  Set aside.  One at a time, peel potatoes, grate coarsely and place in a bowl of cold water until all potatoes have been grated.  Drain potatoes, squeezing out water.  Transfer to mixing bowl; add onions, cheese, garlic, egg, sour cream, butter, salt and pepper.  Mix well.  Spoon mixture into prepared pan.  Pat corners with spoon.  Bake for 1 hour.

name: TOMATO PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. crescent rolls
4  ripe tomatoes
salt and pepper
1  large chopped onion
1  chopped green pepper
4  or 5 chopped mushrooms
3/4  c. mayo
2  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Grease or spray 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam.  Line pan with rolls to make crust.  Peel and slice tomatoes.  Place on crust.  Add salt and pepper.  Saute onion, pepper and mushrooms in oil until tender.  Pour over tomatoes.  Mix mayo and cheese and put on top. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: JELLO SHOTS
ingredients:
1  box Jell-O (any flavor)
3/4  c. liquor (any kind)
preparation: Make Jell-O as directions on box, then add 1/2 cup of cold water and 3/4 cup of liquor.  Mix well together; pour into 1 or 2 ounce Dixie cups.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: SALISICCIG, ALLA RIGATONI
ingredients:
1  lb. Italian sausage
1  c. chopped onion
2  cloves garlic, minced
1 large  can tomatoes
1  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1  pkg. rigatoni
preparation: Remove sausage from casing; brown with onion and garlic.  Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, salt, oil and parsley.  Bring to a boil and simmer, uncovered, 15 minutes.	Cook rigatoni as directed. Serve with sauce.

name: BEEF MARINADE
ingredients:
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/4  c. wine vinegar
1/4  c. pineapple juice
1/4  c. light brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Add meat (either poultry or beef). Cover and refrigerate 6 to 8 hours.

name: BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
9 to 12  slices bread
2  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  lb. sausage
12  to 18 eggs
preparation: Spray a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish with Pam.  Cut ends off bread.  Use as many slices as it takes to cover bottom of casserole dish (can go up the sides).  Place bread very close together in bottom of dish.  Crumble uncooked sausage over bread.  Sprinkle cheese over sausage.  Beat eggs and pour over cheese.  Cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate overnight.  In morning, uncover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until eggs are done in center of dish.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  c. diced zucchini
1  large bell pepper, chopped fine
1  large onion
1  c. bread crumbs
1  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. oil
1  Tbsp. fresh or fried basil
3  large eggs or Egg Beaters, beaten
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Stir with eggs and salt to taste. Bake 40 minutes at 350°.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: HOT BROCCOLI DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1  roll Kraft Cheddar-garlic cheese
1 (4 oz.)  can mushroom stems and pieces, drained
1  can mushroom soup (undiluted)
1/4  large onion, chopped
2  to 3 celery stalks, chopped
dash of Tabasco sauce
preparation: Saute onion, celery and mushrooms in butter.  Melt cheese in top of double boiler.  Add everything and heat thoroughly.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. peanut butter
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs, lightly beaten
2 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
preparation: Cream shortening, peanut butter and sugar until smooth.  Add eggs, then flour sifted with soda.   Roll into small balls. Place on cookie sheet and, with a wet fork, flatten in a crisscross design.  Bake at 400° for about 10 minutes.   Yields 4 dozen.

name: MOIST POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. cake flour
5  eggs
2 3/4  c. sugar
2  sticks margarine, whipped
1  c. shortening
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. milk
preparation: Cream shortening, butter and sugar adding eggs one at a time, beating well after each.  Add flour and milk; beat until very creamy.  Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: STRAWBERRY AND FIG JELLY
ingredients:
3  c. fresh figs, cut in half
3  c. sugar
2 small  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
preparation: Put all ingredients into a pan and bring to boil. Cook for 4 minutes. Put in small canning jars. Great gift to give at the holidays. Good on toast, biscuits or with cream cheese.

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
7  medium potatoes, cooked, sliced and chopped (7 c.)
3  hard-cooked eggs
1/4  c. finely chopped sweet pickles (or pickle relish)
chopped onions (amount desired)
chopped green peppers (amount desired)
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. sweet pickle juice
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. celery seed
1/8  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: In a large bowl combine potatoes, eggs, pickles, onions and green peppers.  Stir together mayonnaise, pickle juice, salt, pepper, celery seed and garlic salt.  Gently fold together both mixtures and chill.  Garnish with additional egg slices, if desired.

name: GRILLED CHICKEN ORIENTAL
ingredients:
1/4  c. soy sauce or teriyaki sauce
2  Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. honey, divided
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. Chinese sesame oil
1-inch piece ginger root, pared and mashed
1  small garlic clove, mashed
4  chicken cutlets (1/4 lb. each)
preparation: In 1/2-cup metal measure or other small flameproof container, combine soy sauce with 2 tablespoons honey, oil, ginger and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until mixture is warm, about 1 minute. Transfer to self-sealing plastic bag or medium bowl (not aluminum). Add chicken and turn to coat with marinade. Seal bag or cover bowl and let stand 10 minutes to marinate.

name: FROZEN CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can seedless tart Bing cherries, drained
1 (16 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  1/2 bananas, sliced (cover with juice of 1 lemon)
2  c. sour cream
1  c. sugar
preparation: Stir all together. May add nuts if desired. Spread into a 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze. Remove 15 to 20 minutes before serving to soften slightly. Slice and serve on lettuce. May freeze in individual muffin cups.

name: STRAWBERRY CREAM SQUARES
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. strawberry gelatin
2  c. boiling water
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. pecans, broken small
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Dissolve strawberry gelatin in hot water. Add frozen strawberries. Let stand until strawberries soften. Add pineapple (with juice). Add pecans; mix well. Pour half of mixture into Pyrex dish. Chill until firm. Spoon sour cream over firm gelatin; spread evenly. Pour remaining gelatin mixture over sour cream. Chill until firm. Cut into squares before serving.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
1  can pork and beans
1  Tbsp. chopped fine onion
1  Tbsp. yellow mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. sorghum (if you have)
2 or 3  Tbsp. tomato ketchup
preparation: Cook in oven 45 minutes at 325° to 350° or until thick.  You can double for larger dish.

name: CHEESE BALLS
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
8  oz. sharp cheese
2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. cyapepper
2  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Melt butter and sharp cheese.  Add flour, cyapepper and Rice Krispies.  Roll into balls and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN SPREAD
ingredients:
2  cans white chicken (Hormel)
1 small  jar Hellmann's mayonnaise (8-oz.)
3  Tbsp. sweet pickle relish
2  chopped green onions
1  pkg. almonds
Dash of salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Spread on bread.  Makes 1 1/2 loaves.

name: GREEN PEPPER PICKLES
ingredients:
fresh firm green bell peppers
4  c. vinegar
1  c. water
salt
preparation: Wash peppers.  Stem and cut into lengthwise strips, discarding seeds.  Mix 4 cups vinegar and 1 cup water.  Pack pepper strips into jars, cover with vinegar mixture, add 1 tablespoon salt to each jar and put on lid tightly.  Invert for 1 hour; then store. Ready for use in 3 months.  Keeps unopened and unrefrigerated for more than 2 years.

name: RICE AND BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1 1/2  sticks butter
1  box frozen chopped broccoli
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. Cheez Whiz
1/2  c. milk
1 1/2 to 2  c. cooked rice or 1 small box Minute rice
preparation: Fry butter, broccoli and onion in skillet, slowly, 10 to 15 minutes.  Add soup, Cheez Whiz and milk; mix well.  Mix in rice; simmer or bake.  Serves 12.  Great for covered dish dinners.

name: MANICOTTI
ingredients:
8  manicotti (about 1/4 lb.)
2  c. (1 lb.) cottage cheese
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. finely chopped parsley
1/2  lb. ground beef
1/3  c. chopped onion
2 medium  cloves garlic, minced
1  tsp. basil
1  tsp. oregano
2  cans tomato soup
1/2  c. water
2  slices Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cook manicotti noodles until tender; drain.  Combine cottage cheese, egg, Parmesan cheese and parsley.  Fill manicotti. Arrange manicotti in shallow baking dish (12 x 8 x 2-inch).

name: FOOD FOR THE GODS
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. butter (2 sticks)
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
dash of salt
2  eggs
1  lb. chopped dates
1  c. walnuts
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter.  Add sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing until smooth.  Fold in flour, then beat again.  Add vanilla.  Fold in walnuts and chopped dates until smooth.  Pour in greased pan; spread evenly.  Lastly, sprinkle/spread a little brown sugar on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.  Cool and remove from pan.

name: SLOPPY JOES
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped onion
2  c. barbecue sauce
2  c. water
1  c. 3-Minute Brand oats
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine beef, green pepper, celery and onion in skillet; cook until meat is browned.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer 35 minutes.  Serve hot on buns.

name: FUDGE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. melted butter or margarine
5  c. sugar
1  can evaporated milk
8  oz. jar marshmallow cream
24  oz. chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla
nuts (optional)
preparation: Boil butter, sugar and milk for 11 minutes.  Add marshmallow cream, chocolate chips, vanilla and nuts.  Beat until stiff. Spread in buttered jelly roll pan.  Cool for several hours. Yield: 5 pounds.  Very good!

name: ELIZABETH'S DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. mayonnaise
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1 small  can deviled ham
1/2  c. parsley (fresh or flaked)
1/2 garlic  clove or dash of garlic powder
preparation: Blend cream cheese and mayonnaise; mix the other ingredients, blend well.  Refrigerate one hour before serving.  Serve with fresh vegetables and/or crackers.

name: CHICKEN STIR-FRY
ingredients:
2  to 3 green peppers, sliced
3/4  c. soy sauce (Chun King)
2  onions, cut into rings and separated
chicken (already cut in pieces)
preparation: Cook chicken in water.  Boil until done.  Pull chicken off the bone; tear the chicken up.  Place in cold saucepan.  Add peppers and onions; add soy sauce.  Cook until peppers and onions are done, usually about 20 to 25 minutes, over medium heat.  Goes good with rice.

name: RHUBARB MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. diced rhubarb
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. oil
1  egg
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix brown sugar, oil, egg, vanilla and buttermilk in large bowl.   Stir in rhubarb, nuts and vanilla.  In another bowl combine flour, soda, baking powder and salt, then add to rhubarb mixture.  Spoon batter into muffin pan.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. chopped apples
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. flour
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix sugar with apples.  Let stand until sugar dissolves.  Add eggs and beat well. Sift dry ingredients together.  Stir into apple mixture.  Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.  While cake bakes, make sauce.  Pour over cake as soon as cake comes from oven.

name: CHEESE FRENCH BREAD
ingredients:
1  loaf French bread
2  or 3 scallions, sliced
1  c. mayonnaise
2  c. Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. sour cream
1/2  tsp. season salt
preparation: Cut bread lengthwise in half.  Mix all ingredients together. Spread on both halves of bread.  Bake in 200° oven for 20 minutes or until browned.  Slice and serve.

name: BRUNSWICK STEW
ingredients:
4  c. chicken broth
3  medium potatoes, peeled and diced
2  c. corn
1  strip bacon or salt pork
salt and pepper to taste
2  c. cooked chicken, diced
1  c. tomatoes
2  c. lima beans
1  medium onion, chopped
1  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients and simmer until vegetables are tender, 1 to 2 hours.

name: SEAFOOD LEG SALAD
ingredients:
6  seafood legs, cut diagonally
2  c. shell macaroni or rotini
4  c. water
1  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. oil
2/3  c. salad dressing
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. Thousand Island dressing
1  c. celery, diced
1  c. frozen peas (optional)
onion (optional)
preparation: Cook macaroni until tender (8 to 10 minutes) in water, salt and oil; drain and cool.  Mix with remaining ingredients and chill.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1/4  c. green pepper
2  Tbsp. pimento
1/4  c. onion
1  tsp. lemon juice
dash of garlic salt
dash of ground red pepper
chopped pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients (except pecans) and shape into one or two balls.  Roll in chopped pecans.

name: APRICOT DELIGHT(Salad or Dessert)
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. apricot jello
2/3  c. sugar
2/3  c. water
2  jars junior apricot baby food
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: In saucepan, combine sugar, water and jello.  Boil 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly.  Put in freezer to cool.  When cool, add baby food and pineapple.

name: HOT TAMALE BALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. ground pork
1 1/2  c. cornmeal
1/4  c. flour
3/4  c. tomatoes, mashed
3  Tbsp. chili powder
5  medium garlic cloves
2  Tbsp. salt
2 large  cans tomato juice
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix together ground meats, cornmeal, flour, tomatoes, chili powder, garlic and 2 tablespoons salt.  Form mixture into small balls the size of a large marble.  In a large roaster, pour in tomato juice and remaining salt.  Let simmer for 10 minutes.  Drop in tamale balls and let cook for 2 hours. Check sauce during cooking and add tomato juice or water, if needed.  Remove balls from sauce and serve.  Makes about 100 balls.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1 small  jar Marshmallow Fluff
preparation: Mix with electric mixer.

name: Mary's Cornbread Veggie Pie
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen veggies, chopped
8  oz. shredded Cheddar or a mixture of cheeses
1 large egg + 1/4  c. Egg Beaters or 2 egg whites
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  pkg. corn muffin mix
1/4  tsp. onion powder
1 1/2  c. milk (dry or low-fat)
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook and drain veggies.  Press evenly in bottom of a 10-inch quiche pan.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Mix remaining ingredients except for Parmesan cheese.  Beat until well combined.  Pour into quiche dish.  Sprinkle with Parmesan.  Bake at 350° until knife tests done, 30 minutes.

name: CUCUMBER SALAD
ingredients:
1  or 2 cucumbers, sliced
1  red onion, sliced into rings
salt to taste
pepper to taste
1  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. (about) sour cream
preparation: Combine crackers, onion rings and salt in bowl.  Chill, covered, for 45 minutes to 1 hour; drain.  Add pepper, vinegar and sour cream, stirring to coat.  Chill for several hours or longer to enhance flavor.  Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CEREAL CANDY
ingredients:
3  c. Rice Krispies cereal
1  c. salted peanuts
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix cereal and peanuts; set aside.  Combine sugar and syrup in heavy pot; cook on medium-low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a full rolling boil.  Remove from heat.  Stir in peanut butter and vanilla.  Immediately pour syrup over cereal mixture, stirring gently to coat.  Pat evenly into buttered pan. Cool.  Cut into 2-inch bars.

name: BANANA-OATMEAL BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. mashed bananas (3)
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. melted margarine
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  beaten eggs
1 1/2  c. oatmeal
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix together in order given.  Place in greased loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: GROUND BEEF CHOP SUEY
ingredients:
2  c. celery, cut in 1-inch strips
1/2  c. sliced onion
1  lb. ground beef
1  Tbsp. fat or oil
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 1/2  c. water
1  beef bouillon cube
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
4  c. chopped cabbage
4  c. cooked rice (about 1 1/3 c. uncooked)
preparation: Cook celery, onion and ground beef in hot fat in large frypan for about 5 minutes, until meat begins to brown.  Blend cornstarch with water; stir into beef mixture.  Add bouillon cube, soy sauce and salt.  Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce is thickened and clear.  Stir in cabbage.  Cook, covered, for about 3 minutes, until cabbage is tender but still firm.  Serve on rice.  Provides 6 servings, 3/4 cup chop suey and 2/3 cup rice each.

name: OVERNIGHT LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1  c. green pepper, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  (10 oz.) bag frozen peas
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  c. mayonnaise
8  slices bacon, fried and crumbled
(4 oz.) Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Layer vegetables in oblong 9 X 13 dish.  Lettuce must be dry (can be shaken in bag with paper towel to dry).  Spread mayonnaise and sugar mixture over top.  Sprinkle with cheese and bacon. Cover; refrigerate overnight.

name: RUSSIAN CREAM(Serves 6)
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
1  c. whipping cream
1 1/2  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
sliced strawberries or blueberries for garnish
preparation: Combine sugar, water and gelatin in small saucepan and blend well.  Let stand 4 to 5 minutes.  Place over medium heat and bring to boil, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Gradually blend in cream.  Combine sour cream and vanilla in medium bowl. Gradually add hot sugar mixture, whisking constantly until smooth. Pour into 6 wine glasses or dessert dishes.  Cover and refrigerate 4 to 6 hours.  Garnish with sliced strawberries or blueberries.

name: SUMMER SAUSAGE
ingredients:
5  lb. ground beef
4  Tbsp. Tender Quick curing salt
1 1/2  Tbsp. mustard seed
2 1/2  tsp. black pepper
2  Tbsp. garlic salt
preparation: Mix well and put in covered bowl in refrigerator for 4 to 5 days.  Form into rolls and bake 4 to 6 hours (175° or 200°).

name: "STAINED GLASS" PAINTBRUSH COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening (part butter)
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
2 2/3  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Cream together shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Sift dry ingredients together and add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream.  Divide dough and roll out to 1/4-inch thickness on well floured pastry cloth.  Cut with cookie cutters and place on a greased cookie sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400°, until lightly browned.  Makes 4 to 5 dozen 2-inch cookies.

name: POTATO CHEESE CHOWDER
ingredients:
1/2  c. sliced carrots
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  c. peeled and cubed potatoes
3/4  c. cold water
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz cheese spread
preparation: Place all ingredients except processed cheese spread in 2-quart glass casserole.  Microwave covered on High 10 to 12 minutes or until vegetables are tender.  Stir in Cheez Whiz until melted.  Microwave uncovered on High, stirring every 2 to 3 minutes until desired consistency.

name: REUBEN SANDWICH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans corned beef
1 large  can sauerkraut, rinsed
several tomatoes, sliced thin (you can use well-drained canned tomatoes)
1 (8 oz.)  jar Thousand Island dressing
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated or shredded
rye bread, crumbled or cubed
preparation: In a 9 x 13-inch pan (greased well) crumble corned beef in bottom.  Put sauerkraut over corned beef.  Put tomatoes over sauerkraut.  Over tomatoes, drizzle Thousand Island dressing. Spread Cheddar cheese over dressing.  Crumble or cube rye bread over top of cheese to cover.  Bake at 375° until it bubbles, 30 to 45 minutes.

name: MILLION DOLLAR PINEAPPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  can condensed milk
1/2  c. lemon juice
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  medium Cool Whip
1/2  c. chopped pecans (optional)
cherries for decoration
preparation: Mix milk, lemon juice and pineapple.  Fold in Cool Whip and pecans.  Pour into 2 graham cracker crumb crusts and chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

name: CHOCOLATE WALNUT BISCOTTI
ingredients:
1  stick margarine, softened
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped walnuts
4  sq. semi-sweet chocolate, coarsely chopped
preparation: Heat oven to 325°.  Beat margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.  Beat in eggs and vanilla.  Mix in flour, baking powder and salt.  Stir in chocolate and walnuts.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
1  Tbsp. pepper
8  oz. tomato sauce
1  pkg. chili seasoning mix
crushed corn chips
1  medium onion
16  oz. can tomatoes
16  oz. can kidney beans
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown meat and onions.  Add pepper.  Add remaining ingredients.  Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish.  Top with cheese and corn chips.  Bake at 300° for 45 minutes.

name: PULL APART CINNAMON ROLLS #1
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen dinner rolls
1 small  box instant butterscotch pudding
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. melted butter
2 to 3  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Grease Bundt pan.  Put in rolls.   Combine rest of ingredients and pour over rolls.  Cover tightly with foil and towel.  Let rise at room temperature or overnight in oven.   Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: DILLY DIP
ingredients:
1  c. Miracle Whip dressing
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
4  tsp. each dill weed, instant minced onion and parsley flakes
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Serve with vegetable dippers.  Makes 3 cups.

name: NEW ORLEANS DIP
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can artichoke hearts, finely chopped and drained
1  c. mayo
1  pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing mix
juice of 1 lemon
preparation: Mix ingredients together and chill. Serve with vegetables or crackers.

name: THELMA'S CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream-style corn
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
1  stick butter or oleo, melted
8  oz. sour cream
1  pkg. Jiffy cornbread mix
2  beaten eggs
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine all the ingredients, except the cheese.  Place in a casserole and bake uncovered for 10 minutes at 375°.  Place cheese on top and continue to cook for 20 to 30 minutes more.

name: EASY JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. carton cottage cheese
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. Jell-O (any flavor)
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 (10 or 12 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Combine cottage cheese, oranges, pineapple and Cool Whip.  Mix well.  Sprinkle dry Jell-O over mixture and stir thoroughly.  Can be used immediately or refrigerate and use when desired.

name: PINEAPPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can chunk pineapple (20 oz.)
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  Tbsp. self-rising flour
1/2  c. grated cheese
1  c. crushed Ritz crackers
1/2  stick margarine or butter
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserve liquid.  Put pineapple in casserole. Cook pineapple juice, sugar, flour and cheese until thick, stirring constantly.  Pour over pineapple and top with buttered Ritz crackers.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.  This dish is great as a side dish with ham!

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  whole chicken or 4 chicken breasts, cooked
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  c. broth (from chicken)
1/4  c. butter
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm stuffing
preparation: Cut chicken into bite size pieces.  Put on bottom of casserole dish.   Mix the two soups with 1 cup broth and pour over chicken. Melt butter.  Mix with stuffing mix and 1 cup broth.  Pour this on top.  Bake in oven at 350° about 30 minutes.

name: CHEROKEE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
1  cup Minute Rice
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. thyme
1  can mixed vegetables (or vegetable of your choice; can omit entirely)
Cheese, type and quantity of your choice
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion; drain.  Add remainder of ingredients except cheese.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Pour into casserole dish and top with cheese.  Bake at 350 degrees until bubbly.

name: CROWN JEWEL JELLO
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
1  pkg. strawberry jello
1  pkg. black cherry jello
1  pkg. lemon jello
1/4  c. sugar
1 (9 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. cold water
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
dash of salt
preparation: Mix crumbs, sugar and melted butter.  Press on bottom and up sides of buttered 9-inch spring-form pan.  Chill

name: CRAB AND BRIE QUESADILLA
ingredients:
2  Granny Smith apples, peeled, cored, and roughly chopped
1  c. apple cider vinegar
1/4  c. granulated sugar
1  Tbsp. minced shallots
1  Tbsp. minced seeded jalapeno
1  tsp. minced garlic
1  c. jumbo lump crabmeat
salt
black pepper, freshly ground
3  Tbsp. chopped green onions, tops only
1/4  c. sliced almonds
4  large flour tortillas
1  lb. Brie, thinly sliced
1/4  c. vegetable oil
2  tsp. minced chives, garnish
preparation: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.  In a small sauce pan, combine the apples, vinegar, sugar, shallots, jalapeno, and garlic to make the chili-apple glaze.  Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer until the apples are translucent and soft and the vinegar has reduced by half, about 15 minutes.  Remove from the heat and cool for at least 10 minutes. Once cool, transfer to a blender or food processor and puree until smooth, about 1 minute.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Set glaze aside.  Place the crabmeat in a bowl and season, to taste, with salt and pepper.  Add the green onions and toss gently to combine.  Cover and refrigerate.  Spread the almonds on a small baking sheet and toast until golden brown, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool.  Place the tortillas on a work surface.  Spread 1/4 cup of the crabmeat mixture evenly over half of each tortilla.  Place 5 to 6 slices of the Brie on top of the crabmeat.  Fold the remaining half of the tortilla over, forming a half-moon shape.  Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large griddle or skillet over medium heat.  When smoking hot, carefully lay the quesadilla in the oil.  Fry on 1 side until golden brown, about 2 minutes, turn with a spatula and cook until golden brown on the second side and the cheese is melted, 1 to 2 minutes.  Remove and repeat with the remaining quesadillas, adding more oil as needed. To serve, cut each quesadilla into 4 triangles.  Spread 1/4 cup of the Chili-Apple Glaze on each plate, and top with quesadilla quarters.  Garnish with the toasted almonds and chopped chives.

name: HOT CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  lb. ground beef (or turkey)
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes with chilies
preparation: Brown meat and drain completely.  Melt Velveeta cheese. Add tomatoes and meat and enough juice from can to dip consistency. Keep hot in  chafing  dish.  Serve	with corn chips or crisp crackers.

name: SHREVEPORT BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak, cubed
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can tomato soup
1/2  pt. sour cream
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  clove garlic, minced
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown meat and onion in small amount of fat.  Mix balance of ingredients and pour over meat.  Simmer 1 hour or longer.  Serve over mashed potatoes or noodles.

name: EASY CHICKEN POT PIE
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter
4  chicken breasts, cooked and shredded
1  can chicken broth
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. mixed veggies, cooked and drained
1 1/2  c. Bisquick
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.  Spread chicken over butter.  Then spread veggies over chicken.  Mix broth and soup; pour over all.  (This can be done ahead of time at this point and refrigerated.)  Then mix milk and Bisquick.  Batter will be thin.  Pour this over entire dish.  Bake at 450° for 25 minutes or until golden brown.

name: MILLIONAIRE PIE
ingredients:
1/3  c. lemon juice
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1  can fruit cocktail, drained
1  (9-inch) graham cracker crust
preparation: Blend lemon juice and milk, gradually stirring in fruit cocktail.   Pour into graham cracker crust.  Chill and serve. Yields one 9-inch pie.

name: STRAWBERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. strawberry jello
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
1  pkg. Oreo cookies
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. Cool Whip
preparation: Crumble enough cookies in bottom of Pyrex dish to cover the bottom.  In a bowl, mix jello with 2 cups hot water and stir to dissolve.  Add ice cream and strawberry jello and stir until ice cream is melted.  Pour over cookies and chill until firm.  Serve with Cool Whip.

name: VENISON KABOBS
ingredients:
2  lb. boneless venison sirloin, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes
3  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. wine vinegar
1 1/2  Tbsp. liquid smoke
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. white pepper
1  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. onion juice
16  cherry tomatoes
24  small fresh mushrooms
8  small onions
2  large green peppers, cut into 24 (1-inch) pieces
hot cooked wild rice
preparation: Place  meat  in  a  shallow glass container; set aside. Combine  oil,  wine vinegar, liquid smoke, salt, white pepper, garlic  powder  and  onion  juice;  pour over meat.  Cover and refrigerate 48 hours, stirring occasionally.  Remove meat from marinade,  reserving  marinade.

name: MICROWAVE PICKLED FRANK KABOBS
ingredients:
8  franks
sliced dill pickles
liquid smoke
preparation: Cut each frank in 8 pieces.  Arrange kabob-style on toothpicks.  Start with frank, then pickle, etc.  Shake 2 or 3 drops of liquid smoke on each kabob.  Arrange kabobs in a circle on plate.  Microwave 1/2 minute on High for 6 kabobs.  Makes 32.

name: SCOTCHAROOS
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
1  c. light Karo
1  c. peanut butter
6  c. Rice Krispies
6  oz. chocolate chips
6  oz. butterscotch chips
preparation: Bring sugar and Karo to a boil.  Remove from stove and stir in peanut butter and then the Rice Krispies.  Press into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: MEAT CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  c. finely chopped pecans
1  c. dried beef or ham, chopped fine
1 or 2  Tbsp. horseradish
several dashes hot sauce
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion or minced onion
flaked parsley (1/4 to 1/2 c.)
preparation: Cream softened cheese and mayonnaise.  Add onion, horseradish and hot sauce.  Take 3/4 cup of pecans and all of meat.  Add to mixture.  Sprinkle remainder of nuts and parsley over ball.  Let set in refrigerator for several hours.

name: SOUR CREAM-APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
4  c. peeled and sliced apples (Granny Smith)
1  pastry shell (8 inch), unbaked
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/3  c. enriched flour
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Beat together sour cream, sugar, 2 tablespoons flour, salt, vanilla and eggs.  Add apples.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake for 25 minutes.  Combine, brown sugar, 1/3 cup flour and butter until crumbly.  Sprinkle on top of pie filling. Bake for 25 minutes more.  Serve hot or cold.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
3/4  c. oil
2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans or walnuts
1  c. raisins
3  eggs
2  c. oatmeal
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Mix brown sugar and oil together.  Add slightly beaten eggs. Beat mixture with electric mixer until creamy.  Add oats.  Sift dry ingredients (flour, baking powder, soda, salt and spices) and add to mixture.   Mix well.  Add nuts, raisins and vanilla.  Drop by spoonful on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° until lightly browned.

name: GOOD LUCK BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. each:  pinto beans, small lima beans, split peas, black turtle beans, lentils and black-eyed peas
1  lb. ham pieces
1  large onion, chopped
1  clove garlic
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies or plain tomatoes
juice of 1 lemon
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix 1 pound of each type of bean.  Rinse 1 1/2 cups of mixed beans.  Soak overnight in water.  Drain and add 2 quarts of water and at least 1 teaspoon salt.  Add ham.  Cook slowly for 3 hours. Add onion, garlic, Ro-Tel tomatoes and lemon juice.  Simmer for 2 hours.  Serve with hot cornbread.

name: POTATO SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
4  eggs
4  Tbsp. flour
2  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
1  c. water
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook until thickens.  Add mustard to taste.

name: PARTY WIENERS
ingredients:
1  pkg. wieners
beer
preparation: Stuffed olives crown a pretty double-molded spread of meat and cheese.  Makes 25 servings.

name: CHERRY JAZZ
ingredients:
1  c. cherry pie filling
1  stick butter
1/2  pkg. yellow cake mix or 1 Jiffy cake mix
preparation: Spread cherry  pie  filling in bottom of an 8 or 9-inch square baking  pan.  Sprinkle  dry  cake mix over pie filling. Pour melted butter  over  cake  mix.  Bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.  Serve warm.

name: TUNA STUFFED TOMATO SALAD
ingredients:
6 1/2  oz. can tuna in water
2  hard-boiled eggs
1  Tbsp. mustard
1/4  c. Miracle Whip
2  tsp. sweet pickle relish
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Drain and flake tuna.  Dice and add eggs.  Add mustard, Miracle Whip, relish and salt and pepper to taste.  Mix well. With a sharp knife, remove stem end of tomatoes and cut from the top to within 1/2-inch of bottom, creating 6-inch petals.  Place lettuce leaves on small plates; center with tomato.  Fill with tuna salad.  Garnish with stuffed olives.

name: FRESH APPLE OMELET
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
dash of salt
2  egg whites
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. milk
2  egg yolks, well beaten
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  large unpared red apple, thinly sliced
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Sift flour with baking powder and salt. Beat egg whites until foamy.  Gradually beat in 3 tablespoons sugar, beating until stiff peaks form.  Into flour mixture beat milk and egg yolks until smooth.  Gently fold flour mixture into egg whites along with lemon juice, just until combined.  Slowly heat large buttered skillet or griddle (about 10 inches) with metal handle.  Turn batter into skillet, spreading evenly.  Arrange apple slices in pattern over top.  Sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar mixed with cinnamon over top.  Bake about 10 minutes or until top is glazed. Cut into wedges; serve warm.  Top with whipped cream or ice cream.

name: CAKE BROWNIES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. soft shortening
1  egg
1 1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  c. hot water (not boiling)
nuts (optional)
preparation: Beat together brown sugar, shortening and egg.  Then mix the vanilla, cocoa, soda and hot water.  Add to the first mixture. Now mix the flour and salt.  Add to mixture.  Then add milk.  (Add nuts if you like or spread nuts on top of the frosting of chocolate powdered sugar.)  Pour into 10 x 15-inch greased and floured cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: LEMON SALAD
ingredients:
2  small lemon jello
1  small and 1 large crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. chopped pecans
2  c. finely grated Cheddar cheese
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1/4  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Prepare jello using 2 cups boiling water. Drain pineapple. Combine all ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13 pan. Refrigerate until set. Cut into squares to serve. Keeps very well in refrigerator.

name: FLIP FLOP SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Jell-O
2  c. boiling water
1  c. pineapple juice
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
5  Tbsp. mayonnaise
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1 (1 lb.)  can crushed pineapple
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. whipped topping
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in water.  Add pineapple juice; cool.  Mix the next 5 ingredients together.  Reserve 1 tablespoon mayonnaise to grease dish.  Put the cream cheese mixture in bottom of dish. Pour Jell-O mixture on top and watch it "flip flop."  Chill in refrigerator.

name: NUT HORNS
ingredients:
6  egg yolks
2  c. margarine
1  pt. sour cream
1 large cake yeast, dissolved in 1/4  c. warm water
7 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Mix all together and roll out on board sprinkled with 3 parts sugar  to  1 part flour.  Cut dough half lengthwise and sprinkle with filling.  Roll like a jelly roll from corner to corner.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
1  c. bread crumbs
1/3  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. parsley
2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  tsp. garlic
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  chicken in pieces or your favorite chicken parts
preparation: Mix bread crumbs, cheese, parsley, salt and pepper.  Combine butter and garlic.  Dip chicken in butter, then in crumb mixture. Arrange in single layer in baking pan.  Bake 1 hour at 350°, uncovered.

name: RASPBERRY KISSES
ingredients:
3  egg whites
1/8  tsp. salt
3 1/2  Tbsp. fruit flavored gelatin
3/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. chocolate bits
preparation: Beat egg whites with salt until foamy.  Combine gelatin with sugar.  Add gradually to the egg whites, beating to stiff peaks. Make sure sugar is well dissolved by rubbing a bit of the mixture between your fingers.  It should not feel grainy.  Blend in vinegar, then fold in chocolate bits.  Drop by teaspoon onto brown paper lined or Teflon lined pans.  Be careful not to use recycled paper bags to line the pans.  Bake 25 minutes in a preheated 250° oven, then turn off oven, but do not remove kisses for another 20 minutes.  The kisses are light and fragile so remove from pans carefully, using spatula or pancake turner.  Makes about 7 dozen.

name: CANDY/COOKIE TURKEY TREATS
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. cream filled chocolate sandwich cookies
1/4  c. red cinnamon candies
1 1/4  c. malted milk balls
1  (16 oz.) container ready to spread chocolate frosting
1 (9.5 oz.)  pkg. candy corn
preparation: Separate each cookie, leaving cream filling on one side.  Set cookie halves without filling aside.

name: CHICKEN PUFFS
ingredients:
1  c. water
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. all-purpose flour
4  eggs
preparation: Heat oven to 400°. Heat water and butter to a rolling boil in a large saucepan. Stir in flour. Stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball, about 1 minute. Drop dough by slightly rounded teaspoonfuls onto Pam sprayed baking sheet. Bake about 25 minutes or until puffed and golden brown. Remove puffs to wire rack. Cool slowly.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. margarine
4  Tbsp. flour
little pepper
3  c. milk
8 to 12  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese (sharp, extra sharp)
3/4 to 1  lb. macaroni (elbows)
preparation: In pot, melt margarine.  Put flour and pepper in margarine and blend.  Add milk and stir until margarine mixture is melted.  Add cheese and stir until melted.  Cook macaroni as directed.  Put macaroni in 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Put cheese mixture over macaroni.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: ORANGE SLICE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
4  c. flour
1  lb. chopped dates
1  lb. orange slice candy, chopped
2  c. nuts
1 small  can (3 1/2 oz.) coconut
preparation: Cream together butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition. Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk and add to creamed mixture. Place flour in a large bowl; add dates, candy and nuts. Stir to coat each piece, then add flour mixture and coconut to creamed mixture. Bake in 10-inch tube pan 2 1/2 hours at 250°.

name: BISCUITS
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
5  Tbsp. baking powder
a little salt
1/3  c. oil
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix flour, baking powder and salt.  Make a hole in middle of flour mixture.  Pour oil and milk all at once in hole; mix well. Roll out and make biscuits.  Bake at 450° until golden brown. Makes 12 to 15 biscuits.

name: CREAM PUFFS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. boiling water
1  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
4  eggs
preparation: Melt butter.  Boil water and add flour and salt.  Cook to a soft ball stage.  Add eggs, one at a time, and beat after each egg.  Drop 12 on a greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 450° for 15 minutes and 325° for 25 minutes.  Cool, cut, fill and top.

name: EGG PUDDING
ingredients:
4  egg yolks
2  c. sugar
2  c. milk
1/4  c. cornstarch
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Cook on top of stove until thickened. Pour into pie shell or loaf pan.  Beat egg whites.  Pour on top. Bake in medium oven until brown.

name: CARROT BREAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar or substitute
2  eggs
2/3  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. shredded carrot
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Grease 3 small loaf pans; line with wax paper.  Mix well 1 1/4 cups sugar or substitute, 2 eggs, 2/3 cup oil, 1 teaspoon vanilla, 1 cup shredded carrot and 1/2 cup chopped nuts.  Mix and add 1 1/2 cups flour, 1 teaspoon baking soda, 1 teaspoon salt and 1 teaspoon baking powder.  Mix until moist.  If you double recipe, use only 1 teaspoon soda.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Freezes well.

name: BOSTON BROWN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. raisins
2 3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  egg
preparation: Boil water and raisins for 5 minutes and cool.  Sift together the flour, salt and soda.  Cream together the shortening, sugar and egg.  Add raisin mixture to dry ingredients.  Fill 3 medium cans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. ground beef round
2  c. chopped onion
1  green pepper, coarsely chopped
3  cloves garlic, pressed
1 or 2  Tbsp. crushed hot red pepper
3  Tbsp. chili powder
2  tsp. ground cumin
1/2  tsp. dried oregano leaves
2 1/2  tsp. salt
2 (1 lb.)  cans pinto beans (undrained)
2 (1 lb.)  cans whole tomatoes (undrained)
1 (12 oz.)  can whole kernel corn
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
preparation: In large heavy  skillet, over medium heat, saute ground beef, stirring occasionally, until red color disappears.  Pour off fat. Add onion, green pepper, garlic, crushed red pepper, chili powder,  cumin,  oregano  and  salt;  mix  well.  Cook, stirring, until onion and green pepper are tender.  Add beans, tomatoes, corn and tomato sauce; stir to mix well, breaking up tomatoes with  fork.  Simmer  slowly,  covered  and  stirring occasionally, until  thickened  and flavors are blended, about 45 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. onion, chopped
2  c. rice, cooked
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
8  oz. jar Cheez Whiz
1  can cream of broccoli soup
paprika
preparation: In saucepan, heat oil; add celery and onions.  Cook until tender.  In bowl, combine soup and milk.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into 10 x 6-inch baking dish.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

name: STUFFED CRAB
ingredients:
1  lb. crabmeat
1  onion (small), chopped fine
2  stalks celery
2  eggs
1  tsp. mayonnaise
1  tsp. mustard
1/2  c. bread crumbs
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Saute celery and onion in butter or cooking oil.  In medium bowl, beat eggs.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Stir in the sauteed celery and onion.  You may put in crab shells if you have them.  If not, spray cookie sheet with Pam and form in 1/2 cup patties.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: COUNTRY GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh green beans
1/4  c. chopped onions
1/4  c. fully cooked ham
1/4  c. water
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
1  clove garlic, minced
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: In a saucepan, combine all ingredients.  Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until beans are tender.  Serves 4.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1  French vanilla cake mix
1  box French vanilla pudding
3  Tbsp. cocoa
1  oz. red food color
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
2  whole eggs or 4 egg whites
1  tsp. butter flavor
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix cake  mix,  pudding, cocoa, soda and baking powder. Mix water, food  color  and add to dry ingredients.  Last, add buttermilk, eggs, butter  flavor  and  vanilla.  Bake  in  9 x 13-inch pan at  350°  until  done.  Frost with Red Velvet Cake Frosting.

name: TWICE BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  large baking potatoes, baked
1/4  c. Blue Bonnet margarine
2/3  c. milk
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
3/4  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
paprika
preparation: Cut  hot  potatoes in half.  Scoop out insides, reserve shells.  In large bowl with electric mixer beat potatoes until creamy.  Gradually  beat  in  milk,  stir  in  onion, salt and pepper.  Spoon  into  reserved  shells.  Sprinkle with cheese. Arrange in  baking dish.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through.  Sprinkle with paprika.

name: SALLY LUNN
ingredients:
1  c. milk
1/2  c. butter or margarine
4  c. sifted all-purpose flour, divided
1/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. salt
2  pkg. dry yeast
3  eggs
preparation: Heat  milk,  butter  and  1/4 cup water until very warm (120°).  (Butter  does  not  need  to  melt.) Blend 1 1/3 cups flour,  sugar,  salt  and  yeast  in  large  bowl.	Blend warm liquids  into  flour  mixture.  Beat  with	electric  mixer at medium  speed  2 minutes, scraping sides of bowl occasionally. Gradually add  2/3	cup  flour and eggs.  Beat at high speed 2 minutes,  add  remaining  flour  and mix well.  Batter will be thick, but	not  stiff.  Cover  and  let  rise (85° draft free place) until  double  in  bulk.  Beat dough down and turn into greased 10-inch  tube  or Bundt pan.  Cover and let rise about 30 minutes.  Bake  in	preheated  oven  at  350°  for 40 to 50 minutes.  Run  knife  around  center  and  sides and turn onto plate to cool.

name: STRAWBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
46  oz. can Hawaiian Punch
46  oz. can pineapple-grapefruit juice
46  oz. can pineapple juice
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
preparation: Mix juices together.  Add frozen strawberries.

name: APPLESAUCE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2 1/2  c. sugar
3  c. applesauce
3  eggs
4  c. flour
2 1/2  c. raisins
1 1/2  c. nutmeats
2  Tbsp. cocoa
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs.  Add applesauce which has had soda added to it.  Mix cocoa, raisins, nuts and spices together.  Add to mixture.  Add remaining ingredients.  Bake in a tube pan for 2 to 2 1/2 hours in a 250° oven.

name: RICE AND MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
1  can Campbell's beef broth soup
1  can Campbell's onion soup
1 (2 1/2 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
1  c. long grain rice
1  stick oleo
preparation: Put all ingredients into baking dish and bake.  No need to mix.  Bake in 400° oven for 1 hour.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE MIX
ingredients:
1  (2 lb.) Nestle Quik
8  qt. pkg. dry milk
6  oz. jar Cremora
2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix.  Use approximately 1/3 cup mix in an average cup of hot water.

name: SKILLET DINNER(Good And Easy)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  pkg. onion gravy or brown gravy mix
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1 1/2  c. water
1/3  c. rice (can use Minute rice)
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas
1  can Durkee French fried onions (for top when done)
preparation: Brown ground beef; drain grease.  Add gravy mix, water, garlic and uncooked rice and peas.  Cook until peas and rice are done, 15 minutes.

name: REFRIGERATOR PICKLES
ingredients:
7  c. fresh sliced cucumbers with peel
1  c. sliced onion
2  c. sugar
1  c. cider vinegar
1 to 2  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat sugar, salt and vinegar until sugar and salt dissolves. Let cool.  Pour over cucumbers and onions.  Put in refrigerator. Will keep all winter.

name: QUICK CHERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. (2 sticks) butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. almond extract
2  c. all-purpose flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Cream together butter and sugar.  Add eggs. Beat until light and fluffy.  Add the almond extract. Stir in the flour and baking powder.  Mix until smooth.  Butter a 13 x 9-inch cake pan.  Turn the mixture into pan.  Spoon the pie filling into the cake in 16 spots. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: ROCKY ROAD FUDGE
ingredients:
1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
3/4  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
1  c. miniature marshmallows
2/3  c. evaporated milk
1  c. chopped nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Freeze 1/2 c. miniature marshmallows. Place chocolate and butter in large bowl.

name: MOLDED RASPBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
3 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry Jell-O
3  c. hot water
2 (10 oz.)  boxes frozen raspberries
1 small  can (flat type) crushed pineapple (do not drain)
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.  Add raspberries and pineapple. Pour half of mixture in mold.  Freeze until firm.  Spread sour cream on first layer, then add rest of mixture on top of sour cream layer.  Put in refrigerator until firm.  Serves 12.

name: STIR AND ROLL PASTRY
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. Wesson oil
3  Tbsp. cold milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 475°.  Mix flour and salt.  Pour Wesson oil and milk into a measuring cup (don't stir).  Add all at once to flour.  Stir until mixed.  Press into balls.  Smooth and flatten slightly.  Roll between 2 sheets of waxed paper.  Press into pie pans.

name: MINI CHEESECAKES
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2/3  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
vanilla wafers
cherry pie filling
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients with electric mixer.  Then can either bake in candy papers (makes about 4 dozen) at 325° for 25 minutes or can put 1 vanilla wafer in bottom of a paper muffin cup, fill 2/3 full and bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes or top gets golden brown.  Top with small amount of cherry pie filling on each one when cool.

name: APRICOT CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1/4  c. sugar
3  oz. cream cheese
1  pkg. apricot jello
1/2  c. cold water
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. celery
1 small  can Carnation milk
preparation: Bring sugar and pineapple to a boil.  Add cream cheese, jello, water, nuts and celery.  Chill, then whip small can Carnation milk; fold in mixture.  Chill.

name: FRENCH POT ROAST
ingredients:
5  lb. bottom round roast of beef
1  can undiluted beef consomme
1  can tomato paste
6  carrots, cleaned, peeled and grated
1  can mushrooms or 1 lb. fresh mushrooms, cleaned and sauteed
2  to 3 onions, finely chopped
salt and pepper to taste
1  clove garlic, crushed or garlic powder
parsley flakes
preparation: Brown beef in Dutch oven.  Add consomme, tomato paste, vegetables and seasonings.  Cover and roast in slow oven (275°) for 5 to 6 hours until done.

name: COPPER CARROTS
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots
1  small green pepper
1  medium onion
1  can tomato soup
1/2  c. salad oil
3/4  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Clean carrots and cut into circles. Boil in salted water until just barely done. Drain and cool. Chop onion and pepper and put aside. Combine all other ingredients and heat until sugar is dissolved. In bowl, alternate layers of carrots, peppers and onions. Pour hot sauce over all and marinate for 24 hours in the refrigerator. Serve cold. Will keep in the refrigerator for 2 weeks. Makes 15 servings.

name: CREOLE CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken parts
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/2 soup  can water
1/4  c. flour
1  can chicken gumbo soup
2  Tbsp. ketchup
preparation: Dust chicken with flour.  In large skillet, brown chicken in butter.  Stir in soup, water and ketchup.  Cover; simmer 45 minutes or until tender.  Stir now and then.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots
1  medium onion, sliced
1  bell pepper, sliced
1  can cream of tomato soup
3/4  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. cooking oil
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
black pepper to taste
preparation: Cook carrots in salted water until just tender; drain well. Mix other ingredients and bring to a boil.  Pour over carrots. Cool and put in refrigerator.  Keeps indefinitely.

name: SOUR CREAM ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  onion
2  cloves garlic
1  can tomatoes, chopped
Doritos
1 small  can chopped green chilies
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, cubed
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
preparation: Brown hamburger and onion together. Mix other ingredients with hamburger mixture and heat. In a 9 x 13-inch pan or casserole, layer mixture with Doritos, ending with mixture on top.  Heat in oven at 350° until it starts boiling.

name: FRESH STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  qt. fresh strawberries
1  c. granulated sugar or 1/3 c. honey and 1/2 c. sugar
1/4  c. water
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. butter
1  baked 9-inch pie shell
1  c. whipping cream
preparation: Line  baked  and  cooled  pie  shell  with 2 cups large uncooked  berries, arranged hulled side down.  Make a sauce of the other  2 cups of berries, cut up and cook until thick with sweetening, water, cornstarch and salt mixed together.  Remove from heat,  add  butter  and  stir  well.  Cool  and pour over berries  in  the  pastry  shell.  Refrigerate  until  ready to serve.  Spread  with  coating  of  whipped  cream  or  whipped topping.  Makes 6 servings.

name: PEANUT DELIGHTS
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate bits
3/4  c. sweetened condensed milk
2  c. salted peanuts
preparation: Melt chocolate bits in a double boiler on low heat.  Take away from heat.  Add milk and peanuts.  Drop teaspoons of mixture onto wax paper.  Chill in refrigerator.  Makes about 3 dozen.

name: CHEESE CAKE TARTS
ingredients:
1  lb. cream cheese
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat all together until blended.  Place cup cake liners in pan, then put one vanilla wafer in liner.  Put cheese filling in (2 tablespoons).  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  When cool put one teaspoon filling (cherry pie filling, blueberry pie filling or crushed pineapple) on top.  Makes 12 large or 24 mini cup cakes.

name: APPLE TORTE CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1 3/4  c. sugar
1  c. salad oil
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. baking soda
5  apples, peeled and sliced thick
3/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Blend eggs, sugar and oil with fork; add dry ingredients and blend.  Add apples and nuts, mix well.  Dough will be stiff.  Bake in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan at 350° for 1 hour.

name: TERRY'S KALE SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. stew beef
1 1/2  lb. linguica
1 1/2  lb. chorizo
4  to 5 potatoes
1  bunch carrots
2  large onions
1 large  bunch kale
1 to 2  cans kidney beans
preparation: Cut beef into bite size pieces and brown in olive oil.  Skin and slice sausages into bite size pieces and add to beef to brown. Then cover meat with water and add washed (peeled if necessary) and chopped vegetables and cook until everything is tender.  Then add drained kidney beans and cook for another 1/2 hour.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  bunches broccoli
1 1/2  sticks butter
2  stacks Ritz crackers, crushed
1  pkg. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Cook broccoli until tender, not soft; drain.  Grease casserole dish.  Melt 1/2 stick of butter and Velveeta cheese.  Add mixture to the broccoli.  Melt 1 stick of butter and add to crackers. Spread mixture over broccoli.  Heat for 1/2 hour at 350°.

name: LEMON BARS
ingredients:
1  c. oleo
1/2  c. powdered sugar
2  c. flour
4  eggs
4  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
2  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. powdered sugar (to be sprinkled on bars)
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and pat into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Smooth and press up on sides of pan.  Bake in 350° oven until firm to touch, about 20 to 25 minutes.  Beat eggs until light in color. Sift remaining ingredients together and add gradually to eggs; add lemon juice.  Pour over crust and bake until light golden brown, 25 minutes.  When done, sift powdered sugar over top.

name: GOLDEN APPLE PIE
ingredients:
1/4  c. white sugar
1/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  c. butter/oleo
6  to 8 apples, sliced
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. salt
2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix sugars, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt in small bowl. Cut in oleo until fine.  Put over sliced apples in pie shell.  (I put about 1/4 cup water of the apple, flour and sugar mixture.) Put the top crust on, brush with milk and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes until brown.

name: HASH BROWN POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. hash brown potatoes, thawed at room temperature
1/4  c. chopped onions
2  c. grated cheese (Swiss or Cheddar)
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. melted margarine
1  can cream of chicken soup, mixed with 1/4 c. milk
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Place potatoes, onions, cheese and pepper in a large bowl. Mix together margarine, soup and sour cream and add to potato mixture.  Mix together and place in a greased, flat Pyrex pan, 9 x 13-inch.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

name: MARYLAND CRAB IMPERIAL
ingredients:
1  lb. backfin crabmeat
1  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. instant minced onion
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  slices white bread crumbs (very fine, crust removed)
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
sprinkle pepper
2  Tbsp. margarine
paprika for sprinkling
preparation: Remove cartilage and shells from crabmeat.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
1  pkg. (2 c.) light brown sugar
1/2  lb. (2 cubes) margarine
1/2  c. light Karo
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. baking soda
6  qt. popped corn
preparation: Put popcorn in larger roaster pan (I spray with non-stick spray).  In saucepan, put brown sugar, margarine, Karo, salt and cream of tartar.  Cook over medium to medium high heat, stirring constantly until hard ball stage (260° to 264°).  Remove from stove; add soda and stir.  Pour over popcorn and stir until covered.  Put into 200° oven for 1 hour.  Stir twice during this time.  Dump on wax paper and separate to cool.  Makes about 2 gallons.

name: MUSCADINE PIE
ingredients:
2  c. juice
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Mix and cook until thick.  Pour into a baked pie shell and cool. Top with Cool Whip.

name: HAWAIIAN BAKED BEANS AND FRANKS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. drained, crushed pineapple (1 large can)
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  c. catsup
1  tsp. prepared mustard
2 (16 oz.)  cans baked beans
1  lb. (8 to 10) frankfurters, sliced into 1-inch pieces
preparation: Drain pineapple well.  Combine pineapple with remaining ingredients in a 2-quart casserole.  Bake in a preheated 350° oven for an hour.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
3  c. sugar
6  eggs
3  c. plain flour
3  sticks real butter
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Cream the cream cheese, sugar, butter and flavoring.  Add eggs and flour.  Mix well and bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour and 15 minutes in greased and floured tube pan.  Check with toothpick to make sure it is done.

name: ARROZ ESPANOLA(Spanish Rice)
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. bacon drippings
1 1/2  c. rice (do not use instant)
1/2  c. onion, sliced
1/2  c. bell pepper
1 (14 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 medium  clove garlic, minced or crushed
1  tsp. black pepper
2  tsp. salt
3  c. water
preparation: Melt bacon drippings in large skillet. Add rice and brown. When the rice is a golden brown, reduce heat and add onion, bell pepper, tomatoes, garlic and pepper. Mix well and add 1 1/2 cups of warm water or enough to just cover rice. Add salt. Cover and let simmer until almost dry. Add remaining water, cold a little at a time, cooking over low heat until fluffy. This is the secret to fluffy rice.

name: APPLE BARS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. butter
2  beaten egg yolks
4 medium apples or 4  c. canned apples
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  slightly beaten egg white
preparation: Combine the 2 cups flour, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder and salt. Cut in butter until crumbs are size of peas. Stir in egg yolks. Press half in 9 X 13 pan. Add apple mixture. Add remaining crumb mixture on top. Brush lightly with egg white. Bake 350° for 40 minutes. Drizzle with powdered sugar icing, if desired.

name: KITTY'S PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. spaghetti
2  cucumbers
8  cherry tomatoes
1 large  bottle Zesty Italian salad dressing
1  small onion or green onion
2  green peppers
1  bottle McCormick Salad Supreme
2  lb. small shrimp, peeled and deveined
preparation: Cook spaghetti as directed. Bring shrimp to boil. Peel and cut up vegetables (you can substitute the vegetables your family likes).

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen broccoli
3/4  c. grated cheese (sharp)
1/4  c. milk
1  beaten egg
1  small grated onion
butter
1  c. saltine cracker crumbs (3/4 c. into casserole and 1/4 c. sprinkled on top)
preparation: Cook broccoli according to directions, leaving out salt. Drain and put in casserole dish.  Dot with butter.  Mix the remaining ingredients thoroughly and pour the mixture over broccoli.  Sprinkle cracker crumbs on top and again dot with butter.  Bake at 325° or 350° for about 45 minutes.  Sprinkle with cheese and melt.

name: SALSA
ingredients:
8oz. can tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. chili peppers, drained and finely chopped
1/4  cup green pepper, finely chopped
2  Tbsp. onion, finely chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1/4  tsp. crushed oregano leaves
1/8  tsp. ground cumin
preparation: Mix all ingredients throughly.  Best if put in blender.

name: APPLE PRALINE PIE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. half and half or milk
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Bake your favorite apple pie.  Remove from oven.

name: RED RUBY
ingredients:
2  beef-flavored bouillon cubes
1/4  c. boiling water
1 (46 oz.)  can tomato juice, chilled
1/4  c. lemon juice
1 (10 oz.)  bottle club soda, chilled
1  c. vodka (optional)
preparation: Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water; let cool.  Stir in juices.  Just before serving, stir in club soda and, if desired, vodka.  Serve over ice.  Yields about 7 cups.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. chopped, cooked chicken
1 1/3  c. mayonnaise
1  c. chopped celery
4  Tbsp. chopped fresh chives
4  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
4  Tbsp. sliced ripe olives
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
4  tsp. Dijon mustard
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a 1-quart bowl. Stir well.  Yields 6.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened to room temperature
1  box Winespread sharp Cheddar cheese spread
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. onion powder
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. crushed walnuts
1/2  tsp. parsley flakes
preparation: Cream together the cheeses, garlic powder, onion powder and Worcestershire sauce.  Mix well.  Shape into a ball.  Put in freezer for 15 minutes.  Roll in walnuts and parsley flakes.  Will stay fresh for 4 weeks, if refrigerated.  Serve with crackers. Enjoy!!

name: BARBECUED BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  green pepper, diced
1  small onion, diced
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 (14 oz.)  bottle catsup
1 (3 lb.)  can Bush's beans
preparation: Brown and season beef, onion and green pepper.  Add brown sugar and catsup.  Add beans.  Bake in a large Pyrex bowl for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

name: APPLE PIE FILLING
ingredients:
25  c. apples
4 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. cornstarch
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
10  c. water
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Cook all ingredients until thick.

name: BLUEBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. graham crackers
1  tbsp. sugar
1  tbsp. melted butter
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. blueberry pie filling
1  cool whip
preparation: Crush graham crackers and mix sugar and melted butter.  Pour into casserole dish.  Mix cream cheese, confectioners sugar, & cool whip.  After mixing, pour over top of graham crackers.  Then spread blueberry filling on top.  Put in refrigerator and let set.

name: MANDARIN SALAD
ingredients:
Lettuce (large leafy lettuce rather than head lettuce)
2  med. stalks celery, chopped
1  sm. onion, chopped
11  oz. can mandarin oranges (drained well)
1/2  c. slivered almonds, roasted
preparation: Combine all above ingredients & add dressing.

name: KUGEL
ingredients:
12  oz. thin egg noodles
1 large  can fruit cocktail
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. white sugar
5  extra large eggs
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. vanilla
1  cube butter or margarine, softened
1  jar maraschino stemless cherries
preparation: Cook noodles per package directions.  While noodles cook, drain canned fruit.  Put rest of ingredients (except cherries) in bowl and mix together.  Drain noodles and add to fruit.  Add that to mixture in bowl.  Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch Pyrex pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon.  Put on cherries (in decorative pattern). Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.  Serve hot or warm; may be reheated.  (Great with turkey or chicken.)

name: CROCK-POT MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1  c. mild Cheddar cheese, grated
1 small  box elbow macaroni
2  eggs
1/4  stick margarine
1 large  can evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cook macaroni in boiling water about 6 minutes.  Drain water off macaroni and place in a lightly greased crock-pot or spray lightly with Pam.  Cut margarine into small pieces and stir into macaroni until melted.  Add remaining ingredients to macaroni in crock-pot, leaving some cheese to sprinkle on top.  Cook on low setting for 2 to 3 hours, or high setting for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

name: PARMESAN POTATOES
ingredients:
6  large potatoes, cut in wedges
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
