1/4  c. flour
3  Tbsp. chicken flavored Shake 'N Bake
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix dry ingredients in bag and mix well.  Shake potatoes, few at a time, until coated.  Place in casserole dish sprayed with Pam.  Dot with 1 stick of margarine and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

name: RICE AND CHERRY SUPREME
ingredients:
1  c. whipping cream
1/2  c. sugar
2  c. cold cooked rice
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  can cherry pie filling
preparation: Beat the cream and sugar together.  Gently fold in rice, vanilla and cherry pie filling.

name: TACO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
1  lb. ground meat
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  c. Ranch Style beans
1  c. cream of chicken soup
1  pkg. Doritos
8  oz. cheese, grated
preparation: Brown meat and onion; add taco seasoning mix.  Crumble chips into oblong pan.  Mix all other ingredients with meat.  Sprinkle grated cheese over top.  Heat oven to 350° or microwave until cheese on top melts.

name: Split Pea Soup
ingredients:
1/2  pound (1 cup) dried split peas
3  quarts water
1  ham bone or 2 ham hocks (trimmed)
2  bay leaves
4  green onions, diced
3  stalks celery, diced
1  carrot chopped
2  large potatoes, pared and cut
2  t salt
1/4  t pepper
preparation: Soak peas overnight, drain.  Place ham and peas in large pot; bring to boil.  Skim if necessary.  Add other ingredients and simmer for 3 hours.  Remove ham, bones, and bay leaves.  Pour soup into blender and process until smooth.  Dice ham and return to soup.  If too thick, add canned chicken broth.  Serve hot with croutons.

name: PERSIMMON PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  pt. sour cream
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
3  tsp. cinnamon
1  pt. or 2 c. persimmons
2  sticks butter
brown sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Pour into well-greased baking dish. Top with 2 sticks butter and sprinkle with brown sugar.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: MOM'S BOHEMIAN CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. shortening or oleo
4  eggs
1  c. milk
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Grease tube pan.  Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs one at a time.  Beat well; add milk and flour alternately (flour sifted with baking powder).  Add vanilla, coconut and pecans.  Bake about one hour; when batter does not stick to toothpick, it is done.

name: PRETZEL CANDY
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. white chocolate pieces
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. peanut butter pieces
1  Tbsp. peanut butter
1  c. crushed nuts
1  c. crushed pretzels
preparation: Melt pieces and peanut butter over low heat; remove from stove and add pretzels and nuts.  Spread on greased (buttered) cookie sheet.  Break into pieces.

name: CHERRY SMORES
ingredients:
1  Hershey bar (7 oz.) broken into 8 sections
8  graham crackers squares
8  large marshmallows
1  c. prepared cherry pie filling
preparation: Place 1 piece of candy on each cracker.  Microwave, 4 crackers at a time, on High for 45 seconds to 1 minutes, until chocolate starts to melt.  Place 1 marshmallow on each cracker.  Microwave 15 to 30 seconds until soft.  Top each with spoonful of cherry filling.  Repeat.  Makes 8 servings.  Try this recipe with other pie filling/toppings; such as raspberry, blueberry, strawberry and peach.

name: TRIFLE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) layer white or yellow cake
1/2  c. strawberry preserves
1 large  pkg. vanilla pudding, mixed according to pkg.  directions
1 large  pkg. strawberry gelatin, mixed according to pkg.  directions
1/2  can Angel Flake coconut
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  pt. whipping cream
preparation: Cut the cake in pieces, 1 x 3-inches.  Split pieces of cake in two and put strawberry preserves between.

name: SALLIE KNOUSE'S JAPANESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
3  c. flour, sifted 6 times
5  eggs
1  c. milk
1  tsp. baking powder
1  lb. seeded raisins
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
preparation: Divide batter in half.  Bake 2 layers plain and to the other half, add the raisins and spices; roll raisins in flour.  No oven temperature given.  Put filling between layers.  Ice cake on outside with white icing.

name: SPINACH BALLS
ingredients:
1  small onion, chopped
2  boxes frozen chopped spinach (squeeze to drain out water)
3/4  c. melted butter
2  c. Pepperidge Farm stuffing
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
2  beaten eggs
1  Tbsp. Accent
1/2  tsp. thyme
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Shape into balls, about 3-inches in diameter.  Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI FRITTERS
ingredients:
1/3  c. biscuit mix
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  eggs, slightly beaten
2  c. shredded, unpeeled zucchini (2 medium)
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: In a bowl, stir together the biscuit mix, Parmesan cheese and pepper.  Stir in beaten eggs.  Fold in zucchini.  In a large, heavy skillet, melt butter.  Use 2 tablespoons of mixture for each fritter.  Cook until brown on each side.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1/2  c. heavy cream less 1 Tbsp.
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  c. dark corn syrup
1  Tbsp. cooking sherry
1/4  tsp. rum extract
1 1/2  c. pecan halves or large pieces
preparation: Put eggs, sugar, cream, vanilla, butter, corn syrup, salt, cooking sherry and rum extract in medium bowl.  Beat well with spoon.  Add pecans and mix.  Pour into baked pie shell.  (When baking pie shell, use weights; don't prick the crust.)  Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes until set in center.  Use knife to see if comes out clean as with custard.

name: TUNA MOLD
ingredients:
1  can condensed tomato soup
6  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1  envelope unflavored gelatin, soaked in 1/4 c. water
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
2 (7 oz.)  cans tuna
preparation: Heat tomato soup slightly.  Add cream cheese and stir until dissolved.  Add remaining ingredients and mix.  Place in mold. Refrigerate overnight to set.

name: CARROT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
5  c. carrots, sliced and cooked
1/2  lb. diced Velveeta cheese
1  cube margarine
1  large onion, diced
salt and pepper to taste
1  tube Ritz crackers, crushed
preparation: Saute onion in margarine.  In buttered casserole (8 x 12-inch), layer half the carrots and half the cheese; repeat layers.  Top with sauteed onions and cover casserole generously with crushed Ritz crackers.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: HOT SHRIMP SPREAD OR SOUFFLE DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  jar Old English cheese (Cheddar)
1  can shrimp, drained
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a 1 or 1 1/2-quart baking dish or ovenproof bowl.

name: BAKED EGGPLANT
ingredients:
1  eggplant, peeled and sliced
1  c. flour
5  eggs
dash of salt
dash of pepper
1  c. milk
preparation: Beat eggs and milk together.  Dip eggplant in egg mixture and then in flour. Salt and pepper to taste.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: TUNA NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
7  oz. water pack tuna, drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1/2  lb. egg noodles, cooked
10  Ritz crackers, crushed
1  tsp. dry onion flakes
1/2  c. diced sharp Cheddar cheese
1  c. sour cream
salt to taste
pepper to taste
preparation: Combine soup, sour cream and onion flakes.  Add cheese, tuna and noodles.  Stir with fork to distribute evenly.  Pour in buttered casserole.  Sprinkle with cracker crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.  Serves 3 or 4.

name: MAKES ITS OWN CRUST COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
2  c. milk
1/4  c. melted butter
1 1/2  c. coconut
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. lemon extract
preparation: Combine all ingredients in order and mix well.  Pour into greased deep 10-inch pie plate.  Bake 45 minutes or until golden brown at 350°.

name: STREUSEL TOPPED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
6  to 8 sweet potatoes (boil, peel and mash) or 3 (16 oz.) cans, drained and mashed
1  c. maple syrup
1  tsp. grated orange peel
preparation: Combine potatoes with syrup and orange peel.  Spoon into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.

name: PIZZA SAUCE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
2  tsp. oregano
1 (5 oz.)  can tomato paste
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. minced onion
preparation: Stir all ingredients in small saucepan and simmer slowly about 20 minutes.  Makes enough for 3 (15-inch) pizzas.  Bake pizza about 25 minutes at 425°.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1  c. light corn syrup
3  eggs, beaten
1/4  tsp. salt
1/3  c. melted butter
1  c. pecans
1  tsp. vanilla
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can Spam luncheon meat
1 (18 oz.)  can sweet potatoes, drained
1 (8 oz.)  can fruit cocktail
1  tsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Arrange sweet potatoes in shallow casserole dish.  Make 5 cuts partially through loaf of Spam; add loaf in dish.  Drain fruit cocktail, saving juice.  Combine cornstarch and brown sugar.  Stir into juice and add margarine.  Heat to boiling.  Stir in fruit and simmer 5 minutes.  Spoon over Spam and sweet potatoes.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, basting with juice during baking. Serves 3 to 4.

name: SINFULLY DELICIOUS CHOCOLATE DESSERT
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake, prepared in large rectangular pan (cake mix is fine)
1 large  box chocolate pudding (instant), prepared
1  large container Cool Whip
1  small bag chocolate chips
preparation: Slice cake in half and into small pieces for layering as needed.  Using a large glass bowl (I use a punch bowl), layer chocolate cake, chocolate pudding and Cool Whip.  Sprinkle with chocolate chips, lightly.  Continue layering until bowl is filled. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. chopped meat (beef)
4  to 6 carrots, cut up
2  to 3 celery stalks, cut up
1  onion, cut up
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  clove garlic
1 (4 oz.)  can tomato sauce
thyme (to taste)
A.1. sauce (to taste)
salt (to taste)
pepper (to taste)
3  to 4 potatoes, cooked and mashed
preparation: Brown meat, saute vegetables in butter with the garlic.  Add rest of ingredients  (except potatoes).  Simmer to blend flavors, then put into casserole dish.  Cover top of mixture with mashed potatoes.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until potatoes are browned.

name: BROCCOLI QUICHE
ingredients:
1  box frozen broccoli, chopped
1  small onion
1 to 1 1/2  c. Swiss cheese
4  eggs
2  c. half and half
1/2  stick butter or margarine
1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Layer into 10-inch deep pie dish (sprayed with nonstick spray) the broccoli, small onion (diced fine) and Swiss cheese.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans whole kernel corn
1  can French-style green beans or 1 pkg. chopped broccoli
1  can cream of celery soup
1 small  carton sour cream
1  onion, chopped finely
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  pkg. slivered almonds (1/2 to 3/4 c.)
3/4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Drain corn and beans or broccoli.  Mix together with above ingredients.  Pour into buttered casserole dish.

name: BUTTERFINGER CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
6  Butterfinger bars, crushed
16  oz. Cool Whip
1/2  c. margarine, melted
2  egg yolks
2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Take melted margarine and add yolks.  Mix in powdered sugar, then fold in Cool Whip.  Bake cake according to directions and break into pieces.  Layer cake, then Cool Whip mixture, then crushed candy bars.  Repeat.  Keep in refrigerator.

name: SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
spaghetti noodles
ketchup
onion
hamburger meat
salt
preparation: Fry the hamburger meat, then boil some water and put the noodles.  Put ketchup and onions in hamburger meat.  Put onions in it.  Let it cook for 10 minutes; cool for a little while where you won't burn your mouth and then eat.  Put salt on it.

name: PLAY DOUGH FOR KIDS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cornstarch
1/2  c. flour
2  c. water
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. salt
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in saucepan.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture gathers on spoon and forms dough.  This will take about 6 minutes.  Dump onto waxed paper until cool enough to handle and knead to form a pliable mass. Store in covered container or plastic bag.  Food coloring may be added to make different colors.  Yields 2 pounds play dough.

name: SPINACH DIP IN BREAD ROUND
ingredients:
16  oz. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. Knorr dry vegetable soup mix
1  box frozen chopped spinach
1/2  can chopped water chestnuts
Hawaiian bread round
preparation: Cook spinach and drain between paper towels.  Combine with other ingredients.  Let set overnight for best taste.  Hollow out center of bread and fill with dip.  Break up bread pieces and use for dipping.

name: LEMON PIE (CUSTARD)
ingredients:
1 1/8  c. granulated sugar
1/3  c. water
3  egg yolks, beaten
2  c. milk
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
butter (size of walnut)
1 1/2  tsp. lemon extract
preparation: Add sugar to water and bring to a boil.  Add milk with beaten egg yolks and bring to a boil.  Add just enough water to cornstarch to mix and add slowly to mixture.  Turn heat down low and let bubble for 3 or 4 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Add butter and lemon extract.  Pour in baked pie shell.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  fresh head broccoli
2  large or 3 small carrots
1  c. chopped celery
1  small onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix broccoli, carrots, celery and onion.  Put in refrigerator. Mix lemon juice, mayonnaise and sugar.  When ready to serve, pour dressing over broccoli mix; mix well.  Can use raisins and nuts in mix, if desired.

name: FIRECRACKER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
1  med. onion, chopped
1  can black beans, rinsed and drained
1-2 TBSP. chili pwd.
2-3 tsp. ground cumin
1/2  tsp. salt
4  flour tortillas
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can diced tomatoes
1 sm.  can green chilies, undrained
1  c. cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Cook the meat in skillet until it is no longer pink, drain. Add beans, chili pwd., cumin and salt.  Transfer to a 9 by 13 in. baking dish.  Arrange tortillas over the top; combine soup and tomatoes, then pour over the tortillas.  Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered at 350° for 25-30 min. Yields 8 servings.

name: CREAM OF BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1 1/2  qt. water
1  onion, chopped
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli, chopped
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. Accent
2  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  c. cold water
8  oz. American cheese, shredded
1  c. milk
1  c. cream
1/4  c. butter
1/3  c. flour
preparation: In 3-quart pan, bring water to a boil.  Add broccoli and onion and boil 10 minutes.  Add seasonings and shredded cheese; stir until melted.  Add milk, cream and butter.  Stir and heat to boiling.  Slowly add water to flour, stirring constantly, until texture is smooth.  Slowly add water, stirring rapidly.  Cook until soup is consistency of heavy cream.

name: WHITE CHOCOLATE PARTY MIX
ingredients:
3  c. Corn Chex
3  c. Rice Chex
3  c. Cheerios
2  c. sm. pretzels
1  lg. bag M & M's
1  lb. white chocolate
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Melt white chocolate.  Pour over dry ingredients and stir.  Spread on cookie sheet to dry.  Store in covered container.  This is pretty at Easter with the pastel M & M's.

name: KAHLUA DIP
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  jar marshmallow cream
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. Kahlua
sliced, fresh fruit
preparation: Combine marshmallow cream and cream cheese; blend well. Stir in	 Kahlua.  Chill,  covered,  overnight.	Serve  with sliced, fresh fruit.

name: SINFUL SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. strawberry jello
1  c. boiling water
3  bananas, mashed
1  c. chopped pecans
2  pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Combine jello and boiling water.  Add bananas, pecans, strawberries and pineapple.  Divide mixture in half.  Pour one half in an 8 x 12-inch pan.  Refrigerate until set.  Keep remaining half at room temperature.  Spread sour cream evenly over set jello.  Pour on remaining jello.  Refrigerate until set.

name: GOUDA WRAP
ingredients:
1  round Gouda cheese
1 four-roll  pkg. crescent rolls
1  jar hot pepper jelly
Triscuits
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Remove red wax from Gouda.  Unwrap crescent rolls and pinch together seams to form two rectangles. Wrap rolls around cheese in two sheets, until cheese is encrusted. Place in oven until crust is golden brown.  Remove from oven and serve with pepper jelly on top.  Serve hot on Triscuits crackers. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

name: MINI MEAT LOAVES
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  eggs, beaten
1 small  can evaporated milk
1/2  c. catsup
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1/3  c. chopped onion
1/3  c. chopped dill pickle
1/3  c. chopped celery
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Mold into small loaves and bake in muffin tins at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: Lenten Mocha Cake
ingredients:
3  c. flour (take out 3 level tsp. and do not use)
1  tsp. salt
2  c. cold coffee
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. cocoa
1  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Add sugar, oil, cocoa and mix, then dry ingredients and vanilla.  Mix well.  Grease 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Frost with powdered sugar or chocolate frosting.

name: FRIED CHEESE MELTAWAYS
ingredients:
vegetable oil
1  c. biscuit mix
1/2  c. milk
1  egg
1  lb. cheese (any kind), cut into 3/4-inch cubes
preparation: Heat 2-inches of oil in deep-fat fryer or saucepan to 375°. Beat biscuit mix, milk and egg with hand beater until smooth. Coat cheese cubes lightly with baking mix.  Insert a round wooden pick in each cheese cube.  Dip into batter, covering cheese completely.  Fry several cubes at a time, turning carefully, until golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes.  Drain on paper towel.  Makes about 45 appetizers.

name: SMALL HUNGARIAN PASTRIES
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
pinch of salt
4  egg yolks, well beaten
1/4  pt. sour cream
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, butter and salt like pie crust, then add egg yolks, sour cream and milk; knead well.  Roll out about 1/8-inch thick and cut into small squares.  Put a small amount of filling in center, then fold 2 corners on top, overlapping.  Brush with egg wash.  Bake in preheated 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: LENTIL SOUP
ingredients:
1  c. lentils, rinsed
5  c. water
3  cubes chicken bouillon
1/2  tsp. thyme
1  medium onion
1  stalk celery, sliced
1  carrot, sliced
preparation: Add all ingredients at same time.  Cook 2 hours or until lentils are tender.  Makes 4 cups.  If desired, chopped ham may be added toward end of cooking time.

name: FROZEN WALDORF SALAD
ingredients:
2  eggs, lightly beaten
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. pineapple juice
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/8  tsp. salt
cornstarch (optional)
1/2  c. diced celery
1/2  c. drained crushed pineapple
2  medium apples, diced
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1  c. whipping cream, whipped
cherries (to garnish)
preparation: Combine eggs, sugar, pineapple juice, lemon juice and salt. Cook until thick over low heat, stirring constantly.   (You may add cornstarch, if necessary.)  Cool.  Important to cool.  Add celery, pineapple, apples and nuts.  Gently fold in whipped cream. Spoon into 8-inch square pan and freeze.  To serve, cut into squares and garnish with cherries.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. candied pineapple, citron, orange peel and cherries
2  c. moist currants
1  lb. dates
1  lb. moist figs
1  lb. seedless raisins
1 1/2  c. nuts
1  c. syrup
1  c. brandy
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon, allspice and cloves
1 1/2  tsp. soda
dash of salt
1 1/2  lb. oleo
1  lb. brown sugar
1 1/2  c. sugar
12  eggs
1  c. molasses
preparation: Cut up fruits and mix all ingredients well!  Make a syrup from 1/2 cup sugar and 1 cup water; boil 3 minutes and pour over cake mixture.  Prepare baking pans, lining them with greased wax paper. Pour in pans; brush top with milk and bake slow at 250° for 1 hour.

name: TRASH
ingredients:
2  (7 oz.) bags Ritz Snack Mixers (traditional flavor)
2  (8 3/4 oz.) bags Chex Mix (traditional flavor)
1  (16 oz.) bag dry roasted peanuts
3  sticks butter
3  Tbsp. salt lick dry rub
4  Tbsp. Lea & Perrins
2  Tbsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix dry ingredients. Melt butter and add seasonings to butter. Pour over dry ingredients and mix thoroughly. Divide mixture over 2 cookie sheets. Cook at 325° for 1 hour, turning every 20 minutes during that hour. Cool thoroughly before placing in containers so that it will not be soggy. Enjoy.

name: HIDDEN VALLEY RANCH CHEESE FINGERS
ingredients:
2  small loaves French bread (8 oz.), cut in half lengthwise
8  oz. cream cheese or Neufchatel cheese
1 (1.0 oz.)  envelope Hidden Valley Ranch Milk Recipe Original Ranch salad dressing mix
4  c. assorted toppings (chopped onions, peppers or grated cheese)
preparation: Slice bread crosswise into 1-inch fingers, leaving attached. Mix cream cheese and salad dressing mix together; spread on bread. Pile on toppings.  Broil until brown and bubbly.  Makes about 4 1/2 dozen fingers.

name: RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  green onions (tops and all)
1 small  can chopped mushrooms
1/4  lb. butter
1  c. uncooked long grain rice
2  c. beef bouillon soup
1/2  c. water
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Bake at 400° for 1 hour.

name: DOUBLE CHOCOLATE FANTASY BARS
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake mix
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1  egg
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
dash of salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large bowl beat cake mix, oil and egg on medium speed until crumbly.  Add nuts.  Reserving 1 1/2 cups crumb mixture, press remainder firmly in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.

name: COUNTRY FRIED CHICKEN (BY DUNKIE)
ingredients:
1  cut up frying chicken
Crisco cooking oil
1/2  c. milk
1  egg
1  c. flour
2  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. oregano
1  tsp. black pepper
1  pinch of salt
preparation: Mix flour, garlic salt, paprika, oregano, black pepper and salt.  Heat oil in skillet to 365°.  Beat egg and milk.  Mix flour and seasoning.  Dip chicken in milk and egg mixture, then dip into flour mixture.  Put into hot skillet and brown on both sides. Cover and simmer for tender chicken.

name: CINNAMON BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  can biscuits
1/8  c. butter, melted
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
preparation: Roll biscuits in butter and then in cinnamon and sugar mixture.  Bake, using temperature on biscuit can.  Remove while biscuits are still slightly doughy.  Do not overbake.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2 large  bottles Ragu spaghetti sauce
1 large  pkg. lasagna noodles
1  large container cottage cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1 large  pkg. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Brown beef; drain.  Add sauce and simmer.  Mix eggs with cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese.  Layer sauce on bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Next layer cheese mixture, next Mozzarella cheese, then noodles, sprinkle a little water over noodles.  Alternate until all of the ingredients are used up. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.  Make a tent of aluminum foil over the pan.  Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until done at 350°. Cool 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

name: CANDY BAR PIE
ingredients:
1  pt. vanilla ice cream, softened
1  prepared chocolate crumb crust
1/2  c. caramel sauce
1/2  c. chopped peanuts
1 (8 oz.)  carton Cool Whip (chocolate), thawed
preparation: Spread ice cream evenly in bottom of crust.  Freeze until firm. Spread caramel sauce over ice cream.  Sprinkle with peanuts.  Cover with whipped topping.  Freeze 4 hours or until firm.  Let stand at room temperature 20 minutes before serving.

name: MOLASSES CRINKLES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. sorghum
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cloves
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar together. Add egg and molasses and beat until well blended.  Sift flour, salt, soda and spices together and add to creamed mixture and mix well.  Chill dough. Then shape dough in balls.  Roll in white sugar and place on cookie sheet.  Flatten slightly.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.  Do not overbake.  These cookies get softer in a day or so if covered tightly.  Makes approximately 4 dozen cookies.

name: COCONUT CHESS PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. coconut
1/2  c. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Combine eggs, sugar, butter, vinegar, vanilla and salt. Beat well.  Stir  in  coconut. Pour into unbaked pastry shell. Bake at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes or until set.

name: PLANTAIN SOUP
ingredients:
2  green plantains
4  c. chicken broth, seasoned
2  Tbsp. olive oil
3  oz. ham, cut in pieces
1  onion*
1  tomato*
1  green pepper, remove seeds*
2  bay leaves
1/4  tsp. oregano
2  garlic cloves, peeled and mashed
1  pkg. Sazon Goya seasoning (with cilantro and achiote)
preparation: *Cut finely in pieces.

name: STEWED POTATOES
ingredients:
6  potatoes, washed and cut in quarters
1  stick margarine
1/2  medium onion, finely chopped
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In large pot, cover potatoes with water and cook until done. Drain 3/4 c. of the water. Add butter, onion, salt and pepper. Cook slowly until soup thickens. Great with almost any meat.

name: DUMP CAKE
ingredients:
2  cans pie filling of choice (apple, cherry, blueberry or mix 1 can pie filling and 1 can pineapple chunks, drained)
1  box white or yellow cake mix
1 1/2  sticks butter or margarine
8  oz. chopped walnuts (optional)
preparation: Take a 13 x 9-inch pan, put in pie fillings, cover with cake mix and top with butter.  Can be topped with chopped walnuts, if desired.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes plus, until brown and bubbly.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  can tuna, drained
1 small  can sweet peas
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  pkg. macaroni and cheese dinner
1/4  c. onion, chopped
1/4  c. milk
6  slices processed cheese
preparation: Mix tuna and onion with prepared macaroni dinner; spread in buttered oblong pan.  Mix remaining ingredients and pour over mixture in pan.  Place cheese slices over top.  Cook, uncovered, in 350° oven until bubbly for 25 to 30 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: ITALIAN DRESSING(134 Calories a Bottle)
ingredients:
1/2  c. distilled white vinegar
1/2  c. water
1  Tbsp. Sunlight oil
1  tsp. crushed oregano
1  tsp. dehydrated onions
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. Sugar Twin
preparation: Mix and chill.

name: FIESTA SALAD(Good Diabetic Recipe)
ingredients:
2  medium sweet red peppers
1 (8 oz.)  can green beans, drained
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can white beans, drained
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can kidney beans, drained
1  small red onion, sliced thin
1  tsp. olive oil
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. black pepper
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
preparation: Cut red peppers in half and remove seeds.  Place on a broiling pan and flatten.  Broil 6 inches below heat for 8 minutes or until charred.  Allow to cool, then peel and cut into 1/2-inch slices.

name: PORK AND BEAN CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. shortening
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  medium onion
1/2  c. ketchup
2 (16 oz.)  cans pork and beans
1 1/2  cans water
preparation: Brown ground beef.  Add remaining ingredients.  Simmer.  Makes a really great chili that's fast and easy.

name: MEAT CROQUETTES
ingredients:
1  c. thick white sauce
1  tsp. minced onion
1  tsp. parsley
2  c. chopped beef, ham, pork or chicken
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. water
fine bread crumbs
preparation: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Shape into cones. Roll in flour, then dip in mixture of egg and water, then in fine bread crumbs. Fry in hot oil until a little brown, 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Drain on paper. Serve with gravy.

name: GOLDEN BARS
ingredients:
2/3  c. shortening
2  c. brown sugar, packed
2  eggs, well beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt shortening in pan which batter is to be mixed.  Remove from heat. Stir in remaining ingredients, first sifting flour, baking powder and salt together.  Spread in pan, 12 x 8 x 1-inch. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: RICE WITH WATER CHESTNUTS
ingredients:
1  c. rice
1  can onion soup
1  stick butter
1  can mushrooms, drained
1  can sliced water chestnuts
3/4  c. water
preparation: Put all ingredients into casserole dish and bake at 350° for approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Easy!  Good with chicken or beef.

name: EDITH'S PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  can chunk pineapple
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1  banana
1/2  c. cheese chunks
1/2  c. pineapple juice
2/3  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Add first 4 ingredients and refrigerate.  Can also add a container of whipped cream.

name: KEVIN'S FAVORITE SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  (27 1/2 oz.) Hunt's meat flavored sauce
spaghetti noodles
preparation: Brown hamburger in skillet.  Drain all grease.  Add sauce and garlic salt.  Let simmer for 15 minutes.  Pour mixture over cooked spaghetti.

name: STRAWBERRY BAVARIAN CREAM
ingredients:
1  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
miniature marshmallows
1  large whipped cream
2  to 3 bananas
preparation: Mix Jell-O as directed on package. Add strawberries to Jell-O; let set. Beat Jell-O with a beater; add whipped cream. Add marshmallows and bananas.

name: JAM THUMBPRINT GEMS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. vegetable shortening
1/4  c. applesauce
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 egg or 1/4  c. substitute
1/2  c. strawberry preserves or choose your favorite fruit preserves
powdered sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Lightly spray cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray.  In a large bowl, whisk vegetable shortening and applesauce until shortening breaks into pea size pieces.  Add sugar and beat well. Add vanilla and egg.   Mix well. Add flour mixture to applesauce mixture. Blend until smooth. Mixture will be stiff.  Using flour coated hands, roll a teaspoon of dough into  a ball.  Place on cookie sheets 1-inch apart. Press thumb into center to make indention. Fill with 1/2 teaspoon preserves.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes until light golden brown. Remove from oven and cool 10 minutes.  Place on cooling rack and dust with powdered sugar.  Makes 24 cookies.  Per serving contains 70 calories and 1.4 grams fat.

name: MEXICAN BEAN DIP
ingredients:
2  cans bean dip
1  c. sour cream
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1 small  can chopped black olives
1  c. chopped green onions
20  drops Tabasco sauce
1  c. Monterey Jack cheese, grated
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Mix everything except cheese together and put in baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.  Serve with corn chips or tortilla chips.

name: EGGPLANT PARMESAN INDIVIDUAL
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. eggplant
salt
1 crushed  clove garlic
1/4  c. olive oil
fresh tomato sauce
1  Tbsp. olive oil
2  cloves garlic, finely chopped
2  Tbsp. tomato paste
1  tsp. salt
1  c. fresh basil
2  c. shredded Mozzarella (6 oz.)
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Trim eggplant; cut in 1/4-inch thick rounds.  Layer slices in colander; set over bowl and sprinkle each layer lightly with salt. Let drain one hour.  Cook garlic in small saucepan in oil over medium heat until golden brown (1 minute).  Remove garlic. Preheat oven to 450°.  Coat 2 jelly roll pans with cooking spray. Place eggplant slices in a single layer.  Brush with garlic oil. Bake for 15 minutes, until lightly brown and tender.

name: OATMEAL CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. quick oats
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: Cover oats with water.  Let stand 20 minutes.  Cream butter, sugar and brown sugar together, then add eggs and remaining ingredients.  Bake until done at 350°.  Ice while still warm.

name: CREAM OF COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix with pudding
1 small  can cream of coconut
1  large tub Cool Whip
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  c. flaked coconut
preparation: Prepare white cake mix as to directions.  Pour batter into 15 x 9-inch jelly roll pan that has been greased and floured.  Bake at 325° about 20 minutes or until done.  Remove from oven.  Poke holes in cake with fork.  Mix cream of coconut and condensed milk, pour over warm cake.  Spread on pineapple.  Let cool completely. Top with Cool Whip.  Sprinkle on coconut.  Keep refrigerated.

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
round steak (1 1/2-inches thick)
3/4  c. flour
1/2  c. butter
1  c. water
1  c. tomato paste
1  tsp. mustard
3  onions
salt and pepper
preparation: Sift  dry  ingredients.  Beat  flour  into  steak;  fry onions in skillet.  Brown steak and place in casserole.  Rinse skillet with water	and  pour  over  steak.  Cover with tomato paste. Bake 1 hour at 375°.

name: STIR-FRIED GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh green beans
1 to 2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
3/4  c. chicken broth
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Wash and string beans.  Cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces.  Pour oil around top of preheated wok, allow to heat for 2 minutes.  Add beans.  Stir-fry 3 minutes.  Add chicken broth and sugar.  Cover. Reduce heat and cook 10 minutes.  Combine cornstarch and water; add to wok.  Cook beans until thickened.  Yields 4 servings.

name: VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  jar chopped pimentos
1  can tiny peas
1  can Shoepeg white corn
1  can French green beans
1  c. chopped green peppers
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped onions
preparation: Drain juices from the vegetables and reserve 1 tablespoon bean juice.

name: JALAPENO CORN BREAD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. yellow corn meal
1  c. milk
2  eggs, beaten
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  c. oil
1 (17 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1/4  c. chopped jalapenos or green chillies
1  onion, chopped
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
preparation: Brown meat; drain.  In large bowl, combine meal, milk, eggs, salt, soda, oil and corn.  Pour half the batter into greased iron skillet dusted with meal.  Add meat and top with remaining batter. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.  Yields 6 servings.

name: STUFFED ONIONS
ingredients:
4  large onions
8  slices bacon, cut in small squares
1/4  c. fresh chopped parsley
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1  tsp. dried marjoram
1  egg, beaten
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
salt and pepper to taste
1  small ripe tomato, peeled and diced
preparation: Very carefully hollow out onion, leaving shell 1/2-inch thick. Place shell in saucepan with water to cover; bring to boil and cook 6 minutes.  Place bacon in skillet set over medium heat until just about transparent.  Add chopped onions; saute 3 minutes until onions begin to color.  Remove and mix with the parsley, bread crumbs and marjoram.   Stir well and add beaten egg, Parmesan and salt and pepper to taste.  Stir in tomato pieces.  Spoon stuffing in onion shell.  Place in greased baking dish, cover dish with foil and bake 1 hour at 375° until they are tender when pierced with fork.  Let sit about 5 minutes before serving.

name: QUICHE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. sausage
1/2  c. onion
1  c. chopped broccoli
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
8  eggs
4  c. milk
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. Bisquick or Jiffy mix
preparation: Fry crumbled sausage and onion until browned.  Cook broccoli, then drain.  Beat together eggs, milk, pepper and mix.  Put sausage, onion, broccoli and cheese in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Pour egg mixture on top.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until set.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
3  eggs
1  c. milk (I use half and half cream)
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. sugar
pinch of salt
1  tsp. vanilla
sprinkle of nutmeg (desired amount)
preparation: Slowly add milk to eggs  which  have  been beaten well. Stir in other ingredients and  pour into a buttered casserole. Set casserole in shallow pan of  water  and  bake  at 325° for about an hour.

name: SPICY POPCORN
ingredients:
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. curry powder
1/2  tsp. turmeric
1/2  tsp. ginger
pinch of cayenne pepper
6  Tbsp. melted butter
6  c. freshly popped popcorn
preparation: Mix together the first 6 ingredients; toss with the freshly popped popcorn.  Serve warm.

name: 7 LAYER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce
1  head cauliflower
1  lb. bacon, fried crisp
1  small onion, chopped
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
2  c. Miracle Whip
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Chop lettuce and cauliflower in bite-size pieces.  Layer in order.  Cover and let set overnight.  Mix well before serving.

name: TURKEY SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. fresh ground turkey
8  oz. can tomato sauce
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. low-fat sour cream
1  Tbsp. dried onion flakes
1  tsp. dried dill weed
6  oz. uncooked spaghetti
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Generously butter 9-inch pie pan (1 1/2-inches deep).  Break spaghetti in half.  Cook in boiling water until tender.  Drain.

name: POTATO, CARROT, ZUCCHINI BAKE
ingredients:
2  c. grated zucchini
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  Tbsp. olive oil
1  c. chopped onions
2  tsp. chopped garlic
3  c. grated potatoes
1  c. grated carrots
3  Tbsp. chopped basil
1  Tbsp. chopped chives
3  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. light cream
preparation: Combine zucchini and salt in large bowl.  Let stand 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, heat olive oil and saute onion and garlic for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Place half of onions and a coating of oil in 9-inch pie plate.  Squeeze zucchini dry and combine with potatoes, carrots, basil, chives and cheese.  Pat into pie plate and top with remaining onions and garlic.  Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.  Pour cream over, lower heat to 350° and cook for 20 to 30 minutes longer or until cooked and browned.

name: OYSTER SNACK CRACKERS
ingredients:
1  pkg. oyster crackers
1  pkg. Hidden Valley dressing mix
1/2  c. oil
dill weed
garlic powder
preparation: Mix all together and put on cookie sheet.  Bake in low oven at 250° for 5 to 10 minutes.

name: CORN PIE
ingredients:
1 -2  oz. jar chopped pimentos
2  tbsp. melted butter
2  cups grated mild cheddar cheese
1  egg beaten
1 -15  oz. can cream style corn
3/4  cups bread or cracker crumbs
1  cup drained and mashed tomatoes
4  strips bacon
preparation: Melt butter in double boiler, add pimentos, cheese, egg, and corn.  Combine cracker crumbs and tomatoes, add to other ingredients.  Place in shallow baking dish, cover with additional cheese and bacon strips.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

name: TEQUILA PORK ROAST
ingredients:
2  cloves of garlic crushed plus 1 sliced thinly
1/2  cup orange juice
1/4  cup lime juice
1/4  cup lemon juice
1/2  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. dijon mustard
1/2  tsp. cilantro
1/2  tsp. crushed red pepper
1/4  cup tequila
1/2  cup salsa
preparation: Mix all ingredients together except sliced clove of garlic. Pour marinade ingredients together. Cut slits in pork roast and insert garlic slivers into the slits. Pour marinade and roast in a resealable bag and marinate at least 8 hours. You can grill or bake until done. Takes approximately 1 1/2 hrs. at 350°.

name: PINK STUFF
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. cherry flavored jello
1 small  carton cottage cheese
1 small  carton Cool Whip
1 small  can fruit cocktail, drained
preparation: Mix dry jello with Cool Whip.  Add cottage cheese.  Add drained fruit; refrigerate.

name: MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/4  c. unsifted flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. mustard
1 1/2  c. shredded cheese
3  c. cooked macaroni
preparation: In saucepan, melt butter.  Mix in flour and salt.  Add milk slowly, continually stirring over medium heat until sauce starts to boil.  Lower heat and cook until thickened.   Add mustard and cheese.  Stir over low heat until cheese melts.  Mix in cooked macaroni.

name: NEVER FAIL OIL CRUST
ingredients:
2  c. white flour
2  Tbsp. wheat germ
1  tsp. salt
2/3  c. oil
1/3  c. cold water
preparation: Stir together flour, salt and wheat germ.  In measuring cup combine oil and cold water.  Add into flour all at once.  Roll into 2 balls.  Roll out each ball between 2 sheets wax paper.  (To keep paper from shifting, dampen area where paper is placed.)  Bake sheets in 425° oven for 10 minutes.

name: POOR MAN'S BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
about 2 Tbsp. butter
minced onions
1  can mushrooms
approximately 1 lb. ground sirloin
1/2  c. sour cream (more or less)
garlic salt to taste
rice or noodles, cooked according to pkg.
preparation: In a large frying pan, put in the butter. Add mushrooms and saute 3 minutes.  Add some minced onions.  Saute some more until onions turn translucent yellow. Throw in hamburger and smash it all around until it turns dark grayish brown.  Drain off liquid. Add 1/2 cup sour cream and simmer while preparing rice or noodles. Put the rice or noodles on the plates.  Plop on the junk from the frying pan and add a blob of sour cream on top of it all.  Makes 4 to 8 servings.

name: RED VELVET CAKE FROSTING
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  box powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream butter, cream cheese and vanilla.  Add powdered sugar and beat until fluffy.

name: CROCK-POT ROAST
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. sirloin tip roast
2  Tbsp. butter
4  c. water
2  bay leaves
preparation: Rinse the roast in cold water and dry with paper towels.  Heat butter in a skillet over medium-high heat until it melts.  Brown the roast on all sides.  Place roast and any pan drippings in the crock-pot.  Cover with the water.  Add the bay leaves.  Cover the pot and cook on low for at least 8 hours.  You can use higher heat for a shorter cook time; however, the slower the meat cooks the better the flavor and tenderness will be.

name: OLD FASHIONED RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
3/4  c. rice
4 1/2  c. hot water
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook in top of double boiler until tender.

name: POLLY OLSON'S TEA COOKIES(Polly Was Pastry Chef At Oviedo Inn, Oviedo, Florida)
ingredients:
1/2  lb. margarine (2 sticks)
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking soda
pinch of salt
4  c. plain flour
2  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  tsp. ground nutmeg
preparation: In a large mixing bowl, cream margarine and sugar together. Add vanilla and flour, mixing well.  Add soda and salt; mix well. Add nutmeg and eggs.  Mix on medium speed until blended.  Pour out on well floured table or board.  Divide in half.  Roll out 2 strips about 2 inches thick.  Chill for about 2 hours.  Cut into 1/4-inch thick slices and place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated 375° oven until light brown.  Let cool before removing from cookie sheet.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick real butter
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. cake flour
1  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. buttermilk
2  oz. red food coloring
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. baking soda
preparation: You will need 3 round cake pans.

name: BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. margarine
1  small onion
3  Tbsp. flour
1  can evaporated milk
3  c. chicken broth
mushrooms as desired
1  c. Cheddar cheese
1  bunch broccoli
preparation: Melt margarine in heavy saucepan and add onion and stir in flour to make thick paste.  Add evaporated milk, chicken broth and salt to taste.  Chop broccoli and add to liquid.  Cover and simmer until broccoli is tender.  Add mushrooms and cheese.  Cook an additional 10 minutes.

name: KIX BARS
ingredients:
7  c. Kix cereal
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1  Tbsp. soft tub margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Place cereal in large mixing bowl.  In medium saucepan, combine sugar, corn syrup and margarine.  Cook over medium heat until sugar dissolves, stirring frequently.  Stir in vanilla. Pour over cereal; stir to coat.  Spread in 11 x 7-inch dish sprayed with vegetable cooking spray.  Press evenly in pan.  Cool. Makes 24 bars.

name: GERMAN CHOCOLATE CHESS BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix with pudding
1  large egg, lightly beaten
1/2  c. margarine, melted
1  c. chopped pecans
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
2  large eggs, lightly beaten
1 (16 oz.)  box powdered sugar
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients in large bowl.  Stir until dry ingredients are moist.  Pat in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Combine next 3 ingredients.  Pour over chocolate mix and spread evenly.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Cool and slice.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1  lb. Cheddar cheese, shredded
8  oz. processed cheese, shredded
4  oz. cream cheese
3  Tbsp. onion, minced
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. Texas Pete
1/2  tsp. (scant) garlic powder
2  tsp. seasoning salt
1/2  c. pecans, finely chopped
preparation: Place Cheddar cheese in mixing bowl with paddle attachment. Cream until smooth.  Add processed and cream cheese.  Whip until light and fluffy.  Add remaining ingredients.  Again, whip until fluffy.  Place mixture in plastic wrap and chill in refrigerator. Remove wrap and shape mixture into a ball or other desired shape. Coat with pecans.  Serve with crackers.

name: MICROWAVE SWEET PICKLES
ingredients:
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. mustard seed
1/4  tsp. allspice
1  c. sugar
1  or 2 onions, thinly sliced
1/4  tsp. turmeric
1/4  tsp. celery seed
1/2  c. white vinegar
4  c. cucumbers (unpeeled), thinly sliced
preparation: In small bowl, combine salt, turmeric, mustard seed, celery seed, allspice, vinegar and sugar. Mix cucumbers and onions in microwave-safe bowl. Pour vinegar mixture over and cook, uncovered, on HIGH for 5 minutes. Stir well. Cook for 5 minutes more. Cool. Pour into a sterilized quart jar. Refrigerate.

name: CRAB CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. crab meat
1  egg
1  tsp. mustard
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  slice bread, crumbled
salt
pepper
crab seasoning
1/4  c. milk
corn flake crumbs
1/2  stick margarine
paprika
preparation: Mix together and put in baking dish.  Add 1/4 cup milk.  Cover with corn flake crumbs.  Dot with margarine and sprinkle paprika. Bake about 25 minutes in oven at 325° to 350°.

name: FRIED SWEET POTATOES
ingredients:
3  large sweet potatoes
1 1/2  sticks margarine
preparation: Peel and slice potatoes into cool water.  Place oil into large frying pan.  Heat butter.  Add potatoes and fry.  Add brown sugar. When potatoes are half fried, finish cooking until tender.

name: BUTTER PECAN ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1  c. chopped pecans
1  stick butter
eggs
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  can evaporated milk
1  c. Mrs. Butterworth's syrup
preparation: Saute pecans in butter.  Beat eggs for 5 minutes.  Add sugar and beat 5 minutes more.  Then add vanilla, milk and syrup; mix well, then add pecans.  Mix and pour into ice cream freezer.  Add milk to fill line, then freeze.

name: SPICY CRISPY CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  (approximately 1 1/2 lb.) chicken breast halves, boned and skinned
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  c. cornflake crumbs
1/2  tsp. ground red pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Dip chicken in egg; coat with combined remaining ingredients.  Place in greased shallow baking dish. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.  Makes 6 servings.

name: TAYLOR FAMILY LEMON PECAN CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. real butter
2  c. sugar
6  eggs
4  c. flour
4  c. pecans, coarsely broken
2  oz. pure lemon extract
1  lb. white raisins
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. candied cherries, halved
preparation: Grease and flour large Bundt or angel food cake pan.  Cream butter and sugar together.  Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Add lemon extract.  Mix baking powder and flour together.  Add flour a little at a time to creamed mixture, until well blended.  Fold in other ingredients.  Bake in 275° to 300° oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

name: GI GI AND MEE MA RUTLAND'S HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
2  c. plain meal
1/2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs
1  c. sweet milk
1 small  can evaporated milk
1  small onion, chopped fine
preparation: Mix dry ingredients together.  Add eggs, sweet milk and onion. It may not take the entire can of milk.  Have batter stiff enough that you can drop by small spoonfuls into hot Wesson oil where the fish have been fried.  (Use a deep pot or Fry Baby cooker.)  The hush puppies will pop up; turn over and cook on the other side. Drain on paper towels.

name: PICKLED BEETS
ingredients:
6  c. vinegar
5  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1  Tbsp. mustard seed
preparation: Cook beets separately until tender (do not overcook). Peel and put beets into glass jars.  Mix together vinegar, sugar, celery seed, and mustard seed and bring to a boil.  Apply boiling vinegar mixture to beets and seal.  Do not process.

name: ORANGE BALLS
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  box vanilla wafers
1  c. coconut
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. powdered sugar
1 small  can frozen orange juice
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and form into small balls.  Roll in powdered sugar.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.  Yields 5 to 6 dozen.

name: SPINACH, BACON AND MUSHROOM SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh spinach
6  slices bacon, crisply cooked and crumbled
1/4  lb. large mushrooms, thinly sliced
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1/4  c. olive oil
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Cut the stems off the spinach and wash the leaves well in cold water. Drain leaves and place in a salad bowl. Add bacon and mushrooms. Mix together the vinegar, oil, salt and pepper.  Pour over salad and toss well. Serves 6.

name: SUNOMONO
ingredients:
2  cucumbers, peeled and sliced very thin
2  carrots, grated
1/4  c. chopped, cooked shrimp, chicken or ham
2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. white vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
preparation: Combine the vegetables, meat and salt.  Combine the vinegar and sugar.  Pour this over the vegetables.  Stir well. Refrigerate several hours.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  small onion, chopped
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  small container sour cream
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  c. yellow rice, cooked
1  chicken bouillon cube
salt and pepper to taste
1 small  box cheese bits crackers, crushed
1  stick butter
preparation: Place broccoli, onion and bouillon cube in casserole dish. Cover with water and microwave for 10 to 12 minutes.  Drain.  Mix broccoli with soup, sour cream, cheese, salt and pepper.  Add yellow rice.  Pour into well-greased casserole dish.  Mix cracker crumbs with melted butter.  Place on top of broccoli.  Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until bubbly.

name: BALSAMIC DRESSING
ingredients:
1/2  c. balsamic vinegar
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. oil (olive)
preparation: Mix in blender. Slowly add oil in a slow stream; process until smooth. Cover and chill.

name: BAKING POWDER BISCUITS
ingredients:
1/3  c. shortening
1 3/4  c. flour
2 1/2  Tbsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Cut flour, baking powder and salt into the shortening.  Add milk sparingly and stir until the dough leaves the sides of the bowl.  Turn dough on floured surface, roll to a thickness of 1/2-inch.  Cut dough with biscuit cutter, set on cookie sheet 1-inch apart.  Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.

name: MY MOTHER'S ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or other shortening
2  c. sugar
4  eggs, separated
3  c. sifted cake flour
1/4  tsp. salt
3  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream the shortening and sugar until fluffy.  Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating thoroughly after each one is added.  Sift dry ingredients together 3 times and add alternately with milk and vanilla to creamed mixture, beating until smooth after each addition.  Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.  Pour into pans lined with waxed paper and bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes. Makes 3 (9-inch) layers.  Or bake in a tube-cake pan in a 325° oven for 1 hour.

name: SPROUT SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. alfalfa sprouts
1  c. wheat sprouts
1  c. mung bean sprouts
1  c. sunflower seed sprouts
1/4  c. green pepper, finely chopped
1/4  c. green onions, chopped
1  large avocado, chopped
poppy seed dressing
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl.  Toss lightly with dressing and serve immediately.

name: AFRICAN PICKLES
ingredients:
1 (46 oz.)  jar whole kosher dill pickles, or whole kosher baby dills
1  teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
3  cloves garlic, slivered
1/2  lb. (1 cup firmly packed) light brown sugar
preparation: Drain pickles; reserve juice.  Cut pickles in quarters lengthwise, then in half through middle, to get 8 pieces from each pickle, put pickles back into jar, layering with red pepper and garlic.  Dissolve brown sugar in pickle juice, holding back 1/2 cup juice which will be displaced by sugar.  Pour over pickles in jar. Let sit at room temperature 24 hours, then refrigerate before serving.

name: M&M COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. M&M's (1 bag plain)
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla thoroughly.  Sift together flour, soda and salt.  Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture.  Mix well.  Stir in 1/2 of the M&M's.  Reserve the rest of the M&M's for decorating.  Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.  Decorate with the remaining M&M's.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Makes 6 dozen cookies.

name: PUMPKIN ROLL(Yields 1 Roll)
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. pumpkin (canned)
1  tsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
powdered sugar
preparation: Beat eggs for 5 minutes.  Gradually add regular sugar.  Fold in pumpkin.  Add lemon juice.  Mix well.  In another bowl, put flour, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and salt.  Mix with pumpkin mixture by hand.  Line 17 x 12-inch cookie sheet with wax paper.  Pour mixture on wax paper and bake for 15 minutes at 370°. When done baking, turn over on dish towel that has been sprinkled a lot with powdered sugar.  Let cool just a couple of minutes, then very easily peel wax paper from pumpkin roll.  Next, very easily roll up in the towel and let cool for about an hour. After cake part has cooled for the hour, unroll it and spread the filling on it.  Roll it back up (without the towel).

name: CHICKEN TORTILLA ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
8  to 10-inch flour tortillas
1  Tbsp. salad oil
1/4  tsp. chili powder
2 (5 to 6 3/4 oz.)  cans chunk chicken
2  cans Northern beans
3  Tbsp. bottled salsa
4  oz. shredded Monterey Jack or Mozzarella cheese
sour cream (optional)
preparation: You just cook it.  When it is cold then you eat it in the kitchen with ice cream sandwiches and sprinkles.

name: BLACK BEAN AND CORN SALAD
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. extra virgin olive oil
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
1  tsp. cumin
1/3  c. chopped cilantro (fresh)
1 (15 oz.)  can black beans, drained and rinsed
1 (7 oz.)  can corn, drained
1/4  c. chopped sweet onion, Vidalia or red
2  plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped
shredded Monterey Jack cheese (optional)
preparation: Combine olive oil, vinegar, mustard, cumin and cilantro; set aside. combine beans, corn, onion and tomatoes.  Drizzle dressing over bean mixture.  Stir together gently to avoid breaking the beans.  May be topped with shredded Monterey Jack cheese if desired.  Serves 4 to 6. Should go with Chicken Tostada recipe.

name: PERFECT PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  unbaked pastry shell
3  beaten eggs
1  stick butter or margarine, melted
1  c. dark Karo syrup
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coarsely chopped pecans
preparation: Beat eggs, sugar, syrup, salt and vanilla.  Melt butter; add and beat vigorously.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans (16 oz. each) cut green beans or 2 pkg. (9 oz.  each) frozen cut green beans
1 (2.8 oz.)  can French fried onions
1  can cream of mushroom soup
salt and pepper to taste
3/4  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  If using frozen beans, cook and drain; canned beans, drain.  In medium bowl, combine beans, milk, soup, salt, pepper and 1/2 can French fried onions.  Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.  Top with remaining onions; bake, uncovered, 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown.  Makes 6 servings.

name: PEANUT BUTTER GEMS
ingredients:
2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  c. crunchy peanut butter
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. butter
3/4  lb. confectioners sugar, sifted
preparation: Mix all together but the chocolate chips and put in a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Spread melted chocolate chips on top.  Chill and cut into squares.  Don't chill too long!

name: FRIED APPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo, melted
1  c. sugar
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese, shredded
3/4  c. self-rising flour
2  cans fried apples
preparation: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Put in apples.  Pour butter over apples.  Combine sugar, cheese and flour.  Pour over apples. Cover and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Uncover and cook until golden brown.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS IN WINE MUSHROOM-RICE PILAF
ingredients:
3  large chicken breasts, boned, skinned and halved
salt and pepper
1  c. vermouth
1  tsp. tarragon
2  cloves garlic
3 to 4  Tbsp. Parmesan
paprika
2  c. rice
1  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. mushrooms, sliced
6  large scallions (white part only)
1  stick butter or margarine
2  c. chicken broth
preparation: Season both sides of chicken pieces with salt and pepper.  Mix vermouth, tarragon and garlic.  Add chicken.  Marinate at room temperature 1 hour, turning occasionally.  Fold chicken pieces in half lengthwise.  Place in greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch dish.  Pour marinade on top.  Sprinkle with cheese and paprika.  Bake, uncovered, in preheated 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.  Serve on Mushroom-Rice Pilaf.

name: BASIC "BAKER'S CLAY"(Non-Edible)
ingredients:
4  c. flour
1  c. salt
1 1/2  c. water
preparation: In a  large  flat bottomed bowl mix flour and salt with rubber spatula  or  wooden spoon.	Add water slowly, mixing as you pour. Additional	water  may  be	needed depending on the humidity of the weather.  However, use caution in adding more water as	the dough  should  be  very stiff for best results. Knead for  10 minutes.  Dough  is  ready	to use when texture appears soft  and smooth.  Bake cookie creations in a 325° to 350° oven.  Allow  1/2 hour baking time per 1/4 inch thickness of dough.  Average time is 1 hour.

name: ZIPPY CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, cubed
1  jar (8 oz.) picante sauce
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain well.  Melt cheese and add picante sauce.  Combine meat and cheese mixture.  Serve hot with tortilla chips.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1 large or 2 small (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
1 large  can evaporated milk
1 (3 oz. size)  box lemon jello
1  c. sugar
1/4  lb. oleo or butter
24  graham crackers (whole squares), crushed  (leave small amount to sprinkle over top)
preparation: Chill evaporated milk.  Dissolve jello with 1 cup hot water and chill.  Do not let it get hard, just firm.  Melt butter and combine with the crushed graham crackers.

name: BARBECUE SPARERIBS
ingredients:
1  lb. spareribs
1  c. catsup
1/4  c. Regina wine vinegar
1  onion, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Place ribs in baking dish.  Mix remaining ingredients and pour over ribs.  Bake in 325° oven for 2 hours.

name: DILLED GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
4 to 6  cans cut green beans, drained
1/4  c. onions, chopped
1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. dill weed
3  Tbsp. cider vinegar
preparation: Mix last 6 ingredients and combine with green beans.  Mix well and refrigerate.  Prepare 24 hours before serving.

name: DORITO CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. Doritos
1  stalk celery, diced
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can tomatoes, drained
1  stew chicken
1  c. grated cheese
1  medium onion
1  bell pepper
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Stew chicken with celery; cool, bone and cube.  In large bowl, mix crushed Doritos, grated cheese, onion, both soups, bell pepper and tomatoes.  Add diced chicken; mix well.  Put into casserole dish; top with grated cheese.  Put into oven and bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: MICROWAVE PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2  c. milk
2  egg yolks
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, cornstarch, flour and salt together, mix in milk. Microwave 7 to 10 minutes, stirring every 3 minutes.

name: PIGS IN A BLANKET
ingredients:
1 1/2  sticks butter
1/2  c. warm water
2  pkg. dry yeast
2  c. warm milk
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
8 to 9  c. sifted flour
preparation: Combine butter and milk in pan; stir until warm.  Mix yeast, water and 2 teaspoons sugar in bowl.  Beat eggs and add to milk and butter.  Combine with yeast and add 1/2 cup sugar and 2 teaspoons salt.  Add flour, about 8 1/2 cups.  Let mixture set for 15 minutes.  Mix well.  Add more flour until smooth.  Let rise until double in size.  Work down and let rise again.  Divide into egg size portions and form around small link sausage.  Let rise again.  Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes.

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
1  qt. lemon juice
5  lb. sugar
4 large (46 oz.)  cans pineapple juice
2  Tbsp. almond extract
4  qt. ginger ale
2  gal. water
food coloring, if desired
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  When ready to serve, add ice.  Serves 100 people.

name: SOUR CREAM APPLE PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
3  c. sliced apples, peeled
3  Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
1/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: In large bowl beat eggs, add sour cream.  Stir in sugar, 2 tablespoons flour, vanilla and salt; mix well.  Stir in apples. Pour in pie shell.  Bake at 350° to 375° for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile combine butter, brown sugar and remaining flour.  Sprinkle on top. Bake 20 to 25 minutes more.

name: CHOCOLATE CHEWS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1/2  c. softened butter
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Melt chocolate in double boiler and set aside.  In large bowl, beat butter and 1 cup sugar until creamy, then beat in eggs and melted chocolate.  In another bowl, stir together flour, salt, baking powder and baking soda.  Gradually add to the butter mixture and blend thoroughly.  Place remaining 1/4 cup sugar in a small bowl.  Roll dough into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar to coat.  Place 2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes or until tops appear dry.  Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

name: PERFECT APPLE PIE
ingredients:
6  c. thinly sliced tart apples
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
dash of ground nutmeg
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Combine sugar, flour, spices and dash of salt.  Mix with apples.  Fill pie crust with apple mixture.  Dot with butter. Adjust top crust, cutting slits for escape of steam; seal.

name: VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. vinegar
1/3  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  box frozen broccoli
1  head cauliflower (fresh or frozen), chopped
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients, then add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate overnight.  Lasts for a week or more.

name: ITALIAN CRESCENT RING
ingredients:
2  tubes (8 count) crescent rolls
1  lb. ground beef
1  can pizza sauce
8  oz. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef;  drain. Add pizza sauce. Heat oven according to crescent roll package. On round baking stone (or greased round pan), unroll 8 crescent rolls; divide into triangles. Make circle with short side in center and points sticking out. Make second circle; match short sides to first 8 with these points to the inside. Spoon ground beef mixture where 2 circles meet. Top with cheese; fold points up over meat from center and outside. Bake per roll instructions plus about 3 to 4 minutes, until rolls are brown.

name: GERMAN SWEET CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. Baker's German sweet chocolate
1/3  c. milk
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Cool Whip, thawed
1  graham cracker pie crust
preparation: Heat chocolate and 2 tablespoons milk in a saucepan over low heat, stirring until melted.  Beat sugar in cream cheese.  Add remaining milk and chocolate mixture and beat until smooth.  Fold in whipped topping, blending until smooth.  Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm about 4 hours.  Garnish with whipped topping. Let stand at room temperature for about 1 hour before serving.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  medium zucchini, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  c. tomatoes
1  tsp. salt
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. chopped cheese
preparation: Cook squash; drain.  Cook onion and celery until celery is tender.  Mix zucchini, onion, celery, tomatoes, cheese and salt. Add cream of chicken soup.  Pour into casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for about 25 minutes.  Put four slices of cheese on top. Return to oven long enough for cheese to melt.

name: COCONUT ORANGE BALLS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice (do not add water to juice)
1 (6 to 8 oz.)  pkg. coconut
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. vanilla wafers, crushed
1  lb. powdered sugar
1  stick margarine
1 1/2  c. finely chopped pecans
preparation: Mix well crushed vanilla wafers, sugar and nuts.  Add orange juice and melted margarine.  Mix well.  Form into small balls and roll in coconut.  Store in a cool place.  Yields:  100.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
1  lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cubed
1  onion, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen corn, thawed
1  c. chicken broth
1  c. salsa (mild)
1 1/2  c. Minute rice
1/2  c. (2 oz.) Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: In large skillet heat oil and cook chicken, onion and pepper until chicken is cooked.  Add corn, chicken broth and salsa and bring to boil.

name: RAISIN MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening (Crisco or butter)
1  c. sugar
1  egg, beaten
1  c. Brer Rabbit molasses
4 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. soda
3/4  c. boiling water
1  c. raisins
preparation: Mix shortening, sugar and beaten egg.  Sift together and add flour, cinnamon, ginger and soda.  Cook together boiling water and raisins.  Add to mixture.  Drop by teaspoon.  Bake for 10 minutes in 375° oven.  Frost them with a plain powdered sugar frosting when cool, if you wish.

name: PARTY CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, deboned and skinned
4  slices bacon
1/2  pkg. (2 oz.) dried beef, torn into pieces
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  carton sour cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Wrap each breast with sliced bacon. Cover bottom of greased 8 x 12-inch baking pan with beef.  Lay chicken on beef.  Mix soup and sour cream and pour over top of chicken.  Bake, uncovered, 1 hour.  Serves 4.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  (2 lb.) bag frozen hash browns, thawed
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  c. sour cream
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 1/2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  stick margarine, melted
black pepper to taste
1  c. corn flakes, crushed
1/4  c. margarine, melted
preparation: Mix first 7 ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.  Mix corn flakes and 1/4 cup butter.  Pour on top of other mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

name: ANGEL WINGS(Chrusciki)
ingredients:
16  egg yolks
1/2  juice of lemon
2  tsp. vanilla
6  c. flour
2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Add salt and vanilla to eggs and beat until thick; add lemon juice, sugar and sour cream and continue to beat.  Fold in flour and knead until dough blisters.  Roll dough out very thin and cut into strips about 4-inches long.  Slit each piece in the center and pull one end through the slit.  Fry in hot fat, 350° to 400°, until lightly browned.   Drain on paper towel and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: BUTTERMILK PANCAKES
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
4  c. buttermilk
4  eggs
1  stick margarine (1/2 c.)
preparation: Beat eggs until blended.  Melt margarine.  Set aside.  Measure dry ingredients.  Add eggs, margarine and buttermilk to dry ingredients.  Mix until blended (batter should have lumps).  Pour 1/4 cup batter or as desired on hot griddle.  Serve with favorite warm syrup.

name: OREO PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Oreo cookies
1  stick butter
1/2  gal. ice cream (vanilla)
1 large  carton Cool Whip
1  jar Hershey's chocolate fudge ice cream topping
preparation: Melt butter in baking pan.  Crumble cookies and spread over butter for first layer.  (Save a few cookies for top.)  Spread soft ice cream over cookie crumbs.

name: NIGHT BEFORE MASHED POTATOES
ingredients:
8  to 10 potatoes, peeled
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  c. sour cream
salt and pepper to taste
butter
preparation: Boil and drain potatoes. Whip hot potatoes, adding cream cheese and sour cream. Continue beating until fluffy and smooth. Add salt and pepper. Place in a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Dot generously with butter. Cover with foil and refrigerate. Bake, covered with foil, 15 minutes at 325°. Continue baking, uncovered, for 20 minutes.

name: ITALIAN VEGETABLE DISH
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant, peeled and diced
1  large tomato, chopped
1  large zucchini, sliced
1  small onion, finely minced
clove garlic, finely minced
dash of each:  basil, oregano, parsley, black pepper and rosemary
4  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Place eggplant, tomato, zucchini, onion and garlic in microwave-safe dish.  Sprinkle with herbs.  Cover and cook on High for 5 minutes.  Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese before serving.

name: SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients:
1  head iceberg lettuce, chopped
3  stalks diced celery
1  pkg. frozen peas, broken apart
1  lb. shrimp meat, rinsed and drained
1 large  can Chinese noodles
1 to 1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Place in large bowl in order (except noodles, mayonnaise and salt and pepper).  Cover with lid and allow to set at least 1 hour. This results in vegetables being crisp.  When ready to serve, add Chinese noodles and toss with mayonnaise, salt and pepper to taste. Be sure to mix well.  Can be served with French and butter as main dish.

name: CHICKEN PICCATA
ingredients:
1  egg
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. flour
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. paprika
4  chicken breast filets
1/4  c. margarine
2  tsp. instant chicken bouillon
1/2  c. boiling water
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Beat egg with 1 tablespoon lemon juice in bowl.  Mix flour, garlic powder and paprika in shallow dish.  Rinse chicken and pat dry.  Dip in egg mixture; coat with flour mixture.  Brown on both sides in margarine in skillet.

name: GELATIN/SOUR CREAM MOLD
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry gelatin
1  packet plain gelatin
1 3/4  c. boiling water
1 (16 oz.)  can whole cranberry sauce
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (do not drain)
1 to 2  c. sour cream
preparation: Dissolve all the gelatin in boiling water.  Stir in the cranberry sauce and the undrained pineapple until the sauce melts. Chill.  Pour one-half of the mixture into a 6 1/2 cup oiled mold. Chill until almost firm.  (Let the remaining mixture stand at room temperature).  Spread sour cream evenly over the gelatin in the mold; chill again.  Spoon the remaining gelatin mix on top of the sour cream layer and chill until firm.  Serves twelve.

name: MOCK CHERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. cranberries
1  lb. seeded raisins
butter (the size of walnut)
1  lb. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. cold water
3  Tbsp. starch or flour
preparation: Take cold water in a saucepan and allow to boil for 5 minutes. Thicken with starch or flour; allow to cool.  Makes two 9-inch pies.

name: GRAHAM SQUARES
ingredients:
1  pkg. graham cracker crumbs
2  lb. marshmallows (small)
1/2  c. walnuts
1/2  c. cherries
1  c. sweetened condensed milk
coconut
preparation: Mix together crumbs, marshmallows, walnuts, cherries and milk. Put layer of coconut on bottom of pan.  Add mixture.   Cover with coconut; refrigerate.

name: HOMEMADE CRACKERS(Wheat Thins)
ingredients:
3  c. uncooked oatmeal
2  c. flour
1  c. wheat germ
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
3/4  c. oil
1  c. water
preparation: Mix all ingredients; roll out onto 2 cookie sheets.  Sprinkle with salt.  Lightly roll again to press salt in.  Cut into squares or diamonds with pizza cutter.  Bake at 350°.  After 20 minutes, begin to check.  Outer ones are done first.  Remove as they turn golden brown and hard.

name: SALISBURY STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  egg
1  onion, minced
1/2  c. milk
1  c. cornflakes, crushed
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
flour and cooking oil
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Combine meat, egg, onion, milk, cornflakes, salt and pepper. Form into 6 to 8 patties.  Roll in flour and brown in hot oil. Place patties in baking dish and cover with mushroom soup.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: DELIGHTFUL FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, drained
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  egg, beaten
1  c. pecans, chopped
3  bananas, sliced
2 (11 oz.)  cans mandarin oranges, drained
2  medium apples, chopped
1/4  lb. purple seedless grapes, cut in halves
1/4  lb. white seedless grapes, cut in halves
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving juice.  Combine sugar, flour, egg and pineapple juice in a small saucepan.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and thickened.  Cool.  Combine pecans and fruit; add dressing, stirring well.  Chill before serving.  Makes 10 to 12 servings.  May want to put bananas in just before serving.

name: CORNBREAD SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Mexican cornbread mix, cooked as directed
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped tomatoes
1  c. chopped broccoli
4  boiled eggs, chopped
1  can whole kernel corn
1  pkg. Ranch style dressing
preparation: Mix according to package directions.  Crumble cornbread and mix all ingredients.  Store in refrigerator.

name: ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
2  boxes diet Jell-O (any kind)
juice (any kind)
1 (No. 2)  can unsweetened pineapple, drained (reserve juice)
1  carton cottage cheese
1  carton Dream Whip
preparation: Break cake and press it in a sheet pan bottom.  Bring juice and Jell-O to a boil, then add can of pineapple, cottage cheese and Dream Whip.  Mix all up in a bowl and pour over cake.  Keep in fridge.  Really good if you are on a diet.

name: CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  sticks butter
3  large eggs
1  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. baking powder
1/4  c. water
2  c. flour
1  c. cornmeal
2  c. milk
preparation: Blend together the sugar, butter, eggs and salt.  Add remaining ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 365° to 375° for 35 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE CRESCENTS MEAT PIES
ingredients:
1  box Pillsbury pie crusts
1/2  lb. turkey or regular sausage
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. yellow raisins
1/4  c. green olives, chopped
garlic powder to taste
chili powder to taste
preparation: Cook sausage (crumbled).  Add onion, raisins, olives and chili and garlic powders to taste.  When cooked, process meat until raisins are ground small.  Cut crusts into circles (24).  Put 1 teaspoon meat mixture in circle and fold over to seal with fork. Brush tops with beaten egg to make brown.  Put on cookie sheet (Pam sprayed) and bake at 350° about 12 minutes.

name: VEG-ALL CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans Veg-All, drained
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can sliced water chestnuts
1  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2  stick margarine
cracker crumbs
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Cool and put in refrigerator overnight.  Sprinkle cheese over top. Cover with cracker crumbs.  Melt margarine; pour over top of cracker crumbs.  Heat on 450° until brown.

name: SWEET AND SOUR BROCCOLI AND CAULIFLOWER
ingredients:
3/4  lb. fresh broccoli or 10 oz. frozen broccoli
3/4  lb. fresh cauliflower or 1 (10 oz.) frozen
4  slices bacon
2  green onions, minced
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
3/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Cook broccoli and cauliflower separately.  Cook fresh vegetables until tender-crisp.   Put into warm serving dish.

name: GRIESNOCKEL(Cream of Wheat Soup)
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. margarine
2/3  c. Cream of Wheat
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
1/2  gal. chicken broth
preparation: Make a paste with the first 4 ingredients. Let set for 5 minutes. With a teaspoon, form mixture into dumpling shapes. Drop into the boiling broth. Cook for 25 minutes. Add more broth as needed. Since eggs are different, drop in one dumpling into the broth to see if it will stay together. If it falls apart, add a little more Cream of Wheat and try again until it will stay together. Serves 6 to 8 for lunch.

name: CHOW MEIN
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. pork, cut up
2  to 3 large onions
3 to 4  c. cut up celery
1  can bean sprouts
1  jar mushrooms
sliced water chestnuts
2  Tbsp. brown gravy sauce
1 to 1 1/2  c. water
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Brown pork very good and simmer for at least 1 hour, even 2. Add onions, cut up and browned.  Add celery (cut up) and simmer a little longer.  Add bean sprouts, mushrooms, water chestnuts and about 2 tablespoons of brown gravy sauce.  Mix about 4 tablespoons of cornstarch in with water and pour into first ingredients.  Serve over chow mein noodles with rice on the side.  Serves 10 to 12 people.

name: MERINGUE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  Egg whites, large
Pinch of salt
1/4  tsp. Cream of Tartar
2/3  c. Sugar
1 1/2  tsp. Vanilla
1/2  tsp. Almond Extract
1  c. Chopped Walnuts
3/4  c. Chocolate chips; Butterscotch Chips or
Peppermint Candy Cane (crushed)
preparation: Heat the oven to 350°.  Lightly grease 2 cookie sheets.  In an electric mixer, beat the egg whites until frothy.  Add salt and cream of tartar.  When whites become firm, gradually add sugar, then vanilla and almond extract.  When the mixture forms stiff peaks and looks shiny stop beating and add nuts and chips.  Drop by teaspoonfuls on to the cookie sheet.  Place in the oven and turn off the heat.  Leave overnight.  Don't peek!!!!!!!!!!!

name: HEAVENLY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime jello
1 small  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  c. nut meats (toasted pecans)
1  c. boiling water
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. whipped cream
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water, stirring until dissolved. Mix cream cheese with pineapple and nuts.  Fold into cooled jello mixture.  Add whipped cream and chill.

name: COW FLOPS
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1  stick oleo
1/4  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
3 1/2  c. oatmeal
