preparation: In saucepan combine first four ingredients.  Bring to boil; reduce to medium heat for 2 1/2 minutes.  Remove from heat; add vanilla.  Mix in coconut and oatmeal and drop quickly from teaspoon on wax paper or tray and let cool.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: CURRY CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
3  chicken breasts
1  carrot, chopped
1  small onion, chopped
1  tsp. salt
20  oz. frozen broccoli
10 1/2  oz. cream of chicken soup
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Boil chicken with salt until tender.  Cook broccoli, carrot and onion; drain.  Place chicken and vegetables in buttered baking dish.  Mix other ingredients, spread on top and cover with bread crumbs.  Drizzle with melted butter on top.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: ANITA'S SHRIMP DISH COUVILLION
ingredients:
5  lb. pkg. shrimp
4 to 5  c. rice
celery
bell pepper
regular onion
green onion
1  stick butter
Tony's and garlic powder
cayenne pepper (if you want it hot)
5 to 6  Tbsp. flour or cornstarch
8 small  cans tomato sauce
8  cans water
preparation: Use shrimp that we order from the hospital.  This feeds about 35 to 40 people.  Cook a pot of rice and set aside.  Cut up celery, bell pepper, regular onion and green onion.  I call this trinity.  In a large saucepan, after you have melted butter, make a layer of trinity and a layer of shrimp (seasoned with Tony's and garlic powder, you may add some cayenne pepper if you want it hot) and sprinkle flour or cornstarch over this.  Add tomato sauce and water.  Cook until the shrimp are done.  Serve over rice.  Do not let it stick.

name: SQUASH DRESSING
ingredients:
2  c. cooked yellow squash
1/2  stick (4 Tbsp.) melted oleo
1  large onion, chopped
2  c. crumbled cornbread (Mexi style pkg.)
1  can cream of chicken soup
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients into a casserole.  Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 400°.

name: CARROT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. applesauce
1  c. whole wheat flour
1/2  c. white flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. shredded raw carrots
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. shelled walnuts
2  eggs
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Lightly coat a loaf pan with oleo or butter, then dust with flour.  Mix sugar and applesauce in a bowl. Combine dry ingredients and add to applesauce mixture.  Add carrots, vanilla and nuts.  Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Mix well. Pour into bread pan and bake for 50 minutes.  Serve with soups, hearty salads and stews.  Very good toasted with butter or cream cheese.

name: HOT ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. dry yeast
2  c. real warm (not hot) water
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. melted shortening (Crisco)
2  eggs
7 to 8  c. flour
preparation: In a large bowl, dissolve dry yeast in warm water.  Add sugar and salt.  Beat and add shortening.  Then add eggs and mix well. Add flour, 2 cups at a time.  I use 7 1/2 cups.  Mix well.  I use mixer, up to 4 cups, then mix the rest with my hands.  Do not knead.  Put into large, greased bowl and let rise, about 3 hours. I cover my bowl with a tea towel dampened with warm water.  It keeps the dough from getting dry on top.

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large  can pineapple juice
1 large  can orange juice
1 large  bottle ginger ale
1/2  carton lime sherbet
preparation: Pour juices and ginger ale in a punch bowl. Spoon in sherbet. Let stand about 20 minutes before serving.

name: MEXICAN FRIED ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
2  c. corn flake crumbs
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs
oil (for deep frying)
honey
whipped cream
preparation: Scoop 4 to 5 balls of ice cream and keep frozen.  Mix corn flakes with cinnamon and sugar.  Roll balls in crumbs and freeze again.  Beat eggs and dip coated balls in remaining crumbs and freeze until ready to serve.  Heat deep hot oil to 350°.  Place ice cream on slotted spoon and lower into hot oil for 1 minute.  Place in champagne glass or dessert plate.  Drizzle with honey and top with whipped cream.  Continue to fry balls one at a time.

name: CREAM OF CHICKEN SOUP
ingredients:
1  pkg. or 4 chicken breasts
1  can cream of celery soup
1  pkg. noodles
2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Boil  chicken  breasts; debone and set aside.  Stir in 1 can cream  of celery soup in chicken broth.  Cook noodles slow until tender  and  drain.  Add  noodles and chicken to chicken broth. Add cheese, a little at a time, until cheese is melted. Add salt and pepper to taste.

name: KAHLUA
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3  c. water
10  tsp. coffee
1  qt. vodka
4  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, water and coffee; simmer 1 hour.  Chill 1 hour. Add vodka and vanilla.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice
1/4  c. oil
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. green pepper
1  (28 oz.) whole tomatoes
1 1/2  c. water
1  beef bouillon cube
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Brown rice lightly in oil in a 10-inch skillet.  Add onion and green pepper, saute until onion is transparent.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Simmer, covered, over medium heat 20 to 25 minutes.

name: APPLE PECAN PIE
ingredients:
5  to 6 tart apples
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
dash of salt
1/4  c. melted butter
1/3  c. flour
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Peel,  core  and  slice  apples  in  a mixing bowl.  Mix sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, flour and salt with apples.  Mix well. Let stand 20 minutes.  Sprinkle 1/4 cup pecans in bottom of pie shell  and cover with apple mixture.  Mix melted butter, flour, brown  sugar,  cinnamon  and  chopped  pecans.  Mix well; cover apple mixture with this mixture. Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350°. Serve plain or with whipped cream or ice cream.

name: GRANOLA-BREAKFAST CEREAL
ingredients:
12  c. quick oats
4  c. brown sugar
2  c. coconut
8  c. whole-wheat flour
3  c. melted butter
4  tsp. soda
1 to 2  c. chocolate chips or raisins
preparation: Mix together first 6 ingredients as you would pie crust. Toast in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown. Stir often so it doesn't get lumpy.  Add chocolate chips or raisins after slightly cooled.

name: TRY ME CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. Crisco oil
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
2 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. coconut
dash of salt
4  eggs
preparation: Put all ingredients in 1 bowl and mix together.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  It is a moist cake.

name: STUFFED MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. lean hamburger
1  can bouillon
3  eggs
4  slices bread
1/2  c. Parmesan
1  Tbsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. garlic
1/2  tsp. basil
preparation: Mix all ingredients except the bouillon, in large bowl.  Roll out into a rectangle.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
8  oz. or 2 c. grated Cheddar cheese
1 large  can crushed pineapple, well drained
1/4  c. minced onion
1/4  c. finely chopped green pepper
1/4  c. finely chopped nuts (optional)
1/4  c. well-drained, chopped pimento (optional)
2  dashes Worcestershire
preparation: With cheeses at room temperature, mix all ingredients thoroughly and then form ball.  Chill 45 minutes.  Roll in finely chopped nuts.  For well-blended flavors, refrigerate 24 hours.

name: 5 CHEESE LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, cooked and drained
2 (15 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1/4  c. dried minced onions
2  Tbsp. flaked oregano
2  tsp. garlic powder
1  pkg. lasagna noodles
1  large container Romano cheese, grated
1  (8 oz.) container grated Parmesan cheese
2  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
1  (32 oz.) small curd cottage cheese
2  lb. grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain off grease.  In large pan, add ground beef, 2 cans of tomato sauce, plus 1 can of water, onions, oregano and garlic.  Let cook until thick; set aside.  Cook noodles.

name: CUCUMBER-BLUE CHEESE DRESSING
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  carton plain, low-fat yogurt
1/2  c. (2 oz.) crumbled Blue cheese
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
dash of pepper
1/2  medium cucumber, shredded
skim milk (optional)
preparation: Combine yogurt, Blue cheese, sugar, vinegar and pepper.  Stir in cucumber.  Cover and chill.  Stir in 1 to 2 tablespoons milk to thin, if desired.  Makes 1 1/2 cups (12 servings).

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. sour cream
1/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream together and refrigerate for a couple of hours.  Serve with fresh fruit.

name: SOUTHERN STYLE CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1  c. yellow corn meal
1/4  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1/4  c. soft shortening or salad oil
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Mix flour with corn meal, sugar, salt and baking powder.  Mix eggs, milk and shortening.  Mix with dry ingredients until smooth.  Pour into a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan or a 10-inch skillet.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: OLD FASHION CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philly cream cheese
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
5  eggs
1  roll crescent rolls
preparation: Mix the cream cheese, sour cream and sugar until creamy.  Add eggs, one at a time; beat well.  Add vanilla.  Place crescent rolls in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Pour cheese mixture over it.  Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: POTATO PANCAKES
ingredients:
4  c. shredded, peeled potatoes
1  egg, lightly beaten
3  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. grated onion
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Place rinsed potatoes in a large bowl.  Add egg, flour, onion, salt and pepper.  Mix well.  Heat oil over medium heat.  Drop batter by 1/3 cupful into hot oil; flatten to form pancakes.  Fry until golden brown.  Serve immediately.

name: POTATOES ROMANOFF
ingredients:
6  large potatoes
1  pt. sour cream
1  bunch green onions
1 1/2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
paprika
preparation: Cook potatoes  until tender.  Peel and shred into large bowl. Add rest  of ingredients, except half cup of cheese and paprika for top.  Pour  into  2-quart buttered dish.  Top with cheese and paprika.  Refrigerate  for	several hours or overnight.  Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: SWEETHEART SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. crushed pineapple
2  envelopes plain gelatin
1  doz. cherries
2  Tbsp. cherry juice
1  c. sugar
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/2  pt. whipped cream or substitute
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix  pineapple and sugar in saucepan and bring to boil. Dissolve  gelatin  in cold water and add to pineapple mixture. Set aside  to  cool.  Crush cherries.  Add cherry juice to the cream cheese  and  mix  until smooth.  Add cherries and lemon juice. Combine  with gelatin mixture.  Fold in whipped cream. Refrigerate.

name: CARAMEL ICING(Mom's Recipe)
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. soda
1/2  stick margarine
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar and buttermilk in an iron skillet and cook until soft ball forms when dropped in cold water.  Add soda and stir until it gets brown.  Add margarine and vanilla.  Beat until margarine has melted.  Quickly spread on cake.  It will harden quickly.

name: HOGUE STYLE TACOS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
1  small onion
1 large  can Ranch Style beans
1 small  can tomato sauce
2 to 4  Tbsp. hot sauce
grated Cheddar cheese
1  large tossed salad
Doritos corn chips
1  container sour cream (optional)
preparation: Brown meat and onion in medium saucepan.  Remove from heat. Blend beans in blender until smooth.  Add tomato sauce and hot sauce to hamburger.  Heat and serve over crushed chips.  Add cheese, salad and sour cream (if desired).

name: RUSSIAN TEA
ingredients:
1 large  can pineapple juice
1 large  can frozen orange juice
1/3  bottle lemon juice
8  tea bags
6  c. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
preparation: Boil first three ingredients together for five minutes.  Make tea using 8 tea bags to six cups water.  Add 1 1/2 cups sugar, 1 teaspoon cloves and 1 teaspoon cinnamon to tea and mix with the juices.  Keep hot while serving.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
3/4  c. white Karo
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
2  Tbsp. melted oleo
pinch of salt
1 1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  unbaked pie crust
preparation: Beat eggs, add Karo, sugar, oleo, vanilla, salt and pecans. Bake in oven at 350° for approximately 45 minutes.

name: HAM ROLLS OR SPAM
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. cream of tartar*
1  tsp. soda*
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. shortening
3/4  c. milk
1  can Spam or 1 c. ham, well ground
2  Tbsp. oleo
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
preparation: *Or, use 4 teaspoons baking powder in place of the cream of tartar and soda.

name: JAMBALAYA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (5 oz.)  box elbow macaroni
2  strips bacon, chopped
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. flour
2 1/4  c. canned tomatoes
1/2  lb. cubed boiled ham
1  c. cooked shrimp
1/4  c. bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. melted butter
preparation: Cook macaroni; drain and rinse.  Brown chopped bacon in skillet.  Add onion,  green pepper and garlic.  Brown and stir in flour.  Add  tomatoes  and	cook until thickened.  Stirring constantly, add macaroni,  ham  and  shrimp.  Pour	into 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.  Combine bread crumbs, cheese and butter and sprinkle over  casserole.  Bake  at  350°  for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

name: LORI'S BREAKFAST PIZZA
ingredients: leftover pizza from Pizza Hut or your favorite pizza place (pizza from Tuesday night is best because kids under 12 eat free)
preparation: Place pizza in refrigerator as soon as you get home from Pizza Hut.  The next morning, take the pizza out of the fridge and place in microwave.  Microwave on High for 30 seconds to 1 minute. Remove pizza from microwave and bon appetit!

name: MOON IN JUNE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. Boston lettuce, cut into strips
1  bouquet watercress
2  c. spinach leaves
1  tsp. chives
2  Tbsp. cold-pressed olive oil
juice of 1/2 lemon
salt and pepper
4  cabbage leaves (shell-shaped)
4  artichoke bottoms
1  white onion, finely sliced
1  garlic clove, finely sliced
2  medium size carrots, grated
preparation: In a large salad bowl, combine lettuce, watercress, spinach leaves, chives, oil and lemon juice.  Season with salt and pepper. Put mixture on shell-shaped cabbage leaves.  Garnish with artichoke bottoms, onion and garlic.  Arrange grated carrots in a circle around the cabbage leaves.

name: CHINESE CABBAGE SALAD
ingredients:
1  head cabbage, chopped
2  bunches green onions, chopped
1  or 2 green peppers, chopped
2  pkg. Top Ramen noodles, crunched and put in bowl (do not use seasoning mix)
1/2  c. slivered almonds
1  bottle light oriental salad dressing
chicken, cut up small (optional)
preparation: Mix and serve.  Sunflowers may be added.  This may be made early so it can marinate.  Will keep for a week.

name: RAISIN CARAMEL PIE
ingredients:
1  c. raisins
2/3  c. sugar
2  eggs, separated
1  can evaporated milk, plus water to make 2 c. or 2 c. rich milk
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. water
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. cornstarch
preparation: Boil the raisins, sugar, water and salt.  Boil for 5 minutes in a 2-quart saucepan.  Beat egg yolks and add milk, cornstarch and cinnamon (mix cinnamon with cornstarch and dissolve in part of the milk first).  Add to the raisin mixture and cook until thickened, stirring constantly.  Pour into a baked pie shell.  Top with meringue.

name: SPINACH BALLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, drain well
2  c. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix (fine)
4  beaten eggs
1/2  lb. melted margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. thyme
1  onion, chopped
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Saute onion in margarine; mix all ingredients into onion (will be wet and moist).  Shape into balls (size of walnuts).  If hard to handle, set in refrigerator for awhile.  Set on cookie sheet, will be a full sheet.  Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.  Can be frozen after baked, then heated on low temperature.

name: CHESS SQUARES
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  egg, beaten
1  stick butter
2  whole eggs
1 (16 oz.)  box powdered sugar
1 (8 oz.)  stick Philly cream cheese
preparation: Mix together cake mix, 1 egg and butter.  Pat down in cake pan.  Mix remaining 3 ingredients (2 eggs, powdered sugar and cream cheese) and pour on top of cake mix mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: VETEBROD (SWEDISH COFFEE BREAD)
ingredients:
2  c. lukewarm milk
2/3  c. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. raisins
1  c. sugar
3  tsp. ground cardamom seeds
small amount of flour
1  pkg. yeast
1/3  c. warm water
1/4  tsp. sugar
1  egg
7 or 8  c. bread flour
preparation: Melt butter in lukewarm milk.  Add salt, raisins, sugar, cardamom seeds and small amount of flour.  Beat until smooth. Dissolve yeast in 1/3 cup warm water with sugar.  Stir yeast mixture into the milk.  Add egg and 7 to 8 cups bread flour, beating until smooth and firm.  Cover with clean towel and let rise in a warm place until double in size (about 2 hours).

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. cut chicken
1  can cream of broccoli soup
1  c. rice
1  Tbsp. butter
2  c. water
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Boil water with can of broccoli soup.  Stir in chicken pieces. Add butter.  Let boil.  Add cooked rice.  To make it thicker, lessen butter and water.  Can pour over rice, if desired.  Makes a nice pot of soup.

name: SWEET POTATO BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  small sweet potato, baked and peeled
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
3 to 4  tsp. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Cream sweet potato and butter and cool. Sift dry ingredients into potato.  Stir in enough milk to make a dough you can handle.  Put dough on floured board.  Shape into a ball and pat or roll and cut out biscuits.  Arrange on greased pan and bake 10 to 12 minutes or until brown.  Makes 12 biscuits.

name: TERIYAKI STEAK
ingredients:
1  round steak
1  large garlic, sliced
1  bottle teriyaki sauce
preparation: Put large skillet on grill.  Let skillet get hot.  Put 1/4 of the bottle teriyaki sauce in skillet.  Slice steak at angle and place the sliced garlic into the cuts in the steak.  Place steak into hot skillet and turn often until steak is the way you like it.

name: OLIVE CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
1  lb. mild Cheddar cheese, grated medium fine
3/4  c. mayonnaise-type salad dressing
1  jar (8 oz.) small pimiento-stuffed green olives, drained (about 1 1/3 c.) and finely knife-chopped
preparation: In a medium mixing bowl vigorously stir together cheese, salad dressing and olives.  Turn into one or two jars or crocks; cover tightly.  Refrigerate.  Makes about 3 1/2 cups.

name: ICE CREAM DESSERT
ingredients:
1/2  gal. Vanilla Ice Cream
1/2  c. Milk
2 small  box instant Coconut Cream Pudding
1  small Cool Whip
2  packs Ritz Crackers
1  stick Butter
preparation: Crumble crackers and mix with melted butter, set aside one cup of crackers.  Soften ice cream until creamy and add milk and pudding mix.  Line bottom of 9x13 inch pan with crackers.  Top with coconut cream mix.  Refrigerate 1 hour.  Top with cool whip and cracker crumbs.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese (room temperature)
1  pkg. Knorr vegetable soup mix
1/3  c. mayonnaise
3/4  c. sour cream
1 small  can water chestnuts, chopped (optional)
preparation: Thaw spinach and drain.  Mix all ingredients together.  Chill overnight.  Serve with pumpernickel bread or rye.  Hollow out bread and place dip in hollow.  Place torn pieces from center around loaf.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  bag hash brown potatoes
1 or 2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  c. Cheddar cheese
corn flakes (average size box)
preparation: Can also put a jar of mushrooms in optionally.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  green pepper, chopped
1/4  c. margarine
1  can corn
1/2  c. seasoned bread crumbs
2  eggs, beaten
3  slices cheese
preparation: Saute onion and pepper in margarine until tender.  Remove from heat.  Add the rest of the ingredients.  Pour into a casserole dish.  Bake at 375° for 35 or 40 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  stewing chicken (4 or 5 lb.)
1  small onion,
1  carrot, sliced
2  ribs celery
1  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. butter
6  Tbsp. flour
1/8  tsp. paprika
1/2  c. light cream
white pepper to taste
dumplings (recipe below)
preparation: Simmer chicken, onion, carrot, celery and salt in enough water to cover until chicken is done, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  Remove chicken from broth.  Remove skin and bones; dice meat.  Strain stock and, if necessary, add enough water to make 1 quart.  Melt butter in saucepan; stir in flour mixed with paprika.  Add chicken stock gradually, stirring constantly; cook for 2 minutes.  Add cream, pepper and season to taste.  Spoon dumplings on top of gently bubbling chicken mixture.  Cover; cook for 15 minutes without lifting lid.  Serve at once.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
1  onion
1  c. water
1/2  pkg. chili seasoning mix
2  or 3 jalapeno peppers
1  can kidney beans
butter
1  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Fry butter, onions and peppers until brown.  Then combine butter, onions and peppers with remaining ingredients in a large saucepan.  Cook on low heat for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

name: CURRY CHICKEN
ingredients:
3  lb. chicken, cut up
1/2  tsp. each:  salt and pepper
1/2  c. butter
2  small onions, finely chopped
2  green apples, peeled and diced
3  Tbsp. curry powder
4  Tbsp. flour
2  c. chicken broth
preparation: Season chicken with salt and pepper.  Brown in melted butter; remove from pan.  Add onions and apples; saute until onions are tender.  Sprinkle with curry powder and flour.  Cook, stirring, for about 2 minutes.  Stir in broth; bring to a boil.  Add chicken; cover and cook over low heat for 40 minutes, or until tender.  If sauce is too thick, add more broth.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: QUESADILLA QUICHE
ingredients:
1 small  can (4 oz.) chopped green chilies
2 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. Swiss cheese, shredded
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1  c. Bisquick
sour cream
taco sauce
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Grease bottom of quiche pan.  Sprinkle chilies and cheese over bottom.  Beat eggs and milk together.  Add Bisquick and beat until smooth.  Pour over chilies and cheese. Bake 25 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted at middle comes out clean.  Cool 10 minutes before serving.  Top with sour cream and sauce to taste.

name: HOT SPICED PUNCH
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. pineapple juice
1  pt. cranberry juice
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. whole cloves
2  tsp. whole allspice
3  sticks cinnamon, broken
1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Pour juices into 8-cup automatic electric percolator.  Add sufficient water.  In percolator basket, put salt, spices and brown sugar.  Allow to perk 10 to 15 minutes.  Serve in mugs or punch cups.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: MY MAMA'S DOUGHNUTS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. shortening or margarine
2  eggs, beaten
4  c. flour
4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. milk
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. mace
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar together; add eggs.  Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk.  Dough will be slightly stiff.  Refrigerate for several hours so that dough will be easier to handle.  Before rolling out, heat your oil to about 375°.  (I don't have an exact on this because Mama just always knew when it was hot enough by trying a donut hole.)

name: MEXICAN SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1/2  head lettuce
1  tomato
1  green pepper
1/2  can black olives (optional)
12  oz. orange Cheddar cheese, shredded
6  oz. bag Doritos, crushed
16  oz. French dressing
preparation: Brown hamburger in skillet.  In a bowl, add lettuce, tomato, green pepper, black olives, cheese and Doritos.  Mix together. Drain hamburger and add to salad.  Pour French dressing and stir well.  Serve.  Good hot or cold.  Double recipe, if desired.

name: TUNNEL OF FUDGE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. butter
6  eggs
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  c. flour
3 1/2  c. or 12 1/2 oz. pkg. Creamy Double Dutch Frosting mix
2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Cream butter in larger	mixer  bowl at high speed.  Add eggs one at a time,  beating well after each addition.  Gradually add sugar; continue  creaming  at  high speed until light and fluffy. By hand,  stir  frosting  mix,  flour and walnuts until well blended.  Pour batter into well-greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for  60  to 65 minutes.  Cool 2 hours before removing from pan.  Cool completely before serving.

name: MARINATED CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
4 or 5  lb. chicken wings
1  c. soy sauce
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. pineapple juice
1/4  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  c. oil
preparation: Marinate chicken wings for 2 hours or overnight.  Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: *STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. butter
2/3  c. milk
2 1/2  c. flour
3  eggs
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  c. strawberry preserves
preparation: Cream butter; add sugar and cream well.  Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each is added.  Alternate sifted dry ingredients with the milk.  Add preserves.  Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch pans.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.

name: PARTY REUBENS
ingredients:
2  loaves cocktail rye bread
1  lb. wafer sliced corned beef
1  lb. sauerkraut, drained
1  tsp. Thousand Island dressing per slice
1  Lorraine Swiss cheese slice
preparation: Layer by order onto cocktail rye bread.  Place in broiler until cheese melts.  Serve immediately.

name: RUSSIAN TEA CAKES
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. pecans or walnuts, chopped small
1 extra  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.   Beat butter and vanilla; add powdered sugar and salt.  Gradually add flour, then nuts.  Mix until mixture holds together and is stiff.  Roll into balls.  Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake for 10 minutes until set but not brown.  Cool slightly; roll in powdered sugar while warm.  Wait a few minutes and roll again.

name: IRISH RAISIN BREAD(For Bread Machine)
ingredients:
1 1/2  tsp. dry yeast
2  c. bread flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sweet butter
1  egg
1/4  c. warm water
1/3  c. warm milk
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Put dry yeast in inner pot.  Add remaining ingredients, except water, milk and raisins.  Carefully pour in the warm water and milk.  Press the select button for "medium".  Press start button. The electronic beeper sounds 10 times five minutes before secondary kneading is finished.  At this signal, add the raisins. After taking out the baked bread from the bread oven, let cool, then slice as desired.

name: SPICY ASPARGUS
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen asparagus spears
French dressing
preparation: Cook asparagus following directions on box; drain.  Place on platter.  Drizzle French dressing over asparagus.

name: RHUBARB RICOTTA BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
6  Tbsp. melted margarine
1  c. Ricotta cheese
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. almond extract
1  c. finely chopped rhubarb
1/2  c. slivered almonds (optional)
confectioners sugar
preparation: In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt.  In medium bowl beat together melted margarine, Ricotta, milk, eggs and extract.  Add Ricotta mixture to dry ingredients; stir just until blended.  Fold in rhubarb and nuts.  Scoop batter into greased and floured 9 x 5 loaf pan.  Bake at 350° about 50 minutes.  Cool in pan on wire rack 10 minutes.  Remove from pan and cool completely.  Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.  Store in an air tight container.

name: PEANUT BALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. peanuts, unsalted and skinned
4  c. sugar
2  c. water
4  egg yolks
1  Tbsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
powdered sugar
preparation: Roast  the peanuts lightly in the oven; cool and grind. Boil the sugar with 2 cups of water until mixture forms a hard ball in cold water (240°).	Add the ground peanuts and continue  cooking, stirring constantly, until bottom of the pan can be seen in the wake of the spoon.	Remove from flame.  Add the egg  yolks, cinnamon,  salt  and vanilla and beat the mixture into  a  paste. Press  mixture  into  small balls with wooden paddles  moistened in cold water.  Arrange on wax paper lined tray and dust with powdered sugar.  Serve when dry.

name: PARKER HOUSE ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. scalded sweet milk
3  Tbsp. shortening or butter
yeast cake
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
3  c. plain flour
preparation: Scald sweet milk; add shortening or butter.  Let cool to lukewarm.  Add yeast cake dissolved in warm water.  Add 3 tablespoons of sugar, 2 tablespoons of salt and 3 cups of plain flour; beat thoroughly.  Let rise to double in bulk.  Add flour to make dough.  Make out rolls.  Let rise, then bake at 350° to 375° until golden brown.

name: BAKED CORN
ingredients:
2  c. corn (or 2 small cans)
2  eggs
1  c. milk
dash of pepper
1/2  c. bread or cracker crumbs
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. melted margarine
preparation: Cook the corn (or if using canned, not necessary).  Beat the eggs, milk, seasonings and 2 tablespoons butter.  Mix well.  Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish.  Mix crumbs with butter and sprinkle over corn mixture.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until mixture is set.

name: PARMESAN CHICKEN(Serves 12)
ingredients:
3  c. fresh bread crumbs (about 6 slices)
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
3/4  c. chopped parsley
3  cloves garlic, minced
3/4  tsp. each: salt, black pepper and paprika
3  broiler/fryer chickens, each cut into 8 pieces
3/4  c. unsalted butter or margarine, melted (1 1/2 sticks)
preparation: In a 1-gallon food storage bag, combine bread crumbs, cheese, parsley, garlic, salt, pepper and paprika.  Dip chicken in butter. Shake 2 pieces at a time in the bag to coat with crumb mixture. Arrange in 2 (15 1/2 x 10 x 1-inch) baking pans lined with aluminum foil; sprinkle any remaining coating mixture over the chicken.  (At this point the chicken can be covered tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerated up to 6 hours.)

name: CHOCOLATE TRIFLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. chocolate cake mix
2  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
1  (16 oz.) container Cool Whip
6  Heath or Skor bars, crumbled
1/2  c. kahlua
preparation: Bake cake the day before serving.  Break half of cake into little pieces in a very large container (trifle bowl).  Pour 1/4 cup kahlua over cake.  Spread 1/2 of Cool Whip over pudding. Sprinkle candy over Cool Whip.  Repeat layers, ending with candy.

name: SHAKE AND BAKE
ingredients:
1  c. bread crumbs
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. cornstarch
1 3/4  tsp. onion powder
1  tsp. paprika
1 3/4  tsp. garlic powder
1 3/4  tsp. poultry seasoning
1  tsp. sugar
1 3/4  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Makes enough to coat about 4 pounds of chicken.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  stick margarine
1 small  pkg. Velveeta cheese
Ritz crackers
preparation: Melt margarine and cheese in double boiler.  Cook broccoli by package directions.  Combine.  Cover with Ritz crackers and butter mixture.  Bake at 350° until golden brown.

name: BREAD AND BUTTER PICKLES
ingredients:
12  medium cucumbers
5  medium onions
1/4  c. salt
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. mustard seed
1 1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1  c. vinegar (white)
1/2  c. water
preparation: Wash cucumbers, peel onions and cut into 1/4 inch rings. Arrange in layers, sprinkling salt on each layer.  Let stand 2 to 3 hours; drain.  Combine remaining ingredients and heat to boiling.  Add cucumbers and onions and simmer 10 minutes.  Pack in hot sterilized jars and seal.  Makes about 4 pints.

name: BARBECUED BEEF SUPREME
ingredients:
2  lb. round steak or flank steak (3/4-inch thick)
2  Tbsp. seasoned flour
2  Tbsp. shortening
1/3  c. minced onions
1/3  c. minced celery
1/2  clove garlic, minced
1 medium  can Hunt's sauce
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  tsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
dash of Tabasco sauce
preparation: Pound flour into steak.  Brown in shortening in a heavy skillet or saucepan, along with onions, celery and garlic.  Add remaining ingredients; stir well.  Cover; cook in a 350° oven or on top of range for about 1 1/2 hours, or until tender.  Makes 6 servings.

name: HAMBURGER CORNBREAD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  Jiffy cornbread mix
1  lb. hamburger, cooked
1  can cream-style corn
8  oz. grated Cheddar cheese
hot peppers (optional)
preparation: Layer the ingredients in a greased 9 x 13-inch bread pan or large casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI PIE
ingredients:
1  c. grated zucchini
pinch of salt
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  egg
1  Tbsp. flour
1  c. Milnot
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix all together; pour into unbaked pie shell and sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.  Bake at 350° until set, about 45 minutes.

name: TWO BY FOUR STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. ground meat
2  cans Italian stewed tomatoes
2  cans pinto beans
2  cans minestrone
preparation: Cook ground meat until well done.  Pour all other ingredients into drained ground meat.  Let simmer for about 20 minutes and eat.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE PILAF *
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. Minute rice
1/2  envelope dry onion soup mix
1  can mushroom soup
1  pkg. frozen chicken breasts or whole chicken (good pieces)
1 1/4  c. boiling water
1/4  c. dry sherry (optional)
1  Tbsp. pimento
melted butter
salt and pepper
paprika
preparation: In a 3/4-quart casserole dish, combine all ingredients, except chicken, butter and seasoning.  In a frying pan, melt butter, add seasonings and chicken.  Brown chicken a little.  Place on top of rice mixture in casserole dish.  Cover.  Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Makes 4 to 5 servings.

name: VEGETABLE SOUP(Low Calorie)
ingredients:
2  c. peeled, diced potatoes
1  c. diced carrots
1  c. diced celery
1  c. chopped onion
3  c. shredded cabbage
1 (6 oz.)  can no-salt added tomato paste
1  tsp. thyme
1/4  tsp. freshly ground black pepper
6  c. homemade or low-sodium beef broth
1/3  c. finely chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Combine all ingredients except parsley in a large stockpot. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.  Remove 3 cups of vegetables and broth and puree in blender or the work bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade.  Return puree to pot, add parsley and reheat. Serve hot.  Serves 9; 1 cup per serving.

name: SAM'S STUFF (MUSH)
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
1  c. cold water
1  tsp. salt
3  c. boiling water
preparation: Mix together cornmeal and cold water.  Add cornmeal mixture to salt and boiling water.  Stir in slowly over low heat.  Cook and stir.  Lower heat to very low; cover and cook about 15 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE ECLAIR
ingredients:
3/4  lb. graham crackers
2 to 3  oz. pkg. instant vanilla pudding
3 3/4  c. milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
1/3  c. cocoa
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. milk
4  Tbsp. margarine, cut up
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix cocoa, sugar and salt.  Add 1/4 cup milk.  Bring to boil and boil 1 minute.  Turn off heat but leave pan on the stove for 5 minutes.  Add margarine and vanilla.  Mix pudding with 3 3/4 cups milk.  Add Cool Whip.

name: QUICK TACO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger meat
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  pkg. taco chips
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown meat and onion in skillet.  Add taco seasoning, mushroom soup and Ro-Tel tomatoes.  Place chips in a casserole dish; add meat mixture.  Top with grated cheese.  Bake at 350° until cheese melts.

name: GREEN-HERB DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. low-fat cottage cheese
1  c. nonfat plain yogurt
3  Tbsp. grated Sap Sago or Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. honey
2  tsp. Dijon mustard
2  tsp. minced shallots
1  tsp. dried basil
1/4  tsp. black pepper
preparation: In blender, process the cottage cheese until very smooth. Transfer to a medium bowl.  Whisk in the yogurt, Sap Sago or Parmesan cheese, lemon juice, honey, mustard, shallots, basil and black pepper.

name: GINGER MARINADE FOR BONELESS CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/3  c. oil
1/3  c. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
2  tsp. grated fresh ginger
2  cloves garlic, minced or 2 tsp. minced jar garlic
preparation: Mix together and then marinate boneless chicken in plastic bag for 2 or more hours.  Then broil or grill.  Delicious!

name: CHEESE AND BEEFARONI WITH BISCUIT
ingredients:
2  c. macaroni
1  c. shredded cheese
8  oz. can tomato sauce
1  can green beans
1  Tbsp. salt
1/4  Tbsp. pepper
1  tsp. Accent
1  can biscuits
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Combine all ingredients together and place in a	casserole dish.  Place biscuit on top and bake for at least 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

name: PORCUPINES
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  onion, diced
1/2  green pepper, diced
1/8  tsp. salt
1  can tomato soup
1/8  c. ketchup
1/2  c. rice
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix hamburger, onion, green pepper, spices, rice and ketchup in bowl.  Make into balls.  Brown in skillet.  Pour off grease. Add tomato soup mixed well with 1/2 can water.   Cover and simmer for 1 hour.  Serve.

name: SUPPER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
2  medium onions, chopped
1  small cabbage, shredded
3  medium carrots, sliced thin
2 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. uncooked rice
1 (14 oz.)  can beef broth
preparation: Brown ground beef and onions in frying pan.  Combine all ingredients in a casserole dish.  Cover and bake at 350° for about 1 hour and 15 minutes, until rice is done.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
2  c. light brown sugar
2  c. white sugar
1  c. milk
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Boil all ingredients to the soft boil stage; when dropped in cold water forms a soft ball.  Remove from heat and add 3 heaping tablespoonfuls of peanut butter and 2 teaspoons vanilla flavoring. Beat until flavoring and peanut butter are completely mixed in. Pour into a buttered pan and cut into squares.

name: HOT ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. sour cream
1  can (14 oz.) artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1/3  c. grated parmesan cheese
1/8  tsp. hot pepper sauce
preparation: Stir all ingredients until well mixed.  Spoon into small ovenproof dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Makes 2 cups.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  egg
1  Tbsp. water
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine dry ingredients.  Cream shortening; add sugars and beat well.  Add peanut butter, egg, water and vanilla.  Blend in dry ingredients.  Roll dough into small balls; place on greased cookie sheet.  Press with fork dipped in flour.  Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.  Yields approximately 2 1/2 dozen.

name: GROUND BEEF AND POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can mushroom soup
1  onion
1  can Cheddar cheese soup
potatoes
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Peel potatoes.  Slice into thin slices. Boil potatoes until done.

name: VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
3  carrots, finely chopped
1  head cabbage, shredded
2  ribs celery, finely chopped
1  onion
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes
6  c. chicken (Healthy Request) no fat broth
freshly ground black pepper
preparation: Place vegetables in a large pot with tomatoes and broth. Bring to a boil and simmer, covered, until thick, about 45 minutes.  Season with pepper.  Has zero fat.

name: GLORIA'S PEANUT BUTTER BALLS(Candy)
ingredients:
12  oz. peanut butter (chunky or your favorite)
1/4  c. maple pancake syrup
about 2 c. powdered sugar
12  oz. milk chocolate or semi-sweet
preparation: In large bowl, combine the peanut butter and pancake syrup. Mix well. Stir in the powdered sugar to form thick clay-like dough. Roll in 1-inch balls and place on waxed paper to dry while you melt the chocolate. Dip half of ball in chocolate to form "buckeyes." Or dip all the way in chocolate for a bonbon. Chill 15 minutes to set chocolate. These freeze well.

name: PUMPKIN DESSERT
ingredients:
6  eggs
1 large  can pumpkin
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  can evaporated milk
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ginger
preparation: Note:  Instead of cloves and ginger, I use 1 1/4 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice.

name: BLUEBERRY POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
3  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. mace
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. blueberries
2  Tbsp. sugar and flour to coat berries
preparation: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add vanilla.  Sift flour, baking powder and mace together.  Add alternately flour and milk, mixing well.  Fold in blueberries.

name: BAKED FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. butter
2  Tbsp. Karo syrup
1  loaf French bread, cut into 3/4-inch slices
5  eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In saucepan over medium heat, mix and melt brown sugar, butter and corn syrup.  Spray 9 x 13-inch baking dish with Pam and pour butter and sugar mixture into dish.  Mix eggs, milk and vanilla. Arrange slices of bread in baking dish and pour egg mixture over bread.  Use all of the mixture.  Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: FRIED GREEN TOMATOES OR EGGPLANT
ingredients:
4  large green tomatoes or 1 medium size eggplant
skillet 1/2 full hot grease
1  c. seasoned flour
preparation: Thin slice tomatoes or eggplant into a bowl of water.  Put seasoned flour into a bag, add a few slices of tomato or eggplant at a time and shake until well coated.  Put each slice into the hot grease and fry until golden brown.

name: PINEAPPLE DO-NOTHING CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour (sift or mix with 1 tsp. soda and 1/2 tsp.  salt)
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 large  can pineapple
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Add other ingredients, stirring to blend well.  No need to use mixer.  Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: CRISP CRUSTED BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  cut up chicken (3 to 3 1/2 lb.)
1  egg
2  Tbsp. milk
1  c. instant potato flakes
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. butter or margarine
preparation: Mix egg and milk in bowl.  In another bowl mix potato flakes, garlic and Parmesan cheese.  Roll chicken in egg mix, then in the potato mix.  Melt butter in shallow baking pan.  Roll coated chicken pieces in the butter and place them skin side up in pan. Bake at 400° for 45 to 50 minutes or until juices from chicken run clear.

name: PINTO BEAN CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  tsp. ground cloves
2  c. sugar
2  c. cooked pinto beans, whipped
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine eggs, butter, flour, baking powder, soda, allspice, cinnamon, ground cloves and sugar together.  Add alternately with pinto beans.  Mix well, then add nuts.  Bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour.

name: HOT PICKLE MIX
ingredients:
1  1/2 qt pickling cucumbers, cut into 1/2-inch slices
2  medium sweet green peppers, seeded and cut into strips
2  medium sweet red peppers, seeded and cut into strips
1  1/2 c sliced carrots
3  c cauliflowerets
1  c peeled, pickling onions
1  1/2 qt long red, green or yellow peppers
3  or 4 fresh jalapeno peppers or dried red pepper pods
1  1/2 c canning salt
4  qt water
1/4  c sugar
2  Tbsp prepared horseradish
2  cloves garlic
10  c vinegar
2  c water
preparation: Prepare cucumbers, sweet green and red peppers, carrots, cauliflower and onions. Dissolve salt in 4 quarts water. Pour over vegetables; let stand for 1 hour. With rubber gloves, remove seeds from hot peppers; cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Combine remaining ingredients; simmer 15 minutes. Remove garlic. Drain vegetables. Pack vegetables and peppers (not jalapeno) into hot jars, leaving 1/4 inch head space. Add a piece of jalapeno or red pepper pod to each jar. Pour hot liquid over mix. Adjust caps. Process for 10 minutes in boiling water bath. Makes about 7 pints.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
5  to 6 green onions, chopped
1  pkg. dry beef (Buddig brand), chopped
preparation: Mix all together in large bowl.  Serve on your choice of crackers.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. box graham crackers, crushed
2  c. sugar
2  sticks margarine
1  c. pecans
1/4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. baking powder
1  bottle maraschino cherries, chopped
5  eggs
1  can coconut
1  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, eggs and margarine in bowl, then add cracker crumbs. Add coconut, pecans, cherries and vanilla.  Add baking powder in the milk and pour into batter.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: COCOA FUDGE
ingredients:
2/3  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  stick butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Combine cocoa, sugar  and  salt in large saucepan.  Add milk gradually; mix  thoroughly.  Bring	to  a  boil  on  high heat, stirring  continuously.  Reduce  heat  to medium.  Cook until firm  or  soft  ball  forms when dropped in cold water. Remove saucepan from heat.  Add butter and vanilla.  Let cool until mixture  thickens  and  loses its gloss.  Pour in 1 cup chopped pecans.  Pour into small bread pan.  Let cool and cut into squares.

name: SPINACH IN SAUCE
ingredients:
1  bag spinach
1  onion, chopped
1  clove garlic, chopped
1/4  c. oil
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. red pepper powder
1  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Clean spinach of stems and wash.  Cook in water with some salt for about 20 minutes.  Pour through colander and chop.   Saute onion and garlic in oil.  Add flour and brown for about 1 minute.

name: TARTS
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
vanilla wafers
2  cans cherry pie filling
preparation: Beat together cream cheese, vanilla, sugar and eggs until smooth, 5 to 8 minutes.  Put cupcake liners in a muffin tin. Place vanilla wafers in bottom.  Fill 1/2 full with batter.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.  Batter will rise almost to the top, it will go back down.  Put cherry pie filling on top of cooked batter and refrigerate.

name: SOUTHERN-STYLE CORNBREAD
ingredients:
3  c. cornmeal
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  c. buttermilk
1/3  c. Parkay margarine, melted
4  eggs, slightly beaten
preparation: Combine dry ingredients.  Add buttermilk, margarine and eggs, mixing just until moistened.  Pour into well-greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jelly roll pan.  Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

name: LEMONADE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick butter
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1  c. sugar
3  c. flour
1/2  c. lemonade concentrate
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs one at a time.  Add flour and soda.  Mix in lemonade that has been thawed.  Drop from teaspoon onto cookie sheet.  Brush top with lemonade and sprinkle with powdered sugar.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

name: PINEAPPLE FILLING
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
4  eggs
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
6  slices cubed bread
preparation: Line bottom of  pan  with bread.  Mix other ingredients in order given and  pour mixture over the bread.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until golden brown.

name: HOT CINNAMON CANDY
ingredients:
bottle of oil of cinnamon
1/2  c. oleo or butter
1  c. light corn syrup
1 1/2  c. sugar
red food coloring
preparation: Mix all together in saucepan.  Cook and stir until boils. Reduce heat; cook to soft crack stage.  Butter a large cookie sheet.  Pour and let cool and cut when cool or pour into small molds.

name: APPLE CRISP
ingredients:
4  c. cooking apples, sliced
1/4  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. sugar
3/4  c. flour
1/3  c. soft butter
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Prepare apples and place in an 8 x 8-inch pan or equivalent.  To 1/4 cup of the water, add salt and cinnamon.  Stir.  Pour over the apples.

name: PANCIT(A Dish From the Philippines)
ingredients:
2  whole chicken breasts, diced about an inch*
1  pkg. pancit canton (dried Philippine noodles)
30  pieces snow peas, cut French-style, about an inch
1  big red pepper, diced about an inch
1  medium size green pepper, diced about an inch
2  stems broccoli, cut into flowerets
2  pieces carrots, cut French-style
any veggies you want that will add color
4  cloves garlic, crushed
1  big onion, sliced
2  stems scallions, sliced
6  dashes Mrs. Dash
1  dash garlic powder
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. canola oil
preparation: Boil the diced chicken in a large pot, 3/4 filled with water. Put 2 dashes of Mrs. Dash or any herbs if you have and 1/2 tablespoon of soy sauce.  Drain the chicken and put aside the broth.

name: HOT BROCCOLI DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. finely chopped celery
1/2  c. finely chopped onions
2  tsp. butter
10 3/4  oz. can mushroom soup
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  lb. cubed Velveeta or garlic cheese
10  oz. frozen broccoli, chopped
1/4  tsp. rosemary leaves, dried and crushed
preparation: Thaw and drain broccoli.  Saute celery and onions in butter. Add cheese and soup and stir over low heat until cheese is melted. Stir in remaining ingredients.  Heat thoroughly, stirring constantly.  Serve with fresh vegetables.  Yields 3 cups.

name: POLISH DRUMSTICK DESSERT
ingredients:
2  c. crushed vanilla wafers
1/2  c. melted butter
2/3  c. crushed Spanish peanuts
preparation: Mix together; put in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: STIR-FRY CRAB WITH PORK AND BLACK BEAN SAUCE
ingredients:
1  lb. crab meat, carefully picked over to remove shell bits and cartilage
salt
2  Tbsp. fermented salted black beans
3  Tbsp. water
2  eggs
1/2  c. oil
3/4  c. ground lean pork
2  Tbsp. finely minced fresh ginger
1 1/2  Tbsp. finely minced garlic
3  Tbsp. dry sherry
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  tsp. sugar
4  scallions, cut into 1/2-inch lengths
preparation: Finely mince ginger and garlic.  Cut entire scallion, except roots and top of green stalks, into 1/2-inch lengths.  Place crab meat in a basin of cold water.  Add few tablespoons salt and let stand 15 minutes.  In a small bowl cover black beans with water; mash.  Mix sherry, soy sauce and sugar.  Have drained crab, pork, eggs, ginger and garlic, sherry mixture, scallions and oil within reach.  Heat wok.  Add oil.  Heat oil.  Add ginger and garlic, then pork; cook until pork loses pink color.  Add crab and black beans and cook for 1 minute.  Add sherry mixture, cook for 30 seconds.  Add eggs, stir until set.  Taste for salt and pepper. Add scallions, stir until combined and heated.  Serve.

name: SUNSHINE ORANGE MOUSSE PIE
ingredients:
1  Envelope Knox unflavored Gelatin
1/4  Cup Cold Water
1  Cup Whipping or Heavy Cream, heated to boiling
1  Pkg. 8 oz. Cream Cheese, softened
1  Can 6 oz. Frozen Orange Juice Concentrate
3/4  Cup Confectioners Sugar
1 1/2  Tsp. Vanilla
9  inch Graham Cracker Crust
preparation: In blender, sprinkle gelatin over cold water, let stand 1 minute.  Add hot cream and process at low speed until gelatin is completely dissolved, about 2 minutes.  Add cream cheese, juice, sugar and vanilla.  Process until well blended.

name: BLACK CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
3  pkg. black cherry jello
2  c. boiling water
1  c. cherry juice
1  c. sugar
juice of 2 oranges
1  can pie cherries
1  can pineapple
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Stir until smooth; add all other ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate overnight.

name: TOLL HOUSE PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
1  c. butter, melted and cooled
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped nuts
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie crust
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour into an unbaked crust.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: CHICKPEA SALAD
ingredients:
1  can chickpeas, drained and rinsed
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  medium tomato, chopped
1/2  c. corn oil
1/3  c. wine vinegar
1  garlic clove, crushed
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: In a bowl, mix together peas, onion and tomato.  Into a jar measure corn oil, vinegar, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper. Cover tightly and shake well.  Pour over vegetables; toss.

name: EASY LASAGNA
ingredients:
1  1/2 lbs. lean hamburger
1 26  oz. jar Ragu (Chunky Garden Style)
1  tsp. Italian seasoning
1  large container cottage cheese
1  egg
salt and pepper to taste
1 large  pkg. shredded cheddar cheese
1 large  pkg. shredded mozzarella cheese
lasagna noodles, uncooked
preparation: Brown hamburger.  Add Ragu and seasonings.  Set aside.  In a bowl, lightly beat the egg.  Add cottage cheese, salt and pepper. In a 13 x 9-inch pan, spread 1/3 of the meat sauce.  Cover this with 1/3 of the cottage cheese mixture.  Place uncooked noodles on top of cottage cheese, then sprinkle 1/2 of both cheeses.  Second layer is 1/3 meat sauce and 1/3 cottage cheese followed by another layer of noodles and the remaining two cheeses.  The last layer consists of noodles, followed by the rest of the meat sauce and the rest of the cottage cheese mixture.  Bake at 350° for one hour. Let stand for 15 minutes before cutting.

name: VANILLA WAFERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. shortening
2/3  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
preparation: Thoroughly cream butter, shortening and sugar.  Add vanilla and salt.  Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each.  Stir in sifted all-purpose flour.  Mix well.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. squash
3/4  stick butter
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  or 3 eggs
1/2 to 1  c. onions (depending on how much you like onions)
1  c. Velveeta cheese (1 1/2 c. if you want)
1  c. bread crumbs or broken up bread
1/2  c. evaporated milk
preparation: Cook squash until tender. Drain. Add butter, salt, pepper and milk. In a bowl, beat eggs; add onions, cheese  and bread. Put all ingredients in dish for oven and bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes. Cube about 4 pieces of wheat bread; spread melted butter over bread and toast in oven. Put on top of casserole.

name: BROCCOLI-PEA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. (10 oz. each) frozen chopped broccoli
1 (17 oz.)  can green peas, drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  c. shredded sharp cheese
1  medium onion, chopped
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. crushed crackers
preparation: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain well. Arrange broccoli in greased 2-quart casserole dish.  Mix together soup, mayonnaise, seasonings, cheese, onion and eggs.

name: GREEN ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  doz. corn tortillas
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  c. grated cheese
1  c. milk
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 small  can chopped green chilies
preparation: Fry tortillas in hot fat until they bubble.  Place in casserole.  Alternate a tortilla with onions and cheese until all are used up.  Mix together milk, green chilies and soup.  Heat. Pour mixture over top and bake in a moderate 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.   Serves 4 to 6 people.

name: BLACK BOTTOM CUPCAKES
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1  egg
1/3  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
6  oz. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. white vinegar
preparation: Cream first 4 ingredients in a small bowl.  Add chocolate chips.  Set aside.  Mix the next 9 ingredients in a large bowl. Fill cupcake tins 1/2 full with chocolate mix.  Place a heaping teaspoonful of cream cheese on top of each batter.  Bake in oiled and floured cupcake tins for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.  Makes 12.

name: CRANBERRY APPLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. sugar
3  medium apples, peeled and sliced
2  c. fresh cranberries
dash of salt
preparation: Arrange in layers in casserole dish.

name: BEEF AND RICE SURPRISE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. bread crumbs
1/4  c. green pepper
1/4  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. grated American cheese
3  c. cooked rice
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. fat
preparation: Saute onions and pepper in fat.  Mix ground beef, bread crumbs,  pepper,  onions, salt and 1/2 cup tomato sauce, press into a crust.  Mix cooked rice, remaining tomato sauce and 1/2 cup cheese and spread over beef crust.	Bake in preheated oven for  25 minutes  at 350°.	Add remaining cheese and return to oven to cook 5 more minutes.

name: CHILI TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  envelope taco seasoning
16  oz. can tomatoes
15  oz. can kidney beans
1/2  c. water
preparation: Brown ground beef; pour  off  excess fat.  Stir in taco seasoning mix, tomatoes,  kidney  beans  and water.  Simmer 10 minutes,  stirring   occasionally.

name: HOT CRABBY PUNCH
ingredients:
5  c. sweet apple cider
4  c. cranberry cocktail juice
1/4  c. light brown sugar
1  cinnamon stick
1/2  tsp. whole allspice
1/2  tsp. whole cloves
preparation: Put all ingredients into a 3-quart saucepan.  Bring to a boil over medium heat.  Do not cover!  After it boils, turn heat down low and let it simmer for 20 minutes.  Turn off heat and remove the spices with slotted spoon.  Pour punch into mugs.  Add a cinnamon stick and drink.  Makes about 9 cups.

name: TACO STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, lean
1  medium onion, chopped
15  oz. (1 can) corn, whole kernel
10  oz. (1 can) diced tomatoes with chilies
15  oz. (1 can) pinto beans in chili sauce
1 1/4  oz. (1 pkg.) taco seasoning
10  oz. (1 can) soup, tomato
1  c. water
baked tortilla chips
8  oz. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
preparation: In a skillet brown ground beef.  Drain and rinse with hot water to remove excess fat.  Put ground beef in a Dutch oven and add the rest of ingredients (except tortilla chips and cheese). Simmer on low heat until bubbly and hot.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can pineapple chunks, drained
1 small  jar cherries, drained
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1 small  can coconut
1/2  c. pecans, chopped
1  c. sour cream
preparation: Mix and chill.

name: WATERGATE SALAD
ingredients:
1  box pistachio pudding
4 1/2  oz. Cool Whip
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix together.  Chill 1 hour.

name: MEXICAN PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  pkg. taco seasoning
4  oz. green chillies (optional)
1  c. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
1 1/4  c. milk
3/4  c. Bisquick mix
3  eggs
1/8  tsp. red pepper sauce
preparation: Cook beef and onion; drain.  Stir in season mix.  Spread beef into plate.  Sprinkle with cheese and chillies.  Beat rest of ingredients until smooth in blender or hand mixer.  Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown and knife comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.   Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: EASY BAKED GINGER GROUPER
ingredients:
1  5-6 lb grouper (before cleaning)
1/4  green pepper, thinly sliced
1/4  tsp. margarine
1  tsp. salt
2  lb. can stewed tomatoes
1  medium onion, thinly sliced
1/4  cup cooking oil
1/4  tsp thyme
1  bay leaf
1/2 to 3/4  cup ginger preserve (chutney and grated ginger will substitute)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Put fish in flat casserole dish. Sauté onion and green pepper; add tomatoes, ginger and spices; boil.  Spoon over fish.  Bake 30 minutes or until just done. Don't overcook.  Serve with rice.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  stick oleo, softened
4  eggs
1 large  can Hershey syrup
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. flour
preparation: Cream sugar and oleo.  Add eggs, beating after each one, and Hershey syrup.  Add salt and vanilla.  Add flour and nuts.  Bake on cookie sheet, depending on how thick you want them.  (No baking powder or soda.)  Bake 30 minutes.

name: CHICKEN-BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. chicken, cooked and cut up
1  bunch broccoli
2  c. herb stuffing mix
1  can milk
1  can cream chicken soup
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
preparation: Spray 9 x 13-inch pan or dish.  Lay broccoli in bottom of pan; next lay cut up chicken.  Cover completely with milk and soup mixed together.  Cover with Cheddar cheese.  Cover with herb stuffing mix made according to box directions.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: NEVER FAIL MERINGUE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. boiling water
3  egg whites
pinch of salt
6  Tbsp. sugar
8-inch pie crust
preparation: Moisten cornstarch with small amount of water.  Add boiling water.  Cook until thick and clear.  Cool! Important!  Beat the egg whites with pinch of salt until soft peaks form.  Add sugar, one tablespoon at a time.  Continue beating until high, firm peaks appear.  Beat in cornstarch mixture; beat until just right for topping.  Pile on top of pie.  Bake 8-inch pie at 350° until golden brown.

name: TURTLE BARS
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  pkg. Kraft caramels
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1/3  c. margarine, melted
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
preparation: Melt caramels with milk in double boiler or over low heat.  Mix by hand the cake mix, margarine and nuts until dough holds together.  Press 1/2 dough into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake 6 minutes at 350° (preheated oven).  Remove from oven and spread semi-sweet chocolate pieces.  Pour on caramel mixture. Crumble remaining dough over caramel mixture.  Return to oven and bake 15 to 18 minutes.  Cool and refrigerate to set caramel.  Cut into squares.

name: GREEN RICE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked rice
1  pkg. frozen broccoli
1/4  c. chopped onions
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  stick butter
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Saute onions in butter.  Add soup and cheese.  Add broccoli and rice.  Stir.  Place in  buttered casserole dish and bake approximately 20 minutes at 350°.

name: FRIED CORN
ingredients:
6 to 8  ears fresh corn
4  slices bacon, diced
1  medium onion, diced
1  green pepper, diced
2  medium potatoes
salt to taste
pepper to taste
preparation: Clean corn and cut from cob.  Peel and dice potatoes.  Start bacon in skillet, then add potatoes.  When bacon is about crisp and potatoes are getting soft, add remaining ingredients and fry over medium heat 15 to 20 minutes, stirring often.

name: REFRIGERATOR MASHED POTATOES
ingredients:
5  lb. potatoes (9 large)
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. sour cream
2  tsp. onion salt
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. margarine
preparation: Cook peeled potatoes in boiling salted water until tender. Drain.  Mash until smooth (no lumps).  Add remaining ingredients and beat until light and fluffy.  Cool.

name: EMERALD SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. cottage cheese
1  pkg. lime jello, mixed with 1 c. water or juice
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  c. Dream Whip
1  tsp. honey
preparation: Combine all ingredients and put in square glass dish. Refrigerate and serve.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks oleo, softened
3  c. sugar
1/2  c. Crisco oil
6  eggs
3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. sweet milk
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream oleo and sugar together until light.  Add oil a little at a time, beating continuously.  Add eggs, one at a time as you continue beating.  Mix salt and flour together, then add alternately with milk, beating well after each addition.  Add vanilla last.  Bake in greased tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or 1 hour for 2 loaf pans.   Cool on rack before turning out of pan.

name: BUTTER-BITE-HOE CAKES
ingredients:
1  c. Martha White self-rising corn meal mix
1 3/4  c. boiling water
preparation: Combine corn meal and boiling water; stir to blend.  In large skillet, heat 1/4-inch shortening over medium-low heat until drop of water sizzles when dropped in skillet.  Spoon batter by tablespoons into hot skillet.  Fry until golden brown.  Turn and fry on other side.  Serve with hot butter.  Makes about 10 hoe cakes.

name: CRUMB CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour, sifted
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter, softened
1  egg
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. cloves
1  c. raisins
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cream butter and sugar.  Blend in flour, mixing well.  Reserve 1/2 cup of this crumb mixture to sprinkle over cake before baking.  Add the egg, salt, buttermilk, baking soda, spices, raisins and nuts to the remaining crumb mixture.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

name: MAMAW'S PIZZA SAUCE
ingredients:
10  oz. tomato puree
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. brown sugar, rounded measure
1  tsp. thyme, rounded measure, crushed
1  tsp. oregano, rounded measure, crushed
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. oil (optional)
preparation: Mix all ingredients, crushing herbs in hand.  Thin with a small amount of water to preference.  It is not necessary to heat this sauce before using to top the pizza.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  chicken
1  lb. Velveeta, cubed
1  bag cheese Doritos
1  can Ro-Tel
preparation: Boil chicken; take off the bone.  Put chips in a 9 x 12-inch pan.  Mix Ro-Tel with chicken.  Pour over chips.  Top with cubed cheese.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. pasta noodles
3  large chopped tomatoes
5  green scallions, chopped (including tops)
2  cucumbers, peeled and chopped
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Kraft Zesty Italian dressing
1/2  bottle McCormick Salad Supreme seasoning
preparation: Cook pasta as directed.  Rinse in cold water and drain well. Put in serving bowl and add remaining ingredients.  Mix well. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

name: NEIMAN MARCUS DIP
ingredients:
1/2  cup mayonnaise
1/2  cup grated cheddar cheese
1/2  cup sliced almonds
1/3  pound bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
1/2  cup sliced green onions
preparation: Mix and serve as dip or spread for crackers.

name: HERB GARDEN AND LEMON PASTA
ingredients:
8  oz. uncooked corkscrew or twist pasta
1/2  c. vegetable oil
3  c. (3 medium) sliced 1/4-inch zucchini
1  c. chopped red onion
1/4  c. freshly grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. chopped fresh basil
1/4  c. chopped fresh chives
2  medium ripe tomatoes, cut in wedges
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Cook pasta according to box directions and drain.  Meanwhile, in 10-inch skillet, heat oil.  Add zucchini and onions.  Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until zucchini is crisply tender.  Add remaining ingredients and pasta.  Cover; let stand for 2 minutes or until tomatoes are heated through.  Serves 6.

name: SWEET CORNBREAD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can whole kernel corn
1 (12 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1  stick margarine, melted
8  oz. sour cream
1  box Jiffy corn bread mix
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Cook 30 minutes at 350°.  (Check with toothpick at center to see if done.)  Remove and add cheese over top.

name: SUMMER PUNCH
ingredients:
1  pkg. Kool-Aid (any flavor)
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  qt. water
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and store in refrigerator.

name: CREAM CHEESE FILLED CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/3  c. sugar
1  egg
1  (6 oz.) bag semi-sweet chocolate bits
1  pkg. chocolate cake mix
preparation: Beat cheese and sugar on medium.  Beat in egg and dash of salt. Stir in chocolate bits.  Prepare cake mix according to directions. Line muffin pans with paper cups.  Fill 2/3 full with cake batter, then drop 1 rounded teaspoonful of cream cheese mixture on top. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Makes 32 cupcakes.

name: ORANGE BLOSSOM PUNCH
ingredients:
12  c. orange juice
2  c. lemon juice
8  c. ginger ale or water
1  c. sugar
4  qt. lemon, lime or orange sherbet
preparation: Combine ingredients except sherbet and ginger ale.  Can be mixed day before and stored in refrigerator.  When ready to serve, add ginger ale and sherbet.  Sherbet takes a little time to melt. Serves 50.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
1/2  vinegar
1  tsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. Worchestershire sauce
1  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. pepper
1  can tomato soup
1  onion
1  green pepper
preparation: Clean and cut carrots.  Cook until tender, then cool. Boil sugar, oil, vinegar, mustard, sauce, salt and pepper. Add carrots. Remove from heat and add tomato soup (undiluted) onion (diced), and green pepper (diced). Cover and put in refrigerator. Marinate about 2-3 hours.  Then re-heat and serve.

name: PICKLE RELISH
ingredients:
12  large cucumbers
4  large onions
4  mangoes (green peppers)
1  stalk celery
salt
3  c. sugar
2  c. vinegar
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. mustard seed
1/2  tsp. turmeric
green food coloring (if desired)
preparation: Grind first 4 ingredients and add a handful of salt.  Let stand overnight.  Next day, drain through colander.  Add next 5 ingredients.  Boil 1/2 hour, then seal in jars.

name: BASIC BANNOCK BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
water
preparation: Mix ingredients with a few tablespoons of water.   Bake 20 to 30 minutes in covered oven.  The dough can bake as one large loaf or several small ones.  Serves 8.

name: CHICKEN SOPPA
ingredients:
1  whole chicken
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1 large  can canned milk
3/4  can chicken broth
1  medium onion, chopped
1  lb. Longhorn cheese, grated
2  pkg. tortillas, cut in half
1  can green chilies, chopped
preparation: Boil chicken; remove meat and save broth.  Blend cans of cream of chicken soup, large can of canned milk and can of chicken broth.  Dip tortillas in hot fat, then dip in soup mixture and layer in the bottom of a 2-inch deep casserole dish.  Sprinkle with onion, chilies, cheese and chicken pieces.  Spoon soup sauce over this.  Continue until all tortillas are used (three layers). Cover with remaining sauce and top with cheese.  Bake at 350° until bubbling (about 30 minutes).

name: PISTACHIO SALAD
ingredients:
1  (4 oz.) pistachio pudding
1  can fruit cocktail (with juice)
8  oz. Cool Whip
6  oz. small marshmallows
preparation: Mix all together.  Put into a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.  Top with nuts and cherries.  Chill.

name: MIXED HERB SPAGHETTI AND CLAM SAUCE
ingredients:
2  c. chopped tomatoes
1  c. tomato juice
1/2  c. dry white wine or tomato juice
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. olive or vegetable oil
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. chopped fresh parsley
2  tsp. dried basil leaves
2 (10 oz. each)  cans whole baby clams, drained
6  c. hot cooked spaghetti
preparation: Heat tomatoes, tomato juice, wine, lemon juice, oil, salt and pepper to boiling in Dutch oven.  Reduce heat.  Simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes or until slightly thickened.  Stir in parsley, basil and clams.  Serve over spaghetti.

name: HOT CHICKEN SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1  stewing hen, cooked and salted to taste
3  c. rich chicken broth
5  slices broken bread, as for dressing
5  eggs, well beaten
sandwich buns
preparation: Cook the stewing hen. Remove from bone, and cut up fine with kitchen shears. Place chicken in pot, and add broth. Bring to a boil. Add bread. Stir until bread dissolves into broth. Turn heat to low, and slowly stir in the well-beaten eggs. Cook until thickened. Serve on hot sandwich buns.

name: CHERRY CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) graham cracker crumb crust or baked pastry shell
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1/3  c. ReaLemon juice
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1 (21 oz.)  can cherry pie filling, chilled
preparation: In large bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy, then beat in condensed milk until smooth.  Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into prepared crust and chill until set.  Top with cherry pie filling before serving.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
2  boxes lime Jell-O
2  c. boiling water
1  c. cream, whipped
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  can crushed pineapple
1  lb. cottage cheese
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.  When starting to thicken, fold in cream, marshmallows, pineapple and cottage cheese.  Set aside to thicken.

name: SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  bottle red Russian dressing
1  jar apricot or pineapple preserves
1  pkg. onion soup mix (dried)
1  c. each: sliced carrots, diced green peppers and pineapple tidbits
4  to 6 chicken breasts (skinless and boneless), cut into bite size pieces
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix dressing, preserves and soup mix in a bowl. Pour over the chicken. Place chicken in refrigerator to marinate about 30 minutes. Place in a baking dish and bake for 1 hour at 350°. During the last 15 minutes, add carrots, peppers and pineapple. Serve over rice or noodles.

name: CHOCOLATE FROSTING FOR ANGEL FOOD CAKE ELEGANTE
ingredients:
1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. Hershey's cocoa
1/2  pt. whipping cream
preparation: Mix ingredients all together and set in refrigerator for an hour. Then beat until thick and spread on angel food cake. Include the center area of cake. Slice with serrated knife.

name: HASH BROWN/AU GRATIN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash browns
1  c. butter, melted
1  pt. sour cream
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
2  c. crushed corn flakes
preparation: Combine potatoes and 1/2 cup melted butter.  Combine soup, sour cream, onion, salt, pepper and cheese.  Heat, then mix with potatoes.  Put into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Top with mixture of crushed corn flakes and other 1/2 cup melted butter.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serves 10 to 15.

name: SMOKED SAUSAGE AND BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  lb. Polish sausage
2 (14.5 oz.)  cans stewed tomatoes (not drained)
1 (15.5 oz.)  can garbanzo beans, drained
2 (15.5 oz.)  cans chili beans (not drained)
1/2  c. fresh chopped parsley
preparation: Cut sausage into bite size pieces and saute.  Add remaining ingredients.  Reduce heat and simmer 5 to 10 minutes.  Serves 4.

name: CHICKEN WITH DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
4  lb. chicken (split breasts, legs, thighs)
1  medium onion, cut up
2  stalks celery, cut up
2  bay leaves
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
Bisquick
4  carrots, pared and cut into 2-inch pieces
1  can chicken broth
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dried thyme leaves
6  Tbsp. flour
preparation: In large pot, combine chicken pieces, onion, carrots, celery, chicken broth, salt, bay leaves, pepper, thyme and 3 cups water. Bring to boil over high heat.  Reduce heat; simmer, covered, for 35 minutes, until chicken and vegetables are tender.  With slotted spoon, remove chicken and vegetables.  Bring liquid to a boil (should be 5 to 6 cups).  Blend flour and 1/2 cup water until smooth; pour into boiling broth, stirring constantly until broth thickens.  Return chicken and vegetables to pot; bring to boil.

name: CINNAMON CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  c. butter
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. soda
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix flour, brown sugar and butter with hands until crumbly. Measure out 1 cup and save for topping.  Now mix egg, milk, soda and vanilla.  Add to first mixture; it will not be a smooth dough. Put in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Mix reserved crumb mixture with nuts and cinnamon.  Sprinkle on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: DIVINITY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. water
2  egg whites
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nut meats
preparation: Cook sugar, syrup and water until sugar dissolves, then cook over low heat without stirring to hard ball stage (265°).  Test by dropping a few drops in a cup of cold water.  Meanwhile beat egg whites and salt until stiff but still moist.  Slowly pour hot syrup over egg whites.  Continue beating until it begins to thicken.  Add vanilla and nuts; drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.

name: CHICKEN BREAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  boned chicken breasts
1  c. rice, boiled and rinsed
1  can cream of mushroom soup
margarine
1  c. sour cream
4  slices baked or boiled ham
4  slices Swiss cheese
preparation: Dip pieces of boned chicken into melted butter, then into flour seasoned with salt.  Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.  Butter casserole dish (9 x 13-inch) and place rice on bottom.  Place ham on next and top with chicken.  Mix soup and sour cream together; beat and pour over chicken.  Place Swiss cheese on top and sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until bubbly and brown.

name: BEEF CHOW MEIN
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
1 1/2  lb. round steak, sliced in thin strips
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
3  c. chopped onion
1  can water chestnuts
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
3  c. celery
1  qt. hot water
1  can mushrooms
1  can bean sprouts
3  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. molasses
preparation: Saute steak in margarine 5 minutes.  Add salt, pepper and onion to meat.  Cook 5 minutes.  Add celery and water.  Boil 5 minutes.   Add mushrooms, water chestnuts and sprouts.  Mix together cornstarch, soy sauce and molasses.  Add to rest.  Cook low until ready to eat.  Serve over noodles or rice.

name: PORK FRIED RICE
ingredients:
2  boneless pork chops, diced
1/2  c. diced carrots
1/2  c. finely chopped broccoli
1/2  c. frozen tiny English peas, thawed
1/4  c. chopped green onion
2  Tbsp. margarine
3  c. cooked rice
2  eggs, beaten
3 to 4  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. ground ginger
preparation: Saute  pork  chops,  carrots,  broccoli, peas and green onion in margarine  in a large skillet 3 to 4 minutes or until pork is cooked.  Remove  from  skillet,  and set aside.  Cook rice in skillet  until thoroughly heated.  Push rice to sides of skillet, forming  a  well in center.  Pour eggs into well, and cook  until set,  stirring  occasionally.  Stir rice into eggs;  add  the vegetables and remaining ingredients, stirring well.  Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: HIDDEN VALLEY RANCH BUFFALO WINGS
ingredients:
24  chicken wings/drummettes
1 (1 oz.)  envelope Hidden Valley Ranch (milk recipe) original Ranch salad dressing mix
1/4  c. hot pepper sauce (less if desired)
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/3  c. margarine, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Dredge chicken in salad dressing mix. Dip  in  mixture of margarine, pepper sauce and vinegar. Arrange on baking pans and sprinkle with paprika.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Turn;  sprinkle with paprika and bake at 450° for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
2  slices bacon
1  lb. ground round
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. rice, uncooked
2  c. tomato juice or canned tomatoes
1  clove garlic
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1  tsp. paprika
preparation: Saute bacon.  Remove.  Set aside and drain.  Brown ground round, onion, rice, tomato juice or canned tomatoes, garlic, green pepper and paprika.  Add bacon.  Cover.  Simmer 20 minutes.

name: PEPPERED CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2  cream cheese block, softened
1  can of deviled ham
1  envelope of ranch dressing
preparation: Mix together and roll into a ball.  Roll it in the black pepper.  Serve with crackers.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. cooking oil
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
3  Tbsp. milk
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. sugar
