3  ripe bananas
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat oil and sugar together.  Add eggs and banana pulp and beat well.  Add sifted dry ingredients, milk and vanilla.  Mix well and stir in nuts.  Pour into 9 x 5 x 3-inch greased and floured pan. Bake at 350° oven for about one hour.

name: PEANUT BUTTER TEMPTATIONS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. flour
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 (10 oz.)  box miniature chocolate-covered peanut butter cups (36 in pkg., 2 or 3 bags)
preparation: Cream all wet ingredients.  Add all the dry.  Shape in 1-inch balls.  Place in tea size papers into teacup tins.  Bake until lightly browned.  As soon as you remove from the oven, press the butter cups in the center of papers with cookies.  Cool before removing from the pan.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES AND PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
5  c. thinly sliced, peeled potatoes
1  c. chopped onions
salt and pepper to taste
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. sour cream
6  (1-inch thick) loin pork chops
chopped fresh parsley
preparation: In a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish, layer half of the potatoes and onion; sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Repeat layers. Combine the soup (undiluted) with sour cream; pour over potato mixture.  Cover and bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: STUFFED PEPPERS
ingredients:
6  large green peppers
1  lb. ground beef
2  c. dry bread crumbs
2  Tbsp. chopped onions
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  cans (8 oz. each) tomato sauce
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cut thin slice from stem of peppers. Remove all seeds and membranes.  Wash inside and out.  Heat 2 cups of water and 1 teaspoon salt to boiling.  Add peppers and cook 5 minutes.  Drain.  Mix remaining ingredients.  Lightly stuff peppers and place in ungreased baking dish.  Cover and bake 45 minutes, then uncover and bake 15 minutes.

name: * NO FROST OATMEAL CAKE *
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  c. quick cooking oatmeal
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1/2  c. butter or oleo
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. chocolate chips, divided
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Pour boiling water over oatmeal; let stand 10 minutes.  Add the brown sugar, white sugar and butter or oleo to oatmeal and beat well.  Add eggs and beat well.  Add flour, soda, salt and cocoa.  Stir in 1/2 cup chocolate chips.

name: APPLE CRANBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1/2  bag fresh cranberries
6  to 8 medium Granny Smith apples
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
1/2  stick butter (1/4 c.)
1/4  c. brown sugar
2  deep-dish pie crusts
preparation: Soak cranberries in 1/4 cup sugar and water.  Peel and cut up apples.   Stew apples in brown sugar and butter until tender.  Add cranberries, stirring until tender.  Pour apples and cranberry mixture with juice into pie crust.  Put other pie crust on top. Trim off excess crust.  Cut vent in center and brush with butter. Bake at 350° until golden brown.

name: CUKES
ingredients:
4  or 5 cucumbers
2  onions
1/2  green pepper
5  Tbsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. white vinegar
1/4  c. water
1/4  tsp. celery salt
preparation: Slice cucumbers and onions and cover with water; add salt. Let stand for 3 hours or more.   Drain and rinse.   Mix vinegar, sugar, water and celery.   Pour over cukes and let stand overnight in the refrigerator.   Can be frozen.

name: BOILED CUSTARD
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jell-O instant vanilla pudding mix
6  c. milk
1/4 to 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together and chill.

name: GARLIC TOAST
ingredients:
bread
butter
garlic salt
preparation: Butter both sides of bread.  Shake a small amount of garlic salt on both sides.  Place in heated frypan until golden brown on both sides.  Serve hot.

name: FRESH FRUIT DELIGHT
ingredients:
2  qt. vanilla yogurt, frozen type
1  qt. fresh strawberries, sliced and marinated in 2 c.  sugar mixed with 3/4 c. Cointreau
preparation: Scoop yogurt into dessert dishes.  Top with marinated strawberries.  Add extra splash of Cointreau if desired.  Garnish with whipped cream dollop.  Enjoy!

name: OLD FASHIONED NAVY BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
meaty ham bone
1  lb. navy beans
4  to 5 carrots, diced
salt to taste
2  c. diced celery
1  medium diced onion
cayenne pepper to taste
3 to 4  qt. water
preparation: Clean and wash beans.  Combine water, beans, ham bone and seasoning.  Cook on low heat 4 to 5 hours.  Dice vegetables.  Add to beans after they have cooked about 4 hours or almost done. Turn heat to high and bring to boil, then turn to low for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

name: BISCUIT AND BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onions
1/4  c. milk
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. catsup
1  can biscuits
preparation: Saute beef and onions in skillet until brown.  Drain.  Combine milk, soup and cream cheese in bowl.  Add salt, catsup and beef; mix well.  Pour into 2-quart casserole.  Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.  Place biscuits on top; bake for 15 to 20 minutes longer or until biscuits are golden brown.  Yield:  5 to 6 servings.

name: FUDGE PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  stick margarine
1/4  c. sifted flour
1/4  c. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Melt margarine and beat eggs slightly.  Mix all ingredients thoroughly and pour into unbaked pie shell.  (Use your favorite pastry recipe.)  Bake at 325° until filling is firm.

name: GRANDMA'S TEXAS BEAN BAKE
ingredients:
1 large  can baked beans
1 (15 oz.)  can lima beans
2  large onions, chopped
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
garlic to taste
1 (10 oz.)  can kidney beans
4  slices chopped bacon
1  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. cider vinegar
preparation: Brown bacon; drain fat.  Add ground beef and brown.  Add onions and cook until brown.  Add garlic, mustard and vinegar. Simmer 20 minutes, then add beans and mix.  Pour into 2-quart casserole and bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: SWEET GREEN RELISH
ingredients:
4  c. ground, unpeeled cucumbers (about 4 large)
1  c. ground green pepper (about 2)
1/2  c. ground sweet red pepper (about 1)
3  c. onions
3  c. finely diced celery
1/4  c. salt
3 1/2  c. sugar
2  c. white vinegar
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1  Tbsp. mustard seed
preparation: Use coarse blade on grinder.  Combine all vegetables in large bowl.  Sprinkle with salt.  Cover with cold water and let stand overnight.  Drain in colander, pressing out all excess liquid.

name: VIDALIA ONION SCALLOP
ingredients:
3  medium Vidalia onions
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped pimiento
1  c. grated Swiss cheese
1  c. cracker crumbs
2  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. light cream
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. white pepper
2  Tbsp. butter, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Peel and slice onions.  Melt 1/4 cup butter in skillet.  Add onions and green pepper.  Cook until tender.  Stir in chopped pimiento.  Place half of onion mixture in shallow baking dish.  Sprinkle with 1/2 cup grated cheese and 1/2 cup cracker crumbs.  Repeat layers of onions and cheese.  Beat eggs with light cream, salt and pepper.  Pour over onions. Combine remaining cracker crumbs with melted butter.  Sprinkle over top.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes, or until set.  Yields 6 to 8 servings.

name: BACON AND CHEESE BREAKFAST PIZZA
ingredients:
pastry for 9-inch single crust pie
1/2  lb. bacon, cooked and crumbled
2  c. (8 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese
4  eggs
1 1/2  c. (12 oz.) sour cream
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Roll pastry to fit into a 12-inch pizza pan.  Bake at 425° for 5 minutes.  Sprinkle bacon and cheese evenly over crust.  In a bowl, beat eggs, sour cream and parsley until smooth; pour over pizza.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until pizza is puffy and lightly browned.  Serves 6.

name: WATERGATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1  c. + 1 Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  pkg. pistachio instant pudding mix
1  c. ginger ale
3  eggs
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1 (8-oz.)  pkg. cool whip
3/4  c. milk
1  pkg. of pistachio instant pudding mix
preparation: Combine box cake mix, oil, instant pudding, ginger ale, eggs, and pecans.  Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan that has been greased and floured.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool and add topping when ready to serve. For topping the cake, mix cool whip, milk and pistachio instant pudding mix. Pour over cake and let set.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onions
4  c. chopped cooked chicken
4  oz. cream cheese (light)
3/4  tsp. cumin
8  oz. sour cream (light)
10  oz. can cream of chicken soup (light)
1  c. skim milk
preparation: Combine ingredients and pour over tortillas.  Top with 1 to 2 tablespoons chopped jalapeno peppers, chopped tomatoes and 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar cheese.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: FLUFFY SQUASH SOUFFLE
ingredients:
2  lb. yellow squash
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  lb. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. Ritz cracker crumbs
preparation: Cook squash and onion in salted water until tender. Drain and cool. Add beaten eggs and mix well. Add sugar and cheese. Place in a greased casserole dish. Sprinkle cracker crumbs on top and dot with butter. Sprinkle with black pepper and paprika. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: QUICK APPLE DESSERT
ingredients:
5  c. chopped apples
1  c. water
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. raspberry jello
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1  stick oleo or butter
ice cream
preparation: Mix flour, sugar and oleo until crumbly.  Pour apples in buttered baking dish, 8 x 8-inch.  Sprinkle jello over apples and pour water over apples and jello.  Next sprinkle flour mixture over apples.  Bake 40 minutes in a 350° oven or until apples are tender and topping is golden brown.  Can be served with ice cream.

name: FRIED TOMATOES AND RICEThis recipe is adapted from a 19th Century book of recipes.
ingredients:
1/3  cup uncooked rice
1/4  cup chopped onion
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
1/2  cup cooked tomatoes
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2 to 1  cup hot water
2  Tbsp. bacon drippings
preparation: Cook the rice in cooking oil for 15 minutes. stirring frquently. In another pan pour in bacon drippings. Add tomatoes, salt and pepper to the onions and continue to cook for 2 or 3 minutes, stirring often. Add hot water to the rice, a little at a time, until it reaches consistence of firm boiled rice. Add rice to the tomatoes and serve.  Serves 4 The original recipe read like this "Fry half a small cup of rice in hot lard 15 minutes. In another pan fry in drippings 1/4 of a small onion, not an El Paso onion, but a northern sized onion. Add 1/2 cup of tomato and let fry.  Add hot water to the rice until the consistency of firm boiled rice. Add a little at a time and put contents of the two pans together and serve in a hot dish with toast, if you like. Salt and pepper, of course."

name: SPEEDY MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped
1  lb. ground beef
1 (10 oz.)  can chili soup
1 (10 oz.)  can tomato soup
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Fritos
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Brown onion and ground beef in a frying pan.  Add soups. Bring to a simmer; add salt.  Line casserole dish with half of Fritos.  Pour in beef mixture.  Place remaining Fritos on top. Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at 400° until cheese melts (20 minutes).

name: GRANDMA'S CHOCOLATE FUDGE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
2/3  c. evaporated milk
2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1 1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Butter 8-inch square pan.  In medium saucepan combine butter, milk, sugar and salt.  Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.  Boil 4 to 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Stir in marshmallows, chocolate chips, vanilla and nuts.  Stir for 1 minute until marshmallows melt completely.  Pour into pan.  Cool and cut into squares.

name: ITALIAN SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
8  peeled medium potatoes
1  large onion, finely diced
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese or grated cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. celery powder
1  c. water or milk
1  c. bread crumbs
preparation: In a Corning Ware dish, layer the first 7 ingredients.  Add the water, and top with the bread crumbs.  Bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours or until potatoes are soft.  Remove from oven and let sit for 15 minutes.  Serve with your favorite side dish.

name: PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
1/2  c. chopped almonds
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Combine all ingredients in bowl.  Beat until smooth.  Pour in greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Cool. Frost with icing.

name: PUMPKIN ROLL
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. cooked pumpkin
1  tsp. lemon juice
3/4  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. powdered sugar
6  oz. cream cheese
4  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine ingredients in bowl and beat until smooth.  Spread on unrolled cake and then reroll.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: MINI MUFFALETTA SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1/4  c. French's yellow mustard
2  Tbsp. Italian salad dressing
1  tsp. chili powder
1/2  tsp. oregano
4  Kaiser rolls
4  lettuce leaves
3/4  lb. assorted cold cuts (turkey, salami, American cheese)
preparation: In a measuring cup, combine mustard, salad dressing and spices.  Mix well.  Slice roll in half and spread each half with 1 tablespoon mixture.  Place lettuce leaf on bottom half of roll. Alternately arrange 1/4 of meat and cheese over lettuce.  Cover with top half of roll.  Repeat for each sandwich.  Makes 4 servings.  Per serving, 310 calories; 20 grams protein, 24 grams fat, 4 grams carbohydrates, 61 mg. cholesterol, 1583 mg. sodium.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER TREATS
ingredients:
1  pkg. graham crackers
chocolate sauce
Cool Whip, thawed
preparation: Break each graham cracker in half.  Thaw the Cool Whip until soft.  Place 1/2 of the graham crackers in a cookie sheet and top with a spoonful of Cool Whip.  Top with another cracker and add Cool Whip on top.  You may add another layer, if you wish.  Repeat with other crackers.  Freeze for several hours.  When serving, top with a drizzle of chocolate sauce or other ice cream sauce.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. ketchup
1 heaping  tsp. butter
1/2  tsp. hot chili powder
1/2  c. white sugar
1 1/2  c. A.1. sauce
2  tsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Bring to a boil.  Pour over browned salted and peppered meat and let simmer.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1/2  c. peanut butter
3  Tbsp. margarine or butter, softened
1  c. sifted powdered sugar
8  oz. chocolate
preparation: Mix peanut butter, margarine and powdered sugar (start with between 1/2 to 3/4 cup powdered sugar and add more as needed). Roll into 1-inch balls and dip in melted chocolate.  Place on wax paper.  Refrigerate.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
5  c. flour
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Beat well.  Add baking powder and baking soda to flour and sift together.  Alternate dry ingredients and buttermilk; stir mixture until blended.  Chill, covered, for 30 minutes or longer.

name: CORN SUCCOTASH
ingredients:
1  c. cooked fresh corn
1  c. cooked fresh lima beans
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. paprika
chopped parsley
preparation: Makes 4 servings.  This is also good made with canned or frozen vegetables.

name: CHOCOLATE-CINNAMON CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/4  c. egg substitute
2  tsp. vanilla extract
vegetable cooking spray
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/3  c. unsweetened cocoa
1  c. nonfat buttermilk
2  Tbsp. margarine, melted
1/4  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Combine the first 7 ingredients in a large bowl.  Combine buttermilk and next 3 ingredients.  Add to dry ingredients, stirring until blended.  Spoon into an 8-inch square pan coated with cooking spray; sprinkle with walnuts.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool in pan on a wire rack.

name: PECAN WAFFLES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sifted all-purpose flour
1 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs, separated
1 1/2  c. milk
5  Tbsp. butter, melted
1/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Sift the dry ingredients together.  Beat egg yolks until thick.  Combine beaten egg yolks with milk and melted butter. Stir into dry ingredients.  Add chopped pecans, mixing only until blended.  Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter.  Bake in hot waffle iron.  Serve with favorite syrup or topping.

name: M&M'S COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. margarine
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  lb. pkg. M&M's
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Stir together flour, baking soda and salt.  Cream together margarine, granulated sugar and brown sugar.  Stir until light and fluffy.  Add 2 eggs and vanilla.  Gradually add in flour mixture. Add M&M's and pecans.  Bake at 350° for 9 to 12 minutes.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (No. 3)  can cut green beans
1 (No. 3)  can sliced new potatoes
tops of 2 green onions, chopped
1/2  stick oleo
juice of 1/2 lemon
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  carton sour cream
preparation: Drain beans and potatoes.  Cook beans and potatoes, covered, on low heat, until oleo melts.  Stir beans and potatoes.  Cover with oleo.  Add sour cream just before serving.  Top with one can of fried onion rings.

name: CARROT SOUFFLE SURPRISE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked carrots, mashed
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1 scant  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. milk
3  eggs, beaten
dash of lemon juice (optional)
preparation: Add butter to mashed carrots.  Combine flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon and add to carrots.  Mix well the sugar, milk and eggs and add to carrots (add lemon juice).  Pour into buttered 8 x 8 x 2 1/4-inch baking dish or any 2-quart capacity.  Bake 30 minutes at 325°.  Remove from oven and cover with topping.

name: FROZEN PUMPKIN PARFAIT SQUARES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. melted butter
1  c. brown sugar
1  can pumpkin
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ginger
1  qt. vanilla ice cream, softened
preparation: Mix crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and 1/4 cup melted butter; press into a 9-inch square pan.

name: PUMPKIN CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. salad oil
3  eggs
2  c. pumpkin
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Mix sugar and oil together.  Add eggs and beat until creamy. Add pumpkin.  Add dry ingredients, sifted.  Grease pan; use angel food cake pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  May add raisins, nuts or dried dates, if desired.

name: MAMA'S SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger meat
1  onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
2  Tbsp. Italian seasoning
1 small  can tomato paste
1 large  can tomato sauce
garlic to taste
mushrooms to taste
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown hamburger; add onion and bell pepper.  Cook until tender.  Add all other ingredients and simmer for 1 hour; stir occasionally.  Serve over noodles or rice.

name: QUICK AND EASY FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick (1/2 c.) butter
1  c. flour
1  c. sugar (or Splenda)
1  c. milk
2  t. baking powder
2  c. sweetened fruit with juice
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Melt butter and pour into cake pan.  In mixing bowl combine flour, sugar, milk and baking powder. Pour this batter on top of melted butter; do not stir.  Pour fruit and juice over batter; do not stir.  Bake for about 40 minutes.

name: "BEST EVER" COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2  c. unsifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  pt. sour cream
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. golden raisins
1  c. chopped pecans
any amount of candied fruits (cherries, pineapple, etc.)
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together over raisins, candied fruits and pecans to coat well.  Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and vanilla and beat well.  Add dry ingredients and sour cream and candied fruits, etc.  Pour batter into greased and floured Bundt cake pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour, or until done (test).  Cool in pan 1 hour before turning out.

name: DEER BURGERS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground venison meat
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. drained tomatoes
1/4  tsp. dried basil
1/2  c. shredded cheese
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
preparation: Mix meat with salt and pepper and spread out in a 9-inch pie pan.  Cover with tomatoes and sprinkle on remaining ingredients. Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 20 minutes.  Cut in wedges like pie to serve.  Enough for 2.

name: GERMAN SWEET CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. Baker's German's sweet chocolate
1/3  c. milk
2  Tbsp. sugar (optional)
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
3 1/2  c. (8 oz.) thawed whipped topping
1  graham cracker crumb crust
preparation: Heat chocolate and 2 tablespoons of  the milk in saucepan over low heat, stirring until chocolate is melted.  Beat sugar into cream cheese; add remaining milk and chocolate mixture and beat until smooth.  Fold in whipped topping, blending until smooth. Spoon into crust.  Freeze until firm, about 4 hours.  Remove from freezer 30 minutes before serving and keep chilled in refrigerator.  Garnish with chocolate curls, if desired.  Store any leftover pie in freezer.

name: SAUCY CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. (10 3/4 oz.) cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1  c. (10 3/4 oz.) cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
2  c. (16 oz.) sour cream
3/4  c. chicken broth
1/2  medium onion, chopped
1  c. sliced mushrooms
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/4  tsp. pepper
6  boneless chicken breasts
cooked noodles or rice
preparation: In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan, combine soups, sour cream, chicken broth, onion, mushrooms and seasonings.  Arrange chicken on top of sauce.   Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour or until tender.  Serve chicken and sauce over noodles or rice.  Yields 6 servings.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Jell-O gelatin (strawberry flavor)
2/3  c. boiling water
2  c. ice cubes
3 1/2  c. Cool Whip
1  c. diced strawberries
9-inch graham cracker crumb crust
preparation: Dissolve  gelatin  in  boiling  water, stirring about 3 minutes.  Add  ice  cubes  and  stir until jello is thickened, about 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove any unmelted ice.  Blend in Cool Whip  until  smooth.  Fold  in  fruit.  Chill 2 hours or more. Garnish with halved strawberries.

name: BAKED STUFFED GREEN PEPPERS
ingredients:
4  c. cooked rice
2  c. ground, cooked ham or more
4  large green peppers
preparation: Cut tops from 4 large green peppers and remove seeds.  Place peppers in a large pan of boiling, salted water and boil, covered, for 10 to 15 minutes, turning once (just until cooked, but not too soft to handle for filling).  Combine ham and rice and fill pepper shells.  Place in baking dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve plain or topped with white sauce.

name: PORCUPINE MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  c. cooked rice
1/4  tsp. monosodium glutamate
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. tomato juice
preparation: Mix hamburger, rice, Worcestershire and monosodium glutamate. Lightly form into small balls.  Pour tomato sauce mixed with tomato juice over meatballs.  Cover and cook in a 350° oven for one hour.  Yield: 4 servings.  Carbohydrate 18 g, protein 22 g, fat 16 g, calories 304.  One serving = 3 meat medium fat exchange, 1/2 bread starch exchange, 1 vegetable exchange or 3 meat medium fat exchange, 1 bread starch exchange.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1  (9-inch) unbaked pastry shell
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin (about 2 c.)
1 (13 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
2  eggs
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  In a large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except pastry shell; mix well.  Pour into pastry shell.  Bake 15 minutes.  Reduce oven temperature to 350°.  Cut a hole in a piece of foil (about 8 inches in diameter) to cover the pastry so it won't burn.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes longer or until knife inserted 1 inch from edge comes out clean.  Cool.  Garnish as desired.

name: REESE'S COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening, softened
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. Reese's peanut butter chips
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy.  Add eggs and beat well.  Combine flour and baking soda; add to creamed mixture.  Stir in Reese's chips and chocolate chips.  Drop by rounded teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned.  Cool slightly before removing from cookie sheet.  Makes 5 dozen.

name: BAKED CHICKEN WITH WINE
ingredients:
6  legs with thighs
3  potatoes
1/2  c. melted butter
1  c. crushed bran flakes
1/2  c. Sauterne wine
small amount parsley flakes
preparation: Dip chicken pieces in melted butter and roll in crushed bran flakes.  Place in 9 x 13-inch dish.  Halve the potatoes and place between chicken pieces.  Pour in a half cup of wine.  Cover and cook 40 minutes in 400° oven.  Uncover and cook 15 minutes more. Sprinkle with parsley.

name: PASTA WITH VODKA SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. olive oil
2  Tbsp. basil
1/4  c. vodka
1  can whole tomatoes, cut up
1/2  pt. heavy cream
4 to 5  cloves garlic
1  lb. pasta of your choice (i.e., ziti, rigatoni, rotelli)
preparation: Brown 1/2 cup olive oil with the cut up cloves or garlic.  Also add basil.  Let brown.  Shut off, then add vodka.  Wait 1 minute. Turn flame back on.  Add the whole tomatoes, heavy cream and salt and pepper to taste.  Pout over one pound of your favorite pasta.

name: QUICK DESSERT
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1  box Cool Whip
1 (10 oz.)  box thawed strawberries
preparation: Slice angel food cake in 3 layers. Spread with Cool Whip and strawberries between layers.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. shortening
2  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla in large bowl.  Mix flour, salt and baking powder in separate bowl.  Add flour mixture to shortening mixture about a cup at a time. This recipe does not have to be refrigerated.

name: SPECKLED CHOCOLATE LAYER CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
8  egg yolks
1 1/4  c. sugar
6  egg whites
1 1/2  c. all-purpose or cake flour
10  oz. semi-sweet chocolate, finely grated
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.   Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans. Line bottom with waxed paper or parchment paper and lightly grease the paper.  Set aside.

name: COCKTAIL SMOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. ketchup
1/2  c. finely chopped onions
1/2  c. bell pepper, finely chopped
1/2  c. pineapple chunks, drained
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. cocktail sausage
1/2  c. white Karo syrup
1/8  c. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients except sausages and pineapple in a large saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil and let simmer for 15 minutes. Add sausages and reduce heat to low.   Simmer for 20 minutes. Add pineapple for garnish and heat prior to serving.

name: GERMAN APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
5  baking or cooking apples
5  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. ground cinnamon
3  c. unsifted all-purpose flour
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
4  eggs
1  c. vegetable oil
2  tsp. vanilla extract
1/3  c. orange juice
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
2  Tbsp. soft butter
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1 to 2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Grease and flour a 10-inch tube or Bundt pan.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Peel apples, core and thinly slice.  In bowl toss apples with 5 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon.  Set aside.

name: MERINGUE FOR PIES
ingredients:
4  egg whites
7  oz. Marshmallow Creme
preparation: Beat 4 egg whites until stiff.  Add Marshmallow Creme.

name: ALOHA CRISPS
ingredients:
1 (13 oz.)  can pineapple chunks, drained
1/2  lb. bacon, halved (about 8 strips)
preparation: Preheat broiler.  Wrap one strip bacon around each pineapple chunk; secure with toothpick.  Broil 5 to 8 minutes until bacon is crisp.  Serve hot.  Makes 16 crisps.

name: ZUCCHINI QUICHE
ingredients:
3  c. shredded zucchini
1  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
4  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. chopped onions, sauteed
1/2  c. oil
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
pepper, parsley, basil and oregano to taste
preparation: Combine all ingredients and pour into a pan or pie plate. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  lb. yellow squash
1/2  c. Vidalia onion, chopped
1  c. bread crumbs
3/4  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  stick margarine
2  eggs
preparation: Clean and slice squash.  Boil until tender.  Drain, then mash. Add all ingredients except 1/2 cup bread crumbs and 1/4 cup margarine to squash.  Melt remaining butter.  Pour squash mixture into casserole dish.  Sprinkle with remaining bread crumbs and drizzle with remaining butter.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until golden brown.

name: STRAWBERRY LEMON PARFAIT
ingredients:
1/2  cup whipping cream
1/2  cup prepared lemon curd
grade peel of 1 lemon
2  pints strawberries sliced
preparation: Whip cream to form stiff peaks. In another bowl mix 1/4 cream into curd and blend; then fold rest of cream and lemon peel. Chill.

name: CREAM OF POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
7  slices chopped bacon
1  onion, chopped
6  potatoes, diced
2  qt. milk
2/3  c. flour
preparation: Fry bacon until half done, add chopped onions, fry until tender.  Add 2/3 cup flour, stir until smooth.  Add milk and stir until thick and low boil.  Add potatoes.

name: COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. self-rising flour
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Put in 9-inch pie pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: CHEESE RING
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. extra sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. medium Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  small onion, grated
1  c. mayonnaise
2  tsp. Texas Pete hot sauce
1  c. chopped pecans
parsley sprigs
Garner's strawberry preserves
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients and mix well. Add 3/4 cup pecans and mix. Shape into a ring and pat remaining pecans on top. Chill. (Put on platter or on sheet of wax paper.)

name: BEEF NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. crinkled noodles, cooked
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. milk
1  can mushrooms
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  pkg. frozen smoked soya meat
1  can diced soya beef
preparation: Melt together cream cheese and milk.  Add other ingredients. Put noodles and mixture in layers in 3-quart casserole.  Bake at 350° until it bubbles.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: STRING PIE
ingredients:
8  oz. spaghetti
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  eggs, beaten
2  tsp. butter
1  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese (2 oz.)
preparation: Cook pasta according to package directions; drain.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Cook beef, onion and green pepper in large skillet over medium-high heat until meat is brown; drain drippings.  Stir in spaghetti sauce; mix well.  In large bowl, combine spaghetti, Parmesan cheese, eggs and butter; mix well.  Place into bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Spread cottage cheese over top.  Pour sauce mixture over cottage cheese.  Sprinkle Mozzarella over top. Bake 20 minutes or until hot and cheese melts.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: CRAB DIP
ingredients:
1 8  oz. package cream cheese
1  can mushroom soup
1  envelope knox gelatin
1/2  cup chopped celery
1/4  cup green onions, chopped
1  (7 oz)  canned crab (or tuna)
1  cup mayonnaise
preparation: Heat cheese and soup in saucepan.  Add gelatin.  Remove from heat.  Add celery, onion, crab, and mayonnaise.

name: UNBAKED FUDGE CLUSTERS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. milk
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
1/2  c. peanut butter
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3 1/4  c. uncooked oatmeal
preparation: Heat butter and milk.  Add sugar and cocoa; boil for 2 to 3 minutes.  Next, add the peanut butter, vanilla and uncooked oatmeal; stir until blended.  Drop the mixture by teaspoons onto wax paper.  Let stand for 30 minutes, or until firm, then enjoy!!!

name: YUM YUM CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines Yellow Cake mix
1/2  can Eagle Brand milk
1 large  can cream of coconut
1  8  oz. container cool whip
1  c. coconut
preparation: Bake cake mix according to directions on box.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Let cake cool.  Next punch holes in the top all over. Pour eagle brand milk over cake and let settle.  Pour cream of coconut over cake and let soak into cake.  Spread cool whip on top and sprinkle with coconut. refrigerate overnight or about 12 hours for better flavor.

name: PINEAPPLE-CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1  Tbsp. bell pepper, finely chopped
3/4  c. pecans
1  tsp. seasoned salt
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, well drained
preparation: Mix all together; divide into 2 parts.  Chill several hours. Shape and roll balls into chopped pecans.  Wrap in Saran Wrap and chill.

name: PEAR RELISH
ingredients:
1  peck pears
3  large onions
2  bell peppers
5  c. vinegar
4  c. sugar
1 small  can or jar pimento peppers
1  Tbsp. mixed spices
red ground pepper to taste
salt to taste
preparation: Peel and cut pears, onions and bell peppers; grind in food chopper or blender.  Drain water or juice in a large saucepan.

name: SLICED APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1  c. oil
3  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. baking soda
5  apples, sliced
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix well all dry ingredients.  Add oil and eggs.  Stir in apples.  This is very thick.  Press into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until done.  (Hint: Put a cover on cake as soon as it comes from oven.)

name: BUTTER PECAN ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2 (14 oz.)  cans sweetened condensed milk
1  qt. half and half
1  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. vanilla extract
1  Tbsp. butter flavoring
2  c. chopped toasted pecans
preparation: Combine all ingredients, mixing well.  Pour mixture into freezer.  Freeze according to manufacturer's instructions. Yields 2 1/2 quarts.

name: FROZEN FRUIT DRINK
ingredients:
2  c. pineapple-orange-banana juice
4  Tbsp. coconut
1  c. strawberries
3  bananas
1/2  c. grenadine
ice (fill blender)
preparation: Mix in blender and enjoy.

name: MEATBALL STEW
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  egg
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1/2  c. soft bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. salad oil
3  Tbsp. flour
1 (1 lb.)  can tomatoes
1  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. basil (dried sweet)
4  small carrots
3  medium potatoes
1  onion, chopped
1  stalk celery, sliced
preparation: Mix ground beef with 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, pepper, egg, minced onion and soft bread crumbs.  Form into ball (size of a walnut). Brown in hot oil.  Remove meatballs from skillet.  Pour off all fat except 3 tablespoons.  Transfer fat to Dutch oven.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. sharp cheese, grated
2  Tbsp. onion, chopped fine
buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Cook broccoli and drain.  Combine all ingredients except crumbs.  Pour into greased casserole dish.  Top with crumbs.  Bake 45 minutes at 375°.  Serves 8.

name: STRAWBERRY-PECAN FREEZE
ingredients:
1  c. sifted plain flour
1/4  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. butter, melted (1 stick)
2  egg whites
1  c. granulated sugar
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries or peaches
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. Cool Whip (4 1/2 oz. container)
preparation: Stir first 4 ingredients together.  Spread evenly in baking pan (use cookie sheet).  Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.  Stirring occasionally with fork, sprinkle 2/3 crumbs in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  (Line with tinfoil if tin pan.)  Combine egg whites, sugar, berries and lemon juice in a large bowl; beat at high speed (almost 10 minutes) until stiff.  Fold in Cool Whip; spoon over crumbs.  Top with remaining crumbs.  Freeze 6 hours or overnight.

name: STRAWBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
2  angel food cakes
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
1  (16 oz.) sour cream
1/2  box powdered sugar
2  boxes frozen strawberries, thawed
1  jar strawberry glaze
preparation: Break up cake into pieces. Stir Cool Whip, sour cream and sugar together. Blend cake and cream together.  Pour strawberry mixture over top.  Let set in refrigerator 4 to 5 hours or overnight.

name: BAKED FISH ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/4  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. soft bread crumbs
1/2  tsp. basil leaves
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
6  very thin fish fillets
1  Tbsp. melted margarine
paprika
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Melt 2 tablespoons margarine in small skillet.  Cook until crisp-tender.  Stir in bread crumbs, basil, salt and pepper.  Mix well.  Spread mixture on fish fillets; roll up.  Place seam side down in 8-inch baking dish.  Drizzle 1 tablespoon melted margarine over fish.  Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork.  Serve with tartar sauce or lemon wedges.  Makes 2 servings.

name: GLORIOUS MESS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  c. rice, uncooked
1  can tomatoes or 2 small cans tomato sauce
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1  can kidney beans
preparation: Brown meat and onions.  Pour off excess grease.  Add remaining ingredients.  Stir to mix.  Cover and bring to a boil.  Turn to low heat and cook 30 minutes or until rice is done.  Stir once or twice while cooking to prevent sticking.  Add water if needed, depending on the amount of liquid in the tomatoes and beans.

name: CHOCOLATE-CHOCOLATE CHIP CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
2/3  c. sugar
2  eggs
1/2  c. chocolate syrup
1/4  c. dairy sour cream
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. miniature chocolate chips
3/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
confectioners sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Set aside.  In medium mixing bowl, blend butter, sugar, eggs, chocolate syrup, sour cream and vanilla.  Add flour, chocolate chips, baking powder and salt.  Beat at low speed of electric mixer until blended, scraping bowl constantly.  Beat at medium speed for 1 minute, scraping bowl occasionally.

name: PRUNE PIE
ingredients:
2 (13 oz. each)  pkg. pitted and dried prunes
1  c. sugar
1  c. apple butter
1  tsp. grated lemon peel
preparation: In large saucepan cook  prunes  in just enough water to cover. When  tender,  drain,  reserving  juice.  Cut  prunes coarsely. If there is more  than  1/3  cup  prune juice, boil down to 1/3 cup.  Combine  prunes,  juice, sugar, apple butter and lemon peel, use for filling 10-inch pie.

name: CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
8  milk chocolate bars without nuts (1.55 oz. each)
2  Tbsp. water
1/2  c. butter or margarine
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. sifted cake flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. chopped pecans
2  c. sugar
preparation: In a saucepan, melt chocolate with water over low heat. Mixture will begin to harden.  Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Blend in vanilla and chocolate mixture.  Stir together flour, salt and soda; add alternately with buttermilk to batter.  Fold in nuts, if desired. Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch pan (tube).  Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or until cake tests done when a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.  Allow cake to stand 10 minutes before removing from the pan.  Cool on wire rack; sprinkle with powdered sugar.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can mixed fruit
2  bananas
2  apples
1  tub whipped cream
preparation: Drain canned fruit.  Cut up bananas and apples.  Mix together. Fold in whipped cream.

name: BAKED PENNE RIGATI
ingredients:
1  lb. pkg. penne rigati, uncooked
1  lb. bulk Italian sausage or lean ground beef, cooked and drained
2 - 26  oz. jars of Classico Di Sicilia ripe olives and mushrooms or Di Napoli tomato and basil pasta sauce
4  c. (1 lb.) sorrento mozzarella cheese shredded
chopped parsley
preparation: Preheat oven 350°.   Prepare penne rigati as package directions.  In large bowl, combine penne rigati, sausage, pasta sauce and 2 cups cheese, mix well.  Turn into greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish; cover.  Bake 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly; uncover, top with remaining 2 c. cheese and parsley; refrigerate left over.

name: SHRIMP PARMESAN
ingredients:
1  lb. medium shrimp, boiled and peeled
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of shrimp soup
1/2 (10 3/4 oz.)  can celery soup
1/4  can water
1/2  pkg. lemon pepper fettuccini
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Boil and peel shrimp. Combine soups and water in small saucepan. Bring to a boil. Add shrimp and cook until shrimp are hot. At the same time, in another pan, cook the fettuccini as directed on package. Drain fettuccini; put serving on plate and cover with shrimp sauce.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Salt and pepper to taste. Serves 2.

name: SALAD DRESSING CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. salad dressing
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. cocoa
dash of salt
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  c. water
preparation: Combine salad dressing, sugar and vanilla.  Add combined dry ingredients alternately with water, mixing well after each addition.  Pour into 2 wax paper-lined 8 or 9-inch layer pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool 10 minutes; remove from pans.  Cool. Fill and frost with Creamy Cocoa Frosting.

name: CROCK-POT PIZZA
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
1  lb. box rigatoni noodles
2 (14 oz.)  jars Ragu chunky pizza sauce
1  small onion, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1  pkg. pepperoni
2 small  cans mushrooms
preparation: Brown hamburger.  Cook and drain noodles.  Mix all ingredients together in a crock-pot.  Set on high for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: SWEET POTATO PUFF
ingredients:
3  c. cooked and mashed sweet potatoes
3  Tbsp. butter
3/4  c. low-fat milk
4  eggs, separated
1/4  tsp. salt
few grains pepper
preparation: Whip cooked potatoes with butter, milk and pepper.  Beat in egg yolks.   Whip egg whites with salt until stiff.  Fold into potato mixture.  Place in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake in a 375° oven for 30 minutes or until top surface is lightly browned.   Makes 4 servings.

name: SUMMERTIME CHILI
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. coarsely ground beef
1  Tbsp. oil
1  c. chopped onion
2  cloves garlic, minced or pressed
1  c. chopped pepper (green)
1/2  c. chopped celery
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  tsp. cumin
1/2  tsp. dried oregano leaves
1/4  tsp. cayenne
1  c. chicken broth
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  c. canned crushed tomatoes
1  c. ripe pitted olives
2  ears corn
2  zucchini
preparation: Tips:  To prepare in advance, the chili can be made in advanced through Step 3 and refrigerated overnight.  Skim off congealed fat. Continue with rest of recipe.  No extra salt is needed as the broth and tomatoes contain salt.  The vinegar adds a tang.  Prepare: Brown beef in 1 tablespoon hot oil.  Stir occasionally but leave large crumbles of meat.  Add onions, garlic, peppers and celery, cooking until softened.  Skim the fat; stir in spices and cook 1 or 2 minutes.  Add broth, vinegar and tomatoes.  Boil; reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes.  Add olives; break the corn ears into halves or thirds. slice zucchini in half lengthwise and then crosswise in large chunks.  Place corn and zucchini on top of chili.  Cover and cook slowly 20 or 30 minutes.  Serve in bowls. Top with corn and zucchini and cornbread.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can Veg-All with juice
1  c. chopped celery
1  large onion, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can water chestnuts
1  c. mayonnaise
1  tube Ritz crackers
1  stick margarine
preparation: Mix the first 6 ingredients together.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Mix next 2 ingredients and sprinkle over top.  Bake 10 to 15 minutes.  Cook in 9 x 12-inch pan.

name: **CHRISTMAS FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2  eggs
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. light cream
juice of 1 lemon
1  c. heavy cream, whipped
1  c. chopped nuts
2  c. white cherries, pitted
2  c. pineapple, diced
2  c. orange sections, cut
2  c. marshmallows, quartered
preparation: Beat eggs until light.  Gradually add sugar, light cream and lemon juice. Mix; cook in double boiler until smooth and thick, stirring constantly.  Cool.  Fold in whipped cream.  Pour this over fruit mixture, marshmallows and nuts and mix lightly.  Chill at least 24 hours before serving.  Serves 10 to 12.

name: CLAIRE'S CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
3/4  c. dark brown sugar
3/4  c. orange juice
3/4  c. soy sauce
3/4  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Marinate chicken overnight. Bake chicken for 1/2 hour at 350°; turn over onto other side. Bake for 1/2 hour at 350°.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  eggs, beaten
1  can cream-style corn
salt and pepper to taste
20  soda crackers, crushed
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Combine all together in casserole.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

name: WALNUT BALLS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
1/2  c. superfine sugar (Bartender's sugar)
1 3/4  c. flour
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
preparation: Cream butter.  Add sugar slowly and cream.  Add flour in 2 parts, chopped nuts, vanilla and salt.  Chill overnight.  Roll into small balls to size and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

name: CREAMED CORN
ingredients:
1 large  can corn drained
1/4  c. butter
1  small onion finely chopped
2/3  c. pickled jalapeno slices drained
2/3  c. cream cheese
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: In a saucepan, melt the butter, add chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until onion is done.  Add the corn and cook for 5 minutes.  Add the jalapenos and stir into the corn mixture.  Stir in the cream cheese.  Cook over low heat until the cream cheese has melted and the corn kernels are coated in the mixture.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.

name: GROUND BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
ground beef, browned with onion
potatoes, sliced and cooked
cream of mushroom soup
slices of American or Velveeta cheese
canned biscuits
preparation: Brown meat with onion, place in bottom of casserole dish. Place cooked potatoes on top of meat.  Place cheese on top of potatoes.  Pour mushroom soup over mixture.  Separate biscuits and place biscuits on top.  Cook until biscuits are brown and casserole is hot and bubbly.  (Amount of each ingredient depends on number of servings needed.)

name: CREAMED PEAS
ingredients:
1  can green peas, drained
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  stick oleo
1  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Butter a casserole dish and set aside.  Melt oleo in saucepan and fry onions until they soften.  Add flour and stir until smooth. Add milk and stir until sauce thickens and boils.  Remove from heat.  Season and add peas.  Stir well and pour into casserole and bake at 350° until hot, about 20 minutes.  May be topped with bread crumbs if desired.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
3  c. hot tea
3  c. sugar
1 1/2  qt. cold water
3  c. fresh orange juice
1 1/2  c. lemon juice
3  c. sliced strawberries
1 1/2  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Dissolve sugar in hot tea.  Add other ingredients.

name: CREAM CHEESE AND BEEF DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
1  jar dried beef, chopped
1  can chopped black olives, chopped
3  or 4 spring onions (green onions)
preparation: You can use a blender to mix everything into cream cheese. Mix well. Refrigerate. You can use as a dip or roll into balls.

name: APRICOT NUT CUPS
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. flour
1  egg
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. Solo apricot filling
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Blend cream cheese and margarine into flour with a pastry blender.  Form 24 (1-inch) balls.  Place into mini muffin pan with a ball of dough; press into place with thumbs.  Combine egg, brown sugar, apricot filling and nuts.  Spoon into crusts.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

name: 45 MINUTE SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1/4  lb. bacon slices, cut into 1-inch pieces
3/4  c. sliced onions
1/2  lb. ground chuck
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. Worcestershire
2  tsp. sugar
3 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1/4  c. sliced stuffed olives
8  oz. thin spaghetti
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: In a large skillet, cook bacon until light brown, pouring off excess fat.  Add onions and ground chuck.  Cook, stirring with fork, until brown.  Add salt, pepper, garlic, Worcestershire, sugar and tomato sauce.  Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.  Add olives; simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.

name: RASPBERRY TAPIOCA PARFAIT
ingredients:
tapioca
whipped cream
frozen raspberries
preparation: Follow the directions on the Minute tapioca box, for fluffy tapioca cream, adding a teaspoon of orange vanilla extract along with the vanilla.  Stir well after 20 minutes.  When cold, fold in a half pint of cream that has been whipped.  In parfait glasses, alternate layers of tapioca and 3 or 4 defrosted raspberries and a dribble of juice (about 3 layers of tapioca) and top with a few berries and a bit of juice.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1 medium  jar marshmallow cream
1  block cream cheese
preparation: Let cream cheese soften before mixing.  Chill 1 hour.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. shortening
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  c. crushed ripe bananas
2  c. Bisquick
1/4  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening in a bowl.  Add the eggs, bananas, Bisquick and nuts.  Beat until well mixed.  Pour into a well-greased loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Remove from pan and cool on rack before slicing.

name: MRS. HEACOCK'S SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. mayonnaise
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking soda
4  c. flour
preparation: Mix together first 4 ingredients and add flour.  Roll into ball shapes and flatten with a glass dipped in sugar.  Don't crowd on pan as they spread as they bake.  Bake at 350° for 6 to 8 minutes.  Strange ingredients; but a very tasty cookie.

name: FRIED EGGPLANT - MEDIUM SPICY(From India)
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground turmeric
1/8 to 1/2  tsp. ground cayenne pepper
fresh ground black pepper
vegetable oil
lemon wedges (optional)
preparation: Cut eggplant into 4 long quarters, then into 1/2-inch slices (pie shaped).  Mix dry ingredients together and sprinkle evenly over slices of eggplant.  Heat oil in frying pan and fry single layer of eggplant until golden-red on each side.  Remove and blot on paper towel.  Do the next batch.  Add oil as needed.  Serve with lemon wedges.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: QUICK AND EASY PASTA
ingredients:
1  box Velveeta and shells
1  lb. hamburger
1  can spaghetti sauce or 2 c. if you make your own
thinly sliced pepperoni
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese
salt to taste
preparation: Prepare Velveeta and shells according to directions on box. Brown hamburger; drain.  Pour Velveeta and shells in bottom of casserole dish; add crumbled hamburger.  Next, pour spaghetti sauce to cover.  Add pepperoni slices and top with cheese.  Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
3/4  c. chopped onion
olive oil
6  c. water
6  bouillon cubes (chicken)
2  (10 oz.) frozen broccoli cuts
1  (12 oz.) egg noodles
1  stick real butter
6  c. milk
1  (1 lb.) Velveeta cheese
garlic to taste (just a pinch)
preparation: Saute onion in olive oil.  Add water and chicken bouillon cubes.  Bring to a boil.  When boiling, add broccoli.  Cook until broccoli is tender.

name: CARAMEL APPLE DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. caramel extract
1  c. finely chopped peanuts (optional)
preparation: Serve with apple slices.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
2  c. sliced peaches
1/2  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. oleo
1  c. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. Crisco
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix peaches with brown sugar and melted oleo. Place in round cake pan. Sift together flour, salt, baking powder and sugar. Cut in shortening. Add milk and mix well. Spoon over peaches. Bake on top rack of oven for 30 minutes at 400°.

name: PECAN CARAMELS
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. half and half
3/4  c. light corn syrup
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips, melted
64  pecan halves
preparation: In a 4-quart saucepan, combine sugar, 1 cup half and half, corn syrup and butter.  Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture comes to a full boil (7 to 8 minutes). Add remaining 1 cup half and half; continue cooking, stirring often, until mixture reaches 245° (35 to 40 minutes).  Pour into buttered 8-inch square pan.  Cover; refrigerate 1 to 1 1/2 hours to cool.  Cut into 64 pieces.  Drop 1/4 teaspoon melted chocolate on top of each caramel; press pecan half into chocolate.  Cover; store refrigerated.

name: FRENCH FRIED ONION RINGS
ingredients:
3/4  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
2  Tbsp. oil
1  egg
3  Bermuda onions
oil (for frying)
preparation: Combine flour, salt, milk, oil and egg.  Beat until smooth. Cut onions into 1/4-inch slices; separate into rings.  Dip each ring in the batter.  Drop a few at a time in the oil, heated at 375°.  Cook 2 to 3 minutes.  Drain on absorbent paper.  Sprinkle with salt, if desired.

name: FIESTA SALAD
ingredients:
2  lb. ground chuck
2  big onions, chopped
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (12 oz.)  can tomato puree
2  Tbsp. chili powder
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1 (23 oz.)  can Ranch Style beans
salt to taste
preparation: Brown meat; drain well.  Saute onions, add to meat.  Add all of the other ingredients and simmer for 1 hour.  Arrange and serve in the following way (buffet style) and do not let your guests skip any steps:

name: FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
1  can blueberries, drained
1  pkg. orange jello (3 oz.)
5  bananas
preparation: Mix pineapple, sugar and flour in pan.  Bring to a boil. Remove from heat; add jello, blueberries and cool.  Add bananas. This makes 3 pies, use 3 graham cracker pie crusts.  Top with Cool Whip.

name: BERRIES ON THE SQUARE
ingredients:
9  whole graham crackers, halved
1 (6 serving size)  pkg. vanilla flavored instant pudding
2  c. cold milk
1  (4 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
1  c. finely chopped strawberries
preparation: Arrange 9 crackers in bottom of 9-inch square pan.  Prepare pudding mix with 2 cups milk as directed on package for pudding. Fold in 1 cup of whipped topping.  Pour 1/2 the pudding mixture over crackers and top with berries.  Arrange remaining crackers on berries and add remaining pudding mixture.  Spread remaining whipped topping and garnish with halved strawberries.  Chill; cut into squares.

name: HAM AND CHEESE BISCUIT POCKETS
ingredients:
1  c. cubed, cooked ham
4  oz. (1 c.) Kraft shredded Swiss cheese
1/2  c. finely chopped, peeled apple
10  oz. can Hungry Jack flaky buttermilk biscuits
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  tsp. water
alfalfa sprouts (if desired)
chopped tomatoes (if desired)
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Lightly grease large cookie sheet.  In small bowl, combine ham, cheese and apple.  Separate dough into 10 biscuits.  On prepared cookie sheet, press or roll 5 biscuits to 4-inch circles.  Place about 1/2 cup ham mixture on center of each circle.  Press or roll remaining 5 biscuits to 5-inch circles. Place each over filling.  Press edges with fork to seal.  Combine egg and water; brush over biscuits.  Bake at 375° for 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown.  Cut each in half to form pocket sandwiches; garnish with alfalfa sprouts and tomatoes to serve. Serve warm.  Makes 5 servings.

name: CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. white corn meal
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
2  c. milk
4  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine meal, margarine, sugar and salt; mix well.  Add 2 cups boiling water.  Mix well and cook until thick, stirring frequently. Remove from stove and add eggs, milk and baking powder.  Stir well. Pour into greased pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: LUCK'S CHILI HOT BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef or bulk pork sausage, crumbled
2  medium onions, chopped
2 (15 oz. each)  cans Luck's chili hot beans
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies, drained
4  tsp. chili powder
1  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: In a 3-quart saucepan, cook beef and onions until beef is brown; drain.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Heat to a boil over medium heat.  Reduce heat; cover and simmer 30 minutes.  Makes about 7 one cup servings.

name: A.1.  FLAVOR MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
6  Tbsp. A.1. steak sauce
1  medium onion, chopped
1  c. dry bread crumbs
2  eggs, beaten
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. seasoned pepper
preparation: Lightly mix all ingredients.  Pat into 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.  Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: LEMON CREAM DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick oleo
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. confectioner sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
2  pkg. instant lemon pudding mix
3  c. milk
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
chopped nuts
preparation: Mix flour and oleo as making a pie crust.  Spread over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 15 minutes at 350°.  Cool.  Mix cream cheese and sugar, then add Cool Whip.  Spread over crust.  Mix pudding mix, milk and lemon juice until thick.  Spread over cream cheese mixture.  Spread leftover Cool Whip over top and sprinkle with chopped nuts.  Chill.  Serves 16.

name: POPCORN FUDGE BARS
ingredients:
4  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. butterscotch chips
3  Tbsp. butter
3  qt. popped popcorn
1 (12 oz.)  jar hot fudge sauce
preparation: In large Dutch oven, over low heat, melt marshmallows with butterscotch chips and butter; stir occasionally until smooth. Add popcorn; stir until well coated.  Press half of mixture firmly into a greased 9-inch square pan.  Spread fudge sauce evenly over mixture.  Press remaining popcorn mixture over fudge.  Allow mixture to cool and harden.  Slide spatula under entire mixture and slide onto a cutting board to cut into bars.  Makes 16 bars.

name: KIELBASA DELIGHTS
ingredients:
1  cut up kielbasa
1/2  c. whiskey
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. ketchup
preparation: Heat in frypan and serve hot.

name: MUSHROOM BURGERS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1 1/2  cans water
salt to taste
pepper to taste
preparation: Pat out ground beef into patties.  Brown, then drain off the fat.  Mix mushroom soup and water together.  Pour over patties. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.  Serve with mashed potatoes or with rice.

name: RHUBARB PIE
ingredients:
3  c. rhubarb
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
2/3  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. quick rolled oats
1/2  c. melted butter
preparation: Wash  and  cut  rhubarb  in  1/2 to 1-inch slices.  Mix sugar and flour; pour over rhubarb and set aside.  Mix next 4 ingredients  together.  Pour  into  a  9  or  10-inch pie pan. (Save about 1/2 cup for topping.) Press on bottom and sides to form  a  pie shell.  Put rhubarb mixture in next, then rest of oat mixture on top.  Bake, covered lightly in a 350° oven for about 45 minutes.  Remove top last 10 minutes.

name: MAGIC COOKIE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1  c. (8 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 (3 1/2 oz.) or 1 1/2  c. flaked coconut
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In 13 x 9-inch glass baking pan melt margarine in oven.  Sprinkle crumbs over margarine.  Pour milk evenly over crumbs.  Top with remaining ingredients.  Press down firmly.  Bake for 25 minutes.  Cool.  Cut into bars.  Store loosely covered at room temperature.

name: FRIED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  medium cabbage
1  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. salt
4  eggs
4  Tbsp. milk
2 1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. red pepper
preparation: Cut cabbage into 6 to 8 squares or wedges.  Cover with water and add 1 teaspoon salt and 1 tablespoon butter.  Bring to boil for 5 to 7 minutes.  Drain cabbage.  Beat eggs and 4 tablespoons milk. In another container mix flour, pepper and remaining salt.  Dip cabbage into egg mixture and coat with flour.  Deep fry in hot bacon dripping.  May also be pan-fried.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: CREAMY RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
6  c. whole milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. water
1  c. rice (Carolina)
preparation: In a stainless steel pot, beat eggs thoroughly.  Add sugar, milk, vanilla, water and rice.  Mix well.  Bring to a slight boil, then lower heat and cook for about one hour, stirring frequently. Pour into a bowl, when slightly cooled off, and refrigerate overnight or 8 hours.

name: PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  box pasta (shells, elbows, etc.)
1  onion
1  bottle French dressing
8  c. assorted vegetables (raw): broccoli, cauliflower, carrots and celery
1  can black olives
mayonnaise
1 to 2  c. shrimp or chicken
preparation: Cook pasta.  Drain.  Put  in bowl and add chopped onion and French dressing.  Refrigerate 12 hours.  Next day, add the chopped vegetables (8 cups).  Just before serving, add olives and mayonnaise	to  taste.  Shrimp, sea legs or chicken may be added.

name: CROCK-POT POTATOES
ingredients:
1  carton sour cream
2  cans Cheddar cheese
instant onions to taste
1  stick margarine
6  to 8 medium potatoes, boiled
preparation: Melt oleo in saucepan and add sour cream and soup.  Combine with cooked potatoes in crock-pot on low.  Heat for at least 1 hour.

name: STRAWBERRY SPARKLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. angel food cake mix
1  c. boiling water
1  pkg. (3 oz.) strawberry flavored gelatin
2  pkg. (1 lb.) frozen strawberries, sliced
1/2  pt. (1 c.) whipped cream
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Bake cake as directed on back of package and cool.  Dissolve jello in water and add frozen block of strawberries, stirring to break up.  Cut 1 inch layer from top of cake.  Cut a tunnel into cake.  Gently remove sections of cake from the middle, tear into small pieces.  Fold pieces into strawberry mixture and spoon into cake.  Place cake layer on top.  Spread whipped cream on cake. Refrigerate until serving time or at least 1 hour.

name: POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
5  lb. potatoes
6  hard-boiled eggs
salt to taste
celery seed to taste (preferably a lot)
2  c. mayonnaise (more or less)
1  small onion, diced small
pepper to taste
preparation: Peel and cube potatoes into bite-sized pieces.  Boil until done (soft).  Do not overcook.  Let cool.  Add mayonnaise, eggs, onion and other spices.  Serve.

name: CORN RELISH
ingredients:
8  c. corn (about 16 ears)
2  c. diced green peppers
4  c. diced celery
1  c. diced onions
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  qt. white vinegar
2  Tbsp. kosher salt
2  tsp. celery seed
2  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  tsp. turmeric
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except corn, dry mustard and turmeric.  Cover and bring to a boil.  Boil 5 minutes.  Add corn, dry mustard and turmeric.  Cook 5 minutes.  Put in clean jars; seal.  Process in hot water bath 15 minutes.

name: ORANGE BREAKFAST RING
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. grated orange peel
1/3  c. chopped almonds
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  Tbsp. orange juice
2 (8 oz.)  cans refrigerated crescent rolls
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Combine orange peel, sugar and cream cheese.  Unroll both cans of rolls.  Press seams together to form a flat surface.  Spread with cream cheese.  Roll up as jelly roll, form a ring with roll and place on jelly roll pan.  From outside, cut halfway to center of ring all around ring, about 2 inches apart.  Give each piece a half turn.  Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Mix powdered sugar and orange juice.  Drizzle on top of ring.  Serve warm.

name: CHICKEN CHOW MEIN
ingredients:
3  c. chopped diced chicken
3  c. chicken stock
1  c. bean sprouts or chop suey vegetables
1/4  c. butter
1  c. mushrooms
1/3  c. water
2  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. soy sauce
2  small onions, chopped
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Saute until brown the butter, onion and mushrooms.  Add ingredients and simmer 15 minutes.  Add salt and pepper to taste. Blend in cornstarch and water.  Cook until thick.  Serves 6.

name: HOT CHEESE SANDWICHES
ingredients:
2 (5 oz.)  jars processed cheese spread
1 (30 oz.)  can grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. softened butter or margarine
1  egg
1  lb. bacon, cooked and crumbled
1  large loaf day-old sandwich bread
preparation: Beat cheese spread, Parmesan cheese, butter and egg at medium speed of electric mixer until light and fluffy.  Stir in crumbled bacon, blending well.  Trim crust from bread; cut into quarters or halves.  Spread with cheese mixture.  Top with second piece of bread.  Spread with cheese mixture.  Repeat procedure with remaining cheese and bread.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Serve immediately.

name: SHORTBREAD COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
2  c. flour
1  c. butter
preparation: Mix all together until mixed well.  Knead until smooth; work with hands.  Roll out to 1/2-inch thick.  Bake on low heat until light brown.  Serves 36.

name: PUMPKIN BARS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
4  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
2  c. pumpkin or No. 1 can pumpkin
preparation: Sift dry ingredients.  Stir together eggs, sugar, oil and pumpkin.  Add flour mixture to pumpkin mixture.  Blend.  Spread onto a greased pan about 17 x 11 x 1-inch.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  When cool, frost.

name: CREAM CHEESE QUICHE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1/2  c. heavy cream
1/4  tsp. pepper
6  slices bacon
3  egg yolks
1  egg
1/4  tsp. salt
unbaked 8 to 9-inch pie shell
preparation: Beat cream cheese, egg yolks, heavy cream, egg, pepper and salt until smooth and blended. Cut bacon in 1-inch pieces and cook until lightly browned and crisp. Arrange the bacon in the pie shell. Pour cheese mix over bacon and bake in preheated 400° oven for 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake 10 minutes longer or until puffed and golden brown. Let stand a few minutes and serve hot. Serves 4 to 6.

name: BEST CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
4  oz. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1  tsp. onion
2  Tbsp. green pepper, diced
1  pkg. Hidden Valley salad dressing "original" dry powder
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix together.

name: CHICKEN A LA KING
ingredients:
2  c. or more cooked, diced chicken
2 (10 oz.)  cans cream of chicken soup
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
1/2  c. diced celery
1/4  c. diced green pepper
1  Tbsp. diced pimento
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
preparation: Saute celery, pepper and mushrooms in oil for 3 to 4 minutes. Add undiluted condensed soups and bring to a simmer.   Add chicken and pimento. Salt and pepper to taste.  Mix well and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve over biscuits or toast.  Serves 4.

name: QUICK AND EASY CHICKEN AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice
2  boneless chicken breasts, skins removed
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. basil
2  c. water
preparation: Grease bottom and sides well of an 8 x 12-inch casserole dish. Spread uncooked rice over bottom.  Arrange uncooked chicken breasts over rice.  Spread undiluted cream of mushroom soup over chicken.  Sprinkle oregano and basil over casserole.  Add water and cover.  Cook 1 hour at 350°.   Serves 4.

name: CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. chicken wings
1/2  c. orange juice
1  Tbsp. peanut oil
dash of sesame oil
1/4  c. soy sauce
1  tsp. minced garlic
1  tsp. minced ginger
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  Tbsp. cornstarch, mixed with 3 Tbsp. water
preparation: Rinse wings; split each into 2 pieces.  Mix all other ingredients (except cornstarch and water) in a bowl.  Lay chicken wings in a baking dish and pour mixture over them.  Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours.

name: BAKED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
sliced onions
salt and pepper
flour
sliced potatoes
butter
milk
breaded pork chops
preparation: Place a layer of thinly sliced onions in a greased baking dish, about 1/3 of the depth.  Season with salt and pepper.   Dust with flour.  Add a layer of thinly sliced potatoes; season.  Dot with butter; moisten with milk.  Place breaded pork chops on top. Bake at 350° until done.

name: WILTED SPINACH SALAD
ingredients:
8  c. fresh spinach
1  c. fresh bean sprouts
1/2  c. sliced water chestnuts
1/4  c. chopped onion
4  slices bacon, cut into small pieces
3  Tbsp. vinegar
3  Tbsp. catsup
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  hard-cooked egg (optional)
preparation: Tear spinach leaves into bite-size pieces in a mixing bowl. Add bean sprouts and water chestnuts.

name: HOMEMADE SALAMI
ingredients:
5  lb. ground beef
5  Tbsp. Tender Quick salt (Morton)
2 1/2  tsp. mustard seed
2  tsp. seasoned salt
1  Tbsp. liquid smoke
1 1/2  tsp. garlic salt
2  Tbsp. coarsely ground pepper
1  Tbsp. peppercorns
preparation: Mix well.  Refrigerate 24 hours, kneading 3 times during the 24 hours.  Form into 4 rolls (12 x 2-inches).  Place on broiler pan.  Bake at 150° for 8 hours, turning 3 times.  Salami will form its own casing.  Keeps in refrigerator several weeks and may be frozen for 3 months.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1/4  c. minced onions
1  egg beaten
salt and pepper
1  c. oatmeal
1  lb. hamburger
2  tsp. Worcestershire
garlic powder
1 small (6 oz.)  can tomato paste, mixed with 1 can water
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl with a fork.  Spray glass baking pan with cooking spray.  Cook at 325° for 1 hour.

name: SPRITZ COOKIES/HOLIDAY COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  Tbsp. cream
2 1/4  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1 1/2  sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted
preparation: Cream margarine.  Add sugar slowly, creaming until light and fluffy.  Add eggs to cream mixture and beat well.  Stir in vanilla extract and cream.  Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg.  Add slowly to margarine mixture, mixing well.  Divide dough in half.  Leave one half plain.  To other half, add cooled, melted chocolate and mix well.  Fill cookie press and form cookies on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake in moderately hot oven (400°) 8 to 10 minutes.   Decorate cookies with colored sugar before baking.  Or the baked cookies may be decorated with confectioners sugar icing and coconut, nuts or candied fruits.  Your choice.

name: STUFFED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  to 8 pork chops
salt and pepper
1  box Stove Top stuffing, prepared
preparation: Brown pork chops in small amount of oil and place in baking dish.  Put a spoonful of Stove Top stuffing (prepared according to directions on box) on top of each pork chop.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: SWEET POTATO POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
2  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. oil
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. mashed sweet potatoes
1/2  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix dry ingredients together in a large bowl.  Add add oil, vanilla, and sweet potatoes and mix well.  Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well each time.  Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour.  Cool.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
2  tomatoes
1  small onion, chopped (if desired)
nacho cheese Doritos
1  head lettuce
2  cucumbers
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
shredded cheese
preparation: Brown ground chuck and cook according to instructions on taco seasoning package.  Drain and set aside.  Mix sliced tomatoes, cucumber, onion and lettuce in large salad bowl.  Add ground chuck and cheese.  Top with Doritos.

name: FRIED POTATOES AND ONION
ingredients:
3  to 4 potatoes, peeled and sliced
1/2  large onion, peeled and sliced
1/2  stick butter
3  Tbsp. teriyaki sauce (not ginger)
preparation: Fry on medium-high heat and serve.

name: EASY COLESLAW
ingredients:
1/2  head cabbage, shredded
1/2  c. green onions, chopped with tops
1  carrot, shredded
1/2  c. real mayonnaise
1/2  c. sweet relish
preparation: Combine cabbage, onions and carrot and mix well.  In separate bowl, combine mayonnaise and relish.  Pour dressing over vegetables, cover and refrigerate overnight to enhance flavor.

name: CHINESE FRIED RICE
ingredients:
2  c. water
2 2/3  c. Minute rice
2  slightly beaten eggs
6  Tbsp. margarine
2/3  c. chopped onion
2/3  c. water
5  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: In small saucepan bring 2 cups water to boil.  Stir in rice. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, using a 10-inch skillet, cook eggs in margarine.   Add chopped onion and the rice until mixture is lightly browned.  Mix 2/3 cup water with 5 or 6 tablespoons soy sauce and stir into rice.  Heat until water is absorbed.  Makes 8 servings.

name: EASY ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. Crisco
3/4  c. sugar
2  c. lukewarm water
2  pkg. yeast
2  eggs
6  c. flour (plain)
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream together Crisco and sugar. Stir together water and yeast. Stir eggs into Crisco and sugar. Stir in yeast and water. Mix flour and salt. Stir in flour about 1/2 cup at a time. Will be real sticky. Cover bowl and place in refrigerator. Will double in bulk.

name: CHICKEN SPAGHETTI
ingredients:
1  chicken, cooked and deboned
1/2  c. celery
1  green pepper, sauteed in 1/2 margarine
1  medium onion
8  oz. spaghetti, cooked
1  pimento (optional)
1/2  lb. sharp shredded cheese
4  oz. can mushrooms
1  can mushroom soup
1  chicken bouillon or broth from where chicken was cooked
preparation: Mix well and put in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Top with Parmesan. Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: ROLLED FILLET OF SOLE
ingredients:
2  lb. fresh sole
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1  medium onion, chopped
1  egg, beaten
2  Tbsp. water
3  slices bread, crumbled
3/4  c. melted butter
fresh parsley and lemon wedges (for garnish)
preparation: Wipe each fillet and sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Sprinkle cheese and onion on each fillet.  Roll jelly roll style and secure with toothpick.  Dip each rolled fillet in egg and water wash. Coat with bread crumbs.  Place in well buttered dish.  Pour melted butter over top and bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Place under broiler until bread crumbs brown.  Serve garnished with parsley and lemon wedges.

name: CROCK-POT APPLE BUTTER
ingredients:
8  c. diced apples
4  c. white sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Cook on low in crock-pot for 12 hours with lid on.  Take lid off, add cinnamon, allspice and ground cloves.  Cook 3 hours with lid off.  This can be canned in pint jars or served with warm toast or muffins.  M-M-M good and you should smell it while it is cooking.

name: PISTACHIO CAKE
ingredients:
1  white or  yellow cake mix
1  pkg. pistachio instant pudding mix
3  eggs
1  c. club soda, 7 up, or water
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix whole thing on low speed. Then at med. speed for 2 minutes.

name: STICKY PECAN ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. chopped pecans
19  Rhodes frozen dinner rolls
1/2  c. melted margarine
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  pkg. instant butterscotch instant pudding
1  c. brown sugar
preparation: The night before, spread pecans on bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan. Place dinner rolls on top of pecans.  Drizzle margarine over rolls. Sprinkle instant pudding over rolls.  Spread brown sugar over pudding.  Cover with Saran Wrap and leave to rise overnight.  To bake, remove Saran Wrap and bake 1/2 hour at 350°.

name: SHIRLEY'S COOKIES
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
2  eggs
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. white sugar
2  c. pecans
1  tsp. soda
2  c. cornflakes
2  c. coconut
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream together first 5 ingredients.  Blend together remaining ingredients.  Stir together and drop from teaspoon on a greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: CZECHOSLOVAKIAN COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or oleo
1  c. white sugar
2  egg yolks
2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  to 1  c. strawberry jam
preparation: Mix by hand with long wooden spoon.  Cream butter and add sugar.  Cream until light and fluffy.  Add eggs yolks and blend well.  Add flour, mix thoroughly.  Fold in nuts, salt and vanilla. Spoon 1/2 batter into pan.  Spread evenly.  Spread strawberry jam on dough.  Cover with remaining dough.  Bake 1 hour at 325° or until lightly browned.  Remove from oven.  Sprinkle powdered sugar on top.  Cut into squares.

name: SPICY CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. chili powder
1 (16 oz.)  can pork and beans (in tomato sauce)
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's condensed tomato soup
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies
1/2  c. water
preparation: In 10-inch skillet over medium heat, cook beef, onion, garlic and chili powder until beef is browned and onions are tender, stirring to separate meat.  Spoon off fat.  Stir in beans, soup, chilies and water.  Heat to boiling.  Reduce heat to low.  Simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Makes 4 cups or 4 servings.

name: LEMON PIE
ingredients:
3  egg yolks
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1/2  c. ReaLemon juice
preparation: Mix well with mixer and pour into graham cracker crust.  Bake at 350° for 8 minutes. Cool and top with Cool Whip.

name: CHINESE PINEAPPLE MEATBALLS
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. pecans
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
4  eggs
1/2  c. celery, minced
1/4  tsp. minced garlic
1/4  c. corn flakes
1 1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine beef, celery, pecans, salt, cornflakes, eggs, soy sauce and garlic.  Roll into small balls.  Roll these in flour and deep fry in very hot vegetable oil, then drain.

name: LADY BIRD JOHNSON'S SPINACH PARMESAN
ingredients:
3  lb. spinach
6  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
6  Tbsp. minced onion
6  Tbsp. heavy cream
5  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  c. cracker crumbs
preparation: Place cooked, cleaned spinach  in  water  (or may steam same). Drain thoroughly and chop coarsely.  Add cheese, onion, cream and 4 tablespoons  butter.  Arrange  in  shallow  baking dish and sprinkle with  crumbs  mixed  with	remaining butter. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: OVEN ROASTED PEANUTS
ingredients: 1  bag raw Virginia type peanuts in shell or shelled
preparation: Place peanuts in 1 layer deep in a shallow baking pan. Roast in a 350 degrees oven for 15 to 20 minutes for shelled and 20 to 25 minutes for in shell peanuts. Remove from heat just short of doneness desired as peanuts continue to cook as they cool.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
24  oz. pkg. hash browns
1  small onion, chopped
