2  cans Cheddar cheese soup
1  can potato soup
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
salt
pepper
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix together and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 350°.  Very good.

name: LEMON SESAME SCALLOPS
ingredients:
1  yellow pepper, julienned
1  carrot, julienned
salt and freshly ground pepper
4  oz. snow peas, trimmed
3  Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
2  Tbsp. clam juice or chicken broth
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1 1/2  tsp. cornstarch
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. minced garlic
1/2  tsp. grated fresh ginger
1  lb. sea scallops
2  green onions, julienned
1  Tbsp. toasted sesame seed
preparation: Combine yellow pepper and carrot in 10-inch microwaveproof pie plate; sprinkle with water and a pinch each of salt and pepper. Cover and microwave on High 1 1/2 minutes.  Stir in snow peas. Microwave, covered, 30 seconds more.  Let stand, covered, 2 minutes.

name: SUNSHINE CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  lb. chicken
2  Tbsp. shortening
1  can condensed golden mushroom soup
1/3  c. drained chopped tomatoes
1/2  c. onion
1/8  tsp. basil, crushed
cooked rice
preparation: In skillet, brown chicken in shortening; pour off fat.  Add remaining ingredients, except rice.  Cover.  Cook over low heat 45 minutes or until done.  Stir occasionally.  Serve with rice. Makes 4 servings.

name: ITALIAN ZUCCHINI
ingredients:
8  medium zucchini, sliced
14  oz. can tomatoes, drained
4  green onions, chopped
1/2  yellow onion, chopped
3  ribs celery, chopped
1/2  stick butter
3  oz. can mushrooms
1/4  tsp. sweet basil
1  c. Monterey Jack cheese, grated
preparation: Cook the zucchini in boiling, salted water until tender. Drain.  In saucepan, saute the onion and celery in butter until soft.  Combine all the ingredients and mix well.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Transfer to a lightly buttered casserole and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Serves 8.

name: BEET SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can diced beets
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. horseradish
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1/4  c. vinegar
preparation: Drain beets. Add enough water to beet juice to measure 1 1/2 cups liquid. Bring liquid to a boil. Add Jell-O. Stir well to dissolve. Add sugar, vinegar and horseradish. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Add beets. Chill until Jell-O is set.

name: CHUNKY CHOCOLATE CHIP BROWNIE-TYPE COOKIES
ingredients:
3  c. self-rising flour
2  c. chocolate chips
1 1/2  Tbsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
2  c. granulated sugar
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. Crisco shortening
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Cream shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla together.  Blend in chocolate chips.  Gradually add in flour on medium speed of mixer.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.  Cool for 25 minutes, then cut into squares.

name: SWEET POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. mashed sweet potatoes
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. melted butter
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/3  c. milk
preparation: Beat all ingredients together and put in a 2-quart casserole.

name: K C GROUND ROUND VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground round
1  c. diced potatoes
1  c. sliced celery
1  c sliced carrots
3  c. water
2  Tbsp. sugar (optional)
1/4  tsp. thyme
2-4 c. tomatoes
3  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. basil
preparation: Brown meat and drain.  Combine all ingredients in a large pot. Simmer covered for one hour.

name: LENA'S CHEESE AND POTATOES
ingredients:
6  large potatoes
2  onions, diced
1  c. bacon bits
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  tsp. basil
2  tsp. chives
2  tsp. parsley
2  tsp. marjoram
1/2  tsp. black pepper
salt to taste
1  stick butter
preparation: Slice potatoes about 1/4-inch thick.  Cook until tender. Drain off water.  Then layer potatoes in a baking pan.  Sprinkle with other ingredients.  Keep doing this until you use all your potatoes and other ingredients.  Put cheese on top.  Put in oven (on broil) for about 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

name: BEEF PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1  boneless top round steak, cut 1-inch thick
1/3  c. cornstarch
1/2  c. vegetable oil
3  medium sweet green peppers, seeded and cut into strips
3  medium size onions, sliced
2  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  c. soy sauce
1  c. water
preparation: Cut meat into 1/4-inch slices.  Toss with cornstarch in large bowl until coated.  Saute beef a few slices at a time, in 1/4 cup of the oil in a wok until no pink remains, about 3 minutes. Remove meat as it cooks to a warm platter.  Saute peppers, onions and garlic in remaining oil until tender, about 3 minutes.  Return meat to wok.  Stir in soy sauce and water.  Continue cooking, stirring and scraping brown bits in wok, until sauce thickens.

name: WHOLE WHEAT BREAD
ingredients:
5 1/2  c. lukewarm water
3  Tbsp. yeast
3  c. white flour
3  c. whole wheat flour
2  Tbsp. salt
3/4  c. oil
3/4  c. honey
7  c. flour (mix white and whole wheat)
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Mix water and yeast until yeast is dissolved.  Add your 6 cups of flour and mix up.  Add your salt, oil, honey and rest of the flour.  Knead your dough for 5 minutes. Let rest, covered with a towel, until double in size.  I get 4 loaves of bread and a large size of cinnamon rolls out of this recipe.  You'll also need a very large bowl for the dough.  Bake bread 35 to 40 minutes or until done.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets
2  Italian herb with tomato recipe soup mix
2  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. fresh bread crumbs
2  eggs
3/4  c. water
1/3  c. ketchup
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a large bowl, combine all ingredients.  In a large pan, shape into loaf.  Bake 1 hour or until done.  Makes 8 servings.

name: ORANGE PUNCH DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
2 (16 oz.)  bottles orange pop
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
2  pkg. orange Kool-Aid
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  oranges, sliced in punch
1 1/2  qt. water
preparation: Mix all ingredients and blend well. Serve over ice.

name: BEST DEVIL'S FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. milk
2  tsp. instant coffee powder
3/4  c. unsweetened cocoa
1/2  c. sour cream
1 1/4  c. all purpose flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
Pinch salt
1  c. butter, softened (no substitutions)
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  large eggs, at room temperature
2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease three 8-inch cake pans. Line bottoms with wax paper. Grease and flour paper. Heat milk and coffee in small saucepan until small bubbles form around edge. Add to cocoa and whisk until smooth. Whisk in sour cream. Cool. In a medium bowl. combine flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Beat butter in mixer bowl until light. Gradually beat in sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Add vanilla. At low speed, gradually beat in dry ingredients alternately with chocolate mixture, beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Beat at medium speed 2 minutes. Pour into prepared pans. Bake 25 minutes, until top springs back when lightly touched. Cool in pan on wire rack 10 minutes. Invert cakes onto rack. Remove paper and cool complete, right side up.

name: STRAWBERRY TORTE
ingredients:
1  box Washington cake mix (yellow, white or angel food)
1 (5.9 oz.)  box instant vanilla pudding
frozen, whole strawberries, or fresh
1  tub whipped cream
preparation: Prepare cake as directed.  Crumble into a dish.  Pour pudding (prepare as directed on box) on top of cake.  Slice strawberries; dump on top of pudding (save a few for on top).  Spread whipped cream on top.  Arrange a few strawberries on top.  Refrigerate.

name: CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP
ingredients:
1 big  can clear chicken broth
1 big  can canned chicken or deboned, cooked chicken, cut up
16  oz. pkg. thin noodles
preparation: Combine all ingredients and simmer.

name: FUDGE PIE
ingredients:
1  stick butter, melted
1/4  c. cocoa
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: "PEACH ON THE BEACH"
ingredients:
6  oz. Malibu rum
6  oz. peach Schnapps
12  oz. orange juice
12  oz. pineapple juice
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Pour about 12 ounces into blender with ice cubes.  Blend and serve.  Repeat.

name: GAZPACHO
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. tomato juice
1/2  tsp. salt or garlic salt
1  beef bouillon cube
1  small tomato, chopped
1/4  c. unpeeled cucumber
2  Tbsp. green pepper
2  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
1  Tbsp. salad oil
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire
3  drops Tabasco
preparation: Heat tomato juice until boiling; add bouillon and stir until dissolved.  Cool; add other ingredients and chill several hours. Makes 4 servings.

name: GRANDMA'S CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  lb. cranberries
1/8  tsp. soda
1/8  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
15  marshmallows
1  c. diced apples
1  c. diced celery
1  c. chopped nuts
1  box strawberry jello
1  pt. hot water
preparation: Cook berries, water and salt.  Boil.  Add soda; boil 10 minutes.  Add jello, sugar and marshmallows.  Dissolve sugar. Pour in other ingredients.  Let set up.

name: CHILI CON QUESO
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta, grated
1/4  c. finely chopped green pepper
1/4  c. finely chopped fresh tomatoes
2  Tbsp. finely chopped hot chilies
2  Tbsp. oil
2  Tbsp. flour
2  c. milk
preparation: Saute green peppers, tomato and chilies in the oil; put aside. Bring milk and flour to a boil, turn heat to low and slowly add the grated cheese until melted.  Stir in the vegetables.  Makes 3 to 4 cups.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. butter, room temp
1- 8  oz. pkg. cream cheese, room temp
2 1/3  c. sugar
6  eggs, room temp
3  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In a large bowl, cream butter and cream cheese.  Gradually add sugar, beating until light and fluffy, about 5 to 7 minutes. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Gradually add flour.  Beat just until blended.  Stir in vanilla. Pour into greased and floured bundt pan.  Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours or until cake tests done.  Cool in pan for 15 minutes before removing.

name: OVEN-FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  c. corn flake crumbs
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. dried parsley flakes
3/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. dried basil leaves
1/4  tsp. dried oregano leaves
1/8  tsp. pepper
2 1/2 to 3  lb. broiler-fryer chicken, cut up
1/2  c. butter, melted
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  In shallow bowl, mix corn flake crumbs, Parmesan cheese, parsley flakes, garlic salt, basil, oregano and pepper.  Dip chicken pieces in melted butter, then in crumb mixture, pressing lightly to coat.  Place, skin side up, in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.  Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 45 to 50 minutes or until coating is golden brown and chicken near bone is no longer pink.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: STEAK FINGERS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak
1 1/2  c. buttermilk
1 1/2  c. flour
salt
pepper
preparation: Cut steak into  narrow strips.  Salt and pepper strips. Pour buttermilk over steak and let stand for 20 to 25 minutes. Roll in flour.  Fry in  hot  fat  in  a frying pan over medium heat.

name: COVENTRY CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. minced onion
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: In a bowl, blend cream cheese, parsley and Cheddar cheese. Add onion, Worcestershire sauce and salt; blend well.  Shape into ball.  Chill and serve with crackers.  Quick and easy.  Tastes good.

name: PEPPER JELLY
ingredients:
4  or 5 hot peppers, cored and cut in pieces
1  c. white vinegar
5  c. sugar
4  sweet green peppers, cored and cut in pieces
1  pouch liquid pectin
green food coloring
preparation: Put 1/2 pepper and 1/2 vinegar in blender; process until liquified. Repeat with remaining pepper and vinegar. Combine liquified pepper and vinegar with sugar in large saucepot and boil slowly for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add liquid pectin and boil hard for one minute. Skim and add a few drops green food coloring. Pour into jars, leaving 1/2 inch from top. Wipe jar tops and put on lids.

name: SOUTHERN PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. white Karo syrup
1  c. pecan nuts, cut in pieces
1/2  c. white sugar
2  eggs (can use 3)
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat eggs slightly.  Add sugar; beat.  Add Karo syrup; beat. Add nuts, salt and vanilla.  Put in unbaked pie shell; dot with butter or margarine.  Bake for 50 minutes in slow oven (325°). Pie will seem not done (or loose) after baking, but will settle and firm as it sets.

name: HAMBURGER SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  can stewed tomatoes
1  medium tomato, chopped
1  can your favorite beans
preparation: Chop onions in food processor.  Open and empty cans of tomatoes and beans in 1 1/2-quart saucepan.  Add onion to tomatoes, beans and add raw ground beef.  Mix well.  Cook, uncovered, over medium-low heat for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  This soup will be thick and can be eaten as a dip with heavier chips such as Doritos or Fritos.

name: PEE WEES PIZZAS
ingredients:
1  pkg. Robin Hood pizza crust
Prego pizza sauce
cheese
desired toppings
preparation: Prepare Robin Hood pizza crust per package directions. Separate and give kids individual amounts to make their own pizzas.  Cover with Prego pizza sauce, cheese and toppings of choice.  Bake on low rack at 450° for 12 to 17 minutes.

name: 4 DAY CUCUMBER PICKLES
ingredients:
7  qt. sliced cucumbers
1/2  c. salt
8  c. sugar
5  c. vinegar
2  tsp. pickling spice
3  tsp. turmeric
2  tsp. celery seed
preparation: This  is  one  of the best pickles I have ever tried or tested.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine or fat
1  egg
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
2  Tbsp. buttermilk
1 1/2  c. rolled oats
1  c. chopped raisins or nuts
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
pinch of salt
preparation: Cream  the  shortening and sugar until creamy.	Add the egg and  beat into the mixture.  Add the flour with the other dry ingredients.  Mix  well.  Add  oats,  raisins  and	nuts. Mixture will be thick.  Add the milk.  Drop on greased cookie sheet with a teaspoon.  Grease the cookie sheet before putting the cookies on it.  Bake at 350° until brown.

name: CHICKEN CUTLETS WITH SAUTÉED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. olive oil
Salt and freshly ground pepper
4  chicken cutlets, thinly pounded
1  box (10 oz.) white button mushrooms, sliced
1/2  c. diced red or green bell pepper
1  garlic clove, crushed
4 thin  slices (about 3 oz.) mozzarella cheese
preparation: Heat 1 Tbsp. oil in large non-stick skillet.  Sprinkle chicken on both sides with salt and pepper.  Add to hot oil and cook over high heat 2 minutes each side.  Remove chicken and set aside.  Add remaining 2 Tbsp. oil to skillet.  Add mushrooms and red pepper and cook, stirring over medium heat, 8 minutes or until mushrooms are lightly browned.  Stir in garlic.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper and cook 1 minute more.  Return browned chicken breasts and any juices to skillet.  Place one slice of cheese on top of each. Cover and cook over medium-low heat until cheese melts, about 3 minutes.  Spoon mushroom mixture over chicken and serve.  Makes 4 servings.

name: BROCCOLI SALAD
ingredients:
1  cup mayonnaise or salad dressing
1/4  cup sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
5  to 6 cups broccoli florets
2  to 3 cups cauliflower florets
1  can (11 oz.) mandarin oranges, drained
1/2  cup red onion, chopped
6  to 8 strips bacon, cook and crumbled
1/2  cup raisins
preparation: In a small bowl, whisk mayonnaise, sugar, and vinegar. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. In a large bowl, combine broccoli, cauliflower, oranges, onions, bacon, and raisins. Add dressing and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.

name: CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  large container Cool Whip
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  can cherry pie filling
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

name: CREAMY PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  stick melted butter
1/3  c. finely chopped pecans
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  c. toasted chopped pecans
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/4 to 1/5  c. whole toasted pecans (for garnish)
preparation: Combine graham crackers, butter and finely chopped pecans. Press into bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie pan. Chill for 20 minutes. Beat cream cheese until fluffy, then add 1 1/4 cups sugar and toasted chopped pecans until mixed. Spoon into chilled crust. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes. Remove from oven.  Mix sour cream, 2 tablespoons sugar and vanilla. Spread over baked filling. Bake again at 350° for 10 minutes.  Garnish with whole toasted pecans. Chill for 3 hours.

name: CRAB MOUSSE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  c. celery, finely chopped
1  bunch green onions, finely chopped
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  Tbsp. gelatin
3  Tbsp. cold water
7  oz. crabmeat (approximately)
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in the cold water.  Heat soup.  Add gelatin mixture.  Cool slightly.  Combine other ingredients.  Mix into soup mixture.  Pour into greased mold.  Chill 3 to 4 hours (best overnight).  Serve with fancy crackers or cocktail toast.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
4  tsp. oil
1  c. raw rice
1  lb. ground meat
2 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  large onion, minced
2  c. canned tomato
6  Tbsp. catsup
preparation: Cook first 3 items until meat is brown.  Add other ingredients in order.  Cover and turn heat to low cook 45 minutes.  Do not lift cover after heat is turned down.  This is best cooked in iron skillet or heavy pan.

name: POP'S HUSH PUPPIES(Ottis Bounds)
ingredients:
1  red Delicious apple, finely chopped
2  eggs, beaten
1  small onion, finely chopped
1/4 to 1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
approximately 3/4 c. cornmeal (80%)
approximately 1/4 c. flour (20%)
preparation: Mix cornmeal, flour and seasonings.  Add eggs, apple and onion.  Stir in milk.  Mix well.  Drop by teaspoonful into hot grease.

name: LEMON CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Duncan Hines lemon supreme cake mix
1  c. apricot nectar
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. Wesson oil
4  eggs
juice of 2 lemons
1  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Mix cake mix, apricot nectar, sugar, oil and eggs until smooth. Bake at 325° until done.  After cake is taken out of oven and while still warm, pour mixture of lemon juice and confectioners sugar over cake (warm until confectioners sugar is melted).

name: AMARETTO DIP
ingredients:
1  (12 oz.) Cool Whip
1  pkg. vanilla instant pudding (3 oz.)
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. Amaretto liqueur
preparation: Mix pudding with 1/2 cup milk (use mixer).  Blend in Cool Whip. Add Amaretto liqueur.  Let stand for awhile.  Serve with fresh fruit.  Will keep for several days.

name: MILLIONAIRE PIE(Makes 2 Pies)
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (9 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. coconut
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1/4  c. lemon juice
preparation: Mix altogether.  Put in 9-inch pie shells already baked.  Put in icebox or freeze.

name: MUSHROOM DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. mushrooms
1  small onion, minced
3  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. sour cream
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
garlic salt
paprika
preparation: Cook mushrooms and onion in butter.  Add flour and salt and cook until mixture thickens.  Remove from heat and add sour cream and cheese.  Garnish with paprika.  Bake in casserole at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: OLD FASHIONED SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
1  c. oil
1  c. granulated sugar
1  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking soda
4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Cream the butter or margarine, oil, granulated sugar and powdered sugar. Add the vanilla and eggs. Blend in the baking soda, flour, salt and cream of tartar.  Chill.  Drop by spoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with sugar and bake at 375° for 12 minutes or until brown on bottom.

name: ELEGANT CHICKEN
ingredients:
6  chicken breasts (whole or boneless)
2  cans cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1/4  c. toasted slivered almonds
1/2  c. beer
1 (3 oz.)  can sliced mushrooms, drained
preparation: Dip chicken in mixture of flour, salt and pepper. Brown in 2 tablespoons hot oil on top of stove. Remove chicken and place in a Pyrex dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.  Sprinkle with almonds.

name: CREOLE BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  qt. Wesson oil
1  whole pod garlic
6  sticks celery
2  lb. onions
5  green bell peppers
1  pt. water
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Chop all vegetables.  Cook the ingredients for at least 2 hours and then add balance of ingredients.

name: BAKED POTATOES ELEGANTE
ingredients:
5  medium baking potatoes
1/2  c. sour cream
3  oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. milk
2  Tbsp. butter, softened
1  tsp. onion salt
1/8  tsp. white pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped chives
preparation: Bake potatoes in 375° oven for 70 to 80 minutes or until done. Cut slice from top of each.  Scoop out insides and mash.  Put empty potato skins aside for later.  Add sour cream, cream cheese, milk, butter, onion salt and pepper.  Beat until smooth and fluffy.  Stir in chopped chives. Fill potato shells with mashed potatoes.  Return to oven and bake 15 minutes or more until potatoes are heated through.  Serves 5.

name: CHEESY SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  onion, chopped
3  Tbsp. margarine
6  medium squash, thinly sliced
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
5 1/2  c. grated American cheese
1 small  can chopped green chiles
1  Tbsp. salt and pepper
1  Tbsp. paprika
preparation: In large skillet, saute onion in margarine until transparent. Add sliced squash and let cook in its own liquid.  Combine beaten eggs, sugar, one cup grated cheese and green chiles.  Pour over squash onion mixture.  Mix well.  Pour into dish.  Top with remaining cheese.  Sprinkle with salt, pepper and paprika.  Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven for 30 minutes.  This recipe will serve 6 people.

name: BAKING POWDER BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. sifted whole wheat flour
1  tsp. salt
4  tsp. baking powder
6  Tbsp. margarine
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Cut in shortening with two knives or pastry blender.  Mix in just enough milk to make soft dough, not too wet.  Turn out on lightly floured board.  Pat out to 1/2 to 3/4-inch thickness.  Cut with floured cutter.  Bake on a greased cookie sheet 15 to 20 minutes at 375° to 400°.  Serve hot with butter.  Yield:  12 to 16 biscuits.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. mayonnaise or salad dressing
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. onion salt
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  tsp. onion powder or 1 Tbsp. grated onion
1/2  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Beat cream cheese and mayonnaise until smooth.  Add Worcestershire sauce and other ingredients.  Slowly blend in grated cheese.  Shape into ball and roll in 1/2 cup crushed pecans.

name: FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. margarine
3/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  qt. canned fruit or berries
1/2  c. water
preparation: Make  batter  from the first seven ingredients and pour into greased baking pan, 8 x 10 x 2-inch.  Add canned fruit or berries and water.	(If the fruit or berries are juicy, do not add the water.) Bake one hour at 350° or until golden brown.

name: EASY CHEESE BREAD
ingredients:
3 3/4  c. buttermilk baking mix
3/4  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
3/4  c. water
3/4  c. Pace picante sauce
1  egg
preparation: Combine ingredients; beat vigorously for 30 seconds.  Pour into generously greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  Bake in a 350° preheated oven about 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove from pan; cool on wire cooling rack.  Makes one loaf.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
16  oz. pineapple tidbits, drain a little
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1  roll Ritz crackers, crushed
1/2  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients.  Layer pineapple mixture. Top with crackers, then melted margarine. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. small or 1 pkg. large jello (can use sugar-free)
1  large cottage cheese (can use nonfat)
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix powdered jello with rest of items.  Refrigerate.

name: CHEESY POTATOES
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. hash brown potatoes, thawed
2  cans cream of potato soup
8  oz. pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
8  oz. sour cream
1/2  tsp. onion salt
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Put in a glass casserole dish. Dab top with butter, then sprinkle top with 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered.

name: PIG LICKING CAKE AND ICING
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
4  eggs
1/2  c. oil
1 small  can mandarin oranges (juice and all)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix until well blended.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER CUPS
ingredients:
2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. plus 1 Tbsp. melted butter or margarine, divided
2 3/4  c. confectioners sugar
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Stir together peanut butter, 1/2 cup melted butter and confectioners sugar.  Press mixture into bottom of a 9-inch square pan.  Melt chocolate pieces and stir together with remaining tablespoon of melted butter. Spread on top.  Set in refrigerator for 10 minutes to set chocolate.  Store at room temperature.  Cut into small squares.

name: PADANG BEEF
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. turmeric
3  lemon grass leaves
2  red chilies, crushed
1 1/2  c. coconut milk from 1 coconut
3  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. ginger
1  lb. beef loin, sliced thin
1  tsp. salt
1  bay leaf
preparation: Sauté in oil the garlic, turmeric, ginger and lemon grass. Add meat, chilies and salt. Sauté 3 minutes. Add coconut milk and bay leaf. Cover and simmer until sauce is thick. May be served hot or cold. Serves 4 to 6.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. salad oil (Crisco)
4  eggs, well beaten
2 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
3  c. carrots
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. walnuts
1  box 10x sugar
1/2  stick butter
8  oz. cream cheese
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix  in cheese and butter together; add vanilla and 10x sugar.

name: STIR-FRY SPAGHETTI WITH BEEF
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. oil
1  garlic clove, minced
1/8  tsp. ginger
1  lb. sirloin steak, cut in thin strips
2  Tbsp. oil
1 1/2  c. small fresh broccoli
1  medium onion, cut into wedges
1/2  red bell pepper, wedges
1/2  yellow pepper strips
1 (6 oz.)  jar whole mushrooms, drained
1  c. cold water
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. instant beef bouillon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. Creamette spaghetti, cooked
preparation: In medium bowl combine soy, garlic, ginger and beef.  Toss to coat well.  Marinate 1/2 to 1 hour.  In medium skillet, heat 2 tablespoons oil.  Add beef mixture and broccoli, stir-fry 2 minutes.  Add onion, peppers and mushrooms.  Stir until vegetables are tender-crisp.  Blend water, cornstarch, bouillon and salt. Stir in beef mixture.  Cook until thickened and translucent.  Mix stir-fry mixture with pasta noodles.  Serve hot.  Enjoy.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
4  c. diced apples
2  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
2  c. flour
1/2  c. oil
2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
raisins and nuts
preparation: Pour sugar over apples.  Let stand 20 minutes.  Add eggs, flour, oil, cinnamon, vanilla, soda, raisins, nuts and salt.  Mix well.  Bake in oven at 350° for about 1 hour.

name: ALMOND JOY COOKIES
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
2  oz. unsweetened chocolate
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla extract
3  c. shredded coconut
45  whole salted almonds
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In the microwave, in microwavable bowl combine condensed milk, chocolate and salt.  Cook on High for 5 minutes or until mixture thickens.  Stir after each minute.  Stir in vanilla and coconut.  Form cookies by dropping teaspoons of the mixture on a well-greased baking sheet, 1-inch apart.  Top each with a whole almond.  Bake on the middle shelf of the oven for 10 to 12 minutes, watching the cookies carefully after 8 to 9 minutes, as the bottoms can get too brown.  Immediately remove the cookies from the pan with a metal spatula and cool on wax paper-covered rack.  Freeze well.

name: WHOOPY CAKES
ingredients:
4  c. plain flour
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
1  c. water
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. Crisco
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. cocoa
preparation: Mix all ingredients by hand except for filling. Stir well. Drop by teaspoons on a greased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes at 350°. Let cool.

name: BLUEBERRY BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. fresh blueberries
1 3/4  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. butter
2/3  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. mashed ripe bananas
preparation: Toss berries with 2 tablespoons flour.  Sift remaining flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.  Cream butter or margarine; gradually beat in sugar until light and fluffy.  Beat in eggs, one at a time.  Add flour mixture and bananas alternately, in three parts.  Stir in blueberries.  Bake in greased bread loaf pan at 350° for 50 to 65 minutes.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
8  qt. popped corn (in large roaster pan)
2  c. light brown sugar
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. light corn syrup
1/2  tsp. soda
pinch of cream of tartar
1  c. peanuts (optional)
preparation: Cook the sugar, corn syrup and butter over medium heat until soft ball stage, stirring often.  Remove from heat.  Add soda and cream of tartar (will get foamy).  Drizzle syrup over popcorn, stirring to coat each kernel.  Put in 200° oven for 1 hour, stirring often.  Store in airtight container.

name: ANGEL FOOD PINEAPPLE TRIFLE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can pineapple tidbits
2  small sugar-free instant vanilla pudding
3  c. skimmed milk
1  (8 oz.) fat-free sour cream
10-inch angel food cake
1  (8 oz.) lite Cool Whip
preparation: Cut angel food cake into 2-inch cubes; set aside.  Drain pineapple and save juice.  Mix pudding, 1/2 cup pineapple juice and milk.  Beat 2 minutes, until thickened; add pineapple.  Stir in sour cream until well blended.  Place 1/3 cake in bowl; drizzle 2 to 3 tablespoons pineapple juice over cake.  Spoon 1/3 cup pudding mixture over cake.  Repeat, ending with pudding mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and chill for 3 hours.  Top with Cool Whip when served.

name: SUGARLESS FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped dates
1  c. prunes, chopped
1  c. raisins
1  c. pineapple chunks
1/2  c. oleo
1  c. water
1  c. pineapple juice
2  c. flour
2  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
4  eggs, beaten
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1/2  c. pecans
preparation: Bring to boil the fruits, oleo, water and juice.  Simmer 2 minutes.  Let cool.  Mix flour, soda, cinnamon, salt, eggs, nuts and vanilla.  Add to cooled fruit mixture.  Pour into angel food cake pan.  Cook at 325° for 40 minutes or until done.  Very moist and good.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. oil
1  egg
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2 to 2  c. blueberries (if frozen, do not thaw)
preparation: Stir milk and oil into egg. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Stir in berries. Stir into 12 muffin-lined cups. Top with Crumb Topping. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: MINI SAUSAGES
ingredients:
1  lb. pkg. cocktail sausages
1 1/2  c. red cooking wine
1  c. grape jelly
preparation: Place sausages and wine in a bowl.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Combine all ingredients in a saucepan or electric skillet.  Heat to a slow boil for 5 minutes.  Serve warm.

name: PIZZA PATTIES
ingredients:
1 or 2  slices whole wheat bread
1  pkg. pepperoni
1  slice cheese (Cheddar)
1  Tbsp. pizza sauce or spaghetti sauce
preparation: Place bread on microwavable plate or cookie sheet for oven. Heat at 350° for 10 minutes.  Add sauce, cheese and then pepperoni.  Or for microwave, put on High power for approximately 1 to 2 minutes.  Set out and let cool for 30 seconds or so, then it's all ready to go.

name: SEVEN LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, hand shredded
1 (15 oz.)  can small peas, drained
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. chopped celery
1  pt. mayonnaise
1  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Into a large glass bowl, first place the lettuce.  On top of that put a layer of peas, then onions, green peppers, celery, mayonnaise and cheese.  Toss right before serving.

name: PORK WITH SWEET PEPPERS
ingredients:
1  lb. center-cut pork chops
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/8  tsp. pepper
cooking spray
3  small bell peppers (red, green and/or yellow), sliced
2  tsp. chopped scallions
1  clove garlic, mashed
1/4  c. beef stock
1/2  tsp. rosemary
1  tsp. cornstarch
preparation: Mix together the flour, thyme and black pepper.  Remove bones and excess fat from chops.  Dredge in flour mixture.  Spray frying pan and heat until hot.  Brown pork and remove to a warm platter. Drain excess fat from pan.   Add peppers, scallions and garlic. Stir-fry 2 minutes.  Combine beef stock, cornstarch and rosemary. Add to skillet.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and cook just until thick.   Pour over pork.

name: APPLESAUCE SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
1/3  c. oil
1  egg
1  c. unsweetened applesauce
1 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg or cloves
1  c. raisins
1  apple, pared, cored and diced
preparation: Combine the oil and egg in large mixing bowl.  Beat in the applesauce.  Sift the dry ingredients.  Add gradually to the batter, beating until smooth.  Stir in raisins and apple.  Bake in greased 9-inch round cake pan at 325° for about 25 minutes.  Cool completely.

name: CHRISTMAS PIE
ingredients:
1  can pie cherries
1  can crushed pineapple
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  box orange jello
1  c. sliced bananas
1  c. chopped nuts
2  baked pie shells
preparation: Mix cherries, pineapple, sugar, cornstarch together and cook until thick. Stir in dry jello and let cool. Add bananas and nuts. Pour into pie shells and refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can celery soup
1  small onion, chopped
1  bell pepper, chopped
chili powder and garlic (optional)
grated cheese
1  pkg. nacho cheese Doritos
preparation: Brown meat, onions and bell pepper in skillet.  Layer Doritos in bottom of casserole.  Add soups and tomatoes to meat.  Pour over Doritos.  Sprinkle grated cheese on top.  Cover with foil and bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: SPAGHETTI PIE
ingredients:
6  oz. spaghetti
2  Tbsp. butter
1/3  c. grated Romano cheese
2  well-beaten eggs
1  c. cottage cheese
1  lb. ground sausage
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 (8 oz.)  can tomatoes, cut up
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. dried oregano, crushed
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Cook spaghetti and drain.  Stir butter into hot spaghetti. Stir in Romano and eggs.  Form spaghetti mixture into a "crust" in a buttered 10-inch pie pan.   Spread cottage cheese over spaghetti crust.

name: POPPY SEED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  chicken, boiled and cut up
2  rolls Town House or Ritz crackers
1 1/2  sticks butter, melted
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. poppy seed
preparation: Mix  crackers,	butter	and  poppy seed.  Press half of this mixture  into casserole dish.  Place chicken over crackers.  Mix soups and sour cream.  Pour over chicken.  Top with remaining crackers.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CRABMEAT CANAPES
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  jar Olde English cheese spread
1 1/2  tsp. mayonnaise
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. Krazy mixed up salt or seasoned salt
1 (7 oz.)  can crabmeat
6  honey wheat English muffins
preparation: Note:  Have all ingredients at room temperature.

name: LISA'S BREAKFAST CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 large  pkg. frozen hash browns
2  c. grated cheese
1  medium white onion, chopped
6 eggs, whisked together with 1  c. milk (may use Egg Beaters and skim milk)
preparation: In 13 x 9-inch casserole, sprayed with vegetable spray, layer hash browns, cheese and onions.  Pour egg mixture over top of layers.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until top is bubbly and brown.  Serve with fruit, bacon, biscuits.

name: SOUR CREAM CANDY
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. corn syrup
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. nuts
2  Tbsp. butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. almond extract
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix sugar, cream, syrup and salt.  Let come to a boil.  Cook gently without stirring to soft ball stage.  Remove from heat; add butter, cinnamon, almond extract and vanilla.  Let stand without stirring, until pan is just cool enough to be held on the palm of the hand.  Stir in nuts and beat candy until it loses its gloss and begins to "fudge".  Quickly pour into buttered pan. Let stand until firm; cut into squares.

name: LINGUINI WITH CLAM SAUCE WHITE
ingredients:
1  can minced clams
1  can whole baby clams
1  bottle clam juice
oil
2  cloves garlic
linguini
parsley
salt and pepper
red pepper
garlic powder
preparation: Cover the bottom of a saucepan with oil.  Add chopped garlic; saute until golden in color.  Add seasonings.  Stir in clams, clam juice and parsley.  Simmer until clams are heated through, about 5 minutes.  Boil linguini; strain.  Add sauce.

name: RICE AND BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  slices bacon
1 (15 oz.)  can black-eyed peas with jalapeno peppers
1 (16 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
2  c. uncooked instant rice
1  medium onion, sliced
preparation: Fry bacon.  Remove from pan and drain all but 2 tablespoons of oil.  Mix the rest of ingredients in pan.  Cook, stirring until well coated.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Crumble bacon over top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

name: COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1  head cabbage
3  carrots
1/4  finely chopped large onion
1/4  c. sugar
1  c. mayonnaise
preparation: Grate cabbage and carrots.  Add onions.  Add salt and pepper to taste and about 1/4 cup sugar.  Add about 1 cup mayonnaise.  If this is not enough mayonnaise, add enough until slaw is creamy.

name: SHOO-FLY PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sifted flour
1  c. light brown sugar, firmly packed
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. butter
3/4  c. boiling water
1/2  c. light molasses
3/4  tsp. baking soda
unbaked pie shell (9-inch)
preparation: Combine first 4 ingredients in bowl.  Cut in butter with pastry blender or two knives until mixture resembles fine crumbs.  Combine boiling water and molasses and stir in baking soda (mixture will foam).  Arrange alternate layers of crumb and molasses mixture in pie shell, beginning and ending with crumb mixture.  Bake in moderate oven at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes, or until top and crust are browned and filling set.  Cool.  Serve plain or topped with vanilla ice cream.

name: HOMEMADE DONUTS
ingredients:
2 (10 count)  cans biscuits
Crisco oil
confectioners sugar
preparation: Heat Crisco oil in deep pan.  Cut centers out of biscuits with a syrup lid.  Place donut cut biscuits in hot oil.  Cook until brown on both sides.  Dip in confectioners sugar until covered.

name: AUNT BETTY'S IRISH OATMEAL BREAD(1 Loaf)
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
1 1/4  c. rolled oats
1 1/2  Tbsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  egg
1/4  c. honey
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.   Grease 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  In large bowl, mix flour, oats, baking powder and salt.  In medium bowl, beat egg, honey and milk with rotary beater.  Pour egg mixture into oat mixture, stirring just until moistened.  Spread batter in pan.  Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes, until crusty and cake tester comes out clean.  Turn loaf out on wire rack.  Brush top with melted butter.

name: JEAN'S BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
4 (15 oz.)  cans pork and beans
1/2  lb. dark brown sugar
1/2  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
4  to 5 strips bacon
water
preparation: Use 2 1/2-quart or larger baking dish.  Open cans and empty into baking dish.  Add sugar and stir until dissolved; add catsup and Worcestershire and stir in.  Add enough water to make "soupy"; put bacon strips on top and bake approximately 1 1/2 hours at 400°.  Will not be set completely when you shake dish.  Serves 12 to 15 people.

name: WHIP CREAM FROSTING
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. Crisco shortening
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. white sugar
3  tsp. flour
1/2  c. warm milk
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat ingredients until creamy for about 8 minutes.

name: CHERRY CRUNCH
ingredients:
1 (1 lb. 5 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  pkg. Duncan Hines white deluxe cake mix
1/2  c. chopped nuts (as desired)
1/2  c. (1 stick) melted butter or margarine
sweetened whipped cream, ice cream or coffee cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Spread pie filling in the bottom of a 9-inch square pan.  Sprinkle with lemon juice.  Combine dry cake mix, nuts and melted butter.  Sprinkle over pie filling.  Bake 40 to 50 minutes until golden brown.  Serve with ice cream, whipped cream or serve with warm coffee cream.

name: TAHITI SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. cooked rice
1 (7 oz.)  can kernel corn, drained
1  bell pepper, chopped fine
1/4  c. vinegar
2  tomatoes, chopped
2  boiled eggs, chopped
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed veggies
1  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. oil
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
dash of garlic pepper
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. green olives, sliced (optional)
preparation: Combine and mix well.  Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

name: PINEAPPLE - CARROT SALAD
ingredients:
8 1/4  oz. can pineapple slices
2  carrots
1/4  c. raisins
1/4  c. pineapple-orange yogurt
lettuce leaves
measuring cup
can opener
fork
paper towels
cutting board
sharp knife
shredder
mixing bowl
rubbing scraper
4  salad plates
ice cream scoop
preparation: Use fork to put pineapple on paper towels to drain.  Save juice to use another time.  Wash carrots.  Put on cutting board. Shred the carrots and put into bowl.  Add the raisins and yogurt to carrots.  Stir with a rubber scraper until mixed.

name: THREE BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can kidney beans
1  can lima beans
1  can pork and beans
1  lb. ground beef, drained
1  small onion
1  small bell pepper
1/4 to 1/2  c. catsup
1/4 to 1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Brown ground beef with onion chopped in it; drain.  Chop bell pepper; add with rest of ingredients.  Mix.  Put in casserole dish; bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: MULLED CIDER
ingredients:
2  qt. apple cider
1/4  c. brown sugar
2  sticks cinnamon
1  tsp. whole cloves
1/8  tsp. ground ginger
1  orange, sliced (unpeeled)
1  tsp. allspice (optional)
preparation: Put in crock-pot.  Cover; heat on low for 2 to 5 hours or longer.

name: LOW-FAT, EASY AND ELEGANT DESSERT
ingredients:
angel food cake mix
1  large container Cool Whip
chocolate syrup
nuts (optional)
cherries (optional)
strawberries (optional)
preparation: Bake an angel food cake according to box directions.  Split in middle (horizontally) after baking and cool.  Use Cool Whip and chocolate syrup, mixed together.  Ice the inside layer first, then the sides and top.  Can decorate with nuts, strawberries or cherries.  May be frozen.

name: MICROWAVE TORTILLA PIZZA
ingredients:
8-inch flour tortilla
3  Tbsp. tomato or pasta sauce
sliced mushrooms
green onion, chopped
1/2  c. Mozzarella or Muenster cheese, shredded
1  Tbsp. Parmesan or other hard cheese, grated
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
preparation: Place tortilla between two sheets paper towel (pierce with fork first).  Microwave on High 1 minute or until barely crisp.  Place on paper plate lined with paper towel.  Spread with sauce. Sprinkle with mushrooms, onions, cheeses and oregano.  Microwave on Medium-high 2 minutes or until cheese is melted.

name: BANANA CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. shortening
3  eggs
1  c. mashed banana
1/2  c. sour milk
2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Beat sugar, shortening and eggs.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Bake at 350° in cake pan for 45 minutes or until done.

name: CHEESE AND SAUSAGE BALLS
ingredients:
10  oz. sharp cheese, grated
1  lb. ground hot sausage
3 1/4  c. Bisquick
1/2  tsp. red pepper
2  tsp. dried parsley
preparation: Let cheese and sausage warm to room temperature.  Add Bisquick, red pepper and parsley.  Mix with hands thoroughly. Roll into inch size balls.  Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 375° for 15 minutes.  Can be frozen.

name: EASY POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
shredded potatoes to fill 3/4 (2-quart) casserole (frozen hash brown patties can be used)
salt and pepper to taste
1 1/2  Tbsp. onion, chopped
half and half coffee cream
shredded or cut up cheese (optional, but cut down on salt)
preparation: Shredding potatoes is easy compared to shredding carrots but they do discolor.  Put them in cool water and then drain.  Mix them with salt, pepper and onion and pour half and half over to just barely cover.  Bake at 350° for an hour or until done.  Serves 6.

name: SIMPLE CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2 (15 oz.)  cans cream-style corn
2  eggs, beat well
4  Tbsp. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Grease casserole and pour in 2 cans of corn.  Blend in the two well beaten eggs.  Mix flour and sugar, then blend into corn mixture.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to an hour.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: SIRLOIN TIP ROAST
ingredients:
3  lb. beef roast
2 or 3   Tbsp. oil
2  cans beef broth
1  pkg. Lipton onion soup
4  Tbsp. Kitchen Bouquet
preparation: Brown the roast in oil, searing the outside.  This will make a dark, rich gravy.  Add to this the other ingredients, especially the Kitchen Bouquet seasoning.  The Kitchen Bouquet gives the meat a wonderful flavor.  Cook in a pressure cooker for 30 minutes at 15 pounds pressure or cook in a Dutch oven for 2 hours on a medium heat.  Keep covered.

name: NO BAKE PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. plus 1 Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  c. thawed Cool Whip
1  graham cracker pie crust
2 small  pkg. vanilla instant pudding
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. cloves
preparation: Mix cheese, 1 tablespoon of milk and sugar until smooth.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Spread in bottom of pie crust.  Mix 1 cup of milk with instant pudding until smooth.  Let set 3 minutes.  Stir spices in pumpkin.  Fold in instant pudding.   Spread over cheese in pie crust.  Chill for 2 hours.  Garnish with Cool Whip and sprinkle with nutmeg and sliced toasted almonds.

name: HASHBROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
30  oz. frozen hash browns
2  c. shredded cheddar cheese
1  stick of butter
1  pint sour cream
1/2  c. chopped onions
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Melt butter over low heat.  Add cheese until melted.  Remove from heat.  In a separate bowl, mix sour cream, onion, salt and pepper.  Add butter and cheese mix.  Mix with frozen hash browns. Spread in large casserole dish.  Slightly dot the top with butter. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

name: CORNSTARCH GOOP
ingredients:
several Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. water
preparation: Put a few spoonfuls of cornstarch into a cup.  Add water, a few drops at a time, until the cornstarch is pasty.  Now pick up this goop and squeeze it, it's crumbly.  Hold it loosely, it oozes through your fingers.  It's as though you can change the substance from a liquid to a solid by simply squeezing it.

name: DIET NAPOLEON SQUARES
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. graham cracker crumbs
5  Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. melted diet margarine
2  pkg. diet instant pudding of choice
2 (20 oz.)  cans crushed pineapple (undrained)
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. light Cool Whip
8  Tbsp. coconut
preparation: Mix graham cracker crumbs and margarine; spread in a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan.  Bake at 350° for 5 to 7 minutes.  Cool. Mix packages of pudding (dry), pineapple with juice, lemon juice and Cool Whip; spread over graham cracker crust.  Sprinkle with coconut.  Refrigerate.

name: 125 YEAR OLD WALNUT POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter
5  eggs
3  cups sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  cup half and half
1/2  cup shortening
3  cups plain flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. lemon extract
1  cup finely chopped black  walnuts
preparation: Cream butter and shortening.  Add sugar and beat well.  Add eggs one at a time and beat. Mix 1/2 flour with nuts and other half of flour with baking powder.  Mix in alternately with milk, starting and ending with flour.  Fold in nuts.  Bake in a large greased and floured pan for 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325 degrees. Do not open oven for the first hour.

name: SPARKLING PINEAPPLE DRINK
ingredients:
1  qt. pineapple juice
1  qt. club soda
ice cubes
1  c. strawberries (for garnish)
preparation: Fill 6 glasses 2/3 full of pineapple juice; add club soda and ice cubes.  Garnish and serve.

name: NEVER FAIL FUDGE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
1 small  can evaporated milk (5 oz.)
1 (7 1/2 oz.)  jar Fluff
3/4  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. vanilla
1  (12 oz.) peanut butter chips
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients.  Stir over low heat until blended.  Bring to a boil over moderate heat.  Be careful not to mistake air bubbles for boiling.  Boil slowly, stirring constantly for 5 minutes (soft ball stage).  Remove from heat.  Stir in chips and vanilla until chips have melted.  Turn into a buttered 9 x 9-inch pan.  Let cool.

name: PITTSBURG POTATOES AND WHITE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  qt. potatoes, cubed
1  onion, finely chopped
1/2  c. pimiento, cut in small pieces
1  tsp. salt
1/2  lb. cheese
2  c. White Sauce
preparation: Cook potato cubes and onions in boiling salted water for 5 minutes.  Add pimiento and cook 7 minutes.  Drain.  Put in a buttered baking dish and pour White Sauce over all, mixed with cheese and salt.  Bake in a moderate oven until potatoes are soft.

name: HUGS AND KISSES BON BONS
ingredients:
12  oz. Semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/4  c. butter
14  oz. condensed milk
2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
Hershey's Hugs or Kisses
preparation: Melt together chocolate chips and butter. Remove from heat and stir in milk, flour and vanilla. Wrap one tablespoon of dough around either the Hershey's Hugs or Kisses. Bake at 350 degrees for 6 to 8 minutes. Cookies will appear soft and shiny. Cool completely.

name: MILE HIGH LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1/4  c. cornstarch
3  Tbsp. flour
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
4  egg yolks, beaten
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. lemon peel, grated
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: In medium saucepan, combine cornstarch, flour, sugar and salt. Mix well.  Gradually add 2 cups water and stir until smooth. Bring to boil over medium heat and boil 1 minute.  Remove from heat.  Quickly stir some hot mixture into egg yolks and return this to rest of hot mixture.  Return to heat, cook on low for 5 minutes.  Remove, gently stir in lemon juice, peel and butter. Pour into pie shell.

name: MILKY WAY CAKE
ingredients:
5  Milky Way candy bars
2  sticks margarine
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1 1/4  c. buttermilk
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Melt Milky Way bars and one stick butter; set aside.  Cream sugar and one stick butter.  Add eggs mixing well.  Combine flour and soda and sift.  Add flour mixture and buttermilk to sugar and butter; mix well.  Add candy and butter.  Stir in chopped pecans. Bake in a tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done.

name: ONION FLAVORED HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. water
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Combine all ingredients and stir well.  Drop by spoonful into hot grease.  Fry to a golden brown or until bread floats.

name: FRUIT TRAY DIP
ingredients:
1  jar marshmallow cream
8  oz. cream cheese
1/4  c. orange liqueur
2  Tbsp. grated orange peel
1/4  tsp. grated ginger
preparation: Mix all the ingredients together.  Refrigerate to blend flavors.  Let set at room temperature for two hours before serving.

name: FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1  c. salad oil
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. vinegar
2/3  c. catsup
juice of 1/2 lemon
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. paprika
preparation: Combine all ingredients in blender and blend for about 1 minute.  Store in refrigerator.

name: HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. hash brown potatoes, thawed
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese (save 1 c. for top)
1/3  c. melted oleo
3  Tbsp. chopped chives
preparation: Mix all ingredients except potatoes.  Add potatoes.  Pour into a casserole; top with 1 cup cheese.  Bake at 350° until light brown and bubbly.

name: CRANBERRY CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. chopped, unpeeled apples
2  c. whole (1/2 pack) raw cranberries
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. water
preparation: Mix and put in casserole.

name: EASY CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  c. fried boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut up
1/3  c. toasted slivered almonds
2  medium stalks celery, sliced
preparation: Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt and pepper.  Toss with chicken, almonds and celery.  Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours.  Serve on salad greens.

name: CORN, RICE AND BEAN SALAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. cooked converted rice
1 (16 oz.)  can pink kidney beans, rinsed and drained
2  Tbsp. fresh lime juice
1  Tbsp. packed brown sugar
1/2  tsp. ground cumin
2  pickled jalapeno peppers, stemmed, seeds and ribs removed and finely minced
1 (12 oz.)  can corn niblets
1/3  c. chopped scallions
1/3  c. safflower/corn oil
1  Tbsp. cider vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. chili powder
preparation: In a large bowl, combine rice, beans, corn, scallions and jalapeno peppers.  Toss to mix.  In a small bowl, combine the oil, lime juice, vinegar, brown sugar, salt, cumin and chili powder. Whisk to blend well and dissolve the sugar.  Pour the dressing over the salad.  Toss to coat.  Let stand at room temperature, tossing occasionally, for up to 4 hours before serving or cover and refrigerate for up to 3 days.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: HAMBURGER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/4  c. shredded coconut
green food coloring
24  vanilla wafers
12  small chocolate mint patties
preparation: Put the coconut in a small bowl with a lid.  Add a few drops of the food coloring.  Put on the lid and shake until the coconut turns green.  Put 12 wafers flat side up on a baking sheet.  Place a mint on top of each wafer.  Bake the wafers at 350° for 1 minute.  Immediately sprinkle each wafer with coconut (lettuce). Top with remaining wafers flat side down and you will have hamburger cookies.

name: SWISS HAM AND POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed cream of potato soup (undiluted)
1  c. half and half
3/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. diced, cooked ham
1/4  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: In medium saucepan over low heat, heat all ingredients, stirring occasionally.  Makes about 4 cups or 3 servings.

name: FLAKY PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. flour (all-purpose)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. oil
2  Tbsp. cold water
preparation: In a medium bowl, sift together flour and salt.  Dribble oil over flour.  Mix with flour until oil and flour are mixed.  Dribble water over this mixture.  Stir to form smooth ball.  Dampen work surface.  Put large wax paper down.  Put dough on this.  Cover with another piece of wax paper.  Roll out.  Remove wax paper.  Shape in pie plate.  Prick holes in shell for cream pies.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in a 425° oven.

name: HOT "PHILLY" SPREAD
ingredients:
1 or 2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  small onion, chopped
1  tsp. cream horseradish
dash of salt and pepper
1 or 2 (6 1/2 oz.)  cans fancy crabmeat
preparation: Blend all ingredients.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with crackers.

name: ASKANSAS HASH
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. hamburger
2  medium onions, chopped
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. uncooked rice
1/2  c. warm water
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  c. celery, chopped
1/4  c. soy sauce
onion rings
preparation: Brown hamburger in skillet and drain.  Mix all ingredients together and bake in a large baking dish at 350°, covered, for 30 minutes.  Uncover and add onion rings and bake 10 minutes longer.

name: CREAMY PEANUT BUTTER CANDY
ingredients:
5  c. sugar
1  can Carnation milk
1  jar marshmallow cream
2  sticks butter
1  c. peanut butter
2  c. pecans
preparation: Mix  sugar,  butter and milk;  cook for 6 to 8 minutes. Take off stove  and  stir  in  1  cup  peanut butter and 1 jar marshmallow cream.	Add 2 cups pecans.  Spread on cookie sheet and let cool.

name: HAM ROLL-UP CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
6  to 8 green onions, chopped top to bottom
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. ham, diced
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. Accent
preparation: Mix all together in large bowl.  Turn out onto cupboard; knead until completely blended.  Divide into 3 equal parts.   Roll in plastic wrap.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.  Will stay fresh for 5 to 7 days.

name: ZUCCHINI RELISH
ingredients:
10  c. ground zucchini (1 extra large one)
4  c. white onions or 3 c. yellow onions
5  Tbsp. pickling salt
2 1/4  c. white vinegar
4 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. nutmeg
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. turmeric
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. celery salt or 1 tsp. celery seed
1  red pepper
1  green pepper
preparation: Mix first three ingredients well and let stand overnight. Drain, rinse and drain well.  Put all ingredients in large kettle and boil 20 minutes.  Stir often.  Makes 7 pints.  Seal in hot sterile jars.

name: CHEESE POTATOES
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1/2  c. half and half cream
1  c. grated cheese
5  potatoes, sliced 1/4-inch thick
salt and pepper
1  onion, sliced
preparation: Layer 3 pieces of heavy foil crisscross.  Melt butter.  Place potatoes on foil.  Pour butter and cream on top.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Lay onion slices on top.  Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours.

name: EGG SANDWICH FILLING
ingredients:
6  eggs
3/4  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. pickles, chopped
1/2  c. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. flour
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Beat eggs.  Add milk and all other ingredients.  Cook in 2 tablespoons shortening.  Stir well while cooking.

name: CREAMY CHICKEN
ingredients:
8  chicken breast halves
1  pt. heavy cream
1  crushed garlic clove
1  pkg. frozen green peas
preparation: Brown chicken breasts in butter.  Place in a baking dish.  Mix heavy cream with garlic and pour over chicken.  Bake at 350° for about an hour; baste with sauce.  Cook and drain peas; add to chicken and heat through.  Serve over rice.

name: OREO COOKIE CAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. Oreo cookies
1/2  c. melted margarine
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. softened cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
2  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
1 large  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
preparation: Crush Oreo cookies; reserve 1/2 cup.  Mix remaining crumbs with margarine and press into 9 x 13-inch container.  Refrigerate 1 hour (or freeze) until set.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick butter
3/4  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
2  c. peaches, peeled and sliced
preparation: Melt butter in 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.  Mix flour, sugar and milk and pour onto melted butter.  Top with peaches.  Bake at 350° about one hour.

name: CORN FLAKE CANDY
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. light corn syrup
1  c. peanut butter
5  c. corn flakes
preparation: Mix sugar and syrup in saucepan.  Bring to a boil for one minute.  Remove from heat and add peanut butter.  Stir until smooth.  Pour over and stir corn flakes.  Spoon out onto wax paper. Cool.

name: APPLE SALAD
ingredients:
2  large Red Delicious apples
1/2  can crushed pineapple
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. pecans
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. pineapple juice
3  Tbsp. plain yogurt
preparation: Mix together and refrigerate.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen broccoli spears
butter
6  chicken breasts, baked and boned
garlic salt
grated cheese
almonds
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
3  Tbsp. milk
1  c. grated cheese
3  Tbsp. cooking sherry
paprika
preparation: Cook broccoli, then layer broccoli, chicken, dots of butter and garlic salt in greased casserole dish. Mix soup, sour cream, milk, 1 cup grated cheese and sherry. Heat. Pour over meat and broccoli. Sprinkle with cheese, paprika and almonds. Bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: ATTITUDE ADJUSTMENT RECIPE
ingredients:
1/2  c. healthy anger
1  c. self-confidence
1  Tbsp. savvy
dash of determination
pinch of purpose
1  oz. optimism
preparation: Let anger brew to the simmering point.  Remove from heat before it comes to a boil.  Combine with self-confidence.  Add savvy, determination and purpose and mix energetically with optimism until well blended.  Be careful not to crush, beat or whip into a frenzy or mixture will turn sour.  Top off with a generous helping of the sweetness of life.  Shake yourself vigorously, then let settle. Serves anyone willing to sample it.

name: CHILI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  gal. tomatoes, peeled and chopped
2  c. onion, chopped
2  c. sweet red pepper, chopped
1  small hot pepper, chopped
1  clove garlic, sliced thin
1  tsp. whole cloves
1  tsp. whole allspice
2  tsp. whole cinnamon
1  c. brown sugar
3  c. vinegar
3  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. black pepper
preparation: Combine chopped vegetables.  Tie spices in a bag and add to vegetables.  Cook rapidly, stirring often to prevent sticking. When the vegetables have cooked down to about half the original amount, add the sugar, vinegar and salt.  Boil rapidly for 5 minutes; stir constantly.   Pour into hot jars.  Wipe rims.  Place lids and rings on tightly.  Process in hot water bath for 5 minutes.  Start processing time as soon as water returns to a boil.

name: JEANNINE'S PEPPERONI BREAD
ingredients:
1  lb. frozen bread dough
1/2  lb. pepperoni, sliced thin
3/4  lb. Provolone cheese, sliced thin
2  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. oregano
preparation: Thaw frozen bread dough according to package directions; divide in half.  Roll out very thin.  Brush with egg and oregano. Spread pepperoni on dough, then Provolone cheese on top of pepperoni.  Brush again with egg mixture.  Roll up and place on slightly oiled cookie sheet.  Brush top with rest of egg mixture; may need to use another egg if this is not enough.  Repeat same directions on second piece of bread.  Both loaves fit on same pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve warm as appetizer, or may be served like pizza with a salad for a light dinner.

name: PASTOR'S PERFECTION BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
3 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1 small  bottle Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  lb. butter
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/8  tsp. red pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. seasoned pepper
preparation: Simmer all ingredients for 30 minutes.  Ready to serve.

name: SAVEYBARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  c. apples
2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. raisins
1/2  c. nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix the first 3 ingredients.  Sift and add the next 6 ingredients.  Stir in raisins, nuts and vanilla.  Bake in greased 13 x 9-inch pan for 35 to 45 minutes at 350°.  Frost with thin coating of confectioners sugar icing while warm.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  medium zucchini
1/2  c. sour cream
1  Tbsp. chives
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. grated Swiss cheese
bread crumbs
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Slice zucchini thin and simmer in butter for 6 minutes.  Melt sour cream and Swiss cheese.  Add zucchini, butter and chives. Stir to coat.  Season well with salt and pepper.  Top with bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.  Heat 30 minutes in 375° oven.  Serve.

name: CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
1  can crushed pineapple
1/4  tsp. salt
3  tsp. lemon juice or vinegar
1/2  c. chopped celery
2  pkg. orange-pineapple Jell-O
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. mayonnaise
10  cut marshmallows or miniatures
preparation: Use the juice of the pineapple and add enough water to make 4 cups of liquid.  Bring to a boil, adding marshmallows.  Dissolve Jell-O in mixture.  Set in refrigerator until it begins to thicken, then add remaining ingredients.  Pour into favorite mold. Chill and serve on lettuce.

name: A SALAD FOR COMPANY
ingredients:
leaf lettuce
fresh spinach
mandarin oranges
fresh mushrooms
black olives
artichoke hearts
preparation: Serve on chilled plates and pour Honey Dijon dressing on lightly and serve.

name: GREEN BEANS ALMONDINE ALA BETH
ingredients:
1/2  lb. whole green beans (frozen)
1  Tbsp. water
1  tsp. olive oil
1/4  tsp. chives (dried)
1/4  tsp. tarragon (dried)
1  Tbsp. sliced almonds
preparation: Saute ingredients over  medium-low  heat  for  10 to 15 minutes, stirring  constantly.  Mix in sliced almonds.  Serves 2.

name: ENGLISH PEA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  stick butter or margarine
1  pkg. Good Season's Italian Dressing
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas
1  jar sliced mushrooms
1  can sliced water chestnuts
preparation: Melt butter or margarine and mix in package of Italian Dressing.  Mix frozen peas, mushrooms, and water chestnuts.  Add seasoning & butter mixture to pea mixture and stir.  Bake at 350° 1 hour.  Stir occasionally.

name: MONSTER COOKIES
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
1  lb. brown sugar
1/2  Tbsp. corn syrup
1/2  Tbsp. vanilla
9  c. oatmeal
4  oz. chocolate chips
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  lb. peanut butter
6  eggs
4  tsp. baking soda
4  oz. M&M's candies
4  oz. chocolate chunks
preparation: Combine butter, sugars, peanut butter and syrup in very large bowl.  Cream until sugars are dissolved.  Scrape bowl.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Blend well.  Combine soda and oatmeal and add and mix well.  Stir in chocolate.  Drop on cookie sheet using a big tablespoon for each.  Bake at 325° for 12 to 14 minutes.  Let cool slightly before removing from sheet.

name: QUICK MUSHROOM STEAK WITH RICE
ingredients:
3  to 4 minute steaks
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
3/4  can of water
1 small  can drained sliced mushrooms
preparation: In large skillet, brown steaks (thoroughly cook). In separate bowl, combine soup with water. Add mushrooms. Mix together. Pour over steaks. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Serve with rice.

name: APPLE PIE
ingredients:
7  to 8 apples
1  c. brown sugar or 3/4 c. granulated sugar
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
dash of cinnamon
1/4  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Peel, core and slice apples.  Mix sugar, spices, salt and lemon juice; toss with apples.  Fill pie with apples, piling high in center.  Cut butter in small cubes over apples.  Cover with top crust.  Bake in a 450° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.  Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 20 to 30 minutes more until crust is brown.

name: CREAMY RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cooked rice
2  c. skim milk
2  Tbsp. sugar
4  packets Sweet One (artificial sweetener)
1  large egg
1/2  c. golden raisins
1  Tbsp. reduced calorie margarine
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
dash of ground cinnamon
preparation: In a medium-sized saucepan over medium heat, combine rice, 1 1/2 cups milk, sugar and sweetener.  Cook 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and slightly creamy.  Beat remaining milk and egg; stir into rice mixture.  Stir in raisins. Continue cooking slowly for 2 minutes.  Stir in margarine and vanilla.  Mixture will thicken as it stands.  Pour into serving bowl and sprinkle with cinnamon.  Makes 8 (1/2 cup) servings with 120 calories per 1/2 cup.

name: Mexican Casserole
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can taco sauce
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies
1  bag taco-flavored chips
1/2  lb. cheese, grated
preparation: Mix all canned ingredients together with meat and heat until bubbly.  Stir in chips.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: SQUASH DRESSING
ingredients:
2  c. cooked and mashed squash
2  c. cooked cornbread, crumbled
2  eggs
salt and pepper to taste
1/2  c. green onions, chopped
1  stick oleo
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Mix together.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: NO BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/4  lb. margarine
1/2  c. milk
1  c. peanut butter
2 1/2 to 3  c. uncooked quick cooking oatmeal
preparation: Combine sugar, cocoa, butter and milk; boil for 1 minute at rolling boil.  Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter.  When thoroughly blended, stir in oats.  Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper.  Cool and store.

name: PICKLED BEETS
ingredients:
3  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
1  c. water
fresh beets
preparation: Cook beets until tender; skin and slice.  Mix vinegar, sugar and water; bring to a boil.  Add sliced beets.  Return to a boil; cook 3 to 5 minutes.  Put in jars and seal.

name: CHEESE BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  lb. New York State sharp cheese, grated
1  stick margarine
2  c. sifted plain flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. ground red pepper (I use almost 1/2 tsp. red pepper)
preparation: Put peanut butter on soda crackers.  Place marshmallows on top.  Place under broiler and watch closely until marshmallows are brown.

name: HELLO DOLLIES
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  stick butter
1  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1  c. coconut
2  c. graham cracker crumbs
preparation: Melt butter and combine with graham cracker crumbs.  Mold into the bottom of a 12 x 12-inch pan.  Layer coconut on top of graham cracker crumbs.  Layer chocolate chips over coconut.  Drizzle Eagle Brand over entire mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: 8 MINUTE CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/3  c. sugar
1  c. (1/2 pt.) sour cream
2  tsp. vanilla
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip, thawed
1  Keebler graham crust (large size)
fresh strawberries for garnish (optional)
preparation: Beat cream cheese until smooth; gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla.  Fold in whipped topping.  Blend well.  Spoon into crust.  Chill until set, at least 4 hours. Garnish with strawberries if desired.

name: ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
12  egg whites
1  c. sifted powdered sugar
1  c. sifted cake flour
1/2  tsp. almond flavoring
1 1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. sugar (granulated)
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat egg whites until stiff, but moist.  Add cream of tartar slowly.  Fold in granulated sugar slowly.  Sift powdered sugar and flour together.  Fold into egg whites.  Bake in large tube pan in preheated 300° oven for 1 hour.  Turn pan upside down and let cool before removing from pan.

name: HAMBURGER-BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  can (16 oz.) green beans, drained
1  can (10 3/4 oz.) condensed tomato soup
1  c. Bisquick
1/4  c. water
preparation: Heat oven to 425°.  Cook and stir beef and onion until brown. Stir in salt, pepper, beans and soup.  Heat to boiling.  Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Keep hot in oven.  Stir flour and water to dough.  Knead 5 times.  Roll dough to fit casserole.  Bake 15 minutes.  Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: PINEAPPLE CHEESE DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. soft margarine
1/4  c. chopped nuts (walnuts or pecans)
1 1/2  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. confectioners sugar
1/4  c. milk
1  pt. whipped heavy cream
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Crust:  Mix together flour, sugar, softened margarine and nuts.  Press into 11 x 7-inch Pyrex dish.  Bake at 400° for 5 minutes or until lightly tanned.  Do not overbake.  When cooled, spread with cream cheese mixture.

name: ENCHILADA SAUCE OR RED CHILE FOR STEW
ingredients:
6  strips bacon
1/3  c. flour
1/4  c. red chili powder
2  cans chicken broth
10  chili pods
1  clove fresh garlic
onion powder to taste
garlic powder to taste
salt to taste
preparation: Cook bacon.  Take out cooked bacon and put flour and chili powder in hot grease on low heat for a few minutes.  Stir in 1 can of chicken broth and some water until gravy is boiling.  Pour in blended chili peppers, along with whole garlic clove.  Simmer for approximately 20 minutes.  Add salt, onion powder and garlic powder to taste.

name: FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
4 1/2  qt. unsweetened pineapple juice
juice of 12 lemons
juice of 12 oranges
juice of 5 limes
3  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. mint leaves
6  qt. dry ginger ale
3  qt. plain soda water
1  pt. fresh strawberries, quartered
preparation: Combine pineapple, lemon, orange and lime juices, sugar and 1/2 of crushed mint leaves.  Chill.  Just before serving, add ginger ale, soda water, whole mint leaves and quartered strawberries.  Pour over large cake of ice in punch bowl.  Yields 75 cups.

name: SALTED NUT ROLL
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  jar dry roasted peanuts
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. peanut butter chips
3 1/2  Tbsp. oleo
2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Spray a 9 x 12-inch cake pan with cooking spray.  Spread 1/2 jar of peanuts in bottom of pan.  In bowl, microwave until just blended the Eagle Brand milk, peanut butter chips and oleo.  Stir, then add marshmallows and microwave until melted.  Stir well and pour over nuts in cake pan.  Spread rest of nuts on top and refrigerate until it sets.  Keep refrigerated.

name: SCRIPTURE CAKE(Found in Old Testament)
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. 1 Kings Chapter 4 Verse 22
1  c. Judges Chapter 5 Verse 25
2  c. Jeremiah Chapter 6 Verse 20
2  c. 1 Samuel Chapter 30 Verse 12
2  c. Nahum Chapter 3 Verse 12
2  c. Numbers Chapter 17 Verse 8
2  Tbsp. 1 Samuel Chapter 14  Verse 25
1  tsp. Leviticus Chapter 2 Verse 13
6  eggs Jeremiah Chapter 17 Verse 11
1/2  c. Judges Chapter 4 Verse 19
2  tsp. Amos Chapter 4 Verse 5
2  tsp. 2 Chronicles Chapter 9 Verse 9
preparation: Mix thoroughly.  Bake in tube pan at 275° for 3 to 4 hours.

name: GENEVIEVE'S HOT MILK SPONGE CAKE
ingredients:
4  large eggs
2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. hot milk mixed with 1/2 cube margarine
2  c. flour
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large bowl add ingredients in the order listed.  Be sure to mix continually with a mixer and then quickly place in ungreased oblong pan and bake for 45 minutes. The bubbles in the batter are important to make a spongy cake.  Ice with Caramel Coconut Frosting if desired.

name: FUDGE PIE
ingredients:
1  sq. Baker's unsweetened chocolate
1/2  c. melted butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
2/3  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
preparation: Melt chocolate and butter or margarine.  Let this cool.  Mix remaining ingredients.  Cook in greased pie plate (or tinfoil plate) at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: HOT WINGS
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken wings
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. hot sauce
1  pkg. original Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
preparation: Arrange chicken in a shallow pan.  Melt butter.  Add vinegar and hot sauce to butter.  Stir to mix.  Pour over chicken and marinate 30 minutes.  Sprinkle Ranch dressing on top and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BREAKFAST BEFORE 6
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. sausage
6  eggs
2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. dry mustard
3  slices of bread
preparation: Cook sausage; drain well.  Cut bread into cubes with crust off.  Beat eggs and seasoning; add milk.  In 9 x 13-inch pan, layer bread, sausage and cheese.  Pour egg mixture over.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BEST EVER LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. sugar
2  c. water
3  eggs, separated
1 1/2  tsp. lemon extract
6  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/3  c. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix sugar and cornstarch together in top of double boiler. Add 2 cups water.  Combine egg yolks with lemon juice and beat. Add to rest of mixture.  Cook until thick over boiling water for 25 minutes (this does away with starchy taste).  Add lemon extract, butter and vinegar.  Stir thoroughly.  Pour into a deep 9-inch pie shell.  Let cool.  Cover with meringue.  Brown meringue in oven.

name: HONEY-PECAN PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
4  fresh pork chops
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
3  Tbsp. butter, divided
1/4  c. honey
1/4  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Pound each chop to 1/4-inch thickness.  Dredge chops in flour, shaking off excess.  Heat one tablespoon butter in heavy skillet over medium heat.  Add chops and brown on both sides, about 5 to 6 minutes.  Stir together remaining butter, honey and pecans.  Add to skillet; stir gently.  Cover and simmer gently for 7 to 8 minutes.  Remove pork chops to serving platter and pour the sauce over them.  Preparation time: 20 minutes.

name: OLD-FASHIONED SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. white sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. shortening (I use butter)
3  eggs
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. lemon extract or 2 tsp. vanilla
3  c. or more flour
preparation: Combine sugars and shortening until creamy and fluffy.  Beat in eggs. Stir in sour cream, blending well. Sift flour with dry ingredients.  Add to the batter with lemon extract or vanilla. Add enough flour  so dough can be easily rolled out.  Roll out on floured board to 1/4-inch thick.  Cut with a large cookie cutter. Sprinkle with sugar.  Place a raisin or pecan half in the center of each cookie.  Place on lightly greased cookie sheets and bake at 350° until lightly browned (about 10 minutes).

name: SAUERKRAUT CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. sugar
2/3  c. shortening or butter
3  eggs
1 1/4  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cocoa
1  c. water or beer
2/3  c. sauerkraut, chopped, rinsed and drained
preparation: Cream together sugar and shortening.  Add eggs, mix well and then add vanilla, salt and cocoa.  Sift together flour, baking soda and baking powder.  Alternating, add flour mixture and water. Fold in kraut by hand.  Bake in greased and floured pan for 35 to 45 minutes at 375°.  Use either one 9 x 11-inch pan or two regular round pans for a layer cake.  Frost with mocha, sour cream or cream cheese icing.

name: CRUMBLE TOPPING FOR PIES
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1  c. cornflakes cereal, crumbled
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Blend together and put on top of pie.

name: MELTING MOMENTS
ingredients:
1/2  c. cornstarch
1/2  c. powdered sugar
2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. butter or margarine
preparation: Mix all ingredients, form into 2 rolls and refrigerate until firm.  Slice and bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 10 minutes.  Frost with favorite frosting.

name: TORTILLA SOUP
ingredients:
1  chopped onion
2  chopped garlic cloves
4  medium chopped tomatoes
1  can beef broth
2  cans chicken broth
2  c. V-8 juice
1  tsp. cumin
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. A.1. sauce
handful of fresh snipped cilantro
8  corn tortillas
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Saute onion and garlic in 2 tablespoons oil.  Add other ingredients and simmer one hour.  During last 20 minutes, add the tortillas which have been cut into 1-inch strips.  Remove pot from burner and add the cheese.

name: RICE CON QUESO
ingredients:
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. water
1 (14 oz.)  can drained and chopped no-salt tomatoes
1  c. uncooked long grain rice
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped and drained green chiles
2  Tbsp. minced fresh cilantro
1/2  c. (2 oz.) shredded low-fat Jack cheese
